This was because the record of the "Shadowless Step" was not in the script of the Southern Border but in the script of the Central Plains, which explained Zhao Tong's vague comments. He likely didn't practice it not because he didn't want to, but probably because he couldn't understand it.
Besides the text, the booklet also included eighteen portraits of a masked woman, either walking or standing, poised slantingly or sideways, with her movements appearing graceful. Each image came with countless footprints which at a glance seemed chaotic but upon closer scrutiny were nothing short of astonishing, with densely packed footprints numbering in the hundreds.
In less than half an hour, Yuan Ming had memorized the entire content of the booklet. However, when he closed the book, he was somewhat irritated.
"Zhao Tong, why did you deceive me?" Yuan Ming frowned and asked.
"When have I ever deceived you?" Zhao Tong sat up straight, also puzzled.
"The 'Shadowless Step' you gave me is incomplete, the content is not whole," Yuan Ming said with a knitted brow.
"Incomplete?" Zhao Tong's expression turned slightly embarrassed upon hearing this.
Clearly, he was unaware of this.
"Incomplete or not, the 'Shadowless Step' was given to me by an elder, and I can't understand it, you can't blame me for that." But quickly, he spread his hands in an indifferent manner as if saying it wasn't his problem.
Although Yuan Ming was dissatisfied, he was helpless.
Compared to other registered disciples whose attitudes were aloof and arrogant, Zhao Tong had been quite decent to him, and he couldn't demand too much, especially since he himself hadn't contributed much.
Moreover, even though the 'Shadowless Step' was only the first volume, the content outlined in the general principles certainly wasn't some common technique, and it was at least much higher level than the 'Wood Stabbing Technique'.
Additionally, after practicing this movement technique, not only would he be more confident in facing enemies in combat, but tracking and stealth would also become much easier, especially when encountering fierce beasts with high alertness, making it easier to track and approach them.
Yuan Ming intended to take his leave, he had already clenched his fist in farewell, but then he suddenly remembered the incident of Hagon being attacked and said:
"Oh, there's one more thing I need to ask about?"
Seeing that he wasn't holding a grudge over the incompleteness of the 'Shadowless Step', Zhao Tong smiled and said, "What's the matter? Let's hear it."
Yuan Ming immediately recounted Hagon's experience and described the long-haired creature.
After listening, Zhao Tong set down the book in his hand and pondered with a furrowed brow.
"What you're talking about, I really don't know what it might be. When I have time, I'll go back and ask my sect mates for you," Zhao Tong said after a moment, shaking his head.
Yuan Ming had no choice but to express his gratitude and then bid farewell.
He didn't linger in Toad Valley and went straight out. As soon as he exited the valley, a young man with a stocky build and a scar across his face approached him.
"Brother Yuan, I've been to Toad Valley to find you many times, and today I've finally caught up with you. Do you have any healing ointment?" The scarred young man's face showed surprise and joy as he enthusiatically approached Yuan Ming.
"Oh, Tu Lei, I'm really sorry, I don't have any extra stock on hand lately," Yuan Ming said with an apologetic look.
"Quit it with that, last time you promised me two jars of ointment. Without giving me the goods, you're not leaving Toad Valley today," Tu Lei said, stretching out his hands and blocking the way with a ruffian's demeanor.
"You really are... Alright then, this was meant for my own use, but since you're in such a rush, I'll let you have it first," Yuan Ming said as he took out two bamboo jars filled with ointment from his bag and handed them over.
"Heh heh, that's more like it. This is your payment; don't say I'm taking your things for nothing," Tu Lei laughed as he threw over a small cloth bag.
Yuan Ming opened the cloth bag, took a look inside, and quietly stowed it away.
The two chatted for a bit more before parting ways.Th%is[email protected] *r- is par-t+ of the col*l&ecti-o$n+ on *.
Yuan Ming left the valley and arrived at a dense forest. He leaped onto a large tree and reopened the cloth bag.
Inside was a piece of beast skin filled with tiny letters, detailing recent events in the nearby woodlands.
The man named Tu Lei was a member of a group called the Earth Bear Association, a small team of about a dozen people.
Unlike the Green Wolf Gang, the Earth Bear Association's way of doing things was much more amicable, and its members were all people who relied on their own strength to collect Blood Food, never once having a bad record of plundering others.
Yuan Ming had met Tu Lei more than two months earlier and had saved his life. Tu Lei, being a man of loyalty and righteousness, was very eager to repay the favor, but sadly he lacked the power to do so.
Noticing that Tu Lei was smooth in handling people and good at networking, Yuan Ming had him help collect information on the Fur Beast Slaves in the mountains, so he could stay informed about various situations in a timely manner.
The two met every now and then, using trade as a cover for their real intentions.
As Yuan Ming read the content on the beast skin, his expression grew grave. According to the information gathered by Tu Lei, the Green Wolf Gang had found the bodies of Ba Yin and his party, and deduced from the chain of events that he was the killer.
It was also written on the beast skin that Gang Leader Wu Bao of the Green Wolf Gang was offering a Half-magical Artifact weapon as a reward for information on Yuan Ming's whereabouts.
"If that's the case, I can't go to Toad Valley anymore for the time being. There are too many people there and it's too easy to draw the attention of those with intentions," Yuan Ming suddenly thought of something and turned to leave.
He pushed his speed to the limit, made a large circle in the forest to ensure no one was following, and then returned to the vicinity of his log cabin.
In the cabin, Hagon was lying down and resting.
Suddenly, he opened his eyes, struggled to sit up, gripping the Green Wolf beast skin, ready to activate the Fur Cloak Skill at a moment's notice.
"It's me," Yuan Ming's voice came from outside the door.
Seeing this, Hagon let out a sigh of relief and sat back down.
"No one has been here while I was away, right?" Yuan Ming asked as he entered.
"This place is quite secluded; no one has come. I've been resting and regaining my strength. But what about you, why such a solemn face? What happened?" Hagon asked after giving Yuan Ming a glance.
"The Green Wolf Gang knows it was I who killed Ba Yin. They are offering a reward and looking for me everywhere. We probably can't stay here much longer; we need to move to an even more secluded place to lay low for a while," Yuan Ming said slowly.
"You actually killed Ba Yin! You have a lot of nerve. He was at the Qi Refining Third Level, not much weaker than Wu Bao. How on earth did you manage it?" Hagon was taken aback.
"I just played a little trick; it's nothing worth mentioning. What are your plans now, Brother Hagon? The Green Wolf Gang is going all out to find me, but they probably aren't paying much attention to you. Are you going to leave with me or go your own way?" Yuan Ming changed the subject to ask.
"Brother Yuan, you underestimate me too much. We, the people of the Wusun Tribe, hold gratitude and loyalty in high regard. If I am given a measure, I will repay tenfold. You didn't hesitate to expose yourself to danger to save me. If I were to leave now, how could I ever face Lord Dog God again with pride?" Hagon huffed, a trace of anger showing on his face.
"My words were careless. Please forgive me, Brother Hagon," Yuan Ming said, bowing his hands.
Having stayed in the Ten Thousand Mountains for some time, he had started to understand a bit about the customs and culture of the Southern Border.
The native inhabitants of the Southern Border were called Wild Men by the Central Plains people, and they usually lived in tribal communities. Each tribe had its customs and beliefs, which they held sacred and abhorred any infringement upon.
"Brother Yuan is from the Central Plains and knows nothing about my Wusun Tribe, so there's no need for such formality. Just do not say such things again in the future," Hagon said, his expression softening considerably upon hearing Yuan Ming's sincere apology.
"I will remember that. Since Brother Hagon has made up his mind, then let's leave quickly. Every extra moment we stay here is a moment of added danger," Yuan Ming said.
"All right, but I'm having trouble moving now, so I'm counting on you to help with that," Hagon said with a spread of his hands.
Without saying much, Yuan Ming picked up Hagon and left the cabin, heading toward the ravine.
The safest place, naturally, was on the opposite side of the ravine.
It was a remote location, devoid of Fierce Beasts, and therefore seldom visited by Fur Beast Slaves. Currently, it was suitable both for a quiet recovery and as a hiding spot from the pursuit of the Green Wolf Gang.
The most important thing was the fog-filled ravine. Even if the entire Green Wolf Gang came looking for him, he could hide in the fog at the bottom of the valley, making their search futile regardless of their numbers.
With Yuan Ming's current strength, even while carrying Hagon, he reached the other side of the ravine quickly.
He didn't look for a new place but directly took Hagon to a cave he had lived in before.
After spending so much time with Hagon, Yuan Ming had mostly figured out his nature. He found him to be honest and trustworthy, worthy of friendship. Since the cave wasn't a place of any strategic importance, it was no problem to reveal it to him.
"I never thought you had such a place, Brother Yuan," Hagon remarked, clicking his tongue in admiration upon seeing the well-equipped cave.
"I found this place when I first arrived. The people from the Green Wolf Gang won't find it anytime soon. There's plenty of food and water inside the cave as well, so you can rest easy here," Yuan Ming said.
Hagon nodded, sat cross-legged, and started cultivating to heal his injuries.
Yuan Ming didn't stay to cultivate but instead walked outside, quickly arriving at a quiet grove.
He had brought Hagon here not only to avoid the Green Wolf Gang's search and to give Hagon a place to heal in peace but also for his own purposes.
His current situation was quite precarious, and he needed to improve his strength as much as possible to ensure his safety in case of emergencies. Advancing his cultivation was not something that could be achieved overnight, but the newly acquired Shadowless Step Technique was an immediate choice to show significant results.
This movement technique was profound and mysterious, requiring time and space to practice. The remote and quiet ravine was thus an ideal place.
Yuan Ming stood still, closed his eyes, and recalled the words and illustrations of the Shadowless Step Technique. He then took a deep breath, sinking his qi to his Dantian, took the first step, and exhaled sharply as he moved on to the second...

chapters.title: Chapter 57 - 37: Prenatal Care
chapters.content:
While Yuan Ming was wholeheartedly practicing his step technique, Toad Valley was still bustling with activity.
About ten miles away from Toad Valley, in a shaded clearing, Wu Bao, the leader of the Green Wolf Gang, sat cross-legged with his eyes closed, breathing deeply and rhythmically.
Suddenly, a series of hurried footsteps interrupted the silence, as a figure rushed in.
"Zan Bai, what have you found out?" Wu Bao asked without opening his eyes.
"Gang Leader, as you guessed, Yuan Ming did go to Toad Valley not long ago. Unfortunately, we were a step late, and the kid slipped away," Zan Bai reported, bowing respectfully.
"Hmph, even Ba Yin met his demise at his hands. Did you really think that you could hold him if you were only a bit earlier?" Wu Bao snapped, his eyes suddenly open and filled with a cold gaze.
"Gang Leader, please calm your anger. I have not returned empty-handed. Yuan Ming entered the valley and made transactions with two people," Zan Bai hurriedly said.
Wu Bao just looked at Zan Bai, remaining silent.
"One of them is a Registered Disciple named Zhao Tong. He's somewhat greedy for money. After being given some benefits, he allegedly sold only a step technique to Yuan Ming. The other is named Tu Lei, a member of the Earth Bear Association who deals in information. I suspect that Yuan Ming knows from him that we are hunting him," Zan Bai said with a dry laugh before continuing.
"Understood. Find Yuan Ming's whereabouts at all costs. I want to meet him personally. Also, reiterate to those forces, especially Hyena Hall, they must not kill Yuan Ming when they catch him. I want him alive," Wu Bao commanded, then closed his eyes again.
"Understood, I shall take my leave," Zan Bai responded, then retreated.
"Yuan Ming... to be able to kill Ba Yin by yourself, you must be at least at the Qi Refining Second Level. You must have some secret on you! I want to see what kind of fortuitous encounter lets you increase your cultivation so rapidly," Wu Bao muttered, opening his eyes once more with a sharp gleam in them.
...
The forest near Yuan Ming's cave dwelling.
An eerie shadow flickered among the trees, now on the left, and in the blink of an eye, appearing on the right, without affecting any of the underbrush. The shadow didn't touch even a single blade of grass or leaf, as if it wasn't made of flesh and blood.
The figure suddenly stopped and landed on a large rock, revealing Yuan Ming, who was gasping for breath with a look of joy in his eyes.
He had been back here for three days already.
During these three days, Yuan Ming didn't practice the Nine Elements Technique; all his time and effort were devoted to practicing the Shadowless Step.
While the location was secluded, there was no such thing as an impermeable wall in the world, so it was possible that the Green Wolf Gang people could find him. It was essential to boost his strength as much as possible.
He discovered that he had quite a talent for step techniques. Within just a few short days, he had already mastered the basics of the Shadowless Step.
The more he practiced, the more he appreciated the profound mysteries of the Shadowless Step Technique. Once executed, his movements were as rapid as the wind, truly living up to the "shadowless" aspect of its name.
Furthermore, this technique was particularly adept at nimble movements in narrow and complex environments, which went well with the White Ape Transformation.
However, using the Shadowless Step was quite taxing on the body and heavily drained his mana. With his current mana pool at the Qi Refining Third Level, even without using any other spells, he could sustain it for at most a quarter of an hour. To wield this technique better, he needed to continue improving his cultivation and conditioning his physical body.
"If even a Fur Beast Slave could have the chance to learn such a marvelous step technique, I wonder how powerful the spells and divine skills of the Biluo Cave Disciples are!" Yuan Ming looked toward the direction of Biluo Cave's entrance, feeling a surge of aspiration.
Yuan Ming came back to his senses, sat down cross-legged, and started to cultivate the Nine Elements Technique.
After cultivating for so many days, he found that the Nine Elements Technique not only rapidly absorbed nature's spiritual energy into the body, enhancing his mana, but also quickly restored his physical strength when cultivated.
His ability to master the Shadowless Step in such a short time was also thanks to the recovery capability of the Nine Elements Technique.
Yuan Ming's physical strength and mana were quickly replenished, and he returned to the cave.
In the corner of the cave, Hagon sat cross-legged.
After several days of healing, the wound on Hagon's chest had scabbed over, and routine movements were no longer a problem, but he still needed more time to fully recover.
In his hands, he held his green wolf skin, muttering to himself as if casting a spell, but it wasn't the Fur Cloak Skill. Where his palms touched the green wolf skin, there was a flicker of light.
"What are you doing?" Yuan Ming asked curiously.
Hagon didn't answer Yuan Ming, continuing his chanting. Only after the time it took to eat a meal did he open his eyes, and the light on his palms disappeared.
"Sorry, I was nurturing the Furred Beast Skin. This process can't be interrupted," Hagon apologized with a slight note of regret.
"It doesn't matter, but what is nurturing Furred Beast Skin? I've never heard of it before." Yuan Ming, who had sat down to cultivate, opened his eyes and asked.
"It's a bit complicated to explain and it starts with the process of refining Furred Beast Skin," Hagon seemed to be choosing his words, remaining silent for a while before he continued.
"Do you know the process of refining Furred Beast Skin? I would like to hear the details." Yuan Ming's eyes lit up as he spoke.
"I heard about it from a street vendor who is a disciple of the Biluo Cave in Toad Valley. The Biluo Cave throws live Fierce Beasts into a secret array, and as the array operates, the beast's flesh, bones, and Beast Soul will all be refined into Primordial Qi and merged into the Beast Skin. If the process goes without error, a piece of Furred Beast Skin will be born. The Furred Beast Skin we hold in our hands may look like just a piece of skin, but in fact, it contains all the Life Essence of a Fierce Beast," Hagon explained.
"Beast Soul..." Yuan Ming muttered to himself, recalling the situation when the Mysterious Incense Burner had enhanced the two pieces of Beast Skin.
He had suspected that the Furred Beast Skin contained Beast Soul, and now it seemed to be true.
"The Primordial Qi refined from the flesh and bones of the Fierce Beasts is actually not important. What's crucial inside the Furred Beast Skin is the Beast Soul! Brother Yuan, you have been using the Fur Cloak Skill for so long, you must have felt the presence of the Beast Soul to some extent, right?" Hagon continued.My Virtual Library Empire (*) thanks you for reading at the source.
"I have noticed a little," Yuan Ming hummed in response.
"These pieces of Furred Beast Skin are already lifeless, and the Beast Soul inside is constantly weakening. So-called nurturing of Furred Beast Skin involves using Mana to warm the skin and stabilize the Beast Soul within," Hagon finally got to the point.
"The weakening of the Beast Soul cannot be reversed, can it? So what's the purpose of stabilizing the Beast Soul?" Yuan Ming nodded first, then asked.
"Nurturing the Beast Skin can not only slow the weakening of the Beast Soul but also make oneself more in sync with the Fur Cloak Skill, allowing for better control over the transformation. With good fortune, it's also possible to awaken the potential of the Beast Soul, gaining one or two new abilities. Of course, this is something one may encounter but cannot seek after, and it requires a very long time," said Hagon, a glint of hope flashing in his eyes.
"Awakening new abilities by stimulating the potential of the Beast Soul!" Yuan Ming silently repeated in his mind, glancing at his right arm.
From the previous performance of the Mysterious Incense Burner in repairing the Beast Skin and stimulating abilities, it seemed to be nurturing the Beast Soul to some extent too, and with an effect far surpassing the so-called nurturing secret technique mentioned by Hagon.
"Are you interested in the secret technique of nurturing Beast Skin? I obtained this technique by chance and will gift it to you," Hagon saw Yuan Ming lost in thought and thought he was interested in the nurturing secret technique. Hagon took out a piece of Beast Skin covered in tiny characters and handed it over.
"Then I thank you, Brother Hagon." Yuan Ming was indeed interested in the nurturing technique and did not stand on ceremony.
"Brother Yuan saved my life. A minor secret technique is nothing in comparison," Hagon laughed heartily, then pointed out a few key points of the nurturing secret technique to Yuan Ming before closing his eyes to continue cultivating.
Yuan Ming found the nurturing technique to be uncomplicated in content. The principle was to transform one's inner Mana into a type of energy that could nurture the Divine Soul and then use special methods to inject it into the Furred Beast Skin to nurture the Beast Soul. The strength of a piece of Furred Beast Skin was closely related to the strength of the Beast Soul contained within it.
After roughly understanding the principles, Yuan Ming wasted no time in operating the Nine Elements Technique, slowly channeling Mana into the White Ape Skin according to the method of the nurturing secret technique. Where his palm touched the Ape Skin, a faint white glow emerged, similar to when Hagon was casting earlier.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming silently nodded and continued to channel Mana.
Time passed incrementally, and after nearly half a day, he noticed a stronger connection between himself and the White Ape Skin.
However, the degree of strengthening was quite limited. To enhance the power of the Fur Cloak Skill through this would require years of dedicated cultivation, and it not only consumed a substantial amount of Mana but would also affect daily practice.
"Previously, when the incense burner strengthened the Beast Skin, it depended on whether the skin would absorb it on its own. Now with this nurturing secret technique, if I stimulate the Heat Flow inside the incense burner to merge into the White Ape Skin, I wonder if it will be more effective?" A thought suddenly crossed his mind.
No sooner said than done, Yuan Ming quietly moved to a secluded spot outside the cave and took out the incense burner in his hand.
A Heat Flow emerged from the incense burner, and Yuan Ming quickly operated the nurturing technique, trying to guide this Heat Flow and carefully directing it onto his right hand.
"I hope this technique works," he prayed silently, pointing his finger and injecting the Heat Flow from the incense burner into the White Ape Skin.
The White Ape Skin absorbed the Heat Flow like a sponge, moving on its own without wind, and then manifested the Fur Cloak Skill, adhering to Yuan Ming's body and transforming into a White Ape shape.
White patterns appeared all over the White Ape's body, shining with bright white light, and the shadowy figure ofAppdeSoul arose once more, much more solid than before.
In addition, Yuan Ming found that his connection with the Ape Skin had deepened somewhat, conservatively estimated to be the equivalent of two months of cultivating the nurturing technique.
He breathed a sigh of relief, then continued to induce the Heat Flow from the incense burner into the Ape Skin, causing the white patterns to shine even brighter.
After injecting the Heat Flow over a dozen times, even with the nurturing technique's enhancement, the White Ape Skin absorbed no more Heat Flow from the incense burner.
At this point, the patterns on the Ape Skin grew thicker, glowing brightly, and the shadowy figure of the White Ape became semi-transparent and substantial, emitting waves of excited roars.
Yuan Ming's connection with the Ape Skin on his body deepened significantly, allowing him to clearly sense the flow of demonic power within the Ape Skin and even feel the demonic power, while maintaining the Fur Cloak Skill, continuously seeping into his meridians, internal organs, Dantian, and even his brain like mercury spilling to the ground.
"So this is how the Fur Cloak Skill erodes the body," he put away the incense burner and narrowed his eyes.
Now that he knew the pathways through which demonic power backlashes against the body, he naturally had a better grasp of how to resist it in the future.

chapters.title: Chapter 58 - 38 Encirclement
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming transformed into the White Ape, quickly moved his hands and feet, and confusion appeared on his face.
He could feel that the compatibility and connection with the Beast Skin had strengthened, but for some unknown reason, the power of his transformation hadn't increased.
As Yuan Ming was pondering, he suddenly felt a warmth all around him. A surge of strong demonic power gushed out from the White Ape Skin, spreading like a flood into every part of his body. Suddenly, there was a loud "bang" within him!
The next moment, his body inflated rapidly like being pumped full of air, his muscles writhed, and his bones made cracking noises.
This change came quickly and went just as fast, lasting only the duration of two or three breaths.
The form of the White Ape grew by a tenth, and his muscles also bulged larger, his hands becoming more sharply clawed.
Yuan Ming took a deep breath, feeling a strength throughout his body that was stronger than before, and his heart swelled with exhilaration.
The method he had clumsily discovered by chance to enhance the might of his White Ape Skin transformation, if given the time, he would definitely study it thoroughly, for it was currently his greatest reliance in battle.
Yuan Ming released the Fur Cloak Skill and returned to the cave. Soon after, he came back out holding a piece of black Beast Skin, which was the toad skin he had found.
If the Nurturing Technique was effective on the White Ape Skin, perhaps it would work similarly on the Toad Beast Skin.
He immediately used the Fur Cloak Skill to transform into the shape of a toad and, following the same method, activated the Nurturing Technique to drive the warm stream emerging from the incense burner, slowly infusing it into the toad skin.
As he predicted, the toad skin also absorbed the heat, but it only accommodated five or six streams before stopping, and no matter how hard Yuan Ming tried, there was no further reaction.
"It seems that the growth potential of Beast Skins varies. This toad skin is far from being on par with the White Ape," Yuan Ming thought to himself.
A few breaths later, a cold yet powerful demonic power transmitted from the Toad Beast Skin, giving him a chilling and unusual sensation all over his body.
Yuan Ming closed his eyes to perceive it carefully and a smile appeared on his face.
The toad form he became didn't increase in size, but there was a significant increase in the strength of his limbs. He breathed more powerfully into his lungs, and the time he could stay underwater had doubled.
However, what excited him was not this, but the new ability that the toad transformation had awakened.
He crouched his body down, and mana flowed into the black protuberances on his back, which wriggled and suddenly enlarged substantially.
Poop! The g!en%ui!ne art!i*c^l@e$ res+ides on M+|V!|L+&+E*MPY%R.
Dozens of black liquid jets sprayed from the protuberances, striking a bush in front like arrows.
Hiss... Hiss...
The lush green leaves rotted at a visible rate, and the tough bark also cracked quickly as if all the moisture was sucked out by the black liquid.
In less than half an hour, a thriving bush withered and died, leaving only a few thick branches barely intact, the rest turned into rotten black mud.
"What a powerful poison liquid. I'll call it Toad Poison Arrow," Yuan Ming inhaled sharply.
"That said, what exactly are these streams of warmth coming from the incense burner? They have such an evident nurturing effect on the Beast Soul?" Yuan Ming stopped his transformation and lightly patted the Incense Burner Mark on his arm, his thoughts stirring once again.
The incense burner had previously allowed his consciousness to possess others, even control their behavior, and now it could enhance the Beast Soul contained within the Furred Beast Skin to increase its might. Each time it managed to amaze him, evidently, it was a reclusive Exotic Treasure. When the day came that he could leave this place, he must thoroughly examine it.
When Yuan Ming returned to the cave, Hagon had already stopped nurturing his Beast Skin and was lying on a bed of dry grass, resting with his eyes closed. The green wolf skin was placed to one side.
Yuan Ming glanced at the wolf skin and sat down.
It was quite clear that the incense burner could enhance the Beast Skin, and it would definitely work on the Green Wolf Skin too. Hagon could be considered his friend, and at this moment, they were in the same predicament. Should he also help him strengthen it?
However, for safety reasons, the secret of the incense burner could not be leaked, even if he wanted to give Hagon a hand, he couldn't let him discover it.
Just then, Yuan Ming suddenly stood up, tilted his head as if listening carefully, his expression quickly darkening.
"Hagon, get up!"
"What is it?" Hagon wasn't asleep, and at the sound, he quickly sat up.
"Someone's coming, and there's quite a few of them!" Yuan Ming said in a grave tone.
"Are they enemies? Should we run?" Startled, Hagon grabbed the green wolf skin beside him.
"There's no time." Yuan Ming shook his head, and with a flicker, he was at the cave entrance, looking out through a crack at the distant figures.
A dozen figures had already come into view, soaring quickly towards them, reaching the entrance in a few breaths and surrounding the exterior in a fan shape.
Clearly belonging to two different forces, the two leaders – one a man with black hair, a hooked nose, and three scars on his face; the other a short, stout man with blonde hair and green bean eyes.
"It's Wu Bao of the Green Wolf Gang and Jin Kun of the Hyena Hall! Those two gangs have always been at odds; why would they show up together?" Hagon also came to the entrance, and upon seeing the people outside, he gasped.
Yuan Ming didn't speak, his expression fluctuating between cloudy and clear.
He had certainly heard of the Hyena Hall, equal in fame to the Green Wolf Gang. If it were only the Green Wolf Gang coming, he was confident he could escape unscathed, but with the addition of the Hyena Hall, the situation became much more complicated, particularly since both gang leaders had shown up at the same time.
"Hehe, Gang Leader Wu Bao, I'm not bragging, but in these Ten Thousand Mountains, there's no one we from the Hyena Hall can't find," the blond man Jin Kun said with a laugh, picking his teeth with a slender Beast Bone.
Wu Bao looked at the cave in front of him and snorted coldly, forming Sealing gestures with both hands. As his palms buzzed, a pigeon egg-sized purple Thunder Ball suddenly appeared out of nowhere.
"Not good!" Yuan Ming's pupils contracted as he quickly retreated backward, pulling Hagon with him.
Wu Bao waved his right hand through the air, and the Thunder Pearl disappeared in a flash.
The next moment, dazzling purple light flashed through the woods, and a bolt of purple lightning appeared out of thin air, striking the boulder at the entrance of the cave.
With a loud "bang," the rock, several feet high, exploded on cue, shattering into countless pieces that flew in all directions, kicking up a huge cloud of dust.
"Who would've thought Wu Bao actually mastered the Thunderfall Skill!" Jin Kun's eyes flashed with a fleeting hint of apprehension.
The Thunderfall Skill, like the Wood Stabbing Technique, fell under the category of Spells. There were countless Spells in the Cultivation World, which ultimately all fell within the scope of the Five Elements: Gold, Wood, Water, Fire, and Earth.
However, there are always exceptions in this world. Some individuals or demon beasts in the Cultivation World were born with extraordinary talents, or encountered major events later in life that allowed them to cultivate and control powers that didn't belong to the Five Elements.
In such cases, the Cultivation World referred to it as an Abnormal Spirit Root.
There are many types of Abnormal Spirit Roots, the famous ones including the Thunder Spirit Root, the Shadow Spirit Root, the Poison Spirit Root, etc. It's hard to say whether an Abnormal Spirit Root is good or bad. A positive mutation can strengthen the Spirit Root, but a negative mutation could harm the body.
The Thunder Spirit Root was considered a positive mutation, and the Thunder attribute was known for its formidable destructive power. Because the natural world generates the power of thunder and lightning, the Thunder Spirit Root was relatively more common compared to other Abnormal Spirit Roots, producing quite a few Thunder Attribute spells and Divine Skills. The Thunderfall Skill was one of the lower-level ones, but its power was far beyond that of Five Elements Magic like the Wood Stabbing Technique.
Wu Bao flicked his sleeve, and faint green light twinkled at his fingertips. A gust of wind sprang up from nowhere, sweeping through and blowing away all the dust at the cave entrance.
The situation inside the cave became clear. Yuan Ming wasn't hiding his tracks and stood there calmly, but Hagon was nowhere to be seen.
Wu Bao's brow furrowed. When he had first arrived, he clearly saw two people inside the cave.
"Gang Leader, be careful. The other person is probably hiding in the shadows. Yuan Ming's behavior is likely a ploy to draw us in. Acting rashly will probably result in an ambush," Zan Bai whispered from the side.
Wu Bao almost imperceptibly nodded his head and made a gesture with his left hand behind his back.
Members of the Green Wolf Gang slowly shifted their positions, surrounding one side of the cave entrance.
Among the crowd, Wulu looked at Yuan Ming with a somewhat complicated expression and seemed to heave a light sigh.
"Wu Bao, Jin Kun, what brings two such important figures together to this place?" Yuan Ming watched the actions of Wu Bao and the people of the Green Wolf Gang, speaking calmly and unhurriedly.
"Yuan Ming, why play dumb? You've opposed my Green Wolf Gang numerous times and even killed my Vice Gang Leader Ba Yin. Your crimes are heinous. Just surrender peacefully, and we might leave your body intact," Wu Bao said coldly.
Yuan Ming's feud with the Green Wolf Gang was irreconcilable, so he refrained from arguing and turned to look at Jin Kun, "Gang Leader Jin Kun, are you also here to capture me? I, Yuan Ming, do not recall ever offending the Hyena Hall."
"Hehe, Brother Wu Bao and I are close friends. When he invited me to come along, I naturally couldn't stand by and watch," Jin Kun said with a laugh, his mung bean eyes twirling.
"Today's fight is between me and the Green Wolf Gang, and it doesn't concern outsiders. Gang Leader Jin Kun should think carefully about whether to get involved. I, Yuan Ming, am not a magnanimous person," Yuan Ming slowly said as he surveyed the Hyena Hall members around him.
"Oh, are you threatening me?" Jin Kun's eyes suddenly narrowed, and his gaze turned cold.
"Not at all, it's just a word of advice," Yuan Ming said with a smile.
Yuan Ming had heard enough from Tu Lei about the relationship between the Green Wolf Gang and the Hyena Hall to know that the two gangs were in a constant state of covert conflict and would never be harmonious.
With Jin Kun's character, he was likely hoping to sit back and watch the tigers fight from the mountain. Yuan Ming's move was to give Jin Kun an out. If he could stay out of the fray, there might still be a chance to win the battle today.
Jin Kun stared at Yuan Ming, his mung bean eyes narrowing to slits, and suddenly burst out laughing.
Yuan Ming's brow twitched slightly, but he said nothing.
"Hehe, Yuan Ming, you're really something, so calm in the face of danger, even trying to divide us. To be honest, I really considered bringing you into the Hyena Hall!" Jin Kun said with a big laugh.
"Jin Kun, do you still want the stuff or not?" Wu Bao asked frowningly.
"All members of the Hyena Hall, heed my command! Surround this place and let not even a fly escape!" Jin Kun said impatiently, gesturing with his hand.
The Hyena Hall members immediately dispersed, forming a half-moon pattern to encircle the other side of the cave, with members of the Green Wolf Gang blocking all possible escape routes.
At that moment, Zan Bai, hiding in the crowd, suddenly pulled out a crossbow loaded with three green arrows, aimed at Yuan Ming, and triggered the device.
The piercing sound of the arrows cutting through the air rang out as they turned into three green shadows, speeding straight toward the vital points on Yuan Ming's chest.

chapters.title: Chapter 59 - 39: No One Can Leave
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming executed the Shadowless Step, his form barely flickering as he moved laterally by half a zhang, easily dodging Zan Bai's covert attack.
Three green arrows struck the wall behind him and exploded almost simultaneously, spreading a large cloud of green smoke rapidly in all directions.
"Poisonous!" Yuan Ming immediately held his breath and waved his hand.
A gray-black round orb shot out, landing near the entrance of the cave on the ground.
With a muffled 'puff', a large cloud of smoke emerged from nowhere, instantly filling the cave and spilling outside, making it hard to see inside the cave and deterring any rash actions for a moment.
"Petty tricks!" Wu Bao scoffed lightly, a flash of green light flickering over his fingers as he tried again to summon a strong wind to disperse the smoke.
Just then, the ground beneath him suddenly cracked open, a sharp wooden thorn emerging and rising swiftly.
Wu Bao shivered and jumped to the side, narrowly escaping a foot piercing, but his wind summoning was forcibly interrupted.
Before Wu Bao and Jin Kun's groups could react, another black round orb emerged from within the cave beneath the cover of smoke and landed on the ground outside.
More clouds of smoke erupted, mingling with the smoke spreading from inside the cave, covering a large area.
In the cave, Yuan Ming covered his nose with his hand and moved to a stone wall deep inside the cave, pushing hard against it.
The stone wall moved slowly, revealing a pitch-black passage; the wall was actually a large cut stone.
Yuan Ming dove into it, pushed the large stone back into place, and ran toward the back exit of the cave.
He had anticipated that the Green Wolf Gang might come after him and had prepared accordingly. The moves he had made earlier were all delaying tactics; by the time Wu Bao and the others outside noticed something was wrong, he was already far away.
Not long after, Hagon appeared in front with a white fluorescing stone in his hand emitting a faint white light, seemingly waiting for him.
"Brother Yuan, I didn't expect this cave to have another exit. Impressive," praised Hagon.
"Now is not the time for idle chat, let's go!" Yuan Ming grabbed Hagon and ran forward.
The two wound through the pitch-black cave, turning corners for a good quarter of an hour before finally reaching the back exit. Yuan Ming used the Fur Cloak Skill and transformed into a White Ape, smashing the large stone blocking the back door with a punch, shattering it.
The two dashed out, about to sweep toward a distant area, when the ground suddenly lit up with lines of yellow light, forming a large yellow net that enveloped them.
Thischapterwasfirstseenon*.
Yuan Ming was startled, all his mana concentrated in his legs, which were already quite sturdy and now swelled another thirty percent with muscles bulging out, fiercely stomping the ground.
Bang!
The ground exploded into a shallow pit, and Yuan Ming shot into the air, escaping the enclosing yellow net at the last instant.
Hagon, however, didn't escape and was enveloped by the yellow net, unable to move.
"Talisman!" Yuan Ming landed a few zhang away, his pupils contracted as he drew the Green Fish Sword and slashed at the net.
Two blade-like golden lights shot from the side, aiming at his legs.
Yuan Ming hastily withdrew his hand and used the Shadowless Step below, shifting several feet in midair, narrowly dodging the golden blades.
Seven or eight figures shot out of the nearby jungle, completely surrounding the area. The leader was a sharp-headed, fat-bodied humanoid exotic beast with small mung bean eyes and a long golden tail dragging behind, resembling a giant humanoid rat.
The giant rat's fur was dark gold, particularly long on the back and upright like a hedgehog, with pale golden forepaws, sharp as steel drills.
"Hehe, did you think I was a vegetarian? Since I took on this assignment, I've naturally investigated your situation thoroughly. You should have asked around about who Grandpa Jin is," the humanoid giant rat spoke in a mild voice, apparently Jin Kun.
Yuan Ming's eyes twitched.
Although he didn't consider any of these Fur Beast Slaves a challenge in single combat, their gathering was not to be underestimated, especially with Jin Kun in charge, making a breakout extremely difficult.
Yuan Ming's gaze shifted, looking toward Hagon, who was tightly bound by the yellow net. Jin Kun and the others paid no attention to him, all eyes firmly on Yuan Ming.
Although he had met Hagon by chance, they had shared hardships together and could be considered rare friends in these Ten Thousand Mountains; unless absolutely necessary, he was loath to abandon him.
"Brother Yuan, don't worry about me, just go!" Hagon's face showed a pitiful expression as he shouted.
"Leave? None of you are leaving today!" Wu Bao's voice rose, and another seven or eight figures flew over from afar.
Wu Bao had also used the Fur Cloak Skill, transforming into a large Green Wolf.
This Green Wolf, resembling Hagon's transformation, was noticeably larger, nearly two zhang tall, its mere presence imposing.
Strangely, a pale purple horn grew on the top of the wolf's head, marked with faint thunder patterns.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming's heart sank, and fine cold sweat appeared on the tip of his nose.
Clearly, he had miscalculated this time.
Despite the situation being overwhelmingly against him, Yuan Ming had no intention of giving up resistance; his thoughts raced as he tried to find a way out of the current predicament.
"Boy, if you have any tricks left, use them now, or else just surrender quietly! I might just spare your life," Wu Bao said, seeing Yuan Ming unmoving, his tone indifferent.
Yuan Ming's heart jumped at the words. Wu Bao almost had victory in his hands yet was not eager to kill him, perhaps he had other plans for Yuan Ming?
"Jin Kun, go capture him!" Wu Bao saw that Yuan Ming still did not move, and shouted.
"What are you yelling for, I'm not one of your subordinates!" Jin Kun glared with his mung bean eyes, retorted, yet still waved his hand to signal his men to close in on Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming slowly retreated a few steps, took a deep breath, and waved his arm.
Two smoke bombs flew from his hand, hitting the ground on both sides.
With a "bang," thick smoke emerged out of nowhere, engulfing the space around for several yards.
"I thought you had some ace up your sleeve, but it's just this trivial trick again!" Wu Bao sneered coldly, his wolf claws glowing with cyan light, and a much stronger gust of wind emerged, quickly dispersing the surrounding smoke.
Yuan Ming took the opportunity to shake his form, turning into a white shadow rushing in one direction.
For the moment, the only option was to escape first and then consider the next steps. As for Hagon, he was powerless to help.
Two Fur Beast Slaves, seeing Yuan Ming speeding towards them, showed a moment of panic on their faces before quickly calming down and confronting him together.
"Get out of the way!" Yuan Ming swung his arms, unleashing a tremendous force like a tidal wave.
The arms of the two Fur Beast Slaves instantly broke, and their huge bodies were directly thrown away, howling in pain.
Whoosh! Whoosh!
Several green poison arrows shot from the front, falling in front of Yuan Ming and exploding into a large cloud of green smoke, forcing him to halt momentarily.
But immediately after, Yuan Ming pushed the Shadowless Step to its limit. His figure blurred, he dodged the remaining green poison arrows, and crashed into the oncoming group of Fur Beast Slaves.
As the smoke was mostly blown away, Wu Bao and Jin Kun also spotted Yuan Ming's position and rushed over together.
A chill went down Yuan Ming's spine as he swung his fists out forcefully. A white light flashed across his chest and abdomen, and a third ape arm burst out, striking a Fur Beast Slave blocking his way.
Bang! Bang! Bang! Three Fur Beast Slaves were thrown away.
However, more people rushed up; it was an unwinnable fight. Wu Bao and Jin Kun, like shadows, moved alongside, seemingly contemplating their moves and not yet striking.
Yuan Ming grew more and more anxious as he fought—there was no chance to break free, and both his mana and physical strength were being rapidly drained. If this continued, he would be worn down to death.
He didn't believe that Wu Bao would truly spare his life. Even if Wu Bao had other plans for him, once those were accomplished, he would still be left on a dead end.
Just then, the nearby jungle rustled loudly, and a tall white figure dashed out, crashing into the encirclement.
Two Fur Beast Slaves couldn't dodge in time and were directly knocked away, spitting blood and falling down, unable to get up.
"All hands, reinforcements!" Zan Bai bellowed out loud, his crossbow aiming forward, shooting three green poison arrows at the white figure.
The experienced fighters in the arena abandoned Yuan Ming and flanked towards the newcomers.
The tall white figure ignored the others and continued to charge in, its arms suddenly blurring.
In a swoosh of air, the three individuals confronting it were all left spewing blood and flew backward into the nearby jungle, life and death unknown; the three poison arrows also snapped and fell to the ground.
"Where did this reckless creature come from, face Grandpa Jin's wrath!" Jin Kun roared furiously, abandoning Yuan Ming and leaping towards the white figure.
The severely injured trio included a member from the Hyena Hall named Chi Na.
This individual had awakened olfactory abilities, and the Green Wolf Gang and Hyena Hall were able to easily find this place and block Yuan Ming's retreat, all thanks to this person's capabilities.
Seeing this, Wu Bao hesitated slightly but then also changed his target, pouncing towards the white figure.
Purple lightning flickered on the horn on his forehead, crackling loudly, and arcs of electricity surged out, roaming all over his body, turning him into a thunder man as he fiercely collided with the white figure.
Jin Kun's body shone brightly with golden light, his spine hair bristling.
Rustling!
Masses of golden fur shot out from his body like a rain of arrows at the white figure.
The tall white figure still ignored the two of them, continuing to run into the encirclement, swinging its arm.
With a loud "bang!"
Wu Bao and Jin Kun were similarly blown away, flying four or five yards like paper kites, and crashed heavily onto the ground.
Wu Bao was far stronger than the previous Beast Slaves, causing the white figure to also stagger, stopping its motion for the first time.
Only then did everyone see the true face of the white figure—it was a strange creature resembling an old white-haired ape, standing over two yards tall, covered in white fur, with blood-red eyes and long black claws on its hands. When it bared its teeth, it revealed jagged and glistening white fangs.
"What kind of monster is this?" everyone present exclaimed in shock.
Yuan Ming also showed a surprised expression, his eyes spinning as he retreated, his arm shaking.
With a soft "bang," another smoke bomb exploded, the thick smoke spreading, obscuring everything nearby.
"Be careful, stop him!"
The few people surrounding Yuan Ming hurriedly followed, trying to continue tangling with Yuan Ming. However, Yuan Ming had already disappeared in the smoke, his whereabouts unknown.
The white-furred creature, seemingly enraged by Wu Bao and Jin Kun's blockade, let out a fierce roar and lunged at the two.
"I'll handle this white-furred creature with Jin Kun. The rest of you, go after Yuan Ming!" Wu Bao quickly focused to confront the threat, shouting as he fought.
However, before he could finish speaking, several smoke bombs came flying from nowhere, landing in various parts of the battlefield.
Bang! Bang! Bang!
Great clouds of smoke erupted, enveloping everyone present and making it impossible to see anything clearly.
The scene became somewhat chaotic for a moment.

chapters.title: Chapter 60 - 40 Turning Misfortune into Fortune
chapters.content:
In the center of the encirclement, Hagon, who was trapped by the yellow net, also widened his eyes, curious about the white figure that had suddenly appeared.
At that moment, a figure shot out from the smoke, and it was Yuan Ming transformed into the White Ape, his Green Fish Sword turning into a green shadow as it fiercely cleaved down on the yellow net.
The Green Fish Sword was already sharp, and with Mana injected into it, its edge became even more pronounced, immediately creating a gap in the yellow net.
"How did you get here, didn't I tell you to leave first?" Hagon said in a lowered, urgent voice as he saw Yuan Ming.
"Shut up!" Yuan Ming swung his sword down again, and the third ape claw on his chest and abdomen also fiercely grabbed at the net.
With a "sizzle", the yellow net was finally torn open, and Hagon rolled out from inside.
"Go!" Without further explanation, Yuan Ming picked up Hagon and ran towards the outside.
Chaos reigned within the surrounding encirclement, and the smoke spread, allowing Yuan Ming and his companion to easily break through the layers of confinement, with escape from the encirclement in sight.
A figure appeared in front of them; it was Wulu.
"Wulu!" Yuan Ming's eyes darkened, and the Green Fish Sword in his hand lit up with a cold light, slashing down at the other's head!
The surrounding smoke would soon disperse, and they couldn't afford to delay even for a moment—they had to fight swiftly and decisively!
Wulu showed a complex expression and dodged to the side, clearing the way.
Yuan Ming looked surprised but didn't pause, breaking out of the smoke-filled area.
"No good, Yuan Ming has escaped!" As soon as they left the encirclement, Yuan Ming and Hagon's figures were clearly exposed and spotted by a Fur Beast Slave on guard outside.
Ignoring the others, Yuan Ming fled towards the Mist Canyon to the south.
In the form of the White Ape, he pushed his Shadowless Step to the limit. Despite carrying a person, he moved incredibly fast, vanishing into the dense forest in the blink of an eye.
Suddenly, a figure detached from the battleground—it was that white-furred creature—pursuing in the direction Yuan Ming and Hagon had fled.
Wu Bao, Jin Kun, and others also quickly emerged from the smoke-filled area, all with unpleasant expressions.
Their carefully planned capture, which seemed foolproof, had been ruined by a white-furred creature that appeared out of nowhere.
"Cough! You can't blame me for this—I blocked the guy for you. Who knew that thing would pop up out of nowhere?" Jin Kun shrugged his shoulders and spread his hands.
"Without catching the man, the reward can't be claimed," Wu Bao said with a dark expression.
"You saw the power of that white-furred creature just now. I'm afraid even if you and I joined forces, we could barely manage it. I, Jin Kun, may be greedy, but I wouldn't risk the lives of my brothers," Jin Kun said with a dry lick of his lips and a cold laugh.
"Catch him alive, and besides what was promised earlier, I'll have an additional reward. But he must be alive," Wu Bao said gravely.
"I don't know why you care so much about that kid, but Hyena Hall will no longer participate. Until next time. Let's go!" With that, Jin Kun summoned his men to carry the wounded and turned to leave.
"Which way did Yuan Ming escape?" Wu Bao watched the Hyena Hall people moving away, his eyes turning bloodshot, obviously on the verge of rage, and asked in a cold voice.
"I vaguely saw, it was in that direction, that white creature chased after them too," Wulu pointed towards a direction in the east.
"Chase!" With Wu Bao's command, he took the lead in pursuit to the east, with the rest following closely behind.
After the two groups left one by one, the scene once again fell into silence.
At this moment, a barely audible "rustle" came from a branch as thick as a child's arm on a nearby large tree. A silver cat walked out with graceful strides.
After licking its body, it once again lifted its head, its amber and gold eyes blinked and glanced to the south.
Then lightly leaping, it landed on another tree nearby. Within a few more jumps, it had disappeared into the distance.
...
Yuan Ming, transformed into the White Ape, was carrying Hagon on his back, running at full strength towards Mist Canyon.
Seeing the white mist growing denser ahead, Yuan Ming felt a slight relief in his heart.
Once they entered the canyon area, they would be basically safe.
"Brother Yuan, be careful!" The Hagon on his back suddenly cried out in alarm.
A white shadow caught up silently from behind, even faster than Yuan Ming, and in just a breath or two, it was behind him, swinging a fist down towards Hagon's head.
Yuan Ming quickly ducked low and rolled to the side.
However, the white creature was too fast; he couldn't completely dodge it, and his left shoulder was hit, sending him flying sideways, while Hagon was flung from his back.
Yuan Ming felt an excruciating pain in his left shoulder, with half his body going numb and a surge of blood reaching his throat, which he forcibly swallowed back down.
The white creature didn't bother with Yuan Ming but turned into a white blur chasing after Hagon.
"Take this!" Seeing there was no time to help, Yuan Ming rallied his "Energy Storage Arm," and his right arm swelled instantly. He threw the Green Fish Sword at the creature.
Whoosh!
The Green Fish Sword traced a chilling, swift shadow, reaching the white-furred monster in an instant like thunder and gale.
The white-furred monster swung its fist toward the Green Fish Sword, its figure still charging forward.
With a clang, the Green Fish Sword was knocked away, and a deep, bone-deep wound was sliced into the monster's fist.
This content was first released on *.
The power of the "Energy Storage Arm" contained within the Green Fish Sword surged, causing the monster's figure to waver slightly.
Before the monster could steady itself, the ground beneath it boomed, and a thick Wooden Thorn burst from the earth. Though it didn't pierce the creature's foot, it caused its already unstable body to stagger and nearly fall.
Yuan Ming seized the opportunity to perform Shadowless Step, appearing beside Hagon in the blink of an eye, he grabbed his body and leaped onto a nearby tree, quickly climbing to the top.
"Brother Yuan, thank you for saving my life again," Hagon said with a bloodied mouth, managing a weak smile.
"Let's save the thanks for when we manage to escape with our lives this time," Yuan Ming said and carried him away, leaping into the distance.
He didn't lead Hagon into the canyon because the white-furred monster was too close. Entering the canyon would not only fail to shake off their pursuer, but in that flat terrain, they would almost certainly have no chance of escape.
Only in the forest they knew well did they have a sliver of a chance for survival.
The white-furred monster steadied itself, its eyes blood red with fury it let out a roar, ignoring the wound on its hand, it transformed into a white shadow chasing after them.
The monster was exceptionally agile, easily climbing the trees and leaping from one tree to another, not a bit slower than Yuan Ming.
"Hagon, I've noticed that the monster seems to have been targeting you from the very beginning. Have you seen it before?" Yuan Ming pushed his speed to the limit, barely managing to create some distance from the white-furred monster, he asked urgently.
Hagon's face showed an unnatural expression, but he didn't respond.
Whoosh!
A thick tree trunk shot from behind, aiming at Yuan Ming's back—it was the white-furred monster that had chopped off a piece of the trunk and hurled it at them.
Yuan Ming ducked his body and swept aside, narrowly avoiding the trunk's attack.
However, this slight delay allowed the monster to close the distance significantly.
"Hagon, if you have something to say, say it quickly. If we delay any longer, we'll be caught. I'm no match for that monster," Yuan Ming said sternly.
Struggling within his mind, Hagon finally made up his mind and said, "Brother Yuan, don't worry. I know why it attacked and how to repel it."
As he spoke, he took out a Jade Bottle from his bosom, tilted it slightly, and a pigeon egg-sized Blood-colored Orb rolled out, exuding an intense scent of Essence Blood.
"What is this?" Yuan Ming's eyes widened.
The white-furred monster behind them caught the scent of the Blood-colored Orb, its eyes filled with greed, and it sped up, closing the distance to less than thirty feet.
However, Hagon showed no concern. He flung his arm, throwing the Blood-colored Orb far away.
The white-furred monster let out a strange cry and immediately abandoned the chase, going after the Blood-colored Orb.
Upon seeing this, Yuan Ming was secretly alarmed but said nothing, turning towards the canyon without hesitation, he leaped into it.
Even while carrying a person, his White Ape Transformation enabled him to scale the cliffs with ease, quickly disappearing into the thick mists and reaching the valley floor.
Yuan Ming didn't stop, he continued to run deep into the canyon, stopping only after two or three miles.
"The fog here is dense, making it difficult for Wu Bao and the rest to track us. We should be safe for the moment." He set Hagon down, released the Fur Cloak Skill, and sat down on the ground with a thud, panting and saying.
After several consecutive battles, his Mana was completely depleted, and he was utterly exhausted.
"Thanks to you, Brother Yuan, I owe you my life again today," Hagon said slowly.
"Wu Bao and the others were after me in the first place. There's no talk of debts. What I want to know is what's the deal with that white-furred monster, why was it after you? And what's that Blood-colored Orb?" After panting for a while, Yuan Ming's breath gradually steadied, and he asked.
"It's a long story. That Blood-colored Orb is called a Blood Pill, only found inside Level 1 Upper Stage Fierce Beasts. It could be said to be the essence of all the Qi-Blood in its body," Hagon explained.
"Level 1 Upper Stage Fierce Beasts! How did you manage to kill one?" Yuan Ming was quite shocked.
With his current strength, he would not dare to confront a Level 1 Upper Stage Fierce Beast.
"I'm not capable of that. I previously came across an Upper Stage Fierce Beast that was severely injured and on the brink of death. I was lucky to obtain that Blood Pill from its corpse, and then the white-furred monster set its sights on me," Hagon said with a wry smile.
"With the monster being so powerful, how did you manage to escape?" Yuan Ming was still somewhat incredulous, persisting in his questioning.
"The beast was injured at the time, and I happened to have a Confinement talisman on me. That's how I barely made my escape. I didn't expect that after so long, the monster would still pursue me," Hagon sighed.
"So that's what happened. But this time we lucked out. If it hadn't been for that creature causing trouble, we would probably have fallen to Wu Bao and his gang. Now, even though you've thrown away the Blood Pill, we can't be sure the monster won't come after us again. You should quickly recover," Yuan Ming nodded and found a corner to sit cross-legged, beginning to cultivate and practice Breathing Control.
Also feeling pain all over after being struck by the white-furred monster, Hagon likewise sat down cross-legged to cultivate and heal his injuries.
Half an hour later, Yuan Ming was the first to open his eyes.
With the aid of the Nine Elements Technique, his Mana was fully restored, and his physical strength nearly replenished.
All around was silent, without any abnormality, indicating the white-furred monster had most likely left after obtaining the Blood Pill and had not pursued them further.

chapters.title: Chapter 61 - 41 Strange Events
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming glanced at Hagon, who was still sitting with his eyes closed, breathing control, and did not make a sound to disturb him as he looked up towards the upper part of the canyon.
He was not worried that Wu Bao and the others might chase them into the canyon. The area inside was vast, and even if the numbers of the Green Wolf Gang and the Hyena Hall were multiplied tenfold, finding them would be as difficult as ascending to the heavens.
Yuan Ming was thinking of his Green Fish Sword, which he had left behind during the fight with the white-haired beast.
This sword was a Half-magical Artifact, exceptionally sharp. It would be a pity to just abandon it.
But going back now to retrieve it would increase the risk of exposure.
"Forget it, it's just a treasure sword." After much consideration, Yuan Ming decided against retrieving the Green Fish Sword and sat down cross-legged.
His White Ape Transformation, originally very ordinary within the Fur Cloak Skill, had evolved several times. He felt his Furred Beast Skin was no less than any others; he was certainly not inferior to Wu Bao and Jin Kun.
By comparison, his cultivation level was still a notch lower.
If his cultivation could advance further to the Qi Refining Fourth Layer, he wouldn't have to face such a debacle like today when encountering Wu Bao and the others.
Yuan Ming steadied his mind and began cultivating with his eyes closed, gradually losing all awareness of the outside world.
…
As Yuan Ming and Hagon leisurely cultivated within the canyon, Wu Bao, driven mad, had the Green Wolf Gang search frantically for them, but to no avail.
He guessed Yuan Ming might have hidden in Mist Canyon, and had sent people to search there, but the regionality of Mist Canyon was vast and the fog was thick as clouds. After several days of searching, they found no clue.
As time passed, Yuan Ming seemed to have evaporated from the world; there was no sign of him, and complaints started emerging within the Green Wolf Gang, as they still had to provide Blood Food every month.
Wu Bao, although reluctant, remembered that Yuan Ming might hold some secrets, but could only abandon the search in the end.
However, the news of how Yuan Ming had managed to escape unscathed from the joint encirclement and blockade of the Green Wolf Gang and Hyena Hall spread wildly, and with him having disappeared, Yuan Ming's name resounded through the region, becoming legendary among the Fur Beast Slaves.
Time passed, and half a year had flown by.
In a hidden cave at the base of the canyon, Yuan Ming sat cross-legged, his face faintly glowing.
Outside the cave, there was no sign of Hagon.
The white fog outside the cave suddenly began to surge violently, like boiling water, drawing the spiritual energy of heaven and earth towards the cave.
This gathering of spiritual energy lasted for a quarter of an hour before it ceased.
Inside the cave, Yuan Ming's body was enveloped by a layer of luminescence, making him look completely revitalized.
He circulated the Nine Elements Technique, a powerful wave of mana spreading out from him, far stronger than before.
Yuan Ming opened his eyes, his expression full of joy.
Qi Refining Thirteen Layers; layers one to three were just the basics. Only upon reaching the Fourth Layer could one considered to have made minor achievements.
It took half a year to advance from the Qi Refining Third Layer to the Fourth Layer, which was slower than before.
Yet, Yuan Ming was not at all dissatisfied. As his cultivation deepened, the breakthroughs took much longer. After the Third Layer, each advancement was measured in years.
That he had only taken half a year to break through to the Fourth Layer was entirely thanks to the exquisite nature of the Nine Elements Technique and was exceptionally fast, especially as his cultivation was not continuous, with each month sneaking out of the valley to exchange for antidotes.
Yuan Ming stabilized his realm slightly by circulating the Nine Elements Technique and couldn't wait to step outside the cave. He performed the Fur Cloak Skill and transformed into a White Ape form.
The White Ape looked not much different from before, but Yuan Ming could clearly feel that the strength of his physical body had increased dramatically, causing a stir with every movement.
He picked up a piece of Green Stone from the ground and gave it a gentle squeeze.
Crack!
The hard Green Stone shattered immediately, turning into a cloud of dust that drifted slowly from his fingertips.
A hint of surprise flashed in Yuan Ming's eyes. He had thought that with his advancing cultivation, the enhancement of physical strength provided by the Fur Cloak Skill would eventually weaken like his size, but this was not the case with the White Ape Skin; the increase in strength did not decrease but grew instead.
He returned to the cave, took out his bundle, and from within it, a sword wrapped in cloth was diagonally inserted—the Green Fish Sword.
This sword and he had quite some fate. During the battle with the white-haired beast, the Green Fish Sword had been left in the mountain forest. He was worried that Wu Bao and his people would detect his traces and did not retrieve it in time, thinking it would surely be lost.
Yet, when he later went out to collect food, he accidentally passed by that place, and the Green Fish Sword still quietly lay in the mountain forest.
Yuan Ming climbed upward and soon reached the top.
He arrived near a large tree and took out a bamboo tube from the roots, which contained a piece of Beast Skin.
Yuan Ming opened the Beast Skin, which was filled with small characters detailing recent events in the Ten Thousand Mountains, left by Hagon.
Not long after entering the valley, Hagon had healed his wounds and left. To keep abreast of the situation in the Ten Thousand Mountains, Yuan Ming used the same method as before, having Hagon leave the news there each month.
Reading the information on the Beast Skin, Yuan Ming's expression grew colder.
While the Green Wolf Gang no longer publicly offered a reward for his capture on the surface, Wu Bao had not given up and had secretly increased the rewards even more than before.
But now, Yuan Ming was not the same as before; his cultivation alone was comparable to that of Wu Bao, and he naturally had no fear.
Besides, the Ten Thousand Mountains were relatively calm, with nothing particularly out of the ordinary happening.
Yuan Ming put away the Beast Skin, took out a headband, and wrapped it around his head and face before heading towards Toad Valley.
He had asked Hagon to request an item from Zhao Tong before, and now nearly two months had passed, Zhao Tong should have had it ready.
While hurrying on his way, Yuan Ming unconsciously activated the Shadowless Step.
With his cultivation and mana enhanced, he now found it even more effortless to control.
Midway through his journey, the nearby jungle rustled loudly as a plump gray rabbit burst out, frantically fleeing into the distance.
To break through his bottleneck, Yuan Ming had secluded himself for a full three days and nights without a drop of water; he felt a bit hungry at the moment and pinched a gesture in the air.
A sharp wooden thorn flashed under the running rabbit, conjured out of thin air, and accurately pierced through the rabbit's body, exiting through its back.
The gray rabbit screamed miserably, struggled a few times, and soon lay motionless.
He rose to retrieve the rabbit's corpse and was about to clean it when he suddenly stopped, his gaze falling on the rabbit's chin and forelegs.
There were many bloodstains there, a blackish red color, clearly not the rabbit's own blood.
Yuan Ming picked a strand of soft, fiery red human hair from the congealed blood.
His expression turned solemn as he walked towards the jungle from where the rabbit had emerged.
At first, he discovered nothing, but not far along, a scent of blood wafted from ahead.
Yuan Ming followed the scent and soon arrived at a valley, parting the dense grass at the entrance, his face suddenly changed.
He saw several corpses lying haphazardly in the valley, all Fur Beast Slaves, each body shattered into several pieces, dying a ghastly death.
The Furred Beast Skins of these people were also torn into many pieces, completely destroyed.
Yuan Ming's brows furrowed deeply!
Since he had entered the Ten Thousand Mountains, he had grown accustomed to bloody slaughters, but such a brutal act of dismemberment was a first for him; nobody would do such a thing even to Fur Beast Slaves, and it didn't seem like the work of Fierce Beasts either.
He suppressed his nausea and carefully examined the corpses, but unfortunately found nothing.
Yuan Ming did not linger there any longer and soon left.
At this moment, he lost his appetite and continued on his journey, quickly reaching Toad Valley.
However, the normally bustling Toad Valley was eerily quiet, seeming somewhat sinister.
As Yuan Ming walked, he scanned his surroundings. The stone houses used by several disciples of the Biluo Cave Sect for business were all closed, and the entire valley was devoid of people.
He quickly arrived in front of Zhao Tong's stone house, which was also empty.
"Could something have happened?" Yuan Ming murmured to himself, stroking his chin.
The message from Hagon had mentioned that there were no other abnormalities in the Ten Thousand Mountains, so it seemed that the drastic change in Toad Valley had occurred recently.
Yuan Ming stood silently for a moment, about to turn and leave, when he suddenly remembered something and went behind the stone house, reaching his hand into a gap between two large stones in the corner.
Рlеаsе rеаd this сhаptеr оn its оriginаl plаtfоrm—М|V|L1ЕМРYR.
He quickly withdrew his hand, now holding a piece of Beast Skin.
Yuan Ming and Zhao Tong had traded many times and were quite familiar with each other; this was their way of leaving messages for each other, a method he had learned from Zhao Tong for communicating with Tu Lei and Hagon through written letters.
Yuan Ming unfolded the Beast Skin; there wasn't much written, and he quickly finished reading it.
According to the message left by Zhao Tong, closing Toad Valley was a directive from the Biluo Cave Sect, and the reason seemed to be that something had occurred within the Ten Thousand Mountains, Zhao Tong also cautioned Yuan Ming to be careful.
He put away the Beast Skin, and the image of the dismembered bodies he had seen not long before crossed his mind; he wondered if the death of those Fur Beast Slaves had anything to do with the current changes?
Yuan Ming did not linger in Toad Valley much longer and soon turned to leave, heading straight back to his dwelling in Mist Canyon to consolidate his realm.
Although his cultivation had improved, he dared not be overconfident, as the incident in the Ten Thousand Mountains was taken seriously by the Biluo Cave Sect, and he naturally did not dare to take it lightly.
Five days later, Yuan Ming left the Cave Mansion again, climbed up the canyon, and headed towards the Boundary Marker.
He was not out to hunt beasts; today was the day to pay Essence Blood.
Yuan Ming quickly arrived at the foot of the Giant Stone Boundary, finding that Wu Lu had already arrived.
"Wu Lu, no troubles I hope." Yuan Ming greeted.
"All is well, Brother Yuan Ming, how have you been recently?" Wu Lu asked with a smile.
"Getting by," Yuan Ming replied with a slight smile, his attitude friendlier than before.
Although the Green Wolf Gang had withdrawn their forces and no longer actively pursued him, the conflict between them had not been resolved. Several months had passed, and though the Green Wolf Gang had not ambushed him near the Boundary Marker, it influenced his relationship with Wu Lu significantly.
"Brother Wu Lu, a few days ago I went to Toad Valley and found it deserted. After inquiring, I heard that something had happened in the Ten Thousand Mountains, leading to the sealing of the valley. The Green Wolf Gang has a well-informed source; do you know if this is true?" Yuan Ming inquired.
"What will happen next in the Ten Thousand Mountains, we too are not sure," Wu Lu sighed thoughtfully, shaking his head.
As the two chatted casually, Elder Hu Huo arrived, soaring on a giant eagle from a distance and landing near the Boundary Marker.
"Greetings, Elder Hu Huo!" Yuan Ming and Wu Lu quickly stood and bowed.
"Good that you both are here; I have something to inform you," Elder Hu Huo said as he leaped down from the giant eagle.
"Please instruct us, Elder Hu Huo," Yuan Ming and the other responded respectfully.

chapters.title: Chapter 62 - 42 Rivals
chapters.content:
"Three days from now, a group of disciples from the Sect will come to the Ten Thousand Mountains to undergo a trial, and all of you Fur Beast Slaves must fully cooperate." Elder Hu Huo said expressionlessly.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming and Wulu exchanged glances, then couldn't help looking at each other in dismay.
"May I ask what the specifics of this trial are?" Wulu paused for a moment before asking.
"You don't need to know now. Just remember to gather here in three days. Understand?" Elder Hu Huo commanded in an uncompromising tone.
"Yes," Wulu lowered his head and responded, while Yuan Ming nodded somewhat listlessly.
"I know what you are worried about. Trials like these are common occurrences within the Sect, but not always an opportunity for you to shine. Listen carefully, at the end of the trial, depending on your performance, you can accumulate Blood Food portions ranging from one hundred to three hundred. If anyone performs an outstanding merit, it's not out of the question that they could be directly admitted into the Sect as a Registered Disciple," Elder Hu Huo glanced at the two and continued.
Upon hearing this, Wulu's breathing became much heavier, and Yuan Ming's eyes lit up as well.
"I have said all I wish to say, do not miss this opportunity," Elder Hu Huo stated indifferently.
"Yes," the two replied in unison, their voices noticeably louder.
Next, Elder Hu Huo took away their Beast Blood, bestowed the antidote for the month, then hastily leaped onto a giant eagle and flew away, leaving Yuan Ming somewhat speechless as he had intended to report the matter of the corpse in the valley to him.
Subsequently, Wulu bid farewell to Yuan Ming and turned to leave, looking rather hurried as his figure quickly disappeared into the distance.
Yuan Ming did not linger at the site, but as he walked toward the canyon, he mulled over Elder Hu Huo's words regarding the disciples' trial, his expression growing increasingly solemn.
The trial seemed at first glance to be a decent opportunity for all the Fur Beast Slaves scattered across the Ten Thousand Mountains, but on closer inspection, it seemed somewhat amiss.
The so-called disciples mentioned by Elder Hu Huo must refer to the Registered Disciples, who in terms of talent and cultivation were stronger than these Fur Beast Slaves on the very fringes of the Sect. The only value the Fur Beast Slaves had for them was their familiarity with the Ten Thousand Mountains, to assist and guide them.
He didn't believe that the Sect would just use these Fur Beast Slaves to show the way and do some menial tasks, and reward them with a considerable share of Blood Food in return.
Things must not be as simple as they appeared.
"Better to be cautious," he warned himself silently.
...
Three days later, near the boundary stele.
Early in the morning, figures converged from all directions. Before the Sun could fully rise, already over thirty people had gathered at this place.
Some were quite excited, eager to start, while others had a blank expression, appearing uncertain about why they were summoned.
No long after Yuan Ming arrived, Hagon approached him.
"Have you heard? It seems that this time the Sect has sent a group of Registered Disciples here for cultivation training," Hagon whispered.
"If they are here for training, let them train. What do they need us to do though?" Yuan Ming asked, puzzled.
"Don't you understand? Those pampered folks who live in luxury within the Sect, how would they know the dangers of the Ten Thousand Mountains? Surely we are to accompany and assist them," Hagon said with a roll of his eyes.
"Like a royal family going on a hunt, taking along some attendants?" Yuan Ming queried. Chapter provided via *.
"Calling it attendants is too kind. More like hawks and dogs," Hagon said, shaking his head.
While they were speaking, a group of about ten shirtless men arrived, escorting a tall man with disheveled black hair and a menacing face—it was Wu Bao of the Green Wolf Gang.
Upon their arrival, they cast angry glances toward Yuan Ming and Hagon.
Yuan Ming's face remained unchanged, returning the gaze without a hint of fear in his eyes.
"The inevitable can't be avoided," commented Hagon, tugging at the corner of his mouth.
No sooner had he spoken than another group of about ten people rushed over, led by Jin Kun of the Hyena Hall.
As their gazes met, Jin Kun's face also looked unpleasant. Their previous collusion with the Green Wolf Gang against Yuan Ming and Hagon not only failed to capture them, but also left several of their own men seriously injured.
As for these two factions, especially Wu Bao, they had not given up on Yuan Ming but simply had not found an opportune moment. The moment an opportunity arose, he would not hesitate to take action.
Jin Kun's beady eyes scrutinized Yuan Ming and Hagon as he spoke to Wu Bao, "Since you still have plans, why not take advantage of the fact that Elder Hu Huo has yet to arrive? We have full manpower; isn't this the perfect chance?"
"I have my own plans; don't create unnecessary complications. As for Yuan Ming, this time he's dead for sure. When only Hagon is left, we'll slowly torment him to death," Wu Bao licked his lips and sneered.
"That's good, that's very good," replied Jin Kun with a nod and a smile, upon hearing this.
Hagon, watching the two conspiring, frowned deeply, while Yuan Ming looked nonchalant.
Just then, a piercing cry came from the sky above.
A huge shadow descended, casting itself toward them.
The crowd looked up, only to see Elder Hu Huo riding a falcon hawk mount, flying over, followed by four unfamiliar figures standing behind him.
After the falcon hawk landed, Elder Hu Huo was the first to jump off, and the other four also followed suit, leaping down one after another.
The arrival of these individuals immediately drew the attention of all the Fur Beast Slaves.
The first to jump off the falcon hawk was a brawny man with a rugged face and a short beard. His burly and muscular stature strained against the swells of his dark black robe, and he carried a huge black axe on his back, clearly not someone to be trifled with.
Following him was a woman with a full and voluptuous figure, yet her appearance was rather plain. Her attire was almost identical to that of the bearded man, apparently the same standard issue, even the beast head emblem on their chests was exactly the same.
Yuan Ming took a closer look and noticed that beneath the emblem of the beast head, there was a line of small characters that read "Beast Taming Hall."
Although the woman's face was ordinary, her figure was undeniably hot.
