"The Human Demon King has a Soul Pearl born inside its body, so it can control the Human Demons to act together. Its strength is far greater than that of ordinary Human Demons. All the participating Registered Disciples are at most at the 6th or 7th Level of Qi Refinement, and they're mainly acting separately. If they encounter the Human Demon King with a large group of Human Demons, they're as good as dead," Chen Wan's voice was hurried with an uncontrollable tremor.
Yuan Ming also frowned upon hearing this.
No wonder Chen Wan was in such a panic. Their trial as Registered Disciples might face massive casualties due to the emergence of the Human Demon King.
"If it were just a few isolated Human Demons, the Sect wouldn't care. As long as they don't show excessive range of activity, no action is taken. However, if multiple Human Demons are active beyond the expected range, the Sect will intervene in due course, organizing trials like this one. But with a Human Demon King, the risk level doubles. It's beyond the trial's acceptable risk, and if we don't inform everyone in time, the consequences are unthinkable. The best way to handle this is to have the Sect send elders," Chen Wan continued rapidly.
Just as Yuan Ming was about to speak, he suddenly heard a "whoosh" sound.
He quickly made a hushing gesture to Chen Wan, urging her to be quiet, and then stealthily looked over towards the Human Demons, only to see a tall White Hair Human Demon jumping down from the place where daylight seeped into the cave from above.
This one looked not much different from other Human Demons, but the hair on its face was sparser and shorter, revealing facial features that were oddly similar to those of the Human Clan.
What was different were the two white bony protrusions on its forehead, each less than half an inch long, resembling raised sharp horns.
Despite its ugly appearance, its posture was erect, emanating an air of a martial and dominating presence.
In its hand, it was holding a young man dressed in a red short robe.
The man's outfit had a flame pattern embroidered on the chest, seeming to come from the same Fire Refining Hall as Chen Wan.

chapters.title: Chapter 70 - 50 Departure
chapters.content:
"Master Yu..." Chen Wan's eyes widened in shock as she looked at the young man being held by the Human Demon King, but before she could call out, Yuan Ming quickly covered her mouth.
The sound stopped abruptly, thankfully the Human Demon King did not notice.
After he landed steadily, the rest of the Human Demons all simultaneously made stiff movements as they lowered their heads, showing a submissive posture.
Senior Brother Yu from the Fire Refining Hall was being held by the neck with one arm of the Human Demon King, lifted up in front of him.
The latter's cheeks twitched in pain, his expression tortured, eyes tightly shut. Clearly, though not unconscious, he lacked even the courage to open his eyes for a glance. His muscles were tensed, his body quivering non-stop, obviously terrorized to the extreme.
Chen Wan's gaze fixed on the fellow disciple, her mind a mess. In the end, she lacked the courage to risk a rescue.
At that moment, the Human Demon King pressed a finger on the unfortunate Senior Brother Yu's forehead.
With a "pu" sound, his skull, as if made of tofu, was easily pierced, creating a bloody hole.
A wail of agony rose, echoing within the cave.
The Human Demon King's gaze was icy as he grasped the writhing Senior Brother Yu in pain and brought him to his mouth.
On opening his mouth, sharp, fang-like teeth were revealed. He leaned towards Senior Brother Yu's forehead, biting down. As he clamped on, he began to suck at the bloody hole.
The next instant, a stream of blood-red light surged from the bloody hole in the forehead, emptied by the Human Demon King's absorption.
Senior Brother Yu's screams stopped abruptly; his body withered away, slowly slipping from the hands of the Human Demon King and falling to the ground.
Immediately after, the Human Demon King spread his arms wide, head slightly tilted back, as if he had enjoyed a gluttonous feast, immersed in the delightful sensation.
At the same time, his body emitted a green glow, sprinkled with specks of light dispersing around.
The other Human Demons basked in the green specks of light, their heads rising as if they were undergoing some kind of sublimation.
Yuan Ming was shocked by this scene and stared for a good while. Chen Wan, by his side, became eerily silent, her lovely face turning pale.
Leaving aside the other Human Demons, if they fell into the hands of this Human Demon King, they definitely had no chance of survival and would become mere Blood Food. Their fate would not be any better than Senior Brother Yu's.
"Boom"
Just then, a surge of air blasted down from an opening above the cavern, the hot breath carrying a torrent of sand and leaves.
The entire underground cave shook violently as if under attack.
The Human Demon King looked up to the sky and suddenly let out an angry roar. He swiftly shot towards the exit above.
The other Human Demons immediately started moving, climbing the steep cave walls with all four limbs, following fast as if in pursuit of their queen.
"We can get out now..." Yuan Ming said to himself with a burst of joy seeing this scene.
He turned back and glanced at Chen Wan, indicating that they should get ready to escape once all the Human Demons had left.
However, after a long wait, as one Human Demon after another clambered out of the cavern, one in the corner remained motionless, not following the others.
"What's up with this guy, why isn't he moving?" Yuan Ming thought anxiously.
Chen Wan was also nervous. If the other Human Demons returned, they would have no chance to escape.
She patted Yuan Ming on the shoulder, and when he turned his head, she made a throat-slitting gesture. They needed to kill this Human Demon quickly to leave safely.
Yuan Ming hesitated for a moment but then nodded.
Just as he was about to descend through the cavern's opening, he noticed the Human Demon start to move.
It swayed its head from side to side as if surveying its surroundings. Seeing that no one was around, it abruptly turned and walked to the left, disappearing from Yuan Ming and Chen Wan's view.
Yuan Ming was startled by this scene.
"That Human Demon is acting strange, as if it has spiritual intelligence," he whispered to Chen Wan.
Chen Wan, hearing this, peered out again and noticed that the Human Demon had indeed vanished.
"This... It's impossible. Even if a king is born among the Human Demons, there could only be one. Two kings would never appear at the same time. Otherwise, they would engage in a fight to the death and never coexist peacefully," said Chen Wan, equally bewildered.
"Never mind that, let's focus on escaping first," said Yuan Ming.
With that, he leaned forward, gripping the cave wall, and began to climb down quickly.
Chen Wan followed swiftly.
Only when they reached the opening where the numerous Human Demons had burst out did they notice a hidden opening on their blind side to the left, leading in a different direction.
Chen Wan looked at the concealed entrance with curiosity in her eyes.
"Don't create unnecessary complications. Let's hurry and escape," Yuan Ming promptly reminded her.
Chen Wan softly acknowledged with a "hmm" and withdrew her gaze.
"I'll go up first and check the situation," Yuan Ming cautioned, starting to climb towards the opening.
He had barely made it halfway up when fierce roars suddenly came from outside the cave.
Immediately after, a shadow fell from the opening, nearly striking Yuan Ming and landing on the ground.
Yuan Ming quickly dodged to the side, pressing himself against the wall and looking down, only to see a half-bodily torso landing near Chen Wan's feet.
It was covered in blood, its face obscured by clotted blood, identifiable only by its clothing, which seemed to be that of a disciple from the Beast Taming Hall.
Yuan Ming's heart tensed, and he suddenly heard the sounds of battle above growing closer, causing his face to change.
He quickly rolled over and dropped down, saying to Chen Wan, "There's a battle going on above, the situation is unclear."
Before his words had fully landed, the light at the entrance above was suddenly blocked by a shadow.
Yuan Ming and Chen Wan looked up at the same time, only to see the back of the Human Demon King.
The two instinctively dodged to the side, seeing that the Human Demon was about to return. It was already too late to climb back to the original entrance.
"This way."
Chen Wan called out and turned to run into a hidden passage on the left.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming could only immediately follow.
The two ran one after the other for half a quarter of an hour, with the cave passage ahead twisting and turning, becoming narrower and narrower.
Before long, they had reached the end.
"How could there be no way out?" Chen Wan asked, confused.
On their journey, they had neither found a fork in the road nor seen the Human Demon return, but they had walked to a dead-end without ever seeing that strange Human Demon again.
Hearing this, Yuan Ming stepped forward to search and soon found a crack near the ground less than half a person tall, just wide enough for one person to pass through.
"It might have gone through here," Yuan Ming said.
"That Human Demon even knows how to bend down and squeeze through holes. Its spiritual intelligence is definitely not that of a newly enlightened being. How did it manage to coexist peacefully with the Human Demon King?" Chen Wan bent down to check and was even more perplexed.
"Let's not worry about that now; we need to get out of here quickly, just in case those Human Demons also come this way," Yuan Ming urged. Find this chapter's source on *.
Hearing this, Chen Wan hesitated no longer, stooped, and crawled through the crack first.
Yuan Ming closely followed, crawling through as well.
Behind the crack was still a narrow, winding passageway. Yuan Ming and Chen Wan walked cautiously within it, and after nearly a quarter of an hour, they finally emerged from the narrow passage.
The passage's exit was also a narrow crack, leading to a cavern as large as two rooms combined outside.
The cavern was dimly lit, yet not pitch-black; the rock walls all around were covered with a kind of stone powder that emitted a faint phosphorescence, providing a slight glow.
Yuan Ming and Chen Wan entered the cavern and were immediately faced with an ancient Stele about six feet tall.
Underneath the rectangular body of the Stele was a stone base shaped like a fierce tiger. The carving wasn't very exquisite, but it exuded an indescribable spirit, looking quite imposing.
Yuan Ming examined it closely and discovered one face of the Stele carved with intricate runes, while the other was engraved with the characters for "Hu Shou" in Southern Border script.
"What is this?" Yuan Ming asked.
Chen Wan, who had also been carefully observing it, thought for a moment then shook her head, saying, "I'm not sure, it looks like some kind of suppression artifact or a boundary marker."
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming didn't ask further and began to examine the rest of the cavern in detail.
But after looking around, he was surprised to discover that aside from the crack they had entered through, there were no other exits in the cavern.
"We've really reached the end this time; there are no other exits," Yuan Ming said with a frown.
"That's strange. Not only did we not find an exit, but why isn't that Human Demon anywhere to be seen?" Chen Wan also looked perplexed.
"Let's search again carefully; this can't be right," Yuan Ming sighed.
Hearing this, Chen Wan twisted her wrist and rapidly released three Fireball Techniques, illuminating the entire cavern.
Using the bright light, they carefully searched the entire cavern again only to come up empty-handed.
"Could there have been a fork in the road we came through that we didn't notice?" Chen Wan wondered.
"Well, let's return the way we came and look again. Even if we don't find a fork, maybe those Human Demons have already left, and we can get out," Yuan Ming said.
"Alright."
After discussing, the two headed back the way they came, hurrying along the narrow, cramped passage.
When they finally returned to the cavern, before they had the chance to leave, they heard voices coming from inside.
"No matter what, we need to see the person alive, or the body if dead," a man's voice came through.
"He's definitely dead; with that situation, there's no way he could've come back alive..." the certain voice of a woman rose.
...
These voices sounded somewhat familiar to Yuan Ming, and he couldn't help but pause.
"Nothing bad happened, right?" At that moment, a somewhat timid voice spoke up.
Recognizing this voice, Yuan Ming immediately realized who it was and wanted to stop Chen Wan at his side, but she had already rushed out.
"Is it the fellow disciples from Biluo Cave?" Chen Wan called out anxiously.
"Don't..."
Yuan Ming had barely shouted "don't" when the three people at the other end of the cavern had already run over upon hearing the sound.
It was none other than Kun Tu, Yang Chan, and Ba Da.

chapters.title: Chapter 71 - 71: 51 chapters Three men make a tiger
chapters.content:
Seeing Chen Wan in an instant, Kun Tu and the other two's complexions stiffened, and their bodies froze in place like sculptures.
Chen Wan was also startled, somewhat caught off guard.
Seeing that Chen Wan's reaction was one of shock rather than anger, Kun Tu's expression changed and he pretended to be delighted as he called out,
"Junior Sister Chen Wan, we've finally found you!"
"You were looking for me?" Chen Wan said, taking a step back subconsciously as he approached, her tone dubious.
Before she had finished speaking, Yuan Ming also rushed out and quickly said, "Be careful, don't get close."
"Despicable Beast Slave, how dare you secretly harm and plunder the disciples of Biluo Cave, such brazen audacity. Do you realize your crimes!" The moment Kun Tu saw Yuan Ming, a murderous intent burst from his eyes, and he immediately scolded.
As the words were spoken, including Chen Wan, Yuan Ming, and even Ba Da, Yang Chan and the others, all were taken aback, as if nobody had expected Kun Tu to say such a thing.
Yang Chan immediately reacted and followed up, saying, "Junior Sister Chen Wan, are you okay? Did that lowly slave hurt you?"
Hearing this, Chen Wan's brows furrowed tight, a hesitancy flashing in her eyes.
"Don't believe their nonsense. Don't forget, how were you poisoned?" Yuan Ming quickly interjected to remind her.
"Junior Sister Chen Wan, this villain and another Beast Slave colluded to poison us with toxins extracted from Fierce Beasts, intent on committing unspeakable deeds. Luckily, Junior Brother Ba Da discovered it in time, and we weren't all poisoned," Kun Tu immediately said.
Yang Chan quickly added, saying, "Yes, we've killed the other Beast Slave, but this one took advantage of your unconscious state to kidnap you and escape. I sent the Fire Python to rescue you, but in the end also..."
She didn't finish her sentence, instead looking towards Ba Da, signaling for him to also say something.
"Junior Sister Chen Wan, after you were taken away, we never gave up and kept searching for you. Thankfully, you're unharmed," Ba Da, slightly slower to react, then nodded vigorously.
By the time these three had each had their say, Chen Wan was somewhat dazed as well.
When she had awoken, she was already on the run in the passage. Aside from the pursuit of the Fire Python, she hadn't seen anything, and now, hearing them say this, she suddenly was unsure whose words to trust.
"Junior Sister Chen Wan, don't be deceived by this guy, a lowly Fur Beast Slave, how can there be a few true words from his mouth?" Kun Tu continued to persuade.
"Sister, let's go with us. Not only are there many Human Demons this time, but a King has also emerged inside. If we split up again, the casualties will be severe. If not for finding you, we would have already rushed back to meet up with the others," Ba Da quickly said.
Though he was the slowest to react, he knew best how to deceive.
His guise of an honest man and his concerned expression once again deceived Chen Wan.
"What they said, is it true?" Chen Wan turned to look at Yuan Ming and asked in a cold voice, her eyes still carrying a trace of hesitation.
Yuan Ming sighed, knowing in his heart that the saying 'three men make a tiger' held true. Chen Wan's doubts had arisen, and she would no longer trust him now.
"Why waste words on this wretch? Kill him," Kun Tu roared furiously.
No sooner had he spoken than his figure suddenly flashed, stepping across towards Yuan Ming with a palm strike aiming at his head.
His palm seemed to inflate like being pumped with air, expanding in a circle and enshrouded in a layer of yellow light, looking like a rock falling down with a whistling sound.
Clearly, he had unleashed a strike intended to silence by killing, a move he deemed nearly infallible.
Yuan Ming was well-prepared for this. As the other party made his move, Yuan Ming had already activated the Fur Cloak Skill and turned into a White Ape, swinging his fist to smash against the yellow giant palm.
The punch collided with the palm, causing a loud boom, and a powerful pressure bore down.
Yuan Ming felt his arm shake, and a 'crack' sound came from his joints as his body involuntarily staggered backward.
"You despicable servant, to be able to receive my Shattering Monument Palm—you dare to lay hands on Junior Sister Chen Wan," Kun Tu saw this and did not forget to slander Yuan Ming again.
Yuan Ming retreated several steps to stabilize his frame, the vibrating force on his arm gradually fading, but his joints were throbbing with pain, as if they had already cracked open.My Virtual Library Empire (*) appreciates your readership at the source.
"Such great power, this person's cultivation must be no less than the Qi Refining Fifth Layer!" Yuan Ming estimated in his heart.
As he was on guard, a red light suddenly lit up behind him, the edge flashing across, sweeping toward Yuan Ming.
He shifted to one side, narrowly evading, only to find that Yang Chan had somehow approached, holding a blood-red dagger in her hand sweeping towards him.
Seeing the sweep miss, Yang Chan twisted her wrist, stabbing the reverse-held dagger diagonally downward, aiming straight for Yuan Ming's chest.
Yuan Ming immediately crossed his hands to block upward, his broad wrists catching Yang Chan's arm, and with an upward force, he repelled her.
She staggered backward, her chest heaving, a smile apparent on her face.
Yuan Ming instantly sensed something was wrong, noticing a dirt yellow glow appearing beneath his feet with three sharp stone spikes arising together, piercing towards him.
It was none other than Ba Da secretly making a move from not far away.
As his timing was impeccable, Yuan Ming had no chance to defend and his left foot was pierced by the sudden spikes, blood spurting as he involuntarily toppled backward.
How could Kun Tu miss such a golden opportunity? His eyes alight with excitement, he charged forward, targeting Yuan Ming from behind. Holding a blue watery spiral cone in his hand, he stabbed it towards Yuan Ming's back.
"Be careful..." Chen Wan found herself unexpectedly calling out a warning without realizing it.
As Yuan Ming saw the cone about to pierce him, bringing certain death, the shadow underneath his feet suddenly shifted to the side as if trying to flee from his physical body.
Immediately following, an astonishing scene unfolded.
As the shadow skewed to one side, Yuan Ming's body also eerily shifted sideways, narrowly evading the conical weapon's assassination attempt. His arm grazed the tip of the cone, leaving behind a spray of blood.
This sudden change in his movement technique caught everyone present by surprise.
"Shadowless Step?" Kun Tu exclaimed in disbelief.
"How is that possible? A Fur Beast Slave managing to learn the Shadowless Step?" Yang Chan was also exceptionally astonished.
Yuan Ming didn't bother to respond and widened the distance between himself and the three assailants as he dodged.
"Can't you see what's happening? They're trying to silence us by killing," Yuan Ming said to Chen Wan, his voice carrying a mix of pity and indignation.
Chen Wan's face showed hesitation. Remembering Yuan Ming's care along the way, she ultimately positioned herself between him and the others.
"Brother Kun Tu, I think there's more to this matter. Moreover, now is not the time to deal with it. We should hurry back and join the other disciples to discuss how to deal with the Human Demon King," Chen Wan said quickly.
Upon hearing this, Kun Tu's expression shifted slightly. He glanced at Yang Chan and Ba Da, and the three exchanged a look.
Yuan Ming immediately sensed something was wrong, and Chen Wan, sensing the odd atmosphere, also became alert.
"Since Sister Chen Wan has spoken, we won't insist. But do be careful of this Beast Slave; he's not as simple as he appears. Don't fall for his tricks," Kun Tu withdrew his aggressive stance and warned.
"Brother, you need not worry. I have my own plans," Chen Wan relaxed slightly and nodded.
Just then, Yang Chan's figure suddenly moved.
Yuan Ming was about to warn Chen Wan to be careful when a commotion suddenly erupted from the entrance above the cave, followed by several figures jumping down from above.
He saw that the five individuals who had fallen all wore the Biluo Cave Disciples' attire, though each had a look of exhaustion, their faces drained of energy.
As the figures dropped down like dumplings, Kun Tu and the others were taken aback. Meanwhile, Yang Chan, who had stealthily approached Chen Wan from behind, also had to hide her blood-red dagger behind her back.
"Get ready, here they come!" Before Kun Tu and the others could speak, someone suddenly shouted.
No sooner had the voice faded than one after another, Human Demons began dropping from above like dumplings, twelve in total—two more than the Biluo Cave Cultivators present.
The already cramped cave became even more crowded in an instant.
Without a need for a signal to start, the Human Demons clashed with the Biluo Cave Disciples, and magic filled the air with radiance and echoes of powerful collisions, plunging the entire cave into chaos.
Seeing that the Human Demon King hadn't returned with them, Yuan Ming felt a surge of relief and hurriedly moved towards the cave entrance amidst the commotion.
"What are you standing around for? Aren't you going to run?" he couldn't help but call out as he passed by Chen Wan.
However, after giving him a complex look, Chen Wan remained motionless, choosing instead to run towards the area where the Biluo Cave Disciples were concentrated.
Observing this, Yuan Ming felt not so much disappointment as he did a pang of loss.
"Have it your way then," he thought to himself. Turning around, he reached the cave wall and leapt up, scaling the rock face with hands and feet, heading for the cave's exit.
However, just as he was about to reach the exit and stretch out an arm to pull himself up, his arm suddenly went limp as if all strength had drained from it, failing to catch a rock protrusion and causing him to fall back down.
Yuan Ming's body fell, landing squarely on a Human Demon.
That creature was unexpectedly as hard as iron, making him feel as if he'd collided with an anvil, and he tumbled down.
Seeing this, Kun Tu quickly rushed toward Yuan Ming's location, not forgetting his intent to kill Yuan Ming even at this moment.
But before he could get close, a Human Demon blocked his path.
Yuan Ming hurried to dismiss the Fur Cloak Technique and crouched down, moving toward a corner.
That's when he saw Ba Da curled up into a ball, lurking in a niche, his small eyes sweeping back and forth with both vigilance and timidity, like a frightened mouse.
Yuan Ming had only taken a few steps when that feeling of weakness and dizziness struck again.
He quickly turned to look at his shoulder where Kun Tu's conical weapon had slashed him. The flesh was turned inside out and had turned dark, clearly indicating he'd been poisoned.
Cursing inwardly, Yuan Ming clenched his teeth and steadied his mind, then ran towards another passage.
Just as he moved, a Human Demon in front of him knocked a Biluo Cave Disciple to the ground and lunged at Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming ducked down and once again performed the Shadowless Step, his shadow skewing strangely as his body tilted, dodging in a manner that defied common understanding, slipping through two battling figures.
As soon as he was clear of the battle zone, his vision darkened, and his body was covered in a cold sweat, finding it difficult to hold on.
"Such a potent poison."
Yuan Ming's vision blurred, making everything appear somewhat illusory and indistinct.
But just then, amidst his overlapping vision, a delicate silver-white figure appeared—it was the mysterious silver cat that had shown up several times before.

chapters.title: Chapter 72 - 52 Stupid Guy
chapters.content:
"Is it? How could it be here?" Yuan Ming looked at the silver cat's agile and delicate figure, his mind a tangled mess.
In a daze, Yuan Ming saw the silver cat not far in front of him stop and look back at him.
Despite the bewildering scene, Yuan Ming clearly saw the silver cat's eyes with their differently colored pupils. His confused mind seemed to suddenly jolt, gaining a bit of clarity.
For some reason, he felt that the silver cat seemed to be waiting for him?
Yuan Ming instinctively took a step toward the direction where the silver cat had been, although his steps were still unsteady.
But as he approached, the silver cat ran off into the distance, skirting a protruding black stone and then vanishing from sight.
In a staggered pursuit, Yuan Ming reached the back of the black stone, only to find a pitch-black hole about the size of a bucket in the wall but no sign of the silver cat.
He looked around, but he couldn't find a single trace of the silver cat.
At that moment, there was a commotion behind him as if someone was approaching amidst a struggle.
Yuan Ming swayed and dived headfirst into the black hole; after his upper body entered, he toppled downward, and his entire being plummeted down.
As soon as his figure fell into it, a layer of murky yellow light suddenly appeared over the black hole, concealing its mouth.
When the light dispersed, the hole had disappeared as well.
...
Having lost track of time, Yuan Ming gradually came to, but still felt a throbbing headache.
The searing pain on his shoulder made him half-open his mouth, unable to hold back a few hissing noises from his throat.
Yuan Ming instinctively reached out to touch the ground beneath him, and immediately felt a sticky sensation in his palm.
At the same time, a mix of blood and rancid stench flooded his nostrils, provoking a bout of retching.
He desperately tried to open his eyes to see his surroundings, but the darkness was as thick as ink, no matter how hard he tried, he could see nothing.
As time passed, the sensation of dizziness in his head somewhat subsided, and he groped around, trying to stand up. The uneven terrain made any movement with his hands and knees awkward and collision-prone.
Yuan Ming stopped fumbling around and instead explored his vicinity, only to horrifically find that he was surrounded by severed limbs and broken bodies, indiscernible whether they were human or animal.
Some were decayed to chilling white bones, others had rotted away to mush, and there were those that seemed freshly dead, their blood not yet dry.
On some of the corpses, Yuan Ming felt the beast skin draped over their flesh and the silken texture of clothes, leading him to guess that these were the remains of Fur Beast Slaves and Biluo Cave Disciples.Part of a series hosted by My Virtual Library Empire (MV&LEMP&YR).
"This seems like a corpse pit?" Yuan Ming speculated, shivering involuntarily.
It was not fear that made him shiver but rather the genuinely low temperature around him. The heavy yin energy, combined with the complex and foul smell, made breathing difficult.
Yuan Ming gently caressed his shoulder, discovering the swelling had not subsided but the pain had lessened significantly, and his mind was not as muddled as before, which brought him some relief.
Knowing this was not a place of safety, he was about to get up when he suddenly heard a voice that seemed to emanate from within his mind:
"I..."
The moment he heard the voice, Yuan Ming tensed up, holding his breath and listening intently.
"I... am you, do... not move."
"I am you, do not move, what does that mean?" The intermittent voice came, leaving Yuan Ming utterly confused.
Just as he instinctively wanted to question "Who is speaking?" the voice echoed once more in his consciousness, this time a bit more coherent.
"I... am you... If that's the case, then... do not move, you will die."
Hearing this, Yuan Ming was filled with even greater suspicion and alarm.
Reason restrained him from speaking out and also made him halt his immediate movement to rise.
Yuan Ming slightly raised his head, his gaze raised just above the decayed remains beside him, and stealthily surveyed the area further away, but it remained pitch black, impossible to see anything clearly.
However, at that moment, a dim red light suddenly lit up, casting a bloody and gloomy glow within a radius of several meters, making it seem like a haunted cavern.
Yuan Ming took advantage of the faint light to carefully look around, searching for the source of the reminder, but found nothing.
But when his gaze settled on the source of the blood light, his heart couldn't help but tremble.
"Human Demon King..."
He saw that near the bottom of the uneven stone wall there was a six-foot-around Blood Pool, the churning blood within emitting a red glow that bathed the wall behind it in a bloody hue.
Inside the Blood Pool, the horned Human Demon King was sitting with his eyes closed, his head slightly tilted back and his mouth wide open.
Above his mouth, three inches into the void, hovered a pitch-black round orb the size of a lychee, shrouded with strands of dark red vapor, slowly swirling like early morning mist.
At this moment, from within the Blood Pool, one after another vague humanoid shadow began to drift out. They were being pulled by an invisible force and absorbed into that black Round Orb.
Yuan Ming stiffened his neck, not daring to let out a breath, his gaze fixed on the Human Demon King, his heart pounding frantically.
After a long while, just as his neck was starting to ache, the Human Demon King's eyes suddenly opened. His eyes were congealed with blood, devoid of any pupils to be seen.
With a single inhale, the black Round Orb sank down and entered his mouth.
Yuan Ming watched intently and discovered that the Round Orb had not sunk into the Human Demon King's stomach but was suspended between his throat, neither rising nor falling. It looked just like an Adam's apple.
As the black Round Orb was swallowed into the throat, a layer of black mist promptly condensed on his face, which then flowed into his eyes and was absorbed completely.
The blood color in the Human Demon King's eyes slightly receded, his pupils gleaming with a dark light. His aura surged violently as if he transformed from a living corpse into an Evil being.
He reached out with one hand, fingers bent into a claw, and grabbed at the empty space above the Blood Pool.
Bubbles suddenly burst forth from the churning Blood Pool as the blood seemed to boil, surging upward. A rough-hewn long knife, which looked as though it had been chiseled from stone slabs, was raised up by the blood and delivered into the hand of the Human Demon King.
The Human Demon King grasped the long knife and swept out of the Blood Pool, charging directly into a cave passageway nearby and disappeared in an instant.
As he left, the surface of the Blood Pool gradually calmed, but then about a dozen vague shadows began to emerge and gathered towards the Corpse Pit where Yuan Ming was located.
Before he could get a clear look, the light within the Blood Pool extinguished, and darkness enveloped the area once again.
Yuan Ming, who had just slightly relaxed, suddenly tensed up again, breathing rapidly, struggling to rise.
However, when he tried to push himself up, he realized that his arms had become stiff and numb without him noticing, and he couldn't even feel their presence.
Upon closer examination, he was horrified to find that not only his arms but also his legs had completely lost sensation. And although his upper body still had feeling, he couldn't move it at all.
"Damn it, the poison is acting up," Yuan Ming's heart sank.
He had been accidentally poisoned during his previous encounter with Kun Tu and the others, and now it seemed that the poison was taking full effect.
Yuan Ming was extremely anxious in his heart, but with struggle to even move, he couldn't self-administer any aid.
Although he couldn't see those ghostly shadows, he could feel the air temperature around him drop once again. His hairs stood on end—the thing was coming...
Before Yuan Ming could react, he suddenly felt a chill at the back of his neck, as if something had clung on to him.
Immediately after, the chill spread throughout his body, causing him to stiffen involuntarily.
"Is it a yin spirit or a ghost?" Yuan Ming wondered in alarm.
At that moment, the chill at his neck intensified, and it seemed as though those ghosts were burrowing into his body.
Just as Yuan Ming felt as though he was sinking into an ice cellar, getting colder and colder, a warm sensation suddenly blossomed on his right arm, instantly spreading to his back.
This warmth, flowing past for just a moment, dispelled the chilling sensation akin to ghostly possession.
Yuan Ming couldn't see, but could sense that the temperature around him had risen slightly, returning to its original state—yet, he still couldn't move.
Even though the ghosts no longer harassed him, being trapped like this wasn't a solution. Even if he didn't succumb to the poison, once the Human Demon King returned, he would most likely die.
Yuan Ming carefully considered his options in his mind but promptly realized he had none.
The Fur Cloak Technique was useless in this situation, and forcefully cultivating the Nine Elements Technique not only wouldn't resist the poison but might also hasten the poison's rush to his brain due to cultivation, leading to a swifter death.
As for the Incense Burner Mark on his arm, it had previously shielded him from Divine Soul harm but had never shown any detoxifying ability. Would it be of any use?
But since there were no other options, Yuan Ming could only try to communicate with the incense burner, hoping against hope.
As he directed a trickle of Mana toward the location of the incense burner on his arm, a faint glimmer of light emerged, and an Incense Burner Mark surfaced, gradually solidifying from ethereal to real, with one leg of the burner already materializing.
However, a surging sense of numbness suddenly overwhelmed him. The Mana he was channeling was forcibly interrupted, and the incense burner on his arm faded away, disappearing from sight.
The last hope was gone.
Yuan Ming cursed inwardly, yet suddenly, a spark of spirit light flashed in his mind.
"Earlier, your guidance was most kind. I am truly grateful. Can you lend me further assistance?" Yuan Ming was not sure if anyone would hear him but still pleaded aloud.
No sooner had the words left his mouth than silence reigned, with no response from any quarter.
"Since you spoke up, you surely don't wish for me to die like this," Yuan Ming continued to call out.
Still, the silence persisted, with not even a whisper of a reply.
"What am I supposed to do now if you don't speak up again? What should I do?" The poison spread further, numbing Yuan Ming's throat, warping his speech, and making his words slurred and unclear.
Just as Yuan Ming was on the verge of despair, that voice finally came again, sounding directly in his mind:
"Foolish... creature."

chapters.title: Chapter 73 - 53 Soul Power
chapters.content:
"Dragon Qiu's nest..." Yuan Ming's heart filled with joy, but the voice he uttered had completely deformed.
Another long silence ensued, and that voice echoed in Yuan Ming's mind again.
"You... have already been poisoned, and now... corpse paralysis has entered your body, the co-occurrence of the two poisons, difficult to survive."
That voice still resonated only in his mind, and it was not until then that Yuan Ming noticed that it belonged to a woman and sounded ethereal and pleasant.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming tried to speak but found himself unable to produce any sound.
"I can... save you, but... afterward, you help me, do something," the voice rang again, seemingly more coherent than before.
It felt as if the person was trying hard to learn to speak and was gradually getting accustomed to it.
"Oh oh..." Yuan Ming vaguely agreed while nodding.
"Now, do as I... say. Sink your thoughts... into the Sea of Consciousness... try to... connect with your own... Divine Soul Power."
Listening to that voice, Yuan Ming felt as if he was under a spell, his thoughts sinking into the Sea of Consciousness. In the midst of chaos, he gradually calmed down.
"Divine Soul Power, connect to the body... awaken... mana, move towards the lower body... first to the hips, then to... the thighs... calves, until it concentrates... in the big toe..."
Yuan Ming did as instructed, surprisingly smoothly, and as the poison moved downward, his upper body quickly regained mobility, and the numbness in his lower body began to recede.
Accompanying this, his right foot began to swell rapidly, expanding more than twice its size, and an indescribable pain struck, almost causing Yuan Ming's will to collapse.
"Maintain focus on Divine Thought... poisoning backlash... all efforts will be undone..." the pleasant voice timely reminded Yuan Ming, allowing him to forcibly regain his composure.
"What's next?" Yuan Ming could speak once more.
His forehead was covered with large beads of sweat that kept rolling down, and the intense pain nearly made him pass out.
"Sharp object, poke through foot... Yongquan point, poisoned blood, force it out of the body..."
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming immediately used the tip of the Green Fish Sword to pierce the Yongquan point on his right foot, and the next instant, blood gushed from the bottom of his foot, its foul smell almost overpowering the odor of the Corpse Pit.
But as the poisoned blood flowed out in large amounts, the discomfort also quickly eased.
Once all the poisoned blood had drained, Yuan Ming's foot returned to its normal size, but the wound did not heal, and the pain, sharp as needle pricks, continued to torment him.
Yuan Ming struggled out of the Corpse Pit and quickly expressed his gratitude: "Thank you for saving my life."
"Blood Pool... this way," the voice rang out again.
Yuan Ming, limping, followed the direction in his memory, groping his way towards the Blood Pool.
"Stop."
Suddenly, the voice called out a warning.
Yuan Ming immediately stopped walking, bent down, and touched the ground, only to realize he had reached the edge of the Blood Pool, another step and he would have fallen in.
"The objects on the ground... pick them up."
Though curious, Yuan Ming still squatted down and extended his hand to feel around.
In his grasp, Yuan Ming felt a slight chill and, upon lifting it, found a thin, triangular metal piece with complicated patterns etched on it.
"Eight pieces... pick them all up... surround the edge of the Blood Pool... bury them in the loose soil," the voice continued to direct.
Yuan Ming didn't hesitate, promptly burying the triangular metal pieces around the Blood Pool as instructed.
"Done."
"You can go... leave, this place," the ethereal voice said.
This сhаptеr first аppеаrеd оn М|V|L^ЕМРYR.
"Thank you very much," Yuan Ming replied, thanking her and then started fumbling about, seeking a way out.
However, the cave was pitch black, and he had no light source on him, nor did he know magic like the Fireball Technique which could illuminate his surroundings. After much groping around, he still could not find an exit.
The mysterious person hiding somewhere seemed somewhat impatient at last and finally spoke up again, "Your Soul Power, not weak... divert Soul Power, concentrate on the eyes."
"Can it be done this way?" Yuan Ming exclaimed in surprise.
"Possessing Soul Power... not utilizing it at all... truly is... a foolish fellow," the voice sighed.
Yuan Ming immediately followed the suggestion, concentrating his Divine Soul Power, focusing his will on his own eyes, and looked around with wide eyes.
"With Soul Power concentrated, why... would you widen your eyes like that?" the ethereal voice chided.
Yuan Ming blinked awkwardly, returning to a normal demeanor, and finely tuned into the sensation of Soul Power concentrated in his eyes.
In no time, he felt a slight coolness in his eyes, followed by his pitch-black vision gradually clearing, as if ink was dissipating. The cave walls, Blood Pool, rocks... the blurred lines of various objects started to emerge.
Even though it was still very dim and things were unclear, it was no longer the pitch blackness where he could not see his hand before his face.
Yuan Ming looked around, trying to find the figure of the one who reminded him and to confirm a guess in his own heart, but in the end, he saw nothing.
"Hurry, leave, before you find yourself unable to," the ethereal voice rang out in his mind, a hint of warning clearly present in the reminder.
"Thank you."
Yuan Ming thanked them and immediately felt along the side of the cave wall until he found a hidden exit and ran out.
After leaving the cavern, the stench of blood and decay in the air was significantly lessened. Yuan Ming took a deep breath and limped away down the passageway, making his escape.
But he hadn't gone far when his vision suddenly darkened and an intense wave of dizziness hit him, followed by a sharp, piercing pain at the center of his forehead.
His vision was obscured by the darkness once again until the Soul Power concentrated in his eyes could no longer maintain itself and dissipated on its own, causing the pain to slowly subside.
"This Soul Power is useful, but it's a pity that it can't be used at will." Yuan Ming clenched his teeth and couldn't help but pinch the sore spot on his forehead, as he supported himself against the wall and moved toward the other end of the passageway.
After walking for quite some time, a flickering light and some indistinct voices suddenly emerged from the darkness ahead.
Yuan Ming guessed that it was the disciples of Biluo Cave. He didn't want to encounter these people, but there was only one path through the passageway, and he couldn't go back to the Human Demon King's cave, so he had to grit his teeth and head toward the light.
"Who's there? Who is it?" A stern shout suddenly came from up ahead.
The noisy chatter ahead came to an abrupt halt.
"I, I am…" Yuan Ming began to say but hesitated.
After a moment's hesitation, he spoke up, "I am a Fur Beast Slave under Elder Hu Huo."
As soon as he finished speaking, the sound of a whooshing object came from ahead, and a Fireball Technique "whizzed" toward him, nearly filling half the cave.
Yuan Ming had no way to dodge and could only draw out the Green Fish Sword and step forward to bring the sword down in a vertical slash.
The fireball split into two with a sound and dispersed to either side.
Following the firelight, an arrow wrapped in green glow quickly shot through the air.
Yuan Ming staggered, struggling to execute the Shadowless Step to dodge. He narrowly missed the arrow attack, but lost his balance and fell to the side.
Laughter then followed from ahead.
"Brother Kun Tu, it's just a Fur Beast Slave, no need to be so cautious," someone said, laughing.
"What nonsense, now that we've arrived at such a dangerous place, it's better to be cautious. Better to kill wrongly than to let go," Kun Tu's voice responded immediately.
Hearing this, Yuan Ming suppressed his anger and didn't immediately stand up, fearing that it might provoke another attack from the other party.
Meanwhile, the light and footsteps gradually approached, and he saw two tall figures walking in front, holding torches high, with many more people following behind, indistinct in the shadows.
The leader brought the torch close to Yuan Ming and illuminated his somewhat pale face.
"Yuan Ming?" a voice uttered, puzzled.
Chen Wan squeezed through from behind the two men.
Hearing this, Kun Tu also pushed through the crowd and the instant he saw Yuan Ming, his face darkened.
"How come you're still alive?" Kun Tu said brusquely.
Yuan Ming didn't answer. Under the circumstances, Kun Tu was not in a position to attack him, and he certainly didn't want to provoke him.
"You… how come you are here?" Chen Wan asked.
Yuan Ming hesitated slightly before replying, "Earlier, I accidentally fell from above and ended up in the Human Demon King's lair. It was quite difficult, but I finally escaped and ended up here, where I ran into you guys."
"You escaped from the Human Demon King's lair?" someone exclaimed incredulously.
"We've been wandering around these interconnected caves for quite some time and haven't found it. You were just lucky enough to fall right into it," someone immediately joked.
The rest also chimed in, showing no sign of fear at all.
"If you go to find the Human Demon King, you will die," Yuan Ming said, not looking at the others but turning his eyes to Chen Wan as he spoke.
Upon hearing this, Chen Wan's face showed hesitation.
"A mere Fur Beast Slave dares to spout such frightening nonsense and mislead others?" Kun Tu shouted angrily.
"Look at him; he must have been scared out of his wits. We have so many people here, are we still afraid of a Human Demon King?" a tall and lean man dressed in Beast Taming Hall disciple's attire said laughingly.
"Hehe, expecting courage from a mere beast slave, yeah right?" another person mocked.
"Yuan Ming, do you still remember how to find the Human Demon King's lair?" Chen Wan asked.
Yuan Ming thought for a moment, then shook his head.
"This kid probably got scared before he even clapped eyes on it, haha…" the crowd laughed again.
"What are you thinking, if he had seen the Human Demon King, how could he possibly still be alive?" someone else said.
"Hey kid, don't be scared. We've cleaned out those Human Demons already. Once we strike directly at the heart and take the Human Demon King's head, you'll get to share in the glory," a burly and tall young man said.
"No need to waste words on him. By causing such confusion, we might as well slaughter him," Kun Tu suggested at the right moment.
"Exactly, this guy is useless; just kill him," Yang Chan added.
Ba Da, who had been hiding in the back all along, didn't speak, but his narrowed eyes were fixed on Yuan Ming, a dangerous flash passing through them.

chapters.title: Chapter 74 - 54 Disintegration
chapters.content:
"Kun Tu, brother, he's not a Human Demon, don't you think it's a bit too much to keep yelling about beating and killing?" Chen Wan's eyebrows furrowed as she couldn't help but speak up.
"Just a Fur Beast Slave, it's his own fault for not being able to keep his mouth shut. He was asking for death," Kun Tu glanced at Yuan Ming and said.
"Alright, stop wasting time here, let him lead the way. We need to hurry up and find the Human Demon King. As long as we can kill it, this trial will be considered more than complete for us. Maybe we can even hope to be promoted to the Inner Sect," said the tall young man with a chuckle.
"There are no forks in this passage, just keep heading inside straight ahead, you can't go wrong," Yuan Ming immediately said.
The tall young man's smile faded, and he sneered, "Without you leading the way, you're useless. Killing you is not out of the question."
Hearing this, Yuan Ming had no choice but to agree.
He took a torch from someone and walked at the very front of the group, leading everyone back.
After a long walk, when they were nearing the cave, they gradually picked up the stench of blood and decay in the air, and one by one, they unconsciously fell silent, beginning to quiet down.
This team, excluding Yuan Ming, had another seventeen or eighteen people, who seemed to be leaders among the Registered Disciples – numerous and strong. Although they were somewhat arrogant, they were not foolish.
When they arrived at the entrance to the cave, they all unconsciously stopped, gesturing for Yuan Ming to go in first.
Helpless, Yuan Ming could only walk in ahead of the others.
Fortunately, the cave was empty; the Human Demon King had not returned.
He carried the torch and looked around inside, checking every corner that he couldn't see clearly before, but he didn't find the presence that had transmitted a message to him earlier. He did, however, notice that there were new rune carvings on the ground around the Blood Pool, faintly surrounding it.
Yuan Ming was certain that when he had buried the triangle charm iron earlier, those rune carvings had not been on the ground, indicating that they were made after he had left.
"The Human Demon King is not here, it's temporarily safe inside." Yuan Ming shouted to the people outside.
After his words fell, it took a full thirty minutes before someone entered the cave.
After that, the rest of the people filed in, seeing no danger inside, they grew bolder and started to look around.
"Where's the Human Demon King? Where is it?" someone asked.
"Looks like it ran off?"
"Search around, are there any other caves?" the tall young man ordered, looking every bit the leader.
Kun Tu meanwhile edged closer to Yuan Ming, intentionally or otherwise.
Yuan Ming was on guard, moving nimbly, always keeping a distance from him.
Just then, from the other side of the cave, suddenly there was a scream.
Before anyone could react, they saw a huge head rolling "gulu gulu" to their feet.
Immediately after, a Blood Shadow flew past in the dimness of the cave.
The tall, thin man who had previously mocked Yuan Ming barely had time to let out a brief shout before the upper half of his body flew up, spraying blood everywhere.
"The Human Demon King, it's the Human Demon King..." someone shouted first.
All around the cave, lights of various colors lit up as these Registered Disciples each activated their Protective Magic Artifacts, retreating to the other side.
Yuan Ming threw the torch towards Kun Tu's direction and turned to disappear into the darkness, using his better knowledge of the terrain to quickly hide his figure.
Drawn by the torch, the Human Demon King's figure flashed and pounced towards Kun Tu.
"Yuan Ming!"
Kun Tu was furious and urgently mobilized his mana. A jade pendant hanging on his body suddenly burst into a soft glow, enveloping him.
At the same time, he dodged with a sidestep, avoiding the Human Demon King's frontal assault.
However, as they passed each other, the Human Demon King suddenly swept out an arm, its muscular and wiry limb, covered in long hair, landed solidly on his body.
Kun Tu's body was surrounded by a bright green glow, which then shattered with a "crack," and his body tumbled outwards.
In this brief encounter, before the others even got a clear look at the Human Demon, several were already dead or injured, causing those Registered Disciples, who were full of ambition, to suddenly lose their composure.
"We can't hold it, our Protective Magic Artifacts can't withstand a single blow."
"It's too strong, it's too strong..."
While the people were screaming in fear, they were retreating backwards, unwittingly clustering together.
"Idiots, spread out, don't bunch up," the tall young man shouted angrily.
No sooner had he spoken than the Human Demon King charged at them.
"Everyone to your positions, as we previously discussed, quickly set up the Fire Array," the tall young man called out aloud.
Only then did everyone start to regain some composure, hastily scattering to all sides.
The tall young man brought his hands together, in the palm of his hands was a Green Talisman Paper, inscribed with runes that seemed both drawn and painted, depicting the figure of a Golden Bell.
The Green Talisman Paper ignited in his palm, producing a wisp of green smoke, and then translucent Golden Light spread from it, forming a radiant golden bell image that enveloped his body.
The young man took the initiative to step forward, blocking the Human Demon King's path, buying time for the others.
Inspired, the rest began to spread out to either side, closing in with the intent to surround the Human Demon King in the middle.
In the advancing crowd, Ba Da's figure was moving backwards, retreating all the way to the entrance of the cave they had come through, and escaped without looking back.
The Human Demon King collided with the tall young man, raised a palm, and slapped it down.
"Boom"
A heavy chiming of the bell rang out, as the golden light surged around the young man, the phantom of the Golden Bell shaking violently, yet not shattering immediately.
The tall young man inside the phantom of the Golden Bell let out a muffled groan, fresh red blood tracing its way out of his ears, instantly rendering him completely deaf, unable to hear anything at all.
However, by the illumination of the Golden Bell's glow, he saw a gigantic hole in the chest of the Human Demon King, a hole so large it penetrated through the entire chest, a clear sign of a severe injury.
"Quick, it's seriously injured, activate the Great Array, release the Flames, burn it to death," the tall young man shouted loudly, but as he opened his mouth, blood filled it.
Having said that, he immediately retreated back, to beyond the encirclement.
The surrounding crowd finally got into position, among them eight individuals each pulled out a small, triangle-shaped red flag from their bosoms and channeled their Mana into them.
The red flags lit up with bright light, a scorching aura spreading out from them.
In the next instant, the eight flags burst into towering flames simultaneously, turning into arm-thick Fire Pythons surging toward the Human Demon King.
The Human Demon King was covered in flames, its entire form igniting instantly.The most up-to-date version is on *.
The roaring Flames, fiercely burning, made the entire cavern oppressively hot, and even the stone walls that hadn't seen daylight for a long time cracked with dry sounds.
The miserable screams of the Human Demon King echoed in the cavern, causing those who heard it to get goosebumps.
After a dozen breaths' time, the Spiritual Power of the triangle flags was exhausted, and the flames of the Flame Array gradually withered, until they vanished completely.
The light within the cavern dimmed rapidly as Yuan Ming frowned and looked towards the Human Demon King.
All that could be seen was its hunched over form, arms wrapped around itself, every hair on its body singed, looking for all the world like a charred piece of black coal, still with sporadic sparks twinkling and wisps of smoke rising from its body.
"Dead?" Yuan Ming was somewhat surprised.
"Haha, it's dead, we've killed the Human Demon King," a thin young man exclaimed happily.
"It wasn't as formidable as we imagined..." another person laughed, completely forgetting the fear that had had him rolling in his own urine earlier.
"This time we are indebted to Senior Brother Qing Chuan. Without him buying us time, we wouldn't have managed to activate the Flame Array in time," someone finally spoke a word of fairness.
At this, the others also began to compliment the tall young man.
The tall young man, while wiping the blood from the corners of his mouth, waved his hand at the crowd with a show of reluctance to take credit.
"This was a concert effort by everyone, I..."
He hadn't finished his words when a round head suddenly flew up into the air, a gush of blood spurting toward the cavern ceiling like a fountain, then spraying onto the faces of the surrounding disciples.
Feeling the warm touch of fresh blood, the others had not yet registered what had happened when they heard Chen Wan's loud shout:
"No good! The Human Demon King isn't dead, everyone run!"
After speaking, she was the first to dashed into the tunnel.
Kun Tu, who was knocked down earlier, also secretly ignited a yellowish talisman paper and burrowed into the ground, disappearing from sight.
The panic of the others surged at that moment, and they all rushed towards the entrance of the tunnel.
The torches were thrown to the ground, and as a Blood Shadow flashed by, the flames were extinguished, plunging the entire cavern back into darkness.
Pitiful screams of agony began, which seemed to go on and on without end.
...
After a long time, the cavern finally became quiet again.
Yuan Ming was still hiding in the same place, covering his mouth with both hands, daring not to let out even a breath.
In the darkness, a rustling sound suddenly emerged.
Forcing his heart to steady, he focused once again, concentrating his vision into the darkness of the cavern.
The once not-so-spacious cavern was now a complete mess; the floor was littered with broken limbs and torsos, while the walls and ceiling were smeared with chaotic streaks of blood.
The rich smell of blood completely suppressed the stench of rotting corpses.
The Human Demon King, charred and smeared with blood, was dragging two mutilated corpses towards the direction of the Corpse Pit.
With every step, the sound of corpses dragging against the ground grated on Yuan Ming's nerves.
To avoid the vertigo and intense pain he experienced before, Yuan Ming watched for a moment before closing his eyes again to quietly recuperate.
After a good while, the sound of dragging ceased.
Yuan Ming immediately refocused his eyesight, searching for the trace of the Human Demon King.
After looking around, he saw the Human Demon King bending down, kneeling beside the Corpse Pit, looking downward at something.
Suddenly, it opened its mouth and spat out a black Round Orb, which shone with a splendid glow. The sphere pulsed with a dark sheen and immediately generated a powerful suction.
Almost at once, layers of Black Mist rose from the pit, blurry shades of Residual Souls slowly emerged, each with faces twisted in fear and struggle, evidently torn out against their will.
No matter how these shades struggled, it was impossible for them to resist the pull of the black Round Orb, and they were torn to shreds, bit by bit absorbed into the sphere.
The Human Demon King opened its mouth wide and swallowed the black Round Orb back down its throat, its eyes immediately lighting up with a blood-red gleam. But soon after, the light subdued, returning to their original appearance.
At this moment, however, the Human Demon King suddenly made a move that surprised Yuan Ming.
The creature clutched at its head with both hands, shaking violently, as if venting frustration and agitation.

chapters.title: Chapter 75 - 55: Taking Action
chapters.content:
Before long, the Human Demon King's eyes, which had been glowing with a blood-red light, dimmed, and he stopped moving, reverting to his original state.
"What's going on? The spiritual intelligence of this Human Demon King seems a bit off," he wondered to himself.
At that moment, the Human Demon King rose to its feet and walked toward the Blood Pool.
Yuan Ming's eyebrows rose as he looked at the runes carved around the Blood Pool, sensing that something might happen when the Human Demon King stepped into them.
Just as the Human Demon King was about to step over the Rune Iron buried in the ground, it suddenly halted, stopping in its tracks.
"Has it discovered something?" Yuan Ming was astonished.
But soon, Yuan Ming realized that he had been overthinking it.
The reason for the Human Demon King's pause seemed to be because the blood color in its eyes had receded once again, as if its spiritual intelligence was malfunctioning, causing it to stop.
A moment later, it stepped over the rune carvings and entered into the Blood Pool.
For some reason, the rune carvings did not react at all to the entrance of the Human Demon King, whether they had not met the trigger condition, or if they were not meant for the Human Demon King in the first place?
Regardless of which it was, Yuan Ming did not intend to intervene; he only wanted to hide quietly on the side and wait for the crisis to pass.
At this time, he noticed that the blood in the Blood Pool was churning violently, the disturbance was several times greater than before, causing countless "gurgle" bubbles to rise, completely shrouding the Human Demon King's upper body, submerging it up to the neck.
The wound on its chest was emitting curls of white smoke, spreading a scent of decaying flesh and blood into the air.
A red halo lit up from the entire Blood Pool, enveloping it completely.
"Could it be that this creature is healing?" Although Yuan Ming did not understand completely, he could guess a thing or two.
After a short time, the water level in the Blood Pool significantly dropped, revealing the Human Demon King's chest where the ghastly wound had been, which was now filled and repaired by fresh flesh.
Even the charred flesh on its body had been restored; its skin turned dry and waxy yellow, resembling a mummified corpse that had been dried for years.
"Such a strong recovery ability!" Yuan Ming watched the wound heal and felt a sinking feeling in his heart, his worries deepened.
All he could hope for now was that the Human Demon King would leave once its injuries were healed.
The hair on the Human Demon King's body had not grown, but its muscles gradually filled out, and its facial contours returned to their original shape, resembling a young man's face with a high nose bridge and chiseled features.
If it weren't for its overly protruding eyes, which twisted its expression, the face would have actually conveyed some noble and handsome qualities.
Yuan Ming inexplicably felt a chill in his heart, certain that he had seen a human face, the face of a young man.
"How can this be? Could it be that the Human Demon King is disguised as a human, or... has it transformed from a human?" These thoughts involuntarily surfaced in his mind.
While he was thinking this, he suddenly heard a shrill scream from the mouth of the Human Demon King in the Blood Pool, and its body suddenly stood up and clawed at its own chest.
Yuan Ming quickly looked over and saw the flesh on the Human Demon King's chest, which had just healed, rotten at a speed visible to the naked eye. The quickly darkening, purplish-black rotten flesh fell off from the chest, revealing the startling blood hole once more.
Not only that, but the flesh around the blood hole was also affected, decaying bit by bit, peeling away from its chest.
The Human Demon King frantically clawed at its own chest, tearing off the rotten flesh, struggling to get out of the Blood Pool.
But at that moment, the rune carvings surrounding the Blood Pool suddenly lit up.
From beneath the ground, a sequence of red lights arose; the rune carvings on the ground interconnected, forming an ancient Array that radiated red light.
Through the ground, Yuan Ming could see indistinct and archaic talisman characters.
To his surprise, these characters were not from the Southern Border, but appeared to be from the Central Plains.
However, each character's shape was different from any Yuan Ming recognized, all twisted and deformed, looking midway between text and drawing, complex and mysterious.
At the same time the runes lit up, numerous dark red rays of light emerged from the Array, writhing and probing into the Human Demon King in the center, wrapping around its neck like chains.
The moment the blood-colored chains ensnared him, the Human Demon King's face contorted in extreme pain, and it let out furious howls, its hands tearing at the bloody chains around its neck.
However, as soon as its claws touched the chains, they recoiled as if touching a red-hot iron.
"Whimper..."
The Human Demon King whined, the blood-red glow flickering in its eyes.
Seeing it ensnared, Yuan Ming knew the time had come and immediately turned to flee.
At that moment, however, that mysterious voice echoed in his head again: "Hurry... cut off its... head."
Yuan Ming hesitated upon hearing the voice and did not move immediately. Instead, he looked around again but still could not see the figure of the mysterious person.
"If you don't act now... the Array... won't hold it... you won't escape the cave... won't reach the surface... you'll die all the same," the voice became more urgent.
After hesitating for a moment, Yuan Ming clenched his fist, struck the wall, and rushed out with his sword.
The sound of his footsteps immediately caught the attention of the Human Demon King. The whining figure in the Blood Pool suddenly jerked, turning its head to look at Yuan Ming. It seemed to smell the scent of a living person and became uncontrollably agitated.
The Human Demon King struggled violently, and the dark red chains wrapped around his neck were yanked fiercely and shook violently.
The Rune Iron, which was buried in the ground, suddenly showed a tendency to be pulled out.
The entire dark red Array shook intensely, on the verge of collapse.
"It's too late..." Yuan Ming sighed in his heart.
He had just reached the Human Demon King's side, his long sword in hand not yet swiping, when a "bang" resounded from the ground.
A piece of Rune Iron, like an anchor, was pulled out, and the body of the Human Demon King tilted and lunged toward him.
Although he had not completely freed himself, the stretched distance was enough for his sharp hooks to slash Yuan Ming's throat.
At this critical moment, a silvery shadow suddenly flashed and landed on Yuan Ming's shoulder out of thin air.
Yuan Ming vaguely felt it was a silver cat, but he dared not distract himself to look.Thisfromthecollectionat*.
"Cut!"
The voice of command echoed in his mind with an undeniable tone of command.
Yuan Ming felt his head buzz as if struck by a bell, and immediately a sense of irresistible compliance rose within him.
It was as if a voice in the darkness was telling him to obey, to obey unconditionally.
At the same time, the Human Demon King's claws were also swinging at him.
At this moment, the silver cat squatting on Yuan Ming's shoulder gracefully faced the Human Demon King head-on, its eyes of different colors seemingly ablaze with bright stars, casting little sparks of light.
The moment the light splashed out, the struggling Human Demon King's body stiffened and stood still, his swinging claw also stopping inches from Yuan Ming's throat.
Just as Yuan Ming was about to yield and recognize the voice from the depths of his heart, desiring to submit, a warm sensation suddenly flowed from his right arm.
The green mark from the incense burner emerged, and a tidal wave of strength surged into his brain, instantly sobering him up.
The urge to submit that he had felt earlier vanished without a trace.
Upon seeing this, the silver cat's differing eyes revealed a flash of surprise, which quickly turned into confusion.
"If you don't strike soon... even if you don't die here... going out... the elders of Biluo Cave... will still lead to death," a stern warning echoed once again in Yuan Ming's mind.
"It really is it..." Yuan Ming confirmed his guess; the one who had been conversing with him in his mind was the silver cat that had appeared beside him long ago.
What was the origin of this silver cat, and how could it have saved me before and now possess such great abilities to contend with this Human Demon King?
Numerous thoughts flooded his mind, and he no longer hesitated, regulating his strength with the Energy Storage Arm and slashing with all his might at the neck of the Human Demon King.
A loud "clang" rang out.
Sparks sputtered from the Human Demon King's neck, and a metallic sound came from the dry skin beneath.
Yuan Ming felt a jolt in his arm, not as if he were chopping into a body, but as if he was striking a piece of steel clad in cowhide.
The forceful power forced him to retreat.
Meanwhile, as if enraged, the Human Demon King let out an angry roar, his body emanating a blood-red glow, which pulsated so violently that it snapped every link of the dark red chains around his neck.
The Rune Iron on the ground also burst into pieces, and the Array Yuan Ming had set up under the guidance of the silver cat was completely deactivated.
"Roar..."
The Human Demon King roared furiously and leaped out of the Blood Pool, facing Yuan Ming head-on.
The diminutive silver cat, with its extraordinary agility, leaped from Yuan Ming's shoulder and headed straight for the Human Demon King, nimbly stepping on its head before leaping several meters away.
Its light posture and swift actions appeared not so much an evasion but more like a dance, rapid and graceful.
Yuan Ming took the opportunity to retreat.
The moment the silver cat landed, its heterochromic eyes suddenly lit up with a strange black light, and its body emitted an indescribable Mana fluctuation.
As this fluctuation arose, there was a sudden disturbance in the nearby Corpse Pit.
Subsequently, bodies that had been dead for who knows how long suddenly "came to life" one after another.
Yuan Ming was startled by this unexpected turn of events, watching in disbelief as those decomposed and foul-smelling corpses twisted their bodies and rose from the Corpse Pit.
Most of them missing arms or legs, some even headless, they moved awkwardly as they walked, and some crawled on the ground using their arms, all lunging towards the frenzied Human Demon King.
The Human Demon King swiped at an oncoming living corpse with a claw, instantly tearing the body in half, yet the severed halves stubbornly rushed forward, clinging to his body.
Then came the second, the third... more and more living corpses surrounded him, toppling the Human Demon King, all climbing onto his body.

chapters.title: Chapter 76 - 56 Help Me
chapters.content:
Looking at the Human Demon King engulfed by corpses, Yuan Ming was already frozen in place.
He stiffly turned his head to look for the silver cat and soon saw it squatting on a rock not far away, still maintaining an elegant sitting posture, though its eyes were fixed on the Human Demon King being overwhelmed by the corpses.
"It is controlling those bodies, how did it do that?" Yuan Ming saw through its eyes that there were swirling masses of black fog, filling his heart with confusion.
At that moment, the Human Demon King suddenly went berserk again, yelling loudly, his body suddenly bursting up, his claws swinging.
Sharp claw marks burst out like sword edges, instantly chopping all the living corpses piled on him and the powerful impact even scattered the broken corpses.
But right after that, about a dozen corpses in the Corpse Pit "came alive" again, including seven or eight that had already turned into white skeletons, all staggering towards the Human Demon King.
The Human Demon King stepped forward and swung his claws, shattering these living corpses into pieces again.
"Don't just stand there . . . block him . . . I need to focus on gathering power . . . kill him," the voice of the silver cat rang out again, still in that cold commanding tone, but it flowed much more smoothly than before.
Although Yuan Ming was displeased, he moved forward as instructed.
He then deployed the Fur Cloak Technique, transformed into a White Ape, and taking advantage of the Human Demon King being entangled by two living corpses, violently charged from the side, hitting the Human Demon King's side with his right shoulder.
With a dull impact, Yuan Ming felt as if his shoulder bone was about to split, yet he still managed to knock the Human Demon King sideways with brute force.
Right after, he slapped the ground with one hand, and a blue light shone from the ground, as three blue Wooden Thorns suddenly thrust out, tripping the Human Demon King from behind, causing him to stumble and fall.
"Well done!" there was finally a pleasure in the echo from the silver cat.
Yuan Ming paid no heed, seizing the opportunity to leap up, his Green Fish Sword in hand pulsing with Mana, lighting up with a flowing green light as if fish were swimming along the blade, he swung it down towards the Human Demon King.
Just then, from the corner of his eye, he suddenly saw the living corpses, inexplicably, falling to the ground one by one as if their life had been drained, leaving him alone charging forward bravely.
"I've been tricked," the thought instinctively popped into Yuan Ming's head.
But by then, it was too late to backtrack.
With this surge of momentum, there might still be a chance for survival, but if he harbored any thoughts of retreat, he was likely doomed.
A fierce nature was stirred up inside Yuan Ming, the Nine Elements Technique madly circulating within him, his Green Fish Sword shining brightly and emitting a faint trembling noise as it swiped towards the Human Demon King's head.
The Human Demon King hurriedly raised his arm to block, meeting the blade head-on.
"Clang"
A shower of sparks flew as the edge of the Green Fish Sword fell onto the Human Demon King's arm.
This time, the Green Fish Sword finally penetrated the Human Demon King's skin, opened a gash in his arm, and lodged into the flesh.
Embarrassingly, however, the blade was trapped by the Human Demon King's exceedingly tough muscles, making it difficult to pull free.
Yuan Ming did not hesitate for a moment, immediately abandoning the long sword and backing away.
The Human Demon King roared furiously, leaping up and blocking Yuan Ming's path.
In his eyes, murder was rampant, his nostrils spewing filthy black air; raising a claw, he thrusted directly at Yuan Ming's throat, not caring about the sword still stuck in his arm.
At the critical moment, Yuan Ming's shadow suddenly shifted, causing his body to weirdly dodge to the side.
The Human Demon King's sharp claws brushed past Yuan Ming's neck without hitting him.
His arm swung in motion, slamming harshly onto Yuan Ming's neck.
Instantly, Yuan Ming felt as though he was struck by a heavy hammer; his mind grew heavy, and his body was flung out, crashing heavily against the cave wall.
"Cough . . . "
He violently coughed up a mouthful of fresh blood, his eyes bloodshot, and his vision blurring.
Before he could even stand up, he suddenly saw a blurry black shadow charging towards him, undoubtedly the Human Demon King.
The heavy blow to the head and the blurred vision caused by the congestion made it impossible for him to make an accurate judgment or dodge, leaving him stumbling backward, making a last-ditch effort to protect himself.
"I'm going to die . . . " that was the only thought left in Yuan Ming's mind.
But just then, behind the fast-approaching shadow, a brilliant flare of red-gold radiance suddenly lit up, like a rising sun, bringing with it a hot yet not stifling breeze, charging forward.
In the next instant, the golden light crashed directly into the Human Demon King's body, entering through his back and bursting forth from his chest.
The Human Demon King's forward movement halted abruptly as if suddenly frozen, still in a charging pose but stiffened on the spot, unable to move.
Yuan Ming, who had thought he was surely a goner, felt a surge of warmth, his vision filled with brilliant and blazing golden light as if the world was all lit up.
His eyes involuntarily brimmed with tears.
Not from being moved, but because the dazzling golden light was quite irritating.
In the bright light, he vaguely saw a divine bird wrapped in red-gold flames.
But then, the red-gold light suddenly dissipated, turning into specks of golden light, dancing in the empty air like a swarm of fireflies, diving unto the silver cat and disappearing into it.
Yuan Ming rubbed his swollen eyes, his eyesockets were puffy, but the bloodshot condition was much improved, and his vision gradually restored a bit, only then did he see that the silver cat hadn't abandoned him to flee.
The brilliant golden light just now was undoubtedly the deadly strike it had been gathering strength to deliver.
"Are you all right?" Yuan Ming asked, noticing that the silver cat seemed off.
It took a while before the silver cat's ethereal yet noticeably tired voice responded in his mind, "Take me... to the Human Demon King."
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming walked over and reached out to pick up the silver cat.
The droopy silver cat immediately dodged his hand, a look of disdain in its eyes, and jumped onto Yuan Ming's arm before climbing onto his shoulder and squatting down.
Yuan Ming pursed his lips and brought it to the Human Demon King.
The Human Demon King lay before him, eyes tightly shut, with no other apparent wounds on his body except for the blood hole originally in his chest and the sword marks left by Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming felt puzzled, unable to figure out how that ball of golden light had killed him.
"In the throat... take out the pearl," the silver cat's voice sounded in his mind at that moment.Please read this chapter on its original platform—*.
"You better start explaining first. What exactly is going on?" Yuan Ming said, yet he did not move.
"What do you want to know?" asked the Voice in his mind.
"Who are you really? Why are you hunting this Human Demon King?" Yuan Ming asked.
"While you ask these questions... the elders from Biluo Cave have arrived," the silver cat did not answer.
"That's your concern, not mine," Yuan Ming said with his hands spread in resignation.
Just then, the tightly closed eyes of the Human Demon King suddenly snapped open.
His eyes still ablaze with blood light, one of his arms abruptly raised, lunging directly at the silver cat on Yuan Ming's shoulder.
Both Yuan Ming and the silver cat were startled by this. The former instinctively dodged backward while the latter's eyes sparked with dark light, but both were a step too slow in the rush of the moment.
Just as the Human Demon King's sharp claws were about to pierce the silver cat, a burst of golden light suddenly flared from Yuan Ming's chest, and an arm, covered in golden fur, awkwardly shot out, grabbing towards those sharp claws.
Their fingers interlocked, emitting a dull thud upon impact.
Yuan Ming's body shook violently, a sharp pain emanating from his chest where the impact had hit.
However, the abruptly grown golden-furred arm firmly gripped the Human Demon King's sharp claws. Although they were not equally matched, it did not break.
The Human Demon King pushed vigorously forward, forcing Yuan Ming to step back repeatedly. The silver cat struggled to use its magic in time.
"Hurry, I can't hold on much longer." Yuan Ming urged, while his other two hands grabbed onto the Human Demon King's arm, forcefully resisting his thrust.
At that moment, the Pill Furnace pattern on his right arm lit up again, releasing a warm and gentle force.
Standing on his shoulder, the silver cat's eyes lit up with dark light, projecting it towards the Human Demon King on the opposite side.
The movements of the Human Demon King stiffened again, frozen in place.
Yuan Ming pulled out his long sword from his arm, aiming for the Human Demon King's neck, when suddenly, the throat of the Human Demon King started moving.
As his Adam's apple bobbed, a dry, hoarse voice came out from his mouth:
"It's you... please, help me..."
...
In another cave,
Two elders from the Biluo Cave were urgently discussing something with Ba Da, who wore a face full of panic.
