"It's alright, I just want to go and take a look. I don't necessarily plan to take on any tasks," Yuan Ming waved his hand. The next moment, he felt a chilling sensation surge from behind and couldn't help but shiver.
"What's wrong?" Chen Wan asked in surprise.
"No... nothing, I might just be a little cold," Yuan Ming touched his nose and caught a glimpse of a silvery figure dashing past a large tree outside the casting house.
"Are we still going?" Chen Wan asked.
"Let's go," Yuan Ming withdrew his gaze and responded.
The two left the Fire Workshop and walked down the mountain, soon arriving at a valley between three tall peaks, where a large gray stone tower stood, clearly divided into three layers.
A stone pillar was erected at the entrance of the stone tower, bearing the red characters "Execution Hall."
There was a constant stream of people entering and leaving the Execution Hall, making it quite lively.
The Execution Hall was where Biluo Cave Disciples could undertake bounty tasks to earn contribution value.
Contribution value was very important, as it could be used not only to exchange for magic skills at Gui Cang Pavilion but also to obtain elixirs, talismans, spiritual materials, and other items elsewhere.
Yuan Ming had heard about this place before but had been busy with forging and cultivation. Today was his first visit.
"Alright, I've brought you here; I won't say more. Take care of yourself," Chen Wan said, then turned and left.
Yuan Ming stood still, looking at the gray tower for a moment before deciding to step inside.
"Junior Brother Yuan Ming, are you here to take on a task?" a timid voice came from behind him, belonging to Qiqige.
"Senior Sister Qiqige, I'm just familiarizing myself with the place. Are you here to take on a task?" Yuan Ming replied with a smile.
"Yes," Qiqige said very shyly, immediately lowering her head when her eyes met Yuan Ming's.
"Then let's go in together; it's my first time here, so I might need some guidance from you," Yuan Ming said.The most up‑to‑date version is on *.
"Okay," Qiqige uttered softly and walked in with her head down.
Yuan Ming also entered the Execution Hall, which was quite spacious, spanning a hundred feet in diameter. The first thing he saw was a long stone counter inside, where two elders dressed as deacons were registering disciples who had taken on tasks.
Beside the counter stood a white jade stele seven or eight meters high and three or four meters wide. Restricted spells displayed various sect tasks on it.
About a dozen Biluo Cave Disciples were gathered around the stele, most of them Registered Disciples, quietly discussing the contents on the stele.
"There aren't many people here; I thought there would be many disciples taking up tasks," Yuan Ming remarked.
"Most of the sect disciples spend the majority of their time doing their main duties within their own halls and the rest of the time in cultivation, so not many come to the Execution Hall to take tasks," Qiqige spoke softly.
"So, taking tasks at the Execution Hall is akin to doing odd jobs," Yuan Ming drew a comparison.
"You could say that," Qiqige responded, slightly startled.
Yuan Ming nodded and looked at the stele.
The tasks listed on the stele varied widely, with the simplest being errand-running tasks such as delivering letters, mainly letters from Biluo Cave Disciples to their families.
These tasks were safe but offered meager rewards, merely one to two points of Contribution Value.
Slightly better rewarded were collecting tasks, which involved going to dangerous places to collect Spirit Grass and spiritual materials or hunting Fierce Beasts to obtain their materials, offering several to dozens of points of Contribution Value.
There were even higher paying tasks which involved dangers beyond collecting spiritual materials or hunting Fierce Beasts.
Yuan Ming's gaze fell on the highest-paying task, an assassination mission, targeting not a Fierce Beast but a cultivator named "Ma Xingkong."
According to the task description, this person was a defector from Biluo Cave, his Cultivation had reached the Qi Refining Peak, and he possessed a spirit beast whose strength was comparable to that of the Foundation Establishment Stage. Biluo Cave offered a thousand Contribution Value for capturing him, dead or alive.
"Senior Sister Qiqige, do you know this Ma Xingkong? His name sounds like he's from the Central Plains," Yuan Ming inquired.
"I know a bit; he is indeed from the Central Plains, originally a disciple from the Beast Taming Hall. It's said he was born a Fur Beast Slave and was personally brought into the Sect by Elder Meng Shan. He suddenly defected more than a year ago and hasn't been caught since," Qiqige replied more confidently without her initial shyness.
"This Ma Xingkong, as formidable as he might be, is just a Qi Refining Stage Cultivator. Why would Biluo Cave offer a thousand Contribution Value for his capture?" Yuan Ming asked, puzzled.
"I don't know about that," Qiqige shook her head.
Yuan Ming had only asked casually and soon put it out of his mind, continuing to examine the tasks on the stele.
He had come here today not just to look around but to try and pick a suitable task to earn some Contribution Value.
He dismissed the errand tasks without consideration; the Contribution Value was too low, and they were time-consuming. Any one of them would take at least ten days to a half-month, and he had to work at the Fire Workshop, so he couldn't leave for that long.
Yuan Ming narrowed his focus to the collecting tasks and quickly selected one.
"Collect Fire Jade: Travel to Tali Volcano to collect Fire Jade, exchanging five pieces for one point of Contribution Value. Team completion allowed."
Since entering Biluo Cave, Yuan Ming had deliberately learned about the nearby geography and had heard of Tali Volcano, which was only about a hundred miles from the entrance to the Biluo Cave, round trip could be finished in half a day.
This task allowed for team completion and was not very dangerous, making it suitable for him.
"Senior Sister Qiqige, you can get back to your tasks; don't worry about me," Yuan Ming said to Qiqige.
Qiqige nodded, turned to look at the stele, quickly headed to the long stone platform to accept a task, and left on her own.
After watching Qiqige leave, Yuan Ming approached the platform, took out his Identity Plate, and handed it to a black-clad deacon, "I'd like to take task number thirty-five, collecting Fire Jade."
"The Fire Jade task is done in a team. There is a team currently recruiting, would you like to join them?" the black-clad deacon took out a white Jade Talisman, tapped Yuan Ming's Identity Plate with it, and asked with an expressionless face.
"I would like to join," Yuan Ming said immediately.
"Very well, the team is over there; you can go straight to them," the black-clad deacon returned the Identity Plate, pointing towards a corner of the hall.
Following his gesture, Yuan Ming saw four Biluo Cave Disciples standing there, all Registered Disciples, and among them was a familiar face, the bald Agula.
His brows furrowed slightly, then relaxed as he walked over.
Noticing someone approaching, all four turned to look.
Upon seeing Yuan Ming, Agula was visibly startled.
"Did this Junior Brother also take the Fire Jade task? Hehe, a new face. I wonder which hall's disciple you are?" a beautiful woman with a silver ornament on her head asked after sizing up Yuan Ming, appearing to be the leader of the group.
This woman in her early thirties had a pleasant and gentle facial contour, wearing a sparkling silver bracelet on her wrist, seemingly not an ordinary item, and hung a green Spiritual Beast Bag at her waist.
Standing next to the woman was a dark-skinned man, his upper body clad in a piece of Beast Skin, revealing half of his chest with a red tiger head tattoo on his shoulder, and a thick black iron rod in his hand, clearly a man of great strength.
The last person was a young man with triangular eyes wearing a felt hat, his expression cold and standoffish, giving off a 'stay away' vibe.
"My name is Yuan Ming, a newly admitted disciple of the Fire Refining Hall; nice to meet you all," Yuan Ming greeted and bowed.
"Fire Refining Hall? Agula, is he one of yours?" the beautiful woman turned to Agula.
Agula forced a smile towards the woman, then turned to Yuan Ming with a grim expression, speaking coldly, "Yuan Ming, you've only been in Biluo Cave for half a month. You probably don't even know three paths in the Sect. Why are you so eager to take on tasks? Are you seeking death?"
Yuan Ming's eyebrows knitted together. Agula was targeting him again, and he did not recall ever offending the man.

chapters.title: Chapter 91 - 71: Gaining the Upper Hand
chapters.content:
"Just joined the Sect half a month ago? Why would a newcomer take on this task, are you in a hurry to feed the Fire Rock Snakes? Our team doesn't need a burden, nor are we responsible for collecting corpses!" The dark-skinned man's face darkened as he spoke bluntly.
"Junior Brother Yuan, Agula and the others have a point, collecting Fire Jade is quite dangerous, and if we encounter an attack from a Fire Rock Snake, we might not be able to look out for you. You should focus on cultivating for a while longer and improve your strength before taking on tasks," the beautiful woman advised, her gaze also carrying a hint of disdain.
"Thank you for the reminder, Senior Sister, and this Senior Brother. Though I'm of humble skill, I believe I have enough power to protect myself and I won't cause trouble for you," Yuan Ming nodded slightly to the beautiful woman and the dark-skinned man, saying with a smile.
He seemed not to see Agula at all.
The beautiful woman's eyebrows lifted slightly, and the dark-skinned man huffed a low sound, but neither said anything more.
At this moment, Agula, who had been ignored, was already as red-faced as a pig's liver and stepped out from the crowd: "That's quite the attitude. If you want to join our team, let me see your strength first!"
"If Senior Brother Agula wishes to enlighten me, then please make your move," Yuan Ming said calmly.
"Good, take my arrow first!" Agula formed a magical gesture with his fingers.
A stream of crystal-clear water materialized out of thin air, quickly twisting and transforming into a strangely shaped two-foot-long Water Bow, with a brightly shining Water Arrow automatically appearing on the bowstring.
With a sharp whistling sound, the Water Arrow tore through the air, heading straight for Yuan Ming's chest, its speed far surpassing that of ordinary arrows.
Agula had secretly played a trick, silently casting before speaking, and by the time his words had ended, the Water Arrow had already been shot.
"Water Arrow Technique?"
Yuan Ming remained unflustered, pushing his right hand through the void, a rich green light emerging in his palm.
A thick Wooden Thorn protruded, cutting off the Water Arrow's path despite being released later.
In these days, Yuan Ming had been diligently practicing the Moonlight Technique. Although his Divine Soul Power hadn't much increased, his reaction speed had greatly improved.
With a loud "bang," the Water Arrow shattered and the Wooden Thorn was also largely fragmented.
"What!" Agula's expression froze.
He had struck first with a sneak attack, using the swift Water Arrow Technique, and yet it had been blocked by the Wood Stabbing Technique!
"Is that enough?" Yuan Ming asked indifferently, as a surge of green light in his palm instantly restored the broken Wooden Thorns to their original state.
Agula's face turned ugly. His hands formed gestures at great speed, and a flash of light passed over the Water Bow, summoning out no less than five Water Arrows.
Whoosh whoosh whoosh! This chapter was made possible by the * community.
The five Water Arrows shot out together, winding their way toward Yuan Ming with the intent to kill.
"Five arrows fired in succession! When did Agula's Water Arrow Technique reach this level?" the beautiful woman exclaimed softly.
The dark-skinned man and the triangle-eyed young man were also surprised at this sight.
It isn't difficult to master the Water Arrow Technique, but to simultaneously cast five arrows was not easy. This required sufficient mana depth and powerful control over that mana.
Yuan Ming's expression grew more solemn, but he remained composed as he began to cast, his fingers moving to form a spell.
Green light flickered continuously in front of him, and three thick Wooden Thorns burst out from the ground, each one about a foot in diameter and lined up in front of him, covering his figure altogether.
Yuan Ming did not have enough mana, and could only summon three Wooden Thorns at the same time.
The Water Arrows hit the Wooden Thorns, easily piercing through and leaving five large holes, but Yuan Ming, who had been behind them, was nowhere to be seen.
Agula looked around with a mix of shock and suspicion. Just then, a sharp gust came from the side, and Yuan Ming's figure suddenly appeared with a Green Fish Sword in hand, slashing down from above.
The treasure sword turned into a cold gleam, falling like lightning.
Agula's face changed drastically. His right hand crushed something in a flash, and a layer of green airflow appeared around him, quickly dodging to the side.
However, he suddenly felt pain under his foot, as a small Wooden Thorn unexpectedly burst up without warning, stabbing into the sole of his boot.
Agula had worn a specially made pair of boots for today's task, crafted from the skin of crocodile-like Fierce Beasts and unusually tough. The Wood Stabbing Technique did not pierce the sole, but it caused him to stagger slightly, pausing his attempt to dodge for a brief moment.
The light of the Green Fish Sword enveloped one of his arms, seeming almost certain to cleave it off.
At that moment, a streak of silver light shot from the side, moving too fast for anyone to see, and with a "clang," it struck the Green Fish Sword.
Yuan Ming's wrist went numb; the Green Fish Sword flew out of his hand, and he was pushed back a couple of steps.
The silver light also revealed its true form, a silver chain bracelet, which was from the beautiful woman's wrist.
Swish!
An elegant figure flashed by, and the beautiful woman appeared between the two.
"Hehe, both of your Five Elements Magic displays were quite an eye-opener. We still have a task to perform later, so how about we consider the sparring finished for now?" the beautiful woman said with a smile, her eyes on Yuan Ming no longer carrying that previous suspicion, clearly acknowledging his strength.
"Of course, Senior Brother Agula and I were merely exchanging pointers," Yuan Ming laughed, picking up the Green Fish Sword from the ground and putting it away.
Agula remained silent, his face a shade of iron blue.
"Junior Brother Yuan has exceptional abilities. With him joining our task squad, I assume there are no objections, right?" The beautiful woman turned her gaze towards the dark-skinned man and the triangle-eyed youth.
"Junior Brother Yuan's cultivation is quite impressive, and I am certainly welcoming of his participation," the dark-skinned man said, grinning and shedding his previous arrogance.
The man with triangular eyes didn't say anything but nodded in agreement.
"In that case, let us prepare to depart," the beautiful woman said and nodded her head.
"Could you all wait for me a moment? I left something at my place, I'll go fetch it and be right back," Yuan Ming suddenly spoke.
"No problem. I was about to head to the Refining Furnace Hall to buy some things, and Mu Li and the others need to go rent immortal cranes for the journey. We'll disperse for now and meet up near the mountain gate in a quarter of an hour," the beautiful woman said after a moment's pause.
"Renting immortal cranes? Are we going to ride cranes to Tali Volcano?" Yuan Ming asked.
"Of course. Tali Volcano is a hundred miles away from the sect. If we were to walk on foot, when would we arrive?" the beautiful woman explained.
Yuan Ming looked troubled; he had just joined the sect, and he was penniless and without any contribution value to rent a spirit beast.
"Junior Brother Yuan needn't worry. You can ride with me later," the beautiful woman said, noticing Yuan Ming's embarrassment.
"Thank you, Senior Sister," Yuan Ming replied, relieved, and bowed in gratitude.
"It's nothing," the beautiful woman shook her head.
Yuan Ming nodded to the others and quickly left, heading for the Fire Refining Hall.
He jogged all the way and soon returned to his room, retrieving a grey bundle from under his bed.
The bundle contained two Furred Beast Skins, that of the White Ape and Black Toad. It was his first time on a sect mission, and he couldn't afford to fail, so he brought the two Furred Beast Skins just in case.
Although he was no longer a Fur Beast Slave, he didn't have many good offensive or self-protective methods besides the Green Fish Sword and the Wood Stabbing Technique. The increase in combat power provided by transforming into a White Ape could play a significant role in a critical moment.
Yuan Ming shoved the bundle into his chest and headed back the way he came, speeding toward the mountain gate.
...
In the grand hall of the Refining Furnace Hall.
The layout here was similar to that of the Execution Hall, with a long stone desk at the front where four or five disciples of the Refining Furnace Hall sat, and rows of grimy, whitish stone counters that were about one zhang tall, laden with jade bottles and porcelain containers of various colors.
The entire hall was filled with the fragrance of medicine, which seemed to invigorate anyone who walked in.
"I'll have a bottle of Water Marsh Pill," the beautiful woman said, approaching a short, plump young man.
"Ten contribution points," the short, plump young man replied after a glance at the woman.
The beautiful woman clearly knew the price of the elixir and took out her Identity Plate, handing it over.
The young man took a white Jade Talisman, tapped it lightly on the woman's Identity Plate, and a white light flowed from the plate into the talisman.
"Just a moment, I'll get the medicine," the young man said, then turned and walked toward the counters at the back.
"Junior Sister Lan Ke, it's been a while," said a woman in a red dress, approaching; it was Chen Wan.
"Senior Sister Chen Wan, have you come to buy an elixir too?" Lan Ke said with surprise as she greeted Chen Wan.
The woman was evidently older but behaved respectfully as if she was the younger in presence of Chen Wan.
"I came especially to see you; is that not allowed?" Chen Wan said with a smile, taking hold of Lan Ke's hand.
"Senior Sister has been promoted to an Inner Sect Disciple and is extremely busy. I dare not have such high hopes," Lan Ke replied with a coy smile.
"I am here on my master's orders to take care of some business at the Refining Furnace Hall," Chen Wan explained with a smile.
"Do you need any help? I'm quite acquainted with a few deacons of the Refining Furnace Hall," Lan Ke offered quickly, her eyes flashing.
Being under the Beast Taming Hall with no prestigious background, she was ambitious and always strived to climb upwards. She was smooth in dealings and had made many connections within the sect. Getting known by the Three Cave Masters through this matter could be very beneficial for her future progress.
Chen Wan shook her head and said, "No need. It's just a small matter. It seems Junior Sister Lan Ke is buying Water Marsh Pills; are you going on a mission to collect Fire Jade?"
Lan Ke was disappointed but didn't show it. She caressed the Silver Snake Chain and replied, "Yes, I'm planning to add another rune to my Silver Snake Chain soon, but I'm short on contribution points and need to gather some."
As she said this, the image of Yuan Ming appeared in her mind.
"Speaking of which, Senior Sister Chen Wan, has your Fire Refining Hall recently taken in a young disciple from the Central Plains named Yuan Ming?" Lan Ke inquired.
"Yuan Ming? Yes, there is such a person. Have you heard of him?" Chen Wan asked, a bit surprised.
"I've assembled a team for a mission to collect Fire Jade, and Yuan Ming is part of it. He's quite strong; he fought several rounds with Agula and actually got the upper hand," Lan Ke shared.
"Really?" Surprise flitted across Chen Wan's face.
Agula was a senior disciple of the Fire Refining Hall. Although not gifted in Artifact Refining, his cultivation was not weak, having reached the sixth-tier Qi Refining. Chen Wan couldn't believe he was bested by Yuan Ming, who had just joined the sect.
She remembered that during the day of the trial mission, Yuan Ming was merely a fourth-layer Qi Refiner and a mere Fur Beast Slave. In such a short span of months, had his cultivation advanced again?
"Could it be that his exceptional talent is why the master personally took him in?" Chen Wan wondered.

chapters.title: Chapter 92 - 72: Getting Close
chapters.content:
"Sister Chen Wan, is there any problem with Yuan Ming?" The beautiful young woman, seeing the change in Chen Wan's expression, asked softly.
"No, I was just remarking on how quickly Junior Brother Yuan has progressed, which must mean he practices diligently on a regular basis," Chen Wan said with a smile.
"Sister Chen Wan, are you and Yuan Ming acquainted?" the beautiful young woman asked, showing surprise.
"Not really, Junior Brother Yuan came from the Fur Beast Slaves," Chen Wan paused momentarily before she blurted out.
The beautiful young woman was somewhat astonished. There were many Fur Beast Slaves in Biluo Cave, but very few could change their status from Beast Slave to Registered Disciple.
However, anyone who could climb their way out of the Fur Beast Slaves was no ordinary person. The disciples of the Beast Taming Hall felt this most profoundly. "Ma Xingkong," who now appeared on the bounty list, was promoted from the Fur Beast Slaves. After entering the Beast Taming Hall, his cultivation improved by leaps and bounds, and in a very short time, he had mastered the Beast Taming Technique and tamed many powerful spirit beasts.
If he hadn't later turned traitor, it would have been quite possible for Biluo Cave to have an additional elder in the Foundation Establishment Stage by now.
"Junior Sister Lan Ke, for this mission, could you possibly look after Yuan Ming? He was personally brought back to the sect by our master, who instructed me to take care of him and ensure he doesn't lose his life during the mission," Chen Wan considered for a moment, then said.
The beautiful young woman was taken aback by the comment and regarded Yuan Ming even more highly. She nodded and replied, "Okay, I'll take good care of him."
The two women chatted idly for a few more moments before parting ways.
...
Yuan Ming quickly arrived at the gate of the mountain. The others hadn't arrived yet, so he found a place nearby to sit cross-legged and wait.
The beautiful young woman and the others did not keep him waiting for long as they arrived one after the other soon after.
Yuan Ming noticed that the dark-skinned man, the young man with triangular eyes, and Agula all had a white Spiritual Beast Bag at their waists now, each embroidered with the mark of the Beast Taming Hall.
"Everyone is here, so let's get ready to go!" The beautiful young woman nodded at Yuan Ming before speaking up.
Biluo Cave had strict controls over its disciples. Anyone wishing to leave had to register at the entrance of the mountain gate and have a valid reason for doing so.
Yuan Ming and the others had a legitimate reason for going out on a mission. After registering their names, they quickly made their way outside the sect.
The beautiful young woman slapped the Spiritual Beast Bag on her waist, and a shadowy figure flew out from it. After circling in the air for a moment, it landed, revealing itself to be an unusually large grey bird.
This bird's wings spanned twenty feet when fully extended, and its body was stout. However, its head was quite small, with an unusually flat face, resembling an owl and looking somewhat ugly, except for its two golden eyes, shining bright like lamps.
"This is a Golden-eyed Eagle!" exclaimed the dark-skinned man in surprise.
Yuan Ming looked at the man. When he had registered his name, he had already figured out the names and statuses of the others.
The dark-skinned man's name was Mu Li, a disciple of the Refining Furnace Hall. The young man with triangular eyes was called Chi Shu, a member of the Law and Regulations Hall. The beautiful young woman's name was Lan Ke, a disciple of the Beast Taming Hall.
"I heard that Junior Sister Lan Ke had recently tamed a spirit beast on her own. I didn't expect it to be the Golden-eyed Eagle. Congratulations!" Chi Shu, who had been silent thus far, also spoke up, his tone clearly envious.
The Golden-eyed Eagle is a type of fierce flying beast unique to the Ten Thousand Mountains. Although not strong in combat, they are incredibly swift and have excellent stamina. What's more special is their keen vision, which allows them to see details from miles away. They are an excellent choice for both travel and reconnaissance.
Unfortunately, the Golden-eyed Eagles are fiercely temperamental, preferring death over submission, which makes them extremely difficult to tame. That's why there are so few Golden-eyed Eagles among the spirit beasts in Biluo Cave, and Chi Shu was so envious.
"You flatter me, Junior Brother Chi Shu. It was pure luck that I succeeded," Lan Ke modestly said with a smile, though her smile couldn't hide a trace of pride, clearly very satisfied with having tamed the spirit beast.
Yuan Ming, who was quite interested in beast taming, curiously observed the Golden-eyed Eagle.
The Golden-eyed Eagle seemed to notice Yuan Ming's gaze and looked back at him.
"Goo..." the bird uttered a low coo.My Virtual Library Empire (*) hosts the original.
Yuan Ming was startled. For some reason, he felt a sense of closeness in the call of the Golden-eyed Eagle.
"The Fire Mink of the Three Cave Masters was quite friendly to me, and this Golden-eyed Eagle doesn't seem to dislike me either. Could it be that I have a trait that makes me close to animals? Why didn't I have this feeling with those Fierce Beasts in the Ten Thousand Mountains?" He was puzzled.
"We shouldn't linger any longer, or we'll delay the mission. Let's set off," Lan Ke said, leaping onto the back of the Golden-eyed Eagle.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming also leaped onto the bird.
The back of the Golden-eyed Eagle was spacious; with two people standing on it, there was still plenty of room to spare.
With a sharp cry, the eagle flapped its wings and effortlessly carried the two of them, soaring into the sky.
Mu Li and the others also called forth their rented spirit beasts, which were three white cranes. They were smaller in size compared to the Golden-eyed Eagle, but were more than capable of carrying them, and they followed in pursuit.
The Golden-eyed Eagle was fast, rapidly leaving everything around it behind. The mountain gate of Biluo Cave was soon just a distant speck.
Yuan Ming watched this scene with envy in his heart.
If he had such a spirit beast, whether carrying out sect missions or other matters would be much more convenient in the future.
Unfortunately, he had only been in Biluo Cave for half a month, and he hadn't even managed to exchange for the Exorcism Technique, let alone the core Beast Taming Technique of Biluo Cave.
"Junior Brother Yuan, you'd better crouch down, the Golden-eyed Eagle flies fast, don't be blown away by the gusts it creates," Lan Ke said, noticing Yuan Ming lost in thought, and reminded him.
"Yes," Yuan Ming sat down.
With a low cry from the Golden-eyed Eagle, the feathers around Yuan Ming suddenly stood on end, forming a barrier in front of him that blocked most of the oncoming airflow.
"Huh, this Golden-eyed Eagle, although subdued by me, is still proud and aloof, rarely showing affection to others. However, it seems to like you quite a bit, Junior Brother Yuan, which is quite rare," Lan Ke said with a look of surprise.
"I have been well-liked by animals since I was young; maybe that's the reason," Yuan Ming couldn't explain why this was the case and gave a random excuse.
"There are such superpowers in the world? If that's true, Junior Brother Yuan, you truly are a talent for cultivating the Beast Taming Technique," Lan Ke still seemed somewhat doubtful as she spoke.
"The Beast Taming Technique of our sect can be learned by disciples outside the Beast Taming Hall?" Yuan Ming asked.
"Of course, our sect has many Beast Taming Techniques, and all Biluo Cave Disciples can learn them. They are available for borrowing in the Gui Cang Pavilion. However, the Classics inside the Gui Cang Pavilion are rather miscellaneous and unorganized, and there might even be some misunderstandings among them. One needs to distinguish carefully. The orthodox Beast Taming Secret Techniques, on the other hand, require a visit to the Beast Taming Hall, but if a non-Beast Taming Hall disciple wants to attend, they must have a clear reason," Lan Ke said with a smile.
"Oh, what sort of reason is usually required?" Yuan Ming's heart throbbed with anticipation, and he asked.
"The most common is for non-Beast Taming Hall disciples who have taken on Beast Taming tasks from the Execution Hall. Naturally, they have every right to learn. Additionally, if ordered by an elder or Cave Master, they may also," Lan Ke seemed to regard Yuan Ming favorably, answering all his questions.
Yuan Ming nodded thoughtfully.
...
An hour later, the group flew over a distance of a hundred miles and arrived at a grey-white mountain range.
The area was littered with sharp stones, neatly and imposingly implanted in the ground like fangs. The sky was a dense grey without any sign of impending rain; the air was dry and hot, filled with the pungent smell of sulfur.
The source of all these smells was a huge volcano in the center of the mountain range. The mountain was exceptionally tall, nearly piercing the clouds. Its vast silhouette cast a large shadow, inspiring awe in anyone who beheld it.
The volcano's mouth was still rumbling, spewing thick smoke outward.
"This must be Tali Volcano," Yuan Ming thought to himself, scanning the surroundings with his gaze.
According to the mission briefing, Fire Jade originates from the magma beneath the earth and would come to the surface during volcanic eruptions. Their task was to extract it from the cooled lava.
Of course, it was easier to find Fire Jade in molten lava that hadn't solidified yet, assuming one could endure the high temperature of the magma.
"This season is when the Fire Rock Snakes are most active, so proceed with caution. To increase efficiency, let's split into two groups as we discussed earlier. Agula, Yuan Ming, and I in one team, Chi Shu and Mu Li in the other. Does anyone object?" Lan Ke said.
The others shook their heads, showing no objections.
Just at that moment, a thunderous boom emanated from the volcano's mouth, and the ground nearby shook violently. A red-hot Magma Fire Column erupted and then overflowed toward the base of the mountain.
Although Yuan Ming and the others were still a good distance from the volcano's mouth, the land under their feet trembled as if there was an earthquake.
"A volcanic eruption! This is perfect, there must be new Fire Jade coming out; we might have a bountiful harvest this time!" Mu Li said excitedly, rushing towards the flow of magma.
Chi Shu quickly followed after him, watching the surroundings cautiously.
"Let's go too. The other two junior brothers will be on the lookout for Fire Rock Snakes later. I will have the Golden-eyed Eagle search for Fire Jade. The harvest will be allocated in a ratio of four, three, three, how about it?" Lan Ke suggested.
"No problem," Yuan Ming nodded.
He was already satisfied with a three-part share of the income.
Agula frowned slightly, as if discontented, but he didn't say anything.
The three of them also moved closer to the volcano's mouth, taking a slightly different direction than Chi Shu and his companion, and soon arrived near the volcano's mouth.
They stopped a hundred paces away from the volcanic lava area, where the temperature had reached an exaggerated level. The air they breathed into their lungs was scorching, making their internal organs feel fiery and painful.
Agula took out a blue talisman and pressed it to his chest. Instantly, a blue light like flowing water appeared on his body's surface, and his face, which had been baked red, quickly returned to normal.
Lan Ke also took out a Water Blue Jade Pendant and hung it at her waist. A blue light shone from the pendant, protecting her body.
Yuan Ming, without the treasures or methods of the other two, could only silently activate the Nine Elements Technique to resist the surrounding heat.
As a cool sensation rose from his Dantian and spread to all parts of his body, the sensation of being roasted eased somewhat.
"Junior Brother Yuan, you didn't prepare any methods to resist the high temperature? Finding Fire Jade is not something that can be done in a short time. Merely using your Mana to protect your body, you won't last long," Lan Ke said with a frown, seeing his state.
"It's no trouble, I can hold out," Yuan Ming shook his head.
"Then, Junior Brother Yuan, just make sure to act within your limits, and tell us if you can't hold on. Don't force yourself," Lan Ke reminded him, then stepped forward to continue.

chapters.title: Chapter 93 - 73: Rushing to the Lava
chapters.content:
Lan Ke parted her lips slightly and let out a melodious, lingering whistle, prompting the Golden-eyed Eagle to fly over and circle above her head, its bright gold eyes scanning the terrain below.
Yuan Ming and Agula followed closely behind, keeping an eye on their surroundings, alert for any attacks from the Fire Rock Snakes.
"Goo!"
A moment later, the Golden-eyed Eagle suddenly cried out, fixing its gaze on a black stone to the front right, which seemed to be a product of cooled magma.
Without a second word, Lan Ke lifted her hand and pointed forward, sending her silver bracelet flying towards the black stone.
The light from the bracelet condensed into a blade-like silver glow, piercing through the black stone like a hot knife through butter, splitting it in two.
Embedded within the black stone was a fist-sized fire-red jade, the very Fire Jade they were searching for.
Surprise flickered in Yuan Ming's eyes. The Golden-eyed Eagle's vision was truly extraordinary—could it see through the interior of stones?
"The first one!" Lan Ke walked over and bent down to pick up the Fire Jade.
A dark red shadow shot out from behind a nearby stone— it was a large dark red snake as thick as a bowl, its gleaming fangs snapping toward Lan Ke's calf, a unique Fire Rock Snake of this region.
This snake, being only a First Level Lower Stage Fierce Beast, did not have a particularly formidable attack; however, its fangs contained a potent venom that could cause serious trouble even for cultivators at the peak of Qi Refinement if bitten.
Agula raised his hand, and amidst spirals of blue light, a Water Arrow shot swiftly towards the Fire Rock Snake.
But his action was a moment too late. The Water Arrow clearly wouldn't intercept the red snake in time.
Lan Ke's eyebrows knitted together as the silver bracelet on her wrist shone brightly, ready to intercept the Fire Rock Snake.
Just then, the ground rumbled as a sharp Wooden Thorn burst forth, skewering the body of the Fire Rock Snake and lifting it into the air.
The blue Water Arrow finally arrived, striking the body of the snake.
With a loud "bang", the body of the Fire Rock Snake was blown into two pieces, blood splashing everywhere. The two halves of the snake's body twisted a few times and then lay still.
Lan Ke recalled the silver bracelet, picked up the Fire Jade, nodded toward Yuan Ming, and continued searching forward.
Yuan Ming followed close behind, keeping a watchful eye on the surrounding area.
Agula, feeling somewhat humiliated, had a darker expression on his face, and a hint of malice flickered in his eyes as he watched Yuan Ming's retreating figure.
An hour passed quickly.
The trio's cooperation became more proficient. Yuan Ming and Agula worked together to fend off all the ambushes of the Fire Rock Snakes, allowing Lan Ke to drive the Golden-eyed Eagle in search of Fire Jade without worries, increasing their efficiency significantly.
So far, they had found over twenty pieces of Fire Jade, and Lan Ke, abiding by the previously agreed ratio, allotted Yuan Ming and Agula's share to them.
Yuan Ming felt the Fire Jades in his embrace, their crisp clinking sounds intertwining. Five Fire Jades could be exchanged for a point of Contribution Value; these Jades were almost worth one and a half points.
It was still early, and if they kept up this pace, they could gather ten or even twenty pieces of Fire Jade before nightfall—that would be four Contribution Points.
With that thought, Yuan Ming's heart surged with excitement.
At that moment, his Dantian suddenly gave a jump; his Mana was running low.
Without sufficient Mana to protect his body, he started to feel a dull pain all over.
Yuan Ming, who didn't possess Fire Resistance treasures like Lan Ke and Agula did, found it difficult to maintain until now.
"The two of you," Yuan Ming said without forcing himself, "My Mana is nearly exhausted, I need to leave here for a rest."
Agula raised his chin slightly, a trace of scorn flashing in his eyes, though it made his usually sullen face seem somewhat more pleasant.
"No problem, you go ahead. The two of us are fully capable of looking after ourselves," Lan Ke said.
"Alright, you two continue searching for Fire Jade. You can divide up any findings while I'm gone however you see fit," Yuan Ming said, then quickly left, soon reaching the base of the volcanic giant peak.Contentsourcedfrom*–MyVirtualLibraryEmpire.
The temperature here had returned to normal. He found a secluded spot and began to practice the Nine Elements Technique.
Nature's spiritual energy converged, replenishing his Mana.
A quarter of an hour went by when Yuan Ming suddenly opened his eyes.
Only a small part of the Mana in his Dantian had been restored, and the recovery speed was noticeably slower than before.
"What's going on? The spiritual energy here isn't thin," Yuan Ming wondered as he was about to investigate further when a series of squeaking sounds came from a distance. They sounded strangely familiar.
He stood up, hid behind a nearby boulder, and looked in the direction of the noise.
A slender red shadow resembling a fox appeared in the distance, quickly running towards the volcano. It was the Fire Mink belonging to the Three Cave Masters.
"Huo Chan'er! What is it doing here? Could it be that the Three Cave Masters are nearby?" Yuan Ming thought as he stepped out.
Having brought him into the Sect and responsible for the Fire Refining Hall he currently resided in, Yuan Ming felt obliged to pay his respects if she was around.
Yuan Ming looked around for quite a while but could not find the Three Cave Masters.
Meanwhile, the Fire Mink noticed Yuan Ming in the distance, turned its head to look his way, and paused its hurried steps.
But it quickly diverted its gaze and continued running towards the volcano its original intention unchanged.
Yuan Ming showed a look of surprise; judging by the Fire Mink's behavior, it seemed as if it were chasing something.
Just at this moment, a rush of hurried footsteps approached from a distance. A tall, red-haired young man, sweating profusely, ran towards this direction. Judging by his attire, he was a disciple of the Beast Taming Hall.
"The Brother up ahead, please stop that Fire Mink; it's one of the Three Cave Masters' spirit beasts and must not come into contact with the lava. It won't withstand the high temperature!" The red-haired young man shouted as he ran, urgency in his voice.
Yuan Ming was startled.
From the young man's words, could it be that the Fire Mink intended to jump into the lava?
Although the Fire Mink's spiritual intelligence was not open yet, even an ant has the instinct to survive. Why would it jump into the lava?
Nevertheless, the Fire Mink was charging forward, its eyes filled with fervor, displaying a determination to never look back.
"It's not truly going to jump into the lava, is it!" Yuan Ming's expression changed slightly as he hurriedly pursued, shouting "Huo Chan'er," the name of the Fire Mink.
However, the Fire Mink, which was usually quite close to him, now completely ignored his calling and continued to run towards the volcano's lava, as if something there was extremely enticing to it.
The Fire Mink was running exceedingly fast. Even though Yuan Ming had unleashed Shadowless Step, he still couldn't catch up, and the distance between them was growing.
Yuan Ming remembered the life-saving grace of the Three Cave Masters and, gritting his teeth, activated Fur Cloak Skill.
White Ape Skin wrapped around him, and in the blink of an eye, he transformed into the form of a White Ape, greatly increasing his speed. However, he only managed to barely keep pace with the Fire Mink.
The gap between them and the volcanic lava was closing fast now, and with the speed of the Fire Mink, it would arrive at any moment.
Yuan Ming's eyes darted around, and he took out a piece of Fire Jade, throwing it in front of the Fire Mink.
He had seen the Three Cave Masters use a Red Crystal Stone to attract the Fire Mink before. Fire Jade, also being a Fire Attribute Ore, might be useful.
The Fire Jade traced an arc, landing precisely in front of the Fire Mink.
The Fire Mink looked towards the Fire Jade with a joyous bark, pounced towards it, and grabbed it with its mouth.
"It really works." A glimmer of joy flashed through Yuan Ming's eyes as he quickened his pace.
However, the Fire Mink tilted its head back and swallowed the Fire Jade in one gulp, then immediately resumed its run towards the front, pausing for no more than three breaths in total.
Yuan Ming's expression stiffened, but thankfully those three breaths gained him some time, and the distance between them closed slightly.
He continued the chase, albeit reluctantly extracting another piece of Fire Jade and throwing it out in front of the Fire Mink.
The Fire Mink seemed to have taken a liking to the Fire Jade, stopping once more to grab it, tipping its head to swallow it, and then carrying on its journey forward.
With the experience of grabbing the jade from before, this time the Fire Mink took only about two breaths.
"It really can eat." Yuan Ming muttered helplessly and continued to throw out pieces of Fire Jade.
Seven Spirit Jades were used up in the blink of an eye, but finally, the gap between them was narrowed to less than ten yards. However, the Fire Mink was also less than fifteen yards from the lava.
Yuan Ming seized the moment to cast a spell with a gesture, and the ground in front of the Fire Mink roared and a thick wooden thorn emerged from nowhere.
The Fire Mink nearly bumped into it, letting out a frustrated roar, and sidestepped to continue forward.
But another roar sounded from the side, and a large wooden thorn popped out, blocking its path once again.
Before the Fire Mink could react, the ground around it echoed continuously, and spikes kept emerging one after the other. In the blink of an eye, a wooden enclosure was formed, trapping the Fire Mink inside.
After circling in place a few times, the Fire Mink stopped abruptly and then leaped upwards.
These wooden spikes were only four to five feet tall, and the Fire Mink had a good jump. It easily leaped out.
Yet, as it had just leaped, a large white-furred hand reached out from the side and grabbed the Fire Mink by its back.
The Fire Mink flailed wildly, roaring incessantly, but in vain. Its neck and back were held tight, and all its struggles were futile.
Yuan Ming paid no attention to the Fire Mink as he immediately deactivated Fur Cloak Skill.
Each additional breath that Fur Cloak Skill was activated caused more evil energy to accumulate within his body. Although the Moonlight Technique seemed able to resolve it, he still intended to avoid using it if possible.
The White Ape Skin slid off him, grabbed in a rush and stuffed into his breast.
The Fire Mink, whether exhausted from roaring or seeing Yuan Ming's true body, suddenly became docile.
"Junior Brother Yuan, what brings you here?" A voice suddenly came from ahead, and two figures emerged from a depression in the terrain ahead. It was Mu Li and Chi Shu.
"What have you caught there? A Fire Fox? Be careful!" Mu Li frowned at the sight of the Fire Mink in Yuan Ming's hands, and his iron club was already poised to strike.
Within the Ten Thousand Mountains, many Fierce Beasts possess all sorts of bizarre abilities; it's always best to kill on sight. Hesitation could mean the difference between life and death.
Chi Shu began casting spells, and two human-head-sized fireballs appeared in front of him, ready for release.
"Both of you, hold your hands. This is a juvenile Fire Mink, a spirit beast of the Three Cave Masters!" Yuan Ming hurriedly placed the Fire Mink behind him and explained.
"The Three Cave Masters' spirit beast! Why is it here?" Mu Li was taken aback and drew back his iron club to ask.
"We probably have to ask him," Yuan Ming turned, looking back.
The red-haired young man, still panting from his rush, caught up and seeing the Fire Mink in Yuan Ming's hands, he immediately heaved a sigh of relief, bowed in thanks, and said, "Thank you… thank you so much, Brothers, for your help!"
By this time, they had arrived at the summit of the giant peak. The terrain was uneven, with many rocky outcrops providing cover. The young man had not seen Yuan Ming's actions, thinking it was due to Mu Li and Chi Shu's intervention that they had stopped the Fire Mink.

chapters.title: Chapter 94 - 74: A Bent Corner
chapters.content:
"You should thank him instead, we didn't contribute much, and we dare not take any credit," Chi Shu glanced at Yuan Ming and said to the redhead youth.
"Thank you, Senior Brother. I owe you a lot today; otherwise, I would have been in big trouble," the redhead youth hurriedly bowed in gratitude to Yuan Ming.
"I don't deserve the title 'Senior Brother.' I am Yuan Ming from the Fire Refining Hall, recently entered Biluo Cave. These two are disciples from the Refining Furnace Hall, Mu Li, and from the Law and Regulations Hall, Chi Shu. May I know your name?" Yuan Ming did not explain further but introduced Mu Li and others before asking.
"I am Lei Gong, a disciple of the Beast Taming Hall," the redhead youth scratched his head and hurriedly introduced himself.
"So, you are Senior Brother Lei Gong. I have seen this Fire Mink before; it is the beloved spirit beast of the Three Cave Masters. Why did you bring it here?" Yuan Ming handed over the Fire Mink and asked.
Lei Gong quickly reached out to catch it, but as soon as the Fire Mink touched his hands, it violently struggled and even squealed sharply, fiercely scratching the young man's hand.
The claws of the Fire Mink were quite sharp; Lei Gong's hand was immediately slashed with several knife-like wounds, from which blood gushed out.
He cried out in pain, and his hand loosened, dropping the Fire Mink.
Yuan Ming quickly reached out and caught the Fire Mink.
Strangely enough, as soon as the Fire Mink reached Yuan Ming's hands, it became docile, not only stopping the struggle but also gently rubbing its head against his body.
Seeing this scene, Lei Gong, Mu Li, and Chi Shu all showed surprised expressions.
"I didn't expect Junior Brother Yuan to not only be skilled in artifact refining but also proficient in the Beast Taming Technique!" Lei Gong said.
"I've only recently joined the sect. I don't know much about the Beast Taming Technique. I just had the fortune to encounter the Three Cave Masters in the Ten Thousand Mountains earlier, and I followed her for a while, taking care of this Fire Mink. Perhaps it still remembers me," Yuan Ming explained half-truthfully.
"So, that's the reason," Lei Gong uttered, his eyes showing a tinge of disappointment.
Mu Li and Chi Shu exchanged glances upon hearing about Yuan Ming's familiarity with the Three Cave Masters, their eyes subtly shifting as they looked back at him.
Gaa...
A sharp and piercing cry rang out as the Golden-eyed Eagle flew over, with Lan Ke and Agula standing on its back. They had evidently noticed the situation here and rushed over.
For character sheets and glossaries, visit *.
"Lei Gong, why are you here too?" Lan Ke jumped down from the eagle's back, asking Lei Gong with a familiar tone.
Agula also jumped down right after, his chest visibly broader than before, clearly having gained something significant in these moments.
"It's because of this Fire Mink, Senior Sister Lan Ke," Lei Gong nodded in greeting and said with a bitter smile.
"You didn't happen to take up that task from the Three Cave Masters, did you?" Lan Ke looked at the Fire Mink in Yuan Ming's hands and asked.
"Yes, I didn't think it through enough. This task turned out to be much harder than I anticipated. If it weren't for Junior Brother Yuan and their help today, I nearly messed it up. It seems my talent in Beast Taming is insufficient; I should stop here with this task," Lei Gong sighed.
"What are you two talking about? Don't just keep it to yourselves; let us hear as well. Is Lei Gong Brother on a sect mission?" Mu Li asked with a frown.
They were here to collect Fire Jade and did not want to get involved in other matters.
"Don't worry, Junior Brother Mu Li. The task I mentioned is just taking care of this Fire Mink, issued by the Three Cave Masters. It won't affect our collection of Fire Jade," Lan Ke said.
"Taking care of a Fire Mink? There's such a task?" Yuan Ming showed a surprised expression.
Just taking care of a spirit beast, yet a task needed to be issued? If the Fire Mink is really naughty, just confine it.
"Junior Brother Yuan, you don't understand Beast Taming. Raising a spirit beast isn't just about feeding them well; it also involves carefully handling their emotions and guiding their temperament. This Fire Mink is still in its juvenile stage, a time when it's lively and active. Keeping it confined for a long time will affect its growth. The Three Cave Masters are usually busy and have no time, which is why this task was issued," Lei Gong explained.
"I see. It's just that I didn't see this task in the Execution Hall?" Yuan Ming asked.
"The Execution Hall is crowded and busy. The Three Cave Masters didn't publish this task openly, but just notified those of us in the Beast Taming Hall, so it didn't appear on the task stele," Lei Gong explained.
Yuan Ming acknowledged, and just as he was about to say something, the Fire Mink suddenly struggled fiercely and jumped out from his arms to the ground.
Yuan Ming was startled and about to reach out to catch it again when the Fire Mink didn't run away but instead bit Yuan Ming's clothes and pulled him toward a further place.
"Gaa gaa gaa!" Lan Ke's Golden-eyed Eagle also screeched sharply, looking towards the giant peak of the volcano in alarm.
Everyone present was stunned.
Just then, the ground beneath their feet suddenly shook violently. With everyone's strengths, they nearly fell over.
Before they could stabilize themselves, the ground shook a second time, then a third...
Yuan Ming's face paled as he steadied himself against a large rock nearby.
At that moment, a thunderous rumble came from deep within the earth, like countless rolling thunders, the ground shook violently, as if an unstoppable force had suddenly erupted.
Facing this mighty force, the people present felt like saplings in a fierce wind, completely unable to resist, their bodies were thrown into the air.
Following that, a "boom" sound erupted from a distance!
Yuan Ming barely managed to raise his head, and his expression drastically changed.
The crater of the volcano shook violently, and a massive pillar of magma burst forth. Countless red-hot magma flowed down the sides of the giant peak.
The area where they stood was also swept by the flowing magma.
Yuan Ming immediately activated the Fur Cloak Skill, transforming into the form of a White Ape.
White Ape, strong and heavy, became much steadier in ape form, precariously bolting down the mountain.
Lan Ke and the others also hurriedly used their methods, fleeing desperately into the distance.
At that moment, everyone could only look out for themselves; they had no regard for others.
Yuan Ming rolled and crawled to escape into the distance, not knowing how many times he fell, but he eventually made it to the foot of the mountain.
If not for the White Ape's thick skin, he would have been bloodied by the impacts.
Even with the protection of the ape skin, he was battered to the point of having a swollen face and bleeding from his nose and mouth, his head buzzing.
But now was not the time to rest, as the surging lava had reached close behind him, melting and submerging everything in its path.
"Squeak squeak squeak..." The cries of the Fire Mink came from ahead, dashing agilely towards a low hill on the right, unaffected by the shaking ground.
Yuan Ming's eyes lit up, and he immediately headed there, arriving quickly at the foot of the low hill.
He activated the White Ape Beast Skin, his ten fingers sprouting sharp ape claws that easily pierced into the rock, quickly climbing toward the top of the hill.
The torrential lava flowed swiftly, rushing down to several miles below the mountain before gradually stopping, engulfing everything in fiery red lava.
The ground movements caused by the volcanic eruption gradually subsided, and the ground slowly calmed down.
By this time, Yuan Ming had climbed to the top of the low hill, deactivated Fur Cloak Skill, and lay sprawled out, gasping for breath with lingering fear.
The Fire Mink lay beside him, seeming very quiet.
"Huo Chan'er, thanks a lot this time," Yuan Ming gently stroked the head of the Fire Mink.
Had it not been for the Fire Mink's alert, running to this low hill for refuge in time, he would most likely have been submerged by the lava now, his body lost forever.
He closed his eyes and rested for a moment, then got up and looked around for traces of other people.
Lan Ke, Mu Li, and others had Flying Spiritual Beasts; as long as they could summon them in time to fly high, they should be able to escape to the heavens.
That Lei Gong seemed to have no Flying Spiritual Beast; it was unknown if he had escaped.
The surroundings were covered in fiery red molten lava, not a bird in sight, let alone people.
Yuan Ming shook his head and surveyed the area around the hill.
Three sides were already covered by lava, but fortunately, there was still an area without lava behind, leaving a path.
Yuan Ming pondered briefly, picked up the Fire Mink, and walked that way.
"Squeak squeak squeak…" Passing by a certain place, the Fire Mink suddenly began to scream excitedly, its eyes fixated intently on a patch of lava not far away, revealing a longing in its gaze.
Yuan Ming stopped, looking in the direction of the Fire Mink's gaze.
"Huh!" He raised his eyebrows and signaled with a gesture.
The ground in the lava area roared loudly, and a large Wooden Thorn emerged, already charred black.
Inside the Wooden Thorn, stubborn green lights resisted the burning of the lava, bending outward sharply, like a large hand splashing water.
"Splash," a patch of lava was flung by the Wooden Thorn, landing not far in front of Yuan Ming.
An elongated object rolled out from the lava, revealing a fiery red object, about a foot long, curved in shape, resembling the horn of an Exotic Beast.
The horn shimmered with red light as if flames were burning on its surface.
Yuan Ming's eyes lit up; although this Fiery Red Horn didn't emit much Spiritual Power fluctuation, just its appearance was extraordinary, far surpassing the Fire Jade, likely a high-grade Spirit Material.
The Fire Mink had earlier rushed towards the lava crazily, was it for this object?
The Fire Mink cheered, turned into a blur as it pounced fiercely, biting onto the Fiery Red Horn, seemingly trying to swallow it.
"Stop, no, hold your bite!" Yuan Ming hurriedly lunged over, grabbing the other end of the Fiery Red Horn.
This object was not some low-level spiritual material like the Fire Jade; any High-grade Spirit Material was exceedingly valuable, letting the Fire Mink eat it like that would be a huge loss.
The Fire Mink bit stubbornly onto the Fiery Red Horn, exhibiting astonishing strength such that even Yuan Ming, using almost all his strength, could not wrest it away.
He was inwardly anxious and was about to use another method to snatch the horn when he suddenly noticed that the Fire Mink's teeth couldn't even scratch it; its sharp teeth didn't leave any marks at all.
Yuan Ming relaxed, no longer struggling, and watched the Fire Mink with a smile.
The Fire Mink bit at the horn again and again, its teeth almost going sour, yet it couldn't move the horn an inch, eventually giving up reluctantly with a disappointed look.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming then picked up the Fiery Red Horn, examining it closely in front of his eyes.
The object was hot to the touch but not burning, and it felt quite comfortable in his hand; peculiar flame patterns naturally appeared on the horn's texture, as if they were innate.
"What Exotic Beast's horn is this, that it can be perfectly preserved in the lava?" Yuan Ming thought secretly, his eyebrows suddenly raising.
He stood not far from the molten rock, the surrounding heat unbearable, continuously cultivating to resist, but upon obtaining this Fiery Red Horn, the scorching heat also seemed to weaken a lot, was the Fiery Red Horn isolating the surrounding heat?

chapters.title: Chapter 95 - 75 New Mission
chapters.content:
"Indeed, it's a high-grade spirit material."
Yuan Ming's eyes lit up with joy. He grew even fonder of the fiery red horn, carefully storing it away, planning to figure out its nature after returning to the Sect.
Such a horn contained within the magma of Tali Volcano truly speaks volumes. This volcano is far from ordinary.
However, he was not capable of exploring the mountain at this time, so he turned and called for the Fire Mink to continue on their way, swiftly leaving the area covered by volcanic magma.
Yuan Ming stood on a slope, gazing at the scarred earth.
Given such a massive volcanic eruption, the Fire Jades near the volcano had been completely submerged by the lava. Without a way to search for them in the magma, it seemed his task would have to end here.
As for what to do next, he was somewhat at a loss, unsure whether to search for the others or to head back to the Sect on his own.
After a moment of consideration, Yuan Ming decided to look for the others, taking the Fire Mink with him in a certain direction.
Leaving now by himself felt somewhat heartless, besides, he only had a rough idea of the location of the Biluo Cave Sect. Going back alone might be problematic.
Just then, a faint sound came from behind, like the noise of footsteps.
Yuan Ming quickly turned to look and saw a figure turning onto the mountain path not far away, it was Lei Gong.
"Junior Brother Yuan, you're still alive, and the Fire Mink is safe too, thank heavens!" Lei Gong, upon seeing Yuan Ming and the Fire Mink beside him, ran over excitedly.
Lei Gong looked very disheveled at the moment, with much of his clothing burned away and several patches of his skin scorched, thankfully none were at vital spots.
The Fire Mink glanced at Lei Gong and then looked away, ignoring him, seemingly not very fond of the man.
"Senior Brother Lei Gong, are you alright?" Yuan Ming's face also lit up with joy.
Encountering a familiar face at this time was always a happy occasion.
"I'm fine, just some minor skin injuries, nothing worth mentioning. By the way, Junior Brother Yuan, did you see Sister Lan Ke and the others? Of course, there's also Mu Li and the rest," Lei Gong asked, waving his hand dismissively.
"In the urgent situation just now, I was only focused on saving myself and didn't pay attention to the others," Yuan Ming shook his head.
"Ah, I wonder how she's getting on," Lei Gong scratched the back of his head with a worried expression upon hearing this.
Yuan Ming's eyes flickered, realizing that Lei Gong, Mu Li, Chi Shu, and Agula were only acquaintances, so naturally, he was worried about Lan Ke. The nature of their relationship remained unclear.
"Let's search around. With Sister Lan Ke's abilities, they should be fine," he didn't inquire further and suggested.
Lei Gong nodded, and the two of them went off to search in a certain direction.
The Fire Mink jumped onto Yuan Ming's shoulder and lay halfway down to rest, squinting its eyes.
"It seems the Fire Mink is quite fond of Junior Brother Yuan! After you return to the Sect, you might want to consider taking on this task," Lei Gong said, half envious, half impressed, as he suggested upon seeing the tame Fire Mink.
Yuan Ming indeed had this idea in mind and asked, "Senior Brother Lei Gong, could you tell me more about this task from the Three Cave Masters?"
"Are you really interested, Junior Brother Yuan? Actually, there's not much to the task itself; the Three Cave Masters' requirements are quite simple, just take good care of the Fire Mink, feed it a few pieces of Fire Flame Crystal each day, and ensure it doesn't get injured," Lei Gong said quickly.
"It doesn't seem too difficult," Yuan Ming remarked.
"It's easy to say, but not at all easy to do. Junior Brother Yuan, you haven't seen how mischievous this Fire Mink can be," Lei Gong sighed, holding his forehead.
Just then, the Fire Mink, which had been squinting its eyes, suddenly opened them and began to hum noisily.
Seeing this, Lei Gong quickly took out a fiery red crystal and held it to the Fire Mink's mouth—seemingly the same thing the Three Cave Masters used to feed it previously.
As soon as the Fire Mink saw the crystal, it immediately raised its head, took a bite of the item, and began to chew and swallow the pieces.
"What's the reward for this task?" Yuan Ming petted the Fire Mink's head and inquired about what concerned him most.
"The reward is naturally generous. As long as you can meet her requirements and take care of the Fire Mink well, you can earn thirty Contribution Values per month, and you can also learn a spell from her for free, provided it's within the scope of the Qi Refinement Realm," Lei Gong explained.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming became even more tempted.
Thirty Contribution Values certainly counted as a generous reward. Working at the Fire Workshop only earned ten Contribution Values per month, not to mention the opportunity to learn a spell for free.
He continued to play with the Fire Mink's head, silently making up his mind.
"Junior Brother Yuan is not a disciple of the Beast Taming Hall, so if you want to take on this task, you should start with the Execution Hall, where the deacon is also aware of this task from the Three Cave Masters," Lei Gong thought for a moment and added.
"Thank you for the advice," Yuan Ming thanked him.
The two continued on their search, but after a long while, they found not a single clue.
Yuan Ming was still okay, but Lei Gong was growing increasingly agitated.
"This blind search isn't the way to go. How about we try a different method?" Yuan Ming suggested.
"Oh, does Junior Brother Yuan have a plan?" Lei Gong's eyes brightened and he asked.
"Since we can't find Sister Lan Ke and the others, why not make it so they can find us?" Yuan Ming spoke.
Lei Gong was taken aback, not understanding the implication.
"Burn wood to create smoke," Yuan Ming pointed toward a nearby small patch of woods.
This text was acquired from *.
"That's a good idea," Lei Gong rubbed his hands together, pleased with the suggestion.
The two of them worked together, cutting down all the trees in the forest and setting up a bonfire.
Thick black smoke soon billowed upwards, drifting high into the sky, forming a smoke column.
The volcanic lava had calmed down, not producing much smoke, so the black smoke column was quite conspicuous.
Moments later, a crisp crane's cry sounded, and two white cranes appeared in the distant sky, rapidly flying over.
The two figures seated on the white cranes were none other than Mu Li and Chi Shu.
"Both of you are safe and sound, that's great," Yuan Ming called out, waving his hands.
Lei Gong's heart sank with disappointment, but he managed to squeeze out a smile and asked the two about Lan Ke's whereabouts.
A piercing scream came from the other side, and a gray shadow quickly approached; it was the Golden-eyed Eagle, with Lan Ke and Agula on its back.
"Senior Sister Lan Ke, you're also unharmed; truly blessed by the ancestors," Lei Gong exclaimed joyously, waving his hand.
Yuan Ming also showed joy on his face, with an added touch of emotion.
Having encountered such a natural disaster, all six of them had miraculously survived; their luck was simply too good.
The Golden-eyed Eagle landed on the ground, and Lan Ke leapt down, but Agula did not move.
His right leg from the knee down was charred black, with much of the flesh burned away, clearly caused by the lava; other areas of his body also suffered multiple burns, appearing extremely miserable.
Mu Li and the others' expressions changed slightly at the sight, and Yuan Ming's brows furrowed as well.
"Junior Brother Agula, how did you get so injured?" Mu Li, who had carried out several missions with Agula and was relatively close to him, asked with concern.
Agula merely gave a bitter smile and did not speak.
With his right leg injured like that, the meridians in his leg were likely damaged too; it was uncertain if they could be restored.
Lan Ke sighed and recounted how Agula was injured.
When the magma surged towards them, he released a white crane in an attempt to escape into the sky, but the crane, intimidated by the volcanic disaster, abandoned Agula and fled alone.
In a mix of shock and anger, Agula had no choice but to run for his life, only to be attacked by a Fire Rock Snake along the way. After being bitten on the leg, he was caught up by the surging lava that burned his leg, and he was on the verge of perishing right there.
At the critical moment, Lan Ke, passing nearby, saved Agula's life.
"Anyway, we are all still alive, a fortunate misfortune. Junior Brother Agula's injuries are severe, but not beyond hope of recovery. We'll have to return to the Sect to deal with it," Lan Ke said.
Mu Li, a disciple of the Refining Furnace Hall and proficient in some medical techniques, immediately applied ointment to Agula's wounds and bandaged them.
"Thank you, Brother Mu Li," Agula expressed his gratitude.
Having fled in haste, everyone now felt quite exhausted, so they took a brief rest around the bonfire.
"It's really strange why such a large-scale volcanic eruption would occur so suddenly," Mu Li said, looking towards the giant peak of the volcano.
"Such natural disasters are beyond the predictions of mortals like us," Lan Ke said, shaking her head.
"It might be Tali, the Flame Demon beneath the mountain, turning over, haha…" With Lan Ke safe and sound, Lei Gong's liveliness returned, and he laughed heartily.
"Tali, the Flame Demon?" Yuan Ming looked over.
"That's a legend about Tali Volcano. Originally, this area was a lush green mountain range, and that giant peak was an ordinary mountain. Later, an Immortal suppressed a Flame Demon under the peak. The demon, wielding flames, melted the rocks, turning this place into a volcanic region," Lei Gong explained animatedly, glancing at Lan Ke from time to time.
Yuan Ming fell silent, remembering the Fiery Red Horn he had just obtained. Could it be the horn of that so-called Flame Demon?
He immediately shook his head and chuckled to himself, scolding his naivety. Such mythical legends, how could they be true?
"By the way, it is rumored that the Flame Demon turns over every five hundred years, causing a massive volcanic eruption. I've read records about Tali Volcano in the Sect; several hundred years ago, there was a large-scale eruption here. Maybe that legend is true," Lei Gong, seeing the other people looking over, became even more animated and talked at length.
"Enough of that. Those are just folklore tales. You're a cultivator and still believe in such absurd stories," Lan Ke said with a frown, rebuking him.
Lei Gong gave a silly chuckle and obediently shut his mouth.
However, Lei Gong's tall tales did manage to lighten the atmosphere significantly.
After resting for a while, everyone somewhat recovered.
"What do you all plan to do next?" Lan Ke asked.
"After such an event, continuing to search for the Fire Jade is no longer possible. Let's return to the Sect first; Junior Brother Agula's injuries need to be looked at as soon as possible," Mu Li suggested.
No one else objected, and the group promptly headed towards the Sect.
…
Execution Hall.
The others who had returned from the mission with Yuan Ming submitted their Fire Jades in exchange for rewards; Yuan Ming, however, had fed all of his Fire Jades to the Fire Mink and could not obtain any rewards.
Nevertheless, Yuan Ming didn't mind; he had already decided to take on the task of caring for Huo Chan'er and went straight to the deacon in charge.
Having registered for the task at the office, Yuan Ming was informed that as a non-Beast Taming Hall disciple taking on a spirit beast nurturing task, he needed to go to the Beast Taming Hall to learn the relevant knowledge and get approval first.
After all, it concerned the beloved pet of the Three Cave Masters; no one could afford the responsibility if anything were to happen.

chapters.title: Chapter 96 - 76: Enemies on a Narrow Road
chapters.content:
The next day, early morning.
Yuan Ming arrived at the Fire Workshop early, and the task of selecting and refining materials was not difficult for him. On the contrary, he was skilled at identifying materials and sifting through rubble and quickly completed all his assigned tasks.
Without wasting time to rest, he picked up the casting hammer once more and started the tedious yet challenging activity of refining the embryo. However, despite his hard work, progress was not going smoothly.
Despite this, he did not get too discouraged. After completing his tasks for the day and having lunch at the Dining Hall, he headed straight to the Beast Taming Hall.
Yuan Ming now knew that among the three peaks within the Sect, the shortest one on the southeast side belonged to the Refining Furnace Hall—Second Cave Master's territory—mainly responsible for cultivating Spiritual Medicine and refining elixirs.
The central peak, needless to say, was where the Fire Refining Hall managed by the Three Cave Masters was located, responsible for Artifact Refining for the Sect.
And the tallest peak on the northeast side was where the Great Cave Master's Beast Taming Hall was situated, also the Sect's most powerful and highest-ranking hall.
Since he did not have his own spirit beast, Yuan Ming could only rely on his legs to travel. By the time he arrived at the territory of the Beast Taming Hall, two hours had already passed.
The situation at the Beast Taming Hall was completely different from the Fire Refining Hall.
Its buildings were widely distributed across the entire peak, with a circular reception hall located at the foot of the mountain.
As soon as Yuan Ming entered, he was greeted by a burly disciple with black tattoos on his face, who came walking towards him.
"Hehe, junior brother looks new here, just joined recently, right?" the disciple said with a smile.
Caught off guard by this sudden enthusiasm, Yuan Ming could only nod in response.
"Junior brother, don't feel restrained here in the Beast Taming Hall. Our services are for all the fellow disciples in the Sect, and our prices are very fair. We can fulfill all your needs! I wonder if junior brother is here to rent or to buy a spirit beast? I can give you a good introduction," the round-faced disciple said with an even broader smile.
Yuan Ming was startled by the mention of business, no wonder the reception was so warm.
"Senior brother is mistaken; I'm here on a task from the Execution Hall to learn the basics of spirit beast breeding," Yuan Ming replied with a smile and a shake of his head.
The round-faced disciple was taken aback, and his smile gradually faded. His tone became somewhat listless:
"Oh, is that so? You've taken on a task, then do you have the authorization from the Execution Hall?"
Yuan Ming had prepared in advance and took out his authorization, handing it over.
The round-faced disciple took it carelessly, looked at it, and frowned: "How come it only has the Execution Hall's Seal but no elder's signature?"
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming's eyebrows furrowed. He had confirmed repeatedly with the deacon of the Execution Hall that the signed authorization with the Seal was sufficient. It was clear the other party was making things difficult for him.
"Go back and get the signature, then come back," the round-faced disciple said as he tossed the authorization back to Yuan Ming, about to turn away.
Just then, a figure entered the hall and immediately approached Yuan Ming upon seeing him.
"Yo, isn't this... Junior Brother Yuan Ming?"
Looking over, Yuan Ming recognized the disciple who had taken care of Huo Chan'er yesterday.
"Lei Gong, brother, what a coincidence to meet you here," Yuan Ming greeted with a smile and a salute.
"Junior Brother Yuan is here, so it seems you have made up your mind to challenge yourself, haven't you?" Lei Gong walked up to Yuan Ming, glanced at the authorization in his hand, recognized it instantly, and said with a smile.
"Ahem, Lei Gong brother, so you know each other..." the round-faced disciple said with a forced smile.
Lei Gong noted his change in expression and knew the man was making things difficult again. He waved his hand and said:
"I'll take Junior Brother Yuan Ming into the mountain, no need for you to worry about this. Go on with your work."
"Alright then." The round-faced disciple no longer mentioned the signature and immediately turned to leave.
"Junior Brother Yuan Ming, follow me," Lei Gong said as he led Yuan Ming through the hall and out the back door.
Once outside of the mountain gate hall, Yuan Ming came to a wide plaza and immediately saw a massive circular building constructed of strip stones, which appeared very sturdy.
Seeing Yuan Ming's curious gaze, Lei Gong offered an explanation: "This is the Beast Fighting Arena, where Sect disciples can bring their spirit beasts to compete. Victors can earn a substantial reward in contribution points."
"When are the fights usually held, and can we watch?" Yuan Ming asked, his interest piqued.
"Usually there's one every month, with a varying number of matches depending on the number of participants. Elder disciples who are not competing can also watch, but there's an admission fee of ten contribution points," Lei Gong explained.
"So it's not free..." Yuan Ming thought to himself.
The most up-to-date version is on *.
"Speaking of which, the fights are always very lively! Spectators can also place bets based on their own judgment, and if the side they bet on wins, they can earn contribution point rewards based on the odds," Lei Gong said with some excitement.
"Is that even possible?"
While Yuan Ming said this, he thought to himself, "Isn't this just gambling? It seems that cultivators are no different from mortals in this aspect."
As they spoke, they bypassed the Beast Fighting Arena and began walking up the mountain path towards the peak.
Thick trees lined the path, among which various buildings of different sizes and specifications were hidden. Their number was multiples greater than that of the Fire Refining Hall, and various roars of beasts could vaguely be heard.
When they reached an open square halfway up the mountain, Lei Gong stopped and warned Yuan Ming:
"The Beast Garden up ahead is the place where disciples from other halls come to study Beast Taming for official business. I'll take you there to register with the Deacon Elder in a moment. Once you're finished studying, return along the same path and don't wander around. Our Beast Taming Hall has many rules and strict hierarchy, especially the area above the middle of the mountain—that is the territory of Inner Sect Disciples, and is generally off-limits."
"Thank you, Senior Brother, I will remember that," Yuan Ming nodded and said.
With that, the two of them arrived at a sizeable courtyard and entered the great hall at the forefront.
The Deacon Elder in charge here was a slender, middle-aged man with a neatly-trimmed beard shaped like the character for "eight." Seeing Lei Gong bring a stranger, he asked, "Lei Gong is here, ah, is this person next to you a disciple from the Fire Refining Hall?"
"Disciple pays his respects to Deacon Mo Lu. I am here to learn about spirit beast breeding and am here to observe and learn," Yuan Ming said, handing over the signed document.
"A disciple eager to learn is always welcome! Come over here and register, and hand over five contribution points," said the bearded Deacon, glancing at him before nodding.
Yuan Ming frowned upon hearing this.
He had received a clear reply from the Execution Hall Deacon that observing and learning about spirit beast breeding for official business did not require a fee, as it was a baseline benefit of being part of a Beast Taming Sect.
"Any problems, Junior Brother Yuan?" the bearded Deacon asked, seeing Yuan Ming standing without moving, his brows knitting together.
Naturally, Yuan Ming didn't have any contribution points, and he couldn't conjure any in the moment. Just as he was about to give up and leave, Lei Gong took out his own Registered Disciple waist card and handed it to Mo Lu:
"Deacon Mo Lu, this Junior Brother is new and doesn't understand the rules. Please deduct it from my contribution points."
"If he doesn't understand the rules, you should teach him properly. Lucky for you, I am easy to talk to. Others wouldn't be so lenient," Deacon Mo Lu's expression softened somewhat.
He took the waist card, pressed it against his own, and with a flash of light in his palm, he immediately handed it back to Lei Gong, then turned and walked towards the doorway behind him.
"Thank you, Senior Brother. I will definitely repay you later," Yuan Ming sincerely thanked Lei Gong.
"It's a trifle, not worth mentioning! If you hadn't helped out yesterday, the Fire Mink of the Third Cave Master would have had issues, and I would have been in big trouble," Lei Gong waved his hand dismissively and said in a low voice.
Just as the two were about to cross the threshold, they suddenly heard a loud shout from behind: "Stop right there."
Yuan Ming's brow furrowed, and he silently cursed his bad luck.
Lei Gong, not understanding what was happening, turned around and saw who it was, his expression subtly changing as he quickly bowed with fists clasped: "Senior Brother Kun Tu, is there something wrong?"
Kun Tu ignored his question, his gaze scanning over Yuan Ming with a teasing look.
Yuan Ming turned to face Kun Tu, meeting his gaze without any sign of avoidance.
He had thought that with the sect being so large, it was unlikely to run into this person by chance, but as fate would have it, the saying "misfortune seldom comes alone" seemed true.
