Hu Huo's body trembled, feeling slightly frightened by Yuan Ming's terrifying gaze. Initially, he did not understand why Yuan Ming looked at him that way, but after glancing at Hagon behind him, he had an epiphany.
But soon, his expression stabilized and a sneer appeared on his lips.
"Yuan Ming, oh Yuan Ming, we actually followed you here intending to kill you stealthily. I didn't expect you to assault your fellow sect members so soon. Well, that's perfect. We can kill you with full justification and report back honestly, and it will still be a meritorious deed," said Kun Tu with a smile.
After entering the Inner Sect, he had been nurtured by Elder Mengshan and with the help of elixirs, his cultivation had surged to the Qi Refining Seventh Level. Facing Yuan Ming, he naturally felt fully confident.
Yuan Ming's expression remained unchanged, his gaze falling on Kun Tu as he asked, "The tasks of the Beast Slave Hall are always carried out in secrecy, and I've never made them public. How did you know about my participation in this task?"
"Hehe, I forgot to tell you, it went so smoothly this time largely thanks to Wulu," Kun Tu laughed.
Yuan Ming frowned and looked towards Wulu.
"Sorry, Brother Yuan, when you asked me about the Beast Slave Hall's task last time, it felt a bit odd. I reported it to Fellow Daoist Kun Tu after I returned," Wulu said with a smile, showing no sign of remorse.
After all, in his view, Yuan Ming was doomed today.
Yuan Ming heard Wulu's words and inwardly sneered, somewhat surprised.
He had not expected that Wulu would pay attention to such details.
It seemed that after entering the Biluo Cave, his alertness had not been enough, which had led to today's dire situation due to some mistakes he should not have made.
"Indeed, it was Fellow Daoist Kun Tu's wise deduction. Just casually mentioning it, he guessed that you would participate in the Beast Slave Hall's mission, and thereafter kept an eye out and finally caught you," Wulu didn't forget to flatter Kun Tu.
"Yuan Ming, now that we are far outside the sect's territory, let's see if anyone can save you?" Kun Tu's face showed a smug expression as he said with a cold laugh.
"Every man for himself, and the heavens for us all. Brother Yuan, after all, we had an acquaintance together, and I had my own unavoidable reasons. Don't blame me." Wulu smiled sympathetically as he slightly bowed to Yuan Ming.
Just then, Yuan Ming suddenly let out a muffled groan, his face turning an iron blue as he clutched his abdomen and collapsed to the ground.
Seeing this, Kun Tu could not help but burst out laughing, "Talking so much nonsense, all just to wait for your poison to take effect. How does it feel, the Cold Yin Frost Poison invading your Dantian? Not very pleasant, is it?"

chapters.title: Chapter 130 - 110 Return
chapters.content:
"The Cold Yin Frost Poison can numb the Dantian and then erode the meridians. Once both the Twelve Main Meridians and Eight Extraordinary Meridians are all poisoned, his hands and feet will be paralyzed, his muscles rigid, and even his Adam's apple will not move. He won't even be able to speak," Ba Da said, quite pleased with himself as he stepped forward without waiting for Yuan Ming to say anything.
"You again, you scoundrel..."
Yuan Ming's words were cut short as his throat suddenly choked up, rendering him voiceless, and the hand he raised stiffened abruptly, veins bulging on his arm as the poison evidently began to erode his meridians.
At this moment, Yuan Ming felt regretful, blaming himself for being too anxious to save someone and having let his guard down, not realizing when these people had caught up with him.
Seeing Yuan Ming immobilized, Ba Da, holding a sharp knife, turned his head to Kun Tu and asked,
"Shall I first cut his tendons in his hands and feet, then pierce his collarbones and leave him with a breath of life so that you can slowly torture him? Is that alright?"
"That's fine. He killed people from the Beast Slave Hall, and even the Three Cave Masters can't protect him. We don't need to kill him in secret anymore. If we bring him back to the Sect, we might even get some extra rewards," Kun Tu nodded and said with a smile.
When Ba Da turned back around, the smile on his face had vanished, replaced by a look of bitter hatred.
"Yuan, if you hadn't meddled, I would have controlled Chen Wan with drugs by now and made her my slave. Now she's become an Inner Sect Disciple, and I no longer have the chance to lay a hand on her. All this, it's your fault," Ba Da moved closer to Yuan Ming, viciously accusing him of his "crimes."
Yuan Ming's Adam's apple moved painfully twice, as if he wanted to say something, but no sound could come out.
"You, you really deserve to die," Ba Da came up beside him and spat in a whisper.
Just as Ba Da got close enough, he suddenly heard a sigh: "Ah, I wanted to get rid of Kun Tu first, or at the very least Hu Huo. You, unlucky fool, are just seeking your own death."
Ba Da's pupils contracted sharply, and he hastily backed away.
However, Yuan Ming, who lay on the ground, suddenly slapped the ground and bounced up vigorously, the hand that had been hidden in his sleeve emerging with a Red Bent Horn grasped in it, thrusting directly at Ba Da's throat.
A piercing sound rang out.
Ba Da had no time to react and was directly impaled through the throat by the Red Bent Horn, blood gushing out immediately.
He clasped his hands over his throat, blood oozing through his fingers, stumbling backward, his eyes wide with shock, he opened his mouth to speak, but his mouth was already full of pink froth.
In a panic, he pulled out a porcelain bottle from his chest, uncorked it, and poured the powder inside over the wound on his neck.
The loss of blood caused his hands to tremble violently, spilling much of the powder, none of which landed on the grievous wound.
Yuan Ming watched the scene calmly, clutching the Red Bent Horn tightly, drawing a vast amount of Pure Yang Power from it, neutralizing the last traces of Cold Yin Frost Poison in his body. With his other hand holding a sword, he stepped forward and chopped off Ba Da's head.
This sudden turn of events caught Kun Tu and the others off guard.
None of them could have imagined that Yuan Ming had the means to neutralize Ba Da's poison so quickly, nor did they anticipate that everything Yuan Ming had shown up to this point was just a ruse.
He had already neutralized the poison but still pretended to gradually succumb to its effects. Had Ba Da not rushed forward first, any one of them who did would have been in trouble.
"With you lot of trash, you also wish to kill me? Didn't you look at yourself to see how capable you are?" Yuan Ming kicked away Ba Da's head and swept his gaze toward Kun Tu and the others.
"You, excellent!" Kun Tu's eyes narrowed slightly, and a murderous intent flashed in them.
"Indeed, I'm in excellent shape now. Speaking of which, Kun Tu, you'd better really kill me this time, or I'll certainly take your head for a night pot," Yuan Ming taunted, then suddenly spun and dashed toward the distant woods.
Provoked by Yuan Ming's challenge, Kun Tu could no longer restrain himself, and slapped the Spiritual Beast Bag at his waist vigorously.
A streak of green light flared, and a huge Green Wolf with a white tuft on its brow, carrying Kun Tu, burst out, chasing after Yuan Ming.
Hu Huo also promptly summoned his Green Falcon, with two Human Demons hopping aboard, taking to the sky and pursuing Yuan Ming.
The One-eyed Woman and Wulu, lacking their own spirit beasts, could only sprint at full speed, following suit.
However, before leaving, Wulu glanced at Tuya and her daughter and shook his head, saying, "You are all doomed anyway; run as far as you can."
Yuan Ming, using the Shadowless Step, quickly sped out of the village and into the forest, where he soon disappeared from view.
Seeing Yuan Ming slip away, Kun Tu immediately patted the head of the Green Wolf beneath him, motioning it to track by scent.
The Green Wolf sniffed the ground and quickly began pursuing in one direction.
After they had been gone for quite some time, a cluster of richly fragrant bushes in the woods slowly unfolded its vines, revealing Yuan Ming, who had been concealed inside a cage made of vines.
Meanwhile, in the direction the Green Wolf was chasing, a black raven flew off into the distance with a piece of torn cloth in its beak.
Having shaken off Kun Tu, Yuan Ming looked up and scanned the sky, not spotting Elder Hu Huo anywhere and immediately set off to return.
His purpose for this trip was to save Tuya and her mother; he had deliberately provoked Kun Tu to draw him away from the mother and daughter.
But before he had taken many steps, a chaotic flurry of footsteps approached—it was the One-eyed Woman and Wulu catching up.
"This yin soul just won't disperse!"
Yuan Ming cursed, his body immediately leaning back against an ancient tree lush with greenery. His heart silently recited the mnemonic, casting the Wood Concealment Skill.
Accompanied by a burst of green light, his skin instantly revealed the rough pattern of tree bark, merging with the ancient tree as though becoming one with it, vanishing into the woods.
After a short while, the one-eyed woman and Wulu appeared in Yuan Ming's field of vision, one after the other.
Seeing that it was only them and no one else, Yuan Ming immediately made a decision.
When the two approached, he planned to let the one-eyed woman in the lead pass and then launch a sneak attack on Wulu who followed.
After killing Wulu, he would then pursue and kill the one-eyed woman.
He concealed his figure, held his breath, and concentrated his mind, watching the movements of the two. As the one-eyed woman was about to come over, Wulu suddenly called out, asking the one-eyed woman to wait for him.
"Useless trash!" The one-eyed woman just glanced back and muttered under her breath before continuing on her way.
Wulu, scolded "useless trash", stopped in his tracks, glaring resentfully at the woman.
"Hmph, running so fast, in such a hurry to meet death? And she dares to call me trash?" he muttered to himself and, to Yuan Ming's surprise, turned around and walked back the way he came.
This left Yuan Ming somewhat caught off guard.
He had planned to kill Wulu first, but then Wulu turned back halfway.
While he hesitated, the one-eyed woman was already upon him.
"Kill."
Yuan Ming steeled his heart, formed a spell with one hand, and mana surged into motion.
As the one-eyed woman took a step, the ground beside her suddenly lit up with a yellow halo. Three sharp wooden thorns in a "品" shape pierced out of the ground, aiming straight for her body.
Her reaction was extremely quick; with a flick of her wrist, the long whip coiled around her waist shot straight into the sky. With a "thud," it pierced a thick branch above.
The one-eyed woman used the pulling force of the whip to leap straight up, avoiding the attack from the wooden thorns, soaring into mid-air.
Just as she was about to reach that branch, the surrounding branches and the vines entwined around the trees suddenly became like live snakes, wrapping towards her from all sides.
Being in mid-air, the one-eyed woman only had the branches above to leverage from.
Unfortunately, before she could shake the vines to change direction, the branch above became as limp as a noodle, twisting and coiling around her whip, hoisting her up in the process.
The one-eyed woman, realizing the situation was dire, stimulated the mana inside her body and her whip bristled with barbs. A fierce force burst forth, instantly snapping the branch.
She then fell towards the ground below.
Do vines and branches had already converged from all sides, twisting together to form a cage of vines, trapping her in the center.
Seeing this, the one-eyed woman immediately pulled out a round iron sphere, black and unremarkable, from her sleeve, channeled mana into it, and threw it towards the ground below.
At the same time, she crossed her arms and curled up into a ball, a layer of dark yellow light emanating from her body as if she had deployed some Earth Attribute magic.
"Boom"
The next instant, a ball of flame burst forth from below.
Enjoying the story? Discover more on *.
The converging vines had not yet fully formed the Wood Prison before they were shattered by the force of this sudden explosion, scattering in all directions.
"An Earth Fire Bomb?" Yuan Ming frowned; he had seen his fellow disciples refine it at the Fire Refining Hall.
The one-eyed woman was blasted upwards by the force of the explosion, and then she began to descend towards the ground.
The yellow glow had already dissipated from her body, and her arms and back had varying degrees of burns. She looked somewhat disheveled.
The moment she landed, she whipped towards the void behind her, guarding against an attack from an unknown source.
However, the whip met nothing but air, making only a "snap" sound!
She dared not linger and immediately tried to run back.
But just as she turned around, Yuan Ming's figure emerged from the ancient tree. With a light tap of his foot, he silently initiated the Shadowless Step, swiftly catching up to the one-eyed woman.
She felt a shiver down her spine and without looking back, the black wood hairpin atop her head was propelled by mana, shooting backwards in a "swoosh."
Yuan Ming ducked and lunged forward, avoiding the black wood hairpin, and with a flash of cold light in his hand, the Green Fish Sword appeared, thrusting forward and aiming directly for the one-eyed woman's heart.

chapters.title: Chapter 131 - 111 Unexpected
chapters.content:
Just as Yuan Ming's Green Fish Sword's tip pierced the one-eyed woman, a yellow halo lit up around her again, attempting to protect her body.
But the light was already dim, and seeing this, Yuan Ming stepped forward, channeling his mana to thrust again.
With a "hiss".
The yellow halo shattered, and the long sword pierced into the back of the one-eyed woman.
The one-eyed woman looked at the blade protruding from her chest in disbelief, her eyes flashing with astonishment. She opened her mouth to speak, but no sound came from her throat.
She couldn't believe that the person they had previously chased around the mountains was now toying with her, leaving her completely powerless to fight back.
Yuan Ming twisted his sword, instantly shredding the one-eyed woman's heart.
Before the Black Wood Hairpin, maintained by mana, could even fall, it landed on the ground with a "clatter".
He searched the one-eyed woman's body and found only the barbed whip and a shattered yellow porcelain tile, which was the source of the yellow glow that had protected her.
However, it had been damaged by the Earth Fire Bomb previously and had been severely damaged by Yuan Ming's hit, and it was now completely destroyed.
Yuan Ming packed up the whip and the Black Wood Hairpin, and without time to examine them further, he hurried back to lead Tuya and her daughter to escape from this place.
At that moment, a sharp cry came from above the forest.
"Hu Huo!" Yuan Ming clenched his teeth silently and turned to plunge back into the thick forest.
In the sky, a Green Falcon swooped down toward this area, with Hu Huo bringing along two Human Demons, descending.
He glanced at the body of the one-eyed woman, his eyebrows furrowed, then he maneuvered the Green Falcon in the direction Yuan Ming had fled, chasing after him.
After he left, Wulu slowly arrived from behind.
Seeing the body of the one-eyed woman on the ground, he tugged at the corner of his mouth and followed at a leisurely pace.
Meanwhile, Hu Huo maneuvered the Green Falcon in the sky, holding a cylindrical magic artifact, looking around the forest.
Suddenly, he glimpsed a white figure flashing through a gap in the woods.This chapter was first seen on *.
"Found him." Elder Hu Huo's eyes lit up.
This time, he didn't call others over for two reasons, one was to avoid startling Yuan Ming and allowing him to escape again, and two was that he wasn't worried about being unable to deal with Yuan Ming with the two Human Demons, including Hagon, beside him.
So, he maneuvered the Green Falcon and immediately followed the figure.
However, Yuan Ming's speed had increased considerably, and by activating the White Ape incarnation, he was even more agile and swift, moving through the forest with difficult maneuvers, making him hard to follow.
It was only when Hu Huo finally reached a river valley with sparser vegetation on either side that Yuan Ming's figure was fully exposed.
He seemed to be trying to use the river to hide his tracks and scent, but before he could jump into the river, he was already caught up.
Hu Huo sneered inwardly; his two fingers clutched a small triangular flag's slender pole, and with a gentle flick toward Yuan Ming.
"Whoosh"
The gold-colored frog on the triangular flag seemed to come to life, opening its mouth to spit at Yuan Ming.
Suddenly, a torrent of golden red flames surged out, rushing toward Yuan Ming by the riverbank.
Yuan Ming felt the scorching heat approaching his back, turned to look, and quickly dove at an angle into the cool river water.
The river was not too deep, failing to completely conceal his tall form transformed into the White Ape, and just as he raised his head, he saw another wave of intense golden red flames rolling toward him.
Yuan Ming quickly dove into the water again, drifting downstream with the flow.
Seeing this, Hu Huo pulled a silver bell from his chest and shook it lightly.
"Ding dong"
The Human Demon Hagon's body jolted, a hint of ferocious light blazing in his dull eyes as wisps of black mist seeped from his ears.
Hu Huo maneuvered the Green Falcon to land on the riverbank, pointing at the white shadow floating downstream in the water, and shouted lowly:
"Go!"
Human Demon Hagon immediately leaped off the Green Falcon's back, chasing after Yuan Ming in the river.
His movements were stiff, yet his speed was not slow; he landed in the water still in a running posture, not swimming, lacking the instinctive actions typical of regular Human Demons, nor as agile as the Human Demon King.
Watching Hagon chase far away, just as Hu Huo was about to fly the Green Falcon again, it suddenly let out a restless, low whine, struggling several times without being able to take off.
Hu Huo immediately realized something was wrong, and with the remaining Human Demon, he leaped down from the back of the Green Falcon.
Mid-air, he turned his head sharply, only to see that beneath the Green Falcon, several sturdy vines were entangled intricately, forming two vine prisons that tightly bound its claws.
At the same time, three wooden thorns unexpectedly protruded from the ground, stabbing directly at the Green Falcon's vital spots.
Hu Huo's heart chilled, he quickly waved the triangular flag, a burst of flame shot out, burning both the wooden thorns and the wood prison.
The Green Falcon also let out a painful scream, broke free from its binds, and rushed into the sky.
Panic and pain made it instinctively want to flee, but before it had flown far, it was recalled by Elder Hu Huo, who had just landed and was controlling a Stone Talisman.
Elder Hu Huo knew that Yuan Ming was behind this mischief. He did not dare to linger, immediately shaking the bell to summon the Human Demon Hagon back to him.
"I am already here. Weren't you constantly eager to seek revenge for Hagon? Hiding now, will you still seek revenge?" Elder Hu Huo looked around, taunting Yuan Ming, trying to provoke him into showing himself.
However, there was silence all around, without any response.
"If I were you, I'd use whatever tricks I have right now. Otherwise, once Hagon returns, you'll have to fight him, and you wouldn't want to behead him yourself, would you? Wouldn't it be easier to deal with just me?" Elder Hu Huo continued to shout.
Just then, from behind him on an ancient tree branch, a figure suddenly appeared, flipped over, and with a flash of the cold light from his long sword, he thrust directly at Elder Hu Huo's head.
Elder Hu Huo did not turn his head, but waved his hand, and the small triangular flag immediately flew up. The surface flashed, and a golden toad emerged like a Light Shield, protecting his head.
The moment Yuan Ming's sword hit the Light Shield, it made a grating sound, but the sword tip could not pierce through the light barrier.
At that moment, the fierce light flashed in the Human Demon's eyes as it charged forward, leaping up to smash a fist towards Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming blocked with his sword horizontally and with the other hand, he formed a seal and chanted softly, "Rise."
As the word rang out, he was knocked flying by a punch.
At the same time, the ground beneath Elder Hu Huo cracked, and black vines burst from the soil, twisting toward him.
Realizing the danger, Elder Hu Huo leapt from the ground in an instant, grabbed the small triangular flag above him, and waved it towards the ground. A surge of Golden Red Flames spewed forth, igniting all the vines.
However, amidst the raging flames, a thin black vine suddenly pierced through, heading straight for Elder Hu Huo's throat.
Sensing the danger, Elder Hu Huo quickly tipped on his toes and retreated, widening the distance from the black vine.
Just as he thought he was out of the black vine's attack range, a surprising scene unfolded.
A small Black Toad leaped out from among the flames, heading straight for his face, with the swell on its back connected to that thin black vine.
As the distance between them narrowed, the thin black vine gathered strength again for another thrust, aiming directly at the vital spot of his throat.
Just as the black vine was about to strike Elder Hu Huo, a white shadow suddenly leaped in from the side, positioning itself in front of Elder Hu Huo — it was the Human Demon.
The black vine struck the Human Demon's upper abdomen, piercing through its hard skin with astonishing force.
A stream of Poison Liquid rapidly infused into its body.
The abdomen of the Human Demon was quickly eroded by the poison, and soon it could not stand and collapsed onto the ground.
Seeing this scene, fear struck Elder Hu Huo's heart, and he was plagued with a series of questions, "That dark little thing... could it be a spirit beast? Since when did Yuan Ming have such a spirit beast?"
As the thought arose, he quickly waved the triangular flag, and the rolling flames immediately surged toward the Black Toad.
However, the triumphant Black Toad had already returned to Yuan Ming's side, summoned by him.
At that moment, the water in the river churned, and a white figure swam upstream against the current — it was the Human Demon Hagon.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming immediately jumped into the river with the Black Toad, bypassed Hagon, and vigorously swam downstream.
Earlier, he had used a vine-woven human decoy, supporting the White Ape Beast Skin as it drifted downstream. Elder Hu Huo still thought the Fur Cloak Technique was Yuan Ming's only reliance, which led him to be deceived.
"This kid is getting harder and harder to deal with," Elder Hu Huo muttered as he watched Yuan Ming's departing figure, his eyebrows tightly furrowed once more.
He shook the bell in his hand, signaling Hagon to give chase again, while he planned to meet up with Kun Tu.
...
Yuan Ming quickly found the White Ape Beast Skin on a shallow bank. After climbing ashore, he looked back and scanned around, then glanced upward at the sky.
"Has Elder Hu Huo not caught up?" he pondered quietly.
At that moment, a black shadow circled back in the night sky, returning — it was the soul crow that had distracted Kun Tu earlier by carrying a piece of his clothing.
The soul crow dove into Yuan Ming's forehead, returning to his Sea of Consciousness.
He had now largely mastered Elder Hu Huo's tactics and could handle them with ease. Now, what worried him more was Kun Tu.
This person's cultivation was profoundly high, and he possessed a Mid-grade Magical Artifact. After becoming an Inner Sect Disciple, his strength must have increased significantly, necessitating caution.
Yuan Ming pondered briefly, then used the Wood Concealment Skill.
After the Divine Soul Transformation, his control over Mana had become more accurate, and the effect of the Wood Concealment Skill had improved significantly. Not a single animal or insect nearby was aware of his presence.
Yuan Ming was very satisfied with this, and he took a detour back to Miao Hua Village to check on Tuya and her daughter's safety.
The Wood Concealment Skill worked superbly; the journey back encountered no obstacles, and he arrived quickly at Miao Hua Village. However, Tuya and her daughter were nowhere to be seen.
There were no signs of a struggle in the surroundings; traces of two sets of footprints were faintly visible in the bushes, suggesting they had escaped on their own.

chapters.title: Chapter 132 - 112 The Cost of Soul Collision
chapters.content:
"Not bad in terms of quick thinking,"
Yuan Ming muttered to himself, chasing in the direction of the footprints while unleashing the Divine Skill "Far Travel" to release all three soul crows, searching for Tuya and her daughter's whereabouts.
The soul crows were much faster than running horses, and with nothing to block their way in the air, they quickly located Tuya and her daughter, who were hurrying along a mountain path in an attempt to escape.
Tuya's mother seemed to have injured her leg, limping as she walked, which meant she couldn't move quickly.
Moreover, perhaps due to their panic and not choosing their path carefully, they didn't head towards the outskirts of the mountain; instead, they were moving deeper into Qingao Mountain.
Yuan Ming's expression eased slightly as he pursued them closely along the way.
…
On a thorny path leading deep into Qingao Mountain, Tuya was slowly helping her mother forward.
Tuya's mother was just an ordinary village woman who didn't know where to go, and all she wanted at that moment was to protect her daughter and keep her away from those murderous demons.
"Ouch!" Tuya exclaimed as she tripped over a tree root and fell to the ground.
Tuya's mother quickly turned back to help her up, and at that moment, the bushes in front of them rustled, and a figure leaped out.
"Don't... don't come any closer!"
Tuya's mother cried out in terror, clutching her daughter to her chest and collapsing to the ground.
"Ladies, there's no need to be afraid, I have no intention of harming you," the figure said, and it was Yuan Ming.
"What do you want to do?" Tuya's mother, who recognized Yuan Ming, looked at him with terror in her eyes that had not lessened at all.
"Follow me, I'll take you to a safe place," Yuan Ming said urgently.
Tuya's mother looked at Yuan Ming fearfully but said nothing and did not move.
Yuan Ming blinked, then understood that to them, he was also a murderous demon.
"Do you want to save both yourself and your daughter?" He coughed to soften his approach slightly and asked again.
Tuya's mother, whether she saw no ill intent in Yuan Ming or was too frightened, nodded subconsciously.
"Then come with me, I'll take you to safety," Yuan Ming said.
"Who are you? Why do you want to help us?" Tuya's mother hesitated, then pressed him for an answer.
"There is no time to explain now; if you want to live, follow me," Yuan Ming said and started walking in the direction out of Qingao Mountain.
Tuya's mother hesitated, unsure whether to trust the man before her.
Although Yuan Ming had helped them before, she could see that it was his companions who had annihilated Miao Hua Village.
If they stayed here and encountered other murderous demons, they, mother and child alone, would have no chance of survival.
Quickly making up her mind, Tuya's mother took her daughter's hand and followed him.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming stopped, then turned and walked back to them.
"What... what are you going to do?" Tuya's mother's nerves showed again.
"You're moving too slowly," Yuan Ming said, and without waiting for a response, he grabbed the two of them and moved swiftly forward using the Shadowless Step.
Tuya and her mother could only feel the whooshing of the wind by their ears, and everything they saw was receding rapidly. Before they could react, they found themselves at a three-way crossing to the northwest of Miao Hua Village.
One of the paths was quite spacious, wide enough for two carriages to run side by side, winding its way into the distance.
Enjoy the story by reading on *.
Yuan Ming had taken this road when he came to Miao Hua Village; about twenty or so miles ahead, there was a town that was an important crossroad and quite large.
Biluo Cave's massacre and soul collection were only aimed at some remote small tribes and would not target bustling towns.
He set down Tuya and her mother and told Tuya's mother the location of the town.
"Once you get there, you'll be safe. This road is a merchant's path, and you won't encounter any enemies, so you can rest assured," Yuan Ming concluded.
"Thank you. Aren't you coming with us?" Tuya's mother felt slightly reassured and asked.
Yuan Ming shook his head; by attacking Hagon and defying Biluo Cave's orders so openly, if he couldn't deal with all of them, Hu Huo, Kun Tu, and others, and even if one were to escape, he would face the endless pursuit of Biluo Cave. Helping Tuya and her mother to this extent was already his limit.
"Hurry, it's going to be too late if you wait..." He began to say.
Before he finished speaking, a breeze blew from afar, sweeping through the woods.
Yuan Ming's brow furrowed, as the breeze carried a trace of the scent of fierce beasts.
He quickly commanded the soul crows to scout the vicinity, his expression changing as he pulled out the White Ape Skin and transformed into the White Ape.
No sooner had Yuan Ming done so than the nearby bushes made a loud noise, and a tall figure leaped out—it was Hagon, transformed into a Human Demon.
When Tuya saw this monster, she trembled, and her mother also showed a look of fear, not realizing that the monster in front of them was Hagon in disguise.
"You two, move aside," Yuan Ming summoned the black toad and said sternly.
Taking in the series of dramatic changes, Tuya's mother, no longer as timid and fragile as before, quickly fled to the side with her daughter.
Hagon ignored Tuya and her mother, his blood-red eyes fixed on Yuan Ming as he roared and lunged forward.
Yuan Ming pinched a spell and the ground in front of Hagon cracked open, with five wooden thorns shooting out, aiming at Hagon's lower abdomen, but he agilely dodged them.
Yuan Ming had already experienced the speed of Human Demons and took advantage of Hagon's dodging to flick his finger.
A smoke bomb shot out from his hand, striking the ground in front of Hagon.
With a "bang," a large cloud of gray smoke arose, obscuring Hagon's vision.
Hagon let out an angry roar, his right leg shone with a thick blue light, growing significantly thicker out of thin air, and he fiercely stomped on the ground.
With a muffled "rumble," the ground was stomped into a not-so-shallow pit, and a gust of wind mixed with blue light swept out, dispersing most of the nearby smoke.
Just at that moment, a black crow flew directly at Hagon, aiming for his face, only a foot away from his body.
However, Hagon seemed to have foreseen it and easily dodged with a step.
Yuan Ming's face showed surprise, unable to understand how Hagon's eyes seemed able to see through the smoke?
"Roar!"
Hagon's gaping mouth opened wide, emitting a roar like a fierce howl.
The airflow within a dozen yards suddenly became violently turbulent, whipping up a huge windstorm, which not only easily dispersed the remaining smoke but also kicked up dust that prevented Yuan Ming from opening his eyes.
Hagon seized the opportunity to continue his onslaught, his two sharp claws crisscrossing towards Yuan Ming's throat.
A shadow flashed beside Yuan Ming, and two more black crows flew out, aiming for Hagon's face.
Hagon, preoccupied with evading Yang Ming's attacks, hurriedly dodged again, avoiding one crow, but ultimately he failed to evade the second.
The black crow fiercely collided with his forehead, actually penetrating through and entering his Sea of Consciousness.
The soul crow turned into a Void Spirit state and, upon colliding with Hagon's Divine Soul, burst into a "bang."
Hagon's body shook violently, and he fell to his knees on the ground, his limbs spasming and trembling, utterly unable to get up.
Yuan Ming's face also turned a few shades paler, but his actions were not affected, and his mind promptly urged him on.
The ground beside Hagon cracked open, and a Purple-Black Demon Vine shot out, rapidly entwining around his body and forming a Wooden Vine Cage within a few breaths' time.
Hagon's body was still spasming, offering no resistance as he was firmly imprisoned by the Purple Vine Cage.
Yuan Ming's expression slightly relaxed, confident in the impregnable Wood Prison Technique formed by the Purple-Black Demon Vine. Considering the previous fight, Hagon did not seem to have the ability to use Fire Attribute attacks and was unlikely to break free.
Tuya and her mother sighed in relief, seeing the monster subdued.
"Mother, this brother is so powerful; I want to be like him when I grow up," Tuya said, no longer as scared, her eyes shining while watching the ongoing fight.
"What nonsense are you spouting!" Tuya's mother quickly covered her mouth, preventing her from babbling.
Tuya was not afraid at all, her round eyes fixated on Yuan Ming's silhouette.
Yuan Ming naturally heard the noise from the two behind him, but he did not respond and instead summoned the remaining two soul crows, sitting down to practice Breathing Control.
What he had just used was the "soul collision" ability obtained after his Divine Soul Transformation; the soul crow would enter the enemy's Sea of Consciousness and self-destruct to carry out a kamikaze attack.
The power of the "soul collision" was incredibly terrifying; slightly weaker enemies would be directly annihilated, while equals would suffer severe Divine Soul injuries, becoming disoriented for a short time and losing bodily control, just like Hagon now.
"Soul collision," as powerful as it was, came with a significant toll; with his current Divine Soul Power, he could only condense three soul crows and perform "soul collision" three times.
Moreover, "soul collision" differed from ordinary Soul Power Divine Skills. Once executed, all Soul Power would explode in the enemy's Sea of Consciousness and dissipate without a trace, and none could be recovered.
Soul Power, unlike Mana, was quite difficult to replenish. Even with the Moonlight Technique, a third of his Soul Power would take about seven days to restore.
"With such a hefty cost, it seems I can't misuse 'soul collision' lightly," Yuan Ming mused internally. After a brief period of cultivating, his complexion had recovered.
The lost Divine Soul Power couldn't be restored quickly; it could only recover slowly.
He got up and approached Hagon. Hagon had awakened from the "soul collision" state, and while his body was still imprisoned, his mouth could move, and he roared incessantly at Yuan Ming, his blood-red eyes filled with a thirst for blood and violence.
Yuan Ming looked at the frenzied Hagon in front of him, somewhat silent.
He had searched for information about Human Demons and the Fur Cloak Skill in the Gui Cang Pavilion, but unfortunately found nothing. It seemed that Biluo Cave intentionally concealed everything about the Fur Cloak Skill, and the method to refine it was not stored in the Gui Cang Pavilion either.
Given that Hagon had become a Human Demon, Yuan Ming currently had no way to help him recover.
Since Hagon was here, Hu Huo and others would probably follow soon, leaving him little time.
"Do I really have to kill Hagon?" Yuan Ming clenched his fist.
"This... sir, shouldn't we quickly kill this monster and leave at once?" Tuya's mother, seeing Yuan Ming staring blankly at the disgusting creature, couldn't help but speak.
Yuan Ming's body shook slightly as he turned to look at the woman.
"Sir... Did I say something wrong?" Tuya's mother's heart skipped a beat under his gaze.
Yuan Ming withdrew his gaze, a hint of sadness flashing in his eyes.
If Tuya's mother knew that the monster in front of her was her husband, what would she feel?
Hearing the woman's voice, Hagon's roaring suddenly paused, and the blood light in his eyes dimmed significantly.
Yuan Ming's eyes showed surprise, glancing at Tuya's mother, a thoughtful look crossed his face, and a vague guess formed in his mind.

chapters.title: Chapter 133 - 113: Powerless
chapters.content:
Hagon's bloodshot eyes didn't remain dim for long; they soon recovered their brightness and he let out an even more intense roar than before.
"It seems that Hagon has not completely lost his senses. Hearing his wife's voice, his rationality temporarily returns," Yuan Ming thought to himself.
Since Hagon's rationality was still present, it meant that the situation was not entirely without a solution.
He sat cross-legged in front of Hagon, placed one hand on his head, and attempted to sense Hagon's Sea of Consciousness.
Hagon's Sea of Consciousness had been overrun by viscous Blood Light, and the circulation of his Soul Power had become unusually sluggish. In contrast, the Blood Light seemed quite agile as it took control in reverse.
Yuan Ming was very familiar with this Blood Light; he had seen it before in his own Sea of Consciousness, stemming from the Fur Cloak Skill's Killing Aura.
"Is this what being completely controlled by Killing Aura looks like? It's almost as I expected," Yuan Ming muttered to himself and began fully deploying the Beast Taming Technique.
The Human Clan's Sea of Consciousness is unique, vastly different from that of Fierce Beasts; one cannot implant Beast Taming Runes in it, hence the Beast Taming Technique is not a Spell used against humans, but it can torture the opponent into submission.
Yuan Ming thought of using the Beast Taming Technique to try and awaken Hagon.
Streams of black gas entered Hagon's Sea of Consciousness, ignoring Hagon's Divine Soul entirely and rushing towards the Killing Aura's Blood Light.
This Blood Light controlled Hagon's mind. If he could weaken or even expel it, Hagon should be able to come back to his senses.
Yuan Ming's plan was correct, but the execution proved far more difficult than he had anticipated. The Killing Aura's Blood Light was much more tenacious than the Divine Soul Power, and the black gas of the Beast Taming Technique had almost no effect when it collided with it.
His brows furrowed but soon smoothed out again as he slightly bent his fingers and recited an ancient Spell.
Inside Hagon's Sea of Consciousness, the black gas of the Beast Taming Technique suddenly condensed and coalesced into two large rotating black stones, resembling two grinding wheels, relentlessly crushing the Killing Aura's Blood Light within the Sea of Consciousness.
After the Divine Soul Transformation, Yuan Ming's control over Divine Soul Power became more skilled, and his prowess with the Beast Taming Technique also soared, now allowing him to manipulate the black gas of the Beast Taming Technique into different shapes.
Of course, the change in the black gas did not occur without cause; it also involved the application of the Moonlight Technique.
After turning into black grinding stones, the power of the Beast Taming Technique surged, and the Blood Light, unable to withstand the pressure, began to disperse.
"The Moonlight Technique is indeed powerful; a slight change can grant such Divine Skills!" Yuan Ming nodded slightly to himself.
Hagon was far from comfortable, showing a pained expression and continuing to roar.
Some of the Divine Soul Power was contained within the Blood Light, and the two were inseparably intertwined. Now they were being crushed together, the pain was inevitable.
Yuan Ming turned a deaf ear and continued casting his Spell.
The Blood Light in Hagon's Sea of Consciousness was gradually weakened, and before long, the majority of it had dissipated.
Hagon's face became pale, and he gasped for breath as a significant portion of his Divine Soul Power had been eroded away.
However, it was all worth it; the blood color in his eyes had significantly faded, and the return of his senses was imminent.
With most of the Killing Aura's Blood Light gone, Hagon's Divine Soul emerged, entwined with a Blood Chain composed of runes, which appeared to be a kind of control secret technique.
"Is this the method Hu Huo uses to control Hagon?" Yuan Ming's pupils contracted as he wrapped the black grinding stones around the Blood Chain, grinding it fiercely.
Hagon's body suddenly trembled, and blood began to flow from his orifices.
The Blood Chain was ten times more resilient than the Killing Aura's Blood Light, and the black grinding stones could not affect it in the slightest.
Tuya's mother watched as Yuan Ming suddenly sat down to cast his Spell as if she and her daughter had been forgotten. She wanted to leave with her daughter, but since Yuan Ming did not speak, she didn't dare to take a single step.
The figure sitting cross-legged was like a towering mountain, suppressing all her thoughts.
"Come here!" Yuan Ming's voice suddenly rang out.
Tuya's mother was startled, but a part of her heart relaxed, and she approached with her daughter.This copy was generated from content at *.
"Great One, what do you wish us to do?" Tuya's mother knelt beside Yuan Ming and asked.
"Do you know why I have repeatedly lent you my aid?" Yuan Ming said without turning his head.
"Please enlighten us," Tuya's mother had been wanting to ask about this and quickly responded.
"I am an old acquaintance of your husband, Hagon. Months ago, both of us were in Biluo Cave, enslaved as Fur Beasts…" Yuan Ming slowly revealed how he had met Hagon and the story of Hagon's transformation into a Human Demon, albeit briefly.
"Great One, are you saying this creature is my husband?" Tuya's mother, looking at Hagon, asked with a shaking voice, deeply moved.
Tuya was too young to understand Yuan Ming's words.
"He has transformed into a Human Demon and is now being controlled by someone. I'm trying to help him regain his senses. It's not easy to do, I need your help," Yuan Ming said.
"I will do everything I can. If it will awaken my husband, I am willing to give up my life," Tuya's mother said eagerly after wiping away her tears.
"Madam, there is no need for such thoughts. The task at hand is not that difficult. I am currently trying to suppress the Forbidden within Hagon's Divine Soul. You need only call out to him with your voices," Yuan Ming instructed.
"Really?" Tuya's mother's face lit up with joy, and she immediately began calling Hagon's name with Tuya.
The Killing Aura's Blood Light in Hagon's Sea of Consciousness had already been mostly shattered by Yuan Ming. Hagon was on the verge of regaining his senses, and hearing the calls of his wife and daughter, he quickly started to respond.
Hagon's body shook, the blood color in his eyes rapidly faded, revealing a clear light.
"Jina, Tuya, is that you… How did you get here? Where is this?" Hagon, seeing his wife and daughter, recognized them.
"Husband, you have awakened…" Tuya's mother cried with tears streaming down her face.
"Father…" Tuya also understood that the creature before her was her father, wanting to get close yet somewhat afraid.
"This is near Qingao Mountain," Yuan Ming said.
"Brother Yuan Ming! You're here too? What on earth is going on?" Hagon, who had seen Yuan Ming's White Ape Transformation, was surprised and hurriedly pressed for answers.
Yuan Ming cut a long story short and recounted how Hu Huo had turned him into a Human Demon and was now leading him to slaughter Miao Hua Village.
"Killing and snatching souls! Biluo Cave's actions are utterly devoid of humanity!" Hagon was furious.
The Killing Aura within his Sea of Consciousness surged as if triggered by his rage, and a hint of Blood Light shimmered in his eyes.
"Biluo Cave has always operated in such a manner, try not to get too agitated," Yuan Ming reminded him.
Hearing this, Hagon quickly calmed his emotions.
"Brother Yuan Ming, thank you for helping me regain my senses," he said to Yuan Ming with sincere gratitude.
"You have helped me several times before; I am merely repaying your kindness. No more words now. Since your senses have returned, focus on preserving the spirit light of your Divine Soul's origin. I will try to see if I can erase all the Killing Aura in your Sea of Consciousness," Yuan Ming said, his voice tinged with urgency.
Erasing the Blood Light from Hagon's Sea of Consciousness had already taken much time, and Hu Huo could appear at any moment.
Hagon picked up on Yuan Ming's urgency and quickly nodded, concentrating on guarding his sanity.
Yuan Ming took a deep breath and continued to operate the Beast Taming Technique, as the two black grindstones kept grinding away at the Killing Aura.
The last remnants of Killing Aura were extraordinarily tough. Though not as unshakable as the Blood Chain, the efficiency of the black grindstones significantly declined.
Moreover, the bond between Hagon's Divine Soul and the Blood Light was too close; with each dispersion of Blood Light, Hagon's Divine Soul Power suffered considerable damage.
If this continued, by the time all the Blood Light was dispersed, Hagon's Divine Soul would completely collapse.
Hagon had not cultivated the Moonlight Technique and could not peer into his Sea of Consciousness, but his body's reactions made him aware of the grim situation.
"The Killing Aura can't be expelled, can it?" Hagon's gaze turned from initially fervent to gradually cool as he calmly inquired.
Hearing these words, Tuya's mother's face instantly paled.
Yuan Ming's expression was heavy, but he said nothing.
He indeed was at a loss at this moment.
"Lord Yuan Ming, please save my husband's life at all costs. You can even take my own life in exchange!" Tuya's mother begged Yuan Ming without stopping.
"Please…" Tuya also pleaded.
Yuan Ming didn't respond to either of them but looked around instead.
Having embarked on the path of cultivation not long ago, his experience was limited, and so was his power. He was eager to help but powerless; the only one who might be capable of saving Hagon now was the silver cat, if it had followed them.
The surrounding area was as tranquil as before, with only the sounds of birds chirping and the wind blowing. Beyond that, there were no other signs of life.
Yuan Ming sighed inwardly; even if the silver cat was nearby, with this lack of reaction, it clearly did not wish to get involved.
"Life and death are predestined; don't trouble Brother Yuan Ming," Hagon said, closing his eyes. When he opened them again, they were unnaturally calm as he spoke solemnly to his wife and daughter.
Tuya's mother and daughter stopped begging and were frozen in place.
"Brother Hagon, my strength is still insufficient. I'm afraid I can't save you today," regret flickered in Yuan Ming's eyes.
"Why would you say such a thing, Brother Yuan Ming? You have helped me regain my senses, allowing me to say farewell to my wife and daughter. That alone is already a tremendous grace, not to mention that you openly defied Biluo Cave's orders to save Tuya and the others. I am not a person who covets more than what's given; how could I ask for more?" Hagon laughed heartily.
"Brother Hagon, do you have any unfulfilled wishes? As long as it is within my ability, I will surely help you fulfill them," Yuan Ming still felt deeply troubled as he asked.
Just as Hagon was about to respond to Yuan Ming's offer, his entire body suddenly froze; his mouth remained open as the Blood Chain on his Divine Soul trembled incessantly.
A layer of Blood Light rose in his Sea of Consciousness and the blood color in his eyes spread rapidly.
Yuan Ming's expression changed drastically. He quickly released two soul crows to scout the surroundings, while once again activating the black grindstones at full force to suppress the Blood Chain.
But his Soul Power had been greatly depleted, and even using the Beast Taming Technique at full strength, he could no longer suppress the Blood Chain.
"Brother Yuan… please take care of Tuya and her mother…" Hagon's eyes were mostly blood-colored now, his rationality on the verge of falling, as he spoke with difficulty.
After he finished speaking, his hands harshly grasped his own neck and head.
"Brother Hagon, you…" Yuan Ming realized what Hagon intended to do and instinctively tried to stop him.
Hagon looked at him, a resolute light shining through the clarity that remained in his eyes.
Yuan Ming's arm lifted in response stiffened, and the next moment, he flashed beside Tuya, covering her eyes with his hand.
Hagon's face showed gratitude, and he suddenly exerted force with both arms.
Crack!
His neck twisted at an odd angle, the divine luster and Blood Light in his eyes completely dissipated, and he lost all strength, hanging lifelessly inside the Wood Prison.
"Husband…" Tuya's mother cried out in anguish.
"Mother, what happened to father?" Tuya struggled to pry Yuan Ming's arm away, crying and asking.
Yuan Ming did not let go, instead gently chopping Tuya on the neck.
Tuya's body went limp, her head drooped, and she fainted.

chapters.title: Chapter 134 - 114: Risking One's Life
chapters.content:
"What are you doing?" Tuya's mother saw Tuya fall unconscious and, disregarding her husband's death, rushed over.
"Someone is coming. If you want your daughter to live, keep quiet!" Yuan Ming stretched out his arm and pressed Tuya's mother to the ground.
Tuya's mother's eyes widened, and she dared not speak again.
With one hand under each, Yuan Ming picked up Tuya and her mother. A green light flickered across his chest as he levitated and flew off into the distance, disappearing into the jungle in the blink of an eye.
As Yuan Ming departed, the vine prison around Hagon was released, and the Purple-Black Demon Vine retracted into the ground, vanishing without a trace.
Hagon's body, no longer supported, fell to the ground with a "bang."
Shortly after Yuan Ming and the others had left, several figures flew swiftly from afar, arriving quickly at the scene. It was Kun Tu, Hu Huo, and Wulu.
Kun Tu and Wulu mounted the Green Wolf Spirit Beast, leading and following respectively, while Hu Huo did not summon the Green Falcon and walked on foot.
Seeing Hagon's body, Hu Huo's expression darkened, although he had sensed it beforehand.
He had long sensed through a secret technique in Hagon's Sea of Consciousness that Yuan Ming was here. Yet, given Yuan Ming's formidable strength and cunning methods, Hu Huo, having suffered losses before, dared not face him alone.
He had coincidentally encountered Kun Tu and Wulu in the mountains and followed them here, only to be slightly delayed. By this time, Yuan Ming had already killed Hagon and vanished again.
"Yuan Ming had close ties with Hagon, but I can't believe he actually went through with it. It seems I need to reassess his character," Hu Huo thought to himself.
"Hu Huo, weren't you confidently claiming Yuan Ming was right here? Where is he?" Kun Tu cast a glance at Hagon's body before looking away and demanded angrily.
"Yuan Ming was indeed here not long ago. He must have sensed our approach and fled. This guy is quite cautious. However, since he withdrew hastily, he most likely has left some traces that would give away his direction," Hu Huo explained with a sheepish smile instead of showing anger.
"Oh, really? Then would you, Elder, please take a look? After all, this young man was once under your charge; you should know him quite well," Kun Tu said, stretching the word "elder" with a taunting tone.
An expression of rage flashed through Hu Huo's eyes but he suppressed it and started searching the area. Soon, he found Yuan Ming's footprints near Hagon's body and began to trace them.
However, while there were footprints of his arrival, there was no trace of where he had gone, as if he had vanished into thin air.
"So, did you find any trace of that Beast Slave?" Kun Tu walked over slowly.
"That guy seems to have tamed some kind of avian spirit beast and escaped flying with it," said Hu Huo, his expression fluctuating between light and shadow before settling.
"When it comes to avian spirit beasts, few can match your Green Falcon, right? It would be good if you could trace him a bit," Kun Tu said.
"Of course. But Yuan Ming has improved vastly; I alone might not be a match for him. Once there, I will signal with fireworks; you two must come quickly," Hu Huo proposed accommodatingly.
"This young man and I have irreconcilable differences; did you really need to mention it?" Kun Tu huffed, clearly annoyed.
"Alright, I'll go first then," Hu Huo nodded and bowed, waving his hand to summon the Green Falcon and soared into the sky.
"Just a mere Beast Slave Hall deacon, getting called 'Elder' by a few Beast Slaves, and he starts forgetting his place," Kun Tu spat on the ground contemptuously.
"Brother Kun Tu, Hu Huo is still a deacon, and he does have connections in the Beast Slave Hall. It seems unnecessary to undermine him so; if he gets infuriated, it's not going to be good," Wulu interjected cautiously.
"Not only does he have vulnerabilities that I hold, but he also needs something from me. Does he dare defy the heavens? I just can't stand his usual behavior!" Kun Tu replied coldly.
"Yes. So, what's our next move?" Wulu asked.
"Although Hu Huo is incompetent, his Green Falcon does have methods for tracking. We'll just follow him. It's a good chance to let him take the lead and test Yuan Ming. This youngster has advanced too quickly since his initiation; I want to see what secrets he harbors," Kun Tu said with a smile.
"Brother, that's wise," Wulu praised.
Kun Tu smirked in satisfaction and led Wulu in the direction of Hu Huo's flying escape.
Yuan Ming, carrying Tuya and her mother, flew several miles. Mana consumption was significant, and they landed in a secluded part of the forest.
"Hide yourselves in there and make no sound. Wait until I return," Yuan Ming directed them to a dense thicket nearby.
Tuya's mother nodded repeatedly and helped the weakened Tuya crawl inside.
Yuan Ming didn't linger; he stood up and ran forward.
Although he had used the Mysterious Incense Burner to escape through the air for a distance, Kun Tu and the others were skilled and would soon catch up. Continuing with Tuya and her mother would only increase the risk.
It was a risk, but leaving the two women here was relatively the safest option for now.
As he ran, Yuan Ming released a Soul Crow to scout the area and took out a green Crystal Stone, holding it in his palm. It was a Wood Attribute Spirit Stone he had obtained from Qingfu Hall in exchange for a Fire Attribute Spirit Stone he had acquired from Mist Island.
The pure spiritual power from the Spirit Stone flowed into him, rapidly restoring the nearly depleted Mana in his Dantian.
"The Spirit Stone is effective in restoring Mana, but unfortunately, I can't use it freely," he muttered regretfully, quickening his pace. He hadn't gone far when he furrowed his brow slightly.
The Soul Crow he had sent to scout had spotted Hu Huo, who was flying rapidly closer on his Green Falcon.
Hu Huo had also pinpointed Yuan Ming's general location and immediately sent a fireworks signal into the sky before continuing the chase on the Green Falcon.
Yuan Ming immediately used the Shadowless Step and sped toward a grove of trees ahead.
Although his Shadowless Step was fast, it was still substantially slower compared to the Green Falcon, and he was soon overtaken.
Elder Hu Huo maneuvered the Green Falcon directly over Yuan Ming's head, then suddenly turned, flapping its wings vigorously downwards.
A sudden gust of wind arose, sweeping across the area, causing trees to sway wildly and sand and stones to scatter.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming did not retreat but advanced, plunging headfirst into the fierce wind. With each step, he forcefully stabbed his feet into the ground, and although his speed was slightly slower, he was hardly affected by the wind.
Elder Hu Huo frowned and controlled the Green Falcon to maintain a certain distance from Yuan Ming, while swinging his hands in the void. Several green Wind Blades howled out, shooting towards Yuan Ming, and at the same time, he glanced anxiously in the direction from which they had come, clearly waiting for Kun Tu and the others to arrive.
Yuan Ming skillfully dodged the attacks of the Wind Blades, his forward speed only slightly affected.
Seeing this, Elder Hu Huo's figure abruptly leaped from the back of the Green Falcon, landing on a nearby large tree, and raised one hand.
The Green Falcon dove at Yuan Ming, its wings suddenly erect, almost closing together, resembling a giant green arrow that instantly reached in front of Yuan Ming. Its iron claws, accompanied by a ferociously sharp wind, aimed for Yuan Ming's head.
The might of this claw was such that even an Iron Man's head could be cracked open.
"Perfect timing!" Yuan Ming shouted softly and raised his hand upward.
A red shadow flashed above his head, and a large red hammer appeared out of nowhere, spinning as it struck the Green Falcon. It was the hammer he had obtained from Mist Island.
The Green Falcon had not expected this change and it was too late to retract its claws, which fiercely grabbed onto the red hammer.
With a loud, piercing "bang," the red hammer was knocked away, showing a few claw marks on its surface, though not deep and seemingly not a major issue.
The Green Falcon's claws were shattered, and blood gushed out. Its pouncing figure skewed sideways and with a "bang," it crashed into a large tree.
Before it could stabilize itself, a sharp whistle came from the side, and a green treasure sword shot out from the woods, heading straight for the Green Falcon's chest, which was the Green Fish Sword.
"You dare to injure my spirit beast!"
Elder Hu Huo shouted loudly, and with a slap on his waist, a small, triangular red flag appeared in his palm, embroidered with a gold three-legged toad, the same Magic Artifact previously used to chase Yuan Ming.
He grasped the triangular flag and waved it forward.
The golden toad on the triangular flag seemed to come to life, opening its mouth to spit something.
In an instant, a surge of gold and red flames burst forth, crossing a distance of several dozen meters in a flash, striking the green treasure sword and easily knocking it away.
Elder Hu Huo quietly breathed a sigh of relief, but he did not plan to engage Yuan Ming in close combat. Instead, he intended to activate the triangular flag again to harass Yuan Ming while waiting for Kun Tu and the others to arrive.
Suddenly, from the dark shadows of the nearby jungle, a soul crow shot out without warning and collided directly with his face.
"What is this!" Elder Hu Huo exclaimed, hastily dodging to the side.
But just then, another soul crow, like lightning, smashed into him from the direction he was dodging toward.
This time he failed to avoid it and was hit head-on.
The soul crow entered Elder Hu Huo's Sea of Consciousness and fiercely struck his Divine Soul, exploding loudly.
"Ah!"
With his Divine Soul severely damaged, Elder Hu Huo clutched his head and screamed in agony. The triangular flag slipped from his palm, and he fell from the tree, landing heavily on the ground.
With a "crack" sound, his calf bone broke.
Elder Hu Huo's cultivation was profound, and his Divine Soul was much stronger than Hagon's. Stimulated by the pain of the broken bone, his consciousness miraculously recovered.

Not far from a large tree, Yuan Ming's face showed surprise.
It seemed that pain could stimulate and help an enemy recover from the impact of soul collision. He would need to be careful about this in future battles.
"Kun Tu, save me!"
Elder Hu Huo's consciousness had just recovered when he shouted loudly, attempting to sit up. Suddenly, the ground beside him cracked open, and a Purple-Black Demon Vine shot out.
With a "pfft" sound, the Demon Vine pierced Elder Hu Huo's throat, penetrating his neck.
Elder Hu Huo spat out a large mouthful of blood, his mouth wide open as if trying to say something, but the light quickly faded from his eyes, and his body flopped down to the ground, turning into a corpse.
The Green Falcon had just stabilized itself and was about to come to his aid when Elder Hu Huo had already fallen. Suddenly, a ring of black light appeared on the Green Falcon's head, and several fist-sized black runes danced within it before silently dissipating.
The Green Falcon paused, taking a few breaths to recover before a gleam of joy appeared in its eyes.
The secret technique that had long imprisoned its Divine Soul was lifted. Although it had caused some damage to its Divine Soul, compared to regaining its freedom, that was negligible.
The Green Falcon did not even glance at Elder Hu Huo's body and turned to fly away, flapping its wings.
Yuan Ming breathed a sigh of relief and leaned against the tree trunk, slowly sitting down.
The attacks seemed ordinary, but he had actually exerted his full strength, even using himself as bait, otherwise, he would not have been able to kill Elder Hu Huo in one go.
He knew that the enemy outnumbered him, and if he could not take advantage of their separation to defeat them one by one, once they gathered together, he would be the one in trouble.

chapters.title: Chapter 135 - 115: On the Brink
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming's mana in his Dantian was almost depleted, and the White Ape Transformation deactivated automatically, the White Ape Skin fell to the ground.
His soul power was only a third remaining; standing felt exhausting, and he wished he could collapse and sleep for three days.
However, he knew now was not the time to rest; Hu Huo's recent shout had made the situation clear enough. Kun Tu and the others might be nearby, and he had to leave quickly.
Biting his tongue tip, he stimulated his spirit with pain, picked up the White Ape Skin, and without even searching Hu Huo's body, he turned and fled, clutching a Wood Attribute Spirit Stone in his hand hidden within his sleeve, absorbing its power furiously without minding the pain.
He hadn't run far when a "whizzing" sound burst forth loudly.
A dense barrage of Wind Blades suddenly shot out from the forest in front, pouring down on his body like a torrential rain.
Yuan Ming's expression drastically changed, and he hurriedly used the remaining mana to execute the Shadowless Step. His figure blurred, moving two zhang to the side out of thin air, barely dodging the assault of the Wind Blade rain.
However, within the dense Wind Blades, two crescent-like peculiar Wind Blades suddenly changed direction, heading towards Yuan Ming's evasive direction, each slicing towards his legs.
Yuan Ming's temples throbbed as he immediately mobilized the last of his mana, activating the Mysterious Incense Burner hidden in his chest. He levitated half a zhang high, dodging the crescent Wind Blade's attack.
The Crescent Wind Blades did not turn again and instead chopped into the ground, "pu chi," burying into it.
Yuan Ming stopped activating the incense burner and staggered to the ground, gasping heavily.
Clap, clap, clap!
Crisp clapping sounds came from the forest as Kun Tu walked out slowly with a smile on his face.
The Green Wolf Spirit Beast followed closely behind him, its ferocious eyes intently fixated on Yuan Ming, seemingly annoyed that he had dodged its attack.
"To evade my spirit beast's chained attacks under such condition, not bad, truly not bad," Kun Tu said, clapping and laughing.
"Kun Tu, it seems you've been nearby all along," Yuan Ming narrowed his eyes.
"Haha, of course I've been here for a while, just wanted to see what new capabilities you have now. Now that your mana is nearly exhausted, why not kneel and beg for mercy? If I'm in a good mood, I might even let you keep your whole corpse," Kun Tu laughed proudly.
"If you want my life, you can try to take it," Yuan Ming provocatively gestured to Kun Tu with a crook of his finger.
On hearing these words from Yuan Ming, Kun Tu's brow slightly furrowed.Chapter provided via *.
He had witnessed Yuan Ming killing Hu Huo right on the spot and did not have full confidence that Yuan Ming's mana was truly exhausted. With his opponent appearing extremely confident, he began to hesitate.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming inwardly breathed a sigh of relief, but his face still held a cold smirk as he continued to draw in spiritual power from the spirit stone, trying to recover some mana.
"Right, where's Wu Lu? Isn't he always following Kun Tu? Could it be he's plotting something in secret?" He suddenly remembered something, thinking to himself.
Just then, footsteps emanated from the jungle behind Kun Tu, and three figures walked out gently.
The leading person was indeed Wu Lu, his hands holding a rope, the other end tied to the wrists of two women—it was Tuya and her daughter.
Yuan Ming's eyes darkened, his fists clenched tighter.
"Wu Lu, did you really have to split up from me just to capture these two mortals?" Kun Tu frowned and asked.
"Elder brother sees clearly, these two are not trivial mortals; they are very useful," Wu Lu responded.
"Useful? What use?" Kun Tu asked curiously.
"When I was a Fur Beast Slave in the Ten Thousand Mountains, I had some interactions with Hagon and heard some of his stories. This Miao Hua Village is Hagon's hometown, and Hagon and Brother Yuan Ming are quite close friends, having shared many hardships, right?" Wu Lu turned his head towards Yuan Ming, a smile forming at the edge of his mouth.
"I don't know what you're talking about; Hagon and I barely know each other," Yuan Ming said impassively, his heart secretly cursing his luck.
"Hehe, this little girl just confessed everything. They are indeed Hagon's wife and daughter. You even killed Hu Zha, breaking the sect rules, and just now you greatly depleted your primordial qi in an attempt to restore Hagon's sanity. Brother Yuan Ming, the changes in you are truly beyond my expectations; even a thoroughly beast-transformed Human Demon is saved by you, impressive," Wu Lu said with a faint smile.
Kun Tu, hearing this, finally understood and was thrilled, "Great! Wu Lu, well done. When we return to Biluo Cave, I will definitely reward you heavily."
"I wondered why you would suddenly go mad and kill Hu Zha; it turns out it was for such a foolish reason," Kun Tu then looked at Yuan Ming, laughing heartily.
"Even if they are Hagon's wife and daughter, do you think I would sacrifice my bright future and even my life for two strangers?" Yuan Ming scoffed coldly.
Kun Tu's smile froze slightly; indeed, he would never do something so foolish.
"If Brother Yuan Ming truly doesn't care about their lives, why not leave immediately instead of hanging around and chatting with us?" Wu Lu said with a smile.
"Brother Wu Lu just reminded me, I indeed have other matters to tend to. I'll take my leave now. Their lives, you may do as you please," Yuan Ming replied with a faint smile, turning to walk away.
Upon seeing this, despair flashed across the faces of Tuya and her daughter.
"You really going to ignore their welfare? Very well, Wu Lu, kill the woman; let's keep the little one. My Yin Ghost Flag hasn't been nourished for a while, and later we'll use the girl's essence blood for the sacrificial flag," Kun Tu sneered.
"Yes!" Wu Lu pulled out a curved knife from his waist without hesitation and swung it towards the neck of Tuya's mother.
Suddenly, a purple-black Vine shot out from the ground by Wu Lu's feet, wrapping around his arm and the curved knife, causing the blade's trajectory to skew.
Four streams of black liquid shot out from the nearby grass, speeding toward Wu Lu like powerful crossbow bolts.
Wu Lu was inwardly shocked and struggled to pull back his arm.
However, the purple-black demon vine tightly bound his arm as if it had grown there, making it impossible to move.
A foul wind blew, and several streams of black liquid had already reached Wu Lu.
The black poison liquid did not strike in one place but from above, below, left, and right, with exceedingly tricky angles. If Wu Lu could not break free from the demon vine, he would be hit no matter which direction he dodged.
Wu Lu's left hand, hidden in his sleeve, moved slightly as if he had done something, and suddenly a deep blue light shield appeared in front of him.
The black poison liquid hit it, sizzling on contact and pitting the blue light shield, but ultimately it was blocked.
"Haha, I knew you would make a move, meet your fate!" Kun Tu saw Yuan Ming act and was not startled but pleased. He laughed loudly and brandished a black flag vigorously.
A tangible black Yin wind surged from the flag, immediately whipping up fierce winds and rapidly dropping the temperature.
Yet Yuan Ming ignored Kun Tu and formed a hand seal toward Wu Lu.
"To ignore me is seeking death!" Seeing Yuan Ming disregard him, Kun Tu flew into a rage and furiously shook the Yin Ghost Flag a few times.
The flag radiated black light, and the surrounding Yin wind congregated into a two to three yards long black Wind Dragon that lunged toward Yuan Ming with bared fangs and claws.
Just at that moment, a black shadow flashed through the bushes beside Kun Tu and a black raven suddenly flew out, heading straight for Kun Tu's face—it was Yuan Ming's last Divine Soul Raven.
"What is that?" Kun Tu dared not be careless and dodged to the side, guiding the Yin Ghost Flag.
The black Wind Dragon that was attacking Yuan Ming instantly changed direction and collided with the raven.
The black raven was not very fast, but it was small and nimble. It barely dodged the black Wind Dragon's attack and once again lunged at Kun Tu, entangling him so that he could not split his attention.
Having seen Yuan Ming forming a hand seal previously, Wu Lu quickly concentrated and braced himself, forcefully maintaining the light shield in front of him.
The sizzling sound of corrosion came, and the demon vine wrapped around his arm secreted black poison liquid, easily corroding the fabric of his sleeves and contaminating his skin.
Wu Lu's skin instantly ulcerated, and the underlying flesh rapidly dissolved, revealing ghastly white bones in many places.
"Ah!" A chill ran down Wu Lu's heart. A layer of blue light emerged on his arm, trying to block the invasion of the demon vine's poison liquid, but it was not very effective.
While Yuan Ming controlled the black raven to entangle Kun Tu, he also summoned up a bit of mana he had just accumulated and activated the Beast Taming Technique to control the purple-black demon vine.
The tip of the demon vine sharpened, and a faint blood light appeared around it like a snake darting out of its hole, stabbing into Wu Lu's chest.
Given the current situation, his mana was about to be exhausted, putting him at a tremendous disadvantage. He had only a chance to win if he could kill one of his opponents as quickly as lightning.
Just then, the forest behind Yuan Ming exploded with a "boom," a violent wind shredding branches and dry leaves. Kun Tu's Green Wolf Spirit Beast lunged out, attacking Yuan Ming's back with its claws.
Yuan Ming startled, rushed to dodge to the side using the Shadowless Step.
His mana was already exhausted, making his movements slow. He barely avoided a deadly blow, but his arm was still slashed, revealing deep, bone-showing wounds as he staggered backward.
The Green Wolf Spirit Beast, seizing the advantage, opened its mouth and shot out four or five green Wind Blades spinning toward Yuan Ming's body.
Yuan Ming's face turned ashen. With his still functioning right hand, he drew out the Green Fish Sword and swung wildly to fend off the Wind Blades.
"Dang dang dang" Several harsh clashes later, a few Wind Blades were deflected, and Yuan Ming, along with his sword, was thrown backward, crashing heavily into a large tree, spurting a mouthful of fresh blood.
After suffering continuous severe injuries, Yuan Ming could not focus on anything else. The influence on the purple-black demon vine was minimal, but the black raven controlled by his divine soul suddenly went sluggish.
"Go!"
Seizing the opportunity, Kun Tu pointed with the Yin Ghost Flag, and a crescent-shaped black Wind Blade shot out from the tip of the flag at an astonishing speed, crossing a distance of several yards in a flash and striking the black raven.
With a light "tsk," half of the black raven's body was sheared off.
The black Wind Dragon opened its great maw and clamped onto the black raven, unleashing a dozen or so savage, fierce black Wind Blades inside its mouth.
How could the black raven withstand such an assault? Its body instantly dispersed.
This left Yuan Ming completely drained of both mana and divine soul power, overwhelmed by an irresistible fatigue.
"Haha, Yuan Ming, just give yourself up to my sacrificial flag!" Kun Tu laughed loudly as he waved the Yin Ghost Flag.
The black Wind Dragon surged forward with bared fangs and claws, shooting straight for Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming's expression changed as he tried to dodge, but his legs felt like they were filled with lead, not moving an inch.
The black Wind Dragon arrived in an instant, striking him hard in the chest.
Yuan Ming was sent flying, blood spewing from his mouth, his internal organs nearly displacing. He crashed to the ground and lay motionless.

chapters.title: Chapter 136 - 116: Is My Slash Beautiful?
chapters.content:
"If you don't take action now, I might just die." Yuan Ming lay on the ground, his chest heaving as he spoke in a low voice.
"All along this journey, you've been playing the hero. Now you remember me? If there's anything good later, I get first pick." A pleasant voice echoed in his mind, filled with an unmistakable gloating delight.
"A mere Fur Beast Slave dares to challenge me? Utterly oblivious of death." Kun Tu sneered as he walked toward Yuan Ming, preparing to deliver a fatal blow.
But just then, an unexpected change occurred!
The black light on the Yin Ghost Flag he held in his hand suddenly surged uncontrollably. The pattern of a blood-colored skull seemed as if it came to life, writhing into motion. A powerful surge of Yin Evil Power transmitted through it, reversing and invading Kun Tu's body, causing him to feel numbness in half of his body, turning his complexion deathly pale.
Chilled to the bone, he subconsciously thought of something and flung the Yin Ghost Flag he held as if it were a snake or scorpion.
The material of the Yin Ghost Flag was special and the runes used on it were extraordinary. The combination of the two allowed the Yin Ghost Flag to not only launch powerful yin attribute attacks but also to devour other living beings to nourish itself—what Kun Tu had previously referred to as a Sacrificial Flag.
After a great deal of Blood Sacrifice, the Yin Qi within the Yin Ghost Flag had greatly increased, and so had its power. However, such yin attribute Magic Artifacts also had a significant flaw: every once in a while, the Yin Power within the flag would slowly seep out and backlash against the owner. It could be controlled as long as it was properly suppressed.
Yet, this time, the anomaly occurred suddenly without any warning and before its time, truly catching him off guard. Although Kun Tu had thrown away the Yin Ghost Flag in time, he was still eroded by the Yin Qi invading his body, stiffening his limbs. He hastily took out a fiery red elixir to swallow, and without giving Yuan Ming a second thought, he sat down cross-legged and began Cultivating.
Without Kun Tu's Mana to sustain it, the Yin Ghost Flag returned to its normal state after falling to the ground; the blood-colored skull on its surface ceased its movements and returned to stillness.
The Green Wolf Spirit Beast that belonged to him ran over to act as his protector.
At the same time, on the other side, the Purple-Black Demon Vine that had been entangling Wu Lu suddenly stopped, and the next moment it rapidly retracted, "whooshing" as it drilled back into the ground, disappearing from sight.
Wu Lu, now free from entanglement, shot a quick glance at Kun Tu then shifted his gaze toward Yuan Ming lying on the ground, his eyes filled with shock and suspicion. His left hand swiftly took out a medicine bottle to clean his right arm, applied medicine, and finally wrapped it in a white cloth. Only then did the piercing pain start to subside.
Kun Tu soon recovered. Although cautious, he reached out to grab the Yin Ghost Flag from the ground and hurriedly stowed it away without examining it.
"Are you alright?" Wu Lu, disregarding the opportunity to strike at Yuan Ming, quickly walked over to Kun Tu and asked with concern.
"Of course, it's nothing. Go kill that guy. I'll reward you handsomely when we get back," Kun Tu said slowly as he straightened up, shaking his head nonchalantly.
Wu Lu, with a sharp mind, noticed something amiss in Kun Tu's demeanor. The real situation was probably not as casual as Kun Tu claimed. It seemed obvious to Wu Lu that Yuan Ming had somehow caused the Yin Ghost Flag to backfire on its owner.
Indeed, as Wu Lu had guessed, Kun Tu was feeling a numbing soreness in half of his body. For some reason, the backlash from the Yin Ghost Flag this time was severe. Even though he had expelled some of the invading Yin Qi with the help of the elixir, a great deal still infiltrated deep into his meridians. No matter how hard he tried, he couldn't force it out, his Mana seemingly sealed, a heavy internal injury like he had never experienced before. He could only wait to return to the Sect and seek help from his master.
"As you command," Wu Lu said respectfully. He bowed to Kun Tu, and possibly due to his recent injury, he stumbled and fell next to Kun Tu, rolling a bit further away.
Kun Tu turned to check on him.
"Puchi" went the sound.
A gleaming blade light suddenly blossomed, piercing into Kun Tu's back and exiting through his chest.
Blood gushed from Kun Tu's mouth, his face filled with incredible disbelief.
After all, he was an Inner Sect Disciple of the Biluo Cave, exceptional in both disposition and aptitude. The moment the blade entered his body, he exerted all his strength to avoid his heart and other vital organs and immediately swung his hand backward.
A gust of Yin Wind struck Wu Lu, sending him flying several yards away, crashing into a thicket of grass.
Kun Tu spat out a mouthful of blood, picked up the Yin Ghost Flag, but unfortunately, his heart and lungs had been pierced through, and his strength was rapidly draining away.
The Green Wolf Spirit Beast, which had initially been stunned, now reacted with a roar and pounced toward Wu Lu.
Wu Lu shot out a pill, hitting the wolf squarely on the nose. The medicine pill exploded with a loud bang, turning into a cloud of yellow smoke with an extremely pungent odor. The Green Wolf howled miserably, its body trembling uncontrollably, and then it slowly collapsed to the ground.Chapter source: My Virtual Library Empire (*).
Wu Lu slowly stood up from the thicket, strode over to the Green Wolf, and with a swift motion of his knife, he severed the wolf's head. His chest was torn open, and blood trickled from the corner of his mouth, but his expression was very relaxed.
"Have you lost your mind?" Kun Tu stared at Wu Lu, asking with difficulty.
"For a petty person like you, only when you're seriously injured do you think of rewarding me. Why don't you stand up and try it now?" Wu Lu said mockingly.
