Yuan Ming was startled, these two turned out to be acquaintances, one was Zhao Tong, and the other was the short and chubby young man he had met before at Qingyan Pavilion, the master of bargaining.
"How did they come together?" Yuan Ming felt strange, then suddenly remembered he had taken off his conical hat for convenience while eating, and grabbed it to put back on.
"Yo, Brother Yuan! What are you doing here?" Zhao Tong's eyes were sharp, and he immediately saw Yuan Ming, greeted him from afar, and walked over with the short and chubby young man.Spotanerror?VisittheoriginalpostonM&VLEMPY&R.
"Heard this place was bustling recently, came to take a look and see if I could find some treasures. What about you, Brother Zhao?" Yuan Ming, realizing he couldn't hide, quietly put away his hat and stood up to welcome them.
"Oh, don't mention it. Made a mistake a few days ago, and the Sect demoted me here to take care of Biluo Shop's business for half a year," Zhao Tong sighed.
"I always felt Brother Zhao had a knack for business. Now the business at Biluo Shop will probably prosper even more. By the way, who is this?" Yuan Ming blinked and looked towards the short and chubby youth.
"Forgot to introduce him, this is Fellow Daoist Gu Yue, an old friend of mine from Black Rock City. Old Gu, this is Yuan Ming, my fellow Sect brother; I've mentioned him to you before, the master of saving money, you two should get closer." Zhao Tong casually introduced the two, unceremoniously sat down, and began enjoying Yuan Ming's food and drinks.
"So, it turns out you are Yuan Ming. We seem to have met before at Qingyan Pavilion," Gu Yue said smilingly after sizing up Yuan Ming.
"Fellow Daoist Gu Yue has good eyes, recognizing me even with a hat on, admirable. Please, have a seat," Yuan Ming also said with a slight smile.
"What? You've met before?" Zhao Tong swallowed a big bite of food, cheeks puffed, as he spoke.
"We met at Qingyan Pavilion. Brother Gu Yue's bargaining skills are commendable; I quite admire them," Yuan Ming did not hide the fact.
"A mere trifle, hardly worth mentioning," Gu Yue said with a wave of his hand.
"Old Gu is an informant in Black Rock City, living off his mouth, of course, his eloquence is unmatched, I admit I'm inferior to him," Zhao Tong laughed, apparently having a good relationship with Gu Yue.
"An informant?" Yuan Ming was taken aback.
"It seems like it's Brother Yuan's first time in Black Rock City. The workshops and shops here are plentiful, visitors come from all over, and newcomers can't get their bearings in three to five days. Informants like Old Gu have been mingling in Black Rock City for years, mainly hired by those who are here for the first time to inquire about news, look for items, and so on," Zhao Tong explained.
Hearing this, Yuan Ming's mind was suddenly stirred.
"Brother Yuan Ming, have you found what you needed? If not, you can ask Old Gu to help you look," Zhao Tong said.
"Not yet, I wonder if Fellow Daoist Gu Yue might be free?" Yuan Ming seized the opportunity to ask, looking towards Gu Yue. He was quite in the dark about Black Rock City Market, and his chances of blindly finding Frost Spiritual Material in the afternoon were truly slim; it might be better to hire Gu Yue for assistance.
Since Zhao Tong was acquainted with Gu Yue, and with that relationship, Gu Yue should be trustworthy.
"If Brother Yuan has a request, naturally I have the time," Gu Yue happily agreed.
"Since you two have business to discuss, I shall not stay any longer," Zhao Tong stood up, wiped his mouth, and said.
"My matter isn't urgent; if you both have important things to do, you can go ahead," Yuan Ming said.
"We don't have anything special, just came here to drink and catch up. You two talk slowly," Zhao Tong laughed heartily and took his leave.
"Whatever you need, Brother Yuan, just say it. I dare not boast, but when it comes to various types of merchandise and information in this city, I do have some connections," Gu Yue said.
"I need Frost Attribute Spiritual Materials, the higher the quality the better, mid-grade would be best," Yuan Ming probed.
"Frost Spiritual Materials are rare to begin with, and those above mid-grade are even harder to find. But now that you're in Black Rock City and have found me, it's not entirely impossible," Gu Yue said, eyes narrowing before breaking into a smile.
"Well then, I'll leave this matter in your hands. How much do you charge for your service?" Yuan Ming inquired.
"One Spirit Stone per day will do," Gu Yue replied.
"Then help me look for one day," Yuan Ming said reluctantly, taking out a Spirit Stone, ready to toss it over.
"If you don't find it, you'll have to return this Spirit Stone," Yuan Ming thought for a moment, pulled back his hand gripping the Spirit Stone, and said.
He seemed to have plenty of Spirit Stones, but the items he wanted to buy were expensive, and he had to be careful with each one.
"Deal, Brother Yuan, please follow me," Gu Yue took the Spirit Stone and left the tavern.
"Where to?" Yuan Ming followed.
"If it's for mid-grade Frost Spiritual Material, it's almost impossible to find it here in the West Market; we have to look in some large shops in the East Market," Gu Yue said.
"East Market, West Market?" Yuan Ming was taken aback.
"Black Rock City is large, but the layout is simple, divided into East, West, South, and North; we are currently in the West Market. Shops set up by powers from the Southern Border and Northern Territory are here, while the East Market is where shops from the Southern Border Southern Domain, Eastern Domain, and Central Plains Da Jin Country are located," Gu Yue explained matter-of-factly.
Yuan Ming listened, nodding thoughtfully.
He had heard of the Southern Border Southern Domain, Eastern Domain, and other places but never had the chance to encounter them. He didn't expect that the city would have shops from those regions, and he might indeed broaden his horizons shortly.
It really was a good decision to come to Black Rock City.

chapters.title: Chapter 164 - 144 Wonders abound
chapters.content:
"Which shops in the East Market might have the spiritual materials I need?" Yuan Ming casually asked.
"The availability of spiritual materials is highly fluid, especially with the upcoming alliance at White Deer Hill which attracts cultivators from all around, even more so than before. However, the Southern Domain is far richer than our Northern Territory, and the Central Plains Da Jin is the Heavenly Dynasty. If there's a place in Black Rock City where Fellow Daoist might find the needed spiritual materials, it would only be the East Market," Gu Yue explained with a smile.
"Mm, there's some sense in what you've said, I'll head over and take a look first. What about the South and North Markets?" Yuan Ming nodded and asked further.
"The South Market is a gathering place for the Scatter Alliance. As for the North Market, it is the smallest in area, located where the City Lord Mansion is. Except for those associated with the City Lord Mansion, no one else is allowed near there," Gu Yue said.
"What exactly is the Scatter Alliance?" Yuan Ming didn't feign understanding and asked straightforwardly.
"Fellow Daoist doesn't know about the Scatter Alliance? You sect-supported cultivators really don't know the hardships of us Loose Cultivators! The so-called Scatter Alliance consists of various groups formed by Loose Cultivators, who mostly undertake various tasks for rewards," Gu Yue said with a surprised look and a light sigh.
Yuan Ming had previously learned from chatting with Zhao Tong and from some Strange Stories in the Gui Cang Pavilion that the power structure in the Cultivation World mainly revolves around Sects and Cultivation Families, naturally varying widely in strength. Overall, these are considered mainstream forces.
The descendants of Cultivation Families generally have a higher probability of possessing a Spirit Root and better cultivation resource support than ordinary commoners. Moreover, these families often have intricate connections with Sects, such as a Family Clan Leader who is also an elder in a Sect, and some core family disciples directly qualify to become Inner Sect Disciples.
As for the majority in the Cultivation World, the Loose Cultivators, some come from declining Cultivation Families, and others are ordinary people who stumble upon various opportunities to step into the world of cultivation. Yuan Ming belonged to the latter.
Thus, it was no surprise that most Loose Cultivators, often of average talent, were like rootless duckweeds in the vast Cultivation World, unsupported and generally struggling to advance beyond the Qi Refinement Realm if without special opportunities, thus naturally choosing to band together.
"How many Scatter Alliances are there in the South Market?" Yuan Ming thought for a moment, then asked.
"Quite a few, most are ordinary alliances consisting of Qi Refining Stage Cultivators. There are only two or three alliances with a Foundation Establishment presence. If Fellow Daoist is interested, you might consider visiting there," Gu Yue suggested.
"We'll see," Yuan Ming was noncommittal.
Right now, his main concern was how to quickly refine his Green Fish Sword into a Magic Artifact; he couldn't be bothered with other matters.
As the two chatted, they soon exited the West Market.
An expansive circular square appeared in front, laid with neatly arranged large slabs of Black Stone, looking quite tidy.
There were no shops in the square, only small stalls everywhere. Some used wooden boards to set up a rudimentary counter; most simply placed their wares directly on the ground.
Many cultivators moved about the square searching for items, making it a bustling hub of noise, even busier than the larger shops in the West Market.
"This is Black Rock Square, the central area. The City Lord specifically designated this area for Loose Cultivators to set up their stalls," Gu Yue explained.
"Such a prime location, and the Black Rock City Lord is willing to leave it for Loose Cultivators to use, truly a wise person," Yuan Ming looked around the east, south, and north directions and remarked.
"Most of the population in the Cultivation World consists of Loose Cultivators. The City Lord must see this point clearly, which is why he's treated Loose Cultivators well over the years, allowing the Black Rock City Market to thrive until today," Gu Yue said admiringly.
Yuan Ming nodded, agreeing with this view, and didn't linger; he headed straight across the square toward the East Market.
Halfway there, he suddenly stopped and looked towards a nearby small stall.
"What is it, Brother Yuan, did you find something you want?" Gu Yue asked curiously as he glanced at the stall.
Yuan Ming didn't speak; his gaze fixed on a section of green tree wood at the stall.
The wood, patterned like pine and emitting a faint spiritual power fluctuation, was clearly a piece of Spiritual Pine.
"Brother Yuan wants that spirit wood? What's the highest price you could offer?" Gu Yue followed Yuan Ming's gaze and asked softly.
"Five Spirit Stones," Yuan Ming hesitated a bit before speaking.Thischapterwasuploadedbytheteamat*.
"Alright, don't say anything later, leave it to me," Gu Yue said.
Then, he approached the small stall, where an old man with graying hair and a ruddy, alcoholic nose appeared somewhat comical.
"Fellow Daoist, how are you selling this piece of wood?" Gu Yue pointed at the green spirit wood and asked.
"Good eye, Fellow Daoist. This item was found by a friend of mine in a Fierce Beast's den, it's top-quality Spiritual Pine, I'll sell it to you for thirty Spirit Stones," the old man, with a glint of shrewdness flickering in his eyes, clearly had noticed Yuan Ming and Gu Yue's earlier whispering.
"Thirty Spirit Stones? Old man, are you planning to rob us? It's just a rotten piece of wood. As I see it, it's not even worth one Spirit Stone," Gu Yue pretended to be shocked, his reaction somewhat exaggerated.
"How is it rotten wood, this is genuinely high-quality spirit wood, I had it verified by someone, and this wood is Patterned Pine Spirit Wood, selling it for thirty Spirit Stones is already very cheap," the old man insisted eagerly.
"Patterned Pine Spirit Wood? You think I have no knowledge! Patterned Pine Spirit Wood is a top-grade spiritual material, a fist-sized piece can sell for a hundred Spirit Stones, would you be selling it at a stall here?" Gu Yue scoffed, exposing the old man's lie.
"Even if this item isn't Patterned Pine Spirit Wood, it's still top-quality spirit wood. If you truly want to buy it, I'll sell it for twenty Spirit Stones, no less," the stall owner said, his face turning red.
"That should be my line, for a broken piece of wood from who-knows-where, if you're sincere about selling, I can offer two Spirit Stones," Gu Yue pressed on.
"Two Spirit Stones? Impossible, at least fifteen Spirit Stones," the old man's head swayed like a rattle drum, clearly losing confidence.
Next, Gu Yue and the old stall owner verbally sparred intensely.
Gu Yue seemed to particularly enjoy bargaining, growing more spirited as the debate went on, and devalued the spirit wood to being worth almost nothing, forcing the old man into continuous retreat until he even began to doubt the true worth of his spirit wood, ultimately securing it for the price of three spirit stones.
The elder no longer possessed his former vigor, hanging his head dejectedly as he handed over the spirit wood like a defeated rooster.
Yuan Ming took out three spirit stones and handed them over, carefully storing the green spirit wood.
"Fellow Daoist Gu Yue has impressive skills, I admire that," he said, seeing Gu Yue in a new light, and handed over a spirit stone to him.
"Thank you, Fellow Daoist! My cultivation is weak, and I have been surviving in Black Rock City all these years just by being quick-witted. Brother Yuan, if you have more of such tasks, feel free to leave them to me," Gu Yue joyously accepted the spirit stone, patting his chest as he spoke, clearly trying to impress Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming grunted in acknowledgment, his hands unconsciously stroking the storage bag at his waist, secretly pleased.
Regardless, purchasing this piece of spirit wood for four spirit stones was definitely a good deal; in the previous stores, such grade of spirit wood would have cost at least ten spirit stones, and that price was non-negotiable.
"What kind of spirit wood is that? If it's convenient to reveal, might I also gain some knowledge?" Gu Yue asked curiously, seeing Yuan Ming's actions.
"I don't know much about it either, only that it's a piece of spiritual pine," Yuan Ming admitted.
Gu Yue thought Yuan Ming did not want to reveal it and chuckled, wisely not pressing further.
Yuan Ming wasn't concealing anything; he genuinely did not know what specific type of spiritual material the green spirit wood was, only identifying it as a piece of spiritual pine.
That was enough for him, for he wanted to buy spiritual pine.
Based on Wu Sang's unreliable analysis, one of the ingredients in Black Incense is pine wood powder. If he replaced it with higher-grade spiritual pine powder, there might be unexpected effects.
As for which type of spiritual pine would produce better results, Yuan Ming himself did not know; he decided to experiment first.
The two continued forward, Yuan Ming occasionally glancing around the stalls, but unfortunately, he found nothing else of use.
The pair crossed the square and proceeded to East Market.
The layout and environment of East Market were basically similar to West Market, but the shops here were built by external powers and had architectural styles starkly different from West Market, offering a fresh sight.
According to Gu Yue, the shops in the Eastern Domain and Southern Domain traded a lot of spiritual materials and artifacts from the sea because these areas were far from the Ten Thousand Mountains, had no other comparable spiritual vein mountains, and the terrestrial resources were quite poor.
Luckily, both were close to the sea, where countless sea beast and spiritual materials abound, providing a solid material foundation for the cultivators there.
"The world indeed holds endless wonders," Yuan Ming murmured after visiting several shops in the Eastern and Southern Domains.
The marine spiritual materials and sea beast artifacts from these two places broadened his horizons, stirring a desire to travel the world.
Of course, that would have to wait until he possessed sufficient capacity for self-protection.
Gu Yue didn't stop as he led Yuan Ming forward.
"I noticed that many shops in the Eastern and Southern Domains have mid-grade spiritual materials; don't they have one or two frost-related spiritual objects?" Yuan Ming asked.
"Searching these shops works too. However, compared to Central Plains Da Jin, the resources in places like the Southern Border are still far inferior. The chances of finding frost spiritual materials there are greater," Gu Yue explained.
"Let's have you arrange our upcoming travels," Yuan Ming didn't pretend to know better.
"Thank you for your trust, Brother Yuan. I certainly won't disappoint you," Gu Yue said earnestly.
The two continued on, quickly reaching the other end of East Market.
Here, the influence of the Southern Border began to wane, and more shops in the style of the Central Plains appeared before them, including magic artifact shops, talisman shops, and elixir medicine stores. Anything a cultivator might need could mostly be found here.
Yuan Ming nodded to himself; indeed, the Da Jin Cultivation World was incomparable to the Southern Border.
Many people from the Central Plains were bustling in and out of these shops, the vast majority of whom lacked any mana and were ordinary people, and from time to time, phrases in the language of the Central Plains could be heard.
Apart from his earlier experiences with possession on the Emperor and Wang Shun, this was Yuan Ming's first time seeing so many Central Plains people, and he felt a deep sense of familiarity.
"The largest Da Jin shop in Black Rock City is just ahead. They deal in spiritual materials, elixirs, magic artifacts, and other businesses. Let's go check there first; if they don't have it, we'll look elsewhere," Gu Yue pointed ahead and said.
Yuan Ming had no objections and was about to hasten his steps when the corner of his eye caught sight of a shop by the side, causing him to halt.
It was a small shop, consisting only of three rooms and a backyard, but judging by the sign over the door and the items within, it appeared to be a magic artifact shop.
Yuan Ming's attention was drawn not because he wanted to buy magic artifacts, but rather because of a large sign hanging at the entrance of the shop, which bore several large characters: "Buying Refining Runes."

chapters.title: Chapter 165 - 145: Unexpected Fortune
chapters.content:
Gu Yue noticed Yuan Ming's movements and also looked over, saying, "Brother Yuan, are you looking to purchase a Magic Artifact? This Magic Artifact Shop is indeed quite famous in the East Market."
"Oh, how famous?" Yuan Ming asked.
"The quality of the artifacts in this shop is quite good. Although they are all Low Grade Magical Artifacts, many low-level cultivators come here by reputation. If Fellow Daoist wants a Mid-grade or better artifact, this place won't be able to satisfy you," Gu Yue said.
"There is an Artifact Refiner in this Magic Artifact Shop who is rather peculiar. The artifacts he refines are all excellent, and he even accepts customers' pre-orders. However, he has one rule: he only refines Low Grade Magical Artifacts." Seeing Yuan Ming with a somewhat puzzled expression, Gu Yue continued to explain.
"Oh, there's actually such an Artifact Refiner," Yuan Ming was still somewhat puzzled.
With his understanding of Artifact Refining, a Foundation Establishment Cultivator's Soul Power and Mana are both sufficient for enriching the runes of a Mid-grade Magical Artifact, yet this person doesn't try to refine Mid-grade ones.
You must know, the price of Low Grade Magical Artifacts mostly ranges around forty to sixty Spirit Stones, while Mid-grade Artifacts can fetch as high as five to six hundred Spirit Stones, nearly a tenfold increase. Even if the quality of the Mid-grade Artifacts he refines are slightly inferior, selling one for three to four hundred Spirit Stones would not be a problem. Does this person not want to earn money?
"Hehe, I heard that this Artifact Refiner is extremely obsessed with rune inscription, studying it day and night, which has delayed his mastery of other steps in Artifact Refining, so he simply only refines Low Grade Artifacts," Gu Yue said.
Yuan Ming slowly nodded. Artifact Refining is a meticulous craft; any slight mistake in any of the four steps could lead to the failure of the refining process, and the difficulty of refining Mid-grade Artifacts is indeed not comparable to that of Low Grade ones.
"Then how are the runes bought and sold?" he asked.
Yuan Ming obtained the inscription methods for forty-something runes from the Black Wood Handbook, but unfortunately, due to the limits of his cultivation, he was unable to enrich them, so those runes were temporarily of no use to him.
Since this Magic Artifact Shop was purchasing runes, if the price they offered was not low, he would not mind selling them. Letting the shop copy the runes, he could also enrich the contents of his Storage Bag.
What he currently wanted was not just Frost Spiritual Material. There were still several materials needed for the Thousand Mechanism Mask, and if he wanted to participate in the White Deer Hill covenant half a year later, he would need to prepare not just Magic Artifacts, but elixirs were also essential. All these required Spirit Stones, and only after coming here and opening his eyes did he realize that the prices for cultivation items truly had no ceiling.
"I am not too familiar with that, but all I know is that runes are the lifeline of Artifact Refiners and talismanic masters; they are not willing to part with rare runes. A few days ago, I heard someone traded a rune for a hundred Spirit Stones," Gu Yue said after thinking it over.
"A hundred Spirit Stones!" Yuan Ming was secretly delighted in his heart.
He knew the value of runes was not low, but he did not expect them to be worth so many Spirit Stones. He had scrimped and saved for so long, day and night, and had only accumulated a fortune of seventy Spirit Stones.
And there were forty-five runes recorded in the Black Wood Handbook!
Yuan Ming immediately asked Gu Yue to wait outside and entered the Magic Artifact Shop alone.This vеrsiоn wаs sоurсеd frоm М|V|L^ЕМРYR.
There were no customers inside the shop, only a bald man sitting behind the counter, engrossed in a thick book, occasionally letting out a silly laugh or two.
The man had a body like a tiger's back and a bear's waist, covered in muscles. If someone said he was a fierce bandit who robbed passersby, no one would doubt it. This fierce-looking man was actually engrossed in reading a book, which was quite odd.
Yuan Ming had an odd expression on his face; could this person be that Artifact Refiner? He was indeed quite strange.
"Would the customer like a Magic Artifact? Our store only sells Low Grade Magical Artifacts, please forgive us," the bald man hastily put down the book in his hand and got up to greet him as a customer entered.
Yuan Ming did not mention selling runes and walked over to a shelf nearby.
All the items on the shelf were knives, swords, whips, spears, and other common types of Magic Artifacts with a quite rough appearance—broad in front and narrow behind, off-kilter angle at the bottom, looking as if they were made by a clumsy blacksmith.
However, there was a trace of cold light flowing through these ugly artifacts that commanded respect.
"Can I try casting with it?" Yuan Ming picked up a fiery red sword and asked.
"Of course you can," the bald man said generously.
Yuan Ming activated his Mana and poured it into the sword. The red sword let out a clear ringing sound and a foot-long red Sword Light, flickering and stretching out in front of it.
He performed the Exorcism Technique, and the red sword flew out of his hand, circulating slowly around him, gaining speed.
"Go!"
With a flick of his finger, he directed the red sword towards a greenish-gray boulder in the corner of the shop, which was covered with holes and cutting marks—obviously set up for customers to test their weapons.
With a muted "pfft" sound, the red sword easily penetrated the boulder, sinking in up to the hilt.
Yuan Ming pulled out the sword, its blade as shiny as before without a single scratch.
"What a good sword!" he praised silently.
Ugly as these weapons were, both the materials they were made of and the runes inscribed inside them were quite remarkable; it was no wonder Gu Yue said that all the Low Grade Magical Artifacts in this store were of fine quality.
Since saving Hagon's wife and daughter last time, Yuan Ming had made a rule for himself in cultivation: do not attract attention without sufficient strength.
Now, he had to add another rule to this list of cultivation: do not judge a Magic Artifact by its appearance.
"Fellow Daoist has a discerning eye. This Fire Cone Sword was a favorite creation of my master last month. It contains a piece of Fire Copper Essence and the inscribed rune is 'Armor Breaking.' It possesses powerful offensive capability and is available for only sixty Spirit Stones," the bald man introduced.
"You're only making five Spirit Stones on it." Seeing Yuan Ming silent, the bald man thought he was finding it expensive and added more information.
Fire Copper Essence was a Mid-grade spiritual material, and a piece the size of an egg was worth fifty Spirit Stones. With the additional materials, wouldn't that lead to a loss?
Yuan Ming did not expose the bald man's lie, and after putting the sword back on the shelf, he said, "We'll talk about buying the sword later. I saw outside that your shop is purchasing runes?"
"Correct, does the esteemed guest have any?" replied the bald man, somewhat surprised.
"Naturally. What type of runes do you need, and what are the prices like?" Yuan Ming asked unperturbed.
"As long as the rune isn't available in our store, we'll take it. As for the price, we won't disappoint our customers," the bald man said with a smile.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming smiled faintly.
There were forty-five runes in the Black Wood Handbook, and he knew that most of them were likely quite common. But since Hei Mu was known as a genius Artifact Refining Master, there must be some rare runes in his life's collection that this store wouldn't possibly have all of them.
"It seems that Brother is quite confident. Please show me," the bald man chuckled, not taking it seriously inside.
He had been collecting runes for many years and had most of the common ones, even many of the rare ones. The vast majority of people who wanted to make a quick profit from them ended up leaving disappointed.
Yuan Ming took out a piece of paper and a pen and wrote down the names of four runes.
Runes have been passed down from ancient times and each has a corresponding name, which for Artifact Refiners is basic knowledge, but the initiation, transition, and final stroke of the rune itself is key.
The bald man glanced at the paper and shook his head. "I've got all these already."
Yuan Ming wrote down another four rune names, and the bald man still shook his head.
Yuan Ming's initially eager heart cooled down by half. Instead of revealing them one by one, he decided to write down all of the remaining runes.
The bald man's face showed surprise. Previously, people who came to sell runes brought at most seven to eight, but Yuan Ming unexpectedly brought out dozens of runes all at once. This person must be an unworthy descendant from some Artifact Refining Family who had stolen the family's secret rune book to sell for money.
"So, you've collected all these runes?" Seeing the bald man's strange expression, Yuan Ming asked, his heart sinking.
"That's not the case. Please wait a moment," said the bald man as he carefully examined the rune names on the paper.
His eyes lit up quickly, "Wind Listening, Illusion — these two runes our shop doesn't have, we can take them."
Yuan Ming breathed a sigh of relief. Although only selling two runes was a bit disappointing, all forty-five runes had come to him by chance; selling even one was pure profit.
"As for the price of the runes, my master will decide. Please give me a moment; I'll ask him to come out," the bald man said before briskly walking towards the back of the Magic Artifact Shop.
A moment later, the curtain inside was lifted, and a short and skinny old man quickly emerged, sporting the appearance of a Central Plains person.
"You have Wind Listening and Illusion runes?" the skinny old man asked eagerly.
"Yes, I do," Yuan Ming answered calmly.
"Good, so good! In my youth, I saw a Magic Artifact with the Wind Listening rune, and its effect was miraculously exceptional. The Illusion rune has also been an item I've sought for many years, and to think I'd find them both today!" The old man's sallow cheeks flushed with excitement.
"I will take these two runes, two hundred Spirit Stones each. What do you think, young friend?" the skinny old man quickly regained his composure and said.
Yuan Ming was momentarily stunned at hearing this.
Not long ago, Gu Yue had mentioned a rune selling for one hundred Spirit Stones, and he had been daydreaming grandly. Now, for himself, two runes could sell for a total of four hundred Spirit Stones?
But seeing the old man's demeanor, who seemed to highly value these two runes, it didn't seem like a deception.
"Do you think it's too little? These two runes are indeed rare. You must have made a great decision to part with them. How about this, five hundred Spirit Stones in total for the two runes?" Seeing Yuan Ming remain silent, the skinny old man proposed again.
Yuan Ming came back to his senses, just as he was about to say something, he heard the old man grit his teeth and say impatiently,
"Six hundred Spirit Stones, I can't go any higher!"
"Not enough," Yuan Ming blurted out.
When the bald man had rejected the runes one by one earlier, even if he could get a hundred Spirit Stones each, he might have been willing to sell them.
But seeing the skinny old man's delighted expression, it was almost as if the words "I must have it!" were written on his face.
If not to raise the price now, then when?
"Add one more condition, craft a Magic Artifact for me for free in the future!" Yuan Ming ventured.
"It's a deal! What are you waiting for, quickly now!" the skinny old man glared at the bald man.
The bald man, already agape at the price, snapped back to his senses after the scolding, and in his hasty fluster, he pulled out six Spirit Stones the size of walnuts from his Storage Bag, three yellow, three green, all emanating stronger spiritual power fluctuations than ordinary stones. He also took out two black Jade Plates slightly larger than the palm.
"Mid-grade Spirit Stones!" Yuan Ming was ecstatic inside, but his face remained as calm as still water, revealing no hint of his inner joy.
Like spiritual materials, Spirit Stones are graded. The Spirit Stones that normally circulate in the market are Low Grade, but these six were Mid Grade.
Mid-grade Spirit Stones contain ten times the spiritual power of Low Grade ones, and are purer and more versatile. Just for restoring Mana alone, Mid-grade is much faster than Low Grade, and using them for cultivation improves mastery faster as well.
The pure and substantial spiritual power contained within Mid-grade Spirit Stones exceeds the scope of the Qi Refinement Realm, and if a Qi Refining Stage Cultivator absorbs this power during a breakthrough, it can even increase the chances of success.
With so many advantages, the value of Mid-grade Spirit Stones far exceeds that of Low Grade. It takes one hundred Low Grade Spirit Stones to exchange for one Mid-grade, and it's often a case of having the money but no market availability.
Yuan Ming had been wanting to get his hands on one or two Mid-grade Wood Attribute Spirit Stones for crucial moments of survival, but had been too strapped for cash. Now, he unexpectedly obtained six of them all at once.
Above Mid-grade, there are High-grade Spirit Stones, also with an exchange rate of one hundred to one.
Above High-grade, it is said there is a top-grade class, but almost no one has ever seen it with their own eyes. Many believe that top-grade Spirit Stones are just a myth.

chapters.title: Chapter 166 - 146 The Identity of Central Plains People
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming's gaze shifted from the Mid-grade Spirit Stones in the man's hands to the two black jade plates, and he paused for a moment, looking slightly puzzled.
"Young friend, this must be your first time trading runes, right?" the skinny old man asked tentatively.
"Cough, indeed, I have not dabbled in this area before," Yuan Ming coughed lightly, admitting with a bit of embarrassment.
"Hehe, it doesn't matter. There's always a first time for everything. This is a Rune Jade Plate, specially designed to record runes. It can capture the entire process of the rune's formation for future reference. You only need to gather a wisp of mana at your fingertip, and trace the rune onto it," the old man chuckled, giving Yuan Ming an encouraging look while secretly rejoicing in his heart, having already categorized Yuan Ming as a profligate scion secretly selling his family's rare runes.
After all, each rare rune in existence is a product of seizing the essence of heaven and earth, and is controlled by some ancient sects and Cultivation families. They pertain to the power of magic artifacts and talismans and are considered heirlooms, not commonly exchanged for Spirit Stones. Such treasures are hard to come by.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming took the black jade plate, and, as the old man described, he concentrated his mana on his fingertip and drew the "Wind Listening" rune on one of the Rune Jade Plates.
The initially ordinary-looking jade plate, under Yuan Ming's touch, lit up with a white glow. The light extended following the movements of Yuan Ming's fingers, and when he lifted his finger, the plate displayed a complex rune glowing with white light. It flashed once and vanished, with the jade plate reverting to its original state as if nothing had happened.
As soon as Yuan Ming finished, the old man snatched the jade plate from him, injected a bit of mana, and immediately, a white point appeared on the plate. It then traced the complex rune before blinking out, the entire tracing process and the speed being identical to Yuan Ming's earlier drawing.
"Wonderful, truly indescribably marvelous..." The old man looked entranced, muttering to himself while attempting to mimic the actions in the air, completely out of sorts.
Yuan Ming was secretly amazed, and without further hesitation, he deftly drew the "Illusion" rune on another Rune Jade Plate and handed it to the old man.
"Good, good! My name is Huo Lian. You seem unfamiliar, could it be that you are a cultivator newly arrived at the Black Rock City Market?" Huo Lian fondled the two Rune Jade Plates affectionately for a while before looking up at Yuan Ming with a smile.
"I am Yuan Ming, indeed it is my first visit to Black Rock City," Yuan Ming replied.
"A fine name that suits the temperament of an Artifact Refiner. Work hard, and your potential will be boundless! If crafting a magic artifact isn't urgent, you can come to me anytime once you've decided," Huo Lian said cheerfully, his mood greatly lifted by fulfilling two wishes in one day.
"Thank you for the praise, senior. I shall take my leave now," Yuan Ming expressed his gratitude and was about to leave.
Just as Yuan Ming received six Mid-grade Spirit Stones from the man and was about to rise and bid farewell, he suddenly thought of something, stopped midway, and turned back, "Huo Lian senior, you've never seen these two runes before, have you? How can you tell if they are authentic or fake? Aren't you worried about someone deceiving you with a made-up rune?"
Huo Lian's mind had already sunk back into contemplating the two black jade plates in his hands, completely missing Yuan Ming's question.
"There's no need to worry about that. Runes are born from the essence of the great Dao of heaven and earth. Someone sufficiently knowledgeable about runes can sense the Spiritual Charm within them, even if the runes are unfamiliar; their authenticity can be instantly discerned," the bald man explained.
"I see," Yuan Ming said thoughtfully and then took his leave.
...
Gu Yue had been squatting at the side of the street, idly chewing on a stalk of grass while watching the passersby. Seeing Yuan Ming emerge from the shop, he immediately threw away the grass, stood up, and approached him.
He didn't ask Yuan Ming what he had done in the store, but instinctively felt that Yuan Ming was in a good mood, and that was enough for him.
In their line of work, if one's "boss" was satisfied, it would naturally bring benefits to oneself, after all, although Yuan Ming appeared shrewd, he was also reasonable in his dealings.
Before Gu Yue could speak up, Yuan Ming suddenly asked, "Next, are you planning to take me to a Central Plains workshop?"
"Let's first visit a Central Plains shop. If nothing suitable is found, we can look elsewhere later," Gu Yue nodded and replied.
"Is there a place here where I can buy Central Plains' clothing? Take me there," Yuan Ming requested again.
Puzzled but obliging, Gu Yue led Yuan Ming to a nearby clothing workshop. Asking Gu Yue to wait, Yuan Ming went inside. Moments later, he reemerged dressed in the fashion of a Central Plains man.
"Tsk tsk, Brother Yuan, with this outfit, if I didn't know better, I'd think you were a scion of some wealthy family from Da Jin!" Gu Yue said, clearly impressed.
"Let's go," Yuan Ming responded with a smile, without further explanation.This translation is powered by the readers at *.
Gu Yue wasn't wrong; Yuan Ming's attire indeed resembled that of his real status in Da Jin when he would venture out for leisure activities.
As for why he had chosen to do this, even he wasn't entirely clear. Perhaps it was a nostalgic longing for home, or maybe he considered that a Central Plains man shopping in a Central Plains shop would be more convenient.
The two continued on their way and after about a quarter of an hour, they stopped in front of a large shop.
The shop was high and imposing, with five floors, green tiles, yellow walls, ornate eaves, and beast figurines. It looked extraordinarily majestic. Above the wide-open doors of the shop hung a large gold-plated signboard with the words "Longevity Immortal Tower" written on it. Customers were coming in and out ceaselessly.
"Is this the place?" Yuan Ming inquired, eyeing the gold signboard.
"Yes, Longevity Immortal Tower is the largest Central Plains shop in the market and it's owned by the Chang Chun Temple, a Cultivation family of great wealth from Da Jin. Many of their goods come directly from Da Jin. Except for being expensive, there's no downside," Gu Yue said with a laugh.
"Chang Chun Temple!" Yuan Ming's heart stirred, and he took another look at the shop before him.
The "Nine Elements Technique" he cultivated was, after all, the secret Cultivation Technique only provided to elite disciples of Chang Chun Temple, wasn't it?
In terms of the effects of cultivation, it indeed couldn't be compared to any Cultivation Technique from Biluo Cave; otherwise, with his talent, he wouldn't even barely reach the Fourth or Fifth Layer of Qi Refinement, let alone the Ninth Layer.
Add to that the close relationship this sect had with the Da Jin Imperial Family, and even setting up shop in the Southern Border, the term "wealthy family" really was well-deserved.
"Right, I heard Brother Yuan came from the Central Plains, you must have heard of Chang Chun Temple, right?" Gu Yue seemed to have realized something and asked.
"It seems to be a Daoist sect in Da Jin," Yuan Ming replied vaguely.
"Brother Yuan really has extensive knowledge. The religions of the Central Plains honor Daoism, Buddhism, and Confucianism the most, and Chang Chun Temple is an orthodox Daoist sect, proficient in Alchemy and talisman-making. The elixirs and talismans within Longevity Immortal Tower are far beyond comparison to any sect in the Southern Border. Brother Yuan Ming, aside from spiritual materials, if you're interested, you could also take a look later," Gu Yue said.
"Okay," Yuan Ming agreed with a single utterance, his mind spinning with thoughts.
Elixirs were exactly what he was looking for and as for talismans, they were consumables that, although convenient to use, cost at least one or two low-level spirit stones for a low-grade junior talisman—certainly not something he had considered within his range before.
But times had changed; he now carried more than six hundred spirit stones, naturally instilling him with much more confidence.
The two entered Longevity Immortal Tower one after the other, stepping into an impressive hall that could accommodate a hundred people without feeling crowded. The interior layout was similar to other shops, with shelves lined up and displaying all kinds of goods.
At this moment, there were plenty of customers in the hall, with the sounds of conversations and the language of bidding everywhere—quite the lively atmosphere.
Yuan Ming glanced over the shelves, which mostly contained spiritual materials, but he didn't see the elixirs and talismans that Gu Yue had mentioned.
"Longevity Immortal Tower has five floors, and the items sold on each floor are different. The first floor sells spiritual materials, while the business of elixirs and talismans happens on the second and third floors. As for the fourth floor, it's said to be specifically for receiving distinguished guests and requires a special invitation to enter," Gu Yue saw Yuan Ming's confusion and explained, his face filled with longing when he mentioned the fourth floor.
Yuan Ming nodded and began to look around among the shelves.
The spiritual materials in Longevity Immortal Tower were also sorted according to their Five Elements Attribute, placed in separate sections. He quickly arrived at the area selling Water attribute materials and after a thorough search, he finally spotted a half-transparent green stone box at the top of a shelf not far away. Inside the box was a piece of white Cold Jade the size of a thumb, exuding an intense chill even through the box.
"Ice Soul Stone! A true Mid-grade spiritual material!" A flash of excitement swept through Yuan Ming's eyes.
Before Yuan Ming could walk over, a green-robed attendant approached him and, with a full-faced smile, said, "What kind of spiritual materials would our honored guests like? Our Longevity Immortal Tower boasts a wide range of products, fair prices, and excellent quality, and we will surely make you feel right at home."
"I'm looking for several spiritual materials, preferably Mid-grade or above. If you have good elixirs and talismans, I'd like to have a look at those too," Yuan Ming spoke calmly.
This time, Yuan Ming spoke in the Central Plains language, a standard and fluent Central Plains Da Jin accent, which took Gu Yue by surprise.
As an intelligence broker in Black Rock City, Gu Yue naturally understood the Central Plains language and could speak a few phrases, but he couldn't do so as fluently.
The most important point was that Yuan Ming's manner of asking for things was much bolder than when they first met. After all, a single Mid-grade spiritual material was worth dozens of spirit stones, not to mention elixirs, and talismans were not something average Qi Refining Stage Cultivators could afford.
If he truly was going to buy all these items, it would cost him several hundred spirit stones, wouldn't it?
"The honored guest is from Da Jin? I apologize for any oversight. Please move to the fourth-floor private room; I will go and invite the deacon immediately." The green-robed attendant had already noticed that Yuan Ming's Da Jin attire and behavior were out of the ordinary and grew even more excited upon hearing him speak, responding with unmatched enthusiasm in the Central Plains language as well.
Then, calling another female attendant to take care of Yuan Ming and his companion, he quickly left.
Yuan Ming and Gu Yue, one after the other, followed the female attendant up the stairs to the fourth floor.
The second and third floors were indeed as Gu Yue had said, dedicated to the sale of elixirs and talismans. The stairway to the fifth floor was obstructed by an iron gate, which the attendant advised only Foundation Establishment Cultivators could enter.
The fourth floor had been outfitted with separate rooms, each tastefully furnished with exquisite furniture and refreshments, creating a very comfortable ambiance.
After settling the two of them in, the female attendant served two cups of pale red Spiritual Tea and excused herself.
"Fiery Sun Tea? This is made from Fiery Sun Grass that grows near the mouth of volcanoes, and drinking it benefits the cleansing of meridians and the calming of the mind. Today, I am fortunate to share Brother Yuan's light," Gu Yue picked up the cup, drank it in one gulp, and showed a face of bliss.
Yuan Ming also took a small sip, feeling a warm flow from his throat entering his insides, and then spreading throughout his body.
He felt as if he had bathed in hot water during winter, with his whole body warm and exceedingly comfortable, and was glad for his spirit-lifting change of attire. The frustration he had previously felt at Biluo Cave due to the different treatment he received as a Central Plains person seemed to melt away with the ice and snow.
Here, it was indeed more advantageous to have a Central Plains identity!

chapters.title: Chapter 167 - 147: Spirit Stone Like Flowing Water
chapters.content:
"I did not expect to encounter a guest today who could recognize Fiery Sun Tea; it truly delights me," a crisp voice came, like the tinkling of spring water, pleasant to the ears.
"Where, I only know a little about the way of tea, which makes Fellow Daoist laugh..." Gu Yue rose to look at the door, his voice suddenly choked off, his expression as if he had swallowed an egg.
A woman in yellow clothes walked in. She appeared to be only in her thirties, her eyes still flirtatious, and her skin was very fair. Unfortunately, her cheeks were swollen, layers of fat folded under her chin, her waist as wide as a barrel, and her limbs round and plump. Her large feet made a "pat pat" sound as they hit the floor.
"Unaware of the distinguished guest's arrival, I failed to meet you from afar. I am Zhuo Lingling, serving as a steward at Longevity Immortal Tower. May I know how to address the guest?" the woman in yellow chuckled, speaking in standard Central Plains dialect, discreetly sizing up Yuan Ming.
Before Yuan Ming could speak, Gu Yue had already risen and introduced in a somewhat stiff Central Plains dialect, "This is Young Master Yuan from Central Plains Da Jin, who happened to come here wanting to buy some items, knowing our Longevity Immortal Tower is also from Da Jin, he specifically came to visit."
Yuan Ming did not mind Gu Yue speaking for him; instead, he was quite pleased with his ability to discern situations and adapt spontaneously, knowing what to say and when, which could save him a lot of trouble.
He did not speak but nodded slightly to Zhuo Lingling as a gesture.
This woman was quite stout but had a high level of cultivation, having reached the Qi Refining Peak, which indicated the non-ordinary strength of Chang Chun Temple, the power behind Longevity Immortal Tower.
"Hehe, Young Master Yuan making a special visit is an honor for our tower. Meeting in this foreign land is also a kind of fate. Our tower has been in Black Rock City for many years, renowned for its high-quality and fair-priced wares. If the young master wishes to buy anything, this is indeed the right place," Zhuo Lingling's smile deepened as she sat down in the chair opposite Yuan Ming.
The chair made a creaking sound, seemingly struggling under the woman's weight.
"Indeed, your tower has a variety of items, but what I need is somewhat mixed, and it will take some effort to find them all. If Steward Zhuo could assist me, that would be most appreciated," Yuan Ming finally began to speak, naturally in fluent Central Plains dialect.
"This servant will certainly do her utmost to ensure that the young master won't be disappointed. I heard the young master mentioned wanting to buy some spiritual materials and Elixir and Talisman; is that correct?" Zhuo Lingling asked. For a better reading experience, visit *).
"Frost Attribute Spiritual Materials, mid-grade or higher, and also Black Stiff Silkworm Silk, Jade Skin Powder, and Xuduan Flower, these three materials. As for Elixir and Talismans, if there is a catalogue, please show it to me," Yuan Ming pondered before saying.
"Although the three items like Black Stiff Silkworm Silk are rare, our storeroom happens to have them. I will send someone to fetch them right away. As for the Frost Attribute Spiritual Materials of mid-grade or higher, although rare, our store does have a few. Does Fellow Daoist have any specific requirements?" Zhuo Lingling barely took a moment to think before she asked.
"I can't specify exactly, but if it's convenient, could you bring them all for me to take a look?" Yuan Ming was secretly delighted but kept his expression neutral as he asked.
In the Da Jin Cultivation World, truly, small sects like Biluo Cave could not compare. If he could gather everything at once, it would save a lot of trouble; he didn't have much time.
"Very well, then please wait here for a moment, Young Master Yuan. Meanwhile, feel free to enjoy some Jade Dew Tea imported from overseas," Zhuo Lingling got up and signaled a maid to bring new tea sets for Yuan Ming and his companion before giving a hommage and heading downstairs.
No sooner had the woman left than Gu Yue came over, laughing, "Brother Yuan, today is truly an eye-opener. Normally, those at Longevity Immortal Tower who turn their noses up are inviting you into a private room today, saving us a lot of effort! You play the part of a noble young master so convincingly that even the steward did not notice anything amiss. But, the items here are not cheap, claiming quality and affordability is utter nonsense."
Gu Yue's words clearly had both sincerity and a hint of flattery.
"Sometimes, money can solve things that would otherwise take effort. Spirit Stones can be earned again, but time waits for no one!" Yuan Ming sipped the fragrant tea and said.
"So that's how it is," Gu Yue realized suddenly.
A moment later, the woman in yellow, Zhuo Lingling, returned.
"I apologize for keeping Young Master Yuan waiting; fortunately, I have brought the items. Fellow Daoist, please take your time to examine them," Zhuo Lingling smiled apologetically as her sleeves swept over the table in the private room, and seven boxes of varying sizes and materials appeared on the table.
Zhuo Lingling flicked her fingers, and the three wooden boxes on the left side opened automatically.
Yuan Ming scanned, and the three boxes contained the Black Stiff Silkworm Silk, Jade Skin Powder, and Xuduan Flower he needed.
These three spiritual materials were all of top quality and in substantial quantity, sufficient for refining the Thousand Mechanism Mask twice.
Yuan Ming looked towards the remaining four boxes, each containing a Frost Attribute Spiritual Material.
Inside a semi-transparent green stone box was a piece of jade, the very Ice Soul Stone he had seen earlier. The remaining three boxes contained a black round stone, a blue flower, and half a white Jade Ruyi respectively.
The Ice Soul Stone, black round stone, and the blue flower all emitted a staggering coldness, but the white Ruyi had no special aura, seeming like an ordinary object.
"Allow me to introduce these four Frost Attribute Spiritual Materials to Young Master Yuan. This white jade is called Ice Soul Stone, born at the bottom of an extremely cold ice pond. The black round stone is called Cold Iron Stone, not only containing intense coldness but also extremely hard, making it fine material for refining magic artifacts. The blue flower is called Nine Cold Flower, unsuitable for artifact refining, yet it is an exquisite material for refining cold attribute elixirs," Zhuo Lingling explained one by one.
"What about this half-piece of ruyi? It looks like a fragment of a magical tool." Yuan Ming nodded noncommittally, but his eyes were fixed on the last white ruyi.
"Young Master Yuan guessed correctly, this item is indeed a fragment of a magical tool, made from Yin Jade. However, you can rest assured, Master Yuan, the runes' aura inside this jade ruyi has completely dissipated, and there are no other materials mixed in. It can be used directly as a pure spiritual material," Zhuo Lingling hesitated for a moment before saying.
"What is Yin Jade?"
Yuan Ming seemed to have seen this material in the Record of Strange Stones; the Record of Strange Stones contained a vast amount of content, and he remembered only the names of many materials along with a general description of their properties, but not the details.
"Yin Jade is a special type of cold attribute spiritual material, not only containing intense coldness but also filled with potent Yin Qi. Although it is just a mid-grade spiritual material, the magical tools refined from it are no less than top-grade magical tools. Our store has applied a sealing spell on the ruyi to suppress the Yin Qi, preventing it from harming people," Zhuo Lingling explained.
"I see, may I pick it up to take a look?" Yuan Ming asked.
"Of course, you may. Just be careful, do not let the Yin Qi invade your body. Prolonged contact can easily harm your Divine Soul," Zhuo Lingling reminded.
Yuan Ming consented with a word and grasped the white ruyi.
An intensely cold and eerie aura emanated from the ruyi, numbing his fingers. He quickly mustered his mana to protect his fingers before he could pick up the ruyi.
Yuan Ming examined the item carefully, becoming more satisfied the more he looked at it.
This Yin Jade, compared to other frost attribute spiritual materials like the Ice Soul Stone, had an added aura of eerie and sinister energy, indeed capable of harming the Divine Soul of ordinary cultivators, but he was unconcerned, thanks to the Mysterious Incense Burner.
"It seems Young Master Yuan has made his decision, but as a prior caution, the Yin Qi within this Yin Jade is extremely dense, forming a poisonous energy, and the owner of the magical tool will also be eroded by it. If Master Yuan decides to buy this item, you will need to find a way to counter it. Once this item leaves this tower, there can be no returns or exchanges," Zhuo Lingling said with a somewhat serious tone.
"Thank you for the warning, Steward Zhuo. May I know how many spirit stones this Yin Jade Ruyi requires?" Yuan Ming touched his nose and asked.
"To be honest, this Yin Jade Ruyi was acquired by our store at a high price from elsewhere. Since it is Master Yuan's first visit, let's form a friendship, a cost price of one hundred spirit stones for Master Yuan. As for those three materials, a total of sixty spirit stones," Zhuo Lingling said with a smile returning to her face.
"Agreed." Yuan Ming did not bargain and consented at once.
The price for the materials required for refining the Thousand Mechanism Mask was still reasonable, while Yin Jade Ruyi was almost twice as expensive as other mid-grade spiritual materials, but considering the effectiveness of the item, it was worth it.
In the following time, Zhuo Lingling took out some elixirs and talismans from the Longevity Immortal Tower, and after Yuan Ming picked some, he felt a mix of joy and sorrow.
He was glad because the elixirs and talismans in Longevity Immortal Tower were indeed extraordinary, far beyond those available in Biluo Cave; however, he was also worried because the prices were much higher. He found himself wanting this and that, realizing that if he let himself choose freely, the six hundred plus spirit stones he had would hardly buy much.
After some consideration, under Gu Yue's envious gaze, Yuan Ming bought ten bottles of elixirs and more than thirty talismans in one go.
Among these, three bottles were healing pills, not inferior to Meat Bone Pills, which would significantly enhance his ability to continue fighting and surviving, especially if he were to join the meeting at White Deer Hill. Additionally, there were five bottles of Nourishing Origin Pills which could speed up the cultivation of Qi Refining Stage Cultivators and two bottles of Lianfu Powder to enhance his physical body.
As for the talismans, a large portion of them were offensive, with low-grade junior talismans like "Rocket Talisman" and "Wind Blade Talisman," and mid-level talismans like "Thunder Strike Talisman" and "Fire Snake Talisman"; the former ranged between two to three spirit stones each, while the latter suddenly jumped to eight to ten spirit stones each, costing Yuan Ming considerably.
That was manageable, but what really pained Yuan was the defensive and auxiliary talismans like "Green Light Shield," "Giant Power Talisman," "Vajra Talisman," which were even more expensive at the same grade.
However, Yuan Ming understood that these were worth it, as talismans allowed him to use spells that he did not master and could be activated rapidly and easily, almost without restraint from mana limitations, which was an excellent method to boost his strength in a short time.
Including the previously acquired spiritual materials, Yuan Ming ended up spending nearly five hundred spirit stones at once, and if he didn't want to keep any mid-grade spirit stones, he likely would have spent them all.
"Earning money is like digging a well, spending is like flowing water." Yuan Ming thought to himself.
The six hundred spirit stones he had just saved up were almost all spent in the blink of an eye, but thankfully, he had managed to buy everything he needed.
Having spirit stones felt good.
Spending spirit stones felt even better.
Now that his spirit stones were nearly spent, this journey to the workshop had come to an end.

chapters.title: Chapter 168 - 148 Assassination (Seeking Monthly Ticket)
chapters.content:
Zhuo Lingling, with a beaming smile, escorted Yuan Ming and Gu Yue to the private room's doorway, where Yuan Ming declined the offer to walk him out of the building.
He certainly didn't want to draw too much attention by being so ostentatious.
The two made their way to the first floor lobby, weaving through rows of shelves and planning to head outside, when they noticed a noisy clamor at the entrance as a group of people swarmed in.
Leading the group was a man in his twenties, dressed in white robes, with a handsome, yet immature face, and strikingly white hair and beard. His thin lips gave off a somewhat frivolous air.
The young man had his arms around a girl in a red dress, laughing and chatting without any regard for the stares of the people around them.
The girl in the red dress had a soft beauty, with a curvaceous figure accentuated by her light, flowing dress that outlined her delicate frame, exuding a heart-stopping, seductive allure, much like a blooming Fire Lotus.
Yuan Ming had seen many beautiful women before, but he had never encountered such a vivid and fiery beauty and couldn't help but take a second glance.
Other guests inside the Longevity Immortal Tower did the same, their gazes inevitably drawn to the girl in the red dress.
She seemed well accustomed to being the center of attention, leaning nonchalantly against the young man and giggling coyly from time to time.
Following behind the pair were about seven or eight guards, probably bodyguards, subtly encircling the young man and his companion.
Among the guards, a Black Robed Elder stood out with his profound demeanor and eagle-like sharp gaze.
"A Foundation Establishment Cultivator!" Yuan Ming thought to himself in surprise.
This young man, merely at the Qi Refinement Realm, actually had a Foundation Establishment guard, indicating his status was certainly no small matter.
"Those people's cuffs are embroidered with a dragon-shaped pattern; they must be disciples from the Eastern Domain White Dragon Island. That young man in white must be Young Master Wula, the Island Master's son," Gu Yue whispered to Yuan Ming.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming scrutinized the young man in white and faintly sensed a rather pure Water attribute Mana fluctuation emanating from him.
"Young Master, look, look, that gemstone is so beautiful," the girl in the red dress said, eyeing a blue gemstone on a nearby shelf with anticipation.
"These are all common spiritual materials. Just take whatever you fancy, and later I'll show you upstairs where the real treasures are," the young man in white said with a careless chuckle.
"Thank you, Young Master!" the girl in the red dress beamed with joy as she picked up the blue gemstone.
"When can I be as debonair and wealthy, with beauties always by my side?" Gu Yue murmured wistfully.
Yuan Ming had little interest in such Cultivation World gossip. Seeing that the group had moved further inside and the door was now open, he decided to leave the Longevity Immortal Tower directly.
However, as he approached the door, a figure wearing a gray-white collar entered the building, brushing past him.
This person's face was covered in multicolored makeup, wearing a slightly ridiculous pointed hat, and odd, curled-toe shoes, akin to a clown from a martial arts circus troupe.
In the workshop, where people often wore unusual outfits, the appearance of the colorful-clad clown didn't attract much attention.
Yet, Yuan Ming stopped in his tracks and looked back at the person.
"Brother Yuan, you?" Gu Yue asked upon seeing this.
Yuan Ming remained silent. Just as they brushed past each other, the hairs on his back had suddenly stood on end, as if he had encountered some terrifying beast.
He churned his Divine Sense within his Sea of Consciousness, considering probing the clown but decided against it after hesitating.
Using Divine Sense to probe others was quite impolite; if this colorful-clad clown was indeed someone formidable, it could lead to trouble for him.
Instead of lingering in the store, the clown walked straight toward Wula and his group.
"Who goes there?" one burly guard stepped in front of the clown and demanded in a low voice.
The other guards, sensing a stranger approaching, also tensed up in preparation.
"Heehee..."
The clown let out a strange laugh. Without any noticeable movement, six Golden Light Blades with trailing afterimages shot from his fingertips, swooping across the necks of the two foremost guards.
It was only when blood spurted out that the guards realized what had happened, but by then their bodies were already sapped of strength, and they collapsed limply.
The six Light Blades continued without pause, speeding toward Young Master Wula, reaching behind him in an instant.
Wula, still embracing the enchanting woman and admiring a spiritual material, was completely oblivious to the danger approaching from behind.
Just as he was about to be pierced by the Golden Light Blades, suffering the same fate as the two guards, a large, dark-green shield the size of a table surfaced from beside him and blocked the blades at the last moment.
With a loud "clang," the six Golden Light Blades shattered into countless golden fragments that scattered in the air.
The dark-green shield was knocked back several feet and trembled a few times before stabilizing.
From beside the shield, a shadow flitted like a specter, and the Black Robed Elder emerged, shouting, "Young Master, retreat quickly!"
The colorful-clad clown let out a strange giggle, clapped his hands, and another dozen golden light blades flew out, all striking toward the Black Robed Elder.
Enraged, the Black Robed Elder naturally ignored the rule that forbade fighting in the workshop and pinched a formula, pointing at the dark green shield.
The already desk-sized shield enlarged by nearly half its size again, and its thickness increased significantly, clashing with the incoming golden blades for the second time.
Green and golden lights violently collided in front of the dark green shield, emitting a deafening explosion. Nearby shelves toppled haphazardly, and the floor tiles were ripped apart by the formidable mana, kicking up dust and debris. The interior of the Longevity Immortal Tower instantly became a mess.
The colorful-clad clown and the Black Robed Elder moved extremely quickly; not until this moment did the guests in the store react, panicking and fleeing outside, just like the green-robed attendants of the Longevity Immortal Tower.
Most of them were mere mortals, who had never seen anyone dare to fight within the Longevity Immortal Tower.
However, there were still many Cultivators and mortals who loved excitement gathered around the entrance of Longevity Immortal Tower, observing everything that was happening inside.
Yuan Ming pulled Gu Yue along, and they too came to the outside of the building with the crowd.
The remaining six guards of the White Dragon Island formed a protective circle around Young Master Wula, and some tried to aid the Black Robed Elder. But the battle between the colorful-clad clown and the Black Robed Elder was so fierce that they couldn't get close. They tried to attack the colorful-clad clown with magic artifacts and spells, but before they could even touch him, they were blown back by the intense collisions.
In the deepest part of the denser dust, the golden light blades became increasingly powerful, each collision reminiscent of boulders striking each other.
The surface of the dark green shield flashed wildly with green light, constantly retreating, and it seemed to struggle against the bombardment of the golden light blades.
The Black Robed Elder was both shocked and enraged, but he did not panic. Supporting the dark green shield with one hand, he pinched a formula with the other, about to cast another spell.
Just at that moment, the elder's eyes suddenly felt intense pain, and a moment later, they burst open, his sharp eyes turning into two bloody hollows.
The excruciating pain made it impossible for the Black Robed Elder to continue the fight, and he collapsed onto the ground.
The colorful-clad clown's eyes flashed with bloodthirsty excitement, his tongue licked his lips, and he gestured with a flicking motion.
The Black Robed Elder's head exploded with a "bang," and a large amount of red and white matter splattered, the screaming abruptly stopping.
Yuan Ming was shocked that a Foundation Establishment Cultivator could be killed so easily, and his gaze unconsciously turned toward the corpse of the Black Robed Elder, under whose waist a small white bag peeked out, pinned under the corpse—it was a storage bag.
A thought flashed through his mind, and he silently withdrew from the crowd, turning away to a secluded area near Longevity Immortal Tower. A black light flashed on his brow, and a soul crow burst forth, entering the spiritual beast bag tied at his waist, colliding with Black Toad's head, and merging into it.
The Black Toad's eyes emitted strands of green light, signifying the newly awakened Corpse Control ability.
Text acquired from M|V|LEMP&YR.
This ability could control not only corpses but also living beings, provided that the Divine Soul of the target was weak, such as mortals, or beings like Black Toad that would not resist their master.
A flicker of sapience crossed the Black Toad's eyes, and a purple-black vine grew out of its back, swiftly waving in flexible movements it could not achieve before, as if it were Yuan Ming's own arm, with his mana freely flowing inside the vine.
"Just as I thought," Yuan Ming muttered to himself, manipulating the vine to extend out of the spiritual beast bag.
He removed the storage ring from his hand, placed it on the purple-black vine, and the vine plunged into the ground with a "puff," quickly burrowing toward the area beneath the corpse of the Black Robed Elder, approaching the white storage bag.
A surge of mana emerged from the purple-black vine, entered the white storage bag, wrapped around everything inside, and pulled it out.
At the same time, Yuan Ming carefully operated the vine with the storage ring attached, enclosing the items inside the Black Robed Elder's storage bag,
a flash of white light passed faintly underground, and most of the items inside the Black Robed Elder's storage bag fell into Yuan Ming's storage ring, leaving only a few spirit stones.
The purple-black vine quietly returned the same way it came, merging back into the spiritual beast bag, leaving behind a storage ring slightly soiled with dirt.
Yuan Ming's heart pounded fiercely, and he couldn't help but take a deep breath, then grasped the storage ring, a slight smile appearing on his lips.
The series of events seemed complex but actually occurred within a few breaths.
He quietly returned to the crowd of onlookers; Gu Yue, always eager for excitement, was currently staring intently inside the building, not even noticing Yuan Ming had quietly left for a moment.
Inside Longevity Immortal Tower, Young Master Wula was already pale with fright. In his panic, he took out a blue bowl, and a blue light shield descended, enveloping his body.
Almost at the same time, the colorful-clad clown's deadly fingers pointed his way.
With a loud "clang," the blue light shield deeply dented inward, nearly being pierced, but ultimately it barely held.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming focused his Divine Sense on the dented part of the light shield, finally discovering some clues.
A slender strand of golden light was fixed on the blue light shield, invisible to the naked eye, and without sufficient Divine Power, it would be undetectable.
Tiny specks of golden light gathered from all directions, remnants of the earlier six golden light blades that had shattered, rapidly merging into the slender golden light.
The slender golden light did not thicken, but its power grew stronger and stronger. After a few breaths, it finally penetrated the blue light shield, stabbing Young Master Wula in the forehead.
A spot of blood-red appeared on Wula's forehead, and the next moment, his head exploded, his headless body swayed twice and fell backward.
The room fell silent, and inside and outside the shop, one could hear a pin drop.
The nearby crowd had not clearly seen how the Black Robed Elder and Young Master Wula had died, looking at the colorful-clad clown with eyes full of horror. Seeing this, the guards of White Dragon Island hurriedly fled in all directions, fearing they would be the next to have their heads explode.

chapters.title: Chapter 169 - 149: Treasure Counting
chapters.content:
The colorful-clad clown ignored this, opened his mouth wide into a grin at both cheeks, revealing a very sinister smile, and made a bow to the crowd outside.
This scene did not at all resemble the aftermath of having just killed several cultivators, but rather the conclusion of a juggling performance.
Moreover, he seemed to greatly enjoy the sensation of being watched by the crowd.
Especially since most of the spectators looked on with eyes full of surprise and horror, their faces also carrying the utmost expression of fear.
After bowing to the onlookers, the colorful-clad clown turned around leisurely, raised a hand, and shot out a serpentine golden light from his palm, pulling the storage magic tools of the black-robed elder and Wula towards him.
Outside the Longevity Immortal Tower, Yuan Ming saw this scene, curled the corners of his mouth upwards, and without a word, turned around and blended into the crowd on the street.
The clown's divine sense delved into the two storage magic tools, but his smiling face instantly stiffened and a hint of surprise flashed through his eyes.
Wula's storage magic tool was fine, but the black-robed elder's storage bag contained only a few dozen Spirit Stones, not even a single mid-level Spirit Stone.
The black-robed elder, as a Foundation Establishment cultivator, was so poor! It was unheard of.
The colorful-clad clown looked at the black-robed elder somewhat sympathetically.
"People from White Dragon Island are all..." Suddenly, the colorful-clad clown shouted, "paupers?" His divine sense erupted completely, enveloping the crowd outside the Longevity Immortal Tower.
The onlookers, who hadn't dispersed in time, saw darkness before their eyes, their divine souls struck as if by a heavy blow, and some with weaker cultivations passed out on the spot.
At this moment, Yuan Ming was far from the Longevity Immortal Tower and was not covered by the clown's divine sense, but he also felt the oppressive sensation it brought with it and quickened his pace even more.
Just then, a tall woman in white appeared out of nowhere beside the clown, with a flash of yellow light on the ground nearby.
The woman had raven waterfall-like hair, was barefoot, and radiated a spotlessly holy aura all over, but regrettably, her face was covered with a fierce evil ghost mask, concealing her features.
"What are you going crazy for! The city's enforcer team is on its way. Stop talking nonsense and leave!" the woman in white said in an urgent tone.
The woman in white flicked her slender, onion-white fingers, and five pillar-shaped beams of yellow light touched down around the two, striking the ground.
Array patterns emerged from within the yellow beams, interweaving like living things, and in an instant formed a round array about a zhang in size.
The colorful-clad clown reluctantly suppressed his anger, realizing he had lost out on this deal.
The woman in white's fingers fluttered, and seven or eight earth-attribute Spirit Stones flew out, embedding themselves into various nodes of the array patterns.
The yellow array burst forth with a powerful surge of spiritual power, whirling into rapid action.
"Wave Hand Array!" exclaimed an unknown cultivator from the crowd outside the store.
Wave Hand Array is a realm of cultivation in array formation, a vast and complex study involving scrutinizing various array maps and patterns, comprehending the movements of the celestial bodies and geography, and connecting with the earth vein spiritual powers. It is recognized as one of the most abstruse and difficult to learn among the divine skills in the cultivation world.
Many array masters study hard for a lifetime and can only set up minor arrays and each time they need to spend a lot of time meticulously inscribing the patterns, taking perhaps ten days to half a month to complete.
However, in the vast world, geniuses abound, and some people are naturally talented in the ways of the array, with an understanding of arrays reaching a level incomprehensible to ordinary people, capable of simplifying the complex, instantly forming an array with a wave of their hands using their own mana.
Such experts are one in ten thousand, without exception, all of them Array Masters, and this young-looking woman in white turned out to be an Array Grandmaster!
"Don't leave!"
An explosive shout like thunder came from afar, and a silver sword shadow, fast as lightning, sped forward, piercing through the doors of the Longevity Immortal Tower and quickly approaching the yellow array.
The woman in white acted as if she saw none of this, once again sweeping out with her sleeve.
Dazzling yellow light exploded from the array, and both the woman in white and the colorful-clad clown shimmered and vanished into thin air.
The silver sword shadow passed through where their bodies had been, but struck emptiness.
After the silver light flashed, a sturdily built man in a purple robe appeared, who slowly touched down to the ground with an ashen complexion.
He turned his head to look at the stairs in the hall; with a series of heavy footsteps, the plump deacon Zhuo Linlin was coming down the stairs quickly, still looking panicked as she ran towards him...
Gu Yue's cultivation was shallow, but since he had been standing further away, he was not rendered unconscious by the colorful-clad clown's potent divine sense.
After his senses returned, he saw the man's complexion and immediately turned, saying, "This man is from the City Lord Mansion, quick..."
Gu Yue suddenly stopped speaking, belatedly noticing that Yuan Ming was nowhere to be seen.
He looked around, but there was no sign of Yuan Ming. With no choice, he supported his still somewhat dizzy head and left on his own.
The other clear-headed onlookers also scattered like birds and beasts, steering clear of trouble.
No one noticed the tiny hole in the ground beneath the elder.
The rest of the marketgoers were unaware of the major incident that had occurred, and the earth-shattering 'Beggar, huh?' attracted many onlookers, creating an exceptionally chaotic scene.
Gu Yue hurried away, not slowing down until he had completely left Longevity Immortal Tower behind and began searching for Yuan Ming.
ThefullserieslivesonMyVirtualLibraryEmpire(*).
A shout came from up ahead where Yuan Ming, now dressed in Southern Border attire, stood by the roadside.
"Brother Yuan Ming, where did you go just now? I had a hard time looking for you," Gu Yue rushed over and complained.
"I had some urgent matters to attend to and had to leave briefly; I saw everything at the Longevity Immortal Tower. Was that purple-robed robust man from the City Lord Mansion?" Yuan Ming asked.
Fearing the people from the City Lord Mansion might trace things back to him, he pulled Gu Yue along, talking as they walked.
"Yes, his name is Lei Bao, a late-stage Foundation Establishment Cultivator with Thunder and Lightning Divine Power. He ranks in the top five within the City Lord Mansion. It's a pity those two fled so quickly; otherwise, had they confronted him, it would have most likely been an unprecedented great battle," Gu Yue said, his excitement inexplicably rising.
Yuan Ming nodded silently.
Gu Yue, who had just experienced the incident, grew more and more excited as he thought about it. Speaking of the colorful-clad clown and his companion, he said, "Judging from the last words exchanged between the woman in white and the clown, it seems they specifically came to assassinate the Young Master of White Dragon Island. I must say, those two are bold, daring to act so openly in Black Rock City and still managing to escape from the hands of the City Lord Mansion's people so easily..."
"Indeed, those two are formidable. One kills without a trace, while the other is an Array Master capable of creating formations with a wave of his hand. They must have significant backgrounds. Brother Gu Yue, can you guess who they are?" Yuan Ming asked.
He had stolen items from the Black Robed Elder's storage ring and made a significant enemy of the colorful-clad clown, so he was keen to find out their identities for his own protection.
"Brother Yuan, don't joke with me! I'm just a minor broker in Black Rock City; how would I know the backgrounds of those two masters? However, they must have some backing to dare to do such a thing, perhaps members of the Scatter Alliance of assassins," Gu Yue suggested.
"Scatter Alliance? Do you mean one that specializes in assassination missions?" Yuan Ming asked.
"Exactly, but that's just my guess," Gu Yue replied.
