"Would the major sects of the Southern Border allow them to exist?" Yuan Ming asked, quite surprised.
He had originally thought that the Scatter Alliance only took on tasks like hunting Fierce Beasts, gathering materials, and escorting bodyguards; to think they also undertook assassination missions brazenly surprised him.
"The major sects of the Southern Border naturally have no jurisdiction over it. The Scatter Alliance operates in secrecy, and offending them would result in heavy losses for the sects. As long as they do not harm their own interests, the major sects are too lazy to deal with such desperate miscreants. Now that the Elder and Young Master of White Dragon Island have been assassinated, and within Black Rock City no less, White Dragon Island won't let this go. Black Rock City will be busy for a while," Gu Yue said, pondering for a moment before speaking confidently.
Yuan Ming wasn't worried about this. Once matters in this place were settled, he would immediately return to Biluo Cave to cultivate in seclusion for a few months. No matter how powerful Black Rock City and White Dragon Island were, it was unlikely they would be able to track him down.
"Brother Yuan Ming, where will you go next?" Gu Yue asked, suppressing his emotions.
"Now that I've obtained the Frost Spiritual Material, there's no need for you to guide me further. I'll operate on my own from here on out," Yuan Ming decided after thinking for a moment.
"Okay, if you come to Black Rock City Market again in the future and need someone to show you around or gather information, you can look for me at the Songfeng Tavern in West Market. When I'm not working, I'm mostly there," Gu Yue offered, then hurriedly took his leave.
The fact that the Scatter Alliance took action to assassinate the Elder and Young Master of White Dragon Island was big news, worth a lot of money, and he had to sell it quickly. Otherwise, it would be meaningless!
Yuan Ming watched Gu Yue walk away, then found an inn to stay in, securely closing the door before eagerly taking out the storage ring.
He had not had a chance to closely inspect the items he transferred from the Black Robed Elder's belongings due to the urgent circumstances. Now, he intended to thoroughly investigate.
Infusing the ring with his Divine Sense, his face couldn't help but light up with joy.
The Black Robed Elder had a considerable collection of items. The first thing detected by his Divine Sense was a small pile of Low Grade Spirit Stones, amounting to over five or six hundred, among which were exactly seven Mid-grade Spirit Stones. The total quantity of Spirit Stones exceeded a thousand.
Yuan Ming had previously struggled desperately, and only after finding someone willing to pay a high price for Master Hei Mu's runes did he manage to scrape together just over six hundred Spirit Stones, almost all of which had been spent; now, to suddenly acquire nearly double that number, how could he not be overjoyed?
However, considering that the other party was a Foundation Establishment Cultivator, having so many Spirit Stones was normal.
"The wealth of a Foundation Establishment Cultivator is indeed substantial," Yuan Ming thought to himself, then moved his Divine Sense to inspect the other items.
Four pieces of spiritual materials, a black token, a water blue Small Banner the size of a palm, a pristine White Jade Box, and two medicine bottles, one large and one small.
The four pieces of spiritual materials were a chunk of earthy yellow carapace, a yellow spirit wood, a fist-sized blue egg, and a gray object the size of a human head, tightly bound by numerous fine threads.
Although he didn't recognize what they were, all four objects exuded an unusual spiritual power fluctuation, and judging by the standard of spiritual materials, they were all Mid-grade, possibly even higher.
"This yellow carapace looks like the shell of some turtle-like Fierce Beast... I'm not sure what variety this yellow spirit wood is, but I can grind it into powder later and make it into incense sticks to see the effect... I don't know what kind of Beast Egg this blue egg is, but given the intense spiritual power fluctuations, the beast's level should not be low. As for this gray silk bundle..." Yuan Ming picked up the gray silk bundle, felt that it was soft yet firm, and very elastic, like a cocoon.
He pinched a gray thread and pulled, but it wouldn't budge.
Yuan Ming, whose Cultivation had reached the Qi Refining Ninth Level and who had repeatedly nourished his Physical Body with Mana, had greatly strengthened his bodily strength. Even without using the Fur Cloak Skill, he could snap a rope with his bare hands, yet he couldn't break this tiny gray thread.

chapters.title: Chapter 170 - 150: Great Harvest
chapters.content:
"It seems that this item is most likely left by some type of fierce beast spider or silkworm. I may find someone to take a look when I have a chance," Yuan Ming mused silently. He didn't pay much attention to it and set the gray silk bundle aside, then took out the black token.
On one side of the token was a coiled dragon pattern with the words "Elder" inscribed below it, and on the other side was a name: Li Sha.
Yuan Ming was about to cast the black token aside but suddenly stopped and channeled his mana into it.
A dense black light emanated from the token, and a small knife-shaped black rune appeared in the center.
"Just an identity token, yet why is it made into a magical tool? Could it be that this token has other uses besides identifying one's identity?" Yuan Ming speculated.
He knew nothing about White Dragon Island, naturally unable to see through it, he did not think further about it. He placed the black token aside and then began to examine the blue small banner.
The banner was embroidered with a cloud pattern. Even without activation, streaks of blue light emitted from it, quickly increasing the moisture in the room, causing droplets of water to form on surfaces like the tabletop and windowsill.
At the base of the small banner was embroidered in tiny characters: Shuiyun Banner.
After a moment of contemplation, Yuan Ming channeled his mana into it. The Shuiyun Banner rose from his hand, casting a bright blue light, and the moisture in the room visibly thickened, with slight mists appearing in the air, creating a somewhat dreamy atmosphere.
He did not stop there and increased the input of his mana. The light on the Shuiyun Banner grew brighter, and two rune-like blue shadows flashed across the banner, arranged in a "品" shape.
"Two runes, a Mid-Grade Magical Artifact!" Yuan Ming could not contain his joy.
The materials and runes are the foundation of a magical tool, each supporting the other, neither can be lacking.
Without runes, it's like the Green Fish Sword, merely a semi-finished magical tool. When only runes are present and the material of the magical tool is too poor, it cannot withstand the engraving of runes or the infusion of spiritual power.
A Low-Grade Magical Artifact can only have one rune inscribed, a Mid-Grade two, and a top-grade has three.
This Shuiyun Banner contains two runes; it is undoubtedly a Mid-Grade Magical Artifact, which counts as a significant gain from this trip to Black Rock City!Brought to you by *.
Considering that the Black-Robed Elder was a Foundation Establishment Cultivator and also an elder of the White Dragon Island, it's usual for him to have a Mid-Grade Magical Artifact as a trump card. Sadly, the painstakingly refined treasure was never used before he was killed, unwittingly benefiting me instead.
Yuan Ming did not continue to activate it further but carefully packed up the Shuiyun Banner.
This place is a hostel after all, too crowded and not suitable for refining magical tools or testing their true power.
However, even without testing it now, this Shuiyun Banner as a Mid-Grade Magical Artifact, surely won't disappoint him.
Yuan Ming calmed his excited emotions and packed up the small banner and the other items, taking out the jade box and the medicine bottles.
He first opened the jade box, and his expression twitched.
Inside the jade box were some jade plates, small flags, and similar items, each engraved with many patterns. They filled the box to the brim.
"What are these?" Yuan Ming picked up a small flag which had patterns somewhat similar to the array patterns he had seen before.
But array patterns are usually engraved on the ground or other immovable surfaces for setting up arrays, what's the use of carving them on these small flags?
"A Foundation Establishment Cultivator would not carry useless items. I'll ask someone about these when I return to the Sect," Yuan Ming decided, then he put the small flag back and picked up two medicine bottles.
He first opened the larger one. It was filled with emerald pills, easily over a hundred in total, each emitting faint fluctuations of spiritual power.
"Nourishing Origin Pills!" Yuan Ming had just bought five bottles of Nourishing Origin Pills at the Longevity Immortal Tower, so he recognized the green pills by name immediately.
The Longevity Immortal Tower sold Nourishing Origin Pills, ten in a bottle for fifteen Spirit Stones. He had actually wanted to buy more, but the constraints of his budget didn't allow it. Now suddenly obtaining so many was like a huge windfall, surely enough for his use during the Qi Refinement Realm.
"This level of Strengthening and Nourishing elixir, that elder surely can't use them. Perhaps they were bought for his disciples or nephews. Luckily for me, I get to experience being pampered with pills by an elder!" he speculated secretly.
His Nine Elements Technique was already progressing rapidly; even compared with disciples nurtured by the Sect with elixir resources in the Biluo Cave, he was not far behind. Plus, being financially constrained before, he actually hadn't considered elixir-assisted cultivation.
With that thought, Yuan Ming felt an irrepressible urge to try it out. He sat down cross-legged, took out a green pill, and swallowed it.
The green pill dissolved as soon as it entered his stomach, turning into a stream of primordial qi, which slowly merged into his body, meandering through the meridians of his limbs and gradually gathering in his Dantian.
He closed his eyes, circulated the Nine Elements Technique, and it took him two hours to absorb this stream of primordial qi. Although the increase in his mana was not significant, it was indeed faster than solely cultivating the Nine Elements Technique.
"The claim by the deacon at Longevity Immortal Tower about doubling the cultivation speed, if not misleading, must be intended for ordinary cultivation techniques," he thought with a trace of a smile. Then he carefully put away the big jade bottle and took out the smaller one.
The small jade bottle was sealed with a white talisman, enveloped by an invisible force.
Yuan Ming's eyes flickered with anticipation, for such a carefully stored item within the small jade bottle was bound not to be ordinary.
He channeled his mana, removed the white talisman, and opened the bottle lid.
Three amber-colored pills lay quietly inside, crystal-clear like jade, radiating a yellow halo.
Yuan Ming took out one pill and sniffed it lightly but didn't smell any fragrance and couldn't determine its ingredients from its appearance.
He activated his Divine Sense to probe inside the pill but gained nothing from it.
"I'm embarrassed that I can't even recognize the items I obtained. I need to travel and observe more in the future to broaden my perspective," Yuan Ming inwardly chuckled bitterly. After sorting and storing everything by category, he took out the Spiritual Pine he had bought earlier, as well as the old man's yellow spiritual wood.
After pondering for a moment, he cut a small part from each piece of spiritual wood, ground them into powder, then took out the tools, materials, and most importantly, the incense ashes needed for making incense. Soon, he had made three sticks of incense.
Due to the incense ashes, the three sticks of incense had no fluctuations of spiritual power.
He did not proceed to light the incense in the incense burner, realizing that he had used it almost six days ago and it hadn't recovered yet.
After storing the three incense sticks and the Spiritual Pine, Yuan Ming changed into another set of clothes, put on a hat, and went back to the streets, arriving shortly at the Magic Artifact Shop that bought runes.
Before entering the shop, he used a low-grade junior talisman that could briefly conceal his aura and prevent divine sense from spying on his appearance.
Although he had a chance for a free artifact refinement, he did not want to use it right away. Instead, he thought about using this opportunity later to see if he could persuade the other party to teach him some artifact refining techniques, which would be far superior to obtaining anything else.
The shop had a customer at the moment; the bald man was fervently boasting about a decent-looking black blade magical artifact.
The customer was swayed by the spiel, and finally, gritting his teeth, he paid with spirit stones to purchase the blade.
After sending off the customer, the bald man saw Yuan Ming standing by the counter and warmly welcomed him, "This distinguished guest, are you also looking to purchase a magical artifact? Although all the magical artifacts in our shop are low-grade, the quality is exceptionally good, and the prices are absolutely fair."
"I heard that magical artifacts can be custom-made here?" Yuan Ming, using mana to alter his voice, asked.
"Is the guest a regular here? Not many know that our shop can customize magical artifacts," the bald man uttered in surprise, examining Yuan Ming from head to toe with a slightly uncertain tone.
Yuan Ming chuckled dryly and merely nodded slightly without committing to an answer to the man's question.
"Our shop indeed accepts orders for custom-made magical artifacts. However, I must mention beforehand that customers need to provide their materials, and if the artifact fails to refine, our shop bears no responsibility," the bald man stated seriously, without pressing further.
"That's acceptable," Yuan Ming, having previously learned about the shop's artifact refining rules from Gu Yue, had no objections.
"Please wait a moment then; I will call Master Huo Lian out… Since you are a regular, you must know our shop only refines low-grade magical artifacts and does not deal with mid-grade or higher," the bald man said as he turned to go deeper into the shop, then suddenly stopped and turned back to confirm.
"I am aware of that. I am here to ask Master Huo Lian to refine a low-grade magical artifact," Yuan Ming replied.
Reassured, the bald man then went into the back room.
Yuan Ming crossed his arms and lightly tapped the fingertips of one hand against his arm.
The magical artifact he sought Master Huo Lian to refine was the Thousand Mechanism Mask.
He had initially planned to ask the Three Cave Masters for help, and the compensation was already prepared.
Xi Ying had told him that the challenge in crafting the Thousand Mechanism Mask lay in engraving the runes, and Master Huo Lian excelled at rune engraving, making him seemingly more suitable for the task.
Master Huo Lian soon emerged from the back room, sizing up Yuan Ming, "Is it you who wishes to custom-order a magical artifact?"
"Indeed. I've heard of Master Huo Lian's exquisite artifact refining skills and have come especially to pay a visit," Yuan Ming said respectfully, maintaining a very humble demeanor.
"Let's dispense with the pleasantries. Tell me directly what magical artifact you want to refine," Master Huo Lian said, waving his hand and disregarding Yuan Ming's respectful attitude.
"The Thousand Mechanism Mask," Yuan Ming, seeing the direct approach of the master, said straightforwardly.
As he spoke, he took out the human-faced ghost spider face skin, white jade stone grease, and other materials.
"Although the Thousand Mechanism Mask is effective, the materials are hard to find, and not many wish to refine it. Especially the human-faced spider's face skin and white jade stone grease are often priceless. I'm surprised you managed to gather them," Master Huo Lian, holding the materials before his eyes for a few moments, shifted from his previous indifference with a hint of eagerness in his eyes.
"Master Huo Lian, may I ask how confident are you in refining it?" Yuan Ming asked bluntly.
"You're in luck. The hardest part of refining the Thousand Mechanism Mask lies in the engraving of the runes; the required rune for the Thousand Mechanism Mask is the Thousand Illusion. I have refined several illusionary-type magical artifacts and am very familiar with this rune. I can't guarantee a hundred percent, but I have about seventy to eighty percent confidence," Master Huo Lian proudly claimed.
"Then I'll leave it in your capable hands. May I know the charges for refining the artifact?" Yuan Ming, feeling a relief in his heart, bowed and asked.
Master Huo Lian said nothing; the smiling bald man stepped forward instead.
Yuan Ming and the bald man negotiated briefly, finally settling on twenty spirit stones with the artifact to be delivered in two days.
Yuan Ming paid a deposit of ten spirit stones and was about to depart when he suddenly recalled something and said, "Master Huo Lian is adept in refining, and must also be very knowledgeable about various spiritual materials. I have an item here; I hope you can help identify it."
"Let's see it then," said Master Huo Lian, responding directly upon hearing this.
Yuan Ming took out the red curved horn and handed it over.
Master Huo Lian examined it closely for a long while before he slowly set it down, his gaze somewhat complex.
"Master, how is it?" Yuan Ming asked.
Master Huo Lian remained silent, his gaze flickering uncertainly.

chapters.title: Chapter 171 - 151 Generous Rewards
chapters.content:
"If there's a fee for appraisal, Master, please don't hesitate to speak," Yuan Ming said upon seeing this.
"That won't be necessary. This Red Curved Horn contains powerful Fire Attribute Spiritual Power, and I can't determine its origin. I can only say that it's at least Mid Grade, perhaps even higher," Master Huo Lian waved his hand and said.
Yuan Ming was delighted, yet even an experienced Artifact Refiner like Huo Lian couldn't recognize the origin of the Red Curved Horn. It seemed it wouldn't be possible to find out its origin anytime soon.
"I wonder if Master Huo Lian would be willing to use this to refine a Magic Artifact?" he asked with clasped hands.
"To use it to refine a Low Grade Magical Artifact would be an appalling waste. I'm afraid I cannot assist you," Huo Lian shook his head.
Yuan Ming was taken aback and then said, "Master Huo Lian, I've seen the Magic Artifacts you've refined. The smelting, Forging Embryo, and engraving are all excellent—surely meeting the requirements to refine Mid-grade Magical Artifacts. Why do you only refine Low Grade ones?"
"Do you also understand Artifact Refining?" Huo Lian asked in return.
"I know a little," Yuan Ming replied vaguely.
"That involves my secrets and it's inconvenient to disclose," Huo Lian said, glancing at Yuan Ming before shaking his head.
"My apologies for the intrusion," Yuan Ming clasped his hands in apology, gathered the two materials, and turned to leave the Magic Artifact Shop. From behind, Huo Lian's voice reached him.
"Young friend, if you come across any good runes, remember to come find me. The price won't disappoint you."
"This Concealing Symbol claims to prevent Divine Sense spying by Cultivators below the early stages of Foundation Establishment. It appears that Master Huo Lian's Cultivation is not low!" Yuan Ming paused briefly in his steps and then continued walking without turning back, though his mind pondered deeply.

As the day was drawing to a close, with the western half of the sky turning red, it should have been a magnificent sight of crimson clouds filling the sky. However, with two large mountains surrounding Black Rock City and obscuring most of the western skyline, only threads of the red glow could be seen.
Yuan Ming looked at the sky and did not return to the inn; instead, he headed towards the South Market of Black Rock City.
He was actually quite interested in the Scatter Alliance of the South Market but had been too preoccupied with collecting spiritual materials to pay attention. Now that things had unexpectedly gone quite smoothly and he was enjoying a bit of leisure, he decided to take a look.
When he passed through the central circular plaza again, he saw an old Taoist with white hair, dressed in a tattered Daoist robe, setting up a stall. It was rather deserted, with barely anyone taking notice.
There were no Magical Artifacts or talismans for sale at the stall, nor elixir medicine books—only one item stood out: incense emitting faint fluctuations of Spiritual Power.
This immediately piqued Yuan Ming's interest. After some inquiry, he learned that the man hailed from a remote minor nation in the Eastern Domain. The incense he sold was not ordinary incense but a special kind known as "Spirit Incense." Although it wasn't a Magic Tool, talismanic pill, or elixir, it was claimed to work wonders similar to these items and could even complement elixirs.
The man sold three kinds: Qingxuan Incense, which could increase the cultivation speed of Qi Refining Stage Cultivators; Soul Nourishing Incense, which aided in nurturing the Divine Soul; and Jiangzhen Incense, which could banish ghosts and ward off evil spirits.
Its unpopularity stemmed partly from the fact that not many Cultivators in the Southern Border used incense during their practice, and partly due to its high price. A single bundle of Qingxuan Incense with thirty-six sticks was priced at twenty Spirit Stones, and each stick would only last for about a quarter of an hour—a far cry from the efficiency of elixirs that cost the same.
However, the old Taoist claimed that he was selling the incense for Spirit Stones out of a dire need arising from an unfortunate event. Otherwise, he wouldn't be selling the incense at all, giving the impression that he was practically giving it away.
When Yuan Ming expressed his desire to try the incense before deciding, the Taoist readily agreed.
Following the Old Taoist's instructions, Yuan Ming gave it a try and found that the incense truly had an effect. After negotiating like Gu Yue, he managed to buy all thirty bundles of Qingxuan Incense for fifteen Spirit Stones each, as well as ten bundles of the pricier Soul Nourishing Incense.
In this transaction, Yuan Ming spent over six hundred Spirit Stones, yet felt a tinge of excitement.
His aptitude was poor, but now armed with the Nine Elements Technique, a multitude of Nourishing Origin Pills, and this Qingxuan Incense, his cultivation during solitary meditation was bound to improve significantly.
The white-haired old Taoist smiled from ear to ear, claiming a destined connection with Yuan Ming. He introduced himself as Immortal Xuanhua, gave Yuan Ming a dirty Ancient Bronze Token, and invited him to stop by the Xuanhua Temple in the Eastern Domain whenever he was free, with the token granting entrance to join him for a drink. Then the old Taoist packed up his things and left.
After Yuan Ming stored the token and the incense, he did not linger and quickly made his way to the South Market.
The layout of the South Market resembled that of the East and West Markets, but the buildings along the streets were not shops, but residences of the Scatter Alliance. These dwellings varied in size and were spaced apart, each bearing a sign with names like "Wind-cutting Alliance" and "Broken Army Alliance."
At the entrance of these Scatter Alliance residences, people in martial attire stood guard, some in pairs, others in groups of four, all looking sturdy and fierce.
Each building had a red chart posted at its entrance, listing the specialties of the alliance: typically gathering spiritual materials, hunting Fierce Beasts, or escort services.
Comparatively, there were fewer pedestrians in the South Market at this time, making it a bit more desolate than the East and West Markets.
Yuan Ming walked slowly, his gaze sweeping across each Scatter Alliance along his path.
He suddenly stopped, looking at one particular Scatter Alliance.
The people standing at its entrance all had Central Plains features, and even the name had the distinct style of Da Jin: "Hundred Battle Alliance."
"How odd, could this be an alliance formed by Da Jin Cultivators?" Yuan Ming mused to himself.
Yuan Ming noticed the Hundred Battle Alliance, and it wasn't just because of these reasons; the list on their board contained a recruitment notice stating that anyone with cultivation above the sixth-tier Qi Refining could join.
At the moment, there were more than a dozen people gathered around the entrance, whispering about the recruitment notice, seemingly discussing matters related to this Scatter Alliance.
After listening for a while, Yuan Ming gained a general understanding of the Hundred Battle Alliance.
As he had anticipated, the Hundred Battle Alliance was indeed a Scatter Alliance founded by Loose Cultivators from Da Jin. It had entered Black Rock City this year, mainly engaging in trade missions, transporting items from Da Jin to the Southern Border and the specialties of the Southern Border back to Da Jin, profiting in the process.
Rather than calling it a Scatter Alliance, it was more like a merchant association.
Its leader was a Foundation Establishment Cultivator, and the strength of its members was also significant, with many skilled practitioners at the eighth, ninth, and even the tenth level of Qi Refinement. Although they had been in Black Rock City for only a year, they had already made quite a name for themselves.
Some time ago, they suffered losses of their members due to dangers encountered on their way back to the Southern Border from Da Jin, which is why they were openly recruiting members now.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming was somewhat tempted.
The Southern Border and Northern Territory were a long way from Da Jin, and crossing several regions of the Southern Border alone would likely prove challenging for him. Since the Hundred Battle Alliance frequently traveled between Da Jin and the Southern Border, he could potentially rely on their power to return to Da Jin.
"The White Deer Hill Assembly is imminent. After participating in the assembly, it wouldn't be too late to consider joining the Hundred Battle Alliance," he thought, and decided against approaching them right away.
Just at that moment, the crowd around him suddenly stirred and surged forward, with phrases like "so much reward" and "incredible" being faintly heard in the distance.
After a moment's contemplation, Yuan Ming followed the crowd.
The crowd stopped in front of another Scatter Alliance's establishment, a magnificent building with red tops and white walls. The plaque above its gate bore four powerful characters from the Southern Border.
"White Night Alliance..." Yuan Ming murmured to himself.
Earlier in the day, when he and Gu Yue were meandering through the workshop, he had asked Gu Yue for some information regarding the Scatter Alliances of Black Rock City and had learned a few famous names, including the White Night Alliance. Its leader, Bai Ye, was said to be a Late Foundation Establishment practitioner who was quite prestigious among the Loose Cultivators in the Southern Border.
The crowd was drawn over by the White Night Alliance's announcement board, which also posted a recruitment notice. However, they were recruiting temporary members to hunt a formidable fierce beast. The reward offered was very generous, with the performance-based maximum being up to five hundred spirit stones.
The recruitment requirements were also high, stating explicitly that one's cultivation must be above the Qi Refining Eighth Level, and one also had to pass the White Night Alliance's test to participate in this mission.
It was known that the usual tasks for Qi Refining Cultivators of Loose Cultivator alliances would typically offer five to ten spirit stones, and a reward of fifty spirit stones would be considered extremely generous.
Such a high-paying task was extremely rare in Black Rock City. Although many people were skeptical or had a wait-and-see attitude, some still stepped out from the crowd and entered the White Night Alliance's establishment.
Yuan Ming was also greatly tempted; though he currently had over a thousand spirit stones, which was considered wealthy among his peers, to further accelerate the enhancement of his cultivation and strength, even ten times more spirit stones could be spent in the blink of an eye.
He had planned to return to Biluo Cave and find new ways to earn money, but unexpectedly, he encountered a good task in Black Rock City. Although the description wasn't very clear, he just met the qualifications, so it was not an opportunity to be missed lightly.
Moreover, according to Gu Yue, the way the White Night Alliance conducted their affairs was quite upright, without any misdeeds, so this public recruitment for the hunt was unlikely to be any sort of plot.
After weighing the pros and cons in his mind, Yuan Ming stepped into the White Night Alliance.
As he walked through the gate, a courtyard appeared before him, and two men dressed in white stood in his path.
"Fellow Daoist, are you here to take part in this hunting mission?" the thin and tall man on the left, with his hands clasped behind him, looked Yuan Ming over and asked.
This man had a face full of pockmarks, sallow skin, and appeared rather uglier, yet his eyes were exceptionally bright, suggesting he practiced a certain cultivation technique.
"That's right," Yuan Ming responded.
"Fellow Daoist must have seen the requirements for participating in the hunting mission. We need to test your cultivation level; please don't take offense," the thin and tall man said.
Yuan Ming naturally nodded without any objections.
Upon hearing this, the man on the right took out a crystal sphere and pointed it at Yuan Ming. The other hand touched the sphere, and soon, the surface began to display sparkling lights, moving unpredictably.
Although Yuan Ming didn't feel anything out of the ordinary, he couldn't shake off the sensation that his body and soul were being thoroughly inspected by the other person.
A moment later, Yuan Ming's figure appeared within the sphere, surrounded by nine green glows that shone brightly.
Yuan Ming gave the crystal sphere another look. It was curious that this device could not only ascertain his cultivation level but could also detect the attributes of his cultivation technique.
"Fellow Daoist's cultivation meets the requirements; please enter the inner hall for the next round of tests," the thin and tall man with a now gentle look in his eyes said, gesturing towards a hall ahead.
Yuan Ming knew that the real test was about to begin. The White Night Alliance was not one to throw money away; since they offered a high reward of five hundred spirit stones, they would certainly have very strict criteria for the candidates.

chapters.title: Chapter 172 - 152: Night Visit to the Scatter Alliance
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming entered the hall where a middle-aged man with a dignified appearance sat firmly, his aura profound, clearly a Foundation Establishment being.
Standing beside the middle-aged man were two young individuals, a man and a woman, both clad in white. The man was handsome, and the woman was charming, appearing like an elegant couple.
Both were young, but their cultivation was extraordinary, each emitting an aura stronger than Yuan Ming's by several degrees.
"Are you the elder in charge of the test?" Yuan Ming's gaze fell on the middle-aged man as he calmly inquired, not at all intimidated by the unique pressure exuded by a Foundation Establishment cultivator.
"Indeed, I am Huan Shi, Vice Alliance Hierarch of the White Night Scatter Alliance. This hunting mission is of no small matter, and for the safety of our guests and the interests of our alliance, we must be cautious in selecting our members. I hope you can understand," the middle-aged man said with a light smile, his demeanor quite courteous.
"Of course, may I know what the test involves?" Yuan Ming asked.
"The test is simple; the mission requires a certain level of strength. If you can last a quarter of an hour against one of these two behind me without using any magic artifacts or talismans, you will have passed," Huan Shi stated.
"Is that all?" Yuan Ming had expected a difficult test, but this sounded relatively straightforward.
"A Qi Refining Ninth Level like you sure talks big. Let's see how capable you really are!" The young man in white couldn't help but retort coldly upon hearing this.
Huan Shi, upon hearing Yuan Ming's response, also raised his eyebrows, looking at Yuan Ming with interest.
"Come with me!" The young man in white walked towards a side hall next to the main hall.
Seeing that Huan Shi did not stop him, Yuan Ming followed.
The space of the side hall was not smaller than that of the main hall. Its thick stone walls were reinforced with forbidden spells, and the floor was paved with thick slabs of stone, making it look like a room specifically designed for martial contests.
"You make the first move," said the young man in white, closing the door behind him with an air of arrogance.
Without a moment's hesitation, Yuan Ming readied himself, sinking his energy into his dantian as he adopted the Shadowless Step stance.
…
A quarter of an hour later, the side hall's doors were pushed open, and Yuan Ming walked out at a leisurely pace, his breathing normal, clothes as tidy as before, and his bamboo hat still intact.
A few breaths after, the young man in white also emerged.
Half of his body was charred black, his hair burned away on one side, and his right cheek swollen, making him look quite disheveled.
"Brother, are you alright?" the woman in white rushed up anxiously to support him.
The young man looked dejected, opened his mouth as if to say something, but eventually, he said nothing.
In the side hall just before, he had been confident that his cultivation was superior to Yuan Ming's and allowed Yuan Ming to take the initiative. However, Yuan Ming stood still and even asked if it was enough just to last a quarter of an hour, much to his irritation.
Unable to restrain himself, he attacked first, but when Yuan Ming moved, his movement technique was unpredictably strange. He simply evaded repeatedly, and the young man not only couldn't catch up to him but also couldn't land any spells or techniques, which Yuan Ming narrowly avoided with his peculiar step technique.
After enduring for longer than the time it takes to drink a cup of tea, the young man, frustrated and angered by Yuan Ming's ever-smiling, handsome face, recklessly activated a magic artifact, intending to teach Yuan Ming a lesson.
Unexpectedly, Yuan Ming suddenly raised one hand, the tip of his finger glowing with a ball of fire, seemingly ready to cast the Fireball Technique, but whether due to lack of skill or something else, he couldn't release it and seemed somewhat flustered.
Not wishing to miss such an opportunity, he pressed on, aiming to deliver a thunderous blow.
However, just as he closed in, the "fireball" that was slightly larger than a regular Fireball Technique suddenly exploded, and he was too close to avoid it, taking a minor but significant hit.
Given his prideful nature and since he had already resorted to using a magic artifact, he felt he had no place to complain.
However, Huan Shi's expression remained calm as he had been using his Divine Sense to track the battle inside the side hall.
"So, have I passed the test?" Yuan Ming asked Huan Shi.
"Of course. You are modest yet possess deep hidden strength, easily defeating my foolish disciple. I am impressed," Huan Shi lauded with a smile.
"I merely abided by the rules set by your esteemed alliance and was lucky to hold out for a quarter of an hour," Yuan Ming humbly maintained.
"It's even rarer to find someone who is victorious without being arrogant. I am curious to know which Fellow Daoist is fortunate enough to have you as a disciple. I envy them," Huan Shi said with a light sigh, probing with his question.
Yuan Ming merely returned a polite smile, not taking the bait.
"Hehe, take this token. We will meet ten days from now at Ghost Cry Gorge in the Ten Thousand Mountains. The specific details of the mission will be disclosed to you there," Huan Shi produced a white jade token and handed it to Yuan Ming.
"Ten days later..." Yuan Ming murmured.
This gave him ample time to return to Biluo Cave and refine his Green Fish Sword into a magic artifact, which would significantly enhance his power.
"Elder Huan Shi, since I have passed the assessment, may I be enlightened about the target fierce beast? It would allow me to prepare adequately in advance," Yuan Ming inquired after some thought.
"It's not that our alliance wants to keep things hidden. It's truly out of necessity. If news of that fierce beast spreads, our alliance will be put in a very passive position and could even cause the mission to fail directly. Young friend, please be patient. Once we gather at Ghost Cry Gorge, every detail about this mission will be fully disclosed," Huan Shi shook his head and said.
Yuan Ming's eyebrows furrowed slightly as he spoke again, "Since there is a reason behind this, I will not inquire what the fierce beast is. However, could you inform me of the strength of that fierce beast?"
"That is possible. Our target this time is a second-level fierce beast. However, you need not worry, young friend. High-level Foundation Establishment experts from our alliance will also accompany us, and this mission is not just recruiting you alone," said Huan Shi.
Seeing that he couldn't get more information, Yuan Ming took his leave and departed.
The sky outside had darkened, and the stream of people in South City grew increasingly sparse.
Yuan Ming did not go far. He found an inn nearby to stay and closed his eyes to rest.
Time passed by little by little, and soon it was past midnight.
He took out the incense burner, as usual, channeled mana into it, and the Tai Chi pattern quickly lit up, the missing point swiftly filled in.
Yuan Ming put away the incense burner and looked out the window towards the White Night Scatter Alliance's quarters.
"At this time, the selection should have ended," he murmured to himself. He sat cross-legged on the bed. A black light flashed between his brows, and a soul crow flew out, heading towards the White Night Scatter Alliance's location.
Although Huan Shi sounded certain, Yuan Ming didn't dare to fully trust him. As his life and fortune were at stake, he had to personally investigate what exactly this beast hunting mission from the White Night Scatter Alliance was about.
With the speed of the soul crow, it quietly arrived at the Scatter Alliance's headquarters. By then, the gates were tightly shut, and recruitment activities had ended.
Despite being late at night, many rooms in the headquarters were still brightly lit, filled with people engaging in lively conversations, their voices incessantly heard.
Yuan Ming listened for a while. They were talking about trivial and complex matters, unrelated to the hunting mission. He then controlled the soul crow to fly deeper into the headquarters.
The headquarters of the White Night Scatter Alliance covered a large area. The small paths between several buildings interconnected, spreading out like blood vessels into the depths of the headquarters, sinking into the darkness, making it difficult to determine where important figures resided at a glance.
The soul crow perched on a tree branch, contemplating which direction to go.
Just then, the sound of footsteps approached, and a tall woman came by—it was the white-clothed woman who had stood behind Huan Shi during the earlier test.
The woman was seen holding a tray with tea and refreshments, seemingly on her way to deliver them somewhere.
Considering the daytime situation, this white-clothed woman held a high position. Whoever merited her personal tea service must be an important person within the White Night Scatter Alliance, perhaps even Huan Shi himself.
The soul crow flapped its wings silently and followed her.This text was acquired from *.
The white-clothed woman soon arrived at a two-story pavilion and entered.
The soul crow too approached the pavilion and heard faint voices coming from a room on the second floor, one of them undoubtedly belonging to Huan Shi.
"Found them at last," Yuan Ming hastily controlled the soul crow to fly over.
Considering Huan Shi's status as a Foundation Establishment cultivator with powerful divine sense, he didn't allow the soul crow to get too close, settling it on a large tree two zhang away, concealed in the darkness.
"Is everything arranged on all fronts?" Huan Shi asked.
"All arrangements are in place. Up to today, we have recruited a total of fifty-five people. According to our previous estimates, even if only sixty percent of them ultimately stay, that would still suffice to deal with the group of Golden Flower Poison Pythons and locate the Python King's nest," another voice sounded, the white-clothed youth he had defeated earlier in the day.
"Excellent. The Golden Flower Python King's snake gallbladder has likely transformed into a snake pearl by now. That is a treasure beyond price; we must not lose it," Huan Shi advised.
"Master, rest assured, your disciple is very careful. I only told those who came in response to the recruitment that we were hunting a second-level fierce beast. For those who attempted to inquire about specific information regarding the fierce beast, I dealt with them ambiguously. Among them, a few are suspected of being from other Scatter Alliances who infiltrated to gather intelligence—those, too, have been dealt with," the white-clothed youth replied.
"Very good," said Huan Shi.
Inside the inn, a hint of unusual color flashed in Yuan Ming's eyes.
This reconnaissance with the soul crow turned out to be quite fruitful, uncovering the White Night Scatter Alliance's real target.
He had some understanding of the Golden Flower Poison Python; it was one of the group-dwelling fierce beasts in the Ten Thousand Mountains. With tough scales and flesh and highly potent venom, it was one of the most troublesome among the many types of python fierce beasts and was among a few extremely dangerous beasts that even Fur Beast Slaves typically dared not hunt. Clearly, the true aim of the White Night Scatter Alliance was that very Golden Flower Python King.
Regardless of the Snake King's actual strength, just the need to gather so many people for the hunt indicates that the mission wasn't as simple as they had described.
As for the previously mentioned maximum reward of five hundred spirit stones, although tempting, it probably wouldn't be that easy to obtain. There would likely be stringent requirements set.
No matter what, given his current strength and his familiarity with the terrain of the Ten Thousand Mountains, he should be able to ensure his own safety as long as he proceeded with caution.
Just at that moment, another voice came from the soul crow's location—it was the white-clothed youth.
"Master, you used your divine sense to observe that fellow with the bamboo hat during our encounter earlier today. Were you able to discern his origins?"
Yuan Ming was taken aback, not expecting the conversation to suddenly turn to him. He hurriedly pricked up his ears to listen intently.

chapters.title: Chapter 173 - 153: Ghost Market
chapters.content:
Inside the room, Huan Shi picked up his teacup and took a sip before looking at the young man in white, speaking indifferently, "What, are you that concerned about losing to him?"
"I truly can't accept losing to a Qi Refining Ninth Level." The young man in white sounded aggrieved.
"In that competition, you lost fairly." Huan Shi observed the young man in white for a moment before speaking slowly.
The young man in white didn't speak, his breathing grew heavy, clearly unconvinced.
"Although your cultivation is higher than his, your experience facing an enemy is far less than his, and your overconfidence and recklessness were bound to lead to defeat," Huan Shi continued slowly.
"The lesson from Master is well taken," the young man in white responded softly, his eyes flickering.
"I know you want to challenge that man again to regain your honor, but with your current strength, it's impossible for you to be a match for that hat-wearing youngster. Moreover, with a major event imminent, do not cause conflicts over trifles. You know very well the consequences if you disrupt the Alliance Hierarch's plans!" Huan Shi furrowed his brows, his tone becoming serious.
"Master, rest assured, I understand what's important," the young man in white, upon hearing the term 'Alliance Hierarch', changed his expression and answered respectfully.
"Heh, youngsters should have some vigor, that's good. You've lost this time, so you should practice hard and strive to reclaim the upper hand the next time you meet. Brother Yuan, don't be too suppressive and snuff out Tuozhe's youthful spirit." The room's door was pushed open, and a majestic man walked in, with that white-clothed woman following by his side.
"Big brother, weren't you in secluded cultivation? Why did you come over?" Huan Shi stood up, his voice filled with surprise.
"Alliance Hierarch." The young man in white hurriedly got up to pay his respects.
"Could this be Bai Ye, the leader of the Scatter Alliance?" Yuan Ming, upon hearing this, quickly controlled the soul crow to conceal its presence, yet listened even more intently.
With the appearance of the White Night Alliance Hierarch, they would probably discuss even more confidential information, which might relate to the mission.
"Cultivation breakthroughs aren't achieved overnight. I heard from Ling'er that preparations for the task of hunting the Golden Flower Python King are nearly done; I came to ask about the situation," the majestic man spoke.
"Everything's almost ready, we—"
The soul crow listened closely to the conversation inside the room, but at that moment, the voices inside abruptly stopped, and the sound of their breathing could no longer be heard.
"Everyone is obviously still in the room, so why has it suddenly gone quiet? It seems someone used something like a soundproofing shield talisman. Bai Ye really is cautious in his actions," Yuan Ming showed a look of regret.
Those people were probably discussing even more confidential matters next, but unfortunately, the soul crow's divine skills were limited and couldn't penetrate the soundproofing shield. This reconnaissance would have to end here.
Luckily, he had already obtained quite a bit of information and had some grasp of the situation; it wasn't a wasted effort.
Yuan Ming called the soul crow back, stood up from the bed, and prepared to leave. His eyes swept over his right arm, and suddenly an idea occurred to him.
The soul crow couldn't investigate the soundproofed area, but the incense burner seemed to have no such limitation. If he could directly possess it like he had with the Emperor, maybe he could openly listen to the conversation of the few people?
With the incense burner's mystery, Bai Ye probably wouldn't detect it, and it was a good chance to test the effect of the newly prepared incense.
"Why didn't I think of using the incense burner for reconnaissance like this before? It seems I still have much to learn about utilizing the incense burner!" Yuan Ming muttered to himself, took out the incense burner, lit a newly made stick of incense, and continuously brought to mind the appearance of the young man in white from the daytime.
Gradually, darkness fell before his eyes, his consciousness plunging into darkness, quickly returning to clarity as a spacious and elegant room came into his view.
Yuan Ming stood on the right side of the room, alongside that white-clothed woman, with Huan Shi and a burly man sitting across from him on two large chairs made of yellow wood.
"It actually worked! It seems using concentrated thought to lock onto the possession target was the correct method!" Yuan Ming thought with joy, quickly sobering up.
"Is this man Bai Ye?" He anxiously looked towards the burly man opposite.
Despite his confidence in the incense burner, a Late-stage Foundation Establishment Cultivator wasn't someone to be taken lightly; they might possess some extraordinary cultivation technique that could sense his presence.
Bai Ye was looking toward Huan Shi without the slightest awareness of Yuan Ming's possession.
Yuan Ming listened to the conversation of the few people.
"...I haven't seen that person before; his face is unfamiliar. His cultivation isn't high, merely at the Qi Refining Ninth Level, but his mana is extraordinarily refined. He practices a superior cultivation technique, certainly not ordinary for a Loose Cultivator, he's very likely a core disciple from some sect." Contrary to Yuan Ming's expectations, Huan Shi was discussing him.
"Black Rock City is a famous workshop market in the North Territory. It's common for sect disciples to come here incognito to take on tasks after descending the mountain, no need to mind them," Bai Ye replied.
"The Alliance Hierarch is right. With such high rewards on offer this time, there should be more than that youngster from the sects who have signed up. With these people joining, the mission should proceed without issue," Huan Shi said.
"We only need those people to help us find the den. Give a bit more reward to the one who finds it and some compensation to the rest. Although we may be exaggerating the rewards, we haven't broken any rules. As for the Python King in the end, we will have to deal with it ourselves; those people are unreliable. Is the Obstacle Avoidance Pearl ready?" Bai Ye slowly shook his head before changing the subject.
"Poison Shadow just sent a message, saying that the Obstacle Avoidance Pearl has been refined. The transaction will happen tonight at the Ghost Market," Huan Shi answered, taking out a piece of white paper with a few lines of small characters written on it.
"Good, with the Obstacle Avoidance Pearl, the Poison Miasma of Snake King Valley is nothing to worry about. The Ghost Market is complex. Just to be safe, Brother Yuan, you should personally go tonight to make sure this matter is well taken care of," Bai Ye nodded, then instructed.
"That might be problematic. That Poison Shadow is very cautious. He specifically mentioned in his message that the transaction must be made with a Qi Refining Stage Cultivator," Huan Shi said as he presented the note with several rows of small characters.
Bai Ye took the paper, which outlined the method of transaction. It required a Qi Refining disciple to come to a certain place in the Ghost Market for a meeting, after which they would verify the secret signal before trading the goods.
"Hehe, this Poison Shadow is indeed as cunning and cautious as the rumors say. Since that's the case, let Tuozhe make a trip for this matter," Bai Ye chuckled and passed the paper to the young man in white.
"Yes." The young man in white accepted the paper, and Yuan Ming also saw the content written on it.
At that moment, his vision quickly turned pitch black; the time for possession had reached its limit.
...
In the inn, Yuan Ming slowly opened his eyes.
This time, the duration of possession had lasted for roughly over twenty breaths, which was twice as long as before, proving the effectiveness of the incense made with spirit wood ground into powder and mixed with incense ashes.
"Overall there doesn't seem to be any issues with this task, at least the White Night Alliance has no schemes to harm anyone. The reward, as expected, is just a gimmick, but when it comes to finding dens, with the soul crow on my side, I don't have too much to worry about. If I can make a profit in spirit stones just like this, it wouldn't be a loss," Yuan Ming stroked his chin, pondering inwardly.
After sitting quietly in the room for a while, his expression changing unpredictably, he rose to his feet once again and left the inn.
An hour later, sitting opposite Gu Yue in a secluded room of a teahouse in the West Market, Yuan Ming spoke.
"I apologize for calling Brother Gu Yue out so late," Yuan Ming said.
"Brother Yuan, why say such things? I am grateful for your patronage of my business, and am far from placing any blame. If there's anything you need, just speak freely. I will do my utmost to assist," Gu Yue hastened to say.
My Virtual Library Empire (*) hosts the original.
"I wish to inquire with Brother Gu about this so-called Ghost Market," Yuan Ming asked, getting straight to the point.
When Bai Ye and Huan Shi mentioned the Ghost Market, their tone was clearly different; this place must be extraordinary.
"Where did Brother Yuan hear about the Ghost Market?" Gu Yue asked, visibly surprised.
"I heard people mention it while I was strolling this afternoon. Brother Gu mentioned during the day that Black Rock City has East, West, South, and North Markets, so where does this Ghost Market come from?" Yuan Ming asked half-truthfully.
"How to explain it? The Ghost Market is also considered a trading market, but it only opens after midnight. It is the covert counterpart to the open daylight workshops, thus it's called the Ghost Market. However, the items traded there are mostly things that cannot be circulated openly, such as stolen loot from murder and theft, forbidden items of the Cultivation World, and so on. These transactions are too conspicuous in daylight; therefore, they're held at midnight," Gu Yue said, scratching his head.
"From what you're saying, there must be plenty of good items in the Ghost Market, and the prices shouldn't be too high," Yuan Ming, not averse to such business, asked with interest.
"The Ghost Market has all kinds of Magic Tools Talismans elixirs; it's just that most of the goods come from dubious sources, so their prices are relatively low. But it's a place with a dangerous mix of characters, and the waters are too deep. I also can't say it's without risks, so those of us in the middlemen trade don't easily get involved with the Ghost Market," Gu Yue admitted candidly.
Yuan Ming nodded slowly, weighing his thoughts.
"If I wanted to visit the Ghost Market, how would I get there?" Yuan Ming asked, sensing the other's reluctance to go to the Ghost Market.
Gu Yue told him an address and warned him of the precautions to take once inside.
"The matters of the Ghost Market involve wide-ranging consequences. Some have scored great finds and made a fortune, while others have paid with their lives for selling or buying things they shouldn't have. Brother Yuan, if you do trade there, please be extremely careful," Gu Yue cautioned.
Yuan Ming gave his acknowledgment and tried to offer Gu Yue compensation, but Gu Yue declined this time, and Yuan Ming did not persist.
"The market opens at midnight, and it's about time now." Yuan Ming hastened his steps, soon arriving at a small alley where the common folk of Black Rock City lived in the northwest.
The night was exceptionally dark here; even things just a few metres away were hard to see, and the air seemed to stir with a swirling Black Mist.
Sensing fluctuations of mana from within the black fog, Yuan Ming knew he hadn't found the wrong place. He continued forward, the darkness growing thicker until he could barely see his hand in front of him.
He activated his Divine Sense to explore and moved unhindered.
A few more steps forward, and a high, thick stone wall appeared, completely blocking the path ahead.
"I wish to enter the Ghost Market," Yuan Ming said, not attempting to scale the wall but instead addressing a seemingly unremarkable shadow on the right side of the stone wall in a deep voice.
As his voice fell, a black silhouette emerged from the shadow, showing no breath or life sign, resembling a ghostly shadow.
"Fellow Daoist, do you want to hang a lantern or seek a fire?" the shadowy figure scrutinized Yuan Ming and asked in a hoarse voice.
This was the secret code of the Ghost Market: "hanging a lantern" meant setting up a stall, while "seeking a fire" referred to buying things.
"Seeking a fire," Yuan Ming responded.
The shadow did not speak but waved its hand over the wall.
From within the thick wall came clicking sounds of gears turning, and a crack formed in the center, gradually widening until it became a three-foot-wide passage.

chapters.title: Chapter 174 - 154: Soul-Attracting Bell
chapters.content:
"Thank you," Yuan Ming said, walking towards the passage.
"Is this Fellow Daoist's first time at the Ghost Market? Are you planning to just go in like that?" The shadow suddenly spoke.
"What do you mean by that?" Yuan Ming found this person's sudden conversation a bit strange, yet he did not lie and asked.
"Although Fellow Daoist is wearing a hat, such a level of disguise can be easily penetrated by a sweep of Divine Sense. Do you not know that in the Ghost Market, being seen in your true face is extremely dangerous?" the shadow said.
Yuan Ming was taken aback; Gu Yue had not mentioned this.
The shadow's words made some sense, but since the Thousand Mechanism Mask was not yet refined, he could not conceal his face.
"Fellow Daoist need not worry. Here is a Concealment Cloak that can hide your aura and block Divine Sense. Once you wear it, I guarantee no one will recognize you. We met today for a reason. I'll sell it to you for fifty Spirit Stones, or you can rent it for five Spirit Stones for one use. How about it?" The shadow took out a hooded gray-black cloak, his tone becoming eager.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming realized, and couldn't help but feel both amused and annoyed.
This shadow had stopped him because he wanted to do business.
He used his Divine Sense to touch the gray-black cloak and was rudely rebuffed by an invisible force.
Yuan Ming's eyes brightened; this cloak really could block Divine Sense. It was indeed a good item.
However, his Thousand Mechanism Mask would be ready soon, so there was no need to spend a lot of money to buy this item.
"I'll rent it for one use, one Spirit Stone." Yuan Ming took out a Spirit Stone and handed it over.
"Hehe." The shadow chuckled, swept the Spirit Stone with his sleeve, and tossed the cloak over.
Yuan Ming put on the cloak, and his mana aura was completely concealed, with his scent also vanishing without a trace.
He felt the cloak; it was not made of cloth but woven from a soft, black grass stem, which he seemed to have seen somewhere before.
Yuan Ming thought carefully, and the image of Old Smoke Bag suddenly emerged in his Sea of Consciousness.
His memory was mostly restored, and he vaguely remembered being picked up by Old Smoke Bag.
The day he was picked up from the riverbank by Old Smoke Bag, he had used a mat to cover him and other bodies to conceal the smell of decay. That mat seemed to be woven from this type of grass stem, apparently a specialty of the Southern Border.
"Please enter, Fellow Daoist. Remember, do not follow any seller out!" The black shadow reminded and then vanished into the darkness.
Yuan Ming stepped into the wall passage and quickly reached the end. The lighting ahead became normal, and a dim square came into view.
Looking around, he saw that the area was filled with small stalls, each vendor's face covered, looking rather makeshift, nowhere near the scale and grandeur of Black Rock City Market.
In the square, sparse visitors could be seen, each concealing their true faces. Most wore the same black cloak as Yuan Ming, obviously all either bought or rented from the black shadow, looking shadowy and indistinct.
After a brief survey, Yuan Ming casually walked towards the nearest stall.
This stall had nothing else on display, only two corpses lying side by side, their bodies covered in green scale armor and a faint black mist emerging from their surfaces.
"Refining corpses."
From the information Yuan Ming had previously studied in the sect, he recognized the two corpses had reached the "Green Steel Corpse" level, a fairly high-grade level of corpse refining within the Black Fire Sect, not commonly let out of the sect. It was unexpected to find them in the Ghost Market, and even more so to see two at once.
Looking at the two Green Steel Corpses, Yuan Ming was somewhat tempted.
The bodies of Green Steel Corpses were harder than iron, their combat power was comparable to the peak of the Qi Refining, even capable of withstanding attacks from Foundation Establishment Cultivators—much beyond the Human Demons refined by Hu Huo. Having one would be greatly beneficial in combat.
"How much for these two refining corpses?" Just then, another person clad in a black cloak came over and inquired.
"Eight hundred Spirit Stones each, the price is firm," the gray-robed, hooded vendor responded without lifting his head.
"Would you sell for five hundred?" the person asked.
"I said the price is firm. Even if you offer a thousand Spirit Stones outside this place, you won't be able to buy them," the vendor said coldly.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming shook his head and walked away.
The price was too high; better to look at other things.
He continued to look at several stalls. The items were indeed fine, even some suitable for Foundation Establishment Cultivators.
Soon, Yuan Ming stopped in front of another small stall.
Behind the stall sat a person in a green robe with a bronze mask, likely a woman by the figure.
Yuan Ming's gaze continued to sweep over the stall.
His eyes shifted and landed on a silver-white bell-shaped magic artifact.
He was more than familiar with this object; it was the same used by Hu Zha and others to collect the souls of Exotic Beasts.
"What is the use of this item, and how much does it cost?" Yuan Ming pointed at the bell, pretending not to recognize it as he asked. Enjoythestorybyreadingon*.
"This Soul-Attracting Bell, though a low-grade magical artifact, possesses soul collection and soul strike effects. When used against mortals, it causes light memory loss, and in severe cases, loss of the soul. Against cultivators, it can cause brief dizziness and memory loss. Despite being low-grade, it is an exclusive magical artifact of Biluo Cave, highly sought after by many cultivators. It sells for sixty spirit stones." the woman in the green robe said in a low voice.
"It can cause mortals to lose their memory." Yuan Ming was taken aback.
He had lost his previous memories when he entered Biluo Cave and had only recalled most of them to date. If this Soul-Attracting Bell had such effects besides soul collection, he suspected he might have been struck by this bell as well.
He had finally found the cause of his memory loss!
Yuan Ming couldn't help but feel inwardly resentful!
He must acquire this bell!
"The effects of this Soul-Attracting Bell are indeed somewhat miraculous, but the spiritual power contained within is weak, and it is a low-grade magical artifact. I fear it might only be useful against low-level Qi Refinement cultivators. As for dealing with mortals, it's a bit of an overkill. Sixty spirit stones are too much; I can only offer twenty," Yuan Ming said.
"Twenty? You must not underestimate this bell. If you were to spend a spring night with a mortal woman you fancy, this magical artifact is most suitable. Fifty-five!" the woman in the green robe said, lowering her voice, "If the Young Master of White Dragon Island had not died, could I sell it to you for cheap?"
"How could I possibly be such a person? Twenty-five, that should suffice!"
"Fifty!"
After some haggling, the stall owner relented to thirty-two spirit stones.
After Yuan Ming left, the woman quickly departed too.
At another stall, there was an antique book displayed, titled "Array Dao Miscellaneous Discussion."
In recent days at the workshop, Yuan Ming had frequently come across matters related to arrays, sparking some interest in them. He wasn't looking to get distracted by learning, but gaining some understanding was essential, so he paid three spirit stones for it.
Having roamed the market for an hour, he stood up from in front of a small stall and spent thirty spirit stones on three somewhat shriveled black fruits.
According to the stall owner, these objects came from a unique tree owned by a family in the Southern Border Southern Domain, which bore this strange fruit every few hundred years. Fierce beasts that ate it could quickly increase their fertility rates. If these fruits were placed in the mountains and forests, even the scent they emitted would attract fierce beasts from hundreds of yards around to vie for them.
Yuan Ming had now visited most of the stalls at Ghost Market. Apart from these three black fruits, he bought a few other items: four talismans, three yellow elixir pills, and over thirty types of spirit wood and grass.
The four talismans were called Four Directions Sealing Spirit Talismans, which had to be used together to form a concealment barrier, hiding all traces of aura fluctuations and concealing actions, suitable for resting in the wild.
Unlike common talismans, this talisman was of a type where its power was slowly triggered, allowing for multiple uses.
The three elixir pills were not ordinary elixirs, but a commonly used poison attack method in the Hundred Poison Cave — upon hitting the enemy, they would burst into a cloud of poisonous dust, similar to the smoke bombs he used frequently before.
As for the spirit wood and grass, they were spontaneous purchases he wanted to experiment with incense making. After this exploration of White Night Scatter Alliance, Yuan Ming had a deep appreciation for the magic of incense burners. However, the duration of Black Incense was too short to bring out the effects of the incense burners, and he had to find a way to prolong it.
His knowledge of incense materials was still insufficient, so he could only use the most straightforward method: buying various spiritual materials and trying them out gradually.
These items all went for somewhat lower than market price, but altogether they still added up to quite a bit, totaling about two hundred spirit stones. Including earlier expenses, he now had just over four hundred spirit stones left in his storage ring.
This trip to Ghost Market had been quite fruitful.
Yet, in one corner, he unexpectedly spotted the Yin Ghost Flag of Kun Tu for sale!
The seller's face was unknown, but was unquestionably an accomplice of Wulu. Yuan Ming was about to approach and strike a conversation when another cultivator beat him to it and bought it, while the seller quickly left the scene. Yuan Ming dared not follow.
Yuan Ming continued onward, and ahead on the edge of the plaza, a black stone pillar appeared, embedded with several pieces of fluorescent stone, illuminating a large area around it.
Such pillars, of which there were four in the marketplace, located at the four corners, lit up the entire plaza with their glow.
With the aid of the light, Yuan Ming looked around. At this moment, there were significantly fewer stalls than when he first arrived.
Below one of the stone pillars was a stall, manned by an old man with one arm, who wore a fox mask and was currently sitting in a rickety bamboo chair with his eyes closed, resting.
The stall had a few items casually displayed, mostly spiritual materials, and one magical artifact, a dark red small shield.
A glint appeared in Yuan Ming's eyes as he squatted in front of the small stall and said, "May I take a look at this magical artifact?"
"Please," the old man said without opening his eyes.
Yuan Ming picked up the shield, channeled his mana into it, and the shield immediately levitated, emitting a red glow. A red rune flashed into existence.
"A low-grade magical artifact, what a pity!" he thought to himself.
With that thought, Yuan Ming set down the dark red small shield, preparing to leave.
The one-armed old man opened his eyes and stopped Yuan Ming, "Fellow Daoist, please wait a moment."
"What is it?" Yuan Ming paused and asked.
"Are you looking to buy a defensive magical artifact? This Fire Rock Shield is still quite decent. If my fellow Daoist likes it, I can offer it for less," the one-armed old man said with a smile.
"I'm not interested," Yuan Ming replied.
"Please forgive my presumption, but do you have any beast eggs or exotic beasts on you?" the one-armed old man asked.
At these words, a sharp light suddenly flashed through Yuan Ming's eyes. He had not only the Black Toad but also a blue beast egg.

chapters.title: Chapter 175 - 155: Gold-Plated Gauze
chapters.content:
"Fellow Daoist, please don't misunderstand, I hail from Da Jin and frequently travel to and from the Southern Border, trading various odd insects and exotic beasts. Especially in the black market here in the Southern Border, disciples from various Sects often sell off unique insects and exotic beasts indigenous to the region. Moreover, transactions in the Ghost Market are always kept confidential, as you know, which is why I ask everyone who passes by my stall," the one-armed elder hastily explained.
"Oh! Is that so?" Yuan Ming's expression remained tense.
"This is something I just bought; if you don't believe me, you can verify it." The one-armed elder took out a small blue bag from behind, which appeared to be a Spiritual Beast Bag.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming's suspicions began to fade.
So this person was seemingly selling goods in the black market but was in fact purchasing.
A thought struck him, considering the blue Beast Egg had a somewhat dubious origin and he didn't want to bring trouble upon himself because of it, he decided to take the opportunity to exchange it for some Spirit Stones.
"I indeed have an exotic beast at hand, but I'm not short of Spirit Stones and have no intent to sell, I'm afraid I'll have to disappoint you, Fellow Daoist," Yuan Ming feigned reluctance.
The one-armed elder didn't show much disappointment upon hearing this, but instead calmly called out to him.
His family specialized in breeding snake-like fierce beasts, often acquiring exotic beasts from the Southern Border and then raising and selling them to Sects in Central Earth, where such beasts were rare and highly sought-after.
He also bought Magical Artifacts and spiritual materials at low prices from the Da Jin Square to sell in the Southern Border, doubling profits through these deals.
"If Fellow Daoist isn't short of Spirit Stones, I also collect quite a few other items - spiritual materials, elixirs, talismans - and these two Defensive Magical Artifacts as well, you may pick anything you like," he said.
As he spoke, the one-armed elder took out a Storage Bag and surprisingly offered it directly.
The Storage Bag contained numerous talismans, elixirs, and two Defensive Magical Artifacts, which also seemed to be of Low Grade, judging from their aura.
"I don't need any of these. In fact, I have a Beast Egg, extremely precious, pity you can't afford it," Yuan Ming taunted.
"Is that so? May I take a look?"
"Please do." Yuan Ming brought out the blue Beast Egg, and the elder looked closely at it. It was a variety he had never encountered before, and his face showed undisguised joy.
"I'm not lacking Spirit Stones, but I want to exchange for a Mid-grade Magical Artifact," Yuan Ming stated.
"A Mid-grade Magical Artifact? I'm just a common peddler, how could I possess such treasures? You overestimate me. Why not exchange for something from this Storage Bag instead? Take another look?" the one-armed elder tapped the Storage Bag.
"Then forget about it," Yuan Ming promptly returned the Storage Bag and walked away without hesitation.
The one-armed elder was taken aback, watching Yuan Ming's retreating figure and feeling a surge of anxiety.
As Yuan Ming's silhouette was about to vanish from view, he quickly caught up, calling out, "Fellow Daoist, please hold on, I just remembered, I happen to have a Mid-grade Magical Artifact on me, see if you're interested."
Yuan Ming slowed his pace and walked back.
With a grit of his teeth, the one-armed elder reached into his chest and brought out a small black Jade Box, carefully opening just a sliver.
Yuan Ming's Divine Sense penetrated the box, revealing a pale golden gauze inside, woven from gold silk, measuring three feet long and half a foot wide, neatly folded within, emitting a golden luminescence throughout.
Just by the appearance, the golden gauze was very different from the previous red shield.
Yuan Ming marshaled his Divine Sense towards the gauze's interior, an invisible force within the gauze withstood his probing.
Activating the Moonlight Technique, his powerful Divine Sense burst forth, suddenly breaking through the gauze's resistance and reaching its depths.
The gauze vibrated with a "hum" and radiated bright golden light, leaking out from the cracks of the box as two golden runes appeared momentarily.
The one-armed elder jumped in fright and hurriedly shut the box, the escaping golden light vanishing after a brief moment.
"Does Fellow Daoist have any doubts regarding the grade of this treasure?" the one-armed elder asked.
"This gauze barely qualifies as a Mid-grade Magical Artifact; how should we trade?" asked Yuan Ming. He had just acquired a Mid-grade Defensive Magical Artifact Shuiyun Banner, and upon returning to Biluo Cave, the Three Cave Masters would aid him in refining the Green Fish Sword. With one defensive and one offensive Magical Artifact at hand, his current loadout was sufficient.
However, considering Xi Ying, who had helped him several times, if he kept taking without giving anything back, he would feel uneasy. Perhaps Xi Ying, with his discerning taste, would appreciate this gauze.
"What do you mean 'barely'? This Gold-plated Gauze was prepared as a birthday gift for my daughter, its defensive capability is much stronger than that of ordinary Mid-grade Magical Artifacts. If not for this Beast Egg, I wouldn't sell it for anything, I'm asking for seven hundred Spirit Stones!" the one-armed elder declared emphatically.
"This gauze is only a Mid-grade Magical Artifact. In the normal Magic Artifact Shops, ordinary Mid-grade Defensive Magical Artifacts cost merely five hundred Spirit Stones, let alone one being sold in the Ghost Market? Four hundred Spirit Stones is the most I can offer," Yuan Ming spoke unhurriedly.
"The Gold-plated Gauze I have is made from the silk of Gold-plated silkworms, mixed with soft gold stone, refined iron, and other precious materials. It's simply not comparable to ordinary Mid-grade Magical Artifacts. Moreover, its origin is clear, and once Fellow Daoist purchases it, it can be used freely. Naturally, it can't be sold at the price of items in the Ghost Market," the one-armed elder countered.Sample from My Virtual Library Empire—read more on M&VLEMPY&R.
"I'm not concerned about the origin of this item, otherwise, I wouldn't be here at the Ghost Market. In fact, I just spent five hundred Spirit Stones to buy this Beast Egg, and I've spent quite a few more Spirit Stones to maintain it recently," Yuan Ming retorted pointedly.
After a brief exchange, the one-armed elder's tone softened considerably. Following some haggling, the Gold-plated Gauze was settled for five hundred Spirit Stones.
Yuan Ming's Beast Egg, meanwhile, was offset to the other party for two hundred Spirit Stones.
A battle of words concluded, with both parties getting what they needed in the end.
Yuan Ming did not continue to stay in the Ghost Market, returning the black cloak to the market's gatekeeper and, with the last remaining mid-grade spirit stone in his storage bag, he left the place.
He took a roundabout route, releasing the soul crow to scout behind him, and only after confirming that he wasn't being followed did he return to the inn.
Upon entering his room, Yuan Ming immediately closed the door and windows tightly and took out the Four Directions Sealing Spirit Talisman, pasting them on the walls and over the doors and windows.
Waves of spiritual energy emanated outwards, merging together to form a barrier-like structure that enveloped the entire room, entirely blocking out any outside noise.
Yuan Ming waved his hand to summon the gold-plated gauze. The golden gauze rose into the air, hovering in the middle of the room, as mana rippled out from it, only to be completely blocked by the barrier created by the Four Directions Sealing Spirit Talisman.
He was quite satisfied with the effect of the Four Directions Sealing Spirit Talisman, and his gaze turned to the gold-plated gauze, prompting him to channel more mana.
The gold-plated gauze shone brightly, suddenly expanding to be more than ten times its original length and several times wider, easily wrapping around him five or six times.
Yuan Ming formed an incantation and pointed, and the gold-plated gauze suddenly tightened. The five or six layers overlapped, forming a thick golden curtain with not a single angle left undefended.
Yuan Ming took out the Green Fish Sword, infused it with mana, and the blade sent out a sword qi more than a foot long, striking the golden gauze curtain.
The golden gauze didn't budge, and his full-strength strike with the Green Fish Sword was as ineffective as a mayfly shaking a tree.
Yuan Ming put away the Green Fish Sword and stretched out his right hand, muttering an incantation.
A series of Wood Stabbing Techniques shot out from his palm and then merged into one, transforming into a thick sword-shaped wooden thorn half a zhang long, the Green Sword Skill!
"Go!" Yuan Ming's arm shook, and the wooden thorn, akin to a green sword, shot out like a crossbow arrow, stabbing into the golden gauze curtain.
The golden gauze just trembled slightly and was soon calm again.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming showed a look of satisfaction. Even the Green Sword Skill, a middle-level magic, could only slightly shake the gold-plated gauze. Its defensive power was even more impressive than he had anticipated.
While the Burning Explosion Skill could test the gold-plated gauze's defensive ability to a greater extent, it was very mana-consuming and made too much noise, which might not be completely concealed by the Four Directions Sealing Spirit Talisman. Moreover, he was afraid of messing up and causing more harm than good.
After putting away the gold-plated gauze and the Four Directions Sealing Spirit Talisman, Yuan Ming sat down on his bed and took out the newly purchased "Array Dao Miscellaneous Discussion" from the Ghost Market, carefully flipping through it.
The book explained the basic principles of arrays as well as entry-level knowledge, seemingly prepared for beginners in array studies.
The author of the book had a profound understanding of arrays yet used simple and easy-to-understand terminology, so outsiders like Yuan Ming could easily comprehend it.
After finishing the book, he had a basic understanding of arrays.
"Eh, this is..." Yuan Ming's gaze fell on the content of the last two pages.
These two pages discussed something called "Array Flags" and "Array Plates," special kinds of magic artifacts that could carry array patterns.
Array Masters had to inscribe a set of array patterns on Array Flags and Array Plates in advance so that when needed, they could be arranged in a certain order with the corresponding spirit stones to quickly set up an array.
Setting up arrays with Array Flags and Array Plates was much faster than inscribing array patterns on the spot, but due to a lack of integration with the environment, the power was considerably weaker.
