However, the book mentioned that inscribing a set of Array Flags and Array Plates was even more difficult than setting up an array itself, and even skillful Array Masters had a low success rate.
"So, the small flags and the jade plates inside Li Sha Jade Box from White Dragon Island must be a set of Array Flags and Array Plates! It's a pity I don't know what arrays they form," Yuan Ming pondered.
Without the proper knowledge of the patterns and sequences inscribed on the arrays, he still couldn't set up the array; he would have to find an opportunity to study it more closely in the future.
Yuan Ming put away the "Array Dao Miscellaneous Discussion" and took out a stick of Qingxuan Spirit Incense to light. The spiritual energy contained within the incense permeated the room with the smoke, providing a sense of tranquility and delight.
He then returned to his bed, sat down cross-legged, swallowed a Nourishing Origin Pill, closed his eyes, and began to refine it with the Nine Elements Technique.
With a gathering soon at White Deer Hill and tasks assigned by the White Night Scatter Alliance, he needed to seize every moment to cultivate, knowing that increasing his mana even a little could enhance his safety.
While cultivating for a while, he suddenly felt a sensation, called out the incense burner, and placed it on the table. He then inserted the lit Spirit Incense into the burner.
The incense upon the burner immediately transformed, as a stream of blue smoke rose straight up, winding upward in the room, continuous and unbroken, gathering without dispersing.
He felt connected to the smoke, flared his nostrils slightly, and subconsciously took a deep breath. The dispersed blue smoke reconverged into a strand, moving towards him like a living thing.
Yuan Ming felt a cool sensation passing through his nostrils, reaching into his lungs and then sinking into his dantian, giving rise to an indescribably pleasant feeling.
At that moment, he felt as if he was bathing in a cool river on a hot summer day, his whole body relaxed in an instant, as the blue smoke circulated within him before being slowly exhaled.
The spiritual power in the blue smoke remained in his body, while the expelled impure qi took away fatigue.
With each inhale and exhale, the surrounding blue smoke seemed to come alive, swirling around Yuan Ming's body, going round and round, in an endless cycle.
Within this small space, it was as if he was in an illusion.

chapters.title: Chapter 176 - 156: Refining the Sword
chapters.content:
Two days passed in a blink of an eye.
In the inn, Yuan Ming slowly opened his eyes, his gaze intense.
With the assistance from the Nine Elements Technique combined with the Nourishing Origin Pill and the Mystic Fragrance, his mana had grown much denser. The cultivation of just these two days was equivalent to nearly half a month's effort from the past.
Presumably, the Mystic Fragrance, suited for high-level cultivators or as tributes in sects, was originally intended for aids in cultivation.
Moreover, each cultivation session consumed more than one incense stick, and the cost in spirit stones was substantial—not something a minor sect could easily afford.
In the barbaric land of the Southern Border, there couldn't be many capable of affording such expenses—no wonder that old priest's business was so poor.
According to the agreement, today he could collect the Thousand Mechanism Mask; he wondered whether Master Huo Lian had succeeded.
Yuan Ming checked out of the inn and headed to Master Huo Lian's magic artifact shop.
Since the other party was aware of his identity, he didn't bother to conceal himself this time.
"Haha, Fellow Daoist arrives just in time; the Thousand Mechanism Mask is already refined, and I've not failed my mission." Before Yuan Ming could speak, the bald man chuckled.
"Thank you! Is Master Huo Lian not in the shop?" Yuan Ming asked, his heart settled.
"Oh, my master is busy in the back room. Please have a look." The bald man said and retrieved a wooden box from beneath the counter, passing it over.
Yuan Ming opened the wooden box, inside was a somewhat translucent white mask, extremely thin and warm to the touch, feeling almost like human skin.
He tried putting it on his face; it fit perfectly and was nearly imperceptible.
"My master said you are quite lucky, Fellow Daoist. This artifact refining session was quite successful. This Thousand Mechanism Mask can be used three times, so please use it carefully," the bald man added.
"What! Only three uses?" Yuan Ming's eyes flashed with surprise.
"Do you not know, Fellow Daoist? The Thousand Mechanism Mask is indeed a consumable magic artifact. Its main material is the face skin of a human-faced spider, a mere Level 1 Fierce Beast material, containing too weak spiritual power. Being able to sustain three transformations is already quite impressive," the bald man explained.
Yuan Ming fell silent.
A Magic Artifact Shop welcomed customers openly and was unlikely to deceive him on such matters. The Thousand Mechanism Mask, made from a Level 1 Fierce Beast material yet being surprisingly effective to the point of deceiving even Foundation Establishment cultivators, was indeed unusual. It seemed his expectations were a bit high.
With that in mind, he didn't pursue further, paid the remaining half of the artifact refining fee, and left with the Thousand Mechanism Mask.
Yuan Ming didn't linger in Black Rock City and quickly departed towards Biluo Cave Sect.
...
On the way, Yuan Ming was wary of potential robbers and made ample preparations, but the journey was uneventful.
Upon returning to Biluo Cave, Yuan Ming headed straight to the back mountains to find the Third Cave Master.
"Is this Yin Jade?" The Third Cave Master's expression changed upon seeing the half of the white Ruyi he took out.
"Indeed," Yuan Ming nodded.
"I didn't expect you to find Yin Jade as a substitute. Although its grade cannot compare to the thousand-year-old ice crystal, it's not easy to find, and it has a particularly unique attribute. You're quite fortunate. Just be cautious, as using such a magic artifact for prolonged periods might harm your Divine Soul. I'll try to minimize its backlash during refining, but you still need to be careful," the Third Cave Master said after inspecting the Yin Jade Yuan Ming brought back, and nodded slightly with a warning.
"Then I'm in the hands of the Third Cave Master," Yuan Ming said, bowing with his fists.
"Follow me," said the Third Cave Master, rising to lead Yuan Ming to the small courtyard's back hall.
Upon reaching the back hall, Yuan Ming immediately noticed a pitch-black casting furnace, similar in style to Master Hei Mu's, also engraved with many secretive patterns.
The Third Cave Master approached the furnace, picked some charcoal stones and sulfur from a nearby shelf, and tossed them into the furnace.
Then, raising her hand, she formed a spell and pressed it onto the body of the furnace.
The next moment, a flash of fire light ignited from her palm, spreading like a wildfire, lighting up the patterns on the furnace.
Streams of red light converged from all directions, focusing into the body of the furnace, coalescing into a blazing flame that ignited the furnace chamber.
An incredibly intense heat emerged fiercely from the furnace, the blast of hot air caused Yuan Ming's face to tighten and he instinctively stepped back.
The Third Cave Master, however, seemed unaffected.
Perched on her shoulder, Huo Chan'er tipped his head back, sagged his waist, and luxuriously stretched, looking quite comfortable.
"Pass me the sword," said the Third Cave Master.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming immediately offered up the Green Fish Sword with both hands.
Huo Chan'er then climbed onto his shoulder by traversing the arm that reached out.
The Third Cave Master waved her hand and opened a sealing door on the furnace, and a surge of fire burst out like floodwaters from a dam.
She raised her palm and made a virtual press towards the oncoming flames, and an invisible mana forced the fire back into the fire pit.
Next, she levitated the Green Fish Sword with her mana, slowly inserting it into the furnace.
Entering the center of the fire pit, the sword was immediately surrounded by roaring flames, the licks of fire tasting the blade as if they had found delicious food.
Yuan Ming felt it strange, but upon closer observation, he realized that the Third Cave Master was deliberately manipulating the flow of the flames.
"You must have a Fire Spiritual Root. On normal days, you should choose a fire attribute magic to practice the Fire Control Technique, which is very necessary for an Artifact Refiner," the voice of the Third Cave Master rang out, giving advice to Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming subconsciously wanted to say that he had been practicing, but he immediately stopped himself.
Not to mention the problematic origin of his magic, even the Burning Explosion Skill, a volatile technique, had nothing to do with Fire Control. If really used, he feared it would instantly blow up the casting furnace.
"Yes," Yuan Ming nodded in response.
"The second smelting is particularly critical regarding the heat; watch carefully," the Third Cave Master instructed.
"With personal guidance from the Third Cave Master, this disciple must engrave it in his heart," Yuan Ming responded.
Actually, Yuan Ming wouldn't miss such a rare observation opportunity even without her reminder.
After the Third Cave Master finished speaking, she no longer continued but concentrated on controlling the flames and the furnace's temperature.
The Green Fish Sword was undergoing a second smelting, unlike the initial smelting where all materials were melted together to remove impurities and merge. Instead, it needed to be burned until it reached the critical state of retaining form but dispersing energy.
Once beyond this critical state, the form of the Green Fish Sword would melt, losing its original solid structure, but if it did not reach this state, the Yin Jade could not be merged into it.
Yuan Ming understood this principle, but to actually perform it, with his current level of power, he was not capable yet.
After about a quarter of an hour of burning, the temperature inside the casting furnace suddenly rose, and the surface of the Green Fish Sword sequentially lit up with bright white, golden, and bright red lusters from inside out.
"Yin Jade," the Third Cave Master said with a slight frown.
Yuan Ming immediately presented it with both hands.
The Third Cave Master took the Yin Jade with one hand and gently stroked the casting furnace's sealing door with the other.
The furnace's sealing door opened again, and a more intense blast of air whooshed out, yet the flames remained under the control of the Third Cave Master within it.
Then, with a flick of her finger, a thread of mana pulled the Green Fish Sword out, placing it on the casting platform.
Almost simultaneously, the hand holding the Yin Jade pressed down towards the Green Fish Sword.
"Hiss..."
With a soft sound, a large amount of white vapor steamed up, obstructing Yuan Ming's vision.
He only saw the Third Cave Master close the fire pit's sealing door, grab the casting hammer beside her, and smash it down on the platform.
"Clang, clang, clang"
With each strike, there were no sparks, but a series of light rings shone brightly with each hammer blow.
The hazy vapor only revealed a blurry, graceful figure, whose movements were fluid and elegant, not giving off any sense of clumsiness.
Yuan Ming's eyes sharpened as he concentrated his mana to his eyes, significantly enhancing his vision.
Only then did he see that with each hammer strike by the Third Cave Master, the Green Fish Sword shined with radiant light, enveloped in a thin layer of white Jade Powder that, no matter how it vibrated, always clung around the sword, never dissipating.
With each hammerfall, some Jade Powder would integrate into the sword, merging with it.
And with each integration, the light on the sword would diminish slightly, and its heat noticeably decreased as well.
Suddenly, the Third Cave Master began to swing her hammer faster and faster. The "clang" sounds of the hammer strikes also began to sound continuous and uninterrupted.
Yuan Ming watched in astonishment, unable to fathom the number of continuous strikes, not to mention, this speed was beyond his reach for now.
However, Yuan Ming could see clearly that the Third Cave Master suddenly sped up to maintain the sword's temperature through the hammering, ensuring all the Yin Jade Crystal Powder could integrate into the sword.
Just then, a hurried call suddenly came from outside the courtyard: "Is the Third Cave Master present? The Great Cave Master sends a disciple to invite her for urgent consultation."
"What bad timing?" Yuan Ming frowned, afraid that the Third Cave Master might be affected.My Virtual Library Empire (*) hosts the original.
The urgent summons from the Great Cave Master, an issue concerning a mere registered disciple, how could it compare? If the Third Cave Master stopped now, all previous efforts would be wasted. Not only would the hard-earned spiritual materials be ruined, but the Green Fish Sword might also lose the chance to improve further.
Fortunately, the latter's actions showed no delay; it was as if she hadn't heard at all and was unaffected.
The person outside seemed to hear the activity inside, fearing that it had not been heard, projected their mana to shout louder, and the voice became even clearer.
But the Third Cave Master continually swung her hammer as if nothing could disturb her.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming finally felt relieved.
He silently counted in his mind until the Third Cave Master had swung her hammer three thousand six hundred eighty-one times before the hammering sound finally ceased, and the surrounding vapor had long since dissipated.
The Third Cave Master put down the casting hammer and single-handedly held up the newly refreshed Green Fish Sword, lifting it in front of her to observe.
The shape of the long sword had not changed much, but the blue body of the sword now had countless white specks, like snow falling in a blue sky or stars spread across the sky, indeed more splendid and ornate than before.
Yuan Ming's eyes lit up as he saw faint traces of white cold air seeping from the sword.
"Is it done?" he couldn't help asking.
"The materials have merged very well; the properties of the Yin Jade and the Green Fish Sword are perfectly compatible. As long as there is no problem with the Engraving and Spirit Implanting, this sword is at least a Mid-grade Magical Artifact," the Third Cave Master also seemed quite satisfied, commented.
"Many thanks to the Third Cave Master," hearing this, Yuan Ming immediately knelt down, sincerely thanking her.

chapters.title: Chapter 177 - 157: Giving Gifts
chapters.content:
"It's all right, just remember what you promised me. After I rest a bit and adjust my condition, I can help you with the engraving and spirit infusion," said the Third Cave Master as she handed over the Green Fish Sword.
Yuan Ming immediately received it with both hands respectfully, feeling the icy coolness as if holding a piece of solid ice. Through his perception, he felt wisps of chill seeping into his body. He weighed the sword lightly and felt that it was slightly heavier than before, though the change was minimal.
The Fire Mink climbed along his arm, wrinkled its nose, and sniffed the sword, immediately showing a look of disgust before turning around and climbing back onto Yuan Ming's shoulder.
It only liked intense heat, the hotter, the better.
"Currently, it hasn't been inscribed with runes yet, so it cannot contain the chilling aura. After the engraving and spirit implanting, there won't be any overflowing chill without mana activation," the Third Cave Master added.
As soon as her voice faded, the shouting of that disciple once again came from outside the door.
Without waiting for her instructions, Yuan Ming quickly trotted to the front yard to open the door and brought the disciple over.
"The Great Cave Master has summoned you; did he mention what it's about?" the Third Cave Master asked directly.
"No, I only know that besides you, the Second Cave Master and Elder Mengshan have also been invited," the disciple replied hastily.
Upon hearing this, the Third Cave Master's eyebrows slightly furrowed.
After a moment of hesitation, she waved her hand, and a metallic case over three feet long appeared in her palm.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming felt a sudden premonition of unease.
"This is the Yunling Sword Box, it can ensure that the spiritual power within the sword doesn't grow dormant. For now, place the Green Fish Sword inside it. Come find me early tomorrow, and I will help you with the engraving and spirit infusion," the Third Cave Master instructed.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming naturally had no objections and could only nod in agreement.
"Let Fire Mink stay with you for now," the Third Cave Master said, glancing at the mink on Yuan Ming's shoulder.
Upon hearing this, its bean-like eyes shone brightly, clearly delighted.
"Yes," Yuan Ming immediately responded.
Returning to his dwelling, Yuan Ming's excitement took a long time to subside. He really wanted to open the sword box to take a look, but worrying about possible taboos, he refrained and simply placed it by his bedside.
He then took out Master Hei Mu's notebook and started to carefully go over the recorded runes, wondering which ones the Third Cave Master might choose to inscribe?
It wasn't until late at night that Yuan Ming settled his somewhat uneasy feelings, closed his eyes, and sat cross-legged, intending to practice the Moonlight Technique.
The Fire Mink also snuggled up happily and decided to curl up beside Yuan Ming.
At that moment, it suddenly raised its neck to look out the window, its small beady eyes rolling around.
Seeing its reaction, Yuan Ming knew that the silver cat was nearby.
"Xi Ying, hurry in," Yuan Ming said aloud.
There was no response from outside, but after a short wait, a graceful figure slowly walked in.
"I went to the workshop and bought a gift for you," Yuan Ming began.
At these words, Silver Cat Xi Ying clearly paused, not expecting Yuan Ming to say such a thing.
"Unwarranted cordiality," it transmitted back, keeping its tone calm as if it wasn't too concerned, "What good thing could you possibly have? I don't want anything cheap."
Yuan Ming's wrist flipped, and a black wooden box instantaneously appeared in his palm, housing the gold-plated gauze.
He then opened the box, lifted the gauze, and with a flick of the wrist, the golden gauze floated, unraveling in front of Xi Ying with each thread shimmering with golden light, creating an almost dreamlike scene.
With another flick, the gold-plated gauze suddenly extended several times in length, spiraling up in front of Xi Ying, layers of golden gauze flying up and down like a gigantic, golden ribbon.
"So beautiful, and it's a mid-grade magical artifact? Did you strike it rich?" Silver Cat Xi Ying exclaimed in surprise.
Hearing this, Yuan Ming flipped his wrist again, and the golden gauze swiftly retracted back into the black box.
"I went to the workshop and unexpectedly came into a windfall. I've been thinking of you, so I specifically bought this for you," Yuan Ming explained.
"I don't want it. Are you trying to bribe me with this to ask for my help again?" replied Silver Cat Xi Ying.
"I truly have no such matter," Yuan Ming countered.
"Hmph, tell me, how did you come by this windfall?" Xi Ying tilted its chin, gestured with its paw, and the golden gauze that floated in front of it touched its paw and vanished.
Yuan Ming recounted his encounter with the jester who attempted to assassinate someone from White Dragon Island in the workshop and how a woman with bare feet and clad in white rescued the jester before Yuan Ming used vines to steal a storage bag.
Throughout the story, Xi Ying asked this and that, humming at the mention of the jester and asking a few more questions about the tall, barefooted woman in white with the strange escape technique that helped the jester flee, causing Xi Ying's eyes to brighten.
Xi Ying's mood seemed to improve after listening to the story.
"Would you like me to give you some pointers on the Moonlight Technique?" Silver Cat Xi Ying offered as its mood brightened, showing concern for Yuan Ming's cultivation.
"So far, it's been smooth, but the sporadic memory fragments in the Sea of Consciousness are somewhat chaotic, often leaving me feeling somewhat befuddled," Yuan Ming replied.
"Your memory loss was caused by damage to your divine soul. Cultivating the Moonlight Technique can help you heal, but it also takes time. Perhaps when you reach the third layer, you'll be able to remember everything," said Xi Ying. "If you take me as your master, I'll consider immediately helping you recover your memories."
"No," Yuan Ming refused decisively; given his current pace of cultivation, he would eventually recover all his memories, and it didn't make sense to owe Xi Ying any form of submission.
"Always concerned about face," Xi Ying remarked before leaving.
After it left, Yuan Ming resumed his seated meditation, continuing his cultivation.
...
Silver Cat Xi Ying returned to its cozy tree hollow.
It waved a paw lightly, and the gold-plated gauze that resembled a golden ribbon floated out, laying like a bedspread upon the thick furs and silks below.
The Silver Cat Xi Ying lightly touched a claw tip to the golden gauze, effortlessly refining it.
Then, a bit of Mana flowed from its paw into the gauze, causing the gold-plated gauze to flicker faintly with light, casting specks of golden stars in the somewhat dim tree hollow.
The silver cat lay on the couch, feeling the silky coolness beneath it and instantly felt as if it was suspended in the clouds, incomparably comfortable and content, unable to resist stretching lazily.
"Such admirable filial piety, haha..." It recalled the way Yuan Ming had presented the gift earlier and couldn't help but laugh heartily.
After that thought, it seemed to remember something, raising a front paw to produce a blue book from nowhere, browsing through it nonchalantly until it reached the last page, where its expression dimmed.
The page depicted a group of hamsters happily eating together.
At the bottom it was written, "Jin, by Yuan Ming."
One of its front paws gently caressed the book, and a complex emotion flickered in its heterochromatic eyes, followed by a soft sigh after a long pause:
"Father..."
No words were exchanged that night, and Yuan Ming had gone to the Three Cave Masters' courtyard early, cradling the Sword Box.
However, after calling out for a long time outside the door, he received no response.
After letting Huo Chan'er in for a look around, Yuan Ming realized in surprise that the Three Cave Master wasn't in the courtyard at all.
"She wouldn't have stood me up, would she?"
Yuan Ming guessed it was probably due to the meeting convened by the Great Cave Master the day before, so he went to seek confirmation from his senior brother Fang Ge.
"What do you need the Master for?" Fang Ge asked with a frown.
Yuan Ming then shared the matter of seeking the Three Cave Master's help for sword refining.
"Junior Brother Yuan, I really didn't expect that you could actually get the Three Cave Master to personally refine a sword for you," Fang Ge said, his serious face showing an exaggerated expression of surprise.
"It's all thanks to Huo Chan'er's face," Yuan Ming explained with a smile.
In fact, he understood in his heart that besides valuing Huo Chan'er's face and the request it had mentioned, the Three Cave Master was likely impressed by the Green Fish Sword itself and therefore had agreed to personally help him with the refinement.
"The Master didn't leave a message, so there must be some urgent matter. But since she promised to help you with the sword, she will definitely do it," Fang Ge reasoned, his gaze landing on the Sword Box Yuan Ming held.
"That's a Yunling Sword Box, isn't it?" he asked.
Yuan Ming nodded in confirmation.Nоtе: Chесk М_VLЕМРY_R fоr аny соrrесtiоns.
"Then there's no problem. The Master will definitely return within three days," Fang Ge said confidently.
"Why is that?" Yuan Ming asked, puzzled.
"The Yunling Sword Box can maintain the Spirit Sword's Spiritual Power from going dormant, but it only works for three days. That's why the Master will certainly return within that time," Fang Ge explained.
"But what if she can't come back?" Yuan Ming asked, frowning.
"If she really can't return, and the sword's Spiritual Power goes dormant, there's no way to continue with the Engraving and Spirit Implanting. Before, when crucial spiritual materials hadn't been added, it was possible to refine it a second time. Now that it cannot be refined again, it's essentially ruined," Fang Ge replied with an embarrassed expression, explaining the situation.
Hearing this, Yuan Ming's heart sank, and his foreboding feeling from the previous day was confirmed.
"Don't worry, since the Master promised, she will definitely return within three days," Fang Ge quickly reassured him upon seeing his reaction.
Yuan Ming, however, felt even more uneasy. It was precisely because the Three Cave Master was a person of her word that today's absence seemed unusual.
"This won't do, I should go and find a way with Brother Mu He..." he said before taking the Sword Box and heading towards the Artifact House at the back.
Clutching the Sword Box, Yuan Ming hurried to the Artifact House and went straight to Mu He's room.
"Knock knock,"
After knocking urgently, the door creaked open from the inside. Mu He, bleary-eyed and exhausted, greeted Yuan Ming with a weary voice:
"Junior Brother Yuan, what is it?"
"Brother, help me," Yuan Ming said as he squeezed into Mu He's room.
"A Yunling Sword Box? What's inside?" Mu He didn't seem too concerned, and after closing the door, his gaze settled on the Sword Box in Yuan Ming's hands, and he frowned slightly.
"My sword, being refined by the Three Cave Master, but there's been a problem..."
Yuan Ming quickly relayed the situation to him.
"I think the Master must have some urgent matter and probably can't get away temporarily," Mu He said after listening, scratching his messy hair.
"Brother, you have to help me," Yuan Ming pleaded with a bitter look on his face.
"Er... it's not that I don't want to help you, but you know, Enriching is a task only Artifact Refiners above the Foundation Establishment Stage can undertake. I mean, I could help with the engraving, but I can't do the Enriching," Mu He said helplessly.
"I understand that. Could you please approach the Fire Refining Hall's elder on my behalf? I'm willing to pay for the assistance, and we can negotiate the price," Yuan Ming quickly suggested.
"Heh, that's quite bold. Do you really think you, a Registered Disciple, can afford the elders' fees for refining a Magic Artifact? I'll go ask, but don't get your hopes up," Mu He evidently didn't believe him, but still agreed to help.
"Thank you, Brother," Yuan Ming said, bowing with his fists in thanks.
Mu He waved his hand dismissively, asking Yuan Ming to wait there while he himself turned and left the room.
"Wait here," Mu He said before departing.

chapters.title: Chapter 178 - 158 Gathering Spirit Formation
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming had never felt time pass so slowly.
He didn't know how many times he had stood up and sat down again before Mu He finally returned to his side, shaking his head at him as soon as they met.
Yuan Ming's heart sank immediately.
"Apart from the master, our Fire Refining Hall has only three elders above the Foundation Establishment Stage, and they are all secluded in artifact refining; not a single one has come out. Nobody can help you," Mu He said somewhat helplessly.
"What should I do then? I can't just watch as the Spiritual Power of my Green Fish Sword fades and it becomes a mere mundane item, can I?" Yuan Ming frowned and said.
"Your only option is to try your luck and wait to see if the master can return within three days," Mu He sighed and said helplessly.
Yuan Ming had no choice but to thank Mu He and leave in a hurry.
He first made another trip to the yard of the Three Cave Masters, but still didn't manage to see anyone, so he could only return to his residence.
The moment he pushed the door and entered, he saw Huo Chan'er lying on the desk by the window, but upon hearing Yuan Ming's movement, Huo Chan'er immediately got up.
Yuan Ming leaned out of the window and saw that on the horizontal branch of the pine tree outside, Silver Cat Xi Ying seemed to be basking in the sun.
Discovering Yuan Ming looking at her, Silver Cat Xi Ying continued without paying him any attention after turning over.
Seeing Xi Ying acting like this, Yuan Ming wanted to speak but swallowed his words and simply sat down next to the desk with the Sword Box in his arms, his face full of worry.
Huo Chan'er cozied up to him in an effort to please, but he could not spare his attention for her.
Almost a day had passed since yesterday.
The Yunling Sword Box only had two more days of preservation; he had to complete the engraving and Spirit Implanting within these two days.
But he had a premonition that the Three Cave Masters were likely occupied with something and wouldn't return any time soon.
"Otherwise, should I make another trip to the workshop?" Yuan Ming hesitated over whether to find an Artifact Refiner there to help him, but after calculating the distance, he realized he was running out of time.
"Let me see what's in your Spirit Storage Box," the curious voice of Silver Cat sounded in his Sea of Consciousness.
Yuan Ming looked up instinctively and saw that Silver Cat Xi Ying had already come to his window, while Huo Chan'er had somehow ended up on the floor, rolling around.
"This sword was refined for me by the Three Cave Masters. Is it impossible to enrich a Magic Artifact with Spiritual Power without the Cultivation at the Foundation Establishment Stage?" he couldn't help asking.
"Of course, it's not possible... But, nothing is absolute," Silver Cat said when hearing him ask this question; she already understood why Yuan Ming was so distressed.
"Do you have a way?" Yuan Ming's eyes lit up, and he immediately became overjoyed.
"Among Magic Practitioners, there are Talisman Masters who are skilled in the way of talismans and Array Masters who are proficient in Arrays. They delve deeply into the paths of talismans and Arrays, and can exert unique abilities that other Cultivators do not possess. Among them, Array Masters have created a type of Rune Array named 'Gathering Spirit Formation,' which can replace an Artifact Refiner to enrich Magic Artifacts and Magic Treasures," Silver Cat Xi Ying explained.
"Aren't you a Soul Cultivator? Are you also an Array Master?" Yuan Ming asked in surprise.
"I'm not an Array Master, but I'm familiar with the Gathering Spirit Formation," Xi Ying glanced at him and said.
"You're only familiar with it? Can you actually draw it, or... how can you help me?" Yuan Ming didn't know how to use the Gathering Spirit Formation.
"I'm not an Array Master and don't know how to draw it. Besides, the Gathering Spirit Formation isn't a talisman that you can just draw on talisman paper and use," Xi Ying explained.
"Forget it. In two more days, if I can't find a way to do the Spirit Implanting, my Green Fish Sword will be ruined. You can't help me anyway," Yuan Ming said.
"What? There's something I can't do?... Actually, you've seen the Gathering Spirit Formation before; it's on that Mist Island, on the casting furnace of Master Hei Mu that you found. It's just that you had no eye for it and didn't take it with you," Xi Ying said, indignant.
How could she know that Yuan Ming didn't lack discernment, but that he simply lacked the ability to take it at that time; otherwise, he would have taken the furnace long ago.
"There might have been other people on the island at that time; I'm afraid the casting furnace might no longer be there," Yuan Ming said, first excited and then worried.
"The casting furnace is still there," Silver Cat Xi Ying quickly reassured him.
"Really?" Yuan Ming asked, joyously.
Silver Cat Xi Ying "tsked" lightly through her nose, too disdainful to reply.
"Thank you!" Yuan Ming, overjoyed, grabbed the Sword Box and ran outside.
"Next time, I must find something you don't know to test you," he added as he reached the door, remembering something.
"Anytime!" Silver Cat replied.
As Yuan Ming passed by Huo Chan'er, the latter swiftly climbed up his leg to his shoulder.
Silver Cat Xi Ying watched his departing figure, a hint of a smile in her eyes. After a moment of hesitation, she leaped down from the pine tree and quickly disappeared.
...
Half a day later, on Mist Island.
On a steep cliff face covered in patches of moss and dark green vines that hung down, a hidden semicircular cave entrance was concealed by them.
In the sky outside the cave, a black raven spread its wings and soared, circling for a long while before slowly descending.
It landed on a rock outside, pecking with its head down as if feeding, yet its shiny black eyes were rolling around, stealthily surveying the surroundings.
Seeing that everything around was stable and without the slightest anomaly, the raven hopped around, changed direction, and with a flap of its wings, it dived into the cave mouth hidden by vines on the mountainside and disappeared.
In a secluded forest ten miles away, Yuan Ming sat quietly amid the dense foliage of an ancient tree, observing the situation near the cave through the vision of a soul crow.
"Good, it really is still there," he sighed in relief the moment he saw the casting furnace.
Then he stood up, used the Wind Swift Skill to leap down from the tree canopy, and hurried toward the cave.
The figure of the silver cat appeared not far away and quickly followed suit.
In no time, Yuan Ming arrived at the cave carrying Huo Chan'er on his shoulder.
Upon seeing the casting furnace, Yuan Ming immediately swung his sleeve, creating a strong gust of wind that swept away all the dust on the furnace, and then he quickly approached to look for the Gathering Spirit Formation that Xi Ying had mentioned.
He circled around the casting furnace but didn't see any arrays inscribed on it.
"How could there be none?" He thought, bending down to crawl under the furnace.
At the bottom of the casting furnace, there were only flame patterns, and Yuan Ming didn't see anything special.
"Inside the furnace chamber," said the voice of Silver Cat Xi Ying, just in time, in Yuan Ming's sea of consciousness.
On hearing the voice, Yuan Ming looked up sharply and "bam," hit his head on the casting furnace.
When he crawled out from under the furnace, he saw Silver Cat Xi Ying perched on top of it, leisurely watching his flustered actions.
"Even without your reminder, I would have found it," said Yuan Ming. Brough#t to you by the f*ol@k^s* at *.
"Even if you had found it, would you know how to use the Gathering Spirit Formation?" Xi Ying looked down at him with an expression that was mocking.
For a moment, Yuan Ming was stumped, then quickly asked, "Do you know how?"
"Of course, open the Sealing Door of the furnace chamber and look at the bottom," Xi Ying instructed.
Yuan Ming promptly responded and opened the Sealing Door of the furnace chamber. He hadn't had a chance to see it clearly when Huo Chan'er, faster than him, scurried in along his arm, ran a circle inside, and then came back out.
Only then did Yuan Ming see that the bottom of the furnace chamber wasn't a smooth plate, but engraved with a complex Rune Array.
At first glance, he recognized one of the runes, which looked somewhat familiar—it appeared to be a transformed Flame Rune surrounded by five other intricate runes he couldn't recognize.
These five runes surrounded the central Flame Rune, connected to it and each other, mutually supporting and forming a stable framework.
"Is this the array?" Yuan Ming muttered to himself.
"This Gathering Spirit Formation is quite simple. Although ingeniously conceived, its power is limited; at best, it can only assist in the Enriching of a Mid-grade Magical Artifact, which is also considered the most low-end," Xi Ying said.
"How can you tell it's simple?" Yuan Ming felt that the lines were already incredibly complex.
"This Gathering Spirit Formation centers around the Flame Rune, which is also the starting point. Together with five Gathering Spirit Talismans as fulcrums, it constructs the formation. There are no superfluous runes or cumbersome lines, which is why its power is limited, but it also prevents the loss of spiritual power—isn't that simple?" When Xi Ying heard this, her voice echoed in Yuan Ming's sea of consciousness.
"So you mean to say, a Rune Array isn't just a simple stacking combination of runes; improper pairing could actually lead to diminished returns?" Yuan Ming pondered and asked.
"Naturally, it couldn't just be simple stacking. In fact, this kind of pairing is quite difficult to control. You have to consider the compatibility and conflict of the properties of the runes and whether the lines between the runes are smoothly connected without causing interference with each other. Otherwise, every Talisman Master would also be an Array Master," Xi Ying explained.
"I see. So how is this Gathering Spirit Formation used?" Yuan Ming asked, suddenly enlightened.
"Do you see the shallow grooves at the center of those five runes around the perimeter?" asked Xi Ying.
"I do. What are they for?" Yuan Ming inquired, puzzled.
"They are for placing Spirit Stones, to draw in spiritual power. Your own mana is insufficient, so you need the spiritual power from the Spirit Stones to fill the gap. The central Flame Rune is the key to transforming, controlling the flow of spiritual power into the Green Fish Sword," Xi Ying answered.
Hearing this, Yuan Ming swiftly turned his wrist and produced five Low Grade Spirit Stones.
"Will these do?" Yuan Ming asked, seeking guidance.
"To Enrich your Sword Spirit, they're enough," confirmed Xi Ying after a glance.
Yuan Ming immediately and carefully positioned the five Spirit Stones into the furnace chamber.
"Open the Yunling Sword Box," commanded Silver Cat Xi Ying.
Since he truly didn't understand the Gathering Spirit Formation, Yuan Ming didn't dare to be negligent and simply became an obedient executor.
He did as instructed and opened the Yunling Sword Box. The Green Fish Sword immediately revealed its true face, releasing wisps of cold aura spreading around, and Huo Chan'er instantly showed a look of disgust and ran to the side.
"The sword's base attribute is cold. Which rune do you plan to inscribe?" Xi Ying asked.
About that, Yuan Ming had already thought thoroughly on the way here, but now when he spoke up, he hesitated again.

chapters.title: Chapter 179 - 159 Engraving
chapters.content:
"Originally, the Three Cave Masters were going to help with engraving and spirit implanting. I had planned to choose a basic Frost Rune, along with a Gale Rune. Combined, they should possess decent defensive-breaking abilities. But now, if I have to engrave the runes myself, I'm not sure I can succeed," Yuan Ming looked at the Green Fish Sword and spoke slowly.
"I've seen you drawing talismans, and you have a bit of talent in this area," Xi Ying said slowly.
"It might have something to do with my practicing drawing since I was young. I did practice engraving on some iron ingots before, but my mindset was completely different back then. Afterward, I had someone else take a look; I never really did spirit implantation, so there's no way to verify whether it was a success," Yuan Ming hesitated.
Xi Ying nodded in acknowledgement after hearing this.
"It's impossible for everything to be foolproof. Cultivation is about opportunities and fate. Today is your chance, so just give it a try. Besides, this isn't exactly quality material—if it's ruined, you can just find a new one," said Xi Ying, untroubled.
Indeed, rather than missing out, it's better to take a chance when there's still a possibility. If I hesitate, I'll lose everything.
Besides, the arrow is already on the bowstring, I must shoot. If this attempt fails, there's no room for further doubt.
Yuan Ming found a rock to sit on, twisted his wrist, and a strange engraving knife, about three inches long, appeared in his palm. The tip of the knife had no blade but was inlaid with a very small, dark red, polyhedral crystal stone.
"My disciple is quite prepared, even bringing a Spirit Awakening Engraving Knife," Xi Ying began to instruct.
Yuan Ming couldn't rebut; he was already regulating his breathing, calming his mind, and no longer responded to Xi Ying.
He held the Green Fish Sword by its hilt and placed it across his knees; with the other hand, he held the engraving knife but didn't hurry to start. Instead, he slowly closed his eyes.
At this moment, the designs of the Frost Rune and Gale Rune began to take shape in his mind.
After a while, Yuan Ming's eyes snapped open, no longer showing any hesitation.
His engraving knife moved close to the sword guard, touching the blade. Mana flowed into it, and the dark red crystal stone inlaid at the tip of the knife lit up and grew hot.
Huo Chan'er was attracted by the light and moved closer to Yuan Ming but was chased away by the silver cat with a swipe of its paw.
Yuan Ming's engraving knife glided over the blade without making any harsh sounds. No indentations appeared on the sword, but a clear mark began to emerge.
As Yuan Ming moved, the knife traced the patterns, and a Frost Rune, resembling a snowflake, was engraved onto the sword.
Yuan Ming's gaze was focused, his entire being concentrated on the blade. Without pausing, he connected it with a gentle curve and engraved another rune, resembling a whirlwind—the Gale Rune.
As soon as the runes were complete, Yuan Ming quickly lifted the knife, and no additional marks were left on the blade.
The silver cat had been crouching on the casting furnace, seemingly indifferent, but its gaze never left Yuan Ming's hand.
Now that the engraving was finished, and Yuan Ming was about to look up, the silver cat turned its head away, looking elsewhere.
Throughout the process of engraving the runes, Yuan Ming was so tense that he almost stopped breathing. Only when he lifted his head did he take a deep breath, then rose and approached Xi Ying.
"Xi Ying, take a look for me. How is it?" he asked eagerly.
He believed that the silver cat's judgment was far superior to his own.
However, Xi Ying didn't even look, and a voice rang out in his Sea of Consciousness, "Whether it works or not, you'll know once you try it."
"Then let's give it a try," Yuan Ming said with a smile.
As he spoke, he placed the Green Fish Sword into the furnace chamber of the casting furnace.
"What's the rush? You need to light a fire to activate the Gathering Spirit Formation first, to refine the Spirit Stones. Only afterward can you insert the sword for spirit implanting," said the silver cat as it got up.
Yuan Ming awkwardly retracted the sword and began to rummage through his Storage Bag for materials to start the fire and fuel it.My Virtual Library Empire (*) thanks you for reading at the source.
"Don't bother looking, it's time for it to pull its weight," Silver Cat Xi Ying's gaze shifted to Huo Chan'er on the ground.
Hearing this, Huo Chan'er stopped grooming itself and looked at Yuan Ming with a puzzled expression.
"Its innate flames are much better than ordinary coal or such. Besides, we are not smelting, merely lighting a fire to activate the formation. It should be sufficient," Xi Ying explained.
At this, Yuan Ming picked up Huo Chan'er and aimed it at the casting furnace.
"Huo Chan'er, help me out here, and I'll give you something tasty," Yuan Ming said with a smile, pulling out an elixir to feed Huo Chan'er.
After eating the elixir, Huo Chan'er understood Yuan Ming's gesture. Its eyes shone, its cheeks puffed out, and then it opened its mouth to spit out a burst of intense flames that shot straight into the fire pit, landing precisely on the Flame Rune in the center.
The next moment, the Flame Rune lit up, and streaks of red light spread along the runes of the Array, lighting up the surrounding five Gathering Spirit Talismans one by one.
The entire rune formation lit up, blooming like a five-petaled fire lotus.
The furnace chamber instantly heated up. Since the Sealing Door was open, a wave of scorching heat immediately spewed out.
Yuan Ming watched intently as spiderweb-like, delicate patterns emerged on the several reddish Spirit Stones, starting from the bottom and spreading upwards.
Along with a series of crisp clicking sounds, all the Spirit Stones shattered.
Streams of Spiritual Power oozed from them, turning into trickles that converged upward toward the formation, forming a red Spirit Fog. The formation constrained it, preventing it from dispersing.
"It's ready," Xi Ying reminded just in time.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming immediately placed the long sword into the furnace.
The Green Fish Sword entered the fire pit and was immediately supported by an invisible force, suspending it mid-air.
The red spirit fog encircled the sword, yet it did not infuse into the sword's body.
"Close the casting furnace's Sealing Door, then start transferring your mana into the furnace. Use your mana as the conduit to lead the spiritual power into the sword," Xi Ying reminded once again.
Without hesitation, Yuan Ming promptly closed the Sealing Door and pressed his hand onto the casting furnace.
The scorching heat passed through the furnace, almost causing Yuan Ming to retract his hand.
But he knew this was a critical moment for Enriching, and he absolutely could not show any sign of relenting, otherwise it would certainly be a failure.
He immediately circulated the Nine Elements Technique and mobilized his Dan Tian Power, directing it through his arm's meridians and into the casting furnace.
Following that, rays of cyan light illuminated beneath his palms, just as he had seen with the Three Cave Masters artifact refining previously. The light streaks flowed along the rune lines on the furnace, brightening the entire casting furnace.
Yuan Ming could clearly feel his mana flowing through the runes on the furnace's body, steadily pouring into the bottom of the furnace cavity, merging with the Gathering Spirit Formation.
Simultaneously, the burning sensation in his hand also receded.
Then, he saw a wisp of green light rising from the center of the Gathering Spirit Formation, like a towering tree growing from a sea of fire, connecting straight to the Green Fish Sword.
The stationary Green Fish Sword began to tremble violently at that moment.
And the hovering spiritual power, like ownerless objects finding their master, poured into the Green Fish Sword under the guidance of Yuan Ming's mana.
The cyan light on the Green Fish Sword flourished, and the specks of white on the blade lit up like stars.
The Frost Rune engraved upon it was the first to shine a bit of light, as spiritual power began to reside in it, filling the rune's lines bit by bit.
Only when the entire rune was fully lit would the Enriching be truly complete.
Just as Yuan Ming felt his mana rapidly depleting, he suddenly noticed the floor's runes, that were already present, were now flickering with a faint glow.
Immediately, he used his other hand to strike a surge of mana onto those runes.
As his mana fell upon them, the ground runes were instantly lit up, and a yellowish Array immediately brightened, with a steady but not strong stream of spiritual power rising from beneath the ground and flowing into the casting furnace.
Yuan Ming instantly felt the pressure lighten, and his mana drained away less rapidly.
"I underestimated this one called Hei Mu; the setup is quite impressive, even including underground Arrays for assistance," Xi Ying couldn't help but exclaim upon seeing this.
At this moment, Yuan Ming was fully concentrated and dared not be distracted in the slightest.
But the Enriching process was exceedingly slow, and after a long time, only half the Frost Rune's lines had lit up.
Yuan Ming, sensing the swift depletion of his mana, and fearing insufficient reserve, quickly took out a Spirit Stone and clutched it in his hand. While he recovered with all his might, he persisted in channeling his power.
Time trickled by, and the spiritual power within the Gathering Spirit Formation was rapidly depleting.
Silver Cat Xi Ying observed the changes in the furnace body, and her eyes flashed slightly, sensing that something was amiss.
"Yuan Ming, what runes did you engrave?" Xi Ying inquired.
"The Frost Rune and the Gale Rune," Yuan Ming repeated.
In the silver cat's unusual eyes, doubt surfaced, and it stepped forward, waving its paw.
The Sealing Door of the casting furnace immediately swung open, with a blast of scorching air sweeping out, which it ignored completely.
Upon witnessing the nearly completed Enriching of the Frost Rune on the Green Fish Sword, its emotional state shifted subtly, and it no longer communicated with Yuan Ming through telepathy, but instead spoke aloud:
"This is not any Frost Rune, but the rarer Extreme Cold Rune!"
Yuan Ming was taken aback by this revelation, not even noticing the silver cat's speech.
He remembered seeing the description of the Frost Rune in Master Hei Mu's pen notes, which stated its power was greater than the common Five Elements Rune, without much further explanation.
"I see," Yuan Ming said.
Hearing this, Xi Ying didn't respond to his words but instead instructed, "Do you have more Spirit Stones? Throw in five more."
Yuan Ming, discerning the urgency in its tone, didn't dare delay and hastily took out five Spirit Stones and cast them into the furnace.
With a glint in its eyes, Silver Cat Xi Ying summoned an invisible force that captured the five Spirit Stones, guiding them precisely onto the five Gathering Spirit Talismans.
As the Spirit Stones settled, the Array affected them immediately, converting them into spiritual mist that rose and enveloped the Green Fish Sword.

chapters.title: Chapter 180 - 160: Scrape the Ground Three Feet
chapters.content:
"Focus all of your mana without distraction," Xi Ying reminded him again.
Although Yuan Ming was puzzled, he sensed the urgency in the emotional shift and knew something unexpected must have arisen.
He immediately steadied his mind and concentrated on funneling his mana into the casting furnace little by little.
The Extreme Cold Rune on the Green Fish Sword gradually illuminated as it was permeated by both spiritual power and mana, and finally lit up completely.
But just then, an abrupt change occurred.
The enriching of the Extreme Cold Rune, now completed, seemed to spiral out of control. Its snowy light grew increasingly bright, and a wave of bitter cold spread instantaneously, suppressing the Gathering Spirit Formation and causing the temperature in the casting furnace to plummet.
If it hadn't been for the timely addition of spirit stones just before, the entire Gathering Spirit Formation would likely have failed in that instant.
"Damn," Yuan Ming cursed to himself.
At that moment, he had no time for any other reaction but to operate the Nine Elements Technique with all his might, transferring his mana into the Green Fish Sword in an effort to keep the enriching process from halting.
If interrupted now, not only would the Green Fish Sword fail to advance to a magic artifact, but the unconnected runes could also cause an imbalance of spiritual power within the sword, leading to a catastrophic loss of control and shattering of the weapon.
Just then, Yuan Ming felt a warm current rise behind him, quickly turning searing hot.
Before he could turn around, he saw a line of fire surge forth, grazing past him and plunging into the casting furnace.
The intense flames brought a scorching heat, clashing against the wintry aura emitted by the runes, instantly stabilizing the temperature of the casting furnace and preserving the teetering Gathering Spirit Formation.
"Well done."
Seeing that it was Huo Chan'er blowing her cheeks to continuously spew flames into the furnace, Yuan Ming was overjoyed.
He had only brought the little creature along to look after it and had not expected it to play such a crucial role at a critical moment.
Yuan Ming didn't dare to be distracted and seized the opportunity with Huo Chan'er's help to hasten the completion of the enriching process.
Fortunately, the enriching of the Gale Rune was much faster than the Extreme Cold Rune, and before Yuan Ming's mana was exhausted and Huo Chan'er ran out of strength, they finally achieved their goal.
At the instant of completing the enriching, the two linked runes lit up together, yet no anomalies occurred; in fact, the once emanating cold aura was now entirely retracted.
The entire Green Fish Sword seemed to have been instantly subdued, receding all its sharpness.
By that point, Yuan Ming's whole body was drenched in sweat, and he collapsed on the ground, completely drained.
A short distance behind him, Huo Chan'er also lay on the ground, tilting its head, panting with its tongue out, its abdomen inflating and deflating dramatically—obviously, it too was greatly spent and weary.
Barely managing to get up, Yuan Ming took out three or four Fire Crystal Stones and a piece of Fire Jade; after a moment's thought, he also produced a Fire Jade Marrow and placed it at Huo Chan'er's mouth.
The little creature's eyes lit up, but it didn't eat immediately, instead continuing to catch its breath to recover its strength.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming felt a bit embarrassed, patted Huo Chan'er's head, and then stood up to go to the casting furnace, taking out the now-renewed Green Fish Sword.
His eyes fixed on the runes of the Green Fish Sword, he poured his thoughts into it, and his vision suddenly blurred, giving him the fleeting illusion of a white whirlwind sweeping past.
Yuan Ming was delighted. He had heard from his senior brother Mu He about such occurrences before.
A magical tool rune that had undergone enriching now had the basic attribute of channeling nature's spiritual energy when invested with a divine soul and enough concentrated divine thought, allowing one to see the respective elemental phenomena.
"Give it a try," Xi Ying's voice came through.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming nodded, then suddenly realized with a start, "You can talk?"
Previously, his mind was preoccupied with enriching the sword, and he had assumed the voice was coming from his Sea of Consciousness. It wasn't until that moment that he realized it was actually coming from the silver cat's mouth.
"I've been able to talk for a while now, what's so surprising about that?" Xi Ying gave him an unimpressed look.
"Then why didn't you speak before?" Yuan Ming asked, puzzled.
"Wouldn't it be troublesome if others heard my voice? Are you always this slow-witted? There's no one else around here anyway," Xi Ying replied.
"No big deal, it's just that your spoken voice sounds different from what I heard in my Sea of Consciousness," Yuan Ming said with a smile.
"Different how?" Xi Ying immediately asked, clearly concerned about the response to this question.
"The voice that comes out is more real, pleasant, and nicer to listen to," Yuan Ming thought for a moment before responding.
Xi Ying seemed very pleased with Yuan Ming's answer.
"I feel like the way you talk has become nicer recently too," after saying so, Xi Ying realized Yuan Ming had already lowered his head to study the newly refined Green Fish Sword and mumbled to itself in a voice only it could hear, "Horrible sounding, speaking with Guoguo's mouth, how can it sound nice with a miaowing tone?"
The newly refined artifact naturally did not require further refining; Yuan Ming grasped the hilt in one hand, with mana flowing through the sword handle.
The runes on the blade lit up, and, simultaneously, the Yin Jade embedded along the blade began to gleam as well, like solitary cold stars reflected upon green river waters.
An aura of cold instantly spread, causing the temperature inside the entire cave to rapidly decrease, as if stepping into deep winter.
Yuan Ming casually swung a sword flourish, lifted the blade, and slashed towards the cliff face ahead.
A streak of white Sword Qi shot out from the edge of the blade in an instant, striking the cliff three zhang away in the blink of an eye.
The sound of rocks breaking echoed as a white fissure appeared on the steadfast cliff.
Yuan Ming stepped forward to inspect the damage and saw that the fissure was a good three feet long and a foot deep, with a layer of white ice crystals that showed no sign of melting even after a long while.
"Judging solely by the state of the stone wall, it's hard to say for certain, but your magic sword's power probably approaches that of a top-grade magical tool. Even if it falls short, it's by a very thin margin," Xi Ying's voice came from behind him.
"A top-grade magical tool? But it only has two runes, doesn't it?" Yuan Ming said, surprised.
"That's why I said it's infinitely close, not that it is one," Xi Ying replied.
Yuan Ming glanced at the long sword in his hand, then back at the mark on the wall, a pleased smile appearing on his face.
When he had been enriching the sword earlier, he had used up a lot of Mana, and he hadn't even used his full strength during the sword testing; the Green Fish Sword's true power hadn't been fully unleashed yet.
"The quality of the materials used for the sword is one reason for its power; the amplification brought on by the Extreme Cold Rune is another. And of course, there's its contribution," Xi Ying said, glancing at Huo Chan'er nearby.
The little one had regained some strength and was immediately back to eating voraciously, crunching on the Fire Crystal Stone as sparks flew in all directions.
Seeing this brought a deeper smile to Yuan Ming's face, though he felt a tinge of regret knowing that Huo Chan'er belonged to the Three Cave Masters and would have to be returned at any time.
He held the sword horizontally in front of him, looking at the scattering of starlight on its surface, and furrowed his eyebrows.
"Now that it's a magical tool, I feel like the name 'Green Fish Sword' doesn't sound right. Xi Ying, why don't you come up with a name for the sword?" Yuan Ming turned to look at Xi Ying and asked.This соntеnt оriginаtеs frоm М1VLЕМРYR, Мy Virtuаl Librаry Еmpirе.
He actually already had a name in mind, but to show his appreciation for the silver cat's help, he wanted it to name the sword.
"The sword's cold gleam shimmers like a frost-covered star, call it the Cold Star Sword," Xi Ying said after a brief pause.
Yuan Ming responded, "What a coincidence; we're on the same wavelength. I was thinking the same thing."
In truth, the name he had thought of was the two characters for 'Frost.'
But the name Xi Ying had chosen, even without the poetic phrasing, conjured an image of a 'lonely cold star in the night' that fit his sword perfectly.
"Lying through your teeth, you're just humoring me," Xi Ying leaped onto the casting furnace and looked at Yuan Ming, remarking.
"Not at all, we really did think alike. Xi Ying, which country's poem did that line come from?" Yuan Ming quickly shook his head and asked.
At his words, Xi Ying's striking eyes closed slightly, and their gaze grew dim.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming knew he had spoken out of turn and upset Xi Ying, and without the ability to voice his comfort, he fell silent beside her.
Fortunately, the silver cat's mood soon lifted, though it no longer paid attention to Yuan Ming.
After sheathing the Cold Star Sword, Yuan Ming sat down cross-legged and closed his eyes in meditation, circulating the Nine Elements Technique to recover his Mana.
...
The next day, at dawn.
With his Mana restored, Yuan Ming rose feeling refreshed to find Silver Cat Xi Ying sprawled on the casting furnace, though Huo Chan'er was nowhere to be seen; he immediately inquired about it.
"The little thing took off after it had its fill," Xi Ying said, sounding disinterested.
"We need to return to the Sect soon. In a few days, I'll have to go out again," Yuan Ming said.
Xi Ying looked at him, her gaze showing curiosity.
"It's just a brief outing; I shouldn't be gone for more than a few days, and I'll be back soon," Yuan Ming explained.
He estimated that participating in a Scatter Alliance mission wouldn't take too much time.
"What will you be doing?" To his surprise, Xi Ying pressed for details.
Yuan Ming thought it over and decided to share the details of the Scatter Alliance mission with her.
After listening, Xi Ying remarked, "Killing the Snake King, huh? Sounds fun. That creature is full of treasures, what a pity. I'm at a critical point in my cultivation and can't join you."
Actually, Yuan Ming didn't feel disappointed that Xi Ying wasn't going.
Deep down, he couldn't fully trust those in the Scatter Alliance, but if he constantly needed others' help, how would he ever make his mark in the Cultivation World?
After a short period of rest, Yuan Ming prepared to leave, his gaze falling once more on the casting furnace.
He had wanted to take the casting furnace with him last time as well, but he hadn't managed to do so due to the Array on the ground.
This time, knowing that there was a Gathering Spirit Formation on the casting furnace, Yuan Ming was even less willing to give it up.
"If you destroy the Array on the ground, you can move the casting furnace," Xi Ying immediately saw through his intention and said.
"A man, long trapped, upon finding a treasure mountain, often wishes to scrape it bare to the ground," Xi Ying glanced at Yuan Ming, her words a precise tease.
Yuan Ming continued to examine the Rune Array on the floor, ignoring Xi Ying's mocking tone.
He studied the Rune Array meticulously, memorizing the curvature and connections of every line until he flicked his wrist and pulled out the Cold Star Sword.
The next moment, cold air surged from the Cold Star Sword, and as its blade sliced across the ground, the Array crumbled instantaneously.
Then, with a gentle wave of his hand over the casting furnace, Yuan Ming swallowed it up whole into his bag.

chapters.title: Chapter 181 - 161: Borrowing the Gauze
chapters.content:
By the time a man and a cat emerged from the cave, the sky outside was already brightly lit.
"Roar..."
Just then, a beastly roar suddenly came from the distant forest.
"Tsk, it's that little thing, seems like it's provoked a big one." The silver cat's eyes flickered, and it spoke.
Yuan Ming also attempted to release his Divine Sense to probe the surroundings, but the distance was too limited to detect Huo Chan'er's tracks.
However, the commotion from afar was huge, and with Xi Ying confirming it was Huo Chan'er, Yuan Ming did not hesitate any longer. He executed the Wind Swift Skill, heading straight toward the source of the noise.
Huo Chan'er was the Three Cave Masters' darling, absolutely not to be lost!
He ran for less than five minutes when he saw Huo Chan'er with a three-inch long, red plant root in its mouth, running towards him as if possessed, frantically waving its short legs.
Behind it was a fire mane lizard about ten to twelve feet long covered in scales, spitting a red tongue, relentlessly pursuing it.
Clearly, Huo Chan'er had snatched its treasure.
The little creature, relying on its agile figure, darted left and right through the woods, cleverly avoiding the fire mane lizard's attacks. Seeing Yuan Ming approaching, it ran even more desperately, as if seeing a life-saving straw, its eyes shining brightly.
The lizard's tongue kept striking, causing the forest trees to snap and rocks to scatter.
Yuan Ming watched, speechless. It was just a Level 1 Middle Stage Fierce Beast. If Huo Chan'er was willing to drop the object in its mouth and spit a flame backward, even if it couldn't kill the fire mane lizard, it should be able to repel it.
But the glutton insisted on being chased around rather than letting go of the delicacy it had gotten.
Once it reached behind Yuan Ming, it stopped running and ceased to dodge.
Looking at the fire mane lizard rushing towards him, Yuan Ming sighed lightly, "Bad luck for you, just in time to test the power!"
With that, he gripped the newly refined Cold Star Sword and slashed downward with a powerful stroke.
An extremely cold Wind Blade burst from the blade, instantly striking the fire mane lizard's head.
The Fierce Beast, unable to stop its charging momentum, ran two more steps then suddenly stiffened. A crack ran through its entire body, splitting it in two, which then fell to the ground.
Upon seeing this, Yuan Ming immediately went to inspect it and soon discovered that the fire mane lizard's body was completely frozen, even the blood inside its veins congealed, leaving not a single trace of blood on its body.
At this moment, Huo Chan'er caught up, still chewing on the root in its mouth, it leapt onto the lizard's head and kicked furiously with its short legs.
Yuan Ming could now clearly see that what was held in its front paws was indeed a "Red Yellow Spirit," a Fire Attribute Spiritual Medicine, which seemed to be a hundred years old judging from its appearance.
No wonder the fire mane lizard was fighting to the death for it.
Yuan Ming grabbed Huo Chan'er by the scruff of its neck, lifted it onto his shoulder, and turned to glance at the leisurely approaching Xi Ying.
The little creature seemed somewhat fearful of Xi Ying, shrinking its body and only peering out at the silver cat with half of its head exposed. At a mere glance from Xi Ying, the little creature's body shuddered and slid right off Yuan Ming, falling onto his leg and hugging it tight.
Xi Ying gave Huo Chan'er a glance and then, with a graceful leap, landed on a nearby branch. After a few more leaps, it vanished from sight.
After watching Xi Ying leave, Yuan Ming took Huo Chan'er and left Mist Island, returning to the Sect.
By the time they returned to Biluo Cave, it was already evening.
To Yuan Ming's surprise, the Three Cave Masters had rushed back and actively sought him out.
"Follow me, I'll help you craft the sword." Her condition appeared poor as if she had just been through a battle, looking rather fatigued.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming felt a touch moved.
No wonder Fang Ge held the Three Cave Masters in such high regard; despite her high status, she was indeed someone who kept her promises.
Seeing Yuan Ming standing still, the Three Cave Masters frowned and said, "What are you waiting for? We don't have much time left."
"Thank you, Three Cave Masters, but the Disciple's sword has already been completed," Yuan Ming bowed with his hands clasped and said.
Now it was the Three Cave Masters' turn to be stunned.
"Which elder helped you forge this sword?" After regaining her composure, the Three Cave Masters asked.
"All the elders were in closed-door Artifact Refining, leaving me no choice but to seek help from an Artifact Refiner in the workshop," Yuan Ming explained, taking out the Cold Star Sword.
"Artifact Refiner from outside, are there Artifact Refiners everywhere out there?" The Three Cave Masters' gaze swept over the sword but she didn't seem to take it seriously, smiling.
"This Artifact Refiner's skill is not inferior, and the choice of runes for the sword is also quite brilliant. The rank of your sword should be above Mid-grade Magical Artifact, nearly High Grade," the Three Cave Masters commented.
Hearing this, and seeing that the Three Cave Masters had finished speaking without further inquiry about the Artifact Refiner, Yuan Ming felt relieved. He took out the Yunling Sword Box and returned it to the Three Cave Masters.
"Come, follow me on another trip," the Three Cave Masters said as she put away the Sword Box and addressed Yuan Ming.
Having said that, she turned and walked outside.
Not understanding the reason, Yuan Ming could only follow her immediately.
Upon returning to the Three Cave Masters' courtyard, she spoke again, "Give me the Green Fish Sword."
Yuan Ming hesitated briefly, but then took out the sword and presented it to her with both hands.
"This sword's appearance and might have both undergone significant changes, and I have already named it 'Cold Star'," Yuan Ming said.
"The name is well chosen. However, your magic sword's refinement is not complete until the Forbidden Array is engraved. I will attend to that for you," responded the Three Cave Masters. She initially furrowed her brows slightly at his words but soon her expression softened.
"Forbidden Array?" Yuan Ming exclaimed in surprise.
"As I mentioned when teaching you the refining mnemonic, magical artifacts generally have restrictions. The more advanced the artifact, and especially with Magic Treasures, the more complex the Forbidden Arrays attached to them. This is to ensure that if your enemies seize the artifact, they cannot immediately activate it with Mana and turn it against you," the Three Cave Master explained.
"I see, I am grateful to the Three Cave Master," Yuan Ming immediately said with a clasped fist.
"I had agreed to help you with the engraving and spirit implanting. Compared to that, inscribing the Forbidden Array is much simpler," the Three Cave Master said.
Having finished speaking, she took the longsword from Yuan Ming's hands and, with a flip of her wrist, pulled out the Spirit Awakening Engraving Knife to begin etching a complex rune Array onto the other side of the blade.
About two hours later.
The Three Cave Master returned the sword to Yuan Ming, having completed the engraving of the Forbidden Array.
"This Forbidden Array has not yet been activated. Once you channel your Mana into it, it will become effective. Aside from yourself, others will not be able to wield this magic sword easily," the Three Cave Master said.
Hearing this, Yuan Ming was delighted. After offering his thanks, he immediately grasped the hilt of the sword, eager to channel a thread of Mana into it.
"Don't be too pleased. It's only a temporary measure. If you die and it's taken from you, it could still be refined by others," the Three Cave Master warned.
"Disciple understands," Yuan Ming replied.
As Mana flowed in, a flash of light appeared on the blade, and a red Forbidden Array emerged, then vanished as quickly as it had appeared, no longer visible to the naked eye.
Yuan Ming then noticed that the characters "Green Fish" originally engraved on the blade had been replaced with "Cold Star."
He remembered Huo Chan'er, who was still hastily packed away in the Spiritual Beast Bag due to their rushed journey. He quickly opened the bag and released it.
The little creature burst out of the bag the moment it was opened, dashing out at a frenzied pace.
However, it immediately ran into the Three Cave Master, who embraced it in her ample bosom, once again robbing it of its freedom.
"Since you'll be attending the White Deer Hill assembly, you should, like Chen Wan, enter closed-door cultivation for the next period. There's no need to visit the Fire Refining Hall for now. Try to enhance your Cultivation level before the assembly. Go," the Three Cave Master instructed, then proceeded to dismiss him.
"Disciple will remember your instructions," Yuan Ming said with a bow.
Returning to his abode, Yuan Ming rested briefly before taking out the incense burner and starting to channel Mana into it, lighting up the Tai Chi Pattern.
...
A few days later, Yuan Ming packed his belongings, donned a long black robe and a wide bamboo hat with a curtain of gauze, and prepared to leave.This is part of a series from My Virtual Library Empire (*).
Before stepping out the door, he turned for one last look at the window. Xi Ying seemed to have been absent for a few days, likely at a critical moment in her Cultivation. With a shrug, Yuan Ming closed the door.
Just as Yuan Ming was about to leave, a silver figure suddenly appeared on the windowsill, scoffing, "Off to play the hero again?"
Then she tossed him the gold-plated gauze that Yuan Ming had given her.
"Why is this?" Yuan Ming caught the golden gauze, puzzled.
"I'm lending this to you, and you'll owe me if it gets damaged! Goodbye!" The moment the telepathic message ended, the silver cat's figure had already vanished from sight.
...
After two days of travel, Yuan Ming finally reached Ghost Cry Gorge in the depths of the Ten Thousand Mountains, arriving at the agreed-upon time.
By then, about fifty individuals had already gathered at the cool entrance of the canyon, sitting or standing in groups of two or three, each keeping a distinct distance from one another.
For Yuan Ming, who already knew the ins and outs, the number of people was not surprising.
As Yuan Ming arrived, many eyes turned to watch him.
However, all but one quickly diverted their gaze. The white-clothed young man who had previously tested Yuan Ming's qualifications kept his eyes fixed on him and approached him directly.
"Fellow Daoist, please this way," the white-clothed young man said with a welcoming smile as he neared.
Yuan Ming also nodded with a smile in response.
He walked towards the group of people, noting that most of them were men with few female cultivators among them. Their appearances and attires varied greatly, contrasting starkly with the uniformly white-clad members of the White Night Scatter Alliance.
Many of them, like him, either wore veiled hats or masks on their faces, unwilling to reveal their true identities.
While it was only a temporary mission, Yuan Ming felt both anxious and eager as he sat down on a rock amidst the crowd, quietly waiting for the White Night Scatter Alliance's arrangements.
That's when he suddenly realized that Bai Ye and Huan Shi, the Alliance Hierarch and Vice Alliance Hierarch of the White Night Alliance, were not among the gathered members.
Just then, two figures emerged side by side from the gorge. It was precisely those two.
Bai Ye, as the Alliance Hierarch, did not come forward to speak but rather returned to the ranks of the official members of the Scatter Alliance, quietly instructing them.
On the contrary, Huan Shi, who seemed to handle ordinary affairs within the alliance, approached the waiting temporary members with a warm smile on his face.
Seeing him approach, most stood up politely, while some remained sitting nonchalantly on the ground, their behavior indicating they frequently participated in such tasks and did not consider it a big deal.

chapters.title: Chapter 182 - 162: Grasping the Rhythm
chapters.content:
"Fellow Daoists, it's about time. Those who have not arrived on time will be considered to have forfeited the mission. I would like to thank everyone in advance for showing up as promised," Huan Shi courteously delivered some pleasantries.
"There's no need for formalities. We're not here to sightsee, so you really should get to the point and explain the details of this mission," a burly man, seated cross-legged on a giant stone, called out impatiently.
"Leave those formalities for the Sect disciples to enjoy. We Loose Cultivators don't have time for this nonsense! We're here for the Spirit Stones, so let's get down to business!"
"Yes! These Scatter Alliance activities are always so secretive, and we still don't know what we're supposed to do even as we're about to set out!"
As the burly man spoke, others quickly echoed his sentiments.
"Very well, very well. Seeing that all fellow daoists are frank and straightforward, I'm quite relieved," Huan Shi responded, his gaze sweeping over the crowd with a gentle demeanor, seemingly unbothered by their impatience.
"Fellow daoists, our White Night Scatter Alliance has summoned you all here to cross the Ghost Cry Gorge behind us and enter the Snake King Valley to hunt the Golden Flower Poison Python King."
As Huan Shi declared this, most were visibly confused, not understanding what the Snake King was.
Yuan Ming already knew their objective, having done thorough research after returning to the Biluo Cave.
An ordinary Golden Flower Poison Python is just a Level 1 Intermediate-stage Fierce Beast, roughly equivalent to the fourth to sixth levels of the Qi Refinement Realm.
However, do not be deceived by their seemingly modest strength. These types of snakes reproduce rapidly, prefer to live in groups and, due to their aggressive nature, when hunting, often attack en masse, relenting only upon death.
Thus, encountering them can become quite troublesome.
This is likely why the White Night Scatter Alliance had recruited a large number of temporary members.
"May I ask the Alliance Hierarch what exactly is this Golden Flower Poison Python King and does it have any special offensive capabilities?" he asked proactively.
"The Golden Flower Poison Python King is a Second-level Middle Stage Fierce Beast, roughly equivalent to the early to mid stages of Foundation Establishment. This beast is robust, extremely strong, and highly venomous," Huan Shi replied following Yuan Ming's gaze, then went on to explain to the others.
Yuan Ming nodded inwardly at this; the information was consistent with what he had researched.
Hearing that the Golden Flower Poison Python King was a Second-level Middle Stage Fierce Beast, everyone's expressions, demeanors, and movements unanimously underwent subtle changes.
Some even openly showed a tinge of retreat.
"Alliance Hierarch, hunting a Second-level Middle Stage Fierce Beast… You're overestimating us, we can't take on such a task," a tall, thin middle-aged man spoke up first.
"Even with many Qi Refining Stage Cultivators, hunting a Second-level Middle Stage Fierce Beast would inevitably lead to heavy casualties. We're only here to make some Spirit Stones, not to risk our lives," another person immediately added.
"What a joke…"
...
Doubts continued to fill the air.
"Fellow Daoists, please stay calm. I haven't finished. Your main task will be to eliminate any Fierce Beasts and poisons blocking the path and spread out to track the Snake King. If anyone can find the tracks of the Snake King, we will offer an additional reward of three hundred Spirit Stones. Those who participate in killing the Golden Flower Poison Python King will receive a reward not less than one hundred Spirit Stones, and depending on your contribution, up to five hundred Spirit Stones," Huan Shi gestured with his hands in front of him, calming their objections.The ori+gi@n#a#l+ s#ou-r^ce+ is *.&
With the promise of a hefty reward, the voices of dissent slightly diminished.
"Why were you vague earlier and unwilling to disclose this risk, waiting instead until we were all gathered here to speak?" However, some still questioned.
Most had already figured out the answer—it was to deceive them into coming here first.
"This matter involves a covert operation by the White Night Scatter Alliance, not suitable for prior disclosure. But rest assured, those who now wish to withdraw can still do so in time, and appropriate compensation will be offered," Huan Shi stated.
At the mention of compensation, those who were apprehensive relaxed their expressions and immediately asked about the compensation details.
Huan Shi extended two fingers and said, "Those who choose to give up now can receive two Spirit Stones and leave immediately."
"Two pieces?"
For ordinary Qi Refinement Stage Loose Cultivators, two Spirit Stones were actually not insignificant, but compared to the maximum potential reward of five hundred Spirit Stones for participating in the mission, they seemed trivial.
The extreme contrast in the number of Spirit Stones aroused some insatiable desires among the crowd.
