If they hadn't known the rewards for participating in the mission or if the rewards had not been so substantial, they might have readily accepted the two Spirit Stones as compensation.
After all, they had merely spent some time traveling here, and receiving two Spirit Stones as compensation was hugely profitable by any calculation.
But the reference to the five hundred Spirit Stones made it quite hard to bear.
Yuan Ming couldn't help but admire internally; the White Night Scatter Alliance had played their hand brilliantly, precisely gauging the minds of these people. He wondered whether it was Bai Ye or Huan Shi's idea.
The atmosphere suddenly became tense, as all the temporary members were torn, contemplating whether to take the risk and gamble.
Setting aside the highly risky part of participating in the killing of the Snake King, just finding its traces could yield as many as three hundred spirit stones!
"I have another question. If we enter Snake King Valley and the situation is more severe than we anticipated, can we withdraw midway?" the tall, thin middle-aged man asked again.
"Once you enter Snake King Valley, your life and fortune are decreed by fate. You become comrades tied to our cause. Any person's sudden retreat could likely cause harm or death to others, so fundamentally, withdrawal is not an option," Huan Shi stated.
Fundamentally not an option, but what about in practice?
As expected, Huan Shi added:
"However, considering the complexity of the situation, before finding the Snake King, everyone will have one opportunity to withdraw, and we will compensate each person with ten spirit stones."
Upon hearing this, those present once again fell into a moral dilemma.
"Having money is great, but one must also have a life to spend it," yet voices of doubt still existed.
"At least there's an additional chance to withdraw, and ten spirit stones as compensation isn't too little..." a Loose Cultivator pondered aloud.
"It's worth a try," someone decided.
"Sorry, I'm out of this task," another chose to withdraw.
With one person withdrawing, soon after, seven or eight more voices of withdrawal were heard, though it was much fewer than at the beginning.
After the few who decided to leave stepped out of the crowd, the White Night Alliance people indeed did not make it difficult for them.
"To each their own. Since several Fellow Daoists have chosen to withdraw, we will not force you. We'll give each of you two spirit stones as a compensation for your troubles," Huan Shi spoke.
After saying this, he glanced at the young man clad in white standing beside him and called out, "Tuozhe."
The young man in white heard him and immediately stepped forward to distribute spirit stones to the seven or eight members who withdrew temporarily.
Seeing the open and generous actions of the White Night Alliance, those temporary members who originally had doubts and feared being deceived had all their anger and concerns dissipated.
Among them, two even felt that the actions of the White Night Alliance were so transparent and generous that they changed their minds on the spot and decided to continue participating in this beast-hunting mission.
Those still determined to leave, after receiving the spirit stones, also took their leave with a respectful salute.
"Fellow Daoists, we of the White Night Alliance have no other demands, just hope that after you leave, you do not disclose the affairs here. At least do not spread it around for the coming days. Should it bring us unnecessary trouble, you too might find yourselves in difficulties," Huan Shi stated after giving the sweet dates to soothe them, he then used the stick to intimidate.
The people who had just received the spirit stones all understood this was a method of both kindness and severity, and they promised not to disclose anything.
After they all had left, Huan Shi then continued speaking to the remaining people:
"You all are peers of strong will, and I believe our cooperation will certainly go smoothly. Inside Snake King Valley, poison miasma pervades everywhere; ordinary anti-poison pills are ineffective against it. We have already prepared anti-plague pearls in advance to dispel the poison miasma."
After saying this, he had several official members of the White Night Alliance step forward to distribute anti-plague pearls to everyone.
Yuan Ming received a fist-sized glazed bead, which had flowing light shimmering on it, making it look just like a treasure bead.
"This is the anti-plague pearl, no need to refine it. You all only need to transfer some mana into it, and it will emanate a cleansing light that forms a safe area with a hundred feet radius around you," Huan Shi said.
After saying this, he let Tuozhe and several others distribute a blue jade talisman to everyone.
"This is a sensing jade talisman, keep it carefully. Once inside the poison miasma, if you get lost, you can crush this item. People nearby will sense it and find your location. Among you, if anyone finds the location of the Golden Flower Poison Python King, you can also crush this item to send a signal," Huan Shi continued.
Upon hearing this, everyone lowered their heads to inspect the jade talisman in their hands.
Yuan Ming rubbed the jade talisman, feeling the rune patterns on it, examined it for a moment, then stored it away.
"To facilitate orderly exploration and mutual support, we will divide everyone into seven teams, each assigned a different area to explore," Huan Shi stated.
After finishing his explanation, he directed the twenty-seven remaining temporary members, grouping them into seven teams of four members each.
The first person assigned to Yuan Ming's team was a burly iron giant, his body wrapped tightly in a cloth robe, almost no skin exposed except for his face.
The second person was one of the few women in the team, dressed in tight black clothing that perfectly outlined her slender figure, a thin black gauze covering half of her face, yet her exquisitely perfect contours were faintly visible.
Especially at the corner of her eye, a rosy-colored tear mole naturally endowed her with a pitiable charm.
The last person, also dressed in black, wore a short, sharp outfit, with a belt around his waist hanging several delicately small bottles and pots and a dark gourd.
This led Yuan Ming to speculate that he was very likely a person from the Hundred Poison Cave.

chapters.title: Chapter 183 - 163 Each Takes Their Own Actions
chapters.content:
Fourteen official members of the White Night Scatter Alliance dispersed, with each pair joining a temporary small team.
The white-robed youth, Tuozhe, joined Yuan Ming's team, and gave him a meaningful smile, while Vice Alliance Hierarch Huan Shi just happened to be in their team as well.
Soon after, the seven teams officially set off, entering the depths of Ghost Cry Gorge.
The narrow Ghost Cry Gorge stretched for a hundred yards, with nothing out of the ordinary on the outermost section. But halfway in, a white mist had already started to spread throughout the gorge, becoming thicker the deeper one went.
"Everyone, no need to be nervous. We have already investigated this area, and it's just ordinary fog. The Poison Miasma is yellowish in color, and you'll see it once we really enter Snake King Valley," Huan Shi reminded them timely, dispelling everyone's doubts.
At this point, members of the different teams began to whisper among themselves, quietly conversing.
"Fellow Daoists, please introduce yourselves. It will be good to have names to call each other by once we're inside. I am from the White Night Scatter Alliance, Tuozhe," said the white-robed youth in Yuan Ming's team of six, taking the initiative to speak.
"Hagon," Yuan Ming responded first.
"I am Mang Tung," boomed the tower-like giant.
"My name is Bai Rong," whispered the black-gauzed woman, her voice quite pleasing to the ear.
The young man dressed in a black short coat was the last to speak, his voice as hoarse as that of a seventy-year-old man.
"Kun Sha," he said succinctly, voicing just two words.
With that, everyone became acquainted.
The hundred yards of distance wasn't far, and they quickly reached the end of the gorge.
Yuan Ming looked around and saw not a narrow and constrained valley, but a vast Ancient Mountain Forest.
The trees in the forest towered high, each at least a hundred yards tall. Curiously, their canopies were extremely lofty, almost all concentrated at the top of the trees. From a distance, they resembled towering umbrellas.
Under the trees, about several dozen yards high, was a dense, white mist swirling around.
Close to the side of the gorge was still white, but going further inward, the mist had turned into an opaque milky white that seemed inextricably thick.
Without waiting for Huan Shi's command, Yuan Ming took the lead, charging headlong into the thick fog.
The enveloping mist instantly hid his figure from view.
"Come back! Do not act recklessly," Huan Shi ordered loudly upon seeing this.
Tuozhe's expression also changed, clearly not expecting Yuan Ming to be so reckless, and he couldn't help but curse inwardly, "Idiot."
The official members of the other White Night Scatter Alliance teams frowned one by one, while the temporary members had smirks on their faces, as if enjoying the spectacle.
Fortunately, Yuan Ming retreated back soon after Huan Shi raised his voice.
"What's wrong with you all? Aren't you going in?" He looked confused, as if unaware that he had done anything wrong.
"The Poison Miasma is dangerous; do not act on your own," Huan Shi, feeling that the gazes from other teams were aggregating upon them, a bit embarrassed, yet still managed to suppress his anger and cautioned them.
"Didn't you say the white mist is not poisonous?" Yuan Ming blinked, puzzled.
"Just because it's not poisonous doesn't mean you can run around blindly," someone said, looking at him as if he were a fool.
"Follow the commands for all actions. If you run around blindly again and end up in danger, no one will save you," Huan Shi warned, frowning.
Yuan Ming didn't argue and immediately returned to the team.
His gaze subconsciously glanced upward, and he saw a black raven, with barely a circle in flight, stealthily flapping its wings and flying into the thick fog.
His seemingly impulsive act was actually a silent way to release a soul crow to help scout ahead. The fog served as a natural barrier, or else he couldn't have done it without attracting any attention.
With his current level of cultivation and Soul Power, maintaining a soul crow for a long time was no longer difficult.
After this interlude, Huan Shi began to assign different sectors to each small team to explore.
Different teams, in different directions, were responsible for the search and exploration of a sector-shaped area.
Yuan Ming's team was tasked to head toward the left side of the valley, find the left valley wall, and then start spreading their search toward the adjacent team's direction within the boundaries of the left side of the valley.
"All teams, maintain a hundred yards distance. Move out," commanded Huan Shi.
All the teams began to move successively, heading off to their designated areas.
Yuan Ming's team did not rush to explore inside the valley but first followed along the border area between the white and yellow Poison Miasma, moving towards the left until they found the edge of the valley, then started to explore inward.
After a while walking, Yuan Ming realized that Snake King Valley was much larger than he had imagined. With a total of forty-two people spread out, it was like forty-two stones tossed into a vast lake.
No wonder the White Night Scatter Alliance resorted to deceptive methods to recruit so many temporary members.
"Gentlemen, spread out and search individually. If you encounter any danger, do not forget to shout loudly, to alert and assist each other," Huan Shi instructed.
After acknowledging, everyone distanced themselves a little and then walked deeper into the valley.
Yuan Ming intentionally chose a side close to the valley cliffs to easily differentiate his location.
Carefully, he channeled his Mana into the anti-plague pearl.
The next instant, the anti-plague pearl emitted a halo of glaze-colored light, spreading outwards.
Under the reflection of the glaze light, the surrounding mist remained pervasive, but the thick and sticky sensation seemed to have lessened somewhat.
As they entered the fog, there was nothing unusual, except that their vision was obstructed.
Although they were cultivators, they still couldn't see through the mist.
Yuan Ming's eyesight was slightly stronger than the others; he could only see things within a distance of thirty feet, beyond which everything became indistinct, and his Divine Sense was even less effective than his eyesight. Considering the soul crows were scouting around, he decided not to use it.
Although the group spread out, they could no longer see each other, but they could still see the blurry light from the anti-plague pearl.
After walking in the fog for a long time, Yuan Ming finally saw the Poison Miasma that Huan Shi had mentioned.
The color was a smoky yellow, incompatible with the white mist, with a clear separation between them as if there was an invisible wall.
"We are about to enter the Poison Miasma area. Everyone, be on your guard and watch out for stealth attacks by poisonous insects and fierce beasts," Huan Shi's warning voice came from a distance.
Hearing his reminder, everyone became fully alert.
Kun Sha, a young man in black, took a black porcelain bottle from his waist and uncorked it.
From the mouth of the bottle, a bright red ant the size of a rice grain slowly crawled out, jumped to the ground, and made its way into the poisonous fog.
Yuan Ming looked up to the sky to see a black raven gliding through the air, entering the Poison Miasma ahead of the group.
Inside, the fog was even thicker, and the visibility was further reduced.
However, the raven was not attacked, and only then did Yuan Ming follow and enter.
Once he stepped into the yellow miasma, he immediately felt a tingling pain on his exposed skin, as if being pricked by needles, and after only a few steps, he felt a burning sensation in his nostrils.
Yuan Ming checked his condition and, reassuring himself that it was only a mild reaction and not poisoning, he breathed a sigh of relief.
In the thickening fog, they could vaguely hear the coughing of others, suggesting that their throats were also suffering.
At that moment, Yuan Ming suddenly received a visual from the soul crow in his Sea of Consciousness: a mass of dark dots in the dense fog was pressing towards them.
Simultaneously, Kun Sha's shout came from a distance:
"Toxic creatures are approaching."
Not long after his words fell, a dense fluttering sound emanated from the fog, and a swarm of black dots broke through the miasma, thousands of them heading straight for the group.
Yuan Ming focused his attention and realized they were palm-sized poisonous bees, with black and yellow striped fuzz covering their bodies and sharp stingers at their tails.
"Tiger-tailed wasps, highly toxic," he recognized immediately.
The books had mentioned that such bees could be found in many parts of the Southern Border, but their size differed greatly from what was written—they were much larger.
Yuan Ming's expression hardened, and he drew the Cold Star Sword without using much mana, relying on the sword's inherent frigid aura to shoot down the flying poisonous bees around him.
Where the Sword Qi passed, even if the bees weren't directly hit, those that came too close were affected by the cold and froze, plummeting to the ground.
Yuan Ming stepped on them, crushing them with loud "crack" noises.Re%ad% ah-e.a.d and get u-pd&at.e&s& by vi#s+iti.n#g+ M^%V&LEMPY*R!.*
In the mist, everyone else also reacted.
Huan Shi lifted his hand and a red glow emerged from his palm. A burst of fire roared out, instantly engulfing half of the bees charging towards him.
Bai Rong wore black gloves, seemingly made of metal, which emitted a faint black fog. Every flick of her wrists enveloped the approaching bees in smoke.
In moments, the tiger-tailed wasps ceased flying and dropped to the ground.
Kun Sha opened another red porcelain bottle, from which a swarm of white insects emerged. One poisonous breed fought another, and there were casualties on both sides.
At his feet, the red ant was furiously feasting, voraciously consuming the bodies of fallen tiger-tailed wasps.
The muscular man was more direct, wielding a mace with vigorous swings, constantly hitting the attacking bees.
Among the sounds of "bang bang", each bee burst open, splattering clouds of Blood Mist.
These creatures, which were not even considered Level 1 Lower Stage Fierce Beasts, did little more than slow their progress; they could not pose any significant danger to them.
After putting in a bit of effort, everyone eliminated the attacking bees one after another.
While they had managed relatively well, other teams experienced similar events, though some were not so fortunate.
One team proceeded unharmed without any attack from insects or beasts.
At first, they thought themselves lucky, but as they continued, some team members noticed something wrong: their necks inexplicably began to swell.
By the time they realized the anomaly, it was too late.
Out of the six-person team, except for two formal members and one temporary member of the White Night Alliance, the other temporary members died because they mistakenly believed they were poisoned and tried to expel the toxins from their necks with mana.
In reality, they had wandered into a breeding ground of Gray Mist Poison Mushrooms and were parasitized by the spores.
When they tried to force out the toxins with mana, they actually fed the parasitic spores in their necks, allowing them to grow rapidly until maturity and explosion, severing the necks along with the mushrooms.
Another team ventured into an area where Demon Vines grew.
The green vines full of poisonous thorns were extremely sensitive to living creatures; the moment the team entered, the vines sprang up as if possessed by spiritual intelligence.
The overwhelming Demon Vines swooped in and swiftly strangled two temporary members to death.
The others, after recovering from their initial panic, fought back and finally managed to escape.

chapters.title: Chapter 184 - 164 All Smooth Paths
chapters.content:
Compared to the other members of the six-person squad, Yuan Ming was actually in a relatively safe environment.
As he continued to move forward through the poisonous fog, with the aid of ravens scouting ahead, he was always able to discern dangers in advance and prepare accordingly.
However, in the boundless poisonous fog, there were an absurd number of venomous snakes, insects, rats, and ants, seemingly endless, as if they couldn't be exterminated.
After Yuan Ming had finally killed off the poisonous bees that attacked him, he heard a rustling sound from within the dense fog.
The soul crows circled in the fog, but they didn't see anything approaching.
While Yuan Ming was feeling puzzled, he suddenly sensed that the Black Toad in his Spiritual Beast Bag was getting restless.
He didn't hesitate for a moment, slapping the Spiritual Beast Bag and taking it out immediately.
Holding the Black Toad in his hands, Yuan Ming then realized that the toad's restlessness was not due to sensing any danger but was rather a barely containable excitement.
"What does this mean?"
Before Yuan Ming could figure it out, the Black Toad pushed off his palm with a leap, landing on the ground in front of him.
As the Black Toad hit the ground, Yuan Ming's gaze shifted downward.
At that moment, he was surprised to find that around the area where the Black Toad landed, within a circumference of three feet, a "white spot" suddenly appeared on the originally pitch-black ground.
This white spot, centered around the Black Toad, seemed out of place.
Yuan Ming observed carefully for a while and realized that the edges of the white spot were blurry and seemed to be undergoing slight changes.
Suddenly, his pupils constricted and his brows furrowed tightly.
What he thought was mossy ground turned out to be a layer of barely visible black moths.
The wings of these moths lay nearly flat on the ground, barely detectable when they fluttered slightly, and the rustling sound was indeed coming from them.
Just as Yuan Ming was about to warn the other team members, he heard Mang Tung's shout not far away: "What's this? So many... uh, so itchy, so itchy..."
In a spot unseen by him, a large number of the black moths beneath Mang Tung's feet suddenly began to flutter their wings and rise from the ground.
Countless black moths, like a whirlwind of darkness, rushed toward him; before he could react, he was engulfed in a dense swarm.
The black moths dropped a large amount of black phosphor powder onto Mang Tung's towering figure, quickly corroding his cloth robe.
In just a few breaths, Mang Tung's clothes had become ragged and torn, and on his exposed skin, large areas of dark blue tattoos emerged.
A great number of black moths then made their way into the holes in his clothes.
In his panic, Mang Tung frantically started slapping at them.
But as he moved, more and more black moths clung to him, and he began to feel a burning heat on his skin, accompanied by an unbearable itching from all over his body, along with a sense that his Mana was slowly draining away.
As more and more black moths attached themselves to him, the rate of Mana draining also increased.
"Ha!"
Mang Tung let out a fierce shout, and the tattoos on his body lit up; with the emergence of a dark red glow, his skin quickly darkened, and the surface began to show scales resembling those of a crocodile.
At the same time, his stature grew taller by a fraction, and his originally round black pupils narrowed into slits of dark gold.
Once his body was covered in Beast Skin, the unbearable itching on Mang Tung's body subsided, his aura grew stronger, and the loss of Mana ceased.
He took out a Yellow Paper Talisman from his bag and tossed it forward; the talisman instantly turned into a streak of yellow light and vanished into the ground ahead.
The next instant, the Yellow Paper Talisman flared up with roaring flames that spread like a carpet, burning a vast number of black moths to death.
Meanwhile, the other members were also using their own methods to exterminate the black moths.
The only one who didn't take action from beginning to end was Yuan Ming.
After releasing the Black Toad, it seemed like a mouse dropped into a rice bin; with an extension and retraction of its long tongue, it gobbled up swathes of black moths.
The venomous insects that others desperately avoided had become delicacies that the Black Toad could not get enough of.
The black moths, when encountering the Black Toad, were like meeting their natural predator, and they couldn't even flee in time, let alone attack Yuan Ming.
Therefore, his journey was smooth, and he soon left the others far behind.
Having left the area filled with black moths, the landscape ahead began to change; no longer were there towering giant trees, but instead, a low forest entwined with black vines.
The Black Toad hopped to the edge of the low forest but didn't directly enter and instead stopped vigilantly.
Noticing this, Yuan Ming immediately sent the soul crow that was flying on its own into the black forest to scout ahead first.
Through the eyes of the soul crow, he saw twisted black vines intertwining with each other, with hardly any clear path to pass through.
Under the black vines, fog was everywhere, steam rising from the ground, indicating numerous pits and puddles scattered about.My Virtual Library Empire (*)
The soul crow landed on a black vine, its black eyes intently staring down, trying to see as clearly as possible what was inside.
In the instant that it turned its head, a black poisonous snake as thick as an arm suddenly lunged from the vines not far away. Its wide-open mouth revealed terrifying fangs as it bit down toward the soul crow.
Fortunately, Yuan Ming reacted extremely quickly, controlling the soul crow to flap its wings swiftly and dodge, flying up high into the sky.
The sudden attack startled Yuan Ming. When he looked over again through the soul crow's eyes, the scene in the forest below made his scalp tingle.
He saw that on a swath of black vines, several black poisonous snakes hung down, their gaping mouths swaying like willow branches. There was nothing of the gentleness of a soft breeze or light rain, only a sense of exceptional horror.
"How on earth do I get through this damned place?" Yuan Ming couldn't help feeling troubled.
It wasn't that he feared he couldn't beat these poisonous snakes; it was just that these pitch-black creatures blended in so well with the vines, he couldn't distinguish them if they stayed still.
Moreover, underfoot there were patches of water, which might house some unknown perils.
While he hesitated, Black Toad suddenly hopped onto his foot, extending a vine from its swollen back to wrap around his calf, tugging forcefully.
"Do you mean for me to follow you?" Yuan Ming asked doubtfully.
Black Toad let go of Yuan Ming's pant leg and leapt ahead into the Black Forest in front of them.
Yuan Ming glanced back in the direction from which they had come and, after a moment's hesitation, followed suit.
Upon stepping into the Black Forest, Yuan Ming instantly felt a moist and soft touch underfoot, like walking on sedge growing on a mudflat, with a sensation of sinking slightly.
With a "plop" sound, Black Toad hopped ahead and dove headfirst into the nearest pool of water.
Bubbles "gurgled" up from the water, but Black Toad's figure was nowhere to be seen for a long while.
Yuan Ming waited for a long time before he saw the already dim pool stir with ink-black water, as creatures reminiscent of eels and poisonous in nature, belly-up, started surfacing from within.
"Well done!" Yuan Ming praised quietly.
At a pool of water a bit farther from the first one, "gurgles" also began as more of the eel-like poisonous creatures belly-up came forth.
Behind them, Black Toad's figure emerged from the water, swinging the vines on its back as if beckoning Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming quickly understood that Black Toad was signaling for him to follow its lead.
He needed only to walk along the edges of the water holes that Black Toad had cleared, so he could ignore potential dangers on the ground and focus solely on the black snakes in the trees.
With this thought, Yuan Ming hefted the Cold Star Long Sword in one hand while touching his forehead between the eyebrows with the fingers of his other hand.
Two more black soul crows flew out of his forehead, circling overhead alongside the original one.
With three soul crows watching his left, right, and back, and Yuan Ming himself vigilant in front, there were no blind spots to worry about. He didn't have to fear any sneak attacks from the black snakes anymore.
Yuan Ming continued towards the depths of the Black Forest, and his strategy proved to be extraordinarily effective.
Now, no matter from which angle the black snakes attempted their stealthy assaults, he could immediately detect them, and with a casual swing of his sword, he could easily kill them.
When passing areas where the ground water had overflowed to the point of becoming nearly swamp-like, Yuan Ming would plant the Cold Star Sword into the earth and release an extreme chill with the help of his mana, instantly freezing the liquid on the ground.
With the coordinated effort of the soul crows and Black Toad, what had been a perilous Black Vine Jungle turned into a clear path for Yuan Ming.
Beyond using up some Divine Soul Power and mana, Yuan Ming passed through effortlessly without paying any other price, unlike other teams who suffered losses in the very same forest.
...
After exiting the Black Vine Jungle, Yuan Ming did not rush to continue on his way, but instead retracted two of the soul crows, leaving only one and Black Toad to keep watch.
He himself sat down cross-legged, with a Spirit Stone in each hand, and began recovery through Breathing Control.
However, before long, a series of mysterious sounds came from deep within the mountains, rumbling with great momentum.
Yuan Ming promptly got up and controlled the soul crow to fly towards the source of the noises.
But before the soul crow could investigate anything, there were already urgent footsteps rushing towards him from another direction.
Yuan Ming, his hand on the Cold Star Sword, prepared for the potential threat.
He saw a slender figure dash out of the thick fog; it was Bai Rong.
Following closely behind her was a large, vague shadow pursuing her in an odd manner.
Bai Rong's face was covered by Black Gauze, her expression obscured. Still, her disheveled hair indicated her disarray.
Yuan Ming immediately ran to the side, hiding behind an ancient tree to watch.
Emerging from the fog behind Bai Rong slithered a Golden Flower Poison Python with a body as thick as a sea bowl and a length of seven to eight Zhang. With a rapid twisting motion, it moved swiftly, its splendidly patterned body glimmering, and as its massive head reared high, a wide mouth and two sets of white fangs were exposed, with a crimson-tongue flickering in and out.
"Golden Flower Poison Python," Yuan Ming recognized the creature at a glance.

chapters.title: Chapter 185 - 165: Yellow Springs Tree
chapters.content:
Although the Golden Flower Poison Python was massive, its movements were surprisingly agile. It weaved through the dense forest without any hindrance, moving at an extremely fast pace.
In just a few breaths, the Golden Flower Poison Python had already caught up to Bai Rong, whose expanded fangs released a stream of purple poison gas that surged downwards.
Seeing that she couldn't dodge in time, Bai Rong promptly turned around and grabbed a bronze mirror with her hand, reflecting it towards the python.
The mirror's surface shone with a white light, forming a solid Round Shield in front of her.
The surging purple gas struck the Light Shield, emitting a "puff puff" sound, but was unable to shatter it.
However, the spreading poison leaked from both sides of the shield, inching closer to Bai Rong.
Just as Yuan Ming hesitated about whether to move forward to help, he suddenly saw Bai Rong rapidly retreating, with an ancient-looking bell now in her other hand.
"Dang"
She fiercely shook it, and the bell rang out loudly.
At that moment, from an ancient tree beside the Golden Flower Poison Python, a shadow in black suddenly swept down.
Accompanied by a hissing sound.
The python's huge head immediately fell to the ground, and as blood splattered in all directions, the poison it had been spraying from its fangs suddenly stopped.
Behind the Golden Flower Poison Python, a man in black emerged, shaking his shoulders as he walked.
"Corpse Control! Is she from the Black Fire Sect?"
When he had a clear view of the man in black, Yuan Ming's brow furrowed.
His entire body was not clothed in black, but wrapped in black ribbons from head to toe, leaving only two deep-set eye sockets unwrapped, which emitted two glimmers of green light.
On the outer sides of his arms, two slender, curved blades were somehow fitted, still smeared with the python's fresh blood.
After slaying the Golden Flower Poison Python, Bai Rong did not approach but quickly stepped in front of the nearby stone wall, carefully inspecting it as if looking for something.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming felt a bit surprised and did not reveal himself, just silently observed.
Shortly after, he saw Bai Rong search through the stone wall and place something on a rock at the base of the wall.
After positioning it, Bai Rong, along with the corpse she brought, quickly left.
Only after her figure had disappeared did Yuan Ming come out from behind a tree, full of suspicion as he began to search beneath the stone wall.
Yoursupporton*keepsthisseriesgoing.
When he lifted the rock, he found something underneath akin to the Jade Talisman given by the White Night Alliance, seemingly some sort of guiding beacon.
Yuan Ming hesitated for a moment. Not knowing what it was, he refrained from touching it impulsively.
He covered the rock again.
By the time he thought to follow Bai Rong, he could no longer find any trace of her.
Turning his head, Yuan Ming saw his Black Toad, which he had placed on alert at the perimeter, now running atop the corpse of the Golden Flower Poison Python.
He quickly followed and saw that the vine extending from the bulge on the toad's back had penetrated the corpse of the python, appearing to absorb the remaining strength from its body.
Moments later, the previously bloated corpse of the Golden Flower Poison Python gradually withered and shrank.
The squatting Black Toad, on the other hand, emitted a faint black mist all over its body, and the vines on its back writhed excitedly, clearly having reaped considerable benefits.
"I've only heard of snakes swallowing toads, this is the first time I've seen a toad swallowing a snake," Yuan Ming muttered to himself.
The Black Toad immediately started hopping in front of him, which seemed like an affirmative response.
Thinking it over, Yuan Ming felt he understood.
When he had relied on the Fur Cloak Technique to survive, wasn't he also hunting Fierce Beasts and consuming their flesh to enhance his strength?
"Since you're so fond of eating poison, come on, I'll take you to have a feast, eat until you're stuffed," Yuan Ming said with a smile.
Xiao Hei immediately let out an excited low cry, pushing off the ground with a leap, and hopped onto Yuan Ming's shoulder.
Guided by the soul crow, Yuan Ming continued to explore ahead.
The deeper he went, the thicker the Poison Miasma became.
Eventually, Yuan Ming himself began to feel distinctly unwell, breathing heavily.
Just when he decided to stop for a rest, a series of urgent combat noises suddenly came not far ahead.
"Bai Rong?" Yuan Ming instinctively thought of that woman.
With a thought, the soul crow flew ahead first.
But when Yuan Ming saw clearly through the soul crow's eyes, he realized that the one fighting was not Bai Rong at all, nor was it a single person, but rather Mang Tung and Kun Sha.
The two were trapped in the center by four massive Golden Flower Poison Pythons, barely holding on with the help of a Defensive Magical Artifact in Mang Tung's hand.
However, the protective Light Shield emitted by the artifact was riddled with holes and clearly wouldn't last long.
"Are you done yet? Can you do it or not?" Mang Tung kept urging as he controlled the artifact.
Kun Sha was also anxiously busy, replying non-stop, "Just a moment more, just a moment more..."
Yuan Ming observed the scene, with a nagging sense that something was amiss.
These four Golden Flower Poison Pythons, at best, appeared to be around Qi Refining fourth and fifth layers, so how could they have driven these two men to such desperate straits?
Just then, frequent disturbances suddenly erupted within the mountains and forests.
Even from a distance, Yuan Ming could feel the ground shaking violently.
Through the soul crow's vision, he saw within the billowing fog, huge shadows emerged en masse—hundreds, perhaps thousands of Golden Flower Poison Pythons burst forth, flooding towards the two from Mang Tung like a surging tide.
The Defensive Magical Artifact of Mang Tung finally succumbed under the immense pressure and collapsed with a boom.
But at the same moment, a red light rose from the center of the two men, followed by an explosion of red mist.
Accompanied by this was the agonized roar of Mang Tung.
The spreading red mist, highly corrosive in nature, managed to drive back the approaching Golden Flower Poison Pythons.
Because of the mist's dispersion, a large number of Golden Flower Poison Pythons actually turned direction and began rushing toward Yuan Ming.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming quickly called the soul crow back, put away the Black Toad, and dodged towards the direction of the mountain wall.
However, before he had gotten far, the Golden Flower Poison Pythons were already slithering their bodies and rapidly surging towards him.
"This is bad! This is a disaster on the level of a beast tide!" Yuan Ming knew he could not contend with them and immediately climbed up the mountain wall.
As the beast tide was about to arrive, he reached a cliff in the middle of the mountain wall and saw a black cave just over a person's height.
Yuan Ming hurried into the pitch-black entrance, but as soon as he took a step, the ground fell away beneath him, and he lost balance, tumbling forward.
Fortunately, what lay ahead was a steep slope, not a cliff, and after several rolls, Yuan Ming braced himself on the ground with one hand, halting his tumbling momentum and flipping to his feet.
Only then did he realize that the passage within the cave was unusually spacious.
Inside the passageway, a warm current constantly blew outwards, halting the outside Poison Miasma at the entrance, leaving nothing but darkness inside, free from the miasma.
Yuan Ming extended his hand, gathered a bit of Mana, and shaped a fist-sized Fireball.
With a flick of his fingertip, the Fireball shot out with a "whoosh," racing downward and exploding about thirty feet away.
Yuan Ming leaned aside to dodge the scorching blast, using the sparks from the explosion to see inside clearly.
The passageway angled steeply downward and was not devoid of contents; the ground was littered with huge, white Beast Bones, more abundant further down, akin to a graveyard of wild animals.
With a thought, Yuan Ming sent the soul crow ahead to scout the path for him.
After about the time it takes to drink a cup of tea, the soul crow finally flew through a pile of white bones that nearly blocked the passage and entered an open and dim space.
The space was described as dim rather than dark because it wasn't completely underground.
Above, a small opening allowed some daylight to filter through, providing just enough light to consider it a Sky Pit.
Soon after, Yuan Ming punched through the large pile of Beast Bones blocking the entrance and arrived there as well.
As soon as he entered, he couldn't help but shiver.
Even though there was daylight seeping through the Sky Pit, it felt even colder than the passageway he'd just left.
The higher up the Sky Pit, the more the surrounding walls teemed with life, covered with green moss and various ferns. Near the entrance, numerous vines entwined, making the already small opening even more concealed.
The ground inside the Sky Pit was also scattered with the remains of wild beasts, most of which were decayed; only a few still had undecomposed fur and skin.
After a careful inspection and finding no danger, he saw in the center of the Sky Pit an oddly shaped black withered tree.
It stood only three feet tall, shaped like coral with many tendrils, entirely black as ink with a metallic luster, appearing as if it had been cast from black iron.
At first, Yuan Ming truly thought it was a lump of iron.
But upon closer examination, he saw wooden grains and scars of an old tree on this "iron lump," with exposed roots visible at the base.
However, the tree was clearly dead, devoid of any leaves.
At the tree's root was a slightly indented pit, still bearing traces of once collected liquid.
Yuan Ming reached out, waving his hand above the pit without touching and felt a cold chill.
"Could this be the legendary Yellow Springs Tree?"
A spark of realization flashed through his mind as he recalled what this thing was.
The records stated that in places where Yin Qi gathered, if springs formed by chance and attracted the earth veins' Yin Qi, a Yinling Spring would develop.
And if a tree seed fell into it and managed to take root and sprout, the resulting tree would be a Yellow Springs Tree.
Thus, depending on what seed fell into the Yinling Spring, the Yellow Springs Tree could vary greatly in appearance. Some could grow into stout trees, which when used to make coffins, could preserve a body uncorrupted for a century.
Others would only grow into small shrubs like the one before Yuan Ming's eyes, whose beads or fragrances, when crafted, had impressive calming and tranquilizing effects.
Some special Magical Artifacts could also be refined using wood from the Yellow Springs Tree as a primary spiritual material.
All things considered, this was a remarkably rare treasure!

chapters.title: Chapter 186 - 166: The Second Chance
chapters.content:
For such a treasure right before his eyes, Yuan Ming naturally wouldn't let it slip away easily. He immediately dug three feet into the ground and pulled out the entire Yellow Springs Tree, carefully storing it in his bag.
At the same time, the soul crow that was searching around in the Sky Pit also made a new discovery.
Yuan Ming immediately rushed over to its location, only to see another huge entrance at the other end of the Sky Pit, obscured by vines hanging from the wall, making it somewhat hidden.
At that moment, the soul crow was perched on a protruding stone just above the vines, with a round, golden, shiny object in its beak.
Yuan Ming reached out to call back the soul crow and took the metallic shiny object from its mouth. Upon close inspection, he found it to be a gold-colored scale with a unique pattern.
At a glance, the scale was very similar to those of the Golden Flower Poison Python they had previously slain, but it was obviously much larger.
While pondering this, Yuan Ming noticed something white sandwiched in the vines below.
He hurriedly reached forward and pulled the object out.
With this pull, Yuan Ming realized that it was, in fact, a section of shed snake skin from a fierce beast.
This piece of snake skin was six feet long and as thick as a bucket, with faintly glowing phosphorescence, making it quite distinctive.
"Such large scales and shed skin most likely belong to the Golden Flower Poison Python King," Yuan Ming thought to himself, his heart skipping a beat.
He first released his divine sense to scan the area and, finding no signs of living creatures, he carefully parted the vine curtains in front of him, revealing a gap to investigate further inside.
Behind the vines was a short passage that lead to a larger underground cavern, faintly illuminated by either fluorescent stones or something else, emitting a cold, ghostly white light that added an eerie atmosphere.
Yuan Ming, not one to take risks, had the soul crow fly through the opening into the cavern.
Once inside, he saw the vast cavern filled with towering stone pillars and stalactites hanging from above, embedded with chunks of fluorite that emitted a blue-white glow.
The cavern's enormity surpassed Yuan Ming's imagination.
His soul crow flew deeper inside for a long time until suddenly, a colossal object made him involuntarily gasp in shock.
It was an enormous Golden Flower Poison Python, coiling around a thick stone pillar like a small hill of flesh, with its tail end slightly trembling and making a "rustling" sound.
Under the blue-white cold light, the golden scales on its body emitted an icy metallic aura, seemingly impregnable.
After a brief observation, Yuan Ming had no doubt in his mind that this was indeed the Golden Flower Poison Python King.
He quietly called back the soul crow and moved to a comparatively safe distance from the entrance. He then took out the Jade Talisman given by the White Night Alliance and, without any hesitation, crushed it within his sleeve.
The exploding Jade Talisman made a slight noise, a flash of blue light passed over the surface before going out, leaving no further movement.
Yuan Ming then distanced himself from that entrance and returned to the one he had come through, remaining alert and quietly waiting for the White Night Alliance people to arrive.
After a long time, people began arriving one after another.
Only a small number came through the same passage as Yuan Ming, with many more locating the incredibly hidden entrance to the Sky Pit through the mark on the Jade Talisman, adding up to about a dozen people.
About half an hour later, Bai Ye arrived with two other official members of their alliance.
"Was it you who sent the mark?" Bai Ye approached Yuan Ming and asked.
"Indeed," Yuan Ming opened his palm, showing the broken Jade Talisman.
"Did you find the Snake King?" Bai Ye asked with a stern tone, frowning.
Before Yuan Ming, three others had crushed their Jade Talismans, but when they arrived, they found only tragically dead bodies.
Those were people who, faced with danger and unable to escape, crushed their Jade Talismans in the hopes that someone would come to their rescue.
Yuan Ming bore no visible injuries, clearly not in the same situation as the others.
"I found it," Yuan Ming nodded.
As he spoke, he swept his hand over his storage bag at his waist, and his palm immediately produced a large golden scale and a piece of white shed skin.
Bai Ye quickly took them into his hands and began to examine them closely.
At that moment, Huan Shi also arrived, hurried over, and intensely examined the items.
After a moment, the two exchanged glances and silently nodded at each other.
"Where did you discover this?" Bai Ye asked.
Yuan Ming immediately led Bai Ye and the others to the vine-covered entrance, lifted a corner, pointed inside, and whispered, "I found these there, the Snake King is inside."
"Did you go in?" Bai Ye asked, furrowing his brow.
"I sneaked in for a peek and saw the silhouette of the Snake King, then I dared to come out and report back. Otherwise, wouldn't that be slandering?" Yuan Ming continued in a low voice.
The cautious actions made everyone present tense up, somewhat convincing them of his words.
"Let's confirm it," Bai Ye turned his head and, unintentionally lowering his voice, spoke to an elderly man with graying hair.
The latter, also an official member of the White Night Alliance, immediately nodded.
Following that, he pulled a brightly furred white mouse from his sleeve and placed it at the entrance of the vine-covered hole.
Xiao Bai wrinkled its nose, sniffed, and then crawled inside.
The group waited outside for a long time, and suddenly a tiny white shadow rushed out from inside, obviously frightened by something, appearing very panicked.
The elderly man with a flower-patterned shell reacted quickly, grabbed the mouse, and held it beside his ear, as if listening to its story.
But the others could only hear the urgent "squeaking" sound.
A moment later, the elderly man put away Xiao Bai and said to Bai Ye, "Alliance Hierarch, it is confirmed without a doubt, this is the Snake King's cave."
As soon as he finished speaking, Bai Ye's eyebrows relaxed, and a hint of joy showed in his eyes.
"Find a way to tell everyone to gather here immediately! Let the others rest on the spot," Bai Ye instructed Huan Shi.
"Yes!" Huan Shi replied, and taking Tuozhe, he walked towards the entrance of the Sky Pit.
...
Within the next quarter of an hour, more people gradually arrived and gathered on the other side of the Sky Pit.This content originates from *, My Virtual Library Empire.
Yuan Ming glanced around and noticed that of the forty-one people who had entered the Snake King Valley together, only thirty-one had arrived at this spot.
Of the fourteen official members of the White Night Alliance, twelve were left, and of the twenty-seven temporarily recruited members, including himself, only nineteen remained.
Of the original six-person team he was a part of, except for the man in black named Kun Sha, the others were all present.
Yuan Ming knew clearly that many of those who hadn't arrived probably would never appear again.
The casualty rate among the temporary members was much higher than that among the official members.
The people who arrived here, besides the two Foundation Establishment Cultivators, Bai Ye and Huan Shi, and a few official members, looked somewhat haggard; nearly everyone had bruises and injuries to some extent. Among the temporary members, many had complex expressions, carrying a hint of regret.
Compared to them, Yuan Ming was in the best condition.
"Fellow Daoist Hagon has done us a great service by finding the location of the Snake King. I wonder if you'd be interested in officially joining the White Night Alliance?" Huan Shi looked at Yuan Ming with admiration and said.
He had a deep impression of Yuan Ming, from the time he outwitted Tuozhe when he first applied, to Yuan Ming's performance in the Poison Miasma, and now finding the location of the Snake King, so he sincerely invited Yuan Ming to join, not just as a formality.
"Vice Alliance Hierarch, your kind offer should indeed be accepted, but there are many complexities involved in this matter, so let us discuss it later," Yuan Ming said smilingly with a cupped-fist salute.
"Fine. We'll talk after we leave Snake King Valley. The reward of three hundred spirit stones promised to you will also be settled afterward," Huan Shi responded with a smile and nodded.
Just as he finished speaking, Yuan Ming spoke, "Vice Alliance Hierarch, could we settle my spirit stones now?"
"Hmm?" Huan Shi paused, surprised.
Such urgency? His perception of Yuan Ming shifted slightly downwards.
"Wasn't it agreed beforehand that everyone has one chance to withdraw before we take action against the Snake King? I would like to withdraw now," Yuan Ming explained.
"Fellow Daoist Hagon, you managed to reach here almost unharmed, which clearly shows your strength is not weak. Why not take it a step further?" Bai Ye asked, showing some interest in Yuan Ming.
His suggestion was clear - with them already at this location, why not give it a try? Success could possibly bring more rewards.
This was likely also the thought of all the temporary members.
"I am just a mere Qi Refining cultivator, and I am aware of my own capabilities. Having reached here safely is purely good fortune; otherwise, I wouldn't have been able to help everyone find the Snake King. As for joining the hunt, I'd rather not participate," Yuan Ming said with a smile, politely declining.
He spoke with great tact, not overly citing the fear of the Snake King to avoid influencing the others.
Seeing this, Bai Ye said no more.
"Are there any others who wish to withdraw now?" Huan Shi then publicly handed out three hundred and ten spirit stones to Yuan Ming, and asked the others.
The official members of the White Night Alliance naturally had nothing to say, but one of the temporary members, a woman, spoke up.
"I, I also want to withdraw."
Yuan Ming looked in the direction of the voice and saw that she was dressed in a black outfit that was somewhat tattered, revealing her pale skin with a shapely figure, her face covered with a thin black gauze. It was Bai Rong, previously a member of their team.
"She wants to withdraw as well?" Yuan Ming wondered.
He had previously noticed her unusual behavior in the Poison Miasma and suspected that she had targeted the members of the White Night Alliance, but now she chose to withdraw, puzzling Yuan Ming even further.
Just when everyone thought the matter had settled with just these two withdrawals, ten more individuals bluntly expressed their wish to leave as well.
Seeing suddenly twelve people opting out, both Bai Ye and Huan Shi's expressions darkened slightly.
Each person's departure meant a greater burden and potentially more injuries for the official members of the White Night Alliance.
However, they decided not to make it difficult for these people.
These individuals, including Yuan Ming, collected the ten spirit stones of compensation and subsequently left the Sky Pit, choosing to depart.

chapters.title: Chapter 187 - 167: What brings you here?
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming turned around and left the sky pit with the other eleven people, everyone tacitly scattering and departing separately.
Yuan Ming stood still, watching the departing figures, a tinge of sentiment arising in his heart.
Perhaps this was the way of the Scatter Alliance missions, without the shelter of a sect, devoid of any allegiance to sect positions, the relationship between the hired and the Scatter Alliance was solely based on remuneration.
Today they delved deep into dangerous dens, battled strange beasts, and after achieving their mission, they withdrew safely, to one day gallop through fields of flowers, observe the scenery of foreign lands, and wander the ends of the earth.
A mutual selection, to stay or to go as one desires.
It even aroused a touch of yearning from his fragmented childhood memories, the desire for the life of a martial arts wanderer, with a sword in hand and a jug of wine.
Back then, he didn't know much about the martial arts world but liked to listen to stories about it.
Now that he had personally experienced and seen a lot, he realized that what he saw was far less wonderful than what he had heard.
On this trip to the Snake King Valley, there were people who just silently fell, unable to even claim their hard-earned ten spirit stones as reward, and perhaps no one would remember them.
After completely escaping the other's lines of sight, a black light flashed across Yuan Ming's brow, and two silent soul crows flew out, one towards the sky pit, the other in a different direction.
In the field of view of the second soul crow, a figure soon appeared, it was Bai Rong.
This woman was suspected to be a disciple of the Black Fire Sect, and had been leaving certain marks along the way, with unknown intentions, which piqued Yuan Ming's curiosity.
Yuan Ming did not go far, but found a hidden cliff and stopped, took out his Cold Star Sword, and quickly carved out a cave in the cliff.
He then released a soul crow to keep watch outside, and then took out the Four Directions Sealing Spirit Talismans, sticking them around the cave and opened a Concealment Barrier, before sitting down cross-legged, focusing on controlling the soul crows heading towards the Snake King Cave and tracking Bai Rong.
The soul crow headed for the Snake King Cave had already flown inside, and soon sounds of a struggle were heard.
Yuan Ming controlled the soul crow to carefully approach and saw Bai Ye and the others battling a group of Golden Flower Poison Pythons.
These Golden Flower Poison Pythons were noticeably larger than those encountered in the valley before, with greater strength, moving like the wind, and even able to spew Poison Liquid, making the temporary members struggle to cope.
However, the White Night Alliance then showed their true strength, aside from Bai Ye and Huan Shi, the other ten each brought out a large white flag Magic Artifact embroidered with a purple flame pattern, appearing to be a set of Magic Artifacts.
All ten simultaneously activated the artifacts, and bunches of fist-sized purple flames were shot from the tips of the white flags, striking the attacking Golden Flower Poison Pythons.
The purple flames were powerful, easily burning through the sturdy scales of the Golden Flower Poison Pythons and reducing them to ashes.
No matter how many Golden Flower Poison Pythons attacked, they all perished under the onslaught of the purple flame rain. Even the few that managed to slip through were taken care of by the Loose Cultivators that followed inside, and Bai Ye and Huan Shi didn't even need to lift a finger.
"So the White Night Alliance has such techniques, no wonder they dare to enter the snake den to hunt the Snake King, but the Golden Flower Snake King is probably in an even deeper location…" Yuan Ming thought to himself upon seeing this.
He shifted his thoughts and looked towards Bai Rong.
Bai Rong was currently moving forward at a breathtaking speed, even faster than Yuan Ming when he used the Wind Swift Skill, by two to three times. Although the soul crow tried its best to catch up, it was still left far behind.
Fortunately, like before, Bai Rong left marks after advancing a certain distance, and by following these signs, the soul crow barely managed to track her.
Moments later, the soul crow arrived at a dark forest. On a large tree outside the forest was a freshly carved sign pointing inward.
"I hope Bai Rong doesn't continue pressing forward," Yuan Ming silently hoped while controlling the soul crow to fly into the forest.
The range of the soul crow's Far Travel was initially only ten miles. After his Moonlight Technique broke through to the second layer, the range doubled, but it was still only twenty miles. Now, reaching its limit, if Bai Rong continued on, he wouldn't be able to follow.
The soul crow flew past large trees, and suddenly, the view opened up, revealing an ancient, dilapidated castle ahead.
"Could it be that people once lived in this Snake King Valley!" Yuan Ming was quite surprised upon seeing this.
On a large tree in front of the ancient castle was a subtle mark. After summarizing and speculating on the various marks along the way, the meaning of this mark was not difficult to understand – it should be pointing inside the castle.
The soul crow flapped its wings and flew inside, searching through the areas of the castle, and soon saw Bai Rong's figure outside a great hall.
Bai Rong was looking excitedly into the hall but didn't enter.
The entire hall was enveloped in a layer of pitch-black light, seemingly a kind of forbidden barrier, preventing one from seeing inside.
Bai Rong pondered for a moment, took out a fiery red Round Mirror from her hand, and pointed it at the black barrier, murmuring words.
The surface of the Round Mirror glowed with a layer of red, then emitted a beam of red light that struck at the black barrier.
But the black barrier only rippled slightly before quickly returning to its original state.
"The Red Seal Mirror is also completely ineffective. It seems to be a rather high-level Forbidden barrier; I can't break it by myself," Bai Rong murmured to herself, her eyes flickering.
As she finished speaking, she took out a purple talisman from her hand, whispered a few words to it, and then crushed it...
At that moment, the soul crow outside suddenly shrieked a warning, and Yuan Ming's face changed abruptly as he slapped the ground with his palm, propelling his seated body backward with the force.
Two yellowish large hands emerged lightning-fast from the ground, fiercely grabbing at the spot where he had just been seated.
"Bang!" A loud crash shattered the rocks on the ground and scattered debris everywhere.
Yuan Ming's Divine Sense spread out, probing into the ground.
A figure was lurking underground, completely enveloped in a layer of yellow light; the two large yellow hands it had summoned, were some type of Divine Skill unknown to him.
Yuan Ming reached out with an empty hand, and the Cold Star Sword appeared in his grip. A flash of white Sword Qi swept past, easily severing the two large yellow hands, and the ground nearby was coated with a layer of white frost.
He then stabbed the sword single-handedly into the ground, the blade sinking nearly halfway.
A burst of Extreme Cold Sword Qi erupted violently, heading straight for the person beneath the surface.
The figure underground sensed the incoming Sword Qi and hurriedly dodged to the side, the yellow light around its body allowing it to move freely underground and avoid the icy attack.
Yuan Ming's mouth curved into a smile as he formed a spell with his fingers, lightly touched the Cold Star Sword, activating the Extreme Cold Rune within, and shouted lowly, "Explode!"
The Extreme Cold Sword Qi exploded abruptly, instantly flooding the surrounding ten feet with piercing cold.
The soil underground froze, hardening like rock, and the figure below was also affected by the surge of cold air, shivering uncontrollably.
The person's mana circulation was impacted, causing the yellow glow around its body to die down considerably, with half of its body trapped in the soil, immovable.
"Damn Guo Ge, you said this guy was just an ordinary Qi Refining Ninth Level cultivator? You didn't even find out that he had such a powerful Magic Artifact!" the figure underground cursed vehemently, desperately urging the Earth Travel Talisman on their body in an attempt to revive the extinguished yellow light.
However, with the area around the person saturated with the Extreme Cold of the Cold Star Sword, the yellow spirit light recovered very slowly.
"If I let you escape easily, my Cold Star Sword would have been refined in vain!" Yuan Ming sneered slightly, performed another spell, and another burst of Extreme Cold Sword Qi shot out, hitting the figure underground directly.
A muffled scream rose from the depths, then fell silent.
A large hole had been pierced through the person's chest and abdomen; they no longer breathed.
Yuan Ming slapped the Spiritual Beast Bag at his waist, and the Black Toad leaped out, shooting out a Purple-Black Demon Vine from its back.
He took off the Storage Ring and had the Purple-Black Demon Vine wrap around, pulling the corpse from underground with the method once used to steal Li Sha's treasured items, quickly bringing up the person's body.
This individual had yellow hair, appeared to be in their twenties or thirties, and was now frozen solid as an icicle, their face frozen in terror and their features twisted—still recognizable as one of the members of the other team that had decided to leave earlier.
Yuan Ming showed no emotion, not bothering to find out why the person tried to ambush him. He never held back against his enemies.
Brought to you by the folks at *.
He took the yellow-haired young man's Storage Bag, then reached into his bosom, and from his frozen clothes, he extracted a palm-sized yellow talisman.
Judging from the yellow-haired youth's earlier use, this must be a talisman with earth-tunneling effects.
Such talismans were extremely rare, and Yuan Ming had wanted to buy one during his visit to Black Rock City but was unable to acquire it.
Although the Yellow Talisman was used, it still emitted quite strong mana fluctuations.
"It seems this talisman can be used multiple times, just like the Four Directions Sealing Spirit Talisman," Yuan Ming muttered to himself, then tucked the talisman away.
He took the yellow-haired young man's Storage Bag and suddenly raised his eyebrows, looking outside.
In the dense poison miasma outside the cave, three figures were slowly approaching, one of them being a burly man, a red-clothed woman, and a cold-eyed young man—the other three members of the yellow-haired young man's team.
As they neared the cave, the three hid behind a large rock, seemingly waiting for something.
Unbeknownst to them, not far from their hiding spot on a rock, a black crow sat silently perched.
"It's them…" Yuan Ming murmured, roughly guessing the trio's intentions.
However, he did not go out and continued to inspect the contents of the yellow-haired young man's Storage Bag.
It must be said, the yellow-haired young man was rather shabby; the Spirit Stones in his Storage Bag totaled only twenty or thirty pieces, the rest were common materials, and a low-grade long knife Magic Artifact.
After sorting and stowing these items into the Storage Bag, Yuan Ming stood and moved to the outside of the cave.
The Black Toad took a step forward and darted out, vanishing into the dense poison miasma.
The three people behind the large rock were growing impatient when Yuan Ming suddenly appeared, they all were startled and quickly contained their breaths.
"Since you've come, why hide in secrecy?" Yuan Ming called out loudly.
Sensing they'd been discovered, the three emerged from behind the large rock.
"How did you find us?" the burly man asked.
All three had cast Concealment spells, and with the cave ten feet away and the miasma in between, even a Foundation Establishment Cultivator might not have detected them.
"How I discovered you is not important, what's important is, what brings the three of you here?" Yuan Ming asked, countering the question.

chapters.title: Chapter 188 - 168: Test the Power
chapters.content:
The burly man, upon hearing Yuan Ming's words, was somewhat stunned and for a moment could not decide what to say.
He had originally thought that Yuan Ming was just an ordinary Loose Cultivator who had strayed from his group, so he had followed him along with three others, planning to kill Yuan Ming and snatch the three hundred Spirit Stones given by the White Night Alliance.
But the situation before him was completely different from what he had expected. Despite Cha Ha's use of the Earth Travel Talisman in a sneak attack, there had been no sign of him, yet there was Yuan Ming appearing unharmed. The burly man began to think of retreating.
The red-clothed woman felt the same, fear creeping into her heart.
"What are you two afraid of? With three against one, surely we won't lose? Boy, smartly hand over your storage magic tool, and you can keep your entire corpse!" the cold young man said aggressively, though he was green and inexperienced as a calf not fearing a tiger.
"Idiot!" The burly man was startled and cursed under his breath, but it was too late to stop the cold young man.
"So, the three of you are after those three hundred Spirit Stones? Since you want to kill and rob, you must have prepared yourselves to be killed," Yuan Ming said calmly.
"Kill us? Based on you, a waste of the Qi Refining Ninth Level?" The cold young man laughed wildly, already producing a green round bead magical artifact with which he aimed directly at Yuan Ming's heart, fast as an arrow released from its bow.
With things having reached this point, the burly man clenched his teeth and had no choice but to take action, flipping his hand to bring forth a yellow casting hammer, half a zhang in length, with a head as large as a millstone, which he swung toward Yuan Ming's head with impressive force.
Seeing the other two engage, the red-clothed woman also took out a blue feather fan and waved it ferociously at Yuan Ming.
Whoosh whoosh whoosh!
More than a dozen sharp ice cones formed out of thin air and shot out, aiming at various parts of Yuan Ming's body.
The combined force of the three was extraordinary, and the Qi Force they unleashed pushed back the surrounding Poison Miasma for several zhang.
Yuan Ming, remaining calm, formed a hand seal and with a point of his finger, a flash of golden light passed by as the gold-plated gauze emerged, wrapping around his body in several layers to form a thick golden gauze curtain.
The green flying sword, the yellow hammer, and sharp ice cones hit almost simultaneously, causing ripples of vibration on the golden gauze curtain which immediately returned to stability.
"How is this possible!" The three observers, including the burly man, were dumbfounded; despite their full force, they couldn't ruffle Yuan Ming's defense!
Yuan Ming looked at the unusually stable gauze curtain and remained expressionless, quite satisfied internally.
He had intentionally used the gold-plated gauze to receive the attacks of the three to see the extent of the gauze's defensive power, pleased that the gold-plated gauze did not disappoint him.
"Haste!"
Yuan Ming raised the Cold Star Sword and pointed at the green flying sword and the yellow hammer outside the golden gauze, doing so in mid-air.
Around the two artifacts, a significant chill surged as a large block of white frost formed out of nothing, freezing both artifacts within it.
The expressions of the burly man and the cold young man changed drastically, their connection to their magic artifacts suddenly interrupted, rendering them unable to control them momentarily.
Neither had ever encountered such a situation and immediately panicked. The burly man, with higher cultivation, forced himself to remain calm and raised his hand to summon another magic artifact.
Just then, the ground beneath him cracked open and a purple-black vine shot out, instantly entwining his legs.
The burly man's heart chilled as he violently leaped backwards, desperately trying to break free from the vine's hold, but the exceptionally tough purple-black vine did not break and instead dragged him to the ground.
A white light shot out from the front, reaching the burly man in an instant, faster than anyone's eyes could follow, and with a "puff," penetrated the burly man's body. It was the Cold Star Sword.
The fierce cold burst forth, the burly man's body freezing into an icicle, his life cut off in an instant.Keep us going by reading on *.
The burly man's cultivation, strongest among the four, could not even withstand two moves under Yuan Ming.
The cold young man and the red-clothed woman, already horrified, turned and fled in different directions.
Yuan Ming formed a hand seal and from his sleeve shot a blue and a black spirit light, directly chasing after the red-clothed woman; they were the Shuiyun Banner and the One-eyed Woman's black wooden hairpin.
Meanwhile, the white light of the Cold Star Sword passed through the body of the burly man, pursuing the fleeing cold young man.
"Stop, stop! I am a member of the Eastern Domain Xue Family Castle, you can't kill me..."
The cold young man, sensing the Cold Star Sword approaching from behind, screamed in terror, continuously running forward while frantically throwing talismans behind him.
More than a dozen spells including Fireball, Wind Blade, and Water Arrow appeared, all aimed directly at the Cold Star Sword.
Yuan Ming remotely activated the Gale Rune within the Cold Star Sword, causing it to become elusive and its speed to increase sharply, easily avoiding the attacks of fireballs and wind blades and catching up with the cold young man in the blink of an eye.
A jade pendant hanging at the young man's waist suddenly shone brightly with white light, forming a semi-transparent white glow that enveloped him.
"Bang!"
The Cold Star Sword struck his spine, blocked by the white glow, but the powerful impact still sent the cold young man stumbling, causing him to fall forward to the ground.
Before the young man could react, a fierce burst of icy Sword Qi rolled down, freezing the cold young man along with the protective white glow into ice.
The sword then fell, chopping the young man along with the ice into pieces.
Almost simultaneously, a piercing scream came from the other side, only to soon fade into silence.
Yuan Ming removed the storage magic tools from the burly man and the cold looking young man, and walked towards the red-clothed woman, quickly reaching her side.
The red-clothed woman's legs were also entangled by purple-black vines, and a huge wound gaped open on her chest and abdomen, seemingly slashed by a sharp weapon, and a black wooden hairpin was also thrust into her heart—she was dead beyond any doubt.
Yuan Ming picked up the blue feather fan and the red-clothed woman's storage bag that had dropped beside her, then turned and headed back to the cave.
Looking at the Cold Star Sword in his hand, a hint of a smile appeared on his face.
The strength of the burly man and others was not weak, but the reason they fell like dominoes today was mainly because the Cold Star Sword could freeze other people's magic artifacts, temporarily wresting control from their owners.
Ordinary frost-infused artifacts couldn't achieve this; at most, they would affect the mana within the artifact, unable to influence the trace of divine soul housed inside. But Yuan Ming's Cold Star Sword was forged from Yin Jade, which could attack the divine souls of people. By freezing the two men's magic artifacts, it also cut off their divine senses.
A Qi Refining Stage Cultivator, who lost their handy magic artifact, would naturally become flustered and thus were easily slaughtered.
Yuan Ming activated his divine sense to inspect the three artifacts.
The blue feather fan, the green round bead, and the burly man's yellow hammer were all low-grade magical artifacts. The runes inscribed within the blue feather fan, which he had seen in the Black Wood Handbook, were called "Ice Cone" and could emit ice cone attacks.
Although the cold young man's round bead artifact was green, it was made of metal, small in size, yet weighing a hundred pounds.
As for the runes inside the green round bead, Yuan Ming didn't recognize them, but judging from the effects of the green round bead, they were impact-type runes.
The runes inside the burly man's yellow hammer, also mentioned in the Black Wood Handbook, were called "Vibration," which could transform strength into vibrations. The golden gauze had earlier rippled with waves, which were the attack effects caused by this yellow hammer.
"I already have one casting hammer, but I didn't expect to acquire an even bigger one today. It seems I have a fate with hammer-type artifacts. Oh, this hammer has a name..." Yuan Ming gently swung the yellow hammer, his gaze falling on the handle's end.
Engraved there were the words: Mountain Shaking Hammer, three characters.
"Mountain Shaking Hammer, the name is indeed fitting," Yuan Ming said with a slight smile on his lips.
Of these three artifacts, only the Mountain Shaking Hammer caught his eye. The hammer, forged from a specific metal, was extremely heavy, even heavier than the green round bead and Master Hei Mu's casting hammer. Combined with the Vibration rune, its attack power was exceptionally formidable, especially suitable for close-hand combat.
If he were to use the White Ape Transformation and wield this Mountain Shaking Hammer, the effects would complement each other perfectly.
Yuan Ming stored the three artifacts and then inspected the storage bags of the three individuals.
The red-clothed woman's storage bag contained a few spirit stones, some ordinary materials, and a very poor-quality low-grade magical artifact, inferior even to the black wooden hairpin.
However, the cold-faced young man's storage bag contained over two hundred spirit stones, including one mid-grade spirit stone, along with two low-grade magical artifacts of fairly good quality.
Yuan Ming finally opened the burly man's storage magic tool, and was immediately taken aback.
This storage bag contained only a small amount of spiritual materials, the remainder being a large quantity of talisman paper, a golden pen with a white tip, several bottles of talisman painting liquid, and a thin booklet.
"This burly man, so rough and large, turned out to be a talisman master," Yuan Ming said with a look of surprise.
The talisman paper, talisman pen, and spiritual liquid all disclosed the burly man's identity.
Yuan Ming counted the talismans inside the storage bag, finding thirty-two completed talismans, all low-level ones like Fireball, Wind Blade, Water Arrow, etc., without a single mid-level talisman.
"It seems his talisman-making skills were just average," Yuan Ming muttered to himself, picking up the thin booklet and flipping it open.
The booklet was something similar to the Black Wood Handbook. The first few pages recorded the burly man's cultivation career, insights, and so on, while the last three pages depicted six talisman runes: Fireball, Wind Blade, Water Arrow, Rock Piercing, Wooden Thorns, and Earth Travel.
The first five talismans were low-grade, but the Earth Travel was mid-grade.
"So that yellow talisman is called Earth Travel," he noted.
The effects of the Earth Travel Talisman were clearly written next to it in the talisman classics. It allowed one to move freely underground for a short period, akin to swimming in water, superior to common Earth Tunneling Techniques.
Regrettably, the burly man had only managed to produce one Earth Travel Talisman.
Yuan Ming silently lamented, then stored the booklet and other items into his storage ring without any intention to try drawing talismans himself.
While he was learning Artifact Refining in Biluo Cave, he had heard discussions about talismans and had a basic understanding of drawing talismans.
Talisman Masters were a profession that extremely consumed resources and time, burning through money. To master a single talisman, one must experience hundreds, if not thousands, of failures, consuming countless materials and energy, gradually accumulating experience to improve success rates.
For those with slightly less talent in drawing talismans, the number of failures could increase by two or three times the norm, and adopting a new talisman meant starting from scratch all over again.
To raise a qualified Talisman Master, there's no other way but to spend countless resources over the years.
Moreover, drawing talismans was extremely draining on one's energy, inevitably affecting cultivation. Any cultivator with ambition wouldn't be distracted by learning this.
Yuan Ming didn't have the resources, nor the spare energy, so naturally, he would not attempt to learn how to draw talismans.
Biting off more than one can chew!

chapters.title: Chapter 189 - 169: Peeping
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming turned and returned to the cave, closed his eyes, and sensed the situation of the two soul crows in the distance, his face showing a look of astonishment.
Inside the ancient castle where Bai Rong was located, there were now four more figures, three men and one woman.
Yuan Ming vaguely remembered these four people were part of the members for this mission, but they had chosen to leave the group at the entrance of Ghost Cry Gorge. He didn't expect them to reappear now.
It seemed these four people were in league with Bai Rong, participating in the mission organized by the White Night Scatter Alliance with ulterior motives. The mark left by the woman earlier might have been to guide these people.
"Sang Yan, are you sure this is the place?" asked a man in a gray robe among the four.
"Reporting to Elder Gu Tu, I followed what was stated in that incomplete scroll. I traveled west from the Snake King Cave for twenty miles and searched to find this place," Bai Rong said respectfully.
...
"Sang Yan! This Bai Rong is Sang Yan!" Yuan Ming's body shook slightly when he heard the conversation between the two.
The Three Cave Masters had once told him about Sang Yan. His condition for helping him refine the Green Fish Sword was to retrieve the Spiritual Material White Flame Gold from Sang Yan's hands at White Deer Hill after. Unexpectedly, Yuan Ming had now run into her here by chance.
"The Three Cave Masters said Sang Yan is a disciple of the Black Fire Sect. Then is this man in the gray robe also someone from the Black Fire Sect? Sang Yan calls him elder, could it be that he is a Foundation Establishment Cultivator whose cultivation is concealed!" Yuan Ming became vigilant.
...
Inside the ancient castle.
"Then there should be no mistake. However, this black restriction seems to be a Yin-locking Array, capable of automatically absorbing Yin Qi to maintain the array's operation for a long time. This ancient castle is rich in Yin Qi, continuously flowing. Breaking through this restriction won't be easy," Elder Gu Tu mused.
"What do we do then? Are we just going to make a wasted trip? We've spent quite a lot of spirit stones to fend off the poison miasma of Snake King Valley," a black-robed young girl grumbled irritably.
"Junior Sister Nala, don't be impatient. Elder Gu Tu is highly skilled in formations and arrays, ranking in the top five in our sect. Such a small array, he will surely think of a method to break it," Sang Yan said with a smile.
"Don't try to flatter me. Who's your junior sister!" The black-robed young girl frowned slightly, spitting out the words lightly.
Sang Yan smiled without saying a word, seemingly unfazed by the young girl's rudeness.
Standing behind Sang Yan was a burly man carrying a black blade, who seemed to be his guard, a flash of anger appearing in his eyes as he stepped forward.
