Next to the black-robed young girl stood a young man with sword-like eyebrows and starry eyes, who also stepped forward, positioning the young girl behind him for protection.
This version is sourced from MV3L3MPYR.
"We have yet to accomplish our important task. What are you quarreling about? Stand down, all of you!" Elder Gu Tu ordered sternly.
Sang Yan motioned with his hand, and the burly man withdrew. The young man with the sword-like eyebrows next to the black-robed young girl also stepped back.
"Elder Gu Tu, although the Yin-locking Restriction is troublesome, with your proficiency in array restrictions, you surely have already thought of a method to break it, haven't you?" Sang Yan inquired.
"If it were a Yin-locking Array set up in recent years, I might not be able to break it. However, the restriction here appears to have existed for many years. Although it's still operational, the array instruments have begun to erode, and instability is already appearing in many places. It's not impossible to break it. Now, listen to my instructions..." Elder Gu Tu pondered for a moment before saying so.
Sang Yan and the others were overjoyed upon hearing this, eagerly listening closely; then, following Elder Gu Tu's orders, each took their positions outside the hall with white jade talisman magic artifacts given by Elder Gu Tu, and started casting to activate them.
Streaks of white light shaped like arrows shot out from the jade talismans, containing specks of runes, striking the black restriction.
This time, the black restriction could not swallow the white light and shook violently, clearly leaking wisps of black Qi.
"It seems that Elder Gu Tu is highly accomplished in formations. I wonder who is more powerful compared to the masked woman in Black Rock City who sets arrays with a wave of her hand?" Yuan Ming thought secretly upon seeing this.
There wouldn't be an immediate result here at the ancient castle, so he shifted his thoughts and, through the vision of the other soul crow, looked at the situation inside the Snake King Cave.
At this time, Bai Ye and the others, after a bout of battle, had already reached the depths of the Snake King Cave.
With Bai Ye and Huan Shi, two Foundation Establishment Cultivators present, and everyone sticking together and fighting cautiously, they had not suffered any casualties.
The space here not only didn't shrink but had also become much larger, and the poison miasma around was even denser. Both members of the White Night Alliance and those Loose Cultivators, though protected by Obstacle Avoidance Pearls, were gradually showing signs of fatigue.
Yuan Ming's soul crow was not a physical living creature, unaffected by the poison miasma, and he followed them easily from a distance.
At this point, the Golden Flower Poison Pythons attacking from the surroundings had started to decrease, and the group faced less resistance.
Bai Ye's and Huan Shi's expressions showed no sign of relaxation but instead, became even more solemn.
"We must be very close to the Snake King's nest by now. Don't be careless, stay alert!" Huan Shi shouted.
No sooner had his voice faded than a threatening hiss came from the cave ahead, low and hoarse, but with a soul-piercing strength.
The Qi Refinement Stage Cultivators trembled greatly, their complexions paling.
The lurking soul crow's body shimmered with disordered black light, shaking uncontrollably.
"This roar carries a sound wave attack that can actually harm the Divine Soul!" Yuan Ming quickly commanded the soul crow to retreat.
As he pondered, a streak of Golden Shadow flashed through the poison in front of him, and a golden snake tail, as thick as a bucket, shot out toward the group, the gale it brought nearly blowing them away.
Huan Shi's figure dashed out swiftly, blocking in front of everyone, a bronze shield appearing in his hand. As he clashed with the golden snake tail amidst a burst of cyan light, both were repelled.
A loud noise erupted as Huan Shi, still holding the shield, was snapped back several steps by the impact while the golden snake tail was also forced back.
"It's the Golden Flower Snake King! Set up the formation!" Huan Shi shouted without steadying himself.
The ten members of the White Night Alliance quickly formed a circle, inserting white flags into the ground, burying them nearly halfway.
With a flick of his sleeve, Bai Ye sent out several Array Plates that settled in each position around the circle.
Boom!
The ten large banners rose up, emitting a dazzling white light, connecting with each other and forming a circular white array that enveloped the ten people within.
The five Loose Cultivators recruited to face the might of the Snake King were extremely terrified and subconsciously retreated.
"Retreating means nothing but a dead end, hide inside the array! The Golden Flower Snake King is a Second-Level Fierce Beast, without the array, you are no match for it at all!" Bai Ye shouted.
The already sealed white array "huala" sounded, splitting open a passage for entry.
The five Loose Cultivators, in a state of panic, quickly rushed towards the breach in the array.
From the thick poison miasma ahead, a giant python at least four to five zhang long with its body covered in golden scales shot out of the poison miasma, its huge snake head spewing out a swath of dark green Poison Liquid, striking at the five Loose Cultivators.
Bai Ye flipped his hand and took out a purple Token, channeling mana into it.
The Token suddenly surged with a great deal of purple light, and a surge of purple flames also emerged within the white array, burning fiercely.
With a light shout from Bai Ye, a zhang-long purple Fire Snake shot out from the array, colliding with the dark green Poison Liquid.
With a "sizzling" sound, the purple Fire Snake extinguished, and the dark green Poison Liquid was also scattered, splashing in all directions.
The sound of "sizzling" rang out as large and small pits were corroded into the ground and stone walls.
A splatter of Poison Liquid, through sheer bad luck, hit one of the fleeing Loose Cultivators on the head.
That person's head instantly melted into a pool of sticky muck, unable to even scream before he fell dead.
Yuan Ming witnessed this scene with his heart pounding in terror, grateful that he hadn't been greedy enough to follow them in and risk his life.
The intense poison of the Golden Flower Snake King was so terrible that it was far worse than the toad poison of the Black Toad, a force beyond what any Qi Refining Stage Cultivator could withstand.
The remaining four Loose Cultivators were scared out of their wits, exerting all their might to dash into the white array like the wind, as the gap closed immediately.
"Quick!" Bai Ye's eyes relaxed as he spurred the Token he held.
The purple fire inside the array intensified, launching a large mass of purple flames that crackled as they burned, shooting towards the golden snake head.
The golden snake head seemed to be quite wary of the purple flames, ducked its head to dodge, and avoided the strike.
At Bai Ye's side, Huan Shi also had a purple Token in hand, which he shook at the purple flames.
The purple fire spread out in the air, transforming into a several zhang-wide purple fire net that enveloped the huge snake head.
The sound of "sizzling" burning rose as the golden snake head was scorched with blackened wounds, emitting pained screams, and spewing out a stream of green Poison Liquid.
The corrosive Poison Liquid was too much for the purple fire net to withstand, as it corroded a large hole and then crumbled and disintegrated.
Shaking its head, the golden Snake King opened its bloody mouth wide, and issued another roar like a dragon's hiss, even more terrifying than before, causing the air in front of its mouth to waver with ripples.
Startled, Yuan Ming did not bother to keep watching; he immediately controlled the soul crow to turn and fly away.
However, he hadn't gone far when the soul crow was hit by the residual force of the roar's Sound Waves, its body trembling violently, black qi spilling out and almost turning it translucent. Fortunately, it did not completely disintegrate.
Yuan Ming felt dizzy as the vision conveyed by the soul crow rapidly blurred.
Not daring to hesitate, and taking advantage of the breather before the next wave of the roar, he quickly controlled the soul crow to withdraw from the Snake King Cave and took it back into his Sea of Consciousness.
At the same time, another soul crow flew out from his forehead, returning to the depths of the Snake King Cave.
Yuan Ming still wanted to keep abreast of the battle situation in the Snake King Cave, despite the cost of some damage to his Divine Soul.
After doing all this, Yuan Ming suddenly thought of something and called the soul crow guarding outside the cave in.
He controlled the soul crow to possess the Black Toad's body and then took out the Earth Travel Talisman and the Storage Ring to give to the Black Toad, before activating the talisman.
A layer of yellow light surfaced on the Black Toad's body, and with a "puff", it burrowed into the ground and headed towards the Snake King Cave.
...
The soul crow once again flew into the depths of the Snake King Cave, cautiously reaching the place where it had lurked before, and looked ahead.
At some point, green fog had appeared in the air ahead; mixed with the poisonous miasma of the place, the visibility was further narrowed, making everything seem somewhat blurred and indistinct.
The green poison fog carried a sour smell and clearly contained intense toxicity. The ground and stone walls corroded and pitted, and the body of the previously fallen Loose Cultivator was completely dissolved, leaving only a puddle of slime.
Within the green poison fog, the Formation that the Bai Ye Alliance had laid out was already shattered, the ten white large banners were destroyed, and their fragments scattered about.
The ten members of the Bai Ye Alliance who had hidden in the array, along with the four Loose Cultivators, were now all lying dead on the ground, their bodies nearly half-dissolved and their skin turned into an eerie pale green.
Of all the people who had entered, only Bai Ye and Huan Shi were still alive, engaged in combat with the Snake King using their Magic Artifacts.
However, both had pale green patches on their cheeks, clearly poisoned by the snake venom, and their movements had become much slower than before.
"How could the Bai Ye Alliance, who went through such great lengths to come here to slaughter the Snake King, be defeated so miserably!" Yuan Ming found it hard to believe. In the time it took his soul crow to withdraw and return, only half an incense stick's worth of time had passed, but the situation had changed drastically.
But then, he focused his gaze sharply.
He suddenly noticed something was not quite right with the Snake King that was battling Bai Ye and the others—it seemed not to be the same one as before.

chapters.title: Chapter 190 - 170: Stealing the Elixir
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming once again commanded the soul crow to fly a little further, his eyes keenly observing the scene, his heart chilled at the sight.
The Snake King in front of him was indeed not the same one as before; it was larger in size, with a hook-shaped single horn growing from its forehead, and four bulges erupting from its abdomen, indicating it might soon shed its snake form to transform into a Flood Dragon.
The Snake King that had earlier engaged in combat with Xiao Bai and the others was now barely alive, lying in the poison miasma behind them.
That Snake King's body was almost half destroyed, with blood flowing continuously, and its head was particularly badly injured, with half of its skull shattered, but it was not dead yet. Its mouth was slightly opening and closing, as though it was breathing control to heal.
"There are two Snake Kings here? The White Night Alliance was mistaken in their intelligence; otherwise, it wouldn't have ended so tragically," Yuan Ming sighed to himself.
The Single-Horned Snake King was far more powerful than the previous one, with its strength and the potency of its green poison liquid at least doubled, capable of easily corroding rocks to create huge pits several feet deep. The poison it released would rapidly evaporate upon hitting the ground, forming a green poisonous fog.
What was most terrifying was the single horn on its forehead, which could shoot out a gold ray with incredible penetration power. Xiao Bai and Huan Shi did not dare let it hit them.
But after all, both were Foundation Establishment Cultivators, and even though they had already been poisoned, they still coordinated well, skillfully using various spells and magic artifacts. They were not defeated for the moment.
Xiao Bai controlled a golden flying sword, while Huan Shi urged the bronze shield into action. Sword Qi surged, and the shadow of the shield flipped and spun on the defensive, effectively blocking wave after wave of the Single-Horned Snake King's attacks.
However, the cave was filled with poison miasma, and even though they were both wearing items that protected against the poison, they could not fully shield themselves. The green toxic aura on their faces slowly intensified, impeding their movements more and more.
The Single-Horned Snake King's narrow pupils flashed with bloodthirsty excitement as its attacks became increasingly vicious.
Yuan Ming paid no attention to the battle inside the cave, his eyes fixed on the severely injured Snake King, discreetly commanding a Black Toad that was lurking underground to move toward the fallen Snake King.
With two Foundation Establishment presences in the cave and two Second-level Fierce Beasts, to avoid detection, the Black Toad traveled from five feet deep underground, taking some time before it arrived beneath the Snake King.
A Purple-Black Demon Vine silently emerged from the ground, stabbing like lightning into the head wound of the Golden Flower Snake King, sinking deep into it.
The wounded Snake King, while breathing control to heal, suddenly suffered a sneak attack to the head, couldn't help but emit a pained howl.
"Now is the time!"
A black shadow shot out from the ground beside the mouth of the Golden Flower Snake King, "whooshing" into its gaping jaws, while the Purple-Black Demon Vine retracted lightning fast, also disappearing into the snake's mouth.
The series of events unfolded as fast as lightning, and it was only then that the Golden Flower Snake King reacted, attempting to investigate the black shadow that had entered its body.
In that moment, it felt excruciating pain in its lower abdomen, as if sharp knives were stabbing through its organs.
The Snake King roared in agony, its thick tail wildly whipping at the surrounding area, cracking open the stone floor and sending dust flying everywhere.
Xiao Bai, Huan Shi, and the Single-Horned Snake King all sensed the commotion, and amidst hesitations, the fight paused.
"What was that black shadow just now? Could there be someone else nearby?" Xiao Bai and Huan Shi retreated a distance, both shocked and relieved.
When the second, stronger Snake King had abruptly appeared, they had already given up on achieving their initial goal and only hoped to escape with their lives. However, the Single-Horned Snake King, enraged by the severe injury to its companion, furiously clung to them, not giving them even the slightest chance to flee.
Although they had still been coping, they were already in despair. Now, with this unexpected turn, there might be a chance to escape.
The Single-Horned Snake King glanced at its companion but did not approach. Instead, it roared and charged at Xiao Bai and Huan Shi even faster than before.
"Dodge quickly!" Xiao Bai shouted, darting to one side, while Huan Shi hastily moved to the other.
Xiao Bai, with his deeper cultivation, could just barely resist the snake poison inside him, but Huan Shi was increasingly unable to suppress it. Suddenly overwhelmed by the venom, his steps faltered.
The Single-Horned Snake King, with spiritual intelligence on par with ordinary cultivators, saw this and immediately abandoned Xiao Bai, pouncing towards Huan Shi. Its thick tail struck out with astonishing agility, and a golden shadow flashed before him in an instant.
Huan Shi had no time to dodge and could only raise the bronze shield in front of him.
There was a loud "clang" as the tail smashed against the shield.
An overwhelming force struck, denting the smooth shield and flinging it to the side.
Huan Shi, too, was sent flying by the impact, crashing onto the ground like a sack, falling unconscious.
"Second brother!" Xiao Bai cried out in alarm, quickly turning back in attack mode. Еnjоying thе stоry? Disсоvеr mоrе оn М|V|LЕМ6РYR.
His golden flying sword shot forward, heading straight for the Single-Horned Snake King's head with brilliant Sword Qi so bright it was nearly blinding.
The Single-Horned Snake King opened its mouth and spat out a fist-sized white round orb, surrounded by astonishing fluctuations of demonic power, colliding with the golden flying sword.
With a thunderous "boom," a fierce demonic power explosion filled the cave, whipping up a violent wind that engulfed the figures of both the Single-Horned Snake King and Xiao Bai.
The distant soul crow could no longer see the situation inside, hearing only "bang bang" collision sounds.
A few breaths later, a white figure was flung out, crashing heavily into a nearby mountain wall and embedding there. It was Xiao Bai.
He now had blood clots all over half of his body, his right arm was bent at an odd angle, the green snake poison on his skin had doubled in intensity, and he lay motionless, having passed out.
The Single-Horned Snake King leaped out of the dust, a huge wound on its neck, half its body dyed red with blood, but still agile in its movements. It moved quickly to the side of the injured Snake King.
At this point, it was not concerned with the life and death of Bai Ye and Huan Shi but was trying to rescue its companion.
However, the Black Toad was hiding inside the injured Snake King, and though the Single-Horned Snake King was formidable, it was helpless and could only fret anxiously by the side.
...
Yuan Ming, watching from a soul crow nearby, heaved a silent sigh.
Even with Bai Ye and Huan Shi joining forces, they were easily defeated. The power of the Single-Horned Snake King was indeed tremendous, likely having reached the Second Rank Upper Stage. Although Yuan Ming's control over the Black Toad temporarily spared them from its venom, he figured they would hardly escape with their lives today.
Yuan Ming had a favorable impression of Bai Ye and Huan Shi. If he could, he would rescue them, but it was a pity that his own power hadn't even reached the Foundation Establishment stage, so he was forced to stand by and watch.
He focused on driving the Black Toad to devour the demonic power of the severely injured Snake King.
The aura of the Black Toad surged, already at the peak of Level 1 and still rising.
The stout body of the injured Snake King had shrunken by nearly half, its struggles growing weaker as its body continuously dried out and its aura became fainter.
In contrast, the Black Toad's power continued to advance by leaps and bounds, already far exceeding the capacity of a Level 1 Fierce Beast.
"Just a bit more, only a little more, and it will reach the realm of a Second-level Fierce Beast!" Yuan Ming thought to himself.
However, the demon power of the Snake King had been mostly absorbed by the Purple-Black Demon Vine, slowing down the Black Toad's advancement.
At this moment, the Purple-Black Vine touched a chicken egg-sized white orb, identical to the one that the Single-Horned Snake King had just sprayed out.
"Could this possibly be the Snake Pearl formed from the Snake Gallbladder, as Huan Shi mentioned before!" Yuan Ming rejoiced silently, promptly using the Purple Vine to pluck the pearl.
As the Snake Pearl was removed from the body, the already dying Snake King trembled, and the last bit of life finally dissipated.
From the Single-Horned Snake King's eyes shot a tangible fury, as the golden light on its forehead surged, and a thick, arm-sized golden beam blasted forth, aiming straight at where the Black Toad was.
Unperturbed, the Black Toad activated the Earth Travel Talisman, flashing through the thin snake skin and burrowing into the ground.
Just as its figure vanished, the golden beam arrived ferociously, effortlessly slicing the shriveled snake body in two and carving a giant crevice dozens of feet long into the ground, but it didn't touch even half a toe of the Black Toad.
"Roar..." The Single-Horned Snake King roared up to the sky in rage, its tail angrily beating the ground, causing broken rocks to fly and dust to rise in a cloud.
Yuan Ming controlled the Black Toad to dive into the ground, stopping only after reaching seven or eight zhang deep, then swallowed the white Snake Pearl.
The Snake Pearl contained most of the Golden Flower Snake King's demonic power, but it was tightly locked inside the pearl. If an ordinary cultivator had found it, utilizing it would have been a hassle.
But since the Black Toad had merged with the Demon Vine and awakened an ability to devour, it could easily refine the pearl.
The Purple-Black Demon Vine entangled the white Snake Pearl, and a huge surge of demonic power flowed into the Black Toad's body, causing its aura to continue its meteoric rise. A few breaths later, it broke through its bottleneck and reached a new realm.
Nature's spiritual energy flooded in from all directions, causing the internal organs, muscles, and skin of the Black Toad to undergo a radical transformation, strengthening continuously. The Purple-Black Demon Vine residing within also writhed incessantly, quickly becoming more resilient.
The Black Toad's body swelled as if inflated, with all its poison sacs vanishing from its back, replaced by a dozen purple patterns, which looked much more pleasing than before.
Those poison sacs didn't disappear; all of the potent venom flowed into a certain part within the Black Toad's body. The surging demonic power also moved there, condensing into a Purple-Black Round Orb.
The aura of the Black Toad soon stabilized, and a vast imposing force erupted, in no way inferior to that of the fallen Snake King.
"Could it have advanced to a Second-level Spirit Beast!" Yuan Ming's eyes flickered with a trace of delight.
A Second-level Fierce Beast was on par with a Foundation Establishment Cultivator, and he finally had a capable ally.
"Speaking of which, with this spirit beast's breakthrough to Second-level, wouldn't it resist the Beast Taming Rune?" He suddenly remembered something and felt for the Beast Taming Rune within the Black Toad.
His worries did not materialize; the Black Toad did not resist the rune inside it and remained docile, obeying his commands.
Yuan Ming breathed a sigh of relief and sensed the divine skills of the Black Toad.
The Purple-Black Round Orb inside the Black Toad was indeed its inner core, much like the Snake Pearl of the Snake King, formed by the condensation of all its demonic power. Once fully stabilized, it could be used as a magic artifact.
Each demon beast's inner core had different abilities. The Golden Flower Poison Python's Snake Pearl was indestructible and could be directly used to smash enemies. The Black Toad's inner core was different, with abilities more inclined toward extreme poison.
Containing the Black Toad's toad poison, the Purple-Black inner core's toxicity had greatly increased compared to before, and its usability also expanded.
In addition to releasing poison, the Black Toad's inner core also had the ability to absorb other deadly poisons and store them within, to be released when necessary.
"It can absorb deadly poisons, too? Let's give it a try..." Yuan Ming thought, controlling the Black Toad to open its mouth and inhale.
The green poison mist in the Snake Cave, along with the billowing Poison Miasma, swirled into the ground like a whale taking in water and merged into the Black Toad's inner core.
The originally Purple-Black surface of the inner core began to show specks of green, acquiring an added layer of eeriness.

chapters.title: Chapter 191 - 171: Coffin
chapters.content:
Seeing that the Black Toad could enhance its cultivation by absorbing deadly poison, Yuan Ming felt delighted.
The green toxic miasma inside the snake den quickly thinned, and the Single-Horned Snake King, witnessing this scene, stopped wreaking havoc. Its thick snake body slowly coiled together, its snake pupils revealing wariness.
The toxic miasma inside the snake den soon disappeared completely, with very little poison miasma remaining.
When the Black Toad finally stopped absorbing, nearly half of its inner core had turned emerald green, and it became extremely excited, as if it hadn't absorbed enough.
Yuan Ming had been worried that the Black Toad might not be able to handle absorbing too much external poison, but now it seemed that he had worried unnecessarily, as the Black Toad's ability to withstand poison far exceeded his expectations.
Besides cultivating an inner core, the demonic power-infused Demon Vine residing within the Black Toad seemed to have been injected with new vitality and had grown much stronger.
Yuan Ming merely had a thought, and a "popping" sound of rupture echoed.
More than a dozen Purple-Black Demon Vines erupted from the Black Toad's back, each one thicker than before by twice as much and covered with purple leaves, resembling a dark purple vine forest.
The Purple-Black Demon Vine was already difficult to deal with, and now its numbers had exploded, and it was even more resilient than before, possibly even formidable for ordinary Second-level Fierce Beasts.
...
On the ground above, the Single-Horned Snake King watched the ground around it with vigilance, golden light flickering on its horn on the forehead.
Just then, it seemed to sense something and its massive body darted to one side.
A dozen thick Purple-Black Demon Vines emerged from the ground, rolling towards the Single-Horned Snake King's body, but mostly missing their target, with only two vines managing to wrap around the snake king's tail.
The tips of the two Demon Vines suddenly became sharp, piercing directly through the Snake King's tough scales and into its flesh.
The Single-Horned Snake King felt a severe pain in its tail, and the demonic power inside was being sucked away by the two Demon Vines. The previously full tail visibly shriveled at a rate visible to the naked eye.
Fury and surprise mingled in the Snake King, and as it swung its head, blobs of dark green poison liquid scattered towards those Demon Vines.
A "hissing" sound arose as the parts of the Purple-Black Demon Vines that came into contact with the poison turned pitch black and swiftly decomposed and disintegrated, but they were only rotten by a small part, with the remaining vines still firmly restraining its tail, even the speed at which they devoured demonic power hardly slowed.
The Snake King's delay allowed other Demon Vines to sweep in, entangling various parts of the Single-Horned Snake King's body, with vines piercing into the Snake King.
A trace of fear flashed through the Snake King's eyes, and it struggled fiercely, spewing out poison liquid while its horn on the forehead shot out golden rays, slicing at the Demon Vines around it.
Although the Purple-Black Demon Vines feared neither the snake's poison nor the rot, and were far more resilient than before, any vine touched by the golden rays was neatly severed in two.
However, the number of Purple-Black Demon Vines had greatly increased and their regenerative abilities were extremely strong. As soon as they were cut, new vines grew out.
The Single-Horned Snake King shot out seven or eight golden rays, but the Demon Vines entangling it not only didn't decrease but increased instead. In no time, its massive snake body was gradually wrapped into a zongzi.
All the vines were crazily drawing the demonic power from the body of the Single-Horned Snake King, which increasingly found it difficult to resist. As its body shrank, it went from an initial wild struggle to a weak flicking of its head and tail at the end.
After a full half quarter of an hour, the Single-Horned Snake King had completely turned into a withered corpse, all its demonic power being swallowed by the Black Toad as if ripped away by a blunt knife.
The Black Toad had just absorbed a Second-level Middle Stage Snake King's core, and now having devoured the essence blood of a Single-Horned Snake King equivalent to a Mid-to-late stage Foundation Establishment Cultivator, its aura surged once more, pressing close to the threshold of Second-level Middle Stage.
Yuan Ming, observing the remains of the two snake kings through the soul crow, felt somewhat incredulous.
Although the Single-Horned Snake King had just gone through a fierce battle with a human, it was still a Second Rank Upper Stage Fierce Beast. Now, before this Black Toad, it seemed to have almost no power to fight back.
He couldn't help but think about re-evaluating the strength of the Black Toad Spiritual Beast in his heart.
Now that the battle in the snake den was over, the battlefield there needed to be cleaned up. There were still quite a few spiritual materials that needed to be collected from the bodies of the two snake kings, and the Black Toad was not particularly suited to doing these things.
Yuan Ming stood up, retracted the Four Directions Sealing Spirit Talisman, and made his way towards the Snake Cave.
As he rushed along, he sensed, through another soul crow, the situation with Sang Yan and the others from the Black Fire Sect.
Inside the dilapidated hall, the Yin-locking Restriction had started flickering erratically, looking like it could collapse at any moment.
Elder Gu Tu suddenly expelled a mouthful of mana, merging it into the white Jade Talisman, as his hands executed a series of seals in front of him.
His white Jade Talisman exploded with a "bang," turning into a white light arrow several feet long, striking the black light screen.
The Jade Talismans of the other four also shattered, turning into white light arrows that fiercely struck the Yin-locking Restriction.
The already precarious restriction completely collapsed, turning into countless wisps of Yin Qi dispersing, revealing the interior of the hall.
Yuan Ming hastened the soul crow closer to spy on the situation inside the hall.
In the center of the great hall lay a black coffin, with two towering blue tiger statues on either side, appearing to be grave guardian beasts.
Deeper inside the hall, there seemed to be a White Jade Platform with various bottles and jars placed on it.
That place was too far away, and the soul crow couldn't see clearly.
Yuan Ming controlled the soul crow to move closer, and Elder Gu Tu suddenly looked over, shouting loudly, "What is that!"
Startled, Yuan Ming quickly controlled the soul crow to retreat, flapping its wings and fleeing outwards.
"Trying to escape?" Elder Gu Tu flicked his finger.
A nearly invisible fine black line shot out, which was a slender as a hair Black Needle, instantly crossing a distance of more than ten yards, aiming for the soul crow's chest.
The soul crow flapped its wings to dodge to the side, narrowly avoiding the attack of the black line.
The direction of the Black Needle abruptly shifted, and it shot towards the soul crow once more, piercing directly through its left wing.
The left wing of the soul crow disintegrated instantly, causing it to fly somewhat unsteadily. Not long after it had taken flight, the Black Needle pierced through its body again, and the soul crow disintegrated completely, dissipating into a cloud of black qi that vanished without a trace.
...
As Yuan Ming sprinted, his mind suddenly buzzed, and his complexion turned a few shades paler.
The destruction of the soul crow he had dispatched resulted in considerable harm to his Soul Power.
Fortunately, he had now cultivated the Moonlight Technique to the second layer, and with the incense burner in hand, he would be able to recover after a period of nurturing.
"It seems I still underestimated the detection abilities of a Foundation Establishment Cultivator," Yuan Ming didn't stop but glanced in the direction where the soul crow had been destroyed and sped up towards the direction of the Snake King Cave.
...
Inside the great hall.
"Elder Gu Tu, what just happened?" Sang Yan asked.
"It must have been someone spying through a secret technique, with their presence extremely well concealed. I only spotted a hint of it just now," Elder Gu Tu pondered as he spoke.
"To escape your Divine Sense, they must be no ordinary Qi Refinement Cultivator," Sang Yan said.
"Could it be Bai Ye or Huan Shi?" The black-clad girl, who didn't get along well with Sang Yan, didn't argue with him this time, instead raising the possibility.
"It doesn't seem like tactics those two would use, it's probably someone else," Sang Yan said.
"No matter who it is, you go in and retrieve the items first, I'll stand guard here! Remember to be quick!" Elder Gu Tu immediately commanded, turning to face the outside.
Not daring to delay, Sang Yan and the others hastened into the hall. They examined the stone platform behind the coffin first, where vats and jars were placed, containing elixirs that, unfortunately, had become worthless over the passage of time.
The group was deeply regretful. They searched the rest of the hall in vain and eventually gathered around the black coffin. They quickly figured out the mechanism on the coffin lid and were about to open it.Brought to you by *.
"Wait."
Sang Yan raised a hand to stop the others, released a white bowl into the air above the coffin, and then signaled that they could proceed with opening.
With the sound of the mechanism turning, the heavy lid of the coffin slowly opened.
Before the group could make out what was inside the coffin, a dense black qi emerged first, emitting a nauseating stench.
"Back away!" Sang Yan shouted, retreating like lightning.
The others also withdrew hastily.
The floating white bowl immediately dove down, emitting a burst of white spirit light that enveloped the black qi.
The black qi, as if alive, surged and tried to break through, but ultimately could not escape the white light's confinement and was slowly absorbed by the white bowl. However, the once pristine white bowl slowly turned black.
"Corpse Poison! Luckily, Sister Sang Yan was prepared, or the consequences would have been unimaginable," a young man with sword-like eyebrows exhaled lightly as he spoke.
The black-clad girl looked at Sang Yan with a complex expression before turning her gaze back to the coffin.
Lying in the coffin was a corpse over seven feet tall, with a lean body and long limbs, much like a bamboo pole.
The corpse was dressed in a tattered green robe, a red jade crown atop its head, its body covered with green hair, yet its aura was exceedingly weak.
"Is this the body of the Heavenly Snake Master, the Loose Cultivator who passed away a hundred years ago? It's said that he had reached the mid-stage of Core Formation during his lifetime, but why is the aura so weak, almost like a common yin corpse?" the black-clad girl surveyed the body and said.
The others, including Sang Yan, all wore similar expressions.
They were disciples of the Black Fire Sect, which excelled in Corpse Control, and their research on corpses was profound. Even if a high-level Cultivator's remains were not intact, they would still retain some of the Cultivator's power from their lifetime and would not look like this.
With a blur of a figure, Elder Gu Tu appeared next to the coffin as well. Upon seeing the green-haired corpse inside, he also frowned.
"Could it be we are mistaken? Could this person not be the Heavenly Snake Master?" the young man with sword-like eyebrows suggested.
"Impossible, I came here following that fragmented map, which was drawn by the only disciple of the Heavenly Snake Master. It clearly marks this place as the tomb of the Heavenly Snake Master. The Yin-locking Restriction outside the hall and those abandoned elixirs are also proof. Furthermore, it is said that Heavenly Snake Master was tall and thin, which matches the corpse here. It couldn't be anyone else!" Sang Yan stated confidently.
"That fragmented map was nothing more than something you bought at a stall; who knows if it wasn't just randomly drawn by some swindler," the black-clad girl retorted with a curl of her lip.
Sang Yan's eyes darkened, ready to argue back.
"I understand now, it's the Corpse Sealing Nail!" Elder Gu Tu's voice rang out, interrupting the argument between the two.
He stood at the top of the corpse, eyes fixed on the corpse's head.
"The Corpse Sealing Nail?" Sang Yan inquired.
"The Corpse Sealing Nail is a unique Magic Artifact of the Corpse Chasing Sect from the Central Plains Chu country, used to refine corpses. As long as this nail is thrust into the Bai Hui Acupoint, it can seal all the meridians in the body, preventing any leakage of qi, and it can also make the body automatically absorb nearby Yin Qi, thereby gradually transforming and absorbing it," Elder Gu Tu explained as he moved aside the jade crown on the corpse's head to reveal a black iron nail driven deeply into its brain.
"Could it really be so easy to transform a corpse into a refined corpse?" the black-clad girl asked in disbelief as she looked at the iron nail.
For the Black Fire Sect to refine a single refined corpse, many steps and a significant amount of resources were required. To think that inserting a single nail could autonomously refine a corpse was nearly beyond imagination.

chapters.title: Chapter 192 - 172: Blockade
chapters.content:
"Of course not, refining corpses with Corpse Sealing Nails is convenient, but it requires a very long time of waiting, at least a century. Speaking of which, it's not considered a top-notch method for refining corpses. For those from the Corpse Chasing Sect, the main use of Corpse Sealing Nails is actually to seal some rampaging refined corpses," Elder Gu Tu shook his head and said as much.
The black-clad girl and others, upon hearing this, suddenly understood.
Elder Gu Tu stopped talking, muttering words under his breath as his fingertip touched the black iron nail, both simultaneously bursting into black light.
His finger slowly moved outward, and the black iron nail seemed to stick to his fingertip, slowly being pulled out, bit by bit detaching from the green-haired corpse's head.
The black-clad girl and the others held their breath and watched intently, not even daring to breathe heavily.
Boom!
The moment the black iron nail left the green-haired corpse's skull, a sinister and dreadful aura burst forth from the corpse, instantly filling the entire hall, outmatching the pressure of Foundation Establishment Cultivators.
Everyone's clothes rustled loudly, and breathing became difficult, their faces filled with great alarm.
"Indeed, I am correct, this is undoubtedly the corpse of the Heavenly Snake Master, only its power has been sealed by the Corpse Sealing Nail. Quick, implant the Corpse Control Talisman into the corpse's Sea of Consciousness!" Elder Gu Tu announced excitedly, urging Sang Yan.
Sang Yan immediately took out a black jade talisman from her Storage Bag, affixed it to the forehead of the green-haired corpse, and quickly chanted a spell.
The black talisman silently dissolved, turning into black runes that entered the green-haired corpse's head.
As she continuously formed hand seals, streams of spells entered various parts of the green-haired corpse, and the violent Corpse Qi began to show signs of being reined in.
Immediately afterward, Sang Yan took out nine white talismans, and with a wave of her hands, slapped the talismans "pop pop pop" onto the top of the green-haired corpse's head, Dantian, and limbs. Only then did the green-haired corpse finally return to complete calm.
"Since you discovered this place and in accordance with the agreement between me and your master, this corpse will belong to you. Take it away first," Elder Gu Tu said.
Upon hearing this, the black-clad girl's gaze shot towards Sang Yan like a venomous snake, her fingers tightly clenched.
"Many thanks to Elder Gu Tu!" Sang Yan expressed her joy and gratitude, taking out a small black bag and activating it with her hand seals.
A beam of black light shot out from the bag, enveloping the corpse and the black coffin, slowly drawing them into the bag.
"Now that this matter has concluded. Elder Gu Tu, should we check out the Snake King Cave? Since Bai Ye and Huan Shi have come here with such careful planning, there must be significant benefits there. With our capabilities, we should be able to get a share," suggested the black-clad girl, who hadn't been able to gain anything just now.
The young man with sword-like eyebrows and the others also had little to show for their efforts, and were somewhat tempted.
Elder Gu Tu, being a Cultivator from a Sect, naturally looked down upon Loose Cultivators like Bai Ye and Huan Shi. He was also aware of the mission of the White Night Alliance to hunt down a Second Level Snake King Fierce Beast. They were likely already heavily injured from the battle, so he had nothing to fear.
"Alright, let's go have a look," Elder Gu Tu nodded and said.
Sang Yan had just joyfully acquired a mid-stage Core Formation corpse and wanted to return to the Sect as soon as possible to refine and control it. She didn't wish to further complicate matters, but seeing the other fellow disciples inclined to go, she didn't object.
...
Meanwhile.
Yuan Ming arrived at the depths of Snake King Cave and, after searching around, extracted the poison fangs and snake skin from two Snake Kings, as well as the single horn from the Single-Horned Snake King, among other useful spiritual materials, and stored them away.
After hesitating for a moment, Yuan Ming didn't feed the Snake Pearl to the Black Toad but instead placed it into his Storage Ring.
This Snake Pearl was quite precious, and selling it could exchange for quite a few Spirit Stones. He was currently strapped for cash due to the upcoming gathering at White Deer Hill, so he decided not to use it for the Black Toad's advancement.
"Quack!" The Black Toad did not demand the Snake Pearl, but instead headed deeper into the Snake Cave.
Yuan Ming had already called back the soul crow that was possessing the Black Toad and was slightly surprised to see this. He quickly followed suit.
It wasn't long before the end of the Snake Cave was reached.
There was a large stone cave, and at its center was a pit about ten meters in size. The soil was flattened and smooth like a mirror, which seemed to be the nest of the two Snake Kings.
In the center of the pit stood a black stone pillar about four to five meters tall and as thick as a millstone, with ancient patterns inscribed on it. It looked extraordinary, and being in a place with such dense miasma for years, its surface was not at all corroded.
The Black Toad headed straight for the pillar, pressing its body against it, showing an extremely comfortable expression on its face.
"Eh, what exactly is this stone pillar? The two Snake Kings made their nest here, and the Black Toad likes it too..." Yuan Ming approached the pillar and began to probe inside with his Divine Sense.
An invisible force emerged suddenly, easily repelling his Divine Sense.
He frowned slightly and flicked his finger.
A green wooden thorn struck the stone pillar, shattering the thorn, but leaving no mark on the pillar.
Yuan Ming then drew his Cold Star Sword, a swath of frost Sword Qi striking the pillar, shattering the Qi but leaving the pillar undamaged.
"Even the Cold Star Sword can't leave a scratch!" He was truly shocked and, after a brief moment of contemplation, extended his Divine Sense once more.
This time, he didn't delve into the depths of the pillar but instead carefully sensed the Black Toad, searching for the reason why it clung to the pillar.
Yuan Ming did not waste his efforts this time and quickly discovered the reason. As the Black Toad drew close to the pillar, a mysterious aura seeped out from within the pillar and merged into its body.
This aura was neither the power of the Five Elements: Gold, Wood, Water, Fire, Earth nor the force of extreme yang, Yin Qi, or even Divine Soul Power. It was a kind of unfamiliar force he had never encountered before.
If he had to describe it, this force had some similarities with Yin Qi, but it was not exactly the same, giving him a faint sensation of malice and foreboding.
After absorbing this aura, the demonic power of the Black Toad did not increase significantly, but the aura it emitted became much more active.
Yuan Ming couldn't figure out the origin of the stone pillar in front of him, but since the aura within it was harmless to the Black Toad, he decided not to bother with it and looked around.
Nearby, on the ground of the Snake King's nest, grew about a dozen black Spirit Grasses. The leaves were shaped like snakes and emanated a strong surge of cold, Yin force.
"Could this be Yin Snake Grass?" Yuan Ming had read about this black grass in the classics. It was said to be a companion spiritual material that grew near snake-like Fierce Beasts.
Yuan Ming hurriedly stepped forward, carefully harvested these Spirit Grasses, and collected them.
Yin Snake Grass was an excellent material for refining yin attribute elixirs; it could be sold for a good amount of Spirit Stones and could also be mixed into Black Incense to test its effects.
In the time that followed, Yuan Ming searched the vicinity but found no more treasures. He, along with the somewhat reluctant Black Toad, made his way back to where Bai Ye and Huan Shi lay.
The two were still unconscious with their breath frighteningly weak.
After a brief examination, Yuan Ming frowned.
The injuries of Bai Ye and Huan Shi were severe but not fatal. However, the poison in their bodies was so deep it had infiltrated their internal organs, beyond the point of remedy.
It dawned on Yuan Ming why the Single-Horned Snake King didn't deliver a fatal blow to Bai Ye and his companion; instead, it attacked him.
He sighed with regret, intending to take the two out of the Snake Cave and find a place to lay them to rest, but then he stopped suddenly.
Yuan Ming thought of the Black Toad's Absorb Poison Divine Ability. This Divine Skill could draw in snake poison from the air, but could it also directly extract the severe poison within the two individuals?
He beckoned the Black Toad, shot out two Purple-black Vines, and gently pierced them into the bodies of the two, activating the inner core to extract the snake poison.
A miraculous scene unfolded!
The green tinge on the body surfaces of Bai Ye and Huan Shi quickly receded, moving along the vines into the body of the Black Toad.
"It's effective, who would have thought the Black Toad's ability to Absorb Poison would be so exquisite!" Yuan Ming secretly rejoiced, encouraging the Black Toad to keep drawing out the poison.
After a moment, the intense poison inside the two had completely disappeared, and their skin returned to its normal color.
Yuan Ming took out two Healing Pills and stuffed them into their mouths, then used his Mana to help them refine the medicine.
As the medicinal power dispersed, the breathing of the two stabilized.
Bai Ye, with profound cultivation but severe external wounds and lighter internal injuries, soon awoke.
My Virtual Library Empire (*) appreciates your readership at the source.
"Fellow Daoist Hagon, it's you..." Bai Ye looked at Yuan Ming in surprise, then quickly scanned the surroundings in fear, remembering the Single-Horned Snake King.
"The Snake King is dead, it's safe now. Rest assured, Alliance Leader Bai Ye," said Yuan Ming as he helped Bai Ye to set his arm bone straight.
Bai Ye saw the corpses of the Single-Horned Snake King and another Golden Flower Snake King and noticed the traces of battle on the ground, which allowed him to roughly understand what had happened while he was unconscious.
"So it was Fellow Daoist Hagon who saved me and Huan Shi? I am deeply grateful!" Bai Ye sincerely thanked him.
"It was nothing, Alliance Leader Bai Ye. Now that you are awake, I need not worry about Senior Huan Shi's injuries. I have matters to attend to and must take my leave," said Yuan Ming, standing up and ready to leave.
Bai Ye wanted to express more gratitude, but seeing Yuan Ming's demeanor, he swallowed his words.
Just as Yuan Ming had taken a few steps, he suddenly stopped and looked ahead.
Since entering the Snake Cave, he had positioned a soul crow at the entrance to the cave for safety. Now, the people from the Black Fire Sect had arrived at the entrance of the Snake Cave.
With a moment's thought, Yuan Ming guessed the purpose of the Black Fire Sect group's arrival, yet he was not alarmed.
The spiritual power in that Earth Travel Talisman had not been exhausted; it could still be used, and he could leave the place at any moment through Earth Tunneling.
"What has Fellow Daoist Hagon noticed?" Having become very jumpy, Bai Ye sensed Yuan Ming's perturbation and quickly asked.
"Someone is coming, five people in total. Bai Rong is among them, along with four other Loose Cultivators who answered the call for this mission. One of them has concealed their cultivation and is a Foundation Establishment Cultivator," Yuan Ming turned to look at Bai Ye and cautioned.
"We are trapped here!" Bai Ye's expression changed drastically with each word Yuan Ming spoke. Those words felt like heavy hammers striking his heart.
If he and Huan Shi weren't injured, they would naturally not be afraid, but now with Huan Shi still unconscious and himself too wounded to move, they would be no match even for a mere Qi Refining Stage Cultivator.
"I am afraid I can do no more; Alliance Leader Bai Ye must look after himself," Yuan Ming finished cautioning and took out an Earth Travel Talisman, preparing to leave.
"Fellow Daoist Hagon, please wait! Huan Shi and I are gravely injured. If those people harbor evil intents, we are utterly defenseless. Please, Fellow Daoist Hagon, lend us your noble assistance. I have more than a thousand Spirit Stones on me, and Huan Shi's Storage Bag should also contain about five to six hundred. You can take them all as a reward for saving our lives," Bai Ye, regaining his senses, spoke quickly.
Yuan Ming was somewhat tempted by the offer, but after careful consideration of the consequences, he still shook his head.
The Black Fire Sect was a mighty power, even superior to Biluo Cave. Killing Sang Yan and the others would be different from the Loose Cultivators he had previously slain—it might draw the Black Fire Sect's pursuit. He had no desire to offend the Black Fire Sect, and alerting Bai Ye was already the limit of his benevolence.
As for whether Bai Ye would harbor resentment for being refused, Yuan Ming didn't care. His current appearance and identity were both fictitious, so naturally, he wasn't concerned about being betrayed.

chapters.title: Chapter 193 - 173 Setting an Ambush
chapters.content:
"I do understand this puts you in a difficult position," Bai Ye hesitated for a moment before finally resolving himself and saying the words that Yuan Ming could not ignore. "I have a Foundation Establishment Pill on me. If Fellow Daoist Hagon is willing to assist me fully, this pill will be your reward!"
"Foundation Establishment Pill!" Yuan Ming's heart leaped violently.
Once a Qi Refining Stage Cultivator breaks through the tenth layer, they can attempt Foundation Establishment. Only by successfully establishing their foundation and consequently doubling their lifespan can they truly enter the proper path of cultivation.
However, Foundation Establishment is extremely challenging. Without additional measures, perhaps not even one in a hundred Qi Refining Cultivators will succeed, and those few lucky enough to do so are typically the outstanding ones with Heaven and Earth Spiritual Roots.
Many Sects have Qi Refining members who have surpassed the tenth layer, even reaching the peak of the thirteenth layer, primarily to increase their chances of successfully breaking through to Foundation Establishment.
The Cultivation World has seen countless people throughout history research methods to aid in breaking through, yielding results. Among all the known methods, the most renowned is the Foundation Establishment Pill.
Who originally created the Foundation Establishment Pill is no longer verifiable, but it is suitable for all cultivators, and consuming it substantially increases the odds of Foundation Establishment.
Such a miraculous elixir is coveted by all in the world of cultivation, but alas, the process of refining it is complicated, and the required spiritual materials are extremely rare. The production is so scarce that every pill that comes into existence incites fierce competition among the powerful forces, as each pill could potentially add an extra Foundation Establishment Expert to their ranks.
Yuan Ming had also inquired about the Foundation Establishment Pill and, upon learning about its rarity, reluctantly gave up the search.
"Let me take a look at the elixir," Yuan Ming said, trying to suppress the excitement in his voice.
Without any hesitation, Bai Ye took out a Jade Box from his Storage Bag. Opening it revealed a thumb-sized, glowing blue pill with a dreamlike layer of blue light swirling around it, resembling the starlight in the night sky.
"It really is a Foundation Establishment Pill!" Yuan Ming's breath caught in his throat.
He had seen records of this pill in the Classics, a perfect match to the one before his eyes, blue as the vast sky, illusory as the starry sea – undoubtedly a genuine Foundation Establishment Pill.
"To think that Alliance Leader Bai Ye possessed such a treasure as a Foundation Establishment Pill. I agree to your terms; I will do everything in my power to help you escape. However, the adversaries are numerous, and I do not have absolute certainty," Yuan Ming pondered for a moment before finally making up his mind.
Unlike his previous reckless move to save Hagon's wife and children, he now knew what he was doing. Although it required taking significant risks, the stakes offered were worth it.
Fortune, after all, favors the bold!
Moreover, he was not entirely without assurance – if he was overwhelmed, the rare Earth Travel Talisman would be his last resort.
"Do not worry, as long as you, Fellow Daoist Hagon, put forth your best effort, this Foundation Establishment Pill will be yours," Bai Ye stated, closing the Jade Box and throwing it over.
Yuan Ming caught it, surveyed Bai Ye with surprise, silently put the Jade Box away, and then collapsed onto the ground next to him. He activated the Wood Concealment Skill to control his breath, and at the same time, he recalled the soul crow that had been guarding the entrance.
All traces of Mana fluctuations dissipated from his body. Even the sound of his heartbeat vanished, and he seemed like nothing more than a cold corpse.
The Black Toad hopped out of the spirit beast bag at his waist, activated the Earth Travel Talisman, and in a flash, disappeared into the ground.
In the middle area of the Snake Cave Passage, a black head emerged from the ground – it was the Black Toad, opening its mouth to exhale.
A stream of purple Poison Miasma rolled out, quickly blending into the surrounding poison fog, soon becoming completely hidden with very little trace of its scent left.
This was the Black Toad's ability to use poison after condensing its inner core, allowing it to transform toad poison into a miasma, making it much harder to detect.
Having completed these actions, the Black Toad submerged back underground.
Bai Ye, witnessing Yuan Ming's sequence of actions, couldn't help but feel stunned; yet before he could even voice a question, there was already a disturbance emanating from the passage leading to their location, forcing him to close his mouth.
Not long after, five figures emerged from the poison fog at the front. It was Bone Map leading a group of people from the Black Fire Sect.
"What's that smell?" The girl in black sniffed, speaking out.
The others also noticed something unusual in the air, finding it slightly sweet and cloying.
"This place is filled with Poison Miasma; do not sniff around carelessly, be careful not to be poisoned!" Bone Map warned.
The girl in black and the rest replied, holding their breath and moving forward, soon reaching where Bai Ye was.
"Isn't this Fellow Daoist Bai Rong? And a few others, didn't you give up the mission? Why have you returned?" Bai Ye opened his eyes and looked at the group, perfectly feigning surprise.
The Black Fire Sect members were initially startled when they saw the situation inside the cave, and then their tense expressions turned to joy.
They hadn't expected to find two dead Snake Kings here, with Bai Ye's Qi Refining members and several Loose Cultivators already perished. Moreover, the strongest among them, Bai Ye and Huan Shi, were seriously injured.
Bone Map's expression remained unchanged while his heart rejoiced.
Coming here was the right decision. The materials from two Second-level Fierce Beasts were a considerable fortune for him, a Foundation Establishment Cultivator, not to mention the Storage Bags of two other Foundation Establishment Cultivators, Bai Ye and Huan Shi.
With that thought, his eyes filled with a cold intent to kill, and he signaled to Sang Yan and the others with a glance.
The four of them understood and stepped back to guard the entrance of the Snake Cave Passage.
"Do you mean to kill for treasure?" Bai Ye's expression darkened, and he asked with feigned composure.
"Blame it on your unfortunate state that made you cross my path. Allow me to relieve you of your misery here," Bone Map flicked his finger, sending a black line shooting towards Bai Ye — the very same Black Needle Magical Artifact from before.
Just in that instant, the ground at Bone Map's feet suddenly cracked open. Dozens of thick Purple-Black Demon Vines broke through the soil, rapidly wrapping around Bone Map's limbs.
Bone Map was shocked and, without further ado, spat out a yellow round orb from his mouth.
Dazzling yellow light burst forth, and in an instant, a yellow spherical protective shield appeared around him, protecting his entire body.
This chapter first appeared on *.
The Purple-Black Demon Vine lashed against the shield, easily blocked from making contact.
A Purple-Black Poison Liquid secreted from the surface of the vine attempted to corrode the yellow shield, but the surface of the shield flashed with light and showed no sign of damage.
"Child's play!" Bone Map sneered coldly, raising both hands as if to do something.
Those dozen or so Purple-Black Demon Vines suddenly thickened considerably and grew dense leaves, turning into a veritable forest of vines in an instant, engulfing Bone Map and the yellow shield within.
Yuan Ming, whose hand was pinned beneath him, gestured towards the Purple-Black Demon Vine, and the vines immediately interlaced left and right, instantly forming a vine cage— the Wood Prison Technique—trapping Bone Map.
The Purple-Black Demon Vine, now unleashed after Black Toad's breakthrough into the Second-level Spirit Beast, was not something the ordinary Wood Prison Technique could compare with, and even with Bone Map's Foundation Establishment Cultivation, he found himself rooted to the spot, unable to move for a while.
All of this happened in a flash of lightning!
Sang Yan and the others were shocked when they saw this and, neglecting the defense of the cave, hurriedly flew towards this scene.
Yuan Ming leaped up from the ground and swung his arm.
The Shuiyun Banner shot out from his sleeve, quickly expanding to block Sang Yan and the others, now grown to the size of a ten-zhang-long banner, like an enormous blue palm slapping towards the four of them.
Sang Yan and the others stopped in their tracks, hastily unleashing their Divine Skills to protect themselves.
With a "bang," their bodies shook slightly, but they quickly steadied themselves, the anticipated powerful attack failing to materialize.
Not only that, but the blue banner unfolded with a "whoosh," completely blocking off the Snake Cave Passage.
Only then did Sang Yan and the others realize they'd been duped and quickly took out their Magic Artifacts and refining corpses to attack the Shuiyun Banner.
The Shuiyun Banner was a Mid Grade Defensive Magical Artifact. Although it shook under their attacks, it steadfastly blocked the way, preventing Sang Yan and the others from breaking through immediately.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming breathed a sigh of relief, and with a grasp in the air, a blazing Fireball appeared in his palm while his other hand held a Spirit Stone, furiously absorbing Spiritual Power.
He circulated the Mana within his body, endlessly flowing into the Fireball, which swelled from the size of a fist into something much larger.
Bone Map, who was attempting to break free from the Wood Prison Technique, saw Yuan Ming's actions and immediately stopped, focusing intently on his defense.
However, after a few breaths, Yuan Ming still hadn't acted, and the Fireball in his hand, now the size of a human head, swelled and its Mana fluctuations became several times more intense.
Bone Map immediately understood Yuan Ming's intention and slapped the black pouch on his waist.
Two shadows shot out from the fissures in the vines, landing outside the shield and transforming into two towering refining corpses.
The skin of these two corpses was bluish-black, covered in green Scale Armor—they were the Green Steel Corpses that had appeared in the Ghost Market, seeming even more powerful than those in the workshop, their aura verging on the Foundation Establishment Realm as they roared and rushed toward Yuan Ming.
Almost at the same time, the Black Needle, originally directed at Bai Ye, had appeared behind Yuan Ming, and under the fierce attack of the Green Steel Corpses, it silently stabbed toward Yuan Ming's heart.
However, with a "ting" sound, a piece of Gold-plated Gauze suddenly appeared behind Yuan Ming, blocking the Black Needle's sneak attack—it was the Gold-plated Gauze.
The two Green Steel Corpses also pounced, their claw-like fingers reaching for Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming tossed aside the drained Spirit Stone with his left hand, gestured a spell, and then the mere three-zhang-long Gold-plated Gauze expanded quickly, wrapping around his body several times, encasing him thoroughly.
The claws of the Green Steel Corpses squelched against the Gold-plated Gauze, sparking off points of fire, yet still unable to penetrate the gauze's defense.
As three great forces transmitted through the Gold-plated Gauze, Yuan Ming's body shook, and he hastily placed his left hand on the gauze, injecting Mana to stabilize the defense, while his right hand continued to maintain the Burning Explosion Skill.
"A Mid Grade Defensive Magical Artifact, its defensive strength seems to exceed my Stone-controlling Bead!" Bone Map's expression darkened.
It would have been acceptable for the two Green Steel Corpses to fail, but even the Black Needle Magical Artifact returned without success.
This needle was one of his cherished Mid-grade Magical Artifacts, engraved with the runes "Sharp" and "Concealment." Even cultivators of the same rank in the Foundation Establishment Realm could easily suffer should they be careless. It was unexpected that Yuan Ming was able to detect it!
Bone Map pointed a finger, and a Nine-Ring Chopper radiating golden light flew out from the shield, piercing through the vine Wood Prison and slashing towards Yuan Ming.
The Black Needle Magical Artifact's dark light surged wildly, spinning rapidly as it whistled sharply, aiming another strike at the Gold-plated Gauze, while the two Green Steel Corpses also launched frenzied attacks.
The Gold-plated Gauze swayed left and right, and even with Yuan Ming's Mana reinforcement, the glow on it quickly dulled.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming took out the Mid-grade Spirit Stone of Wood Attribute, stuffed it into his chest to draw on its Spiritual Power, recovering Mana to sustain the Gold-plated Gauze and the Fireball of the Burning Explosion Skill.
The crimson Fireball swiftly grew again, turning into a millstone-sized monster in an instant; its color deepened to a vivid red, emanating terrifying Mana fluctuations.
Yuan Ming's eyes brightened, and he stopped infusing Mana.
This was the limit he could control at present, and any more Mana would cause the Burning Explosion Skill to become uncontrollable!

chapters.title: Chapter 194 - 174: Leave No One Behind
chapters.content:
"What on earth is this!"
Although Bone Map didn't know what secret technique Yuan Ming was using, a foreboding feeling in his heart increased. He formed hand seals like turning wheel hubs, and streaks of black spells shot out.
He opened his mouth to spit out a mouthful of Essence Blood, which merged with those spells. The black spells instantly turned blood-red and merged into the Black Needle Magical Artifact and the Nine-Ring Gold Saber.
The two magic artifacts emitted intense vibrations, their power surged by nearly half, and ferociously struck the same spot on the golden gauze.
The Gold-plated Gauze was indented inward, and the outermost three layers of golden gauze "ripped" apart, while the layers behind barely blocked the attack from the two artifacts.
Yuan Ming didn't have time to regret as he pointed out with a hand seal.
The Gold-plated Gauze suddenly flew outward, rolled back and enveloped the Black Needle Magical Artifact and the Nine-Ring Gold Saber, quickly wrapping and forming a golden gauze ball, trapping the two artifacts inside.
Almost simultaneously, a white shadow flashed by his side, and he was already wearing the White Ape Skin.
Yuan Ming's body suddenly enlarged, transforming into a ten-feet-tall white giant ape. His left hand held the Cold Star Sword, pointing continuously at the void towards the two Green Steel Corpses.
Two streaks of frost Sword Qi shot out, striking both refining corpses.
An intense cold burst forth, and a layer of white hard frost appeared on the surfaces of the two Green Steel Corpses, slowing their movements slightly.
This series of actions might sound complicated, but it all happened within just two or three breaths of time. Bone Map was slightly startled and was about to deploy another technique.
Yuan Ming himself darted out, and under the enhancement of the Fur Cloak Skill, he instantly appeared beside Bone Map. The Cold Star Sword had already been put away, and more than a dozen talismans flew from his hands, all of which were the attack type talismans he had purchased in the Black Rock City Market and threw them out.
Fireballs, Fire Snakes, and Thunder emerged, creating a wave of spells that erupted with astonishing mana fluctuations, all striking toward Bone Map.
The Wood Prison technique around Bone Map suddenly disintegrated, and all the Purple-Black Demon Vines withdrew back into the ground. The surging wave of spells fiercely struck the yellow protective shield.
A series of loud bangs exploded, and the intense mana collision caused visible ripples to undulate in the nearby air.
The yellow protective shield trembled violently, surfaces showing cracks, but it did not collapse.
Within the shield, Bone Map's body also trembled violently, but seeing the shield holding up, he immediately breathed a sigh of relief.
He pressed his hands on the inside of the shield, pouring robust mana into it, attempting to restore the shield's strength.
At this moment, a purple rush suddenly surged on Bone Map's cheeks, and his limbs became somewhat weak and powerless, with his mana circulation also affected.
"Poisoned! Could it be the sweet scent I smelled earlier in the passage? But I held my breath in time; how could I still be poisoned?" A shock went through his mind.
At this very moment, Sang Yan and others who were attacking the Shuiyun Banner also developed purple poison spots on their faces, their mana retreating like a tide, and their expressions greatly changed.
"It's finally taking effect," Yuan Ming thought, relaxing slightly.
The poison mist previously spewed by the Black Toad was mixed with the snake poison of the Single-Horned Snake King, different in effect from the liquid toad poison. The mist wasn't corrosive but was able to damage the internal organs and meridians of the opponent.
This poison didn't need to be inhaled to take effect; as long as the skin came into contact with the poison mist, the toxin would automatically permeate into the body.
However, Bone Map quickly flipped his hand to take out an Elixir Pill and placed it in his mouth. The purple color on his face quickly subsided, and his movements became smooth again, continuing to inject mana into the shield, with the cracks on its surface quickly closing up.
Just then, three streaks of black light suddenly appeared around Bone Map, coming from three directions and penetrating the cracks of the shield, flying towards Bone Map's head.
They were startlingly three soul crows!
A chill ran through Bone Map's heart; he managed to dodge two, but the third struck him right at the eyebrow.
He only felt a "bang" in his mind, as if something had exploded, and his entire being suddenly froze, his gaze turning dull, the restoration of the shield also stopping.
Meanwhile, Yuan Ming also felt a sudden intense dizziness surge into his head, but he bit his tongue hard and took the opportunity to move close to Bone Map, pushing his right hand forward and sending out a millstone-sized red Fireball, smashing it at the cracked spot of the yellow shield.
"Boom"! A loud bang!
The huge red orb touched the shield and immediately exploded with immense force, and the fiery red flames engulfed Bone Map's figure.
The entire Snake Cave shook violently, with stones of all sizes falling like rain.
Yuan Ming immediately retreated backward the moment he released the Burning Explosion Skill, barely avoiding the storm triggered by the explosion.
Just then, a figure shot from the fiery red flames, darting towards the distance, it was Bone Map.
Half of his body was charred, and his chest and abdomen were even exposed to several stark white bones, clearly wounded by the Burning Explosion Skill, with his fleeing figure appearing somewhat staggering.
Yuan Ming threw away the Mid-grade Spirit Stone in his left hand, meanwhile, his right hand stretched out, and the Mountain Shaking Hammer appeared in his grasp, which he fiercely hurled at Bone Map.
With a piercing shrill whistle, the Mountain Shaking Hammer flashed and caught up with Bone Map.
Bone Map spewed a stream of black qi, forming a barrier behind him, but it was easily shattered by the Mountain Shaking Hammer. Although the hammer's speed was greatly reduced, it still struck Bone Map's back.
He was sent flying, crashing heavily against the mountain wall, spewing a large mouthful of fresh blood.
Before he could get up, the ground around him suddenly cracked, and those several Purple-Black Demon Vines surged out again, reaching towards him.For a smoother reading experience, visit MV&LEMPYR.
With heavy injuries and his magic artifacts and refining corpse trapped by Yuan Ming, Bone Map was powerless to resist and was easily bound by the demon vines.
"Hold your hand, let's talk! I am an elder of the Black Fire Sect, if you dare to harm me, the Black Fire Sect will never let you go..." Bone Map threatened with a fierce tone yet fear inwardly.
Yuan Ming's expressionless face squeezed a spell, and a dozen purple-black demon vines pierced into the bone map's body before it could finish speaking, instantly turning it into a dried corpse.
Since he had chosen to make a move, there was no turning back.
Once the bone map died, the two Green Steel Corpses, the Black Needle Magical Artifact, and the Nine-Ring Gold Saber stopped moving, the latter falling powerlessly to the ground.
Yuan Ming simultaneously activated several magical artifacts and released three soul crow soul collisions in succession. With his soul power greatly damaged and his mana nearly exhausted, he was only supported by sheer will. Seeing his formidable enemy fall, he finally could not hold on any longer and sat down on the ground, taking deep breaths after deactivating the Fur Cloak Skill.
The situation had just been a matter of life and death. If he could not eliminate his opponent in one go, once the enemy recovered, he would surely be no match. At this moment, the unpredictable divine abilities of a Soul Cultivator were truly demonstrated, creating an opportunity for the Burning Explosion Skill.
Outside, Sang Yan and the others were taking out Detoxification Elixirs to consume, trying to neutralize the intense poison in their bodies; hearing the bone map's dying scream, shock appeared on their faces.
Although it was just a brief glimpse earlier, all four had seen that Yuan Ming was merely a Qi Refining Late Stage cultivator; how could he possibly have killed the bone map? Could it be that Bai Ye and Huan Shi were not injured?
Without a word, Sang Yan turned around and dashed out of the snake cave.
Seeing this, the other three hurriedly followed.
"Uproot to eliminate, leave none behind!" Yuan Ming called out without turning back, his voice resolute.
The dozen purple-black demon vines immediately retracted into the ground, and the Black Toad transformed into a yellow shadow, sneaking towards the outside.
Screams of terror quickly came from the outside, and soon after, it returned to silence.
The Shuiyun Banner quickly shrunk into a small blue banner, flying back into Yuan Ming's hand, revealing the situation ahead.
The bodies of three young women in black lay not far in front of the Shuiyun Banner, already turned into mummies, while Sang Yan had managed to flee several tens of feet away, nevertheless suffering the same fate of being turned into a dried corpse.
The purple-black demon vines slowly withdrew into the ground, shaking excitedly.
Deep underground, the Black Toad belched contentedly, its aura seemingly strengthened slightly.
Bai Ye nearby stared blankly at everything that had happened before him, taking a long time to come back to his senses.
He had pinned all his hopes on Yuan Ming as a last resort, merely wishing Yuan Ming had some means like the Earth Travel Talisman to temporarily evade a calamity for him and Huan Shi; he never imagined Yuan Ming would kill a Foundation Establishment Expert and four cultivators of the same stage.
Yuan Ming ignored everything else, took out several recovery elixirs, swallowed them, and held a spirit stone in each hand, starting to cultivate and control his breathing. His depleted mana finally started to recover a bit.
He then stood up, collected the bone map's Black Needle and Nine-Ring Gold Saber, then approached the bone map's corpse.
Yuan Ming first picked up the nearby Mountain Shaking Hammer, then inspected the bone map's body, finding a black small bag, a green-colored ring, and the yellow Round Bead Magical Artifact.
He opened the black small bag, and a rich Yin Qi seeped out from it.
With a shift in his gaze, Yuan Ming, having experienced the Black Rock City Market, naturally recognized that this was a Corpse Nourishing Bag.
The Corpse Nourishing Bag is a magical artifact that every disciple of the Black Fire Sect typically has, similar to the Spiritual Beast Bag of Biluo Cave, but used for storing refined corpses or ghosts, providing them with a suitable environment so they don't degrade due to insufficient Yin Qi.
After some attempts, Yuan Ming successfully stored the two Green Steel Corpses in the Corpse Nourishing Bag, planning to deal with them later.
As for the green ring, it was a storage magic tool; he didn't have time to look closely at this moment and simply stored it away, then picked up the yellow Round Bead.
The Round Bead Magical Artifact had two cracks on its surface, obviously heavily damaged from his barrage of talismans and the Burning Explosion Skill, with most of its spiritual power dissipated.
Yuan Ming felt disappointed. The defensive power of this Round Bead Magical Artifact was quite extraordinary, not beneath that of the Gold-plated Gauze, but it was a pity it had cracked; he wondered if it could still be repaired?
After collecting the items, he cast the Burning Explosion Skill, and a fireball turned the bone map's corpse into ashes.
Bai Ye watched Yuan Ming handling the bodies proficiently, an involuntary chill running through his heart, silently recovering his mana.
Yuan Ming then walked over to the bodies of the three young women in black, and the Black Toad brought over Sang Yan's body as well; the four bodies were lined up together.
Yuan Ming collected the four people's magical artifacts, storage magical tools, and the Corpse Nourishing Bag, then again released a flame, enveloping the bodies.
The bodies quickly turned to ashes, and he was about to turn and leave when he suddenly stopped in his tracks.
Among the ashes of Sang Yan's body, a surviving item remained.
Yuan Ming picked it up, feeling surprised. It was a White Jade Belt embedded with three green gemstones.
He had noticed this belt before and saw no mana fluctuations on it, thinking it was just an ordinary item, and paid no heed. Unexpectedly, this belt was capable of resisting the Spiritual Fire of the Burning Explosion Skill.
Yuan Ming activated his Divine Sense to examine it closely and soon made a discovery. Of the three green gemstones on the belt, one exhibited a faint trace of spiritual power. If not for his strong Divine Sense, he might not have noticed it.
As for the other two gemstones, they were devoid of any aura, each with a crack inside, seeming to have been damaged.
After a moment of contemplation, he fastened the belt around his waist and channeled his mana into the gemstone containing spiritual power.
The green gemstone lit up with a hint of light, and a rune slowly emerged. Yuan Ming's body suddenly became extremely light, as if a gust of wind could blow him away.
This effect was similar to the Wind Swift Skill but much stronger.
Yuan Ming took a step forward, his figure instantly blurring, moving three yards away in a flash, and then retreating back to his original position.
His face lit up with great joy, no wonder Sang Yan's travel speed was so fast earlier, the soul crows couldn't catch up, and even after being poisoned, he could run so far, all because of this belt! Indeed, it was an excellent magical artifact for travel and combat.

chapters.title: Chapter 195 - 175: Accidental Discovery
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming moved around in the passageway, familiarizing himself with the abilities of the white belt.
He cast the Wind Swift Skill, and the lightness effect of the skill could be stacked with the belt's power. Coupled with the enhancement of the Shadowless Step, his movement technique escalated to an astonishing level, nearly imperceptible to the naked eye. He could cover a distance of six or seven zhang in a flash, ghost-like.
If he used the Shadowless Step at full strength, faint illusions would follow in his wake, akin to some illusion-based spells.
Yuan Ming was secretly pleased. With such speed combined with the White Ape Transformation, he would have a significant advantage in the future, whether it was for preserving his life or facing opponents in combat.
