"That's really impressive!" Yuan Ming chuckled awkwardly, offering praise.
"Of course, this is not something ordinary cultivation techniques can compare with," the silver cat said proudly.This part of the collection on *.
"When can I cultivate to this realm?" Yuan Ming asked.
"What I taught you is just the introductory chapter of the Moonlight Technique. Even if you complete all three layers, you can only cultivate to the late stage of the Qi Refining realm as a Soul Cultivator. However, even so, a Foundation Establishment Cultivator might not be able to withstand the techniques of a Qi Refining Stage Soul Cultivator. It's just that ordinary Soul Cultivators are prone to backlash. Moreover, this is not the limit of those three layers of the technique; it's your own limit," Xi Ying explained.
"What do you mean?" Yuan Ming genuinely didn't understand.
"After you complete the three introductory layers of the Moonlight Technique, when you advance to the Foundation Establishment Stage, you don't need to continue cultivating; your Soul Cultivation Realm will also break through to the Foundation Establishment Stage, and your Soul Power will leap forward once," the silver cat explained.
"I see," Yuan Ming realized.
Having said that, he then added, "I've recently hit a bottleneck in cultivating the Moonlight Technique, always unable to complete the cultivation of the three layers, but I don't know why."
"The introductory chapter of the Moonlight Technique is no different from the Magic Cultivation Technique of the Qi Refinement Stage. Ultimately, they both lay the foundation for future cultivation, which is essentially the accumulation of Soul Power. I see that your cultivation has slowed down recently, it's not that you have neglected your cultivation, but that you have expended too much Soul Power," the silver cat assessed him and continued promptly.
Yuan Ming fell silent at these words.
He had paused his cultivation of the Moonlight Technique after noticing the slowdown, having not slackened before that.
Does that mean that he might have overexerted his Soul Power?
The tactics of Soul Cultivators are inscrutable and unpredictable, especially the soul collision, a Divine Skill that can unexpectedly wound an enemy's soul; although each use also significantly drains his own Soul Power, he did not use it often—only in dire situations, and along with the aid of an incense burner to nourish his Divine Soul. Could it be that his Soul Power was not overly exhausted?
However, the silver cat no longer engaged with him, having already turned to walk back.
Yuan Ming followed for a few steps, then suddenly paused, as another thought crossed his mind. His Soul Power depletion might also have something to do with his use of incense possession.
Coupling this with past recollections, the timeline of his slowdown in the Moonlight Technique cultivation correlated closely with when he began experimenting frequently with incense.
If anything had influenced his Soul Power, it was most likely this.
At this thought, Yuan Ming became rather conflicted. Cultivating the Moonlight Technique was crucial for him, but discovering the original Black Incense was an urgent goal as well—how should he choose?
But when he remembered the upcoming "White Deer Hill Alliance," Yuan Ming figured it out: he need to advance significantly in his cultivation of the Moonlight Technique as a priority.
He would still test incense, but he couldn't do it as frequently as before.
"Xi Ying, when will you teach me the further techniques of the Moonlight Technique?" Yuan Ming suddenly asked.
"When did I say I was going to teach you the advanced techniques?" Xi Ying stopped in her tracks, turning to look at him.
"Hey, why give up halfway?" Yuan Ming asked half-jokingly.
"After you reach Foundation Establishment, depends on my mood," Xi Ying responded somberly.
"Since we're on the topic, I wanted to ask you something. Apart from the Foundation Establishment Pill, is there any other way to enhance the success rate? After all, I only have the lowest Four Spirit Roots talent," Yuan Ming inquired.
Suddenly raising her voice, Xi Ying said, "Who says Four Spirit Roots are bad? I have Five Spirit Roots!"
"Five Spirit Roots?" Yuan Ming was startled; he had never heard of a cultivator with Five Spirit Roots.
"These sects have shallow insights, only knowing that fewer Spirit Roots cultivates faster, and picking disciples among those with lesser Spirit Roots. They even call the Single Spirit Root the Heavenly Spirit Root, pah! Remember, the more Spirit Roots you have, the higher your upper limit in the future! If you reach the Nascent Soul and beyond, you'll understand the benefits of having multiple Spirit Roots," Xi Ying declared.
"Then my Four Spirit Roots talent is not bad," Yuan Ming felt as if he had opened a new door and quickly followed up.
"Don't get too excited; even after Foundation Establishment with your Four Spirit Roots, your cultivation will always be difficult, and Core Formation is still far off," Xi Ying threw cold water on his hopes, bringing Yuan Ming back to reality.
"It really is a long and arduous journey!" Yuan Ming sighed.
"Just focus on cultivating that technique up to the thirteen layers first; when combined with a Foundation Establishment Pill, it can increase a lot of possibilities. After all, the technique you're cultivating is not simple, looking around this North Territory, apart from some major families and Sect Direct Disciples, I fear there aren't many who can surpass your cultivation speed," Xi Ying commented with a sneer.

chapters.title: Chapter 202 - 182: Preparation
chapters.content:
Several days had passed.
Xi Ying had already left, and Yuan Ming had been cultivating during these days but eventually stopped.
In recent days, it was not only the cultivation of the "Moonlight Technique" that had slowed down, but also the cultivation of the "Nine Elements Technique" had slowed down considerably.
Without the aid of Nourishing Origin Pills and the effectiveness of Qingxuan Incense, the sudden slowdown in pace was indeed unaccustomed for Yuan Ming, so he decided to make another trip to the workshop.
Several days later.
Inside an elegant private room within a tavern in Black Rock City.
Yuan Ming sat at the main seat of the Eight Immortals Table, all smiles.
Sitting opposite him was a good-natured, short and plump young man, it was Gu Yue.
"Brother Yuan, it has been almost three months since we last met, I have missed you greatly," Gu Yue, with a thick smile, lifted a white porcelain wine jug to pour wine for Yuan Ming as he spoke.
"I too missed Brother Gu's elegance, hence my visit again," Yuan Ming took the wine cup, also responding with a warm smile.
"It's my honor to have Brother Yuan visit, there's no disturbance to speak of. Speaking of which, last time it was thanks to you that I was fortunate enough to sit in the fourth floor private room of Longevity Immortal Tower. Here's to you!" Gu Yue said, as he toasted Yuan Ming.
"Speaking of the Longevity Immortal Tower, have there been any developments from the City Lord Mansion regarding the matter of the Young Master of White Dragon Island?" Yuan Ming casually asked.
"What developments could there be! Although the people from the City Lord Mansion have vast divine skills, what can they do against someone even more powerful? However, I did hear that later someone saw that lady in white and the colorful-clad clown near the city gate again, but before people from the City Lord Mansion could arrive, the lady waved her hand to set up a formation, and disappeared with the clown," Gu Yue dismissed with a wave of his hand.
"Brother Gu's information is indeed well-connected. Let's now talk about the real matter, as I have a favor to ask of you," Yuan Ming said with a smile.
"If Brother Yuan is so polite, it actually makes me feel uneasy. May I know how can I be of help?" Gu Yue replied with pleasantries before seriously asking.
"I have some magical artifacts that I need to sell, but I am not as familiar with the market as you are, so I would like to entrust you with selling them on my behalf," Yuan Ming explained with a smile.
Hearing this, Gu Yue laughed, "I thought it was something serious. Given Brother Yuan's trust, it is my duty to help."
"Brother Gu is straightforward," Yuan Ming toasted.
"Whatever good items Brother Yuan has, bring them all out for a look, I'll first help you estimate a price. If you think it's acceptable, I will help you sell them. If I overestimate, please forgive me," Gu Yue said after drinking a cup and then began speaking.
Chapter source: My Virtual Library Empire (*).
"Thank you for the trouble, Brother Gu," Yuan Ming replied with a smile.
Having said that, he swept his palm across the table, and one magical artifact after another immediately appeared on the table.
Included among them were a blue feather fan, a green round bead, a red round mirror, a red sharp cone, a triangular iron flag... totaling eleven items.
Seeing so many items suddenly appear on the table, even Gu Yue, who was normally unflappable, was slightly taken aback.
"I underestimated Brother Yuan before, to have so many magical artifacts in stock," he couldn't help but admire.
"They are all low-grade magical artifacts, making Brother Gu laugh," Yuan Ming said.
Gu Yue picked up each item to inspect; he found that the blue feather fan was a Water Attribute Magical Artifact, the green round bead was a Gold Attribute Magical Artifact, the red sharp cone was a Fire Attribute Magical Artifact, and the attributes of the other various artifacts were each different as well.
He was momentarily dazzled as he examined them.
After he put down the last circular artifact, he looked at Yuan Ming and said, "I have examined these magical artifacts, and although they are all low-grade, each has different appearances and fluctuations of spiritual power, so their prices will vary accordingly."
Yuan Ming nodded, understanding.
"Among these, the blue feather fan, the green round bead, the Red Seal Mirror, and this red sharp cone are the best, and can be sold for up to sixty Spirit Stones. As for the others, except for this iron flag used for setting up an array foundation and this circular artifact that can sell for fifty Spirit Stones, the rest, such as this yellow round bead which is damaged, can only be sold for the lowest price of forty Spirit Stones," Gu Yue continued.
Although Yuan Ming's judgment was not as sharp or experienced as Gu Yue's, he could see that Gu Yue's quoted prices were somewhat inflated.
"Brother Gu, friendship is friendship, but business is business, you can't suffer a loss," Yuan Ming spoke.
"Brother Yuan, if you say that, you are questioning my professionalism. Haha... rest assured, neither of us will lose out on this deal," Gu Yue laughed heartily.
Hearing this, Yuan Ming nodded with a smile:
"I naturally have faith in your professionalism, and since you say so, I will not be pretentious. There are some more items here too that need Brother Gu's help," Yuan Ming said.
"Oh, Brother Yuan has more good items?" Gu Yue's eyes brightened as he rubbed his hands together in anticipation.
Yuan Ming didn't speak further, but instead reached into his bosom and pulled out ten storage bags, stacking them in front of Gu Yue.
The storage bags he had collected previously, except for one gifted by the Three Cave Masters, were all here.
Gu Yue only took a glance, and his eyes immediately widened.
His shock was not so much about the value of the storage bags, but about the storage bags themselves.
Or rather, it was about the fact that Yuan Ming could take out ten storage bags all at once.
Ordinary people, even if extravagant, would not carry so many storage bags because truly wealthy individuals would upgrade to using storage rings or storage bracelets, more high-end storage magic tools.
Being able to take out so many storage bags at once could only mean that these storage bags did not belong to one person.
"Yuan... Brother Yuan, are you truly a cultivator from the genealogy of Biluo Cave, and not some wilderness loose cultivator?" Gu Yue's throat turned somewhat dry as he spoke.
In the past, he had encountered some loose cultivators who, after killing and looting others, came to sell others' storage bags, but coming across someone like Yuan Ming who brought a pile of them was indeed a first in his life.
In an instant, he found Yuan Ming all the more inscrutable.
"Brother Gu, there's no need for that. These storage bags are all ones I picked up by luck while on missions," Yuan Ming knew what Gu Yue was thinking and also knew explanations were futile, so he casually remarked.
Upon hearing this, whether Gu Yue believed it or not, he indeed stopped asking further questions and just said,
"Brother Yuan, with these items... I may need to make a trip to the Ghost Market to handle them without leaving any troubles behind, otherwise, they might bring trouble for both you and me."
"Proceed as you see fit, I will bear all the costs and losses involved, and additionally give you ten percent as compensation for your troubles," Yuan Ming, being well-versed in dealings, proposed.
The very reason he had approached Gu Yue to handle this matter was to hide his identity without leaving any trace behind.
"There's no need for compensation, Brother Yuan, just rest assured, I will definitely handle this matter cleanly and beautifully," Gu Yue waved his hand and replied.
"Then I'll be in your debt," Yuan Ming clasped his hands in gratitude.
Afterward, Gu Yue helped him calculate the total, the price for all magic artifacts added up to six hundred and twenty spirit stones, and the storage bags were even easier to calculate, fifty spirit stones each, totaling five hundred spirit stones.
If Yuan Ming sold everything, he would gain one thousand one hundred twenty spirit stones, deducting the ten percent payment for Gu Yue, he would still have one thousand and eight spirit stones left, a quite bountiful harvest indeed.
"Brother Gu, how long do you think it will take to sell these items?" Yuan Ming asked.
"At most three days... perhaps, they could all be sold in less than two days," Gu Yue hesitated slightly, then gave a deadline.
"Good, then I will wait here for you for two days, and return once the matter is settled," Yuan Ming smiled as he spoke.
"Although Brother Yuan, you trust me to handle so many treasures, we have our own rules in this line of business. Here is my entry pass for operating in Black Rock City; you'd better keep it," Gu Yue said as he took out a scroll tied with a red string and handed it over.
Yuan Ming didn't refuse and took the scroll, storing it without even looking at it, feeling even more satisfied with Gu Yue's way of handling things.
Actually, he didn't need it, as he could track Gu Yue's movements using a soul crow, but the fact that the other party wanted to handle things so openly saved him a lot of trouble.
The hosts and guest parted amicably, going their separate ways.
After parting with Gu Yue, Yuan Ming headed straight for Longevity Immortal Tower.
He had just entered the building when a yellow figure immediately came up to meet him.
"Young Master Yuan, just a few days unseen, and your aura is even more profound, your manner even more majestic, truly awe-inspiring," a slightly plump lady approached with an enchanting voice, it was Zhuo Lingling, the deacon of Longevity Immortal Tower.
"Fellow Daoist Zhuo seems to have become even more charming too," Yuan Ming teased with a smile.
"If others said that, I might not believe them, but coming from Young Master Yuan, I must take it seriously," Zhuo Lingling covered her mouth and lightly chuckled, leading Yuan Ming to a private room in the inner hall.
After the maid served fine tea, Zhuo Lingling then began, "Young Master Yuan, what rare spiritual materials would you like to purchase during this visit?"
"I'm not buying spiritual materials this time, I need some elixirs that aid in cultivation," Yuan Ming got straight to the point.
"I remember last time the Young Master bought Nourishing Origin Pills, were you satisfied with their effects? Do you need more?" Zhuo Lingling's face blossomed with a smile as she inquired.
"Is there perhaps a better elixir available?" Yuan Ming pondered a moment before asking.
During his previous cultivation, just like with Qingxuan Incense, Nourishing Origin Pills led to diminishing returns in the latter stages and could no longer satisfy Yuan Ming's current cultivation needs.
"Among the elixirs suitable for the Qi Refinement Realm, Nourishing Origin Pills indeed rank low-grade. It seems they no longer match the pace of Young Master's cultivation. Our Longevity Immortal Tower indeed has better elixirs, ranked as mid-grade level for the Qi Refinement Realm, called 'Golden Flower Pills,' which are three times as effective as Nourishing Origin Pills, but... the price is five times that," Zhuo Lingling finished and carefully watched Yuan Ming's facial expression change.
Upon hearing the price, however, Yuan Ming's expression did not change.
But actually, he was secretly grumbling inside; Nourishing Origin Pills were priced at fifteen spirit stones a bottle, whereas these Golden Flower Pills directly demanded seventy-five spirit stones, a difference not to be ignored.
"The potency only increases threefold, but the price jumps so much, how is that reasonable?" Yuan Ming asked with an expressionless face.

chapters.title: Chapter 203 - 183 Dawn
chapters.content:
Seeing Yuan Ming hesitate, Zhuo Lingling thought the price was too high, which made Yuan Ming consider giving up on the purchase. She was reluctant to miss out on this deal, so after pondering for a moment, she smiled again and said,
"Young Master Yuan, may I ask how many Golden Flower Pills you intend to buy?"
"Fifteen bottles," Yuan Ming replied.
When Zhuo Lingling heard "fifteen bottles," her breath quickened slightly. In her heart, she couldn't help but exclaim that this Yuan Ming from the Central Plains was indeed her noble benefactor!
From the last transaction alone, she had already earned a considerable commission. Seeing another large purchase in prospect, how could she just watch it slip through her fingers?
"Young Master Yuan, our Longevity Immortal Tower highly values esteemed customers like yourself and is always eager to offer special treatment. On behalf of our Longevity Immortal Tower, I present you with a Longevity Token. With this Token, you will enjoy premium services at any Longevity Immortal Tower shop, including priority purchasing rights for all goods on sale. Additionally, you may use it to participate in private auctions held exclusively for our special clients," Zhuo Lingling said quickly, lowering her voice towards the end, imparting a sense of mystery.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming's attention returned from his own thoughts.
"If that's the case, then my trust in your establishment hasn't been misplaced," Yuan Ming said in an even tone.
Zhuo Lingling was overjoyed upon hearing this, and she quickly produced a white jade Token and offered it with both hands.
Yuan Ming took the Token and examined it. One side bore a relief carving of a quaint Taoist temple, while the other was engraved with the words "Longevity Token." The material wasn't particularly special, but it was exquisite enough.
Afterward, he paid for the "Golden Flower Pills" and left the Longevity Immortal Tower with Zhuo Lingling seeing him off.
Having bought the elixirs, he had only three hundred spirit stones remaining. It was not a lot to say the least, but wasn't too little either. Yuan Ming decided to wander the city to see if he could find any interesting items.
Most importantly, he hoped to find another Magic Artifact, similar to the Gold-plated Gauze, for Xi Ying.
Walking through the markets of the east and west, he noticed little change in the shops, but the stands of smaller merchants were constantly changing. The Immortal Xuanhua, who sold Qingxuan Incense before, was no longer in his usual spot and had likely wandered off to an unknown location.
He roamed until dusk, the sky gradually darkening, and Yuan Ming had yet to find anything he wanted to purchase.
Suddenly feeling peckish, Yuan Ming went to the "Mountain Treasure Building" in the southern part of the city, a place well-known for its reputation.
This was the most famous restaurant in all of Black Rock City, mainly because its ingredients were various spiritual medicines, materials, and rare beasts from the mountains, which, when specially prepared by the chefs, often had some beneficial effects for cultivators.
But what truly set it apart was the taste. Of course, for actual cultivation benefits, consuming elixirs was far more reliable.
As soon as he entered the restaurant, a waiter greeted him and led Yuan Ming to the second floor, heading for a private room.
But just as Yuan Ming started up the stairs, he came face to face with a dignified yet kind-looking middle-aged man.
"Fellow Daoist Huan Shi," Yuan Ming exclaimed in surprise.
The man on the other side was equally astonished upon seeing Yuan Ming and said, "Fellow Daoist Hagon?"
Huan Shi recognized Yuan Ming at a glance.
"Do the two of you know each other?" the waiter hesitated.
"Go bring up that jar of 'Hundred-mile Drunk' I have stored here, and don't worry about anything else," Huan Shi instructed the waiter before leading Yuan Ming back to his private room.
Inside the room was another person—Bai Ye.
Different from the commanding presence of their initial meeting, Bai Ye now had a furrowed brow and an evident look of concern.
Seeing Huan Shi return with Yuan Ming, he also showed a look of surprise.
After exchanging pleasantries, and once the waiter had delivered the wine and the table was laid with dishes, Huan Shi stood up, closed the door, took out a "Soundproof Talisman," and affixed it to the door.
Once the talisman lit up, a faint white glow enveloped the entire room.
"Fellow Daoist Hagon, have you come to Black Rock City today to take on another mission?" Huan Shi asked while urging Yuan Ming to enjoy the food and initiating the conversation.
"I'm just here to buy some elixirs," Yuan Ming shook his head and smiled.
At this, Bai Ye and Huan Shi exchanged glances and, observing the change in Yuan Ming's aura, they both appeared astonished.
Huan Shi looked conflicted and said, "Fellow Daoist Hagon, it has been less than three months since we last parted, but your cultivation seems to have undergone such a remarkable change. How is this possible?"
Yuan Ming was taken aback, as they were not especially close, and under normal circumstances, such a direct inquiry would be inappropriate.
But after a moment's thought, he understood.
Huan Shi and Bai Ye assumed that Yuan Ming had intentionally concealed his true cultivation level during their mission in the Snake King Valley and that what had been revealed today was his actual level.
"You two needn't speculate wildly. After the battle in the Snake King Valley, both my combat experience and insights into cultivation improved greatly. I went into seclusion immediately afterward, which is why I've made such rapid progress," Yuan Ming explained.
Hearing this, they both felt that if Yuan Ming really did possess the ability to conceal his cultivation, he would not have refrained from using it this time.
"With such a rate of cultivation, Fellow Daoist Hagon truly has exceptional talents, and we are ashamed that we cannot compare," Huan Shi couldn't help but exclaim with emotion.
"Fellow Daoist Hagon, do you remember the proposal we made last time?" Bai Ye asked.
"What proposal?" Yuan Ming really did not remember.
"We invited you to join our White Night Scatter Alliance and become our second Vice Alliance Hierarch," Bai Ye said.
Huan Shi, upon hearing this, seemed somewhat surprised and glanced at Bai Ye.
Yuan Ming thought to himself that while he had indeed been invited to join, when had there ever been talk of him becoming the Vice Alliance Hierarch?
"The Alliance Hierarch's kind intentions are sincerely appreciated by me. However, you must also have realized that I have a sect heritage and therefore cannot join your Scatter Alliance," Yuan Ming expressed with a hint of regret.
"If that's the case... it is truly a pity," Bai Ye sighed.
"How is the White Night Scatter Alliance faring now?" Yuan Ming inquired, seeing Bai Ye bring up the subject.
Both Bai Ye and Huan Shi had complex expressions on their faces, but neither began to speak first.
"Both Alliance Hierarchs are Foundation Establishment Cultivators and conduct business with fairness and integrity. With such practices, you really shouldn't worry about your future prospects," Yuan Ming said reassuringly.
"During the last battle in Snake King Valley, the White Night Scatter Alliance brought its core members, but suffered heavy losses, and many of them fell there. Now, the remaining members are seriously lacking in combat power, and indeed, the situation is quite dire," Huan Shi lamented.
"Had Fellow Daoist Hagon not been willing to exchange the Snake Pearl, we would have found it difficult to fulfill the task for White Dragon Island. If the task had failed, all the reputation we've previously built would have been lost," Bai Ye added.
"Still, the Young Master of their side personally came, and the result..." Huan Shi trailed off without finishing his sentence.
What he omitted was naturally the matter of the White Dragon Island Young Master being killed.
Bai Ye, unbothered by taboos, said, "Because the Young Master was killed, White Dragon Island also felt very cautious about the task. Even though we completed it and received the due reward, we have still made enemies with White Dragon Island."
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming finally understood just how difficult the situation was for the White Night Scatter Alliance.
Their own losses were substantial, their alliance was lacking in talented individuals, and they had offended a client, which to a certain extent meant their reputation was damaged—it was a significant case of loss outweighing the gain.
No wonder they were willing to offer Yuan Ming, a Qi Refinement Realm cultivator, the position of Vice Alliance Hierarch as a way to win him over.
"Let's not talk about these troubles anymore. Today, my brother and I just wanted to drink to drown our sorrows and temporarily set aside these bothersome matters," Huan Shi said with a carefree smile, opening the jar of "Hundred-day Drunk" and pouring a cup for Yuan Ming.This content is presented by *.
The intoxicating fragrance immediately filled the air, making even Yuan Ming's eyes light up.
"This wine is rich in fragrance and has a deep, mellow flavor; it truly is a rare and fine liquor," Yuan Ming said admiringly after taking a small sip.
"Haha, Fellow Daoist Hagon has good taste. This is a fine wine aged over a hundred years. The Mountain Treasure Building has a limited stock and it's not normally for sale," Huan Shi chuckled.
"Then I must savor it properly," Yuan Ming quickly took another large gulp.
The three of them clinked glasses and drank, the mood becoming merrier.
"Big brother, I think we shouldn't bother resisting anymore. Since Dawn has shown an interest in recruiting us, why don't we just go? The compensation they're offering is quite generous too; it's not a bad deal," Huan Shi began to loosen up and speak plainly.
"Dawn only wants the strong, and the only clear invitations have been to you and me. Among our subordinates are those at the Qi Refinement Realm, and they most likely won't want them," Bai Ye was still rational and shook his head.
"Let's negotiate, everything can be discussed. What's wrong with the Qi Refinement Realm, after all? Not to speak of others, I certainly don't dare underestimate him. While Dawn has high standards, this time they are clearly looking to expand on a large scale, and I think it's an opportunity," Huan Shi spread his hands and said.
Upon hearing this, Bai Ye fell into deep thought.
"Dawn is...?" Yuan Ming hesitated to ask.
"It's another Scatter Alliance organization, only much stronger than our White Night. They've always been mysterious, their strength unfathomable, and to date, they've never failed a single task they've taken on," Huan Shi explained.
Yuan Ming nodded thoughtfully upon hearing this.
"The key is that no one understands this organization, not even the number and composition of its members. Only through rumors can it be known that they have a very distinct style of doing things, different from other organizations," Bai Ye also said.
"Oh? How distinct?" Yuan Ming asked, curious.
"Apparently, they also accept tasks of hunting down vicious Late-stage Foundation Establishment Cultivators, helping people find missing relatives, and they even dealt with a horrifying extermination case in the central part of the Southern Border... In short, no one can fathom the pattern by which they choose their tasks," Huan Shi responded.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming's mind, like Bai Ye's and the others, reached a consensus: "Dawn is an organization that is mysterious, powerful, with a unique way of doing things, and it's difficult to discern whether they are righteous or evil."

chapters.title: Chapter 204 - 184: The Full Force Strike of a Peak Foundation Establishment Cultivator
chapters.content:
"They've been expanding on a large scale recently. Could it be that they've accepted some major task?" Yuan Ming pondered before asking again.
"It's said that they are going on a treasure hunt in the Southern Border, Southern Domain," Bai Ye replied.
"The Southern Border, Southern Domain isn't like the North Territory. Some Sects there even have Nascent Soul Stage powerhouses in residence, full of hidden dragons and crouching tigers. If we happen to violate these Sects' taboos, we could end up dead. This is one of the reasons we hesitate to join them," Huan Shi slowly said.
Yuan Ming nodded thoughtfully, gaining a deeper understanding of the Southern Border's Cultivation World.
If Bai Ye and the others truly joined the Dawn Organization, their situation would be the same as those members temporarily recruited for the Snake King Valley mission—these hastily joined members could very well be cannon fodder. Furthermore, being in the Southern Domain added to the danger.
Whether Dawn was as generous as Bai Ye remained unknown.
And not everyone could carve a path out of being cannon fodder like Yuan Ming could.
Yuan Ming couldn't offer advice, after all, lives were their own to live, and they needed to be responsible for their choices.
By the time the three of them finished the banquet, it was nearly midnight.
With Huan Shi's help, Yuan Ming managed to purchase several jars of "Hundred-day Drunk" from the Mountain Treasure Building, planning to bring them back for Fisherman to try.
After parting ways, Yuan Ming estimated the opening time of the Ghost Market and rushed over.
By the time he arrived, the market had already been open for a while.
Yuan Ming donned his cloak, gave the secret passphrase, and entered.
Stepping into the Ghost Market again, he found the scene similar to his last visit, with both vendors and visitors far less numerous than in the workshop.
The square was sparsely populated, with few people in sight.
He wandered slowly among the stalls, scouting around to see if there were any appealing treasures.
However, after a long look, he came up empty-handed.
Just when he felt his interest waning, he suddenly spotted a familiar face.
At the edge of the square, in a dim and secluded corner, there was a stall where a one-armed old man, wearing a fox mask, sat in a dilapidated bamboo chair, pretending to doze off.
Feeling someone approaching, the one-armed old man immediately opened his eyes.
"Fellow Daoist," Yuan Ming said in a lowered voice.
"Oh, it's you. What, have you got another Beast Egg Strange Insect to sell?" Even though Yuan Ming's voice was low, the old man recognized him.
After speaking, however, he hesitated and asked, "You do have something to sell this time, right?"
"I've come to you not to sell Beast Egg Strange Insects," Yuan Ming said.
"Not selling... then you're buying? I've got some new items. Do you see anything that catches your eye?" the one-armed old man inquired tentatively upon hearing this.
"No, I'm not buying either. It's just that the Gold-plated Gauze I bought from you before is damaged, and I wondered if there's a way to repair it or if you know how?" Yuan Ming clarified his purpose.
"What a joke, that's a Mid-grade Magical Artifact, and you've broken it already? Young man, don't be too rash," the one-armed old man frowned and admonished.
"One has to do what one must when navigating the martial arts world!" Yuan Ming nodded in agreement and responded.
The one-armed old man fell silent for a moment, throwing Yuan Ming a look that said "Sure, keep dreaming."
After a while, he spread his hands and said bluntly, "I'm not an Artifact Refiner, and I got that Gold-plated Gauze from somewhere else. I'm sorry, but I can't help you with that."
Yuan Ming, upon hearing this, didn't feel too disappointed as it was within his expectations; he was just trying his luck with a slim hope.
Having received his answer, Yuan Ming thanked him and turned to leave.
"Wait, Fellow Daoist, I have something to ask," the one-armed old man suddenly called out.
"What is it?" Yuan Ming turned to ask.
"With the luck you carry, you seem destined for great things. Should you come across any strange beast, come and find me," the one-armed old man said.
"Alright," Yuan Ming casually agreed, then turned to walk away.
"Hold on, Fellow Daoist. Based on my experience, the strange insects from the Southern Border are all extraordinary. Would you be interested in a long-term partnership?" the one-armed old man offered.
"How would that partnership work?" Yuan Ming inquired.
"Whenever you have information on any rare birds or exotic beasts, you can contact me. Our Sect specializes in hatching and rearing rare birds and exotic beasts; it's the only one of its kind in Da Jin. As for the price, heh, our Sect Leader and deacons only buy the best regardless of the cost," the one-armed old man whispered.
"That sounds good, so how do we stay in contact?" Yuan Ming asked, thinking this could be a source of income, wondering how much they would offer for his own strange toad—not that he would ever sell it.
"This place is too secluded. In any slightly larger workshop, we have a Treasure Spirit Pavilion; just mention my name 'Gu Qiuming' to get in touch. I am leaving the Southern Border tomorrow to return to Da Jin, so you may send letters to contact me. Or if you ever come to Da Jin, you can look for me," the one-armed old man explained.
Hearing this, Yuan Ming replied, "That would be convenient. Please leave a way for me to find you, then."
"Good. Whether you're sending a letter or looking for someone, you can go to the Treasure Spirit Pavilion in Da Jin's Thunder City. Also, remember to mention my name during transactions, so I can earn some contribution points with the Sect," the one-armed old man added.
"Alright, I've made note of it," Yuan Ming said and prepared to leave.
At that moment, the one-armed elder suddenly spoke again: "Fellow Daoist, there's no need to rush."
"If you have something to say, please speak," Yuan Ming said, this time somewhat speechless.
"Since fate has brought us together, I also have a piece of fortune to pass on to you," the self-proclaimed Gu Qiuming, the one-armed elder, said with a smile, not minding at all.
"A gift?" Yuan Ming was puzzled.
"Take a look over there, on the backside of that stone pillar—is there not a man in black clothes?" Gu Qiuming gestured with his mouth as he spoke.
Yuan Ming furrowed his brows and looked over, only to see a thin man dressed in black. His entire body was wrapped in black clothes, and he was also wearing a black mask that concealed his face, glancing around nervously.
"Is he the fortune?" asked Yuan Ming.
"I've observed him here for several days; it's likely that he's short of money. I've checked out the things he's selling—they are good stuff, but unfortunately, he's asking too high a price and hasn't been able to make a sale," said Gu Qiuming.
"What is it?" Yuan Ming inquired.
"The Heart-splitting Bomb," replied Gu Qiuming.
Yuan Ming pondered for a moment and realized he had no recollection of such an item, then promptly asked, "What's so special about it?"
"It's a consumable magic artifact, created by compressing the power of Thunder into it through artifact refining. When used, it strikes like a hidden weapon, bursting forth with Thunder Power unexpectedly, catching one off guard—it's an exclusive artifact of the Five Thunder Sect in Zhao Country," explained Gu Qiuming.
"How is it different from a Thunder Strike Talisman?" Yuan Ming asked with a frown.
"Don't you understand what an exclusive artifact is? How powerful do you think a Thunder Strike Talisman is? The explosion from the Heart-splitting Bomb is comparable to the full-force strike of a peak Foundation Establishment cultivator. Even cultivators of the same rank who take it head-on will suffer greatly. How can it be compared to the mere Thunder Strike Talisman?" scoffed Gu Qiuming, looking at Yuan Ming with a hint of smugness.Keep us going by reading on *.
Yuan Ming was moved by these words.
"Thank you. However, I'm a bit curious. If Fellow Daoist Gu can discern its value, why not buy it yourself?" Yuan Ming asked with a frown.
"The item is good but unfortunately too expensive. Besides, I came to the Southern Border only to collect strange insects and exotic beasts; I have no urgent need for other items. I am a benevolent person and do not strive for such possessions," Gu Qiuming said with a smile.
After giving another respectful fist salute, Yuan Ming left and made his way toward the booth of the man in black.
Upon arrival, Yuan Ming couldn't help but laugh silently. In front of the man was a spread-out piece of black cloth, yet it was completely empty, devoid of anything at all.
"Fellow Daoist, do you have any goods to sell?" Yuan Ming asked.
The eyes of the man in black, visible beneath the mask, showed a hint of wariness. He looked around before speaking. "A top-grade magical tool, the Heart-splitting Bomb—are you interested?"
"May I take a look?" Yuan Ming inquired.
After a moment's hesitation, the man in black searched through his sleeve and pulled out a fist-sized sphere.
"You can look but don't touch," Yuan Ming was just about to reach for it, but then the man quickly pulled it back.
Yuan Ming could only laugh silently and sharpened his vision with condensed mana, observing closely.
Upon closer inspection, he saw that the sphere was greenish, seemingly made of bronze. Its surface had fine, dark-golden lines that formed intricate patterns, interconnected into an array.
Top-grade magical tools typically have three runes inscribed to synergize and enhance their quality. Yet, this bronze sphere seemed to have an entire miniaturized array on it, indeed appearing quite exquisite.
Yuan Ming took a mental note, already fairly certain that the item was genuine.
"Let's talk about the price," Yuan Ming said.
"1,500 Spirit Stones each, not a coin less," the man in black promptly replied.
"That's just nonsense; a normal top-grade magical tool might be worth 1,500 Spirit Stones, but this is a consumable. It's gone after one use," Yuan Ming immediately countered.
"The Heart-splitting Bomb is for saving your life, not for fun. Surely your life is worth at least 1,500 Spirit Stones," the man in black replied coldly.
"You're right; it can indeed save one's life at a critical time, but the price is ridiculously high. I fear it won't be easy to sell at such a rate," Yuan Ming said with a smile.
"If you don't want it, that's fine," the man in black said displeasedly.
"Could we possibly negotiate the price further? You have to pay each time you enter the Ghost Market, and I see you're eager for Spirit Stones. It would be best to sell quickly—selling sooner means earning sooner," Yuan Ming mentioned with a smirk.
The man in black considered these words, finding reason in them.
"I can tell you might be pressed for time as well. Although this is the Ghost Market, it's bustling with people. Perhaps word has already spread that an exclusive artifact from the Five Thunder Sect of Zhao Country is up for trade."
Before Yuan Ming could finish, he saw the man in black about to interject. Yuan Ming preempted him with a gesture and continued, "Don't rush to argue. It's better to offload such items sooner for peace of mind. Honestly, we've been talking quite a while now."
Upon hearing this, the man in black finally showed interest.
"How much are you willing to offer?"

chapters.title: Chapter 205 - 185: Searching for the Toad
chapters.content:
"One hundred spirit stones each," Yuan Ming said, holding up a finger.
"No way, at least a thousand spirit stones each, I only have four," the man in black shook his head resolutely.
"One hundred and ten spirit stones," Yuan Ming raised the offer.
"Fellow Daoist, your bargaining is really insincere," the man in black frowned.
"This kind of one-time thing, that's the price," Yuan Ming raised an eyebrow, questioning.
"Just eight hundred spirit stones. If you don't agree, then forget it," the man in black did not continue bantering and spoke directly.
"Two hundred spirit stones, don't be so quick to disagree. If the item were easy to sell, you wouldn't be unable to sell it for several days," Yuan Ming said.
"Are you going to buy it or not..." the man in black said indignantly.
"Of course I'll buy it. I think those who could use this item can't afford it with spirit stones, and most of those with spirit stones are strong enough not to need it. They would rather create a top-grade magical tool with their spirit stones. Isn't that right? Like that person over there." Yuan Ming waved his hand in the direction of a distant figure, greeting Gu Qiuming.
The latter cooperated by raising his only remaining arm in response.
Seeing this, the man in black's eyebrows twisted into a knot, and he was at an even greater loss for words.
"Fellow Daoist, the price I'm offering is a fair one," Yuan Ming said, patting the man in black on the shoulder with a look of earnestness.
"Fine, I haven't met someone as eloquent as you. A thousand spirit stones, and the three Heart-splitting Bombs are yours. But let's get one thing straight, no more haggling!" the man in black hesitated for a moment, slumped his shoulders, and said.
"Alright, wait here for a moment, I'll go get the money right away," Yuan Ming readily agreed.
"That won't do, you have to pay right now," the man in black immediately said.
"What are you so worried about? I'll leave a deposit of three hundred spirit stones here, and the Heart-splitting Bombs are still in your hands, isn't that reassuring enough?" Yuan Ming said while handing over three hundred spirit stones to the man in black.
"Really? Aren't you afraid I'll just take your spirit stones and run off?" the man in black quickly caught them, skeptical.
"No worries, I can afford to lose three hundred spirit stones. See, my sect brother is also selling stuff over there. If you have any rare exotic beasts you want to sell, just mention my name, Hagon," Yuan Ming said with a smile, then turned and left.The reference version of this on *.
The man in black glanced at the one-armed old man, looked at another vendor not too far away, and his peripheral vision caught two people leaning against a tree, suddenly feeling surrounded by Yuan Ming's people. With the sensitive nature of the item he was selling, he dared not harbor any other thoughts and could only wait there nervously.
What he didn't know was that in the darkness not too far away, a black soul crow was staring unblinkingly at him.
Yuan Ming hurried back and found Gu Yue, who had not yet had the chance to sell his items for him.
After a discussion, he helped Yuan Ming gather a thousand spirit stones, the price being that whatever money was made from selling those magic artifacts and storage bags in the future would belong to Gu Yue and had nothing to do with him anymore.
When he returned to the Ghost Market, Yuan Ming successfully bought the three Heart-splitting Bombs and almost spent all his savings at once.
Later, he spent the last hundred or so spirit stones he had left on some useful talismans, and then hurried back to the Ten Thousand Mountains to continue his seclusion.
About a month later.
After using the remaining Qingxuan Incense and with the help of the Golden Flower Pill, Yuan Ming finally broke through to the twelfth layer of Qi Refinement in one fell swoop.
By then, there were less than ten days left until the meeting on White Deer Hill.
Although he had a Foundation Establishment Pill and did not want to give up on the opportunity promised by his sect, he made many preparations. In his view, this so-called opportunity was likely just a Foundation Establishment Pill. If he were successful, he could have two Foundation Establishment Pills, which would greatly increase his chances of successful Foundation Establishment.
However, with many talents from various sects present at the time, he had to be fully prepared. It was also time to call back the Black Toad.
...
Yuan Ming hurried all the way to Snake King Valley.
The environment inside the valley was as before, with towering trees and miasma shrouding the area as if it had always been like this and would never change.
He sat cross-legged at the entrance where he had parted with the Black Toad, closed his eyes to sense its location, and his eyes suddenly darkened.
He couldn't sense the Beast Taming Rune inside the Black Toad!
With Yuan Ming's current understanding, there were only two possibilities for this phenomenon: either the Black Toad had been killed, causing the Beast Taming Rune to naturally dissipate, or the Black Toad had been confined by some kind of Array Restriction, severing the connection between him and the Beast Taming Rune.
Since the Black Toad had advanced to the Second Level and awakened several powerful abilities, it was his most important asset. If it had been killed, that would be a significant loss.
Thousand thoughts raced through Yuan Ming's mind, and he felt a sense of unease. He forced himself to calm down.
First, he needed to determine whether the Black Toad was alive or dead.
The Black Toad had previously been fond of that black Stone Pillar; it was likely to have gone there.
With this in mind, Yuan Ming swiftly headed towards the Snake King Cave.
Boosted by the White Jade Belt, he quickly arrived at the entrance of the Snake King Cave. Just as he was about to enter, he stopped abruptly and released three soul crows.
One flew into the Snake King Cave, another stood guard outside the entrance, and the third kept watch over the surrounding area.
After completing these preparations, Yuan Ming took out the Shuiyun Banner and held it in his hand as he entered the Snake King Cave, swiftly making his way to the deepest part of the cavern as if he were familiar with the route.
There, the towering black stone pillar that once stood had vanished, and a large, three-zhang-wide hole appeared in the ground, pitch-dark and bottomless. Nearby, the ground was littered with various-sized rocks and dirt, seemingly the aftermath of the black stone pillar being forcibly removed.
Yuan Ming had already discovered this situation through his soul crow, so he wasn't surprised. With a thought, he controlled the soul crow to fly into the black hole to investigate while he searched the rest of the cave.
With the strength of his Divine Power, he quickly made a discovery. Under a large rock, he found a piece of broken vine that was part of the Purple-Black Demon Vine, confirming that the Black Toad had indeed been there.
At this moment, the soul crow had reached the bottom of the dark hole. The hole extended straight down, reaching a depth of over thirty zhang, resembling a deep well.
The space at the bottom of the hole was much larger than above, yet completely empty, with a Green Stone passageway emerging from one side and stretching into the distance.
The floor and walls of the Green Stone passage were smooth, evidently man-made, and covered in dust.
Yuan Ming controlled the soul crow to scout around the underground area and, detecting no dangers, he conjured the Shuiyun Banner to protect his body and leaped into the large hole.
The Shuiyun Banner shot out two large hand-like blue water glows, grasping onto the hole's walls and greatly reducing his descent speed, allowing him to safely land.
After looking around the bottom of the hole for a while and finding no new pieces of vine, he turned his gaze toward the Green Stone passageway.
The soul crow had already flown into the passageway, advancing at least three hundred zhang without reaching the end.
With things having come this far, Yuan Ming did not back down. He conjured the Shuiyun Banner to protect his body, stepped into the passageway, and released his Divine Sense.
He hadn't walked far when he suddenly stopped, looking toward the right side of the passage wall. There, in a corner, was a thumb-sized dark spot that seemed to have been corroded by something.
This spot was inconspicuous, and if he hadn't expanded his Divine Sense, he would have never noticed it.
Yuan Ming drew closer to the dark spot and sniffed gently, his eyes suddenly lighting up.
The dark spot gave off a sour smell, unmistakably that of the Black Toad Poison Liquid; it seemed the Black Toad had passed through here, and was likely ahead.
He quickened his pace and soon vanished into the darkness.
The length of the Green Stone passageway far exceeded his expectations. Yuan Ming rushed forward for a full quarter of an hour and still saw no end in sight.
Luckily, there were no forks in this passage, so there was no fear of getting lost.
As he walked a bit further, Yuan Ming's brows suddenly rose in intrigue.
The soul crow that served as his scout finally reached the end of the Green Stone passageway, and an exit emanating white light appeared in front of it.
Yuan Ming instructed the soul crow to stop, and he himself quickened his steps, rapidly reaching the passage exit.
A look of astonishment suddenly crossed his face as he looked up into the space above his head.
After entering the Green Stone passage, Yuan Ming didn't forget to control the two soul crows on the surface; the one at the mouth of the Snake King Cave remained in place to monitor the situation at the entrance.
The other crow, sent out for scouting, he controlled to fly directly overhead, providing him a reference point to confirm his position.
The soul crow overhead had arrived at an unexpected location: the ancient castle that Bone Map and the others had previously visited.
It turned out that this passage led to the underground of the castle, suggesting some connection between the two.
Yuan Ming conjured the Shuiyun Banner to protect his entire body and stepped into the white exit.
His vision was filled with dazzling white light, then in the next moment, all light suddenly vanished, and he found himself inside a grey stone hall.
The stone hall was rectangular, about fifteen to sixteen zhang long and seven to eight zhang wide but only one to two zhang high, creating an extremely oppressive feeling.
On both sides of the hall stood four stone pillars, each large enough to be embraced by a person, carved with numerous human and beast figurines in relief.
These reliefs had a bizarre style; far from adding color to the stone hall, they made it appear even more sinister, resembling the underground palace of a tomb.
Yuan Ming paid no attention to the environment because the walls of the grey hall were covered in lush Purple-Black Vines, with Purple-Black Vines also entwining around the eight stone pillars—these were the very Purple-Black Demon Vines from inside the Black Toad.
The Black Toad was lying next to one of the stone pillars, belly up and sound asleep, its rounded belly comically expanding and contracting with each breath.
Yuan Ming heaved a heavy sigh of relief and glared at the Black Toad.
This Black Toad was actually taking a deep sleep here, causing him unnecessary worry.
Once he confirmed the Black Toad was safe and sound, Yuan Ming totally settled down and began to take a closer look at the grey hall.
The walls of the hall flickered with a faint black light that was barely visible. When he tried to probe with his Divine Sense, it barely penetrated before being blocked, suggesting that the white glow was some kind of restriction that could isolate the power of Divine Sense, which was why he couldn't detect the Black Toad's presence from outside.
Not only did the walls flicker with black light, but the air also hung with threads and strands of dark energy that resembled fluff. Each stream emitted a faint malicious aura.
Yuan Ming was familiar with this energy—it was the same dark energy emitted by the black stone pillar before.
The Purple-Black Demon Vine on the Black Toad's back, in conjunction with the toad's breathing, had flowers that opened and closed as if they were breathing through their mouths and noses. The dark energy in the hall slowly converged towards them, being absorbed by the flowers and leaves of the Purple-Black Demon Vine.
Yuan Ming was not surprised; the Black Toad had been absorbing the strange dark energy before, but now it seemed that it was actually the Purple-Black Demon Vine that was absorbing the dark energy.

chapters.title: Chapter 206 - 206: 186 Chapter: The Assembly
chapters.content:
"Eh!"
Yuan Ming suddenly discovered something abnormal, these Purple-Black Demon Vines not only grew lush leaves and blossomed with purple-black flowers, their length had also changed drastically.
Originally, the Demon Vines were at most around seventy to eighty feet long, but the ones before him were far beyond that, at least over sixty feet long. Could it be related to the strange black mist they had absorbed?
After a moment of contemplation, Yuan Ming communicated with the Black Toad through Divine Sense.
The Black Toad's belly quivered as it woke up.
Sensing Yuan Ming's presence, the Black Toad quickly flipped over, with a purple-black glow emerging on its back, and the Demon Vines that covered the entire hall rapidly retracted into its back.
A few breaths later, the Demon Vines inside the hall had all disappeared, and the Black Toad also hopped to Yuan Ming's side.
Yuan Ming connected with the Black Toad mentally, inquiring why it had come here.
The thoughts of the Black Toad buzzed over, struggling to recount its experiences in the Snake King Valley during this time.
The spiritual intelligence of the Black Toad was not high, its account was not very clear, but with some guessing and piecing together clues, Yuan Ming roughly understood the Black Toad's journey here.
After Yuan Ming left it in the Snake King Valley that day, the Black Toad immediately returned to the Snake King Cave here and continued to absorb the fierce black mist inside the black stone pillar.
At first, all was calm, but a few days later, the black stone pillar suddenly rose from the ground, while the earth below shook like an earthquake, revealing a straight hole in the ground.
The black stone pillar then plunged into the hole as if someone was controlling it.
The Black Toad was lying on the pillar at the time and, seeing such drastic changes, hurriedly wrapped its body tightly around the pillar with the Demon Vine to avoid being thrown off.
The black stone pillar followed that green stone passage beneath the ground and arrived at this gray underground palace.
Here, the strange black mist was even denser. The Black Toad was overjoyed and simply chose to stay, releasing its Demon Vines to absorb the mist.
The Purple-Black Demon Vines thrived on the strange black mist, the more they absorbed, the more vigorously they grew.
While the Black Toad, as the symbiotic body of the Demon Vine, didn't gain any benefits, it also felt very comfortable and soon fell into a deep sleep, until it was awakened by Yuan Ming just now.
Yuan Ming pondered all this, feeling incredulous, and at the same time, his gaze fell upon the Black Toad's spine—that bulge had now grown quite a bit, looking like it was wrapped in several purple-black leaves.
"Where is that black stone pillar now?" Yuan Ming asked.
The Black Toad raised its head and looked toward the deepest part of the underground palace.
There, on the wall, stood a tightly shut black stone gate with the black stone pillar erect beside it to the right. The patterns on it glowed with a black ghostly light, and the emanating black mist was ten times denser.
"You don't need to worry about me; continue absorbing the black mist," Yuan Ming instructed.
Upon hearing this, the Black Toad joyfully croaked and once again released its Demon Vines to absorb the black mist of this place.
Yuan Ming approached the stone pillar and tried probing it with Divine Sense once more, to no avail—just like before, as soon as it touched the pillar, an invisible force repelled it.
He sighed, looking towards the black stone gate and tried extending his Divine Sense inside.
However, just like the walls, the stone gate was also protected by some kind of prohibition; his Divine Sense could not penetrate through.
Yuan Ming searched carefully around the stone gate for a while but found no mechanism to open it.
The black stone pillar wouldn't have moved from the Snake King Cave to this place for no reason; there must be something significant behind the stone gate.
After a moment's silence, Yuan Ming suddenly flicked his finger.
A dazzling golden light shot out, which was the Nine-Ring Gold Saber he had obtained from the Bone Map, fiercely striking the stone gate.
With a "clang" sound, the Nine-Ring Gold Saber was repelled, and the black stone gate remained unscathed.
Yuan Ming's brows furrowed, and he then made a grabbing motion with his right hand, conjuring the Burning Explosion Skill and continually infused it with Mana.
Now at the Qi Refining twelfth layer, not only was his Mana much richer and thicker, but his control over spells had also greatly improved. Soon, he expanded the fireball to the size of a millstone, with the power fluctuations bursting forth far stronger than when he battled Bone Map.
"Go!" With a push of his hand, Yuan Ming launched the giant fireball at the black stone gate and simultaneously retreated backward.
Billowing flames spread out, engulfing the entire gate as the massive explosion caused the whole underground palace to shake, and chaotic ripples emanated from the prohibitions on the gate.
The red flames quickly dissipated, and a charred large pit appeared on the ground in front of the gate, but the black stone gate was still intact.
A few dozen feet away, Yuan Ming's expression became utterly solemn.
After pondering for a moment, he reached into his chest and pulled out a black bag, the Corpse Nourishing Bag belonging to Bone Map, which contained the corpse of the Heavenly Snake Master.
With a wave of his hand, he summoned the corpse of the Heavenly Snake Master, ready to remove the black iron nail to control the corpse with the soul crow.
Suddenly, the corpse of the Heavenly Snake Master opened its eyes, which shone with an extreme excitement and ferocity. The black iron nail on its forehead buzzed and trembled, as if an invisible force was about to pop it out.
A "clang clang" noise came from ahead, but it was coming from behind the black stone gate, as if someone was frantically knocking from the inside.
Yuan Ming's expression changed drastically, his heart beating wildly with each knock from behind the door, a sense of indescribable fear welling up in him, as if there was a primordial beast standing before him.
He immediately activated the Corpse Nourishing Bag and recollected the Heavenly Snake Master, channeling his Mana to suppress the corpse.
The Heavenly Snake Master's corpse gradually calmed down, and the knocking from behind the black stone gate ceased as well.MyVirtualLibraryEmpire(MVLEMPYR)appreciatesyourreadershipatthesource.
Yuan Ming immediately distanced himself from the black stone gate, his heart finally settling down after it had thumped wildly, his gaze towards the black stone gate flickering incessantly.
The Heavenly Snake Master's body appeared to be the key to opening that stone gate, but what exactly was behind it to give him such a terrifying feeling?
With his current strength, it seemed that he wasn't qualified to open the gate; rashly entering might just lead to situations he could not handle.
Yuan Ming turned and walked over to the Black Toad, not paying any more attention to the black stone gate, and sat down with his legs crossed to restore the Mana that had nearly run dry from casting the Burning Explosion Skill.
As soon as his Mana had somewhat recovered, fearing that the Heavenly Snake Master's corpse might trigger something odd again, he immediately left with the Black Toad.
Not until his feet touched the ground of Snake King Cave did Yuan Ming feel completely at ease. Without the strength of at least the Foundation Establishment Stage, Yuan Ming would not come to explore this place again.
He cast a spell to conceal the entrance of the underground cave and then turned to leave Snake King Valley, heading back to Biluo Cave.
Three days later, Yuan Ming rushed back to the Sect.
The White Deer Hill summit meeting was not far off; the atmosphere in Biluo Cave had become much livelier than before. Even the disciples who had not signed up to participate were looking forward with anticipation to the grand event, guessing which of the Biluo Cave disciples attending the summit had the best chance of achieving good results.
Yuan Ming naturally did not care about these trivial matters; upon returning to the Sect, he stayed at his own residence, not leaving his room.
Time quickly passed, three more days went by.
One day, as Yuan Ming was cultivating in his room, he heard a series of urgent "bang bang" knocks at the door.
He got up to open the door and found a servant, who was responsible for cleaning the area, standing outside.
"Superior immortal, news has just come that the Sect is summoning all disciples to gather in Qingluo Square," the servant said respectfully.
Yuan Ming was startled and asked, "Summoning all disciples? Did they say what for?"
"They did not mention it," the servant shook his head.
"Alright, I understand. I'll head there immediately," Yuan Ming said after a brief silence.
The servant bowed, took his leave, and went to knock on another disciple's residence nearby.
Yuan Ming tidied up his clothes and stepped out of his room, walking down the mountain.
Qingluo Square, which the servant mentioned, was the large green stone square at the mountain's foot where Biluo Cave would gather disciples for significant events.
By the time Yuan Ming arrived at Qingluo Square, many people were already there. Disciples from various halls naturally clumped together; Yuan Ming joined the Fire Refining Hall Disciples, where Fang Ge and Mu He had already arrived.
"Junior Brother Yuan Ming, it's been a while since I've seen you. Eh, your cultivation?" Fang Ge greeted him with a smile, his expression suddenly turning to one of surprise.
"I've been in closed-door cultivation for some time, and I've had some minor success," Yuan Ming said vaguely.
"Last time at the sword refining, your level was only at the Qi Refining Ninth Level. It hasn't been that long and you've reached the Qi Refining Tenth Layer. It seems Junior Brother Yuan Ming must have had some fortuitous encounters," Fang Ge complimented.
"What fortuitous encounters could there be? I just happened to come across a bottle of Strengthening and Nourishing elixir lately, which allowed me to advance luckily," Yuan Ming modestly stated.
"Oh, so that's how it is," Fang Ge nodded still showing a hint of doubt in his eyes. The speed of Yuan Ming's cultivation advancement was indeed hard to comprehend.
Yuan Ming naturally noticed Fang Ge's doubt, but the speed of his cultivation was too fast, and any excuse would seem to cover something more significant, so he did not offer explanations, especially since Elder Brother Fang Ge was not one to pry.
After all, although Biluo Cave was a Sect, aside from the Inner Sect Disciples, the higher-ups and even the elders generally didn't care much about the ordinary Registered Disciples.
Mu He was engrossed in a book of runes and did not join in the conversation between the two.
More and more people gathered in the square, and soon enough, aside from a few who were out on Sect missions, all the Biluo Cave Disciples had assembled in Qingluo Square, numbering seven or eight hundred.
The Foundation Establishment Stage elders from the various halls had also arrived, standing in front of the crowd.
Yuan Ming was witnessing for the first time since joining the Sect the gathering of the Foundation Establishment Stage cultivators of Biluo Cave, numbering as many as seventy or eighty.
In the distance of Qingluo Square, a silver cat sat perched on a large tree, its head resting on its front paws, looking at the bustling crowd with interest.
A stir went through the crowd suddenly, and everyone turned their attention to the front.
Two figures approached, one a middle-aged man with copper rings on his ears and the other a black-bearded old man with yellowed skin and a sturdy frame; they ascended the temporary wooden platform set up in front of the crowd.
"How come only the Great Cave Master and the Second Cave Master have come? Aren't the Third Cave Master and the Great Elder coming?" the crowd whispered among themselves.
Yuan Ming was also curiously observing the two Core Formation Stage cultivators, but he was too far from the wooden platform to sense their aura.
"Fellow disciples of Biluo Cave, this summoning pertains to the White Deer Hill summit meeting. The significance of this decennial meeting to the entire Southern Border and Northern Territory's Five Great Sects, I am sure you all understand, and I will not elaborate further," the Great Cave Master began, his voice resonating across the square, silencing everyone.
"In two days' time, the summit will commence. Since White Deer Hill is quite far from the Sect, we will depart tomorrow led by the Second Cave Master, Law and Regulations Hall's Elder Mo Sa, and Execution Hall's Elder Chu Xiong," the Great Cave Master added after a pause.
The people below had anticipated this assembly's connection with the White Deer Hill summit and were not surprised.
Yuan Ming was fully prepared, carrying essential items with him at all times, and would have no issue even if they departed right now.
"Before we set out, there are two things I need to clarify with everyone. The first is to announce the rewards the Sect has prepared for this summit," said the Great Cave Master, glancing at the black-bearded elder by his side.
The crowd below buzzed with discussion, and those who had enrolled for the summit looked on with eager anticipation, Yuan Ming included.

chapters.title: Chapter 207 - 187: Bell Ringing
chapters.content:
"Unlike previous years, in this White Deer Hill alliance meeting, aside from the spiritual materials collected by the participating disciples, the Sect has decided to bestow additional rewards on the ten disciples who harvest the most, as an encouragement. You may see for yourselves what the specific prizes are," the black-bearded elder said, raising one hand and causing a white banner to appear in mid-air, inscribed with rows of golden, shimmering characters and smaller explanatory text below them.
"The rewards for this alliance are surprisingly generous!"
"It's rare for the Sect to be so lavish, oh, had I known, I would have registered too!"
As the disciples present read the listed rewards, they collectively gasped in astonishment and began buzzing with discussion.
With a sweeping glance, Yuan Ming's face also betrayed a hint of astonishment.
The rewards the Sect had prepared this time were not insignificant, with those for the top three all related to Foundation Establishment. The first-place prize was a Foundation Establishment Pill, the second place was the Soul-Calming Incense, and the third place was a Yuan Condensing Pill.
According to the description, the Soul-Calming Incense came from the Southern Border Eastern Domain and was as its name suggested, capable of stabilizing the mind, allowing one to remain in a state of absolute calm, greatly aiding in breaking through the Foundation Establishment Stage.
This incense was a novelty for other Biluo Cave cultivators or disciples, but to Yuan Ming, it was not particularly rare.
The Yuan Condensing Pill was an elixir that accelerated the condensation of mana, significantly aiding in Foundation Establishment as well.
Both the Soul-Calming Incense and the Yuan Condensing Pill were precious items, and the Foundation Establishment Pill, needless to say, indicated Biluo Cave's high regard for this meeting at White Deer Hill.
The rewards for fourth to tenth places included magic artifacts, elixirs to advance cultivation, and a substantial number of Spirit Stones, all quite valuable, albeit not as much as the Foundation Establishment Pill or Soul-Calming Incense.
The other participating disciples were both shocked and thrilled to see such valuable rewards.
Some people's eyes darkened as they looked towards the other participants.
With such valuable rewards at stake, rather than painstakingly searching for treasures and materials and competing for rankings, it might be better to reduce the number of fellow Sect members directly.
Only forty to fifty people from Biluo Cave had registered for the White Deer Hill alliance meeting this time. The more people eliminated, the greater the chance of entering the top ten.
A crisp 'ding' resonated, startling those who harbored murderous intentions; they nearly fell to the ground, while others were less affected.
The Great Cave Master had somehow acquired a small white bell in his hand, which was emitting a gentle white light.
He raised his hand and struck the bell, which immediately intensified its white glow and shot out numerous white bell shadows that accurately entered the bodies of all attendees.
Yuan Ming's body also absorbed one of the white bell shadows, startling him. He hurriedly activated his Divine Sense to investigate but found nothing.
"Don't worry, the bell shadow that just entered you was a Heart Warning Seal from my Heart Warning Bell, and it will dissipate after a while," the Great Cave Master said.
"May I ask Great Cave Master, what is the effect of this Heart Warning Seal?" a voice rang out, belonging to a tall Biluo Cave disciple with a scar running from his right eye to his chin.
Yuan Ming recognized this person, named Wu Luo, who was the direct disciple of the Second Cave Master, highly respected among the younger generation in Biluo Cave.
"That leads me to the second matter. In past White Deer Hill meetings, disciples from the Five Sects fought fiercely over spiritual materials and treasures, sparing neither strangers nor fellows from their own Sect for ranks and gains. This time, we absolutely will not tolerate fratricide within the Sect! The Heart Warning Seal can sense murderous intent, and it will activate if you turn on your fellow disciples. Those whose seals are triggered, no matter how much they have gathered, will be disqualified from the top ten rankings!" The Great Cave Master's gaze turned sharp as he spoke slowly.
"Yes," the participating disciples averted their gaze and bowed their heads in agreement almost immediately.
Those who had plotted against their fellow Sect members suppressed such thoughts at once.
"You are no exception; do not think that the Sect is unaware of your covert strife. Interaction and sparring among fellow disciples are permitted, but there should be limits. Currently, Biluo Cave needs sincere unity and must avoid internal conflict!" the Second Cave Master addressed those disciples and elders who were not participating in the meeting, his voice stern.
Every person his gaze swept over shivered involuntarily, some guiltily turning their heads away.
Under this oppressive atmosphere, these people responded in unison.
Yuan Ming frowned secretly. Previously, Biluo Cave had not interfered in the disputes among disciples and even took a lenient attitude. Why the sudden change in approach? Perhaps something had occurred, forcing Biluo Cave to make adjustments.
Those swift of mind among the crowd also guessed this and looked towards the Great Cave Master and Second Cave Master with a touch more suspicion in their eyes.
"But don't shun struggle as if avoiding food because of choking; necessary sparring is still permissible. How else to improve strength? Especially against other Sects, we initiate no troubles but neither are we afraid of them. The Great Elder alone has elevated Biluo Cave into the ranks of the Five Great Sects, fending off other Sects from encroaching. If the disciples of our Sect are all timid, how can we stand firm?" The Great Cave Master said with a smile surfacing on his face.
The disciples of Biluo Cave relaxed slightly upon hearing this.
The Great Elder, as the pillar of Biluo Cave, was deeply revered; it was said that his cultivation had reached the peak of Mid-stage Core Formation, far surpassing the three Cave Masters and counting as one of the few powerhouses in both the Southern Border and Northern Territory.
As long as he was there, other Sects from the Northern Territory dared not intrude a step.
"The Great Elder truly is formidable," Yuan Ming muttered to himself.
He had been with the Sect for quite a while and had never seen the Great Elder, who was rumored to always be in seclusion in the mountains behind Biluo Cave, rarely appearing in public or ever seen in action.
From his perch atop a large tree near the square, Xi Ying sat crouching, his gaze passing through the crowd and lighting, looking towards the back of Biluo Cave.
Behind the three main peaks of Biluo Cave was a range of continuous mountains, densely wooded and utterly deserted. A faint mist pervaded the space between trees, wafting through the forest with the mountain breeze, lingering among the treetops.
On a green rocky cliff sat a cave mansion; to its right, carved into the stone wall, were the three large characters "Biluo Cave", covered with green moss and seemingly existing for centuries.
Nearly a thousand disciples of Biluo Cave did not know that the name of their sect originated from this place.
The stone gate of the cave mansion was tightly shut, with faint blue light rippling over it.
Deep within the Biluo Cave, in a stone chamber, a youth clad in a dark green robe was sitting cross-legged. He had high cheekbones and deep-set eyes, which greatly differed from the appearance of the Southern Border People.
The green-robed youth formed hand seals, and in front of him floated a small black kettle half a meter high, engraved with landscapes, flowers, and birds. Below the spout, three small characters were engraved: Soul Suppressing Kettle.
The Soul Suppressing Kettle buzzed and trembled ceaselessly, wisps of black mist rose from within, making the kettle lid clatter intensely. A small dent appeared at the top of the lid as if a part was missing, making it look somewhat incongruous.
"Lacking the Soul Suppressing Pearl atop the lid, controlling this Soul Suppressing Kettle is indeed taxing," the green-robed youth sighed, his hands rotating like wheels as he formed seals.
Waves of blue light struck the Soul Suppressing Kettle, gradually restoring calm to its body, and the leaking black mist completely vanished.
The green-robed youth flicked his sleeve, casting out twenty or thirty strokes, which landed in front of him. They were twenty or thirty black bells, indeed Soul-Attracting Bells.
"Gather!" he commanded, forming a seal towards the Soul Suppressing Kettle. The kettle lid levitated, emitting a suction force.
Streams, as thick as fingers and constantly shifting, of Divine Soul Power flew out of the twenty or thirty Soul-Attracting Bells, rolling into the Soul Suppressing Kettle and were quickly sucked dry.Tosupportourwork,pleasereadon*.
The kettle lid fell, sealing the kettle mouth tightly.
However, the Soul Suppressing Kettle started to tremble clangorously again, with more black fog spilling out from the mouth than before.
The green-robed youth's expression condensed, and he cast a wave of blue light with a sweep of his sleeve, wrapping around the Soul Suppressing Kettle and dropping it onto a black Array on the ground several feet in size ahead.
The Array swiftly activated, a black mild light covered the kettle, reducing the trembles of the Soul Suppressing Kettle considerably.
The color of the green-robed youth's face eased slightly, his hands forming seals, enveloping the kettle with soft black light that flowed like water into the body of the kettle.
Moments later, a "crack" sound of something breaking emerged from within the Soul Suppressing Kettle. The kettle emitted a black light, and its top cover was blasted off, causing ghostly wails and wolf howls to faintly resonate within a few meters.
The walls of the stone chamber emitted a layer of black light, blocking all the ghostly wails.
"Finally, the Soul Power has accumulated sufficiently. I, Xi Cangqiong, can now attempt to break into the late-stage of Core Formation using the Divine Soul Power as a guide," murmured the green-robed youth softly as he exhaled lightly.
As he spoke, a black light flashed across his forehead, revealing a black tiger head phantom, which touched the ground before sucking at the Soul Suppressing Kettle.
A stream of exceptionally pure black mist surged out from the Soul Suppressing Kettle, no longer writhing even a bit, entering the black tiger head.
Showing a look of ecstasy on his face, the green-robed youth sat cross-legged, forming a Sealing with his hands in front of him.
Suddenly, a tremendous oppressive force burst forth, shaking the entire stone chamber, the air in it roaring and shrieking.
Atop a large tree outside Biluo Cave, a sparrow perched, hopping agilely along the branches, its eyes occasionally flashing past the green stone gates, revealing a hint of lively light.
In a distant tree above Qingluo Square, Xi Ying narrowed its eyes, anxiously sharpening its claws against the tree. Suddenly, it looked up towards the mountain gate of Biluo Cave, its eyes reflecting shock.
"Who has come..." it murmured, its form darting towards the mountain gate.
Outside the mountain gate of Biluo Cave, shadowy figures in black clothes, whose origin was unknown, suddenly appeared, quickly approaching from all directions. The number was no less than three or four hundred, each with an embroidered emblem on the chest resembling a rising sunrise surrounded by a few white clouds.
Although these people tried desperately to conceal their movements, their large numbers soon were detected by the scouting methods arranged near the sect by Biluo Cave.
A hidden stake of Biluo Cave leaped out from the bushes, darting toward the mountain gate. Pulling out a white talisman, he activated it and yelled, "A large group of unidentified individuals is approaching fast. Hurry..."
Before he could finish, he felt a black arrow silently shoot towards him from behind. No matter how he tried to dodge, a "puff" sound was heard as the arrow pierced his throat.
The stake's voice abruptly ceased, he collapsed to the ground, soon breathless. However, with the last of his strength, he crushed the talisman in his hand.
