A burst of white light shot into the sky, exploding mid-air, forming a shower of dazzling light rain.
Almost simultaneously, several bursts of white light also shot into the sky from both the east and the west sides of the Biluo Cave Sect, turning into firework-like light showers.
Dang, dang, dang!
Suddenly, an enormously loud bell sound arose, deafening, reverberating across the entire mountain gate of Biluo Cave, echoing endlessly through the sky.

chapters.title: Chapter 208 - 188: The Five Elements Combined Body
chapters.content:
The crowd on Qingluo Square heard the bell ring. The disciples who had recently joined Biluo Cave had no idea what had happened, while those who had joined earlier and the Foundation Establishment elders all changed their expressions.
"Something's wrong! The Cloud Breaking Bell rang nine times! That only happens when enemies massively attack the mountain. Could someone be assaulting the Sect gate?" Fang Ge widened his eyes.
The Great Cave Master soared into the sky, his eyes shooting two beams of cold light several meters long, scanning in all directions before swiftly descending.
"Are we under attack?" the Second Cave Master immediately asked.
"From every direction except for the north: east, west, and south, enemies are approaching, and their numbers are not few! Cloaked in black robes, their origins unclear," the Great Cave Master said gravely.
"During the Sect gathering, most disciples are here, leaving our defenses elsewhere vulnerable. Clearly, the attackers are well-prepared. Shall we ask the Great Elder to join the fight?" the Second Cave Master wrinkled his brow as he spoke.
"Once the Cloud Breaking Bell rang, the Great Elder would have noticed, and he will decide on his own. Let's act separately for now. Have a few elders take people to guard the east and west sides. There may be more enemies at the southern gate; I'll lead a defense there personally. You, go and activate the Sect Protection Array immediately!" The Great Cave Master closed his eyes and took a breath, his eyes flashing confidently as he spoke rapidly.
"Understood," the Second Cave Master transformed into a tunnelling light and flew up, disappearing into the distance in the blink of an eye.
"Who knows where these audacious attackers from Silver Cat Xi Ying came to assault our Biluo Cave Sect gate. All elders heed my command and defend separately. Once the Sect Protection Array is activated and the Great Elder arrives, no matter how many attackers there are, there's no need to worry." The voice of the Great Cave Master wasn't loud, but it clearly reached the ears of everyone present, instantly quieting the scene.
Next, the Great Cave Master began directing from the center, quickly allocating defensive forces in all directions of the gate. Groups of disciples, led by the elders, rushed toward various directions. Soon, only the Great Cave Master and more than thirty Foundation Establishment Cultivators, along with nearly four hundred Qi Refining disciples, remained in the square.
Yuan Ming was left behind, while Fang Ge and Mu He had already been dispatched to other teams and had left early.
"The rest of you, follow me to guard the gate. Today, as our Sect is under attack, you must all fight valiantly. Anyone who attempts to flee secretly, or plays tricks, will face my wrath after this, as I will personally cleanse our ranks!" The Great Cave Master's voice was chilling, sending a shiver through everyone present.
Naturally, no one dared object, and they all agreed aloud.
"Move out immediately!" The Great Cave Master transformed into a beam of white light, shooting towards the gate.
The other thirty-something Foundation Establishment Cultivators and some disciples summoned various flying creatures, each taking a few disciples and swiftly racing toward the gate.
The remaining disciples, who didn't have Flying Spiritual Beasts or were not carried by others—mostly those with lower cultivation and ordinary status within the Sect—had no choice but to grit their teeth and run on foot, closely following the main force toward the gate.
"With such a major incident befalling the Sect, where has Silver Cat Xi Ying gone?"
Yuan Ming naturally belonged to the latter group, and as he moved with the large group towards the gate, his heart was filled with anxiety.
Moreover, the fact that Biluo Cave's Sect Protection Array and the presence of several Core Formation experts like the Great Elder were no secret. Since the enemies dared to attack, they must have several Core Formation experts themselves; the situation was likely dire.
...
At Biluo Cave's Sect gate.
The Mountain Guarding Disciples were already clashing with the black-robed individuals. Although there were only thirty to forty Mountain Guarding Disciples and despite having activated the Defense Restriction Mechanism, they were no match for the black-robed attackers, who numbered ten times more, and were swiftly forced into retreat.
"These enemies took advantage of the Great Cave Master's convening of a full Sect assembly to attack. Troublesome intruders! Has there been any response from the Sect side?" a Foundation Establishment Elder wielding a giant hammer among the Mountain Guarding Disciples shouted as he sent two black-robed attackers flying with a heavy blow.
This man, named Qi Wei, was an elder of the Law and Regulations Hall at Biluo Cave, and it was his turn to guard the gate today.
"Just received a message; the Great Cave Master is already on his way with reinforcements," replied a person beside him, bathed in blood, who was named Wulu.
"Good! Fellow disciples, hold on a little longer. Since they've come to court death, let's show them what we're made of!" Qi Wei bellowed.
At that moment, several black-robed individuals leapt forward, hurling several magic artifacts at them like bolts of lightning.
Although all of these individuals were Qi Refining Stage Cultivators, each was a high-level practitioner around the Qi Refining Tenth Layer, making their magic artifacts significantly powerful.
"Scram!" Qi Wei flicked his sleeve outward.
A white round orb shot out from his hand, swelling in size like a house as it flew, "bang bang" knocking away several magic artifacts.
Without any pause, the white giant pearl continued and struck several black-robed individuals.
The individuals were hit as if by a meteor, blood spraying from their mouths as they were knocked back, one of them having his head struck directly, causing his skull to crack and resulting in his instant death.
Although Qi Wei could still hold them off, the other Mountain Guarding Disciples were overwhelmed by the number of enemies, and their defensive line was on the verge of collapse.
Qi Wei rapidly formed hand gestures, and the white giant pearl began to emblazon seven star patterns on its surface.
Bang bang bang!
Dozens of beams of starlight rained down like droplets, striking the group of black-robed assailants, triggering a wave of bloodshed.
"The Seven Star Pearl!" a voice came from the front; it wasn't loud, yet it subdued the surrounding combat and shouting.
Qi Wei's expression turned solemn, knowing that the enemy Core Formation experts had finally revealed themselves. He quickly recalled the white giant pearl and suspended it above his head.
Just then, a yellow glow flashed beneath his feet, and a yellow array spontaneously emerged from the ground.
Qi Wei was startled and promptly retreated, but he was a step too late.
Dozens of whip-like yellow lights shot out from within the array, binding Qi Wei's legs before he could react.
"Earth Binding Array!" Qi Wei was immobilized at once, yet he did not panic; he fiercely slapped his right hand down.
A green sharp claw magic artifact emerged out of nowhere, swelling several times in size. Its claws, emitting a foot-long green light, viciously clawed at the Earth Binding Array.
The green claw light appeared extremely sharp, and with a loud bang, it tore through a corner of the Earth Binding Array.
More than a dozen rays of starlight shot out from the white giant pearl, striking the Earth Binding Array and riddling it with holes.
However, the Earth Binding Array was not destroyed. The ruptured parts healed at a speed visible to the naked eye, and the yellow tendrils still firmly trapped Qi Wei, tightening even more.
"The Earth Binding Array is only a basic magic array; how can it be so tough!" Qi Wei exclaimed in disbelief.
"This is not the usual Earth Binding Array, but the Yin-Yang Earth Binding Array I modified. With Yin on top and Yang below, you only destroyed the Yin Array; how could you possibly escape?" A white figure slowly emerged from among the people in black robes, appearing to be a young girl with a mask on her face and bare feet, but each time her foot touched the ground, the phantom imprint of embroidered shoes appeared.
If Yuan Ming were here, he would surely recognize her as the female array master who had caused a great commotion in Black Rock City with her Wave Hand Array.
Qi Wei quickly extended his Divine Sense to probe the ground and found another Earth Binding Array operating several meters below, resonating with the surface array.
"The Great Cave Master has brought people here; prepare to meet your end!" Qi Wei shouted and then frantically attacked the ground Yin Formation with the green sharp claws and the white giant pearl.
The female array master flicked her fingers and a dirt-yellow orb fell into the array, merging with it.
The Earth Binding Array shone brightly with yellow light, causing many modifications in its array patterns, including the addition of many spiked designs.
The array's yellow light flashed continuously, and several large ground spikes suddenly sprouted, stabbing into Qi Wei's body.
However, Qi Wei's yellow robe suddenly emitted a dazzling light, forming a dirt-yellow light screen that blocked the attack of the ground spikes.
The female array master let out a light gasp but paid it no further mind; she raised her hand again,
effortlessly shooting out five green rays that landed on the outer perimeter of the Earth Binding Array.
A series of green array patterns rapidly spread, instantly forming a green array that reflected against the two Earth Binding Arrays, with Yimu Spiritual Power swiftly pouring into the Earth Binding Array.
The sound of rumbling within the Earth Binding Array resumed, and more large ground spikes emerged from thin air, nearly half of which had turned green, sparkling with a woody luster.
Content first released on *.
The yellow light screen around Qi Wei shattered in response, with several ground spikes penetrating his body, piercing through his Dantian and heart. He opened his mouth as if to say something, but he died before he could speak.
"Elder Qi Wei has fallen!" Wulu exclaimed in shock, having already retreated far back and continuing to flee while gesturing with his index finger.
With Qi Wei's demise, the control of the white giant pearl and the green sharp claws was lost, returning them to their original size and flinging them far away, right next to Wulu.
Wulu flicked his sleeves, gracefully scooping up the items, then ran even faster.
With Qi Wei's defeat, the Biluo Cave Mountain Guarding Disciples completely lost their will to fight, were slaughtered, and quickly fell into disarray; the people in black robes soon approached the mountain gate of Biluo Cave.
The ground at the mountain gate of Biluo Cave shook incessantly as large black stone pillars sprouted from the ground, rapidly forming a stone array.
The Stone Forest appeared chaotic and without pattern, but the moment those in black robes entered, they immediately became dizzy and disoriented.
The Biluo Cave Disciples were unaffected, relying on the Stone Forest to fend off the people in black robes, blocking them once again.
Nearby on a large tree, Silver Cat Xi Ying was perched, blending with the leaves.
"Wave Hand Array, could this be the female assassin that Yuan Ming spoke of, seeming like a Five Elements Combined Body? Such outstanding talent." She watched the female array master and muttered with interest.
The female array master seemed to sense something and turned her head towards where Xi Ying was.
But there was nothing unusual to be seen, just emptiness.
The female array master slightly furrowed her brows but soon looked away, commanding the people in black robes to attack the Stone Forest.
A few meters away on another tree, a silver flash passed – Xi Ying appeared and looked up at the distance.
"Fantastic, whoever is coming, hurry up and break in. Why are you dawdling?"
She then swiftly moved towards the direction of Biluo Cave Sect, her body exuding a strange silver light, and swiftly fading away. In a few breaths, she completely disappeared, leaving no trace of her presence.
…
Meanwhile, Yuan Ming was mingling among over a hundred Registered Disciples, hurrying towards the mountain gate.
Although his cultivation was far superior to that of the other Registered Disciples, at that moment, he had subdued his presence and did not stand out in the crowd.
After reflecting on the situation, he felt quite worried and, whether intentionally or not, gradually lingered at the back of the group.
"A great battle is inevitable today; it's really bustling," a cheerful voice suddenly rang in his mind; it was Xi Ying.
Yuan Ming's heart stirred, and he glanced around but did not find Xi Ying's figure; he then whispered in an almost indiscernible voice, "Do you know who these people are?"
He was not adept in sound transmission techniques, and had to communicate with Xi Ying in this way, relying on her divine skills to hear his words.

chapters.title: Chapter 209 - 189: The Task at Dawn
chapters.content:
"Who cares who he is? Right now, I have a big task to handle. Why are you still here? I'm leaving first, and I might contact you later." Indeed, Xi Ying's voice transmission came through once again.
"Where are you going? Be careful," Yuan Ming didn't ask further, merely whispering a word of caution.
Xi Ying didn't respond again, apparently she had already left.
Yuan Ming continued to move forward with the group, while ruminating over the situation.
Xi Ying seemed exceedingly pleased about the attack on Biluo Cave, and no doubt intended to fish in troubled waters.
He didn't feel much loyalty to Biluo Cave; if things took a bad turn, he surely wouldn't foolishly share fate with Biluo Cave. He needed to find an opportunity to slip away.
The Earth Travel Talisman had only a little spiritual power remaining, but it should still be able to activate one more time for an underground escape. There was a good chance to avoid this calamity.
As for the threats just made by the Great Cave Master, Yuan Ming didn't take them to heart. Not to mention that once a battle started, the Great Cave Master would be too preoccupied with the Core Formation Stage expert among the enemy to care about these Qi Refining Stage cultivators. And with his identity as a Registered Disciple and his usually low-profile demeanor, it was likely that few among those around him would even recognize him.
Yuan Ming glanced around and found no one was paying attention to him, pretending to wipe sweat from his forehead.
From the spot between his brows, he released two soul crows, which dove into his sleeves and then headed underground through his trouser legs.
Yuan Ming kept moving forward, and his figure soon disappeared into the distance.
Two black crows flew out from the nearby woods one after another, silently heading in different directions.
...
The Great Cave Master soared through the sky, much faster than Yuan Ming and the others who were traveling on foot, and soon arrived at the gate of Biluo Cave.
By then the stone forest at the gate had been completely destroyed, the Mountain Guarding Disciples nearly wiped out, and the ground almost entirely stained red with open corpses and scattered limbs.
The Great Cave Master's eyes were full of rage, but they shifted slightly upon seeing the sunrise pattern on the black-clothed figures: "Dawn Alliance!"
Seeing the Great Cave Master appear, a few of the black-clothed figures who had gone into a frenzy attacked with magic artifacts in their hand.
"Stop!" someone in the crowd cried out in haste, but it was already too late.
The Great Cave Master's eyes shone with a cold light, his hands forming seals and then rubbing together.
Dozens of thunderbolts as thick as arms shot out, and for a dozen or so feet around, brilliant thunder and lightning interwove. In a flash of lightning, one of them struck the black-clothed man at the front.
How could these Qi Refining Stage cultivators withstand a blow from a Core Formation Stage cultivator? Their bodies immediately burst open.
The snaps and cracks filled the air!
In just a moment, seven or eight people fell, and only then did the remaining black-clothed figures realize that something was wrong and began to retreat. Still, more than ten people were struck dead by the swiftly moving purple thunderbolts.
"The Great Cave Master has come!" The surviving Mountain Guarding Disciples cried out with joy.
Without a word, the Great Cave Master made another set of seals with his hands, sending another few dozen thunderbolts pouring down.
At that moment, a whip-like blood-colored blade light shot out from the forest ahead, sweeping over the purple lightning at a speed several times faster than a falling thunderbolt.
All of the lightning was cut in half and dissipated into countless electrical arcs that vanished into the void.
The blood-colored blade light flew back and landed in the palm of a sturdy hand, revealing itself to be a blood-red battle axe with faint red lines flickering on its surface.
The owner of the sturdy hand was a Blood Robed Man, standing over eight feet tall, with red hair down to his shoulders and dark red eyes, emitting a terrifying aura of murderous intent.
"Xue Zhan, it's you! Why are you working for the Dawn Alliance?" Upon recognizing the face, the Great Cave Master frowned and spoke.
"I am now the Vice Leader of the Dawn Alliance's Southern Border division. Is it not a matter of course for me to protect my subordinates when I strike?" the Blood Robed Man cackled strangely.
"You've joined the Dawn Alliance!" The Great Cave Master seemed surprised.
"Indeed, not long ago I received an invitation from Captain Ou Ji and have just joined," said the Blood Robed Man with a smile.
"What is Dawn Alliance's purpose in launching such a major invasion of my Biluo Cave today? Who has put you up to this? This is quite the grand display!" The Great Cave Master's pupils constricted as he asked coldly.
"That is beyond my knowledge. The task I was given was simply to stop you, Fellow Daoist Mao," the Blood Robed Man replied, licking his lips.
The disciples of Biluo Cave at the gate had been at a disadvantage, but with the timely arrival and intervention of the Great Cave Master, they finally caught a break.
Now that the Great Cave Master was held up by the unexpected appearance of the Core Formation Stage cultivator Xue Zhan, the last dozen or so of them were surrounded once more, and two more fell in an instant.
Despite facing an enemy force several times their size and having held out until now, each of the dozen or so were skilled practitioners at the Ninth Level or Ten Layers of Qi Refinement. The Great Cave Master frowned slightly, and lightning once again flickered in his hands.
"Fellow Daoist Mao, if you continue to strike, I'm afraid we'll have to engage in another battle today. If you and these disciples remain stationary, we too will step aside and not interfere. How about it?" The Blood Robed Man flashed in front of the Great Cave Master, the giant axe in his hand pulsing with blood light.
"Xue Zhan, you do have a way with jokes! You invade my Biluo Cave, and as the Biluo Cave Master, if I were to give up and remain motionless, wouldn't that make the entire Southern Border Immortal Cultivation World laugh their heads off? If it's a fight you want, then let's fight, no need for empty talk!" The Great Cave Master huffed, his hands surging with thunder, ready to make his move.
The Blood Robed Man known as Xue Zhan was a famous Core Formation Stage Loose Cultivator in the Southern Border, known for his unruly nature, bloodthirsty and fond of killing for temporary pleasure. Once he really got fired up, he wouldn't stop until either he or his opponent was dead, which is why few dared to provoke him.This chapter was originally posted on *.
He had once clashed with Xue Zhan, and though his cultivation was a small realm higher than his opponent, the other fought as if he had no regard for his life. Every time he had the chance to seriously injure his adversary, the opponent would press forward rather than retreat, adopting a stance that seemed ready to trade life for life, which caused him quite a headache.
Now that his foe had appeared again, he was indeed a troublesome character to deal with.
Xue Zhan let out a hearty laugh, holding his battle axe across his chest, his blood qi roiling around him as if he was ready to strike at any moment.
The confrontation between the two Core Formation Stage cultivators in mid-air was about to erupt, while more than a dozen Biluo Cave Mountain Guarding Disciples below, despite relying on their forbidden arts, were completely isolated. In a blink of an eye, several more perished, and they were on the verge of being utterly annihilated.
Just at the critical moment, four or five red flames shot out from the mountain gate in front, screeching shrilly as they struck like meteors into the group of black-clad people surrounding the dozen or so Biluo disciples, exploding with a loud bang.
Large numbers of the black-clad people were blown away, many swallowed by the sea of flames, screaming continuously.
"Everyone, attack together and let these petty thieves stay here forever!"
A giant red spiritual bird, several zhang in length, flew out from inside Biluo Cave. The red flames were spat out from its mouth. On the back of the spiritual bird stood a person—it was Elder Meng Shan from the Beast Taming Hall.
Following closely behind Elder Meng Shan were several flying spiritual beasts, all rushing forward at full speed with Foundation Establishment Cultivators standing on their backs.
Behind these elders, more and more Biluo Cave cultivators surged up like a tide.
The reinforcements from Biluo Cave had finally arrived!
The black-clad army had already been fighting for a while and inevitably showed signs of fatigue, while the Biluo Cave disciples were fresh forces. With nearly thirty Foundation Establishment cultivators among them, far more than the black-clad people's Foundation Establishment cultivators, they immediately gained the upper hand.
The black-clad army was killed and forced to retreat continuously, soon driven out beyond the mountain gate.
The Great Cave Master was still confronting Xue Zhan but breathed a sigh of relief upon seeing this scene.
Just then, figures flickered in the woods outside the sect, and a large group of black-clad people burst forth, among them not a few Core Formation Stage experts.
"Do not act rashly, come back!" Seeing this, the Great Cave Master urgently shouted.
Under the leadership of Foundation Establishment Stage cultivators, Elder Meng Shan and the other Biluo Cave cultivators halted their advance and formed a defensive array.
Yuan Ming had already retreated to a corner of the crowd and looked toward the oppressive mass of black-clad people with trepidation.
So many enemies, appearing out of nowhere. The large-scale assembly of cultivators had managed to advance without prior notice, and it seemed that he needed to be careful in the upcoming battle.
"Excuse me for a moment," a voice came from the ground beneath him.
Startled, Yuan Ming quickly stepped aside.
The ground burst open, and a figure covered in dirt emerged.
"Wu Lu, is that you! How come you're here?" Yuan Ming looked closely at the person and was surprised.
The individual emerging from the ground was none other than Wu Lu.
The nearby people, noticing the commotion here and seeing a Biluo Cave Disciple emerge, all revealed a disdainful look in their eyes.
"Brother Yuan Ming? I'm quite embarrassed. I was on duty guarding the gate today, and when the enemy launched a massive assault, I had to use the Earth Travel Technique in desperation to flee underground," explained Wu Lu as he patted the dirt off himself, his tone self-deprecating.
"By no means. If I were in Brother Wu Lu's place, I would have made the same decision," Yuan Ming said evenly.
Wu Lu nodded gratefully and took out an elixir to consume, then turned his gaze toward the black-clad army opposite them.
"Does Brother Wu Lu know the origins of these black-clad people?" Yuan Ming inquired.
"Don't you recognize the emblem of the Dawn Alliance? These are members of the Dawn Alliance," Wu Lu said in a low voice.
Yuan Ming was shocked and looked incredulously at the opposing crowd.
"The Dawn Scatter Alliance is a legendary loose alliance of the Southern Border. It's not just in the Southern Border; Dawn's influence spreads throughout the Southern Border, the Central Plains, and many other areas. If we talk about strength, they're actually incomparable to Biluo Cave. These black-clad people should be members of the Dawn Alliance's branch in the Southern Border," Wu Lu elaborated, assuming Yuan Ming had not heard of the name Dawn before.
"Does Dawn have a grudge against our Biluo Cave, or have they been hired by someone else?" Yuan Ming composed himself and asked.
"I'm not sure about that. The Dawn Alliance acts without restraint. As long as the payment is good, they will dare to accept any mission. This attack on the mountain must have been instigated by someone else, and they came well-prepared," said Wu Lu with a glimmer in his eyes, speaking somberly.
The Great Cave Master looked at the members of the Dawn Alliance with a gloomy expression and slowly asked, "My Biluo Cave has always steered clear of the Dawn Alliance's waters. Xue Zhan, I ask you once more, why have you led an attack on the Biluo Cave's mountain gate today?"
"I've already said, today's actions of the Dawn aren't under my command; you're asking the wrong person," Xue Zhan said casually, resting the battle axe on his shoulder.
The Great Cave Master was about to speak again when he suddenly looked intently towards a certain direction in front of him.
A dark cloud zoomed in from the front, landing about ten zhang away in the blink of an eye, and rumbling like distant thunder emanated from inside.
A deep voice came from the cloud, "Hehe, Fellow Daoist Mao Lihong, it's been many years since we've seen each other, and yet your elegance remains. Truly a joyous occasion!"
"Ou Ji!" The pupils of the Great Cave Master constricted.

chapters.title: Chapter 210 - 190 Solid Evidence
chapters.content:
"After so many years, I did not expect Fellow Daoist Mao to still remember such an insignificant person as myself. It is truly an immense honor." The dark clouds slowly dissipated, revealing a large man with a purple face and a black robe, whose appearance was quite imposing.
Seeing the momentum and grandeur of this man's arrival, it was evident that he too was a Core Formation Stage cultivator.
The faces of the Biluo Cave's people showed concern as two Core Formation Stage beings appeared among the enemy, while only the Great Cave Master stood on Biluo Cave's side.
Although in terms of the number of Foundation Establishment cultivators and Qi Refining cultivators, both sides were more or less comparable, and even with Biluo Cave holding a slight advantage due to the favorable terrain, the decisive power in the battle clearly rested with the Core Formation Stage cultivators.
As a Mid-stage Core Formation Stage cultivator, the Great Cave Master was the strongest in Biluo Cave apart from the Great Elder and was quite formidable. However, facing two beings of similar strength, he obviously couldn't gain any advantage.
"It's him!" Wulu couldn't help but express his shock upon seeing the newcomer.
"Brother Wulu recognizes this person?" Yuan Ming asked upon seeing his reaction.
"I was recently assigned to Qingfu Hall for a task and saw the collected tomes of the Southern Border's major powers' important figures kept by our sect. If I'm not mistaken, this person is the Southern Border Squad Leader of the Dawn Alliance, the Core Formation Stage Loose Cultivator Ou Ji," Wulu explained.
Yuan Ming looked toward the three people in the sky, then turned his gaze to the crowd opposite them, his thoughts racing.
He had come here with the main troop because he hadn't found an opportunity to escape along the way, and also because he wanted to see how strong the attackers were and their numbers.
Seeing the situation before him, he already had a rough idea.
This time, it seemed Biluo Cave was in big trouble. He wondered whether the mysterious Great Elder would truly appear and if he indeed had the power to turn the tide.
"Ou Ji, Biluo Cave and your Dawn Alliance have no past grudges, nor any recent conflict. Leading your people to attack the gates of Biluo Cave, do you intend to blatantly violate the Ten Rules of the North Territory?" the Great Cave Master asked with a heavy voice.
A long time ago, the cultivation forces of the Southern Border and Northern Territory had formed an alliance to resist powerful enemies, establishing ten rules known as the Ten Rules of the North Territory, governing the behavior of Cultivation Sects.
Although the alliance exists in name only now, the Ten Rules of the North Territory were still recognized and followed by all sects even today. One of the rules states: no wanton attacks on other forces are allowed.
"So Biluo Cave also knows about the North Territory's ten rules. Then, Fellow Daoist Mao, do you remember the third rule, 'Do not wantonly kill mortals!' Over the years, your Biluo Cave has been capturing mortals wantonly, killing those without a Spirit Root and enslaving people with poor innate Spirit Roots as Beast Slaves, causing the population of the Southern Border and Northern Territory to continuously decline. How do you explain this?" Ou Ji asked with a cold laugh.
"Nonsense! Biluo Cave has always acted in accordance with the rules. When have we ever massively killed mortals!" the Great Cave Master promptly denied, with a sense of righteousness rising in his heart.
"Is that so? Ma, come out," Ou Ji said with a light smile, turning his head to call out.
A figure flew out from the group of people in black clothes and landed beside Ou Ji; it was a young man with sharp eyebrows and starry eyes who had the appearance of a Central Plains person.
"Ma Xingkong!"
"He's actually still alive!"
The Biluo Cave disciples were in an uproar.
Yuan Ming's eyes showed a hint of surprise as he observed the young man with sharp eyebrows.
The reputation of Ma Xingkong was something he had heard of for a long time. To this day, he was still a target on the execution list of the Biluo Cave's Execution Hall. After leaving the sect, had he also joined the Dawn Alliance?
"Fellow Daoist Mao, this Ma is surely someone you recognize. He was once a distinguished disciple of Biluo Cave. As for whether your sect has killed mortals, he knows best," Ou Ji remarked indifferently.
The Great Cave Master appeared expressionless and calm, but internally he was becoming increasingly anxious.
Ma Xingkong had risen from being a Fur Beast Slave with low status in Biluo Cave. He had also participated in several mortal slaughtering missions to collect souls afterward and knew the whole process like the back of his hand. If he were to speak out now, it would be troublesome.
With his cultivation, it would take only a moment to kill the man, or even use Spiritual Pressure to crush him outright. But with Ou Ji's protection, he was helpless.
"Captain Ou Ji, the crime of Biluo Cave violating the North Territory's ten rules and killing mortals is undeniably true! During the years I was with Biluo Cave, I was forced to partake in nine mortal slaughters to collect souls, with each mission resulting in the deaths of several hundred. These details of the nine missions can be verified," Ma Xingkong said as he took out a White Jade Plate and infused it with mana.
The Jade Plate grew in size with the wind. Lines of text appeared on it, detailing the dates, locations, and number of people killed for each mission.
The expressions of the Biluo Cave disciples grew unnatural upon seeing this. Such missions to kill and collect souls were something they had all heard of, with many having directly participated in them. At the time, they simply thought the contribution points were good and saw nothing amiss.
"Ma Xingkong is a defected disciple of Biluo Cave. His words are untrustworthy, mere slander," the Great Cave Master maintained his composure as he spoke.
"I knew you'd deny it outright. See if you can deny this," Ma Xingkong said with a cold smile, raising a blue orb.The latest chapters are always available first on *.
A bright blue light shot from the orb, spinning and transforming into a blue water screen which revealed scenes of Biluo Cave disciples slaughtering mortals and collecting souls.
In the Cultivation World, there exists a special kind of Recording Artifact that can document past events, and this blue orb was clearly one of them.
The Great Cave Master's heart sank. With so many recorded scenes as evidence, the fact of Biluo Cave killing mortals could no longer be argued.
"For the confirmed crime of Biluo Cave killing mortals, my Dawn Alliance's actions today are but the execution of heaven's punishment. Attack!" Ou Ji shouted loudly.
The Dawn Alliance members shouted in unison and charged, while Biluo Cave's people hurriedly countered. Magic artifacts clashed, spells collided against each other, and the spectacle was truly magnificent.
With the Great Cave Master present to anchor the line, Yuan Ming had no choice but to charge forward with the person beside him, wielding the Nine-Ring Gold Saber to block a Black Shuttle Magic Tool.
The owner of the Black Shuttle Magic Tool was a tall and slim man whose cultivation had reached the peak of the Qi Refining Stage. His Black Shuttle Magic Tool was quite extraordinary as well, having attained mid-grade status; as it danced about, bursts of black flames exploded from it, creating several indistinguishable real and fake shadows that were quite mystical.
However, Yuan Ming's mana was much more profound than the other's and his Divine Sense was even more powerful, so no matter how the Black Shuttle Magic Tool changed, it could not escape his divine perception.
The Nine-Ring Gold Saber transformed into nine golden saber shadows, forming a golden net that easily trapped the Black Shuttle Magic Tool.
The tall and thin man, no matter how he urged the Black Shuttle, could not break out from the enclosure of the golden net, and he knew that the other's strength was greater than his own. Yet, other than maintaining a stance of combat with him, the opponent did not increase the aggression, which made him hesitate on whether to advance or retreat.
Yuan Ming took control of the situation, allowing the other to gain a slight advantage on purpose, wary of being ambushed by other members of the Dawn. His gaze swept over the nearby battles.
He saw Wu Lu rush up as well, pointing a finger toward the sky before clashing with a member of the Dawn Scatter Alliance. Both of their cultivations were comparable, and the power of their magic artifacts was similar, neither being able to overcome the other for the time being.
When it came to numbers, there was little difference between the two sides. The disciples of Biluo Cave were slightly less intimidating in momentum, but with the help of spirit beasts and the advantage of the terrain, neither side showed a clear strength or weakness.
In the midst of the sky, Xue Zhan was no longer confronting the Great Cave Master with Ou Ji's help. The three unleashed their techniques, engaging in an aerial battle across the void.
Faced with wave after wave of attacks from the two, the Great Cave Master struggled a bit, yet the large white net he drove, spiraling and flying in the surroundings, growing large and then shrinking, both offensive and defensive, made Ou Ji and Xue Zhan wary of pressing too close.
Meanwhile, the great python of the Foundation Establishment Stage that he had summoned coiled around the trio, waiting for an opportunity to strike. With well-founded advance and retreat, it also prevented Ou Ji and the other from focusing entirely on the Great Cave Master.
Yuan Ming silently commended the Great Cave Master for his way of dealing with opponents. The current state of the battle seemed manageable, and if the side of Biluo Cave could stabilize the situation and endure until the arrival of that mysterious Great Elder, perhaps they could survive this crisis.
A deathly scream not far away suddenly pierced the air, followed by the dissipation of a strong wave of mana, clearly signaling the demise of a Foundation Establishment Cultivator.
Yuan Ming swiftly glanced over in the direction of the scream.
He saw a red-faced bald elder of Biluo Cave lying on the ground face-up, with a bloody hole in his forehead from which red and white matter oozed out.
Standing in front of the red-faced elder was a white-clothed young man with his mouth corners turned up, his face smeared with colorful oils. A thin strand of golden light flickered incessantly between his fingers.
"It's him!" Yuan Ming's pupils contracted.
Even though he had changed his attire, Yuan Ming would not mistake the appearance of this white-clothed young man, who was none other than the clown who had openly committed murder on the streets of Black Rock City.
The white-clothed young man put away the red-faced elder's storage magic tool and continued to dart out, pouncing toward another tall, bearded elder of Biluo Cave not far away.
The gold light from his fingertips shot out first, aiming for the back of the bearded elder's heart.
The bearded elder, who had been fervently fighting with a Dawn Foundation Establishment cultivator, had been keeping an eye on the white-clothed young man. Seeing this scene, he hurriedly used his spirit beast to block the Dawn Foundation Establishment cultivator while dodging to the side himself.
It seemed that the man had also cultivated a Step Technique, as he was quite agile and barely managed to dodge the golden light's attack.
The white-clothed young man opened his mouth and spat out a mass of liquid emitting a blue glow, spreading rapidly in all directions, enveloping the bearded elder.
The blue-glowing liquid instantly expanded to a size of seven or eight zhang, and its speed was extremely fast. The bearded elder had no chance to evade and had to call forth a red copper mirror to defend.
The mirror spun rapidly, swelling to several zhang in size in an instant, facing the descending blue light and blocking it in mid-air, preventing it from falling.
Before the bearded elder could make another move, a golden shadow struck, the very strand of thin golden light that had missed its mark earlier now shooting at him again from the side.
The bearded elder hurriedly controlled the copper mirror to defend. The surface of the mirror shone with spirit light without any irregularities, but after a tremble, it inexplicably became immobile.
The blue-glowing liquid contained a strong stickiness, and the copper mirror was firmly stuck in it, unable to move even slightly, while the thin strand of golden light had already reached the bearded elder's face.
"Damn it!" The bearded elder had no choice but to give up controlling the copper mirror and quickly maneuvered again to evade.
But the white-clothed young man appeared in front of him at some point, raising his hand and slashing three golden light blades horizontally, aimed straight at the bearded elder's neck.
The bearded elder was startled and slapped his Spiritual Beast Bag at his waist.
A black giant spider, about a zhang tall, flew out from the bag. It had a glossy black body likened to golden iron and two front limbs like large sabers, which moved extraordinarily nimbly to meet the golden light blades.
The white-clothed young man let out a soft laugh, made a gesture with one hand, and somehow the three golden light blades pierced through the giant spider's defenses. One of them "swooshed" through, severing half of the spider's head, while the other two chopped fiercely into the bearded elder.
A layer of black light surged from the garb the bearded elder wore, which also appeared to be a magic artifact. However, when the two golden light blades sliced down, it completely collapsed and dispersed.
Fear showed in the bearded elder's eyes as he raised his hand to do something, but it was already too late.
The thin strand of golden light pierced into his skull from behind and shot out through his forehead.
The divine light in the bearded elder's eyes faded in an instant, and his corpse thunderously fell to the ground.

chapters.title: Chapter 211 - 191: So You're the Traitor
chapters.content:
The white-robed youth retracted the viscous blue light, casually stowed away the black-bearded elder's copper mirror and storage magic tool, and continued to rush toward the next Foundation Establishment Cultivator of Biluo Cave.
"This person is exceedingly formidable!" Even though it was the second time he saw the other's techniques, Yuan Ming couldn't help but inwardly exclaim in astonishment.
Due to the emergence of this youth and his incredibly bizarre methods, the nearby Foundation Establishment Cultivators of Biluo Cave all harbored apprehension, starting to be distracted and didn't dare to give their full effort, while the Qi Refining Stage Cultivators, out of fear, also began to fight while retreating.
On the contrary, the morale of the Dawn Alliance soared, and their offensive was as swift and forceful as a tide.
At this moment, the battle situation was delicate; pulling one hair would move the whole body, causing the entire defensive line of Biluo Cave to begin to falter.
Just then, a beam of white light shot from afar, arriving instantly at the gate, revealing a burly figure of a black-bearded elder, none other than the Second Cave Master.
Without a word, he raised his hand and waved, a beam of arm-thick green light landed next to the gate on the ground, sinking into it.
The ground there thunderously vibrated, erupting with an astonishing mana fluctuation from beneath, but it quickly dissipated and vanished.
Seeing this scene, everyone nearby was filled with uncertainty.
Unable to take down the Great Cave Master in a short time and unsure of the Second Cave Master's intentions, Ou Ji and Xue Zhan exchanged glances then simultaneously withdrew from the battle.
"Are you ready?" The Great Cave Master, slightly out of breath, felt a surge of joy in his heart and asked through spiritual voice transmission.
"All seven Array Eye Stone Pillars have been activated, and we can mobilize the Sect Protection Array at any moment," replied the Second Cave Master through spiritual voice transmission.
"Good, deploy the array immediately!" The Great Cave Master's eyes shone brightly.
"Some Qi Refining disciples have fought their way far from here, and the Sect Protection Array might not cover them. Should we order the disciples to regroup before deploying the array?" the Second Cave Master hesitated momentarily before asking through spiritual voice transmission.
"There's no time to worry about that! Xue Zhan may be one thing, but Ou Ji is exceedingly astute. Any action now will only add variables. Deploy the array first. For the sake of Biluo Cave's foundation, sacrificing some Qi Refining disciples is of no consequence!" the Great Cave Master coldly transmitted back.
The Second Cave Master, upon hearing this, said no more, flipped his hand out a green disc, engraved with complex runes, and started to trigger it.
The ground near the gate shook, and a black stone platform quickly emerged from the place where the surge of mana had burst forth, its entire body carved with countless runes and lines, emanating a piercing green light.
Elder Chu Xiong of the Execution Hall shot out and landed on the platform, his body also emitting streaks of green light, resonating with the platform's glow.
His hands quickly formed seals, green light on the stone pillar swiftly gathered, and in the blink of an eye, it transformed into a green beam of light that shot straight into the sky.
Almost simultaneously, six other beams of heaven-reaching green light rose from other directions around Biluo Cave, each beam also emanating from a stone platform, with each one guarded by a Foundation Establishment Cultivator of Biluo Cave.
These seven beams of light formed a ring, enclosing the entire Biluo Cave, including part of the rear mountain.
"Go!" The Second Cave Master in mid-air waved his hand, and the green disc in front of him shot up into the sky at a tremendous speed, reaching a great height in the blink of an eye.
With a thunderous "boom", the green disc burst forth with blinding green light, too dazzling to look at directly, resembling a small green sun.
The seven heaven-reaching beams of light attracted by the green disc all bent towards it, merging into the small green sun.
The Second Cave Master's fingers danced quickly forming seals, a green light screen emanated from the disc, sliding down along the seven curved beams of light, seeming to form a huge hemispherical light screen that would encompass the entire Biluo Cave Sect, with the seven stone platforms marking its boundaries.
The green light screen descended rapidly, soon about to completely reach the ground.
Seeing this, the disciples of Biluo Cave outside the gate hurriedly rushed toward the inside.
Being left outside the green light screen was definitely a road to death.
At this moment, Yuan Ming was still entangled with the tall thin man, far from the gate. Seeing this, he urgently recalled his Nine-Ring Gold Saber, too dashed toward the inside of the gate.
"Don't run!" Seeing this, the tall thin man, while urging his Black Shuttle Magic Tool to chase, also shot a green rope magic tool from his sleeve targeting Yuan Ming's legs.
Yuan Ming, not looking back, swung his hand in the air, releasing two streams of white Sword Qi which accurately struck the Black Shuttle and the green rope, causing them to pause momentarily, unable to continue the chase.
Yuan Ming spurred his jade belt and further employed the Shadowless Step Technique. His entire person sped up, and in the next moment, he appeared at the gate, flying in.
A shadow, only a half-step slower than him, also dashed into the gate, it was Wulu.
Continuously, a few more disciples retreated back through the gate, and with a loud "boom", the green light screen touched down on the ground, forming the Sect Protection Array like a huge overturned bowl, leaving many disciples who had not managed to get inside isolated outside!
The Dawn Alliance had already been prevailing, but suddenly a light screen separated them from the Biluo Cave disciples, instantly losing their advantageous position, filling them with both shock and rage, and they fiercely struck the light screen with various magic tools, causing only mild vibration where the green light screen was hit.
Ou Ji and Xue Zhan also descended from midair, hovering in front of the green light screen.
With their Divine Skills, it would not have been difficult to enter the green light screen's interior just moments ago, but it was far too dangerous for just the two of them; they would have been surrounded and doomed on the spot by Biluo Cave.
Ou Ji raised one hand and snapped his fingers, launching a thick black Divine Thunder towards the green light screen, producing an explosive sound akin to a thunderclap.
This was Kui Water Divine Thunder, a Divine Skill that could only be performed by those who had reached an advanced level in Water System Techniques.
The green light screen vibrated intensely, the area hit by the water thunder noticeably thinned out by a significant amount.
But the surrounding green light quickly converged once again, and the green light screen was restored in a matter of breaths.
Ou Ji raised an eyebrow, lowered his arm, and ordered sternly, "The opponent's Sect Protection Array is already in place, but it is not impregnable. Everyone heed my command and attack with all your might!"
Upon hearing this, the members of the Dawn Alliance nearby unfolded various methods and struck with all their strength.
For a moment, a myriad of magic artifacts, spirit beasts, and refining corpses were unceasingly summoned into use.
The Dawn Alliance members hailed from complex backgrounds, possessing a vast array of attack methods, including Divine Skills and secret techniques from the Five Sects of the Southern Border and even other areas of the Southern Border.
Amid the "rumbling" sounds of explosions, bursts of multicolored light continuously detonated on the surface of the green light screen, generating ripples of various colors that intensified the vibrations in the air.
Inside the Sect Protection Array, the disciples, feeling the fierce assaults from the Dawn side, all wore tense expressions and were left uneasy.
Meanwhile, a few Dawn members who had momentarily followed inside were immediately surrounded and killed by the Biluo Cave Disciples.
Yuan Ming, who had been holding the Heart-splitting Bomb in his hand all this time, put it away and looked toward Wulu. Seeing his heaving chest and grave expression, it was clear he hadn't recovered from his earlier tension.
He then looked beyond the array, where the Biluo Cave Disciples who hadn't managed to escape inside were utterly powerless below the concentrated attacks of the Dawn Organization members.
Seeing that they were isolated outside by the array, more and more individuals began to surrender, ceasing their resistance. The fighters from the Dawn confiscated their storage bags and placed a type of circlet magic artifact on each captive's head and neck.
Those inside the Sect Protection Array could only watch helplessly, continuing to rely on the defense of the great array to cope with the enemy's attacks.
Fortunately, this Sect Protection Array was fairly robust. Despite the incessant bombings that shook it tremendously, causing the ground to quake continuously, it never collapsed.
"What's going on, why hasn't the auxiliary array outside the Sect responded?" Elder Chu Xiong, guarding a part of the array, looked toward the distant exterior of the light screen and could not help but frown.
"Is that even a question? It must have been tampered with secretly long ago." Elder Saren, who had come here to support, frowned and responded after a moment.
"Impossible, we have continuously strengthened patrols. If the outside auxiliary arrays were damaged, it would definitely be discovered," Elder Chu Xiong said, finding it hard to believe.
"The cause must be investigated after this matter ends," Elder Saren replied with a grave expression.The canonical source for this content: *.
Upon hearing the conversation between the two, Yuan Ming's expression immediately grew complex.
He suddenly recalled that during the hunt for the Human Demon King, he and Chen Wan had followed a possibly spiritually intelligent Human Demon into an underground cave.
There, he had seen an ancient stele, about six feet tall, engraved with the characters "Hu Shou."
At that time, he didn't know what it was, but now recalling the patterns on it, they were clearly runes of an Array, likely the auxiliary array outside the Sect mentioned by Elder Saren.
With the protection of the Sect Protection Array, those disciples who had retreated back to the mountain gate by chance, felt as if they had a new lease on life when they saw the array couldn't be breached. They were all beaming, having completely forgotten about the countless disciples stranded outside the mountain gate.
Regardless of what others thought, any remaining debt of gratitude Yuan Ming felt for Biluo Cave dissolved at that moment.
All he wanted was to rush back to the Fire Refining Hall to see the situation there.
If there was any place left in the entire Biluo Cave that he still cared about, it would be there.
After making up his mind, Yuan Ming decided not to stay here any longer. He shifted his gaze to Wulu and intended to call him to leave together.
But at that moment, he noticed that Wulu had already turned around and was walking towards the inside of the Sect.
"Wulu, the situation is critical this time. I fear that without the Great Elder's intervention, we cannot wrap this up. It might be better if we look after each other. But you go ahead and leave, I still have some things to take care of," Yuan Ming hurriedly caught up and whispered.
Turning to look at him, Wulu smiled faintly, gave Yuan Ming a knowing wink, and said.
Yuan Ming, upon hearing this, slightly frowned and gave Wulu a deep look, then immediately turned and left.
As Yuan Ming walked a good distance away, the smile on Wulu's face gradually faded, and his expression turned serious again.
He walked slowly toward an elder and suddenly spoke in a voice so low that only the two of them could hear, "Son, kneel down and call me 'Dad,' and I'll spare your worthless life."
The provoked elder angrily reached out to strangle Wulu.
But Wulu, as if he had been suddenly slapped, tapped the ground with the tip of his foot and flew backward.
In mid-air, his hands flailed above and below in an uncontrollable manner.
"So, you are the traitor!" Wulu shouted loudly, his voice resonating like thunder on a clear day.
Upon hearing the shout, Yuan Ming turned to see the scene and couldn't help but be startled.
The surrounding Biluo Cave Disciples were even more baffled, their attention previously focusing solely on the enemy's attack on the Sect Protection Array, clueless to what had transpired.
However, Elder Saren and Elder Chu Xiong were the first to react, frowning as they looked this way.

chapters.title: Chapter 212 - 192 Break Array
chapters.content:
At that moment, Wulu didn't know what had happened, but his chest was soaked in crimson, as if he had spat out half a bowl of blood, looking pitiful as he staggered to his feet and charged toward the two elders, stumbling over.
As he ran, spitting blood, he cried out, "Elder, that scoundrel is a spy from Dawn, catch him!"
Elder Saren, even though he hadn't figured out what was going on, believed Wulu somewhat when he saw his condition.
His figure flashed, and he rapidly pounced toward that elder.
The elder, seeing Wulu's appearance but not yet aware of what had transpired, stood frozen in place for a moment.
Just as Elder Saren closed in rapidly, his hand reached out through the air toward that elder. In the void, five beams of black light appeared out of nowhere, converging around him.
Just as he was about to be bound, the elder finally reacted, frantically trying to dodge while repeatedly crying out, "I didn't... he's framing..."
Before he could finish his sentence, the five beams of black light viciously pressed down and heavily pinned him to the ground.
"Ah..."
Just as Elder Saren was about to question him closely, a dreadful scream suddenly came from behind him.
He was shocked and quickly turned around, only to see a sight that terrified him.
Wulu, who had just appeared to be seriously injured, had now reached the Array platform. In his hand was an all-black serpentine longsword, which he had thrust through the heart of Elder Chu Xiong from behind.
And Wulu had actually achieved the cultivation of the Foundation Establishment stage.
Yuan Ming was startled for a moment, then a flash of understanding crossed his mind.
He had long felt that Wulu's past behavior was mysterious, giving him an unfathomable feeling. Now, combining today's events with the past, everything seemed to connect into a single thread.
Elder Chu Xiong, as the Master Elder of the Execution Hall, had reached the late stage of Foundation Establishment, one of the few top Foundation Establishment practitioners in the Sect apart from the three Cave Masters. At that moment, on one hand, he was fully focused on operating the Array Eye, and on the other, he completely did not anticipate Wulu's sudden betrayal, allowing himself to be caught off guard by the attack.
This person's cunning and skill were exceptional; he had always concealed his cultivation, sending a chill down Yuan Ming's spine.
"You're the traitor!" Elder Saren bellowed furiously, immediately abandoning the previous elder and lunged toward Wulu.
"You're quite the clever one, aren't you!" Wulu's mouth curled into a deep, sinister smile, as he lifted his sword to impale Elder Chu Xiong and tossed him off the platform.
Elder Chu Xiong's body tumbled to the ground, life already fled from his form.
Following that, Wulu's serpentine longsword emitted a layer of black sword light and violently stabbed into the platform beneath.
"Boom"
The platform's Array, upon the longsword's insertion, instantly dimmed, and the straight green Light Pillar also collapsed, leaving a great gap in the Sect Protection Array like a corner of the sky had caved in.
All this happened in the blink of an eye; Elder Saren was still in mid-air, rage filling his eyes as he raised his palm.
As he pushed his palm forward, a flash of cold light streaked from the center of his palm. An icicle materialized out of thin air, leaving a trail of light in the void before flashing in front of Wulu in an instant.
Wulu seemed to have anticipated this, waving his hand to draw down a curtain in front of him, revealing a Black Silk that blocked the incoming icicle.
With a "whoosh" sound!
The Black Silk was immediately indented, bulging inward at the tip, almost touching Wulu's chest.
Under Wulu's full-force operation, the Black Silk ultimately withstood the Ice Cone.
As the thrusting force of the Ice Cone slowed, a terrifying coldness burst forth from it, penetrating the Black Silk and seeping through, instantly frosting over half of Wulu's chest with White Frost.
But then, a surge of light suddenly intensified around Wulu, not only dissolving the White Frost but even repelling Elder Saren's Ice Cone.
"This man must have at least reached the mid-stage of Foundation Establishment!" Yuan Ming thought, no longer able to remain calm.
Wulu was likely a sleeper agent that Dawn had planted there early on. Thinking back, the disruption of the subsidiary Array mentioned by Elder Saren was most likely his doing as well.
Yuan Ming reflected on their first encounter when both he and Wulu had been Fur Beast Slaves, feeling a flood of emotions.
"Wulu, you're ruthless!"
At that moment, he suddenly thought of something else.
Wulu must possess some extraordinary Cultivation Technique that allowed him to forcibly disguise his Foundation Establishment stage cultivation as an ordinary person with only a Spirit Root and no Qi Refinement, deceiving everyone!
Could it be that Dawn had plotted the downfall of Biluo Cave even before Yuan Ming had entered?
With preparations made, naturally, they would not be limited to these few tricks.
Now, with a breach in the Great Array, the forces of the Dawn Organization that had been besieging from the outside began to swarm in en masse, rushing to penetrate the breach.
Yuan Ming glanced over and immediately recognized a few familiar faces, all charging in his direction.
The most conspicuous among them was the white-robed youth with his face smeared with colorful paint, who once again wore that somewhat comical pointed cap on his head, his face alight with excitement.
Between the movements of his hands, golden Light Blades whirled and danced, severing limbs and sending flesh flying wherever they passed.
Not far from him, Yuan Ming also spotted Bai Ye and Huan Shi rushing over.
Compared to the clownish youth who was seeing red, Bai Ye and Huan Shi both seemed to be fishing in troubled waters to some extent.
Seeing a large number of enemies pouring in from this location, Elder Saren could only grit his teeth, give up on Wulu, threw out a Communication Talisman, and called for everyone to tighten their defenses against the incoming attackers.
The disciples and elders, who had just narrowly escaped death, were forced to meet the battle, each summoning their spirit beasts to charge at the pursuing cultivators from the Dawn Alliance. Suddenly, the sect gate descended into another round of chaotic combat.
Yuan Ming had originally intended to abandon the situation and leave, but after a moment's delay, the Dawn forces were already upon him, forcing him to draw his Cold Star Sword to face the enemy.
Two Dawn cultivators attacked from both sides—one holding a black round mirror, which shone a black light directly at Yuan Ming, causing him to stiffen, as if mired in mud, slowing his movements.
The other wielded a long sword and attacked from the side, fervently swinging down to strike.
Yuan Ming was sluggish in his response, and just as he was about to be struck by the sword, the green gemstone on his waistband suddenly flashed with spirit light, lightening his body. He abruptly shifted to the side, narrowly avoiding the blade.
At the same time, he slashed his long sword at his attacker.
A bitter cold Wind Blade screamed out, and the attacker's jade pendant at his waist lit up as well, casting a green light that enveloped his whole body.
The next moment, a "crack" of shattering sound echoed.
The attacker's jade pendant broke, the protective green light shattered, and he fell to the ground, frozen stiff.
The other person with the black round mirror turned it around and shined it again, but was met with an intensely burning flame arrow.
The surging flames blocked the dark light from the black mirror.
As the "Rocket Talisman" on Yuan Ming's fingertip burned out, another black needle appeared in his palm and shot out with a "swoosh," piercing through the void.
The Black Needle flashed through the air and then disappeared from sight.
By the time the man with the mirror reacted, the needle, having passed through the flames ignited by the Rocket Talisman, brushed against the edge of the black round mirror and "hissed" as it entered his forehead.
The man's body stiffened and he fell back rigidly.
Yuan Ming casually beckoned, summoning the Black Needle back to him with the Beast Taming Technique and quickly pocketed it.
His movements were efficient and decisive; he had eliminated two enemies in practically just an exchange of blows.
Elder Saren had also taken note of the situation and suddenly felt that everything he had seen and heard today was too fantastical and overturned his previous understanding. First, there was Wulu, a traitor who could kill a Foundation Establishment elder in one blow, and now a Qi Refining disciple with exceptional strength had emerged; and from their outfits, both previously appeared to be merely Registered Disciples.
In fact, Yuan Ming had once met Elder Saren and reported on his mission after completing a task for the Beast Slave Hall. At that time, the elder hardly paid attention to him, his focus entirely on the matter of Kun Tu and the others being killed, barely granting Yuan Ming a second glance.
And ever since then, Yuan Ming had remained low-profile, never revealing his skills within the sect, which is why he had stayed under the radar until today.
Having momentarily extricated himself from the fray, Yuan Ming's gaze searched for Wulu's figure.
He saw that Wulu had already fled in the direction outside the sect gate.
Yuan Ming's gaze sharpened, and he saw that when Wulu encountered members of Dawn who came to tangle with him, he would extend the middle finger and index finger of his left hand, crossing them to deliberately show the other party.
Upon seeing this, the opponents would indeed fly past him as if they hadn't seen him at all, no longer attacking or obstructing him.
"Sure enough, it's a secret sign," Yuan Ming thought rapidly, considering in his mind.
"Boom"
Another loud explosion echoed.
The platform standing inside the sect gate, unattended, was shattered by a figure that descended from the sky with a punch.
The blasted rocks scattered in all directions, like a meteor shower, injuring the surrounding Qi Refining disciples severely.
As that foundation of the Array completely collapsed, the Sect Protection Array, which had only been maintained for a short while, began to fall apart. The green light barrier shrouding the entire sect shattered piece by piece, dissipating into nothingness.This content is hosted at *.
The entire Biluo Cave's gates were flung open, heralding the Dawn Organization's full-scale invasion.
"Retreat, retreat quickly..."
Elder Saren called out loudly, leading the elder disciples toward the three peaks to seek refuge.
At that moment, a figure from the Dawn Organization suddenly leaped out and landed beside Elder Chu Xiong's body.
Yuan Ming had intended to leave directly, but after seeing the person's actions, he couldn't help but look over.
He seemed to be in his forties, with a tall figure, a dignified and warrior-like appearance, with brows perennially furrowed, giving him a worried and sorrowful look.
The man knelt down to examine Elder Chu Xiong's corpse for a moment, and a look of pain and regret swiftly crossed his face.
He then produced a curiously shaped long-hooked scimitar, hooked the blade against Chu Xiong's neck, stepped on his head, and pulled hard.
Elder Chu Xiong was already dead, but his head was still severed and rolled to the side.
The majestic middle-aged man seemed unsatisfied, his gaze scanning the battlefield until it locked on Elder Saren.
The next moment, his aura surged wildly, as if all his anger had ignited, and he stomped hard on the ground, his black boots shining with light.
He shot up from the ground, leaping more than ten feet into the air, and heavily smashed down toward Elder Saren.

chapters.title: Chapter 213 - 193 Body Cultivation Shows Off
chapters.content:
"The Dawn Organization really is a gathering of hidden dragons and crouching tigers. The strength of this person's aura suggests that he must also be a late-stage Foundation Establishment Cultivator!" Yuan Ming's gaze narrowed slightly upon seeing this scene.
During his contemplation, the valiant middle-aged man swiftly descended with a knife in one hand. While still seven or eight zhang away, the long-hooked scimitar already chopped down towards Elder Saren.
Golden light burst forth from the blade, and a substantial crescent-shaped light swept down like a scythe.
Due to the opponent's swift speed, Elder Saren, out of desperation, had only enough time to slap a talisman paper onto himself, transforming it into a layer of light green protective shield. At the same time, he maneuvered a round earthen yellow shield to meet the oncoming attack.
With a 'bang', an explosion resounded!
The earthen yellow round shield shattered on impact, unleashing a circular shock wave that swept around, and Elder Saren's protective shield was also shattered by the residual force of the blade light, sending him tumbling and crashing out.
The Qi Refining disciples nearby were affected by the shock wave, resulting in a chaotic scene of people and horses overturned.
Elder Saren managed to create some distance from the valiant middle-aged man with the momentum, and upon standing up, he had a short fork in his hand poised in front of his chest, his gaze sweeping over the bloody head of Elder Chu Xiong not far away.
'Who are you?'
He could also see that this person obviously had an issue with him, yet he did not remember knowing the man.
"You may not recognize me, but I recognize you! Do you still remember my son Long Xi?" the valiant middle-aged man's eyes blazed with fury as he bellowed.
Elder Saren's expression suddenly stiffened upon hearing these words.
Yuan Ming also sharply caught his breath, finally recalling the figure and those eyes filled with despair.
The Human Demon King!
Yuan Ming thought to himself. No wonder the aura of the valiant middle-aged man seemed familiar. If his guess was correct, he was mostly likely the Human Demon King's father, Long Hao, the current clan leader of a hidden cultivation family in the Southern Border.
That day, he and Xi Ying had joined forces to battle the severely injured Human Demon King. In the final moments, the Human Demon King, relying on his strong willpower, had regained a portion of his Divine Sense and revealed his origins to Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming was then able to learn that his true name was Long Xi, the son of a clan leader of a cultivation family from the Southern Border, who was mistakenly captured as a Beast Slave by Elder Chu Xiong and brought to Biluo Cave.
It was Elder Saren, who was responsible for the assessment, who discovered his exceptional potential as a Dual Spirit Root Cultivator and further confirmed his true identity.
But by then, the mistake had been made. Instead of rectifying their error, Elder Chu Xiong and Elder Saren, to cover up their wrongdoing, concealed the results of the assessment.
They neither released Long Xi nor sent him into the sect for focused training, as would have been customary, but instead condemned him as a Beast Slave and banished him to the Ten Thousand Mountains.T^his. chap#ter-'s- tru#e% s%o$u%rce is My Virtua-l Li#b*r!a!ry Em-pi^r@e# (#*.).
Long Xi, having exceptional potential, was likely to evolve from a Human Demon into a king.
To obtain the Soul Pearl of the Human Demon King, the two of them intentionally persecuted him, forcing him to frequently use the Fur Cloak Technique, leading him to gradually transform step by step until he became the Human Demon King.
"Did you think that the things you've done would remain unnoticed?" Long Hao stepped closer, a dense killing intent in his eyes.
Elder Saren knew that further words were useless and promptly slapped his Spiritual Beast Bag at his waist.
Next instant, a Green Wolf Spirit Beast with two huge heads appeared at his side.
This Green Wolf had one bluish-black eye and one crimson eye, emitting two distinctly different waves of Spiritual Power, both reaching the level of a Second-level Demon Beast.
"Kill."
At Elder Saren's command, the short fork in his hand transformed into a streak of purple light that shot towards Long Hao, while the huge two-headed Green Wolf, one zhang high and three zhang long, also fiercely pounced on him.
At the same time, the pupils of its two heads lit up and opened their blood basins wide.
The right head took the lead and spat out intense Flames, followed by the left head, which spurted out a blue gale.
The blue gale, carrying the Flames, did not scatter them but, with the force of the wind, enhanced the fire's ferocity, creating a huge flaming tornado, which, along with the purple light of the short fork, charged directly at Long Hao.
"Well met!" Long Hao advanced instead of retreating, gripping the long-hooked scimitar with both hands. Golden light surged into the blade, and with a horizontal slash, he deflected the incoming purple light.
The next instant, he raised the long blade above his head once more, and blinding golden light erupted from it.
"Break."
With a low shout, he chopped down with the long blade, and the golden light burst forth, extending into a winding blade light tens of zhang long.
Golden light shattered the fire dragon, and the gale swept all around.
Amidst the spreading flames, the valiant figure charged straight through, advancing with an unstoppable momentum, reaching the two-headed Green Wolf, and delivering another slash.
Beneath the golden blade light was the eruption of all his furious emotions.
The two-headed Green Wolf let out a pitiful howl, its body split in two down the middle, torn apart.
Yuan Ming watched this scene and couldn't help but tense up.
This Second-level Demon Beast Green Wolf was simply no match for Long Hao at all.
Elder Saren was too alarmed to mourn the loss of his Spirit Beast, which he had been nurturing for many years.
He had originally thought that with the cooperation of the Spirit Beast, he could easily suppress Long Hao. However, before he could take further action, the Spirit Beast was killed.
Long Hao, wielding a long-hooked scimitar, was emanating a murderous aura as he relentlessly advanced step by step toward Elder Saren.
The latter had already lost all courage to fight and turned to flee toward the direction of the three main peaks.
"Where do you think you're going?"
Long Hao let out a sinister laugh, grasped his long knife, and dashed forward several steps. Using the momentum of his charge, he leapt high into the air, reaching more than ten zhang, then like a falling meteor he smashed down toward Elder Saren.
His muscles were not particularly exaggerated, but his whole figure seemed to be brimming with explosive power. His movements were succinct, yet each strike was imbued with devastating force.
Yuan Ming watched and suddenly realized—was this Long Hao a rare Body Cultivator?
Just as Long Hao was about to catch up with Elder Saren, the latter suddenly halted his flight. Spinning around, he brought one hand to his mouth and, facing the person pursuing him from high in the sky, he bellowed.
Yuan Ming focused his eyes and saw something resembling a small, concealed arrow tube in the hand Elder Saren was holding to his lips.
A green steel needle, its surface coated with a sheen of green light, flashed on the surface of the object and shot out with incredible speed, aiming straight for Long Hao's chest.
The latter, flying in mid-air with no leverage, found it impossible to twist his body or dodge.
With a low shout from his mouth and a burst of light from his eyes, his skin turned pitch black in an instant.
The next moment, the evidently poisoned steel needle pierced his clothes and struck his chest.
With a "ding" of a crisp sound,
the green steel needle bounced off his exceedingly hard chest and fell toward the ground.
Long Hao's descent was not slowed in the slightest, and as he landed, he swung his blade at Elder Saren.
Seeing his hidden weapon attack fail, Elder Saren, with no time to evade, suddenly grabbed into the void behind him with a reverse grip, pulling out an ominous red golden gourd copper hammer.
He took a step, pivoting on the spot, and managed to dodge the swing of the blade.
Simultaneously, he swung the golden gourd copper hammer behind him in a half-circle, aiming for Long Hao's back.
Long Hao, having missed with his strike, landed heavily on the ground.
The hard, rocky surface shattered upon impact, and he was simultaneously struck hard on his back.
Long Hao grunted, his body involuntarily lunging forward.
But at the same time, he curled the fingers of his right hand inward, changing his palm to a claw, and violently grabbed backward.
His now pitch-black hand, like a ghostly claw, tore through the fabric of Elder Saren's chest, leaving behind glaring bloodstains and dragging the man forward, causing him to stumble.
Elder Saren let out a furious roar. As he steadied himself, he swung his hammer, aiming it downward at Long Hao's head.
With a "bang,"
a heavy thud resounded from Long Hao's head, and he staggered forward, about to fall.
It was only due to Long Hao's formidable physical strength that he could withstand such a blow from the hammer. Had it been a Magic Practitioner in his place, that strike would have been decisive.
Where would Elder Saren let such an opportunity slip by? He tossed his hammer, and using the Beast Taming Technique, he directed it to strike heavily again toward Long Hao's skull.
However, just as Long Hao, who looked as though he was about to tumble to the ground, seemingly instinctively flipped over in that very moment, eluding the golden gourd copper hammer.
Then, bouncing off the ground, he turned and slashed his knife at Elder Saren.
The latter, who had thought the victory was in his grasp, had not anticipated the physique of the Body Cultivator would be overwhelmingly strong, and that his muscular responsiveness was nearly instinctual. Caught off guard, he could only throw out a "Rocket Talisman."
Yet, before the talisman paper could ignite and the flames of the arrow could form, the edge of the blade was already upon him.
In the flash of the knife, the half-burned talisman was split in two, the forming flames instantly dispersed, and with them, Elder Saren's head flew into the air, rolling on the ground with a dull sound.
After Long Hao had successfully slain Elder Saren, there was no joy of revenge on his face, only a furious roar to the sky, as if to comfort the spirit of his deceased son.
Yuan Ming, who had watched the scene from afar, felt nothing but sympathy and respect for this grieving father, and not an iota of pity for Elder Saren.
With the widespread invasion by the Dawn Organization, the defenses of Biluo Cave had completely collapsed, and it seemed only a matter of time before it would fall.
Although Yuan Ming was already some distance away from the gate, he was still targeted by the pursuing members of the Dawn Organization.
A middle-aged man dressed in a black robe was the first to charge at him.
Yuan Ming held a Thunder Strike Talisman in one sleeve, while extending his hand in the manner Wulu had shown before, crossing the middle finger over the index finger to show the pursuer.
Upon seeing his gesture, the man immediately halted, nodded slightly to Yuan Ming, and chased off in another direction.
"Indeed," Yuan Ming sighed silently to himself.
At this moment, a figure suddenly appeared high in the sky in the distance—it was the Great Cave Master.
His clothes fluttering and snapping in the wind, he called out to the scattering disciples of Biluo Cave: "All disciples, heed my command, gather in the plaza at the foot of the mountain. The sect is about to activate the two-layered magic array for protection, providing us a chance to counterattack."

chapters.title: Chapter 214 - 194: Surprise Attack (Two-in-One Big Chapter)
chapters.content:
Having heard the words of the Great Cave Master, the disciples of Biluo Cave, who had been as disoriented as headless flies, finally found their backbone. They stopped their disorderly retreat and assembled in groups of threes and fives behind some Foundation Establishment cultivators toward the direction of the three main peaks.
Yuan Ming's gaze shifted back to the direction of the mountain gate and found that Wulu's figure had completely disappeared.
Originally, he had thoughts of returning to the Fire Refining Hall and seizing the chance to slip away, but seeing the sinister glances of the Great Cave Master scanning the crowd, he decided to simply follow the retreating disciples toward that direction.
By the time he arrived, more than two hundred people had already gathered on the spacious plaza. Many had expressions of relief akin to having survived a catastrophe, mixed with nervousness, and many were still not fully recovered.
Not long ago, Biluo Cave had been one of the Five Great Sects in the north of Ten Thousand Mountains at the Southern Border, with a Mid-stage Core Formation Great Elder in residence and three Core Formation Cave Masters running daily affairs. Its strength was not inferior to the other four sects. Even a registered disciple from the sect, encountering ordinary people, was regarded as a "superior immortal," a cut above other loose cultivators. Hearing that one was a cultivator from Biluo Cave, others would not dare to cause any trouble.
