But now, they had been suddenly attacked and caught off guard. The Foundation Establishment elders they once looked up to were either dead or injured, and even the Sect Protection Array had been broken through.
Many were somewhat despondent. If not for the Great Cave Master stabilizing the situation and the revered image of that mysterious Great Elder established in the past, they would probably have disregarded everything and scattered in a panic.
The Second Cave Master was leading seven or eight Foundation Establishment cultivators, systematically directing disciples arriving one after another into different areas for assembly. This scene did stabilize the emotions of the Qi Refining disciples somewhat.
Read ahead and get updates by visiting *.
Yuan Ming looked and saw that the entire plaza and the area in front of the rear mountain had been deliberately divided into nine different assembly points.
With nearly a hundred people, the Second Cave Master was in the very center of the plaza while the other eight Foundation Establishment cultivators, with varying numbers of elders and disciples, sat scattered around, forming a circle nearly a thousand feet in diameter.
Unknown to everyone, complex and difficult-to-understand runes had appeared under their feet, interconnected, and some spots were embedded with differently colored mid-grade Spirit Stones, clearly forming a large, fully engraved array.
Although Yuan Ming wanted to return to the Fire Refining Hall, given the situation, he naturally couldn't leave and was assigned to join an assembly point with about a dozen people.
Most of these people were registered disciples, and the Foundation Establishment cultivator in the center was tall, with a scar under his right eye—none other than Wu Luo, the direct disciple of the Second Cave Master.
After arranging for Yuan Ming and the others to take their positions, he fixed his gaze on the Second Cave Master in the middle of the plaza, seemingly waiting for the next instructions.
However, it wasn't long before a noisy clamor arose in the distance, and the people from the Dawn Organization had chased to within a hundred feet.
"No more waiting, start now!" commanded the Great Cave Master, hovering in mid-air. After issuing the order, he summoned a giant rocbird and flew toward the direction of several battle groups in the distance, apparently to assist those surviving forces.
The Second Cave Master immediately took out a palm-sized square stone slab, cast it to the ground, and it transformed into a square stele about one fathom high. He placed both hands on the stele, channeling his mana into it.
The runes on the square stele instantly lit up, shooting out a beam of light that soared straight into the sky.
The other eight Foundation Establishment elders surrounding the area each took out a slightly smaller stone tablet as well, transformed them into steles, and channeled their mana into them, promptly resulting in eight more beams of light soaring into the sky.
Nine towering light pillars stood, each connected by spreading blue light that intertwined to form a blue array that shielded the entire plaza in front of the rear mountain.
The rest of the people within the array primarily focused on protecting those operating the Array Eyes. Noticing the intense fluctuations emitted by the array, their panicked emotions finally eased a bit.
However, many disciples were still uneasy and confused.
Even some of the Foundation Establishment elders appeared anxious and were unsure of what they would face next, or when that mysterious Great Elder would appear.
The members of the Dawn Organization who arrived first did not pause at all but immediately began their attack.
The methods that had previously bombarded the Sect Protection Array were once again employed here.
However, no matter how they attacked, the Great Array merely showed ripples of spiritual power, appearing very stable.
Yuan Ming noticed that with every strike's glow and fluctuation, a layer of red light emerged on the surface of the elders' stone tablets, accumulating little by little, deepening in color.
At that moment, seven Foundation Establishment cultivators from the Dawn Organization formed a circle, with a person in the center suspending a palm-sized black inkstone above his head, while the others continuously channeled magic formulas into the inkstone.
As the black inkstone slowly rotated, rings of runes swirled and jumped on its surface, emitting bursts of black light.
Soon after, the person in the center chanted a few times and cast a magic formula, causing the inkstone to suddenly rise high into the air and expand to the size of a building, carrying the overwhelming force of Mount Tai as it smashed down toward the array below.
Watching this, the disciples of Biluo Cave saw the dark shadow covering them like dark clouds, causing a wave of panic, and they couldn't help showing a look of fear.

chapters.title: Chapter 215 - 194: Raid (Two-in-One Mega Chapter)_2
chapters.content:
"Boom!"
A massive black inkstone smashed against the blue light screen and came to a steady halt.
Not a shred of breaking appeared on the blue light screen; instead, moments later, it burst out in dazzling light.
As the light flared, a strong resistance force rose from various parts of the magic array, shooting upwards.
The next instant, the black inkstone was repelled by a tremendous force, unexpectedly flying backward and crashing towards the many Dawn members.
The cultivator surrounded by six people hurriedly activated his spell, attempting to retrieve the inkstone.
However, his black inkstone was now completely beyond his control, wobbling toward the ground, causing everyone to hastily dodge.
The roaring sound was tremendous!
The area where the Dawn members had stood was smashed into a crater several tens of meters wide, with dust and debris flying everywhere.
"Everyone stop," a clear female voice suddenly rang out, halting the Dawn members' attack.
It was the woman capable of forming magic arrays with a wave of her hand.
This female array master held a notably special status within the Dawn Organization. As soon as she spoke, everyone immediately complied, temporarily ceasing their tide-like assaults.
At that moment, the clown walked up to the female array master and quietly asked, "Sister, what is mysterious about this formation?"
"This magic array is not just a simple defense array. It can absorb external attacks' power and release it in an instant as a counterattack. This must be from the Luo Family of Wu Country," the female array master replied.
"So that's how it is," the clown said.
"Breaking it isn't difficult, but it's still going to take some effort. Had I known this mission would be so troublesome, I wouldn't have come," the female array master said.
"Oh dear, Sister, you were the one who wanted to come at first, and now you want to back out. But I am enjoying the fight," the clown laughed.
"Xiao Yao! I'm telling you, don't charge to the front so much; you never remember. We're just making an appearance here," the array master advised in a low voice.
"Got it, got it, I'll just go through the motions later," the clown said nonchalantly.
"Let me think of a way to break it," the female array master said.
Мy Virtuаl Librаry Еmpirе (М|V|L0ЕМРYR) hоsts thе оriginаl.
At this time, Ou Ji, the squad leader of Dawn Organization's Southern Border branch, also walked out from the split crowd, scanning the temporary defensive line put up by Biluo Cave with a slightly tense expression.
"All people of Biluo Cave listen, the mission we received is to annihilate Biluo Cave, but not to massacre all of you. We only seek to eliminate the chief culprits. As long as you are willing to cease resistance, we can let you go; we will spare your lives. But if you insist on resisting, you will be mercilessly killed," he declared coldly.
"Could their target be just the Great Elder?" Yuan Ming thought, feeling that something was odd but couldn't pinpoint what exactly.
The many ordinary elders and disciples heard this, causing an uproar. Many began to show timidity, particularly since Biluo Cave was already in a desperate situation. People's hearts wavered, and there was an incipient sense of disintegration.
At that time, the Great Cave Master, who was returning from coordinating with disciples further away, was rapidly approaching on a giant roc while loudly shouting:
"Do not believe their sweet words. Once you give up resistance and choose to surrender, even if you don't die now, what awaits you will be a lifetime as mine slaves, a fate worse than death, with no chance of turning things around ever again."
At those words, the square fell silent.
Yuan Ming had heard about mine slaves—slaves controlled by the various major sects or families of the Southern Border, who spent their days deep within the dark mines, mining ore.
Compared to them, becoming a Beast Slave of Biluo Cave was already a great fortune.
The disciples of Biluo Cave, hearing this, were more inclined to trust their own sect, especially coming from the words of the Great Cave Master.
But facing such a situation, they instinctively felt that victory was hopeless; they wanted to surrender.
However, no matter what they thought, the army's morale could not be restored.
The Great Cave Master, with a group of people, easily descended into the center of the Great Array, joining forces with the Second Cave Master and others.
"Everyone, the Great Elder has just sent a message that right now he is at a critical phase of his seclusion. Once he successfully emerges, he will lead us to exterminate this rabble," the Great Cave Master reassured everyone.
Thinking of the Great Elder, who was like a pillar of strength, the already demoralized cultivators of Biluo Cave felt a bit more confident, bolstered by the protection of the magic array. The chaotic situation then stabilized slightly.
"The Great Elder he..."
Seeing the Great Cave Master had arrived, the Second Cave Master started to speak in a lowered voice but hesitated.
"The Great Elder is at the final critical phase of breaking through to a later stage and needs more time. Once successful, our Biluo Cave will stand unparalleled in the North Territory. None of these inferior foes will match us," the Great Cave Master stated.
"Can we only hold out until the Great Elder emerges?" the Second Cave Master worriedly transmitted his voice.
"The Great Elder has communicated to me to stabilize the front for now and just hold off Ou Ji and Xue Zhan. As long as no Core Formation Stage cultivator interferes from that side, there will be no immediate concern. Once he completes his cultivation and emerges, that will be these people's death knell," the Great Cave Master surveyed the Dawn members outside and said.
After speaking, he asked again: "This Green Flow Circulation Array, how long can it hold?"
"Even if Ou Ji and Xue Zhan attack fiercely together, the Great Array will not collapse any time soon. Other people's attacks can't break through the defense limit of the Great Array and will only help to replenish its power; they are barely worth considering," the Second Cave Master stated.

chapters.title: Chapter 216 - 194: Raid (Two-in-One Mega Chapter)_3
chapters.content:
Upon hearing these words, the Great Cave Master's gaze flickered for a moment, but his brows furrowed even tighter.
Currently, the Second Cave Master was in charge of controlling the Green Flow Circulation Array and naturally couldn't leave the formation to join the battle. Stopping Ou Ji and Xue Zhan had to be done by him alone.
"It's unfortunate that Ling Songhua just happens to be not within the Sect at this time," the Second Cave Master said, half complaining, half resentful.
"Given the situation, talking about this is useless now. Let's give it our all," the Great Cave Master sighed and then spoke.
He suddenly looked up, seeing Ou Ji and Xue Zhan leaping up, aiming to bypass the grand square array and head towards the rear mountain; he immediately flew out of the array.
"Gentlemen, we haven't decided a winner yet. Dare you fight another three hundred rounds?" the Great Cave Master said in a solemn voice, standing mid-air with his clothes fluttering. A purple sword floated beside him.
"Why are you so determined to risk your life for Chen Cangqiong? Look at the situation," Ou Ji said, looking at the middle-aged man in front of him.
"The Great Elder has been kind to me. Without him, there would be no Mao Lihong today. Now, as the Great Cave Master of Biluo Cave, I must protect the Sect. I advise you to retreat soon. Once the Great Elder emerges, you won't be able to escape," the Great Cave Master slowly said.
"If that's the case, then don't blame me for being ruthless," Ou Ji responded upon hearing this.
"No need to waste any more words with him, Brother Ou! Let's not hold back any longer!" Xue Zhan licked his lips, his eyes shimmering with a bloody light.The M|V|LE&MPYR team worked hard on this chapter.
"Good, let's make it quick," Ou Ji muttered under his breath.
Having said that, the two simultaneously surged forward, charging straight at the Great Cave Master.
...
A hundred yards away from Biluo Cave on a big tree in the rear mountain, Silver Cat Xi Ying lay motionless on a branch, her form merging with the leaves. If not looked at closely, her figure was completely invisible.
Those heterochromatic eyes stared unblinkingly in the direction of Biluo Cave, muttering under her breath, "Xi Cangqiong, your disciples are nearly all dead. Aren't you coming out yet? If you don't come out now, you'll be all alone, and all your efforts in this life will have been in vain."
"Come out, come out, hurry and come out."
"Come out, come out, hurry and come out."
After muttering for a while, feeling tired, she decided not to look towards the cave entrance anymore and instead focused on a group of ants fighting on the ground.
Meanwhile, she released two sparrows, which chased each other around, clearly enjoying themselves.
...
In a valley of the Ten Thousand Mountains, surrounded by mountains on three sides, there was a lake as blue as jade.
An elderly man with white hair and a douli hat stood on the cliff edge, hands clasped behind his back, looking down at the lake below, his face unnaturally calm.
The valley was crescent-shaped, resembling a blue moon nestled in the valley when viewed from high above.
The breeze was gentle, the lake surface shimmered with light, and mists hovered above the water, creating a perfect Cave Heaven Blessed Land.
Just then, as a loud cry resounded, a fiery red figure swooped down from mid-air and landed behind the elderly man on the ground, revealing itself to be a massive three-zhang-long fiery red bird.
From the bird's back, a lean figure in fiery red leaped down, standing not far from the elderly man, motionless.
The Douli Elder slowly turned around, looking at the beautiful woman with a gentle demeanor before him. His face seemed to reflect a mix of reminiscence and relief.
The two of them silently gazed at each other, the valley winds seeming to halt for that moment.
After a long while, they broke into smiles simultaneously.
...
Above the plaza of Biluo Cave.
The Great Cave Master slapped his hand on his Spiritual Beast Bag, immediately causing a burst of crimson fire to emerge, which quickly transformed into a gigantic Fire Spirit Falcon over ten zhang in length. It flapped its wings, sending strong ripples of Spiritual Power throughout the area.
Under its wingbeats, hot waves rolled downwards, giving off an intense heat that made one's mouth parched and tongue scorched.
"Such a powerful aura!" Yuan Ming looked up and couldn't help but think.
Someone nearby couldn't help but exclaim, "Is that the Great Cave Master's spirit beast, the Fire Spirit Falcon? Its aura is terrifyingly immense. And that sword must be the Great Cave Master's famous Magic Treasure, the Bitter Wheel Sword, right?"
"I heard that the falcon was hatched from a beast egg that the Great Cave Master found in the Tali Volcano. It has been fed Heavenly Materials and Earthly Treasures since it was young, nurtured bit by bit," someone commented.
"My master mentioned that this Fire Spirit Falcon has reached the top level of a second-level demon beast and is only a step away from awakening its spiritual intelligence and advancing to the third level. That's a spirit beast powerful enough to contend with Core Formation Cultivators!" another added.
Unlike cultivators who control their Mana with ease, spirit beasts release strong Spiritual Power fluctuations to intimidate their enemies once they enter combat, making the sensation intensively felt by the bystanders.
The Great Cave Master leaped onto the back of the spirit beast, leading Ou Ji and his companion to the west, tactfully avoiding the crowded area of the plaza.
Yuan Ming's gaze did not stay fixed on the Great Cave Master and his group. Instead, he occasionally observed the situation around the members of the Dawn Organization.
Meanwhile, the two soul crows he had sent out were providing him with a view of the Sect's various locations, helping him plan his escape route.
Just then, he noticed that the female Array Master from the Dawn Organization, who seemed to hold a special position, had not looked at the three Core Formation Cultivators since earlier and appeared to be pondering something.
But just as Yuan Ming's gaze fell on her for a brief moment, she clapped her hands with a triumphant smile on her face.
Soon after, she quickly took out various flags used for setting up formations and began arranging them on the ground.

chapters.title: Chapter 217 - 194: Raid (Two-in-One Mega Chapter)_4
chapters.content:
This scene made Yuan Ming's heart shudder, "Could it be that they already have a method to break the array?"
Once everything was properly positioned, the Female Array Master took out a black iron canister and began pouring some black powder from it, using it to draw lines connecting all the Array Flags and Bone Slabs, eventually forming a complex array.
"Is she planning to use an array to break through another array?" Yuan Ming pondered silently.
Once the array was completed, the Female Array Master stepped back and immediately started casting, activating the array.
At that moment, a man in black emerged from the Dawn Members and slapped his Storage Bag at his waist, summoning an Armored Giant Bull over two zhang tall, which stepped into the array.
"What is this for?" Yuan Ming frowned.
In his understanding, such an array was mostly some kind of powerful offensive tool intended to break through the defenses of Biluo Cave, but the current situation seemed somewhat different?
As Yuan Ming was contemplating, a booming sound erupted in mid-air, followed by a dark red silhouette plummeting from the sky.
It was Xue Zhan, struck in the back by the Great Cave Master wielding the Bitter Wheel Sword, injured and landing on the ground.
"Great Cave Master is mighty!"
This scene invigorated the spirits of all the cultivators of Biluo Cave below.
However, Yuan Ming's gaze merely swept over the scene above before immediately returning to the Female Array Master, who pinched a spell with her hands and looked over intently, a light glowing in her palm, aiming towards the ground array.
The next instant, the ground array lit up with a yellow halo, a beam of light flashed, swallowing the figure of the Armored Giant Bull and then vanished.
Yuan Ming instinctively felt something was off and quickly turned to look back.
At this time, a bit away from him where a crowd gathered, a yellow halo appeared out of nowhere in the void, followed by an expanding light that revealed a huge figure, unmistakably the Armored Giant Bull.
"A Teleportation Array?" Yuan Ming was taken aback, then became curious and wanted to go see the array up close.
The moment the figure of the Armored Giant Bull appeared, it clearly targeted the center of the crowd, where an elder was standing with both hands against a stone tablet, and charged, its sharp horns gleaming with a golden light.
The surrounding disciples were unable to react immediately, hastily using their Magic Artifacts and talismans against the bull.
Yet, as the bull ran, its aura was astonishing, its scales incredibly hard, and despite being bombarded with attacks and bloodied, it did not fall but charged directly at the elder.
Its horns, glowing brightly with golden light, thrust fiercely towards the stone tablet in the elder's hands, aiming to destroy it.
Even though the elder was originally concentrating on activating the array, he was caught off guard and failed to respond in time.
Just as the horns were about to strike the stone tablet, a red-glowing Flying Knife flew in from the side, striking the horns.
The tremendous force shattered the horns and flipped the bull over.
Before it could react further, another Flying Knife thrust in, piercing directly through the bull's head.Pleasereadthischapteronitsoriginalplatform—*.
In the end, the Spiritual Beast fell in the battle, within the Green Flow Circulation Array, killed by the timely intervention of the Second Cave Master.
Yuan Ming glanced and saw the two Flying Knives, having completed their task, flew back and hovered beside the Second Cave Master, aligning with five other identical Flying Knives, guarding their master.
However, no sooner had the Armored Giant Bull fallen than another giant Spiritual Beast suddenly appeared at another Array Eye, aiming to disrupt the array there.
Having learned from the previous incident, the people of Biluo Cave became alert, and when another Spiritual Beast invaded, they no longer panicked and were able to handle this kind of intrusion calmly.
After several Level 4 Spiritual Beasts that entered through the Teleportation Array were slain, the Female Array Master seemed deflated and temporarily stopped casting.
Seeing this, the spirits of the people of Biluo Cave slightly lifted.
But what everyone failed to notice was that a dark red shadow had mysteriously appeared next to the Teleportation Array and then leaped into the array. Following a flash of yellow light, the dark red figure vanished in an instant.

chapters.title: Chapter 218 - 195: Escape
chapters.content:
In midair, the Great Cave Master and Ou Ji were still locked in an indistinguishable battle. However, because Blood Battle had ceased participating, the pressure on the Great Cave Master had drastically decreased. Yet under Ou Ji's calculated offensives, he couldn't break free in a short time.
On Biluo Cave's square, the Green Flow Circulation Array, under the control of the Second Cave Master, was defending against the relentless attacks from the Dawn Alliance. At the same time, all disciples were vigilantly on guard to prevent any surprise teleportation attacks from the opposition.
For a moment, both sides were at a stalemate.
The disciples of the Biluo Cave side slightly relaxed, as this steady situation was advantageous for them.
Many firmly believed that everything would be no problem once the Great Elder emerged from seclusion.
Yuan Ming stood near Wu Luo, scanning his surroundings and pretending to be on guard like everyone else, but he was actually looking for a chance to escape.
He didn't believe that the Dawn Alliance would allow the situation to continue in a deadlock. The temporary calm might be brewing a stronger storm.
"You, you, and you two, go to where the Second Cave Master is and be vigilant!" At this moment, Wu Luo's voice rang out. He designated a third of the people from the surrounding protectors. Among them, shockingly, was Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming walked toward the center of the square, where the Second Elder was stationed, while observing his surroundings. The other seven array eyes also had people assigned, continuously adjusting the allocation of personnel.
Although the situation was unfavorable, the Second Cave Master conducted himself in an orderly manner, completely unflustered.
...
In the center of the Green Flow Circulation Array, nearly one hundred and fifty cultivators had gathered around the Second Cave Master, including about ten Foundation Establishment Cultivators who fortified his defense impermeably.
The Second Cave Master would also whisper occasionally to the Foundation Establishment elders, who knew that it was time to fight with all they had.
While operating the array, he anxiously hoped for the Great Elder to come out of seclusion, knowing that Biluo Cave's situation was now perilously unstable.
Both the Great Cave Master and his own position were merely temporizing measures to delay the enemy's progress. He was somewhat aware of the operational style of the Dawn Alliance. Gathering such a force to attack Biluo Cave surely meant they had further contingencies in place.
They likely had additional preparations even against the Great Elder.
Right then, the Second Cave Master's gaze flickered slightly and he immediately shouted to those around him in an alert tone, "An intruder has breached the array, search for them now!"
His emitted Divine Sense faintly detected the presence of the enemy.
However, the protectors around him, despite frantically scanning to the left and right, failed to see any trace of the invader.
Yuan Ming, who stood at the farthest corner of the crowd from the Second Cave Master, also looked around but didn't see anyone breaching the defenses.
Suddenly, he squinted, instantly spotting a difference in the shadow under the Second Cave Master that was distinctly darker than those of others nearby.
Before he could react, the shadow of the Second Cave Master twisted bizarrely. A blood-red figure burst from it, striking like thunder at the Second Cave Master's chest with a palm.
The cultivators around, including Yuan Ming, never anticipated that the enemy could directly reach the Second Cave Master. They couldn't react in time.
"Blood Battle!" someone exclaimed.
The Second Cave Master, reacting quickly, was immediately enveloped by a layer of light. He also spat out a green light, which enveloped a small ruler about an inch tall.
The little ruler suddenly elongated into a size of about a meter. As the green light increased, it smashed down toward Blood Battle's head.
At this moment, a starkly visible, deep flesh wound was evident on Blood Battle's back. Still, facing the imminent giant ruler, he made no move to dodge, his eyes even showing a hint of madness.
In the palm of his left hand that struck toward the Second Cave Master, a compressing blood cloud formed, with a blazing flame lighting up within it.
"Boom"
Then, a thunderous explosion rocked the air!
A red sun burst forth from the center of the array, with its fierce flames expanding rapidly under the intense heat, instantly blasting everyone within the array, tossing them around chaotically.
The Second Cave Master took a direct hit. His protective body light was immediately breached, his chest and abdomen scorched by the flames, his clothes torn apart, and a shocking wound appeared on his body.
The square stele he was protecting behind him was also shattered by the powerful impact, tumbling to the side.
Within the array, chaos immediately ensued.
Yuan Ming, being farther from the center of the explosion, was only lightly impacted and toppled to the ground. Meanwhile, the elders and disciples near the Second Cave Master suffered catastrophic injuries, their bodies burst open and dead or heavily wounded.
He clearly saw every moment of the attack, even noticing Blood Battle who launched the assault, also blown away by the Second Cave Master's giant green ruler magic treasure. He was blood-soaked, with one of his arms broken, visibly also heavily injured.
Yet, he used the momentum to transform into a blood shadow, racing out of the array.
The core of the array was breached, and the entire Green Flow Circulation Array instantly collapsed, dissipating into specks of green light.
The Female Array Master looked at this scene, her lips curving into a smile.
All of this was within her plans, including the initial kamikaze attacks by the second-level spirit beasts, all aimed to divert attention, setting the stage for teleporting Blood Battle underground for the sneak attack.
"My task is done," said the female Array Master.
"Charge!" a leader from the Dawn Alliance ordered loudly.
The young clown, who had been guarding her side, was the first to respond and rushed toward Biluo Cave cultivators, now unprotected by the Array.
"Brother, be careful," the female Array Master shouted loudly, but the cultivator named Xiao Yao had already charged too far away.
The remaining Dawn Cultivators followed closely behind, their battle cries shaking the heavens.
The severely injured Second Cave Master, his expression as dark as water, swallowed several elixirs and yelled to everyone, "The Array is broken! Things have come to this point, you decide whether you want to die honorably or live a life as a dignified mining slave."
His cry was so loud that even Yuan Ming, upon hearing it, felt moved,
and some elder disciples even shed hot tears.
Seeing no way out, the cultivators of Biluo Cave slapped their Spiritual Beast Bags at their waists, summoned their spirit beasts, and pulled out their best Magic Tools and Talismans, ready for the final battle.
Above the square, the last brutal melee finally began.
The Great Cave Master in the distant sky saw what was happening and his eyes almost burst with rage. He realized that when he had repelled Xue Zhan with a single sword strike earlier, the enemy hadn't really retreated but had used the opportunity to escape and attack the Second Cave Master as a part of a feint.
Angry and anxious, the Great Cave Master wanted to come to the aid, but he was suddenly struck by several streaks of black thunder, which were the Kui Water Divine Thunder used by Ou Ji.
The Great Cave Master had no choice but to focus and fight, being tightly held back by Ou Ji.
After swallowing the elixirs, the Second Cave Master took a deep breath, forced his body to stand, and lifted a red ring to prepare to face his enemies.
But just as he activated the ring and sent two nearby men in black flying, he suddenly grimaced in pain, vomited a mouthful of dark blood, and fell to the ground again, his skin turning a purplish-blue hue as his limbs convulsed uncontrollably, apparently poisoned.
The red ring also fell to the ground with a clanging sound, its spirit light quickly fading away.
Seeing the Second Cave Master exhausted and unable to fight back, and with the Great Cave Master unable to assist, the situation deteriorated rapidly as their comrades fell one by one, and the little morale that the people of Biluo Cave had mustered evaporated instantly. Both the ordinary disciples and the Foundation Establishment elders lost their will to fight and scattered in all directions.
Soon, the collapsed Second Cave Master was controlled by the members of the Dawn Alliance using a magic tool.
The moment the Second Cave Master was attacked, Yuan Ming was the first to break away from the group, fighting and retreating to the edge of the square leading towards the back mountain.
The Dawn members had already fiercely invaded Biluo Cave, blocking all paths to the front mountain, and only the road leading further into Biluo Cave remained unguarded.
Yuan Ming didn't think twice, his body swiftly flickering as he sped in that direction.
"Stop!"
Several Dawn Alliance members approached rapidly from the side, one of whom was the tall, thin man who had previously fought him at the gate of Biluo Cave.
Yuan Ming immediately used the Wind Swift Skill to accelerate, quickly creating distance between himself and the pursuers.
The tall, thin man, seeing that he couldn't catch up, took out the red crossbow he had used earlier to attack the Sect Protection Array.
A shrill shriek sounded, and a red arrow flew straight toward Yuan Ming's heart.
Yuan Ming quickly activated the Jade Belt at his waist, his figure instantly becoming blurred as he dashed several meters to the side.
The red crossbow bolt struck his former position, exploding with a loud blast and creating a large crater in the ground, dust billowing.
Without looking back, Yuan Ming continued to spur the Jade Belt, speeding forward with several shadows trailing behind him.Visit My Virtual Library Empire (*) for more.
By the time the tall, thin man and his companions arrived, Yuan Ming had already disappeared.
Several roads appeared ahead, and they could not tell where Yuan Ming had gone.
The men stopped reluctantly, turned, and chased after other Biluo Cave disciples.
Yuan Ming pushed his speed to the limit and quickly completely lost the Dawn Alliance pursuers.
He ran to a hidden area below Fire Refining Peak and controlled two soul crows to scout the situation outside.
The disciples of Biluo Cave had completely dispersed. For those who chose to surrender, whether they were Foundation Establishment elders or Qi Refining disciples, the Dawn Alliance did not trouble them, merely confiscating their storage magic tools and fitting them with a circular magic tool around their necks, gathering them in one place for supervision.
But for the few cultivators who stubbornly resisted, the outcome was grim; outnumbered, almost all were either killed or seriously injured.
The Dawn Alliance had obviously prepared thoroughly for their attack on Biluo Cave, quickly stationing personnel at strategic posts throughout the cave, leaving no stone unturned.
"At such a critical time, what exactly is Xi Ying doing? It's really worrying!"
Yuan Ming hid in a secluded corner, concealing his breath and hardly daring to breathe at all, monitoring every movement on the battlefield through the soul crows, while anxiously searching for any sign of Xi Ying.
In the current chaos, if he could find a loophole through the Dawn's defenses using the soul crows and use the remaining Earth Travel Talisman to try to escape, he figured he still had a ninety percent chance of success, but he was unsure if Xi Ying had accomplished her important task and was now unreachable.

chapters.title: Chapter 219 - 196: Blood Bat
chapters.content:
In mid-air, the Great Cave Master's face was pale, his fight against Ou Ji grew increasingly fierce. Roaring and bursting sounds occasionally echoed, shaking the vicinity for miles.
The Fire Falcon Spirit Beast that belonged to the Great Cave Master had been recalled at some point, and he was now controlling a white large net Magic Treasure and a purple long sword, the Bitter Wheel Sword, to cross hands with Ou Ji.
The Bitter Wheel Sword was clearly a rare Thunder Attribute Magic Treasure, with purple arcs of electricity coiling around its blade, demonstrating considerable power. In combination with the white large net, it continuously neutralized the Kui Water Divine Thunders while launching wave after wave of ferocious assaults at Ou Ji.
Ou Ji's black robe was severely damaged, and there was a scar on his face, indicating that he had sustained some injuries.
As one of the pinnacle experts of Biluo Cave, one of the Five Great Sects of the North Territory, the Great Cave Master was more than capable of handling a fight against another cultivator of equal rank.
Ou Ji dodged several strikes of thunder and lightning, his gaze seeming to sweep across the void near the Great Cave Master before abruptly shouting loudly and flicking his sleeve.
A large mass of black water clouds condensed once again, instantly transforming into a black water sphere half-a-zhang in diameter, with thick Kui Water Divine Thunders crawling over it and roaring as it surged directly towards the Great Cave Master.
The Great Cave Master's expression stiffened, and before the water sphere could approach, he maneuvered the white large net to cover it.
Thick streaks of lightning suddenly shot out from within the water sphere, forming a black lightning snake several zhang long that struck the white net.
The lightning snake had concentrated nearly all the power of the Kui Water Divine Thunders from the black water sphere, causing the white net to be forcefully blown away.
The black lightning snake twisted its body and turned into a streak of black electric light, charging straight for the Great Cave Master, and in an instant, it was only a few zhang away from him.
The Great Cave Master remained calm, opening his mouth to spit a mouthful of Essence Blood onto the Bitter Wheel Sword in his hand. Its glow surged, and amidst a crackling sound, its surface swirled with lightning as he thrust it forward.
"Crackle"
Dense, purple lightning bolts shot out from the sword, aiming at both the black lightning snake and Ou Ji behind it, with an astonishing speed.
Ou Ji faced the rapidly approaching purple lightning bolts without dodging or evading, simply letting a faint blue Light Shield appear around his body to protect his vitals. Meanwhile, his hands moved in front of him like turning wheels, quickly casting several Magic Formulas.
But the black lightning snake, regardless of the purple lightning striking its body, burst open right before it could disperse, and a black short cone suddenly shot out from its mouth, hurtling towards the Great Cave Master at a speed akin to lightning.
Simultaneously, Ou Ji's faint blue Light Shield also shattered under the bombardment of the purple lightning, and his body was shocked into flying backwards for more than a dozen zhang.
The Great Cave Master saw the black short cone rapidly approaching, less than a zhang away from him. He shot backward in mid-air while gesturing towards the white net.
The white net "whooshed" open, engulfing tens of zhang in front of him in an instant. Although the black short cone was fast, it was still caught by the white net.
The black short cone was like a fish trapped in the net, desperately struggling and darting in all directions, yet unable to escape the control of the white net.
The Great Cave Master quickly formed hand seals, and strands of white Spiritual Patterns permeated from the net into the short cone, rapidly covering its surface and causing the dark spirit light on the cone to dim quickly.
Not far away, Ou Ji, who had just steadied himself, gritted his teeth, formed a hand seal and pointed it outwards, shouting, "Explode!"
The Great Cave Master was startled by this action and hastily retreated backward, but it was already too late.
"Booming"
The dark light on the black short cone surged and exploded violently, with countless black filaments shooting out in all directions, instantly flooding the area within a dozen zhang.
A large cloud of black smoke arose from the center of the explosion, sweeping in all directions and causing a rapid drop in temperature, as black crystals formed in the air in a flash.
The Great Cave Master's figure shot out from the black smoke, his clothing on one side torn to shreds, covered in numerous puncture wounds, and a trail of blood also ran from the corner of his mouth.
"To think you would go as far as to self-destruct the Black Cold Cone and incur grave injuries, was it worth it?" the Great Cave Master steadied himself mid-air, wiped the blood from the corner of his mouth, and smiled.
"Out with the old, in with the new. Fellow Daoist Mao, give up now; there might still be room for negotiation if you surrender to us now," Ou Ji said slowly, his mouth also dripping with blood, the self-destruction of the Magic Treasure had also inflicted significant injuries on him.
The Great Cave Master's figure was slightly swaying, just as he was about to say something more, his expression suddenly changed.
Behind him, a Blood Shadow rose into the sky, which turned out to be Xue Zhan who had slipped away to strike back again.
Seeing this scene, the Great Cave Master chuckled bitterly in his heart.
"Great Elder, I did my best…"
…
Yuan Ming observed this scene through a soul crow from afar, his thoughts racing.
The Great Cave Master and Ou Ji had fought each other to the point of severe injury, and it looked like the Great Cave Master would soon be overwhelmed. The Second Cave Master had lost his fighting ability due to poisoning. This battle was indeed tragic, and the defeat of Biluo was inevitable. Yet, the so-called Pillar of Heaven, the Great Elder, still had not shown the slightest sign of action.
Yuan Ming emerged from his hiding place, not heading towards the sect's gate but instead sweeping to the west side. Since he couldn't find Xi Ying's trace, he might as well leave this trouble-ridden place first.
The defenses of Biluo Cave on both the east and west sides had been breached long ago. Although there were people from the Dawn Alliance stationed there, their numbers were small, making it a more suitable place to escape.
…
On the treetops near the square, a grey squirrel perched silently, gazing toward where the Great Cave Master had fallen, its eyes faintly shimmering with traces of green light.
In a secret chamber within the Biluo Cave on the back mountain, the green-robed youth was still absorbing Soul Power from the Soul Suppressing Kettle.
A blue ancient mirror was suspended in front of him, displaying the situation near the plaza. Biluo Cave disciples were scattered and fleeing, with fewer and fewer daring to resist.
"Brother Mao, you've tried your best, I truly apologize, I, Xi Ying, am ashamed," the youth sighed lightly, raising one hand.
"Still so much left! Time is not on my side, so be it, even if my cultivation suffers a loss, I'll deal with you first!" The green-robed youth, his face filled with reluctance, formed a hand seal and pointed.
A black light flashed across his brow, and the image of a tiger's head vanished, ceasing the absorption of Soul Power from inside the Soul Suppressing Kettle.
The green-robed youth clasped his hands together rapidly like turning a wheel, conjuring a black Array from the ground out of thin air, enveloping the Soul Suppressing Kettle.
"Sha Hao!" the youth suddenly stood up, walking out of the secret chamber and called out loudly.
A figure quickly walked over from outside; it was a cold-faced, pale young man in white.
This young man's aura was profound, revealing him also to be a Foundation Establishment Cultivator.
"Master, what are your orders!" The person knelt down on one knee, respectfully asking.
"Guard the Cave Mansion, and let no one enter, especially near the secret chamber!" Without stopping, the green-robed youth continued to walk outside, speaking without looking back.
"Yes, disciple obeys!" The youth in white hurriedly complied.Enjoythestorybyreadingon*.
The green-robed youth's body radiated a bright white light, transforming into a white streak shooting outward.
...
Near the midpoint of Fire Refining Peak, more than ten Biluo Cave disciples had retreated there. Relying on the treacherous terrain, they clashed with the pursuing members of the Dawn Alliance. Leading them was Wu Luo, a direct disciple of the Second Cave Master.
At this time, he was covered in wounds, his chest rising and falling erratically. He quickly affixed several talismans upon his body. As the green light flowed, the bleeding from his wounds stopped, and he continued to urge his Magic Artifact to charge ahead.
The Dawn Alliance outnumbered them, with more than twenty people. Led by a short and plump middle-aged Foundation Establishment Cultivator, they were like a surging tide. The Biluo Cave's side was clearly unable to hold, on the verge of being overwhelmed.
Just then, dozens of fist-sized blood-colored bats flew from nowhere, diving straight toward the battling factions.
"Where did these many bats come from?"
"What kind of fiends are these!"
Both the Dawn Alliance and Biluo Cave disciples were startled, quickly casting spells and summoning Magic Artifacts for protection.
However, those blood-colored bats seemed like spiritual body illusions; spells and Magic Artifacts could not stop them at all, as the Blood Bats easily penetrated them, entering the bodies of everyone present.
Those who had their bodies breached by the bats first became rigid in movement, blood light flickered in their eyes, and they started to behave deliriously, as if their souls had been stolen.
In the blink of an eye, except for Wu Luo and the plump middle-aged man, everyone engaged in the battle had been entered by the Blood Bats, standing motionless on the spot.
Seeing the tide turning against him, Wu Luo had already called forth a Green Bird to escape, but after a Blood Bat possessed the bird, it plummeted from midair. Wu Luo was unable to avoid it in time as a Blood Bat swooped directly towards him.
The plump middle-aged man seemed to have a stronger Divine Soul; after being swooped upon by a Blood Bat, he did not completely lose his senses, retaining a trace of lucidity in his eyes. Panic-stricken, he turned to flee down the mountain.
But just as he started running, several more Blood Bats emerged from nowhere in front of him. With no way to avoid them, he was swooped upon by two more Blood Bats and instantly lost consciousness, just like the other Qi Refinement Cultivators.
The situation had reversed in an instant.
The next moment, a group of thirty-odd people, who had just been locked in a life-or-death struggle, had their eyes surge with blood light and rushed mightily down the mountain. Along the way, they encountered several scattered members of the Dawn Alliance and immediately attacked without distinguishing between friend and foe, swiftly reaching the base of the peak.
Many members of the Dawn Alliance had gathered at the base of the mountain, and before they could even open their mouths to ask what was happening, both sides had already engaged in a chaotic battle.
A member of the Dawn swung his combat blade, striking a disciple of Biluo Cave in front of him.
Against all expectations, the low-level Biluo Cave disciple didn't dodge; with a "crack," several ribs in his chest were broken, but he managed to thrust the Magic Artifact in his hand into the throat of the Dawn member.
The Dawn member clutched his throat as he fell, blood gushing from his chest, while the Biluo Cave disciple seemed unbothered by his own condition, rushing towards the next target. It was only after taking a few steps that he collapsed limply to the ground from the severity of his wounds.
The others, whose eyes held a surge of blood light, were likewise fearless of death, ignorant to pain, and quickly routed the Dawn Alliance with significant losses.
In the distance, behind a large rock, a black-clothed Monk looked on with shock.
This person used a hat to cover most of his face, leaving only a pair of eyes exposed—it was Yuan Ming.
Those blood-colored bats bore fluctuating waves of Soul Power similar to his soul crows, except his soul crows could only possess the dead, while these Blood Bats could control the living, evidently a notch higher.
At the same time, not only on Fire Refining Peak but also in many other areas of Biluo Cave, a large number of Blood Bats emerged, entering the bodies of either Biluo Cave disciples or members of the Dawn Alliance, manipulating them to fight back.
The entire Biluo Cave had almost been seized by the Dawn Alliance, but now everyone was once again evading the attacks of the blood-colored bats, and the situation became chaotic once more.

chapters.title: Chapter 220 - 197 Perils Everywhere
chapters.content:
"To control so many soul bats, this person's Soul Cultivation Realm must be incredibly powerful. Could Xi Ying have encountered danger?" Yuan Ming wondered to himself, an idea suddenly surfacing in his mind.
Where exactly are you, Xi Ying?
He didn't linger any longer and continued to flee into the distance.
At that moment, several Blood Bats appeared ahead, swooping toward him.
Yuan Ming cursed silently and hastily used the Wind Swift Skill to dodge to the side, avoiding the attacks of several Blood Bats.
But these Blood Bats, like leeches that had latched onto fresh blood, pursued him closely as if they were embedded in his very bones.
The speed of the Blood Bats was extremely fast. Even though Yuan Ming used the Shadowless Step and accelerated with a white Jade Belt, he was still unable to shake them off; instead, the distance between them grew even smaller.
His expression turned grim. Those controlled by the Blood Bats would completely lose themselves, and at that time, let alone escaping from Biluo Cave, it was highly likely he would die here!
Yuan Ming couldn't afford to hold back any longer and quickly took out an Earth Travel Talisman, activating it. His figure, enveloped in a yellow glow, vanished into the ground in a flash.
To his surprise, the Blood Bats also burrowed into the ground, their pursuit speed undiminished.
Yuan Ming had no time to ponder; he could only push himself to the limit to continue tunneling forward.
Although the Earth Travel Talisman allowed for movement underground, the speed was not fast. In the blink of an eye, a few Blood Bats caught up and entered his body.
A cold sensation merged with Yuan Ming's body and quickly entered his Sea of Consciousness, eroding his Divine Soul.
His body suddenly stiffened, and blood-red light began to emerge in his eyes.
However, after all, he was also a Soul Cultivator, with a powerful Divine Soul that allowed him to maintain his rationality.
Due to the backlash from the Fur Cloak Skill, his Divine Soul had already endured numerous similar attacks. Now, with a rapid turn of thoughts in his mind, he started to run the Moonlight Technique.
A moon of Ming Yue rose in his Sea of Consciousness, casting rays of white light. Wherever the light passed, the cold sensation that had invaded his Sea of Consciousness melted away and vanished.
The blood color dissipated from Yuan Ming's eyes and his body regained its ability to move. He breathed a sigh of relief, and a certain thought in his heart grew stronger, causing him a shiver of fear.
Biluo Cave had been collecting the Divine Souls of common people for many years, coupled with the emphasis on the Great Elder's immense power, it was undoubtedly the Great Elder who owned the soul bats.
This person's methods were truly dreadful, silently releasing so many Divine Soul Transformations to attach to living people, turning those possessed into puppet-like beings who attacked without consciousness, seemingly forgetting pain and not fearing death.
Such overbearing methods from a Core Formation Stage Soul Cultivator!
Fortunately, Soul Cultivators have difficulty in their practice and can often perish from backlash if they are not careful. Therefore, compared to Magic Practitioners and Body Cultivation Cultivators, they are extremely rare.
The Dawn Alliance was tasked with attacking Biluo Cave, and they kept insisting on punishing the primary evil. Could the employer have a grudge against the Great Elder, or were they wary of him?
"Could it be the Fisherman?" He suddenly thought of this possibility.
Fearing that Blood Bats were everywhere outside, he didn't immediately emerge from the ground. Instead, he continued to control the two soul crows outside to observe the situation and find a way to escape.
The Great Cave Master had been injured and captured, but the situation that seemed secure because of the appearance of these strange Blood Bats had become chaotic. Ou Ji and Xue Zhan were injured and had no solution to this situation; they could only try their best to stabilize it.
Just then, a Blood Shadow shot out from the nearby void, moving incredibly fast towards Ou Ji and Xue Zhan. It was a Blood-colored Banner with images of ferocious and ghastly ghosts painted on it.
"Ten Thousand Ghost Banner!"
Both Ou Ji and Xue Zhan dodged to the left and right as if avoiding a deadly poison.
The direction of the Blood-colored Banner shifted, heading straight for Xue Zhan.
Shrieks of ghosts resonated loudy as endless Blood Clouds gushed from within the Blood-colored Banner, forming a tumultuous wave of blood rushing at Xue Zhan. Within the wave, countless gruesome Evil Ghosts appeared, gnashing their teeth and clawing ferociously within the Blood Clouds.
Despite his heavy injuries, Xue Zhan reacted extremely quickly, his arm swiping back as he slashed a saber in the air.
A saber light, dozens of feet long, shot out, striking the Blood Clouds and ghostly images, instantly splitting them in two.
But, almost immediately, the Blood Clouds and ghostly images merged back together, seemingly unharmed, and continued to surge towards Xue Zhan, quickly engulfing most of the area around him.
Xue Zhan roared, and the Blood Light on his saber surged as he launched nine smaller saber lights, cutting through the approaching Blood Clouds once again.
With another sweep of his hand, more than twenty purple talismans appeared out of thin air, each emitting a strong aura of thunder and lightning.
Xue Zhan formed a hand seal and activated all the talismans at once. Dozens of bolts of purple lightning, thick as bowls, appeared, resembling a forest of Thunder, tearing apart all the Blood Clouds and ghostly images, striking towards the Banner deep within the Blood Clouds.
Blinding Lei Guang engulfed everything, quickly dissipating afterwards.
Love this story? Show your support on *.
A tattered Banner tumbled out, falling toward the ground below.
Xue Zhan's lips formed a smug smile. His cultivation was only slightly lower, and he had sustained serious injuries, so if Chen Cangqiong were to take action against them, he would undoubtedly target him first. Fortunately, he had made ample preparations.
However, just at that moment, things took an unexpected turn!
Xue Zhan suddenly felt a severe pain in his lower abdomen. A bloodstained hand pierced through his Dantian, grasping a water-blue Gold Core.
Xue Zhan's strength rapidly drained from his body, yet his eyes remained wide open, his face full of disbelief.
His Blood Spirit Saber had long since been enlightened. As long as someone came within thirty feet of him, it would immediately sound an alarm. How could he have been ambushed?
Suddenly, countless cracks appeared in Xue Zhan's field of vision, and in the next moment, they shattered thunderously, revealing an entirely new scene.
A green-robed youth stood silently before him, his palm piercing through his body. The Ten Thousand Ghost Banner wasn't destroyed by the power of thunder and lightning, and at this moment, it tightly wrapped around the Blood Spirit Saber, rendering it immobile. A vast expanse of Blood Cloud enveloped the two, barring Ou Ji from getting closer.
"So it was an illusion," said Xue Zhan with difficulty, a self-mocking smile on his lips.
The green-robed youth crushed the Golden Core in a single grip, and Xue Zhan's vision was engulfed by endless darkness.
"Who gave you the guts to run wild in my Biluo Cave?" the youth sneered as he withdrew his hand.
He retrieved Xue Zhan's corpse and the Blood Spirit Saber, then his gaze shifted, looking towards Ou Ji not far away.
Ou Ji's heart chilled, and he turned to flee into the distance.
"Too late." The green-robed youth formed a hand gesture, and the Blood Cloud around him surged tumultuously, instantly transforming into a blood-colored Long Dragon measuring over a dozen feet long, chasing after Ou Ji with gnashing fangs and claws.
The Blood Dragon moved with incredible speed, rapidly closing the distance between it and Ou Ji.
Ou Ji reached for a Jade Pendant with one hand and crushed it. A surge of white light immediately enveloped him, and then his figure abruptly turned into a beam of white light, speeding away into the distance at an even faster rate.
A sinister smile appeared at the corner of the youth's mouth as he made another hand gesture.
The Blood Dragon's body abruptly swelled, its speed increasing severalfold as it instantly caught up with Ou Ji and engulfed his form. Then, the figure of Ou Ji suddenly stalled and plummeted towards the ground, smashing heavily onto the terrain.
A loud "bang" echoed as the Blood Dragon's body exploded, reverting into a large Blood Cloud that spread in all directions, covering a radius of several dozen feet and continuing to expand.
This place was near Qingluo Square, where the Female Array Master and many Dawn Members were gathered. They were immediately engulfed by the Blood Cloud, falling to the ground with cries of agony.
Shadows floated up from their bodies, which were their Divine Souls, devoured by the Blood Cloud.
The overwhelming Blood Cloud surged towards them, threatening to engulf the Female Array Master as well.
Seeing this, she showed no fear, stomped her foot, and a Silver Formation immediately appeared around her transparent shoes, radiating intense light.
Just as the Female Array Master's figure was about to disappear, a bat struck her body like a bolt of lightning.
The Silver Formation's light shattered, the transmission complete, and the Female Array Master vanished without a trace.
"A small movement charm?" The youth raised his eyebrows in surprise but remained unbothered, about to activate the Ten Thousand Ghost Banner again.
Silver light flashed above his head, and a silver small bell appeared out of nowhere, accompanied by a hunched elder, another Core Formation Stage cultivator.
The elder shouted, slapped the bell, and the silver small bell immediately increased in size several times over, ringing rapidly with "clang clang clang."
Silver ripples enveloped downwards, instantly submerging the green-robed youth's body.
The green-robed youth froze, his eyes filling with confusion.
A ripple in the void beside him heralded the arrival of two more figures, a red-robed man and a woman in a green dress, both prominent Core Formation Stage beings as well.
Three Core Formation Stage cultivators!
One wielded a Fiery Red Flying Fork and the other a green Flying Sword, both attacking the green-robed youth's body as fast as lightning.
The defenseless green-robed youth was cut into three pieces, his blood splattering in all directions.
The trio looked excited, but their smiles quickly froze on their faces.
The youth's blood turned into streaks of light and vanished as his figure reemerged from a white light that flashed in the void a dozen feet away.
"More illusions! Be careful, Chen Cangqiong's Soul Cultivation Realm must have progressed a lot, easily pulling us into an illusion," warned the hunched elder, retreating several feet back, his expression extremely solemn.
"Impossible, we all have Forbidden God Talismans; how could we still be affected by illusions?" the red-robed man and the woman in the green dress retreated to the elder's side, speaking in disbelief.
All three were reinforcements hired at a high price by the Dawn Alliance to deal specifically with Chen Cangqiong and had made thorough preparations, the Forbidden God Talisman being one of them.
This talisman had only one function: to open a special barrier around the user, preventing the approach of Divine Power.
For a Soul Cultivator to cast an illusion on someone, it's essential to touch them with Divine Soul Power. Chen Cangqiong's Divine Power might be stronger than all three of them, but it was definitely incapable of breaking through the barrier of the Forbidden God Talisman.
"This person has mysterious divine skills, proceed with caution." The hunched elder too was puzzled, speaking slowly.
A black tunneling light shot from the distance, landing beside the trio to reveal Ou Ji's figure.
He had escaped the Blood Cloud's confinement, but his complexion was pale as paper, clearly having suffered a severe drain on his Primordial Qi.
"To deal with me, did you really think that having more Core Formation Stage cultivators would assure your success?" The green-robed youth looked around at the four of them, unconcerned, and spoke slowly.
The Blood Cloud on the ground flew back, surrounding him once more, churning and swirling, making his figure appear and disappear intermittently. With a wave of his hand, dozens of bats flew around him, darting back and forth, adding a layer of eeriness to the scene.

chapters.title: Chapter 221 - 198: Entering the Cave
chapters.content:
"Fellow Daoist Chen, your fierce reputation echoes throughout the Southern Border and Northern Territory, and we would never dare to treat you lightly. Being able to invite you out today is a rewarding journey indeed," Ou Ji slowly began.
"I didn't expect those four spineless old men to be so lacking in spirit. Even though they fear my breakthrough to the later stages, they only dare to hide and ask you from Dawn to make a move, which is quite amusing. They must be willing to empty their coffers, right?" the green-robed youth said with a trace of a cold smile on his lips, scornfully.
"This matter is unrelated to the other four sects. Biluo Cave slaughters villages and towns and even turns humans with Spirit Roots into Beast Slaves, violating the heavens' principles. Dawn is merely enforcing heavenly justice," Ou Ji replied calmly and unhurriedly.
"Those four families are just worried about openly attacking me together in case they fail and I escape. Then someday I'd come back for revenge one by one. That's why they don't dare to show up," the green-robed youth laughed.
"More talk is pointless. Chen Cangqiong, just surrender. We'll allow you to disperse your cultivation to the Foundation Establishment Stage. Swear to leave this place for the North Territory or Overseas, and never set foot in Central Plains or Southern Border again. I can vouch for you," Ou Ji urged him in the end.
"Is this your way of telling me to kneel? Dream on! Just four Core Formation cultivators. Since you don't know any better, just stay here, all of you!" the green-robed youth declared. As he did, the Blood Cloud around him suddenly expanded several fold, enveloping the four in a sky-covering shroud.
...
The Dawn Alliance truly came prepared, and everything previously was just to lure the Great Elder out. Now, it's the most critical clash. With the Great Elder of Biluo Cave finally appearing, it also dragged out all of Dawn's hidden trump cards. Now nobody is paying attention to Biluo Cave's Qi Refining disciples anymore, granting them the perfect opportunity to escape.
Deep underground, Yuan Ming thought to himself.
Yuan Ming silently emerged from the ground, heading to burrow into the nearby jungle when the Earth Travel Talisman on him gave a sharp crack, disintegrating into countless fragments that scattered in the wind.
Knowing the limited power of the talisman, he was prepared and quickly made his way out of Biluo Cave.
Just then, a sparrow flew over and landed on his shoulder, a spark of sentience in its eyes.
Yuan Ming was shockingly startled, his hand glowing with a cyan light, ready to do something.
"Yuan Ming, Yuan Ming, hurry to the back mountain," Xi Ying's voice suddenly resounded in his mind.
"Xi Ying, that Great Elder from Biluo Cave and several Core Formation Cultivators from Dawn are about to clash. Isn't this our chance to break free?" Yuan Ming asked, relieved upon realizing it was Xi Ying, then inquired.
"I have been waiting in this damned place for three years just for today's opportunity. Once it's done, let's leave together," Xi Ying said.
"Alright!"
Having heard this, Yuan Ming no longer hesitated and whisked toward the back mountain. Following the sparrow's guidance, he quickly arrived at a tree line near the back mountain of Biluo Cave, under an inconspicuous large tree.
At this moment, Xi Ying was crouched on the tree, looking towards an ancient Cave Mansion not far away, with "Biluo Cave" inscribed in three large characters above it.
"What place is this?" Yuan Ming asked, looking toward the Cave Mansion ahead with a curious expression.
"Xi Cangqiong's place of seclusion," Xi Ying responded.
"Xi Cangqiong, the Great Elder?" Yuan Ming inquired.
"Yes. He's now called Chen Cangqiong, a runaway slave from my household two hundred years ago. He stole treasures from my family and fled here, discovered by the incredibly smart Xi Ying myself," Xi Ying said with pride.
Yuan Ming recalled what the Fisherman had said and suddenly understood.
"I need to make a trip into the cave but don't want to alert Xi Cangqiong. Didn't you create a 'Fog Incense'? Light it up quickly!" Xi Ying urged.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming caught on to Xi Ying's plan.
His self-made "Fog Incense," once lit, produced a white fog that could block Divine Sense. Xi Ying believed it could temporarily disrupt the connection between Chen Cangqiong and the mansion's defenses.
"But he is a Core Formation Stage Expert, and also a Soul Cultivator. Are you sure my Fog Incense can block the connection between him and the mansion? Let's not backfire," Yuan Ming said with concern.
"The backfiring will be on me. Put this on and light the incense!" Xi Ying flicked a paw, revealing a grey cloak that appeared from thin air, falling beside Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming picked up the grey cloak from the ground and put it on. Instantly, all traces of his presence vanished without a trace.
The Wood Concealment Skill could also hide one's presence, but Divine Sense could still detect it. This cloak was different; even with his powerful Divine Sense, he couldn't detect any signs.
Yuan Ming infused his Mana into the cloak, and his entire being merged rapidly with the surrounding environment, imperceptible to both Divine Sense and sight.
Seeing this, he said no more, took out the incense burner, and lit the Fog Incense.
Under Yuan Ming's direction, a large expanse of white fog quickly gathered and soon engulfed the Biluo Cave and the nearby woods.
Xi Ying glanced at the thick fog around her, nodded in satisfaction, and with an incredibly light figure, darted off, vanishing into the fog ahead.
...
In front of Biluo Cave, the silver cat appeared in a flash and spat out a beam of Golden Light, striking the stone gate.
The cyan light of the array that secured the Cave Mansion's doorway suddenly brightened, becoming several times thicker, and the doorway seemed to gain an extra layer of cyan crystal barrier, immediately stopping the Golden Light.
However, the beam of Golden Light abruptly disintegrated, turning into countless Golden Runes that quickly merged into the defense mechanism of the stone gate.
The cyan array might look extraordinary, but upon contact with the Golden Runes, it rapidly collapsed, and in the blink of an eye, it completely dissipated. The ancient door emitted a light sound and slowly opened.
As the array broke down, an invisible wave attempted to spread outward but was blocked by the dense white fog surrounding the mansion, failing to transmit further.
Xi Ying did not immediately enter the cave, instead turning her head to glance toward the front mountain.
On a large tree near Fire Refining Peak of the front mountain, a sparrow was staring unblinkingly at the Great Elder in mid-air, who was fully focused on casting and controlling the Blood Soul, unaware of the defenses on the back mountain Cave Mansion being breached.
Xi Ying finally transformed into a streak of silver light and darted into the cave.
Behind the stone gate was a black passageway that looked quite profound. White candles were lit along the walls, but the flames were an eerie green, giving off a strange appearance.
"Hmph! Old habits die hard, still lighting soul candles!" A trace of coldness flashed in Xi Ying's eyes.
The silver cat did not stop but continued to move quickly forward, coming upon two diverging paths that led in different directions.
From its brow, it shot out a ray of crystalline light, transforming into a red shadow of a bird that flew into the left passageway, while the cat's body entered the right.
The red bird shadow moved even faster, quickly reaching the end.
There was a stone chamber, with the floor dug out to form a pool.
The pool was not filled with water but was filled with fresh, thick blood. Around it was a black array that was slowly rotating.Enj%oy^ing the sto&r+y-? Fin@d m&o!r%e@ at *!.
The blood light within the pool was being drawn by the array, converging towards the center where a stone platform stood with a blood egg the size of a bowl placed on top; it seemed like some kind of bird egg.
All the blood light flowed into the blood egg, being absorbed by it.
"This is no ordinary blood; it's Fierce Beast Essence Blood, no doubt. No wonder Xi Cang Qiong always needs a large amount of Fur Beast Slaves to collect Blood Food. It turns out it's all to feed this blood egg," the red bird shadow spoke in human language.
This blood egg seemed extraordinary, but it was obviously not what Xi Ying was searching for. After a quick search in the chamber and finding nothing else, the bird shadow turned and flew back.
Meanwhile, the silver cat was quickly moving along the passageway, and soon a stone gate appeared in front, emitting a faint black light.
Xi Ying did not stop but kept moving forward.
Behind the stone gate, a white-robed youth was lurking—it was Sha Hao.
Watching Xi Ying getting closer, Sha Hao's eyes showed a trace of surprise and doubt, "Why would the intruder be a cat? Could it be just a scouting spirit beast? No, I cannot afford to be careless!"
He immediately formed a hand seal and pointed, and suddenly the stone walls to the left and right of Xi Ying cracked open, and two towering figures burst out, each wielding a green long knife and slashing through the air.
The knives emitted green blades of light, about three feet long, aiming for Xi Ying's body, cutting through the solid stone walls as if they were tofu.
Xi Ying ignored them completely. A gleam of crystalline light flashed over its brow, and a human figure emerged, floating in mid-air.
If Yuan Ming was here, he would have recognized her—the hazy figure of a beautiful woman, who had once appeared before him.
The hazy woman held her hands out, with white ripples faintly visible in her palms. The two towering figures suddenly halted, and the fierce blade light stopped just inches above Xi Ying's head.
The true forms of the two towering figures were revealed to be two Human Demons covered in green fur, with an incredibly powerful aura, having reached the late stages of the Foundation Establishment. Two black horns sprouted from their heads.
"Xi Cang Qiong is indeed generous to have nurtured two. It seems he plans to merge them, trying to breed a Core Formation Stage Xiao King," noted the hazy woman, glancing at the two Human Demons.
"Who are you? How do you know my master's true name?" Sha Hao, astonished and angry, stood frozen as he demanded an answer.
"You're a disciple of Xi Cang Qiong, aren't you? Didn't he tell you that despite their strength, Human Demons have low intelligence, their Soul Power is chaotic, and they shouldn't be used to fight against Soul Cultivators?" The hazy figure crossed the stone gate and appeared in front of Sha Hao.
Sha Hao's expression changed drastically. He spat out a silver shuttle artifact, striking at the hazy figure.
However, the hazy figure merely waved her hand, and a flash of white light from her palm made Sha Hao's eyes instantly grow dim, and like the two Foundation Establishment Human Demons, he became unable to move.
Even though the silver shuttle artifact hit the hazy figure, it passed right through her without causing any damage.
The hazy figure didn't pay any attention to him but looked straight ahead. Behind the stone gate was a stone chamber, the very place where the Great Elder had been in seclusion, and in front was the black array protecting the Soul Suppressing Kettle.
"Is it here?" The hazy figure gazed at the Soul Suppressing Kettle with an excitement she could hardly suppress and flew forward.
But as she just stepped into the area of the black array, the black light inside intensified several folds in an instant, forming a black light curtain, blocking the hazy figure on the outside.
The hazy figure seemed somewhat surprised, turned around, and flew to Sha Hao's side, pressing her palm on his head as threads of crystalline light rapidly seeped in.
"So that's how it is." The hazy figure murmured to herself and withdrew her hand.
Sha Hao also fell backwards onto the ground, unconscious.
The hazy figure flew back, and the silver cat had already entered the stone chamber.
She pulled out three silver talismans, the surfaces of which faintly bore Thunder Runes, and placed them around the black array.
Immediately after, the hazy figure lifted one hand, activating the three talismans. Three streaks of silver thunder struck the array's light curtain, producing a crackling noise.
The black light curtain trembled violently and was torn open with a large gap.
The hazy figure saw this and a trace of joy flashed across her face. She spat out a pitch-black gemstone, which seemed like a black hole capable of absorbing all light around it, dimming the brightness in the vicinity as soon as it appeared.
With a "whoosh" sound, it darted into the gap in the light curtain, hovering above the Soul Suppressing Kettle.
The Soul Suppressing Kettle trembled violently, especially the lid, which rattled incessantly.
The black gemstone surged with black light, flickering non-stop, and seeming to resonate from afar with the Soul Suppressing Kettle's lid.

chapters.title: Chapter 222 - 199 Mist
chapters.content:
The vague silhouette performed a spell with a flick of the hands, and the black gem slowly descended, fitting perfectly into the notch on the top of the Soul Refining Pot.
Streams of black light began to emanate from the black gem, merging into the dark lid and into the Soul Suppressing Kettle itself.
The Soul Suppressing Kettle's entire body exuded a crystal clear light, the black light on its surface surged, emitting bursts of shrill cheers, as if celebrating the return of a long-lost part.
A look of joy appeared on the face of the vague silhouette, who performed another spell, causing thick black light to spew forth from the black gem, forming a strange pattern around it, rapidly spinning.
The crystalline light on the Soul Suppressing Kettle spun as well, and a "sizzling" sound continuously emanated from within.
After a few breaths, all of the black light and strange noises disappeared, and from the mouth of the kettle, a sparkling silver orb flew out, made up of Soul Power, resembling an elixir.
The vague silhouette opened its mouth and inhaled, and the Silver Orb shot back and entered its mouth.
Silver light radiated from within the silhouette, and its form quickly solidified, transforming into a girl clad in a white gauzy dress with long, cascading hair, her face veiled such that her features could not be seen clearly.
The maiden in the gauzy dress moved her body slightly and nodded in satisfaction.
"Meow..." The silver cat leapt over and rubbed against the legs of the maiden in the gauzy dress.
"You're a good girl, Guoguo," said the maiden in the gauzy dress as she leaned over to pat the fluffy cat head, which seemed indistinguishable from a normal flesh-and-blood body.
She raised her hand and beckoned, causing the Soul Suppressing Kettle to fly out from the dark Array, hovering in front of her.
No sooner had the Soul Suppressing Kettle left the area of the Array than the dark Array began to twist, breaking apart into countless shards of black light.
The gauzy dress maiden showed a look of surprise but didn't seem too concerned as she took the Soul Suppressing Kettle and walked outside.
"Guoguo, I almost forgot. That Blood Egg looks extraordinary, we can't leave it behind; go and fetch it," she remembered something and said to the silver cat.
The silver cat let out a "meow" and shot out like a streak of silver light.
At this moment, at the peak in front of Biluo Cave, Chen Cangqiong, the Great Elder who was engaged in combat with Ou Ji and four other Core Formation Stage cultivators, suddenly felt a pain in his finger. The black ring he was wearing shattered and fell off.
He abruptly turned and looked towards the rear mountain, his expression one of shock and fury, and immediately abandoned the four and flew towards the rear mountain.
"Where do you think you're running to!" Ou Ji and the others didn't know what had happened but instinctively made a move to stop him.
"Get out of my way!"
Four beams of blood-light shot from the brow of Chen Cangqiong, plunging into the surrounding Blood Cloud. The cloud churned, and four gigantic Blood Bats with wingspans of several meters flew out, hurtling toward the heads of the four cultivators with overwhelming momentum, incredibly swift.
Ou Ji and the others, seeming to have a particular dread of the Blood Bats' assault, quickly dodged to avoid the impact.
Seizing the opportunity, Chen Cangqiong's figure blurred into the Blood Cloud, which roiled thunderously, quickly transforming into a massive Blood Dragon that broke through the cultivators' blockade and dashed towards the rear mountain as swiftly as lightning.
...
Inside Biluo Cave.
Sha Hao lay on the ground, his life or death uncertain.
The maiden in the gauzy dress approached the two Human Demons and shook the Soul Suppressing Kettle she held, muttering a complex and obscure incantation.
The lid of the kettle shot up, hovering above their heads and with a swift spin, unleashed a tremendous suction force.
The brows of the two Human Demons split open, releasing two black Soul Pearls that fell into the kettle lid.
A hint of joy flickered in the eyes of the gauzy dress maiden, but she suddenly looked outside and said, "Did they discover us this quickly? Oh dear, not fun anymore, we better leave."
In the dense forest outside the Cave Mansion, Yuan Ming, surrounded by a moving mist, was approached by the same sparrow that had come before, now landing on his shoulder and speaking,
"That guy is back; you better leave!"
Yuan Ming was startled and used the soul crow to look towards the plaza area in front of the mountain.
In mid-air, there was an imposing Blood Shadow speeding towards this direction at a lightning pace, quickly approaching the rear mountain area in just a few breaths.
An overwhelming presence engulfed the area, causing all the birds, insects, and creatures of the rear mountain to be filled with terror, yet they were immobilized by the pressure of this presence.
Feeling that enormous presence for the first time, Yuan Ming experienced an unprecedented sense of oppression.
He glanced at the entrance to Biluo Cave where Xi Ying was and then at the direction from which the Great Elder was coming. His hesitating gaze became resolute.
Yuan Ming immediately took out an incense burner and held it in hand, then he took out a bundle of "Fog Incense" and inserted it into the burner, lighting them all with a flick of his fingertips.
With the Exorcism Technique, Yuan Ming controlled the burner to fly in the direction of the Great Elder. After getting halfway there, he shifted course towards another direction and then, moments later, changed directions again.
After several such maneuvers, within an area of ten miles, the air was filled with dense white fog several times thicker than before, starting to solidify like a tangible object, completely obscuring the line of sight.
The already furious Great Elder prompted the Blood Dragon to halt above the rear mountain, only to see that the front was already obscured by thick white fog, making it impossible to see the way ahead.
Chen Cangqiong's eyes narrowed, as he released Divine Power, spreading it all around.
"Eh?"
As he released his Divine Sense, he couldn't help but express his surprise aloud.
The dense white fog before him actually had the ability to obstruct Divine Sense; the moment he extended his Divine Power, it was like plunging into a quagmire, dragged and pulled as it struggled to spread out.
"Trivial tricks!"
He suddenly thrust his hands forward, his sleeves billowing and rustling loudly.
