From the sleeves surged the image of Azure Dragons writhing, with fierce winds rolling out, instantly dispersing the white fog within several dozen feet in front of him.
As the visibility cleared before his eyes, the Great Elder immediately dashed forward.
However, he hadn't run far when he was surprised to find that he was once again shrouded by the rolling dense fog, the void several feet ahead of him becoming blurred and indistinct once more.
Right now, he needed to hasten back to his Cave Mansion, but limited visibility and the restriction on his Divine Sense made even discerning the direction difficult; to rush about rashly, he feared he might encounter a stealth attack from the treasure thief.
After his facial expression underwent several changes, he brought his two fingers together and pointed at his brow. A dark red Blood Bat pattern emerged on his forehead, and immediately a red halo expanded like ripples on a lake's surface, spreading around him.
With the Divine Thought Secret Technique enhancing him, his Divine Sense, originally only capable of probing five yards, expanded to a mile in an instant.
"The obstructive force is so strong?" He couldn't help feeling surprised again.
Normally, his Divine Power could easily cover ten miles without any secret technique, and after using one, it could expand nearly tenfold.
But now, he could only probe a mere mile?
At that moment, his Divine Thought suddenly picked up a sensation from a certain direction.
Chen Cangqiong's brows furrowed with anger, and as he scolded sternly, he pinched a spell with one hand. A ring of silver light shone around his pupils, and a sharp glint shot out from his eyes.
The giant, terrifying Blood Shadow behind him immediately mimicked drawing a bow and releasing arrows.
"Swoosh" "Swoosh" "Swoosh"
Seven or eight dark red arrows, condensed from Divine Soul Power, shot through the air, crossing over a hundred yards in the span of only two breaths. The area they covered was precisely the ten-plus yards centered around Yuan Ming.
One of them aimed almost directly at Yuan Ming, who was concealed behind an ancient tree.
Yet at this moment, Yuan Ming's vision and Divine Sense were also obscured by the dense fog, and he didn't notice the Great Elder's attack at all.
Not until the Divine Soul attacking arrow was within several dozen yards did he finally realize the danger, and while his heart chilled, he quickly leapt to one side.
At that moment, a white Jade button on his gray cloak lit up with light, unfolding a silver-white nebulous light screen that stood in front of Yuan Ming.
The next instant, the blood-colored arrow scraped past the silver-white light screen.
The white Jade button emitted strands of light, stirring up a violent Soul Wave.Visit My Virtual Library Empire (*) for more.
Merely swept by the aftermath, Yuan Ming felt his head throb, as if struck by a heavy hammer, his body staggered almost to the point of falling.
Fortunately, the incense burner he held immediately lit up with a gentle glow, sending a warm current into his mind, instantly soothing the Soul Wave.
Yuan Ming's heart raced with fear; a Qi Refining Stage Cultivator facing a Core Formation Stage Soul Cultivator's Divine Soul attack was truly like an egg striking a rock. Just a tiny touch could shred his Divine Soul to bits.
If Yuan Ming hadn't worn that cloak capable of concealing his aura and blocking Divine Sense, and also lit the Fog Incense, then with Chen Cangqiong's proficiency in Soul Cultivation, he would have nowhere to hide. A simple gesture from the opponent could annihilate his soul.
Yuan Ming didn't dare to hesitate and immediately activated the Wind Swift Skill, with a light shining from his Jade Belt, fleeing rapidly backward; the sparrow followed close behind.
Just as his figure merged into the dense fog, Chen Cangqiong had already reached the spot where Yuan Ming had just been.
The intense Soul Wave had finally been sensed by Chen Cangqiong, who focused his attention in Yuan Ming's direction of retreat, grunting coldly.
His Divine Thought probed faster than Yuan Ming's retreat, locking onto Yuan Ming's position again before he could escape a mile.
Just as he was about to attack again with the Blood Soul Technique, his vision suddenly blurred, and a surge of dizziness overwhelmed him. His body swayed violently, and he almost couldn't stand steady for a moment.
Chen Cangqiong immediately let out a low shout. His aura soared instantly, dispelling the sensation of dizziness and confusion.
Scanning the ground, he saw that not far from his feet, seven or eight incense sticks were messily stuck in the ground, their tips smokey, giving off a unique scent.
"Seductive scent?" Chen Cangqiong's brows furrowed.
By the time he came to his senses, the aura he had locked onto had escaped from his Divine Sense range, and he could no longer trace it.
Letting a junior, whose Cultivation was far weaker than his own, slip through his fingers ignited an unnamed rage in his heart.
Chen Cangqiong was unsure how to vent, so he took a deep breath, trying his best to suppress that flicker of anger, calming down and sweeping his gaze around.
But the surrounding fog was vast, without a single silhouette in sight.

chapters.title: Chapter 223 - 200: Luring the Beast
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming managed to flee a couple of hundred yards before he dared to stop, taking cover behind a rock, his chest heaving wildly as he gasped for air.
Just a moment ago, he had felt that he was about to be discovered. Had it not been for the seductive scent he had lit in advance, which hindered the other party for a moment, he surely wouldn't have been able to escape.
"Core Formation Stage soul cultivators are truly terrifying. Thank goodness for the cloak Xi Ying gave me. I wonder how Xi Ying is doing," Yuan Ming pressed one hand against his chest, feeling as though he had narrowly escaped death.
However, amidst his panic, he still closed his eyes slightly and began to check the perspectives of the two soul crows he had sent out.
One remained at the cave entrance where Xi Ying was, and the other continued to monitor the plaza area.
At the entrance of Biluo Cave, there was still no sign of the silver cat, while the Great Elder once again flared his sleeves, starting to blow away the fog in search of the cave entrance with a gust of wind.
The fog incense wouldn't last much longer, and with the Great Elder's cultivation, he and Xi Ying were bound to be discovered sooner or later.
Yuan Ming's brows furrowed deeply as he pondered a strategy. A moment later, he inserted a deep black stick of incense into the incense burner, where the fog incense was burning, and lit it.
Create chaos and escape during the confusion!
After smelling the familiar scent of the Beast Attraction Incense, Yuan Ming once again used the Exorcism Technique to control the incense burner. Guided by the direction provided by the soul crows, he moved towards the Great Elder's location under the cover of the thick fog.
...
In the front mountain plaza, the chaos continued.
Earlier, the blood bats had caused nearly a hundred cultivators from both Biluo Cave and the Dawn Alliance to fall into a frenzy, attacking other members of the Dawn Alliance as if they had lost their minds.
Some of the elders who had been dispatched to the east and west sides of Biluo Cave also began to return with their people in tow, meeting up with the remaining disciples to mount a desperate resistance.
After the Great Elder broke away from the siege and ducked towards the rear mountain, the hunched-back elder and two other Core Formation Stage cultivators briefly conferred before chasing after the Great Elder. Meanwhile, Ou Ji stayed behind, directing the cultivators of the Dawn Alliance to fend off counterattacks from the remaining forces of Biluo Cave, while also stepping in to stabilize the frenzied members of their own alliance.
After all, many of them were their own people who had merely lost their sensibility momentarily; they couldn't be killed indiscriminately.
The original chaotic situation began to show signs of improvement.
With both cave masters captured, the remaining Biluo Cave cultivators, leaderless, no longer cared whether they could control them or not and released almost all their spirit beasts, fighting like trapped beasts in a desperate struggle.
However, just as they were fiercely battling, a peculiar situation arose.
A Green Wolf, which had been under control and engaged in combat, suddenly came to a stop mid-charge and turned its head towards the direction of the rear mountain.
Its eyes gradually turned red, its mouth revealing blood-stained teeth as thick saliva dribbled out. Suddenly, it charged madly towards the rear mountain as if possessed by madness.
The bewildered Biluo Cave Disciple still on the Green Wolf's back didn't know what was happening and hastily used the Beast Taming Technique, trying to regain control of the Green Wolf.
But at that moment, the Green Wolf had lost all sense of reason, and the Beast Taming Technique also failed to work. Its back arched in furious leaps, it threw off its rider, and headed straight for the rear mountain.Note: Check * for any corrections.
Like the Green Wolf, more and more spirit beasts broke free from control and flung their masters away, or even dragged them along, rushing towards the rear mountain. The spirit beasts of the Dawn Alliance were no exception.
In no time, the spiritual birds and Fierce Beasts from the surrounding mountains all converged around Biluo Cave.
A stampede of beasts…
In the rear mountain, as the fog incense burned out, the dense white fog gradually began to disappear.
The Great Elder, Chen Cangqiong, had also found his direction again and was preparing to continue on his way when he suddenly heard the sound of hooves rumbling around him, which put him on high alert.
He shifted his gaze around and saw that in the distance, within the rolling fog of the forest, huge figures burst forth and charged directly towards him.
Among those shadows were the massive One-horned Rhinoceroses, Green-furred Giant Wolves with wings on their backs, Black Pigs covered in Scale Armor, and fire-red Scale Pythons as thick as barrels...
Some of them were spirit beasts raised by the Biluo Cave Sect, and even more were Fierce Beasts that lived in the Ten Thousand Mountains; however, all of them were charging towards him as if driven mad.
"How can there be a beast tide?" Chen Cangqiong looked anxious and confused.
The Fierce Beasts and spirit beasts all around him had charged up in a frenzy, and he had no choice but to take action in response, once again bogged down.
Above in the sky, huge birds of prey also swooped towards his direction, diving from above towards the Great Elder.
Chen Cangqiong was surrounded by nearly a hundred Fierce Beasts, blocking his path.
"Annoying!"
A resonant, powerful growl erupted from Chen Cangqiong, and the blood-colored bat mark on his forehead lit up. From behind him, a terrifying claw of the Blood Soul Illusion swept across in a scythe-like motion.
In an instant, blood splattered everywhere, and the Fierce Beasts within a hundred yards of the Great Elder were all torn asunder by the Blood Claw, their Divine Souls shredded as if their entire strength had been drained. They fell in disarray across the ground.
Chen Cangqiong easily blazed a trail of blood through the throng of Fierce Beasts, and, after discerning the direction, rushed toward the cave.
...
On the other side, Yuan Ming put away the incense burner after retracting it. The Beast Attraction Incense was already half burned, so he stored the incense burner away.
At that moment, Yuan Ming suddenly saw Xi Ying's sparrow fly through the thinning fog and come towards him.
"Xi Ying, have you come out of Biluo Cave?" Without waiting for the sparrow to speak, Yuan Ming asked first.
The sparrow landed on his arm, speaking human language, "I came out earlier, hurry over here."
"Lead the way!" Yuan Ming halted abruptly, turned around, and commanded.
The sparrow flapped its wings and flew in a certain direction.
Yuan Ming followed, his cloak billowing as he sprinted, the corners of his garment fluttering in the air.
He had not run far when the surrounding mist gradually dissipated, clearing the view of the surroundings; from a distance, he could see a large number of frenzied spirit beasts and Fierce Beasts that had already made their way to this area.
Although the Beast Attraction Incense had been extinguished, the lingering scent still affected the crazed Fierce Beasts. Having lost their direction, they began attacking the living creatures nearby.
As a living human, Yuan Ming naturally bore the brunt of the attack, becoming the primary target.
Seeing seven or eight Fierce Beasts charging at him first, with even more frenzied figures looming behind, Yuan Ming did not panic at all. He immediately took a Detoxification Pill and lit the seductive scent in the incense burner.
With the catalysis of the incense burner, the effect of the seductive scent increased manifold. Within a hundred paces around Yuan Ming, it instantly became forbidden ground for the Fierce Beasts.
All Fierce Beasts that approached within a hundred paces of him, without exception, began falling to the ground, descending into slumber.
Luckily, the sparrow, heeding Yuan Ming's warning, flew high above a hundred paces, arriving first at Xi Ying's location.
Yuan Ming rushed all the way and finally saw the silver cat's figure far in the distance, only to unexpectedly find it squatting beside that female Array Master from the Scatter Alliance.
Just as Yuan Ming was about to catch up, he suddenly heard a loud noise coming from the direction of the cave behind him.
The soul crow that stayed in Biluo Cave immediately gave him a clear view of the scene there.
He saw a burst of Blood Light suddenly appear at the mouth of the cave, massive rocks collapsing, dust and smoke billowing.
"Sha Hao, wake up, who took my Soul Suppressing Kettle…" Chen Cangqiong's figure burst out from the tumbling dust, his eyes blood-red, his face full of intense anger suffused with thick killing intent, he bellowed.
Before his words fell, three figures had already broken through the fog, following the sound of his voice and finding their way over.
"Chen Cangqiong, where are you going!"
"Do you think you can get away?"
"Chen Cangqiong, let's have a good talk."
Three voices arose from three different directions, and the hunchbacked elder, including the two other Core Formation Stage cultivators, appeared one after another.
The Great Elder felt as if his vision were already covered by red, his heart filled with nothing but raging anger that had nowhere to vent; he roared, "You're seeking death, I'll grant it to you!"
Behind him, the Blood Shadow surged forth, pouncing on one of them.
…
Watching the four Core Formation cultivators continue in their chaotic battle, Yuan Ming sighed with relief and turned his gaze back to Xi Ying and the female Array Master.
He saw that outside of them, there was a protective shield enveloped in green light, separating them from the frenzied Fierce Beasts around.
At that moment, a One-horned Rhinoceros with green scales covering its body was furiously slamming against the green light shield.
Its thick, slightly curved horn, gleaming with a metallic luster, struck the green light shield repeatedly, causing the entire shield to tremble violently, its light flickering.
The guiding sparrow flew into the green light shield, landing on the female Array Master.
After a moment, the spirit light in its eyes scattered and, once again flapping its wings, it flew away directly.
Seeing that he was about to reach the vicinity of the silver cat, Yuan Ming hurriedly extinguished the seductive scent in the incense burner, fearing it might affect Xi Ying adversely.
Spotting two Green Wolves drawing near the green light shield, the prepared Yuan Ming instantly raised his hand and waved; the Nine-Ring Gold Saber whistled out, skewering both wolves, while he himself, wielding the Cold Star Sword, charged next to the One-horned Rhinoceros, striking down with his sword.
The One-horned Rhinoceros, seeing an attack coming, immediately turned to confront it, its solitary horn aimed straight at Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming's sword flashed with cold light; as the frost surged from the blade, before even touching the One-horned Rhinoceros, a layer of White Frost had already formed on its forehead.
Even feeling the chilling breath, the One-horned Rhinoceros did not back down; in its ferocity, it let out a roar and charged with full force.
Finally, the long sword descended, colliding right with the horn.
A clanging metallic sound rang out.
The exceptionally hard horn ultimately could not withstand the Sharpness of the Cold Star Sword.
The Cold Star Sword cleaved through the tip of the One-horned Rhinoceros' horn, its edge penetrating its head.
The One-horned Rhinoceros' head was split in two, but it still managed to push Yuan Ming back a few steps before finally stopping.
By then, the already faltering green light shield also collapsed, dissolving into points of light and vanishing...

chapters.title: Chapter 224 - 201 Soul Splitting Possession
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming pulled out his sword and hurried over to the silver cat's side.
At that moment, he could feel the intermittent calls of birds and roars of beasts from all directions, and the ground was also trembling slightly, showing the gradual effect of the Beast Attraction Incense.
"Xi Ying, how are you doing?" he asked repeatedly, carefully examining the silver cat and even stroking its head.
This was the first time the silver cat had allowed him to touch her body, and the feel of her head was soft and compliant.
The silver cat crouched on the ground, allowed him to stroke her, then tilted her head to look at him, and then said, "Meow…"
Meow?
Yuan Ming was slightly stunned, then frowned, sensing something was amiss.
In the silver cat's eyes, the usual spark of intelligence and pride was gone, replaced by a gaze that seemed to belong to the instinct of a spirit beast.
She even allowed him to touch her, what had happened to the silver cat before him?
But the guiding sparrow and Xi Ying's melodious voice could not have been faked, clearly, it had led him here.
"Xi Ying?" Yuan Ming tried to call out again.
The silver cat had a clear reaction to his call, but it wasn't her usual response, only giving another "meow."
As Yuan Ming was filled with doubts, Xi Ying's voice suddenly sounded in his Sea of Consciousness.
"That's Guoguo, my spirit pet. I am in this woman's body."
Hearing this, Yuan Ming instinctively looked at the white-robed woman lying next to the silver cat who wore transparent embroidered shoes, her eyes closed tightly, showing no signs of life.
"What exactly is going on?" Yuan Ming was utterly confused.
"She was previously injured by Xi Cangqiong, her Divine Soul severely damaged, nearly collapsing. This body with the Five Elements Unification Spirit Root is quite good. Initially, my soul splitting was attached to Guoguo, but now I plan to possess her body and borrow it for a while," Xi Ying explained.
"So that's it, you can even split your soul!" Yuan Ming exclaimed in surprise.
"Yeah, the main soul controls the body for cultivation, while the soul splitting comes out to play," Xi Ying answered.
"Can Soul Cultivators really do that?" Yuan Ming asked, wistfully.
"Of course, I am a genius, you know," said Xi Ying with pride, then added, "However, the body controlled by my split soul can't unleash my full strength, otherwise, I could take Xi Cangqiong's life with just a finger."
"You're amazing," Yuan Ming sincerely complimented Xi Ying, then said, "I just ignited the Beast Attraction Incense, and soon there will be more fierce beasts, we should go somewhere safe."
"It's too late, any further delay and the original soul of this woman will disperse, and the body will be completely ruined, such a pity. I must start casting now, and if you can't hold them off, just run for your life, don't mind me, I can always return to Guoguo's body," Xi Ying finished, paused, and then said, "Mmm, Xi Cangqiong is now entangled by three Core Formation Stages, so the major trouble is gone."
"Alright, I'll cover you for the next while," Yuan Ming said, looking around.
"Okay, I'll be back soon, really looking forward to the feeling of being an Array Master," Xi Ying said.Findthesourceofthischapterat*.
Having said that, the Female Array Master lying on the ground suddenly sat up sharply.
Her body suddenly revived, and like a marionette, she made the motions of sitting cross-legged with her hands forming spells.
As she settled into a cross-legged position, a hazy light unexpectedly emerged from between her eyebrows, within which flashed the shadow of a Three-legged Golden Crow, vanishing in a blink.
Soon after, the aura around her began to intensify, and a wave of Divine Soul strength grew from weak to strong, radiating from her body.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming raised his hand to recall the Nine-Ring Gold Saber, gripping the Cold Star Sword, he stood guard beside Xi Ying.
After he had cleaved down more than a dozen fierce beasts that charged at them one after the other, the commotion from the surrounding beast crowd intensified, and what started as a slight rumbling of the ground now turned significantly more violent.
He thought about lighting more Fog Incense to cover the area, but he was apprehensive that it might be scattered by the fierce beasts that followed, making it even harder to protect the Female Array Master if he accidentally moved away from Xi Ying's side.
And now, seductive scent could not be used either, so he had to rely on his own skills to hold the fort.
"It's just thirty minutes!" he grinned broadly, filled with bold spirit.
At that moment, another seventeen or eighteen fierce beasts, influenced by the Beast Attraction Incense, noticed the two people and one cat, and driven by their wild nature, they immediately charged towards them.
Yuan Ming glanced around, and noticing that the strongest beast among those approaching was only Level 1 Middle Stage, he felt somewhat relieved.
He strode forward, keeping just over three meters distance from Xi Ying, formed a spell with one hand, while his Cold Star Sword immediately lit up with starlight, flew out of his hand, and swept toward those fierce beasts.
The Exorcism Technique controlled the Cold Star Sword as if directing his own arms, unstoppable amongst the group of fierce beasts, with its cold breath spreading wherever the sword light passed, each fierce beast chopped into pieces without a trace of blood spilled.
In just a few breaths, nearly all a dozen fierce beasts had been slain, not even coming within ten meters of Yuan Ming, let alone close to Xi Ying.
For a period, the vicinity was littered with the carcasses of fierce beasts of various sizes, and though Yuan Ming still had plenty of strength left, the battle had left him somewhat breathless.
Watching this scene, the silver cat Guoguo lazed open her mouth and yawned.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming sighed internally, sure now that this silver cat was undeniably Guoguo herself, as with Xi Ying's personality, if she were possessing the silver cat, she would never act like this in front of him.
After one glance, Yuan Ming immediately withdrew his gaze.
The effect of the Beast Attraction Incense wouldn't fade anytime soon; hordes of Fierce Beasts kept streaming toward the back mountain.
Although their location wasn't the epicenter of the fierce beast onslaught, which spared them from attacks from all sides, it was still a heavily affected area. They couldn't afford to be careless.
Soon, the sky darkened somewhat, with large numbers of avian Fierce Beasts, along with many other birds affected by the incense, sweeping over the treetops and flying toward Biluo Cave.
Under the effect of the incense, they gathered there temporarily without attacking Yuan Ming and his party.
But once the effect of the incense wore off, it was anybody's guess what these Fierce Beasts would do.
As Yuan Ming stayed on guard, there was suddenly a loud "rumbling" sound coming from the woods.
Ahead, trees fell in swathes, and dozens of tough-skinned, sharp-toothed wild boar Fierce Beasts formed a phalanx, charging towards them with eyes red, kicking up dust and dirt.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming's brow slightly furrowed.
This time, he didn't rush forward to attack, realizing that he wasn't confident he could slash through dozens of frenzied wild boars with a single sword strike.
His gaze sharpened, and suddenly he raised his hand and gestured as if wielding a sword, casting the Exorcism Technique.
As he lifted his hand, a concealed dark flash shot from his sleeve, the Black Needle Magical Artifact whizzed out, tracing a blurred arc in mid-air, and hovered to the side of the entire boar phalanx.
"Go."
Yuan Ming flicked his finger, and the black steel needle emitted a quivering sound as it shot out.
The black streak of light flashed, and in an instant, it passed from the left to the right side of the boar Fierce Beasts at the forefront.
"Plop…"
The runes on the surface of the needle were stained with a layer of blood, and its trembling end dripped blood onto the ground.
As the blood hit the soil, the leading dozen or so wild boars hadn't even time to shriek before they toppled over, lifeless.
The wild boars behind, caught off guard by their dead companions blocking the way, fell one by one in a messy heap, some running so swiftly that they were tripped and sent flying into the air.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming continued to manipulate the Black Needle, weaving it through the fallen creatures to continue the slaughter, while he soared into the air and, with sword in hand, successively chopped down the flying Fierce Beasts.
Soon, this wave of wild boars was completely exterminated.
Just as Yuan Ming could catch his breath, the ground shook with vibrations, signalling another large group of Fierce Beasts surging toward them, more numerous and scattered than before, almost forming a fan-shaped assault on their position.
Yuan Ming concentrated and operated the Exorcism Technique, controlling the Flying Needle to charge back and forth among the beasts.
But given the scattered distribution of this wave, the effect wasn't as good as the previous assault on the wild boars, and many Fierce Beasts still reached their position.
Yuan Ming, wielding the Cold Star Sword, utilized the Wind Swift Skill and Shadowless Step to their limits, shuttling back and forth in front of the Female Array Master, swiftly cutting down any beast that broke through.
In just a short time, piles of corpses began to amass in the direction of the beast tide's onslaught.
He himself was drenched in blood.
Yuan Ming leaned on his sword, breathing heavily, and turned his head to glance at the Female Array Master. She was still sitting cross-legged.
The Silver Cat Guoguo crouched by her side, appearing lazy and uninterested in the intense battle occurring around her.
Yuan Ming caught his breath, just beginning to ponder over the matter of soul splitting when he again felt the ground vibrating, signaling yet another wave of Fierce Beasts on the move.
With the soul crow's bird's-eye view, he saw nearly a hundred more Fierce Beasts rapidly approaching.
The most troublesome was a Single-Horned Green-Scaled Python running at the forefront, emanating fluctuations indicating it was at the Second Level Early Stage, equivalent to a Fierce Beast at the Foundation Establishment Stage.
This was no trivial opponent...
Indeed, as Yuan Ming controlled the Black Needle for another surprise attack, the keenly aware beast spotted it.
It turned its head toward the sneaking needle and spat out a breath of Cold Breath.
The intense chilly air condensed the moisture in the void, forming layers of Ice Crystals that hindered, successfully slowing the needle's speed.
After it pierced through the Ice Crystals, the Single-Horned Green-Scaled Python knocked it aside with a flick of its sharp horn.
With its massive body rapidly slithering, it climbed atop a mound made of beast corpses, raised its head high, and its cold eyes looked down at Yuan Ming below.
However, what met it was a head-sized blaze of intense flames.
Knowing his needle stood no chance against the Single-Horned Green-Scaled Python, Yuan Ming had already started to gather power early on using the corpse mountain as cover, preparing the Burning Explosion Skill.
His lips curled into a slight smirk, soon revealing a smile, and that fireball shot out with a "whoosh."

chapters.title: Chapter 225 - 202 - Hold the Fort
chapters.content:
As the intense flames drew near, the frenzied Single-Horned Green-Scaled Python showed no intention of dodging. Firstly, it reared its head back to gather strength, then abruptly dived forward, opening its mouth to release a gust of bitterly cold wind.
The white frost, under the force of the wind, formed a torrent of icy air that rushed straight towards Yuan Ming.
The intense fireball met the cold air head-on, its extremely high temperature instantly evaporated the chilly air, creating a large amount of white mist, obscuring Yuan Ming's line of sight.
But in the next instant, within the white mist, a fiery red sun flared up.
The fierce light of the fire violently expanded, rapidly enlarging from a human-head-sized orb of fire and exploded into a dazzling wall of fire, countless spheres of flame scattered in all directions, evaporating all the mist.
In the bright fiery light, the body of the Single-Horned Green-Scaled Python burst apart, turning into countless fragments that shot outward.
Even the mountain of Fierce Beast corpses piled up nearby was blown open, with remnants of shattered beast corpses everywhere.
The beast horde charging from behind inevitably felt the impact; some, already not strong in physique, were even pierced through by the splintering Beast Bones due to the violent impact, resulting in numerous casualties.
Yuan Ming, taking advantage of the chaos, once again maneuvered the Black Needles to slaughter through the beast horde, swiftly resolving this wave of attack.
After this wave, Yuan Ming staggered, feeling a sense of weakness as if both his mana and physical strength had been drained.
He quickly took out an elixir and swallowed it, while grasping a Spirit Stone in one hand to rapidly restore his mana.
A moment later, Yuan Ming suddenly furrowed his brows and looked upwards.
Above him, the previously calm swarm suddenly began to grow restless, some of the flying Fierce Beasts unexpectedly started attacking those next to them, wildly fighting amongst themselves.
This meant that the Beast Attraction incense he had released earlier was starting to wear off, and the upcoming hordes would no longer converge here, indicating that the danger was about to be resolved.
Before Yuan Ming could shift his gaze, the Fierce Beasts circling overhead, having been drawn by the intense scent of blood, discovered them and began to dive down.
Yuan Ming sighed, once again maneuvering the black steel needles, lunging rapidly at them.
For now, controlling the Black Needles seemed to be the most practical tactic since they were precise and consumed the least amount of mana, and with Yuan Ming's own Divine Soul Power, also the easiest to manipulate.
As for Yuan Ming himself, he needed to recover his mana as quickly as possible. Unless a Second Level Fierce Beast appeared, he would avoid engaging in combat as much as possible to conserve strength.
But the group of Fierce Beasts above, especially the seven or eight carrion-eating vultures, clearly did not intend to leave him in peace.
They all dispersed in all directions, constantly diving and attacking, each moving agilely and with extreme speed, making it difficult for the Black Needles to be effective.
Left with no choice, Yuan Ming slapped the Corpse Nourishing Bag, summoning the Core Formation Stage refining corpse, Heavenly Snake Master.
As the refining corpse appeared, the Soul Crow that Yuan Ming had left in the cave also flew back, not stopping for a moment before colliding head-on into the refining corpse's head, disappearing into it.
The next instant, a flicker of ghostly light flashed in the eyes of Heavenly Snake Master, and he began to move.
Wearing a pair of black gloves on his hands, he moved close to the Female Array Master, standing guard attentively.
If those carrion-eating vultures only ate the dead beast bodies, Yuan Ming would not bother with them. But if they treated "Xi Ying" as a corpse too and attacked, he would immediately intervene.
Even if the Black Needle couldn't block them, he still had Heavenly Snake Master, adding an extra layer of insurance.
Time passed unmeasured, and eventually, the mountain woods gradually grew quiet again, leaving many more corpses of Fierce Beasts around.
Yuan Ming, now mentally exhausted, had no choice but to recall the remaining Soul Crows, leaving just one nearby on alert.
The body of Heavenly Snake Master naturally returned to the Corpse Nourishing Bag. At present, Yuan Ming could only just barely activate this corpse and could not utilize its full power, nor dare to leave it out for too long.
"There shouldn't be another large-scale beast attack coming. Thirty minutes are about to pass…" As he was thinking this, Yuan Ming suddenly narrowed his eyes.
He clenched his hand on the Cold Star Sword, and his figure swiftly dashed, arriving behind Xi Ying.
Just then, the trees in the nearby woods shook wildly, a Mountain Turtle, standing thirty feet tall with a vast body, broke through several towering ancient trees and charged wildly towards them.
The Mountain Turtle, a terrestrial tortoise known for its incredibly resilient body and nearly indestructible tortoiseshell that resembled a Defensive Magical Artifact, was infinitely strong.
In the many legends of the Southern Border, there were stories of Mountain Turtles carrying mountains, always embodying strength.
Normally gentle and disinclined to fight, Mountain Turtles usually didn't attack other living creatures. However, it seemed to have also gone mad under the influence of the Beast Attraction Incense.
At that moment, Yuan Ming noticed that on the head of the approaching Mountain Turtle, there unmistakably was a yellow Spirit Talisman attached.
This trаnslаtiоn is pоwеrеd by thе rеаdеrs аt М|V|LЕ9МРYR.
This was a spirit beast bred by the Sect, radiating fluctuations of Spiritual Power, which had reached the Second Level Early Stage, another Foundation Establishment Stage spirit beast.
The Mountain Turtle was now less than sixty feet away from them, leaving Yuan Ming with no time for further thought, so he could only advance with his sword drawn.
As they got closer, Yuan Ming gripped his sword with both hands, his mana surged within him, flowing into the Cold Star Sword.
The sword glimmered with starlight, white frost overflowed, and ice crystals formed along the blade.
With a forceful slash of his long sword, Yuan Ming cut towards the head of the advancing Mountain Turtle.
A snowy white arc of sword light swept out, where it passed, the air's temperature plummeted, the suspended moisture in the air condensed into ice, even the grass on the ground was covered with a layer of White Frost.
Just as the sword light fell, the Mountain Turtle's head, which had peeked out, suddenly retracted back into its thick shell.
The sword light struck the shell, emitting a sharp clang and then shattering like scattering stardust, but the Mountain Turtle was completely unharmed. It stuck its head out again, continuing to charge towards Yuan Ming.
It had only taken a few steps when the Mountain Turtle's stride suddenly halted; from where the sword light had fallen, a cold air spread, instantly forming a layer of ice that encased it entirely.
The Mountain Turtle was encased in ice.
Yuan Ming hadn't even had time to rejoice when his heart suddenly started pounding wildly.
His external Divine Sense sensed a powerful aura assaulting from the other side towards the female Array Master.
Yuan Ming abruptly turned and saw a tall figure suddenly appearing in the adjacent woods.
This person had a square face and a prominent nose, sporting a short beard and wearing a brocade robe stained with much blood. His expression was gloomy; it was none other than Elder Meng Shan.
Ever since the invasion of the Sect began, this person had not shown himself. Yuan Ming thought he had already fled, but unexpectedly, he encountered him here.
"Elder Meng Shan! Disciple is here, I have treasures to offer you."
Yuan Ming raised his arm and shouted loudly, trying to attract his attention.
However, his target, who was the unmoving female Array Master, completely ignored Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming activated the Jade Belt, employed the Wind Swift Skill and Shadowless Step, his figure flashing rapidly, trying to intercept between Elder Meng Shan and the female Array Master.
Elder Meng Shan remained indifferent, launching a palm strike at Yuan Ming and said, "Kill you, and everything is mine."
Under the mana driven by a Late-stage Foundation Establishment cultivator, a casual palm strike was not something Yuan Ming, a Qi Refining Late Stage cultivator, could withstand.
Seeing an almost transparent white palm imprint pressing down from the void, swiftly striking towards him, Yuan Ming dared not face it head-on and hurriedly dodged aside.
Shocked by Elder Meng Shan's shamelessness, Yuan Ming didn't waste words; he flung out three Thunder Strike Talismans towards Elder Meng Shan.
The talisman paper burned in the void, and three bolts of thunder fell from the sky, striking towards Meng Shan.
The latter raised his hand towards the sky, pushing it with the palm which contained an Eight Diagrams Mirror, brightening up with golden light and forming a barrier that blocked the strikes.
The white thunderbolts crashed into the golden light barrier, sparking off large arcs of electricity, but failed to cause any damage.
Elder Meng Shan ultimately reached the female Array Master's side first. Guoguo at her feet suddenly stared wide-eyed, its fur standing on end, though the former didn't even glance at the little silver creature.
Due to the rumbling sound of the thunder and the sparks of electric light that flared up, a momentary glare was cast in front of Meng Shan, briefly hindering his vision.
At that moment, a black soul crow swiftly swooped down from a nearby tree, plunged into Elder Meng Shan's forehead amidst an irresistibly rapid assault, entering him from solid to ethereal.
The soul crow exploded inside Elder Meng Shan's Sea of Consciousness, releasing pure Divine Soul Power and causing a strong soul shock.
Before Meng Shan could react, his entire body stiffened suddenly, losing control of his body under inertia, and he fell forwards.
A flash of joy appeared in Yuan Ming's eyes, and without delaying a moment, his figure dashed forward swiftly; his hand raised the Cold Star Sword, slashing heavily towards his head.
Just as the sword's edge was about to strike, the situation took another turn.
"Roar..."
A roar, similar to that of a wild beast, erupted from behind him. Yellow light surged from the ground as huge rocks burst upward, colliding fiercely. In the strong airwave, they struck towards Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming's back felt like it was being rammed by a wild bull, uncontrollably tumbling forward.
The Mountain Turtle, which had been encased in ice, managed to free itself at this moment and launched an attack.
The soul crow's soul collision attack, although temporarily damaging the soul, could only incapacitate bodily control momentarily.
Disturbed by the Mountain Turtle, Yuan Ming had lost his prime opportunity to overpower and severely injure Elder Meng Shan.
He sighed internally. As he tumbled to the ground, he caught sight out of the corner of his eye of the Eight Diagrams Mirror that Elder Meng Shan had dropped. He grabbed it in passing and, with a push of his arms against the ground, leaped back up, swinging his sword at Meng Shan once more.
By now, Elder Meng Shan had regained his senses, though blood trickled from the corner of his eyes and his eardrums swelled, still somewhat dazed.
He hadn't even fully realized what attack he had suffered, but as Yuan Ming's long sword slashed toward him, he hastily pulled out a set of black hooks to meet the strike.
With a sharp clang,
The collision of the magical artifacts sent Yuan Ming flying back several yards before he could barely stabilize himself, while Meng Shan remained unfazed.
Elder Meng Shan wiped a hand over the blood and tears in his eyes, refocusing his sight on Yuan Ming, his eyes filled with murderous intent.
Meanwhile, the Mountain Turtle also sped toward them on all fours.
Caught between the two attackers, the situation was highly unfavorable for Yuan Ming.

chapters.title: Chapter 226 - 203: The Might of the Heart-splitting Bomb
chapters.content:
Elder Meng Shan's movement technique shifted beneath his feet, and his figure charged towards Yuan Ming like a phantom.
"Shadowless Step..."
Yuan Ming's heart tightened as he suddenly saw a cold gleam light up ahead.
The instant Elder Meng Shan charged in front of him, the dagger in his hand, emitting a greenish hue, thrusted towards his chest and abdomen.
Yuan Ming was already prepared. The palm he had hidden in his sleeve suddenly shot out, the Nine Elements Technique wildly circulated within his body, channeling mana, just as the small Eight Diagrams Mirror in his palm had barely finished refining when it lit up with a golden light screen.
The moment the dagger struck the golden light screen, a massive force exploded, scattering the golden light and shattering the surface of the Eight Diagrams Mirror with a "crack" sound, showing cracks.
Yuan Ming also felt a huge force assaulting him, a power surged up his arm to his shoulder and neck amidst the severe pain, sending him flying backward.
Before he landed, Yuan Ming noticed something odd about the ground behind him.
He saw waves of soil and stone upturning from underground, forming a noticeably elevated ridge of earth, clearly the Mountain Turtle utilizing its innate divine ability to burrow beneath the ground.
As the earthen ridge rapidly extended, heading towards the female array master, Elder Meng Shan's smile became increasingly evident on his face.
But just then, the bulging earth ridge suddenly halted and stopped moving.
Following that, through the thick layers of earth, a dull yet piercing mooing sound came from underground.
The ground shook violently, and as the soil and stone collapsed, a huge figure burst forth from underground — it was indeed the Mountain Turtle.
However, at this moment, its eyes were full of terror as if there was something extremely horrifying beneath the ground.
Yuan Ming looked at the black spots appearing on its massive head and a hint of a smile flashed through his eyes.
Since he needed to protect Xi Ying, how could he possibly not be fully prepared?
With soul crows monitoring from the trees and a Black Toad safeguarding underground, he was ready to prevent any exotic beasts from tunneling underground and launching an attack that he might not be able to fend off.
The strongest Black Toad could only be arranged to guard under the array master as the last barrier.
The Mountain Turtle's massive body became extremely heavy, and after running only a few steps, it collapsed amidst intense agony, convulsing on the ground, its huge head struggling with its last bit of energy before it fiercely drooped down.
Seeing the Mountain Turtle's head crashing towards the female array master,
Yuan Ming, who leaped into the air, saw the silver cat Guoguo, who had been sitting somewhat dazedly by the female array master's side, suddenly lunge as the head fell.
Its body radiated a sudden surge of silver light, and its small form grew instantaneously, transforming into a six-foot-long, over three-foot-tall snow-white ferocious beast, almost resembling a robust White Tiger.
A Second Level Early Stage spirit beast!
At this time, Guoguo's body was silvery-white, with longer fur and pupils one gold and the other amber, while its claws gleamed coldly.
With a fierce roar,
Guoguo merely swung its paw, causing a gust of wind, followed by a loud "bang".
The Mountain Turtle's massive head was effortlessly torn open under its sharp claws, turning into a shower of blood rain mixed with fragments of bone and flesh.
This scene not only stunned Yuan Ming, but even Elder Meng Shan was taken aback.
But what surprised him even more came next.
The massive silver-white tiger suddenly emitted a layer of silver ripples and abruptly disappeared from his view.
Yuan Ming immediately released his divine sense to search, but he found nothing.
The silver tiger had not only vanished in form but its breath had also completely disappeared.
Each time the silver cat could appear beside him undetected, only revealing itself when it chose to let Yuan Ming notice its presence – this time was no exception.
Not just Yuan Ming, but Elder Meng Shan also lost perception of the silver tiger.
But in the next instant, Elder Meng Shan immediately swung his hook claw, fiercely striking towards the empty space beside him.
The hook claw shone with dark light, and a tremendous force surged forth.
Accompanied by this was a blur and distortion in the void, as if enveloped by a layer of mist, when a huge white shadow emerged from it, precisely the silver tiger.
Just as it revealed its form, a snow-white sharp claw had already swung with full force, sweeping towards Elder Meng Shan.
The white sharp claw exactly collided with the black hook claw, and a powerful impact instantly exploded from the collision.
The silver tiger's massive form was pushed backward by this force.
But Elder Meng Shan didn't gain any advantage either, retreating seven or eight yards backward.
"What immense power!"
At that moment, he saw the array master being attacked and teleported, anticipating she wouldn't be transported very far, he decided to search the surroundings alone, hoping to luck out. If he found her first, it would undoubtedly be a rare opportunity.
Yuan Ming hadn't expected not only a brat to stand in his way but also that this Array Master, severely wounded by the Great Elder's soul bat, would have such a powerful spirit beast hidden.
But before Meng Shan could come to his senses, the ground beneath him suddenly trembled violently, and the soil and rocks collapsed once more.
A pitch-black vine suddenly shot out from below, swiftly coiling around his lower leg.
Immediately after, a cloud of black smoke spread from his lower leg, where his clothes instantly corroded and turned black, then crumbled into dust.
"Ugh..."
An intense and unparalleled pain instantly originated from his lower leg, causing him to let out a muffled grunt.
Elder Meng Shan quickly swung his hook claw down, sharply severing the vine.
After freeing himself, he immediately made several consecutive jumps to distance himself from the vine.
He looked down at his lower leg and saw that the flesh was necrotic where the vine had wrapped around it, and patches of black spots appeared on his entire lower leg.
"What powerful poison," Elder Meng Shan's expression drastically changed, and he completely panicked.
He never imagined that merely trying to capture a female Array Master and using her power to escape would involve so many defensive measures around her?
Two spirit beasts, as strong as Foundation Establishment Cultivators, one overt and one covert, both had extremely tricky innate divine abilities.
In his knowledge, such powerful spirit beasts must be the female Array Master's backup; how could they be related to that little Qi Refining Realm cultivator?
Before he could figure it out, a white silhouette suddenly appeared beside him, and the spirit beast, resembling a silver tiger, manifested out of nowhere and clawed furiously at him.
Elder Meng Shan had already developed the idea of retreating and quickly dodged, moving over ten yards back.
But before he could land, a shadow suddenly swept up from the ground behind him, and another black vine, like a spiritual snake, lunged at him, heading straight for his face.
Elder Meng Shan swung his hook claw to block it, but out of the corner of his eye, he spotted a black crow swooping in, also hurling itself at his face.
Despite his extensive battle experience, this string of continuous attacks left him somewhat flustered.
Just as he dodged the silver tiger's claw, cut off the poison vine, and spat out a whirlwind to blow away the crow, the intense pain in his lower leg struck again, and the bizarre poison began to numb his entire lower body.
When he landed, he stumbled and fell to the ground.
At that moment, the sound of a sword humming filled the air.
A giant, snow-white figure holding a sword flashed out. It was Yuan Ming who had donned the White Ape beast skin, transforming into the White Ape, gaining increased strength and vigor as he thrust a sword toward Elder Meng Shan.
A beam of cold light flashed swiftly, enveloping him in severe cold, instantly freezing the arm that held the black hook claw.
Elder Meng Shan felt a chill surging up. His arm stiffened, and just as he was about to gather his mana to resist, he saw Yuan Ming, transformed into the White Ape, swing his arm, hurling a round, bronze sphere at him.
The muscles in the White Ape's arm contracted sharply, generating immense force that made the bronze sphere, with a sonic boom, arrive instantly with a trace of afterimage.
Elder Meng Shan no longer had any chance to dodge.
The bronze sphere was covered in dense runes that brightened with conspicuous light traces.
Just when a light click sounded, the bronze sphere suddenly split open, revealing a bright silver-white light from within.
"Sizzle..."
After a flurry of silver sparks, the bundle of silver-white light exploded abruptly.
"Boom"

A striking thunderous light pillar surged skyward from within the woods, unleashing an immensely powerful shockwave. In the dazzling light, one could vaguely see Elder Meng Shan's body stiffen and sway as arcs of electricity exploded around him.
The loud noise drowned out his screams.
When all the electricity had dissipated, the ground was marked by a shallow, charred pit, and the trees within a radius of thirty feet were scorched, with flames still burning inside them and smoke wafting up.
In the center of the shallow pit, Elder Meng Shan's body still stood in its original position, although it was now unrecognizable. Right at the top of his head was a dreadful, lightning-struck wound still emitting smoke.
To his death, he couldn't believe that one day he would be killed by a mere Qi Refining Stage Cultivator.
Just then, the silver tiger moved in a flash and swung its massive claw down, shredding Elder Meng Shan's remains into pieces.
Yuan Ming hurried forward and picked up a finger from the ground, pulling off a blue-gem-embedded storage ring. Before he could examine the storage ring in his hand, the soul crow noticed a small group of people approaching from afar.
He quickly tucked away the storage ring and the hook claw magic artifact from Meng Shan's hand and stepped back to stand in front of Xi Ying.
Yuan Ming signaled to the Black Toad to continue hiding. Only a vine tendril piercing through the headless Mountain Turtle's neck remained visible, madly absorbing the remaining power while the piles of fierce beasts Yuan Ming had previously slain had already been pulled into its underground tendrils.
Turning around, Silver Cat Guoguo had also returned to her usual cute and well-behaved appearance, squatting next to the female Array Master and continuing to guard her.
The voices from the distance were now close at hand.
Yuan Ming followed the sound and saw a group of Dawn's figures, about seven or eight people, led by that clown, hastily approaching.

chapters.title: Chapter 227 - 204: The Power of a Soul Cultivator
chapters.content:
The clown at this moment had his face paint no longer intact, sporting only that somewhat comical pointed cap on his head.
If not for that, Yuan Ming might not have recognized him at all.
For beneath the comical paint hid a quite young and handsome male countenance.
Once Clown Xiao Yao caught sight of the Female Array Master with her eyes closed, and his eyes subsequently fell on Yuan Ming, a thick murderous intent suddenly burst forth.
"Sister, what's happened to you!"
"Thief!" With a fierce shout, the clown rapidly surged forward, and with a swing of his hand, over a dozen golden Light Blades shot through the air toward Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming, seeing the clown's approach, had already put a good distance between them, and upon witnessing the clown's attack, he dodged even further away thanks to his agile speed.
With one hand tightly clutching the Cold Star Sword, he communicated with the Black Toad, ready to launch a counterattack.
"Brother, stop it."
At that moment, a crisp female voice rang out.
As the voice sounded, the dozen or so golden Light Blades suddenly halted in mid-air, hanging there without immediately being withdrawn.
Yuan Ming slightly shifted his stance and saw that the Female Array Master had already awakened.
"Xiao Ying, are you alright?" The clown's face showed an expression of joy as he hurriedly inquired.
"Brother, I'm fine now, he's one of us. I was injured and lost consciousness earlier, and he's been protecting me the whole time." At this point, the Female Array Master had already stood up from the ground, and with a stamp of her foot, her transparent embroidered shoes flashed, and she teleported right next to Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming asked in a low voice, "How is your recovery?"
"Good, very good, hee hee," Xi Ying answered softly, "From now on, I will be called Xiao Ying."
Yuan Ming swiftly said in a voice that only the two of them could hear, "From now on, you Xiao Ying, are my employer, and I am the person you've bribed to infiltrate Biluo Cave."
Xi Ying said, "Exactly, that solves the issue of your identity, you're so clever."
Yet Yuan Ming couldn't help but ask with concern in a low voice, "What's your current situation?"
"For the moment, I am occupying this body and have also gained her memories. The original Xiao Ying's Divine Soul was severely wounded by Xi Cangqiong, and I stepped in to save it, but unfortunately, she will need to remain unconscious for a long time to come," explained Xi Ying through transmitted voice.
"Is this also a Soul Cultivator's method?" Yuan Ming asked.
"Of course, you will come to understand the wonders of Soul Cultivator techniques later on," Xi Ying replied with a hint of amusement in her voice.
By this time, Xiao Yao had also caught up, circling around her with eyes full of concern, and only after confirming there were no evident injuries did he begin to feel a bit relieved.
"Sister, what happened? You reprimanded me earlier for being rash, so how could you be so reckless? Do you know how worried I was just now? If something had gone wrong, how would I explain it to the Great Elder when we get back?" After checking, he couldn't help but pull the authority of the older brother as he questioned her.
"I underestimated the Great Elder's strength and teleported a bit slowly, but I'm alright now," Xi Ying spoke, her voice indistinguishable from Xiao Ying's.
"This man is your Dark Child arranged within Biluo Cave, how come you've never mentioned him before?" Xiao Yao relaxed a bit and looked towards Yuan Ming with a flash of suspicion in his eyes as he asked.
"Brother, aren't you annoying? Can I possibly tell you everything?" retorted Xi Ying with an impatient expression on her face.
Xiao Yao's expression stiffened; obviously, he had no real way to deal with this sister.
Yuan Ming had also put on the Dawn Coat provided by Xi Ying by this time, ready to switch allegiances.
"I had been injured just before and spent quite a while with Breathing Control; how is the battle situation now?" Xi Ying inquired.
"The situation is largely decided. It's just that Chen Cangqiong has not yet been slain… A Soul Cultivator nearing a late-stage Core Formation breakthrough is truly a nuisance to deal with. Three Core Formation Stage cultivators exerted various methods and, even joining forces, have yet to subdue him," Xiao Yao said solemnly.
Upon hearing this, Xi Ying's expression became serious, and she revealed a contemplative look.
"Sister, do you still have any Array that could trap Chen Cangqiong? If we can't kill him this time and he escapes, when he returns after his breakthrough, I fear it might bring boundless calamity," Xiao Yao said with concern.
The others who had followed seemed equally hopeful, sharing the same worries.
After all, provoking a Core Formation stage Soul Cultivator and failing to completely eradicate him would mean no one could bear the consequences should he seek revenge in the future.
Unexpectedly, after only a moment's thought, Xi Ying simply smiled slightly, "Don't worry, he's as good as dead this time."
Upon hearing her words, everyone was startled, their reactions a mix of shock and anticipation.
"Let's go and take a look," said Xi Ying confidently, bending down to pick up the Silver Cat Guoguo.
"And where did this little cat come from?" Xiao Yao asked.
"It ran out from the beast tide just now, and we hit it off very well; I've given it a name, Guoguo. Does it sound nice?" Xi Ying said.
"Alright, it does look really cute," Xiao Yao said.
"Meow," Guoguo seemed to have heard.
It didn't take long for the group to reach the back mountain battlefield.
But the scene before them was startling: half of the mountainside had collapsed, nearly ten miles of trees broken and fallen, the ground littered with the carcasses of Fierce Beasts and pockmarked with craters where explosions had occurred.
Fires burned here and there on the ground with black smoke rising. As far as the eye could see, the landscape was battered and bruised.
Above in the sky, three Core Formation Stage cultivators from the Dawn Organization strategized in a triangle formation, encircling the Great Elder in the center.
The Great Elder, who appeared as a young man, now stood with his hair disheveled. A blood-colored banner was erected in front of him, and his clothes were torn and fluttering in the wind, his face distorted with madness.
The situation of the three people surrounding him wasn't much better.
The hunchbacked elder had muddled flesh and blood on his right shoulder, and only half of his right ear remained. He was drenched in blood, yet he was controlling a silver small bell raised high above his head, aimed directly at Chen Cangqiong.
From the silver small bell, visible semi-transparent sound waves could be seen bombarding, constantly pressing down on the Great Elder.
On the other side, the red-robed man's face had turned deathly pale. His body was trembling non-stop, and his eyes were glazed, as if his Divine Soul had been greatly damaged.
He was now relying completely on his strong will to drive the fiery red flying fork, blocking one of the Great Elder's escape routes.
The green-robed lady was in the best condition, with no apparent injuries. Her expression was serious as she continuously infused mana into the jade flying sword floating in front of her.
The sword body radiated a bright green light, and one after another, Jade Sword Shadows split from the sword body. Soon, more than twenty jade flying swords were arranged in formation.
"Go," the green-robed lady commanded with a delicate shout.
Over twenty jade flying swords immediately took flight, forming an array on their own. In an instant, they transformed into a circular Sword Array in the sky, bearing down on the Great Elder with the force of a crushing mountain.
"Stop, everyone don't come any closer," Xi Ying called for a halt with the group 300 zhang away.
Yuan Ming watched from a distance and couldn't help but feel a sense of alarm.
Beneath the jade Sword Array, intersecting sword marks crisscrossed through the void, distorting into twisted sword trails. Any living being entering its radius would undoubtedly be sliced into countless pieces.
The Great Elder's expression became slightly grave upon seeing this.
His hands suddenly lifted, and the blood-colored banner rose into the sky, slamming directly into the Sword Array.
As the two neared each other, red light burst forth from the banner, and a vast expanse of Blood Cloud surged out, colliding with the Sword Array in an instant. The red and green lights intertwined, releasing bursts of thunderous roars.
Seeing the deadlock, the hunchbacked elder immediately let out a low shout and pushed the silver small bell forcefully with both hands.
"Dang…"
A loud bell's chime rang out, and waves of sound poured out like a flood towards the Great Elder.
As everyone watched, the Great Elder's movements suddenly became unbelievably slow, as if he were trapped in the mire, struggling to move.
The red-robed man, who had been dazed moments before, now had a sharp gleam in his eyes. He pushed forward with his hand, and the fiery red flying fork traced an arc, piercing through the Great Elder's chest from behind.Sample from My Virtual Library Empire—read more on M&VLEMPY&R.
The right side of the Great Elder's chest was immediately pierced by the flying fork, leaving a gruesome gash as fresh red blood gushed out.
Yuan Ming felt somewhat surreal witnessing this scene.
However, the other members of Dawn were already shouting in excitement.
Just then, everyone suddenly realized that the gushing blood was not dispersing. Instead, it writhed on its own, splitting into a large swarm of blood-colored bats that flew out with a "whoosh."
They roughly split into three groups, each heading towards one of the three Core Formation Stage cultivators involved in the siege.
The hunchbacked elder reacted the quickest, turning the silver small bell to blast the incoming bats with sound waves, dispersing them all.
The red-robed man pulled out a fiery red round mirror from his chest and reflected it in front of him. A torrent of flames spewed forth, scorching the bats.
Only the third batch of bats, which rushed towards the green-robed lady actively powering the Sword Array, managed to get close and dove to bite her.
The green-robed lady had no time to defend herself and was panicked when the blood-colored bats neared her. But she found that the approaching blood bats all turned into a cloud of Blood Mist and dispersed.
Instead, behind the hunchbacked elder, who had been the first to defend, the figure of the Great Elder materialized out of thin air.
His hand emerged from behind like a specter, reaching for the hunchbacked elder's nape with a surge of Blood Light in his palm.
Just then, a black kettle with mountain and river bird patterns engraved on it suddenly flew up into the sky. The kettle shone with dark light, like a black sun emitting rings of black ripples.
It was the Soul Suppressing Kettle that Xi Ying had taken.
As the black ripples spread, everyone's vision twisted, and the scene in mid-air drastically changed.
There were no longer any Blood Cloud and Sword Array collisions in the sky, nor was the hunchbacked elder under duress...
Everything they had seen was but an illusion!
The real scene was...
The green-robed lady and the red-robed man were back-to-back, wrapped up by the Great Elder's Blood-colored Banner.
Two enormous blood-colored bats were perched on their foreheads, sucking at them.
Only the hunchbacked elder, with the delaying power of the silver small bell, was resisting the Great Elder's actual body.
But even now, the Great Elder no longer looked like a young man. His hair was white and fluttering, and his face bore the look of advanced age, suggesting he had also activated some costly secret technique or Divine Skill.
"Ah…"
The crowd was truly shocked by the scene that suddenly appeared before them and all wanted to turn and flee.
Yuan Ming was also staggered. A Core Formation Stage Soul Cultivator was able to suppress three Magic Practitioners of the same realm with his own strength.
No wonder Soul Cultivators were considered heretics and were feared and ostracized by the entire Cultivation World. Their abilities were simply too unfathomable.

chapters.title: Chapter 228 - 205 The Reason
chapters.content:
"Hmph, even resorting to the Soul Burning Blood Technique, I arrived just a step too late; these three Core Formation Cultivators of Dawn would have perished here," everyone was filled with shock and fear, but only Xi Ying's lips slightly curled up, revealing a faint smile, as she transmitted her voice to Yuan Ming.
At this moment, the Great Elder Chen Cangqiong also noticed the anomaly and turned his head to see the black little kettle suspended in mid-air, his expression changing dramatically.
"Who is it!"
With a loud shout, he was actually ready to abandon the hunchbacked elder to snatch the black kettle.
Seeing this, Xi Ying raised her hand and a black light soared into the sky.
Yuan Ming's gaze sharpened as he finally saw clearly that within the black light was a round kettle lid, thoroughly black and exquisitely fashioned.
As the kettle lid flew out, the Soul Suppressing Kettle seemed to respond, moving to meet the lid.
The two joined together, once again becoming whole.
"How is this possible? Who is it, who has come?" Chen Cangqiong, seeing this, had his eyes wide with terror, more shocked than if he had seen a ghost.
However, Xi Ying had no intention of responding.
"Retrieve." She had already formed the spell, and uttered a low command.
This translation is powered by the readers at *.
As her words fell, the handle of the kettle lid embellished with a small beast resembling a lion suddenly shone from its eyes, as if coming to life, opening its mouth.
A black radiance sprung from its mouth, and a black vortex akin to a starry nebula emerged, emitting a powerful suction force.
"Stop! Don't, don't…" Seeing this, Chen Cangqiong panicked completely.
He hurriedly tried to recall the two blood bats that were perched on the forehead of the woman in green and the red-robed man, which were his Divine Soul creatures, just like Yuan Ming's soul crows, but in reality even more vital to him than Yuan Ming's soul crows.
All the Divine Skills of a Soul Cultivator are tied to the Divine Soul; the deeper the cultivation, the truer this is.
The Soul Suppressing Kettle was precisely summoned to counter Chen Cangqiong's Divine Soul creatures, and the two blood bats had no power to resist and were directly sucked into it.
Chen Cangqiong tried to prevent it but was also affected by the Soul Suppressing Kettle, his own Divine Soul showing signs of being dragged out as well.
Xi Ying did not delay for a second, immediately raising her hand and beckoning, and the Soul Suppressing Kettle turned into a beam of light flying back to her.
By then, Chen Cangqiong had finally traced the path of the light to the "Female Array Master" Xi Ying, who was surrounded by a crowd of people, disbelief filling his eyes.
He tried to swoop down, but the hunchbacked elder took the opportunity to break the Blood-colored Banner, rescuing the conscious woman in green and the red-robed man. The three Core Formation Cultivators joined forces once more and surrounded Chen Cangqiong from all sides.
Xi Ying had already averted her gaze, silently chanting an obscure and complex incantation, pouring mana into the Soul Suppressing Kettle to drive its refining ability.
The landscape and flora and fauna illustrated on the Soul Suppressing Kettle lit up, coming to life as if infused with a soul, while Chen Cangqiong in the high sky held his head with both hands, falling into immense pain.
The red-robed man summoned a small red hammer, and with a slight tremor, countless hammer shadows emerged, striking Chen Cangqiong together with the Flying Swords unleashed by the woman in green, hitting the Protective Blood Mist around him.
Bursts of blood light exploded on the Blood Mist, and the pitter-patter of rain hitting banana leaves suddenly sounded. The Blood Mist first rippled and then turned into violent boiling. Unable to be supported by Chen Cangqiong, it finally collapsed.
Seeing this, the hunchbacked elder pressed on, a silver glow surfacing in the palm of his hand, slapping it onto the Great Elder's head.
A "bang" sounded.
Chen Cangqiong's head burst like an overripe watermelon.
His body floated down, and Ou Ji leapt forward, grabbing the corpse in his hands.
With Chen Cangqiong's death, across the front mountain, those controlled by the Blood Bats also returned to normal.
"Chen Cangqiong has been executed; Biluo Cave disciples surrender immediately, Dawn Alliance will not hold past actions against you!" With the Great Elder's corpse in hand, Ou Ji flew up into the air, his voice echoing loudly.
The remaining resisting Biluo Cave Disciples saw the Great Elder's dead body and lost the will to fight, dropping their Magic Artifacts. The Dawn Alliance quickly took control of the situation.
Hundreds of miles away from the Biluo Cave, atop a range of mountains, stood a figure, a Black Robed Elder with his hair tied into a small triangular braid, while on another peak a hundred zhang to the side, a tall woman adorned with a colorful phoenix crown and heavily made-up sat with closed eyes, meditating.
"It seems to be over," the tall woman opened her eyes and said.
"Dawn really took down the Biluo Cave by themselves. Indeed, we made the right choice approaching the Dawn Alliance this time; we didn't have to show ourselves, and even if Chen Cangqiong got away, we wouldn't have taken any risk," the Black Robed Elder spoke with a laugh, yet a hint of wariness flickered in his eyes.
"Chen Cangqiong was indeed formidable; despite Dawn deploying so many experts this battle, they still lost a Core Formation Cultivator," a light chuckle came from another mountain, belonging to a brawny, bald giant man.
"Haha, Brother Man Dong is correct; our collaboration with the Dawn is indeed the least risky strategy. Once Dawn retreats, our four families will divide the territories according to the agreement," not far from the three mountain peaks another huge peak stood where a sumptuously dressed middle-aged man, evidently a person from the Southern Border but clad in Central Plains attire, stood against the wind.
If anyone familiar with the Southern Border and Northern Territory situation were here, they would have been stunned, for these four individuals were significant figures from the Black Fire Sect, Hundred Poison Cave, Beast King Sect, and Green Rock Association.
Black Fire Sect Venerable Hei Yan, Hundred Poison Cave's Poison Queen Miao Xi, Beast King Sect elder Man Dong, and Vice President Sai Han of the Green Rock Association.
"Very well, it's a pity all of Biluo Cave's years of accumulation have gone to Dawn. We have also paid a great price," Hei Yan nodded slowly.
"The situation in the Northern Territory has been perilous in recent years. It's daring of Biluo Cave to make moves against Da Jin Caravan and the border people. If Chang Chun Temple were to use these incidents as an excuse to meddle in Southern Border affairs, we would be forced to get involved in the struggle between the great sects of the Southern Border Southern Domain and the Da Jin sects. By that time, we would have no control over our fate, and if things go badly, all four of our families could be destroyed. This sacrifice is worth it," Miao Xi breathed a sigh of relief.
"Indeed, fortunately, we joined forces at the first opportunity, won over Li Zhui, and learned of the weaknesses in Biluo Cave's Great Array. Only then was Dawn able to immediately arrange for someone to infiltrate and destroy it. He just had to pretend to fish every day. Even Ling Songhua didn't have to take action. This time, we've benefited entirely from Fisherman Li Zhui's gains," said Sai Han.
Everyone echoed in agreement.
"The last time Da Jin came to negotiate about the missing border people, it was unexpected that even their chief envoy disappeared. Emperor Jin was furious, and given Chang Chun Temple's domineering way, they would certainly not let this go. They could have intervened in Southern Border affairs immediately three years ago, but they didn't. Instead, Da Jin's vice-envoy gave us three years to deal with Biluo Cave through Dawn. This is somewhat strange," Miao Xi said.
"Indeed strange. Initially, the Da Jin Mission kept the matter confidential and did not hold us accountable. I believe this matter will probably not implicate us," stated Hei Yan.
"That's good, then. We might as well pretend to be ignorant, just afraid that Chang Chun Temple will bring up the old issues in the future. The missing person is the favored aide of General Yuan, Emperor Jin's childhood study companion," said Sai Han.
Just then, a tunneling light shot forth from the direction of Biluo Cave and stopped midair among the four, revealing the figure of Captain Ou Ji.
"Chen Cangqiong has been executed. The task is complete."
"Captain Ou Ji has worked hard. Dawn is powerful. Here is the rest of the agreed-upon reward." Hei Yan chuckled and handed over a storage bracelet.
Ou Ji activated his divine sense to investigate and found no issues. He turned around, intending to depart.
"Wait a moment, Captain Ou Ji. What do you plan to do with those Biluo Cave Disciples?" Sai Han suddenly asked.
The other three also looked over, their gazes sharp.
"Why does Fellow Daoist Sai Han ask such a question? Our agreement was that as long as Chen Cangqiong was eliminated, everything in Biluo Cave except the Fire Refining Hall Disciples belongs to us," replied Ou Ji expressionlessly.
"People are scarce in the Southern Border, and those with spirit roots are even rarer. In fact, the disciples of Biluo Cave, especially the Inner Sect Disciples, each one has a decent spirit root. If Captain Ou Ji is willing to part with them, we can offer an additional reward," Hei Yan produced another storage bracelet.
"The elders of the Sects are indeed wealthy and generous, but, unfortunately, this matter is not up for discussion," Ou Ji said, his gaze sweeping over the four as he shook his head.
Upon hearing this, the four showed expressions of disappointment.
"I won't make concessions regarding the Biluo Cave Disciples, but there are a significant number of Fur Beast Slaves within Biluo Cave in the Ten Thousand Mountains. If you wish to take them, you may do so, provided you pay the reward," Ou Ji spoke again.
Hei Yan and the others' faces brightened at this news.
It's a pity for Biluo Cave's large batch of Foundation Establishment and Qi Refining cultivators, who have gone through life-and-death battles only to be inherited by someone else, making the Dawn power stronger by a measure.
...
On another side of Biluo Cave, in a secluded hollow of a mountain, stood a group of people, led by none other than Fisherman Li Zhui and Three Cave Master Ling Songhua.
Behind the two stood sparsely a dozen Fire Refining Hall Disciples, Fang Ge, Chen Wan, Mu He, and others were all present.
Above their heads floated a transparent round orb, emitting an invisible fluctuation that enveloped everyone in a transparent protective shield.
The birds and ants nearby moved naturally, as if the group didn't exist.
The people all looked toward Biluo Cave with complicated expressions.
"Chen Cangqiong led Biluo Cave into a golden age, but alas, he was too eager for quick success. I always knew he would come to no good end and eventually meet this fate," the Fisherman lamented.
"The sun rises and sets, and the moon waxes and wanes. Even heaven and earth are thus; the rise and fall of a Sect is only natural. We are now freed and have become individuals of free will," the Three Cave Master said calmly, seeming unruffled by the downfall of Biluo Cave.
Fisherman Li Zhui took a deep breath, his expression complicated—a mix of annoyance, resentment, and a slight sense of relief.
"Three Cave Master, will the people from Dawn Alliance kill our Sect's disciples? Should we save some more people?" Fang Ge glanced at the orb above them and asked.
They were all saved by the Three Cave Master utilizing the magic treasure shaped as an orb with an invisibility effect, impervious to divine sense exploration.
"Words from Dawn Alliance can be trusted, and today's attack on Biluo Cave was aimed at the Great Elder. The ordinary disciples are not in danger and are most likely to be recruited into the Dawn Alliance," Three Cave Master remarked.
Hearing this, Fang Ge and the others fell silent.
"Let's go," said the Fisherman.
The group departed from the place and soon vanished into the distance.

chapters.title: Chapter 229 - 206: Full Recovery of Memories
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming followed Xiao Ying, Xiao Yao, and others to the Qingluo Square in front of the mountain, where the Biluo Cave Disciples were all escorted.
After scanning the crowd a few times, his eyebrows suddenly furrowed.
There were quite a few disciples from each hall of the Biluo Cave, but the disciples from the Fire Refining Hall were conspicuously few.
During the chaos of battle before, he had sent his soul crow to scout around and hadn't seen any trace of the Fire Refining Hall Disciples. The Third Cave Master hadn't appeared from the beginning to the end.
"Could it be..." A thought flashed across Yuan Ming's mind.
"Who are you looking for?" Xi Ying's voice reached him.
"The people from the Fire Refining Hall don't seem to be here," Yuan Ming murmured after a moment's hesitation but felt relieved inside.
He had some fondness for his brothers from the Fire Refining Hall; with the sect in great disarray, the disciples of the elders must have suffered heavy casualties. They were all under the Third Cave Master, who was absent at the critical moment, so they must have been taken away by the Third Cave Master.
After gaining control of the situation, the Dawn Alliance methodically began to break the restrictions on important places within the Biluo Cave, such as the storerooms of the Refining Furnace Hall, the warehouse of the Fire Refining Hall, etc. A large amount of ore, Spirit Grass, elixirs, and even spirit beasts were transported out and arranged in the Qingluo Square according to category.
Items confiscated from the Biluo Cave Disciples were also placed there; from afar, half the square glistened with spirit light, catching the eye.
The years of accumulation from Three Stars Mountain to Biluo Cave must all be here.
Members of the Dawn Alliance gradually gathered at this place, eyes shining brightly as they looked at the items on the ground, yet no one dared to touch anything.
Yuan Ming, overhearing the conversations of those nearby, learned that this was the usual practice of the Dawn Alliance. After every mission, they would display all the loot in public and then distribute it according to each member's contribution, to ensure fairness.
Yuan Ming thought to himself that the biggest gain for the Dawn Alliance in annihilating Biluo Cave this time was not these items, but rather the storage magic tools of the Great Elder, the Great Cave Master, and the Second Cave Master.
How could the truly valuable items be put out for distribution?
"Brother Yuan Ming, what are you doing here?" A somewhat surprised voice called out from ahead.
Yuan Ming looked up, his gaze also shifting.
The person approaching was Wulu, who now showed no doubts about his Foundation Establishment Stage of cultivation. Though he had some injuries, it was nothing serious.
Standing beside Wulu was Xiao Yao, who appeared to be acquainted with him.
