"Brother Wulu, unhurt I see. I am grateful for your care over these past three years," Yuan Ming said.
"Brother Yuan, what a pleasant surprise. Our paths diverged, but now we meet as brothers," Wulu said, feigning sudden realization.
Yuan Ming smiled and glanced at Xiao Yao beside him, then said loudly, "It's more than brothers. We have been looking after each other since we were Beast Slaves in the Biluo Cave; we are brothers who have been through life and death together."
The two laughed uproariously together.
Xiao Yao, who had been somewhat suspicious of Yuan Ming being a spy, now saw how familiar Yuan Ming was with Wulu, a man of great merit in this mission, and how they had apparently been through adversity together. This dispelled his doubts.
Before long, a tunneling light shot from a distance and stopped in mid-air above the square, revealing the figure of Ou Ji, who announced that he would distribute the items on the square to everyone.
Upon hearing this, the members of the Dawn Alliance let out a thunderous cheer.
Bai Ye and Huan Shi were also among a group of Foundation Establishment cultivators, both unharmed.
Yuan Ming exchanged glances and nodded with them from a distance. Seeing that Yuan Ming was now dressed in Dawn's attire, they understood and smiled at each other.
Ou Ji arranged for the distribution of goods and then left.
"The distribution is starting? Let's go over there too!" Xi Ying chuckled lightly and waved her sleeve.
Yellow Array Patterns appeared under their feet on the ground where she, Yuan Ming, and Xiao Yao were standing, quickly forming a yellow Array.
Yuan Ming's vision was engulfed in yellow light, and by the time he regained his senses, they had appeared near the entrance of Biluo Cave.
Ou Ji, the hunchbacked elder, and three other Core Formation Stage cultivators were there. Seeing Xi Ying and Yuan Ming arrive, they all smiled.Content first released on *.
"Xi Ying, you've finally arrived; we were just waiting for you," Ou Ji said.
"Why wait for me? You all can distribute things without me. But this Yuan Ming, with such great merit this time, must be rewarded generously," Xi Ying said with her hands clasped behind her.
Hearing this, the faces of Ou Ji and the others showed embarrassment, insistently saying that they must all make the decision together.
"Captain Ou Ji, then I won't stand on ceremony. I exerted the most effort in killing Chen Cangqiong; I want to have the first pick from his belongings," Xi Ying stated.
Upon hearing this, Ou Ji exchanged glances with the others. The hunchbacked elder grunted, while the red-robed man and the green-dressed woman looked at Xi Ying with dissatisfaction.
"My fellow Daoists, how about we stick to our earlier agreement? The contents of Chen Cangqiong's storage magic tool will be divided into five parts, and Xi Ying will have one of them. Since she wants to pick first, let her pick first," Ou Ji said, slightly embarrassedly clearing his throat.
"Captain Ou Ji, we three were invited by your Dawn Alliance, and the battle with Chen Cangqiong nearly cost us our lives. Why should she get to pick first?" the hunchbacked elder said bluntly; they didn't understand why Ou Ji was so accommodating to a Foundation Establishment female cultivator, even if she had just saved them.
"My three friends, you don't know something. This woman comes from Red Lotus Island in the Southern Border Southern Domain. She's the direct granddaughter of the Red Lotus Island's Ancestor. She also has the Five Elements Combined Body, making her one of the most talented Array Masters on this continent," Ou Ji subtly motioned with his lips, explaining via a transmission of sound to the three.
The three showed an expression of astonishment.
The Xiao Family of Red Lotus Island is extremely famous throughout the Southern Border Southern Domain and even the entire Southern Border. The Xiao Family excels at the art of Array Restrictions and is particularly adept at refining items such as Array Flags and Array Plates, which are essential for protective formation artifacts. Many sects in the Southern Border have visited them for this reason, all in the hopes of obtaining an excellent sect-protecting Array.
And the Ancestor Xiao mentioned by Captain Ou Ji is the current head of the Xiao Family as well as a Master of Formations. His Cultivation is said to have broken through the Late-Stage Core Formation, a rarity among Array Masters. Whether in strength or connections, he is far beyond comparison with the three of them.
"Besides, the merit of breaking the Array and killing Chen Cangqiong is clear for all to see. The three of you were also indirectly saved by Xiao Ying, everyone should feel grateful," Captain Ou Ji added.
"Alright, Xiao Ying can choose first," the hunchbacked elder and the others exchanged glances, finding the point very reasonable.
"Xiao Ying, what do you think?" Captain Ou Ji turned to Xi Ying and asked, deliberately ignoring Yuan Ming's request for a reward.
"And what about Yuan Ming? He was the first to follow my instructions, infiltrating Biluo Cave three years ago and risking his life to steal Chen Cangqiong's Magic Treasure for me; he too deserves a substantial reward," Xi Ying countered.
"I heeded Senior Xiao's instructions three years ago and entered Biluo Cave, working together with Wu Lu to watch each other's backs and provide cover," Yuan Ming added.
"I can vouch for that, and if you don't believe me, you can call Wu Lu over to confirm it," Xiao Yao offered.
"It's true; Wu Lu has reported to me several times that a Disciple named Yuan Ming was very suspicious. Turns out it was your doing, Xiao Ying, a precaution that happened to coincide with my strategy. He deserves a reward. Dawn always rewards the valorous," Captain Ou Ji declared.
"Could this person be trying to claim credit after the fact?" the red-robed man challenged.
The red-robed man glared at Yuan Ming, and a wave of pressure enveloped him. The gap between their Cultivations was too vast, and even just a fraction of the released pressure made Yuan Ming feel as if a mountain was pressing down upon him face-on. His body involuntarily trembled slightly, and his bones emitted light snapping sounds.
For a moment, Yuan Ming nearly felt his entire being was about to be crushed, his Sea of Consciousness and Divine Soul also shaken continuously.
With the pressure on his body also coming down on him, his Divine Soul flickered like a flame in a gale, on the verge of extinguishing at any moment, rendering him powerless to move, let alone retreat from this overwhelming force.
Yuan Ming circulated the Nine Elements Technique and the Moonlight Technique with all his might, desperately trying to withstand the pressure from the red-robed man, but to little avail.
However, this immense pressure instead ignited his fighting spirit. Yuan Ming's eyes widened as he pushed the Moonlight Technique to its limits, his Soul Power surging in his Sea of Consciousness like a tidal wave.
Almost simultaneously, his arm warmed up as a vast stream of heat flowed from the Incense Burner Mark, merging into his Sea of Consciousness.
In his mind, a sound of shattering echoed suddenly, and his Divine Soul, which was on the brink of collapse, visibly strengthened at a rapid pace, firmly shielding against the red-robed man's pressure.
"I've broken through!" Yuan Ming exclaimed with shock and joy, as his Moonlight Technique finally advanced to its third layer!
Memories from the past flooded his mind like a tide.
He was fully immersed in recollections, and all his memories were restored!
During this period, he had been diligently cultivating the Nine Elements Technique to enhance his Cultivation while also persistently practicing the Moonlight Technique. His Soul Power had been growing steadily, culminating at the peak of the second layer.
Yuan Ming had originally planned to find a place to enter seclusion and attempt to break through the third layer of the Moonlight Technique after the matters of Biluo Cave concluded. Unexpectedly, under the profound pressure of the red-robed man, combined with the help of the Incense Burner Mark, he succeeded in one fell swoop.
Xi Ying noticed the change in Yuan Ming and immediately turned to the red-robed man.
"You sure carry a great presence, but you shouldn't bully those who have contributed. Captain Ou, you must do what's right," she protested indignantly.
"Let's prioritize harmony among us, it's all trivial issues. We'll discuss Yuan Ming's reward separately," Captain Ou Ji said, standing between Yuan Ming and the red-robed man.
"I was not bullying him; I was only testing whether he truly had the ability to remain undercover in Biluo Cave for so long. Not bad, not bad, the lad has a bright future. Dawn indeed has a keen eye," the red-robed man said, retracting his pressure and changing his tune.
The hunchbacked elder and the green-dressed young woman were somewhat surprised by Yuan Ming's performance under intense pressure.
"Hehe, it was just a little test; you won't take it to heart, will you, Yuan Ming?" Captain Ou Ji asked.
"Of course, the elders here are role models for the younger generation. I deeply admire the heroism you displayed in today's battle," Yuan Ming said with neither servility nor insolence.
"Indeed, a hero emerges from youth. You are from Da Jin, aren't you? Dawn has a significant mission in Da Jin a year from now. Our branch will be coordinating with a sect from Da Jin for an operation. Why don't you partake in it? The reward is guaranteed to be satisfactory, and we need someone to be infiltrated in advance. The task is secure, low-risk, and offers a significant reward," Captain Ou Ji suggested.
"Thank you for your appreciation, Captain Ou, but I feel my Cultivation is at a critical juncture for a breakthrough and may need to be in seclusion for a long time. I hope you will understand," Yuan Ming said, aware that he was unsuited to take part in Dawn's mission despite its high rewards.
"What mission? I can do it," Xiao Yao interjected from the side.
"Shut your mouth, we already promised that we'd return right after this event is over. It's the Ancestor's birthday soon," Xi Ying said.
"Too bad, but Cultivation is all about experience, as the Ancestor once said," Xiao Yao tried to argue further, but was silenced by a glare from Xi Ying.
The others, hearing of the Xiao Family's Ancestor's birthday and the significant upcoming event, began to think about attending to pay respects and potentially receiving several Array Flags as a considerable gain.
"I'd also like to offer my birthday congratulations; I've admired the Xiao Family's Ancestor for a long time," the green-dressed young woman said with a light smile.
"Of course, we should definitely go to give our congratulations," the red-robed man added.
"Right, right, right, we'll go together. Today we've fought and survived alongside the two Xiao Fellow Daoists; Xiao, you must introduce us," the hunchbacked elder said to Xiao Yao.
"No problem," Xiao Yao replied.
The atmosphere instantly became amiable.
"Now, what would you like, Fellow Daoist Yuan?" Captain Ou Ji, catching the vibe, turned his attention to Yuan Ming and inquired.

chapters.title: Chapter 230 - 207: Two Foundation Establishment Pills
chapters.content:
"Thank you, Captain Ou Ji, I would like some elixirs that will aid in Foundation Establishment," Yuan Ming said, bowing.
"No problem, Senior Ou Ji conquered the Biluo Cave, and what he has most in abundance is Foundation Establishment Pills. Please give one to Yuan Ming as well," Xi Ying said casually.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming smiled inwardly, though he maintained a respectful demeanor.
Although he had already received a Foundation Establishment Pill from Bai Ye, his own Spirit Root aptitude was truly complicated. Even with the enhancement of the Nine Elements Technique, taking a single Foundation Establishment Pill hardly assured him of success in establishing his foundation. However, with two pills, the situation would be entirely different.
Of course, if he was lucky and succeeded in Foundation Establishment with one pill, the extra one would be a priceless treasure.
"Xiao Ying, actually, these Foundation Establishment Pills are not easy to come by; each has a designated recipient," Ou Ji said, somewhat embarrassed.
"Dawn has always been clear about rewards and punishments, never mistreating the brave, right? So this is how you don't mistreat them!" Xi Ying quipped with a curl of her lip.
"I haven't finished speaking yet," laughed Ou Ji, "Although these Foundation Establishment Pills are valuable, Yuan deserves this reward." Smiling, he produced a wooden box from within his robe and handed it to Yuan Ming.
"Senior Ou, my aptitude is rather mediocre; one Foundation Establishment Pill is somewhat difficult." Yuan Ming spoke with apparent regret.
"Not enough, not enough; how could one be enough? Biluo Cave has plenty of Foundation Establishment Pills. For a cultivator as brave and strategic as Yuan Ming, if he succeeds in Foundation Establishment, who knows if Dawn may need his help again?" Xi Ying continued.
The other three also echoed Xi Ying's opinion, all agreeing that one pill definitely wouldn't suffice for Yuan Ming due to his aptitude.
Left with no choice, Ou Ji again produced a wooden box and handed it to Yuan Ming.
"Thank you for your generous love, Senior Ou Ji," Yuan Ming said joyfully, accepting the two wooden boxes. He turned back to see Xi Ying looking at him with a mischievous, charming smile.
Afterward, Ou Ji and the other four Core Formation Stage cultivators, along with Xi Ying, began to distribute the items found within the storage magic tools of Chen Cangqiong, the Great Cave Master, and the Second Cave Master.
Ou Ji then set up a blue Forbidden Array nearby to block all prying eyes and divine senses.
This scene left Xiao Yao scratching his head in frustration, wanting to follow Xi Ying inside to see what treasures Chen Cangqiong and others had left behind, yet unable to enter; he could only stare blankly from outside the Forbidden Array.
Yuan Ming tactfully walked away, opening the two wooden boxes. Inside each, there lay a Foundation Establishment Pill, emitting a star-like blue radiance, which was even more majestic than the one he had received from Bai Ye.
His heart thrilled with secret joy; with these three Foundation Establishment Pills as a base, plus the enhancement from the thirteenth layer of the Nine Elements Technique of Qi Refinement, his chances of breaking through to the Foundation Establishment Stage could indeed increase significantly.
Yuan Ming put away the wooden boxes and sat down cross-legged, sensing the state of his Sea of Consciousness.
Having broken through to the third layer of the Moonlight Technique, his Divine Soul Power had increased significantly, allowing him to condense six soul crows, each one's Divine Soul fluctuation stronger than before, enhancing both the range of their far travel and the power of their soul collision.
Yuan Ming glanced toward where Ou Ji and the others were; he quietly released a soul crow, sending it flying far away, maintaining contact up to a distance of thirty li before starting to weaken.
He nodded slightly, continuing to sense the changes occurring in the soul crow and exploring his newly acquired ability, "Soul Search."
With this ability, he could invade another's Sea of Consciousness to explore their memories. In the future, he might even forcibly alter or erase someone's memories.
Currently, with Yuan Ming's level of cultivation, he could only search memories, and he was not yet able to alter or erase them.
Even so, this excited him immensely.
...
Meanwhile, inside the blue Forbidden Array, Ou Ji took out Chen Cangqiong's storage magic tool and used his mana to activate it.
With a "swish," the ground was suddenly covered with a pile of items, including six thousand Spirit Stones, two Jade Boxes, two bottles of pills, the Ten Thousand Ghost Banner, a Blood Blade Magic Treasure from Xue Zhan, and over a hundred black bells, which were Soul-Attracting Bells.
Ou Ji handed the storage bracelet to the others, who took turns examining it to confirm no items were left inside before tossing it aside.
Ou Ji then activated the two Jade Boxes which opened automatically and displayed two Jade Scrolls. The caps of the two medicine bottles also flew up automatically, revealing one unremarkable blue-black elixir each, emitting a bitter medicinal scent.
"Five Internal Organs Pills!" The bow-backed elder stared intensely at the black pills, exclaiming in shock.
"Oh, are these the Five Internal Organs Pills that can regulate the five organs and reinvigorate the body, said to increase lifespan by fifty years upon consumption?" Ou Ji asked, somewhat surprised.
"This is my first time seeing these pills; they are said to be nearly extinct in the Southern Border Immortal Cultivation World," the red-robed man murmured.
The bow-backed elder didn't speak, his gaze never leaving the two Five Internal Organs Pills, clearly determined to obtain them as his lifespan was not much.
The red-robed man and the green-robed woman had plenty of years left and did not need the Five Internal Organs Pills. Their gazes shifted towards the Ten Thousand Ghost Banner and the blood-colored saber, both Magic Treasures.
Seeing the desires of the three, Ou Ji was about to propose a method of distribution.
Xi Ying raised her hand, and the two Jade Scrolls floated up and landed in her hands, saying, "I'll take these two Jade Scrolls, these Soul-Attracting Bells, and a thousand Spirit Stones."
The others saw this, their expressions varied.
Ou Ji and the hunchbacked old man did not care much, those two Jade Scrolls probably contained Chen Cangqiong's Cultivation Method, and it would be troublesome if outsiders knew they possessed Chen Cangqiong's techniques.
As for those Soul-Attracting Bells, they were just the most common low-level Magical Artifacts, previously distributed to low-level disciples who went out to capture beast slaves, useless except for collecting Divine Souls.
The red-robed man and the green-robed woman, although tempted by Chen Cangqiong's eerie Soul Cultivation techniques, said nothing as Xi Ying had already made the first move.
Seeing that the four had no objections, Xi Ying did something unexpected to everyone, her hands shining with a ball of white light, enveloping those Soul-Attracting Bells and Jade Scrolls, and then she vigorously rubbed them.
The Soul-Attracting Bells and the Jade Scrolls completely shattered into black dust and scattered.
"What are you doing?" Ou Ji said in surprise.
"Soul Cultivation techniques and Soul-Attracting Bells are forbidden, and if they spread, it will be harmful to everyone. It's better to destroy them," Xi Ying said indifferently.
Ou Ji and the others neither agreed nor disagreed with this explanation; however, the Soul-Attracting Bells were not theirs, and they had no objection to however Xi Ying chose to handle them. As for the Soul Cultivation Method, since it was destroyed and now unreachable by anyone, that was even better.
"Let the four seniors discuss slowly, I will take my leave first," said Xi Ying, and then she turned around and left the Forbidden Zone.
...
Yuan Ming saw Xi Ying coming out from the Forbidden Zone, and just as he was about to approach her, Xiao Yao rushed ahead, getting to Xi Ying first, rubbing his hands and asked, "My dear sister, you came out so quickly? Did you find anything good for your brother?"
"I chose Chen Cangqiong's Cultivation Method and the Soul-Attracting Bells," Xi Ying said.
"This Soul Cultivation Method is really something special. Let me see," Xiao Yao said excitedly.
"I destroyed them on the spot," Xi Ying said.
"What?" Xiao Yao jumped up.
"Keeping them would be a disaster, and having them would be even more disastrous for the Xiao Family. Now that I've destroyed them on the spot, if it spreads later, who wouldn't know of our Xiao Family's great magnanimity and reputation. Reputation is more important than anything," Xi Ying said.This is part of a series from My Virtual Library Empire (*).
"Sister, you really are wise; no wonder the old ancestor always said that the Xiao Family would depend on you in the future." Before Xiao Yao could finish his sentence, Xi Ying hailed Yuan Ming with a call: "Let's go."
Yuan Ming took a few steps forward, and Xi Ying performed a Teleportation Array with a flick of her sleeve, and the three of them disappeared in a flash, returning to Qingluo Square.
The allocation at Qingluo Square was still ongoing, ten Dawn Members holding ledgers stood at the edge of the square, calling out names.
The ledgers seemed to record the merits of participants in the mission, and those called could choose items according to their merit points; half of the items on the square were already taken.
"Brother, you've made quite an effort this time, don't you want to receive a reward?" Xi Ying suddenly said.
"Hehe, I've already collected it, and I'm not as generous as you. I felt I was at a loss after the last mission when I killed the White Dragon Island Young Master," Xiao Yao said with a laugh.
"You still have the cheek to mention it. You were shouting in the workshop, afraid that others wouldn't know it was you who made the move. This time you've offended the Qingshan Hermit, I don't know how you'll apologize later. You were supposed to follow him, but why did you have to attack him upon meeting? Couldn't you wait until you were out of the workshop?" Xi Ying said angrily.
Xiao Yao's smile froze at once, and he opened his mouth but ultimately said nothing, his mood visibly dampened as he ran towards those holding the ledgers, his small, pointed cap drooping to one side.
"I'm going to stroll around first," Xi Ying dismissed Xiao Yao and then, without waiting for Yuan Ming to speak, she flamboyantly performed a Teleportation Array with a wave of her hand and disappeared from sight.
Yuan Ming was planning to find a quiet corner to rest when Wulu appeared out of nowhere, bringing Ma Xingkong to Yuan Ming, and enthusiastically introduced him:
"Brother Yuan, where have you been? I've been looking everywhere for you! Let me introduce you to someone. This is Fellow Daoist Ma Xingkong, I'm sure you already know him. We were fellow disciples at Biluo Cave and now we are in the Dawn Alliance together. There's no need to use formalities like senior or junior anymore."
"Brother Ma, I've long admired your reputation," Yuan Ming greeted with a bow, feeling a trace of admiration for this man.
His breakthrough to the third layer of the Ming Yue Technique had sharpened his sensitivity to auras, and he felt that the aura of Mana around Ma Xingkong was somewhat similar to his own.
"Lucky to meet you! I've heard about you from Wulu. You are also from Da Jin, right?" Ma Xingkong examined Yuan Ming and said.
"Yes! Who would have thought to meet a fellow countryman here, what a coincidence," Yuan Ming said.
The three of them had all experienced being beast slaves, and as they talked about their past experiences in Biluo Cave, they quickly lost any sense of alienation. If someone else saw them, they would think the three were long-lost close friends.
"Brother Ma, have you been with the Dawn Alliance ever since you left Biluo Cave?" Yuan Ming asked.
"Not at all, I only joined the Dawn Alliance recently," Ma Xingkong dismissed with a wave.
"Brother Yuan, you may not know, but Brother Ma is now a high disciple of the Da Jin Chang Chun Temple. He has been cultivating in Da Jin all these years, and only recently joined Dawn temporarily to eliminate Biluo Cave," Wulu said.
"Chang Chun Temple!" Yuan Ming was surprised, then somewhat enlightened.

chapters.title: Chapter 231 - 208: The Bonds of Youth
chapters.content:
No wonder Ma Xingkong's mana aura was similar to his own; it seemed that the cultivation technique he practiced was also closely related to the Nine Elements Technique. In that case, whether it was Biluo Cave or Chang Chun Temple, the two of them could be considered fellow sect members. Indeed, it was fate. With this thought, Yuan Ming had a new idea about Ma Xingkong.
"So you're a disciple of Da Jin's number one sect, Chang Chun Temple," Yuan Ming said, complimenting him.
"You flatter me too much. I'm hardly a distinguished disciple. After I escaped from Biluo Cave, I came across my master by chance. Seeing that I still had some potential, he took me under his wing. Recently, when it was time to eradicate Biluo Cave, it happened that I had some recorded evidence of Biluo Cave killing mortals, so I was sent to the Southern Border to deal with this matter alongside Dawn," Ma Xingkong explained.
"I see. So those recorded images of Biluo Cave killing mortals were deliberately documented by you when you were there?" Yuan Ming nodded and asked curiously. However, he felt there must be other reasons for Chang Chun Temple's involvement.
"Indeed, I come from a mercantile background. Back then, I followed a merchant caravan to the Southern Border and was attacked by Biluo Cave along the way. All my relatives and friends were killed, and I was fortunate enough to escape with my life because of my Spirit Root. To avenge my family, I endured hardships from being a Fur Beast Slave to becoming a Registered Disciple. Later in the marketplace, I even bought a magic artifact to record several instances of Biluo Cave murdering mortals. I originally planned to use these records to accuse Biluo Cave of violating the Northern Territory's ten rules, but unfortunately, the Five Sects of the North Territory kept shirking responsibility. Only now have these recordings finally come into use," Ma Xingkong said, a hint of hatred in his eyes.
"Biluo Cave has acted against the heavens and harmed the living; its destruction today is indeed deserved. Brother Ma, your contribution is immeasurable," Yuan Ming remarked, envisioning the tragic sight within Miao Hua Village and sighing.
"We've been chatting for quite a while and almost forgot about the important stuff. Brother Yuan, I've already reported your contribution for you, and your name has been added to the list of those receiving rewards. Hurry up and claim yours before all the good items are taken," Wulu suddenly remembered, saying.
Yuan Ming's face showed realization, his mouth expressing thanks, yet he felt amused inside. He had already obtained two Foundation Establishment Pills from Ou Ji, and now to think he could receive additional rewards here!
When it came to rewards, more was always better; he had indeed exerted much effort, both burning incense and acting as a protector, which had been quite exhausting.
He immediately went to the ten Dawn Members holding ledgers and gave his name.
"Ah, Fellow Daoist Yuan, it's a pleasure to meet you! The tale of how you and Wulu successfully infiltrated Biluo Cave is truly a legend!" A pockmarked woman checked her ledger and smiled at Yuan Ming.
"The basic merit points for participating members is one hundred. Fellow Daoist Yuan, you have endured much and worked hard, accumulating a total of five hundred merit points. The items in the square have all been marked with their respective merit points for you to choose from," another short-haired young man said.This from the collection at *.
"But you should hurry; most of the good items have been picked over," the pockmarked woman whispered as a reminder.
"Thank you both."
Yuan Ming thanked them and hastened towards the gathering of spirit beasts in front of the Beast Taming Hall.
He had always wanted a flying spiritual beast for travel but had never found the opportunity. Now, with a large number of spirit beasts from Biluo Cave being offered as rewards, it was the perfect time to choose one.
Biluo Cave was renowned in the Southern Border and Northern Territory for commanding spirit beasts, and this time the Beast Taming Hall's spirit beasts had also become the focus of competition among the Dawn Members. At this point, the majority had already been chosen, with flying spiritual beasts, being a prime target, in even scarcer supply.
His gaze briefly swept over the square before settling on a conspicuous Green Cloud Crane. Standing tall at about ten feet with a blue neck and white wings, it exuded an air of ethereal elegance, and its cry was piercingly proud and aloof.
And coincidentally, the robust man standing in front of the crane was none other than Bai Ye, with Huan Shi nowhere to be seen.
"Heh, Fellow Daoist Hagon, I would never have thought that after parting ways in Black Rock City that day, we would meet again here today," Bai Ye said with a chuckle, noticing Yuan Ming.
"Alliance Leader Bai Ye, it seems we are truly fated," Yuan Ming also said with a smile.
"Fellow Daoist, you are truly a deep pool of hidden depths. No wonder your prowess is exceptional, and you're so tight-lipped," Bai Ye said meaningfully, sizing up Yuan Ming.
"You flatter me. Forced by the circumstances, I had no choice. Alliance Leader Bai Ye, are you here to pick a flying spiritual beast?" Yuan Ming neither confirmed nor denied Bai Ye's remark, glancing at the crane as he spoke.
"I contributed little this time, so I do not have enough merit points. As much as I'd like this Green Cloud Crane, it requires quite a hefty sum of merit points," Bai Ye said, seeing that Yuan Ming was reluctant to elaborate further. He too turned his attention back to the crane.
"Four hundred and fifty merit points, indeed quite steep!" Yuan Ming nodded. A Level 1 Upper Stage flying spiritual beast required a high number of merit points, which high-cultivation cultivators might not care for, and those interested might not afford. If not for its high price, how could it have remained available?
"Fellow Daoist Hagon, take your time. Now that the matters here are concluded, I shall take my leave," Bai Ye said.
"What are your plans after this, Alliance Leader Bai Ye? Are you planning to stay with Dawn, or to rebuild the White Night Alliance?" Yuan Ming inquired.
"Honestly, I plan to return to Da Jin Thunder Continent and join my sect. Fellow Daoist Hagon, I believe we will meet again in the future. Farewell," Bai Ye said with a tinge of wistfulness before turning and leaving.
Yuan Ming watched Bai Ye's towering figure disappear at the end of the square, then turned his attention back to the Green Cloud Crane in front of him. He examined it further and nodded with satisfaction.
He had seen this Green Cloud Crane before in the sect; it was the mount of Elder Meng Shan from the Beast Taming Hall, graceful and swift. He wondered why it was not taken when the elder left the sect.
Without delay, Yuan Ming confirmed his merit points with a nearby Dawn Member and stored the Green Cloud Crane in his Spiritual Beast Bag.
For the remaining fifty merit points, he casually exchanged them for a small pile of white Spirit Fruit called "Confusion Fruit." Supposedly, consuming them could cause one to lose their mind in extreme pleasure, becoming utterly addicted.
This fruit is harmful to the body and has no benefits, but he planned to use it to try refining incense, so he didn't think too much about it.
Just as Yuan Ming was about to leave the square in front of the Beast Taming Hall, Xi Ying appeared from nowhere, holding Guoguo in her arms.
"Biluo Cave indeed is a Cave Heaven Blessed Land, it's a pity it was destroyed in a great battle," Xi Ying said.
"No matter, in a few decades everything will be restored to its original state. What are your plans going forward?" Yuan Ming asked.
"I've been loitering around Biluo Cave before because of that Soul Suppressing Kettle. Now that the matter is finally settled, I intend to play around in the Southern Border using Xiao Ying's identity for a while. Her great ancestor will be celebrating a big birthday soon, and I will need to return for that. Since I've taken over her body, I should do something for her. What about you? What are your plans?" Xi Ying, tilting her head and pondering for a moment, said.
"My cultivation is just one step away from reaching the Qi Refining Peak, then I plan to find a quiet place to attempt Foundation Establishment," Yuan Ming replied.
"That's good, take this with you," Xi Ying said, taking out a Storage Bag and tossing it over.
Yuan Ming instinctively caught it, activating his Divine Sense to investigate.
Inside the Storage Bag were a Blood Egg, a Jade Scroll, and three green talismans.
"That Blood Egg was found in the old guy's Cave Mansion. The Fur Beast Slaves have been drawing blood to feed this egg for many years; have fun with it. The Jade Scroll is a manual of the Xiao Ying Family's array formations. I remember you have a set of Array Flags but don't know how to use them; this Array Formation Manual contains some methods of setting up formations. As for the three talismans, they are called Green Spirit Communication Talismans; as long as the distance doesn't exceed ten thousand miles, you can use them to send messages to me," Xi Ying's calm voice carried over.
"This Blood Egg seems extraordinary, do you know its origins and how to hatch it?" Yuan Ming asked.
"Xi Cangqiong once used the Beast Blood collected from the Fur Beasts in the Ten Thousand Mountains to feed it. I've seen that the amount of blood essence absorbed by the egg is sufficient. In the future, you can draw one drop of your Essence Blood every half month to continue feeding it, and perhaps it will hatch on its own. Alright, I've said all that needs to be said, so this is goodbye. We'll meet again someday," Xi Ying said after considering for a while.
"Wait a moment," Yuan Ming called out to Xi Ying, taking out a gray cloak, "Here, this is for you."
"This cloak is so ugly, I don't want it," Xi Ying turned around.
Yuan Ming didn't argue and kept the cloak for himself.
"Parting today, who knows when we will meet again. I have a question in my heart, and I hope you can clear my confusion," Yuan Ming said.
"Back when we first met, I was just an ordinary Fur Beast Slave, but why did you treat me differently and even passed on a cultivation technique to me?" Yuan Ming asked the question that had long been on his mind.
"Because you had that tripod," Xi Ying replied.
"Because of the incense burner?" Yuan Ming probed.
"What you have is not some incense burner, it's a treasure for soul cultivators like me, supposed to be the legendary 'Stealing Heaven Tripod'. It's a pity it has already recognized a master, otherwise, I'd really want to snatch it away," Xi Ying said with a meaningful smile curling up her lips.
"'Stealing Heaven Tripod', what a domineering name," Yuan Ming continued, "Then you could just kill and rob now." Yuan Ming looked at Xi Ying with a half-smiling expression.
"Humph, I don't care for it. Killing you would mean one less overconfident hero in the world, wouldn't that be boring," Xi Ying retorted, "Kill, kill, kill, I will have to tell my father when I get home that his 'prodigy' is now just a mundane person who always talks about killing."
"Do you still recognize this book?" After a moment of silence, Xi Ying waved her hand and a blue object drifted over.
Yuan Ming reached out to catch it, only to see it was a somewhat worn picture book.
He briefly flipped through it, finding it to be a children's storybook with some hamster illustrations in the middle, and memories surfaced in his heart.
In his childhood, he had not cultivated due to certain reasons. He learned the zither, chess, calligraphy, painting, and martial arts. Out of boredom, he wrote some children's storybooks, which then spread. This was one of them.
Yuan Ming was naturally intelligent and was hailed as a prodigy. His children's storybooks were not only widely circulated in Da Jin but also spread to neighboring countries.
The young Emperor of Da Jin particularly liked the stories written by Yuan Ming, which is why he was recruited as a study companion for the Emperor.
"A story written in childhood, of course, I recognize it," Yuan Ming closed the book and slowly said.
"In my childhood, my father bought me a copy of this book. He praised your work, saying it was in harmony with the Heavenly Dao. I happened to read it when I was bored, although the stories were incomplete, the mouse drawings were pretty good. I brought it with me on this trip," Xi Ying said softly. After speaking, she turned around, gazing toward the distant mountains with a look as serene as still water, seemingly

chapters.title: Chapter 232 - 209: Fate
chapters.content:
After a long while.
"So it turns out, the bond between us actually stemmed from the naive drawings of my childhood, fate really is wonderful," Yuan Ming hadn't expected Xi Ying to look upon him with different eyes for that reason, and couldn't help but be emotional.
"Who has a bond with you," Xi Ying scoffed lightly, waving her hand and forming an array with yellow array patterns.
A dazzling flash of yellow light passed, and Xi Ying's figure had disappeared.
As the person vanished, a faint fragrance still lingered near his nostrils.
Suddenly remembering something, he looked down at his right hand.
He was still holding the book, having forgotten to return it to Xi Ying.
"I'll return it to her the next time we meet," Yuan Ming thought to himself, and was about to put away the book when he suddenly frowned.
There was a hard feeling inside the book, as if something was sandwiched between the pages.
He opened the book and found a thin, grey jade scroll tucked between the last two pages.
Yuan Ming took the jade scroll, probed it with his divine sense, and his body stiffened slightly.
Inside the jade scroll were surprisingly the subsequent cultivation techniques of the Moonlight Technique, including the mnemonics from the Fourth Layer to the Sixth Layer.
His Moonlight Technique had just recently broken through to the third layer, and the more he cultivated, the more he could deeply appreciate its power. He had a strong desire for the subsequent techniques, and he couldn't believe that Xi Ying had given them to him directly.
"Brother Yuan, what are you doing by yourself?" Wulu said.
Yuan Ming was startled; without realizing it, Wulu had already approached him, and he suddenly noticed that only the jade scroll was in his hand, while the book had vanished.
The recent encounter with Xi Ying, he wasn't sure if it was an illusion or reality.
"You appeared so suddenly, Brother Wulu, you gave me quite a scare," Yuan Ming said calmly as he put away the jade scroll.
"Were you just thinking about Xiao Ying, lost in thought?" Wulu chuckled heartily.
"Brother Wulu truly has a discerning eye," Yuan Ming laughed along as well.
"Young people need to dare to dream, to act, and to take responsibility— I support you," Wulu said with laughter.
"How do you plan to support me?" Yuan Ming asked.
"Do you want me to sneak into the Xiao Family and gather some information for you?" Wulu whispered.
"What would be the cost?" Yuan Ming inquired.
"Five thousand spirit stones, plus a top-grade magical tool?" Wulu proposed.
"I can't afford that, what about Ma Xingkong?" Yuan Ming asked.
"Brother Ma has already left to return to Jin Country. He asked me to say goodbye to you on his behalf. Do you need to see him for something, Brother Yuan?" Wulu inquired.
"It's nothing, now that the matters regarding Biluo Cave have concluded, I had wanted to say goodbye to Brother Ma before leaving. What are your plans, Brother Wulu?" Yuan Ming asked.
"This time I've completed the task given by my family, and since I rarely have so much free time, I want to travel around and really see the world. I'll go to Black Rock City in a few days and then to the Southern Border Eastern Domain, and I want to see the sea as well. I'm almost fifty and I've never seen the sea," Wulu remarked with emotion.
"Alright then, may we meet again if fate allows," Yuan Ming said.
After more idle chatter, the two parted ways.
The Scatter Alliance had little control over temporary members, who were free to come and go as they pleased; Yuan Ming left directly from the entrance of Biluo Cave and plunged into the dense forests of the Ten Thousand Mountains.
A moment later, Yuan Ming arrived at a small stream in the mountains, scooped up the cool water to wash his face, and turned to face what was behind him.
"You've followed me all this way, time to show yourself, don't you think?"
The jungle behind him rustled and parted, and a tall and upright figure stepped out: it was Long Hao, who had shown his might during the previous battle of the mountain attack.
"So it's Senior Long Hao," Yuan Ming said, his eyes showing surprise as he clasped his hands in greeting.
"You are Yuan Ming?" Long Hao's voice boomed like a bell as he scrutinized Yuan Ming.
Please read this chapter on its original platform—*.
"Indeed," Yuan Ming replied calmly.
"Did you write this letter?" Long Hao took out an envelope from his bosom, not named but marked only with a paw print.
Yuan Ming's eyebrows raised slightly as he nodded.
In the Ten Thousand Mountains, after reaching an understanding with the Human Demon King Long Xi, he had written this letter according to Long Xi's wish, to inform his kin of his ordeal.
"Since the letter is indeed written by you, you must also be the one who buried my son's body. Lead me there," Long Hao said sternly.
"Senior, follow me," Yuan Ming said without attempting to hide anything, taking off in a certain direction.
Half a day later, the two arrived at the valley where Yuan Ming had buried the Human Demon King's head.
"The people from Biluo Cave were conducting a stringent search that day, and I had no time to take away Brother Long Xi's body. I could only take his head, I ask for your understanding, Senior," Yuan Ming led Long Hao to Long Xi's grave and explained.
Long Hao didn't speak. Instead, he stared at the unmarked tomb before him, and in that moment, his tall figure seemed to stoop, and his limbs shook faintly.
Yuan Ming sighed silently and quietly stepped back outside the valley.
After a long time, Long Hao emerged from the valley, his expression restored to calm, and said, "Thank you, Yuan, for burying my son. I wonder what reward you would like?"
In return for writing the letter, Long Xi had made a promise on behalf of his family to Yuan Ming, a matter already stated in the letter.
"Thank you for your kindness, Senior Long Hao, but I do not wish for a reward," Yuan Ming said.
"Very well, you already know the location of my clan. You may visit any time; this is a token of passage," Long Hao took out a dark gold token with the character "Long" on it. His clan seemed to occupy a unique, reclusive position within the Southern Border Immortal Cultivation World.
"Thank you, Senior," Yuan Ming received the token, clasping his hands in gratitude.
Long Hao's mood was solemn as he gathered his son's remains, not saying much before turning to leave.
"Yuan Ming, Senior Long Hao, please wait a moment." A green falcon came speeding through the air, landing nearby.
A figure leaped down, revealing himself to be Fang Ge.
"Brother Fang Ge, it's great that you're safe. How come you're here?" Yuan Ming said happily.
Long Hao also looked towards Fang Ge, his face expressing confusion.
"Under the orders of Ancestor Li Zhui and the Three Cave Masters, I have been tasked with inviting both of you to their dual cultivation ceremony." Fang Ge took out two red invitations and handed them to Yuan Ming and Long Hao.
The Dual Cultivation Ceremony of the Three Cave Masters! It was not known that she had a daoist companion, so who was this Li Zhui? Yuan Ming had a faint guess in his heart.
"Senior Li Zhui! He's still alive?" Long Hao exclaimed in surprise, his voice so loud that Yuan Ming couldn't help but glance sideways.
"Indeed, I hope both of you will bestow us with your presence," Fang Ge said.
"Senior Li Zhui showed me great kindness in the past. Of course, I will attend his dual cultivation ceremony," Long Hao immediately said.
"I naturally cannot be absent from the Three Cave Masters' ceremony either," Yuan Ming stated.
"Good, please mount the falcon," Fang Ge suggested.
The green falcon quickly ascended into the air and headed towards Biluo Cave, arriving before long.
Inside the gates of Biluo Cave, there was no sign of life, whether from the captured Biluo Cave disciples or the Dawn Alliance members, all had vanished without a trace.
Not long before, the place was alight with the sounds of battle, but now it was eerily silent, prompting a sense of lament.
The green falcon dove down, landing in a secluded valley near Fire Refining Peak.
Yuan Ming had been here before; it was where the Fisherman lived, the valley enshrouded in dense mist, hiding its interior from view.
This place confirmed Li Zhui's identity.
The falcon flew straight into the valley, passing through a point in space with a slight cracking noise, as if piercing through something.
Yuan Ming's vision blurred, and all the mist vanished, revealing the tranquil valley once again before his eyes.
He looked back, understanding that an Illusion Technique Restriction enshrouded the valley, making it appear foggy from the outside.
The falcon landed, and the three of them leaped down, approaching the straw hut where the Fisherman resided.
Many new houses had been built within the valley, adorned with red silk lanterns, creating a festive atmosphere. Many people were busy here, all of them disciples from Fire Refining Hall. Yuan Ming looked on with joy.
Seeing Yuan Ming, the Fire Refining Hall disciples, having been reunited after the disaster, were also extremely delighted.
The three arrived at a spacious courtyard deep in the valley, where over a dozen banquet tables were set up. Aside from the Fire Refining Hall disciples, there were also some unfamiliar faces, likely friends of the Three Cave Masters and Li Zhui.
At that moment, the Three Cave Masters, donned in red robes, and the similarly clad elderly Fisherman, were entertaining guests.
"It really is the Fisherman," Yuan Ming thought to himself.
Fang Ge led Yuan Ming and Long Hao to sit at a table, and it wasn't long before the Three Cave Masters and the Fisherman came over.
"Senior Li Zhui, I did not expect that you would still be among the living," Long Hao said as he rose.
"Fellow Daoist Long, by my reckoning, we haven't seen each other for over a hundred years. It's truly wonderful that Yuan, too, could attend," the Fisherman greeted Long Hao and Yuan Ming warmly.
The Three Cave Masters and Long Hao were not well acquainted.
"How did you two come to arrive together?" the Fisherman inquired.
"By chance, I also owe Yuan a favor," Long Hao said.
"Three Cave Masters, congratulations on your wedding today, please accept this jar of fine wine," Yuan Ming said as he took out a jar of wine he'd intended for the Fisherman and handed it over.
"You are thoughtful, but since Biluo Cave no longer exists, there's no need for old titles. Just call me Ling Songhua," the Three Cave Masters said with a smile, accepting the wine.
"Yes, Senior Ling," Yuan Ming readily agreed.
"You're not only fortunate but also have a heart as intricate as a finely carved piece," the Fisherman said with a smile.
"The opportunities I've had are all thanks to Senior Ling's initial willingness to take me in; otherwise, I wouldn't know where I'd be right now. Once again, congratulations to both seniors," Yuan Ming said, bowing respectfully to Ling Songhua and the Fisherman.
The two of them lifted Yuan Ming to his feet.
Then, the Fisherman and Long Hao moved to one side to catch up.
The auspicious time arrived.
The dual cultivation ceremony of cultivators wasn't much different from the weddings in the mundane world, except that both Ling Songhua and the Fisherman were Core Formation Stage cultivators who had cultivated for over a hundred years, and their mortal parents had long since passed away, forgoing the rituals of kneeling and bowing. After paying respects to heaven and earth, and sharing a cup of wine between them, the ceremony was complete.
Being with the Fire Refining Hall disciples, Yuan Ming felt incredibly comfortable. During the feast, the conversations were about those who had met with retribution for their vile deeds, while some grieved for fallen brothers and sisters. That evening, everyone drank merrily, filled with a sense of relief and joy.
After the feast, Yuan Ming took his leave.
"Yuan Ming, the master would like you to stay. Please wait for her in the side hall," Fang Ge interrupted Yuan Ming's departure.
Yuan Ming faintly guessed the purpose of Ling Songhua asking him to stay and followed Fang Ge to a nearby straw hut.
An hour later, Ling Songhua arrived slowly, saying, "I apologize for making you wait."
"Not at all, Senior Ling's big day naturally comes with many obligations. As for myself, having nothing pressing, waiting is of no concern," Yuan Ming said.
"When did you join the Dawn Alliance?" Ling Songhua, sitting down, asked directly.
Yuan Ming was taken aback, as Ling Songhua also seemed to think he had joined the Dawn Alliance, and at that moment, he didn't quite know how to explain.

chapters.title: Chapter 233 - 210: Returning Home
chapters.content:
"I had long known the identity of Wulu, and as for you, a citizen of Jin Country, beginning as a Beast Slave, your rate of advancement in cultivation has been remarkably swift, likely related to Dawn Alliance by eighty percent. It was precisely because I knew this that I regarded you differently and even covered for you several times when other elders asked about you," Ling Songhua continued.
"Thank you, Senior Ling, for your care," Yuan Ming said.
At that moment, Huo Chan'er jumped onto Yuan Ming's shoulder, nudged his head, and Yuan Ming gently stroked it.
"Under Chen Cangqiong's leadership, Biluo Cave has long acted in ways that defy heaven and hurt humanity, earning the wrath of both. Its obliteration was bound to happen sooner or later. Although I preferred not to assist Dawn Alliance in wiping out Biluo Cave, I was happy to see its success," Ling Songhua said coldly.
Yuan Ming suddenly realized that Ling Songhua thought he was a spy sent by Dawn Sect and had looked after him previously due to this mistake.
"Do you know why I asked you to stay?" Ling Songhua asked.
"Please enlighten me, Senior Ling," Yuan Ming said cautiously.
"Back then, when you sought White Flame Gold for me, I had never repaid that favor. I had originally planned to refine a Flying Artifact for you, but now Dawn Alliance has destroyed Biluo Cave, and the materials I had stored in the Fire Refining Peak warehouse have all been taken. I'm afraid it won't be possible to fulfill that now," Ling Songhua said.
"Senior Ling has been thoughtful. I already possess a Flying Spiritual Beast. It doesn't matter whether I have a Flying Artifact or not. That piece of White Flame Gold was also something I stumbled upon without much effort, please don't concern yourself with repaying me," Yuan Ming declined.
"Hehe, Yuan Ming, there is something you don't know. Song Hua's cultivation technique is unique and requires an extremely strict state of mind. The White Flame Gold you brought helped her significantly. If I don't repay, it might leave a hidden concern; please don't decline this matter anymore," a voice came, and it was Fisherman Li Zhui who walked in.
"Senior Li," Yuan Ming stood up to greet him.
"We are friends of old; no need for such formality, please sit," Li Zhui chuckled.
"I have two ways to compensate you. One is to give you a sum of Spirit Stones, equivalent to the market price of White Flame Gold, and the other is to refine another type of Magical Artifact for you," Ling Songhua said.
Upon hearing this, an idea suddenly surfaced in Yuan Ming's mind.
"Since Senior Ling has offered, I shall take the liberty of making a request. There's no need for you to refine a new artifact for me; upgrading this item to a top-grade magical tool will suffice." He took out the Black Needle Magical Artifact and said.
This needle was a Mid-Grade Magical Artifact with astonishing power, made of extremely high-quality materials, even superior to the Cold Star Sword. He estimated that it certainly could be advanced to a top-grade magical tool.
Ling Songhua took the Black Needle, activated her Divine Sense to examine it, and a look of surprise appeared on her face.
The original source is *.
"This needle is refined from Meteorite Iron! Meteorite Iron is certainly more than sufficient for refining a Magic Treasure, let alone upgrading to a top-grade magical tool. However, regarding the two runes on it, do you plan to keep them?" she asked.
"These two runes perfectly match the Black Needle Magical Artifact. Just add a 'Gale' rune," Yuan Ming said.
"Good, I'll start refining it now, and it should be done in one day," Ling Songhua got up and walked out.
Yuan Ming was about to say there was no rush, but Ling Songhua had already disappeared outside the door, leaving only him and the Fisherman in the room.
"I had long felt that you and the Three Cave Masters had an exceptionally close relationship; I never expected you would become Daoist companions. It's truly delightful," Yuan Ming chuckled.
"Now I have no other desires, only to stay and accompany Song Hua," Li Zhui slowly said.
"Now that Chen Cangqiong is dead, and Biluo Cave has been destroyed, don't you plan to rebuild Three Stars Mountain? With you and Senior Ling as two Core Formation Stage cultivators, reconstructing Three Stars Mountain wouldn't be difficult," Yuan Ming asked.
"Having been through the bustling mortal world and experienced the vicissitudes of life, I once overlooked the common folk, and I've fallen into the mundane as well. What is an Immortal? And what is not an Immortal? Although I am an Immortal, I no longer care to inquire about the Immortal way. Past events are like smoke in chains, all passed away; the remainder of my life is like a dream, seeking only peace with no ties," Li Zhui leaned back in his chair, stretching, his eyes revealing a sense of release.
"What an unencumbered heart! Though I have not long been on the Immortal Path, I have never felt that Immortals lead much happier lives than ordinary people. There's nothing but intrigue and indifference, continually hustling for resources and treasures all day long—it's less carefree than a martial arts warrior wandering through the martial arts world!" Yuan Ming said, sensing the truth in these words.
"Haha, Yuan, understanding this and achieving a focused and carefree spirit shows a mental state not common among ordinary cultivators. So-called Immortals refine their bodies, but in future, they refine their hearts. They come from the mundane, seeking eternal life from their original hearts, returning to their true selves; the great path is forthcoming," Li Zhui laughed heartily.
"From now on, there will be one less Immortal named Li Zhui in this world, but one more leisurely person, Fisherman Li," Yuan Ming also laughed.
The two naturally hit it off and chatted until late at night before dispersing.
Yuan Ming didn't seek another place to stay, and instead, he spent the night meditating in the side hall of the thatched cottage.
Early the next morning, Ling Songhua, looking slightly fatigued, came to the thatched cottage.
"It's ready; see if it meets your satisfaction?"
When Yuan Ming opened his eyes, he barely caught a glimpse of a dark shadow flashing before him, as the Black Needle magically appeared in front of him.
With his current Divine Sense, he had not even managed to track the movement of the needle.
"Thank you, Senior Ling!" Yuan Ming expressed his joy gratefully and took the needle to examine closely.
There was little change in the appearance of the needle, still in the shape of a thin black pin, but he could feel the surge in spiritual power within.
The more runes engraved, the more the material's spiritual power is stimulated.
After the Black Needle was advanced to a top-grade magical tool, its power was incomparably greater than before.
He channeled his mana into the Black Needle, activating the three runes inside. With a "whoosh," the needle vanished, instantly reappearing several yards away.
His Divine Sense almost failed to keep up as the needle slightly wobbled before stabilizing again.
"This Black Needle is small and was already fast, but now with the Gale Rune, its speed is further enhanced. However, because of this, it's difficult to control; it would be better to wait until you've advanced to the Foundation Establishment Stage, when your Divine Power is strong enough, before using this magical tool. Otherwise, a mishandling could easily hurt someone," Ling Songhua cautioned.
"Thank you for the warning, Senior Ling. I'll bear it in mind," Yuan Ming replied, his heart bursting with joy.
In terms of mana, he still had a significant gap between himself and the Foundation Establishment Cultivators, but when it came to Divine Soul Power, having broken through the third layer of the Moonlight Technique, he was confident that his Divine Soul's strength was comparable to any Foundation Establishment Cultivator.
Having finished his business, Yuan Ming bid farewell and left.
Ling Songhua and Fisherman Li Zhui did not try to retain him and personally saw him off from the valley.
To Yuan Ming's surprise, the disciples of the Fire Refining Hall who were in the valley just yesterday were nowhere to be seen; the entire valley was vacant and quiet, as if it had returned to its former state.
"Where are Brother Fang Ge and the others?" Yuan Ming asked.
"We have no intention of rebuilding Three Stars Mountain. I dismissed Fang Ge and the others. They have their own paths to follow. The world is vast; they shouldn't be confined to this valley for a lifetime," said Fisherman Li Zhui with a smile.
Yuan Ming deeply agreed with this.
"Yuan Ming, if you encounter Fang Ge and the others in the future, please take good care of them," Ling Songhua said.
Yuan Ming readily agreed, took out the Beast Taming Talisman Stone, and held it in his hand. Then, he gently patted the white Spiritual Beast Bag at his waist, and a spirit crane with a green neck and white wings flew out.
"I shall take my leave for now. I hope to visit you again if there's a chance in the future, and by then, I hope you both will have successors!" He leaped onto the Green Cloud Crane, laughing as he said his farewells.
Fisherman Li Zhui maintained his cheerful demeanor, while Ling Songhua's pretty face blushed. She swung her hand, "Scram, you're so rude, asking for a smack!"
Yuan Ming laughed heartily, controlling the Green Cloud Crane to flap its wings and ascend, dodging Ling Songhua's palm strike. He waved to them and quickly left the valley behind.
The Green Cloud Crane was swift, and it didn't take long before they left the entrance of Biluo Cave behind.
Huo Chan'er jumped on the rooftop, squeaking towards the direction Yuan Ming was leaving—as if it knew that Yuan Ming was embarking on a long journey, bidding him farewell.
Sitting cross-legged on the crane's back in the wind, Yuan Ming looked at the vast mountains below. The answer from the Three Cave Masters had cleared his last doubt, giving birth to a sense of relief in his heart that he hadn't felt in a long time.
He took a deep breath and took out the Black Needle Magical Artifact once again, channeling a robust Divine Power into the needle.
The Black Needle Magical Artifact emitted a dense black light and slowly levitated, starting to move around with increasing speed.
The Divine Soul Power Yuan Ming was now channeling into the Black Needle Magical Artifact was sufficient for its control; it moved faster and faster without the slightest instability.
A slender black shadow flickered and raced through the nearby void, at a glance appearing like four or five flying needles.
Yuan Ming's eyes shifted, and he raised his hand to stop the Black Needle.
Although the needle was now as fast as lightning, he sensed that its full potential had not been activated; the Soul Power he had infused was still not enough.
Yuan Ming silently operated the Moonlight Technique, a soul crow shot out from his glabella and entered the black magical tool.
The Black Needle Magical Artifact suddenly shone with a dense black light, the needle fully integrated within it.
Yuan Ming's eyes revealed a look of surprise, and with a gesture, he pointed out.
The Black Needle Magical Artifact flickered and disappeared. Almost simultaneously, a shrill scream echoed from the jungle below.
A fierce beast resembling a half-human-high black pig ran out, its forehead pierced by a thin needle hole, with blood slowly seeping out.
The black pig fierce beast managed only a few steps before its body began to wobble and then it crashed down heavily. The Black Needle Magical Artifact hovered behind the black pig, its needle as pristine as new without a speck of blood.
Yuan Ming's smile grew even brighter. With a gesture, the Black Needle Magical Artifact vanished in a flash.
A few breaths later, a Green Wolf fierce beast howled pitifully and likewise collapsed.
Yuan Ming was delighted and beckoned with his hand.
A black shadow flashed across his palm, and the Black Needle Magical Artifact reappeared.
The direct control by the soul crow of the Black Needle Magical Artifact had an effect beyond his expectations.
The soul crow's Soul Power was both abundant and concentrated, very suitable for activating the Black Needle, a top-grade magical tool filled with numerous runes.
Furthermore, this was Yuan Ming's first time controlling a magical tool with a soul crow, and he made an unexpected discovery: the attack range of the Black Needle Magical Artifact had also greatly expanded.
The attack range of a magical tool is constrained by both Divine Power and mana.
Mana can adhere within the magical tool, linking them closely. Even if it flies out to a great distance, it doesn't disperse. However, Divine Power does not blend with the magical tool, and it disperses once it exceeds the covering range.
Generally speaking, the farther a cultivator's Divine Power can spread, the greater the attack range of the magical tool.
For ordinary cultivators, even those at the Foundation Establishment Stage, the scope of Divine Power is merely about a hundred meters, whereas the far-travel range of the soul crow reached a terrifying thirty li.
For Yuan Ming, the attack range of the Black Needle Magical Artifact was no longer limited by the reach of Divine Power but by the extent of mana adherence.
Meteorite Iron had a unique property that tightly fused with his mana, and within a range of three hundred meters, it would not disperse, thus giving the Black Needle Magical Artifact an astonishing attack range of three hundred meters!
To launch an attack from three hundred meters away, with the concealing effect of the Black Needle Magical Artifact, even a Foundation Establishment Cultivator might not be able to dodge it.
Thinking of this, Yuan Ming felt a surge of excitement and, controlling the Green Cloud Crane, flew towards the depths of the Ten Thousand Mountains.

chapters.title: Chapter 234 - 211: Vine Change
chapters.content:
Several days later, deep within the Ten Thousand Mountains, in a dense forest.
A leopard cloaked in coin-shaped patterns fled in terror, its four legs pounding across the forest floor, occasionally emitting angry roars.
This leopard was two to three Zhang long, with a sleek body and a powerful aura. Wherever it passed, birds and insects scattered in fright; it was unmistakably a second-level fierce beast.
There were no wounds on the leopard's body, but blood was continuously trickling from the corner of its mouth.
No matter how desperately the beast ran, the blood by its mouth flowed more profusely, its speed rapidly diminishing until it finally collapsed to the ground, never to move again.
Two hundred zhang away in a clump of grass, the air trembled gently, and a green silhouette slowly emerged—it was Yuan Ming.
He was draped in a gray cloak gifted by Xi Ying, which now took on a jade green color, completely blending with the surrounding environment.
Yuan Ming strode forward and soon arrived beside the carcass of the leopard.
This leopard, known as the Golden Patterned Leopard, was a second lower-rank fierce beast. Its combat ability was comparable to an early-stage Foundation Establishment cultivator. However, Yuan Ming had remotely controlled the Black Needle Magical Artifact from a distance, ambushing the beast's abdomen, piercing through its belly and entering its body, slashing the leopard's heart, liver, intestines, and lungs into a shattered mess.
The Golden Patterned Leopard met its bewildering end without even detecting the enemy's location.
Yuan Ming beckoned with his hand and the Black Needle Magical Artifact flew out from the leopard's mouth, landing in his palm.
Looking at the top-grade magical tool in his hand, thin as a hair, he nodded in satisfaction and stored it away.
He had spent several days refining the tool, making it more attuned to him. This trial confirmed it met his expectations.
Yuan Ming drew out the Cold Star Sword, carefully skinning the Golden Patterned Leopard's hide.
As a Gold Element fierce beast, its skin contained abundant Gold Attribute Spiritual Power, extremely sturdy yet lightweight and supple, suitable for refining into inner armor-class magic artifacts, and quite valuable.
As for the rest of the leopard's body, it was not worth much.
Yuan Ming stored the leopard skin and lightly tapped another Spiritual Beast Bag.
The Black Toad Spiritual Beast leapt out and, sensing the rich blood energy of the Golden Patterned Leopard, shot out several Purple-Black Demon Vines, quickly draining the leopard's corpse.
Read ahead and get updates at *.
The demonic power contained within the Golden Patterned Leopard's flesh and blood was quite different from that of the Black Toad, hence the toad's energy increased only slightly, and it lazily returned to Yuan Ming's side.
Yuan Ming's brows furrowed slightly, as the Black Toad had always been spirited and never so sluggish before.
Through the Beast Taming Rune inscribed in the Black Toad's Sea of Consciousness, he communicated with it but could not detect anything wrong. Thus, he stopped bothering about it and returned it to the Spiritual Beast Bag.
Yuan Ming then summoned the Green Cloud Crane and flew towards the outskirts of the Ten Thousand Mountains, no longer hunting beasts in the area.
Two days later, Yuan Ming arrived outside Snake King Valley.
Having experienced the devastating battle at Biluo Cave, facing powerful cultivators and hordes of beasts, he acutely felt his own insignificance, yet his vision had also expanded.
Now, his desire for advancement in cultivation had grown even more intense. With his preparations nearly complete, if he could break through the bottleneck, his cultivation and strength would take a qualitative leap.
Upon returning to Da Jin, he intended to settle accounts with certain individuals.
Breaking through to Foundation Establishment could take a considerable time; he needed to find a safe and secluded place. After much thought, the underground passage in Snake King Valley, which he had visited before, was the quietest and safest, an ideal spot for seclusion.
Although the valley was filled with dense miasma, deep underground it was much thinner, and with the assistance of the Obstacle Avoidance Pearl, it would not affect his cultivation.
Yuan Ming released three soul crows to thoroughly scout Snake King Valley. Only after confirming no one had passed by did he enter the valley and soon arrived at the underground passage beneath Snake King Cave, waving his hand to summon the Black Toad.
As soon as the Black Toad landed, excitement flickered in its eyes, and it rushed toward the depths of the passage.
Yuan Ming did not call it back, allowing it to disappear into the darkness ahead.
His reason for choosing this place for seclusion was not only for its tranquility but also because the Black Toad had previously absorbed the strange black air within the ancient tomb, significantly increasing its strength. He planned to continue letting the Black Toad absorb it to see how much it could improve.
Spirited as the Black Toad now appeared, it seemed to be untroubled; its previous sluggishness must have been a fluke.
Yuan Ming composed his mind, affixed the Four Directions Sealing Spirit Talisman onto the surrounding stone walls, and unfolded a Spiritual Power Barrier, completely isolating the thin miasma.
He sat cross-legged and ingested a Golden Flower Pill, cultivating to refine it.
As time passed, over a month quickly went by.
Within the underground passage, a burst of aqua light around Yuan Ming suddenly intensified, and his powerful aura rippled outwards in all directions, shaking the Barrier formed by the Four Directions Sealing Spirit Talisman.
He opened his eyes, a hint of joy on his face.
Through arduous cultivation, combined with the assistance of the Golden Flower Pill, the Nine Elements Technique had finally broken through to the Qi Refining Thirteen Layers.
The supply of Golden Flower Pills, which had already been running low, was now completely exhausted, but fortunately, the breakthrough was successful.
The Qi Refining Thirteen Layers differed significantly from the twelfth layer, with the Mana in his Dantian even more condensed, hinting at a tendency to liquefy.
The hallmark of a Foundation Establishment Cultivator was the liquefaction of Mana. Reaching the thirteen layers with the Nine Elements Technique indeed provided substantial assistance for Advancement to Foundation Establishment.
Yuan Ming did not pause but continued cycling the Nine Elements Technique to stabilize his realm.
After three days and nights, the Mana in his Dantian stabilized completely, and his Divine Soul was adjusted to an optimal state.
Yuan Ming took out a Foundation Establishment Pill and swallowed it, starting to cultivate and refine it.
The Foundation Establishment Pill was entirely different from the elixirs he had taken before; it took a long time to slowly dissolve with the cultivation.
Before long, a scorching sensation erupted from his lower abdomen, as if a fire had been lit within.
Yuan Ming had already determined the method for using the Foundation Establishment Pill, rotating the Nine Elements Technique and transferring this extremely hot medicinal power to his Dantian.
The use of the Foundation Establishment Pill was very simple, just directing the medicinal power into the Dantian would do. The scorching medicinal power would forge the mana repeatedly, like a hammer forging ore, until a breakthrough occurred.
This process was extremely lengthy, requiring half a month to yield results.
Yuan Ming closed his eyes and circulated his mana, coordinating with the play of the medicinal power of the Foundation Establishment Pill.
Ten days passed in the blink of an eye.
Yuan Ming opened his eyes and stopped cultivating, a bitter smile appearing on his face.
This attempt at Foundation Establishment had ended in failure; although his mana boiled and surged under the action of the medicinal power of the Foundation Establishment Pill, there was little tendency to liquefy, retreating every time it reached the critical threshold for breakthrough.
He wasn't surprised; with his Four Spirit Roots, cultivation during the Qi Refinement Realm could rely on the Nine Elements Technique and the massive amounts of elixirs he had obtained from various places for rapid progress. However, Foundation Establishment was different; the difficulty increased by more than tenfold, not something that a single Foundation Establishment Pill could easily overcome.
"It seems I need to find some additional auxiliary items," Yuan Ming thought to himself.
If he was somewhat confident before, this attempt gave him a deeper understanding. Although he still had two Foundation Establishment Pills, he decided not to try them without more than fifty percent certainty to avoid wasting them.
Of course, this unsuccessful attempt at Foundation Establishment wasn't without gain. The mana within his Dantian became even more robust and viscous, increasing his chances for a successful breakthrough into the Foundation Establishment Stage next time.
After failing to advance to Foundation Establishment, Yuan Ming had no intention of staying here. He telepathically communicated with the Black Toad, preparing to leave but received no response whatsoever.
Yuan Ming was puzzled and stood up to walk deeper into the passageway, quickly arriving at the ancient tomb in front.
Just like before, the Demon Vines inside the Black Toad spread out again, covering an even larger area than before, nearly swallowing the entire Stone Chamber. The purple-black vines and flowers were also larger and more numerous, an odd and ethereal fragrance wafting through the air.
The originally dim ancient tomb now seemed to have turned into a luxuriant garden.
Yuan Ming admired the strange and beautiful scene before him and was about to step forward when several vine bodies nearby sprang up like venomous snakes, poised to attack him.
Yuan Ming's expression grew grim as he lightning-fast grabbed a vine body, activating his Beast Taming Technique.
A thick black mist rolled out, pouring into the vine along the vine body, and stirring the Beast Taming Runes.
All the Demon Vines in the hall writhed in pain, quickly retracting.
Within a few breaths, except for the vine in Yuan Ming's hand, the Demon Vines in the hall had all disappeared, and the figure of the Black Toad revealed itself, having undergone a great change.
The Black Toad's originally plump body had become exceptionally shriveled, skeletal to the point of emaciation. Raised objects covered its entire body, at first glance seemingly its meridians. However, Yuan Ming could clearly sense that these raised objects were the Purple-Black Demon Vines.
The Purple-Black Demon Vines had been living symbiotically within the Black Toad. But now, the Demon Vines had begun to plunder the Black Toad's life force!
"Could it be because it absorbed the black mist?" Yuan Ming recalled how the Demon Vine had recently dared to attack him, feeling increasingly that something was amiss.
A spirit beast imprinted with a Beast Taming Rune wasn't foolproof and could go out of control, with several precedents in Biluo Cave's history of spirit beasts turning on their masters.
Yuan Ming originally thought that with his powerful Divine Soul and Beast Taming Technique, he could easily control the Demon Vine. Now, it seemed he had underestimated this Demon Vine!
However, as a major Beast Taming sect, Biluo Cave naturally had ways to deal with out-of-control spirit beasts.
Yuan Ming held onto the vine with one hand, continuously activating the Beast Taming Technique, while the other hand sliced open the skin on his fingertip, forming a seal in mid-air.
A stream of blood shot out, drifting and forming a blood-colored pattern as he made his seals in the air.
"Zha!"
Yuan Ming bellowed, the Blood-colored Rune flaring with light before turning into a stream of Blood Light that entered the Demon Vine, striking at its Beast Soul consciousness.
This rune was called the Blood Spirit Rune, which not only enhanced the power of the Beast Taming Technique but could also severely damage the Divine Soul of a spirit beast, preventing it from causing trouble.
The consciousness of the Purple-Black Demon Vine was heavily damaged, becoming weak and listless, the vine in Yuan Ming's hand drooping like a dead snake.
The Black Toad let out a miserable cry, flipped over, and collapsed, motionless.
Yuan Ming hurriedly crouched down to check on the Black Toad's condition; its consciousness was also very weak, now sinking into a deep sleep.
Not being particularly skilled in Beast Taming, Yuan Ming didn't know what to do in this situation. For the time being, he could only collect the Black Toad into the Spiritual Beast Bag and decide what to do after observing the situation for a while.
Several days later, in the afternoon.
In a tavern near the main street of Black Rock City, a young man with a somewhat delicate appearance sat drinking with a burly man by the window.
"Brother Wulu, talking about it really is a coincidence! You said you would come to Black Rock City in a few days, and strangely enough, I had just set foot in the city when I bumped right into you," the delicate young man said with a smile.
"This is called fate bringing people together from a thousand miles away! You see, I also ran into some troubles on the way, and after dealing with them, I was delayed. Come on, let's toast to our serendipitous meeting!" Wulu laughed heartily, clinking his glass with Yuan Ming's and downing it in one gulp.
Yuan Ming naturally had his suspicions about Wulu's explanation but kept his secluded cultivation a secret. The decision to come to Black Rock City was also impromptu; unless the other person could read his mind, it was impossible to know his itinerary.
"Perhaps it really is a coincidence?" Yuan Ming thought so, emptying the contents of his glass in one gulp.

chapters.title: Chapter 235 - 212 I am the Author
chapters.content:
"Speaking of which, Brother Yuan, your cultivation aura seems much more condensed. Could it be that you've made yet another breakthrough?" Wulu sized up Yuan Ming and said.
"I overestimated my abilities and took the Foundation Establishment Pill to attempt reaching the Foundation Establishment Stage, but alas, I nearly succeeded yet failed. Let's not talk about it. What are your plans next?" Yuan Ming sighed.
"I have some matters to handle, and will inevitably be busy for a while. We might not be together long and will soon part ways," Wulu said with a smile.
"It seems fortune has smiled upon you on this journey, Brother Wulu. You've made quite the haul!" Yuan Ming joked with a smile.
"It's mutual! What are you planning to do, Brother Yuan?" Wulu raised an eyebrow and smiled.
"I will stay in the city for a short while before planning to leave the Southern Border to return to Da Jin. From then on, you and I will be worlds apart; meeting again might not be easy," Yuan Ming explained.
"This mission in Biluo Cave wasn't short, and I'm also exhausted both physically and mentally. I plan to relax for a while. I intend to leave the Southern Border and check out the scenery in the north," Wulu said with a smile.
"You're going to Central Plains?" Yuan Ming asked, surprised.
"That's right. I've always been fascinated by those coastlines depicted in the tales of knights I read about, wanting to see for myself what's described as 'rocks shattering the clouds, waves splitting the shores, rolling up a thousand layers of snow'!" Wulu nodded.
"Brother Wulu prefers the raging waves crashing against the rocky shores rather than beaches with sunset and palm shadows. The south would not do; you should look towards the north side of the East Sea," Yuan Ming analyzed instinctively.
"I have a target in mind. Once I'm done here, I plan to visit Haiyan City in Yue Country. You're heading north back to Da Jin as well, why not travel together?" Wulu suggested.
Yuan Ming pondered for a moment, recalling that Haiyan City was located in Hua Continent of Yue Country, near the East Sea.
"I'll pass. Going through Yue Country on my way to Da Jin would involve a lengthy detour, not a good choice," Yuan Ming said.
"That's too bad," Wulu sighed.
"How long will you stay there, any plans to come to Da Jin?" Yuan Ming asked.
"Hard to say, the journey is long. Just reaching there may take months, and I might stay a bit longer afterward.
