The neighbors assumed that Shopkeeper Hu Tu's luck had taken a turn for the better, having connected with the powerful and gone to enjoy his good fortune.
Another two days later, escorted by a contingent of the Lord Mansion's trusted aides, the group from the Central Plains left Iron Tiger Town in a grand procession and headed back to Da Jin.
In the carriage surrounded by escorts, Hu Tu asked excitedly, "Am I really able to go to Da Jin?"
"That's how the Young Master has arranged it," Fu Qing, sitting opposite him, nodded and replied.
However, Yuan Ming himself was not actually part of this party.
Fu Qing had initially been firmly opposed to such an arrangement, but after a spar with Yuan Ming upon his insistence, he was soundly defeated and consequently had no choice but to agree to split up.
As for taking the Southern Border man with them, that too was Yuan Ming's plan.
In addition, Yuan Ming had given him a mission, which was to take the chronicle, "Young Master Sheng's Southern Journey," he had written, back to the Emperor.
The book would also be published through Tianming Book Society and distributed throughout the Central Plains and the Southern Border.
Moreover, Yuan Ming also wrote a secret letter and a map of the Southern Border territory charted based on Southern Border classics and his own travels, marking the locations and brief details of various clans and sects such as the Kasi Clan and Biluo Cave.
"The Young Master said he could take you to the borders of Da Jin, but he couldn't take you to the Capital," Fu Qing, aware of the special relationship between Hu Tu and Yuan Ming, treated him quite politely.
"This Yuan Ming… Young Master Yuan told me about it, I know," Hu Tu said somewhat constrainedly.
He had asked Yuan Ming the reason, and Yuan Ming only said "the Capital is unsafe" without further explanation.
Hu Tu naturally didn't mind; as long as he could leave the Southern Border and go to the longed-for Central Plains, that was all he cared about. As for the rest, it was naturally up to him to strive and fight for.
...
On the other side, Yuan Ming left Iron Tiger Town from another direction.
But Yuan Ming had barely left the town when he suddenly frowned, moving forward without a sound while a hair-thin Black Needle Magical Artifact shot silently from his sleeve and disappeared into the nearby jungle.
Immediately after, Yuan Ming turned around and said slowly, "The three of you, having followed me for so long, why not come out and meet?"
"Hehe, Young Master Yuan has such sharp Spiritual Sense, detecting us so quickly," a light sound followed as three figures stepped forward.
All three had the appearance of Central Plains people; the leader was an old man with a goat beard, with sunken cheeks making him look gaunt, but his eyes were exceptionally bright and piercing.
Behind him was a pair of young men and women; the woman was stout with a tall figure and dark skin. As for her looks, although not ugly, there was no gentleness typical of a woman, and she carried a small green bag at her waist, apparently a Spiritual Beast Bag.
As for the young man, he was handsome but with a touch of effeminacy.
The eyes of the young couple met from time to time, clearly indicating a deep relationship.
All three were dressed in the style of Da Jin and exuded Mana fluctuations.
Quietly extending his Divine Sense, Yuan Ming ascertained that the goat-bearded old man had a robust aura, a Foundation Establishment Cultivator, while the two behind him were at the peak of Qi Refinement Realm.
"Who are you three, and why follow me?" he asked.
"Young Master Yuan, please don't be alarmed; we mean you no harm. We are members of the Guangli Scatter Alliance of the Da Jin Cultivation World, entrusted by Emperor Jin himself to bring you home," the goat-bearded old man spoke.
The latest chapters are always available first on *.
"The Emperor sent you? Then why do you skulk around so?" Yuan Ming pictured the Emperor in his mind and asked.
"Emperor Jin is aware of the previous assassination attempt on the envoy group and also that General Yuan had sent people to the Southern Border. However, fearing that the enemy harbors persistent ill intentions and to ensure absolute safety, he instructed us to act clandestinely to safeguard your return to Da Jin without fail. If Young Master Yuan does not believe, please verify this item; this is a letter the Emperor has written to you," the old man with a goat beard took out an envelope sealed with wax and handed it over.
Yuan Ming used an Exorcism Technique, and the envelope floated towards him, hovering in midair.
Without touching the envelope, Yuan Ming flicked his fingers slightly, and it opened on its own, revealing a letter inside.
"Young Master Yuan's Exorcism Technique is so exquisitely used; even I am ashamed to admit inferiority," the goat-bearded old man praised.
"You flatter me," Yuan Ming responded modestly as he looked at the letter.
The handwriting on the letter was indeed that of the Emperor, and the content matched what the goat-bearded old man had said.
The letter also introduced the names of the three people: the goat-bearded old man was named Xu Changqing, the strong woman with dark skin was Liu Su, and the handsome young man was Lin Liumu.
"So it's Senior Xu, Fellow Daoist Lin, Fellow Daoist Liu. Recently, I have faced multiple dangers and had to be cautious, so my earlier offense was unintentional, please do not take it to heart," Yuan Ming bowed and said.
"It's only human nature, no harm done. What are your plans going forward, Young Master Yuan? Before his departure, Emperor Jin instructed that we three are to cooperate with you in your actions," Xu Changqing returned the gesture and asked.
"Since the three of you were tasked with bringing me back to Da Jin, you must have already considered strategies for our return. I would like to hear your opinions first," Yuan Ming pondered and replied with a question.
"Although it's still unclear who intended to harm you before, the enemy remains hidden, and we must be cautious. We have prepared two methods for returning to Da Jin, one is to use my Flying Artifact, which will take us directly back to Da Jin. Not to boast, but my artifact moves without a trace, and even Foundation Establishment Cultivators rarely catch up to it," Xu Changqing spoke confidently, as a glimmer of white light in his palm revealed a foot-long white Jade Shuttle, emitting wisps of white shimmering light.
"And the second method?" Yuan Ming looked at the Jade Shuttle and asked noncommittally.
"The second method involves blending into a merchant caravan. Fifty li east from here, in Green Cloud Town, there's a caravan from Da Jin preparing to return. I have some connections with the merchants traveling to and from Jin Country, and we can join them without anyone noticing. Under the cover of the caravan's numbers, we can return to Da Jin," Xu Changqing explained, looking towards the east.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming fell silent in contemplation.
"Young Master Yuan can take his time to consider, but it would be best for us to leave this place sooner rather than later. We cannot guarantee that there aren't any of the enemy's spies in Iron Tiger Town," Xu Changqing reminded.
At this moment, the four of them stood not far outside the town and indeed stood out with their Central Plains features.
"Very well, let's head toward Green Cloud Town for now. I'll carefully consider it on the way," Yuan Ming said.
Xu Changqing and the others had no objections.
The group of four set off towards the east and soon left Iron Tiger Town behind, with a range of rolling hills coming into view.
There were no paths here, but as cultivators, clambering over hills was nothing to them.
A brook flowed from upstream, its water exceptionally clear, seemingly from a mountain spring.
"This brook looks good. I'm a bit thirsty; let's get some water," Yuan Ming's eyes brightened as he stopped and said.
"Liu Su, you fetch the water," Xu Changqing told the muscular, dark-skinned woman.
Liu Su agreed and took a water bag towards the brook.
"I need to relieve myself," Yuan Ming added.
"Young Master Yuan, please feel free," Xu Changqing said with a restrained smile.
Yuan Ming stood up and walked towards the nearby woods, followed by Lin Liumu, who said, "I need to go too, let's go together."
Yuan Ming didn't refuse, and the two of them entered a clump of trees not too far away.
Yuan Ming looked up at the sky without unfastening his clothes.
"Aren't you going to relieve yourself, Young Master Yuan?" Lin Liumu asked, puzzled by his actions.
"That's not urgent. Since you're here to kill me, we are now far away from Iron Tiger Town, so it's about time you make your move," Yuan Ming suddenly said.
"What do you mean by that, Young Master Yuan?" Lin Liumu's face shifted slightly as he asked.
Yuan Ming just gazed at Lin Liumu, without saying a word.
Lin Liumu looked confused, clearly not understanding the implication of Yuan Ming's words.
At that moment, a rustling noise came from behind Lin Liumu, as if someone had stepped into the thicket.
"You! Why are you here?" Yuan Ming looked beyond Lin Liumu, his face dramatically altering as if he had seen an unbelievable person.
Startled, Lin Liumu involuntarily turned to look back, but the place was empty, with not even a shadow in sight.
Realizing the trick, he immediately turned around, only to find that Yuan Ming, who had just been standing there, had vanished without a trace. The dense shrubbery nearby quivered slightly.
Lin Liumu's expression drastically changed as he hurriedly pursued, but there was no sign of Yuan Ming anywhere to be seen, his presence completely gone.
"Yuan Ming has escaped!" Lin Liumu bellowed.
Whoosh! Whoosh!
Xu Changqing and Liu Su swiftly arrived.
"Where did he flee to? Can't even keep track of one person, what uselessness!" Liu Su glared at Lin Liumu, speaking irritably.
Lin Liumu's face flushed red, but he did not retort.
"A Qi Refining Stage cultivator can't escape my grasp. Let's search separately," Xu Changqing commanded sharply, his Divine Sense spreading out, but he could not sense Yuan Ming's whereabouts.
Liu Su and Lin Liumu also began scouring the forest, wielding their Magic Artifacts to sweep and slash around.
Bushes and grass were chopped and sent flying; the undergrowth was quickly destroyed by nearly half, yet Yuan Ming seemed to have truly disappeared, with no sign of movement.
Under a clump of low bushes, not too far away, Yuan Ming lay quietly in hiding, draped in a grey cloak gifted by Xi Ying, blending seamlessly with the surrounding greenery.
Xu Changqing's Spiritual Sense passed by several times without detecting anything amiss.
Yuan Ming's eyes flickered; a simple test had revealed the true intent of these three people.
Though the handwriting of the letter seemed authentic, he had been corresponding with the little Emperor since their youth. For fun, they established a code known only to the two of them: in the last sentence of a letter, randomly omit a stroke from one character. However, this letter contained none.
He knew then that there was something wrong with the three of them, but he pretended to be unaware, all to draw out their true motive.
Seeing how Xu Changqing and his team mercilessly upended the ground to find him, it was clear they were likely not there to escort him back to Da Jin but perhaps to kill and eliminate any trace of him.

chapters.title: Chapter 243 - 220: 1 vs 3
chapters.content:
Is this a follow-up to the previous assassination attempt or has there been a new crisis in Da Jin?
Yuan Ming's thoughts churned, a trace of chill flashed in his eyes as he quietly brought out the incense burner and lit a stick of poisonous incense.
Wisps of smoke rose and spread out close to the ground under his control, soon dissipating into the air and drifting towards Xu Changqing and his two companions.
The green pouch on Liu Su's waist suddenly bulged, emitting a gurgling sound.
"Someone is releasing poison gas! The source is that area, hold your breath quickly," Liu Su suddenly turned towards Yuan Ming's hiding place.
Yuan Ming displayed a look of surprise. His poisonous incense was colorless and odorless; how had this woman detected it? And she seemed to have pinpointed his hiding spot!
He did not stand up immediately, instead, he quickly extinguished the poisonous incense and switched to fog incense before lighting it.
Xu Changqing flew over at the sound, his hand flashed with gold light, already brandishing a golden curved sword, shaped like a snake with a forked tip resembling the heart of a venomous snake.
He pointed repeatedly into the void, the tip of the sword shining with dazzling golden light, as a dozen streaks of golden Sword Qi whistled out, striking the spot where Yuan Ming was hiding.
Yuan Ming could no longer hide and leaped up, brandishing the recently repaired Eight Diagrams Mirror in front of him.
With several loud "clangs," Yuan Ming was sent retreating several steps, both he and the mirror completely exposed.
Xu Changqing, wary of Yuan Ming's poisonous incense, stopped about seventy to eighty feet away, the golden snake sword flying out of his hand with a 'zing' directly aiming at Yuan Ming at high speed.
Yuan Ming, having clashed with early-stage Foundation Establishment cultivators before, had already figured out their casting speed. As soon as Xu Changqing began to move his hand, Yuan Ming activated his White Jade Belt and darted to the side, easily dodging the attack of the golden snake sword.
"Just hold your breath and protect your body with Mana, no need to be overly cautious," Liu Su shouted loudly, a layer of golden light appearing on her body as she dived from the other side.
A streak of green shadow flashed from the pouch at the woman's waist, and a strange green snake shot out, equipped with a pair of green meat wings on its back, enabling it to leap off the ground and flank Yuan Ming from the other side.
Lin Liumu's body radiated a green protective shield as he leaped behind Yuan Ming, blocking his last route of escape.
At that moment, a white fog suddenly arose in the dense forest, quickly thickening.
"What's going on?" The trio, including the well-informed Liu Su about poisons, all got startled, her face turning pale.
Yuan Ming took the opportunity to activate the White Jade Belt, also casting Wind Swift Skill and Shadowless Step, turning his body into three or four hard-to-distinguish afterimages that shot off in different directions.
Xu Changqing and his companions couldn't distinguish Yuan Ming's real body at the moment, and with the interference of the white fog, Yuan Ming easily broke through the encirclement and dashed towards the distance.
"We can't let him escape, chase him!" Xu Changqing's expression suddenly darkened, as a surge of white light rose under him, which turned out to be the White Jade Shuttle.
His body lifted off the ground, turning into a streak of white light that closely pursued Yuan Ming.
Liu Su and Lin Liumu also hurried to follow; without Flying Artifacts, they could only run on foot, quickly falling far behind.
The surrounding fog thickened, and Yuan Ming and Xu Changqing both disappeared into the distance ahead.
Seeing this, Liu Su and Lin Liumu urgently accelerated their pace.
Although Yuan Ming's movement technique was incredibly quick, compared to Xu Changqing's Flying Artifact, it was significantly inferior; the distance between the two men swiftly closed, rapidly reducing to just twenty feet.
At that moment, Yuan Ming ahead abruptly stopped his motion and lunged back like lightning.
Boom!
Four streams of differently colored radiance shot out from his sleeves, consisting of the Cold Star Sword, Nine-Ring Gold Saber, and Elder Mengshan's pair of Wushan Claws.
The four Magical Artifacts burst forth with powerful force, trailing beams of light behind them, and reached Xu Changqing in the blink of an eye.
Xu Changqing was startled, but being an early-stage Foundation Establishment cultivator, he reacted swiftly, immediately stopping and using his left hand to maneuver the golden snake sword to intercept the Cold Star Sword.
His right hand flashed with black light as a Black Needle Magical Artifact appeared out of nowhere. It quickly enlarged to the size of a table, colliding with the other three Magical Artifacts.
A series of intense clashes ensued—"boom" after "boom"— as the Cold Star Sword and the other three Magical Artifacts were all blocked.
Xu Changqing's eyes held a cold glow, his fingertips shining with intensified golden light as he formed a spell in the void.
The golden snake sword exploded with dazzling golden light, sweeping aside the Cold Star Sword and turned into a blurred golden shadow streaking directly towards Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming showed no panic--with a light wave of his right arm, a large White Ape figure appeared in front of him, the Heavenly Snake Master's corpse integrated with White Ape Skin, which abruptly reached out with both hands.
With a loud "clang," the golden snake sword suddenly stopped, shockingly grasped firmly by the White Ape's hands.
Xu Changqing was startled by the sudden appearance of the White Ape and hurriedly tried to motivate the golden snake sword, which struggled fiercely yet failed to break free.
Yuan Ming's lips curved into a cold smile, his right index finger lightly hooking.
A nearly invisible black needle shot from the white fog behind, swiftly and silently stabbing towards Xu Changqing's head.
Only when the black needle was two feet behind Xu Changqing did he abruptly awaken. He stretched his hands out to the left and right, his palms radiating a burst of blue light, instantly forming a spherical water-blue light shield around him.
Just as the light shield formed, the Black Needle Magical Artifact stuck into it. The small black needle suddenly erupted with a shocking mana fluctuation, fully demonstrating the power of a top-grade magical tool.
The ordinary Water attribute protective shield was not infused with much Mana by Xu Changqing, and with a single thrust, the Black Needle Magical Artifact punctured it.
The light shield went "bang" and shattered, dissipating into countless blue lights.
The Black Needle paused slightly, then continued to shoot out, thrusting toward Xu Changqing's back of the head.
But Xu Changqing needed just this moment of delay, he opened his mouth to spew out a chicken egg-sized golden orb, which swiftly flew behind him and barely blocked the Black Needle.
However, a shadow flitted over the Black Needle, and a black crow burst forth, bypassing the golden orb and striking towards Xu Changqing with alarming speed.
This time, Xu Changqing couldn't react in time, the black crow struck his forehead and disappeared.
The body of this Foundation Establishment Cultivator shuddered, and he froze in place, with several magic artifacts he was controlling coming to a halt as well.
Seizing the opportunity, the Black Needle shook off the golden orb, flashed, and pierced through Xu Changqing's back of the head, coming out his forehead and pulling a trail of blood.
The spirit light on Xu Changqing's body rapidly dimmed, and he fell from the Jade Shuttle Magical Artifact to the ground, motionless.
The Jade Shuttle, Golden Snake Sword, golden orb, and black inkstone among other magic artifacts lost their luster and fell to the ground with a clinking sound.
Yuan Ming's expression relaxed, he stowed the White Ape away, pulled out a Wood Attribute Spirit Stone to recover his Mana, and waved his hand to summon.
The White Jade Shuttle, Golden Snake Sword, golden orb, black inkstone, and Xu Changqing's storage magic tool flew over and landed in his hands.
Liu Su and Lin Liumu finally caught up at this moment, saw Xu Changqing's body on the ground, and their expressions drastically changed as they both stopped in their tracks.
"Now you two can tell me who sent you, right?" Yuan Ming looked at them and slowly said.
Fear appeared on the faces of Liu Su and Lin Liumu, and the next moment they fled in different directions.
Yuan Ming let out a small cold laugh and waved his hands left and right.
The Cold Star Sword and several other artifacts split into two groups, Wushan Claws chased Liu Su while the Cold Star Sword and Nine-Ring Gold Saber struck towards Lin Liumu.
A soul crow flew out of his forehead once more, entering the nearby Black Needle Magical Artifact, which also vanished in a flash.
This chapter was uploaded by the team at *.
Lin Liumu's movement techniques were sluggish, and he was quickly caught up by the Cold Star Sword and Nine-Ring Gold Saber, both of which lit up brilliantly as they chopped down from above.
Lin Liumu, with a face full of terror, mustered all his Mana to infuse it into the Flying Wheel Artifact.
The wheel, bursting with white light, grew ten times in stature upon meeting the wind, transforming into a gigantic white wheel, colliding with the two artifacts.
With two loud clangs, the great white wheel was cleaved away, and Lin Liumu's body also trembled sharply, falling heavily to the ground, his complexion pale from the shock.
A figure blurred behind him, and Yuan Ming materialized like a specter, his hand holding a human head-sized blazing red fireball, which was none other than the Burning Explosion Skill, it seemed he had already amassed a considerable amount of Mana.
"Go!" He flicked his wrist, and the blazing red fireball struck Lin Liumu's back.
In a panic, Lin Liumu hurriedly summoned a black Cloud Pocket Magical Artifact for protection, but before the black cloud could fully shield his body, the Burning Explosion Skill fireball had already struck him.
With a loud bang, an explosion erupted!
Bursts of red flames engulfed Lin Liumu's body, forming a scorching pillar of fire shooting several feet high, shaking the nearby ground intensely.
Lin Liumu's charred body flew out of the flames, crashing heavily to the ground with half his body gruesomely mangled, visibly breathing his last.
Yuan Ming appeared beside Lin Liumu, placed his right hand on his head, and began casting the Soul Searching Divine Ability, his palm emitting strands of crystalline light that quickly penetrated the other's head.
This was his first time conducting a Soul Search on someone else; the Soul Searching Crystal Light soon touched Lin Liumu's Divine Soul essence, revealing his memory scenes.
Moments later, Yuan Ming withdrew his hand, frowning.
Lin Liumu was not entirely sure about the details of the assassination either, he merely followed Xu Changqing's arrangements, knowing only that completing the task would reward him with a considerable amount of Spirit Stones.
However, from Lin Liumu's memories, Yuan Ming uncovered important information, that the trio including Xu Changqing were not members of the Guangli Alliance; they were cultivators from Da Jin Changchun Temple.
Having Da Jin Changchun Temple's cultivators chase after himself, this assassination attempt must have been significant and not something Lin Junsheng was capable of, right?
Lin Liumu, already gravely injured and further devastated by the Soul Search, finally breathed his last.
Yuan Ming stowed the white Flying Wheel and this man's storage magic tool, then dashed towards the direction Liu Su had fled to, soon arriving near a small puddle in the nearby woods.
Liu Su sat in the puddle, each of her legs bearing a deep, bone-deep claw wound, the surrounding flesh turned black and purple, swollen significantly.
This woman's lower abdomen showed traces of blood on her clothes, with a small bloody hole penetrating through her Dantian. Her Mana had completely dissipated.
The Wushan Claw and Black Needle Magical Artifact hovered in mid-air, slowly rotating.
Yuan Ming, through the soul crow within the Black Needle Magic Artifact, controlled the entirety of the battle.
Liu Su appeared to be an individual cultivator, her movement technique fast, and her fists were harder than steel, capable of resisting magic artifacts. Her strength was significantly stronger than Lin Liumu's; unfortunately, the Black Needle had advanced to a top-grade magical tool and was manipulated by the possessed soul crow, making it impossible for Liu Su to counter.
Taking advantage of Liu Su's distraction by the Wushan Claw's attack, the Black Needle launched a sneak attack from behind, striking her Dantian in one blow, dispersing her energy and rendering her powerless.
Yuan Ming gestured with his hand, drawing the Wushan Claw and Black Needle Magical Artifact back into his sleeve.
"Yuan... Yuan Ming Fellow Daoist, I was coerced by those two and didn't want to be your enemy. I am willing to reveal the name of the mastermind behind this if you spare my life," Liu Su saw Yuan Ming appear and desperately pleaded, trying to look pitiful.
But this woman was robust and sturdy. Her attempt to look pitiful only made Yuan Ming shudder. He composed himself before regaining his calm.
"Given the steadiness in your voice, it appears you are not seriously hurt; having your Mana dissipated yet still withstanding the Wushan Claw's venom is indeed beyond my expectations," Yuan Ming said slowly.

chapters.title: Chapter 244 - 221 Lin Junsheng
chapters.content:
"I make no secret from you, Fellow Daoist, that I have practiced a Body Refining Technique, which makes my physical body quite resilient, and my resistance to poison stronger than that of an ordinary cultivator," Liu Su said with a flattering expression, explaining.
"So, you are a Body Cultivator. No wonder you still attempt to counterattack despite the dire situation," Yuan Ming said as he stopped three yards away from Liu Su.
"What do you mean by that, Young Master Yuan? I sincerely intend to surrender, with no second thoughts," Liu Su hurriedly responded.
"Is that so?" Yuan Ming sneered and raised his hand, pointing a finger.
A stream of azure Sword Qi shot out, aiming at Liu Su's right arm.
Yuan Ming's Divine Sense was powerful, leaving no place hidden from his sight. The muscles there appeared calm, but in reality, every muscle was tensely charged, ready to launch a fierce attack at any moment.
Suddenly, Liu Su's expression turned as cold as water. Her tall figure sprang out from a puddle and easily dodged the azure Sword Qi, hurling herself at Yuan Ming like a cheetah, seemingly unaffected by the wounds and severe poison on her legs.
Yuan Ming was slightly startled, and his figure shot backward, while the Cold Star Sword and the Nine-Ring Gold Saber flashed and slashed at Liu Su in a crossing motion.
A flash of green from the spirit beast bag on Liu Su's waist, and a blue, strange snake leapt out, positioning its body in front of her.
With a "puth" sound, the blue snake was cut into three pieces, yet its head could still move and spat at Yuan Ming.
A cloud of green poison mist rolled out, instantly engulfing an area within several yards, rapidly turning all the plants and grasses within it yellow and withered.
Yuan Ming swiftly summoned the Shuiyun Banner to shield his entire body, keeping the poison mist out, while the Cold Star Sword slashed backward in mid-air.
A giant Sword Qi, about ten feet long, chopped the blue snake's head clean in two, killing it instantly.
However, a blurred figure swiftly streaked from the other side, arriving in an instant beside Yuan Ming. It was none other than Liu Su.
Her right arm suddenly enlarged, whirling with bulging blue veins on the surface, emitting a metallic luster akin to a Vajra Pestle, and struck fiercely on the Shuiyun Banner.
The Shuiyun Banner rippled like waves, dipping deeply, as Liu Su's fist hit Yuan Ming's chest.
With a "clang" sound, Yuan Ming, along with the banner, was knocked back, but a slender, silk-like needle shadow also flickered through the void, piercing through Liu Su's head.
The next moment, Liu Su suddenly shot forward, her right fist still aimed at delivering a fatal blow to Yuan Ming. Yet mid-air, her body abruptly froze, the look in her eyes swiftly faded, and her tall figure fell to the ground.
Yuan Ming's figure, having been smashed back several yards, barely touched the ground before he immediately leaped up.
The Shuiyun Banner "whooshed" open, revealing his silhouette.
Yuan Ming's expression was slightly pale, yet he appeared unharmed. His garments on his chest were scattered like tatters, revealing a set of golden inner armor made from Golden Flower Poison Python scales.
If not for this armor, his vital parts on his chest would have been directly hit, likely resulting in his death or severe injury.
The resilience of a Body Cultivator's physique was beyond his expectations, and even depleted of mana, they could still launch such a fierce counterattack, giving him a new understanding of their strength.
Yuan Ming soared and in a flash, appeared beside Liu Su's body, pressing his palm on her head as threads of crystal light seeped inside.
Liu Su's Divine Soul was on the verge of completely dissipating. He seized the last chance to Soul Search her, and moments later withdrew his hand, his expression grave.
Liu Su knew significantly more things than Lin Liumu did.
The assassins sent by Changchun Temple to kill Yuan Ming were only the three of them, but they had also anonymously hired the Guangli Scatter Alliance from Da Jin.
The members of the Guangli Scatter Alliance were currently lying in ambush on the road back to Da Jin, waiting for the right moment to strike, while Xu Changqing and the other two followed the guards sent by General Yuan to track Yuan Ming, who unexpectedly acted alone, leading them to take their chance and attack.
Regrettably, Xu Changqing, overconfident in his Foundation Establishment strength, underestimated Yuan Ming, resulting in their demise in a foreign land.
According to Liu Su's knowledge, the strength of the Guangli Scatter Alliance was not to be underestimated, containing as many as ten Foundation Establishment Cultivators. Though not all were deployed for this mission, the majority were involved.
Yuan Ming silently pondered for a moment, then removed Liu Su's storage magic tool, and using a storage bag, separately collected the bodies of the three. He summoned the Green Cloud Crane to fly away from the area.
After flying tens of miles, he found a secluded valley to land in and began inspecting the items obtained from Xu Changqing and the others.
He first picked up a white Jade Shuttle and, after a brief exploration with his Divine Sense, discovered it contained three runes, identifying it as a high-grade Flying Artifact.
Intrigued, Yuan Ming paused his inspection and tossed the Jade Shuttle forward, simultaneously casting a spell with a wave of his hand.
The Jade Shuttle hovered in front of him, slowly expanding until it was about ten feet long and half a foot wide.
Yuan Ming jumped onto it, channeling his mana from the soles of his feet into the Jade Shuttle.
The Jade Shuttle suddenly emitted a brilliant white light, transforming into a long rainbow shooting forward; everything around rapidly receded backward, incomparable even to spiritual birds like the green cloud cranes, but the consumption of mana was immense.
Yuan Ming secretly felt fortunate that he had previously killed Xu Changqing with lightning speed. Had his initial strike missed and allowed that man to escape with this magical artifact, it would have been impossible to catch up with the speed of a green cloud crane.
He maneuvered the Jade Shuttle back and forth, experiencing a speed he had never felt before, and played around for an hour before returning to the valley to continue examining Xu Changqing's possessions.
The golden hooked sword, the black inkstone, and the golden pearl were all mid-grade magical artifacts. The golden hooked sword was offensive, the black inkstone defensive, and the golden pearl was the most peculiar—an auxiliary magical artifact that could suddenly burst into dazzling golden light, blinding enemies and even causing temporary blindness, which could prove highly effective in certain situations.
This Xu Changqing, indeed a Foundation Establishment Cultivator from the Da Jin Changchun Temple, possessed belongings far surpassing those of his same-stage peers from the Southern Border.
Yuan Ming then inspected Xu Changqing's storage magic tool, which was also quite rich in contents, including nearly a thousand spirit stones, along with a green token, two white medicine bottles, a jade box, and a piece of paper.
One side of the token bore the three words "Chang Chun Temple," while the other side was inscribed with "Gu River," which seemed to be Xu Changqing's identity token.
However, his real name no longer mattered, as everything, following his demise today, would become bygones. As time passed, even the memory of such a Foundation Establishment Cultivator from Chang Chun Temple might be forgotten.
The world of Immortals is such cruel, and although their lifespan is longer than that of ordinary people, they are more easily forgotten.
Yuan Ming collected his thoughts and turned his attention to the two medicine bottles.
Contained within the jade bottles was a milky-white elixir, which from its aura, was identified as a Strengthening and Nourishing type. The rich medicinal scent was far superior to that of the Golden Flower Pill, and it should enhance the cultivation of a Foundation Establishment Cultivator considerably, deserving a high value.
As for the jade box, it was sealed with a silver talisman.
Yuan Ming spent some effort to break it open and found a piece of yellow wood inside, emanating a strange fragrance that invigorated the spirit and brought a sense of tranquility and peace to the soul.
The fragrance emitted by the yellow spirit wood seemed to have a unique effect on soothing the mind.
Yuan Ming could not identify the origin of the wood, but since he had begun learning incense making, he fostered a keen interest in various items related to incense making he encountered. Presuming this wood could be used in incense making, he carefully returned it to the jade box, reapplying the silver talisman.
He then opened the piece of paper, only to read: "Collect 500 spirit stones, deadline within three months, assassinate Jin's Yuan Ming, cancel the task if overdue, and additionally compensate three times the deposit. This serves as proof. Signed by Wu Xuming of Guangli Alliance."
The document was dated a month ago.
He then started inspecting the storage magic tools of Lin Liumu and Liu Su.
As Qi Refining Cultivators, the items in their storage tools far paled in comparison to those of Xu Changqing. Except for Lin Liumu's white flying wheel, all were low grade, with the total spirit stones amounting to only about five to six hundred. Other items like elixirs and spiritual materials were also of low grade, providing little use to Yuan Ming who was already at the Thirteenth Layer of Qi Refinement.
Yuan Ming put aside Liu Su's storage tool, playing with a copper bottle.
Over the past two years, he had continually used the Fur Cloak Skill, moderately strengthening his physical body; however, it was still far inferior when compared to Liu Su, a Body Cultivator.
Yuan Ming envied Liu Su's robust body, regretting that her storage tool did not contain the Body Refining Techniques she practiced. During the soul search, he also failed to find memories of her cultivation practice in time, only discovering a body refining elixir called "Copper Skin Pill" inside this copper bottle.
Enjoying the story? Find more at *.
The pill was meant to be used in conjunction with body refining techniques to make one's body as tough as ironstone, impervious to blades. Without the body refining technique, Yuan Ming dared not recklessly consume the pill and decided to store the copper bottle away, beginning to consider his next moves.
Considering the Guangli Scatter Alliance was ahead, returning directly from the Southern Border to Da Jin through the Northern Territory would significantly increase the risk.
Although he considered his strength unmatched in the Qi Refinement Realm and could even contend against an early-stage Foundation Establishment opponent like Xu Changqing, he was not so arrogant as to think he could face six or seven Foundation Establishment Cultivators. For now, it seemed he would have to find an alternative route.
"Who could be so determined to kill me?" Yuan Ming pondered for a moment, recalling certain figures in his mind.
He took out a piece of Black Incense and placed it in the incense burner, recalling Lin Junsheng's appearance and related memories as his consciousness was soon engulfed in darkness. When he awoke, he found himself in a room.
At that moment, Lin Junsheng was sitting cross-legged, forming hand gestures and running a cultivation technique.
Yuan Ming, experiencing Lin Junsheng's perspective, felt somewhat surprised—not because Lin Junsheng was cultivating, but because the scene before him was exceptionally clear, much clearer than any previous possession.
"What is going on now?"
Yuan Ming quickly thought of a possible reason: the Black Incense he used this time was newly made from the incense ashes of the City Lord Mansion; it seemed that different incense ashes yielded varying effects in possession.
He quickly composed himself. Since he couldn't control the other's body, he simply closely sensed the cultivation technique Lin Junsheng was running, and the next moment, he was stunned.
The technique Lin Junsheng was practicing felt eerily familiar, remarkably similar to the Nine Elements Technique. Could it be that this person had been accepted into Chang Chun Temple?
As the premier Cultivation Sect of Da Jin, Chang Chun Temple was extremely strict in accepting disciples. Even children of high-ranking officials had to possess adequate aptitude.
Yuan Ming faintly remembered that both he and Lin Junsheng, as youths, had once attempted to become disciples, yet despite having Spirit Roots, their talents were quite ordinary, and they were bluntly turned away. It was unexpected that over time, Lin Junsheng had been accepted into Chang Chun Temple.

chapters.title: Chapter 245 - 222 Youthful Loyalty
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming carried the doubts in his heart and carefully sensed Lin Junsheng's cultivation process.
The very next moment, he found that the feeling of Lin Junsheng's cultivation technique in operation, the flow of mana within the body through the meridians, and so on were much clearer than the sensations he had felt when he had possessed the little Emperor and experienced the Burning Explosion Skill.
Since the cultivation technique practiced by Lin Junsheng was very similar to the Nine Elements Technique, and Yuan Ming had mostly learned the Nine Elements Technique on his own, with no elder instructing him or sharing insights, this direct perception in comparison with his own experience of cultivating the Nine Elements Technique proved somewhat beneficial.
However, Yuan Ming's purpose in burning incense to possess Lin Junsheng this time was not for these matters but to investigate whether this person was involved in the recent assassination attempt on himself. Now, with Lin Junsheng sitting here motionless in cultivation, he could not find out anything.
Yuan Ming tried to influence Lin Junsheng, but although they seemed to be close at hand, they were also as if separated by a vast distance. No matter how he tried to channel his Soul Power or make other efforts, he could not affect the other party in the slightest.
A sense of helplessness welled up inside him.
All he could do at this moment was to share the other's field of vision and sensations.
"This must be the difference between the counterfeit Black Incense and the original Black Incense," Yuan Ming concluded after his attempts and had to give up reluctantly.
Not long after, his vision darkened once more, and his consciousness returned to his own body.
Yuan Ming opened his eyes and his brows slightly furrowed.
This time, the incense making used the same materials, only adding the incense ashes from the Lord Mansion. Although the feeling of possession was clearer than before, the duration was much the same. It seems this was all due to the use of different incense ashes.
The incense burner could not be used again for seven days. It was impossible to uncover the truth behind the assassination in the short term, and changing his following travel plans had become inevitable.
Yuan Ming took out a Beast Skin. It was a map of the Southern Border he had drawn based on the information he had gathered. Without returning to Central Earth through the Northern Territory, his only options were detouring through the Eastern Domain or the Western Region.
The Southern Border and Western Regions have always been mysterious, said to be controlled by a large Cultivation force with religious overtones, highly xenophobic, barely interacting with the other three regions, and strictly forbidding Cultivators from other places from entering the Western Region.
Yuan Ming's gaze landed on the Eastern Domain of the Southern Border marked on the Beast Skin map. At the moment, that seemed to be the only way to go.
After a short contemplation, he took out a somewhat dirty Token from his Storage Ring.
This item was given to him by Immortal Xuanhua when he purchased the Qingxuan Incense at the Black Rock City Market. The man had claimed to be from the Eastern Domain's Xuanhua Temple and said if Yuan Ming ever passed by the Eastern Domain, he could drop by for a visit.
He hadn't taken the man's words seriously at the time, but he kept the Token in his Storage Ring as it didn't take up much space.
However, as the combined effects of the Qingxuan Incense and elixirs during his cultivation and his deepening exploration into various Spirit Incenses, he had to re-evaluate this cultivation item that was not highly regarded in the Northern Territory.
Yuan Ming had many things he wanted to do, and he would not have made a special trip to the Eastern Domain if it were not absolutely necessary. However, the current situation forced him to take such a trip, and it coincidentally provided an opportunity to ask that old Taoist priest for guidance on Incense Making.
With this in mind, he roughly planned out the route on the Beast Skin map and then rode his white Jade Shuttle out of the valley towards the East.
The area of the Southern Border and Northern Territory was vast. Although the white Jade Shuttle was quite fast for travel, it consumed a lot of mana. The Green Cloud Crane did not require as much mana to operate, but had insufficient endurance. Yuan Ming alternated between the two, traveling almost day and night, and it still took him a full five days to reach the border of the Northern Territory.
Although the Southern Border Eastern Domain was not as closed off as the Western Region, it was feared that entering rashly, especially by flying, would easily draw the attention of the Cultivation World in this area and cause unnecessary trouble.
Yuan Ming hoped to keep a low profile, and he easily entered the Eastern Domain by blending in with the ordinary merchants and civilians.
For a smoother reading experience, visit MV&LEMPYR.
The Eastern Domain was coastal, and the human cities there were generally wealthier than those in the Northern Territory. The people also lived more peacefully. Yuan Ming walked on foot, immersing himself in the simple and natural world of ordinary people, which eased his tension considerably.
In the blink of an eye, three days passed uneventfully.
Yuan Ming then relaxed a little and continued on his way as planned on the Jade Shuttle.
Half a day later, a towering Green Mountain appeared in front, its aura filled with a rich Spiritual Energy, making it an excellent place for cultivation.
Such a prime cultivation location was generally occupied by a Cultivation Sect. Yuan Ming was about to divert his path when he suddenly stopped his tunneling light and looked towards the top of the mountain.
From this vantage point, he could vaguely make out the situation at the peak, where many buildings were in a state of disrepair, presenting a desolate scene devoid of human presence.
He was somewhat puzzled and controlled the Jade Shuttle to quickly approach the mountain.
Closer now, the condition of the Green Mountain became clearer.
Both the peak and the mid-mountain were dotted with buildings that looked like they had once belonged to a not-so-small Cultivation Sect. They were now ruined walls covered with moss and cob
Yuan Ming's expression suddenly changed as he looked towards a dilapidated hall halfway up the mountain.
This place seemed to be a shrine, where a desk in the nearly collapsed corner was haphazardly covered with several ancestral tablets inscribed with the names of cultivators.
The site had clearly been long neglected; the offering table and ancestral tablets were covered with a thick layer of dust, and there was only half a portrait left on the wall behind the desk, barely discernible as an elderly immortal with a noble demeanor.
Yuan Ming's gaze shifted, and he quickly walked towards the collapsed corner, bent over to move some broken bricks and tiles, and revealed an ancient bronze incense burner leaning against a piece of wood, filled with a considerable amount of grey-black incense ashes.
He looked at the incense burner before him, his mind racing with thoughts.
The previous possession experience had made Yuan Ming realize that black incense made from different incense ashes had slightly different effects on possession. The incense burner was his greatest aid, and if he could figure out the specific details of how the incense ashes influenced the effect of possession, it would be a major breakthrough in uncovering the mysteries of the original black incense.
Yuan Ming took some incense ashes and found a secluded place in the Green Mountain to begin making incense.
His incense-making skills had become quite proficient; he quickly finished crafting a stick of Possession Black Incense.
The Tai Chi pattern on the incense burner was now fully lit, and Yuan Ming inserted the stick of incense into it and ignited it.
Images of Lin Junsheng, the little Emperor, and his father General Yuan flashed through his mind, but in the end, he focused on his father, and darkness soon enveloped his vision.
When he regained consciousness, he was already inhabiting General Yuan's body.
At this moment, General Yuan was seated in a carriage, eyes closed in meditation, appearing to have just returned home from court.
Yuan Ming found his father's inner condition was very clear — the flow of mana within was vividly presented in his mind, even clearer than when he possessed Lin Junsheng, almost as if he was examining the lines on his palm.
"It seems that different incense ashes indeed produce different effects, the ashes from Liu Xin Sect seem to be a bit more effective than what I got from Iron Tiger Town," Yuan Ming had anticipated this and was not surprised.
The carriage soon arrived at General Mansion, and General Yuan changed into casual clothes and quickly entered a side room in the wing.
A beautiful woman in her forties, wearing white, was sitting alone in the room. She had a blue jade hairpin on her head and a snow-white fur coat draped over her shoulders. Her eyebrows curved like crescent moons, faint as distant mountains, and she exuded a demeanor of extreme grace and propriety.
Yuan Ming looked at the woman before him and felt an indescribable rush of emotions; she was the wife of General Yuan, his mother.
Compared with the memory lodged in his mind, lines had formed at the corners of her eyes, and strands of silver could now be seen amidst the black hair at her temples.
"My lady, your cold hasn't improved yet; why have you come out?" asked General Yuan.
Yuan Ming tensed up, his mother was sick with a cold? Indeed, her complexion did not look very good.
A cold could be minor or serious and should not be taken lightly. It was a pity that he was not home; otherwise, he would have definitely examined his mother's pulse.
No sooner had this thought formed when General Yuan suddenly moved forward and took hold of the white-clothed woman's wrist.
"It's just a minor ailment... Why are you holding my hand? You know nothing of medicine!" the woman in white asked in surprise.
"It's nothing..." General Yuan was taken aback and released her hand, then sat down on a nearby chair, somewhat baffled.
He did not understand why he had taken hold of his wife's wrist; it was as if the strange thought had suddenly arisen in his mind.
Yuan Ming was also stunned; what just happened? Could his thoughts have influenced his father's actions?
"Is there any news of Ming'er?" the woman in white did not mind the General's odd behavior and asked.
"Rest assured, we have found him," a trace of a smile appeared on General Yuan's stern face.
"Really?" The woman in white stood up involuntarily, her voice filled with surprise and delight.
"Absolutely true. And Ming'er has even turned misfortune into a blessing by joining a Sect in the Southern Border to practice cultivation, becoming a person of the Immortal Path," General Yuan said.
"As long as he is safe! Ming'er, that stubborn child, once wanted to join Chang Chun Temple, but they didn't accept him due to his lacking talents. His pride wounded, he swore off entering the Immortal Path in a fit of anger. But I knew in his heart he must have been unwilling to accept that. Now it seems his wish has been fulfilled," the woman in white sighed in relief.
"Although Ming'er is now a cultivator, his cultivation is still shallow, and traveling from the Southern Border to Da Jin is a long journey. I have sent someone to fetch him; I believe he will return home soon," said General Yuan.
Yuan Ming's thoughts stirred; it seemed that General Yuan was unaware that he had not traveled with the guards sent to him. It appeared that the Southern Border was too far from Da Jin Capital, and there was not a convenient means of communication like talismans between them.
He shook his head, his thoughts returning to the incident just before.
Apart from the incense burner's built-in black incense, which could directly control someone's actions, whenever he possessed someone using his own crafted spirit incense, he had always been just an "onlooker" experiencing it firsthand; he had never influenced the actions of the possessed. Even when he possessed Lin Junsheng seven days ago, he had tried to influence the latter, but to no avail.

chapters.title: Chapter 246 - 223: Thoughts
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming pondered for a moment and decided to try again, focusing his thoughts on his father, repeatedly recalling in his mind, "Turn your head back, turn your head back..."
Having just sat down next to the beautiful woman in white after speaking, General Yuan picked up a cup of water to drink when he suddenly turned his head backward.
"Good, I'll immediately have Wang Shun take people to clean Ming'er's courtyard thoroughly again. Our family can finally be together. Hmm, what are you looking back at?" The woman in white, happy at the corners of her brows, saw General Yuan's action and asked with a frown.
"Did I look back..." General Yuan froze, realizing he had indeed turned his head back, his mind suddenly a bit confused.
"I'm talking to you about Ming'er's matter, can you concentrate!" The woman in white's expression darkened as she spoke.
"Understood, understood..." General Yuan, baffled and facing his wife's roar, quickly put down his teacup and nodded repeatedly.
Watching this scene, Yuan Ming felt a slight apology toward his father while simultaneously feeling surprise and delight. He could really influence his father's actions—could this also be caused by the incense ashes from the Liu Xin Sect?
"Ming'er has been missing for so long, the Emperor is also very worried. You should quickly send him this news to put his mind at ease," the woman in white continued their conversation.
"I have already sent people to pass on the message," General Yuan said.
"These two kids really... When Ming'er was initially rejected by the Chang Chun Temple and swore off the Immortal Path, the Emperor also decided not to pursue it. They are two stubborn and loyal kids," the woman in white recalled some past events, her expression becoming gentle.
"The Emperor has his own difficulties. His decision to not cultivate might not be entirely because of Ming'er. Once he enters the Foundation Establishment Stage, he'd have to abdicate to let a more virtuous person rule. The Emperor has yet to marry and has no offspring; once he abdicates, his lineage would likely be out of the succession," General Yuan said slowly as he picked up a cup of tea and began to drink.
Hearing this, Yuan Ming was taken aback; this was his first time learning that such a rule existed within the Da Jin Imperial Family.
"What of it? Thrones and powers are mere clouds passing by. Even if one sits at the pinnacle of glory, it ends up as a cup of loess a hundred years later. Only by cultivating to become an immortal does one hope to live as long as heaven and earth," the woman in white said.
"What Madam says is true. The Emperor has recently been absorbed in cultivation and has not been managing state affairs, leading to increasingly fierce power struggles in the court, which disturb me and halt any progress in my own cultivation," General Yuan remarked.
"Pursuing the Immortal Path is good, but having offspring is equally important. I've heard that reaching a high realm in cultivation makes having children very difficult. Should we arrange a marriage for Ming'er when he returns?" asked the woman in white, hesitating briefly.Findthesourceofthischapterat*.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming inwardly gave a wry smile.
His mother had always been arranging his matrimonial matters, having started looking for a wife for him before his mission to the Southern Border, and now she was thinking about it again.
"The worries of a mother for her child traveling a thousand miles," he thought. His disappearance had caused her endless worry, and now that she knew he was safe, she started thinking about this matter again.
Yuan Ming only wanted to focus on his cultivation and had no intention of marrying.
He used his thoughts to influence his father to oppose his mother's suggestion.
"Ming'er is still young; there seems to be no rush for him to marry," General Yuan indeed said what was on his mind.
Yuan Ming was overjoyed inside; the feeling of controlling others with his thoughts was truly gratifying and fun.
With this ability, the things he could do by possessing others in the future were boundless.
"What kind of words are these coming from a father? We cannot delay matters of marriage. I think the Prime Minister's younger daughter Lou Lan is quite suitable; she and Ming'er are childhood sweethearts, and I heard she also has a Spirit Root. Shall I send someone to inquire soon?" the woman in white, excited, chided her husband.
"Madam, please stop trying to matchmake. Ming'er has told me that Lou Lan from the Prime Minister's family has been devoted to the Emperor for many years; Ming'er and her are not suitable. Moreover, due to the Emperor neglecting his duties, the current court relations are complex—it's not a good time for Ming'er to marry. Let's discuss this matter later," General Yuan said with some concern.
Seeing her husband's serious expression, the woman in white did not pursue the matter further.
Yuan Ming, seeing his mother give up, also breathed a sigh of relief.
General Yuan and the woman in white then shifted to discussing some trivial family matters. Yuan Ming, feeling playful, continued to influence his father to interject with jokes, earning a good scolding from his mother.
Yuan Ming, watching his normally imposing and always stern father getting scolded, secretly chuckled to himself.
"Oh no, I got carried away with playing and forgot the purpose of this possession!" he reprimanded himself, attempting to use his thoughts to make his father discuss the assassination matter with his mother.
However, General Yuan showed no reaction this time and continued chatting about household affairs with his mother.
Yuan Ming frowned, wondering why it didn't work this time.
At that moment, darkness suddenly enveloped his vision—it was time for the possession to end, and when he awoke, his consciousness had returned to his own body.
Yuan Ming furrowed his brows in thought, pondering why his attempt to make his father discuss the assassination had failed.
After much contemplation, he realized a possibility: his father simply didn't know about the people from Chang Chun Temple coming to assassinate Yuan Ming.
Something his father was completely unaware of was naturally impossible for him to act upon.
"It seems that influencing the possessed with one's consciousness can't accomplish just anything," Yuan Ming thought to himself. What he could achieve would have to be tested in future possessions.
Yuan Ming's gaze shifted to the remaining incense ashes in his hands.
The sudden ability during the possession to influence his father was likely connected to these incense ashes.
He had been trying to use incense ashes for making incense for some time and gradually came to understand some things: the reason incense ashes could create magical spices was because they were transformed by the prayers and worship of people, initiating a peculiar change beyond his comprehension.
It was this peculiar change that made the spices made from incense ashes have miraculous effects.
Originally, according to Yuan Ming's conjecture, the more people who worshiped, the stronger this peculiar change would be, and the better the effect of the Black Incense possession.
However, the two recent possessions made him doubt whether this conjecture was valid.
As you know, the only worshipers in Iron Tiger Town were the Lord and his kin, whose numbers couldn't possibly exceed those of the incense burners at Jiuli Temple.
As for the Liu Xin Sect before him, it appeared not large in scale, even smaller than Biluo Cave, and the number of disciples could not possibly exceed the unending stream of incense burners at Jiuli Temple every day.
"Could it be because the incense tributors at Jiuli Temple are all mortals? There are cultivators at the Lord Mansion in Iron Tiger Town, and even more so, all the worshipers within the Liu Xin Sect are cultivators, hence the possession effect is the best?" Yuan Ming suddenly had this thought.
"Speaking of which, although the Liu Xin Sect has declined over the years, the accumulation of ash in this incense burner must be due to the accumulation over the years. The number of people who offered tributes in the past might not match Jiuli Temple, but perhaps the disciples' devout faith in the sect was much stronger."
Whether it was the previous conjectures or the current thought, they were preliminary speculations and would need to be slowly verified in the future.
Yuan Ming stood up, removed all the incense ashes from the incense burner, and left the Green Mountain, continuing towards the Eastern Domain.
A few days later, in a small city in the Eastern Domain, within a room at an inn, Yuan Ming sat cross-legged, scanning through several thick classics.
These were collected from the city, containing geographical and cultural records of the Eastern Domain.
Immortal Xuanhua had not told him where Xuanhua Temple was located, so Yuan Ming had to keep traveling while conducting his investigation.
After several days, he had not found Xuanhua Temple but had instead deepened his understanding of the Southern Border Eastern Domain.
The cultivation forces here in the Eastern Domain were similar to the Five Great Sects of the North Territory earlier, with four leading forces nearly managing the entire Eastern Domain cultivation world, one of which was indeed White Dragon Island.
These four major sects were powerful, and their actions were quite domineering. All the small to medium cultivation sects in the Eastern Domain were essentially vassals to these four forces.
Xuanhua Temple naturally did not belong to any of the four major sects; based on his conjectures, it was probably just one of the less famous, smaller sects.
However, there were significant differences in the secular aspects between the two regions.
The Eastern Domain did not divide power territories by families, but rather, the concept of a nation was stronger, likely influenced by the concepts from the Central Plains.
The country where Yuan Ming was currently located was called "Lie Country," which was considered a fairly large nation in the Southern Border Eastern Domain.
The books he was reading described the geography and famous landscapes of Lie Country, but unfortunately, even after reading to the end, he still could not find any trace of Xuanhua Temple.
Yuan Ming didn't mind. He picked up another book and continued reading.
He had his own methods to find Immortal Xuanhua; he just needed to wait a little longer.
Half a day later, Yuan Ming set aside the book in his hand, summoned the incense burner, and the Tai Chi pattern at the base of the burner was once again fully lit.
He deftly took out a stick of Black Incense, which was also made with Liu Xin Sect's incense ashes, and lit it in the incense burner.
Yuan Ming recalled the figure of Immortal Xuanhua in his mind, and his field of vision soon plunged into darkness.
When Yuan Ming's consciousness awakened, a dim stone chamber appeared before him, where Immortal Xuanhua was sitting, closed-eyed and cultivating.
Seeing this scene, Yuan Ming did not act rashly.
This time, possessing Immortal Xuanhua, he naturally wanted to figure out his location. Surprisingly, this person was also hidden in a secret chamber cultivating. Influencing him with intent might cause him to stand up, but that would disturb Immortal Xuanhua's cultivation.
Yuan Ming first observed the surroundings of the stone chamber. On the left side of Immortal Xuanhua, there was an incense burner, into which a purple Spirit Incense was inserted, emitting curling spirit smoke, seemingly similar to Qingxuan Incense, which could accelerate cultivation.
On the ground to his left was another incense burner, with a purple Spirit Incense emitting curling spirit smoke inside, seemingly a spirit incense similar to Qingxuan.
To the right side against the wall was a wide stone table, laden with a dazzling array of tools.
Ordinary people might not understand the uses of these tools, but Yuan Ming could tell that these were all tools for making incense, much more refined than the set of tools he had.
Yuan Ming carefully observed the surroundings, trying to deduce Immortal Xuanhua's location from some details. Unfortunately, the stone chamber was very ordinary, without any extra decorations, giving him no clues to work with.
"Well, if it causes a disturbance, so be it." He helplessly used his intent to influence Immortal Xuanhua, attempting to make him stand up and leave the stone chamber.
There was a slight ripple in Immortal Xuanhua's Sea of Consciousness, but it soon returned to calm, and his body continued to cultivate with closed eyes.
Yuan Ming inwardly smiled bitterly; it seemed that influencing Immortal Xuanhua was much more difficult than influencing his father.
This was normal; after the possession, he could sense the Divine Soul Power of both, and Immortal Xuanhua was indeed much stronger than his father.
Moreover, that purple Spirit Incense, besides accelerating cultivation, also stabilized the mind, reducing the impact of his intent to some extent.

chapters.title: Chapter 247 - 224: Living Up to the Name
chapters.content:
"It seems like influencing others with one's thoughts does have many limitations," Yuan Ming thought to himself.
However, he did not give up and continued to try to influence Immortal Xuanhua over and over again, while also sensing the progress of Immortal Xuanhua's cultivation.
Immortal Xuanhua's cultivation had also reached the Qi Refining Peak, but the cultivation technique he practiced was quite mediocre. It was only with the help of the purple Spirit Incense beside him that he could barely absorb spiritual power at the pace of the Biluo Skill.
Yuan Ming discovered that the purple Spirit Incense's effect on assisting cultivation was much better than that of the Qingxuan Incense, but he did not know what it was called?
If he could meet Immortal Xuanhua this time, he would definitely try to buy some. Of course, if he could find a way to get the refining method, that would be even better.
Under Yuan Ming's repeated influence, the ripples in Immortal Xuanhua's Sea of Consciousness became more and more intense, and soon he stopped cultivating and stood up.
However, Immortal Xuanhua did not leave the Stone Chamber but took out an old Beast Skin Book to browse, apparently trying to calm his mind.
Yuan Ming thought to himself that it seemed Immortal Xuanhua had strong willpower, and it was not easy to affect his state of mind.
He wasn't in a hurry and continued to exert the influence on Immortal Xuanhua to leave the Stone Chamber. His attention also shifted to the Beast Skin Book, and he immediately felt elated and stopped manipulating Immortal Xuanhua with his thoughts.
This Beast Skin Book was a classic on Incense Making, recording the methods for making various Spirit Incenses.
Immortal Xuanhua flipped through the pages quickly, and soon his gaze stopped at a certain spot.
Yuan Ming hastily focused his gaze there. The two pages recorded the methods for making three types of Spirit Incense, named "Purple Mysterious Incense," "Red Butterfly Fragrance," and "Seven-step Immovable."
According to the description, he found that the "Purple Mysterious Incense" was indeed the purple Spirit Incense lit inside the room, which had a more significant effect in assisting cultivation.
He guessed that the Qingxuan Incense that Immortal Xuanhua brought out to sell must be the least powerful among this kind of cultivation-assisting Spirit Incense, and there were probably better ones than this Purple Mysterious Incense.
"Red Butterfly Fragrance" is a tracking Spirit Incense, as long as it clings to a target, there's no washing or changing clothes that could remove it.
This incense itself is odorless and must be combined with another special potion, applied inside the nostrils. The two combined can then detect a special scent, making tracking both secretive and convenient.
As for "Seven-step Immovable," he didn't need to read the introduction to know it was a type of seductive scent. Once an enemy was affected by it, they would fall to the ground after taking only seven steps. It was somewhat similar to the Poisonous Incense Yuan Ming had stumbled upon on his own, only more effective.
The materials and steps required to make these three types of Spirit Incense were quite intricate. Yuan Ming's own incense-making seemed rudimentary by comparison.
"This is what real Spirit Incense is all about," Yuan Ming couldn't help but sigh, then focused on memorizing the methods.
With his photographic memory, he quickly memorized the methods of making the three types of Spirit Incense, and then he tried to influence Immortal Xuanhua through his thoughts to continue browsing, hoping to see a few more Spirit Incense formulas.
However, Immortal Xuanhua's gaze was fixed on the method for making Purple Mysterious Incense, pondering its essence. His focus was so intense that Yuan Ming's influence had no effect.
He soon put down the Beast Skin Book and went to an incense-making platform nearby, taking out various materials and beginning preparations. From the materials he had taken out, it seemed that he intended to create "Purple Mysterious Incense."
"When I previously possessed the emperor and borrowed his enlightenment during his spell practice, I learned the Burning Explosion Skill in no time. I wonder if comprehending his incense-making would yield a similar effect?" Yuan Ming pondered.
At this moment, Immortal Xuanhua had already prepared the preliminary work and began making incense. Yuan Ming watched intently.
Quite some time had passed since this possession, and he was a bit anxious internally, silently praying that he could watch the entire process.
Because the method for making Purple Mysterious Incense wasn't simple. It required not only ordinary incense-making skills but also the coordination of mana, blending many spiritual materials into one, which was far more challenging than making Black Incense. Although he had memorized the method, actually doing it would undoubtedly take time to try. If he could directly experience it intuitively this time, it would make future attempts much more efficient.
Fortunately, Immortal Xuanhua was clearly proficient in making Purple Mysterious Incense and quickly completed one stick. Yuan Ming also experienced the production process of Purple Mysterious Incense as if he was there himself.
Just as Immortal Xuanhua finished making the Purple Mysterious Incense and had yet to try it, Yuan Ming's time for possession ended, and he returned to his own body in a daze.
"Speaking of which, learning to make incense through possession is not a bad method. It's a pity it can only be done once every seven days, and the other party may not be making incense." Yuan Ming closed his eyes and recalled the making of Purple Mysterious Incense. It felt extremely familiar as if he had made hundreds of them already, understanding every detail of each step thoroughly.
Yet, this sensation was somewhat intangible, and he would need to try making Purple Mysterious Incense himself to have a deeper understanding.
Thinking so, Yuan Ming got up from his room in the inn and headed towards the south of the city.
He had been in this small city for two days and learned that fifty li to the south, there was a small workshop where much could be purchased.
Half a day later, he returned to the inn, locked the door, and waved his hand over the table.
A flash of white light swept across, and seven or eight pieces of spiritual materials appeared on the table, precisely the ingredients for Purple Mysterious Incense.
Yuan Ming took out his incense making tools and once again carefully recalled the entire process of how Immortal Xuanhua made the Purple Mysterious Incense before he began to make his own.
Before long, he had in his hand a stick of purple incense, the color and scent of which were nearly identical to the one produced by Immortal Xuanhua.
Yuan Ming took out an ordinary incense burner, lit the Purple Mysterious Incense, and then circulated the Nine Elements Technique to test its effects.
After a short while, he opened his eyes.
The Purple Mysterious Incense's efficacy in aiding cultivation was slightly less than that of Immortal Xuanhua's, but it was much better than the Qingxuan Incense, without a doubt a successfully made Spirit Incense.
Yuan Ming's cheeks flushed with excitement. That he had succeeded in making Purple Mysterious Incense on his first try suggested that his earlier guess was correct; the possession ability of the incense burner could help him learn spells, and similarly help him grasp incense making quickly, though of course, a bit of luck was needed too.
Thinking deeper, skills like alchemy, artifact refining, drawing talismans, and arrays could also be swiftly learned using the incense burner's possession ability.
The name of this incense burner was indeed befitting, for while others toiled a lifetime for their achievements, the incense burner could easily steal them, truly worthy of being called the "Stealing Heaven Tripod."
Yuan Ming got up and paced around the room. After a long while, he calmed down.
Although the ability of the Stealing Heaven Tripod was astonishing, he always felt that he had not yet truly mastered this treasure and needed some time to slowly explore the intricacies contained within.
What was most troubling him at the moment was ensuring he had truly evaded the pursuit of the Guangli Alliance and that he could safely return to Da Jin.
"If I could break through to the Foundation Establishment Stage, many problems could be readily solved. Unfortunately, I don't have much confidence yet," he thought.
With this in mind, Yuan Ming went to his desk and continued making Purple Mysterious Incense.
In the following days, he stayed in the small city, making Purple Mysterious Incense during the day and continuing to cultivate the fourth layer of the Moonlight Technique at night.
Seven days later, the incense burner was restored.L+ove t$h$i-s s!to@ry?+ S.how sup.p%o*rt at *.$
Yuan Ming lit the Black Incense without delay, possessing Immortal Xuanhua once again.
To his surprise, Immortal Xuanhua was still in that dimly lit secret chamber making incense, only this time it was not "Purple Mysterious Incense," but "Seven-step Immovable."
Yuan Ming naturally assumed the role of an apprentice and observed the making of "Seven-step Immovable" from the most direct perspective.
Immortal Xuanhua was adept at making "Seven-step Immovable," seemingly pondering something while casually producing them, and in just a quarter of an hour had already made two sticks.
Having witnessed the full process twice, Yuan Ming's understanding of the making of "Seven-step Immovable" surpassed that of the "Purple Mysterious Incense." He began to consider that after this possession ended, he would head to the workshop to purchase the materials and try his hand at it.
Immortal Xuanhua did not continue to make a third "Seven-step Immovable" but instead fell silent for a while before taking out the Beast Skin Book. He turned to the last page, his eyes emitting a fervent glow.
Yuan Ming noticed Immortal Xuanhua's unusual behavior and curiously looked over. The last page of the book also recorded a formula for Spirit Incense, but there was only one kind, named "Foundation Establishment Incense."
Yuan Ming's heart skipped a beat, and just as he concentrated on seeing it more clearly, endless darkness engulfed him, his consciousness plunging into chaos.
When he regained consciousness, he was back in his own body.
Yuan Ming suddenly stood up from the bed, his eyes shining with excitement as he felt quite stirred.
Although he had not seen the formula for "Foundation Establishment Incense" clearly just now, he had caught a glimpse of some of its effects. According to the description, this incense, true to its name, was an aid for Foundation Establishment, and its effects were quite good, potentially increasing the success rate by about twenty percent.
If it were an ordinary method to assist Foundation Establishment, Yuan Ming might not have paid it much attention, but Spirit Incense was different. His Stealing Heaven Tripod had the effect of activating Spirit Incense, so the twenty percent increase in Foundation Establishment success rate provided by Foundation Establishment Incense, when agitated by the Stealing Heaven Tripod, would likely be even more significant.
"This is surely heaven aiding me. If I could obtain this incense and combine it with the assistance of a Foundation Establishment Pill, as well as my foundation at the Qi Refining Thirteen Layers, my chances of success would greatly increase!" As Yuan Ming came to this realization, he involuntarily clenched his fists tightly.
After sitting quietly in his room for a while and allowing his emotions to settle completely, Yuan Ming set out towards the workshop to purchase materials for making "Seven-step Immovable."
In the days that followed, Yuan Ming attempted to possess Immortal Xuanhua once every seven days to check on his whereabouts.
Yet, Immortal Xuanhua seemed spellbound, staying in the secret chamber the entire time. He spent most of the time cultivating, with the remaining time spent making Spirit Incense.
Unfortunately, after that glimpse of the "Foundation Establishment Incense," Immortal Xuanhua never looked again at the descriptions of this incense and did not truly refine it, even under Yuan Ming's repeated mental influence.
This made Yuan Ming anxious; after all, the incense ashes he had obtained from the Liu Xin Sect were very limited, and there was nothing he could do about it.
Fortunately, in his last possession, he very coincidentally discovered the location of Immortal Xuanhua: Ning City in Yue Country of the Eastern Domain.

chapters.title: Chapter 248 - 225: Incense Making Talent
chapters.content:
Having learned the whereabouts of Immortal Xuanhua, Yuan Ming immediately left the small town and set out for Yue Country.
Yue Country was the largest country in the Southern Border Eastern Domain, bordering the Central Plains. Over a hundred years ago, it had even conquered a small country in the Central Plains, annexing its territory, so it wasn't purely considered a Southern Border country anymore.
And Ning City was a major city in Yue Country, located by the sea, its scenery sprawling and picturesque.
Several days later, Yuan Ming stood on the edge of a cliff outside the city, gazing out over the sea.
Everywhere he looked, there was boundless blue water, with the sea wind stirring up waves that rose and fell, spraying layers of white foam, each breath carrying a hint of salt.
Ships with grey and white sails sailed or anchored on the ocean surface, the sunlight reflecting off the water like countless gold scales, stretching to the horizon, blending into the pale blue sky, making it hard to distinguish where the sea ended and the sky began.
Occasionally, groups of seagulls would freely soar above the surging expanse, lightly touching the crests, emitting several high and clear cries.
Having lived in the Da Jin Capital since childhood, Yuan Ming had never visited the seaside; he had only heard of the sea's majestic expanse and had never seen it with his own eyes. His previous missions to the Southern Border had mainly taken him over land and rivers; now that he had come to the seaside for the first time, he was genuinely stunned.
"Rocks crumble, waves split the shore, rolling up a thousand piles of snow, it is indeed a stunning sight," he murmured to himself, beginning to understand why Wulu was so fascinated by the sea.
Yuan Ming did not linger at the seaside for long and soon turned to enter the city.
Yue Country spanned both the Central Plains and the Southern Border, blending the characteristics of both in its street layouts and city architecture. Under the lush, broad-leaved trees, most of the buildings and towers were constructed of wood or bamboo, offering a refreshing splendor that filled the eyes with exotic charm.
But Yuan Ming had matters on his mind and no time to appreciate the scenery of Ning City. He went directly to a rundown temple in the west of the city, where the gate bore a plaque reading "Xuanhua Temple."
He walked over and knocked on the tightly shut doors.
A moment later, a clean-shaven Daoist disciple of about eleven or twelve years old came out. Seeing Yuan Ming's unfamiliar face, the young boy looked a bit nervous.
"This senior is most courteous. May I ask what brings you to Xuanhua Temple?" The Daoist disciple, though nervous, did not neglect his manners. He bowed to Yuan Ming and asked with a clear voice.
"I am Yuan Ming, and Immortal Xuanhua and I are old friends. I was passing through Ning City and came to visit, please let your Master know," Yuan Ming said, having seen this Daoist disciple several times during the time he was possessed by Immortal Xuanhua. He knew the boy was a disciple of Immortal Xuanhua, and taking out an ancient bronze token, he spoke.
"My master is currently cultivating inside the temple. Please wait a moment, senior," the Daoist disciple said, relieved to learn Yuan Ming's name and see the token. He turned and quickly ran inside.
