Yuan Ming raised an eyebrow, noting the Daoist disciple's expression. Xuanhua Temple seemed not to be very peaceful?
A moment later, a hearty laughter came from inside the temple.
"Haha, it turns out to be Fellow Daoist Yuan here, truly a rare guest, a rare guest indeed," laughed Immortal Xuanhua, wearing a pair of wooden clogs as he came out.
"Fellow Daoist Xuanhua, Yuan is here unannounced; I hope I have not disturbed your cultivation," Yuan Ming said with a bow.
"How could it be a disturbance? Please, come in," Immortal Xuanhua said, smiling as he led Yuan Ming inside.
As the two of them chatted casually, the Daoist disciple swiftly set up a table with a feast in a living room, beginning to arrange the dishes and utensils.
"Since Fellow Daoist Xuanhua has prepared a feast, I shall bring out a jar of fine wine," Yuan Ming said with a smile as he took out a vivid red wine jar.
This was a bottle of Spiritual Wine he had whimsically bought from a workshop while en route to Ning City. It was brewed from a hundred-year-old Spirit Fruit, costing him over twenty Spirit Stones.
"Hundred Fragrance Wine? Fellow Daoist Yuan does indeed have good taste in wine!" Immortal Xuanhua exclaimed with a laugh after a pause.
The two old friends caught up on trivial matters, and after having their fill of food and drink, they finally turned to the main topic.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan has come all the way from the North Territory to Ning City; surely, you didn't come just to see me, did you?" Immortal Xuanhua asked.
"Fellow Daoist Xuanhua is straightforward, and so will I be. The Spirit Incenses you sold me last time were very useful, and afterward, I spent quite some effort learning the skill of Incense Making. Today, I came to Ning City to discuss the craft of making Spirit Incense with you and also to buy some more Spirit Incenses from you," Yuan Ming said with a smile.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan is also interested in the Incense Dao? Compared to Alchemy and talisman making, this belongs to a minor path and is not very well regarded, really," Immortal Xuanhua said, sizing up Yuan Ming with some surprise.
"I do not see it that way. Spirit Incense has many marvelous uses. To say nothing else, the Qingxuan Incense in accelerating Cultivation is not as rapid and striking in effect as elixirs, but it excels in a steady and continuous manner and can complement them well. Moreover, making Spirit Incense is much simpler than Alchemy, Artifact Refining, and creating Arrays. I only regret not having come into contact with the Incense Dao earlier," Yuan Ming remarked.
Immortal Xuanhua's gaze became increasingly bright as he looked at Yuan Ming, but then it dimmed again: "Fellow Daoist Yuan has a keen insight to see the unique aspects of Spirit Incense, which is praiseworthy. Unfortunately, today's Cultivation World is eager for quick success and instant benefits, flocking to elixirs and Magic Artifacts; who cares about Spirit Incense anymore? Even in workshop shops, Spirit Incense is usually tucked away in corners for sale."
Saying this, he gulped down a mouthful of wine and shook his head with a bitter smile.
"That is precisely why we, as incense makers, must strive harder, to refine top-quality Spirit Incense and change the public's misconceptions about them," Yuan Ming encouraged, refilling the cup of Xuan Hua Daoist.
"Haha, Fellow Daoist Yuan is right; it was I who was disheartened," Immortal Xuanhua adjusted his breathing, smiled, and then asked, "Fellow Daoist Yuan, since you are interested in discussing this, naturally I would not decline. I wonder, what progress have you made? Do you have any finished Spirit Incense for me to review?"
Yuan Ming knew that his earlier words had moved Immortal Xuanhua, and he felt secretly pleased. He took out a stick of Purple Mysterious Incense and handed it over.
"Purple Mysterious Incense!" Immortal Xuanhua narrowed his eyes, took the incense, and examined it carefully, his expression growing solemn.
He immediately took out an incense burner, inserted the stick of incense, lit it, and closed his eyes to cultivate.
A moment later, Immortal Xuanhua opened his eyes and looked at Yuan Ming with an unusual gaze.
"Is there a problem with this incense?" asked Yuan Ming, seeing this.
"No, this Purple Mysterious Incense is excellently made. Apart from a few minor flaws in detail, it is nearly perfect," said Immortal Xuanhua.
"You flatter me, Fellow Daoist Xuanhua," Yuan Ming smiled.
"However, I am puzzled about one thing. The formula for this Purple Mysterious Incense is held only by me in the entire Yue Country, even in the Southern Border. Where, then, did Fellow Daoist Yuan obtain it?" Immortal Xuanhua stared at Yuan Ming, seeming to seek to discern something in his eyes.
"I don't have the formula for Purple Mysterious Incense. I had previously explored refining Qingxuan Incense on my own, accumulating some insights. A few days ago, I accidentally bought a few sticks of Purple Mysterious Incense in a workshop I passed by, and after identifying them, I tried to replicate them," Yuan Ming said, meeting the other's gaze honestly.
"What!" Immortal Xuanhua's eyes widened in disbelief.
There is a saying among alchemists: "Even immortals struggle to guess the pill by the powder," meaning that deducing the formula from a finished elixir is nearly impossible. Though Spirit Incense is somewhat simpler than elixirs, deducing the formula from the final product is also extremely difficult, requiring vast experience, talent, and skill.
Immortal Xuanhua asked himself if even he could not do such a thing, how could Yuan Ming have managed it?
"Even though I do not know how Fellow Daoist Yuan managed this, I genuinely admire you. Now, I have an impolite request. I wonder if you could make a stick of Purple Mysterious Incense on the spot, so that I might better understand your current level of skill?" he paused, then said.
"Of course, I was just about to ask Fellow Daoist Xuanhua for guidance," Yuan Ming readily agreed.If you're not on *, you're viewing a copy.
Immortal Xuanhua led Yuan Ming towards the temple interior and soon reached a secret chamber. There was also a set of tools for incense making there, somewhat more rudimentary than Immortal Xuanhua's set but much better than Yuan Ming's.
Yuan Ming didn't stand on ceremony; he took up the tools, brought out the materials for Purple Mysterious Incense, and began to make the incense.
Over the past month, he had taken possession of Xuanhua on several occasions, intuiting the process of making Purple Mysterious Incense and had practiced it himself many times, becoming thoroughly familiar with its production.
Of course, to avoid arousing suspicion, he made some unimportant adjustments to the incense crafting process, making it a bit longer than the original time required. Even so, it didn't take him long to produce a finished product.
Immortal Xuanhua took the newly made Spirit Incense, inspected it carefully, and sighed deeply, seeming greatly impacted and suddenly appearing much older.
If one did not consider the process, the final product of this Purple Mysterious Incense was perfect. He asked himself, even if he were to act, could he only reduce some steps in the process and not produce a better quality final product than this?
Yuan Ming felt a bit guilty but said nothing to comfort him.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan's talent in incense making is truly unmatched; I am far inferior. Surely you studied the Incense Dao by yourself, without anyone's guidance?" Immortal Xuanhua recovered quickly and asked.
"A few months ago, in order to master incense making, I visited various cities and temples and received some initial guidance on the Incense Dao from a senior. Afterward, it was all my own rough studies, which lacked systematic approach, hence my visit today to seek advice from Fellow Daoist Xuanhua," Yuan Ming said, half-truthfully.
"Just some initial guidance and Fellow Daoist Yuan was able to easily replicate Purple Mysterious Incense. It seems that your senior must be a hidden grandmaster of the Incense Dao. May I be so fortunate as to know his name?" pressured Immortal Xuanhua.
"The senior did not reveal his name to me and strictly forbade me from mentioning his affairs to anyone. Please forgive me, Fellow Daoist Xuanhua," Yuan Ming bowed and said.
"No name given, so no formal apprenticeship attained, that's very good… very good..." mumbled Immortal Xuanhua softly.
"What did Fellow Daoist Xuanhua say?" Yuan Ming inquired.
"Nothing much, your skills in incense making are already very exquisite; I have almost nothing to offer in guidance. It's just that I noticed you handling some materials just now; it seems you are still somewhat lacking in your understanding of the Incense Dao," Immortal Xuanhua composed himself and stated.
"I indeed lack in this area; I humbly request guidance from Fellow Daoist Xuanhua," Yuan Ming straightened up, clasped his hands together in a salute and said.

chapters.title: Chapter 249 - 226: Incense Dao
chapters.content:
"Imparting guidance is no trouble at all; however, these matters are the secret techniques passed down by the ancestors of Xuanhua Temple and cannot be lightly transmitted to others," Immortal Xuanhua said slowly, seemingly hinting at something.
"I understand. I still have some savings on me and am willing to offer five hundred Spirit Stones for the restoration of the Xuanhua Temple buildings. Please, Fellow Daoist Xuan Hua, kindly accept." Yuan Ming took out a storage magic tool and passed it over.
"Spirit Stones are not necessary. I have another matter to request, which would be of great benefit to both of us. As long as Fellow Daoist agrees, I am willing to impart the Incense Dao heritage passed down from the ancestors of Xuanhua Temple, as well as all the insights I have gained from a lifetime of Incense Making," Immortal Xuanhua said, not accepting the storage magic tool, gazing at Yuan Ming with an eager look.
"May I know what matter Fellow Daoist Xuan Hua requires me to handle?" Seeing Immortal Xuanhua's peculiar expression, Yuan Ming was unsure what he would request, so he spoke rather vaguely.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan's talent in the Incense Dao is astonishing. Do you have any interest in joining Xuanhua Temple to focus on comprehending the Incense Dao? With your aptitude, and the support of our temple, in no more than fifty years, you will surely become a grandmaster of the Incense Dao," Immortal Xuanhua stated with a grave demeanor, convincing anyone looking that his words truly came from the heart.
"Join Xuanhua Temple?" Yuan Ming's brow gradually furrowed, clearly not keen on the idea.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan must not misunderstand. My invitation for you to join Xuanhua Temple is not to take you as a disciple; we would be peers, with no distinction of seniority. Although Xuanhua Temple is not large, we still possess some resources, and our research in Spirit Incense is profound—few in Yue Country can compare. If Fellow Daoist is willing to join, you may freely use and peruse everything our temple has, including all kinds of incense-making materials and libraries on Spirit Incense," Immortal Xuanhua urged, his eyes showing a slight urgency.
Upon hearing that he could freely peruse any classics, Yuan Ming's mind flashed with the image of that Beast Skin Book, his heart moved, but in the end, he shook his head and said, "Thank you for your kind intentions, Fellow Daoist Xuan Hua, but I value my freedom and do not wish to be restrained by a sect."
"Fellow Daoist Yuan need not worry about this matter. You can join our temple and ignore all trivial matters, focusing solely on the study of the Incense Dao. I will handle all the daily affairs of Xuanhua Temple myself and will not trouble you," the Xuan Hua Daoist continued to persuade, somewhat reluctantly.
A genius in the Incense Dao like Yuan Ming only appeared once in several hundred years. If he could be brought into the fold, the future prosperity of Xuanhua Temple was all but assured.
"Fellow Daoist Xuan Hua, there's no need to say more. I currently have no intention of joining any sect, please forgive me," Yuan Ming stubbornly shook his head.
Having just experienced the destruction of Biluo Cave, he now only wished to cultivate alone in peace; he truly had no desire to join a second sect at this critical juncture.
Seeing Yuan Ming's resolute attitude, Immortal Xuanhua knew any further persuasion would be futile and might even cause annoyance, so he refrained from speaking further.
"Fellow Daoist Xuan Hua, I am willing to add another three hundred Spirit Stones and donate them to your esteemed temple, in exchange for some pointers in Incense Making. May I?" Yuan Ming offered one last effort, bowing slightly as he spoke.
"Although Xuanhua Temple is small, we do have some Spirit Stones, so there is no need," Immortal Xuanhua said.
Yuan Ming felt disappointed upon hearing this but did not take it too seriously.
With the Stealing Heaven Tripod, he could possess Immortal Xuanhua at any time and secretly learn the Art of Incense Making. Not receiving guidance was not much of an issue.
"The insights of Incense Making passed down by the ancestors of our temple are not to be taught to outsiders, but my rudimentary understanding of the Incense Dao can be shared. Since Fellow Daoist Yuan is interested, we can exchange views with each other," Immortal Xuanhua unexpectedly continued.
Yuan Ming stood there, stunned, momentarily forgetting to reply.
"The most important aspect of Spirit Incense is 'spirit,' followed by 'incense,'" Immortal Xuanhua continued, unconcerned.
"Could you please explain this a little more clearly?" Yuan Ming, puzzled by the profound words, eagerly listened and inquired.
"Like living creatures, Spirit Incense is a product of the convergence of the Five Elements Power. Each type contains spiritual materials of the Gold, Wood, Water, Fire, Earth attributes, which form the basis of a stick of Spirit Incense. Only then are other spiritual materials added, and finally, the Spirit Incense is formed," Immortal Xuanhua explained.
Yuan Ming nodded repeatedly, gaining some clarity on many of the doubts he had during Incense Making.
"In making Spirit Incense, avoid being rigid and unchanging. Every cultivator's Spirit Root and constitution differ. Even for the same kind of Spirit Incense, the proportions of the five spiritual materials must be adjusted according to the target individual's condition to achieve the best effect," Immortal Xuanhua continued.
Although Yuan Ming had not agreed to join Xuanhua Temple, Immortal Xuanhua did not withhold any secrets, imparting all his knowledge of Incense Making, and time quickly passed half a day.
Though it was only half a day, Yuan Ming's understanding of Spirit Incense had deepened significantly, and combined with his previous experience in Incense Making, his insight into the Incense Dao grew.
"Fellow Daoist Xuan Hua, I've heard that within Xuanhua Temple, there is a type of Foundation Establishment Spirit Incense that can increase the success rate of Foundation Establishment. Is it true?" Yuan Ming asked.
Hearing this, Immortal Xuanhua's face showed a look of surprise: "The Foundation Establishment Spirit Incense is our temple's greatest secret. Even disciples of our temple do not know of it. How did Fellow Daoist Yuan come to know of this?"
"It was the senior who guided me in the Incense Dao who informed me. He advised me to come here in search of this incense, to use its power to break through the Foundation Establishment Stage," Yuan Ming casually fabricated.
"If it was said by that senior..." Immortal Xuanhua's expression changed slightly.
Considering Yuan Ming's astonishing achievements in the Incense Dao, Immortal Xuanhua firmly believed he had the guidance of a highly skilled individual. With this preconceived notion, he did not doubt Yuan Ming's words and secretly speculated whether that senior had a connection to Xuanhua Temple.
"Since it was mentioned by that senior, I will not lie. Our temple indeed has the recipe for the Foundation Establishment Spirit Incense. Frankly, I too wish to use this incense to advance to Foundation Establishment. However, firstly, the effective use of this incense must be accompanied by a Foundation Establishment Pill, and secondly, its refinement is quite difficult, far from something like the Purple Mysterious Incense, and the required materials are also exceedingly rare. I have yet to gather them all, let alone produce it," Immortal Xuanhua shook his head with a sigh.
"Which materials are you still lacking?" Yuan Ming pressed on, thinking to himself that it was no wonder the Foundation Establishment Incense was not as widely spread as the Foundation Establishment Pill. The difficulty of refining this incense seemed to be no less than that of the pill, and there were likely many restrictions as well.
"I've mostly gathered the other materials. Currently, I am only missing a main spiritual material of the Water attribute," Immortal Xuanhua revealed.
"I have ascertained that White Dragon Commerce on White Dragon Island has recently acquired this type of spiritual material, but unfortunately, they are not willing to sell it," Immortal Xuanhua said after thinking for a moment.
"Would Fellow Daoist Xuanhua be able to disclose the name of the spiritual material to me? Perhaps I could find a way to persuade them to part with some," Yuan Ming said upon hearing this.
Before Immortal Xuanhua could respond, a series of knocks on the door interrupted their conversation.
"Come in," Immortal Xuanhua said.
The door was pushed open, and the fair-skinned Daoist disciple hastened in, apparently having run all the way here as he was gasping for breath.This is a sample from My Virtual Library Empire. Read the rest on *.
"What has happened that you are so flustered?" Immortal Xuanhua's face darkened as he commanded.
"This disciple begs forgiveness, it's that person from White Dragon Island," the fair-skinned Daoist disciple glanced at Yuan Ming before responding.
"Haven't we already clearly rejected them a few days ago? Why have they come knocking again!" Immortal Xuanhua was startled and spoke with a frown.
The fair-skinned Daoist disciple bowed his head, saying nothing.
Yuan Ming's expression changed subtly. They had just been speaking of White Dragon Island when someone from there arrived; what a coincidence.
Yet the visitor was likely not here with good intentions, no wonder the Daoist disciple was so vigilant when Yuan Ming had first arrived.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, there are some matters that need my attention within the temple. I must attend to them. Please wait here for a moment," Immortal Xuanhua said, turning to Yuan Ming.
"Please, Fellow Daoist Xuanhua, feel free," Yuan Ming nodded.
"You stay here and entertain the guest," Immortal Xuanhua instructed the Daoist disciple before quickly walking out.
Yuan Ming sat down beside the table inside the room and asked, "Is there any tea?"
"Please wait a moment, senior. I'll fetch some right away," the fair-skinned Daoist disciple said before quickly walking out.
Yuan Ming took advantage of this moment to collect some incense ashes from the incense burner on a nearby altar table and tucked them away, while also stuffing several Spirit Stones into the burner.
The incense ashes he had previously obtained from Liu Xin Sect had all been used. Although Xuanhua Temple was not as large as Liu Xin Sect, it was still a sect, and many disciples offered incense to the ancestors daily, so these incense ashes were also worth a try.
The frantic little Daoist disciple hadn't noticed that a black soul crow had followed him outside, silently flying toward the front courtyard of Xuanhua Temple and soon perched on a large tree near the front hall.
From this location, one could see inside the front hall of Xuanhua Temple, where a black-clad middle-aged man was seated authoritatively, with thick eyebrows and keen eyes that gave an unapproachable aura. His cultivation was profound and inscrutable; Yuan Ming couldn't see through him with the soul crow, indicating he was likely at the Foundation Establishment Stage.
The man's attire was identical to that worn by Li Sha from White Dragon Island, who had been killed in Black Rock City, which implied that he was probably an elder from White Dragon Island as well.
At that moment, the fair-skinned Daoist disciple came back with a steaming kettle and a tea cup, pouring a cup of tea for Yuan Ming.
"This is the Green Dew Tea from our temple. Although it is not Spiritual Tea, it has quite a nice flavor. Please have a taste, senior," the fair-skinned Daoist disciple said obediently.
Yuan Ming took a sip from the tea cup and nodded, asking, "What is your name?"
"Reporting to senior, this humble one is named Kong Bing," the fair-skinned Daoist disciple replied respectfully.
"Kong Bing, that's a good name. Let me ask you, what is the person from White Dragon Island doing at Xuanhua Temple?" Yuan Ming inquired.
"It seems they are here to negotiate a deal with my master. I'm not too clear on the details; master doesn't allow us to get involved in these matters," the fair-skinned Daoist disciple said, lowering his gaze.
Yuan Ming smiled upon hearing this; the young Daoist disciple seemed not large in age, yet he was quite shrewd, cutting off any further inquiries with a single sentence.
Fortunately, with the soul crow to investigate, Yuan Ming would soon know the purpose of the black-clad man's visit.
It didn't take long for Immortal Xuanhua to reach the front hall, whereupon seeing the black-clad man, he said sternly, "Elder Bai, I should have made it clear that the Incense Making Classics are the foundation of our temple and cannot be sold. Please leave now, and if you continue to press this matter, I will have to report it to Tieyun Temple and ask them to intervene."
Tieyun Temple was one of the Four Major Sects of the Eastern Domain, and Ning City fell under its protection.
"Heh, why become angry, Fellow Daoist Xuanhua? In my view, there's no deal in this world that cannot be made; it all depends on whether the buyer is willing to pay the price. I heard you went to White Dragon Commerce a few days ago to request Heavenly Glue, and I have brought the item with me. Just give the word, and this piece of Heavenly Glue, along with two thousand Spirit Stones, will be yours," the black-clad man chuckled, and a White Jade Box and a storage bag appeared on the table.
Upon opening the Jade Box, a faint chill spread out, and lying within was a chicken egg-sized, crystal clear white gelatinous body that made the moisture in the hall noticeably denser.
On seeing this object, Immortal Xuanhua's throat clearly moved slightly.

chapters.title: Chapter 250 - 227: Volunteering
chapters.content:
"Heavenly Glue!" Yuan Ming's eyes brightened when he saw the item through the soul crow inside the jade box.
When he had first arrived in the Eastern Domain, he'd heard a workshop owner mention this rarity, saying that Heavenly Glue was produced at the bottom of the deep sea, only forming under a combination of conditions such as spiritual power, earth veins, temperature, and water pressure. It was extremely scarce, a small piece costing seven or eight hundred spirit stones and often without a market price.
"Elder Bai, please keep this. I, as the master of Xuanhua Temple, bear the legacy of our ancestral masters, and I dare not forget even a single detail. The secret incense-making scripture of our temple can never be sold," Immortal Xuanhua said, shaking his head with firm conviction.
Bai Lin's face darkened, and he said coldly, "Fellow Daoist Xuan Hua, I, Bai, have already made my terms very clear. Do not be ungrateful! At the heart of this matter, you failed to fulfill the commission of one hundred 'Seven-step Immovable' incenses on time, ruining my big deal. This is why we have reached this situation. Even if you face confrontation at Tieyun Temple, you'd have no ground to stand on!"
Immortal Xuanhua's face turned crimson, and he stammered, unable to speak.
"The beast has been startled and is hiding in its lair, refusing to come out. Our only option is to request the secret incense-making scripture from your Xuanhua Temple and ask Blue Lizard Daoist for assistance in hopes of hunting down the beast. If we fail, both you and I are facing a fatal threat. Should you die, the Xuanhua Temple would vanish into smoke and clouds, so what inheritance would there be to speak of?" Bai Lin's eyes were frighteningly cold as he spoke, word by word.
With every word he heard from Bai Lin, Immortal Xuanhua's face lost more color, and by the time Bai Lin finished speaking, sweat beaded on his forehead.
"I'll give you one more day, Fellow Daoist Xuan Hua. I'll return tomorrow and hope you will not disappoint me. Otherwise, do not blame me for being ruthless," Bai Lin said, then stood up, collected the jade box and storage bag, and left.
Immortal Xuanhua's face was drained of all color as he sat down listlessly in the front hall.
Footsteps approached. It was Yuan Ming walking in.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, what brings you here?" asked Immortal Xuanhua as he stood up.
"Don't blame me, Fellow Daoist Xuan Hua, but I have a secret technique that allows me to listen to distant sounds. I accidentally overheard your conversation just now, and I thought to come and discuss this matter with you," Yuan Ming apologized with a bow.
Immortal Xuanhua was taken aback, but then waved his hand in exhaustion and sat back down.
"Fellow Daoist Xuan Hua, it seems from your conversation that you've found yourself in a pickle because you couldn't hunt down a fierce beast, and that's why you and Senior Bai Lin are in this predicament. What's the whole story? I don't dare claim expertise in many things, but when it comes to hunting fierce beasts, I believe I have some methods and might be able to help," Yuan Ming said as he took a seat next to Immortal Xuanhua.
"You? Hunt a fierce beast?" Immortal Xuanhua looked at Yuan Ming in surprise, clearly disbelieving.Thischapterwasuploadedbytheteamat*.
It was no wonder, as incense makers typically spent years toiling away in secluded rooms, leaving material purchases to others and having no connection with battle.
Yuan Ming gave a faint smile and formed a hand gesture.
Suddenly, a chair not far away split in half, the break so smooth it was exceptional. Immortal Xuanhua had no idea how it had happened.
"Unexpectedly, Fellow Daoist Yuan, you possess such skills. But I'm afraid you can't help with this matter," said Immortal Xuanhua, surprised, yet still shaking his head.
"There's no harm in telling me about it," Yuan Ming replied, not giving up.
"Alright then, this matter began a month ago," Immortal Xuanhua sighed and began to recount.
A month prior, Bai Lin had come to him with a big business deal to refine one hundred 'Seven-step Immovable Falling Incense', offering a hefty price but requiring completion within ten days.
Immortal Xuanhua was gathering spirit stones to prepare spirit grass for refining Foundation Establishment Spirit Incense and agreed without hesitation.
With Immortal Xuanhua's incense-making skills, a hundred 'Seven-step Immovable' sticks in ten days was quite doable. But fate was cruel, and on the seventh day, an old ailment in his head flared up. He fainted in the chamber and didn't wake up until two days later, which greatly delayed the incense-making process. In the end, he produced just over eighty 'Seven-step Immovable', failing to meet Bai Lin's deadline.
Bai Lin needed a hundred 'Seven-step Immovable' to hunt a Vortex Beast from the sea, a creature whose strength had nearly reached the third level and had always been sly, hiding in the undercurrents and whirlpools at the bottom of the sea."
Somehow Bai Lin had managed to lure it to the surface and trap it with an array, using a large amount of 'Seven-step Immovable' to daze it and attempt to kill it there.
However, with insufficient incense, the Vortex Beast regained its senses at a critical moment, broke free from the array's confinement, and escaped back to the sea bed. No matter how Bai Lin tempted it, the beast refused to show itself again.
The reason Bai Lin was hunting the Vortex Beast stemmed from a command by a Core Formation Stage cultivator from White Dragon Island who had a terribly volatile temper. If Bai Lin failed to bring back the Vortex Beast's corpse on time, his life would likely be at risk.
Left with no choice, Bai Lin sought help from a formidable Loose Cultivator near Ning City, Blue Lizard Wanderer, whose cultivation had reached Mid-stage Foundation Establishment, and whose technique was adept for underwater activities. He even had a Bottom Water Spirit Beast as his aid, which could contend with the Vortex Beast and possibly draw it out again.
Yet, that Blue Lizard made a demand: he would only move if he received Xuanhua Temple's incense-making secret scripture; otherwise, he would not lift a finger, leading to Bai Lin's aggressive visit.
"Fellow Daoist Xuan Hua, do you suffer from a brain disease?" Yuan Ming inquired after hearing the story.
"Yes, it's an old problem. I become prone to attacks when I'm agitated or emotionally upset. I've been medicating to suppress it for years and had not suffered for a long time. But recently, for some unknown reason, my thoughts have become restlessly active. Coupled with the relentless work on incense-making, it triggered the recurrence of my old problem," Immortal Xuanhua explained with a sigh.
Yuan Ming opened his mouth to speak, then hesitated, his eyes flashing with a hint of apology.
Immortal Xuanhua's thoughts had been restless lately, perhaps due to the influence of the consciousness after possession.
"What do you plan to do, Fellow Daoist Xuan Hua? Are you really going to give up your temple's secret scriptures?" Yuan Ming asked again.
"Even if I die, I will never hand over the sect's secret scriptures to others!" Immortal Xuanhua's eyes were filled with determination.
"If that's the case, we only have one choice, which is to hunt down the Vortex Beast. Do you know where its lair is, Fellow Daoist Xuan Hua?" Yuan Ming paused, then continued to ask.
"I heard Bai Lin mention it once, it's near Coral Island, about a hundred miles to the southwest. Do you really intend to hunt this beast? I appreciate your kindness, but with how powerful the Vortex Beast is, even a group of Foundation Establishment Stage Cultivators might not win against it, let alone us Qi Refinement Stage Cultivators. I should ask Tieyun Temple to handle this. At worst, we'll spend a hefty amount of Spirit Stones. I don't believe that we can't resolve this issue," Immortal Xuanhua said, shaking his head.
"It's certainly not possible by myself alone, but I have several rather formidable companions. If they take action, there should be a fair chance of success," Yuan Ming replied.
"Do you truly have confidence, Fellow Daoist Yuan?" Immortal Xuanhua's face showed a hint of hope upon hearing this.
Although he said he would pay Tieyun Temple to intervene, he actually had no assurance at all. Given that he was at fault in this matter and lacked close friends within Tieyun Temple, it was highly unlikely that they would back him up over some Spirit Stones and get into conflict with the elders of White Dragon Island.
"There's no certainty of success, but there's still a 50 to 60 percent chance," Yuan Ming thought for a moment before answering.
"If Fellow Daoist Yuan really can hunt down the Vortex Beast, then you will be a benefactor to Xuanhua Temple. In the future, whatever you ask for, I will not turn you down!" Immortal Xuanhua bowed deeply, making a solemn promise.
"Fellow Daoist Xuan Hua, you are too kind. If I retrieve that Vortex Beast's corpse, I should be able to exchange it for Heavenly Glue from someone on White Dragon Island. If you can make more than two Foundation Establishment Spirit Incense sticks, I hope you'll share one with me," Yuan Ming returned the bow and said.
Whether it was to express his apology or in pursuit of refining Foundation Establishment Incense, he was determined to hunt down this Vortex Beast.
To others this creature might be a tricky adversary, but Yuan Ming had many methods, especially since he had the body of the Heavenly Snake Master integrated with the White Ape Skin. As long as he wasn't directly fighting a Core Formation Stage cultivator, he feared nothing.
Moreover, going by the conversation between Immortal Xuanhua and Bai Lin earlier, the hardest part in hunting this beast was luring it out from the bottom of the sea. On that matter, he happened to have a unique secret technique.
Naturally, Immortal Xuanhua agreed without hesitation.
"From what you say, that Vortex Beast is cunning. I might not be able to return tomorrow. If the cultivators from White Dragon Island come again, please find a way to stall them for a few days, Fellow Daoist Xuan Hua." Yuan Ming said.
"No problem, leave this trivial matter to me," Immortal Xuanhua replied.
Yuan Ming nodded, stood up, and walked outside, with Immortal Xuanhua personally seeing him off.
Yuan Ming did not leave through the front door he had entered earlier but asked Immortal Xuanhua to lead him out through a back door.
His soul crow had detected that Bai Lin had sent someone to guard the main entrance. For now, Yuan Ming preferred not to have contact with anyone from White Dragon Island to avoid trouble.
The two of them passed through the courtyard behind the main hall, and a loft appeared in front of them, where they could see several spirit tablets enshrined with candles burning brightly and incense diffusing in all directions.
"That area is the ancestral hall where we venerate the past masters of this temple," Immortal Xuanhua explained, noticing Yuan Ming's gaze.
Yuan Ming looked at a large incense burner within the ancestral hall, filled with incense ashes, and his eyes immediately lit up.
The quantity of incense ashes he had seen in the main hall was too little, but he hadn't expected to find even more in this place.
Without asking for permission, Yuan Ming continued walking and soon left Xuanhua Temple through the back door.
Half a quarter of an hour later, a blurred figure that was hard to see with the naked eye slipped into the ancestral hall of Xuanhua Temple and approached the incense burner.
The figure took out a rather large jade vessel and took nearly half of the incense ashes from the burner before quickly leaving.
A disciple of Xuanhua Temple arrived with a broom and suddenly paused.
He thought he had seen a shadow flicker by, but when he looked carefully again, he saw nothing. Shaking his head and muttering to himself, he didn't take it seriously and started cleaning the ancestral hall.
After leaving Xuanhua Temple, that shadowy figure quickly came to a deserted alley nearby. Lifting off a gray cloak, Yuan Ming revealed his true identity.
Looking at the jade vessel in his hands, he showed a pleased expression.
With so much incense ash, he would have enough to last him a significantly long time.

chapters.title: Chapter 251 - 228 Going to Sea
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming tucked away the Yu Hu, but instead of leaving the city immediately, he came to a secluded alley in the northern part of the city. Lifting his foot, he stepped in. Halfway through, his figure vanished as if merging into water.
Before his eyes, a bustling, expansive street appeared, with cultivators coming and going. On both sides of the street were shops selling all kinds of elixirs, talismans, and magical artifacts.
This was a workshop Yuan Ming had heard about while drinking with Immortal Xuanhua.
After a brief glance, Yuan Ming noted the workshop was not large and the items it sold were not superior to those found in Black Rock City Market.
He had matters to attend to and was not in the mood to wander around the workshop, so he found a bookshop and, with the shopkeeper's recommendation, bought a classic that introduced the sea beasts of the East Sea.
Although he felt confident about hunting the Vortex Beast, he knew that prior preparation was essential. He understood the principle of knowing the enemy and knowing oneself.
"Rest assured, customer, this classic was written by a master from Tieyun Temple after traveling around the East Sea for decades. It has been circulated for a long time, with detailed and accurate content. It certainly won't lead you astray," the bookseller confidently asserted.
"I hope so," Yuan Ming murmured. Without leaving the shop, he began to peruse the book and quickly found the section about the Vortex Beast.
The shopkeeper hadn't exaggerated. The book contained a detailed account of the Vortex Beast, listing its divine skills, what forces could subdue it, and its preferred prey, with a comprehensive description.
Very satisfied, Yuan Ming stowed the classic in his Storage Ring and left the bookshop.
Then, he added some water-use talismans from nearby shops and made his way to the workshop's entrance.
Just as he reached the entrance, he saw two people approaching. One of them was Bai Lin, and the other looked like a young boy in a short shirt, probably Bai Lin's attendant.
The two hurried past without noticing Yuan Ming, whom they did not recognize.
Yuan Ming, hearing the footsteps behind him fade away, did not bother to investigate further and continued on his way.
A quarter of an hour later, he left Ning City, summoned the Green Cloud Crane, and flew southwest.
Once he was far from Ning City, Yuan Ming switched to the Jade Shuttle Magical Artifact, turning into a streak of white light that shot forward, quickly traveling a hundred li.
All around him was an endless expanse of sea, with no islands in sight.
An ordinary cultivator experiencing this for the first time might feel lost and frustrated, not knowing how to proceed, but exploration was Yuan Ming's forte.
He released five soul crows to scout the vicinity and soon found a rather large coral island, spanning over a dozen li, covered in red corals that glimmered brilliantly under the sunlight, breathtakingly beautiful.
To the north of the island was a vast vortex, dozens of zhang in diameter. The roaring waters flowed, emitting deafening rumblings.
"This must be the place Immortal Xuanhua spoke of," Yuan Ming muttered to himself as he directed a soul crow to dive into the vortex, quickly descending to a depth of a hundred zhang.
The water pressure here was astonishing, challenging even a Foundation Establishment Cultivator with the finest water-shielding treasure. Luckily, the soul crow, being a spiritual body, could endure and kept diving deeper, another hundred zhang down without reaching the bottom.
As it reached this point, the soul crow began to show signs of its Soul Power dissipating.
Yuan Ming frowned, contemplating a solution.
Suddenly, the water nearby burst into noise as a strange fish, over one zhang in length with eyes as large as copper bells and covered in spikes, lunged at him. Its mouth, filled with sharp teeth, aimed for the soul crow at considerable speed.
With a heavy demon energy fluctuation, the bizarre fish was a First-level Upper Stage sea beast.
"Thousand-needle fish." Yuan Ming deftly maneuvered the soul crow to evade the fish's attack, quickly recognizing the creature and revealing a look of pleasant surprise.
According to the classic he had perused earlier, the Thousand-needle fish was one of the Vortex Beast's favorite preys, and it was normal for its preferred food to be here where it resided.
His initial plan had been merely to use the soul crow to probe the situation with the Vortex Beast, but with the appearance of the Thousand-needle fish, his plans needed adjustment.
While controlling the soul crow to dodge the fish's attack, Yuan Ming flicked his finger.
The Black Needle Magical Artifact shot out, and another soul crow possessed it, quickly reaching the first soul crow's location inside the vortex.
The Thousand-needle fish continued to chase behind when a black needle flashed before its eyes. The fish instinctively tried to dodge, only to feel a sharp pain in its forehead before its consciousness plunged into endless darkness.
Yuan Ming did not retrieve the Black Needle that had pierced the fish's head and, with a thought,
the pursued soul crow swooped over, entering the body of the Thousand-needle fish, whose dull eyes suddenly regained vitality.
Once inside the fish's body, the soul crow was no longer subject to the intense water pressure and seemed quite at ease—a case of killing two birds with one stone.
Yuan Ming looked rather relieved, controlling the dead Thousand-needle fish's body to dive toward the seabed, quickly descending another seventy or eighty zhang and finally reaching the bottom of the sea.
This was his first glimpse of the underwater environment, and he observed it with curiosity.
The seafloor was undulating with peaks and valleys, not so different from land if one discounted the omnipresent sea, with mountains, plains, deep valleys, and so on...
In a nearby valley, a massive chasm had opened, cleaving a seafloor mountain in two. The crevice was pitch-black and bottomless, emitting a strong suction that stirred the surrounding waters into a tumultuous flow, forming the great vortex on the surface.
After observing for a while, Yuan Ming controlled the Thousand-needle fish to approach the chasm and slowly entered.
Suddenly, a blue lightning bolt shot out from the crevice, striking the fish.
The thousand-needle fish's body was pierced through, with streaks of blue electric arcs coursing over it, robbing the fish of all its ability to move.
The soul crow hiding inside the thousand-needle fish was also affected by the blue electric arcs. Fortunately, these arcs were not actual thunder but divine skills similar to the Kui Water Divine Thunder, so although the soul crow was considerably dispersed, it hadn't completely dissipated.
A blood-red shadow shot out from a crevice in the ground, wrapped around the corpse of the strange fish, and dragged it down. It soon arrived in front of a black sea beast as large as a house.
This sea beast resembled an ape, with all four limbs and an extremely wide mouth, equipped with four eyes. Its body was covered in pitch-black tumors and scales, making it look exceedingly ugly.
Above the sea, Yuan Ming's eyes lit up with delight. This hideous sea beast was the target of his journey—the Vortex Beast.
The blood-red shadow was the Vortex Beast's tongue, which had wrapped around the spiky fish and dragged it into its gaping maw, swallowing it whole without care for the spines on its body.
"Done!" Yuan Ming's face lit up with joy, and he immediately took control of the Black Needle Magical Artifact hidden within the spiky fish's head, attacking the Vortex Beast from the inside.
However, after one attempt, his expression abrupt changed.
The connection between the Black Needle Magical Artifact, the two soul crows, and himself was suddenly cut off, as if isolated completely by something.
Yuan Ming quickly regained his composure, thinking to himself that this Vortex Beast was truly no ordinary creature, no wonder the people from White Dragon Island couldn't capture it.
Since the clever approach had failed, he had no choice but to engage in direct combat.
Yuan Ming took out a stack of Array Flags and Array Plates, the very set he had obtained from Li Sha.
In the days that followed his practice, he also devoted himself to studying the Xiao Ying Family's Array Formation Manual and had finally made some progress, understanding the origin of Li Sha's formation, as well as the basic principles of setting it up.
The name of this formation was the "Thousand Knot Water Rope Array," a confinement type of formation capable of condensing water ropes imbued with the effect of confinement, used for binding and sealing the enemy.
Yuan Ming surveyed the terrain of Coral Island, quickly arriving at the shallow sea area on the southern side of the island with relatively flat terrain favorable for setting up the array.
He buried the Array Flags into the ground and inserted Spirit Stones at the corresponding locations.
The Thousand Knot Water Rope Array was a Water attribute formation, best activated with Water attribute Spirit Stones. Unfortunately, Yuan Ming didn't have many of them, so he had to make do with other types of Spirit Stones to quickly set up the formation.
He held the Main Array Flag and activated it, bright blue light rising from the seabed and merging into the sea. The water near the formation quickly condensed, forming water ropes of various sizes.
This was Yuan Ming's first time setting up a Great Array, and he was full of interest, making hand gestures as if in preparation.
Several water ropes shot out from within the array, disappearing into the nearby sea.
A hundred yards away in the deep sea, an octopus sea beast was chasing after its prey when several blue shadows flashed by, its body bound by several of the water ropes.

The octopus sea beast was shocked and struggled fiercely. A power of confinement permeated from the water ropes, rendering its entire body powerless, and its eight tentacles drooped down limply.
The water ropes suddenly contracted, and the octopus sea beast's vision blurred as it appeared within a large array.
Yuan Ming sensed the octopus sea beast's condition through his Divine Sense, nodded in satisfaction, and stopped controlling the formation.
The water ropes disappeared from the octopus sea beast, and its strength returned. It hurried away toward the distance in panic.
Yuan Ming didn't mind the frantic octopus sea beast, instead he turned and went ashore, finding a concealed place to sit down.
He set up a Barrier around himself with the Four Directions Sealing Spirit Talismans, then took out a stick of Beast Attraction Incense and lit it in the incense burner.
Wisps of white smoke rose, spreading out in all directions.
Yuan Ming took out two black gloves, which were magical artifacts he had obtained from Sang Yan back in Snake King Valley.
These gloves didn't have any enchancements for attack but instead contained an inner space for storing poison gases and mists.
Yuan Ming activated the runes within the gloves, and each glove emitted a suction force, pulling in the white smoke billowing from the Beast Attraction Incense.
After absorbing for a good half moment, Yuan Ming stopped and extinguished the incense.
Both black gloves were now filled with white smoke, which had nearly solidified inside.
Since the white smoke from the Beast Attraction Incense had been absorbed by the gloves, and Yuan Ming had set up a Barrier, no fierce beasts were lured over.
He put away the incense burner and went into the Thousand Knot Water Rope Array, gesturing with his hands.
A water rope as thick as a wrist rose from within the array, disappearing into the nearby water, and after a few breaths, it brought back a half-yard long black sea snake.
This snake also had a hint of demon energy but was merely a Level 1 Lower Stage fierce beast.
Yuan Ming waved his hand to kill the sea snake, leaving a surge of Mana within it, then used the soul crow to take possession and control it, taking one of the black gloves and diving towards the lair of the Vortex Beast, arriving nearby shortly after.
The Mana within the sea snake's body had mostly dissipated, and the soul crow controlled the remaining Mana, pouring it into the black glove, stimulating the runes within.
Bouts of white mist began to roll and gush out, merging into the nearby seawater.

chapters.title: Chapter 252 - 229 Capturing the Beast
chapters.content:
Inside the fissure den, the Vortex Beast had just devoured the Thousand-needle fish and was contentedly closing its eyes to sleep when it suddenly sniffed, seeming to catch a scent, but it did not pay much attention.
Not long after, the creature suddenly lifted its head and looked outside, its eyes showing a wary expression.
As time passed, its eyes slowly began to turn red, and its expression grew agitated as though it wanted to burst out but was also hesitant.
The Sea Snake lurked in a nearby crevice, watching the Vortex Beast's demeanor.
Above the sea, Yuan Ming sighed in relief.
His biggest worry had been that the seawater would block the scent of the Beast Attraction Incense, which is why he had gone to great lengths to carry the Beast Attraction Fog to the vicinity of the Vortex Beast's lair before releasing it with black gloves.
Now, it seemed he had been overly concerned; at most, the seawater affected the spread of the Beast Attraction Incense, but it did not prevent it from working.
Yuan Ming used a soul crow to control another sea beast he had hunted, approaching the underwater lair with a second glove and releasing the Beast Attraction White Fog in the same manner.
Gradually, the Vortex Beast's eyes became even more bloodshot, almost to the point of dripping blood, and the area around its lower abdomen turned red and swollen, with scales opening and closing continuously.
A moment later, the Vortex Beast could no longer endure and burst out of its den.
Upon seeing this, Yuan Ming quickly took out the incense burner and lit the Beast Attraction Incense, releasing plumes of white fog.
He then took out a homemade Poisonous Incense and a Seven-step Immovable Falling Incense to insert into the burner and ignite.
After completing these steps, Yuan Ming slapped a blue talisman on himself and donned a Concealment Cloak, submerging into the sea.
This blue talisman was called an "Anti-water Talisman," capable of isolating water currents and allowing the caster to lurk underwater for an extended period. Once cloaked in Concealment, even the Mana fluctuations of the Anti-water Talisman were completely isolated.
Above the sea surface, only an incense burner quietly floated there, quickly dispersing the Beast Attraction White Fog.
Amid the "splashing" sounds of water, a lizard-like sea beast with red eyes swam over rapidly; it was a Low-level Fierce Beast of the First Level Lower Stage, which suddenly leapt out of the water and lunged at the incense burner.
However, just as the creature was about to reach the burner, the green incense burner "whooshed" up into the sky and hovered a dozen feet above. The lizard sea beast frantically swam below, but without the ability to fly up and reach the incense burner, it could only fret anxiously.
The continuous "splashing" sounds of water followed as more and more sea beasts were attracted, quickly accumulating twenty or thirty of them, all low-level sea beasts, including two that had reached the First Level Upper Stage.
Yuan Ming, hiding nearby in the sea, watched this scene with quiet satisfaction at the effect of the incense burner's Beast Attraction Incense. In the future, if he needed to hunt Fierce Beasts, there would be no need to search arduously; simply light the incense, and the Fierce Beasts would be naturally drawn to him.
At that moment, the water near Coral Island "splashed," and the Vortex Beast emerged from the sea with its eyes completely blood-red, drooling thick saliva from its mouth, and excitedly pounced toward the floating incense burner.
The sea beasts below detected the Vortex Beast's presence and showed expressions of panic, retreating to give way, yet due to the scent of the Beast Attraction Incense, they were reluctant to leave too far.
The Vortex Beast ignored the other sea beasts and swam over quickly, but just as it was about to enter the range of the Thousand Knot Water Rope Array, it suddenly stopped and looked toward the seabed with blood-red eyes, seemingly aware of the Mana fluctuations of the Array.
Yuan Ming, inwardly commenting on the craftiness of the Vortex Beast, quietly took out the Main Array Flag and began to activate the Great Array.
A flash of blue light passed by near the Vortex Beast, as numerous thick Water Ropes materialized out of thin air, wrapped around its body like lightning, and with a forceful pull, dragged it into the Thousand Knot Water Rope Array.
More Water Ropes rapidly converged from all directions, sweeping toward it.
Despite being driven mad by the Beast Attraction Incense, the Vortex Beast had not completely lost its sanity. It swung its front paws and burst forth with thick blue arcs from within its body, instantly tearing nearly half of the Water Ropes around it.
With a Level 2 Peak strength and abundant demonic power, the Water Ropes had not fully formed their bindings, and the restraining force could not significantly affect it.
Yuan Ming narrowed his eyes and, after a brief moment of contemplation, made a gestured and pointed into the void.
A glint of spiritual light passed behind the Vortex Beast, as the Cold Star Sword and the Nine-Ring Gold Saber, two magical artifacts, shot out and slashed towards the Vortex Beast's back.
"Ao!"
The Vortex Beast let out a low roar, and the water around it suddenly rose, rapidly spinning around its body, instantly forming a fast-rotating vortex water pillar.
The Cold Star Sword and the Nine-Ring Gold Saber struck it and were immediately repelled by the spinning water, not even touching the Vortex Beast.
The Vortex Beast continued to generate blue lightning to tear apart the Water Ropes around it and violently stomped its foot, causing the nearby water to surge dramatically, creating seven or eight deep whirlpools, roaring from within.
With a loud noise, seven or eight thick water pillars burst from the depths of the whirlpools, each as thick as a grinding disc, twisting in mid-air like agile dragons, moving as if alive, all striking towards the locations where the three magical artifacts emerged from the water.
The sea surface burst open with a "thunderous" noise, and the water pillars hit the seabed about a meter deep, easily creating a pit several tens of feet deep, scattering mud and sand, and turning nearby waters murky.
Yuan Ming, hiding on another side, was not affected by the water pillars, and continued to control the Cold Star Sword and the Nine-Ring Gold Saber to attack the Vortex Beast, drawing its attention.
Meanwhile, he released the White Ape and took control of a soul crow, pulling out the Corpse Sealing Nail from its head.
The aura emitted by the White Ape suddenly surged, causing the nearby Spiritual Energy to become chaotic.
The Vortex Beast abruptly looked over, its expression grave.
The White Ape's figure "rushed" out of the water with a splash, its huge body leveraging the water's surface as it lunged towards the Vortex Beast, cutting through the sea and creating a long trail of white waves.
The Vortex Beast was alarmed, its arms radiated a bursting blue glow, and the surrounding whirlpool water columns thickened suddenly, nearly doubling in size. From the nearby vortexes, several water columns rose and shot towards the White Ape.
The White Ape let out a mighty roar to the sky and swung a powerful punch.
Within a radius of ten feet, the air exploded with a series of booms, an overwhelming force pressed on.
The corpse of the Heavenly Snake Master absorbed Yin Qi and transformed into a being similar to a Human Demon. Although its previous Cultivation was astonishing, its combat power had actually dropped below the Core Formation Stage. However, since wearing the White Ape Skin, the corpse of the Heavenly Snake Master's strength had greatly increased, surpassing even the strongest Body Cultivation practitioner Yuan Ming had seen, Long Hao, and effectively reentering the realm of the Core Formation Stage.
Before the water columns could reach the White Ape, they were shattered by the overwhelming Fist Power. The White Ape's figure turned into a white blur and instantly appeared near the Vortex Beast. Its huge fist turned into a white afterimage as it struck the whirlpool water column.
A crackling sound of shattering echoed, and the whirlpool water columns, which neither the Cold Star Sword nor the Nine-Ring Gold Saber could damage, were shattered by a single punch.Publication courtesy of *.
The White Ape's punches were as fast as lightning, landing solidly on the Vortex Beast's shoulder.
The Vortex Beast's shoulder exploded on impact, and one right arm spun off, flying away as the massive body was also knocked back.
Yuan Ming was overjoyed. He manipulated the Cold Star Sword and Nine-Ring Gold Saber that had been waiting behind, striking with full force at the Vortex Beast's back.
Two half-foot-long wounds were slashed onto the back of the Vortex Beast, but the skin and flesh were not deeply injured.
Yuan Ming's gaze darkened, realizing his Cultivation and the Vortex Beast were too far apart. Any attack would be futile, so he focused most of his effort on controlling the Thousand Knot Water Rope Array and the White Ape.
Thick water ropes shot out from the sea surface, tangling the Vortex Beast once again and firmly restraining it. The White Ape transformed into a white blur, closely pursuing.
The pain from the severed arm was unbearable for the Vortex Beast. It suppressed the influence of the Beast Attraction Incense. Its eyes, once bloodshot, now cleared up significantly. Regaining its senses, it extended its remaining left arm, which glowed brightly with a blue light, and waved it through the air.
Suddenly, huge waves several tens of feet high rose from the nearby sea, like giant palms covering the sky, crashing towards the White Ape.
The White Ape's arms suddenly became a blur, striking in quick succession, shattering all the incoming waves, but its advance was blocked.
The Vortex Beast let out a low growl, and bright blue thunder and lightning surged on its left arm. A destructive aura burst forth. Even from a distance, Yuan Ming's hair stood on end.
His inner alarm bells ringing wildly, he decisively abandoned his concealment and raised the white Jade Shuttle, shooting up towards the sky. The incense burner, the Cold Star Sword, and the Nine-Ring Gold Saber were also taken away with him.
The Vortex Beast moved its left arm, and the blue thunder light shot out from it, forming a thunder blade about ten feet long, which struck the surrounding water ropes.
With a "sizzle" like the tearing of fabric, all the water ropes were easily cut.
The thunder blade then exploded, turning into dense blue thunder and lightning, submerging everything within a dozen feet. Each arc of electricity was as powerful as a strike from a Thunder Strike Talisman.
The sea surface instantly boiled, the water ropes formed by the Thousand Knot Water Rope Array were all shattered, and the Array at the bottom of the sea was damaged, unable to continue operating.
The White Ape was also affected by the blue thunder and lightning. The Heavenly Snake Master encased in Ape Skin was a dead thing, and the Power of thunder and lightning was its nemesis. Yuan Ming hurriedly controlled it to retreat.
The Vortex Beast continued to use its Divine Skills, its aura declining considerably, before transforming into a black shadow and diving towards the deep sea.
Yuan Ming acted urgently, about to risk personal action, when the Vortex Beast suddenly staggered, appearing as if it was intoxicated.
His eyes lit up with joy, recognizing that the Poisonous Incense and Seven-step Immovable were finally taking effect. He quickly surfaced and, with a wave of his hand, threw a round bronze sphere, hitting right in front of the Vortex Beast. It was a Heart-splitting Bomb.
A blinding streak of light, and the Heart-splitting Bomb suddenly split, a brilliant silver-white thunder light erupted. In a flash, it formed a striking thunder and lightning Light Pillar, crashing heavily into the Vortex Beast's chest.
The Vortex Beast's chest was split by a wound half a yard long, and it staggered back.
The White Ape's figure shot from the side. A fan-shaped Golden Light suddenly appeared out of nowhere. In a flash, the White Ape stood behind the Vortex Beast, holding a golden long sword in its hand, which was the Golden Snake Sword.
A flash of Golden Light, and the Vortex Beast's head tilted and fell off. A fountain of blood sprayed out, and the massive body wobbled before collapsing into the water.
Yuan Ming felt relieved and quickly collected the corpse of the Vortex Beast. He even retrieved the severed arm and lifted the Thousand Knot Water Rope Array from the sea bed.
After the soul crow that had dived into the sea returned with the pair of gloves, he put away the soul crow and the gloves, raised the Jade Shuttle Magical Artifact, and sped away into the distance.

chapters.title: Chapter 253 - 230 Ren Xiaoyao
chapters.content:
A moment later, Yuan Ming landed eagerly on another island.
His eyes brimmed with threads of blood, a consequence of the demonic influence that eroded him while he controlled the White Ape through the possession of the soul crow.
As the White Ape's strength surged, so did the evil energy within its body become increasingly dense. Using the soul crow to manipulate it placed a burden on his own Divine Soul, which would have grown severalfold had it not been for his Moonlight Technique reaching the third layer—without it, he couldn't have lasted until now.
Yuan Ming quickly found a secluded spot on the island to sit down, where he used the Four Directions Sealing Spirit Talisman to set up a barrier and then began to sit cross-legged on the ground, closing his eyes to circulate the Moonlight Technique.
No sooner had he sat down when he felt a sensation of the world spinning, his entire body unbearably hot. Yet the continuous flow of warmth from the Stealing Heaven Tripod mark on his arm kept the last bit of clarity in his mind.
"Uh... Ah!"
With a bite of his tongue tip, Yuan Ming let out a low growl he purposely suppressed, filled with a bloodthirsty ferocity, yet finally regained some control over his body.
He hurriedly circulated the Moonlight Technique throughout his body, and soon his Divine Sense cleared up.
After a quarter of an hour, aided by the combined power of the Moonlight Technique and the Stealing Heaven Tripod, he managed to rid his mind of all the malevolent thoughts that filled it.
Yuan Ming let out a heavy sigh of relief, opened his eyes, and lightly brushed away the sweat on his forehead.
At this moment, he further realized why Soul Cultivation was so unwelcome in the Cultivation World.
Soul Cultivation was exceedingly perilous, both in its practice and when casting spells, deterring most people. Yet, because of the formidable power of Soul Cultivation Methods, there were always those unafraid of death who pressed on with the practice. Eventually, the few who succeeded could nearly sweep across their rank, even beyond.
Naturally, this was a situation most people didn't want to see.
Chen Cangqiong, the Great Elder of Biluo Cave, wouldn't need to resort to immoral acts. As long as there was a chance for his cultivation to break through the late-stage Core Formation, Dawn—or rather, the powers behind it—probably would find other reasons to swiftly dispose of him.
It seemed he would need to be more cautious in his actions from now on, especially once he returned to the Central Plains. It would be best not to reveal his identity as a Soul Cultivator in front of others.
He composed himself, took out the carcass of the Vortex Beast, and began to probe its interior with his Divine Sense.
Both his soul crows and the Black Needle Magical Artifact were inside the creature, and he had yet to extract them, which was truly strange.
Yuan Ming carefully explored the Vortex Beast's carcass with his Divine Sense, finding nothing until his Divine Sense swept through its stomach, which made him raise an eyebrow.
It seemed as though a special power within the pitch-black stomach of the Vortex Beast was blocking his Divine Sense. Could the Black Needle Magical Artifact and the soul crows be inside?
According to the Sea Beast Manual, though many parts of the Vortex Beast's body were valuable spiritual materials, the stomach wasn't included.
Yuan Ming took out the Cold Star Sword, carefully cut out the stomach, and removed it.
As soon as the stomach was separated from the body of the Vortex Beast, the special power inside began to leak out. Yuan Ming distinctly sensed the aura of the Black Needle and the soul crows within the stomach.
He carefully cut open the stomach, and out flew the Black Needle and the two soul crows.
Yuan Ming put away the Black Needle and soul crows and continued to cut open the stomach, soon splitting it completely.
A silver token quietly laid inside, engraved with strange patterns, which was the source of that special power.
When Yuan Ming tried to check it with his Divine Sense, he found it was impossible to get close to the token; an invisible force bounced his Divine Sense away from it within about a foot's distance.
He pondered for a moment and then cast the Exorcism Technique; the silver token floated up without any abnormalities.
Yuan Ming then wrapped a stream of Mana around the silver token. The token still showed no unusual reactions, so he felt safe to pick it up.
The silver token was cool to the touch and smooth, as if it were entirely carved from a piece of Cold Jade.
When he circulated his Mana into it, the surface of the token emitted a faint silver glow, with no other abnormalities.
Yuan Ming was not convinced and continued to turn it over, trying to investigate, but unfortunately still had no clue.
He thought of something and picked up the Vortex Beast's stomach again, only to find that it now showed no signs of anomaly and was no different from usual internal organs.
Yuan Ming's gaze shifted, and he placed the token back into the stomach. The stomach displayed no changes.
He let out a wry smile, not understanding the reason and deciding not to bother any longer. He was about to place the token into his Storage Ring.
The moment his palm touched the Vortex Beast's stomach, it was covered in mucus. The silver token, also slippery, slid down from his fingertips and fell to the ground.
Once the token touched the ground, the surface suddenly burst out with a liquid-like silver light that rapidly spread across the ground, quickly reaching the Barrier formed by the Four Directions Sealing Spirit Talisman.
In just a few breaths, the ground and the Barrier were enveloped in a layer of silver light. Yuan Ming's Divine Sense could not penetrate the Barrier to sense what was outside; inside and outside seemed to be completely isolated.
With a surprised expression, he looked at his surroundings and picked up the token from the ground.
As soon as it left the ground, the silver light on the Barrier quickly dissipated, and the Divine Sense could extend inside and out with ease.
Yuan Ming realized something; he took out a wooden box, threw the token inside, and closed the lid. An invisible force immediately shrouded the box's interior, making it impervious to his Divine Sense.
Upon opening the box's lid, everything returned to normal.
Yuan Ming revealed a faint smile at the corner of his mouth, as expected, the token would emit a silver light and seal any enclosed space the moment it touched any side of it, as long as it was in a confined space.
Although he did not know why this was so, this silver token was clearly a peculiar and rare treasure. If used well, it could bring about wondrous effects.
The Vortex Beast somehow found this token and swallowed it, which then gave it the ability to devour magic artifacts.
Yuan Ming stored the token carefully and also collected the corpse of the Vortex Beast, then summoned the Green Cloud Crane and flew towards Ning City.
His mood was different from the anxiousness he felt on his way here. Now that his objective was achieved, he was in no rush, allowing the Green Cloud Crane to gallop freely above the sea surface.
Standing against the wind, gazing at the vast sea and rolling waves around him, feeling the sea breeze against his cheeks and the bright sun on his face, he suddenly felt his chest broaden as if all the trials and tribulations he had undergone seemed so insignificant in front of the vast sea, as if they didn't matter at all.
At the same time, a surge of heroic spirit arose in his heart. One day, he had resolved to master that legendary Great Divine Power that could move mountains and fill seas, to travel across thousands of miles of land as unknown as the sea, to truly see the original face of this world.
The "White Horse Youthful Dream" of his childhood had settled deep in the memories he could no longer return to. The martial arts world was no longer the same, and now, having emerged anew from his cocoon, he would start venturing through the world that belonged to him.
"A laugh spans the sea, past dreams drift far, unaware of the myriad miles of mountains and rivers, how many dawns have passed this evening? I practice Soul Cultivation against heaven's will, fearing not the world's censure, what do Immortals fear? I'll steal the heavens and embrace the Ming Yue, all shackles shall turn to mist!"For a bet%te@r! re&a%d%in#g% e+x$p-e.r%i%en*ce+,- vi*s#i.t M#(V&LE^M%P@Y!R)%.+
Riding the green cloud, wielding the Cold Star, the needle leaves no shadow. Where did the past go? No one joins me in my drunken song.
The homeland is thousands of miles away, the longing intense as an arrow's flight, people's hearts as deep as the sea. With a broad and righteous spirit, I roam the world freely!"
Yuan Ming took out a jug of wine, tipped back his head to drink a big gulp, and began to sing a ballad, spontaneously expressing the sentiments of his heart.
A man and a crane, in the midst of the monochromatic sea and sky, journeyed farther and farther away.
...
Half a day later.
Yuan Ming returned to Ning City and did not immediately go to find Immortal Xuanhua. Going back and forth a hundred miles and slaying a Level 2 Peak Fierce Beast within such a short time was too shocking, and it would probably scare Immortal Xuanhua and the others.
Yuan Ming found an inn to rest for the night, and early the next morning, he casually stepped into Xuanhua Temple.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, did you encounter problems while hunting the beast? It's alright if you did, the Vortex Beast is as strong as a Half-step Core Formation Cultivator and is not easy to handle," Immortal Xuanhua said upon seeing Yuan Ming returning so early. He had a sinking feeling, but his face showed indifference.
Yuan Ming said nothing, taking out a Storage Bag and handing it over.
Immortal Xuanhua was taken aback, accepted the Storage Bag and sent his Divine Sense into it.
His eyes immediately widened, his mouth half-opened with an expression of disbelief, which then turned into ecstasy. It took a while before he managed to calm himself down.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, you and your friends are truly remarkable, to have slain the Vortex Beast so quickly! With this beast, Xuanhua Temple can avoid this disaster, thank you!" Immortal Xuanhua deeply bowed to Yuan Ming.
"There's no need for such formalities, Fellow Daoist Xuan Hua. I did it for the Foundation Establishment Spirit Incense," Yuan Ming returned the bow.
"Rest assured, Fellow Daoist Yuan, if I get the Heavenly Glue, I will do my utmost to refine the Foundation Establishment Spirit Incense as a token of gratitude," Immortal Xuanhua solemnly said.
Just then, a series of rushed footsteps came from outside, and a Xuanhua Temple disciple ran in, his face full of panic.
"Master, it's bad news. A group of people has barged in, blocking our gate!"
"It seems Elder Bai Lin has arrived. That man truly is impatient. I have no wish to meet with him; I'll leave everything to Fellow Daoist Xuan Hua to handle," Yuan Ming said, and stepped into the inner chamber.
"Don't panic, let them in," Immortal Xuanhua turned around and calmly said.
"Hehe, Temple Master Xuanhua has come to his senses? You should have done so earlier; hand over the Incense Making Secret Manual, and we can all end this nicely," the Xuanhua Temple disciple had not yet spoken when a group of people walked in with big strides, led by Bai Lin.
Next to Bai Lin was a blue-robed man, walking shoulder to shoulder with him; by his bearing, he too was a Foundation Establishment Cultivator.
"The Blue Lizard Daoist is also here. I'm afraid you will be disappointed," Immortal Xuanhua's gaze fell on the blue-robed man as he calmly shook his head.
"I've long told you that Old Daoist Xuanhua is stubborn and unchanged; why waste time with him?" the Blue Lizard Wanderer casually sat down on a nearby chair and said.
"So it seems, Temple Master Xuanhua, that you intend to persist in your folly? If that's the case, don't blame Bai for not showing mercy!" Bai Lin said with a dark expression, raising his hand.
His accompanying Cultivators slowly surrounded them, and around Xuanhua Temple strands of white light appeared, quickly condensing into a white light barrier that enveloped the entire temple.
"Elder Bai Lin, there's no need to hurry. Take a look at this first," Immortal Xuanhua's expression changed slightly as he threw over the Storage Bag.
Bai Lin caught it and instinctively scanned it with his Divine Sense, then froze on the spot, his reaction mirroring Immortal Xuanhua's from earlier.
"What happened?" the Blue Lizard Wanderer, unable to help himself, asked.
"How could Xuanhua Temple possibly have slain this Fierce Beast!" Bai Lin ignored the Blue Lizard Wanderer, turning to ask Immortal Xuanhua.
"Our temple has been assisted by a venerable expert," Immortal Xuanhua proudly said.
"A venerable expert? Could it be that friend in the back chamber? Why not meet in person, and we can all make a friend," Bai Lin looked at the inner chamber and raised his voice.

chapters.title: Chapter 254 - 231: The Fox Exploits the Tiger's Might
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming's eyebrows slightly knitted as he took out a cyan robe and put it on before stepping out.
The robe was obtained from the storage magic tool of Lin Liumu, a disciple's attire from Chang Chun Temple.
"I dare not claim to be a highly skilled expert. I, Lin, am just an ordinary disciple from Chang Chun Temple," Yuan Ming said frankly.
"A disciple of Chang Chun Temple!" The eyes of Bai Lin and the others landed on Yuan Ming, who was dressed in the attire of Chang Chun Temple, his bearing vibrant and his demeanor haughty.
The Southern Border Eastern Domain bordered the Central Plains, and there was frequent interaction. They understood the Immortal Cultivation World of the Central Plains far better than any other region in the Southern Border. Although White Dragon Island was one of the four major sects in the Eastern Domain, it was nowhere near the level of Chang Chun Temple.
The expression of Blue Lizard Wanderer also turned solemn, and he slowly rose from his seat.
Upon hearing Yuan Ming's words, Immortal Xuanhua's face also showed surprise, but he reacted very quickly and soon returned to calm.
"Haha, so you are a disciple of Chang Chun Temple. I, Bai, also know a few friends from Chang Chun Temple. May I ask which esteemed surname and given name you might carry, Fellow Daoist? Whose disciple are you?" Bai Lin gave a secret signal with his eyes, indicating for the people crowded around to step back, then stepped forward and cupped his fists in greeting.
The white barrier outside Xuanhua Temple also gradually dissipated.
"I am Lin Liumu, a disciple of Elder Xu Changqing of Chang Chun Temple. I have come to Xuanhua Temple on behalf of my master to negotiate the trade of Spirit Incense," Yuan Ming said, taking out Xu Changqing's identity token and giving it a shake.
Bai Lin, responsible for managing the trade of spiritual materials on White Dragon Island, indeed had some dealings with disciples of Chang Chun Temple, and had vaguely heard the name Xu Changqing. Seeing the identity token in Yuan Ming's hand, any doubts he had evaporated, and his face broke into an eager smile, "So it's Fellow Daoist Lin, what a fortunate meeting. Elder Xu has long been renowned in Ning City, but I have not had the opportunity to meet him. I hope Fellow Daoist Lin could introduce me when the chance arises."
"My master is here on other urgent matters, but I will convey Elder Bai's greetings," Yuan Ming said calmly.
Bai Lin nodded with a smile, his thoughts racing in his mind.
He hadn't expected someone from Chang Chun Temple to get involved in this matter. Naturally, he had to handle it with care, as angering the other party was definitely something he couldn't afford.
"My master is aware of the differences you've had with Xuanhua Temple. This Vortex Beast was hunted by his hand as a gesture to White Dragon Island. I wonder if Elder Bai Lin is satisfied?" Yuan Ming looked at Bai Lin and asked.
"Satisfied, of course, I am satisfied. To have a matter so trivial trouble Elder Xu himself, I shall offer my apologies in person when I have the chance." Bai Lin said with a smile.
"Then that's good. Xuanhua Temple will need to provide various types of Spirit Incense to Chang Chun Temple for a long time to come. Let's hope that no minor issues will get in the way of important matters," Yuan Ming said with a smile.
"Of course, I understand," Bai Lin nodded again and again.
"And who might this be?" Yuan Ming nodded with satisfaction, his gaze shifting to the Blue Lizard Wanderer by the side. His tone shifted from light-hearted to somber.
The atmosphere around them quickly turned cold, and many people instinctively held their breath.
The Blue Lizard Wanderer clenched his fists, unable to utter a single word.
Even though Yuan Ming was just a Qi Refining Stage Cultivator, he was backed by Chang Chun Temple, an entity as colossal and unreachable for White Dragon Island, let alone for a Loose Cultivator like him.
"This is Blue Lizard Wanderer. I was originally planning to entrust him with hunting this Vortex Beast at sea. Now that Elder Xu has acted, naturally, his services aren't needed," Bai Lin said, stepping forward to defend the Blue Lizard Wanderer as the situation demanded.
"Oh, so this is the Blue Lizard Wanderer. I have heard from the Temple Master of Xuanhua Temple that you would like to acquire Xuanhua Temple's Incense Making Secret Manual. My Chang Chun Temple also appreciates the Spirit Incense produced by Xuanhua Temple. However, we only negotiate trades with the Xuanhua Temple Master and have never considered taking someone else's heritage by force. You do seem to have quite the ambition," Yuan Ming's expression turned colder, his eyes like two deep, cold pools.
The color drained from Blue Lizard Wanderer's face, and fine beads of cold sweat appeared on his forehead.
"Fellow Daoist Lin. The Blue Lizard Wanderer was acting out of good intentions, which led to a misunderstanding. I, Bai, guarantee that such incidents will not occur in the future. Blue Lizard Daoist, why don't you step forward and offer your apology to Fellow Daoist Lin," Bai Lin said after slight hesitation, signaling Blue Lizard Wanderer with his eyes.
"I was momentarily confused. Please forgive me, Fellow Daoist Lin and Temple Master Xuanhua," Blue Lizard Wanderer said, taking a deep breath and clasping his fists.
"I, too, am to blame for this matter. In addition to the Heavenly Glue, there are three precious pieces of spirit wood produced by White Dragon Island, all of high quality. I hope Fellow Daoist Lin and Temple Master Xuanhua will accept them," Bai Lin said, taking out a storage magic tool and handing it over.
Yuan Ming did not receive it and glanced at Immortal Xuanhua.This copy was generated from content at *.
Immortal Xuanhua took the magic tool, activated his Divine Sense to scan it, and nodded at Yuan Ming.
"All right, for Elder Bai's sake, I will not pursue the matter further," Yuan Ming's expression softened.
