The old emperor frowned upon hearing this and turned to the State Preceptor:
"Master Yu Hu, though you hold the esteemed position of State Preceptor, your duty is to guide the new Emperor in his Cultivation, not to meddle in secular state affairs. Do not forget, Lin Junsheng has only entered your mentorship and has yet to be officially recorded in the genealogy of Chang Chun Temple."
What he meant was that Lin Junsheng was not yet an official disciple of Chang Chun Temple, and should thus fall under the jurisdiction of Da Jin, not to be protected by him.
The old emperor didn't really care who lived or died in these secular matters; what mattered to him was whether his grandson, who had excellent qualifications for Cultivation, could enter Chang Chun Temple for Cultivation as soon as possible.
Upon hearing these words, the State Preceptor opened his mouth as if to speak, but finally, under the old emperor's stern gaze, shut it again.
This meant that no one else would speak out on behalf of Lin Junsheng and Prince Xian, sealing their inevitable doom.
Lin Junsheng's last glimmer of hope extinguished, and he slumped to the ground in defeat.
"Bring Prince Xian and Lin Junsheng to the prison, and execute them without delay," the Emperor commanded in a low shout, and immediately Armored Soldiers stepped forward to seize the two men.
Prince Xian's face showed terror, and he began to speak, but after locking eyes with the State Preceptor, immediately fell silent as if struck by a chill.
Lin Junsheng also seemed to have lost his soul, his entire being in a state of stupor. But when someone grasped his arms again, he suddenly became hysterical.
He flung his arms, struggling to throw off the two men controlling him, and with a face full of unwillingness roared out:
"Your Majesty, I have been wronged! The reason I was misled by Prince Xian is that there is someone else behind this, and that person is the... "
Just as the words "State Preceptor" were on the brink of escaping, everyone in the room was greatly shocked.
Prince Xian looked at Lin Junsheng as if he were a madman, whereas Yuan Ming, the one involved, was the most composed of all.
At that moment, everyone in the hall felt a scorching wave of heat rise up.
"Whoosh... "
A fiery Fireball roared out, and before Lin Junsheng could spout his mad accusations, it struck him in the chest.
In the next instant, the firelight suddenly exploded with a loud bang.
Lin Junsheng's body burst into Flames in midair, turning to ash.
The powerful blast knocked over the surrounding Civil Servants and military officers, throwing the hall into chaos, with the Armored Soldiers stationed outside all drawing their swords and rushing in.
"Silencing the witness?" was the first thought that came to everyone's mind.
They all turned their gazes to the State Preceptor, only to see him calmly drinking tea, making no move to attack.
It was then that they were surprised to discover that the caster of the Burning Explosion Skill was none other than the little Emperor Liu Tianming himself.
"Audacious traitor, My decree has already been pronounced, and yet he dared to speak and bring false accusations; he truly deserved to die," the Emperor shouted in anger.
As he spoke, he couldn't help but glance at Yuan Ming by his side. Seeing that Yuan Ming still maintained his composure, with no particular reaction to the event, the Emperor then relaxed.
Yuan Ming actually understood the Emperor's dilemma. Dealing with Lin Junsheng and the Eighth Prince during today's succession ceremony was something they had agreed upon beforehand. But that was as far as it went; no matter how one looked at it, Yuan Ming's power was insufficient to make the State Preceptor pay the price. The State Preceptor's reputation, Cultivation, the backing of Chang Chun Temple, and even his influence in the court far exceeded that of Yuan Ming.
"The matter is settled; let the succession ceremony continue," the Emperor declared, effectively putting an end to the drama. Servants immediately came forward to clean the mess in the hall.
Everyone breathed a sigh of relief that the upheaval was finally subsiding.
"Your Majesty, I have something to say," Yuan Ming's voice suddenly rose at that moment.
It was then that everyone realized that Yuan Ming, as the person involved, had said very little during the entire conflict. His presence was so minimal that people had almost forgotten he was the unfortunate victim.
So when he started to speak, everyone's eyes were immediately drawn to him.
The Emperor's expression changed slightly, and General Yuan's brows also furrowed in nervousness.
The two of them were the most knowledgeable of Yuan Ming in the entire hall and immediately guessed what Yuan Ming intended to do.

chapters.title: Chapter 268 - 245: On What Basis?
chapters.content:
"Yuan Ming, whatever it is, let it wait until after the ceremony," the Emperor advised.
Yet Yuan Ming merely smiled at him, shook his head, and then turned to address the ministers and generals of the court, raising his voice:
"Ladies and gentlemen, concerning the ambush I encountered at the Southern Border, whether it be Prince Xian who was captured or Lin Junsheng who was killed, both were merely puppets manipulated by others. The real mastermind is someone else."
As soon as these words were spoken, an eerie silence fell upon the great hall, and many involuntarily turned their gaze toward the State Preceptor, only to quickly look away.
The reactions of Lin Junsheng and Prince Xian had already provided these seasoned officials with the answer; what puzzled them, however, was why Yuan Ming would so recklessly pierce this veil of decency.
Could it be that he truly had the confidence to overthrow the State Preceptor single-handedly?
Or was he relying on the Emperor's favor, becoming arrogant and forgetting that the State Preceptor was from Chang Chun Temple and a Foundation Establishment Cultivator whom the laws of Da Jin might not be able to restrain?
A genius who rose to fame at a young age, a mere Qi Refinement Realm cultivator, should not act so impulsively.
"Yuan Ming..."
The Emperor suddenly raised his voice, silently shaking his head at him.
Yuan Ming merely glanced at him, then smiled and, pointing directly at the State Preceptor, loudly demanded, "Master Yu Hu, I, Yuan Ming, have neither grudge nor grievance against you. Why then, do you seek to harm me unto death?"
A single stone stirred up a thousand ripples.
The veil was ultimately ripped asunder by Yuan Ming's outstretched finger.
"How dare you slander the State Preceptor like this?" a cultivator from Chang Chun Temple, standing at the back, was the first to lose his patience and shouted angrily.
"The State Preceptor is upright and virtuous, having performed rituals for Da Jin for many years, ensuring the prosperity of our empire. He is a pillar of our nation; how dare you accuse him so?" the Minister of Rites, an older man with grey hair, stepped forward and scolded.
"The State Preceptor has always been righteous and virtuous; how could he make a move against a mortal?" others also expressed their doubts.
...
The Emperor watched silently as these varied and tumultuous words floated around him, sighed inwardly, yet did not reprimand Yuan Ming.
For in truth, Yuan Ming had done nothing wrong.
"State Preceptor, regardless, shouldn't you come forward and give us, the Yuan Family, an explanation?" At that moment, a powerful voice suddenly overwhelmed the noise of the other civil servants' debates.
General Yuan's eyes were slightly red, and he fixed his gaze steadfastly on the State Preceptor.
Although he knew he could not challenge the State Preceptor with his own power, as a father, he had to stand firm and support his son.
"State Preceptor, this matter ultimately requires an explanation to Yuan Ming," the Emperor also spoke up.
Now that the matter had been brought to light, he had no other choice but to stand by Yuan Ming.
Master Yu Hu looked at Yuan Ming, his gaze solemn for a long time, finally sighing and standing up.
"Arranging for Prince Xian and instructing Lin Junsheng to assassinate Yuan Ming on his mission to the Southern Border was indeed my doing," the State Preceptor suddenly confessed.
"What, why would you do that..."
"Impossible, why would you ever resort to that, State Preceptor?"
"What has Yuan Ming done to warrant such actions from the State Preceptor?"
Questions arose tumultuously.
The old Emperor also could not help but frown and look at him.
"While it is true that I did it, I do not believe I did anything wrong," the State Preceptor spoke again, dropping another bombshell that exploded in everyone's hearts.
"What a thing to not consider wrong!" Yuan Ming responded, not with anger but with laughter, clapping his hands.
"Yuan Ming, you were deemed to have poor talents back then and could not enter Chang Chun Temple for cultivation. Angered, you used trickery and painting to beguile His Majesty, causing him to give up cultivation even though he possessed supreme talent. You even used your mission as a pretext to pave your way for entering the official ranks. If you were not eliminated, His Majesty would not embark on the path of cultivation, eventually straying and missing the best opportunity to ascend the Immortal Path," the State Preceptor declared bluntly to Yuan Ming.Brоught tо yоu by МV6LЕМРY6R.
Upon hearing this, the entire court was stunned.
They had never imagined that the State Preceptor had acted for this reason.
Even the look the old Emperor gave the two confronting men grew much deeper.
"So that was it, so that was it..."
"It seems the State Preceptor would not act for personal gain against justice, and indeed, all was for His Majesty," the Minister of Rites, as if finding an undeniable reason, suddenly remarked.
His words quickly gained the support of many civil servants, who began to speak out in praise.
Suddenly, the justification for the State Preceptor's attempt to kill Yuan Ming seemed utterly appropriate.
"Yuan Ming, you have deeply misled His Majesty. Had it not been for you, His Majesty might have already reached the Foundation Establishment two years ago. In the path of cultivation, to be slow by a step means being slow in every step. You are truly the guilty official," a disciple of Chang Chun Temple also began to shout.
The observing elder from Bailuo Manor and Fairy Luoshui from the Water Spirit Palace also nodded quietly, showing their agreement.
At once, the voices of accusation overwhelmed those calling for accountability, and the few voices opposing the State Preceptor were suppressed.
"Ladies and gentlemen, if it was your children who were targeted, murdered, and had experienced hardships in the barbaric land of Southern Border, would you still condemn them so righteously?" General Yuan finally couldn't bear it any longer and stood up to challenge. "Yuan Ming has never bewitched the Emperor; in fact, he has always privately advised the Emperor to enter Chang Chun Temple for cultivation. What right do you have to harshly criticise my son when he is clearly the one being persecuted?"
These forceful questions silenced everyone.
A long while passed before the young Emperor recovered from his shock. He had never imagined that the State Preceptor's reason for acting against Yuan Ming was actually for his own sake.
"Indeed, you have wronged Yuan Ming. My reluctance to cultivate is entirely due to personal reasons and my resistance to the idea of secluded cultivation in that temple has nothing to do with Yuan Ming," the young Emperor wearily stated.
"Perhaps I was wrong, but does Yuan Ming bear no responsibility for misleading and obstructing?" the State Preceptor finally conceded, seeing the young Emperor completely siding with Yuan Ming.
I might have been wrong, but is Yuan Ming without faults?
Hearing this, General Yuan's eyes reddened with rage.
Yuan Ming, however, raised his head and closed his eyes, seemingly trying very hard to suppress his anger.
"State Preceptor, when one is wrong, one is wrong—no need for further words. You must compensate Yuan Ming," the young Emperor also showed his anger.
"In that case, let's exceptionally allow Yuan Ming to be recorded in the Daoist lineage alongside the Emperor, to be included in the genealogy, and to enter Chang Chun Temple for cultivation together. Upon completing the Qi Refinement Realm, he may also receive a Foundation Establishment Pill," Master Yu Hu contemplated for a moment and then suggested, stroking his beard.
Upon hearing this, everyone was filled with envy.
The status of Chang Chun Temple in Da Jin Country was paramount; gaining entry for cultivation was exceedingly challenging. It wasn't only about one's background, but primarily about one's cultivation aptitude.
Even the legitimate sons of generals and nobles found it hard to get in, and here was Yuan Ming not only securing a spot but even receiving a promise of obtaining a Foundation Establishment Pill—such a favor was immense.
"Furthermore, after entering Chang Chun Temple, Yuan Ming will also cultivate the 'Nine Elements Technique' together with me, not the 'Chang Chun Skill,'" the young Emperor added.
While having the Nine Elements Technique meant Yuan Ming had it too, private cultivation and legitimate, open cultivation were ultimately two different states.
Upon hearing this, a disciple from Chang Chun Temple was the first to disagree.
"Your Majesty, the Nine Elements Technique is a magical technique that only core disciples can cultivate. What capabilities does Yuan Ming have? Why should he be allowed to cultivate the Nine Elements Technique? Allowing him to cultivate the Chang Chun Skill is already an exception; how can you be so greedy?"
"You say I am being greedy?" the young Emperor scoffed.
"I, I…" the disciple from Chang Chun Temple was momentarily at a loss for words.
"Your Majesty, I cannot decide on the 'Nine Elements Technique,' please excuse me," the State Preceptor bowed slightly and said.
The young Emperor, hearing this, showed hesitation.
"Ladies and gentlemen, I think there may have been some misunderstanding," Yuan Ming's voice rang out again at this moment.
Everyone turned to look at him.
"The reason I am standing here accusing the State Preceptor is not to seek any compensation or to have you advocate for me; I only hope that everyone can witness and give me a chance, a chance to challenge the State Preceptor."
At Yuan Ming's words, everyone was thunderstruck.
"What does he mean, he wants to challenge the State Preceptor?"
"Has Yuan Ming lost his mind? Challenge the State Preceptor... how?"
"Will they compete in painting and calligraphy, or in writing? What a joke!"
...
Whether they supported the State Preceptor or opposed him, everyone thought Yuan Ming was out of his mind.
"We thought he was a genius, but it turns out he's just foolish!"
"The Emperor has already secured a tremendous benefit for you; by doing this, where does that leave the Emperor?"
"Utterly ungrateful and reckless!"
...
"Yuan Ming, what nonsense are you talking about?" Frustrated and furious, General Yuan disregarded court etiquette and rushed to Yuan Ming's side.
He put his hand on his son's shoulder and whispered urgently, "We can't fight the State Preceptor. What the Emperor has done for you is the best compensation possible; don't act recklessly."
"Brother Ming, what exactly are you trying to do?" the young Emperor also came up to Yuan Ming, his brow furrowed, asking in a voice only they could hear.
"Father, Your Majesty, the dangers I encountered in my journey to Southern Border are actually far more than what I've written in 'Young Master Sheng's Southern Journey.' When I left Iron Tiger Town, the State Preceptor even sent Cultivators to kill me once. I made my way back here step by step, just wanting to fight for my own life and my rights. If I don't resolve this openly today, I will have to watch out for him for the rest of my life," Yuan Ming smiled and said.
If it had only been Lin Junsheng's earlier targeting, Yuan Ming might have really accepted the reconciliation from the State Preceptor. But the second assassination outside Iron Tiger Town was something he couldn't forgive.
Once can be forgiven; twice cannot.
Indeed, I, Yuan Ming, reward kindness, but I, Yuan Ming, also seek revenge.
Having said that, he turned to everyone and called out assertively: "A vendetta as deep as death—on what grounds does the State Preceptor lightly phrase an apology and expect me to accept? On what grounds does Chang Chun Temple offer me a cultivation spot and expect me to be grateful? On what grounds should I submit a life-and-death challenge to someone seeking to kill me and you curse me as ungrateful?"
"I must ask you all, what is my fault? Why do you disallow it?" Yuan Ming blazed his eyes over the crowd, demanding in a loud voice.
Yuan Ming's interrogation, like a thunderclap on a dry field, made everyone's cheeks burn in shame, and silenced them completely.

chapters.title: Chapter 269 - 246 Duel
chapters.content:
"I accept."
After a prolonged silence within the great hall, the State Preceptor's voice finally rang out.
"Alas..." From somewhere, a sigh was heard.
"Yuan Ming is truly seeking his own death! I fear that after today, the 'Southern Travel Chronicles' will become a thing of the past."
"Why must it come to this, why oh why."
"Brother Ming, have you thought this through? Are you really going to do this? There's still time to back out, I can..." The Emperor was cut off before he could finish.
"Trust me." Yuan Ming said with a smile, subtly winking at the Emperor.
The Emperor paused for a moment, then remained silent.
Yuan Ming's response also blocked any words of persuasion that General Yuan wished to say.
Despite his worries, he had no choice but to trust, trusting that his son had a reliable basis for his actions.
Soon, the State Preceptor and Yuan Ming signed a life-and-death agreement in the Taian Palace.
The crowd moved to the plaza outside the great hall, where the imperial guard had already cleared the area, leaving enough space for their duel.
"Now that the life-and-death agreement is signed, no one can intervene in your duel until the outcome of... life or death is determined. Afterward, regardless of the results, neither party, nor their families and sects, may seek revenge in any form." The Emperor, revealing his imperial majesty for once, stood on the central platform and announced loudly.
After speaking, he looked toward the old emperor, the white-haired old crone from Bailuo Manor, and Fairy Luoshui beside him.
They were the most prominent witnesses to this duel.
Fairy Luoshui said with regret, "What a pity, a mayfly shaking a tree!"
However, the old emperor said, "The sons of Jin Country should be so, not dishonoring the name of a tiger born of a general."
Having spoken, the three exchanged glances and nodded simultaneously.
"The duel begins." The Emperor raised his hand with a command.
Yuan Ming and the State Preceptor, Master Yu Hu, entered the center of the plaza, standing ten paces apart, facing each other.
"You can still admit defeat now. I can spare your life, but you should no longer harbor dreams of entering Chang Chun Temple, for a rotten wood cannot be sculpted." Master Yu Hu looked at Yuan Ming and spoke indifferently.
Yuan Ming did not speak but simply extended his hand, gesturing an invitation with a "please" posture.
"Since you're courting death, don't blame this State Preceptor for being merciless!" Master Yu Hu's eyes glinted coldly, and his sleeves fluttered.
A bright red light flashed, and three thick fire snakes emerged from his sleeves, each two to three zhang long with vivid scales, looking as lifelike as real pythons. They twisted and lunged towards Yuan Ming.
"Mid-tier Fire Snake Skill?" Yuan Ming showed no sign of panic. A blue light flashed by his hand, and he raised the Shuiyun Banner.
Sourced directly from *.
He no longer concealed his cultivation. The powerful mana of the Foundation Establishment Realm infused the Shuiyun Banner, which expanded several times in the wind, wrapping around his body. A thick layer of blue mist emerged on its surface, suddenly filling the area within several zhang with dense water vapor.
The three fire snakes hit the Shuiyun Banner, erupting into three massive explosions.
The water vapor around the Shuiyun Banner was blasted away, and the banner trembled violently, but it quickly stabilized, and the blue mist promptly recovered.
"This... is Foundation Establishment cultivation!"
"Yuan Ming is already a Foundation Establishment Cultivator. Has he only been cultivating for three years?"
"What exactly happened during his time in the Southern Border?"
"It's such a pity that Chang Chun Temple missed out on such a talented individual."
Fairy Luoshui, the white-haired old crone from Bailuo Manor, and the other cultivators were in an uproar, discussing animatedly, with some even taking pleasure in the tumult.
Yuan Zuochong stood rooted to the spot, slightly relieved, and then cursed softly, "The boy, he even kept his own father in the dark."
Though he was scolding, anyone could hear the excitement and agitation in his voice.
The Emperor's eyes shone brightly, happily clapping his hands in approval.
Master Yu Hu also showed a look of shock on his face and a flicker of regret passed through his heart, but it soon turned into a cold killing intent.
If previously he had held back because of his status, merely intending to cripple the opponent's cultivation to satisfy both Liu Tianming and the Imperial Family, it turned out that Yuan Ming had concealed his cultivation by some means and reached Foundation Establishment in just three years! Now that things had come to this point, he could not leave Yuan Ming alive, or it would lead to endless trouble!
Whilst thoughts whirled in his mind, he pinched a spell with both hands, casting several spells around him.
"Hula"
A red pillar of light suddenly surged around him, shooting straight into the sky and exploding in the air, rapidly spreading out to form a fire cloud around ten zhang in size, appearing exceptionally bright red.
"The State Preceptor's trump card, the Fire Cloud Secret Technique, seems like he doesn't want Yuan Ming to leave here alive!" The Emperor's heart sank with a thump, his lips parting, about to use Chang Chun Temple's transmission skill to warn Yuan Ming.
"Since they have agreed to a fair fight, it would be best for you not to interfere." A voice transmitted to his ear.
The Emperor's expression stiffened, and he had no choice but to give up on transmitting the message.
General Yuan stayed silent, his gaze fixed on the plaza, his fists clenched tightly.
Yuan Ming, despite not knowing what Divine Skills Master Yu Hu was using, had survived life-and-death situations in the Southern Border and even took part in the siege of Biluo Cave. Having fought against Foundation Establishment Cultivators more than once while still in the Qi Refinement Realm, he was well-versed in combat tactics and naturally wouldn't let his opponent act unchecked.
His hands seemingly grasped the emptiness before him.
Sundry magic artifacts were launched in succession from his release, notably the Cold Star Sword, the Nine-Ring Gold Saber, and Wushan Claw – an array of Mid-grade Magical Artifacts.
After advancing to the Foundation Establishment Stage, his Divine Soul Power surged, further enhanced by the Moonlight Technique, making him increasingly adept at simultaneously manipulating multiple magic artifacts in coordinated attacks.
These artifacts formed a flood of dazzling colors that surged directly towards Master Yu Hu.
Under the cover of the myriad artifacts' brilliance, the Black Needle Magical Artifact transformed into a fine shadow, silently looping around to directly target Master Yu Hu's back.
Master Yu Hu's expression remained unchanged as his palms, encased in red light, crossed each other in front of his body.
The churning Fire Cloud in mid-air roared like thunder, and suddenly, more than a dozen water droplet-shaped fireballs the size of fists shot down from the sky, striking the area around him.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
All the fireballs burst simultaneously, forming a large ring of flames around him, impermeable like a barrier, repelling not only the Cold Star Sword and Nine-Ring Gold Saber but even the Black Needle Magical Artifact.
The ground below was also affected; the thick Green Stone tiles were shattered, and the ground was gouged out deeply, kicking up dust and debris.
Yuan Ming's face showed surprise, with a hint of inexplicable fervor deep in his eyes.
A cold smile played upon Master Yu Hu's lips as he raised one hand and swiftly pointed a finger towards Yuan Ming's location.
The rumbling Fire Cloud in the sky fired down another dozen or so massive fireballs, even faster than before, sealing off all Yuan Ming's potential escape routes.
Yuan Ming felt a terrifying wave of heat and Spiritual Pressure assaulting him, almost suffocating him.
But he didn't dodge. His hand gestures changed rapidly, and the Shuiyun Banner around him shone with a bright blue light, and the Eight Diagrams Ancient Mirror was also raised, rapidly spreading a layer of golden light around him, adding another defense.
He had just finished these preparations when the dozen or so fireballs had already arrived, striking the golden barrier.
One after another, earth-shattering explosions erupted!
The surging red flames shot upward and then formed into a black and red Fire Cloud that enveloped everything nearby.
Master Yu Hu's cheeks were slightly pale, indicating that the recent spell casting had consumed a considerable amount of his Mana, but his lips curled into a cold smirk nonetheless.
His Fire Cloud Secret Technique was tremendously powerful, and his last strike was delivered with full force; even a late-stage Foundation Establishment Cultivator would hesitate to face its edge head-on, let alone Yuan Ming, who had just stepped into the early stages of Foundation Establishment.
However, the next moment, Master Yu Hu's smile froze.
His Divine Sense detected that amidst the raging red flames, Yuan Ming's presence was still there, and he seemed to have suffered little damage.
"This is impossible!"
Master Yu Hu hastened to cast another spell as the Fire Cloud in the sky started churning once more.
However, before he could make another move, the ground beneath his feet suddenly cracked open and several thick, purplish-black vines shot up, stabbing towards his body like spears and halberds.
While taken aback, Master Yu Hu managed to stay composed. With a flip of his hand, he summoned a yellow umbrella, which flew above his head and opened with a "whirr," spinning continuously.
Layers of pale yellow light cascaded from the umbrella like a waterfall, quickly forming a cylindrical barrier around him.
The purplish-black vines struck the yellow barrier only to be deflected effortlessly, not even causing a tremor in the light.
Among the red flames, Yuan Ming wiped the blood from the corner of his mouth, his gaze fixated on the high-grade defensive umbrella.
The Eight Diagrams Ancient Mirror at his feet was shattered to pieces, landing on the ground, its spirit extinguished. The Shuiyun Banner was still present but its light dimmed significantly, showing signs of serious damage.
When the Eight Diagrams Mirror was destroyed, he decisively raised the black inkstone magical artifact along with the Shuiyun Banner to withstand the assault, otherwise he doubted he could have withstood the barrage of Bursting Fireballs.
Yuan Ming slapped the ground with both hands, emitting a bright green light from his palms.
The ground around Master Yu Hu cracked in all directions, as thick purple vines sprouted out, wrapping layer upon layer around the yellow barrier that surrounded Master Yu Hu.
In a few breaths, Master Yu Hu, along with the barrier, was completely covered and submerged by the surging vines.
Dozens of feet under the ground, right beneath Master Yu Hu, lay a Vine Man half-reclining there—it was Hua Zhi.
Yuan Ming had instructed Hua Zhi to sneak underground even before the succession ceremony, using the Wood Concealment Skill to hide its presence and move deep underground, lying in wait right beneath Master Yu Hu.
"Master, I alone am enough to deal with this old Taoist!" Hua Zhi declared arrogantly.
"Shut up!"
Yuan Ming once again took control of his array of magic artifacts, targeting not Master Yu Hu but the Fire Cloud in the sky.
Master Yu Hu's face revealed a touch of surprise as he hastened his hand signs towards the sky.
The Fire Cloud surged once more, releasing nearly twenty more fireballs, half of which met the flying artifacts head-on, and the other half bombarded the ground.
"Boom! Boom! Boom!" thunderous roars erupted.
A vast expanse of red flames flared in mid-air, sending the Cold Star Sword and other artifacts flying once more, with the Wushan Claw even being blasted to pieces, utterly destroyed.

chapters.title: Chapter 270 - 247: Slaying
chapters.content:
Meanwhile, almost seven or eight fireballs were fiercely smashing down towards the Purple-Black Demon Vine below.
Buried beneath the ground, Hua Zhi flashed a green light in each hand, transmitting it with incredible speed.
The numerous Purple-Black Demon Vines wrapped in a yellow light shield suddenly split from the middle, sliding quickly to the sides, revealing Master Yu Yu as well as the yellow light shield, confronting the descending fireballs.
Seeing this, Master Yu Yu was startled and hurriedly tried to control the direction of the falling fireballs, but it was already too late. Four or five fireballs struck the yellow light shield solidly, while the rest fell on the Purple-Black Vine.
In the deafening sound of explosions, Master Yu Yu was engulfed by a blaze soaring to the sky.
Yuan Ming had just withstood a bombardment, and Master Yu Yu endured a similar ordeal. The yellow light shield trembled violently, but the yellow umbrella did not shatter like the Eight Diagrams Mirror did.
Inside the light shield, Master Yu Yu's face turned even paler.
Although only a few fireballs hit the Purple-Black Demon Vine, it was severely damaged; nearly half of the vines were destroyed, and the rest were all injured.
Hua Zhi showed a pained expression and spat out a green light, as the broken Demon Vines quickly fused together, transforming in the blink of an eye into two gigantic Purple-Black hands, which fiercely slapped towards the yellow light shield.
Yuan Ming did not stop his attack either, continuing to control the Cold Star Sword and other magic artifacts shooting towards the midair fire clouds, while his palm slapped towards the Corpse Nourishing Bag, a soul crow merging into the White Ape's head.
The White Ape suddenly opened its eyes and leaped out of the Corpse Nourishing Bag.
Yuan Ming pulled out the Corpse Sealing Nail, and a strong aura immediately surged from the White Ape. It stomped violently on the ground, turning into a white shadow rushing straight towards Master Yu Yu.
In that moment, under the watchful eyes of all, the White Ape displayed all its strength from the Late Foundation Establishment.
"First the Demon Vines emerging from underground, and now a Late Foundation Establishment White Ape appears. It seems that Yuan Ming is no simple character and had premeditated today's events," Fairy Luoshui said leisurely from the high platform.
"I just thought this fellow was ignorant of the world's ways, but unexpectedly, at such a young age, he is so cunning and crafty. Things seem a bit unfavorable for Yu Hu now! He has been enjoying the court's blessings in Da Jin Country for so many years and hasn't fought for a long time," the old lady with a cane laughed.
The old emperor didn't say anything, a faint smile appearing on his face.
Those watching Yuan Ming now inadvertently viewed him with a bit of awe, no longer the initial disdain.
Master Yu Hu faced a relentless onslaught from Yuan Ming, beads of sweat appearing on his forehead. He summoned fireballs to continue battling the two Purple-Black Vine Hands and Cold Star Sword while slapping his storage bag on his waist.
A streak of white light shot out, turning into a tall aqua-colored Puppet, quite similar to the mechanical Puppet of Master Huo Lian. Its eyes flickered with traces of aqua light, and as soon as it landed, it charged directly towards the White Ape.
The aqua-colored Puppet held a silver-white greatsword in its hand, blocking the White Ape's path as it swung the sword horizontally.
The White Ape punched out, its fist surface rippling with a rich golden light, and collided with the silver greatsword.
The clang of gold and iron meeting rang out, forcing the White Ape back two steps while the aqua-colored Puppet staggered back five or six steps.
Just then, a slender black shadow somehow flashed from behind the Puppet, no longer concealing its tracks. Three runes were fully activated, with the needle exuding foot-long black sharpness, pulling out shadow after shadow at an even faster speed, and in a blink, it stabbed into the back of the aqua-colored Puppet's head.
With a loud clang, sparks flew from the back of the aqua-colored Puppet's head, the Black Needle penetrating nearly halfway in, causing a depression in the nearby skull.
But the aqua-colored Puppet seemed unaffected and continued to fight desperately with the White Ape, firmly blocking its way.
Yuan Ming frowned, deployed Shadowless Step, and suddenly urged the power of his White Jade Belt. His figure blurred, vanishing from the spot, and he appeared like a ghost behind the Puppet, raising his hand in a wave.
A streak of silver light targeted the aqua-colored Puppet; it was the Silver Token previously obtained from the stomach of the Vortex Beast.
His left hand swiftly struck out, a Yellow Talisman also targeting the aqua-colored Puppet.
The Silver Token struck the aqua-colored Puppet first, making a crisp clang, causing no damage to it.
The White Ape, entangled with the aqua-colored Puppet, suddenly pulled back, creating some distance.
As the aqua-colored Puppet was about to pursue, the Yellow Talisman had already flown forth, striking its chest.
Bright yellow light abruptly blossomed, forming a cage-shaped yellow light shield that enveloped the aqua-colored Puppet within.
This talisman was called "Earth Prison Talisman," a mid-level talisman with quite strong restraining capabilities, but it could only restrain Qi Refining Stage Cultivators and Level 1 Fierce Beasts.
Master Yu Hu scoffed disdainfully, about to control the aqua-colored Puppet to wield its sword to break the Earth Prison Talisman, when a surge of silver light suddenly emerged, swiftly spreading over the ground and on the light walls of the Earth Prison Talisman, engulfing everything in the blink of an eye to form a sealed silver space.
The aqua light in the eyes of the aqua-colored Puppet instantly dimmed, standing motionless within the light shield of the Earth Prison Talisman.
Master Yu Hu suddenly discovered that the silver light within the Earth Prison Talisman seemed to have the effect of isolating Divine Sense, instantly severing the Divine Sense connection between it and the aqua-colored Puppet.
Startled and furious, he was about to use the Fire Cloud Secret Technique to break the Earth Prison Talisman, but the White Ape had already swooped close, reaching within a three-meter radius of him.
Master Yu Hu could no longer care about the aqua-colored Puppet, and pointed towards the midair Fire Cloud.
The dozen or so fireballs originally targeting the Purple-Black Demon Palm and Cold Star Sword and other magic artifacts abruptly changed direction, all howling towards the White Ape.
Not only that, but Master Yu Hu's right hand flashed with red light, producing a palm-sized red talisman filled with dense runes, bursting with intense and abnormal Fire Attribute Spiritual Power fluctuations, clearly a high-grade talisman.
He spat out a mouthful of essence blood into a red talisman, then suddenly crushed it.
A several zhang-long fiery red dragon suddenly appeared, emitting a stunningly high temperature, and lunged at the White Ape with its teeth and claws.
Master Yu Hu, with his discerning eye, felt a particular threat from the White Ape among all Yuan Ming's many techniques. Only by eliminating this creature could he settle down and gradually deal with Yuan Ming.
At that moment, in front of Master Yu Hu, the figure flickered, and Yuan Ming appeared like a ghost, his eyes flashing with white light, the very illusion technique he had just learned.
Caught off guard, Master Yu Hu's expression became momentarily dazed, and the numerous fireballs intended for the White Ape struck an empty spot instead.
The direction of the fire dragon also changed, striking another empty spot on the ground.
The White Ape suddenly accelerated, appearing instantly in front of Master Yu Hu, and threw a punch.
The punch tore through the air, emitting a piercing screech.
Hua Zhi sensed this scene and, for some reason, became furious. A thick green light surged from her, rapidly traveling down her arms to the two Purple-black Demon Palms on the ground.
The fingers of the two purple demon palms suddenly separated, transforming the ten fingers into ten vine swords with an unusually sharp aura, fiercely stabbing at the yellow light shield.
However, the White Ape's punch was as fast as lightning, striking the yellow light shield first.
Yuan Ming exerted full control over the soul crow within the White Ape. In that instant, he stimulated the White Ape's strength to its utmost limit, a mountain-collapsing force erupted, all pouring into the yellow light shield.
The yellow light shield shattered on cue, breaking into countless shards of yellow light streams, and the yellow umbrella suspended above Master Yu Hu's head also "crackled" and broke into seven or eight pieces of rag, its spirit completely lost.
The two Purple-black Demon Palms made a forceful grab, their ten fingers piercing through Master Yu Hu's body, creating seven or eight holes in his torso.
Master Yu Hu abruptly woke up, feeling his essence blood rapidly draining away and his body paralyzed, unable to even scream.
A shadow flashed, and Yuan Ming swept out from one side, holding a treasure sword in his hand and making a swift downward slash.
A flash of sword light passed by.
Master Yu Hu's body remained still, his head flying off to land on the ground three zhang away.
A fountain of blood burst forth, shooting a foot high, the dense smell of blood spreading around.
The crowd outside was dumbfounded, the silence deadly.
It was only when the vine swords were withdrawn from Master Yu Hu's body that the corpse fell to the ground, and the crowd finally let out a collective shout.The latest chapters are always available first on *.
Then, there was complete silence.
The little Emperor stared blankly first at Yuan Ming, then at the headless corpse of Master Yu Hu, and it took him a while to come to his senses.
General Yuan raised his fist to the sky, let out a long breath, then shouted loudly, "My son is mighty!"
Yuan Ming raised his hand to recall all the magic artifacts, leaving no fragments on the ground.
Hua Zhi burrowed deeper into the ground, disappearing from sight.
Yuan Ming appeared near the White Ape, silently inserted the Corpse Sealing Nail, then collected it into the Corpse Nourishing Bag, his expression immediately relaxing as the nascent bloodlust in his eyes was quickly suppressed.
He then went over to the light shield, performed a casting to dissolve the Earth Prison Talisman's yellow light shield, and the silver glow inside also dispersed immediately.
Yuan Ming's palm emitted a force of suction, drawing the Silver Token into his hand, and he put it away.
A figure flashed by, appearing out of nowhere next to Master Yu Hu's corpse, and it was Liu Tianming's grandfather, the old emperor, who now looked at Yuan Ming, fell silent for a long time, and said, "A fine young man of the Yuan Family, it's a pity you can't stay at Chang Chun Temple."
"Senior flatters me, I was presumptuous, please forgive my offenses against Chang Chun Temple," Yuan Ming said apologetically.
The old emperor did not reply.
"This duel is concluded, the victor is Yuan Ming!" After a while, the old emperor suddenly spoke up, announcing the result loud and clear.
The nearby crowd let out a chorus of amazed cheers, this duel being much more entertaining than the dull ceremonies.
The old emperor waved his hand, a disciple of Chang Chun Temple stepped forward to collect Master Yu Hu's body and the nearby blue mechanical puppet. "Do not fail Tianming, this child, take good care of yourself from now on," the old emperor instructed softly, then turned and left.
Watching the old emperor leave, Yuan Ming breathed a sigh of relief, looked up at the sky, his eyes as clear as water, feeling a great weight lifted off his heart.
...
In a side hall of the Imperial Palace, Yuan Ming and the little Emperor sat facing each other.
"Brother Ming, you're too secretive, advancing to the Foundation Establishment Stage without telling me. Say, how should I punish you?" the little Emperor sipped from his tea, said with a smile.
"I accept the punishment. The technique I practiced was a secret technique I obtained in Southern Border, likely unique to a certain family. I will pass it on to you now, but don't use it carelessly to avoid drawing their attention," Yuan Ming explained as he detailed the "Hidden Element Technique" to the little Emperor.

chapters.title: Chapter 271 - 248 Sending Off
chapters.content:
"The State Preceptor has a huge influence in the Capital, so I must feign weakness. If I revealed my Foundation Establishment Stage cultivation, the State Preceptor would surely ask other high-level cultivators to take action against me. Lin Junsheng wouldn't stay obediently in the Capital either," said Yuan Ming as he finished his tea in one gulp.
"That's true. Your recent killing of Master Yu Hu will soon become known to all countries, and your fame will soar, but you've also completely offended the Chang Chun Temple and the State Preceptor's faction. What are your plans for the future?" The Emperor asked with some concern, not truly blaming Yuan Ming.
"I'll be leaving soon. The world is vast; where can I not find refuge? Being a Loose Cultivator suits me quite well," Yuan Ming said nonchalantly.
"It seems your trip to the Southern Border has broadened your horizons considerably. I too should seize the opportunity to travel with Lou Lan," the Emperor said with a longing tone.
"I don't mind whatever happens to me, alone and free to come and go as I please, but my parents will be in the Capital. If the Chang Chun Temple seeks revenge for today's event, I fear they won't be able to withstand it," Yuan Ming said with a flicker of worry in his eyes.
"Don't worry about that. Your duel with Master Yu Hu was fair, and the outcome was left to fate. This matter will soon spread throughout Da Jin and even the neighboring Cultivation World. The Chang Chun Temple has always prided itself on being a righteous Sect, and they won't provoke you over this, lest they tarnish their own reputation. Besides, I will make proper arrangements to ensure the safety of Yuan Mansion," the Emperor paused then added, "The State Preceptor's faction has controlled the court for many years, and they've monopolized the best disciples for just as long. It's time for a change. He attacked you, breaking the prohibition, and you openly challenged and killed him. By doing this, you have done my grandfather a great favor."
"So how will your grandfather thank me?" Yuan Ming asked.
"Ensuring your safety is probably all I can offer," the Emperor replied, "Even so, you must be careful. As they say, it's easy to avoid the arrow you see, but it's hard to guard against the hidden one."
Yuan Ming's greatest concern was precisely this. He breathed a sigh of relief upon hearing this and then asked, "Speaking of which, the Fire Cloud Skill that Master Yu Hu used earlier was very powerful. Do you know the origin of that technique?"
"To my knowledge, the Fire Cloud Secret Technique is a special and extremely powerful Secret Technique of the Chang Chun Temple. It is, however, very difficult to practice, which is why it's not widely recognized. Yu Hu probably only knew the basics," the Emperor explained.
"Fire Cloud Secret Technique? How is it different from the technique you used to kill Lin Junsheng?" Yuan Ming asked casually.
"The technique I used to kill Lin Junsheng is called the Burning Explosion Skill. It's like an introductory spell to the Fire Cloud Secret Technique," the Emperor said.
"With your talent, you should be able to learn the Fire Cloud Secret Technique. It's truly terrifying. If it weren't for the few Mid Grade Defensive Magical Artifacts I possess, I would have been defeated long ago," Yuan Ming sighed.
"Yes, with my aptitude for Fire attribute magic, I will also practice this technique when I enter the Sect." the Emperor boasted.
Yuan Ming chatted idly with the Emperor for a moment before taking his leave.
Passing by a certain garden, Hua Zhi emerged from the ground, complaining incessantly even before she could enter the Spiritual Beast Bag.
Yuan Ming was taken aback and listened carefully, realizing that Hua Zhi was complaining about Yuan Ming releasing the White Ape during the recent battle.
"You seem to dislike the White Ape? Why?" Yuan Ming asked, puzzled.
"I don't know, I just find it annoying," Hua Zhi paused for a moment before replying telepathically with Divine Thought.
"Alright, but what's annoying about it? It doesn't even have spiritual intelligence," Yuan Ming said.
"It's just annoying. When I see it, I can't help wanting to tie it up and whip it," Hua Zhi prattled on.
...
Outside the palace gates, beneath a high wall, a carriage from the General Mansion waited, with Yuan Zuochong inside.
Before long, Yuan Ming boarded the carriage. Facing his son, who had reached the Foundation Establishment Stage, Yuan Zuochong was full of questions and was about to ask.
"Father, this isn't the place to talk. We'll discuss it at home," said Yuan Ming in a low voice.
Yuan Zuochong was startled, nodded, and after glancing around, lowered the curtain of the carriage.
Neither father nor son spoke another word, and they returned to the General Mansion in silence.
In the main hall of the General Mansion, Yuan Ming's mother stood with a somber expression, apparently already aware of the events that had occurred during the succession ceremony.
"Mother," Yuan Ming chuckled dryly, speaking tentatively.
"Ming'er, you were too impulsive today. The State Preceptor deserved to die, but you shouldn't have struck him in public. This action will likely offend many, especially the cultivators from Chang Chun Temple, and may bring great trouble," Yuan Mu finally said after a long silence.
Yuan Ming didn't argue with his mother. She was astute and right, but as she wasn't a cultivator, she didn't know the whole story and couldn't explain it.
Master Yu Hu was the State Preceptor and held a revered position within the inner palace. If Yuan Ming hadn't taken action today, it might have been difficult to even see him again, let alone seek revenge.
Yuan Ming could have chosen to strike when Master Yu Hu was outside the temple, but who knew how long that would take? Plus, if discovered, Yuan Ming would become an outright assassin, truly offending the entire Chang Chun Temple. There would be no place for him in Da Jin.
By challenging him openly, although he offended many, the incident has had a wide impact, and those offended have no legitimate reason to openly attack him, making him safer in comparison.
"Ming'er is still young and acted on impulse, and besides, it's all over now, so let's not bring it up," Yuan Zuochong intervened, playing peacemaker.
Yuan Mu glared at Yuan Zuochong but did not pursue the matter further.
"Ming'er, when did you achieve Foundation Establishment? You've only been practicing for three years; how have you progressed so quickly?" Yuan Zuochong changed the subject, trying to lighten the mood in the hall.
"I had some fortuitous encounters in the Southern Border," Yuan Ming naturally went along with his father.
He recounted some of his experiences in the Southern Border that he could share.
As for the reasons behind the advancement of his cultivation, he attributed it all to elixirs and Spirit Incense, without mentioning the Stealing Heaven Tripod.The canonical source for this content: *.
Although Yuan Zuochong also practiced cultivation techniques, he had always been entangled in the mundane court, and in the strict sense, he couldn't be considered a true member of the Immortal Path, let alone having participated in a genuine cultivator battle, so he was quite curious about the life Yuan Ming described.
Yuan Mu was also captivated by Yuan Ming's stories and her expression became much softer.
"Father, there's no need for me to hide anything now. Here are some elixirs and Spirit Incense for advancing one's cultivation in the Qi Refinement Realm, and a few magic artifacts. Take these to use for now. If it's not enough, just tell me," Yuan Ming said, taking out a storage ring and handing it to Yuan Zuochong.
Yuan Zuochong looked at the ring in his hand, feeling the myriad treasures inside with his Divine Sense. His heart was filled with gratification, yet also mixed feelings.
"You're only giving gifts to your father, what about mine?" Yuan Mu stretched out her hand.
"Of course, I have not forgotten about Mother. This Heart-Clearing Pearl should be worn close to the body as it can adjust the five organs and relax the muscles and tendons. It also has some effect on a woman's complexion and skincare, which suits Mother perfectly," Yuan Ming said as he took out a white Jade Box and passed it to her.
Inside the box was a pale blue round orb, emitting a soft luster, very beautiful to behold.
He had looked around several workshops on his way back to Da Jin to find this gift that was suitable for his mother.
On hearing this, Yuan Mu took the round orb and examined it joyfully.
"Father, today I killed Master Yu Hu. Although it was an upright duel, the people from Chang Chun Temple might not let it go. I cannot stay at home; it's better for you and Mother if I leave," Yuan Ming cautioned, still not at ease despite the Emperor's assurance.
"That's right, Ming'er, go with no worries. Although I have cultivated immortal techniques, I am still a mundane man in the court and hold a distinguished position. The people from Chang Chun Temple wouldn't dare to do anything to us," Yuan Zuochong said.
"That's good," Yuan Ming nodded.
"Ming'er, are you thinking of leaving the Capital alone?" his mother asked, sensing something amiss.
"Chang Chun Temple will not let bygones be bygones. If I stay in the city, it's only a matter of time before they come for me," Yuan Ming sighed.
"But you've only just returned from the Southern Border, and now you have to leave alone, with Chang Chun Temple watching you. If anything happens to you, how do you expect me to go on?" his mother said, her voice trembling as she was on the verge of tears.
"Ming'er, your mother makes a good point. With the great power of Chang Chun Temple, wouldn't you be in even greater danger alone outside?" Yuan Zuochong also advised.
Yuan Ming felt helpless and was just about to explain further to ease his parents' minds when he saw his mother, grasping at straws, clutching his hand.
"You've been wearing the White Jade Ring since you were a child. Your grandmother said it is a treasure passed down from the Shengye Sect. If something happens, you can rely on it to go to Thunder City and seek help from the Sect," his mother said, touching the ring on Yuan Ming's hand.
Yuan Ming was startled, then suddenly remembered the one-armed old man he met in Black Rock City at the Southern Border, and his Treasure Spirit Pavilion, which seemed to be from the Thunder Continent Sect.
After a moment of contemplation, he nodded, "That sounds good. I'll do as Mother suggests and seek protection from Shengye Sect in Thunder Continent."
His mother was overjoyed, "Alright, I'll help you pack your things right away. You must take more with you to avoid hardship on your own."
"Ming'er, rest at home tonight. Tomorrow, I will arrange for a team of elite guards to escort you to Thunder Continent," Yuan Zuochong added.
Yuan Ming nodded and did not reject his parents' kindness. However, once he returned to his room, taking advantage of the moments when no one was paying attention, he secretly wrote a detailed letter and gave it to Hua Zhi, instructing him to deliver it into the palace through the underground path.
...
The next day, before dawn, just as the rooster crowed,
Yuan Ming pushed open the door to his room, donned the Concealment cloak, and used an Illusion Technique to cover his figure./p>
Thus, he moved unimpeded through the mansion and quickly arrived at his parents' bedroom.
His father was frowning in his sleep, as if he was dreaming of something unpleasant, while his mother also had a troubled face, muttering Yuan Ming's name in her sleep.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming sighed and silently knelt and bowed several times to them before placing a letter he had written overnight by his father's pillow.
In the letter, he also left a Communication Talisman he had bought in the workshop, so that, if necessary, his father could contact him.
After one last look at his parents, Yuan Ming turned and left the General Mansion without a sound.
Outside the mansion, a plain carriage quietly stood in a corner.
Next to the carriage, a figure wearing a hat and dressed in black was anxiously waiting.
Not far away, Yuan Ming, who had just left the mansion, released a soul crow, quietly surveyed the surroundings to confirm there was no ambush near the carriage. He then approached, "I'm here."
"Get on the carriage first, then we'll talk," the mysterious figure immediately pulled Yuan Ming onto the carriage, and on a closer look, it was indeed the young Emperor, Liu Tianming.
"Your Majesty, why have you come?" Yuan Ming asked in a low voice inside the carriage.

chapters.title: Chapter 272 - 249 Rushing to Thunder Continent
chapters.content:
Liu Tianming took off his straw hat, "Last night I received your message and immediately started making arrangements, but not feeling reassured, I simply came myself."
"Aren't you afraid of being discovered by the people from Chang Chun Temple?" Yuan Ming asked.
"Even if they discover me, what can they do to me? Let's not talk about this anymore. Brother Ming, as per the secret message you sent last night, I've arranged for ten identical carriages. They will soon leave the city in different directions for different destinations. The one we are in now is one of them, driven by an unknowing ordinary guard, you just go ahead and arrange it," Liu Tianming said, waving his hand and then speaking in a low voice.
Yuan Ming smiled, "You really went to a lot of trouble this time."
"With our relationship, why bother about this! Oh right, you better keep this safe." Liu Tianming took out a communication talisman and handed it to Yuan Ming.
He continued explaining, "This is a specially made two-way communication talisman, it bears my mana imprint. If you encounter any thorny issues outside, just contact me."
Yuan Ming nodded and accepted the communication talisman.
Seeing this, Liu Tianming smiled, stood up, and said, "It's unexpected, we haven't been together long and we already have to part again, Brother Ming, take care."
Yuan Ming clasped his fist towards him, and the two parted ways.
Soon, the carriage sped along, passing through the city gates under the signboard inscribed with "Qujiang," leaving a trail of rolling dust as it raced toward the sunrise.
At the city gate, a middle-aged city guard absentmindedly watched the distant carriage, turned his head to his colleague beside him, and said, "Did you hear about what happened at the abdication ceremony yesterday?"
"Of course, I heard. How could anyone in Qujiang City not know about such a big event?" The young colleague casually replied while picking his teeth with a bamboo stick.
"Alas, it's hard to say how Young Master Yuan trained; three years ago, he was just an ordinary person turned away by Chang Chun Temple due to poor aptitude, yet now he has somehow managed to defeat the State Preceptor. It's truly incredible," the middle-aged city guard exclaimed.
The young colleague threw the bamboo stick away, perked up, and said, "It's really baffling! Speaking of Young Master Yuan, I heard that the 'Young Master Sheng's Southern Journey' sold by Tianming Book Society is adapted from his experiences in the Southern Border. I've got to buy a copy after my shift ends to see if I can learn something from it."
"Give me a break, you?" the middle-aged city guard scoffed.
"If a person doesn't have dreams, they're no better than a salted fish, and at least a salted fish can still turn over!" the young colleague said nonchalantly.
The middle-aged city guard paused, then suddenly coughed twice and said,
"Ahem, well, when you do, grab a copy for your elder brother here too. I want to see what opportunities there are in the Southern Border."
...
A month later, Wo River City.
The city, named after its proximity to Wo River, wasn't large, but thanks to the port connecting north-south waterways bustling with countless passenger and cargo ships, it thrived exceptionally well.
Because of this, there were not a few who made their living off these water routes; Fifth Brother Wang was one such inconspicuous member.
His ancestors had fished for generations, and only with great difficulty did his family amass some savings. His father originally intended to expand the fishing business, but Fifth Brother Wang, loath to spend his days in the company of fishy smells, resolutely bought a passenger ship and turned to running a ferry business instead.
However, in this city, there were not one hundred but two hundred running a ferry business. Fifth Brother Wang's passenger ship had nothing novel about it, and customers were scarce, leaving him quickly caught in a deficit.
Now, he couldn't even afford to hire a helper; his entire family lived on the ship, helping with steering and sailing just to barely make ends meet.
Note from the editor: Always check * for corrections.
Passing thirty-five, and facing daily complaints from his wife, the disappointed looks from his old father, and his growing son with an increasing appetite, Fifth Brother Wang felt immensely anxious, spending all day wandering the docks in search of passengers.
Today, just after noon, Fifth Brother Wang squeezed beside the porters resting at a tea stall, ordered a cup of free cold water, and sipped it while surveying the activities at the docks.
Typically, there wouldn't be any passengers at this time, but perhaps Fifth Brother Wang was lucky—indeed, he spotted a customer looking for a boat.
This person wore a plain, long robe; despite the simple attire, the phoenix-like eyes and sword-like eyebrows on his elegant face were quite extraordinary.
This person was none other than Yuan Ming, who had left the capital alone to evade retaliation from Chang Chun Temple.
Fifth Brother Wang's eyes lit up, and he quickly gulped down the cold water, hurriedly jogging over.
"Sir, do you need a boat?"
Having just finished speaking with another boatman, Yuan Ming nodded upon seeing Fifth Brother Wang approach, "Yes, I'm heading to Thunder City. Does your boat go there?"
Fifth Brother Wang immediately cheered up, noting the gentleman's demeanor; he should not be a stingy person, so he tentatively said, "Sir, Thunder City isn't an easy journey, the water currents are turbulent all the way, and it could damage the boat. Plus, I'd have to return empty!"
"I'm aware of that, which is why I asked if your boat goes. I'll charter it," Yuan Ming replied.
Fifth Brother Wang's eyes darted about, hesitated briefly, then held up four fingers, "It can go, but it will cost this much."
The price he quoted was more than double the usual rate.
Yuan Ming didn't point it out and said, "That's fine, but I need to leave immediately."
"No problem, my whole family is on the boat, we can leave right away!" Fifth Brother Wang was overjoyed and nodded repeatedly, leading Yuan Ming onto his boat.
The boat was not large, but it was tidy; the deck was divided into six rooms, all empty save the one that housed Fifth Brother Wang's family.
Yuan Ming randomly chose a room to settle into, instructed Fifth Brother Wang not to disturb him unless necessary, and that meals should just be left at the door, then sent him off to start the boat.
After Fifth Brother Wang left, Yuan Ming silently performed the "Moonlight Technique," releasing a soul crow to monitor from the air, and summoned Hua Zhi from the Spiritual Beast Bag to hide beneath the cabin, only then did he feel somewhat relieved.
For the past month, he had been traveling by carriage and horse, changing disguises and constantly on the move, almost always on the road with very few stops.
Now aboard this boat, floating downstream along the waterway, he no longer needed to switch between carriages and horses, gaining some intervals for rest.
As his tightly wound feelings slightly relaxed, Yuan Ming summoned the Stealing Heaven Tripod and inserted a stick of Black Incense made from new materials and lit it.
Amid the curling smoke, Yuan Ming recalled his father's face in his mind, and soon was able to possess him.
Compared to a month ago, Yuan Zuochong's appearance had not changed much. At the moment, he was sitting in his study, writing a memorial.
"Your servant, Yuan Zuochong, petitions for retirement..."
Soon, he finished writing the memorial, exhaled a light breath, picked up the document, reread it once, and then tucked it away.
After pondering for a moment, Yuan Zuochong suddenly took out the communication talisman Yuan Ming had left him, studied it for a long time, and finally set it down.
"I wonder how Ming'er is doing now. With his cultivation, courage, insight, and experiences from the Southern Border, even if he encounters any trouble, it should not be too difficult for him."
A long sigh fell.
At that moment, Yuan Ming ended the possession, returning to his own body, but his heart was overwhelmed with desolation.
He quickly gathered his emotions; since his home should be safe for the time being, he also needed to make some plans for the road ahead.
His Divine Sense entered his Storage Ring, briefly inventoried it, and found that the Elixirs and Talismans he had prepared earlier were almost all used up, leaving not much left, and those currently useful to him were a few bottles of Foundation Establishment Stage Elixirs scraped together from Elder Meng Shan and Xu Changqing.
As for the "Copper Skin Pills" from Liu Su, they would also have to wait until he found a suitable Body Refinement Technique before he could use them.
In terms of Spirit Stones, counting them up, he still had over two thousand, which seemed like a lot, but were insufficient for purchasing items like Foundation Establishment Stage cultivation elixirs.
Apart from these, he still had quite a few magical tools.
He had one top-grade magical tool, the Nameless Black Needle, and around a dozen Mid and Lower Grade magical tools, including the Cold Star Sword, Nine-Ring Gold Saber, Short Jade Dagger, and the Golden Snake Sword.
Yuan Ming selected some of the tools he wouldn't need and planned to look for a market in Thunder City to sell them for Spirit Stones, then began to go through some spiritual materials in his Storage Bag.
Among them, the materials for incense making were mostly used up, and he would need to find a way to replenish them in Thunder City. He also took out a few spiritual materials that had been forgotten by Yuan Ming and looked them over as well.
The first was an earthy yellow shell and a gray silk mass the size of a human head, which he had obtained from an Elder's Storage Bag at the Black Rock City Market by chance.
Following that was a Fire-Red Curved Horn, obtained by Yuan Ming while on a mission in Biluo Cave; though its origin was unknown, Master Huo Lian had judged that its grade might even be above Mid Grade.
Last was the Golden Pattern Leopard Skin, a trophy from a creature Yuan Ming had hunted, which as a Second Lower Rank fierce beast, was also quite valuable.
As he sorted through items, Yuan Ming suddenly found a green sphere, the Heart-splitting Bomb he had bought at the Ghost Market in Black Rock City.
Initially, he had bought three; one was used on Elder Meng Shan, another against a Vortex Beast, and the effects were indeed impressive. Now, with only one left, he wouldn't use it unless absolutely necessary.
This magical tool was exclusive to the Five Thunder Sect of Zhao Country. Thunder Continent bordered Zhao Country, so it was possible that Heart-splitting Bombs might also circulate in the market there.
With his mind made up, Yuan Ming carefully stored the Heart-splitting Bomb and then organized the remaining talismans and materials. At last, he completed inventorying the contents of the ring.
He shifted his consciousness to the soul crow, seeing that Fifth Brother Wang's boat had already left the dock and was now moving northward along the Wo River. His family hadn't tried to engage him in conversation, which suited his preferences, so he withdrew his consciousness and began his cultivation.
An hour later, Yuan Ming sighed, frowning as he detached from the cultivation state.
Since obtaining the complete "Nine Elements Technique" from Liu Tianming, although he had been cultivating it for a while and his cultivation had somewhat improved, compared to the rapid progress during the Qi Refinement Realm, there was a considerable lack.

chapters.title: Chapter 273 - 250 Xu Family
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming knew clearly that if he hadn't been practicing the Nine Elements Technique, his cultivation speed with his Four Spirit Roots would have likely been even slower.
The reason for this was, naturally, that although his absorption speed of Spiritual Energy improved after entering the Foundation Establishment Stage, the amount of Spiritual Energy required for cultivation increased even more.
He estimated that as his cultivation continued to improve, this issue would become increasingly evident.
In light of this, in order to enhance his cultivation speed as much as possible, it seemed he would still need to rely on elixirs and Spirit Incense for assistance.
Feeling a twinge of pain at the cost, Yuan Ming took out a Foundation Establishment Stage Elixir from his Storage Ring and swallowed it with closed eyes, then took advantage of the elixir's effects before they dissipated to re-enter cultivation.
Without any further incidents, half a month later.
It had passed midday, but the sky remained a murky grey, and the rumbling sound of thunder echoed among the countless clouds.
The river was tumultuous and the muddy waves hit the boat's side, causing the vessel to rock.
On the deck, Fifth Brother Wang and his son bustled about, and only after some effort, they managed to moor the boat to the dock and cast the anchor.
"Alright, Da Gou, go and inform the passengers that we've arrived at Thunder City," Fifth Brother Wang wiped the sweat from his forehead and turned to his son.
His son nodded, but as he turned around, he saw Yuan Ming already stepping out from within the cabin.
"Young Master, the boat has arrived; do you think we could settle the fare now..." Fifth Brother Wang rubbed his hands together.
Yuan Ming nodded and casually tossed a bag of silver coins to him, which was considerably more than the previously agreed amount.
Fifth Brother Wang was profusely grateful, promptly gesturing to his son to set up the plank to facilitate Yuan Ming's disembarkment.
With the silver coins in hand, Fifth Brother Wang counted them twice, then looking up and seeing Yuan Ming still smiling at him, he couldn't help but ask, "Does the distinguished guest have any other business?"
Yuan Ming spoke, "Call your family over here, I have an additional reward for the care you've shown me along the way."
Fifth Brother Wang immediately summoned his wife and children, beaming as they stood before Yuan Ming. Yuan Ming lifted the Soul-Attracting Bell and gently rang it with a "ding dong" sound.
Fifth Brother Wang's family felt dizzy for a moment and then regained consciousness.
In his hands, Fifth Brother Wang held a pouch of coins, utterly confused, and upon looking around, he exclaimed, "Oi, what's happened, how did we get to Thunder City?"
...
The structure of Thunder City was completely different from that of the Capital.
The somewhat narrow streets undulated, higher in the middle and lower on the sides, with a gutter running along each side. Each household had built a small stone bridge over the gutter in front of their door, creating a connection to the street and adding a touch of "little bridges and flowing water homes."
The surrounding dwellings were tall and compact, with white brick walls connected in succession and blue roof tiles curving like crescent moons. Rainwater slid down the bricks and tiles, dropping just so into the gutters and stirring ripples.
At the end of the gutters was a broad river where numerous small boats with wooden awnings were moored. An ancient stone bridge straddled the river, with the occasional boat passing underneath and the clear sound of paddles creaking in the water.
Yuan Ming moved swiftly through the streets and soon arrived in front of a large and elegantly decorated mansion.
Bright red lanterns hung grandly at the gate, their light shining through the paper and illuminating the "happiness" character on them.
Underneath the plaque that read "Xu Family," the wide gates were open, and two house servants dressed as young lads stood guard, their faces full of smiles.This translation is powered by the readers at *.
Behind them, waves of laughter, the clinking of glasses, and playful shouts of children echoed from behind the screen walls, creating a lively atmosphere.
As Yuan Ming watched this scene brimming with worldly life, memories from his childhood flashed through his mind, and an indescribable warmth welled up in his heart. However, he was well aware that since he had embarked on the Immortal Path, his connection to such mundane affairs would likely become less frequent in the future.
He composed himself, used an Illusion Technique to change his appearance, and approached the two servants to inquire, "Excuse me, is there a celebration today in the Xu Family?"
"Indeed, today our second young master is getting married, and the master has ordered that anyone is welcome to come and have a cup of celebratory wine. Would you, sir, care to join in and share the joy?" The servant enthusiastically invited, seeing that Yuan Ming appeared dignified and respectable.
"Then I shall not refrain," Yuan Ming nodded and followed the servant into the Xu Mansion.
His visit here was not on a whim but because the Xu Family was related to his mother's line. By genuine relations, the second young master getting married today was his cousin.
Having visited the Thunder Province with his mother as a child, Yuan Ming somewhat remembered the way. However, his knowledge of Thunder City's Cultivation World was limited. If he wanted to join the Shengye Sect, he would have to start by learning about the situation from his uncle's house.
But to prevent the Chang Chun Temple from discovering his whereabouts, he didn't immediately reveal his identity.
Yuan Ming was led by the house servant to a side hall to sit. Once the servant left, Yuan Ming swiftly applied an Illusion Technique to conceal his presence and donned a cloak to mask his aura, then quickly left the side hall.
Soon, he found his uncle in the study of the Xu Mansion.
"Big brother, do you think mother won't be returning today?" asked a clean-shaven middle-aged man within the room.
A man with a mustache sat before him, calmly sipping tea as he listened to Xu Rong's lament.
"Your son's marriage is hardly a major event; if Mother doesn't want to return, let her be. Why are you so anxious?"
These two men were none other than Yuan Ming's third uncle, Xu Rong, and his eldest uncle, Xu Fan.
"Alas, it's not easy for the family to have some good news, and now Mother won't return, neither will Second Brother nor Fourth Sister. Isn't that quite boring?" Third Uncle Xu Rong grumbled.
"You, how old are you now, yet you still act like a child," the eldest uncle sighed.
At that moment, the voice of a third person suddenly came from outside the study.
"Hehe, Third Uncle, don't be in such a hurry. Haven't I come back?" A handsome young man pushed the door open and looked at Xu Rong with a beaming smile.
"Oh! Tian has returned. Eh, why just you? Where is your grandmother?" The eldest uncle stood up, joyfully looking at the handsome young man and then, puzzled, glanced behind him.
Yuan Ming, who was secretly watching from the sidelines, recognized that this person was Xu Fan's son, his cousin Xu Tian.
Unlike the two uncles, Xu Tian had faint traces of spiritual energy fluctuating around him, clearly a cultivator at the Qi Refining Third Level.
"Grandmother just went into seclusion not long ago and couldn't come back conveniently. She sent Junior Sister Luo with a gift to come back with me," Xu Tian said with a smile.
A petite and cute young girl peeked out from behind him. With her hair tied in a ponytail and a naive smile on her delicate, baby-faced features, she immediately elicited a sense of affection from anyone who saw her.
Like Xu Tian, she was also a cultivator, but with a cultivation level at the Qi Refining Second Level.
"Uncles," the girl greeted with a bow.
"Let me introduce you, this is Luo Xing'er, Grandmother's newly accepted disciple. She may possibly be Grandmother's last disciple," Xu Tian introduced.
Upon introduction, Xu Fan and Xu Rong promptly responded with a polite greeting, not daring to show any negligence.
Although they were her elders, they were mere mortals without a Spirit Root, and thus unavoidably showed restraint in the presence of cultivators.
However, Luo Xing'er didn't seem to mind at all. Instead, she eagerly began to ask questions.
"Uncles, I heard that you have a nephew named Yuan Ming, is that right?"
As soon as these words were spoken, not only were Xu Fan and his brother taken aback, but even Yuan Ming, who was watching in secret, was slightly startled.
"Yes, the son of Fourth Sister's family does have that name. Do you know him, Miss Luo?" the eldest uncle asked in return.
"Of course I do! Now, in the entire Da Jin Cultivation World, who hasn't heard his name!" Luo Xing'er's eyes shone bright as she spoke excitedly.
She then narrated the story of Yuan Ming challenging the State Preceptor at the abdication ceremony and ultimately avenging his grudge by killing the Great Jin National Master.
"Yuan Ming killed the National Master? This... won't implicate us, will it?" the eldest uncle asked with a pale face after listening.
"Dad, the matters of the Cultivation World won't involve the secular world," Xu Tian said helplessly.
"Uncle, were you close to Yuan Ming when he was a child? Can you tell me some stories about him?" Luo Xing'er persistently inquired.
The aunts and uncles of the Xu family knew little after Yuan Ming's mother had married out and seldom returned. Thus, Xu Fan and his brother hesitated for quite some time and eventually could only recall a few anecdotes of Yuan Ming's childhood fame gained from writing storybooks.
Luo Xing'er quickly lost interest in inquiring about Yuan Ming, but suddenly, she seemed to remember something and pleaded with Xu Tian to take her to the house where Yuan Ming's mother had stayed when she visited her family.
Unable to refuse her, Xu Tian could only call for a servant to show her the way, while he stayed behind.
"I remember Yuan Ming disappeared three years ago on a mission to the Southern Border; how has he suddenly returned and caused such a stir?" Third Uncle watched Luo Xing'er leave and expressed his doubts.
"I'm not sure about the specifics. These are all rumors brought back by cultivators from our Sect who attended the abdication ceremony. They say that when Cousin Yuan Ming disappeared years ago, it was the dark deed of the National Master. But unexpectedly, that disaster turned into a blessing. After cultivating for three years in the Southern Border, he returned at the Foundation Establishment stage and sought revenge on the National Master," Xu Tian shook his head and explained.
"Foundation Establishment stage... How does that compare to your grandmother?" the eldest uncle asked, not very familiar with the Cultivation World.
"Grandmother is also at the Foundation Establishment stage; she should be around the middle level," Xu Tian remarked.
Yuan Ming's two uncles fell silent, their faces showing a touch of concern.
"Initially, our Sect was unaware of the connection between Grandmother and Yuan Ming. But once someone uncovered it, the Sect's attitude towards Grandmother and me changed instantly. Even an elder who previously didn't get along with Grandmother started to send quite a few gifts, all smiles," Xu Tian added.
"These past days, I've also been inquiring about Cousin's feats. Now, not just Junior Sister Luo, but I myself am profoundly impressed by him," Xu Tian said, admiration apparent on his face.
"Does that mean Yuan Ming killing the National Master is actually a good thing for our Xu family?" the eldest uncle stroked his goatee.
"Not entirely so. The Sect behind the National Master, Chang Chun Temple, has a huge influence. Not only has my cousin offended them, but he has also caused them to lose face. We're likely to face many troubles in the future. That's why Grandmother went into seclusion, aiming to increase her cultivation level and have more influence in the Sect to provide my cousin with protection. We shouldn't worry too much. With Yuan Ming having achieved Foundation Establishment Cultivation at such a young age and even defeating the Great Jin National Master, his future prospects are boundless. He will surely become a powerful aide for our family," Xu Tian said with a sigh.
The two uncles continued to discuss the impact Yuan Ming's actions might have on the family's future.
Having overheard the conversation for a while, Yuan Ming quietly departed.

chapters.title: Chapter 274 - 251 Little Lake City
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming left the Xu Mansion and found another inn in the city to stay at, while secretly releasing the soul crow to spy on the activities within Xu Mansion.
His uncles, being mortals, did not know much about the Shengye Sect. His cousin, Xu Tian, was a disciple of the Shengye Sect, and following him could help Yuan Ming find his way when he returned to the Sect.
However, it seemed that his actions at the abdication ceremony had already spread throughout the entire Shengye Sect, and joining under his real identity would attract too much attention.
In that case, it might be better to join the Shengye Sect as an ordinary disciple to avoid some trouble.
Upon further reflection, if he joined the Shengye Sect, he would eventually be exposed, which could potentially bring disaster to the Sect.
