Yuan Ming made up his mind and decided to secretly follow Xu Tian and Luo Xing'er when they returned to the Sect, to find out the location of the Shengye Sect's gates. He planned not to get involved with anyone during this period. He would decide what to do once he found the Sect's location.
...
Three days later, Xu Tian said goodbye to his parents and, along with Luo Xing'er, set off on a flying boat, leaving Thunder City.
Yuan Ming, through the soul crow, saw this scene and immediately released his Jade Shuttle, following them from a distance.
Xu Tian and Luo Xing'er headed north and soon entered a huge swamp.
The sky in Thunder Continent was mostly gloomy, and this swamp area was even more shrouded in year-round poison miasma, where visibility was so poor one could not see beyond their outstretched hand, and all kinds of poisonous insects and fierce beasts lurked, deadly to any mortal who dared approach carelessly.
However, before entering the swamp, Xu Tian and Luo Xing'er seemed to have put on something that emitted a faint halo of light around them, not only keeping the poison miasma at bay but also causing the poisonous insects and fierce beasts to keep their distance from them.
Yuan Ming also had an anti-plague pearl left from exploring the Snake King Valley, and with his Foundation Establishment Stage cultivation, he too was not afraid of these poisonous insects and fierce beasts. However, before entering the swamp, he suddenly stopped, took out the Spiritual Beast Bag, and released Hua Zhi.
"Master, what place is this? The fog here smells so sweet and fragrant!" As soon as Hua Zhi landed, it took a deep breath, swallowing the nearby poison miasma, and even appeared to be intoxicated.
"Hua Zhi, lurk underground and advance with me," Yuan Ming instructed.
Hua Zhi nodded cheerfully and swiftly burrowed into the swamp's ground.
Yuan Ming then continued forward, fortunate that the soul crow he had released earlier was unaffected by the poison miasma and was still following Xu Tian and his companion, ensuring he did not lose track of them.
An hour later, a fine drizzle suddenly began to fall from the sky, and Yuan Ming followed Xu Tian and Luo Xing'er as they flew out of the swamp and into a mountain range.
Not far off, a massive gate hidden among lush greenery appeared intermittently through the light rain. Xu Tian and his friend flew to the gate and stopped, not entering but instead speaking briefly before they took to their magic artifact and flew off in the northwestern direction.
Curious, Yuan Ming left a soul crow to watch over the Shengye Sect's gate while he continued to follow them.
About half an hour later, Yuan Ming saw a giant protective shield under the gloomy sky, encompassing a city within the mountains.
Under the drizzle, a bluish giant protective shield enveloped the city Yuan Ming was observing.
The fine, silk-like raindrops fell, hitting the shield and disappearing in the blink of an eye, leaving no trace.
Below the shield, hundreds of intersecting streets and alleys were lined with countless houses and pavilions. Atop each house, four white Bright Pearls were placed at the roof's corners, their light interwoven and merging to illuminate the whole city brightly and clearly.
In the center of the city, a small lake spanning several dozen acres rippled gently, with a square paved with white jade bricks in the lake's center, connected to the main road by four jade stone arch bridges.
On the square, a twenty-zhang-tall Four-sided Pavilion rose from the ground, its body pale white while the tiles above shone a brilliant blue, as clear and sparkling as crystal.
At every edge of the protective shield, there was a massive city gate, slightly shorter than the crystal pavilion but far taller than the city's buildings. Atop each gate stood a Divine Beast Stone Statue, exquisitely carved, with scales and feathers depicted so lifelike that they seemed almost real.
Xu Tian and Luo Xing'er had not yet approached the shield when they voluntarily reduced their flying boat and approached one of the city gates on foot.
Yuan Ming also descended his Jade Shuttle in a distant valley, watching the two enter the city before slowly making his own way towards the city.S.ampl-e fr.om& My V*ir*tu#al.[email protected] Empi@r#e@—re-ad m-o-r%e on M*&&VLE$M&P+Y%&R!.
A sign hung above the city gate, bearing only three characters: "Little Lake City."
After paying a Spirit Stone as a toll, Yuan Ming was about to pass through the gate when he noticed some cultivators entering without paying. Curiously, he inquired and learned that cultivators who owned houses in the city were exempt from the fee, a fact Yuan Ming noted silently.
Once inside the city, compared to his earlier distant view, he felt even more immersed in its atmosphere.
The fine rain was blocked by the shield, making the city exceedingly dry. On the wide streets, pedestrians bustled, many of whom possessed cultivation.
However, after closely observing for a moment, Yuan Ming noticed that the pedestrians on the street subtly displayed two distinctly different styles of clothing.
One style was mostly long robes and skirts, predominantly red, with wearers often having jade ornaments around their necks and waists, their clothes fluttering like undulating flames.
The other style consisted mainly of brocade clothes and trousers, intermixing red and blue, with fewer ornaments on the wearers but more often carrying swords and blades.
As Yuan Ming observed the pedestrians, his expression suddenly changed, and he turned his head to look beside him.
"Fellow Daoist seems to be new to Little Lake City. Our meeting must be fated," said a male cultivator with a hooked nose wearing a crimson robe, who stopped and smiled at Yuan Ming under his gaze.
This person's cultivation wasn't high, only at the Qi Refining Fourth Level, but Yuan Ming was also using the Hidden Element Technique, suppressing his cultivation to the Late Stage Qi Refining level, so the other party didn't notice Yuan Ming's true cultivation.
"Seeing Fellow Daoist's spirited appearance, you must have come from Zhao Country, right? Do you need a guide by any chance?" the hooked nose cultivator said familiarly.
Yuan Ming looked at him, reminded of the broker Gu Yue he had encountered in Black Rock City, but he still shook his head, "Thank you, but I don't need a guide."
"Then, might Fellow Daoist need a map of Little Lake City? It's not expensive, just one spirit stone," the hooked nose cultivator persisted, flipping his right hand to produce a jade scroll.
"One spirit stone? That's expensive," Yuan Ming exclaimed in surprise.
"Fellow Daoist, this is honestly a fair price. Do you know how many shops there are in Little Lake City? Which ones are scams, which offer great value for money, which are run by the Great Sects, and which are established by the Scatter Alliance? Everything is on this map, just one spirit stone can save you so much trouble. Time is spirit stones," the hooked nose cultivator shook the jade scroll in his hand.
Yuan Ming, finding his words reasonable, decided not to haggle and took out a spirit stone to buy the map.
Upon receiving the jade scroll, Little Lake City was the largest cultivation market on the Thunder Continent, with cultivators from Da Jin and the nearby Zhao Country coming here for trading. The map not only clearly marked the locations of large and small shops in Little Lake City's market, but also included many helpful reviews about the shops.
Yuan Ming was pleased with the jade scroll, and quickly found a store called "Hundred Books Pavilion" guided by the map.
This was a shop specializing in selling classics. Upon entering, Yuan Ming saw seven or eight tall wooden bookcases neatly arranged in the shop, filled with various classics, all enveloped by a pale blue light.
A dedicated counter was placed next to these bookcases, inside of which were various uniform-style wooden boxes, containing mostly worn and tattered classics or jade scrolls, some even had only a single page.
Seeing Yuan Ming enter, a long-robed shop assistant immediately came over to greet him.
"Are you here to buy cultivation techniques, or sell them?"
"Does your shop have magic secret manuals for sale?" Yuan Ming asked.
"Our shop has a wide variety of magic secret manuals. Which specific type do you need? If you're looking for something basic, I recommend this one. It records many commonly used spells, all quite rudimentary, but plentiful in number and variety," the assistant thought for a moment and took a thicker book from the shelf.
"I'll take this one. Also, what are all these items in the counter being sold?" Yuan Ming nodded and pointed to the counter containing the wooden boxes.
"These are nameless secret books we've collected; most are incomplete, and some texts are not commonly used in the Central Plains. They're all inexpensive. If Fellow Daoist is interested, you could buy a few to study. However, once you leave the store, if there are any errors in cultivation, our store does not take responsibility," explained the assistant.
Yuan Ming shook his head and decided to purchase only the magic secret manual. Since it contained only basic spells, he spent fewer than thirty spirit stones.
After taking the spirit stones, the assistant retrieved a jade ruyi from a storage bag and gently tapped it on the magic secret manual. The pale blue glow enveloping the manual instantly shattered, transforming into a dim talisman that fluttered to the ground.
"This is a special sealing talisman made by our shop. It can only be opened with a specific magic artifact; otherwise, it will burn everything inside to ashes," the assistant, seeing Yuan Ming's curiosity, explained with a smile.
Just then, another customer, a man in brocade clothes with a long sword at his waist and a goatee, entered the store, and immediately another shop assistant went up to greet him.
Both the goatee and the assistant spoke in an accent that was different from what Yuan Ming usually heard.
"I noticed quite a few people in the market dressed like them. I wonder where they are from?" Yuan Ming gestured with his chin towards the man with the goatee and asked the assistant.
"Oh, they are from Zhao Country. Our Thunder State is on the border of Da Jin, which is adjacent to Zhao Country. Little Lake City is located at the junction of Da Jin and Zhao Country, so there are many cultivators from Zhao Country in this area," the assistant explained.
Yuan Ming suddenly understood and thanked the assistant before leaving the shop.
Having bought the magic secret manual, he then turned his attention to elixirs.
His cultivation currently needed a lot of elixir support, and coincidentally encountering such a sizable market, he naturally wanted to take a good look around.

chapters.title: Chapter 275 - 252 I'm Here to Collect a Debt
chapters.content:
According to the annotations on the map, among the shops in Little Lake City that sell elixirs, there are not many that have elixirs for the Foundation Establishment stage; there are only two with the highest reputation.
One is the Longevity Immortal Tower, a familiar place run by the Chang Chun Temple of an acquaintance of Yuan Ming.
Not only elixirs, but Longevity Immortal Tower also deals with talismans and spiritual materials; Yuan Ming just happens to have some spiritual materials to sell, and with a Longevity Token in hand to enjoy better services, going there was most suitable.
However, Yuan Ming's gaze was drawn to another shop.
Before long, Yuan Ming arrived at a shop named "Qingmu Building".
Before he even entered, he noticed on either side of the shop's entrance neat rows of jade potted plants; among them grew a Calming Flower, a Spirit Grass whose fragrance was faint but soothing and focused the mind, thereby also serving as one of the auxiliary ingredients for Nourishing Origin Pills for Qi Refining disciples.
Despite the Calming Flower not being a particularly rare Spirit Grass, placing it so prominently at the doorstep still highlighted a certain boldness.
Yuan Ming passed by the Calming Flower potted plants and walked into the shop, immediately enveloped by a wave of unique and captivating fragrance as he glanced at the variety of Spirit Grass on display on the shelves.
These Spirit Grasses seemed to have undergone special selection and cultivation, their intertwining aromas not at all cluttered or unpleasant; rather, they formed an especially rich and unforgettable scent.
Between the shelves, shop assistants dressed in light green robes either greeted customers or arranged Spirit Grasses, and even those who did menial tasks and moved things around showed a hint of cultivation.
Suddenly, Yuan Ming noticed that Xu Tian and Luo Xing'er were also in the shop, speaking with a shop assistant behind the counter about something.
Yuan Ming, standing at the entrance, surveyed the interior when a shop assistant noticed him and immediately came over, smiling, "Senior, the items on the first floor are all Low Grade Spirit Grasses, which may not catch your esteemed eye. Please follow me upstairs to discuss further."
Yuan Ming, who came to buy Foundation Establishment stage elixirs, hadn't concealed his cultivation and followed the assistant upstairs. The green-robed assistant escorted Yuan Ming into a private room, served him a cup of fragrant tea, asked him to wait for a moment, and then left.
Yuan Ming deliberately held the Longevity Token in his hand.
The private room was decorated mainly in green, with carvings of plants on the screens and furniture, and the medicinal fragrance in the room was particularly refreshing.
Yuan Ming felt that compared to the Southern Border, the service by the shop owners in the Central Plains Market really made one feel right at home.
Before long, an old man in a wooden-patterned robe with white hair and beard quickly entered the room and said to Yuan Ming with a smile,
"Our shop is greatly honored by your visit, senior. It truly is a privilege. I am Jiang Yuan, the shopkeeper here. Should you have any needs, senior, please feel free to mention them."
"I'm just looking around," Yuan Ming leaned back in his chair, casually playing with a white jade token in his hand.
"Hehe, senior has indeed come to the right place! Not to hide from senior, many regular customers of this building have come from Longevity Immortal Tower. Although my Shengye Sect isn't as renowned as Chang Chun Temple, we certainly do not fall behind in terms of elixirs." Jiang Yuan glanced at the words 'Longevity Token' on the token in Yuan Ming's hand and said with even more enthusiasm.
Seeing Yuan Ming unmoved by his words, Jiang Yuan immediately continued, "For a distinguished customer like yourself, senior, our Qingmu Building places even more emphasis on experience. Please accept this Green Wood Token. In addition to the same treatment as Longevity Immortal Tower, all items sold, including elixirs and magic artifacts, will have a ten percent discount."
As he spoke, he took out a green wooden token from his sleeve and presented it to Yuan Ming with both hands.
"Then I'll accept it without ceremony. I've been in need of some elixirs for my cultivation recently; do you have any recommendations? You can also introduce some for healing." Only then did Yuan Ming show a faint smile, took the Green Wood Token from the old man, while the Longevity Token in his hand had already been put away.
"For healing, Rejuvenation Pills are good and can quickly treat most external wounds. In terms of effects, Bone-generating Pills are better, but they release their medicine more slowly and are not suitable for use in battle. As for cultivation elixirs, considering senior's situation, our sect's specially improved Four Spirits Pill should be the first choice. Compared to the ordinary Four Spirits Pill, not only is the effect slightly better, but it's also less likely to cause drug resistance and can be taken in conjunction with other elixirs even after a breakthrough to the mid-stage."
Jiang Yuan said, got up, gave a slight command to the waiting assistants outside the room, and soon an assistant came back carrying a tray with three porcelain bottles.
Yuan Ming took the bottles and opened each porcelain bottle one by one.
The Rejuvenation Pills were slightly red in color, emitting a faint burning sensation when held in one's palm, and the fragrance was not strong. The Bone-generating Pills, on the other hand, were completely opposite: not only pure white, but they also carried a rich and lingering fragrance, and they felt just warm when held in hand.
Compared to them, the Four Spirits Pill seemed quite ordinary, with no special color or fragrance—its appearance was unremarkable, just like an ordinary candy bean.
Before his visit, Yuan Ming had already learned that the Four Spirits Pill was relatively common as an assistant cultivation elixir for the Foundation Establishment stage, and he went straight to the point,
"Let's talk about the price."
"The Rejuvenation Pills and Bone-generating Pills are fifty Spirit Stones per bottle, while the Four Spirits Pill is two hundred and seventy Spirit Stones per bottle. It's the same price as the market rate, but the effect is better. These are the list prices and they are on display on the second floor," said Jiang Yuan.
Although Yuan Ming was prepared, he was still inwardly taken aback by the prices which were several times higher than the Qi Refinement stage elixirs.
This was only suitable for cultivators in the Foundation Establishment Stage.
No wonder there's a saying in the Cultivation World that cultivation, apart from innate talent, is actually about cultivating resources. Putting aside those heavenly materials and earthly treasures from the legends or those particularly effective special elixirs, even these relatively common elixirs were not something ordinary cultivators could consume long-term.
If a sect or family were to support a cultivator, naturally, the cultivator's speed of cultivation would be something that an unsupported Loose Cultivator could not catch up with.
Although one's lifespan could reach more than two hundred years after advancing to the Foundation Establishment Stage, most Loose Cultivators probably spent the majority of their time seeking various opportunities or collecting resources. The actual time they could settle down for closed-door cultivation was likely not much.
After turning the thought over in his mind, Yuan Ming used the excuse of wanting to try them out as this was his first visit and purchased a bottle of each of the three types of elixirs, including the Four Spirits Pill. Before leaving, he also casually learned about a well-reputed spiritual materials shop called "Red Refining Hall" in the city, knowing that it was backed by the Heavenly Fire Sect from Zhao Country.
After leaving Qingmu Building, he found an inn, tried the Four Spirits Pill and found its effects to be quite impressive. He then visited Longevity Immortal Tower before heading straight to Red Refining Hall. After some consideration, he decided to sell all the spiritual materials and unused magic artifacts he held to the latter.
In the process, he accidentally learned that the Fiery Red Horn he had retrieved from Tali Volcano through Huo Chan'er was the horn tip of a Second-level Demon Beast, the Molten Fire Rhinoceros, a main material for refining top-grade Fire Attribute magical tools, extremely rare. After some haggling, he sold it for a whopping six hundred and fifty Spirit Stones.
As a result, the Spirit Stones in his Storage Ring now amounted to close to four thousand.
Therefore, Yuan Ming returned to Qingmu Building, sought out the Shopkeeper Jiang Yuan, and bought another fifteen bottles of the Four Spirits Pill all at once. After learning that the other party loved paintings and calligraphy, they quickly became heartfelt friends upon seeing eye to eye, and he managed to get the shopkeeper to knock off another ten percent from the already discounted price.
"It seems I'll need to find a way to earn more Spirit Stones. These dozen or so bottles of elixirs won't last long if I go into seclusion," Yuan Ming murmured to himself, scanning the less than one thousand Spirit Stones remaining in his Storage Ring with his Divine Sense.
As he was worrying, a thought suddenly struck him. He took out a document from his Storage Ring and looked it over several times, a notion forming in his mind.
...
Half a day later, West City of Little Lake City, the Guangli Alliance's outpost.
As a quite famous Scatter Alliance within Da Jin, Guangli Alliance's branches were scattered throughout every market of Da Jin, and Little Lake City was no exception.
Yuan Ming looked up at the sign above the gate of the outpost to make sure he had found the right place, then braved the scrutinizing gaze of the guards and approached, spreading out the document in his hand.
"I've come to collect a debt!"Thiscopycomesfromcontenton*.
One of the guards at the gate became furious. He had been with the Guangli Alliance for many years and it had always been them collecting debts from others, never the other way around. He immediately wanted to teach Yuan Ming a lesson.
However, as his eyes scanned over the document and the Longevity Token in Yuan Ming's hand, his anger instantly dissipated.
Thinking it was a mistake, he reached out to take the document, but Yuan Ming swiftly tucked it away again.
"Let your Alliance Hierarch meet me," Yuan Ming said indifferently.
The guard glanced at Yuan Ming, noting that he was dressed in Chang Chun Temple's attire and did not dare to slight him. He quickly ushered Yuan Ming into the outpost and then turned to summon the branch president.
Yuan Ming waited for a short while in a room of the outpost, and soon enough, a young man dressed like a scholar came out smiling.
"Heh heh, I wondered why the magpies were chirping so happily early this morning. It turns out we have a friend from Chang Chun Temple visiting. I am Zhang Luhe, the steward of this place. May I know your distinguished surname?"
"Let's skip the pleasantries, shall we? My master is Xu Changqing. Today, I am here to collect a debt from your Guangli Alliance," Yuan Ming said with a cold face, slamming the document on the table.
At the time, Yuan Ming had disguised his Cultivation as being in the Qi Refinement Realm, whereas, as the president of the Guangli Alliance branch, Zhang Luhe's Cultivation had naturally reached the Foundation Establishment Stage.
Seeing a Qi Refining Disciple dare to order him around, Zhang Luhe's temper flared, and the smile on his face instantly vanished.
But after he picked up the document put forth by Yuan Ming and read it, he awkwardly began to smile again.
"This document...?"
"What about it? Let's get to the point, unless the Guangli Alliance intends to deny this debt," Yuan Ming scoffed.
"Not at all, it's just that this is a matter of great importance. I need to contact the Alliance Hierarch before making a decision. Please wait a moment; I will be back shortly," Zhang Luhe said with a forced smile.
With that, he took the document and hurried off, while Yuan Ming sat back relaxedly in the room, waiting for his response.

chapters.title: Chapter 276 - 253 Settling Down
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming took out a document, which was precisely the contract he had scavenged from Xu Changqing. It clearly stated that the Guangli Alliance was to assassinate him by a certain deadline. Now, that deadline had passed, and he had caused such a commotion in the Da Jin Capital that anyone would know that he was not only still alive but had also become a Foundation Establishment Cultivator.
Now, by showing up at their door disguised as a disciple of the Chang Chun Temple asking for debts, with proof in hand, no one could find any fault.
Moreover, even if they wanted to find Xu Changqing, who held the document, to verify its authenticity, unless they could locate Yuan Ming's corpse inside his Storage Bag, who could claim that he was not a disciple of the Chang Chun Temple?
After a while, Zhang Luhe returned with the document, his smile seemingly more genuine than before.
"I have confirmed with the Alliance Hierarch. Your document is authentic. However, why has your master not come in person?" he asked.
"The master said he no longer wishes to deal with you," Yuan Ming replied indifferently.
Zhang Luhe's hand, clutching the document, tightened suddenly, but he relaxed after a moment and took out a Storage Bag from his waist.
"Hehe, we indeed missed this time. According to the contract, here is the compensation of 1,500 Spirit Stones. Additionally, there are 500 Spirit Stones as a prepaid deposit. Please accept it with a smile."
"That's more like it." Yuan Ming nodded calmly, accepted the Storage Bag, and without another word, turned and left the Guangli Alliance's quarters.
After Yuan Ming left, a man in a white robe appeared in the room, looking in the direction Yuan Ming had left. He asked, "Brother Zhang, this was a big loss for the business."
"Alas, there are times when one makes mistakes. Who would have thought that Yuan Ming would escape the pursuit and then go on to kill Elder Yuhu during the succession ceremony? Fortunately, we did not encounter him. Had we really met, our Southern Border colleagues would have been in danger too. I've said it many times that we must be prepared with accurate information. It's just that they were blinded by Spirit Stones," Zhang Luhe sighed.
A street away, Yuan Ming thought about the extra two thousand Spirit Stones in his Storage Bag and could no longer restrain the smile on his face. With these Spirit Stones, he could naturally exchange them for numerous elixirs for cultivation, as well as materials to make Spirit Incense.
As he was calculating in his mind, he suddenly paused in his steps.
Yuan Ming looked sideways and saw a uniquely shaped building not far away. The lower half was a normal tower, but the upper half looked like a colossal sword of refined iron, thrust directly into the tower, quite imposing.
On the plaque above its front door were just three big characters—Loose Cultivation Association.
Driven by considerable curiosity, Yuan Ming entered and saw a vertical square stone in the center of the room, with "Evil Cultivator List" written at the top. Below it, in blood-red ink, were dozens of names, with their respective cultivation levels indicated, followed by a number, seemingly representing the bounty of Spirit Stones.
Yuan Ming looked up to the top of the stone, where a cultivator named "Elder Youquan" was listed, with an impressive Peak of Core Formation cultivation level, and a whopping bounty of five hundred thousand Spirit Stones at the end.
At the bottom was a cultivator named "Pu Zhengqing," at the Foundation Establishment stage, whose exact strength was unclear, but who was also a Soul Cultivator, with a bounty of one hundred thousand Spirit Stones. However, there were two small characters added to the end—"Alive".
Having reviewed the list, Yuan Ming couldn't help but marvel and understood his own worth.
It seemed that within the Da Jin Cultivation World, where cultivation resources were relatively abundant, the number and strength of Loose Cultivators were incomparable to those in smaller places like the Southern Border and Northern Territory. And there was such a list, though it was hard to say whether those listed as evil cultivators truly deserved bad reputations.
Looking at the names on the list, each represented a genuinely strong cultivator, none of whom he felt he could currently handle.
He had been complacent, believing that as a Soul Cultivator, he could be invincible among his peers, but now he realized that was too optimistic.
There were higher peaks to climb, and more powerful individuals out there—his current cultivation level had only just risen above the lowest ranks in the world of cultivation. He wasn't like the protagonists in the stories, who could always turn misfortune into fortune.
He would have to act humbly and cautiously—for caution can make one sail the seas forever.
After the duel with Master Yu Hu in the Imperial City, although it felt good at the moment to get revenge, now he had to move stealthily.
Nonetheless, this also ignited a strong desire in Yuan Ming's heart for the first time. He had to continuously improve his cultivation and enhance his strength to gain more influence. After all, if he was not at just the Early-stage Foundation Establishment, why would he need to worry about his family being affected by his troubles, or having to leave his home shortly after returning and leave his parents again?
The root cause was that he did not have the ability to protect his family, or even fully protect himself.
He collected his thoughts, looked at the list one more time with a trace of doubt in his heart. Surely, the Loose Cultivation Association, aimed at serving the numerous Loose Cultivators and their associations, should not just have these high-profile lists?
After asking at a nearby counter, he learned that this huge stone only recorded Evil Cultivators with bounties exceeding one hundred thousand Spirit Stones. For those with lower bounties, one would need to inquire separately.
Besides the Evil Cultivator List, there was a specific mission list. Anyone could post tasks or bounties on these two lists after paying a deposit.
And if a Loose Cultivator wanted to take on a task, they, too, had to pay a certain deposit and prove their strength. In principle, one could not take on tasks much beyond his ability.
Yuan Ming had no intention of taking on tasks for now. So, he just quickly scanned the Evil Cultivator List to confirm that his name wasn't on it, then left without lingering any longer.
He had planned to go to Qingmu Building to buy some Four Spirits Pills, but at this moment he had lost this mood, after all, as long as there were enough Spirit Stones, elixirs could be bought at any time, it was not urgent for now, but there was something that did need to be verified.
Previously, Xi Ying had given him a Blood Egg, and on his way back to Da Jin, he had tried many methods but all failed to hatch it. He had even tried the method taught by Xi Ying to drip Essence Blood on it daily to no avail, and moreover, he was unable to feel any fluctuation of Spiritual Energy within the egg.
This made him wonder, could the Blood Egg possibly be hatched at all, or was there at least some way to confirm whether it was still alive?
After some thought, he realized he would have to ask someone more knowledgeable in this field.
Now that he had arrived in Thunder Continent, he thought of the one-armed elder Gu Qiuming from the Sect that happened to specialize in this area.
Yuan Ming took out a map, quickly located the Treasure Spirit Pavilion, and walked briskly towards it.
No sooner had he stepped in than a steward in a fiery red long robe greeted him.
Without waiting for him to ask, Yuan Ming said, "Excuse me, Fellow Daoist, is there a Cultivator named Gu Qiuming here?"
"Sorry, Deacon Gu returned to his Sect not long ago and is not currently here. However, if you need, I can relay a message to him," the steward courteously replied.
"That will do, just say an old acquaintance from Black Rock City is visiting; he will know who it is," Yuan Ming said upon hearing this.
The steward immediately agreed and then began to promote the various exotic beasts in the shop.
Many were common in Southern Border; the good ones were unaffordable, and the lesser ones were not as good as his own, yet the prices were more than triple those of Southern Border. Yuan Ming showed little interest and made some perfunctory replies before turning around and leaving.
...
At night, Yuan Ming stood by the window of his room in the inn, gazing outwards.
This was the second floor, with quite a broad view.
The Inside of Little Lake City was brightly lit at this moment, dazzlingly beautiful against the backdrop of the night sky.
After a long while, Yuan Ming turned and walked back to the bedside, took out the White Jade Ring and observed it for a moment, then put it into his Storage Ring as his eyes gradually firmed up.
He had finally made a decision in his heart: he would not go to Shengye Sect but would settle for a long-term cultivation in Little Lake City's Square Market.Y#o*ur s.upp@o#rt at *. keep!s$ the ser+ies* goi+ng.!
Firstly, he was afraid of bringing trouble to his grandmother's Sect, as his circumstances could implicate his mother's family, thus adding to his mother's worries. Secondly, Yuan Ming had really grown tired of the tedious rules of the Sect, where reporting was required for going anywhere and approval was needed to leave the Sect; Little Lake City's Square Market was the second largest market in Da Jin, with rich Spiritual Energy and everything one could need. Thirdly, there were many Loose Cultivators in the market, the best place to hide is in plain sight.
As for the resources needed for cultivation like elixirs, he intended to find a way himself, convincing himself that even if he were at Shengye Sect, as a Foundation Establishment Cultivator, he would still be an outsider and dependent on others, and it was unlikely he would receive preferential treatment.
With this thought, Yuan Ming felt even more confident in his choice.
The next morning, he came to a large and impressive palace near the lake in the city center, bustling with people coming and going.
Two guarding Cultivators stood at the door of the great hall, paying no attention to those entering and leaving.
Yuan Ming walked into one of the side rooms, which was simply furnished with a long grey-white stone table, behind which sat four or five Cultivators in white.
Inside the hall, many Cultivators gathered, sitting next to the stone table and talking in low voices with the white-robed Cultivators, some were cheerful while others had frowns on their faces.
This was the place in Little Lake City's Square Market where houses were rented out.
"Fellow Daoist, are you here to rent or buy a house, and have you chosen a location?" the white-robed Cultivator asked with a smile, showing no disdain for Yuan Ming's apparent Qi Refinement Cultivation.
"Renting a house, in the Outer Area, but it should be by the street, the cheaper the better," Yuan Ming did not bother to inquire about the price of purchasing a house, presuming he couldn't afford it, so he said.
"There are many vacant houses in the cheaper Outer Area. There are eighty-nine available in East City, and one hundred and twenty-one in West City. Here is the price list; Fellow Daoist may wish to look it over," the white-robed Cultivator said as he handed over two pieces of Jade Scrolls.
Yuan Ming picked up a Jade Scroll and scanned it with his Divine Sense, his brow furrowed in hesitation. Renting a house in Little Lake City was not cheap; even those in the Outer Area cost one or two hundred Spirit Stones a year.
"This city is abundant in Spiritual Energy and has a Nascent Soul cultivator in residence, ensuring safety. Little Lake City is the second largest market in Da Jin, where every corner offers convenience for living. As for where to live, it depends on what Fellow Daoist needs," the white-robed Cultivator kept listing the benefits of living in Little Lake City.

chapters.title: Chapter 277 - 254: Opening a Store
chapters.content:
"As you said, let's go with this one, Eighty-five Horse Hoof Lane in East City." Yuan Ming handed back the Jade Scroll and said.
This house was somewhat secluded, with a yearly rent of one hundred and fifty Spirit Stones.
"Fellow Daoist has a good eye. This house not only faces the street, but also has good size and layout. It can be used both for business and as a living space for cultivation. It's truly the best of both worlds," said the cultivator in white.
"This is the first year's rent. Hu Tu, a Loose Cultivator from Yue Country." Yuan Ming figured that if he spent one Spirit Stone daily on expenses and accommodation, it would still be more cost-effective to rent a place directly, so he took out a small bag of Spirit Stones and placed it on the table.
The white-robed cultivator efficiently counted them and, without asking further about 'Hu Tu's' background, handed over a set of keys and a token with Hu Tu's name and the proof of residence for Little Lake City, and said, "Fellow Daoist can make any changes inside the residence, but do not tamper with the walls. The bricks and stones in our city are specially crafted, with some protection against prying. You'll need to compensate at cost if they're damaged."
Indeed, quality comes at a price.
"Sorry for the disturbance." Yuan Ming nodded, took the keys, and got up to leave.
He first wandered around the workshop area and spent fifty Spirit Stones on two sets of simple House Protection Arrays for decorating cave mansions, then he headed eastward.
When he arrived at Horse Hoof Lane, he found it more secluded than he had imagined, with few people around.
Yuan Ming quickly located house number eighty-five.
The house faced the street and had a garden in the back, along with two inner rooms. The layout and setting were indeed nice.
However, the place had not been lived in for a long time and was covered in dust.
After cleaning up, Yuan Ming just settled in one of the rooms in the backyard, but then he thought again and returned to the rental place.
He soon was back at the rental property.
Using the name 'Hagon,' Yuan Ming rented the house across the street at number eighty-six. During this rental, he used an Illusion Technique on the person responsible for the rental, quickly completed the procedures, took the token, and left.
Having offended Chang Chun Temple, Yuan Ming spared no expense in preparing an extra residence for emergencies, even spending a hundred Spirit Stones on a short-range Teleportation Array, with three Spirit Stones placed at the Array Eye.
Yuan Ming set up the Teleportation Arrays between the two houses and returned to house number eighty-six.
This house had the same layout as number eighty-five. He chose a room in the inner house as his personal cultivation space and set up the entire set of House Protection Arrays there.
The other set of arrays he installed around the perimeter of the entire backyard, forming two layers of defense.
By the time he was done, it was already dark.
Looking at his day's work, Yuan Ming was quite satisfied. Though it was still somewhat simple, he finally had a proper residence and began planning his following cultivation practices.
For him, the most important thing was certainly the improvement of his cultivation level. Although the Nine Elements Technique was performing well, cultivation at the Foundation Establishment Stage was still quite slow. If assisted by elixirs and Spirit Incense, the process would naturally be much more effective.
Although he had already purchased a batch of Four Spirits Pills, such Foundation Establishment Stage elixirs were indeed expensive. With his modest amount of Spirit Stones, it would not take long before he ran through them unless he established a sustainable way to make money.
He had rented these two street-facing shops with that in mind.
Yuan Ming pondered his current capabilities and after careful consideration decided to make and sell Spirit Incense.
First published on *.
He had looked around the market district the day before and found no shops selling Spirit Incense here.
Spirit Incense was not valued in Southern Border, and probably the same in Da Jin, but he believed this had much to do with the marketing philosophy of Immortal Xuanhua. Although inferior to similarly priced elixirs in effect, the auxiliary benefits of this product were actually quite significant.
In a Cultivation World like Da Jin, there were always cultivators and sects who were not short of Spirit Stones, just lacking in promotion.
With the varieties of Spirit Incense he currently mastered, as long as he operated properly, making Spirit Stones should not be difficult.
Thinking further, now that his cultivation had reached the Foundation Establishment Stage, using Spirit Incense for possession to influence Immortal Xuanhua's behaviors would be easier, and learning to create new varieties of Spirit Incense was feasible without worrying about not being able to introduce new products. Eventually, he would master all the skills of Immortal Xuanhua.
Yuan Ming returned to house number eighty-five via the Teleportation Array, went out, and bought a batch of materials for making Spirit Incense and items needed to set up shop, such as counters and shelves, and started recruiting a shopkeeper.
Ten days later, a brand new shop opened at Eighty-five Horse Hoof Lane: "Xuanhua Spirit Incense Shop."
The shopkeeper was named Mu Yang, a Qi Refining Third Level Cultivator whom Yuan Ming had recruited. After some investigation, he found that Mu Yang's master was a Loose Cultivator who had passed away and knew a few low-level Earth Magic spells. Yuan Ming hired him for ten Spirit Stones a month to open the shop during the day and sell incense.
The shop opening did not attract much attention, and the shelves were filled with common Spirit Incense for blessings, ghost banishing, and calming minds. The only valuable item was the "Qingxuan Incense," priced at one Spirit Stone each.
As for higher-grade Spirit Incense like "Purple Mysterious Incense", he planned to stock them later.
The neighboring businesses were quite curious about this obscure product, discreetly inquiring one after another.
The business at Xuanhua Spirit Incense Shop was very average, often going several days with just one transaction. Those people soon lost interest and no longer visited. As for the dismal state of the incense business, Yuan Ming was not in a hurry; business also depended on opportunities, and tireless promotion was useless without them.
All arrangements were set, and Yuan Ming's life entered a proper routine.
He returned to number eighty-six and alternatively engaged in incense making and consuming elixirs he had bought to enhance his cultivation, studying the spells recorded in the book during his idle moments.
Moreover, he specially took three days to fly far to the edge of another small city in the Thunder Continent, sending a letter to his parents and Liu Tianming to report his safety, but he did not disclose his current whereabouts.
Along with the letter, he also sent "Mr. Sheng's Eastern Travelogue," compiling his experiences traveling to Yue Country and hunting beasts at sea into a new storybook, with Tianming Bookstore as the recipient.
As days passed, Yuan Ming overcame the initial discomfort and increasingly felt that the decision to stay in Little Lake City was correct.
He didn't have to look at anyone's face or worry about exposing his secrets and could freely arrange all his time.
He often visited the workshop and tea houses, chatted with other cultivators, learned about the dynamics of the Cultivation World, and met many cultivators. Though busy every day, his life was exceptionally fulfilling, and he was growing to like it more and more.
Hua Zhi was naturally active and had endured while they were traveling, but now that Yuan Ming had settled down, Hua Zhi could no longer bear it and insisted on going out.
Yuan Ming could not resist it and had to release it from the Spiritual Beast Bag.
Hua Zhi did not take the proper path but directly tried to tunnel under the earth to leave Little Lake City and enter the marsh outside the city, yet it was blocked by the city's formation, so it had to obediently shrink inside the bag and follow Yuan Ming through the city gate.
This swamp was known as Rain Ruins Swamp, covering a vast area and was one of the notorious dangerous places in the Thunder Continent. Due to humid climate and constant rainfall, it was filled with poison miasma and housed many poisonous insects and demon beasts.
Hua Zhi was not weak in strength and had even learned earth tunneling, so Yuan Ming was not worried about its safety.
Another month passed in a blink of an eye.
In the room of number eighty-six, Yuan Ming chanted spells and made gestures with his hands.
An invisible protective shield appeared around him, encompassing a radius of four to five yards, and all external sounds disappeared, completely isolated.
A satisfied smile appeared on his face; this was the "Soundproofing Technique," considered one of the more complex techniques in that magic book, which ordinary cultivators might need a long time to master.
With his Foundation Establishment cultivation and strong Divine Sense, Yuan Ming had learned it in just two days.
He then tested other effects of the soundproofing technique and, quite satisfied, dismissed the technique with a wave of his hand.
Yuan Ming picked up the magic book beside him and put it away.
He had already learned all the spells in this book, which filled the gap he had in spells.
Unfortunately, the spells recorded in the book were ordinary, sufficient for everyday use but ineffective against strong enemies.
However, Yuan Ming was not worried; he had seen many Foundation Establishment Cultivators from Chang Chun Temple and other sects of Da Jin during the inheritance ceremony. Possessing those people and suggesting them covertly to steal some spells should not be a difficult task.
He took out the Stealing Heaven Tripod and inserted a stick of Black Incense into it.
This stick of Black Incense was made using the incense ashes from Xuanhua Temple, into which he had mixed some previously acquired Fire Pine Wood, curious about its effectiveness and ready to try it out.
Yuan Ming lit the Black Incense and after a brief contemplation, he locked onto an old woman with a cane from the Bailuo Manor in his mind.
Her cultivation level was not very high, and she was very old and weak, making her easier to control, so he decided to start learning with her.
The Black Incense quickly ignited, and Yuan Ming's vision darkened. When he came around, he had already possessed the old woman with the cane.
The place seemed to be a spacious and unoccupied cave mansion, where the old woman was meditating. Air continuously streamed from her mouth and nose in wisps of purple qi, which rapidly traveled around her body before slowly merging into her fingernails.
Her fingertips gradually turned purple, appearing strikingly exotic.
Yuan Ming was surprised and was about to sense the old woman's consciousness when a thought suddenly occurred to him.
"After possession, shouldn't I only be able to observe the surroundings through the possessed person's viewpoint? Why can I see the surroundings when this woman is meditating with closed eyes?"
It seemed he had experienced something similar a couple of times before, but he had not paid attention to it back then.
"Could it be due to my improved cultivation or the continuous enhancement of the Black Incense?" Yuan Ming speculated.
He quickly stopped his pointless thinking and focused on sensing the old woman's cultivation status.
The technique she was currently cultivating seemed to be a poisoning spell; the wisps of purple qi all contained intense poison, which, once merged into the nails, layered the poison deeper, ready to be released when necessary.
This method not only made poisoning convenient but also strengthened the toxicity. The intense poison in the old woman's nails had evidently reached an astonishing level, and she was very cautious herself.
Yuan Ming was quite interested in this technique and, after careful realization, quickly learned it fairly thoroughly.

chapters.title: Chapter 278 - 255 Assassination
chapters.content:
Having just possessed a body and learned a practical spell, Yuan Ming was quite excited. He then repeatedly hinted to the old woman, trying to make her practice another spell.
After Yuan Ming hinted more than ten times, the cane-wielding old woman stopped practicing, stood up, and moved toward the entrance of the cave.
The entrance was blocked by a giant stone several meters high. The old woman placed her palm on it, and a layer of yellow glow emanated from the stone. It shot up from the ground like a bullet, making a "whoosh" sound as it flew outside.
At a thought, Yuan Ming recognized that the old woman was casting a Middle-level Earth Attribute spell, Stone Control Technique, which could manipulate soil and rocks and was very useful in battle.
Unfortunately, his Spirit Root was deficient in the Earth Element, so he couldn't grasp Earth Attribute magic and didn't bother to perceive the casting process.
Outside the cave was a vast forest of towering stones, among which vines and trees thrived. Even further away, countless tall trees grew, making it look like a wilderness. It was unclear why the old woman had come here.
Just as the cane-wielding old woman was about to leave, a black sword light suddenly shot out from the stone forest without warning, stabbing toward her neck.
The old woman, startled, swung her cane horizontally, and a yellow shadow met the black sword light.
Her other hand radiated a dense yellow glow, as if she was about to use another Divine Skill.
However, at that moment, the black sword light suddenly changed, twisting like a Spiritual Snake, easily avoiding the cane's shadow and stabbing into the old woman's chest at a speed as fast as lightning, piercing through her back.
Bang!
A cloud of blood mist sprayed backward, staining a large area of the ground red.
Yuan Ming, because he was possessing the old woman, was startled by such an immersive sudden attack, and only now did he recover his senses.
Being merely a spirit possessing the old woman, his perception of the surroundings was limited, and he hadn't seen everything clearly.
The cane-wielding old woman spat out a mouthful of fresh blood, her eyes filled with extreme shock and rage. She took out an elixir and swallowed it, while her other hand stretched forward and shot out five purple rays like long dragons from her fingernails, striking rapidly into the stone forest ahead.
The rocks and trees in the stone forest, touched by the purple rays, "sizzled" and melted through like candles.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming couldn't help but admire the lethal potency of the old woman's Poisonous Divine Power. Not to mention a cultivator's body, even a Magic Artifact might not withstand it, making Hua Zhi's poison seem insignificant in comparison.
Although the cane-wielding old woman's Poisonous Divine Power was formidable, her vital spot had been hit and, due to her severe injuries and the leakage of Mana, she soon collapsed weakly on the ground. Her eyes were fixed on the stone forest, filled with hatred and unwillingness, seemingly desperate to know who had killed her.
This old woman held a high position in Bailuo Manor, yet someone had so easily assassinated her. Yuan Ming was also quite curious about the identity of the assassin and looked toward the passage as well.
Time passed slowly, and no one appeared from inside the stone forest.
The cane-wielding old woman's breath grew weaker and weaker and stopped after a few breaths; her eyes slowly closed.
Yuan Ming sighed inwardly. At this moment, since he was possessing the cane-wielding old woman and she was dead, his possession was likely to end, and he wouldn't be able to see the assassin.
However, contrary to his expectations, as the cane-wielding old woman's breath completely dissipated and her Divine Soul Power began to disperse, he could still see his surroundings.Uploaded by the *) team.
"Why is this happening?"
Yuan Ming was filled with shock and suspicion, and hastily sensed the situation of his possession more carefully, soon making a discovery.
His Divine Soul Power could actually diffuse outward, similar to activating Divine Sense to probe, but much more subtle; if he didn't sense carefully, he would hardly notice it himself.
Yuan Ming realized why he could still see the surroundings when the old woman's eyes were closed.
He guessed that this was somehow related to the incense ashes used to make the Spirit Incense. Could it be that these ashes, having been worshipped by cultivators, triggered so many changes after possession?
Just then, a figure in a broad black cloak emerged from the passage, face unseen.
Yuan Ming extended his Soul Power to try to discern this person's features, but as his Soul Power touched the black cloak, it was blocked by an invisible force, leaving him unable to detect anything.
The robed figure approached the old woman's corpse and took her storage magic tool and the cane artifact.
Yuan Ming felt darkness envelop his sight, and his consciousness completely sank into darkness, returning to his body.
He slowly opened his eyes, silent, his mind whirling.
Who exactly was this black-robed person who had suddenly assassinated the old woman?
However, if he himself had encountered such an attack, how would he have reacted? After briefly pondering without conclusion, he set the thought aside for the time being.
This possession had been full of unexpected events and had not tested the duration of possession from adding Fire Pine Wood to the Black Incense. He would have to wait for the next possession to find out.
Yuan Ming lit a stick of Purple Dark Incense, placing it in the Stealing Heaven Tripod. The incense smoke rose faintly, forming a snake-like pattern, coiling around him. Yuan Ming inhaled, and the spirit smoke split into two streams that he breathed in through his nostrils while swallowing a Four Spirits Pill and simultaneously practicing the Nine Elements Technique.
Suddenly, his Divine Sense in his mind fluctuated.
This was caused by the trembling of the Beast Taming Rune inside Hua Zhi. The Vine Demon was likely battling another formidable opponent again, its demonic power operating too intensely and affecting the runes inside it.
Yuan Ming was not surprised; similar instances had occurred many times this month. Hua Zhi seemed very keen on hunting, and he had long since grown accustomed to it.
After steadying his spirit, Yuan Ming closed his eyes again and immersed himself in his cultivation practice.
...
Inside the Rain Ruins Swamp.
Hua Zhi was battling a black mantis-like demon beast.
This mantis beast was about sixty feet long with sharp eyes, and its forelimbs resembled two giant black machetes, slashing through the air and creating dark lines that severed trees and stones alike upon contact.
Facing the black mantis, Hua Zhi was extraordinarily cautious, summoning demon vines from all directions to attack while avoiding the forelimbs' slashes.
Around Hua Zhi, many small demon beasts followed suit, including other Vine Demons like Hua Zhi and various poisonous insects and small beasts, amounting to about twenty or thirty, all seemingly under Hua Zhi's command.
These small demons along with Hua Zhi attacked the black mantis from all directions.
The black mantis gradually became overwhelmed, trying several times to fly away but being stopped by Hua Zhi every time.
After a few moments of struggle, the black mantis began to slow down and in a moment of carelessness, one of Hua Zhi's demon vines pierced its hard chest shell, burrowing into its flesh.
Enraged, the black mantis chopped the offending vine in half with a swipe of its limb.
Just as it was about to counterattack, it suddenly felt a severe pain in its chest. The earlier vine had continued to move inside its body, burrowing deeper toward its heart, quickly piercing it.
The black mantis let out a mournful cry, fell to the ground, and after struggling for a moment, lay still.
Hua Zhi extended a vine into the chest cavity of the black mantis and quickly wrapped around a broken vine, which twisted like a snake.
A flash of purple light passed, and the broken vine slowly merged into the vine that had captured it.
Other demon vines from Hua Zhi pierced the black mantis's body, rapidly draining its blood until only a dry husk remained.
It then manipulated the vines to morph into blade shapes, severing the two black forelimbs and bringing them in front of itself before waving its hand.
Nearby, a swarm of small demons crowded around, eagerly devouring the remains of the black mantis and quickly finishing it off.
Hua Zhi spat out a storage ring and collected the sharp forelimbs of the mantis.
This storage ring was given to it by Yuan Ming before coming to the Rain Ruins Swamp, and it could be used with Hua Zhi's demonic power.
Yuan Ming allowed it to roam freely, but not without conditions; he wanted Hua Zhi to help gather various spiritual materials from within the Rain Ruins Swamp and send them back periodically.
"Really knows how to use others." Hua Zhi put away the ring, slightly dissatisfied as it muttered to itself and led the group of small demons forward.
...
Seven days passed quickly, and the Tai Chi Pattern on the Stealing Heaven Tripod was restored. Yuan Ming took out an hourglass and lit a Black Incense added with Fire Pine Wood, and once again undertook possession.
This time, his target was Liu Tianming.
Yuan Ming's vision went dark, and when he came to, he had possessed Emperor Liu Tianming.
At that moment, Liu Tianming was walking along a White Jade Mountain Road, an extraordinarily long path leading to the summit of a giant peak that seemed to reach into the clouds, like a staircase to heaven.
Under the sunlight, the White Jade Mountain Road shimmered, and the peak was radiant with golden light, while nearby stood grand and tall buildings.
In the half-sky above, auspicious clouds were abundant, and immortal cranes flew about, creating an air of a heavenly palace.
"Tsk tsk, this is Chang Chun Temple, really the top Cultivation sect of Da Jin, not at all comparable to Biluo Cave," Yuan Ming remarked to himself as he viewed the scene, feeling quite impressed.
"Who on earth thought of building the Book Collection Pavilion on the peak? Every time it's such a long trek," Emperor Liu Tianming suddenly stopped walking, sat down on a big rock nearby, and grumbled discontentedly.
Yuan Ming didn't bother being polite with the Emperor, subtly bombarding his mind with the words "Fire Cloud Secret Technique."
Ever since entering the Cultivation World, the most powerful Fire attribute magic he had seen was the Fire Cloud Secret Technique. The day he confronted Master Yu Hu, he had thought about stealing the technique.
Previously in the Da Jin Palace, Yuan Ming had subtly encouraged the Emperor to learn the Fire Cloud Secret Technique, exactly for the opportunity to steal the technique himself.
After all this time, he wondered if the Emperor had learned it yet.
The Emperor's cultivation level was slightly lower than Yuan Ming's, and his Divine Sense was not as strong as Yuan Ming's, who quickly influenced him. The Emperor's mind shifted from thinking about the classical texts to concentrating on the Fire Cloud Secret Technique.
He suddenly took out a red Jade Scroll from the storage ring, but then paused, speaking to himself in confusion, "Huh, why did I suddenly take out this Jade Scroll for the Fire Cloud Skill?"
He initially intended to put the scroll away, but after thinking for a moment, he placed it on his forehead and released his Divine Sense into it.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming also extended his Divine Sense into the scroll, finally accessing the long-desired Fire Cloud Secret Technique.
However, the contents of the scroll were quite complex, giving him quite the headache upon first glance.
The Fire Cloud Secret Technique was not just a simple spell; it incorporated several Fire attribute spells, as well as Prohibition Techniques, a rune system, and more, making it far more complex than any magic he had encountered before.
Although Yuan Ming believed he had some talent in magic, such a complex secret technique would take at least a year and a half of exploration before he could possibly master it.

chapters.title: Chapter 279 - 256: Hard Work Pays Off for the Dedicated
chapters.content:
"This Fire Cloud Skill is indeed abstruse and difficult to understand, I should ask Grandpa Emperor for guidance when I have time," Emperor Liu Tianming snapped back to reality, looking at the jade scroll in his hand and sighed.
He shook his head, put away the jade scroll, and quickened his pace. Soon, he arrived at the peak and stood in front of a white jade hall with golden letters on the plaque that read "Book Sea".
There were no guards at the entrance of the hall, and on each side stood a bronze giant beast statue, each towering seven to eight zhang high, one a giant green lion, the other an exotic beast resembling a horse with an extremely long neck.
Just as Liu Tianming was about to step inside, a voice came from the side, "The Book Sea is a vital area of Chang Chun Temple. Which disciple from which Sect are you, not knowing you need to show a permission token before entering?"
Liu Tianming was taken aback and then realized the speaker was the long-necked exotic beast statue on his right. The statue suddenly came to life, stretching its neck out in front of Liu Tianming with bell-sized eyes staring intently at him, an imposing aura emanating from it.
"Are you the esteemed Bai Ze of the Book Sea? Junior Liu Tianming has recently joined Chang Chun Temple and has not yet taken a master, so I am unaware of the rules here. Please forgive my ignorance, this is the permission token." Liu Tianming bowed deeply, respectfully producing a white jade token.
"Seeing as you're quite respectful, lad, I'll let go of this transgression of trespassing. You may enter," the long-necked exotic beast nodded and said, its neck gradually retracting.
Liu Tianming thanked the beast and then walked into the hall.
From the outside, the Book Sea Hall appeared magnificent, but upon entering, he was greeted by rows and rows of extraordinarily tall bookshelves reaching seven to eight zhang high, some floating in mid-air requiring one to look up to see them.
Two side doors were to the left and right of the main hall, seemingly leading to two side chambers filled with tall bookshelves stacked with innumerable books and jade scrolls—a sight worthy of the name "Book Sea," that made it feel like the books were mountains and the knowledge a sea.
Yuan Ming marveled at the sight before him.
The Gui Cang Pavilion of Biluo Cave also had many classics and books, but compared to this place, it was like comparing clouds to mud—there simply was no comparison.
Liu Tianming too was awed by the scene before him and stood stunned for a moment before regaining composure and began searching through the shelves.
Seizing the opportunity, Yuan Ming observed that the layout of the Book Sea's collections was quite ordered, divided into multiple areas according to topics like Cultivation Techniques, Spells, Geography, History, Sect anecdotes, spiritual materials, elixirs, Arrays, etc. Despite the vast quantity of books, one would not feel dazzled or have difficulty searching.
Yuan Ming looked toward the Spell area, where the bookshelves were enveloped by a white light screen. Inside were placed numerous jade scrolls, and next to them were plaques recording the names of Spells for the Qi Refinement Realm, Foundation Establishment Stage, and even Core Formation Stage.
Yuan Ming was quite envious, but Liu Tianming headed straight for the area with the spiritual material classics.
He hesitated for a moment but did not forcefully hint to Liu Tianming to go there.
Liu Tianming was likely in the Book Sea to look up important materials, and Yuan Ming had already delayed him enough. There would be plenty of time in the future to manipulate him into borrowing those Spell jade scrolls.
Liu Tianming stopped in front of a bookshelf that was also shrouded in a white forbidden light. As he was about to search, a cloud of white fog surged on the light screen of the bookshelf and condensed into a figure about one chi tall, which astonishingly spoke human language, "Which classics do you need?"
"Who are you?" Liu Tianming was startled.
"I am the Array Spirit formed by the Book Sea Restriction. There are many classics in the Book Sea, and it is too time-consuming to search on one's own. Tell me the name or category of the book you wish to read, and I will guide you to its location," the white fog figure said.
"So you are the esteemed Array Spirit of the Book Sea. I am looking for content related to the Silver Chalice Flower," Liu Tianming said.
"The Silver Chalice Flower is a herbaceous spirit plant of the Asteraceae family, and the related classics are in the spiritual material area, third bookshelf, second layer," the white fog Array Spirit pointed to a bookshelf not far away and said.
"Thank you for your guidance, Array Spirit," Liu Tianming said with gratitude and quickly walked over, soon finding the related classics.
He took out a green token, which was the Identity Plate of a Chang Chun Temple Disciple, with the number five hundred appearing on it.
Liu Tianming activated the token, aiming it at a book within the light screen and lightly tapping it.
The number on the green token decreased slightly, and the book inside the light screen automatically flew out and into his hand.
Liu Tianming flipped through the classics, scanning them quickly.
Chang Chun Temple, being the leading Cultivation Sect in Da Jin, had unique insights in its collected materials. Yuan Ming followed along with Liu Tianming's reading of a few pages and felt he had gained quite a bit and was about to seize the opportunity to study further.
Just at that moment, the possession ended, and his consciousness returned to his original body.
Yuan Ming immediately checked the hourglass beside him, a hint of joy in his eyes.
The Fire Pine Wood, as a superior spiritual material, had replaced the previous Spiritual Pine, significantly extending the time of possession, almost reaching a quarter of an hour.
Moreover, from the information obtained through Liu Tianming, he knew little about the Fire Cloud Skill, while the old emperor seemed to have a good understanding of it.T-his@ t.r.ans%l*at.io.n is po%were#d by the r!e%ad%e*r*s& at M|&V.|#L%E#9-MPY#R.
It seemed Yuan Ming needed to change his strategy now.
Yuan Ming closed his eyes and took a moment to recuperate, then took out a blank jade scroll to copy down the Fire Cloud Secret Technique he had secretly learned, lest he forget it.
He didn't overestimate his ability to comprehend this secret technique on his own. After storing away the jade scroll and hourglass, he resumed the cultivation of the Nine Elements Technique.
Seven days later.
Yuan Ming lit incense and sat cross-legged with closed eyes.
His target this time was to possess the old emperor to delve into his understanding of the Fire Cloud Skill.
At that moment, the old emperor was sitting cross-legged in a dark room, eyes closed, breathing controlled, his aura circulating at an exceedingly slow pace, indicating some Cultivation Technique in progress.
After verifying the surroundings and situation, Yuan Ming immediately tried to influence his cultivation of the Fire Cloud Secret Technique through mental suggestion.
Perhaps it was because the old emperor's cultivation had reached the Late Foundation Establishment stage, much more advanced than Yuan Ming's, that his will was extremely firm. Yuan Ming exhausted a great deal of effort, yet by the time the possession ended, he still hadn't succeeded, not even causing the slightest ripple in the other's state of mind.
He did not get discouraged. After seven days, he continued to attempt suggestive possession, but it still ended in failure.
It wasn't until the third attempt that, perhaps the suggestion had taken effect, the old emperor executed the Fire Cloud Secret Technique once, and Yuan Ming hastily took the opportunity to comprehend it.
However, the technique was extremely complex. Merely relying on one observation, he naturally couldn't master it.
But with this beginning, the old emperor seemed to have lost his initial resistance to executing the Fire Cloud Skill. However, since this technique was quite conspicuous when used, the old emperor, likely due to concerns, always kept its power at the lowest when he executed it.
This did not impact Yuan Ming's comprehension of its execution process. After observing it several more times, fortune favoured the persistent, and Yuan Ming finally mastered this high-level spell as he wished.
Of course, this was only a preliminary mastery. To truly unleash its power, he still needed to practice it himself repeatedly.
...
One day, more than a month later.
In the depths of the Rain Ruins Swamp, next to a black pool, a thick red light suddenly rose and formed a rich fire cloud of about seven or eight zhang in size in mid-air, with flames rolling within it.
Even though it was raining in the sky, it did not affect the fire cloud in the slightest.
Yuan Ming stood on a White Jade Shuttle, hovering in mid-air, forming a spell seal with his hands and pointing at the black pool.
"Go!"
Seven or eight large fireballs shot out from within the fire cloud and entered the pool.
These Bursting Fireballs, condensed from the Fire Cloud Secret Technique, could not be extinguished by ordinary water.
A few breaths later, violent explosions roared from within the pool, throwing up gigantic waves several zhang high, turning the clear water turbid.
Hua Zhi was also nearby. Seeing this scene, her face showed pleasure.
"Roar—!" A low roar came from the pool, with a deterrence that could pierce one's Divine Soul.
"Master, be careful, it's coming out!" Hua Zhi's voice transmission rang in Yuan Ming's mind.
Before her voice faded, the turbid water suddenly churned, and a thick shadow shot out, pouncing towards Yuan Ming in mid-air like lightning.
Yuan Ming was well-prepared, controlling the Jade Shuttle to rapidly retreat backwards, instantly pulling back more than ten zhang.
The shadow missed its target and revealed its true form. It was a giant beast resembling both a snake and a lizard, over five zhang long and covered with a thick layer of black Scale Armor that looked indestructible.
A mass of thick black clouds floated beneath it, supporting the body of the beast.
"So it's an Ink Lizard Beast," Yuan Ming uttered lightly with surprise.
According to the classics, the Ink Lizard Beast was the offspring of the mating between an Ink Flood Dragon and a Swamp Giant Lizard, possessing the Ink Flood Dragon's sturdy Scale Armor and strength in Water attribute spells, as well as the tenacity and brute force of the Swamp Giant Lizard.
He appeared here in the swamp today partly to test the might of the newly learned Fire Cloud Secret Technique, and also to fulfill Hua Zhi's request to help repel this Ink Lizard Beast.
Yuan Ming formed another spell seal, and once more, seven or eight fireballs shot out from the fire cloud, targeting the Ink Lizard Beast.
In a frantic rage, the Ink Lizard Beast had just soared to mid-air when it sensed the force of the Bursting Fireballs. It quickly spewed out a black water pillar to intercept, then darted downwards.
The black water pillar, evidently not ordinary, made a "hissing" sound. Most fireballs were extinguished, yet two fireballs slipped through and hit the Ink Lizard Beast.
"Boom" "Boom" two loud noises later, the Ink Lizard Beast was blasted away but remained uninjured, righting itself midair in a roll.
Yuan Ming couldn't help but inwardly praise the toughness of the Ink Lizard Beast's scale armor and pointed with both hands.
One after another, fireballs plummeted from mid-air, consecutively striking the Ink Lizard Beast and exploding in a series, turning the air above the pool into a raging sea of fire, surging violently.
Although the Ink Lizard Beast's scale armor was tough, it couldn't withstand such continuous bombardment. Its defenses quickly broke, and it was submerged in the wild flames, emitting a piercing scream of agony.
Yuan Ming nodded slightly, quite satisfied with the power of the Fire Cloud Secret Technique.
Hua Zhi also let out an exuberant cry of cheer, spreading her arms wide as a dozen or so Demon Vines shot out, piercing like lightning into the rolling flames.
The large body of the Ink Lizard Beast fell from the sky, crashing into the mud near the pool.
Its body was covered in shattered scale armor and its flesh was a blur, heavily injured by the Fire Cloud Secret Technique. Hua Zhi's Demon Vines had also penetrated its body, rapidly absorbing its blood and demonic power.
The Ink Lizard Beast's body swiftly shrank, and within a few breaths, it turned into a dried-up corpse.
The aura emanating from Hua Zhi fluctuated slightly, as new dark purple vines grew inside her body, becoming more numerous and dense, quickly forming a large dark purple cocoon that enveloped her. The cocoon sprouted bunches of dark purple flowers, emitting a strange fragrance.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming's face lit up with joy.
Hua Zhi's strength originally pressed close to the Second-level Middle Stage. After killing and absorbing countless demon beasts in the Rain Ruins Swamp, she was finally about to make a breakthrough.

chapters.title: Chapter 280 - 257: New Partner
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming thought of this and dispersed the Fire Cloud in the sky, descending near Hua Zhi to act as her protector.
However, as soon as Yuan Ming landed, his legs suddenly went weak, his entire body experienced unbearable stinging pain, and it felt as if flames were burning inside his body. He almost wished he could tear open his flesh with his fingers to dissipate some of the scorching force.
"Poisoned? Could it be that there are enemies lurking around?" He was both shocked and furious, enduring the severe pain as he concentrated mana, sweeping his Divine Sense around him.
However, the surroundings were tranquil, with no enemies appearing.
Yuan Ming paused slightly, then suddenly thought of something. He turned abruptly to look at the Spiritual Flower on the purple-black cocoon, the faint fragrance hovering in his nostrils, finally understanding where the deadly poison had come from.
He tried hard to mobilize the remaining strength in his body to move outward.
After an unknown length of time, Yuan Ming finally could no longer smell the fragrance of the purple-black Spiritual Flower. He started operating the Nine Elements Technique, and his weakening body gradually recovered, the internal burning pain also gradually subsided.
After a long while, Yuan Ming finally returned to normal.
"The Spiritual Flower produced by Hua Zhi turned out to be poisonous, and so potent that even I almost fell victim," he silently remarked, feeling fortunate.
Yuan Ming looked at those purple-black Spiritual Flowers, his eyes sparkling, pondering something.
Quickly, three days passed.
The purple-black cocoon suddenly began to shake, and the purple-black Demon Vines also appeared to awaken from deep slumber, slowly swaying.
A few breaths later, all the Demon Vines fully awakened, and the purple-black cocoon slowly unfolded, revealing Hua Zhi's body, which seemed to have grown significantly and whose features were more delicate, with an aura that had fully reached the Second-level Middle Stage.
Recalling the incident in the underground palace of the Snake King Valley when Hua Zhi, having improved in strength, had once tried to attack him, Yuan Ming subconsciously became wary.
However, contrary to his expectations, Hua Zhi immediately sprinted over, rubbing against his body in a fawning, ingratiating manner. "Master, that Fire Cloud Secret Technique of yours is really incredible. It can even shatter the Scale Armor of the Ink Lizard Beast, enabling me to break through to the Second-level Middle Stage!"
Yuan Ming sensed the Beast Taming Runes within Hua Zhi's body and knew this demon's flattery was genuine, so he relaxed.
"You have been collecting quite a few small demon beasts recently; do you, perchance, mean to play the tyrant here in the Rain Ruins Swamp?" he said lightly, then looked into the distance.
The small demon beasts, watching from afar, did not approach.
"Life in the Rain Ruins Swamp is just too joyous; I can only find such diversions! Besides, I do this for your sake, Master," Hua Zhi replied.
"Explain how capturing these small demons is for my benefit?" Yuan Ming questioned, turning his gaze to Hua Zhi.
"Of course. I expand my territory here, gathering subordinates for you, Master. If you encounter formidable enemies in the future, you could lead them here, and at my command, these demon beasts would attack en masse. Together with our combined strength, even a Core Formation Stage cultivator might not stand a chance," Hua Zhi boasted, arms entwined boastfully.
"If your small demons can actually deal with Core Formation Stage cultivators, then those cultivators are far too easy to handle," Yuan Ming thought to himself, though he kept his doubts unspoken.
After shifting his thoughts, he spoke, "Have your subordinates gather various spiritual materials from the swamp, especially floral spiritual objects, and give them to me later."
"Okay, no problem. Leave this small task to me," Hua Zhi responded confidently, slapping her chest and promptly agreeing.
"Does that purple-black Spiritual Flower on you contain potent poison?" Yuan Ming then asked.
"I absorbed the Life Essence of the Black Toad, which allows me to devour various kinds of potent poisons. Coupled with my innate traits, I can produce Spiritual Flowers that contain potent poisons," Hua Zhi answered.
"This flower's toxicity is not mild. I plan to use it to refine Poisonous Incense," Yuan Ming stated.
"No problem. These seeds are easy to obtain. Master, just plant these seeds in the soil, water them daily with clean water, and soon they will take root and sprout, blossoming into these poisonous flowers," Hua Zhi extended an arm, a burst of green light flashing over it, quickly producing many purple seeds.
Yuan Ming hadn't expected the poisonous Spiritual Flower to be so readily available, and he was delighted. He collected these seeds, planning to plant them in the garden of his courtyard once he returned.
However, since the flower was poisonous, he would need to buy a set of prohibitions later to isolate the poisonous fragrance.
...
In the following days, Yuan Ming, inside a house in Little Lake City, devoted himself to cultivation, lighting Black Incense every seven days and possessing other Foundation Establishment Cultivators he had seen during the passing of powers ceremony to try and secretly learn various sects' secret techniques.
Of course, for various reasons, the learning process was not very smooth, but given Yuan Ming's prior experience of possessing the old emperor, he was prepared mentally and did not force the issue.
Soon, another three months passed.
He gradually learned several spells from other sects in Da Jin, including some not low-ranked spells with considerable power.
During this time, the reputation of the Xuanhua Spirit Incense Shop gradually spread, and as customers increased, Mu Yang found it somewhat challenging to cope, prompting Yuan Ming to pause his cultivation to personally receive them.
That day, a person stepped into the Xuanhua Spirit Incense Shop, and it was none other than Hu Tu, his face a deep black.
"Excuse me, which one of you is the owner here?" Hu Tu asked hesitantly.
Mu Yang stepped forward, ready to greet him.
"Mu Yang, this is an old acquaintance of mine, Hu Tu, come into the back room." Yuan Ming, who was in the back room, called out.
Upon hearing this, Hu Tu entered the back room.
"Hu Tu, it's been a long time," Yuan Ming said as he turned around and revealed his face.
Love this story? Show your support on *.
"Immortal Master, is it really you? This place is the Immortal City, right?" Hu Tu exclaimed in surprise.
