"From now on, just call me boss. No need to call me Immortal Master here, as everyone here is an Immortal Master," Yuan Ming stated.
"I see, the shop mentioned in the letter, is it this one?" Hu Tu suddenly realized as he nodded and looked around.
"That's right. If you are willing, you could stay here and help me look after the shop. If you have any questions, ask Shopkeeper Mu Yang," Yuan Ming said with a wink.
As soon as he had decided to open this Spirit Incense Shop, he had not planned on looking after it himself, as that would be too much of a waste of time. Employing Mu Yang alone was merely a temporary solution; he needed someone he knew to help manage and keep an eye on things. Sending someone from his family was inappropriate, so after thinking it over, Yuan Ming thought of Hu Tu, hence the shop was rented in his name.
He then used the Black Incense Possession to find out his whereabouts before hiring a member of the Small Scattered Alliance from the workshop to travel to the southern part of Da Jin in the Zhuo Continent and bring Hu Tu to Little Lake City.
"Of course, I can. I was just living a mundane life in Zhuo Continent, hoping to have a better life in Da Jin, but although the Jin people don't say it, their eyes are filled with discrimination. Here in Little Lake City, nobody looks at me with discrimination, so naturally, I am willing. As for the compensation, there's no need for it, I only have one request that I hope you will grant," Hu Tu spoke.
"You may speak freely, Hu Tu." Yuan Ming roughly guessed what was on Hu Tu's mind and said with a smile.
"These days, having seen the methods of the Immortals, I am extremely envious and wish to cultivate the Immortal Path. Please accept me as your disciple, Hu Tu will definitely be utterly devoted and repay your great kindness!" Hu Tu took a deep breath, bowed deeply, and made a grand gesture according to the customs of the Southern Border.
"Please rise, admiring the Immortal Path is a common desire, but cultivation requires certain qualifications, and not everyone can do it," Yuan Ming said as he helped Hu Tu to his feet, speaking slowly.
"I have some understanding of this matter; please inspect me, sir. If I lack the qualifications, I will accept my fate and will also take on the task of watching over the shop," Hu Tu said.
Yuan Ming nodded and grabbed Hu Tu's wrist, sending a thread of Mana into his body.
After advancing to the Foundation Establishment Stage, it was possible to test someone's Spirit Root with just Mana without the need for a Magic Artifact.
At this moment, Hu Tu appeared somewhat nervous, holding his breath and hardly daring to breathe, as if he was afraid that any carelessness might cause him to lose his Spirit Root.
"Huh, you actually do have a Spirit Root, quite lucky, it's the Four Spirit Roots of water, fire, wood, and earth," Yuan Ming said after a moment, his expression slightly surprised.
"Really?" Hu Tu was overwhelmed with joy and had already knelt on the ground, covering his face as he wept.
"Indeed, since you possess a Spirit Root, you can practice immortal techniques. I have a cultivation technique here; take it and ponder over it. If there's anything unclear, come ask me again." Yuan Ming took out a piece of white paper, swiftly wrote down the mnemonic for the Biluo Skill, and handed it over.
"Thank you, master, for bestowing upon me this immortal technique!" Hu Tu took the white paper with trembling hands and bowed deeply.
"Stop! I have no intention of taking disciples, you should still address me as boss, and I will call you Hu Tu," Yuan Ming said sternly as he held onto Hu Tu.
Seeing Yuan Ming's serious expression, Hu Tu did not dare to contradict and agreed meekly, feeling even more grateful to Yuan Ming in his heart.
"Hu Tu, you must take good care of this shop in the future. If you do well, I still have some Qi Refinement Realm elixirs and Magic Artifacts here that I can reward you with," Yuan Ming encouraged.
Having followed Fu Qing and others to Da Jin before, and then coming to Little Lake City with the Scatter Alliance, Hu Tu had gained some understanding of the Cultivation World and knew the significance of elixirs and Magic Artifacts. He happily agreed.
"Do not worry, boss. I have done business in both the Southern Border and Zhuo Continent, and I will surely live up to this important task and manage this shop well," he assured, patting his chest.
Yuan Ming understood Hu Tu's character well. Being somewhat cunning by nature, Hu Tu was indeed suited for doing business, or else Yuan Ming would not have invited him over.
Yuan Ming then took Hu Tu for a tour around the shop, introduced him to Mu Yang, and told them to consult with each other if there were any issues. He also informed him of some common knowledge in the Cultivation World and key points about selling Spirit Incense, before taking on the role of a hands-off shopkeeper.
He did not return to his neighboring residence, but chose to sit and cultivate in the back courtyard while keeping an eye on how Hu Tu managed the shop.
Hu Tu was quite shrewd in doing business. In just half a day, he had completely understood how to sell Spirit Incense and was quite adept at attracting customers. No matter how many questions the customers had, he patiently explained to them, keeping the shop orderly and without chaos. Whenever he faced questions he couldn't answer, he would ask Mu Yang. The two coordinated well, so Yuan Ming simply let Mu Yang stay in the shop as well.
After three days, feeling satisfied with no issues, Yuan Ming explained the Biluo Skill to Hu Tu twice and gave a few tips before returning to his residence at No. 86 to focus on his cultivation.
Of course, he would occasionally summon a soul crow to perch on a nearby tree to watch over the situation in the shop.

chapters.title: Chapter 281 - 258: The Way of Business
chapters.content:
After Hu Tu arrived at Xuanhua Spirit Incense Shop, despite his efforts, the shop was located in a remote area and there weren't many people on this street, leading to subpar sales.
Yuan Ming could only adjust his sales tactics.
First, he drew a portrait depicting Immortal Xuanhua with an ethereal and wise appearance and hung it in the center of the main hall. In front of the portrait, he placed an ordinary incense burner and lit a stick of Qingxuan Incense.
Then he instructed them as follows: if they encountered cultivators representing a sect for purchases, they could offer a rebate. If a customer referred another customer, they would give a rebate to the old customer. Both Mu Yang and Hu Tu were clever and grasped the concept immediately.
After giving these instructions, Yuan Ming went to the back room, took out the Stealing Heaven Tripod, inserted the Qingxuan Incense into it, and lit up the spirit smoke. Under his urging, the fragrance spread out into the street.
Two cultivators walking along the street smelled the incense and felt an immediate boost in spirit. They talked for a while and sought out the source.
At a tavern, several cultivators were drinking but then set down their cups and hurried down the stairs.
...
Soon, the store gathered dozens of cultivators inquiring about Qingxuan Incense, keeping Mu Yang and Hu Tu suddenly very busy.
Hu Tu even pulled a cultivator aside and whispered in secrecy.
That day, they sold all of their stock.
Subsequently, the first month's profit reached over a thousand Spirit Stones, the second month even reached one thousand two hundred, and then it stabilized at around 1,500 Spirit Stones each month.
Seeing the business flourish, Yuan Ming felt much relieved; he rewarded both Hu Tu and Mu Yang with a bottle of elixirs for Qi Refinement, and even set aside an evening to clarify their doubts and answer their questions.
He then purchased some Dan Recipes, improved a few new types of Spirit Incense, and based on one of the Beauty Pill recipes, created a Beauty Incense that helps enhance facial beauty and whiten skin. Once displayed on the shelves, under Hu Tu's slick salesmanship, it also became popular among female cultivators, further increasing the profits.
Things were also going smoothly for Hua Zhi; the territory expanded significantly, and the supply of spiritual materials increased every month.
Every month, spending on purchasing spiritual materials, making incense, and buying elixirs was huge, but the Spirit Stones in the Storage Ring also increased.
The situation was very favorable at the moment, yet the only thing that troubled Yuan Ming was that the incense ashes, which had the best possession effect from inside Xuanhua Temple, were almost used up, and only those from Jiuli Temple were left in his hands.
Having been accustomed to high-quality incense ashes from inside the sect, he had started to disdain mundane substances.
...
Two months later.
Inside Xuanhua Incense Shop, Yuan Ming sat in a chair, flipping through the store's ledger, grinning from ear to ear as he read.
"Hu Tu, Mu Yang, this month has been good," Yuan Ming said, setting down the ledger while smiling.
"Mainly it's because the boss has good methods; Spirit Incense has selling points, and here in Little Lake City's Square Market, it stands alone; purchases by sects make up the bulk," Hu Tu, who had genuinely admired Yuan Ming for some time, continuously flattered.
Yuan Ming pointed to the newly written signs outside and said, "Hang up these two signs."
The two eye-catching wooden signs hanging outside the shop read:
"Qingxuan Incense available in limited daily quantities of one hundred sticks, buy quickly."
"Beauty Incense rare, available by appointment only."
"The boss's tactics are really clever; the scarcer it is, the more they are willing to buy. With this, the orders for next month should be no worry," Hu Tu chuckled, rubbing his hands and said.
Yuan Ming glanced at Hu Tu, feeling that this fellow, with a pig-like face, was indeed suited to be a shopkeeper.
Hu Tu, with his bushy brows, big eyes, and dark skin gave anyone the impression of a straightforward and honest person from Southern Border, yet he possessed a sharp business acumen deep inside.
"It's only Qingxuan Incense and Beauty Incense; one is used to aid in cultivation, and the other targets the psyche of female cultivators with high demand. We can only run promotions like this with these products. Other types, we haven't reached a point where everyone is scrambling to buy," Yuan Ming said, "so we're going to bundle sales from now on. For those familiar customers, we'll make a points booklet. Buying incense can earn points, and those with high points get the privilege to purchase Qingxuan Incense and Beauty Incense first."
"Boss, is this really okay?" said Mu Yang.
"Senior Brother Mu, why wouldn't it be? High point holders also get discounts. Doing business is just about giving a little here and taking a little there, everyone understands," Hu Tu said.
"Where did the boss learn these tricks?" Hu Tu asked.
"I figured them out myself; before, I owned a bookstore. When business was bad, I thought up these methods. Later, the bookstore got a partner and became famous, and gradually didn't need to use these tricks," Yuan Ming recalled and smiled, saying, "Doing business is all about tricks, but you just focus earnestly on your major cultivation path."
"Okay, boss, I'm actually quite content with how things are now," Hu Tu sincerely said.
"How is your Biluo Skill coming along?" Yuan Ming asked.
Hearing this, Hu Tu's face showed an embarrassed expression and said, "I can barely sense the existence of Mana, which should be equivalent to the Qi Refining First Level mentioned in the cultivation technique."
"For any cultivation problems in the future, you can also ask Mu Yang; I have taught him the Biluo Skill as well," Yuan Ming said.
"Boss, after I switched to practicing the Biluo Skill, I honestly feel it's better than the cultivation technique my master passed down to me," Mu Yang also said.
The origin of the Biluo Skill was unknown, but since Xi Cangqiong had made it the main technique of Biluo Cave, it was indeed much better than the techniques of ordinary Loose Cultivators, which is why Mu Yang had such a comment.
Upon hearing this, Hu Tu said, "I feel like I'm wasting these Qingxuan incenses now."
"Nearly half a year to reach the Qi Refining First Level is quite normal, slower than some who may take several years to develop any mana at all. Since you already have a Spirit Root, you naturally have a bit of a fairy fate. The lifespan of a small cultivator in the Qi Refinement Realm can't be much, but if you're lucky enough to reach Foundation Establishment, living more than two hundred years won't be a problem." Yuan Ming rolled his eyes as he spoke.The latest chapters are uploaded first on *.
"Two hundred years? I will cultivate diligently!" Upon hearing this, Hu Tu immediately changed his tone.
After chatting idly for a moment, Yuan Ming resolved some of their cultivation confusions and then left his own Spiritual Incense Store, heading straight for the shop of the Shengye Sect.
After reaching Foundation Establishment, his speed in practicing the Nine Elements Technique had greatly decreased. Over the past six months, the elixirs he had saved up were all used up, and his progress in cultivation was minimal, still far from mid-stage, necessitating another purchase.
He headed straight to Qingmu Building, bought ten bottles of the Four Spirits Pill, and then left.
On the way back, Yuan Ming took a detour, coming to the Treasure Spirit Pavilion once again.
After observing and visiting covertly over this period, Yuan Ming had grasped some understanding of the reputation of Treasure Spirit Pavilion, and considering its fair and upright actions, he decided to send his egg there for help with hatching.
As soon as Yuan Ming stepped into the Treasure Spirit Pavilion, the steward who had served him last time immediately came to greet him.
"Honored guest, I've been waiting for you, come, come, please follow me to the private room on the second floor," the steward urged Yuan Ming upstairs without further ado.
While Yuan Ming was still confused, he heard hurried footsteps approaching from outside.
"Fellow Daoist…"
Accompanied by a familiar voice, a dark-skinned old man with an arm missing and a face marked by the years, looking much like an old farmer from the fields, walked in from outside.
Upon seeing each other, both of them couldn't help but size each other up for a moment.
The one-armed old man then asked somewhat uncertainly, "Could it be Fellow Daoist Hagon?"
"Fellow Daoist Gu," Yuan Ming smiled and nodded.
When they had met in the Ghost Market back then, one had worn a cloak to conceal his aura, and the other a mask to hide his true face, neither knowing how the other really looked.
"It's been years, Fellow Daoist Hagon's aura and demeanor have completely changed, almost making him unrecognizable," Gu Qiuming exclaimed in surprise.
"Fellow Daoist Gu still retains his youthful grace," Yuan Ming replied with a smile.
"When I came back, the steward mentioned someone was looking for me, but no matter how much I guessed, I couldn't imagine it being you, so I asked him to watch for you coming again, and unexpectedly you really did show up. What brings you to the Thunder Continent?" Gu Qiuming and Yuan Ming sat down opposite each other and served tea for one another.
"It's all destiny," Yuan Ming smiled.
"Haha, Fellow Daoist Hagon is visiting, do you have some good items to sell, or do you wish to buy something?" Gu Qiuming didn't beat around the bush and directly asked.
"Now that you, Fellow Daoist Gu, are here, things will be easy. I came to the Treasure Spirit Pavilion because I have a spirit beast egg that I would like your help in checking," Yuan Ming said.
"Let's have a look, let's have a look," Gu Qiuming's eyes brightened as he hurriedly replied.
Yuan Ming waved his hand, and a bowl-sized blood-red avian egg appeared in his hand.
He handed the Blood Egg to Gu Qiuming, who did not take it but stretched out his single arm to tap on the tabletop, indicating that Yuan just needed to place it on the table.
After Yuan Ming did as told, Gu Qiuming moved his chair closer and began to examine it carefully.
After a while, he didn't say a word, but his brow furrowed more and more.
"Fellow Daoist Gu, what's the matter, is there something wrong with this egg?" Yuan Ming asked with a frown.
Gu Qiuming didn't respond but took out an oval transparent crystal stone from his sleeve, placed it before his eyes to look through, and closely reexamined the Blood Egg once again.
"Such a peculiar thing…" Gu Qiuming shook his head and said.
"Fellow Daoist Gu, don't keep me in suspense, what's the matter?" Yuan Ming asked, his curiosity growing.
"This Blood Egg, judging by its size, shape, surface patterns, and the texture when touched, should be an egg of the Winged Bird spirit beast. However, the problem is that Winged Bird eggs are usually sky blue or dark blue; I have never heard of any being blood red," Gu Qiuming said.
"It was like this when I acquired it, could this red possibly be a dye?" Yuan Ming, knowing the origin of the Blood Egg, instinctively thought that the color might have been stained by long-standing immersion in blood.
"What a joke, the shells of Winged Birds have faintly winding patterns and a gentle luster; coloring is impossible. Besides, I observe that this red color clearly penetrates deep into the shell, identical to the inside creature," Gu Qiuming said.
"Fellow Daoist Gu, then what could be the reason for this?" Yuan Ming asked.
"Hard to say, it could be a mutation or perhaps other reasons," Gu Qiuming nodded.

chapters.title: Chapter 282 - 259: Winged Bird Egg
chapters.content:
"So, is this ultimately a good thing or a bad thing?" Yuan Ming asked, somewhat unsure.
"It's half good, half bad, I suppose. The outcome won't be known until after it hatches. It's also possible that it might not hatch at all. If Sixth Uncle from my sect were here, I could let him appraise it," Gu Qiuming said pensively.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming still felt there was a greater possibility that it had become stronger. Xi Cangqiong had hidden this egg in Biluo Cave, and for many years, it had been soaked in the Essence Blood of countless demon beasts collected by Beast Slaves! It couldn't be just an ordinary Winged Bird!
"Fellow Daoist Hagon, name your price," Gu Qiuming spoke, then added with emphasis, "Anything you ask!"
"I'm not selling this item. I only wish to entrust it to your Treasure Spirit Pavilion to help it hatch," Yuan Ming said.
Though he had been prepared for such an answer, a look of evident disappointment still flashed in Gu Qiuming's eyes when he heard Yuan Ming say he wouldn't sell.
"Believe me, the chances of a mutation yielding a useless creature are definitely greater than producing a stronger spirit beast. Instead of taking this gamble yourself, it would be better to name a good price and sell it, yielding greater profits," Gu Qiuming advised.
"This egg was gifted to me by a friend; it holds a different meaning for me. Even if a weakling hatches, I would still accept it," Yuan Ming replied with a smile.
How could he possibly sell the Blood Egg that Xi Ying had given him?
"Alright then, since that's the case, I won't try to persuade you further. However, I must make it clear beforehand: this Winged Bird Egg is no ordinary egg. The Treasure Spirit Pavilion can't hatch it; I will have to take it back to our Zhenling Sect and use an Array to hatch it," Gu Qiuming said.
"Fine, that's not a problem, but I want to go with you," Yuan Ming said after a moment's thought.
"Of course. After the spirit beast hatches, you'll need to tame it quickly while it's still young. If you wait until it grows up and develops its wild nature, taming it will be much harder," Gu Qiuming explained.
"How much will it cost for the incubation?" Yuan Ming inquired.
"According to the rules of our sect, hatching a spirit beast egg using an Array requires at least a hundred Spirit Stones. Since we're friends, I can hatch it for you personally and take ten Spirit Stones less. Ninety Spirit Stones, and any additional Array energy consumption will be calculated separately. The price remains the same even if the hatching fails," Gu Qiuming stated.
"That price is acceptable," Yuan Ming responded, nodding his head.
"Prompt decision! I still have some matters to deal with here; let's depart early tomorrow morning," Gu Qiuming said with a smile.
"If I may ask, where exactly is the Zhenling Sect located?" Yuan Ming asked.
"On the other side of the Rain Ruins Swamp, not too far from here," Gu Qiuming replied.
"Good, then let's set off early tomorrow morning."
After making their arrangements, Yuan Ming left the Treasure Spirit Pavilion.
...
The next day, early in the morning.
Yuan Ming and Gu Qiuming set off for the Zhenling Sect, riding cranes.
Meanwhile, inside the Rain Ruins Swamp, Hua Zhi was using vines to weave a plow-like object. She sat on it, with two three-foot-long black fish bound by vines at the front, pulling her swiftly along.
On the way to Zhenling Sect, Gu Qiuming informed Yuan Ming about some basic information regarding the sect.
He learned that Zhenling Sect was situated on the eastern side of the Rain Ruins Swamp, a small cultivation sect built along the lakeshore of the swamp, mainly specializing in the incubation and taming of spirit beasts, with a heritage that spanned several hundred years.
In fact, the Zhenling Sect was somewhat similar to Biluo Cave, except it lacked most of the spirit beast capturing business.
What set it apart was that, though the Zhenling Sect was also a cultivation sect, its main body was composed of the "Gu" family, which also absorbed many cultivators with different surnames.
The individuals with real power within the sect were almost all from the "Gu" family, while Gu Qiuming was just a collateral member of the family.
Upon reaching the territory of the Zhenling Sect, Yuan Ming was the first to see a series of beautifully carved stone archways lined up neatly, stretching over hundreds of yards.
Most of these archways were engraved with phrases like "A Thousand Years of Prosperity," "Scenic Moonlit Views," and "Marvelous Cave Heavens." Only on the last and largest archway were engraved the three characters "Zhenling Sect," written in a bold and impressive style.
Clearly, this sect had once been very prominent, giving Yuan Ming even more confidence.
Standing under the archway and looking back, Yuan Ming saw a series of buildings with white walls and black tiles, nestled among lush forests by the lakeshore of the swamp. Shrouded in mist, they exuded a hazy sense of beauty.
From afar, he could hear a chorus of exotic birds and animal calls emanating from that cluster of buildings.
After entering the Zhenling Sect, Yuan Ming discovered the sect, which resembled a town, was divided into many areas, each breeding different types of spirit beasts. The numbers seemed modest, but the varieties were diverse, including birds and beasts of all kinds, each area protected by an Array's light shield.
On the shore of the swamp lake, there were also fenced-off ponds, which astonishingly contained aquatic breeds of spirit beasts.
As Gu Qiuming led Yuan Ming through the sect, they encountered many people who would greet Gu Qiuming proactively. However, the terms they used were familial titles like uncle, brother, and cousin rather than martial brother or martial sister.
"Your Winged Bird Egg is a bit special. I should have my uncle take another look at it to avoid any mistakes," Gu Qiuming said, leading the way into the sect's interior.
"Sure," Yuan Ming readily agreed.
The two of them passed through a series of arches and corridors to arrive at a secluded courtyard.
"Sixth Uncle is the Law Enforcement Elder of the Zhenling Sect; he has always been strict. When we meet him later, I'll do the talking; you just listen. If you have any questions, you can ask me after we leave," Gu Qiuming seemed to hold a certain fear for his uncle.This соntеnt wаs first rеlеаsеd оn МV_LЕМРYR.
Yuan Ming nodded.
"Junior Gu Qiuming seeks an audience with Sixth Uncle," Gu Qiuming called out as they arrived at the entrance to the courtyard.
"Come in and talk." After a moment's wait, a steady, somewhat hoarse voice came from within the courtyard.
Gu Qiuming immediately gestured for Yuan Ming to follow and led him into the courtyard.
In the yard, under an old pine tree with a vigorous appearance, a dignified elderly man with gray hair and a short gray beard sat on a stone bench, reading a scroll with eyes that radiated an inner light.
Upon seeing the two enter, the elder's brows involuntarily furrowed.
Gu Qiuming, aware that he was displeased with him for bringing an outsider, rushed to speak:
"Sixth Uncle, my friend here has acquired a peculiar Spirit Beast Egg. My vision is limited, and I could not determine what it is. I vaguely guessed it might be a Winged Bird, but the egg is red. I wish for you to take a look."
Upon hearing this, the authoritative elder put down the scroll in his hands, clearly interested.
"Among the younger generation, you have been roaming around for years and have a good eye. If you say it's a Winged Bird Egg, you are probably not wrong. Bring it out for me to see," the elder asked.
Gu Qiuming hurriedly made a signal to Yuan Ming, who understood and immediately took out the Blood Egg and placed it on the table.
The authoritative elder's gaze landed on the egg and after a mere glance, he asked:
"You got this egg from the Southern Border, didn't you?"
"How did you know?" Yuan Ming asked in surprise.
"This is just an ordinary Winged Bird Egg, but it has been nurtured with the Blood Nourishment Method, which is commonly used by the Beast Tamers in the Southern Border," the elder explained.
"What is the Blood Nourishment Method?" Yuan Ming inquired.
"Beast Masters of the Southern Border soak bird eggs in the blood of several demon beasts after acquiring them to imbue them with vitality upon hatching. The red color of the eggshell is simply due to the absorption of blood essence. You need to incubate it soon; otherwise, without blood nourishment for too long, the creature inside will starve," the elder said with a glance at him.
"Sixth Uncle, I want to use a Formation to incubate this egg. What do you think?" Gu Qiuming tentatively asked.
"That's acceptable," the authoritative elder said indifferently, then became silent.
Gu Qiuming, along with Yuan Ming, gave their thanks and took their leave.
"Putting a talent to a small use," the elder murmured quietly.
As the two left the courtyard entrance, a young man dressed in a Cloud Brocade Robe, with handsome features and fair skin, and a lock of hair hanging over his forehead, looking somewhat unrestrained, walked past.
"Oh, isn't that Brother Qiuming the Lone Arm? You're always out making a fortune; why have you come back today?" the young man said upon seeing Gu Qiuming.
Gu Qiuming only gave him a cold glance and didn't bother to respond, leading Yuan Ming away.
The young man didn't seem to care; he chuckled and walked into the yard, respectfully greeting the elder: "Sixth Uncle."
"Qiulong! Why are you disrespectful to your cousin?" the authoritative elder looked at him disapprovingly.
"He's nothing but an incapacitated, one-armed good-for-nothing," Gu Qiulong said nonchalantly as he took a seat opposite the elder.
"Shut your mouth! He lost his arm fighting for our clan," the elder suddenly snapped.
Apparently, Gu Qiuming didn't take the recent events to heart; he continued to chat and joke as he led Yuan Ming to a relatively distant courtyard. The yard was deserted, with antiquated decorations, and the paint on the doorposts was peeling, suggesting that Gu Qiuming had not stayed here for a long time.
"Fellow Daoist, this is where I reside; you may stay here for a few days. I need to go to the clan's Incubation Room to help incubate this bird egg," Gu Qiuming found a room for Yuan Ming and settled him in.
"How long will it take?" Yuan Ming asked.
"About ten days or so. Don't worry, when the Winged Bird is about to hatch, I'll bring you there in advance. However, for the next few days, we probably won't see each other," Gu Qiuming said.
"No worries, I will stay and await the good news," Yuan Ming said with a smile.
Gu Qiuming looked at him with an odd expression, seemingly having something to say but hesitating.
"What's the matter, is there anything amiss?" Yuan Ming asked.
"It's nothing much, just that during my absence, you'd better stay in the yard and please don't wander around elsewhere," Gu Qiuming said with evident difficulty.
"I thought it was something serious, don't worry." Yuan Ming laughed.
Afterward, Gu Qiuming left with the Blood Egg, and Yuan Ming wandered around the yard for a while before bringing his fingers together and pressing them to his forehead.
Suddenly, four soul crows flew out from his forehead, soared into the sky, and headed outside the yard.

chapters.title: Chapter 283 - 260 Stealing Ashes
chapters.content:
After releasing the soul crows, Yuan Ming walked back to his room, closed the door, and began to meditate with his eyes closed.
Through the perspective of the four soul crows, he felt as if he was soaring high in the sky, looking down at the entirety of Zhenling Sect.
Yuan Ming's actions weren't spontaneous but had been premeditated.
When Gu Qiuming invited him to his Sect, Yuan Ming had already set his sights on the incense of their Ancestor Hall, which he urgently needed now.
Zhenling Sect, unlike the talent-scarce Xuanhua Temple, wasn't a powerful large-scale sect, but had an orderly heritage and was clan-based, which he guessed meant their tributory incense's desire power might be purer.
The only trouble was the highest cultivation level within Zhenling Sect was around late-stage Core Formation, which Yuan Ming had already investigated. Making a move here, with the cloak given by Xi Ying to cover him, as long as he was careful, the risk was still within a controllable range.
After all, to ordinary cultivators, incense ashes were nothing more than trash. Likely, it even took some manpower to clean it up every so often.
On the way here with Gu Qiuming, although they didn't talk much, Yuan Ming had managed to indirectly inquire and roughly determine the Ancestor Hall's location within the Zhenling Sect.
Thus, it didn't take him much effort to locate the Ancestor Hall.
Zhenling Sect, like most sects, placed their Ancestor Hall on the highest terrain within their sect's grounds though their terrain wasn't very high overall, so it was merely on a small hill to the southeast of their grounds.
Their Ancestor Hall's structure was also similar to many southern Da Jin clan temples, with white walls, black tiles, and high firewalls adorned with various beautifully carved statues symbolizing auspiciousness.
Yuan Ming controlled the soul crows to get closer to observe the Ancestor Hall, but before they could get close, a white light shot towards them like a flying blade, nearly cutting the soul crows in half.
Startled, Yuan Ming hastily controlled the soul crows to flap their wings awkwardly, flying upwards in disarray.
It was then that he saw a middle-aged man in a blue robe, sweeping the ground with a broom, cursing in the direction of the soul crows as "ominous."
"To think there's a Late-stage Foundation Establishment Cultivator on guard, this is troublesome," Yuan Ming concluded from the attack, realizing the middle-aged man's cultivation level and felt it might be somewhat difficult now.
With his current level of cultivation, it was quite difficult for the soul crows to steal incense ashes right under the nose of a Late-stage Foundation Establishment Cultivator.
"Since I still need to stay here for a while, it's best not to startle the snake but to plan thoroughly," Yuan Ming thought to himself.
Deciding, he stopped letting the soul crows get recklessly close and recalled them all, then took out an elixir and swallowed it, before closing his eyes to cultivate the "Nine Elements Technique."
...
The night deepened, and the sound of insects began to rise.
Outside, the crescent moon had clearly tilted to the west; it was the latter part of the night.
Yuan Ming sat by the window cultivating the "Moonlight Technique", when suddenly, some rustling noises came from outside his window.
He frowned slightly and opened his eyes, looking toward the source of the sound.
Suddenly, by the window had grown a small tree, and a fresh twig stretched in through the window, topped with a dark-purple, enchantingly beautiful vine flower.
"Hua Zhi..."
Yuan Ming whispered to the dark-purple vine flower, his hand covering his mouth, while the branch with the flower nodded as if in agreement, quivering up and down.
After a moment, the small branch slowly withdrew from the window and, along with the whole sapling, receded into the ground.
Yuan Ming waited a while, estimating that the time was about right, then donned the grey cloak given by Xi Ying and climbed out the window.
He released four soul crows to patrol the high airspace, scouting for any guards on patrol, easily avoiding anyone along the way and smoothly made his way close to the hill where the Zhenling Sect's Ancestor Hall was located.
Once there, he didn't let the soul crows get close to the Ancestor Hall but instead carefully concealed his energy and found a hidden spot nearby to hide.
Then, Yuan Ming took out the Stealing Heaven Tripod, inserted a seductive scent stick, and lit it by pinching the incense head between two fingers.
Next, Yuan Ming immediately used the Exorcism Technique to control the incense burner, causing it to float slowly towards the Ancestor Hall.
The Stealing Heaven Tripod spun and flew out, resembling a flicker of firelight suspended half a foot off the ground, quickly arriving near the Ancestor Hall's front door.
At that moment, through the vision of one soul crow high above, Yuan Ming was surprised to find that compared to during the day, there was now a beast resembling a hunting dog with unusually large ears sitting outside the Zhenling Sect's Ancestor Hall.
This creature sat between the two stone lions at the door, its ears twitched, and immediately detected the stealthily floating incense burner.
The large-eared beast's eyes flashed red, and it was about to bark a warning.
However, at this instant, Yuan Ming had already used his Divine Thought to control the incense smoke, which rapidly entered its nostrils.
The large-eared beast's cry halted abruptly, its eyes rolled back, and it passed out on the spot.
Inside the Ancestor Hall, the blue-robed middle-aged man meditating with crossed legs suddenly opened his eyes, sensing something unusual and planned to get up to check.
However, just as he stood, he was hit by a wave of intense drowsiness and, like the large-eared hunting dog, fell into a deep sleep.
A moment later, beneath an old pine tree in the Ancestor Hall's courtyard, the soil bulged outward, and a branch slowly emerged, then it spread and branched out into more and more twigs.
These twigs gradually gathered together outside and eventually formed a densely branched Tree Man.
It was naturally Hua Zhi, looking as if that tree had originally been there.
Clutching a clay jar in her arms, Hua Zhi glanced over at the main hall of the Ancestor Hall. Seeing that the cultivator had already fallen asleep, she shook off the soil clinging to her feet and tiptoed slowly towards the inside.
Upon entering the Ancestor Hall, she noticed the floor tiles and walls were made of the same materials as Yuan Ming's rented house. Bypassing the middle-aged man, her eyes immediately caught sight of an extraordinarily large incense table and the mountain-like stacked ancestral tablets behind it.
On both sides of the main hall, long-burning lamps in staggered rows still burned. The unknown oils within them produced exceptionally stable flames, emitting a faint fragrance.
Hua Zhi swept her gaze over them and quickly averted her eyes, squinting slightly, she focused her attention on the table.
There, three exquisitely inlaid gold-carved, three-legged incense burners were placed, filled to the brim with incense ashes accumulated over many years.
The canonical source for this content: *.
Remembering her mission, Hua Zhi immediately stepped forward, placing the clay jar on the table.
Then, she extended her tree branch hands, shaping them into a shovel-like form, scooping from the burners one by one, and collecting all the incense ashes into a storage bag hanging at her waist.
Afterwards, she opened the clay jar and poured ordinary incense ashes she had scavenged from elsewhere into the three incense burners on the table.
Having completed all this, Hua Zhi then retreated towards the outside of the Ancestor Hall.
When reaching the courtyard, she stretched out a hand to create a broom made of fine twigs, sweeping the soil she had brought into the area back under the old pine tree.
Afterward, she retracted back into the ground and disappeared from sight.
Much later, the middle-aged man in a blue shirt gradually awoke, startling when he realized he had somehow fallen asleep, immediately dispelling all traces of drowsiness.
He immediately stood up, extended his Divine Sense, quickly scanning the surroundings while also looking around, and spoted nothing out of the ordinary.
He then methodically searched inside and outside the hall, yet still discovered nothing.
He knew the arrangement of the Ancestor Hall so well he could navigate it blindfolded. Not to mention if something was missing or added, even a slight movement of any object would have been instantly noticeable to him.
But incense ashes, something he deemed utterly useless, weren't worth his concern.
Finding nothing amiss, the middle-aged man went outside the Ancestor Hall.
As he pushed open the door, he realized that the Police Ear Beast was also lying on the ground, deeply asleep.
His eyebrows instantly furrowed, and he stooped down to give it a hefty slap.
The Police Ear Beast jolted awake from the slap, but its eyes still shimmered with a confused look.
Seeing it like this, the middle-aged man could only sigh, carefully inspecting once more, but naturally to no avail, and thus he let the matter go.
...
Elsewhere, back inside his house, Yuan Ming gazed at the newly acquired incense ashes on the table, in high spirits.
"Well, that ought to do it, should last me a while," he said.
The incense ashes obtained from Xuanhua Temple had already been used up, even the Black Incense made from it had been exhausted, leaving him just a few sticks made from Jiuli Temple's incense ashes.
These few incense sticks not only had a shorter possession time but also lacked the psychological inducing effects, belonging to those that could only be looked at and not used for anything else. Hence, the newly acquired incense ashes were a timely relief for Yuan Ming's urgent needs.
Now, all he had to do was get back to Little Lake City's Square Market and purchase some spirit wood materials to produce another batch of Black Incense. Given Zhenling Sect's resources, he speculated that the effects would definitely be stronger than those of Xuanhua Temple, and could even surpass those of Liu Xin Sect.
Yuan Ming looked forward to this with great anticipation.
...
Two days later, Yuan Ming, planning to continue practicing the Nine Elements Technique at noon, spontaneously lit a stick of Black Incense and attached his Divine Thought to Guoguo's body, once again encountering Xi Ying.
At that moment, Xi Ying was sitting beside an elegantly decorated boudoir desk, her hand propping her chin, the other holding a writing brush, deep in thought, occasionally scrunching her nose, looking exceedingly charming and attractive.
Guoguo sat obediently beside her on a stool, squinting as she napped, only occasionally glancing up at her.
After performing the Divine Soul Possession, Yuan Ming wanted to prompt Guoguo to open her eyes and interact with Xi Ying; however, due to the limited effect of the Jiuli Temple incense, Guoguo could not sense his subtle hints and remained in a half-drowsy state.
Yuan Ming was both anxious and annoyed, but there was nothing he could do.
"Knock, knock, knock,"
At that moment, a knocking sound came from outside the door, and Xi Ying turned her head to look.
"Didn't I say not to disturb me unless it's important?" Xi Ying frowned and asked, clearly annoyed that her thoughts had been interrupted.

chapters.title: Chapter 284 - 261: The Disappearance of Gu Qiuming
chapters.content:
"Miss, Young Master Da's friend, Young Master Luo Tang, has come again," a maid's voice came from outside the room.
"Tell him to piss off," Xi Ying's voice rose in disgust, without a hint of politeness.
"Miss, that's Young Master Da's friend. It's not good to speak like that. Young Master Da would like to invite you to meet him when you have time," the maid hesitated for a moment before speaking softly.
Xi Ying thought for a while and said, "Then you can meet him on my behalf. Isn't that how they do it in the plays? In the end, the pretty maid marries successfully, and the lady disguises herself as a man and becomes the top scholar."
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming couldn't help but chuckle silently within Guoguo's body, causing the furry little body to tremble slightly as well.
"But I'm so ugly, I don't look like you at all," the maid muttered.
"Then can't you wear a mask? Just go, don't bother me. If you succeed, I'll reward you with a magic artifact," said Xi Ying.
"Really, Miss? Then I'll go," the maid smiled and had no choice but to turn and leave.
After sending the maid away, Xi Ying put down her pen and lifted Guoguo under its armpits, holding it up.
It was the same familiar motion, the same familiar point of view.
Yuan Ming, feeling a bit embarrassed, turned his head away, only to see the table densely covered with drafts.
All those papers were filled with complex and intricate lines, resembling the design of some kind of array. Xi Ying then continued to concentrate on studying the formation.
As time slowly passed and Guoguo nearly fell asleep, suddenly two plump lips pressed against its head, followed by Xi Ying's voice saying, "The large transmission array is too complicated, let's take a break. Guoguo, do you think I should use a communication talisman?"
Before Yuan Ming had time to savor the feeling, his vision blurred, and the possession ended.
He woke up somewhat reluctantly in bed, thinking, "The large transmission array, is it an array that can teleport over long distances? Or can it transport multiple people at once?"
Since he didn't know much about transmission arrays, he didn't dwell on it any further. He took out an elixir, swallowed it, and resumed his cultivation.
Use a communication talisman? To contact whom? Me? Or Xi Ying's family?
...
Before long, another six days had passed.
Yuan Ming paced the courtyard, his brow slightly furrowed.
According to what Gu Qiuming had previously said, the Winged Bird Egg was nearly ready to hatch, but not only had Gu Qiuming never come by, he hadn't even sent a message. Something seemed amiss.
It was a pity that he still needed one more day for the next possession; otherwise, he would have just lit the incense and possessed someone to check the situation.
"Elder Hagon, here is your food for today," a fair-looking young man came from outside, holding a tray with a delicate pastry, a plate of Spirit Fruit, and a cup of Spiritual Tea.
Food requirements for a Foundation Establishment Cultivator were minimal, and this was enough to sustain them for a day.
Yuan Ming looked towards the newcomer. This fair young man was named Xu Chuan, a Qi Refining disciple with an external surname from the Zhenling Sect, and he had been responsible for delivering Yuan Ming's food in recent days.
"Fellow Daoist Xu, have you received any news from Fellow Daoist Gu these past two days?" Yuan Ming asked, secretly casting the Enchanting Illusion Technique.
"No," said Xu Chuan, shaking his head.
"Where is the incubation room?" Yuan Ming continued to ask.
"It's ten miles to the southwest, in Wangyou Valley..." Xu Chuan went on to say.
Yuan Ming asked for more details about the place, then he hesitated no longer. With a wave of his hand, Xu Chuan's eyes rolled back, his gaze grew hazy, and he fell asleep.
Yuan Ming quickly took off the other man's coat, exchanged it with his own, laid him on the bed in the bedroom to look as though he were sleeping, and then crafted a barrier with the Four Directions Sealing Spirit Talisman before stopping his actions.
Yuan Ming then took out a translucent white mask, put it on his face; it was the Thousand Mechanism Mask. In his mind, he recalled Xu Chuan's face.
The Thousand Mechanism Mask began to wriggle slowly, changing in a few breaths to an exact copy of Xu Chuan's appearance, without any flaws.
When Yuan Ming probed with his Divine Sense, he could detect nothing amiss and was quite satisfied.
"The Thousand Mechanism Mask truly is extraordinary. It's a pity it can only be used three times," he thought with a tinge of pain.
However, to avoid detection by Cultivators below Core Formation, he still needed to use this precious item. As for Cultivators above Core Formation, he didn't think they'd bother using their Divine Sense to scan a mere Qi Refining disciple.
After stepping outside, Yuan Ming paused after only a few steps.
In this period, besides cultivating the Nine Elements Technique, he had also put in great effort to practice the Moonlight Technique. His Divine Soul had thus grown stronger, and his perception had become even sharper. The moment he had left the door, it felt as though a gaze had swept over him and then quickly returned to monitoring that courtyard area.
"It seems someone is watching me?" A thought passed through Yuan Ming's mind, but his stride did not falter, and he continued to walk ahead.
A short while later, Yuan Ming, following the directions provided by Xu Chuan, arrived at a valley.
Here, Spiritual Energy was abundant, with lush trees and grass everywhere, birds chirping and flowers fragrant, seemingly a paradise on earth.
Yuan Ming paid no attention to the beautiful scenery and soon reached the deeper part of the valley, where a series of contiguous buildings appeared before him.
He pushed on, but his steps were extremely cautious. Many dangerous Forbidden spells surrounded the perimeter of the buildings, and tripping any one of them would lead to unpredictable consequences.
"Wangyou Valley is a forbidden area; idle people are not allowed to enter. Who goes there? State your name."
A voice came from behind the flowers ahead.
"I am Xu Chuan from the Foreign Affairs Pavilion. A few days ago, I carried out an important task for Elder Gu Qiuming, and today I have come back to respond. I heard he was in the Incubation Room, so I came looking for him. Please, brother, could you pass on the message for me?" Yuan Ming took out a spirit stone and sent it behind the flowers, speaking in Xu Chuan's voice.
The Thousand Mechanism Mask could change not only one's appearance but also had the ability to affect the muscles of the throat, altering the voice.
"Gu Qiuming? He seems to have left already, he's not in the valley now."
The man, having received a benefit, was considerably more amiable as he spoke.
"I heard that he's hatching a bird egg in the Incubation Room. Please, brother, would you go in and check for me?" Yuan Ming was secretly startled and then handed over another spirit stone.
"Alright, wait here," the man said after hesitating.
A grey figure swept out from behind the flowers and disappeared into the nearby buildings.
After a moment, the grey shadow flew back.
"Indeed, Gu Qiuming is not in the valley; he left three days ago and took the bird egg with him. It's said he went to find another place to hatch it," the somber voice said.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming felt alarm and anger stir within him. Could it be that Gu Qiuming intended to embezzle his Winged Bird Egg?
From their past interactions, it did not seem like Gu Qiuming was such a dishonest and untrustworthy person.
Or could it be that he was using the so-called "formation" for incubation?
Yuan Ming didn't ask any more questions, took his leave, and returned to his previous residence.
He removed the Thousand Mechanism Mask, changed back into their respective clothes, and then dispelled the Illusion Technique that had affected Xu Chuan.
Xu Chuan had no awareness of the recent happenings and only felt that he had stayed for an unusually long time, hastily bidding farewell and leaving.
The most up-to-date version is on *.
Yuan Ming did not go out or use other means but went to the inner chamber and closed his eyes to cultivate his spirit.
The next day, Yuan Ming cast a soundproofing shield around the room and sealed everything with the silver token before lighting a stick of Black Incense and possessing Gu Qiuming.
Yuan Ming's vision went dark, and when he regained his senses, he was indeed startled.
He had successfully possessed Gu Qiuming, but found himself in a dim and damp place.
At the moment, Gu Qiuming's hair was disheveled, and his hands and feet were locked by a magic artifact; he was indeed imprisoned.
In front of him, the space was quite large, with a hexagonal stone platform on the ground, covered in array patterns, forming a large magic array. A tall, straight purple wooden pillar stood in the middle of the array, which seemed to be made of no ordinary wood, and had some patterns on its surface.
In the very center of the array was the Winged Bird Egg, its surface flickering with purple thunder.
The purple column rose straight up, piercing through the stone walls of the dungeon ceiling, and it was unclear where it led. Spiritual energy seemed to be attracted by an invisible force, entered the Blood Egg, and the surface of the Blood Egg began to show faintly visible patterns that flickered on and off.
A young man dressed in a Cloud Brocade Robe stood beside the stone platform, taking spirit stones out of his storage bag and replacing them in the array.
Yuan Ming had seen this person before when Gu Qiuming had taken him to visit the Sixth Uncle, and they had met once.
"Gu Qiulong, it's not too late to stop now! Since the founding of the Zhenling Sect, when have we ever coveted the belongings of our guests? If this gets out, the reputation we have built over hundreds of years will be ruined in an instant!" Gu Qiuming shouted gravely.
It seemed his mana was sealed, and he couldn't break free at all.
"Rest assured, when I act, I never leave loose ends. That boy has been watched by my people. As soon as the Winged Bird Egg is successfully hatched, he will disappear silently from this world without leaving a trace," Gu Qiulong said nonchalantly without turning his head, his tone utterly indifferent.
"What! You even plan to silence him? Although Hagon's cultivation isn't high, he has a mysterious background. Don't you bring disaster upon the sect!" Gu Qiuming's expression shifted as he shouted.
"That's none of your business," Gu Qiulong said with a cold, disdainful laugh.
He kept inserting spirit stones into the array, and as they were replaced, the great array on the stone platform was activated. It hummed and spun, and the purple wooden pillar also started to shine with strands of white light.
"Hehe, the third cousin has a good eye. Using this Guiyuan Thunder Drawing Array to hatch the Winged Bird Egg is indeed brilliant. It's hard work for you to have done all this analytical proof," Gu Qiulong looked at everything happening with the Blood Egg, a hint of a smile in his eyes, as he addressed Gu Qiuming.
"Pah! You taking away the hatching formation without permission... Elder Lin from the Incubation Room will find out sooner or later. Let's see how you'll handle it then," Gu Qiuming spat fiercely.
"How old-fashioned! The Winged Bird has the ability to summon thunder. With this spirit beast, our sect will enter the ranks of Da Jin's top ten sects within a few decades. I will be the greatest contributor!" Gu Qiulong was not angry but rather full of pride.
"Shameless acts!" Gu Qiuming couldn't help but curse.
"Shameless? The realm of cultivation is all about the survival of the fittest. As long as one can gain tangible benefits, the methods do not matter. It's because you don't understand this that you're still lingering in the Qi Refinement Realm. Who else can you blame?" Gu Qiulong said with disdain.
Gu Qiuming closed his eyes, not wanting to look at the other party.
Gu Qiulong no longer paid him any mind and focused on controlling the stone platform array.
However, it wasn't long before his expression changed.
The array, which had been humming and operating, suddenly slowed down, while the patterns on the surface of the Blood Egg continued to flicker faintly.
Gu Qiulong looked at the many surrounding spirit stones that were almost depleted of spiritual energy and, gritting his teeth, took out a handful of spirit stones from his storage bag, replaced the ones embedded in the array, and cast several spells.
After replenishing the spirit stones, the array operated once again. As spiritual energy continued to enter the Blood Egg, the patterns on the Egg's shell became even more prominent.
But this situation only lasted for a few breaths before it turned sharply downward again, and the array once more showed signs of stalling.

chapters.title: Chapter 285 - 262: Tracing (Seeking Monthly Ticket)
chapters.content:
Gu Qiulong saw this, his face alternating between shadows and light before he once again took out a handful of Spirit Stones from his Storage Bag for replacement.
This scene had already occurred several times, and during this time, Gu Qiulong had almost spent over two thousand Spirit Stones. His face, which had been calm and collected, gradually became furrowed with worry, and his forehead was covered with beads of sweat.
He was already on his ninth replacement of the Array's Spirit Stones, nearly depleting all the Spirit Stones in his Storage Bag, when suddenly, an unexpected change occurred.
With a loud thunderclap from above, dazzling lightning bolts began to emanate from the purple wood columns, quickly cascading down and seemingly drawing in the natural thunder and lightning from outside, causing the dungeon space to violently shake.
The purple Array on the stone platform also suddenly brightened, its speed of operation increasing several times over.
Streams of white Spiritual Power flowed out of the Spirit Stones and into the Winged Bird Egg.
The glaring arcs of electricity on the purple columns were absorbed by the stone platform Array, which transformed them into a much softer Power of Thunder and Lightning, pouring it all into the Winged Bird Egg.
Purple lightning flickered on the surface of the Winged Bird Egg, the erratic patterns dimming and the blood color fading noticeably.
Seeing this, Gu Qiulong stared unwaveringly at the Blood Egg, his expression becoming one of extreme tension.
Yuan Ming had seen enough to understand what was going on; Gu Qiulong, lusting after the Winged Bird Egg, had abducted Gu Qiuming to this place.
When he first arrived in Little Lake City, he didn't immediately go to Treasure Spirit Pavilion to incubate the egg, fearing such a situation might occur. Later, when he met Gu Qiuming, an acquaintance, he felt assured enough to visit, never expecting that things would still move in the direction he feared.
Not only was the Winged Bird Egg extraordinarily precious, but it was also a gift from Xi Ying. Naturally, he couldn't give it up. His thoughts raced as he began to contemplate his options.
However, after much deliberation, he still had no clear idea of what to do next, especially since finding the other party's location was proving to be a significant challenge.
Although the Zhenling Sect was not as formidable as Chang Chun Temple, it still had Core Formation Stage cultivators. As an outsider, he could not simply search and move around at will.
"Gu Qiulong, if you are willing to return the egg, I can pretend this never happened. In addition, as a reward, I can tell you the location of another Thunder Attribute spirit beast," Gu Qiuming suddenly opened his eyes and said.
"What spirit beast?" Gu Qiulong turned his head and asked in surprise.The authentic version is on *.
"A Thunder Worm Beast!" Gu Qiuming said slowly.
"Is it really a Thunder Worm Beast? Where is it?" Gu Qiulong asked excitedly, his attention momentarily diverted from the Blood Egg.
A Thunder Worm Beast was a rare Thunder Attribute demon beast whose strength could reach third-level as an adult. Its value as a spirit beast was immense, no less than that of a Winged Bird.
"It's in the Rain Ruins Swamp, less than a hundred miles from here. That Thunder Worm Beast is still a juvenile, just entering the second level. I accidentally discovered its tracks. As long as you return the Winged Bird Egg to Fellow Daoist Hagon, I will take you to capture the Thunder Worm Beast," Gu Qiuming said.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming's eyes suddenly brightened. The distance between the Zhenling Sect base and Little Lake City, including the Rain Ruins Swamp, was considerable, at least two to three hundred miles, which meant Gu Qiuming and his captor were not at Zhenling Sect!
He had previously assumed they were somewhere in Zhenling Sect, which left him at a loss, but if they were outside, things would be much easier to handle.
Yuan Ming, while continuing to listen to their conversation, concentrated his gaze on the dungeon environment, trying to discern some clues.
The dungeon was extremely damp, with droplets of water continuously forming on the walls and trickling down.
Such a moist and watery environment suggested that they really were near the Rain Ruins Swamp.
But beyond that, there were no other useful pieces of information in the surroundings.
Yuan Ming strained to invoke his Divine Soul Power, trying to extend it outwards. However, it was impossible to do so – it seemed as though there was an invisible barrier around his Divine Soul, preventing his Soul Power from breaking through.
"It seems that the extension of my Soul Power before was indeed due to the improvement of the Black Incense's quality," Yuan Ming thought to himself.
Just then, his gaze suddenly shifted upwards.p>
Three prolonged bell chimes came from above, followed by another four sets, and then three sequences of seven, eight, and twelve, respectively.
"Three starting, four descending, seven urgent, eight slow, twelve even; these are the bell tolls of a Daoist temple. Is there a temple nearby?"
Yuan Ming, with his extensive experiences, identified the source of the bell tolls.
He was about to listen further when suddenly, darkness fell; his time of possession had ended.
Yuan Ming's consciousness returned to his own body. After a moment of silence, he got up and walked out, quickly leaving the Treasure Spirit Pavilion.
He didn't summon his Green Cloud Crane or use a magical flying artifact; instead, he employed the Wind Swift Skill and raced toward Little Lake City.
Meanwhile, three figures also silently departed from the Zhenling Sect, following Yuan Ming at a distance – they were three Zhenling Sect disciples.
The leader was a bald, burly man, with the other two being a tall, thin young man and a heavily made-up young woman. The bald man's Cultivation had already reached the Foundation Establishment Stage, while the tall, thin young man and the made-up woman were both at the Qi Refining Peak.
The three of them obviously used either Concealing Talismans or magic tools. Not only was their presence faint, but their figures also melded seamlessly with the surrounding environment, making them difficult to detect.
Yuan Ming quickly covered forty to fifty miles when a dense Black Pine Forest appeared nearby.
He suddenly changed direction and swept into the forest.
The three followers were startled and hastened their pace, plunging into the Black Pine Forest as well, but they had lost track of Yuan Ming.
"Could it be that he noticed us and is trying to find a way to escape?" the thin, tall young man said with a grim expression.
"Did your green bird detect anything?" the bald man asked, looking at the made-up woman.
The young woman put her finger to her lips and whistled softly.
A green bird fluttered down from a nearby tree and perched on the heavily made-up young woman's shoulder, chirping a few times.
"The green bird says that the person walked under this tree and then suddenly disappeared," said the young woman.
"Sudden disappearance? Could it be a concealment spell..." the bald man mumbled to himself, his sparse eyebrows knit tightly.
Before he finished speaking, his legs suddenly weakened, and his figure began to sway.
"Not good, someone used poison…" the bald man's face changed abruptly.
The skinny young man and the heavily made-up young woman were in the same condition, falling to the ground one after another, more swiftly incapacitated, and falling into unconsciousness; the green bird was no exception.
The bald man felt his head heavy and his feet light, his consciousness blurred, and with great difficulty, he reached toward his waist to his storage bag, seemingly trying to retrieve something.
However, his hand had only extended halfway when his consciousness completely blurred, and he collapsed to the ground.
Yuan Ming, wearing a gray cloak, emerged from behind that large tree, holding the Stealing Heaven Tripod in his hand, from which an extinguished incense stick protruded.
This was a stick of Seven-step Immovable Falling Incense, into which he had mixed the Poisonous Flower obtained from Hua Zhi, significantly heightening the toxicity of the seductive scent. The effect was indeed remarkable, easily overwhelming the Foundation Establishment Stage cultivator with the bald head.
Yuan Ming put away the Stealing Heaven Tripod, approached the bald man, and placed a hand on his head, using the Soul Searching Divine Ability. He quickly made a discovery.
The bald man was called Zheng Da, initially a Loose Cultivator near Little Lake City who later ingratiated himself with Gu Qiulong and joined the Zhenling Sect, mainly doing Gu Qiulong's dirty work.
This time, he and the other two were commanded by Gu Qiulong to monitor Yuan Ming and, upon Gu Qiulong's order, to kill Yuan Ming and silence him forever.
Yuan Ming did not show anger; rather, joy appeared on his face.
Zheng Da received Gu Qiulong's order three days ago; he met with him in a forest outside the Zhenling Sect. After Gu Qiulong finished his instructions, he flew off toward the southwest, the direction of the Rain Ruins Swamp.
Gu Qiulong might not have truly gone to the southwest, but this was an important clue worth considering.
Afterward, Yuan Ming performed the Soul Search on the other two, obtaining information far less detailed than Zheng Da's but essentially the same.
He immediately took all three's storage magic tools and flicked three Water Arrows, piercing through their foreheads.
Since these three intended to kill him, Yuan Ming naturally would not show mercy.
He then conjured three Fireballs, turning the three corpses into ashes and scattering those to the wind.
He carefully erased all traces in the forest before stopping.
After completing these tasks, Yuan Ming immediately took out a map of the surroundings of Little Lake City and began searching to the southwest of the Zhenling Sect.
Yuan Ming's gaze halted; in the southwest of the Zhenling Sect, near the Rain Ruins Swamp, he found a Daoist temple called "Shuiyun Temple."
"It should be here!" He did not delay and immediately headed in that direction.
Shuiyun Daoist Temple was an ordinary temple, built between two small mountains, with tall gates and majestic temple halls, occupying an area of twenty to thirty mu, its incense offerings flourishing.
By now, the sky had completely darkened, but many rooms in the temple were still lit.
Yuan Ming did not rashly enter and stopped outside Shuiyun Temple, releasing three soul crows to scout inside, while summoning Hua Zhi to search underground.
Time ticked away slowly; neither the soul crows nor Hua Zhi had any results.
Just as Yuan Ming was growing impatient in secret, the skies lowered with dark clouds, and a downpour started again, a thick bolt of thunder streaking out of the cloud layer, tearing through the pitch-black night sky.
The end of the thunderbolt swept past the back of Shuiyun Temple, then suddenly took a turn, as if guided by something.
Recalling the scene he had witnessed during possession, Yuan Ming's eyes lit up. He immediately flew toward that spot on the White Jade Shuttle, spreading his Divine Sense, and soon made a discovery.
"Indeed, it's here!" He stopped his movement, looking toward a high elevation not far away.
There, a purple-black wooden pillar protruded from the ground, the same one he had seen during possession, its top now charred black.
Yuan Ming pulled out a yellow talisman. He had purchased it at a high price from a talisman shop in Little Lake City. It was an Earth Tunneling Talisman, similar in effect to the Earth Travel Talisman, both can tunneled through the ground.
After calling two of the soul crows back and leaving only one outside as a guard, he activated the Earth Tunneling Talisman and submerged into the ground.
Hua Zhi also arrived at the rear mountain at this moment, infiltrating from another side.
Yuan Ming followed the Thunder-Attracting Purple Wood downward, easily finding the underground chamber. He concealed himself in a corner, peering secretly into the dungeon.
Inside the dungeon, Gu Qiulong was still desperately urging the array to hatch the Winged Bird Egg, unaware of the disturbances outside.
Gu Qiuming was still locked in the dungeon, clothes disheveled, face bruised and swollen, suggesting their negotiation had ended in failure and Gu Qiuming had been beaten.
The Winged Bird Egg at the center of the array had undergone great changes: the blood color on the eggshell had completely vanished, replaced by a shining silver color, with strands of thunder and lightning dancing across it.
Furthermore, two fine cracks had formed on the eggshell, giving the impression that it would hatch imminently.
(Fellow Daoists, please cast your monthly tickets at the beginning of the month.)

chapters.title: Chapter 286 - 263: No Need for Your Help
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming, upon seeing this scene, did not rush to take action. Instead, he clad himself in a gray cloak and moved slightly away from the wooden pillar to avoid being affected by the power of thunder and lightning.
Outside, the rain intensified, and before long, thick thunderbolts streaked across the overcast sky, illuminating it.
Purplish lightning flickers emerged from the wooden pillar as the thunder within the clouds was drawn towards it, striking it and conducting into the dungeon array.
The Winged Bird Egg greedily absorbed the pure power of thunder and lightning. With its shell already cracked, it completely shattered, and a wet, black chick hatched, falling onto the stone platform with a "patter."
The bird was only half a foot long, yet its wings were extraordinarily large, stretching a full foot when unfolded, with lightning patterns faintly visible on its skin.
Despite just hatching, the black chick flapped its wings twice and unexpectedly took flight.
Gu Qiulong was overjoyed and released a white net magic artifact, casting it towards the black chick.
He was focused on capturing the Winged Bird and did not notice that in a corner above the dungeon, two purple-black vines silently emerged, quickly blooming with purple spiritual flowers, spreading a seductive scent rapidly throughout the dungeon.
Lying on the ground, Gu Qiuming inhaled this scent and his already weak body became entirely limp, his face showing a look of intoxication.
Gu Qiulong had just captured the black chick and was about to cast the Beast Taming Technique to subdue it when he too smelled the scent of the poisonous flowers, his limbs becoming weak and powerless.
Under the influence of the scent, the newly hatched black chick also became groggy and lay prostrate on the ground.
"Who's there!" Gu Qiulong finally realized something was amiss, his face suddenly changing as he raised a purple crystal pearl.
A purple light beamed down, creating a purple halo enveloping his body and isolating the seductive scent on the outside.
Gu Qiulong felt weakness in his limbs.
Uploaded by the *) team.
But before he could react, the dungeon exploded from all around, as thick purple-black vines lashed out, attacking Gu Qiulong and entangling with one another, transforming the entire dungeon into a dense sea of vines.
Gu Qiulong's face turned pale, and he quickly increased the power of the purple halo.
The ends of the attacking purple vines sparkled with green light, turning into green swords.
Dozens of green swords pierced from all directions into the purple halo, perforating it and causing it to collapse with a roar.
The purple orb also shattered into pieces and fell to the ground.
Gu Qiulong quickly recited a spell, his body glowing with blue light as he transformed into a blue rainbow and shot out, making his way through the forest of vines to land in a corner of the dungeon.
"Water Form Technique!" Yuan Ming, who was hiding nearby, exclaimed softly at this.
The Water Form Technique was a type of spell that could change one's form, turning the tangible body into intangible water for a short period, to evade enemy attacks.
There were similar shape-changing techniques within the Five Elements Magic, and if used properly in the heat of battle, they could have miraculous effects.
Yuan Ming had always wanted to learn, but such shape-changing techniques belonged to high-level magic, not only were they difficult to obtain but also to master. He was surprised that Gu Qiulong knew how to perform it.
Curious as he was, Yuan Ming did not hesitate in his actions. He activated the Earth Tunneling Talisman to approach the dungeon walls and placed the Stealing Heaven Tripod inside the dungeon, inserting a lit Poisonous Incense and a Seven-step Immovable into the tripod.
With a thought, he directed his Divine Sense to control the two streams of poisonous incense drifting toward Gu Qiulong.
Just as Gu Qiulong calmed his mind and took out a Detoxification Elixir to consume, processing it with his cultivation, he had become entirely alert and immediately sensed Yuan Ming's movement, pulling out both a yellow short halberd and a green feather fan.
The yellow short halberd transformed into a long yellow rainbow, slashing at the Stealing Heaven Tripod, while the green feather fan ferociously fanned out, sending more than a dozen door-sized green Wind Blades whirling towards the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
Feeling the powerful Mana fluctuations from the two top-grade magical tools, Yuan Ming retracted the Stealing Heaven Tripod with a thought and activated the Earth Tunneling Talisman to escape into the distance.
Several loud "booms" followed as one wall of the dungeon was blasted to bits, especially from the yellow short halberd which easily penetrated the wall's earth.
Gu Qiulong's face twisted with anger as he prepared to continue his attack when he again felt a softness in his body and his consciousness rapidly grew dim.
Having fought alongside Yuan Ming on multiple occasions, Hua Zhi's cooperation was now well-honed. Vines shot out once again, and dozens of green wooden swords slashed down.
Gu Qiulong fiercely bit his tongue tip, using the pain to stimulate his senses and slapped his waist.
A golden figure burst forth, landing before him, revealing a golden tiger beast about a foot long, with the presence of a Second Level Early Stage.
With a mouth as wide as a basin, a flat nose, drooping ears, and erratically-angled fangs, the beast's body was gaunt and feeble, looking extremely unsightly and bearing no semblance of the king of a hundred beasts.
This ugly golden tiger let out a low growl, and its withered body emitted a dazzling golden light, with its once gaunt form becoming robust and powerful. Claws shot out, extending a golden aura a foot long, and with continuous slashes, it easily shredded all the green swords.
The tiger then emitted a roar that could pierce through metal and rock, sending blades of golden light alongside the roar, aiming at the distant purple-black vines.
The golden light was incredibly sharp, and with a succession of "puff puff" sounds, the demon vines that filled the dungeon space were almost entirely swept clean, leaving only a heap of broken twigs and fragments.
Gu Qiulong, witnessing this scene, breathed a sigh of relief.
He had been affected by more than one type of seductive scent, his will teetering on the edge of collapse. At this moment, relaxing slightly, he hurriedly sat down with his legs crossed, took out an elixir and popped it into his mouth, and stuck a talisman on his body. At the same time, he ordered the golden ugly tiger to protect him.
Just then, scattered throughout the dungeon, all the broken branches and vines suddenly levitated, shone with strands of green light, and enveloped Gu Qiulong and the golden ugly tiger completely.
The next moment, all the broken vines shot out like bows drawn taut, striking at Gu Qiulong and the golden ugly tiger with an alarming force!
This was the high-level Wood Attribute magic, the Ten Thousand Wood Arrow Technique, which could control all forms of wood to become sharp arrows. Yuan Ming had stolen this technique from the elder Fairy Luoshui of the Water Spirit Palace and later taught it to Hua Zhi.
Facing the incoming vines, Gu Qiulong stood his ground and continued to cultivate in an effort to resist the seductive scent he had inhaled. In his view, with the golden ugly tiger present, these broken vines posed no threat at all.
However, contrary to his expectations, the golden ugly tiger ignored the vines attacking from all directions. After a moment of dazed eyes, its gaze suddenly turned towards Gu Qiulong.
A flash of golden light passed by its mouth, and its already considerable jaw swelled in size more than twice in an instant, lunging ferociously towards Gu Qiulong.
Gu Qiulong leaped to his feet, startled. Just a moment ago, through his Divine Thought, he sensed that his spirit pet had fallen under some illusion technique, mistaking him for an enemy!
But at this moment, he had yet to expel the seductive scent, and his entire body was still somewhat weak. Before he could act, the golden ugly tiger had already pounced, biting his leg and tearing fiercely.
"Ah!"
Gu Qiulong screamed as the ugly tiger tore off his entire right leg and gulped it down, before flinging his body with a swipe of its paw. He slammed against the dungeon wall and passed out.
No sooner had the golden ugly tiger done this, the confusion in its eyes dissipated, and it wondered why, despite aiming to bite the enemy, it ended up severing its master's leg instead.
At that moment, thousands of vine arrows whistled in, engulfing the tiger's form.
There were continuous "boom boom" explosions, the solid ground collapsed like rotting wood, blasting a deep pit several meters wide, and raising a cloud of dust.
The air in the dungeon was damp and the dust quickly dispersed, revealing the figure of the ugly tiger squatting at the bottom of the pit, its body riddled with holes from the Ten Thousand Wood Arrow Technique. Many vines were still piercing it, and blood stained most of its body.
"Crack"
The ground beneath the golden ugly tiger cracked open, and seven or eight thick vines shot out, rapidly entwining around the tiger's body.
These vines were dense with wood grains and displayed blood-red patterns quite different from the previous vines.
The ugly tiger, in shock and rage, bristled like a porcupine, and shot out fine golden rays, not less sharp than the previous golden Sword Qi, stabbing into the surrounding vines.
But these vines had changed; the golden light penetrated only halfway before dissipating.
The Blood Pattern Vines wound quickly around him, continuously applying the Wood Prison Technique, and in the blink of an eye, the tiger was bundled up like a rice dumpling.
Not only that, but the vines hissed, shooting out thin blood-red tendrils that pierced into the tiger's body.
The formidable body of the golden ugly tiger shrank quickly, its flesh withering and its breath growing weaker.
The ugly tiger roared in terror and rage, exhaling a thick black mist that wrapped around its body and quickly seeped into it.
Not far away, Yuan Ming let out a light exclamation upon seeing this. That black aura he had just witnessed, he had experienced it in the Underground Palace of Snake King Valley, similar to the black mist emitted by the black Stone Pillar.
As the golden ugly tiger's body absorbed the black mist, spirals of black patterns emerged on its skin, and its body swelled rapidly, doubling in size in the blink of an eye. Its power surged several times over, reaching the peak of the Second Level Mid-Stage and verging on the Second Level Late Stage.
Seeing such a change in the ugly tiger, Hua Zhi was initially shocked, then delighted.
Its emotions fluctuated extremely violently, and the operation of its demonic power was affected.
The golden ugly tiger, sensitive to this, immediately struggled vigorously.
A terrifying strength burst forth, causing the nearby air to tremble, and the Blood Pattern Vines restraining it crackled, fissuring with cracks.
Yuan Ming quickly summoned the White Ape and threw it into the dungeon space.
White Ape too was excited, splitting its mouth into a grin, laughing with a "cackle" as it landed, and shot out like a white shadow, heading straight for the golden ugly tiger.
"I don't need your help!" Hua Zhi shouted as it saw White Ape appear. With a pull of its right hand upwards, its arm grew exponentially larger.
The ground under the golden ugly tiger burst open, a huge vine palm the size of a house emerged from beneath the earth, grabbed the golden ugly tiger's body like it was a small cat or dog, and despite the tiger's struggles, it was futile.
White Ape had also rushed over, reaching out its hands towards the golden ugly tiger.
"Get lost!" Hua Zhi roared with anger, and the ground split once more, as a second giant vine palm surfaced from underground, striking at White Ape with a fierce gust.
White Ape showed no sign of retreating, smashed out a punch generating a substantial burst of fist wind, and the terrifying force caused the ground to tremble faintly.
The giant palm and fist collided!

chapters.title: Chapter 287 - 264: Leading Calamity Eastwards
chapters.content:
"Bang!"
The violent impact spread outwards, the ground revealing huge cracks as a fierce wind arose, shaking the entire dungeon relentlessly.
In terms of strength, it was ultimately the White Ape that had the upper hand. With a loud "bang," the viney giant palm exploded into a large hole about ten feet in diameter, centered on the fist of the White Ape.
The White Ape passed through the ruptured vine giant palm in a flash and arrived in front of the golden ugly tiger, grabbed its neck, and opened its huge mouth to bite directly onto the tiger's neck.
With a "crack," the neck bone of the golden ugly tiger was forcibly bitten through. Its body shuddered, and its life force completely dissipated.
Poor golden ugly tiger, an extremely formidable being among ordinary spirit beasts, met its humiliating demise at the jaws of the Hua Zhi and White Ape.
