Hua Zhi, however, became furious due to the White Ape's action, immediately burrowed from the ground towards the White Ape, and shot vines like crossbow arrows towards it.
Seeing this, the White Ape also charged without showing any weakness towards Hua Zhi.
Just as the battle between Hua Zhi and the White Ape was about to erupt, a yellow light flashed between them on the ground, and Yuan Ming's figure appeared out of thin air, reaching out with both hands.
"Stop!"
Hua Zhi's vision blurred momentarily, and suddenly it found itself in an endless sea with waves surging and sea breezes blowing.
"The master's illusion technique?" Hua Zhi was startled.
A great force swept over it, sending it flying backwards beyond its control. Its vision also returned to normal, relegating it back to the dungeon space, retreating several feet.
Hua Zhi's grip on the giant paw of the golden ugly tiger had loosened, and now the tiger's corpse was held in the embrace of the White Ape, being gnawed upon ferociously.
"Master, you are biased, I want some too!" Hua Zhi cried out in grievance.
"The dark aura carried by that ugly tiger seems to be very beneficial to the White Ape. Let it have the corpse. You have already absorbed quite a bit of dark aura in the underground palace of Snake King Valley. I will definitely compensate you with something else later, okay?" Yuan Ming said.
At this moment, the White Ape seemed to have gone mad, holding onto the corpse of the golden ugly tiger and refusing to let go no matter what. Thus, he had made this decision.
"Hmph, seeing that it's for the master, this will not set a precedent." Hua Zhi glanced at the White Ape with some disdain but reluctantly agreed.
"Why do you and the White Ape both fancy this kind of dark aura so much?" Yuan Ming curiously asked.
"I don't know either. I just saw this dark aura and really wanted to absorb it," Hua Zhi replied.
Yuan Ming fell silent in contemplation and soon shook his head, not dwelling on it further, and looked towards his right hand.
He was holding a man in his hand, none other than Gu Qiulong, who had just had a leg bitten off and knocked unconscious by the golden ugly tiger. When he used the illusion technique to stop Hua Zhi and the White Ape from fighting, he had conveniently captured him.
Yuan Ming stuck a needle into Gu Qiulong's lower abdomen, shattering his Dantian and rendering his mana useless.
Gu Qiulong's face showed pain, but having been heavily dosed with seductive scent and poisonous incense, he still hadn't woken up.
Yuan Ming placed his palm on Gu Qiulong's head and employed the Soul Searching Divine Ability, his expression quickly turning serious.
Gu Qiulong's identity was not ordinary; he was a direct blood relative of the Zhenling Sect's Gu family, much more important than the collateral member Gu Qiuming.
Gu Qiulong's lineage included a Core Formation Stage cultivator, who held significant sway within the entire Zhenling Sect. This Core Formation Stage being was none other than Gu Qiulong's grandfather, who was very fond of his talented and sweet-talking grandson.
As for the reason Gu Qiulong came here, Yuan Ming also found out through soul searching; after being scolded by his Sixth Uncle, Gu Qiulong harbored thoughts of revenge against Gu Qiuming.
When he discovered that the Winged Bird Egg hatched by Gu Qiuming was mutated, greed took over. Initially, he tried to buy it from Gu Qiuming, but after being sternly rejected, he took advantage of the situation, subdued him, and brought both him and the egg to Shuiyun Temple.
Shuiyun Temple, a branch of the Zhenling Sect and in decline for generations, barely maintained itself. Due to Gu Qiulong's identity, the temple master, who only had Qi Refinement Cultivation, let him use the temple's array.
Gu Qiulong also sent away everyone in the temple to keep his actions secret.
Yuan Ming narrowed his eyes. This Gu Qiulong was greedy and shameless, daring to covet his Winged Bird Egg, and deserved to die. However, killing him recklessly might cause significant trouble since he had a Core Formation Stage ancestor.
Yet, letting him go would also lead to considerable trouble.
Yuan Ming had already dealt with the three bald men sent by Gu Qiulong to watch him. How should he handle Gu Qiulong?
After pondering for a moment, he thought of a solution.
He first diligently cleaned up the signs of battle in the dungeon, then took out Xu Changqing's body, using several Corpse Control Talismans on it.
Fresh Qi-Blood was generated inside Xu Changqing's body, and his hair and skin color changed to appear almost like a normal person, as if someone deeply asleep.
"This Corpse Control Talisman really works wonders," Yuan Ming thought to himself with satisfaction. He then took out Xu Changqing's Golden Snake Sword and Gu Qiulong's Yellow Short Halberd and Green Feather Fan, both magic artifacts.
He simultaneously activated three magic artifacts, colliding fiercely within the dungeon, and quickly left marks on both the floor and the walls.
The golden snake sword shot out like lightning, piercing through Gu Qiulong's heart.
With his heart pierced, the man's body trembled violently, and soon, there was no breath left in him.
The yellow short halberd also chopped down fiercely, splitting Xu Changqing's head into several pieces, creating the false impression that both had perished together.
This setup was not very clever but might barely deceive the pursuers. Given Xu Changqing's extraordinary identity, dying alongside Gu Qiulong, under the Zhenling Sect's reluctance to risk their assets, they might slow down their pursuit of the murderer.
As for the two magic artifacts and the storage bag at Gu Qiulong's waist, Yuan Ming did not leave them behind; he took them, regardless of what the Zhenling Sect might speculate.
After a fierce battle in the dungeon space, he had to leave before the people from Shuiyun Temple noticed.
Yuan Ming stored Hua Zhi, as well as the white ape still gnawing on the corpses, into the spiritual beast bag, and made his way to the stone platform.
The array on the stone platform had already ceased operation, and the black young bird was restrained by Gu Qiulong's white net magic tool, lying on the platform.This chapter was made possible by the community at *.
The entire dungeon space was filled with poisonous incense. The winged young bird, having just been born, could not resist like the golden ugly tiger could; at this moment, it was still unconscious.
Yuan Ming quickly released his Divine Sense to check, and soon found that the bird was only unconscious with no major harm, easing his worries.
He was here today, and had even taken the risk of being pursued by a Core Formation Stage powerhouse, solely for this winged young bird. If it had been damaged, it would have been all for naught.
Yuan Ming took out a new spiritual beast bag, carefully stored the young bird inside, and turned to approach the dungeon's entrance.
During the fierce fight, Gu Qiuming had also not been injured.
Yuan Ming quickly swept his Divine Sense over, and soon, his eyebrows raised in interest, and his fingertips emitted a blue light which promptly transformed into the shape of a hand, tearing off a yellow talisman from Gu Qiuming's back.
Gu Qiuming's mana began to restore immediately.
Yuan Ming picked up Gu Qiuming and moved far away from Shuiyun Temple, setting Gu Qiuming down in a secluded area. Once awake, it would be easy for him to break free from his chains.
He left a note: "Gu Qiulong is dead; leave Thunder Continent quickly." He left five hundred spirit stones in his storage bag. What Gu Qiuming would choose to do next, was up to him. Then, summoning the White Jade Shuttle, Yuan Ming flew toward Little Lake City and quietly entered the city.
Yuan Ming cautiously avoided everyone, returned to residence number 86, activated two arrays, and then took out a silver token and placed it on the ground.
A rich silver light emerged from the token, quickly spreading throughout the room, and soon submerged the entire room.
Yuan Ming finally relaxed a bit, half lying on the bed, pondering today's events from beginning to end. From making Gu Qiuming's acquaintance, to finding Treasure Spirit Pavilion, then his sect and meeting his Sixth Uncle, and finally killing Gu Qiulong, he had left no trail that could reveal his true identity.
Moreover, his daily life was secluded, and sales of incense were mostly managed by Hu Tu and Mu Yang; there were barely a few people in Little Lake City who knew him. Even if Gu Qiuming went back and disclosed everything, he wouldn't know Yuan's residence, making it not so easy for the Zhenling Sect to find him. Considering Gu Qiulong's attitude towards Gu Qiuming, Gu Qiuming would likely have fled far away by now upon finding the extra spirit stones in the storage bag.
As for the temple master of Shuiyun Temple, finding Gu Qiulong dead in his temple, he probably only had the option to flee.
After thorough consideration, Yuan Ming decided not to leave Little Lake City, choosing instead to wait and see how things would unfold.
He retrieved Gu Qiulong's storage bag, his Divine Sense diving into it, brightening his eyes soon after.
Gu Qiulong, truly a Foundation Establishment disciple favored by a Core Formation Stage grandfather from the Zhenling Sect, had a rich legacy. Just the spirit stones alone were over two thousand, and other items included a green jade scroll, a purple invitation, a two-foot-high jade box, several magic artifacts, and more than ten bottles of Four Spirits Pills among other elixirs.
Yuan Ming first picked up the green jade scroll. His Divine Sense dived into it, bringing a glint of delight to his eyes.
The information recorded within the green jade scroll was the Zhenling Sect's Beast Taming Secret Technique, titled "Ten Thousand Beasts True Mirror," similar to the Beast Taming Technique of the Southern Border, involving placing Beast Taming Runes within the demon beasts.
However, the Ten Thousand Beasts True Mirror contained numerous ingenious methods for subduing demon beasts, far more sophisticated than the Beast Taming Technique taught by the Three Cave Masters, though it didn't discuss much about the act of taming itself.
Yuan Ming soon saw that most of the content in the scroll was about introducing demon beasts that could be tamed as spirit beasts in the Cultivation World, detailing their Divine Skills, habits, and more, broadening his horizons considerably.
He searched carefully, but unfortunately did not find the origin of Hua Zhi. However, he discovered a record of Gu Qiulong's golden ugly tiger.
This beast was called the "scale-toothed tiger," a Gold Attribute spirit beast capable of unleashing various Gold Attribute attacks, usually fond of consuming Five Metal Spiritual Materials...
Yuan Ming quickly finished reading the portion about this beast, his brow slightly furrowing.
The jade scroll never mentioned anything about the black qi emitted by the scale-toothed tiger. Could it possibly be a mutated spiritual beast?
Yuan Ming didn't dwell on this, swiftly skimmed through the remaining content, and then set the jade scroll aside, planning to study it in detail later.
He picked up the purple invitation which read "Tianxiang Auction" in large characters. The invitation ended with a date, which was two and a half years later.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming's thoughts stirred.
Having lived in Little Lake City up to now, he was quite familiar with the local situation, certainly having heard of the grand reputation of the Tianxiang Auction, a triennial auction meet agreed upon by the major Cultivation forces of Thunder Continent, where any cultivator with means from Thunder Continent might attend to find treasures of their desire.

chapters.title: Chapter 288 - 265: Demonic Qi
chapters.content:
The Tianxiang Auction was renowned far and wide, attracting not only cultivators and loose cultivators from Thunder Continent, but also those from other provinces and even the cultivators from Zhao Country to Little Lake City.
However, not just anyone could attend this grand auction, as the organizers required participants to possess a special invitation, the means of obtaining which were quite mysterious. Even those eager to find one were not guaranteed success.
Unexpectedly, Gu Qiulong had one in his possession.
Yuan Ming had been quite interested in the Tianxiang Auction, and now that he had the invitation, he planned to go and see for himself what it was all about.
He put away the invitation and took out the jade box to examine it, finding it filled to the brim with three crystal stones.
"These are Thunder Attribute high-grade spirit stones!" Yuan Ming rejoiced inwardly.
Spirit stones in the world were categorized by the Five Elements of Gold, Wood, Water, Fire, Earth. Yet, beyond the Five Elements, there were some abnormal spirit stones, and Thunder Spirit Stones were one of them. Formed by spirit veins absorbing the power of thunder and lightning, they were much rarer than the ordinary Five Elements spirit stones and were far more valuable.
Yuan Ming discovered from Gu Qiulong's memories that these Thunder Spirit Stones, along with another two thousand spirit stones, were public assets of the Zhenling Sect. Gu Qiulong had acquired them not long ago in a transaction with Bailuo Manor and had yet to hand them over. Unexpectedly, the spirit stones all ended up in Yuan Ming's hands, becoming his unintentional dowry.
Yuan Ming put away the jade box and briefly examined the remaining items.
The magic artifacts were all common goods, as for the pills, there was a bottle of Detoxification Pills, a bottle of Healing Pills, and not a few Four Spirits Pills.
Yuan Ming stored these items away and his divine sense swept towards a Corpse Nourishing Bag at his waist.
Inside the bag, the White Ape had already devoured the scale-toothed tiger clean, its body's demon energy surging erratically as if nurturing some significant change.
Hua Zhi had previously absorbed much black qi in the underground palace of Snake King Valley, making substantial progress in strength. Could the White Ape do the same?
Yuan Ming observed for a moment and, seeing that the White Ape's changes wouldn't stop anytime soon, he waved his hand and took out the winged young bird.
The black winged bird lay within a white net, still unconscious.
Yuan Ming pressed his palm on the head of the winged young bird, applying the beast taming secret technique. Billowing black qi entered the young bird's head.
The winged young bird suddenly woke up with a start, but it was ensnared by the net magic tool and couldn't move, only making a few low chirps as Yuan Ming's beast taming techniques infiltrated.
Perhaps because the winged young bird had been fed with Yuan Ming's essence blood before, it quickly showed affection towards him, and he successfully planted a Beast Taming Rune.
Yuan Ming communicated with it through his thoughts, learning about its innate divine ability.
The bird's innate divine abilities included three main powers: one was swift flight—the winged bird being a Thunder Attribute demon beast, its flying escape speed was as fast as lightning and would be top-tier when used as a mount once it was grown. The second was its ability to cast thunder and lightning magic. The third was soaring into the clouds and using its own thunder and lightning to control clouds and summon thunderstorms.
However, the winged bird was still too small to unleash the power of these three innate divine abilities.
Yuan Ming nodded secretly, the three divine abilities of the winged bird were certainly extraordinary, no wonder Gu Qiulong had gone to great lengths, damaging the reputation of his sect and even committing murder and silencing others just to capture it.
He put away the white net and tentatively placed a spirit stone near the mouth of the winged young bird.
The winged young bird immediately came closer, rubbing against Yuan Ming's arm and making "peep peep" sounds like a chick asking its parents for food.
Yuan Ming smiled and took the spirit stone away, and instantly the winged young bird became discontented.
He tossed the spirit stone, and the winged bird caught it with its mouth, swallowing it in one gulp. Its small eyes closed slightly, revealing an expression of contentment.
Seeing the winged young bird's cute mannerism, Yuan Ming's playful side emerged as he teased it for a while before finally storing it in the spiritual beast bag.
At that moment, Yuan Ming's expression subtly changed as he looked towards the Corpse Nourishing Bag.
Sounds of low growling echoed from the bag, indicating that the White Ape was undergoing some kind of transformation.
The White Ape's body was now emitting golden, gray, and black lights in turns, which appeared rather eerie.
The golden light was the Gold Attribute Spiritual Power, the gray light was the Corpse Refining Power of the Heavenly Snake Master, and the black light naturally came from the black qi contained within the recently devoured scale-toothed tiger.
The three lights alternated and grew increasingly brighter, causing the Corpse Nourishing Bag to become unable to withstand the pressure, gradually swelling up.
Yuan Ming's expression changed, and he quickly released the White Ape.
The three-colored glow on the White Ape shone even brighter, its demonic power circulating more rapidly, and suddenly, a purple glow surged in its sea of consciousness—a powerful purple soul power.
This purple soul power was extraordinarily strong, comparable to Yuan Ming's own and full of vibrancy, starkly different from the residual soul that had previously resided within the White Ape Skin.
Yuan Ming looked on in astonishment. Why had the White Ape developed a new divine soul?
He suddenly recalled something and appeared in front of the White Ape in a flash, pressing a hand on its forehead to perform the Beast Taming Secret Technique.
The Beast Taming Secret Technique passed down to him by the Three Cave Masters only allowed him to subdue one spirit beast in the Qi Refinement Realm. Now that his cultivation had broken through to the Foundation Establishment Stage, the number of spirit beasts he could control had increased to three.
A stream of black qi rolled out from Yuan Ming's palm, seeping into the White Ape's head, and he successfully implanted a Beast Taming Rune within the purple soul power.
The White Ape, unaware of what had transpired, bore a new soul. It could no longer be controlled solely by the Fur Cloak Skill; Yuan Ming had to implant a Beast Taming Rune in it to be at ease.
The powerful purple soul power, perhaps because it had just been born, didn't know to resist, and was easily imprinted with a Beast Taming Rune.
Only then did Yuan Ming feel relieved and step back.
As the White Ape was tamed, its aura didn't decrease but increased. Its form was shrouded in dazzling golden light, and a powerful demonic force began to spread tumultuously, causing the entire silver space to tremble incessantly, yet it did not collapse.
A black iron nail was shaken out and struck against the nearby wall, making a light sound. It was the Corpse Sealing Nail that had been always inserted in the White Ape's head.
Yuan Ming put away the item, contemplative.
A few breaths later, the golden light receded, and the figure of the White Ape appeared.
Yuan Ming had been prepared, but he was still surprised when he saw the White Ape clearly.
The White Ape had grown considerably taller than before, its fur turning a mixture of white and gold, its muscles more bulging, emitting a full sense of oppression.
However, the biggest change was not these, but the third arm of the White Ape that had finally grown out, its position having shifted from the chest and abdomen to the left side of the back. Meanwhile, on the right side of its back, a thick golden ape arm had grown, perfectly symmetrical to the left.Readaheadandgetupdatesat*.
Yuan Ming's eyes lit up with joy. It had been a long time since the White Ape Skin's Fur Cloak Skill transformation had progressed, but now it had made a breakthrough and grown a fourth ape arm.
The White Ape slowly lifted its head, the familiar ferocity and dullness in its eyes had completely disappeared, replaced with clarity.
"Master," the White Ape said, cupping one fist in the other hand in a salute to Yuan Ming.
"You have developed spiritual intelligence?" Yuan Ming's eyebrows rose.
"Thanks to the Master's meticulous cultivation, I was able to undergo a rebirth," the White Ape said, moving its four arms and grinning.
"Now that you have awakened your spiritual intelligence, you should have a name. Let's call you Vajra," Yuan Ming suggested.
The White Ape didn't care about the name and nodded in agreement.
Hua Zhi peeked out from the Spiritual Beast Bag, the wooden patterns on its face parting to reveal a pair of purple orbs inside, resembling a pair of eyes, which sized up the freshly named Vajra with a cold snort.
"Bean Sprout," Vajra said with a toothy smile, looking at Hua Zhi.
"Monkey, who are you calling?" Hua Zhi's Divine Soul vibrated with anger, sending a telepathic message.
"I'm talking about you," Vajra replied, apparently able to hear Hua Zhi's telepathy, and chuckled.
Just as Hua Zhi was about to retort, Yuan Ming raised his hand and intervened, "Stop the argument."
Hua Zhi and Vajra stopped bickering, but the looks they exchanged were still full of hostility.
Yuan Ming felt a headache coming on. Vajra hadn't awakened its spiritual intelligence before, and Hua Zhi had already been very unfriendly towards it. Now that they both had developed intelligence, he feared that their future spats could become even fiercer.
He calmed Hua Zhi down and started to examine Vajra's body with his Divine Sense.
Vajra's demonic power hadn't increased noticeably, but the strength of its physical body had made great strides, especially the newly grown arms, which contained astonishing power.
"Very good, it wasn't in vain that I had you consume the scale-toothed tiger's corpse. Do you know the origins of that black aura?" Yuan Ming asked.
"That black aura is Demonic Qi," Vajra said after hesitating.
"Demonic Qi!" Yuan Ming was startled.
"Does the Master know what Demonic Qi is? I don't understand the meaning of these words; they just suddenly flashed through my mind," Vajra inquired.
"I've seen it mentioned in the classics. There are countless people in the world who practice cultivation, and not everyone pursues the Immortal Path; some step into the Demon Dao, and those cultivators use Demonic Qi," Yuan Ming explained after thinking it through.
"So that's what it is," Vajra said, nodding in realization.
"Demonic Qi, Demonic Qi," Hua Zhi murmured, hands cradling its head, its Divine Soul vibrating as if trying hard to remember something.
When Hua Zhi first awakened its own spiritual intelligence, it had developed several rather useful abilities.
After a conversation with Vajra, Yuan Ming learned that Vajra possessed formidable physical strength, particularly in its newly grown arms, which held power several times that of ordinary limbs.
Vajra, eager to show off, shook its new arms.
A surging force exploded, causing a rumbling sound in the nearby void, stirring up a wild wind, and the silver light barrier shook violently once again.
"Not bad," Yuan Ming said, his eyes gleaming.
"It's just some brute strength," Hua Zhi sent a telepathic retort, sounding sour.
Apart from strength, the power of the Spirit Root within the body of the Heavenly Snake Master had also been activated. Vajra could manipulate Gold Attribute Spiritual Power, and from the tips of Vajra's fingers sprouted five golden talons, each several feet long and looking extremely sharp.
"Do you have any other abilities?" Yuan Ming continued to inquire.
"There's nothing else... Wait, there seems to be something extra in my mind, like a Cultivation Method?" said Vajra, suddenly frowning and sitting down cross-legged.
The surrounding nature's spiritual energy was drawn in, pouring into Vajra's body but not converting into demonic power, instead merging into its Physical Body.
"Utilizing spiritual power to enhance the Physical Body, that's a Body Cultivation Method, isn't it!" Yuan Ming expressed, his eyes revealing amazement.
"It should be," Vajra opened its eyes.
"Does this method include a mnemonic?" Yuan Ming asked eagerly.
In the Cultivation World, although Body Cultivators weren't as rare as Soul Cultivators, they were still quite uncommon, and Body Cultivation Methods were even rarer. Throughout his time in the Cultivation World, he had acquired many Magic Cultivation Techniques, but not a single Body Cultivation Method. The Copper Skin Pill he had obtained from Liu Su was still in his Storage Ring because he lacked a suitable Body Cultivation Method. If he could acquire a Body Cultivation Method from Vajra, his Physical Body strength could be enhanced, which would also heighten his ability to protect himself during combat.

chapters.title: Chapter 289 - 266 Soul Seal
chapters.content:
"The Cultivation Technique is absent," Vajra hesitated for a moment as if pondering, then responded.
"Can you tell me how to practice it?" Yuan Ming asked eagerly.
"This comes naturally; I have no way to articulate it," Vajra considered for a while but then shook his head.
Yuan Ming felt somewhat disappointed.
"Alright, I'll teach you how to read another day," Yuan Ming had no choice but to say, "Take this and eat it; it should be beneficial for you."
Yuan Ming took out a Copper Skin Pill and gave it to Vajra, who didn't hesitate to take one and consume it.
"I feel so hot inside," Vajra expressed after eating the pill and waiting a while.
"That should be the medicinal power working; it's beneficial for you. You go ahead and cultivate," Yuan Ming said.
With a wave of his hand, Yuan Ming took out a Spiritual Beast Bag and stored the White Ape King Kong inside.
He had never fully understood the cause of King Kong and Hua Zhi's mutation and enlightenment.
Recalling the experience of obtaining the two demon beasts, he faintly felt there was a connection between their appearance and the two demons he saw in his mind right after he had obtained the Stealing Heaven Tripod and fell into the water in the Southern Border.
...
In the following days, Yuan Ming secluded himself, and seven days quickly passed, the Tai Chi Pattern of the Stealing Heaven Tripod regaining its brightness.
Seven days had gone by, and he wondered if the Zhenling Sect would start to suspect him.
He took out the Stealing Heaven Tripod and a stick of Black Incense. This new Black Incense was made from materials Hu Tu had purchased for him, using the incense ashes of the Zhenling Sect. He was curious about the effect.
After briefly pondering, Yuan Ming lit the Black Incense, recalling the face of the Sixth Uncle. Darkness soon enveloped his vision.
When his consciousness returned, he had possessed the body of the Sixth Uncle, appearing in a place resembling a Beast Garden, looking at a group of fiery red young foxes, holding a notebook and occasionally recording something, seemingly observing their habits.
After briefly surveying his surroundings, Yuan Ming began trying to influence the Sixth Uncle with suggestions, making him talk to someone who knew the details about the murder of Gu Qiulong.
The effect of the Black Incense made from the Zhenling Sect's incense ashes was apparently not bad, as after just three or four suggestions, the Sixth Uncle stopped his work and walked to the other side of the Spirit Beast Garden, quickly finding an elderly man with a black beard who was engrossed in writing something in a building.
"Lin Hai, are you looking for me?" the black-bearded man stood up and asked.
"Gu Zhen, how is the investigation into the matter of my grandnephew Qiulong going? Why haven't there been any updates?" the Sixth Uncle asked gravely.
To Yuan Ming's delight, not only did the Sixth Uncle follow the vague suggestions precisely, but he also managed to find someone fitting the criteria exactly. The effect of the suggestions was even better than before using the incense ashes of the Zhenling Sect.
"Lin Hai, since the Sect has sealed the matter, there must be reasoning behind it; you should avoid inquiring too deeply," Gu Zhen glanced at the Sixth Uncle and said.
"It seems the Sect has already investigated quite a bit; this matter concerns the death of my grandnephew, so I ask you, Brother Gu Zhen, to inform me," the Sixth Uncle bowed slightly in request.
Gu Zhen's expression showed difficulty, and he didn't speak.
"Gu Zhen, be straightforward," the Sixth Uncle urged.
"Alright, the Sect Master has visited the scene. Besides your grandnephew Gu Qiulong, there was another corpse dressed in Chang Chun Temple's apparel. Judging by the surface situation, it appears they died fighting each other," Gu Zhen whispered.
"A Chang Chun Temple Cultivator! Have they identified who it was?" the Sixth Uncle gasped in shock.
"This person was a Foreign Affairs Elder of Chang Chun Temple, Xu Changqing," Gu Zhen revealed.
"Xu Changqing? I've never heard of him. How did they end up fighting to the death? What were they fighting over?" the Sixth Uncle's brows furrowed tightly.
"I'm not sure about that. The storage magical tools of both Gu Qiulong and Xu Changqing have vanished. Besides the two of them, there was likely a third person at the scene, possibly the Shuiyun Temple Master," Gu Zhen speculated.
"The Shuiyun Temple Master? Qiulong wouldn't have gone to Shuiyun Temple for no reason. Where is the temple master now?" the Sixth Uncle asked.
"The temple master is missing. The other Taoists of Shuiyun Temple haven't seen when Gu Qiulong arrived," Gu Zhen informed.
"Besides these findings, the Sect also discovered another situation; your other grandnephew, Gu Qiuming, suddenly disappeared ten days ago, and his daughter Gu Hui vanished seven days ago," Gu Zhen continued.
"Gu Qiuming? I saw him a few days ago. Could he be related to this matter?" the Sixth Uncle was visibly shaken.
"I don't know about that; the Sect has already sent people to search for the three of them discreetly," Gu Zhen mentioned.
Afterward, the two discussed for a long time until the Black Incense burned out.
Yuan Ming deduced that Gu Qiuming must have seen his message and fled with his daughter. The Shuiyun Temple Master, realizing that Gu Qiulong was dead, feared the Zhenling Sect's wrath and also disappeared.
The next morning, Yuan Ming visited the Treasure Spirit Pavilion.
Yuan Ming demanded the Winged Bird that he entrusted Gu Qiuming to hatch for him, but the shop assistant said Gu Qiuming had been missing for many days. Yuan Ming flew into a rage, demanding compensation. The shop assistant demurred, claiming the shopkeeper was absent and asked Yuan Ming to return another time.
With a plan in mind, Yuan Ming returned home and, seven days later, once again possessed Xu Chuan, the Qi Refining Disciple that Gu Qiuming had arranged to host him.
The Black Incense was lit.
At that moment, Xu Chuan was busy in a Spirit Beast Garden, and Yuan Ming started attempting to influence him with suggestions.
Soon, Xu Chuan ceased his work and walked towards the other side of the Spirit Beast Garden, finding a young man.
"Xu Chuan, are you looking for me?" the young man stood and asked.
"Gu Qiuyang, you're well informed. Do you know how the investigation into the disappearance of Gu Qiuming and his daughter is going?" Xu Chuan asked.
"Why do you ask?" Gu Qiuyang said.
"Just curious," Xu Chuan sighed.
"You're worried about Gu Hui, aren't you?" Gu Qiuyang said with a smile.
"Stop beating around the bush," Xu Chuan urged.
"Gu Hui left on the day that Gu Qiulong died," Gu Qiuyang said quietly.
Yuan Ming subtly prompted Xu Chuan to inquire further, influencing him three times before Xu Chuan obliged with the question.
"What is the identity of the person who killed Gu Qiulong?" Xu Chuan asked.
"The sect is keeping it confidential, so I don't know. Gu Hui is so beautiful, there's no telling how many people in the sect are disappointed by her departure. You're one of them, aren't you? Otherwise, why would you be so attentive to Gu Qiuming?" Gu Qiuyang said.
"That's not the case; I just pity Gu Qiuming being one-armed," Xu Chuan denied.
Yuan Ming nodded slightly and influenced Xu Chuan again, asking about the Core Formation Stage ancestor, Gu Qiulong.
This time he influenced him only twice before Xu Chuan casually steered the conversation towards some matters within the sect.
The influence on Xu Chuan through suggestions seemed easier? Yuan Ming's thoughts stirred.
Through their casual conversation, Yuan Ming learned about the situation of Gu Qiulong's Core Formation Stage ancestor, who was currently in seclusion.
Yuan Ming finished asking all his questions and his mind shifted to Black Incense Possession.
He had caused possession of a Qi Refining Stage Cultivator using Black Incense made from the Xuanhua Temple's incense ashes, and compared to possessing Xu Chuan this time, he concluded that the effect of Zhenling Sect's incense ashes was indeed superior to that of Xuanhua Temple.
However, influencing Xu Chuan's behavior this time initially required four or five instances, but later it became increasingly easy. What was going on?
An idea flashed through Yuan Ming's mind as he suddenly recalled the situation when he had possessed the old emperor.
After consecutive influences, some strange changes seemed to have occurred between Yuan Ming and the old emperor, with the latter becoming more compliant to his influence.
Could it be that the more frequent the influences, the more obedient the possessed subject would become?
Upon this realization, another idea surfaced in Yuan Ming's mind.
He mimicked his previous method with the old emperor, repeatedly influencing Xu Chuan with suggestions.
Time passed by, and the possession period was quickly coming to an end.
At that moment, the Divine Soul Power in the Sea of Consciousness of Xu Chuan suddenly vibrated, as if undergoing some transformation.
Yuan Ming hurriedly probed, and Xu Chuan's consciousness became exceedingly compliant, unreservedly accepting Yuan Ming's influence without any resistance, as if obeying Yuan Ming's will was a matter of course.
This feeling was mysterious, akin to a demon beast that had been affixed with a Beast Taming Rune, thoroughly tamed.
At that moment, Yuan Ming's vision darkened, signaling the end of the possession period.
His consciousness returned to his body, but his face showed an unmistakable joy.
This is a sample from My Virtual Library Empire. Read the rest on *.
It seems that with Black Incense Possession, as long as there was enough time to continuously apply influence, it was indeed possible to affect the other party and ultimately have them completely at one's disposal.
Why this was the case could be that the continuous influences touched the deepest part of the possessed person's Divine Soul, leaving an indelible mark that rendered them submissive.
However, based on his judgment, the effects of such suggestions might not be the same for everyone. For those with particularly strong wills or exceptionally powerful Divine Souls, the effects might be less pronounced, at least they wouldn't be influenced so easily.
"From now on, let's call this ability 'Soul Seal,'" Yuan Ming thought to himself.
With this ability, there would be much more he could do when possessing others.
Yuan Ming collected his thoughts and considered his next move.
Based on the information gathered from the two possessions, the Shuiyun Temple Master and Gu Qiuming and his daughter's disappearance remained without evidence; the Zhenling Sect was unlikely to suspect Hagon.
This matter would remain untroubled for the time being.
Yuan Ming pulled out the Incense Making Secret Manual and turned to the back, where it listed truly precious Spirit Incense such as Purple Mysterious Incense and Red Butterfly Fragrance.
He picked up a silver token from the ground next to him and communicated with Hu Tu through a transmission, instructing him to procure the materials required for making precious incenses like the Purple Mysterious Incense.
Upon hearing that Yuan Ming was going to make new incenses, Hu Tu and his companion were overjoyed and immediately purchased a large batch of materials.
Yuan Ming had already mastered the process of making these kinds of Spirit Incense, and soon, he transformed one spiritual material after another into Spirit Incense, displaying them on the counter and shelves.
Just as he had speculated, as soon as the Purple Mysterious Incense and other Spirit Incense appeared, they were immensely popular. Not only did Qi Refining Stage Cultivators come to purchase, but also a substantial number of Foundation Establishment Stage Cultivators; in just one month, he earned three thousand Spirit Stones.
Yuan Ming also tentatively placed three sticks of Seven-step Immovable Fainting Spirit Incense on the shelves.
Yuan Ming had mixed incense ashes into the Seven-step Immovable Spirit Incense. With the magical effect of eliminating any fluctuations of Spiritual Power, once ignited, the incense was colorless, odorless, and devoid of any Spiritual Power fluctuations, making it nearly undetectable—truly bewitching people imperceptibly.
The price of each stick of Seven-step Immovable Fainting Spirit Incense was comparable to that of a Low Grade Magical Artifact.
The reputation of Xuanhua Spirit Incense Shop gradually spread, and several auction houses in the workshop took notice and approached to do business—wanting to sell the Spirit Incense at auctions. Yuan Ming didn't pay attention to the auction houses, as the time for auctions had not yet arrived.

chapters.title: Chapter 290 - 267: Please
chapters.content:
Time flew by, and in the blink of an eye, two years had passed.
Besides the booming business at Xuanhua Spirit Incense Shop, everything else remained calm as usual. The concerns Yuan Ming had did not come to pass, and people from Zhenling Sect did not find their way here.
In the secret chamber of residence number 86, Yuan Ming sat cross-legged, his body faintly emanating a green glow.
With the income from the Spirit Incense Shop, he had access to almost an endless supply of elixirs for cultivation. Starting from initially taking just Four Spirits Pills, he later added the more effective Harmonization Liquid Pill which was nearly worth four hundred spirit stones per bottle.
It is said that this was the best elixir for someone in the Early-stage Foundation Establishment to consume, equivalent to the treatment a Direct Disciple from a Sect such as Chang Chun Temple would receive.
Also, aided by Purple Mysterious Spirit Incense, his cultivation had improved quite fast, and he had now reached the peak of the Early-stage Foundation Establishment.
Yuan Ming opened his eyes, a divine light faintly visible within them as he slowly exhaled a breath of turbid air.
After steadying his mind, he flipped his hand and swallowed a white elixir, his body's green glow quickly becoming brighter.
This white elixir, called the Condensing Pill, helped in breaking through the cultivation bottleneck in the Foundation Establishment Stage.
Yuan Ming closed his eyes again, inhaled and exhaled the nature's spiritual energy, and circulated the Nine Elements Technique to refine the Condensing Pill, attempting to break through the bottleneck of the Early-stage Foundation Establishment.
Soon, strong mana fluctuations burst forth from within his body, spreading out like waves continuously.
The secret chamber was enveloped in a silver light screen formed by the Silver Token, which blocked all the mana fluctuations.
This condition lasted for about a quarter of an hour; then, the green glow on Yuan Ming's body suddenly dimmed, and the agitated mana fluctuations steadied.
"Cultivating in the Foundation Establishment Stage is indeed much harder than in the Qi Refinement Realm," he murmured with resignation, opening his eyes.
This was his third attempt at breaking through the bottleneck in the past month.
Yuan Ming did not continue in seclusion. After checking the time, he stood up, left the Spiritual Fragrance Shop, boarded his Magic Artifact, and once again returned to Thunder City.
He found a teahouse to sit down in, having already secretly dispatched a soul crow to monitor the surroundings en route.
Soon, a short figure in a grey robe entered the teahouse. After casually glancing at the other customers, the figure also found a seat by the window and ordered a pot of tea.
Through the soul crow, Yuan Ming saw that nobody was following the person in the grey robe. He approached and tentatively asked, "Grandma, long time no see, you look just like I remember from my childhood."
Upon seeing Yuan Ming, the person in the grey robe looked up, her face lighting up with joy mixed with affection, "My child, you've grown so much, looking just like your mother."
She lifted her hood to reveal the face of a middle-aged woman around her forties, with slight wrinkles between her eyebrows and partially grey curly hair. Her eyes, however, were bright and spirited as she carefully scrutinized Yuan Ming's appearance, but soon, she feigned anger, "Coming to Thunder City and not looking for me, you've had me worried for a long time."
"I didn't want to cause trouble for Grandma," Yuan Ming replied.
"What would I be afraid of at my age? I immediately left seclusion when I heard you were coming to Thunder City. I waited and waited but you never showed up, and I worried myself sick. Besides, if Chang Chun Temple retaliated against you, wouldn't they be ashamed?" Grandma said.
"I still need to be cautious. Hidden dangers are hard to defend against," Yuan Ming said.
In the years that had passed, he felt fairly safe in Little Lake City. Since his soul crows patrolling the city had not detected anything unusual, he would often send letters back home to reassure his parents, although he never revealed his specific location.
Recently, he had gotten in touch with Grandma, who had asked him to meet at this teahouse in Thunder City at this time, saying she had a matter to entrust to him.
"Ah, Ming'er, you really are mature beyond your years. If your cousin Xu Tian had even half of your care, I could die in peace. Originally, I didn't want to trouble you, but in a few days, your cousin Xu Tian will go out for experience, and recently there has emerged a villain near Thunder City who specifically targets Qi Refining cultivators, with many already harmed. I can't help but worry, but the Sect Leader has just tasked me with an errand I cannot refuse, so after much deliberation, I could only turn to you," Grandma sighed, her face apologetic.
Before Yuan Ming could speak, Grandma continued, "I understand your predicament. If you can't make it, could you perhaps introduce a reliable friend? I trust your judgment."Thiscontentoriginatesfrom*,MyVirtualLibraryEmpire.
Worried, Grandma added, "Grandma has been overly concerned. I happen to be free during this period, but I can only offer covert protection," Yuan Ming pondered for a moment before agreeing.
"You needn't worry about that. Every year, the Sect publishes missions in the Loose Cultivation Association for the experience tasks.any qualifying Loose Cultivator can participate. You just need to join under an alias," Grandma exclaimed joyfully.
Afterward, Yuan Ming inquired further about the details of the mission from Grandma, politely declined the Spirit Pills and Spirit Stones she offered him, taking only a new cloak while instead presenting her with numerous cultivation elixirs and Spirit Incense as a token of respect.
After all, before he had even set foot on the Immortal Path, Grandma had been very fond of his mother and had taken great care of his family. She had even been willing to shelter him when he had offended Chang Chun Temple and fled, though he had not gone to her for refuge.
While Grandma was visibly pleased, she also cautioned Yuan Ming to always be careful.
Yuan Ming finally parted with her and returned to Little Lake City.
...
Days later, at the Loose Cultivation Association.
Today, the task hall was exceptionally lively, with cultivators in various colored garments gathering in small groups. The chatter was slightly noisy, and behind the counter, the clerks were so busy that they hardly touched the ground. The number of people seemed to be much greater than usual.
Seeing the clerks so busy, Yuan Ming asked for a jade scroll printed with a task list and began to carefully look it over alone.
The list contained well over a hundred tasks of various kinds; the requirements for acceptance and rewards also greatly differed.
Simple tasks like escorting cultivators and transporting goods, although low in reward, were low-risk and didn't take much time; however, they required certain levels of trustworthiness and cultivation from those who took them.
Adventurous tasks, on the other hand, were almost barrier-free to accept and offered quite significant rewards.
However, these tasks were accompanied by two notes: one explaining the potential dangers, advising the taker to think carefully, and the other recording the number of cultivators who had accepted the task but had not returned within the allotted time.
For example, an exploration task in a certain secret realm within Zhao Country offered a reward of a thousand spirit stones, but the dangers were unknown, and the number of cultivators who had yet to return was already as high as thirteen.
This was why, due to their difficulty and low completion rate, exploration tasks made up a significant portion of the past task lists.
Whereas simple escort tasks were usually taken up as soon as they appeared and rarely lingered on the list for long.
However, Yuan Ming noted that today's task list was unusually full of escort tasks, and most were escorting Qi Refining cultivators.
Recalling what his grandmother had mentioned about the killer targeting Qi Refining cultivators, he called over a clerk to subtly inquire about it.
"Indeed, there have been some disturbances, but it shouldn't be much of an issue for a senior like yourself. It's just that within the Thunder Continent, a murderous, nameless cultivator has emerged who targets solitary Qi Refining cultivators, and to date, more than a dozen cultivators have been murdered," the clerk replied.
Yuan Ming feigned surprise, "Really? Has anyone figured out his background?"
"This person's ability to hide his tracks is quite sophisticated. Little Lake City has organized several investigation teams, but all have returned empty-handed. Now, affected sects have come forward to lead the efforts, offering a reward for information on this person. If you're interested, you can participate in the investigation; if you can capture this person, our association will offer a substantial reward," the clerk said respectfully.
Yuan Ming noncommittally nodded his head. Seeing his lack of interest, the clerk tactfully withdrew, leaving him alone to continue reviewing the task list.
But not long after the clerk left, two cultivators walked up to Yuan Ming and saluted with their hands.
"Pardon the intrusion, we hope Fellow Daoist will understand," one said.
The speaker was a burly man about eight feet tall with a full beard, who appeared rough but spoke with extreme politeness.
The other cultivator wore a blue long robe, held a whisk, and had a gentle expression with a slight smile on his lips and his eyes squinting into slits.
"The two of you seek me out; may I know the reason?" Yuan Ming asked, looking at them.
He had sensed someone observing him during his conversation with the clerk. As the two approached, he was somewhat blunt. Their aura indicated they were both Foundation Establishment cultivators, similar in cultivation to himself.
"Hehe, it's not really instruction, but my companion and I noticed that the Fellow Daoist carries a remarkable bearing, likely possessing unique divine skills. We also happen to have a task needing more hands. Would you be interested?" the bearded man cajoled.
"I'm sorry, but I am accustomed to working alone and not interested in joining with others," Yuan Ming declined without hesitation and turned to leave.
"Hey, don't rush off, Fellow Daoist. Listen to what I have to say before you decide," the bearded man said with a laugh.
Yuan Ming stopped, turned back, and looked at them, his expression distant. However, the bearded man appeared unfazed and continued:
"As you might have heard from the association's member just now, there's a hefty reward for capturing the culprit attacking the Qi Refining cultivators. Not to deceive you, my companion, Fellow Daoist Liao, has a unique spell that can pinpoint the culprit's location. The two of us were sufficient, but considering the fiend's cunning nature, to prevent his escape, we thought it wise to invite the Fellow Daoist to join us. Of course, the reward obtained afterwards would also be shared with you. What do you say?"
Yuan Ming frowned, skeptical, "If the fiend targeted only lone Qi Refining cultivators, it suggests limited strength. You two are Foundation Establishment; why fear his escape?"
"You err in thinking thus, let alone the fact that teams organized by the association to capture this fiend included Foundation Establishment cultivators and still failed to track him. But consider this, something that might change your mind about his power," the bearded man looked around mysteriously, lowering his voice.
"Two years ago, an elder from Zhenling Sect was murdered near the wilderness of Little Lake City. Zhenling Sect was infuriated and spent great efforts to find the murderer. They even posted a high reward, but to this day, it's still open, and there's still no news of the murderer," the bearded man explained.
Yuan Ming was inwardly startled, but kept a composed face and nodded, "Oh, I have heard something of this matter, but what does this have to do with the murderer targeting the Qi Refining cultivators?"

chapters.title: Chapter 291 - 268: Escort Mission
chapters.content:
"According to the information I have, Qi Refining cultivators had been disappearing near Little Lake City as early as a year and a half ago; however, the number and frequency of these disappearances were not high, and it only recently surged, which is why no one paid attention to it back then," the bearded man analyzed.
"Similarly, a year and a half ago, Zhenling Sect investigated the murderer to no avail and temporarily gave up the large-scale search. Instead, they issued a high-reward bounty for clues about the murderer. Comparing the timelines, the conclusion becomes much narrower," the bearded man said with extra confidence.
"Fellow Daoist means to say, the one who killed the Zhenling Sect elder and the one ambushing the Qi Refining cultivators is the same person?" Yuan Ming's face was full of shock, as if he had discovered some incredible secret.
"According to my conjecture, the murderer initially wanted to target a Foundation Establishment cultivator, but he picked the wrong target and mistakenly killed a Zhenling Sect elder. He then lay low for a while, and later he turned to targeting Qi Refining cultivators, being very cautious at first. Seeing that no one could find him, he became increasingly bold, which again drew attention," the bearded man stated confidently.
"Fellow Daoist's analysis is clear and convincing; it indeed persuades one, just that without solid proof, if the deduction is wrong, wouldn't it be making a mountain out of a molehill?" Yuan Ming remarked upon hearing this.
"Hehe, if my deduction is wrong and the murderer is not powerful, wouldn't that be even better? I have also inquired in advance, the bounty set by the Loose Cultivation Association for the murderer is three thousand spirit stones. If we can capture him, the three of us will split it equally, a thousand each, which is certainly a significant amount," the bearded man said nonchalantly.
Yuan Ming smiled, "Fellow Daoist has a point, but I apologize, I am not adept at fighting with others. You should seek someone more capable for this task."
The bearded man looked disappointed and tried to persuade him a few more times. Seeing Yuan Ming was resolute, he did not persist further, bowed, and left with his companion.
Yuan Ming watched the two leave, pondered for a moment, took out the task list, and flipped through it, indeed finding the reward task posted by Zhenling Sect.
"Find Gu Qiuming's whereabouts, rewards one thousand spirit stones for reliable information, three thousand for capture."
Yuan Ming shook his head, unable to believe that Gu Qiuming was suspected by Zhenling Sect, and his "price" was quite high now.
He muttered to himself for a bit, then started looking for the Shengye Sect task mentioned by his grandma.
The high reward offered by Zhenling Sect, yet unable to find Gu Qiuming for two years, somewhat reassured him.
And he had been strenuously practicing cultivation at home for a long time, yet his cultivation had hardly improved. He agreed to take on the Shengye Sect's task both for familial loyalty and to take a break.
Soon, he found the task mentioned by his grandma among many others.
"Escort mission, escorting Shengye Sect Qi Refining Disciples to the forests of Zhao Country to collect Spiritual Medicine, departing in five days. Takers should have resided in Little Lake City for over a year and possess cultivation at or beyond the Foundation Establishment stage, the reward is two bottles of Four Spirits Pills or equivalent spirit stones."
After thinking for a moment, Yuan Ming called the attendant again: "I would like to take on the task of escorting Shengye Sect disciples."
"Alright, please leave your name and cultivation, and I will record it for you," the attendant took out a jade scroll.
"Hagon, Early-stage Foundation Establishment," Yuan Ming reported his alias.
"Alright, I have recorded it for you, senior. Please keep this token safe and bring it with you to the second floor of our association two days later at 7 am, where Shengye Sect will conduct an assessment of you," the attendant handed over a black token.
"An assessment is needed?" Yuan Ming was slightly startled.
"Yes, because it's a customary task for Shengye Sect, they have many cultivators apply each year, and since the disciples being escorted are their elites, for safety, Shengye Sect has high requirements for the character and strength of the applicants, hence the assessment is specially arranged for selection," the attendant explained.
"How many people have applied now? Who are they?" Yuan Ming asked curiously.
"Including you, there are thirteen people total, but per regulations, I can't reveal their names to you, please understand," the attendant said.
Yuan Ming didn't mind; he nodded and then took the token and left.
...
Two days later.
Yuan Ming arrived at the Loose Cultivation Association at the end of 5 a.m. to 7 a.m., showing his token, an attendant immediately led him to the second floor.
The rooms on the second floor of the Loose Cultivation Association were carefully designed, not neighboring each other, and each was equipped with a specialized soundproofing array to prevent eavesdropping.
The room assigned by Shengye Sect was in a deeper part of the second floor, but when Yuan Ming entered the room, he saw eight cultivators already waiting inside.
There were men and women among them, and their ages varied.
Yuan Ming did not know any of them nor did he intend to exchange pleasantries. He directly found a chair, sat down, and closed his eyes to rest.
Soon thereafter, three cultivators entered the room following Yuan Ming. Among them were some acquaintances of the cultivators who had arrived earlier, and they sat together, whispering among themselves.
Shortly after, it was 7 a.m., and the door was pushed open again, with a wave of medicinal fragrance following.
Yuan Ming opened his eyes and saw two Late-stage Foundation Establishment cultivators walking into the room, one after the other.
The leader, dressed in a dark green long robe and of average height, had thick eyebrows and round eyes that made him look as fierce as a tiger, exuding great authority.
The cultivator following him was Yuan Ming's old acquaintance from the Southern Border, Bai Ye. Bai Ye seemed surprised to see Yuan Ming as well, but soon, a cheerful expression appeared between his brows as they exchanged smiles.
"I am Lu Shen, the External Affairs Elder of Shengye Sect. According to past practice, the tasks issued by our sect required only a year's residence in Little Lake City. However, given the recent events in the city, which you all might have heard of, for the safety of our sect's disciples, this assignment will only be open to cultivators who have resided in the city for more than two years," said the cultivator in the dark green robe as he scanned the room.
As soon as these words were spoken, immediately some cultivators expressed their dissatisfaction.
"Then why didn't you make that clear when you issued the task? What a waste of time!" A short, plump Taoist stood up and stormed out, flinging his sleeves.
Lu Shen remained unmoved: "It sadly caused some Fellow Daoists a wasted trip, for which I feel quite guilty. Therefore, I have specially prepared some Spiritual Tea. Please take a portion when you leave."
The short, plump Taoist had just reached the door when he heard this. His body stiffened, but appearing unable to swallow his pride to turn around and ask for the Spiritual Tea, he hesitated for a moment before snorting coldly and fiercely pushing the door open to leave.
Though other cultivators were also dissatisfied, hearing there was compensation with Spiritual Tea, they no longer showed anger and took the tea before leaving.
Soon, the room was left with only Lu Shen and Bai Ye, along with four other cultivators, including Yuan Ming.
"There are four Fellow Daoists who qualify. For this mission, our sect needs only two participants. Therefore, I ask each of you to demonstrate your Divine Skills. I will choose the two strongest participants," Lu Shen said, making a gesture to invite them. "However, this room is too confined for such displays. Please follow me to the training field to test your skills."
Just then, Bai Ye suddenly spoke: "This Fellow Daoist Hagon needn't go, right? I have personally witnessed his strength, and it is not inferior to mine."
"Elder Bai, this relates to our sect disciples' safety. How can we ignore the rules out of personal favoritism? This Fellow Daoist Hagon is only at the Early-stage Foundation Establishment. How could his strength exceed yours?" Lu Shen frowned, visibly displeased.
Part of a series hosted by My Virtual Library Empire (MV&LEMP&YR).
"Brother Lu, what I said is absolutely true. If it hadn't been for Fellow Daoist Hagon's rescue, I would have perished in the Southern Border long ago. Not only is his strength outstanding, but his character is also impeccable. Remember, reliable character is most crucial for this mission," Bai Ye said. Seeing Lu Shen still unconvinced, he stealthily communicated something to him using a voice transmission technique.
Upon hearing Bai Ye's voice transmission, Lu Shen's face showed a flicker of surprise. After pondering for a moment, he nodded, "Elder Bai makes a strong case. Since you vouch for him so strongly, let it be this Fellow Daoist."
On hearing this, the other three cultivators' expressions varied, some showing disdain, some surprise, and one with a probing look in his eyes.
However, since there was still one spot remaining, they seemed to have no intention of competing fiercely with Yuan Ming. Seeing that Lu Shen said no more, they left the room and followed him out.
Once the others had left, Yuan Ming greeted Bai Ye with a cupped fist salute: "Fellow Daoist Bai Ye, long time no see."
"It's unexpected to meet here after our parting in the Southern Border. Are you also residing in Little Lake City now?" Bai Ye replied with a smile.
"Yes, after the affairs at Biluo Cave were concluded, I wandered here and found this place peaceful and suitable for my cultivation. Are you a member of Shengye Sect, Bai Fellow Daoist? Why do they call you an Elder?" Yuan Ming asked, puzzled.
"Hehe, my sect has always had a friendly relationship with Shengye Sect. The disciple training each year is often jointly held by both sects. I am now barely serving as an elder in my sect, dealing with such minor matters," said Bai Ye modestly.
"I see. This is also my first time undertaking such a task. Is there anything special I should be cautious about?" Yuan Ming nodded and asked.
"Actually, you needn't worry too much. Despite what Elder Lu said, the places selected for disciples' training each year are not truly dangerous. We Foundation Establishment cultivators accompany them covertly, merely as a precaution. It's rare that we need to take action," Bai Ye waved his hand dismissively.
Yuan Ming nodded understandingly. Afterwards, they chatted idly for a while, exchanging information about their experiences and sights in various places over the years.
Time passed quickly, and before long, Lu Shen returned to the room with the selected cultivator.
"This Fellow Daoist is called He Wendao, who is particularly skilled in Earth Techniques. His use of the Earth Escape Skill is nothing short of masterful, making him extremely suitable for protecting disciples," Lu Shen introduced.
He Wendao was not very old, with a clean-shaven face, appearing rather delicate, and seemed to be at the Mid-stage Foundation Establishment.
Upon hearing Lu Shen introduce him, he quickly greeted Yuan Ming and Bai Ye with a cupped fist, acknowledging their acquaintance.
Seeing this, Lu Shen turned to Yuan Ming: "I wonder what spells Fellow Daoist Hagon specializes in?"
"I have some understanding of Beast Taming," Yuan Ming said, half-truthfully.

chapters.title: Chapter 292 - 269: Parade
chapters.content:
Lu Shen nodded slightly but did not ask Yuan Ming to demonstrate. He continued, "There are three days left until the sect disciples depart for their training. If you two have no other plans, how about returning to Shengye Sect with me for a few days and then setting off together? What do you think?"
Yuan Ming had nothing else going on, so he did not refuse, and He Wendao did the same.
The four of them then left the room and walked downstairs. Just as they reached the bottom of the stairs, Yuan Ming looked up and suddenly paused.
At the entrance of the Loose Cultivation Association, three Foundation Establishment cultivators arrived together, clad in Chang Chun Temple robes, their faces full of arrogance. They looked at other cultivators with a touch of disdain in their eyes.
"People from Chang Chun Temple? What are they doing here?" Lu Shen caught sight of the trio and could not help frowning.
However, the three from Chang Chun Temple did not notice Yuan Ming and the others coming down from the upstairs. They walked directly into the mission hall, looked around, and then the one in the center channeled his Spiritual Power and loudly announced,
"I, Xu Changqing of Chang Chun Temple, a Foundation Establishment cultivator, was murdered near Little Lake City. Whoever can provide clues or information about the murderer will receive a reward of one thousand spirit stones!"
As soon as his words fell, the mission hall instantly erupted into commotion.
Some, not understanding, turned to their companions. "Who is Xu Changqing? Have you heard of him?"
Others, shocked, exclaimed, "Someone dared kill a person from Chang Chun Temple? Are they tired of living?"
Still others muttered in displeasure, "A reward? Hah, Chang Chun Temple really knows how to throw its weight around, asking us for information as if it is doling out alms!"
Among the crowd, Yuan Ming's face remained expressionless. He firmly observed the three from Chang Chun Temple for a few moments, memorizing their features, before he shifted his gaze away.
"Chang Chun Temple's people don't even pick a good place to die. Is this just an excuse? We'd better rush back and inform our sect quickly lest this fire burns us too…" Lu Shen's brows were tightly knit. He turned his head, called out, and quickly walked towards the exit of the Loose Cultivation Association.
Yuan Ming and the others silently followed, and soon, they left the Loose Cultivation Association, leaving the tumult behind.
...
Three days later, Shengye Sect.
Today was the first day of the annual Qi Refinement disciple training. Early in the morning, all the registered disciples gathered at the sect's plaza.
Daily cultivation was dull and tedious, making the rare chance to venture out in broad daylight exciting for many young disciples. Right now, their faces were filled with impatience.
Older ones, however, kept their eyes on the rankings of the training. While not as generous as the sect's main competition held every three years, achieving results in the training could not only secure numerous cultivation resources but might also attract the attention of the sect's elders, skyrocketing one's status.
Of course, for the students personally taught by the elders, rankings didn't matter much. What truly mattered were those who would be their rivals in future major sect competitions.
For Xu Tian, however, what really troubled him was his junior sister.
"Xing'er, listen closely. Stick with me once we're out there, absolutely don't wander off, and consult with me about anything that comes up. Did you understand?" Xu Tian held Luo Xing'er's hand, repeatedly instructing her.
He was at the sixth-tier Qi Refining level, while Luo Xing'er was somewhat lower, at the Qi Refining Fourth Level.
"Alright, alright, I got it. Brother, you really can nag," Luo Xing'er pouted, a small face puffing up in slight annoyance.
Seeing this, Xu Tian sighed deeply. He wanted to say more, but at that moment, Luo Xing'er grasped his hand excitedly and started shaking it.
"Brother, look, look, it's Elder Lu! He is a Great Cultivator at the late stage of Foundation Establishment. I wonder when I'll reach such Cultivation." Luo Xing'er spoke with envy.
"As long as we cultivate diligently and put in the hard work, that day will eventually come," Xu Tian replied upon hearing her words.
"Oh, then Young Master Yuan is so formidable because he cultivated the same way?" Luo Xing'er turned to look at him.
Xu Tian was somewhat speechless but managed to assert, "Naturally."
Meanwhile, Lu Shen stood on the temporarily erected platform, his stern gaze sweeping over the disciples below. The plaza, which had been quite noisy moments earlier, quickly fell silent.
"All of you have managed to stand out from the mundane and enter our Shengye Sect, which in itself is no small feat. After enduring the harsh discipline of our sect for a long time, today…" facing the multitude of disciples, he started a lengthy speech, discussing the difficulties of Cultivation and drawing parallels to life's broader challenges, quoting extensively, his words flowing like a river without end.
Some of the older disciples below, prepared for this, had sealed their hearing with Spiritual Power in advance, while those experiencing this for the first time listened with rapt attention at first but gradually got confused and overwhelmed as the speech went on.
After more than half an hour, Lu Shen finally concluded his speech, his eyes filled with expectation as he looked over the Qi Refining disciples in the plaza.
After scanning the crowd, he summoned the sect's specially crafted giant Green Wood Flying Boat, instructing the disciples below to board one by one.
Seeing this situation, the disciples breathed a sigh of relief and hurried onto the Green Wood Flying Boat without any delay, fearing that Lu Shen might suddenly decide to add a few more points.
Soon, all the disciples had boarded the Green Wood Flying Boat one after another. Lu Shen then jumped onto the bow of the boat, inserted a few mid-grade spirit stones into the array on the deck, activated the array, and the Green Wood Flying Boat rose into the air, slowly flying away from the sect.
In a storeroom above the Green Wood Flying Boat, Yuan Ming, who had been meditating cross-legged, also opened his eyes and secretly released a soul crow, which now flew in the sky, guarding the flying boat as it moved forward.Love this story? Show support at *.
...
Zhao Country, Yunluo Mountain Range.
The continuous, rolling mountains towered over the land, the peaks piercing into the clouds as if trying to break through the sky, while the misty clouds clung to the ridges like river water, slowly drifting down and eventually dissipating among the dense woods.
Even in the mountainous Zhao Country, this place was considered magnificent. Unfortunately, the spirit veins here were scattered and disordered, capable of nurturing many exotic beasts and spiritual medicines but unsuitable for a sect to establish a base.
In the sky, the Green Wood Flying Boat cut through the mist and slowly landed in a clearing among the trees.
The disciples streamed out of the flying boat, assembling on the clearing, while Lu Shen, who had been in charge of piloting the boat, now also stood by the side and looked at the disciples.
"This place is the venue for this trial. In the next five days, you may freely search for spiritual medicines here, but you must not travel more than fifty miles away from the flying boat, or else your trial results will be deemed invalid. Moreover, the trial ends at noon five days from now; those who fail to return on time will also be considered as having failed," Lu Shen announced the rules of the trial as he surveyed the disciples.
Then he waved his hand, and immediately disciples responsible for tallying scores and miscellaneous tasks stepped forward and distributed a jade scroll to each disciple.
"If you encounter a dangerous situation during the trial, you may crush the jade scroll at any time. At that point, I and a few other fellow daoists will immediately come to your aid. Although this action will disqualify you early, I would rather you prioritize your lives over your scores. The principle of 'Surviving to fight another day' should be clear without further explanation." Lu Shen sternly admonished.
All the disciples loudly acknowledged, then dispersed on their own.
Lu Shen turned and returned to the top of the flying boat, where Yuan Ming and two others had already gathered, seeing Lu Shen return, Bai Ye spoke.
"Elder Lu, I have already given the artifacts that can detect the location of the jade scrolls to the two fellow daoists," Bai Ye said.
"Good, the next five days will be trying for you. Although the elders of the sect have already checked this area beforehand, to avoid accidents, please remain vigilant. If you encounter any special circumstances that require support, you may also activate the artifact, so that the others will also receive the message," Lu Shen nodded and said.
Afterward, the four of them left on their designated flying artifacts according to the areas previously assigned and left the flying boat.
After leaving the flying boat, Yuan Ming found a secluded place, took Hua Zhi out of the spiritual beast bag, and as usual, commanded him to burrow underground and follow, before once again mounting the flying shuttle to patrol his designated area.
...
Three days later.
In the dense forest, a giant python with wrinkled skin, about a zhang long, coiled around an ancient tree, its brownish exterior blending perfectly with the branches, making any observer none the wiser.
At the treetops, several fist-sized fruits swayed in the wind, many of which were green tinged with orange, indicating they were nearing ripeness.
Near the python, two fruits had completely shed their green skin, and sunlight filtered through the leaves, making the bright orange fruits glow.
Suddenly, not far away, a young man in a light green robe emerged, looking up at the fruits on the tree, and was momentarily stunned before showing an expression of surprise.
But he was not hasty. Instead, he carefully circled the ancient tree twice, then took out a small bell magic artifact about the size of his palm and activated it with mana, giving it a shake.
Sound waves rippled out, sweeping over the ancient tree. The giant python resting on the branch was disturbed by this and shifted its body slightly in displeasure.
However, the cultivator below mistook the movement of the python for the swaying of the branches and was not alarmed by it.
Seeing no demon beasts lurking nearby, his eyes filled with an even stronger joy, then he took out a long sword magic artifact and controlled it to fly up to the treetops, intending to cut down the fruits.
This action thoroughly infuriated the python. The previously sluggish creature raised its tail instantly, then swept it across like a blade, knocking the flying sword away in one swift motion.
Seeing this, the disciple from the Shengye Sect turned pale and immediately turned to flee, but the python was not willing to let him go. It loosened its coiled body around the branches, and its snake head crossed several meters in an instant to appear in front of the Shengye Sect disciple.
As the python stared at the panicked disciple of the Shengye Sect, its golden snake pupils dilated, its massive jaws opened, and it lunged at him.
In that critical moment, the disciple of the Shengye Sect fumbled out his jade scroll and snapped it in half, the stench from the python's mouth blowing in his face as it closed in, blanking out his mind.
However, just at that moment, the python's head suddenly burst with a small hole and it died midair.

chapters.title: Chapter 293 - 270: Plotting
chapters.content:
The disciple from Shengye Sect, spared from the catastrophe, collapsed onto the ground, panting heavily. Just as fear was starting to take hold in his heart, he suddenly heard a clear voice.
"The danger has been removed. Since you have crushed the Jade Scroll, you should hurry back to the Flying Boat and not linger in the woods."
"Ah, yes, the disciple understands. Thank you, senior, for saving my life," the disciple from Shengye Sect regained his composure and hastily bowed in the direction of no one in particular.
Although he received no response, he did not dare stay any longer and quickly left the area. Behind him, a dark purple vine slowly writhed, soon sucking a giant python dry into a mummy.
In midair, Yuan Ming, piloting the Jade Shuttle, sent a soul crow to follow the disciple, shaking his head with a hint of emotion.
Over the past three days, he had already rescued seven disciples from the Shengye Sect. Many of them, like the one just now, let their guard down due to the allure of rare spiritual medicines and ignored the dangers around them.
These disciples from Shengye Sect were all officially admitted into the sect after passing the Sect's trials and the Spirit Root test. Since stepping onto the Immortal Path, they had always been cared for by masters and elders, knowing the dangers of the Cultivation World only through hearsay without any real experience.
Because their sect excelled in alchemy, they had abundant resources. Whether it was cultivation techniques, magic artifacts, or elixirs, these disciples lacked for nothing except actual combat experience. It was no wonder that they were known for not being adept at fighting.
For these disciples, their trials were like leisurely outings. During the day, they searched for herbs, and at any sign of danger, they called for an elder. At night, they set up camp, chatting and laughing, cozy and affectionate with each other.
Watching these Qi Refining disciples, Yuan Ming felt a mix of emotion and envy. When he had started on the Immortal Path, he began as a Beast Slave, fighting for his life daily in the treacherous mountains of the Southern Border, never sure if he'd see the next day, let alone experience such joyous ease.
As he reflected, Yuan Ming quickly took out a magic artifact used for locating the Jade Scroll.
The artifact was now emitting a glaring red light. Yuan Ming immediately started casting, pinpointed the location of the distress signal, and once again steered the Jade Shuttle toward that direction.
In a valley.
Amidst intermittent howls, dozens of blue-black demon wolves surrounded many Shengye Sect disciples, ceaselessly seeking opportunities to attack.
The area was crowded with most of the trial-participating disciples. Their abilities were strong, generally above the Fifth Layer of Qi Refining. Facing the onslaught of demon wolves, they coordinated well with each other and fought evenly matched.
Though the demon wolves were also Level 1 Middle Stage, their coordination was extremely impeccable. Whenever a demon wolf was gravely injured and repelled by the disciples, another would immediately fill its place.
As the disciples' mana gradually depleted, the number of demon wolves remained unchanged.
But this was not their most pressing concern.
Not far away, a Second Level demon wolf as tall as a man, its eyes gleaming eerily, swung its tail out of nowhere. Two azure Wind Blades suddenly flew towards He Wendao, who was in front of it.VisitMyVirtualLibraryEmpire(*)formore.
Seeing this, He Wendao quickly formed a hand seal, and the ground beneath him trembled. A wall of earth swiftly rose, shielding him.
The hastily formed earth wall was incredibly fragile. Though it blocked the Wind Blades, it shattered into pieces the next moment.
Amidst the flying dust, a blue-black wolf shadow lunged out from the broken fragments, charging straight at He Wendao.
He Wendao's face turned pale, with seven or eight Level 1 demon wolf corpses already lying around him, seemingly drained of much mana. Yet facing this critical situation, he did not dare to relax. With a flip of his right hand, he slammed a talisman onto the ground.
Dozens of sharp earth spikes erupted from the ground. The approaching demon wolf hastily dodged, but its skin was still torn by the spikes, causing blood to flow profusely.
But this only intensified the demon wolf's ferocity. It halted its charge, its forepaws digging into the ground, its back arching as it lowered its head slightly before violently raising it, baring its bloody jaws as a piercing howl instantly echoed through the valley.
As the sound waves vibrated, the earth spikes emerging from the ground shattered one by one, and He Wendao's vision darkened, his footing becoming unsteady.
Gleam flashing in the demon wolf's eyes, it pushed off with its four limbs, soaring high into the air, and pounced toward He Wendao.
At that moment, a vine-like figure dropped from the sky. Numerous dark purple vines swiftly extended, intertwining to form a large net that intercepted the demon wolf.
Yuan Ming, piloting the Flying Shuttle, arrived just in time. As the Hua Zhi intercepted the demon wolf, he also jumped off the Flying Shuttle.
"Are you alright?" Yuan Ming asked with concern.
"Thank you, Fellow Daoist Hagon, for your help," He Wendao steadied his head and bowed to Yuan Ming.
"It's nothing. Elder Lu and the others have arrived; this place should be safe now," Yuan Ming said.
As he conversed with He Wendao, two streaks of light flew across the sky.
Yuan Ming looked up and saw Bai Ye and Lu Shen had also arrived. He simply instructed Hua Zhi to exert itself and did not summon his magic artifacts to fight at full strength.
The demon wolf was no match for Hua Zhi, and with the addition of two Foundation Establishment cultivators into the fray, it was quickly defeated, its head twisted off by Hua Zhi in death.
