"Fellow Daoist He, how did you end up in such a sorry state?" Lu Shen jumped down from the Flying Artifact, frowning as he looked toward He Wendao.
"When I arrived, I only saw disciples of your Sect being attacked by a pack of wolves. I had just dealt with a few when unexpectedly another Second Level demon wolf lurking in the shadows caught me off guard, and I got a bit injured. I am ashamed," He Wendao said with a bitter smile.
At this point, Bai Ye also helped the other Shengye Sect disciples deal with the remaining Level 1 demon wolves, leading them over.
"How did you all get in here?" Lu Shen asked.
"Reporting to the elder, yesterday, the disciple accidentally discovered an injured demon wolf. While pursuing it, I inadvertently entered this place and found several Wind Orchids deep in the valley. Since there were quite a few demon wolves guarding outside at that time, the disciple stealthily retreated, and later gathered other fellow disciples, intending to eliminate the demon wolves together. However, for some reason, the number of demon wolves today seems to be twice as many as what the disciple had seen," Xu Tian, his face filled with bitterness, explained to Lu Shen.
"Wind Orchids? These are high-level Spirit Grasses rarely encountered once in hundreds of years, not just one but several. Are you sure you didn't see it wrong?" Lu Shen, startled, asked in surprise.
"This disciple assures there's no falsehood," Xu Tian guaranteed.
After pondering for a moment, Lu Shen asked Xu Tian to lead the way to the place where the Wind Orchids grow, with the rest of the disciples following behind.
The group then delved deeper into the valley and soon, in a depression deep in the valley, saw seven or eight small flowers emitting a faint silver glow.
Lu Shen's face showed delight as he quickly walked towards the Spiritual Medicine.
He Wendao and Bai Ye also followed closely behind him, the former's eyes widening slightly, an expression of amazed admiration on his face.
As for Xu Tian and other disciples, they stayed outside the depression, not daring to approach without Lu Shen's command.
"Fellow Daoist Hagon, aren't you coming over to take a look? This is the Wind Orchid, a high-level Spiritual Grass rarely seen in hundreds of years," He Wendao turned his head toward Yuan Ming, who was standing not far away, and asked.
"Hagon, come and look at the Wind Orchids, we're in luck. This is one of the primary ingredients for making Foundation Establishment Pills, can't believe we found it here," Bai Ye then said.
Driven by curiosity, Yuan Ming walked over and, still two to three dozen yards away from the Wind Orchids and leveraging the superior Divine Power of a Soul Cultivator, detected something unusual about this Wind Orchid.
The wave of Spiritual Power from this Wind Orchid wasn't emanating from the plant itself but from beneath the ground, with a clear and steady rhythm. Could it be that this flower's root system was different, possessing especially strong Spiritual Energy?
"Who was the first to find the Wind Orchid? We must reward them greatly once we return to the Sect. The main materials for Foundation Establishment Pills are becoming increasingly scarce," said Lu Shen, reaching out toward one of the Spiritual Medicines as he spoke.
At that moment, Yuan Ming suddenly felt a faint gust of wind at his side, and out of the corner of his eye, he spotted He Wendao, who had been just behind him, now transforming into a blur as he swiftly moved away.
"It's a trap!" Yuan Ming immediately roared.
As he shouted the warning, he quickly retreated backward, simultaneously calling for Hua Zhi to come to his aid.
However, it was ultimately too late.
Just as Elder Lu Shen, his face full of surprise, grasped the Wind Orchid, the Spiritual Medicine instantly turned into specks of flying ash and disappeared, with the other surrounding Spiritual Medicines vanishing as well.
At the same time, the ground trembled slightly, and streaks of turquoise lightning surged from beneath the earth, forming a Thunder Array about ten yards across that surrounded the three of them.
Despite Yuan Ming's swift reaction, he ultimately couldn't escape the perimeter of the Array. As he tried to exit, a rising net of electricity blocked him, and he was struck by a flash of lightning from a Thunderbolt Whip before he could get close.
With a "crack,"
Yuan Ming hastily activated the Snake Scale Soft Armor for defense.
After a burst of electric sparks, Yuan Ming was thrown back, his chest clothing scorched and torn, revealing the Snake Scale Soft Armor underneath.
Looking at Yuan Ming and others trapped in the center of the depression by the Thunder Array, some of the Shengye Sect disciples standing outside turned pale with fear, many scrambling and rolling as they ran towards the valley exit, while only a few disciples like Xu Tian and Luo Xing'er remained, some panicking uncontrollably, others too shocked to rise.
Xu Tian nervously watched the Array in the depression, tightly holding Luo Xing'er's hand, equally at a loss.
"What's going on?" Bai Ye scanned the surroundings, and noticing that He Wendao was nowhere to be seen, he exclaimed in surprise.
"We've been set up. The Wind Orchids were illusory bait created by an Illusion Technique, and the earlier demon beast was purposely used to lure us here. There's something wrong with He Wendao; we've walked into an ambush," Yuan Ming quickly explained as he got up.
"A mere Array thinking to trap me?" Elder Lu declared. He formed hand seals with one hand and slammed the other onto the ground. From his palm, a circle of earthy yellow halo lit up, rippling outward in all directions like water waves.
As the halo expanded, the ground began to tremble violently, as if a massive force was spreading from beneath, aiming to directly destroy the base stones of the Array buried deep under. When the yellow halo reached the boundary of the Array, the ground trembled violently once more.

chapters.title: Chapter 294 - 271 Trapped
chapters.content:
However, after the great earthquake, the Thunder Array didn't show any signs of collapse.
Instead, the array, inverted like a giant bowl of green light, roared like an enraged beast, emitting a thunderous bellow.
"Zzzzzzz"
Streaks of lightning burst forth from the array, transforming into several green thunder whips, lashing towards Yuan Ming and the two in the pit.
Yuan Ming hastily drew out his Cold Star Sword to wield in defense.
Elder Lu Shen pressed his hands against the ground, and as he rose, three earth walls sprung up around him, blocking the electrical whips.
Bai Ye also summoned a golden longsword that circled around him for protection.
After a round of thunder whip lashes, the lightning slowly stabilized again.
"Elder Lu Shen, how are you, are you all right?" He Wendao called out anxiously from outside, unable to see through the intense lightning.
"It's just a trapping array, I can break it with a wave of my hand," said Lu Shen as he exchanged glances with Yuan Ming and Bai Ye, snorting coldly.
"Fellow Daoist Bai Ye, can you discern the foundation of this array?" Yuan Ming asked, moving closer to Bai Ye.
"I don't recognize it—it seems not so easy to break. Did you just say there's something wrong with He Wendao?" Bai Ye shook his head, replying softly.
"His performance when facing the Second-level Demon Beast, and his timely retreat from the range of this trapping array, were both very abnormal," Yuan Ming said.
Upon hearing this, Bai Ye's expression immediately became even more complex.
Meanwhile, as the two of them conversed in whispers, Elder Lu Shen took out a Vajra Pestle as thick as a child's arm, its entire body a dark yellow color, shrouded in a hazy glow.
Elder Lu Shen held the Vajra Pestle in both hands, mana surging into his palms. The once-dull pestle suddenly shone brightly, emitting strong Earth Attribute mana fluctuations.
"Break!"
Elder Lu Shen roared and, with both hands gripping the Vajra Pestle, he violently smashed it into the ground.
With a thunderous landing, an even grander yellow light burst from the pestle, triggering the force of mountain collapses in an attempt to destroy the array beneath the ground.
Centered around Lu Shen, the ground shattered under this force, throwing up clouds of dust and debris.
Yuan Ming and Bai Ye were both affected, each conjuring their magical tools to defend themselves.
Through the rolling dust, the entire area within the array was left without a single inch of unscathed soil, as if churned by a plow.
Yet, beyond the array, there was absolutely no sign of damage.
Before the dust had fully cleared, the roars of thunder were heard once more, and thick as bowls, columns of lightning suddenly shot in from all sides, scattering the dust with their fierce glow, and striking Yuan Ming and his companions.
"Be careful," Yuan Ming quickly warned.
As he spoke, he raised his hand sharply, and a black inkstone flew out, rapidly enlarging to hover above his head, shielding him from the falling thunder columns.
After Bai Ye blocked the first thunder column, he was hit by a second one that followed closely, and was sent flying, half of his body scorched black, emitting wisps of smoke, obviously injuried.
Elder Lu Shen summoned a shining round mirror, managing to deflect the blasts from the thunder columns, but the surface of the mirror was severely damaged, half-ruined.
And the Great Array, far from showing any signs of damage, now had even more dense lightning than before.
"Elder Lu Shen, how are you?" the anxious voice of He Wendao came from outside.
"Strange, even with the full force of my top-grade magical tool, the Earth Burying Mallet, I can't cause any damage," Elder Lu Shen paused thoughtfully, then said.
"Perhaps Elder Lu's so-called Earth Burying Mallet isn't as potent as its reputation suggests. Why don't the three of you try working together? You might be able to break it with combined efforts," suggested He Wendao from outside upon hearing this.
Upon hearing this, Elder Lu Shen glanced at Yuan Ming and the fallen Bai Ye.Content sourced from * – My Virtual Library Empire.
It took Bai Ye a while to stand up from the ground, and after coughing once, he turned his gaze to Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming suddenly spoke up, "Fellow Daoist He, go ahead, what's your condition? We can talk."
"No, no, no, you misunderstand. How about this, you all act simultaneously, attack the array together, and maybe it will work," He Wendao replied with a slight smile, then continued.
Seeing that He Wendao didn't state any terms, Yuan Ming realized the situation and shouted to the Shengye Sect disciples gathered in the distance, "Disciples of the Shengye Sect, listen! He Wendao is a spy; you must scatter and flee this place immediately, and do not return."
The disciples in the distance were bewildered, looking at each other, none of them moved.
"We won't leave, we must rescue our seniors," declared Xu Tian loudly.
"Right, Senior Brother Xu, we won't go," Luo Xing'er added.
The other disciples were even more perplexed, unsure of what to do.
Yuan Ming rebuked Xu Tian, "Xu Tian, your grandmother personally arranged for me to protect you, trust me. If you survive and return, tell your Aunt Qu Jiang that Ming'er failed to fulfill his filial duties. Leave immediately."
At Yuan Ming's words, Xu Tian's body shook, and he quickly realized who the Hagon trapped in the valley thunder array was. Luo Xing'er stared at Yuan Ming, incredulous.
Elder Lu Shen showed a flash of surprise in his eyes but quickly snapped back to reality.
"Shengye Sect disciples, heed my command, disperse and escape from this place immediately, anyone who disobeys will be treated as a traitor to the sect," Elder Lu Shen bellowed.
Upon hearing his command, the dozen or so Shengye Sect disciples scattered and fled in all directions.
Xu Tian gritted his teeth, grabbed Luo Xing'er, took out a talisman and slapped it, and with a flash of yellow light, they both disappeared underground.
Seeing this, He Wendao waved one hand, and a flying sword shot out from his sleeve, aiming at the escaping disciples. In an instant, several were injured and fell to the ground, but fortunately, most of the disciples had dispersed and still managed to flee the valley.
"Stop!" Elder Lu Shen's eyes were about to split with fury.
"He Wendao, accumulate some virtue for once," Yuan Ming said with a cold sneer.
"It would've been nice if you had cooperated a bit more. So many small fish slipped through the net, what a pity," He Wendao said, no longer pursuing the fleeing disciples, but walking to the edge of the Array with a gentle smile on his face.
"You're not alone, are you?" Yuan Ming asked.
"Trying to buy time is pointless, resign yourself to your fate, all of you are going to die here today," He Wendao said with a smile as he looked at Yuan Ming.
"The cultivators who mysteriously perished recently around Little Lake City, were they all lured and killed by you using methods like this?" Yuan Ming asked.
"You're giving them too much credit, they're not worth the effort on my part. You should feel honored," He Wendao responded.
"He Wendao, why are you doing this?" Elder Lu Shen shouted furiously.
"Elder Lu Shen's question reveals ignorance, doesn't it? It's normal in the Immortal Path of cultivation to kill for treasure, the virtuous will claim it. Why make such a big fuss?" He Wendao sneered in response.
"You…" Elder Lu Shen was momentarily at a loss for words.
"Where's your accomplice? They should be coming out by now, right?" sneered Yuan Ming, a mocking smile curling at the corner of his mouth.
Before the words had finished, two figures approached from the direction of the distant valley mouth.
One was a cold-looking young man in white, with pale skin and a white eagle perched on his shoulder.
The other was a tall, bald man, stout as a tower, his muscles defined as if carved by knives and axes, carrying a bronze giant sword that was one foot wide and five feet long on his back, exuding a sense of immense pressure.
"Fellow Daoist He, you've worked hard. This haul isn't bad, three Foundation Establishment Cultivators, plus a bunch of Qi Refinement Realm ones, enough for us to rest for some time," the young man in white laughed heartily.
"It's all thanks to Brother Sha Hao's exquisite Illusion Technique," He Wendao said. "Has the Flying Boat been stopped?"
"We were one step too late, as soon as the Array here was activated, the Flying Boat probably received Elder Lu Shen's transmission message and fled," said Sha Hao.
"So it fled, no matter. It doesn't affect Pu Zhengqing's illustrious reputation. Your bounty is going up," He Wendao laughed.
Upon hearing the names "Sha Hao" and "Pu Zhengqing," Yuan Ming was slightly startled.
Although he had never met this person, he knew the name. With a little thought about the previously encountered Illusion Technique, his identity wasn't hard to confirm.
When Biluo Cave fell, what was found in the Storage Ring of the Great Elder Xi Cangqiong didn't match up to his stature as a Sect Master.
As the direct disciple of Xi Cangqiong, Sha Hao, who had disappeared, was naturally the most likely person to inherit his legacy.
This also meant that the Soul Cultivator who was recently sponsored by the Loose Cultivation Association of Little Lake City with a bounty of one hundred thousand Spirit Stones was also his alias, and the earlier Illusion Technique came from his hand as well.
"It's a bit dull that there is no bounty on me to this day," the tower-like giant, who had a resonant voice, said at that moment.
"You can't be compared with Brother Sha Hao. That one called Hagon had some smarts about him, tried to negotiate terms with me, which was quite interesting," He Wendao pointed at Yuan Ming and said across the buzzing Array lights.
"Hagon? Sounds like he's from the Southern Border?" When Sha Hao heard this, he wrinkled his brows somewhat guardedly.
"Who cares where he's from? Why bother with all this fuss? Just kill him and talk later," the tower-like giant said.
"Alright! Better to avoid prolonged trouble," Sha Hao nodded in agreement and said, "Shi Dian, make your move."
"Okay." The tower-like giant named Shi Dian acknowledged, then took the bronze giant sword off his back and walked to an inconspicuous pile of rocks. He slid the sword into the crevice.
With a "sizzle" from the friction, half of the bronze giant sword sank into the ground, leaving only half exposed, the hilts embedded with a purple Spirit Stone that shone with light, pouring a continuous stream of Spiritual Power into it.
Yuan Ming's gaze sharpened, knowing that the Array Eye must be over there.
A piercing bird cry cut through the sky.
In mid-air, a black-winged bird, about a zhang in length, circled above. Shaped like a hawk, with a hooked beak and long sharp talons, its feathers were glossy black, interspersed with purple patterns—it was the Winged Bird named "Lei Yu" by Yuan Ming.
Lei Yu had just flown in from afar, and although its speed was lightning-fast, it was still too late. If it had been a little faster, perhaps it could have broken this Thunder trapping Array.
At the moment, Lei Yu dove towards the Array with its slender talons crackling with purple sparks.
"Huh?" Sha Hao exclaimed in surprise, "Go, catch it alive."
The White Eagle on Sha Hao's shoulder spread its wings and turned into a beam of white light, swiftly intercepting it. In an instant, they clashed in the air. Although Lei Yu was as fast as lightning, it was no match for the peak level 2 White Eagle, and in a blink of an eye, they disappeared into the distance.
After all, Lei Yu was still in its juvenile stage, and although it had been well cared for by Yuan Ming and trained in thunderstorm-prone areas, it was only at the strength of a level 1 demon beast. With the White Eagle and the trio of Sha Hao present, it was like a moth to a flame.
While Yuan Ming was contemplating a strategy, he suddenly looked up in alarm, only to see that in the center of the Thunder Array above their heads, a human head-sized green Thunder Ball was condensing, with lightning flashing inside and thunder roaring, containing a tremendous Spiritual Pressure.

chapters.title: Chapter 295 - 272 "Thank You
chapters.content:
"Be careful."
As Yuan Ming uttered the warning, he had already maneuvered the black inkstone to block the attack from above once more.
The next moment, a streak of lightning suddenly burst with a loud crack.
The green Thunder Ball exploded, lighting up a dazzling green flash, and three green Thunder Spears shot out, aiming at Yuan Ming and the two others.
With a "boom",
the green Thunder Spears struck the black inkstone, blasting a large web of green lightning across it, with the sound of electrical arcs crackling continuously.
The black inkstone spun back and fell to the ground, its surface showing a fine crack.
Elsewhere, the three earth walls on the ground were all shattered, and behind them, Elder Lu Shen's shoulder was scorched black, his face showing fear that for the first time overcame his anger.
Bai Ye had a talisman attached to his chest, with a white protective shield surrounding him, his complexion pale.
This white protective shield, at first glance, seemed unremarkable, but upon closer inspection, its light flickered slightly, as if it was about to fail to hold up.
"We can't go on like this; the Array's offensive power is too formidable," Bai Ye said as he clutched a mid-grade Spirit Stone, channeling mana into the white protective shield.
"Let's just hold on for now," Lu Shen said somberly.
Yuan Ming was crouching on the ground, with one hand propped on the earth, a slender vine emerging from underground, touching his palm.
He had his eyes closed slightly, as if sensing something.
However, as his sensing continued, his brows furrowed deeper, and his expression became increasingly grim.
He had earlier quietly sent out Hua Zhi underground to investigate the Array's layout, hoping to use the vine's power to destabilize the Array from beneath and help them escape.
Yet, the response that Hua Zhi brought back was that there was also a thunder Barrier underground, making it impossible to touch.
...
Meanwhile, outside the Array.
"Shi Dian, make it quick. Why is the Xiao Family's Array this weak?" Sha Hao said discontentedly.
Upon hearing those words, Shi Dian's chest heaved slightly, his hands resting on his sword as he let out a fierce yell.
The next moment, a green light radiated from his body, flowing like tide water up his arms and into the bronze giant sword he held.
The patterns on the bronze giant sword lit up, and the ground within dozens of zhang from the center began to tremble; the entire Thunder Array glowed with a burst of green light and spilled over with electricity, clearly indicating that the next strike would be formidable.
Yuan Ming felt a sudden heaviness in his heart and frantically absorbed the mid-grade Spirit Stone in his hand.
"Hagon, I've doomed you!" Bai Ye exclaimed, pressing a circular Heart Protector onto his chest.
As the copper mirror protected his chest, a large amount of golden light emerged, spreading and forming a set of translucent golden armor, covering the vital parts of his body.
Lu Shen also took out a bronze small bell the size of a fist and tossed it above his head.
The bronze small bell spun above him, casting a shadow of an earthy-yellow bronze bell, enveloping Elder Lu Shen completely within it.
Outside the shadow of the bronze bell, there were also three layers of yellow earth walls, enclosing him entirely.
At this moment, they could only fend for themselves.
"Boom"
"Boom"
"Boom"
Three consecutive thunderous blasts rang out as three thick green Light Pillars fell straight down from above the Array, smashing towards Lu Shen, Bai Ye, and Yuan Ming respectively.
Lu Shen, hiding behind layers of Earth Element walls, could not escape being penetrated by the green lightning; the bronze small bell, meant for protection, rang once before bursting apart.
Bai Ye's golden armor fared no better, also being shattered, and the Heart Protector at his chest broke, the golden armor scattering like sparks.
Yuan Ming defended with one hand holding up the black inkstone, while dense vines surged from the ground in front of him, forming several layers of vine armor to barely meet the Light Pillar.
With a "boom",
the moment the green Light Pillar hit the black inkstone, the already overwhelmed inkstone burst into countless black crystal powder fragments, exploding.
The green Light Pillar shrank slightly, but continued to pierce down, landing on the Purple-black Vine Shield.
The first layer of the Vine Shield barely resisted before turning to ash, and the green Light Pillar shrank a bit more,
the second layer held up slightly longer but was also torn by the green light, and the Light Pillar shrank yet again,
the third layer of the Vine Shield held up even longer, but it too couldn't withstand the pressure…
"Thank you!" Yuan Ming used the Communication Talisman from Xi Ying for the first time!
As the layers of vine shields were penetrated one by one, the green Light Pillar was rapidly depleted.
But in the end, the cyan light pillar still fell upon Yuan Ming, accompanied by a series of crackling sounds, enveloping his entire being.
In the midst of the Thunder Array, the three individuals, despite deploying their most powerful defensive techniques, all fell to the ground under this barrage of Thunder Strikes, turned into three charred human figures.
Thunder Skill attacks are renowned in the Cultivation World for surpassing Fire Techniques, rightfully earning the title of the most formidable offensive power, and the enhancement from the Array made it overwhelmingly mighty, an unstoppable force by mere mortals!
After this attack, the Thunder Array itself seemed to have exhausted most of its strength, becoming dim and maintaining only its most basic form.
Shi Dian, the man who operated the Array, now had a gaunt look with his cheeks sunken in. He looked as if half of his life force had been drained, lacking the domineering presence he had earlier.
He let go of the bronze giant sword and barely managed to sit on the ground. Without a word, he took out an elixir, consumed it, and started to recover through Breathing Control.
"Are they all dead?" After a long while, He Wendao tentatively asked.
"Shut up, who could possibly survive that?" Shi Dian suddenly opened his eyes wide and snapped back, angered.
"I've always believed in Brother Shi's abilities. You have played the most crucial role this time, and with the treasures we've obtained, you can choose one first. Wrap up the Array, and you should rest for a while," He Wendao immediately said with a smile.
"That's more like it!" Shi Dian snorted, then stood up and walked towards the pile of rocks. He pulled the bronze giant sword out of the ground, where the Thunder Attribute Spirit Stone embedded in the hilt had disappeared. Shi Dian shook his head in regret.
He then walked over to a corner, bent down and reached for the ground. In just a moment, he pulled out a cyan engraved copper pillar the thickness of an arm and three feet long from the earth and put it into his storage ring. In a certain order, he extracted seven identical pillars from the ground, dismantling the entire Array, and then sat down to recover.
Sha Hao released his Divine Sense to investigate and nodded, saying, "I can no longer sense any Spiritual Power fluctuations from those three."
He Wendao circled around the charred corpses of Yuan Ming and the other two.
"Brother Shi, the Bronze Thunder Pattern Array that you reluctantly sought from the Xiao Family after traveling thousands of miles from the Southern Border is indeed powerful. However, it's too troublesome to set up and consumes too much Spirit Stones. With such a huge consumption, if it weren't for killing three at the Foundation Establishment Stage in one go, we'd end up making a loss rather than a profit..." He Wendao said, shaking his head back and forth.
While speaking, he moved forward to take off the Storage Ring from Bai Ye's hand and then reached into his chest to pull out a Storage Bag.
He couldn't just take it for himself in front of both Sha Hao and Shi Dian, so he held it in his hand and went on to take Elder Lu Shen's Storage Ring as well.
"You old fool, acting all high and mighty in front of me. You must have quite a few elixirs, right?" As he spoke, He Wendao spat out a mouthful of saliva and couldn't resist kicking Elder Lu Shen's body.
After that, he finally turned towards Yuan Ming.
Among these three individuals, the weakest was this "Hagon", who had previously been exempted from the strength test recommended by Bai Ye, much to He Wendao's dissatisfaction. Now being the last one to deal with, naturally, he thought about taking his belongings and destroying his body along with it.
"Pah, impostor of the Southern Border People," He Wendao muttered as he approached Yuan Ming.
Soon after, he bent down and removed the storage ring from Yuan Ming's charred finger.
Just as he was about to inspect the contents of the ring, a shiver ran through his heart.
At the same time, Sha Hao also noticed a sudden surge of intense mana fluctuations emanating from Yuan Ming's body.
He had just thought to warn out loud when he felt a chill on the back of his neck. Quickly dodging, he twisted around to look.
He saw a slender shadow flash in the void, then vanish without a trace.
When he looked back towards He Wendao, he could only see Yuan Ming with a short dagger in his hand, the color of peacock tail feathers, plunged into his chest.
He Wendao had not even managed to release his Protective Treasure Light before his heart was pierced through.
Blood gushed from He Wendao's chest, and before he could utter a word, the blood turned black, and his life force dissipated rapidly.Kееp us gоing by rеаding оn МV_LЕМ_РYR.
Sha Hao frowned and murmured, "Faked death!"
It was apparent to him that He Wendao was beyond help, but he couldn't understand how Yuan Ming had so perfectly concealed his mana fluctuations and even the breath of life to feign death.
Before he could figure it out, Yuan Ming had already flung He Wendao's corpse aside, taken all the storage magic tools he had collected and his own storage ring back. At the same time, the charred parts of his body peeled off, revealing something similar to sawdust.
In the next moment, using Shadowless Step with the Cold Star Sword in hand, Yuan Ming charged towards Sha Hao.
During that last strike of Thunder, at the very last moment, Hua Zhi had abandoned most of its body to form a Vine Shield that covered Yuan Ming entirely, isolating the Thunder and bearing the final attack, allowing him to escape death.
He had also pushed the Hidden Element Technique to its limit at the last moment, completely concealing his mana breath and creating an illusion of death.
Seeing Yuan Ming's approach, Sha Hao furrowed his brows and waved his hand lightly in front of him. The space in front of him rippled as if water was disturbed, flickering slightly.
But as he made the move, his brows furrowed suddenly, his face changing color instantly, and he alerted the towering figure of Shi Dian, "Be careful, he's coming for you."
As he shouted, he swiftly tapped the ground with the tip of his foot, lunging directly towards Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming, as if "cooperating" with his words, indeed turned halfway through his charge and twisted his body, rushing towards Shi Dian.
Shi Dian stopped his Breathing Control, grabbed the bronze giant sword, and took a large step forward, leaping towards the oncoming Yuan Ming.
As he swung the giant sword around, three ancient runes lit up on its blade, followed by a crackling of electric light covering the entire sword.
The bronze giant sword, now enveloped in cyan Thunder, turned into a six-foot-long Thunder Light Pillar and slashed down upon Yuan Ming.
This shift in offensive and defensive maneuvers placed Yuan Ming between a rock and a hard place, turning from attacker to being sandwiched between Shi Dian in front and Sha Hao's pursuit from behind.
Just when he was about to clash with Shi Dian, Yuan Ming suddenly came to a halt, twisted sharply, and cast his arm towards Sha Hao behind him, throwing the Short Jade Dagger in his direction.
The dagger shot out like a wisp of ghostly light, while Yuan Ming's back was left wide open, seemingly content to meet Shi Dian's giant sword head-on with his flesh and blood.

chapters.title: Chapter 296 - 273 Escape
chapters.content:
"Die."
Shi Dian, suspended in mid-air, was delighted upon seeing this, and, with all his strength mustered in his arms, he fiercely brought down the giant sword wrapped in thunder light towards Yuan Ming's back, intending to cleave Yuan Ming in two.
However, faced with his attack, Yuan Ming still didn't turn around. Instead, with a flex and flick of his fingers, the Cold Star Sword transformed into a streak of white light and shot out, also aiming for Sha Hao.
Just as the pillar of thunder was about to strike, a gigantic shadow suddenly appeared behind Yuan Ming.
It was the White Ape King Kong!
The King Kong opened its mouth in a roaring gesture, its robust arms meeting the green thunder light as the palms turned gold in an instant, grabbing the blade edge of the descending giant sword.
The next instant, "crackle and pop" noises filled the air.
Countless green lightning bolts danced in the White Ape's palms, sending out dense electric arcs that easily tore through the golden glow of the Vajra's hands and blackened its palms with electricity.
The towering body of the White Ape trembled incessantly, but it refused to let go, no matter how hard Shi Dian tried, he couldn't break free from the White Ape's grip.
Shi Dian's face showed shock. His Thunder Pattern Greatsword was an extremely rare, thunder attribute, upper-grade magical tool. Past enemies, regardless of their cultivation, would lose the ability to move if struck by the green thunder emitted by this sword, yet this White Ape was able to withstand it!
Just as he intended to increase the power of the green thunder of the giant sword, two sturdy golden arms grew out from the King Kong's back—with blade-like claws reaching for Shi Dian's chest and abdomen.
Shi Dian hastily let go of the giant sword and retreated, but he still sustained two deep, bone-visible wounds on his chest and abdomen.
Narrowly escaping death, Shi Dian tried to retreat further to cast spells and heal his injuries, only to find that a few steps later the ground beneath him suddenly split open. Several vine whips sprang out like venomous snakes, instantly wrapping around his legs—it was Hua Zhi making a move.
It had lost half of its body to the power of the thunder and lightning from the Bronze Thunder Pattern Array and its vitality had been halved, but it was more than sufficient to deal with the equally grievously wounded Shi Dian.
Shi Dian felt a numbness over his entire body and couldn't move; the vines wrapping around him exerted an immense force, and with a violent pull, they smashed his burly body into the ground. More vine whips emerged from the split earth, binding him and dragging him down into the sandy soil, disappearing in an instant.
"Monkey, thanks." The Divine Thought of Hua Zhi traveled from the depths of the ground.
From deep within the earth, there came a dull and mournful howl, which quickly fell silent.
Meanwhile, facing the greenish-glimmering dagger thrown by Yuan Ming, Sha Hao made no attempt to dodge.
As they made contact, the dagger simply pierced through his body. Sha Hao's figure instantly shattered. However, instead of a scene of flesh and blood flying, his figure dissipated like evaporating steam, slowly vanishing.
Sha Hao's figure emerged from thin air behind Yuan Ming, gripping a slender long sword, and struck down towards the King Kong.
The King Kong rolled away, got to its feet, and threw a punch at Sha Hao.
Yet, when his fist struck Sha Hao, it once again passed through him as if he were not there, and Sha Hao's figure collapsed again like a mirage, evidently another illusion.
After swinging at empty air, the King Kong stood bewildered in place, looking around, at a loss, and fell into Sha Hao's illusion technique.
Although the White Ape had great physical strength, it was helpless against illusions.
Yuan Ming called to the King Kong through telepathy but to no avail. His heart sank with alarm, and he immediately recalled the Cold Star Sword, causing a white light to hover in front of him as his Divine Sense spread out, searching for Sha Hao's trail.
Yuan Ming suddenly turned towards one side, only to see a ripple of water waves emerging out of thin air, followed by a shadow materializing—it was indeed Sha Hao.
Yuan Ming instinctively released a burst of Soul Power, enveloping Sha Hao.
Sha Hao's eyes showed a hint of confusion, but he quickly recovered.
"Illusion Technique? Could it be that you are also a Soul Cultivator? Perhaps there is some connection between us." He lightly waved a black folding fan in his hand, and with that, he swung the black fan fiercely at Yuan Ming.
"Whoosh"
A roaring wind blew, and a black tornado, ten zhang tall and twisted like a monstrous dragon, barreled directly towards Yuan Ming.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming didn't dare to be careless, and immediately took out a blue feather fan and swung it hard.
A dozen door-sized wind blades lined up and shot forward, swirling like a rolling plow, colliding with the black dragon.
The black dragon was instantly sliced apart and dissipated like smoke.
At the same time, two black hooks pierced through the smoke and rushed towards Sha Hao's face.
This time, Sha Hao didn't dodge but raised one hand high, and in his palm, a completely silver metallic sphere appeared, floating into the air.
The next instant, runes on the silver sphere flashed with light, and a dazzling silver beam shot out from the sphere, striking the Wushan Claw that was flying towards him.
With a "bang," the Wushan Claw that had flown close to Sha Hao exploded on impact.
In the wake of the Wushan Claw's explosion, Yuan Ming's body shook violently, and he instantly felt a sweet taste in his throat, evidently suffering backlash.
At that moment, the silver sphere suddenly lit up with blinding brightness again, and a beam of light shot straight towards Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming swiftly gestured into the void, and the Nine-Ring Gold Saber clanged as it was cleaved towards the approaching silver light.
A flash of light burst from the Nine-Ring Gold Saber, sending forth a blade aura that collided with the silver light.
The golden blade light was no match for the silver light line; it exploded upon contact, and the silver light continued to surge downward, striking the Nine-Ring Gold Saber in an instant.
"Bang!" came a loud noise.
The Nine-Ring Gold Saber trembled violently, and the nine gold rings hanging from it burst apart, scattering in all directions.
Yuan Ming's hands shuddered greatly, and as he looked at the dagger in his embrace, he saw that the blade was already densely covered with cracks, seriously damaged.
At this time, on the other side of the ground, the earth suddenly began to shake, and soil and rocks burst and flew.
After killing Shi Dian, Hua Zhi burst out of the ground and flung her hands forward. Dozens of vines, under the envelopment of green light, turned into dozens of wooden flying swords, shooting straight towards Sha Hao.
Right after the flying swords, Hua Zhi, with the bronze giant sword dragging from one arm, also pursued Sha Hao directly.
However, before she could get close, a silver light had already pierced through, smashing all the wooden swords and aiming at her vital spot—the chest.
In a hasty move, Hua Zhi held the sword horizontally in front of her to defend and also formed a shield of vines to block.
In the "boom" of an explosion, numerous vines burst and shattered.
The bronze giant sword snapped into two pieces, and Hua Zhi herself was sent flying.
Just as Hua Zhi got up, still holding the broken sword and wanting to attack again, she suddenly saw a flash of red light and realized she was surrounded by intense flames. She was trapped by scorching fires on all sides, with no way to move.
She tried to reach out to Yuan Ming, only to find that the perception between them had been cut off, leaving her with no idea of where Yuan Ming was.
Yuan Ming, observing Hua Zhi standing still in the original spot, knew that she too had fallen into an illusory realm, and his brow furrowed tightly.
Hua Zhi and White Ape were his two great sources of support. In past encounters with other situations, they were always invincible, but now they were tightly restrained by Sha Hao's Illusion Techniques.
Although Yuan Ming himself was barely unaffected by the opponent's illusions, he had to be wary of that silver sphere, which might be a top-grade magical tool.
Check for the latest updates on My Virtual Library Empire (*).
Looking at the severely damaged Nine-Ring Gold Saber in his hand, Yuan Ming couldn't help but think of retreating.
He took out a green feather fan and waved it strongly forward.
A mighty green storm burst forth, carrying dust and leaves with it, and charged towards Sha Hao, enveloping a range of dozens of feet in chaos, leaving nothing visible.
At the same time, he flicked his sleeve, and amidst the storm and dust, three slender black lights shot towards Sha Hao; they were three black daggers shaped like willow leaves.
This set of magical tools was acquired from the storage magic tool of Zheng Da from Zhenling Sect. Zheng Da and his cohorts were merely Gu Qiulong's henchmen, of meager worth, and the only valuable item among the storage magic tools of all three of them was this set of Mid-Grade magical tools, the Willow Leaf Linked Rings Saber.
Sha Hao chuckled, and with a light swipe of the black folding fan in his hand, a black Light Shield appeared in front of him, easily blocking the Willow Leaf Linked Rings Saber.
But at that moment, Yuan Ming had vanished without a trace.
In his haste to search, Yuan Ming's figure appeared like a ghost near the immobilized Vajra. With a flick of his sleeve, he wrapped around the object and put it into the Spiritual Beast Bag.
He did not pause for even a moment, immediately rushing towards Hua Zhi on the other side.
Sha Hao then realized that Yuan Ming's hopeless action had been a ploy to distract him, so as to take the opportunity to rescue the two spirit beasts.
Both White Ape and Hua Zhi were powerful, and if Yuan Ming were to rescue them, it would be quite unfortunate.
Sha Hao uttered a low shout and once again spurred the silver sphere into action, emitting a dazzling silver light, streaking towards Hua Zhi.
Yuan Ming, having witnessed the power of the silver light, promptly brought out the Shuiyun Banner to block the dazzling light.
With a "hiss," this Mid-Grade magical tool that had followed Yuan Ming for many years exploded, turning into fragments. However, the silver light's direction was also deflected by the explosion, passing just by Hua Zhi's head.
Yuan Ming, feeling a painful regret, reached out to grab Hua Zhi's body and put it into the Spiritual Beast Bag before immediately fleeing into the distance.
"Don't run!" Seeing he had been tricked, Sha Hao looked downright unpleasant and quickly gave chase.
At the same time, under the swirling blood light between his eyebrows, a vague Blood Shadow flew out—a blood-colored bat.
"Blood Bat! This is his Divine Soul Transformation? The same as the Great Elder's," Yuan Ming thought, a chill running down his spine.
The blood-colored bat was exceptionally fast, far outpacing the soul crow, and rapidly closed in on Yuan Ming, looking as if it was about to catch up.
Suddenly, a resounding crack of thunder ripped through the sky, and a purple thunderbolt the thickness of an arm came crashing down, targeting the blood-colored bat. Lei Yu had returned at some point, and now he bore a wound where a feather had been lost from his back, and the White Eagle that had previously been pursuing him was also flying in the distance.
The blood-colored bat, being formed of Divine Soul and quite wary of thunder attacks, made Sha Hao hastily maneuver the bat to dodge.
Meanwhile, Yuan Ming took the opportunity to recall the Willow Leaf Linked Rings Saber, and, summoning the White Jade Shuttle, he leaped onto it. Mana continuously poured into the shuttle from the soles of his feet.
The White Jade Shuttle transformed into a white rainbow, soaring into the sky, followed by Lei Yu making a swift circle and then trailing behind.
At this very moment, Hua Zhi and Vajra inside the Spiritual Beast Bag trembled and managed to break free from the illusion, coming to their senses.
Feeling this change, Yuan Ming's heart lightened. He had been preparing to attempt breaking the illusions affecting the two beasts, but it seemed they had awakened on their own.
As for Sha Hao, he wasn't feeling the same relief as Yuan Ming. Gazing in the direction Yuan Ming had fled, he pointed a finger into the air.
A streak of black light shot out from his sleeve, heading straight for Lei Yu—a short, serpent-shaped spike, incredibly fast.
However, with a single flap of his wings, Lei Yu made a turn in the sky, transforming his body into a black Illusion, easily avoiding the spike's assault and continuing the pursuit of Yuan Ming, effortlessly matching the speed of the White Jade Shuttle.

chapters.title: Chapter 297 - 274: Relentless Pursuit
chapters.content:
Sha Hao waited for the White Eagle to land on his shoulder, and saw that at this moment, the White Eagle's one claw was scorched black, and the feathers on its tail wing were sparse. It had clearly suffered a lot during the recent chase with Yuan Ming's Winged Bird.
Sha Hao had no time to comfort the White Eagle. With a raise of his hand, a fiery red flying boat appeared in front of him, shaped like a swimming fish, about twenty feet long, with two green wheels at either end, standing by each side.
Sha Hao leaped onto this oddly shaped flying boat. The fiery red flying boat immediately burst forth dazzling red light, and the green wheels at the stern spun rapidly, shooting out two thick green beams of light. The red light mingled with the green glow seemed as if fire and wind were joining forces, causing spiritual power fluctuations to surge immensely.
The fiery red flying boat sped into the sky like lightning, far surpassing the White Jade Shuttle, and quickly closing the gap between them.
"Lei Yu!" Yuan Ming looked toward the Winged Bird flying alongside him, took out a purple Spirit Fruit, and threw it over. Lei Yu caught the Spirit Fruit in midair and swallowed it, emitting joyous cries.
He then threw a storage ring into Lei Yu's mouth, and a soul crow flew out of his sleeve, surrounded by a swirl of Mana, and entered Lei Yu's body as well.
"Go." Yuan Ming instructed.
Lei Yu spread its wings to soar high, then flipped back toward Sha Hao and the fiery red flying boat, and spat out a purple thunderbolt.
Sha Hao, unfazed, raised his hand and cast a spell. A crystal-clear red Light Shield immediately appeared around the flying boat.
The purple thunderbolt struck it, emitting a thunderous boom, but the red Light Shield merely trembled and then stabilized.
Seeing that the attack failed, Lei Yu screeched, flapping its wings and diving at Sha Hao, its claws flickering with threads of lightning, seemingly seeking to regain its honor with its talons.
As Lei Yu charged closer, a hint of joy flashed in Sha Hao's eyes.
He had long noticed that this Winged Bird was extraordinary and had even had the White Eagle attempt to capture it before.
If Lei Yu had continued to attack with thunderbolts from afar, considering its lightning-fast speed, Sha Hao might have not been able to capture it. Now that the Winged Bird was approaching by itself, he had many ways to subdue it.
In that moment, Sha Hao pointed at his glabella, emitting a strong Divine Soul wave that enveloped Lei Yu.
However, right then, Yuan Ming's soul crow manipulated the Mana, activating the talismans stored in the storage ring.
Motions erupted in front of Lei Yu, and more than ten talismans appeared out of thin air.
With a twist, Lei Yu turned back toward Yuan Ming.
These talismans varied in color; each burst with quite a powerful Mana fluctuation, all of them were Mid-grade Talismans.
Sha Hao's expression changed dramatically, and he quickly steered the red flying boat to dodge to the side, while a red Light Shield immediately appeared around the boat.
However, it was too late. A blue light flashed in front of Lei Yu, and all the talismans were activated.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
Thunder, fireballs, Wind Dragons, raining swords, and other Spells rained down from the sky, all smashing onto the red flying boat, their spell power deluged it, engulfing the flying boat.
The flying boat's red Light Shield, although sturdy, couldn't withstand the combined attack of the more than ten Mid-grade Talismans, and after several fierce flashes, it explosively collapsed.
Only the sound of snapping and breaking was heard incessantly, and the large flying boat ignited into a fireball and shattered into pieces, plummeting downwards.
Taking advantage of Sha Hao's falling flying boat, Yuan Ming controlled the White Jade Shuttle to continue flying forward.
Soon, Lei Yu flew back, its claws clutching a storage ring and spitting out a soul crow.
It was fortunate that there was no shortage of Spirit Stones now, as Yuan Ming had purchased quite a few Talismans. This strategy of using a soul crow in combination with a spirit beast for long-distance casting was very covert; Yuan Ming had used it several times before, always with reliable success.
As a Soul Cultivator, Sha Hao naturally relied on his transformed Divine Soul, able to control Mana from a distance, but he had not anticipated such a use, caught completely off guard.
The burning red flying boat exploded loudly, its fiery tongues engulfing everything within a dozen feet, as Sha Hao, with nothing to rely on, fell from the sky.
The White Eagle swiftly descended from above, catching Sha Hao in a spiral.
Both eagle and rider were severely injured. The White Eagle's wings had burnt many feathers, its claws were charred black, and Sha Hao's clothes were tattered, making him look quite wretched.
"Chase!" Sha Hao slapped the White Eagle beneath him and took out a medicine pill for it to consume.
The White Eagle's spirit was lifted, and it flapped its wings to chase after Yuan Ming.
However, the injured White Eagle was much slower than the red flying boat and even slower than the White Jade Shuttle, quickly falling far behind.
But Sha Hao did not give up and continued to pursue relentlessly from behind.
Seeing Sha Hao persistently following, Yuan Ming's heart also sank.
He had just been through a fierce battle and actually had little Mana left. Now controlling the White Jade Shuttle, even with the addition of Spirit Stones, he couldn't sustain it for long.
Yuan Ming's gaze flickered, and his hand reached for the Spiritual Beast Bag that held the green cloud crane.
Though this crane was not fast in flight, it could buy him some time to recover his Mana.
"Caw caw..." Lei Yu's cry came from the side, accompanied by the thought of offering Yuan Ming a ride.
Although Lei Yu was only a First-level Upper Stage, its spiritual intelligence already compared to a Second-level Spirit Beast, enabling it to conduct simple communication with Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming hesitated. Lei Yu was born only two years ago and was only about ten feet in size. He had never thought to ride this bird, planning to wait until it advanced to Level 2 before considering making it his mount. Now it was still too early.
However, Sha Hao was closely pressing from behind, and it wouldn't be long before he caught up.
"Then I'll have to trouble you for a bit." Yuan Ming leaped onto Lei Yu's back, while simultaneously retracting the Flying Shuttle.
Lei Yu's body sank briefly, but quickly stabilized and emitted a piercing scream that tore through the clouds, its wings flashing with Thunder light, and it shot forward with a whoosh.
This speed was much faster than the White Jade Shuttle, with everything around quickly receding.
Yuan Ming was both shocked and delighted; he knew Lei Yu was fast, but he didn't expect it to be this fast even while carrying him.
Lei Yu, intending to show off in front of Yuan Ming, intensified the Thunder light on its wings, and its speed increased significantly, soon disappearing from sight as it completely shook off Sha Hao.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming finally relaxed, sat cross-legged on Lei Yu's back, took out an elixir to recover, and also pulled out two Mid-grade Wood Attribute Spirit Stones to absorb the Spiritual Power within.
His mana quickly recovered, and he calculated his next moves.
The message to Xi Ying got no reply, apparently Xi Ying was thousands of miles away.
Sha Hao had been lured here by him; as long as Xu Tian was fortunate, escaping the Trial Land should be no problem.
Shengye Sect had lost so many disciples this time, and Lu Shen had fallen here; they would certainly not let this go. Sha Hao's appearance had been exposed, and continuing to swagger through the streets was likely no longer possible.
Yuan Ming's only worry was whether Sha Hao would expose his identity as a Soul Cultivator. The Central Plains Immortal Cultivation World was even more hostile towards Soul Cultivators, practically everyone would attack on sight. If Sha Hao were caught and his identity as a Soul Cultivator was publicized, he too would suffer.
Although Lei Yu was fast, it was still young and had just fought a tough battle with the White Eagle, expending a lot of energy. Less than a quarter hour later, it began to show signs of fatigue and its speed noticeably slowed.
Yuan Ming did not force Lei Yu and let it rest in the Spiritual Beast Bag, calling out the Green Cloud Crane to continue on his way.
He hadn't flown long before his expression suddenly changed, and he turned to look behind him.
A white dot appeared on the horizon behind him, quickly closing the distance—it was Sha Hao.
"This fast?" Yuan Ming was startled.
Winged Birds are extremely fast, he had just thrown Sha Hao off by dozens of miles and had changed direction several times, far exceeding Sha Hao's range of Divine Sense. How had Sha Hao caught up?
But mulling over this now was of no use, Yuan Ming immediately retracted the Green Cloud Crane, switched to the White Jade Shuttle, and sped up his travel.For a smoother reading experience, visit MV&LEMPYR.
His mana had recovered by about twenty to thirty percent, and with full power operating the White Jade Shuttle, he quickly pulled away from Sha Hao again.
However, after such exertions, Yuan Ming's mana was almost depleted, and he had no choice but to call out the Green Cloud Crane again while he sat on its back to recover his mana.
Having learned from previous events, Yuan Ming summoned water to wash his entire body, then put on a gray cloak and also applied a Concealment spell to the Green Cloud Crane, eliminating any possible chances of being tracked.
But half a quarter hour later, Sha Hao caught up again.
Yuan Ming muttered about the oddness and once more took out the White Jade Shuttle to flee, while he used his Divine Sense to thoroughly scan his body.
Sha Hao had managed to catch up precisely twice, there must be a method to locate him.
In the Cultivation World, there are Secret Techniques to use mana or Divine Sense to place a mark on an enemy. Could it be that during their recent clash, Sha Hao had unknowingly employed such a method?
However, after checking three times, Yuan Ming still found nothing.
He checked his clothes, the White Jade Shuttle, and other items, even Lei Yu, Hua Zhi, and Vajra inside the Spiritual Beast Bag, but found no trace of anything unusual.
Helpless, Yuan Ming could only flee with all his might.
Thus, the two of them played a game of hide and seek within the Yunluo Mountain Range, one chasing and the other escaping.
The White Eagle was slower than Yuan Ming's White Jade Shuttle, and each time it approached, it was thrown off. However, this person was like a sticky candy, no matter what Yuan Ming tried to hide his tracks, it had no effect.
As long as Yuan Ming did not use the White Jade Shuttle to travel, Sha Hao would quickly catch up.
Half a day later.
Yuan Ming once again shook off Sha Hao, his expression growing gloomy.
Sha Hao had somehow managed to significantly increase the speed of that White Eagle, and although still slower than the White Jade Shuttle, he was catching up faster every time.
Helpless, Yuan Ming kept taking elixirs, pushing his mana to the limit repeatedly, causing his Dantian to ache faintly.
Lei Yu was too exhausted in both physical strength and demonic power to recover, unable to carry him away again, and continued overexertion was too much for its young body to bear.
"I can't keep this up, otherwise, I won't have escaped the Yunluo Mountain Range before Sha Hao catches up!" Yuan Ming strategized and looked downward.
His eyes suddenly lit up, and he flew downward, soon landing before a valley.
This valley was shaped like the mouth of a gourd, becoming narrower the deeper one went, densely packed with trees that covered the sky, obviously a good place to hide.
Yuan Ming entered, and his figure quickly disappeared from view.
Not long after, Sha Hao arrived riding the White Eagle and landed in front of the valley.
"Hmph, think you can outsmart me? Let's see where else you can run!" He retracted the White Eagle, looked toward the valley, and tapped his forehead, suddenly summoning a surge of Blood Light.

chapters.title: Chapter 298 - 275: Illusion Technique Showdown
chapters.content:
"Whoosh"
Three blood-colored bats flew out from the blood light between Sha Hao's eyebrows.
Immediately after, Sha Hao stepped into the valley without hesitation and walked briskly. The three bats fluttered and danced within a range of more than ten zhang from him, constantly probing their surroundings.
Along the way, he noticed nothing unusual, but suspicion surged in his heart, and his pace began to slow.
After taking a few more steps, he suddenly turned around with a shiver.
The path he had come from began to drift with strands of white mist, giving off an unreal, dream-like sensation, and an inexplicably sweet, cloying scent filled the air.
Sha Hao suddenly became alert and immediately held his breath, intending to retreat, but his movements were somewhat delayed.
"Boom"—the ground beneath his feet suddenly exploded, sending up a large cloud of dust that enveloped everything in the valley.
"Crack"
Four or five blue wooden dragons burst from the ground, each four or five zhang long and as thick as a barrel, lunging towards Sha Hao with bared teeth and claws.
Under the cover of the wooden dragons and the dust, the Cold Star Sword and Willow Leaf Linked Rings Saber shot out from the nearby jungle, striking at Sha Hao's body.
Shock did not lead to chaos for Sha Hao. He slapped his hand on his waist, and a burst of yellow light suddenly rose, forming an oval protective shield around him.
The wooden dragons, Cold Star Sword, and Willow Leaf Linked Rings Saber struck it, causing the oval shield to tremble incessantly yet without collapse.
Not far from the thicket, there was a "boom" as it exploded; a white illusion darted out from it, reaching Sha Hao in a flash. It was the White Ape King Kong.
The Vajra's arms flipped up and down, his fists furiously slamming down, striking the yellow shield violently.
A force as immense as overseeing mountains burst forth from its fists, shattering the yellow light curtain into pieces.
The Vajra's arms, without the slightest pause, tightly grabbed Sha Hao's body like iron hoops and violently tore him apart.
Sha Hao's body "splattered" open, and blood-soaked remnants with blood-red substances scattered around.
In the nearby jungle, Yuan Ming, wearing a gray cloak and concealing all his aura, merged seamlessly with the nearby bushes.
Seeing this scene, he suddenly changed his expression and rolled to the side to dodge.
A silver light shot forth, brushing past his ear, leaving several blood marks on his cheek with its sharp momentum.
The remains of Sha Hao on the ground also transformed into clusters of white light bubbles, quickly dispersing and vanishing.
"Illusion Technique!" Yuan Ming's expression suddenly sank, filled with disbelief.
Since Sha Hao had entered the valley, he had been continuously cautious guarding. When had he fallen for Sha Hao's illusion?
Yuan Ming did not panic, waved his hand to recall several magic artifacts, and then frantically circulated the Moonlight Technique, attempting to break the illusion as before.
However, no matter how he operated the Divine Soul Power, he still could not find any breakthrough.The l.a%te%s^t& c&h!a.pte#rs are al!w^ays- a%vaila&b*le fir@st% on MV5.L!EMP&Y-R.#
Silver light flashed in the nearby void, and four or five streaks of silver light, just like those before, shot towards him.
Yuan Ming was about to counter, but the Vajra flashed and flew close to Yuan Ming, its body bursting with golden light while the other two ape arms also emerged from its back, meeting the several streaks of silver light.
The anticipated sound of collision did not occur; the Vajra's fists easily penetrated those silver lights, which turned out to be yet another set of false illusions.
Yuan Ming's eyes slightly darkened. The few streaks of silver light, whether in aura or appearance, were identical to the previous ones. His Divine Sense detected no anomalies, but they turned out to be illusions. It seemed that Sha Hao's illusion technique was more terrifying than he had anticipated.
At that moment, the surrounding environment changed again, as large swaths of gray-white mist suddenly emerged, and the scene transformed within a blink of an eye.
The White Ape King Kong became agitated, its four fists furiously striking the surrounding area.
The overwhelming power of the punches hit the gray-white mist but seemed to dissolve into nothing, merely causing the mist to swirl, without any effect.
"Vajra, stop wasting your energy. I have something to ask you. How did you break free from Sha Hao's illusion before?" Yuan Ming called out to the White Ape and asked.
"I don't know how it happened, I just suddenly came to. Wasn't it you, Master, who broke the illusion for me?" Vajra said, slightly confused.
Yuan Ming remained silent. At that time, he had intended to break the illusions affecting Hua Zhi and Vajra, but before he could act, they had already returned to normal.
He recollected the situation at that time when Vajra and Hua Zhi had suddenly awakened while he was ascending into the sky on the White Jade Shuttle.
"Could it be that Sha Hao's illusion can only be cast at close range, and once out of range, the illusion automatically dissipates?" Yuan Ming suddenly thought of a possibility, decisively deployed the White Jade Shuttle, and swiftly lifted off with the Vajra.
The spirit light on the White Jade Shuttle intensified, soaring into the sky.
However, not far into the flight, a "bang" resounded, hitting something extremely thick and hard, seemingly a mountain wall, though he was sure he had flown upward.
"I was clearly flying upwards, so why did I hit a mountain wall? Has my sense of direction also been scrambled?" Yuan Ming flipped over to stabilize his form, his expression growing even darker.
At that moment, a strange expression flickered across his face, then he quickly returned to normal, turned around, and flew back to the ground. His hands formed seals at an extremely fast pace, and he executed the Fire Cloud Secret Technique.
A column of red light shot into the sky reaching several dozen feet high, instantly forming a thick canopy of fire clouds.
No sooner had the fire clouds formed than the void around again flashed with silver light, and over a dozen streaks of silver light roared from all directions toward Yuan Ming.
Although the Vajra was brave, it could not block all the incoming silver light.
Yuan Ming's expression was exceptionally calm as he formed a hand seal and pointed.
Dozens of huge red fireballs cascaded from the sky, colliding with the silver lights.
Bang!
All the fireballs burst open, creating a raging sea of flames around them, engulfing all the silver lights.
Almost all the silver lights were illusions, except for one real streak of silver light which penetrated the barrier of flames, heading straight for Yuan Ming's head with incredible speed.
A white shadow flashed, and the White Ape stood behind Yuan Ming. A newly grown ape arm shot out dazzling golden light, blocking the silver light.
The punch of the White Ape was half-pierced by the silver light, creating a bloody hole, with blood splattering, yet its eyelids did not flicker, as if the injury was not its own.
Yuan Ming glanced at the wound on the White Ape's fist, a pained expression appeared on his face, and he hastened the stimulation of the Fire Cloud in the sky.
Fist-sized fireballs fell from the sky like raindrops.
Bang!
Everything nearby was devoured by flames, and the grey-white fog was completely torn apart, revealing the once-hidden quiet valley.
The cliffs on both sides collapsed significantly, the vegetation within the valley was utterly destroyed, spewing towering dust, and the ground was blasted with huge cracks.
However, Sha Hao neither appeared nor revealed any trace of his aura.
Yuan Ming did not stop the Fire Cloud Secret Technique, while holding a mid-grade Spirit Stone in one hand, he frantically replenished his Mana and continued to stimulate the Fire Cloud Skill, sending fireballs raining down on various parts of the valley, seeming intent on leveling the entire valley.
Amidst the rising smoke, Sha Hao's body transformed into an invisible shadow, dodging fireballs from left to right, slowly closing in on Yuan Ming.
The three Blood Bats hovered above his head, their mouths open towards Yuan Ming, seemingly spitting something.
Sha Hao quickly approached within ten yards of Yuan Ming, grabbing the Silver Orb and channeling Mana into it.
As the Silver Orb spun around, all four runes were activated, releasing a beam of silver light.
This silver light was entirely different from before, exceptionally slender and twice as fast.
Yuan Ming had no time to react, and was pierced through the chest, tumbling to the ground.
The Fire Cloud in the sky became chaotic and rapidly disintegrated.
Sha Hao nodded in satisfaction. The slender silver light was a special attack from the orb, activated at the cost of a vast amount of Mana not only for its immense power but also for its incredible speed, which even a Cultivator at the peak of Foundation Establishment might not dodge.
The only downside to this move was its narrow range of attack; the master had to hold the Magic Artifact in hand and activate it at close range.
Sha Hao stored the Silver Orb and walked over to Yuan Ming's corpse.
In the Central Plains, Soul Cultivators were even more oppressed than in the Southern Border. Encountering a Soul Cultivator here was utterly unexpected for him.
Now that Yuan Ming was dead, there was no point in dwelling on this, but as Soul Cultivators were rare, Sha Hao was quite curious about Yuan Ming's lineage and the Soul Cultivation Method he practiced. He reached for the Storage Ring on his hand but grasped at thin air.
Yuan Ming's corpse suddenly turned into an illusion and disappeared into thin air.
"Illusion!" Sha Hao's expression changed drastically, and his hands swiftly formed an intricate Seal Technique.
His Divine Soul emitted threads of crystalline light, then shook violently, causing a tremendous upheaval in the Sea of Consciousness, centered around the Divine Soul and rapidly spreading to the entire Sea of Consciousness.
Sha Hao's vision shattered like glass, freeing him from the influence of the illusion.
The next moment, he felt a scorching wave of heat descending from above, as seven or eight fist-sized fireballs flew towards him, closing in within three feet.
Sha Hao hastily retreated backward, but his speed could not compare to that of the Bursting Fireballs. In the blink of an eye, he was overtaken, and the fireballs exploded simultaneously.
A thunderous explosion rang out, and deep red flames engulfed Sha Hao's body, further morphing into a mushroom-shaped pillar of fire shooting dozens of yards into the sky.
The scorching blast swept through, the ground shook, and the entire valley trembled lightly.
However, the next moment, Sha Hao's figure shot out from the column of fire, swiftly fleeing into the distance.
His clothes were ripped, revealing a shining golden inner armor on his upper body, which had astonishingly remained unscathed under the ferocious attack of the Fire Cloud Secret Technique, not even a scratch on it.
The golden inner armor protected Sha Hao's upper body, but not his lower body. His legs were bloodied, with some spots even showing white bone, his fleeing figure slightly staggering.
A figure chased after him from behind, it was Yuan Ming, forming a hand seal directed at the Fire Cloud above.
Swoosh, swoosh, swoosh!
Four or five more huge fireballs shot down, emitting more powerful than before, howling as they chased after Sha Hao.
With his legs injured, Sha Hao was quickly overtaken by the fireballs. Gritting his teeth, he took out a Yellow Talisman and crushed it, immediately a yellow Array appeared under his feet.
Dazzling yellow light burst out, and his figure flickered before vanishing into the ground, quickly escaping into the distance.
Several fireballs hit empty space, crashing into the mountain wall behind and violently exploding.
The mountain wall collapsed, and large and small rocks flowed down like a torrent.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming did not pursue, but stood in place, spreading out his Divine Sense in all directions, sensing for Sha Hao's aura.

chapters.title: Chapter 299 - 276: Return to the Clan
chapters.content:
After confirming that Sha Hao had completely left, Yuan Ming's complexion suddenly turned as pale as paper, and he fell to the ground with a "thud", gasping for breath.
The Fire Cloud in mid-air surged a few times and quickly dissipated.
Vajra flew over, looked at Yuan Ming's weakened state, wanting to help but not knowing where to start, and could only fret anxiously.
"Get me out of here, quick..." Yuan Ming said hoarsely.
Vajra nodded repeatedly, picking up Yuan Ming with two arms and sprinting into the valley with the other two arms holding his legs together, and after a few leaps, he disappeared into the vast forest.
Yuan Ming didn't let Vajra run too far, and soon had him put himself down, hastily summoned Hua Zhi, and then sat down cross-legged, taking out two Mid-grade Wood Attribute Spirit Stones to absorb the spiritual power and recover.
Although Hua Zhi and Vajra didn't get along, with Yuan Ming injured, they didn't argue any further at the moment and each guarded one side as his protectors.
Vajra directly sat cross-legged on the ground, his eyes, large as copper bells, scanning around alertly.
Hua Zhi, on the other hand, spread its vines far and wide, covering an area of a hundred paces, capturing every small animal that passed by, devouring their blood to heal its injuries.
After a quarter of an hour, Yuan Ming opened his eyes, his pale face having recovered slightly.
As a disciple of Xi Cangqiong, Sha Hao indeed had an impressive attainment in Soul Cultivation, and his strength surpassed Yuan Ming's expectations.
When Yuan Ming had escaped to the valley, his mana was almost depleted, and having continuously activated the Fire Cloud Secret Technique just now, his mana had been completely exhausted, fortunately scaring Sha Hao away at the last moment.
Ga ga...
Accompanied by a shrill cry, Lei Yu fell from the sky, landing beside Yuan Ming.
"Luckily, I had released you earlier after entering that valley, or today I really would have died at Sha Hao's hands," Yuan Ming stroked Lei Yu's smooth feathers.
"Master, how did you break those illusions?" Vajra turned to ask, curious.
Hua Zhi also ran back and sat on the other side of Yuan Ming, obviously wanting to know the answer too.
"I didn't break Sha Hao's illusions at all," Yuan Ming shook his head.
"Didn't break the illusions? How is that possible? Sha Hao clearly fell for your illusion at the end and was nearly blown to pieces by you," Vajra didn't understand.
"Who said that being in an illusion means you can't cast illusions on someone else?" Yuan Ming chuckled.
Vajra scratched his head in confusion, not understanding Yuan Ming's words.
"When I was affected by Sha Hao's illusion, I couldn't see my surroundings clearly. However, with your reminder, I realized that Sha Hao's illusions had distance limitations, so I had Lei Yu peek at the situation inside the valley from above. Indeed, Lei Yu was not affected and could see everything clearly from mid-air. Although Lei Yu's spiritual intelligence isn't as high as yours or Hua Zhi's, he could still tell me some basic information, such as Sha Hao's position. This way, even though I was still under Sha Hao's illusions, it was almost as if I wasn't," Yuan Ming explained.
"Oh, I see, that's quite complicated," Vajra still seemed somewhat confused.
"Strong limbs, simple mind," Hua Zhi, having understood, sent a telepathic tease.
"You sprout, asking for a beating!" Vajra roared angrily, his palm as large as a fan fiercely grabbing towards Hua Zhi's head.
With ready anticipation, Hua Zhi swiftly burrowed into the ground.
"If you dare, don't run underground!" Vajra thundered furiously.
"If you dare, come down and fight!" Hua Zhi retorted.
"You come up!"
"You come down!"
Yuan Ming sighed, ignoring the two and continued to hold the spirit stones, recovering his mana.
Vajra and Hua Zhi made noise for quite a while before calming down.
"Master, what happened afterward? How did Sha Hao fall for your illusion?" Vajra ran back beside Yuan Ming, pressing for details.
"I cast the Fire Cloud Skill, making Sha Hao think I was getting frantic, drawing him closer. Then, when he was off-guard, I cast an illusion. My illusion might not be as powerful as his, but it's effective as long as I know his position. Sha Hao was caught by surprise, but it seemed he had a way to break it and managed to escape in time," Yuan Ming glanced at Vajra, explaining.
"So that's how it was," Vajra finally completely understood and looked at Yuan Ming with admiration.
"Master, what do you think Sha Hao used to break your illusion?" Hua Zhi also emerged from the ground, asking.
"I can't guess. It might be some method specifically for breaking illusions," Yuan Ming said.
Through the previous battle, he had also vaguely figured out a method to break illusions.
Just now, he had bombarded the valley with the Fire Cloud Secret Technique. Due to the lack of mana, he hadn't used any protective measures, and his body was inevitably affected by the blasts, causing considerable pain.
With each wave of pain, the illusions before his eyes showed slight fluctuations.
Yuan Ming licked his lips, his tongue had cracked a bit, and fresh blood was still slowly seeping out.
His earlier statement to Vajra that he hadn't broken Sha Hao's illusions wasn't exactly accurate.
He had bitten himself when Sha Hao was fleeing, using the excruciating pain, along with the aid of the Moonlight Technique and the incense burner, to linger between consciousness and unconsciousness.
Yuan Ming confirmed that about one third of his mana had recovered, so he summoned the White Jade Shuttle and rushed back, quickly returning to the previous valley.
He landed a good distance from the valley and released a soul crow to scout inside.
The situation in the valley had not changed. He Wendao, Bai Ye, Lu Shen, and the bodies of the five Shengye Sect disciples were still in place, and a few scattered magic artifacts were there too.
Yuan Ming had the soul crow scout around once more to confirm there were no issues before he entered.
Looking at the bodies scattered all over the ground, a sense of desolation inevitably rose in his heart.
However, he quickly dismissed this peculiar emotion and gathered up the bodies and the scattered magic artifacts.
Hua Zhi shot two vines from the Spiritual Beast Bag into the ground, quickly dragging out the desiccated body of Shi Dian, which Hua Zhi had drained.
Yuan Ming collected it as well, and then stood in place and closed his eyes.
On the way here, he had quietly left a mana marker inside Xu Tian's body to facilitate his own monitoring, which would work as long as the distance did not exceed a hundred li. F-i-nd the tr*an^s@lat$i+o*n on MV-&*LE!M$P&YR.
Yuan Ming soon opened his eyes, summoned the White Jade Shuttle, and flew toward a distant area, finally arriving above a secluded recess in the mountains.
He descended and scanned the valley with his Divine Sense, discovering that many cultivators were rapidly traveling. Almost all of the scattered Shengye Sect disciples were gathered here, including Xu Tian and Luo Xing'er.
"Well, that saves me the trouble of looking for them one by one," Yuan Ming nodded slightly and descended.
The Shengye Sect disciples walking within the recess were initially tense when they saw someone approaching, but upon recognizing Yuan Ming, they all breathed a sigh of relief.
"Senior Hagon, it's great that you're unharmed," Xu Tian said joyfully.
Luo Xing'er, too, was overjoyed to see Yuan Ming safe and sound.
"How did you all manage to regroup after scattering?" Yuan Ming nodded to both and asked.
"Reporting to Senior Hagon, after Elder Lu Shen messaged me, I immediately flew away with the disciples aboard the flying boat. Then I informed the remaining disciples to regroup. The flying boat is huge, and I feared being discovered by the enemy's spirit beasts, so I dared not drive the flying boat with everyone aboard. Thus, we decided to walk back," a tall young man from the Shengye Sect stepped forward and spoke, bowing to Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming recognized him as the pilot of the flying boat, named Luo Shan, a cultivator at the Qi Refining Peak. He was impressed with Luo Shan's handling of the situation. If the flying boat had left just a moment later, the disciples on board would have been wiped out by Sha Hao in the valley. Walking through the mountains also offered better concealment.
"Senior Hagon, may I ask how Elder Lu Shen and Elder Bai Ye are doing?" Luo Shan asked further.
"Lu Shen and Fellow Daoist Bai Ye, they have both fallen. Luckily the enemy was injured and has left. You are safe now," Yuan Ming said.
Upon hearing this, the tension that everyone had been holding was finally released, with some of the more timid and cowardly disciples even weeping with relief.
"What should we do now? Can you escort us back to the sect alone?" Luo Shan asked.
"Where is the flying boat?" Yuan Ming asked.
"The flying boat is currently stopped in another valley," Luo Shan replied.
"You retrieve that Green Wood Flying Boat, and I'll protect these disciples here. We can now leave aboard the flying boat. Don't worry, I'm here," Yuan Ming pondered briefly before speaking.
He then lent the flying shuttle to Luo Shan, urging him to make a quick return, and Luo Shan summoned the White Jade Shuttle and sped away.
Yuan Ming rode the Green Cloud Crane and patrolled the skies.
Watching Yuan Ming in the sky, many of the Shengye Sect disciples showed admiration.
"This Senior Hagon looks quite young, yet his strength is remarkable. Even Elder Lu Shen fell to the enemy, yet he managed to escape safely," a female disciple from the Shengye Sect with a round face held her cheeks in her hands, her eyes sparkling.
"Of course, Senior Hagon is..." Luo Xing'er began, lifting her fair chin, about to reveal Yuan Ming's glorious deed of killing the Great Jin National Master, but Xu Tian stopped her with a look.
"Junior Brother Xu, Junior Sister Luo, it seems you know Senior Hagon?" another disciple asked them.
"We haven't met him before, but Senior Hagon is acquainted with our family elders, and Xing'er and I have heard some of his exploits," Xu Tian explained.
"What exploits does Senior Hagon have? Tell us about them!" the round-faced female disciple urged.
"Senior Hagon is naturally modest and dislikes being talked about behind his back, so it's inappropriate for us to say more. Please understand," Xu Tian said, shaking his head.
Yuan Ming had offended Chang Chun Temple, and since he used the pseudonym Hagon, it was clear he didn't want to reveal his identity. Xu Tian, knowing some details from his grandmother, naturally wouldn't divulge them.
Everyone was disappointed by this but did not pursue the matter further.
A short while later, Luo Shan piloted the Green Wood Flying Boat, which emitted bright green light, quickly returning to the recess and gathered all Shengye Sect disciples. The flying boat slowly lifted off, heading toward the Shengye Sect's gate.
"Who has a way to contact the sect?" Yuan Ming looked at the others and asked.
The Green Wood Flying Boat was quite conspicuous, and it would be best to contact the Shengye Sect to send someone quickly in case of further incidents along the way.
However, everyone shook their heads.
"The magic tool for contacting the sect was with Elder Lu Shen," Luo Shan said.
Yuan Ming frowned without taking out Lu Shen's storage magic tool.
For this mission of the Shengye Sect, he had nearly risked his own life. Lu Shen's storage magic tool was not something he planned to return, considering it his well-deserved compensation.
