"Ah, out so soon? Seems like I need to go purchase some more at the workshop," Sha Hao muttered.
Following that, he stood up and left the stone house.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming was shaken and quickly focused his attention, taking advantage of Sha Hao's departure to observe the surroundings.
The place where Sha Hao resided seemed to be a remote mountain range, with ancient trees towering into the sky and intermittent sounds of birds and beasts. Nothing out of the ordinary could be observed.
After leaving his dwelling in the mountain cave, he brandished a Token and took off in a Flying Boat that soared into the sky.
All along the way, Yuan Ming did not see any landmark that could determine Sha Hao's location. His usually calm mood began to stir with ripples of concern.
Missing this opportunity, he did not know when the next chance to encounter Sha Hao venturing out would come.
Yuan Ming felt anxious inside but had no means to influence Sha Hao. He could only pray silently that the workshop Sha Hao intended to visit was not too far away.
His prayer, however, did not seem to take effect. The workshop Sha Hao chose to visit was not particularly close to his hiding place, but fortunately, due to the inclusion of the thousand-year-old water crown wood in the new incense, the time he could possess Sha Hao was much longer than before.
After an amount of time had passed, Yuan Ming finally saw a city appearing in the distance, and as they drew closer, he realized that the architectural style of the city was completely different from that of Thunder Continent or the entirety of Da Jin.
Enjoy the story by reading on *.
As Sha Hao brought the Flying Boat down, Yuan Ming also saw the city's name inscribed on the plaque above the gate—Wangyue City.
Before entering the city, Sha Hao carefully disguised himself and headed straight to an elixir shop once inside, avoiding contact with anyone else along the way. He was the epitome of caution and vigilance.
However, Yuan Ming, who was inhabiting his body, clearly observed every shop and passerby they had passed on the road.
The cultivators coming and going in the main street all wore brocade robes and had various magic artifacts slung at their waist, occasionally uttering slang from Zhao Country in their conversations.
The scripts on the signs of the shops by the road had slender lines with smooth strokes, which were characteristics of the Zhao Country's script.
Most crucially, at one of the shops that Sha Hao passed by, there was a huge notice board hanging outside that read:
"New arrival of Northern Desert Sand Worms at our shop, purchase while supplies last."
Thus, it seemed that Wangyue City was likely a city in the northern part of Zhao Country.
Based on this deduction, Yuan Ming made his assumptions, and at the same time, Sha Hao crossed the street and entered the elixir shop.
And at that moment, the time Yuan Ming could spend possessing Sha Hao had just run out.
...
Two days later,
Inside a private room at the Four Symbols Tea House, Yuan Ming finally met with the Artifact Refiner referred to him by Song Huichong.
To his surprise, the man was none other than Master Xu Xinyang, who had been at the auction.
Song Huichong noticed Yuan Ming's astonished expression and smiled as she explained, "Speaking of refining top-grade magical tools, Master Xu is a renowned figure throughout Zhao Country. Even I have a magic treasure on me that originated from a top-grade magical tool refined by him."
"Senior Song flatters me. My artifact refining skills are just passable and not particularly useful. The title 'Master' makes me feel somewhat ashamed," Xu Xinyang said with a wave of his hand, speaking in a gruff voice.
"The top-grade magical tools refined by Master Xu, most of which can be improved into magic treasures, are coveted by many Core Formation cultivators. How can you say they are useless?" Song Huichong responded.
"Alas, Senior Song knows, my talent for cultivation is limited, and the difficulties of advancing to Core Formation are insurmountable. No matter how skilled I am in refining, creating top-grade magical tools is as far as I can go. I can't create magic treasures, let alone glimpse the higher splendor. I'm really no master," Xu Xinyang shook his head.
"I remember, Master Xu, didn't you once propose a theory that it might be possible to balance and fuse the fifth rune with the other four, forming a fake rune formation, and directly refine a magic treasure? Is that path not feasible?" Song Huichong inquired.
"That's only theoretically possible. In practice, it's extremely difficult. From my years of research and the numerous attempts I've made, none have succeeded. It seems that apart from the Pill Fire nurtured within the body of a Core Formation cultivator, there likely isn't a good way to ease the conflict and rejection among the five runes. My ideas are just empty talk. Anyway, let's not discuss it. You invited me here to introduce a talented fellow cultivator, could it be him?" Xu Xinyang said with a wry smile.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming immediately clasped his hands and said, "I am Hagon, and I have the pleasure of meeting Master Xu."
"Master Xu, you must have heard of his name in the past few days. He fought Pu Zhengqing to save my disciple but lost most of his magical tools in the process. I felt terrible about it, and that's why I sought you out. I wonder if you might do me the honor of helping him improve one of his high-grade magical tools to top-grade," Song Huichong requested.
Xu Xinyang scrutinized Yuan Ming for a moment and then shook his head, "Senior Song, it's not that I don't want to do you this favor. I'm simply too busy with a top-grade magical tool I'm currently refining, and I can't spare any time right now. But the store under my name is located in Yuhe City of Zhao Country, managed by my elder brother. His skills are not bad, and he has also refined a few top-grade magical tools. Fellow Daoist Hagon could go to him for assistance, just say that I sent you."
This was a polite refusal. Song Huichong sighed helplessly. She wasn't very close to Xu Xinyang, and it wasn't appropriate to press him into agreeing considering her seniority. It was up to Yuan Ming now to persuade him.
Hearing Xu Xinyang's words, although Yuan Ming felt somewhat disappointed, he had come prepared and immediately said, "Master Xu, in earlier years, I accidentally acquired a rune. I have not been able to discern its origin or function. As you have extensive knowledge and experience, would you be willing to help clarify some things for me?"
With that, Yuan Ming handed over a Jade Plate he had prepared earlier.
Xu Xinyang knew that Yuan Ming was proposing the exchange of a rune for artifact refining services. However, having immersed himself in the art of artifact refining for many years and having seen a great variety of runes, he doubted that Yuan Ming could present anything of value. Therefore, he only gave the Jade Plate a cursory glance, but it was that one look that made him sit bolt upright.
He took the Jade Plate from Yuan Ming's hand, his eyes round with intensity as he closely studied the rune on the plate, completely engrossed in his examination. He was so absorbed that he seemed to forget the presence of the other two people in the room.
Yuan Ming had inscribed on his jade plate a Corpse Control Rune that he had obtained from the portrait of Ba Yin Ancestor, the lord of Iron Tiger Town. Although this rune was originally used for creating talismans, it was not improper to use it on a magical artifact.
It took Xu Xinyang a good while, under the incessant urging of Song Huichong, to come back to his senses. He glanced at Yuan Ming impatiently, then remembered the previous topic and said directly, "This rune of yours, I haven't really seen much of it either, and I need to study it further. So, leave the magical artifact that you want to upgrade with me. I'll refine it for you when I've finished my research. Keep this Communication Talisman safe, I will notify you in twenty days to come and collect it."
Yuan Ming nodded, then took out the Black Needle, the Flood Dragon Scale, and the long-neglected White Jade Belt: "Master Xu, my Black Needle has been refined once before, could you please add an Armor Breaking Rune to it? Also, this Flood Dragon Scale, if possible, I would trouble you to refine it into a top-grade shield. And this White Jade Belt, please see if you can repair it as well."
Xu Xinyang put down the jade plate and looked at Yuan Ming with an unpleasant expression: "Fellow Daoist, aren't you asking for too much?"
"Please forgive my impertinence, Master." Yuan Ming replied, as he handed over a Storage Bag.
Xu Xinyang took the Storage Bag, a trace of scorn appearing at the corner of his mouth. As an Artifact Refining Master, he had seen plenty of Spirit Stones in his days, and the notion that a Foundation Establishment Cultivator thought to influence him with Spirit Stones was laughable.
As he thought this, he opened the Storage Bag, and upon seeing the glaring pile of Spirit Stones inside, he was immediately taken aback.
He counted roughly and found there were a full six thousand Spirit Stones in the bag.
"I wonder if Master finds my offering to your satisfaction. This is only half of it. Once you have finished refining, I will immediately present the other half," Yuan Ming said with clasped hands.
These Spirit Stones were almost all he could offer. Although he had earned quite a bit through the Spiritual Incense Store over the years, most of it was spent on buying elixirs to enhance his cultivation.
But he did not feel any heartache, for Spirit Stones could be earned again, whereas an opportunity like this, once missed, might not come again. Besides, he had calculated that if the other party agreed, he would still have made a good profit based on market value.
Xu Xinyang coughed twice and pocketed the Storage Bag: "Since Fellow Daoist sincerely requests assistance, I shall help with all my heart."
As he spoke, he took the three items that Yuan Ming had brought out one by one, but when he got to the White Jade Belt, his gaze sharpened. Then he took the belt in his hands and began to examine it repeatedly.
"Interesting, using gems as carriers for the runes rather than the magical tool itself, a thought to avoid rune conflict. However, these gems... are they Sea Coral Stones? No, Sea Coral Stones don't transmit Spiritual Power this quickly. But... where exactly did Fellow Daoist Hagon find this magical tool?" As Xu Xinyang looked more and more puzzled, he finally turned to Yuan Ming and asked about the origins of the artifact.
"I got it while traveling in the Southern Border, after killing an enemy," Yuan Ming did not conceal the truth.

chapters.title: Chapter 314 - 291: Praying for Rain
chapters.content:
"Southern Border? No, that's not possible. The style of Artifact Refining for this magic artifact leans more towards the style of the Eastern Sea Islands; it must be the work of an Artifact Refining Master from an overseas sect. The gemstones as well should originate from the Eastern Sea; as for what kind of spiritual materials they are, I need to study further. Regarding whether it can be restored or not, I cannot guarantee that," Xu Xinyang said with a slight frown, shaking his head.
"No matter, please do as you see fit, Master," Yuan Ming said.
Xu Xinyang nodded, no longer speaking much, and took both the Black Needle and the White Jade Belt with him.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming took the initiative to stand up and take his leave, and Song Huichong also left with him.
Outside the teahouse, Yuan Ming thanked Song Huichong for her help before saying goodbye to her and heading to Qingmu Building.
In a private room on the third floor, Yuan Ming completed the transaction of the Heavy Armor with Di Yue for a thousand Spirit Stones and once again declined Di Chen's request for a spar.
After all of this, he left Little Lake City, riding the Flying Shuttle into Rain Ruins Swamp, and released Hua Zhi back into it.
He had already learned where Sha Hao might be located and now had even more urgency to strengthen his powers every minute, every second. Moreover, Hua Zhi had been feeling restless in the Spiritual Beast Bag, always clamoring to return to the swamp to continue its cultivation, so Yuan Ming obliged.
Aside from the True Water Ring he had given Hua Zhi earlier, Yuan Ming had wanted to equip it with more magic artifacts, but considering Hua Zhi's ever-changing form and its ability to condense blades, it was not suited for wearing armor. He thus abandoned this idea, thinking to prepare some supportive magic artifacts for it in the future instead.
After giving Hua Zhi some instructions, Yuan Ming quickly returned to his accommodation in the city, lit a stick of Purple Dark Incense, and swallowed an elixir, continuing his cultivation.
...
Five days later.
In a certain courtyard, an old emperor in a yellow robe stood with his hands hanging down, looking up at the sun high in the sky. Then, suddenly, he twisted his fingers and struck a Magic Formula.
The Mana inside his body revolved rapidly, and soon, under his urging, dark clouds appeared in the sky, filling it within dozens of miles and shielding him from the blazing sun.
Then, a drop of rain fell, plunking just half an inch from the tip of his foot.
As if it were a signal to charge, countless raindrops followed suit, competing to leap out from the dark clouds and crash to the ground below the old emperor's feet.
The light drizzle quickly turned into a downpour.
At this moment, having already erected a Mana Shield to insulate himself from the rain, the old emperor turned around and directed his gaze to Liu Tianming not far behind him, and said,
"Do you understand this rain praying technique? The environment this Spell creates not only greatly enhances the power of your Water Magic but also significantly weakens the Fire Magic cast by your opponents. It depends on how you employ it in combat. If there's anything you don't understand, feel free to ask."
"Thank you for your guidance, Grandfather Emperor. I have remembered it and will work hard to practice and comprehend it," Liu Tianming said respectfully.
Meanwhile, many miles away in the northern part of Da Jin, in Little Lake City, Yuan Ming also opened his eyes, carefully recalling the details of the old emperor's Mana circulation that he had just witnessed, and nodded slightly to himself.
The Black Incense, after being mixed with thousand-year-old spiritual wood, had a duration more than twice the original, allowing him to do much more. This confirmed that spiritual incense made from ancient spiritual wood does indeed have a corresponding benefit in terms of duration.
When Yuan Ming had initially possessed the old emperor, he was teaching Liu Tianming about cultivation insights, starting with some important points about the Nine Elements Technique, then went on to teach Liu Tianming the Water attribute Spell, the rain praying technique, and even demonstrated it himself.
During this period, Yuan Ming watched the entire process through possession and not only gained a deeper understanding of the Nine Elements Technique but also successfully learned this secret rain praying technique, thanks in part to the long duration of the Black Incense made from the ancient spiritual wood; otherwise, he wouldn't have had enough time to witness the whole process.
However, just one such understanding might not be enough to fully master this secret technique. He will have to continue possessing the old emperor and Liu Tianming in the future. If he were to try to comprehend it on his own, it would not only be time-consuming and laborious, but the results might not be ideal either.
Yuan Ming tried to cast the technique and, upon failing to succeed, was not discouraged. Instead, he planned to continue cultivating while also preparing for his upcoming journey to Zhao Country.
Given Sha Hao's formidable strength, even if Xu Xinyang was able to refine all three magic artifacts as desired, Yuan Ming wasn't sure he would win in a direct confrontation, although he felt secure about his own protection.
A few days later, he used the finest materials, along with Hua Zhi's Poisonous Flowers, and tried to incorporate the potent poison from He Wendao's Green Flying Sword into a new batch of Seven-step Immovable.
The tremendous power of the Green Flying Sword's poison, augmented by the catalyzing effect of the Stealing Heaven Tripod, resulted in a rather formidable new batch of Seven-step Immovable.
The intense poison, mingling with the mist and directly inhaled into the body, acts faster than when penetrating through a wound. Yuan Ming tested it on several Second-level Demon Beasts in Rain Ruins Swamp, and they simply couldn't resist, immediately collapsing as their internal organs were eroded by the poison, quickly leading to death.
In addition, Yuan Ming purchased a batch of talismans from the workshop, mainly focusing on Middle-level attack talismans, totaling thirty to forty pieces.
His previous successful surprise attack with a talisman on Sha Hao had left him with a taste for more,
Little Lake City was a large workshop, and even First-Level Upper-Stage talismans were available, which Yuan Ming bought more than a dozen of judiciously.
Upper-Stage talismans were expensive, costing twenty to thirty Spirit Stones each, which made him, now more financially conscious, rather pained.
As for Second-level Talismans, firstly, they were not sold in Little Lake City, and the vast power they nestled meant that whether from Sect talisman masters or Loose Cultivators' talisman masters, any they made were quickly hoarded rather than brought out for open sale. And secondly, even if they were available, he couldn't afford them in the short term anyway.
Time flew, and when the agreed deadline arrived, Yuan Ming only then received the belated message from Xu Xinyang, who didn't mention any results but merely asked him to go to the Yuhe City shop to pick up his items.
Yuan Ming, upon hearing this, immediately left Little Lake City and headed to Rain Ruins Swamp to meet Hua Zhi.
As soon as he entered the Rain Ruins Swamp, the sky turned black with thick leaden clouds, from which torrential rain poured down, accompanied by deafening peals of thunder. Streaks of blinding lightning tore through the heavens as if to pierce the sky, more terrifying than any previous storm.
He quickly lowered his tunneling light and stayed close to the ground, advancing to avoid being struck by lightning.
The thunderstorm in the sky grew increasingly fierce, and even standing on the ground, Yuan Ming felt his hair stand on end and his body go numb.
"Such dense power of thunder and lightning, this is actually a good opportunity for Lei Yu to stretch its wings," he murmured to himself, then with a wave of his hand, he summoned the Winged Bird Lei Yu.
By now, Lei Yu had absorbed all the power of thunder and lightning from the Bronze Broken Sword, and its aura had grown significantly stronger.
Feeling the omnipresent thunder and lightning, Lei Yu let out an excited cry. After circling above Yuan Ming's head, it spread its wings and soared up, disappearing into the thunderclouds.
As the Winged Bird had the ability to control thunder and lightning, Yuan Ming was not worried about Lei Yu's safety and continued forward, soon arriving near Hua Zhi's nest.
"Master, are we going to teach Sha Hao a lesson?" Hua Zhi sensed Yuan Ming's approach from afar, coming up to meet him with a crowd of Little Demons.
When Hua Zhi was returned to the Rain Ruins Swamp, its injuries were almost healed. Now, about a month later, its wounds had completely recovered, and its body, damaged by the Bronze Thunder Pattern Array, had also regrown.
"Do you want to take these subordinates with you as well?" Yuan Ming nodded, looking at the crowd of Little Demons behind Hua Zhi, which numbered more than forty or fifty.
These Little Demons were all First-level Demon Beasts: there were birds, beasts, and two vine-type demon beasts like Hua Zhi.
The crowd of Little Demons, whose spiritual intelligence had not yet awakened, were not very afraid of Yuan Ming, several of them even curiously staring at him.Check for the latest updates on My Virtual Library Empire (*).
"Master, have you not yet determined the location of Sha Hao's Cave Mansion? The subordinates I've selected all have some scouting abilities, and I believe they could help you find Sha Hao," Hua Zhi communicated psychically.
"That will do." Yuan Ming pondered briefly, then waved his sleeve, casting a cyan glow that enveloped Hua Zhi and the Little Demons, sweeping them all into the Spiritual Beast Bag.
Hua Zhi, once it stretched out, was quite large. He had specially bought a large Spiritual Beast Bag for it, which was enough to contain these Little Demons.
At this moment, the previously wild and rampant storm began to subside. Seeing this, Yuan Ming used his mind to communicate with Lei Yu, telling it to come back quickly. However, he received no response.
Yuan Ming was startled and quickly leapt onto the White Jade Shuttle, flying towards the location of Lei Yu.
By the time he arrived, Lei Yu was still in mid-air, surrounded by dark clouds, which periodically shot out dazzling arcs of electricity, all pouring into the clouds and being absorbed by Lei Yu.
Lei Yu showed a hint of pain in its eyes, and its aura fluctuated wildly.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming felt a surge of joy in his heart. It seemed that Lei Yu was about to break through to the Second Level, and his careful cultivation these past days had not been in vain.
He immediately refrained from disturbing it and instead maneuvered the White Jade Shuttle to maintain a certain distance, intending to personally protect it and prevent any mishaps.
Time ticked by, and as Lei Yu continued to absorb the thunder and lightning from mid-air, its aura kept soaring, inching closer and closer to the Second Level.
However, the rain in the heavens had stopped and the dark clouds in the sky were quickly dissipating, leaving less and less thunder and lightning for absorption, slowing the growth of Lei Yu's aura.
Yuan Ming's brow furrowed. If the clouds completely cleared, Lei Yu's breakthrough would surely end in failure, possibly even causing it injury from backlash, which would affect its next attempt at a breakthrough.
Anxious, he took out the three High-Grade Thunder Attribute Spirit Stones, just about to throw them to Lei Yu, when suddenly another idea came to his mind.
He stood upright on the Flying Shuttle, hands hanging by his side, and began to channel his mana, attempting to cast the rain praying technique.
Over the past twenty days, Yuan Ming had taken possession of the old emperor and Liu Tianming again, subtly suggesting that they perform the Praying for Rain Secret Technique. By now, he had basically mastered the technique, though he had never performed it by himself. But with the situation pressing, there was no time for hesitation.
The moisture nearby rapidly thickened, and dense rain clouds began to appear in the sky, covering a few miles. Raindrops started falling sparsely.
Yuan Ming's Magic Power Cultivation was far from that of the old emperor, so the rain clouds created by his rain praying technique were only so big and relatively weak in power.
However, the thick water vapor in the Rain Ruins Swamp quickly gathered, causing the rain clouds in the sky to rapidly expand, and thunder and lightning once again appeared in mid-air, converging toward Lei Yu.
"Just as I thought," Yuan Ming nodded to himself.
His rain praying technique could only cover a ten-mile radius, which wasn't particularly useful, but the water vapor inside the Rain Ruins Swamp was too dense, accumulating in the sky. With just a little external force, it could easily form a wide-scale downpour.
With the help of this renewed power of thunder and lightning, Lei Yu's aura continued to rise sharply.
Accompanied by a resounding, piercing cry from among the clouds, the dark clouds in the sky churned violently, as if a dragon governing the clouds and rain was at work. Thunderous roars erupted, with silver lightning streaking through the clouds.
In an instant, the world was filled with an ominous atmosphere, and fierce winds raged!

chapters.title: Chapter 315 - 292: Tracing
chapters.content:
As a crisp and piercing cry came from within the dark clouds, the surging thunderclouds grew violently more intense, with silver lightning flashing wildly.
Boom, rumble!
Accompanied by the dense sound of thunderbolts, about two dozen thick bolts of lightning shot down from midair, creating a forest of lightning that struck a stretch of jungle over a hundred feet away.
In an instant, the lush undergrowth turned to nothing, the ground blasted with deep holes, and clumps of soil were flung into the air, leaving the whole area of the jungle two feet lower than the surrounding terrain and the ground scorched black.
Yuan Ming's face showed an expression of shock; the destructive power displayed by the lightning called down by the thunderstorm had exceeded that of second-level demon beasts, and even third-level demon beasts might not be capable of such an act. Could the lightning summoned by the Winged Bird truly be this powerful?
After a moment of thought, he realized that the majority of the lightning forest had been produced naturally by the Rain Ruins Swamp, complemented by the rainy weather, which gave the Winged Bird the advantage of the environment. Reliant solely on its own demonic power, it would be impossible to unleash such terrifying thunder strikes.
Lei Yu emerged from the dark clouds, his size having visibly increased a lot, now reaching a length of one and a half zhang, with the purple lightning patterns on his body appearing even more vivid; he looked extraordinarily majestic and now fully possessed the elegance of a second-level demon beast.
Yuan Ming raised his hand for a beckon, and Lei Yu glided down, landing on Yuan Ming's shoulder in the blink of an eye, issuing a cheerful chirp, as if flaunting to Yuan Ming.
Naturally, Yuan Ming offered some encouragement, and then instructed Lei Yu to demonstrate some of his various abilities.
After breaking through to the second level, Lei Yu's flying speed had increased significantly, and his stamina had also improved substantially. The power of the Thunder Strike Divine Ability emitted from his mouth had consequently increased greatly as well.
Furthermore, his spiritual intelligence seemed to have made no small progress, with the ability now to convey some relatively complete information.
Yuan Ming nodded secretly; by this moment, Lei Yu had indeed become a reliable assistant to him.
He put Lei Yu into the Spiritual Beast Bag, brought out the White Jade Shuttle, and headed off toward the northwest direction.
…
Yuhe City is a medium-sized city located at the southernmost edge of Zhao Country, bordering Da Jin.
After Yuan Ming arrived in the city, a little inquiry soon led him to the location of Xu Xinyang's shop.
He announced his name, was led into the inner room by shop attendants, and then saw Xu Xinyang.
Upon seeing Yuan Ming, Xu Xinyang did not speak, but waved his hand over a table beside him.
A flash of red light passed and three magic artifacts appeared on the table—the Black Needle, the White Jade Belt, and a splendid golden shield that dazzled the eyes.
Yuan Ming's breath hitched for a moment. He first picked up the Black Needle and scanned it with his Divine Sense, his eyes quickly lighting up with joy. Then he picked up the White Jade Belt and the golden shield, his face showing even more elation.
The Black Needle had already become a top-grade magical tool, the White Jade Belt had clearly been repaired, and as for the golden shield, although it was only a high-grade magical tool, it seemed quite impressive.
Although he had boldly asked the other party to refine two top-grade magical tools for him at the beginning, he actually understood that this was an exceedingly difficult task. Otherwise, with the other party's skills in Artifact Refining, he wouldn't have only managed to refine eleven top-grade magical tools up to now. To have succeeded with one now was already very rare.
"This Black Needle was already known for its speed and stealth, but against strong opponents or powerful defensive magical artifacts, its offensive edge was slightly lacking. Therefore, I added an 'Armor Breaking' rune to it, making it the twelfth top-grade magical tool I have refined in my career. As for the two gems on the White Jade Belt, I have re-empowered them to restore their spirit, and inscribed 'Gale' and 'Wind-breaking' runes anew," said Xu Xinyang.
"Thank you, Master Xu! To have all three magical artifacts refined in just twenty days far exceeds my expectations. Master Xu's Artifact Refining skills are indeed extraordinary. I am familiar with the Gale Rune, but what does the Wind-breaking Rune do?" Yuan Ming quickly expressed his gratitude, then asked with some curiosity.
"When one is moving rapidly, the faster you go, the greater the wind resistance you face. The Wind-breaking Rune can disperse the airflow resistance caused by high-speed movement, allowing your speed to reach new heights," Xu Xinyang explained.
"I see, thank you for the guidance, Master Xu," Yuan Ming said, nodding slowly.
"As for this Dragon Scale Shield, I actually put the most effort into it. These scales should be from a Golden Flood Dragon, with exceptionally abundant Gold Attribute Spiritual Power. Unfortunately, the person who harvested these Flood Dragon's Scales originally did not do so correctly and damaged its foundation. I used eight pieces of high-grade Gold Attribute Spirit Material to integrate into it, but I wasn't confident that it wouldn't be damaged after inscribing the fourth rune; therefore, I only refined it into a high-grade shield. However, its defensive power is almost on par with top-grade ones," Xu Xinyang added.
Hearing this, Yuan Ming was delighted and thanked him again. Once he paid the remaining six thousand Spirit Stones, he bid farewell and left.
He didn't linger in Yuhe City, heading straight for Wangyue City.
…
Like Little Lake City, Wangyue City is a city of cultivators, named after being backed by the Wangyue Mountain Range.
Wangyue Mountain Range is a rather large mountain range to the north of Zhao Country, stretching thousands of miles.Read ahead and get updates by visiting *.
With abundant mineral resources within Zhao Country's borders, the Wangyue Mountain Range was no exception, having once possessed several large spirit stone mines and spiritual material mines. However, these were completely mined out over a hundred years ago.
After continuous exploitation since ancient times, the Wangyue Mountain Range had been dug full of holes and was greatly depreciated in value, its Spiritual Energy gradually dwindling. Therefore, it was abandoned early on by the cultivation sects within Zhao Country's territory. Only certain Loose Cultivators occasionally entered the mountains to seek treasures.
Although the mineral treasures of the Wangyue Mountain Range were exhausted, it was still richer with nature's spiritual energy compared to ordinary mountain ranges. Since it was far from the influence of the large Cultivation Sects of Zhao Country, it became a lawless land where many Loose Cultivators chose to reside and established Cave Mansions.
In a cave dwelling somewhere within the mountain range, within a stone chamber around thirty to forty zhang in size.
A White Eagle stood on a stone pillar, resting with its eyes closed.
This place was arranged with a platform resembling an altar, about two to three zhang high, with ten or so stone steps on each side. The platform was inscribed with a black array, and right in the center, a black weapon about two feet long, resembling both a sword and a knife yet neither, was suspended in mid-air.
Around the array, according to the Eight Diagrams Directions, stood eight black spirit wood poles, from which strands of Yin Qi seeped out, all converging onto the black strange sword.
The black Sword Qi swallowed and spat ceaselessly, looking exceptionally spiritual, as though it possessed spiritual intelligence.
"The Soul Extinguishing Sword Energy has already stabilized in its initial stage, not in vain have I put in so many years of effort," Sha Hao stood before the array, carefully observing the black strange sword floating within, and muttered to himself.
As he spoke, he took out several sticks of black Yin Wood from his storage bracelet, replacing one in the array where the Yin Qi was thin, then took out a silver-white bell, the Soul-Attracting Bell, and gently shook it towards the direction of the black strange sword.
With a sound of an ethereal bell echoing, a smoke-like Soul Power dispersed from within the Soul-Attracting Bell, seemingly drawn by some invisible force towards the array, wrapping around the black strange sword like threads.
The moment this smoke touched the black strange sword, it was absorbed like clay oxen into the sea. Simultaneously, the Black Sword's body trembled slightly, emitting bursts of joyful and clear ringing.
There wasn't much Soul Power within the Soul-Attracting Bell, and it was quickly drained, causing the strange sword to also subside into silence.
"The souls of Qi Refinement Stage Cultivators are just too weak. It was all because of that Hagon messing up my plan. Otherwise, with Lu Shen and Bai Ye's Divine Souls to nourish it and a few more souls from those in the Foundation Establishment Stage, the Soul Destroying Sword would have been finished refining by now! Now that my identity has been exposed, even Chang Chun Temple will be on my heels!" Sha Hao put away the Soul-Attracting Bell, somewhat indignant, as he spoke to the White Eagle beside him.
"It's a pity that the tracking of the Soul-locking Pearl can only last three days. Otherwise, I'd definitely kill that Hagon. With such a strong soul from a Soul Cultivator, my Soul Destroying Sword could have been perfected!" Sha Hao's eyes were cold as he took out a white Round Orb and played with it.
The white Round Orb emitted a faint flow of Yin Qi, with three points of light suspended inside.
"It seems these three guys won't appear for a while. The tracking is quite tight at the moment, you go patrol around the cave mansion more, and see if there's anyone suspicious," Sha Hao said and turned to leave the stone chamber.
The White Eagle soared and flew out of the stone chamber.
...
At the same time, in another secret valley more than ten miles away, Yuan Ming sat cross-legged in a cave, resting with his eyes closed.
The ground shone with a yellow light, and Hua Zhi's head popped out.
"Have you investigated clearly?" Yuan Ming asked, without opening his eyes.
"I've had those under me thoroughly scout the ten-mile radius around Sha Hao's cave mansion, and found nothing unusual. It seems this Sha Hao is quite arrogant and does not believe he will be discovered, hence he hasn't prepared any means against his adversaries. Only that White Eagle is continuously patrolling the sky, but it won't suspect anything," Hua Zhi reported.
Listening to this, Yuan Ming nodded slightly.
Sha Hao's hiding place was indeed well concealed—it would be incredibly difficult to discover it if not for Yuan Ming's possession by Black Incense.
"There's a formidable demon beast hibernating beneath Sha Hao's cave mansion. I took the risk and scouted; it's a Second-level Demon Snake with the ability to tunnel through the earth. It's likely Sha Hao's spirit beast, in charge of guarding the cave mansion," Hua Zhi added.
"A Second-level Demon Snake that can tunnel through the earth? Leave this beast to you, then. Proceed as planned," Yuan Ming raised his eyebrows slightly as he spoke.
"Rest assured, Master," Hua Zhi confidently replied, diving back into the ground and disappearing.
"Sha Hao... must be eliminated. Otherwise, he will be a never-ending trouble." After Hua Zhi left, Yuan Ming opened his eyes and murmured to himself.
Having finished speaking, he stood up, changed into a set of black clothes, and put on the Thousand Mechanism Mask.
His appearance rapidly changed, and within a few breaths, he had transformed into a middle-aged man with a square face.
He then applied the Hidden Element Technique to conceal his aura and sped toward the direction of Sha Hao's cave mansion.
Yuan Ming had been in the Wangyue Mountain Range for several days now. Relying on his possession by Black Incense and with the help of those inconspicuous small demon beasts under Hua Zhi, he had smoothly located the exact position of Sha Hao's cave mansion.
Yet, since Sha Hao was so powerful, Yuan Ming did not rashly approach, preferring to make detailed preparations here first.
Sha Hao and he had already forged a deadly enmity, and his identity as a Soul Cultivator was also known to the opponent. He could not afford to fail this hunt!
...
Inside the cave mansion, the Divine Power around Sha Hao rose and fell erratically, seemingly cultivating some kind of Divine Soul Secret Technique.
Suddenly, a low growl came from underground, echoing within the secret chamber.
Sha Hao opened his eyes and took out a blue Round Mirror from his bosom, pinching and pointing on it.
The Round Mirror glowed with a dim blue light, revealing the figure of a middle-aged man.
"Eh? This man looks somewhat familiar; he seems to be Manager Liao of Five Thunders Pavilion in Wangyue City. Could it be that he followed my trail here? No wonder yesterday, when I returned from the market, I faintly felt someone was tracking me," Sha Hao muttered to himself with a turn of a cold expression in his eyes.
"No matter what Five Thunder Sect it is, since you've come to my doorstep, then I will unceremoniously reap your Divine Soul," he sneered and got up, walking outside.

chapters.title: Chapter 316 - 293: Battle with Sha Hao Again
chapters.content:
Manager Liao of the Five Thunders Pavilion in Wangyue City, mentioned by Sha Hao, was none other than Yuan Ming in disguise.
At this time, he was wandering around the entrance of Sha Hao's Cave Mansion, looking as if he was searching for the entrance when suddenly, his face showed a look of alarm, and his figure blurred slightly, transforming into an illusion as he shot forward.
The moment Yuan Ming darted out, a black Sword Shadow, resembling a Wide-blade Short Sword, shot out from nowhere and embedded itself in the spot where he had been standing just a moment before.
The fierce Sword Qi suddenly erupted, and the ground collapsed with a loud bang, creating a pit a zhang in diameter and three zhang deep.
Sha Hao's figure flashed near the deep pit as he sneered slightly, having already locked onto Yuan Ming with his Divine Sense. He muttered under his breath as if casting some Magic.
Yuan Ming had barely burst forth by a dozen zhang when his figure slightly staggered, a trace of confusion crossed his eyes, but it immediately returned to normal. He activated his White Jade Belt to increase his speed and continued to escape into the distance.
"Eh!" Sha Hao showed a look of surprise. The presence of the man in front of him had suddenly changed to that of the Foundation Establishment Stage, and he had easily broken through his own Illusion Technique—an unprecedented feat.
And the man had already gotten near his Cave Mansion, so he absolutely could not be left alive!
Sha Hao took out a talisman and crushed it, and a layer of blue light suddenly surrounded him, chasing after Yuan Ming at high speed.
Yuan Ming was not particularly fast, and each time when Sha Hao felt he was about to catch up, Yuan Ming would increase his speed or use some other method to widen the gap, which left Sha Hao grinding his teeth in frustration.
The two of them continued their chase and flight and soon came to a small mountain valley.
Sha Hao saw Yuan Ming heading towards a pond not far ahead. The pond water was clear, and the shores were covered with eggstones. It was an exceptionally serene environment. Nonetheless, he vaguely felt threatened by this place and suddenly stopped in his tracks,
Being able to sense danger from such a distance, Sha Hao's combat instincts were indeed powerful. Yuan Ming, noticing the situation behind him, sighed in his heart. While mentally communicating with Hua Zhi, he called out the Stealing Heaven Tripod, held it in his palm, and quickly lit two sticks of Spirit Incense inside—the Fog Incense and the newly made Seven-step Immovable.
As Yuan Ming sped along, wisps of white mist began lightly diffusing into the valley, blending into the air.
Upon seeing this, Sha Hao's face showed alertness. He turned and leaped back, but the ground beneath his feet suddenly exploded, and thick Purple-black Vines, like giant pythons, lunged at him, blocking every possible escape route.
Several zhang below the surface, Hua Zhi lay in ambush, draped in Yuan Ming's gray cloak, masking all its scents.
"Hagon, it's you!" Sha Hao recognized the Purple-black Vines and instantly understood everything.
He, however, did not panic; the talisman he had been holding in his hand was now slapped onto his body, and a thick yellow light shield appeared around him. The Purple-black Vines struck the yellow light shield and were vibrated back.
Sha Hao boosted his Divine Sense to probe beneath the ground, preparing to subdue Hua Zhi with an Illusion Technique once more. However, the surrounding mist had become thicker, and an invisible force filled it, making it dense and continuous, so that his Divine Sense could not extend outward.
Sha Hao felt a sinking feeling in his heart and quickly brought out the silver sphere. As soon as the four runes on the sphere were activated, it emitted a dazzling silver light and swiftly swept around his body. The black Wide-blade Short Sword he wielded spun around him, slashing out over a dozen fierce Sword Qi, aiming at the surrounding vines.
Though Hua Zhi's vines were tough, they were sliced through in the blink of an eye under the simultaneous attacks of the silver sphere and Short Sword, clearing away all the vines.
Knowing that Hagon was a formidable opponent and fearing that he might have fallen into a trap, Sha Hao did not dare to linger after clearing the vines, and immediately flew back towards his Cave Mansion.
At that moment, the figure of Vajra flashed out from the hazy mist ahead, his fists striking towards Sha Hao's chest with a speed like thunder, rippling the air with visible waves.
Taken by surprise, Sha Hao had no time to bring out his Defensive Magical Artifact and could only drive the silver sphere and black Short Sword in front of him while his body lit up with a bright Golden Light.
With a 'bang', the silver sphere and black Short Sword were sent flying far away, the yellow light shield shattered, and a mighty force like a landslide swept over him. Sha Hao's body was hurled through the air and smashed heavily into the ground, spitting out a mouthful of blood.
Without waiting for Sha Hao to leap up, the ground nearby cracked again, and over a dozen thick vines burst forth from the earth, winding tightly around his body and wrapping him up like a zongzi.
By this time, Yuan Ming had flitted to the side of the pond, activating the Thousand-Knot Water Rope Array. Two or three dozen transparent Water Ropes quickly condensed and shot towards Sha Hao like arrows.
Trapped by Hua Zhi's Vines, Sha Hao had no way to dodge the Water Ropes and was bound tightly by them, completely immobilized.
Vajra leaped into the air and took out the Earth Burying Mallet. The Mallet's yellow light surged, aiming for Sha Hao's head.
"You stinking monkey, don't think of stealing the credit!" Hua Zhi roared from beneath the earth, displaying its Green Sword Skill. The tips of the Vines holding Sha Hao turned into green wooden swords, stabbing towards various parts of Sha Hao's body.
Despite facing such peril, Sha Hao showed no sign of panic. His arms suddenly glowed with a blue light and with a snake-like twist, he wriggled free from the Vines and Water Rope. He opened his palms simultaneously, with a hint of Blood Light flickering within.
Hua Zhi, lurking beneath the ground, saw the scenery change abruptly as an Endless sea of Fire enveloped it, immobilizing all its Vines as if by an immobilization spell.
Vajra was also instantly trapped in an illusion, becoming rigid, and his leaping body slumped, falling to the ground with a 'thud'.
From the moment Sha Hao noticed something amiss and stopped the chase, to quickly subduing Hua Zhi and Vajra, only a few breaths of time had passed.
Behind a nearby large rock, a black Soul Crow's head peeked out.
With the Fog Incense concealing him, Sha Hao should not have been able to extend his Divine Sense. Yuan Ming wore a look of astonishment as he recognized something was amiss through the sight of the Soul Crow.
In the palms of Sha Hao's hands, two faint blood-colored patterns emerged, extremely fine, and almost invisible from a distance.
Upon seeing this, Yuan Ming flipped his hand and took out an Earth Tunneling Talisman, and his figure disappeared into the ground.
After Sha Hao used an Illusion Technique to trap Vajra and Hua Zhi, he quickly chanted a spell and a layer of blue light appeared on his body, which he twisted to break free from the vines and Water Rope.
At the same time, two Blood Bats flew out from his sleeves, circling nearby as if on alert.
Sha Hao's footsteps as he landed were noticeably staggered, and a trace of green appeared on his face. He forced himself to keep going, took out a blood-red elixir, swallowed it, and raised a hand to summon something from the direction of his Cave Mansion, while an obscure spell could be heard from his mouth.
Inside Sha Hao's Cave Mansion, the Black Strange Sword within the array burst with Sword Qi, suddenly breaking free from the Array's constraint, and shot outwards at high speed.
The ground in front of the Cave Mansion flashed with a yellow glow, and a yellow giant python emerged; it was over a dozen zhang long, covered with palm-sized yellow scales, and had several thick yellow bone spurs growing on its forehead and neck, making it look extremely ferocious.
The yellow python twisted its body, quickly wriggling towards the direction of Sha Hao.
...
T.h&i.s& vers&io!n was sour$c#ed f*ro^m- M&|%V|L^E.M+PY+R.+
Whatever the blood-red elixir Sha Hao ingested was, it caused a surge of blood-colored energy to spread across his face, dispelling much of the green.
He secretly breathed a sigh of relief and formed a hand seal with his right hand.
The silver sphere shot back towards him; the four runes inside it lit up, and a dazzling silver light burst out, aiming viciously at the head of Vajra.
Previously, when he fought against Hagon, he trapped this White Ape with an Illusion Technique but did not kill it in time, which backfired on him. This time, he would not repeat the mistake.
At that moment, a Golden Shadow flashed by, and a golden shield appeared in front of Vajra.
A harsh, ear-piercing sound of a tremendous collision, "clang", echoed in all directions.
The Dragon Scale Shield's surface flickered with Golden Light, and the face of the shield showed a distinct dent, but it managed to block the silver light.
A burst of green light emerged from the ground, enveloping Vajra and the Dragon Scale Shield, and with a flicker, both disappeared, revealed to be Yuan Ming who had been lurking underground to save Vajra in the nick of time.
Sha Hao, wary of Yuan Ming's mystifying Illusion Technique, did not dare to hesitate and immediately moved towards Hua Zhi's location.
Seeing this, Sha Hao was not alarmed but rather seemed pleased, directing the two Blood Bats toward the ground; he opened his mouth as if to spit out something, but at that moment, two rumbles of thunder sounded overhead, and two bolts of Purple Thunder tore through the fog and struck towards the two Blood Bats.
The Blood Bats, manifestations of Sha Hao's Divine Soul Transformation, were extremely wary of the power of thunder and lightning; Sha Hao quickly maneuvered them to evade the purple lightning strikes.
He looked up to the sky and saw the shadow of a black bird flitting through the mist, surrounded by strands of purple thunder and lightning, moving with exceptional speed.
Sha Hao recognized it as Yuan Ming's spiritual bird. He snorted coldly, whistled sharply, and from not far away, a White Eagle rushed in from the sky, plunging towards the Winged Bird wrapped in thunder and lightning.
Sha Hao circulated his Soul Power in silence, and blood light flashed from his forehead, sending out eight Blood Bats in rapid succession, all opening their mouths to spray at Yuan Ming's location.
Great waves of blood-colored patterns gushed out and surged into the ground.
With the Winged Bird's diversion buying time, Yuan Ming was nearly at Hua Zhi's side, and just as he was about to arrive, he hit the blood-colored patterns sprayed by the Blood Bats.
At that moment, Yuan Ming's vision blurred, and he found himself in a fiery red world.
Indeed, the moment the blood-colored patterns touched his body, he fell into an illusion. Unlike the last Illusion Technique, in this illusion, Yuan Ming lost his freedom, tied to a cross of about a zhang high, with chains locking his limbs down tightly, unable to budge. From all directions, tendrils of flames swept in, licking at his body.
Yuan Ming's skin was instantly scorched, turning charred and sending waves of intense pain that attacked his will, causing his Divine Soul Power to quickly weaken.
Yuan Ming knew he had to break free from the illusion soon, or his Divine Soul would suffer greatly, and his mind quickly focused.
Suspended in his Sea of Consciousness was a shadow that suddenly pounced toward his Divine Soul, clearly, it was a soul crow.
He was planning to use the Soul Collision Divine Ability on himself.
Among the Classics he had purchased, in addition to explaining the principles and methods of casting Illusion Techniques, some also provided insights into breaking illusions.
Once trapped in an illusion, all five senses are under the control of the opponent. To break free, one needs to apply sufficient stimulus to oneself.
Yuan Ming had previously bitten his tongue and used the penetrating pain to break free from Sha Hao's illusion—that was one method.
However, physical stimuli are not very effective for breaking illusions and can only counteract common illusions. Against strong illusions, they don't work, and more intense influences are needed—for instance, a stimulus targeting the Divine Soul.
At the moment, the only method that could shake his Divine Soul was the Soul Collision Divine Ability.

chapters.title: Chapter 317 - 294: Soul Destroying Sword Energy
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming didn't know if a soul collision could break the illusion, but at this moment of life and death, even if it meant severely injuring his own Divine Soul, he spared no effort, making the soul crow hit his Divine Soul with full force.
An excruciating pain that almost exploded assailed him, his Soul Power in the Sea of Consciousness was scattered by thirty percent, but the illusion before his eyes also disappeared following this stimulation.
Yuan Ming quickly composed himself and took a deep breath.
Soul collision indeed had a miraculous effect on breaking illusions, though the force seemed too strong. He estimated that using half the power of the soul collision could have broken Sha Hao's illusion.
As his thoughts shifted, his actions did not stop; he continued moving underground, quickly reached Hua Zhi's side, waved his hand to put it into the Spiritual Beast Bag, and then continued moving forward.
He did not use soul collision to awaken the two beasts because, firstly, the power of soul collision was too great and could cause irreversible trauma to the Divine Souls of Hua Zhi and Vajra with just a slight mishap, and secondly, the soul crow had greatly drained his Soul Power, which he needed to conserve.
Based on his previous experience, Sha Hao's illusions had a distance limit; as long as they escaped far enough, the illusions affecting the two beasts would automatically dissolve.
Sha Hao sensed that Yuan Ming had broken free from his illusion, his eyes revealing disbelief. This was the illusion he had created at great expense of his Soul Power, deploying eight Blood Bats, which even he himself would struggle to escape. He had intended to kill Hagon in one strike, yet he had failed.
Sha Hao's gaze grew more serious—this was an unprecedented formidable enemy since his Foundation Establishment, and his desire to kill grew even stronger.
Just then, a black light pierced through the white fog and steadily landed in his hand—the Black Strange Sword.
Good, you are worthy for me to wield the Soul Destroying Sword!
Sha Hao gripped the Black Sword, the blade emitting a black sword light about a zhang long, vaguely spreading a wild aura. He swung it downward into the void, the Black Sword emitting a ghostly wail, and next the black light flashed, releasing a Black Sword Qi about thirty zhang long, plunging directly into the ground.
The surface showed no trace, and the soft soil and sand remained undisturbed as if the Black Sword Qi was just an illusion, disappearing in a flash.
Deep underground, Yuan Ming quickly advanced, quickly putting seventy to eighty zhang between him and Sha Hao. Vajra and Hua Zhi were faintly showing signs of awakening. Feeling slightly relieved, he continued moving forward, while planning in his mind how to counterattack next. Since he had come today, he had not planned to return without achieving anything. Just then, a light suddenly brightened ahead, and Yuan Ming tunneled out of the soil layer and landed in a large mining cave.
The area of this mining cave was about four or five hundred zhang, with a height of more than ten zhang, everywhere covered with dust, obviously abandoned for many years. Sha Hao's cave mansion was built on this vein, so it was normal to have several underground mines nearby. He didn't mind and was about to find a direction to continue forward.
Just at that moment, his heart skipped a beat, a bad premonition faintly arising. He swiftly turned his head to look behind, sensing a sharp aura rapidly approaching from behind. He shivered, hurriedly releasing his Divine Sense, but his Divine Sense was immediately shredded upon contacting that sharp aura, then forcefully swallowed.
A stinging pain surged in Yuan Ming's brain at the same time as a shock in his heart. He hurriedly retracted his remaining Divine Sense and turned to look behind. A flash of golden light passed by his side, and he summoned the Dragon Scale Shield in front of him.
In the blink of an eye, a black light flashed on the cave wall, and a Black Sword Qi burst out, heading straight for his face.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming activated the Dragon Scale Shield to meet it while stepping sideways to dodge.
However, the Dragon Scale Shield was also penetrated by the Black Sword Qi in a flash, offering no protection at all. The Black Sword Qi, as if it had eyes, changed direction and continued to slash towards Yuan Ming!
Yuan Ming, startled, hurriedly activated the White Jade Belt, his steps performing the Shadowless Step, creating several blurry afterimages.
But the Black Sword Qi was unaffected, directly heading for his real body, increasing in speed and soon cornering him in a corner of the cave.Visit My Virtual Library Empire (*) for more.
With nowhere to retreat, Yuan Ming flung his hands outward, and dozens of Mid-level Talismans flew out from his hands, transforming into Fire Snakes, Water Swords, and Thunder and Lightning Magic, striking towards the Black Sword Qi.
The Fire Snakes, Water Swords, and the like also failed to have any effect; only the Thunder and Lightning Magic hitting the Black Sword Qi caused it to pause momentarily, but it was far from being crushed.
A look of elation appeared in Yuan Ming's eyes. Three silver talismans appeared in his hand, which he immediately activated through casting. These three talismans were called Heavenly Thunder Talismans, purchased as First-level Upper Stage Talismans in Little Lake City.
The sound of crackling was intense, and three bowl-thick silver thunders emerged, resembling three silver Thunder Flood Dragons, snapping their jaws as they pounced toward the sword qi.
Silver Thunder surrounded by dazzling silver thunder runes lighted up the entire cave, striking the Black Sword Qi.
With a thunderous "bang," the Black Sword Qi was greatly shattered.
The remaining Sword Qi still stubbornly shot forward, finally catching up to Yuan Ming, striking him on the head.
Yuan Ming's head remained unharmed; the remaining Black Sword Qi, upon touching his body, instantly entered the Sea of Consciousness and chopped directly at his Divine Soul!
An aura that made his Divine Soul tremble enveloped him, his entire Divine Soul feeling as if it were being crushed and then absorbed.
In desperation, Yuan Ming's mind moved, and three bursts of black light flashed in the Sea of Consciousness. Three soul crows formed, lined up to meet the Black Sword Qi, simultaneously employing the Soul Collision Divine Ability.
Bang! Bang! Bang!
Three loud bangs resounded, two soul crows struck the Black Sword Qi, were sequentially shredded by it, and the Black Sword Qi quickly shrank and weakened, finally being shattered by the third soul crow's Soul Collision Divine Ability, but the third soul crow also disbanded and dispersed.
Yuan Ming's complexion immediately turned as pale as paper.
With his current level in the Soul Cultivation Realm, he could only rally six soul crows in a single battle, and he had already used four of them, leaving only two. It was impossible to replenish them in a short time.
The Soul Power in his Sea of Consciousness was also greatly depleted, less than one third of its original amount.
The black Sword Qi could even target the Divine Soul directly; had its power been slightly stronger, Yuan Ming might have truly perished here.
Still shaken, Yuan Ming took out an elixir to recover, circulated the Moonlight Technique, and slightly soothed his agitated Divine Soul.
At that moment, a warm flow emanated from the incense burner mark on his arm, infusing into his Sea of Consciousness and rapidly restoring his sparse Soul Power, which replenished by a great extent in the blink of an eye.
Yuan Ming's heart then settled down somewhat.
At this time, Vajra and Hua Zhi in the Spiritual Beast Bag awakened from the illusion one after another.
Although the black Sword Qi released by Sha Hao was too bizarre and alarming, even surpassing that silver sphere, he was already poisoned. The newly formed Seven-step Immovable's power was astonishing, the deadly poison was undoubtedly corroding his viscera, and he would struggle to recover momentarily.
Yuan Ming's Soul Power, however, was rapidly recovering due to the Stealing Heaven Tripod, and along with the support from Hua Zhi and Vajra, the situation still remained under his control.
After a brief ponder, Yuan Ming only released Hua Zhi and then activated the Earth Tunneling Talisman, retracing the way he had come.
At this time, Sha Hao was sitting cross-legged on the ground, his face flickering with blood light, fully cultivating to expel the poison, and the black strange sword was nowhere to be seen.
Next to him coiled a massive yellow giant python with its head raised erect and two earth-toned eyes alertly scanning the surroundings.
During his subterranean journey, Yuan Ming had observed the presence of the giant yellow python through the soul crow.
The Qiu Snake was no ordinary demon snake but a mutant demon snake, possessing potential for a Flood Dragon Transformation like the Golden Flower Poison Python.
However, the Qiu Snake, an Earth Attribute demon beast, lacked the severe poison characteristic of the Golden Flower Poison Python but was renowned for its great strength and sturdiness and could cast various Earth Attribute Divine Skills, making it a rare spirit beast.
Observing the demon energy of this Qiu Snake, it had already reached the Second Rank Upper Stage.
During these swift thoughts, Yuan Ming immediately communicated with Lei Yu.
...
In the sky, Lei Yu was still chasing the White Eagle.
When Lei Yu was a Level 1 demon beast, its speed was already superior to that of the White Eagle. Now that it had broken through to the second level, its speed was far greater than its opponent, but in a head-to-head fight, it was only considered on par, thus it had kept the White Eagle entangled in the sky.
Feeling Yuan Ming's summoning, Lei Yu shook off the White Eagle and flew back above Sha Hao, emitting a sharp screech.
The originally clear sky suddenly filled with dark clouds. A fierce wind arose, and the sea of fog below also churned ceaselessly. Soon, thunder rumbled ominously.
The White Eagle quickly caught up, but Lei Yu had already hidden within the dark clouds. Streaks of electricity flashed through the clouds intermittently, making the White Eagle too cautious to enter and only anxiously circled nearby.
The Qiu Snake raised its head towards the sky, showing a trace of fear. A yellow glow radiated from its body. Most of its body submerged underground, seemingly finding solace in this manner. Being an inherently Yin Qi-bearing demon beast, it had a natural fear of thunder.
Sha Hao naturally noticed the situation in the sky as well but was at a critical moment in suppressing the violent poison within his body and could not afford to be distracted.
The dark clouds overhead quickly thickened, and soon, a heavy rain poured down. A series of dazzling thunderbolts began moving through the layers of clouds, significantly smaller compared to when Divine Skills were used inside the Rain Ruins Swamp.
The next moment, the dark clouds suddenly pressed lower, and five to six silver thunderbolts struck down towards Sha Hao and the Qiu Snake.
Sha Hao transmitted his thoughts to the Qiu Snake to help him withstand for a while.
Just as the Qiu Snake was about to forcibly overcome its fear to act, it felt the destructive aura emanating from the silver thunderbolts. Its body "slithered" instinctively, burrowing into the ground.
Sha Hao, both shocked and enraged, had to momentarily stop his detoxification efforts and waved his hand to summon a gray umbrella-shaped Magic Artifact.
The Grey Umbrella opened above his head, spinning with a swish, and dazzling golden light burst from the surface of the umbrella, forming a substantial golden protective shield in an instant that guarded the area below Sha Hao.
Several silver thunders struck the golden protective shield, sparking clusters of dazzling silver light, yet the golden shield remained unshaken.
A look of murderous intent flashed in Sha Hao's eyes. No longer caring to continue expelling the poison, a dark glow flashed through his right hand as the black strange sword reappeared. He took a deep breath and swung towards a spot on the ground behind him, slicing through the air.
With a "sizzling" sound, a slightly smaller dark black Sword Qi was chopped down.
Just as the Sword Qi was about three feet above the ground, a figure leaped from below and dashed towards the distance, unmistakably Yuan Ming himself.

chapters.title: Chapter 318 - 295: Soul Sword
chapters.content:
At this moment, Yuan Ming had figured out the intricacies of the black sword qi and was no longer as flustered as before. As he retreated backward, he flicked his wrist and threw out four Heavenly Thunder Talismans in one breath, while a black needle shadow also shot out from his sleeve, disappearing in a flash.
Half of the First-level Upper Stage talismans he had purchased in Little Lake City were Heavenly Thunder Talismans, specifically chosen because the Thunder Attribute posed a certain restraint on Soul Cultivators. Now, he used them all at once.
Amid the thundering sound, four massive Thunder Flood Dragons appeared and struck the black sword qi.
Although the black sword qi was formidable, it couldn't withstand the combined strike of four Heavenly Thunder Talismans and disintegrated into blue smoke with a "sizzle."
Simultaneously, a fuzzy black line flashed before the circling White Eagle in the mid-air storm clouds. Before it could react, the black needle blurred for a moment and pierced through the head of the White Eagle, causing it to plummet rapidly.
After advancing to a top-grade magical tool, the Black Needle not only had an attack power that was unimaginably high, but its speed also greatly increased. A common Second-level demon beast like the White Eagle had no chance to retaliate.
"Hagon!" Sha Hao felt the death of the White Eagle and was deeply pained, recklessly charging towards Hagon.
However, a silver thunderbolt fell from the storm clouds with a "thunderous boom," striking Sha Hao with a thickness much greater than the previous lightning strikes.
Sha Hao dared not be careless and had to stop, activating his Grey Umbrella and unleashing a golden protective shield to defend himself.
The silver thunderbolt struck the golden protective shield, causing it to tremble violently.
Sha Hao's complexion slightly changed, obviously surprised by the power of the thunderbolt, and his previous poisoning, combined with the consecutive swings of the Soul Destroying Sword, had also significantly depleted him.
But this electric strike was just the beginning. The thundering inside the storm clouds grew louder as one bolt of lightning after another fell, shaking the golden protective shield sporadically, almost to the breaking point.
The hovering gray umbrella overhead also dimmed, severely damaged in spirit.
Sha Hao's expression darkened like water, and with a low roar, he made several hand seals towards the umbrella, causing it to burst forth with intense golden light and finally stabilized the light shield.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming immediately formed hand seals with both hands.
The storm clouds summoned by the Lei Yu rapidly enlarged and thickened, expanding several times within moments, and the lightning zipping inside the clouds also doubled in size.
Lei Yu, hidden within the clouds, was delighted. Thunder shone brightly on his wings, sending purple electric arcs shooting out in all directions.
The lightning within the rain clouds, as if summoned, all converged towards the center, intertwining and entangling.
With a "thunderous boom," a thunder column as thick as a bowl fell from the sky, striking Sha Hao on the ground.
Seeing this, Sha Hao bellowed, his clothes inflating and then bursting apart, revealing a golden half-body inner armor. A continuous stream of golden light flowed from within the armor, covering his entire body like a light curtain.
Just as he finished these preparations, "crackle" the golden protective shield shattered like glass, and the grey umbrella was also destroyed.
The undiminished power of the silver thunder column continued to strike Sha Hao, producing a deafening sound.
The golden light curtain trembled violently, its surface flashing chaotically with electric sparks and emitting a piercing roar.
The light curtain rapidly thinned and faint cracks began to appear.
Sha Hao's face looked extremely grim as his facial muscles twisted. He bit his tongue, spraying essence blood onto the golden inner armor.
Liquid-like golden light surged from the inner armor and circulated around his body, restoring the golden light curtain to its original state and seemingly making it even thicker than before.
Sha Hao breathed a sigh of relief, but a trace of pain flickered through his eyes as the suppressed green Qi rose again on his cheeks.
Then, with a sudden jolt, he suppressed his discomfort and stimulated the silver sphere to shoot out a bright silver light toward a certain point in the void.
There was a "bang" sound!
A dark shadow was blasted away by the silver light—it was Yuan Ming's top-grade magical tool, the Black Needle!
Meanwhile, from another misty side, two golden talismans and a greenish-blue sphere flew out—two First-level Upper Stage Golden Spear Talismans and the last Heart-splitting Bomb.
Two shadows of Golden Spears, each about a zhang long, and a massive thunder column appeared out of thin air and struck the golden protective shield.
Sha Hao was shocked and tried to activate the silver sphere again to block, but it was too late.
The three attacks fiercely struck the golden light curtain surrounding him. The light curtain trembled violently, and Sha Hao staggered.
Before he could stabilize himself, the Black Needle magical tool struck again from behind, piercing the golden light curtain and penetrating nearly half its length before wriggling like a venomous snake, drilling further inside.
The golden light curtain shook nonstop, again showing signs of failure.
Sha Hao felt a chill in his heart and started making wheel-like hand seals. Then with a roar, he pressed his hand firmly on the golden light curtain, pouring mana into it.
But just then, a burst of white mist opposite the Black Needle bloomed, and the White Ape Vajra appeared, grasping the Earth Burying Mallet and swinging it down viciously!
"Bang!" With a huge noise!
The golden light screen trembled violently, and cracks appeared on its surface, clearly unable to hold any longer.
Sha Hao's face was stricken with horror, just about to repair it desperately, when suddenly his face surged with a dense, green color and the intense poison within his body erupted completely.
His body quivered, a mouthful of green-tinged blood spurted out, and he collapsed weakly onto the ground.
The eyes of Vajra glinted with a bloodthirsty excitement. A flash of golden light passed under his rib, and his two ape arms shot forward, transforming into two afterimages that struck the golden light screen, making the surrounding air buzz and tremble.
Finally, under Vajra's fierce pounding, the light screen shattered with a bang, scattering into countless golden specks of light.
The freed Black Needle Magical Artifact immediately transformed into a blurry black line, piercing through Sha Hao's Dantian.
Sha Hao groaned in agony, the Mana remaining in his Dantian dissipating completely as he half-knelt on the ground.
"Boom!"To report errors, please visit the original post on *.
Another silver thunder column came crashing down, engulfing Sha Hao's body, while the two Blood Bats coiling around him were also enveloped by the Power of Thunder and Lightning, extinguished instantly before they could even scream.
The bright and dazzling thunder light quickly faded, revealing Sha Hao's charred body, already passed out, his breathing extremely faint, barely clinging to life.
A silver sphere rolled to a stop next to him, motionless.
The surface of the sphere had several obvious scratches, but its Mana fluctuations were stable, and it had not suffered major damage.
In his other hand, he was still tightly clutching that black strange sword. The spirit light on its surface was somewhat dim and the chaotic flicker of black light on the blade gave the impression it could collapse at any moment.
Yuan Ming emerged from the white mist, took out the Cold Star Sword, and touched it to the two artifacts, neither of which reacted.
He activated the Cold Star Sword, forming thick white ice crystals on the two artifacts, enveloping them. Yuan Ming then collected them both, and approached Sha Hao, gesturing with one hand.
The Black Needle Magical Artifact flashed into existence in front of Sha Hao, aimed at his forehead, ready to pierce through his skull at any sign of movement.
Sha Hao's Illusion Technique was formidable; Yuan Ming had to stay alert.
However, Sha Hao made no move at all, his breath growing weaker and weaker; it seemed he really was nearing his end.
Finally reassured, Yuan Ming removed the inner armor and Storage Ring from Sha Hao's body, pressed his right hand against his head, and performed the Soul Searching Divine Ability.
He quickly withdrew his hand and stood in place, silently and without speaking.
Through Soul Searching, Yuan Ming mostly understood what happened to Sha Hao after the destruction of Biluo Cave.
On the day Biluo Cave was destroyed, Sha Hao woke up amidst Xi Ying's illusion to find the Soul Suppressing Kettle he was guarding missing. Fearing the Great Elder's pursuit for his negligence, and believing the Great Elder wouldn't stand a chance against Xi Ying, he took the opportunity when no one was watching him and hastily fled Biluo Cave.
Before leaving, he decided to take everything and swept away all the items stored by the Great Elder in the cave, and made his way to Central Plains.
Sha Hao then assumed the name Pu Zhengqing and began hunting cultivators across Central Plains—not for wealth, as the Great Elder's collection, whether Spirit Stones, materials, or elixirs, left him with plenty to spend for a considerable time. He hunted cultivators primarily for that black strange sword.
Yuan Ming took out the Black Sword, his eyes becoming eager.
According to Sha Hao's soul memories, this sword, named "Soul Extinguishing," was indeed a top-grade Soul Cultivation Magical Artifact.
As a disciple of the Great Elder, Sha Hao had spent ten years gathering precious materials for the Great Elder to request Master Hei Mu to refine.
The Soul Extinguishing Sword was forged using Nine Nether Iron as the main material, combined with many Yin Attribute Spiritual Materials from Southern Border. When activated, the Soul Destroying Sword Light it emitted could attack the Divine Soul, ignoring the defenses of most Defensive Magical Artifacts.
Nine Nether Iron is the highest grade of Yin Attribute Spiritual Material. Yuan Ming had seen records of this material in the Record of Strange Stones; it originated in Extremely Yin Land, a product of the fusion of Yin Qi and Nether Iron Ore, with an incredibly hard texture, not susceptible to common elemental weaknesses like thunder, flames, or other such forces, making it incredibly difficult to destroy.
Moreover, Nine Nether Iron had one special property: it could absorb Soul Power and thus was also called "Soul Capturing Nether Iron." The Divine Souls slashed by the Soul Extinguishing Sword would be absorbed and digested, enhancing its own power.
The refining of Soul Extinguishing Sword was extremely difficult starting from the Forging Embryo step. The runes on the sword were copied from the runes on the Soul Suppressing Kettle by the Great Elder. When Master Hei Mu reached the final engraving step in the refining, he found the sword to be ferocious and seized the opportunity to secretly escape. Master Hei Mu's desertion led to the collapse of the sword's runes.
At this point, Yuan Ming recalled a passage in the Black Wood Handbook, "Tripped up during the refining of a special secret treasure." Master Hei Mu's final words also said, "If this continues, everyone will die!".
It turns out, his choice to leave Biluo Cave was related to the forging nau

chapters.title: Chapter 319 - 296: Annihilation
chapters.content:
"So, the Soul Extinguishing Sword was refined by the Three Cave Masters. It appears to share the same creator as my Cold Star Sword," Yuan Ming murmured, looking at the strange black sword in his hand.
He sensed the four runes on the body of the sword, aware only of the "Soul Stabilizing" rune, while the other three were unfamiliar to him. However, he conjectured that they were all related to the Divine Soul.
Yuan Ming then turned his gaze toward Sha Hao, who was lying on the ground, his expression growing cold.
Counting up, Sha Hao had killed no fewer than three hundred cultivators from the Southern Border to Da Jin, mostly those in the Qi Refinement Realm. Considering the current state of the Soul Extinguishing Sword, just a few more souls of Foundation Establishment Cultivators would allow the sword to undergo a transformation. If it were a soul of a Soul Cultivator, due to the robustness of their Divine Soul, possibly just one would suffice. Previously, when Yuan Ming was protecting the Shengye Sect Disciples, his identity as a Soul Cultivator had aroused Sha Hao's intense envy.
"Since you so desire the completion of this Soul Extinguishing Sword, let your own Divine Soul fulfill this sword," Yuan Ming said, as he dissolved the frost on the Soul Extinguishing Sword and thrust it into Sha Hao's forehead.
Sha Hao's body shuddered, his face clouded with a surge of black energy, swirling around before quickly fading, and his life force completely dissipated.
Yuan Ming activated the runes of the Soul Extinguishing Sword. Four streams of black light entered Sha Hao's head, pulling out an ephemeral Blood Cloud, which emitted strong fluctuations of Soul Power.
The Blood Cloud revealed a somewhat blurred image of Sha Hao's face, full of terror and desperation. His struggle was futile; even if it were a full soul rather than a residual one, it could hardly resist the might of the Soul Extinguishing Sword and was quickly devoured.
The Soul Extinguishing Sword emitted an exhilarated tremor. The four runes gleamed, casting threads of blood-colored spirit light.
Yuan Ming clasped his hands in a spell-casting gesture, using a secret technique he had acquired through a Soul Search, trying to stabilize the four runes.
After all, he too had considerable experience in Artifact Refining and some insights into runes, otherwise, he might not have been able to master this secret technique so quickly.
The four runes flickered uncertainly before the Soul Extinguishing Sword began to tremble wildly, emitting a series of sharp, grating screeches. The surface roiled with black energy, briefly forming an unidentified ghastly face. However, in a flash, it twisted into another grotesquely ugly male face.
This male face lasted only briefly before transforming again into a withered old woman.
As the faces within the black energy on the sword's surface changed, Yuan Ming's expression grew increasingly solemn, veins bulging on his forehead, and large beads of sweat slid down his face as his fingers rapidly moved through hand seals.
Suddenly, as the face in the black smoke transformed into that of an exceptionally beautiful young girl, it let out a harsh, mocking laugh, opened its mouth, and a stream of black light swept out, attacking Yuan Ming's face.
Yuan Ming was startled. Unable to dodge at such close range, in his desperation, he summoned the Stealing Heaven Tripod with a thought, placing it before him.
This black light, capable of piercing through solid objects, was forcefully blocked by the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
Meanwhile, Yuan Ming took the opportunity to rapidly maneuver his fingers like turning wheels, then formed a strange hand seal, quietly uttering:
"Swift!"
After a flurry of intense flashes, the four runes finally vanished all at once, the black aura on the Soul Extinguishing Sword rolled back into the blade and subsided.
The blade still radiated a layer of black spiritual light but had returned to calm, no longer flickering erratically as before.
Yuan Ming finally let out a long sigh of relief, having narrowly escaped danger. Fortunately, his Divine Soul was strong, and with the protection of the Stealing Heaven Tripod, he had avoided being counter-devoured by the sword.
After stabilizing himself, he channeled Mana and Soul Power into the Soul Extinguishing Sword.
The Soul Extinguishing Sword emitted a dragon-like chant, shooting out a jet of black Sword Qi. The power had not increased much but was much purer than before.
Yuan Ming swung his arm, sending out a crescent-shaped Sword Qi, which pierced the ground.
