Dozens of feet below the ground, the Qiu Snake had awakened and attempted to burst forth from the surface but was entangled by Hua Zhi's vines, each sustaining injuries in their struggle.
The snake's teeth appeared to have a petrifying ability; any vine bitten by it would rapidly petrify and crumble, effectively countering Hua Zhi's regenerative properties.
At that moment, the black Sword Qi effortlessly pierced through the soil layer, striking the Qiu Snake's head in a flash, penetrating the Scale Armor and entering its skull.
The enormous body of the Qiu Snake shuddered violently, then remained motionless, its life force rapidly fading.
Streams of Soul Power seeped from the Qiu Snake's head, yet they did not disperse. Rising to the surface, they began to converge toward the Soul Extinguishing Sword and slowly merged into it.
Yuan Ming, observing this, was slightly astonished.
He hadn't expected the Soul Extinguishing Sword's ability to absorb souls to be so effective, functioning even through the ground and over such a distance.
Seeing this, Hua Zhi took the opportunity to thrust more vines into the Qiu Snake's body, absorbing its Essence Blood and demonic power.
A moment later, Hua Zhi emerged from the ground, carrying the withered corpse of the Qiu Snake.
Yuan Ming pried open the Qiu Snake's mouth, extracting two earthy yellow snake teeth.
These teeth, filled with rich Earth Attribute Spiritual Power, gave a stiff, numb sensation when held. It seemed these were the source of the Qiu Snake's ability to petrify Hua Zhi's vines.
This was a rare and valuable find. If he could find a skilled Artifact Refiner, perhaps he could craft one or two rare magical tools related to petrification.
Yuan Ming stored the two snake teeth, flicked a few Fireballs, and reduced the Qiu Snake's body to ashes.
Although the battle with Sha Hao took place within a white mist and in a remote area unlikely to draw attention, nothing was absolutely certain. After dispersing the mist, Yuan Ming packed up the Vajra Flower Branch Thunderstorm and did not linger. He immediately took Sha Hao's body and sped toward the latter's previous Cave Mansion.
Before long, Yuan Ming stopped in front of a stone wall deep in a mining tunnel.
He took a yellow Command Flag from Sha Hao's Storage Ring and channeled Mana into it.
The Command Flag emitted a beam of yellow light, which entered the stone wall.
The stone wall emitted bursts of yellow light, which slowly dissipated, revealing two stone doors that opened automatically.
Yuan Ming released three spirit beasts to guard the outside and then stepped in himself, the stone wall outside immediately returning to its original state.
After passing through a corridor, he saw a rather large stone hall appear before him.
Before Yuan Ming could take a closer look at the hall, two tall dark shadows lunged towards him from the front at a great speed.
Unperturbed, Yuan Ming flipped his hand and took out a small black bell and gave it a toss.
Ding...
The two dark shadows immediately halted, revealing themselves to be two human demons covered in black fur.
When Yuan Ming performed a Soul Search on Sha Hao, he learned the origin of these two human demons, which Sha Hao had brought with him when he escaped from Biluo Cave, each possessing the combat strength of the Qi Refining Peak, used to guard the cave mansion.
He waved the small bell again, and the two human demons obediently backed away.
Yuan Ming looked around the stone hall, which was furnished with stone stools and chairs, and connected to four chambers around the hall, one for cultivation and another arranged with an array for nurturing the Soul Destroying Sword.
The Soul Destroying Sword was now stable in its refinement, thus, the array was naturally no longer needed.
Of the remaining two chambers, one stored half a room of miscellaneous items, which were various spiritual materials in large quantities but of relatively low grade, and some low-level magical tools, storage bags, and so on.
Yuan Ming knew these were acquired by Sha Hao during his recent killings of cultivators, yet to be sorted through.
The last chamber was exceptionally spacious, comparable to the outer hall, which Sha Hao had converted into a medicine garden, planting numerous spirit grasses and spiritual medicines.
"Star Gazing Grass, Ningling Flower, Cold Moon Vine..."
Yuan Ming scanned these spirit grasses, all precious, with several kinds that could be used to make spirit incense.
"Eh, this is Wind Orchid!"
He looked towards a corner of the medicine garden where four or five silver spiritual flowers were planted, exactly the Wind Orchid needed as a main ingredient for the Foundation Establishment Pill, which he had encountered in the Yunluo Mountain Range.
Check My Virtual Library Empire (*) for the latest updates.
No wonder Sha Hao was able to replicate the flower so vividly that day; it turns out he really did discover this precious spiritual flower in the Yunluo Mountain Range.
Yuan Ming's gaze swept across the rest of the garden and suddenly landed on a corner where a water tank was placed, slanting with a three-foot-long black branch inserted in it, rough and uneven on the surface, showing nothing extraordinary.
The water in the tank was a pale black, emitting slight fluctuations of Yin Qi.
Around the water tank was arranged a small array, isolating it from the other spirit grasses, clearly indicating that Sha Hao placed great importance on this black branch.
Yuan Ming went before the array, activating his Divine Sense to carefully probe, but regrettably discovered nothing special; the black branch seemed to be some kind of Yin Attribute spiritual material, quite rich in Yin Qi, but that was it.
However, if the black branch were merely a Yin Property spiritual material, Sha Hao likely wouldn't have placed it here, right?
The Soul Searching Divine Ability can investigate a person's memories, but a cultivator's lifetime memories are vast and immense, requiring a long time to review in full; he had just searched for what he wanted to know and hadn't seen anything regarding the black branch.
Yuan Ming turned and left the medicine garden, heading to Sha Hao's cultivation chamber.
The chamber was very simply furnished, with a blue meditation cushion in the center and a bronze incense burner in the corner, burning a stick of spirit incense, which was actually the Purple Mysterious Incense he had refined.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming couldn't help but feel a sense of pride unexpectedly rise within him; to think Sha Hao had actually purchased the Purple Mysterious Incense, it seemed that the man had at some point visited the Xuanhua Spirit Incense Shop without his knowledge.
Yuan Ming gathered his thoughts, sat down on the cushion, and began to sort through these acquired items.
He first took out the silver sphere, only slightly scratched on the surface, which did not affect its function.
He channeled his mana into it, and the silver sphere quickly lit up with brilliant silver light, and the four runes also glittered brightly.
Yuan Ming was secretly delighted, having seen several times the impressive attacks launched by this silver sphere, no less powerful than his Black Needle.
"Capable of firing such powerful silver rays, I'll just call it the Silver Light Pearl from now on, and the Black Needle will be called the Absolute Shadow Needle," he said to himself.
With the Silver Light Pearl and the Absolute Shadow Needle, his offensive capabilities had increased a notch.
Yuan Ming stored the item away and then picked up the golden inner armor, activating his Divine Sense to probe it.
The golden inner armor contained four runes, evidently another top-grade magical tool.
Unsure of the material used for its refinement, its inherent defensive power was impressive, far superior to the Dragon Scale Shield, and it could also trigger a golden barrier.
In the previous major battle, Sha Hao had overexerted the golden inner armor, which suffered hits by the combined forces of the thunderstorm and the Vajra, causing the runes to become somewhat unstable.
However, this was not a big problem, as nourishing it with mana for a while would mostly restore it.
The defensive power of the golden inner armor, witnessed firsthand by Yuan Ming, was strong; with this treasure for protection, he wouldn't have to worry about attacks from those at the Foundation Establishment stage.
He didn't stash the inner armor away but wore it directly on his body, then methodically stored all the treasures away before sitting cross-legged on the cushion, channeling his mana to start nourishing the inner armor.

chapters.title: Chapter 320 - 297 Harvest
chapters.content:
A moment later, Yuan Ming opened his eyes and swept his divine sense over himself, nodding slightly.
After a period of mana nourishment, the runes on the gold inner armor had stabilized slightly more than before. Now reassured, he thought that once he returned to his residence, he could spend some time each day to slowly nourish it.
Then, he took out Sha Hao's storage ring and pinched a magic gesture to activate it.
A white light flashed on the ground, and a pile of items appeared, most of which were spirit stones piled about a yard high.
Besides the spirit stones, there were also several magic artifacts, three jade boxes, a giant yellow gourd taller than a man, two jade bottles, one grey and one white jade scroll.
Yuan Ming first counted the spirit stones, finding there were nearly a hundred thousand, which brought joy to his heart.
In recent times while running the Spiritual Fragrance Shop in Little Lake City, although he was making thousands of spirit stones per month, the expenses were practically all spent on cultivation resources, elixirs, and mystic fragrances. It had only allowed him to reach his current level of cultivation, but he had still not been able to break through to the mid-stage.
This was partly due to his talent and partly because he did not have the financial power to buy better elixirs; if he could really practice without restraint, he believed the progress would have been much faster, though the spirit stones needed would more than double.
For example, during the Tianxiang Auction he had once seen a Gathering Spirit Formation that could greatly enhance the efficiency of cultivation. The starting price alone was ten thousand spirit stones, and it eventually sold for as much as seventeen thousand spirit stones. Each activation reportedly consumed several mid-grade spirit stones, making it an extreme luxury that he had previously been reluctant to pursue.
Besides, although he was putting most of his effort into cultivation, he still occasionally needed to make time to produce incense in exchange for spirit stones, preventing him from truly secluding himself for full-time cultivation.
This time, in order to deal with Sha Hao, he had nearly spent all his spirit stones, likely unable to meet even his prior conditions for cultivation in the short term. Now, with such a large pile of spirit stones, he could finally afford a real seclusion.
Yuan Ming happily collected the spirit stones and then turned his attention to the magic artifacts.
There were nine magic artifacts in total, among them five command flags that appeared to be part of the same array set.
These five flags were red, yellow, blue, green, and gold in color, all identical in size and shape; the yellow command flag he had used earlier to open the great doors of the mansion was among them.
From Sha Hao's memories, he knew these five flags were used to control the arrays surrounding the mansion: they were the Array Flags of the formation.
This array was called the "Five Elements Illusion Destruction Array", quite sophisticated, far beyond the capabilities of the Thousand Mechanism Water Rope Array or the Bronze Thunder Pattern Array.
It was said that the Five Elements Illusion Destruction Array was not only an illusion technique array but also contained intricate derivations of the Five Elements. Due to its ingenious design, even ordinary cultivators could activate its illusion restrictions, trapping those who rashly entered. It was difficult for a normal Foundation Establishment cultivator to escape, thus it was also known as the 'Small Immortal Entrapping Array'.
If one had mastery of certain Five Elements Techniques, it was also easy to manipulate changes corresponding to those attributes within the array, allowing illusions and the Five Elements to enhance each other, shifting between illusion and reality, and thereby greatly increasing its power.
Upon considering this, Yuan Ming activated the command flags and tried stimulating the array.
Soon, the surroundings of the mansion were illuminated with red, yellow, blue, green, and gold light, which then turned into the illusory shapes of flames, flowing water, giant trees, mountains, and golden blades, their appearances flickering and uncertain, occasionally transforming into real objects, yet seemed somewhat chaotic and disordered.
Since he had scarcely dabbled in arrays and was a novice, his technique was clumsy. After repeatedly practicing several times, he barely got the hang of it.
As his cultivation of the Nine Elements Technique was one of the best in the Wood Attribute cultivation methods, after several more attempts, he also mastered a few Wood Attribute transformations among the Five Elements.
However, whether he was to fully grasp the Wood Attribute transformations for combat or to continue comprehending transformations of other attributes, he still needed more time to ponder and practice.
Although the power of the Five Elements Illusion Destruction Array was remarkable, its consumption was also substantial; setting it up even once could easily cost over a thousand spirit stones, not affordable for ordinary cultivators.
Yuan Ming collected the five command flags and continued to check the remaining four magic artifacts. They were a black short sword, a blue flying boat, a white round orb, and a blue round mirror.
He had already seen the black short sword and the blue flying boat; the former was a top-grade magical tool with considerable offensive power, the latter a common flying artifact.
The white round orb, called the "Soul-Locking Pearl", was a top-grade Soul Cultivation Magical Artifact capable of locking onto someone else's Divine Soul Aura and tracking from a distance.
As long as the target was within a hundred li, the Soul-Locking Pearl could accurately sense the opponent's location. In his previous confrontation with Sha Hao, Sha Hao had firmly located his position using this magical artifact, nearly forcing him into a dire situation.
The Soul-Locking Pearl could not only lock onto enemies from a distance but was also extremely covert, so much so that even Core Formation Stage cultivators might not detect it.
The only drawback of the pearl was that it had a time limit; each locking could only last for three days, after which the Divine Soul Aura inside the bead would dissipate, necessitating a re-lock.
As for the blue round mirror, it was called the "Water Observation Mirror", a mid-grade Water Attribute Magical Artifact with some scouting capabilities. In places abundant with water vapor, it could probe hundreds of meters.
However, if there was no water nearby, the effectiveness of the Water Observation Mirror would be significantly reduced, even worse than ordinary magical artifacts.
Sha Hao had taken a different approach by combining the Water Observation Mirror with the Five Elements Illusion Destruction Array, thus he could use this mirror to scout within three hundred meters around the array.
Both of these magical artifacts were valuable; if used wisely, they could have remarkable effects.
Yuan Ming put away all the magical artifacts and picked up three jade boxes, opening them to find a shiny black iron block, a green crystal stone, and a yellowish-brown round orb.
He recognized these three items as Black Mysterious Iron, Green Water Amber, and Mountain Spirit Pearl, all precious materials for refining top-grade magical tools, though he currently had no use for them.
Yuan Ming then checked the yellow gourd and discovered it was filled with white jade-like elixirs, almost a thousand in number.
He took out one elixir, feeling the cold touch of a snowball in his palm, and smelling a strong medicinal aura, immediately recognizing it as a Strengthening and Nourishing Spirit Pill, superior to the ones he was currently taking.
"Could this be the Snow Crystal Pill?"
The Snow Crystal Pill was considered one of the best Strengthening and Nourishing elixirs among those available during the Foundation Establishment Stage, unfortunately, they were very expensive and beyond Yuan Ming's means for long-term use. He had not expected Sha Hao to have so many.
Yuan Ming felt secretly overjoyed; with so many Snow Crystal Pills, along with the abundant spirit stones he had obtained earlier, he wouldn't have to worry about elixirs for a considerable time. These pills would support his cultivation up to the Late Foundation Establishment.
As for the other two jade bottles, one contained a Detoxification Elixir and the other a Healing Pill, both of top grade.
Finally, Yuan Ming took out two jade scrolls for inspection. The gray jade scroll contained a cultivation method called "Mystic Jade Technique" and a soul cultivation technique called "Heart Cleansing Technique."
He already possessed many cultivation techniques and paid little attention to the "Mystic Jade Technique," focusing instead on the "Heart Cleansing Technique."
This was his first encounter with a soul cultivation method other than the "Moonlight Technique," and he was quite curious, immersing himself in thorough contemplation and quickly finishing it.
The "Heart Cleansing Technique" was also a refined soul cultivation method, yet it still fell short of the "Moonlight Technique." However, this technique had unique aspects in refining the mind and eliminating emotional distractions.
According to the jade scroll, this technique could sever all Seven Emotions and Six Desires at a profound stage, even achieving the "Four Nones" state of "Heartless," "Ignorance," "No Recognition," and "Painless."
"This really is a sinister technique," Yuan Ming muttered, realizing that cultivating it could truly make one unmovable as a mountain in mental state, but at the risk of becoming a being devoid of thoughts, a likely side effect of the "Heart Cleansing Technique."
Fortunately, his "Moonlight Technique" carried no such drawbacks.
Yuan Ming then picked up the white jade scroll, his divine sense penetrating it.
His expression suddenly turned puzzled as the white jade scroll seemed to devour his divine sense, but it quickly released it back to him.
"What's going on?" Yuan Ming wondered, releasing his divine sense once more to probe the white jade scroll.
This time there were no surprises, and his divine sense smoothly entered the inside of the white jade scroll.
He paused for a moment, deciding to ignore the earlier anomaly, and concentrated on reading the contents of the scroll.
The white jade scroll contained the Great Elder's insights on soul cultivation practice, most of which were related to the "Heart Cleansing Technique" and offered considerable value for reference.
The scroll also recorded several secret soul cultivation techniques that caught his eye.
The ones that Yuan Ming paid most attention to were the Soul Splitting Skill, the Soul Shaking Secret Technique, and the Dream Butterfly Illusion Technique.
The Soul Splitting Skill allowed one to split their Divine Soul form, maintaining the capabilities of the Divine Soul form after splitting, though it significantly weakened them.This trаnslаtiоn is pоwеrеd by thе rеаdеrs аt М|V|LЕ9МРYR.
The Great Elder had used this technique during the annihilation at Biluo Cave, splitting his Blood Bat into hundreds, nearly reversing the entire battle scenario.
However, this technique consumed an immense amount of Soul Power and was perilously dangerous, as even a moment of inattention could lead to soul exhaustion.
The Soul Shaking Secret Technique, true to its name, could shake the Divine Soul, specifically counteracting illusions and enabling one to rescue themselves from illusions.
Yuan Ming suddenly understood why Sha Hao could so easily escape his illusions during the battle at Yunluo Mountain Range.
Once mastered and skillfully applied, he wouldn't need to use soul collision to escape illusions any longer.
As for the Dream Butterfly Illusion Technique, it was a powerful illusion technique that could trap someone unaware in an illusion from which they could not escape, using the illusion to consume the enemy's Divine Soul Power and harm them intangibly.
This technique was far superior to the illusion techniques Yuan Ming had used before, and Sha Hao had indeed used this technique against him.
The Dream Butterfly Illusion Technique was profound and mysterious, divided into four stages: Mirror Flower, Mirage, Illusion Dream, and Void Silence, and was tremendously difficult to cultivate.
Sha Hao had only cultivated it to the first stage, the Mirror Flower, which was just the beginning. However, his Divine Soul form, the Blood Bat, could emit strong blood-colored Soul Waves with strong penetration ability, which allowed him to remain unaffected by the Fog Incense in the previous big battle and easily penetrate deep into the divine soul to execute illusions with twice the result for half the effort.
Sha Hao had combined the Dream Butterfly Illusion Technique with his blood bat's Soul Wave, greatly enhancing its power. From the Southern Border to Central Plains, no low-level cultivators could escape his illusions; if not for Yuan Ming's prompt use of his soul collision secret technique to hit his own divine soul and save himself, he might only have faced defeat that day.

chapters.title: Chapter 321 - 298: Claiming the Reward
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming thought of this and silently praised his luck, relying on his Soul Collision Divine Ability and the Stealing Heaven Tripod, he believed he could break any illusion, no matter what Sha Hao threw at him, which was somewhat careless.
If Sha Hao had cultivated his Dream Butterfly Illusion Technique to the Mirage Realm, even Soul Collision might not be effective.
The Dream Butterfly Illusion Technique was extremely powerful, and he had resolved to learn it, but it was a pity that Sha Hao was dead, otherwise he might have used Black Incense Possession to comprehend it and achieved twice the result with half the effort.
Yuan Ming began to put everything away and walked around Sha Hao's Cave Mansion, the more he saw, the more satisfied he became.
This Cave Mansion was well-hidden, and nature's spiritual energy was denser than in Little Lake City; it was also guarded by the formidable Five Elements Illusion Destruction Array, much stronger than his small dwelling in Little Lake City.
He had lived in Little Lake City for three years, and although he made a considerable sum through the Xuanhua Spirit Incense Shop, it also brought some troubles, in addition to the looming threat from Chang Chun Temple, it was time to move on, and this place was within the Five Thunder Sect's sphere of influence in Zhao Country.
Yuan Ming immediately began to arrange things inside the Cave Mansion. He cleared out the stone chamber where the Soul Destroying Sword was originally placed, removed all arrays from the ground, and placed the casting furnace acquired from Master Hei Mu's Cave Mansion in this spot.
After the recent great battle, Yuan Ming deeply realized the role magic artifacts played in combat, he learned the Artifact Refining Technique in Biluo Cave, and with his strong Divine Soul Power, he had a natural advantage in Drawing Talismans, Enriching, and other aspects. If he could concentrate on studying artifact refining, he would probably have achieved considerable success by now.
Regrettably, since leaving Biluo Cave, he had been busy and had no time or conditions to devote himself to the study of the Artifact Refining Technique.
Now, with the Snow Crystal Pill and nearly a hundred thousand Spirit Stones gained from Sha Hao, he need not worry about cultivation resources for the next two or three years and could afford to take it easy a bit.
In a secret room next to Sha Hao's, many spiritual materials were piled up. Yuan Ming also had a lot of unused spiritual materials in his own Storage Ring, as well as demon beast materials, he planned to improve his Artifact Refining skills in the coming days while continuing his cultivation.
Yuan Ming quickly arranged everything but did not immediately begin cultivating, as there were still some matters to take care of in Little Lake City.
He sealed the Cave Mansion and flew southwards.
...
Little Lake City, Xuanhua Spirit Incense Shop.
After the Tianxiang Auction ended, business at the shop had been booming day by day.
Qingxuan and Purple Dark Incense, as one of the main products of the shop, had become regular procurement items for All Major Sects.
As for the Seven-step Immovable that was auctioned off, rumors spread that a Loose Cultivator was attacked in the wild, surrounded by two same-level cultivators. It was said that they managed to escape successfully, and even counter-killed one of them, all thanks to Seven-step Immovable.
The story circulated with credence, but if someone were to truly inquire, there would be few who could clarify the exact identity and cultivation of this Loose Cultivator.
As for the truth, Hu Tu, who always happened to be present when the story was told, probably knew the best.
"The boss hasn't returned yet; give it a few more days, and we won't have any incense to sell," Hu Tu, having sent away the last customer in the shop, hung up the closed sign as usual and said to Mu Yang.
After speaking, he swiftly closed the shop door. As soon as he turned around, he saw Yuan Ming's figure.
"Boss, you're back! Are you here to check the accounts? I'll go and get the ledger for you right away," Hu Tu said excitedly.
Yuan Ming nodded and did not stop him. After quickly reviewing the ledger, a smile appeared on his face.
"Not bad, the recent business income has increased by fifty percent compared to before."
"It's all thanks to the good quality and effectiveness of our incense; we're just doing what we should," Hu Tu complimented timely.
Yuan Ming closed the ledger, "When I left, I asked you to take the time to inquire about the news in town. Is there anything noteworthy now?"
"In the past few days, only two major events are worth noting. One is the Fire Sparrow Sect gathering the Scatter Alliance of Guangli, Qi Yue, and Hong Shang to form a team and head to the Northern Desert. Second is that Chang Chun Temple, based on some intelligence, has generally located the position of the Soul Cultivator Pu Zhengqing and has organized a considerable force. Three Core Formation Elders from Chang Chun Temple, Shengye Sect, and Zhenling Sect have just set out yesterday to capture this miscreant in Zhao Country," Hu Tu reported.
"Very good, well done. However, in the next few days, both you and Mu Yang pack up and sort out the remaining incense in the shop. After that, I will take you to Wangyue City in Zhao Country, where I plan to open a new shop," Yuan Ming nodded and said.
"But boss, it took us a long time to build up a reputation in the city, wouldn't it be a pity to close now? How about this, let Mu Yang manage this shop, and I'll go with you to open a branch there?" Hu Tu was reluctant to let go of the thriving business.
"I have plans for this matter, and besides, our materials and output are limited and not enough to support two shops," Yuan Ming shook his head.
Hearing this, Hu Tu could only sigh regretfully, bowed, and went off with Mu Yang to get things in order.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming also got up and left the Spiritual Fragrance Shop, turning his head toward the residence of the Loose Cultivation Association.
Perhaps because the Fire Sparrow Sect and Chang Chun Temple's tasks had drawn away a large number of people, there were pitifully few people within the Loose Cultivation Association. The attendants stood behind the counter, bored out of their minds, some so idle that they even sneakily pulled out a book to read on the side.
Yuan Ming glanced at it and saw that the book in the attendant's hand was actually the "Young Master Sheng's Southern Journey" that he had written himself. He couldn't help but chuckle to himself and walked toward that attendant.
Upon hearing someone approaching, the attendant immediately scrambled to hide the book, lifted his head, and seeing that it wasn't the steward, he visibly relaxed and adopted a respectful demeanor.
"Senior, are you here to receive a task?"
Yuan Ming shook his head, raised his hand, and threw out Sha Hao's corpse, saying only two words, "Claim reward."
Seeing a corpse suddenly appear before him, the attendant was so scared that his soul nearly flew out of his body. After finally regaining his senses, he looked closely at Sha Hao's face and exclaimed in surprise, "Pu Zhengqing?"
As these three words came out, the entire Loose Cultivation Association went suddenly quiet. Some Loose Cultivators looked over curiously, also startled to see a corpse lying in front of Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming looked around, without any intention to conceal, and loudly declared, "Fellow Daoists, I am Hagon, a Soul Cultivator. I have found and thoroughly slain Pu Zhengqing, and here lies his body as proof. From now on, this villain will no longer be able to harm the world, and I ask you all to be my witnesses."
Upon hearing his words, the Cultivators in the Loose Cultivation Association were all dumbstruck and astonished, while the attendants were stunned, although a few quick-witted ones hurriedly turned around to summon the steward of the association.
Soon, a Foundation Establishment Stage steward hurriedly came out and gave Yuan Ming a cupped-fist salute, "As per our association's rules, I still need to verify the corpse's identity to confirm there's no disguise. Please, Fellow Daoist Hagon, be understanding."
Yuan Ming nodded and stepped aside.
The steward initially wanted to have the attendants take the corpse to a specialized verification room, but seeing that many Cultivators had gathered around with curious expressions, he simply had people bring the tools over and began the examination right there in the hall.
As he started, the surrounding Cultivators looking on also began to discuss amongst themselves, with some asserting and others questioning.
Under everyone's gaze, the steward took out a transparent gem-like Magic Artifact, within which floated plenty of fresh blood. As he activated a spell, the Magic Artifact slowly levitated, hovering above the corpse. Then an orange-yellow light beamed out from within, covering the entire body, sweeping around it before returning to the Magic Artifact, causing the floating blood within to change shape.
Quickly, a blood portrait of Sha Hao emerged within the center of the Magic Artifact.
Seeing this, the steward swallowed hard, lifted his head, and looked at Yuan Ming with undisguised admiration.
"This is indeed Pu Zhengqing's body, with nothing tampered," he confirmed.
At once, the Loose Cultivation Association erupted into an uproar, but Yuan Ming merely nodded and said, "Now that the identity has been verified, I should be able to receive his bounty, correct?"
"Of course, I will have someone fetch it immediately. However, since what Fellow Daoist brought back is his corpse, the reward is only fifty thousand Spirit Stones. Please understand," the steward said.
"It's no problem," Yuan Ming waved his hand dismissively.
Soon, Yuan Ming received a Storage Bag containing fifty thousand Spirit Stones from the steward, and without lingering any longer, turned and strode away.
Although he had left, the discussions about him within the Loose Cultivation Association didn't stop.

"Hehe, this Hagon, I wonder whose disciple he is, to be so formidable. A person whom Chang Chun Temple had to send a Core Formation Cultivator to deal with, and he, a mere Foundation Establishment Stage, managed to kill," someone exclaimed admiringly.
"Not only that, think about it, Chang Chun Temple took great effort to pinpoint Pu Zhengqing's location, and right after they set out, Hagon delivered the corpse. It shows that his cultivation is not ordinary and his other abilities must also be extraordinary. It seems many Sects will want to recruit him," another Cultivator in yellow robes said.
"Sigh, fame comes with trouble; fortune and misfortune are intertwined. What if Chang Chun Temple finds out about this? Do you think they'll reward Hagon, or will they feel slighted and make trouble for him?" a Cultivator in long robes suddenly asked.
"Chang Chun Temple is arrogant but not foolish. How could they possibly trouble a Cultivator with such boundless prospects over such a trifle? I think the possibility of them seeking to recruit him is higher," the man in yellow robes shook his head.
"The Elder from Chang Chun Temple who came this time is Zuo Qinghui. He tried to recruit Hagon at the Tianxiang Auction last time but was refused by Hagon. This time, he might try to recruit him again," a well-informed Cultivator analyzed.
"Hmph, Chang Chun Temple's domination over Da Jin is absolute! They always use both carrots and sticks to recruit any notable Loose Cultivators," someone complained bitterly.
However, this remark seemed to touch a taboo, immediately silencing all those around, who then dispersed and refrained from openly discussing such topics.
But the discussions about Hagon did not cease, and the news of Pu Zhengqing's death at his hands spread with wings, swiftly reaching every corner of Little Lake City.

chapters.title: Chapter 322 - 299: Breakthrough
chapters.content:
Half a month later.
Yuan Ming returned to Wangyue City and after surveying for a while, learned that Chang Chun Temple's team had successfully captured Pu Zhengqing and returned to Da Jin. With the Sha Hao incident settled down, he reopened the Spiritual Fragrance Shop with Hu Tu and Mu Yang within Wangyue City.
After taking care of the shop's related affairs, he then returned alone to his cave mansion.
Business at the newly opened store was much quieter than before, but Yuan Ming now had an ample supply of Spirit Stones and elixirs, and running the shop was just meant to be a steady trickle of income. Therefore, in terms of operation and promotion, he only asked Hu Tu and the other to do what they were capable of, not as invested as before.
If everything went as expected, the legacy left by Sha Hao should support his cultivation until the late stages of Foundation Establishment. For the foreseeable future, he planned to stay and cultivate in seclusion, unless something significant came up.
His past experiences had given him a greater longing for an increase in strength. Whether in the Southern Border or in Da Jin, only absolute power could grant one absolute authority. The so-called fairness applies only when power is equal.
If he remained stuck in the early stages of Foundation Establishment, he might not be considered weak among ordinary cultivators, but he would be nothing compared to real powerhouses. He certainly didn't want a repeat of the incident where he was forced to leave his homeland because he hesitated to use his magic artifacts after killing Master Yu Hu.
The incense needed for the shop would also be handled by Lei Yu after they were made; he wouldn't leave the cave mansion easily himself.
As Yuan Ming contemplated his future plans, he took out a stick of Black Incense.
A few days before, he had already confirmed that his parents were safe through a possession by the Black Incense. This time, however, he wanted to check on Xi Ying's situation.
Whether it was the news of Sha Hao's death or the acceptance of the entire legacy of the Great Elder, Yuan Ming had accumulated a mountain of things he wanted to share with Xi Ying. Sadly, with mountains and seas between them, his words could never reach her ears.
On the Stealing Heaven Tripod, the Black Incense burned slowly, and amidst the drifting smoke, Yuan Ming's vision gradually shifted, transferring to Guoguo.
Splash—
Just as the possession completed, Yuan Ming hadn't yet adjusted when a splash of waves hit him in the face. The salty sea water drenched Guoguo from head to toe, not a single hair remained dry.
"Meow!"
Guoguo cried out as if complaining, but the waves continued to wash over its body mercilessly, forcing it to squint and pitifully cling to the scales beneath with its paws, pressing its body—which had shrunk due to the wet fur—closely against the creature.
Although its eyes were closed, once Yuan Ming calmed his mind, he began to observe the surroundings through the power of Divine Sense.
Not far in front of Guoguo, Xi Ying stood on the back of the beast, enveloped by a faint white light that kept the incoming sea water at bay.
Yet, whenever a wave hit her, Xi Ying would shout excitedly, her eyes brimming with eagerness and anticipation.
Beneath her and Guoguo lay a giant fish, several zhang in length, covered in solid blue scales. Its back was flat like a long table, with eight pairs of fins on each side, shaped like cattail fans.
The strange fish leaped and darted across the sea surface, its powerful fins stirring up wave after wave. Its massive body sometimes dove into the water and sometimes leapt above the surface, offering its passengers a thrilling ride.
Yuan Ming noticed the vast blue sea and sky around and guessed that Xi Ying must have left the Southern Border and reached somewhere in the East Sea. Unfortunately, the distance from Wangwangyue Mountain Range to the East Sea remained vast, and the Sound Transmission Talisman likely useless.
After some time, the antics of the sea creature attracted the attention of others. A green light swiftly passed through the sky, stopping just above the head of the fish.
However, upon seeing this, Xi Ying didn't seem surprised at all. She pinched a spell, causing the sea creature beneath their feet to come to a halt.
"Senior Xiao, my master is growing impatient. You should hurry over," said a female cultivator dressed in light green, standing on a Magic Artifact, bowing slightly to Xi Ying.
"There's plenty of time, no harm in her waiting a bit longer," Xi Ying waved her hand dismissively, clearly reluctant.
"Senior Xiao…" The woman in green smiled wryly, opening her mouth as if wanting to persuade further.
"Meow—" At that moment, Guoguo suddenly let out a weak mew.
Xi Ying furrowed her brows, picked up Guoguo, and grumbled, "Usually you can't even walk straight when you see fish, but now you can't handle being on a fish's back for a short while? As punishment, you're not allowed to eat fish for a month when we get back!"
Hearing this, Guoguo mewed again but showed no intention of leaving Xi Ying's embrace.
Yuan Ming, who was possessing Guoguo, could sense its vague thoughts—it seemed Guoguo disliked getting wet more than it hated missing out on fish.
Xi Ying placed Guoguo inside her robe, dismissed the sea creature, then trod upon the air, flying straight up into the sky.
"Alright, I'm off. You better catch up quickly," she said.
With that, Xi Ying's figure flashed, stepping onto a gourd-shaped Magic Artifact, and flew eastward, without waiting for the woman in green.
Seeing this, the woman in green could do nothing but hastily propel her artifact to follow.
The place Xi Ying was heading to was not close by. Before Yuan Ming's Black Incense burned out and the possession ended, she hadn't yet reached her destination.
However, Yuan Ming was only there to confirm her condition, and now that he saw she was safe and sound, there was no longer anything to worry about.
After withdrawing his thoughts, Yuan Ming calmed his mind, discarded any stray thoughts, and delved into cultivation.
...
Thischapterfirstappearedon*.
Time flew by, and five years had passed in the blink of an eye.
Inside the cave mansion, the fluctuations of spiritual power around Yuan Ming had already reached the level of mid-stage Foundation Establishment, still a distance away from the peak.
With the elixirs left by Sha Hao, the Purple Mysterious Incense he refined himself, and the Gathering Spirit Formation he later exchanged for with spirit stones, Yuan Ming had been cultivating day and night without rest. He broke through to the mid-stage more than four years ago, and under the continuous support of the elixirs, his mana kept making rapid advances, steadily moving towards the peak of mid-stage Foundation Establishment.
In addition, with the daily nourishment of the Divine Soul by the Stealing Heaven Tripod and the nightly practice of the Moonlight Technique, Yuan Ming's Divine Soul also saw considerable improvement. Today, he finally arrived at the edge of the Moonlight Technique's Fourth Level.
With the breakthrough imminent, he did not dare to be negligent and specially took out a stick of Spirit Incense from his Storage Ring.
Over the years, he often reviewed the cultivation insights from the Great Elder, from which he gained a lot.
The insights mentioned an elixir that could help overcome the bottlenecks faced by Soul Cultivators. Although Yuan Ming was not adept in alchemy, through analysis and research, he managed to create a stick of Spirit Incense with similar effects.
This incense could stabilize a cultivator's mental state, dispelling stray thoughts while also slightly enhancing the strength of the Divine Soul. It could not only assist Soul Cultivators in their breakthroughs but was also very beneficial for the cultivation of regular cultivators.
Yuan Ming named this incense "Soul Nourishing Incense," and planned to sell it in the Spiritual Fragrance Shop in the future, but there was no rush for now.
As he lit the Soul Nourishing Incense, he immediately felt a cool sensation in his head, clearing away all trivial matters. His nervousness about the impending breakthrough also gradually eased.
Following that, Yuan Ming silently began to circulate the Moonlight Technique, and the Soul Power in his Sea of Consciousness started stirring little by little, quickly becoming like raging waves crashing through his Sea of Consciousness and all rushing towards the divine shadow in the center of the Sea of Consciousness.
With the entry of the Soul Power, Yuan Ming's Divine Soul gradually filled up, reaching its limit soon after; nonetheless, the surging Soul Power in the Sea of Consciousness continued unabated, showing no signs of stopping.
Soon, Yuan Ming's Divine Soul began to swell and twist unnaturally.
Yuan Ming sensed that outside his Divine Soul, there seemed to be some indescribable constraint preventing further growth and development.
But this was not due to external forces; it was a natural restraint for every cultivator.
The Great Elder had mentioned this in his insights, referring to it as "Soul Constraints." It is the key that truly differentiates Soul Cultivators from ordinary cultivators. Starting from breaking through this restraint, the cultivation path of Soul Cultivators will gradually diverge from that of regular cultivators, ultimately widening the gap between them.
In the Sea of Consciousness, Yuan Ming's Divine Soul no longer retained its original appearance. However, the restraints that bound him still existed, and no matter how much he circulated the Moonlight Technique, he could not break free.
Gradually, the Soul Power in the Sea of Consciousness was depleted, the surging waves slowly calmed, and a hint of anxiety flashed in Yuan Ming's mind. Although it was soon soothed by the smoke of the Soul Nourishing Incense, it could not change the fact that the breakthrough was about to fail.
But just then, the mark of the Stealing Heaven Tripod on Yuan Ming's arm suddenly lit up, and the familiar warm current appeared once again, rushing toward the Sea of Consciousness within Yuan Ming.
However, this time, when the warm current reached the Sea of Consciousness, Yuan Ming discovered that there was suddenly a shadow of the Stealing Heaven Tripod in front of his Divine Soul's phantom.
He hadn't figured out what was happening when he saw the shadow of the Stealing Heaven Tripod fiercely collide with his Divine Soul.
A sharp pain shot through Yuan Ming's forehead, causing him to feel disoriented. Before he could recover his senses, another loud noise echoed within the Sea of Consciousness as the shadow of the Stealing Heaven Tripod collided with his Divine Soul once again.
Under the violent impact, both the shadow of the Stealing Heaven Tripod and the phantom of the Divine Soul developed fine cracks.
With his Divine Soul damaged, Yuan Ming felt dizzy, and the Moonlight Technique he had been running also halted for an instant. However, at that very moment, the shadow of the Stealing Heaven Tripod collided with the Divine Soul for the third time, shattering both into pieces.
Yuan Ming felt darkness before his eyes and fainted.
Though he had lost consciousness, he had completed the final step in breaking through the Soul Constraints.
The previously restrained Soul Power that had flooded into his Divine Soul did not disperse despite the lack of external constraints; instead, it operated independently, absorbing the shards of the Stealing Heaven Tripod and the fragments of the Divine Soul before rapidly recondensing into a human form, transforming the newly-formed Divine Soul phantom into something more solid. While far from being fully formed, it showed a slight indication of taking on a physical form.
Inside the cave mansion, after an unknown amount of time, Yuan Ming slowly regained consciousness, propped up his head, and sat up. As he recalled the experience, he immediately inspected his Sea of Consciousness with Inner Observation, anxious to see the current situation.
When he saw the somewhat solidified faint yellow shadow in the center of the Sea of Consciousness, he was first taken aback and then overjoyed.
He immediately released the soul crows, and as expected, the number of soul crows he could control had increased by two, and the range of their Far Travel had been extended to forty li.
In addition, his soul crows had awakened a new ability called "Crow Cry," capable of emitting Divine Soul Sound Waves to attack enemies.

chapters.title: Chapter 323 - 300 Desire Power
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming instructed Hua Zhi to catch a nearby demon beast for an experiment and found that the soul crow's "Crow Cry" could cause an opponent's Divine Soul to tremble, rendering their consciousness stupefied and body rigid, taking some time before they could recover.
In addition, during his previous cultivation sessions, he had preliminarily completed the first level of the Dream Butterfly Illusion Technique, "Mirror Flower." Now, by combining it with the release of the soul crow, he could imperceptibly trap enemies in an illusion.
This greatly extended the range within which Yuan Ming could cast illusions, which excited him immensely.
Yuan Ming called back the soul crow and was about to test other Soul Cultivator abilities when he suddenly noticed that the "Stealing Heaven Tripod" mark on his arm was getting warm.
With a thought, he summoned the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
No sooner had the Stealing Heaven Tripod appeared than Yuan Ming noticed a deeper connection with it. In the air, thin filaments of an invisible force began gathering from all directions, each one of them entering the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
"What is this?" Yuan Ming exclaimed with surprise, sensing the invisible force, and quickly made a discovery.
This invisible force was very similar to Divine Sense, yet there was a difference.
His expression thoughtful, he held the Stealing Heaven Tripod in his hands, focused his mind, and tried to sense the interior of the tripod.
With a hum, a layer of golden runes and forbidden spells appeared around the Stealing Heaven Tripod, blocking his Divine Sense from penetrating even the slightest bit.
When Yuan Ming was still in the Southern Border, he had tried to refine the Stealing Heaven Tripod and encountered this layer of golden prohibition. That time, he was violently repelled, but now the reaction of the golden prohibition was not as strong as before.
He was inwardly pleased, believing that with the progress he had made in the Moonlight Technique, his connection with the Stealing Heaven Tripod was deepening and its resistance was weakening. Sooner or later, he would have complete control over it.
Yuan Ming closed his eyes to sense the invisible force that was gathering and soon showed a look of surprise again.
His Divine Sense, upon contact with the gathered invisible force, actually absorbed a bit of it, and found it quite beneficial.
"These invisible forces can be absorbed? It appears that they are indeed of the same nature as Divine Power. Whenever my Divine Soul was injured in the past, the surge of heat from the incense burner must have been the invisible force collected by the Stealing Heaven Tripod," Yuan Ming realized suddenly.
Unfortunately, with the golden prohibition surrounding the Stealing Heaven Tripod, he was unable to permeate inside, so it seemed he was still a distance away from being able to mobilize this force.
Yuan Ming set down the Stealing Heaven Tripod and recalled that its name was given by Xi Ying. He wondered if she knew anything about this force.
He took out the Communication Talisman that Xi Ying had left him, thinking of sending a message to inquire, but after some thought, he stowed it away again.
He had been in closed-door cultivation in his Cave Mansion for five years, focusing on his practice without much contact with the outside world, and barely using the Black Incense, unaware of Xi Ying's whereabouts.
His thoughts then shifted to his parents at home. Having not seen them for many years, he wondered how they were now.
He took out a piece of Black Incense and inserted it into the tripod, ready to possess his father and check on the situation, but he suddenly felt that the Black Incense also faintly possessed that same invisible force, albeit somewhat diluted.
"Black Incense also contains this force..." Yuan Ming muttered to himself. After some thought, he took out the only remaining original Black Incense.
As expected, the original Black Incense also carried that invisible force, which was extremely rich, even giving him a sense of stickiness.
Yuan Ming seemed to come to a realization, then took out the incense ashes used for Incense Making and discovered that they too were enveloped in the invisible force.
"So that's how it is... So that's how it is," Yuan Ming said, coming to an epiphany and laughing out loud.
He had long suspected that the possessing divine power of the Black Incense was triggered by a special force within the incense ashes; the more of this force there was, the better the effect of possession. Now it seemed he was right indeed!
The force within the incense ashes seemed to originate from the wishes and prayers of worshipers, and Yuan Ming decided to name this force "Desire Power."
His research on this Desire Power was still very superficial, and he could not figure out its intricacies in a short time, so he temporarily set aside his thoughts and lit the Black Incense, possessing his father's body.
At this moment, his father seemed to be sitting in a quiet room cultivating, and judging by the Spiritual Power circulating within him, his cultivation had progressed from the Qi Refining Seventh Level to the Qi Refining Ninth Level, entering the Late Stage Qi Refining.
Yuan Ming noticed this and immediately felt happy. If his father could take another step forward and encounter some opportunities, advancing to the Foundation Establishment was not impossible.
However, he then thought about his mother, who did not have a talent for cultivation. Now that he and his father had obtained longevity, how could he leave his mother alone with a short lifespan?
He made up his mind to specifically find some life-extending elixirs for his mother if he had the chance.
His father was very dedicated to cultivation, and his thoughts were neither hurried nor slow. Until Yuan Ming ended the possession, he did not leave the quiet room.
This also indirectly confirmed that nothing significant had happened at home, which reassured Yuan Ming a bit.Thank you for reading. This was brought to you by *.
After Yuan Ming's Divine Thought returned, he planned to continue sitting in meditation.
Vajra had been cultivating inside the Spiritual Beast Bag lately and had already devoured all of the Copper Skin Pills he obtained from Liu Su. Now he could only practice diligently in the conventional manner.
As the Vajra Spirit's intelligence gradually increased, it recorded the cultivation methods it practiced. Yuan Ming took a look at them and discovered that the Body Cultivation Method practiced by Vajra was truly extraordinary.
Previously, Yuan Ming had also collected some information on Body Cultivation and knew that the fundamental essence of the Body Cultivation Methods in the Central Plains started from the outside and worked inwards, beginning with skin and flesh, then training muscles and bones, and finally the internal organs. However, the Body Cultivation Method that Vajra passed to him started with directly tempering the internal organs and was incredibly brutal in its approach, only suited for demon beasts with exceptional physical gifts. It was simply impossible for ordinary cultivators to practice.
He could only reluctantly put aside the idea of Body Cultivation for the time being, planning to look for a proper Body Cultivation Method later on.
Suddenly his expression changed, and he took out a Communication Talisman from his bosom.
The talisman crumbled with a "sizzle," and Hu Tu's voice came through, speaking about matters concerning the Spiritual Fragrance Shop. There was a customer who wanted to discuss a major business deal, insisting on dealing with the owner directly, and he could not refuse.
Yuan Ming had just broken through with his Moonlight Technique, and his Soul Power had not yet completely stabilized. He did not wish to end his seclusion so prematurely, yet due to an overly optimistic estimate earlier, he had already consumed all the Snow Crystal Pills. Continuing to consume the previously acquired hundred thousand Spirit Stones at the current rate would eventually lead to depletion, which was not a solution.
The higher the cultivation, the more expensive the elixirs needed. If he wished to maintain the same high-speed cultivation rate until breaking through to the Late Foundation Establishment, he would still need a large number of Spirit Stones. He couldn't afford to pass up on the major deal at the Spiritual Fragrance Shop.
With this thought, he left Hua Zhi and Lei Yu to guard the Cave Mansion and headed towards Wangyue City.
"What kind of person could it be coming this time? I've already authorized Hu Tu to handle all shop affairs, what matter could there be that they insist on discussing with me? Could it be someone with ill intentions?"
Yuan Ming was already curious why someone had so adamantly requested a face-to-face meeting with him, and now, as he grew closer to the shop, thoughts rapidly flashed through his mind, causing him to subconsciously stop walking.
After a moment of contemplation, he released a soul crow and sent it diving into the city's underground, heading stealthily towards the direction of the Spiritual Fragrance Shop.
After the breakthrough to the Fourth Level of the Moonlight Technique, the soul crow also improved in its ability to change form and could now completely virtualize. It moved through the earth quickly and soon arrived at the Spiritual Fragrance Shop.
There was no one in the outer hall of the Spiritual Fragrance Shop, only Mu Yang was at the counter, and the soul crow sneaked into the inner hall, poking half its head out from a hidden corner.
In the inner hall, Hu Tu was conversing with a grey-robed elder, seemingly enjoying a pleasant conversation. This should be the person who demanded to talk with Yuan Ming.
Upon seeing the man's face clearly, Yuan Ming's pupils suddenly constricted. The person was none other than Zuo Qinghui!
"Why is he here!"
As a cultivator of Chang Chun Temple, and being at the Core Formation Stage himself, Yuan Ming had remained highly vigilant about Zuo Qinghui since their first acquaintance at the Tianxiang Auction.
If they had simply run into each other by chance in Wangyue City, Zuo Qinghui would have likely introduced himself by his name. Now, acting so covertly and asking to purchase a large batch of Spirit Incense, it was probable that he had no good intentions.
After a moment's thought, Yuan Ming immediately summoned the White Jade Shuttle to return to his Cave Mansion and instructed Hua Zhi and Lei Yu to leave the Cave Mansion and find a place to hide.
He then took out the Bronze Thunder Pattern Array and arranged it around the Cave Mansion, interweaving it with the Five Elements Illusion Destruction Array.
After all these preparations, Yuan Ming used the Hidden Element Technique to suppress his cultivation to the peak of the Early-stage Foundation Establishment and returned to Wangyue City, entering the Spiritual Fragrance Shop directly.
"A customer wants to order custom-made Spirit Incense? Oh, Senior Zuo?" Yuan Ming feigned surprise.
"Hehe, Yuan, it's been a long time," Zuo Qinghui said with a light laugh.
Yuan Ming remained calm, unsurprised. He had been using his real name in Wangyue City, and Zuo Qinghui could have easily learned of this with a little inquiry.
Hearing Yuan Ming utter the honorific "Senior," Hu Tu was stunned. He knew that Yuan Ming was already at the Foundation Establishment Stage, so could this customer be at the Core Formation Stage? With this thought, Hu Tu quickly found a reason to leave, tactfully excusing himself.
"Senior Zuo, previously I was compelled to challenge the former State Preceptor. To maintain the reputation of Chang Chun Temple, I used a false name and kept a low profile. I hope Senior does not take offense," Yuan Ming quickly recovered his usual manner and said, giving a bow.
"Not at all, all of that is in the past now. You are meticulous in thought and decisive in action, Yuan. Moreover, you executed Pu Zhengqing, establishing an extraordinary achievement for the Da Jin Cultivation World. Few of the younger generation disciples in Da Jin can match you," Zuo Qinghui's face beamed with an even broader smile.
"Senior flatters me," Zuo Qinghui's words seemed to carry an underlying meaning, and Yuan Ming carefully pondered his words.
"Your Spiritual Fragrance Shop was thriving in Little Lake City; why suddenly close it and come to open a shop in Wangyue City?" Zuo Qinghui asked, glancing around.
"Spirit Incense, unlike elixirs or spiritual materials, is not an essential item for cultivators. Only those with ample wealth would buy it for novelty. The business in Little Lake City was actually not so good anymore. Continuing there was simply not profitable," Yuan Ming replied.
"Oh, I didn't realize that aside from your strength, Yuan, you also have unique insight into business. It seems I didn't misjudge you," Zuo Qinghui chuckled.
"What do you mean by that, Senior?" Yuan Ming asked, slightly startled at the remark.
"I'll be frank. I've come here for a matter I need to discuss with you, Yuan," Zuo Qinghui sat down on a chair beside him and waved his hand to create a soundproof barrier, speaking leisurely.
"Please speak, Senior," Yuan Ming said, as he saw Zuo Qinghui act in such a manner, his heartstrings tightened, yet his face remained obliviously composed.
"Making Spirit Incense is a minor matter. I've come to you to revisit an old proposal. Do you remember the suggestion from five years ago?" Zuo Qinghui's smile grew warmer as he spoke.

chapters.title: Chapter 324 - 301 No Retreat
chapters.content:
"Are you saying that you want me to join your ranks? I'm sorry, but I, Yuan Ming, am not one for great ambitions and prefer a life of freedom. I'm afraid I'll have to disappoint you once again," Yuan Ming said, shaking his head and declining politely.
"Heh, I don't know how many Loose Cultivators wish to join Chang Chun Temple but get no chance, yet you have refused time and again. You truly are the renowned genius Foundation Establishment cultivator in Thunder Continent, not to mention Pu Zhengqing, Gu Qiulong, as well as Xu Changqing all died at your hand. They were not wronged," Zuo Qinghui said lightly, dropping a bombshell.
Upon hearing these words, Yuan Ming's mind was greatly shaken, but he quickly regained his composure.
However, that fleeting change in his demeanor did not escape Zuo Qinghui's notice.
"The things you do are covert, yet they always leave traces to follow. With careful investigation and a bit of conjecture, many clues can be unearthed at Zhenling Sect and within the Guangli Alliance," Zuo Qinghui said indifferently.
Yuan Ming's expression remained unchanged, but his heart had already sunk.
Since arriving in Little Lake City he had been extremely cautious, the only slip-ups being when he impersonated Xu Changqing's disciple to collect the breach of contract fee at the Guangli Alliance, and when he visited the Zhenling Sect to hatch the Winged Bird Egg. Zuo Qinghui had brought up these two places the moment he spoke, which meant he must have already investigated everything thoroughly.
"I'm not sure what Senior means by this. Pu Zhengqing was indeed killed by me, but I have never even heard of Xu Changqing and Gu Qiulong," Yuan Ming naturally denied everything.
If Zuo Qinghui was recording their conversation with a Magic Artifact, his guilt would be irrevocably nailed down.
Yuan Ming was also puzzled by Zuo Qinghui's intentions. With his Core Formation cultivation, if Zuo Qinghui had come to capture him, he would have done so by now. Why was he merely engaging in idle talk?
"Now that we've reached this point, there's no need for such pretenses, young friend. You don't need to worry, I have no ties with Xu Changqing. If you're willing to pay the price, I can cover this matter up for you," Zuo Qinghui said as he tapped the table beside him, moving his lips subtly to transmit his words through voice.
"I wonder, what exactly does Senior Zuo want me to do?" Yuan Ming pondered silently for a moment before replying with a transmission.
"I am in need of a large sum of Spirit Stones recently. You give me the profits from your Xuanhua Spirit Incense Shop for the past few years, along with Pu Zhengqing's bounty, and I will cover up this incident for you and pin Xu Changqing's death on Pu Zhengqing," Zuo Qinghui said straightforwardly, no longer beating around the bush.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming's heart somewhat eased.
Although the hundred thousand Spirit Stones he had acquired from Sha Hao were almost entirely used up, his shop had made some profits over the years. After accounting for the losses from Artifact Refining, there was still some left. If Zuo Qinghui only wanted Spirit Stones, Yuan Ming could grit his teeth and scrape together the amount, thereby making a deal.
"I've spent quite a bit on my cultivation these past years, and the business of the Spirit Incense Shop in Wangyue City is just average. Give me some time, and I should be able to gather thirty-five thousand Spirit Stones," Yuan Ming said.
"Within three days, fifty thousand Spirit Stones," Zuo Qinghui frowned and demanded in an uncompromising tone.
Yuan Ming weighed his options, intending to send Zuo Qinghui on his way and then leave Wangyue City at once.
At that moment, two beams of golden light shot out from across from him—it was Zuo Qinghui pointing casually.
Yuan Ming's face changed suddenly, and he swiftly dodged backward, but it was too late. A beam of golden light hit his right arm and disappeared without a trace.
Yuan Ming quickly examined his arm, which was unscathed—the golden light seemed to have fused into his body.
"Senior Zuo, what is the meaning of this?" Yuan Ming asked with a grave voice.
"Why are you so upset, my young friend? It's merely a Mana imprint I've placed within your body," Zuo Qinghui retracted his finger and said nonchalantly.
Yuan Ming's expression turned grim in an instant. He activated his Divine Sense, hastily scanning his right arm and the rest of his body, but found nothing.
"I've already agreed to give you the Spirit Stones. Why did you still have to do this?" He knew that Zuo Qinghui wasn't easy to fend off. Suppressing the anger in his heart, he asked.
"Yuan, you're playing dumb now. We are now one and the same. I did it to solidify our relationship and to make it more convenient for us to get along in the future," Zuo Qinghui chuckled.
"Get along in the future?" Yuan Ming furrowed his brow.
"Of course, you don't think you're the only one in Chang Chun Temple investigating Xu Changqing's death, do you? Many people are paying attention to this matter. If we want to keep it hidden long-term, I need to manage things at every level. How about this: from now on, you and I will split the income from this Spirit Incense Shop thirty to seventy, and I will take care of any issues with Chang Chun Temple so that you remain safe and sound," Zuo Qinghui said proudly.
Yuan Ming was almost fuming with rage as he looked at Zuo Qinghui's smug face, resisting the urge to punch him.
Xu Changqing was just an ordinary Foundation Establishment cultivator from Chang Chun Temple. To dispatch Zuo Qinghui, a Core Formation cultivator, to investigate his death was already making a big deal out of it, so how could there be others involved?
Clearly, Zuo Qinghui was interested in the profits of the Spirit Incense Shop. Greedy and never satisfied, he found fifty thousand Spirit Stones insufficient, and now he wanted to continue milking the future profits of the Xuanhua Spirit Incense Shop, obviously planning to extort Yuan Ming over the long term.
"Additionally, the two people in your shop are too weak to ensure its safety. I will send two disciples over in a few days to assist. There's no need to thank me; helping you is also helping myself," Zuo Qinghui got up, his hands behind his back as he walked around the inner hall as if inspecting his own property.
Yuan Ming, with his back to Zuo Qinghui, had a momentary look of sheer ruthlessness in his eyes.
He had backed off again and again, only for Zuo Qinghui to relentlessly press on, now even planning to have people directly supervise him!
Yuan Ming exhaled slowly, his gaze quickly returning to calm, without a hint of a ripple.
"Alright then, but Senior Zuo will need to swear by his Heart Demon that he won't tell a third person about Xu Changqing's affair," he sighed, sounding resigned.
Zuo Qinghui saw Yuan Ming yield and felt a secret triumph, promptly raising his hand to swear.
"Now that we've reached an agreement, please wait here for a moment, Senior. I'll be right back," Yuan Ming said.
"Didn't I give you three days? How is it that you can produce the Spirit Stones now?" Zuo Qinghui asked with a frown.Text acquired from M|V|LEMP&YR.
"Senior, since you urgently need Spirit Stones, I've just calculated that I still have some in my Cave Mansion," Yuan Ming said. "The rest are materials, magic artifacts, and other items. I'll go fetch them for you to review. If you wish to exchange them for Spirit Stones, I can immediately find a place to make the exchange."
"From what that kid named Hu Tu said, you've been living and cultivating in the Wangyue Mountain Range outside the city. I'll go with you. I happen to have a powerful Formation at hand, which we can set up around your Cave Mansion to strengthen its defenses," Zuo Qinghui said, giving Yuan Ming a noncommittal glance as he rose to his feet.
Yuan Ming didn't speak and walked towards the outside.
Soon, the two of them left Wangyue City and arrived at Yuan Ming's Cave Mansion.
Yuan Ming had already stopped the Five Elements Illusion Destruction Array and set it to a dormant state. The gates of the Cave Mansion revealed themselves, and he pushed the door open and walked in.
Zuo Qinghui released his Divine Sense, sensing only faint traces of an array around the Cave Mansion, which allowed him to enter with reassurance.
"Your Cave Mansion looks quite good, but the Array setup is too rudimentary. Let me lend you a hand," Zuo Qinghui said as he started to move around the Cave Mansion.
Yuan Ming didn't speak but silently walked toward the cultivation chamber, passing outside the Medicine Garden.
Zuo Qinghui paused upon seeing the various Spirit Grasses in the Medicine Garden.
He didn't care about other Spirit Grasses but his eyes lit up when he saw the Wind Orchid, and his attention shifted away from Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming immediately activated his mana, channeled it into the Storage Ring, and spurred the command flags of the Five Elements Illusion Destruction Array.
A rumbling noise erupted!
Red, green, yellow, blue, and golden lights burst forth suddenly in the Cave Mansion, rapidly thickening.
Zuo Qinghui was startled and looked behind him sharply.
There was nothing behind him, as Yuan Ming's figure had already shot out, heading straight for the Cave Mansion's entrance.
"You brat, you're seeking death!" Zuo Qinghui bellowed in anger, flicking his sleeve.
A golden ruler more than two feet long shot out, dotted with silver points like stars, emitting astonishing spiritual power fluctuations, far surpassing any top-grade magical tool.
The Golden Ruler Treasure flew out like lightning, heading for Yuan Ming's back, reaching him in the blink of an eye.
Magic Treasure! Yuan Ming's pupils shrank sharply as he immediately raised his hands behind him.
The Dragon Scale Shield and a turtle shell-like black shield flew out, positioned behind him.
Over the past five years, Yuan Ming's artifact refining skills had advanced considerably, and he could occasionally produce top-grade magical tools. The black shield was one of his best artifact refining results. Its defensive power, although not as strong as the Dragon Scale Shield, wasn't far behind.
Nevertheless, he knew that relying solely on two top-grade magical tools was unlikely to withstand the magic treasure's attack. He stretched out his arms behind him, and a golden inner armor also flew out of his body, advancing toward the golden ruler treasure from behind.
Yuan Ming didn't stop there. The Silver Light Pearl, a green toxin-infused flying sword, the black short sword he acquired from Sha Hao, the Cold Star Sword, and other magical artifacts also flew out of his sleeves, striking at Zuo Qinghui from all directions.
"An ant trying to shake a tree, utterly ridiculous!" Zuo Qinghui's face showed a grim color as he performed a spell with his hand.
Suddenly, the Golden Ruler Treasure divided into seven or eight shadows, charging at the Silver Light Pearl and the like.
With a "crack," a shadow split the Silver Light Pearl in two, dispersing all its spiritual power.
The other magical artifacts were no different, shattering upon contact with the golden ruler's shadows, like eggs striking stones.
The main body of the Golden Ruler Treasure also hit the two shields, piercing through them readily, and striking the Golden Light Inner Armor.
The inner armor was "pierced" with a sound, but being a top-grade magical tool, it managed to slightly slow down the speed of the Golden Ruler Treasure.
As for the destruction of his magical artifacts, Yuan Ming felt no regret. He slapped his hand on the Spiritual Beast Bag at his waist.
A white shadow flashed by, and the White Ape appeared, already transformed into its four-armed state. It wielded the Earth Burying Mallet, radiating a bright yellow light, and struck the Golden Ruler Treasure fiercely, causing a fan-shaped yellow ripple.
With a loud "clang," the Earth Burying Mallet exploded into countless fragments.
The Golden Ruler Treasure was slightly deflected, piercing into one of the White Ape's arms, easily penetrating its armor, and then running through its limb.
The White Ape's eyes turned bloody as it let out a berserk roar. Its two regrown arms reached out like lightning, filled with afterimages, and struck the Golden Ruler Treasure.
Its fists had turned completely golden, the void rumbling with a thunderous noise wherever they passed, and they hit the Golden Ruler Treasure hard.
A louder roar erupted, and finally, the Golden Ruler Treasure was knocked away. The White Ape's fists shattered, and its towering body was flung backward.
Yuan Ming swayed, his sleeve casting a green light, wrapping around the White Ape, and pulling it back into the Spiritual Beast Bag.
Meanwhile, the surrounding multicolored light suddenly intensified. Countless flames, enormous trees, rocks, and various illusions appeared, engulfing everything.

chapters.title: Chapter 325 - 302: You’re Actually a Soul Cultivator!
chapters.content:
Zuo Qinghui was enveloped in a layer of golden light, his form light and floating as he flew towards Yuan Ming's direction, easily breaking through the illusory shadows of flames and giant trees made of spirit light.
However, he had barely flown a few dozen feet when the environment before his eyes blurred, and his figure inexplicably returned to its original place.
A trace of astonishment flickered in Zuo Qinghui's eyes. With a single hand making a quick gesture before his chest, his body immediately shone brightly with golden light, turning into a stream of light that shot out towards another direction, his speed astonishingly fast.
But as quickly as he left, he returned even faster. Almost the moment after he flew out, he blurred before coming back to where he started.
Zuo Qinghui's expression grew somber. The array set up in this cave mansion was not simple, seemingly able to shift his location or perhaps it was some kind of illusion technique that he also couldn't see through at a glance. He couldn't afford to be careless.
Yuan Ming had taken the opportunity to flee from the cave mansion and couldn't help but breathe a sigh of relief.
It was indeed too much pressure being in close contact with an early-stage Core Formation cultivator. Fortunately, Zuo Qinghui had not exerted his full strength just now, and his own reaction had been quick enough. He had used many magic artifacts and let Big Green barely withstand the attack; otherwise, he would have been unable to defend against that strike from the Golden Ruler Treasure just now.
He knew that the Five Elements Annihilation Array inside the cave mansion might not be able to trap Zuo Qinghui for long. Once he broke free, it was nearly impossible for Yuan Ming to escape his pursuit.
Although he did not wish to confront a Core Formation Stage cultivator head-on, today's extortion had left him almost no way out. If he truly agreed, he would become a slave working to make money for Zuo Qinghui. Given the latter's greedy and stingy nature, not only would Yuan Ming be constantly monitored, making it impossible to keep secrets, but any hope for future breakthroughs would also be dashed, forever depriving him of his freedom and eternally enslaving him.
Yuan Ming took a deep breath, a resolute look flashing in the depths of his eyes, no matter what, he had to leave him here today, to forever thwart future troubles!
While mentally commanding Hua Zhi and Lei Yu to come over, he took out a bronze giant sword in one hand. The sword was brimming with green thunder, the very Bronze Thunder Sword from Shi Dian, and with a fierce thrust, he plunged it into the ground!
The purple spirit stone on the hilt immediately flickered with spirit light, incessantly infusing spiritual power into the ground below.
Over the past five years, although he seldom left the house, he still managed to repair the sword and embed it with high-grade Thunder Attribute Spirit Stones thanks to the Thunder Attribute Ore he found continuously.
Inside the cave mansion, Zuo Qinghui stood in place, no longer acting rashly, but spreading his Divine Sense to carefully observe his surroundings and deducing the changes in the Five Elements Annihilation Array.
By his estimate, although this trapping array was somewhat clever, it was not indecipherable with his knowledge of formations.
However, just at that moment, the roaring sounds of "rumble" thunder echoed, and streaks of green lightning emerged from the ground, weaving rapidly, forming a Thunder Array with a radius of several dozen feet surrounding him, more powerful than when Yuan Ming was trapped by the same array.
Zuo Qinghui gave a slight chuckle, raising one hand and sending the Golden Ruler Treasure flying out, spinning rapidly, and striking the Thunder Array before him.
With a "zilah" sound, the Thunder Array was easily torn open with a massive hole.
The Golden Ruler Treasure did not stop there, transforming into a golden rainbow and fiercely striking a certain part of the Five Elements Annihilation Array.
With a "chit" sound, the entire Five Elements Annihilation Array also trembled, a white mark appeared as though it was a crack.
Zuo Qinghui's body lit up again with an eye-catching golden glow, flowing up and down, and under his control, he shot out from the opening in the Thunder Array, heading straight for the white crack.
Although Zuo Qinghui had not discovered the operation pattern of the Five Elements Annihilation Array, he aimed to use brute force to break the cunning array. Seeing this, Yuan Ming showed no panic. With a twist of his hand holding the Command Flags,
Green spirit light surged around the white mark, and numerous green tree shadows emerged from nowhere, enveloping the white mark within them, and in a flash, disappeared from sight.
Zuo Qinghui missed and became furious. His ten fingers changed seals rapidly.
The Golden Ruler Treasure blurred slightly and morphed into dozens of golden ruler shadows, then, like a storm of violent thunder, struck various parts of the array. The space around the array stirred, the Five-Colored Spiritual Light boiling like churning water, yet it showed no sign of collapse.
Yuan Ming meanwhile, secretly mobilized the soul crows, a flicker of black light at his brow, sending out four soul crows.
He made hand seals and used the Dream Butterfly Illusion Technique.
Gaah...
The four soul crows quietly flew to each corner of the cave mansion and then simultaneously opened their mouths to caw, black sound waves billowing out and rushing towards Zuo Qinghui.
In an inconspicuous corner of the cave mansion, two newly-made Seven-step Immovable incense sticks were already burning inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
If previously Zuo Qinghui still harbored intentions of making Yuan Ming submit and turning him into a money tree, his murderous intent was now intense, truly harboring killing intent towards Yuan Ming.
Just when he was about to unleash another technique to completely shatter the trapping array, he suddenly felt a disturbance in the void around him, and the enveloping black sound waves closed in. His face showed surprise as he swiftly flew backward.
In that instant, he had not yet understood what these black sound waves were but suspected that they definitely weren't going to be beneficial to him. It was better to dodge them first.
A Core Formation Stage cultivator's speed far exceeded any Foundation Establishment existence, and his form retreated a great distance in the blink of an eye, almost flying out of the cover of the black sound waves.
Yuan Ming did not panic at all. With a flip of his hand, the green Array Flag shot out, merging into the array as a streak of green light.
