Zuo Qinghui's vision changed, and a huge green forest suddenly appeared overhead, followed by a pressure so heavy it seemed to weigh tens of thousands of pounds, causing a slight delay in his movement.
It was this moment of hesitation that allowed him to be engulfed by the black sound waves released by the soul crows.
Zuo Qinghui's eyes became blurry, and he stood there, dazed.
Yuan Ming's face lit up with hidden joy, yet he dared not delay. With the flick of his finger, the Absolute Shadow Needle shot out like lightning toward Zuo Qinghui's temple.
A black shadow flashed in his hand as he gripped the Soul Destroying Sword, slicing through the air and emitting a sharp, piercing screech.
A black Sword Qi, four or five zhang long, howled as it shot straight for Zuo Qinghui's head.
At that moment, the Golden Ruler Treasure suddenly appeared beside Zuo Qinghui, blocking the Absolute Shadow Needle before rapidly encircling everything.
With a "ding," the Absolute Shadow Needle was forcibly sliced in two.
Zuo Qinghui's figure also abruptly shifted to the side, avoiding the attack of the Soul Destroying Sword Energy, his eyes becoming exceptionally clear as he turned and pounced toward Yuan Ming's position.
"You're a Soul Cultivator! You're actually in league with Pu Zhengqing!"Note: Check * for any corrections.
As the words fell, the Golden Ruler Treasure flew out of his hand, transforming into a vast, long rainbow that shot toward Yuan Ming's location.
Everywhere it passed, the Illusion Array's spirit light was effortlessly torn apart, revealing Yuan Ming's figure.
Before he could dodge, the Golden Ruler Treasure was already striking down upon him, moving several times faster than before, like a flash of golden lightning.
With a "pfft," Yuan Ming's body was split in two, but unexpectedly, no blood appeared, and both halves of the body dissolved into phantoms.
Deep within the Five Elements Annihilation Array, Yuan Ming's figure emerged, wiping the virtual sweat from his forehead.
That last moment was due to the virtual and real changes of the Five Elements Annihilation Array, where everything within the array could be turned into phantoms through this transformation.
This was a profound alteration of the Five Elements Annihilation Array, which took him five years of focused effort to learn to run this array, consuming numerous Spirit Stones to finally master it.
Fortunately, he had invested great effort in diligently practicing this array, which was his lifeline.
Yuan Ming became even more cautious, shifting his position once more while simultaneously releasing all eight soul crows to cast the Crow Caw Illusion Technique upon Zuo Qinghui.
The black sound waves, now more concentrated than before, enveloped Zuo Qinghui, their coverage even wider.
Zuo Qinghui's face tensed, facing a Soul Cultivator in combat for the first time, he retreated once again to evade.
However, behind him, the void was filled with thunderous light, with eight thick bolts of green thunder streaking out, their contained might astonishing, forcing Zuo Qinghui to pay heed.
A flash of cold light in Zuo Qinghui's eyes, and the Golden Ruler Treasure let out a long cry, its golden brilliance flaring up as if it were armor enveloping him completely.
The eight bolts of green thunder struck faster, hitting Zuo Qinghui first.
Dazzling green thunder light burst forth before quickly dissipating.
Zuo Qinghui's Protective Golden Light was shattered substantially, with the arm holding the Golden Ruler charred black.
The black sound waves emitted by the soul crows swept over, giving him no chance to dodge, engulfing his body.
Powerful waves of illusion emanated by the sound waves assaulted Zuo Qinghui's Divine Soul like a tidal surge.
Having just been injured by the Bronze Thunder Pattern Array, Zuo Qinghui's Divine Soul was unstable. Unable to resist, his eyes showed signs of confusion, truly falling into an illusion.
Behind him, a black light flashed past as the previously evaded Soul Destroying Sword Energy flew back, striking atop Zuo Qinghui's head, entering his Sea of Consciousness, and fiercely slashing at his Divine Soul.
The illusions before Zuo Qinghui's eyes vanished, his body shaking violently. He could not help but clutch his head, letting out a pained moan, rooted to the spot.
Yuan Ming narrowed his eyes and, with a swing of the Soul Destroying Sword, struck thrice in rapid succession.
Three beams of Soul Destroying Sword Energy were unleashed, striking him while Zuo Qinghui was unable to move.
With a wail of agony, Zuo Qinghui bled from the seven orifices on his face, his complexion deathly pale, his Sea of Consciousness and Divine Soul almost annihilated.
His mana circulation was also greatly affected, with the Golden Ruler Treasure's light becoming extremely dim, only a fraction of what it had been before.
At the same time, Yuan Ming's body also swayed slightly, his complexion terribly pale, his Sea of Consciousness Soul Power nearly depleted.
The Soul Destroying Sword's power was astonishing, yet the consumption of Soul Power was also exceptionally immense. With his current level of Divine Soul Power, channeling four strikes in a short period was already his limit.
At this moment, the Soul Destroying Sword suddenly let out a humming sound, bursting forth with a fierce and deadly aura, violently impacting Yuan Ming's Divine Soul as his already weakened Soul Power trembled intensely.
What was happening? Pain surged in Yuan Ming's Sea of Consciousness, his head felt as if it would split open, and he was gripped by panic. He released the Soul Destroying Sword too late, his Divine Soul violently shaking. Yuan Ming's head spun, his vision darkening, feeling his consciousness fading away.
In this critical moment, Yuan Ming raised a hand to retrieve the Stealing Heaven Tripod, which entered his arm. A warm current gushed forth, flowing into his parched Sea of Consciousness.
His Soul Power quickly recovered, and the warm stream enveloped his Divine Soul, merging into it. The intense pain in Yuan Ming's Divine Soul was greatly alleviated, and his dissipating consciousness rapidly regained clarity.

chapters.title: Chapter 326 - 303: Divine Soul Cleft
chapters.content:
"What just happened? Could the Soul Destroying Sword backlash against its owner?" Yuan Ming furrowed his brows, his expression fluctuating between dark and light.
Although he had found information about the Soul Destroying Sword from Sha Hao's memories, Sha Hao was not the refiner of the sword and knew only incomplete information about it.
He had actually already considered that the Sword Qi released by the Soul Destroying Sword, capable of ignoring an enemy's defense, directly attacking the Divine Soul, and devouring it, would come with a terrifying ability, and its use would surely carry a significant price.
Now it seemed that the sword could indeed easily kill enemies above one's level, but the cost was a backlash against the owner, truly making it a double-edged sword that wounded others as well as oneself.
To deal with Zuo Qinghui, whose cultivation was far above his own, Yuan Ming had nearly exhausted his Divine Soul Power. Facing the backlash of the Soul Destroying Sword, he was naturally without the strength to protect himself. Fortunately, he possessed the Stealing Heaven Tripod as his trump card.
In truth, if he hadn't had the gentle nourishment and soul-stabilizing effect of the Stealing Heaven Tripod for the Divine Soul, he might not have dared to embark on the soul cultivation path—full of thorns and bordering on a life and death struggle.
Yuan Ming took a deep breath and looked at the Soul Destroying Sword on the ground beside him, his eyes revealing a complex look.
"Eh!" He suddenly let out a light exclamation of surprise.
The warm current still flowing from within the Stealing Heaven Tripod showed no sign of stopping. It continued to pour into his Divine Soul and was even splitting in two.
Yuan Ming hurriedly performed Inner Observation and took a look inside his body. He was startled by what he saw.
Unbeknownst to him, a crack had appeared on his Divine Soul, seemingly caused by the fierce evil aura of the Soul Destroying Sword's previous assault. It might have been small and gone unnoticed before, but now, under the Stealing Heaven Tripod's influence, it had not healed but instead deepened considerably. It looked as though the two parts of the Divine Soul could completely separate at any moment.
The two-part split of the warm current was respectively pouring into the two separated parts of the Divine Soul.
"How could this happen?" Yuan Ming couldn't help but feel astonished.
Fortunately, the heart-wrenching pain of his Divine Soul had already subsided. Although the crack was deepening, it seemed to have no significant impact on his Divine Soul.
Within the Five Elements Illusion Destruction Array, Zuo Qinghui had already taken the opportunity to rest. He had placed several talismans on his body and swallowed an elixir; the paleness of his face steadily improved.
Meanwhile, his Golden Ruler Treasure was spinning around his body, rousing a golden glow that enveloped his figure.
Yuan Ming furrowed his brows and, setting aside the anomaly of his Divine Soul for the moment, decided to focus on dealing with his formidable enemy first. He urged the Array Flag in his hand, continuing to activate the Five Elements Illusion Destruction Array.
At the same time, with a pat on his waist, Vajra shot out from his Spiritual Beast Bag, turning into a white shadow and pouncing at Zuo Qinghui.
Hua Zhi and Lei Yu were also respectively rushing toward Zuo Qinghui from above and below.
Zuo Qinghui, having no time to continue tending to his Divine Soul injuries, pointed a single hand towards the void. The Golden Ruler flickered, transforming into numerous ruler shadows that furiously slashed at Vajra.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming formed a hand-seal and urged the five Array Flags before him. A green shadow flickered above Zuo Qinghui's head, and countless images of giant trees emerged, resembling a vast and unending forest.
A tremendous oppressive force descended, causing Zuo Qinghui's figure to falter and the speed of the Golden Ruler Treasure to significantly decrease.
Vajra ducked low, avoiding a strike from the Golden Ruler Treasure, then clenched a fist with one ape paw and struck Zuo Qinghui hard in the chest.
Zuo Qinghui's body barely resisted Vajra's strike with a golden light screen, but he was still sent flying backward by a mighty force.Readaheadandgetupdatesbyvisiting*.
"Crackle!"
Three streaks of silver lightning shot out from the nearby void, striking at Zuo Qinghui's back.
Dozens of purple-black vines emerged from another part of the void, their tips congealing into green wooden swords stabbing towards Zuo Qinghui's body.
Zuo Qinghui let out a low roar, and the glow from the Golden Ruler Treasure brightened, rapidly weaving around his body. A series of ruler shadows emerged densely packed, grinding the silver lightning and purple-black vines into pieces.
As a Core Formation Stage cultivator, although Zuo Qinghui had suffered great damage to his Divine Soul and had only a fraction of his strength remaining, he was not someone that Foundation Establishment stage spirit beasts like Hua Zhi and Lei Yu could handle.
Although Vajra was stronger than Hua Zhi and Lei Yu, it was already injured.
Zuo Qinghui, having sustained serious damage to his Divine Soul and after casting spells, was gasping for breath. He reached towards his Storage Bag at his waist, and the space around him fluctuated, revealing a purple spear adorned with nine blue dragon pattern engravings—the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear purchased at the auction.
At the same time, a blood-red, half-foot-long cylinder as thick as a fist appeared above his head with a flash of blood light.
Yuan Ming's expression turned stern, and, setting aside his worry about the abnormality of his Divine Soul, he once again cast the Crow Caw Illusion Technique. Eight soul crows emitted black Sound Waves in unison, instantly enveloping Zuo Qinghui's body.
If Zuo Qinghui had been at his peak, he naturally would not have been so easily hit, but now his resistance to Soul Cultivation Illusion Techniques was greatly reduced, and he immediately fell into an illusion, standing motionless.
Yuan Ming gritted his teeth, picked up the Soul Destroying Sword from the ground, and poured Mana and Soul Power into it. The sword emitted a cheerful clear hum and shot out a black Sword Qi about a zhang long.
"Slas**h**!"
He shouted loudly and swung the sword in the air.
A black Sword Qi that was seven to eight zhang long and as wide as a door burst forth, emanating a massive Divine Soul absorbing power. Nearby, Hua Zhi, Lei Yu, and even Vajra felt their Divine Souls restless, as if they might burst out of their bodies and be sucked away by the Sword Qi.
The three of them hurriedly flew backward, feeling that the farther they were from the black Sword Qi, the better.
The black Sword Qi, fast as lightning, flashed by and buried itself into Zuo Qinghui's head, viciously slashing his Divine Soul.
Zuo Qinghui's entire body shuddered, with wisps of black light spraying out from his seven orifices. His Sea of Consciousness and Divine Soul violently collapsed, completely extinguished by the astonishing Sword Qi!
The Golden Ruler Treasure, the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear, and the blood-colored cylinder fell to the ground with a clatter, having lost their wielder.
Yuan Ming immediately threw the Soul Destroying Sword aside. This time, however, the sword did not backlash unexpectedly; when it left his palm, it began to glow with a ghostly black light, emitting a suction force.
Clusters of scattered Soul Power gathered and were devoured by the Soul Destroying Sword.
The Soul Destroying Sword trembled slightly, giving off an excited hum. The four runes on the blade deepened in color noticeably before it settled down after a few breaths.
Indeed, it was a fierce sword! Witnessing this, Yuan Ming couldn't help but exclaim in awe.
He formed a hand seal to stop the operation of the Five Elements Illusion Destruction Array and immediately sat down to meditate, inspecting the condition of his mind. He didn't even bother to check his spoils of war.
The torrent of warmth from the Stealing Heaven Tripod had almost ceased. Only now, the cracks on his Divine Soul had deepened significantly, and the flow of Soul Power between the two parts had almost ceased, seeming as if they were about to split into two completely.
Upon seeing this, Yuan Ming couldn't help but feel deep regret.
Having a problem with the Divine Soul was definitely a major issue for a cultivator, especially for a Soul Cultivator like him.
He had thought that with the Stealing Heaven Tripod's protection, the cracks wouldn't have too much of an impact on his Divine Soul. Now, however, the tripod seemed to have accelerated the complete splitting of his Divine Soul.
Although it seemed that the split had not caused any apparent effects for the time being, who knew what could happen in the future?
At least he had never read in any classics about a cultivator whose Divine Soul was torn or split managing to be unharmed. Such a situation would usually lead to the complete collapse of the Divine Soul.
But now that it had come to this, he knew there was no use lamenting over spilt milk. He had no reason to dwell on it any longer. If he hadn't made a decisive move, he might have faced more than just the splitting of his Divine Soul; he could have been killed by Zuo Qinghui, both body and soul destroyed.
The moment Yuan Ming thought of this, he calmed his mind and spirit and began running the Moonlight Technique, trying to repair the damage to his Divine Soul as much as possible.
However, as soon as he ran the Moonlight Technique without operating it, Soul Power from both parts of his Divine Soul began circulating, and the crack started to widen at a visible rate.
Yuan Ming's heart lurched, and he hurriedly stopped running his Soul Power, but it was too late—the crack had reached its peak.
With a "snap," his Divine Soul split into two, with one portion, about one-fifth the size of the rest, completely severed.
Yuan Ming's emotions exploded, and his heartstrings reached their limit. He couldn't even care about the excruciating pain that seemed to tear his head apart, feeling like a condemned prisoner on the scaffold, waiting for his Divine Soul to suffer great damage or even collapse completely.
Yet the anticipated disaster did not occur. After his Divine Soul split into two, aside from a momentary headache, there were no other effects—everything seemed to be the same as before.
"What's going on? Could it be that the splitting of the Divine Soul isn't actually a big issue?" Yuan Ming was astonished, continuing to probe the condition of his Divine Soul with his inner sense.
The larger portion of the Divine Soul still stood firm in the center of his Sea of Consciousness, with Soul Power slowly gathering around it and merging within as before.
A stream of warmth emanated from the Incense Burner Mark once again, blending into the main Divine Soul. Remarkably, the part that had been severed began to regrow at a visible rate. It seemed it would not be long before it fully recovered.
Yuan Ming then realized that under the protection of the Stealing Heaven Tripod, his Divine Soul could still regenerate, which explained why he hadn't felt any abnormalities.
The severed piece of Divine Soul slowly drifted around the Sea of Consciousness without dissipating.
This scene piqued Yuan Ming's interest.
He focused his attention on the severed Divine Soul and, upon closer examination, found that its Soul Power was not weak, roughly equivalent to that of two soul crows.
As soon as the thought crossed his mind, the form of the severed piece of Divine Soul changed abruptly, transforming into a soul crow, albeit a transparent one.
Yuan Ming was taken aback by its responsiveness. Just thinking of a soul crow caused the fragment of Divine Soul to morph into one. Could it transform into something else?
No sooner had the thought occurred to him than the shape of the soul crow changed once again, this time into a soul bat, identical to Sha Hao's Blood Bat.
A notion struck Yuan Ming, and he manipulated the fragment of Divine Soul to morph into various shapes. His Divine Sense could unfold, transforming into a Soul Wave similar to Divine Sense.
The next moment, this fragment of Divine Soul flew out of the Sea of Consciousness, assuming the guise of a soul crow and zipping around his Cave Mansion.
Yuan Ming watched the transparent soul crow with a smile, but his smile suddenly froze.
This soul crow seemed very much like his other soul crows, but it was fundamentally different. It possessed a degree of independent consciousness. This was not so obvious while it was in his Sea of Consciousness, but once it was released, he immediately sensed this difference.
While his other soul crows could share his vision and even multitask while controlling corpses, they were completely under his control. This transparent soul crow, however, had a sense of self.

chapters.title: Chapter 327 - 304: Soul Splitting Control
chapters.content:
At this time, Yuan Ming felt as if he was driving a spirit beast while he controlled the flight of the transparent soul crow.
Fortunately, the self-awareness of this transparent soul crow was not strong, and it had a special affinity for him, obeying his commands without issue.
Upon seeing this, Yuan Ming gradually relaxed. He carefully sensed the transparent soul crow through his Divine Sense and soon, a look of pleasant surprise appeared on his face.
This soul crow was not formed through a Soul Cultivation secret technique, but it was a transformation of his own Divine Soul's Origin Power. It possessed two abilities similar to those of a Soul Cultivator, able to travel far with its soul and manipulate other objects.
The soul traveling was no different from other soul crows, except that it seemed to cover a much greater distance. As for how far, he would have to test it later.
As for manipulating other objects, it was even more powerful than a soul crow's ability to control corpses, as the transparent soul crow could possess and control both corpses and living creatures.
Of course, controlling living creatures had a prerequisite— the target's Divine Soul Power could not be stronger than that of the transparent soul crow itself.
Driven by curiosity, Yuan Ming immediately commanded the transparent soul crow to fly out and merge with the corpse of Zuo Qinghui, trying to control the corpse.
Zuo Qinghui's thoroughly dimmed eyes suddenly surged with new vitality, his heart began to beat again, and his Qi-Blood started flowing through his body.
Before long, "Zuo Qinghui" managed to stand up by pushing off the ground with one hand.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming was astonished.
The transparent soul crow's control of the corpse was so lifelike that Zuo Qinghui, in every aspect, appeared to be a living person, breathing slowly through his mouth and nose as if truly revived.
After his astonishment, he quickly understood the reasons.
First, Zuo Qinghui had just fallen, and the cause of death was the soul-destroying blow of the Soul Destroying Sword; his body had not suffered much damage. The possession by the transparent soul crow was akin to injecting a new Divine Soul into the body, revitalizing it.
Second, the corpse control ability of the transparent soul crow was much more flexible than that of ordinary soul crows, increasing the likelihood of reviving the corpse.
Such revival of bodily functions like breathing was not entirely unheard of. Yuan Ming had also seen similar records on the Jade Scroll concerning the Bone Map at the Black Fire Sect.
The Black Fire Sect excelled in the art of refining corpses, having refined countless corpses. Indeed, some bodies not significantly damaged could under external stimuli, potentially resume breathing and heartbeat.
This condition was not really a resurrection from death but merely a stimulation of the remnants of vitality in the corpse, allowing the corpse to remain longer in the world; the dissipated Divine Soul could not return.
However, such a resurrected corpse was significant for a Corpse Refining Sect like the Black Fire Sect and could be used to refine some higher-level corpses.
But the current Zuo Qinghui was different. If the transparent soul crow continued to possess him, this body could genuinely come back to life.
Yuan Ming examined the internal state of Zuo Qinghui. Various parts of his viscera showed purple-black spots, clearly the result of being eroded by the Poisonous Incense.
He nodded slightly, seeing that the Seven-step Immovable Poisonous Fragrance had some effect on Core Formation Stage cultivators, but their immense Mana could suppress the potent poison.
He summoned Hua Zhi, drew out the potent poison from Zuo Qinghui's body, and then examined his Dantian with his Divine Sense.
Within Zuo Qinghui's Dantian, a golden and blue Golden Core floated, already shattered into several pieces, with most of its Mana dispersed, only remaining at the Early-stage Foundation Establishment level.
Now with Zuo Qinghui's corpse revived and possessing a Divine Soul again, the leakage of Mana in the Dantian stopped, and it slowly started to rotate anew.
Yuan Ming tried to control this Mana and experienced no issues, as if it were Mana he had cultivated himself.
He nodded to himself in approval, amazed that the transparent soul crow's ability to control corpses even extended to restraining the Mana within the body. In the future, when controlling corpses, he could utilize its Divine Skills from its lifetime. If used properly, it could yield unexpected effects.
After controlling Zuo Qinghui's corpse for a while, he allowed the transparent soul crow to leave.
Zuo Qinghui's body once again became immobile, but his breathing did not stop, resembling a living dead standing there, and the Mana in his Dantian continued to disperse again.
Yuan Ming nodded and directed the transparent soul crow to fly towards Lei Yu, vanishing into its body to try controlling a living creature.
A fleeting haze passed through Lei Yu's eyes, which quickly cleared up, and it flapped its wings and flew to Yuan Ming, landing beside him.
Yuan Ming could distinctly feel that at this moment, Lei Yu was completely under the control of his transparent soul crow.
Just like controlling Zuo Qinghui's corpse, the transparent soul crow could manipulate the demonic power within Lei Yu, executing Thunder Strike, speeding flight, and even summoning Lei Yu's Divine Skills.
A satisfied expression appeared on Yuan Ming's face. He soon controlled the transparent soul crow to leave Lei Yu and flew towards the distance to test how far the transparent soul crow could travel.
The transparent soul crow, being purely formed of Divine Soul Power, was much lighter than ordinary soul crows, easily penetrating stone walls and quickly flying into the distance, about three times the speed of ordinary soul crows.
In just a short time, it had flown over fifty or sixty li, and it still hadn't reached its limit.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming continued to command the transparent soul crow to fly forward. After another quarter hour, he started feeling strained.
By now, the transparent soul crow had flown out a hundred and fifty li.
"A hundred and fifty li of far travel!"
Yuan Ming couldn't help but feel excited. The surprises the split Divine Soul had given him were too significant; this greatly surpassed the capabilities of Soul Cultivators. Even Xi Cangqiong in his prime probably never had the power to influence places a hundred and fifty li away.
He did not let the transparent soul crow stay outside for too long and immediately summoned it back.
Yuan Ming calmed his mind, stood up, and came to Zuo Qinghui's corpse, picking up the Golden Ruler Treasure, the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear, and the Blood-red Cylinder.
The Golden Ruler Treasure was only two feet long, but it was very heavy, weighing about seventy to eighty pounds, composed of an unknown material.
Although it had not been activated, its surface still emitted a faint spirit light and looked very dazzling.
Yuan Ming activated his Divine Sense in an attempt to penetrate its interior but was blocked by an invisible force. His attempts to infuse it with Mana were like casting a stone into the sea, completely ineffective.
"Indeed, only Core Formation Stage cultivators can use Magic Treasures," he shook his head, murmuring to himself, examined the golden ruler closely for a moment, and discovered that the two tiny characters "Golden Sun" were engraved at its bottom.
Yuan Ming then picked up the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear and found that it was also weighty in hand. Divine Sense similarly failed to inspect its interior, and its connection to the East Sea Secret Treasure remained elusive.
Although he couldn't use them, he still played with the Golden Sun Ruler and Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear for a while before carefully storing these treasures and shifting his gaze to the blood-red cylinder.
The aura of the Blood-red Cylinder indicated it was only a top-grade magical tool, but since Zuo Qinghui took it out at a critical moment, it must have been extraordinary.
After a brief examination, Yuan Ming released his Divine Sense into the blood-red cylinder, his expression soon showing surprise.
The structure of the Blood-red Cylinder was peculiar, divided into two parts. The front part was engraved with four strange, blood-colored runes that he did not recognize.
A blood-colored bullet the size of a jujube fruit was suspended inside, gently trembling, ready to be launched.
The rear part was akin to a Spiritual Beast Bag made of blood-colored space, seemingly used to store something.
Yuan Ming pondered for a moment and understood.
It seemed that the blood-colored bullet was a type of offensive weapon, but since he was unclear about its origin, he refrained from activating it and stored the cylinder as well.
He took a Storage Bag from Zuo Qinghui's waist, and his expression immediately turned joyful as his Divine Sense entered it.
The possessions of a Core Formation Stage cultivator from Chang Chun Temple were indeed substantial. Just the Spirit Stones in Zuo Qinghui's Storage Bag amounted to over fifty thousand, and there were many spiritual materials and elixirs as well.
Among these, about five or six spiritual materials seemed to be of decent quality, three of which should suffice to refine top-grade magical tools.
As for the elixirs, they were all consumable by Core Formation Stage cultivators and were of no immediate use to him.
Yuan Ming's gaze swept over those items, quickly moved on, and he took three more objects from the Storage Bag: a blood-red flying knife and two Jade Scrolls, one white and one red.
The Blood-Red Flying Knife was over a foot long, thin as a cicada's wing, with a blade that sparkled with a chilling brilliance, giving the sense of being indestructible.
Engraved with four runes inside, the knife was evidently a top-grade magical tool, emitting spiritual power fluctuations that were even more potent than those of the Silver Light Pearl and the Absolute Shadow Needle.Findthischapter'ssourceon*.
Yuan Ming probed the runes on the blood-red flying knife with his Divine Sense, which were very similar to those on the blood-red cylinder, showing that both were of the same type of magical tool.
He then inspected the two Jade Scrolls, the white scroll contained the "Golden Shadow Sword Technique," a very profound cultivation technique indeed, complete enough to practice up to the pinnacle of the Core Formation Stage, seemingly a heritage of Chang Chun Temple.
Zuo Qinghui's corpse had regained vitality. If preserved correctly, it could continue practicing this Golden Shadow Sword Technique to see if its cultivation could be enhanced.
Yuan Ming's Divine Sense entered the blood-red Jade Scroll, and his eyes quickly deepened with intensity.
The blood-red Jade Scroll recorded a heretical cultivation technique called "Blood Transformation Technique." The mnemonics were completely intact, also practicable up to the pinnacle of the Core Formation Stage.
The practice of the Blood Transformation Technique was profoundly sinister, actually requiring the consumption of fresh demon beast blood, using the spiritual power-rich Beast Blood as one would an elixir. The higher the grade of the demon beast, the stronger the spiritual power contained in its blood, and the more it would aid the Blood Transformation Technique.
This cultivation technique was morbidly vicious and cultivating it would affect one's disposition, gradually turning the cultivator bloodthirsty and murderous. Despite these drawbacks, the power of the Blood Transformation Technique was considerable. Its Mana had a strong corrosive property, capable of directly corroding both Mana Shields and magical tools, as well as being able to extract the Essence Blood of enemies during battle.
The scroll also included several formidable secret techniques, like the powerful Blood Flame Secret Technique, the Blood Spirit Great Method, which combined killing enemies and self-preservation, and the Blood Swapping Technique, capable of curing diseases and saving people, refreshing Yuan Ming remarkably.
"Oh!" His eyes suddenly brightened, looking towards the last part of the blood-red Jade Scroll.
It recorded the methods for refining two types of magical treasures, one of which was called the "Blood Star Tube," matching the description of the blood-red cylinder, though regrettably only refined to the level of a top-grade magical tool.
The four runes inside the magical tool were all of types like Blood Transformation and corrosion. After storing a demon beast corpse inside the rear space of the Blood Star Tube, the four runes could refine the corpse, transforming it into corrosive blood-colored bullets, particularly effective in corroding protective Mana and magical tools.
The power of the blood-colored bullets would depend on which demon beast had been refined. If it were formed from a Third-level Demon Beast corpse, it could even threaten a Core Formation Stage cultivator.
Upon seeing this, Yuan Ming quickly took out the Blood Star Tube, his face revealing joy.
In the fierce battle just prior, Zuo Qinghui had taken out this Blood Star Tube using it to deploy a blood-colored bullet whose power was undoubtedly significant, perhaps even formed by refining a Third-level Demon Beast corpse.
As for another magical treasure recorded in the Jade Scroll named "Blood Transformation Saber," its description matched that of the Blood-Red Flying Knife.
The knife's runes were similar to those of the Blood Star Tube but more focused on attack. A cut from its blade light would inflict Blood Poison, and without a proper antidote, the victim would quickly secrete pus and die.

chapters.title: Chapter 328 - 305: Fleeing to the Northern Desert
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming's mood at the moment was still pretty good. In the previous battle, his magic artifacts had almost been destroyed by Zuo Qinghui, and if he could acquire these two top-grade magical tools, it would make up for his losses.
However, Zuo Qinghui was a cultivator of Chang Chun Temple and it seemed unlikely that he would spend great effort to refine such malicious instruments. It was more probable that he obtained the blood-colored Jade Scroll and two weapons by killing some heterodox cultivator, seizing them in the process.
Yuan Ming collected the two weapons and two Jade Scrolls, as well as the remains of Zuo Qinghui's physical body. He then waved his hand to emit a beam of cyan light, which quickly circled around the cave mansion, gathering all the broken artifacts scattered from the battle.
He looked over these discarded artifacts with a hint of regret, but then his eyebrows lifted as he picked up the inner armor that had been pierced by the Golden Sun Ruler, mentally exclaiming his good fortune.
Although the inner armor seemed to be penetrated, its Spiritual Power had not dissipated; it had only weakened significantly, and its four runes were still relatively intact.
With his Artifact Refining Technique already quite advanced, Yuan Ming knew that such golden inner armor could be completely restored if fused with suitable spiritual materials.
Among the three top-grade spiritual materials in Zuo Qinghui's Storage Bag, there happened to be a piece of gold-attributed ore. He could find an opportunity to try repairing the inner armor later.
Yuan Ming put away the golden inner armor and was about to collect the other shattered artifacts when he suddenly stopped, picked up a green broken sword, which was a part of the Green Jade Poisonous Sword.
The Poisonous Sword had been cut in half by the Golden Sun Ruler, its runes completely collapsed, and the Spiritual Power within its materials had dissipated entirely, rendering the broken sword worthless.
Yet Yuan Ming's eyes were fixed on the broken edge of the sword as he tapped it on the ground several times.
With a "clink," a square, purple jade piece about an inch in size fell out, devoid of any Mana fluctuations, but with a faint green light flickering within.
Moreover, as soon as the dark green jade piece touched the ground, the nearby earth visibly turned purple and black at a speed visible to the naked eye, as if something was spreading from within the jade piece, eroding the terrain.
Yuan Ming raised his hand to gesture, applying an Exorcism Technique, and the purple jade piece levitated from the ground, halting further decay of the earth.
"It seems that the potent poison of the Green Jade Poisonous Sword originates from this purple jade piece. I wonder what the history behind this object is?" He carefully examined the purple jade piece, pondering to himself.
On the other side of the jade piece was a small scorpion image, lifelike, as if it were some kind of mark.
After studying it for a while and finding nothing else, Yuan Ming took out a White Jade Box and carefully placed the purple jade piece inside.
Jade materials are inherently effective at resisting the erosion of potent toxins due to their solid and moist nature, and this box was made from White Water Jade, which was particularly adept at deterring poison, capable of effectively limiting the spread of the intense poison on the purple jade piece.
As expected, the terrible poison on the purple jade piece was unable to corrode the White Water Jade Box, only managing to etch a light purple mark after a long time.
Not fully reassured, Yuan Ming took out another larger jade box and placed the White Water Jade Box inside before finally storing it away with peace of mind.
After dealing with these trifles, he sat down to consider his next move.
Zuo Qinghui had managed to find his way to Wangyue City, there's no guarantee that other people from Chang Chun Temple would not come looking. Now that he had killed Zuo Qinghui, no matter how you looked at it, he had firmly established enmity with Chang Chun Temple.C*h$eck My Vi@r+tu*al%[email protected] E^m$p+i%r+e& (+M&V1#L#EM!P^1^Y&R)- for the l!a-t.e!s-t u&p*da$te@s+.
Previously, he could claim that their duel was an open one, sanctioned by a life-and-death contract, and Chang Chun Temple, due to various factors, wouldn't openly trouble him. But after killing Zuo Qinghui, he no longer had such an excuse.
It was clear that he could no longer stay here.
It was a pity to abandon such a secluded and safe Cave Mansion.
Yuan Ming swiftly moved throughout the cave, retrieving the Five Elements Illusion Destruction Array and the Bronze Thunder Pattern Array. He then collected the casting furnace and all the Spirit Herbs and Spiritual Medicines from the Medicine Garden. He didn't spare the black branch steeped in the water vat either.
This black branch had also been intermittently researched by him over the past five years, yet he still could not determine its origin or use.
Yuan Ming took Vajra, Hua Zhi, and Lei Yu with him as he left the Cave Mansion and headed towards Wangyue City.
He didn't enter the city but instead wrote a letter and had it delivered to Hu Tu, instructing them to close down the Spiritual Fragrance Shop and leave the place as soon as possible, with the incenses and a small amount of Spirit Stones inside the shop to be theirs to keep.
Afterward, Yuan Ming summoned Lei Yu, sat cross-legged on its back, and flew northward.
He had already decided on his next destination.
Yuan Ming took out a wooden box, inside which lay over twenty jade pieces of various colors.
He selected one of them, a Jade Scroll that was a map of Zhao Country and the surrounding regions.
To the northwest of Zhao Country was a vast desert known as the Black Wind Desert. Due to the black storms that swept through, the desert was sandwiched between Zhao Country, Qin Country to its west, and the Northern Desert.
Though it was an endless desert, it was far from barren as numerous veins of spiritual materials were buried underneath, and many exotic demon beasts existed there, attracting the forces of Zhao Country, Qin Country, and the Northern Desert, along with many Loose Cultivators in search of treasures and to mine.
Located amidst the three powers, the Black Wind Desert had been the site of struggles between Zhao, Qin, and the Northern Desert for hundreds of years, with none able to completely overwhelm the others, each party weakening themselves in the conflict.
Later an armistice was reached among the three, ending large-scale direct conflicts and turning overt wars into covert struggles.
With the deterrence of major battles gone, Loose Cultivators began to emerge, mining for wealth and seeking treasures to fill their pockets.
Over ninety percent of the desert's mineral resources were claimed by the three major powers, but its resources were so rich that even the scattered leftovers were enough to enrich a large number of Loose Cultivators—and there were countless demon beasts to be hunted as well.
The desert's reputation as resource-rich gradually spread, attracting even more Loose Cultivators to swarm in.
Where there are people, conflict is inevitable, and acts of murder and robbery are all too common.
Zhao Country, Qin Country, and the sect powers of the Northern Desert came here for profit. The Black Wind Desert is not within the territory they claim, and they turn a blind eye to the skirmishes of Loose Cultivators. They don't concern themselves with these matters most of the time.
Seeing that no one governed the Black Wind Desert, thieves, sect defectors, and wanted evil cultivators from the cultivation worlds of the three regions have all flocked here, plunging the area into greater turmoil.
The Black Wind Desert has now completely become synonymous with chaos and bloodshed. No one knows how many cultivators are hidden here, not even the three major forces that hold power in the region, who at best can only barely make sense of their own territories.
Yuan Ming was now heading to the Black Wind Desert.
Chang Chun Temple was on the opposite side of Zhao Country, and even if their reach was long, it couldn't extend here.
As for the dangers rampant within the Black Wind Desert, Yuan Ming didn't take them to heart. His Moonlight Technique had reached the Fourth Level, his prowess in illusion techniques was outstanding, and with powerful magic artifacts like the Soul Destroying Sword, he could protect himself against any ordinary early-stage Core Formation cultivators he might encounter.
Yuan Ming put the map jade scroll back into the wooden box and picked up a white jade scroll.
This was a jade scroll obtained from Sha Hao, containing the experience of the Great Elder in practicing the Dream Butterfly Illusion Technique.
Although the Dream Butterfly Illusion Technique played a significant role in the battle just now, its power was still not enough and needed further refinement.
He activated his Divine Sense and immersed it into the jade scroll.
Boom!
Suddenly, a suction force emerged from the jade scroll, devouring his Divine Sense.
Yuan Ming was taken aback. He had encountered his Divine Sense being devoured when he first explored this jade scroll, but it hadn't happened again in the past five years. The reappearance of this phenomenon must have a reason.
His thoughts raced, and instead of withdrawing his Divine Sense, he allowed the jade scroll to devour it. Wisps of white light began to emanate from the jade scroll, which quickly brightened.
Yuan Ming suppressed the excitement in his heart and continued sending his Divine Sense into the jade scroll.
A few breaths later, the white jade scroll stopped absorbing Divine Sense, and the light on its surface dispersed completely.
Yuan Ming hurriedly checked, and indeed, the jade scroll was different from before, revealing many new contents left by the Great Elder.
The new content began with a detailed explanation of the reason for the jade scroll's anomaly, which was due to a secret technique used by the Great Elder to conceal it, requiring a strong enough Divine Sense to reveal it.
Yuan Ming suddenly realized that the reason the white jade scroll had only slightly devoured his Divine Sense before settling down was that his Divine Sense at that time wasn't strong enough. Now that his Moonlight Technique had broken through to the Fourth Level, he had finally met the requirements.
He carefully examined the new content, knowing that Xi Cangqiong must have hidden important information with great effort.
As he read on, Yuan Ming's expression gradually changed, showing an uncontrollable delight. He eventually burst into hearty laughter.
The newly appeared content was a Soul Cultivation Secret Technique called the "Soul Pill Technique." The specifics of the technique involved condensing Divine Soul Power to form a Soul Pill, similar to a Golden Core.
According to the secret technique, the Soul Pill could aid in overcoming the bottleneck of the Core Formation Stage, and the effect was tremendous, with a chance to improve Core Formation success by fifty percent.
Since entering the Cultivation World, all cultivators longed for Core Formation, not only because Core Formation Stage cultivators possess far stronger power than those at the Foundation Establishment Stage, but also because forming a Golden Core could significantly extend their life span.
Foundation Establishment cultivators have a maximum lifespan of just over two hundred years, but once a Golden Core is formed, the lifespan can more than double, reaching over five hundred years.
However, the step of Condensing Golden Core is exceedingly difficult, leaving countless cultivators sighing with aspiration.
If we say that advancing through the Foundation Establishment Stage requires assistance from Foundation Establishment Pills and other Spiritual Medicines, along with top-grade aptitude and firm determination, then advancing to Core Formation is a hundred times more difficult.
At this stage, the impact of aptitude and determination has become minimal. Even cultivators with Heavenly Spirit Root barely stand a chance at this threshold, and forming a Golden Core is almost entirely up to fate and opportunity.
Biluo Cave, with nearly a thousand disciples, only has a few Core Formation Stage cultivators. Even Central Plains Sects like Shengye Sect and Chang Chun Temple, which have ten times more disciples than Biluo Cave, still have very few Core Formation Stage cultivators.
Yuan Ming, with a Four Spirit Roots Physique, was among the cultivators with the poorest aptitude in the Cultivation World. He had barely managed to break through to Foundation Establishment thanks to a Foundation Establishment Pill, Foundation Establishment Spirit Incense, and the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
For Core Formation, he had practically no confidence at all.
Now, having obtained a Secret Technique that could increase his chance of Core Formation by fifty percent, how could he not be ecstatic!
The reason why forming a Soul Pill could assist in Core Formation is, on one hand, because a Soul Pill, condensed from Soul Power, and a Golden Core, condensed from Mana, share a fundamental connection.
The so-called Golden Core is not merely the concentration of Mana, but also the inward blending and refining of essence, energy, spirit, and intent, polishing into a pill that is radiant and round, impervious to influence and difficult to destroy—this is the Pill Intent.
If Mana can form a Golden Core and produce Pill Intent, so can Soul Power forming a Soul Pill. If one can form a Soul Pill and comprehend the Pill Intent, then forming a Golden Core with Mana becomes much easier.
According to the content of the jade scroll, after forming the Soul Pill, it then must be introduced into the Dantian to guide the Mana with the Pill Intent of the Soul Pill and condense it into a Fake Pill.
With this dual assistance, the chances of Core Formation increase greatly, and Xi Cangqiong succeeded in advancing to Core Formation Stage through this Soul Pill Technique.

chapters.title: Chapter 329 - 306 Black Wind
chapters.content:
The art of the Soul Pill, although greatly beneficial for Core Formation, is not an easy feat to achieve; in fact, it could be said that it's as difficult as the Core Formation itself.
Condensing a Soul Pill requires an immense amount of Soul Power. In other words, only Soul Cultivators can attempt to master this secret technique. In the entire Cultivation World, Soul Cultivators are few and far between, and in many areas, their existence is even considered taboo.
Even for Soul Cultivators, success is not guaranteed.
According to the Jade Scroll, Xi Cangqiong succeeded in cultivating the Heart Cleansing Technique to a very high level and then used the Soul Suppressing Kettle to refine a significant amount of Soul Power, which led to his fortunate success.
Although Yuan Ming had cultivated the Moonlight Technique to the Fourth Level, his Divine Soul Power was still far from sufficient. Since he had embarked on the path of the Soul Cultivator, the Stealing Heaven Tripod had been of considerable help, mainly in restoring Soul Power. However, unlike the Soul Suppressing Kettle, it did not have the capability to refine others' Divine Souls and feed back into its own.
This meant that if he wanted to cultivate the Soul Pill, he would still need to find a way to enhance his own Divine Soul Power.
His complexion changed between cloudiness and clarity, and gradually calmed down.
No matter what, although he had poor inherent qualities, his talents as a Soul Cultivator were quite high. If he wished to successfully form a Golden Core in the future, using Soul Power to condense the core was not a bad method.
Yuan Ming's Divine Soul withdrew from the white Jade Scroll, which flickered with wisps of white light again, rehiding the content of the Soul Pill Secret Technique.
He placed the Jade Scroll back into the wooden box and began to plan his future cultivation.
Since he had decided to cultivate the Soul Pill Secret Technique, he needed to increase the cultivation time of the Moonlight Technique, refine a large amount of Soul Nourishing Incense, and wonder whether the Desire Power collected by the Stealing Heaven Tripod, which could fuse with Divine Sense, could be directly absorbed?
If so, the cultivation of the Moonlight Technique could be greatly accelerated.
With this thought, Yuan Ming instructed Lei Yu to continue heading north, while simultaneously taking out the Stealing Heaven Tripod and holding it in his arms as he began to operate the Moonlight Technique.
As soon as he operated the Moonlight Technique, he sensed the Desire Power converging around the Stealing Heaven Tripod more clearly.
Yuan Ming extended his Soul Power from his Sea of Consciousness, wrapping around a strand of Desire Power and attempted to bring it into his Sea of Consciousness.
The process went surprisingly smoothly.
Under the tug of Soul Power, the strand of Desire Power was smoothly pulled into his Sea of Consciousness.
Yuan Ming operated the Moonlight Technique, and a vortex of Soul Power appeared in his Sea of Consciousness, enveloping the Desire Power and beginning to refine it. It was quickly and completely absorbed, and his Divine Soul Power grew slightly.
He was pleasantly surprised, but then was immediately startled.
The absorbed strand of Desire Power surged with a strong and complex mix of emotions, including fear, restlessness, defeatism, and reverence.
Yuan Ming felt a throbbing pain between his eyebrows as various emotions swirled in his heart, lingering for a long time.
"Huh... Desire Power actually carries emotions? Well, obviously, since Desire Power is indeed the power of will, it naturally mixes with various emotions." After a long while, Yuan Ming recovered and exhaled a breath of turbid air.
Unlike Desire Power from within the Stealing Heaven Tripod, which carried no emotions.
"It seems there is some secret inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod that can refine these Desire Powers," Yuan Ming guessed in his mind.
Although it's difficult to refine Desire Power from external sources at present, using this method to enhance Divine Soul Power is much faster than purely cultivating the Moonlight Technique.
Yuan Ming steadied his emotions and continued attempting to draw in and refine the Desire Power.
...
In the azure sky, the sun hung high.
The endless expanse of yellow sand covered the earth, and the undulating dunes resembled waves in the sea. From a distance, they seemed uncommonly smooth like a flawless mirror.
In the caravan, the dark-skinned Tara lifted his head and tightened the white cloth wrapped around it, his gaze climbing along the bright yellow sand. Seeing the blend of yellow and blue in the distance where the sky seemed to merge with the sand yet remained distinctly separate, he breathed a sigh of relief.For a bet@ter re^a&ding e.x#pe^r-i#en^ce, v@is%i&t# *$)#.
"Let's push on while the weather's good. Try to make more headway to reach Xiansha City sooner!" he turned and shouted back to those behind him.
The other members of the caravan responded half-heartedly, their voices uneven, and their footsteps did not quicken.
Not encountering sandstorms was indeed cause for joy, but the sky was devoid of any clouds, and the harsh sunlight beaming down directly made it uncomfortable.
After nearly a day's travel, most in the caravan were already physically and mentally exhausted. Their feet burning from the scalding sand, as if walking on a hot iron plate, who had the energy to hurry?
After all, not everyone could ride on camels like Tara, the leader of the caravan.
However, riding camels wasn't just Tara's exclusive privilege, within the group there were four others sitting atop the lofty camel humps, their faces showing no signs of tiredness.
But for them, no one else in the caravan dared to feel discontent, knowing that these were lofty Immortal Masters. If not for their duty to escort the goods, they would have probably flown to Xiansha City on magic artifacts long ago, instead of wasting time with these mortals.
However, not absolutely everything followed this order. Among the caravan, there existed a handsome young man, clearly unweathered by hardships, who sized up the four cultivators on the camels and turned his head to ask softly:
"Hu Ji, you say we are but a mortal merchant caravan, then why are there cultivators with us?"
The man he addressed as Hu Ji, had a rough face full of stubble and a scar below his left eye.
Upon hearing this, Hu Ji recognized the newcomer as one recruited within the borders of Zhao Country, seemingly named Yuan Ming, and casually explained: "The Black Wind Desert is full of dangers; demon beasts could erupt from anywhere. Without Immortal Masters to protect us, which mortal would dare to venture carelessly?"
"But cultivators don't care for mortal gold and silver, how did the caravan leader hire them?" Yuan Ming asked curiously.
"Boy, remember, this place is different from the outside world. Without an Immortal Master's protection, mortals can hardly survive here. Thus, towns in the desert are built for these Immortal Masters, and we mortals are merely slaves serving them. The real master of this caravan is also an Immortal Master; he naturally has ways to hire other Immortal Masters." Hu Ji shook his head and admonished softly.
"Given such harsh conditions, why don't you leave this place and settle elsewhere?" Yuan Ming asked in surprise.
"Have you ever seen a master who allows his slaves to escape? And to tell you the truth, there are only three kinds of mortals living in this wretched place: those like you, lured here by high wages, those who are criminals or felons from Qin Country, Zhao Country, or the Northern Desert, and those who are captured or trafficked slaves. Once anyone enters the city, they get branded, and will be trapped in the Black Wind Desert like in a vast cage, completely losing their freedom. Even if you have descendants, they can't escape from here. And even if they somehow did, a look at the brand would have someone contacting the officials to throw you back here. Where could you escape to?" Hu Ji explained with a self-deprecating laugh.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming remained silent for a long while before he let out a deep sigh.
Hu Ji looked at him expecting to see regret and fear in his eyes, yet what flashed through was a touch of pity.
Hu Ji was taken aback for a moment and muttered to himself about the strange man before he stopped paying attention to Yuan Ming.
And Yuan Ming lost interest in continuing the conversation.
He had arrived at the border of Zhao Country not long ago and had disguised himself as a mortal to blend into the caravan and enter the Black Wind Desert.
Even using his real name and swaggering about, in this lawless land, hardly anyone cared, let alone Chang Chun Temple.
The sun gradually set, and the evening sky was painted with orange rouge, as the sandy ground completely blended into the sky. Standing atop a sand dune looking into the distance blurred the line between heaven and earth.
On the other side of the sand dunes, after a day of travel, the caravan members finally were able to set up camp and properly rest. Despite their previous exhaustion, they now had somewhat revitalized spirits.
Yuan Ming, gazing out over the rolling sand dunes, pondered for a moment and decided that since he had now ventured deep into the desert, he no longer needed to follow the mortal caravan. As long as he used an Illusion Technique to extract the location of Xiansha City from the caravan leader, he could leave on his own.
Determined, he walked down the sand dune, ready to find Tara, but unexpectedly ran into Hu Ji, whom he had spoken with during the day.
Hu Ji, holding two wooden boxes filled with food, approached Yuan Ming: "Where have you been? I had such a time finding you. Here, this is your meal; I helped you to a portion."
"No need, I'm not that hungry." Yuan Ming smiled and declined his offer.
Seeing this, Hu Ji sighed: "Ah, I know, what I said during the day made you uncomfortable, but as the saying goes, breed content in what comes, working with our caravan is already good enough."
Just as Yuan Ming was thinking about escaping using an Illusion Technique, he suddenly noticed that it had gotten dark around them, and someone nearby also cried out.
"It's bad! It's the Black Wind! The Black Wind is coming!"
He turned towards the shout and saw that the once clear blue sky was completely shrouded in dark clouds, the evening glow and the sun had vanished, replaced by a chilling cold breeze.
In the distance, the sand dunes appeared to come alive, wildly racing across the land. From afar, they resembled real roaring waves, one after another, crashing against invisible cliffs and shores.
The ground trembled incessantly, and the sand under Yuan Ming's feet vibrated, casting the faces in the caravan camp in a mix of terror and despair.
Just then, four streaks of light suddenly appeared in the camp, the four Qi Refining cultivators, who without hesitation took out their magic artifacts and flew away toward the distance.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming was also startled. Ignoring any potential exposure, he immediately summoned Lei Yu and mounted it.
Just as he was preparing to take off on Lei Yu, he suddenly caught sight of Hu Ji, who looked dazed standing nearby.
Without hesitating, he grabbed Hu Ji by the collar, pulled him onto the back of Lei Yu, and then directed Lei Yu to race toward the direction where the four Qi Refining cultivators had escaped.

chapters.title: Chapter 330 - 307 Underground City
chapters.content:
The speed of Lei Yu was superior to that of the four cultivators' magical artifacts, and although he started later, he soon surpassed them in the blink of an eye, landing straight ahead.
When the four cultivators witnessed this scene, they did not need to guess that there was a Foundation Establishment cultivator hidden within the caravan, but now they were too focused on escaping to bother with that detail, each desperately urging their magical artifacts, fearing they were a step too slow.
At the same time, five pitch-black tornadoes suddenly appeared in the sky behind them.
The black tornado picked up the yellow sand from the ground, and amidst the flying sand, several bolts of thunder dropped from the dark clouds, illuminating the area with blinding light in an instant.
Yuan Ming, while racing, glanced back hurriedly and saw endless streaks of electricity flaring and leaping within the tornado, like several rabid evil dogs chasing after some unknown entity.
At that moment, Hu Ji, whom Yuan Ming was carrying, also shouted loudly, "Immortal Master, hurry to Xiansha City, only the underground array there can withstand this!"
"Rumble"
Before he could finish his sentence, a heart-shaking thunderous sound came from afar, reaching everyone's ears in a flash.
At the instant Yuan Ming heard the thunder, he felt a strong dizziness and pain, as if someone were hammering at his Divine Soul with a huge mallet.
Below him, Lei Yu also cried out in pain and headed straight toward the ground.
Perhaps it was due to Yuan Ming's strong Divine Soul, but he quickly recovered from the dizziness.
By this time, he had already become separated from the back of Lei Yu and was plummeting toward the ground.
Not daring to delay, he quickly took out the Jade Shuttle, and as he started flying, he also rescued the similarly falling Hu Ji and Lei Yu before they hit the ground.
Yuan Ming, feeling somewhat distressed, put the still dizzy Lei Yu into the Spiritual Beast Bag and continued to control the Flying Shuttle forward. Glancing back again, he saw that the four Qi Refining cultivators who were following him had now vanished without a trace.
Meanwhile, the five tornadoes relentlessly pursued him without pause, the electricity flashing and leaping within them, sketching out, in a blur, the head of a gigantic beast that roared silently at Yuan Ming.
At the same time, the rolling thunder approached, resembling the drums of war before a battle, each peal louder than the last, yet for some reason, the thunder now seemed less powerful and did not inflict any further damage on Yuan Ming's Divine Soul as it reached his ears.
However, this did not mean Yuan Ming was out of danger; the raging tornadoes kept on his heels, and bursts of piercing cold directly targeted his spine.
"Crack"
Suddenly, Yuan Ming heard the sound of ice crystals shattering. Looking down, he was horrified to find that a black mist, resembling frost, had crept onto the tail of the Jade Shuttle.
The mist slowly spread toward Yuan Ming's feet, resembling the hands of a soul-reaper, inching towards his body.
But in the next instant, the wind behind Yuan Ming suddenly stopped, and the black mist on the Jade Shuttle dissipated. The clouds in the sky rapidly cleared away, vanishing in the blink of an eye as if they had never appeared.
The setting sun once again landed on Yuan Ming's shoulder, the warmth of the sunlight dispelling the lingering chill on his body. Everything returned to normal, as if all that had just occurred was merely a bad dream.
Yet when Yuan Ming turned around, he saw that the desert behind him was marred with several terrifying, narrow gorges, like scars on the earth, sending chills down the spine.
The name "Black Wind Desert" came from the frequent "Black Winds" that struck there, a natural disaster that appeared and vanished without prediction, leaving nothing but sand in its wake.
Before coming here, Yuan Ming had heard of the notorious Black Wind, but only upon facing it did he truly understand the profound meaning of "natural disaster."
Yuan Ming flew towards the previously-set caravan campsite on his Flying Shuttle, but all along the way, aside from gullies, all he saw were scattered fragments of wood and cloth, and occasional limbs and body parts— not even a single complete body remained.
Of the entire caravan, the only survivors now were he and that man called Hu Ji.This copy was generated from content at *.
Yuan Ming landed the Flying Shuttle, put Hu Ji down on the sandy ground, checked his condition, and found his body was largely unharmed but his Divine Soul had been injured, causing him to fall into a coma with no knowing when he would recover.
With the vastness of the Desert Sea and now without a guide, Yuan Ming did not know where Xiansha City was located. With no other option, he decided to try and performed a Soul Search on the unconscious Hu Ji.
Fortunately, though Hu Ji's Divine Soul was damaged, much of his memory remained intact, including his experiences traveling between Zhao Country and Xiansha City with the caravan.
And within his memory, Xiansha City was located in the direction from which Yuan Ming and the four Qi Refining cultivators had just fled.
Now that the location was clear, Yuan Ming did not linger any longer. He took the unconscious Hu Ji and once again boarded the Jade Shuttle, flying towards Xiansha City.
...
Not long after, Yuan Ming approached a large black sand dune and commanded the Jade Shuttle to descend.
This place was where Xiansha City was located.
Unlike other places, all towns in the Black Wind Desert were built underground, thus they were also known as underground cities.
The entrance of each underground city was established within the same black sand dunes, reinforced through formations, and guarded by dedicated cultivators. If a Black Wind disaster occurred, they would immediately burrow underground and activate another array in the city capable of defending against the Black Wind.
When the Black Wind raged, not only would there be tornados and thunder on the surface, but evil spirits would also erode from below. Hence, simply going underground was not enough to escape the Black Wind alive.
However, at least being underground could prevent damage from the tornados. Although this was of little significance to cultivators, it could greatly reduce damage to buildings and the consumption of magical formations for the towns.
Yuan Ming soon located the entrance to Xiansha City at the foot of the black sand dune. Seeing Yuan Ming covered in dust and carrying an unconscious mortal, the Qi Refining cultivators guarding the place immediately tensed up.
"Senior, what is this..."
"The merchant caravan I was escorting encountered the Black Wind. Fortunately, we were fairly distant, and I managed to escape with him just in time," Yuan Ming said, his face revealing heartfelt relief.
Upon hearing this, the guards at the gate widened their eyes and repeatedly praised Yuan Ming's good luck as they let him in.
Beyond the sand dune's entrance was a spacious underground tunnel sloping gently downward, with Luminous Pearls embedded in the stone walls above and on either side, providing enough light for the entire tunnel.
Yuan Ming continued downwards and before long, his sight suddenly opened up to a city situated beneath the sand, presenting itself before him.
The whole city was built inside a massive hollow, above which were densely arrayed specialized glowing magical artifacts that emitted light no less bright than sunlight, illuminating the entire city with unparalleled brightness, absent any dark or oppressive feeling.
Looking down from above, the city's layout was concentrically structured with an inner city and outer city. But whether it was the inner city or the outer city, most of the buildings here were constructed of sand and soil, with hardly any stacking marks, almost all integrated structures with window frames largely made of stone, and covered with cloth rather than paper.
Additionally, restricted by the height of the hollow, the tallest of these buildings were no more than five stories. From the city center outward, there was a clear gradient difference.
The construction and decorations of the buildings in the inner city were much more luxurious compared to the outer city, but they were still quite rudimentary compared to the cities Yuan Ming had seen before. Not to mention a large workshop city like Little Lake City, even Iron Tiger Town was better off than this place.
As for the houses in the outer city, they were even less visually appealing, with rough construction evident everywhere. From inside to outside, the houses became increasingly rudimentary, not only showing various axe and knife marks on the walls but also bearing many scars from magical destruction, resembling devastated ruins.
Toward the edge of the city, there weren't even decent walls or tiles, just makeshift tents made of tattered cloth and worn coats. It was only because the underground city was windless, otherwise, these tents would likely have been blown away long ago.
Yuan Ming did not rush to tour the town, first chose a fairly orderly medical clinic in the outer city to treat Hu Ji, and left a sum of gold and silver for the doctor to hand over to Hu Ji after he awakened. Then he headed toward the inner city.
On the streets of the outer city, Yuan Ming noted that the mortals coming and going either bore faces of poverty and sadness or emitted a fierce aura, not looking like good folk.
However, even these bandit-like individuals would immediately carefuly sidestep to avoid getting in the way if they encountered cultivators walking on the streets.
Compared to the mortals, the cultivators on the streets had even more wild and frenzied auras.
Perhaps because Yuan Ming's gaze lingered for too long, one of the cultivators with a beard by the roadside, who was arguing with another, suddenly looked up and glared fiercely at Yuan Ming, "What are you looking at, looking for trouble?"
Not wanting to cause any trouble, Yuan Ming shook his head and averted his gaze, intending to continue forward, but suddenly furrowed his brows and nimbly dodged to the left, avoiding a staggering lean cultivator. At the same time, he swiftly grabbed the man's arm.
"Fellow Daoist, doing this is rather blatant," he said, his face showing a hint of anger.
"Misunderstanding, all misunderstandings, Fellow Daoist," the lean cultivator apologized profusely with a smile and bowed continuously.
But just as he bowed his head, his empty left hand swiftly flicked upward, his fingertips seemingly clutching something, and he struck toward Yuan Ming.
However, these small maneuvers couldn't escape Yuan Ming's perception. Just as the man's arm was raised, Yuan Ming's hand was already pointing in front of him, where a fireball appeared at his fingertips and rapidly expanded.
Feeling the power of Yuan Ming's Burning Explosion Skill, the lean cultivator immediately broke into a cold sweat and dared not make any further unexpected moves, instead pleading repeatedly for mercy.
Yuan Ming, being new to the place, did not want to start any trouble, so he voluntarily let go of the lean cultivator's arm and scolded him a few times, allowing him to go.
However, after the lean cultivator hurried away, Yuan Ming heard a substantial amount of hissing around him.
He looked around and saw that because of his actions, many onlookers had gathered around; seeing that they had not fought, each of them seemed disappointed as if they wished for chaos.

chapters.title: Chapter 331 - 308: Insect Pill
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming furrowed his brows and continued forward, only to witness another astonishing scene.
In a small alley beside the main road, a headless corpse lay sprawled with its blood already dried. Not far from it stood a topless man with a rugged beard, exuding the aura of an early-stage Foundation Establishment, who was cursively yelling,
"Who the hell did this? Killing someone and not even cleaning up the body, just leaving it in front of someone else's house—have they no sense of public decency?"
Seeing him scolding righteously, the nearby Cultivators seemed indifferent; some even too lazy to turn back for a glance, Yuan Ming couldn't help but gain a new understanding of the chaos in this area.
However, as he entered the inner city, the situation improved significantly, though the passersby Cultivators still carried a fierce aura, at least there were no more daring street fights.
Soon, Yuan Ming found a place to rent a house in the inner city, intending to rent a room to settle down.
Unexpectedly, the yellow-robed Cultivator responsible for renting out the houses quoted him a price that greatly shocked him.
"600 per year for a house in the inner city? Why don't you just rob people?" Yuan Ming exclaimed angrily.
He had plenty of spirit stones on him, but that didn't mean he could just let people rip him off. After all, house prices in Little Lake City were at most one or two hundred spirit stones. How could such a rundown place be more expensive than there?
However, in response to Yuan Ming's anger, the yellow-robed Cultivator simply smiled and said, "Senior, please calm your anger. The high price has its reasons. The inner city area is personally protected by the City Lord. No one is allowed to fight here. Not only is life convenient here, but the public security is also very good. If you don't have enough spirit stones on you, I can recommend some cheaper houses in the outer city. Although those are less expensive, I must tell you that there was a disturbancerecently, and many Cultivators living there suffered losses, including a few in the Foundation Establishment stage like yourself."
Speechless, Yuan Ming recalled everything he had seen and heard on his way into the city and did not say much else, reluctantly accepting the price.
Seeing this, the yellow-robed Cultivator immediately handed over a jade scroll that marked the locations of available rooms in the inner city. Yuan Ming took it and furrowed his eyebrows again.
"How come there are only two left?"
"No helping it, many people from the outer city are breaking their necks trying to move to the inner city. These two are all that's left, and you are lucky; they just became available yesterday," explained the yellow-robed Cultivator.
Resigned, Yuan Ming didn't bother asking what 'just became available' meant and directly chose one of the relatively secluded rooms. After handing over the spirit stones, he took the keys and a token marking his residency from the yellow-robed Cultivator's hands and left the place.
After renting the house, Yuan Ming immediately headed to a shop in the city that sold elixirs.
The shop, called Spring Breeze Hall, was far inferior to Qingmu Building in Little Lake City in terms of both scale and decor. It only had a few types of Foundation Establishment advancement elixirs, and the prices were more than half higher than those at Qingmu Building.
This made Yuan Ming somewhat regret not buying more elixirs while he was in Da Jin and Zhao Country.
"From the look of senior, you just arrived at Black Wind Desert, right? This place is far from the Central Plains; Black Wind Desert is rife with bandits, and if you're unlucky, you might encounter the deadly Black Wind. Thus, transporting goods here is extremely inconvenient, and prices can't be compared to those in the Central Plains. Xiansha City, located at the edge of Black Wind Desert, actually has cheaper elixir prices. If you go deeper in, prices there are even higher," said a young attendant who approached him.
Yuan Ming also thought about this point and began to quietly calculate his current finances.
He still had tens of thousands of spirit stones, but now, without the stable income from the Spirit Fragrance Shop, maintaining a relatively good cultivation environment and spending down his savings, he wasn't sure how long he could last.
"If senior finds the elixirs expensive, there are some cheaper ones inside; you can take a look," the young attendant suddenly winked and said.
Startled, Yuan Ming motioned for the attendant to lead the way.
The young attendant took Yuan Ming to the innermost part of the shop, where there was a counter displaying several gray and black medicine bottles.
Yuan Ming swept his Divine Sense across them, a look of surprise on his face.
The elixirs in these bottles were entirely different from those outside; they were much smaller in size, and their surfaces were coarser, looking dull and barely distinguishable from mud pellets. Yet the fluctuations of Spiritual Energy emitted from these elixirs were notably rich, almost comparable to the Snow Crystal Pills he had consumed before.
Most importantly, the prices of these elixirs were very cheap, typically around a hundred or so spirit stones, and no more than two hundred spirit stones.
"What are these elixirs?" Yuan Ming picked up a medicine bottle, gently opened the stopper, and a sharp, tart odor wafted out.
"These are Insect Pills," the young clerk said.
"Insect Pills?" Yuan Ming looked at the clerk.
"In the Black Wind Desert, not a blade of grass grows, and it is inconvenient to transport from the Central Plains. The underground mines are very rich, but Spirit Grass and Spiritual Medicines are extremely scarce. Fortunately, there are countless demon insects here. The alchemists in the Black Wind Desert have learned the alchemy methods from the Northern Desert and use local materials, refining these Insect Pills with demon insect cores," the young clerk explained.
"Insect core? Could it be something similar to a Demon Core? As far as I know, it's rare for second-level demon beasts to have Demon Cores. It's only common for demon beasts to develop Demon Cores when they reach the third level. Surely, these Insect Pills aren't made from third-level demon insects?" Yuan Ming asked, puzzled.
"Of course not, third-level demon beasts are as powerful as Core Formation Stage cultivators. It's impossible to hunt them in large numbers. The environment of the Black Wind Desert is special; even the first-level demon insects here will develop an insect core in their heads. As for why they develop insect cores, I'm not very clear either. It's said to be an influence of the Black Wind," the young clerk said.
"In their heads..." Yuan Ming murmured thoughtfully upon hearing this.
Although the Black Wind Desert looks barren, it is rich in underground mines, and the demon insects here don't worry about replenishing Spiritual Power. The Black Wind that blows inside the desert greatly affects the Divine Soul. In such a special environment, it's not surprising that demon insects protect their Divine Souls with demonic power and form insect cores in their heads.
"Senior, don't judge these Insect Pills by their appearance. In fact, the Spiritual Power contained within is extremely dense, nearly twice that of ordinary elixirs of the same ranking, and when you actually consume it, you'll find that it doesn't taste as bad as it looks and smells," the young clerk said quickly, seeing Yuan Ming's silence and thinking he was resisting the Insect Pills.
"Oh, these Insect Pills have such good effects, yet you sell them for so cheap? There must be some drawbacks to these pills, right?" Yuan Ming shook the medicine bottle in his hand and asked with a smile.
"Senior, you have keen insight. Honestly, even though the medical power refined from insect cores is extremely potent, it also contains lingering intentions of the demon insects, which can influence a cultivator. However, as time passes, these remnants gradually dissipate, and as long as you don't consume them in large amounts over a short period, there won't be any severe problems," the young clerk said somewhat awkwardly.
"I see," Yuan Ming said casually, understanding in his heart.
If the effects of the Insect Pills really were minor, with their medicinal efficacy, they wouldn't be sold so cheaply.
"Senior, if you are worried about the remnants of the demon insects, why not try this Rock Whisker Pill? The insect cores used in this batch of Insect Pills were all taken from within Rock Whisker Worms and have been specially refined through a unique method. They contain half the residual thoughts compared to similar elixirs and are of excellent quality, suitable for someone trying them for the first time like you," the clerk said, picking up a black medicine bottle.
After weighing it over in his mind, Yuan Ming finally decided to buy just one bottle to try under the enthusiastic sales pitch of the clerk, while he chose to purchase a few other ordinary elixirs to try as well.
After purchasing the elixirs, he returned to the residence he had rented. Although the Cave Mansion was simple, it was fully furnished, neat, and tidy, which slightly lifted his spirits.
