He didn't rush into cultivation but first thoroughly inspected the house to make sure there were no traps or hidden mechanisms left by others. He also specifically arranged a Five Elements Illusion Destruction Array outside before he finally felt at ease.
He sat cross-legged on the bed, took out the Rock Whisker Pill he had bought, and hesitantly placed a pill in his palm. After much deliberation, he steeled his heart, closed his eyes, and consumed the pill.The a^uth-en*tic# v#e^r@s*i%on is on *.%
To his surprise, as soon as the Rock Whisker Pill entered his mouth, it instantly melted, turning into a fragrant medicinal liquid with a slightly sweet taste that was rather refreshing.
As the medicinal liquid entered his stomach, Yuan Ming immediately felt a cool sensation spreading from his abdomen to his limbs and bones, akin to the relief one feels when drinking a bowl of chilled herbal tea in the scorching heat of summer.
Soon after, he felt an extremely strong medicinal power merging into his body, prompting him to quickly operate his Cultivation Technique to refine the medicine while its power was dissipating, intensifying his cultivation.
He had circulated his mana for one complete cycle, and although there was no significant increase in his mana, his speed of cultivation was indeed faster than before.
But just then, Yuan Ming suddenly felt a pain in the center of his forehead, followed by a noisy, insect-like buzzing in his ears.
Simultaneously, a very faint black mist appeared in his Sea of Consciousness, slowly enveloping his Divine Soul.
His consciousness blurred momentarily, and he felt as if he had become a black insect lurking in the sand, intermittently echoing the calls of his companions.
However, this sensation quickly dissipated, and Yuan Ming returned to normal.
He rubbed his forehead and glanced at the nearby Rock Whisker Pill, giving a wry smile.
Although cultivating with the Rock Whisker Pill was fast, he was already enduring the emotional erosion from refining Desire Power every day. If he continued cultivating with this Insect Pill, he feared his Divine Soul might eventually be affected.
Yuan Ming shook his head, stored the Rock Whisker Pill, and decided to refrain from using this medicine for now.
He tried other elixirs and found that although the elixirs here were incredibly expensive, their effects were quite normal, which somewhat relieved him.

chapters.title: Chapter 332 - 309: The Source
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming steadied his mind slightly, practiced some breathing control, and after midnight struck, he took out a stick of Black Incense, planning to possess the disciples who had followed Zuo Qinghui in Little Lake City to see if Chang Chun Temple was already aware of Zuo Qinghui's affairs.
Although he had already arrived at the Black Wind Desert, it was still necessary to keep an eye on the situation at Chang Chun Temple, otherwise, if they came looking for him, he would be at a disadvantage.
However, when he took out the Stealing Heaven Tripod, he suddenly paused.
He sensed a stream of Desire Power, thicker than any he had felt before, winding around the exterior of the Stealing Heaven Tripod like tentacles.
Yuan Ming was greatly surprised. Previously, the Desire Power was always thin like threads, so why was it so dense now?
He tried to envelop this Desire Power with his Divine Sense and sent it into his Sea of Consciousness, discovering that it also contained emotions like admiration, aspiration, inferiority, and anxiety.
Moreover, as he refined and assimilated this stream of Desire Power, he vaguely sensed its source, not too far away, seemingly within Xiansha City.
Yuan Ming showed a look of delight, released the transparent soul crow from his Sea of Consciousness, and sent it straight toward the source of this Desire Power.
The transparent soul crow, capable of traveling much farther and faster than ordinary soul crows, could also change into various forms, making it more suitable for scouting.
Although the crow had its own consciousness, its Soul Power was of the same origin as Yuan Ming's, allowing Yuan Ming to share its senses.
...
In the inner city of Xiansha City, Zhang Yu's Mansion.
As the butler of the City Lord of Xiansha City and an ordinary human, Zhang Yu had also gained the privilege to reside in the inner city.
This status had been handed down from his grandfather's generation, and whenever he mentioned it, he felt extremely fortunate that his grandfather had found such a good master.
Now, having worked at the City Lord Mansion for over thirty years, married with children, he saw his son growing up and thought it was time to start training him to take over.
Yet, faced with his father's suggestion, his son Zhang Xiu was particularly resistant.
"Bang—"
Zhang Yu harshly pushed open the door, saw his son clumsily hiding a book, and immediately became furious.
"You worthless thing, I told you to study accounting with your Uncle Li, and you dare to lie about being sick to read leisure books here, hand them over to me now!"
"Dad, I don't want to learn those things," Zhang Xiu said with a mournful face.
He was only thirteen or fourteen, his face youthful and tender, his black hair messily tied up, clearly unkept on a regular basis.
It's worth noting that on his left cheek, near his ear, there was a very clear burn scar, looking like a violent tornado.
Zhang Yu quickly stepped forward, grabbed Zhang Xiu, snatched the hidden book from his hands, and opened it to see the title "Mr. Sheng's Eastern Travelogue" boldly written on the cover.
"You don't want to learn accounting, then how will you take over my position? By reading these leisure books, can you serve the City Lord well?"
Zhang Yu angrily scolded and tore "Mr. Sheng's Eastern Travelogue" in half.
Zhang Xiu, seeing his beloved book torn, became instantly emotional and madly lunged at his father, grabbing the torn pieces of the book.
"Dad, I don't want to follow your path, nor do I want to stay in this rotten place to be some butler, I just want to go out and see the world, why can't you understand me, let me be free!" Zhang Xiu cried, holding the book.
Zhang Yu looked at his son with disappointment, "Xiu'er, you are too naive. Do you know how many people in the city have fought over this position you disdain? You speak lightly of going out to see the world, but have you looked at the scar on your face, can you even go out? You want freedom, fine, I'll give it to you, you can leave right now and I'll see if you starve to death today or tomorrow!"
Zhang Xiu sobbed silently, without a word.
"Ah, you'll understand when you grow up, son. All this is for your good. You were born in the Black Wind Desert, being able to follow my path is already a great fortune," Zhang Yu said with a sigh, seeing his son's state.
Zhang Xiu looked up, his eyes carrying a dim glimmer of hope, "Father, is there really no other path for me?"
"Son, just accept your fate. In this world, only those high above Immortals can truly achieve freedom. We mortals don't have the luxury of choice," Zhang Yu shook his head.
Zhang Xiu lowered his head dejectedly, tears welling up in his eyes which he forcefully held back.
Seeing his son like this, Zhang Yu added, "Think hard about what I said today. As for these leisure books, if you honestly attend your classes starting tomorrow, I'll still let you keep them, but if today's situation happens again, don't blame me for being heartless."
With these words, Zhang Yu stood up and left the room.
Watching his father's somewhat stooped back, Zhang Xiu couldn't help but feel a deep bitterness, stumbling back onto his bed, raising the torn halves of "Mr. Sheng's Eastern Travelogue," and as the stories from the book flashed through his mind, along with the vivid landscapes described within, his view blurred uncontrollably again.
Outside the window, the transparent soul crow witnessed everything that had just happened, then withdrew its gaze and burrowed into the ground.
At the same time, Yuan Ming also opened his eyes, suddenly realizing.
The Desire Power swirling around the Stealing Heaven Tripod was indeed produced by people who had read his book, no wonder it carried emotions of admiration and longing.
It seemed that many of the Desire Powers previously absorbed by the Stealing Heaven Tripod likely came from his readers as well.
Yuan Ming then recalled the argument between Zhang Xiu and his father, his thoughts a whirlwind.
The word 'freedom', easy to say, but to truly achieve it, is extremely difficult.
Yuan Ming, once a prisoner from the Southern Border, now a traveler through the Desert, recalls his past, feeling most acutely the phrase "not in control of one's own fate."
What about ordinary mortals? And Immortals? They all are inevitably inside this worldly prison, toiling tirelessly, but rarely able to break free of their destinies.
So-called freedom is but the surplus of the strong and the luxury of the weak. His earlier refusal to join Chang Chun Temple, and later, his battle with Zuo Qinghui, weren't these for the sake of freedom?
Yuan Ming pondered, his eyes filled with confusion at first, gradually turning resolute.
He longed for freedom, aspired to unrestricted exhilaration. No difficulty could alter his thoughts, nor could it destroy his will.
Yuan Ming shook his head, his mood gradually stabilizing, and he resumed studying the changes in the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
From what he understood so far, the transfer of Desire Power was greatly affected by distance; the farther apart, the more diluted the transferred Desire Power became.
Since Zhang Xiu was the closest to him, the Desire Power he transferred was much denser than others'.
To verify his guesses, Yuan Ming immediately began experimenting.
He left his dwelling and walked in the opposite direction from Zhang Xiu.
As expected, as Yuan Ming gradually distanced himself, the Desire Power transmitted from Zhang Xiu started to thin, and the sensation of its source became increasingly vague.
When he reached several miles outside Xiansha City, he completely lost sense of the source of the Desire Power.
"It seems the sensing range of the source of Desire Power is only thirty miles," Yuan Ming muttered.
Yuan Ming thought of something else and took out a stick of Black Incense, made from the Zhenling Sect Ancestral Hall Incense Ash, thickly entwined with Desire Power.
He activated his Divine Sense and touched it, but couldn't absorb it at all.
"It appears I can only absorb Desire Power targeted at myself, not that of others," Yuan Ming muttered.
In the Black Wind Desert, hot winds howled, pulling up clouds of dust.
Yuan Ming didn't linger outside the city. He turned to head back when suddenly, from behind him in the sandy soil, over a dozen blue lights shot out, aimed at his back.
A cold gleam surged in Yuan Ming's eyes, and his form unexpectedly soared into the air, then silently landed several meters away.
The blue lights missed their target and struck where Yuan Ming had been standing, but they were a dozen blue Ice Cones, exceedingly sharp.
A figure in a gray robe peeked from the origin of the blue lights, glaring menacingly at Yuan Ming, yellow light flashed over his body as he dived back underground, evidently another Foundation Establishment Cultivator.
Naturally, Yuan Ming wouldn't let him escape. A strand of Divine Sense shot out from his forehead, employing the Dream Butterfly Illusion Technique.
The gray-robed man, who had just dived underground, suddenly stiffened. His fierce eyes became vacant as he burrowed out from the ground.
This chapter was first seen on *.
A flash of bloody sword light swept by, and the gray-robed man's head fell off, blood gushing out and staining the nearby sand.
Yuan Ming grabbed the man's Storage Bag, used the Fireball Technique to turn the body into ashes, then headed back to the city.
He had noticed this man lurking underground nearby, likely planning to ambush a Cultivator returning from treasure hunting or hunting beasts, intent on robbing and killing. For such people, he naturally wouldn't show mercy.
Nevertheless, being only a few miles from Xiansha City and yet someone was laying ambushes to kill, just as rumors stated, Black Wind Desert was indeed as chaotic and fraught with danger at every turn.
Yuan Ming quickly returned to his dwelling, his Divine Sense exploring the Storage Bag; inside were six or seven hundred Spirit Stones, a few ordinary Magic Artifacts, the highest being Mid Grade, and a dozen low-level talismans, nothing extraordinary.
But Yuan Ming was still quite pleased. If he ran out of Spirit Stones in the future, he considered taking a tour of the Black Wind Desert and killing some bandits; he might be able to cover his expenses.
He took all the Spirit Stones and talismans, inserted the Black Incense into the Stealing Heaven Tripod, sat cross-legged, and possessed the body of Zuo Qinghui's disciple.
That disciple of Zuo Qinghui was currently cultivating in Chang Chun Temple. Yuan Ming, using the Soul Seal, commanded him to inquire about Zuo Qinghui from the other disciples.
Yuan Ming's Moonlight Technique had broken through the Fourth Level, significantly enhancing his Divine Soul Power, easily imprinting the Soul Seal on him.
Zuo Qinghui often traveled outside, sometimes not returning for years, hence these disciples also seemed unaware of Zuo Qinghui's death, and Chang Chun Temple had yet to discover this fact.
After ending the possession, Yuan Ming felt a release. Although unsure how long he could keep this secret, at least for the short term, he didn't have to worry about anyone coming after him.
Moreover, now situated in the Black Wind Desert, the longer he could stall, the less likely Chang Chun Temple would find any clues or trace his whereabouts.
For the time being, Yuan Ming set aside his worries and continued to extract the Desire Power swirling around the Stealing Heaven Tripod, starting his cultivation.
Threads of Desire Power entered his Sea of Consciousness, slowly refining.
However, very soon, he felt waves of inexplicable and indescribable chaotic emotions surge through his mind, forcing him to temporarily stop absorbing and operate the "Moonlight Technique" to calm his mind.
After a long while, Yuan Ming finally freed himself from the emotional turmoil, glancing at the Stealing Heaven Tripod and sensing the swirling Desire Power, he couldn't help but sigh deeply.
This Desire Power was clearly right before his eyes, yet he simply couldn't take it away, truly frustrating.
He wondered when he would be able to break the golden rune restriction outside the tripod and probe into the Stealing Heaven Tripod's interior to absorb the refined Desire Power?

chapters.title: Chapter 333 - 310: The Wonders of Soul Splitting
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming remained silent for a moment, continuing to cultivate the Moonlight Technique and absorb Desire Power into his Sea of Consciousness.
The transparent soul crow, created from his soul splitting, aimlessly wandered in his Sea of Consciousness.
Yuan Ming performed Inner Observation on his Divine Sense, glanced at the crow, and disregarded it.
Just as he was about to continue refining the Desire Power, his expression suddenly changed, and his Divine Sense firmly locked onto the transparent soul crow, making him feel both annoyed and amused!
As the transparent soul crow wandered in his Sea of Consciousness, it wasn't aimlessly so, but it was slowly absorbing the freshly accumulated Soul Power in the Sea of Consciousness to enhance itself.
The Soul Power, painstakingly refined from the Desire Power he transformed, was actually being cornered by this transparent soul crow!
Just as Yuan Ming was about to summon this transparent soul crow out, a thought suddenly occurred to him.
The next moment, he split the Desire Power sent into the Sea of Consciousness into two streams, one toward his main soul and the other toward the transparent soul crow.
Since this soul split had already become independent and developed its own consciousness, it should also be able to absorb Desire Power. Once it refined the Desire Power, he could absorb its Soul Power, which would greatly accelerate the enhancement of his Divine Soul Power.
The Desire Power sent into the main soul was refined and absorbed as usual, so Yuan Ming did not pay further attention to it, but instead focused all his attention on the soul split.
The transparent soul crow quickly absorbed the Desire Power it came into contact with and showed no abnormalities.
Yuan Ming was secretly pleased; this method seemed to work.
However, at that moment, the body of the transparent soul crow suddenly began to show abnormalities by forming bubbles and many cracks appeared.
This startled Yuan Ming, who hurriedly shifted the Desire Power from the soul split back to the main soul, but even so, the cracks on the transparent soul crow's body kept increasing, and it seemed to be on the verge of collapsing.
Through the connection with the soul split, Yuan Ming realized that it was not that it couldn't absorb the Desire Power, but that it simply couldn't dissolve the chaotic emotions contained within the Desire Power.
Being a person with a mature and autonomous consciousness, Yuan Ming himself would experience various emotions daily, which would dissolve over time. Therefore, even by absorbing Desire Power and gaining more mixed emotions, as long as it didn't exceed a certain level, he could dissolve them by himself.
The consciousness of the soul split, although independent, was still very immature and fragile, and it couldn't even form a single coherent thought. Faced with the sudden influx of mixed emotions, it naturally couldn't dissolve them on its own.
Realizing this, Yuan Ming immediately had the soul split run the Moonlight Technique, hoping it would help dissipate the mixed emotions.
However, although the Moonlight Technique was an advanced Soul Cultivation Method, it was only mediocre in dispelling stray thoughts, and the situation of the transparent soul crow did not improve.
"What should I do? Do I just watch this transparent soul crow collapse?" Yuan Ming couldn't help but feel a great urgency in his heart.
This transparent soul crow was not easily obtained and was quite useful. Losing it would be a great loss.
It was then, an idea flashed in his mind, recalling the Heart Cleansing Technique contained within Sha Hao's Storage Bag.
As the main Cultivation Technique of the Great Elder, the Heart Cleansing Technique's greatest feature was its ability to refine the mind and spirit and eliminate emotional stray thoughts.
However, cultivating this technique to its highest realm could completely sever a person's Seven Emotions and Six Desires, which is why Yuan Ming had never tried cultivating it.
Now that the transparent soul crow was troubled by mixed emotions and on the verge of collapse, he might as well try the unlikely cure and not worry about the consequences.
Furthermore, even if the soul split became devoid of emotions due to the Heart Cleansing Technique, it wouldn't affect the main soul much. The M|V|LE&MPYR team worked hard on this chapter.
Yuan Ming had already memorized the content of the Heart Cleansing Technique and, making a decisive move, controlled the soul split to cultivate according to the method of the Heart Cleansing Technique and operate its Soul Power.
As the soul split had strong Soul Power, combined with Yuan Ming's experience in cultivating the Moonlight Technique, it didn't take long to get a handle on the Heart Cleansing Technique.
Suddenly, the collapsing condition of the soul split staggered to a halt.
Yuan Ming was delighted and continued to control the soul split to operate its Soul Power.
After barely half an hour, he began to clearly feel the mixed emotions within the soul split dissolving like ice and snow, gradually disappearing without trace, the cracks started to heal, and its expanding body gradually returned to calm.
Not only that, the Soul Power of the transparent soul crow was noticeably strengthened.
Yuan Ming breathed a huge sigh of relief; he hadn't expected the Heart Cleansing Technique's ability to remove stray thoughts to be so effective.
With this, his previous plan could completely be realized!
Yuan Ming again directed a stream of Desire Power into the Sea of Consciousness, allowing the transparent soul crow to absorb it all while operating the Heart Cleansing Technique.
The effect of the Heart Cleansing Technique far exceeded his expectations, and the stream of Desire Power was quickly refined and transformed into pure Desire Power in a very short time.
Yuan Ming operated the main soul crow, deploying the Soul Feeding Divine Skills, and before the soul split could act, he sucked away this pure Desire Power.
He couldn't help but feel excited; with this method, he would be able to enhance his Soul Power without any risks!
Yuan Ming repeated the process, continuously directing the Desire Power lingering around the Stealing Heaven Tripod into the soul split, refining it with the Heart Cleansing Technique, retaining only a small part for nourishing the soul split, and pouring the rest into the main soul.
He cultivated in this manner for an entire day and, to his delight, opened his eyes to find that his Divine Soul Power had improved by leaps and bounds, much faster than simply cultivating the Moonlight Technique.
The rapid advancement of Divine Soul Power made the previously elusive Soul Pill Secret Technique now highly probable.
Comparatively, the amount of Desire Power surrounding the Stealing Heaven Tripod now seemed less. It seemed that it was necessary to spread his books throughout Xiansha City for more people to see and idolize him, thereby accumulating Desire Power.
Today, when Yuan Ming went to buy elixirs, he roughly strolled around Xiansha City, where some bookshops also sold books, making publication not a problem.
Yuan Ming contemplated, yet suddenly recalled the Rock Whisker Pill.
This pill was affordable, but the most challenging part was the mixed remnants of Demon Insect thoughts it contained. Since the Heart Cleansing Technique could refine Desire Power, could it also remove the remnants of Demon Insects?
Once this idea struck him, Yuan Ming promptly acted, took out a Rock Whisker Pill, and swallowed it.
Shortly, a thin black mist reappeared in Yuan Ming's Sea of Consciousness. Prepared this time, he immediately ordered his split soul to absorb all the mist.
Then, as his split soul continuously operated the Heart Cleansing Technique, the black mist vanished in the blink of an eye. Yuan Ming waited for a moment to confirm that the demon beast's miscellaneous thoughts were completely dissolved, revealing a broad smile.
Thus, the side effects of the Insect Pill were non-existent for him. He could purchase and consume it without any hesitation, accelerating his cultivation while genuinely saving a significant amount of Spirit Stone expenditure.
Excited, Yuan Ming immediately went out and purchased various Insect Pills from a few elixir shops at quite low prices, returned to his residence, and immersed himself in cultivation.
...
Four months later.
Yuan Ming came out from a bookshop in the outer city, shook his head, and turned towards the inner city.
Located on the frontier of the Central Plains and far from Da Jin, his publications, though circulated, were scarce in quantity, many of which were pirated with missing or incorrect words. Some even had sections of other books transplanted into them.
To increase his income from Desire Power, he had specially rewritten the manuscript of his works and sent it to a bookshop in Xiansha City for printing and publication.
But now, four months later, he found that the number of readers had grown exceedingly slowly, incrementally accumulating only four or five strands of Desire Power.
He today visited the bookshop and finally understood what was happening.
In the harsh conditions of the Black Wind Desert, where common folk struggled daily just to survive, there was no leisure to buy and read books.
Besides, with Cultivators ruling the area and viewing common people as servants, simply needing them to obey, they naturally did not establish any public or private schools to teach literacy.
Most of the city's commoners were illiterate, and the sales of Yuan Ming's books were abysmal, starkly contrasting with the situation in Da Jin.
Faced with such circumstances, Yuan Ming could only helplessly consider selling the books as a sideline, no longer expecting to gain more Desire Power through this means.
After entering the inner city, he quickly arrived at Spring Breeze Hall.
He had finished the common elixirs he had previously bought and now came to buy more Rock Whisker Pills in bulk for future cultivation needs.
As he walked into the store, thinking about finding the shopkeeper, he looked up and unexpectedly found an acquaintance he had once met.
This person wore a blue scholar's hat and plain scholar's robe, with a gentle and amiable face but dark skin as if often exposed to the sun. Although thin, he did not appear frail.
Currently, he was selecting elixirs in the store. Sensing Yuan Ming's gaze, he looked up, and seeing it was Yuan Ming, his face showed surprise.
"It turns out to be Fellow Daoist Cui, what a coincidence, it's been a long time." Yuan Ming greeted with a smile.
This person was indeed Cultivator Cui who Yuan Ming had met previously in Little Lake City at the Four Symbols Tea House. Although he was from Zhao Country, it was fate that he met Yuan Ming here today.
Cultivator Cui clearly remembered Yuan Ming. However, since Yuan Ming had not exchanged names with him at that time, he wanted to return the greeting but did not know how to address him.
Yuan Ming realized this and immediately said, "Fellow Daoist, just call me Yuan Ming."
Hearing this, Cultivator Cui was momentarily stunned, then seemed to realize, and also greeted with a smile.
"I am Cui Wuran. Fellow Daoist Yuan, I've long admired your name. What brings you to the Black Wind Desert?"
Back at the Four Symbols Tea House, when they talked, someone mentioned having seen Yuan Ming and even had a signed book as proof. Now, one of them calling himself by this name naturally could not be true.
Cui Wuran guessed that Yuan Ming might be using a false name to avoid enemies seeking revenge.
"I came across some minor troubles and thought to lay low for a while. And you, Fellow Daoist Cui?" Yuan Ming replied.
Cui Wuran nodded, further confirming his suspicion. However, when it came to the reasons for his presence, he seemed reluctant to share and vaguely changed the subject.
"Hehe, I'm more or less in the same situation. Are you here to buy elixirs, Fellow Daoist Yuan? I've been living in the city for a while now and am acquainted with the shopkeeper of this store. Let me introduce you later so you can also get a discount," Cui Wuran said.
Yuan Ming smiled, thanked him with a bow, and just then, the shopkeeper came down from upstairs. Seeing Cui and Yuan together, he immediately approached and greeted:
"Senior Cui, you've come! It's been a long time indeed. I thought you might have settled in another city."

chapters.title: Chapter 334 - 311: Benefactor
chapters.content:
"Heh heh, I was busy with some trifles not long ago and indeed left the city for a while. Let's not talk about that. Manager Shen, let me introduce you; this is Fellow Daoist Yuan Ming, with whom I am somewhat acquainted," said Cui Wuran.
"So it's Senior Yuan, I've long heard of you. Is the senior coming to my shop to buy elixirs? Since Senior Cui has introduced you, I will offer you a ten percent discount. I hope the senior will continue to patronize our shop," Manager Shen said, immediately bowing to Yuan Ming.
Cui Wuran, seeing Manager Shen offering a discount on his own accord and thereby greatly boosting his face, immediately beamed with joy.
Upon seeing this, Yuan Ming wasn't shy, and straightforwardly said, "Since that's the case, may I know how many Rock Whisker Pills your shop still has? I'd like to buy quite a few at once."
"Eh, Rock Whisker Pills? Fellow Daoist Yuan, are you aware of the side effects of this elixir? Be careful not to make a mistake in purchasing," Cui Wuran said, startled, promptly reminding him.
"Ah, Fellow Daoist Cui, thank you for your kind reminder. How could I not know about the side effects of the Rock Whisker Pill? It's just that I am really strapped for cash; after much calculation, I have no choice but to purchase this pill for cultivation," Yuan Ming said with a bitter smile, his expression forlorn.
Seeing this, Cui Wuran's lips twitched twice, as if he too was reminded of some sorrowful matter, and for a while, he found himself lost for words.
Manager Shen, seeing the mood, immediately smoothed things over, "Senior Yuan, don't worry, we still have plenty of Rock Whisker Pills in stock. If you'd like, they are only one hundred and sixty spirit stones per bottle."
Yuan Ming nodded, stating the amount he needed for a year's cultivation, and upon hearing this, Manager Shen hurriedly went to make arrangements.
After Manager Shen had left, Cui Wuran suddenly sighed, "Ah, Fellow Daoist Yuan is living in such dire straits now, it pains my heart to see. Thus, I recently received a task from the Mountain Flipping Alliance in the city that can earn a large number of elixirs. Although the task is difficult, because the reward is very generous, the Mountain Flipping Alliance prefers to choose only those they trust and thus did not advertise it publicly. If Fellow Daoist Yuan is willing, I could introduce you and share the profits."
"Please tell me more, Fellow Daoist Cui," Yuan Ming feigned interest.
"This is the deal, nearby Xiansha City, a Fire Throat Lizard's nest was recently discovered, with quite a number of Second Rank Upper Stage beasts within. Our task is to completely destroy this nest. Once successful, every participant will receive at least eight bottles of Four Spirits Pill or an equivalent amount of spirit stones as a reward," Cui Wuran explained.
Yuan Ming was somewhat surprised. The level of the reward meant little to him, but for typical Loose Cultivators considering the local prices, it was indeed considered substantial.
However, he was not truly in need of elixirs and spirit stones at the moment and thus, after feigning hesitation for a long time, he shook his head and said:
"I'm sorry, Fellow Daoist Cui, my strength is limited, and I am afraid I might not be able to handle a group of Second-level Demon Beasts and so shouldn't add trouble to your efforts."
Hearing this, Cui Wuran knew Yuan Ming probably didn't fancy this mission. He looked disappointed but persuaded a few more times. Seeing Yuan Ming's firm attitude, he could only temporarily give up and handed Yuan Ming a Communication Talisman, telling him to seek him out if he ever changed his mind.
Yuan Ming nodded, accepted the Communication Talisman, and just then Manager Shen returned with the Rock Whisker Pills. After briefly checking them, Yuan Ming bid farewell to Cui Wuran and left the Spring Breeze Hall.
Once back at his residence, Yuan Ming did not dwell on the event at Spring Breeze Hall and proceeded with his cultivation as usual.
However, just as he was preparing to absorb Desire Power to cultivate his Divine Soul, he suddenly discovered that another rich wave of Desire Power had accumulated outside the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
Unlike the Desire Power generated from his readers, this wave seemed even more profound and mature, seemingly from another source.
Yuan Ming channeled this new Desire Power into his soul splitting, and during the refinement, he faintly sensed a complex emotion imbued with gratitude, prayers, and pleas.
At the same time, he also sensed the location of this Desire Power's owner, situated in a house in the eastern part of the outer city.
Despite having lived in Xiansha City for only a short while, Yuan Ming had closely studied its layout. Beyond the distinction between the inner city and outer city, the city was further divided into different areas such as the garrison where the Scatter Alliance gathered and Hangshang Square, bustling with shops.Uploaded by the *) team.
However, the source of this Desire Power was in the outer city's infamous Black Earth Square, a place no cultivator wished to visit, inhabited solely by impoverished and downtrodden common folk.
Curious, Yuan Ming once again sent out a soul crow to investigate the source of the Desire Power.
...
A pair of worn-out cloth shoes stepped onto the filthy black soil.
Hu Ji carried a cloth bag, walking cautiously on the street, gingerly avoiding the occasional garbage debris and the pungent, moist sand-mud.
The dilapidated earth-yellow walls on both sides of the street were interspersed with makeshift barriers made of dirty fabric and broken stones, dividing the already cramped houses into a dozen separate rooms.
Countless thin ropes stretched across the street, connecting the houses on both sides, with faded clothes hanging on them dripping with pale black dirty water, falling on passersby and inciting bursts of cursing.
In a narrow alley on Hu Ji's left, three children sneakily stood at a corner, directing filth toward a certain door; the moment the door suddenly opened and the owner, unaware of what was happening, stepped out, his foot landing on the filth. After realizing what had happened, his face flushed with anger as he waved his arms and chased after the children.
On Hu Ji's right, two ragged women were arguing, their quarrel interspersed with coarse language and the origins of the contention, apparently all over someone wearing someone else's undergarment.
Today, Black Earth Square was as noisy as it ever was.
Hu Ji did not linger over those all-too-familiar sights but quickened his pace, returning to his dwellings deep within Black Earth Square.
Having mixed in Xiansha City for many years and having a job in the caravan, he had managed to save a little. The rented room, which was not partitioned and only housed him, his wife, and daughter, was considered upper-tier accommodation in Black Earth Square.
As soon as he entered the house, he saw his six-year-old daughter sitting in the room, washing clothes. Her tender small hands were wrinkled from the water, which made Hu Ji's heart ache.
"Where's your mother? Why is she making you do this?" Hu Ji put down the cloth bag he carried, took the wooden basin from his daughter, and began scrubbing the clothes as he talked.
"Mom, she just fell ill again. I didn't want to strain her anymore, so I thought I'd help out. Dad, don't blame mom."
Apparently sensing a hint of reproach in Hu Ji's tone, the daughter timidly explained.
Hu Ji's hands stiffened, and he quickly set down the clothes and stood up, saying, "She's ill again? What about the medicine we bought earlier? Did you give it to her?"
"I gave it to her, but mom said it wasn't too serious this time. The medicine is expensive, so she said to save it and take less," the daughter said.
Hearing this, Hu Ji furrowed his brows and quickly walked to the inner room, lifting the curtain of the bedroom door, and indeed he saw his wife lying on the bed.
His wife was extremely thin, her limbs like poles, her hair like dry grass, and her sallow face had no healthy color but was dotted with numerous greyish-blue spots, which looked particularly alarming.
When she heard Hu Ji approaching, she turned her head with difficulty and glanced at the door, surprises in her cloudy eyes.
"Ah Ji, why did you come back so early today?"
"They couldn't find enough hands at the caravan, so they let me go home to wait for news. But you, haven't I told you not to skimp on expenses? If you are sick, you should buy medicine. Why don't you ever listen to me?"
Hu Ji muttered under his breath while reaching under the small table next to the bed to pull out a wooden box.
He opened the box, his gaze slightly sharpening. Then, pretending nothing was wrong, he took out a dark medicine pill and stood up to fetch a bowl of water from the water tank in the room.
The water in the tank was not clear; it had a faint green-blue tint and even a mild odd smell. Ordinary people, upon seeing it, would hesitate to drink it.
Yet this was the only water available to the residents of Black Earth Square, sourced from wells that led directly to the Underground River. The water quality was very poor, hence, it was not valued by Cultivators and was only used by ordinary people.
Hu Ji helped his wife up and fed her the medicine. Seeing that her complexion was worse than before, he grew inwardly anxious but, not wanting to worry his wife, kept his concerns off his face.
After comforting his wife a few words, he stood up, left the bedroom, and went to a small altar in the main room.
On the altar, there was a placard with the words "Black River God" in red, intricately crafted and decorated with many patterns.
Hu Ji glanced at the placard, then went to pick up the cloth bag he had set down at the entrance. He took out a brand-new wooden placard from it and placed it on the altar.
This placard bore just four small characters—"Benefactor Yuan Ming," and though it was slightly less exquisite than the Black River God's, it clearly showed effort.
After placing the placard correctly, Hu Ji kneeled in front of the altar and respectfully knocked his head on the floor three times. He then bowed his head in prayer for a while before he crawled under the altar, pulled out a small bag of gold and silver from a hidden compartment, and tucked it into his cloak, admonishing his daughter with a few words before he stepped out of the house.
Soon after, he brought the hidden gold and silver to the front of a two-story house and hesitated for a moment before knocking on the door.
"Who is it? Oh, isn't this Brother Hu Ji? What brings you here in broad daylight?" A corpulent man opened the door and greeted Hu Ji.
Hu Ji looked down and said, "Divine Envoy, I've come to buy medicine."
Hearing this, the fat man's eyes lit up, and his chubby face squeezed out a smile.
"Buying medicine, you say? That can be arranged. But lately, there have been too many cases of the green poison illness in the city, and the medicines blessed by the Black River God are somewhat scarce now. I'm afraid the prices will have to be much higher than before."
Hu Ji took a deep breath, gritted his teeth, and said, "Divine Envoy, rest assured, I've brought quite a lot of silver this time."
With that, he handed over the bag hidden in his cloak.
The fat man took the bag, weighed it in his hand, and his face immediately showed a satisfied smile. He stepped aside to let Hu Ji into the house.

chapters.title: Chapter 335 - 312 Nether Moon God
chapters.content:
Hu Ji squeezed past the plump man into the room, his gaze sweeping around subconsciously.
The room's decor was not luxurious, yet it exuded a mysterious air; positioned against the wall stood a giant divine statue two people tall, sculpted as a mysterious man in a black robe, his face completely hidden by the shadow of the hood, rendering it unclear.
There were also quite a few men and women in black robes standing in the room, each with three wave-like patterns stitched in silk on their chests, marking them as believers of the Black River Divine Sect.
Standing in the room listening to the prayers of those people, Hu Ji felt increasing irritation.
However, soon, the chubby man who had taken his money bag walked out from an inner room, still holding a wooden box in his hands.
Hu Ji took the wooden box and counted the contents, only to find that the number of medicine pills was nearly half less than before. A surge of anger rushed to his head, but when he looked up, he saw that the plump man was now flanked by several burly men in black robes.
"Brother Hu, this is a reward from the Black River God. You must keep it safe, otherwise, if you offend the Black River God and he casts down divine punishment, I won't be able to protect you," said the plump man, looking at Hu Ji with a quasi-smiling expression, his tone affected and pretentious.
Seeing this situation, Hu Ji had no choice but to suppress his anger and asked, "May I dare to ask the Divine Envoy, with the medicine this expensive bestowed by Lord Black River God, can it truly cure the green poison disease? My wife has been taking it for so long, why hasn't she gotten better yet?"
"Audacious! How dare you question the Black River God! If your wife's illness is not cured, it is because her faith is not devout enough. When you return, let her recite the scriptures of the Black River God a few more times, and the efficacy of the medicine will naturally manifest. Stop making unreasonable trouble here!" The plump man huffed coldly, waved his hand, and the burly men next to him pushed and dragged Hu Ji out of the room.
Outside the house, Hu Ji was shoved so hard that he fell, but he managed to protect the wooden box in his hands. When he got up, the doors of the house had already closed. Seeing this, he could only get up and head back to his dwelling.
Meanwhile, on the roof of the house, a soul crow had seen everything, and seeing Hu Ji leaving, it too, flapped its wings, its form virtualizing as it dove into the ground, soon disappearing without a trace.
...
Since his wife had previously taken the medicine pills, Hu Ji set the wooden box aside after returning home and then busied himself with household chores.
Yet, in his heart, he unconsciously began to harbor a sliver of doubt toward the "Black River God" mixed with an indescribable resentment, despite having no choice but to trust the "Black River God" for now.
Having medicine was still better than having none.
After he busied himself around the house for awhile and hung the washed clothes out to dry, he returned inside only to unexpectedly find a man in a plain robe talking with his daughter.
Seeing this, Hu Ji felt a chill in his heart and quickly went forward, intending to stand in front of his daughter, but he froze when he saw the man's face.
"Benefactor?"
Yuan Ming smiled and nodded at him, "It's been many days. Seeing you so spirited, I'm also relieved."
Emotionally, Hu Ji knelt in front of Yuan Ming, "Previously, I did not recognize the great person in front of me. On the way back, I was disrespectful to benefactor many times. Thank you for your magnanimity, not only ignoring my faults but also saving me from the Black Wind. I am deeply grateful and willing to serve you in any way you instruct, without any hesitation."
Yuan Ming quietly watched Hu Ji, the corners of his mouth still carrying a faint smile.
Hu Ji was indeed a smart man, and he clearly understood that as a cultivator, Yuan Ming wouldn't seek him out without reason; therefore, at first sight, he expressed his gratitude and willingness to work for Yuan Ming.
"I have come to seek you today to help you," Yuan Ming said, walking over to the altar table and, using his finger as a knife, he picked up the tablet of the Black River God, erased the inscribed words, and re-carved three new characters—"Nether Moon God".
"From now on, I want you to preach in the name of the Nether Moon God throughout the city. The more believers you gather, the greater the rewards I will give you. Reaching a certain number might even grant you a chance to step onto the Immortal Path," Yuan Ming said.
Without any hesitation, Hu Ji replied, "I respectfully follow the decree of my benefactor. From this day onwards, I shall do my utmost not to disappoint your expectations, but there is one more thing I hope benefactor can help me with."
Yuan Ming simply said, "Is it about curing your wife's illness?"
"Benefactor indeed knows everything. I indeed have this intention, though it's not just for personal reasons but also for the sake of benefactor's mission to spread the faith," Hu Ji explained.
"Let's hear it," Yuan Ming said, his voice containing a trace of scrutiny.
"As I mentioned before, the Black Wind Desert is a mixed source for mortals, situated at the border between Qin and Zhao countries and the Northern Desert. Each city houses a mix of people from Qin, Zhao, and the Northern Desert. I am from Zhao, and my wife is from the Northern Desert. People from the Central Plains do not have a habit of following a faith, whereas many from the Northern Desert already have beliefs. Therefore, it's not easy to spread a new faith," Hu Ji said, knowing Yuan Ming was assessing his insight and judgment, so he explained carefully.
"Moreover, in the Black Wind Desert, mortals are slaves to cultivators, and although their vision is limited, they won't worship just any magic they see. To gain their faith, one must genuinely solve the problems they face. Recently, the biggest problem in Xiansha City, where the mortals live, is the Green Poison Disease, the same illness my wife suffers from. If we can solve this disease, gaining their faith might be as easy as flipping one's hand," Hu Ji concluded.
Hearing this, Yuan Ming asked, "Are these the deeds of the Black River Divine Sect that you speak of?"
"Indeed, that Black River Divine Sect has risen to power through these matters and now relies on selling divine medicine to amass a large number of believers. As long as you can teach me to make elixirs with slightly better effects, we can recruit all their followers into our fold," Hu Ji nodded in response.
"You need not worry about that. Their medicines are nothing but clay pills without a trace of spiritual energy fluctuations, merely things to fool people with. This bottle of elixir I have, even if you were to soak it in water and distribute the resultant medicinal solution, would be hundreds, thousands of times more effective than theirs."
Yuan Ming shook his head and took out a bottle of low grade detoxification pills, placing it on the altar table.
Overjoyed, Hu Ji quickly got up, took the elixir, exchanged a few words with Yuan Ming, then hastened into the bedroom.
Yuan Ming was indifferent and did not follow him. His gaze swept casually around the room. At that moment, Hu Ji's daughter approached him, holding a bowl with both hands. She approached Yuan Ming and said in a crisp voice,
"Benefactor, please drink this tea."
The six-year-old girl, unaware of Yuan Ming's identity as a cultivator, saw her father treating him with great respect and instinctively treated Yuan Ming as a distinguished guest, offering him tea.
Yuan Ming was touched by her thoughtfulness but, looking down at the tea in the bowl, he couldn't help but be amused.
Broken leaves floated in the light green tea, steam rising from it, not bringing the fragrance of tea, but a sour and astringent smell instead.
Yuan Ming had never drunk such tea, but seeing the girl's sincere gaze, a soft spot in his heart was touched, and he couldn't bring himself to refuse. He merely took a light sip as a gesture of drinking.
However, as soon as the tea reached his stomach, Yuan Ming's brows furrowed, and with a raise of his hand, he summoned Hua Zhi.
The girl was startled at the sudden appearance of a vine creature but then gathered her courage and touched Hua Zhi's arm, her face full of curiosity.Fоr а bеttеr rеаding еxpеriеnсе, visit М(VLЕМРYR).
But Yuan Ming had no time to attend to her and directly handed the tea bowl to Hua Zhi, saying, "Check where the poison in this tea comes from."
Hua Zhi took the tea bowl, dipped his finger into the tea, picked up some of the broken leaves, and swallowed them.
Soon, he had come to a conclusion, "Master, the water contains poison."
Yuan Ming nodded, and just then, from the bedroom, a cry of joy erupted. Hu Ji came out supporting his wife, whose facial spots had faded considerably compared to before.
"Benefactor, this is..." As Hu Ji looked up, he saw Hua Zhi and was taken aback.
"This is my companion; never mind him for now. I have a question for you. The water in your house, where does it come from? Have you ever added anything to it, or has anyone else touched it?" asked Yuan Ming.
After thinking for a moment, Hu Ji shook his head, "The water is drawn daily from the well. Although it tastes bad, there is enough of it. Each household draws its own and doesn't interfere with one another, and there's certainly no question of adding anything."
"Where is the well located? Lead me there," Yuan Ming instructed.
Hu Ji nodded, settled his wife down, and immediately led Yuan Ming to the well.
Soon, Yuan Ming arrived at the well. He released a soul crow to explore down the well. However, tracing the path of the well water downward, Yuan Ming discovered that the well was connected to a deeply situated underground river with turbid waters, obscuring visibility.
After pondering for a moment, Yuan Ming had another idea. Using an illusion technique for cover, he again released Hua Zhi, ordering him to enter the well and follow the dark river downwards, trying to determine the source of the water's poison.
Hua Zhi immediately obeyed, diving into the ground and heading toward the dark river.
After considerable effort, Hua Zhi arrived at the location of the dark river. The murky river water obscured his vision, and even Hua Zhi couldn't discern the direction, but he could feel the flow of toxins in the water and directly followed the source of the toxins upstream.
Before long, Hua Zhi suddenly emerged from the water only to find himself in a wide underground cavern. In this cavern, an insect demon, resembling a ladybug with feelers on its head and about the size of a human, was joyfully feasting on the corpses of other demon beasts on the stone wall.
Greenish body fluid dropped from its back to the ground, forming a shallow pool that ultimately flowed back into the dark river.
Seeing this, Hua Zhi immediately charged at the insect demon and engaged it in combat.
The insect demon, being of the second lower rank, was no match for Hua Zhi's summoned vines, which it couldn't even bite through. Its back's toxic fluid also had no effect on Hua Zhi, so it quickly fell into disadvantage, and just when it was about to be killed, the insect demon became frightened, coiling up its body, lowering its feelers in submission, and stretching them toward Hua Zhi.
Sensing its submission, Hua Zhi approached without hesitation, lightly pricked the insect demon's body with a vine, leaving a mark inside it, and then summoned it to follow him back to the surface.
On the surface, Yuan Ming listened to Hua Zhi recount the whole story. Knowing that the toxin in the water had been dealt with, he was pleased and also began to consider whether he could use this incident to increase his collection of desire power.

chapters.title: Chapter 336 - 313: Competition
chapters.content:
One month later, in front of the water well at Black Earth Square.
Nearing midnight, twenty-odd people dressed in grey and white robes stood surrounding the well, men and women of various ages, each holding a torch in hand, all standing in silence, with no one speaking.
Around them, over a hundred others of different attires and ages watched the scene, whispering to each other from time to time.
Before long, Hu Ji, clad in a luminous white robe, emerged from the shadows. He did not hold a torch, yet his garment emitted a soft glow that illuminated the surroundings.
The people in grey and white robes all looked up at Hu Ji and instinctively parted to form a path, silently watching as he passed by them and walked up to the well, whereupon the path closed behind him.
The believers formed an inner circle around Hu Ji, their gazes filled with fervor and hope, while the others also ceased their chatter, subconsciously moving closer, forming an even larger circle on the outside.
All eyes were on the well at the center, some faces marked with confusion, others with curiosity, and yet others with disdain.
But at that moment, no one spoke, and the scene fell into utter silence.
"When the Nether Moon rises, all lingering darkness shall be dispersed, all rampant disease shall be healed, all rampant sins shall be cleansed. The Nether Moon God has descended and will grant light to those who look up, blessings to those who follow, and guidance to those who believe. Brothers and sisters, we gather here tonight to witness the miracle of the Nether Moon God!" Hu Ji stood in the center of the crowd, raised his arms, looked around, and slowly spoke, breaking the silence.
The believers around him also raised their arms, looking at Hu Ji in the midst of the crowd, their eyes brimming with reverence.
In that month, Hu Ji had rapidly relieved many mortals afflicted by the Green Poison using the Detoxification Pills given by Yuan Ming, thereby increasing the Nether Moon God's followers.
Unlike the elixirs brought out by the "Black River Divine Envoy," the effects of the Nether Moon God's bestowed elixirs were evident to all. Even if some mortals knew this might be a gift from a Cultivator, they were willingly prostrating themselves under the esteemed name of this Cultivator.
And today, Hu Ji had summoned them, along with many other residents of the square, claiming he was going to show them the miracle of the Nether Moon God.
"Xiansha City has been plagued by the Green Poison for two years now, during which many false gods and evil cults, under the pretense of relieving the suffering of the masses, conducted their crooked businesses. We spent large sums of gold and silver, only to be left with diseases beyond cure."
"We pleaded with the City Lord's Mansion, only to be met with indifference and neglect. We knelt before Immortal Masters, who returned our pleas with disdain and scolding. Only the Nether Moon God heard our cries, saw our agony, pitied our plight, and was willing to extend a helping hand to save us from our suffering," Hu Ji said, his voice rising gradually.
As the believers listened, they recalled their past tribulations, their emotions stirring. Even some onlookers began to nod quietly, agreeing with Hu Ji's words.
They were not blind; they could clearly see who truly helped them and who exploited the opportunity to collect wealth.
"Moreover, the Nether Moon God, pitying the world, also knew that evil must be eradicated. Not only did he bestow elixirs, but he also wielded Divine Power to identify the main culprit behind all this. And today is the day of judgment for that pest."
Suddenly, Hu Ji raised his arms high, and behind him arose a pure white Round Moon, slowly rising as if emerging from the East Sea, and eventually hovering above everyone's heads.
Within the Round Moon, a segment of purplish-black glowing vine suddenly grew out. Countless pale butterflies accompanied the vine, flying out of the moon together. They circled the vine, urging it to grow rapidly and vigorously, quickly turning into a vine ball. Guided by the butterflies, it flew into the well.
The light of the Round Moon was soft and warm; bathed in its glow, everyone felt an unprecedented sense of comfort.
As they looked up at the Round Moon, they suddenly noticed an image appearing within its luminous ring.
It was a green Insect Demon perched on a stone wall, surrounded by countless dreadful corpses, both demon beasts and humans.
The filthy green pus oozed from the Insect Demon's back, mingling with the river water. Seeing this sight, everyone recalled the water they drank daily, with some even unable to suppress their retching.
Just then, the vine ball intruded into the scene, and the butterflies surrounding it also rushed into the ball at this moment.
The vine grew wildly, and soon turned into a Vine Man clad in glowing armor, who went straight forward to battle the Insect Demon. The Insect Demon was vicious, employing a multitude of tactics. Yet the Vine Man always responded appropriately, sometimes the scene seemed perilous, drawing gasps from the crowd, but soon the advantage was effortlessly reclaimed.
After an unknown span of time, the Vine Man finally penetrated the Insect Demon's defenses, impaling it straight through with his arm, causing the onlookers to shout excitedly.
Immediately thereafter, Hu Ji raised his hand, and the Vine Man flew out from the well with the corpse of the Insect Demon hanging from his arm.
"Today, the Divine General of the Nether Moon God has slain the Insect Demon, and from this day forth, the people of Xiansha City shall no longer be troubled by the Green Poison!"
Upon hearing this, the crowd could not help but shout the name of the Nether Moon God in unison, even those who were initially non-believers joined in the chorus.
But just then, from within the outermost crowd, suddenly came a cold snort.
"Hmpf, I thought it was something big, but they just caught an Insect Demon and say it's the culprit behind the Qing Poison Disease. Such trickery, it's laughable."
The Believers all turned their heads to look, only to see a fat man who called himself the "Black River Divine Envoy," standing with a tall man in a black robe, looking down on Hu Ji with disdain.
Throughout this month, while Hu Ji was recruiting Believers, he had been on guard against the Black River Divine Sect's interference. Unexpectedly, they had never made a move, allowing Hu Ji to steal their Believers. He thought they had ceased their antics, but it turned out that they had chosen today to show up.
"Tu Cha, I have already reported to the Nether Moon God about your actions of extorting wealth in the name of the Black River God. The great deity is merciful and was willing to give you a chance to mend your ways. But you are so ungrateful. Today the Divine General is here. If you kneel now and confess, you may still keep your life!" Hu Ji looked at the fat man and shouted.
To his surprise, Tu Cha didn't even glance at him, instead smiling broadly at the man beside him.
"Sir, this is the Hu Ji who conjured up some Nether Moon God and offended the divine might of the Black River God."
The man did not respond to Tu Cha, but raised his head to look at Hua Zhi, then shouted to the surroundings.
"I am Li Xia, an envoy under the Black River God. All the Believers here are under my jurisdiction. Fellow Daoist, you come uninvited, stealing my Believers and destroying my Divine Sect. You're quite domineering. Now that I am here, if you come forth and apologize, then leave, I can let it go. But if you remain deluded, don't blame me for being ruthless and slaying your spirit pet on the spot."
In the crowd, Yuan Ming, who was concealing his presence, frowned. He initially thought this Black River God was just something mortals dreamt up to extort money, but the Li Xia who stepped forward was an actual Late-stage Foundation Establishment Cultivator.
Yuan Ming became secretly vigilant, released his Divine Sense, and found that there were no other Cultivators in Black Earth Square apart from Li Xia. Therefore, he decided to try to learn the truth from him.
He immediately commanded Hua Zhi to attack Li Xia and also began to activate the Moonlight Technique, casting an Illusion Technique.
Upon receiving the order, Hua Zhi's limbs stretched out, growing countless vines, which moved through the crowd towards Li Xia.L#ove$ thi%s story?& S!h%ow supp!ort- at *.
The onlookers at the periphery, including the fat man, scattered to avoid the commotion, leaving only Li Xia standing in place.
"Hmpf, seeking death. I'll indulge you!" Seeing this, a vicious look crossed Li Xia's face.
He quickly formed hand seals, mumbling incantations, and from his sleeve, a dark black Round Orb flew out, emitting countless black streams of water like a fountain, enclosing himself and sending tendrils of water flying in all directions.
The dark water streams fell to the ground and immediately a "sizzling" sound was heard, and white smoke rose from the ground.
Witnessing this terrifying scene, the surrounding mortals, including the Believers, screamed in horror and turned to run away. Yet many were splashed by the black water stream and their bodies instantly melted like ice, turning into puddles of blood.
Many of the vines released by Hua Zhi corroded upon touching the black water streams.
Shocked by this turn of events, Hua Zhi quickly tried to retract its other vines.
But at that moment, Li Xia simply reached into the air and the black water streams in front of him interwove, turning into a massive black claw, which grasped down and completely consumed Hua Zhi.
"This is what happens to those who dare offend the Black River God! If you don't show yourself now, I'll drag you out myself!" Li Xia's eyes flashed with bloodthirsty pleasure as he shouted.
No sooner had his words fallen, than his gaze abruptly shifted, piercing through the scattering crowd, landing on Yuan Ming who was mingled among them.
At that moment, Yuan Ming instinctively looked back with a face full of panic, as if he was trying to escape using the cover of the mortals around him, but he ended up meeting Li Xia's eyes.
Li Xia sneered and formed another hand seal. The Round Orb above his head shimmered twice, no longer spewing out black streams. Instead, after a brief pause, it suddenly shot out a jet-black Water Arrow that pierced through Yuan Ming in an instant.
Li Xia smiled smugly upon seeing this, and was about to recall the Round Orb when he suddenly felt a pain on his neck. Then, the scenery around him changed rapidly. The supposedly dead mortals were wrapped in purple-black vines around their waists, hanging in mid-air, not at all swallowed by the black streams.
Yuan Ming stood not far away, looking calmly at him.
Li Xia was shocked, wanting to activate the Round Orb again, but he suddenly felt the world spinning. The mortals had turned upside down, completely inverted.
What is this—
Before he could understand what was happening, he lost consciousness completely.

chapters.title: Chapter 337 - 314: Independent Soul Splitting
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming quickly walked up to Li Xia, and before his head hit the ground, he scooped it up in his hand, intending to perform a Soul Search to ascertain the identity of the Black River God.
However, before he could execute the spell, he saw Li Xia's Divine Soul suddenly explode, and a wisp of black smoke drilled out. It swiftly entered the earthen wall atop Xiansha City and disappeared without a trace.
Yuan Ming's expression darkened slightly, knowing that this might be a trick set up by the person behind Li Xia, yet he was helpless to do anything about it.
He sighed, then picked up the Round Orb and Storage Bag from Li Xia's body, scanned the newly resettled Believers and the crowd, and raised Li Xia's head high.
"I am the Nether Moon God Envoy. The lackey of the False God has been executed on the spot. The Nether Moon God's light shines upon the land, the righteous receive protection, and the wicked face punishment. You all must remember this henceforth."
No sooner had his voice faded than a strong silver-white brilliance erupted from his whole body. It enveloped him and he flew into the Round Moon hanging above the crowd's heads, while at this time, Hua Zhi also placed the crowd back down, once again surrounded by butterflies of light, and flew into the Round Moon.
Witnessing everything that had just taken place in front of them, the crowd was awed by the power of the Nether Moon God. They cheered one after another, their faith growing even more devout.
Meanwhile, in a corner of the crowd, Yuan Ming watched this scene unfold, nodded his head, and then slowly dispelled the Illusion Technique. He recalled Hua Zhi and his Insect Demon minions, turned around, and left the place to return to his residence in the inner city.
The rest could be left to Hu Ji.
"Master, how was it? I played my part well, didn't I!" As soon as he returned to his residence, Hua Zhi couldn't wait to seek his praise.
Yuan Ming nodded and generously commended, "I think you were born for this kind of thing. What do you want?"
"I don't want anything. I just hope Master won't keep me in the Spiritual Beast Bag anymore. It's dark and boring in there," Hua Zhi immediately pleaded.
Yuan Ming contemplated; Hua Zhi was becoming more human-like and disliked the arduous cultivation. He actually grew faster when freely cultivating in the wild. Previously, near Wangyue City, due to the scarcity of demon beasts, his strength had not changed much in five years. Now in a place like Black Wind Desert, where demon beasts were plentiful, it would be better to let him out since he desired it.
With that thought, Yuan Ming nodded, "Alright, but don't go too wild out there. Don't stray too far from Xiansha City and stay safe. Otherwise, if you encounter the Black Wind, it would be troublesome."
Hua Zhi quickly agreed.
Following that, Yuan Ming took out a talisman and a Concealing Cloak, along with a set of black clothes that could cover his body.
"Keep these items well. There's an Array beneath here. Go through the city gate when you leave. Put on the cloak and clothes when entering or exiting the city so others won't see your identity. Also, this Evil Avoiding Talisman is said to be able to resist the Yin Sha within the Black Wind to some extent. It needs to be used underground. If you can't make it back to the city in time, you may try using it."
Yuan Ming had spent a significant sum to buy this talisman in the city. Even the seller wasn't confident in its effectiveness, so only wealthy Foundation Establishment Cultivators would buy one just in case. Now that Yuan Ming didn't need to leave the city much, it was fitting to give it to Hua Zhi.
Knowing the value of these items, Hua Zhi felt even more grateful and close to Yuan Ming.
It took the items from Yuan Ming, said goodbye to him and his Insect Demon minions, and left.
After sending off Hua Zhi, Yuan Ming took out the Round Orb previously held by Li Xia.
The Round Orb was a top-grade magical tool. After examining it for a moment, Yuan Ming put it away and began to examine Li Xia's Storage Bag.
The contents of the bag were sparse, consisting only of elixirs and spirit stones, and a gourd-shaped magic artifact the size of a palm.
The gourd was engulfed in darkness, forged from Nine Nether Iron. It felt chilling to the touch. Intricate patterns were carved on its surface, divided into two distinct sides. One bore the image of a blazing sun with an indistinct figure within, below which myriad cultivators and mortals bowed in fervent worship.
On the other side hung a ghostly moon, under which sat a faceless person in the lotus position, hands held as if supporting the moon, or trying to grasp it. Around this figure swarmed countless aggrieved spirits and lost souls, locked in strife and turmoil as though in purgatory.
"This is made of Nine Nether Iron!" Yuan Ming examined the gourd and let out a surprised chirp.
His own Soul Destroying Sword was primarily made of Nine Nether Iron, an exceptionally rare material. That the gourd was entirely cast from Nether Iron suggested that Li Xia's backing was not insignificant.
Yuan Ming took out the gourd and tried to activate it, only to realize that it seemed to require a particular spell to function.
As he attempted to probe it with his Divine Sense, he was astonished to discover a vast amount of Desire Power stored within the gourd.
Yuan Ming was filled with amazement and doubt; the gourd could actually store Desire Power!
Apart from the Stealing Heaven Tripod, he had never seen an object that could store a large amount of Desire Power, except for incense ashes that could preserve a small amount.
Could this black gourd be a treasure similar to the Stealing Heaven Tripod?
However, aside from being cast from Nine Nether Iron, the gourd did not bear any intricate runes, and it was merely a magical tool in terms of rank.
He extended his Divine Sense to investigate the situation inside the gourd more closely and promptly discovered something at the base: a white object the size of a fingertip that seemed like a shard of jade.
The jade shard emitted an attractive force. All the Desire Power within the gourd orbited the shard slowly. Whenever any Desire Power erupted, it was blocked by the gourd's Nine Nether Iron shell, preventing any from leaking out.
Yuan Ming realized the gourd's ability to store Desire Power was primarily due to that piece of jade shard, with the Nine Nether Iron shell serving merely as a container.
What was the origin of this jade shard, that it could attract Desire Power?
He immediately tried to extract the Desire Power within but found he was unable to invoke any of it, leaving him to watch with envious eyes.
He then tried to direct his Divine Sense towards the jade shard at the center of the gourd, but as his Divine Sense drew near, he felt a suction force pulling at it, drawing it into the shard and soon losing contact with Yuan Ming.
This pulling force was extraordinarily strong, surpassing even the Soul Destroying Sword.
Yuan Ming was greatly astonished. After studying it for a moment longer, he found that he could neither utilize the Desire Power within nor remove the jade shard, unless he was willing to destroy this magical tool.
With no other recourse, he sighed and quietly stowed it away, his thoughts turning to the matters concerning the Black River God.
Although he had slain Li Xia, the events just before his death indicated that there was another mastermind behind him.
Moreover, this mastermind also seemed to be collecting Desire Power, though their purpose remained unknown.
Additionally, from his recent attempts, he confirmed once again that he could only absorb Desire Power generated towards himself; Desire Power emanating from others was useless to him and could not even be manipulated.
Yuan Ming pondered for a moment, but couldn't come up with much at once, so he simply adopted the attitude of dealing with whatever came his way, responding to changes with constancy.
The most urgent matter was to enhance his Cultivation and strength as quickly as possible.
With this thought in mind, Yuan Ming sat down cross-legged, summoned the Stealing Heaven Tripod, and continued to absorb Desire Power.
Streams of Desire Power flowed continuously from the surroundings into the Stealing Heaven Tripod, significantly more than before.
Over this period of time, as the image of the Nether Moon God he had cultivated became deeply ingrained in the hearts of the people, together with Hu Ji's quite talented operations, the collected Desire Power had been steadily increasing; and this time, the decisive blow dealt to the Black River Divine Sect proved to have an even more significant effect.
As a result, the advancement of his cultivation in the Moonlight Technique was bound to make leaps and bounds again.
He thought so to himself, while simultaneously controlling his soul split to absorb all the Desire Power, refining it, which rapidly increased the Soul Power in his Sea of Consciousness.
Before he knew it, another month had passed.
In the secret room, Yuan Ming, who was previously meditating with eyes closed, suddenly stopped absorbing Desire Power. A ripple formed at his brow, and a transparent soul crow emerged, circling and dancing around the room.
The size of the transparent soul crow had doubled compared to when it first appeared, and the fluctuation of its Soul Power had greatly increased as well.
However, this fluctuation of Soul Power seemed slightly sluggish, not as spirited as before.
"This Heart Cleansing Technique is indeed peculiar; reaching just the second layer has such a significant impact on the Divine Soul," Yuan Ming muttered to himself.
The soul split had been continuously practicing the Heart Cleansing Technique, and with a great deal of Desire Power to aid it, it had now reached the second layer.
Like the Moonlight Technique, the Heart Cleansing Technique is also divided into six levels.
The consciousness within the soul split wasn't very strong originally, and the Heart Cleansing Technique could sever the Seven Emotions and Six Desires, hence the consciousness of the soul split became even weaker.
However, this was also a good thing, as the soul split would never be able to escape his control.
And with the Heart Cleansing Technique reaching the second layer, he could also attempt a secret technique.
Yuan Ming drew the soul split back into his Sea of Consciousness and rapidly performed hand seals with both hands.
The Soul Power within the transparent soul crow slowly surged, and a crack gradually appeared in the middle, which quickly grew larger and deeper.
"Split!" Yuan Ming uttered a low shout, and the transparent soul crow divided into two halves.
The two portions of Soul Power wriggled quickly, and after a few breaths, they transformed into two slightly smaller transparent soul crows.
This was the Soul Splitting Skill recorded in the Jade Scroll of the Great Elder, which required the cultivation of the Heart Cleansing Technique to the second layer before it could be performed.
Yuan Ming felt as though his Sea of Consciousness was being split open with an axe, a pain far more excruciating than the previous soul split caused by backlash from the Soul Destroying Sword, and much more agonizing.
He gritted his teeth and endured, his body trembling uncontrollably, until a while later when he finally eased.
"I didn't expect the cost of the Soul Splitting Skill to be so great. It's already this painful splitting the soul split; if I were to divide the main soul, it would probably be agonizing enough to kill me," Yuan Ming thought with lingering fear.Sourced directly from *.
He sensed the two transparent soul crows; their abilities for Far Travel and possession were both intact, and he nodded to himself in satisfaction.
The Great Elder's Jade Scroll was indeed true to its word, with the split Divine Souls retaining their former abilities.
With two soul splits, he could do even more tasks.
Furthermore, as he continued to refine and assimilate Desire Power, the number of soul splits could keep increasing. Someday, if he could have hundreds of soul crows like the Great Elder, he wouldn't fear even if more members from the Chang Chun Temple Sect came after him.
Yuan Ming waved his hand, and Zuo Qinghui's body appeared on the ground.
During the past half year, the transparent soul crow rarely possessed Zuo Qinghui's body. Although the body still maintained signs of life, Mana had nearly completely dissipated.
Yuan Ming controlled one soul crow to enter Zuo Qinghui's body.
Color returned to his eyes as he sat up.
Yuan Ming then controlled Zuo Qinghui to sit cross-legged, beginning to practice the Golden Shadow Sword Technique.
The spiritual energy around him started to flow, converging towards Zuo Qinghui's body.
The transparent soul crow possessing Zuo Qinghui was able to cultivate, which meant that this body had fully recovered and was no different from a normal person; with his soul split in control, Zuo Qinghui could be used as a special clone.
Moreover, Zuo Qinghui had Gold and Water Dual Spirit Roots, and was formerly a Core Formation Stage Cultivator. Although his Golden Core had shattered, his potential remained considerable and was worth developing.
Yuan Ming accelerated the circulation of the Golden Shadow Sword Technique, which ran exceptionally smoothly, nothing like someone practicing the sword technique for the first time.
The natural spiritual energy rapidly transformed into Mana, accumulating in Zuo Qinghui's Dantian.
"Even though the Divine Soul has perished, some of Zuo Qinghui's experience in cultivation still seems to reside within this body," Yuan Ming thought to himself.
This was a good sign. Given Zuo Qinghui's aptitude, plus the residual experience in cultivation, his level of Cultivation would soon rise.
"Take these elixirs for now and use them to quickly raise your Cultivation," Yuan Ming said, taking out several bottles of Qi Refinement Realm elixirs and passing them over.
The Insect Pill in his hand was too potent for Zuo Qinghui to handle at the moment.
Zuo Qinghui took them and went to another room, cultivating on his own.
Yuan Ming also sat down and started practicing the Nine Elements Technique.

chapters.title: Chapter 338 - 315: Invited
chapters.content:
A year and a half passed in the blink of an eye.
A clear whistle emanated from the secret chamber, containing waves of vigorous mana fluctuations that caused the ground and walls to tremble faintly.
A layer of yellow light flowed over the four walls of the cave mansion, blocking all sound and mana fluctuations from escaping.
Moments later, Yuan Ming emerged from the secret chamber, exuding a powerful aura, having reached the Late Foundation Establishment Stage.
He had already been close to reaching the Late Foundation Establishment Stage, and after resolving the drawbacks of the Insect Pill through soul splitting, its medicinal power was exceptionally strong. Coupled with items like Spirit Incense, the cultivation of the Nine Elements Technique progressed as smoothly as water flows in a canal.
This time, Yuan Ming was not surprised by his breakthrough in cultivation—as a result of a year and a half of arduous practice, the most significant improvement was in his Divine Soul.
Because he had repeatedly come to the aid of Black Earth Square, as well as the ordinary people in the nearby area, and with Hu Ji managing things appropriately, the number of devout believers of the Nether Moon God had increased to more than three hundred people, with even more general believers, leading to a natural surge in collected Desire Power.
With the aid of the numerous Desire Powers, Yuan Ming's practice of the Moonlight Technique advanced rapidly, nearing perfection in the Fourth Level. After consolidating it for a while, he could consider breaking through to the Fifth Level.
Once he broke through the Fifth Level, his Soul Power would be close to the level required for condensing a Soul Pill.
In other words, his cultivation in Soul Power would completely surpass that in mana.
Within Yuan Ming's Sea of Consciousness, his soul splitting hovered quietly, having not only returned to the size it was before splitting but had also grown significantly larger.
Moreover, with the daily practice of the Heart Cleansing Technique during this period, the condensation of his Soul Power reached an astonishing degree, giving a sense of solidity like that of refined iron tempered a hundred times.
With such a soul splitting, the efficiency of refining the emotional thoughts in the Desire Power was far higher than before.
Yuan Ming walked slowly to another secret chamber and pushed the door open to enter.
Zuo Qinghui was meditating here with eyes closed, his aura quite robust, having also reached the Foundation Establishment Stage.
Speaking of which, Zuo Qinghui's talent was far superior to Yuan Ming's. With a sufficient supply of elixirs, he had reached the Qi Refining Peak half a year ago.
Afterward, Yuan Ming spent a considerable amount of Spirit Stones to buy a Foundation Establishment Pill in Xiansha City, aiding him to successfully establish his foundation.
Although elixirs from the Central Plains were scarce in Xiansha City, the place was a hive of scum and villainy where valuable items still emerged, all brought over by cultivators from thousands of miles away specifically to sell here.
Based on Yuan Ming's experience over the years, even here, as long as you could afford it, you could do many things that you couldn't do in the Central Plains.
With extraordinary talent, Zuo Qinghui began cultivating with Insect Pills after breaking through to Foundation Establishment, and his mana progressed by leaps and bounds, almost describable as sky-rocketing. It was believed that in a few years, he could catch up with Yuan Ming.
