But there seemed to be something wrong with his Physical Body, perhaps due to being resurrected from death, or possibly due to the backlash from cultivating the Golden Shadow Sword Technique and Insect Pills, or some other reason. His skin turned a pale gold color, and the wrinkles on his face had dissipated quite a bit, now making him appear in the prime of his life.
Yuan Ming found this surprising but did not attempt to resolve it. Zuo Qinghui, being a Core Formation Cultivator from the Chang Chun Temple, was already worried about attracting attention when going out. With this transformation, it was actually less likely for him to be recognized.
The soul splitting within Zuo Qinghui's Sea of Consciousness had also grown much stronger, a result of Yuan Ming's deliberate cultivation using Desire Power.
The stronger the soul splitting's Soul Power, the more effortlessly he could control Zuo Qinghui.
This soul splitting refined the remnants of the demon beast's thoughts within the Insect Pill through the Heart Cleansing Technique over the years, and its Soul Power was also tempered to be quite condensed.
Yuan Ming did not awaken Zuo Qinghui but turned and left. Just as he stepped out of the secret chamber, his expression shifted slightly and he took out a Sound Transmission Talisman from his bosom, allowing his Divine Sense to enter it.
The Sound Transmission Talisman shattered, turning into a ball of white light, and a voice entered Yuan Ming's ears.
A glint of joy flashed in Yuan Ming's eyes as he rose to leave his dwelling and quickly arrived at a shop called "Earth Spirit Pavilion" in the inner city.
This was a shop that sold magical formation tools, and Yuan Ming had placed an order for a custom formation here two months ago, which was now finally completed.
Yuan Ming entered the shop, announced his name, and an attendant soon led him to the inner hall where an elder in green clothes had been waiting.
"Master Lu, you have labored hard," Yuan Ming said with cupped hands.
"Hehe, Fellow Daoist Yuan is too courteous. I am but doing my business; there is no labor too hard. The formation you ordered is inside; you can inspect it." The elder in green handed over a wooden box about the height of a ruler, which contained a set of black Array Flags and Array Plates radiating compelling Spiritual Energy.
"Master Lu, your personally refined formation could not possibly be flawed; there's no need to check." Yuan Ming chuckled and directly took the wooden box.
The elder before him, Master Lu, was one of Xiansha City's top-ranked Array Masters, highly skilled in refining formation tools as well. Yuan Ming had spent a considerable amount of Spirit Stones to commission him for a "Beidou Star Soul Array."
This formation itself had no effect in overcoming enemies; its sole purpose was to form a Star Soul Barrier within which Soul Power would not leak in the slightest, a prerequisite for condensing a Soul Pill. The method of refinement was also recorded in the Soul Pill Secret Technique, but of course, Yuan Ming could not refine it himself.
Master Lu was very satisfied with Yuan Ming's attitude and exchanged pleasantries for a moment before bidding farewell.
Yuan Ming was still in the early stages of fostering a relationship with Master Lu, planning to ask him to refine other formations for himself in the future, so he sensibly bid farewell and left.
After stepping out of Earth Spirit Pavilion, he activated his Divine Sense and delved into the Storage Ring to examine the Array within the wooden box, comparing it with the Soul Pill Secret Technique he had memorized. Realizing there was nothing wrong with the Array, he finally relaxed.
Now that everything was ready, all that was left was for the breakthrough in the Moonlight Technique.
Yuan Ming turned around to head home, but halfway there, he suddenly stopped, turned, and walked in a different direction, soon arriving at another side of the inner city.
Here, the shops began to thin out, and the buildings along the road became taller and broader. This area was the stronghold of various Scatter Alliances, with all the Scatter Alliances in Xiansha City located in this region.
Many Cultivators were entering and exiting the various Scatter Alliances' strongholds, most of them in a rush.
Yuan Ming went straight to the stronghold of a Scatter Alliance named "Huwei," where a tall, thin figure cloaked in a black robe stood—it was none other than Hua Zhi.
Seeing Yuan Ming approach, Hua Zhi came forward and handed over a Storage Bag.
"You haven't been gone long, yet your gains are quite substantial," Yuan Ming remarked, his eyebrows rising as his Divine Sense entered the Storage Bag.
Over the past year, Hua Zhi hunted Demon Insects near Xiansha City to improve his strength.
Yuan Ming figured that since he had to hunt Demon Insects anyway, he might as well take on some missions to collect materials and, in the process, earn some Spirit Stones.
However, the speed at which Hua Zhi hunted the Demon Insects was beyond his expectations. The demon beast materials in the Storage Bag were plentiful, and even if he sold them directly, he could exchange them for quite a sum of Spirit Stones.
"I've gained a few more subordinates recently, so the collection speed has naturally increased," Hua Zhi communicated telepathically, his voice filled with delight.Thе М|V|LЕ&МРYR tеаm wоrkеd hаrd оn this сhаptеr.
Yuan Ming had an epiphany and instructed Hua Zhi to return to his residence first, while Yuan Ming himself took the Storage Bag and entered the Huwei Scatter Alliance.
Though Hua Zhi was greatly intelligent, he could not speak. Hence, the task of turning in missions still had to be handled by Yuan Ming himself.
Entering through the main gate of the Huwei Scatter Alliance led to a large stone hall, where many mission scrolls were hanging around, with various tasks written on them.
Having close ties with the Magic Artifact shops within Xiansha City, the Huwei Scatter Alliance posted many tasks for collecting demon beast materials, which was why Yuan Ming came here. Moreover, the Huwei Scatter Alliance was welcoming, allowing non-members to take on tasks as well.
Quite a few Cultivators moved about the hall, looking through the list of tasks.
Yuan Ming headed straight to the longest table in the back, took out a Storage Bag filled with Demon Insect materials and two stone tablets, and passed them to a man in gray clothes behind the table.
The gray-clothed Cultivator dealt with countless mission transactions daily. His hands were efficient, and the business was concluded quickly. Yuan Ming's Storage Ring now contained several hundred more Spirit Stones.
As Yuan Ming was about to turn around and leave, a voice came from beside him:
"Eh, isn't that Fellow Daoist Yuan?"
Yuan Ming looked up to see a man in yellow robes approaching. It was Cui Wuran, whom he had encountered several times before.
"Fellow Daoist Cui, it's been a while. Are you here to take on tasks as well?" Yuan Ming greeted with a nod.
"Yes, the Huwei Scatter Alliance allows outsiders to come and go freely, so I just stopped by to have a look. Eh, Fellow Daoist Yuan, your cultivation has greatly advanced. That's truly joyous and congratulations are in order," Cui Wuran said, envying the noticeable change in Yuan Ming's aura while also being astonished.
"It was just a lucky breakthrough," Yuan Ming said with a chuckle, "And Fellow Daoist Cui's cultivation seems to have made no small progress either."
"How can mid-stage Foundation Establishment be compared with late Foundation Establishment? I'm just of mediocre talent, relying solely on external aids. I can't compare with you, Fellow Daoist Yuan," Cui Wuran said, shaking his head.
"Fellow Daoist Cui gives me too much credit," Yuan Ming replied with a light smile.
At that moment, a bearded man walked from the mission submission table, stopping about three feet away. After giving Yuan Ming a glance, he spoke to Cui Wuran, "Fellow Daoist Cui, our business here is done. Shall we leave?"
"It seems Fellow Daoist Cui has other matters to attend to. I won't keep the two of you. I'll take my leave now," said Yuan Ming, who had a good impression of Cui Wuran but had no desire to engage in extended conversation as he was preoccupied with his own matters and took the opportunity to excuse himself.
"It happens that I, along with a friend from the Fire Origin Sect, Fellow Daoist Shi, have invited a few friends to host a small exchange meeting. If you're not busy, Fellow Daoist Yuan, why not come along and have a look?" Cui Wuran then invited.
"An exchange meeting? That sounds good," Yuan Ming's expression shifted, showing interest.
Exchange meetings were common gatherings among Cultivators, where they discussed cultivation insights, debated the affairs of the Cultivation World, and sometimes traded items they no longer needed.
Since stepping into the Cultivation World, Yuan Ming had occasionally heard of such activities but had never attended anything similar. It seemed a good opportunity to experience one now.
The bearded man, upon hearing this, gave Yuan Ming a cold look, his expression somewhat haughty as if displeased by Cui Wuran's invitation to Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming took no offense and made no move to greet the bearded man. Judging by the aura, this man also seemed to be at the mid-stage Foundation Establishment level.
Yuan Ming had heard tidbits about the Fire Origin Sect—it was the same Sect into which Wulu had been ordered to infiltrate to steal a Cultivation Technique, which later surfaced at an auction, wasn't it?
Seeing the situation, Cui Wuran quickly introduced the two men to each other and made soothing conversation before leaving the Huwei Scatter Alliance's stronghold with them.

chapters.title: Chapter 339 - 316: Exchange News
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming and the bearded man followed Cui Wuran to a nearby restaurant, walking directly up to the third floor to a spacious private room.
The floor was carpeted in crimson, and the walls around were carved with exquisite patterns of birds and flowers, inlaid with gemstones, exuding an opulent aura.
In the center of the private room stood a mahogany round table, already occupied by three people: a young man in his twenties dressed in a black robe, a middle-aged woman with a plump figure, and an elderly man with a ruddy complexion and grey hair.
The group was engaged in a quiet conversation, but when they saw Cui Wuran and his companions enter, they stopped talking and turned their gaze toward them.
"Haha, Fellow Daoist Cui, you've finally arrived," said the grey-haired old man as he stood up with a smile.
"We were delayed a bit on the way, sorry for making you wait. I'll drink three cups as a penalty later," Cui Wuran laughed.
"Let me introduce you to our friends: this is Fellow Daoist Shi, a prominent disciple of the Fire Origin Sect from Zhao Country, and as for the other, Fellow Daoist Yuan, he is an acquaintance I made in Da Jin," and with those words, he turned to introduce the bearded man and Yuan Ming.
"So, it's Fellow Daoist Shi and Fellow Daoist Yuan, a pleasure to meet you," the grey-haired old man greeted enthusiastically, while the black-robed young man and the plump woman simply nodded slightly in acknowledgment.
The bearded man, still with an air of arrogance, nodded to the three and then pulled out a chair to sit down by himself.
Yuan Ming, however, did not put on any airs and gave a cupped fist salute to the three.
Cui Wuran then introduced the other three individuals at the table. The black-robed young man's surname was Ruan and the grey-haired old man's surname was Qu; both were Loose Cultivators from Zhao Country.
Cultivators in the Black Wind Desert were wary, and apart from close friends, most people would only reveal their surnames when introducing themselves.
The plump woman introduced herself as Gu Sanniang, originally from a small sect in Zhao Country, but she had left the sect to travel around at an early age, making her a semi-Loose Cultivator.
Yuan Ming's Divine Sense swept over the table and immediately discerned the Cultivation of the three individuals.
Both the black-robed young man and the grey-haired old man were at the Mid-Stage of Foundation Establishment, while Gu Sanniang was at the Late Foundation Establishment Stage, with a much stronger Mana than Yuan Ming, clearly having reached this stage quite some time ago.
After the initial courtesy, everyone sat down. Cui Wuran ordered a lavish meal, appetizing and comprising ingredients that contained Spiritual Power, aiding in Cultivation when consumed.
Both Cui Wuran and the grey-haired old man were eloquent speakers. During the meal, they frequently toasted, and the bearded man's proud demeanor gradually eased, and he occasionally joined in the conversation with others.
"It seems you three were discussing the Soul Burying Abyss earlier? Has something happened there again?" Cui Wuran asked after having the waitstaff clear the dishes from the table.
Yuan Ming's heart stirred; he had also heard of this place.
The Soul Burying Abyss was a special area deep in the Black Wind Desert, noticeably lower in elevation compared to its surroundings, almost resembling a vast and deep abyss at first glance.
There, the Black Wind occurred frequently, home to numerous unusual demon insects and rumored to contain other dangers. Even Core Formation Stage cultivators dared not assure their safety if they ventured in, hence it was named "Soul Burying Abyss" by cultivators of the Black Wind Desert.
"It's nothing major—several months ago, someone saw dense black vapor rising near the Soul Burying Abyss. It covered a vast area and shot up into the sky, taking a long time to dissipate," explained the grey-haired old man.
"Could such an odd occurrence be just a rumor?" Cui Wuran asked.
"This was no rumor. The black vapor persisted for half a day before it disappeared, seen by many cultivators with their own eyes, there's no falsehood in it," said Gu Sanniang, her voice deep and rough like an old cow's.
"Since Fellow Daoist Gu says so, it must be true. But I wonder, could it signify the advent of some treasure?" mused Cui Wuran, stroking his chin.
"It's hard to say. With a place like Soul Burying Abyss, aside from Core Formation elders, who would dare to explore it recklessly? Even if it truly were a treasure, it's irrelevant to us Loose Cultivators," stated the black-robed young man.
"Such an anomaly is indeed bizarre, just not sure if the Five Thunder Sect, True Gang Sect, and Black Desert Alliance have sent anyone to investigate it," continued Cui Wuran.
The group chatted casually, occasionally discussing their Cultivation experiences. Everyone present had personal insights into Cultivation, and after exchanging views, they all felt they had gained much.
Yuan Ming shared insights on the wood attribute cultivation methods and received some tips on late-stage Foundation Establishment from Gu Sanniang, feeling the trip was especially worthwhile.
As evening approached, their enthusiasm only increased, and they finally got to the main topic—discussing the exchange meeting.
However, with only six people present, it felt insufficient. Cui Wuran proposed inviting more Fellow Daoists.
After the earlier exchanges, everyone became more familiar with each other, and their guardedness lessened. They immediately used Communication Talismans to call others.
Soon, seven or eight more cultivators joined, and the exchange meeting officially began.
All the attendees, except for Yuan Ming, came prepared.
The grey-haired old man produced a rare Breakthrough Pill, aiding in increasing the likelihood of breakthroughs during cultivation bottlenecks, effective even for Foundation Establishment cultivators.
The black-robed young man's trade item was a damaged top-grade magical tool with power surpassing that of top-grade magical tools, albeit with a limited number of uses.
A cultivator called by Gu Sanniang from a small sect presented a piece of Bitter Tung Wood capable of refining top-grade magical tools.
The other participants also brought out items of significant value, none of which were useless.
Yuan Ming used ten sticks of Purple Mysterious Incense and two pieces of demon beast materials to trade with a newcomer for two stones imbued with abundant power of thunder and lightning.
He did not intend to cultivate a Thunder Attribute Magical Artifact; it was meant for Lei Yu.
The climate of the Black Wind Desert was dry, hardly seeing half a drop of rain, providing no thunder and lightning energy for Lei Yu to absorb. Lei Yu's cultivation had been stagnant for a long time.
When it was Yuan Ming's turn, he hesitated briefly before placing three items on the table, consisting of a tan-colored armor, a curved, purple spiked stinger, and a green stone surrounded by mist-like green light.
The yellow armor was the outer shell of a Second-level Middle Stage Rock-piercing Armor, while the purple spikes were from the stinger of a Second Rank Upper Stage Purple Patterned Scorpion, both of which Hua Zhi had obtained after hunting demon beasts in the Black Wind Desert.
The green ore was called Songtao Stone and was one of the top-grade spiritual materials in Zuo Qinghui's storage magic tool.
All three materials emitted impressive spiritual energy fluctuations, attracting the attention of everyone present.
"Haha, Fellow Daoist Yuan really keeps his cards close to his chest. May I know what you wish to exchange these for?" the elder with the surname Qu asked.
"I wish to exchange these three materials for a piece of information," Yuan Ming said.
"What information does Fellow Daoist Yuan seek?" Gu Sanniang asked, her eyes fixed on the Songtao Stone as she was planning to refine a wood attribute magical artifact and could use this stone.
"Something practical, either a method to assist in Core Formation or information on obtaining such a method. If it exceeds the value of these three spiritual materials, I can compensate with additional spirit stones," Yuan Ming said.
Although the Soul Pill Secret Technique could increase the chances of Core Formation by fifty percent, his talent was truly not outstanding, and to possibly enhance the success rate, he had to seek other methods.
While speaking, Yuan Ming spread his Divine Sense, closely observing the expressions of all those present.
All people here were Foundation Establishment Cultivators from various places and circles, and it was possible that some of them might have come across such secret techniques.
He did not actually expect anyone to provide a method to assist in Core Formation, but if anyone showed an unusual expression, he could use the Black Incense Possession and imprint a Soul Seal to dig out the corresponding information.
The crowd exchanged glances, silent for a moment, with no unusual expressions on their faces.
Yuan Ming furrowed his brows, looking towards Gu Sanniang and a newly arrived youth with red hair.
Both individuals had reached the Late Foundation Establishment stage and would likely start paying attention to methods that could aid in breaking through to the Core Formation Stage if they intended to advance.
"Don't look at me, Fellow Daoist Yuan. With my poor natural aptitude, accumulating to my current level through elixirs, I no longer have any potential for advancement, let alone aspire to reach the Core Formation Stage," Gu Sanniang said with a wry smile and a shake of her head.
The red-haired youth merely sipped his tea quietly, ignoring Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming paused briefly, about to retrieve his materials.
"I have two methods here; Fellow Daoist Yuan might want to take a look," a voice suddenly came from the side, it was Cui Wuran.
"Fellow Daoist Cui has methods?" Yuan Ming's face showed surprise.
The other people in the room looked his way as well.
"I must declare beforehand, these two methods were obtained by chance, one of them is fairly reliable, but the authenticity of the other has not been verified, and I cannot guarantee its effectiveness," Cui Wuran said as he took out a white Jade Scroll.
"One reliable method is already enough," Yuan Ming said joyfully.
Upon hearing this, Cui Wuran wrapped the item in mana and sent it over.
The eyes of others were fixed on the Jade Scroll, all filled with longing.
Although the hope of reaching Core Formation was faint for the vast majority of Foundation Establishment Cultivators, if there was even a slight chance, no one would want to miss advancing further.
At that moment, a mana-conjured red palm suddenly stretched from the side and snatched the Jade Scroll.
"What are you doing, Fellow Daoist Wen?" Yuan Ming's expression darkened as he looked towards the owner of the red palm, who was the red-haired youth.The full series lives on My Virtual Library Empire (*).
"This secret technique for assisting Core Formation intrigues me as well. What do you say to letting me join this transaction?" the red-haired youth said with a smile, projecting his Divine Sense towards the Jade Scroll.
Yuan Ming's eyes suddenly turned cold, and a blood-colored blade light shot out, severing the red palm with a slash.
The Jade Scroll was also enveloped in the blade light and flew back. The Divine Sense emitted by the red-haired youth was smashed by an intense bloody aura when it encountered the blood light.
"This transaction was already settled between Fellow Daoist Cui and me. If you too desire these two Core Formation secret techniques, you may discuss it with Fellow Daoist Cui," Yuan Ming said calmly.
The red-haired youth's eyes turned chilly, and a dark glow flashed in his palm where a black long whip appeared, his arm flicked.
The black long whip lengthened in the wind and crossed several meters in an instant, coiling towards the white Jade Scroll.
"Top-grade magical tool!" someone in the room murmured, the expressions of others becoming slightly serious.
Yuan Ming remained expressionless, his fingers outstretched as the white Jade Scroll continued to fly back.
The blood-colored blade light shot out again, instantly striking the central part of the black long whip where the mana was weakest. An ordinary cultivator might not notice this, but Yuan Ming's Divine Sense was exceptionally powerful. With just a sweep, he understood every aspect of the black long whip as if he were reading the lines on his hand.
With a light "snap," the black long whip was knocked backward, spinning back towards the red-haired youth.
The blood light also revealed its true form, the Blood Transformation Saber, emitting a malevolent and bloody aura along the whip, transferring into the body of the red-haired youth.
The red-haired youth's muscles and veins twitched in pain, his internal qi-blood churning intensely, almost causing him to vomit from the extreme discomfort.
The expression on the youth's face became fiercely threatening. The black long whip suddenly surged with a layer of black flames, releasing a powerful chilling air that burst forth in an instant.

chapters.title: Chapter 340 - 317: The 2nd Method
chapters.content:
"Fellow Daoist Wen, please stop!" Cui Wuran exclaimed in alarm, flinging his sleeves and releasing several rays of white light into his surroundings, spreading open a white barrier light screen within the private room as he shouted.
The red-haired youth, however, turned a deaf ear, his eyes faintly glowing with a blood-red hue as if he had lost his rationality. With a single sweep of his hand, a black long whip shattered the table and then lashed towards Yuan Ming. The several individuals near Yuan Ming were also affected by the black flames on the whip, panicking and hastily dodging backward in shock and anger.
Yuan Ming frowned; this person really was relentless. With a flick of his sleeve.
The Blood Blade glowed with blood light, shooting out once more as a streak of blood, flashing in front of the red-haired youth with speed doubled from before.
The red-haired youth was greatly startled. His Body Protection Technique operated rapidly, and countless black flames spontaneously erupted, enveloping his body within them. A green shadow flashed in his hand, and he produced a bamboo-basket-like magical tool, attempting to shield against the Blood Transformation Saber.
However, the Blood Transformation Saber suddenly blurred and vanished. Nine blood-colored Flying Knives appeared around his body—above, below, left, right—all exuding a fierce aura and thrusting down mercilessly at the same time.
The red-haired youth was terrified, uncertain which Flying Knife to cover with the bamboo-basket magical tool.
In that moment of hesitation, he lost his last chance. The nine Flying Knives pierced his body; the black fire screen had no effect at all, easily breached by them.
"Ah!" The red-haired youth let out a wail of despair as all the black flames dissipated from his body. He toppled to the ground, a bloody hole pierced through his chest.
A force ten times stronger than before and full of sinister energy rapidly spread throughout his body. Wherever it passed, the youth's body became numb and powerless, immobilized.
The spectators inside the room all wore expressions of shock and dismay, silent for a long while.
Yuan Ming dispelled the Soul Power wrapped around the Blood Transformation Saber, dispelling the illusion. The nine Blood Blades merged into one, and with a flash of blood light, flew back into his sleeve.Spotanerror?VisittheoriginalpostonM&VLEMPY&R.
In the Inner City of Xiansha, it was strictly forbidden to fight using magic, let alone kill. Yuan Ming did not want to invite serious trouble. Otherwise, even without activating the Blood Transformation Saber, just the saber's Blood Poison alone could easily claim the red-haired youth's life.
Yuan Ming ignored the red-haired youth and continued to immerse his Divine Sense into the Jade Scroll to explore it.
"Fellow Daoist Wen!" Cui Wuran rushed over quickly, helping up the red-haired youth.
The young man's face surfaced with a layer of blood-colored halo, seemingly employing a secret technique, and quickly regained mobility in his limbs.
"Your strength is formidable, I, Wen, admit defeat. We'll settle this account another time!" He broke free from Cui Wuran's support and took out a green talisman, sticking it on the wound on his chest before stumbling away.
Yuan Ming paid no attention to this man, his Divine Sense still probing the contents of the Jade Scroll, indifferent to the affairs of others.
One of the two methods recorded in the Jade Scroll was the Transplanting Technique, quite profound, which could transfer a Third-level Demon Beast's Demon Core into one's Dantian. Once successfully refined, it could act as a substitute for a Golden Core.
This secret technique had many restrictions. First, the attributes of the Demon Core had to match the cultivator's perfectly; any deviation would make success impossible. Secondly, during the refining process, one would need to endure the influence of the residual soul of the demon beast within the demon core.
If one could withstand these two trials, there was a seventy to eighty percent chance of successfully forming a Core.
However, a Golden Core formed through such a shortcut differed significantly from a true Golden Core, lacking life extension effects, and also significantly limited the possibility of future breakthroughs.
Compared to these downsides, a Golden Core formed via the Transplanting Technique had one advantage: the cultivator could perfectly inherit the power contained within the demon core, and even perform the Innate Divine Ability of the demon beast.
The second secret technique was relatively standard, mentioning a Washing Elixir Spirit Liquid that could cleanse a cultivator's Dantian, purifying the Dan Tian Power and facilitating a smoother Core Formation.
However, the Jade Scroll did not specify where to obtain this Washing Elixir Spirit Liquid, vaguely mentioning that it had been seen in Purple Thunder City more than a decade ago.
"Purple Thunder City..." Yuan Ming muttered to himself.
Purple Thunder City is the largest city controlled by Zhao Country in the Black Wind Desert area, governed by the Five Thunder Sect, not only is it more than ten times larger than Xiansha City, its prosperity is beyond comparison.
"Fellow Daoist Cui, you just said, which of these two methods is reliable, and which one has not been verified?" Yuan Ming looked at Cui Wuran and asked through a spiritual transmission.
"The more reliable one is the second method with the Washing Elixir Spirit Liquid; I heard about it from Purple Thunder City. As for the Transplanting Technique, I got it from a corpse and have not verified it," Cui Wuran replied through spiritual transmission.
No sooner had the words fallen than he transmitted over an apology, "Fellow Daoist Yuan, my apologies for the incident just now. That Fellow Daoist Wen is usually quite amiable; I do not know why he lost his temper today. Please forgive his outburst."
"It's nothing. Can Fellow Daoist Cui tell me more about the origin of the Transplanting Technique?" Yuan Ming inquired further.
"Of course. Several years ago, while I was hunting Demon Insects in the Black Wind Desert, I stumbled across a rotten corpse underground. The corpse's finger had a Storage Ring, inside of which there was a cultivation journal that mentioned this Transplanting Secret Technique," Cui Wuran transmitted.
Yuan Ming remained silent. The second method required verification at Purple Thunder City, while the first could not be traced or verified at all. The biggest concern was the inability to make further breakthroughs afterwards, which was unacceptable to him.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, do you not believe me? I can swear upon my Heart Demon that everything I've just said is true. Should there be any falsehood, I am willing to suffer from Heart Demon's harassment and have my Cultivation completely destroyed, relegating me to a mere mortal!" Cui Wuran solemnly sent through telepathy.
Upon hearing Cui Wuran's oath, Yuan Ming fell silent once more, then collected the Jade Scroll and handed over the three spiritual materials on the table to Cui Wuran.
The trading soon continued, but due to the astonishing Divine Skills Yuan Ming had just displayed, the atmosphere became far more subdued than before.
Yuan Ming remained silent and did not make any more moves.
After half an hour, the exchange meeting ended swiftly, and the attendees bid their farewells.
As Yuan Ming stood up to leave, he was stopped by Cui Wuran's telepathic message, mentioning some matters to discuss.
"Fellow Daoist Cui, what is the matter?" Yuan Ming asked.
Cui Wuran waved his hand to cast a Barrier, then took out the three materials he had just received and pushed them back toward Yuan Ming.
"What do you mean by this, Fellow Daoist Cui?" Yuan Ming asked after a moment of silence.
"During our transaction, had I refused these three materials, it might have affected the exchange meeting. Both methods I mentioned didn't require much effort on my part to acquire, how could I accept these precious materials from you? Besides, you and I are old friends. Consider it a gift from me to congratulate you in advance on your Core Formation," Cui Wuran said with a chuckle.
Surprised by these words, Yuan Ming pushed the three materials back and said, "Fellow Daoist Cui jests. How can I, Yuan, accept such precious secret techniques for assisting in Core Formation without offering anything in return? If you have something else to say, please speak frankly."
"Since you have noticed, I will speak directly. Indeed, I have a favor to ask of you, and these three spiritual materials are just a token of our meeting. There will be an additional reward of five thousand Spirit Stones upon successful completion," Cui Wuran said with an embarrassed smile before becoming serious again.
"Five thousand Spirit Stones! Could you first tell me what the task is?" Yuan Ming inquired, raising an eyebrow.
"It's nothing complicated—just to hunt down two demon beasts. With your formidable strength, Fellow Daoist Yuan, you are well-suited for this mission," Cui Wuran explained.
"If it's just dealing with two ordinary demon beasts, you would be able to handle them yourself, Fellow Daoist Cui. Even if others were to be invited along, it would not warrant such a high price of five thousand Spirit Stones. Therefore, the beasts you wish to kill wouldn't happen to be two third-level demon beasts, would they?" Yuan Ming asked, looking intently at Cui Wuran.
"The task is to exterminate a pair of Second Rank Upper Stage Red Gold Centipedes. Their strength is extraordinary, and the combined power of a mated pair is enough to make their combat prowess surge, certainly no less formidable than a third-level demon beast. However, you don't need to worry, Fellow Daoist Yuan. It's not just the two of us on this mission; there are several Foundation Establishment Cultivators involved. With the power of the Formation, we'll be able to deal with these demon insects without much danger," said Cui Wuran.
"Red Gold Centipedes!" A trace of intrigue flashed across Yuan Ming's eyes.
Red Gold Centipedes are a type of Gold Attribute demon insect capable of devouring metals; with exceptionally durable bodies, even top-grade magical tools struggle to cause harm. They are among the most formidable second-level demon insects in the Black Wind Desert.
In recent times, Yuan Ming had been in contact with Master Lu on several occasions, and he had mentioned more than once his desire for a pair of Red Gold Centipede bodies to refine a set of special Formation tools.
However, Red Gold Centipedes were extremely rare, last seen over a decade ago. Despite Master Lu offering a bounty for them in several Scatter Alliances, the task had remained unfulfilled to date. Unexpectedly, Cui Wuran had managed to locate traces of the Red Gold Centipedes.
This mission seemed worth attempting. If he could acquire the bodies of Red Gold Centipedes, he would be able to do Master Lu a favor, thus facilitating future requests for him to refine Formation tools.
Even disregarding Master Lu's interests, the mission itself was worth undertaking, with the reward of five thousand Spirit Stones being quite tempting.
Currently, Yuan Ming needed vast resources, as "Zuo Qinghui," controlled by his soul splitting, required the same amount of cultivation as two Foundation Establishment Cultivators combined. His supply of Spirit Stones was dwindling, and the revenue from Hua Zhi hunting demon insects was hardly sufficient.
"Is this mission issued by Earth Spirit Pavilion's Master Lu?" Yuan Ming inquired.
"Master Lu? Of course not. This is a mission entrusted by the City Lord Mansion, supposedly for hunting on behalf of an elder of the Core Formation Stage from the Five Thunder Sect. They also provided the location of the Red Gold Centipedes. The City Lord Mansion has other obligations and couldn't spare experts, so they have turned to us Loose Cultivators to carry out the task," Cui Wuran clarified with a shake of his head.
"Five Thunder Sect!" Yuan Ming's gaze grew slightly serious.
The region where Xiansha City was located fell under the influence of Zhao Country, with the Black Wind Desert's mine resources being plentiful. Major Cultivation Sects of Zhao Country all had stakes here, and Xiansha City was no exception, being controlled by a Cultivation Sect named Yellow Sand Sect.
As the premier Cultivation Sect of Zhao Country, Five Thunder Sect naturally would not overlook the lucrative Black Wind Desert, dispatching numerous elders and disciples to reside there.
Due to the chaotic and disorderly nature of the Black Wind Desert, Five Thunder Sect also enforced a ruthless rule, annihilating anyone or any force that dared to challenge their authority.
With the might of Five Thunder Sect and their iron-fisted policies, they had established a reputation far surpassing those outside. Within the territories of Zhao Country, Five Thunder Sect was akin to an Emperor, whose commands were heeded by dozens of underground cities.
Yuan Ming stayed quiet. If Five Thunder Sect was aiming to hunt down two Red Gold Centipedes, even if he succeeded, the bodies would not end up in his hands. Should he forsake this opportunity?

chapters.title: Chapter 341 - 318: Hunting
chapters.content:
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, do you really have no interest? This task is quite rare, and I only got the chance to invite others to it because I'm acquainted with a steward from the City Lord Mansion. Don't miss this opportunity," Cui Wuran said, hastily trying to persuade Yuan Ming when he saw the expression on his face.
"Thank you for the consideration, Fellow Daoist Cui, but I've just made a breakthrough to the late stage of Foundation Establishment, and my realm is not yet stable. I must, regrettably, decline your kind offer. However, I have two friends whose cultivation might be slightly inferior to mine, but their Divine Skills are not to be underestimated. Together, their strength is no less than mine. Could they possibly take on this task? As for the reward, they would be content with a total of five thousand Spirit Stones upon the successful completion of the hunt," Yuan Ming replied after a moment of contemplation.
"This..." Cui Wuran showed a look of difficulty.
"If it's inconvenient for you, then let's forget about it. Please accept these three materials," Yuan Ming said.
"Since Fellow Daoist Yuan has spoken so highly of them, these two friends must be extraordinary. I will mention it to that steward from the City Lord Mansion. Wait for my message," Cui Wuran took out a Communication Talisman and handed it to Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming naturally agreed.
The two of them made small talk for a bit and soon parted ways.
Yuan Ming returned to his residence and continued to meditate. Not even two hours later, he received a reply from Cui Wuran. The steward from the City Lord Mansion had agreed and asked to meet at the city gate entrance early the next morning.
"Master, when you mentioned the two who would take your place, were you referring to me and Vajra? I really don't want to act together with that smelly monkey," Hua Zhi complained somewhat discontentedly.
"Vajra is currently in seclusion inside and doesn't look like he will be emerging any time soon. This time you'll be acting with Zuo Qinghui," Yuan Ming said.
"Zuo Qinghui? He is barely acceptable, certainly better than that smelly monkey," Hua Zhi muttered to herself after she hesitated, communicating through her spiritual intelligence.
Over the past year, she had been hunting various demon insects non-stop and her strength had improved rapidly. She was already nearing the second rank upper stage, her strength surpassing that of the current "Zuo Qinghui" by quite a bit.
This chapter was made possible by the community at *.
...
The next morning, not far from the City Lord Mansion, Cui Wuran saw Yuan Ming's two friends on an open ground. One was a thin and tall figure wrapped in a black robe, and the other was naturally Zuo Qinghui.
At this moment, Zuo Qinghui had grown out his hair and beard, covering most of his face. In addition, with changes in his aura and his complexion, even his direct disciples would not necessarily recognize him immediately.
As for the figure in the black robe, it was naturally Hua Zhi.
"The two of you must be Fellow Daoist Hua and Fellow Daoist Zuo, right? It's a pleasure to meet you. Allow me to introduce you, this is Manager Liao from the City Lord Mansion," Cui Wuran introduced the dark-skinned, short, and stout middle-aged man beside him.
Despite his short stature and hands clasped behind his back, the aura he exuded was no trivial matter.
"Hehe, friends recommended by Fellow Daoist Cui indeed aren't ordinary people. Fellow Daoist Hua's strength almost seems to be reaching the late stage of Foundation Establishment, doesn't it? And Fellow Daoist Zuo also has quite impressive cultivation. With the aid of the two of you, it seems the task will not be much of an issue," Manager Liao said with a laugh, showing no airs about him.
"You flatter us, Fellow Daoist Liao," Zuo Qinghui politely returned a sentence.
Hua Zhi stood in silence on the side, just nodding her head slightly without greeting the other two.
"Fellow Daoist Liao, Fellow Daoist Cui, Fellow Daoist Hua is mute by nature, not disrespectful to you. Please don't take offense," Zuo Qinghui explained.
"No problem at all," Manager Liao glanced at Hua Zhi, raising his eyebrows slightly as he spoke.
"When do we depart?" Zuo Qinghui asked.
"We're still waiting for two other Daoists to arrive. Please wait a moment," Cui Wuran said before Manager Liao could speak.
Zuo Qinghui agreed and, along with Hua Zhi, stood aside.
The two others quickly arrived, and to Yuan Ming, both were familiar faces. They were Gu Sanniang and the Luo Sibearded big man from the Fire Origin Sect who called himself Shi Chuan, whom he had met at the exchange meeting the day before.
Zuo Qinghui's expression shifted slightly. It seemed that Cui Wuran's invitation to several people to the exchange meeting yesterday had another deeper intent.
After Cui Wuran made brief introductions, Manager Liao greeted both of them quite cordially.
"Now that everyone has arrived, let's set off," Manager Liao said, raising his hand and throwing out a phantom shadow. As it caught the wind, it transformed into a snow-white jade Flying Boat. He then leaped onto it with a flicker of his figure.
Cui Wuran and the other four quickly followed, climbing aboard the Flying Boat.
The Flying Boat rose into the air and turned into a white rainbow that shot off, vanishing into the distant sky.
Manager Liao led the five towards the northwest, flying for a full day and night before stopping, descending into a desert canyon.
"Fellow Daoist Liao, it seems we are no longer within the territory of Zhao Country, correct?" Shi Chuan looked around at the landscape and asked cautiously.
"It seems we've already reached Qin Country?" Gu Sanniang also spoke.
Both Zuo Qinghui and Hua Zhi looked around without saying anything.
"Hehe, you both have good eyesight; indeed, this is already Qin Country's domain. However, it's only the outer area, so we won't encounter people from the Cultivation Sects of Qin Country," Manager Liao said with a chuckle.
"I hope so," Shi Chuan said slowly, neither affirming nor denying it.
The Fire Origin Sect had two cities within the Black Wind Desert, and because of disputes over mine veins, there had been quite a few conflicts with the Cultivation Sects of Qin Country.
If they were to encounter Cultivators from the Sects of Qin Country here, it might not be a problem for others, but it would be a great trouble for him.
"Fellow travelers, you've all had a long journey. Rest here for a while. The City Lord Mansion has also invited a few other fellow Daoists to meet here; they should arrive shortly," Manager Liao said.
Shi Chuan didn't say anything and went to sit down on the side while Gu Sanniang hesitated for a moment before sitting down not too far from Shi Chuan.
Zuo Qinghui and Hua Zhi walked to another side, whereas Cui Wuran and Manager Liao stood where they were, idly chatting on and off.
They waited for the better part of the day until, as the sun set, three streams of tunneling light finally appeared in the distant sky. They quickly flew into the valley and descended, revealing two men and a woman.
The men were dressed in red robes and looked similar, apparently brothers, with their Cultivation reaching mid-stage Foundation Establishment.
The woman appeared to be in her mid-twenties, with arching eyebrows and a delicate nose, a full figure, and skin so smooth it seemed water could be squeezed from it. Her eyes were moist and seductive, half-open and half-closed, as if a single glance could hook one's soul away.
The aura emanating from this woman had already reached the late stage of Foundation Establishment and her attire was quite similar to that of Manager Liao.
"Manager Yue, you've finally arrived. Any later and we might have delayed important matters," Manager Liao said with a cold voice, seemingly in some discord with the voluptuous woman.
"Red Gold Centipedes are active during the day and return to their nest to rest at night. Now is the perfect time," Manager Yue replied without taking offense, instead smiling sweetly, causing the men present to be somewhat dazed.
Hua Zhi was naturally unaffected, and Zuo Qinghui's cultivation of the Heart Cleansing Technique was profound enough that he too remained unaffected by the woman's charm.
Upon hearing this, Manager Liao's expression stiffened.
"Manager Liao has invited so many fellow Daoists here. Very good. I, Yue Rong, will rely on the strength of all the fellow Daoists here for today's matter," Yue Rong said as she politely greeted the group brought by Manager Liao, seemingly overshadowing the host.
"Of course, of course," Shi Chuan replied with a hearty smile, the first to respond.
Yue Rong gave Shi Chuan a slight smile and, with a wave of her hand, a large yellow sand boat appeared on the ground in front of them.
"We are not far from the nest of the Red Gold Centipedes. Flying escape might be detected, so let us take this earth-riding flying boat there," Yue Rong said as she boarded the sand boat.
Seeing this, the others also jumped onboard.
Manager Liao's expression turned somewhat unsightly, but he did not argue with Yue Rong and boarded the sand boat as well.
Shi Chuan, seemingly attracted by Yue Rong's beauty, started conversing with her as soon as he got on the boat.
Yue Rong chatted and laughed with Shi Chuan while also propelling the sand boat forward.
The yellow sand boat moved forward slowly at first but gradually increased speed, not much slower than flying escape, and soon reached the vicinity of a small stone mountain.
"The nest of those two Red Gold Centipedes is right beneath this Small Stone Mountain. These demon insects are intelligent with keen senses, so fellow Daoists, please don't carelessly use your Divine Sense, lest they detect it," Yue Rong sent the message telepathically.
All nodded in agreement.
Yue Rong parked the sand boat in a concealed location nearby and took out a set of yellow Array Flags and Array Plates, quickly starting to set up an Array with practiced movements, indicating that she was an Array Master.
"Is this the Houtu Two-Phase Array?" Zuo Qinghui recognized the Array after watching for a while.
"Oh, Fellow Daoist Zuo is also versed in Formations?" Yue Rong looked over and smiled.
"To say I'm versed would be too much. I just have some knowledge," Zuo Qinghui replied calmly, as if he had not seen Yue Rong's soul-enticing eyes.
A hint of surprise flashed in Yue Rong's eyes, but she continued to set up the Array and quickly finished.
"What a skillful technique, Miss Yue. With the Houtu Two-Phase Array as our support, those two Red Gold Centipedes, no matter how formidable, are not to be feared," Shi Chuan said, trying to ingratiating himself.
"Fellow Daoist Shi is too kind," Yue Rong replied with a graceful smile.
"Now that the Array is set up, let's proceed as we previously discussed. We'll divide into two groups: I, along with Fellow Daoist Cui and the Wang brothers, will lure the Red Gold Centipedes here. The rest of you prepare to provide support here," Manager Liao said.
"Luring the Red Gold Centipedes is quite dangerous, Manager Liao, you..." Yue Rong was surprised and hesitant about Manager Liao's offer to take on the task.
"When it comes to controlling the Houtu Two-Phase Array, I am no match for you. It's better for you to control it. Fellow Daoist Cui has a Magic Artifact for Earth Tunneling, and the Wang brothers practice Earth Attribute Cultivation Techniques and are also skilled in the Joint Attack Skill. The four of us going is the most suitable," Manager Liao said decisively.
"Manager Liao is right. We'll trouble you then," Yue Rong replied slowly.
Without further ado, Manager Liao gestured to the other three and they stealthily approached Small Stone Mountain.
Yue Rong activated the Array, and streams of sand-like yellow light poured out, enveloping everyone present.
The yellow light of the Array blended in perfectly with the surrounding sandy terrain, virtually indistinguishable at first glance, emitting no trace of breath.
No one could use their Divine Sense to investigate the surroundings; only Yue Rong sat with her eyes closed, seemingly sensing the outside through the Array.
Time ticked by, and a quarter of an hour quickly passed.
"They're coming; everyone, get ready!" Yue Rong abruptly opened her eyes and said.
Upon hearing this, everyone inside the Array became alert, each conjuring their Magic Artifacts, looking around vigilantly, and preparing for the confrontation.

chapters.title: Chapter 342 - 319: Prestigious Sand Pirates
chapters.content:
A few breaths later, Yue Rong took out a yellow Array Flag and shook it fiercely toward a certain direction.
The Houtu Two-Phase Array suddenly disbanded, revealing the situation outside.
Manager Liao and the pair of red-robed brothers were each activating their Flying Artifacts, shooting towards this place from the direction of Small Stone Mountain; all three bore visible bloodstains, seemingly not lightly wounded—especially Manager Liao, who appeared somewhat unsteady. Cui Wuran, however, was nowhere to be seen.
Behind them, a towering cloud of dust pursued relentlessly, within which blinding golden light flickered intermittently.
The three men and the trail of dust just happened to pass near the Houtu Two-Phase Array.
"Now!"
With a delicate shout from Yue Rong, she unleashed a silver spiked Magic Artifact that she hurled into the midst of the dust.
Including Zuo Qinghui and Hua Zhi, the others also launched their attacks, their diverse Magic Artifacts striking harshly, tearing apart the drifting dust to reveal a vicious centipede about seven or eight zhang long and as thick as a water bucket.
This creature seemed as if it were cast from gold, each segment of its body glinting brightly; its hundred legs were sharp and ferocious, making a clanging sound and sending sparks flying as it scraped across the ground.
Clang clang clang!
Everyone's Magic Artifacts struck the Red Gold Centipede, sending sparks flying in all directions, but they failed to inflict any significant damage on it, at most leaving behind some marks.
The Red Gold Centipede, inflicted with considerable pain, abandoned chase of Manager Liao and his companions and turned to pounce toward the group, its mouth spraying out a stream of dark green poison fog.
The Magic Artifacts flying head-on were touched by this fog and immediately became erratic, tilting in all directions, and a dark green layer covered their surfaces. The spiritual energy they lost caused them to plummet to the ground, startling everyone.
"Do not let this poison fog touch your body," Yue Rong said solemnly, urging the yellow Command Flag in her hand.
The nearby ground rumbled, and a glow like yellow sand reappeared to form a thick barrier of yellow light.
The dark green poison fog fell upon the light barrier and made a sizzling sound, as if a green giant wave had crashed against rocks, the vapor rolling away in all directions.
But before everyone could even take a breath of relief, the figure of Manager Liao appeared above the Houtu Two-Phase Array, his previously unsteady form now changed.
He flung out several yellow Array Flags, and with a flash, they floated around the Houtu Two-Phase Array, forming a strange array.
As several spells flickered and descended upon these Array Flags, the flags trembled, flashing with various colors of light. Beams connected, forming a peculiar Array that encompassed the Houtu Two-Phase Array below.
Several colorful beams of spirit light fell from the peculiar Array onto various parts of the Houtu Two-Phase Array below, causing the yellow light barrier to shake violently, appearing on the verge of collapsing.
"Liao Zhong! What are you doing?" Yue Rong's voice was a mix of shock and fury. She flicked her sleeve, and seven or eight Array Flags shot towards various parts of the Array.
"Be careful of your footing, Yue Daoist, retreat quickly!" Zuo Qinghui suddenly shouted coldly, a Blood-red Cylinder appearing in his palm and he launched a blood-colored bullet the size of an egg toward the ground behind her.
However, the ground there slightly bulged, and seven or eight Black Needles shot out first, striking Yue Rong's legs.
Yue Rong let out a muffled grunt and fell to the ground with a "thump," the seven or eight Array Flags scattering their light and dropping to the ground.
The blood-colored bullet vanished into the ground in a flash, and almost simultaneously, a scream came from underground.
At this moment, the Houtu Two-Phase Array completely collapsed, and the Red Gold Centipede once again spat out a swath of dark green poison fog that enveloped the figures of the five people.
A furious voice from Yue Rong emerged from within the poison fog, as three yellow Light Pillars shot out, forming a '品' shape.
A tremendous surge of yellow light erupted from the ground, creating a strong storm that swept away all of the poison fog in an instant.
The five people within the Array became visible, their energy depleted, with patches of poison on their cheeks, arms, and other places, clearly having been poisoned by the Red Gold Centipede's venom.
The situation was worst for Yue Rong, with seven or eight dark needle holes on her legs, from which the black venom rapidly spread.
But the woman was remarkably resilient and still managed to stand, clenching her teeth.
Around them, seven or eight Cultivators had appeared out of nowhere, all in the Foundation Establishment Stage, wearing yellow garments, surrounding the group in the center with mocking eyes.
Manager Liao, the Wang brothers, and Cui Wuran stood outside the encirclement, clearly in league with the people in the yellow robes.
Cui Wuran's right arm was cleanly cut off at the shoulder—the cut was even, revealing he had severed it himself. His eyes bore resentment mixed with panic as he looked at Zuo Qinghui.
His right arm was hit by the blood-colored bullet underground and withered away at an alarming rate. If he had not acted swiftly to cut off his arm, by now his entire body would have turned into pus and blood.
The red-haired youth with the surname Wen from yesterday's exchange meeting was among them too, his gaze scanning the five people inside the Array, seemingly looking for something, but finally, he retracted his gaze in disappointment.
Yue Rong and the others felt their hearts sink. At this point, it was clear to anyone that they had fallen into someone's trap.
Zuo Qinghui, however, was not as worried as the others. From beneath the ground, Hua Zhi had already sent up a thin vine to draw out the potent poison from his body.
The poison patches on his body quickly receded, though those on the exposed parts such as hands and cheeks were intentionally left, to deceive the others.
Zuo Qinghui's gaze swept over the yellow-robed men surrounding them, finally settling on the nearby Red Gold Centipede.
The Red Gold Centipede crawled alongside, not only did it avoid clashing with those yellow-robed people, but it also had a sense of joining hands against a common enemy.
One hundred miles away, atop a sand dune, a yellow figure sat quietly cross-legged. It was indeed Yuan Ming.
He was dressed in a yellow robe with a hood, adorned with a scale-like pattern that completely concealed his presence.
This yellow robe was refined from the skin of a species of lizard in the Black Wind Desert, capable of concealing one's aura. Although it wasn't as effective as the grey cloak that Xi Ying had given to him, it was still quite impressive.
He had originally planned to let Zuo Qinghui and Hua Zhi follow the people from the City Lord Mansion to hunt the Red Gold Centipede. He would follow from behind, looking for an opportunity to snatch away the Red Gold Centipede's carcass. Unexpectedly, things took a drastic turn, leading to the current situation.
"It seems that this mission has been a deception from the start, fortunately, there really is a Red Gold Centipede," Yuan Ming pondered in his mind.
He rose into the air and summoned the White Jade Shuttle, flying towards the direction of Small Stone Mountain.
...
"Liao Zhong, what exactly do you intend to do?" Yue Rong looked at Manager Liao and said coldly.
Manager Liao watched his nose and his nose watched his heart, as if he didn't hear Yue Rong's voice.
"I've long heard that Xiansha City Lord Mansion has a Manager surnamed Yue, naturally charming and provocatively seductive. Seeing you today, it really holds true. Brothers, we're in luck today!" A tall man came out from the group, his eyes shooting undisguised lewdness, circling around Yue Rong's body.
This man had a long face and large mouth, incredibly ugly, and most peculiarly, he had a yellow horn growing on his forehead; yet his cultivation was already at the Late Foundation Establishment stage.
The rest of the yellow-robed cultivators let out a burst of boisterous laughter, their gazes fixed on Yue Rong, nearly stripping her with their eyes.
Shi Chuan was furious in his heart but dared not express it.
"Who exactly are you? Although Xiansha City is a small place, the task at hand is commissioned by the Five Thunder Sect; I advise you not to make a grave error," Yue Rong spoke calmly, apparently not hearing the obscenities from the other side.
"Five Thunder Sect? Your cultivators from Zhao Country may fear this name, but to us people from Qin Country, it's worthless," the man with the single horn said disdainfully.
Upon hearing this, Yue Rong's brows furrowed slightly. Even in the Cultivation World of Qin Country, the Five Thunder Sect had a renowned reputation. Even the most lawless evil cultivators and thieves would not dare to be so disrespectful.
These people regarded the Five Thunder Sect as nothing; it was unclear what their backgrounds might be.
"Fellow Daoists, if I have guessed correctly, these individuals should be disciples of the Guiyuan Sect from Qin Country," Gu Sanniang's voice reached the ears of the other four.
"Guiyuan Sect!" Yue Rong and Shi Chuan felt a chill in their hearts.
Zuo Qinghui's eyes also shifted; Guiyuan Sect was the foremost sect of Qin Country, as well as the leading force among the Cultivation forces in the Black Wind Desert. Its strength and influence were no less than that of the Five Thunder Sect of Zhao Country.
"How did Fellow Daoist Gu recognize them?" Yue Rong also operated her Divine Sense to communicate, enveloping only the five of them.
"The Guiyuan Sect excels in the Joint Attack Skill; they have strict rules and a severe hierarchy. Their disciples are brave and good in battle, known for their absolute obedience. I have crossed hands with disciples of the Guiyuan Sect. The positions of these individuals may seem lax, but in fact, they contain mysteries, very much like the Joint Attack Formation of the Guiyuan Sect," Gu Sanniang replied through telepathy.
Zuo Qinghui observed the yellow-robed cultivators upon hearing this. At a glance, their positions seemed haphazard and unordered, but in truth, they held a hidden significance, with the aura of the individuals faintly interconnected, indeed resembling a kind of special Combined Attack Divine Power.
Such observation led to the conclusion that these people were very likely indeed disciples of the Guiyuan Sect.
However, Zuo Qinghui was indifferent to this. Whether these individuals were disciples of the Guiyuan Sect or the Five Thunder Sect, to him, they were the same. His only goal was the Red Gold Centipede.Contentsourcedfrom*–MyVirtualLibraryEmpire.
"So you all are disciples of the Guiyuan Sect, no wonder you don't put the Five Thunder Sect in your eyes. But since when did the distinguished disciples of the Guiyuan Sect become sand pirates? If word of this spreads, I wonder what the senior members of the Guiyuan Sect would think?" Zuo Qinghui stepped forward, his expression composed.
Yue Rong and the others suddenly changed color.
Zuo Qinghui had directly exposed their identities. Wasn't he forcing the opposite side into a position where they might kill to silence them?
"Zuo Qinghui, you're seeking your own death; don't drag us down with you!" Shi Chuan angrily sent a telepathic message.
"Don't panic, the three of you. Just follow my commands, and I have a way to help you escape. I'll first rid you of the extreme poison in your bodies," Zuo Qinghui's voice sounded in the ears of the three.
Yue Rong and the others were startled, then felt a slight pain at the soles of their feet as if something had pricked them.
The extreme poison in their bodies began to converge towards their feet, swiftly being drawn out.
Especially Yue Rong, not only was the Centipede Poison in her sucked away, but the intense poison from the needles in her legs also quickly receded, and her body rapidly recovered, more effective than any Detoxification Elixir.
"Heh, who would've thought that the noble disciples of the Guiyuan Sect would stoop to thievery, how laughable," Yue Rong was inwardly overjoyed, her face showing a mocking smile, laughing lightly.
"Oh, so you have recognized our origin. Now you leave us no choice but to dispose of you, take action!" The man with the single horn's expression darkened as he waved his hand, giving the order.
The nearby yellow-robed cultivators almost moved in unison, stepping forward to press in closer.
"I advise you all not to come any closer for your own good. This compatriot of mine cultivates an Evil Poison Skill, which once unleashed, will cause disaster for all living things within a hundred steps. Haven't you noticed that the air smells somewhat different than before?" Zuo Qinghui pointed to Hua Zhi, who was wrapped up tight, and spoke with a smile.
"Not good, back off!" The man with the single horn was taken aback as he detected a faint fragrance with his nose, his complexion turning pale, and he quickly retreated.
Seeing this, the others, whether they smelled the fragrance or not, all flew backwards.

chapters.title: Chapter 343 - 320 Conspiracy
chapters.content:
"Where do you think you're going!"
Yue Rong pinched a spell with both hands, and the remaining Array Flags of the Houtu Two-Phase Array beneath her burst into dazzling yellow light, forming a vast yellow light circle that enveloped the one-horned man and a tall, thin old man beside him.
At the same time, Gu Sanniang also conjured a golden small axe, which transformed into a large axe shadow about a zhang long, chopping down directly at the one-horned man's head.
The one-horned man suddenly turned around, fluttered his sleeve, and a small green flag flew out. In a whirlwind, it expanded to several zhang wide, and numerous green clouds appeared, supporting the yellow light circle.
A yellow beam as thick as a bowl shot out from the horn on his forehead, colliding with Gu Sanniang's golden large axe.
With a loud "clang," the golden large axe was sent flying, and its sharp edge unexpectedly turned into a grayish-white stone color.
"Petrification Divine Ability!" Gu Sanniang exclaimed with a shiver, hurriedly retracting the large axe for inspection.
The tall, thin old man hurriedly stopped, conjured a dark black short dagger, and with a streak of black light, aimed it at Gu Sanniang.
But just at that moment, the old man's eyes suddenly became dazed, and then swiftly regained clarity.
The black short dagger's direction changed abruptly, lunging towards the lower back of the one-horned man.
The one-horned man sensed the danger and immediately sidestepped, avoiding the short dagger, while a yellow glow rose from his body.
However, a "puff" sound followed as the yellow glow was torn apart, and he felt a chill in his lower back as a pitch-black short spear pierced through his abdomen from the back, with Blood Light suddenly emerging!
All of this occurred in the blink of an eye, and with the proximity being extremely close, even though the one-horned man's Cultivation was slightly higher than the tall, thin old man's, he was still unable to defend against this sneak attack.
"Lin Po, what are you doing?" the one-horned man turned his head in anger, and a beam of yellow light shot out from his horn, piercing through the old man's chest and blossoming into a blood flower as large as a bowl, turning the nearby skin and flesh into grayish-white stone.
Yet, the tall, thin old man seemed to be unaware of the pain, advancing instead of retreating. A flash of white light in his hand revealed seven or eight red talismans, which all broke into pieces after a flash of red light, and seven or eight Fire Birds the size of grinding plates appeared out of nowhere, which were Upper Stage Level 1 Fire Bird Talismans.
The Fire Birds shot out like arrows released from their strings, all hitting the one-horned man who had no chance to dodge given the close distance.
Loud 'boom boom boom' sounds of explosions rang out, and the one-horned man was engulfed by the exploding flames.
"Brother Fang!" The other Guiyuan Sect disciples finally reacted, crying out in shock.
The tall, thin old man did not continue to attack the one-horned man, but instead turned around and dashed straight towards the Red Gold Centipede.
"Stop Lin Po!" the weak voice of the one-horned man came from the midst of the exploding flames.
The other Guiyuan Sect Cultivators, who were originally heading towards the one-horned man, all pounced towards the tall, thin old man upon hearing the command.
However, the ground in front of them suddenly split open, and the figure of Hua Zhi surged out, sweeping two long purple-black Vines covered with purple blossoms from her sleeves like whips.
Sourced directly from *.
A faint fragrance spread, and the Guiyuan Sect Cultivators felt their entire bodies go limp as they drew near; recalling the words of Zuo Qinghui just now, they dodged away as if facing a plague.
Manager Liao, the Wang brothers, and Cui Wuran also tried to come to the aid but were blocked by Yue Rong, Shi Chuan, Zuo Qinghui, and Gu Sanniang. For a while, the mid-air was ablaze with the fierce collision of multi-colored Magic Artifacts and Spells, and Manager Liao and the others were kept at bay.
At this moment, the tall, thin old man had already pounced in front of the Red Gold Centipede, the dark black short dagger aiming for one of the centipede's eyes.
The Red Gold Centipede, furious, spat out a stream of ink-green Poison Liquid engulfing the old man's body.
The old man did not dodge, and his body instantly began to decay rapidly, plummeting downwards.
The Red Gold Centipede opened its mouth wide and bit down on the old man's body, swallowing it whole just like it had swallowed the tall, thin old man before.
Seeing this scene, everyone present was shocked, and the Guiyuan Sect disciples were stupefied.
The flames around the one-horned man had died down, and he was sitting on the ground, nearly half his body charred black, but his life was not in danger.
"Gold Centipede General, kill all these people, leave no one alive!" the one-horned man took out a green talisman and stuck it on the wound at his lower back, slowly getting to his feet, his voice cold.
The eyes of the Red Gold Centipede also flashed with a strange light, which quickly dissipated, and its colossal body flew towards Zuo Qinghui and Yue Rong.
The other Guiyuan Sect Cultivators quickly took Detoxification Pills into their mouths, and put on masks to protect their noses and mouths before following the Red Gold Centipede, surrounding them.
Shi Chuan's eyes showed a hint of fear. He suddenly broke away from the melee and conjured a flaming red Flying Sword to carry him away.
The Flying Sword turned into a red rainbow and in a blink of an eye, it flew dozens of zhang away, clearly planning to flee during the battle.
Seeing this, Gu Sanniang couldn't help cursing, and Yue Rong's delicate brows also furrowed.
"Don't worry about him. Both of you, prepare to retreat," Zuo Qinghui's rather indifferent voice transmission caught Yue Rong and Gu Sanniang by surprise.
No sooner had he finished speaking than an unexpected change occurred!
The Red Gold Centipede, previously charging at Yue Rong and the others, suddenly turned direction and rushed towards Manager Liao and the others, spewing a stream of ink-green Poison Liquid.
Manager Liao and his three companions were caught off-guard, immediately engulfed by the Poison Liquid, and screamed in agony.
The Red Gold Centipede's body zapped into the poison cloud, biting down on Cui Wuran, who was desperately resisting the poison, and swallowed him just as it had the tall, thin old man before.
The centipede then twisted its body, sweeping its thick tail towards the Guiyuan Sect Cultivators.
The nearby ground suddenly cracked open, and thick Vines emerged, topped with purple Poisonous Flowers, sweeping towards the Guiyuan Sect Cultivators, pushing them back once more.
To his surprise, the one-horned man called out, but the Red Gold Centipede paid him no attention. Yue Rong and Gu Sanniang, seeing this, felt a mix of shock and joy.
"Let's go!" Zuo Qinghui transmitted to the two women and with a wave of his hand sent two sword-shaped Golden Lights.
The Golden Lights brushed over the bodies of Yue Rong and Gu Sanniang, coaxing out two invisible, hair-thin small worms.
Gu Sanniang's face showed a look of surprise, clearly unaware of when these two little insects had appeared on their bodies.
"How will you manage, Fellow Daoist Zuo?" Yue Rong asked with a grateful expression, transmitting her voice.
"I have my own way of escaping, you all should leave quickly!" Zuo Qinghui urged.
"Then, thank you, Fellow Daoist Zuo. We shall repay this great kindness another day!" Yue Rong didn't dawdle, bowed to Zuo Qinghui, and summoned a silver, bird-shaped flying car.
The two women jumped into the car and worked together to activate it.
The bird-shaped flying car shot out, turning into a splendid silver light as it soared into the sky.
Zuo Qinghui's figure flickered, and in the next moment, he was beside Hua Zhi.
The Red Gold Centipede quickly made its way over, Zuo Qinghui and Hua Zhi jumped onto the back of the Red Gold Centipede, and he waved his hand, emitting several green talismans that stuck to the Red Gold Centipede's body, all of them Featherweight Talismans, Gale Talismans, and other speed-enhancing talismans.
The Red Gold Centipede became light, its hundred legs moving with incredible speed, and its long body turned into a blurry golden shadow, not much slower than Yue Rong's bird-shaped flying car.
This series of changes happened in the blink of an eye; Zuo Qinghui and the others were gone without a trace!
"Damn it, forget the others, chase the Red Gold Centipede!" the one-horned man shouted anxiously.
However, at that moment, thick white fog suddenly emerged from the void nearby, engulfing everything in an instant, preventing even the Divine Power from radiating out.
Already unsettled by Zuo Qinghui's many strange and tricky methods, fearing a further ambush if they continued forward, they instinctively stopped in their tracks.
"Don't stop! Otherwise, the Red Gold Centipede will be taken from us, and none of us will survive. Chase it!" The one-horned man, still trying to stop the bleeding from his wound, took the lead in pursuit.
Seeing this, the others, gritting their teeth, chased after them, and luckily they didn't encounter any more danger, soon leaving the range of the white fog.
By then, however, the Red Gold Centipede had vanished without a trace, leaving not a single mark on the ground.
"The Red Gold Centipede can't fly, so how can there be no trace? Could it have been put into a Spiritual Beast Bag? That's impossible!" The one-horned man's eyes showed a look of disbelief.
"Brother Fang, what do we do now?" a square-faced man said with a panicked expression, looking towards the one-horned man.
They came today on someone's orders, to capture the cultivators of Xiansha City. Now that their targets had all escaped and they had lost three men, and the Red Gold Centipede had been taken by the enemy using strange methods, it would be a gruesome death for them if they just went back like this.
The others also looked at the one-horned man, who was also at a loss at this moment.
Manager Liao and the Wang brothers also flew over. The three of them were covered in poison spots and had a look of having narrowly escaped death in their eyes.
The one-horned man glanced at the three of them but ignored them.
"I still have one Smoke Worm left, attached to that bearded young man from the Fire Origin Sect," suddenly said a short woman cultivator nearby.
"Pursue, we must capture this person at all costs!" the one-horned man ordered resolutely.
The red-haired youth brought out a white flying boat, lifting everyone aboard and whooshing forward, chasing in the direction where Shi Chuan had fled.
...
After the one-horned man and the others had left, the ground rippled slightly, the sandy conditions changed dramatically, and the track marks of the centipede's passage became visible.
Not far from there, the ground suddenly split open, and the Red Gold Centipede slowly emerged.
A yellow light flashed across the sand, and the figures of Zuo Qinghui, Hua Zhi, and Yuan Ming also appeared in a flicker.
"Master, now that you have arrived, it would be easy to capture these people. Why let them go?" Hua Zhi looked at Yuan Ming, puzzled.
"These are disciples from the Guiyuan Sect; killing them all would have a great impact, and I don't have the time to clean up after such an ordeal. My target is the Red Gold Centipede. Capturing this beast is enough," Yuan Ming said indifferently, turning to the Red Gold Centipede.
The Red Gold Centipede opened its mouth wide and spat out two people; they were the skinny tall elder and Cui Wuran.
Yuan Ming needed to ask the two men some questions, so he had not allowed the centipede to use its Poison Liquid to dissolve them. Instead, he had somehow extracted the intense poison from their bodies while they were in its stomach.
Both men were still alive at the moment, though their breathing was exceedingly weak.
Yuan Ming came next to Cui Wuran, placed his hand on his head, and began to use the Soul Searching Divine Ability.
Cui Wuran clearly had been colluding with these people for a while; the exchange event from the day before had been a conspiracy set up by him in advance. The words he had spoken at the exchange could possibly be false.
Concerning Core Formation, Yuan Ming had to make sure whether those two methods were true or false.
Threads of black light emanated from Yuan Ming's palm, and he quickly located the memories of the two Core Formation Secret Methods, heaving a sigh of relief.
According to Cui Wuran's memories, both methods were indeed real, but a lot of the content of the Transplanting Technique was missing.
This secret technique had indeed been acquired from a corpse in the desert but wasn't found by chance; it also came from these cultivators of the Guiyuan Sect.
Cui Wuran had been in cahoots with the cultivators of the Guiyuan Sect for a long time, and for some reason, they had been capturing cultivators all over the Black Wind Desert, mainly those at the Foundation Establishment Stage.
The region of the Black Wind Desert was already chaotic and lawless, with cultivators disappearing frequently being nothing out of the ordinary; thus, even when people occasionally fell victim, it didn't attract much attention.
Cui Wuran had joined them a few years ago when he was destitute, through a chance encounter.
This man's strength was mediocre, but he was eloquent and had a reputation for being righteous in his interpersonal dealings. After gaining trust, he used various enticements to lure some cultivators to the Black Wind Desert and hand them over to the Guiyuan Sect cultivators, earning a substantial return from this.
Just like today, if not for Yuan Ming being here, the others would have succeeded.

chapters.title: Chapter 344 - 321 Beast Body Transplantation
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming discovered something in Cui Wuran's memories. Over a year ago, when he first met Cui Wuran in Xiansha City, Cui Wuran had invited him to undertake a mission together, but it was actually to lure him out and deliver him to those people from the Guiyuan Sect. It was only that Yuan Ming had refused at that time.
Cui Wuran's cultivation breakthrough was thanks to the benefits he received from the Guiyuan Sect.
And the so-called Transplanting Technique was one of the benefits given by those people, which was also the biggest reason why Cui Wuran devotedly worked for the Guiyuan Sect.
He possessed three spirit roots talent, which was considered medium in the Cultivation World. Generally speaking, without any special fortuitous encounters or strong support from a sect or clan, reaching the Foundation Establishment Stage was already the limit, especially for a Loose Cultivator, where it was even more difficult. Only with the Transplanting Technique would he have a hope of reaching Core Formation.
As for that Manager Liao, although he was a core backbone of the Xiansha City Lord Mansion and took risks in getting involved, it was also due to the temptation of Core Formation through the Transplanting Technique. With his help, Cui Wuran was even more successful in recent years.
"The temptation of Core Formation is indeed great. If it were not for being a Soul Cultivator, lacking the Soul Pill Secret Technique, I might also pin my hopes on this Transplanting Technique," Yuan Ming murmured to himself, withdrawing the Soul Destroying Sword with a flick of his hand.
A sword qi shattered this person's Divine Soul, and Cui Wuran's presence completely dissipated.
Yuan Ming approached the skinny old man, pressing his palm on his head and performing Soul Search again, quickly figuring out the old man's origins as well.
This person was originally a Loose Cultivator, captured by the Guiyuan Sect, who didn't hesitate to betray a number of friends in exchange for his freedom, and in the end, blatantly collaborated with them, engaging in the business of trafficking cultivators.
Because the skinny old man had spent a long time with the Guiyuan Sect, his relationship with that group of cultivators grew even tighter. His memories contained images of their hideout, a mining vein controlled by the Guiyuan Sect, where all captured cultivators would be sent, to be handed over to a Core Formation Stage cultivator there.
This Core Formation Stage cultivator ruled over that particular mining vein and seemed to be conducting many inhumane experiments using the captured cultivators, incorporating parts of demon beasts' bodies into the cultivators. The memory of that deeply impacted the skinny old man.
Yuan Ming recalled the single horn on the forehead of the man with the unicorn earlier, and then he understood.
The experiments by this Core Formation Stage cultivator indeed resembled the Fur Cloak Skill of Biluo Cave, both involving the implantation of demon beast's power into cultivator bodies.
However, according to the skinny old man's memories, directly transplanting parts of demon beast bodies into cultivator bodies carried high risks. More than half of the cases resulted in conflicting energies between man and beast, causing the recipient to explode and die.
Yuan Ming shook his head and continued the Soul Search, his expression suddenly fixed.
In the skinny old man's memory, he recognized a figure he was quite familiar with—it was Wulu.
He was in that mining vein, working hard at mining along with other mine slaves.
