In the stands of the Combat Arena, the roar of cheers rose like a tide — the mine slaves were all shouting Feng Ling's name, their eyes gleaming with excitement.
Upon hearing the cheers, Feng Ling grasped the corpse of the Zizhu Beast and lifted it above his head, which once again ignited the spectators' emotions.
He reveled in the cheers and praise, looked around, then tossed the corpse of the Zizhu Beast down and left the Combat Arena.
Outside the arena, a 13- or 14-year-old young cultivator was waiting for him. Seeing him return, the young cultivator, sporting a collar around his neck, hurried over impatiently, offering him a jug of water.
Feng Ling nodded to the boy, took the gourd, swished a few sips in his mouth and spat it out, then poured the remaining clean water over himself.
Meanwhile, the young cultivator excitedly began to calculate: "Brother Feng, including today's battle, just five more fights and we'll have saved up enough contribution points. As long as we redeem the mining quota, we will surely get out of here and regain our freedom."
Feng Ling glanced at the boy and shook his head: "You're mistaken; it's not us, but you."
"Eh? Brother Feng, you don't plan to leave? Do you actually want to stay here as a mine slave?" the boy asked, perplexed.
"My situation is complicated and... even if you leave here, you'll still be under the control of the Guiyuan Sect, obligated to follow their orders, luring more cultivators here... Do you really think that's freedom?" Feng Ling said in a low voice.
"But it's still better than being trapped here, having to mine every day, right?" the boy said nonchalantly.
Feng Ling was silent for a moment before suddenly saying, "If that's what you think, then I..."
Before he could finish, he suddenly looked up toward Wulu and Zuo Qinghui walking toward him from the left.
"Haha, Fellow Daoist Feng, how have you been?" Wulu greeted familiarly.
"No one visits a temple without a cause. Fellow Daoist Wu, you're not upstairs serving your guests today and specially came to find me — it must be that you need something, right?" Feng Ling said, looking at Wulu with a light chuckle.
"Fellow Daoist Feng, you misunderstand. I just happened to meet an old friend today and thought to introduce him to you. Here he is, Zuo Qinghui, Fellow Daoist Zuo," Wulu said awkwardly before turning to introduce Zuo Qinghui.
"Fellow Daoist Feng, I've long heard of your reputation," Zuo Qinghui said with a smile, then looked up at the boy next to Feng Ling.
Feng Ling noticed, and immediately said, "Wei Chang has known me for many years; I view him as a brother. There's nothing that needs to be hidden from him."
Hearing this, Zuo Qinghui nodded and no longer concealed his purpose: "I heard that Fellow Daoist Feng has been here in the mines for five or six years now, have you ever thought of leaving this place?"
Feng Ling's pupils constricted, and he turned to Wulu: "Fellow Daoist Wu, I consider you a friend, but what are you implying by bringing someone to test me today?"
Before Wulu could explain, Zuo Qinghui quickly said, "Fellow Daoist Feng, you've misunderstood. My question was genuine. Honestly speaking, I was captured on a mission ordered by my superior, specifically to rescue the mine slaves. This visit was just to use your renown to connect with a few of the mine slave leaders and inform them of the plan."
Feng Ling curled his lip, revealing a faint smile, still looking incredulous.
Zuo Qinghui then calmly moved his lips as though he was employing a sound transmission technique with Feng Ling.
When Feng Ling heard his words, a flash of ferocity crossed his eyes, and he abruptly spoke in an unfriendly tone: "Fellow Daoist Zuo, are you threatening me?"
"It's not a threat; I just want to tell you that if I were a man of the Guiyuan Sect, I would have already revealed your secret and not be standing here asking for your help," Zuo Qinghui shook his head.
Feng Ling's expression darkened, and after pondering for a moment he said, "You're right, but why should I believe you have the capability to rescue us?"
"Fellow Daoist does not need to believe it now since all plans only begin upon the removal of the collars, at which point my superior will also act as the vanguard and lead the charge. You can fully decide whether to join based on the situation then," Zuo Qinghui stated.
"If that's the case, why come to me now? When the riot starts down in the mine and our collars are removed, won't we naturally join the uprising?" Feng Ling said.
"Without someone to oversee the situation, the uprising will be as scattered as sand. Cultivators are human, and humans will instinctively follow. Only if we lead will they organize to fight back together rather than each fleeing for their own lives," Zuo Qinghui replied.
Feng Ling looked at Zuo Qinghui without revealing his stance: "This is a serious matter. Please give me some time to think it over, Fellow Daoist Zuo."
"Of course."Lоvе this stоry? Shоw yоur suppоrt оn М9VLЕМРYR.
Zuo Qinghui nodded his head and stepped aside, allowing Feng Ling to walk past him, marking the end of any interaction between the two.
But when Wei Chang passed by, he suddenly looked up and said to Zuo Qinghui,
"Don't worry, after I return, I will try to persuade Brother Feng again. Come back here tomorrow, and he will surely agree."
Zuo Qinghui smiled but did not respond.
Later, after Feng Ling and Wei Chang had completely left, Wulu suggested,
"Since we have to wait for his decision, why not let me take you to meet the other leaders first?"
"No need. If we go now, the result would be the same as now. Let's wait until tomorrow. With Feng Ling's support, convincing them will certainly be much easier," Zuo Qinghui shook his head.
"You truly believe Wei Chang will persuade Feng Ling?" Wulu asked curiously.
"No, actually Feng Ling had already agreed. His current refusal is only because he has some personal matters to attend to," Zuo Qinghui said with a mysterious smile.
...
The night deepened, yet Feng Ling was on the bed in a position known as 'Five Hearts Toward Heaven', seemingly immersed in cultivation.
This did not make sense normally, because due to the suppression of the collar, no matter how the mine slaves cultivated, their cultivation would not improve in the slightest.
However, upon closer inspection, it would be clear that Feng Ling's cultivation method was not the same as that of a regular Magic Practitioner.
The spiritual energy drawn from the surroundings wandered through his meridians, but instead of accumulating in the Dantian, it was absorbed by the flesh and blood throughout his body.
Every time he completed a Circulation, he would immediately take out a wooden box from under the bed, extract a brass beetle about the size of a thumb, and swallow it.
The beetle was alive, and emitted a cry of despair when crushed by his teeth, yet Feng Ling remained indifferent, as if what he had consumed was merely an elixir meant for cultivation.
After eating the beetle, Feng Ling would continue to cultivating, repeating the cycle without pause.
Perhaps because he was so focused on cultivating, he did not notice another pair of eyes hiding behind his room's door.
Wei Chang quietly observed Feng Ling's cultivation, his face shifting through expressions of doubt, pity, regret, and resolution.
Eventually, he silently left Feng Ling's doorway and returned to his own room, packed up his belongings, and was about to leave when someone suddenly slapped his shoulder.
Wei Chang's body jolted, and he hurriedly turned around, only to see Feng Ling standing behind him, causing his heart to skip a beat:
"Feng, Brother Feng, why aren't you asleep so late?" he asked with a forced smile.
Feng Ling did not answer, only looked down at Wei Chang from above and slowly said, "Your eyes, they're very similar to my daughter's."
"Is that so, it's an honor..." Wei Chang replied, a bead of cold sweat running down.
"She was about the same age as you, thirteen or fourteen. She had average talent, low cultivation, and a stubborn personality. She couldn't stand the monotony of cultivation, read a few books for leisure, and then dreamed of wandering the martial arts world, becoming some kind of heroine. Whenever I returned from Scatter Alliance missions, she would always be the first to wait at the door to greet me, but as soon as we met, she would start complaining about this and that, criticizing me for my wrongs," Feng Ling reminisced with a tender smile on his face, but to Wei Chang, it seemed like an Evil Ghost was grinning menacingly at him.
"I will never forget the day she died, the despair and resentment that filled her once smiling eyes. From that day on, I swore that I would bring her murderer before her grave and have him cut a thousand times to appease her spirit in heaven."
Feng Ling clenched his fist, "But I'm useless! I'm trash! Even though I found the murderer and was fully prepared, I couldn't kill him, not even die with him. And now I'm trapped in this place called a mine, and I will never get the chance to avenge her."
Wei Chang swallowed hard, trembling as he attempted to ask, "So..."
However, at that moment, Feng Ling grabbed his throat, rendering him unable to make any sound:
"That copper beetle, I discovered it by chance, its effect is similar to that of a body cultivation pill and would allow me to embark on the Body Cultivation path. I didn't want to get involved with others, but from the day I saw you, your eyes reminded me of my daughter. That's why I kept you, cared for you like my own brother, even begged the guards to share their contribution points with you. But you shouldn't have thought about joining the Guiyuan Sect after all my persuasions. For the sake of false freedom, you wanted to be their dog! You even planned to use the information about me eating the copper beetles as a bargaining chip, as a credential to offer to the Guiyuan Sect!"
Wei Chang struggled desperately, his eyes filled with terror, his hands frantically clawing at Feng Ling's arms, his nails even piercing the flesh, leaving several scratch marks.
"You are smart, knowing you still need to rely on me for contribution points, revealing it so early wouldn't bring the greatest benefit. Today, the words of the one surnamed Zuo showed you further possibilities, and you finally took action. Unfortunately, even if Zuo didn't come today, I was already planning to deal with you because, you see, your eyes are too similar to my daughter's. The thought of you, with those eyes, joining the Guiyuan Sect made me nauseous!" Feng Ling growled in a low voice, his arm suddenly exerting force and easily snapping Wei Chang's neck.

chapters.title: Chapter 352 - 329: Straight to the Point
chapters.content:
Feng Ling slowly relaxed his grip on the palm, watching Wei Chang's body slide to the ground, he sighed softly and slowly began to speak:
"You are free now."
Having said that, he expressionlessly stretched out his hand, gouged out Wei Chang's eyes, then laid the body flat on the ground, covered it with a thin blanket, and walked out of the room.
The next morning, Wei Chang's body was discovered, and Feng Ling was greatly enraged. He spent a large number of contribution points to place a bounty on the murderer. For a time, the mine slaves were in a state of panic, both eager for the windfall and fearful of ending up like Wei Chang, being targeted by the murderer.
But for the mine guards, this was not a big deal; after all, only a mine slave had died, and in the past, they would have simply disposed of the body. Although they were short-handed in the mine now, they only conducted a cursory investigation and naturally did not inquire into any results, ultimately dismissing the incident as infighting among the mine slaves.
That same evening, in the Combat Arena, facing Zuo Qinghui and Wulu who had come to meet again, Feng Ling finally gave a positive response and introduced them to several other figures who had some reputation among the mine slaves.
In the days that followed, Zuo Qinghui and others took advantage of the daytime mining, secretly discussed in the mine tunnels, and gathered again at night, discussing the details of the plan, and finally, everything was ready.
...
Night fell.
In a hidden depression near the mine vein, Yuan Ming slowly rose and walked towards the desert outside, with Vajra's silhouette following him.
The ground around them bulged, and Hua Zhi emerged from underground, asking, "Master, shall we start now?"
"This is a dangerous battle, hold nothing back, fight with all your might!" Yuan Ming spoke as he walked.
The man and two beasts quickly reached the vicinity of the bronze gate on the sand dune, Yuan Ming released Lei Yu to monitor the surroundings of the mine vein while he approached the bronze gate.
After observing the gate for a few moments, Yuan Ming pointed a finger at his brow, releasing a soul crow.
The soul crow emitted a silent Crow Cry at the gate, sending out a wave of Soul Power Sound Waves which easily penetrated the gate.
Inside the bronze gate, several guards' eyes became misty, as if seeing someone from their sect come to inspect the mine vein, prompting them to immediately open the gate.
Yuan Ming retracted the soul crow and walked in.
The few Green Wolf demon beasts tied in the corridor suddenly stood up, their eyes blazing with ferocity, about to bark.
However, Yuan Ming had already shot out a burst of Divine Sense from his brow and cast the Dream Butterfly Illusion Technique.
The eyes of the Green Wolves also became drowsy, and they lay down on the ground and fell into a deep sleep.
Whoosh!
Several purple-black vines shot out from the ground, piercing the heads and hearts of these wolves.
The few Green Wolves made muffled whines, but the vines that pierced their heads firmly wrapped around their mouths, silencing them, while the vines quickly absorbed the demonic power and blood of the Green Wolves.
A few breaths later, these Second-level Demon Beasts were reduced to withered carcasses.
The Guiyuan Sect could hardly have dreamed that its secret mine vein located here would be easily discovered by outsiders, and that its originally stringent defenses were practically non-existent in front of a Foundation Establishment Soul Cultivator.
"According to the plan, split into two teams." Yuan Ming said to Hua Zhi.
Without a second word, Hua Zhi turned and burrowed into the ground, leaving no trace.
Yuan Ming and Vajra continued forward, using illusions to knock down all the Qi Refining disciples guarding the path along the way, quickly passing through the corridor and reaching the entrance of the underground void.
It was deep into the night, and there were only a few Guiyuan Sect disciples patrolling here, led by a bald, middle-aged man in the Foundation Establishment stage, who was engrossed in meditation on a Stone Pillar.
This man immediately sensed Yuan Ming and Vajra approaching, and just as he was about to stand up and question them, a white figure flashed before his eyes, and Vajra appeared right in front of him, throwing a punch directly.
Vajra's movements had no flourish, distinguished only by its speed, far surpassing the reaction time of the Foundation Establishment Cultivator.
With a loud bang, his bald head shattered, bits of red and white scattering, the headless body flew backward like a meteorite, crashing heavily into the stone wall behind and forming a crater in the hard wall, spiderweb-like cracks emerging around it.
As Vajra acted, the few Qi Refining disciples had already been knocked out by Yuan Ming's Illusion Technique, completely unconscious, naturally taking a while to wake up.
While Vajra's strike was as smooth as flowing clouds, taking only a breath or two from the start to the killing of the bald cultivator, Yuan Ming clearly did not intend to conceal the noise. In no time, many Guiyuan Sect guards rushed towards the scene.
"These people are yours to deal with." Yuan Ming, having already grasped the general layout of the cave through Zuo Qinghui and moved past Elder Hai's dwelling without stopping.
According to the information explored by Zuo Qinghui and the soul crow, Elder Hai had been staying in the secret chamber of his dwelling these past two days, deeply immersed in his bizarre experiments. To avoid disturbance, the secret chamber was surrounded by Forbidden Barriers, and unless the barriers were triggered, it was likely Elder Hai would remain oblivious to any commotion outside.
Yuan Ming chose to make his move today for this reason, too. If he had acted the moment he broke in, Elder Hai would have intervened, complicating matters significantly.
His speed was extremely fast, and in the blink of an eye, he dashed deep into the mine to a stone wall, where he took out an Earth Tunneling Talisman and activated it.Chесk fоr thе lаtеst updаtеs оn Мy Virtuаl Librаry Еmpirе (М-VL-ЕМР-YR).
A yellow light flashed, and Yuan Ming submerged into the stone wall, quickly reaching its depths.
A grayish-white Stone Pillar stood there, covered with Array Patterns and emitting bursts of blue light.
Yuan Ming flipped his hand and summoned the Blood Transformation Saber, channeling all his Mana into it.
Thick Blood Light burst from the Blood Transformation Saber, illuminating the nearby stone walls, which melted rapidly, forming a hole several feet wide in the blink of an eye.
"Slash!" Yuan Ming formed a spell, and the Blood Transformation Saber let out a whistling hum, transforming into a blood-colored saber stream several meters long and fiercely striking the Stone Pillar.
With a loud bang, the Stone Pillar was nearly cleaved in half, dimming most of the Array Patterns on it.
Without the slightest pause, Yuan Ming quickly withdrew the Blood Transformation Saber and struck again, releasing an even larger blood-colored saber stream at the crack in the Stone Pillar.
The Stone Pillar finally couldn't withstand it and was completely cleaved in half, with all the Array Patterns on it dimming entirely.
This Stone Pillar was one of the core parts of the mine's Barrier, and now that it was split, the light from the mine's various Barriers rapidly weakened.
Yuan Ming sheathed the Blood Transformation Saber and continued to activate the Earth Tunneling Talisman, heading straight for the next Stone Pillar.
...
In a hidden chamber, Elder Hai was seated next to a blood-colored Array, inside of which lay a Foundation Establishment Cultivator, specifically the recently captured Fire Origin Sect burly man Shi Chuan.
Shi Chuan was currently unconscious, and for some reason, his Mana was circulating rapidly, his body emitting strands of red light and radiating intense fluctuations of Fire attribute magic power.
"Not bad, not bad, to cultivate the Red Fire Heart Method to such a degree is no small feat," Elder Hai slightly nodded, retrieving an object, which was an arm covered in fiery red fur with a pale blue talisman attached to it.
The arm's fingers resembled human hands, but the joints were thick, and sharp claws extended from them; it was the arm of a Fire Ape Demon.
The arm seemed to still possess considerable vitality, as if it had been freshly severed, emitting fluctuations of demonic power far surpassing that of a Second-level Demon Beast, its original owner unmistakably a Third-level Demon Ape.
Elder Hai tore off the talisman from the arm, then flicked his fingers, sending a blade of Blood Light slashing across Shi Chuan's right arm, severing it cleanly at the shoulder as blood spurted out.
He then aligned the ape arm, and from his palm, dozens of blood-colored tendrils shot out, rapidly suturing the ape arm onto Shi Chuan's shoulder.
After a few breaths, the ape arm was attached, looking as if Shi Chuan's right arm had naturally grown that way. Perhaps because of the compatibility in attributes, it did not produce any abnormalities.
"It seems that in terms of body transplantation, my Transplanting Technique has already reached a considerable level of proficiency." A hint of joy flitted through Elder Hai's eyes. He then cast a spell with one hand, activating the blood-colored Array's operation.
Numerous translucent blood threads surged from within the Array, merging into Shi Chuan's body, eventually gathering at the joint between the hand and ape arm.
A layer of faint Blood Light emerged, meandering back and forth between the fiery red ape arm and Shi Chuan's body, slowly beginning to merge the demonic power of the ape arm with Shi Chuan's aura; the process seemed to proceed smoothly.
Elder Hai showed a look of satisfaction. This blood-colored Array was a Supporting Magic Array he had specially set up after mulling over the previous unsuccessful heart transplant incident, and now, it seemed to be performing exceptionally well.
However, at this moment, on one side of the chamber's stone wall, a fist-sized white Jade suddenly emitted a bright blue light, flickering incessantly.
"Someone is invading, who dares to be so bold?" Elder Hai's expression darkened, his eyes flashing with a trace of murderous intent.
But now was a critical moment in his transplantation technique, and abruptly stopping it would mean all his previous efforts were wasted. His expression fluctuating, he could only accelerate the Array's operation, attempting to stabilize the situation as quickly as possible.
His fingers moved rapidly, casting spells continuously. Before long, the blood-colored Array brightened, forming a square-shaped Blood Barrier that enveloped Shi Chuan's body.
Only then did Elder Hai stand up and quickly walk outside.
...
The dormitory area.
It was now midnight, and most of the mine slaves had already retired to rest, but the Combat Arena was still exceptionally noisy, with many Guiyuan Sect guarding disciples and a few mine slaves gathered around watching.
On the Combat Arena, two monk slaves were fighting against two Leopard demon beasts. One of them was Feng Ling, while the other was a rotund man, not very agile, but his immense strength barely held off one Leopard demon.
Feng Ling faced the other; he dodged to the side at the last second, narrowly avoiding the Leopard demon's attack, then immediately turned around and pounced, his entire frame like that of a large, robust demon beast.
Feng Ling landed directly on the Leopard demon's back, reaching out with both hands to grasp its neck, and forcefully twisted.
His arm muscles suddenly bulged enormously, doubling in thickness, and a tremendous strength burst forth instantly.
With a "snap," a muffled sound echoed as the neck bones of the Leopard demon were brutally broken, its body convulsing like sieved chaff, and it soon lay lifeless.
Feng Ling stomped on the ground, leaping up, and pounced on the other demon, quickly killing it in the same fashion, provoking a burst of cheers from the nearby bleachers.

chapters.title: Chapter 353 - 330: Revenge
chapters.content:
"Tsk tsk, it didn't even take sixty breaths to take down the two Flower Striped Leopards, and I was just getting into it!" Chen Shang commented from the high platform behind the Combat Arena, twirling a corner of his mustache.
Sitting next to Chen Shang were Zhu Si and Liao Zhong, who had just joined them.
The three were supposed to be guarding the dormitory tonight, but lacking the patience for such duty, they sent a few Qi Refining disciples to watch the entrance and came to the Combat Arena themselves to pass the time.
"Feng Ling's strength is indeed commendable. He has managed to remain unbeaten in the Combat Arena for so long. He really has a few tricks up his sleeve, but it's a pity," Liao Zhong remarked.
"Haha! I must admit, I also think highly of him. Not to mention anything else, but generally, demon beasts below Second Level are no match for him," Chen Shang laughed heartily.
"Since Senior Brother Chen is so confident, would you dare to wager a bet with me?" Zhu Si suddenly asked.
"Oh, what kind of bet?" Chen Shang's eyebrows rose, showing interest.
"There was a White Rock Weasel that just arrived here recently. Let's bet on whether Feng Ling can handle it, shall we?" Zhu Si suggested with a smile.
"White Rock Weasel..." Chen Shang's expression grew serious.
The White Rock Weasel, a first-level Upper Stage demon beast, was fast and strong, covered with thick Scale Armor. Ordinary low-level spells couldn't penetrate its defense, and it could use Divine Skills similar to Earth Shaking. Even Qi Refining Eighth or Ninth Level cultivators would find it challenging, let alone Feng Ling, who had his cultivation suppressed to the Third Level of Qi Refinement.
"What? Senior Brother Chen, you were just boasting about Feng Ling's strength. Are you backing out after hearing the name White Rock Weasel?" Zhu Si's eyes flashed with disdain.
"Hmph, just a White Rock Weasel. Since Junior Sister Zhu wishes to bet, I'll naturally oblige. But I'm not interested in a small wager; let's go big!" Chen Shang declared, banging the table.
"What would you like to wager, Senior Brother Chen?" Zhu Si asked, showing no signs of backing down.
"This is the Golden Feather Saber I just acquired. Although it is only Mid Grade, its power isn't far off from a High Grade," Chen Shang said, pulling out a broad-backed saber that gleamed with golden light and slammed it on the table, making a loud 'bang.'
"Senior Brother Chen truly has a grand presence! It's just unfortunate that I, your Junior Sister, am without influential connections in the sect and quite strapped for cash, unable to produce an item of equivalent value," Zhu Si remarked with a glance at the golden saber and a smile.
"Why pretend to be poor, Junior Sister Zhu? I heard you acquired a bottle of Vessel Firming Pills recently. Would you dare wager that?" Chen Shang said with a cold laugh.
"Senior Brother Chen is indeed well-informed. Well then," Zhu Si responded, pulling out a white Jade Bottle and placing it on the table. The lid wasn't even opened yet, but a tantalizingly sweet fragrance was already faintly detectable.
"That's the spirit! Let's have Fellow Daoist Liao bear witness," Chen Shang eyed the white bottle, he-he chuckling.
"I wouldn't dare refuse," Liao Zhong agreed immediately.
With the bet set between the two Foundation Establishment Cultivators, the nearby Qi Refining guardians quickly went to make arrangements.
The next battle in the Combat Arena began swiftly. A White Rock Weasel, about half a zhang tall and clad in Scale Armor, appeared in the arena, eliciting gasps of surprise from the crowd.
The beast looked small, but its eyes glimmered with a cruel green light as it stared towards Feng Ling, its body emanating a bloodthirsty murderous aura.
"How could it be a First-level Upper Stage demon beast? How can we deal with this!" exclaimed the chubby mine slave, both shocked and furious, his face showing a desire to retreat.
Feng Ling's face also darkened. Seeing the White Rock Weasel charging at him with a tangible evil wind, he had no choice but to meet it head-on.
After a brief exchange, Feng Ling and his companion were immediately pushed into a tough battle.
The White Rock Weasel was not only strong and fast with its solid Scale Armor, but also agile. Feng Ling tried several times to flank it and lock its neck from behind, but the beast skillfully dodged each time.
"Zhou Zhuang!" Feng Ling, experienced in beast fighting, saw that his opponent was tough and immediately changed tactics, signaling with a glance to the chubby mine slave.
Zhou Zhuang, catching the hint, swept towards the left of the White Rock Weasel while Feng Ling rushed to the right, aiming for a pincer attack.
However, the White Rock Weasel, highly intelligent, let out a low roar and its front paws radiated bright yellow light, which it then stamped forcefully onto the ground.
The yellow light spread like water ripples, making the stone platform of the Combat Arena shake, causing Feng Ling and the chubby slave to lose their footing, disrupting their coordination.
The White Rock Weasel seized the opportunity to counterattack, lunging at Feng Ling.
Its hind legs also emitted yellow light, shooting out two spear-like rays of yellow light that skittered along the ground at an incredible speed toward Zhou Zhuang's legs.
Zhou Zhuang tried to dodge hastily, but was still grazed by the yellow light, resulting in blood gushing out.
The sight of blood stirred up excited cheers from the spectators.
Chen Shang's eyes gleamed with thrill, he lifted a cup of wine from the table and drained it in one gulp, while Zhu Si smiled silently.
As time slowly passed, Feng Ling and Zhou Zhuang soon accumulated several wounds.
However, the two of them aided each other well in defense, syncopating their moves effectively, which also began to inflict injuries on the White Rock Weasel, especially the five blood traces that Feng Ling tore across its head, almost gouging out an eyeball.
But overall, it was the White Rock Weasel that had the upper hand.
Chen Shang's brow furrowed, his expression turning impatient, he was about to send a message urging Feng Ling.
He knew Feng Ling possessed a secret technique that burned Essence Blood to temporarily enhance combat strength several-fold, enough to defeat the White Rock Weasel, otherwise he wouldn't have bet with Zhu Si.
Just then, a flashing blue light appeared on the stone walls above the dormitory, shaking it slightly.
"Why has the protective forbiddance of the mine been triggered? What's happened?" Chen Shang and the others were startled and stood up.
Seeing this, a flicker of joy passed through Feng Ling's eyes, and he leaped down from the high platform.
Zhou Zhuang had also reached the limit of his strength, and upon seeing this, he hurriedly flipped and jumped out.
The White Rock Weasel, restrained by the Secret Technique on the Combat Arena, could not follow and could only emit several howling sounds.
Feng Ling landed on the ground, where suddenly his feet slipped and he fell with a thud.
The ground beneath him cracked open abruptly, and a purple-black vine shot out, wrapping around his collar.
Chen Shang and the other two paid no attention to the situation on the Combat Arena, briefly discussed it, then left Chen Shang there while Liao Zhong and Zhu Si sped towards the underground void.
The guard disciples watching nearby also hurriedly followed them.
"Everyone, return to your quarters immediately. Without notice tonight, nobody is allowed to go out!" Chen Shang shouted.
The mine slaves who overheard this quickly left, and the once bustling Combat Arena became empty in the blink of an eye, except for the White Rock Weasel still standing on the platform.
Chen Shang, with an unsettled mind, no longer stayed on the high platform. He leaped to the ground and rushed towards the entrance of the dormitory.
That location was closer to the external underground void; any incident there could be conveyed at the first instance.
However, just then, a figure appeared ahead—it was Feng Ling.
"Didn't you hear what I just said? Get back to your room and stay there. We'll settle the matter of your defeat in the battle later!" Initially startled, Chen Shang immediately shouted coldly and continued to move forward without stopping.
Feng Ling suddenly raised his hand and pointed, and a burst of powerful Mana fluctuations erupted from him, surprisingly reaching the mid-stage Foundation Establishment.
The ground flashed with a yellow glow as seven or eight thick and sharp rock spikes burst forth with a bang, aiming at Chen Shang's legs with great speed and urgency.
Chen Shang was startled but, as an Inner Sect Disciple of the Guiyuan Sect with notable cultivation, his reaction was exceptional. His legs emitted a blue glow, and he leaped aside, narrowly evading several of the rock spikes.
"You restored your Mana? How is that possible! Who unlocked your collar?" After landing, Chen Shang immediately looked towards Feng Ling, noting his empty collar, his expression extremely ugly.
Feng Ling did not intend to explain to Chen Shang, and once again formed a hand seal. A batch of sharp rock spikes sprouted from the ground around Chen Shang, stabbing towards his lower body.
At the same time, he lunged forward, a blue light flashing at his fingertips, and a blue long saber magic artifact appeared, slashing towards Chen Shang's head.VisitMyVirtualLibraryEmpire(*)formore.
Seeing Feng Ling fight as if staking his life, Chen Shang shuddered and swiftly slapped his storage bag on his waist.
A Silver Bell magic artifact appeared above his head out of thin air, thousands of strands of silver light cascading down to form a semi-transparent bell-shaped protective shield, enveloping his body within.
The Rock Piercing Technique and the blue long saber magic artifact clashed against the Silver Bell protective shield with "clang" "clang" sounds, being shattered and blown away, while the Silver Bell protective shield remained intact.
Seeing this, Chen Shang finally breathed a sigh of relief.
"Feng Ling, you dare collude with outsiders to sabotage the protective array and plot to escape? Wait to be apprehended by our Guiyuan Sect!" he shouted at Feng Ling and turned to rush outside the dormitory.
Even though Chen Shang did not understand how Feng Ling had restored his Mana and suddenly attacked him, his own safety was the paramount concern. As for the mine's safety, he did not care much about it.
"You're not getting away today!" Feng Ling shouted and immediately followed in pursuit, frantically chopping with the blue long saber against the silver protective shield.
A sneer crossed Chen Shang's face, continuing his earlier flight.
Just in that instant, the ground beneath him cracked open, and several thick purple-black vines shot out, swiftly wrapping around Chen Shang's legs.
Chen Shang, who had enhanced himself with a spell similar to the Wind Swift Skill, now had his legs entangled, causing him to fall to the ground suddenly.
His expression alarmed, he reached into his storage bag.
One of the purple-black vines wrapped around his legs shot out like an arrow, and with a "pfft" sound, it pierced his right palm and pinned it to the ground.
"Ah..."
Chen Shang, though of extraordinary origin, was cowardly and cautious by nature, having rarely fought against others. He had never suffered such pain before and was almost in tears.
A freezing power invaded his body, rendering him unable to move even half an arm immediately, and his Mana also became chaotic.
The Silver Bell protective shield trembled considerably, rapidly thinning by a large margin.
Chen Shang knew that it was a crucial moment of life and death, ignored the pain in his palm, and reached into his storage bag with his left hand.
A fragrant scent wafted through, and unbeknownst to him, a large cluster of purple spiritual flowers had bloomed on the vines entangling his legs, emitting bursts of floral fragrance.
Chen Shang hurriedly held his breath, but his body had already turned limp, his left hand falling down as well.
His Mana was completely disrupted, and the Silver Bell protective shield rapidly thinned, disintegrating completely after a few breaths.
A blue figure flashed by—it was the blue long saber shooting towards him, "piercing" through Chen Shang's lower abdomen Dantian.
Chen Shang's Mana dispersed completely, and he spat out a mouthful of fresh blood.
He stared fixedly at Feng Ling, who approached slowly, his eyes revealing despair, unwillingness, and confusion.
"Want to know why I'm killing you? Remember the white-robed girl you killed in Wugou City eight years ago?" Feng Ling stepped slowly towards Chen Shang and slowly began to speak.

chapters.title: Chapter 354 - 331: Cultivators Will Never Be Slaves
chapters.content:
Eight years ago? Wugou City? The girl in white?
Chen Shang's mind flashed with these three terms, as he vaguely pictured the face of a mischievous young girl.
Since his youth, he was fond of women, often using his family's power to abduct mortal girls from the civilian population. Later, mortal women no longer satisfied his desires, so he began to target low-level Loose Cultivator women without power or influence.
He also had a habit of killing the women he seduced and then abandoned, in order to avoid any unnecessary trouble afterward.
The girl in the white dress had just embarked on the Immortal Path. Her playful yet innocent temperament and her stubborn, unyielding nature had left a deep impression on him. Since he had seen her, he naturally wouldn't let her go.
Chen Shang carefully recalled the girl's appearance, which bore some resemblance to Feng Ling before him. Could the two be father and daughter?
His heart sank, but he said, "Fellow Daoist Feng, I don't know what you're talking about. I grew up in Wugou City, but I left there more than twenty years ago to join the Guiyuan Sect, and I have never gone back since. You must be mistaken."
"Is that so? Let me jog your memory then," Feng Ling slowly rotated his blue long knife, its sharp blade slicing through Chen Shang's organs.
"Ah..." Chen Shang let out a piercing scream.
"Remember now?" Feng Ling paused with the long knife in his hand and asked slowly.
"I really don't know what you're talking about! I am a direct descendant of the Chen family in Wugou City, and also an Inner Sect Disciple of the Guiyuan Sect, you can't kill me..." Chen Shang begged in agony.
"Hehe, quite an impressive background, so you must have done many such heinous acts. This hand did them, right?" Feng Ling's mouth twisted into a cruel smile as he stepped on Chen Shang's right hand and pressed down hard.
With a "snap," Chen Shang's entire palm shattered into a lump of flesh, and the bones were crushed to bits.
Amid Chen Shang's screams and terror-filled eyes, Feng Ling stepped on his other hand, similarly reducing it to pulp.
Chen Shang let out another heart-wrenching scream, his eyes filled with fear and despair as he looked at Feng Ling.
He realized Feng Ling didn't care whether he admitted his guilt; he just wanted to let him die slowly in agony.
"I found out five years ago that you were the murderer. To avenge my daughter, I've been watching you every moment these past five years, but you're too cowardly, always hiding in safe places. Even here in these mines, you only nested in the residential area of the Guiyuan Sect Disciples. Without help, I don't know how long it would have taken for me to get this revenge!" Feng Ling said slowly, pressing his foot down on Chen Shang's knee with force.
Chen Shang's leg bones shattered, and after screaming in intense pain, he fainted.
"We don't have much time left; it's about time to finish this," Hua Zhi's voice rang in Feng Ling's ear.
Feng Ling fell silent for a moment, then pulled out his blue long knife and struck with the back of his hand.
Blood sprayed as Chen Shang's head flew off.
"I have honored the agreement with you and our master, helping you achieve your revenge. What about your promise?" Hua Zhi continued to speak through sound transmission.
"Don't worry, I have arranged everything. Just follow the plan," Feng Ling replied, putting away the long knife.
"Okay." Hua Zhi responded, her voice completely disappearing.
A burst of exclamations came from ahead, where several Qi Refining Stage guards who were patrolling the dormitory area heard some noises and rushed over.
"Good timing, you can accompany him in death!" Feng Ling's eyes flashed with a vengeful light, as he immediately charged with his knife.
These Qi Refining Stage cultivators were no match for Feng Ling, who cut them down in the blink of an eye.
After killing several enemies in succession, Feng Ling felt somewhat calmer, grabbed the Storage Bags of Chen Shang and the few Qi Refining cultivators, and headed straight for the inside of the dormitory.
In a larger room in the deeper area of the dormitory, about twenty Foundation Establishment monk slaves were gathered, including She Yu, Xu Che, and Wulu.
No one spoke; it seemed they were all waiting for something.
Suddenly, the ground in front of them cracked open, and dozens of purple-black vines shot out, wrapping around the collars on everyone's necks.
The people inside the room stirred slightly, but did not dodge.
A surge of powerful demonic power poured from the vines, ruthlessly destroying the forbidden restrictions inside the collars.
The collars on about a dozen people "clattered" as they broke and fell to the ground.
Various colors of light shone on these people as their Mana completely returned.
"Let's start the action as we previously discussed!" a bald man said. The group with restored mana rushed outside.
Hua Zhi's vines shot out again, wrapping around the collars of the remaining Foundation Establishment cultivators and breaking them in the same manner.
Among these people were Zuo Qinghui, She Yu, Xu Che, and Wulu; She Yu and Xu Che burst with bright yellow light, both cultivating Earth Attribute Methods.
They too rushed outside to release the collars off other cultivator slaves.
She Yu, Xu Che, and Wulu were about to follow when Zuo Qinghui called out to them.
He waved his sleeve, and the ground flashed with spirit light, revealing two Magic Artifacts and two Earth Tunneling Talismans.
"There are many Array Eyes in the defensive Arrays inside the cave. She Yu, Xu Che, you both cultivate Earth Attribute methods. Use these Artifacts and Talismans to help our master destroy those Array Eye Stone Pillars," Zuo Qinghui said. Hua Zhi had previously returned his storage magic tool when she broke his collar.
She Yu and Xu Che acknowledged and took out the Artifacts and talismans, immediately tunneling underground.
Zuo Qinghui turned to Wulu, about to assign him a task.
However, Wulu, who had just been standing beside him, was now nowhere to be seen.
Zuo Qinghui was startled; he had been using his Divine Sense to monitor the surroundings, yet he hadn't noticed when Wulu disappeared.
But he didn't pay it too much mind, soaring outward to join the action of removing the collars.
Word spread quickly, from one to two, two to four, four to eight...
In a very short time, as many as forty or fifty mine slave cultivators had gained their freedom and restored their mana.
Breaking the collars required the mana of Foundation Establishment Stage, so Zuo Qinghui and the others chose to rescue the Foundation Establishment Cultivators.
The magic artifacts brought by Hua Zhi and the others who arrived later were distributed, but it was far from enough; only a few people had magic artifacts, while the majority were still empty-handed.
Even so, forty or fifty Foundation Establishment Cultivators already made a considerable force.
Zhou Peng was among the first batch to be rescued, but having been freed from the collar's restraint, he showed little joy and instead appeared tense with a hint of bewilderment on his face.
Just then, the Guiyuan Sect cultivators from the caverns ahead finally noticed the disturbance in the dormitory area and a dozen or so Foundation Establishment Cultivators, accompanied by dozens of Qi Refinement Stage Cultivators, charged over.
Zhu Si and Liao Zhong, who had left not long before, were among them.
Zhou Peng had been imprisoned by Guiyuan Sect for many years and deep down had developed an awe of the Sect's guarding disciples. Seeing the large number of Guiyuan Sect cultivators arriving, each with a murderous look, he immediately showed a frightened expression.
There were not a few cultivators like Zhou Peng, all showing fear and retreating, the will to fight completely gone.
The morale that had just risen now plummeted to the bottom.
"Cultivators will never be slaves, kill!"
Feng Ling, who had anticipated this scenario, roared out first, propelling his blue long knife toward Zhu Si, who was at the forefront!
Following behind him were a few of his loyal subordinates who had also just received their magic artifacts, all of them urging the artifacts forward, following Feng Ling in assault.
Zhu Si, facing Feng Ling's offensive, didn't think twice before clapping his hands together, and immediately his body flashed with silver light, shooting out nine small silver swords, each one circulating with silver light, the momentum daunting.
Enjoying the story? Find more at *.
After briefly circling around, these small swords clashed with the blue long knife.
Zuo Qinghui knew that this moment was critical; if he couldn't rally the will to escape among these mine slaves, their previous efforts might well be in vain.
"Fellow Daoists, my master has already entangled Elder Hai. As long as we defeat these Guiyuan Sect cultivators, we shall immediately break free from the clutches of Guiyuan Sect. Once that happens, the vast heavens and earth will be ours to roam freely. What are you hesitating for? Cultivators will never be slaves, fight for freedom!" Zuo Qinghui also bellowed, raising the Blood Star Tube.
The Blood Star Tube burst forth with dazzling Blood Light, and a blood-colored bullet roared out, aimed at another leader, Liao Zhong.
Liao Zhong, who had already witnessed the power of the Blood Star Tube and was extremely wary of it, hurriedly raised a Black Gold Shield and a yellow Banner, stacking them in front of his body.
The Spiritual Power fluctuations on the Black Gold Shield and yellow Big Banner were intense, clearly of no low grade.
The blood-colored bullet hit the outer Black Gold Shield, making "pu pu" two soft noises as it easily penetrated both magic artifacts, continuing to head straight for Liao Zhong.
Liao Zhong's complexion drastically changed, and he quickly moved to the side while a bright white light flared up on his body, forming another white Light Shield around him.
With a "sizzle," the blood-colored bullet effortlessly broke through the white Light Shield and hit Liao Zhong's chest, melting into it.
A blood hole the size of a bowl appeared on Liao Zhong's chest, rapidly widening, and as it progressed, not only flesh but even bones were dissolving.
Blood flowed from the seven orifices on his face as he fell to the ground with a thud, twitching a few times before he breathed no more, his body quickly turning into a puddle of purulent blood.
The nearby Guiyuan Sect cultivators were all shocked, their faces filled with horror!
Zuo Qinghui was not surprised by this; he had studied the Blood Star Tube for over a year and had completely mastered the secrets of this magic artifact.
This tube was able to melt demon beast corpses into blood-colored bullets with strong corrosive effects for storage, its might unparalleled.
Currently, there were four blood-colored bullets in the tube. The Blood Pill Zuo Qinghui had used to attack Cui Wuran earlier was transformed from the corpse of a Second-level Demon Beast.
Now to boost morale, he decided to ensure a one-hit kill, so he launched the very first one, which was likely transformed from a Third-level Demon Beast. Even Core Formation Stage cultivators may not be able to withstand this Blood Pill, let alone Liao Zhong.
Pu pu pu!
The nearby ground cracked, and dozens of thick Purple-black Vines shot out, sweeping across the sky to coil around the Guiyuan Sect guards stunned by the Blood Star Tube.
"Cultivators will never be slaves! Let's charge!"
"Cultivators will never be slaves! Kill!"
Seeing the leading person of Guiyuan Sect being killed, the other mine slaves suddenly came to their senses, and roaring with energy, they urged their magic artifacts and magic forward, rushing to attack.
The mine slaves had the advantage in numbers of Foundation Establishment Cultivators, and together with Hua Zhi, Zuo Qinghui, and others, they quickly overpowered the Guiyuan Sect disciples, who began to fall back step by step.
However, under the command of several Foundation Establishment Cultivators of Guiyuan Sect, these disciples gradually steadied their footing. Even though they were at a disadvantage at the moment, they did not show any signs of an immediate collapse.
Meanwhile, more guarding disciples continued to join the battle from the surrounding areas, and both sides were momentarily locked in a deadlock.

chapters.title: Chapter 355 - 332: Fight for Freedom
chapters.content:
"Fellow Daoist Zuo, what should we do next? Staying put here might lead to more problems as the night grows longer," Feng Ling said while fighting Zhu Si, sending the message telepathically to Zuo Qinghui.
Although he didn't specify his concerns, his implication was clear: he was worried about Elder Hai, a Core Formation Stage cultivator. Should he appear, their newly assembled forces might crumble at a touch.
"Let us focus on our tasks and quickly liberate all the mine slaves, including the mortals. As for Elder Hai, my master has plans in place," Zuo Qinghui replied.
"I understand what to do now," Feng Ling responded, nodding, then began to communicate telepathically, his lips moving slightly.
Being well-known among the mine slaves and holding a high reputation, he quickly coordinated with a few others to divide their Foundation Establishment cultivators into two groups: those with magic artifacts and more profound cultivation were to hold off the Guiyuan Sect cultivators, while the others went to rescue additional Foundation Establishment mine slaves.
With more and more Foundation Establishment cultivators breaking free and joining the fight, the situation gradually turned favorable, putting the Guiyuan Sect's disciple guards at a disadvantage.
Before long, most of the imprisoned Foundation Establishment mine slaves had regained their mana, and they began to display an overwhelming advantage in numbers and momentum.
Over the years, the Guiyuan Sect had captured no fewer than a hundred Foundation Establishment cultivators for the mine. The mine was securely hidden and fortified with arrays, and all mine slaves had their mana bound, making it a safe place.
Although the Guiyuan Sect did not expect any disturbance, they had not slackened their guard. Among the guards, there were no fewer than twenty Foundation Establishment cultivators, over a hundred Qi Refining disciples, and even one Core Formation cultivator in position.
Now that so many Foundation Establishment mine slaves had suddenly regained their mana and rose to resist, the Guiyuan Sect's guards, caught off guard, could not withstand the absolute force despite their proficiency in coordinated combat.
Zhu Si and other leading cultivators were quickly scattered. The stronger ones managed to retreat while many of the remaining Foundation Establishment and Qi Refining disciples were largely annihilated, and their carried magic artifacts were plundered.
"Cultivators shall never be slaves, believe in the Nether Moon God and gain freedom!"
This vеrsiоn wаs sоurсеd frоm М|V|L^ЕМРYR.
"Cultivators shall never be slaves, believe in the Nether Moon God and gain freedom!"
It was unclear who shouted first, but soon others joined in, the cries rising wave after wave. A sense of indescribable excitement appeared on everyone's faces—many of whom never dreamt they could escape the eternally dark mines in their lifetimes.
Having avenged a great wrong today, and now leading the cultivators in crushing the local guards, Feng Ling felt immensely relieved and grateful to the Nether Moon God, remembering the orders of his messenger, Zuo Qinghui.
He immediately began organizing some cultivators to guard the entrance of the dormitory, while dispatching most to free the Qi Refining mine slaves from their collars scattered around the dormitory area.
Soon, on the relatively spacious square at the entrance of the dormitory, hundreds of ragged mine slave cultivators gathered, including Qi Refining cultivators. Many were completely unaware of what had happened, showing bewildered and even panicked expressions.
The Guiyuan Sect was harsh on any mine slaves attempting to escape; these few hundred appeared formidable, but having not fought for a long time, they were particularly fearful of Elder Hai, the Core Formation powerhouse stationed there.
Zuo Qinghui stood on high ground, with Feng Ling and others next to him while Hua Zhi, dressed in a black robe, stood on the other side.
He observed the assembled hundreds of cultivators below and the confused looks on their faces, his mind racing with thoughts.
If so many cultivators became devout believers of the Nether Moon God, offering their Desire Power, the Soul Pill Technique could achieve great success in an instant.
Unfortunately, cultivators are resolute, especially those at the Foundation Establishment level who are experienced and knowledgeable, not so easily swayed to join. However, this event should at least earn their gratitude.
The desire power born from gratitude might not be as continuous and enduring as that from faith, but it was still better than none, and far superior to that of mortals.
"Ladies and gentlemen, as cultivators blessed by heaven with the ability to wield mana, we should be roaming the world freely, pursuing the Immortal Path. Now, having been subjected by the Guiyuan Sect to mine in this place with no hope of respite, my lord, the Nether Moon God, could not ignore this and sent me to rescue you. Elder Hai will be handled by him. Our task is only to clear this place of the Guiyuan Sect guards and release the mortal mine slaves as well, and then we can leave safely!" Zuo Qinghui stepped forward and shouted.
"The Nether Moon God?" Several Qi Refining cultivators looked at each other in confusion.
Zuo Qinghui had been spreading the teachings lately, and although many present had heard of it, they didn't really believe.
Zuo Qinghui didn't say much more, instead turning to look at Feng Ling.
Understanding the cue, Feng Ling stepped forward and said, "Yes, our escape was all thanks to Lord Nether Moon God's protection. As long as we work together, we will surely leave this place and regain our freedom!"
Feng Ling had significant influence among the mine slaves, and his words somewhat reassured the Qi Refining cultivators who were unaware of the full circumstances.
"Fight for freedom! Kill!" With no further explanation, Zuo Qinghui and Feng Ling led the army of cultivators as they charged out.
...
Almost simultaneously, intense fighting was taking place in a cavern ahead.
Vajra, rampaging through the cavern, tried his best to distract the guards, buying time for Zuo Qinghui, Hua Zhi, and others to rescue the mine slaves and for Yuan Ming and his team to sabotage the arrays.
More and more Guiyuan Sect cultivators rushed over, with more than ten Foundation Establishment cultivators led by the unicorn-man Fang Dafu trying to encircle Vajra.
However, Vajra's movements were swift as the wind, and his strength was overwhelming. Ordinary Foundation Establishment cultivators were no match for him, let alone the Qi Refining guards.
In no time, many Guiyuan Sect disciple guards had fallen, leaving limbs and blood scattered everywhere, filling the cavern with an unpleasant stench of blood.
Boom!
The grand doors of the four-story building burst open, and Elder Hai flew out.
"Elder Hai!" the Guiyuan Sect guards were instantly invigorated.
Fang Dafu, upon seeing Elder Hai, had a complex expression but also breathed a sigh of relief.
Seeing the situation in the underground cavern, a flicker of anger crossed Elder Hai's eyes, and he pointed a finger at Vajra after forming a hand seal.
A white, bone-chilling bone saber broke through the air, slashing toward Vajra.
The handle of the bone saber was a ferocious skull, and the blade emitted a flame-like white light, which, paradoxically, had no warmth but instead gave off a bitterly cold and fierce aura.
The white bone saber cleaved through the air, its fierce sword energy forming an extremely cold aura that could almost freeze a person's blood, ruthlessly chopping toward Vajra's head.
The body of Vajra was enveloped in the chilly aura emitted by the bone saber, shuddering, but a layer of golden light swiftly emerged on its skin, restoring it to normal. A purplish figure flickered through its hands, and it now wielded a purple long spear.
This spear was the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear obtained from Zuo Qinghui's storage bag. With a flick upwards, it met the white bone saber with a "clang".
Elder Hai looked slightly taken aback. Vajra's aura was peculiar. Although it also emitted demon energy, it wasn't particularly strong; instead, its physical body appeared exceptionally powerful.
And that purple long spear, easily blocking his Cold Flame Bone Saber, was definitely of magical treasure level, yet it wielded none of the expected mighty power. It seemed that the white demon ape was merely using it as a weapon.
As he contemplated, Elder Hai formed another hand seal and pointed. A vast swath of bone-white flames ignited on the white bone saber and lunged toward Vajra as if alive.
Vajra's arms swayed, and with a violent shake of the tip of the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear, a tremendous force burst forth, sending the white bone saber flying away.
With a sweep of its arm, the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear swished left and right, sending two shocking spear winds howling out, completely tearing apart and scattering the incoming white flames.
"What is this..." Elder Hai was taken aback.
Vajra didn't entangle with Elder Hai and immediately lunged at the Foundation Establishment Cultivators.
With the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear in hand, its combat power became even more terrifying; spear shadows burst forth like fireworks.
Wherever the spear shadows reached, the cultivators had their brows and chests pierced with holes, rendering any protective magical device or spell utterly useless, shattering upon contact.
"Everyone, fall back! This demon ape is an individual cultivator, do not engage it in close combat!" Elder Hai shouted in alarm and fury, and lunged forward in a flying attack.
The rebounded white bone saber halted, turning directly toward Vajra to strike.
However, just at that moment, Vajra, darting through the air, suddenly stopped. Its left arm glowed brightly in gold, turning to pure gold, and it slammed a punch out toward the white bone saber.
With a "bang", the white bone saber was sent flying and Vajra's fist was cleaved with a deep cut, a ball of white cold flame clinging to it, burning intensely.
Undeterred, Vajra's right arm suddenly thickened significantly, and it hurled the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear.
Whoosh!
A purple illusion shot backward, directly aiming for Elder Hai's chest.
This sudden change was extremely abrupt, and by the time Elder Hai reacted, the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear was already upon him.
Elder Hai hastily halted his momentum, pushing forward with both palms.
Two blue ribbons shot out, wrapping around the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear, immediately shredding it into dozens of pieces of cloth, though they also caused the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear to pause briefly.
Seizing this gap, Elder Hai's right eye suddenly turned deep blue and doubled in size. At the center of his eye, a vertical stripe appeared, giving him an ugly, eerie wave mixed with demon energy and mana.
A cold, electric blue beam shot out from the eerie blue eye, hitting the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear.
With a "clang," the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear was sent flying back.
The blue light erupted with an extremely cold aura, and suddenly a blue ice mountain, several meters tall, emerged, encasing the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear within it, with a layer of blue ice crystals also forming on the nearby ground.
"What kind of divine skill is this?" Vajra, whose spiritual intelligence had awakened not long ago, was greatly astounded by Elder Hai's maneuvers.
However, Vajra, loving war and slaughter, showed no fear, vanishing in a flash, and the next moment, it appeared near the ice mountain, throwing a punch at it.
The tall ice mountain shattered with the impact, breaking into numerous large and small ice blocks that flew toward Elder Hai, each containing Vajra's tremendous force, emitting a terrifying sound as they broke through the air.

chapters.title: Chapter 356 - 333: Response
chapters.content:
Elder Hai furrowed his brow, clasped his hands together, and then split them apart, magically producing a blue command flag in each hand.
He waved them upward, and the two flags swelled in the wind, transforming into two large flags the size of millstones. As the flags shined intermittently, two torrents of blue light burst forth from the ground in front of him, mingled with many blue streaks, instantly forming two blue light screens.
After a series of loud "bangs," all the flying ice shards shattered, but the two blue light screens also trembled violently before dissipating.
"What's going on, could someone be sabotaging the protective array's Array Eye? It looks like I need to end this quickly!" Elder Hai was alarmed upon seeing this.
Vajra swiftly pulled the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear from the shattered ice, ready to continue his charge at Elder Hai.
However, at that moment, a surge of blue Frost emerged from within the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear, crawling up his arms.
A layer of blue ice crystals formed on Vajra's arms, rapidly spreading towards the rest of his body.
"Quickly let go, the spear has been tainted with that blue-eyed's Frost power!" Yuan Ming's voice appeared in Vajra's mind.
Vajra shuddered, hurriedly threw away the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear, and his figure swiftly retreated. The spread of the blue ice crystals stopped, freezing only up to his elbows.
A white light accompanied by a chilly breeze attacked.
It was the White Bone Knife, flying toward him with a roaring white flame, aiming for Vajra's head.
...
Deep within the mine, against a stone wall, Yuan Ming was activating the Blood Transformation Saber, striking at a white stone pillar in front of him.
Including the previous Array Eyes destroyed by Xu Che and She Yu, only this core Array Eye needed to be broken to completely breach the protective array of this mine.
Once that happened, Elder Hai, deprived of the array's enhancement, would be much easier to handle.
This pillar was several times thicker than the previous ones, constructed completely from white crystal stone, adorned with more intricate Array Patterns, and appeared exceptionally robust. The Blood Transformation Saber could only chip off fragments the size of a bowl, far less effective than the previous two strikes that severed pillars.
"Huh, Elder Hai's blue-eyed aura is eerie, similar to that one-horned Fang's; both are demon beast features fused into his body using a secret technique," Yuan Ming suddenly paused, muttering to himself.
To stay informed about the situation in the underground voids, he had secretly planted a soul crow near Vajra, allowing him to see everything about Elder Hai and Vajra's encounter.
Elder Hai had an uncanny use of Divine Skills, and with his ability to call upon the protective array for assistance, Vajra, although physically as strong as an average early-stage Core Formation cultivator, was still considerably outmatched. Maintaining a balance was already commendable.
He needed to break the mine's Great Array quickly and go to assist.
With this in mind, Yuan Ming suddenly bit his tongue, spurting out a mouthful of fresh blood, which he merged into the Blood Transformation Saber.
The Blood Light around the Blood Transformation Saber surged drastically, fiercely striking the white stone pillar in front of him.
...
In the underground void, Elder Hai and Vajra were entangled in battle again.
Elder Hai, slightly wary of Vajra's immense strength, had no intention of getting close and stimulated the two large flags in his hands towards the ceiling of the cave.
A shrill whistling sound emerged from the cave ceiling as blue Array Patterns appeared, shooting down lines of blue light which instantly formed a large blue net, aiming to trap Vajra.
The area of the blue net was massive, and with Vajra under its coverage, there was no chance to evade.
His hands being frozen and unable to use the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear, his combat power was severely diminished. He instantly turned into a Golden Shadow darting back and forth.
"Where do you think you're running?" Elder Hai sneered, shaking the Command Flag in his hand, and the net swiftly chased after Vajra, moving much faster than him.
After several dodges and sprints, Vajra tried to escape the net's embrace, but under Elder Hai's manipulation, it moved even faster, ultimately capturing Vajra within it.
Elder Hai's figure flickered, appearing ten zhang away. The blue eye blazed, projecting a beam of blue light straight towards Vajra.
Not only that, his right sleeve suddenly burst, revealing an arm covered in purple lightning patterns, clearly transplanted, reaching towards Vajra through thin air.
Thunder roared!
The lightning patterns on the arm emitted thick purple electrical arcs, instantly forming a barrel-sized purple Thunder Column, striking towards Vajra's chest.Content sourced from * – My Virtual Library Empire.
Elder Hai, now unleashing all his Divine Skills, sought to quickly finish off Vajra so he could move to other areas to salvage the situation, especially since the dormitory region seemed to be in a dire state.
Facing such an overwhelming assault, Vajra's expression grew tense. A flash of Golden Light appeared behind him, and two new, rugged ape arms burst forth, grabbing the blue net and tearing through.
With a "ripping" sound, the blue net tore apart like paper mache.
The two freshly formed ape hands then grabbed into the void, one holding a gold ruler and the other a bronze giant sword, precisely the Golden Sun Ruler Magic Treasure and the bronze giant sword.
Vajra swung his arms, causing countless ruler and sword shadows to appear, sweeping towards the White Bone Knife, the blue light, and the purple Thunder Column.
A series of loud explosions erupted. The White Bone Knife was sent flying, and both the blue light and the purple Thunder Column were violently crushed.
However, Vajra's figure was also thrown backward, crashing into a rear stone wall. Half of his body was encased in frost, while the other half turned charred black. The Golden Sun Ruler and the bronze giant sword were also jolted away.
Elder Hai let out a faint cold laugh, his two Array Flags shooting out and merging into the ground.
Blue Array Patterns emerged on the stone wall behind Vajra, firing chains of blue light that instantaneously locked around Vajra's body.
Vajra, filled with shock and anger, grabbed the chains of blue light and tugged fiercely.
However, it was seriously injured at this moment, and the blue light of the chain was even more robust than the blue net before, unexpectedly failing to break it.
"Die!" Elder Hai spat a white light from his mouth, merging it into the White Bone Knife.
The cold aura of the White Bone Knife surged, shooting out a white Sword Qi over thirty feet long, slashing towards the neck of Vajra with the force of splitting mountains and parting seas.
...
"Not good!"
Yuan Ming saw the situation of Vajra and his expression changed instantly.
The white jade stone pillar in front of him was only half chopped off, and it would take a long time to completely destroy it.
The Protective Array of this mine was incredibly intricate. If Elder Hai was controlling it, Yuan Ming was not sure he could cope, which was why he thought to destroy the Array first before confronting the other party. Unexpectedly, Vajra was defeated so swiftly.
"Forget it, let's deal with Elder Hai first, and then destroy the barriers here later." He muttered inwardly, a flash of black light crossed his brow, and seven soul crows all flew out, rushing outside.
Yuan Ming was about to mobilize himself to leave, when he suddenly stopped.
To facilitate his casting, like before, he used the Blood Transformation Saber to corrode a sealed space about ten feet in size around the white stone pillar.
A thought suddenly struck Yuan Ming's mind, and he activated the Earth Tunneling Talisman to enter the stone wall.
However, at the moment of tunneling into the stone wall, he removed the Silver Token and threw it inside the sealed space next to the stone pillar.
As soon as the Token touched the ground, it immediately released a fluid-like silver light, spreading out extremely rapidly, instantly filling the space around the stone pillar to form a silver barrier.
The Array Patterns on the white stone pillar were isolated by the silver barrier, completely cutting off any connection with the outside world.
Almost at the same time, the Array Patterns on the stone wall behind Vajra flashed and disappeared entirely, and the blue light of the chains dissipated completely.
It was shocked and delighted as it pushed against the stone wall with its primate claw, and its body sharply moved several feet to the side.
The White Bone Knife cleaved into the stone wall near Vajra, causing a thunderous bang!
The cave wall shook violently, a monumental crack a few feet deep appeared, and large pieces of rock started to fall.
Yuan Ming felt a surge of joy in his heart, the effects of the Silver Token's barrier were astonishing, not only isolating mana and Divine Sense but also severing the connection of Array Patterns. He had underestimated the use of this token before.
"Not good! Could someone have breached the Array?" Elder Hai continuously activated the Command Flags of the Protective Array, to no avail.
Just at that moment, a surge of Black Sound Waves shot out from the nearby stone wall, enveloping Elder Hai without warning.
Elder Hai had noticed the nearby soul crows earlier, but he had been busy dealing with Vajra and had not attended to them. As soon as the Black Sound Waves appeared, he swiftly drifted backward and easily dodged it.
However, contrary to his expectations, a black light flashed on the ground behind him, also releasing a dense burst of Sound Waves, several times more concentrated than before.
This time, Elder Hai could not evade it, and his body was engulfed by the Black Sound Waves, causing his Divine Soul to tremble, his vision flooded with illusions, and he became completely stupefied.
A streak of Black Sword Qi shot out from the nearby stone wall, heading for Elder Hai's head, and disappeared into it in a flash.
Elder Hai clutched his head and let out a piercing scream, but he freed himself from the illusions and immediately got up and sped forward.
Within a part of the nearby stone wall, Yuan Ming's face showed surprise.
Elder Hai's Divine Soul was unstable, and the earlier strike from the Soul Destroying Sword was aimed specifically at the disorderly part of his Divine Soul. He hadn't expected that the opponent could not only endure the attack but also swiftly get up and flee. When Zuo Qinghui of Chang Chun Temple was attacked with the Soul Destroying Sword, he couldn't move immediately as well.
However, from their recent clash, Yuan Ming had thoroughly assessed Elder Hai's Divine Soul to be weaker than his own, likely unable to withstand the Crow Caw Illusion Technique.
Black light flashed on the nearby stone wall and the ground, and torrents of the Crow's Call Wave burst out, targeting Elder Hai without giving him any chance to escape, completely inundating his figure.
Elder Hai's eyes immediately grew dim, quickly sinking into an illusion.
However, his Divine Soul suddenly trembled, and an unknown resilience emerged within him, resisting the Crow Caw Illusion Technique as his gaze turned towards the distance, looking at the Guiyuan Sect cultivators.
"Take Fu'er and run..." his lips trembled as he struggled to send his message.
In the crowd, the ground beneath Fang Dafu suddenly rippled with yellow waves as if they were water, and a large hand covered in yellow scales reached out from the ripples, grabbed his calf, and pulled him downwards.
Fang Dafu's body sank into it and vanished.
Just at that moment, the roar of battle cries rose from the direction of the dormitory; it was Feng Ling, Zuo Qinghui, and others leading the mine slaves in a charge toward them.
The Guiyuan Sect guards hurriedly met the attack, and the two forces clashed, their various colored spirit lights violently colliding.
Despite being significantly outnumbered, the GUIYuan Sect guards, all of whom were elites, some possessing demon beast abilities like Fang Dafu, formed several Battle Formations to defend against the mine slaves' attack and managed to barely hold them off.
The range of the Crow's Call Wave was too wide; Vajra could not intervene in Yuan Ming's fight with Elder Hai. Gathering the fallen Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear, Golden Sun Ruler, and the bronze giant sword, it lunged at the Guiyuan Sect guards.
Yuan Ming glanced towards the mine slaves and swiftly redirected his gaze, once again controlling the soul crows to initiate the Crow Caw.
The intense Sound Waves once again overwhelmed Elder Hai, quickly drowning the remaining rationality in his eyes; he fully plunged into the illusion.
Yuan Ming flicked his finger, and the Blood Transformation Saber shot out from the stone wall, transformed into a streak of blood light, and swept past Elder Hai's neck.
Elder Hai's head tilted, and it rolled off his shoulders, a fountain of blood gushing out.

chapters.title: Chapter 357 - 334 Celebration
chapters.content:
Elder Hai was beheaded, and the Guiyuan Sect guards who witnessed this scene were all scared witless, their war intent instantly dissipating. They ceased to tangle with the mine slave cultivators they were fighting and turned to flee.
The nearby mine slave cultivators, seeing Yuan Ming's heroic performance in slaying a Core Formation elder, were now even more excited, like chickens injected with adrenaline, shouting enthusiastically as they pursued the fleeing guards.
With these people in pursuit, the news that Elder Hai had been killed quickly spread throughout the entire mine. The already lopsided battle situation collapsed even more swiftly.
Yuan Ming, seeing that the battle was already decided and that there was no need for him to make a move, ordered Hua Zhi and the others to scatter and assist the mine slaves, while he himself collected Elder Hai's body and storage bag and descended to his four-story building.
From top to bottom, he searched Elder Hai's residence for hidden goods, but perhaps because this place was only Elder Hai's residence in the mine and not his private Cave Mansion, there weren't many valuables. After a search, there wasn't much that caught his attention.
Soon, Yuan Ming accessed the basement through a hidden door. As the place where Elder Hai spent most of his time, it stored numerous elixirs and spiritual liquids of unclear purpose, as well as books recording his experimental findings.
Yuan Ming took all these, and then went to the frosty room where severed limbs were stored. Even though he already knew what was inside, he still frowned upon approaching it.
He bypassed that room and continued forward, coming into the deepest hall.
In the countless cages, only demon beasts remained. The cages that once held cultivators were now empty.
Yuan Ming looked around. Since Elder Hai often used the flesh and blood of failures to feed these beasts, they remained ferocious despite their captivity. To prevent them from escaping and causing chaos, Yuan Ming took action, executing them one by one.
Then, he controlled his magic artifact to destroy everything in the room and brought down the pillars supporting the basement. Finally, he returned to the surface before it collapsed.
Without support, the four-story building began to shake and ultimately collapsed with a thunderous crash.
In the center of the mine, the dust and mud kicked up by the fall of the building rose into the air with a great noise, illuminated by fires from every side. It was like fireworks celebrating the liberation of the mine slaves, and it also resembled the afterglow of a sunset, signifying the end of Guiyuan Sect's rule over this place.
…
Late at night, the disturbance in the mine gradually subsided. The Guiyuan Sect cultivators who weren't dead had fled. Now, the only ones left in the mine were the mine slaves they had captured.
The cultivators who had regained their freedom could have left, but most of them, after venting their anger, spontaneously stayed behind, just to catch a glimpse of the benefactor who had fought alone against a Core Formation elder and handed them the opportunity for freedom.
Behind them were hundreds of mortal mine slaves.
Yuan Ming stood atop the ruins of the four-story building, looking at the cultivators and mortals gathering around, observing their grateful or astonished or searching expressions, and slowly began speaking:
"When I first set foot on the path of cultivation, I was like you, a slave kept by a Sect, trapped in the vast mountains, without freedom."
"During the countless days and nights of captivity, I constantly thought of breaking free, of regaining control over my own life and future, but to rebel was incredibly difficult. Our enslavers would use various methods to numb us, to corrupt us, to make us intoxicated by the grace that trickled through their fingers, to accept their rules, to willingly embrace servitude for a future that they deliberately made seem possible but was, in fact, unattainable."
"Fortunately, like you, I received help from a noble, who not only freed me from slavery but also gave me the cultivation and strength I have today. I am grateful to her, but I have often wondered why she helped me. Could it be merely because she had once read the words I had written as a mortal?"
"Today, standing here looking at you, recalling the past, I finally understand the answer."
"Speaking honestly, I discovered this mine by chance, after finding out a good friend was trapped here. My initial thought was to rescue him quietly and unnoticed, but when I actually arrived, I saw some people and things, I realized that you, like me back then, also longed for freedom, and were even willing to give your lives for it. To be honest, I was moved."
In the crowd, Xu Che looked at Yuan Ming standing on the ruins, with a glint in his eyes.
Yuan Ming also looked at him at that moment, nodded slightly, and continued:
"The Immortal Path is endless, we cultivators practice desperately, some for longevity, some for status, some for dignity, but in the end, it all stems from the longing for a carefree world. Since the heavens cannot keep us in mortal shells, naturally no cultivator could ever keep us shackled in chains!"
"Among you, some may have become numb to reality, but many more haven't let shackles dull their spirit, still daring to bare their fangs at those who stand in their way, roaring unwilling to settle for mediocrity."
Zhou Peng listened to these words, his expression somewhat moved. His lips quivered twice, but in the end, all he let out was a sigh of age.
However, Yuan Ming was not looking at him but pointed to the ruins beneath his feet, continuing to speak loudly:
"This is why I helped you, and perhaps, it is also the reason my noble extended a helping hand to me. But remember, it was I who toppled this high building, yet it was you yourselves who overturned this mine."
"Now, everyone, celebrate, for your very own victory, for the freedom of each one of us."
As the voice faded, the entire mining area suddenly plunged into an ecstatic sea, with cultivators cheering and shouting, venting the depression of years in captivity, and some mortals even began to prostrate in worship.
Among them, some faces flushed with excitement, some shed tears reminiscing the past, and some gazed at Yuan Ming, praising his strength and impeccable integrity, but without exception, everyone felt heartfelt gratitude and profound respect for Yuan Ming.
