At that moment, Yuan Ming suddenly felt an endless surge of desire power erupting from the cultivators and mortal mine slaves in front of him, rushing toward his right arm.
The desire power coming from the cultivators was different from that of the mortals, each thread imbued with an aura a hundred times more potent than usual, but regrettably, perhaps because they did not worship Yuan Ming, the desire power they could provide was not continuous. Each individual had a different duration for which they could offer desire power, but almost all had a limit.
As the desire power flooded in, the incense burner mark on Yuan Ming's right arm suddenly grew hot. The Stealing Heaven Tripod was not visible, but it was incessantly helping Yuan Ming absorb the desire power.
However, Yuan Ming was still unable to actively use the desire power stored in the tripod. Seeing this, he became anxious and immediately commanded his recently returned soul splitting to operate at full speed, absorbing all the desire power flowing toward the Stealing Heaven Tripod. He then sat down cross-legged on the spot, his main soul absorbing the purified desire power from the soul splitting, rapidly cultivating the Moonlight Technique.
In front of the ruins, Xu Che and the others, having heard Yuan Ming's recent speech, now had a few words they wanted to share with Yuan Ming. However, seeing him suddenly sit down cross-legged, they were instantly puzzled.
"There's no need to worry. Our lord has simply gained an insight and will discuss with everyone once he has fully assimilated his gains," explained Zuo Qinghui at this time.
As to preserve the life force of Zuo Qinghui's physical body, the soul splitting that Yuan Ming had placed inside him was never readily utilized, and now it could also take care of some matters in place of the main soul.
Hearing Zuo Qinghui's explanation, Xu Che and the others nodded, their doubts dissipating. However, She Yu suddenly glanced at Yuan Ming, who was sitting cross-legged, and whispered with a laugh.
"I'm also curious, Fellow Daoist Zuo won our freedom, what made him willing to acknowledge him as lord?"Thаnks fоr rеаding—brоught tо yоu by М|VL|ЕМРYR.
"My relationship with our lord is more intimate than you can imagine. Moreover, our lord has never restricted my actions; coming and going as I please, how can I not be free?" Zuo Qinghui said.
Xu Che asked, "By the way, Fellow Daoist Zuo, when we speak with your lord later, how should we address him? Do we still call him Nether Moon God?"
"Our lord's real name is Yuan Ming; you can just call him Fellow Daoist. He doesn't care about these formalities," Zuo Qinghui replied.
Upon hearing this, Xu Che was momentarily startled: "Yuan Ming... could it be that he is the author of 'Children's Storybook'?"
"Indeed, in fact, our lord took notice of you because of the content of your monologue that night; it wasn't unrelated," Zuo Qinghui said with a smile.
Xu Che remembered his behavior that night and grinned sheepishly, no longer speaking.
Meanwhile, as they conversed, Yuan Ming's cultivation had reached a critical stage.
Within his Sea of Consciousness, the vast Soul Power churned like raging waves, forming a massive vortex engulfing the desire power refined by the soul splitting to strengthen itself.
And as the Soul Power rapidly grew, Yuan Ming's Sea of Consciousness soon filled to the brim, with everything, including the main soul and soul splitting, seemingly submerged in a sea, engulfed by the Soul Power.
But the next instant, the Soul Power that had filled the Sea of Consciousness abruptly ebbed away. While the soul splitting continued to supply desire power ceaselessly, the retreat of the Soul Power was unabated, quickly receding to half its size.
Just then, a round moon-like pure white halo, like the first appearance of a bright moon, rose slowly from the ocean of Soul Power.
Within the halo, Yuan Ming's Divine Soul sat cross-legged, resembling a meticulously carved jade statue, its face and posture indistinguishable from Yuan Ming's own.
As the halo completely floated above his Sea of Consciousness, Yuan Ming abruptly opened his eyes in reality, and his Divine Sense scattered in all directions, instantly covering the entire mining area.
Those in the mining area celebrating victory immediately felt a shiver throughout their bodies, as if they had been targeted by some formidable entity.
"Everyone, do not be alarmed; this is merely a fortunate breakthrough I've made, and I momentarily forgot to control it."
Yuan Ming's gentle voice echoed in everyone's ears; then, he retracted his Divine Sense, and everyone immediately felt relief. They looked at each other, knowing that even that brief instant of contact had drenched their backs with sweat out of dread.
At that moment, they truly felt Yuan Ming's immense power, and their hearts filled with an added sense of awe.

chapters.title: Chapter 358 - 335 Episode 13
chapters.content:
Atop the ruins, Yuan Ming savored the sensation he had just experienced, his eyes brimming with excitement.
With the aid of Desire Power, he had directly broken through to the Fifth Layer of the Moonlight Technique.
Upon reaching the Fifth Layer of the Moonlight Technique, Yuan Ming felt as if he had entered a brand-new realm. Not only did his Soul Power greatly improve, but more crucially, once in this realm, his Soul Power would circulate automatically in the manner of the Moonlight Technique without deliberate effort, constantly enhancing itself.
In other words, Soul Cultivators at this stage are becoming stronger almost every moment, with the only limitation being the bottlenecks encountered when attempting to break through minor realms.
For ordinary Soul Cultivators, this is definitely the strongest boost that could utterly outpace Magic Practitioners and Body Cultivators in terms of strength and Cultivation.
But for Yuan Ming, the rate of this strength growth paled in comparison to the speed at which he actively refined Desire Power. It could only be considered better than nothing.
Indeed, for ordinary Soul Cultivators, breaking through to this realm is extremely difficult. Even those with excellent talents would need to spend a great deal of time in arduous cultivation, plus some chance opportunities, to break through.
However, with the assistance of Desire Power, Yuan Ming's cultivation speed was nearly a hundred times faster, not to mention that he had just shattered the bottleneck between the Fourth and Fifth Layers with the Desire Power generated from the gratitude of the hundreds of Cultivators in the mine.
The importance of Desire Power for Yuan Ming goes without saying, and in his excitement, he quietly resolved to come up with more ways to increase his acquisition of Desire Power in the future.
After breaking through to the Fifth Layer, several of Yuan Ming's abilities had improved in ways different than before.
First, the number of soul crows increased by four, bringing the total to twelve, and their far-travel range extended to sixty li.
Correspondingly, the distance his soul splitting could operate also increased significantly. Although Yuan Ming could not test it on the spot due to special circumstances, he estimated it should be over three hundred li.
Unfortunately, the soul splitting remained relatively independent, and with the main soul's advancement, the split souls did not benefit.
Among the remaining abilities, Soul Search had the most significant improvement, the speed of memory probing increased several times. Scanning the complete memory of a Cultivator used to take at least ten days to half a month, but now only one to two days were required.
The power of "soul collision" and "Crow Cry" made striking advancement, doubling in strength.
The power of "Soul Feeding" increased as well, and it could now absorb not only the Residual Souls of the dead but also the souls of some weak living beings.
As for the "Corpse Control" ability, there was no substantial change. Each soul crow could still control only one corpse, but manipulation became much smoother than before.
In addition to these existing abilities, with this breakthrough, Yuan Ming also awakened a new ability called "Emotion Manipulation."
It could control various emotions in people's hearts, such as sadness, fear, anger, joy, and envy, amplifying or suppressing them. It could make a person extremely rational or drive them into a frenzied or even insane state.
Like Illusion Techniques, "Emotion Manipulation" could be deployed using Divine Sense, and it could also be activated by Crow Cry.
However, the effect and duration of "Emotion Manipulation" varied depending on the strength of an individual's Divine Soul and mental state.
After understanding the effects of this ability, Yuan Ming immediately thought of many ingenious uses. It was a pity that with many people around, he couldn't research and try it out in public. He had to set aside his anticipation for now, descend from the ruins, and approach Xu Che and the others.
"Thank you, Fellow Daoist Yuan, for your assistance."
Seeing Yuan Ming descend, Xu Che and the others all gave their thanks with clasped hands, all appearing somewhat restrained in their demeanor.
Yuan Ming waved his hand and smiled, "You are too kind, Fellow Daoists. May I ask what plans you have next?"
"I should return to Black Desert City. It's under the jurisdiction of the Black Desert Alliance, and the Guiyuan Sect cannot reach there. If Fellow Daoists happen to pass by in the future, you can find me at the Hidden Dragon Inn in the city," She Yu said.
"Alright, but She Daoist need not worry about the Guiyuan Sect seeking revenge. They have secretly captured so many Daoists, and now that they've escaped, once the news spreads, their days in the Black Wind Desert will be troubled," Yuan Ming said.
"That's true, I'm going to spread the news. If we can get several big powers to jointly pressure them and force the Guiyuan Sect to retract their influence, that would be for the best," She Yu said with a smile.
Yuan Ming nodded and turned to Feng Ling, "Fellow Daoist Feng, are you planning to return to Qin Country? That's the Guiyuan Sect's stronghold, so you should be careful."
"Thank you for your reminder, Fellow Daoist. But I've sworn to Juan'er that I must bring the corpse of that scoundrel Chen Shang to her grave to comfort her spirit in heaven," Feng Ling said through clenched teeth.
Yuan Ming sighed and didn't persuade further. He then turned to Xu Che. Before he could speak, Xu Che said with cupped fists, "Young Master Yuan, may I follow you, just like Fellow Daoist Zuo?"
"I remember that you have unfinished business in Zhao Country, Fellow Daoist Xu. Now that you have gained freedom, don't you want to go back for revenge? Why would you want to follow me?" Yuan Ming was somewhat surprised.
Xu Che shook his head, "To be honest, a few of my uncles have sided with a Core Formation Elder of the Five Thunder Sect to fight for the family property. With my current strength, it's really hard to fight back. I've been wasting years in this Black Wind Desert without any growth, and the chance for revenge seems ever more elusive. Following Young Master Yuan, since you have the power to overcome someone in Core Formation, perhaps I can learn more than stumbling around on my own."
"But why should I help you?" Yuan Ming asked.
Fellow Daoist Zuo once said that you're willing to give the believers the key to open their cages. I don't need you to act personally; I just need you to give me the chance for revenge," Xu Che said as he bowed his head to Yuan Ming, resembling a believer praying to his deity.
Yuan Ming looked at Xu Che as if he saw himself from earlier days, "If you obtain power and face your nemesis again, to find that everything he did was justified in everyone's eyes, what would you do?"
Xu Che had heard of Yuan Ming's exploits and naturally knew how to answer to Yuan Ming's satisfaction, but he still hesitated. After a moment, he stood up straight and said to Yuan Ming, "I might forgive him, or continue to hate him, even kill him, but no matter what, it will be my own choice. I won't give up the power and freedom that belong to me just to please anyone."
Yuan Ming smiled. He felt that when Xu Che finished speaking, a strong Desire Power slowly rose from him and kept drifting toward the Incense Burner Mark on his arm.
The belief of mortals stems from awe and admiration, while the belief of cultivators comes from recognition.
To cultivators, the only difference between them and deities is the level of their Cultivation. Therefore, it's the ideals of deities that truly attract cultivators to worship and follow.
They are not worshipers of the gods, but followers and companions. What they bow to is not the deity's power, but their thoughts and will.
And through recent pondering and answering, Xu Che, at this moment, fully understood Yuan Ming's interpretation of freedom and genuinely agreed with his thoughts from the heart.
Thus, he became Yuan Ming's first cultivator Believer, a fellow traveler on Yuan Ming's path to freedom. Perhaps one day, he might become the object of admiration for others, gaining their gratitude and belief, and the Desire Power born from this would trace back to its roots, ultimately extending to Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming looked at Xu Che, patted him on the shoulder, and smilingly agreed to his request. Xu Che didn't show an excessively grateful demeanor; he just nodded, silently stepped away, and like Zuo Qinghui, stood behind Yuan Ming.
She Yu and Feng Ling watched this scene with different expressions. At this time, Wulu, who had almost disappeared from the battle, suddenly appeared and came to Yuan Ming with a grin.
"Brother Yuan, long time no see," he said cheerfully.
"You rascal, where have you been hiding all this time? Why haven't you been seen for so long?" Yuan Ming complained helplessly.
"Please forgive me, Brother Yuan. I really had a compelling reason," said Wulu, glancing at the others nearby.
Seeing this, She Yu seemed a bit displeased, but Feng Ling didn't care at all. After speaking to Yuan Ming, he turned around and left, and upon seeing this, She Yu also bowed to Yuan Ming and left together.
Behind Yuan Ming, Xu Che also understood Wulu's intention to have a private conversation with Yuan Ming, so he took the initiative to offer to check on the situation of the mortal mine slaves in the mines, and then left with Zuo Qinghui.
Wulu took Yuan Ming to a secluded spot and cast a soundproofing spell before he spoke.This version is sourced from MV3L3MPYR.
"Brother Yuan, now that things have come to this point, I won't hide it from you anymore. The truth is, I have always been secretly serving a Cultivation Family," said Wulu.
Yuan Ming feigned surprise, "Really? But I remember Brother Wulu was a member of Dawn, which is known for its mysterious origins. Could it be your family that founded it?"
"Brother Yuan thinks too much. Although many in my family have connections with Dawn, they're definitely not founders. And as far as I know, although Dawn is a Scatter Alliance, many behind it come from Great Sects, but who the actual Alliance Hierarch is, no one has ever figured out," Wulu shook his head.
"My family is somewhat similar to Dawn; though we're a Central Plains family, we have people from the Southern Border, Western Region, Northern Desert, and even the half-demons from the East Sea. Within our family, there are twelve Core Formation Elders, each responsible for different regional mission assignments. Despite being Loose Cultivators, we have a broad network. Elder Niu Mian, who's responsible for Zhao Country, had a profound relationship with Elder Hai who held power here. You've killed him this time, Brother Yuan, so you should be careful in the future," continued Wulu.
Yuan Ming listened to Wulu's story, his brow furrowed. He couldn't help asking, "Brother Wulu speaks so openly. Have you encountered some trouble again?"
Wulu paused for a moment, sighed and said, "Alas, Brother Yuan, do you know how many undercover tasks I've taken in all my years with the family?"
Before Yuan Ming could respond, Wulu raised both hands, saying, "Thirteen times, thirteen different Sects. Each time, I started from the very bottom, with the shortest term being two years and the longest seven. Ever since I entered Foundation Establishment, it's been fifty years of living undercover, almost not a single day of freedom."

One dwells above the temple hall; the other lies at the far end of the martial arts world.

chapters.title: Chapter 359 - 336 Black and White Token
chapters.content:
"Sometimes, I myself almost can't distinguish who I am anymore, whether I am Wulu from Biluo Cave, Nan Chenzi from Fengshan Temple, or Luo Yao from Fire Origin Sect? Every once in a while, I have to train in different disciples' rooms of different sects, practicing different cultivation techniques, not daring to relax for a moment, afraid that the Hidden Element Technique used to conceal my essence will fail and be discovered by others," Wulu said with a wry smile.
"I'm fed up, Brother Yuan, really fed up. All these years, the only one I could really call a friend is you, haha, to be honest with you, do you remember the scene when you discovered the aftereffects of my Hidden Element Technique when I was a Beast Slave in Ten Thousand Mountains? At that time, I wanted to kill you, just like I had wanted to kill others who discovered me during my infiltration missions. But when I tried to use the Fire Pattern Iron to lower your guard, you told me that your saving people wasn't for any reward."
Wulu pointed at Yuan Ming, suddenly burst into loud laughter, rocking back and forth, then continued after a long while:
"How can there be such a foolish person, taken as well yet having lost even their own memories? Every day without hope, without seeing the future, just being strung along by false visions, continuing to endure as a Beast Slave, yet still keeping a trace of kindness, willing to save a person of unknown origin without wanting anything in return. Such a person doesn't need me to act; who knows, they might end up dead in the mouth of a demon beast any day."
Yuan Ming looked at Wulu, calmly saying, "Yet that person still survived."
"Yes, who would have thought? The fool I spared on a whim not only survived until now but also made his mark, saving another fool from dire straits. Haha, perhaps this is destiny."
Wulu, his smile fading from his face, continued: "Brother Yuan, I don't want to continue infiltrating anymore, nor do I want to live this kind of life anymore. I want my own freedom. I betrayed my family, but in the end, I was still caught by Elder Niu Mian. It seems he is busy laying out some scheme in Zhao Country and doesn't have time to deal with me, so he contacted Elder Hai and had me thrown into this mine as punishment."
"The battle at the mine, I refrained from joining because I was worried about leaving traces, fearing that Elder Niu Mian might detect my association with you in the future and bring you trouble. Now that the mine has been destroyed and does not concern me, Elder Niu Mian and Elder Hai may have a relationship, but they will not actively seek you out. Just, Brother Yuan, if you encounter them later, remember never to mention me or the matter of the mine."
Yuan Ming nodded, then asked: "Brother Wulu, from your words, do you plan to wander the martial arts world henceforth?"
"Exactly, but Brother Yuan need not worry. With my skills, if I want to hide, no one can find me. It's just a pity that we brothers met with such difficulty, haven't had the time to enjoy a drink and chat, yet now it's time to part ways, and who knows when we will meet again," Wulu said with a sigh, then took out two jade scrolls and handed them over to Yuan Ming.
"These two jade scrolls were hastily recorded by me during a melee. One of them contains my Concealing Breath Technique, named 'Hidden Element Technique.' When we first met, you mentioned it, and due to family constraints, I couldn't give it to you. Now, there are no such concerns. As for the other, it is a secret technique from my family, called 'Hidden Vein Condensing Pill Technique,' which can increase the chances of Core Formation. However, it should be based on the 'Hidden Element Technique.' Yuan Ming, you would do well to practice the former before considering the latter."
Without accepting the jade scrolls, Yuan Ming suggested: "Brother Wulu, with my current strength, even cultivators at the Core Formation Stage might not be a challenge. You might as well return with me to Xiansha City. Even if Niu Mian finds you, with my help, it will be better than facing it alone."
Wulu laughed but still shook his head: "No need, Brother Yuan, you have your own path to follow; why should you be encumbered by me? Besides, aside from escaping my family's pursuit, I am also seeking an opportunity to achieve Core Formation. If I succeed, perhaps I'll come back and ask for your help, and together we'll settle accounts with my family."
Seeing that Wulu was resolute, Yuan Ming didn't ask further and took the jade scrolls.
Wulu then said, "Oh, one more thing, Brother Yuan, do you remember after the battle at Biluo Cave, I said I was going to see the sea and ended up in Haiyan City? Actually, at that time, I wasn't just there to enjoy the scenery but because I heard someone had seen Penglai Island there."
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming exclaimed, "Penglai Island? Isn't that one of the legendary East Sea Three Islands, famed for producing the Elixir of Immortality? Isn't it said that no one has ever found its exact location?"
"I thought so initially. Later, when I went to Haiyan City and found it was just a rumor, I let it go. However, in recent years, I've heard more and more about the cultivators from the East Sea Three Islands. Some say they saw a phantom; others say it disappears as soon as one gets close. The exact truth is a matter of debate. But one thing is certain, something big might be about to happen in the East Sea. Brother Yuan, if you have time, you might also want to check it out," said Wulu.
Wulu then took out a black and white token and handed it to Yuan Ming: "This is another identity token of mine in the Dawn Alliance, under the name Wu Chen, a Foundation Establishment cultivator. I had made preparations in advance, and my family doesn't know this identity exists. The Dawn Alliance recognizes only the token, not the person. Take it; the Alliance is also offering rewards for information on the East Sea Three Islands, and many have already headed there. If you go and encounter them, you can show the token to avoid some trouble."
"Just remember, the squad leader of the Dawn Alliance in the East Sea, Pei Jianghai, is a late-stage Core Formation cultivator. He is proud and a bit petty. Brother Yuan, remember it's best not to offend him publicly. Other than that, there is nothing much to worry about. But with the current noise around the East Sea, the Vice Alliance Hierarch might personally intervene. His true identity is unknown to anyone, but rumors suggest he once fought a Nascent Soul cultivator; his strength is inscrutable."
Yuan Ming accepted the token, seeing Wulu as if finalizing his last affairs, sighed softly, and couldn't help but want to persuade him again. However, Wulu noticed his intention, smiled, and waved his hand, stepping back two steps like a hero in the stories, and saluted Yuan Ming with a fist.
"Brother Yuan, there is no banquet that doesn't end. As we part here, our paths in the martial arts world will cross again someday."
Yuan Ming also smiled and saluted him with a fist: "Brother Wulu, take care."
Wulu nodded, laughed out loud, turned around, took out a flying artifact he had scavenged from bodies amidst the chaos, stepped on it, and was about to take off when he suddenly heard Yuan Ming asking from behind.
"Brother Wulu, as we are parting, may I know your real name?"
Wulu, without turning his head, said, "Brother Yuan, I was just an orphan raised by the family clan. Although I had many faces, no one ever cared about me. The only name I have is Wulu. It was he who made your acquaintance, and it was he whom you rescued. Now that these shackles are removed and all the faces scattered, from now on, my identity will only be Wulu."
Having said that, Wulu rode his Flying Artifact and flew out of the mine.
...
This from the collection at *.
After seeing off Wulu, Yuan Ming reflected for a moment before getting busy.
Although they had won the battle in the mine, the cleanup was troublesome.
There were originally over eight hundred cultivators in the mine. After the celebration ended tonight, they were to head off in different directions to continue pursuing their own futures. Therefore, besides the possessions of Elder Hai that no one dared to touch, the Storage Bags and storage magic tools of the Guiyuan Sect disciples, as well as the Spirit Stones within the mine, were all divided up by the cultivators as spoils of war.
However, as the most abundant minerals in the mine, although the cultivators had picked up some, many still remained.
Yuan Ming then planned to take these minerals out and find an opportunity to sell them later, which would also bring a significant income of Spirit Stones.
Before that, Yuan Ming first went to the location of the mine's formation nodes and retrieved his silver token that he had placed there.
Afterward, he began to treat Vajra's injuries. As a Body Cultivator, Vajra's recovery ability was astonishing. Additionally, Yuan Ming had given him elixirs for treatment in advance, so the injuries he sustained while clashing with Elder Hai were almost entirely healed. The only issue was the Frost on his arm that had not yet dissipated.
But now that he had some free time, Yuan Ming soon managed to melt away the Frost after some research.
At the same time, Lei Yu, whom Yuan Ming had always kept outside the mine for vigilance, was also called back and re-entered into the Spiritual Beast Bag.
Subsequently, he and Vajra sought out Feng Ling, who had not yet left the mine, and obtained the beetles that he had been secretly ingesting during cultivation.
Feng Ling was originally a Magic Practitioner, but was forced to change to Body Refinement only because it was absolutely necessary. Naturally, there was no reason for him to keep the beetles anymore. With his help, Yuan Ming quickly located where the beetles frequented.
He planned to collect the beetles with Vajra, but upon learning from Zuo Qinghui that the mortal believers in the mine were looking for him, he had to let Vajra capture them alone.
Soon, Yuan Ming arrived in the northern part of the mine, at the residential area for mortals. Xu Che and Zuo Qinghui were there, leading three mortal men and women waiting for him.
"Nether Moon God, these are the leaders unanimously elected by the mortal mine slaves here. They wish to personally express their gratitude to you," Xu Che said, referring to Yuan Ming as the Nether Moon God instead of his name in front of others.
Yuan Ming nodded, his gaze sweeping over the three mortals one by one.
The one on the far left was a middle-aged robust man with dark skin and bulging muscles, incredibly strong and sturdy.
Next to the strong man was a woman of similar robust build, who in no way seemed inferior to the strong man in physique, and had a somewhat heroic look between her brows and eyes.
The one on the far right was an elderly man with white hair. Although his body was frail, the skin that was exposed was bronze, clearly indicating that he had worked in the mines for a long time.
"Believers Bai Qi, Rong Zhuang, and Qiao Saibei, greet the Nether Moon God," the three shouted in unison, kneeling down.
Behind them, in the residential area for the mortals, countless other mortal mine slaves also knelt down with them, chanting the name of the Nether Moon God.

chapters.title: Chapter 360 - 337 Persuasion
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming looked at them, feeling the Desire Power flowing from them, and nodded.
"Everyone, please rise."
"Thank you for the grace of the Nether Moon God," the believers exclaimed as they stood up.
Although Yuan Ming had seen grand scenes, the chorus of a thousand voices still made him feel somewhat uncomfortable, so he took the initiative to ask, "Have my messengers, Xu Che and Zuo Qinghui, mentioned that you have matters to discuss with me?"
Qiao Saibei hurried forward and said, "We are troubled by the concern of the Nether Moon God. Everyone is somewhat anxious, not knowing if the Nether Moon God has any commands or arrangements for us to follow in the future."
"I have already eliminated all the cultivator supervisors in this area. You are now free and can go home. I don't need you to do anything for me. If anything, just recite my name a few times each day," Yuan Ming said.
However, upon hearing his words, most of the mortals did not show the joy he had expected; instead, they looked at each other, their faces filled with confusion.
Bai Qi hesitated for a moment before bravely saying, "But Nether Moon God, this place is our home. If we leave here, where can so many of us go? Which Underground City has the resources to sustain all these people? Moreover, without this place, where would we even begin to look for another Underground City?"
"That's what this is about. Rest assured, I have already made arrangements. I will lead you away from here when the time comes and find a place for you to settle. Of course, you can also decide on your own whether to stay or leave. I won't stop you," Yuan Ming explained, with a sudden understanding.
Upon hearing this, all the mortals were thrilled, once more kneeling down and loudly chanting the name of the Nether Moon God.
Yuan Ming waved his hand, signaling them to rise, before instructing Bai Qi and two others to gather some food from the area to hold a simple celebration for the mortals. He then told them that after the celebration, they should count the number of people, pack their belongings, and relocate to the large Flying Boat in the mine that was used for transportation. He also asked to allocate some people to move the ore from the mines there as well.
Afterward, he left the area with Xu Che and Zuo Qinghui amid the cheers of the mortals.
"Master, there are still quite a few spirit beasts here that the Guiyuan Sect cultivators couldn't utilize during the battle and are now confined. What should we do with them?" Xu Che asked as they walked.
"Check if there are any powerful or rare ones among them and send those to the Flying Boat as well. Ask the locals if anyone wants the rest. If not, just let them go. There are still many veins unmined here, and the Guiyuan Sect will surely return, so we shouldn't leave anything for them," Yuan Ming instructed.
Meanwhile, amidst the joyous celebrations of the mortals and cultivators at the mine, hundreds of miles away in the desert, a dull yellow light emerged from the sands.The full series lives on My Virtual Library Empire (*).
As the light dissipated, the figures of Fang Dafu and another middle-aged cultivator appeared.
This middle-aged man seemed plain looking, with long hair and no beard, nothing noteworthy about him except a blood-red brand on the back of his neck.
"The situation was urgent before, and I could only drag you away forcibly to escape. Please forgive me, young master," the middle-aged cultivator said, bowing to Fang Dafu.
Hearing this, Fang Dafu came to his senses and shook his head, "It was chaotic at that time, Uncle Ding, it was hard enough for you to save me, let's not talk about that. Where is Elder Hai? What should we do next to meet up with him?"
Uncle Ding was Elder Hai's confidant, said to have been by his side since he was a child, always loyal and never faltering.
Faced with Fang Dafu's question, Uncle Ding's eyes flickered with a hint of sorrow, "My young master, please restrain your grief. The elder was killed by a villain, and I'm afraid you will never see him again."
Fang Dafu was stunned, his face going through disbelief, then astonishment and confusion, and finally tinged with sorrow.
He wanted to argue, but having seen Elder Hai's decline with his own eyes, and knowing Uncle Ding, who was his father's trusted aide, was unlikely to joke about such matters, he opened his mouth but found his throat dry, unable to speak, his vision blurred as if by tears, yet when he wiped his face with the back of his hand, it was dry.
Since he could remember, he had been dependent on his mother alone. He naturally despised the father who had abandoned them. But when his mother died and his much-maligned father appeared, wanting to vent his anger yet seeing his father's pain and sorrow when looking at his mother's memorial tablet, he was, just like now, unable to say anything.
Uncle Ding stood by for quite a while, seemingly waiting for Fang Dafu to vent his emotions, but seeing that he remained unresponsive, he chose to remind him.
"Young master, if I may be so bold, you should quickly return to the Sect base and report the situation at the Flame Scale Mine. Then, before the news spreads completely, take control of the assets left by the elder, lest they be seized by others in the family."
Fang Dafu took a deep breath and looked at Uncle Ding, shaking his head.
"Those assets, they'll never allow an illegitimate son like me to inherit them."
"The elder had only you as a child. As long as you are willing to acknowledge your ancestry, they'll have to accept it," Uncle Ding insisted.
"Uncle Ding, there's no need to persuade me any further. I won't change my name, nor do I wish to get involved with the Hai Family's affairs. From now on, you shouldn't follow me or call me young master either. I am thankful for your help today in rescuing me, and I will surely find a way to repay you in the future," Fang Dafu shook his head.
Uncle Ding remained silent for a moment, then asked, "Young master, I am an outsider and should not interfere in your family affairs, but there are some things I cannot keep to myself. You feel that the old master has wronged you and your wife, but after so many years, the old master has devoted himself to you wholeheartedly. Isn't that enough to make up for his past mistakes?"
And, stepping back ten thousand paces, even if you still resent the old master, he has given so much for you. He was harmed by criminals, yet do you not feel the slightest urge for revenge? How could you bear to watch the legacy that the old master spent half a lifetime building be taken away by those who have always looked down on you and your wife?"
Fang Dafu fell silent, pondering deeply for a long while before he finally let out a deep sigh, "What should I do then?"
"Firstly, you must return to the family and acknowledge your ancestors by changing your surname back to Hai. After this, I will arrange trustworthy people to help you take over the old master's property. You can also place some of our own people, but this can only ensure momentary safety. Next, you must hasten your Core Formation, only then can you truly secure your position. The items needed for Core Formation have already been partially gathered by the old master, there are only a few missing items left which you'll have to find yourself," Uncle Ding quickly explained.
Then, he took out several Storage Bags and Spiritual Beast Bags: "When I helped you escape, I seized the chance to take some precious items and all successful experimental bodies from the old master's residence. The abilities of the old master's experimental bodies are outstanding and can be controlled for self-defense before you break through."
Fang Dafu took the Storage Bags and Spiritual Beast Bags, looked inside, and found that among the experimental bodies in the Spiritual Beast Bags was the figure of Shi Chuan he had previously captured.
However, he paid it no mind. After placing the Storage and Spiritual Beast Bags aside, he looked towards the direction of the mines, his gaze distant as if he was viewing his past.
Quickly enough, he turned around, took out his Flying Artifact, and flew towards the Guiyuan Sect's base with Uncle Ding.
...
The next day at noon, a massive Flying Boat loaded with a large amount of ore and thousands of mortals slowly left the mine.
After a night of celebration, the other cultivators at the mine dispersed, and now only Zuo Qinghui and Xu Che remained by Yuan Ming's side on the Flying Boat.
These two were also the ones controlling the Flying Boat, while Yuan Ming sat in the quiet room of the Flying Boat, tallying the gains from his slaying of Elder Hai.
There wasn't much of interest in Elder Hai's residence, nor was there much noteworthy in his Storage Bag.
However, the number of Spirit Stones was quite impressive, about sixty to seventy thousand, with the rest being a couple of Jade Scrolls, some elixirs, spiritual materials, and several Cultivation books.
Most of the Cultivation books were related to demon beasts, the rest were a miscellaneous collection, including some on elixirs and Battle Formations.
A Battle Formation is actually a special kind of Formation that uses cultivators as central nodes to gather the power of various cultivators in one place for an attack, thus achieving extraordinary power.
The Guiyuan Sect is renowned in the Central Plains for this method, and Yuan Ming had seen those disciples employ it during the battle in the mine tunnels.
However, those disciples stationed in the mine had been out of practice, and their application of the Battle Formation wasn't as exquisite as that of the core disciples, hence they didn't shine in the battle.
But this doesn't mean that the Battle Formation itself is worthless.
Yuan Ming perused these books with extra care.
Currently, his Corpse Control ability could manipulate up to twelve bodies. If he could combine that with a Battle Formation, maybe he could unleash even greater power.
While examining, Yuan Ming discovered that there are various forms of Battle Formations, but ultimately, they focus on the manipulation of Spiritual Power and Magic, requiring coordination between these two to unleash their power.
However, the book mentioned a concept of a Body Cultivation Battle Formation, but it was only briefly touched upon and wasn't very clear.
The bodies controlled by Soul Crow cannot manipulate Spiritual Power nor utilize Magic, so they were not suitable for the Battle Formation Technique.
It seemed that if he wanted to use Battle Formations in the future, he would have to rely on bodies controlled by Soul Splitting.
Yuan Ming felt somewhat disappointed and set the book down. But just then, a new idea suddenly struck him.
If he could form a Battle Formation directly using Soul Crows, substituting Soul Power for Mana, and have them simultaneously use their 'Crow Cry' ability, perhaps he could enhance their power even further.
He envisioned several formation methods in his mind, but since he was on the Flying Boat, he worried that experimenting with this attack-capable ability might affect the mortals below, so he decided to wait until he returned to try it out.

chapters.title: Chapter 361 - 338 Soul Pill
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming, upon thinking this, continued to take inventory of the spoils of war.
In Elder Hai's storage bag, two jade scrolls detailed the Transplanting Technique and a cultivation technique named "Yin Luo Skill."
Unlike the Transplanting Technique Yuan Ming had previously acquired, the one from Elder Hai's possession was not only more complete but also included many insights and experiences that he had personally noted.
The complete Transplanting Technique could not only place a demon core into a human's Dantian to assist in breakthroughs, but also enhance a cultivator's strength by performing beast body transplants.
However, the latter came with many drawbacks. Firstly, there were issues with rejection. According to Elder Hai's research, forcibly transplanting a demon beast's torso onto a human body would cause a strong rejection reaction, leading to the death of the transplantee, so special elixirs and techniques were needed to achieve a certain rate of success.
In addition, there seemed to be a special correlation between the person receiving the transplant and the demon beast, though the exact patterns weren't clear. One thing was certain, the Spirit Root was definitely the most critical influencing factor.
Secondly, after a successful transplant, the cultivator's Divine Soul would often be influenced by the remnants of the demon beast's consciousness. This influence was somewhat similar to the side effects of consuming an Insect Pill, with the difference being that the former could not be eliminated and would recur after a period of time even if temporarily erased.
Last was the fact that after the transplant, one's cultivation would no longer be able to advance. Even if only the body and not the demon core was transplanted, it would prevent the cultivator from making any further progress in this lifetime.
Between the lines, Yuan Ming noticed that Elder Hai often mentioned a person with a tone of resentment. It seemed that it was due to this person that he had no choice but to resort to the Transplanting Technique.
He might have had his own story, but with his death, Yuan Ming might never learn of it.
The other jade scroll from Elder Hai contained the "Yin Luo Skill," his primary cultivation technique.
This technique, which he had obtained during an exploration of a secret realm, was a rare yin attribute skill with six levels, capable of being cultivated up to Core Formation.
Yuan Ming skimmed through it and discovered it was not immediately useful to him, so he set it aside for now.
This time, in the battle at the mine, the physical items such as magic artifacts Yuan Ming obtained were few. His greatest gain was the Desire Power produced by the monk slaves.
Besides, the remaining spoils were the mortal believers on the Flying Boat and a shipload of ores.
The appearance of Xu Che was an unexpected bonus. Yuan Ming could assign him many future tasks. As long as he continued to provide Desire Power, there was no need to worry about betrayal.
Yuan Ming did not plan to bring back these mortals to Sandtrap City. Firstly, the influx of thousands of mortals would attract too much attention; secondly, the Black Wind Desert was by no means a kind place. He could not save these believers from the tiger's den only to send them into the wolf's lair.
Therefore, he planned to take these people away from the Black Wind Desert and find a hidden location in Zhao Country to settle them.
Although every mortal in the Black Wind Desert was branded, Yuan Ming had the means to erase it effortlessly.
Thus, during the journey that followed, Yuan Ming quietly developed a medicinal solution, which could simply be applied on the branding to erase it.
After the Flying Boat left the Black Wind Desert, Yuan Ming sent Xu Che to Zhao Country's Market to purchase enough medicinal ingredients, helping all the mortals to remove their brands.
Latter, Yuan Ming found a secluded valley for the mortals and spent a considerable amount of time helping them clear the land, build houses, and eventually establish an embryonic village.
Of course, not all mortals wished to stay; for those who wanted to leave, Yuan Ming didn't hold them back and provided them with enough gold and silver to return home, letting them go on their own.
After the construction of the village, Yuan Ming appointed Qiao Saibei as the village head, Bai Qi as the leader of the village guards, and Rong Zhuang as the temple priest of the Moon God Sect. He asked them to take charge of the village affairs, decide on major and minor matters through discussion, as he would occasionally send someone to inspect the situation.
Qiao Saibei and the others were grateful, and over the past few days, the other mortals had witnessed the Nether Moon God assisting them in building their homes, which deepened their devotion.
To prevent chaos, Yuan Ming only left them with essential supplies like rice, cattle, and sheep for subsistence, intentionally avoiding gold and silver. As for the Flying Boat and its ores, he found another valley to hide them, creating a disguise so he could come back to retrieve them later.
...
After Yuan Ming settled everything, he left with Xu Che and Zuo Qinghui under the worshipful gaze of many mortals and soon returned to Sandtrap City.
Although he hadn't been away from Sandtrap City for very long, he had encountered so many things during that time. Seeing the familiar underground city again felt like he had crossed into another world.
Yuan Ming shook his head and entered the city with the other two.
The security at the city gate had been significantly heightened, and surveillance of those entering the city had intensified. A few wanted posters were also posted near the gate, featuring Liao Zhong, Fang Dafu, and others.
Yuan Ming wasn't surprised. Liao Zhong, as a steward of the City Lord Mansion, had conspired with Guiyuan Sect to hunt down Sandtrap City cultivators, especially targeting Yue Rong, and naturally, the City Lord of Sandtrap would not stand idly by.
Zuo Qinghui had met Yue Rong and had also revealed his true identity during the mine vein battle. Just in case, Yuan Ming immediately operated his Divine Sense to cover the three of them, casting an Illusion Technique to adjust their appearances and allowing them to enter Sandtrap City smoothly.
Yuan Ming arranged for Xu Che to stay in the outer city, coordinating with Hu Ji, and acting as an envoy of the Moon God Sect to oversee the Sect's affairs there.
"Xu Che, in the days to come, make life as smooth as possible for these believers and encourage them to pray to the Nether Moon God." He instructed.
"Yes, my lord," Xu Che responded respectfully.
Yuan Ming gave a few more instructions, then returned to the inner city with Zuo Qinghui. After purchasing some items, they went straight back to their dwelling to prepare for the concoction of the Soul Pill.
Concocting a Soul Pill required absolute silence, without the slightest disturbance.
Yuan Ming first activated the Five Elements Illusion Destruction Array, then instructed Zuo Qinghui, Hua Zhi, and Vajra to stand guard outside while he began setting up the Beidou Star Soul Array.
Three days later, everything was ready.
Yuan Ming stepped into the Beidou Star Soul Array and began to cast the Array by forming a Dharma Seal.
With a soft "buzz", streaks of black light shot out from within the Array, enveloping the entire secret chamber and forming a black light Array.
Yuan Ming sat down cross-legged, operating the Moonlight Technique; the robust Soul Power in his Sea of Consciousness was mobilized, flowing slowly.
A massive wave of Divine Soul Power spread out, stirring up a strong yin wind within the secret chamber, but it was completely blocked by the Beidou Star Soul Array, not leaking out in the slightest.
Yuan Ming's hands moved swiftly, casting according to the steps for refining the Soul Pill, his brow emitting a faint white light, illuminating his facial features in a luminous white hue.
The flow of Soul Power in his Sea of Consciousness grew faster, converging towards the main soul and continuously compressing and condensing.
The operation of the Beidou Star Soul Array also accelerated, emitting waves of pressure that acted upon the inside of the Sea of Consciousness, assisting in the compression of the Soul Power.
Time quickly passed, and the vast Soul Power within Yuan Ming's Sea of Consciousness swiftly diminished, soon depleting by a large extent.
"Ha!" he suddenly let out a low shout, his hands forming a Dharma Seal, and he remained motionless.This is part of a series from My Virtual Library Empire (*).
Yuan Ming's face in the white light changed, showing an expression of pain, with fine beads of sweat continuously rolling down his forehead. However, the white light emitted from his brow grew brighter and brighter, becoming too intense to gaze upon directly.
In the Sea of Consciousness, Soul Power surged and gathered, as a hazy orb slowly began to take shape.
A look of joy appeared on Yuan Ming's face, as the Soul Pill had finally begun to take form; he knew that as long as he kept infusing it with Soul Power, it would eventually fully condense into a Soul Pill.
"Hmm, could it be that my Soul Power is insufficient?" Yuan Ming opened his eyes.
After the phantasmal form of the Soul Pill had consolidated, it rapidly absorbed the Soul Power in the Sea of Consciousness. Even the immense Soul Power that he had amassed after breaking through to the Fifth Level of the Moonlight Technique was proving inadequate.
However, he had come prepared and promptly summoned the Stealing Heaven Tripod in front of him.
The next moment, vast amounts of Desire Power from the Nether Moon God believers within Sandtrap City, combined with the profound Desire Power transmitting from the human monk slaves in the valley, flooded in as the split soul operated the Heart Cleansing Technique at full strength to refine all the Desire Power and inject it into the Sea of Consciousness.
Moreover, the split soul also integrated its own Soul Power into the main soul.
The door of the secret chamber vibrated, and the second split soul residing within Zuo Qinghui flew in, entering Yuan Ming's Sea of Consciousness and transferring Soul Power to the main soul.
Zuo Qinghui's Cultivation was already profound, and a short departure by the second split soul wouldn't cause a significant drop in his Cultivation.
With so much auxiliary power, the Soul Power was finally restored, and the luminescence of the phantasmal Soul Pill swiftly transformed into a material crystal glow, with the Soul Pill gradually solidifying into an actual entity.
A moment later, an orb emerged in the Sea of Consciousness, radiating bright light, rotating continuously, and gently pulsating, as if a powerful heart was beating.
Bang... Bang... Bang...
A formidable wave of Divine Soul Power emanated from within the Soul Pill, causing even the Beidou Star Soul Array to tremble persistently.
Yuan Ming's eyes showed delight, and he couldn't help but let out a hearty laugh.
After so much hard work, the Soul Pill was finally refined, marking a solid step forward for his future Core Formation breakthrough!
After briefly giving vent to his emotions, he quickly calmed down and carefully comprehended the uses of the Soul Pill.
The Soul Pill was a product of concentrated Divine Soul Power. It converged all Soul Power within the Sea of Consciousness into it, with the main soul now residing inside the Soul Pill, feeling incredibly safe.
The Soul Power within the Soul Pill was extremely stable, and if it encountered an attack like soul collision, the Soul Pill alone could withstand it. If someone cast an Illusion Technique on him, its effectiveness would be greatly reduced.
On the contrary, when he himself cast the Soul Collision Divine Ability or Illusion Technique, the Soul Pill could provide significant enhancement.
"No wonder the Great Elder values the Soul Pill Secret Technique so much. The Soul Power condensed into the Soul Pill is indeed as effective as the Mana crystallized into the Golden Core," Yuan Ming thought to himself.
The Soul Pill Secret Technique was not yet complete, and he immediately continued to operate the Moonlight Technique. The Soul Pill began to move, quickly leaving the Sea of Consciousness and traveling down the body, eventually entering the Dantian.
The Soul Pill continued to rotate, and the Mana within the Dantian, influenced by it, gathered slowly, enveloping the Soul Pill, layer by layer.
Yuan Ming nodded to himself in approval; the Soul Pill Secret Technique indeed provided substantial help in Core Formation, as the Soul Pill could rotate on its own without his control.
In the long run, all the Mana in the Dantian would adhere to the Soul Pill, forming a Void Pill, which would make actual Core Formation much easier at that time.

chapters.title: Chapter 362 - 339 Meeting in Purple Thunder City
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming calmed his mind and closed his eyes, continuing to probe the changes within his body.
Now, his main soul had followed the movement of the Soul Pill from the Sea of Consciousness to the Dantian, but his body didn't feel any significant discomfort.
Meanwhile, the first soul split remained in the Sea of Consciousness. With the Sea now empty, Yuan Ming commanded this split soul to continue operating the Heart Cleansing Technique to refine the Desire Power into Soul Power.
Having lost a considerable amount of Soul Power to condense the Soul Pill earlier, Yuan Ming allocated half of the refined Desire Power to the split soul, allowing it to recover swiftly, while the rest was infused into the Sea of Consciousness.
The previously vacant Sea of Consciousness gradually began to feel full.
Yuan Ming was still somewhat uneasy and continued to operate the Moonlight Technique.
After a day and night, he felt his Soul Power had fully stabilized and he could finally ease up.
Now that the Soul Pill had been cultivated, the next steps were to push his Mana to the Peak of Foundation Establishment, find the Washing Elixir Spirit Liquid, and practice the Hidden Vein Condensing Pill Technique, making the final preparations for forming the Golden Core.
Yuan Ming pondered for a moment, then stood up and walked out.
He first visited a shop within the inner city that sold elixirs and spent a great deal of money to buy enough Insect Pills to last him two years.
Afterward, he went to the outer city to meet with Xu Che, bestowed upon him several Magic Artifacts, and asked him to temporarily cease managing Xiansha City's secular believers to make a trip to Purple Thunder City in search of Washing Elixir Spirit Liquid.
Having taken care of these two matters, Yuan Ming returned to his residence and directly entered his secret chamber.
Days passed, and life in Xiansha City continued its tranquil course. The common people were still engaged in menial tasks, trading their labor for the necessities of life, and dramas of worldly love, hate, and emotional entanglements played out daily.
The Cultivators also led busy lives, venturing into the Black Wind Desert to hunt demon beasts, seeking spiritual materials, outwitting robbers in the desert, or practicing meditation, all striving for the improvement of their own strength; no one noticed an ordinary house in the inner city that almost went unnoticed.
Time flowed by, and in the blink of an eye, a year and a half had passed.
The tightly closed door of the Cave Mansion opened, and Yuan Ming stepped out with Zuo Qinghui in tow.
Yuan Ming now had a gentle look in his eyes, which shimmered with a faint glow; he looked quite different from before.
After more than a year of arduous Cultivation, with the help of a large number of Insect Pills and the aid of items like Spirit Incense, he had broken through to the Peak of Late Foundation Establishment.
Zuo Qinghui, too, had consistently taken Insect Pills to Cultivate over the year, making significant progress, having reached the Mid-stage Foundation Establishment.
Yuan Ming didn't linger at the entrance, leading Zuo Qinghui straight outside, soon leaving Xiansha City behind.
He summoned the White Jade Shuttle, carrying them both as they soared through the sky.
Yuan Ming had successfully mastered the Hidden Vein Condensing Pill Technique, sealing a vast amount of Mana within his meridians, ready to be called upon to aid in Core Formation at any moment.
This time, however, he ventured forth in search of something else to assist with Core Formation.
A day earlier, news from Xu Che had arrived, finally finding a lead on the Washing Elixir Spirit Liquid in Purple Thunder City.
Core Formation was his top priority, and Yuan Ming did not dare to be negligent, promptly setting off for the destination.
But before heading to Purple Thunder City, he first needed to make another stop.
Moments later, the White Jade Shuttle landed near a secluded valley to the northwest of Xiansha City.
A figure with arms longer than its knees stood motionless in the valley, bathing in the harsh sunlight.
The day Yuan Ming had settled the laypeople and returned to Xiansha City, Hua Zhi had left to hunt and cultivate in the Black Wind Desert.
To Yuan Ming's surprise, Vajra had also expressed the wish to leave shortly thereafter, intending to Cultivate alone in the Black Wind Desert.
Vajra, with its formidable physical body and strength, didn't concern Yuan Ming for its safety. He had given it two Earth Tunneling Talismans and two Evil Avoiding Talismans before allowing it to enter the Black Wind Desert.
As Yuan Ming controlled the Flying Shuttle to land, he was about to greet Vajra when a flicker of surprise crossed his eyes.
Vajra had undergone a drastic change in appearance, much smaller in size, now only as tall as a normal human, with muscles and bones more robust, its skin and fur more vivid, shimmering with strands of golden luster, looking as though it was cast from a mix of brass and gold.
Vajra was with eyes closed, its breathing coming in bursts through its nostrils, hissing sharply now and then, reminiscent of a venomous snake's sibilant exhale.
Check for the latest updates on My Virtual Library Empire (*).
Yuan Ming employed his Divine Sense to inspect the inside of Vajra and was even more astonished.
Vajra's transformation wasn't only external, its whole body had undergone earth-shattering changes; all Yin Qi had vanished from within, with muscles, bones, and internal organs energized, becoming almost indistinguishable from that of a true demon beast.
Beyond that, its demonic power had completely disappeared, replaced by a never-before-seen type of energy stream that filled every part of its body.
This energy stream, somewhat similar to Mana, was much sharper and denser.
Accompanied by the Vajra's breathing, air flowed ceaselessly within its body, drawing its organs to surge rhythmically, rising and falling, expanding and shrinking without end, at times emitting muffled sounds, appearing as if it were refining its organs over and over like Artifact Refining.
Streams of scorching nature's spiritual energy converged, pouring into the Vajra's organs.
The Vajra's organs were exceptionally robust, no less than its muscles, its body from the inside out seemed like a slab of iron, giving off an unshakeable feeling.
Yuan Ming was astounded, only a little over a year had passed, and the Vajra's body had undergone such significant changes; could it have been triggered by consuming those brass beetles?
"Master, why have you come?" Sensing Yuan Ming's arrival, the Vajra opened its eyes.
"Xu Che has already found a lead on the Washing Elixir Spirit Liquid, I've come to fetch you and Hua Zhi. What have you been doing during this time that your body has transformed in this way?" Yuan Ming asked.
"I don't know myself, ever since I started consuming those brass beetles, my body has grown progressively stronger, and about half a year ago, I suddenly recalled a set of breathing exercises that train the organs, and I started practicing it. Before I knew it, I became like this," the Vajra explained, scratching its head, seemingly quite puzzled.
"Using breathing to train the organs…" Yuan Ming's eyes flickered.
This method of training the body was unheard of by him; it might be a Secret Technique of Body Cultivation.
"How do you feel now? How does your combat strength compare to before?" Yuan Ming thought for a moment then asked.
"I feel great, I'm filled with strength now, and my combat power has naturally improved a lot. If I were to fight with Elder Hai again, I definitely wouldn't lose!" the Vajra declared proudly, clenching its fist tightly.
The air around its hand suddenly exploded, creating a wave of scorching air currents.
Yuan Ming clearly saw that the explosion of air was caused by the flow of energy from the Vajra's body when it clenched its fist, violently grasping the air; the power of this energy flow was indeed formidable.
"Good, let's go and pick up Hua Zhi." He summoned the White Jade Shuttle, carrying the three of them as they flew towards the other side of the Black Wind Desert.
Having met up with Hua Zhi, Yuan Ming didn't delay and headed straight in the direction of Purple Thunder City.
Purple Thunder City was located deep within the Black Wind Desert, not close to Xiansha City. With the speed of the White Jade Shuttle, they flew for a day and a night before barely arriving.
Like Xiansha City, Purple Thunder City was also built underground, with the entrance being a several miles long gigantic fissure that was pitch-dark and bottomless. From time to time, streams of tunneling light flew from all directions into the fissure, and many Cultivators flew out from within, making the place quite lively.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming secretly sighed; Purple Thunder City indeed deserved to be the largest city of Zhao Country in the Black Wind Desert.
He slowed down and flew into the fissure.
The deeper they went, the wider the fissure became, rapidly leaving the surface entrance above their heads behind, and the light also quickly dimmed.
There were still gleams of light here, as many purple and yellow mushrooms grew on the mud and rocks on both sides of the fissure. As large as umbrellas, they emitted a soft glow, bringing a trace of light.
Having been in the Black Wind Desert for a number of years, Yuan Ming had gradually collected some information about the area and knew these mushrooms were called "Spirit Light Mushrooms," which lived deep beneath the Black Wind Desert, surviving by absorbing the Spiritual Power from the underground mineral veins.
Loose Cultivators seeking spiritual materials in mineral veins often relied on the Spirit Light Mushrooms to treasure hunt; where the Spirit Light Mushrooms flourished, there might be a vein hidden.
From the current situation, it looked like this fissure also contained a mineral vein, though it was uncertain if it had been mined.
While Yuan Ming pondered aimlessly, they finally reached the bottom of the fissure.
The bottom of the fissure was flat, spanning twenty to thirty miles in size, almost like a plain, with a towering underground colossus standing there.
From a distance, the entire city was enclosed by huge walls made of purple stone, with seven or eight city gates, some for entering, others for exiting. High-rise buildings towered within the city, their imposing aura far surpassing Xiansha City.
It was unclear whether the underground had been deliberately arranged with lighting restrictions or if the Protective Array inherently provided light, but the entire underground was as bright as daylight, almost no different from the surface.
Yuan Ming landed on an open ground nearby the city walls designated for the landing and take-off of Cultivators, retracted the White Jade Shuttle, and then, along with Zuo Qinghui and the Vajra with Hua Zhi, walked towards the nearest city gate.
There stood several Purple-robed Cultivators at this gate, their collars and cuffs embroidered with the insignia of the Five Thunder Sect, collecting city entrance fees.
Although the Vajra and Hua Zhi each wore a cloak to hide their shapes and auras, their figures were still somewhat different from ordinary people, appearing rather strange. However, the gate-keeping Cultivators from the Five Thunder Sect didn't seem to care enough to ask, adopting an attitude of allowing anyone into Purple Thunder City as long as they paid the Spirit Stones.
Therefore, Yuan Ming paid the required Spirit Stones, and without any obstruction, they smoothly entered the city.
The architecture of Purple Thunder City followed the style of Zhao Country, grand, antique, majestic, with wide streets lined with shops selling spiritual materials, elixirs, talismans, and other Cultivation Items.
Xiansha City had few shops that dealt with elixirs and talismans, but Purple Thunder City had many, not at all beneath Little Lake City and Wangyue City, obviously reflecting the considerable efforts of the Five Thunder Sect to manage it. The streets were bustling with people, exceedingly lively.
"My Lord, you've arrived." Near the city gate, from a nondescript shadow, a figure rushed over—it was Xu Che.
He was also wearing a robe capable of Concealment, with a cloth covering his face to hide his features.
"What's the situation now?" Yuan Ming retracted his gaze from surveying the surroundings and asked.

chapters.title: Chapter 363 - 340: Master of Hundred Pills
chapters.content:
"Reporting to Your Majesty, the situation is somewhat complex. I've reserved a private room in a tea house up ahead, where we can talk over tea," Xu Che said in a hushed voice.
Seeing Yuan Ming nod, Xu Che led the way, and in a short time, they arrived at a tea house named "Ming Yan."
"This tea house belongs to a Cultivator from Zhao Country who is a master tea maker and has a special method of roasting tea. He can blend different teas and spiritual materials together, creating tea cakes that are brimming with Spiritual Energy for everyone to try," Xu Che deftly managed the arrangements of tea for them.
Yuan Ming lifted the tea cup and took a sip, finding the taste refreshingly aromatic and the aftertaste lingering; indeed, it was a rare delicacy.
Vajra finished his cup in one gulp, smacking his lips as though unsatisfied, while Hua Zhi, sitting to the side, glanced at Vajra disdainfully, much like Zuo Qinghui, not touching her tea.
"Alright, let's hear it," Yuan Ming said, setting down his cup and erecting a soundproofing shield, he asked.
"Following Your Majesty's orders, I came to Purple Thunder City in search of clues for the Washing Elixir Spirit Liquid. I made no progress in the first year, but after getting familiar with some Cultivators here and attending several exchange meetings as well as auctions, I finally heard news about the Washing Elixir Spirit Liquid. It is refined by a business called 'Hundred Pills Square' in the city, extremely precious, and only supplied to some influential powers in the Black Wind Desert, nearly unknown to regular Loose Cultivators," Xu Che explained.
"Hundred Pills Square, I seem to recall this name, famous for their elixirs. Some of the Insect Pills in Xiansha City are indeed purchased from Hundred Pills Square," Yuan Ming tapped his fingers lightly on the table as if in thought, saying.
"Your Majesty is right. Hundred Pills Square is a rising power in the Black Wind Desert, established just over a decade ago and renowned for their Alchemy," Xu Che said.
"Now that you've discovered this business can refine the Washing Elixir Spirit Liquid, have you had any contact with them?" Yuan Ming asked.
"Yes, thinking that if I could purchase the Washing Elixir Spirit Liquid, there'd be no need to trouble Your Majesty to come here personally. A few days ago, I spent a good amount of Spirit Stones to invite a somewhat influential Cultivator from the city and approached Hundred Pills Square for the liquid, but the shopkeeper refused politely, citing a shortage," Xu Che said.
"Ha, 'shortage,' I fear that's just an excuse," Hua Zhi's voice came out sharp and thin.
Hua Zhi's Cultivation had improved a lot by now, just a hair's breadth from reaching the Upper Stage of Second Level. As her power greatly increased, the human form she assumed became more lifelike; although she couldn't drink tea, she could now speak with some effort.
"It may not necessarily be an excuse. If the refinement of Washing Elixir Spirit Liquid were not difficult, Hundred Pills Square wouldn't be doing business solely with powerful forces," Yuan Ming slowly shook his head.
"Should I use Earth Tunneling to sneak in and steal a couple of bottles?" Hua Zhi offered.
Xu Che's expression changed slightly. Purple Thunder City was Five Thunder Sect's territory, not a place to act recklessly. He was about to admonish her.
"Given Hundred Pills Square's dealings with major powers in the Black Wind Desert, we must not underestimate its strength. Although you have the Earth Tunneling Divine Ability, it would still be challenging. Let's do this, I will first make contact with someone from Hundred Pills Square. If it's truly impossible to make a purchase, we'll think of another strategy," Yuan Ming thought for a moment, then shook his head and said.
Hua Zhi was silent, appearing somewhat disappointed.
Yuan Ming instructed Zuo Qinghui, Hua Zhi, and Vajra to wait in the tea house for news, and he and Xu Che headed deeper into Purple Thunder City.
Within Purple Thunder City, the public order was relatively good compared to the Black Wind Desert. It did not suffer from the chaos of places like Xiansha City, and there was no division between inner and outer city. They quickly arrived in front of a tall shop deep in Purple Thunder City, with "Hundred Pills Square" written on the board above the entrance.
The business occupied a large area, nearly twice the size of the surrounding shops, and consisted of five floors. The business was booming as Cultivators continuously entered and exited, mostly with excited smiles on their faces.
Yuan Ming and Xu Che entered the shop, and Yuan Ming's gaze was drawn to the rows of elixir shelves, loaded with a variety of elixirs that were almost on par with the Qingmu Building of Shengye Sect.
"What elixirs would you like to purchase, guests?" a green-robed attendant approached them with a broad smile.
Without needing Yuan Ming to speak, Xu Che stepped forward.
After some negotiation, the green-robed attendant glanced at Yuan Ming and led them further inside, quickly reaching the third floor of Hundred Pills Square, where they met a white-robed scholar referred to as "Manager Huo" by the attendant.
"Fellow Daoist Xu, why have you come again today? I'm afraid I'm powerless regarding the matter you mentioned earlier; there's no need to waste your energy," the white-robed scholar glanced at Yuan Ming and said to Xu Che.
"Manager Huo's words are well understood by me. This is my master, and he has come to visit in person today. I hope you can inform Master Yan of Hundred Pills for us," Xu Che said.
"Our master isn't in Hundred Pills today; he's gone to see a friend and may not be available for your visit," the white-robed scholar's face turned cold, seemingly displeased by Xu Che's persistence.
"Is that so? Perhaps Manager Huo could check again; your master might have returned by now," Yuan Ming spoke calmly.
Hearing this, the white-robed scholar internally sneered.
Purple Thunder City was the largest city of Zhao Country in the Black Wind Desert, with countless Cultivators visiting every day. As a manager of Hundred Pills Square, he dealt with high-ranking members of large businesses and disciples and elders of Cultivation Sects on a daily basis. He thought little of Xu Che and Yuan Ming, questioning who they were and from which obscure small family they had come from, to be directing him.
Just as he was about to sarcastically retort, his gaze met Yuan Ming's and he felt as if stuck by a magnet, unable to look away.
The white-robed scholar felt his entire head turning numb, incapable of moving or making a sound, which made him panic.
As panic set in, it spread like a tide, rapidly increasing by tenfold, a hundredfold, until it consumed the white-robed scholar's every thought.
The person's body trembled, weeping bitterly, and a patch on the lower part of his pants became wet and quickly spread larger.
Xu Che observed this scene, his face betraying no emotion, while his heart felt a mix of shock and delight.
His Majesty truly possessed boundless Divine Skills, this White Jade Scholar was the major steward of the Hundred Pills Square. Although somewhat opportunistic, his Cultivation was very strong – a genuine Late Foundation Establishment Cultivator. It was said that he wasn't far from reaching the Fake Core Stage, yet a single glance from Yuan Ming terrified him to the point of crying uncontrollably!
This was probably one of the few times he lost his composure since entering the Cultivation World.
Yuan Ming also secretly nodded in approval; he had first used an Illusion Technique to control the White Jade Scholar momentarily, then manipulated his fear with the "Emotion Manipulation" ability. It was the first time he had used this power on a Cultivator, and he was quite satisfied with the results.
The combination of Emotion Manipulation and Illusion Technique had their power doubled; the White Jade Scholar's Cultivation was not much weaker than his, but he still had no power to fight back.
Yuan Ming did not continue to manipulate the emotions of the White Jade Scholar, and instead found a chair and sat down.
The terror in the heart of the White Jade Scholar gradually subsided, and he regained his reason. Filled with shame and anger, he dared not lash out at Yuan Ming; after giving Yuan Ming a deep look, he hurriedly ran out. ThisisasamplefromMyVirtualLibraryEmpire.Readthereston*.
"Your Majesty, Manager Huo is a prominent figure in the Hundred Pills Square. Although he got what he deserved, by making him humiliate himself like this, you have indirectly slapped the face of the Master of Hundred Pills. I'm afraid our visit today will have been in vain," Xu Che said hesitantly.
"No matter," Yuan Ming waved his hand, unconcerned.
From the way Hundred Pills Square was selling the Washing Elixir Spirit Liquid, it was clear they were not just looking to exchange for Spirit Stones but to use the elixir as an intermediary to make connections with influential friends.
He was only a Loose Cultivator; through normal channels, it was highly likely he wouldn't be able to purchase it.
Yuan Ming had not held any hope of buying the item with Spirit Stones from the beginning; he and Xu Che had come here today solely to meet the Master of Hundred Pills face to face.
As long as he met this person, he could use further measures.
"By the way, I didn't get the chance to ask earlier; who is the Master of Hundred Pills, and what is her Cultivation like?" Yuan Ming inquired.
"Reporting to Your Majesty, the Master of Hundred Pills is named Yan Sijing. I haven't seen her myself, but it's said she is young and at the Late Foundation Establishment stage," answered Xu Che.
"Late Foundation Establishment…" Yuan Ming was taken aback.
To have established such a large Foundation like the Hundred Pills Square, he had thought for sure that she would at least be a Core Formation Stage Cultivator. He hadn't expected she was actually a Foundation Establishment Stage Cultivator.
His interest in this person increased.
...
The White Jade Scholar ran to the back hall, changed into a set of clean clothes, and then his mood finally steadied.
"Damn it, where did that youth come from? Just by looking at me, he left me in this state; it's something not even a Core Formation Stage Cultivator could necessarily do. Could that person be a Core Formation Stage existence? Probably not, but it's likely he isn't far from Core Formation." His heart was filled with trepidation, and the thoughts of revenge he had just began to formulate dissipated like smoke.
The White Jade Scholar hesitated for a moment, then stamped his foot fiercely and made his way to the fourth floor.
Yuan Ming, using his Divine Sense to track the White Jade Scholar, felt reassured upon seeing this and withdrew his Divine Sense.
It wasn't that he did not want to continue the tracking, but rather the fourth floor of the Hundred Pills Square had a soundproofing shield against Divine Sense, and forcefully probing might trigger the warning of the Forbidden seal, which would be counterproductive.
A flash of white light passed over the jade pendant hanging at the waist of the White Jade Scholar, and he went through the Forbidden seal laid down on the fourth floor, quickly arriving at the door of a side hall, where he knocked.
"Manager Huo, what's the matter?" A crisp female voice came from the hall, sounding like spring water tinkling yet also carrying a sense of authority.
"A guest in the Fake Core Stage has come to the workshop, seemingly with a notable background, wanting to purchase Washing Elixir Spirit Liquid. He is accompanied by the same Xu Hu who visited a few days ago. I dare not make a decision on my own and have come to consult with the Master," said the White Jade Scholar with a bowed head.
Xu Che had enemies in the Five Thunder Sect; although it was unlikely he would encounter them in Purple Thunder City, to be on the safe side, he had still taken a pseudonym.
"Xu Hu? The profligate Young Master from the Hundred Refinement Pavilion who brought that person? I remember he is a Loose Cultivator," the crisp female voice asked.
"Yes, however, Xu Hu called the person accompanying him his master, with a very respectful demeanor and tone. It seems that the intelligence we collected earlier was incorrect; the two of them should come from a Cultivation Family. But unfortunately, with my limited insight, I can't deduce their origins, so I have come to consult the Master," said the White Jade Scholar.
"Oh, if he is a Fake Core Stage descendant of a Cultivation Family, it's not good to refuse outright. I'll deal with it personally," said the crisp voice.
The door to the side hall opened, and a young girl dressed in pale yellow garb stepped out.
She appeared to be about seventeen or eighteen years old, lively and engaging, with large, clear eyes that starkly distinguished black from white, giving off an odd elfin aura.

chapters.title: Chapter 364 - 341: Turning Point
chapters.content:
"Workshop owner," the scholar in white bowed respectfully to the girl in yellow.
"Tell me in detail about the conversations and behavior of those two people after they entered Hundred Pills Square," said the girl in yellow, which would help her deduce the origins of Yuan Ming and his companion.
The scholar in white complied and recounted word for word the dialogue and actions he had observed from Yuan Ming and his companion. He naturally omitted the part where he was scared to tears and lost control of his bladder by a mere glance from Yuan Ming, referring to it instead as being controlled in speech and action by Yuan Ming's look.
After all, that incident was too embarrassing to share. If people knew, he couldn't show his face in Hundred Pills Square any longer.
"Controlled by a mere look? It must be an illusion technique of some kind," the girl in yellow mused before falling into deep thought, then began descending the stairs.
Seeing this, the scholar in white followed two steps behind.
In the elegant room on the third floor, Yuan Ming sat with his eyes closed in meditation, then suddenly, he opened them, a look of surprise crossing his face.
His Divine Sense had detected the yellow-clothed girl descending the stairs along with the respectfully following scholar in white. Could this girl be the master of Hundred Pills Square?
Before long, the door creaked open, and the girl in yellow walked in, while the scholar in white did not follow but turned and went downstairs to attend to business.
"The two Fellow Daoists have been waiting for some time. I am Yan Sijing, the master of Hundred Pills Square. May I know the esteemed names of the Fellow Daoists?" The girl in yellow looked at Yuan Ming and bowed slightly.
"Yuan Ming," Yuan Ming replied, sizing up the person before him.
So, the girl truly was the master of Hundred Pills Square. Now that he had seen her true face, things would be easier from here on out.
