Yan Sijing had a cultivation at the Late Foundation Establishment stage. Later, with the help of Black Incense Possession, he would be able to easily plant a Soul Seal on her to control her actions. Combined with Hua Zhi and the soul crow, obtaining a vial of Washing Elixir Spirit Liquid should be an easy feat.
Yan Sijing was also assessing Yuan Ming, thinking to herself about the existence of Cultivation Families with the surname Yuan in Zhao Country, or perhaps even in Qin Country, but failing to draw any conclusions. Rather than worrying herself over it, she left the matter to others in the square to analyze.
"So you are Fellow Daoist Yuan. Have you come to purchase some Washing Elixir Spirit Liquid?" She maintained a smile as she asked.
"Indeed," Yuan Ming answered succinctly.
"I'm afraid I will have to disappoint you, our square..." Yan Sijing began, shaking her head, but her speech suddenly halted as her face showed a look of surprise.
Yuan Ming had seen Yan Sijing's expression. He was about to politely excuse himself and leave when he noticed her reaction, causing him to pause slightly.
"Cough! Thank you for bestowing us with your presence, Fellow Daoist Yuan. The Washing Elixir Spirit Liquid is a secret treasure of Hundred Pills Square; it is extremely rare and usually reserved well in advance by distinguished clients. Normally, it would definitely not be available for immediate purchase. However, your luck is quite good— I've just received news that a customer had a mishap and returned a portion of the Spirit Liquid. If Fellow Daoist Yuan is willing to help our square with a matter, we can offer the Washing Elixir Spirit Liquid at half price," Yan Sijing said after a cough, her tone changing suddenly.
Yuan Ming frowned. Yan Sijing's speech was all over the place, and he wasn't sure what play she was acting in. However, it seemed that things had taken a fortunate turn. If he could obtain the Spirit Liquid through official channels, he had no desire to resort to subterfuge. With the Five Thunder Sect presiding over Purple Thunder City, causing trouble when unnecessary was best avoided.
"What matter does Fellow Daoist Yan wish for me to attend to?" Yuan Ming asked at an unhurried pace.
"Rest assured, Fellow Daoist Yuan, it's not a complicated matter. Three days from now, our square needs to transport a batch of goods to Black Moon City. Lately, bandits have grown rampant in the Black Wind Desert. Recently, one of our caravans was attacked, suffering heavy losses, and we can't spare enough manpower at the moment. Hence, we'd like to ask Fellow Daoist Yuan to accompany the caravan. What do you think?" Yan Sijing said with a smile.
Yuan Ming's eyebrows raised slightly. Escorting goods didn't seem like a difficult task after all.
Still, if it were merely an ordinary escort mission, Yan Sijing shouldn't need to offer the precious Washing Elixir Spirit Liquid as compensation, should she?
"Agreed," Yuan Ming replied after a moment of contemplation.
With his current strength, plus Vajra, Hua Zhi, and Lei Yu, he could retreat unscathed even against one or two Core Formation Cultivators, or even slay them. There wasn't much need to worry, and even if he were no match, he had the means to escape.
"Then I thank you, Fellow Daoist Yuan," Yan Sijing said, her smile beaming.
The two of them then discussed the specifics of the task, and Yuan Ming took his leave at once.
After seeing Yuan Ming and his companion downstairs, Yan Sijing turned and walked up. She quickly returned to the door of the offset hall on the fourth floor of Hundred Pills Square and pushed the door open to enter.
A woman in white sat quietly inside, playing with a white Jade Scroll.
The woman appeared to be in her early twenties, with well-shaped eyebrows, a delicate nose, fair skin, and she bore a resemblance to Yan Sijing by about seventy to eighty percent. However, while Yan Sijing's face carried the freshness of youth and a hint of naivety, the woman in white had a more mature aura, with a curvaceous figure exuding a mature and seductive charm.
Yet the woman's eyes were vacant, devoid of spirit – she was blind.
A tall yellow wooden bookshelf stood beside the woman, reaching nearly to the ceiling with ten layers, each marked with a year, the very top one being the current year.
There were no books on the shelf; instead, each layer was filled with Jade Scrolls, stacked one after another, with the sparsest layer having at least several hundred and the most exceeding a thousand.
The lady in white beckoned with her jade hand, and a jade scroll flew out from the second to the last shelf above, landing in the woman's hand.
"Sister, why did you have me agree to sell Yuan Ming a Washing Elixir Spirit Liquid? The experts we've recruited for this mission are already sufficient. The Washing Elixir Spirit Liquid is difficult to refine, and demand is high; we may not be able to spare it," Yan Sijing sat down beside the woman in white, took her arm, and said in a coquettish voice.
"This Yuan Ming is not simple, just look at this message," the woman in white passed the jade scroll she had just taken down.
Yan Sijing took the jade scroll, activated her Divine Sense to inspect it, and said, "The intelligence on the robbery of the Flame Phosphorus Ore at Guiyuan Sect a year ago? The Nether Moon God? It's probably just some cultivator bluffing and deceiving. Sister, do you think this has something to do with that Yuan Ming we just met?"
"Mmm, Flame Phosphorus Ore is a scarce material. Uncle Qian from our sect specifically investigated this matter. After much effort, we finally obtained the likeness of that self-proclaimed Nether Moon God cultivator a while ago. Take a look," the woman in white took another jade scroll from the first layer of the huanghuali bookshelf and handed it over.
"This likeness, it looks a lot like the one that was just called Yuan Ming," Yan Sijing's eyes lit up.
"Based on past intelligence, the Nether Moon God who robbed the Flame Scale Ore excels in divine soul attacks. According to Manager Huo's description, the Yuan Ming we met earlier also excels in this respect. With such overlapping information, it is very likely the same person," the woman in white said slowly.
"Looking at it this way, it indeed seems very possible. This Yuan Ming was able to rob a Guiyuan Sect's mine and overpower a Core Formation Stage elder by himself—a formidable strength. With him joining, this mission should not be a problem," Yan Sijing nodded thoughtfully.
"Mmm, my intuition also tells me that his addition will bring us a certain positive impact," the woman in white touched her brow with her fingertip and said.
"Really? That's great," Yan Sijing said happily.
"With his addition, some adjustments will need to be made to our previous arrangements. Do as it says on this one," the woman in white handed over another jade scroll she was holding.
"Alright," Yan Sijing took the jade scroll and said without even looking at it.
The woman in white was her biological older sister, named Yan Siyun, born blind but blessed with a keen mind, extreme intelligence, never forgetting any information she heard, and particularly adept at analyzing situations and predicting the future.
The jade scrolls on the huanghuali bookshelf recorded intelligence collected by Hundred Pills Square, including personal information on key figures among the various forces in the Black Wind Desert, events that occurred elsewhere, bounties, and so on.
With the information she collected, Yan Siyun was able to deduce many things.
The woman also possessed a special superpower, an extremely sharp intuition, even to the extent that she could vaguely predict good or bad luck.
Using her deductive skills, combined with the superpower to predict fortunes, Yan Siyun's predictions were highly accurate.
Though the owner of Hundred Pills Square was Yan Sijing, she was only responsible for refining elixirs and handling affairs day-to-day. The real decisions and major strategizing were actually done by her sister.
Yan Sijing refining elixirs and Yan Siyun calculating prospects; the two sisters worked together, allowing Hundred Pills Square to quickly grow and expand over the years.
...
Yuan Ming found an inn near Hundred Pills Square to stay, while Xu Che returned to the tea house to bring Zuo Qinghui and the others over.
In his room at the inn, Yuan Ming set up a Barrier, took out some Black Incense and inserted it into the Stealing Heaven Tripod, lit it, then closed his eyes and began trying to possess Yan Sijing.
At this moment, Yan Sijing was alone in the Alchemy Room.
She exhaled a white flame from her mouth, enveloping the base of a cyan Pill Furnace, her hands rapidly forming signs, in the midst of refining an elixir.
"To think that she's an alchemist—no, she's clearly only at the late stages of Foundation Establishment, so how can she spit out Pill Fire?" Yuan Ming expressed his surprise.Chapterprovidedvia*.
Though he hadn't been distracted by learning alchemy, he was far from unfamiliar with it. Cultivators at the Foundation Establishment Stage generally relied on Spiritual Fires provided by arrays or Earth Fire to refine elixirs.
Only when one's Cultivation reaches the Core Formation Stage, fostering their own Pill Fire, can they refine independently without relying on external flame sources.
"Could it be that Yan Sijing has a Spiritual Body constitution with innate Spiritual Fire?" Yuan Ming suddenly thought of a possibility.
In the Cultivation World, some naturally gifted individuals possess unique Spiritual Body constitutions with inherent superpowers. There are many types of Spiritual Bodies; some people are born with the ability to control the power of the Five Elements, others can communicate with spirit beasts or control ghosts, and so on.
Some individuals with a Fire Attribute Spiritual Body inherently contain Spiritual Fire. Even before reaching Core Formation, the power of their Spiritual Fire is no less than that of a Core Formation Stage Cultivator's Pill Fire, which grants them a significant advantage in Alchemy and Artifact Refining.
As Yuan Ming pondered, Yan Sijing's hands flew, continuously feeding materials into the furnace, her technique expertly refined, clearly showing her level of proficiency in alchemy was far from low.
Yuan Ming hesitated. He possessed Yan Sijing with the intention of investigating the inner workings of Hundred Pills Square's escort mission, but now discovered she was in the midst of refining elixirs.
Over the years, Yuan Ming had been occupied with cultivation, but he also harbored interest in alchemy; it's just that he hadn't found the right person to learn from, and he was too entangled with various matters to divert his attention.
Seeing that Yan Sijing's skills in Alchemy Technique were strong, he recognized a rare opportunity presenting itself.
"Forget it, I'll send the first soul to infiltrate Hundred Pills Square later to further investigate this escort task," Yuan Ming quickly made a decision, settled his mind, and through Yan Sijing's perspective, keenly understood the alchemy process unfolding before him.

chapters.title: Chapter 365 - 342 Departure
chapters.content:
As time ticked away, Yan Sijing's alchemy process was swiftly approaching its end.
She activated the spell, ceasing the fire and opening the furnace.
The top of the azure pill furnace slowly opened, and a rich fragrance of medicine wafted out. Five crimson elixirs hovered within, emitting intense fluctuations of spiritual power, far surpassing those of Foundation Establishment stage elixirs.
"Could these be elixirs used in the Core Formation stage?" Yuan Ming was stunned.
The value of Core Formation stage elixirs was incomparable to those of the Foundation Establishment stage; the difficulty of refining them was also more than tenfold. If Yan Sijing could refine such elixirs, her alchemy level was far beyond his expectations.
A surge of joy immediately rose in Yuan Ming's heart. Perhaps it was because his Divine Soul had grown much stronger; although he had only perceived it once, he had basically mastered the refining process of these crimson elixirs and had also memorized the required spiritual materials.
Yuan Ming had a premonition that as long as he could find those materials, his success rate in refining the crimson elixirs would not be low, and if he had the chance to comprehend it a few more times, his proficiency in alchemy would greatly increase.
The possession soon ended, and his consciousness returned to his own body.
Yuan Ming didn't actually go looking for materials to refine elixirs, as the most important thing at the moment was the escort mission three days later.
He put away the Stealing Heaven Tripod and released his first soul to travel underground toward Hundred Pills Square.
...
Three days later, Yuan Ming arrived at Hundred Pills Square on time as agreed and saw a maid in green waiting at the door.
"Senior Yuan, please follow me, miss and the other seniors are already waiting upstairs."
Yuan Ming nodded and followed the maid upstairs. Along the way, he casually asked, "How many Fellow Daoists did your workshop invite to participate in the escort mission?"
"In addition to yourself, senior, there are two other seniors who have accepted the task. Including the tributor and elder of our workshop, there are five participants in total," the maid replied.
As they spoke, the maid led Yuan Ming to a private room on the second floor and opened the door for him.
Hearing the movement, the several people sitting inside all turned to look at the door.Your support on * keeps this series going.
Yuan Ming glanced around the room and saw Yan Sijing sitting in the seat of honor, giving him a slight nod of acknowledgment. To her right was a female cultivator in a green dress and a flower hairpin, with a beauty mark at the corner of her mouth, at the Late-stage Foundation Establishment.
To the left was an ordinary-looking middle-aged male cultivator, dressed in a plain gray robe, seemingly unremarkable, but his cultivation was at the Early-stage Core Formation, and his gaze toward Yuan Ming was full of scrutiny.
Apart from them, there were two more Foundation Establishment cultivators in the room, one particularly short, at least a head shorter than Yuan Ming, and the other fair and beardless, with the appearance of a scholar, gently waving a folding fan in his hand.
They too were of Late-stage Foundation Establishment Cultivation.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming's gaze sharpened slightly. Hundred Pills Square had not only offered the Washing Elixir Spirit Liquid as a reward for this escort mission, but they had also invited Late-stage Foundation Establishment cultivators and sent a Core Formation Elder to lead the mission, suggesting that the task was not as simple as Yan Sijing had previously mentioned.
However, Yuan Ming had already anticipated this, so he did not hesitate and entered the room confidently, finding a seat to sit down without concern.
Seeing Yuan Ming seated, Yan Sijing immediately smiled and introduced him,
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, you've arrived. Let me introduce you. The two beside me are Sacrificial Officer Ai and Elder Chai from our workshop, who are leading this mission. This is Fellow Daoist Gan from Hidden Hill Sect, whose mastery of Earth Magic is almost unparalleled among fellow cultivators at the same stage, and this is Mr. Bei Yan, whose Wind Manipulation Technique is incredibly refined, once forcing back three cultivators of the same stage single-handedly."
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming gave everyone a polite fist salute and said, "I am Yuan Ming, it is an honor to meet you all."
Sacrificial Officer Ai and Mr. Bei Yan returned the gesture, while Elder Chai just nodded slightly. The short-statured Cultivator Gan looked Yuan Ming up and down before bluntly asking, "I'm quite familiar with the cultivators in Purple Thunder City, so how come I've never heard the name Fellow Daoist Yuan before?"
Yuan Ming replied with an indifferent smile, "I have been cultivating in another city, quite far from Purple Thunder City, beyond the reach of Fellow Daoist's attention."
At that remark, Mr. Bei Yan laughed softly while Cultivator Gan furrowed his brows, sensing something amiss in Yuan Ming's words but unable to pinpoint the issue immediately.
Yan Sijing, sitting at the head of the room, also picked up on the implication in Yuan Ming's words that Cultivator Gan had a narrow view, her lips curling at the edges, but she did not comment. Instead, she shifted the conversation,
"Well, now that everyone is here, let me further explain the details of the mission to you all."
At her words, everyone, including Yuan Ming, focused their attention on Yan Sijing.
Yan Sijing paused for a brief moment before continuing, "The caravan that all of you need to escort this time is headed for Black Moon City. Along the way, it will stop in Qianjun City and Oasis City for a few days to resupply. Apart from basic spiritual medicine and supplies, there is also a batch of precious elixirs ordered by Sha Ran Valley. This batch of elixirs is crucial to our workshop's reputation and must not encounter any mishap. Hence, we have made special arrangements."
As she spoke, she clapped her hands, and immediately several maids entered in file, each carrying a tray, and stood in front of the group.
On each tray, there was a gray storage bag, all sealed with forbidden spells and impossible to open casually.
"Among these five storage bags, only one contains the order for Sha Ran Valley. The rest are just decoys, but which one exactly contains the elixirs is unknown even to Elder Chai of our workshop. Therefore, I ask each of you to carry one, taking good care of the storage bag you are entrusted with. As long as it safely reaches Black Moon City in the end, the task is considered complete. Whether it is the actual bag or not, our workshop will present the agreed-upon remuneration with both hands," she explained.
Hearing this, Yuan Ming and the other two also dismissed the idea of probing further and directly accepted the storage bags.
Mr. Bei Yan suddenly asked, "Fellow Daoist Yan, the previous caravan from your workshop was robbed because it was transporting these goods, right? Have the identities of the bandits been investigated clearly?"
Yan Sijing's expression darkened slightly as she shook her head, "At present, we only know that they call themselves Feiyu and have a Core Formation Cultivator among them; the rest remains unknown."
Hearing this, Mr. Bei Yan snapped his folding fan shut on the palm of his other hand, sighed with heavy concern, and said, "Alas, although the Black Wind Desert has never been a place of peace, lately, major incidents are happening frequently. First was the inexplicable destruction of Earth River City, then the mining area of Guiyuan Sect was destroyed by something called the Nether Moon God, and now even Core Formation Cultivators have turned into sand pirates. If this continues, it's hard to say what else might happen."
"That's how it is. Where in the world is not in chaos? The small and large sects of the Northern Desert are constantly fighting, the Western Region and Qin Country have recently started disputes, and the Southern Border wiped out a well-known sect a few years ago. The East Sea is even more serious; news of the Three Immortals Island emerging has spread far and wide, drawing many cultivators there. Daily, countless conflicts arise and even the seemingly peaceful Central Plains has had many high-rankings sect members assassinated by an unidentified power in the past few years, with no results found to this day," said Cultivator Gan nonchalantly.
Mr. Bei Yan shook his head noncommittally, his face still showing concern, while Yuan Ming appeared indifferent, showing no emotion.
At that moment, someone from outside suddenly reported that the caravan was ready. Yan Sijing immediately stood up, said a few more words, and then had Elder Chai and Sacrificial Officer Ai lead everyone to the caravan's assembly point to set off.
...
Several days later, at dusk.
Taking advantage of the daylight before night fell, the Hundred Pills Square caravan, having traveled all day, set up camp on the spot, ready to rest.
However, Yuan Ming, who was among the convoy, gradually developed doubts.
Though the journey had been uneventful these past few days, and the soul crows he had sent to scout around had not seen any sand pirates or suspicious cultivators approaching, the incredibly slow pace of the Hundred Pills Square caravan was beyond what he expected.
Logically, since the goods were important and there was a potential encounter with sand pirates on the way, the Hundred Pills Square caravan should be rushing day and night, or at the very least hurrying as fast as possible. Their speed could not possibly be slower than the mortal caravan Yuan Ming had joined when he first came to the Black Wind Desert.
When Yuan Ming shared his doubts with Sacrificial Officer Ai, he received an unexpected answer.
"Please forgive us, Fellow Daoist Yuan. After the last robbery, our workshop suffered heavy losses. We lost several tributors, and many of the experienced merchants among the mortals were killed or injured. Even the carefully-selected camels meant for transporting the goods were also taken away. The reorganization of the caravan has been hurried and many are inexperienced, which has slowed down our pace," Sacrificial Officer Ai responded with a wry smile.
"If that is the case, why not let us, who are carrying the important elixirs, go ahead first, and later assign personnel to deliver the remaining goods?" Yuan Ming inquired further.
Sacrificial Officer Ai sighed, "After the caravan was robbed last time, the workshop owner reassigned a large number of people to deal with other matters. Now, even those who can accompany the caravan are..."
Yuan Ming then realized, Hundred Pills Square was in a difficult situation and naturally wanted to spend money on one task to accomplish two. That explained why they, the Late-stage Foundation Establishment Cultivators, had taken on the job which should have been undertaken by Qi Refining cultivators.
Sacrificial Officer Ai gave the same explanation to Mr. Bei Yan and Cultivator Gan. Although they were somewhat dissatisfied, considering the remuneration, they ultimately had nothing more to say.
That night, Yuan Ming sat silently meditating in his tent, pondering over Sacrificial Officer Ai's explanation, yet he had a nagging feeling that something was not quite right.
Reassembling the personnel in a rush without understanding the origins of the sand pirates, even hiring several Late-stage Foundation Establishment Cultivators for protection, still didn't seem safe enough.
Moreover, Hundred Pills Square was a large workshop, with Core Formation Cultivators in its ranks, capable of producing Washing Elixir Spirit Liquid of such grade. It was unlikely that it would fall into such decline simply because of one instance of being plundered.
As he was contemplating, the ground next to him loosened, and Hua Zhi suddenly burrowed up from below, arriving in front of Yuan Ming.
"Master, there are eight cultivators about dozens of miles to the northeast, rushing here using the Earth Tunneling Technique," Hua Zhi reported.
"What is their cultivation level?" Yuan Ming raised an eyebrow and asked.
"The one leading them seems to be a Core Formation Stage cultivator, going by the aura. I didn't dare get too close, for fear of being discovered," Hua Zhi replied.
Yuan Ming nodded and immediately got up, intending to inform the others in the caravan of the situation. However, as soon as he stepped out of the tent, he saw Elder Chai, dressed in a plain gray robe, standing not far from the tent, his hands clasped behind his back, gazing up at the stars in the sky.

chapters.title: Chapter 366 - 343: Something's Not Right
chapters.content:
"It's so late, and you're in such a hurry; is there something you need to say?" Elder Chai turned his head and asked Yuan Ming.
A glint of spirit light flashed in Yuan Ming's eyes, and without a word, he took two steps back before saying, "Junior has just detected a group of cultivators heading this way, among which there are some at the Core Formation Stage."
Elder Chai nodded slightly, seemingly unsurprised, but still, he stirred his mana, sending his voice throughout the entire encampment.
"Enemy attack, wake up quickly!"
The quickest to respond were naturally Mr. Bei Yan and others; almost as soon as the words were spoken, they rushed out from their tents with faces full of shock and doubt, at the same time using their divine sense to probe their surroundings.
However, they soon discovered that there was no sign of the enemy nearby, which left them somewhat puzzled.
Seeing Yuan Ming and Elder Chai standing outside, they immediately asked, "Elder Chai, where is the enemy attacking from? How many are they, and what are their cultivation levels?"
Elder Chai raised his hand and pointed towards Yuan Ming, saying, "He's the one who noticed them."
Mr. Bei Yan and the others looked even more surprised, and Cultivator Gan hummed dissatisfiedly, saying, "There are no enemies nearby, could it be that you dreamt them up last night?"
Yuan Ming couldn't be bothered to argue with him, and he simply pointed to Hua Zhi and said, "It was my spirit pet that discovered them, to the northeast, there are a total of eight cultivators tunneling through the earth, and the leader has Core Formation Stage cultivation."
"Earth Tunneling? Dare to use this technique in front of me, truly ignorant of their own limits," sneered Cultivator Gan.
Then, he immediately formed a spell with both hands, his mana surged forth, and he stamped his right foot firmly on the ground.
In an instant, a ring of earthy yellow light spread from his feet, reaching beyond the encampment in just a moment.
Yuan Ming immediately felt the sandy ground underfoot become much harder, while Mr. Bei Yan let out a sigh of relief and laughed, "With Fellow Daoist Gan's Solid Ground Technique, those people will have a hard time if they try to tunnel from below."
Cultivator Gan laughed heartily, "Of course, they don't even know who I am, how could they get the better of me in earth techniques?"
He had hardly finished speaking when his face suddenly stiffened, and then, the sound of earth breaking suddenly erupted as eight cultivators burrowed out from different directions outside the encampment, stepping on magic artifacts and flying up into the air, looking down over the five people in the camp from a superior position.
Among them, two were actually standing on void, clearly being at the Core Formation Stage.
One of the two Core Formation cultivators was a young man around twenty-five or twenty-six, handsome and extraordinary in appearance, but his brows and eyes were full of pride, while the other was an older man with two strands of white hair hanging over his shoulders, hands crossed behind his back, standing upright, albeit half a step behind the young man.
The young cultivator glanced at Cultivator Gan in the encampment and sneered with disdain,
"So this is Gan Tan from Purple Thunder City, famous for his earth techniques? Under the reputation, indeed, there is no real substance. This Solid Ground Technique of yours is not even as good as that used by my spiritual dog."
Upon hearing the young cultivator's mockery, Cultivator Gan was fuming with rage, but when he looked up and saw the two Core Formation figures standing in the air, he felt as though a bucket of cold water had been poured over his head, extinguishing not just his anger, but leaving him even too afraid to retort.
As for Mr. Bei Yan and Sacrificial Officer Ai, their faces were full of surprise and fear. They hadn't expected the sand pirates, who only dared to raid caravans, to actually have two Core Formation leaders.
With such cultivation, they would be honor guests in any faction no matter where they went; they could even start their own underground city, become the lord of a city—why would they stoop to being sand pirates when there were far more enjoyable things to do?
Among these Foundation Establishment cultivators, only Yuan Ming remained calm. His gaze lingered on the young man and the elder for a moment, and his mind raced as he began to calculate his possible responses.
It was then that he suddenly glanced at Elder Chai standing not far away. Faced with the siege of two cultivators of the same rank, this person seemed to have breathed a sigh of relief.
"Something's not right!"
Yuan Ming, recalling all the suspicious points he had observed earlier, was full of doubts and gradually began to think of retreating.
"I am Chai Jiujin, an elder of the Hundred Pills Square, leading this trading expedition. The elixirs we're delivering are from Sha Ran Valley. Aren't you afraid of being encircled and suppressed by our workshop in conjunction with Sha Ran Valley if you rob us?" Elder Chai reprimanded loudly.
"Haha, Elder Chai, you can save the name-dropping of Sha Ran Valley. We wouldn't dare to rob you if we hadn't inquired about your situation thoroughly. To tell you the truth, if it weren't for the Hundred Pills Square's caravan, I wouldn't even bother robbing you!" the young cultivator laughed.
"The Hundred Pills Square has been operating for many years, aiming to treat people kindly. I wonder what offense we have given to you for such resentment," said Chai Jiujin, frowning, his voice still not hurried.
"The Hundred Pills Square has done enough to offend me. As for the reason, Elder Chai, you might have to journey the Netherworld Road and ask your old workshop owner," said the young cultivator.
"Indeed, you must be Feiyu, the last caravan led by Old Yan was also raided by you!" Chai Jiujin's eyes flashed with insight.
"Heh heh, now you know, but it's already too late! Attack!"
The young cultivator sneered coldly, and before his voice had even faded, he opened his mouth to spew a burst of purple light, which disappeared with a peal of thunder in an instant.
Chai Jiujin seemed to have been prepared, immediately raising his hand to throw out the Pure White Jade Ring, which had been concealed in his palm. With a flash of milky light, it hovered above his head and dropped down a pale white Light Shield, protecting him from all sides.
No sooner had the Light Shield formed than the vanished purple light suddenly reappeared and struck it directly, erupting into blinding purple radiance.
The brightness forced Chai Jiujin to close his eyes in the next instant, and when the light dissipated, he discovered to his horror that the purple light was actually a small sword wrapped in purple lightning, and more terrifyingly, just that one strike had cracked the Light Shield protecting him.
This sent a wave of shock through him; after all, his Ice Jade Ring was a Lifebound Magical Treasure that he had nurtured with great care. Although its techniques were limited, its defensive power was so strong that even the Magic Treasures of mid-stage Core Formation Cultivators could hardly break through.
Yet this young cultivator, clearly at the early stage of Core Formation himself, where did he get such a powerful Magic Treasure?
Seeing his Purple Lightning Small Sword fail to achieve its effect, the young cultivator seemed somewhat surprised as well. Glancing at the Jade Ring over Chai Jiujin's head, a glint of greed passed through his eyes.
Then, under Chai Jiujin's astonished gaze, the young cultivator's left palm faced upward, and with a lift, a Jade Seal instantly appeared, surrounded by spirit light, its power seemingly even greater than the Purple Lightning Small Sword.
Although Chai Jiujin was an elder of the Hundred Pills Square, he was not particularly wealthy. Refining the Ice Jade Ring had almost exhausted his savings, yet this young cultivator was just a sand pirate, and not only did he possess many Magic Treasures, but they were also incredibly powerful.
While Chai Jiujin was lost in shock and suspicion, on the other side, Mr. Bei Yan and the others were also caught in a fierce battle.
Although they were facing opponents at the late stage of Foundation Establishment, nearly every one of them managed to bring out several High Grade magical tools, and there were even two using top-grade magical tools. Moreover, they were outnumbered, barely holding on, looking as disheveled as one could be.
The only exception was Yuan Ming; after entangling an enemy with Hua Zhi, he drew out the Blood Transformation Saber and engaged a cultivator wielding a top-grade magical tool in close combat, with bursts of colored spirit light flashing incessantly between them. The fight seemed intense, but in reality, Yuan Ming had already ensnared his opponent with an Illusion Technique, completely controlling the direction of the battle. Moreover, he was multitasking, keeping an eye on the Core Formation battlefield while exchanging blows.
When the young cultivator took out a second Magic Treasure, Yuan Ming was also slightly surprised, but soon his attention was drawn to something else.
Ever since making his appearance, the elder had been standing behind the young cultivator with his hands behind his back, silently observing the fight between the young cultivator and Chai Jiujin, with no indication of joining in.
With a hint of doubt in his heart, Yuan Ming covertly switched to view through the soul crows he had earlier released as sentries, only to see that the elder's hand, hidden behind his back, held an Array Plate, flickering with spirit light, seemingly on the verge of activation.
Realizing what was happening, Yuan Ming immediately warned, "Careful, that man is activating a Formation!"
At these words, Chai Jiujin's heart skipped a beat. Glancing at the elder, he quickly pieced things together, his face immediately turning pale.
Hearing Yuan Ming's words, the young cultivator also glanced back at him with a hint of surprise in his eyes.
"You are quite perceptive. Elder Guo, no need to hide anymore, activate the Formation now!" The latest chapters are uploaded first on *.
"Yes, Young Master!"
The cultivator known as Elder Guo immediately ceased his hand movements, held the Array Plate before his chest, and his left hand rapidly formed spells, abruptly pointing towards the Array Plate.
In the next instant, countless lights lit up around the camp, and a verdant green light screen rose from the ground, swiftly closing in. In the blink of an eye, it was about to completely envelop the camp.
At this moment, Chai Jiujin, with an expression of painful resignation, took out a talisman inscribed with unknown runes and slapped it onto his body.
Instantly, a ghostly blue glow enveloped his entire figure, and just before the Array Formation Light Shield could fully close, it transformed him into a streak of light that flew out.
Seeing this, the young cultivator's face darkened, and Elder Guo hastily said, "Forgive me, Young Master, for my oversight that allowed our plan to be seen through. Please permit me to make amends and capture Chai Jiujin."
The young cultivator immediately shook his head, "No, the object is more important. I will pursue Chai the Old Dog, you kill everyone here, and take their Storage Bags from Hundred Pills Square before coming to assist me."
Having said this, he too quickly executed a spell, turning into a streak of light to chase after the fleeing Elder Chai.
Elder Guo watched the young cultivator depart and then looked at Yuan Ming, trapped within the Formation, with resentment. If it were not for him revealing the Formation, there would have been no need to rush, and they might not have let Chai Jiujin escape, causing him to lose face in front of the Young Master.
With this in mind, a surge of murderous intent welled up within him. He intended to enter the Formation and personally execute Yuan Ming, but to his surprise, Yuan Ming within the Formation suddenly spoke up, saying to Mr. Bei Yan and the others:
"When I break the Formation, think of a way to escape with me."
His voice was calm, betraying not the slightest bit of fear or nervousness.

chapters.title: Chapter 367 - 344: Killing Intent
chapters.content:
Mr. Bei Yan and the others were being suppressed by their opponents, and upon seeing the trapping array take form, their hearts sank even further into despair.
In their distress, hearing Yuan Ming make such a claim was like grasping at a lifeline, and without pausing to consider whether Yuan Ming could actually break the formation, they all readily agreed.
Outside the formation, Old Guo couldn't help but burst into laughter, "You junior, are truly ignorant of the vastness of heaven and earth. This formation is the product of my meticulous research, designed to allow entry but no exit. Even a Core Formation Stage cultivator would have to expend considerable effort to break free, and here you are, a mere Foundation Establishment cultivator, making such bold claims? Ha-ha, if you really can do it, I'll eat this Array Plate right in front of you!"
Yuan Ming gave Old Guo a look that was both mocking and indifferent, "Then, senior had better prepare some water to moisten your throat."
No sooner had he spoken than he flipped the Blood Blade in his hand, a trail of blade light flickered, and amidst the flurry of crimson blade shadows, the Foundation Establishment cultivator he was facing suddenly became confused, standing motionless on the spot with their Magic Artifact hanging in mid-air.
"Hiss."
A flash of Blood Light, and the cultivator's head effortlessly rolled to the ground, while the body remained standing upright in place.
At the same moment, Hua Zhi demonstrated its might, using the purple-black vines that stretched out from underground to tightly bind its opponent and injecting a potent venom, instantly rendering them incapacitated.
Then, Hua Zhi swayed its form and stood at Yuan Ming's side.
Almost simultaneously, Yuan Ming slapped his Storage Bag, and Vajra appeared at Yuan Ming's other side.
The smile had yet to fade from Old Guo's face when two of their cultivators fell, and the addition of a golden-haired demon ape as tall as a person caused his smile to freeze instantly.
The other spectators watched this scene with varied expressions, their attention now focused on Yuan Ming and the Hua Zhi Vajra at his side.
"So, you have powerful demon beasts at your side; no wonder you're so confident," Old Guo remarked as his voice fell, spitting out a Bronze Small Tripod. With a spin in mid-air, it suddenly grew to the size of a zhang, then the many carvings on the tripod lit up one after another, and several groups of golden fireballs the size of human heads emerged from the tripod, whistling towards Yuan Ming and Hua Zhi Vajra.
However, Vajra, seeing this display, had not the slightest intention of dodging.
With a fierce step forward, it spread its arms wide, its fists the size of pots pounding on its chest with a deep thud, echoing like a gong.
Then it twisted its body, pulling its arms back, aligning its fists with its waist, and the breath it took became robust, even exhaling breaths like thunder from its nostrils, its internal organs pounding violently like drums.
The golden fireballs pierced through the formation and, in an instant, arrived before Vajra. In that split second, Vajra took a deep breath, and the people in the camp suddenly felt as if a strong wind had blown past, whisking them towards Vajra by a couple of steps.
The next instant, Vajra's right fist shot out abruptly, and an invisible force surged from its fist. Everyone felt a brief silence at their ears, followed by a thunderous explosion as the incoming fireballs burst into nothingness; the flames were caught by the raging wind from the fist's blast and obliterated in the blink of an eye.
The relentless force of the punch then struck the Array Formation Light Shield in the next breath, tearing open a hole as if through thin air. Following the sound of shattering crystal, the Array Formation Light Shield collapsed instantaneously, yet the force of the punch didn't dissipate and continued forward, barreling towards Old Guo.
"Hundred-step Divine Fist!"
Seeing this, Old Guo paled and shouted in panic, then promptly started backpedaling explosively, retreating over a hundred steps away from Vajra in a flash.
Vajra's punch followed through like a shadow, moving faster than Old Guo. Although the punch was ferociously formidable, its power waned beyond a hundred steps, and when it reached Old Guo, only a breeze caressed his cheek.
Even then, Old Guo wore a look of having survived a scare, and his facial expression seemed to be haunted by some unpleasant memories.
Meanwhile, in the midst of the formation, Yuan Ming's expression remained calm and composed from beginning to end, as if he had already anticipated the power of Vajra's punch, showing no sign of surprise.
However, the instant Vajra broke the formation, he immediately stored Vajra and Hua Zhi back into the Spiritual Beast Bag, then summoned Lei Yu, leaped onto it, and burst through the breach in the formation, fleeing swiftly toward the southwest without looking back.
As for the true nature of Hundred Pills Square's escort mission, Yuan Ming was unclear. Now, with the situation taking a critical turn, he naturally wouldn't fight on behalf of Hundred Pills Square, especially considering Chai Jiujin's strange reaction when attacked, which made Yuan Ming feel that there were secrets hidden within the escort mission.
Regarding the Washing Elixir Spirit Liquid, Yuan Ming felt confident in his multitude of methods, so obtaining it would not be difficult knowing its whereabouts. There was no need to get entangled in unnecessary disputes over an uncertain promise, attracting trouble for himself.
But even as he tried to retreat, Old Guo wasn't willing to let him go.
Seeing Yuan Ming escaping on a spirit beast, Old Guo's face darkened.
He glanced at the rest still fiercely battling inside the formation. Seeing that his men seemed capable of engaging them for a while longer, he decisively slapped a green talisman onto himself and pinched a spell with his other hand. His figure suddenly shot up from the ground, becoming a tunneling light chasing after Yuan Ming.
...
Chai Jiujin and the young cultivator chased and fled, covering a hundred li in the blink of an eye, and the distance between them had already closed to thirty zhang.
A trail of thunder passed over the fingertips of the young cultivator, a slender purple lightning shot out, revealing it to be a Purple Lightning Small Sword.
The Purple Lightning Small Sword was astoundingly fast, covering the thirty-zhang distance in a flash, aiming for a stab at Chai Jiujin's back.
Just at that moment, nine earthen yellow Flying Knives erupted from the ground, forming a net of blades that caught the Purple Lightning Small Sword.
After a series of loud clangs, the Purple Lightning Small Sword was repelled, and the earth-yellow Flying Knives were also sent flying.
The young cultivator was shocked and hurriedly summoned his purple small sword, turning to flee.
However, behind him, the void fluctuated, and five or six figures appeared, led by a man with the build of a bear and the waist of a tiger, his hair blonde and his cultivation at the mid-stage of Core Formation.
Yan Sijing and Yan Siyun stood on a white Flying Boat, hovering near the blond-haired man.
The rest were also Cultivators at the mid to late stages of Foundation Establishment, none of them weak.
Chai Jiujin also flew back, joining forces with Yan Sijing and others to surround the young cultivator in the middle.
"Hundred Pills Square's two Core Formation Stage Tributors are all here, it seems that you came prepared this time, with a layout to capture me," the young cultivator said, regaining his composure after his initial panic.
"Scoundrel, you robbed my caravan, killed my uncle, today your retribution has arrived!" Yan Sijing shouted fiercely, raising a black giant brush Magic Treasure, ready to strike.
"Who are you, exactly? Why are you repeatedly antagonizing Hundred Pills Square?" Yan Siyun stopped her sister and asked.
The young cultivator remained silent.
The blond-haired man suddenly let out a low shout, and in front of him appeared an ancient white mirror, which emitted a bright crystal light, striking at the void a dozen zhang away.
A burst of white crystal light exploded, and the young cultivator's figure emerged.
The figure of the young cultivator surrounded by the crowd shattered like a bubble, turning into a crystal-clear white talisman, which then completely fragmented with a bang.
"Substitute Talisman!" Yan Sijing exclaimed in shock and anger.
The blond-haired man moved like lightning, blocking the young cultivator's path once again.
"If you remain silent when questioned, then you must leave your life behind today," Yan Siyun said calmly.
Upon hearing this, Chai Jiujin and the blond-haired man immediately controlled their Magic Treasures and made their move.
The Ice Jade Ring shook and turned into five seemingly illusory ring shadows, swirling towards the young cultivator's body.
The blond-haired man's nine Flying Knives were even faster, leaving behind afterimages as they stabbed at the young cultivator's vital points.
Yan Sijing raised her black giant brush, and from the tip of the brush shot hundreds of black threads, all aimed at the young cultivator.
The other Foundation Establishment Cultivators pounced forward, raising their Magic Artifacts one after another, and a torrential downpour of attacks also headed towards their opponent.
"Damn it!" The young cultivator, intermingled with shock and rage, hastened to drive the Purple Lightning Small Sword and the Jade Seal in defense, with multicolored lights emerging frequently as the two sides battled into a melee.
Read ahead and get updates by visiting *.
...
Old Guo's tunneling speed far exceeded Lei Yu, but perhaps out of wariness of Hua Zhi Vajra, he always hung behind Yuan Ming, maintaining a distance of at least a hundred steps, while also activating his Magic Treasure, shooting out orange-red Fireballs the size of human heads at Yuan Ming's location.
Yuan Ming, manipulating Lei Yu, nimbly dodged the Fireballs, and glancing back to see Old Guo in relentless pursuit, felt a nameless anger well up within him.
If it were a one-on-one fight, he did not fear this Old Guo, but he did not want to attract trouble, and yet the other party persisted so tenaciously.
With that thought, Yuan Ming's mind moved, and in the clouds above Old Guo's head, a soul crow appeared, its beak opened, and a black sound wave struck right at Old Guo, who was caught off guard.
Struck by the Crow Cry, Old Guo instantly felt his Sea of Consciousness tremble and his Divine Soul shudder. He was briefly dazed and, upon regaining his senses, realized he was still standing mid-air, but Yuan Ming, whom he had been chasing, had already disappeared from sight. In his place was the young cultivator who had gone to kill Chai Jiujin.
At that moment, the young cultivator held a dead body in each hand, which upon closer inspection turned out to be Chai Jiujin and Yuan Ming.
"Useless, I ordered you to kill those people, and yet you let them escape! If I had not arrived in time, how would you have ended this?" the young cultivator scolded.
Old Guo immediately became flustered and was about to step forward, "Young Master, forgive me, I..."
But just then, a cool sensation came from his waist and abdomen, instantly rushing into his Sea of Consciousness, as if someone had poured a bucket of ice water over his head, making him instantly sober.
The scenery before his eyes also changed rapidly, and the young cultivator's figure disappeared in an instant, replaced by Yuan Ming, who stood on the back of Lei Yu with a hint of surprise in his eyes.
At the same time, a blood-colored blade light was slicing straight towards him, just seven or eight zhang away.
Old Guo, in fright, hastily pinched a spell with his right hand, and a surge of crimson mana burst forth from his sleeve, rapidly condensing into a Flame Shield in front of him to block the blood-colored blade light.
Due to the hasty casting, the Flame Shield's strength was not high and, after a brief stalemate, was shattered by the blade light, but that brief moment was enough for Old Guo to recall the Bronze Small Tripod to protect himself with the Magic Treasure.
Yuan Ming did not wish to clash directly with Magic Treasures using the Blood Transformation Saber, so he recalled it, and at that moment, Old Guo's attention was not on the Blood Blade but was fixed on Yuan Ming, his eyes full of wariness.
"With such a level of Illusion Technique, you are a Soul Cultivator!"

chapters.title: Chapter 368 - 345 Bait
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming raised an eyebrow, not engaging in conversation.
He already harbored the intent to kill Elder Guo; now that his identity as a Soul Cultivator was revealed, he was even less likely to let him go.
Without further ado, Yuan Ming's mind moved, and instantly five soul crows flew out from his Sea of Consciousness, circling above his head.
Seeing this, Elder Guo began to regret pursuing him, especially now knowing that Yuan Ming was a Soul Cultivator.
After all, with his experience as a Core Formation Cultivator, he knew some Soul Cultivators focused so much on cultivating their Divine Soul Power that, while their Magic Power Cultivation and Physical Body might appear weak, their mastery in Soul Cultivation could reach a level capable of killing invisibly.
However, judging by the current situation, his opponent was likely just a Foundation Establishment Soul Cultivator. As long as he was cautious, there should be no danger.
Immediately feeling as if facing a great enemy, he took off a jade pendant from his waist, held it in his palm, and started casting spells on it, while chanting a spell, then suddenly bit his tongue and sprayed Essence Blood onto the jade pendant.
The jade pendant instantly absorbed the blood, then flew up automatically, hovering over Old Guo's head, emitting a dazzling pale blue light.
Struck by this light, Elder Guo felt his Spirit Platform become clear and his Divine Soul purified as an invisible force enveloped his Sea of Consciousness, blocking all external influences.
Yuan Ming, on the other hand, seeing Elder Guo deploying his technique, also focused his gaze, his Sea of Consciousness stirring with Soul Power. The six soul crows immediately spread their wings and lined up from top to bottom.
Following that, their eyes suddenly flashed red, and a surging Soul Power emerged like threads from their bodies, instantly connecting them together in mid-air to form an array pattern.
Just as all the soul crows connected, they opened their mouths to emit crow cries, yet the sound waves didn't come from their mouths but surged from the center of the formation instead.
The black sound wave was several times larger than before, creating the illusion of a sky obscured by black mist.
This was the Soul Crow Formation that Yuan Ming had developed after analyzing the battle formation techniques of the Guiyuan Sect, which could amplify the power of crow cries several times depending on the number of soul crows in the formation.
Yet Elder Guo, protected by the spirit light of the jade pendant, seemed overly confident, even showing a disdainful smile.
"If you were a love witch, I might have feared you somewhat, but alas, you are just an illusion witch. Today you've fallen into my hands!" he said.
Sure enough, as the black sound waves surged like tidal waves and met the pale blue light emitted by the jade pendant, they instantly dispersed.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming panicked, while Elder Guo promptly activated his Magic Treasure, unleashing countless fireballs that completely engulfed both Yuan Ming and Lei Yu.
Elder Guo laughed heartily, letting his guard down, and flew forward to catch the charred corpse of Yuan Ming.
"I didn't expect to find such unexpected joys on this trip out. Although he was just an illusion witch, with this merit, the sect will surely—"
He didn't finish his words when he suddenly felt a pain in his neck, and everything before him vanished, leaving only a hand gripping his head and some light filtering through the fingers.
From the corner of his eye, he could still vaguely see a headless body, wearing clothes he found all too familiar.
Yuan Ming used the Blood Transformation Saber to cut off Elder Guo's head, stowing his body while swiftly grabbing his head to perform a Soul Search before his Divine Soul scattered.
Soon, Elder Guo lost all traces of life, and his Divine Soul dissipated into the Heaven and Earth.
But Yuan Ming, through observing his memories, obtained some of the information he desired.
To his surprise, this Elder Guo was not some nameless Loose Cultivator but a Guest Elder of the Five Thunder Sect.
In his youth, he had been severely injured by a Core Formation Body Cultivator and had barely managed to cling to life by taking refuge in the Five Thunder Sect.
As an outsider, he didn't have much status within the sect and had relied on a young cultivator he called Young Master, eventually following him to Black Wind Desert.
This Young Master, whose name was Yu Hong, was responsible for the business of the Five Thunder Sect's shops in Black Wind Desert. He secretly recruited a troop of Foundation Establishment Loose Cultivators to pose as sand pirates and raid rival shops when they encroached on his business.
This time, Yu Hong targeted Hundred Pills Square partly because they had stolen his business and partly because he had taken a fancy to Yan Sijing, aiming to drive her into a tight spot before taking her as a Furnace Tripod.
Therefore, he had specially brought Elder Guo, disguised, to personally ensure the raid was successful.
The jade pendant he had used was actually a unique Magic Artifact of the Five Thunder Sect, known as "Heart-Clearing Pendant," designed specifically to ward off Soul Cultivator's Illusion Techniques.
Similar artifacts were quite common in the Five Thunder Sect, but Elder Guo was not clear about the specific reasons.
Within the sect, the titles for Soul Cultivators were also different, classified not as ordinary Qi Refinement or Foundation Establishment but as soul witch, illusion witch, and love witch, although Elder Guo didn't know why this differentiation existed.
Yuan Ming stowed Elder Guo's head, thought a moment, but still felt something was amiss.
In Elder Guo's memory, Yu Hong and Hundred Pills Square were not cohorts; they were genuinely there to raid the caravan. But why did Chai Jiujin seem to foresee their arrival as if he had prior knowledge?
At this thought, Yuan Ming immediately shifted his focus to the first soul splitting.
As Chai Jiujin fled, he had also secretly released his first soul splitting, transforming it into an invisible soul crow, closely following Chai Jiujin to uncover the true nature of this escort mission.
However, when Yuan Ming saw the situation through his first soul splitting, he was taken aback.
...
Above the desert, the battle had already been decided.
Chai Jiujin's forehead was sweating as he tightly controlled the Ice Jade Ring that entangled the Purple Lightning Small Sword. Next to him, another Core Formation Elder from the Hundred Pills Square had a slightly somber look as he rapidly tapped his fingers towards the void in front of him.
Following bursts of yellow light, nine earthy yellow Flying Knives materialized, splashing a sky full of knife shadows that directly chopped the Jade Seal away, and then chopped down towards Yu Hong.
By that time, Yu Hong had lost his previously arrogant demeanor. He fled in a wretched manner while roaring with a ferocity that belied his fear, "Do you know who I am? Dare to kill me, and you will definitely—"
The sound of a blade piercing flesh abruptly rang out, and Yu Hong's words were interrupted by his own wails. He could no longer maintain his Mana and screamed as he fell from the sky.
His body, covered in blood, heavily smashed onto the sandy ground, his bones instantly shattered, and fresh blood gushed from his wounds, quickly staining the sand red.
Just then, two cultivators landed with their Magic Artifacts and stood in front of Yu Hong.
The blood blurred Yu Hong's vision; he could no longer see clearly who stood before him but used his last bit of strength to reach out towards the two people.
"Don't... kill me... I am..."
"The scoundrel who killed my uncle!"
Accompanied by a roar, Yan Siyun raised the wooden staff Magic Artifact she was leaning on and stabbed towards Yu Hong's head.
Blood and brain matter splattered out, staining Yan Siyun's long skirt filthy.
Next to her, Yan Sijing still felt unsatisfied. She pulled out her long sword Magic Artifact and chopped at Yu Hong's corpse dozens of times.
The sun set in the west, and the crimson twilight dyed the sky red.
Atop the blood-red sand dune, Yan Siyun and Yan Sijing stood side by side; a gentle breeze came, slowly fluttering their blood-stained skirts as if they were the clouds aflame in the sky or the blooming flowers of the other shore.Help us continue by reading at the source: *.
Below the dune, other Foundation Establishment cultivators from Hundred Pills Square watched this scene, their hearts filled with mixed emotions.
Chai Jiujin landed from the air, saw this scene, and seemed to want to say something. After hesitating for a moment, he ultimately just let out a long sigh.
And another Core Formation Cultivator stood next to the Yan sisters, looking at Yu Hong's corpse with a profound gaze.
"Big Brother Yan, the person who killed you is dead; now your spirit in heaven can finally rest."
The Yan sisters' parents had died early, and they were raised entirely by their uncle. Later, when establishing the Hundred Pills Square, they received their uncle's full support, with the sisters responsible for management and their uncle for trading.
However, during the last trade caravan raid, their uncle, who was in Core Formation, was killed by Yu Hong. For revenge, the sisters specifically set up this trap.
The crowd stood and mourned for a while; it was Yan Siyun who first wiped her tears and turned around, saying, "Elder Zhen, keep this scoundrel's Storage Bag for now; we must immediately head to the camp. There's another Core Formation there, and those hired Loose Cultivators won't last long."
The Core Formation Cultivator known as Elder Zhen nodded, intending to pick the Storage Bag from Yu Hong's corpse, but suddenly turned his head, looking towards the southwest.
"Someone is coming."
Upon hearing this, everyone immediately tensed up, but soon, they saw that the person coming from the southwest was not the Core Formation enemy they had expected, but Yuan Ming riding on Lei Yu.
After discovering through his first soul that Yu Hong was being attacked by cultivators from Hundred Pills Square, he immediately rushed over.
He stood on Lei Yu's back, glanced up and down at Yan Siyun, then shifted his gaze to Yan Sijing and spoke, "Fellow Daoist Yan, aren't you going to explain?"
Just as Yan Sijing was about to speak, Yan Siyun stepped forward and said, "Since Fellow Daoist Yuan has escaped, I presume, the other Core Formation Sand Pirate has already died by your hand."
Yuan Ming sneered, flipped his hand, and threw out Old Guo's headless corpse, "You seem to know a lot about me, Fellow Daoist?"
Chai Jiujin and Elder Zhen were still somewhat skeptical of Yan Siyun's words, but upon seeing Old Guo's corpse, they were suddenly struck dumb, looking as if they had seen a ghost.
Although Yan Sijing had heard from her sister that Yuan Ming could kill a Core Formation across ranks, seeing the solid proof still astonished her immensely.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan jests. I just collect some intelligence, so I knew about your other identity," said Yan Siyun. Suddenly, she transmitted a message to Yuan Ming, her lips barely moving as she said three words: "Nether Moon God."
However, Yuan Ming's expression changed, "Hehe, Fellow Daoist, don't talk nonsense; I'm not carrying that kind of dark blame."
"If Fellow Daoist Yuan says it is not so, then let it be so, but now, you should have the mood to have a proper chat with me, right?" Yan Siyun smiled.
Yuan Ming didn't respond; his gaze fell on Yu Hong's corpse on the sand dune. He suddenly asked, "Fellow Daoist, since you claim to have collected quite a bit of intelligence, do you know the true identities of these two Core Formation Sand Pirates?"
Yan Siyun frowned, sensing from Yuan Ming's words a sudden bad premonition, "Please enlighten me, Fellow Daoist."
"Yu Hong of the Five Thunders Pavilion in Purple Thunder City, have you heard of him?" Yuan Ming asked.

chapters.title: Chapter 369 - 346 The Division of Body Cultivation
chapters.content:
Yan Siyun, upon hearing these words, was as if struck by a bolt from the blue. She froze for a long while before she decisively said, "Impossible! With Yu Hong's status, how could he become a sand pirate? Moreover, his appearance and attire are completely different."
Her words seemed resolute, but the tremor in her voice betrayed what she truly thought.
"If Fellow Daoist does not believe it, why not take a look inside his storage bag? Perhaps there will be something to prove his identity?" Yuan Ming shrugged nonchalantly.
Although he had counterattacked and killed Elder Guo, a cultivator at the Core Formation Stage, the man was, after all, only an insignificant guest elder. Now that Yu Hong, his master, was also dead, it was uncertain whether anyone in the Five Thunder Sect would remember Elder Guo, let alone seek revenge on him for this.
However, the trouble would be significant for Hundred Pills Square, which had personally taken part in the killing of Yu Hong.
Upon hearing Yuan Ming's words, Yan Siyun trembled, and without needing her to say anything, Elder Zhen beside her immediately scooped up the storage bag. After a brief inspection, he took out an expressionless token representing the status of an elder of the Five Thunder Sect.
Seeing the token, Yan Si Jing held her breath and instinctively reached out to grab her sister's arm.
Although Yan Siyun did not use her Divine Sense to probe, seeing her sister's reaction, her heart sank, and a bitter smile appeared on her face.
Seeing her like this, a flicker of sympathy crossed Yuan Ming's face.
As the person who could manage the business of the Five Thunders Pavilion in the Black Wind Desert, Yu Hong's identity was more than just an elder of the Five Thunder Sect. He was the direct grandson of the early-stage Nascent Soul powerful Thunderbolt Ancestor of the Five Thunder Sect, born with an Abnormal Spirit Root, and possessed extraordinary talent. He was doted upon since childhood, with almost the entire sect's resources used for his upbringing.
Although the sect let him come to the Black Wind Desert for training, what he was put in charge of was the immensely profitable business of the shops, which indicated the extent of the favor he enjoyed.
This time, it was fortunate that Hundred Pills Square managed to kill Yu Hong. Because the last assault on the Hundred Pills Square's trade caravan went too smoothly, Yu Hong did not bring many followers and did not use many magic treasure talismans, leaving him defenseless. Otherwise, with his wealth, facing two Core Formation Cultivators, he would not necessarily win, but self-preservation would not be a problem.
Yan Siyun was silent for a long while, finally recovering her senses and taking in a deep breath before taking out a storage bag.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, we used you as bait this time to ambush the sand pirates, which was truly regrettable. This Washing Elixir Spirit Liquid and elixirs are our compensations. Please accept them."
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming took the storage bag from her hands and examined the thunderstorm, knowing that it was both an apology and hush money. He nodded and said, "Both Fellow Daoists Yan, rest assured, I will no longer dwell on this matter with this compensation and will act as if I was never involved in today's events."
Yan Siyun nodded with a meaningful look, "That's for the best, I also won't disclose to anyone about Fellow Daoist Yuan helping to kill the sand pirates."
"I will take my leave then. Everyone, please take care." Yuan Ming smiled indifferently, checked the items in the storage bag, and without saying more, turned and left atop Lei Yu.
"Sister, are we just letting him go like this? What if he speaks of today's events..." Yan Si Jing watched Yuan Ming's departing figure with her words hanging in the air.
"Yes, although his strength is not weak, he is, after all, alone. If Elder Chai and I take action together, it should not be difficult to stop him," Elder Zhen exchanged a glance with Chai Jiujin and said.
"If he can easily kill a Core Formation Cultivator by himself and dares to come here alone, do you really think we can stop him? He is a clever man who knows what to do. We at Hundred Pills Square would hope to befriend such a person. Si Jing, if he comes again in the future, treat him as a Core Formation Stage cultivator and receive him with due respect," Yan Siyun said.
"Sister, I understand." Yan Si Jing nodded and once again looked towards the disappearing speck in the distant sky, her eyes filled with a complex, inexplicable emotion.
...
On the way back to Purple Thunder City, Yuan Ming sat cross-legged on Lei Yu, enjoying the refreshing breeze, feeling quite pleased with himself.
This journey had its share of twists and turns, but the rewards were also substantial. Most importantly, he had directly obtained the Washing Elixir Spirit Liquid from them, saving quite a bit of trouble and time, not to mention the effortless killing of a Core Formation Cultivator.
With that in mind, he took out Elder Guo's storage bag to check its contents.
As a Core Formation Stage guest elder of the Five Thunder Sect and after serving under Yu Hong for so many years, Elder Guo was quite wealthy. The storage bag contained tens of thousands of spirit stones, numerous elixirs, and spiritual materials. There was also a jade scroll and many classics.
With these items, plus the Washing Elixir Spirit Liquid and other elixirs given by Yan Siyun, Yuan Ming could say that this trip was a major windfall.
The only regret was that Elder Guo didn't have many magic artifacts and treasures on him. Aside from the Bronze Small Tripod and Heart-Clearing Pendant, all that remained was a pair of artifact spirit boots he wore on his feet.
When Yuan Ming collected Elder Guo's corpse, he removed the boots and didn't throw them away with the body to Yan Siyun and the others.
The boots were inscribed with Light Body and Earth Tunneling runes, constituting a top-grade magical tool of quite good quality. Yuan Ming named them Earth Element Boots, planning to give them to Xu Che in the future to increase his efficiency in handling matters.
The Jade Scroll left by Elder Guo contained his primary Cultivation Technique, a Fire Attribute Technique named Swallowing Fire Skill. It seemed fairly good and could be cultivated up to the Early-stage Core Formation. However, Yuan Ming already had a more exquisite full version of the Nine Elements Technique, so he had no use for it and thus paid it no further attention after a brief glance.
Among those classics, Yuan Ming unexpectedly discovered a book called Body Refining Manual. The cover and pages were wrinkled clearly from frequent use.
The book seemed to originate from the Western Region; the first half was written in the script of the Rong people, while the latter half was translated into the language of the Central Plains.
It detailed the characteristics of each stage of Body Cultivation and listed some commonly used moves for cultivators at different stages. While it didn't delve into the specifics of cultivation, as an introductory text, it was excellent.
According to the book, levels of Body Cultivation were categorized based on the strength of the flesh and bones. The realms might be similar to those of Magic Practitioners, but the titles were different.
From the bottom up, they were known as Copper Skin Body, Iron Bone Body, Innate Body, Tongqiao Body, and Body of Wanxiang, corresponding to the Qi Refinement, Foundation Establishment, Core Formation, Nascent Soul, and Returning Void realms of Magic Practitioners.
Copper Skin Body involved continuously refining the muscles and skin by absorbing nature's spiritual energy, making the skin as hard as refined iron, able to withstand spells and magic artifacts.
Iron Bone Body focused on tempering the bones, enhancing the body's strength from the inside out to easily crush magic artifacts.
The Innate Body was different from the previous two, and cultivation was no longer limited to the polishing of muscles and bones but centered on the application of breathing techniques.
Every Body Cultivator who reached the Innate Body stage would have a unique set of breathing techniques. Even if some used the same technique, individual variations would gradually emerge during cultivation. Moreover, many demon beasts known for their powerful physical bodies possessed their breathing techniques by the Core Formation stage in a certain sense.
These breathing techniques, while refining the cultivator's internal organs, also created a type of inner breath within Body Cultivators that differed from the Mana of Magic Practitioners. Body Cultivators could use their inner breath to perform special moves or distribute it throughout their body to form a Vajra Unbreakable Body, significantly resisting attacks from magic treasures and spells. Common spells and artifacts could hardly breach their defense.This copy comes from content on *.
Some commonly seen moves for Body Cultivators at this stage, such as Breath to Arrow, Mountain Crossing Bull Striking, and Hundred-step Divine Fist, all possessed the massive force comparable to Magic Practitioners' treasures. The key was that these moves were merely ordinary uses of inner breath and could not even be considered unique techniques, yet they required extensive cultivation with many Spirit Stones or spiritual materials.
The move Vajra used to Break Array and the protective shield, known as Hundred-step Divine Fist, could deliver invisible Fist Power with condensed yet undissipated force, reaching a hundred steps away in an instant. The only downside is that its power diminishes with increasing distance. Beyond a hundred steps, its effectiveness almost vanishes, yet "a hundred steps" is just a conceptual distance. As the body becomes more refined, the range can be extended.
The book mentioned a Body Cultivator with an Innate Body who specialized in the Hundred-step Divine Fist, eventually able to project his Fist Power hundreds of yards away, striking fear into the hearts of cultivators from all paths.
The Body Refining Manual provided little information on the last two stages of Body Cultivation, briefly mentioning that advancing to the Tongqiao Body requires comprehension of Conception, and only mentioning the name of the Body of Wanxiang.
As cultivators purely advancing on the Immortal Path through physical strength, the power of Body Cultivators is undoubtedly formidable, yet their overall numbers in the Cultivation World are much fewer than Magic Practitioners, and they have two fatal flaws.
One is that Body Cultivators cannot fly until they reach the Tongqiao Body. Although they can temporarily hover using methods like leaping, they cannot borrow force in mid-air, making it quite difficult to execute various techniques.
Therefore, theoretically, Magic Practitioners can take advantage of their ability to fly high and use elevation to wear down Body Cultivators in combat.
Of course, the reality is that when Magic Practitioners encounter a Body Cultivator of the same rank who they cannot defeat, they usually just flee, not willing to waste time wearing down their "turtle shells."
The second major weakness of Body Cultivators is their Divine Soul, as the strength of their body cannot reflect upon their Divine Soul. If specific measures are taken, Body Cultivators are easily defeated.
However, only Soul Cultivators possess a broad range of Divine Soul attack techniques, so for regular Magic Practitioners without special methods, it remains difficult to exploit this weakness of Body Cultivators.
The Body Refining Manual didn't greatly aid Yuan Ming's own cultivation, but it did broaden his horizons and gave him a more comprehensive understanding of the way of Body Cultivation.
Time always flies when one is engrossed in reading. Unwittingly, Lei Yu had already reached Purple Thunder City. Seeing this, Yuan Ming put the books away once again.

chapters.title: Chapter 370 - 347: Running Away
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming did not enter Purple Thunder City, but descended thirty li north of the city in a hilly area and, after putting away Lei Yu, communicated with Zuo Qinghui through his mind.
He had killed Elder Guo and was somewhat implicated in Yu Hong's death as well. It was unlikely that the Five Thunder Sect would trace these events back to him in the short term, but to be safe, he decided not to enter Purple Thunder City again.
A moment later, two tunneling lights flew from the distance, stopping right in front of him, revealing the figures of Zuo Qinghui and Xu Che.
"My lord, did everything go smoothly?" Xu Che came forward and asked.
Yuan Ming did not speak but simply nodded slightly.
A smile crossed Xu Che's face. Although he had not been following Yuan Ming for long, he vaguely knew that Yuan Ming had made several preparations for his Core Formation attempt.
Now that they had acquired the Washing Elixir Spirit Liquid, the chances of successful Core Formation had increased again. Once successful, his strength would leap forward dramatically.
"I'm planning to go into seclusion next, Xu Che. You need not accompany me. I am giving you a new task, to travel to various cities in the Black Wind Desert and spread the teachings of the Moon God Sect among the mortals," Yuan Ming said.
"Yes," Xu Che answered solemnly.
"Our deeds of killing Elder Hai and looting the Flame Scale Ore have already reached Zhao Country. The Guiyuan Sect might well be pursuing us; you must be careful in your actions. Take these items with you, just in case you need them," Yuan Ming took out a storage ring and handed it to Xu Che.
After thanking him, Xu Che took the ring and explored it with his Divine Sense, his face showing a shock.
Inside the storage ring were nearly ten thousand Spirit Stones, over a hundred various talismans, dozens of mid-grade magical tools, seven or eight top-grade magical tools, and a pair of earth yellow boots that sparkled with spirit light, precisely the Earth Element Boots.
Beyond these, there were also numerous Foundation Establishment Stage elixirs, each radiating rich Spiritual Power and of high quality.
"My lord, with so many treasures, I am truly unworthy," Xu Che said, his face showing a fearful expression.
"These items are not all for you. When you are spreading the faith, if you encounter cultivators who are struggling to make ends meet, try to recruit them as believers. Cultivators are different from mortals; subduing them will inevitably come at a price. These Spirit Stones, talismans, and magical tools are prepared for this purpose," Yuan Ming explained.
Xu Che finally understood, though some disappointment surfaced in his heart.
Of course, this emotion was but fleeting. He followed Yuan Ming out of a recognition of him; agreeing with Yuan Ming's decisions was akin to affirming himself.
"Those Earth Element Boots are specifically for you. This pair has the Divine Skills of light body and earth tunneling. Wearing them, you could even escape from late-stage Foundation Establishment cultivators with ease," Yuan Ming said again.
The boots were extraordinary; even Yuan Ming himself was quite tempted by them, except that he lacked an Earth Attribute Spirit Root to utilize their full power.
Xu Che cultivated an Earth Attribute Cultivation Method and needed these boots for self-protection, especially since he was tasked with traveling far and wide to spread the teachings.
"Thank you for your generous gift, my lord. I will do my utmost to fulfill my duties and repay your great kindness," Xu Che said, his earlier disappointment now completely dispelled as he joyfully kowtowed in thanks.
"These are but trifles. Focus on spreading the teachings. In the future, there will be other treasures for you. Make use of those elixirs as well; while spreading the faith, do not forget to cultivate and enhance your own power. For us cultivators, strength is paramount," Yuan Ming stated blandly.
Xu Che thanked him again, then summoned a Flying Artifact and tore through the sky as he left.
Yuan Ming also summoned Lei Yu again, preparing to fly toward Sandtrap City.
"Master, are you planning to form your core in Sandtrap City?" Hua Zhi popped out of the Spiritual Beast Bag and asked.
"Sandtrap City's Spiritual Energy is too sparse; it is not a good place for Core Formation. I am returning for other matters," Yuan Ming shook his head as he said.
Core Formation mainly relied on condensing one's own Mana, but during the actual core solidification, it would absorb the surrounding nature's Spiritual Energy to complete the last step; thus, places with overly sparse Spiritual Energy were unsuitable for Core Formation.
Yuan Ming's current return to Sandtrap City was mainly for the items in that house.
If Yan Siyun could discover that he was the Nether Moon God, other forces might also be able to deduce it. With a large number of followers of the Nether Moon God among the mortals in Sandtrap City, so many clues could not withstand scrutiny by the determined.
He had been too careless previously when he secluded himself there for cultivation; he must leave soon and find another place for his practice.
The more Yuan Ming thought about it, the more inappropriate it seemed, and he ordered Lei Yu to speed up.
Lei Yu screeched, and the feathers on its wings began to generate strands of electrical arcs, further accelerating and reaching Sandtrap City in just a third of the usual time.The most up‑to‑date version is on *.
But Lei Yu was nearly exhausted to the point of collapse and hid inside the Spiritual Beast Bag to recover.
In the past two years, Yuan Ming had been busy with his own cultivation and had not taken Lei Yu into account. The Black Wind Desert was dry year-round, lacking natural thunder for absorption, so Lei Yu's power had stagnated, remaining at the Second Lower Rank level.
Short distances were manageable, but over long, exhausting flights, Lei Yu's insufficient demonic power became a glaring weakness.
Yuan Ming secretly resolved that once he had achieved Core Formation, he would properly train Lei Yu, at least elevating it to the Second Upper Rank.
He landed outside Sandtrap City and first controlled Zuo Qinghui, disguised with a cloak, to enter the city.
Zuo Qinghui made his way to Yuan Ming's residence, surveyed the surroundings to ensure no one was watching, then quickly entered the house.
Inside the house, nothing was amiss, nor were there signs of anyone having searched it.
Yuan Ming silently breathed a sigh of relief; it seemed that no one had traced him here yet.
He controlled Zuo Qinghui to take away everything from the house, including the Five Elements Illusion Destruction Array, and then used a spell to clean up various places before immediately leaving.
