Yuan Ming had originally wanted Zuo Qinghui to find Hu Ji and leave him some money as a thanks for managing the Moon God Sect for the past two years, but after thinking it over, he decided against it.
Hu Ji was currently living well and did not need his interference; moreover, Yuan Ming himself was troubled by many problems, and more contact with Hu Ji would only put him in greater danger.
Zuo Qinghui did not stay in Sandtrap City and soon left the city.
"I don't know if I will have the chance to come here again," Yuan Ming, stepping on the White Jade Shuttle, looked at the place he had lived for several years with a sense of reluctance.
He quickly shook his head, and the White Jade Shuttle beneath his feet immediately transformed into a white rainbow that flew northward.
Yuan Ming did not have a specific destination, drifting aimlessly while considering where would be ideal to achieve Core Formation.
He did not want to achieve Core Formation in Sandtrap City, not just because of the sparse spiritual energy here, but more importantly, because Core Formation would provoke great natural phenomena that no barrier could hide; within Sandtrap City, the only Core Formation Stage cultivator was the city lord. A breakthrough here would certainly provoke a fierce reaction from the Sandtrap City Lord.
Yuan Ming had offended the Guiyuan Sect and was entangled in the grievances between Hundred Pills Square and the Five Thunder Sect. At this critical juncture of retreating to advance to the Core Formation Stage, he did not want to draw the attention of any power.
"Master, if it really doesn't work out, we can find a place in the Black Wind Desert to achieve Core Formation. Over the years, I have been hunting beasts in the Black Wind Desert and know several covert places where the spiritual energy is rich," Hua Zhi understood Yuan Ming's concerns and suggested.
"Not feasible. From the start of Core Formation to the solidifying of the pill, it takes a significantly long time, from a few months to several years. If luck is bad and the Black Wind sweeps through, the consequences are unthinkable," Yuan Ming shook his head.
He did not possess any Array Restriction to isolate the fiendish energy of the Black Wind. Being interrupted by external forces during Core Formation could result in minor injuries or fatally ruin all his prior achievements.
Although the chances of such an event were minimal, he could not take the risk.
"What about outside the Black Wind Desert? There's no threat of Black Wind there," Hua Zhi proposed another suggestion.
Yuan Ming had considered the possibility of that choice; however, the areas nearby the Black Wind Desert generally had poor spirit veins and thin nature's spiritual energy; even compared to Sandtrap City, they were inferior unless one ventured deep into the territory of Zhao Country.
But those places rich in spiritual energy were all controlled by the cultivational powers of Zhao Country's Cultivation Sects, making Core Formation there just as troublesome.
Yuan Ming frowned deeply but soon relaxed it.
He had made up his mind to achieve Core Formation inside the Black Wind Desert.
Since performing Core Formation anywhere would draw attention, it might be better to do the opposite and attempt it right in a major city akin to Purple Thunder City.
Such major cities undoubtedly housed numerous Core Formation Stage cultivators; adding one more would hardly draw any attention.
Yuan Ming turned over his hand and took out a Jade Scroll, plunging his Divine Sense into it.
This was a scroll he had purchased previously, detailing various information about the Black Wind Desert.
"Let's go here." Yuan Ming quickly locked onto an underground city named Spirit Wind City within the scroll, governed by Zhao Country's Spirit Talisman Sect.
The Spirit Talisman Sect was second only to the Five Thunder Sect in Zhao Country. Spirit Wind City was not small in scale, rich in various cultivation resources, making it a top-notch underground city suitable for residence.
Near Spirit Wind City, there was a large spirit stone mine vein, and nature's spiritual energy was exceptionally rich, well-known throughout the Black Wind Desert.
More importantly, the Spirit Talisman Sect's actions were primarily moderate, unlike the domineering Five Thunder Sect, and they managed the loose cultivators in the city quite casually, hardly intervening as long as no regulations of Spirit Wind City were violated.
Because of this lenient policy, Spirit Wind City had been developing rapidly in recent years, attracting a large number of loose cultivators to settle down, and was gradually catching up to Purple Thunder City.
Having made up his mind, Yuan Ming accelerated his flying speed and finally arrived at his destination, Spirit Wind City, after several days.
Spirit Wind City, like Five Thunder City, was built within a huge, deep underground fissure, not underground, but on the stone walls on both sides of the fissure.
Numerous tall buildings stood here in layers, distinctly different in style compared to Purple Thunder City.
In mid-air, streaks of tunneling light converged from all directions, and many cultivators shot out from within the city towards various parts of the desert.
Yuan Ming followed other cultivators and landed on a large platform within Spirit Wind City.
A rich wave of nature's spiritual energy hit him, even more vigorous than in Purple Thunder City.
Yuan Ming secretly nodded, coming here to achieve Core Formation was indeed the right choice.
"This fellow Daoist seems unfamiliar, are you here in Spirit Wind City to purchase items, or to settle and cultivate?" a green-clothed monk greeted him, wearing the attire of a Spirit Talisman Sect disciple.
"I need to find a secluded place," Yuan Ming said.
"As a cultivator at the Late Stage of Foundation Establishment, you can directly obtain a six-month residency permit for our Spirit Wind City. After that period, if you wish to continue residing, just go to the Spirit Wind Hall within the city to handle it," the green-clothed monk's finger flickered with a bright green light from a ring he wore, showing a smile as he handed over a green token.
Yuan Ming took the green token and hung it at his waist.
The richness of the spiritual energy in Spirit Wind City was greatly beneficial for cultivation. Many foreign cultivators, after arriving, clung to not leaving, leading to overcrowded conditions in many areas of the city. Out of necessity, the Spirit Talisman Sect had implemented this rule.

chapters.title: Chapter 371 - 348: Life and Death Seclusion
chapters.content:
"This is the Spirit Wind City Area Distribution Map, Fellow Daoist can use it as a reference," said the green-clothed monk, as he passed another jade scroll to Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming took the jade scroll, and his Divine Sense penetrated into it.
The jade scroll contained a detailed introduction to the structure of Spirit Wind City. According to the records, the city was divided into upper, middle, and lower areas, with all of the shops located on the lower level. The middle and upper levels were residential areas, providing living quarters for cultivators who settled here.
As described in the jade scroll, the lower area was bustling with shops connected by stone steps and plank roads, and some places even had plazas excavated, teeming with crowds and a good number of ordinary people mixed in.
The middle area was mainly composed of cave mansions, packed closely together like a honeycomb with thousands of them.
By contrast, the number of cave mansions in the upper area was much sparser, spaced further apart, with only around a hundred or so.
Yuan Ming paid no attention to the shops in the lower level and looked towards the middle and upper areas.
The stone wall where Spirit Wind City was located was connected to the nearby spirit stone mine's Spirit Vein, and when the city was established years ago, an elder of the Spirit Talisman Sect had set up some kind of Forbidden Divine Skills to fix the Spirit Vein in place, making the Spiritual Power within the walls of Spirit Wind City more pure and stable.
Since the Spirit Vein flowed from the top down, the higher the location of the cave mansion, the more abundant the Spiritual Energy, and naturally, the more expensive the rent.
The place for renting the cave mansion was also the Spirit Wind Hall mentioned by the green-clothed monk.
After a brief moment of contemplation, Yuan Ming decided to split up with Zuo Qinghui. He would head to the Spirit Wind Hall in the middle area to rent a cave mansion, while Zuo Qinghui would go to the shopping area on the lower level to purchase other items required for Core Formation.
...
An hour later.
In front of Spirit Wind Hall, Yuan Ming stood still, surveying the building in front of him with a slightly distracted gaze.
This three-level pavilion, constructed from bamboo, wood, bricks, and tiles, with its four-pillared flying eaves, looked fairly standard, though it had a rather small footprint and hardly qualified as a hall. However, the three characters "Spirit Wind Hall" hanging above the door made it clear he had come to the right place.
The occasional cultivator entered and exited the door, most wearing broad hats or masks to hide their faces.
Yuan Ming's eyes flickered, wondering if, unlike usual cultivator cities where renting a dwelling required revealing one's true face and identity, Spirit Wind City might have no such requirement?
With this thought in mind, he also took out a gray mask and put it on, blending into the crowd and entering the Spirit Wind Hall.
This gray mask was acquired during the great battle at the Guiyuan Sect's Mine.
In that battle, Hua Zhi and Vajra had killed many cultivators from the Guiyuan Sect, and naturally, their storage magic tools were collected. The Two Beasts didn't have much use for these tools, so they handed them over to Yuan Ming afterward; the gray mask was found inside a Guiyuan Sect disciple's storage tool.
The mask didn't possess any special Divine Skills, its sole function was to block Divine Sense searching, so once worn, no one could see his True Face.
The inner space of Spirit Wind Hall was not big, yet it held seven or eight stone tables, making the space seem even more cramped.
Behind each stone table sat a cultivator dressed in the Spirit Talisman Sect's garb, serving those who came in.
Yuan Ming approached a vacant stone table and sat down.
"Does Fellow Daoist wish to rent a cave mansion or is it something else?" the Spirit Talisman Sect cultivator behind the stone table asked in a routine manner.
"Renting a cave mansion, the higher the location the better, ideally in the upper area," Yuan Ming said with a deep voice.
"The upper area? That's where cultivators in the Core Formation Stage reside, and the price is not cheap," the Spirit Talisman Sect cultivator then raised his head to look at Yuan Ming, showing a bit of surprise.
Yuan Ming did not speak, but his intention was clear.
"Well then, Fellow Daoist, please wait a moment. The rental of cave mansions in the upper area is handled by our sect's elder. I will go and ask him to come here," the Spirit Talisman Sect cultivator stood up and walked towards the back of Spirit Wind Hall, a glint of delight flashing in his eyes.
Securing a deal to rent a cave mansion in the upper area would earn him a substantial reward.
Shortly after, the Spirit Talisman Sect cultivator returned with a bald elder, who possessed a profound aura, clearly a Core Formation Stage existence.
"You wish to rent a cave mansion in the upper area? Here is the price list, take a look first," the bald elder sat down in front of Yuan Ming, placed a jade scroll on the table, and spoke in an even tone.
Yuan Ming, having already killed several Core Formation Stage cultivators, was not intimidated by the bald elder's presence and calmly took the jade scroll, his Divine Sense entering into it.
He frowned slightly soon after.
No wonder the Spirit Talisman Sect cultivator said the cave mansions in the upper area were not cheap. The yearly rent for any of them started at five or six hundred Spirit Stones, and all the cave mansions were rented at a minimum of five years. Those with a less impressive fortune simply couldn't afford it.
However, considering that it was where Core Formation Stage cultivators resided, the price was quite reasonable.
"I'll take Number 12 cave mansion, for ten years," Yuan Ming made his selection and stated.
Number 12 cave mansion, according to the jade scroll, was the highest located among the vacant cave mansions, with a five-year rent of more than ten thousand Spirit Stones, extraordinarily expensive.
But he needed to concentrate on advancing to the Core Formation Stage, and although he made many preparations in advance, he still hoped the Spiritual Energy in the cave mansion would be as dense as possible, as success could hinge on just that bit more.
This was one instance where he wouldn't skimp on spending the necessary Spirit Stones.
Yuan Ming swept his sleeve over the table, and a small pile of Mid-grade Spirit Stones floated into view.
"The wealth of Your Excellency is indeed substantial," the bald elder appraised Yuan Ming, his surprise turning into a smile.
This content is hosted at *.
The bald elder counted the Spirit Stones, took them all, and handed Yuan Ming a white Jade Talisman engraved with the number twelve, saying, "This is the Forbidden Jade Talisman for Cave Mansion number twelve. It will automatically expire after ten years. If Your Excellency wishes to renew the lease, you will need to make another trip here."
After speaking, the bald elder didn't wait for Yuan Ming to reply; he turned and walked away on his own.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming touched his nose through the mask.
The management of Spirit Wind City was indeed lax toward Loose Cultivators; there was no need to leave a name, and no need to reveal one's True Face. The handing over of Spirit Stones was enough to obtain a Cave Mansion. For someone like him with secrets to hide, this was more than satisfactory.
He picked up the Jade Talisman and walked out of Spirit Wind Hall, ready to take a look at his new Cave Mansion.
At that moment, a Cultivator wearing a blue cloak, who looked rather petite, approached. Their body and face were hidden under the cloak as they brushed past Yuan Ming, heading straight for Spirit Wind Hall.
Yuan Ming paused in his steps, a look of surprise in his eyes, then light flickered beneath his feet as his figure soared into the sky, blending into the myriad of tunneling lights above.
The person in the blue robe seemed to sense something and looked back.
The place behind them was empty and nothing seemed amiss.
The figure in the blue robe appeared relieved and quickly stepped into Spirit Wind Hall.
At this moment, standing dozens of feet above Spirit Wind Hall, Yuan Ming stood in the void on a White Jade Shuttle, his expression fluctuating.
Just now, he'd sensed the aura of the person in the blue cloak, despite its ability to shield auras; his Divine Sense was strong enough to detect it. Surprisingly, it was Yan Sijing from Hundred Pills Square.
What was she doing in Spirit Wind City, moving so secretively? It didn't seem like she was here to conduct business. Could it be that Yu Hong's death had been exposed and she had come to hide from the pursuit of Thunderbolt Ancestor?
After a moment's thought, Yuan Ming shook his head and flew toward the upper area.
No matter why Yan Sijing was here, it had little to do with him. At this critical juncture, he did not wish to get entangled with her.
Yuan Ming, following the map, went straight to Cave Mansion number twelve.
This Cave Mansion was directly carved into the cliff face, spanning a large area, with five or six rooms, a Medicine Garden, and even an Earth Fire Room that could channel Earth Fire for Alchemy or Artifact Refining. It was even more complete than the one Sha Hao had established.
The Spiritual Energy here was as rich as described by the people from Spirit Wind Hall, much stronger than anything he had experienced before, making it well worth the numerous Spirit Stones he had spent.
After thoroughly inspecting the inside and outside of the Cave Mansion without finding anything untoward, Yuan Ming took out three Arrays and started to arrange them throughout the Cave Mansion.
These three Arrays were the Five Elements Illusion Destruction Array, the Golden Snake Entanglement Array, and the Houtu Rock Formation.
The Golden Snake Entanglement Array and the Houtu Rock Formation were obtained from Master Lu in Xiansha City.
After returning to Xiansha City from the Guiyuan Sect's Mine, he delivered the corpse of the Red Gold Centipede to Master Lu. In great spirits and bearing a favorable impression of Yuan Ming, Master Lu allowed Yuan Ming to choose two Arrays and gave them to him at a significant discount.
Yuan Ming quickly set up the three Arrays, and only then did he comfortably sit cross-legged in the Cave Mansion, and took a short rest.
Before long, Zuo Qinghui flew in from the lower region. He had toured around Spirit Wind City and acquired a clear understanding of the city's environment, bringing with him the few items Yuan Ming still needed for his Core Formation breakthrough.
"In the time to come, you all will guard me from outside while not neglecting your own cultivation," Yuan Ming called forth Vajra, Hua Zhi, and Lei Yu, instructing them.
With the abundant Spiritual Energy within the Cave Mansion, it was natural to make the most of it.
Vajra nodded silently.
"Don't worry, Master. We will guard the outside well and ensure no one disturbs you," Hua Zhi assured, thumping her chest.
Lei Yu also gave a soft cry and flapped its wings a few times to indicate it understood Yuan Ming's instructions.
Zuo Qinghui handed over the items he had bought to Yuan Ming, then turned around and left the Cave Mansion once again.
"Isn't Zuo Qinghui staying?" Hua Zhi asked telepathically upon seeing this.
"Your protection is sufficient. Zuo Qinghui has other matters to attend to," Yuan Ming replied.
Hua Zhi acknowledged with an "Oh" and inquired no further.
Yuan Ming left a few more instructions for the three beasts, then took all the items he had prepared and entered the most Spiritually Energized room in the Cave Mansion, sealing himself in for Life and Death Seclusion.
Given his current level of Cultivation, he was fully capable of fasting, but he intended to not leave this room until he had successfully formed a Golden Core in one fell swoop.
Now that the Cave Mansion was guarded by the three beasts, and the soul split's control was in the flexible and mobile Zuo Qinghui, who was closely monitoring the outside world, there was no need for him to be overly concerned.
Thus, Yuan Ming first laid out a Gathering Spirit Formation inside the room, inserted a sufficient number of Spirit Stones, then summoned the Stealing Heaven Tripod next to him, ignited a stick of Spirit Incense...
After arranging all the preparatory tasks, he returned to the cushion, sat cross-legged, consumed an elixir, and as the faint blue smoke rose, he gradually closed his eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 372 - 349: Golden Core Formation
chapters.content:
Time trickled by, and before one knew it, a year had passed.
Yuan Ming's cave mansion had been closed since and had not opened once, with a layer of dust settled on the door.
Two years went by, and still, there was no sign of the secret chamber where Yuan Ming was in seclusion showing any signs of opening.
Three years...
In the blink of an eye, five years had elapsed.
On this day, Hua Zhi, Vajra, and Lei Yu were sitting at the entrance of the secret chamber in a pin-shaped formation, guarding the door with a somewhat bored expression.
For the full span of five years, aside from the occasional hurried visits from Zuo Qinghui, there had been almost no news from Yuan Ming. Worried that sending a message might disturb Yuan Ming's Core Formation, they dared not inquire about the situation inside.
Hua Zhi, by nature restless, stretched in a languid yawn, just about to get up.
Boom!
A wild wind arose near Yuan Ming's cave mansion, and the spiritual energy of heaven and earth surged, crazily infusing into the cave mansion, forming a spiritual energy vortex several miles in size, whistling as it spiraled.
Hua Zhi's Three Beasts were also caught in this sudden spiritual energy vortex, the force of the vortex so great that their bodies were swept into the air.
"Ah ya, what's going on?" Hua Zhi extended her hands into vines, rooting them into the stone wall behind her to stabilize her figure.
Spot- an error.?$ V.isi&t- the or%ig#i-nal post on M&.VLEM@PY&*R.#
"It seems the master has succeeded," Vajra said as inner breath coursed through him, nullifying the sweeping force of the spiritual energy vortex, his body landing firmly on the ground, his eyes gleaming with a hint of brilliance.
Lei Yu's body erupted with lightning, tearing through the force of the spiritual energy vortex, his eyes also revealing a touch of joy.
The astonishing phenomena around Yuan Ming's cave mansion naturally could not escape the eyes of the cultivators in Spirit Wind City.
"This phenomenon? Someone is about to form their Core!"
Many cultivators from the lower and middle strata, upon seeing this scene, flew out to observe the phenomenon in the sky, their faces showing extreme envy.
The Core Formation Stage cultivators living in the upper region kept to themselves, mostly not appearing, but such massive fluctuations in spiritual energy naturally could not be hidden from them. Powerful Divine Senses swept towards Yuan Ming's residence, only to be rudely repelled by the Five Elements Illusion Destruction Array.
Within the Spirit Wind Hall, several Core Formation Stage cultivators of the Spirit Talisman Sect also looked over, their expressions varied.
"Another person has formed their core. If we count, this would be the fourth in a hundred years," a lady in green robes said joyfully.
"The Sect Master's decision to relax the management of Spirit Wind City was truly wise. Many loose cultivators lacking a place for Core Formation have come to Spirit Wind City. Almost half of them have become guest elders of the Spirit Talisman Sect, greatly strengthening our sect's power. Everyone here has contributed," a scholarly middle-aged man nodded and said with a smile.
This cultivator had the highest cultivation, having already reached Late-stage Core Formation, and appeared to be the leader among the Core Formation Stage cultivators present.
"It is all thanks to Elder Wen's capable management that so many are willing to join our sect," another Core Formation Stage cultivator said with a smile, referring to the bald elder who had arranged for Yuan Ming's rental.
"Let's not be modest, for the year-end sect rewards, I will try my best to obtain some for you. Now that another Core Formation Stage Fellow Daoist has emerged, let's find out which cave mansion it is. We'll send someone to contact them later to see if they are willing to join our sect," the scholarly middle-aged man said.
"Judging by the location of the spiritual energy vortex, it should be cave mansion number twelve, it seems to be that person," the bald elder said.
"Elder Pi, are you familiar with the person residing there?" the scholarly middle-aged man asked.
"Hm, I was the one who handled his rental. It's been just five years, and he has successfully formed his core. He is probably the fastest to achieve Core Formation in the past hundred years," Elder Pi remarked.
"In that case, you go invite him," the scholarly middle-aged man said.
"Alright," Elder Pi nodded.
…
The colossal spiritual energy vortex lasted for a quarter of an hour before it burst open, forming a spectacular array of five-colored aurora, which then dissipated completely after a few breaths.
Inside the secret chamber of the cave mansion, Yuan Ming slowly stood up from the ground, his face covered with stubble, looking disheveled as if he were a beggar.
However, his entire demeanor had completely transformed, his eyes emitting a frightening brilliance. With every gesture, substantial waves of mana impacted against the restrictions of the cave mansion, causing them to flicker incessantly.
"Three times... I've finally formed my core." Yuan Ming looked at his hands, overjoyed with his achievement.
Although he had prepared various auxiliary methods for this Core Formation and had both the Soul Pill and Washing Elixir Spirit Liquid to aid him, his Spirit Root aptitude was indeed very low, making the process extremely arduous. His first two attempts at Core Formation had ended in failure.
Each failure not only wreaked havoc on his body, requiring a long time to recover, but also dealt a severe blow to his confidence.
Especially after the second failure, he almost doubted whether he could ever succeed in Core Formation with his aptitude. After all, Core Formation Stage cultivators are already as rare as phoenix feathers and unicorn horns in the Cultivation World, and it's likely that not even one in a hundred Foundation Establishment cultivators would reach the peak of Foundation Establishment and successfully condense a Golden Core.
Those who reached the peak of Foundation Establishment not only generally had better aptitude than himself but also had their own fortunes and opportunities. It was evidently an uphill battle for him to succeed.
Fortunately, Yuan Ming had been tempered in the Southern Border, and with his determined character, after a period of self-doubt, he quickly adjusted his mood, brought every aspect of his body to its best state, re-cultivated the Hidden Vein Condensing Pill Technique, and accumulated enough mana to begin his third assault.
With the experience from the two previous attempts, the third effort finally paid off, as the mana within his Dantian finally merged Yin and Yang, condensing into a Golden Core.
The Golden Core flickered with gold, green, blue, red, and black lights; the first four colors represented his Four Spirit Roots physique, while the last black light signified the yin attribute.
Because Yuan Ming used the Soul Pill secret technique during his Core Formation attempt, after forming his Golden Core, the Soul Pill's mission was complete, and it returned to the Sea of Consciousness along with the main soul.
However, during the Core Formation process, a significant portion of Soul Power was absorbed by the Golden Core, resulting in the emergence of the fifth color of light.
The Jade Scroll of Xi Cangqiong had no record of such a circumstance, and Yuan Ming did not know whether it was good or bad.
After advancing to the Core Formation Stage, not only did his Golden Core solidify, but the mana inside his Dantian also underwent an earth-shattering change, becoming several times denser and extremely pure.
Now, he could condense Pill Fire within his body to nurture rune formations and refine magic treasures.
After the excitement had passed, Yuan Ming quickly calmed down, sorted out his appearance, and then sat down cross-legged again to run the Nine Elements Technique to stabilize his surging mana.
Seven days and nights later, the mana within his body had completely settled down.
Yuan Ming cycled his thick mana and a smile appeared at the corner of his mouth.
Having broken through to the Core Formation Stage, his lifespan increased to five or six hundred years. He no longer needed to worry about insufficient lifespan like before and could settle down to do things he enjoyed aside from cultivation.
More importantly, breaking through to the Core Formation Stage meant that Yuan Ming finally had a certain say in the Cultivation World. His strength had greatly increased, and coupled with the Divine Power of Soul Cultivation from the fifth layer of the Moonlight Technique, he was no longer the small character who could be easily manipulated by others.
Whether it was Guiyuan Sect or Five Thunder Sect, or even the threat from Chang Chun Temple, he now had enough confidence to resist. He wouldn't be as suffocated as before when the opponent merely sent a Core Formation Stage cultivator to pressure him.
Yuan Ming steadied his mind, contemplating his next plan.
Having just broken through to the Core Formation Stage and yet to refine a magic treasure, he was at a disadvantage in combat against cultivators of the same rank. His current top priority was to refine a lifebound magical treasure for himself.
Yuan Ming had already decided on his lifebound magical treasure and with a flip of his hand, he summoned a Black Sword, which was none other than the Soul Destroying Sword.
The main material of the Soul Destroying Sword was Nine Nether Iron, which had immense potential and was exceptionally compatible with his Soul Cultivation Divine Power and did not conflict with the Nine Elements Technique, making it highly suitable to be refined into his lifebound magical treasure.
However, the Soul Destroying Sword currently only had four runes installed; he needed to add one more to form a rune formation and thereby advance it into a magical treasure.
Yuan Ming had not yet decided which rune would be the final addition.
Refining a lifebound magical treasure requires caution; once completed, it cannot be changed, and he must carefully consider all details, as the slightest oversight cannot be afforded.
Moreover, Yuan Ming's artifact refining skills still needed improvement. Although he was already capable of refining top-grade magical tools, he was not confident about adding the last rune to the Soul Destroying Sword, nor did he have a trustworthy Artifact Refiner acquainted well enough to complete this step for him.
"Forget it, this matter can be considered slowly. After all, I still have other magic treasures at hand," said Yuan Ming as he took out three magic treasures: the Golden Sun Ruler of Zuo Qinghui, the White Bone Knife of Elder Hai, and the Bronze Small Tripod of Elder Guo.
The Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear was with Vajra, as the spear greatly enhanced Vajra's combat power, so he did not take it back.
Picking up the Golden Sun Ruler, Yuan Ming exhaled a green flame that enveloped it, as he began to refine it with incantations between his hands.
Yet, a surge of golden light arose from the Golden Sun Ruler, obstructing the penetration of mana.
However, having reached the Core Formation Stage, Yuan Ming's mana had undergone a qualitative transformation. With the operation of the spell, he quickly broke through the barrier of the golden light and penetrated into the innermost core of the Golden Sun Ruler, making contact with its most central rune formation.
The golden rune formation consisted of five intertwined runes, forming an entity similar to an array.
"A rune formation?" This was Yuan Ming's first time truly encountering the rune formation within a magical treasure.
The power of the five golden runes was amplified by the rune formation, increasing their might several times, not something magical tools could compare to, which is why magical tools stood no chance against a magical treasure.
Yuan Ming scanned the five runes of the Golden Sun Ruler, recognizing them as Armor Breaking, Sharpness, and similar runes, except for one rune he didn't recognize.
This rune was rather special, appearing as though two runes were superimposed on each other.
Yuan Ming recalled Zuo Qinghui's use of the Golden Sun Ruler, which had created multiple ruler shadows. Those shadows were not remnants but possessed considerable power, likely an effect of this unknown rune.
Activating his mana, he poured it into the rune formation, rapidly refining and allowing his Divine Sense to seep into the formation.
After a magical treasure is refined, a Divine Soul Mark remains within the rune formation. Unless the mark is completely expelled by a new owner, they don't truly possess the treasure.
Yuan Ming's Divine Sense quickly encountered the core of the rune formation and saw a dim Divine Soul Mark floating there.
He stimulated his Divine Sense to envelop the Divine Soul Mark, attempting to remove it.
The Soul Mark was deeply embedded in the rune formation, and although Yuan Ming's Divine Power was formidable, it was stifled and thus slow to act.
At this rate, it would take several months to completely expel the mark.

chapters.title: Chapter 373 - 350: Universe Within the Cauldron
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming was not surprised by this. To expel the Divine Soul Mark from a Magic Treasure was extremely difficult. Some Lifebound Magical Treasures, refined with particular secret techniques, had exceptionally strong Divine Soul Marks. Even if someone killed for treasure, they could only unleash part of the Magic Treasure's power.
"The Divine Soul Mark is composed of Soul Power, perhaps I can try taking a shortcut," Yuan Ming thought inwardly as a soul crow shot out from his brow and entered the Golden Sun Ruler.
The soul crow transformed into a surge of Soul Power, struggling to break through the rune formation's obstruction within the Golden Sun Ruler before reaching the side of the Divine Soul Mark. It then opened its beak and exerted a sucking force, which was precisely the Soul Feeding ability.
The soul crow's Soul Feeding power had increased a lot, perhaps enough to suck away the mark.
The Divine Soul Mark trembled, and threads of Soul Power diffused out and were sucked into the soul crow's mouth, gradually thinning the mark.
"It really works!" Yuan Ming quietly delighted and continued to perform the Soul Feeding.
An hour later, the Divine Soul Mark had become extremely faint, barely discernible.
The soul crow issued a sharp cry, and its Soul Feeding suction power suddenly increased. The entire Divine Soul Mark completely crumbled and was absorbed into the mouth of the soul crow.
The Golden Sun Ruler dimmed for a moment before becoming ten times brighter. It floated up and emitted joyful tremors.
Yuan Ming recalled the soul crow and activated the Golden Sun Ruler with a hand seal. It transformed into a Golden Shadow that shot out, and as it travelled, it split into several dozen golden ruler shadows that fiercely struck the secret room's wall.
The Five Elements Illusion Destruction Array within the secret room's wall automatically activated, radiating a thick layer of green light in which patterns resembling tree rings emerged, making it look exceptionally sturdy.
Over the years, Yuan Ming had not neglected his research on the Five Elements Illusion Destruction Array, so the power of this array had long since improved drastically.
However, accompanied by a series of clangs, the green light quickly thinned but still barely managed to block the bombardment of the golden ruler shadows.
Yuan Ming pointed a hand seal and the Golden Sun Ruler flew back to him.
He silently nodded, the rune within the Golden Sun Ruler was indeed as he had anticipated, able to morph into substantial ruler shadows, somewhat similar to the Shadow Transformation Light Splitting Divine Power.
This Golden Sun Ruler Magic Treasure was quite powerful, but unfortunately, he did not cultivate the Gold Attribute Technique, so he couldn't fully unleash its power.
Yuan Ming put away this object and took out the White Bone Knife from Elder Hai, starting the refinement using the same method, rapidly expelling the Divine Soul Mark within the rune formation.
The rune formation on the White Bone Knife consisted of Yin Attribute Runes, and one Yin Fire Rune was quite miraculous. Combined with the original spiritual power of the White Bone Knife, it could trigger the strange White Bone Cold Flame, which was extremely damaging to flesh and blood.
During the mine battle years ago, it was fortunate that he faced Vajra and its strong physical strength, nearly cultivating the Body Cultivation Internal Breath, which could resist the erosion of the White Bone Cold Flame.
If Yuan Ming himself had been touched by the White Bone Cold Flame, his body would have turned to ash within a few breaths.
Finally, Yuan Ming picked up Elder Guo's Bronze Small Tripod from the Five Thunder Sect and began refining it with a hand seal.
"Huh!" His face showed surprise as the rune formation inside the Bronze Small Tripod turned out to have six runes.
"Could it be that rune formations are not all composed of five runes?" Yuan Ming narrowed his eyes and activated his Divine Sense to sense the rune formation in the Bronze Small Tripod, which was noticeably stronger than those in the Golden Sun Ruler and the White Bone Knife.
Thoughtful, he completed the refinement of the Bronze Small Tripod and stored it away.
For a Core Formation Cultivator, having more Magic Treasures was naturally better, but during actual combat, managing too many treasures simultaneously could be distracting.
But Yuan Ming did not have this problem. With the strength of his Divine Soul, he could fully control multiple Magic Treasures against enemies without any hindrance, and the more refined Magic Treasures, the better.
The dramatic increase in strength filled Yuan Ming with quiet joy, but after all this, he wasn't rushing to leave his retreat. He took out an object that had accompanied him for a long time, the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
Ever since acquiring it, Yuan Ming had always wanted to refine it, but he was hindered by the golden runes and forbidden markings on it. Even though he had cultivated the Moonlight Technique to the Fifth Layer, he couldn't break through them and fully understand the tripod's internal mechanisms.
Now that he had entered the Core Formation Stage, capable of refining Magic Treasures, perhaps he could also refine the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
Yuan Ming exhaled a stream of Mana, wrapping around the Stealing Heaven Tripod, attempting to refine it.
The golden patterns on the Stealing Heaven Tripod emerged again, resisting his refinement, but Yuan Ming had reached the Core Formation Stage, and his Mana had undergone a qualitative change, slowly seeping into it.
Divine Patterns slowly faded as he continued to refine.
Noticing this, Yuan Ming was invigorated and then calmly focused, wholeheartedly devoting himself to the refinement.
...
Three days later.
Yuan Ming sat cross-legged in his room, and in front of him, the Stealing Heaven Tripod was wrapped in Mana, slowly rotating mid-air, with only the last thin ethereal shadow of the golden runes and forbidden markings remaining.
With a gleam in his eye, he exhaled a stream of Mana to speed up the refinement.
As time passed, the shadow faded more and more, and after half an hour, it completely dispersed.
Just at that moment, a buzzing sound suddenly came from Yuan Ming's mind and the Stealing Heaven Tripod in front of him also shook violently. A blue spirit light burst out from the tripod, shooting directly into Yuan Ming's brow, rushing into his Sea of Consciousness, and finally merging into his Divine Soul.
The Divine Soul, sitting atop a sea of Soul Power, had a lunar-like halo behind it. Suddenly, the blue spirit light emerged, rapidly condensing into the spectral image of the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
A Tripod hidden within the moon, with a man sitting inside the Tripod— the three overlapped and intertwined, appearing as one.
Yuan Ming felt that the Stealing Heaven Tripod had truly merged with him, and he could manipulate it as he wished with just a thought.
He tried to mobilize the Desire Power stored in the tripod and immediately discovered that an invisible warm current rushed out from a mysterious space within the tripod, flowing into his Sea of Consciousness like spring water.
The Desire Power stored in the tripod was extremely pure, not even containing any emotional thoughts, purer than after refining the first soul.
Yuan Ming greedily absorbed this warm current, quickly restoring the Soul Power he had expended refining three Magic Treasures.
As soon as his Divine Soul recovered, the warm current promptly ceased.
Yuan Ming furrowed his brows, he had already refined the Forbidden on the external part of the Stealing Heaven Tripod, but just like before, he could only use the warm current inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod to restore his Divine Soul and could not enhance his Soul Power.
He activated his Divine Sense and penetrated into the interior of the Stealing Heaven Tripod, investigating the source of the warm current.
A faint calling sound came from within the Stealing Heaven Tripod, ethereal and elusive, not noticeable if one didn't listen attentively, let alone hear the content of the callings. Moreover, these callings were numerous and chaotic, with tones and timbres all different, seemingly not emanating from the same person.
Just as Yuan Ming was about to listen carefully to these sounds, a sudden "bang" like thunder exploded in his ear, his head became heavy, the scenery before his eyes shifted, and he suddenly appeared in an unfamiliar, dimly white space.
"Where is this?" Yuan Ming was inwardly startled and quickly looked around.
All around him were dim white walls of fog, the visible space was only twenty or thirty feet in size, and farther areas were drowned in dense white fog, impenetrable by sight or Divine Sense.
The sky also reached only about ten feet high, also enveloped in white fog.VisitMyVirtualLibraryEmpire(*)formore.
This twenty or thirty feet space wasn't empty; the ground was paved with warm jade stone bricks, looking crystal clear and bright.
More importantly, a cylindrical White Jade Altar was situated not far away, about ten or so feet in size, four or five feet high, with a White Jade Lotus Platform placed on its top surounded by countless flickering Golden Light, like the stars of the night sky, making the Lotus Platform appear even more sacred and mysterious.
Yuan Ming checked his body, his storage magic tool, Golden Sun Ruler, White Bone Knife, and other Magic Treasures were all present, which slightly relieved him.
Although he didn't know where he was, having a few Magic Treasures in hand meant that he had some ability to protect himself should danger arise.
Yuan Ming waved his hand and raised the Bronze Small Tripod, a palpable golden light emanating from within enveloped his body.
The Golden Sun Ruler and White Bone Knife also appeared and circled around him, fluttering in flight.
After completing these actions, Yuan Ming slowly walked towards the White Jade Altar, inspecting and moving as he walked.
The altar was cylindrical, its exterior walls engraved with many ancient golden patterns that appeared to form a golden formation.
Yuan Ming closely inspected the golden Array Patterns, becoming more and more astonished as he did so.
These patterns resembled the golden patterns that appeared on the body of the Stealing Heaven Tripod during his recent refinement, only these were significantly more complex.
"Could it be that this is inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod?" Yuan Ming suddenly thought wildly.
But recalling everything that had just happened, the more he thought about it, the more he felt he was correct.
He placed his palm against the exterior wall of the altar and activated his Mana, trying to stimulate the golden formation.
However, the interior of the altar was immeasurable and deep, and the robust Mana entering it vanished like a stone sinking into the ocean, only causing the Array Patterns near his palm to faintly emit golden light while other areas remained still.
Yuan Ming then activated his Divine Sense, attempting to probe the interior of the altar, but a flexible force ruthlessly blocked him out.
He became silent, then looked towards the White Jade Lotus Platform at the top of the altar and flew up onto it.
As soon as he reached the top of the altar, the numerous calls he heard earlier reappeared, originating from the White Jade Lotus Platform. As Yuan Ming approached, the calls grew clearer and more urgent, those seemingly disordered words landing in Yuan Ming's ears now all transformed into titles uniquely his.
"Lord Yuan Ming..."
"Lord Nether Moon God..."
"Master..."
Accompanied by countless calling voices, streams of Desire Power converged from all directions, pouring into the White Lotus Platform.
Feeling this scene, Yuan Ming was completely certain that this was inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
The Lotus Platform flickered with tens of thousands of points of Golden Light, bright and dark, near and far, each one emitting streams of Desire Power filled with complex emotions, continuously transferred here.
The White Lotus Platform emitted a soft white light, the complex emotions swirling around the Desire Power touched the white light and immediately vanished like ice and fire, turning into streams of pure Desire Power, merging into the White Lotus Platform.
Yuan Ming slowly nodded, the Stealing Heaven Tripod used this Lotus Platform to refine the emotions within the Desire Power; what kind of treasure was this White Jade Lotus Platform?
Just then, the White Lotus Platform suddenly burst forth with bright white light, releasing a tremendous suction force enveloping Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming was greatly alarmed and urgently activated his Mana to resist, but it was like trying to stop a vehicle with a mantis's arms, and he was pulled over without any ability to resist, "bang," landing on the Lotus Platform.
As streams of Desire Power converged toward him, Yuan Ming was greatly shocked and hurriedly tried to activate the soul splitting technique to refine the Desire Power to prevent being overwhelmed by the surging emotions contained within it.

chapters.title: Chapter 374 - 351: Manifestation
chapters.content:
However, before Yuan Ming could activate his first soul, his body was enveloped by the white light emanating from the Lotus Platform, and the Desire Power was refined before it even touched him, merging into the Lotus Platform.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming slightly relaxed and began to probe the Lotus Platform beneath him with his Divine Sense.
He had thought that his Divine Sense would be repelled again, yet this time the Lotus Platform offered no resistance to his probing, easily allowing his Divine Sense to enter.
A massive current of heat surged within the Lotus Platform, vast like the deep sea, its tumult nearly crushing his Divine Sense.
"So the Desire Power absorbed by the Stealing Heaven Tripod was all stored here," Yuan Ming thought, carefully sensing the currents of heat within the Lotus Platform.
This current was divided into two parts: one was very close to him, and he could clearly sense it was made from his refined Desire Power; the other felt completely foreign.
However, this foreign heat current was extremely scarce, making up less than one percent.
"Could this heat current be from the previous owner of the Stealing Heaven Tripod? Indeed, back when I was a Beast Slave in Biluo Cave, the Stealing Heaven Tripod once released this kind of heat current to save me. At that time, I could not collect Desire Power, so it must have been a gift from the previous owner of the Tripod," Yuan Ming speculated in silence, then attempted to summon this heat current.
The white light on the Lotus Platform suddenly stirred, and the obedient heat current surged out, merging into his Sea of Consciousness.
Yuan Ming's Divine Soul Power swelled as if being inflated, his Soul Power climbing rapidly, and in a short period of time, it had increased more than tenfold.
At that moment, he felt his Spirit Platform was incomparably clear, and with the amplification of his Soul Power, every single thought possessed tremendous power.
Yuan Ming felt as if he had transformed into a spirit god wielding endless power, towering like a mountain, overlooking all beings, able to crush several Core Formation Stage cultivators with a wave of his hand.
"Such powerful strength, the Sixth Level of the Moonlight Technique is probably no better than this, right?"
Just as Yuan Ming was marveling inwardly, the white light from the Lotus Platform dissipated, and he regained control of his body.
Without the Protective Body of white light, tens of thousands of Desire Powers converged, acting upon his Divine Soul.
Yuan Ming only felt a "hum" in his Divine Soul as countless emotions flooded his Sea of Consciousness, nearly bursting it, and he stood up in alarm.
As soon as his body left the Lotus Platform, the surging heat current in his Sea of Consciousness quickly receded, flowing back entirely into the Lotus Platform.
Yuan Ming's Soul Power also returned to normal.
"So it turns out that the heat current inside the Lotus Platform cannot be taken away; it can only be borrowed temporarily," Yuan Ming quickly understood.
He hesitated for a moment, then sat on the Lotus Platform again.
"Boom"
The immense heat current surged from within the Lotus Platform once more, merging into his Sea of Consciousness, causing his Soul Power to skyrocket tenfold.
No white light appeared on the Lotus Platform this time, and countless muddled and disordered emotions followed the Desire Power into his Sea of Consciousness.
Yuan Ming quickly ran the Moonlight Technique. Although this cultivation technique wasn't particularly good at stabilizing emotions, it still helped to steady his Divine Soul, barely withstanding the onslaught.
Yuan Ming did not dare to relax. He continued to run the Moonlight Technique, trying to refine the massive heat current.
The power contained in this heat current was just too strong, and he couldn't help but want to make it his own.
However, no matter how Yuan Ming ran the Moonlight Technique, or even the Heart Cleansing Technique, he was unable to absorb a trace of the heat current. It seemed to contain some special intention that made it impossible to refine.
"There really are no shortcuts to heaven in this world, but being able to experience the realm of the Sixth Level of the Moonlight Technique in advance is also quite good," a hint of disappointment flashed in Yuan Ming's eyes.
Now that his Soul Power had increased tenfold, he had a deeper connection with the golden light around the Lotus Platform that represented Desire Power. With a mere thought, he could trace back to the origins of that Desire Power.
Yuan Ming operated a stream of Divine Sense, reaching out for a point of golden light.
As soon as they touched, the scene in front of him changed instantly, revealing a vision.
In a humble cottage, a woman wearing coarse hemp clothes knelt in front of a wooden ancestral tablet, ceaselessly praying with hands clasped. The tablet was engraved with the words "Nether Moon God."
Not far away, a middle-aged man with a weathered face sat at a table, depressedly puffing on a dry pipe. Glancing at the woman doing so, he couldn't help but complain.
"Stop praying, you pray to this broken tablet every day, and yet our child's illness hasn't gotten better."
"You heartless man, all you do is complain there," the woman retorted, "Mr. Li from the Huichun Inn said that our child's illness cannot be treated by ordinary people, only those Immortal Masters proficient in spells can heal it. You and I are both Prisoners, and those high and mighty Immortal Masters in Xiongya City don't care about our life and death, only the Lord Nether Moon God is willing to show mercy to us mortals. If I don't pray to him, whom should I pray to?" the woman turned her head and snapped back.
"Xiongya City..." Yuan Ming had heard of this city, an underground city under Zhao Country, quite far from Spirit Wind City.
Using the Stealing Heaven Tripod to sense the origins of the Desire Power in the past, the furthest he could reach was merely dozens of miles.
Now that he had entered the Stealing Heaven Tripod, his sensing range had increased so much that he could even see the general situation of the believers clearly.
This Stealing Heaven Tripod is truly inconceivable; what level of treasure could it be?
"I think you have been deceived by that man who claims to be a Nether Moon God Envoy, an Immortal Master named Xu Che. Are there really any gods in this world? Even if you cracked your head open, would that so-called Nether Moon God spare you a glance?" the middle-aged man, frustrated, slapped his dry pipe onto the table with a "snap."
"Then what do you suggest we do? Gouwa is only nine years old, if, if he dies, I won't want to live either!" the woman shouted back, unable to hold back her tears.
Seeing this, the middle-aged man's anger was doused by her tears, and he lowered his head, sighing deeply.
Watching this scene, Yuan Ming mostly understood everything—the woman was very likely a believer cultivated by Xu Che.
He stirred the Divine Sense he had projected over, quickly expanding his field of view to envelop the entire hut. In a neighboring bedroom, he found Gouwa mentioned by the woman, a dark-skinned little boy.
Gouwa was lying on the bed with his eyes tightly closed, his cheeks sunken and his breathing weak; he appeared to have not much time left.
Yuan Ming activated his Divine Sense to examine Gouwa's body and found no injuries. However, his Divine Soul was exceptionally weakened.
Upon closer inspection of Gouwa's Divine Soul, he discovered a fine crack on its surface, seemingly inflicted by some sort of soul attack.
Ordinary people possess feeble Soul Power; even a minor soul shock can cause significant problems.
This level of injury wasn't difficult to handle. Not to mention cultivators, even slightly older mortals wouldn't fall into a coma from this, although they might suffer from other sequela such as amnesia and so on.
Yuan Ming himself had lost his memory after being attacked by the Soul-Attracting Bell.
However, as he began to practice the Moonlight Technique, his Divine Soul became more refined, and he reclaimed his lost memories.
The best way to heal this kind of injury was to allow the injured to use their own Soul Power to mend it, thereby strengthening the Divine Soul.
Of course, Yuan Ming could not pass on the Moonlight Technique to Gouwa, and even if he did, Gouwa couldn't cultivate in his continuously comatose state.
But Yuan Ming was not without methods.
He increased the projection of Divine Soul Power, enveloping Gouwa's body.
Next, he manipulated his first soul, refining the Pure Will Power that still streamed in endlessly, and then infused a strand of the refined Pure Will Power into Gouwa's Divine Soul.
After absorbing and refining the Will Power for so long, Yuan Ming gradually discerned some of its properties.
The Will Power drawn by the Stealing Heaven Tripod originated from others' gratitude, faith, and adoration toward Yuan Ming. Stripping away these emotions revealed that this Will Power was akin to unclaimed Soul Power that others could absorb and utilize.
Although it was just a strand of Will Power, it was excessive for Gouwa, an ordinary child. The crack in his soul quickly vanished, his Divine Soul completely recovered, and even grew stronger.
Yet Gouwa had been comatose for so long and was physically weak, it seemed he would not wake up anytime soon.
"My Divine Power can be projected through the Stealing Heaven Tripod; I wonder if mana can be sent as well?" Yuan Ming thought, casting a Wood Attribute healing spell.
A green light shot from his hand, directed toward the dot of golden light representing the woman.
The golden formation on the altar began to operate, and Yuan Ming felt his connection with the woman strengthen rapidly.
He hurriedly projected the green light toward her.
A ripple appeared above Gouwa's head, as the green light materialized from the void and instantly merged into his body.
The next moment, Gouwa's pale complexion rapidly returned to normal, and his breathing evened out.
Yuan Ming no longer found the magical effects of the Stealing Heaven Tripod strange and was quite satisfied with the current situation.
In the past, he had to work hard to recruit believers, personally going to solve their troubles. Now that he had entered the Tripod, he could finally respond to his believers' prayers from afar, barely resembling a deity.
"As you have wished, your child is now fully healed," Yuan Ming sent a thread of thought, conveying it into the woman's Sea of Consciousness.
The woman abruptly lifted her head, her face displaying shock.
"What's wrong? Why the shock?" The middle-aged man, who was sitting at the table sighing, spoke in an irritated tone upon seeing his wife's reaction.
The woman ignored her husband, abruptly stood up, and rushed into Gouwa's room.
The middle-aged man's expression changed slightly, and he quickly followed her.
Gouwa was sitting up in bed, still looking somewhat confused.
"Child! Are you well?" The woman threw herself at Gouwa, embracing him tightly and crying with joy.
The middle-aged man also showed a happy face, gently stroking Gouwa's head.
Help us out by reading on *.
"Wife, what's going on?" The man quickly regained his composure and asked.
The woman had somewhat calmed down by now and explained the voice that had echoed in her mind just now.
"The Nether Moon God? Could it be that there is truly a deity in this world willing to protect mortals?" The middle-aged man opened his eyes wide, somewhat incredulous.
He often worked for Immortal Masters and had a broader perspective than ordinary mortals, but he couldn't help but believe the situation before his eyes.
"I have always said that Lord Nether Moon God is effective, now do you believe it?" the woman said smugly.
"I believe, of course, I believe," the middle-aged man quickly responded, nodding eagerly amidst his excitement.
Finally, Gouwa regained his senses, looking up at his parents with a puzzled expression.
"Dad, Mom, what are you doing?"
Seeing her son speak, the woman was both shocked and overjoyed, hugging her child again, crying and scolding, "You little brat, do you have any idea how worried you've made me?"
The middle-aged man wiped his eyes and said, "Wife, take care of the child first; I'll go buy some good incense right now."
"Yes, yes, make sure to buy the good stuff," the woman said, pulling Gouwa to the altar of the Nether Moon God and made him kneel beside her.
"Gouwa, remember, it was Lord Nether Moon God that saved you. From now on, you need to worship day and night with your mother, praying for peace and smooth sailing."

chapters.title: Chapter 375 - 352: Fragment
chapters.content:
Inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod, Yuan Ming sensed an increase in the Desire Power coming from a woman, and a substantial amount of Desire Power also surged from the mid-aged man and Gouwa. He smiled contentedly.
He withdrew his Divine Sense and reached out to another believer.
This believer was an elderly mortal named Xu Daniu, who lived in Xiansha City for decades. He had taken a wife and had children, but unfortunately, his wife and children had all passed away, leaving him to live alone.
Xu Daniu prayed for the resurrection of his wife and children so that his family could live a life free from illness and disaster.
Yuan Ming lacked the ability to bring the dead back to life and thus couldn't fulfill this request. He could only cast a Calming Incantation to stabilize the mind.
A beam of white light shot out from the Nether Moon God's tablet and merged into Xu Daniu's body.
Although the Calming Incantation was a minor spell, when Yuan Ming, who was at the Core Formation Stage, cast it on a mortal, the effect was exceptionally good.
Xu Daniu felt a warm current flow through his body, erasing all his fatigue, sadness, loss, and other negative emotions. His mind felt more peaceful than ever before, causing him to stand there in a daze.
He knew his prayer could not be fulfilled and had appealed to Lord Nether Moon God more as an outlet for his inner turmoil. To his surprise, Lord Nether Moon God actually responded to him.
"Lord Nether Moon God..." The old man bowed his head in fearful gratitude and knelt, becoming even more devout than before!
Yuan Ming retracted his Divine Sense and responded to a few more believers' requests, receiving mostly positive feedback. The desire power generated by these people had noticeably increased.
However, the Desire Power generated by mortals was ultimately limited. After addressing a few believers, he began to search for cultivator believers.
According to his observations, the more Desire Power the believers generated, the brighter the golden light surrounding the White Jade Lotus Platform grew. Yuan Ming activated his Divine Sense and aimed for the brightest point of golden light.
The figure of a young man appeared, sitting in the shade of a large sand dune and devoutly chanting the name of the Nether Moon God. It was Xu Che.
Yuan Ming was slightly startled, then regained his composure.
Among his many believers, Xu Che's cultivation was indeed the highest. It was unfortunate that Hua Zhi and Vajra, being spirit pets with independent thoughts, only verbally called him master. Their relationship was more of a special cooperation rather than complete admiration or belief in him.
Otherwise, with their strength, they would have been able to generate a significant amount of Desire Power.
Perhaps one day, the nature of his relationship with Hua Zhi Vajra might change, but it was not something to consider in the short term.
Yuan Ming operated his Divine Sense, carefully examining Xu Che and nodded slightly.
Compared to the last time they met, Xu Che's cultivation had improved significantly and he must be near the Mid-stage Foundation Establishment.
The stronger Xu Che's abilities, the more Desire Power he would generate, which could help attract more believers of Nether Moon God.
An idea suddenly popped into Yuan Ming's mind. If the Stealing Heaven Tripod could transmit spells, perhaps it could also transport items?
With this thought, he took out several bottles of Mid-stage Foundation Establishment elixirs and placed them on the altar.
The golden formation on the altar buzzed and operated, wrapping the bottles in a golden light mixed with many silver runes, sending them towards Xu Che.
Yuan Ming watched the scene with surprise and joy.
If it could transport items, the Stealing Heaven Tripod would be even more valuable.
However, at that moment, the golden light with silver runes suddenly disappeared, and the golden formation abruptly stopped. The bottles of elixir flew back to Yuan Ming's side.
Almost simultaneously, a "crack" sound emanated from the front of the White Jade Lotus Platform. The top of the altar suddenly split open, revealing a circular area several meters in size, engraved with golden Array Patterns, forming an exquisitely complex Array Map.
The Array Map and the surrounding golden formation seemed to be one, except for the Array Patterns, it also contained numerous indents. Hundreds of densely packed, fist-sized, multicolored crystal stones were embedded in it.
Yuan Ming observed the rapid changes in front of him for a while before realizing what was happening. He hastily examined the Array Map and the crystal stones within.
The Array Map was too profound for his current understanding of formations, but he could somewhat discern the crystal stones. These stones were somewhat similar to Spirit Stones, yet the waves of spiritual power they emitted were very subtle.
"It seems these crystal stones are supporting the operation of the Stealing Heaven Tripod's restrictions," Yuan Ming mused.
Although the fluctuations of these stones were subtle, he could still distinguish their attributes, which were primarily the Five Elements. However, six crystal stones were exceptions.
These six stones were one silver, one grey, two black, and two white.
Yuan Ming looked at the silver crystal stone, which had become translucent, indicating that its spiritual power had been depleted.
A thoughtful expression crossed his face.
The recent failure to transport the elixirs was caused by the sudden disappearance of the silver runes, which bore the same aura as the silver crystal stone before him.
Tracing back to its root, the failure to transport the elixirs was likely due to the depletion of spiritual power within this silver crystal stone.
With this realization, Yuan Ming reached out to grasp the silver crystal stone, exerting a slight force.
With a soft click, the crystal stone was pulled out.
He carefully sensed the crystal stone, firmly remembering the remaining aura fluctuations within it.
If he wasn't mistaken, as long as he obtained a new silver crystal stone, the Stealing Heaven Tripod would be able to transport items.
"Oh!" Yuan Ming's gaze suddenly shifted, and with a wave of his hand, he sent out a green light, rolling out an object from a gap along the edge of the array map.
This was a sword blade fragment, completely dark, half a foot in length, with one end being the sharp tip, razor-sharp, and the other end was the broken part, with a jagged, uneven break, as if it had been bluntly smashed by a heavy object.
Full of curiosity, Yuan Ming examined the object in his hand. This sword blade fragment, being hidden within the circular array, was certainly no ordinary item.
He activated his Divine Sense, but there was no aura remaining on the fragment; it seemed completely destroyed, and infusing Mana had no effect as well.
Yuan Ming felt somewhat disappointed, yet he did not give up and continued to explore it with other methods.
A moment later, his expression suddenly changed, holding the sword blade fragment before him, he gazed intently inside the fragment.
The black sword blade fragment had a kind of translucent quality, and faintly visible inside were three inscribed runes.
These three runes had numerous strokes, ten times more complex than the most complex rune he had encountered so far, yet this dense pattern did not feel chaotic but instead conveyed an indescribable sense of beauty.
Although he hadn't activated their power, he was certain that the effects of these three runes were extraordinarily powerful beyond imagination.
For an Artifact Refiner, a wondrous rune was invaluable.
Yuan Ming once again directed Mana into the sword blade fragment, this time targeting one specific rune.
The rune initially showed no response, but after several breaths passed, it suddenly emitted a faint glow, which quickly dimmed.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming felt a surge of joy. It seemed that the sword blade fragment was not completely destroyed after all, and the three runes still retained a trace of Spiritual Power.
Undoubtedly, this was good news for him. As long as the runes were not completely damaged, he could study their drawing method and inscribe them onto other Magic Treasures to restore their power.
Yuan Ming carefully stored the sword blade fragment and continued to sense Xu Che's situation over there.
At this moment, a flicker of light passed beside the Lotus Platform, and a bright golden light appeared, a robust stream of Desire Power transmitted over, clearly generated by a Cultivator.
A hint of surprise flashed across Yuan Ming's eyes as his Divine Sense extended over, and a scene emerged before him.
This was a room similar to a young lady's boudoir, with a white scrim bed placed against the wall, beside it, a set of tea table and chairs, on the other side, a redwood vanity table.
A yellow-clothed young girl lay on the scrim bed, engrossed in a book, which was Yuan Ming's "Young Master Sheng's Southern Journey."
"It's her," Yuan Ming's brow twitched.
The yellow-clothed young girl reading was none other than Yan Sijing, whom he had coincidentally met earlier when renting the Cave Mansion.
Yuan Ming moved the power of his Divine Sense, looking around, and soon confirmed that Yan Sijing was still within Spirit Wind City, in a Cave Mansion in the middle area of the city.
In another room of the Cave Mansion, Yan Siyun was sitting cross-legged on the bed, meditating with closed eyes.
"That figures," Yuan Ming muttered to himself.
Before he secluded himself for his Core Formation breakthrough, he had sent Zuo Qinghui out to handle duties, specifically to acquaint himself with the situation in Spirit Wind City, attempt to expand the Moon Sect, and cooperate with the bookstores in the city to sell "Young Master Sheng's Southern Journey" to gather more Desire Power.
After the breakthrough to the Fifth Layer of the Moonlight Technique, the rise became increasingly difficult, and the demand for Desire Power grew significantly, as the first soul also needed to be enhanced; the previous Desire Power was starting to be insufficient.
Yuan Ming's face showed a pensive expression, then he mobilized all his Divine Power, casting it downwards, enveloping Yan Sijing's body.
This is a sample from My Virtual Library Empire. Read the rest on *.
In the Cave Mansion of Spirit Wind City, Yan Sijing was flipping through the travelogue, the descriptions of Southern Border scenery, exotic customs, and various ethnic groups thoroughly captivated her heart, arousing strong curiosity about Southern Border.
"It's really nice, here in Black Wind Desert there's only sand, which makes it so stifling. If I could go to Southern Border and enjoy the beautiful mountains and waters, that would be wonderful," Yan Sijing murmured with sparkling eyes.
Although she was the workshop owner of Hundred Pills Square and was responsible for refining elixirs and greeting customers on a daily basis, her sister Yan Siyun handled the real troubles inside the workshop; she still exhibited a girlish nature.
However, unprecedented disaster had befallen Hundred Pills Square lately; Thunderbolt Ancestor had discovered the cause of Yu Hong's death and sent people to demolish the workshop.
Fortunately, Yan Siyun had prepared in advance and escaped with most resources in time, heading straight for Spirit Wind City.
People from Thunderbolt Ancestor were searching everywhere for the Yan sisters; they did not even dare to step out of Spirit Wind City, let alone head to the Southern Border.
"That old lecher Thunderbolt Ancestor, he may not have a hundred grandsons, but he has quite a few. Just because one died, demolishing Hundred Pills Square isn't enough; he must absolutely obliterate everything! When granny here has achieved significant Cultivation, I'll make sure he knows what I'm capable of!" Yan Sijing clenched her fist and cursed silently.
Just at that moment, with a "boom" sound, an immensely powerful Divine Soul pressure descended from the sky.
This oppressive force was as immense as the sovereign heavens, heavy as the earth mother, and Yan Sijing, completely powerless to resist, was pressed down, paralyzed on the bed, unable to move a finger.
"No good, could it be Thunderbolt Ancestor has come!" Yan Sijing's eyes widened, her previously bold words completely forgotten, leaving only bone-deep terror.
"Are you, Yan Sijing from Hundred Pills Square?" an imposing voice resounded within Yan Sijing's mind, nearly crushing her soul.

chapters.title: Chapter 376 - 353: Congratulations
chapters.content:
"Thunderbolt Ancestor, my sister and I never intended to kill Young Master Yu Hong. Please show mercy and spare our lives..." Yan Sijing pleaded.
"I am not the so-called Thunderbolt Ancestor; I am the Nether Moon God. I came seeking those fated to meet me. Someone once mentioned to me that you possessed exceptional wisdom. I have descended to inquire whether you would be willing to become a follower of mine," he said.
"Nether Moon God?" Yan Sijing was stunned.
According to her sister's guess, the Nether Moon God was an identity Yuan Ming had fabricated. So how could there be another Nether Moon God?
That Yuan Ming was merely a Late-stage Foundation Establishment Cultivator, whereas Yan Sijing had managed Hundred Pills Square and had even met Nascent Soul cultivators before. The terrifying pressure that enveloped her just now was undoubtedly at the Nascent Soul Level, so it was impossible they were the same person.
Yan Sijing recalled the Nether Moon God's recent words: Someone once mentioned to me...
She had no connection with the Nether Moon God, and the only contact she had was that escort mission.
"Could it be that Yuan Ming wasn't the Nether Moon God but rather his envoy? After meeting me, he reported my existence, which is why the Nether Moon God has descended?" Yan Sijing guessed silently.
"Are you willing?" Yuan Ming said with a deep voice, his tone now authoritative.
"This humble girl is willing to become a follower," Yan Sijing quickly said, her Divine Soul trembling violently once more.
"Very well. Pray sincerely every day, and if you find yourself in danger, you may silently call my name," Yuan Ming said, softening his voice.
"Yes," Yan Sijing replied with a dejected face.
She felt incredibly unlucky recently, being pursued by the Thunderbolt Ancestor and now entangled by a mysterious Nether Moon God. She wondered if she could escape safely.
"I have heard of Hundred Pills Square. Why aren't you busy with your shop, and how come you are here?" Yuan Ming asked.
Yan Sijing's thoughts raced. "Hundred Pills Square has not been doing well these past few years. I came here to cultivate in seclusion, attempting to make a breakthrough in Alchemy Technique to break the deadlock," she explained.
Hearing this, Yuan Ming understood that Yan Sijing did not trust him, but he did not expose it and retracted his Divine Sense.
It was difficult for Xu Che alone to attract cultivator believers. Since he had declared himself the Nether Moon God through the Stealing Heaven Tripod, he could not remain idle.
Cultivators generally have strong wills and do not easily worship a deity. Yuan Ming also did not wish to force faith upon anyone, as followers obtained through threats or temptations cannot genuinely produce Desire Power.
Yan Sijing and her sister had their own remarkable qualities, more worthy of nurturing than Xu Che, and they were currently in danger. This was a good opportunity; if he could offer some help at a critical moment, there was a good chance to win over the sisters as believers.
Yuan Ming had some involvement with Yu Hong's death and feared retaliation from the Thunderbolt Ancestor. Over the years, he had Zuo Qinghui inquire about the latter's cultivation, knowing that the opponent was a Nascent Soul Early Stage Cultivator. Inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod, his Soul Power was comparable to the Sixth Level of the Moonlight Technique, and he was not afraid of the Thunderbolt Ancestor.
Yan Sijing felt the pressure lift from her shoulders as all the tension dissipated. She hurriedly jumped up from the bed and cautiously looked around, seemingly observing whether the Nether Moon God had truly left.
After a long while, the voice of the Nether Moon God did not reappear. Her mind somewhat settled, she quickly headed towards the secret room where Yan Siyun was cultivating.
Inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space, Yuan Ming rubbed his forehead.
The Soul Power in his Sea of Consciousness hadn't diminished at all; it was still immense. However, controlling such vast Soul Power was a hefty burden on him, and he was exhausted.
"It seems using this power comes at a cost," Yuan Ming whispered to himself, rising to his feet.
The moment he stepped off the Lotus Platform, the Soul Power in his Sea of Consciousness rapidly weakened, returning to normal levels, but he also felt much lighter.
Yuan Ming looked around. The space inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod was mysterious, likely much larger than this, with thick fog hiding many secrets. He wondered when he would be able to fully explore it.
He had encountered too many mystical things today, and his spirit was exhausted. He lacked the energy to delve further and only wished to return and rest.
But then it struck him, how was he supposed to leave this place?
Although Yuan Ming had refined the outer layer of the Forbidden on the Stealing Heaven Tripod, he was far from being able to control it.
Just then, his vision suddenly blurred, and by the time he came to his senses, he was already back in the Spirit Wind City's secret room, with the Stealing Heaven Tripod silently hovering in front of him.
"So that's how it is," Yuan Ming muttered to himself, stowing away the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
He sat down cross-legged but did not immediately close his eyes to rest. Instead, he formed a hand seal and pointed to the nearby wall.
A layer of water-like reflection appeared out of nowhere on the wall, rapidly flashing with countless images.
This was a Water attribute variation from the Five Elements Illusion Destruction Array, similar to a Recording Artifact, capable of documenting images.
Controlling the Array, the Water Mirror soon displayed the scene of him refining the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
The Golden Light on the Tripod flared, and he vanished into thin air, leaving only the Tripod suspended in the room.
"It seems I have indeed entered the tripod," Yuan Ming thought to himself.
His expression suddenly changed as he remembered something.
According to the situation displayed on the Water Mirror, after his body took refuge inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod, all he needed was to find a reliable person to take the tripod away, and then nobody would be able to find him, right?
With this thought, Yuan Ming felt a surge of excitement, but he quickly calmed himself down.
Visit My Virtual Library Empire (*) for more.
Although this idea seemed flawless, whether it could actually be implemented required further study.
He suppressed his various thoughts and closed his eyes to rest his mind.
The next morning, Yuan Ming emerged from the seclusion chamber.
The Three Beasts that had been waiting outside the room knelt down on one knee as they saw Yuan Ming come out — Hua Zhi and Vajra immediately, and Lei Yu followed suit, folding its wings and bowing its head.
"Congratulations to the master on the successful Core Formation."
Hua Zhi and Vajra congratulated in unison, while Lei Yu let out a cry.
"You have had a hard time protecting outside," Yuan Ming nodded and gestured for them to stand beside him, then he moved to the entrance of the Cave Mansion and pushed open the door.
Outside the door, a Sound Transmission Talisman blocked by a forbidden seal was fluttering, unable to find its way, sticking right on the seal. Yuan Ming released the seal, gestured with his hand, and the talisman flew straight into his hand.
Yuan Ming activated the Sound Transmission Talisman, and soon heard a somewhat familiar and elderly voice from it.
"This is Pi Xiu, elder of the Spirit Talisman Sect, congratulating Fellow Daoist on your successful Core Formation. May I ask whether Fellow Daoist would allow this old man to visit and offer congratulations in person?"
In the Spirit Wind City, there was not just one Core Formation Cultivator like Pi Xiu, but after Yuan Ming's breakthrough, this was the only Sound Transmission Talisman he received. The deep implications behind this couldn't help but lead to wild speculations.
After a moment of contemplation, Yuan Ming gave a decisive response, "Of course, I will await Fellow Daoist's arrival in front of the Cave Mansion."
A light laughter came from the Sound Transmission Talisman, and then it burned to ashes.
In a short while, a tunneling light flew out from the Spirit Wind Hall and landed in front of Yuan Ming, revealing Pi Xiu's figure — the bald old man who had handled his residency.
Upon seeing Yuan Ming, Pi Xiu greeted with a smile and a clasped hand, "Fellow Daoist made me wait quite a bit. Do you remember Pi, who handled your residence? At the time, my old eyes were dim and I failed to see the exceptional talent of Fellow Daoist. So young yet able to form a Golden Core, if there was any neglect, I hope Fellow Daoist will forgive me."
"Fellow Daoist Pi is too kind. On the contrary, it was I who spent a few extra days to stabilize the realm and failed to receive the transmission in time. Please forgive me," Yuan Ming replied politely, inviting Pi Xiu into the Cave Mansion.
