Pi Xiu laughed loudly, "Not at all, not at all. As a new Core Formation cultivator, it's proper to fully experience the mysteries of this state."
As he spoke, he stepped into the mansion and saw the Three Beasts of Hua Zhi standing to the side, a flicker of surprise crossing his face.
"I have only just arrived in this treasure land and haven't managed to make friends with any trustworthy Fellow Daoists, so I could only have my three spirit beasts protect from outside. I apologize for the amusement," seeing this, Yuan Ming explained.
Pi Xiu shook his head, "Where is that, Fellow Daoist? Each of these three spirit beasts is extraordinary and clearly not of common stock. Even ordinary Foundation Establishment cultivators might not be able to contend with them. It is no wonder Fellow Daoist can form a Golden Core at such a young age."
Unresponsive to his flattery, Yuan Ming smiled and did not reply, instead continuing to move forward, leading him into the reception room.
Once seated, Pi Xiu went straight to the point, "Fellow Daoist is young and promising; may I ask whom you were mentored by?"
Yuan Ming shook his head, "I am but a Loose Cultivator. Although I do have a mentor, she does not regard me as a disciple."
"Is that so? Then I wonder what you think about our Spirit Talisman Sect?" Pi Xiu asked again.
"Fellow Daoist Pi need not probe. I have a good impression of your esteemed sect, but I have been accustomed to being unrestrained in the past and do not like to be bound by others. I have no plans to join a sect at the moment," Yuan Ming answered directly.
Pi Xiu was not ready to give up, "Fellow Daoist, don't be hasty. Listen to what I have to say before making a decision. Our Spirit Talisman Sect, although on par with the Five Thunder Sect among the great sects of Zhao Country, is not as strict as the Five Thunder Sect towards Loose Cultivators who are willing to join."
"As long as you become a Guest Elder of our sect, Fellow Daoist will receive a monthly stipend, and you can also acquire our sect's unique talisman points by carrying out tasks or purchasing them directly with spirit stones. You can exchange talisman points for spiritual materials, elixirs, talismans, and cultivation techniques stored in our sect's treasury. Not only are the prices more favorable, but there are also many treasures not found elsewhere."
"Furthermore, every sixty years, our sect's Nascent Soul Ancestors will hold a grand lecture in the main hall. If Fellow Daoist becomes a Guest Elder, you will also be eligible to attend. At that time, Fellow Daoist can even spend talisman points to obtain the right to ask questions to a Nascent Soul Ancestor."
"As you know, at our level, each step forward is incredibly difficult. Receiving guidance and solving cultivation puzzles from a Nascent Soul cultivator is an invaluable opportunity that countless spirit stones cannot buy."
If another Loose Cultivator had heard this lengthy speech, they probably would be eager to nod in agreement, wishing to join immediately.
It's a pity that Yuan Ming carried too many secrets and was destined not to join the Spirit Talisman Sect. No matter how enticing the conditions, he would firmly shake his head and refuse.
Seeing that Yuan Ming was still unmoved, a trace of disappointment flashed across Pi Xiu's face, but he remained very courteous towards Yuan Ming, "If Fellow Daoist changes your mind in the future, you may come to the Spirit Wind Hall to find me at any time. I will be more than happy to receive you. Additionally, here is the rent you paid before. Since Fellow Daoist has achieved Core Formation, according to the rules of our sect, your future rent in Spirit Wind City is waived, which can also be considered a Core Formation congratulatory gift from our sect."

chapters.title: Chapter 377 - 354: Three Runes
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming did not refuse and, after accepting the storage bag passed to him by Pi Xiu, he consulted Pi Xiu about some issues he needed to be aware of after entering the Core Formation Stage. Pi Xiu, already inclined to form a good bond with Yuan Ming, did not skimp on offering guidance.
However, in their conversation, he would intentionally or unintentionally mention the benefits of joining the Spirit Talisman Sect, which made Yuan Ming somewhat bemused.
After talking for a while, Pi Xiu seemed to have received a sound transmission from someone and took the initiative to say goodbye. Before leaving, however, he left behind a few sound transmission talismans, obviously not giving up on recruiting Yuan Ming.
But Yuan Ming did not mind his persistence and, moreover, although he had declined the invitation, most of the Core Formation Cultivators in Spirit Wind City had chosen to become guest elders of the Spirit Talisman Sect. If Yuan Ming wanted to network, he still needed to go through Pi Xiu for introductions.
This was evident from the fact that after Yuan Ming emerged from seclusion, he received a sound transmission talisman only from Pi Xiu.
The Spirit Talisman Sect might not show malice toward Core Formation Cultivators who reject them, but those Loose Cultivators residing in Spirit Wind City, even those who choose not to join, still mostly consider the face of the Spirit Talisman Sect. Before the Sect acknowledged Yuan Ming's status, they would not rashly welcome him into their circles.
In the days that followed, Yuan Ming did not choose to cultivate bitterly in his cave mansion. Instead, by using Pi Xiu's introductions, he actively participated in large and small gatherings of Core Formation Cultivators, where he engaged in idle talks about Daoism and made many acquaintances among his peers, gradually broadening his perspectives.
Additionally, Yuan Ming sold some items he no longer needed, which he had obtained from Elder Hai and Elder Guo, at several trading meetings for Core Formation Cultivators, and in return, he acquired several rare items.
Of course, during this period, Yuan Ming also often inquired about information concerning the refining of magic treasures and met a few Core Formation Cultivators who specialized in the way of Artifact Refining. Although he heard some basic insights from them, after returning to his cave mansion, he learned a lot about the experience and techniques of refining magic treasures through the Black Incense possession from them.
As he had previously understood, the biggest difference between a magic treasure and a magic artifact is that the former is not inscribed with just one rune, but with a formation made up of at least five runes.
As long as a rune formation is formed and continuously nurtured with Pill Fire, allowing the rune formation and the materials to merge perfectly, a magic treasure is considered successfully refined.
Whether upgrading from top-grade magical tools to magic treasures or directly refining magic treasures, the number of runes composing a rune formation on it must be at least five, not limited to only five.
The number of runes inscribed on a magic treasure and the material of the magic treasure are closely linked—the higher the grade of the refining treasure materials, the more runes they can withstand.
The quality and power of a magic artifact are judged by the number of runes, but at the level of magic treasures, the number of runes in the rune formation continues to be the decisive factor in judging the power of a magic treasure.
A rune formation formed by six runes is far more powerful than one with five runes.
Of course, the power of a magic treasure is also greatly related to its nurturing in later stages. If well-nurtured, a five-rune magic treasure might not necessarily be weaker than one with six runes.
However, the foundation of a magic treasure with six runes is there, overwhelmingly exceeding one with five runes.
Since Yuan Ming considered the Soul Destroying Sword as his Lifebound Magical Treasure, he did not plan to refine it carelessly, he aimed to enhance its power to the maximum.
The main material of the Soul Destroying Sword was Nine Nether Iron, which, as a top-grade material for yin attribute magic treasures, had previously been used by others to refine powerful magic treasures with seven runes right from the start.
After learning this information and after much deliberation, Yuan Ming decided to follow in the footsteps of that renowned individual, attempting to add three more runes while elevating the Soul Destroying Sword to a magic treasure, forming a powerful seven-rune formation.
He was quite confident in this decision, first and foremost, in terms of Artifact Refining Skills. Yuan Ming had spent a year mastering various techniques of refining magic treasures, including some secret techniques from a guest elder of the Spirit Talisman Sect, through multiple possessions by Black Incense.
He also had several Artifact Refiners attempt to refine magic treasures while he was possessing them, noting down their experiences—both successes and failures. Although he had never personally crafted a magic treasure, his refinement experience was no less than those Core Formation Cultivators who specialized in Artifact Refining.
Moreover, his Divine Soul Power far exceeded that of ordinary Core Formation Cultivators; he could enter Stealing Heaven Tripod and, using the power of the White Jade Lotus Platform, enhance his Soul Power by tenfold, giving him a tremendous advantage in engraving runes.
The only issue was deciding which three runes to inscribe on the Soul Destroying Sword, Yuan Ming found this challenging.
He sat at the stone table in his cave mansion, where a jade scroll was placed, recording more than a dozen runes that he had collected during this time.
While the selection of runes for a magic treasure is stricter than for a magic artifact, it is not excessively stringent.
As long as the chosen runes do not conflict with the magic treasure's material and do not counteract each other, cultivators can freely select runes to compose the initial rune formation of the magic treasure.
B@r!ou%g$ht to you by **.
However, the more similar the properties of the runes in the rune formation are, the more stable and powerful the rune formation becomes, and the greater its potential for future enhancement.
But if runes of the same attribute are selected, the magic treasure often has shortcomings. For example, a magic treasure of the Frost Attribute, if not supplemented with runes like "Swift" or "Gale," would move very slowly and struggle to catch up to enemies.
Therefore, when Artifact Refiners choose runes, they generally find it quite vexing, and most ultimately opt for a compromise.
However, Yuan Ming did not think so. Whether it was a Magic Treasure or a Magic Artifact, stability and potency were of utmost importance. Shortcomings in usage could be compensated for by other means. Sacrificing the power and potential of the Magic Treasure for the sake of temporary convenience was a very foolish act.
After gathering information secretly, Yuan Ming had figured out the four runes on the Soul Destroying Sword. They were "Soul Stabilizing," "Soul Suppressing," "Soul Devouring," and "Soul Blade," all of which were runes related to souls with a yin attribute.
Clearly, Xi Cangqiong's opinion on the runes of the Magic Treasure was the same as his.
The three runes Yuan Ming intended to add to the Soul Destroying Sword were also related to the Divine Soul, at the very least being yin attribute runes.
All the runes inside the Jade Scroll were related to the Divine Soul, except for the last three.
Yuan Ming's Divine Sense lingered on the last three exceedingly complex runes, which he had obtained from that piece of sword blade from the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
The three runes on the fragment were profoundly mysterious. While studying them, he often found himself entranced unwittingly. Even without activating them, he would frequently marvel at their exquisite strokes and mysterious spiritual charm.
To discern the effects of these three runes, Yuan Ming specifically sought out Artifact Refining Masters with whom he had good relations. He obtained from them a particular Formation used solely for testing rune effects.
This Formation could simulate the effects of the runes, though the displayed potency was slightly weaker than the actual effects of the runes. Also, since it was intended for testing, it could not be used in combat.
Through prolonged research and exploration in the Formation, Yuan Ming gradually inferred the effects of the three runes.
He named the first rune "Curse," which could remotely lock onto an enemy, executing an invisible curse attack. The struck enemy would feel chest tightness and nausea. Their Mana and Soul Power would become disordered, and in severe cases, there was even a risk of dispersion.
This kind of attack was very secretive. To execute it was like it descended from nowhere. Even Yuan Ming, as of now, could not detect it. Neither protective magic treasures nor Protection Magic could block it.
He named the second rune "Soul Extinguishing." Upon activation, this rune would release an invisible fluctuation that enveloped the surroundings, weakening all senses and Divine Sense of everyone except the holder.
The last was named "Frenzy Blood." This rune, upon hitting an opponent, would cause their blood to roil, quickening its flow. At the same time, it would make the enemy bloodthirsty and belligerent, affecting their sanity to a certain extent.
The three runes were overly complex. The Formation for testing the runes could not clearly analyze them, and Yuan Ming was unsure about their attributes. He could only judge from the effects, which seemed very similar to those of yin attribute runes.
Whether the other runes on the Soul Destroying Sword could accommodate three runes, or if they would affect the future potential of this sword, he had no assurance.
However, he was certain, these three runes were stronger than any he had seen before. If he could successfully engrave them, they would definitely be far more formidable than ordinary runes.
Yuan Ming's expression flickered indeterminately, and after a long time, he made up his mind to use these three runes!
If the engraving failed, or if successful but affected the potential of the Soul Destroying Sword, he could simply recollect materials and refine the treasure again.
Having achieved the Core Formation, he now had plenty of time.
These three runes were much more complex than ordinary ones, and he must practice a lot to fully master their drawing techniques.
Yuan Ming took out the materials for Drawing Talismans and started practicing over and over.
A year passed in a blink, and Yuan Ming finally mastered the drawing techniques of the three runes. He also gathered all the spiritual materials required to upgrade the Soul Destroying Sword. After several days of sitting in meditation and Breathing Control, he adjusted his condition to the optimal state and officially started refining.
Like when he formed his core, he activated all three Formations in the cave mansion, appointed Hua Zhi's Three Beasts to protect outside the Seclusion Room, and then took out the Stealing Heaven Tripod within the Seclusion Room, entering its mysterious space.
Prior to this, he had already moved all materials required for the refining of the Soul Destroying Sword and the refining furnace to this space, which now looked like an Artifact Refining Room.
Yuan Ming stepped to the altar, leapt up to sit on the Lotus Platform as before, with thousands of Desire Powers flowing into his Sea of Consciousness from the platform, instantly boosting his Divine Soul Power tremendously.
He acclimated to his now intense Divine Soul strength, then raised his hand and pointed. A Jade Box underneath the altar, containing the Nether Iron Gourd he had captured, flew straight into the refining furnace.
The Desire Power in the gourd was of no use to him, having been dispersed long ago.
Following this, Yuan Ming pinched a spell with both hands, and immediately a Spiritual Light flickered upon his body. Moments later, he opened his mouth and a light green Pill Fire spurted out, diving into the furnace.
The next instant, as Yuan Ming's hands manipulated the spell, several more spells struck the furnace. The patterns on the furnace's surface lit up, and the Pill Fire within surged, completely enveloping the Nether Iron Gourd, beginning the smelting process.

chapters.title: Chapter 378 - 355: The Fifth Rune
chapters.content:
The tenacity of the Nine Nether Iron exceeded Yuan Ming's expectations, and the refining process was incredibly lengthy. Fortunately, Yuan Ming had made ample preparations and even had a good supply of mid-grade spirit stones on hand to replenish the spiritual power consumed by releasing the Pill Fire.
After ten days, the Nether Iron Gourd was finally completely melted, its impurities fully expelled by Yuan Ming, leaving behind only a fist-sized blob of pitch-black iron slurry.
Besides the Nether Iron slurry, the fragment of jade that was in the gourd also continued to float. After such a long time being scorched by Pill Fire, the Nine Nether Iron itself had melted into a liquid, yet the piece of jade remained unchanged, with its surface lustre even becoming brighter.
Yuan Ming remotely opened the refining furnace and removed the jade fragment, setting it aside for the time being. Then, he raised his hand and pointed, sending the Soul Destroying Sword, which had been sitting off to the side, into the furnace.
The number of runes a magic treasure can withstand is determined by the main material of the treasure but is also greatly related to the quantity of that material.
Although the Soul Destroying Sword was made from Nine Nether Iron as the main material, there wasn't much of it inside the blade. It likely couldn't bear seven runes, but it should be just right after merging with the Nether Iron Gourd.
He had learned numerous refining techniques through the Black Incense possession, including a unique secret technique called the "Same Material Compression Method."
This technique involves mixing the same spiritual materials into the object to be refined and compressing it through a special technique, subsequently and indirectly enhancing the might of the magic treasure.
This secret technique was incredibly useful, capable of increasing the power of a magic treasure without damaging the existing runes.
Time quickly passed, and ten more days went by.
Yuan Ming melted the form of the Soul Destroying Sword, then combined it with the previously refined Nether Iron slurry, beginning the compression and condensation process.
This step took much longer than Yuan Ming had imagined, costing him nearly half a year to barely complete.
The Soul Destroying Sword, post-condensation, was slightly larger in size than before, its color deeper and more profound, and the sensation of holding it was considerably heavier than before.
After reshaping the Soul Destroying Sword, Yuan Ming did not immediately begin the next step of the refining, but sat down on the Lotus Platform and silently rested.
Throughout this half-year, he had assisted the artifact refining with his Divine Sense, feeling little fatigue.
However, the exhaustion accumulated in his physical body from the prolonged activation of Pill Fire was not easily dispelled, so despite feeling mentally refreshed, he had no choice but to pause and rest.This version is sourced from MV3L3MPYR.
Yuan Ming increasingly felt the weakness of his body and couldn't help envying Vajra during his rest.
If he could cultivate his physical body to the strength of the Innate Body, his power would greatly increase.
Yuan Ming's thoughts wandered, and he suddenly remembered that years ago in the Southern Border, he had done a favour for a body cultivator named Long Hao. Previously, he had been unable to possess Long Hao with the Black Incense, and gradually he forgot about it. Now that he remembered, he wondered if, after entering the Core Formation stage, he would be able to possess the man and take the opportunity to learn a body refinement technique.
Of course, he was now practicing both magic and soul cultivation. Whether it was in terms of energy or time, he had to invest several times more than others. If not for the continuous supply of elixirs and Desire Power, along with the smooth cultivation provided by top-tier techniques like the Nine Elements Technique, he wouldn't have been able to reach his current state.
As far as body cultivation is concerned, he had no significant advantage at the moment. Unless there was a special opportunity, blindly toughening up would probably not yield much harvest despite a lot of effort, and it would also occupy his time for other aspects of cultivation, which might not be worth the loss.
Half a month later, Yuan Ming's body completely recovered. After adjusting his state, he began the refining once more.
The next step was drawing runes.
Although he had entered the Core Formation Stage, due to the unparalleled hardness of the Nether Iron and its recent compression and refinement, Yuan Ming still had to take out his purchased high-quality engraving knife and carefully engrave runes onto the Soul Destroying Sword one stroke at a time.
The first rune he engraved was the one with the "Curse" effect.
This rune was far more complex than any other Yuan Ming had mastered. Even though he was confident after sufficient practice and his Divine Soul was far stronger than before, he dared not be careless while actually drawing it.
But as soon as his engraving knife touched down for the first stroke, an unexpected event occurred.
As the knife traced its path, a faint dark mark immediately appeared on the Soul Destroying Sword. At the same time, Yuan Ming saw the blade suddenly light up, and a mysterious sucking force emerged at the mark, spreading through the knife and into Yuan Ming's body.
Yuan Ming felt the mana in his body being pulled into the dark mark. His mana slowly filled the newly engraved lines bit by bit, but the dark mark seemed unsatisfied, and its sucking force surged again.
An unknown force rushed towards Yuan Ming's Sea of Consciousness, drawing his Soul Power towards the freshly engraved mark.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming was shocked, yet he knew that once he started engraving a rune, he must complete it in one go. Since he had already made the first stroke, he had to finish the subsequent lines without pause; otherwise, all his efforts would be wasted.
He didn't hesitate. After taking a deep breath, he forcefully stabilized his mind and continued with the engraving.
With each stroke, the soul-sucking force of the Soul Destroying Sword increased slightly, making Yuan Ming's engraving even more difficult. Having engraved less than one-fifth, he felt as if there were thousands of mountains obstructing him, and a simple vertical line required a great deal of time to carve out.
Meanwhile, on the Soul Destroying Sword, the lines already engraved began to light up with a faint spirit light, always shining a bit slower than Yuan Ming's engraving knife.
It was only now that Yuan Ming realized the runes he was engraving were anything but ordinary, their Spiritual Charm potent enough to break convention, mixing the separate processes of engraving and Enriching into one.
However, be it Magic Artifacts or Magic Treasures, the step of Enriching typically requires an enormous amount of Spiritual Power. Ordinary Artifact Refiners choose to deposit Spirit Stones into the refining furnace during the process to provide the necessary Spiritual Power.
Yet Yuan Ming could only use his own Mana, and even his Soul Power, to complete this hugely consuming step of Enriching.
Although he was now seated on the Lotus Platform, his Divine Soul Power greatly increased, and he had a continuous supply of Desire Power replenishing his Soul Power. In terms of Mana, however, he gradually felt a sense of depletion emerging from within his body.
Yuan Ming dared not pause; he could only temporarily divert a sliver of Mana to draw the previously prepared Spirit Stones closer by his side, continuously absorbing their Spiritual Power to fill the needs of Enriching.
Gradually, the situation eased.
Yuan Ming's carving knife slowly yet firmly continued to trace the runes, while his Mana and Soul Power flowed like a trickle, filling in the gaps in the runes steadily. Everything was progressing smoothly until seven days later.
There were only a few more strokes left for the "Curse" rune to take shape on the Soul Destroying Sword, but at that moment, the blade suddenly began to tremble. At first, the movements were minuscule, but as the engraving progressed, the trembling grew more violent to the point where Yuan Ming had to forcefully press it down with his hand.
In the face of this situation, Yuan Ming appeared expressionless, but an urge to hurry surged within him.
With his current skill in Artifact Refining, he could see at a glance that this was a sign that the Soul Destroying Sword couldn't withstand the imprinting of the runes. But he had already refined and compressed the Soul Destroying Sword beforehand; it should not be unable to bear even the fifth rune.
The problem could only lie within that particular rune.
Yuan Ming had anticipated that the Soul Destroying Sword might not fully withstand the three Divine Runes, but he never imagined that the refined and compressed Soul Destroying Sword wouldn't even bear one.
However, things had already reached this point, and Yuan Ming had no room for regret. Clenching his teeth, he held the engraving knife and poured all his Mana and Soul Power into the sword, in an attempt to hasten the process of engraving and Enriching.
Time slipped away little by little, and another day quickly passed.
Under Yuan Ming's forceful suppression, the Soul Destroying Sword's tremors were kept from affecting the engraving process, but its blade was now covered with cracks, as if it might shatter at any moment.
Yuan Ming's engraving knife was just a hair's breadth away from completing the engraving, nearly invisible to the naked eye, yet as insurmountable as a chasm, separating success from failure.
At this point, Yuan Ming's eyes were bloodshot, his forehead vein throbbing, and his fingers, gripping the engraving knife, had turned white from exertion, signifying his readiness for a final desperate attempt.
Suddenly, Yuan Ming felt the engraving knife in his hand loosen, the immense force hindering him a moment ago dissipating like a breeze. His heart skipped a beat, and he quickly lifted the knife to prevent leaving any additional marks.
But at that moment, the absorbent power—once subsided—on the cracked blade surged violently once again. Yuan Ming's left hand, pressing down on the Soul Destroying Sword, seemed to be glued to the blade, immovable no matter how hard he tried.
However, this time the Soul Destroying Sword was not absorbing his Mana but was devouring his Soul Power like a giant whale. His Divine Soul Power in the Sea of Consciousness rapidly dried up, only to be filled madly with Pure Will Power the next instant.
This cycle of absorbing and releasing affected Yuan Ming's Divine Soul, causing him to experience waves of dizziness and stabbing pain, like the ebb and flow of the tide.
He felt like a conduit for Soul Power, caught between the Soul Destroying Sword and the Lotus Platform.
After what seemed like an eternity, the Soul Destroying Sword seemed to have had its fill of Soul Power and slowly lessened its absorbing force. Yuan Ming finally managed to pull his hand away from the blade.
As he took a slight breather, he looked down and saw that the cracks that had formed during the refining process had all dissipated. In their place were smooth, dark purple lines, crisscrossing like a dragon etched onto the Soul Destroying Sword, extraordinary and divine.
The fifth rune was a success!
All five runes on the sword glowed brightly, but the light from the last one representing "Curse" was quickly fading as though it would completely vanish the next instant.
Yuan Ming's heart raced; he took out the Soul Destroying Sword immediately, bit his tongue, and sprayed a mouthful of Essence Blood onto the blade. He then wrapped it in Pill Fire once more to merge his Essence Blood with it.
Slowly, Yuan Ming felt a tenuous connection form with the Soul Destroying Sword and without any hesitation, cast a spell to draw the Soul Destroying Sword into his body, using the internal Pill Fire to envelop and nurture it.

chapters.title: Chapter 379 - 356 Soul Burying Abyss
chapters.content:
The final step in refining a Magic Treasure is to claim ownership with Essence Blood immediately after the Enriching process is completed and then absorb it into the body, where it is nurtured continuously with Pill Fire, allowing the runes on it to gradually connect cohesively, forming a rune formation.
This step is crucial, if it isn't absorbed into the body without delay, the newly Enriched runes would begin to lose their effectiveness one by one, until it reverts to the state of a top-grade magical tool with only four runes.
After several days of nurturing the Magic Treasure inside the body, the rune formation will become fully established. From then on, there is no worry of regression, and the cultivator can take it out for use.
Yuan Ming sat cross-legged on the Lotus Platform, with his eyes closed and looking inward, only to see that the five runes on the Soul Destroying Sword, enveloped by Pill Fire, were operating smoothly without any conflict among them.
He realized he had bet correctly this time!
The "Curse" rune was also a yin attribute rune, matching the other runes on the Soul Destroying Sword.
Despite several twists and turns, Yuan Ming finally succeeded in upgrading the Soul Destroying Sword to a Magic Treasure. With this thought in his mind, Yuan Ming, sitting on the Lotus Platform, felt all the exhaustion of recent days swept away and could no longer contain his excitement. He couldn't help but burst into loud laughter.
...
Several days later, Spirit Tea Tower.
This tower was located in the Upper City District of Spirit Wind City, and it was a tea house built by the Spirit Talisman Sect specifically for Core Formation Cultivators, divided into three layers, each with a different purpose.
The first layer was a spacious hall where the Spirit Talisman Sect had set up numerous counters; some were responsible for accepting tasks, some for selling elixirs, and others were in charge of recording and exchanging points for Guest Elders.
Although most things here were related to the identity of the Spirit Talisman Sect's Guest Elders, the Spirit Talisman Sect didn't mind loose Core Formation Cultivators using their facilities either.
Especially the tasks posted for the Core Formation Stage, apart from some that required the status of a Guest Elder, others could also be accepted by loose cultivators.
Of course, if a loose cultivator undertook the task, the final reward would be less than what a Guest Elder would receive, and there would be no additional reward of talisman points.T+hi@s* is a sam%p^le% f^r@om My V&irtu#a+l+ L#ib.r@a-r+y E$m&pire!. R#ead the re+s!t$ on *$.
The second layer of Spirit Tea Tower was a tea room provided for Core Formation Cultivators to relax and socialize. The interior was decorated luxuriously, with special Moonlight Stones embedded in the walls and ceiling, which emitted a soft yet not glaring light. Regardless of the light outside, this place was always bright.
All kinds of Spiritual Tea and Spirit Incense were available for Core Formation Cultivators to use freely, much like they didn't cost anything. There were also many disciples of the Spirit Talisman Sect serving as attendants here, each proficient in music, chess, poetry, and painting. Aside from questions about cultivation, whatever the Core Formation seniors asked, they could reply with relevant knowledge.
It's fair to say that the Spirit Talisman Sect had truly put in great efforts in winning people over.
The third layer of Spirit Tea Tower was a small trading hall where a trading meeting among Core Formation Cultivators would take place periodically. The scale was not large, but the items brought out were non-ordinary.
Over the years, Yuan Ming often frequented this place. Now that he was returning, he felt like he knew the ropes. As soon as he stepped onto the second floor, he noticed several familiar Core Formation Cultivators who were already seated inside, talking and laughing.
As he approached, a tall and thin male cultivator with slender limbs and a faint stubble on his face talked eloquently about his experience of stumbling into a Secret Realm. Upon seeing Yuan Ming coming, he nodded slightly in greeting and continued his story.
This man was named Feng Qi, a Loose Cultivator from Zhao Country who joined the Spirit Talisman Sect as a Guest Elder after reaching Core Formation. He was very eloquent and somewhat overly familiar, often attending cultivator gatherings in the Spirit Tea Tower, and had a good relationship with Yuan Ming, having introduced him to many Fellow Daoists.
"Long time no see," Yuan Ming said as he took a seat and heard a male cultivator with an odd accent speaking from the side. Looking up, he saw a man with deep-set eyes and a high nose, burly and strong, whose right arm appeared to be injured, not only wrapped in bandages, but also smeared with a herbal ointment with a strong plant smell.
"Fellow Daoist Ya Xian, what happened to your arm? Why is it so serious?" Yuan Ming asked in surprise.
Ya Xian opened his mouth, about to say something when suddenly Feng Qi's voice chimed in from the side.
"Ah, it's just bad luck. When Fellow Daoist Ya Xian and I went out to search for herbs, we were attacked by a Third-level Demon Beast. At first, we thought there were only three of them, but unexpectedly, there was a Middle-level one hiding in the dark, which suddenly struck me. Thankfully, Ya Xian blocked it for me, or else Brother Yuan, you wouldn't see me talking here today," Feng Qi said, touching his neck with a lingering fear and then gratefully patting Ya Xian's shoulder.
"It's nothing," Ya Xian said indifferently.
"By the way, where have you been lately, Brother Yuan? You weren't at the last trading meeting. It happens that several Fellow Daoists from the outer city came that day with plenty of good stuff. It's a pity you missed it," Feng Qi said.
"I was just in closed-door cultivation for a while. Missing the trading meeting is fine; I don't lack anything lately," Yuan Ming explained.
"Really? Even elixirs? Let me tell you, among the people who came that day, someone got a lot of elixirs from the Shengye Sect, and several Fellow Daoists almost got into a real fight over those few bottles," Feng Qi said, clicking his tongue.
Yuan Ming raised an eyebrow, but was not much surprised.
The Black Wind Desert was scarce with Spirit Grass, and there had always been a shortage of elixirs, particularly those for the Core Formation Stage, which were especially rare. Regardless of the shop, elixirs for the Core Formation Stage were in such high demand that their prices were frighteningly expensive, far beyond what ordinary Core Formation Cultivators could afford.
Ordinary elixirs were already scarce, let alone those from the Shengye Sect, a major Alchemy Sect.
"That's indeed a pity, but on the other hand, even if I had participated, I have limited financial resources and I probably wouldn't have been able to buy many bottles," Yuan Ming sighed.
He, too, was truly worried about the issue with elixirs; after two years of use, the stock he had confiscated from Elder Hai and Elder Guo's Storage Bags was running low. Now, even the Insect Pills for the Core Formation Stage were scarce on the market – there was nothing for him to even try to take advantage of.
Upon hearing this, Feng Qi suddenly laughed and asked, "Speaking of which, the number of Spirit Grass we found with Mr. Ya Xian last time wasn't small. If we can refine them into elixirs, I reckon there would be enough to distribute among five people. It's just a pity that those Third-level Demon Beasts are guarding them. It seems we won't be able to take them back."
Yuan Ming realized and immediately scolded with a laugh, "Well, look at you, waiting for me here."
"Heh heh, Brother Yuan, don't be upset, I actually wanted to invite you to join me from the start. Who knew you would go into seclusion all of a sudden? Although we did take a hit from those Third-level Demon Beasts, you don't have to worry too much. I'm well-prepared for this attempt, and I've even invited a mid-stage Core Formation Fellow Daoist to join us. With Brother Yuan's help, this expedition is bound to be foolproof," Feng Qi said to Yuan Ming with a wink and a smile.
Yuan Ming thought for a moment and didn't immediately agree, "Which specific species of Third-level Demon Beasts is Brother Feng referring to?"
"Poisonous Blade Locusts, four of them, one big and three smaller ones. We seriously injured one of them, though it isn't dead, I doubt it will be much of a combatant," Feng Qi replied.
Poisonous Blade Locusts are unique insect demon beasts in the Black Wind Desert. They resemble locusts but have two huge antennae like machetes, yet as thin as cicada wings, covered in a fierce poison that corrodes flesh. Those struck must promptly cut away the flesh around the wound to prevent the spread of the poison, or else the consequences are unimaginable.
Yuan Ming nodded, "In that case, I shall accompany Brother Feng on this venture, but I wonder where exactly those Spirit Grass are located."
With a smile, Feng Qi uttered three words: "Soul Burying Abyss."
...
In the sky, dark clouds like a wall of stone loomed, and the continuous thunder echoed incessantly like the beating of war drums, creating a heavy atmosphere that made it almost hard to breathe.
The undulating dunes abruptly collapsed in one particular area, as if they had been sliced by a giant sword's diagonal slash, removing the "flesh" of the earth, leaving behind a "wound" that stretched for countless miles.
The "wound" was a deep crater, with endless sand sliding down the steep slopes until it fell into darkness untouched by sunlight, a chilling blackness.
A cold wind swept across the sands, carrying with it dust and howling through the valley with a sorrowful and piercing sound, chilling to the bone, as if the wails of wronged souls filled the air.
Four streaks of light pierced through the sandstorm, approaching from the southwest, and came to a stop at the valley's edge.
As the light dispersed, Yuan Ming and three others revealed their shapes. Since they had been there before, aside from Yuan Ming, the others were not surprised by the sight; however, seeing such dangerous terrain for the first time, Yuan Ming couldn't help but exclaim.
"No wonder this place is called the Soul Burying Abyss; it truly resembles the underworld."
Hearing this, a pale, handsome middle-aged cultivator with some wrinkles at the corners of his eyes gave a slight smile and said, "According to what Fellow Daoist Yuan said, are we not throwing ourselves into the net, delivering ourselves for others to reap our souls?"
Feng Qi rubbed his arms exaggeratedly, "Oh my, don't scare me, Brother Fang. You've got me goosebumps all over."
After these words, he and the cultivator surnamed Fang burst into laughter, which eased the chilly atmosphere around them.
Yuan Ming could only shake his head helplessly and joined in the laughter, which further relaxed his already somewhat tense mood.
The cultivator surnamed Fang was actually named Fang Youting – a Guest Elder from the Spirit Talisman Sect. Despite his youthful appearance, he had already been in Core Formation for many years and was ostensibly the strongest among the four in terms of public perception.
After the laughter subsided, Feng Qi grew serious, "Gentlemen, the nest of those Poisonous Blade Locusts is at the edge of the Soul Burying Abyss. Although Mr. Ya Xian and I have figured out the exact number, we still need to be cautious to avoid another surprise attack by a demon beast."
Fang Youting nodded, "Don't worry, Feng. With my Divine Sense, even if a Third-level Upper Stage demon beast approaches, it won't slip by unnoticed."
Yuan Ming also highly agreed with him; he felt that Fang Youting's Divine Sense was indeed much stronger than that of a typical Core Formation Cultivator. However, it still fell short when compared to his own.
The group didn't continue to make small talk. Feng Qi handed out some pre-prepared talismans and pills, then led the others flying near the nest of the Poisonous Blade Locusts.
The nest was a hollow beneath the sands, and even with the dim light coming through the ceiling hole, it barely illuminated anything.
Intermittently, fine grains of sand whipped up by the cold wind fell from the edge of the ceiling hole, forming a curtain as dense as drizzle, which disappeared as quickly as it came.

chapters.title: Chapter 380 - 357: Worth Pursuing
chapters.content:
The group concealed their forms and quietly descended from the courtyard skywell, while simultaneously each pressed a night vision charm to their bodies.
Directly beneath the skywell, layers of bones buried under the yellow sand, both from the demon beasts and the Human Clan. A gigantic locust, as big as an average human, sprawled regally on a pile of these bones. Its body was a reddish-yellow, with two scythe-shaped antennae swaying atop its head, casting a faint green gleam along the blade edge.
Meanwhile, on the deep cavern's stone walls, water continually oozed out, slowly accumulating downwards to form a clear spring. Beside the springwater grew seven or eight pale white flowers, six of which had matured, emitting an extremely rich medicinal fragrance.
The pale white flowers were known as Sand Spring Flower, a unique Spirit Grass in the Black Wind Desert and a main ingredient for Core Formation Stage elixir Spring Eruption Pill.
Upon observing the scene inside the cavern, Yuan Ming and his three companions didn't act rashly. Instead, they continued to conceal their presence and searched around for other Poisonous Blade Locusts.
"There's one hidden in the sand on the left, another hiding in the crevice of the stone wall to the right. I haven't spotted the third-level middle-stage one yet. You guys first…" Fang Youting released his Divine Sense and observed for a moment.
Yuan Ming confidently said, "The remaining one is hiding under the spring water."
Fang Youting was startled, hurriedly released his Divine Sense toward the direction Yuan Ming mentioned, and after a moment, he looked deeply at Yuan Ming with a hint of surprise in his eyes.
Yuan Ming didn't intend to explain, and directly spoke, "That one is for Fellow Daoist Fang to handle."
Having said that, he exchanged glances with Feng Qi and Ya Xian, pulled out the White Bone Knife, and together they attacked the Poisonous Blade Locust buried in the sand.
The Bone Knife pierced through the air, whistling as it slashed into the sandy ground.
However, the Poisonous Blade Locust seemed to sense something, screaming in alarm before the Bone Knife could hit, it drilled out from the sand swiftly, flapped its wings, and took to the air, just grazing by the Bone Knife, yet was still affected by the knife's cold aura, shivering as a layer of White Frost formed on its body.
In midair, upon seeing this reaction, Yuan Ming immediately formed a hand spell and pointed towards the Bone Knife buried in the sand.
Instantaneously, a large expanse of White Flames burst from the Bone Knife, surging towards the Poisonous Blade Locust.
The Poisonous Blade Locust attempted to fly and dodge, but found its flying speed severely reduced due to the cold aura's influence, unable to create distance from the White Flames. It could only shake its head lightly, its antennae wildly slashing, producing an impenetrable green blade light that scattered the incoming White Flames.
Yuan Ming's eyes narrowed slightly, he raised his finger, and the White Bone Knife rose again, slashing towards the Poisonous Blade Locust.
The Poisonous Blade Locust tried to repeat its defensive maneuver, about to slash out with blade light again, but suddenly, its vision blurred, and the White Bone Knife disappeared only to be replaced by its mate.
Stunned, it instinctively squawked to inquire about the situation from its mate, but the mate, silent, charged forward, its antennae slashing across its torso.
"Crack"
The body of the Poisonous Blade Locust was instantly severed into two, the separated halves still twitching, its eyes fixated on its "mate," seemingly trying to understand why.
However, the image of the "mate" blurred and then transformed back into the White Bone Knife, flying toward Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming glanced at the Poisonous Blade Locust on the ground, confirmed its life had dissipated, and immediately used the Bone Knife to assist Feng Qi and others.
As a third-level demon beast, the Poisonous Blade Locust had a fragile body but was especially responsive and quick, its toxic blade light from its antennae posing a difficult challenge. Ordinary Core Formation Cultivators would often switch from offense to defense after a few exchanges, relentlessly worn down by the Poisonous Blade Locust, or even fatally ambushed by other lurking locusts.
But for Yuan Ming, such level of demon beast, with just a slight Illusion Technique, hardly counted as a formidable enemy. After all, to others, the battling Poisonous Blade Locust merely froze suddenly, and naturally, no one would ask why.
If it were not for the presence of Feng Qi and others, he would have already eliminated all the Poisonous Blade Locusts in the area.
Nevertheless, while assisting Feng Qi and the others, Yuan Ming refrained from rashly using Illusion Techniques to avoid arousing suspicion; instead, he continuously weakened the Poisonous Blade Locust's speed with the white flame and cold aura of the White Bone Knife, eventually allowing Feng Qi and the others to find an opportunity to slay it in one strike.
Soon, everyone had cleared out the Poisonous Blade Locusts, Feng Qi heaved a sigh of relief, looked up to see Yuan Ming still effortlessly dealing with the situation, and remarked, "I had no idea Brother Yuan is usually unassuming yet possesses such formidable strength. If Pi Xiu hadn't personally mentioned it, I'd have hardly believed that Brother Yuan you had only just recently entered Core Formation."
"Brother Feng flatters me. I am merely luckier, having stumbled upon a powerful Magic Treasure," Yuan Ming humbly said.
Fang Youting looked at the White Bone Knife in Yuan Ming's hand, and nodding in agreement, commented, "Yin attribute Magic Treasures are rare. Fellow Daoist Yuan must have prepared for a long time before Core Formation, spending much effort on this treasure. No wonder you possess such strength right after your breakthrough."
Yuan Ming only smiled and did not reply, allowing Feng Qi and others to take that as his acquiescence, and thus they spoke no further on the matter.
The group tidied up the battlefield a bit, after which Feng Qi stepped forward to inspect the Sand Spring Flowers.
"The remaining two Sand Spring Flowers should also mature in a few days. Why don't we wait here a bit longer? That way, we can gather all of them at once and take them back."
"This place is the territory of the Poisonous Blade Locust, and now that the demon beast is eliminated, it's unlikely another will come soon. Waiting a few days should be trouble-free." Fang Youting nodded in agreement.
"Fine," Ya Xian succinctly agreed.
However, Yuan Ming slightly frowned upon hearing this, as the Soul Burying Abyss was no benign place. Although he did not fear attacks from demon beasts, the area was often subjected to Black Wind attacks, something he had experienced when he first arrived at the Black Wind Desert, and it was something he was not eager to encounter again.
Before he could speak, his expression suddenly changed.
"Not good, another demon beast is coming."
Everyone was startled and hurriedly took out their Magic Treasures.
"Woo wu―"
At the same time, along with a cry resembling a woman's sob, a fierce wind swept in from the courtyard, stirring up sand and dust while Yuan Ming and his three companions immediately performed the Wind-Avoiding Spell to resist the sandstorm hitting their faces.
Following that, a giant black bird plummeted from the sky. It was as tall as two men. Although its body was covered with black feathers, there were also pale, totem-like patterns on them. Its two bright yellow sharp claws resembled amber, and its sharp beak shone with a dim light.
The bird's head had three eyes swollen bright red like drums, yet upon closer examination, it was clear that within the blood-red whites, there crawled human-shaped yellow threads, resembling ghosts. The orange-yellow pupils at the center comprised numerous screaming human faces.
"Is it actually a Three-eyed Crow?"
When the bird's life was clearly seen, Fang Youting suddenly cried out in a voice containing both fear and delight.
"A Three-eyed Crow? Fellow Daoist Fang, you recognize this beast?" Yuan Ming asked.My Virtual Library Empire (*)
Before Fang Youting could answer, they heard Brother Feng shout, "It doesn't matter what it is, just attack! This is a Third-level Peak Demon Beast. If we don't focus on fighting, soon we will end up in its belly!"
Before the sound of his voice had faded, he pinched a spell, and a Green Jade Ruler flew out beside him.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming suppressed his doubts and urged the White Bone Knife, slashing directly towards the Three-eyed Crow.
Meanwhile, Ya Xian took out three Earth Yellow Small Flags from his Storage Bag and tapped them a few times with both hands. A yellow mist immediately emerged from the flags, whirling halfway through the air before rolling up the dust and stones from the hollow like a tornado, striking towards the Three-eyed Crow.
As for Fang Youting, he directly raised his hand, cast a spell on his Purple Steel Fork, and in an instant, several bolts of purple thunder struck from the fork, aggressively targeting the Three-eyed Crow.
Facing the attacks of Yuan Ming's group, the Three-eyed Crow folded its wings by its sides, then suddenly spread them open, shooting out countless black feather arrows from its wings, clattering against the Green Jade Ruler and White Bone Knife, decelerating their momentum.
Next, the Three-eyed Crow opened its beak and spewed out seven or eight clusters of gray ash-like mist. Although the fog seemed ethereal, it exploded suddenly when it hit the tornado summoned by Ya Xian, forming a high wall of gray ash that blocked all the sand and dust.
However, when it encountered the thunder released by Fang Youting, the gray fog was directly split apart, holding off only for a moment, yet it was enough for the Three-eyed Crow to find an opportunity to spread its wings and fly up, narrowly avoiding the thunder.
The thunder released by Fang Youting's Magic Treasure had left scorched black traces on the ground, including an odd purple halo. Seeing the black marks, the Three-eyed Crow seemed somewhat fearful.
Seeing this situation, Yuan Ming immediately shouted, "Fellow Daoist Fang, I'll keep it busy, you take the chance to activate your Magic Treasure!"
After speaking, Yuan Ming tapped the White Bone Knife, and instantly, numerous pale Bone Fires burst forth, lunging towards the Three-eyed Crow.
At the same time, Yuan Ming's eyes hardened, and he secretly began to cast an Illusion Technique on the Three-eyed Crow.
The Three-eyed Crow was confused by Yuan Ming's Illusion Technique, pausing momentarily, but just then, Yuan Ming saw a flash of red light from its third eye on its forehead, and it abruptly broke free from the illusion, with all three eyes simultaneously focusing on Yuan Ming.
But even with this momentary delay, the White Bone Fire had already reached the Three-eyed Crow, forcing it to hurriedly spew gray fog in defense, yet it was still burned by the Bone Fire, manifesting several patches of frostbite on its body.
Simultaneously, Fang Youting once again activated his Magic Treasure to release thunder, and the Three-eyed Crow hurriedly flapped its wings to dodge but was still struck by a bolt of thunder, instantly knocking off its pitch-black feathers, revealing burned, charred flesh.
At that moment, attacks from Brother Feng and Ya Xian also arrived, forcing the Three-eyed Crow to dodge in a flustered manner, gradually showing signs of weakness.
Seeing victory within reach, Brother Feng and the others became exhilarated, and Fang Youting's eyes shone brightly, his face alight with immense surprise and delight.
But just then, the Three-eyed Crow suddenly cried out three times, spewing gray fog from its mouth while its body trembled. Its black feathers shot out like a torrential rain, forcing Yuan Ming and his companions to temporarily abandon their attack and cast spells in defense.
Seizing this opportunity, the Three-eyed Crow immediately turned around, flapped its wings, and without a backward glance dove through the hollow flying towards the depths of the Soul Burying Abyss.
"No, we can't let it escape!" Fang Youting hurriedly said, then prepared to immediately pursue the Three-eyed Crow with tunneling light.
"Fellow Daoist Fang, do not chase after a desperate enemy, and besides, it's headed deep into the Soul Burying Abyss. What if it encounters other powerful demon beasts?" Yuan Ming voiced a note of caution, advising him.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, trust me, this is a Three-eyed Crow, it's definitely worth the chase!" Fang Youting shook his head, disregarding Yuan Ming's advice, and immediately flew out.

chapters.title: Chapter 381 - 358: The Killer from Those Years
chapters.content:
"Fellow Daoist Yuan need not worry, although the Three-eyed Crow is formidable, with four against one, we will surely capture it with ease," Feng Qiben hesitated, but seeing Fang Youting so determined, he couldn't bear to miss out on the spiritual materials that could be stripped from a third-level peak demon beast, and quickly followed in pursuit.
Ya Xian also transformed into a yellow long rainbow, escaping through flight.
Yuan Ming furrowed his brows, wondering why Fang Youting was so persistent, but recalling that the third eye on the Three-eyed Crow's forehead could unravel his Illusion Technique, he couldn't help but feel a surge of curiosity.
After only a moment's hesitation, he too mounted his tunneling light and chased after Fang Youting.
The Three-eyed Crow was incredibly fast in flight, and the four cultivators couldn't catch up for a while.
A trace of urgency flashed through Fang Youting's eyes. His hands formed a spell, preparing to perform a Secret Technique to forcibly increase their tunneling speed. Just then, the Three-eyed Crow suddenly dove down into the ground.
There was a crevice several dozen feet wide on the ground, the Three-eyed Crow's body emitting a rich black light as it swiftly burrowed into it, disappearing without a trace.
Fang Youting and the other two arrived moments later and, without hesitation, followed into the crevice.
Yuan Ming's Divine Sense probed into the crack and found nothing amiss, so he followed after the three and entered the crevice as well.
The fissure in the ground twisted and turned, seemingly leading to a very deep place underground.
After chasing for a full quarter of an hour, the space ahead suddenly opened up, revealing a massive subterranean cavern.
The place was pitch-dark, and even with the Cultivators' Core Formation Stage Cultivation, they could only see a few dozen feet ahead. The cave was filled with a thick miasma of netherworldly evil and even Divine Sense couldn't probe too far ahead, making everyone feel somewhat uneasy.
Fang Youting increased the mana infused into the Purple Thunder Flying Fork, causing the fork to emit a dazzling light. The others also invigorated their Magic Treasures with light, soon illuminating a large area around them.
The air inside the cave was damp, with the ground covered in interlocking sharp rocks, and stalactites resembling wolf's teeth hanging from the ceiling; all of these stones were black, giving off a sense of eerie ghostliness.
"There's something odd about this place, and the Three-eyed Crow is nowhere to be seen. We should leave first," Yuan Ming said, scanning his surroundings before making the suggestion again.
"Indeed, something's off. Let's withdraw and talk later," Fang Youting, upon hearing this, gave the other two a look, and they began to retreat.
However, just as Fang Youting was about to turn around, a black resentful ghost shot out from the darkness behind, its blood-stained ghost claws rapidly reaching towards Fang Youting's back.
Fang Youting was on alert, sweeping the Purple Thunder steel fork behind him, tearing the black resentful ghost apart with a "sizzle," turning it into green smoke that dissipated.
Yet on the ground of the underground cavern, and on the walls and ceiling, shadows flickered continuously, and ghosts emerged out of thin air—men, women, and spirits of demon beasts forming into ghosts—stretching as far as the eye could see, adding up to nearly a thousand.
These ghosts were not weak, with the weakest being at the Late Stage Qi Refining level and nearly half reaching the Foundation Establishment Stage; several imposing figures stood behind this host of ghosts, their presence no less than that of Core Formation Stage cultivators.
The faces of Fang Youting and the others turned deathly pale; they were just pursuing a Three-eyed Crow and had not expected to face such a desperate situation.
"Fight our way out!" Yuan Ming, not panicking, said with a grave expression, and took the lead in flying upwards.
The White Bone Knife flew out from his body, its blade surging with boiling White Bone Cold Flames, slashing towards the ghosts in the sky.
The White Bone Cold Flames were a kind of Yin Fire, sharing the same origin with the ghosts and thus causing significant damage to them; seven or eight ghosts were swept by the cold flames and instantly torn apart, turning into several wisps of black smoke.
Seeing this, the other three couldn't help but admire Yuan Ming's courage, and they hurried to follow up.
At that moment, seven or eight clumps of ash-gray Yin Fire shot out of the darkness nearby, striking towards the three of them with great speed and urgency.
"It's that Three-eyed Crow!" Fang Youting exclaimed, stimulating his Purple Steel Fork, which began to show five Thunder Runes within its body.
Three purple Thunder bolts, each as thick as a wrist, shot out from the tip of the fork and collided with the ash-gray Yin Fire.
Feng Qiben and Ya Xian also hurriedly took action, revealing a Green Jade Ruler and three Earth Yellow Small Flags, from which a dozen crescent-shaped green Light Blades and a yellow storm howled out, also striking the ash-gray Yin Fire.
The ash-gray flames exploded with a bang, triggering a violent storm that sent Fang Youting and the others flying in different directions across the cavern.
The nearby ghosts surged up like a tide, engulfing the figures of the three.
Yuan Ming saw this and was startled, quickly turning back to try and rescue them.
"Whoosh," a black Ghost Claw as large as a grinding disc reached out from the nearby stone wall, its fingertips firing substantial black light, aiming for Yuan Ming's chest.
The White Bone Knife shot back, its blade surging with white flames, fiercely striking towards the black Ghost Claw.
Facing the White Bone Knife, the black Ghost Claw showed no intention of dodging; it grabbed the knife as fast as lightning, and despite the boiling White Bone Cold Flames, the Ghost Claw remained unharmed.
Yuan Ming uttered a soft 'huh' and then shot back exceptionally fast.
Another black Ghost Claw emerged from another side of the stone wall, grabbing at where Yuan Ming had just been standing, naturally missing its target.
Immediately afterward, the body of the black Ghost Claw also became visible, shocking to see it was a Core Formation Stage ghost creature, human in body with the head of a bull, resembling the bull-headed ghosts of the Netherworld.
No sooner had the Bull-headed Ghost appeared than it immediately leaped forward, transforming into a black shadow that charged towards Yuan Ming's chest, also spewing out a wisp of green Ghost Fire aiming to envelop Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming spat out a Black Sword Qi, piercing the green Ghost Fire.
The Yin Soul Power inside the Ghost Fire suddenly dissipated by a great extent, extinguishing and scattering, with the remaining flames not posing any threat; Yuan Ming waved them away with a Flame Burst Fireball.
The Black Sword Qi continued to shoot forward, in a flash wrapping around the black shadow transformed by the Bull-headed Ghost, and it slashed down in mid-air.
With a slight "zing" sound, the shadow was split in two, and the Bull-headed Ghost's thick arms were severed, its body retreating in shock.
That plain-looking Black Sword Qi actually contained a terrifying power capable of devouring its very Soul Power, and the Bull-headed Ghost's only thought was to escape.
Naturally, Yuan Ming was not going to let it get away, casting an Illusion Technique.
The expression on the bull-headed ghost's face immediately became confused, and its retreating form came to a halt.
Black Sword Qi shot out like a bolt of lightning, piercing into the chest of the bull-headed ghost.
The bull-headed ghost's consciousness instantly returned, and it let out a terrified scream. The Yin Soul Power within its body surged wildly, attempting to expel the Black Sword Qi from inside.
However, the Black Sword Qi was wedged in there like a wedge, and the Yin Soul Power that the bull-headed ghost mustered was devoured as soon as it touched it, let alone expelling the Black Sword Qi.
"Swoosh" "Swoosh" "Swoosh"
Yuan Ming's fingers flicked repeatedly, sending four or five strands of Sword Qi shooting from within the Black Sword Qi, piercing into various parts of the bull-headed ghost's body. The ghost's Yin Soul Power drained even faster, and its originally towering body deflated rapidly, shrinking like a leaking balloon.
As Yuan Ming's hand gestures changed, the strands of Sword Qi began to rotate and cut, slicing the bull-headed ghost's body into several sections. The bull-headed ghost howled tragically as it was completely devoured by the Black Sword Qi.
The Black Sword Qi also revealed its true form—a long black sword, the very Soul Destroying Sword, which emitted tremors of excitement.
Although Fang Youting and the other two were surrounded by a large number of ghosts, the three of them were after all Core Formation Stage cultivators. Each of them cast spells to protect themselves and were temporarily unharmed.
Seeing Yuan Ming kill the bull-headed ghost so easily brought great joy to the three, who hastily moved closer to his side.
Wooo wooo wooo...
Sudden ghostly cries emerged from the depths of the cavern, like the piercing scream of a grieving woman or the cry of a baby, sharp and prolonged, easily piercing through one's Divine Soul and reaching deep within.
Fang Youting and the others felt their minds swaying, unable to help themselves from dancing around, with their Mana becoming chaotic.
"Soul Capturing Ghost Sound!"
Yuan Ming naturally heard the ghostly cries as well, but his Divine Soul Power was strong and he had forged a Soul Pill, making his Soul Power condensed and stable, preventing the ghostly cries from affecting him.
He pointed at the Soul Destroying Sword in the void, and "swoosh," the sword shot out at high speed, heading straight for Fang Youting, who was closest, and then it made a cut mid-flight.
A fierce strand of Black Sword Qi shot out, slicing toward the ghosts next to Fang Youting.
Overflowing with sharpness and brimming with Yin Qi, the Sword Qi was like a reversed flow of the Milky Way, unstoppable!
After its advancement, the Soul Destroying Sword's power surged, and the Soul Destroying Sword Qi it released was far stronger than before, incomparable to its past strength.
For a smoother reading experience, visit MV&LEMPYR.
The ghosts near Fang Youting seemed to feel the intense oppression brought by the Soul Destroying Sword and scrambled to flee.
However, the Soul Destroying Sword was faster and reached them in a flash, slashing across their forms.
With a "rip" that sounded like fabric tearing, two or three dozen ghosts were cut in half by the Sword Qi, clearing a large empty area.
Fang Youting, now back to his senses, was overjoyed. His Purple Steel Fork shot out more than a dozen purple thunderbolts, blocking another group of ghosts. He then soared into the sky and flew close to Yuan Ming.
At that moment, two miserable screams rang out from the side—it was Feng Qiben and Ya Xian!
Yuan Ming quickly turned his head to look, and his expression immediately darkened.
Feng Qiben's chest had been pierced through by a blood-red ghost claw, and his body was rapidly shriveling to a visible extent.
Ya Xian was enveloped in a layer of eerie white mist, and his body quickly froze up, turning into an ice sculpture in the blink of an eye.
Their magic treasures lost all spirit light and clanged to the ground.
The blood-red ghost claw withdrew, and a female ghost in a red dress appeared out of thin air. Her features were delicate, and her pale face was stained with two lines of blood tears, making her appearance quite chilling.
A white ghostly figure emerged from the ice sculpture that Ya Xian had become. It was a man in white clothes with an austere appearance, his face pale as ice and faintly transparent.
Both ghosts were enveloped in thick Yin Qi, also reaching the Core Formation Stage level.
Yuan Ming's brows furrowed; it seemed that there were quite a number of Core Formation Stage ghosts here.
Ghosts were vicious by nature, and if left uncontrolled, they would have attacked each other long ago. Since that was not the case here, it was very likely that someone was manipulating them from behind.
But then he thought that to control so many ghosts, this person's strength could not be weak, and he needed to be cautious in dealing with them.
"Brother Sikong! Mrs. Qi! Why are you here? How did you become like this?" Fang Youting exclaimed in surprise.
"Fellow Daoist Fang, do you know these two ghosts?" Yuan Ming transmitted his voice to ask.
"They were two Core Formation Stage City Lords of Earth River City. I stayed in Earth River City for two years, and I was quite familiar with this couple!" Fang Youting replied with a transmission, eyes filled with shock.
"Earth River City? I've heard people say that city mysteriously perished several years ago," Yuan Ming recalled a rumor he had heard when he was taking on tasks for the Hundred Pills Square.
"That's right, all the people in Earth River City mysteriously disappeared for some unknown reason, not a single body was left behind, and the entire city turned into a ghost town. The Five Thunder Sect sent people to investigate, but they found nothing," Fang Youting had regained his composure and spoke somberly through his transmission.
Yuan Ming's expression became grave. The Core Formation Stage city lords who had disappeared years ago had now turned into ghosts, indicating that the culprit who destroyed Earth River City was here.
The red-dressed female ghost and the white-clad male ghost did not attack Yuan Ming and the other, they grabbed the corpses of Feng Qiben and Ya Xian and flew off into the darkness, vanishing in an instant.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming activated his vast Divine Sense and scattered it around, then suddenly flicked his finger.
The Soul Destroying Sword made a virtual slash in the air, and a slender Sword Qi shot out, heading toward a specific spot in the cavern.
A surprised yelp came from the darkness, followed by a "bang" of a dull explosion, and everything returned to calm.

chapters.title: Chapter 382 - 359 Soul to Soul
chapters.content:
"Kakaka! A Magic Treasure refined from Nine Nether Iron, not bad, not bad. I am in need of an offensive Magic Treasure, and this sword is just right," a harsh and unpleasant voice echoed from the darkness.
A hunched figure slowly came into view, an old man in a green robe, leaning on a black cane topped with a huge skull that had two eerily burning green flames in its eye sockets.
The old man, seemingly all skin and bones, had unusually large eyes that glinted with a hungry wolf-like green light, staring intently at the Soul Destroying Sword.
This person's presence was not weak either, having reached the Mid-stage of Core Formation.
The Three-eyed Crow that the group had been chasing earlier was now obediently following behind the old man, appearing to be his spirit pet.
"It seems that you were the one who deliberately used this Three-eyed Crow to lead us here," Yuan Ming said slowly.
"Indeed, one of my Magic Treasures is in need of a few Core Formation Stage cultivator souls for nourishment. I specially invited you for a visit. You may leave, but your souls will stay," the green-robed old man chuckled, the green flames in the skull on his cane flaring intensely.
Fang Youting's heart chilled, and he instinctively gripped his Purple Steel Fork tighter.
Yuan Ming suddenly spread his fingers, and the Soul Destroying Sword shot out, hovering in mid-air above his head.
Thin trails of Sword Qi shot out from the Soul Destroying Sword, instantly forming a black curtain of sword energy around the two of them.
Almost at the same time, several dozen arrow-shaped white vapors shot out from the nearby void, colliding with the black sword curtain.
A series of dense explosions sounded as the black sword curtain spun and cut with alarmingly fast rotation, completely obliterating the arrow-shaped white vapors.
Only now did Fang Youting react, and just as he was about to raise his Purple Steel Fork to assist, it was already over, and a complex expression flashed in his eyes.
His Cultivation was higher than Yuan Ming's, yet after this series of battles, Yuan Ming's strength had far exceeded his expectations.
Yuan Ming formed another spell, and several streaks of black Sword Qi separated from the sword curtain, striking a spot in the void dozens of feet away in an instant, erupting into a burst of black light.
The figure of the man in white emerged from the bursting white light in the void, his face twisted in agony.
Yuan Ming's gaze swept over the ghost, and he cast the Dream Butterfly Illusion Technique again. The man in white's body suddenly froze, immobilized by Yuan Ming's Illusion Technique.
Fang Youting finally caught up with Yuan Ming's pace, shooting out more than a dozen thick bolts of purple thunder from his Purple Steel Fork towards the man in white.
The figure of the man in white suddenly flickered and vanished into thin air, and the bolts of purple thunderstrikes missed their mark.
Yuan Ming was slightly taken aback and looked down.
The man in white had, somehow, appeared next to the old man.
"Good reflexes, to see through a netherworld ghost's invisibility. Considering that both of you have decent strength, just surrender obediently. Give up half your Divine Souls, and I shall show leniency by sparing your lives instead of turning you into Ghost Slaves," the green-robed old man said with a flicker of surprise in his eyes.
"You are merely at the mid-stage of Core Formation, how can you be so arrogantly confident?" Yuan Ming scoffed.
"Since you are unwilling to give up your souls, I shall have to take them myself," the eyes of the green-robed old man turned cold, he slammed his black cane hard on the ground, and the green flames in the skull's eyes blazed vehemently.
Swarms of ghosts surged out like a flood, lunging towards Yuan Ming and the other.
The man in white's body once again merged into the void, and the red-dressed female ghost also shot out from the darkness, lunging towards them.
"Keep moving upward, protect yourself well!" Yuan Ming's gaze intensified as he transmitted his voice to Fang Youting. The Soul Destroying Sword shone with black light, enveloping his body and charging into the countless ghosts above.
The Soul Destroying Sword, with its Divine Power to extinguish souls, either tore the approaching ghosts apart or obliterated them completely, unable to hinder it in the slightest.
Fang Youting hurriedly followed, shooting out a series of purple thunders from his Purple Steel Fork, forming a layer of thunder and lightning protective shield around him. The ghosts found it difficult to approach, and in the blink of an eye, he reached the top of the underground cave.
Fang Youting was overjoyed and aimed for the crevice at the top of the cave, but suddenly, a sneer sounded in his ear.
Then, his field of vision shattered abruptly, and he found himself standing on the cave floor, having not flown up to the top at all.
The green-robed old man stood not far away, but Yuan Ming was nowhere to be seen.
"Illusion Technique!" Fang Youting's face changed.
In the mid-air above, countless ghosts were swarmingly moving towards one spot, clearly chasing after Yuan Ming.
"That young man above dares to offend me; I plan to let him endure the agony of being consumed by a thousand ghosts. As for you, would you hand over your Divine Soul yourself, or should I extract your soul myself?" the green-robed old man said to Fang Youting expressionlessly.
Fang Youting's face paled, and he suddenly turned into a beam of purple light, once again flying towards the opening in the cave above.
"Foolish," the green-robed old man shook his head, a black shadow shot out from his third eye, revealing a smaller Three-eyed Crow, flapping its wings chasing after Fang Youting.
"Divine Soul Transformation! You're a Soul Cultivator!" Fang Youting exclaimed in shock.
The Three-eyed Soul Dove was incredibly fast, even faster than Fang Youting's tunneling speed, and in an instant, it caught up and pecked at him with its sharp beak.
Fang Youting was not defenseless himself; he channeled his Mana into the Purple Steel Fork, shooting out three thick bolts of purple thunder towards the Three-eyed Soul Dove.
But the ghostly dove behind disintegrated suddenly, turning into a misty form with only its head remaining solid.
The three bolts of purple thunder struck the misty form of the soul dove, "zzzt" passing right through.
The black mist formed by the Soul Dove evaporated slightly, but overall, it was not significantly affected. The eye in the forehead of the dove widened, shooting out a fine beam of Blood Light directly at Fang Youting.
The Blood Light moved with astonishing speed; Fang Youting couldn't dodge in time and was hit in the chest, the Blood Light penetrating straight into him.
Fang Youting's face showed a look of terror, and the next moment his eyes filled with intense Blood Light, his expression turned vacant, and his figure stopped midair, unmoving.
The Three-eyed Soul Dove let out a triumphant screech, flapping its wings and pouncing towards Fang Youting's head.
Just then, a black Sword Shadow shot down from above, it was the Soul Destroying Sword, aimed at the body of the Three-eyed Soul Dove.
Yuan Ming followed closely after the Soul Destroying Sword, but the ghosts above surprisingly did not pursue him, continuing to surge towards a certain spot on the cave ceiling, as if Yuan Ming was there.
The green-robed old man's face showed surprise, then quickly regained calmness, making a pinching motion in the air.
The Three-eyed Soul Dove completely ignored the incoming Soul Destroying Sword, its head snapping towards Yuan Ming, the third eye on its forehead firing off another beam of Blood Light faster than before.
Yuan Ming couldn't dodge in time and was hit by the Blood Light, his eyes also filled with strands of Blood Light, but they faded away immediately.
The Soul Destroying Sword remained unaffected, stabbing into the body of the soul dove.
Several fierce Sword Qi burst forth from within the Soul Destroying Sword, violently tearing through.
The Three-eyed Soul Dove's body completely disintegrated, turning into a dissipating Black Mist, all of which was absorbed by the Soul Destroying Sword.
Screams came from the side; not far away, Fang Youting's chest had burst open with a bloodied hole, the green-robed old man's Three-eyed Crow had at some point stealthily moved in, striking Fang Youting dead with one claw.
The Three-eyed Crow grabbed Fang Youting's corpse and flew deeper into the cave.
Yuan Ming's eyes flickered, but he did not chase after the Three-eyed Crow.
He had protected Fang Youting several times, which was as much as could be expected of him; the man's inferior strength, leading to his demise here, was simply his fate.
"To use such a wide-ranging Illusion Technique, affecting thousands of ghosts in the cave, and not being influenced by the Soul-stealing Blood Light, it seems my guess was correct, you're also a Soul Cultivator." The green-robed old man sized up Yuan Ming with an ugly smile on his face.
"Since we're both Soul Cultivators, having suffered relentless pursuit in the Black Wind Desert, we can empathize with each other. How about we stop here?" Yuan Ming said.
Uplоаdеd by thе М|V|L(ЕМРYR) tеаm.
"Stop? You, a fledgling who has just entered the Love Witch Realm, dare to negotiate terms with me?" The green-robed old man sneered, his black walking stick gesturing in the air.
Numerous thin strands of green light shot out from the stick, heading straight for Yuan Ming without a sound.
Yuan Ming, not daring to be careless, brought out the Golden Sun Ruler, transforming it into nearly a hundred ruler shadows, which collided with the green threads.
However, the moment they touched, the ruler shadows dissipated like smoke, leaving only the Golden Sun Ruler floating in mid-air, wrapped by green threads with its spirit light visibly fading.
Yuan Ming, seeing this, stimulated the Soul Destroying Sword, dozens of Sword Qi burst forth, cutting through the green light threads.
These green threads contained Soul Power, and the Soul Destroying Sword should be effective against them.
Indeed, the green threads were cut piece by piece by the Sword Energy of the Soul Destroying Sword, and the Golden Sun Ruler broke free.
"Do you really want to fight me to the death? There is no old grudge between us. With this Soul Destroying Sword in my hand, your Soul Cultivation Divine Power will mostly likely be restricted by me. Continuing this fight, you may not gain much advantage." Yuan Ming said solemnly.
"Youngster, I have roamed the Cultivation World for hundreds of years; don't embarrass yourself with these inferior tricks! Your Magic Treasure is indeed good, but it requires a significant amount of Soul Power to activate. Moreover, you need to continue casting the Illusion Technique, influencing the ghosts in the cave. With the Soul Power of someone who has just entered the Love Witch Realm, how long can you last?" The green-robed old man said with a cold laugh, the black walking stick pointing into the void again.
Countless green light threads whistled out again, striking towards Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming's expression suddenly darkened, as if the green-robed old man had struck a nerve, but internally he sneered secretly.
Ever since he refined the outer golden prohibition of the Stealing Heaven Tripod, he could easily draw on the flow of Desire Power within the Stealing Heaven Tripod, replenishing his Soul Power at any time; if it came to a battle of Soul Power exhaustion, he was not worried at all.
