While considering his options, Yuan Ming waved and stimulated the Soul Destroying Sword, shooting out Sword Qi after Sword Qi, cutting all the green light threads, and controlling the nearby White Bone Knife with casting.
This knife shot towards the green-robed old man, the blade emanating dazzling white light, solidifying into a gigantic blade light over a dozen feet long, twined with thick white cold flame, looking unstoppable.
Yuan Ming gestured, and the vast blade light followed, cleaving down on the old man's head!
"Not a bad bone knife, my luck today really isn't bad." The green-robed old man laughed, the black walking stick left his hand, transforming into a dark Flood Dragon.
The Flood Dragon stirred up thick Black Mist around it, with two claws gesturing upwards, colliding with the White Bone Knife.
With a loud "clang", the White Bone Knife was stopped in mid-air, unable to descend.
The green-robed old man made a gesture with his hands, and the Flood Dragon's mouth opened wide, spurting out a stream of nether green Flames that wrapped around the White Bone Knife.
These nether green flames also contained Divine Soul Power, and once they touched the White Bone Knife, they quickly infiltrated it.
The spirit light of the White Bone Knife instantly became unstable, wobbling as if it were drunk.
Yuan Ming recalled the knife with all his might, managing to pull it back before it completely failed, then swung his left hand.
The Golden Sun Ruler shot out from his left sleeve, attacking the green-robed old man from another side, without any concern for the magic treasure being taken away.
The green-robed old man frowned slightly, controlling the black Flood Dragon to face off against it.
Time passed bit by bit, and soon the back-and-forth exchanges lasted for a quarter of an hour with Yuan Ming still full of energy, showing no signs of Soul Power depletion.

chapters.title: Chapter 383 - 360: Never Say Die
chapters.content:
The ghosts in midair were still chasing around the ceiling of the cave, still immersed in the Illusion Technique Yuan Ming had cast.
"You've only just entered the early stages of the Love Witch Realm, how could you possibly possess such immense Soul Power!" the green-robed old man realized something was amiss and shouted in a deep voice.
Not only was the person before him endowed with tremendous Soul Power, but his divine abilities in Illusion Technique were also extremely impressive. During this quarter-hour, he had tried multiple times to break the illusion that had ensnared the ghosts, but the power of the illusions was astonishing. Even he could only resolve them one by one, and soon after breaking them, the ghosts would fall back into the illusory realm, making it all pointless.
The more the green-robed old man thought about it, the more inconceivable it seemed. What exactly was the background of this person?
"Now is the time!" Yuan Ming sensed the emotional fluctuations of the green-robed old man and activated his "Emotion Manipulation" ability.
The "Emotion Manipulation" ability could control a person's emotions, but it had a prerequisite; the target's emotions needed to show certain fluctuations to be effective. If the target's emotions were stable, "Emotion Manipulation" would be useless. Forcibly using it would have little effect.
This green-robed old man had also reached the Love Witch Realm long ago, and his emotions were exceptionally stable. Whether it was the earlier slaying of his Three-eyed Soul Dove or revealing his identity as a Soul Cultivator, the green-robed old man had remained quite composed, offering no opportunity to be taken advantage of. Now, under his evidently impressive Soul Power, a slight crack finally appeared.
The shock in the green-robed old man's emotions suddenly magnified, his mind instantly destabilized, various emotions beginning to surface one after another.
Yuan Ming was secretly delighted and immediately used "Emotion Manipulation" to grasp the old man's anger and amplify it.
If one wished to disturb the mind, shock was far less useful than anger.
An uncontrollable surge of anger welled up in the green-robed old man's heart, and his eyes started to redden slightly.
"Not good!" the green-robed old man realized something was wrong and hurriedly tried his best to suppress the various emotions.
Yuan Ming would not allow his opponent to recover, prompting the Curse Rune within the Soul Destroying Sword, and an invisible force began to shake.
The air around the green-robed old man suddenly became heavy, as if sinking into a viscous mire. Both body and mind felt an intense nausea, his internal organs churning.
Vomit...
He vomited uncontrollably, but instead of food from his stomach, he spewed out clumps of black Qi, emanating fluctuations of Mana and Soul Power, which were his painstakingly cultivated Mana and Soul Power.
The aura of the green-robed old man plummeted from mid-stage Core Formation instantly to the early stages of Core Formation, his Soul Power in the Sea of Consciousness also weakening by thirty percent.
This was also Yuan Ming's first time using the Curse Rune in actual combat, and the effect was surprisingly good.
Previous testing of the rune had only shown that the Curse Rune would cause Mana and Soul Power to dissipate, but he hadn't expected the rune could actually forcibly reduce the opponent's cultivation level.
"What kind of attack is this!" The green-robed old man was greatly taken aback, his composure even more disrupted, emotions becoming even more chaotic, his expression revealing a hint of madness.
Yuan Ming continued to use the "Emotion Manipulation" ability to disturb the green-robed old man's thoughts. He flicked his sleeves forward, and eight soul crows shot out.
With "Emotion Manipulation" controlling most of his emotions, the green-robed old man alternated between cursing and feeling frightened, with greatly reduced judgment. Yuan Ming's soul crows reached halfway before the old man noticed and responded hastily.
From his forehead, the green-robed old man shot out eight Three-eyed Soul Doves, placing the black Flood Dragon in front of him as a shield.
However, the positions of Yuan Ming's eight soul crows suddenly changed, forming a formation akin to a battle array, a technique he had devised by integrating the Crow Formation with the joint attack formations of the Guiyuan Sect.
He had named this technique: Crow Formation.
The eight soul crows cried out in unison, and eight streams of Crow's Call Wave surged forth, merging with each other, and almost instantly turned into a tangible wave of black Sound Waves that overwhelmed the eight soul doves, the black Flood Dragon, and the green-robed old man behind them.
The eight soul doves showed a dazed expression and came to a halt in their escape, while the black Flood Dragon also stopped in place.
The green-robed old man, having suffered both the Emotion Manipulation and the Curse Rune attack, had a very unstable Divine Soul. The Dream Butterfly Illusion Technique carried within the crow's call quickly invaded, and the green-robed old man began to see all kinds of illusions, unable to extricate himself.
The White Bone Knife shot out like lightning, covering a distance of more than ten zhang in an instant, slashing across the green-robed old man's neck.
The green-robed old man's head flew off, but in the next moment, a flash of black light passed over his body and his head was restored as before.
At the same time, among the many ghosts trapped in the illusion above, the body of the white-clad man suddenly decapitated, dissolving into a large cloud of Yin Qi dissipating away.
"Death Replacement Divine Ability!" Yuan Ming's eyes moved.
The green-robed old man, having been revived from death, did not bother to reclaim his black walking stick but instead dived into the ground, escaping deep into the cave. His tunneling speed was surprisingly not slower than his Flying Escape.
Yuan Ming immediately gave chase, again prompting the Curse Rune within the Soul Destroying Sword.
Once more, Curse Power enshrouded the green-robed old man in the ground, causing him to vomit a stream of Mana and Soul Power, although this time the Mana and Soul Power he lost were clearly less than the first.
When used consecutively, the effect of the Curse Rune gradually weakened.
Even so, the green-robed old man still groaned, his escape speed significantly reduced.
The eight soul crows rushed over, once again forming the Crow Formation, and unleashed the Crow Attack. A wave of black Sound Waves swept down, engulfing the green-robed old man's body.
The green-robed old man fell into an illusion, appearing in a vast ocean with blowing sea breezes and blooming waves, indistinguishable from reality.
The old man hurriedly cast spells similar to the Soul-shocking Secret Technique, which could break Illusion Techniques, to no avail.
The illusions around him faintly formed into an Illusion Technique space, exceptionally tough.
Yuan Ming had been busy with his cultivation lately and didn't spend much time practicing the Dream Butterfly Illusion Technique. However, his soul power had increased so much that the technique had also improved significantly, showing signs of breaking through to the Mirage Realm.
Yuan Ming activated the Soul Destroying Sword, and a substantial Sword Qi shot forth, burrowing ten feet into the ground and piercing the glabella of the green-robed old man, exploding in his Sea of Consciousness.
The old man's Divine Soul shattered, and he fell dead without so much as a whimper.
But the next moment, his Divine Soul was restored to its original state, and he broke free from the illusion, continuing to tunnel deeper into the cave.
In mid-air, the red-dressed female ghost's head exploded, and she fell dead.
"I'd like to see how many times you can come back to life!" Yuan Ming deployed the Curse Rune once more, causing the cultivation of the green-robed old man to drop again, halting his fleeing figure.
Crow's Call Sound Waves surged towards him, trapping him in the illusion once again.
This time Yuan Ming didn't move to kill him, he simply patted the Spiritual Beast Bag at his waist.
The figure of Hua Zhi shot out, burrowing into the ground. Numerous highly poisonous vines wound around the green-robed old man, with more than a dozen vines piercing his body.
The old man's skin quickly turned purplish-black, and his vital energy rapidly weakened.
After a short while, the light in the old man's eyes scattered, and he died.
However, the next moment, another ghost fell from mid-air, trading its life for the resurrection of the green-robed old man, yet the poison within his body did not dissipate, causing him to exhaust his energy and become entangled by Hua Zhi's vines, unable to move.
A yellow light flashed over Yuan Ming's body, and he tunneled into the ground, nearing the green-robed old man.
"Fellow Daoist, my previous actions were reckless, and I apologize to you. We indeed have no enmity between us. The bodies of those three can also be returned to you. Let us put an end to today's matters," the green-robed old man hastily said.
"Since you claim to be an old hand in the Cultivation World, you shouldn't need to resort to such underhanded tactics," Yuan Ming replied indifferently, activating the Curse Rune once again.
The green-robed old man's cultivation dropped significantly again, this time plummeting past the Core Formation Stage.
His Golden Core shattered into pieces, falling all the way to the Late Foundation Establishment stage of cultivation.
Yuan Ming was taken aback, the Curse Rune's effects were really so miraculous?
He had thought that the weakening of the old man's energy was temporary, like the exhaustion during regular battles, recoverable after a brief period of Breathing Control. He had not expected that the drop in cultivation caused by the Curse Rune would be so authentic, shattering the green-robed old man's Golden Core directly.
Not only was the Golden Core a congealment of a Core Formation Stage cultivator's mana, but it also contained the cultivator's Dao Foundation. With the shattering of the Golden Core, the Dao Foundation is greatly damaged, which is almost impossible to recover unless aided by treasures of heaven and earth.
With his Golden Core shattered, the green-robed old man had utterly lost his future prospects in magic practice, his eyes showing despair as he began to beg for mercy.
By then, Yuan Ming was unmoved, continuing to weaken the old man's cultivation with Curse Runes, while Hua Zhi injected more poison into the old man's body.To support our work, please read on *.
As the green-robed old man's cultivation greatly decreased, his resistance to Hua Zhi's poison also weakened significantly, and he quickly died of poisoning again, only to be resurrected once more.
Yuan Ming carefully observed the process of the old man's resurrection and pondered. The first soul from his Sea of Consciousness shot out and flew deeper into the cave.
He persisted in his actions, causing the green-robed old man to face another round of death.
The man cursed, then began to beg piteously; Yuan Ming remained indifferent.
This green-robed old man was a Soul Cultivator and possessed such an eerie ability to revive. Having formed a deep hatred, Yuan Ming couldn't let him go.
The Curse Runes were continuously cast, causing the old man's cultivation to drop further and further until it fell to the Qi Refinement stage.
Just as Yuan Ming was about to proceed, his brow suddenly raised; his first soul had uncovered a situation.
He shifted his position and arrived close to the green-robed old man, pressing a single hand against the man's head and employed the Soul Search Divine Ability, quickly understanding the full story.
With a thought, he stunned the green-robed old man, captured him in the Spiritual Beast Bag to suppress him, and then continued forward, arriving in front of a blue stone wall which faintly glowed with spirit lights, evidently engraved with some kind of forbidden restriction.
Yuan Ming took out the old man's Storage Bag, retrieved a blue token from inside, and gave it a gentle wave.
A blue light entered the wall, the spirit lights on the wall dissipated, slowly moving to the side, revealing a passage leading downward.
Having learned all about this place from the green-robed old man's memory, Yuan Ming directly entered and quickly arrived at the bottom of the passage.
This was a huge stone chamber; the Three-eyed Crow was also present. Seeing Yuan Ming's sudden appearance, its three eyes shone with malice, and it took flight, spitting out several clumps of gray flames towards him.
Alone now, Yuan Ming had no need to hold back. The White Bone Knife hacked across.
With an exceedingly cold aura bursting forth, it easily extinguished the gray flames.
The Three-eyed Crow was also struck by the knife light, flipping over and crashing heavily into the stone wall behind it.
Immediately after, several sound waves of Crow's Call struck the Three-eyed Crow.
The Three-eyed Crow had previously relied on soul cultivation techniques left in its body by the green-robed old man to avoid falling into Yuan Ming's illusions when they hunted the Poisonous Blade Locust. Now that the green-robed old man was critically injured and unconscious, the Three-eyed Crow lacked external support and could not resist Yuan Ming's illusions, instantly falling into the illusion, immobilized.

chapters.title: Chapter 384 - 361: Night Parade of Hundred Demons
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming had no intention to kill the Three-eyed Crow. After all, this beast was a very rare yin attribute spirit beast capable of unleashing powerful yin attacks. Its third eye could even see through illusions and disguises, making it highly valuable to cultivate.
Although the beast had already been tamed by that green-robed old man earlier, which greatly increased the difficulty of subduing it again, it was not hard to achieve with the soul cultivation techniques Yuan Ming possessed.
Yuan Ming didn't pay attention to the beast, turning his gaze to the center of the stone chamber instead.
There sat a large white screen, two zhang in length and one zhang in height. The semi-translucent screen was embroidered with the figures of men, women, elderly, and children, as well as animal shapes, all of which appeared vivid and lifelike.
Figures that Yuan Ming had already seen, such as the man in white clothing, the woman ghost in red skirt, and the Bull-headed Ghost Yuan Ming had first slain, were all there.
However, these figures, along with seven or eight others, appeared very dim, forming a stark contrast to the other lively figures.
On the other side of the screen, three corpses lay on the ground: they were none other than Fang Youting, Feng Qi, and Ya Xian.
What was eerie was that their bodies had already started to merge into the screen. The white screen seemed to consume people, swallowing the bodies of the three bit by bit.
Feng Qi and Ya Xian had been delivered here much earlier and were already swallowed up to their thighs, while Fang Youting, who had just been brought by the Three-eyed Crow, had only his feet merged into the screen.
"It can even refine corpses? Tsk tsk, what a wondrous magic treasure," Hua Zhi entered and remarked upon seeing this scene.
"Hmm, this object is called the 'Night Parade of Hundred Demons'; it is a rarely seen treasure, incomparable to ordinary magic treasures," Yuan Ming looked at the white screen and slowly said.
"The Night Parade of Hundred Demons? Could it be that those ghosts outside are controlled by this screen? To control so many ghosts at once is indeed a heavy treasure," Hua Zhi clicked her tongue in admiration and shot out a vine aiming to touch the screen.
"Do not touch this object. This 'Night Parade of Hundred Demons' is incredibly fierce. Apart from the person who refines it, any living creature that comes close will be devoured whole, body and soul, never to be freed," Yuan Ming hastened to stop Hua Zhi.
"That's powerful! Master, the dim figures on the screen look like the ghosts that previously died for that green-robed old man. Could it be that the old man couldn't be killed because of this screen?" Hua Zhi quickly retracted her vine and asked.
"There is some relation, but it's not solely because of the screen," Yuan Ming said.
He learned about the green-robed old man's identity and origins, as well as everything about the white screen, from the man's memories.
The green-robed old man claimed to be the "Heavenly Ghost Wanderer," originating from a sect in the Northern Desert called the Wuyue Sect. He was framed, defected from the sect, and became a Loose Cultivator.
As for the white screen, named "Night Parade of Hundred Demons," it was not refined by the Heavenly Ghost Wanderer himself but was an exotic treasure he stumbled upon years ago in the Soul Burying Abyss.
The Night Parade of Hundred Demons was utterly different from ordinary magic treasures. The Heavenly Ghost Wanderer could not fully sense the rune formations inside the screen; he could only detect four runes located at the four corners of the screen. As for the depths of the screen, it was enveloped by an invisible yet robust force that he, despite trying various methods over the years, failed to decipher.
Eventually, the Heavenly Ghost Wanderer simply refined the four runes. After some exploration, he had an initial grasp of the Night Parade of Hundred Demons screen.
Even with just four runes refined, the Night Parade of Hundred Demons already possessed inconceivable divine powers.
Currently, the screen had two abilities. The first was the collection of ghost spirits.
Just like a Spiritual Beast Bag, the Night Parade of Hundred Demons had internal space and could directly collect ghost spirits into it.
The screen contained powerful Space Power and had a broad range for capturing ghost spirits. Any ghost that entered its range would struggle to escape being collected by the screen.
The Night Parade of Hundred Demons could not only collect ghost spirits, but it could also release them from the internal space, and the placement of these spirits could be decided at will.
The fact that the man in white clothing fell to Yuan Ming's illusion technique and then mysteriously appeared next to the Heavenly Ghost Wanderer was due to this capability.
The second ability of the Night Parade of Hundred Demons was Ghost Spirit Rebirth.
This was the most crucial ability of the screen. It could refine a cultivator's body together with their soul into a Ghost Spirit Body, turning them into a ghost slave within the screen.
The ghost slaves converted in this way would not see a reduction in strength and would retain many of their abilities from when alive, as well as being completely controlled by the owner of the screen.
Although named 'Hundred Demons,' the screen could control far more than a hundred ghost slaves. The Heavenly Ghost Wanderer had refined various types of ghost spirits over the years; not long ago, he killed everyone in Earth River City and refined thousands of ghost slaves, still far from reaching its limit. Yuan Ming estimated the Night Parade of Hundred Demons could refine four to five thousand ghost creatures.
The ghost slaves refined by the Night Parade of Hundred Demons were divided into three levels. The first level consisted of those whose realm was weaker than the owner's. Most of the ghost slaves refined by the Heavenly Ghost Wanderer were of this level.
These level one ghost slaves would not appear on the screen.
The second level consisted of ghost slaves whose realm was on par with the owner's. These ghost slaves would be displayed on the screen and be entirely controlled by the owner.
The third level comprised ghost slaves whose cultivation was higher than the owner's. Similarly displayed on the screen, the owner could not fully control these ghost slaves. The higher the ghost slave's cultivation compared to the owner's, the more difficult it was to control them.
The Heavenly Ghost Wanderer was at the mid-stage of Core Formation in terms of cultivation, and the Ghost Slaves he had refined up to now were all at the level of Core Formation, with just one or two whose cultivation was slightly higher than his. Even the higher ones were limited in strength, making them not difficult to control.
As for the Undying Divine Power of the Heavenly Ghost Wanderer, it was a product combined from the Night Parade of Hundred Demons and his Divine Soul Transformation ability.
The Divine Soul Transformation of the Heavenly Ghost Wanderer was a Three-eyed Soul Dove, which had an ability called "Substitution Tribulation." It could transfer the damage received by its original body to the person possessed by the Three-eyed Soul Dove, but each use of this ability would consume one Three-eyed Soul Dove.
This "Substitution Tribulation" ability was quite mysterious. The closer the relationship and the more similar the situation between the person possessed by the soul dove and the Heavenly Ghost Wanderer, the better the effect of "Substitution Tribulation."
In the past, the Heavenly Ghost Wanderer had no suitable targets to transfer to and could only use this ability to transfer some minor injuries he sustained. After getting the Night Parade of Hundred Demons, he was ecstatic.
The Heavenly Ghost Wanderer was a Soul Cultivator, and the Ghost Slaves refined by the Night Parade of Hundred Demons were soul bodies with auras very similar to his. Moreover, they were connected by a master-slave contract, which greatly increased the range of injuries that could be transferred.
Ever since obtaining the Night Parade of Hundred Demons, the Heavenly Ghost Wanderer's strength had greatly increased. In battles, he seemed to be invincible, no longer afraid of injuries, and even when facing opponents one or two levels higher than himself, he was not afraid at all.
However, fortune and disaster coexist. After gaining great strength from the Night Parade of Hundred Demons, the Heavenly Ghost Wanderer became increasingly arrogant and conceited, and today he finally died at the hands of Yuan Ming, someone he originally didn't even take seriously.
Yuan Ming's face showed a thoughtful expression, and then he flicked his fingers.
A sword Qi entered the Spiritual Beast Bag, and a blood hole appeared on the forehead of the unconscious Heavenly Ghost Wanderer inside the bag, his breath completely dissipated, but he was quickly resurrected again.
Yuan Ming released another sword Qi into the Spiritual Beast Bag.
Through Soul Searching, he had deduced that the Divine Soul Transformation of the Heavenly Ghost Wanderer must have been used up and he could no longer use the Substitution Ability.Thе gеnuinе аrtiсlе rеsidеs оn М|V|L&ЕМРYR.
Indeed, another blood hole was pierced through the forehead of the Heavenly Ghost Wanderer, and his breath quickly disappeared completely, with no resurrection this time.
Wisps of Blood Mist floated out from the Night Parade of Hundred Demons, which were the Essence Blood and Mana left by the Heavenly Ghost Wanderer inside it.
The Ghost Slaves outside, having lost their master's control, quieted down. Then, with expressions of wild joy, they scrambled to flee into the distance.
Not just the ghosts outside, but also from the Night Parade of Hundred Demons, a black light surged out, and the Core Formation stage Ghost Slaves inside it detached from the screen and ran towards the distance.
Yuan Ming did not stop them. No matter how far these Ghost Slaves fled, they could not escape the bindings of the Night Parade of Hundred Demons, and catching them one by one afterward would be easy.
He cut his finger, and a drop of fresh blood fell onto the white screen, quickly merging into it.
A mysterious connection formed between him and the Night Parade of Hundred Demons at once, the feeling of estrangement gone.
Yuan Ming summoned Vajra and had it along with Hua Zhi stand guard outside the Stone Chamber. He then set up a protective prohibition inside the Stone Chamber and took out the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
He grasped the Night Parade of Hundred Demons, channeled his Mana and Divine Sense into the Stealing Heaven Tripod, and along with the Night Parade of Hundred Demons, entered the space of the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
Yuan Ming sat down on the White Jade Lotus Platform, forming hand signs to refine the Night Parade of Hundred Demons.
His Soul Power suddenly increased tenfold. With the experience of the Heavenly Ghost Wanderer's prior refinement, he quickly refined a rune, deepening his connection with the Night Parade of Hundred Demons even further.
Yuan Ming did not continue to refine the scroll but instead took out the corpse of the Heavenly Ghost Wanderer and threw it into the Night Parade of Hundred Demons.
A chill white light surged out from the screen, enveloping the corpse of the Heavenly Ghost Wanderer, pulling it into the scroll and rapidly refining it.
A moment later, the Night Parade of Hundred Demons had refined the corpses of the Heavenly Ghost Wanderer, Fang Youting, and other several individuals. Four silhouettes gradually emerged on the Night Parade of Hundred Demons, becoming increasingly clear.
The cultivation realm of the Heavenly Ghost Wanderer was forcefully reduced to the Qi Refinement stage by a Curse Rune used by Yuan Ming, but the man's Divine Soul Power was exceptionally strong. Despite being weakened multiple times, it still possessed the strength of a Love Witch Level, hence his form still appeared on the Night Parade of Hundred Demons.
Yuan Ming closed his eyes to sense the Ghost Slave that the Heavenly Ghost Wanderer had turned into, and his face soon showed joy.
After being turned into a Ghost Slave, the Heavenly Ghost Wanderer retained most of his abilities from his life, including several Soul Cultivator techniques. Among them was the "Substitution Tribulation" ability he cared about the most.
The "Substitution Tribulation" ability could not only transfer his own injuries to others but could also transfer injuries from others to himself.
With the Heavenly Ghost Wanderer's ability at his disposal, in future major battles, Yuan Ming would effectively have an extra life, an ability none of his current Magic Artifacts or Magic Treasures possessed.
Yuan Ming then sensed the Ghost Slaves that Fang Youting and the other two had turned into. Their cultivations were the same as when they were alive, and they retained some of their abilities, but all were rather ordinary and lacked distinctive features.
The only one that was somewhat interesting was Fang Youting. He had cultivated a Thunder and Lightning Technique in his previous life. Now transformed into a ghost body, the Purple Thunder Power within him had turned into Yin Thunder. Compared to the fierce and overwhelming Yang Thunder, Yin Thunder seemed somewhat eerie and appeared to be able to erode the meridians of others. As for the specific effects, further experiments would be needed to find out.

chapters.title: Chapter 385 - 362 Same Origin and Same Ancestry
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming steadied his mind and took the storage magic tools from the four men, giving them a superficial inspection.
Although Fang Youting, Feng Qi, and Ya Xian were Guest Elders of the Spirit Talisman Sect, they were essentially Loose Cultivators. Aside from a single Magic Treasure on each of them, they didn't possess many valuable items, and there weren't many Spirit Stones either. The three of them together only amounted to sixty or seventy thousand.
The collection inside Heavenly Ghost Wanderer's Storage Bag was far superior to that of Fang Youting and the others. He had over a hundred thousand Spirit Stones alone. As for Magic Treasures, aside from the black cane left outside, there were three others: a blue ring, a yellow thin sword, and a golden Short Halberd.
The blue ring was a Confinement Magical Treasure with considerable power, and both the yellow thin sword and the golden Short Halberd were Attack Type Magic Treasures, also quite powerful.
As for the rest, there were some precious elixirs, spiritual materials, and Jade Scrolls among other items.
Yuan Ming didn't bother with the rest and took out the two Jade Scrolls, immersing his Divine Sense into them.
One of the Jade Scrolls contained the Heavenly Ghost Wanderer's practiced Cultivation Technique—"Phantom Yin Technique", a cultivation method with yin attribute that was extremely powerful. However, the deeper one cultivated this technique, the more their body would transform into a phantom entity.
The other Jade Scroll detailed the Heavenly Ghost Wanderer's Soul Cultivation Method called "Mysterious Moon Technique". At first glance, it appeared extremely mystical, seemingly no less astonishing than the Moonlight Technique.
Yuan Ming couldn't help but be intrigued as he closely inspected the contents of the Mysterious Moon Technique. It was strikingly similar to the Moonlight Technique, showing evident signs that the two originated from the same source.
"Could it be that this Moonlight Technique has some connection to the Wu Yue Sect?" Yuan Ming speculated quietly.
The authentic version is on *.
Given that the Heavenly Ghost Wanderer originated from the Wu Yue Sect, his knowledge of the sect was surprisingly limited, only understanding very superficial information, which seemed quite abnormal.
Being a Core Formation Cultivator from the Wu Yue Sect, it was impossible for the Heavenly Ghost Wanderer to have no knowledge of his own sect.
After a moment of contemplation, Yuan Ming summoned Fang Youting, Feng Qi, and Ya Xian.
"Master," the three said in a tone devoid of emotion, bowing respectfully to Yuan Ming.
After being transformed into Ghost Slaves, most of a cultivator's emotions are erased, but their spiritual intelligence remains, and so do their past memories.
"Do you three know of the sect named Wu Yue Sect?" Yuan Ming asked.
"We do. Wu Yue Sect is a sect in the Northern Desert, specializing in nurturing Soul Cultivators, and it's the birthplace of Soul Cultivation practices. It once flourished greatly," Fang Youting said in an even voice without any inflection.
"The birthplace of Soul Cultivation!" Yuan Ming exclaimed in surprise.
That Wu Yue Sect was the cradle of Soul Cultivation meant the likelihood that the Moonlight Technique was an inherited skill of this sect was quite high, no wonder it bore such a resemblance to the Mysterious Moon Technique—they likely shared the same roots and origin.
Xi Ying was proficient in the Moonlight Technique; could she be related to the Wu Yue Sect as well?
"If the Wu Yue Sect is the origin of Soul Cultivation, it should be renowned. Why have I never heard of it before?" Yuan Ming wondered.
"The Wu Yue Sect indeed had a prestigious reputation ten thousand years ago. However, because it was a sect of Soul Cultivators that acted wickedly, in pursuit of power, it ignored all the prohibitions of the Cultivation World. Its disciples were overwhelmingly evil, committing unspeakable crimes to refine Evil Treasure and practice Evil Techniques, slaughtering and annihilating souls and clans without any limitations. In the end, it provoked public outrage, and Da Jin Changchun Temple, together with sects from the Western Region, East Sea, and Southern Border worked collectively to eradicate the Wu Yue Sect. Nowadays, there are hardly any who remember the Wu Yue Sect. I also happened to come across a classic about the Wu Yue Sect by chance, which is how I learned about it," Fang Youting continued.
Yuan Ming couldn't help but smile wryly to himself. The reputation of Soul Cultivation was so poor, it was nearly synonymous with a rat crossing the street, all due to the Wu Yue Sect.
He immediately furrowed his brows as, according to Fang Youting, the Wu Yue Sect had perished ten thousand years ago. But if the Heavenly Ghost Wanderer emanated from this sect, could it be that the Wu Yue Sect hadn't disappeared completely but had secretly continued its lineage?
"Do you still have that classic about the Wu Yue Sect?" Yuan Ming looked at Fang Youting.
"I do not. I sold that classic to someone else a few years ago, but I still remember quite a bit of its content," Fang Youting shook his head.
"Record down whatever you remember for me," Yuan Ming said, handing over a blank Jade Scroll.
Fang Youting took the Jade Scroll, his hand glowing white as he swiftly inscribed upon it before handing it back.
Yuan Ming immersed his Divine Sense into the scroll, his expression becoming increasingly grave.
According to this information, Wu Yue Sect had an enormous influence back in the day, not only dominating the entire Northern Desert but also extending its reach to Central Plains, East Sea, Western Region, and even Southern Border.
Unlike sects such as Chang Chun Temple and Five Thunder Sect, Wu Yue Sect organized itself in the manner of a religion, allowing even laypeople to join their ranks.
The hierarchy within the sect was strict, from low to high: common sect members, envoys, Si Zhao, law kings, Venerables, and the supreme Wu Yue God,
The sect members of Wu Yue Sect held intense worship and faith towards the Wu Yue God; the status of sect members, apart from strength, was majorly evidenced by their contributions to the Wu Yue God.
"It really is a peculiar sect," Yuan Ming murmured to himself.
Wu Yue Sect was the origin of Soul Cultivation, and the levels of Soul Cultivation were also created by Wu Yue Sect. The Jade Scroll recorded the names of these Soul Cultivation realms.
As he had previously learned, they were divided into "Soul Witch," "Illusion Witch," and "Love Witch", corresponding to the levels of Qi Refinement, Foundation Establishment, and Core Formation for Magic Practitioners.
The Jade Scroll had explanations for these Soul Cultivation Realm names. A "Soul Witch" signifies one who has initially trained their Divine Soul and completed the Divine Soul Transformation.
When the Soul Power of a Soul Cultivator further increases and can be radiated outward to cast Illusion Techniques, the cultivator becomes an "Illusion Witch".
If an Illusion Witch advances even further, able to sense and even control emotions, they are referred to as a "Love Witch".
Upon reading this, Yuan Ming suddenly understood, combining it with his own cultivation insights from the Moonlight Technique, he deepened his understanding of Soul Cultivation.
The Jade Scroll also mentioned a realm beyond the Love Witch, called the "Sleeping Witch".
The Scroll didn't go into detail about this realm, but mentioned in passing that a Sleeping Witch can manipulate others' dreams and memories, far more formidable than a Love Witch.
"To control memories... Could it be that the Heavenly Ghost Wanderer's memories have been tampered with? Erased of all content related to the Wu Yue Sect?" Yuan Ming's heart chilled, and he grew more wary of this sect.
He put away the Jade Scroll, collected the Heavenly Ghost Wanderer, Fang Youting, and others back into the Night Parade of Hundred Demons scroll, lifted the Array Restrictions in the stone chamber along with the Three-eyed Crow, and took off with Hua Zhi and Vajra towards the outside.
All the Ghost Slaves confined within the Night Parade of Hundred Demons scroll had escaped, leaving the underground cavern empty. The Heavenly Ghost Wanderer's black cane was still there, having reverted to its cane form.
He picked up the object and probed it with his Divine Sense, a slight joy appearing on his face.
From the Heavenly Ghost Wanderer's memories, Yuan Ming learned this cane was refined from a Level 4 Flood Dragon spine, infused with plenty of high-quality Yin Attribute Spiritual Materials. The rune formations carved inside the cane had reached seven, giving it formidable power, especially adept at corrupting Magic Treasures—no wonder the White Bone Knife and the Golden Sun Ruler stood no chance against it.
Yuan Ming collected the black cane but did not refine it.
Right now, the most pressing matter was to recapture the escaped Ghost Slaves; they were a force not to be underestimated or lost.
He took out the Night Parade of Hundred Demons scroll, sensing the whereabouts of those Ghost Slaves, a trace of surprise flitting across his eyes.
He had thought the Ghost Slaves would scatter in every direction, but those spirits were almost all gathered underground not far from the cavern, seemingly drawn by something.
Yuan Ming activated the Earth Tunneling Talisman and pursued them, and soon a much larger underground hole emerged before him.
This place had an even denser Yin Qi, posing greater constraints on Divine Sense than the cavern the Heavenly Ghost Wanderer had lived in. A several-meters-wide crack on the ground of this underground hole was releasing dense black Qi, accompanied by faint Blood Light.
The Ghost Slaves from the Night Parade of Hundred Demons were all gathered near the crack, greedily absorbing the dark Qi and Blood Light.
"What is this..." Yuan Ming's expression revealed yet another surprise.
He hadn't seen this fissure in the Heavenly Ghost Wanderer's memories. Given its proximity to the Heavenly Ghost Wanderer's cavern, if the fissure had long existed, the wanderer would have definitely been aware of it—could it have just appeared recently?
The Ghost Slaves near the crack sensed Yuan Ming's approach and fled when they saw the Night Parade of Hundred Demons scroll, showing fear as they escaped into the distance.
Yuan Ming gave a slight smile and activated the Night Parade of Hundred Demons scroll, a burst of white light blossoming from the screen.
But just then, the ground beneath Yuan Ming began to tremble violently, stalactites crashed down from the ceiling, and roaring noises like the howling of Evil Ghosts came from every direction. An overwhelming Yin Sha Qi rolled in, even devouring the white light that shot out from the Night Parade of Hundred Demons scroll.
With a chill in his heart, Yuan Ming quickly drove his tunneling light and flew towards the exit without concern for the fleeing Ghost Slaves.
Suddenly, a deep red twilight burst from the fissure, piercing through the fog of Sha Qi in an instant, engulfing all the Ghost Slaves.
Wrapped in the twilight, the Ghost Slaves let out piercing wails as their bodies rapidly dissolved in the Blood Light, disappearing completely after a short time.
After swallowing the fleeing Ghost Slaves, the crimson twilight seemed unsatisfied and continued to sweep towards Yuan Ming.
Turning to see this terrifying scene, Yuan Ming hastened to escape, but in the next instant, the blood-colored twilight wrapped around his body as well, enveloping him.
Once wrapped in the twilight, his mana was instantly suppressed. He was unable to cast any magic, and his Divine Sense couldn't penetrate beyond the twilight.
However, perhaps because he wasn't a ghost spirit, unlike the swiftly dissolving Ghost Slaves, he was merely tightly bound and unable to move.
After capturing Yuan Ming within it, the twilight scanned the vicinity several times, and, finding no other living creatures or lost souls, quickly withdrew, disappearing into the fissure.
Meanwhile, outside the cavern.
Thick black Qi spiraled upwards, connected to the clouds in the sky like a towering pillar, surrounded by Yin Wind and Evil Thunder, stirring the Spiritual Energy in the Soul Burying Abyss and driving all demon beasts into a frenzy.
In an instant, the Soul Burying Abyss was filled with the constant wails of beasts and ghosts, and those Core Formation Cultivators who had come to hunt beasts and search for treasures were affected. Some who were battling troublesome demon beasts lost control and were torn to shreds by the beasts in a matter of moments.
Those who had survived thus far hastily disengaged from their opponents, each flying high into the air. Seeing the black Qi reaching up to the heavens, they were bewildered and puzzled about what new change occurred in the Soul Burying Abyss.

chapters.title: Chapter 386 - 363: Five Murals
chapters.content:
Under the distant gaze of a group of cultivators within the Soul Burying Abyss, the soaring black qi began to transform at a visible rate.
From bottom to top, it gradually turned ethereal and white, as though something was purifying the malevolent energy within it.
This sight initially stunned the onlooking cultivators, then varying expressions emerged on their faces. Some had eyes shimmering with fascination, others showed disbelief, and some stared intently at the soaring black qi, as if trying to see through it and understand the reason behind the change.
After a while, the Yin Wind Evil Thunder swirling around the black column rapidly dissipated, replaced by a profoundly dense tide of spiritual energy that, with the black qi as its center, spread outwards in waves, sweeping across the entirety of the Soul Burying Abyss and invigorating all the cultivators.
About a dozen breaths later, the soaring black qi had completely transformed into a pale white spirit light, even tearing through the perennial clouds above the Soul Burying Abyss, bringing long-lost sunlight to this land filled with malevolent energy.
And within that spirit light, a majestic palace about a hundred zhang tall slowly rose from the abyss.
Constructed entirely of flawless purple jade, under the sunlight, the faint purple spirit light appeared dreamlike and misty within the palace, spontaneously arousing a longing in those who beheld it.
"An Immortal Mansion, an Immortal Mansion has appeared!"
The Core Formation cultivators within the Soul Burying Abyss, upon witnessing such a scene, were overjoyed and immediately, some of the impatient ones began to fly towards the palace on their tunneling light, fearing they would be too slow and miss the opportunity.
However, as they approached the palace, the spirit light surrounding it blocked them; neither their magic nor their Magic Treasures could breach this barrier of light to enter the palace.
Some persistent cultivators continued trying, but many others began to realize that perhaps the Immortal Mansion was not yet open for entry.
After hesitating for a moment, some used Divine Power Techniques or activated their Magic Tools Talismans to contact their sects, families, and friends. They then each found a safe spot nearby to wait for the right moment to arrive.
...
Meanwhile,
Yuan Ming was enveloped in a blood-red halo, perceiving nothing but a vast expanse of red. Apart from this, he couldn't hear any sound nor could his Divine Sense pierce through the halo, as if he was completely isolated from the outside world.
Fortunately, he found that apart from limited mobility and perception, he wasn't affected in other ways and his situation was relatively safe.
After forcing himself to calm down, guided by his powerful Divine Soul, he faintly sensed that within the halo, he was being dragged in a certain direction.
Helpless to resist, he could only acquiesce, all the while remaining highly vigilant.
It was hard to tell how much time had passed when suddenly the blood-red halo before him ripped apart like clouds dispersing after a storm, but then his vision darkened.
Immediately following that, his body started to plummet due to a loss of support.
Now that Yuan Ming had regained his ability to move and his Mana had recovered, he quickly spat out the Soul Destroying Sword to protect his body, and also summoned the White Jade Flying Shuttle to stabilize his form, his eyes and Divine Sense swiftly scanning around.
It was clear he was no longer at the bottom of the Soul Burying Abyss; it seemed he was currently inside an unfamiliar and vast hall, very dim around him and utterly silent.
Yuan Ming, controlling the White Jade Flying Shuttle, slowly descended. As he approached the ground, he lifted his hand and released the Vajra.
The Vajra's body hit the ground heavily, creating a 'rumbling' sound that echoed throughout the hall, carrying a series of rolling echoes.
The moment he stabilized himself, his fists pounded his chest, assuming a ready stance, his gaze searching around, prepared for a potential battle.
However, there was nothing around him; he stood there utterly alone.
Vajra, looking somewhat puzzled, looked up at Yuan Ming as if waiting for instructions.
"Where is this? Could this be a deep crack beneath the ground?" Yuan Ming didn't respond to Vajra; instead, he extended his Divine Sense outward, trying to discern the situation outside this hall, but when his Divine Sense touched the walls, it was repelled back.Enjoy the story by reading on *.
He was somewhat surprised and repeated the attempt several times, discovering that neither his First Split Soul nor the soul crow could cross the obstruction of the walls. He then ceased trying to probe outside and began carefully observing his surroundings.
The hall he was in was vast enough to accommodate thousands of people sitting simultaneously. However, it lacked any decorations or furnishings, even the windows high on the walls, made of large blocks of Moonlight Stone, were fake windows that opened to nowhere, serving only as the hall's source of light.
In the direction facing the main door, a dark, deep corridor led into the interior of the building, but its entrance was enveloped by a pale red forbidden barrier, blocking Divine Sense, and Yuan Ming was unable to discern what lay beyond it.
Beyond that, the only things of note in the hall were the five murals on the walls.
The murals were all centered around a single figure, seemingly depicting several scenes from his growing up process.
In the mural on the far left, a baby was born with a loud cry. His parents stood by his side, surrounded by a circle of close friends and family. It looked like a scene from a wealthy household. Everyone in the painting looked towards the baby in the middle, smiles on their faces.
The content of the second mural began to change. From left to right, there were six figures, apparently representing different stages of the baby's growth, from crawling unsteadily to walking briskly. The baby grew into a young boy who ultimately knelt before an old man who exuded the aura of an immortal.
The next mural continued the theme of the second, depicting the young boy learning arts. However, all the actions of the boy were combined into one person, making it appear as if the person had grown three heads and six arms.
The scene in the fourth mural was particularly grandiose. The young man stood alone on the right side, with a dark crack behind him. On the left side of the painting, countless figures tearfully bid farewell, all displaying expressions of reluctant parting, adding a touch of tragic grandeur.
In the final mural, the young man stood tall against the sky, with countless figures below bowing in worship. The scene appeared peaceful. However, there was a dark hole where the young man's left eye should have been, as if it had been gouged out, creating an eerie effect.
Yuan Ming swept his Divine Sense over the murals and found no fluctuations of Spiritual Power. However, after examining the content of the paintings closely, he couldn't help but furrow his brows.
With his many years of experience in the art of painting, he noticed that although the five paintings seemed cohesive, there were clear signs of alteration. It seemed someone had overlaid new paint on the already completed artworks to change their content.
Yuan Ming tried to restore the five murals, but found they had fused with the wall, unharmed even by the use of a Magic Treasure.
The only exception was the last painting. When Yuan Ming struck it with the Soul Destroying Sword, the right eye of the young man in the painting suddenly lit up.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming carefully prodded the young man's right eye with the Soul Destroying Sword, and saw the right eye suddenly crack open, with a white ring falling out.
Yuan Ming picked up the ring, finding it strikingly cold to the touch, giving a burning sensation in his palm. He tried to refine the ring, then was surprised to find that he could not detect the arrangement of runes on it.
This reminded Yuan Ming of the Night Parade of Hundred Demons. The construction of runes on these two Magic Treasures was so similar, could they originate from the same source?
Thinking of the Night Parade of Hundred Demons, Yuan Ming recalled those Ghost Slaves swallowed by the bloody glow. More than twenty Core Formation Ghost Slaves that could have been his significant support had dissolved so easily, making him feel a deep sense of loss.
He sighed deeply for a while, then turned his attention back to the white ring in his hand.
Compared to the Night Parade of Hundred Demons, the ring's ability was more singular; upon infusing Mana, it only emitted a white mist.
The mist seemed ordinary, but it contained bone-chilling cold. Anything it touched would freeze instantly, Magic Treasures included.
Even the Vajra, who had achieved the Innate Body, showed a trace of fear at this white cold mist and subconsciously stepped back.
This white cold mist could not only freeze the flesh but could also imperceptibly affect the Divine Soul. Initially, Yuan Ming did not notice this until he withdrew the mist and tried to continue exploring with his Divine Sense, only then realizing his Divine Sense's movement had become slow and stiff.
Fortunately, as the mist dissipated, Yuan Ming's Divine Soul quickly recovered. However, his recent experience gave him a deeper understanding of the power of the white cold mist.
After putting away the ring, Yuan Ming looked up at the mural again. He suddenly realized that with the right eye shattered, the young man in the last painting now appeared as though both eyes had been gouged out.
The entire mural seemed even more eerie!
He immediately realized that perhaps there originally was a ring in the young man's left eye, but someone had already taken it.
With this thought, he recalled the Night Parade of Hundred Demons. The Heavenly Ghost Wanderer had never been here, yet he obtained this Magic Treasure, perhaps because someone had taken it out beforehand.
Yuan Ming's heart chilled as his slightly relaxed mood became tense again.
Although this place seemed empty, it exuded eeriness everywhere. It was not somewhere to stay for long.
He began to look for the exit of the grand hall. The walls and doors around isolated his Divine Sense and were indestructible even with Magic Treasures. As for the runes of the Forbidden formation at the entrance, he had never seen any of their like before, and his knowledge failed to help him decipher them.
After pondering for a while, Yuan Ming realized that he had no means to leave this place.
However, he soon remembered the Second Split Soul he had left inside Zuo Qinghui. Since it was only at the Foundation Establishment Stage, Yuan Ming hadn't brought it along to the Soul Burying Abyss, and now it might be his only hope.
Yuan Ming immediately sat down cross-legged and began circulating his Soul Power to contact the Second Split Soul. Luckily, although the walls blocked his Divine Sense, they did not sever his connection with the Second Split Soul.
…
"Struggle in the New Ming Dynasty" written by old school historical author Sui Qingfeng, and adapted into the web drama "I am Li You" which premiered on Youku yesterday! Traveling back to ancient times as a live-in son-in-law, using poetry to confront corrupt officials. Featuring the live-in son-in-law representative, Wai Zui Dragon King Guan Yunpeng. With the original work, director, and screenwriter all being veterans from the starting point, they expertly play with internet novel tropes. I watched the first few episodes, and they're great, repeatedly giving unexpected laughs. The poetry analysis segment at the end is somewhat moving, such pure male-oriented adaptations have been rare in recent years. Everyone should check it out and give it more support ^^

chapters.title: Chapter 387 - 364: Nascent Souls Gather
chapters.content:
Half a month later, Linyuan City.
As the city closest to the Soul Burying Abyss, Linyuan City has always been regarded as a remote place where few people are willing to visit.
Even though Core Formation cultivators occasionally enter the Soul Burying Abyss to hunt for beasts and seek treasures, with their tunneling speed, they could completely opt to stop in larger cities farther away instead of coming here to suffer.
However, now, with the news of the Immortal Mansion's emergence spreading, in order to reach the site of the Immortal Mansion as quickly as possible, countless cultivators began pouring into Linyuan City to rest, not only Loose Cultivators in great numbers but even several major powers from the Black Wind Desert sent people to stay. They bought the city in co-ownership, for a considerable price, from the original city owner's hands.
With the influx of cultivators, the city's infrastructure developed at an exceptionally rapid pace, among which tea houses—where information could be collected—opened most abundantly.
As the saying goes, money moves hearts. Despite the many dangers of the Soul Burying Abyss, from which even Core Formation cultivators cannot guarantee safe return, the chance of an Immortal Mansion appearing suddenly stirred greed in many Foundation Establishment cultivators as well, who, mustering their courage, also wanted to try their fortune and get a piece of the action.
And today, in the newly opened "Immortal Fate Tea House," several Foundation Establishment cultivators sat around a long table, as usual, exchanging information with each other.
"Did you hear? A few days ago, eight fellow Daoists formed a team to explore, but they accidentally encountered a Third-level Lower Stage demon beast. In the end, only one came back with a severed arm. Tsk, tsk, tragic." A long-haired male cultivator spoke.
Upon hearing this, a female cultivator with freckles beside him sighed, "Alas, it's only been half a month since the Immortal Mansion appeared, and so many fellow Daoists have already died in the Soul Burying Abyss. The opportunity in this accursed place isn't something we Foundation Establishment cultivators can covet. In my opinion, we should leave early while we can."
"You're right, and look at the Great Sects. With such a big opportunity, they send Core Formation elders, not even one Foundation Establishment disciple is seen. It's just us Loose Cultivators who are daring enough to risk our necks and barge in. Fellow Daoist Zuo, wouldn't you agree?" A middle-aged male cultivator echoed, looking towards a golden-skinned man sitting at the table.
This person was Zuo Qinghui. Yuan Ming, who he was currently trying to rescue, was still trapped beneath the Soul Burying Abyss, in that mysterious grand hall. He came to Linyuan City to gather information, intending to mount a rescue.
Upon arriving in Linyuan City, he heard about the emergence of the Immortal Mansion, which made him realize he must have been captured by some kind of Array Restriction from the Immortal Mansion.
"Indeed, with the news spreading for so long, no one seems to have found any opportunity. Moreover, I heard that the forbiddens around the Immortal Mansion have not been opened to this day. I wonder if anyone has found any other way in or out?" Zuo Qinghui asked seemingly nonchalantly.
"Who knows? But even if there is a way, unless it's accidentally discovered by someone, who would publicize it? Are they worried there aren't enough people vying for the opportunity?" The middle-aged male cultivator shook his head.
"True, the phenomenon of the Immortal Mansion's appearance was so magnificent that its origin must be extraordinary. Perhaps it's related to the origin of the Soul Burying Abyss. I wonder if there is any historical record in Linyuan City that could provide a clue to gain entry?" Zuo Qinghui tapped his fingers on the table, musing aloud.
"Linyuan City was built just a century ago; how could there be any historical records? Besides, the Soul Burying Abyss has existed since ancient times, probably even the Nascent Soul Ancestors who do not appear in the world on ordinary days have no idea of the origin of this place." The long-haired male cultivator said, shaking his head emphatically.
"Speaking of which, you all saw the scene of tunneling lights covering the sky and the Flying Boats crossing, didn't you? I inquired about it; those were the vehicles of the Nascent Soul Ancestors from the three major powers. We haven't seen such a grand sight in the Black Wind Desert for many years. It's a pity the Soul Burying Abyss is too dangerous; otherwise, I would have insisted on going to broaden my view," the freckled female cultivator said.
"Heh, not just the three major powers. I heard that the Nascent Soul Ancestor from the Spirit Talisman Sect also came, but they have always been low-key, not as grand in their arrival," the middle-aged male cultivator mentioned.
Zuo Qinghui, who was listening, had a slight frown on his face and was deep in thought when suddenly, a sound similar to a dragon's chant, a sharp sword ringing, came from outside the tea house, startling all the cultivators. They promptly got to their feet and rushed to the window to see what was happening.
In the sky, a dazzling tunneling light, like a long sword, tore through the clouds and sped towards the Spirit Light Sky Pillar deep within the Soul Burying Abyss. The magnitude of the sound was so significant that those who saw it were struck dumb with astonishment.
"Hehe, looks like another Nascent Soul Ancestor has arrived, although it's anyone's guess which Sect or lineage the senior hails from," the middle-aged male cultivator commented.
Among the crowd, Zuo Qinghui stared intently at the receding tunneling light, his face solemn.
He found an excuse to leave and went to the inn where he was staying. After closing the door, he took out a set of Array Restrictions and set them up around the room. It was only after taking a seated position that he took out four white talismans and stuck them on his Dantian, chest, forehead, and back.
This сhаptеr wаs first sееn оn МV^LЕМ^РYR.
A surge of white light rose, enveloping Zuo Qinghui's entire body. His Mana circulation was sealed, and he was unable to move.
A glint of crystal light flashed across Zuo Qinghui's forehead, and a transparent soul crow shot out. It was his Second Split Soul.
The Second Split Soul tunneled into the ground and flew towards the direction of the Soul Burying Abyss outside the city.
...
Meanwhile, in the Soul Burying Abyss.
Four cultivators stood in front of the crowd, sizing up the Spirit Light Restriction outside the Immortal Mansion while exhibiting slight wariness towards each other.
Each of them appeared unarmed, with no Mana on display, yet behind each, several Core Formation cultivators stood at the ready, as if awaiting orders.
After a brief silence, a short-statured male cultivator suddenly coughed twice and was the first to speak up:
"Heh, none of us knows the situation inside the Immortal Mansion, so why must we be at each other's throats? I suggest we all set some rules in a friendly manner, limiting those who can explore the Immortal Mansion, to avoid fighting amongst ourselves and letting the opportunity slip to someone else."
He was only half the height of an average person, with short, thick limbs, resembling an enlarged doll. Yet, his face was not young; wrinkles appeared along with his smile, and his sharp voice made others quite uncomfortable.
Behind him stood three Core Formation cultivators side by side. One had a single horn on his head—it was none other than Fang Dafu, who Yuan Ming had encountered before. Another had golden hair and blue eyes, with a high bridge nose that set him apart from the Central Plains people, and the last was dressed in white, his face pale, giving off an impression of extreme frailty.
"Hmph, Su Zimo, you always like to make these petty schemes. Who doesn't know that your Guiyuan Sect is the last to abide by rules? I heard that not so long ago, one of your mines was destroyed, losing a Core Formation in the process, and your scheme of enslaving people was exposed. Have you cleaned up your mess? And here you are, talking about rules!" A bearded old man scoffed unreservedly.
Dressed in indigo robes, with the demeanor of a leopard and a beard like a whiskered tiger, his voice boomed like thunder, ensuring everyone heard him clearly.
Behind the old man stood three Core Formation female cultivators, each beautiful enough to cause the downfall of cities. Among them was Yan Sijing, though the wittiness once in her eyes was replaced with a troubled look, seemingly always preoccupied with heavy thoughts.
Faced with public mockery by the purple-robed elder, the short cultivator called Su Zimo remained smiling, not seeming angry in the slightest. However, Fang Dafu behind him couldn't help clenching his fists tightly.
"Ha, by the way, Old Monster Yu, wasn't your grandson killed a few years ago? Have you found the murderer yet, or shall I call some disciples to help you look for the culprit?" Su Zimo said cheerfully.
"Hmph, the mastermind behind that has been caught by me, so there's no need for your concern. Go ahead and clean up your own mess," retorted Thunderbolt Ancestor, also known as Old Monster Yu.
Upon hearing this, Su Zimo's face stiffened, and Yan Sijing's expression behind Thunderbolt Ancestor involuntarily darkened.
"If you ask me, why don't you two find a place to fight it out? Let the winner decide, so we don't have to hear this whining, distracting me from figuring out the Forbidden Breaking Method," interjected an impatient young cultivator with a black kerchief over his head.
He had a pair of eyes that looked neither open nor closed and uneven eyebrows, with a flattened nose and thin lips, hollow cheeks, and prominent cheekbones—a face that didn't suggest a decent person.
The three Core Formation cultivators following him varied in build—one robust like a tower, one of average build, neither fat nor thin, and one with the graceful posture of a curved waist and long back. All three were clad in black robes with masks obscuring their faces.
"Disturbed? Dugu Feng, stop putting on airs. With your mediocre understanding of formations, you probably couldn't figure it out after studying for decades. But, Golden Dawn Fairy, you've been studying it for so long—have you discerned anything?" Lei Ming said, turning his gaze to a beautiful female cultivator in a golden gauze skirt.
Golden Dawn Fairy was quite young, her fair skin blushed with health, and her egg-shaped face framed with scarlet lips and green eyebrows set off her Hidden Moon Star Eyes. A touch of golden light adorned her forehead, and tender green earrings dangled by her ears, adding to her noble charm.
"This restriction mostly employs Ancient Runes, making it especially difficult to unravel. However, it seems the power of this Forbidden Restriction is waning over time; it is already much weaker than on the day of our arrival. In just a few more days, it should dissipate on its own," Golden Dawn Fairy spoke, her voice as pleasant as a ringing bell, significantly calming the previously tense atmosphere.
Three Core Formation cultivators accompanied her as well, all of them elders in charge of Spirit Wind City, including Pi Xiu.
Upon hearing this, Su Zimo and Thunderbolt Ancestor both nodded their heads, about to add something, when suddenly, all four Nascent Soul cultivators present changed their expressions.
The sound of a sword whistling came from behind, and a blade-like tunneling light reached in front of everyone in an instant.
All lifted their eyes to see a middle-aged cultivator in the sky, his sword-like eyebrows and handsome features exuding a dignified presence as he stood aloft. His figure was as straight as a pine tree, and though his indifferent gaze swept over them, the Core Formation cultivators who met his look felt as if slashed by a sword, their skin tingling with pain.
"Wan Qi Hong of Chang Chun Temple has come for matters regarding the Immortal Mansion. Forgive my directness, Fellow Daoists," he said, his words suggesting apology, yet his tone was brusque and without a hint of a bow, maintaining an air of arrogance even in the presence of the four Nascent Soul cultivators, including Lei Ming.

chapters.title: Chapter 388 - 365: Breaking In
chapters.content:
Upon Wan Qi Hong's arrival, Thunderbolt Ancestor and the other three simultaneously fell silent for a moment, their expressions changing several times before settling on slight smiles.
"I have long heard of Fellow Daoist Wan Qi's great reputation. Seeing you today, it truly lives up to the name," one of them said.
The smile on Su Zimo's face looked extremely sincere, as if he was genuinely pleased by Wan Qi Hong's appearance.
The smile on Thunderbolt Ancestor's face was somewhat stiff. "Haha, I have always heard that Fellow Daoist Wan has been in lone cultivation in the temple, attempting to break through the mid-stage bottleneck. Now that you have emerged, did you find any breakthrough opportunity?"
"There's no talk of an opportunity. It's just that the other fellow daoists in the temple had urgent matters to deal with, and it happened that I just came out to clear my mind and took this chance to deal with this matter. Now that my senior brother is waiting for my report, we should cut the idle talk. I wonder if you have found any forbidden breaking method?" Wan Qi Hong straightforwardly asked.
Seeing the other three people casting their gazes on her, Golden Dawn Fairy repeated what had just been discussed, and Wan Qi Hong nodded noncommittally, turning back to study the forbidden spell outside the Immortal Mansion.
Seeing this, Golden Dawn Fairy and the other three exchanged glances, also remaining silent, while casually inspecting the forbidden spell in front of them and whispering instructions to the Core Formation Cultivators they had brought with them.
Meanwhile, hidden behind a rock a hundred yards away, lay a black-brown Poison Scorpion Demon Insect, its eyes flickering with intelligence as it watched over the area.
The Second Split Soul of Yuan Ming was currently hidden inside this Poison Scorpion.
The Soul Burying Abyss was too dangerous, so Zuo Qinghui could not come in person and had to temporarily seal his mana, sending the Second Split Soul to inspect the situation.
"I didn't expect so many Nascent Soul cultivators would come. It seems this Immortal Mansion is quite significant," the Second Split Soul thought.
With so many Nascent Soul cultivators working together, breaking the Immortal Mansion's external forbidden spell should be a trivial issue; the rest was just a matter of time, and Yuan Ming's escape looked promising.
But then he faced a new issue—once these powerful Nascent Soul cultivators entered, Yuan Ming would undoubtedly be discovered by them.
In the main hall of the Immortal Mansion's square, Yuan Ming, through his Second Split Soul, had learned about the situation outside and secretly lamented.
Imagine when those Nascent Soul cultivators joyfully break the forbidden spell and enter, only to find a Core Formation Cultivator, who had been here long before, his predicament would be predictable.
By then, even if he hadn't done anything or discovered anything, it would be his word against theirs.
Yuan Ming's thoughts raced, and a moment later, he summoned the Stealing Heaven Tripod, placing both the Hua Zhi Vajra and all items too sensitive to be seen into it. He also collected the fragments of shattered stone from the right eye of the mural youth to prevent others from becoming suspicious.
After doing all this, he quietly sat cross-legged in the palace.
…
Outside the Immortal Mansion, Wan Qi Hong observed for a moment and then spoke again, "Though this forbidden spell is exceptionally exquisite, its current power is not so formidable. Since I am here, let's not wait any longer. If the five of us join forces, we can definitely break it."
Already somewhat impatient, Thunderbolt Ancestor and the others voiced their agreement upon hearing Wan Qi Hong's initiative.
However, Su Zimo seemed to have other ideas, "Breaking the spell is naturally good, but besides us, there are so many Loose Core Formation Cultivators around. Since Fellow Daoist Wan has come, why not join us in clearing the area to prevent lost opportunities?"
"Afraid that the Loose Core Formation Cultivators will snatch away the opportunities? Fellow Daoist Su, you really are regressing the more you live. Please feel free to clear the field; I will not participate," Wan Qi Hong shook his head, firmly refusing.
Seeing Wan Qi Hong's refusal to take the lead, Su Zimo awkwardly smiled and dropped the topic of clearing the field.
Seeing that no one else had objections, Wan Qi Hong immediately opened his mouth and expelled a Golden Rainbow Small Sword, which grew to its normal size in the wind. Then he waved his hand to cast a spell, and instantly, dozens of sharp Sword Shadows slashed down, striking the Spirit Light Sky Pillar encasing the Immortal Mansion.
At the same time, the other Nascent Soul cultivators made their moves.
Thunderbolt Ancestor clapped his palms together, and instantly, thunder exploded, followed by his hands fiercely pulling apart, dazzling electric lights emerging from his palms. In just a moment, they formed two head-sized pale blue Thunder Balls, which he threw, smashing into the Spirit Light Sky Pillar.
Golden Dawn Fairy, on the other hand, flipped her slender hand over, and a Golden Scroll appeared in her palm. As she recited the spell, the Golden Scroll immediately released countless golden characters the size of fingers, which rushed like a torrent towards the Spirit Light Sky Pillar.
In comparison, Dugu Feng's actions were much quieter; he simply silently pointed a finger, and a pitch-black long sword flew out of his sleeve, silently striking the Spirit Light pillar.Forabetterreadingexperience,visit*).
As for Su Zimo, he did not make a move himself but merely tapped his Storage Bag, summoning seven half-human, half-beast Core Formation stage refining corpses. At his command, the refining corpses charged forward, their beast claws and steel teeth tearing out dozens of black lights, all striking the Spirit Light Sky Pillar simultaneously. The light dimmed considerably, the effect actually better than that of the others.
Seeing this, surprise flashed across the faces of Thunderbolt Ancestor and the other two. Even Wan Qi Hong turned his head to glance at Su Zimo.
"Hehe, just some trifling skills, please forgive the lack of impressiveness," Su Zimo said with a chuckle.
Thunderbolt Ancestor snorted coldly, turned his head away, and paid no more attention, while Dugu Feng looked thoughtfully at the seven Core Formation refining corpses, appearing quite interested. Golden Dawn Fairy, however, frowned and looked at the refining corpses with evident disgust in her eyes.
As for Wan Qi Hong, his gaze only lingered on the refining corpses for a moment before suddenly shifting to Fang Dafu, who stood behind Su Zimo.
Fang Dafu, sensing that he was being watched, was startled and quickly looked up, but by then Wan Qi Hong had already turned his head away. After a brief search and seeing that no one else seemed to notice him, Fang Dafu felt somewhat uneasy and perplexed.
Under the joint assault of five Nascent Soul cultivators, the light of Spirit Light Sky Pillar was visibly diminishing, with successive harsh attacks continuously colliding and causing waves of conflict.
Eventually, with a crisp "crunch," the Spirit Light Sky Pillar completely shattered, revealing the Immortal Mansion that had been enveloped by it to everyone present.
Wan Qi Hong took the lead and flew toward the Immortal Mansion immediately, and Thunderbolt Ancestor and the others quickly followed suit.
The Second Split Soul hesitated briefly before detaching from the Poison Scorpion and vanished in a flash into Yan Sijing's body.
With the shattering of the Spirit Light Sky Pillar, the nearby area was awash with surging spirit light, and with various energies colliding, the chaos was extreme. No one noticed the actions of the Second Split Soul.
The Second Split Soul, now inhabiting Yan Sijing's body, did not suppress her consciousness. Despite her complex emotions, she failed to notice the extra presence of Soul Power within her.
As they approached, the purple light emitted by the Immortal Mansion seemed to intensify, and when they reached the front door, they found a high-hung plaque of purple gold on it. Oddly enough, the plaque was completely blank, devoid of any inscriptions.
Being Nascent Soul cultivators, Wan Qi Hong and the others were puzzled by this situation but were not intimidated. After closely inspecting the Immortal Mansion, they attempted to extend their Divine Sense into the building only to discover that even the Divine Sense of a Nascent Soul cultivator could not penetrate the Purple Jade Stone Bricks of the Immortal Mansion.
So they could only push open the great doors of the Immortal Mansion and quickly entered, only to be surprised to find an enormous hall paved with jade stones beyond the doors. The walls of the hall were fitted with countless moonlight stones, whose soft radiance illuminated the hall, reflecting the vibrant murals on the walls—and also revealing the figure of Yuan Ming sitting in the center.
Yuan Ming, seeing the surprised expressions of the five Nascent Soul cultivators, feigned shock before hurriedly getting up and bowing to them.
"Junior Yuan Ming, at your service, esteemed seniors," he said.
After Yuan Ming introduced himself, the leading Wan Qi Hong glanced at him then immediately shifted his gaze, looking around the hall.
Fang Dafu, who had a clear view of Yuan Ming's face, paused for a second, then a look of hatred flashed in his eyes as he walked over to Su Zimo and whispered a few words.
Su Zimo gave Yuan Ming a couple of looks, but his expression remained unchanged, and his Divine Sense swept across the hall.
Pi Xiu also recognized Yuan Ming and quietly whispered something to Golden Dawn Fairy.
On the other side, Yan Sijing, seeing Yuan Ming, also showed a look of surprise. However, being in a low spirit, she soon turned her gaze away, showing no further reaction.
"Who are you? A Core Formation junior, why are you here?" Wan Qi Hong, after scanning the hall with his Divine Sense to no avail, focused his gaze on Yuan Ming, enveloping him in an intangible pressure.
"Junior Yuan Ming, a Loose Cultivator from Spirit Wind City. Half a month ago, along with some fellow Daoists, I came to the Soul Burying Abyss to hunt Fierce Beasts. An anomaly occurred, and a red light emerging from the ground enveloped me; when I regained consciousness, I found myself trapped here. Do the esteemed seniors know where this place is?" Yuan Ming asked, his face slightly pale as he spoke quickly.
Since discovering the Nascent Soul cultivators outside, he had anticipated the current situation and had been rehearsing this conversation repeatedly, making sure his tone and expression were utterly convincing, without any flaws.
Wan Qi Hong stared into Yuan Ming's eyes, who met his gaze squarely, his eyes clear and devoid of any fear.
Wan Qi Hong soon averted his gaze, turned, and walked away, no longer paying attention to Yuan Ming.
Seeing this, the other Nascent Soul cultivators present reacted differently.
"This place is an Immortal Mansion that has appeared in this era. The red light that enveloped you was the forbidden light emitted by the Immortal Mansion when it appeared. It took us half a month to break the outer prohibition of the mansion and enter here. You accidentally entered the Immortal Mansion and survived; consider yourself fortunate," the Golden Dawn Fairy explained with a slight smile.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, I didn't expect to meet you here. Don't worry; this is Golden Dawn Fairy, a Nascent Soul Elder from the Spirit Talisman Sect. You're a cultivator from Spirit Wind City; Elder Jin Xi will ensure your safety," Pi Xiu's voice rang simultaneously in Yuan Ming's ears.
"I see, thank you for the information, senior," Yuan Ming glanced at Pi Xiu and then bowed to Golden Dawn Fairy.
"Now, tell us the full reason why you were trapped here without holding anything back," Golden Dawn Fairy continued.

chapters.title: Chapter 389 - 366 Immortal Mansion Inheritance
chapters.content:
Golden Dawn Fairy's words seemed to display no intention of defending Yuan Ming, yet they effectively handed him an opportunity to step down gracefully.
"After being swept into this place by the red light, this junior has been trying to find a way out. However, there's nothing else in this grand hall, the entrance is sealed shut, and the path deeper into the hall is covered by formidable restrictions. With no way up to heaven and no path down to earth, all I could do was sit here and pray that someone would come to the rescue," Yuan Ming spoke in a matter-of-fact tone.
Golden Dawn Fairy and the others found Yuan Ming's account to be coherent and without any noticeable discrepancies.
The several individuals exchanged glances and dispersed to conduct a thorough search of the grand hall.
The grand hall was indeed just as Yuan Ming described, completely empty, with no place to hide anything.
As for the murals on the walls, when the cultivators swept over them with their Divine Sense and detected no fluctuations of Spiritual Power, they didn't pay much attention.
Upon seeing the restriction in the corridor directly facing the entrance, Su Zimo immediately commanded seven refining corpses to attack. Despite a siege that dimmed the restriction, it remained unbroken.
