Seeing this, Golden Dawn Fairy stepped forward to investigate and soon shook her head towards the other four Nascent Soul cultivators, saying, "This restriction is also crafted from Ancient Runes. Even for me, breaking it without leaving traces would require considerable effort."
With her vouching for him, Yuan Ming breathed a silent sigh of relief. However, at that moment, several serpent-like purple thunders shot out from beneath his feet, rapidly entwining his body.
Yuan Ming was both angry and frightened as he struggled fiercely. Yet a searingly hot Power of thunder and lightning penetrated him, easily shattering the Mana he had gathered.
Thunderbolt Ancestor's figure flickered and appeared beside Yuan Ming like a specter, his hand glowing with purple light as he reached for his head.
Yuan Ming's eyes twitched toward the Incense Burner Mark on his arm.
"Old Monster Yu, what are you doing?" A furious shout erupted, and Golden Dawn Fairy deployed the Golden Scroll, from which shot more than a dozen streaks of Golden Light, formed by many golden letters, aimed at Thunderbolt Ancestor like arrows from their bows.
Thunderbolt Ancestor seemed quite wary of those golden lights, dodging them with a swift motion.
The dozen or so golden lights changed direction and struck Yuan Ming, merging into his body.
Brilliant Golden Light suddenly burst from Yuan Ming's skin, and the grand hall echoed with a loud chant as if many people were nodding and reading aloud therein.
The Purple Thunder entwining Yuan Ming's body was pierced by the Golden Light and dissipated quickly, restoring his mobility as the Golden Light also faded rapidly.
He exhaled in relief and withdrew the Mana he had channeled into the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
"Fellow Daoist Jin Xi, what is your relationship with this youngster that you defend him thus?" Thunderbolt Ancestor grunted.
"Yuan Ming is a cultivator of Spirit Wind City and hence associated with the Spirit Talisman Sect. As I am here, it is only natural that I ensure his safety. Old Monster Yu, on the other hand, why harm someone for no reason?" Golden Dawn Fairy said, after flickering into a position beside Yuan Ming.
Su Zimo and Dugu Feng noticed the commotion and looked over.
Wan Qi Hong stood with folded arms in front of a mural, ignoring the exchange between Golden Dawn Fairy and Thunderbolt Ancestor.
"I never trust words spoken by others. This youngster's argument may be self-consistent, but who's to say he is not hiding something? If you want me to believe him, he must submit to my Thunder Sound Soul-shaking Technique," Thunderbolt Ancestor grumbled.
The Thunder Sound Soul-shaking Technique was a unique skill of Thunderbolt Ancestor, allowing him to implant a special Thunder Seal into someone's Divine Soul, shaking their mind and temporarily rendering them unconscious, turning them into a puppet who must answer any question asked.
"Your Thunder Sound Soul-shaking Technique is extremely overbearing. Yuan Ming is only at the Early-stage Core Formation, he can't bear it. A great harm to his Divine Soul is a trivial matter, but he could even suffer damage to his spiritual intelligence and become a fool. Do you intend to destroy him?" Golden Dawn Fairy said with steely anger in her voice as she slowly spoke.
Yuan Ming's complexion turned pale, and he clenched his fists tightly.
"I think Fellow Daoist Yu has a point. This Immortal Mansion is no trifling matter. Since Yuan Ming entered before all of us, what he saw and obtained, we must thoroughly investigate. Fellow Daoist Yu's method might harm him, but that's his misfortune for being the first to enter," Su Zimo said with a cold laugh.
Golden Dawn Fairy's expression darkened, before she said, "No matter what, Yuan Ming is a person of Spirit Wind City; with me present, I cannot let others harm him at will. Where then would the dignity of the Spirit Talisman Sect stand?"
Thunderbolt Ancestor and Su Zimo's eyes darkened at her words.
"All this talk boils down to concerns that he might have taken something and hidden it, right? If so, let Yuan Ming take out all his storage magic tools for you to inspect thoroughly," Golden Dawn Fairy suggested.
Upon hearing this, Thunderbolt Ancestor and Su Zimo hesitated for a moment, then nodded in agreement.
"Please feel free to examine these, seniors," Yuan Ming said, relieved as he produced three storage magic tools and handed them to Thunderbolt Ancestor.
Thunderbolt Ancestor's Divine Sense delved into them, his brow furrowing as he lifted his hand with a flick.
The sound of clutter filled the ground, and three piles of items appeared, all mundane. Although there were quite a few spiritual materials and elixirs, none were impressive for Nascent Soul Stage cultivators, and there were no heavy treasures among them.
Su Zimo's Divine Sense swept over the three piles, and his expression also sank. He then glanced at the three storage magic tools in Thunderbolt Ancestor's hands.
Thunderbolt Ancestor snorted and tossed three magic artifacts over to Su Zimo. Su Zimo activated his Divine Sense to inspect them and indeed found nothing concealed inside.
Thunderbolt Ancestor turned to look at Yuan Ming, covering Yuan Ming's body with his Divine Sense without any attempt to conceal it, searching every inch.
This act was nothing short of humiliation; however, Yuan Ming's face twitched, yet he did not say a word throughout.
Seeing this, Golden Dawn Fairy could not help but say, "Fellow Daoist Yu, after all, he's just a junior who strayed into this place. Now that the search is over, isn't it needless to treat him so harshly?"
"Hehe, Fairy is so protective of him. Could it be that this person has a significant connection with your Spirit Talisman Sect? Or is it that, regarding the affairs of the Immortal Mansion, your sect had foreseen everything, holding much information, and thus you could determine he didn't get any serious opportunity?" Thunderbolt Ancestor chuckled sinisterly, his words piercing like daggers, his probing Divine Sense unretracted.
"Why resort to baseless accusations, Fellow Daoist Yu? Although this person is from the underground city governed by my Spirit Talisman Sect, him getting trapped in the Immortal Mansion was purely accidental. If I had known in advance, why wouldn't I have let him leave this place before we entered?" Golden Dawn Fairy said in a calm and steady manner.
Thunderbolt Ancestor ignored Golden Dawn Fairy and thoroughly searched Yuan Ming from head to toe three times. Finding no hidden storage magic tools, he grudgingly withdrew his Divine Sense.
Just then, Dugu Feng, who had been silent until now, suddenly raised his hand and sent out a black light, rolling up an entirely black twig from the three piles of items.
"Boy, where did you obtain this thing?"
Yuan Ming looked up at the twig in his hand, recalled it carefully for a moment, remembering it was found in Sha Hao's Cave Mansion, and immediately answered, "This item was incidentally obtained from an abandoned Cave Mansion."
This content originates from *, My Virtual Library Empire.
Dugu Feng nodded, "This item is of use to me, name your price."
"This item came to me by chance, without any cost. If senior requires it, please feel free to take it," Yuan Ming promptly said.
However, Dugu Feng suddenly laughed, "Boy, I, Dugu Feng, am not one to bully the weak, and I also dislike taking advantage of others. Since you refuse to name a price, let's trade it for a promise instead. Within my power, I can do one thing for you, whether it's to help you escape a bind, assist you in breaking through a bottleneck, or even kill someone for you, I can accomplish it."
As he spoke, Dugu Feng suddenly glanced at Thunderbolt Ancestor and Su Zimo, the meaning behind his words self-evident.
Seeing the implied threat in his eyes, Thunderbolt Ancestor instantly snorted coldly, while the smile on Su Zimo's face faded significantly.
"How could I dare to ask the senior to do something for me? If senior insists on it, I would only ask for some guidance after getting out," Yuan Ming said with a humble tone.
Dugu Feng nodded, accepting Yuan Ming's request and pocketed the black twig.
Seeing that Dugu Feng seemed to intend to protect Yuan Ming as well, the expressions of Thunderbolt Ancestor and Su Zimo flickered as they pondered their next moves.
"Fellow Daoists have seen and searched. Are you both satisfied now?" Golden Dawn Fairy asked.
Thunderbolt Ancestor snorted and turned away.
Su Zimo shrugged his shoulders and threw the three storage magic tools back to Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming's heart, which had been held in suspense, finally settled. He picked up the items from the ground, once again thanking Golden Dawn Fairy.
Golden Dawn Fairy spoke up, "Yuan Ming, there are still many Core Formation Cultivators waiting outside to enter the Immortal Mansion to seek opportunities. Going out now, you might become the target of many. It would be better to continue exploring this place with me."
"Indeed, you've been trapped here for half a month; to leave empty-handed would be to suffer in vain. But following a great sect like Spirit Talisman Sect, you might only get what's left over. It might be better to come with me, our Black Desert Alliance takes care of Loose Cultivators the most," Dugu Feng added, simultaneously showing his intention to recruit Yuan Ming.
"Thank you for the kindness, seniors, but I do not expect much gain; I only wish to return safely to Spirit Wind City," Yuan Ming politely declined Dugu Feng's offer, standing behind Golden Dawn Fairy.
Dugu Feng was not annoyed, his gaze shifting away as if nothing had happened, no longer paying attention to Yuan Ming.
Just then, Wan Qi Hong's voice rang out, "Enough, settle any personal grudges or old resentments after we get out. The opportunity is ahead, why dawdle here?"
Upon hearing this, the cultivators present redirected their attention to the restriction leading to the interior of the Immortal Mansion.
This restriction was slightly weaker than the Spirit Light Restriction outside the Immortal Mansion. Wan Qi Hong and the other four joined hands again, quickly breaking through the restriction.
Everyone passed through the deep and narrow corridor and then came to a small square room. In the center of the room was a Transmission Array, and beside the Formation, a gray stele lit up, revealing a row of tiny characters.
"I have wasted hundreds of years in this place and finally found a way out. Before leaving, I left my inheritance within the mansion. Those of destiny who come here may enter the array to brave the dangers. Whoever passes through shall receive my inheritance."
The Transmission Array was not large, accommodating at most three people at a time. The Nascent Soul cultivators looked at each other and fell into a tacit silence, seemingly contemplating how to ensure their own people would be the first to enter the array.
However, Wan Qi Hong was disdainful of the others' scheming. He stepped forward without a word to activate the array, and in the next instant, his figure vanished.
Seeing this, Thunderbolt Ancestor and the others naturally had no more disputes. After instructing their subordinates, they stepped into the Transmission Array one by one.
Soon, only a group of Core Formation Cultivators remained in the room, yet the atmosphere between them was even tenser than when the Nascent Soul cultivators were present.

chapters.title: Chapter 390 - 367: My Name is Hai Dafu!
chapters.content:
Fang Dafu stared at Yuan Ming, his complex gaze ultimately leaving behind only a monochromatic hue of hatred. However, just as he was about to act, the blue-eyed man standing beside him reached out and grabbed his shoulder.
"Master has said that the mission is most important; all else can wait,"
Upon hearing the blue-eyed man's secret transmission, Fang Dafu grudgingly stepped back, still fixing Yuan Ming with an unfriendly stare.
Meanwhile, among the three following Thunderbolt Ancestor, Yan Sijing also looked at Yuan Ming as if she wanted to say something to him in private. However, considering the Core Formation stage female cultivator standing next to her, she didn't even dare to transmit her thoughts.
Seeing so many gazes fixated on Yuan Ming, within the Spirit Talisman Sect's group, a middle-aged cultivator dressed as a scholar transmitted a message to Yuan Ming:
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, follow me in later, to avoid being ambushed by people from the Guiyuan Sect and the Five Thunder Sect."
This person was Wen Zaihou, who was among the most highly cultivated of the three from Spirit Wind City, already at the late stage of Core Formation.
Yuan Ming nodded in agreement, though in his heart he wasn't too worried.
The situation at hand was significantly better than the worst-case scenario he had previously anticipated.
Just as the atmosphere turned somewhat tense, the three from the Black Desert Alliance stepped forward directly, stood in the Array without saying a word, and after a flurry of spirit light flashes, they too disappeared.
Seeing this, Wen Zaihou immediately gave Yuan Ming a meaningful glance, and the two also stood on the Formation. As a beam of spirit light enveloped them, all the gazes around them suddenly vanished.
Yuan Ming felt the scenery before him change, and a sensation of soaring through the clouds overtook him. When the surroundings stabilized, he found himself in a gorge filled with dense Yin Qi.
Surrounding him was a dark grey fog of Yin Qi, chilling winds howled past, carrying waves of ghostly wails that chilled both heart and body.
Yuan Ming stood within an Array that enveloped the area, a faint white spirit light forming a protective shield that kept the malign wind and evil ghosts at bay, allowing Yuan Ming a moment to observe.
Wen Zaihou was not beside him at the moment; it seemed the Transmission Array had scattered their locations. However, there were no signs of other Nascent Soul cultivators nearby, which was a relief to Yuan Ming.
As he surveyed his surroundings, the Formation at his feet suddenly brightened; soon after, a beautiful young girl appeared behind Yuan Ming—it was Yan Sijing.
As soon as she appeared, she looked around nervously. Seeing Yuan Ming standing in front of her with a smile that was not quite a smile, her face momentarily showed a hint of joy beyond hope.
But then she grew tense again, not relaxing until she noticed that the figure of Thunderbolt Ancestor was nowhere to be seen. She hastily said to Yuan Ming:
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, I—"
However, before she could finish her sentence, the Formation beneath their feet brightened again. This time, the figure that appeared in front of them was Fang Dafu.
When Fang Dafu saw Yuan Ming and Yan Sijing standing before him, he showed a shocked expression, then without hesitation, he drew back sharply. With a single hand raise, he summoned three Core Formation refining corpses to block in front of him.
Yuan Ming had already seen these Demon Core refining corpses through his Second Split Soul when Su Zimo attacked the Spirit Light Restriction. Possessing the complete Transplanting Technique, he naturally knew that these so-called refining corpses were actually Demon Core cultivators cultivated using this technique.
After he destroyed the Guiyuan Sect's mine, he specifically demolished Elder Hai's underground lab as well, yet unexpectedly, after all these years, the Guiyuan Sect's research on this technique had advanced even further, to the point of entering mass production.
Having witnessed the tragic state of those stitched together by the Seamstress, a surge of anger ignited in his heart, and his gaze towards Fang Dafu was filled with killing intent.
Though flanked by three Demon Core cultivators, Fang Dafu was now full of confidence. Sensing the murderous intent in Yuan Ming's eyes, he sneered instead.
"Yuan Ming, when you killed my father in the mine that day, did you ever think this day would come?"
Yuan Ming, however, furrowed his brows: "When have I ever killed your father?"
"The Guardian Elder of the Flame Scale Mine, Hai Qing—don't tell me you've forgotten!" Fang Dafu shouted forcefully.
But Yuan Ming frowned even more deeply: "Aren't you surnamed Fang?"
At these words, Fang Dafu was suddenly taken aback, memories flooding back. The resentment when he first met his father, the stubbornness of not changing his surname, the bewilderment upon learning of his father's death, and the ongoing remembrance.
His eyes suddenly reddened, complex emotions turning into tears, and also into a roar.
"My name is Hai, Hai Dafu!"
As soon as he spoke, he waved his hand, and the three Demon Core cultivators immediately rushed at Yuan Ming.
Compared with the Demon Core cultivators summoned by Su Zimo, those called by Hai Dafu had a much more evident degree of beastly transformation.
The leading Demon Core cultivator no longer had arms, replaced instead with a pair of huge mantis limbs, dark green blades flashing with cold light. With a swing, three pale white blade lights crisscrossed and slashed towards Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming had already raised his sleeve, pushing Yan Sijing several meters back with a surge of power, while lifting his hand, the Golden Sun Ruler spun out. Under a flash of golden shadow, it split into dozens of golden light ruler shadows in mid-air, confronting the blade lights head-on, dispersing them instantly, and then striking toward the Insect Arm Cultivator.
But at that moment, two straight purple lights shot out from behind the Insect Arm Cultivator, landing on the ruler shadows, pinning them in mid-air.
Yuan Ming, upon witnessing this, swept his gaze across the scene and noticed another Demon Core cultivator behind the Insect Arm Cultivator. This cultivator had four additional eyes on his forehead, a pair of snake pupils and a pair of tiger eyes, from which a purple gloom was emitted by the snake pupils.
When the cultivator with multiple eyes caught Yuan Ming looking at him, all six eyes blinked simultaneously, and a dazzling white light surged from the two tiger eyes, forcing Yuan Ming to squint.
Simultaneously, several booming sounds erupted, followed by waves of scorching heat assaulting his face as several fireballs, each the size of a human head, hurtled toward Yuan Ming.
With a single hand raised, Yuan Ming sent the Bronze Small Tripod flying into the air, where it swelled to the size of a zhang in the wind. Countless red flames billowed from the tripod, coalescing into a blazing Long Dragon that warded off all the incoming fireballs with its claws, spikes, and tail.
The one casting the fireballs turned out to be the last of the Demon Core cultivators, who by appearance was Shi Chuan, the same person captured and taken to the mines with Zuo Qinghui.
At that moment, he was completely out of his mind, his right arm as straight as a white-furred ape's, with flames emerging from his palm and merging into a sphere before bursting forth with a boom.
As the three Demon Core cultivators launched a fierce attack on Yuan Ming, Hai Dafu spat out a White Bone Knife. Its shape was astonishingly identical to the one used by Hai Qing.
Following that, Hai Dafu's Mana surged throughout his body as he pointed a single hand towards the Bone Knife. Immediately, strands of Yin Qi emerged from his fingertips, wrapping around the knife like silk and igniting a pale flame on it, which devoured all the surging Yin Qi.
As Hai Dafu channeled his energy, the pale flames on the Bone Knife grew more intense, radiating bone-chilling cold capable of reaching the marrow. Even bystanders felt that coldness seeping into their Divine Soul.
With a cold smile, Hai Dafu lifted a finger, ready to command the Bone Knife to slash towards Yuan Ming. However, when he looked towards Yuan Ming, he was shocked to see his own father, Hai Qing, surrounded and attacked by the Demon Core cultivators.
"Fu'er, it's your father, stop your attack!" Seeing Hai Dafu realize his presence, Hai Qing hurriedly shouted.
Hai Dafu froze for a moment before suddenly snapping back to reality and gritting his teeth, "Scoundrel, don't think to deceive me with Illusion Techniques! Father is already dead!"
Shouting loudly, Hai Dafu didn't hesitate as the Bone Knife in front of him slashed towards Hai Qing, the pale flames like a ravenous tiger, instantly freezing Hai Qing into an ice sculpture.
However, the illusion in front of Hai Dafu did not disappear. In his eyes, the father sealed within the ice was staring at him fixedly, showing both shock and reproach.
"Don't stare at me like that!"
Roaring, Hai Dafu controlled the Bone Knife to shatter the Frost, but the broken shards were like mirrors, each fragment hiding Hai Qing's eyes.
Those substantial gazes all fell upon Hai Dafu simultaneously, giving rise to an indescribable emotion within him—anger mixed with guilt, and even a spine-chilling sense of relief and guilty pleasure.
"No, that's not right. I didn't think like that!"
Hai Dafu roared, his expression as if he were on the verge of collapse. That bizarre emotion overwhelmed his heart and even made him forget he was engaged in combat with Yuan Ming.
In his eyes, everything around him had disappeared. Only he and those shining fragments of ice scattered on the dark ground remained.
But suddenly, the icy shards melted abruptly and the water surged toward Hai Dafu only to solidify once more into the figure of Hai Qing right before his eyes.
For a smoother reading experience, visit MV&LEMPYR.
"Dafu, you have deeply disappointed your father," Hai Qing said as he suddenly produced a Bone Knife and stabbed it into Hai Dafu's chest.
Agony surged, but it did not awaken Hai Dafu. Looking at his father, seeing the disappointment in his eyes, he felt, paradoxically, a sense of release.
"Perhaps, it should have been like this all along."
In the last moment of his life, that was his thought.
Since the moment he accepted his father's affection, his hatred no longer held righteousness.
He thought he was shackled by the past, yet he never considered that it might have been his excuse to peacefully enjoy everything.
He always believed that he was too soft-hearted to resist the persuasion of others, but in reality, it was the greed in his heart that led him to where he was today.
His father might have noticed this, but always felt guilty, neither daring nor willing to chastise him.
The chains of desire dragged him step by step into the Abyss, and yet no one was willing to sever them.
No, there was someone, but they were gone after his mother passed away.
If only his father had been stricter with him, if only he had been stricter with himself, perhaps he wouldn't have ended up at this point.
Alas, it was too late.
Yet he never once regretted being born as Hai Dafu.
"My name is... Hai Dafu... Father, Mother, your child... is coming to reunite with you…"
The last thought crossed Hai Dafu's mind as a faint smile surfaced on his lips, and then consciousness plunged into endless darkness. His knees buckled, and his body fell forward heavily, stirring a plume of dust.

chapters.title: Chapter 391 - 368: The Path to Self-Rescue
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming gazed at Hai Dafu's corpse, and for some reason, a difficult-to-describe emotion welled up in his heart.
Cultivators begin their journey primarily to transcend the mundane and chaotic, chasing after greater power, and sharing a lifespan with the heavens and earth. In the eyes of mortals, Immortals can travel through heaven and earth and are omnipotent, seemingly no longer susceptible to worldly suffering or mortal troubles, free to roam the universe.
Yet, cultivators themselves originate from mortals, favored by the heavens and earth with a Spirit Root, pursuing the supreme path. However, they often cannot truly detach from the secular world and also possess the Seven Emotions and Six Desires, experiencing the joys and sorrows of separation and reunion.
In the end, one is human first, and becomes an Immortal later.
Where there are people, there is a martial arts world; where there is a martial arts world, there are grievances—such is also the case in the Cultivation World.
Ever since he embarked on the path of seeking Dao, he had merely moved from one martial arts world to another—a more chaotic, dangerous, and deceitful bloody world.
Mortals, at least, have the order and morality of the secular world and the governing of officials. If tired of the worldly life, one can wash their hands clean and retire from the martial arts world.
In the Cultivation World, although there are certain constraints, in most cases, strong power represents everything. Without equivalent power, there's simply no such thing as fairness.
In other words, if one has no value, no one will stand up for them.
Today, Hai Dafu died by his own hands, killed by impulsiveness as well as lingering familial affection. If Yuan Ming were ever slightly careless or if his cultivation halted, he too could follow in those footsteps; his end might not be any better.
Yuan Ming sighed lightly, gathering his scattered thoughts, and silently moved forward to collect the Storage Bag and Spiritual Beast Bag from Hai Dafu's body.
Cultivators with Demon Cores inherently have weak Divine Souls. He almost effortlessly caused them to turn against their allies. After casting an Illusion Technique to deceive Hai Dafu, he also used his Emotion Manipulation Ability to amplify the emotions within Hai Dafu's heart, and upon his breakdown, had the Insect Arm Cultivator kill him.
Everything happened in the flicker of a flame; Hai Dafu spent such a long time in the illusion, but in reality, it was only a matter of a few breaths.
Not far away, Yan Sijing saw Hai Dafu lash out and was somewhat worried about Yuan Ming, but seeing Yuan Ming kill Hai Dafu so swiftly, she was especially surprised.
With other people around, Yuan Ming, after cleaning up the battlefield, did not check his gains but simply smiled slightly at Yan Sijing, "Miss Yan, it has been a long time."
His voice was calm and composed, as if the recent skirmish had never happened.
Yan Sijing snapped back to reality, her face still showing disbelief, "Fellow Daoist Yuan, it's been many days. Your strength has really improved."
"Miss Yan flatters me. It's just that I happened to master the Transplanting Technique, knowing the secrets to controlling these Demon Core Cultivators, making them turn against each other at the critical moment, making it so easy," Yuan Ming explained half-truthfully.
Yan Sijing nodded, seemingly not quite believing Yuan Ming's words, but also knowing that if he was reluctant to say more, it was not her place to pry further.
"By the way, I didn't expect Miss Yan that you had reached the Golden Core stage. Congratulations! However, I wonder why now you are traveling with Thunderbolt Ancestor? Where is your sister? Is she well?" Yuan Ming changed the topic.
Hearing this, Yan Sijing's expression darkened, and she sighed deeply, "It's a long story. After parting with you that day, my sister and I immediately returned to Hundred Pills Square, dismissed the staff, and took the accumulated resources to hide in Spirit Wind City, trying to lay low for a while."
Yuan Ming raised an eyebrow, pretending to be surprised, "Oh, that is really coincidental. I was also staying in Spirit Wind City before, what a pity that I never encountered you sisters."
"Alas, it's probably for the best that you didn't run into us. My sister and I thought we would just hide out in the city, not going out until things cooled down. But unexpectedly, not long after staying in Spirit Wind City, I was discovered by an entity known as the Nether Moon God. Upon hearing this, my sister immediately took me to another Underground City to seek refuge. Coincidentally, Elder Chai was also hiding in that city. His whereabouts were still somewhat undiscovered by the people of Five Thunder Sect, which led Thunderbolt Ancestor to come personally and eventually, he found us sisters in the city," said Yan Sijing ruefully, having already learned about this situation from listening to Golden Dawn Fairy and others' arguments outside, and therefore was not surprised, but bitterly smiled.
While she spoke, her beautiful eyes stared unblinkingly at Yuan Ming, as if trying to read something from his face, whereas Yuan Ming maintained a calm and composed expression throughout, showing no signs of irregularity.
Yan Sijing felt somewhat helpless and continued, "After Thunderbolt Ancestor captured us, he forcibly made us practice a Cultivation Technique to nurture the Primordial Essence, preparing to use us as Furnace Tripods for replenishment. For this purpose, he forcibly elevated my Cultivation to Core Formation and, using my elder sister as a threat, commanded me to stay by his side for emergency needs. The two other Core Formation female cultivators who accompanied me were also spare Furnace Tripods. However, they wholeheartedly attached themselves to Thunderbolt Ancestor and had long become his accomplices, strictly monitoring me. It's only now, with them not around, that I am able to converse with Fellow Daoist Yuan."
While speaking, Yan Sijing sighed deeply, her words tinged with a hint of melancholy, "Fellow Daoist Yuan, I heard from my sister that you destroyed the Guiyuan Sect's mine using the name of the Nether Moon God in Spirit Wind City. Could it be that the Nether Moon God came for you and by chance discovered me there?"
"Perhaps that is so. I had previously reported the affair of Yu Hong to the Nether Moon God. Later, when I formed my Core in Spirit Wind City, the Nether Moon God indeed descended in person to bless me. However, he did not mention this matter to me," Yuan Ming replied with a gentle sigh, yet he chose not to reveal the truth.
Yan Sijing was silent for a moment, her emotions suddenly agitated, "Fellow Daoist Yuan, forgive my frankness. If the Nether Moon God truly exists, he had assured me in the past that if I ever encountered danger, I could silently chant his name to seek his protection. When Thunderbolt Ancestor appeared, I chanted it, but why didn't he show himself? With his Great Divine Power and the flag of allowing everyone in the mine to determine their own destinies, why didn't he reach out to help us?"
Yuan Ming did not respond, merely silently watching Yan Sijing vent her feelings.
Seeing Yuan Ming's reaction, a hint of despair flashed across Yan Sijing's face. She pursed her lips, turned away, and said no more.
Just then, Yuan Ming suddenly spoke:
"God is omnipotent, but God does not watch over the mortal world at all times. Miss Yan, did you worship and pray after hearing the divine decree? As a Divine Envoy residing in Spirit Wind City, God naturally casts his gaze there. But in a city without believers, how would God pay attention? Moreover, those who disdain God on ordinary days only pray when disaster strikes. What kind of God would care for such people?"
"Only believers can be redeemed, and such a god dares to claim he saves all beings?" Yan Sijing retorted with a cold laugh as she turned back.
"You are mistaken. It's not only believers who can be redeemed but those who are awakened. Only self-rescue can lead to salvation. God has formidable power in the world, but since all beings suffer, he does not grant wishes indiscriminately. That would not be saving people, but harming them. His redemption is showing us a path of self-rescue. We follow in the footsteps of God and walk this path, ultimately achieving our own redemption," Yuan Ming continued measuredly.
Content presented by *.
Yan Sijing blinked, her large, clear eyes showing a flicker of contemplation.
Yuan Ming gave her a glance, his expression unchanging as he proceeded:
"Just like the battle at the Guiyuan Sect mine, it was I who resolved Hai Qing, but the remaining Foundation Establishment and Qi Refinement realm guards were ultimately freed by the mine slaves themselves. The Nether Moon God freed their minds, allowing them to depend on themselves, gaining their freedom."
"Similarly, if you devoutly pray to the Nether Moon God, God might send me to grant you the Cultivation Technique needed to achieve Core Formation. Then, facing Thunderbolt Ancestor, even if you can't defeat him, you might still have a chance to flee with your sister. If even fleeing is impossible, then God will personally intervene to deal with Thunderbolt Ancestor for you."
At these words, Yan Sijing pressed her lips together, seemingly unwilling to accept this, yet ultimately, she could only let out a deep sigh.
"Sigh, it's too late for anything now."
However, Yuan Ming shook his head and said, "As long as the heart is sincere, it's never too late."
Yan Sijing paused, then saw Yuan Ming continuing, "As the Divine Envoy, my presence here signifies that the Nether Moon God is watching this place. From now on, if you sincerely believe in the Nether Moon God and embrace his ideologies, he will forget past grievances and grant you grace when you need it most."
"Grant grace? What kind of grace? Will he personally help me kill Thunderbolt Ancestor? Or will he directly take my sister and me somewhere else where Thunderbolt Ancestor can't find us?" Yan Sijing asked with a smile.
"I said, God is omnipotent, but he does not grant requests indiscriminately. Now, trapped like a caged animal, similar to the trapped mine slaves, Thunderbolt Ancestor is like a collar around your neck. Only if you pray sincerely, the Nether Moon God will help you remove that collar, but freeing your sister ultimately requires you, who has broken free, to save her yourself," Yuan Ming shook his head as he spoke.
A flicker of hope ignited in Yan Sijing's bright eyes, and she was slightly persuaded, quickly saying, "Alright, I agree. From now on, I will pray sincerely to the Nether Moon God. If he truly can help me kill Thunderbolt Ancestor, allowing me to gain the strength to rescue my sister, I will also make my sister believe in the Nether Moon God. When Hundred Pills Square is rebuilt, we will have everyone there believe in the Nether Moon God, becoming his believers."
"The Nether Moon God is watching this Immortal Mansion. Your words will reach his ears. Just remember, you are not yet a Divine Envoy of the Nether Moon God, so your prayers must be sincere. The Nether Moon God will tolerate once, but not a second time," Yuan Ming nodded and advised solemnly.
"I remember, and I won't gamble with my sister's and my own lives," Yan Sijing earnestly assured.

chapters.title: Chapter 392 - 369: Significant Supplementary Boost
chapters.content:
At this moment, a cold sneer filled with mockery came from behind Yuan Ming and Yan Sijing.
Both of them looked in the direction of the sound, only to see a graceful figure in a black robe, shrouded in the Yin Qi not far away, evidently a Core Formation Stage cultivator from the Black Desert Scatter Alliance.
This person had appeared quite abruptly and without a sound, neither Yuan Ming nor Yan Sijing had noticed where this person came from or when they had appeared.
Yan Sijing's expression changed drastically, a golden light flashed in her hands, and a gold treasure sword with an ancient design and engraved with numerous monster patterns appeared, her face full of wariness.
"Isn't it a bit sneaky to eavesdrop on others' conversations so silently?" Yuan Ming stopped Yan Sijing with a gesture and asked in an even tone.
The figure in the black robe paid no heed, as if Yuan Ming and Yan Sijing were of no consequence, and the figure blurred, heading straight toward the valley.
Yuan Ming narrowed his eyes slightly, casting his divine sense over the black-robed individual and beginning to use the Dream Butterfly Illusion Technique.
No matter when this person appeared, since they might have heard his and Yan Sijing's plans, they couldn't be allowed to leave like this.
However, the person in the black robe continued moving at the same speed, completely unaffected by Yuan Ming's illusion technique.
Yuan Ming's pupils contracted, and he felt a surge of surprise in his heart.
With the strength of his divine soul, and his mastery over illusion techniques, even late-stage Core Formation cultivators might not be completely unaffected.
In the middle of his thoughts, Yuan Ming promptly activated the Night Parade of Hundred Demons; space fluctuated in front of the black-robed person, and a gray figure emerged out of nowhere—it was Fang Youting, in his ghost slave form, reaching out with a claw.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
Five streaks of black thunder lanced from his fingertips towards the black-robed figure, a new Yin Thunder divine skill that Fang Youting had acquired since transforming into a ghost slave.
Seeing Yuan Ming make his move, Yan Sijing also shouted, her gold treasure sword unleashing a roaring sound that shook the void, slicing toward the black-robed figure.
The figure in the black robe didn't move, and ripples of white spread out from their body.
Fang Youting's eyes immediately became vacant, and the Yin Thunder he released veered off course, narrowly missing the black-robed figure and passing by.
Yan Sijing's eyes also showed a hint of confusion, as if she had fallen into an illusion, and the sword in her hand suddenly went awry, cutting in another direction.
"Illusion Techniques!" Yuan Ming realized with a chill in his heart, now understanding why the black-robed person was unaffected by his own illusions.
This person had easily plunged Yan Sijing and Fang Youting into an illusion; their mastery over illusion techniques was likely not inferior to his own.
Chapter provided via *.
Yuan Ming uttered a sharp cry, his Soul Pill in the Sea of Consciousness suddenly shrunk to the size of a sesame seed, then swiftly expanded.
A torrent of powerful divine sense burst forth violently, forming a mighty surge of divine sense waves that forcefully struck Fang Youting and Yan Sijing.
This was a technique to break illusions that he had recently devised by combining the Soul Pill Technique, the Soul-shocking Secret Technique, and the "soul collision" capability: the Ten Directions Soul Wave.
The Ten Directions Soul Wave's effect on breaking illusions was nowhere near that of soul collision but was advantageous due to its wide range.
Fang Youting and Yan Sijing shuddered, coming back to their senses.
The person in the black robe turned their head to glance at Yuan Ming, a flicker of surprise evident in their eyes, then with a flash, they had vanished into the depths of the valley and quickly disappeared without a trace.
A peculiar expression crossed Yuan Ming's face, but he made no further attempt to stop them.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, why did you let that individual in black go?" Yan Sijing asked anxiously, her words carrying a hint of reproach.
"No matter, that person will not leak our secrets," Yuan Ming replied with a slight flicker in his gaze.
"Why? Do you know that person?" Yan Sijing frowned, dissatisfied with Yuan Ming's explanation.
Yuan Ming did not reply but with a wave of his sleeve, three small yellow flags landed around him, the very Magic Treasures that Ya Xian had used.
"I have an urgent task to attend to, and I would ask you, Fellow Daoist Yan, to act as my protector for a bit," he spoke quickly, and without waiting for Yan Sijing's response, he activated the three small yellow flags.
Bright yellow light rose from the flags, forming a thick, hemispherical light barrier that enveloped Yuan Ming's figure, impervious to divine sense.
Yan Sijing, confused and somewhat angered by Yuan Ming's string of actions, simply took a deep breath, quelled the fire in her heart, and silently sat down cross-legged near the yellow light barrier.
Fang Youting stood on the other side of the yellow light barrier, his eyes blank as he scanned the surroundings.
Yuan Ming, sensing Yan Sijing's actions through his second split soul, nodded slightly, took out the Silver Token, and added another layer of silver light behind the yellow barrier before he sat down with peace of mind and took out the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
Moments later, the yellow light barrier dissipated, and Yuan Ming's figure was revealed.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, how did things go?" Yan Sijing stood up with a smile, refraining from questioning Yuan Ming about what he had done.
"All is taken care of. Thank you for waiting, Fellow Daoist Yan; let's set off," Yuan Ming responded with an additional glance at Yan Sijing, who had quickly adjusted her mood, as he put Fang Youting back into the Night Parade of Hundred Demons and spoke.
Instantly, the two of them soared up and entered the valley.
The further they went, the denser the Yin Qi in the valley became; soon, a thick, grey-black fog emerged in the air, and even from a distance, Yuan Ming and Yan Sijing could feel their meridians becoming numb, and a piercing pain began to emanate from deep within their bones.
"Ghost Miasma! The Yin Qi here is so dense!" Yan Sijing's face turned grave.
Yuan Ming's gaze flickered as well; he had heard that Ghost Miasma would only form in places with extremely dense Yin Qi, where ghosts gathered. It was extraordinarily noxious, and even cultivators could wither and die from drained Essence Blood if their cultivation was too weak.
However, for some Ghost Path Magic Treasures, Ghost Miasma is a great nourishment.
With a thought, Yuan Ming secretly activated the Night Parade of Hundred Demons. The flow of air in the valley stirred, and the dense Ghost Miasma began to drift towards the two of them.
Yan Sijing's complexion changed, and in a panic, she conjured up a fiery red Round Orb, floating above her head.
A red Light Pillar enveloped her from the Round Orb, shrouding her within.
When the Ghost Miasma touched the red Light Pillar, it immediately made a "sizzling" sound and evaporated by the red light within the pillar.
Yuan Ming, on the other hand, slightly activated the Night Parade of Hundred Demons and a white light emanated from his body.
At the touch of the white light, the Ghost Miasma immediately vanished without a trace, not even touching his body.
Yan Sijing couldn't see through what method Yuan Ming had used, but she didn't ask any further.
After both of them employed their methods, they continued to move forward and soon flew into the Ghost Miasma.
The Night Parade of Hundred Demons was like a gaping Taotie, causing the Ghost Miasma to surge wherever it passed, over a range of hundreds of meters.
Although the valley seemed unchanged, the essence of the Ghost Miasma had already been absorbed completely.
The Night Parade of Hundred Demons emitted joyful tremors, and the patterns on it became several shades clearer. Several Ghost Slaves within the scroll also absorbed the power of the Ghost Miasma, their strength slowly increasing.
Especially the Heavenly Ghost Wanderer, his body quickly became more substantial, faintly surpassing Fang Youting in momentum.
Yuan Ming felt secretly delighted; the Heavenly Ghost Wanderer was originally a peak-level Soul Cultivator of a love witch, forcibly demoted in Cultivation by Curse Runes. If he could recover his strength by relying on the Ghost Miasma, he would undoubtedly become a powerful aid for Yuan Ming.
After some contemplation, he threw the White Bone Knife and the Heavenly Ghost Wanderer's black staff into the Night Parade of Hundred Demons as well.
Both items were yin attribute Magic Treasures, which could potentially become more powerful if nourished by the Ghost Miasma.
As for the Soul Destroying Sword, Yuan Ming did not put it into the Night Parade of Hundred Demons.
This sword required the pure power of Yin Soul, and the Ghost Miasma was somewhat mixed for it, potentially harmful rather than beneficial.
However, the commotion brought about by Yuan Ming's generous nourishment of the Night Parade of Hundred Demons on their journey caused Yan Sijing to be on edge the entire time. Clutching the golden treasure sword in her hands, she was fully focused on surveying their surroundings.
"Fellow Daoist Yan need not be so concerned. This disturbance in the Ghost Miasma might be intentionally caused by the Immortal Mansion's master as a test for us. Should any ghosts attack, leave them to me," said Yuan Ming, noticing Yan Sijing's frightened state and feeling slightly apologetic. He reassured her and flew to her front.
"Ghost Miasma is born from the rich Yin Qi. Since such dense Ghost Miasma can form here, there must be many ghostly entities lurking. Be careful, Fellow Daoist Yuan," Yan Sijing sighed with relief and reminded him.
Yuan Ming hummed in acknowledgment and scanned the surroundings with his Divine Sense, the Soul Destroying Sword within him itching to move.
Different from Yan Sijing, he was actually very much looking forward to ghosts attacking.
The Soul Destroying Sword had just advanced to an Advanced Magical Treasure and needed a substantial amount of Yin Soul Power to nourish it.
In the past, no matter how much Soul Power the sword absorbed, its strength wouldn't change much, but now that the Soul Destroying Sword had formed a rune formation, the more Yin Soul Power it devoured, the greater its power would be.
Contrary to their expectations, they pressed on for a long time, yet didn't encounter a single ghost.
"Could it be that they were all killed by that person in the black robe earlier?" Yan Sijing speculated with a mix of shock and joy.
Yuan Ming remained silent, silently wondering if the ghostly entities in the area had been scared off by the Night Parade of Hundred Demons.
As he considered whether to stow the Night Parade of Hundred Demons, suddenly a grey shadow streaked out from the miasma behind them. It was a disheveled, fierce-faced grey-robed female ghost, pouncing towards Yan Sijing.
The Yin Qi swirling around this ghost was so strong that it was no less than that of a Core Formation Stage cultivator.
Yan Sijing reacted extremely quickly, raising the golden treasure sword and slashing a grand golden sword light backwards.
The grey-robed female ghost grabbed with a single hand, and a black Ghost Claw, about a meter in size, appeared out of thin air, easily blocking the golden sword light.
Before Yan Sijing could react, the grey-robed female ghost let out a piercing scream. In an instant, an area of more than a dozen meters around was filled with ghastly wails, painfully shrill to the ears.
Yan Sijing felt as if her Divine Soul had been struck heavily, her face instantly turned pale, and her mind went blank.
With a shake of her hand, the grey-robed female ghost pushed aside the golden sword light and clawed towards Yan Sijing's chest, about to slay her on the spot.
A black sword light shot from the front, piercing through the black Ghost Claw and dissolving it into nothingness.
Yan Sijing was also wrapped in a green glow and flew backward, landing behind Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming, whose Divine Soul was exceptionally stable as he had congealed a Soul Pill, wasn't affected in the slightest by the screaming and even wore a light smile as he sized up the grey-robed female ghost.
The grey-robed female ghost also fixed her gaze on Yuan Ming, finding it more challenging than facing Yan Sijing. After hesitating for a moment, she made another move, letting out another ghostly howl as two black Ghost Claws emerged out of nowhere, striking at Yuan Ming from both sides.
Yuan Ming chuckled lightly and spat two Soul Destroying Sword lights, obliterating the black Ghost Claws.
At the same time, a vast scroll phantom shot out from his body, swiftly wrapping around the grey-robed female ghost.
The grey-robed female ghost struggled fiercely but couldn't escape the scroll phantom's restraint and, after a miserable scream, vanished, getting absorbed into the Night Parade of Hundred Demons.
Yuan Ming hesitated for a moment before deciding not to kill and absorb her with the Soul Destroying Sword.
The Ghost Howl Divine Skill of the grey-robed female ghost was not weak, somewhat resembling the techniques used by Soul Cultivators. It could be useful in a critical moment.
He activated the transformation of the ghostly form of the Night Parade of Hundred Demons to begin refining the grey-robed female ghost into a Ghost Slave as well.

chapters.title: Chapter 393 - 370 Yin Capital City
chapters.content:
"Eh, what happened to that ghost? Did you repel it?" Yan Sijing had recovered by now, looking around in some panic.
"Don't worry, that ghost has been subdued by me," Yuan Ming said, continuing to fly forward.
Yan Sijing was slightly taken aback, her expression somewhat complex as she watched Yuan Ming's retreating figure and followed as well.
Not long after the two had left, a transparent figure materialized in the void about a dozen zhang away—it was the black-robed person from before.
This individual did not exude a trace of aura. Previously, both Yuan Ming and Yan Sijing's divine senses had swept over this spot but failed to detect this person's presence.
The black-robed person watched Yuan Ming's retreating figure, eyes shimmering with brilliance under the dark cloth, and then vanished in a flash.
On their subsequent journey, Yuan Ming and company encountered more ghosts, including some powerful ones in the Core Formation Stage as well as hordes of those in the Foundation Establishment and Qi Refinement Stages.
However, no matter the ghost, they all had no power to resist against Yuan Ming, either being swept away by an ethereal image of a scroll or being directly slain by the Soul Destroying Sword.
Yan Sijing rarely took action along the way, her thoughts becoming increasingly heavy.
The strength displayed by Yuan Ming repeatedly exceeded her expectations, almost beyond what a Core Formation cultivator should possess, and it seemed he had not yet exerted his full strength.
"Yuan Ming is just an envoy of the Nether Moon God, yet he possesses such strength. Perhaps the Nether Moon God he serves may truly be able to contend with Thunderbolt Ancestor," Yan Sijing speculated secretly.
Although she had promised Yuan Ming to believe in the Nether Moon God, she still had many doubts about the god's strength before.
Now witnessing Yuan Ming's astonishing combat abilities, she began to genuinely revere the Nether Moon God.
At this moment, the Ghost Miasma suddenly thinned, and the valley finally ended.
The view ahead opened up, the ground covered with sand and black stones, seemingly an endless Gobi Desert. A few green grass and leaves sprouted from the cracks in the rocks, adding a bit of vitality to this place.
The sky was also gray-black, conveying a sense of vastness.
However, on this desolate desert stood a gray-black city with walls as high as twenty or thirty zhang, extending far in all directions, occupying no less an area than Little Lake City or Wangyue City.
The city gate faced the canyon, with three large characters "Yin Capital City" inscribed on it, full of dynamic flourishes.
Possibly due to a lack of maintenance over many years, many parts of Yin Capital City were already collapsed and damaged, with cracks in the three big characters above the gate as well, and the two large doors battered by years of wind and rain.
Through the half-fallen gate, one could see the insides streets equally dilapidated, devoid of any human traces.
"Have we passed the valley's test? What's up with this city?" Yan Sijing subconsciously looked to Yuan Ming for guidance.
"I don't know, but if we want to continue exploring the Immortal Mansion, we'll have to enter the city," Yuan Ming stated calmly.
"Why?" Yan Sijing asked, puzzled.
Yuan Ming pointed to the right, where a small stele stood behind several rugged boulders, inscribed with a line of small characters:
Within Yin Capital City, between Yin and Yang, secret treasure awaits those destined!
"Fellow Daoist Yuan is observant. The other three sentences are easy to understand, but what does 'between Yin and Yang' mean?" Yan Sijing examined the small characters on the stele.
Yuan Ming was also pondering the meaning of these sentences but had not reached any conclusion yet.
"Regardless, we need to enter the city to find out. I am ready to go in for a look, what are your plans, Fellow Daoist Yan?" he asked.
"Since Fellow Daoist Yuan is interested, this young lady naturally will accompany," Yan Sijing responded after a brief contemplation.
Yuan Ming had promised to employ the power of the Nether Moon God to eliminate Thunderbolt Ancestor. If she were to stop here, she would be unable to verify the truth. Moreover, although the wilderness seemed tranquil, who could know if there were other dangers?
Yuan Ming did not say much more and took the lead by squeezing through the cracks in the gate without damaging it. Yan Sijing also followed suit and entered.
...
Meanwhile.
In a snowy and icy land, the Thunderbolt Ancestor moved rapidly with a Core Formation female cultivator.
One after another, luminescent blue fox-like monsters emerged from the snow below, lunging at the Thunderbolt Ancestor and his companion.
The Thunderbolt Ancestor, without looking aside, emitted bolts of Purple Thunder from the indigo robe he wore, piercing through the blue fox monsters effortlessly, turning them into charred corpses.
Shortly afterwards, the ice and snow ahead rapidly melted away, and verdant, lush forests grew id fueling in its place. A gray, towering city stood there—it was also called Yin Capital City.
What's more, the state of collapse and dilapidation at the city walls and gate matched exactly the Yin Capital City that Yuan Ming and company had encountered in the desert.
"Ancestor, there's a stele here." The Core Formation female cultivator pointed to a nearby jungle where a stele stood, inscribed with the same words as the one near Yuan Ming and his companion.
"Secret treasure! Hahahaha, the treasures are finally starting to appear." The Thunderbolt Ancestor's eyes revealed a look of greed. Just as he was about to leap into the city, he suddenly stopped in his tracks.
"You go in first," he said to the Core Formation female cultivator.
The female cultivator understood that the Thunderbolt Ancestor wanted her to check the path ahead. Although she cursed him in her heart, she dared not disobey and, conjuring her magic treasure for protection, went into the city ahead.
As the Thunderbolt Ancestor watched her, confirming she was not in immediate danger, he was about to follow, but the female cultivator inside the city suddenly vanished into thin air.
The Thunderbolt Ancestor was startled; he had been using his divine sense to lock onto the Core Formation female cultivator but could not discern how she had disappeared.The full series lives on My Virtual Library Empire (*).
The gloomy city gate seemed like an unfathomable giant maw, devouring all who dared to enter.
Thunderbolt Ancestor's heart secretly trembled, and after his expression underwent several changes from cloudy to clear, he still chose to move forward and enter the city.
...
Wan Qi Hong traversed the Flame Mountain Range, where there were no attacks by demon beasts. However, the scorching high temperatures in the air could ignite everything, and many rocks melted into magma.
As Wan Qi Hong traveled through, his body shimmered with a faint golden light, completely insulating him from the searing heat, unaffected in the slightest.
The Flame Mountain Range soon came to an end, with a hilly area appearing in front, where a towering city, also Yin Capital City, stood, the situation identical to what Yuan Ming and Thunderbolt Ancestor had encountered.
When Wan Qi Hong saw the stele near the city gate, his expression barely changed; after pausing briefly, he directly flew into the city gate, smashing the ruined gate to pieces.
...
Su Zimo, accompanied by a golden-haired, blue-eyed young man, passed through a forest filled with toxic poison miasma, and a Yin Capital City appeared in front of them too.
...
Upon entering Yin Capital City, both Yuan Ming and Yan Sijing's expressions changed.
The entire city was shrouded in an invisible force, severely impacting their Divine Sense, which could only extend a few yards from their bodies.
Not only that, but this invisible force was also coupled with a peculiar Forbidden Space Power.
Yan Sijing conjured a gourd Magic Artifact, attempting to soar into the sky, only to immediately feel an overwhelming pressure descending from above. The higher she flew, the greater the pressure became.
Even with Yan Sijing's Core Formation Stage strength, she could only ascend thirty feet before she could no longer bear it and was pressed down.
"It seems the master of the Immortal Mansion doesn't want us flying high and overlooking the entire city," Yan Sijing exhaled softly and said.
Yuan Ming's mind stirred as he attempted to release his first soul from his body to see if it could ascend into the sky.
However, the city's invisible restrictions greatly affected the Divine Soul Power, and the soul splitting, being formed of Soul Power, was likewise unable to leave his body.
His heart sank; if Divine Sense couldn't leave the body and soul splitting was the same, then the soul crows were out of the question.
So, his most powerful Illusion Technique was almost rendered useless.
Yuan Ming was somewhat unwilling to give up; he tried to activate the Night Parade of Hundred Demons, and a red ghost creature with the head of a human and the body of a bird appeared out of thin air. It was another Core Formation Stage ghost creature he had just subdued in the valley, very similar to the legendary Gu Huoniao.
As soon as the Gu Huoniao appeared, it immediately spread its wings and flew towards the sky without using any mana.
Yuan Ming wanted to see if the city's invisible restrictions would be triggered without the use of mana.
However, as soon as the Gu Huoniao rose thirty feet, it too was battered back down by a powerful force.
Yuan Ming furrowed his brows and propelled the Soul Destroying Sword forward, flying a distance without feeling any pressure.
"It seems lateral flying is unimpeded," he breathed a sigh of relief.
Magic Treasures could fly laterally, and normal combat wasn't affected, so the situation wasn't entirely hopeless.
"No matter what, let's first explore every part of the city to see if we can find that so-called secret treasure," Yuan Ming retracted the Soul Destroying Sword and proceeded forward.
He didn't recall the Gu Huoniao to the Night Parade of Hundred Demons, letting it fly half a yard above his head.
Yan Sijing activated her Magic Treasure for protection, walking side by side with Yuan Ming.
The two quickly walked through several streets without detecting anything unusual. Yan Sijing, attentive to detail, entered the buildings along the streets to search several times, but still came up empty-handed.
The city truly seemed to be just an ordinary one, with bricks and tiles made of mundane materials, not containing any hint of Spiritual Power.
"Yin Capital City is quite large, and with our Divine Sense unable to spread out, searching like this will take who knows how long to cover everything. Let's search separately," Yuan Ming suggested.
"This... the city looks peaceful for now, but who knows if there's any danger. It's better to stick together, we can just search slowly," Yan Sijing hesitated.
"Alright, I'll let a few ghosts go to search first," Yuan Ming nodded, sent the Gu Huoniao ahead, and released Fang Youting, Heavenly Ghost Wanderer, and several other ghosts in different directions.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan excels at rearing ghosts? These few Yin Ghosts all have Core Formation Stage strength. In Zhao Country's Immortal Cultivation World, there are sects proficient in rearing ghosts, but they only rear Qi Refinement and Foundation Establishment Stage little ghosts, far inferior to Fellow Daoist Yuan. I'm truly impressed," Yan Sijing said half-flatteringly, half-probingly.
Yuan Ming smiled noncommittally, just as he was about to say something else, his expression suddenly darkened.
"What's wrong?" Yan Sijing quickly asked, noticing his change in demeanor.
"The ghosts have suddenly vanished," Yuan Ming said gravely, heading in the direction Heavenly Ghost Wanderer had taken.
Yan Sijing hurriedly followed.
The two quickly turned a corner and a broad street appeared before them. Based on Yuan Ming's last sense, Heavenly Ghost Wanderer had flown here before suddenly vanishing.
Yuan Ming arrived at the last known position of Heavenly Ghost Wanderer and examined the area carefully but found nothing.
His expression grew solemn. The Heavenly Ghost Wanderer had been absorbing Ghost Miasma along the way, and its strength had largely recovered. If he were to face it in combat, it would not be easy to win, yet it disappeared without a trace.
What troubled him even more was that the other ghost slaves had also disappeared in the same silent fashion, a feat not even Nascent Soul cultivators might achieve.
This was truly too eerie!

chapters.title: Chapter 394 - 371: Phantom Kill
chapters.content:
The only relief for Yuan Ming was that the marks of the Ghost Slaves such as the Heavenly Ghost Wanderer were still present in the Night Parade of Hundred Demons, indicating that the ghosts hadn't been killed but were somehow restrained.
"This Yin Capital City is truly bizarre, and continuing to search may lead to more strange encounters. Why don't we retreat for now and see if others will come looking for us, and then explore together?" Yan Sijing's complexion wasn't looking good as she suggested.
Yuan Ming weighed the options briefly in his mind before finally nodding in agreement.
The two retraced their steps, running towards the city gates.
However, after walking through several blocks, not to mention reaching the gate, the tall city walls were still in the distance, not appearing any closer.
Yan Sijing's complexion turned slightly pale, and it was obvious that the scene before her exceeded her understanding. Had Yuan Ming not been by her side, she might have collapsed mentally.
"What's happening? Could it be that I'm under some illusion?" Yuan Ming pinched his fingers to cast a Soul-shocking Secret Technique.
With his current level of Soul Power, the effect of casting the Soul-shocking Secret Technique was incomparable to before. His Soul Pill and the Divine Soul within violently trembled, yet the surroundings remained unchanged, without any difference.
This meant that he probably hadn't fallen under any illusion, nor was he in any sort of illusionary realm.
This was odd.
Yuan Ming looked around briefly, then instead of continuing along the street, he levitated and flew low towards the city walls.
The houses below rapidly receded, and after flying for about a quarter of an hour, the tall city wall was still in the distance with no sense of it getting closer.
Yuan Ming stopped his tunneling light, stood in place, and fell silent.
Although he didn't know the specifics of the weirdness in Yin Capital City, he obviously had fallen into some special type of illusion.
But what kind of illusion was it? Even with his current proficiency in Illusion Techniques, he couldn't detect the slightest clue.
Just at that moment, Yan Sijing caught up from behind, landed beside him, and said with a bitter voice, "Fellow Daoist Yuan, it seems we have both fallen victim to the enemy's tricks. I fear it's difficult to leave this place today."
"Indeed," Yuan Ming said without turning his head, as suddenly a streak of black sword light shot out from under his rib, piercing through Yan Sijing's chest.
Yan Sijing was sent flying, crashing into a nearby wall, her face filled with shock and anger.
"Yuan Ming, what are you doing?"
Yuan Ming's expression was emotionless; his arm trembled slightly.
The Soul Destroying Sword swept out horizontally, and Yan Sijing's head flew off in a flash, yet no blood spurted out.
Yan Sijing's body suddenly split open, turning into a large cloud of Blood Mist, instantly engulfing an area of tens of feet.
Yuan Ming was also enveloped by the Blood Mist, his eyes painfully hot, unable to see anything.
A Blood Shadow shot out from the Blood Mist, heading straight for Yuan Ming.
Before the Blood Shadow even arrived, Yuan Ming's Essence Blood began to boil, nearly bursting out of his body to merge into the Blood Shadow.
Suddenly, several Purple-black Vines shot out from his Spiritual Beast Bag around his waist, piercing into the Blood Shadow, and Hua Zhi's figure also appeared from the Spiritual Beast Bag.
The Purple-black Vines quickly withered, as if the nutrients inside were being drained by the Blood Shadow, but they managed to entangle the Blood Shadow, stopping its advance.
Vajra also flew out of another Spiritual Beast Bag, simultaneously clapping his hands while still in mid-air.
The air in front of the Blood Shadow exploded repeatedly, generating powerful airwaves that sent the Blood Shadow flying backward.
Yuan Ming flew out from the Blood Mist, activating the Curse Rune inside the Soul Destroying Sword, sending a force of Curse Power breaking through the air and infiltrating into the Blood Shadow.
The Blood Shadow emitted a piercing scream, flying back as bursts of Blood Light spread out, seeming to suffer extreme damage, frantically fleeing into the distance, and disappearing in the blink of an eye.
Yuan Ming infused Mana into his eyes, and his vision slowly recovered; he looked in the direction the Blood Shadow had fled, pondering.
"Master, how did you know that Yan Sijing just now wasn't real? I can devour others' Mana and demon energy, and am very sensitive to auras, but I didn't notice anything wrong with that Yan Sijing," Hua Zhi asked curiously.
"Yan Sijing has my Second Split Soul inside her, but the aura of that Yan Sijing just now, although convincing, lacked the Split Soul, so I instantly recognized it," Yuan Ming said softly.
"I see, but what exactly is going on with this Yin Capital City? Those ghosts of yours have disappeared, and now Yan Sijing is also nowhere to be seen; don't tell me, in a while, both I and that stinky monkey will disappear into thin air," Hua Zhi said worriedly.
"That won't happen," Yuan Ming assured her.
"Why not?" This time, it was Vajra who was curious.
"Both the Ghost Slaves and Yan Sijing disappeared only after moving a certain distance away from me. As long as you don't stray too far from me, you should be fine," Yuan Ming explained.
"It does seem to be the case," Hua Zhi recalled the recent situation and said.
"Moreover, my Ghost Slaves and Yan Sijing haven't actually disappeared. I can sense that the Second Split Soul is not too far from me, indicating Yan Sijing is still within Yin Capital City, just invisible to us. The same probably applies to those Ghost Slaves," Yuan Ming said, closing his eyes.
Currently, Yan Sijing was wandering down a street, her face full of panic, pale as paper.
Just as Yuan Ming flew off into the distance, she was a step too late in following; by the time she looked up, Yuan Ming had already vanished.
Without Yuan Ming by her side, panic had already overwhelmed Yan Sijing's heart.
However, having faced dangers recently, her temperament had been tempered, and she hadn't truly collapsed but instead forced herself to calm down and ventured forward alone.
...
A woman in a green robe was sprinting down a street, none other than the Core Formation stage female cultivator accompanying Thunderbolt Ancestor.
Her face etched with panic, she occasionally glanced back as if something terrifying was chasing her.
The street quickly came to an end, a large building loomed ahead, appearing to be a garden. Through the gate, one could see the dense forest inside.
Overjoyed, the woman in green practiced the wood attribute cultivation method and had a secret technique that allowed her to conceal her tracks amidst the dense forests, so she immediately darted into it.
This indeed was a garden, filled with pavilions, towers, small bridges, and flowing water. However, due to years of neglect, it was overgrown with weeds, and the wood attribute spiritual power was exceptionally vigorous.
The woman in green felt slightly relieved and immediately headed towards a colorful garden.
Just at that moment, the flowers in the garden suddenly twisted, all turning towards the woman in green. From within the blossoms, pairs of blood-red eyes emerged, staring intently at her.
The woman in green was terrified, she took out a green feather fan and waved it fiercely.
A gust of green wind swept across, mixed with large and small wind blades; in the blink of an eye, it sliced the surrounding flowers into pieces, wiping them out completely.
However, before she could catch her breath, she felt the solid ground beneath her feet become loose, and her legs quickly sank into the ground.
Greatly alarmed, the woman in green immediately tried to leap into the air, but her legs were firmly gripped by the ground, an astonishing suction force emanating from below.
With a scream, her whole body was instantly swallowed by the ground.
The ground undulated for a moment, as if chewing on something, and soon returned to calm.
A bunch of plants rapidly grew, and within a few breaths, they formed a lush garden once again.Chaptersource:MyVirtualLibraryEmpire(*).
...
At this moment, Wan Qi Hong stood in front of a large mansion with a darkly hued façade, its door adorned with a dusty plaque bearing the words "City Lord Mansion."
A fleeting smile crossed his expressionless face. With a flick of his finger, a beam of golden light hit the door, which was already rotten, immediately blasting it to pieces.
He stepped inside, but the next moment, he found himself in the middle of the street, several meters away.
Wan Qi Hong was slightly taken aback, then he spat out a beam of golden light, wrapping around his body as he soared over the walls of the City Lord Mansion and flew directly inside.
Yet, as the golden light flashed through the center of the street, Wan Qi Hong's figure once again appeared out of thin air.
"Spatial displacement restriction?" Wan Qi Hong frowned, pondering how to break the restriction.
Just then, a blood-colored ghost shadow slowly appeared behind Wan Qi Hong, who, despite his cultivation, was completely unaware of it.
The blood-colored ghost shadow slowly opened its mouth, revealing sharp and ferocious fangs, and viciously bit towards Wan Qi Hong's neck.
...
In a deserted residential area of Yin Capital City, a man in white from Guiyuan Sect was manipulating a Purple Wheel Treasure, spewing a column of scorching purple flame towards an old well.
The mouth of the well flickered with a faint white light, forming a white screen that made the already pale face of the man appear even paler; through the screen, one could clearly see a bright blue light floating at the bottom of the well.
Under the impact of the purple flame column, the white screen trembled violently and quickly thinned, shattering in moments.
The man in white retracted his Purple Wheel Treasure and released a red light to retrieve the blue light from the bottom of the well.
The blue light quickly extinguished, revealing a translucent blue treasure bead emanating astonishing spiritual energy waves.
"What a treasure!" The man in white greedily caressed the bead, unwilling to let it go.
"Is that so? Since you think so, why don't you get closer and acquainted with this bead?" A mocking voice sounded.
The translucent blue bead suddenly turned blood red and transformed into a mist of blood, disappearing instantly as it merged into the body of the man in white, too quick for the eyes to follow.
The man in white's body rapidly shriveled, his face showing an expression of immense terror.
A few breaths later, the man in white had turned into a desiccated husk, falling to the ground.
All his flesh had disappeared from the husk, leaving only a layer of shriveled dead skin clinging to the skeletal frame, even the bones were covered in cracks, seemingly drained of all moisture.
"Such little Qi-Blood, truly unsatisfying," the voice sounded again from the blood-colored orb as it flew out from the corpse of the man in white, seemingly unsatisfied.
"Oh, what rich Qi-Blood, this must belong to someone with an Innate Body engaging in Body Cultivation!" the Blood Pearl suddenly shifted direction and shot off towards a new target.
...
"What do we do next? Continue searching?" Hua Zhi looked towards Yuan Ming and asked.
"I have a better idea, it might work, follow me," Yuan Ming dashed towards a distant white mansion.
According to the sensations from his second split soul, Yan Sijing was currently within this white mansion. However, no matter how he searched, he could not detect any trace of Yan Sijing, evidently, her presence had been concealed by the illusion technique restrictions within the city.
Similarly, for Yan Sijing who was just a wall away and not too far from Yuan Ming, his existence was also concealed.

chapters.title: Chapter 395 - 372 Reunion
chapters.content:
"You two, protect me," Yuan Ming instructed Vajra and Hua Zhi as he once again conjured three yellow banners, forming a circle of yellow light around him.
He summoned the Stealing Heaven Tripod and suspended it in front of him, channeling his Divine Sense into it.
Immediately after, his vision blurred, and he found himself within the space of the Stealing Heaven Tripod. With a leap, he landed on the White Jade Lotus Platform, attempting to survey the situation inside the Immortal Mansion.
However, without the Desire Power of believers as a link, the Stealing Heaven Tripod could not see into the Immortal Mansion.
"As expected, fortunately I made preparations in advance," Yuan Ming thought to himself, closing his eyes to try and establish communication with his Second Split Soul.
Within the white mansion, Yan Sijing was seated cross-legged in a room, practicing Breathing Control, when suddenly a voice sounded in her Sea of Consciousness.
"It's me, Fellow Daoist Yan."
"Yuan Ming! Where are you now? How are you able to send me a message?" Yan Sijing asked with great joy, hastily inquiring.
"This is a Divine Skill bestowed upon me by Lord Nether Moon God, allowing me to communicate briefly with other Divine Envoys and believers within a certain range, undeterred by any Forbidden restrictions," Yuan Ming explained.
"Oh, is that so? What should I do next?" Yan Sijing asked, clearly skeptical of Yuan Ming's words.
"Inside Yin Capital City, it's too dangerous. If this continues, we may both perish here. Our only hope now lies with Lord Nether Moon God," Yuan Ming continued without further explanation.
At this moment, Yan Sijing felt somewhat at a loss, and having already harbored some allegiance, her eyes lit up upon hearing him, but she quickly calmed down and asked, "As a Divine Envoy of Nether Moon God, you can seek help from Lord Nether Moon God at any time. Why inform me? Do you need me to do something?"
"Fellow Daoist Yan, you are wise indeed. I am currently praying to Lord Nether Moon God, but the restrictions within Yin Capital City are formidable, and my prayers have failed to draw the attention of Nether Moon God. Join me!" Yuan Ming said.
After a moment's hesitation, Yan Sijing still began to practice with her Magic Treasure to protect her surroundings, sat down cross-legged, and prayed sincerely to the Nether Moon God.
Within the space of the Stealing Heaven Tripod, a powerful burst of Desire Power transmitted over, originating from Yan Sijing.
Yuan Ming's face lit up with joy, and immediately using this Desire Power as an anchor point, he projected his Divine Sense.
With the support of the Stealing Heaven Tripod, Yuan Ming's Divine Sense easily pierced through the Forbidden restrictions of Yin Capital City and saw Yan Sijing's situation.
Yuan Ming's heart leapt with happiness. Initially, he had only wished to use the power of the Stealing Heaven Tripod to probe the Illusion Technique Restraints inside the Immortal Mansion; he had not expected that in the face of the Stealing Heaven Tripod, the Immortal Mansion's restrictions were as good as non-existent.
At this moment, Yan Sijing was sitting cross-legged in a room in the white mansion, only a dozen or so yards away from himself.
Yuan Ming communicated with Hua Zhi, instructing it to probe that room.
Hua Zhi shot out several vines that burrowed underground into the neighboring room, but they were totally unaware of Yan Sijing's presence.
"The Illusion Technique Restraints within Yin Capital City are indeed extraordinary; while they cannot stop the Stealing Heaven Tripod, they are difficult to break through with ordinary methods," Yuan Ming privately remarked, shifting his Divine Sense's perspective to look elsewhere in Yin Capital City.
The entire city was laid bare before his eyes, with Wan Qi Hong, Thunderbolt Ancestor, Golden Dawn Fairy, and others all present within Yin Capital City.
The entire city was shrouded in a faint Black Mist at the moment; everyone was busy searching for each other, occasionally passing within an arm's length, unseen by each other, and continuing on their separate ways.
"It seems this Black Mist is the Illusion Array," Yuan Ming thought to himself.
Two spots within the Black Mist-shrouded Yin Capital City were particularly dense: one in the center of the city where the City Lord Mansion was located by its signboard, and another in the East City, which appeared to be a garden.
Streams of Black Mist emanated from the City Lord Mansion, running through all the streets of the city, eventually converging in the garden of the East City. The city's streets seemed like the Array Patterns of a Formation.
Yuan Ming observed the Black Mist in the city attentively, his brows suddenly knitting together.
A streak of Blood Light shot from afar, speeding toward the location of Vajra and Hua Zhi with extraordinary swiftness.
"Eh! This aura of Blood Light is very similar to the Blood Shadow that attacked me earlier, and it is unaffected by the Black Mist's Illusion Array. Something's odd about this Blood Light," Yuan Ming mused and, with a flip of his hand, he conjured his Soul Destroying Sword, activating the Curse Rune.
With his current Divine Soul Power driving the Soul Destroying Sword, its might was completely different from before.
A powerful Curse burst forth from the space of the Stealing Heaven Tripod, striking the incoming Blood Light.
A shrill scream echoed from within the Blood Light as all of it collapsed, revealing a Blood-colored Orb the size of an egg.
A human face emerged within the Orb, its expression full of pain and rage as it bellowed, "It's you! The one with the Black Sword just now. Have the guts to show yourself!"
Yuan Ming gave a cold smile and raised the Soul Destroying Sword, making a feint in the air.
A thick Black Sword Qi appeared out of the void above the Orb, stabbing toward it.
The face within the Orb roared, its body emitting ten thousand rays of Blood Light that instantaneously formed a substantial Blood Barrier, appearing extremely sturdy.
Grass and trees within the boundary of the Barrier instantly withered, while stones and wood became completely dry, their moisture sucked out in a flash.
Unfortunately, Soul Destroying Sword Energy is stimulated by Soul Power, and even when it was still a Magic Artifact, it could penetrate protective shields formed by mana. Now that it has advanced to a Magical Treasure, it's even less likely to be blocked by ordinary means.
With a flash of black Sword Qi, it pierced through the Blood Barrier and entered the blood-colored orb.
The face within the orb was split in half, emitting a death rattle as it completely dissipated into smoke and thin air.
The blood-colored orb, having lost all its power, dropped to the ground with a "clatter".
