Yuan Ming was taken aback; his original intention was to injure the face within the blood-colored orb and then use the Soul Searching Technique to probe its details. He hadn't expected that with the power of the Stealing Heaven Tripod bolstering it, the Soul Destroying Sword's power would greatly increase, directly slaying the blood-colored face.
That blood-colored orb lay quietly on the ground, emitting a faint blood light. It seemed to have been damaged due to the shadowy face being slain.
This orb seemed extraordinary and was likely a powerful Magic Treasure; it shouldn't be discarded carelessly.
Yuan Ming invoked his Divine Sense, pouring it into the blood-colored orb, then suddenly froze in place.
Inside the blood-colored orb, there was only a single huge rune. However, a strong blood vortex swirled around the rune, roaring as it spun, bursting with an astonishing aura that was no less than the black cane with seven runes owned by the Heavenly Ghost wanderer.
"Only one rune, yet its aura is so powerful?" Yuan Ming, who was also well-versed in Artifact Refining, had never heard of such a phenomenon.
Unable to understand, he didn't ponder it further. He remotely cast the Exorcism Technique, tossing the blood-colored orb beside Hua Zhi and Vajra.
"What is this?" Hua Zhi asked, wrapping her vines around the orb.
"This orb seems to have the effect of absorbing Essence Blood, which is quite similar to your abilities. Moreover, there is only one rune inside the orb that you should be able to activate. For the time being, keep it and use it," Yuan Ming's voice appeared in Hua Zhi's mind.
"Thank you, Master." Hua Zhi, who was in dire need of a powerful Magic Treasure, quickly gave her thanks and injected her demonic power into the blood-colored orb.
Bright blood light immediately illuminated from the orb, proving that she could indeed activate it.
Hua Zhi was secretly delighted and absorbed the blood-colored orb into her body to refine it with her demonic power.
Yuan Ming withdrew his Divine Sense and continued to investigate the Black Mist Illusion Array within Yin Capital City. However, his expertise in formations was too shallow, and after a long observation, he couldn't find any clue.
"Forget it, I'll ask for her help." Yuan Ming's gaze shifted and landed on a black-robed person in the city, who was the Loose Cultivator from the Black Desert Alliance that had entered Ghost Miasma Canyon with him.
The first soul shot out from Yuan Ming's Sea of Consciousness, falling towards the black-robed person with the power of the Stealing Heaven Tripod, and disappeared into the body in a flash.
The black-robed person suddenly stopped walking, as if detecting the intrusion of the first soul. A burst of Golden Light shone from their forehead, and a swirl of Golden Flames enveloped the first soul.
This Golden Flames possessed the power to burn Divine Souls, causing the first soul to suffer intense pain as its Soul Power rapidly evaporated.
"Stop it, Xi Ying, it's me!" Yuan Ming quickly controlled the first soul to speak.
Brought to you by the folks at *.
The terrifying Golden Flames instantly subsided, and a trace of surprise flashed in the black-robed person's eyes. Then, they slowly pulled down the black veil covering their face, revealing an exceptionally delicate face. It was none other than the long-missed Xi Ying.
"Where are you? How can you see my true face?" She looked around curiously.
"There's no need to look. I'm in another place in Yin Capital City, not near you. Currently, I can only communicate with you briefly through the power of the Stealing Heaven Tripod and the Soul Splitting Skill. As for your identity, you used an Illusion Technique to subdue my Ghost Slave, which is exactly the same as what was used during the great battle that wiped out the sect in Biluo Cave years ago. I might mistake other people's techniques, but how could I possibly not recognize yours?" Yuan Ming said with a smile.
His words were true, as he indeed had recognized Xi Ying through the Illusion Technique earlier.
However, he wasn't completely certain, which is why he had waved three small flags to open a protective shield and used Black Incense Possession on Xi Ying, to confirm the identity of the person in the black robe. And as he suspected, the possession had indeed taken place on the black-robed person.
"Hmph, you're somewhat clever. I thought that you'd be completely smitten with that girl from Five Thunder Sect and wouldn't be thinking straight," Xi Ying huffed.
"Are you talking about Yan Sijing? I have no relationship with that woman, just some entanglements of interest," Yuan Ming began to explain his relationship with Yan Sijing in detail, including the incident with the Stealing Heaven Tripod and the Moon God Sect, omitting only the recent use of the Stealing Heaven Tripod to possess Xi Ying.
As Xi Ying listened, the coldness in her eyes gradually faded, yet her expression remained unchanged.
"I didn't acknowledge you when Yan Sijing was nearby. Why did you come here, and why are you accompanying a member of the Black Desert Alliance?" Yuan Ming inquired.
"I have many reasons for coming here, and we can talk about them in detail later," Xi Ying said after a moment of silence.
"Fine," Yuan Ming nodded.
"And you? Did you really come to this Immortal Mansion by accident?" Xi Ying asked.
"It was truly an accident, but there might have been other factors involved…" Yuan Ming briefly recounted his encounter with the Heavenly Ghost wanderer, not hiding any details about the Night Parade of Hundred Demons or the fact that the wanderer was from the Wu Yue Sect.
"That Heavenly Ghost wanderer doesn't seem like an ordinary wanderer. Choosing to live beneath the Soul Burying Abyss, and after I killed him, this Immortal Mansion emerged immediately. There could be some connection between the two," he speculated openly in front of Xi Ying.
"Let's not worry about that. Do you have the Night Parade of Hundred Demons? That's great!" Xi Ying's face lit up with joy.

chapters.title: Chapter 396 - 396: 373 Chapter: Clearing the Clouds to See the Sun
chapters.content:
"Xi Ying, do you know about this Magic Treasure?" Yuan Ming's eyes flickered with a trace of surprise as he asked.
"I know a little. The Night Parade of Hundred Demons is said to be the Lifebound Magical Treasure refined by a legendary Loose Cultivator known as the Shura Master more than three thousand years ago. Its power is enormous, far beyond that of ordinary Magic Treasures. Keep it safe; it will be of great use to you in the future." Xi Ying glanced at Yuan Ming and said.
"This Shura Master is indeed an enigmatic person." Yuan Ming had never heard of this individual, and he vaguely felt that there was more to Xi Ying's words than met the eye.
However, since Xi Ying did not elaborate, he did not press further.
"You've suddenly contacted me; is there something you wish to discuss?" Xi Ying asked again.
"With the power of the Stealing Heaven Tripod, I was able to see clearly the situation within Yin Capital City. The entire city is shrouded in Black Mist, the mist flows as if it contains certain Forbidden changes..." Yuan Ming carefully told Xi Ying about the situation within the city, and even drew a map of the Black Mist's movements and the street layout, giving it to Xi Ying.
"Based on this map, the movement of the Black Mist is indeed some sort of Formation, and this Array is not complicated. By destroying a few nodes, you can break the illusion Array within the city," Xi Ying said with a hint of joy after a brief contemplation.
"It's good that you can see through the mystery of the Black Mist's operation." Yuan Ming sighed in relief.
He had sought to consult with Xi Ying in hopes of leveraging her Array Formation Cultivation to break the city's illusions. If Xi Ying couldn't see through the Black Mist Formation, that would be troublesome.
Xi Ying closed her eyes, seemingly deducing the changes in the Black Mist Formation. Yuan Ming quietly waited without disturbing her.
A few moments later, she opened her eyes.
"How is it?" Yuan Ming immediately asked.
"Time is limited, so I've only deduced most of it—but it should be enough. We just need to destroy these three nodes at the same time, and the Array will fall," said Xi Ying as she took out a blank Jade Scroll, drew the Black Mist Formation on it, and marked three locations.
Yuan Ming memorized them firmly and quickly deduced the positions of the three nodes based on the Array Map Xi Ying had drawn. None of them were too far from him.
"Guide me to one of the nodes. I'll take responsibility for one, and you'll take care of the other two," Xi Ying patted her hands and said.
Yuan Ming then directed Xi Ying towards the nearest node to her, while he and Vajra separately went to the other two nodes.
As the three nodes were destroyed one after another, the Black Mist Formation that pervaded the entire city trembled violently like ripples on water, and after a dozen breaths, it collapsed with a booming sound.
Yuan Ming saw ripples in the void before him, which then returned to normal.
He had now left the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space and could no longer see the Black Mist inside the city, yet he could sense that the intangible Forbidden throughout the city had dissipated significantly. The illusion had likely been lifted, and the city's restrictions on flying had weakened considerably, greatly increasing the range of his Divine Sense when it left his body.
"What just happened? Something seems to have dissipated?" Other people in the city also keenly perceived something unusual.
Yan Sijing was praying devoutly and didn't notice the changes around her.
After a little while, she slowly opened her eyes.Brought to you by *.
Despite her long prayers, the Nether Moon God had not responded, and she wasn't sure if her prayers had been effective.
Just then, footsteps sounded from outside. Yan Sijing quickly got up and walked out of the room, only to see Yuan Ming standing at the entrance of the mansion.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan? Is it really you?"
Seeing Yuan Ming, Yan Sijing hesitated for a moment, seemingly wary of approaching.
"Miss Yan, rest assured, the illusion Array here has been broken by Lord Nether Moon God, and what you and I see now is genuine and not a facade," Yuan Ming said with a smile.
Yan Sijing, finally noticing the changes in the invisible restrictions in the void, nodded hesitantly. Yuan Ming did not rush to explain further but simply gestured for her to walk out of the mansion.
Several dark figures swiftly flew from afar. They were the Ghost Slaves that had been lost in the Illusion Array, all of which now returned.
A hint of joy appeared on Yuan Ming's face as he gathered them into the Night Parade of Hundred Demons. Yan Sijing became even more convinced by Yuan Ming's words.
Yet, Yuan Ming was not paying attention to Yan Sijing; he looked around, recalling the full view of the city he had seen through the Stealing Heaven Tripod. As he thought about recognizing the way forward, he suddenly saw a pillar of fire surging into the sky at a distance. The crimson light illuminated the entire city, the display immense, yet it seemed to lack any harmful power.
"That must be Communication Fireworks released by a senior; I wonder if it's the Golden Dawn Fairy who released them," Yuan Ming murmured to himself.
"Thunderbolt Ancestor's Divine Skills often involve thunder as a trigger; this kind of fire pillar is unlikely to be his technique," Yan Sijing said, shaking her head upon hearing this.
"Now that the illusion has disappeared and with this firework as a signal, everyone in the city will likely go to investigate. Even if it's Thunderbolt Ancestor's action, we'll be fine if we go a little later," Yuan Ming pondered and said after a moment.
Thus, the two of them returned to the white mansion to conduct a quick search, finding no Exotic Treasures or opportunities. They then set off towards the pillar of fire.
The location of the Pillar of Fire was situated in the midst of a plaza; when Yuan Ming and another arrived, they found that four Nascent Soul Stage powerhouses had already gathered. Besides them, there were also four Core Formation cultivators present.
Behind Dugu Feng stood two in black robes, among them was Xi Ying, and behind Golden Dawn Fairy, Pi Xiu also stood with lingering fear, having seen Yuan Ming's arrival, he couldn't help but reveal a hint of joy. The golden-haired, blue-eyed man behind Su Zimo seemed indifferent to the nose and heart and showed no reaction to Yuan Ming and his companion's arrival.
On the other hand, next to Thunderbolt Ancestor, there wasn't even a Core Formation cultivator; when he saw that one of the two new arrivals was from his own, his face initially lit up with pleasure, but upon realizing it was Yan Sijing, and she was accompanied by Yuan Ming, his expression immediately soured.
Yan Sijing, sensing the possible anger from Thunderbolt Ancestor, immediately lowered her head and without a word, left Yuan Ming's side and quickly walked behind Thunderbolt Ancestor.
Yuan Ming, knowing the woman's current predicament was awkward, did not mind her behavior and quietly took a stand behind Golden Dawn Fairy.
Soon after Yuan Ming, a Core Formation stout man in black robes also hurried over; seeing that the first to arrive were his own Core Formation subordinates, Dugu Feng let out a loud laugh and gave a smug look towards the other three.
Thunderbolt Ancestor's face darkened a bit again, and Su Zimo's expression also turned blank, while only Golden Dawn Fairy exchanged pleasantries with Dugu Feng, complimenting the strength of his underlings.
Following that, another female cultivator under Thunderbolt Ancestor and Wen Zaihou arrived late. Seeing Thunderbolt Ancestor's gloomy face, the female cultivator immediately tensed, and like Yan Sijing, silently left Wen Zaihou's side and stood behind Thunderbolt Ancestor.
Wen Zaihou shook his head as if in regret and then took a place next to Yuan Ming.
Afterward, the cultivators waited for a while longer; seeing no other Core Formation cultivator come forth, Thunderbolt Ancestor's originally grim face eased quite a bit, Golden Dawn Fairy let out a soft sigh, while Su Zimo's expression became somewhat unnatural.
"Alright, the rest who haven't come have probably perished by now; this cursed place is so peculiar, having only lost four Core Formation cultivators is rather fortunate for us," Dugu Feng chuckled lightly.
Su Zimo's expression couldn't help but turn grim, feeling as if those words were like a stab to his chest. He promptly changed the subject, saying,
"Fellow Daoist Wan Qi hasn't arrived yet; Then, it must have been him who broke through the restriction. I wonder how far he's gotten by now. Since everyone is here, let's hurry on over so as to avoid…"
He didn't finish his sentence when they suddenly heard Wan Qi Hong's voice coming from behind them.
"It wasn't me."
The cultivators turned their heads to look, only to see Wan Qi Hong striding forward, still wearing his proud demeanor, without a hint of dishevelment on him.
Hearing Wan Qi Hong's denial, the Nascent Soul cultivators were slightly surprised, and Thunderbolt Ancestor directly addressed him,
"Not Fellow Daoist Wan Qi? That's odd. Since it isn't one of the five of us, could it be that there is another Nascent Soul who snuck in?"
Golden Dawn Fairy also frowned and with a wave of her hand, a Golden Scroll flew into mid-air. The pages unfolded and countless golden characters floated up, soon coalescing into a mirror-like shape.
As Golden Dawn Fairy manipulated the spell with her fingers, a scene suddenly emerged within the golden mirror.
The scene showed a place within the city, a seemingly ordinary landscape. However, at the center of the image, a conspicuous charred-black mark on the ground was enveloped by a faint purple glow, appearing quite mystical.
"Thunder Skill? Old Monster Yu, among the people present, who else would use such magic? There's no need to deny it any longer," Dugu Feng said with a laugh.
"Hmph, I act openly and honorably; if I did it, I wouldn't be sneaking around. Besides, Dugu Feng, are you blind? Can't you see the power of this magic stops at Golden Core? If I made a move, would it be so weak?" Thunderbolt Ancestor responded disdainfully.
"Then it seems it must be the act of some Core Formation junior. I wonder who is so skilled that they could break through an Array that even we couldn't see through so effortlessly," Su Zimo said with a sinister smile, his gaze lingering on the Core Formation cultivators besides the blue-eyed man.
At that moment, Xi Ying, who was standing behind Dugu Feng, suddenly stepped forward.
"This was the work of the junior; I hope it brings no shame to the senior cultivators here," she said.
The group was startled, and Yuan Ming also looked at Xi Ying in surprise, not understanding why she would suddenly step forward to admit.
"Oh, right, I had forgotten that your proficiency in Arrays is quite remarkable. But to penetrate the Illusion Array in such a short time, you've done a great service. I will certainly reward you handsomely when we return to the alliance," Dugu Feng suddenly exclaimed as if he had just realized.
"Thank you for your graciousness, Alliance Hierarch," Xi Ying bowed and thanked him.
The other Nascent Soul cultivators looked at Dugu Feng, all with a curious light in their eyes. Among the Core Formation cultivators brought this time, only his subordinate had not perished, and now even an Array that the Nascent Soul cultivators could not break through had been solved by his underling. If she hadn't voluntarily stepped forward, they might have racked their brains in vain to figure out who did it.
"Heh heh, to be able to see through such a Great Array with Core Formation Stage cultivation, Brother Dugu's Black Desert Scatter Alliance indeed has an abundance of talents. No wonder it's possible to suppress so many legitimate Sects in the Northern Desert and prevent them from even lifting their heads," Su Zimo suddenly laughed.
"To each their own. My Black Desert Scatter Alliance might have plenty of talents, but it's nothing compared to your Guiyuan Sect, Brother Su, which always seems to have an endless supply of cultivators to squander. I hear that every year, in the conflicts with the Western Region, no fewer than a hundred perish, and with every fallen cultivator, their bodies always mysteriously disappear. I have no idea where they all go," Dugu Feng said with a meaningful smile.
"Brother Dugu need not concern himself with that," Su Zimo replied, unflustered and appearing not to take Dugu Feng's words to heart.
"Dugu Feng, you may be petty in your personal affairs, but I didn't expect that as the leader of an alliance, you're still not magnanimous in your actions! Such achievements should be rewarded immediately; if I were in your place, I'd bestow the reward right now. Heh heh, my friend, instead of following him, Dugu Feng, and eating dust every day, why don't you follow me back to the Five Thunder Sect? I guarantee that your path to Immortality will be unobstructed," Thunderbolt Ancestor looked at Xi Ying, his eyes flashing with an unusual fervor.

chapters.title: Chapter 397 - 374: Mystery in the Ancient Garden
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming raised his eyebrows upon hearing the words of Thunderbolt Ancestor, and noticed that Xi Ying's fists unconsciously clenched tighter, but she still suppressed her anger, silently retreated two steps, and hid behind Dugu Feng.
"Hehe, I've heard that Fellow Daoist Yu has numerous wives and concubines. Surely not all were charmed by such sweet nothings?" Golden Dawn Fairy said, half reminding and half mocking, dissatisfied with the attitude shown by Thunderbolt Ancestor.
Thunderbolt Ancestor glanced at Golden Dawn Fairy nonchalantly, just about to speak, but was interrupted by Wan Qi Hong.
"Enough, no wonder you've made no progress over these years, spending all your energy on these schemes and intrigues. Have you all forgotten what we came here for?" Wan Qi Hong said with a disdainful glance, igniting anger in each of them, yet none dared to react.
"Fellow Daoist Wan Qi is right, but I wonder how many treasures Fellow Daoist Wan Qi has found in the city so far? It would be enlightening for us to know," Su Zimo said in a sarcastic tone.
The recent fog had affected them, the Nascent Soul cultivators, though not severely, and so they had braved the forbidden areas and explored many locations. They found that despite the city's size and the abundance of buildings, the locations containing fortunes and treasures were few. Even when encountered, the items within were not appealing to beings at the Nascent Soul stage.
Moreover, many of the treasures were guarded by evil beings, whose powers were greatly enhanced under the cover of the recent fog. Even for these Nascent Soul cultivators, dealing with them proved quite troublesome, and after defeating them, they found that the treasures were only suitable for those at the Core Formation stage or below, which was frustrating, to say the least.
The reason they had gathered here instead of exploring on their own was precisely because of this discovery. Otherwise, they wouldn't have waited for any Core Formation cultivators to arrive and would have each searched for their own fortunes.
"I indeed haven't found any treasures, but I have discovered their location," Wan Qi Hong said calmly.
"Since Fellow Daoist Wan Qi has already located the treasure, why come to find us? Could it be that you've encountered some formidable restrictions?" Dugu Feng immediately understood.
"Exactly, we can enter most of the mansions throughout the city at will, but the City Lord Mansion at the heart of the city is enveloped by a space-transposing restriction. Although I have deciphered it, there's another, more formidable restriction inside that I fear I cannot break alone. We will need to join forces," Wan Qi Hong confessed.
His frankness indeed surprised the other Nascent Soul cultivators, who couldn't help but wonder what kind of restriction could force the proud Wan Qi Hong to seek help.
Thus, under Wan Qi Hong's lead, everyone immediately rushed towards the City Lord Mansion at the city's center, but as they approached the mansion, they witnessed a horrifying scene.
The street in front of the City Lord Mansion was bathed in blood. Both the ground and the walls on either side were painted a deep red, marked with countless sword scars, each bearing ominous intents that alarmed Thunderbolt Ancestor and the others. Although no corpses or remains were visible, the scene vividly illustrated the fierce battle Wan Qi Hong had experienced here.
However, when they looked at Wan Qi Hong, they saw his face remained calm, his clothing untouched by any blood, recalling his nonchalant demeanor upon arrival, which raised their vigilance.
Wan Qi Hong's strength might be greater than they had imagined.
The main gate of the City Lord Mansion was already shattered by Wan Qi Hong, but looking through the door, the inside appeared eerily dark. Even though the fog had dispersed, they couldn't see anything inside, and their released Divine Sense vanished as quickly as if sinking into the sea.
Seeing this, everyone felt a slight shock, yet Wan Qi Hong fearlessly walked into the City Lord Mansion right before their eyes.
His figure quickly disappeared into the darkness, vanishing from their sight, without even a sound being heard.
Seeing this, Thunderbolt Ancestor and the other Nascent Soul cultivators no longer hesitated and led their followers into the City Lord Mansion, following Wan Qi Hong.
However, when Golden Dawn Fairy was about to lead Pi Xiu and Wen Zaihou inside, she noticed Yuan Ming still standing in place after taking a few steps, showing no intention of following.
"Yuan, why aren't you entering?"
"Thank you for your concern, Senior Golden Dawn. It's just that I know my strength is meager. I've had some difficulty dealing with the evil beings in this city. Hearing what Senior Wan Qi said, this City Lord Mansion is said to contain heavy treasures. I stumbled into this place by mistake, and now I do not wish to risk my life further. Please forgive me and allow me to rest at the door until everything settles down. Then I shall leave with you," Yuan Ming bowed and said.
Visit My Virtual Library Empire (*) for more.
Golden Dawn Fairy saw his earnest and sincere expression, nodded without insisting, and after giving a couple of warnings, she led Pi Xiu and Wen Zaihou inside the City Lord Mansion.
As Yuan Ming watched Golden Dawn Fairy enter the City Lord Mansion, he waited silently for a moment. Seeing no one emerge from the mansion, he quickly turned around and dashed towards East City.
When the Illusion Array was intact, two areas in the city where Black Mist gathered were the City Lord Mansion as the source and the East City Garden as the return spot, forming head and tail, causing the Black Mist to shuttle incessantly through the city.
Now with the fog dispersed, Yuan had observed before leaving the Stealing Heaven Tripod that both places had shown a faint flash of spirit light, but it had quickly faded, unnoticed by others.
With five Nascent Soul cultivators gathered, even if the fortunes inside the City Lord Mansion were tempting, it would be immensely difficult for Yuan to have a share. It would only invite unnecessary trouble and potentially fatal danger. It might be better to take advantage of the interval and search the East City Garden. Even if the treasure found were of a lower tier, it would be safer than trying to snatch the spoils from a tiger's mouth.
The road to East City was unobstructed, possibly due to the dissipation of the Black Mist, the evil spirits hiding in the streets and residences seemed to have gone deeper. As Yuan Ming walked along, he encountered no obstacles.
Soon after, Yuan Ming arrived in the garden. Entering the garden, he saw aged trees everywhere, leaves whirling in the wind, and weeds growing rampant, with pavilions and terraces showing signs of heavy dilapidation and desolation.
Before stepping onto the Immortal Path, Yuan Ming was obsessed with ink landscape paintings and had some insights into garden construction. Surveying the garden landscape, although covered with weeds and withered leaves, he could faintly discern its former glory, which inevitably made him sigh with regret.
However, after a moment of emotion, Yuan Ming immediately summoned the Bronze Small Tripod to protect his body, without letting his guard down.
Wherever flora thrive and humans haven't ventured in a long while, shade accumulates and becomes a gathering place for spirits. The formation that once shrouded the entire city also took advantage of this fact, choosing this location as a gathering place for the Black Mist.
Unlike the City Lord Mansion, which also served as a gathering place for the Black Mist but was protected by forbidden arrays, this place had no such defenses to prevent entry.
Yuan Ming remained cautious, then slowly began exploring the garden.
The garden was structured in a circular layout. Green trees and blooming flowers encircled the central lake, and it was broadly divided into four areas: a lush green forest right past the main entrance, a rocky area with stacked artificial mountains to the left, and a brightly colored, flower-filled area to the right.
If he were to go straight, he could cross a bridge over the pond to a small island. Bypassing the island and moving forward, he would find a dark three-story pavilion standing quietly as if watching those who entered the garden, instilling a faint chill in onlookers.
Although the mist had dispersed, the invisible force blocking Divine Sense still existed. Without the aid of the "Stealing Heaven Tripod," Yuan Ming could not penetrate the veil and had to rely on his naked eyes and Divine Sense, floating a few feet from his body, to observe the surroundings.
The garden didn't lie in just any wilderness; the sky above bore no sun or moon yet was faintly illuminated.
Yet, as Yuan Ming stepped into the forest, underneath the dense canopy of branches and leaves, shadows enveloped his body, swallowing the faint light and leaving only darkness behind.
Silence surrounded him, broken only by the rustling of wind through the treetops, reminiscent of venomous snakes hissing in the dark, hissing at Yuan Ming.
Suddenly, Yuan Ming felt an inexplicable chill crawl over his body, as if he were being watched by someone. He looked around, but aside from the swaying shadows of the trees, he could see nothing.
His pace gradually slowed, the Bronze Small Tripod continuously spinning around his body, and after a long while, no evil spirit attacked.
Meanwhile, as he delved deeper, there appeared around him numerous spirit woods of considerable age. Yuan Ming took out his White Bone Knife and used his mana to gather them.
Soon, Yuan Ming reached the edge of the forest, adjacent to the central lake. There, the trees were sparse except for a solitary, strong ancient pine standing alone in front of the pier, its branches swaying in the breeze as if they were waving arms gesturing to Yuan Ming.
Seeing the intense Spiritual Energy on the ancient pine, Yuan Ming's eyes sharpened, and he immediately flicked his finger, sending the White Bone Knife chopping towards the trunk.
After a crisp sound, a hack appeared on the trunk of the ancient pine, but the tree only shook for a moment from the cut before becoming still again.
However, Yuan Ming did not ease up and continued to drive the White Bone Knife with accelerated chops.
As the chopping increased in speed, the crisp sounds continuously linked together, eerily resembling the screams of mortals, chilling to the bone.
When the trunk of the ancient pine was nearly severed, the tree could no longer support its heavy body and began to slowly fall toward the direction in which Yuan Ming was standing.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming instantly dodged to the side and then heard a sound resembling a sigh of relief as the ancient pine completely fell over, shaking a few times before settling completely still.
Yuan Ming waited a moment to see if there were any anomalies, then slowly exhaled, raised his hand to wipe, and gathered the pine stump along with its roots.
From the tree rings of the ancient pine, it was over two thousand years old, and the intensity of Spiritual Energy within it almost qualified it as a top-tier spiritual material.
However, after gathering the ancient pine, Yuan Ming couldn't help but feel a flicker of doubt. Most treasures in this place were guarded by evil spirits, yet this ancient pine stood alone unguarded, which seemed highly peculiar.
Yuan Ming pondered as his gaze followed the pier forward, seeing a pavilion on Lake Heart Island surrounded by lush vegetation but devoid of tree shadows. He thought for a moment and then suddenly turned and retraced his steps.

chapters.title: Chapter 398 - 375 Quick Battle Quick Decision
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming did not intend to leave just yet by doubling back. Instead, he wanted to check out the other two areas before making any plans.
Before long, Yuan Ming arrived in front of a garden bursting with vibrant colors, and even before he stepped in, he was greeted by a mixture of over a dozen different floral fragrances assaulting his nose.
Yuan Ming's nostrils flared, and with just a slight inhale, he found the scent of the flowers pleasing and refreshing to the heart and spleen.
He walked slowly into the garden and quickly discovered many aged Spiritual Flowers and Spirit Grasses under his scanning gaze. Although they were not too rare, they could still be exchanged for quite a few Spirit Stones, so he immediately swept them up with a flick of his sleeve, and a stream of rosy light collected them all into his pouch.
However, at that moment, his brow suddenly furrowed, and the floral scent before his nose somehow turned into an odorous, nauseating stench of blood.
He immediately looked up and saw—what should have been a sea of competing flowers had morphed into a nightmarish vision of mountains of corpses and seas of blood. The so-called blossoms and green leaves were clearly blood-stained hands, feet, and palms that seemed to sway in the wind but, in truth, were the twitching of fingers and toes.
In his palm, a newly picked Spiritual Flower had also transformed into the shape of a severed hand, its root constantly oozing blood, while its fingers desperately stretched out as if trying to touch Yuan Ming's own palm.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming frowned heavily but did not throw the strange flower in his hand away. Instead, with a thought, Soul Power surged out from his Sea of Consciousness, and Divine Sense swarmed upon the flower in his hand. To his sight, it remained in its original vibrant colorful form.
Moreover, everything shrouded by his Divine Sense, though still terrifying in Yuan Ming's eyes, appeared completely normal when observed with Divine Sense.
"Could it be Poison Technique instead of an Illusion Technique?" Yuan Ming realized something and immediately shut off his sense of smell, blocking the influence of the floral scent. The bizarre sights before his eyes faded away as a result.
But just then, the ground beneath Yuan Ming's feet suddenly turned unbelievably soft, and a massive force of suction emanated from below, swallowing a small section of his legs in a moment and continuing to pull him down faster and faster.
A chill ran down Yuan Ming's spine, and he quickly raised his hand, releasing Hua Zhi and Vajra while simultaneously pinching his spell, and a large area of bone-white flames suddenly flared up on the White Bone Knife, slashing towards the ground beneath him.
Hua Zhi and Vajra had just been released when Yuan Ming instructed them to take action as well.
Hua Zhi instantly drove its arms into the ground, sprouting countless purple vines that surged towards Yuan Ming's feet, while Vajra quickly stepped forward, grabbing Yuan Ming's arm and, working in concert with his own channeling of Mana, began to pull him out of the softened earth.
As if sensing Yuan Ming's impending escape, the suction force from below ground abruptly intensified. But as soon as the White Bone Knife plunged into the earth and the purple vines followed, a panicked howl echoed faintly from beneath.
The next moment, Yuan Ming felt the suction from below loosen, and in an instant, he was flung high into the air by Vajra's unexpected and sheer brute force.
From mid-air, Yuan Ming swiftly stabilized his body with Mana and looked back at where he had just been standing.
He saw the ground of the garden undulating and swelling under the chase of Hua Zhi's vines, as if a giant python was slithering through the soil.
Yuan Ming called back the White Bone Knife and, observing from mid-air, the "giant python's" slithering trajectory, he waited for the right moment and pointed fiercely. The White Bone Knife whooshed out and met the "giant python" head-on just as it broke the surface.
To his surprise, when the White Bone Knife struck the creature's head, it made a crisp sound as if it had shattered something, and with a painful cry, the creature immediately dove back into the ground, seemingly trying to flee.
Yuan Ming immediately pinched his spell, and the white flames on the knife, as if alive, latched onto the creature before it fully submerged back into the earth.
The creature, scorched by the white flames, soon bore countless pale Ice Crystals on its skin and its movements slowed significantly. Seizing this opportunity, the vines released by Hua Zhi quickly caught the creature from the soil and suspended it mid-air.
Only now did Yuan Ming get a clear view of the creature— it was not a giant python, but a bizarre lizard covered in white fur; on its head was a piece of Black Armor with small fragments chipped away, presumably from where the White Bone Knife had struck moments before.
The strange lizard, still hanging in mid-air, continued to struggle chaotically. As it did so, several white hairs fell off and, the moment they touched the ground, vanished as if swallowed by the earth. Shortly thereafter, the flowers in that area bloomed instantly, releasing waves of fragrant scent that assaulted Hua Zhi.
However, as Hua Zhi's true form was that of vines and with Yuan Ming directing nearby, it did not breathe in the scent of the flowers and thus remained unaffected.
Yuan Ming looked the creature up and down, his mind suddenly recalling a type of demon beast called "Ground-drilling Boar" mentioned in the Classics he had read before.
Indeed, the Ground-drilling Boar, similar to the Earth Demon, not only had the superpower to burrow through the ground but could also control the softness and hardness of soil and stone to a certain extent, trapping and killing its enemies with it.
In addition, the white fur covering this demon was quite peculiar— once shed, it caused the flora in a given area to emit Poisonous Incense. If inhaled, one would fall into an illusion. But this illusion affected the body, not Divine Sense, and posed no significant threat to a Cultivator; rather, it served as a shortcut to finding the beast.
Yet, Yin Capital City had been shrouded by an Illusion Array, significantly compensating for the drawbacks of the demon's Divine Skills and making it difficult for a Cultivator who entered its territory to distinguish between reality and illusion, eventually becoming prey to the demon beast.
But now, with the Illusion Array broken and Yuan Ming possessing a strong Divine Soul and expertise in Illusion Techniques, this demon's limited abilities were akin to making a futile attempt in the presence of an expert. Despite having the Cultivation of a Third-level Demon Beast, its exhibited combat power was even less than that of some Second-level Demon Beasts.
Yuan Ming lifted his hand and the White Bone Knife darted forth, severing the head of the Ground-drilling Boar, its body immediately absorbed by Hua Zhi, soon becoming a mummified corpse.
With no demon beasts hindering him, Yuan Ming continued his exploration of the garden, eventually finding several ancient Spirit Grasses, but there were no other gains.
For an ordinary Core Formation Cultivator, the harvest from the garden would have been considered abundant, those many stalks of Spiritual Medicine could be exchanged for Spirit Stones or refined into elixirs, either way, it was quite remarkable.
However, in Yuan Ming's heart, this place was a treasure trove on par with the City Lord Mansion, mere Core Formation Stage Spirit Grasses were still far from satisfying him.
Yuan Ming left the garden and returned to the dense woods, his gaze wavering between the lake and the rockery, eventually choosing to step onto the lake's gangway.
Since five Nascent Soul Stage experts were jointly investigating the City Lord Mansion and their speed was mostly faster than his, he had to beat everyone to it, making quick decisions to grab the treasures in the garden before rushing back.
In the several areas, only the three-layered pavilion gave Yuan Ming an extraordinary feeling. He didn't approach it earlier out of caution, but now, realizing that the garden didn't harbor any heavy treasures, he figured the rockery wouldn't either, which meant no need to waste time.
Yuan Ming hurriedly walked on the gallery bridge, with Hua Zhi and Vajra closely following behind, one man and two beasts keeping vigilant of their surroundings while searching for treasures along the way.
As they drew closer to the island in the lake, lotus leaves began to appear in abundance beside the gangway.
Among the tender green foliage, lotus pods hung their heads, and as the breeze blew, they resembled drowsy children, occasionally touching the lake surface, waking with a start from the ripples they created, before hurriedly straightening up, struggling to hide their sleepiness, soon drooping down again.
Yuan Ming looked around and felt the Wood Attribute Spiritual Energy in the air had thickened several times over, and on impulse, he cast a spell to pick a lotus pod and excavated several fragrant, energy-rich lotus seeds.
Covering the lotus seeds with his Divine Sense, he investigated them and found no abnormalities, so he tried eating one.
Upon swallowing the lotus seed, Yuan Ming instantly felt a warm current spread throughout his body, his depleted mana was instantaneously replenished, and even his cultivation somewhat advanced.
Seeing such miraculous effects from the lotus seeds, Yuan Ming's eyes brightened, and he called Hua Zhi and Vajra over to pick them together.
While picking, Yuan Ming also dug out the Spiritual Lotuses hidden beneath the lotus leaves. Though their exact effects were unknown, judging by the strong Spiritual Energy not inferior to the lotus seeds, he knew they were no ordinary items.
While sweeping through the area as they moved forward, Yuan Ming suddenly discovered that far from the gangway, in the depths of the lake concealed by layers of lotus leaves, a multicolored aurora burst forth like a rainbow after rain, dazzling and strikingly beautiful.
Yuan Ming, feeling the dense Spiritual Energy emanating from behind the lotus leaves, had a stirring in his heart and immediately floated down to the lake surface, walking toward the source of the aurora.Help us continue by reading at the source: *.
He pushed through the obstructing lotus leaves, and a small multicolored lotus appeared before him. The lotus was already in full bloom, with seventy-two tender petals arranged in three layers, surrounding the handful of multicolored lotus seeds at the center. The rich Spiritual Energy formed a fine mist that undulated with the aurora, seemingly breathing.
Deeply captivated by the sight before him, Yuan Ming couldn't help but admire it and prepared to approach and pick it, but after taking just two steps he felt a sudden twitch in his eyelids and an intense sense of danger emerging from his Divine Soul.
Yuan Ming's heart skipped a beat, and before he had a chance to react he felt a pain in his ankle, following which his body uncontrollably flew up, ending up suspended upside down in midair, like an insect caught in a spider's web.
At the same time, the calm surface of the lake churned, and two blood-red vines covered with barbs emerged from the water, stabbing toward Yuan Ming.
Seeing the ferocious appearance of the two vines, Yuan Ming quickly pinched a spell, summoning the Bronze Small Tripod, from which endless Flames poured out, forming a shield in front of him to block the vines.
But against the roaring fire, the exterior of the blood-red vines seemed to be covered with a thin film, showing no signs of catching fire. Meanwhile, as they continually lashed out, the Flame Shield began to shrink and soon shattered.
Almost the moment Yuan Ming was attacked, Hua Zhi and Vajra, standing on the gangway, simultaneously reacted, each beginning to use their methods.
Hua Zhi rapidly closed the distance and extended her arms, with purple-black tendrils coalescing into a large purple sword, which swooped down towards the blood-red vine with a howl.
The blood-red vine immediately changed its target, its barbed body rising up to meet the giant sword, and at the moment of contact, it twisted around and became entangled with it, transferring its barbs across the sword's surface and even tearing off chunks of the plant's skin and splinters.
Seeing Yuan Ming suspended upside down by two blood vines wrapped around his ankles, Vajra immediately used his inner breath to walk on water, flashing several times before arriving below Yuan Ming, grabbing one of the vines latched onto his ankle, and with a surge of strength in his arms, attempting to tear it in two.
During this process, the barbs on the vines madly tried piercing Vajra's body but were like striking an iron wall, sparking upon impact without penetrating an inch.
However, the resilience of the vine also exceeded Vajra's expectations; he exerted almost all his strength but managed only to tear a small gash in the vine, unable to completely break it.

chapters.title: Chapter 399 - 376: Fierce Battle
chapters.content:
At that moment, Yuan Ming was suspended upside down, unable to free himself, yet he did not panic.
With a single hand, he raised the White Bone Knife and it flashed out, attempting to sever another blood vine wrapped around his ankle. But no matter how he chopped, not even a scratch appeared on the blood vine.
He frowned and pinched a spell with one hand. A Magic Formula flashed and disappeared into the White Bone Knife, igniting pale flames on the blade once more.
The White Bone Knife moved again, leaving a streak of light, and a white fiery arc landed on the blood vine.
The originally tough blood vine turned white and rigid under the pale flames, and when slashed by the falling bone knife, it only made a crisp sound before shattering into pieces.
Yuan Ming was delighted and dealt with another blood vine in the same way. He fell from the sky, casting to stand on the water's surface, only to look up and see that Hua Zhi was struggling in a tough battle.
Hua Zhi's arms, transformed into giant swords from vines, were entangled by two blood vines. Before she could free herself, another seven or eight blood vines burst out of the water, scrambling to climb the two giant swords. Their sharp tips pierced into them, and then they began to swell and contract incessantly, seemingly sucking something.
Since the birth of Hua Zhi's spiritual sense, it had always been the one devouring others, never having been devoured in such a manner.
Feeling the loss of power inside, it was both shocked and angry. The vines that formed its body writhed, pushing out a blood-colored orb, which then was activated by casting.
The orb flew into the air, spinning, and then instantly transformed into a mist of blood. In a flash, it penetrated the blood vines wrapped around it.
Just a moment later, the blood vines entwined around the giant swords turned ash-gray, withered, and shriveled, and as Hua Zhi swung its arms, they directly turned into ashes and drifted down.
Just then, a thunderous roar erupted from the small island in the lake, shaking the entire island.
At once, the soil tore apart, and the lake water churned as a blood-colored willow tree, dozens of feet tall, burst from the ground. Countless blood vines twined around its trunk displayed faces, resembling a wild dance of snakes.
The demonic power emitted by the Blood Willow had already reached the Level 4 standard, and dark black gas like threads wrapped around its trunk, giving it a terribly ominous appearance.
The trunk of the Blood Willow trembled slightly, and a dozen blood vines split in two, dancing towards Yuan Ming and Hua Zhi.
Hua Zhi quickly swung its giant sword-like arms to block, trying to chop them down, but the vines attacking this time were faster than before. Several easily wrapped around its arms, with others aiming straight for its body.
Hua Zhi wanted to activate the Blood Pearl, but right as it raised its Mana, seven or eight blood vines wrapped around its body. The terrifying suction that emerged rapidly seized its vitality and liveliness.
On the other side, Vajra stood in front of Yuan Ming, his right arm gripping the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear, his inner breath churning throughout his body, covering the Nine Dragons Spear Point. He then thrust out fiercely.
Dozens of thrusts in quick succession, so fast that only the wall of spear shadows could be seen, met the blood vines head-on.
With the enhancement of inner breath, the power of the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear reached a terrifying level. Even if the Blood Willow was a Level 4 demon beast, the seven or eight blood vines it swung were still torn apart by the dense spear shadows.
Seeing its vines destroyed, the drooping branches of the Blood Willow instantly curled up, shaking like a spinning drum.
As it shook, branches released seeds encased in white shells.
The seeds did not fall to the ground but hovered in midair. Immediately after, tiny cracks appeared on their white shells, and a crimson mist burst out, soon enveloping the seeds and turning them into murky blood-colored spheres.
After forming, the spheres paused in the air for a moment, and then abruptly shot densely towards Vajra.
Seeing the Blood Willow unleashing a new move, Vajra breathed even harder, his inner breath continuously flowing into the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear, causing it to emit a faint golden glow.
To counter the incoming blood-colored spheres, he switched from one-hand to two-hand grip on the spear, placing it horizontally in front of his chest, with the spear point angled slightly downward to the right. Simultaneously, he steadied his stance, his full strength surging into his arms, causing the veins on his arms gripping the spear shaft to bulge instantly.
With a whoosh, Vajra swept the spear toward the incoming blood-colored spheres.
Before the spear had struck, the wind had already begun to move.
The fierce resistance of the whirlwind created before the spear point made contact slowed the momentum of all the blood-colored spheres, but a few still managed to push through the wind toward the front, only to be hit squarely by the following spear point.
The sharp spear blade slashed through, instantly splitting the spheres in two.My Virtual Library Empire (*) thanks you for reading at the source.
However, the split spheres, as if receiving a signal, trembled and then unexpectedly spawned two new blood vines from within. Still in midair, with their thick, blood-like sap not yet dry, they whipped towards the wide-open Vajra.
Vajra's heart jolted, and he immediately released his left arm while pressing down his right arm, his palm tightly gripping the spear shaft and sweeping across with a backhanded strike.
The newly grown vines seemed even more fragile than before, being completely severed as the spear blade swept across them, emerging from the blood-colored orbs.
However, before the fragments of the blood-colored vines could fall, two new vines grew from the blood-colored orbs.
Moreover, when the fragments fell to the ground, the supposedly inactive vines regained vitality, burrowing into the ground as if finding their rightful place, and in moments, two fresh vines emerged from the ground.
At the same time, the blood-colored orbs that were initially hindered by the force of the spear now stopped mid-air, splitting open on their own volition and releasing blood-colored vines that surged towards Vajra like they had found prey.
Vajra once again swung the Purple Star Nine Dragons Spear, shattering the oncoming vines, but this time, the more vines he shattered, the more grew back, initially manageable, but as the spear danced, it became increasingly difficult to cope.
It was not until then that Vajra realized that what attacked him were not simply vines, but the roots of the Blood Willow—those blood-colored orbs were its seeds, which contained the roots, and whether cut or torn, as soon as they touched fertile soil, they would immediately grow new roots.
Realizing this, Vajra immediately changed tactics, still wielding the spear but trying to avoid severing the blood roots completely, thus finding himself in a deadlock without a solution at hand.
Yuan Ming observed everything that unfolded before him, already having taken out the Night Parade of Hundred Demons, releasing the Heavenly Ghost Wanderer and other ghost slaves to help alleviate some of Vajra's pressure, then he took out the Stealing Heaven Tripod and entered it while connecting with the Second Split Soul, contacting Yan Sijing in the City Lord Mansion.
…
As the Blood Willow emerged, the cultivators in the City Lord Mansion also plunged into a bitter battle.
In an exceedingly vast hall, a blood-red skeleton sat cross-legged on a mat at the center.
Greenish flames flickered in the eye sockets of the skeleton, its jagged fingers forming eerie magic formulas, with eight luminous blue orbs floating in front before it, each containing a flashing rune.
The orbs were coated with a thin layer of blood mist, and from this mist, strands like veins ran, linking the eight orbs in an array.
Driven by this formation, above the blood-colored skull, the phantom of a serpentine river appeared, its waves deep red and emitting a rotten stench that pervaded the air, causing all present to retch.
Endless streaks of blood light emerged from the phantom, transforming before they hit the ground into decayed, blood-colored swords hurling towards the five Nascent Souls.
The five Nascent Souls were each wielding their skills to cope with these blood-colored swords.
Wan Qi Hong snorted coldly, his body flashed with golden light, and with a gesture of his sword finger, countless golden sword shadows densely slashed through, easily shattering the blood-colored swords coming towards him.
However, as the blood-colored swords shattered, they transformed into foul-smelling blood, and upon contact with the gold, the sword shadows hissed and wisps of white smoke arose; in a blink, the sword shadows Wan Qi Hong displayed were completely corroded by the blood, utterly vanishing into the air.
Elsewhere, Su Zimo's mind flickered, and the seven Demon Core cultivators surrounding him instantly spread out in a seemingly loose but subtly regular formation.
Once the Demon Core cultivators arranged the formation, they simultaneously formed magic hand seals and chanted in such unison they seemed as one.
In an instant, seven beams of differently colored light shot out from their mouths, hitting the blood-colored swords and displaying seven different effects, including burning, freezing, and turning into dust.
Su Zimo looked somewhat pleased with the Demon Core cultivators' maneuvers, but then, he noticed blood-colored marks crawling up the seven beams, ominously reversing flow and rapidly surging towards the Demon Core cultivators.
Shocked by this development, Su Zimo immediately raised his hand, having the Demon Core cultivators stop simultaneously, with the beams abruptly vanishing, yet the contaminated parts seemed to solidify in mid-air before reluctantly dissipating after a moment.
Not far from Su Zimo, Thunderbolt Ancestor faced a similar ordeal.
Utilizing his magic, he conjured a thundercloud in the hall, and although the lightning striking down from the cloud could shatter the blood-colored swords, it was soon contaminated by the eerie blood, turning the originally grey thundercloud that released lightning into a horrific red cloud raining blood.
Compared to them, Dugu Feng had a far worse outcome; he sacrificed a set of Black Needles, twenty-one in total. As they penetrated the blood-colored swords, they were quickly stained with red, and Dugu Feng's expression changed as he realized he had completely lost control over this Magic Treasure.
As for Golden Dawn Fairy, she wielded the Golden Scroll, and golden characters surged from it to strike the blood-colored swords, immediately shattering before being contaminated, making her the least affected among the five Nascent Souls.
After recognizing the peculiarities of the blood-colored swords, they attempted to change tactics and minimize their own damage, but before they could act, they saw further changes within the Blood River phantom.
The blood-colored swords they had shattered flew back into the Blood River, completely turning into blood and merging with the river.
Then, the restless surface of the river suddenly converged into a splash as tall as a person, and from the spray, five blood-soaked cultivator phantoms emerged, bearing an uncanny resemblance to Wan Qi Hong and the others.

chapters.title: Chapter 400 - 377: Watching and Helping
chapters.content:
After the shadows of five cultivators appeared, they simultaneously raised their hands, using the power of the Blood River to cast the spells that Wan Qi Hong and his group had just released.
For a moment, Sword Shadows, Light Pillars, Thunder, Black Needles, and Blood Words—all five attacks surged towards Wan Qi Hong and his group, causing their expressions to subtly change as they again employed their methods to respond.
Meanwhile, as they engaged the blood skeletons, the Core Formation cultivators they had brought along were also entangled in combat with two faceless Green Stone statues nearby.
Both statues were three Zhang tall, entirely sculpted from some type of greenish giant rock, resembling a massive bear in appearance, moving with great force and heaviness, while the other appeared similar to a cheetah, moving as swiftly as a startled swan.
The Core Formation cultivators unleashed their techniques, sending a flurry of blade lights and sword shadows, along with Magical Treasure Talismans, bombarding the Green Stone statues.
However, the bodies of these two Green Stone statues were extremely hard; even when hit simultaneously by four or five Magic Treasures, they only chipped a slight crack, which could barely be considered a notch.
As for the spells cast upon them, they only kicked up a ring of dust upon impact. Neither fire attacks nor water assaults left any mark on the statues.
Seeing this, the cultivators realized that these statues seemed to be immune to magic, so they mostly used Magic Treasures against them, occasionally employing spells primarily to obstruct and entangle the enemy.
After all, they believed the critical part of this battle lay with Wan Qi Hong and others; they just needed to tie down these two statues so Wan Qi Hong and his group could focus on the peculiar skeleton.
In the crowd, Yan Sijing was also fully engaged in combat with a Green Stone Puppet.
Her Magic Treasure was an all-white Jade Ruyi, which under her control, shot out faint white light towards the other few Core Formation cultivators, landing on them and healing some of their minor injuries while seemingly also restoring some Mana and spirit.For character sheets and glossaries, visit *.
The Core Formation cultivators, sensing Yan Sijing's supportive capabilities, kept her implicitly protected behind them, simultaneously manipulating the battleground to ensure the statues' attention didn't settle on her.
"Miss Yan, I've encountered some troubles here and need to ask the Nether Moon God for help. Please pray to the Nether Moon God just like me, quickly!"
While Yan Sijing was casting her spell, Yuan Ming's voice suddenly echoed in her Sea of Consciousness, causing her a slight shock. Fortunately, others were not paying attention to her at the moment, so they did not notice her reaction.
Hearing the urgency in Yuan Ming's words and sensing his dire situation, she hesitated just for a moment and didn't ask further, instead silently praying in her mind.
As she was distracted with her prayer, Yuan Ming, who was seated on the Lotus Platform, had to exert much effort to latch onto a faint trace of her Desire Power.
Following this trace of Desire Power, Yuan Ming identified the anchor point and immediately projected his Divine Sense downwards, not bothering to inspect the surroundings of the City Lord Mansion but adjusting his view towards the East City garden.
Due to the earlier delay, the situation in the garden had grown even more dire.
The Blood-colored Roots extending from the Blood Willow's main body had tightly entangled Hua Zhi, and now, like a leech, they were crazily draining the Spiritual Power and vitality from Hua Zhi's body.
Meanwhile, for Vajra, the spear shadows produced by the Purple Star Nine Dragons Spear were thinning; although a defensive strategy prevented an increase in the Blood Roots, Vajra still caught opportunities to breach its defense lines and whip its body from time to time.
Though Vajra was tough-skinned and generally impervious to normal Magic Treasures, under the attack of the higher-Cultivation Blood Willow, streaks of blood began to show on its body.
As for the Ghost Slaves released by Yuan Ming, most were struggling just like Vajra under the attacks of the Blood Willow; however, the leading Heavenly Ghost Wanderer had been entangled by a new opponent.
A Ground-drilling Boar had unexpectedly emerged, standing atop a small island in the lake and surrounded by a pile of rocks from unknown origins. As the demon swung its arms, a yellowish Spiritual Light surged out from its body, wrapping around the rocks and shooting them towards the Heavenly Ghost Wanderer.
The Heavenly Ghost Wanderer immediately dodged, but the stones wrapped in the yellowish Spiritual Light seemed to have eyes, turning mid-air and continuing to chase after him.
At the same time, countless more rocks, wrapped in the same yellowish Spiritual Light by the Ground-drilling Boar, swept towards the Heavenly Ghost Wanderer like a sandstorm stirred by a fierce wind.
Seeing this, the Heavenly Ghost Wanderer had to seize the moment a stone grazed past, quickly manipulating his spell to cast a magic technique.
However, just then, from the water beneath him, an unnoticeable yellow-light rock suddenly shot out, hitting him directly between the legs.
As a soul body, he naturally had no weak spots there, nor would he be affected by mere rocks, but the yellow Spiritual Light on the rock seemed to contain some mysterious power; it exploded upon hitting the Heavenly Ghost Wanderer.
The Heavenly Ghost Wanderer suddenly felt a heaviness in his legs. Looking down, he saw his thighs had turned to solid stone, dragging him towards the lake's bottom.
On the shore, the Ground-drilling Boar excitedly clapped its paws, as if mocking the Heavenly Ghost Wanderer, emitting a strange cry.
Seeing this scene, Yuan Ming immediately mobilized his Divine Soul, releasing a soul crow and casting the Crow Caw Illusion Technique on the Ground-drilling Boar.
The Ground-drilling Boar paused abruptly, blinked its eyes, and then, somewhat confused, looked towards the Blood Willow.
This glance was careless, and in the next instant, the Ground-drilling Boar's face immediately showed an extremely terrified expression. It didn't know what it had seen, but its two claws swung fiercely, wrapping the yellow light that surged from its body around the rubble, and struck at the true body of the Blood Willow.
When the yellow light and rubble hit the trunk of the Blood Willow, it exploded and, just like when dealing with the Heavenly Ghost Wanderer, quickly petrified the surface bark of the Blood Willow.
However, the petrified trunk of the Blood Willow was much smaller than that of the Heavenly Ghost Wanderer. Sensing the attack from the Ground-drilling Boar, the branches of the Blood Willow shook, making a rustling sound as if questioning.
The Ground-drilling Boar, caught in an illusion, naturally couldn't answer the Blood Willow's questions, and with a swing of its claws, two more yellow light rubble shot forth.
The Blood Willow was clearly provoked as its drooping branches rolled back up again, sending a dozen blood-colored seeds toward the Ground-drilling Boar.
As the Blood Willow released more Blood Seeds, on Vajra's side, several blood-colored seeds suddenly dimmed and vanished, greatly reducing the pressure on it and giving it a moment to breathe.
Yuan Ming, using his Divine Sense, noticed this scene and immediately realized there was a limit to the number of Blood Seeds. Next, he summoned the soul crows again, taking the opportunity to cast the Crow Caw Illusion Technique on the Blood Willow.
His Divine Soul, bolstered by Desire Power, had already reached the realm of the Sleeping Witch. Although the Blood Willow had the strength of a Level 4 Demon Beast, its Divine Soul was significantly weaker than that of a Nascent Soul cultivator. Now, caught in a rage, it was even more susceptible to manipulation.
Thus, the illusion cast by Yuan Ming easily shielded the Blood Willow's perception, plunging it into a deep illusion.
In its perception, suddenly five cultivators of comparable strength flew into the garden from outside.
A flash of fear crossed its mind, but for some reason, the anger in its heart instantly burned away this trace of fear.
Faced with formidable enemies, it could not afford to deal with minor "insects" like Vajra and also retracted the Blood Roots sucking on the Hua Zhi, its branches rolling upwards and pouring all its Blood Seeds toward the five cultivators in the sky, while its blood-colored roots covered in thorns also broke through the ground at the same time, wildly whipping at the airborne enemies.
With the full outburst of the Blood Willow, the ground of the entire garden trembled, and countless blood-colored roots filled the sky, resembling blood-colored long worms that covered the heavens, gruesome and terrifying.
Even Yuan Ming was taken back by such a spectacle, the power of a Level 4 Demon Beast far exceeding his expectations. Without the aid of the Stealing Heaven Tripod and relying solely on Soul Cultivation Illusion Technique, he might be able to escape this battle, but he certainly had no chance of winning.
He composed his mind and, to be safe, cast another Crow Caw Illusion Technique on the Blood Willow. He was just about to contact Vajra through Divine Sense when he suddenly felt a slight fatigue, not from his body but from his Divine Soul.
Yuan Ming paused, realizing that even though his Divine Soul was amplified by Desire Power, it was still not his true strength. Combat with a Level 4 Demon Beast was already tiring, and facing a true Nascent Soul cultivator might drain more resources than he anticipated.
Yuan Ming took a short break to alleviate his fatigue, then messaged Vajra to take advantage of the Blood Willow being caught in an illusion and step forward to kill it completely.
Upon hearing this, Vajra immediately took up the Purple Star Nine Dragons Spear and stepped forward, his body sinking as his arms suddenly exerted force, sending out countless spear shadows that splashed across the sky and struck the trunk of the Blood Willow, but only chiseled out several small cuts, unable to truly harm it.
Yuan Ming frowned slightly, realizing that dealing with this kind of physically robust Level 4 Demon Beast was probably still difficult with just Core Formation techniques.
Just as he was thinking about paying a price to exert the Soul Collision Divine Ability to utterly shatter the Divine Soul of the Blood Willow, he suddenly saw the weak Hua Zhi, supporting itself and staggeringly moved to the side of the Blood Willow.
"Master, let me try," it said.
Hearing Hua Zhi's somewhat weak telepathy, Yuan Ming was silent for a moment, then consented to its request, watching as Hua Zhi turned its hands and feet into vines and pierced into the Blood Willow.
At the same time, a surge of Blood Light suddenly rose from within it, the power of the Blood-colored Orb, entwining around the purple-black vines.
The tree body that the Purple Star Nine Dragons Spear had difficulty damaging, the purple-black vines easily pierced through, heading straight for the core of the willow tree.
Streams of visibly blood-colored demon energy transmitted over, and the originally weak aura of Hua Zhi started to rapidly increase.
The body of the Blood-colored Willow Tree trembled greatly, seemingly in pain, and its consciousness began to rapidly recover.
Yuan Ming would not let it recover, he waved his hand, and eight soul crows dived down, hovering around the Blood Willow, simultaneously emitting caws, it was the Crow Formation Divine Power.
The Divine Soul of the Blood Willow shook violently, sinking into the illusion, its consciousness sinking once again.
Hua Zhi quickly controlled the purple-black vines to continue probing deep into the Blood Willow, soon touching a blood-red crystal the size of a bowl, bursting with astonishing demonic power.
It was indeed the heart of the Blood Willow, similar to a Demon Core.
Without any hesitation, a purple-black vine penetrated the blood-red crystal.
Streams of exceptionally profound demonic power transferred through the vine, rapidly advancing Hua Zhi's aura.

chapters.title: Chapter 401 - 378 Exploring the Building
chapters.content:
The Blood Willow Tree Heart, under attack, quivered violently as it once again showed signs of awakening.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming immediately channeled his Divine Soul Power into the Crow Formation, and the crow's cries rose once more. Despite the Blood Willow's consciousness churning violently, it ultimately failed to break through the barrier of the illusion.
Taking advantage of the situation, Hua Zhi frantically absorbed the demonic power inside the blood-colored crystals, and its aura soared wildly, breaking through to the Second Rank Upper Stage in an instant, and it didn't stop there.
As the Blood Willow's massive body trembled, the blood-colored vines swirling around it danced wildly in the air, stirring up a whirlwind of flying sand and stones. The Ground-drilling Boar, which had been firmly bound by the Blood Vines sprouting from the blood-colored seeds, lost most of its Essence Blood and was barely alive. Now, it was flung away outright.
However, Hua Zhi firmly clung to the Blood Willow's body, continuing its crazed absorption.
Yuan Ming knew that this was the critical moment, a do-or-die situation, so he immediately operated his Soul Power and cast the Dream Butterfly Illusion Technique, firmly suppressing the Blood Willow's Divine Soul.
The demonic power of the Blood Willow rapidly drained away, and its Divine Soul Power also weakened swiftly, soon falling to less than half of its peak, causing the dancing Blood Vines to slow down, giving off a feeble impression.
A cold light flashed in Yuan Ming's eyes, and with a thought, a soul crow spread its wings and shot out, entering the Blood Willow's body to perform the Soul Collision Divine Ability.
The Heavenly Ghost Wanderer approached the Blood Willow closely, and a Three-eyed Soul Dove shot out from his forehead. A thick Black Mist emerged on the surface of his body, also rushing toward the Blood Willow's Divine Soul.
This was another Soul Cultivator ability, "Soul Erosion," which the Heavenly Ghost Wanderer retained after transforming the Ghost Slave. The black mist surrounding the Three-eyed Soul Dove had a strong corrosive effect, able to erode an enemy's Divine Soul.
A gray shadow flickered near the Blood Willow—it was the gray female ghost Yuan Ming had previously subdued. She opened her mouth to emit a piercing ghostly howl and struck hard against the Blood Willow.
The other ghosts with the ability to attack the Divine Soul also swooped in to launch their attacks on the Blood Willow.
The Blood Willow's Divine Soul, already extremely weak, finally collapsed completely under the relentless assault of soul attacks, scattering to the winds.
Upon seeing this, Yuan Ming also took a deep breath of relief. After all, this was his first time facing a Level 4 Demon Beast. Fortunately, he was a Soul Cultivator and had numerous methods at his disposal. Had it been an ordinary Core Formation Stage cultivator, even one who was one or two minor realms higher, they would likely have met their end here.
Hua Zhi was overjoyed and quickly directed the purple-black vines to burrow deeper into the Blood Willow, and its body slowly fused with it.
Countless tiny vines emerged from all parts of the Blood Willow, interweaving and tangling on the surface, quickly submerging the Blood Willow and forming a giant purple-black cocoon.
Yuan Ming immediately left the Stealing Heaven Tripod and went over to the purple-black cocoon.
Even from outside the cocoon, he could clearly sense Hua Zhi's rapidly rising aura, which seemed to be nearing third level.
Yuan Ming estimated that the deep demonic power of this Level 4 Blood-colored Willow Tree would be enough to allow Hua Zhi to break through to the third level.
With this, Hua Zhi's strength would greatly increase, and his ability to protect himself on this island would further improve.
Yuan Ming nodded in satisfaction, emanating a green light that enveloped the purple-black cocoon, and put it into his Spiritual Beast Bag. Then he turned to Big White and said, "Killing this Blood Willow, you also exerted a lot of effort. But Hua Zhi needs the remains of this tree to enhance its strength. Once we leave this place, I will find a way to reward you."
"The fact that my master is thinking of me is satisfaction enough! Besides, Hua Zhi is so weak, I hardly feel like talking to it unless it becomes stronger," Big White said, patting his chest.
Yuan Ming felt relieved to know that, despite the usual bickering between Hua Zhi and Big White, there was still a sense of companionship in critical moments.
Big White had not suffered any damage in the fierce battle, but it was quite drained. Yuan Ming put it into the Spiritual Beast Bag for rest, and then recalled all the Ghost Slaves back into the Night Parade of Hundred Demons.
He cleaned up the battlefield, took some time for Breathing Control, and then stood up to proceed deeper into the island.
Although the Blood Willow was subdued, he remained on full alert. Fortunately, there were no further ambushes along the way, and he arrived at the three-story dark-colored pavilion.
Yuan Ming stopped in front of the pavilion door, a quick glance told him that the door was covered with a faint blue glow, not a common barrier.
To report errors, please visit the original post on *.
He was pleasantly surprised rather than shocked. The presence of a barrier around the pavilion meant that there were certainly valuable things stored inside.
Yuan Ming immediately brandished the White Bone Knife and chopped fiercely at the pavilion door.
The expected loud bang did not occur. The White Bone Knife struck the door as if it had hit a thick slab of fat, with much of the force being offset, and the blade sliding to the side.
"Eh, a Water attribute barrier?" Yuan Ming thought, pulling out the white ring he had obtained earlier and putting it on, channeling Mana into it.
"Whoosh"
The surface of the white ring appeared vibrant with spirit light, instantly emitting a white cold fog that covered the entire door, drastically lowering the temperature around it.
Yuan Ming surmised that the cold fog from the ring was incredibly potent, the bane of Water attribute Magic Treasures, and it should also be effective against Water attribute barriers.
He was not disappointed, as the entire door was instantly covered with a layer of white solid ice under the cover of the white fog, and the blue light barrier on the door was frozen as well.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming lifted the White Bone Knife again, pouring all his Mana into it, and slashed forward. A tremendous white blade light burst forth, illuminating a vast area of space and striking the door.
"Boom"
After a loud bang, the white solid ice along with the door below shattered into pieces.
Only then did Yuan Ming satisfyingly put away the Bone Knife, sweeping his Divine Sense around the interior several times before cautiously stepping into the attic.
The first floor of the attic was a reception hall, furnished with several tables and chairs, as well as folding screens and paintings. Although the decor was not vulgar and had a certain freshness and elegance, they were all mundane items, which naturally held no value to Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming followed the stairs by the side and slowly ascended to the second floor.
At first glance, the second floor of the attic appeared rather empty, except for a square rosewood table placed right in the center. On the table, a palm-sized, dark red mask lay on one side and a silver warhammer about a foot long on the other.
Both items were radiating faint Mana fluctuations, and there were two plaques beneath the mask and the warhammer, respectively inscribed with "Blood Bone Mask" and "Thunder God Hammer."
"There really are treasures!" Yuan Ming's eyes lit up, but he didn't rush over.
First, he summoned the Night Parade of Hundred Demons and called forth the Heavenly Ghost Wanderer to carefully inspect the area around the table, ensuring there were no dangers. After that, Yuan Ming personally stepped forward to first pick up the Blood Bone Mask.
Having the Heavenly Ghost Wanderer guard his surroundings, Yuan Ming then used his Mana to probe the mask.
The corner of his mouth couldn't help but reveal a smile from what he saw.
Inside the Blood Bone Mask, there were a total of nine runes, most of which Yuan Ming didn't recognize. These runes outlined a grand rune formation that appeared extremely intricate.
The aura of the nine-runed formation was not only grand but also emitted a sense of completeness.
"They say all things come to completion in nines, being the ultimate number. Could it be that the limit of the Array within a Magic Treasure is nine runes?" Yuan Ming speculated as he further connected with the Blood Bone Mask and quickly understood its abilities.
The Blood Bone Mask, like the previously refined Thousand Mechanism Mask, belonged to the same type of treasure capable of altering and transforming appearances.
However, the Blood Bone Mask was far stronger than the Thousand Mechanism Mask, not only could it arbitrarily change appearance and stature, but it could also completely conceal the wearer's Mana fluctuations, preventing any breath-related flaws from being detected.
The capabilities of this treasure didn't stop there; it could also collect others' Mana signatures, storing them in nine special spaces within the mask, allowing up to nine different kinds of breaths to be stored.
When using the Blood Bone Mask to transform into someone else, one could utilize this ability to freely emit a variety of different Mana fluctuations. If one could collect the breath of the person they're imitating, they could achieve a Perfect disguise.
"Not bad, with this, disguising as someone else will be much more convenient in the future," Yuan Ming nodded, storing the Blood Bone Mask away and picking up the Thunder God Hammer.
Just like the mask, the hammer also contained nine runes, all of them Thunder Runes.
Yuan Ming refined the Nine Thunder Talisman Array a bit and also quickly discerned the abilities of this treasure.
Due to the nine Thunder Runes, the Thunder God Hammer contained an immense amount of the Power of thunder and lightning, capable of unleashing astonishing thunder and lightning attacks, far surpassing the Purple Thunder Steel Fork of Fang Youting.
Beyond releasing thunder and lightning in battle, this hammer also possessed the ability to absorb thunder and lightning, storing it within the Nine Thunder Talisman Array to be unleashed later when necessary.
If willing to spend time collecting, it might even be possible to use this Thunder God Hammer to unleash Nascent Soul Stage thunder and lightning prowess.
Yuan Ming suppressed the impulse to immediately refine the treasure and test its power, storing it away, and quickly ascended to the third floor of the attic.
If the second floor of the attic already housed two Nine Talisman Array Treasures, surely the third floor held even more precious items?
No sooner had he stepped onto the third floor than Yuan Ming was taken aback.
The third floor of the attic was completely empty, devoid of anything to the eye, not even a single table, and thick dust covered the floor.
"Could it be that the treasures here have already been taken by someone?" Yuan Ming was greatly disappointed, but soon regained his composure.
He had already obtained many treasures, so it didn't matter if the third floor was empty.
However, since he was there, he didn't neglect to thoroughly inspect the third floor.
As if fortune favored the diligent, his search yielded a discovery.
