From the dust in the corner of the attic, he found something that looked like a Black Key, half a foot long and as thick as a finger, with no Mana fluctuations, seemingly a mundane object.
When Yuan Ming used his Divine Sense to probe the Black Key, he quickly made a discovery: there were two small characters engraved on it: Shura.
"Shura? That's right, Xi Ying previously mentioned that the Night Parade of Hundred Demons originated from a Loose Cultivator known as the Shura Master. Here there's a key inscribed with the characters 'Shura'; could this Immortal Mansion be related to the Shura Master?" he couldn't help but speculate.
While Yuan Ming was deep in thought, the characters 'Shura' on the Black Key suddenly lit up, and a black Array appeared under his feet.
Waves of Black Mist surged out, engulfing his body.
Before Yuan Ming could even react, his vision blurred; he vanished from the spot into thin air.

chapters.title: Chapter 402 - 379 Key
chapters.content:
The battle within the City Lord Mansion still raged on.
Beneath the now somewhat sparse Blood River Formation, for some unknown reason, above the heads of the five Nascent Soul cultivators' apparitions, a golden lotus appeared, spinning around as countless fine golden threads cascaded down, immobilizing them in place, preventing any movement.
Not far away, Golden Dawn Fairy wore a solemn expression, her fingers danced ceaselessly, swiftly striking the golden lotuses with one spell after another.
Since these apparitions were restrained, Wan Qi Hong and the other four Nascent Soul cultivators began to focus on besieging the Blood-colored Skull.
Apart from Wan Qi Hong, the other three had already taken on all sorts of attacks from the Blood-colored Skull, putting in great effort to restrain it, while Wan Qi Hong kept launching fierce assaults on the Blood-colored Skull.
Meanwhile, of the two Green Stone Statues battling Yan Sijing and several other Core Formation Cultivators, only the cheetah statue remained, as the other, a giant bear statue, had already been reduced to a pile of rubble.
After a period of adjustment, these Core Formation Cultivators gradually developed some tacit understanding and seemingly discovered the knack to deal with these statues. While the cheetah statue was as swift as the wind, it suffered numerous scars under the concerted attack of the cultivators' Magic Treasures, and its defeat was imminent.
Wan Qi Hong opened his mouth and spat out a golden sword light, which flickered and multiplied into nearly a hundred sword shadows, blanketing the sky as they descended towards the Blood-colored Skull.
The Blood-colored Skull hurriedly maneuvered the Blood River to defend, barely withstanding the blow, but the Blood River was significantly weakened, becoming even more tenuous.
With a flick of his sleeve, Golden Light flashed in front of Wan Qi Hong, and a Flying Sword wreathed in Golden Flames materialized out of thin air. After spinning around, it rapidly grew in size, transforming in an instant into a five or six-zhang-long giant golden sword and slashed down at the thinned Blood River.
The Blood-colored Skull opened its mouth wide, and a blinding Blood Light shot out, colliding head-on with the Golden Flames Flying Sword.
At that moment, an unexpected change occurred!
Between flashes of spirit light on the ground, a huge black Array emerged, enveloping everyone in an instant.
Immediately thereafter, everyone was immobilized, and Magic Treasures like the Golden Flames Flying Sword were suppressed by an enormous force, unable to move even an inch.
Wan Qi Hong and the others were shocked. Seeing the equally astonished Blood-colored Skull, they felt slightly relieved.
Dense black light poured out from within the Array, cloaking everyone, including the Blood-colored Skull, and then in a flash, they disappeared without a trace.
Yuan Ming's vision blurred, and he found himself in a bright space.
Under the clear blue sky dotted with white clouds, an endless verdant grassland stretched out before him, with peaks of rolling mountains just visible in the distance. The air was filled with a freshness indistinguishable from the outside world.
Near him, a group of people appeared amidst the flashing black light on the ground, revealing Wan Qi Hong and the others.
The Blood-colored Skull also ended up here, its blood-red eyes revealing an incredibly surprised delight. After glancing at Yuan Ming, it immediately shot off into the distance.
Numerous clouds of Blood Mist emerged from the Skull, forming a Blood Cloud several mu in size. In the blink of an eye, it flew hundreds of zhang away and then disappeared into the horizon.
"Stop!" Su Zimo shouted frantically, ready to give chase.
"Let's not pursue a desperate enemy in unfamiliar territory!" Thunderbolt Ancestor said, raising his hand to stop Su Zimo.
"Damn it, we were about to seize that Blood-colored Skull and take the treasures within the City Lord Mansion. Why were we suddenly teleported here?" Su Zimo was filled with rage.
"That, I'm afraid we'll have to ask Yuan Ming. How did you come to be here? Right before that Blood-colored Skull made its escape, why did it take a special look at you?" Thunderbolt Ancestor directed his gaze at Yuan Ming.
The others turned their attention to Yuan Ming as well.
Yuan Ming's expression altered slightly as his mind raced. He said, "I do not know. While the seniors and Fellow Daoists went to the City Lord Mansion to search for treasures, I, being weak, did not dare to enter, so I wandered aimlessly around the city. Somehow, a black Array appeared under my feet out of nowhere, and the next thing I knew, I was here."
"Is that so?" The gaze of Thunderbolt Ancestor flickered, clearly unconvinced by Yuan Ming's words, and was about to press further.
Visit Мy Virtuаl Librаry Еmpirе (МV-LЕМР-YR) fоr mоrе.
"Eh? What's this?" Moving like a wraith, Wan Qi Hong appeared before Yuan Ming and reached into the void.
A strong suction force came forth, and the Black Key in Yuan Ming's hand shot out toward Wan Qi Hong.
Yuan Ming, startled, reached forward instinctively, and a white ring on his finger emitted a puff of white smoke that collided with the void in front of the Black Key.
With a sizzle, the air ahead of the key froze, and the suction force unleashed by Wan Qi Hong was frozen in place.
The Black Key continued to fly forward, struck the icy white expanse, and with a clang, it was repelled back.
Yuan Ming stretched out his hand and snatched the Black Key back.
He felt a rush of relief. The chill within the white ring was indeed remarkable, not only capable of freezing Magic Treasures and Forbidden spells but even able to freeze tangible impacts such as suction.
The quick exchange between Yuan Ming and Wan Qi Hong ended in the blink of an eye, but no one present was weak and all witnessed the scene, showing surprise as they scrutinized the white ring.
Wan Qi Hong's expression darkened, and just as he was about to act again, a ray of Golden Light landed in front of Yuan Ming, forming a golden light barrier that separated him from Wan Qi Hong.
The figure of Golden Dawn Fairy appeared beside Yuan Ming, her brows furrowed as she said, "Fellow Daoist Wan Qi, why are you unjustly seizing Yuan Ming's belonging?"
Only then did the others turn their attention to the Black Key.
"This key is..." Dugu Feng, who had originally been standing at a distance, flashed over in the blink of an eye, staring intently at the black key, a repressed excitement gleaming in his eyes.
The others noted Dugu Feng's expression, and their hearts stirred.
This black key seemed very precious; both Wan Qi Hong and Dugu Feng wanted it.
Thunderbolt Ancestor and Su Zimo extended their Divine Sense to carefully probe the black ring.
Here, without the restrictions from Yin Capital City, their Divine Sense could spread freely.
"Fellow Daoist Jin Xi has misunderstood; I was merely intrigued by the key's uniqueness and wished to take a closer look," Wan Qi Hong said, casting an annoyed glance at Dugu Feng.
Dugu Feng was unfazed, his gaze still locked on the black key.
Yuan Ming, watching the scene unfold, secretly regretted not having put away the black key promptly; it was now too late to hide it.
A thought crossed his mind, and he communicated with Xi Ying through his first soul.
"Xi Ying, do you know the origin of this black key?"
However, Xi Ying stood there with her head bowed, not responding to Yuan Ming's inquiry as if she hadn't heard him at all.
Yuan Ming's brows slightly lifted, but he did not pursue the question.
"Is that so? However, the key belongs to Fellow Daoist Yuan, and even if Fellow Daoist Wan Qi wishes to see it, he should obtain his consent. I do not wish for any more unpleasant incidents to occur," Golden Dawn Fairy said, and at the end of her remark, she shot a meaningful glance at Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming understood and put away the black key.
A flash of ferocity flitted through the depths of Wan Qi Hong's eyes but was quickly suppressed, making way for a benign expression as he asked, "Fellow Daoist Yuan, where did you come across this black key?"
"I found it inside an ordinary building in the city. I noticed it possessed some distinctive features, so I picked it up," Yuan Ming said half-truthfully.
"Since the key was obtained by chance, you probably don't care much for it. It is of great importance to me; I wonder if you might sell the key to me? Whether in exchange for Spirit Stones or for spiritual materials and Magic Treasures, either is fine," Wan Qi Hong suggested.
"I also need that key. If Yuan wishes to sell it, he must consider my offer too," Dugu Feng also stated.
"Fellow Daoist Dugu, do you really intend to compete with me for it?" Wan Qi Hong's eyes flickered with a hint of chill.
"If Brother Wan Qi were to obtain the key, I would naturally dare not indulge in wishful thinking. However, since Fellow Daoist Yuan has it, I intend to do all I can to contend for it," Dugu Feng said with a smile.
Wan Qi Hong snorted coldly and turned away from him to address Yuan Ming, "Fellow Daoist Yuan, what do you think about my earlier proposal?"
Yuan Ming had already weighed the matter and, after a brief pause, took out the black key and said, "Senior Wan Qi is right. I came upon this key by chance and have no significant use for it. Since both seniors desire it, I am not averse to parting with it."
His gains for the day were already substantial, and although the black key might be important, with Wan Qi Hong and the others getting involved, he likely wouldn't come out ahead even if he wanted to intervene; withdrawing now seemed wise.
"Excellent, what do you need, young friend? Spirit Stones? Magic Treasures? Spiritual materials and elixirs? Just name it," Wan Qi Hong said happily.
"I am not currently in need of Spirit Stones or elixirs. I have been looking for some Nine Nether Iron to refine a yin attribute Magic Treasure; if either of the seniors has this Divine Iron, and the amount is not too small, I am willing to offer this key with both hands," Yuan Ming proposed.
The Soul Destroying Sword had fused with the Nine Nether Iron from the Black Gourd, greatly enhancing its power, withstanding the Curse Rune.
But that was far from enough. Yuan Ming's ambitions didn't end there. He wished to gather more Nine Nether Iron, inscribe the other two runes onto it, and forge a Divine Sword with power that could pierce the heavens and the earth.
Upon hearing this, Wan Qi Hong's smile stiffened.
He was well aware of this rare yin attribute top-grade spiritual material with its incredible superpower, exceedingly scarce.
Though Nine Nether Iron was rare, Chang Chun Temple, which had been dominant in the Central Plains for over ten thousand years, had collected some. Wan Qi Hong had personally seen a few pieces, but he did not carry any.
"Hahaha, what a coincidence! I happen to have a significant piece of Nine Nether Iron," Dugu Feng laughed out loud and produced a fist-sized chunk of black ore from his hand.
The ore emitted a black spirit light, causing the surrounding area to become noticeably dimmer as if all light was being absorbed into the black ore.
"Nine Nether Iron!" Yuan Ming's eyes lit up, and he drew the black ore towards him.
Such a large piece of Nine Nether Iron, once integrated into the Soul Destroying Sword, should suffice to inscribe the second Rune of the Broken Sword; if not, little more would be required.
As he was about to speak, Wan Qi Hong's gaze turned cold, spreading a chill in the air.
Yuan Ming's eyelids twitched, and he halted midsentence.
"What, does Fellow Daoist Wan Qi intend to steal it by force? Then he shall have to ask if my sword agrees!" Dugu Feng said, looking over as a black long sword materialized in the palm of his hand.
The other three from the Black Desert Alliance also moved closer, lining up behind Dugu Feng.
Wan Qi Hong showed no sign of backing down, his cold gaze fixing on Dugu Feng.

chapters.title: Chapter 403 - 380 Cooperation
chapters.content:
The atmosphere in the arena suddenly became as tense as a drawn sword and a cocked crossbow, and the air seemed to cease flowing.
Thunderbolt Ancestor, Su Zimo, and others, upon hearing this, how could they not know that the Black Key was involved in a wide range of matters and might even be the crucial key to unlocking a part of the Immortal Mansion?
However, Chang Chun Temple's influence was overwhelming, and the Guiyuan Sect and the Five Thunder Sect weren't as remotely located as the Black Desert Alliance, so the two did not dare to rashly intervene and snatch it away.
Just at this moment, a colossal roar resembling the cry of a dragon and the roar of a tiger came from afar, causing the ground to shake incessantly.
A thick white Light Pillar suddenly rose up, piercing straight into the sky amidst the deafening uproar, casting the surrounding heaven and earth in immeasurable brightness in an instant.
The clouds hanging midair were also drawn in, slowly revolving around the Light Pillar.
Faced with such an enormous anomaly, Yuan Ming and the others were naturally shocked, and then their faces brightened with delight.
"You two can discuss slowly; this old man will take the lead." Thunderbolt Ancestor gathered Yan Sijing and another Early-stage Core Formation female cultivator with a flick of his sleeve, and shot toward the white Light Pillar.
Su Zimo followed closely behind, leading the remaining blond youth.
Only Wan Qi Hong, the Black Desert Alliance party, Golden Dawn Fairy, and others, as well as Yuan Ming, remained in the arena.
"Golden Dawn Fairy, let's set off too," Wen Zaihou couldn't help but whisper.
"If the two Fellow Daoists continue to argue, the opportunities ahead may be snatched away by others," Golden Dawn Fairy said, her eyes shifting as she let out a light cough.
Wan Qi Hong's gaze swept toward Golden Dawn Fairy. Although she hadn't made her stance clear, she obviously leaned more toward Dugu Feng compared to him.
With his Nascent Soul Middle Stage cultivation, dealing with Dugu Feng and his Core Formation Stage cultivators would be more than enough, but adding Jin Xi and her subordinates to the mix changed the situation.
Wan Qi Hong couldn't help but regret his overconfidence, coming here alone. If he had brought a few Core Formation subordinates with him, he wouldn't have been so isolated and helpless.
"I will remember today's events!" Wan Qi Hong's figure shot into the sky, transforming into a golden rainbow charging toward the location of the white Light Pillar.
"Thank you, Golden Dawn Fairy, for speaking out in justice. If there is anything I can help with later on, feel free to say so," Dugu Feng said, his expression softening as he cupped his hands toward Golden Dawn Fairy.
"Fellow Daoist Dugu, you are too courteous. Yuan Ming is from Spirit Wind City, and I have said earlier that I would protect him thoroughly. His matters, naturally, I will help one or two," Golden Dawn Fairy said with a smile.
Pi Xiu gave Yuan Ming a nod and smiled, expressing closeness and kindness.
However, Wen Zaihou frowned slightly, obviously thinking little of Golden Dawn Fairy for making an enemy out of Wan Qi Hong over the trivial matter of Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming also thanked Golden Dawn Fairy, put away the Nine Nether Iron, and then swiftly handed over the Black Key to Dugu Feng.
A flicker of excitement passed through the depths of Dugu Feng's eyes as he received the key, and without a second glance, he tucked it away.
The group immediately set off, flying toward the white Light Pillar.
...
At this very moment, inside the Soul Burying Abyss, more and more Loose Cultivators and cultivators from various sects and sizes had gathered at the entrance of the Immortal Mansion, numbering in the hundreds.
Based on their standing positions and attire, it could be discerned that the people present were divided into three factions, still clustering separately from Zhao Country, Qin Country, and the Northern Desert.
With so many cultivators converging, the nearby demon beasts had all fled. Among the hundreds of people, most were Foundation Establishment cultivators, while only twenty or thirty were at the Core Formation Stage.
The Spirit Light Sky Pillar that Wan Qi Hong and others had broken was mended once again, and the cultivators from the three factions raised their Magic Treasures, attacking the Light Pillar.
Regrettably, everyone present was at the Core Formation Stage without any Nascent Soul existence. Despite their numbers, the attack effect was ordinary. The Spirit Light Sky Pillar trembled incessantly, yet showed no sign of breaking open.
"How infuriating, are the treasures within this Immortal Mansion going to fall into the hands of those Great Sects again!" A host of Core Formation Stage cultivators showed restlessness in their eyes.
They outwardly submitted to the Five Thunder Sect, Guiyuan Sect, and the Black Desert Alliance in daily life, but with the Immortal Mansion at stake, greed began to stir in each of them.
"Fellow Daoists, do not be hasty. I have a Magic Treasure that can harness the strength of everyone here and has a great chance of breaking the Forbidden of the Immortal Mansion. Would you be willing to cooperate?" a young man in gray emerged from the crowd.
The young man appeared to be in his early twenties, dressed like a scholar, with symmetric features and quite handsome. Peculiarly, he had heterochromatic eyes, one blue and one red, giving off an eerie and captivating presence.
Behind the scholar stood two people: one was a stunningly beautiful girl with picturesque brows and eyes, dressed very boldly, with a neckline revealing a tender ravine that distracted the onlookers; a snow-white little beast, which seemed to be a fox, perched on her shoulder.
The other was a man in his thirties wearing a green shirt, of average build, with fine brows and a square face, an ordinary appearance yet an exceptional demeanor, seemingly tranquil as still water, or a gentle moonlight, impossible to overlook.
All three were Core Formation Stage cultivators, with the man in the green shirt having a higher cultivation at the Mid-stage of Core Formation, while the gray-clothed scholar and the gorgeous girl were at the Early-stage of Core Formation.
Upon hearing this, the other Core Formation Stage cultivators displayed joy.
"The three Fellow Daoists look quite unfamiliar. May I know your honorable names and in which city you reside?" A one-eyed man from the Qin Country faction stepped forward, cupping his hands toward the gray-clothed scholar.
"My humble self is Wu Yuezhi, and these two are my sworn siblings. We three have recently arrived at the Black Wind Desert and are currently staying in Linyuan City. Hearing of the emergence of an Immortal Mansion, we came to join the excitement," the gray-clothed scholar said with a smile.
"So you are Fellow Daoist Wu. May I ask what Magic Treasure you speak of and whether it can indeed break the Forbidden of this Immortal Mansion?" the one-eyed man inquired.
"I wouldn't dare to guarantee a perfect certainty, but there's still a sixty to seventy percent chance," said Wu Yuezhi indifferently.
As her words fell, she sacrificed an item—an azure-blue square stone plate, inscribed with nineteen crisscrossing lines, resembling a chessboard.
"This object is a magic treasure I fortuitously acquired, known as the Heavenly Star Chessboard. It can gather the mana of many, and execute an attack. Without any Nascent Soul cultivators among us, only by concentrating the power of everyone to a single point is there a chance to break through the Immortal Mansion's forbidden barriers," Wu Yuezhi pointed at the chessboard after forming a hand seal.
The item began to spin, rapidly enlarging and transforming into a platform several zhang in size.
From the void, starlight cascaded down onto the chessboard, turning into black and white chess pieces, half-hidden and half-visible.
Seeing the imposing Heavenly Star Chessboard, everyone's confidence swelled from within.
"Good, as long as Fellow Daoist Wu can lead us into the Immortal Mansion, we will surely offer a generous reward," said the one-eyed man.
"There's no need for rewards. Our three siblings alone certainly cannot break the Immortal Mansion's restrictions. It's just mutual benefit," replied Wu Yuezhi.
"In that case, we won't stand on ceremony. May I ask how do we use this Heavenly Star Chessboard, Fellow Daoist Wu?" the one-eyed man inquired with a cupped-fist salute.
"The treasure is quite simple to use. Those among you who wish to enter the Immortal Mansion, take your place on the chessboard and do not resist its circulation of spiritual power. Leave the rest to me," said Wu Yuezhi as she waved her sleeve and the grand chessboard floated into midair.
The secret realm of the Immortal Mansion, with its imminent opportunities, was a place no cultivator would want to miss.
One by one, Core Formation Stage cultivators leaped up and landed on it, totaling twenty-one people.
The chessboard emanated a gentle force, transporting the twenty-one cultivators to different positions on the board.
The cultivators heeded Wu Yuezhi's words and offered no resistance.
"Twenty-one fellow daoists, plus the three of us, is just enough to lay out the Scorpion Formation and further our hope of breaking the forbidden spell," Wu Yuezhi's face broke into a smile as she leaped and landed in the central Heavenly Yuan position of the chessboard.
The man in the green robe and the stunningly beautiful young woman also flew up, taking their positions on two stars.
All nineteen paths of the Heavenly Star Chessboard lit up, and the mana of everyone within it was drawn out.
Twenty-four beams of spirit light rose from the chessboard, and with a congealing motion, turned into twenty-four black chess pieces, scattered and arranged to form a sequence of moves that at first glance resembled a scorpion.
With a hand seal and a spell cast by Wu Yuezhi, the Heavenly Star Chessboard soared into the sky, emitting a colossal howling sound as it smashed into the Spirit Light Sky Pillar like a meteorite, producing a tremendous noise.
The Spirit Light Sky Pillar trembled unceasingly, deeply indented by the impact, with much of its spirit light dispersed.
"Everyone, channel all your mana into the chessboard without holding back any longer. Whether we can break the forbidden barrier hinges on this strike!" Wu Yuezhi, with a solemn expression, shouted loudly.
Hearing this, everyone hastened to funnel all their mana into the chessboard beneath them.
Wu Yuezhi's hands continued to form seals, and the light from the chess formation of twenty-four pieces intensified, faintly taking the form of a colossal black scorpion, emitting terrifying mana fluctuations that far surpassed the Core Formation realm, and continued to climb.
The black scorpion gained clarity and took shape; with each movement of its body, the slender stinger on its back thrust forward in a flash, striking the Spirit Light Sky Pillar.
Spot an error? Visit the original post on M&VLEMPY&R.
The Pillar shook violently, thinning rapidly, but ultimately, it was not pierced through, leaving only a thin layer.
The stinger of the black scorpion trembled incessantly, as spirit light flashed wildly, straining to continue the thrust forward.
Yet, to everyone's surprise, the most internal part of the Spirit Light Sky Pillar was unusually sturdy, and no matter how hard the scorpion's tail tried, it could not make further progress.
Moreover, the light from other parts of the Pillar swiftly converged, and the punctured areas began to close, appearing to be gradually healing.
"Big brother!" Wu Yuezhi, sweating from her forehead, looked towards the man in the green robe.
With an ever-calm expression, the man merely raised one hand, and a luminous glow emerged before him: a bright and shiny copper mirror, archaic in design, with bronze edges elaborately engraved with lifelike dragons and phoenixes.
The copper mirror spun several times, and when it finally stopped, the black scorpion's reflection appeared on its surface.
"Enlarge!" was all the man in green said in a calm tone, and just like that, the scorpion within the mirror grew to twice its size.
A bizarre scene unfolded!
The black scorpion hanging mid-air also experienced a surge of spirit light, its form instantly doubling, its stinger's might also dramatically increasing. With a lift and a drop, it pierced through the Light Pillar with a "pfft," creating a large hole.
The Core Formation Stage cultivators within the chessboard were dumbfounded, despite being from great sects with broad knowledge and experience, they had never before seen such a magic treasure.
Seeing this, Wu Yuezhi was overjoyed and kept her hands moving swiftly, manipulating the Heavenly Star Chessboard.
The originally large chessboard swiftly shrank, turning into a stream of blue light that flew through the large hole in the Pillar.
The Spirit Light of the Pillar surged, quickly sealing the broken hole, returning to its original state within a few breaths, and also obscuring the situation of the Heavenly Star Chessboard.
The cultivators near the Immortal Mansion only saw the Spirit Light Sky Pillar being breached and did not discern the details, but they all cheered ecstatically.

chapters.title: Chapter 404 - 381: Entering the Tower
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming and the others flew forward and soon arrived at the location of the white light pillar.
The scale of the white light pillar was similar to the Spirit Light Sky Pillar outside the Immortal Mansion, and through the pillar, one could faintly see a black tower enveloped in black mist, approximately four layers high.
Wan Qi Hong and the others had arrived earlier but were kept outside by the white light pillar, all covered in dust, seemingly at a disadvantage.
Through Xi Ying and the soul splitting within Yan Sijing, Yuan Ming had already understood what had occurred here just earlier.
After Thunderbolt Ancestor and others arrived, they immediately tried to break the white light pillar. However, the pillar was exceptionally tough; no matter what methods they used, after a round of intense bombing, the pillar remained immovably intact.
Not only that, each attempt to strike at the white light pillar resulted in a white thunderbolt shooting out as a counterattack.
The power of this thunderbolt was not small, and though it could not truly harm these Nascent Soul cultivators, its speed was extremely fast. The Nascent Soul cultivators present could not completely dodge it, thus each of them ended up somewhat embarrassed.
"Fellow Daoist Dugu, Golden Dawn Fairy, your arrival is timely. This white light pillar is quite peculiar, and to break it, it seems we need to join forces again," Su Zimo suggested.
Just as Golden Dawn Fairy was about to speak, the white light pillar suddenly started to tremble and then disintegrated like an avalanche. In a few breaths, it completely vanished from everyone's sight.
"How could this be?" The people present were astonished, exchanging looks of disbelief, only Wan Qi Hong remained calm, not surprised.
Since arriving here, Yuan Ming had been quietly observing Wan Qi Hong. Seeing this development, he quietly activated his "Emotion Manipulation" ability on him.
He was not trying to control Wan Qi Hong, as the Divine Soul Power of a Nascent Soul cultivator was stable, and not so easily manipulated. His use of the "Emotion Manipulation" ability now was to sense Wan Qi Hong's emotions.
The "Emotion Manipulation" ability was invisible and intangible. As long as he did not directly manipulate someone's emotions, it was almost undetectable, so there was no worry of Wan Qi Hong discovering it.
Yuan Ming soon had his findings. Wan Qi Hong's face was calm, but his Divine Soul fluctuated with intense reluctance, seemingly directed at Dugu Feng.
"Why does Wan Qi Hong harbor this emotion? Could the collapse of the white light pillar be related to Dugu Feng? Could it be because of that black key?" a thought popped up in his mind.
With the dispersal of the white light pillar, the eerie black mist around the black tower also strangely dissipated, completely exposing it to everyone's sight.
The tower was entirely made of a certain type of black crystal stone, appearing indestructible. The top of the tower was covered with golden glazed tiles, reflecting dazzling, mesmerizing light.
On the first floor of the black tower, directly facing the crowd, was a bronze door, currently tightly shut. Beside the door stood a stone statue, depicting a middle-aged man dressed in dark robes, chin raised, chest thrust forward, hands clasped behind, whose features were very similar to a youth depicted in the mural at the entrance of the Immortal Mansion.
Only, the middle-aged man's face no longer bore the youthfulness of the boy, radiating an aloof arrogance from within, his gaze disdainful as if he held no one in regard.
"This person appears so frequently; could he be the master of this Immortal Mansion?" Yuan Ming speculated silently.
On the other side of the bronze door stood a half-man-high stele, upon which a few lines were inscribed:
"Since my youth when I first embarked on the Immortal Path, 652 years have passed. Unwavering in my arduous cultivation, I eventually reached the Returning to Void Stage. Despite diligent efforts thereafter, I made no further progress. Closer scrutiny revealed the sparse spiritual energy of the Yunhuang Continent was insufficient for a Returning to Void cultivator. Seeking advancement, I scoured ancient texts and heard tales of an Overseas Immortal Mountain with abundant spiritual energy far surpassing that of the continent, apt for cultivation at the Returning to Void Stage. Thus, I crossed the vast ocean in search of the mountain, only to be blocked by a gigantic beast, with whom I battled for over a month before returning heavily wounded.
After this great calamity, my Dao Foundation scattered, and my days were numbered. Unwilling to let this lifetime's achievements become void, I constructed this Shura Palace to be passed down to future generations.
The object within the tower is my most treasured possession, awe-inspiring and also greatly dangerous, not within the grasp of ordinary individuals. Hence, I set three trials. Those who pass may possess this treasure; treasure it and cherish it dearly.
From the hand of the Shura Master."
Having read this, Yuan Ming felt his spirits surge.
This Immortal Mansion was truly built by the Shura Master, originally a venerable Returning to Void Stage expert. No wonder he was able to build such a magnificent mansion and create such an expansive space.
The others also finished reading the inscription on the stele, their expressions varied.
"The Shura Master, is he the legendary Loose Cultivator who single-handedly subdued all factions under the heavens three thousand years ago?" Thunderbolt Ancestor's eyes shone with excitement.
"Subdued all factions? My Chang Chun Temple has never submitted to this Shura Master," Wan Qi Hong said darkly, snorting.
Only then did Thunderbolt Ancestor remember that Wan Qi Hong, a cultivator from Chang Chun Temple, was standing nearby, and laughed awkwardly a few times, closing his mouth, but his eyes flickered with contemplation.
"It was rumored that the Shura Master built a palace before his death, so this must be it," Dugu Feng didn't care for the rest, staring at the black tower, muttering to himself as if nobody else was around.
"Fellow Daoist Dugu, do you know what the object mentioned on this stele is? We failed to obtain the secret treasure in Yin Capital City earlier; we absolutely cannot miss out on the treasure here," Su Zimo approached and asked.
"How would I know that?" Dugu Feng shook his head.
Su Zimo merely smiled ambiguously and did not press further.
Having used "Emotion Manipulation" to sense Wan Qi Hong's emotions, Yuan Ming found this method extremely profound, as it allowed him to probe the thoughts of his adversaries to a certain extent. At this moment, while everyone's emotions were stirred, he fully exerted his "Emotion Manipulation" ability, sensing the emotions of the several Nascent Soul beings present.
Dugu Feng's predominant emotion was excitement. When Su Zimo questioned him, his emotional fluctuation was intense, clearly insincere. This man likely knew about the hidden treasure inside the black tower.
Su Zimo's emotions were relatively stable, and his questions had been mainly exploratory; it appeared that he knew nothing about the Immortal Mansion and the Black Tower in front of him.
The situation was basically the same with Thunderbolt Ancestor, evidently he also knew little about this place.
Wan Qi Hong's emotions had not changed much from before, but his feelings of unwillingness had intensified slightly.
As for Golden Dawn Fairy, her emotional stability was exceptional, her mindset like a deep pool without a ripple.
"This woman is no simple character, to remain so calm even with a heavy treasure before her," Yuan Ming murmured to himself.
"Senior Jin Xi, may I ask what this Shura Master means by 'Yunhuang Continent' mentioned on the stele?" he inquired of Golden Dawn Fairy.
When Yuan Ming asked this question, he actually already had some guesses in his heart, but he still wanted to confirm it.If yоu'rе nоt оn М*VLЕМ*РYR, yоu'rе viеwing а соpy.
"Yunhuang Continent is the general term for the world we are currently in, including Central Plains, Southern Border, Northern Desert, East Sea, and Western Region, all are just parts of Yunhuang Continent," Golden Dawn Fairy answered Yuan Ming with an unusual courtesy, responding to every question.
Yuan Ming inwardly agreed and continued to examine the stele.
Though the text on the stele wasn't much, the information it revealed was immense: Yunhuang Continent, Overseas Immortal Mountain, Returning Void Spiritual Energy, and so on, almost refreshing his understanding of this world.
"Senior Jin Xi, are there really Immortal Mountains overseas?" Yuan Ming asked Golden Dawn Fairy again.
"Although I possess the cultivation of a Nascent Soul, I have been diligently cultivating all these years and have never left Yunhuang Continent. Since this Shura Master left such a message, there should be," Golden Dawn Fairy replied.
Yuan Ming, who delighted in curiosities, had been this way when traveling in the Southern Border and was now intensely interested in the world beyond Yunhuang Continent, intending to ask more.
"If you wish to continue with idle talk, you are free to do so, but I shall not keep you company," Wan Qi Hong snorted and waved his hand, shooting a beam of golden light at the gate of the Black Tower.
The entrance to the Black Tower had no protective restrictions and opened immediately upon impact, Wan Qi Hong stepping inside briskly, followed closely by Dugu Feng.
Thunderbolt Ancestor, Su Zimo thinking of the treasures mentioned on the stele, also hurriedly led their followers inside.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan seems very interested in matters overseas, but focusing on storming the tower is crucial right now. We can discuss in detail once the matters here conclude," Golden Dawn Fairy spoke.
"Yes," Yuan Ming replied.
Seeing Golden Dawn Fairy being so kind to Yuan Ming, Pi Xiu had no objections, but a shadow of jealousy fleetingly crossed Wen Zaihou's eyes.
Soon, everyone had entered the first layer of the Black Tower one after the other, and a flicker of surprise crossed Yuan Ming's face.
The Black Tower appeared just like a common building from the outside, but inside, what faced them was a huge hall a hundred feet in size, far exceeding the Black Tower's dimensions.
"Could this be a Space Restriction?" Yuan Ming quickly realized.
The Shura Master, capable of opening up such drastically different environments within the Immortal Mansion, must have exceptional mastery over space restrictions, easily enlarging the inside space of the Black Tower architecture.
The hall was empty, except for five thick Stone Pillars that stood supporting the roof.
Upon seeing this scene, everyone slowly spread out to search for the challenges mentioned on the stele.
Just then, the five Stone Pillars suddenly started to make a "clicking" noise, and the bottom of the pillars split open, neatly lined up Stone Statues in the shape of Green Battle Pigs marched out — five from each pillar.
These statues, about ten feet tall and with human bodies but pig heads, had strong muscles on their arms and legs, each holding a thick, spiked black mace. They moved in unison, like a well-trained group of soldiers.
Yan Sijing, Wen Zaihou, and other Core Formation Stage cultivators turned pale. They had come to blows with these green stone statues in City Lord Mansion; with just a two to eight advantage, they hadn't gained much upper hand, only managing to grind down one statue with sheer numbers.
Now, there were as many as twenty-five War Pig Stone Statues appearing in front of them; how were they supposed to fight?
However, thinking about the different circumstances now, with the presence of Wan Qi Hong, Thunderbolt Ancestor, and other Nascent Soul cultivators to take the lead, they suddenly felt relieved.
There were no Blood-colored Skulls here, Wan Qi Hong, and others would naturally step forward to hold the line, it didn't matter how formidable these War Pig Stone Statues were.
After a brief standoff, intense combat immediately erupted.
The twenty-five Green Battle Pigs rushed forward at extreme speed, their thick maces swinging ruthlessly at everyone.
The five Nascent Soul cultivators stood at the forefront, Wan Qi Hong stepped half a step forward, opened his mouth, and spewed out a golden Flying Sword, which whirled into a giant sword ten feet long, slashing at a Green Battle Pig charging at the front.
The Green Battle Pig reacted quickly, blocking with the black mace in front of it.
While the green stone statues could block the Magic Treasures of Core Formation Stage cultivators, they were no match for Nascent Soul cultivators. With a "sizzle" sound, the thick mace was cut in half, the cut as smooth as a mirror, then the sword light fell, and the Battle Pig was split into two halves, falling to the ground.
Dugu Feng, Thunderbolt Ancestor, and others also each raised their Magic Treasures and attacked, and within merely a dozen breaths, they had each killed one or two War Pig Stone Statues. In a blink, a third of the twenty-five statues were obliterated.

chapters.title: Chapter 405 - 382: Ambush from Behind
chapters.content:
Meanwhile, a group of Core Formation cultivators engaged the remaining Green Battle Pigs but found the fight extremely tough. No matter if it was Magic Treasures or Magic Talismans, they struggled to break through the defenses of the Green Battle Pigs.
"The presence of a Nascent Soul cultivator truly is incomparable to Core Formation cultivators," Yuan Ming couldn't help but inwardly sigh.
He and Pi Xiu together resisted a Green Battle Pig. Since most of his Magic Treasures were not to be exposed, he used his Green Jade Ruler, sealed with the power of seven, to combat the enemy.
The Green Jade Ruler was a Wood Attribute Magic Treasure. Although its offensive power was average, it could be used for both attack and defense, and it matched Yuan Ming's Nine Elements Technique very well. It was more than enough for self-defense, though it might not be enough to harm the enemy.
Fortunately, with the Nascent Soul cultivators present, the Core Formation cultivators knew they just needed to defend themselves and could outlast with time.
Wan Qi Hong and others continued to make their moves. Giant swords swept across, inscriptions flashed with gold, and in a blink of an eye, another seven or eight battle pigs fell.
"If the first trial is only this easy, then passing it seems too simple," Yuan Ming thought to himself upon seeing this.
No sooner had this thought arisen than a flash of silver light passed at the base of the five stone pillars nearby, and five silvery shadows shot out, rushing straight towards Wan Qi Hong and the others.
Yuan Ming's Divine Sense was powerful, and he keenly saw the true forms of these silvery shadows—five Silver Battle Pigs. Their appearance was fundamentally the same as the Green Battle Pigs, only they looked even more majestic and formidable, wielding a dazzling, silver Meteor Hammer instead of weapons.
Wan Qi Hong huffed lightly, the golden giant sword shifted direction, cleaving diagonally at the incoming Silver Battle Pig.
The Silver Battle Pig was much faster than the Green Battle Pigs, and with a nimble leap, it managed to dodge the slash of the golden giant sword.
Wan Qi Hong raised his eyebrows, the golden giant sword quickly swung back, and its blade suddenly blurred, splitting into two identical, massive Sword Shadows.
Each Sword Shadow emitted strong fluctuations of Mana, cutting across towards the Silver Battle Pig.
The Silver Battle Pig hurriedly dodged again, slamming its silver Meteor Hammer into one of the Sword Shadows.
With a resounding "clang," the golden shadow was sent flying, while the other Sword Shadow left a long, deep wound on the chest of the Silver Battle Pig.
Yet, the Silver Battle Pig did not seem to be significantly harmed, swinging the Meteor Hammer and charging over once again.
Wan Qi Hong's face tightened slightly; the combat strength of this Silver Battle Pig seemed to be not less than that of Late-stage Core Formation cultivators, and its physical body was exceptionally tough. Even he had to be careful.
Amidst these thoughts, Wan Qi Hong made a finger gesture towards the giant sword, which then split into seven or eight Sword Shadows, slashing at the Silver Battle Pig.
However, the Silver Battle Pig moved as fast as a specter, with an incredibly tough body. It wielded the Meteor Hammer in such a divine manner that despite being pressed by Wan Qi Hong's attacks, there was no sign of defeat.
The silver Warhammer must have been forged from some mysterious material. Despite hard clashes with Wan Qi Hong's Golden Light Flying Sword, it was only marked with notches and did not shatter.
The other Nascent Soul cultivators were in a similar situation. Although they seemed to have the upper hand, they couldn't slay the Silver Battle Pigs and were firmly entangled.
Without the aid of the Nascent Soul cultivators, the pressure on Yuan Ming and the others increased drastically, each having to face a Green Battle Pig alone.
Yuan Ming fought hand to hand with a Green Battle Pig, being pushed back step by step. However, he was actually using his Divine Sense to probe the Green Battle Pig's condition.
The power within the Green Battle Pig obstructed his Divine Sense, but with Yuan Ming's strong Divine Sense, he forcibly penetrated the barrier and soon infiltrated it.
After this exploration, he found that the Green Battle Pig was made from a special stone material and that its skeletal structure was composed of closely connected gears decorated with runes, appearing to be a special kind of puppet.
Yuan Ming had some understanding of puppets. Every puppet had a core that sustained its activity, usually powered by Arrays and Spirit Stones, but there was nothing like that inside the Green Battle Pig.
He couldn't help but wonder, without Spirit Stones supplying Spiritual Power, what was maintaining the activity of these Green Battle Pigs?
"Forget it, let's deal with these nuisances first," Yuan Ming shook his head, no longer pondering and channeled Mana into his Green Jade Ruler.
Over a dozen crescent-shaped green Light Blades shot out, striking the Green Battle Pig, but they did not even cut through the pig's skin.
However, those green Light Blades did not dissipate; they all stuck to the battle pig's body, seemingly very sticky.
The Green Battle Pig continued to rush towards Yuan Ming, swinging its black mace into shadows akin to Flood Dragons, enveloping Yuan Ming from all directions with no place to dodge.
Xi Ying, who was in the midst of fighting a Green Battle Pig at a distance, saw this scene and tensed her gaze, appearing as if she was about to do something.
Visit Мy Virtuаl Librаry Еmpirе (МV-LЕМР-YR) fоr mоrе.
However, a flash of yellow light crossed Yuan Ming's body, and he dived several meters into the ground, evading the attack of the black mace with this wily method, then pointed upwards with a finger gesture.
The crescent-shaped green marks on the Green Battle Pig suddenly transformed, turning into chains of green that wrapped around its entire body, firmly restraining its limbs.
The movements of the Green Battle Pig became instantly difficult as it swung its limbs trying to break free from the chains.
Just at that moment, a flash of green light emerged from below, and the Green Jade Ruler appeared out of thin air, radiating a bright green glow.
The next instant, all the green light withdrew rapidly and focused intensely, forming a green circle about three meters wide around the battle pig's body.
The green ring exerted an astonishing binding force; the Green Battle Pig was already troubled by the green chains and now became completely immobilized.
A flash of yellow light appeared from below as Yuan Ming emerged from the ground, his ring shooting out a trail of white smoke, hitting the Green Battle Pig squarely in the back.
A white layer of ice formed on the back of the Green Battle Pig's heart, spreading rapidly.
But the external ice was merely a facade; what Yuan Ming really wanted to freeze were the runes on the bones of the Green Battle Pig.
Although he had not seen through the principles of these stone statues, those runes definitely played a crucial role. As long as he froze them, the Green Battle Pig should be unable to move.
At that moment, the force within the Green Battle Pig that had been blocking his Divine Sense surged once again, actually preventing the cold from infiltrating.
Yuan Ming's face showed a hint of surprise. He increased the power of the white ring, launching a thicker plume of cold smoke, quickly overwhelming the force and invading the pig's skeleton.
A layer of solid ice covered the ribcage of the Green Battle Pig, and the faintly flickering runes on the bones all solidified, ceasing their movement.
Yuan Ming continued to stimulate the cold air, soon freezing all the bones inside the battle pig.
The body of the Green Battle Pig was completely covered by white solid ice, turned into an ice sculpture.
He was quite interested in the secret treasure of the Shura Master. With his current strength, coupled with the augmentation of the Stealing Heaven Tripod, as well as other treasures like the Night Parade of Hundred Demons, he might be able to seize that object.
Right now, it was just the first hurdle; he couldn't let the team suffer too much damage. The power of the white ring had already been demonstrated, and it wouldn't raise suspicion among those Nascent Soul old monsters.
Yuan Ming called back the Green Jade Ruler from underground, glanced at Xi Ying, and then pounced toward Pi Xiu not far away.
Pi Xiu was struggling against the Green Battle Pig and was overjoyed to see Yuan Ming come to help.
Yuan Ming flicked his fingers in the air, and the Green Jade Ruler shot out, striking the Green Battle Pig.
Pi Xiu, witnessing through his Divine Sense how Yuan Ming subdued his Green Battle Pig, understood his intentions and also tried to restrain the pig's movements.
Together, they soon trapped the pig, and Yuan Ming used the white ring to freeze it, just like he had done before.
Yuan Ming's figure flickered and disappeared; the next moment he appeared beside Wen Zaihou, shooting out a stream of cold smoke from the white ring.
With Yuan Ming's strong support, several Green Battle Pigs were quickly subdued.
Wan Qi Hong and other Nascent Soul cultivators saw the Core Formation cultivators finish their battles first and felt their pride wounded. They used their hidden tricks, and the silver battle pigs finally began to falter, being shattered one after another.
When the last silver statue fell, a muffled sound came from a wall not far away. Then, everyone saw the wall slowly lift, shaking off debris and dust as it revealed the staircase leading to the second floor.
Wan Qi Hong glanced at the staircase, took a few steps forward, his sleeve flew out, and he collected the scattered remains of the silver statues into his Storage Bag.
Seeing this, Thunderbolt Ancestor and others did likewise, dividing up the remaining silver remains.
Materials from puppets that were at Late-stage Core Formation were naturally tempting to them; the remains of the Green Stone Puppets, though also valuable, weren't worth tarnishing their reputation over.
Thus, with the silent consent of the elders, a group of Core Formation cultivators started cleaning up the battlefield.
Wan Qi Hong noticed this scene and felt more regret about coming alone. As the thought flashed through his mind, he still couldn't lower his dignity to compete with the Core Formation cultivators for the remains, so he averted his gaze and quickly headed to the second floor.
The other Nascent Soul cultivators didn't want to be outdone by him and also hurried up the stairs.
Among the Core Formation cultivators, Yuan Ming also collected a few pieces of statue remains. However, his attention remained on Wan Qi Hong and the others. As they went upstairs, he was about to follow when he was struck by an inexplicable sense of alarm.
Immediately after, a scream suddenly rang out behind him.
He swiftly turned around, only to see a thin red and weak figure standing behind Wen Zaihou, his arm piercing through Wen Zaihou's chest.
The creature's arm was withered like a dry branch without any flesh or blood, merely skin wrapped around bone. However, it shimmered with a sinister red glow, almost like an arm ring, moving from the wrist to the elbow.
Wen Zaihou wore an expression of agony, and at the same time, his body visibly withered away as if he was being drained of blood by the monster's arm.
In just two breaths of time, Wen Zaihou had completely turned into a dry corpse, and the thin figure withdrew its arm, casting aside Wen Zaihou's body as if throwing away trash.
At that moment, Golden Dawn Fairy, having heard the scream and turned back, saw the dreadful death of Wen Zaihou and was instantly filled with rage. She shouted angrily, and the Golden Scroll flew into the air with countless golden characters shooting out, condensing into six Golden Light Flying Knives in the air and shooting towards the gaunt figure.
However, upon seeing this, the gaunt figure's cracked lips curled into a mocking smile, and it then vanished silently from the spot.
The Golden Light Flying Knives, having lost their target, stopped mid-air.
Seeing this, Golden Dawn Fairy's eyebrows furrowed. She raised her hand and cast another spell on the Golden Scroll.
The Golden Light Flying Knives shattered instantly, and the golden characters that flew out recombined to form two golden shields, flying to Yuan Ming and Pi Xiu's sides and rapidly circling around them.
Just then, two more screams were heard among the group; one was from a female Core Formation cultivator under Thunderbolt Ancestor and the other from a massive man of the Black Desert Alliance.
Two thin figures appeared behind them, their dark red arms thrust out like swords, quickly rendering them the same fate as Wen Zaihou.

chapters.title: Chapter 406 - 383: Volunteering
chapters.content:
Thunderbolt Ancestor, who had just turned around upon hearing the noise, witnessed the killing of his subordinate and was immediately infuriated.
He clapped his hands together and a Thunder Light Seal appeared in front of him, from which countless dazzling bolts of lightning surged forth, striking head-on at the emaciated figure attacking the Core Formation female cultivator.
At almost the same time, Dugu Feng's eyes flashed coldly, and he spat out a Black Sword Magic Treasure from his mouth that howled as it charged toward another emaciated figure.
Simultaneously, Su Zimo quickly formed hand seals and sacrificed two talismans that transformed into two Light Shields, protecting his only subordinate.
However, both the Thunder Light and the Black Sword hit nothing, and after draining the blood of two Core Formation cultivators, the two emaciated figures disappeared instantly just like before, leaving no trace behind.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming felt a sinking feeling in his heart and immediately started fiddling with the ring in his hand, his Divine Sense locking onto Yan Sijing and Xi Ying, ready to assist at any moment.
Wan Qi Hong, walking at the front of the staircase, also turned his head back now, his face solemn, his gaze sweeping across the main hall on the ground floor.
It was clear he too sensed the strangeness of the situation, and reckoned that recklessly heading to the second floor might not be a wise choice.
The atmosphere immediately became heavy. For a while, no one dared to move or speak, plunging the scene into total silence.
Just as everyone was guessing where the emaciated figures might appear next, Wan Qi Hong suddenly raised his hand and ruthlessly made a move; three sword lights howled from his hand, each targeting Xi Ying, Yuan Ming, and the man with blue eyes.
Yuan Ming was caught off guard but quickly suppressed the urge to defend, letting the sword light pass by him.
Three screams rang out simultaneously, but this time the injured were not the Core Formation cultivators present, but rather the emaciated figures that had appeared behind the three.
The sword lights unleashed by Wan Qi Hong were immensely powerful, slicing the three emaciated figures diagonally in two with a single strike. However, despite such severe injuries, the figures still seemed to be alive, disappearing just like before with a scream, leaving no bodies or debris behind.
"How did Fellow Daoist Wan Qi spot them?" Golden Dawn Fairy immediately asked.
"They cause slight spatial fluctuations when they appear and disappear. You just have to find the location of these fluctuations in advance," explained Wan Qi Hong.
Golden Dawn Fairy nodded, appearing enlightened, while the others remained silent, though their expressions were not good.
The cultivation of each Core Formation Cultivator requires the Sect to pour in countless resources and over a hundred years of time, combined with various opportunities and transformations, making them the central force of a Sect. Having entered the Immortal Mansion in search of treasures, they have yet to obtain anything substantial but have already suffered losses, naturally making it hard for them to accept.
Although Wan Qi Hong had severely damaged the three emaciated figures, each time they appeared, their number increased. The group did not take things lightly and remained alert, preparing to continue exploring the tower.
Golden Dawn Fairy quickly stepped forward to collect Wen Zaihou's corpse, her face full of sorrow.
"Hmph, such a waste, after I spent so many Spirit Stones on her cultivation," Thunderbolt Ancestor walked over to the Core Formation female cultivator's body, his face displaying dissatisfaction.
He did not intend to collect the corpse but took the Storage Bag from the body and picked up the female cultivator's Magic Treasure, handing it to Yan Sijing.
"Her Magic Treasure is now yours. Make sure you don't die before I need you, as I can't guarantee your sister's safety," he said.
Yan Sijing bowed her head and whispered an affirmative, yet her eyes flickered with intense killing intent.
However, when she raised her head, that killing intent had vanished, leaving only fear and confusion.
On the side of the Black Desert Alliance, Dugu Feng glanced at the corpse of the burly man by the iron tower, but just as he was about to step forward, another Black Robed Cultivator by Xi Ying's side took the initiative to collect the body.
Dugu Feng paused, a trace of inexplicable meaning flickering in his eyes, then silently acknowledged the Black Robed Cultivator's action.
Next, the Black Robed Cultivator also collected the Core Formation female cultivator's body.
"Boy, what are you trying to do?" Thunderbolt Ancestor immediately expressed his displeasure.
"Reporting to senior, I simply cannot bear to see a Fellow Daoist's body abandoned in the wilderness. If senior dislikes this, I will immediately return the corpse." the Black Robed Cultivator explained anxiously.
Thunderbolt Ancestor snorted coldly, but chose not to voice any inhumane remarks, thus tacitly permitting the Black Robed Cultivator's action.
After waiting for about half an hour, the previous emaciated figures did not reappear.
Given the earlier incident, the group lost the motivation to clean up the battlefield and gathered near their respective Sect's Nascent Soul Ancestors, taking a break before continuing upwards.
The second floor of the tower was much smaller than the first and lacked any stone statues or eerie shadows, housing only a statue of the Shura Master, standing desolately in the center of the hall.
The statue looked much younger than the one outside the tower, with an unshed youthful aura on its face marked by a touch of melancholy.
When Wan Qi Hong and the others all set foot in this place, the statue's eyes suddenly lit up with a red glow, and an Array of Silver Light appeared in front of it.
Immediately after, a voice filled with vicissitudes emanated from the statue:
"Flowers may bloom again, but youth will never return. I have cultivated for hundreds of years, glimpsing the eternal Dao. Looking back, often due to insufficient strength, I have left many regrets."
"After stepping into the Refining Void Realm, I created the Illusion Array Divine Ability that allows one to revisit the past. Yet, revisiting old matters never yielded superior solutions, leaving the regrets intact. Therefore, I set up this trial here. If you can fulfill my unachieved desires, you will be worthy of inheriting my treasure."
The crowd reacted differently upon hearing the recorded message of the Shura Master, and a few Nascent Soul cultivators exchanged glances, seemingly reluctant to take the lead in exploring.
At that moment, Su Zimo scanned the remaining Core Formation cultivators and suddenly smiled, "Brother Dugu, among those present, you have suffered the least loss under your command. Why not let your two subordinates give it a try in this trial?"
"Those were your own useless people who couldn't make it until now. In my opinion, since they are all useless, why should Fellow Daoist Su cherish them? Better to use them sooner to prevent them from becoming burdens later on," Dugu Feng retorted with a sneer.
"Brother Dugu speaks the truth, but I also worry about my disciples' incompetence, which might waste everyone's time. As it happens, your subordinates are quite capable, like that one who broke the illusion earlier. Maybe taking the lead this time could also be effective," Su Zimo said with unchanged expression, sneaking a glance in Xi Ying's direction.
"Su Zimo, you're right, but you picked the wrong person. It should have been that one who gathered the corpses just now. Since he has such a compassionate heart, he would probably be willing to make sacrifices for others," Thunderbolt Ancestor laughed heartily.
Dugu Feng's expression turned cold, and he was about to retort when he suddenly heard Wan Qi Hong also speaking up in agreement.
"They are right, Dugu Feng, it's time for you to exert some effort," Wan Qi Hong added.Рubliсаtiоn соurtеsy оf М|V|LЕ-МРYR.
Seeing the three of them appearing to reach a consensus on this matter, Dugu Feng's expression chilled further, and noticing that Golden Dawn Fairy remained silent beside him, he knew she wouldn't help him in this matter, so he finally said:
"Since that is the case, Xiao Ying, go on and give it a try for these seniors," Dugu Feng ordered.
"Wait, seniors, let me go instead," Yuan Ming suddenly stepped forward and said.
As soon as he spoke, the gaze of several Nascent Soul cultivators instantly focused on him, and all the Core Formation cultivators in the area also turned their eyes towards him, their expressions varied, especially Xi Ying, whose look at Yuan Ming was tinged with complex emotions.
However, at that moment, Yuan Ming, faced with everyone's gaze, showed a look of shame and did not glance at Xi Ying.
"The seniors assisted me in escaping from a predicament, which was a great favor. I previously missed a heavy treasure because of my mistakes and truly feel guilty. Now, I only wish to offer a meager effort on behalf of the seniors to probe the reality of the trial and thus atone for my wrongdoing," Yuan Ming spoke convincingly, his attitude extremely sincere.
"Good! You are a grateful young man, how could we disregard your intention," Thunderbolt Ancestor immediately laughed heartily, eager to decide on this matter.
Su Zimo also nodded with a smile, but his gaze still flitted between Yuan Ming and Dugu Feng.
Golden Dawn Fairy looked at Yuan Ming with a complex expression, seemingly hesitating to speak.
Meanwhile, Dugu Feng, unabashedly, waved his hand grandly and said, "It's rare for you to have such intention. Once we leave here, you may come to my Black Desert Alliance to claim a reward anytime, and if you're interested in joining, I can even appoint you as a Squad Leader to wield some authority."
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming thanked Dugu Feng, prepared to step forward into the Silver Light Array when suddenly, Wan Qi Hong stopped him.
Wan Qi Hong flipped his hand and took out two talismans, handing one of them to Yuan Ming.
"This item is called the Unity Talisman, a special product of the East Sea. Once used, it lasts for a day. During this period, if you die, the other talisman will also burn up spontaneously," Wan Qi Hong explained the effects of the talisman and then signaled Yuan Ming to activate it by casting.
Yuan Ming looked at the talisman in his hand, hesitated, unsure whether its use would reveal anything else.
"I wonder if Fellow Daoist Wan Qi would allow me to take a look at that talisman?" Golden Dawn Fairy suddenly asked.
After receiving Wan Qi Hong's permission, Golden Dawn Fairy took the talisman, circulated her Mana, and after a brief touch to her eyes, her black pupils suddenly turned golden, resembling the eyes of a dragon.
She looked down at the talisman in her hand, her eyebrows furrowed, and then she suddenly revealed a look of epiphany.
"So that's how it is, this Core Rune can only be engraved with special spiritual materials. No wonder those sects in the East Sea always mystify, aiming to conceal this rune, probably for fear that we would target this spiritual material to produce the Life Talisman," Golden Dawn Fairy revealed a look of joy.
Upon hearing this, the Nascent Souls were somewhat curious and wanted to ask precisely which spiritual material it was, but Golden Dawn Fairy turned to look at Yuan Ming and shifted the topic, revealing nothing further.
"Yuan Ming, you can be assured in using this talisman; it only serves as a marker and has no other side effects," she said.
Yuan Ming nodded. Having no other choice and reassured by Golden Dawn Fairy, he promptly activated the talisman and placed it on himself.
As a flash of blue light passed, Yuan Ming immediately sensed a mysterious connection forming between himself and the talisman in Golden Dawn Fairy's hand.
Seeing that the talisman indeed had no other reaction, Yuan Ming let go of his concerns, stepped forward quickly, and stepped into the Array in front of the statue.

chapters.title: Chapter 407 - 384: The End of the Talisman
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming had just stepped onto the array in front of the Shura Master's statue when two substantial red beams shot out from the statue's eyes, sweeping over his body.
Yuan Ming's heart first seized with a chill, and he hastily performed Inner Observation on his body, discovering that nothing was amiss; only then did he let out a sigh of relief.
But immediately afterward, the voice of the Shura Master once again echoed from the statue:
"When I was young, I became a disciple of the Chaotian Sect. I thought that with the Sect's power, my Immortal Path would be worry-free. But who could have foreseen that overnight, the millennium-old Sect was extinguished in a moment. Alas! At that time, I had just set foot in the Foundation Establishment realm, powerless to prevent the impending collapse. I could only watch as my fellow disciples perished before my eyes. This remains one of the great regrets of my life. If you can overturn the outcome within three chances, resolving my turmoil, then you may claim the treasures I left behind."
No sooner had the voice faded than Yuan Ming vanished from within the array.
The crowd was at first stunned, then quickly turned to look at the talisman in the Golden Dawn Fairy's hand, only to see a cobalt flame suddenly ignite on the talisman at the next moment, which in an instant burnt the talisman to ashes.
…
The Shura Master's voice had barely ceased when Yuan Ming, not even having time to react, suddenly felt a blur before his eyes. After feeling as though the heavens and earth were spinning, he found himself in a rather small parlor. Although his clothing had not changed, the mana in his body was suppressed to the level of the early-stage Foundation Establishment.
"Could this be the inner workings of the Chaotian Sect from the Shura Master's time?"
At this thought, he tried to channel mana, attempting to forcefully break through the suppression on his cultivation, but just then, he felt an unexplainable palpitation. It wasn't until he abandoned the idea that the sensation of palpitations gradually faded.
This restriction seemed to also apply to his Divine Soul. Whenever he exceeded the range of Divine Sense that was permissible at the Foundation Establishment Stage, it too would trigger palpitations.
Yuan Ming did not know whether Wan Qi Hong and the others could see his actions here, so he did not attempt to use Soul Cultivation Techniques. However, judging by what had happened earlier, the restrictions should be the same.
That is, he could not employ any cultivation abilities that the Shura Master of that time period did not possess.
After tentatively arriving at this conclusion, Yuan Ming steadied his mind and began to observe the room he was in.
The parlor was small, but its decoration was unusually simple and elegant, quite similar to his previous residence in the Capital.
There were many calligraphy and paintings in the room, which, in Yuan Ming's view, were all of excellent quality, signed by someone named "Zhen Luo."
Besides calligraphy and paintings, there was also a Storage Bag in the parlor. Apart from Spirit Stones and some common Cultivation books, there were only a few not-so-exquisite Magic Artifacts, among which only a dark Flying Knife was high grade; the rest were mid-grade or lower.
Yuan Ming took out the Magic Artifacts and familiarized himself with them briefly.
Although he could not perform Soul Cultivation Techniques at present, his Divine Soul Strength was still at a Love Witch Level. He quickly became adept at handling the top-grade magical tool, making it feel as though it were an extension of his own limb. After practicing for a while, he put away the Magic Artifacts.
Next, Yuan Ming began to flip through the books in the Storage Bag. To his surprise, all sections pertaining to Cultivation Techniques in the books were completely blank, as if intentionally hidden from view.
It was clear that the space-time he was in was created by some Great Divine Power by the Shura Master, with rules naturally set by him. This was not him genuinely traveling to that past time.
However, except for the sections on Cultivation Techniques, the contents of the books were quite detailed, especially regarding the identity he currently held, which seemed to be specifically marked and explained.
As Yuan Ming had speculated, he indeed was within the Sect called "Chaotian Sect." An old Nascent Soul Middle Stage ancestor presided over the Sect, making it the foremost Great Sect in Zhao Country, its fame widespread.
The Sect had twenty-one peaks, each headed by a Core Formation Peak Master. These masters usually did not deal with mundane matters but were responsible for cultivating and teaching their disciples.
The Foundation Establishment Stage and Qi Refining Stage Cultivators beneath them were divided into three categories: Direct Disciples, Registered Disciples, and Mundane Disciples.
The former two were under the direct tutelage of Core Formation Peak Masters, exempt from any mundane matters except tasks personally assigned by the masters. The only differences between them lay in the frequency of their meetings with the masters and the disparity in their monthly salaries.
Mundane Disciples, on the other hand, were primarily responsible for handling miscellaneous Sect duties. Those who performed well and showed decent Cultivation aptitude after fulfilling certain years of service could also be promoted to Registered Disciples, henceforth focusing solely on Cultivation.
Mundane Disciples were further categorized based on their roles in different halls like the Alchemy Hall or Artifact Refining Hall, leading to distinctions between Hall Masters and deacons.
The Shura Master that Yuan Ming was currently emulating was a Direct Disciple of Lingxing Peak, whose Peak Master was a Core Formation Cultivator named "Shen Lingyun." Since he had recently entered Core Formation and Lingxing Peak was newly established, there was only one Direct Disciple on the entire peak—the Shura Master himself.
"Junior Brother Zhen, get up, get up! This year's grand ceremony will see numerous sects coming to observe, and the Deacon Hall has issued many reception tasks. Not only do they offer generous rewards, but the requirements are also not demanding. I've specifically reserved two tasks for you, so hurry up and come out to claim them."
Suddenly, a bustling and noisy exclamation came from outside the door; Yuan Ming chanted softly for a moment, then walked forward and opened the door.
In front of the door, a plump man resembling a round ball was happily brandishing a jade scroll in his hand.
Yuan Ming looked at him, and suddenly the voice of the Shura Master sounded in his ear, revealing the fat man's name and identity.
"Shen Peng, an Early-stage Foundation Establishment Cultivator, a disciple of Changle Peak, and someone who has always been on good terms with me."
When Shen Peng saw Yuan Ming come out, he immediately smiled and handed over the jade scroll, saying, "Here you go, Junior Brother, these two tasks I chose especially for you; they are to receive delegates from Great Sects, and if you do well, forging connections with those geniuses could lead to incredible opportunities."
"Thank you for the consideration, Senior Brother Shen, but I haven't attended many grand ceremonies before. Being in charge of receiving Great Sects, I'm afraid I might be inadequate and mess things up, which would be quite problematic," Yuan Ming shook his head and politely declined Shen Peng's suggestion.
"Ah, don't talk like that! The founding grand ceremony happens only once every hundred years. Except for those who have been trapped at the Foundation Establishment stage for a long time, which of us isn't attending for the first time? Besides, the reception tasks are essentially about guiding people from other sects, and sharing our sect's history with them. You have always been fond of reading ancient texts, so this task is hardly a challenge for you." Shen Peng waved his chubby hand as he spoke.
"I appreciate your kindness, Senior Brother Shen, but recently my cultivation practice has encountered some issues, and I've been somewhat troubled. I keep feeling like something major is going to happen and really can't shoulder such an important responsibility," Yuan Ming continued to refuse. Chapter provided via *.
"You, my boy, are just overthinking things from staying cloistered in your room all day. We have known each other for so long, yet I've never seen you crack a smile; you always have such a grave expression, making your immortal cultivation seem too joyless," unable to rouse Yuan Ming's interest, Shen Peng couldn't help but say.
Yuan Ming wanted to ask him about things related to the younger days of the Shura Master, yet fearing he might slip up and raise suspicions, he could only reply with silence.
"Then take care of yourself, and remember to drink plenty of warm water," seeing this, Shen Peng lost interest in continuing the conversation with Yuan Ming, exchanged a few more casual words, then left.
Yuan Ming watched Shen Peng's receding figure and pondered over the words the Shura Master had said when he stepped into the Array.
The point in time he was currently in must be on the eve of the Chaotian Sect's destruction; on the eve of Biluo Cave's destruction, there had already been signs like Wulu lurking in the shadows and Dawn summoning people. And for a sect with a Nascent Soul Middle Stage Cultivator to be annihilated overnight, there must be some undercurrents in the dark.
Just like the battle of Biluo Cave, which erupted when a gathering of disciples took place, the catastrophe that would obliterate Chaotian Sect might also erupt during the grand ceremony of the sect, an ominous prospect.
Oftentimes, the least likely moment to encounter trouble is precisely when people are most complacent.
What roles did those invited sects play here? Were they enemies or allies?
Yuan Ming couldn't be sure; the information he had obtained so far was too scarce to deduce the full picture of events. After much deliberation, he finally turned his gaze to the top of the peak where his residence was located.
Not long thereafter, in the Cave Mansion of Shen Lingyun, Yuan Ming stood in front of Shen Lingyun, who had just completed his cultivation, and said with a bow:
"Master, I have been frequently restless recently, always feeling as if something significant is going to happen. Last night, I woke up in shock because I dreamt that during the founding grand ceremony, suddenly, powerful enemies descended from the sky, disrupting the proceeding of the ceremony. Fellow disciples fought desperately and repelled the enemy but suffered heavy casualties. I thought it was just a nightmare, but today during cultivation, scenes from the dream repeatedly appeared before my eyes, which made me uneasy, and so I have come to report to Master."
"Daytime thoughts become the dreams of the night. You dreamt of our sect being destroyed; could it be that you have noticed something awry during the daytime?" Shen Lingyun did not take his disciple's words as a joke but instead pondered seriously.
"That being said, I indeed feel that something is not quite right with some fellow disciples, but I can't pinpoint anything specific," Yuan Ming feigned distress.
"Then take this token of mine and go to the Deacon Hall at Changle Peak. Say it's by my order and ask to review the recent travel records of all disciples. Identify anyone you deem suspicious and bring the information back to me," Shen Lingyun directed, producing a token with a flip of his hand.
Yuan Ming, pleasantly surprised by Shen Lingyun's decisive response, still harbored a little doubt in his heart.
"Master, forgive my frankness, but aren't you afraid this is really just a nightmare of mine?" he asked cautiously.
"It's a matter of no consequence, and besides, we're only investigating without passing judgment. Even if it turns out to be nothing, we lose nothing. Moreover, I know your nature. When I took you from the Zhen Family, I said you would be my only successor and my most trusted disciple," Shen Lingyun replied with a smile.
Seeing the amiable and sincere smile on Shen Lingyun's face, Yuan Ming was quite moved and solemnly bowed to Shen Lingyun, "Rest assured, Master, I will do my utmost to ensure the smooth and worry-free progress of our sect's grand ceremony."
"I'll be looking forward to it," Shen Lingyun nodded, his eyes full of expectation.

chapters.title: Chapter 408 - 385: Again?
chapters.content:
At the second layer of the tower, everyone looked at the burned-out Unity Talisman in the hand of Golden Dawn Fairy, first in shock, then with various expressions crossing their faces.
"No way, did that kid die so quickly? Could it be that the so-called trial is actually just a trap? This Shura Master really is sinister!" Su Zimo exclaimed in surprise.
"It is rumored that Shura Master has killed countless people in his lifetime, and his famous Magic Treasure is even refined with the flesh and blood of over a thousand cultivators. Deliberately leaving a lethal trap in his own Cave Mansion is not beyond the realm of possibility," Dugu Feng said noncommittally.
"The records left by my sect state although Shura Master's methods are cruel, he walks a forthright path and disdains lying. Besides, if he wanted to kill someone, why would he use such an obviously shoddy tactic that could be seen through at a glance?" Wan Qi Hong shook his head and said.
"So, the trial is fraught with danger, and the kid lost his life due to a misstep?" Lei Ming Ancestor said indifferently.
"It shouldn't be the case; after all, the Unity Talisman burned up too quickly. That lad Yuan Ming might look simple and honest, but to have come this far, he must have some tricks up his sleeve; it's unlikely that he couldn't withstand even a moment's assault," Dugu Feng shook his head and said.
"Perhaps the place where the trial is held has powerful forbidden restrictions that cut off the connection with the Unity Talisman?" Golden Dawn Fairy speculated with slightly furrowed brows, somewhat uncertain.
While the Nascent Soul cultivators were discussing, the Core Formation Stage cultivators naturally could not interject, but Xi Ying, who had been silent and with her head bowed, suddenly looked up and said upon hearing Golden Dawn Fairy's words:
"Elders, how about letting me try my luck as well?"
"Heh, you're in such a hurry? Could it be that there is some involvement between you and that kid?" Su Zimo glanced at Xi Ying, smiling with ill intent.
Dugu Feng, however, stared at Xi Ying thoughtfully without expressing any opinion.
"Senior Su's words are not quite right. I just think that dragging this out is not a solution; after all, the elders also wish to pass through this layer of the trial as soon as possible. Furthermore, Shura Master just mentioned that the trial was set by his Illusion Array Divine Ability. Since I could break the mist within Yin Capital City, naturally, this Illusion Array is not entirely beyond my grasp," Xi Ying replied calmly and logically.
