Hearing her tone devoid of any impatience, and seemingly unconcerned about Yuan Ming's safety, and seeing that even Dugu Feng had nothing to say, the rest were too lazy to speculate further on Xi Ying's relationship with Yuan Ming.
Seeing that no one else opposed, Xi Ying bowed slightly to Dugu Feng, then strode forward and stepped onto the Array before the statue.
"When I was young, I once had a Daoist companion, yet her family was powerful and looked down upon my origin, intending to betroth her to another. Unwilling to accept this, I arrived on their wedding day to seize her away, only to discover she had been drugged by her family days earlier and lost her virtue. Upon seeing me, she killed herself. This remains one of the great regrets of my life. If you can overturn this outcome within three chances, you shall obtain the Cultivation Technique I left behind."
As the voice faded, Xi Ying vanished just like Yuan Ming.
After waiting for a moment, Dugu Feng suddenly spoke out, "She's not dead."
Upon hearing this, the other Nascent Soul cultivators looked towards Dugu Feng, only to see him look up with a smile, unwaveringly grabbing another Core Formation Cultivator under his command and swiftly stepping forward, both of them entering the Array together.
"I..."
Following another set of words, both Dugu Feng and the Core Formation Cultivator disappeared.
Seeing this, the other Nascent Soul cultivators set aside their wariness, stepping forward one by one, each of them not forgetting to take along their remaining Core Formation Cultivator.
When it was Lei Ming Ancestor's turn, he was about to step forward and had taken a couple of steps when he noticed that Yan Sijing had not followed. He immediately turned around, calling out in dissatisfaction.
Yan Sijing then came to her senses and hurriedly followed Lei Ming Ancestor's steps.
And when she stood on the Array, she listened to Shura Master recounting the regrets of his life while silently praying to Nether Moon God in her heart.
Praying that he would protect her... and Yuan Ming.
...
Changle Peak Deacon Hall.
As the most significant celebration of Chaotian Sect, the Founding Ceremony was not merely a grand ritual.
The ceremony would last a full seven days, during which, in addition to the customary Disciple Competition, there would be events like the Elders' Discussion of the Dao, Immortal Sect Treasure Hunt, and more. Each of the twenty-one peaks within the sect also needed to prepare a unique event, meant to showcase the achievements and the cultivation ethos that had emerged over the century.
Therefore, whenever the grand ceremony approaches, the Deacon Hall is always festooned with colorful decorations and becomes extraordinarily bustling. Deacons who wish to recruit assistants and disciples from various peaks seeking quality tasks always crowd the hall to the brim, and the clamor rises and falls in waves.
This copy was generated from content at *.
This scene bears a striking resemblance to the annual Lantern Festival in the mortal world, with a sense of "trees of lights and never-ending fireworks, an unparalleled joyous night at the grand fair."
When Yuan Ming arrived there holding his master's token, what he saw was exactly this kind of heated and lively scene; he even couldn't squeeze in for a long while.
He had intended to find Shen Peng to help retrieve the records, but after scanning the room, he didn't spot that plump figure. Presuming that Shen Peng was, as he said, busy with tasks, Yuan Ming had no choice but to stop a disciple from the Deacon Hall who was hurrying by and explain his purpose.
Upon hearing Yuan Ming's request, the disciple appeared as if he had a headache and quickly told Yuan Ming that such matters required the Hall Master of the Deacon Hall to decide, and after pointing out where the Hall Master was, he hurried off.
Feeling somewhat helpless, Yuan Ming could only follow the indicated direction and work his way through the crowd. After much meandering, he found Hall Master Li Can in a small room behind the Deacon Hall, buried in paperwork.
"I am aware of Peak Master Shen's wishes, but as you can see, Junior Brother Zhen, our hall is swamped with work right now, everyone's hands are in use, and I really can't spare anyone to accompany you for the investigation," Li Can said with a wry smile after listening to Yuan Ming's purpose.
"Senior Brother Li, you just need to bring out the relevant records, I am sufficient for the investigation alone," Yuan Ming was not ready to give up.
Upon hearing this, Li Can visibly relaxed, fearing that this junior brother might adamantly insist on his help. He immediately stood up, took a black jade key from a shelf beside him, and handed it to Yuan Ming, saying:
"This is the key to the storeroom where the records are kept. Upon leaving my office, go east to the very end, and the room on the left-hand side is it. The shelves near the door have the records of tasks undertaken in the past year. Junior Brother Zhen, you may consult them freely, but remember not to take or alter anything. The prohibitions on those jade talismans are connected to the Punishment Hall, and if there is any problem, they will know about it immediately."
Yuan Ming was momentarily stunned upon hearing this. He thought about Shen Lingyun's instructions to bring the records back, but then it occurred to him that while the records couldn't be taken out, they could still be transcribed, so he did not take the matter to heart.
He thanked Li Can, took the black jade key, and hung it on his waist.
Just as Yuan Ming was about to turn around to take his leave, Li Can seemed to remember something and added, "Oh, right, Junior Brother Zhen, the preparatory documents for your Lingxing Peak have not been submitted for this grand ceremony. When you go back, please remember to remind them."
"Senior Brother Li, Lingxing Peak was only recently established, and I am the only direct disciple on the peak. Are we also responsible for preparing entertainment for the grand ceremony?" Yuan Ming turned back around and asked with some confusion.
"That is true, but if I remember correctly, doesn't your peak also have several mundane disciples and Qi Refining Disciples? Preparing for these matters is indeed their duty. Besides, especially because there are few on your peak, you should take this opportunity to make yourselves known. Think about it, if your peak makes a good impression and gains fame during the centennial celebration, won't you attract more disciples in the future? And when competing for sect resources, you would have a much stronger say!"
Seeing that Yuan Ming was still unmoved, Li Can continued to earnestly persuade him:
"Actually, this is also a tradition of our sect. Whenever a new peak master takes position, if it coincides with the founding grand ceremony, they usually personally organize some events to showcase their cultivation philosophy to other peak masters and disciples, helping in the recruitment of disciples. Though I've heard that Senior Shen prefers tranquility over activity and doesn't pay much attention to these matters concerning the lower disciples, as his direct disciple, you should take more interest in these things to avoid impacting the development of your peak. This is a matter of lasting significance."
"Thank you for your advice, Senior Brother Li. I will take note of it," Yuan Ming then nodded noncommittally, acknowledging the advice. However, his mind was not really on Li Can's words, but rather, he sensed something odd.
If he hadn't specifically gone and expressed his concerns to Shen Lingyun, his nominal master indeed seemed to be indifferent to the grand ceremony.
But there's all sorts in life, and plenty who don't like the hustle and bustle. After all, Yuan Ming wasn't the Shura Master, and didn't know much about Shen Lingyun's temperament. Perhaps, as Li Can said, he simply preferred quiet to activity and wasn't fond of joining the fray.
Yuan Ming set aside his doubts. Seeing Li Can had buried himself back into his paperwork, he took the initiative to bid farewell and leave the room. Once outside, he quickly made his way towards the storeroom following the directions given.
When he reached the storeroom door and was about to use the black jade key he had taken from his waist, he found the door unlocked.
He was somewhat surprised, but still pushed the door open and entered to find there was also a desk inside with a middle-aged cultivator in green clothes holding documents and a jade scroll, apparently focused on recording something.
When the man noticed Yuan Ming entering, he looked up in surprise and furrowed his brows, saying, "Senior Brother, this place is important to our hall; please do not enter without permission."
Yuan Ming showed the key and token and repeated his purpose, all the while inwardly questioning why Li Can hadn't mentioned that someone would be there.
To his surprise, upon seeing the token in Yuan Ming's hand, the man muttered softly, "Eh, a token from Peak Master Shen? Again, has something been discovered?"
Yuan Ming's heart skipped a beat, and he quickly asked, "May I ask what you mean by 'again,' Senior Brother?"

chapters.title: Chapter 409 - 386: Second Attempt
chapters.content:
"Ah? You didn't know about this? Wasn't it just the other day that someone from your Lingxing Peak took a token to our hall's intelligence storeroom to retrieve some information? I happened to be on duty there at that time. Recently, due to a shortage of personnel here, the Deputy Hall Master had me transferred here again; it really keeps me extremely busy." The middle-aged cultivator was also very surprised and still carried some complaints in his voice.
Yuan Ming's heart sank. Shen Lingyun had sent someone to fetch intelligence ahead of time? Then why hadn't he informed him beforehand? Could there be some hidden circumstances?
He carefully recalled the scene of his interaction with Shen Lingyun, pondered for a long while, and gradually formed a plan.
After confirming Yuan Ming's token and purpose, the middle-aged cultivator did not further trouble Yuan Ming and busied himself with his own matters.
This allowed Yuan Ming to linger in the storeroom for about a day before finally returning to Shen Lingyun's cave mansion with a bunch of Jade Scrolls.
"These are the suspicious records you've identified? This one named Ge Chen, what exactly is suspicious about him?" Shen Lingyun carefully examined the Jade Scrolls presented by Yuan Ming and casually inquired.
"Reporting to Master, firstly, every time he completes a mission, one of his companions inevitably dies a violent death, and secondly, according to what your disciple has learned, he once took a master's token to the Deacon Hall to access some classified intelligence," Yuan Ming replied respectfully, head bowed.
Upon hearing this, Shen Lingyun suddenly paused as if recalling something, a flicker of surprise crossing his face. He then fixed his gaze sharply, his aura restrained yet unlaunched, his voice becoming even more emotionless as he spoke calmly:
"Oh? Such a thing happened?"
"Indeed, disciple speculates that perhaps that token was forged by him. This man dares to impersonate master's name; it's truly detestable," Yuan Ming continued.
"Hehe, you guess well. He probably managed to get a rough likeness of my token from somewhere else, but this does not prove anything," Shen Lingyun suddenly chuckled lightly.
"Master is right. Since this is the case, I've now located this man's position. Please permit me now to capture him and confront him face-to-face to clear Master's suspicions," Yuan Ming bowed and turned to leave.
But just then, he suddenly felt a pain in his chest, and looking down, he saw it was a silver-white long spear, penetrating his thorax.
Yuan Ming recognized it was Shen Lingyun's magic treasure. He immediately tried to stay conscious and, unable to believe it, turned his head to look at Shen Lingyun.
"Master, why... this?"
"It's a pity; I truly wanted you as my successor. Some things you would have come to know in time. If you must blame something, blame your own curiosity for noticing things you shouldn't at the wrong time," Shen Lingyun said still wearing a smile, his voice as calm as ever.
However, in the next instant, his smile froze on his face.
Suddenly, Yuan Ming, summoning the last of his strength, crushed the Jade Talisman in his hand. Simultaneously, a sound that shook the heavens suddenly resounded outside the cave mansion.
"These are the suspicious records you've identified..."
Shen Lingyun was startled and immediately released his Divine Sense, only to see two phantoms floating above the cave mansion, depicting himself and Yuan Ming.
Meanwhile, near the mountain waist, the corpulent Shen Peng looked up into the sky with surprise, holding in his hand a fist-sized treasure bead that continuously emitted light.
"The Abnormality Capturing Pearl, since when?"
Shen Lingyun's eyes flashed coldly, recognizing it as a popular magic artifact of the Chaotian Sect. Paired in twos, it could record the nearby situation and simultaneously transmit to another Round Bead Magic Artifact not far away.
This artifact was generally used during high-level cultivators' teachings, allowing disciples who were not qualified to attend to also have a chance to listen in. Never did he expect Yuan Ming to use it here.
Shen Lingyun took advantage of the moment before any critical scene was displayed, and with a thought, he knocked Shen Peng unconscious. He then quickly walked over to Yuan Ming's corpse, took the other Image Capturing Pearl from him, and directly crushed it.
Just then, Shen Lingyun suddenly saw the last expression on Yuan Ming's face, mocking.
"These are the..."
The familiar voice echoed again, yet this time, the phantoms did not appear over Lingxing Peak but over Changle Peak.
Shen Lingyun froze, then suddenly recalled that activating the Abnormality Capturing Pearl did not require a Jade Talisman. Yuan Ming's last action had triggered something else.
"Junior Brother Shen, what is this all about?"
Suddenly, another elderly voice came from outside the cave mansion; it was a Core Formation Stage cultivator from the Chaotian Sect stationed at other peaks, who, having noticed the content of the Image Capturing Pearl, had come specifically to inquire.
Shen Lingyun's face shifted for a moment, but eventually, he steeled his heart, took out a Ten Thousand Miles Communication Talisman, activated it, and only said one sentence:
"There's been a change, we must initiate the plan immediately, please Venerable come quickly."
Then, he released his hand, letting the communication talisman turn into ashes. Simultaneously, he took out a token, mana surged, and he activated the protective formation already prepared.
A light pillar soared from Lingxing Peak into the sky, like a beacon of fire, and after a brief silence, several other peaks within the sect, just like Lingxing Peak, activated their protective formations.
The chaos of the Chaotian Sect had officially begun at this very moment.
...
Yuan Ming opened his eyes and found himself back in the room again. At the same time, he heard the voice of Shura Master, tinged with a trace of regret.
"The first replay failed."
However, Yuan Ming did not feel discouraged, for the last few tactics were merely feeble struggles to get back at Shen Lingyun for deceiving him. What he truly wanted was to start the next attempt armed with the intelligence he had gathered.
After all, the experience in the Illusion Array wasn't real history; he only needed to reach his goal within three tries without considering the consequences.
After briefly pondering the intelligence he had gained from his last experience, Yuan Ming soon heard Shen Peng's voice outside the room.
"Junior Brother Zhen, hurry up..."
Before Shen Peng could finish calling out a few times, Yuan Ming had already opened the door and asked directly.
"Senior Brother Shen, did you manage to hold a reception task for me? I wonder if there is one for Chang Chun Temple?"
"Chang Chun Temple? There is, but how did Junior Brother Zhen know I came to tell you about a reception task?" Shen Peng scratched his head, utterly puzzled.
"Hehe, Senior Brother Shen has always been warm-hearted, and seeing that he came today with joy, conceivably he had gone out of his way to arrange a good opportunity for his junior brother. I merely happened to guess it, but still, thank you, Senior Brother, for your care. I will keep your kindness in mind," Yuan Ming said with a chuckle.
Seeing Yuan Ming's smiling face, Shen Peng was so shocked that he momentarily didn't know what to say.
"So, Senior Brother, is there a task for receiving Chang Chun Temple?" Yuan Ming urged upon seeing his reaction.
Like waking from a dream, Shen Peng said, "Ah, yes, yes, I have two tasks in hand, one for Chang Chun Temple and one for the Five Thunder Sect. Since Junior Brother already has a plan, I'll give you the Jade Scroll for Chang Chun Temple, and I'll go back and register it later. However, Junior Brother, you don't have any issues today, do you?"
"Senior Brother need not worry. It's just that I had some insights and felt that the past was too dull. I wanted to change something to avoid affecting my future cultivation," Yuan Ming explained.
Shen Peng nodded hesitantly, but seeing that his usually gloomy junior brother had become much more cheerful, he thought it not a bad thing, so he didn't say much more. He briefly explained the task details and reminded him of a few precautions before turning to leave.
Yuan Ming returned to his room, let his Divine Sense sink into the Jade Scroll, and learned that the delegation from Chang Chun Temple would arrive the next day. After reflecting for a moment, he picked up his Storage Bag and went outside the Sect to prepare the necessary items at the workshop.
The next morning, at the peak of Dragon Peak.
This peak was tasked with negotiations with other Sects and housed buildings mostly for receiving guests from other Sects. Although some disciples maintained them daily, there was no Peak Master assigned.
A large Green Wood Flying Boat slowly landed on the platform at the top of the mountain. Dozens of cultivators dressed in Da Jin attire descended, led by a handsome young cultivator with a tuft of green hair draped on either side of his ears, adding a carefree flair.This chapter was made possible by the community at *.
Trailing behind him were about seven or eight Foundation Establishment cultivators, who all seemed quite young, with two of them subtly taking the lead.
Seeing the people disembark from the flying boat, Bi Changyou, the Peak Master of Changle Peak, immediately came forward laughing.
"Haha, I didn't expect that this time the leader would be Fellow Daoist Wan Qi Ze. The rumor that you entered the Core Formation before fifty has been all the rave recently. Now, seeing you in person, you indeed have an extraordinary demeanor," he said.
"Fellow Daoist Bi is jesting. My achievements today rely fully on the devoted nurturing of my sect, coupled with some fortunate encounters. Truly speaking of power, it's nothing more than a reflection in the mirror, a flower in the water, not worth mentioning at all," Wan Qi Ze humbly replied.
"Under a great reputation, there's no mediocrity. Fellow Daoist, there's no need for modesty. Since it's rare for you to visit our Chaotian Sect, I have already prepared a tea session in advance. Would you honor me with your presence so we can sit and discuss the Dao?" Bi Changyou invited.
"I shall follow your kind command," Wan Qi Ze nodded and left with Bi Changyou.
Seeing their interaction, Yuan Ming, who had been silently standing behind Bi Changyou, stepped forward at the right moment and bowed to the remaining cultivators from Chang Chun Temple.
"Fellow Daoists, my name is Zhen Luo from Lingxing Peak, and I will guide you through the scenic spots of our Sect. Is there any place you wish to visit in particular?" he asked.
Upon hearing this, the cultivators from Chang Chun Temple looked at each other, and finally, one of the Foundation Establishment male cultivators spoke:
"We have long heard that your Sect possesses four great desolates, among which Heavenly Dawn Peak's Thousand-year-old Immortal Mist is the most famous. We have longed to see it for a long time; please lead the way, Fellow Daoist Zhen."
Yuan Ming nodded and his gaze fell on the face of the male cultivator. He felt somewhat familiar with his features. Noticing a certain commanding presence in the man's mannerisms, he asked:
"May I know how to address Fellow Daoist?"
"Liu Zhanshang," the male cultivator replied with a smile.
"Ah, so it's the Emperor of Da Jin himself. My apologies for the oversight," Yuan Ming realized, his smile broadening.

chapters.title: Chapter 410 - 387: Master, Why Hurt Your Disciple?
chapters.content:
"It's just some worldly identities, Fellow Daoist Zhen need not mind." Liu Zhanshang waved his hand, unconcerned.
Yuan Ming nodded slightly, feeling somewhat amused in his heart.
The reason he had guessed the other's identity was due to a sentence he had heard by chance in the ancestral teachings of the Liu Imperial Family's genealogy early on, "Look far with high esteem, follow the path respectfully and prosperously." Every member of the Imperial Family was arranged in generational order according to these teachings. Although it had been three thousand years and he could not specifically determine the generation, the character 'Zhanshang' was indeed from the genealogy.
He thought that if he met Liu Tianming in the future, he would tell him about today's encounter with his ancestor.
Subsequently, under Yuan Ming's lead, the group from Chang Chun Temple finished touring the Chaotian Sect's four extreme conditions and witnessed the style of each peak, until dusk approached when they returned to their arranged accommodations.
However, when Yuan Ming was guiding the group from Chang Chun Temple to their accommodations, he did not leave; instead he accompanied them into the residence.
"Fellow Daoist Zhen has already troubled you much today. If you happen to have time to visit Da Jin or Chang Chun Temple in the future, I hope you could inform us in advance to allow us to extend our hospitality," Liu Zhanshang said with a smile.
"Fellow Daoist Liu is too kind. Regarding the itinerary for the next few days, I still need to confirm some details with you, Fellow Daoist Liu. May I have a private word?" Yuan Ming spoke in a calm and unhurried manner.
Liu Zhanshang looked at Yuan Ming thoughtfully for a moment, then instructed his sect mates to scatter and rest. He entered his own room with Yuan Ming, cast a soundproofing magic with a flick of his hand, then turned around and quietly waited for Yuan Ming to speak.
Yet, Yuan Ming seemed not entirely reassured, as he solemnly took out an array plate and set up another formation to block divine senses before he slowly began to speak:
"Fellow Daoist Liu, what I am about to discuss is highly confidential. I hope that after hearing it, you will immediately contact Senior Wan Qi to return and not reveal it to a second person."
"It's our first meeting, Fellow Daoist. If you have something highly confidential, why insist on discussing it with me?" Liu Zhanshang shook his head, clearly somewhat dismissive.
"Because this matter involves Chang Chun Temple significantly. After accidentally discovering it, I have been restless and tossing and turning. Having enjoyed our conversation today, I truly felt uneasy and wanted to inform you," Yuan Ming sighed first, then under Liu Zhanshang's somewhat puzzled gaze, he revealed the shocking information:
"Fellow Daoist Liu, are you aware that your Chang Chun Temple's secret Cultivation Technique 'Nine Elements Technique' has been stolen and learned by others?"
"What? That's impossible. Anyone who cultivates the 'Nine Elements Technique' must register their name in the temple and need a guarantor. If it leaks, it involves more than just one person; please be cautious with your words, Fellow Daoist Zhen," Liu Zhanshang suddenly stood up, his face full of tension.
This from the collection at *.
Yuan Ming shook his head and said nothing, instead, he handed over a jade scroll.
Liu Zhanshang took the jade scroll, barely probed it with his divine sense, and his expression froze. By the time he finished reading, he was sweating profusely.
"Is this the entire 'Nine Elements Technique'? Fellow Daoist, where did you obtain this?"
"In all honesty, I found this while organizing the cave mansion for my master. The name 'Nine Elements Technique' is renowned. I memorized its content at that time and later copied it, wanting to ascertain its authenticity. Seeing your reaction today, it seems my suspicions were correct, this cultivation technique is indeed a unique teaching of your temple," Yuan Ming said somberly.
Upon hearing this, Liu Zhanshang became restless, pacing back and forth in the room holding the jade scroll. After a moment, he suddenly remembered something, rapidly took out a Sound Transmission Talisman, and contacted the leading Core Formation Elder to report.
About 15 minutes later, the room door was pushed open hurriedly, Wan Qi Ze entered the room, seeing the nervous Liu Zhanshang and the sighing Yuan Ming, he immediately frowned deeply.
"Something serious has happened, Master Mo Qi," Liu Zhanshang began without waiting for him to ask, recounting Yuan Ming's words and handing over the jade scroll.
After Wan Qi Ze read the contents of the jade scroll, his face also showed shock. He then ordered Liu Zhanshang to close the room door, raised his hand, and two more soundproofing spells were cast. Next, he spat out a small sword that gleamed with golden light, which instantly flew out and pressed against Yuan Ming's neck.
"Who sent you here, and where did this cultivation technique come from? Tell me everything clearly, or I won't mind killing you first and then using a secret technique to search your soul," Wan Qi Ze said, his tone overflowing with killing intent.
Yuan Ming's face showed fear and grievance, but he was already prepared. He immediately spoke out the rehearsed arguments:
"Senior Wan Qi misunderstood me. I came here of my own accord, with no one behind the scenes directing me. As for the cultivation technique, I have already told Fellow Daoist Liu: I found it by accident when organizing my master's cave mansion. If the senior does not believe me and insists on searching my soul, there is nothing I can do. Consider it a misunderstanding of my sincere intentions," Yuan Ming said.
"Haha, your acting might fool others, but it won't fool me. Who would not take care of such a secret item? Besides, you said it belongs to your master. There's no involvement between you and our Chang Chun Temple. You betray your own sect for no reason, just to hand this over to us? Do you think I'm a fool?" Wan Qi Ze shouted fiercely.
"Senior Wan Qi is wrong. I have no intention of betraying my sect. The one who truly wants to betray is my master. He has been a part of Chaotian Sect for a long time, yet as a peak's master, he ignores the tasks given by the sect, does not manage the peak diligently, and also secretly hoards Chang Chun Temple's cultivation techniques. What is his purpose? Who is he stealing the cultivation techniques for?" Yuan Ming said.
Hearing this, Wan Qi Ze's brows slightly furrowed. Although the golden light sword still pressed against Yuan Ming's neck, the murderous look in his eyes somewhat receded.
"If it were for stealing from the sect, but I, as his direct disciple and also his student, have never seen such cultivation techniques circulating within our sect. If it were for his own theft, he has never changed his main cultivation technique, so what use would he have for this secret book? Therefore, I boldly speculate that my master, Shen Lingyun, might belong to another power, lurking within our sect for some other purpose, perhaps even to steal the core cultivation techniques, and this 'Nine Elements Technique' could be the result of his previous infiltration," Yuan Ming continued to explain rapidly as he saw this.
Wan Qi Ze fell silent. After a long time, he suddenly retracted the Golden Sword Treasure. Seeing this, Yuan Ming quietly sighed in relief, knowing his analysis had taken effect.
His statement actually wouldn't withstand scrutiny, but firstly, even though this speculation might be false, the fact that Shen Lingyun was a traitor was true. By drawing the target and shooting the arrow, even if others were suspicious, seeing the correct results, they wouldn't care too much about the process.
Secondly, he only needed to solve the matter of Chaotian Sect's destruction, without needing to consider the consequences. Even if the lie were exposed, what did it have to do with him, Yuan Ming?
"Why did you choose to tell us this statement just now, instead of discussing it with other Core Formation Elders within the sect?" Suddenly, Wan Qi Ze seemed to have caught a hole in Yuan Ming's statement.
"I'm insignificant and my words carry little weight, especially when they concern my own master. How many would believe me if I spoke out? Moreover, does Shen Lingyun have any accomplices within the sect? I might run into another elder who has infiltrated; I know nothing and can't trust others. The reason I told Senior Wan Qi, first, is because of the 'Nine Elements Technique', and second, because you're outsiders with no ties to our sect. Even if you were undercover, not gathering intelligence within our sect and instead operating in other sects, what purpose would that serve?" Yuan Ming explained logically.
Wan Qi Ze fell silent again and, after a moment, he spoke again, this time with a hint of inquiry in his tone.
"What would you have me do?"
"Don't worry, Senior. I already have a plan. You just need to step in at the critical moment to save my life. It won't be difficult for you. Even if asked later, you were merely passing by and this wouldn't lead to any enmity with our sect," Yuan Ming stated confidently.
Afterward, he laid out his plan in detail, and Wan Qi Ze nodded repeatedly, looking at Yuan Ming with a bit of admiration in his eyes.
"Your plan, although it won't make you bear the infamy of betraying your master and ancestors, those old stubborn members of Chaotian Sect won't accept this. In the future, no Core Formation cultivator would want to take you as a disciple. I think you might as well join me and enter Chang Chun Temple to avoid being settled by those old stubborn members later," Wan Qi Ze suddenly suggested.
"Thank you, Senior Wan Qi, for your appreciation. I respectfully accept your offer," Yuan Ming responded joyfully, bowing to Wan Qi Ze.
Afterward, the two of them discussed in secret for a long time, and eventually finalized the plan. Under Liu Zhanshang's complicated gaze, Yuan Ming smiled as he bid farewell and left the lodging at Chang Chun Temple.
...
The next day, Yuan Ming visited Shen Lingyun and repeated the same statement as last time, getting his token.
After that, Yuan Ming continuously made his way to the Deacon Hall, pretending to check there for a while, before taking a bunch of Jade Scrolls back to Shen Lingyun's Cave Mansion.
The same conversation was repeated, but this time, as Yuan Ming turned to leave and Shen Lingyun suddenly made a sneak attack, his silver long sword hit Yuan Ming, but did not pierce through his chest. Instead, it was repelled by a golden light.
"Master, what are you doing!" Yuan Ming exclaimed in astonishment.
Shen Lingyun did not respond, but realizing that Yuan Ming was prepared, he immediately formed a spell, intending to eradicate him entirely.
But at that moment, a hearty laugh from Bi Changyou suddenly came from outside the Cave Mansion.
"Ha ha, Junior Brother Shen, I've brought Fellow Daoist Wan Qi from Chang Chun Temple to discuss the Dao with you."
Shen Lingyun was shocked inside, and his hands stopped moving. His expression changed for a while before returning to calm.
"I was just testing whether you've been lax on a daily basis. Now it seems that I was overly concerned," he said.
Hearing this, Yuan Ming gave a secretive smile and suddenly took out a long sword surrounded by Core Formation Stage mana, stabbing his own left shoulder, then used his mana to fly backwards out of the Cave Mansion.
"Master, why would you hurt your disciple?"
Outside the Cave Mansion, Bi Changyou and Wan Qi Ze were floating in mid-air, both full of smiles as they awaited Shen Lingyun to come out and greet them, when they suddenly saw Yuan Ming flying out backward, crying out with a bloodied wound on his left shoulder, and they were dumbfounded, unsure of what had happened.
Just then, two ghostly shadows suddenly appeared above Lingxing Peak, replaying the events that had just unfolded inside the Cave Mansion.
However, the content of the shadow performance, up to the point where Shen Lingyun attacked, did not record the moment Yuan Ming was protected by golden light.

chapters.title: Chapter 411 - 388 Loophole
chapters.content:
In midair, Wan Qi Ze raised his hand and gently swept his sleeve, catching Yuan Ming who was sent flying and shielding him appropriately. Only then did he turn to Bi Changyou with an implicating tone and said,
"Fellow Daoist Bi, it seems that your Chaotian Sect still has some internal issues to deal with, eh?"
Changle Peak's Peak Master Bi Changyou withdrew his gaze from the phantom in the sky and looked through the shattered gates of the Cave Mansion at Shen Lingyun, whose face was dark with anger. Hesitating for a moment, he did not take action to capture Shen Lingyun but instead asked,
"Junior Brother Shen, what's going on here?"
"Senior Brother Bi, this is a setup. My unruly disciple must have been beguiled by someone. He's trying to use this method to frame me. The wounds on his body were clearly self-inflicted with a Magic Artifact; it has nothing to do with me!" Shen Lingyun immediately defended himself.
"Oh, is that so? Yet, the Spiritual Power swirling around the wound seems to be from the Core Formation Stage Mana, what do you think, Fellow Daoist Bi?" Wan Qi Ze suddenly interjected.
Bi Changyou released his Divine Sense to envelop Yuan Ming and quickly discovered that what Wan Qi Ze had said was true. There were indeed remnants of Core Formation Stage Mana around Yuan Ming's wounds, undeniable evidence.
His expression immediately darkened, his gaze fixed intently on Shen Lingyun, and his tone became much less cordial.
"Junior Brother Shen, I need an explanation."
"Senior Brother Bi, I noticed this rebellious disciple acting suspiciously lately, seemingly colluding with outsiders, so I took action to test him. Now it appears that he's clearly involved with this person from the Chang Chun Temple!" Shen Lingyun's eyes swiftly swept over Yuan Ming and Wan Qi Ze, as if he had realized something, then he coldly said.
Upon hearing this, Wan Qi Ze's brow furrowed, and he set the severely injured Yuan Ming down on the ground. After casting a cold glance at Shen Lingyun, he turned and cupped his hands towards Bi Changyou, saying,
"Fellow Daoist Bi, don't involve others in your sect's internal affairs. As for today's incident, I have taken note of it. Once you have dealt with it, you owe Chang Chun Temple an explanation."
After speaking, Wan Qi Ze left without any intention of staying. Although Shen Lingyun wanted to stop him, he knew it was impossible, especially with Bi Changyou standing right there.
A flicker of anger crossed Bi Changyou's face but it was unrelated to Wan Qi Ze.
Shen Lingyun, seeing Wan Qi Ze act this way, was even more bewildered. He couldn't understand how events had unfolded to this point. Although he was an undercover agent, how did his disciple come to know the truth? And who had arranged this series of plans?
Meanwhile, the disturbance at Lingxng Peak had attracted the attention of the other Core Formation Peak Masters of the Chaotian Sect. They flew out from their Cave Mansions one after another, seeing the mess at the entrance of Shen Lingyun's Cave Mansion yet not knowing what had happened.
Bi Changyou, not wishing to air dirty laundry at such a critical time and wanting to keep the issue within the sect, briefly explained the situation to the other Peak Masters who had arrived. He then took them towards Shen Lingyun's Cave Mansion, intending to clear up the truth privately.
Just then, Shen Lingyun suddenly smiled, took out a token, and stimulated his Mana to activate a Formation that had been surreptitiously set up within the mountain beforehand.
However, when his Mana infused the token, it only glowed momentarily before dimming again. No Formation emerged on Lingxing Peak, nor was there even a substantial ripple of Spiritual Power.
Realizing something, he turned incredulously towards Yuan Ming, who was lying on the ground, and let out a roar of despair.
"You little thief, how dare you..."
Bi Changyou's brow furrowed as he saw Shen Lingyun behaving like a madman and realized something was amiss. He immediately tried to cast magic to capture him, but suddenly, from behind him, another Core Formation Stage Peak Master spat out a Jade Ruyi and took him by surprise with an attack.
Caught off guard, Bi Changyou quickly raised a Protective Light Shield, but he was still knocked back by the impact of the Jade Ruyi.
Just as he was about to question the Peak Master for such actions, he saw that in the sky above, several Core Formation Peak Masters were attacking those beside them, and within the Chaotian Sect's twenty-one peaks, four were suddenly enveloped in Formations. Columns of light shot up into the sky like beacons.
At the same time, beside Shen Lingyun, an old man clothed in gray appeared suddenly and silently, not revealing the slightest bit of his aura.
Note:Check*foranycorrections.
The old man looked at Shen Lingyun discontentedly and muttered,
"Useless."
Seeing the old man appear, Shen Lingyun was overjoyed. Hearing the rebuke, he kneeled down in a panic,
"Please forgive me, Master."
"Considering your past loyalty, your death penalty can be spared but punishment is inevitable. The specific penalty will depend on your performance in the mission from here on out," the old man said coldly.
"Yes, thank you for your mercy, Master. I will give it my all and not disappoint you," Shen Lingyun said earnestly, knocking his head on the ground like he was pounding garlic.
As chaos unfolded in the sky, an inexplicable power surged out from the top of the Chaotian Sect's Main Peak, falling upon each Peak Master and instantly revitalizing them, with their injuries also showing significant healing.
Following that, two tunneling lights shot out from the Main Peak, swiftly arriving above Lingxing Peak. The tunneling light dissipated, revealing the figures of an old and a young Cultivator, their presence vast and mighty, unmistakably two Nascent Soul Cultivators.
The elder Nascent Soul Cultivator had white hair and beard, wearing a plain Daoist robe and holding a whisk in his hand, his face bearing an expression of sorrow for the world.
The younger one was a ten-year-old girl in red clothes and shoes, with twin ponytails adorned with bells on her ponytail holders that jingled crisply from time to time.
The Daoist-robed elder was about to ask about the situation, but upon lowering his head and seeing the grey-robed elder standing beside Shen Lingyun, his sorrowful face suddenly changed, revealing a look of shock.
"Junior Brother, you're actually still alive!"
"Heh, yes, I am still alive. Surprised? Are you regretting your moment of soft-heartedness back then, not killing me when you had the chance?" the grey-robed elder sneered, also stepping into the sky step by step.
"So many years have passed, are you still so obstinate?" the Daoist-robed elder sighed.
"Hmph, what a joke. Wasn't it you and that old thing who wanted to snatch my treasure and plotted against me? Now it turns out to be my 'obstinacy' in your mouth; when it comes to inverting right and wrong, you people are indeed a bit more skilled," the grey-robed elder scoffed coldly.
"Back then, you killed people to refine corpses and caused harm to countless cultivators, even disrupting the mortal realm. Our master and I only wished for you to wake up and repent. I didn't expect that you'd see it this way. Alas, I was too merciful and soft-hearted then. Let me personally correct that mistake today," said the Daoist-robed elder, shaking his head as his expression gradually turned colder.
"Haha, so you're finally dropping the act? But now that we are both at the Nascent Soul Middle Stage, it won't be so easy for you to kill me," the grey-robed elder laughed disdainfully.
"What bold words. But have you forgotten about me!" the Nascent Soul girl shouted, about to take action, when suddenly thunderous rumbling approached from the horizon.
"Fellow Daoist Xi, this is a grudge between these brothers; I think it's better you don't interfere," a brawny man with a full beard and bare upper body suddenly flew to the side of the grey-robed elder.
"Lei Kuang, so you were the one behind this all along!" A hint of surprise mixed with a bit of wariness flashed in the eyes of the female cultivator surnamed Xi.
"What do you mean 'behind this'? I just think that Fellow Daoist Kang has such talent and rightfully belongs to the orthodox lineage of the Chaotian Sect. It's a pity he was harmed by treacherous people. Don't you agree, Fellow Daoist Le?" Lei Kuang laughed loudly, turning his head to ask.
"Well said."
Along with the chilly voice, another cultivator shrouded in a black robe appeared beside Kang's Nascent Soul.
"The Beiming Scatter Alliance, huh? It seems, Junior Brother Kang, you've prepared quite a bit in secret. But today, Senior Brother shall teach you a lesson—the Cultivation World ultimately speaks with strength!" The Daoist-robed elder's eyes flashed, and his aura surged forth, pressing towards a late-stage Nascent Soul.
In the next instant, five Nascent Soul existences took action simultaneously, and a fierce battle erupted in an instant.
For a time, the half-sky above Lingxing Peak was filled with thunderous noises as various spirit lights and magic treasures illuminated the sky brightly.
Simultaneously, inside the Chaotian Sect, many disciples of the Five Thunder Sect along with black-robed loose cultivators appeared. Together with the rebellious cultivators of the Chaotian Sect, they plunged the entire sect into the flames of war.
Meanwhile, at Lingxing Peak, as Kang's Nascent Soul ascended to mid-air, Shen Lingyun didn't dare delay any longer. He immediately got up, preparing to go to execute the Chaotian Sect's Core Formation disciples.
But before that, he intended to first deal with the traitorous disciple who made him reveal himself prematurely.
However, when he looked towards where Yuan Ming had just been, he found nothing but a pool of fresh blood.
Among the dense forests, Yuan Ming, having slightly recovered from his injuries with the help of the elixir given secretly by Wan Qi Ze, immediately hid and started gathering intelligence by every means possible.
Reflecting on his failed plan, Yuan Ming found two flaws: first, he had taken too long, allowing not only the traitorous disciples within the sect to catch up to him but also their external allies to arrive in time.
Second, he had underestimated the situation with the sect's traitors, mistakenly assuming there was only Shen Lingyun; otherwise, he would never have caused such a commotion, alerting those traitors to Shen Lingyun's exposure.
As Yuan Ming was contemplating how to make use of his final chance to redo everything, he suddenly felt a shock in his heart as if he were being targeted by a venomous snake.
He immediately took out his magic artifact to protect his body, but in the next instant, he saw the scenery around him change dramatically. The towering trees all turned blood-red, and human faces began to slowly appear on them.
"Traitor, why did you betray me!"
Countless voices echoed in Yuan Ming's ears. He was astonished. In the next moment, his body uncontrollably lifted into the air, suspended mid-air.
Figures identical to Shen Lingyun emerged from the Blood Trees, flew into the sky, and surrounded Yuan Ming, frantically gnawing at his flesh.
However, since Yuan Ming was already within an Illusion Array trial, he felt no pain, though he was extremely startled internally.
As a Soul Cultivator, he knew there was only one magic that could cause the current scene—Illusion Technique.
The records left by the Shura Master didn't mention Shen Lingyun knowing any Illusion Techniques, let alone one so powerful that a common magic practitioner couldn't execute it.
Shen Lingyun is a Soul Cultivator.
That thought flashed through Yuan Ming's mind, and then everything went dark and bright again—he was back in the side room.

chapters.title: Chapter 412 - 389 Misunderstanding
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming immediately stood up, found some paper and a writing brush from the room, and swiftly wrote down the names of the mountains where the formation erupted at the last moment during his previous attempt.
Evergreen Peak, Heavenly Dawn Peak, Enlightenment Peak, Qinglan Peak.
Including Shen Lingyun's Lingxing Peak, there were at least five peaks known to have betrayed among the twenty-one peaks of Chaotian Sect.
Yuan Ming stared at the words on the paper with furrowed brows, finding it hard to understand why there were so many traitors within the thriving Chaotian Sect.
Especially Tianxia and Enlightenment Peaks, according to the introduction left by Shura Master, the masters of these two peaks were both in the late stages of Core Formation, holding positions in the sect second only to two, above tens of thousands. The sect's cultivation resources were also biased towards these two peaks, so there was no reason for them to betray the sect.
Moreover, the goal of their rebellion wasn't even to seize power but to destroy the sect. For them, the path of betrayal was thoroughly thankless and only served to leave them a legacy of curses.
While Yuan Ming was still unable to fathom the situation, Shen Peng's voice sounded from outside the room once more.
Yuan Ming sighed, opened the door with a sense of helplessness, exchanged a few courteous words with him, and asked about the arrival time of the Five Thunder Sect's observation team before excusing himself, feigning illness, and returning to his room.
After composing himself, he took another piece of Xuan paper and began to deduce a method to break the situation.
Based on what he'd heard and seen during his last attempt, there were three primary reasons for the downfall of Chaotian Sect: traitors, external help, and Nascent Souls.
The solutions for the second and third issues were the same. Yuan Ming had to race against time, hoping to resolve the traitor issue before the arrival of Five Thunder Sect and Beiming Alliance. By forcefully compelling the grey-clothed old man to reveal himself, the Nascent Soul Ancestors of Chaotian Sect could then, two against one, slay him, and all problems would be solved.
Shen Peng had just informed Yuan Ming that the Five Thunder Sect's observation team would arrive in four days. However, considering that they might have laid ambushes secretly, this timeframe might even need to be brought forward by a day.
As both Five Thunder Sect and Chaotian Sect belonged to Zhao Country's sects and frequently had friction, despite their proximity, the Five Thunder Sect's observation team always arrived the day before the grand ceremony went ahead, to uphold their own sect's dignity.
Now, Yuan Ming had to deal with a jump from one Core Formation traitor to five, possibly along with even more Foundation Establishment and Qi Refining disciples. It was no longer possible to expect Chang Chun Temple to help him; the only solution was to win the trust of the sect.
Upon this realization, Yuan Ming couldn't help but smile bitterly.
Previously, just with Shen Lingyun alone, he had risked his own safety just to expose the traitor. Now, there were four more high-ranking Core Formation stage peak masters.
With his current status within the sect, even if he produced ample evidence, it would likely be easily suppressed by them.
Yuan Ming recalled the plan he had set up against Shen Lingyun and suddenly, a spark of spirit light flashed in his mind. He realized he had been trapped in a wrong assumption all along and remembered a clue he had previously overlooked.
Soon, at the peak of the Cave Mansion, Yuan Ming paid another visit to his traitorous master, but this time, he didn't mention anything about nightmares.
"Master, with the ceremony imminent, our Lingxing Peak still hasn't prepared any special entertainments. The Deacon Hall has sent someone to urge me several times. What do you think we should do about this…" Yuan Ming carefully inquired.
Although Shen Lingyun was a Soul Cultivator, he wouldn't use his soul cultivation abilities regularly to avoid exposure. Besides, Yuan Ming's Divine Soul was no weaker than his, and though unable to display techniques, he could still sense if someone was probing him beforehand.
Therefore, he wasn't worried that his lies would be detected by Shen Lingyun using soul cultivation methods.
As expected, upon hearing Yuan Ming's suggestion, Shen Lingyun sensed nothing amiss and casually replied, "Just tell them since our peak is newly established and short on manpower, we will not partake in this ceremony. Let's talk about it next time."
"That's exactly what I told them, but they still insisted on asking for your opinion. Do you think you could give me something to prove that this is indeed your wish?" Yuan Ming asked.
After pondering for a moment, Shen Lingyun nodded, raised his right hand, and a token flew into Yuan Ming's hand.
"Take this with you. Also, before the ceremony starts, I need to enter closed-door cultivation for a while. Unless other peak masters look for me, handle all mundane affairs on my behalf as if you were me," Shen Lingyun instructed.
Yuan Ming took the token, bowed respectfully, and then slowly exited the Cave Mansion.
He then rushed to the Deacon Hall without delay, seeking out the mundane disciple assigned as the storeroom guard.
"Senior Brother, do you still remember the appearance of the disciple who entered the intelligence storeroom with this token last time?" Yuan Ming took out the token and shook it.
"I remember... his eyes were very narrow..."
As the storeroom guard recalled the detailed features of that person, Yuan Ming took out a Jade Scroll and with his Divine Thought, sketched the person's portrait.
"Is this him?" Yuan Ming handed the Jade Scroll with the drawn portrait to the guard.
"That's right, it's this man. Tsk tsk, Senior Brother, your drawing skills are truly exquisite! To think you could draw him so precisely just based on my description." The guard was full of praise when he saw the portrait.
Yuan Ming smiled, put away the Jade Scroll, and immediately contacted Shen Peng without delay.
"Senior Brother Shen, I'd like you to help me find someone..."
...
Half a day later, Xiu Jie Peak.
After a long day's work, the mundane disciple Tao Wenlong didn't take the main road back to his residence but chose a scenic path through the mountains, leisurely appreciating the beautiful landscape on either side.
Xiu Jie Peak ranked towards the bottom among the twenty-one peaks of the Chaotian Sect. Initially, Tao Wenlong had complained, feeling that despite his capabilities, he had been dispatched to this godforsaken place, where he couldn't achieve anything noteworthy.
But having lived here for a while, he had grown fond of the scenery.
Not long ago, his superiors had even contacted him to dispose of some critical intelligence that the Chaotian Sect had accidentally obtained. He had expected it to be a major task, but the Sect wasn't aware of the intelligence's significance and had casually stored it away. With the token prepared by his superiors, he effortlessly completed the task, adding a merit to his record.
It was then that he realized, as an undercover agent, one should pick inconspicuous places. If he had been hiding in one of the more prestigious peaks, although there might have been a chance to achieve great things, he would have likely spent each day in constant fear of being exposed and never would have received such an easy assignment.
Tao Wenlong looked at the scenery surrounding him, gazing at the towering, cloud-piercing ancient trees, and suddenly felt a wave of emotion.
This landscape, steeped in a thousand years of history, would soon be consumed by the flames of war. After the battle, who knew how many ancient trees and flowers would remain, how many could stand unyielding?
Tao Wenlong shook his head and sighed deeply, then slowly exited the small road to reach his residence. Just as he was about to push the door open, he heard a stern shout from behind.
"Tao Wenlong, you've been exposed. Come with us."
Tao Wenlong's body tensed, cold sweat dripped from his forehead in an instant, and his mind raced frantically. After a moment, he suppressed his shock and fear, turned around with a forced smile, and cupped his hands in greeting,
"There must be some misunderstanding, surely you've got the wrong person? I've always been law-abiding and haven't done anything wrong, have I?"
Behind him stood several Foundation Establishment cultivators shoulder to shoulder. The one leading them was a handsome young man. Because of the token given by his superiors, Tao Wenlong recognized him and knew he was Lingxing Peak's only direct disciple, Zhen Luo, and his heart sank.
On the other side, Yuan Ming glanced at the Jade Scroll in his hand, confirming this was the man described by the storeroom guard, and let out a cold laugh, "Heh, there's no mistake, we're looking for you. As for what you've done, I think you know very well. Tell me, who instructed you to do this, and which faction do you belong to? Five Thunder Sect, or Beiming Alliance?"
Upon hearing this, the people beside Yuan Ming seemed a bit puzzled, but hearing the words "Beiming Alliance" from Yuan Ming's mouth, Tao Wenlong trembled slightly, beads of sweat appearing on his forehead, completely oblivious to the others' reactions.
"Hehe, Senior Brother Zhen, what are you talking about? Somehow, I don't quite understand..." Content first released on *.
As Tao Wenlong spoke, he took a few tentative steps backward and then suddenly raised his hand. In an instant, he threw out a talisman that exploded into an extremely bright white light in front of everyone.
However, Yuan Ming had come prepared. Almost at the moment Tao Wenlong released the talisman, he flipped his right hand and an Array Plate fell into his palm. As he performed the spell, in sync with the burst of white light, eight azure light ropes sprang out from the ground.
The white light faded quickly, and when the other Foundation Establishment cultivators reopened their eyes and gained a clear view of the surroundings, they saw Tao Wenlong tightly bound by the eight light ropes, roaring in frustration.
"What are you doing? I'm innocent. You're framing me!"
"No wonder you, Junior Brother Zhen, asked us to wait here specifically; you had prepared the Formation in advance?" The Foundation Establishment cultivator standing to the right of Yuan Ming, a tall man dressed in dark blue armor, exclaimed with surprise.
"Heh, it's just my habit to be prepared. I didn't expect to actually use it, but now it seems that Tao Wenlong's secret is even deeper than I expected, and the crimes he's committed are probably not limited to forging the Peak Master's token," Yuan Ming said with a smile.
After confirming Tao Wenlong's identity, Yuan Ming immediately sought out the members of the Punishment Hall, showing them the token from Shen Lingyun, claiming to be acting under orders, and informed them of Tao Wenlong's transgressions. That's how he brought several Foundation Establishment deacons from the Punishment Hall here with him.
The one who had just spoken was a Punishment Hall deacon named "Gu Zhiping."
"Indeed, but Junior Brother Zhen, why did you ask him if he belonged to the Five Thunder Sect or the Beiming Alliance earlier? It felt like you already knew," Yuan Ming's comrade to his left, Shen Peng, asked curiously.
"I just felt that the deeds he committed didn't quite match what a disciple of our Sect would do. That's why I tried to deceive him, to see if he was an undercover agent sent by other forces. I didn't expect to actually catch one," Yuan Ming quickly gave the reason he had rehearsed many times before.
These words, of course, were not only for Shen Peng's ears but also for Gu Zhiping and the other Punishment Hall disciples; otherwise, his behavior would indeed seem abrupt. And if suspicions turned to him and he gave his reasons later, they wouldn't be as convincing as the seemingly offhand remarks he was making now.
Shen Peng nodded again and again, looking at Yuan Ming with added admiration, and naturally, he didn't pursue the matter further.

chapters.title: Chapter 413 - 390 Unable to Get Away
chapters.content:
Thus, Yuan Ming followed Gu Zhiping and others, escorting Tao Wenlong directly back to the Punishment Hall, where they immediately began an intense interrogation.
Under the coercion of elixirs, talismans, and various interrogation magic tools, Tao Wenlong soon opened his mouth and spilled everything he knew without any omissions.
"Are you saying that he's not the real Tao Wenlong, but a Loose Cultivator who, through magic and disguise, took on his identity?"
Inside the Punishment Hall, Yuan Ming felt surprised when he heard Gu Zhiping's summary of the interrogation results.
"That's right, he's merely a Loose Cultivator affiliated with the Beiming Alliance. His infiltration into our sect was for a certain mission. However, the person issuing the mission did not inform him of the specific objective, just instructed him to lie low under Tao Wenlong's identity and wait for contact when needed," said Gu Zhiping.
"He just impersonated him like that, and Tao Wenlong's fellow disciples didn't notice anything amiss?" Yuan Ming frowned.
"Tao Wenlong was a reclusive person with few friends. Besides, after infiltrating, he exhibited no unusual behavior, conducting himself orderly and scarcely leaving Xiu Jie Peak. Were it not for Junior Brother Zhen discovering his misuse of the token, no one would have suspected that he was replaced," Gu Zhiping said with some helplessness.
"About the matter of him stealing a token to enter the intelligence vault, what exactly was he trying to do?" Yuan Ming nodded thoughtfully, pressing for answers.
"It seems to be in order to destroy a Strange Story. According to his account, it was about an experience of Junior Cui from Changle Peak. He and a Loose Cultivator friend went out to search for herbs but encountered a third-level demon beast. As the two fled for their lives, only Junior Cui survived. Everyone thought that was the end of it, yet after several days, Junior Cui saw his friend alive and active as a normal person, only with a complete reversal in personality and some memory loss. This raised suspicions in his heart. After numerous investigations, it was found that his friend was indeed dead, and it was a strange insect that had parasitized the body, creating an illusion of resurrection," Gu Zhiping narrated with evident amazement.
However, Yuan Ming was puzzled after listening, "Is this the intelligence that the Beiming Alliance went to such lengths to destroy using a Dark Child? It doesn't seem to have anything particularly notable."
"Indeed, that's what puzzles me! So I specifically sent someone to look for Junior Cui... Ah, look, they're just coming back," Gu said as he suddenly noticed someone hurrying over and smiled, waving to him.
"Senior Brother Gu, I went to Changle Peak and inquired around. They all said that Junior Cui left the sect more than a month ago and has yet to return," the newcomer said with a grave expression.
Hearing this, both Gu Zhiping and Yuan Ming's expressions darkened, knowing that Junior Cui must have learned something he shouldn't have and was very likely in grave danger.
"Senior Brother Gu, this matter appears to be more serious than we thought. We should immediately inform the Peak Master of your esteemed peak to avoid disaster," Yuan Ming said on the spot.
"That might not be a good idea. While we've caught a spy, he's only a small fry. And we've yet to uncover any key information. Besides, with the sect's grand celebration at a critical juncture, it may not be wise to disturb it hastily, lest we be blamed for incompetence," Gu Zhiping replied with evident reluctance in his voice.
Yuan Ming was about to further persuade him when suddenly he saw Shen Peng approaching from outside, waving a jade scroll in his hand.
"Junior Brother Zhen, you were right. Out of the twenty-one peaks, including Lingxing Peak, there are a total of five peaks with this peculiar array embedded within. I have asked a friend from Array Talisman Hall to help decode it, and we should be able to understand its purpose soon," Shen Peng said, obviously excited.
Yuan Ming feigned surprise as he took the jade scroll, then his expression turned serious.
"Senior Brother Gu, I've discovered crucial intelligence on my side. The situation is urgent; please contact the Hall Master of your esteemed hall immediately. Any blame should fall on me alone," Yuan Ming insisted, leaving no room for refusal.
Gu Zhiping seemed to sense something amiss as well, hesitated for a moment, and then nodded, taking out a Sound Transmission Talisman.
Soon, Di Tao, the Peak Master of Tingtao Peak, descended from the sky and strode into the Punishment Hall.
Yuan Ming had previously inquired about the appearance of the twenty-one peak masters. Upon seeing him arrive, he immediately went to greet him before Gu could report.
"Uncle Master Di, I am Zhen Luo, a direct disciple of Lingxing Peak, and I have urgent matters to report," Yuan Ming said respectfully.
Di Tao's eyebrows furrowed, and he seemed somewhat displeased. Seeing this, Gu Zhiping immediately came forward and informed him that Yuan Ming was the one who caught the undercover operative.
Having learned the basics about the spy through the Sound Transmission Talisman, Di Tao's attitude softened somewhat. He nodded to Yuan Ming, indicating him to speak his mind.
"Reporting to Uncle Master, I've discovered three unusual incidents in the sect these days. The first is the matter of the spy stealing the token, the second is that my master had conversed with a suspicious black-robed old man in his Cave Mansion; I felt uneasy and secretly recorded his portrait, which is now on this jade scroll. The third is a special array shrouding Lingxing Peak, the originator of which is unknown to me. I've documented it and later found similar arrays in four other peaks, seemingly from the same origin," Yuan Ming spoke rapidly, handling two jade scrolls as he did so.
Assessed individually, these three matters did not seem noteworthy, but when connected, one could understand the implications of his suggestion.
After listening to him, Di Tao's eyebrows knitted tightly together. He took a long look at Yuan Ming before taking the jade scrolls.
However, as soon as he saw the old man's likeness in the scroll, his face drastically changed, and a flicker of shock crossed his eyes.
Instantly, he thrust out a hand, casting a spell. Blue spirit light fell upon Yuan Ming, transforming into shackles that bound his limbs.
The action stunned everyone present. Although Yuan Ming was prepared, Di Tao's decisiveness still caught him off guard.
"Disciples of Tingtao Peak, heed my command: before I return, you must strictly guard Zhen Luo. Do not let him escape, and do not subject him to torture or interrogation."
Di Tao commanded in a stern voice and then hastily left the Punishment Hall, transforming into a tunneling light, darting straight toward Chaotian Sect's Main Peak.
Seeing Di Tao leave in a hurry, everyone was somewhat puzzled, only Yuan Ming knew that his trip was to report the situation to the Nascent Soul Ancestors, feeling a bit relieved, he cupped his hands toward Gu Zhiping and asked calmly,
"Now the trouble falls to Senior Brother Gu. I wonder if there is a quiet room in the hall, suitable for Brother Gu to guard conveniently."
...
Late into the night, at Chaotian Sect's Main Peak.
The two Nascent Soul Ancestors, who had sequestered themselves for many years, suddenly appeared and summoned the Peak Masters of the twenty-one peaks to the Main Peak for a meeting, which lasted until the early morning of the next day. As the first ray of sunlight fell upon the Chaotian Sect, the tightly closed doors of the Main Peak's grand hall suddenly swung open. However, of the twenty-one Peak Masters who walked out of the grand hall, only sixteen remained.
Text acquired from M|V|LEMP&YR.
At the same time, within the Punishment Hall, the Hall Master, who had received Di Tao's orders, released Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming stood under the sunshine again, and upon learning that his master, along with four other Peak Masters, had been punished to face the wall in contemplation on the Main Peak for speaking out of turn, he couldn't help but reveal a slight smile.
However, an hour later, when he realized he had not left the Illusion Array, the smile on his face vanished completely.
In a side room of Lingxing Peak, Yuan Ming paced back and forth, brows furrowed in thought, pondering over potential oversights.
Through his efforts, most of the adverse factors in the battle for Chaotian Sect's downfall had been eliminated. The only thing remaining might be the mysterious man in grey, the leader of the rebellion.
But that person was a Nascent Soul cultivator; surely they couldn't expect him, a mere Foundation Establishment Cultivator, to deal with the man himself?
Yuan Ming sighed and looked up, only to see a painting hanging on the wall.
In the painting, Shen Lingyun, dressed in a pristine white robe, gazed like water, gentle and clear, and his smiling face was as warm as the winter sun.
In front of him, Zhen Luo, in tattered clothes, knelt and kowtowed, his face full of tears, as if he had just endured an indescribable hardship.
The two figures in the painting stood against different backdrops; the stark contrast between light and dark subtly conveyed the painter's deep yearnings and aspirations.
In the bottom right corner of the painting, the name of the piece was written—just two characters: Master.
Yuan Ming gazed at the painting and felt a flash of spirit light in his mind, as memories from the time he entered the Illusion Array flooded in, finally connecting all the dots.
Shen Lingyun was a Soul Cultivator, yet he called the grey-clothed old man his revered teacher. However, judging from the grey man's actions last time, he was not a Soul Cultivator.
Who then provided Shen Lingyun with the Soul Cultivation Method? Could it be a fortuitous encounter?
But the duality of cultivating both one's magic soul and divine soul is exceedingly difficult. Yuan Ming himself had barely managed thus far, relying on the Stealing Heaven Tripod and various chances. Shen Lingyun had to infiltrate Chaotian Sect and hide his Soul Cultivator identity from the grey-clothed man, how did he obtain the resources to get this far?
Furthermore, what was so important about the intelligence specifically destroyed by the Beiming Alliance, which mentioned only a special demon beast? Why spend so much effort to eradicate it?
Linking this question with the term "Soul Cultivator," all problems seemed to unravel.
The methods of a Soul Cultivator, setting aside signature techniques like Illusion Techniques, are fundamentally extensions of Divine Soul Refining.
Knowing what a Soul Cultivator uses for Refining, while it may not completely reveal their specific capabilities, at least provides an understanding of their general range of abilities.
For instance, the most prominent feature of Sha Hao and the Great Elder's Blood Bat is "Sound Waves," whereas Yuan Ming's own Soul Crow is critical for "Far Travel."
The information erased by the Beiming Alliance might contain the details of a key figure.
Realizing this, Yuan Ming didn't hesitate and immediately dashed out of the side room, hurrying to the Punishment Hall to find Gu Zhiping, and without preamble, said,
"Senior Brother Gu, please help me get a message to Uncle Master Di; I have an urgent matter to report."

chapters.title: Chapter 414 - 391 Reminiscence
chapters.content:
Gu Zhiping heard the words, opened his mouth, yet before he could speak, a figure descended from the sky beside them. The tunneling light converged, revealing Di Tao's presence.
"What do you seek from me?"
The entire appearance of Di Tao was silent and without a trace, as if a ghostly specter emerged soundlessly.
In fact, Yuan Ming's Cave Mansion had already been placed under covert surveillance by his people. At the slightest movement from Yuan Ming, information about his whereabouts would be reported immediately to him, and ever since Yuan Ming was spotted several hundred feet away from the Punishment Hall, Di Tao had locked onto him with his Divine Sense.
"Uncle Master Di, may I inquire if the ancestors have any spare time? I have important information about the gray-clad old man that must be communicated in person," Yuan Ming said, not bothering to question why Di Tao had appeared so swiftly, and immediately spoke with urgency.
Upon hearing this, Gu Zhiping's eyes widened, and he looked at Yuan Ming with a complex expression. It was known that even the Peak Masters of each peak couldn't just request to meet the two Nascent Soul Ancestors as they pleased, let alone these Foundation Establishment disciples.
Yet now, Yuan Ming boldly demanded an audience with the ancestors as if it were his right.
Di Tao's expression changed, and after studying Yuan Ming closely for a moment, he nodded his head.
Shortly after, under his leadership, Yuan Ming alone stepped into the Ancestor Master Hall located at Chaotian Sect's Main Peak, and for the first time, faced the Nascent Soul Ancestors of the Chaotian Sect.
In the middle of the spacious and solemn hall was a platform surrounded by golden-yellow banners. At this moment, an old man with white hair and beard, dressed in a plain Daoist robe, was sitting cross-legged.
The old man was currently facing away from the door, closing his eyes for Breathing Control, his hands forming the Meridian Seal in front of him, with a whisk carelessly resting on his shoulder, looking no different from the common Taoist seen in mortal temples.
"Reporting to the ancestor, Zhen Luo is in attendance," Di Tao said, bowing to the old man.
"Disciple Zhen Luo, pays respects to the ancestor," Yuan Ming said respectfully.
"Although my junior brother isn't smart, his talents are beyond question. Not only is he cautious, but his methods are extremely brutal. You say you saw him by chance, and you were even alive afterwards to draw out his likeness. Could it be he has changed his ways?" The old man in the Daoist robe turned around, looking at Yuan Ming with a half-smile.
"Could it be the junior brother the ancestor mentioned is..." Yuan Ming feigned ignorance, and with a slight shock, he said.
"Hehe, indeed, it's the same old man who was conferring secretly with your master," the old man in the Daoist robe nodded and said.
"I dare not deceive the Great Master. Although I possess some unique methods, my desire to protect the Sect remains unchanged," Yuan Ming immediately replied.
The man in the Daoist robe said nothing; he scrutinized Yuan Ming for a long time before slowly nodding his head.
"Good. If all disciples of this Sect were like you, I could close the Life and Death Seclusion in peace and wouldn't have to appear for these trivial matters."
Yuan Ming was slightly startled in his heart, feeling that the attitude of the Daoist-robed old ancestor seemed different from what he had expected.
"Di Tao mentioned that about my worthless junior brother, what have you discovered?" The old man in the Daoist robe asked again before Yuan Ming could fully comprehend his thoughts.
Hearing this, Yuan Ming immediately nodded and shared his earlier prepared statements regarding Shen Lingyun's "behaviors" that he had let slip inadvertently and his own conjectures.
These "behaviors" were naturally mostly related to Soul Cultivation; after all, he was most familiar with Soul Cultivation. Whether Shen Lingyun had actually done these things was not important. As long as the ancestor could deduce Shen Lingyun's identity as a Soul Cultivator from them, it would suffice.
Now, as a mere Foundation Establishment cultivator facing a Nascent Soul, instead of trying to fabricate lies, it was better to reveal the truth, which would seem more credible.
"...A strange insect that brings people back to life? A Soul Cultivator who uses such a being for Refining? Could it mean..." The old man in the Daoist robe suddenly furrowed his brow.
"I had doubts before, not knowing why so many traitors would appear in the Sect. At first, I thought they might be masquerading like Tao Wenlong, but now upon reflection, perhaps they have had their minds controlled by the hidden Soul Cultivator, thereby becoming enemies of the Sect," Yuan Ming added.
The old man in the Daoist robe nodded thoughtfully, but said nothing more.
"Ancestor, I also found this cultivation technique not long ago in Shen Lingyun's Cave Mansion. I dared not examine it closely at the time, but I copied down a small part of it, please review," seeing this, Yuan Ming said, turning his hand over, and in his palm appeared a Jade Scroll.
The old man in the Daoist robe gestured with one hand, and the Jade Scroll fell into it. With a sweep of his Divine Sense, his expression changed instantly.
"Di Tao, you may leave first," the elder said to Di Tao who was also standing below.
Di Tao was slightly taken aback but did not dare to disobey the ancestor's wish. After giving Yuan Ming a look, he took his leave.
The elder did not look at Yuan Ming again and did not say anything more. With just a slight movement of his lips, but without making a sound, it seemed like he was transmitting a message to someone.
Yuan Ming also said nothing further, only bowing his head respectfully, with his eyes observing his nose, and his nose observing his heart, he waited patiently.
The contents of the Jade Scroll actually originated from the beginning of the "Heart Cleansing Technique." Although it was incomplete, it was evident that it was a quite extraordinary Soul Cultivation Method.
After all, his only goal was to complete the task given by the Shura Master. As for other matters, there was no need to be overly concerned.Che-c*k for the l^a#t&es!t up#da.tes# on My V.ir&t!ua!l* Libr+a.r!y E^mp!i-r@e (#*#)^.
After 15 minutes, a red-clothed girl entered the hall. She was another Nascent Soul Ancestor of the Chaotian Sect.
With a curious look, she glanced at Yuan Ming twice, then bluntly spoke to the elder in the Daoist robe, "Hey, Senior Brother Lu, turns out you guessed right. Their Divine Souls have indeed been tampered with. It's just that the discovery came a bit late and, with our methods, I'm afraid we can't resolve it."
"What a pity. Then there's no need to keep them. You go handle it," the elder in the Daoist robe nodded, his tone as calm as if he were crushing an insect.
Upon hearing this, the red-clothed girl did not seem surprised. She nodded and then left straight away. At the same time, the elder in the Daoist robe turned to look at Yuan Ming. Seeing his surprised face, he slowly said,
"Do you think I'm being too cruel?"
"Disciple wouldn't dare... However, Venerable Ancestor, Uncle Master Shao and the others have also contributed a lot to the Sect in the past. Since it has been clarified that betrayal was not their intention, why can't they be imprisoned on the Main Peak and seek a solution slowly?" Yuan Ming carefully measured his words and cautiously asked.
"Because it is not just as simple as them being controlled by others. I am merely assisting them in liberation. Your recent guess was correct. There truly is a Soul Cultivator with not low cultivation who has taken 'Soul Devouring Leech' as the prototype for his Divine Soul Refining. He made his name five hundred years ago and once caused All Major Sects of the Central Plains to join forces to pursue him. And yet, he luckily escaped with his life. Unexpectedly, today, he has targeted my Chaotian Sect again. It seems the news of the Overseas Spiritual Treasure has ultimately been leaked by that foolish disciple of mine," the elder in the Daoist robe lamented as he spoke.
"The person Venerable Ancestor is talking about is?" Yuan Ming inquired curiously.
"His original name is unknown, but he calls himself the Six Desires Venerable. His cultivation has reached the Nascent Soul Mid-stage. His myriad of methods are unfathomable, and the most insidious among them is his 'Soul Attachment' skill," the elder in the Daoist robe said with a look of reminiscence in his eyes.
"Soul Attachment... Soul Devouring Leech..." Yuan Ming frowned upon hearing this.
"He can split his Divine Soul into leeches the size of small fingers and bury them into others' Divine Senses. Not only can he continuously absorb their Soul Power, but he can also covertly alter their minds, turning them into puppets under the control of Six Desires. Most crucially, each Divine Soul Leech could potentially be transformed into his main soul. During the previous sieges, he had used this skill multiple times to escape from our 'Heaven and Earth Net,'" the elder in the Daoist robe recalled that time, a hint of apprehension on his face.
"With such peculiar abilities, wouldn't he be immortal?" Yuan Ming exclaimed in surprise.
"Hehe, in this world, who truly has eternal life? Even those of the Returning Void Realm from ancient times cannot outlast their lifespan, let alone a mere Nascent Soul. No matter how many Divine Soul Leeches he splits off, once his lifespan ends, he cannot escape death," the elder in the Daoist robe said with a bitter smile.
"Moreover, the Divine Soul Leeches are linked to his main soul; setting aside their limited number, once they are embedded in someone's Divine Soul, they cannot separate again. Furthermore, if the host dies, the Divine Soul Leeches will also perish, and his own cultivation will be affected."
"In addition, during the sieges, we discovered that for a Divine Soul Leech to restore the main soul's cultivation, it takes at least ten years. During this period, if we manage to capture a Divine Soul Leech beforehand, we can also use a Secret Technique to locate the other leeches."
"However, the execution of the Secret Technique consumes the Divine Soul Leech, and once performed, it will alert him, making the efficiency of the capture extremely low. In the end, we could only let the matter rest," the elder in the Daoist robe reminisced with a sense of regret.
No sooner had he finished speaking than the red-clothed girl returned, but this time, her expression was much more serious. She glanced at Yuan Ming and then announced,
"Senior Brother Lu, we've found the traitor's location."
Upon hearing this, the elder in the Daoist robe fell silent for a moment, the sorrow on his face deepening before he sighed,
