"...Alas, so many years have gone by, and I didn't expect my disciple to still be so deluded. Well then, it's time for me to personally put an end to the mistake he made."
As soon as these words fell, Yuan Ming suddenly heard a harsh sound of porcelain shattering in the hall.
With surprise, he lifted his head only to see that although he was still in the Ancestor Master Hall, the entire hall's arrangement had undergone significant changes.
The elder in the Daoist robe and the red-clothed girl had suddenly vanished, and in their place were three members of the Chaotian Sect, an elder and two youths, all unfamiliar faces.
Though unfamiliar, after observing them closely for a moment, Yuan Ming could vaguely see that the features of the two young Cultivators bore some resemblance to the elder in the Daoist robe and that disciple.
"Rebel! Do you realize what you have done? Entire three cities, nearly a hundred thousand lives, do they mean nothing to you?"
The elder with flowing whiskers bellowed, smacking hard on the long table beside him, causing the teacups on it to crash down.

chapters.title: Chapter 415 - 392 All Living Beings' Dream
chapters.content:
Hearing the rebukes of the older Elder Chang Ran, the slightly younger cultivator merely hung his head, remaining silent.
"Wickedness, wickedness!" Seeing this, the elder became even more infuriated, pointing at the young cultivator and bellowing non-stop.
"Master, Junior Brother Kang is still young, and it was only from a moment of confusion that he made such a grave mistake. We should first think of a way to cover this up. The matter of his punishment can be discussed later," the slightly older young cultivator advised.
Yuan Ming, upon witnessing this, somewhat realized that the three people before him were the ancestral masters of the Chaotian Sect and the still-Core Formation stage Elder Lu, brothers of the Sect.
"Cover up? The incident has caused such a stir, not to mention the Five Thunder Sect, I'm afraid that the sects of the entire Central Plains already know it was this traitor who did it. Before long, they will come knocking on our door to demand justice, and you ask me how to cover it up!" the ancestral master spoke angrily.
"Master, why bother yourself with these trivialities? Once I have fully refined this treasure, not to mention the sects of the Central Plains, even if all the sects of Yunhuang Continent combined, they will not be our match," said Cultivator Kang, suddenly raising his head to make his declaration.
"Ha, you traitor dare to utter such wild boasts. Even if you refine a Magic Treasure, ten or eight of them, what difference would it make? A mere Core Formation, do you truly think you can take on thousands, overcome dozens of Nascent Soul cultivators joining hands?" the ancestral master sneered furiously in response.
"It's insufficient with a Magic Treasure, but what about a Spiritual Treasure? Master, at this point, I have nothing to hide from you. Do you remember when I went alone to the East Sea to hunt for treasures several months ago? There, I encountered an individual claiming to be from beyond Yunhuang, whose skills were beyond the match of any Nascent Soul stage cultivator. Seeing my devotion to the Dao, he not only described to me the various marvels beyond Yunhuang, he also bestowed upon me this unfinished Spiritual Treasure, advising me that as long as I diligently refined it, I could ascend to heaven in a single step," Cultivator Kang said, with a trace of fanaticism flashing across his face.
The ancestral master and Cultivator Lu were then struck with astonishment.
Meanwhile, the scene before Yuan Ming shifted in a blur once more, and this time, he found himself no longer within the Ancestor Master Hall, but in a valley that seemed to have been the site of a great battle.
At the bottom of the valley, the blood-covered Cultivator Kang knelt on the ground with a miserable laugh while before him, the equally wounded Elder Lu, supporting the ancestral master, looked toward Cultivator Kang with a glance that bore a trace of reluctance and remorse.
"Cough cough cough, you traitor, even now, do you still refuse to surrender, to preserve the thousand-year foundation of our Chaotian Sect?" the ancestral master questioned, coughing up blood and looking pale.
"Hehe, old man, if you want the Spiritual Treasure, just say it. Why seek such a grand-sounding excuse?" Cultivator Kang forced himself to stand, his body swaying as he spoke with a cold laugh.
Upon hearing this, the ancestral master couldn't help but let out a bitter laugh, his expression one of profound sadness as he sighed:
"Who would have thought that I, Lu Fangzhou, priding myself on my excellent judgment all my life, would have a moment of misjudgment? Accepting you, a traitor, is the shame of my life. If today I cannot slay you here, even in death, I will have no face to meet the ancestral masters of Chaotian Sect in the underworld!"
Having said this, Lu Fangzhou suddenly pushed away Elder Lu, who was supporting him, and unleashed the imposing aura of his Nascent Soul Stage without reservation.
Seeing this, Cultivator Kang struggled to steady himself, preparing to grimly execute a spell, but then he saw Elder Lu step forward to block Lu Fangzhou.
"Master, I implore you to spare Junior Brother Kang for the sake of our many years of camaraderie. All the Major Sects are awaiting our news, and as long as we take the Spiritual Treasure back and claim Junior Brother is dead, they will not quibble," Elder Lu pleaded.
"Get out of my way!" Lu Fangzhou's eyes blazed with fury, clearly unmoved by the plea.
Just then, a deep chuckle suddenly echoed through the valley.
"Haha, that was close, I almost missed it."
Lu Fangzhou and Elder Lu were both taken aback, looking around but seeing no one.
"Who's there, come out!" roared Lu Fangzhou.
However, in the next instant, he saw Cultivator Kang enveloped in a white light, vanishing from sight in a flash.
"As per our agreement, I have taken the person away. As for that Spiritual Treasure, since it was already given away, it has nothing to do with me anymore. You may take it back with you, but whether he will come back to reclaim it in the future is not my concern," the voice gradually faded, soon disappearing completely from the valley.
As the voice disappeared, Yuan Ming's vision changed once again, and this time he found himself above the Chaotian Sect, looking down upon the twenty-one peaks engulfed in roaring flames.
In front of him, the grey-robed Cultivator Kang stood shoulder to shoulder with Lei Kuang and others, their expressions impassive as they stared at the fiery Chaotian Sect below, seemingly lost in thought.
"Master, the cleanup is complete, not a single survivor was left."
Suddenly, Shen Lingyun's voice came from behind Yuan Ming. Turning around, he saw that standing next to Shen Lingyun was a young man with a pale expression.
"Hmm, it's time to go, Fellow Daoist Lei, I owe you thanks for your aid this time. From now on, the task of 'relief' falls on you," Cultivator Kang nodded slightly, then turned to look at Lei Kuang.
"Heh, no problem at all, but Fellow Daoist Kang, doesn't it pain your heart that the foundation of the Chaotian Sect, built up over a thousand years, was destroyed by your hands?" Lei Kuang asked with some curiosity.
"I have come only for vengeance," Cultivator Kang said indifferently.
Lei Kuang chuckled. He did not seem to believe what he said, but he didn't intend to probe further. After a casual salute, he took his disciples and pretended to help with the disaster relief while actually plundering the resources of the Chaotian Sect.
"Your senior brother's memory does not contain any information about the whereabouts of the Shura Blood Devouring Map," a man draped in a black cloak said suddenly after Lei Guang left.
"Hmph, that old man deceives even his own disciples, truly a deep and calculating mind. However, when the six sects joined forces to condemn him years ago, and he managed to preserve the Chaotian Sect, it's impossible that he hid the news about the Shura Blood Devouring Map alone. Among the other Nascent Souls present at that time, there must have been some who knew the situation," Cultivator Kang said with a cold expression.
"But this is not what we agreed upon. If it weren't for your promise that you would definitely find the Shura Blood Devouring Map during this opportunity, why would I have expended so much effort to help you?" the cloaked man spoke with evident dissatisfaction.
"Rest assured, what I have promised will eventually end up in your hands; it's just a matter of time. Or are you, the impressive Six Desires Venerable, not even patient enough to wait this out?" Cultivator Kang spoke leisurely.
"You had better find what I want before I run out of patience."
The Six Desires Venerable clenched his teeth, seemingly wanting to attack Cultivator Kang, but appeared to be wary of something, and in the end, he did nothing but issue a harsh threat.
"Alright, I will focus on the investigation for the next while, and I'll let you know once I have news," Cultivator Kang nodded and then turned and left.
Shen Lingyun hurriedly followed, but before leaving, he discreetly glanced at the Six Desires Venerable, who silently nodded back to him.
Throughout all this, none of them paid any attention to the young man following Shen Lingyun, nor did they care about the emotions brewing within his ash-like pupils.
Yuan Ming quietly watched the young man, feeling contemplative about the fickleness of the world, when suddenly, the young man looked up and met his gaze.
"You did well," the young man said, his figure gradually changing until he completely turned into the likeness of the statue in front of the tower.
"I appreciate the compliment, senior," Yuan Ming, startled, felt a surge of shock in his heart but managed to respond with a composed salute.
"You need not worry. Currently I am nothing but a Residual Soul guarding this Illusion Array, I cannot harm you in the slightest," the Shura Master said as he stepped towards Yuan Ming, raised his hand, and swiftly, the scenery around them changed, returning them to the starting chambers.
"Since I created this Illusion Array, you are the first to unearth the thread of the Six Desires Venerable within three attempts in all these years," the Shura Master said, looking at Yuan Ming with an approving gaze.
Love this story? Show your support on *.
"Senior flatters me, I merely happened to know some key information in advance. But there's something I don't quite understand. Why can the Illusion Array created by senior be so lifelike? If I hadn't been informed beforehand, I might have thought that all the people inside were real, not imaginary," Yuan Ming questioned.
"That's because those you encountered, are indeed real people," the Shura Master smiled slightly, with a wave of his hand, a cup of fragrant tea appeared in front of each of them.
"Real people? Senior, surely you jest. Not to mention the deceased in the Illusion Array, but even if they were alive, more than three thousand years have passed. Even Nascent Souls don't have such a long lifespan," Yuan Ming strongly shook his head.
"You're right. Though cultivators strive against the heavens, we are still confined by the limits of lifespan. Not just Nascent Souls, even those who reach the Returning to Void stage cannot share the same longevity as the heavens and earth; immortality is but an empty hope," the Shura Master replied.
"However, after reaching Returning Void, in my pursuit of breakthrough, I sought ways to leave Yunhuang multiple times. Although I still failed to leave in the end, I stumbled upon a Divine Rune from Overseas during my travels."
"It's through this rune that I deduced the Illusion Array Divine Ability. While I claimed it was to make up for past regrets, that was merely the surface. The true purpose of the Illusion Array is to substitute for the physical body and accommodate the Divine Soul, creating a dreamlike phantom world by consuming their Divine Soul Power."
"Thus, I also named this Illusion Array Divine Ability 'All Living Beings' Dream.' Here, everyone ceaselessly experiences their own beautiful dreams, free of regrets and pain. Everything they yearn for is realized within this realm," the Shura Master explained as countless scrolls suddenly appeared around them, the contents of which constantly shifted, seemingly reflecting the lives of different people.
Yuan Ming listened, dumbstruck, and couldn't help asking, "Such a powerful divine ability, can it truly be mastered by someone in Returning Void?"
"Naturally not. To establish All Living Beings' Dream, one requires, first, the mystical power of that rune; second, a plentiful supply of Divine Soul Power for consumption; and third, a sufficient number of Divine Souls to fill in the potential gaps in the dreamscape. The scenes you witnessed previously also needed their memories to complete the details," the Shura Master explained, gently shaking his head.

chapters.title: Chapter 416 - 393: Deceiving Others and Oneself
chapters.content:
"For this, I mercilessly slaughtered a million mortals, using the power of their divine souls as kindling, and collected thousands of cultivator souls to construct the illusion, and even split a part of my own soul to serve as the core. Only then did I barely manage to build this All Living Beings' Dream," Senior Shura said continuingly, without waiting for Yuan Ming to speak, lamenting the difficulty of his endeavor.
However, Yuan Ming felt his hair stand on end as he listened, his heart pounding with fear despite having witnessed so much bloodshed after stepping onto the Immortal Path.
"Do not think of my methods as cruel. The path of immortal and mortal is distinct, and all beings suffer. In fact, those cultivators I killed initially harbored some resentment, but when they realized that the All Living Beings' Dream could fulfill all their desires, they began to worship me as a deity, thanking me more than once for integrating them into this formation. Moreover, without my intervention, after three thousand years, they would have been nothing but a handful of dust, whereas, in the All Living Beings' Dream, they are still alive to this day. If you wish, I can even bring a few here for you to hear how they feel," Senior Shura said nonchalantly, raising his hand as if about to summon someone.
"Senior, there's no need, I understand your methods are formidable, and maybe they are genuinely willing, but I must ask you, even if these cultivators' dreams are beautiful, when the divine souls of a million mortals are exhausted, would you also use them as kindling? Besides, with you in control here, their life and death are merely at your whim. Is such longevity, such a life, truly delightful? Truly free?" Yuan Ming asked.
"The questions you asked, some have asked me years ago, but after enjoying hundreds of years of beautiful dreams, he no longer harbored any other thoughts. You are a prodigy, young and yet having fortuitous encounters and stepping into Core Formation, aiming for a longer, grander path. But for most people, their lifespan – reaching Foundation Establishment or even just Qi Refinement – is their limit, spending most of their lives in arduous cultivation, with no time for pleasures. Thousands of years of beautiful dreams and hundreds of years of illusionary feasts, which is real, which is illusion, what does it matter, as long as one is content and merry while alive," Senior Shura said, shaking his head.
Yuan Ming fell silent, finding himself unable to find words to counter Senior Shura, and realized that for those trapped inside the All Living Beings' Dream, abruptly bringing them back to reality may actually be more cruel. He sighed deeply, choosing not to speak further.
"Actually, for you guys, the trial I set up, failing it might have been better than succeeding."
"After all, succeeding would only mean obtaining the Magic Treasure Skills I have accumulated, continuing to struggle in the cruel mundane world, but failing, on the other hand, would allow you to enjoy peace within the All Living Beings' Dream."
"Especially you, with so many Nascent Soul cultivators out there wanting you dead, going out might not be as safe as staying here," Senior Shura cajoled persuasively, his words laden with seduction.
"Thank you for your kind thoughts, Senior, but the situation I'm facing is not precisely one of inevitable death, and moreover, if I cannot control my own destiny, being immersed in a false dream is, to me, nothing but a gilded death," Yuan Ming said resolutely, shaking his head.
"Real or fake, like an illusion or a dream, life is but a dream; how much is it worth for joy? How can you be so sure that the current 'you' isn't dreaming? Why be so obstinate about whether it's reality or a falsehood?" Senior Shura remarked regretfully.
"Actually, I wanted to ask you: if you think the All Living Beings' Dream is so wonderful, then why isn't your main soul living in it? Instead, you continue to seek adventurous opportunities to go overseas?" Yuan Ming shifted the conversation, interrogating in return.
Senior Shura stared at Yuan Ming, then suddenly pointed at him and burst into laughter,
"Not bad, not bad! Why don't I want to join myself? Ha ha ha, maybe I've been in the dream for too long, thinking about deceiving others, but I ended up deceiving myself."
"We cultivators, if we do not aspire to compete with the heavens, how are we different from mortals? What's false will ultimately be false and can never become real, just like this tea, its aroma, its richness, cannot enter my nose or mouth, is nothing but self-deception."
Having said that, Senior Shura swept his sleeve, and the tea on the table instantly disappeared.
At that moment, Yuan Ming suddenly remembered something and hurriedly said, "Senior Shura, I wonder if the trials for the others have ended and if they have all passed?"
Senior Shura glanced at him, smirked teasingly, "Are you worried about your sweetheart? Both of you share the same concern, truly envy-worthy!"
Yuan Ming gave an awkward laugh, suddenly understanding the implication in Senior Shura's words, and quickly inquired, "Does that mean, Senior, that she has already met with you?"
Senior Shura nodded and pointed toward a painting scroll beside them.
Everything in the painting scroll was continuously changing. Yuan Ming focused, and saw Xi Ying, dressed in black, sitting cross-legged in a secret room, incessantly absorbing the Black Mist from the Soul Suppressing Kettle in front of her, apparently cultivating.
"Speaking of which, she was even quicker than you; she used just one opportunity to solve the trial I set, which made me curious enough to meet her myself. But after talking for mere moments, she began asking about you and, upon learning you were still safe, she even offered to give up her reward and asked me to promise her that should your trial fail, not to trap you in the All Living Beings' Dream but to send you out of the Cave Mansion," Senior Shura recounted slowly.
Upon hearing this, warmth flooded Yuan Ming's heart, and he immediately responded, "Senior Shura, since I have successfully passed the trial, her words should not count. Please reinstate her reward, and if that breaks the rules, you can cancel mine instead."
"Ah, why do all you young ones think I'm some kind of villain? It's just a trivial matter, so why should it cost you your rewards?" the Shura Master seemed somewhat displeased as he tapped on the table.
Yuan Ming coughed awkwardly, not daring to voice his real thoughts.
The Shura Master didn't seem too concerned about it and seeing that Yuan Ming had no response, he continued.
"Alright, let's end the idle chatter here. As one of the only two people who has made me appear in person, I allow you to proactively choose the type of reward you need, be it Magic Treasures or Cultivation Techniques. If you have no specific desires, then I'll choose something suitable for you myself."
"I'll defer to Senior's decision," Yuan Ming said immediately without a second thought.
The Shura Master seemed to have anticipated his response. With a flick of his finger, a streak of light instantly flew into Yuan Ming's body.
Immediately after, Yuan Ming realized that a new secret technique called "Soul Splitting and Soul Merging Technique" had appeared in his mind.
"I see you practice both the Magic Soul and dual cultivation. Thus, this secret technique is most suitable for you. It is known that during the Nascent Soul formation, one must merge their Divine Soul with the Golden Core to progress. However, for a Soul Cultivator, all Divine Skills reside within the Divine Soul, and following the normal method would undoubtedly result in a loss of all abilities, rendering one weaker than a Core Formation cultivator," explained the Shura Master.
Yuan Ming was taken aback as he had only recently entered the Core Formation Stage and knew little about the Nascent Soul process. He had not realized there were such intricacies involved.
"So this 'Soul Splitting and Soul Merging Technique' can resolve this issue?" Yuan Ming asked while checking the secret technique.
"This 'Soul Splitting and Soul Merging Technique' allows one's Divine Soul to split into two, with one part merging into the Golden Core. This way, one can preserve their Soul Cultivator's cultivation and also proceed with forming the Nascent Soul without impacting oneself," said the Shura Master.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming recalled Xi Cangqiong's Soul Splitting Secret Technique, which was quite similar to this 'Soul Splitting and Soul Merging Technique'; however, the split souls from the former had their own consciousness and could potentially pose a risk as they grew stronger.
The split soul from the 'Soul Splitting and Soul Merging Technique' was different; it had no hidden dangers and shared a united will with the main soul, essential for condensing the Nascent Soul.
"That being said, the 'Soul Splitting and Soul Merging Technique' is extremely dangerous to perform. Unlike typical soul splitting methods, it requires a complete replication of the main soul's Seven Emotions and Six Desires, making it a hundred times more dangerous than the usual Soul Splitting Secret Techniques. Before I acquired this technique, many had become fools from its practice. You must be extremely cautious before cultivating it; it's not to be used lightly unless absolutely necessary," the Shura Master warned.The full series lives on My Virtual Library Empire (*).
Yuan Ming's expression remained unchanged upon hearing this, yet he felt a bit of secret joy. He had already generated his own split soul through a serendipitous coincidence and was quite experienced in this regard.
Furthermore, each time he split his soul, the desired power's hot flow inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod would automatically repair it, making his cultivation of this technique far safer than others.
However, Yuan Ming still put on a reluctant face and said, "Senior Luo, since this technique is so perilous, doesn't it seem inappropriate to offer it as a reward? My pursuit of the Soul Cultivation Path is just a hobby, and I don't necessarily intend to go too far on this path. Please consider replacing it with something else."
"Ah, to tell you the truth, while I do have many techniques and treasures here, given your strength in both the Magic Soul and dual cultivation during the Core Formation Stage, you probably wouldn't be interested in them. Yet, the Nascent Soul Stage items would be useless to you if you can't break through to the Nascent Soul Stage. After considering everything, this really is the most suitable for you," the Shura Master said somewhat helplessly.
Seeing Yuan Ming still looked dissatisfied, he quickly added, "Of course, since I have offered it, I won't let you suffer a loss. The Black Key you obtained earlier is crucial to the operation of my Cave Mansion. Securing it is akin to gaining the entire mansion, sadly you couldn't keep it due to your lesser strength. Therefore, I will bestow upon you a Spirit Talisman, which can substitute for the Black Key, enable you to gain partial control of the Cave Mansion, and give you an advantage when competing for Spiritual Treasures."
With those words, he flicked his finger again, and a beam of Blood Light entered Yuan Ming's forehead, soon transforming into a mark resembling an erect pupil before blinking twice and vanishing.
"Spiritual Treasures? May I ask, Senior, what exactly are Spiritual Treasures?" Yuan Ming, delighted about his additional gains, still harbored some doubts about this "Spiritual Treasure" and decided to inquire further.
"A 'Spiritual Treasure' is a treasure only cultivable by those above the Returning to Void Stage. Compared to Magic Treasures, it awakens spiritual intelligence to a certain extent, hence the designation 'Spiritual Treasure.' Naturally, its power is vastly different from ordinary Magic Treasures," explained the Shura Master.

chapters.title: Chapter 417 - 394: Strange Tales from Overseas
chapters.content:
"A world apart? Senior, your words might be a bit exaggerated," Yuan Ming said, somewhat disbelieving.
"The power of a Spiritual Treasure is beyond your imagination. The Night Parade of Hundred Demons and the Cold Moon Ring on your body are merely replicas that I crafted. They are far from the true Spiritual Treasures, which are extremely rare. Across the entire Central Plains Immortal Cultivation World, there are probably no more than three," the Shura Master said, giving Yuan Ming a glance.
"Cold Moon Ring? Are you referring to this ring?" Yuan Ming raised his right hand, revealing the white ring on it.
"Correct. In my early years, I fortuitously obtained the method to refine the Ancient Spiritual Treasure known as the Nine Palaces Cold Moon Ring. Unfortunately, due to various limitations, I only managed to produce this replica, which possesses less than thirty percent of the original's power," the Shura Master sighed.
Yuan Ming was stunned. He could not sense the runes within the Cold Moon Ring; he could only activate some of its rather shallow powers through Mana, which were already astonishingly strong. If he could unleash the power of the runes, he couldn't imagine how formidable it would be.
If such a Cold Moon Ring was still less than thirty percent of a true Spiritual Treasure's power, then indeed, the power of a true Spiritual Treasure was unimaginable.
"Spiritual Treasures have other miraculous properties. If you have the chance to seize the Shura Blood Devouring Map located on the next level, you will naturally understand," the Shura Master added.
"The Shura Blood Devouring Map you mentioned, could it be..." Yuan Ming suddenly thought of something.
"Correct, it is the Spiritual Treasure I just showed you in the memory, the Night Parade of Hundred Demons is modeled after the Shura Blood Devouring Map. The spiritual materials are different, and I made some adjustments to the runes as well, resulting in significant differences in their Divine Skills. The Shura Blood Devouring Map is not an ordinary Spiritual Treasure. My Spirit Talisman will ensure your safety, but whether you can subdue it still depends on your own abilities," the Shura Master said.
Yuan Ming nodded, taking these words to heart before asking, "May I ask Senior, since the Night Parade of Hundred Demons was crafted by you, it should be kept within the Shura Palace. Why did it appear outside?"
"I placed the Night Parade of Hundred Demons just inside the outermost hall of the Shura Palace. The Wanderer Heavenly Ghost, who entered here before the Shura Palace came into existence, accidentally took the Night Parade of Hundred Demons," the Shura Master explained.
"I see," Yuan Ming nodded.
"Although the Night Parade of Hundred Demons and the Cold Moon Ring are both replicas, they both have potential. If you can cultivate to the Returning Void Realm in the future, you might try advancing them to full-fledged Spiritual Treasures," the Shura Master said again.
"Thank you for your auspicious words, Senior. I will do my best. Just a question, Senior Luo, the memory you showed mentioned that the Shura Blood Devouring Map was bestowed by a visitor from Overseas. Could that Senior also be a Returning to Void Cultivator? Is he still alive in this world?" Yuan Ming continued.
The Shura Master unusually fell silent for a long while before slowly shaking his head and smiling bitterly:
"I'm not very clear about that person's cultivation background or whether he's alive. After I entered the Returning Void, I searched the entire Yunhuang Continent but couldn't find any clues left by him. Perhaps he has already returned overseas," he said.
"The Stele outside the Black Tower records that you, Senior, have traveled overseas. What is that place really like?" Yuan Ming asked curiously.
"Do you know what 'overseas' refers to?" the Shura Master countered without answering.
"To be honest, before entering the Shura Palace, I had never heard of the Overseas World. According to the text you engraved on the stele outside the tower, it should be the world outside the Yunhuang Continent, right?" Yuan Ming said.
"Correct," the Shura Master replied.
"I've heard that the East Sea Area is vast with innumerable islands and abundant resources, known for being inexhaustible. Is that also part of the Overseas World?" Yuan Ming asked.
"The East Sea Area is only the near sea, worlds apart from the true Overseas World," the Shura Master said, shaking his head, gazing into the distance with a reminiscent expression.
Yuan Ming didn't speak, waiting quietly.
"Overseas is a place completely different from the Yunhuang Continent. In a word, it is a gigantic world," the Shura Master said after a moment of silence.
"Gigantic? In what way is it vast?" Yuan Ming asked, somewhat puzzled.
"Everything there is, whether it be the waves, the storms, or the demon beasts living there. Can you imagine waves tens of thousands of meters high, tornado columns connecting the heavens and the earth, or giant birds with wings spread wide enough to cover the sky? These are common sights overseas," the Shura Master said.
Yuan Ming opened his mouth but was at a loss for words.
"I've visited overseas three times. The first time from the Northern Desert, crossing the nearby Nether Sea, it took three years to reach the overseas region. I encountered a gray sea mist filled with Yin Qi. I flew for eleven years without being able to escape it, and my body was almost eroded into a ghost body by the Yin Qi in the mist. The gray mist also had hallucinatory effects. If not for accidentally discovering the 'All Living Beings' Dream' Rune, I would have died there. With the help of the All Living Beings' Dream Rune, I resisted the illusions and barely escaped the gray mist, returning to Yunhuang," the Shura Master said.
"Boundless gray mist? Could that be some kind of natural disaster overseas?" Yuan Ming asked, startled.
"Not a natural disaster. After further exploration and deduction, I found it to be just a common sea mist there," the Shura Master shook his head and said.
Yuan Ming stood bewildered on the spot, realizing that an ordinary sea fog had nearly claimed the life of a Returning to Void Cultivator, sufficiently highlighting the dangers of the Overseas.
"The second time I set out from the Southern Border, flew over the Stone Dried Sea and reached Overseas, I found the waters there extremely corrosive, making it difficult to land. I flew for months before spotting a gray island among the vast waves. Just as I was about to land on it and rest, I discovered it was actually a giant beast sleeping in the sea. Unbeknownst to me, I was poisoned by a cunning toxin, presumably intrinsic to the beast. Once I started casting, the pain became unbearable, and I had no choice but to turn back. It took me a full twenty years to finally expel the poison from my body," Shura Master recounted.
"The third, and final time, I originally headed to the East Sea, trying to find the legendary Three Immortals Island. After spending ten years, I hadn't found the Immortal Island, but instead drifted away from the coastal areas. Then, I encountered a tsunami that lasted for years. Hardly managing to survive that, I came across a tree demon as large as a mountain. I did not wish to provoke it, yet the tree demon was exceptionally belligerent and attacked. Unable to escape, I had no choice but to engage in a prolonged battle for over a month, only to be grievously defeated with my Nascent Soul crushed by the tree demon," Shura Master said.
"Such a formidable tree demon?" Yuan Ming inhaled sharply.
"I thought I was utterly doomed when suddenly, a giant maw emerged from the seabed and clamped onto the massive tree. It turned out to be an enormous sea turtle. As the two titanic beasts fought, I seized the chance to burn my Essence Blood and displayed the Blood Escape Divine Ability, barely escaping with my life. After that, I had no more chances to recover and thus ended my journey," Shura Master spoke calmly.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming was deeply shaken and remained silent for a long time.
"The Overseas World is filled with mystery and extreme danger. Even Nascent Souls and Returning to Void Cultivators have little advantage there, resembling ordinary humans. A storm or a sea fog can claim lives. Young man, if one day you also reach the Returning Void Realm, heed my advice—do not lightly venture into Overseas. Even if you go, you must prepare thoroughly. Relying solely on high cultivation to forcibly cross would merely result in your tale being a laughable story for future generations," Shura Master somberly sighed.
"How is this a laughing matter? The world is full of cowards, of those who willingly debase themselves; what right do they have to mock you, Senior? Besides, your experiences are immensely valuable. Those who later dare to explore Overseas should be grateful that you marked the path for them. Should someone manage to venture into those lands, their first thought should be to thank you, Senior, for guiding their way," Yuan Ming said resolutely.
"If that day really comes, I can then be truly without regrets," Shura Master perked up a bit upon hearing these words.
"What you may not know, Senior, is that before I stepped into the world of Cultivation, I made my living by writing travelogues and handling literary arts in Da Jin, where I was somewhat well-known. If you permit, I would like to write a travelogue about your explorations Overseas, so they may be passed down through the ages and not let your hardships be in vain," Yuan Ming proposed.
"Oh? You can write? I had similar thoughts once, but unfortunately, I lack the talent in literature. If you could produce such a book, it would indeed settle a matter for me. Here are some records of my three Overseas explorations for your reference," Shura Master said as he took out a Jade Scroll and handed it over.Uploadedbythe*)team.
"I will devote myself fully to it," Yuan Ming accepted the Jade Scroll and spoke earnestly.
"It's rare to see someone be so dedicated to my affairs; take this then," Shura Master gestured, and a cluster of pitch-black mist appeared out of nowhere, whirling with a whooshing sound.
"Is this Demonic Qi?" Yuan Ming's pupils constricted.
"Heh, you know about Demonic Qi? Although it occasionally descends on the Yunhuang Continent, not many are aware of this term," Shura Master expressed slight surprise, pressing down with his palm.
The black mist rushed towards Yuan Ming, splitting in two not towards his body but into the two Spiritual Beast Bags at his waist.
Yuan Ming was startled and hastily sent out his Divine Sense to check, only to see the Demonic Qi entering both the purple-black cocoon formed by Hua Zhi and the body of Vajra.
At this moment, Hua Zhi was fiercely refining the demon energy of the Blood Willow. The influx of Demonic Qi immediately made its aura extremely active, accelerating the refining process of the Blood Willow by several folds.
In just a few breaths, Hua Zhi's demonic power surged, breaking through the Level 3 boundary.
Since the Blood Willow was a Level 4 Demon Beast, though much of its demon energy had dissipated upon being killed, what remained was still immensely dense. After Hua Zhi broke through to Level 3, there was still plenty of unrefined demon energy left.
Hua Zhi did not stop but continued to refine the corpse of the Blood Willow, its aura rising once more.
Vajra absorbed the Demonic Qi, undergoing a transformation as it grew significantly taller, with a popping sound like frying beans emanating from its legs, and strange black patterns emerged on its leg bones.
"The spirit beasts by your side seem to have a remarkable origin and great potential. If they can absorb a lot of Demonic Qi, their cultivation might even advance faster than yours. When I ventured out to sea back then, I collected quite a bit of Demonic Qi, which I have now given to your spirit beasts. It should help them advance further," Shura Master explained.
"Thank you, Senior," Yuan Ming expressed his gratitude.
"The Demonic Qi in this land of Yunhuang originates from Overseas. Where did the Demonic Qi in these two demon beasts of yours come from?" Shura Master suddenly frowned.
"I once spent some time in the Southern Border and accidentally entered a place called Snake King Valley. There was an Underground Palace beneath it where some Demonic Qi had accumulated, and these two spirit beasts absorbed the Demonic Qi there," Yuan Ming explained.
"Snake King Valley? I seem to have never heard of it; perhaps it has changed its name over these three thousand years? Well, it doesn't matter now that I cannot leave this place. Even if I knew, it would be of no use. However, if you have the chance in the future, you should still check it out. Places with Demonic Qi always have something extraordinary," Shura Master noted.
Yuan Ming nodded, taking the advice to heart.
Seeing that there were no other matters to discuss, Shura Master then raised his hand, and a door surrounded by a faint white glow materialized before Yuan Ming.

chapters.title: Chapter 418 - 418: 395
chapters.content:
"Thank you, Senior Xiu Luo, for bestowing the treasure upon me. Once matters here are concluded, this junior will surely return to discuss the Dao with you," Yuan Ming said with a smile and a cupped-fist salute.
Afterward, he turned around, pushed open the bamboo door, and strode out.
Outside the bamboo door was a secret chamber illuminated by Moonlight Stones. Yuan Ming looked around, considering how to leave, when suddenly his heart stirred, and he turned to see a palm-sized array that appeared to have materialized on the wall.
He pressed his hand on the array, and then he heard a rumble as the wall in front of him slowly rose. He stepped out quickly and found himself back in the main hall on the second layer of the high tower.
At the same time, Wan Qi Hong and others also emerged from secret chambers in different directions; from the expressions on their faces, it seemed they hadn't achieved much.
Yuan Ming's gaze turned to Xi Ying, but she did not look at him and simply stood silently behind Dugu Feng.
Wan Qi Hong and the other five Nascent Soul cultivators exchanged glances, surprised to see that everyone had returned unharmed, and were just about to converse when they suddenly heard a crackling sound from ahead.
...
While Yuan Ming and others were undergoing their trials, a burst of crystalline light flashed outside Yin Capital City, and a giant chessboard flew in, hovering outside the city gate—it was Wu Yuezhi and his companions.
The Core Formation cultivators were still on the chessboard; however, the pattern they had formed was entirely different now, creating a circular ring.
A black light shield enveloped the whole Heavenly Star Chessboard, appearing indestructible.
"Yin Capital City! There seems to be a restriction within the city, making it difficult to see the situation inside. It doesn't look simple," the one-eyed man on the Heavenly Star Chessboard said with an astonished and delighted expression as he looked down at the city below.
The other Core Formation cultivators also peered eagerly toward Yin Capital City.
Wu Yuezhi also looked into the city, which seemed to be separated by a layer of rough crystal, making it difficult to see clearly, and Divine Sense also couldn't penetrate.
He turned to the gorgeous young girl beside him, who just happened to look back at him; both saw a trace of confusion in each other's eyes.
"Fellow Daoist Wu, now that we have reached the depths of the Immortal Mansion, shall we separate to seek our own fortunes? Continuing to advance together might be inappropriate," the one-eyed man said to Wu Yuezhi with a cupped-fist salute.
The others also looked over, their expressions cautious.
The longer they stayed on the Heavenly Star Chessboard, the more proficiently they were able to combine their Mana, and the greater their power.
However, the restrictions of the chessboard also grew deeper, its black light shield imprisoning them atop the board like a jail.
Wu Yuezhi's eyes flickered, but he remained silent.
"What you have said makes sense. Let's part ways here," the man in the green robe suddenly spoke.
"Big brother..." Wu Yuezhi seemed to want to say something but was silenced by a look from the man in the green robe.
Wu Yuezhi, somewhat reluctantly, performed a spell, and the black light around the huge chessboard dissipated, freeing everyone on it.
"We will repay the kindness of the three Daoist friends generously once we leave the Immortal Mansion," the one-eyed man said with a bow. He and several Core Formation companions flew off the chessboard and descended into the city.
The other Core Formation cultivators scattered in all directions as well, some entering the city, others flying away into the distance, quickly disappearing without a trace.
"Big brother, why let those people leave? Their departure significantly weakens the power of the Heavenly Star Chessboard. With our sister here, it would have been easy to keep them," Wu Yuezhi said, puzzled.
Although the circular protective shield had disappeared, the spirit light of the Heavenly Star Chessboard was still present, so their conversation couldn't be heard from outside.
"With my Six-winged Butterfly King Gu, they wouldn't dare to disobey," the beautiful young girl raised her arm, her loose sleeve sliding down to reveal her fair wrist.
On the young girl's arm, like white jade, was a bright butterfly pattern with three pairs of wings in different colors—one red, one white, one black—looking rather eerie.
"There's no need. With the situation always changing within the Immortal Mansion, these people with fickle hearts would be more of a bane than a boon if forcefully kept," the man in the green robe shook his head and said.
"If big brother says so, it must be right," Wu Yuezhi immediately changed his attitude, showing great trust in the man in the green robe.
"Indeed, with our combined strength as the three of us, conquering this Immortal Mansion will be more than enough," the gorgeous young girl also added.
"Big brother, didn't you say that the Illusion Technique Restriction within Yin Capital City had been broken according to that person's message? Why do I still feel its presence? Could that person be deceiving us?" Wu Yuezhi looked down at the city and asked.
"No, spreading such a lie that could easily be seen through is not that person's style. There must have been some kind of change inside Yin Capital City that caused the Illusion Array to reform," the man in the green robe said thoughtfully.
"Six Nascent Soul cultivators working together, yet they can't break a mere Illusion Array—what a bunch of incompetents," Wu Yuezhi said, showing contempt.
"Don't underestimate them. The Five Thunder Sect, Guiyuan Sect, and Spirit Talisman Sect have been established for thousands of years, and Chang Chun Temple is even an evergreen tree on the Yunhuang Continent that has lasted for ten thousand years. The Nascent Soul cultivators from these sects are not to be trifled with. You're talented and have strong methods, but if you underestimate the characters of this world because of that, you will suffer sooner or later," the man in the green robe said, his words laden with deep meaning.
"You are right, big brother," Wu Yuezhi said, his body jolting as he bowed his head in admission.
"Let's go. We have already delayed enough. Head straight for the City Lord Mansion. According to that person's message, the treasures there haven't been claimed yet; we can't let others take advantage," the man in the green robe flew downward.
Wu Yuezhi and the young girl followed hurriedly.
...
Within the second layer of the black tower, accompanying the "click-click" sounds, the walls cracked open again, revealing the passage to the third layer.
The crowd exchanged glances; led by Wan Qi Hong and other Nascent Soul cultivators, they took to flight towards the direction of the passage.
At that moment, strands of yellow light began to appear out of the void above the passage, and the next moment, countless yellow clouds billowed forth, instantly enveloping the entire second layer space.
Composed of numerous minute sand particles, the rolling yellow clouds produced a "whooshing" sound as they surged.
The change occurred so suddenly that everyone, including Wan Qi Hong, didn't have time to react before being surrounded by the yellow clouds, which also covered the ground.
"A new trial? No, someone is sabotaging us!" Yuan Ming was stunned but quickly came to his senses.
"Su Zimo!" Wan Qi Hong roared, spitting out two golden sword beams which slashed towards Su Zimo, who was behind the crowd, like lightning.
"Haha, in the end, it is you, Fellow Daoist Wan Qi, who discovered it first. However, it is already too late," laughed Su Zimo heartily, pulling along the golden-haired, blue-eyed youth, and retreating backwards into the yellow clouds while sweeping his sleeve.
A yellow silk magic treasure shot out, spinning swiftly, transforming into a layer of hazy yellow light shield that blocked the golden sword beams.
However, those golden sword beams were incredibly sharp; with the sound of fabric tearing, the yellow light shield was easily split apart, but the beams paused for an instant.
Taking advantage of this moment, Su Zimo and the golden-haired youth rushed into the yellow clouds and disappeared without a trace.
"Don't even think of escaping! Dual Sword Combined Divine Power!" Wan Qi Hong rubbed his hands together and then quickly separated them.
The two swords beams intertwined and in a blink, their momentum increased manifold, cutting open a huge rift in the yellow clouds as they gave chase.
The speed of the conjoined sword beams also increased by leaps and bounds, swiftly catching up with Su Zimo and the golden-haired youth and slashing at them from above.
The golden-haired youth grabbed Su Zimo by the shoulder and the two figures "swooshed" and vanished from the spot.
A straight trail appeared in the yellow clouds ahead, clearly a result of the golden-haired youth carrying Su Zimo as they fled hastily.
A flicker of astonishment crossed Yuan Ming's eyes; he was no stranger to the movement technique of the golden-haired youth—it was the speedy movement technique occasionally used by Body Cultivation after breaking through to an Innate Body, unique to Body Cultivation.This copy was generated from content at *.
Yet, the speed of the golden-haired youth was far greater than that of Vajra.
"It seems that the golden-haired youth is also an individual cultivator," Yuan Ming pondered to himself.
Surprise also crossed Wan Qi Hong's face, but he didn't stop; he continued to control the combined sword beams to slash forward, breaking through layer upon layer of yellow clouds.
However, the yellow clouds were filled with a dense and tenacious force, causing the speed of the sword beams to slow down more and more until they finally came to a complete halt.
The yellow clouds were thick ahead, and Divine Sense was also greatly limited in this place, unable to spread too far, leaving the full depth of the clouds unknown.
Countless yellow threads surged out from within the yellow clouds, entwining around the golden sword beams, quickly dimming their luster as the Dual Sword Combined Divine Power automatically dissolved, revealing two golden Flying Swords.
The yellow threads wound around the Flying Swords, swiftly covering most of the blade.
Wan Qi Hong snorted coldly and performed a hand seal; dazzling golden flames rose from the two golden Flying Swords.
The golden flames emitted astonishing high temperatures, causing even the void to ripple slightly, and the yellow threads were quickly burned away.
The two Flying Swords regained their brightness and shot back, quickly leaving the yellow cloud area behind.
"This is Guiyuan Sect's Ten Thousand Miles of Yellow Sand Formation! It seems Su Zimo aims to trap us here and enjoy the treasure alone," said Dugu Feng with a grave voice, his face showing worry.
A hint of surprise passed through Yuan Ming's eyes. He continued to sense the emotions of those around him with his Emotion Manipulation Ability. Despite Dugu Feng's worried expression, there was no sense of worry in his emotions.
"Could it be Dugu Feng knows about the situation on the third layer? Can he be sure that even if Su Zimo gets there first, he won't be able to acquire the treasure?" Yuan Ming thought.
If he entered the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space, he could instantly investigate the entire Ten Thousand Miles of Yellow Sand Formation, even the situation on the third floor, but with so many eyes around here, he absolutely must not reveal the existence of the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
"Despicable scoundrels! Everyone, quickly join forces to break this Yellow Sand Formation, otherwise the treasure on the third layer will fall into Su Zimo's hands," Thunderbolt Ancestor said, his expression unpleasant as he summoned his Thunder Seal Treasure and fiercely struck the yellow clouds.
"Crackle—"
Thick bolts of thunder tore through the yellow clouds, blasting a deep hole.
The others also took up their magic treasures and attacked; the Ten Thousand Miles of Yellow Sand Formation was swiftly riddled with holes.
Yet the resilience of the formation was remarkable; no matter how much damage it sustained, it always recovered.
"Even though the Ten Thousand Miles of Yellow Sand Formation is a secret formation of the Guiyuan Sect, the one laid by Su Zimo in haste cannot possibly have such power!" Thunderbolt Ancestor said sternly.
"It seems Su Zimo has used his Heavenly Sand Gourd to enhance the formation's power. He must have set up the formation within the gourd well in advance, indicating premeditation," Dugu Feng commented.
"Correct, it must be so. I didn't expect Fellow Daoist Dugu to be so knowledgeable about the Ten Thousand Miles of Yellow Sand Formation. Do you know how to break the formation?" Thunderbolt Ancestor nodded, then asked after a moment.

chapters.title: Chapter 419 - 396 Escape
chapters.content:
"In my view," Dugu Feng said after a moment of contemplation, "continuing to attack blindly will not break through the Great Array. Our only option is to enter the Ten Thousand Miles of Yellow Sand Formation and focus our strength on one point, forcibly breaking through this array."
"That might indeed be a viable method," Thunderbolt Ancestor mused.
Golden Dawn Fairy remained silent, looking toward Wan Qi Hong with an ambivalent gaze as if she wanted him to make the decision.
At that moment, Wan Qi Hong did not decide immediately but slightly furrowed his eyebrows.
He had already broken through to the Nascent Soul Middle Stage and had been in seclusion all this time, hoping to advance even further. He didn't know much about Su Zimo's situation. His Flying Sword had barely made it through the Ten Thousand Miles of Yellow Sand Formation, and it had almost been sealed by the array; if his true body entered, the Sealing Power he would face would probably be even greater.
"What's the matter? Is Fellow Daoist Wan Qi afraid?" Dugu Feng looked over with a teasing smile.
"If you dare to enter, Fellow Daoist Dugu, how could I not dare?" Wan Qi Hong said calmly.
"Since that's the case, we should not delay. Let's take action immediately," Dugu Feng said as he swept his sleeve, and a black long sword shot out, its blade wreathed in black Thunder, slashing into the Yellow Cloud.
A deep, hoarse thunderous sound erupted, tearing a gap tens of feet long and several feet wide in the Yellow Cloud.
Not waiting for the gap to close, four Nascent Soul cultivators, led by Wan Qi Hong, took the lead and flew into it, releasing their Magic Treasures in every direction.
Yuan Ming and the other Core Formation Stage cultivators, although not fully confident, had no choice but to steel themselves and follow, each deploying their Magical Treasure Talisman and other items, joining Wan Qi Hong and the others in their assault.
The Yellow Cloud roiled, attempting to close up, but the damage caused by the cultivators' Magic Treasures exceeded the cloud's rate of healing, and the gap quickly widened more than double.
The group continued to advance and destroy the Yellow Sand Formation, rapidly moving forward by twenty to thirty feet.
Yuan Ming took out his Green Jade Ruler Magical Treasure and attacked the surrounding Yellow Cloud, inwardly puzzled.
The space on the second layer of the Black Tower wasn't that large, and the span of the Ten Thousand Miles of Yellow Sand Formation should not be wide. They had been walking for so long, yet had not reached the end?
However, his Five Elements Illusion Destruction Array also created illusions and expanded space, so it wasn't surprising that the Ten Thousand Miles of Yellow Sand Formation, a secret passage of the Guiyuan Sect, had this effect.
Just at this moment, a sudden change occurred.
The Ten Thousand Miles of Yellow Sand Formation started to vibrate, the fluctuating aura it emitted surged violently, and the Yellow Cloud rapidly became denser, almost solidifying. The effectiveness of the cultivators' Magic Treasures against it greatly decreased.
Not only that, but the Yellow Cloud quickly began moving, pressing in from all around at a rapid pace.
The cultivators hurriedly increased the power of their Magic Treasures, but to little effect. The space of the gap, originally several feet across, swiftly shrank by nearly half, and the cultivators soon faced being engulfed by the Yellow Cloud.
Thunderbolt Ancestor uttered a soft sound of surprise and flicked his finger at the Thunder Seal atop his head.
The Thunder Seal Treasure immediately flew half a foot upward, emitting thick bolts of Thunder, which then fell down, forming a hemispherical Thunder Light Screen that enveloped everyone within.
Wan Qi Hong, Dugu Feng, and Golden Dawn Fairy, not wanting to leave Thunderbolt Ancestor to bear this alone, also stimulated their Magic Treasures to merge into the Thunder Light Screen.
Although the Magic Treasures of the several people had different attributes and somewhat conflicted when merging, they were all Nascent Soul existences, so such a small inconvenience naturally did not pose a problem for them.
The Thunder Light Screen thickened by more than twice, with runes, Sword Shadows, and other patterns appearing on it, emanating gold, purple, and black lights, forming an extraordinarily sturdy Mana Shield.
The Yellow Cloud crashed down like a massive wave upon the Mana Shield.
The Three-colored Shield let out squealing sounds as if it could not bear the pressure, but it managed to hold up.
"Su Zimo is only at the Nascent Soul Early Stage, how could he possibly unleash the power of the Ten Thousand Miles of Yellow Sand Formation to this extent!" Thunderbolt Ancestor said with a furrowed brow.
Wan Qi Hong and Golden Dawn Fairy kept silent, and even Dugu Feng, who was quite familiar with Su Zimo, remained silent, with a hint of solemnity in his eyes.
However, at that moment, thick yellow Array Patterns started to seep out from within the Yellow Cloud and penetrate the Mana Shield, the same patterns that had sealed Wan Qi Hong's Flying Sword before, but now they were more than double the size.
The once sturdy Shield quickly thinned, and yellow patterns began to appear on the Magic Treasures of the four, causing the Spiritual Light to diminish rapidly.
Thunderbolt Ancestor's expression changed slightly, and he immediately gestured to cast a spell.
The Thunder Seal Treasure emitted dazzling Thunder Arcs, tearing apart the yellow patterns on it.
Wan Qi Hong, Golden Dawn Fairy, and the others followed suit, destroying the yellow patterns, and the Three-colored Light Screen quickly regained its former thickness.
Yet more yellow patterns surged from within the array, forcing the four to incessantly cast spells, unable to advance further.
Just then, the surrounding Yellow Cloud suddenly churned violently, and although its power increased somewhat, the Spiritual Power within the Ten Thousand Miles of Yellow Sand Formation became frenzied and lost its former meticulousness. The onslaught of yellow patterns also diminished significantly.
Spot an error? Visit the original post on M&VLEMPY&R.
Wan Qi Hong's eyes gleamed, and he spat out three Golden Flying Swords, with the two within the Three-colored Shield also descending.
The five Flying Swords merged into one, and with a flash, they transformed into one giant Golden Sword.
Wan Qi Hong soared into the air, his entire body radiating a terrifying golden light as he seemed to merge with the giant Golden Sword.
The giant Golden Sword turned into a stunning rainbow of Sword Qi, piercing through the Yellow Cloud ahead with ease, tearing it apart. In the blink of an eye, it disappeared without a trace.
Thunderbolt Ancestor saw this scene, waved his sleeve, and wrapped around Yan Sijing who was beside him.
The Thunder Seal Treasure in midair fell down, and the glaring thunder light engulfed both him and Yan Sijing's bodies.
Ao!
With the sound of dragon's chants, a silver Thunder Flood Dragon, over a dozen meters long, shot out, closely following Wan Qi Hong. It moved along the still unsealed Yellow Cloud and disappeared in a flash.
Yuan Ming's eyes showed a different color, noting that these Nascent Soul cultivators had indeed all retained some of their strength before. The divine skills displayed by Wan Qi Hong and Thunderbolt Ancestor just now must be their true capabilities.
In particular, Wan Qi Hong, who had just executed what seemed to be the legendary sword cultivation technique "Man and Sword Unity."
"Man and Sword Unity" is a renowned divine skill among sword cultivators, not only increasing one's tunneling speed dramatically but also boosting the power of the Flying Sword several times. It's a skill all sword cultivators yearn for.
However, this skill had almost been lost to time, and it had been many years since anyone had heard of it. Unexpectedly, Wan Qi Hong could, Chang Chun Temple really lived up to its reputation as the foremost sect in Central Plains, with profound heritage.
The already precarious Three-colored Shield couldn't hold on any longer after Wan Qi Hong and Thunderbolt Ancestor recalled their treasures. Finally unable to maintain itself, the shield collapsed with a bang, flinging the few people within outward.
Dugu Feng was about to follow Thunderbolt Ancestor, but he was one step too late. The windstorm generated by the exploding shield hit him first.
He hastily cast Protective Body spells, shooting out two streams of Black Sword Qi from his hands, wrapping around Xi Ying and another Black Robed Cultivator, pulling them back to his side.
Golden Dawn Fairy was also busy casting spells to protect Pi Xiu, then sent out a streak of Golden Light towards Yuan Ming.
However, Yuan Ming's position was somewhat far from Golden Dawn Fairy, and moreover, the pressure from the exploding shield struck him hard, sending him flying backward like a meteor, smashing into the Yellow Cloud behind first.
Yuan Ming was like a leaf falling into the giant waves of a river, instantly engulfed.
Golden Dawn Fairy's complexion changed with shock, and she quickly spurred her golden book. Countless characters shot out, condensed into each other, and in the blink of an eye formed a golden net that covered the area where Yuan Ming vanished, akin to a fisherman casting his net.
Golden Dawn Fairy pointed at the golden book, and the net quickly retracted, but it was empty inside.
Xi Ying's expression slightly shifted, then her gaze suddenly moved, and she regained her composure.
Yellow Cloud nearby stirred more violently, with windstorms sharp as Sword Qi cutting through. Both Golden Dawn Fairy and Dugu Feng's Protective Spiritual Light trembled continuously.
"This Ten Thousand Miles of Yellow Sand Formation is becoming increasingly powerful. I shall take my leave first," said Dugu Feng to Golden Dawn Fairy while cupping his hands, then a startling Sword Qi enveloped the three from the Black Desert Scatter Alliance and shot forward.
Golden Dawn Fairy did not leave immediately but released her Divine Sense, attempting to find Yuan Ming.
However, as the power of the Ten Thousand Miles of Yellow Sand Formation surged, the restriction on Divine Sense also greatly increased. Golden Dawn Fairy's Divine Sense extended to its limit but still could not find any trace of Yuan Ming, and she reluctantly gave up.
The golden book landed in her hand, releasing concentric circles of golden halos, enveloping her and Pi Xiu as they flew forward.
In a particularly violent area of the Ten Thousand Miles of Yellow Sand Formation, a small green tripod floated quietly, occasionally tossed up and down by the windstorm. It was indeed the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
The Yellow Cloud windstorm struck against the Stealing Heaven Tripod, unable to inflict the slightest damage.
Yuan Ming was currently inside the space of the Stealing Heaven Tripod, his clothes in tatters, not lightly injured, but his face was very calm.
He had been flung away by the collapsing shield just moments before, intentionally plunging into the Ten Thousand Miles of Yellow Sand Formation to escape and leave.
The Black Tower's third layer was approaching, and he knew a group of Nascent Soul cultivators would undoubtedly trade blows fiercely. Yuan Ming did not wish to get involved. Anyway, with Yan Sijing, his Believer, through her Desire Power as a medium, he could easily monitor the situation above, perfectly positioned to watch from the sidelines.
Yuan Ming took out a Healing Pill to consume, sat on the White Jade Lotus Platform, and connected his Divine Sense with Yan Sijing, urging her to pray to the Nether Moon God once again.
At this moment, Yan Sijing, having been taken away by Thunderbolt Ancestor, had already flown out of the Ten Thousand Miles of Yellow Sand Formation. Upon hearing Yuan Ming's sound transmission, she obediently started praying silently in her heart.
Yuan Ming grabbed this stream of Desire Power, let his Divine Sense cascade down, and spread out rapidly.
Not even the Illusion Array restrictions within Yin Capital City could block the Divine Sense falling from within the Stealing Heaven Tripod, to say nothing of the Ten Thousand Miles of Yellow Sand Formation; his Divine Sense could probe the entire second layer of the Black Tower without missing a single detail.
The Stealing Heaven Tripod tumbled within the roiling Yellow Clouds, with no unusual aura or Divine Sense probing nearby.
Yuan Ming secretly breathed a sigh of relief and looked elsewhere.
In an area within the Yellow Sand Formation, a yellowish-brown gourd floated quietly, spewing out a stream of crystal-clear yellow sand grains, continuously blending into the surrounding Yellow Clouds. It should be Dugu Feng's Heavenly Sand Gourd.
Yellow Flames burned on the Heavenly Sand Gourd at this moment, making the expelled sand brighter and brighter.
"Is this the burning of Origin Power from the Magic Treasure? No wonder the power of the Ten Thousand Miles of Yellow Sand Formation is growing! Tsk tsk, that's really extravagant," Yuan Ming muttered in some realization.
With his current understanding of Magic Treasures, he only knew that burning the Origin Power of a Magic Treasure could evoke far more power than usual, at the cost of the Magic Treasure's permanent damage, or even complete destruction.
As for how it was done, that was beyond his knowledge.
Not all Magic Treasures can burn their Origin, it seems only those with eight or more runes can do so, and the price is steep.

chapters.title: Chapter 420 - 397 Tower Spirit and the Trial
chapters.content:
At this moment, a group of Nascent Soul cultivators had already taken their subordinates and flown out of the Ten Thousand Miles of Yellow Sand Formation, heading straight for the third-floor staircase.
Yuan Ming's gaze also shifted away from the Heavenly Sand Gourd, as his Divine Sense spread towards the third layer of the Black Tower, and his eyes widened slightly.
Just as Wan Qi Hong and others successively entered the third layer, they all stopped in their tracks, displaying varied expressions.
The space on the third layer of the Black Tower was almost as spacious as the first and second layers, with not even a Stone Pillar for support, allowing one to see to the very end at a glance.
At the end of everyone's line of sight, there stood a circular stone platform, crafted entirely from white, translucent jade, with a faint glow shimmering across it.
On the platform, there was a blood-colored screen with five peculiar figures embroidered on it, both male and female. The dark red Blood Light constantly shifting across it gave off an extremely eerie aura.
Yuan Ming's eyes flickered upon seeing the blood-colored screen which was two zhang in length and one zhang in height; its size and form were quite similar to the Night Parade of Hundred Demons, with some parts being exactly the same.
"This screen is so similar to my Night Parade of Hundred Demons. Could it be the Shura Blood Devouring Map?" Yuan Ming guessed silently in his heart.
However, above the blood-colored screen, two figures were suspended in mid-air, none other than Su Zimo and the golden-haired youth.
Both of them had their arms outstretched and legs together, as if confined by something, unable to move and with expressions of horror on their faces.
A red-clothed woman stood in the void in front of Su Zimo and the youth. Her facial features were fairly delicate, but her eyebrows carried a severe ferocity, and she wore a loose, floor-length red robe.
This woman was shrouded in a fierce, evil power, unpenetrable by the Divine Senses of Wan Qi Hong and the others. However, the Divine Sense that Yuan Ming extended from the Stealing Heaven Tripod enveloped everything, leaving nothing about the red-clothed woman hidden from his view.
Her cheeks and arms appeared normal, but beneath the red robe was an empty skeletal frame, with remnants of flesh clinging to her bones.
The reason why Su Zimo and the youth were suspended in the air was because their bodies were entwined by several invisible and shadowless transparent cords.
These transparent filaments came from an invisible web suspended in the air, similar to a spider web, with Su Zimo and the youth appearing like two small insects that had collided with it, completely immobilized.
This invisible web seemed like a Magic Treasure, with excellent concealment. Even Yuan Ming, with his Divine Sense descending from the Stealing Heaven Tripod, had almost failed to detect its presence.
The red-clothed woman seemingly indifferent to the arrival of Wan Qi Hong and the others, extended her hands and emitted a mist of blood-red filaments from her fingertips, piercing into Su Zimo and the youth's bodies.
The bodies of Su Zimo and the youth shriveled at a rate visible to the naked eye. Their mouths agape, they were unable to utter any sound.
Thanksforreading—broughttoyouby*.
In just a few breaths, under the watchful eyes of Wan Qi Hong and the others, they withered away into two corporeal husks.
The death of a Nascent Soul ancestor, who could otherwise dominate the Central Plains, occurred silently, causing all onlookers' pupils to constrict sharply, their looks toward the red-clothed woman tinged with wariness.
Even Nascent Soul cultivators like Wan Qi Hong and Thunderbolt Ancestor could not detect the presence of the invisible net, and for a moment, stood still, not daring to make any rash moves.
Yuan Ming, while investigating from within the Stealing Heaven Tripod, discovered some unusual characteristics as well.
Although Su Zimo and the other had perished, their Divine Souls had not left their bodies for some reason and remained inside.
"It seems that Blood Shadow wasn't lying; the Shura Palace has indeed emerged," said the red-clothed woman as she looked toward the people at the entrance of the staircase. She moved her hands slightly, and the blood-red filaments she was emitting snapped.
The transparent web trembled gently, and the bodies of Su Zimo and the youth fell, but instead of hitting the ground, two tentacle-like beams of Blood Light shot out from the blood-colored screen, wrapped around the two bodies, and retracted them back.
Ripples of Blood Light spread across the screen, and the desiccated corpses merged into it, vanishing from sight.
"Your demeanor does not seem that of a living being. Could you be the guardian of this blood-colored screen? We are here following the guidance of the Shura Master, seeking to pass the challenge and obtain treasure," Wan Qi Hong said politely with a cupped fist salute after giving the blood-colored screen a glance.
"I've been refined by the Shura Master into the Tower Spirit, and have been here for over a thousand years, waiting for you all. This screen is the Blood Devouring Map, the proud creation of the Shura Master and your objective," the red-clothed woman said as she looked toward the blood-colored screen.
"So this screen truly is the Blood Devouring Map, but this red-clothed woman..." Yuan Ming nodded silently, a cold smile appearing on the corner of his mouth.
At that moment, Thunderbolt Ancestor and Golden Dawn Fairy revealed excited expressions; the blood-colored screen before them was actually a Spiritual Treasure!
As Nascent Soul cultivators from major sects, both were naturally aware of the existence of Spiritual Treasures. Within Chang Chun Temple was a Spiritual Treasure known as the "Canghai Xuan Water Pearl," which had demonstrated tremendous power that shook heavens and earth on the few occasions it was used.
It was precisely the Heavenly might of the Canghai Xuan Water Pearl that cemented the supremacy of the Chang Chun Temple in the Central Plains.
If they could seize the Blood Devouring Map, there was the possibility for the Five Thunder Sect and Spirit Talisman Sect to take their power to the next level, and perhaps even stand equal to the Chang Chun Temple.
"Fellow Daoist Jin Xi, let's not dwell on our past grudges. With the Spiritual Treasure before us, you and I, fighting alone, I fear are no match for Wan Qi Hong and the Black Desert Scatter Alliance. How about joining forces? Should we succeed in seizing the Shura Blood Devouring Map, not only will the strength of our sects greatly increase, but even the status of Zhao Country's Immortal Cultivation World will rise significantly. We will no longer have to cater to the whims of Da Jin, nor Chang Chun Temple," Lei Ming proposed with suppressed excitement, immediately transmitting his voice to communicate with Golden Dawn Fairy.
"Fellow Daoist Yu's suggestion may have merit, but there is only one Shura Blood Devouring Map. Even if we are lucky enough to obtain it, how should we divide it?" Golden Dawn Fairy responded after a moment of silence.
"The value of a Spiritual Treasure is immeasurable and truly challenging to divide. When the time comes, the Five Thunder Sect and Spirit Talisman Sect can form an alliance and jointly control this treasure. In any case, we must not allow the Shura Blood Devouring Map to fall into the hands of Chang Chun Temple or the people of the Northern Desert," Lei Ming replied through voice transmission.
"Very well, let's proceed as Fellow Daoist Yu suggested," Jin Xi replied.
Lei Ming's heart leapt with joy when he heard her response, though he maintained an impassive face.
Wan Qi Hong and Dugu Feng had a deeper understanding of the Shura Master and had heard that he possessed a Spiritual Treasure. Hearing what the red-clothed woman said, their eyes too flashed with irrepressible excitement.
Although the four Nascent Soul cultivators present were tempted by the Spiritual Treasure, each harboring their own thoughts, none of them made a move.
The fall of the two Su Zimo was still fresh, and they knew that none of them could silently kill them single-handedly. Therefore, no one dared to approach recklessly.
The red-clothed woman said nothing more, only quietly watching everyone below.
For a time, the scene once again fell into silence, so quiet you could hear a pin drop.
"If you are waiting for us to take the challenge, why did you kill Su Zimo and their companion?" Lei Ming was the first to break the silence and asked.
"To claim the Shura Blood Devouring Map, one must pass the trial set by the Shura Master. Just now, those two did not heed my warning and attempted to forcefully snatch the treasure. Those who don't follow the rules must pay the corresponding price. If you wish to forcibly take the treasure, feel free to try," the red-clothed woman replied with a serene tone.
Lei Ming gave an awkward smile and closed his mouth.
"We certainly will not behave as rudely as Su Zimo did. However, the Shura Blood Devouring Map is a Spiritual Treasure of incalculable value. You have guarded it here for a thousand years, are you really just going to let us take it?" Dugu Feng chimed in.
"I am tasked with guarding this place. As long as the Shura Blood Devouring Map remains here, I cannot leave. If you take this map, it is as good as freeing me from my shackles, which is exactly what I desire! Besides, with my current form as the Tower Spirit, I am incapable of wielding the power of the Spiritual Treasure. Why would I bother keeping this white elephant?" the red-clothed woman explained.
The expressions on Dugu Feng and the others' faces relaxed, seemingly believing the red-clothed woman's words.
"May I inquire, what is the trial left here by the Shura Master?" Dugu Feng asked.
"The Shura Blood Devouring Map is an extremely sinister Spiritual Treasure. It cannot be wielded by anyone without a firm mind. You few should first face the challenge of this Blood Soul Domain. Those who pass may then enter the map to undergo the 'Heart Inquiry' trial. The one who ultimately passes will acquire the Shura Blood Devouring Map," said the red-clothed woman, waving her sleeve as she spoke.
The third layer's space began to fill with thick Blood Light, fierce winds howled, and the Blood Mist spread, as distorted ghostly shapes surged out from within the mist, wailing like ghosts and howling like wolves.
The red-clothed woman flicked her fingers several times. The Blood Light and the chill wind suddenly congealed, transforming into a rectangular blood-colored Light Domain stretching in front of Dugu Feng and the others, not far away.
Seeing this, they couldn't help but scrutinize the blood-colored Light Domain, their gazes quickly overwhelmed by the Blood Light, moving forward blankly, and Wan Qi Hong was no exception.
"This red-clothed woman's schemes are profound and her Illusion Technique is masterful!" Yuan Ming thought to himself.
The chilly wind and Blood Light were part of a powerful Illusion Technique. The red-clothed woman had first unsettled everyone's mind with the Shura Blood Devouring Map, then under the pretense of a trial, lured Dugu Feng and the others into lowering their guard, controlling everyone with her illusion in one fell swoop.
It seemed that the red-clothed woman's use of the Illusion Technique simply aimed to draw everyone closer to the Shura Blood Devouring Map.
That clear net-form Magic Treasure hovered above the blood-colored Light Domain, twitching eagerly, seemingly waiting for the crowd to come closer before swooping down to engulf them all in one fell swoop.
At this moment, Yan Sijing also fell into the illusion, advancing in a daze. Her prayers to the Nether Moon God began to break up, and Yuan Ming's vision quickly blurred.
Yuan Ming's expression changed slightly, and after a quick thought, he extended his Divine Sense all around Yan Sijing, unleashing the Ten Directions Soul Wave, impacting the Divine Souls of everyone present.
Yuan Ming wasn't sure what the red-clothed woman was truly up to. Now that Xi Ying also seemed to be controlled by the illusion, and considering the third layer's eerie circumstances and the red-clothed woman's formidable power, he doubted he could wrest the Shura Blood Devouring Map from her hands alone.
Before deciphering the mysteries of the third layer, the others could not die!
Dugu Feng and the others' souls trembled, coming back to their senses.
The red-clothed woman sensed the Ten Directions Soul Wave, her face showing annoyance. Her hands reached out and vanished into the Void!
A blood-curdling scream and the sound of thunder sounded simultaneously. In the crowd, Pi Xiu's chest was pierced by a bloody hand, the very hand that the red-clothed woman had withdrawn. When she reached out again, she held a beating heart, still thumping, with fresh blood dripping down.

chapters.title: Chapter 421 - 398: Help from Outsiders
chapters.content:
Pi Xiu stared at his still beating heart and the bloodied hand holding it, his eyes widened with disbelief.
Knowing his own early-stage Core Formation cultivation, though he could be considered a prominent figure outside, he was the weakest in the group except for Yan Sijing, so he dared not be careless and had activated a protective treasure bracelet early on, forming a white ring of light around him.
However, this circle of light did not have any effect. The red-clothed woman's hand appeared directly inside the circle and easily penetrated his body.
Behind the palm of this hand, however, there was nothing, as if it had reached out directly from the void.
The thunderous roar came from Yan Sijing, who looked somewhat bewildered. Behind her, silver lightning flickered in the void a few times before dissipating.
After recovering from the shock, several Nascent Soul cultivators clearly saw the red-clothed woman's other hand was attacking Yan Sijing but was repelled by a bolt of silver lightning coming from an unknown source.
Wan Qi Hong, Dugu Feng, and others quickly retreated. They were not surprised that Yan Sijing had dodged disaster, assuming she wore some kind of automatic defensive treasure bestowed by Thunderbolt Ancestor when facing an enemy.
Thunderbolt Ancestor's eyes also flashed with surprise. He knew he had not given such a treasure to Yan Sijing, but in the current situation, he naturally did not have time to care more.
Inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod, Yuan Ming put down a silver hammer he was holding. It was he who had driven the Thunder God Hammer to save Yan Sijing's life just in time.
