This woman was his only believer currently in Shura Palace. Should she perish, it would be troubling. Most of all, he would lose the chance to understand the situation firsthand. Thus, risking the exposure of some details about the Stealing Heaven Tripod, he also took the risk to save her.
"Sorceress!"
Golden Dawn Fairy did not retreat. She raised one hand and threw the golden book she held.
The book instantly burst into blinding golden light. Countless golden characters densely emerged, swirling around the book without ceasing, and then the shape of the book transformed into a golden giant bird several zhang in size, with wings on its back and sharp beak and claws, looking majestic.
The giant bird flapped its wings toward the red-clothed woman, its sharp beak pecking toward the void where Pi Xiu was.
"Swoosh"
A majestic golden light arrow shot out, its dazzling golden light illuminating the entire third layer space in gold, directly targeting the bloodied hand that had pierced through Pi Xiu's body.
The red-clothed woman moved her arm, and with a flash of the bloodied hand, retracted it along with Pi Xiu's heart, making the golden light arrow miss its target.
By the time the golden giant bird had charged in front of the red-clothed woman, its two sharp claws quickly reached out, shooting out claw beams like Sword Qi, grabbing toward the woman's head.
The red-clothed woman, however, ignored this completely, not even bothering to defend herself. Just when everyone was slightly amazed, the body of the golden giant bird suddenly froze without warning, then hovered in midair, just like what had happened earlier to Su Zimo and the golden-haired youth.
Yuan Ming raised an eyebrow. The red-clothed woman's attacks could freely shift space, similar to the Night Parade of Hundred Demons but even surpassing it in the effect of shifting.
As for the capture of the golden giant bird, it was naturally the work of an invisible spider web, which now entangled the bird, pulling it into midair.
As the red-clothed woman withdrew her hand, Pi Xiu's body was tossed out by a gust of air, hitting the back wall like a rag doll before sliding down, spitting out a mouthful of fresh blood, his breath extremely weak.
Golden Dawn Fairy did not continue to attack the red-clothed woman but flew to Pi Xiu's side, fed him several elixirs, and applied several talismans on him, to no avail.
Pi Xiu's breath continued to fade quickly, and he soon lost all signs of life.
Although the physical bodies of Core Formation Stage cultivators are much stronger than ordinary humans, the heart is the Life Gate of the body. Once destroyed, survival is nearly impossible unless there is some miraculous elixir capable of regeneration or high-level Wood Attribute healing magic is applied immediately.
Golden Dawn Fairy's expression darkened as she collected Pi Xiu's body and turned to look at the red-clothed woman, her eyes filled with deep resentment as she made a hand gesture in the air.
The golden giant bird, unable to escape and hanging in midair, suddenly flashed with golden light all around it, reverting to the form of a book, which shot out dozens of runes forming a small array.
The book "swooshed" and disappeared, appearing in the hands of Golden Dawn Fairy the next moment. Carrying Pi Xiu's body, she also flew back.
The red-clothed woman's eyes flashed with surprise but she did not make another move.
By this time, Wan Qi Hong and others had retreated to the location of the stone steps entrance, coldly watching the red-clothed woman.
"What is your intention? By controlling us with illusions, do you intend to slaughter all of us?" Wan Qi Hong asked coldly, five golden Flying Swords floating above his head, trembling slightly, ready to strike at any moment.
The red-clothed woman, as if she had not heard, looked up and opened her mouth, revealing full, fiercely sharp teeth. She bit into Pi Xiu's heart, swallowing it in a few bites, chewing audibly.
At the same time, the rectangular blood-colored Light Domain that filled the void quickly dissipated, as if it had never appeared before.
Wan Qi Hong's eyes flickered with cold light, yet he did not immediately take action but exchanged thoughts with the others through their Divine Sense.
"It appears the words spoken by this red-clothed woman were all nonsense; she's most likely not even a Tower Spirit, merely using illusion techniques to control and lure us close to the Shura Blood Devouring Map, most likely aiming to annihilate us all!" Thunderbolt Ancestor grimly transmitted.
"Fellow Daoist Yu is not wrong. Fortunately, we regained our senses in time, or the consequences would have been unimaginable, perhaps even worse than Su Zimo's fate," Dugu Feng said slowly.
"Is that so? I believe someone helped us, otherwise how could we have broken free from the illusion simultaneously? And if I'm not mistaken, the one who awakened us possessed some kind of Soul Cultivator Divine Power," Wan Qi Hong remarked as he looked meaningfully towards Dugu Feng, clearly suspecting someone from the Black Desert Alliance was involved.
Thunderbolt Ancestor and Golden Dawn Fairy also looked at Dugu Feng with suspicion in their eyes.
It wasn't strange for the three to have such doubts. The Northern Desert was desolate and isolated, with very little interaction with the Central Plains Cultivation World, but one thing everyone from the Central Plains knew was that the Northern Desert had a relatively higher number of Soul Cultivators.
Unlike the animosity towards Soul Cultivators in the Central Plains Cultivation World, the Northern Desert not only refrained from restricting them but greatly revered them, and thus many renowned Soul Cultivators in the history of Yunhuang Continent hailed from the Northern Desert.
The Central Plains Cultivation World often demanded that the Cultivation Sects of the Northern Desert restrict Soul Cultivators, but the latter would publicly conform while defying secretly, and the various sects from the Central Plains could do nothing but turn a blind eye.
"What do you mean by that, Fellow Daoist Wan Qi? Apart from the three attendants, I haven't brought anyone else!" Dugu Feng said in a deep voice.
"If Fellow Daoist Dugu says there's no one, then there's no one," Wan Qi Hong dismissed with a smile, not pressing further.
Dugu Feng's expression darkened, but he offered no explanation.
"Whether there's someone else involved, we can discuss that later. What should we do next?" Thunderbolt Ancestor coughed, asking.
"That red-clothed woman is definitely unwilling to hand over the Shura Blood Devouring Map. In that case, we don't need to hold back. We should join forces and kill her! As for the Shura Blood Devouring Map, after killing this woman, we may then contest it amongst ourselves based on our abilities," Wan Qi Hong transmitted.The genuine article resides on M|V|L&EMPYR.
"Agreed!" Thunderbolt Ancestor approved, and Dugu Feng also slowly nodded.
As for Golden Dawn Fairy, she had no second thoughts and immediately activated a golden book, transforming once again into a golden bird that dove at the red-clothed woman.
The golden bird stretched out its claws; two millstone-sized golden claw shadows tore through the air, striking at the red-clothed woman.
The claw shadows emitted astonishing mana fluctuations, leaving clear traces in the void, their power far surpassing that of the earlier Golden Arrow, evidently driven by Golden Dawn Fairy's real anger.
Wan Qi Hong, Dugu Feng, and Thunderbolt Ancestor also utilized their Magic Treasures, summoning five golden Flying Swords, the Thunder Seal Treasure, and twenty-one Black Needles towards the red-clothed woman.
Facing the pincer attack from four Nascent Soul cultivators, the red-clothed woman's expression turned solemn. She opened her mouth and spewed out a stream of blood light that flared up, instantly forming a sea of blood-red fire about seventy to ninety feet wide.
An invisible spider web descended and merged with the sea of fire which then thickened, exhibiting a net-like pattern within it.
The Magic Treasures struck it, producing a low, muffled sound, causing the sea of blood fire to shake but not shatter; it managed to engulf all four Magic Treasures.
The red-clothed woman sneered slightly and gestured behind her. A ray of blood light entered the Shura Blood Devouring Map, which began to flicker rapidly.
Amidst Wan Qi Hong and others, the void fluctuated, and thirty-some skeletal corpses appeared out of thin air, the same emaciated figures that had appeared on the first layer, their numerous bone claws striking down.
Each of these skeletal corpses possessed strength not lesser than that of Core Formation cultivators, catching Wan Qi Hong and his companions off guard. They quickly released Protective Magic Treasures around their bodies.
"Bang" "Bang" "Bang" — a series of loud impacts!
The combined strike from dozens of Core Formation cultivators was formidable, causing the Protective Magic Treasures of Wan Qi Hong and his comrades to waver incessantly. The less experienced Thunderbolt Ancestor and Golden Dawn Fairy were even blown away, though fortunately uninjured.
Not just Wan Qi Hong's group, but Yan Sijing, Xi Ying, and the Black Robed Cultivators from the Black Desert Alliance were also under attack from several skeletal corpses.
Xi Ying and the Black Robed Cultivator together raised a strange bird-shaped Magic Treasure, and white wings emerged on their bodies, enhancing their movement speed extraordinarily as they flickered and escaped the clutch of the skeletal corpses in a flash.
In comparison, Yan Sijing's techniques were mediocre. She summoned a golden treasure sword and a white Ruyi, managing to barely block the attack from two corpses.
This woman's lack of combat experience was apparent as she struggled to resist the two corpses, despite wielding quite exquisite Magic Treasures. Her face turned pale as she was on the verge of being overwhelmed, subconsciously praying fervently to the Nether Moon God in her heart.
Within the Stealing Heaven Tripod, Yuan Ming furrowed his brows.
He had traveled with Yan Sijing for a while, but during that time he had taken on almost all the fighting himself, not realizing Yan Sijing's poor combat skills until now.
However, given that the woman had just advanced and was an alchemist with limited combat experience, her poor performance was somewhat understandable.
Since he had promised to help her escape her dire straits and considering her current value, he naturally could not let her perish so easily.

chapters.title: Chapter 422 - 399 Secret Passage
chapters.content:
"Do you have any Thunder Attribute Magic Treasures or talismans at your disposal? If so, use them now!" Yuan Ming's voice echoed in Yan Sijing's mind.
Yan Sijing was startled, then she spat out two purple Thunder Pearls towards the two skeletons.
The Thunder Pearls exploded mid-way, transforming into two purple thunderclouds about ten feet in size each, with streaks of purple thunder coursing through them.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming channeled his Mana into the Thunder God Hammer, then with a quick manipulation of his spell, two silver electric arcs as thick as bowls shot out from the hammerhead and disappeared into the void.
Inside the two purple thunderclouds, fluctuations arose as two thick silver electric arcs struck the two skeletons.
The skeletons crumbled as if they were rotten wood, dissolving into wisps of black vapor.
Yan Sijing's mouth hung open, and it took her several breaths to calm down, her trust in the Nether Moon God naturally deepening by a fraction.
Xi Ying, who was at the side, watched this scene and her gaze shifted subtly.
Thunderbolt Ancestor noticed the aura of the silver thunder and his eyes turned icily toward this direction.
He was well aware of Yan Sijing's capabilities; there was no way she could manifest such powerful Thunder and Lightning Divine Power. It was evident that someone was secretly assisting them.
"That red-clothed woman was previously attacked from a distance, and was also saved by the silver lightning. It seems to be the same person. Could it be that the one who helped us break free from the illusion earlier is the same person? Why would this person want to assist us?" Thunderbolt Ancestor's mind raced with thoughts.
At this moment, a flash of blue crossed over his head as eight azure Round Orbs appeared out of thin air.
A surge of blood red light erupted from within the azure Round Orbs, turning them blood red. The Blood Light spread, instantly forming a vast Blood River, enveloping Thunderbolt Ancestor and Dugu Feng within it.
A figure shrouded in Blood Light flashed within the Array; it was the Blood-colored Skull that appeared in the City Lord Mansion of Yin Capital City.
"It's you!" both Thunderbolt Ancestor and Dugu Feng exclaimed in shock.
"Of course, it's me. You foreign Cultivators relied on your numbers earlier and almost got the better of me. Now, let's see what else you have up your sleeves!" the Blood-colored Skull sneered menacingly.
As the words fell, it lifted its bony arms on both sides, the vast Blood River around it began surging rapidly, emitting a thunderous sound like thousands of horses galloping, as it ferociously rushed toward Thunderbolt Ancestor and Dugu Feng.
Thunderbolt Ancestor and Dugu Feng hastily cast spells in defense, simultaneously summoning the Thunder Seal and Black Needle Magic Treasures to counterattack the red-clothed woman.
At that moment, two Blood Shadows shot out from within the Blood River, bearing the likenesses of Thunderbolt Ancestor and Dugu Feng, carrying the Blood-colored Thunder Seal and Blood Red Flying Needles, and striking out with a crash.
The power of the Blood-colored Thunder Seal and Blood Red Flying Needles seemed in no way inferior to their originals, easily blocking the attacks from Thunderbolt Ancestor and Dugu Feng.
With Thunderbolt Ancestor and Dugu Feng preoccupied, the red-clothed woman had an easier time handling Wan Qi Hong and Golden Dawn Fairy. Assisted by a number of Core Formation skeletons, she quickly turned the tide and gained the upper hand.
However, as Wan Qi Hong and Golden Dawn Fairy both came from major sects with numerous Magical Treasures and secret techniques, even though they were at a disadvantage, the red-clothed woman could not overcome them.
The situation with Thunderbolt Ancestor and Dugu Feng was also similar, resulting in a somewhat stalemate in the battle.
For a time, the entire third layer's space was filled with the loud impacts of colliding Mana, Magic Treasures radiating spirit light flying across the sky, with spirit light explosions everywhere, causing the entire space to waver unstably. Only the Shura Blood Devouring Map stood quietly, attracting no attention.
Yuan Ming's eyes lit up; everyone else was locked in combat, making it the perfect opportunity to seize the Shura Blood Devouring Map.
He pinched a spell and pointed at his forehead, activating the Spirit Talisman given to him by the Shura Master, and a blood-colored eyeball emerged on his brow.
A translucent Blood Light shot out, entering the void and disappearing without a trace.
The center of the third layer's space rippled, and the translucent Blood Light emerged, heading straight for the Shura Blood Devouring Map.
Divine Sense is formless and intangible, making it extremely easy to project from the Stealing Heaven Tripod, and it covers a wide range.
In contrast, Mana is much denser, and projecting it from within the Stealing Heaven Tripod is much more difficult, as the location where it lands has considerable restrictions, and it cannot be too far from the focus point of Desire Power.
The translucent Blood Light crossed dozens of feet in an instant, merging into the blood-red screen in a flash.
The screen flickered with Blood Light, shaking violently.
Wan Qi Hong and the others were fiercely fighting, but half of their attention remained on the blood-red screen. Seeing this development, their expressions changed.
"Where did this Blood Light come from? Is there another Cultivator here? Could it be the same person who broke the illusion earlier?"
Wan Qi Hong and the others grew increasingly suspicious, probing the area where the Blood Light landed with their Divine Sense, but found nothing.
Upon witnessing this scene, the red-clothed woman immediately abandoned Wan Qi Hong and Golden Dawn Fairy, and rushed straight toward the Shura Blood Devouring Map.
Seeing this, the Blood-colored Skull, who was battling Thunderbolt Ancestor and Dugu Feng, also transformed into a Blood Shadow and sped towards the Shura Blood Devouring Map.
In a flash, the two merged into the blood-red screen, and the figures of the red-clothed woman and Blood-colored Skull appeared on the screen.
The entire Shura Blood Devouring Map shook even more violently, emitting dense Blood Light from inside, as if something drastic was happening within.
...
The blood light Yuan Ming emitted entered the Shura Blood Devouring Map, and he immediately sensed the four runes in the map, just like the Night Parade of Hundred Demons, located at the four corners of the screen.
He was secretly delighted and began to attempt to refine the four runes.This is part of a series from My Virtual Library Empire (*).
Just at that moment, two strong mana surged from within the Shura Blood Devouring Map, and judging from the aura, they were precisely the red-clothed woman and the blood-colored skull, which slammed fiercely against the four runes.
The strength contained in the blood-colored crystal light was weak, no match for the two Nascent Soul entities, and was easily crushed.
Yuan Ming's brows slightly furrowed, then smoothed out as his vast Divine Sense plunged into it, infiltrating the interior of the Shura Blood Devouring Map.
"Who is it that disturbs my master's peaceful cultivation?" A voice like a broken gong sounded, and a pair of blood-colored eyes appeared out of thin air on the blood-colored screen, sweeping around.
At the same time, a stream of blood mist shot out from the Shura Blood Devouring Map, instantly covering an area of several zhang, where the ground and stone platform quickly melted away.
"Indeed, it's a Spiritual Treasure, it has even nurtured an Artifact Spirit, surpassing our sect's Canghai Xuan Water Pearl by a notch!" Wan Qi Hong was overjoyed, and his right hand stealthily reached into his bosom.
Inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod, Yuan Ming was quite surprised to hear the Magic Treasure speak, and then he increased his efforts in stimulating the Spirit Talisman between his eyebrows, dropping down another blood light, trying to subdue the Artifact Spirit inside the Shura Blood Devouring Map.
"What kind of youngster are you, thinking that merely with the Spirit Talisman granted by the Shura Master, you can make me submit to you? He doesn't have that kind of clout!" the Shura Blood Devouring Map said with a cold laugh, and a surge of power cut off the connection with the Spirit Talisman.
Yuan Ming's brows raised; the Spiritual Treasure was indeed not so easy to subdue.
However, he had other methods prepared, as his enormous Divine Power churned downward.
Just at this moment, silver light appeared above the Shura Blood Devouring Map in the void, and Wan Qi Hong's figure appeared out of nowhere, reaching downward from the void.
A golden palm the size of several zhang grasped the blood-colored screen and pulled upward.
Seeing this scene unfold, Yuan Ming stopped his subduing actions, ready to wait and see how things played out.
The ground beneath the screen suddenly shook, rising up beams of white light, quickly forming into a white Array, enveloping the Shura Blood Devouring Map.
The white Array appeared to be an imprisoning formation, the Shura Blood Devouring Map seemed to be cast in the ground, and the golden hand could not pull it at all.
Wan Qi Hong's gaze turned cold, and he spat out two golden Flying Swords, slashing fiercely towards the ground Array.
Dugu Feng and others had all reacted by now, disregarding the danger, and they all leapt forward, casting spells to grab at the blood-colored screen.
"Who are these bunch of little thieves, trying to rob me? All of you, get lost!" the Shura Blood Devouring Map roared angrily, the blood light on the screen rose, and the surrounding blood mist instantly thickened several fold.
The golden palm sent by Wan Qi Hong rapidly corroded away, dissolving into nothingness, and the same happened with the absorbing methods sent by the others.
Golden flames rose up from Wan Qi Hong's Flying Swords, warding off the invasion of the blood mist, and they slashed fiercely at the ground.
With two loud "booms," the ground was left with two large holes, and the white Array immediately collapsed.
"Haha, thank you all for helping me break this ground imprisoning formation. Having stayed in this decrepit tower for thousands of years, I can finally leave!" the Shura Blood Devouring Map suddenly let out a laugh full of triumph, rose from the ground, turned into a blood shadow, and smashed against the wall of the third layer's space.
As if intangible, the blood shadow merged into it in a flash and disappeared without a trace.
Yuan Ming's Divine Sense, enhanced by the Stealing Heaven Tripod, could penetrate everything, naturally including the walls of the Black Tower; the blood shadow transformed by the Shura Blood Devouring Map shot out from the other side of the wall and headed straight for the distance, vanishing into the horizon in the blink of an eye.
This sudden turn of events shocked Wan Qi Hong and the others greatly.
Wan Qi Hong quickly followed the direction in which the Shura Blood Devouring Map had fled. The two golden Flying Swords shot out ahead, slashing fiercely at the wall through which the Shura Blood Devouring Map had escaped.
However, with two loud clangs, a layer of white crystal light appeared on the wall, easily bouncing the two Flying Swords back.
The wall remained as smooth as ever, without a single scratch left on it.
"What's going on? The Shura Blood Devouring Map easily penetrated through!" Lei Ming Ancestor exclaimed in shock and doubt.
Wan Qi Hong's expression remained calm, as if he had anticipated this situation, and turned to look behind him: "Fellow Daoist Dugu, where are you going?"
Lei Ming Ancestor and Golden Dawn Fairy looked back, and Dugu Feng had somehow appeared by another wall, holding the Black Key, seemingly about to do something.
Seeing the others look over, Dugu Feng's movement froze.
"Fellow Daoist Dugu, Fellow Daoist Yu, and Fellow Daoist Jin Xi might not know, but I am fully aware. The key in your hand can open all the prohibitions in the Shura Palace. Does Fellow Daoist Dugu plan to leave us behind and go alone... No, with the Soul Cultivator companion concealed here, the two of you to take that Shura Blood Devouring Map?" Wan Qi Hong suddenly appeared near Dugu Feng and said.
Lei Ming Ancestor and Golden Dawn Fairy's expressions shifted slightly, both turning their gaze to the Black Key.
Golden Dawn Fairy had a realization; no wonder Dugu Feng and Wan Qi Hong were fighting so desperately for that Black Key before. The sudden collapse of the white Light Pillar outside the Black Tower was probably also because of this key.
The two of them tacitly flew over and stood on either side of Dugu Feng.
"What do you mean by this, Fellow Daoist Wan Qi? I've already said that I didn't bring anyone else into this place. That blood light that emerged just now has nothing to do with me," Dugu Feng slowly said.

chapters.title: Chapter 423 - 400 The Most Dangerous Person
chapters.content:
"Whether you brought someone with you or not, now that the Shura Blood Devouring Map has developed spiritual intelligence, its combat power is comparable to a Nascent Soul cultivator, and there are also a red-clothed woman and a blood-colored skull, two Nascent Soul stage monsters within the map. Even if Fellow Daoist Dugu shakes us off, he won't be able to obtain that Spiritual Treasure. It would be better for the four of us to join forces. At least, we won't let this treasure slip away!" Wan Qi Hong said to Dugu Feng.
"We share the same thought," both Lei Ming Ancestor and Golden Dawn Fairy expressed their stance.
Dugu Feng fell silent for a moment and then said with a smile, "What the three Fellow Daoists said is very true. I was short-sighted just now. Given the current situation, it is indeed more appropriate for us to join hands."
"It's great that Fellow Daoist Dugu can think this way. Let's quickly break this wall restriction, otherwise, the Shura Blood Devouring Map might get far away," Wan Qi Hong urged.
Dugu Feng nodded and channeled mana into the Black Key.
A dim black light rose from the key, disappeared into the wall, and formed a shadow of a key about a zhang in size.
Dugu Feng rotated his wrist, and the shadow of the key also turned around, causing the white crystal light on the nearby walls to dissipate quickly, revealing a large blank area.
Wan Qi Hong formed a seal with his hands and sent a golden Sword Qi striking the area.
Without the protection of the white crystal light, the wall became fragile and was easily broken open, creating a large hole.
Just as the group was about to give chase, the stone platform where the Shura Blood Devouring Map was placed suddenly shook violently, emitting beams of white light outward, causing the entire third layer space to tremble incessantly.
Wan Qi Hong and the others exclaimed in surprise and halted their movements.
Yuan Ming, who was keeping watch inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod, saw this and extended his Divine Sense toward the interior of the stone platform to investigate.
"What is this..." A trace of surprise flickered through his eyes.
Wan Qi Hong and the others also operated their Divine Sense, attempting to probe the inside of the stone platform, but they were blocked by the power of a restriction.
"Fellow Daoist Dugu," Wan Qi Hong immediately looked towards Dugu Feng.
Dugu Feng understood, recalled the Black Key and activated it again, and a flash of black light shot into the stone platform and disappeared.
"It won't work; the restriction inside the stone platform is unusually tough, far beyond comparison to the crystal light on the wall. We can't break through it in a short time," Dugu Feng said, frowning.
Upon hearing this, the expressions of Wan Qi Hong and the others darkened.
"The three of you can decide on your own. I don't want to interfere, but I'm going to pursue the Shura Blood Devouring Map and don't have the time to break this restriction here. Please do as you see fit," Dugu Feng said indifferently as he put away the Black Key.
Without waiting for the others to respond, he turned and headed towards the large hole in the wall.
"Alliance Hierarch, I'm weak and wouldn't be much help if I followed. It might be better for me to stay here and see what's really going on with this stone platform," Xi Ying suddenly said.
"That's fine," Dugu Feng agreed, after a moment of surprise, and with a wave of his sleeve, he enveloped another Black Robed Cultivator and passed through the large hole in the wall, chasing after the Shura Blood Devouring Map.
Wan Qi Hong immediately followed closely, as if he feared Dugu Feng would snatch the Shura Blood Devouring Map.
Seeing this, Lei Ming Ancestor and Golden Dawn Fairy quickly followed suit.
"Yan Sijing, you stay here as well to see what secrets lie within this stone platform. I lend you this for your use," Lei Ming Ancestor said to Yan Sijing before leaving, handing her a blue Jade Box.
In the blink of an eye, only Xi Ying and Yan Sijing were left in the entire third layer space.
Yan Sijing glanced at Xi Ying and stood at a distance.
Xi Ying turned her head and shot a white light towards the area near the large hole in the stone wall.
The Crystal Light Restriction on the stone wall lit up and rapidly healed, covering the damaged area of the wall again within a few breaths.
Yan Sijing's heart tightened, and she immediately opened the blue Jade Box. A silver Thunder Pearl rolled out and was caught by her hand.
The Thunder Pearl was the size of a pigeon's egg, unassuming in appearance, but it emitted a terrifying thunder energy.
This was a Heavenly Thunder Pearl, refined by compressing the power of thunder and lightning collected by a Nascent Soul cultivator. Once activated, it was equivalent to the strike of a Nascent Soul cultivator.
Xi Ying, without looking at Yan Sijing or the Heavenly Thunder Pearl in her hand, looked up at the void, "Alright, the obstructive ones have all left. Yuan Ming, come out now. There are some matters I need to discuss with you."
Upon hearing Yuan Ming's name, Yan Sijing's eyes brightened as she looked around.
In the Ten Thousand Miles of Yellow Sand Formation on the second layer, she was taken away by Lei Ming Ancestor and did not see Yuan Ming swallowed by the Yellow Sand Formation. She did not see Yuan Ming on the third layer either and was puzzled. Listening to Xi Ying's tone, could it be that Yuan Ming had always been hiding nearby?
That being the case, the assistance provided to everyone to escape the Illusion Technique earlier, and the Blood Light just now, must have been Yuan Ming's doing.
Yan Sijing was shocked inwardly. With Wan Qi Hong and other Nascent Soul cultivators present just a moment ago, Yuan Ming managed to evade the detection of so many Nascent Soul cultivators, truly worthy of being the envoy of Lord Nether Moon God.
As for Xi Ying addressing Yuan Ming in such a familiar tone, Yan Sijing wasn't surprised. Back in Ghost Miasma Canyon, she already sensed a certain understanding between Yuan Ming and Xi Ying based on her intuition.
"I still have things to do and can't show myself now. Whatever you have to say, just say it," Yuan Ming's voice echoed from within the third layer space.
Xi Ying frowned slightly and turned to look at Yan Sijing.
Before Yan Sijing could react, she felt a buzzing in her head as countless illusions appeared before her eyes, and her consciousness quickly sank.
At that moment, a powerful wave of Soul Power descended from the sky, striking Yan Sijing's Divine Soul, causing all the illusions before her eyes to dissipate and her consciousness to regain clarity.
"This woman is the only believer of Lord Nether Moon God in Shura Palace, and many things depend on her action, so she cannot be allowed to fall unconscious," Yuan Ming's voice sounded again.
Yan Sijing, still shaken, retreated further and looked at Xi Ying with eyes filled with fear.
"Then let her leave this place. What I have to say cannot be known by others," Xi Ying said impatiently.
"Go to the second layer to avoid for a while. Once there, do not wander around, focus on praying. Lord Nether Moon God just gave me a message, he will soon make a move to eliminate Thunderbolt Ancestor for you," Yuan Ming's voice echoed in Yan Sijing's mind.
Yan Sijing, who had already been eager to leave, promptly complied and hurried down the stairs to the second layer.
The Ten Thousand Miles of Yellow Sand Formation was still in operation, albeit on a much smaller scale.
Following Yuan Ming's instructions, Yan Sijing did not pay attention to anything else, found a spot, sat down with crossed legs, and began to pray intently to Lord Nether Moon God.
A rich Desire Power flowed into the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space, sharpening Yuan Ming's vision.
Xi Ying waved her sleeves, and dozens of yellow lights fell around her, quickly condensing into a golden Array that completely sealed off the surroundings.
The Yellow Sand Formation was quite sophisticated, also serving to isolate Spiritual Energy and forbid Divine Sense, though of course, it was ineffective against Yuan Ming.
"Your Formation skills have improved a lot since before. However, Wan Qi Hong and the others have left, and the wall restrictions have been restored as before. Is such caution really necessary?" Yuan Ming spoke.
"I'm not worried about that Wan Qi Hong, I'm guarding against someone else," Xi Ying said, with a disdainful curl of her lip.
"Who might that be?" Yuan Ming asked with some curiosity.
"The person Dugu Feng took with him," Xi Ying said.
"Oh, the taciturn one from the journey? What's so special about him?" Yuan Ming recalled the figure of the Black-clothed Monk.
"Reluctant as I am to admit it, that guy is the strongest and most dangerous person in Shura Palace! It was precisely because he was nearby earlier that I did not dare to communicate with you telepathically, lest he sense it," Xi Ying said with a grave expression.VisitMyVirtualLibraryEmpire(*)formore.
"Is that so? What's that person's identity? And, you said you had something to discuss with me earlier. What is it?" Yuan Ming's expression became serious as he listened to Xi Ying.
"I need to kill someone, but I'm a bit short on strength and require your assistance," Xi Ying said without directly answering Yuan Ming's questions.
"Kill who? Don't tell me it's..." Yuan Ming paused, taken aback.
"Yes, it's that Black-clothed Monk!" Xi Ying's eyes flickered as she slowly said.
…
Several hundred miles from the Black Tower, amidst a range of mountains, Wan Qi Hong and the others, with all their might, had finally caught up to the Shura Blood Devouring Map, and the battle unfolded once again.
Wan Qi Hong took the lead without a word, bringing out his golden Flying Sword, but this time, there were a total of nine.
The nine Flying Swords linked together, forming a vast Golden Sword Formation, dozens of yards in size, enveloping the Shura Blood Devouring Map.
Countless sharp golden Sword Qis continuously emerged, slashing at the map from all directions.
The Shura Blood Devouring Map, at this moment, released highly corrosive Blood Mist, forming a massive Blood-colored Fog Ball around it. The dense Blood Mist surged like divine dragons, exuding a terrifying presence.
The dense golden Sword Qi struck the surface but was immediately corroded and dissipated by the Blood Mist, utterly unable to touch the Shura Blood Devouring Map inside.
Dugu Feng, Thunderbolt Ancestor, and Golden Dawn Fairy were also nearby. Seeing this, they each brought out their Magic Treasures to attack.
On their way here, the four had agreed that whoever could subdue the Shura Blood Devouring Map would own the treasure.
Although they all knew that the others might not willingly abide by the agreement after the Shura Blood Devouring Map was defeated, the victor could claim the moral high ground. This would give them an advantage in the future struggle for the treasure, so Dugu Feng and the others also exerted their full power.
Dugu Feng's twenty-one Black Needles transformed into a sky full of Needle Shadows, shooting out in all directions; the Black Sword's surface bristled with dense black arcs of lightning, cleaving down with the force to split mountains and rivers, creating thunderous roars with each strike, and manifesting an impressive might.
Thunderbolt Ancestor continued to manipulate the Thunder Seal Treasure, conjuring three awe-inspiring Thunder Flood Dragons, each several dozen yards long. They clawed and thrashed, spitting out large Thunder Balls from their mouths, which were quite effective against the Shura Blood Devouring Map's Blood Dao Divine Power.
Golden Dawn Fairy floated in the air, not as flamboyant in her methods as the others, still merely directing the golden book. A plethora of runes shot out, condensing into golden talismans that fell.
As soon as the golden talisman left the book, it instantly enlarged in the wind, transforming into door-sized golden Sword Shadows, emitting astonishing sounds of wind and thunder, striking at the Shura Blood Devouring Map.
Each Sword Shadow was actually a third-level Wind and Thunder Sword Talisman.
As experts in Drawing Talismans, the Spirit Talisman Sect considered the golden book in Jin Xi's possession an auxiliary treasure for casting talismans, allowing her to create talismans in the Void, skipping steps like engraving and Enriching.
Together, the four Nascent Soul cultivators acted with such power that they shook mountains and rivers with every move. The dense Blood-colored mist surrounding the Shura Blood Devouring Map fervently boiled, quickly evaporating, and drastically decreasing the size of the Fog Ball.

chapters.title: Chapter 424 - 424: 401
chapters.content:
"How dare you! Do you younglings who've eaten the hearts of bears and the gall of leopards truly think I cannot kill you?" roared a voice from the Shura Blood Devouring Map, as two blood-colored figures shot out from the Fog Ball, the Blood-colored Skull and the red-clothed woman.
The Blood-colored Skull spat out eight round orbs, which floated in midair and quickly interwove into a flickering formation of blood light.
An illusion of a winding Blood River appeared, emanating a putrid, fishy smell that was nauseating, hovering in front of Dugu Feng, Thunderbolt Ancestor, and Golden Dawn Fairy.
The blood-colored illusions of Dugu Feng, Thunderbolt Ancestor, and Golden Dawn Fairy emerged from within the Blood River, looking more realistic than before, and their Magic Treasures also manifested in blood red.
Dugu Feng's illusion formed a spell, and twenty-one blood-colored Flying Needles shot out, transforming into a sky full of blood-colored needle shadows, colliding with the incoming Black Needles. Instantly, large and small spheres of light burst forth, resulting in a stalemate.
A blood-colored Thunder Sword also met Dugu Feng's black treasure sword, and they collided with a thunderous roar, evenly matched.
It was the same for Thunderbolt Ancestor and Golden Dawn Fairy; they were blocked by their own illusions, caught in a deadlock, making no progress.
They all felt chilled, having previously fought the Blood-colored Skull several times but always holding back. Now, even going all out, the outcome was still a draw. The Blood River Illusion seemed to grow stronger with opposition, never to be broken.
"Hehe, my Blood River Illusion Array, inherited from ancient times, is impervious to your level of cultivation and exquisite Magic Treasures," the Blood-colored Skull chuckled coldly.
On the other side, the red-clothed woman also employed her Blood Sea Divine Ability, fiercely colliding with Wan Qi Hong's Golden Sword Formation, causing it to tremble violently.
Wan Qi Hong looked solemn, his fingers fluttering rapidly, sending spell after spell into the sword formation. Although the Golden Sword Formation was temporarily stabilized, the descending Sword Qi was considerably scattered, absorbed entirely by the Blood Sea.
The Shura Blood Devouring Map Artifact Spirit finally managed to take a deep breath as the Blood Mist behind the map roiled, contracting inward and disappearing in the blink of an eye.
The next moment, raised black patterns appeared at the center of the Blood Devouring Map, spreading quickly like the meridians of a living creature, soon extending over the entire map.
Bang bang bang...
A strange oscillating force spread out, causing the nearby nature's spiritual energy to boil and form a huge Spiritual Energy Vortex.
The Shura Blood Devouring Map expanded a hundredfold in the storm, becoming unusually pliable, as the Spiritual Energy Vortex pulled toward the center of the Golden Sword Formation's nine Flying Swords.
Always read at the source—*.
Wan Qi Hong's expression changed, and he hurriedly activated the sword formation to intercept. Numerous golden Sword Qi, dense as a rapid storm, shot down, with strands of golden flames appearing on the Sword Qi, striking the Shura Blood Devouring Map.
However, all Sword Qi vanished without a trace as soon as it touched the map, having no effect whatsoever.
The next moment, an invisible suction force from the Spiritual Energy Vortex suddenly enveloped the nine Flying Swords within the sword formation.
Just then, a void fluctuation occurred, and a black-clothed figure materialized out of nowhere, the Black Desert Alliance's black-clothed monk, raising his hand.
A Black Key was released from his hand, precisely piercing the Shura Blood Devouring Map's central area.
A cry of agony echoed from within the Shura Blood Devouring Map as the black patterns vanished completely, and the strange oscillating force also receded, dispelling the Spiritual Energy Vortex.
The map quickly shrank, returning to its previous form, transforming back into a blood-colored screen with significantly diminished spirit light, falling from midair.
Astonished, the Blood-colored Skull and the red-clothed woman hurriedly shot toward the Shura Blood Devouring Map.
However, the black-clothed monk shot backward, dodging out of the Golden Sword Formation within a few flashes, taking the Black Key with him as it flew out from the blood-colored screen and into his hand.
All this happened in the blink of an eye, even causing the four Nascent Soul cultivators present to hesitate.
Wan Qi Hong was especially surprised as he glanced at the black-clothed monk; he had not cleared the way for this man, yet he effortlessly left the Golden Sword Formation!
However, given the urgency of the situation, this was not the time to dwell on the identity of the black-clothed monk.
Wan Qi Hong quickly handled the Golden Sword Formation, with dense golden Sword Qi raining down from the sky, striking the Blood River Formation's illusions of Dugu Feng, Thunderbolt Ancestor, and Golden Dawn Fairy.
Distracted, the Blood-colored Skull failed to manifest an illusion of Wan Qi Hong in the Blood River Formation. The three Blood Shadows immediately counteracted but were helpless against the sudden onslaught of the sword formation.
The three Blood Shadows were pierced by countless Sword Qi, their blood light dispersing profusely, rendering them immobile.
Overjoyed, Golden Dawn Fairy ran her finger over the scroll-like Magic Treasure.
Three golden pages fluttered down, each inscribed with a complex talisman that resembled a blooming Golden Lotus.
Level 4 Spirit Talisman, the Golden Lotus Sealing Spirit Talisman.
Three pages of glowing golden light transformed into three golden talismans, which flashed and instantly attached themselves to the Blood Shadow.
A golden lotus appeared above Blood Shadow's head, spinning rapidly as it cast dense streams of golden light that trapped the three Blood Shadows in place.
The Blood-colored Skull, flustered and regretful, saw that the red-clothed woman had already protected the Shura Blood Devouring Map and immediately flipped to fly back.
The three Blood Shadows were transformed from most of the mighty power of the Blood River Illusion Array, and could not be abandoned.
"Our fight isn't over yet, and you already want to change opponents?" Dugu Feng quickly moved, blocking in front of the Blood-colored Skull, and swung down a black treasure sword with a force like Mount Tai bearing down.
The attacks from Thunderbolt Ancestor and Golden Dawn Fairy also followed, severely targeting the Blood-colored Skull, trying to take the opportunity to crush it completely.
The Blood-colored Skull, not having the leisure to rescue the three Blood Shadows, activated the Blood River Formation. Its winding, turbulent flow protected itself.
"Let's continue as well!" Wan Qi Hong gave a slight cold smile and waved his sleeve.
The nine Flying Swords' surfaces burst with golden brilliance, and the whole Sword Array buzzed into action, enveloping the Shura Blood Devouring Map and the red-clothed woman with countless Sword Qi.
The Shura Blood Devouring Map suffered heavy damage, and the auras of the Blood-colored Skull and the red-clothed woman weakened noticeably as the scope of the Blood River Formation and Blood-colored Sea of Flames reduced significantly, barely withstanding the assault from the four.
"Artifact Spirit senior, by now, you should give up! This Shura Palace is no different from a prison for you. Why not leave with this junior? Chang Chun Temple will certainly offer you esteemed treatment and provide all the resources you need for your Cultivation!" Wan Qi Hong's earnest persuading continued without a delay in his attack.
The Blood-colored Sea of Flames kept shrinking, and the fierce and unparalleled Sword Qi soon neared the Shura Blood Devouring Map.
The red-clothed woman made a valiant effort to activate the sea of blood, yet it was all in vain.
Within this woman, an invisible soul shadow stood in the void, and it was indeed Yuan Ming.
The location of the Shura Blood Devouring Map had already exceeded the range of his Divine Sense. In order to check the situation there, he simply ignited the Black Incense for possession on the body of the red-clothed woman.
"Wan Qi Hong's strength is indeed formidable, it seems the Shura Blood Devouring Map cannot escape their control, what a pity," Yuan Ming secretly said.
"Artifact Spirit senior, this won't do. We've been trapped inside the Shura Palace for thousands of years and the Blood Origin Power inside the Blood Map has long been depleted. Although we previously seized the Essence Blood of two external Cultivators, it's still far from enough for usage. What should we do next?" The red-clothed woman anxiously communicated with the Artifact Spirit.
Yuan Ming, having possessed this woman, could hear their conversation.
The Blood-colored Skull felt deep resentment in its heart; both it and the red-clothed woman were top-level Blood Corpses within the Shura Blood Devouring Map, and their combat power was closely related to the Blood Origin Power inside.
The current Shura Blood Devouring Map was just an empty shell, and they were like Cultivators depleted of Mana, unable to exert their actual strength. Otherwise, by their power alone, how could Wan Qi Hong, Dugu Feng, and a few Nascent Soul Early and Mid-stage Cultivators possibly match them?
"How should I know! I originally hid a good portion of Blood Origin Power inside the Blood Devouring Map without telling Shura Master, that old thing, intended for escaping once the Shura Palace opened. But you, taking advantage of my slumber, stealthily absorbed it for Cultivation, using up all the Blood Origin Power, and you still have the face to ask me!" The Artifact Spirit furiously berated the red-clothed woman.
The red-clothed woman, knowing she was at fault, did not retaliate.
"And you, Blood Shadow, Shura Master assigned you to guard Yin Capital City, how could you return in such a sorry state? Not only did you lose a Blood River Pearl, but the Thousand Illusion Treasure Mirror, the Blood Bone Mask, and the Thunder God Hammer from Yin Capital City were not brought back either. You've really regressed as you lived longer, wasting the times I chose to keep both of you!" The Artifact Spirit turned its rebuke towards the Blood-colored Skull.
The Blood-colored Skull hung its head silently, not uttering a word.
After venting its anger for a while, the Artifact Spirit finally stopped.
"Senior, forgive me, but this can't be blamed on me. All these years, you only cared about your own slumber. Those Core Formation stage Blood Corpses are stupid and clueless, I didn't even have one to talk to, so I had to resort to Cultivating to pass the time," the red-clothed woman said sheepishly, trying to defend herself.
"Humph, you always have excuses," the Artifact Spirit huffed.
"I didn't have a chance to ask before, Blood Shadow, how have you fared these years? At least you were comfortable, assigned by Shura Master to guard Yin Capital City, where there are many demons to chat and kill time with. By the way, how's the Blood Willow in Yin Capital City? Has it already died at the hands of these outsiders? Also, who took away your Blood River Pearl?" The words of the red-clothed woman changed, and she incessantly inquired about the Blood-colored Skull's circumstances.
"Nonsense, Shura Master severed half of my life connection with the Shura Blood Devouring Map! Not only did my strength not improve over a thousand years, but I also had to strain to maintain the Forbidden array in Yin Capital City. What comfort do you think there was? You think everyone is as talkative as you!" The Blood-colored Skull, greatly dissatisfied, growled back.
"We are all Blood Corpses from within the Shura Blood Devouring Map, no matter how much we cultivate, there won't be much progress. Why bother getting frustrated over this? If you ask me, we should find a way to leave this damned place as soon as possible," the red-clothed woman, uncaring of the current crisis, continued to ramble on, seemingly wanting to voice out all the frustrations she had kept bottled up for thousands of years.
"Enough, both of you shut up. I've just awakened, and if those people outside don't kill me, your bickering will!" the Artifact Spirit yelled angrily.

chapters.title: Chapter 425 - 402: Millennium Old Demon
chapters.content:
"Artifact Spirit ancestor, if it really comes to that, we could just temporarily submit to them. After all, when facing the Shura Master back then, we did the same thing. These cultivators have such short lives; if we endure for a few hundred years, they will die off on their own, and then we can regain our freedom!" the Blood-colored Skull suggested, growing more smug as it spoke.
"That's right, we'll outlive them!" the red-clothed woman immediately agreed.
"Hmm, what you're saying isn't a bad idea at all," the Artifact Spirit mused thoughtfully.
Yuan Ming heard this and couldn't help but be speechless.
These old timers had been locked up for thousands of years, they must have gone senile in their captivity. Even if they outlasted the next owner of the Shura Blood Devouring Map, the treasure would certainly be passed on. Especially if it fell into the hands of a major sect like Chang Chun Temple, they could forget about ever escaping again, even after tens of thousands of years.
Once the three Artifact Spirits had reached an agreement, they shouted out, "Fellow Daoists with incredible Divine Skills, please cease your attacks. This venerable one is willing to follow you and leave."
The Blood-colored Skull and the red-clothed woman each swiftly retracted their Magic Treasures and crisply flew back into the bloody screen.
The Shura Blood Devouring Map was now completely exposed within the Sword Array, showing not the slightest defense.
Wan Qi Hong was overjoyed to hear this and quickly stopped the Golden Sword Formation to avoid damaging the Spiritual Treasure.
At that moment, a burst of blood blossomed from his lower abdomen, and a hazy white silhouette emerged from his stomach, piercing through the Dantian, revealing itself to be a white long sword.
The fierce Sword Qi exploded, instantly shredding Wan Qi Hong's Dantian and severing all his meridians with Sword Qi.
And behind Wan Qi Hong, at some unknown time, had appeared a shadowy figure like a ghost—it was Dugu Feng.
Lei Ming and Jin Xi were both shocked at the sight. The soundless movement technique of Dugu Feng, as well as the speed of that white sword, were astoundingly fast, far surpassing Dugu Feng's previous performance.
"Ghost Shadow Escape! Black and White Dual Swords! You are not Dugu Feng, you are the Ghost Shadow Swordsman Jing Wusan..." Wan Qi Hong spat out a mouthful of fresh blood and struggled to speak.
"Jing Wusan is Dugu Feng, and Dugu Feng is Jing Wusan. Rest assured in your journey to the afterlife, Fellow Daoist Wan Qi. The Black Desert Alliance will make good use of this Shura Blood Devouring Map!" Dugu Feng laughed heartily as the white long sword sliced upwards, releasing a snow-white blade of Sword Qi.
Wan Qi Hong's body split in two, his head no exception.
Lei Ming's eyes flickered, as if he wanted to say something.
"Is that so?" A cool voice came from the side. Wan Qi Hong was surprisingly standing several meters away, startling Lei Ming and Jin Xi, who hurriedly looked towards Dugu Feng.
The corpse of Wan Qi Hong that had just fallen turned into a torn black paper effigy, which looked strikingly realistic, covered in various talismans and runes.
"Death Replacement!" Dugu Feng's brows lifted, showing no surprise.
"Unexpectedly, you know of our sect's Death Replacement. Then why bother wasting your efforts and attempt a sneak attack?" Wan Qi Hong said, somewhat surprised by Dugu Feng's reaction.
"I have long heard that the cultivators of Chang Chun Temple are the premier sect in the Central Plains, evergreen for ten thousand years. I wanted to test if your strength truly lives up to this reputation," Dugu Feng said, placing the white long sword horizontally before him and lightly stroking the blade with his fingers.
Now that he had revealed his true identity, a sense of pride shone through Dugu Feng's brows, a stark contrast to his earlier demeanor.
"And after the test, what are your thoughts?" Wan Qi Hong smiled and asked.
"You do have some skills," Dugu Feng said indifferently.
"It is an honor to be commended by the Ghost Shadow Swordsman. It's said that the Ghost Shadow Swordsman's escape technique is astonishing, and the Black and White Dual Swords are even more formidable. The Black Sword ensnares souls, fast as lightning, killing without need for a second stroke, while the White Sword reaps lives, twice as fast as the Black Sword. Combined, their power doubles. I wonder how they compare to my Flame Sun Sword Formation?" Wan Qi Hong chuckled, forming hand seals, as the Golden Sword Formation started up again.
Countless Sword Qi appeared out of thin air, each strand aglow with golden flames, turning the area within hundreds of meters blisteringly hot in an instant, as if suddenly brought into the middle of a volcano's magma.
Seeing this, Lei Ming and Jin Xi realized that neither of them was a match for Dugu Feng nor Wan Qi Hong. As the two were about to clash again, they both flew backwards.
"Great Sun Golden Flames! Truly formidable. But my mission has already ended, and now I shall simply watch from the sidelines!" Dugu Feng suddenly turned around and flew off into the distance, evidently not planning to continue the fight with Wan Qi Hong.
Wan Qi Hong was taken aback, but he wouldn't allow Dugu Feng to leave just because of a few words. Countless blades of Sword Qi rained down, filling the void with the terrifying sound of cutting through air.
However, at that moment, he suddenly clutched his head and screamed in agony, his forehead's veins bulging as if he was suffering extreme pain.
All the Sword Qi became wildly erratic and then vanished, as the Golden Sword Formation collapsed with a bang, and the nine Flying Swords fell to the ground.
Lei Ming and Jin Xi looked on in astonishment, not knowing what kind of attack had stricken Wan Qi Hong. They quickly summoned their Magic Treasures to protect themselves.
"This is..." Yuan Ming frowned from within the red-clothed woman as he witnessed the scene unfolding before him.
The three beings within the Shura Blood Devouring Map were also stunned; they had been prepared to surrender, but now these cultivators had started killing each other!
"These cultivators really haven't changed in three thousand years, delighting in fratricide. The Sword Array has disappeared, Artifact Spirit ancestor, let's escape quickly!" the Blood-colored Skull exclaimed joyfully.
The Artifact Spirit hummed in agreement, and the Shura Blood Devouring Map turned into a Blood Shadow and shot towards the distance.
"Since Your Excellency has decided to surrender, why attempt an escape? Better to stay," said a black shadow that emerged in front of the Shura Blood Devouring Map, the very Black-clothed Monk from the Black Desert Alliance.
As he spoke, he waved his hand and shot out the Black Key once again, striking it at the center area of the Shura Blood Devouring Map.
The Artifact Spirit of the Shura Blood Devouring Map let out a muffled groan. The blood light on the blood-colored screen flickered erratically, and the Inner Strength restrictions became instantly chaotic. The Flying Escape was forcefully interrupted.
"Damn it, that key again! Curse that old Shura, dead and still haunting us!" raged the Artifact Spirit.
"It's him!" Yuan Ming recognized the newcomer with a shiver.
The Black-clothed Monk didn't allow the red-clothed woman and the Blood-colored Skull to act. He formed a gesture and pointed into the air, sending a solid-looking black light from the Black Key in his hand. It was filled with many runes and merged into the Shura Blood Devouring Map.
The blood light from the Shura Blood Devouring Map became even more chaotic, and new black patterns appeared on the screen, rapidly spreading across the entire map to form a Sealing pattern, rendering the map utterly immobile.
Yuan Ming, possessing the red-clothed woman's body, was unable to see the outside situation with the Shura Blood Devouring Map being sealed. He could only faintly sense the aura outside.
The Black-clothed Monk put away the key and slowly flew up to where Wan Qi Hong was.
"Master," Dugu Feng greeted the Black-clothed Monk from a distance with a respectful salute.
Thunderbolt Ancestor and Golden Dawn Fairy were stunned by the sudden development before them and took a fresh look at the previously silent Black-clothed Monk.
"The thing in my Sea of Consciousness... was it you... who planted it?" Wan Qi Hong asked, lifting his head with difficulty, glaring at the person before him.
"Correct, it is my soul leech! I took the opportunity to plant it when you were pierced by the White Sword and your Dantian was ruptured. Although Chang Chun Temple's Death Replacement can swap out the host's injuries, it needs half a breath's time to take effect, which was enough time for my soul leech to Parasite," said the Black-clothed Monk slowly.
"Soul leech! You are..." Wan Qi Hong's eyes widened in realization.
"It seems you have guessed my identity, so you should also know why I must kill you. Now go on your way!" The Black-clothed Monk raised his hand and a black giant palm several zhangs across materialized out of thin air, smashing towards Wan Qi Hong's head.
The black palm emitted five rings of light that felt suffocating. The space all around solidified and then quickly collapsed, as if the whole world was pressing down. There was simply no room to escape.
Wan Qi Hong was in extreme pain and had absolutely no strength to dodge as the black palm struck him.
With a "bang," Wan Qi Hong's head and the majority of his body exploded into pieces.
However, in the next moment, he turned into yet another shattered Death Replacement.
Wan Qi Hong's figure appeared about a dozen zhang away, his form unhesitatingly aiming for the Shura Blood Devouring Map.
The Black-clothed Monk was startled and immediately gave chase, urging the soul leech in his mind.
A thin silver bug appeared in Wan Qi Hong's Sea of Consciousness, winding around his Nascent Soul and burrowing towards it, sending waves of intense pain.
However, a white talisman appeared inside Wan Qi Hong's Sea of Consciousness, placed atop his Nascent Soul. A white light enveloped both the Nascent Soul and the silver bug, slowing down the bug's movement significantly, as if it were sealed.
Wan Qi Hong's expression eased slightly, and he made a pulling gesture with his hands.To report errors, please visit the original post on *.
Nine Flame Sun Swords flew in, fusing into one large golden sword that lifted his body.
In the next instant, Wan Qi Hong's speed surged, and in a blink, he was beside the Shura Blood Devouring Map.
The giant golden sword exploded with a roar, transforming into nine Flying Swords suspended at various positions around the blood-colored screen, with fierce Golden Flames igniting from each blade.
"Stop! If you dare to move a step closer, I'll self-destruct my Flying Swords. We can all perish together, and nobody will get the Spiritual Treasure!" Wan Qi Hong halted his flying figure, shouting at the Black-clothed Monk who was in hot pursuit.
The Black-clothed Monk stopped a dozen or so zhang away, sizing up Wan Qi Hong before speaking, "You're just a Magic Practitioner, and yet you've suppressed my soul leech? You must have used some kind of Divine Soul talisman or treasure."
Dugu Feng caught up as well and stopped behind the Black-clothed Monk, his expression changing before he gave a cold laugh, "I don't believe you have the heart to destroy such a Spiritual Treasure!"
"Facing an ancient demon like Your Excellency, I only wish to escape with my life. Whether it's a Spiritual Treasure or an Immortal Treasure, they're not as important as my own life!" Wan Qi Hong scoffed coldly, without any hesitation, he pointed a gesture.
The Flying Sword shone with a sun-like luminance as its aura fluctuated violently, then it suddenly burst apart!
A golden sun appeared out of nowhere, enveloping the blood-colored screen.
The blood-colored screen was submerged by the golden light. After several breaths, it reappeared with one corner scorched black, showcasing a series of cracks.

chapters.title: Chapter 426 - 426: 403
chapters.content:
"You!" Dugu Feng's face was full of shock and anger, yet he dared not utter another word!
As a crack appeared in the corner of the blood-red screen, the black seal on it was also torn apart; a blood-colored skull and a red-clothed woman emerged from within the image and furiously pounced toward Wan Qi Hong.
"No one is to make the slightest move, or I shall detonate all the flying swords this instant!" Wan Qi Hong bellowed once again, and the remaining eight flying swords blazed with golden light.
The blood-colored skull and the red-clothed woman also immediately halted, glaring at Wan Qi Hong with eyes almost spitting fire.
Wan Qi Hong laughed triumphantly, turning to the black-clothed monk and barked, "Release me from the soul leech, or I'll take this Shura Blood Devouring Map with me to the grave!"
"Agreed," the black-clothed monk replied after a brief silence, stepping forward.
Upon hearing this, a glint of joy flashed in Wan Qi Hong's eyes.
At that moment, a disturbance in the void occurred behind him, and the figure of another black-clothed monk materialized from thin air, a black giant hand with five rings of light emanating from within, striking down like lightning.
Wan Qi Hong was both shocked and furious, hastily dodging to the side.
However, where a black light flitted by, another black giant hand emerged.
The two giant hands, one in front of the other, sealed all of Wan Qi Hong's escape routes and struck down viciously.
Wan Qi Hong had already witnessed the might of the black giant hand and knew he couldn't withstand it, as his eyes turned blood-red in an instant.
"Then let's die together!" He laughed wildly, as the eight flying swords carrying the Shura Blood Devouring Map flew toward him, their golden light surging!
But just at that moment, the space before Wan Qi Hong rippled like water, and then returned to normal.
The Shura Blood Devouring Map that was previously mounted by the eight flying swords had vanished, reappearing in the distance, guarded by the black-clothed monk and Dugu Feng on either side.
There were no longer any cracks on the Shura Blood Devouring Map; the black seal was completely intact.
"Illusion Technique!" Wan Qi Hong was dumbfounded, realizing he had unwittingly fallen into an illusion from the start.
Before he could figure out when he had fallen into the illusion, the golden light from the eight flying swords had already started to flicker wildly, bursting forth with a thunderous explosion.
A round sun, dozens of feet in size, appeared out of nowhere; flames burned fiercely on its surface, engulfing his body.
The sun then shattered, turning into countless streaks of dense golden light, which spread out over hundreds of feet, covering everything beneath it.
Flames burned on each streak of golden light; wherever they passed, the void trembled violently, and black marks appeared, as if it was about to be torn apart.
The black-clothed monk and Dugu Feng's expressions changed drastically, and they hurriedly carried the Shura Blood Devouring Map as they shot backward at full strength, narrowly escaping the range of the dense golden light; they retreated a good distance before coming to a stop.
The area engulfed by the golden light had turned into a sea of fire, with the fierce golden flames burning within and stirring up hot whirlwinds that circled with a roaring sound, turning everything to nothingness.
"The Flame Sun Sword is indeed powerful! We would've been in trouble too if we had been slower to escape just now!" Dugu Feng said with lingering fear.
"You keep an eye on the Shura Blood Devouring Map," the black-clothed monk instructed, and then vanished with a flicker.
In a part of the golden sea of fire, a golden figure, barely an inch tall, shot out, holding a silver banner—it was Wan Qi Hong's Nascent Soul, having somehow survived using an unknown method.
Fear was etched across the tiny face of the Nascent Soul; without a moment's pause, it continued to shoot away into the distance at a startling speed, almost like instantaneous movement, covering several miles in the blink of an eye.
Just then, a disturbance arose in the void ahead, and the figure of the black-clothed monk appeared out of nowhere, a black giant hand descending from above!
"You really are determined to eradicate me completely!" the golden Nascent Soul cried out in shock and rage, hurling the silver banner ahead.
The banner swelled in the wind, expanding hundreds of times in an instant, turning into a giant silver flag that blocked the black giant hand.
The Nascent Soul flicked its small hand through the air, and the silver banner expanded again, enveloping the black giant hand and the black-clothed monk behind it.
A trace of sorrow flashed in the Nascent Soul's eyes as it streaked past the side of the giant silver banner, continuing its escape.This c.ha^p&te%r% is pa$r%t of the c#olle$c.t.io$n. on *.%
However, ahead of it, dozens of silver beams flickered into existence, and several silver, leech-like bugs appeared out of nowhere, all lunging towards the golden Nascent Soul.
A look of unspeakable horror spread across the Nascent Soul's face, its hands waved frantically, and its body emitted a tangible golden light in an attempt to fend off the silver leeches, alas to no avail.
All the silver leeches easily pierced through the golden light's defense, burrowing into the Nascent Soul's body.
The previously plump golden Nascent Soul quickly shrank, becoming emaciated tenfold within a few breaths before bursting into pieces.
Within the Shura Blood Devouring Map, Yuan Ming sensed Wan Qi Hong's aura fading and was secretly alarmed.
No sooner had the black-clothed monk appeared than Wan Qi Hong had perished, evidently at the hands of this person; the monk's divine skills were indeed formidable.
Just as he was about to activate his Divine Sense to investigate further, the time for Black Incense Possession ended, and his consciousness returned to his body within the Black Tower.
"Finally back to your senses? Who would've thought the Stealing Heaven Tripod could be used in such a sneaky way! Did you discover anything?" Xi Ying looked at Yuan Ming as he slowly regained consciousness, her expression containing a trace of malice as she huffed.
Yuan Ming had no choice but to reveal the Stealing Heaven Tripod's possession ability to Xi Ying before attempting to possess the red-clothed woman.
Xi Ying immediately asked Yuan Ming if he had ever possessed her. Yuan Ming hastily denied it but mentioned that he had possessed Silver Cat Guoguo to check on Xi Ying's condition.
Xi Ying, being extremely clever, immediately recalled several odd occurrences involving Guoguo while on Red Lotus Island in the Southern Border, and pressed Yuan Ming for answers.
Yuan Ming did not hide the truth, admitting it was his actions while possessing Silver Cat that had caused those incidents.
Remembering the times when these odd changes occurred and how she had held Silver Cat in her arms, Xi Ying instantly felt her face flush with embarrassment and awkwardly chose to ignore Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming hurriedly apologized, promising he would never possess Guoguo again. Xi Ying reluctantly forgave him, though her demeanor still showed signs of embarrassment and annoyance.
"Wan Qi Hong is already dead, most likely at the hands of the black-clothed monk. Who exactly is this person?" Yuan Ming stood up and asked.
Upon hearing this, Xi Ying's expression slowly turned grave.
...
The shock was evident on the faces of Thunderbolt Ancestor and Golden Dawn Fairy when they saw that Wan Qi Hong was dead.
After reaching the Nascent Soul Stage, it was generally difficult to die in a conflict, as even if the physical body were destroyed, one could normally use a secret technique to allow the Nascent Soul to escape and later find another suitable body to seize.
Moreover, coming from the Chang Chun Temple's Wan Qi Family, Wan Qi Hong not only had formidable cultivation but also possessed more life-saving means than an average Nascent Soul cultivator.
Yet, he was still effortlessly killed by the black-clothed monk, who left him no chance of escaping with his Nascent Soul.
Almost instantly, Thunderbolt Ancestor and Golden Dawn Fairy harbored the same thought of fleeing this place of trouble.
When it came to life and death, no Spiritual Treasure was worth mentioning.
However, just then, a voice full of desire rang in their ears.
"Haha, life is short, why bother struggling for it? Why not join us in indulging our desires and make this trip to the mortal world worthwhile?"
The mind of Thunderbolt Ancestor trembled, and he suddenly felt as if a fire had ignited in his lower abdomen, making him increasingly restless.
At the same time, the apparitions of numerous female cultivators appeared by his side. Thunderbolt Ancestor looked carefully and saw that these phantoms slowly transformed into the female cultivators he had once 'harvested', all casting seductive glances and flinging themselves at him.
Golden Dawn Fairy, upon hearing the voice, also felt a faint flame ignite within her, but it was so weak that she easily suppressed it with a thought.
However, she then heard a thunderous noise. When she turned her head, she saw Thunderbolt Ancestor, seemingly crazed, with lust-muddled eyes, gesturing with his hands to cast spells, while endless lightning surged from his body toward the empty void.
The surging thunder poured towards Golden Dawn Fairy as well. She immediately raised her hand to summon the Golden Scroll, with her finger acting as a brush, she drew a rune on the scroll. Following that, golden letters emerged from the scroll, forming a Golden Bell in the air that enveloped her entire being.
When the thunder struck the Golden Bell, a sonorous bell sound echoed around, and ripples of sound waves spread outward, reaching Thunderbolt Ancestor's ears and dissipating the haze in his eyes.
Thunderbolt Ancestor regained his senses, and the apparitions of the female cultivators vanished from his sight. Recalling his actions just moments ago, he was truly horrified.
He gave Golden Dawn Fairy a grateful look and then immediately turned to flee.
Golden Dawn Fairy, seeing this, drew a new rune on the Golden Scroll. Countless golden letters wrapped around her body, and then she flew away with greater speed than Thunderbolt Ancestor, faster by a third.
Oddly, Dugu Feng and the black-clothed monk made no move to chase after the fleeing pair, standing silently and watching them leave.
Golden Dawn Fairy, who was escaping, looked back and saw this scene, a sense of alarm rising in her heart. Just then, an eerie voice came to her ear.
"The Shura Palace is so comfortable, why should I leave? I might as well stay here much longer, which is far better than my kennel."
Subsequently, a strong desire to stay arose within her. The Shura Cave Mansion's allure made it hard for her to leave. Was it truly what she wanted to abandon it so easily?
As the thought emerged, the golden light enveloping her gradually dissipated. She stopped her flight, looking around, her heart filled with reluctance.
At the same time, Thunderbolt Ancestor, seeing Golden Dawn Fairy halt, immediately remembered the spooky scene he had witnessed and realized they were both trapped by an illusion technique. The black-clothed monk was undoubtedly a Soul Cultivator.
In dealing with Soul Cultivators, their Five Thunder Sect was the foremost in the Central Plains. He was only caught off guard previously, but now, aware of the Soul Cultivator's deviousness, he was confident that he would not be bewitched again with the Magic Treasures he possessed.
If he could slay or even capture the Soul Cultivator alive, he would surely gain immense prestige, and his status within the sect would rise significantly.
"When people mention the Five Thunder Sect then, they will think of me, Thunderbolt Ancestor first, not my senior brother."
Reinvigorated by the words he heard, Thunderbolt Ancestor immediately stopped his tunneling light, turned around, and returned to the black-clothed monk with sparkling eyes.
Similarly, Golden Dawn Fairy, unable to part with the excellent environment of the Shura Palace, returned involuntarily, ready to claim the Cave Mansion from the hands of the black-clothed monk.
As they both returned to face the black-robed person, the desires that entangled their minds vanished in an instant.
Once they regained clarity, they first looked confused, then their expressions turned to one of dread. Thunderbolt Ancestor glared fiercely at the black-clothed monk and bellowed both in shock and rage, "Who on earth are you? You've already obtained what you wanted, what else do you intend to do?"

chapters.title: Chapter 427 - 404: The Mystery of the Six Desires
chapters.content:
"Heh, has it really been three thousand years since I've made an appearance? Have the people of today truly forgotten my methods?" the black-clothed monk said, lifting his hand to remove the veil from his head, revealing an extremely handsome face.
His appearance made it difficult to distinguish his gender, possessing both the masculine vigor of a man and the feminine grace of a woman.
In Thunderbolt Ancestor's eyes, this person incited a yearning that surpassed that of any female cultivator he had ever harvested, and in Golden Dawn Fairy's eyes, this person's face uncannily resembled the male cultivator she had been unable to forget since her girlhood.
After a brief moment of shock, both Thunderbolt Ancestor and Golden Dawn Fairy regained their senses, realizing that their seven emotions and six desires had been manipulated without their awareness just moments ago.
Looking at the black-clothed monk before them, they couldn't help but recall a name that had been recorded in the history books of all the sects across the Central Plains.
"The Six Desires Venerable! How can this be, weren't you killed by the Shura Master three thousand years ago? How can you still be alive!" Thunderbolt Ancestor could hardly believe his own eyes.
And a trace of fear appeared on Golden Dawn Fairy's face; three thousand years might seem like an eternity to mortals, long enough to bury many things, but for the Cultivation Sects, it was merely the span of a few generations. Events from three thousand years ago were clearly recorded in the libraries of all major sects.
The name Six Desires Venerable was certainly an existence that the Central Plains Immortal Cultivation World would firmly remember, each stroke written with the blood of cultivators from all major sects.
Since the Wu Yue Sect's annihilation ten thousand years ago and the subsequent division of territories within the cultivation world, there had been relative peace, but three thousand years ago, there was a period of turmoil and bloodshed.
All of the disturbances stemmed from two individuals, the Six Desires Venerable and the Shura Master.
Three thousand years ago, a soul cultivator with malevolent intentions appeared in the Central Plains Immortal Cultivation World, killing people everywhere to extract their souls, especially fond of slaying high-level cultivators. His brutality was such that his deeds were considered even more heinous than those of the Wu Yue Sect in bygone years.
The cultivators of the sects in the Central Plains Immortal Cultivation World dispatched experts to investigate together, losing two Nascent Soul cultivators and more than a dozen Core Formation cultivators before confirming that the culprit was a remnant of the Wu Yue Sect, the Six Desires Venerable.
Although the Wu Yue Sect had fallen, all sects remained vigilant against this mysterious soul cultivation sect. The emergence of the Six Desires Venerable instantly caused great unrest across the Yunhuang Continent, prompting the sects of the Central Plains to join forces once more, gathering over ten Nascent Soul cultivators. The great elder from Chang Chun Temple, who was at the late-stage Nascent Soul at the time, even took action in person, vowing to slay this demonic presence.
However, the Six Desires Venerable was too powerful, his soul cultivation had already delved deep into the peak of the Sleep Witch Realm, and he had even reached the mid-stage Nascent Soul as a magical practitioner, employing exceedingly cunning methods. Despite over a hundred years of tracking by the demon-extermination team, they failed to eliminate this evil, losing several Nascent Soul cultivators in the process.
Afterward, the Six Desires Venerable suddenly disappeared without a trace, leaving the cultivators from various sects not only enraged but also relieved.
Yet, three hundred years later, the long-absent Six Desires Venerable reemerged with a surge in strength. His soul cultivation reached the peak of the Sleep Witch Realm, and his magical cultivation had astonishingly broken through to the late-stage Nascent Soul, stepping into the realm of a Great Cultivator and sweeping away several millennium-old major sects of the Central Plains Immortal Cultivation World with an overwhelming force.
The Spirit Talisman Sect also suffered a devastating blow that year, and following the account of the Six Desires Venerable were pages listing the names of the cultivators sacrificed by the Spirit Talisman Sect to hunt him down—covering two full pages. From Nascent Soul to Qi Refinement, the mountain of bodies constructed of names was where the figure of the Six Desires Venerable stood.
Just as the sects of the Central Plains were about to unite again to face the threat of the Six Desires Venerable, an even more dazzling cultivator, the Shura Master, emerged from nowhere. He defeated the Six Desires Venerable in single combat and spent several years afterward tracking down and completely slaughtering the Six Desires Venerable.
It was this battle that firmly established the Shura Master as the number one person on the Yunhuang Continent.
"Hmph, the Shura Master is nothing more than a lucky thief who doesn't have what it takes to kill me! If it weren't for his fluke of obtaining the Shura Blood Devouring Map before me, how could I have been defeated by his hand?" The Six Desires Venerable, upon hearing the name of the Shura Master, showed a terrifying intent to kill in his eyes, as if Thunderbolt Ancestor had touched upon the most humiliating chapter of his heart.
Thunderbolt Ancestor hurriedly closed his mouth, daring not to speak anymore, and Golden Dawn Fairy turned silent as well.
"However, I should also thank him for his relentless pursuit.
