Had he not forced me into a corner, I might never have comprehended the highest realm of the Six Desires Breaking Emotion Great Method, thus achieving immortality, freeing myself from the shackles of lifespan forever," the Six Desires Venerable said with a suddenly warm expression, smiling as he spoke. His voice echoed all around, almost as if he were speaking to the now-deceased Shura Master himself.
At that moment, a violent wind suddenly swept through the mountains. Its roaring sound drowned out the voice of the Six Desires Venerable, as if responding with a roar of anger to his mockery.
However, amidst the violent wind, the Six Desires Venerable stood unmoved, his icy gaze sweeping over Thunderbolt Ancestor and the other individual. Suddenly, with a slight motion of his fingers, two bright white Silver Light Leeches flew out from his body, accompanied by his soft voice:
"You are indeed fortunate today, for I am in high spirits having acquired a spiritual treasure. I shall not commit unnecessary slaughter. You only need to accept the soul leech and become soul slaves under me to spare your lives," the Six Desires Venerable said with a sinister tone.
"However, should anyone be foolish enough to renounce their cultivation and oppose me, do not blame me for lacking mercy. I will personally use you to refine this spiritual treasure," the Six Desires Venerable added ominously.
Upon hearing these words, Thunderbolt Ancestor and Golden Dawn Fairy's faces turned deathly pale in an instant.
...
"Six Desires Venerable?"
Inside the high tower, Yuan Ming heard this name from Xi Ying and was instantly taken aback.
"It seems you've heard of him, which saves me some explanation," Xi Ying said, somewhat surprised as she glanced at Yuan Ming.
Hearing this, Yuan Ming quickly recounted his experiences in the All Living Beings' Dream. Xi Ying's expression also revealed a hint of surprise after listening.
"Are you saying the destruction of the Chaotian Sect was actually orchestrated in secret by this Six Desires Venerable? No wonder the Shura Master holds such a grudge against him, insisting on killing him—there is this connection," Xi Ying murmured thoughtfully.
"Let's not dwell on that for now. As far as I know, a Nascent Soul cultivator has only a thousand years of life span, and soul cultivation does not extend one's life. Since the Six Desires Venerable was already present three thousand years ago and is still alive, could it be that he later broke through to the Returning Void Stage, thereby gaining an extension of his lifespan?" Yuan Ming wondered.
"Not quite. Back then, the Shura Master pursued the Six Desires Venerable for several years, almost completely annihilating him, but ultimately he escaped death by using the soul leech parasitic method. Over these three thousand years, the Six Desires Venerable has been secretly healing his injuries and only in recent years has he managed to recover to the peak of Sleep Witch. The reason he has lived for so long is because of the Six Desires Breaking Emotion Great Method he cultivated. It is a top-tier soul cultivation method from the Wu Yue Sect, capable of controlling the six desires of life, perception, speech, visibility, sensation, and emotion. It is even more mysterious and powerful than the Moonlight Technique I taught you," Xi Ying shook her head and explained.
"To control the six desires! That truly sounds bizarre. Can the Six Desires Breaking Emotion Great Method extend one's lifespan?" Yuan Ming asked in astonishment.
"No, but it's said that once this method is cultivated to its highest realm, one can completely sever the link between the divine soul and the physical body. As long as one can continuously replenish the consumed soul power, the divine soul can exist indefinitely in the world, even being able to seize others' bodies for rebirth at will," Xi Ying said.
"To have such a heaven-defying technique, isn't that invincible?" Yuan Ming gasped in shock.
"Although the Six Desires Breaking Emotion Great Method is strong, it has many drawbacks. First of all, to cultivate this method to perfection is as hard as ascending to the heavens. Many in the Wu Yue Sect have cultivated this method, yet none have ever taken the final step. Unexpectedly, in response to the pursuit from the Shura Master, Six Desires willingly abandoned his physical body and attempted to live off soul leeches for replenishing soul power. Although the move was insane, it inadvertently allowed him to uncover the secrets of this realm and ultimately survive until now.
"Furthermore, the amount of divine soul power needed to extend life with this method is colossal. Therefore, every so often, Six Desires must completely devour a batch of cultivators' divine souls. To ensure quantity, he cannot fully eliminate the lingering thoughts and emotions of those souls, and as time passes, his divine soul has also become less pure, occasionally falling into madness, even arguing with himself. However, he is well aware of these drawbacks, so unless absolutely necessary, he will not personally engage."Rеаd аhеаd аnd gеt updаtеs by visiting М^VLЕМРYR.
"In addition, because he frequently changes bodies, his soul cultivation remains stable, but his magic cultivation fluctuates depending on the strength and talent of the new body. For instance, this time, the body he has taken over is only a mid-stage Nascent Soul magic practitioner, whose strength and talent are far inferior to his original body," Xi Ying continued to explain.
"But this emergence of the Shura Palace still drew him out. Was it because of the Shura Blood Devouring Map?" Yuan Ming quickly realized.
"Exactly, the emergence of the Shura Palace was news I managed to relay to him. He has long coveted this spiritual treasure. Last time, he wasn't able to get there in time, and the Blood Devouring Map was taken by the Shura Master. He will not make the same mistake again, and as I anticipated, he came here in person," Xi Ying nodded.
"Do you intend to take this opportunity to kill him here?" Understanding Xi Ying's intention, Yuan Ming asked.
"If we miss this opportunity and the Six Desires Venerable retreats to his lair, it will be difficult to find another chance. Will you help me?" Xi Ying looked at Yuan Ming and said.
"Of course, I'll lend you a hand, but the Six Desires Venerable is formidable. I am currently only at the Love Witch Realm, and although I can temporarily elevate my soul power to the Sleep Witch Realm with the Stealing Heaven Tripod, I am still far behind him," Yuan Ming spoke slowly.
"No worries, I have my ways to deal with him. Moreover, in the cave mansion, we're not the only ones who want his life," Xi Ying revealed a fleeting hint of joy, which then disappeared as she spoke.
"Are you referring to the Shura Master? But he only left a residual soul in the All Living Beings' Dream. If he truly had the capability, he should have subdued Six Desires when he entered the formation for trials," Yuan Ming commented with concern.

chapters.title: Chapter 428 - 405: Oath of Dao Heart
chapters.content:
"You should not worry about this matter, arrangements have already been made," Xi Ying said.
"I understand," Yuan Ming replied, nodding, though a trace of unusual color flashed in his eyes.
"Is there anything else you want to ask? Why hesitate in front of me? Just ask directly," Xi Ying said, giving Yuan Ming a glance.
"With such a thorough understanding of the Wuyue Sect, could it be that you are also a member?" Yuan Ming gave a wry smile but did not hesitate further as he asked.
Upon hearing this, Xi Ying fell silent for a moment before saying, "If I said I am not, would you believe me?"
"I've heard that the Wuyue Sect is the origin of all Soul Cultivators on the Yunhuang Continent. Since I have embarked on the path of Soul Cultivation, naturally, I do not view the Wuyue Sect with the same hostility as the Central Plains Immortal Cultivation Sects. However, what exactly is your position within the Wuyue Sect? Knowing so many secrets, yet planning to kill a Venerable within the sect? This act is tantamount to betrayal. You should have considered the consequences, right?" Yuan Ming said, looking into Xi Ying's eyes.
A mysterious expression flashed in Xi Ying's eyes, and her lips, hidden under her veil, moved slightly as if she harbored some hesitation.
Just as she was about to speak her mind to Yuan Ming, the stele in the great hall suddenly cracked, and a beam of white light emerged, forming a light gate about ten feet tall and three feet wide in front of them.
"The ins and outs of the matter will be explained after killing the Six Desires Venerable. For now, let's focus on the task at hand," Xi Ying said.
Yuan Ming, knowing Xi Ying was not a person of impulsive actions, nodded and stepped forward to examine the situation, only to find that the white light gate was enveloped by a forbidden barrier, rendering him unable to touch or probe it with his Divine Sense.
At that moment, he suddenly recalled the Spirit Talisman given to him by the Shura Master, which had the ability to control some of the forbiddances within the Shura Palace. Perhaps it could also remove the forbiddance outside the light gate.
With this thought, he immediately communicated with the Spirit Talisman at his brow with his mind, attempting to unlock the forbiddance outside the light gate.
Meanwhile, behind him, Xi Ying quickly made a silly face at Yuan Ming, though her mood seemed much improved from before.
Engrossed in breaking the forbiddance, Yuan Ming did not notice Xi Ying's small gesture.

Soon, with his efforts, a crisp "bang" sounded, and the forbiddance outside the light gate dissipated into spirit light.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming was immediately overjoyed. He stepped forward, pushed open the light gate, and entered through it with Xi Ying.
Behind the light gate was another great hall, its structure very similar to the second and third layers of the Black Tower.
"Is this the Fourth Layer?"
Yuan Ming pondered with some doubt, looking around only to find no treasures but a blue stele standing in the center of the hall.
The stele, about five feet tall, had three ancient blood-red characters inscribed on it. Yuan Ming, who had been well-read even as a mortal and had studied ancient texts, recognized them immediately as "Shura Palace."
Although not runes, a shimmering spirit light subtly flickered over these characters, imbuing them with a touch of Spiritual Charm.
"What is this?" Yuan Ming curiously examined the stele, suddenly feeling a warmth in his brow as the blood-red Spirit Talisman on his forehead, resembling an eye, shone a beam of spirit light directly onto the stele.
"It seems this is the core of the Shura Palace's forbiddance, excellent. Before they return, you should quickly refine it. This will give us a greater advantage against the Six Desires," Xi Ying said with a flick of her finger on the stele, a white light emanating from her fingertip as her eyes brightened.
Upon hearing her words, Yuan Ming was momentarily startled, then nodded in agreement.
He immediately focused his mind on the Spirit Talisman on his brow. The light emanating from the talisman intensified and touched the forbiddance within the stele.
At that moment, Yuan Ming's vision blurred, and he found himself in a mysterious space.
This space was only about ten feet in size, surrounded by pure white in all directions, except for the direction Yuan Ming faced, where a painting hung. In it, a black-clad Shura Master was portrayed with his back to Yuan Ming, seemingly gazing at the tranquil sea before him.
Yuan Ming was observing the painting curiously when suddenly a warmth surged in his brow and a red light shot from the blood-colored Spirit Talisman, entering the painting in an instant.
Then, to Yuan Ming's surprise, the figure in the painting turned around and met his gaze.
"I didn't expect you to be the first to reach the Shura Stone Tablet. Did you manage to obtain the Shura Blood Devouring Map?" the Shura Master asked, scrutinizing Yuan Ming with a smile.
"I regret to disappoint you, Venerable. Although I have your bestowed Spirit Talisman, my limited abilities prevented me from securing the Shura Blood Devouring Map; it fell into the hands of another," Yuan Ming said with a wry smile.
"Who obtained this treasure?" the Shura Master asked, a slight movement in his brows.
"The Six Desires Venerable," Yuan Ming replied.
"So it's really him..." The expression on the Shura Master's face did not change much, and after a brief silence, he murmured to himself.
"Venerable, are you aware that the Six Desires Venerable has entered the Shura Palace?" Yuan Ming asked.
"Although he had switched bodies and his Mana was completely different from before, he couldn't hide the aura of his Divine Soul, which I naturally recognized," the Shura Master said.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming was on the verge of speaking but stopped himself.
"You want to ask why I didn't take the opportunity to kill the Six Desires Venerable during the test in the All Living Beings' Dream?" the Shura Master seemed to see through what Yuan Ming was thinking.
"Junior indeed has this doubt," Yuan Ming admitted honestly.
"There are two reasons. First, I am now only a Residual Soul, and even though I can control the prohibitions of the Shura Palace, I am still not powerful enough to kill the Six Desires Venerable," the Shura Master explained.
"What's the second reason?" Yuan Ming agreed and asked.
"The second reason is related to what I am about to discuss with you!" the Shura Master said.
Yuan Ming quietly waited for him to continue.
"You being the first to arrive here has already proven your fortunate opportunity, allowing you to take most of the treasures in the palace. However, to truly inherit the entirety of the Shura Palace, you need to prove your conviction and strength to me!" the Shura Master said, his expression growing stern.
"What does Senior mean?" Yuan Ming asked, puzzled.
"After I reached the Returning Void Stage, I explored the Overseas World many times. Though I ultimately lost my life because of it, my desire to explore the Overseas World did not diminish. If you wish to inherit the Shura Palace, you must vow here with your heart, that if you reach the Returning Void Stage, you will take it upon yourself to explore the Overseas World until death," the Shura Master declared.
Yuan Ming's eyes gleamed. The Shura Master's obsession with the Overseas World was profound and almost maddening.
Nevertheless, Yuan Ming himself was greatly interested in the Overseas World. The Spiritual Energy of the Yunhuang Continent was limited; even if the Shura Master made no such demand, he would still go to the Overseas to find new lands once he broke through to the Returning Void Stage.
"Junior Yuan Ming, with my heart, I vow…" Yuan Ming looked at the Shura Master, his gaze unwavering.
After listening to Yuan Ming's vow, the Shura Master nodded in satisfaction and spoke again, "As for proving your strength, you need to help me kill someone, and that person is the Six Desires Venerable!"
Yuan Ming was not surprised by this; the Six Desires Venerable was a great enemy of the Shura Master in life. Now inside the Shura Palace, the Shura Master naturally could not allow him to leave alive, while also testing the capabilities of his successor.
"The Six Desires Venerable took away the Shura Blood Devouring Map. Even if Senior did not demand it, I must retrieve this map!" he declared firmly.
"Very well, then let me explain carefully about the inheritance of the Shura Palace, which is mainly divided into three parts. The first is the Shura Blood Devouring Map, which needs to be retrieved from the Six Desires Venerable; the second is 'All Living Beings' Dream,' a Divine Skill I created using Overseas runes combined with a lifetime of study in Illusion Techniques, which has many marvelous uses; the third is this Shura Palace Mansion itself," the Shura Master explained.
Yuan Ming felt a surge of excitement upon hearing this.
He already knew of the wonders of the Shura Blood Devouring Map; he had also experienced the power of the All Living Beings' Dream Divine Skill during the previous trial, knowing if he could master this Divine Skill, he would possess a potent Illusion Technique.
As for the Shura Palace Mansion itself, with its vast area, possessing it would greatly benefit his future cultivation.
"How do you find this mansion?" the Shura Master asked.
"Senior's Shura Palace has opened my eyes. Such a simple mansion contains such vast internal space. Senior's expertise in Formation is truly admirable! It's a pity that I am not well-versed in the way of Formations; otherwise, I would learn this set of space-expanding Formation at any cost," Yuan Ming praised sincerely.
"Young friend, you flatter me. Creating a small space with the power of Formations is within my ability, but to open such a vast space is not something a Cultivator in the Returning Void Stage can achieve," the Shura Master said, shaking his head.
"Then how did such a vast space come to be within the Shura Palace?" Yuan Ming asked, surprised.
"The space of the Shura Palace was derived from an artifact, which I happened to come across on my third expedition overseas. It possesses the superpower to open up spaces, and I call it the Void Stone," the Shura Master said, raising his palm. A silver-white stone as large as a human head materialized as a phantom in his palm.
"This item appears ordinary, yet it can open up the void," Yuan Ming remarked in amazement, looking at the phantom of the silver stone.
"The Overseas World not only harbors dangers but also infinite treasures. Many parts of this Shura Palace are constructed from Overseas spiritual materials," the Shura Master explained.
Yuan Ming felt a slight stir in his heart upon hearing this.
The Shura Master explaining the situation of the Shura Palace was probably deliberately directing the conversation towards the Overseas to spark his desire to explore there.
"The Shura Stone Tablet contains all the prohibitions of the Immortal Mansion, and it is a unique method I refined which can only be refined using a special Sacrificial Refining Method. The secret technique is in the scroll that I am currently in. It's my final aid to you, after which whether or not you can kill the Six Desires Venerable and obtain the inheritance of the Shura Palace will depend on your methods," the Shura Master finished speaking. Suddenly, flames rose from the bottom of the scroll, quickly burning it into a void of Spirit Fog, which then immediately surged into Yuan Ming's Divine Soul, transforming into a mnemonic.
The next moment, Yuan Ming left the pure white space and returned outside the Stele.
Xi Ying was still in the same state as before, seemingly unaware of anything strange.
Yuan Ming composed himself; due to the urgency of time, he didn't reveal what had just happened to Xi Ying, silently reviewing the complicated refining secret technique that had appeared in his mind.
This refining method was much more complex than ordinary Sacrificial Refining Methods, but Yuan Ming's current cultivation and insight were unparalleled compared to before. He quickly grasped it and immediately began to refine the Stele.

chapters.title: Chapter 429 - 406 Breakthrough
chapters.content:
Although he had obtained the Secret Technique, the multitude of runes on the stele made refining it no easy task.
However, whenever Yuan Ming channeled the spell, a blood-colored spirit talisman at the center of his brow would always emit a beam of spirit light, covering the runes on the stele and greatly accelerating Yuan Ming's refining speed.
In just a short amount of time, he had already mastered control over ten percent of the Shura Palace's restrictions and even gained the ability to observe the situation throughout the Shura Palace.
He was secretly pleased, and while he intensified his refining efforts, he also allocated part of his Divine Thought to explore the Six Desires Venerable's circumstances through the restrictions he had cracked.
Soon, the blood-colored ancient text on the stele gradually faded away, replaced by an extremely clear image.
In the image, the Six Desires Venerable led the way, followed by Dugu Feng, Thunderbolt Ancestor, and Golden Dawn Fairy. The red-clothed woman and the blood-colored skull were nowhere to be seen, leaving only the Shura Blood Devouring Map floating beside the Six Desires Venerable.
Seeing that Thunderbolt Ancestor and others had been recaptured by the Six Desires, and realizing that they seemed to be flying towards the Black Tower, Yuan Ming couldn't help feeling anxious. With a shift of his Divine Thought, he activated the Shura Palace's restrictions he controlled.
...
In midair, the rapidly flying Six Desires Venerable suddenly stopped his tunneling light and frowned, looking up ahead.
A white fog of unknown origin suddenly began to spread before his eyes. The speed was not fast, but when his released Divine Sense made contact with the fog, he would feel a slight resistance that hindered the exploration of his Divine Sense.
Although this resistance was not yet enough to shield his Divine Sense, as the fog spread, the resistance gradually became stronger, and it might not be long before it could genuinely affect the Six Desires Venerable's Divine Sense.
Realizing this, the Six Desires Venerable immediately transmitted a message to Dugu Feng and others, urging them to increase their tunneling speed.
In response to his request, Dugu Feng and the others dared not neglect their efforts and hastened their flying escape, trying to leave this place before being completely swallowed by the fog.
However, barely fifteen minutes had passed when they noticed something was not right.
"Venerable, this place—we seem to have passed here just now," said Dugu Feng, looking at the hazy scenery shrouded by the fog at his feet with a tone of uncertainty.
"Keep going," the Six Desires Venerable ordered coldly, not replying.
Dugu Feng nodded, and the group set off again. Another thirty minutes passed, but they still had not walked out of the fog.
By now, the pale white fog had turned milky white and even swallowed up everything around it.
The Six Desires Venerable stopped his flying escape again, his gaze on the sky above as he forcefully extended his Divine Sense against the pressure, but he could only make out the vague shadows of mountains and stones.
Since the appearance of the white fog, they had passed through this place four times. Each time they left, the Six Desires Venerable chose a different direction, but in the end, they still returned to this spot.
Even more bizarre was the fact that they had unwittingly turned upside down without realizing it; they were now floating in the air with their feet towards the sky. If he had not used his Divine Sense to detect this anomaly, they might not have noticed anything out of the ordinary at all.
As he pondered, the surrounding fog became increasingly thick, to the point where the Six Desires Venerable could see a layer of mist enveloping his hand like sheer silk when he reached out, as if dipping into river water.
Behind him, Thunderbolt Ancestor and Golden Dawn Fairy, who were farther away, had disappeared without a trace, and even the figure of Dugu Feng began to look blurry, while the Shura Blood Devouring Map floating beside him remained unaffected.
"What exactly is the nature of this White Mist Restriction?" the Six Desires Venerable asked the Shura Blood Devouring Map Artifact Spirit beside him.
"What new tricks could that old thing of the Shura Master come up with? It's still the same old trick of confusing the five senses. You just need to keep releasing Divine Sense as a guiding object without stopping, and you can easily walk out from here," the Artifact Spirit answered nonchalantly.
Upon hearing these words, the Six Desires Venerable nodded silently.
For some reason, he was exceptionally reserved and restrained at this moment, and after hearing the Artifact Spirit's reply, he did not even bother to confirm its trustworthiness before he began to try it out.
But quickly, when the concentration of the fog reached a certain limit and stopped intensifying, it started to show some new changes instead.
And it was at this moment that the Six Desires Venerable suddenly felt an inexplicable sense of fatigue wash over him. A faint sleepiness crept up into his mind; although he immediately suppressed it, it made him realize that something was amiss.
Sleepiness and drowsiness are ultimately the external expressions of Divine Soul exhaustion. As a Soul Cultivator who hadn't expended much Soul Power, how could he feel sleepy?
He frowned, as if realizing something, immediately withdrew his Divine Sense, and after waiting for a moment, finding no more sensation of drowsiness arising, he confined a wisp of the fog with his Mana and studied it closely for a while before understanding.
This fog enveloping the surroundings was a special kind of Spiritual Energy fog. Once a cultivator's Divine Sense made contact with it, sleepiness would arise unnoticed. Nascent Soul cultivators like them were still manageable, but ordinary Core Formation cultivators might truly fall into deep sleep within the mist, never to awaken unless the fog dissipated.
"You dare to deceive me!"
The discovery of the mystery behind the fog filled the Six Desires Venerable with rage, and his eyes, burning with fury, glared viciously at the Shura Blood Devouring Map. His expression was completely different from his earlier reserved demeanor, now appearing as if he might tear the Blood Devouring Map to shreds.
Although the Shura Blood Devouring Map Artifact Spirit didn't know why the Six Desires Venerable's emotions had changed so drastically, seeing his angry face, it couldn't help but let out a laugh:
"Haha, how exactly do you cultivate that you believe whatever I say? No wonder you couldn't beat that old fogey, the Shura Master. Turns out you've got a problem in the head!"
Upon hearing the four words "Shura Master," the Six Desires Venerable's expression changed once again; the anger on his face faded, replaced by a chilling indifference.
Wordlessly, he flicked his finger at the Blood Devouring Map, and a thread of Soul Power shot out from his fingertip, striking the Artifact Spirit of the Map.
The Artifact Spirit, in the midst of its loud derision, was suddenly struck by the spirit light; its boisterous laughter abruptly ceased.
It was horrified to find that it had lost all perception of the outside world, as if it had been shut in a pitch-black box, where complete darkness prevailed and no other object existed.
The Artifact Spirit looked around in shock, trying to speak, but found it couldn't make any sound.
The utter silence around it was frightening; the boundless darkness and absolute quietness gave even this eons-old Artifact Spirit a hint of chill at the bottom of its heart.
It tried to call out the Blood-colored Skull and the red-clothed woman from the Blood Devouring Map for a conversation, but its Divine Thought fell on the Map and was completely lost, without eliciting any response.
The Artifact Spirit was getting afraid. Having existed for endless years, its desire for external things had been reduced to the simplest form, yet it still harbored desires unique to itself.
As a Spiritual Treasure, it had a high starting point, but unlike Cultivators, it lacked the possibility of further progress; it was predestined to be controlled by others. Although it was unwilling, it did not entirely reject this fate.
After all, what it yearned for as freedom, what it aspired to as life, was nothing but to be pursued by the masses and worshipped by the people; even its master would treat it as a companion, or even a senior, showing it respect.
Honestly, it was quite satisfied with the Shura Master—if it hadn't been sealed in the Shura Palace.
And now, trapped by the Six Desires in such a place without a glimpse of daylight, unable to speak or see, with all its myriad thoughts reduced to nothing, how could it not be afraid?
But in its heart, it still held onto a sliver of hope. The Six Desires Venerable had captured it not just to seal it; the lesson was temporary, it believed. As long as it was patient enough, it would soon be able to leave this place.
With this in mind, it waited, and a "hundred years" passed.
After flicking out the Soul Power, the Six Desires Venerable barely waited for a moment before he casually released the illusion.
However, the Artifact Spirit, which had just been booming with laughter, was now as inert as a piece of wood, devoid of any reaction.
The Six Desires Venerable's brow furrowed slightly, realizing the problem.
Though the Blood Devouring Map was a Spiritual Treasure, the Divine Soul strength of its Artifact Spirit was far inferior to that of a Returning to Void Cultivator, even falling short of an ordinary Nascent Soul cultivator's level.
The illusion he had just woven was intended to make the Artifact Spirit spend a year in darkness. He hadn't expected to overdo it, leaving it stupefied for too long, affecting its mental state as well.
Still, even a momentary oversight was highly unusual for a Soul Cultivator of his level.
The Six Desires Venerable recalled the shifts in his own emotions just now and suddenly understood—the white mist's effect on the Divine Soul was more severe than he had anticipated.
As he pondered, he channeled another thread of Soul Power, beginning to repair the Divine Soul of the Artifact Spirit.
The Artifact Spirit, supplemented by Soul Power, revived like a traveler in the desert receiving sweet dew, and instantly snapped out of its daze.
However, it then recalled the "hundred years" it had just endured and, shivering with fear, promptly extended a Divine Thought towards the Six Desires Venerable in submission.Th$i$s! c-op$y was gen-era$t&ed fr.o#m* c+o*nt$ent& at *.
In the illusion, the passage of time became incredibly clear and slow. Unable to cultivate or voluntarily fall into slumber, it could do nothing but watch helplessly as it suffered through a century in utter silence.
No normal Cultivator could withstand such torment, and this was just an Artifact Spirit.
Seeing that his intimidation had been effective, the Six Desires Venerable chose not to mention his minor mistake, maintaining an indifferent facade.
"Now, are you ready to tell the truth? Exactly how do we leave the White Mist Restriction?" he asked slowly.
"There are two common methods of breaking it, but with me here, I can guide you," the Artifact Spirit replied respectfully.
"Unless you want to experience what just happened all over again, don't try to be sneaky with me," the cold light flashed in the eyes of the Six Desires Venerable.
"Please spare me, master. I... no, Little Luo, Little Luo won't dare anymore," the Artifact Spirit spoke in a panicked tone.
The Six Desires Venerable nodded and ordered it to lead the way. At the same time, he reached out to the Thunderbolt Ancestor and others through soul leeches, telling them to keep close.
The white mist affected the performance of the Divine Sense, but couldn't block the connection between the Six Desires Venerable and the soul leeches. It was precisely due to this that Lei Ming and the Golden Dawn Fairy did not take advantage of the mist to scatter and flee.
With the Artifact Spirit guiding the way, they soon left the area covered by the White Mist Restriction and returned in front of the Black Tower.

chapters.title: Chapter 430 - 407: Undercurrents Surge
chapters.content:
Meanwhile, a sudden void fluctuation appeared in the distance near the Black Tower, and with it, an Array materialized, from which three figures emerged. It was the three siblings of Wu Yuezhi.
As soon as they appeared, they were surrounded by a vast expanse of white fog, having no clue about directions, let alone discerning a path.
"Big brother, this fog blocks out Divine Sense. Could it be another Forbidden seal? All the troubles we've encountered along the way, that person's messages were either incorrect or omitted, could he be deceiving us?" Wu Yuezhi complained.
In the face of the dense fog, even the man in the cyan robe frowned slightly, but at that moment, his expression changed and he produced a talisman emitting a blue light from his hand.
"It's me. I can already see you. The fog's Forbidden seal nearby was opened by my orders. Continue following the guidance of the positioning Magic Artifact I gave you earlier and you will find the Black Tower," the voice of Xi Ying came from the Jade Scroll.
Upon hearing this, the cyan-robed man's eyebrows raised, "You can already control the Forbidden seals here?"
"Heh, if I didn't have at least this much ability, how would I dare to move against the Six Desires?" Xi Ying chuckled in the Jade Scroll.
"Hmph, I advise you not to underestimate the Six Desires. Relying on mere lifeless objects will only be a slight nuisance to him, not really an obstacle," the cyan-robed man warned coldly.
"I'm well aware of that, Ni Mu. You just need to stick to our agreement and handle your part. Don't worry about anything else," Xi Ying responded unhurriedly.
"That's fine. But let me make myself clear, I'll only move when the opportunity arises. If I don't see you having a sure chance of victory, even for the Spirit God Pill, I won't rashly move against the Six Desires," said Ni Mu, the man in the cyan robe.
"Understood."
No sooner had Xi Ying's voice faded than the talisman in Ni Mu's hand lost its glow and turned to ash that fell to the ground.
"Big brother, the voice of that person sounded quite young. Does he really have the strength to help us eliminate the Six Desires?" Wu Yuezhi immediately asked.
This was also his first time hearing the voice of the messenger. Before, they relied only on Ni Mu's retelling. They did not know much about the true identity and origin of the messenger.
"Heh, being young doesn't mean weak. You should know, she is the Xi Family's most outstanding prodigy of the last millennium. It took her less than two hundred years to step into the Nascent Soul realm. Speaking of strength, in the entire Xi Family, probably only her father can surpass her. If not for her lack of seniority, I might even have to address her as Venerable by now," Ni Mu said, shaking his head.
"I see. But no matter how powerful she is, in the end, she is just a naive girl. After we kill the Six Desires this time, and you break through to Late-stage Nascent Soul with the help of the Spirit God Pill, your status within the Sect will surely rise, and it's likely she'll have to address you as Venerable first," Wu Yuezhi chuckled.
Ni Mu nodded slightly, noncommittally, his face showing little reaction, but the flicker of light in his eyes betrayed his feelings.
"Alright, we have delayed long enough. Let's go meet the Six Desires. If we miss this chance, that old fox might again disappear without a trace," Ni Mu said, taking out the positioning Magic Artifact that Xi Ying had given them in advance.
Wu Yuezhi and the glamorous young lady agreed in unison, and then the three set off once more, groping their way through the fog toward the Black Tower.
At the same time, on the Fourth Level of the Black Tower, Yuan Ming's main soul was still ceaselessly refining the Stele, while his split soul was conversing with Xi Ying.
"Are they the helpers you mentioned? Three Core Formation Stage cultivators, can they really stand against Venerable Six Desires?" Yuan Ming wondered aloud.
He had sensed their arrival through the Forbidden seals he controlled and projected their images onto the Stele as soon as the siblings of Ni Mu appeared.
Xi Ying had seen this scene, too, which is why she used the Sound Transmission Talisman to get in touch with Ni Mu.
"It's just a cover. The one leading them, Ni Mu, is at the Peak of Middle-stage Nascent Soul, a step away from advancing to the later stage. As for his two Core Formation siblings, anyone who can call a mid-stage Nascent Soul their peer must have some skills up their sleeve," Xi Ying explained offhandedly as she let go of the disintegrated Sound Transmission Talisman.
"As long as you have a clear idea, but can they really be trusted? Don't let them end up being the helpers of the Six Desires," Yuan Ming said, somewhat worried.
"I don't know about others, but this Ni Mu might want to kill the Six Desires even more than I do," Xi Ying admitted.
"Why is that? Does he have a grudge against the Six Desires as well?" asked Yuan Ming, curious.
"Ni Mu is also a follower of the Wuyue Sect. He was exceptionally talented from a young age and has been in the Nascent Soul realm for quite some time now. Due to his background, however, he has always been unable to rise in status within the Sect. Furthermore, Venerable Six Desires has coveted his robust physical body and has been suppressing him overtly and covertly, restricting his Cultivation increase to keep him under control. Over time, Ni Mu has become resentful and realized that without killing the Six Desires, not only will he never have a day of prominence, but becoming the next physical vessel for Venerable Six Desires is just a matter of time," Xi Ying explained.
Having heard this, Yuan Ming understood, and seeing Xi Ying's confident manner, he said no more and continued diligently refining the Stele.
At this moment, the image on the Stele shifted back to the situation with the Venerable Six Desires. Seeing that they had arrived at the Black Tower, guided by the Artifact Spirit, Yuan Ming pondered for a moment and then connected with the split soul inside Yan Sijing's body.
"The Thunderbolt Ancestor and his group will return soon. You quickly come to the Third Level and use the Light Gate to come to me. Don't let them detect you."
On the second floor of the Black Tower, upon praying, Yan Sijing was startled, then hastily rose to her feet and returned to the third level of the high tower. She passed through the Light Gate which Yuan Ming had opened especially for her and arrived in front of Yuan Ming and Xi Ying.
When Xi Ying saw Yan Sijing come over, she was somewhat displeased, but seeing the Six Desires and others return, she knew the gravity of the situation and therefore didn't speak further.
"I need to concentrate on refining the Forbidden, and won't be able to attend to you for the moment. Take this Spiritual Beast Bag and keep it safe. When necessary, my two spirit beasts will lend you a hand. In addition, in times of danger, don't forget to pray to the Nether Moon God," Yuan Ming said as he tossed the Spiritual Beast Bag, which contained Hua Zhi and Vajra, to her.
Find this chapter's source on *.
Yan Sijing, upon seeing the images displayed on the stele, was immediately surprised, but hearing Yuan Ming's hurried tone, she didn't ask further and obediently nodded. She received the Spiritual Beast Bag and then stood to one side.
...
At this moment, the Six Desires Venerable and others, through the large hole they had previously broken through, directly returned to the third level of the Black Tower.
However, the place was already devoid of people, neither Xi Ying nor Yan Sijing, who had been left behind earlier, could be seen, and the previously active stone platform had returned to calm.
Dugu Feng was immediately puzzled, while the Thunderbolt Ancestor furrowed his brow even more.
"Odd, where did Yan Sijing go?" Thunderbolt Ancestor released his Divine Sense and began to search for her whereabouts.
However, he searched the entire Black Tower and, except for the yet unappeared fourth level, could not find any trace of Yan Sijing at all.
In front of him, the Six Desires Venerable had completed his Divine Sense search a step ahead of him. In his originally tranquil eyes, a flicker of irritability suddenly emerged.
"How do we get to the fourth level, speak quickly!" He looked at the Shura Blood Devouring Map, his tone brimming with indisputable urgency.
"Master, although I am sealed here by the old Shura scoundrel, the Forbidden Light Gate that leads to the fourth level is not under my control. I only know it is hidden in the stone platform, but I truly don't know how to open it," the Artifact Spirit said hastily, afraid the Six Desires Venerable wouldn't believe him.
Upon hearing this, the brows of the Six Desires Venerable slightly wrinkled. He suddenly raised his hand, took out the Black Key, and after spurring it with a spell, moved it close to the stone platform.
Just then, a faint resistance emanated from the stone platform, repelling the approaching Black Key.
A flicker of unease crossed the mind of the Six Desires Venerable. His thoughts turned, and he was about to continue employing his methods.
But suddenly, several swooshing sounds came from behind them, and the Six Desires Venerable immediately turned his head to look, only to see three tunneling lights landing at the hole in the third layer of the Black Tower.
The gaze of the Six Desires Venerable swept over the three individuals, finally settling on the figure at the forefront, Ni Mu.
"Ni Mu, wasn't your Dawn Alliance instructed to focus on the matters of the East Sea? As the Alliance Hierarch, what are you doing here?" the Six Desires Venerable asked with furrowed brows.
"Respected Venerable, not long ago, a scout from our alliance reported that a cultivator who had been to the East Sea Three Islands was spotted here. I came to investigate and, by chance, heard of the emergence of an Immortal Mansion. I wanted to share in the opportunity, but I didn't expect it to be an opportunity eyed by the Venerable. I will take my leave now," the man in the green robe known as Ni Mu revealed a hint of surprise upon seeing the Six Desires Venerable and immediately apologized with a salute.
Saying this, he gestured with his hand to the Six Desires Venerable and, taking Wu Yuezhi and the other two, turned to leave.
"Wait, since you're here, no need to run around again. I just so happen to need some help as well, so you will stay at my side," the Six Desires Venerable said, with a flash of cold light in his eyes, suddenly stopping the three of them.
"I dare not disobey," Ni Mu said, halting his steps and showing a conflicted expression. Ultimately, he let out a deep sigh, turned, and bowed to the Six Desires Venerable, then flew back to him.
"The Shura Master's Cave Mansion is full of manifold prohibitions. To prevent losing contact, take this soul leech. Once we're out, I shall remove it myself," the Six Desires Venerable flicked his finger, and a silver-light soul leech immediately flew towards Ni Mu.
"Yes, Venerable," Ni Mu took a deep breath, forcibly repressing his aversion and allowed the soul leech to merge into his body.
The Six Desires Venerable confirmed that the soul leech had attached to Ni Mu's Nascent Soul and then redirected his attention to the stone platform before him. As for Wu Yuezhi and the other individual who followed Ni Mu, naturally, he didn't even grant them a glance.
He once again spurred the Black Key, directing it towards the stone platform. He raised a hand and sent out two silver soul leeches.
As the Black Key neared, the repelling force from the stone platform surfaced again, but although this force secluded the key, it did not stop the silver soul leeches.
In the blink of an eye, the soul leeches penetrated the stone platform. After a heart-palpitating gnawing sound, the repelling force from the platform suddenly vanished, and the Black Key merged into it as if it were flying.
Subsequently, the stone platform broke apart once more with a "crack," and a white Light Gate bored out from it, landing directly in front of the Six Desires Venerable.

chapters.title: Chapter 431 - 408 Divided into Three Paths
chapters.content:
In the Black Tower's fourth level space, Xi Ying saw through the green stele the scene of the Six Desires Venerable breaking open the stone platform with a soul leech, and her brows immediately tightened.
"Not good, Six Desires has actually trained the soul leech to the point where it can parasitize arrays! They're going to come in, Yuan Ming, you better hide quickly!" Xi Ying hurriedly spoke.
Yuan Ming closed his eyes and said nothing, as if he hadn't heard at all, his hands moving quickly to form seals, and in the final moments, he activated the Black Tower's forbidden mechanism that he had already mastered.
In an instant, bright white light burst forth from the green stele, engulfing the entire fourth level space in a sea of light in a single breath.
At almost the same time, the Six Desires Venerable pushed open the white light gate and stepped in first, leading everyone to the fourth level of the Black Tower.
As soon as he entered, he saw in the vast hall only Xi Ying and Yan Sijing standing with puzzled faces, apart from them, there was nothing else.
Seeing this, the Six Desires Venerable immediately released his Divine Sense to search the surroundings but failed to find anything that could control the Shura Palace's prohibitions.
"Why are you two here? Have you found the core of the Shura Palace's prohibitions?" the Six Desires Venerable's gaze swept toward Xi Ying and Yan Sijing, finally settling on Xi Ying as he asked.
Upon hearing Six Desires Venerable's question, Xi Ying feigned surprise, stealthily glancing at Dugu Feng standing behind Six Desires, then looked doubtfully at the three new figures of Ni Mu and his party that had appeared behind them, seemingly hesitant.
"This is the Six Desires Venerable, the true master of our alliance. Whatever he asks you, you answer, no hemming and hawing!" Dugu Feng immediately scolded.
"Yes, I know my mistake." Xi Ying pretended to be panicked as she lowered her head, then began to speak in detail.
"Venerable, previously I was investigating the anomaly of the stone platform on the third level according to the Alliance Hierarch's command, when suddenly a white light gate appeared, sucking both her and me in. However, when we arrived here, there was nothing at all. Although I searched several times, my strength is too weak to assert whether the core is here or not," Xi Ying steadied herself and immediately answered fluently.
At her side, Yan Sijing also kept her head low, looking frightened, not daring to meet Six Desires Venerable's gaze.
Hearing Xi Ying's words, the Six Desires Venerable nodded without expression, neither confirming nor denying that he believed her.
Seeing this, Dugu Feng spoke, "Venerable, I think this place might..."
He hadn't finished speaking when suddenly a large expanse of white light emerged before everyone, obscuring their vision.
In less than a breath, the white light disappeared as suddenly as it had appeared, restoring everyone's vision, only to find themselves on a vast, verdant prairie.
The sky was a clear blue, without a cloud in sight, and a gentle breeze swept across the grassland, raising the rustling sound of the grass colliding.
Not far away, three man-high steles stood erect, with a differently colored path beside each, leading to three strange places.
On each stele, three strong and forceful characters were engraved.
The one on the far left read "Cold Martial Realm," the winding path covered with snow and frost, looking towards the end of the road, one could faintly see a mountain shrouded in blizzard.
The middle one was called "Extreme Fire Realm," the path leading straight ahead was filled with pits and potholes brimming with magma, and at the end of the road, a wide pit spewed out flames like flood dragons reaching for the sky.
The one on the far right was the "Netherworld," the somber gray path was shrouded in Yin Qi, and deep within the road, a dense black mist that didn't dissipate swallowed everything, making it impossible to see the specifics at the end of the path.
Seeing such changes, everyone couldn't help but show surprised expressions, and Dugu Feng also realized what was happening and continued from where he left off:
"Venerable, this might just be the last trial set by Shura Master, the core of the Shura Palace's prohibitions might be at one of these places."
The Six Desires Venerable did not express his position but turned his head to look at the Shura Blood Devouring Map.
"This... I was already sealed when Shura bastard built the fourth level, I only know the core is above, anything else I truly don't know, master," the Artifact Spirit hesitated, then quickly explained after realizing what the Six Desires Venerable meant.
"Let's all take a look then, choose a path each, if any discovery is made, just activate the soul leech and call my name," Six Desires Venerable nodded slightly, making a decision.
"Yes," Dugu Feng and the others responded in unison.
"Ni Mu, you three go ahead and scout the Cold Martial Realm, I will cover you from behind," seeing this, the Six Desires Venerable turned his head and glanced at Ni Mu and his group, pointing to the snow-covered winding path.
"Yes, Venerable," Ni Mu seemed somewhat reluctant but could not help but lead Wu Yuezhi and the other one onto the path, scouting for Six Desires Venerable.
Subsequently, the Six Desires Venerable trailed them at a distance as he too made his way towards the Cold Martial Realm.
Seeing this, Dugu Feng also gestured with his hand and led Xi Ying onto the road heading to the Extreme Fire Realm.
Thunderbolt Ancestor glanced at the retreating figures and thought of the soul leech swirling within his Sea of Consciousness. His expression grew even grimmer.
"Yan Sijing, come with me," he said in a muffled voice.
At his words, a tense look crossed Yan Sijing's face, and she reluctantly followed Thunderbolt Ancestor's footsteps towards the remaining part of the Netherworld.
Just then, Yan Sijing heard a sigh and turned her head in confusion, only to see that Golden Dawn Fairy had also followed.
"Jin Xi, what are you following for?" Thunderbolt Ancestor noticed the situation behind him and spoke in displeasure.
"Fellow Daoist Yu, we are now in the same boat. If not with you, should I stay with that Dugu Feng instead?" Golden Dawn Fairy shook her head.
"Hmph, suit yourself. Just don't hold me back," Thunderbolt Ancestor grunted unhappily and said no more.
...
An hour later, in the Netherworld.
They say you can't judge the difficulty of the road until you travel it, and although the dense Black Mist that enveloped everything didn't seem far, it took Thunderbolt Ancestor and the others a lot of effort when they actually arrived.
As soon as they entered the Black Mist, all three of them felt a chill penetrating their Divine Souls, and gusts of Yin wind howled past, shattering the screams and wails that came from deep within the mist.
However, Thunderbolt Ancestor and Golden Dawn Fairy were both at the Nascent Soul Stage, so naturally, they weren't frightened by such a scene.
Golden Dawn Fairy summoned the Golden Scroll. With a few light taps of her finger, countless golden characters scattered the surrounding fog, clearing space for her.
Thunderbolt Ancestor, even more direct, rubbed his hands together, and the surging thunder light pierced through the fog unrestrained, leaving only the unpleasant smell of something scorched.
Using their own methods, the two advanced through the Netherworld, while Yan Sijing silently followed behind Thunderbolt Ancestor, her head slightly bowed to hide her gaze, her thoughts unknown.
Another half hour passed, and the three had ventured deep inside, but the pitch-black mist around them seemed endless. No matter what methods they used, they couldn't clear it away completely.
Even the path they had taken earlier was resealed by the rolling Black Mist.
Along the way, many ghosts rushed out from the mist. Although none could approach them too closely, as the strength of the ghosts increased, both Thunderbolt Ancestor and Golden Dawn Fairy shifted from an easy handling to a gradual sense of pressure.
But under the pressure of the Six Desires Venerable, they had no choice but to continue meandering through the Black Mist, seeking the core of the Forbidden.
Suddenly, while manipulating her Magic Treasure to disperse the mist, Golden Dawn Fairy heard a sudden pause in the thunder beside her. Turning her head, she saw Thunderbolt Ancestor had stopped his incantations, and a faint red glow flashed in his eyes.
"Fellow Daoist Yu, what's the matter?" Golden Dawn Fairy asked, puzzled.
"It's nothing. Just an old problem flaring up. You continue searching, Jin Xi. I'll take a short rest and catch up with you soon," Thunderbolt Ancestor said and then turned around, using his Mana to sweep up Yan Sijing and flew downwards.H%e#l%p- us c&ontin+ue- by re!ad&i@ng# at the s#o.u#r*c!e:! *.
Seeing this, Golden Dawn Fairy furrowed her brows. She stood in place, conflicted for a moment, before letting out a deep sigh and continued to explore deeper into the Black Mist.
After parting with Golden Dawn Fairy, the red light in Thunderbolt Ancestor's eyes grew stronger and even his breathing became labored.
Yan Sijing, carried by him, immediately realized something. Her face turned slightly pale, but she soon took a deep breath, steadying her heart and silently praying to the Nether Moon God.
The Cultivation Technique that Thunderbolt Ancestor practiced was the famous Thunder Secret Scripture from the Five Thunder Sect. However, years ago, due to his impatience for quick results, he made a mistake during cultivation, damaging his foundation. Ever since then, whenever he used Thunder and Lightning Divine Power for an extended period, the old injury would recur, causing Mana to form lightning arcs that moved erratically through his meridians.
To resolve this issue, Thunderbolt Ancestor had to absorb a woman's Yuan Yin through a Secret Technique of Dual Cultivation when he was afflicted. This was also why he insisted on bringing a Furnace Tripod even when treasure hunting.
Among the three female cultivators he brought, Yan Sijing was the most precious. With her innate Xuanyin Body, she naturally nurtured Ice Core Yin Fire in her Dantian. If she could continue to nourish it until she reached the Late-stage Core Formation, then finally absorb her during Dual Cultivation, not only could her power help heal his old injuries, but it could also advance Thunderbolt Ancestor's Cultivation.
If it were not for the other two female cultivators' demise, Thunderbolt Ancestor really did not want to use Yan Sijing here.
Moreover, for some reason, his old injury had recurred sooner than usual, and he hadn't been able to detect it beforehand. Otherwise, he wouldn't have used so many Thunder Skills in exploring the Black Mist.
But contemplating the cause was too late. His priority was to find a safe place to absorb Yan Sijing to suppress the old injury.
About thirty minutes later, and just as Thunderbolt Ancestor was about to run out of patience, he finally found a natural pit on the ground.
He flew into the pit in a hurry, stretched out his hand to cast a Sealing spell on the entrance, and then, in a frantic rush, grabbed Yan Sijing in front of him, reaching straight for her swollen chest.

chapters.title: Chapter 432 - 409: Defeat Them One by One
chapters.content:
But just as Thunderbolt Ancestor's hand was about to touch Yan Sijing, something unexpected happened!
A dark purple vine shot out suddenly from Yan Sijing's embrace, instantly piercing through Thunderbolt Ancestor's shoulder, who had no defenses up.
Thunderbolt Ancestor lost color in shock and immediately pushed Yan Sijing away. At the same time, he used his palm as a knife, channeling mana to form a shadow of a lightning blade in his palm and slashed down, cutting the vine into two pieces.
However, the severed vine melted into Thunderbolt Ancestor's body in the blink of an eye.
When Thunderbolt Ancestor tried to reach for the severed branch, it had already disappeared without a trace.
Right after, a powerful Curse Power descended, and just like the branch, it merged into Thunderbolt Ancestor's body upon contact.
Thunderbolt Ancestor immediately felt the mana inside his body become extremely chaotic. It exploded like boiling water, wildly rushing through his meridians and Sea of Consciousness. His Nascent Soul suddenly shrank, his skin gradually turned yellow and hardened, and in just a moment, it devolved into a dim Golden Core, as his Divine Soul was abruptly flung out.
Thunderbolt Ancestor spurted out a mouthful of blood, his momentum drastically decreased, and he quickly fell back to the Late-stage Core Formation.
At the same time, within the Stealing Heaven Tripod not far away, Yuan Ming, who was sitting on the Lotus Platform, also let out a muffled groan, and blood slowly flowed from his nose. In his Sea of Consciousness, it was as if a storm had hit, with waves of Soul Power surging higher with each wave. Above it, in the shadow of the Round Moon, Yuan Ming's Divine Soul contorted with pain, and several crisscrossing cracks began to emerge on its surface.
Yuan Ming, realizing the situation in his Sea of Consciousness, hurriedly absorbed the Desire Power flowing from the Lotus Platform, trying to repair his Divine Soul.
When Six Desires Venerable entered the Fourth Level, Yuan Ming immediately used the controlled transmission Forbidden to teleport himself and the core Stele to a different location.
Though this act was out of necessity, it was not without a plan.
The three realms of the Cold Martial Realm were not actually trials but a cultivation ground set by Shura Master. By moving Six Desires Venerable and his group there, Yuan Ming not only led them to believe this was the final trial but also avoided their pressing questions about the core location of the Xi Ying Forbidden, and, it also served to prevent them from acting as a united front.
As a Soul Cultivator, Yuan Ming could share visions with the soul crow, and probably the soul leech of the Six Desires Venerable could see the viewpoints of the possessed as well. Faced with three different paths, scattering to search was undoubtedly the best and most time-saving choice.
The decision of Six Desires Venerable was as Yuan Ming expected, which also meant that Yuan Ming had the opportunity to defeat them one by one.
He took action against Thunderbolt Ancestor first after careful consideration. After all, Yan Sijing had informed him that Thunderbolt Ancestor was already carrying a hidden injury. Among all Nascent Souls, he was undoubtedly the weakest.
However, it was only moments before that Yuan Ming, through soul splitting, had discussed with Yan Sijing how they could separate Thunderbolt Ancestor and Golden Dawn Fairy. Unexpectantly, Thunderbolt Ancestor's old injury recurred, which resulted in him separating from Jin Xi on his own, presenting them with an opportunity.
After Hua Zhi initiated the ambush, Yuan Ming immediately activated the Curse Rune on the Soul Destroying Sword, aiming to weaken Thunderbolt Ancestor.
However, the backlash of the Soul Destroying Sword was already strong, and now, empowered by the Sleep Witch Realm's Soul Power, it unleashed a terrifying power. Yet, the resulting backlash was even more overwhelming.
Despite this, Yuan Ming was temporarily rendered unable to act, but outside the Stealing Heaven Tripod, he still had several helpers.
Just as Thunderbolt Ancestor spat out a mouthful of blood, before he could make sense of what had happened, his cultivation plummeted, and he suddenly showed a look of horror. He promptly spit out his Magic Treasure, the Thunder Seal, but before he could activate it, a figure wielding a long spear—an Ape Demon, appeared next to Yan Sijing, whom he had pushed away.
It was Yuan Ming's spirit beast, Vajra.
As soon as Vajra landed, he stamped on the ground fiercely. With a "boom," he left behind an afterimage, standing above the shattered ground, while his true form suddenly appeared in front of Thunderbolt Ancestor. The long spear in his hand, with its terrifying howling sound, aimed directly for Thunderbolt Ancestor's face.
Thunderbolt Ancestor's heart blared with alarms; he didn't even care to activate his Magic Treasure, and instantly burnt Essence Blood to deploy a Secret Technique, transforming himself into Lei Guang. In a flash, he attempted to escape far beyond the cavern.
However, the Lei Guang had not reached the cavern's exit before it abruptly disappeared, and Thunderbolt Ancestor's body reappeared with several dark purple marks on his face, resembling vines, causing his body to rigidly freeze in mid-air, unable to move even a fingertip.
At this moment, Vajra also rushed over, his speed not much slower than Thunderbolt Ancestor's Lei Guang tunneling speed.
With Vajra's spear thrust forward, a bowl-sized wound abruptly appeared on Thunderbolt Ancestor's chest. At the same time, several Core Formation ghosts suddenly emerged from the ground and pounced on Thunderbolt Ancestor.
After the wail of the Yin Qi, the gleam of the spear flashes, and soon Thunderbolt Ancestor's body quickly became a heap of minced flesh.
Seeing this, Vajra lowered the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear, just about to turn around, but saw a divine soul fly out from the broken flesh like a lightning bolt, taking advantage of the surprise, it circumvented the encircling Core Formation ghosts and headed straight for the exit of the cave.
However, suddenly, a black Sword Shadow descended from the sky, appearing out of nowhere. It was Yuan Ming who had temporarily repaired the cracks in his divine soul and took action again, directly pinning Thunderbolt Ancestor's divine soul to the ground with Soul Destroying Sword Energy.
The Yin Qi around surged forth, forming a hemispherical protective shield outside this divine soul.
"Vajra, the Silver Token," Yuan Ming's voice transmission suddenly reached Vajra's ears.
Upon hearing this, Vajra immediately nodded, waving his hand and throwing out a Silver Token, which formed another silver protective shield under the barrier of Yin Qi.
Meanwhile, in the distant Cold Martial Realm where Six Desires Venerable was observing the battle through a soul leech, his face darkened. He looked up in the direction of the Netherworld, then channeled his Soul Power and made contact with Golden Dawn Fairy who was in the Netherworld.
"Thunderbolt has been killed by his own Furnace Tripod, but the one who really made the move must be someone else. I have sent you the location. Go check it immediately, be cautious. Apart from that Furnace Tripod and the person hiding in the dark, there are two spirit beasts. One is a Vine Demon, whose vines can temporarily control the body, and the other is an Ape Demon, likely a Body Cultivator with an Innate Body. Don't let them get close to you," he ordered coldly.
Through the soul leech, he could sense the status of every parasitized person at any time, so he knew the moment Thunderbolt Ancestor was ambushed. However, he did not expect the assailant to possess so many tricks that could kill Thunderbolt Ancestor in such a short time.
The most crucial point was that the person even held a Token that could completely shield his soul leech's sensing. Now, he could completely no longer see Thunderbolt Ancestor's condition and could only send Golden Dawn Fairy to check on it.
He was not worried about Golden Dawn Fairy also losing her life. If it cost a Nascent Soul to determine the real identity of the assailant, it would not be a loss for him.
What surprised him was that someone was able to hide from his Divine Sense and lurk within Shura Palace.
As Six Desires Venerable pondered the identity of the person behind the scenes, his eyebrows couldn't help but furrow.
On the other side, before the silver protective shield was fully formed, Yuan Ming immediately transmitted his voice to Yan Sijing, telling her to step into the silver protective shield in advance.
"You bastard, you persecuted us sisters. Did you ever think this day would come!" Yan Sijing glared at Thunderbolt Ancestor's divine soul with fierce hatred and scolded angrily.
"Yan Sijing, please, spare me. Think about it, although I imprisoned you sisters, have I ever mistreated you? You were able to reach your current Cultivation because I provided you with a large number of elixirs. Remember these favors and spare my life," the divine soul of Thunderbolt Ancestor pleaded in panic.
"Ha, favors? Would you consider the fodder fed to a lamb waiting for slaughter as a favor? If it weren't for Lord Nether Moon God's help today, would you let me leave this place alive? Those female cultivators who you exhausted, do you think I haven't seen their tragic states!" Yan Sijing laughed coldly.
Seeing the intense hatred in Yan Sijing's eyes, Thunderbolt Ancestor knew his chances of survival were slim and no longer wailed for mercy, instead he began to curse fiercely.
T@h*is v*e&rsion was so$u!rc^e.d fr*om% *.
"You wretched girl! I truly regret not using you earlier! And your blind sister, I should have strung you both up and played with you day and night, and when I grew tired..." Thunderbolt Ancestor kept cursing, his vile and foul language whitening Yan Sijing's face with anger, unable to suppress the murderous intent in her heart, she immediately gestured a spell and used a technique to summon lightning.
The flashing lightning immediately submerged Thunderbolt Ancestor's divine soul, and in just a few breaths completely shattered his divine soul.
Yan Sijing stared unblinkingly at Thunderbolt Ancestor's divine soul until it completely dissipated, then spitefully spat, her anger finally subsiding somewhat.
"It's time to go, Golden Dawn Fairy will be here soon," Yuan Ming's voice transmission sounded once again.
Hearing this, Yan Sijing nodded her head, and Vajra stepped forward to collect the Silver Token, as the surrounding Core Formation ghosts dispersed, while Hua Zhi, the first one to take action, still had not emerged from the Spiritual Beast Bag.
After they tidied up everything, a white light suddenly appeared, enveloping Yan Sijing and Vajra.
Soon, they left without a trace, and when Golden Dawn Fairy arrived, all she saw was the scattered flesh and traces of battle, proof that here had fallen a Nascent Soul.
Within the Stealing Heaven Tripod, Yuan Ming also withdrew his gaze, beside him, a cyan Stele floated, clearly fully refined by him.
Through the Stele, he had long observed every reaction of Six Desires Venerable, and although he could not know what he said to Golden Dawn Fairy through the soul leech, his expression confirmed that he did not know who the real culprit was.
Yan Sijing had pointed out before Thunderbolt Ancestor's death that it was Lord Nether Moon God who helped them, yet Six Desires Venerable showed no reaction, which meant that the protective shield formed by the Silver Token could indeed block the connection of the soul leech.
After confirming this point, Yuan Ming felt somewhat more assured about the situation he would face later on.

chapters.title: Chapter 433 - 410: Golden Dragon Scissors
chapters.content:
Within the Extreme Fire Territory.
The intense heat turned everything crimson, with occasional sparks rising through the swirling white mist, distorting and deforming the surroundings, and from time to time large and small magma lakes could be seen, where fiery red bubbles continuously rolled and burst.
Above the slightly red rocky ground, Dugu Feng, accompanied by Xi Ying, flew at a low altitude. Both of them had a nearly transparent light blue light screen protecting their bodies, isolating the high temperature.
Dugu Feng's face showed little emotion. His eyes constantly scanned around, and his Divine Sense continuously probed the surroundings, searching for something.
Xi Ying followed silently behind, her gaze also moving around from time to time, though her expression was much calmer than Dugu Feng's.
At that moment, Dugu Feng suddenly let out a soft exclamation, and his tunneling speed abruptly increased.
Seeing this, Xi Ying immediately followed.
The two quickly flew over a fiery red mountain, around a hundred feet high, that was still spewing magma, revealing a vast depression in their field of view.
The depression was covered with red tiles, forming a rather large red square with two dark palaces situated around it, the one on the left silent, while the interior of the one on the right emitted regular "rumbling" sounds, reminiscent of muffled thunder.
"Could it be here?" Dugu Feng murmured hesitantly, flew to the square with Xi Ying, paused briefly, and then headed towards the palace on the left.
At that moment, a flash of white light crossed the void in front, and Yan Sijing appeared out of nowhere.
"A spatial transfer restriction? You are the woman by Old Monster Yu's side. How could you be here?" Dugu Feng stopped, furrowing his brows.
Xi Ying also looked at Yan Sijing, sizing her up without saying a word.
"I am here under the command of the Shura Master to take your life," Yan Sijing said calmly.
"Take my life? With just you?" Dugu Feng was startled and then burst into laughter.
However, in the next moment, his smile froze as the ground near the square suddenly cracked, and columns of red fire erupted, turning the entire square into a sea of fire in an instant.
Furious waves of fire engulfed Dugu Feng and Xi Ying from all sides, leaving no room for them to dodge.
Strangely, as soon as the red flames touched Yan Sijing, they split and flowed around her, not even touching her clothes.
This fire contained intense fluctuations of Fire Attribute Spiritual Power and was exceedingly hot. Dugu Feng could not afford to be careless; he quickly opened his mouth, spat out a white Cold Pearl, and a spell was cast into it.
An oval protective shield covered his body, and his figure flew up into the air, trying to escape the red square first.
Xi Ying also raised a large banner, embroidered with the pattern of a Fire Phoenix, separating her from the surrounding flames, and escaped into the air.
At this moment, the flames above swiftly condensed and instantly formed into a giant net of fire, blocking their escape.
Dugu Feng's expression turned solemn as a flash of black light passed over his palm, and the Black Sword shot out, transforming into a giant black sword dozens of feet long.
The surface of the giant sword displayed streaks of black Thunder, and with a force that could split even the mightiest barrier, it slashed upon the fire net.
With a sizzling sound of tearing, a burst of black and red light erupted, and the fire net was cut with a long slit. Dugu Feng's figure darted towards the slit like lightning.
Within the space of the Stealing Heaven Tripod, Yuan Ming performed a hand gesture toward the Shura Stone Tablet, gathering streams of flames, rapidly repairing the net.
In front of Dugu Feng, shadows in the void flickered, and several black crows appeared out of thin air, cawing in unison.
Large black Sound Waves swept down, engulfing Dugu Feng's body, and Xi Ying nearby was also affected by the Crow's Call Wave.
Xi Ying's eyes rolled back, and she fell straight down from the air, her figure passing through the red flames below, disappearing without a trace.
Dugu Feng's eyes also became blurry, but he recovered the next instant.
Yuan Ming frowned, for Dugu Feng's Soul Power was significantly stronger than Thunderbolt Ancestor's, and with his injured Divine Soul, ordinary Crow's Call seemed utterly insufficient to trap this man.
Dugu Feng ignored the soul crows, His figure flickered mysteriously and disappeared, and in the next moment, he appeared not far behind Yan Sijing.
A streak of white light passed, and the White Sword shot out, turning into an invisible afterimage, slashing towards Yan Sijing's neck.
Yan Sijing, who was merely at the Core Formation Stage and lacked practical experience, had been sent on the previous mission merely to divert attention and make Dugu Feng lower his guard. She did not even notice her opponent approaching, let alone defend or dodge.
"Terrible!" Yuan Ming exclaimed, knowing it was too late for another Illusion Technique.
Yan Sijing was his only believer in the Shura Palace; if she were killed, his subsequent plans would be greatly complicated.
Ignoring his injured Divine Soul, he once again urged on the Curse Rune of the Soul Destroying Sword.
Bang!
A massive force of Curse Power poured down, instantly infusing Dugu Feng's body.
Dugu Feng felt his organs churn, his flying form halted, and he vomited, dropping both the White Sword and the White Cold Pearl to the ground.
Only then did Yan Sijing realize Dugu Feng was behind her and hurriedly fled into the distance.
Dugu Feng spat out a mass of black air. His Divine Soul greatly weakened, and his cultivation plummeted significantly.
Yet, this man's cultivation was much stronger than Thunderbolt Ancestor's, nearly reaching the Nascent Soul Middle Stage. Even though his cultivation had seen a big drop, it didn't fall to the Core Formation Stage like it did with Thunderbolt Ancestor.
"What kind of attack is this!" Dugu Feng forcibly maintained his composure, but his heart was filled with shock and uncertainty.
Inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod space, Yuan Ming's face turned deathly pale, the cracks in his Divine Soul deepened significantly.
However, he and Xi Ying had previously communicated secretly through soul splitting and had agreed on a strategy. They planned to use the Forbidden Stele to separate the Six Desires Venerable and the others, swiftly eliminate his support, and then concentrate their power to take down the Six Desires Venerable. Now, at this critical moment, there was no time to rest.
Yuan Ming, struggling to maintain his stance, operated his Soul Power and used the "Emotion Manipulation" Divine Skills.
With the boost from the Stealing Heaven Tripod, his Soul Power surged, making the power of Emotion Manipulation several times stronger than usual.
Dugu Feng's mind was violently agitated, and his emotions suddenly erupted like a volcano, his mouth alternating between cursing in anger and shouting in fear, his mind temporarily falling into chaos.
Yuan Ming seized the opportunity and released all the soul crows.
All around Dugu Feng, shadows flickered in the void as twelve soul crows appeared, arranged in scattered order, collectively emitting a burst of Crow Caw.
Crow Formation!
The Crow's Call Wave, now several times denser than before, engulfed Dugu Feng. The sound waves, carrying Illusion Power, penetrated deep into Dugu Feng's Divine Soul.
Dugu Feng's eyes clouded over with confusion, and he completely fell into the illusion.
Nearby, Xi Ying, who had been lying on the ground, flipped over and stood up, swung his right hand, and a bright golden light shot out like a meteor across the sky, stabbing directly towards Dugu Feng's head.
Within the sword light was a rusty golden scissors, which looked unimpressive but emitted an exceptionally powerful aura, even surpassing Dugu Feng's Black and White Dual Swords.
At the critical moment, Dugu Feng's bewildered eyes suddenly turned silvery white, and his figure abruptly transformed into an illusion and retreated. The golden scissors missed its target.
Inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod, Yuan Ming narrowed his eyes.
The silvery light in Dugu Feng's eyes was not unfamiliar; it was the soul light of the Soul Leech from the Six Desires Venerable. It seemed that the Six Desires Venerable had temporarily controlled Dugu Feng through the Soul Leech, no wonder he could instantly escape the Crow Caw Illusion Technique.
He operated the Shura Stone Tablet spell, and flames burst out once again from the ground around the plaza, enveloping the entire area within a giant flame protective shield.
Yan Sijing flicked her sleeve, and the Silver Token shot out again, landing on the ground.This version is sourced from MV3L3MPYR.
A vast amount of silver light surged out from it, rapidly spreading.
A glint of coldness flashed in Dugu Feng's eyes, and his figure transformed into a dark shadow, heading straight for the area not yet enclosed by the silver light.
A tall golden shadow appeared in front of him. It was the Vajra, who appeared unexpectedly. The Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear shot out, stabbing towards Dugu Feng's head.
The spear tip emitted no breath at all, the air remained undisturbed without a shriek. It was as though it was a silent purple shadow.
This was concentrating all power inside the spear, to explode only upon hitting the target, something impossible without extremely high control over power.
"Back off!" Dugu Feng's eyes burst out with a cold light, the Black Sword appeared instantaneously in front of him, blocking the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear.
The White Sword also materialized, transforming into a white shadow, slashing towards Vajra's chest.
However, Vajra didn't care at all, his fists like Flood Dragons emerging from their cave, hammered towards Dugu Feng's chest.
With a "bang," the nearby void buzzed and trembled, stirring up a surging wave of air!
Vajra was directly cleaved away by the White Sword, a giant wound deep enough to expose bone slashed across his chest, his golden fur dyed red with blood.
But Dugu Feng was also shaken back by the might of Vajra's fists, his body flying backward.
The silver light emitted by the Silver Token swiftly gathered, engulfing and submerging the fire protective shield, creating a silver barrier.
Dugu Feng's eyes filled with fury. However, the silver barrier cut off the connection between the Soul Leech and the Six Desires Venerable, and the silver light in his eyes rapidly dissipated, returning to normal.
With this brief moment serving as a buffer, Dugu Feng's own Divine Soul had already escaped from the Crow Caw Illusion Technique. He relaxed slightly, then turned towards Xi Ying, shouting angrily, "Xiao Ying, you've conspired with outsiders. Do you want to see your family wiped out?"
Responding to Dugu Feng were the twelve soul crows, flying back towards him, emitting a Crow Caw, the rolling sound waves sweeping through.
Dugu Feng, having suffered from the Crow Formation before, hastily retreated with all his might.
However, a flash of golden light passed behind him, and the golden scissors attacked again, faster than before.
Dugu Feng's face turned ashen. He had no choice but to stop, the Black and White Dual Swords flashing into existence behind him, blocking the golden scissors.
But suddenly, the golden scissors split into two, transforming into two gold-colored Flood Dragons, tens of meters long, emitting thousands of golden lights, sweeping across the Black and White Dual Swords.
With a "sizzle," the Black and White Dual Swords, like wooden swords, snapped into four pieces.
"Golden Dragon Scissors! The Magic Treasure of the previous Golden Dragon Venerable, how...how could it be in your hands..." Dugu Feng widened his eyes, crying out in shock.
The two streaks of golden light, like lightning, swept across Dugu Feng's body.
A flash of blood light appeared, Dugu Feng's protective light shield was effortlessly breached as if rotting wood were pulled apart, and his body was directly cut into two halves, collapsing lifelessly to the ground.
Inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod, Yuan Ming also showed a look of surprise.
The power Xi Ying displayed far exceeded his expectations, and the might of the Golden Scissors Magic Treasure even surpassed that of the Thunder God Hammer.

chapters.title: Chapter 434 - 411 Soul Split
chapters.content:
Inside Dugu Feng's fractured body, a small golden figure about an inch tall flashed out and transformed into a streak of golden light, rapidly flying away like lightning. In just a breath's time, it was almost out of the plaza's boundary.
