Yuan Ming was about to control the soul crow to obstruct with Crow's Call Wave, but Xi Ying, as if having anticipated this, raised one hand, her palm emanating a white light toward the direction where the golden figure was fleeing.
The Nascent Soul immediately appeared bewildered, standing still on the spot.
Yuan Ming's face revealed a hint of astonishment; observing through the Stealing Heaven Tripod, he finally discerned the subtlety of the situation.
He saw a thin, hair-like transparent thread shooting out from Xi Ying's palm, bridging a nearly hundred-yard distance, with the other end entering Dugu Feng's Nascent Soul.
"So this is how Xi Ying cast her illusion technique," Yuan Ming muttered to himself.
Every time Xi Ying had used her illusion technique before, it had been silent and unnoticeable, he had never been able to detect how she performed it. Now it seemed that she shot out condensed threads of Divine Soul.
Soul threads were more discreet and more concentrated than the dispersed Divine Soul, naturally making her illusions more effective than Yuan Ming's Crow's Call Wave.
However, not every Soul Cultivator could condense their soul into threads; at least Yuan Ming at his current Soul Cultivation Realm could not. Condensing soul into threads required immense control, which surpassed even the love witch's abilities.
A flicker of curiosity crossed Yuan Ming's eyes. To what realm had Xi Ying's Soul Cultivation really advanced?
From within the Stealing Heaven Tripod, it appeared that Xi Ying's Soul Power was at a love witch's level, but her control over Soul Power was astoundingly precise, coupled with the Golden Dragon Scissors Magic Treasure capable of severing the Black and White Dual Swords. Xi Ying's strength was increasingly mystifying. No wonder she was confident enough to hunt down the Six Desires Venerable.
As Yuan Ming contemplated, a beam of black light shot out of Xi Ying's palm, enveloping Dugu Feng's Nascent Soul and penetrating inside.
The originally dazed golden figure immediately tensed, its face expressing pain.
"You are going to perform a Soul Search on Dugu Feng? Be careful of the soul leech inside," warned Yuan Ming upon seeing this.
His Divine Sense spared nothing; inside Dugu Feng's Nascent Soul, a motionless silver bug lay quietly, precisely the Six Desires Venerable's soul leech.
As a silver barrier isolated the soul leech from the Six Desires Venerable, the silver soul leech did not move, appearing to be in a coma as well.
"I know. The soul leech is a part of the Six Desires Venerable, containing its original memories. If I can Soul Search it, it will greatly benefit our subsequent actions," Xi Ying said, releasing a soul thread from her palm that pierced into the body of the soul leech.
The soul thread flared up with transparent flames, making the soul leech tremble. Its body gradually became transparent and was rapidly assimilated by the soul thread.
Xi Ying also touched the memories contained within the soul leech and closed her eyes to begin reading them.
At that moment, the soul leech suddenly raised its head, twining around the soul thread.
The next moment, half of the soul leech's body vanished, merging into the soul thread and infiltrating back.
Yuan Ming's expression turned solemn. He stirred his Soul Power, ready to assist at any moment.
However, a flash of golden light passed through Xi Ying's brow, turning the fire on the soul thread gold. It instantly burnt the parasitic force of the soul leech and continued reading its memories.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming dissipated his Soul Power, his face displaying even greater exhaustion.
Having stimulated the Soul Destroying Sword on top of his wounded Divine Soul, he had exacerbated his injuries. Having kept up in the intense battle till now, he was nearly at his limit.
But at that moment, the remaining half of the soul leech suddenly split open, with a pitch-black eye emerging, staring at Xi Ying.
The black eye was profoundly deep, bottomless, seemingly leading to the Nine Nether Abyss.
"Nili Divine Eye!" Xi Ying shuddered, opening her eyes, and was about to break off the soul thread.
A streak of black light shot out from the pitch-black eye before her, merging into the soul thread, and infiltrated rapidly.
Instantly, a speck of black appeared on Xi Ying's brow, rapidly spreading. Her whole body seemed as if hit by an immobilization spell, unable to move, the only activity being the shock in her eyes.
Witnessing this scene, Yuan Ming was shocked, and, disregarding his fatigue, he stirred considerable Soul Power down to block the bizarre black light from advancing, attempting to stop its erosion.
However, the black light split off a strand, entering Yuan Ming's Divine Sense.
The black light's might could, following his Divine Sense, infiltrate into the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space.
Startled, Yuan Ming felt his body turn weak and numb, his consciousness also slightly delayed.
"What power is this!" he suppressed his mind, quickly utilizing the hot flow inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod to block this force.
The black light's force was similar to Soul Power, and seemed to have the same origin as the Desire Power hot flow. Since only a strand of black light had entered Yuan Ming's body, the Desire Power hot flow quickly countered it.
Yuan Ming was able to handle it here, but the situation on Xi Ying's side was looking grim.
At this point, most of her face had turned black, a hint of ferocity appearing in her expression.
Sweat appeared on Yuan Ming's forehead. Clenching his teeth, he grabbed the Soul Destroying Sword, once again activating the Curse Rune on it.
By this point, he could no longer afford to care about so much.
A massive curse descended, striking the soul leech.
The soul leech let out a shrill scream, its body suddenly expanded tenfold and burst with a loud "bang," dissipating into smoke and clouds.
The Divine Soul of Dugu Feng was closely connected to the soul leech. As the soul leech was destroyed, Dugu Feng's Divine Soul also shattered and scattered apart.
With the disappearance of the soul leech, the eerie black light also vanished. Xi Ying's forehead emitted a dazzling golden light, like a rising sun, quickly cleansing the blackness from her forehead.
"The Nili Divine Eye is indeed formidable, truly worthy of being one of the Great Divine Powers of the Wu Yue God. I really was careless this time; I didn't expect the Six Desires Venerable to have been granted this Divine Power," Xi Ying expressed her relief at having survived, thinking to herself that had it been a moment or two slower, she might have been in trouble.
Xi Ying quickly calmed her mind and tried to communicate with Yuan Ming to inquire about the situation there.
Although Xi Ying had been immobilized by the Nili Divine Light, her five senses were still intact, and she witnessed the collapse of the soul leech.
However, no matter how she called, there was no response from Yuan Ming.
"What's happening? Could it be that the backlash from the Soul Destroying Sword is too strong, causing him to fall into a coma?" Xi Ying's brows furrowed.
She and Yuan Ming could communicate at any time. During their previous discussion of future plans, they had already learned about the existence of the Soul Destroying Sword and its significant backlash against the Divine Soul.
"The master's Divine Soul Aura is incredibly weak now, like a candle in the wind, likely to extinguish at any moment. If you have a way, go and see him quickly," Vajra said as he walked over, clutching his chest.
Although there was a huge wound on his chest, it seemed to be of no serious concern; the bleeding had stopped, and it was even beginning to heal.
Xi Ying's expression darkened as she collected Dugu Feng's body and Nascent Soul, along with the broken Black and White Dual Swords, and suddenly looked towards Yan Sijing in the distance.
At that moment, Yan Sijing's face showed shock. The battle between Xi Ying and Dugu Feng had far exceeded her imagination. Either of them could crush her into dust with a mere gesture.
However, being able to personally experience such a high-level battle filled Yan Sijing with both fear and excitement. If she could contemplate quietly in time, it would greatly benefit her cultivation and strength.
When Xi Ying looked over, Yan Sijing was about to speak, but suddenly, her Divine Soul "buzzed," and her consciousness plunged into endless darkness.
Xi Ying beckoned with her hand, and a Storage Ring flew out from the prominent peaks of Yan Sijing, tainted with a hint of maidenly fragrance.
"Hmph!" Xi Ying's gaze turned slightly cold as she imbued her Divine Sense into the Storage Ring, quickly pulling out a green incense burner, precisely the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
She activated her Divine Sense, trying to infiltrate the interior of the Stealing Heaven Tripod, but was blocked by an indestructible force, unable to penetrate even slightly.
"This is bad! The Stealing Heaven Tripod has already recognized Yuan Ming as its master; besides him, no one else can enter," Xi Ying thought to herself, her brow furrowing tightly.
Unable to enter the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space, how could she check on Yuan Ming's condition? Given Yuan Ming's unknown life or death status, if she couldn't intervene in time, the consequences might not be optimistic.
Critically, he had fallen into this state entirely for her sake.
Whether it was previously agreeing to assist her against the Six Desires or helping her this time regardless of his own Divine Soul damage, it was all based on his trust in her, and now she felt helpless.
As Xi Ying was frantic with anxiety, a point of golden light shone on the Stealing Heaven Tripod, and a force emerged from the tripod, enveloping her body.
Xi Ying only saw a blur before her eyes, and the next moment she appeared inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
'This place... is it the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space?' she wondered, taking a quick look around before swiftly flying up to the platform.
Yuan Ming was lying next to the White Jade Lotus Platform on the ground, barely keeping his eyes open, his face devoid of any color, and an intense aura of decay hovered between his brows.Findthischapter'ssourceon*.
He had just sensed Xi Ying trying to enter this place and, mustering the last bit of his Mana, had summoned Xi Ying in.
'Yuan Ming, how are you now?' Xi Ying squatted down, eyes filled with anxiety."It's nothing serious, the backlash from the Soul Destroying Sword is too strong. I used three Curse Runes consecutively, and my Divine Soul has suffered severe damage. I need to enter deep sleep immediately to recover, and I can no longer assist you against the Six Desires Venerable. You can use any of my Magic Treasures. With this force of Mana, you will be able to leave the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space..." Yuan Ming said weakly, slightly raising his arm as a ball of blue Mana flew from his fingertips.
After saying those words, he could no longer maintain consciousness and collapsed into a coma.
Xi Ying ignored that force of Mana, activating her Divine Sense to inspect Yuan Ming's Divine Soul. Her pretty face changed.
Yuan Ming's Divine Soul wasn't just severely damaged but was on the verge of collapse. His Divine Soul was torn and shattered, barely held together in some places, and likely to completely break apart with any slight disturbance.
'Yuan Ming only mentioned that the backlash from the Soul Destroying Sword was terrible, but I didn't realize it was to this extent. He had already used it twice earlier, and still, to save me, he pushed himself to use it a third time...' Xi Ying lowered her eyelids, thoughts flashing through her mind.
She remained silent, then looked at Yuan Ming's bloodless face, her eyes turning resolute.
Xi Ying helped Yuan Ming to sit up in a seated position, and she also sat down in front of him, close enough to clearly feel each other's breathing.
A blush crossed Xi Ying's face, but she soon regained her composure, lowered her head slightly, and pressed her snow-white forehead against Yuan Ming's.
A massive Soul Power shot from Xi Ying's forehead, dispersing into countless fine threads, delicately entering Yuan Ming's Sea of Consciousness.

chapters.title: Chapter 435 - 412 You Can't Learn This Secret Technique
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming had a dream.
After stepping onto the Immortal Path, he gradually got used to meditating instead of sleeping and could hardly remember the last time he had dreamt.
Moreover, as a Soul Cultivator, he clearly knew that dreams were nothing but illusions created by the natural depletion of Soul Power. Those fragmented and bizarre scenes were merely a patchwork of the dreamer's daily observations and thoughts.
However, this time, the dream Yuan Ming had seemed different.
He dreamt that his Divine Soul left his body, flying into a vast expanse of white radiance where everything was milky white, with no discernible shapes or objects.
A wind blew across his Divine Soul, bringing a hint of coolness that was not bone-chilling but made Yuan Ming's Divine Soul shiver involuntarily, leaving him feeling somewhat hollow.
Then, as if from nowhere, warm water enveloped Yuan Ming's Divine Soul. The warmth dispersed the coldness and filled the emptiness, gradually rising and causing his Divine Soul to feel a wave of heat.
The warm water ebbed and flowed rhythmically, sometimes slowly, sometimes rapidly, and with each swell and contraction, his Divine Soul ascended and burgeoned.
The cold wind arose as the warm spring waned, and as the warm spring ascended, the cold wind descended.
In this alternation of cold and heat, Yuan Ming felt an inexplicable joy well up in his heart. The injuries on his Divine Soul began to heal. He reveled freely in the embrace of the warm water, feeling a sense of sublimation.
After an unknown period, Yuan Ming slowly came to and opened his eyes. He had not yet risen when he suddenly felt refreshingly clear-headed.
He immediately inspected his Sea of Consciousness and discovered that the Divine Soul sitting within the Round Moon's illusory shadow had not only healed from its wounds but had also become more resilient and powerful, having reached the mid-stage level of a love witch's Cultivation.
Excited as he was, Yuan Ming also felt a hint of puzzlement.
But soon, he recalled the events that occurred before he fainted. Hurrying to his feet, he saw that he was still sitting within the Stealing Heaven Tripod, and not far away, Xi Ying was meditating with her back to him, silently practicing Breathing Control.
Strangely enough, compared to before, Xi Ying's Divine Soul Aura had weakened significantly, and her entire temperament seemed to have changed. Yet, if asked what exactly was different, Yuan Ming could not pinpoint it.
The past Xi Ying was like the reflection of the moon in water—cold and illusory. Now, while she remained as pure as the moon, she seemed to have a touch of authenticity to her, and the distance between her and Yuan Ming no longer felt so insurmountably vast.
Yuan Ming hesitated, about to ask a question, when suddenly, Xi Ying turned around first. Her face showed no particular expression, only indifference.
"I just performed a secret technique for healing Soul Cultivators to help you mend your Divine Soul injuries. It was a bit of a heavy toll, but don't worry about it too much. After all, you were hurt while helping me, so no need for any excess words. Let's quickly resume our Breathing Control to recover. The Six Desires Venerable is still out there, and since we've killed two of his Nascent Soul subordinates, he's bound to react. We can't afford to delay," Xi Ying spoke, her speed seemingly quick as if to block any questions from Yuan Ming, giving him no chance to inquire.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming simply nodded and expressed his gratitude.
"Thank you, this time I owe you a lot. Without you, I'm afraid I couldn't have made it. By the way, could you teach me the secret technique you performed? If you get injured in the future, I can help heal you," Yuan Ming said, then casually asked.
But no sooner had the words left his mouth, Xi Ying glared at him with a murderous look and firmly rejected his request:
The reference version of this on *.
"You can't learn this technique, and we're short on time. Even if I gave it to you, you wouldn't be able to learn it right now. Sigh, let's talk about it after we kill Six Desires," she replied.
Yuan Ming's gaze grew more puzzled, and he couldn't tell if it was an illusion, but it seemed like Xi Ying's face was faintly blushing. He had a nagging feeling that something wasn't quite right.
However, seeing Xi Ying so resistant to discussing it further, he didn't feel it was appropriate to press the issue and chose to set his doubts aside for the time being, planning to approach the subject indirectly later on.
…
In the Cold Martial Realm.
The Six Desires Venerable had already stopped his exploration and was now standing mid-air with furrowed brows in deep thought.
Not far in front of him, Ni Mu and the other two stood with their hands tied, showing signs of surprise and astonishment on their faces upon seeing the Six Desires Venerable's demeanor.
Among the three, the youngest-looking, fetching woman seemed to be unable to bear the chill of the surroundings, casually rubbing her arms and drawing her sleeves tighter.
Under the cover of wide robes, the butterfly tattoo on her right arm flickered, then, as if coming to life, fluttered its wings unexpectedly.
However, the Six Desires Venerable did not notice the expressions on Ni Mu and his peers' faces, nor the young woman's subtle movements.
All his attention was focused on Dugu Feng, with whom contact had been lost.
If Thunderbolt Ancestor's death could still be considered accidental, then Dugu Feng's demise was undoubtedly premeditated.
According to what he sensed when possessing Dugu Feng, the person who took action was a Soul Cultivator at the early stage of the Sleeping Witch's power. His strength wasn't remarkable, and the way he cast the Illusion Technique was quite crude. However, the two Magic Treasures in his hands did cause the Six Desires Venerable some concern.
One was the Silver Token that could shield the connection between him and the soul leeches, and the other was the Golden Dragon Scissors unleashed by Xiao Ying.
His soul leeches were not like ordinary Divine Soul Transformations. Each one not only acted as a vessel for his Soul Cultivation Divine Powers but also formed the basis of his potential resurrection.
In other words, every soul leech could be considered an individual Six Desires Venerable, scattered within different cultivators' bodies, yet able to share emotions and consciousness with each other, ensuring that only one main soul exists at any given time.
This was the first time he had encountered his soul leech being completely blocked, and apart from the actions of those who blocked the connection to the soul leech, just the act of blocking itself had severe consequences.
Whenever the Six Desires Venerable's main soul perished, one of the soul leeches would enter a transformation phase, and after seven days, it would develop into the new main soul.
And the blocked soul leech, having lost contact with the main soul, would default to assuming the main soul had vanished, thus entering the transformation phase.
In just seven days, a brand-new Six Desires Venerable would be born into this world, and once it restored contact with the other soul leeches, it would inevitably compete with the true main soul, deciding the only victor.
And this was only the situation with one soul leech being blocked.
The Six Desires Venerable, thinking of the possible scenarios, felt an immediate rise of impatience in his heart, seething with a desire to kill.
Even if the bearer of the Silver Token seemed unaware of this possibility, he could not allow the Token to remain in someone else's hands, or it would surely bring trouble later.
However, he was still somewhat puzzled about the true identity of the person behind the scenes.
The two subordinates brought by Dugu Feng had been carefully selected by him, and this Xiao Ying, he remembered, was just a member of an Array Master family from the Southern Border Southern Domain, whose family reputation was indeed prominent, but lacking a Nascent Soul, they did not catch his especial notice.
The Golden Dragon Scissors in her hand could not possibly be her own acquisition; it must have been a gift from the person behind the scenes.
After all, the previous Golden Dragon Venerable was a fellow Wu Yue Sect Venerable, with comparable strength but not as long-lived as himself, leaving behind a legacy that had now been inherited by others.
Yet, the Divine Soul Transformation form of the person who inherited the title of Golden Dragon Venerable was one the Six Desires recognized, and it was definitely not in the shape of a raven.
In the Yunhuang Continent, the disturbance of a breakthrough to the Nascent Soul stage was impossible to conceal, and given how long the Six Desires Venerable had lived, there might be Nascent Souls unknown to him, but none that he did not recognize.
Now, with the sudden emergence of an unknown Sleeping Witch with some connection to his Wu Yue Sect, thoughts raced through the Sea of Consciousness of the Six Desires, leading to a sudden possibility.
Perhaps someone within the sect was dissatisfied with his presence, had specially cultivated a Sleeping Witch, and even refined the Silver Token that could restrain him.
Once the thought took shape, it became uncontrollable.
Following his line of thought, the Six Desires Venerable became increasingly convinced of his speculation, his back growing cold, a sensation he had not felt for quite some time.
Then, turning his head abruptly, he looked toward Ni Mu and his two companions, his gaze carrying a hint of murderous intent.
"Ni Mu, I'll ask you one more time, what exactly did you come to the Black Wind Desert for?" His tone was very smooth, his emotions stable, sounding as if he was casually chatting with Ni Mu.
Yet upon hearing his question, Ni Mu's eyes took on a serious cast, while the bodies of Wu Yuezhi and the beautiful young woman instantly tensed behind him.
"Venerable, I..." Ni Mu took a deep breath and began to speak.
As soon as he began, the Six Desires Venerable suddenly turned around, fixing his gaze in the opposite direction of Ni Mu and his party.
Several miles away, Yan Sijing had just appeared when she looked up to see the Six Desires Venerable's gaze meet hers from afar, her heart immediately shocked.
Just then, a powerful Curse Power descended upon the Six Desires Venerable, causing his cultivation to plummet abruptly, falling to the Nascent Soul Early Stage.
A flicker of shock passed through the Six Desires Venerable's eyes. Although he had already felt the might of Curse Power through the soul leeches, it was only upon direct contact that he realized the power was much stronger than he had imagined.
That force not only reduced his physical cultivation to the Nascent Soul Early Stage but also lowered his Divine Soul strength by a small realm.
In his long life, aside from the weakness brought by death and resurrection, he had never seen such methods or experienced anything similar.
There's no mistake, this Sleeping Witch was specifically cultivated to kill me!
The thought flickered for only a moment.
Once the Six Desires Venerable was certain of his guess, he made no further reservations and took action with all his strength. His body shone with a silver light, and in the blink of an eye, he crossed several miles to arrive in front of Yan Sijing.
Seeing this, Yan Sijing's face showed shock, and before she could react, a white flash enveloped her, Yuan Ming having activated the Forbidden to teleport her ten miles away.
However, the Six Desires Venerable once again locked onto Yan Sijing's position, the silver light reappeared around him, and in the next instant, he appeared before her like a wraith.
Within the Stealing Heaven Tripod, Yuan Ming, seeing this, immediately activated the Forbidden again, trying to teleport Yan Sijing away.
But this time, as the white light just began to shine on Yan Sijing, the Six Desires Venerable extended his hand like lightning, and a silver rope-like object materialized out of thin air, directly entwining Yan Sijing's body.
Then, the white light enveloped Yan Sijing once more, and with a flash, her surroundings blurred, but when she looked again, she was still in the same place, the Six Desires Venerable's half-dark, half-light visage still before her.

chapters.title: Chapter 436 - 413 Ambition
chapters.content:
Yan Sijing's face drained of color, her instincts screaming for her to flee.
But at that moment, the silver object binding her body tightened, making her groan from the pressure, her Mana freezing in place, unable to muster even the slightest bit.
Inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod, Yuan Ming saw the transmission ban fail and his eyelid twitched involuntarily.
Observing the silver object that ensnared Yan Sijing with his Divine Sense, he discovered it writhing like a living creature, with its tail vanishing into the void and emitting faint spatial fluctuations.
Yuan Ming had a thought and immediately realized that it might be a type of Magic Treasure or Divine Skills related to space, which was anchoring the Space Power around Yan Sijing, causing the transmission ban to fail.
This was going to be troublesome!
On the other hand, Six Desires Venerable had captured Yan Sijing and his vast Divine Sense immediately enveloped the vicinity, but he could not locate the Sleeping Witch's figure.
Furthermore, Yan Sijing carried no special Magic Treasures or Forbidden items on her person.
Where on earth was that person hiding, and how did they launch their attack?
The Six Desires Venerable pondered quietly, and then spoke loudly towards the void, "Which old friend of the sect does your master belong to? Since you have come, why skulk in the shadows? Why not show yourself? We can talk things over. It could be an opportunity for you. Otherwise, I cannot guarantee the safety of your friend here."
But Yuan Ming knew it was simply a delaying tactic by the enemy—he certainly wouldn't show himself, so he chose to remain silent.
After the Six Desires Venerable finished speaking and waited a moment, the silence remained unbroken with no responses. A cold glint flashed across his face, and with a flick of his finger, a soul leech shot towards Yan Sijing's head.
Just then, a thick silver Thunder Column appeared above Yan Sijing's head. Lei Guang cascaded down like flowing water, forming a Thunder Light Shield outside her body, crackling loudly.
Seeing this, the Six Desires Venerable's pupils constricted, his fingers curled back as the soul leech advancing towards Yan Sijing came to a halt in mid-air, seemingly wary of the shield brimming with lightning.
The essence of Divine Soul Transformation is Soul Power, naturally suppressed by Thunder Power. This had nothing to do with the level of Cultivation—it was simply due to opposing natures. If he pushed forward, even if he could achieve his goal, the loss would not be small.
However, this did not mean the Six Desires Venerable had no means to counter the Thunder Light Shield.
Yet, just as he was about to act, another surge of powerful Curse Power descended. It didn't press down on the Six Desires, but instead poured into the silver threads binding Yan Sijing.
In an instant, the silver threads trembled violently, sorrowful wailing echoes emerging from the void. In the blink of an eye, the silver threads drooped powerlessly, their roots connected to the void suddenly snapping—their body voluntarily severed them.
Simultaneously, a white spirit light reappeared on Yan Sijing's body. This time, the surging light even enveloped the detached silver threads.
A hint of surprise flashed in the Six Desires Venerable's eyes. His thoughts shifted quickly, and from the void behind him, another silver thread shot out. It tried to breach the Thunder Light Shield, not to bind Yan Sijing again but to coil towards the severed part of the thread.
However, this newly appeared silver thread seemed much weaker. By the time it broke through the Thunder Light Shield, the white light had already vanished, and both Yan Sijing and the severed part of the thread had disappeared without a trace.
Seeing the silver thread snatch at empty air, the Six Desires Venerable's expression darkened. But then, he suddenly raised his hand, forming complicated seals, spitting out one unintelligible syllable after another.
After a few breaths, he abruptly looked up towards the direction of the Extreme Fire Realm.
My Virtual Library Empire (*)
"Found it, but..." he murmured to himself, then suddenly turned his head to glance at Ni Mu and his two companions.
The skirmish had been brief, yet from start to finish, Ni Mu and the others had observed coldly from the sidelines, showing no intention of intervening, regardless of what machinations they harbored in their hearts, or whether they simply hadn't reacted in time. The Six Desires had no intention of leaving them behind any longer.
With his current strength, he had no need for others' help from the start. Planting soul leeches in the Nascent Souls was simply to have them serve as his eyes and, at the same time, cannon fodder.
Rather than keeping Ni Mu and his companions for their negligible usefulness, the Six Desires Venerable would feel more at ease with them dead.
On the other side, Ni Mu also noticed the killing intent rising in the Six Desires Venerable and decided not to play along anymore. He instantly retrieved a talisman, slapping it onto his body.
The talisman transformed into a purple-gold light that infused into his body, swiftly enveloping both his Nascent Soul and the soul leech attached to it.
The Six Desires Venerable immediately realized that he had lost contact with the soul leech planted in Ni Mu, which further confirmed his suspicions.
Indeed, they were all here specifically to kill him!
The Six Desires Venerable had this thought, and his eyes already revealed a ferocious gleam.
However, he did not immediately attack Ni Mu and the other two. Instead, he formed another hand seal and recited an incantation, and a streak of light abruptly flew out from his Sea of Consciousness, landing beside him. With a flicker to the left and right, it astonishingly transformed into another Venerable that looked exactly the same as him.
After the new Six Desires Venerable appeared, it didn't even communicate with the original and instantly turned around and dashed towards the Extreme Fire Realm with a silver rope in hand.
"Divine Soul Incarnation Technique? Hmph, who would have thought Six Desires, you are so overconfident. Do you really believe you can kill the three of us with just your physical body?" Seeing this, a subtle sense of relief flickered in Ni Mu's eyes, though he didn't show it outwardly.
The so-called Divine Soul Incarnation Technique was a secret technique that temporarily separated the physical body from the Divine Soul. Using this technique, a Soul Cultivator could materialize their Divine Soul into a shell indistinguishable from their physical body, allowing them to simultaneously control both and achieve the effect of outnumbering the enemy.
The Six Desires Venerable didn't care about Ni Mu's attitude and said with a deep gaze, "Hehe, Ni Mu, in the past, respecting the hardship of your cultivation, this Venerable thought to wait until you passed away of old age to take your body. But since you are so ignorant of what is good for you, I will take on the trouble and claim your body ahead of time!"
As soon as these words fell, the Six Desires Venerable lifted his palm and made a pressing motion over the heads of Ni Mu and the others, and a giant black palm suddenly appeared out of thin air, swiftly slapping towards the three of them.
But just then, the Six Desires Venerable's expression suddenly changed, and numerous multicolored patterns abruptly emerged on his skin. Inside his body, grains of worm eggs started growing from his internal organs, with minute Gu Worms rapidly growing beneath the transparent husks.
Affected by this, the Six Desires Venerable had to disperse the giant palm he had formed, and his Mana circulated throughout his body, igniting blood-colored Flames in his organs to burn them.
One by one, the worm eggs turned to charred ash in the fire, and the beautiful young woman noticed this and quickly flipped her sleeve, lightly tapping the butterfly tattoo on her arm.
With Mana pouring in, the tattoo came to life, taking flight from her forearm into the air. As it gently flapped its wings, countless particles of powder fell from the wings, spreading into the air.
At the same time, the remaining worm eggs within the Six Desires Venerable seemed to be summoned and started to grow at an accelerated rate.
Taking advantage of the blood-red Flames that were not yet extinguished, the worm eggs pulsated rapidly as if breathing, and in the span of a single breath, larvae burst forth from the eggs. Yet they continued to cling to the organs, opening their mouths full of sharp teeth to gnaw on the flesh.
On the other side, Wu Yuezhi took out the Heavenly Star Chessboard with a flip of her hand, raising it into the air. The chessboard turned round and round, expanding into several zhang in size. Following this, countless stars descended from the sky, turning into chess pieces next to the board.
"Sky and Star!"
With a fierce shout, Wu Yuezhi pointed, and on the chessboard, ten white spirit lights ascended, forming ten white pieces surrounding the Heavenly Yuan and falling down.
At the same time, a chessboard phantom suddenly appeared beneath the Six Desires Venerable's feet. Looked from above, he seemed like a black piece, strategically placed right on the position of Heavenly Yuan.
Then, ten meteors fell from the sky, surrounding the Six Desires Venerable and forming the configuration of Sky and Star. Beams of bright white spirit light shot out from the meteors, turning into ten chains that tightly bound the Six Desires Venerable.
Afterward, Wu Yuezhi pointed again, and six spirit lights soared into the sky. In mid-air, they condensed into black pieces, not landing on the chessboard but standing upright in mid-air in the configuration of the Big Dipper, with their lower ends aiming directly at the board's Heavenly Yuan.
Simultaneously, Ni Mu raised one hand, and the Dragon and Phoenix Bronze Mirror instantly flew out, circling in the air. Reflected in the mirror was the image of the Big Dipper.
"Quickly!"
With a grave expression, Ni Mu pointed, directing his Mana towards the bronze mirror. The reflection in the mirror instantly grew more than ten times larger.
The Big Dipper configuration above the chessboard also grew explosively, and above the Six Desires Venerable's head, six more meteors hurtled down, forming the Big Dipper. Endless spirit lights rushed towards them, causing them to steadily expand until they became hundreds of zhang in size.
The Six Desires Venerable, bound by the spirit light chains, looked up and saw this scene, a mysterious expression suddenly flashing in his eyes.
"Interesting, interesting! Only it's a pity that it's still lacking in intensity," he suddenly whispered, then touched his brow. A strange fluctuation swept out and headed straight for the Heavenly Star Chessboard.
And as that strange fluctuation swept over, the pieces that had been placed on the chessboard abruptly changed. The white pieces surrounding the Heavenly Yuan shifted a space to the left in unison, while the black pieces suspended in mid-air reversed direction, flipping upside down.
As the pieces changed, the meteors around the Six Desires Venerable also shifted.
The chains around his body shattered, and then new chains emerged from the meteors, locking onto the Void beside the Six Desires Venerable as if there was a person standing there.
Furthermore, the meteors that had been falling towards his head suddenly stalled and then inverted, now racing towards the sky instead.
Seeing this, Ni Mu's eyes revealed a look of shock.
"Quick, use the Ningxin Talisman!" he bellowed, then took out a talisman and slapped it onto his forehead.
Wu Yuezhi and the beautiful woman heard this and were startled. Just as they were about to act, their bodies stiffened in unison. Then they turned their heads, their lifeless eyes fixated on Ni Mu, showing an unmistakable intent to kill.

chapters.title: Chapter 437 - 414: Separation of the Soul Body
chapters.content:
"Heh, it seems you were quite prepared, but still a step too late," the Six Desires Venerable said, his figure slowly flying towards them and stopping a few yards away from Ni Mu.
Wu Yuezhi and the glamorous woman slowly flew towards him as well and soon stood by his side.
"Wasn't your main soul supposed to have left? How can you still manipulate Soul Power and use Illusion Techniques?" Ni Mu's heart sank, knowing they had fallen for an illusion, yet he was utterly baffled.
The Soul Power of a Soul Cultivator depends on the Divine Soul; they can exert their powers through transformation, yet it must be controlled by the Divine Soul.
The Six Desires Venerable had already split his Divine Soul using the Divine Soul Incarnation Technique; now, relying solely on his physical body, it should have been impossible for him to employ the means of a Soul Cultivator, which is why Ni Mu and the others had not immediately used any methods to counter the illusion.
However, the current situation proved that a Divine Soul still resided within the Six Desires Venerable's physical body; with the main soul having left already, what remained could only be a split soul.
Yet, as far as Ni Mu knew, due to the unique nature of Divine Soul Transformation, the Six Desires Venerable was exceedingly wary of splitting his soul. Moreover, a split soul is generally weaker than the main soul, but the Illusion Technique just deployed had even deceived Wu Yuezhi's Magic Treasure—a feat no ordinary split soul could achieve.
On the other side, faced with Ni Mu's questioning, the Six Desires Venerable scoffed with disdain.
"Do you think I would tell you?"
Saying this, he waved his hand, and Wu Yuezhi and the glamorous woman started using their respective signature moves again, only this time, their target had changed to Ni Mu.
Ni Mu looked at his sworn siblings, a flash of reluctance in his eyes.
Faced with such a perilous situation, though unwilling, he had no choice but to make a move against Wu Yuezhi and the other.
It had come to this, and he could only use "that."
Ni Mu thought to himself, his fingers frenziedly tapping in mid-air as Mana burst forth from his body, all streaming into a Storage Bag at his waist.
...
Extreme Fire Realm.
As the white light dissipated, Yan Sijing immediately looked around and let out a sigh of relief upon noticing that the Six Desires Venerable was not nearby.Brought to you by *.
Just then, Yuan Ming and Xi Ying flew out from the Stealing Heaven Tripod and approached Yan Sijing.
"Here, take these elixirs for now, rest a bit, and calm yourself," Yuan Ming looked Yan Sijing up and down, seeing her unharmed, he also relaxed slightly.
"I'm fine, really fine. To personally participate in a battle among top cultivators is something I've never experienced before. And with the Nether Moon God protecting us, though I was scared at that moment, it's not a bother now," Yan Sijing said excitedly, her eyes bright with anticipation of the next battle.
Yuan Ming was somewhat surprised, but seeing that she seemed genuinely fine, he let her be.
"Lift your hand," Xi Ying said, not caring about Yan Sijing's state, and simply reached out to remove the silver cord wrapped around her.
"What's this?" Yuan Ming asked curiously.
"I'm not sure, it feels like a rope, but it doesn't seem to be a Magic Treasure," Xi Ying scanned it with his Divine Sense and shook his head.
Suddenly, Yuan Ming felt his Spiritual Beast Bag stir at his waist. Before he could reach out to open it, a stream of purple-black light burst from within and transformed into a human form next to the trio.
It was a small-framed girl with delicate features, her eyes full of vitality and liveliness. She looked like any ordinary person except for her purple-black skin, vine-like patterns on her body, and hair that resembled willow leaves, hinting at some plant characteristics.
"Master, this should be a type of Spirit Vine," the girl said, moving closer to Yuan Ming as if seeking approval.
However, Yuan Ming's attention was no longer on the silver "rope" but was instead fixed on the girl in surprise.
"You are... Hua Zhi? How did you transform like this?" Yuan Ming asked in astonishment.
Since coming out from All Living Beings' Dream, he hadn't had the chance to check the situation inside the Spiritual Beast Bag. Although he sensed Hua Zhi awakening through his Divine Sense, he had no idea she could fully transform into human form.
"Hehe, I'm great, aren't I, Master? All thanks to the Demonic Qi given by Shura Master, otherwise it would have taken me much longer to transform!" Hua Zhi boasted, hands on her hips and head slightly raised, a proud look on her face.
At this point, Yuan Ming also noticed that the aura Hua Zhi emitted had already reached the Third-level Upper Stage.
"Hua Zhi, you said this is a Spirit Vine, can you be more specific about which type it is?" Since Xi Ying was unaware of Hua Zhi's previous transformation, he didn't care much about Hua Zhi's results in transforming.
"Hmm... I just feel its essence is that of a Spirit Vine, but to know exactly which one, I'd have to eat it. Ah, don't get me wrong, oh! This is a new ability I gained after breaking through to the third level. I can know other creatures' abilities by devouring them, it's not because I'm greedy!" Hua Zhi explained, sneaking a glance at Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming didn't notice her little gesture but remembering the Six Desires Venerable's anxious expression when they killed the silver Spirit Vine, he immediately nodded and said:
"Alright, then eat it quickly and analyze its abilities, I have great use for it."
"Yes, Master!" Hua Zhi joyfully agreed, taking the Spirit Vine from Xi Ying's hand, then turned back into a stream of light and slipped back into the Spiritual Beast Bag.
The next moment, Yuan Ming's expression changed slightly.
"What's wrong?" Xi Ying asked.
"The Six Desires Venerable is flying towards us as a soul body, and he's moving very fast, so he'll arrive soon," Yuan Ming said quickly.
"This is a capability of the Sleeping Witch, allowing the soul body to separate for extended periods. Divine Souls who've reached the Sleep Witch Realm move extremely swiftly, unlike your soul crow," Xi Ying explained.
"So that's how it is," Yuan Ming nodded.
"What is the physical body of the Six Desires Venerable doing?" Xi Ying thought of something and asked again.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming activated the Shura Stone Tablet's forbidden, swiftly seeing the situation around the Six Desires Venerable's body, but the situation wasn't good.
"Ni Mu and the others have begun clashing with him? It seems the Six Desires Venerable reacted quickly. Let's see what they can manage to do. Regardless, the demise of the Six Desires has come!" Xi Ying said with a cold smile upon hearing Yuan Ming's report.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming felt a stir in his heart.
Xi Ying's words carried a deep hatred, seemingly bearing some deep grudge against the Six Desires Venerable.
However, Xi Ying did not elaborate, and he did not ask further.
"Hua Zhi has not yet figured out the abilities of the Silver Vine, so it's not advisable to confront the Six Desires Venerable directly. Let's hide for now," Yuan Ming took out the Shura Stone Tablet.
A white light surrounded the trio, and in a blur, they appeared in the Netherworld.
Almost simultaneously, Yuan Ming also sensed the Divine Soul of the Six Desires Venerable change direction, flying towards them with uncanny precision.
"Strange, how could the Six Desires Venerable know our location? We did not show ourselves just before, and there's nothing amiss on Yan Sijing either," Yuan Ming glanced at Yan Sijing.
Although Yan Sijing was briefly captured by the silver tentacle, he had carefully checked with his Divine Sense and could ensure there were no Mana marks or similar things planted on her.
Yan Sijing felt a shiver inside and subconsciously lowered her head, activating her Divine Sense to inspect herself, naturally without finding anything.
"The Six Desires Venerable must have used the Ancient Shadow Soul Seeking Technique of the Wu Yue Sect, a tracking secret technique. As long as a trace of the target's aura is captured, it can lock onto their location. Even if they are a thousand or two thousand miles away or hidden within forbidden areas or Spiritual Beast Bags, it does not block it and is extremely difficult to escape," Xi Ying said thoughtfully.
"There's such a powerful tracking secret technique?" Yuan Ming was secretly shocked.
This Ancient Shadow Soul Seeking Technique's effect somewhat resembled the Soul-locking Pearl Magic Artifact he had obtained previously, but the Soul-locking Pearl could only track up to a hundred miles, nothing compared to this technique.
"Ordinary cultivators using the Ancient Shadow Soul Seeking Technique wouldn't see such formidable effects; the Six Desires Venerable has lived for two or three thousand years and has cultivated various secret techniques to their peaks, allowing him to track from so far away," Xi Ying explained.
After hearing this, Yuan Ming felt slightly relieved and manipulated the Shura Stone Tablet to move them near the Black Tower.
And naturally, the Divine Soul of the Six Desires Venerable changed course and pursued them here.
"Truly an unshakeable pursuer. It seems he definitely used the Ancient Shadow Soul Seeking Technique as Xi Ying mentioned. However, although it may be difficult for others to evade this technique, it is useless against me," Yuan Ming sneered secretly, his Divine Sense enveloping Yan Sijing.
Yan Sijing's expression turned vacant, caught in an illusion.
Yuan Ming swept her up with a flick of his sleeve, pulled Xi Ying, and entered the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space, leaving only a bronze incense burner suspended outside.
Then, a flash of white light occurs, and the Stealing Heaven Tripod also vanished without trace.
At the entrance to the Netherworld, the Six Desires Venerable stopped, closed his eyes to sense the position of Yuan Ming and the others, but found nothing.
He stood silently for a few breaths, then turned and flew towards the direction of his physical body.
...
For Yuan Ming, Ni Mu and the others were now his own people, relying on them to clash with the Six Desires first; he wouldn't allow the Divine Soul of the Six Desires Venerable to go back and assist.
He quickly manipulated the Shura Stone Tablet, and white light arose around the Six Desires Venerable, instantly forming a Teleportation Array.
The Divine Soul of the Six Desires Venerable was wrapped by the array, about to be transported away.
At that moment, the Divine Soul of the Six Desires Venerable suddenly split into several dozen streaks of silver light, each containing a silver soul leech, shooting in all directions.
A dazzling white light shot up into the sky, and both the white array and the soul leeches disappeared.
A flash of white light over Yin Capital City, a swarm of soul leeches appeared from thin air, hesitated briefly, then scattered and flew away.
Inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space, Yuan Ming's expression was solemn.
The soul leeches sent to Yin Capital City constituted the majority, but a few managed to break through the white array at the last moment, disappearing into the vast expanse of the sky.
He urged the Shura Stone Tablet's forbidden, trying to sense the position of that few soul leeches.
However, those soul leeches seemed as if they had disappeared, leaving no trace behind.
Not only that, but the soul leeches inside Yin Capital City also gradually vanished, with no clue as to where they went.

chapters.title: Chapter 438 - 415 Void Crystal Stone
chapters.content:
"Strange, where have they all gone?" Yuan Ming's eyebrows furrowed, a sense of unease growing in his heart. He informed Xi Ying of the situation, but Xi Ying was equally puzzled.
"Xi Ying, when you performed a Soul Search on that soul leech earlier, were you able to discover any useful information? For instance, what kind of Soul Cultivation Divine Powers does the Six Desires Venerable possess?" Yuan Ming asked, unwilling to give up hope.
"The Six Desires Venerable's control over memories is far superior to mine. Even a soul leech would be able to hide important information well enough to prevent detection by others. While we cannot grasp the soul cultivation divine powers of Six Desires, I do know some things about the common Sleeping Witch. The core of the Sleeping Witch's powers lies in one word: 'sleep,' which is to put the enemy into a deep slumber rapidly," Xi Ying said with a sigh of resignation.
"Slumber?" Yuan Ming's interest was piqued.
"Do not underestimate this ability; no matter how formidable a person is, once they fall asleep, they are like lambs to the slaughter," Xi Ying said.
"That's true. On a battlefield where situations can change in the blink of an eye, a moment's hesitation can mean the difference between life and death, let alone falling asleep," Yuan Ming agreed profoundly.
"Not only that, but aside from inducing sleep, a Sleeping Witch can also manipulate dreams, and even kill a person within a dream," Xi Ying continued.
"Kill within a dream?" Yuan Ming couldn't help but gasp in surprise, astonishment flooding his heart.
"This is the Sleeping Witch's most common tactic. Once someone falls under the control of a Sleeping Witch's dream, it is difficult to survive, even if their strength exceeds the witch by one or two realms. Therefore, one must never fall asleep when facing a Sleeping Witch!" Xi Ying cautioned.
Hearing this, Yuan Ming's expression grew solemn as he nodded slowly.
Xi Ying said nothing more and went to sit down to one side, closing her eyes to recover her Mana.
Yuan Ming also took out an elixir and swallowed it, continuing to manipulate the restrictions in search of the Six Desires Venerable.
Although he had fought two battles in a row, he had mostly used Soul Cultivation Divine Powers, resulting in little Mana exhaustion, and he recovered quickly. Yet, the Six Desires Venerable still did not appear.
Inside the Spiritual Beast Bag, Hua Zhi was still casting, and it seemed she would not finish anytime soon.
After a brief moment of contemplation, Yuan Ming leapt up to sit on the White Jade Lotus Platform.
He took the Spiritual Beast Bag that held the Three-eyed Crow, placed his palm on it, and began the Beast Taming Secret Technique. Billowing black mist surged out and merged into the bag.
This Three-eyed Crow had extraordinary potential and considerable strength, making it suitable to be his spirit beast.
Of course, Yuan Ming had another reason for subduing this Three-eyed Crow.
While running the Beast Taming Secret Technique, he began casting an Illusion Technique to make the Three-eyed Crow submit and believe in the Nether Moon God.
With only Yan Sijing as his believer inside the Shura Palace, the situation was somewhat perilous. Should anything happen to this woman, he would be unable to influence anything outside from within the Stealing Heaven Tripod. It was crucial to subdue another believer.
Now that Yuan Ming's Soul Power had reached the level of a Sleeping Witch, the Three-eyed Crow had no chance of resisting, and he soon subdued it completely.
He stopped casting and, with a wave of his sleeve, both the Three-eyed Crow and Yan Sijing left the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space and arrived inside the Shura Palace.
Yuan Ming urged the Shura Stone Tablet, and a flash of white light surrounded them, vanishing from their spots.
The very next moment, the Three-eyed Crow appeared at the entrance of netherworld, while Yan Sijing materialized in the middle of Yin Capital City.
He spread his Divine Sense through the anchors of their desire powers.
With the Divine Sense reinforced by the Stealing Heaven Tripod, the search might be more effective than even the Shura Palace's restrictions, and he might be able to locate the whereabouts of the Six Desires Venerable's soul leech.
Black light emanated from the third eye on the Three-eyed Crow's forehead, scanning in all directions.
This was the power of the Three-eyed Crow's third eye: the ability to see through Illusion Techniques, disguises, restrictions, and more—a capability the Heavenly Ghost Wanderer arrogantly named 'the Illusion-breaking Demon Eyes'.
Although the name might sound presumptuous, the third eye of the Three-eyed Crow truly deserved it.
This demon eye was a natural mutation, far more powerful than that of an ordinary Three-eyed Crow. The Heavenly Ghost Wanderer somehow found a cultivation method for the Spiritual Eye that allowed it to absorb Illusion Power to grow stronger.
For a long period in the past, the Heavenly Ghost Wanderer cast illusion spells on the Three-eyed Crow daily to help increase its Pupil Power. Accumulated day by day, there was already a considerable buildup.
Yuan Ming's Divine Sense spread out and quickly scanned both Yin Capital City and the vicinity of the entrance to the Netherworld, finding nothing.
Undiscouraged, he shifted their positions and continued the search.
At that moment, Hua Zhi also finally completed her preliminary analysis of the Silver Vine.
"Master, according to my exploration, this Silver Vine not only can manipulate Space Power but also affect the instantaneous movement of the Shura Palace's restrictions or even traverse through the Void. It's a spatial type of demon beast, with inscrutable and formidable power, no less than the Blood Willow," she reported.
"Anything else?" Yuan Ming nodded and inquired.
"That's all I can discern for now," Hua Zhi replied with a shake of her head.
"Knowing this much is already good. If I'm not mistaken, that Silver Vine is likely the Six Desires Venerable's spirit beast. I'm beginning to understand why those soul leeches of the Six Desires Venerable disappeared — they've probably been taken away by the Silver Vine breaking through the Void," Xi Ying opened her eyes and said.
Hearing this, just as Yuan Ming was about to say something, the spirit light on the Shura Stone Tablet suddenly flickered.
Yuan Ming quickly began casting to investigate, and his expression immediately darkened.
He discovered that the instantaneous movement restriction within the Shura Stone Tablet was no longer usable, and the other restrictions were also greatly compromised.
"Has something happened?" Xi Ying frowned and asked.
Yuan Ming did not conceal anything and told Xi Ying about the situation while he stimulated the probing restriction.
This time, it was not futile. The probing restriction found something unusual near the Black Tower, where the Spiritual Energy fluctuations were quite strong.
"Let me out. You are currently unable to use the Instantaneous Movement restriction. I have a Flying Magical Treasure that can quickly get us to the Black Tower," Xi Ying said.
Yuan Ming immediately waved his hand, releasing Xi Ying.
Xi Ying lightly waved her sleeves, and a flying car made entirely of lustrous white material appeared. It seemed to be crafted from the skeleton of a demon beast. An engraved image of a flying bird adorned the body, and two pairs of wings fitted on either side, with runes fluttering on them, gave off the elegant impression of being ready to dissolve into the wind at any moment.
Xi Ying put away the Stealing Heaven Tripod, landed on the flying car, and began casting the mnemonic.
The flying car turned into a white rainbow, breaking through the sky to fly away. Its speed far surpassed that of a Core Formation Stage cultivator's Flying Escape, almost matching the likes of Dugu Feng and Thunderbolt Ancestor.
"I didn't expect you to have such an impressive Flying Magical Treasure," Yuan Ming praised.
"This treasure is known as the Kunpeng Flying Car. I accidentally obtained a Kunpeng skeleton in a relic years ago and had it refined into this vehicle. It's a pity that my Mana is currently not sufficient; otherwise, the tunneling speed would be even faster," Xi Ying said, pouring more Mana into it.
The location where the two were positioned was not too far from the Black Tower, and they quickly arrived with the speed of the Kunpeng Flying Car.
A figure was already standing before the Black Tower—it was Yan Sijing.
The space above Yin Capital City was not extensive, and Yuan Ming had already quickly finished probing it earlier, relocating that woman to the space where the Black Tower was located.
Yan Sijing happened to be near the Black Tower, and so she arrived first.
Yuan Ming activated his Divine Sense, probing inside the Black Tower, quickly looking through all four layers without finding anything unusual.
His brows furrowed as he extended his Divine Sense to scan the surroundings.
The area within a few dozen miles of the Black Tower was quickly examined but nothing was discovered, so Yuan Ming stretched his Divine Sense toward the depths below.
His Divine Sense descended five hundred yards, but still, he found nothing.
"Could it really have been a mistake?" Yuan Ming thought, but he chose to trust his judgment and continued to extend his reach to the depths below.
When his Divine Sense sank to nine hundred yards, his eyes brightened, finally discovering something.
Below, a sizeable Stone Chamber had been created within the earth, and inside it lay a Blood-colored Coffin.
Yuan Ming's Divine Sense was omnipresent, easily penetrating the interior of the Blood-colored Coffin. Inside lay a corpse that had not yet decayed, and by appearance, it was indeed the body of the Shura Master.
Near the Blood-colored Coffin, a Silver Crystal Stone the size of a human head floated, brilliantly shining and illuminating the entire chamber.
A silver-robed man in his twenties stood next to the crystal stone. With small eyes and a large mouth, his appearance was quite ugly. His goldfish eyes rolled around wildly, giving off the impression of being as crafty as a fox.
Sоurсеd dirесtly frоm МV6LЕМР6YR.
This man was missing an arm; the sleeve was empty and hanging loosely. His left hand had transformed into several Silver Vines, wrapping around the Silver Crystal Stone.
The Six Desires Venerable, in his Divine Soul state, stood beside him, with one hand pressed on the crystal stone and silver light flickering in his palm.
"Who would have thought that within the Shura Palace there would be such a large Void Crystal Stone? I was wondering, with the strength of the Shura Master at the Returning to Void Stage, how could it be possible to create such a vast space? It turns out to be because of this treasure!" the Six Desires Venerable exclaimed joyfully.
"The master's fortune reaches the sky. With this Void Crystal Stone, you can accumulate enough contribution points with the Wu Yue God and exchange for the mantra of the Seventh Layer of the Six Desires Breaking Emotion Great Method," the silver-robed man said.
Hearing this, the Six Desires Venerable laughed heartily, extremely pleased with himself.
"While that is true, the Void Crystal Stone and this space have already fused into one. It's not easy to take it away. I have already used the Soul Leech to reside within the crystal stone and have cut off the connection between the Void Crystal Stone and the prohibition of the Shura Palace's space. You should use your Space Divine Power to extract this stone quickly, lest Xiao Ying and the person behind her arrive, and it becomes troublesome," the Six Desires Venerable said, his laughter abruptly stopping.
"Understood," the silver-robed man responded, as strands of silver light appeared on the Silver Vines that his arm had become, pouring continuously into the Void Crystal Stone.
"So they went to dig up the Void Stone, no wonder they couldn't be found there!" A sharp gleam flashed through Yuan Ming's eyes.
He discussed tactics with Xi Ying and then activated the Shura Stone Tablet, causing a thick white fog to reappear around the Black Tower. Within the fog, more strands of prohibition light emerged.
"Not good, the restrictions near the Black Tower have been activated, they are here!" the Six Desires Venerable suddenly looked up from within the Stone Chamber underground.
Yuan Ming's brow lifted slightly as he took out the Soul Destroying Sword without hesitation, activating the Curse Rune on it.
After his Divine Soul was restored by Xi Ying with a secret technique, not only had his Soul Power greatly increased, but his entire Divine Soul had become much more tenacious. He was now able to barely withstand the Soul Sword and the backlash of the Curse Rune.
Instantly, a powerful Curse Power broke through the air and entered the body of the silver-robed man.
The silver-robed man showed a look of pain, and his demonic power drastically dropped by a small realm.
"Ouch! That person is back again. Such attacks are unforeseeable. What kind of monster has Six Desires provoked, no good, no good! A place of conflict is no place to stay!"
The silver-robed man's eyes rolled frantically, not bothering to collect the Void Crystal Stone anymore, he flashed with silver light, and astonishingly, directly escaped into the Void.

chapters.title: Chapter 439 - 416 Battle Against the Six Desires
chapters.content:
"Don't go! I can handle this person, come back!" the Six Desires Venerable urgently shouted.
His spirit beast had an extraordinary origin, and its innate divine ability was even more formidable, but its only flaw was that it was too timid, to the extent that it would turn and flee at the slightest sign of danger. Additionally, since the spirit beast possessed the ability to enter the void at any time, not even his beast taming secret technique could restrain it.
The silver-robed man had no intention of listening. Before the Six Desires Venerable could finish speaking, he had already dashed deep into the void and disappeared without a trace.
The Six Desires Venerable swore furiously, a glint of spirit light flashing between his brows as several silver soul threads shot out, chasing after the silver-robed man.
However, a shadow flickered above the stone chamber, and a slash of black sword qi tore through the air, cleanly severing the silver soul threads.
The sword qi did not stop there, continuing its trajectory toward the Six Desires Venerable's head.
The Six Desires Venerable had already calmed down from the silver-robed man's escape, knowing that the beast would not run far. As long as he could kill Xi Ying and the others, there would be plenty of time to collect the void crystal stones.
"Such mediocre capabilities, and you dare to come forth and show yourselves!" the Six Desires Venerable sneered slightly, his right hand swiftly reached out, easily grasping the black sword qi.
A flash of silver at his fingertips, the black sword qi was forcibly crushed.
The Six Desires Venerable looked upward, his figure suddenly transforming into a beam of silver light shooting up, the soil having no effect on him. He burst through the earth layer in the blink of an eye.
Sensing the situation below, Xi Ying immediately controlled the Kunpeng Flying Car to move back, releasing a beam of golden light from her hand—the Golden Dragon Scissors.
A resounding dragon's roar echoed, and two golden flood dragons appeared out of thin air. Just as the Six Desires Venerable was emerging from the ground, they slashed across his waist.
The Golden Dragon Scissors, refined by a previous generation's Golden Dragon Venerable, had slain countless lives. Though a magic practitioner's treasure, it was imbued with a strong essence of Yin Evil Power, highly damaging to the Divine Soul as well.
"Ha! If it were the Golden Dragon Venerable wielding this treasure, I might have some reservations, but you—a mere Core Formation Stage cultivator—think you can harm me with it?" the Six Desires Venerable revealed a cold smile, as a burst of silver light radiated explosively from his body, spreading out at an astonishing speed.
Engulfed by the silver light, the Golden Dragon Scissors and the flood dragons took on a personified look of weariness, closing their eyes as all the golden light dissipated, reverting back to the form of golden scissors and falling downwards.
Xi Ying and Yan Sijing were also submerged by the silver light. Xi Ying's forehead shone with golden light, forming a golden protective shield around her, barely holding off the silver light but showing a tired expression, half-kneeling on the Flying Car.Find the translation on MV&LEMPYR.
Yan Sijing, lacking such means, was invaded by the silver light, falling unconscious to the ground without even a whimper.
Xi Ying's expression shifted slightly, a trace of panic flashed in her eyes, but she swiftly regained her composure.
Her fleeting change in expression was nonetheless caught by the watchful eyes of the Six Desires Venerable.
"Although I don't know what trickery you're up to, you always have that Core Formation Stage girl with you everywhere you go. She must be an essential component for that Sleep Witch backing you to enact her measures, right? Without her, let's see what tricks you have left!" the Six Desires Venerable sneered, his figure flashing like lightning to appear above the Flying Car.
A black giant palm shot out from his body, slamming down harshly towards Xi Ying and Yan Sijing—it was the same divine skill he had used to kill Wan Qi Hong before.
The black giant palm, formed of condensed Soul Power, was not inferior to any Mana attack, making the void solidify wherever it passed.
"Great Black Sky God Palm!"
Xi Ying's expression shifted slightly, her brow shining with golden light as a gigantic three-legged bird ablaze with golden flames burst forth, resembling the legendary Three-legged Golden Crow. It collided with the black giant palm.
A thunderous explosion resounded!
The three-legged bird was sent flying, its flames largely extinguished by the shock, while the black giant palm remained unscathed, continuing its assault on Xi Ying.
Xi Ying turned pale but did not panic, her hands forming spell gestures like turning wheels.
A small black kettle appeared above her head, the Soul Suppressing Kettle, with its lid shooting off.
A burst of golden light erupted from within it, producing a shocking surge in Soul Power that greatly surpassed Xi Ying's own, merging into her body.
Xi Ying's Soul Power surged, reaching the realm of the Mid-stage Sleep Witch.
The three-legged bird cried out resoundingly, doubling in size instantly, managing to hold off the black giant palm.
"The Soul Suppressing Kettle! This treasure has been missing for thousands of years, where did you find it?" The Six Desires Venerable disregarded the significantly empowered three-legged bird; his gaze fixated on the Soul Suppressing Kettle, his face a mixture of shock and elation.
As he spoke, the black giant palm changed direction, reaching for the Soul Suppressing Kettle but was once again blocked by the flapping wings of the golden bird.
However, a flash of black light on the Six Desires Venerable's body revealed another black giant palm, emerging suddenly and snatching at the Soul Suppressing Kettle with the speed of lightning, pulling it towards him.
Xi Ying's expression remained unchanged, the corner of her mouth even curling slightly. She perfected her spell gestures and uttered a low shout, "Return!"
A dark light shone from the mouth of the kettle, a swirling black vortex like a nebula appeared, from which an astonishing attractive force emanated, encompassing the black giant palm.
The Soul Power within the black giant palm began to disperse, being sucked into the Soul Suppressing Kettle.
The giant palm quickly grew thin, the Soul Suppressing Kettle steadied itself, and then flew back towards Xi Ying.
"Indeed, the Soul Suppressing Kettle can absorb all Soul Power, it's a pity you cannot wield its full power. Hand it over to this venerable one!" The Six Desires Venerable said delightedly rather than alarmed, flicking his fingers and shooting a beam of silver light towards Xi Ying.
A strong fear toward the Six Desires Venerable surged in Xi Ying's heart, when suddenly a voice rang out in her mind, "Why aren't you running yet? The Six Desires Venerable is a peerless Soul Cultivator of three thousand years; how could you possibly be his match? Do you want to fall here, with no place for your body to rest in death?"
"Nonsense! The Six Desires Venerable is already in his twilight years, his mind muddled; what's there to fear? By killing him, not only will all the treasures of the Shura Palace be ours, but we will also become renowned and make the name Xi Ying remembered throughout the Yunhuang Continent!" another voice arose.
"Why do you have to fight to the death with the Six Desires Venerable? Instead of enjoying good days, you really don't know what's good for you!"
"Why are you only thinking about fighting to the death? Don't you want to understand the full picture of the Shura Palace? I think there must be other secrets here."
"Alas, Xi Ying, you act so rudely and speak coldly, how could you possibly win Yuan Ming's favor?"
Then three other voices joined in, talking in a clamor.
Xi Ying felt a surge of different emotions in her heart, causing her mind to be in great disorder. Her mana and soul power were both starting to flow less smoothly.
The Soul Suppressing Kettle's spirit light scattered, and its suction power decreased significantly. It was once again pulled by the black giant palm and flying towards the Six Desires Venerable.
Xi Ying's cheeks were pale, and blood seeped from her seven orifices. Her eyes were even more vacant, and the situation was extremely dire.
Within the Stealing Heaven Tripod, Yuan Ming, through his soul splitting, saw Xi Ying's condition and became very anxious.
However, at this moment, Yan Sijing was unconscious, and he simply was unable to influence the outside situation, left only to feel helpless.
Just then, a Three-eyed Crow appeared in the distant sky, rapidly flying over.
Yuan Ming was overjoyed. His Divine Sense surged out through the Three-eyed Crow's Desire Power anchor point, enveloping Xi Ying and penetrating into her Sea of Consciousness.
He waved his hands, performing gestures as if paying respects to the gods.
This was a secret technique from the Heart Cleansing Technique, designed to help stabilize another's Divine Soul.
With Yuan Ming's assistance, Xi Ying felt invigorated. The chaotic soul power in her Sea of Consciousness recovered slightly.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming was pleased and continued casting.
At that moment, a strong suction force emerged from Xi Ying's Divine Soul, drawing Yuan Ming's Divine Sense and even his Soul Power rapidly into it.
The two soul powers merged, turning into a flow of coolness and warmth, somewhat similar to when Xi Ying had healed him while he was unconscious before.
Yuan Ming had an idea. Rather than absorbing these two flows, he sent them towards Xi Ying instead.
Xi Ying's Divine Soul absorbed the two flows and immediately felt a surge of rejuvenating power, her disordered soul power quickly stabilizing, and the glint in her eyes reigniting.
A dense black light lit up on the Soul Suppressing Kettle, resisting the pull of the black giant palm.
"How is this possible! You actually managed to neutralize my Six Desires Power!" the Six Desires Venerable said in a deep voice, seemingly greatly shocked.
"There are many things you don't know, prepare to die!" Xi Ying's eyes flashed with a complex expression before returning to calm as she formed a spell with her fingers.
From within the Soul Suppressing Kettle, a transforming black light spewed out, enveloping the black giant palm in reverse.
The Six Desires Venerable suddenly found himself surrounded by illusions, almost getting lost in them, and urgently cultivated his power to stabilize his mind.
Inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod, nearly half of Yuan Ming's Soul Power was absorbed by Xi Ying, bringing forth a wave of exhaustion. However, he suppressed the feeling and once again injected mana and Soul Power into the Curse Rune.
A strong Curse Power fell, pouring into the Six Desires Venerable's body.
After this attack, he sat temporarily paralyzed on the White Jade Lotus Platform, absorbing Desire Power to restore his Soul Power, unable to continue attacking.
The Six Desires Venerable let out a pained grunt, his soul power decreasing further.
He had already been hit by a Curse Rune attack previously, significantly dissipating his soul power. Now hit a second time, his Divine Soul Power finally fell to the mid-stage of a Sleep Witch.
"Damn it! Could I have been wrong, thinking that the hidden Sleep Witch couldn't attack without Yan Sijing's help?" The Six Desires Venerable worriedly expanded his Divine Sense, looking back over his shoulder.
A dozen miles away from the Black Tower, the Three-eyed Crow hovered in the air, slowly circling.
"I see, it's the attack carried out with the help of that strange three-eyed bird?" The Six Desires Venerable realized, his eyes flickering with a shadow.
Having suffered repeated heavy blows and greatly weakened, he stood little chance against two Sleep Witches simultaneously. He forcibly gathered his Soul Power, suppressed the remaining Curse Power within, and a silver light flickered between his eyebrows.
Seven or eight soul leeches shot out, splitting in two directions—heading towards the Soul Suppressing Kettle and the Three-eyed Crow respectively.
Xi Ying's soul power had already stabilized, and she began forming spells with her fingers.
The Three-legged Golden Crow, tangled with another black giant palm, released a brilliant golden light from its wings, flinging the black giant palm away and spitting a translucent golden flame at several soul leeches, blocking their path.
The lead soul leech touched the golden flames and "sizzled" into nothingness.
"Burning Divine Soul!" The Six Desires Venerable's face showed shock as he quickly manipulated the other soul leeches to stop and dodge to the side.
Xi Ying did not direct the Three-legged Golden Crow to pursue, but instead took out a black iron flute and began to play.
A series of whimpering flute sounds echoed nearby, not only devoid of any melody but also grating like sawing wood or scraping an iron pot, extremely unpleasant to hear.
Upon hearing the flute sound, the Six Desires Venerable suddenly froze in place, with strands of black mist seeping out of his body. His soul power continuously decreased, as if suffering from some terrible affliction.

chapters.title: Chapter 440 - 417: Cross-Dimensional Cooperation
chapters.content:
Inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
Yuan Ming had achieved some recovery in his Soul Power through the transformation of Desire Power, but he was immediately surprised when he heard the sound of the flute played by Xi Ying.
After listening to the tune, he felt nothing but its discordance, never expecting that the Six Desires Venerable would suffer considerable damage and even have his mind controlled upon hearing it!
It appeared that the flute was an Exotic Treasure, specifically sought by Xi Ying to deal with the Six Desires Venerable.
With the Six Desires Venerable under the flute's control, the two giant black palms instantly collapsed, and both the Three-legged Golden Crow and the Soul Suppressing Kettle flew back to Xi Ying's side.
The Soul Suppressing Kettle floated above Xi Ying's head, emitting a black halo that enveloped her body.
Aside from refining Soul Power, the Soul Suppressing Kettle also had the effect of suppressing Divine Souls. Xi Ying's Divine Soul completely calmed down, and the sawing sound of the flute grew much louder. The Six Desires Venerable's Soul Power dispersed even faster, trending toward a significant reduction to the early stages of the Sleeping Witch.
All of a sudden, a green gleam flashed in the eyes of the Six Desires Venerable and a muffled explosion-like sound came from within his body; the next moment, he regained his ability to move.
He didn't bother fighting for the Soul Suppressing Kettle and turned to fly far away.
"Quick, stop him, don't let him escape!" Xi Ying's voice reached Yuan Ming through her soul splitting.
"He won't get away!" Yuan Ming sneered slightly and triggered the Shura Stone Tablet.
The mist near the Black Tower grew denser once again, forming a substantial wall of fog, and with the Black Tower at its center, a vast expanse of white foggy space was created.
Xi Ying waved her hand and a Silver Token shot out, landing within the expanse of white fog.
Brilliant silver light surged from the Token, and in just a moment, a silver barrier formed within the massive space of white fog.
The Six Desires Venerable slammed into the silver barrier with a "bang," rebounded back, his face showing fleeting expressions of fear and anxiety as a black light flashed over his body.
A giant black palm shot out, striking toward the silver barrier.
Yuan Ming's heart shuddered, and he hastily deployed the Divine Skill "Emotion Manipulation," inciting various emotions in the heart of the Six Desires Venerable.
His Soul Power had greatly declined, on par with Yuan Ming's, and his emotions were even more unstable; "Emotion Manipulation" easily grabbed hold of his fear and anxiety, amplifying them.
The Six Desires Venerable's mind instantly became chaotic, he briefly lost his rationale, and the giant black palm stopped several feet away from the silver barrier.
Xi Ying took the opportunity to form a spell and pointed toward the void below; the Golden Dragon Scissors on the ground shot out, transforming into two colossal, glaring Flood Dragons that covered dozens of feet in an instant, slicing across the body of the Six Desires Venerable.
The body of the Six Desires Venerable was cut in two. While no blood gushed out, both halves of the body exploded violently, turning into currents of Soul Power that flew in all directions.
Yuan Ming's heart settled, a wave of Soul Power descended, transforming into a surge that hit Yan Sijing.
Yan Sijing's body trembled and she awakened.
Yuan Ming had already instructed her that the moment her consciousness became clear, she was to constantly pray to the Lord Nether Moon God. With this thought, Yan Sijing felt a jolt in her heart, immediately sat up, and prayed to the Nether Moon God.
Yuan Ming swung the Soul Destroying Sword, sending out waves of Sword Qi, then appeared out of nowhere within the silver barrier and struck at the scattered Soul Power of the Six Desires Venerable.
Xi Ying reached out and fetched a light golden talisman, with golden arcs flickering on its surface, radiating the astonishing Power of Thunder and Lightning.
Yuan Ming's Divine Sense had already permeated the entire silver space, but it was cut piece by piece near Xi Ying, evaporating like snow under the fierce sun, disappearing without a trace, which shocked Yuan Ming and made him hastily control his Divine Sense to avoid approaching Xi Ying.
Xi Ying crushed the talisman in her grip, and dozens of golden arcs shot out in an instant, each targeting the scattered Divine Souls of the Six Desires Venerable, as if they had eyes, and their speed was also astonishing.
