With continuous "zzzt" sounds, wherever the golden arcs swept through, the scattered Soul Power of the Six Desires Venerable instantly turned into green smoke.
In the blink of an eye, the majority of the Six Desires Venerable's Divine Soul was destroyed, with only a tiny amount of Soul Power enveloping a couple of soul leeches barely surviving, desperately trying to burrow into the silver barrier.
However, the silver barrier blocked everything; the soul leeches were unable to break through.
A joy flashed in Yuan Ming's eyes, and he flipped his hand to summon the Thunder God Hammer.
Boom, boom, boom!
A blinding flash of lightning burst forth within the silver barrier, striking the residual soul of the Six Desires Venerable.
Although the Power of Thunder and Lightning emitted by the Thunder God Hammer was not as powerful as Xi Ying's Golden Thunder, it still had a restraining effect on Soul Power. The Six Desires Venerable's residual soul let out a shriek and, along with the two soul leeches, turned into green smoke.
Still not reassured, Yuan Ming waved the Thunder God Hammer non-stop, sending down streaks of silver lightning, which traveled everywhere within the silver barrier, continuing until the fragments of the Six Desires Venerable's Soul Power were also entirely obliterated, only then did he stop.
The white fog around the Black Tower dissipated, and the silver barrier collapsed with a bang.
"Are you alright? Do you need to use the soul cultivators healing secret technique again? There is an abundance of Desire Power within the White Jade Lotus Platform, so you should not worry about me. Feel free to use my Soul Power to recover," Yuan Ming appeared beside Xi Ying with a concerned inquiry.
Xi Ying's Soul Power had fully recovered, but her cheeks were still somewhat pale.
Through the recent healing, Yuan Ming had basically figured out the fundamental principle of the healing secret technique mentioned by Xi Ying, which was essentially refining the Soul Power of the other party to nourish oneself.
He had the Stealing Heaven Tripod, which could restore Soul Power at any time, so it did not matter how much of his Soul Power Xi Ying refined.
"No need, I am already much better," Xi Ying said without turning her head, her expression somewhat strange as she looked forward.
After entering the Shura Palace, Yuan Ming had noticed various peculiar things and actions from Xi Ying, but he had become accustomed to it and didn't give it much thought.
"That lightning talisman was truly formidable, almost completely countering the Divine Skills of the Six Desires," Yuan Ming remarked with some admiration.
"That talisman was given to me by the Shura Master as a reward for passing the illusion test. As for the black flute, it's called the Nightmare Demon Flute. Once played, it can cause a person's Three Souls and Seven Spirits to temporarily separate and not unite, making one feel as if they've entered a nightmare, vulnerable to manipulation, with their Soul Power naturally seeping out," explained Xi Ying, noticing Yuan Ming's interest in the two items.
"This Nightmare Demon Flute is indeed an Exotic Treasure. Without it, our encounter with the Six Desires would have been much more difficult," Yuan Ming nodded thoughtfully, understanding the situation.
The Shura Master had already discovered the Six Desires Venerable lurking in secret and had provided a talisman to Xi Ying, prepared in advance to counter the Divine Soul Skills, aiding her in exterminating the Six Desires Venerable.
The operation to surround the Six Desires could be considered a plan devised by both the past Shura Master and the present Xi Ying, spanning time and space to cooperate in action, which naturally also involved quite a bit of luck, and Yuan Ming himself had inadvertently become embroiled in it, but he too had played a significant role.
"This flute's effect is strong, but it has one prerequisite: only those whose Divine Souls are injured will be affected by its sound. The more severe the injury, the stronger the effect. Conversely, if the Divine Soul is unharmed, the Nightmare Demon Flute will be useless, even against ordinary mortals, and the owner of the flute, whether injured or not, is immune to its influence," Xi Ying added.Thi-s te.x&t was acqui!r!ed. fr+o@m. **.#
Yuan Ming thought to himself that, although this black flute had stringent conditions for use, if used skillfully, it could be extraordinarily effective.
"Regardless, the Divine Soul of the Six Desires Venerable has been extinguished by us, everything is finally coming to an end," he said with a sigh of relief.
"It's not time to relax yet. As long as a single soul leech remains, the Six Desires can revive at any time. Back then, the Shura Master was careless for a moment and failed to find all the soul leeches, which allowed the Six Desires to survive by luck," Xi Ying shook her head and said.
Yuan Ming nodded, taking a mental note to stay alert.
The Six Desires was a monster that had evaded death even from the Shura Master in the Returning to Void Stage; Yuan Ming absolutely could not afford to be careless.
Seeing Yuan Ming's demeanor become serious again, Xi Ying did not remind him further. Instead, she slapped her Storage Bag, took out a white Cloud Disk, and with a flick of her fingers, images of her and Yuan Ming appeared on it, along with seven or eight points of light lighting up, one of which was right under their feet.
"This is a Magic Treasure that I specially had someone refine for tracking the location of the Six Desires soul leeches," she explained upon seeing Yuan Ming's curious gaze.
"So these points of light are his soul leeches? This one so close to us, could it be attached to the Void Stone?" Yuan Ming stroked his chin, a glint in his eye.
The two immediately returned to the underground Stone Chamber where the Void Stone was located. Looking at the Void Stone suspended beside the sarcophagus, Xi Ying had a thought, and a red Fire Phoenix flew out from her Sea of Consciousness, shooting into the Void Stone.
An orange flame instantly enveloped the Void Stone. Amidst the intense Burning, a silver soul leech suddenly drilled out from the Void Stone and was reduced to ashes by the flames.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming's brow twitched. He could sense that the flames enveloping the Void Stone were transformed from Soul Power, which might not have been so powerful against a Physical Body, but the damage they could inflict on a soul body was beyond imagination.
Perhaps that red Fire Phoenix was Xi Ying's Divine Soul Transformation.
As he pondered this, suddenly his expression changed, and he summoned the Shura Stone Tablet, discovering it had returned to normal.
"You can control the forbidden powers of the Shura Palace again? Then quickly seal this space completely, don't let that silver man escape," Xi Ying glanced at Yuan Ming and reminded him.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming immediately activated the Barrier, immobilizing the entire space of the Shura Palace. Unless someone used the palace's own Teleportation Array, no one could use the Space Power to move freely.
Of course, the distance Yuan Ming could move instantaneously through the barrier had been significantly reduced, but compared to letting the silver man escape, this drawback was trivial.
Then, Yuan Ming focused his mind, searching every corner of the Shura Palace through the control of the forbidden powers, and soon, a look of surprise flashed across his face.
"It seems Ni Mu's two subordinates have been controlled by the Six Desires and are now attacking him. He's in a bit of a tight spot; should we go help him right now?" Yuan Ming looked towards Xi Ying.
Xi Ying furrowed her brow as she thought for a moment, then asked,: "What is Ni Mu using to fend off his attackers?"
"...What is he using? Naturally, it's Magic Treasures and Spells; what else could it be?" Yuan Ming was utterly puzzled.
However, Xi Ying simply smiled mysteriously and shook her head, "Then we don't need to intervene. He still has an ace up his sleeve, and for dealing with the Physical Body of the Six Desires, it should be more than enough."
Yuan Ming nodded dubiously and checked on Ni Mu's situation once more. Seeing that he was struggling but not seriously hurt, he took Xi Ying's word for it and dropped the subject of providing assistance.

chapters.title: Chapter 441 - 418 Tongchen
chapters.content:
In the sky, three meteors fell in a "品" shape, trailing white tails like fireworks, hurtling towards Ni Mu.
By Ni Mu's side, seven or eight giant butterflies, each half the height of a man, were flapping their wings, and the fine dust fell like fragments, swirling in the wind that sealed off Ni Mu's retreat and pressed straight towards his face.
Faced with the predicament, Ni Mu appeared calm as still water, not overly flustered.
His fingers moved swiftly through the air, and the Bronze Treasure Mirror floating next to him spun, instantly emitting over a dozen beams of blue light, aiming at the meteors and the enveloping winds.
After coming in contact with the blue light, the meteors and the winds rapidly diminished, quickly shrinking to a quarter or fifth of their original size, and the once-frightening dust and light now became faint and dim.
Immediately after, Ni Mu pinched a spell, and a small ball covered with icicles appeared in front of him; with a thought, the icicles shot out, absorbing moisture from the air and gradually swelling to the thickness of an arm, easily scattering the weakened meteors and winds.
However, no sooner had he resolved one wave of attacks than he saw Wu Yuezhi move chess pieces and place eight white stones on the Heavenly Star Chessboard.
The sound of "swoosh, swoosh" intensified!
With that, more meteors fell from the sky, enveloped in spirit light and taking the form of giant swords, slashing fiercely at Ni Mu.
Not far away, a glamorous woman also made her move, a long centipede-like creature flying out from her hair, spewing out a green poisonous mist from its mouth, which, along with the wind generated by the seven or eight butterflies, surged towards Ni Mu.
Seeing this, Ni Mu's pupils suddenly contracted.
If he didn't truly resolve the issue with Wu Yuezhi and the other person, he would never be able to break free from the predicament.
As thoughts raced through his mind, Ni Mu continued to calmly activate the Bronze Treasure Mirror to counter the onslaught from Wu Yuezhi and the other.
At this time, the backup plan he stored in his Storage Bag had already absorbed enough Spiritual Energy, ready to be deployed at any moment, yet he still waited for the right opportunity with an unfathomable gaze, unwilling to reveal his edge despite being weary from responding to the attacks.
Your support at * keeps the series going.
His real enemies were not Wu Yuezhi and the other person but the Six Desires Venerable standing behind them.
The Six Desires Venerable, noticing Ni Mu's cautious stance, revealed a sneer at the corners of his mouth while manipulating Wu Yuezhi and the companion to besiege Ni Mu with Illusion Techniques, not making a move himself and playing a cat-and-mouse game.
Though it seemed overly confident, in reality, he was also trying to buy time to heal the injuries on his body.
The Gu Technique of the glamorous woman, though not life-threatening, had ultimately hurt his Primordial Qi a bit.
But for the Six Desires Venerable, the physical body was merely a garment that could be changed at any time; he would not care about the severity of injuries if not for the time needed to adapt and integrate with each new body.
As long as his Divine Soul was unharmed and the soul leech remained, he could live forever.
However, suddenly, the Six Desires Venerable's expression stiffened, immediately turning his head to look toward the Black Tower, a trace of astonishment in his eyes.
How is it possible that the Divine Soul is dead? Who exactly is...
The news of the main soul's demise caused him a momentary lapse of concentration, which also allowed Ni Mu to keenly detect a flaw in the Six Desires Venerable's flesh.
A gleam flashed in Ni Mu's eyes, and with a light tap of his right hand on the Storage Bag, he took out a palm-sized azure mirror—it was the Thousand Illusion Treasure Mirror he had obtained at the Yin Capital City Lord Mansion.
The Thousand Illusion Treasure Mirror was vastly different from Ni Mu's Bronze Treasure Mirror, its appearance resembling flowing water, barely maintaining an oval shape, making it look as if it could dissolve into a pool of water at any moment.
A layer of hazy mist lingered on the mirror's surface, veil-like, and if one looked too long, it would induce a dizzying effect, appearing quite mystical.
Ni Mu raised the mirror and swiped his hand across it, uttering a soft "go." The center of the Thousand Illusion Treasure Mirror instantly lit up with a spirit light, then abruptly split open. Its form disintegrated, dividing into two streams of mutually repelling blue mist, moving with the speed of Instantaneous Movement, heading straight for Wu Yuezhi and the companion.
In the blink of an eye, the two mists reached Wu Yuezhi and the other, entering their Seas of Consciousness before they could react.
The next instant, blue light shone in the eyes of Wu Yuezhi and the companion, and both froze in mid-air, unable to move even a little bit.
Without their control, Ni Mu easily evaded the meteors and winds, then set Mana ablaze and dashed towards the Six Desires Venerable.
All this happened in the blink of an eye, and by now the Six Desires Venerable had also come back to his senses.
He noticed the change in the situation and while somewhat surprised by Ni Mu's skills, there was still a hint of disdain in his eyes.
Nonetheless, he was not foolhardy enough to underestimate his opponent, and facing the oncoming Ni Mu, he opened his mouth to spit out, finally summoning his Magic Treasure.
That was a folding fan engulfed in purple flames.
The fan's surface looked like human skin, its ribs resembling human bones, and at the handle, two thumb-sized skull heads with empty eyes shone with a dim light. Their jawbones opened and closed, emitting mocking laughter as if they were alive.
Upon witnessing this, Ni Mu's gaze sharpened, yet his momentum did not waver. With a light tap, he reached into his Storage Bag at his waist, and a blinding Golden Light instantly fell into his palm.
Immediately afterward, the Golden Light spread rapidly over his body, and in a mere moment, it enveloped him entirely, before solidifying into form.
In less than a breath's time, a suit of gleaming Golden Iron Armor had covered Ni Mu's entire body, revealing only his eyes and mouth and nose, without a single crack elsewhere.
Seeing this, the Six Desires Venerable became more cautious, directly lifting his hand to grasp the Purple Flame Bone Fan, opening it with a swish, and waving it in front of him.
In an instant, a boundless sea of purple ghostly fire surged from the fan, turning into an enormous skull the size of seven or eight people in midair, issuing a silent roar at Ni Mu.
Facing this scene, Ni Mu did not dodge or avoid. Like a moth to a flame, he charged directly into the mouth of the skull.
A flicker of surprise crossed the eyes of the Six Desires Venerable, and immediately after, that flicker of surprise turned to shock.
In midair, a flash of Golden Light suddenly appeared at the Purple Flame skull's mouth, then rapidly spread, transforming all the flames it touched into Golden Iron.
The Six Desires Venerable had no time to react, as the giant Purple Flame skull completely turned into a statue radiating dazzling Golden Light.
Simultaneously, Ni Mu flew out of the skull's mouth, and he was now less than thirty feet away from the Six Desires Venerable, nearly upon him in an instant.
Seeing this, the Six Desires Venerable's figure explosively retreated while he raised one hand and waved the Bone Fan in his hand. The Soul Power from his Sea of Consciousness also surged out, attempting to use an Illusion Technique to stop Ni Mu's charge.
However, whether it was the Purple Flame or the formless Soul Power, when they came into contact with Ni Mu in his armor, they turned into Golden Iron in the blink of an eye.
Ni Mu moved through the Golden Iron effortlessly, as if swimming in the ocean, not only unimpeded but even accelerating by a fraction.
The Six Desires Venerable wanted to deploy another tactic, but Ni Mu had already caught up to him, flying directly in front of him, silent and determined, he threw a punch.
The Six Desires Venerable tried to dodge by tilting his head, but at that moment, he found that his body too had become rigid and clumsy, as if it had turned into Golden Iron.
In the next instant, Ni Mu's fist struck the Six Desires Venerable's face with a force not lesser than that of a Body Cultivation practitioner, and with just one blow, the Six Desires Venerable's head exploded into bits.
While those pieces were still in the air, one by one, they turned into metallic fragments emanating Golden Light. As for the Six Desires Venerable's headless body, it too turned into a Golden Iron statue in the blink of an eye and plummeted towards the ground.
Ni Mu, wearing the armor, stood in midair, looking down at the lifeless body of the Six Desires Venerable. Once he confirmed that he was thoroughly dead, he relaxed slightly.
But at that moment, a look of pain flashed in his eyes, and he exerted all his strength to unfasten the Thousand Illusion Treasure Mirror that held Wu Yuezhi and another person.
As the Six Desires Venerable's Physical Body died, the Illusion Technique affecting Wu Yuezhi and his companion was also lifted. After the Thousand Illusion Treasure Mirror flew back into Ni Mu's hands, they both quickly recovered.
Wu Yuezhi looked around, taking some time to understand the situation. Seeing the dust settle, joy appeared on his face. He looked up at Ni Mu intending to offer his congratulations, but he saw the expression of pain under the faceplate, and his heart suddenly tightened.
"Not good. Big brother is being assimilated by the Puppet. Use the talisman he gave us earlier!" Wu Yuezhi spoke with urgency and hurriedly flew toward Ni Mu.
The gorgeous woman also revealed a look of panic and rushed alongside Wu Yuezhi toward Ni Mu.
The two did not dare to approach Ni Mu directly. After flying to a certain distance, they frantically took out several talismans from their Storage Bags, using one on themselves first before rushing to Ni Mu and placing another on him.
The spirit light from the talisman quickly entered Ni Mu's body, and after a few breaths, the agony in Ni Mu's eyes gradually faded. The Golden Iron Armor covering his body shook, then suddenly split open, parting to both sides.
Ni Mu stepped out of the armor, looking up to see it closing again, with Golden Iron filling its interior. It quickly solidified into a humanoid Puppet, and only then did he finally breathe a sigh of relief.
"Big brother, this Tongchen Puppet is assimilating foreign objects faster and faster. If you keep using it like this, I'm afraid next time we won't be quick enough to save you with a talisman," Wu Yuezhi expressed his concern.
"It doesn't matter. Once this matter is settled, I will use the Spirit God Pill to break through to the Late-stage Nascent Soul. I should be able to fully control the Tongchen Puppet then, and we won't have to worry about being assimilated by it ever again," Ni Mu shook his head, his expression somewhat relaxed.
"Alas, the origin of this Puppet is unknown. It was too risky for you to refine it as your Lifebound Puppet, big brother. This is not the first time you've been in danger while defeating an opponent," Wu Yuezhi sighed.
"The Immortal Path must be contested. If we don't take risks, how can we glimpse the path to everlasting life? Let's not talk about the distant future; if it weren't for Tongchen today, we would have perished here. What future would there be?" Ni Mu replied with a light laugh, carefree.
"What big brother says is true," Wu Yuezhi sighed, his respect for Ni Mu's resolve growing a bit more.

chapters.title: Chapter 442 - 419 Return
chapters.content:
On the other side in Yin Capital City.
A green-robed cultivator crashed through a dwelling's window and landed on the street, glancing around before quickly heading towards the edge of the city.
Moments later, three cultivators rushed out of the dwelling. They were disheveled and bore numerous wounds, but none of them stopped to heal. After quickly determining the direction in which the green-robed cultivator had fled, they chased after him, their faces murderous.
Due to the lingering fog in the city and the inability to fly, the green-robed cultivator's tunneling speed was not fast, and he was unable to shake off the three men pursuing him.
Worse still, due to unfamiliarity with the terrain, he soon ran into a dead-end, surrounded by tall buildings on all sides, with no other exit but the way he came.
"Heh, run, why aren't you running now?" The three pursuers blocked the entrance to the alley, and the one with a beard on the left, seeing the green-robed cultivator had no way out, sneered immediately.
"Fang Hongru, hand over the treasure you stole, and I might mercifully spare your life," the burly leader said coldly.
Fang Hongru, the green-robed cultivator, turned around and saw the fierce look on the three men's faces, not believing his statements at all. His eyes shifted, and he suddenly proposed, "Fine, I can give you the treasure, but there's only one. How will you three split it?"
At this remark, the expressions of the two men at the back slightly changed. However, the leader impatiently furrowed his brows and turned to scold, "Don't be fooled by him. Let's first get our hands on the item. We can talk about how to divide it afterward. If we argue now and it ends up with someone else, that would be time wasted."
Hearing this, the two men momentarily curbed their greed, and their ferocious gazes locked onto Fang Hongru once again.
When one plan failed, Fang Hongru's eyes flickered as another idea came to him.
"Fine, you've forced my hand. I didn't want to use this secret technique, but since I can't escape, I will fight to the death and take one of you with me!" Fang Hongru bellowed, his hands forming a spell, and a terrifying aura burst forth from him, along with a dense, blood-red color climbing up his body.Еnjоying thе stоry? Disсоvеr mоrе оn М|V|LЕМ6РYR.
Seeing this, the faces of his three pursuers slightly changed. While they prepared themselves, they also calculated their next moves.
Fang Hongru was undoubtedly going to be killed, but if they got too injured during the fight or even killed by his desperation attack, it would advantage the other two.
This time, even the leader couldn't help but feel dubious.
Seeing this, Fang Hongru's expression grew even more fierce, but internally, he felt a surge of relief.
The so-called secret technique he was using was merely a pretense intended to be intimidating without actually enhancing his strength.
Still, no cultivator would want to face a cornered enemy. Fang Hongru's act was designed to force the pursuers to instinctively protect themselves, thus creating an opportunity for him to escape.
Based on his years of experience in the Cultivation World, the more enemies there were, and the less united they were, the better the success rate and effectiveness of this tactic.
"Take this, Blood Burning Technique!"
Fang Hongru saw that the timing was right, and with a scream that strained his voice, he executed his magic and manipulated his Magic Treasure with a blood-soaked aura, convincing anyone that he was not merely bluffing.
As expected, faced with a desperate Fang Hongru, the bearded trio looked utterly horrified. They not only summoned their Magic Treasures to protect their bodies but also retreated rapidly backwards, inadvertently clearing a path for him.
Seeing this, Fang Hongru was proud of his ploy but suddenly sensed something was amiss.
They didn't have to be that afraid, did they?
Just as this thought flashed through his mind, he suddenly felt a pain in his Divine Soul, followed by a complete loss of consciousness.
Behind Fang Hongru, a silver-robed man emerged from the void, not even glancing at the now lifeless Fang Hongru. His icy gaze turned to the fleeing bearded trio, and with a cold snort, three silver Spirit Vines shot out from the void, piercing through the chests of the three men and dragging them back.
At the same time, a silver-white soul leech slowly floated up from Fang Hongru's body. It was slightly larger than ordinary soul leeches and emitted a different aura.
The soul leech, seeing the bearded trio impaled by the Spirit Vines, excitedly swam towards them and quickly devoured their Divine Souls completely.
Afterward, the silver-robed man used the Spirit Vines to drain the four corpses dry and then caught the now plumper soul leech, merging it into his body before preparing to tear through the void to hunt for new prey within Yin Capital City.
The Six Desires Venerable had survived for thousands of years, and his development and research of the soul leech's abilities had almost reached perfection.
The rebirth of the soul leech seemed random, but it actually still followed the law of survival of the fittest. After the main soul died, the strongest among all the soul leeches would transform into the new main soul.
If one actively facilitated the soul leech's consumption of Divine Souls, it was possible to manually control the location of its rebirth. Moreover, by nourishing it with a large number of Divine Souls, one could shorten the seven-day limit and accelerate the revival process.
The man in the silver robe had been searching for the Void Stone in the Shura Palace and thus became aware that many Loose Cultivators at the Core Formation Stage were treasure hunting in Yin Capital City. He had informed the Six Desires Venerable, hence, just before dying, the Six Desires issued him his final command—
Sacrifice the cultivators in this place in blood to hasten his return.
As a Level 4 demon beast who mastered Space Divine Power, the man in the silver robe was undeniably swift when hunting Loose Cultivators in the Core Formation Stage, a speed that surpassed ordinary expectations. The Six Desires Venerable was confident of this point and therefore did not have the man in the silver robe flee with him.
He believed that in less than 15 minutes, he could resurrect, reclaim his physical body, and slay the two thieves in his prime condition.
However, from the moment his main soul died, everything entered an unknowable state. Although he trusted the loyalty of the man in the silver robe, he ultimately could not foresee all events.
Just as the man in the silver robe was about to tear open the void, his expression suddenly stiffened. The space he could usually tear open with ease had become as firm as iron, impervious to breakage. Despite using several times the power he normally would, he could barely open a small gap, allowing only a single vine to stretch out.
The man in the silver robe was not lacking in intelligence, but the Six Desires Venerable had not disclosed everything to him. Facing this sudden and unexpected situation, a bad premonition arose in his heart, yet now that the space was reinforced, he couldn't escape directly from this place.
"I must revive my master quickly, so he can take control of the situation!"
Determined, the man in the silver robe then used his physical body to move through Yin Capital City, continuing to hunt the Loose Cultivators who had come seeking opportunities.
Initially, due to being somewhat unfamiliar with the Escape Skill, his speed was not fast, but as he killed more and more Loose Cultivators, he gradually mastered the tricks of the Escape Skill, quickly annihilating almost all the cultivators in the entire city.
After devouring the Divine Souls of so many Loose Cultivators, the soul leech residing in his body had swollen unbearably, its massive body no longer able to merge into the man in the silver robe's body.
As the Soul Power was digested, the aura emitted by the soul leech gradually intensified, and its form rapidly changed, first growing limbs, with hands and feet slowly forming, followed by a head and facial features. Its hair also swiftly grew out and quickly turned from white to black.
Soon, a brand-new Six Desires Venerable lay before the man in the silver robe. His closed eyes suddenly shot open, exuding a formidable aura unique to the Sleeping Witch, which was quickly suppressed.
"Master, you are awake," said the man in the silver robe joyfully.
However, the Six Desires Venerable did not regard his greeting but instead abruptly looked up toward the depths of the Shura Palace.
"Villains! How dare you destroy my physical body and annihilate my soul leech!" he bellowed, his enraged face hiding a trace of panic.
Each resurrection was the most dangerous moment for the Six Desires Venerable. To quickly navigate through this period, he had prepared many methods to cope.
Accelerating the revival of the Divine Soul through a spirit pet was one method; relying on soul splitting to temporarily ensure the safety of the soul leech was another.
However, when the soul splitting in his backup physical body was slain by Ni Mu using an Exotic Treasure, and the soul leeches he had hidden throughout the Shura Palace were discovered and annihilated one by one during this period.
For the former, he could still make excuses, such as setting too many limits on the soul splitting or his physical body being not strong enough, or being too careless facing Ni Mu and so on.
But for the latter, even though he had now awakened, he still knew not how Xiao Ying had managed to locate his soul leeches.
The only thing he could think of was the Countertracking Spell that the Central Plains cultivators had created three thousand years ago, but that required activating the connection between the soul leeches, something he couldn't possibly fail to notice.
Could it be that they had optimized this spell?
A chill sank into the heart of the Six Desires Venerable. As he contemplated this, another soul leech was discovered and slaughtered. Now only three of his soul leeches remained hidden in the Shura Palace; he no longer had time to delay.
With this thought, he immediately leaped up and turned to look at the man in the silver robe.
"Yinkong, quickly revert to your true form and help me escape from here!" he swiftly commanded.
Upon hearing this, Yinkong dared not delay, and with a shift of his Spiritual Power, his skin rapidly turned tough and coarse. His limbs gradually merged with his torso, his features slowly dissolved, and his hair continued to grow, eventually turning into silver leaves that still shimmered brilliantly in the mist.
Soon, a towering tree appeared in Yin Capital City, its body radiating a silver-white brilliance. Its roots did not dig deep but rather firmly rooted in a void space rift.
Immediately afterward, the Six Desires Venerable quickly stepped forward, placed his hand on the trunk, and the Soul Power he had finally accumulated surged into Yinkong's body like it was free.
Yinkong trembled in response, his entire canopy rustling loudly. His roots seemed to breathe, expanding and contracting, continuously drawing Space Power from the void.
The space, originally as solid as iron, seemed to be melting and gradually softened. Suddenly, a crack appeared behind the Six Desires Venerable, its ends slowly expanding as if forcibly pried open.
Soon, a space crack wide enough for one person to pass through fully formed. Through the crack, the Six Desires Venerable could even see the dark clouds and yellow sand outside the Shura Palace.
He was only a step away from escaping this place.

chapters.title: Chapter 443 - 420: The End of the Dream and the Dissipation of the Soul
chapters.content:
"Hmph! Once I harness the power of the Shura Blood Devouring Map to step into the Returning to Void Realm, I shall imprison your Divine Souls and torment you day and night, never to transcend in eternity!" the Six Desires Venerable gazed at the space-time rift in front of him, a hint of joy on his face. Yet, he snorted disdainfully soon after, saying.
He activated his mana, broadcasting his voice to every corner of Yin Capital City, then released his grip, turned around, and prepared to step into the space-time rift.
However, at that moment, he saw a somewhat familiar figure suddenly emerge from the yellow sands on the other side of the rift, that figure, looking at the shocked Six Desires Venerable, waved cheerfully at him.
"Sorry, this way is blocked," the Shura Master stated.
Seeing his once-mighty foe who had cut him down before, the Six Desires Venerable's heart trembled. He had no time to think and instinctively took several steps back, moving away from the space-time rift.
Simultaneously, the Shura Master emerged from the rift as well, his formidable presence, unique to the Returning to Void Stage, thronging outwards. With a casual wave of his hand, the space softened by Yinkong immediately solidified, quickly smoothing over the rift completely.
As a consequence, Yinkong itself was gravely injured, its trunk's shine abruptly dimming, showing bark as withered as dead wood, and its lush leaves breaking off and falling, soon covering the ground.
Facing the Shura Master, the Six Desires Venerable was on high alert, his whole body taut and soul power brewing, unmistakably preparing some formidable spell.
Nonetheless, the Shura Master made no move to stop him, simply looking at him with a beaming smile, as if he were gazing at an old friend.
"You're not the real Shura Master, just a Residual Soul of his!" After a moment, the Six Desires Venerable, seeing that the other made no move, suddenly came to a realization.
"Smart, but not quite smart enough," the Shura Master responded, still smiling.Chесk fоr thе lаtеst updаtеs оn Мy Virtuаl Librаry Еmpirе (М-VL-ЕМР-YR).
In the next instant, a massive wave of Curse Power descended from above, striking the Six Desires Venerable's Divine Soul and instantly causing his Cultivation to slip, hugely reducing his Soul Power. The technique that the Six Desires Venerable was brewing thus crumbled in an instant.
The Six Desires Venerable was hit by a backlash, uttering a muffled groan, and his momentum dropped again, nearly falling from the Sleeping Witch's realm.
Right at that moment, a flash of white light passed, and Xi Ying's figure appeared above the Six Desires Venerable. She held the Black Flute, and upon her arrival, she began to play immediately.
The harsh and unpleasant sound of the flute enveloped him, and the Six Desires Venerable was struck once more. Wisps of dark energy wriggled out from his Divine Soul like the last straw breaking the camel's back, causing his recently restored Divine Soul to no longer maintain its form, instantly disjointed and scattered.
Then, a thunderous boom roared out of nowhere, dazzling thunderbolts fell from the sky, striking precisely upon the broken fragments of the Six Desires Venerable's Divine Soul.
The dense curtain of thunderbolts lasted for a solid thirty minutes before it slowly dispersed. By then, only charred marks from the thunder remained on the ground, with not a trace of the Residual Soul in sight.
Yuan Ming, who held the Thunder God Hammer, appeared beside Xi Ying, asking with his eyes, while Xi Ying took out a White Jade Plate to show it, which now bore only the last fading light spot.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming heaved a sigh of relief, put away the Thunder God Hammer, and descended from the sky, bowing to the Shura Master.
"Thank you, senior, for lending your aid," Yuan Ming said respectfully.
"Haha, no need for such formalities, this was merely one of the trades involved with that girl, and besides, my enmity with Six Desires runs deep as the sea. His survival to this point has been due to my mistake; my current action is merely to amend past errors," the Shura Master laughed loudly, waving his hand dismissively.
Yuan Ming looked up, about to ask more, but suddenly noticed that the Shura Master's figure had grown much fainter; he could even see the scenery behind him through his chest.
"Senior, what's happening to you?" Yuan Ming exclaimed in alarm, asking promptly.
"Heh, I am after all just a Residual Soul now. I had to expend a significant amount of my remaining Soul Power from the All Living Beings' Dream to fake the presence of the Returning Void and intimidate that cur Six Desires. But don't feel sad for me; the real me has long been dead, and after dreaming for over three thousand years, it's about time to wake up," the Shura Master said with a shake of his head, his smile conveying utter acceptance.
"Moreover, my death is actually fortuitous for you. You should be happy, for with the All Living Beings' Dream gone, that rune will become vacant. Now that you have control over the Shura Palace, you can retrieve it for yourself to comprehend. My research into Divine Skills only managed to unveil a mere corner of that rune's mystery. Perhaps, you could uncover a new usage for it," the Shura Master added.
"Senior, you needn't comfort me with these words. You know I'm not that kind of person. Besides, isn't there really no way to continue the All Living Beings' Dream for you?" Yuan Ming sighed.
"Of course, there is. Just go out, kill more people, and use their Divine Souls as fuel," the Shura Master joked.
Yuan Ming sighed again, feeling somewhat helpless.
Though he had grown used to the bloodshed and cold-heartedness in the Cultivation World, he still couldn't bring himself to mindlessly slaughter lives.
"All right, enough joking. Yuan Ming, you need to remember what I'm about to say. The Shura Blood Devouring Map has been with me for a long time, and its Artifact Spirit, though quick with words, has a good heart. Treat it as a companion after you refine it, and it surely won't harm you,"
"Moreover, this Spiritual Treasure, besides its intrinsic power, also contains a Body Cultivation Method from Overseas that can be cultivated to the Body of Wanxiang level. In addition, it harbors the Cultivation insights left by me and its previous master. These might assist you in your breakthrough to the Returning Void Stage in the future," the Shura Master advised earnestly.
Yuan Ming nodded, carefully committing the words of the Shura Master to memory. As he contemplated that this might be their last conversation, a wave of melancholy washed over him.
The Shura Master patted Yuan Ming's shoulder and smiled at him, "Yuan Ming, I have lived a life of intrigue, reflecting upon my past, all my regrets have been sealed within the All Living Beings' Dream. Now that the dream has dissipated and memories have vanished with the wind, Only the quest to explore the Overseas remains an obsession, even in the face of soul dispersion."
"You've seen what has become of my body. In the future, if you truly set foot in the Overseas, I ask that you bury me there. In doing so, my life will have found its final resting place, and I shall have no more regrets..." The Shura Master's voice faded, his nearly non-existent form gradually transformed into countless points of light, completely vanishing into the mists of Yin Capital City.
Witnessing this, Yuan Ming's heart was filled with a torrent of emotions. He stood in silent tribute to the Shura Master for quite some time, then let out a deep sigh and turned to look at Xi Ying.
"What do you plan to do with this guy?" Xi Ying pointed at Silver Void, who was laying nearby with a feeble breath, and asked Yuan Ming.
"Don't, don't kill me!" Before Yuan Ming could speak, Silver Void's main trunk immediately sprouted a face, pleading for mercy from Yuan Ming and Xi Ying.
"Hua Zhi, this guy is yours—" Yuan Ming ignored him and simply raised his hand to summon Hua Zhi.
Before he could finish, Silver Void shouted in a mixture of ferocity and fear, "Wait, wait a minute, if you lay a hand on me, I'll immediately detonate my body, and the Spiritual Treasure within me from the Six Desires will forever be lost to you!"
Yuan Ming raised an eyebrow and held back the eager Hua Zhi, he coldly told Silver Void, "Explain in detail."
"My true form is that of a Silver Void Tree Demon, naturally possessing internal space capable of storing anything. The Six Desires has always been cautious, storing all valuable items inside me rather than in a Storage Bag, including the Shura Blood Devouring Map he acquired before, all within this space. Without my permission, even if you kill me, you won't find the space, let alone if I self-destruct – the items within will be scattered to the void, and no one will know where they end up!" Silver Void hastily divulged all his secrets without reserve, desperate to save his life.
"Are you suggesting a trade? The items within you for your life?" Yuan Ming looked at Silver Void, his smile tinged with an indiscernible meaning.
"Indeed." Silver Void answered anxiously, the remaining few leaves on his canopy shaking vigorously as if nodding in agreement.
Yuan Ming didn't respond but instead looked at Xi Ying. However, Xi Ying seemed indifferent to Silver Void's fate, simply glancing at the Cloud Disk, then shrugged after confirming there was no soul of the Six Desires Venerable within Silver Void, signaling Yuan Ming with a look that the decision was his to make.
"Fine, I agree." Seeing this, Yuan Ming made his decision.
"Then you..."
As Silver Void spoke, he seemed to want Yuan Ming to swear an oath of assurance, but suddenly, he noticed a warning gaze drifting over from the side. A quick glance revealed Xi Ying looking coldly at him.
His heart skipped a beat, and he dared not make any further demands, hastily retrieving all the items hidden in his storage space and presenting them to Yuan Ming.
The Six Desires Venerable had only a few items stored within the space, including the sealed Shura Blood Devouring Map, there was a Black Gourd, a White Jade Plate, a green round bead, and a Silver Banner.
Among them, the Black Gourd was made of the same Nine Nether Iron as the one Yuan Ming had obtained after killing the Black River Divine Envoy.
Yuan Ming was inwardly delighted; he had obtained a piece of Nine Nether Iron from Dugu Feng, but that was somewhat insufficient for inscribing the second rune on his broken sword. Now, with this Black Gourd in hand, there would be no problem at all.
As for the White Jade Plate, it was filled with tiny text, just like an ordinary Jade Scroll. When his Divine Sense swept over it, it revealed the mnemonic of the Six Desires Breaking Emotion Great Method.
Yuan Ming was intrigued by this Cultivation Technique, but now was not the time to examine it closely; he merely glanced over it briefly and withdrew his Divine Sense.
The remaining green round bead and the Silver Banner, which he couldn't identify at the moment, were put away as well—reserved for detailed investigation later.
Afterward, Yuan Ming looked up at Silver Void, who was looking at him expectantly. True to his word, he gave a swift wave of his hand and opened the previously sealed space.
Silver Void noticed the change around him and was overjoyed. He quickly transformed back into human form, bowed to Yuan Ming, and then immediately fled into the void, disappearing without a trace.
However, Yuan Ming, who had received his bow, wore a peculiar expression on his face. It wasn't until after Silver Void had departed that he finally couldn't help himself and said to Xi Ying,
"His hair..."
Having lost many branches and leaves from his original form as the silver tree, Silver Void's hair had thinned considerably when he took human form again. As he bowed his head in gratitude, it was so sparse that Yuan Ming almost burst into laughter.
Xi Ying, seeing this, also struggled to hide a smile.
"Alright, he's gone now, let's not tease him about it. Don't forget, we still have a soul leech to deal with," Xi Ying said.
Yuan Ming coughed twice to compose himself, putting the amusement aside and becoming serious once more.

chapters.title: Chapter 444 - 421 Inheritance
chapters.content:
Moments later, when Yuan Ming and Xi Ying reached the site where the last soul leech was located, the sight of the Golden Dawn Fairy left him visibly astounded.
"Xi Ying, you've finally come. I thought you had forgotten about me," the Golden Dawn Fairy said with a sigh of relief as she saw Yuan Ming and his companion arrive.
Yuan Ming's thoughts shifted, and he suddenly recalled that the Six Desires Venerable had particularly placed a soul leech on all the Nascent Souls to reclaim them.
Due to the Golden Dawn Fairy's unique stance among the Nascent Soul cultivators, along with her care along the way, Yuan Ming naturally could not treat her as he had the other Nascent Souls by eliminating her. Since Xi Ying hadn't spoken of it either, it had slipped his mind.
Now, it appeared that Xi Ying's omission of the matter had deep implications.
"How could that be? If you hadn't bravely fed yourself to the tiger by deliberately having the Six Desires insert a soul leech onto your Nascent Soul, how could we have located all his soul leeches? If we were to forget anyone, it certainly wouldn't be you, the great hero," Xi Ying said with a smile.
"Don't sugarcoat it. The old thief Six Desires is dead now, right? Hurry and get rid of this soul leech; having it attach to my Nascent Soul has been utterly disgusting," the Golden Dawn Fairy rolled her eyes.
Then, she pinched a spell with her right hand, and immediately countless golden light characters flew from her body, condensing into a Golden Scroll in midair before falling into her palm.
Xi Ying also touched her forehead, and a Three-legged Golden Crow instantly flew out, entering the Golden Dawn Fairy's body in a flash to eradicate the soul leech attached to her divine soul before flying back into Xi Ying's Sea of Consciousness.
After the Golden Dawn Fairy's divine sense swept through her body and confirmed that the Six Desires soul leech had indeed been removed, she felt a rush of clarity and refreshment.
At the same time, sensing Yuan Ming's confusion, Xi Ying took the initiative to explain:
"Jin Xi is my close friend from girlhood. She came to Shura Palace at my invitation to help. Without her using the Heavenly Talisman Strategy to seal the soul leech and the sensing technique to detect the locations of the others which ultimately reached me, we would not have easily killed the Six Desires."
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming finally understood; however, sadness tinged the Golden Dawn Fairy's face:
"Alas, the several elders I brought from the sect had unfortunately perished before Six Desires even made a move, and I didn't even have the chance to protect them."
"I'll compensate you for this afterward," Xi Ying said proactively.
"It's alright. I had already informed them of the risks before they came. Now that they are dead, it is not due to fighting against Six Desires, no one else is to blame," the Golden Dawn Fairy sighed softly and shook her head.
The three remained silent for a moment, but then the Golden Dawn Fairy took the initiative to break the rather heavy atmosphere.
"Well, let's not talk about this anymore. Since the matter here is settled, I need to return to the Spirit Talisman Sect to deal with the aftermath. Once this storm has passed, Xi Ying, come find me to fulfill the agreement to help me recover the other half of the Heavenly Talisman Strategy," the Golden Dawn Fairy said.
Xi Ying nodded silently, then signaled Yuan Ming to open the passage. The Golden Dawn Fairy nodded to Xi Ying in farewell, gave Yuan Ming a mysterious smile, and was then enveloped by a white light activated by Yuan Ming, leaving the Shura Palace.
"Ni Mu has also dealt with the Six Desires' main body on his side. Do you want to go over and say a few words to them?" After seeing the Golden Dawn Fairy off, Yuan Ming suddenly remembered something and proposed.
"I'd rather not. Though Ni Mu is our ally, he has his own agenda and is not wholly with me. Besides, our deal with them isn't over yet; just free them all," Xi Ying shook her head and said.
"I heard Six Desires previously address Ni Mu as the Dawn Alliance Leader, and you mentioned before that he is a member of the Wu Yue Sect. Does that mean Dawn is also part of the Wu Yue Sect?" Yuan Ming asked in surprise.
"Indeed, Dawn is considered an affiliate of the Wu Yue Sect. Although the sect has remained hidden these years, in reality, they have gained control of numerous Scatter Alliances and even some minor sects, their influence far greater than you imagine," Xi Ying explained.
"Has the Wu Yue Sect truly revived? What exactly are their objectives?" Yuan Ming frowned and inquired.
"Thousands of years ago, the Wu Yue Sect reigned over the entire Yunhuang Continent. Now, their revival aims merely to return to the glory of those days," Xi Ying shook her head.
"And you..." Yuan Ming hesitated, looking at Xi Ying.
"Me? Ha, thousands of years ago, our Xi Family ancestor was one of the six Venerables of the Wu Yue Sect. After it was destroyed in a joint effort by Chang Chun Temple along with the Central Plains, East Sea, Western Region, and Southern Border regions, our ancestor managed to escape and settled at the borders of the Northern Desert. To this day, our family has grown to possess several Nascent Soul elders, even three Mid-stage Sleep Witches. Now that the Wu Yue Sect is resurging, they are looking to actively recruit the Xi Family again, not only offering a high position as Venerable but also presenting the mnemonic of the Seventh Layer of the Moonlight Technique," Xi Ying explained slowly.
"The Seventh Layer? I remember you only had the Sixth Level," Yuan Ming was somewhat moved now.
"Indeed, for a long time, the Moonlight Technique passed down in our Xi Family contained only the first six levels. This time, the Wu Yue Sect recovered the lost Seventh Layer, which holds great attraction for the old members of our family. Moreover, they already favored the Wu Yue Sect's plan to unify the continent and were greedy for the rewards promised by the sect, readily joining it. Now they have completely been pulled aboard and have solidified their identities as followers of the Wu Yue Sect," Xi Ying's eyes flashed with a barely noticeable fury.
"And you? Do you agree with them?" Yuan Ming took the initiative to ask, though he already had an answer in his mind.
"Haha, the people of the Wu Yue Sect are no good; they only want to use us as cannon fodder. Moreover, though the Wu Yue God has revived, his methods are outdated and lacking in strategy. It's been ten thousand years, yet he still acts according to the old ways, allowing his followers to kill and harvest souls at will. Furthermore, although the Wu Yue Sect seems unified, in reality, there is severe infighting among the different factions within, with the old members suppressing the newcomers. Even someone like Ni Mu isn't valued. The Wu Yue God still relies on those few decrepit subordinates of his, showing uneven rewards and favoritism. With the sect in such a rotten state, if they could unify Yunhuang, it would indeed be a miracle," Xi Ying said with a cold laugh.
"What are your plans moving forward?" Yuan Ming nodded thoughtfully and then asked.
"Unfortunately, I don't have much say within the clan. For now, I can only outwardly agree with the family's judgment while secretly gathering my own forces, planning to turn against them in the future and completely sever ties with the Wu Yue Sect," Xi Ying said calmly.
Then, she suddenly looked at Yuan Ming, "Actually, I've traveled around Yunhuang these past few years and found that whether it's the Central Plains, the East Sea, the Western Region, or the Southern Border, each place is brimming with talents and prodigies. Though I had a plan, I lacked confidence, until I met you and realized you could even be a potential rival to the Wu Yue God, and that's when I finally settled on my plan."
"Me? Right now, at best, I'm merely a love witch, and even with the Stealing Heaven Tripod, I can only forcibly elevate myself to mid-stage Sleeping Witch. It's already so hard to kill a Six Desires Venerable, how could I be a rival to the Wu Yue God?" Yuan Ming pointed to his nose, somewhat surprised.Love this story? Show support at *.
"You're thinking in the wrong direction, it's not about being a rival in cultivation, but a rival in gathering Desire Power! The reason why the Wu Yue God can attract so many soul cultivators is because of the magic treasures he bestows, which can gather Desire Power for soul cultivators to use in their cultivation. Otherwise, who would want to spend all day worshiping spirits?" Xi Ying said irritably.
"Ahem, I see, but how did you know I could gather Desire Power?" Yuan Ming was surprised.
"Silly, have you forgotten who told you the name of the Stealing Heaven Tripod?" Xi Ying looked at Yuan Ming as if he were a fool.
Yuan Ming scratched his head awkwardly, but quickly remembered something and hastily asked, "Speaking of which, since you know about the Stealing Heaven Tripod, could you tell me about its origins?"
"I've only seen the appearance and name of the Stealing Heaven Tripod in one of the Wu Yue Sect's classics. It mentioned that it possessed the ability to collect Desire Power, but beyond that, I don't know much more, just like that space you brought me into, I had never heard of it before," Xi Ying spread her hands, somewhat helplessly.
"What about the Wu Yue God then? Who exactly is he, and how did he come to possess the secret skill for absorbing Desire Power? Could it be that he also has a Stealing Heaven Tripod?" Yuan Ming asked again.
"I'm not sure about that either, only that he has existed for over ten thousand years, lived longer than the Six Desires, and his cultivation has reached unfathomable depths, able to kill with a single word. However, he has mostly been in a dormant state and only recently revived, so his strength might not be as formidable as before," Xi Ying said.
"But you don't have to worry. The Wu Yue God seems to have suffered a severe injury and can hardly leave the core sacred site of the Wu Yue Sect. He also doesn't usually care about anyone outside his old subordinates; otherwise, he would have come after us for killing the Six Desires long ago," Xi Ying continued.
Yuan Ming nodded, thought for a moment, then asked, "Speaking of which, your killing of the Six Desires was meant to weaken the Wu Yue Sect's strength?"
"...Not only that, but also because the Six Desires once killed my brother," Xi Ying's mood suddenly dropped, and she only uttered one sentence before falling silent.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming didn't want to rip open her old wounds and opted to change the subject, "Since we are destined to be enemies with the Wu Yue Sect eventually, Ni Mu and his two companions will sooner or later become our enemies. Why not take advantage of our current position and just kill them now to eliminate future problems?"
"Ni Mu is too cunning to deal with that easily. We are currently allied, and there are some things left after killing the Six Desires that need his attention. It's not good to completely burn our bridges yet, and besides, he may not be entirely loyal to the Wu Yue Sect. There might still be opportunities for cooperation in the future," Xi Ying shook her head.
"Wrap things up?" Yuan Ming was puzzled.
"The Six Desires was cautious; even if his main body entered the Shura Palace, he would leave a few soul leech clones outside as a backup. Ni Mu's delay in arriving was to capture those clones. If we kill him here, the Six Desires might still be able to resurrect from those soul leeches, so we can only let him go," Xi Ying explained.
Yuan Ming finally understood. No wonder Ni Mu dared to collaborate with Xi Ying without fear of being silenced; he had always kept a life-saving talisman for himself.
Next, he sensed the location of Ni Mu and his two companions through the forbidden restrictions, ready to open a pathway for their departure, but suddenly, Ni Mu unexpectedly looked up and made eye contact with Yuan Ming, who was observing them through the restrictions.
However, Ni Mu seemed not to actually see Yuan Ming, only nodding slightly in that direction as a greeting before continuing to converse with his companions.
Even so, his response sent a chill through Yuan Ming's heart, and he no longer waited for them to leave on their own, directly using the forbidden restrictions to eject the three from the Shura Palace.
(Sorry, Wang Yu was a bit busy yesterday, which delayed the update time. I apologize for any inconvenience to my fellow Daoists!)

chapters.title: Chapter 445 - 422: Ancient Corpse
chapters.content:
In a deserted area of the Soul Burying Abyss, a flash of white light streaked through the void, and the silhouettes of Ni Mu and the two others appeared there, surrounded by the bright light.
"What happened? Why did we suddenly come out?" Wu Yuezhi looked around and frowned.
"Someone is controlling the Forbidden of the Shura Palace, moving us outside. The Six-winged Butterfly King just sensed the fluctuation of the Space Restriction. It was a very powerful space restriction," the glamorous woman said as she raised her arm, the bright butterfly tattoo on it squirming slightly.
"It's Xi Ying," Ni Mu said slowly.
"Xi Ying! So, does that mean the Six Desires Venerable's main soul has also been extinguished?" the glamorous woman exclaimed in shock.
"All of Six Desires Venerable's soul leeches have also been killed. Xi Ying has instructed us to quickly execute the residual souls outside," Ni Mu said, taking out a flickering Sound Transmission Talisman.
"She killed the main soul of the Six Desires Venerable so quickly? How is that possible!" The glamorous woman's eyes widened in disbelief.
To deal with the Six Desires Venerable, they had prepared for many years and were very aware of the terrifying Divine Skills of the Six Desires Venerable, especially those soul leeches, whose ability to hide and escape was astonishing. Even the Shura Master had missed one in the past.
The reason they chose to strike at the Six Desires Venerable within the Shura Palace was because it was a completely enclosed environment, where the Six Desires Venerable's soul leeches couldn't escape.
To ensure that not a single soul leech was missed, the Dawn Alliance prepared a massive sensing array, planning to search the entire Shura Palace bit by bit.
But before anything could start, Xi Ying had already declared that she had killed all the soul leeches of the Six Desires Venerable, how could the glamorous woman believe this.
"Xi Ying always plans thoroughly before acting. Perhaps she had already prepared a way to deal with the soul leeches," Ni Mu said thoughtfully.
"Big brother, you really think highly of Xi Ying," the glamorous woman said with a light snort.
Ni Mu smiled slightly, offering no explanation.
He also found it unbelievable, but the message from Xi Ying was very clear, and based on his understanding of her, she wasn't someone to boast without basis.
Moreover, since a while ago, Ni Mu's intuition had been echoing within him—the main soul of the Six Desires Venerable had indeed completely fallen.
Seeing the smiling face of Ni Mu, jealousy surged in the glamorous woman's heart, a hint of murderous intent flashing deep in her eyes.
"Xi Ying is too domineering. We just helped her deal with the Six Desires Venerable, and she immediately drove us out of the Shura Palace. She must want to monopolize the treasures inside! She hasn't even given us the promised Spirit God Pills yet, does she plan to repudiate the debt?" Wu Yuezhi said gravely.
"We have already achieved our goal. There's no need to dispute over trivial benefits with Xi Ying. As for the Spirit God Pills, we have several of the Six Desires Venerable's clones in our hands; Xi Ying won't dare act rashly. The trade for these pills was already scheduled to happen half a month later," Ni Mu shook his head and said.
"Big brother is right. Xi Ying must already have control of the Shura Palace. Staying there wouldn't bring us any good," the glamorous woman agreed.
"Since you both say so, I won't say much more. But it's such a pity. Now that the Six Desires Venerable, Dugu Feng, and Old Monster Lei Ming have all fallen, only Xi Ying, the Golden Dawn Fairy of the Spirit Talisman Sect, and a few others remain in the Shura Palace. If we kill them, everything would belong to us," Wu Yuezhi lamented.
The glamorous woman, upon hearing this, felt her previously suppressed thoughts stirring once again.
Though they had been expelled from the Shura Palace, it didn't mean they had no way to return. The Dawn Alliance had influence spread across the Yunhuang Continent, including a hidden branch in the Black Wind Desert that could provide assistance at any moment.
"Don't be rash! Xi Ying has cunning Divine Skills and even more formidable intelligence, not so easy to deal with," Ni Mu frowned and chided.
"I actually think the third brother's words make sense. Now that only a few big and small cats remain in the Shura Palace, it's not impossible for us to take it down if we give it our all," the glamorous woman said.
"If Xi Ying's methods were only this simple, how could she ever have dealt with the main soul of the Six Desires Venerable?" Ni Mu said coldly, scolding her.
"Big brother, do you think Xi Ying has other trump cards up her sleeve?" the glamorous woman asked in surprise.
"Most of the Divine Skills of a Soul Cultivator lie within the Divine Soul. We struggled so much just dealing with the Six Desires Venerable's body and soul splitting, let alone his main soul's abilities. Although Xi Ying is formidable, if it was just her alone, surviving under the main soul of the Six Desires Venerable would be good enough, let alone killing him. From my repeated observations, there seems to be a Sleeping Witch level Soul Cultivator lurking beside Xi Ying, likely her final trump card," Ni Mu speculated thoughtfully.The most up‑to‑date version is on *.
"There's such a person! How come I never noticed?" Wu Yuezhi exclaimed in surprise.
"I haven't detected this person's traces either, but that further proves how formidable this individual is," Ni Mu added.
"If that's the case, then let's forget about it," Wu Yuezhi concluded.
A hint of resignation flickered in the glamorous woman's eyes, but she remained silent.
The three of them then transformed into three beams of tunneling light and disappeared into the distant horizon.
...
Inside the Shura Palace, Yuan Ming and Xi Ying didn't linger at the original spot but were flying towards the Black Tower.
"Yuan Ming, the matters of the Shura Palace have finally concluded. Withdraw the radiance of the Forbidden around the Cave Mansion. The commotion here is quite large. If another expert comes along, another troublesome fight is inevitable," Xi Ying mentioned.
Yuan Ming nodded in surprise, taking out the Shura Stone Tablet and channeling Mana into it.
He raised an eyebrow, finding that activating the Shura Stone Tablet was much easier than before, with various Forbiddens ready at his command, feeling as if he were directing them with his own limbs.
"Could it be because the Residual Soul of the Shura Master has completely dissipated?" Yuan Ming silently pondered, yet he didn't concern himself too deeply, locating the Forbidden outside the Shura Palace and suppressing it.
Outside the Shura Palace, the dazzling Spirit Light surrounding the entire Cave Mansion rapidly extinguished, and the Spirit Light Sky Pillar also vanished without a trace.
"What's going on?"
The cultivators around the Cave Mansion were shocked, and they discussed fervently. Some, feeling bold, even flew toward the Cave Mansion attempting to enter while the Spirit Light Sky Pillar no longer obstructed them.
However, at that moment, the enormous Shura Palace suddenly shrank and swiftly sank into the Abyss.
In just two or three breaths' time, the Shura Palace had completely vanished without a trace.
The nearby cultivators were in an uproar, and some, still not giving up, fell into the Abyss trying to find the Shura Palace, but to no avail.
The crowd clamored for a while, and many began to leave, but a few, still harboring a sliver of hope, stayed behind, continuing their search in the Abyss.
...
Meanwhile, Yuan Ming was casting with both hands toward the Shura Stone Tablet, with Mana flowing continuously into it.
The gigantic Shura Palace had now transformed into a mini Mansion about a foot in size, tunneling into the void and rapidly departing from the bottom of the Abyss.
The location of the Shura Palace had already been exposed; even sinking into the ground, it was difficult to escape the Divine Sense of a powerful cultivator. Only by moving elsewhere could he ensure safety.
What Yuan Ming hadn't anticipated was that moving the Shura Palace was excruciatingly difficult, and with his current level of Mana and Divine Sense, he found it overwhelming.
After merely persisting for half an hour, Yuan Ming felt too weary to continue.
He paused his casting and, while gasping for air, felt nearly drained, and yet the Shura Palace Mansion had barely moved a hundred li.
"I hadn't expected moving the Shura Palace to be this difficult," Yuan Ming said, exhaling deeply.
"Of course, the Shura Palace houses a vast space. Moving such a large space naturally consumes a lot of energy. Your Mana is still somewhat shallow. Once you reach the Nascent Soul Stage, controlling the Shura Palace will be much easier," Xi Ying said nonchalantly.
Yuan Ming nodded, closed his eyes for Breathing Control to restore his Mana, and then continued moving the Shura Palace.
It took him the better part of a day to move the Shura Palace a thousand li to a spot underground, where he finally stopped.
Yuan Ming and Xi Ying's figures flickered and appeared in the space beneath the Black Tower.
The blood-colored coffin lay quietly there, the Void Stone emitting dazzling silver light.
Yuan Ming pinched a spell and pointed at the blood-colored coffin; the coffin lid slowly opened.
A dense Blood Light spread out, turning the entire Stone Chamber into a blood-red world.
Yuan Ming, already aware of what was inside the coffin, was not surprised.
The body of the Shura Master had skin white yet flush with red, and aside from the lack of breathing and heartbeat, it seemed no different from a living person. The red light contained blazing Qi-Blood Power, as if a blood-colored sun was rising, rapidly increasing the temperature of the entire chamber.
Yuan Ming felt a painful stinging on his skin and hastily opened a Mana Shield, which alleviated the discomfort.
The body of the Shura Master slowly floated up from the coffin, pores all over the body emitting fine rays of star-like light, seemingly communicating with something.
"What's going on here?" Yuan Ming expressed the puzzlement in his eyes.
He had completely refined the Shura Stone Tablet and could easily sense all the restrictive arrays inside the Shura Palace. There were definitely no arrays near the blood-colored coffin, yet the body started floating up on its own?
Seeing this, Xi Ying raised her hand and shot a golden light pillar toward the Shura Master, but before it could get close, the starlight cut it into several pieces.
A dull roar erupted from within the Blood Light, and a giant elephant phantom appeared, lifting its foot to completely crush the fragmented golden light.
The extremely thick leg of the elephant did not stop, continuing its stomp toward Xi Ying, shaking the entire Stone Chamber with its majesty, causing it to tremble incessantly.
Yuan Ming, shocked, immediately activated the Shura Stone Tablet. Three thick yellow light screens blocked in front of the elephant leg's phantom.
Simultaneously, a beam of white light emerged, enveloping him and Xi Ying.
"Bang," "Bang," "Bang," three muffled explosive sounds followed, and the three yellow light screens shattered on cue, the elephant leg's phantom paused briefly and then continued stomping toward Yuan Ming and Xi Ying.
"Quick!"
Yuan Ming shouted lowly, the white light around them surged, teleporting them away at the critical moment.
The elephant leg's phantom hit empty space, stomping fiercely on the stone wall behind.
Yuan Ming and Xi Ying flashed out as distortions in the void above the Black Tower occurred.
A dull huge sound came from underground, the ground shook, and the Black Tower swayed as if an earthquake had occurred.
"Are you okay?" Yuan Ming looked downward, asking with lingering fear.
"It's nothing." Xi Ying's face was pale, yet her eyes were unusually bright as she spoke.
Although they had just avoided the strike from the elephant leg's phantom, they were still swept by the aftershocks. Xi Ying was closer to the elephant leg and sustained dark injuries that were not light.

chapters.title: Chapter 446 - 423 The Damn Old Shura Ghost
chapters.content:
"You were a bit impulsive just now, the corpse of the Shura Master seems to have been placed under some kind of restriction," Yuan Ming spoke quickly, his concern evident in his tone.
"That was not any restriction, but rather the physical body reaching the later stage of the Tongqiao Body or the early stage of the Wanxiang Body, which is normal. I didn't expect that the Shura Master was also a Body Cultivator," Xi Ying shook her head and said.
"Oh, how can you tell?" Yuan Ming asked.
"It seems you don't know much about Body Cultivation. First of all, a Body Cultivator who has cultivated the Tongqiao Body can stand in the void and fly through the earth, using the close connection between acupoints and nature's spiritual energy to completely overcome the limitation that Body Cultivators can't fly and have insufficient mobility. The self-suspending corpse of the Shura Master and the phenomenon exhibited through the pores of his body are sufficient to prove this point," Xi Ying explained.
"So even if a Body Cultivator at this realm has perished, their physical body can still maintain such characteristics?" Yuan Ming's expression changed as he asked.
"The physical body of a Body Cultivator, upon reaching a certain degree, indeed undergoes some extraordinary changes. You can think of it this way: Magic Practitioners refine external objects into Magic Treasures, whereas Body Cultivators enhance their own physical body into a Magic Treasure. Especially high-level Body Cultivators, even after their demise, their bodies still retain some of the characteristics from when they were alive. Of course, if the body is severely damaged, it may not be able to retain these characteristics," Xi Ying nodded and said.
"Then when you say the Shura Master's Body Cultivation realm had reached the late Tongqiao Body stage or the early Wanxiang Body stage, could it be related to the huge elephant shadow that attacked us?" Yuan Ming asked thoughtfully.
"My understanding of the Wanxiang Body is very limited, after all, throughout the ages, very few from the Human Clan have cultivated such a body. I only know that, when reaching the Wanxiang Body realm, the acupoints will open further and begin to attract the Power of the Sun for body refinement. The strength will reach an astonishing level, and each strike will possess the power of the Wanxiang, hence the name Wanxiang Body. The huge elephant shadow we saw earlier was formidable, but it has not fully demonstrated such a degree yet," Xi Ying said.
"Attracting the Power of the Sun for body refinement!" Yuan Ming exclaimed in surprise.
If one were to say what the most domineering force between heaven and earth is, ninety percent of people would think it's the Power of the Sun. Legends say that in ancient times, there were once nine suns in the sky, which nearly turned the world into scorched earth. Later, a peerless powerhouse shot down eight of them, and the world was able to recover its vitality.
Although there is only one sun today, the Sun Fire is enough to incinerate the void, and no one can resist it. For Body Cultivators to reach such a realm and be able to attract the Power of the Sun for body refinement is quite inconceivable.
"The Qi Blood Power exuded by the Shura Master just now was scorching hot and oppressive. Fortunately, he has already perished, or else, caught off guard, we could have easily been injured," Xi Ying said.
Yuan Ming nodded in agreement, his interest in Body Cultivation greatly increasing.
He remembered that the Shura Master had once mentioned that the Shura Blood Devouring Map contained a set of Body Cultivation Methods and cultivation experience; perhaps it was this method that he had practiced in the past. When he had time, he could well consider studying it.
If that set of Body Cultivation Method is profound enough, Yuan Ming planned to pass it on to Vajra as well.
Vajra had already cultivated an Innate Body, but Yuan Ming's strength had advanced too quickly, and Vajra, the spirit beast, was becoming less and less useful. It had to improve its strength as quickly as possible, preferably cultivating the Tongqiao Body.
As for the Wanxiang Body, he didn't dare to think too much about it. That was a Body Cultivation Realm on par with the Returning to Void Stage, which was too far away from his current self.
Yuan Ming, having thought this, gathered his thoughts and began to control the power of the restrictions, probing into the situation of the underground Stone Chamber.
The Stone Chamber had completely collapsed. On one side of the Stone Chamber underground, there was a straight passage hundreds of feet long, created by the impact of the elephant's leg.
The corpse of the Shura Master and the Void Stone, both containing earth-shattering powers, naturally would not be affected by mere falling rocks and still floated quietly there.
"Let's go back and have another look," Yuan Ming pondered briefly, touched the Shura Stone Tablet, and with a flash of white light, both reappeared in the Stone Chamber.
The collapsed rubble inside the Stone Chamber had disappeared without a trace, naturally moved elsewhere by him.This content originates from *, *.
Xi Ying seemed extremely interested in the corpse of the Shura Master, examining it incessantly.
Yuan Ming, however, after only looking a few times, took out the Shura Blood Devouring Map, tossed it into the air, and struck it with a spell; a streak of black light entered the Blood Devouring Map.
This black light was the forbidden power of the Shura Palace, no less powerful than a strike from a Nascent Soul cultivator.
With a "boom", a large expanse of Blood Light erupted from the Shura Blood Devouring Map, engulfing the Stone Chamber, and the seals within it were instantly broken.
The Blood-colored Skull and the red-clothed woman flew out from within the map, but the area around the Shura Blood Devouring Map was enveloped by a powerful Space Restriction. Having just flown out, they hit an invisible wall and were confined within a space of several tens of feet around the Blood Devouring Map.
"Keep still and don't move around," Yuan Ming said slowly to the Blood-colored Skull and the red-clothed woman.
"It's you! How did the Shura Blood Devouring Map fall into your hands?" The Blood-colored Skull, which had once sent a Blood Shadow clone to attack Yuan Ming but was killed by him and lost a Blood River Pearl, immediately recognized Yuan Ming and roared angrily.
The red-clothed woman had clashed with Yuan Ming secretly but had not seen his face. Seeing this situation, she did not speak.
"The Six Desires Venerable has been executed. This map has now acknowledged me as its master. If you two don't want to suffer, you'd better obediently follow my orders, or else don't blame me for being impolite," Yuan Ming said.
"Pah! A Core Formation Stage cultivator like you wants to command me? Return that Blood River Pearl to me!" The Blood-colored Skull spat out eight Blood River Pearls, and a long winding river shadow immediately emerged above the Blood Devouring Map.
"Ignorant of death!" Yuan Ming sneered, unleashing the power of the Space Restriction oppressively.
The source of all the spatial power in the Shura Palace was in the Void Stone, and here in this underground Stone Chamber, the power of the Space Restriction was far superior to other places. The eight Blood River Pearls were easily separated into several segments, and the Blood River Formation immediately collapsed.
The Blood-colored Skull was startled and attempted to use other means.
Yuan Ming took out the Thunder God Hammer, and a thick bolt of thunder shot out, vanishing into the void in a flash.
A fluctuation appeared above the head of the Blood-colored Skull, and that silver thunder emerged from nowhere, striking down hard on the skull of the Blood-colored Skull.
Although the silver thunder was not as powerful as the golden thunder talisman that Xi Ying had previously cast, it still had a significant restraining effect on the Blood-colored Skull's skeletal structure.
Silver arcs of electricity raced across the Blood-colored Skull's body, its condensed power disrupted, and it screamed in agony.
"You're courting death!" The blood-colored skull erupted in towering fury, as flickers of blood light started to shimmer on the Shura Blood Devouring Map, seemingly about to employ its space-shifting divine skill.
However, Yuan Ming sneered condescendingly and lightly tapped the Shura Stone Tablet.
The entire stone chamber was enveloped in a layer of white light, solidifying all the space power within.
Having previously clashed with the Six Desires Venerable, Yuan Ming had learned from the Silver Void Tree Demon how to counteract the space-shifting divine skill. As long as the space power could be sealed, the space-shifting divine skill would be rendered unusable.
The Void Stone was right nearby, and with its power, plus the restrictions within the Shura Palace, temporarily sealing the space within the stone chamber was effortless.
The body of the blood-colored skull wobbled but returned to normal, failing to shift its position, and it was utterly shocked.
Yuan Ming's expression remained impassive as he once again began to activate the Thunder God Hammer.
Another even thicker bolt of silvery thunder shot out, striking the blood-colored skull.
The blood-colored skull let out a wretched scream as it was knocked to the ground.
Yuan Ming continued to pour mana into the Thunder God Hammer, sending waves of thunder crashing down upon the blood-colored skull.
"You little bastard, you dare... Ah!"
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, it's my fault... Ah..."
"Master, please spare me, I'm willing to submit to you!"
Initially stubborn, the blood-colored skull received seven or eight blows from the Thunder God Hammer and eventually gave in, begging for mercy.
Yuan Ming delivered a few more merciless strikes until the blood-colored skull was barely hanging on. Then he stopped and, turning to the red-clothed woman whose face was a mask of shock and uncertainty, he said:
"Would you care to try resisting as well?"
At this moment, he had complete control over all the restrictions within the Shura Palace. Even if the red-clothed woman and the blood-colored skull were to double their strength while inside, they stood no chance against him.
"Fellow Daoist, your strength is superior. I am willing to follow you!" said the red-clothed woman, hastily speaking out.
"Smart choice. Where is the Shura Blood Devouring Map Artifact Spirit? What do you say?" Yuan Ming said indifferently.
