"Hehe, Fellow Daoist Yuan, your divine skills are extraordinary, and you were personally chosen by the Shura Master as his successor. I've always admired you and am honored to serve under your command," said the voice of the Shura Blood Devouring Map Artifact Spirit, ingratiatingly.
If Yuan Ming had not been possessing the red-clothed woman, upon hearing the previous conversation between the Shura Blood Devouring Map and the blood-colored skull, he might have actually been fooled by the Artifact Spirit.
However, Yuan Ming did not call out the Artifact Spirit. With a single finger to his forehead, a beam of blood light shot out, disappearing into the Shura Blood Devouring Map in the blink of an eye as he began to refine the map.
This time, the Artifact Spirit did not resist, and Yuan Ming soon touched upon the four runes at the corners of the Shura Blood Devouring Map, beginning the refinement through casting.
But the Shura Blood Devouring Map was a Spiritual Treasure, with incredibly sturdy runes quite different from ordinary Magic Treasures, making it extremely difficult to refine.
Seeing this, the Artifact Spirit sneered inwardly. Without the correct Sacrificial Refining Method, how could a Spiritual Treasure possibly be easily controlled?
If it were a Nascent Soul cultivator, they could still forcibly refine and control the Shura Blood Devouring Map with their profound mana, but Yuan Ming was only at the Core Formation Stage, and far from capable of such a feat.
This was precisely why he chose to feign submission to Yuan Ming.
As long as Yuan Ming took the Shura Blood Devouring Map out of the Shura Palace, he could escape Yuan Ming's control and gain complete freedom.
After yet another attempt at refinement without progress, Yuan Ming reluctantly ceased his efforts.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, there's no need to be impatient. A Spiritual Treasure is inherently difficult to refine. Even the Shura Master spent a full three years mastering this map using a painstaking method. However, with your powerful Divine Sense, I think it will take you no more than two years," the Artifact Spirit consoled him.
"Is that so?" Yuan Ming said quietly, then resumed the refinement process.
This time, his technique was different from before; it was the Sacrificial Refining Method taught to him by the Shura Master, used to refine the Shura Stone Tablet.
Joy quickly spread across Yuan Ming's face as his mana began to rapidly penetrate the four runes of the Shura Blood Devouring Map, a stark contrast to the previous difficulty he had faced while refining.
"How does Fellow Daoist Yuan know this Sacrificial Refining Secret Technique?" asked the Artifact Spirit in shock.
"It was passed on to me by the Shura Master. Is there a problem with this secret technique?" Yuan Ming asked casually, while continuing to cast.
"No... no issues..." the Artifact Spirit stammered, fuming inside.
This Sacrificial Refining Method was not of the Yunhuang Continent but was passed to the Shura Master by the previous owner of the Shura Blood Devouring Map. The method involved great significance, and that person had made the Shura Master swear not to divulge it. Now that the Shura Master had broken his oath, the Artifact Spirit's plans were completely ruined.
"Damn that old Shura ghost, setting traps for me even in death!" cursed the Artifact Spirit internally.

chapters.title: Chapter 447 - 424 The Mystery Overseas
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming was naturally unaware of the little tricks within the Artifact Spirit's mind and continued to operate the secret technique, swiftly refining the runes at the four corners of the Shura Blood Devouring Map.
Though these four runes couldn't form a rune formation, their effects were interconnected, used to control the changing size of the Shura Blood Devouring Map and the function of spatial displacement.
He continued to channel his mana, spreading it deep into the Shura Blood Devouring Map, and soon encountered more runes, this time eight of them.
Yuan Ming followed the same method, continuing to refine with the secret technique, and quickly refined these eight runes as well.
These eight runes formed a rune formation that was used to control the Artifact Spirit, the Blood-colored Skull, the red-clothed woman, and others.
As soon as the eight runes were completely refined, the Shura Blood Devouring Map suddenly erupted with intense blood light, and a blood-colored Jade Scroll shot out from within.
Yuan Ming reached out to catch it and his Divine Sense entered it, he couldn't help but be overjoyed.
Recorded within the Jade Scroll was the very Body Cultivation Method mentioned by the Shura Master, named "Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill."
According to the Classics, this was a method created by an ancient Body Cultivation expert who, by chance, observed a massive elephant capable of reaching the heavens, studied it for a hundred years, and combined with his own understanding of Body Cultivation.
The Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill had five layers, corresponding to the realms of Copper Skin Body, Iron Bone Body, Innate Body, Tongqiao Body, and Body of Wanxiang.
Yuan Ming had never obtained any other Body Cultivation Methods, but he had discussed Body Cultivation information with Vajra on normal days and had also discussed Body Cultivation with other Core Formation Stage cultivators in Spirit Wind City, so he was able to see the power of the Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill.
Ordinary Body Cultivation Methods, when reaching the realm of copper skin, could only have the strength of one ox, but upon reaching the first layer of the Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill, one could possess the strength of an elephant.
The second layer was ten elephants, the third layer was a hundred elephants, the fourth layer was a thousand elephants, and reaching the fifth layer, one could truly possess the power of Wanxiang.
The Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill was different from the Body Cultivation Method practiced by Vajra; it did not absorb nature's spiritual energy for cultivation but directly absorbed Qi-Blood Power to strengthen muscles and bones, somewhat similar to Hua Zhi's abilities.
The stronger the strength of the absorbed target, the greater the help to the Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill; as long as there was sufficient Qi-Blood Power supplied, the skill could progress rapidly.This chapter was originally posted on *.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming's heart pounded excitedly.
The power of the Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill, as well as the speed of its cultivation, far exceeded his expectations, and he almost doubted whether such a body cultivation technique, which could be described as defying the heavens, wasn't just fabricated by others.
But considering the corpse of the Shura Master beside him, as well as the previous instructions from the Shura Master, it seemed unlikely to be fake.
Attached to the back of the Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill were many cultivation experiences, which should have been left by the Shura Master and other predecessors who had practiced it before.
After a moment of silence, Yuan Ming put away the blood-colored Jade Scroll, attempting to continue probing the interior of the Shura Blood Devouring Map; however, no matter how he tried, he could not advance any further.
"It seems my cultivation is not enough," Yuan Ming sighed quietly and stopped casting.
"Master!" The Blood-colored Skull and the red-clothed woman knelt down before Yuan Ming.
The Artifact Spirit also showed itself as a Blood Shadow, bowing towards Yuan Ming, utterly abandoning any thoughts of betrayal.
"There is no need for such courtesy; although you are now under my control, in life you were both Nascent Soul experts. I will not treat you as mere slaves; in the future, we shall communicate as peers," Yuan Ming waved his hand, and a force of restriction lifted up the Blood-colored Skull and the red-clothed woman.
The three of them were greatly surprised upon hearing this, but felt somewhat better.
"You have been in the Shura Blood Devouring Map for a long time, you should be very familiar with its capabilities, right?" Yuan Ming said.
He had refined the prohibitions of the Shura Blood Devouring Map and had a certain understanding of the treasure's capabilities, but naturally, it was not as detailed as the knowledge of the Artifact Spirit and the figures of the Blood-colored Skull and the red-clothed woman.
The three Artifact Spirits did not hold back anymore and shared all they knew.
The Shura Blood Devouring Map was capable of draining others' blood and then refining their bodies into skeleton-shaped Blood Slaves.
The Blood Slaves could maintain their combat strength and many abilities from before death, and even if their bodies were shattered, as long as they could return to the Shura Blood Devouring Map in time, they could recover.
The extracted blood, on the other hand, was stored inside the Shura Blood Devouring Map and refined into a pure Qi-Blood called Blood Origin Power.
At first glance, the capabilities of the Shura Blood Devouring Map seemed similar to those of the Night Parade of Hundred Demons, but they were not.
The Night Parade of Hundred Demons could at most refine Nascent Soul cultivators and only three at a time; the Shura Blood Devouring Map, however, could refine cultivators at the Returning to Void Stage, and as many as twelve.
As for ordinary Blood Slaves, naturally, the number was much higher; if fully utilized, the map could form an entire army of Blood Slaves.
Originally, the Shura Master had subdued dozens of Nascent Soul Blood Slaves, but unfortunately, most of them perished during three expeditions Overseas, leaving only the Blood-colored Skull and the red-clothed woman.
During the previous battle at the Black Tower, the Core Formation Stage Blood Slaves in the Shura Blood Devouring Map were all destroyed under Wan Qi Hong's Sword Array.
Now there were only two— the Blood-colored Skull and the red-clothed woman— within the Shura Blood Devouring Map.
Yuan Ming didn't pay much attention to the decline in the fighting power of the Shura Blood Devouring Map, his eyes flickering with an irrepressible excitement.
Compared to the Blood Slaves, he valued the map's ability to refine blood even more. The Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill required the swallowing of others' Qi-Blood to practice, but if the Qi-Blood wasn't purified, the harm was significant. At best, cultivation would stagnate; at worst, it could cause one's body to mutate and even explode to death.
Among magic practitioners, there were also techniques for swallowing other people's Essence Blood to enhance one's cultivation. Such methods were too eager for quick success and belonged to the Demon Dao, fraught with hidden dangers.
The Shura Blood Devouring Map could actually refine others' blood, transforming it into the pure Blood Origin Power, which when absorbed posed much less harm.
"It seems the true effect of the Shura Blood Devouring Map is to assist the Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill. Could this Spiritual Treasure have been crafted for this purpose?" Yuan Ming mused to himself.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, did we say something wrong?" The Artifact Spirit asked tentatively upon seeing Yuan Ming's ever-changing expressions.
"No, I was just slightly wistful. It's just that this Shura Blood Devouring Map actually possesses such miraculous Divine Skills," Yuan Ming said.
"Spiritual Treasures far outshine Magic Treasures; it's only natural for it to have such power," the Artifact Spirit said with a slight sigh of relief.
"Hmm, let's not talk about that. Artifact Spirit, according to what the Shura Master said, this Shura Blood Devouring Map is from Overseas. You must have some understanding of the Overseas World, tell me about it," Yuan Ming looked toward the Artifact Spirit.
"This... I'm very sorry, Fellow Daoist Yuan, I was forced by the first owner of the Shura Blood Devouring Map to take a heavy oath, to never reveal anything about the Overseas World, or else I would be willing to accept divine punishment and die with my soul scattered," the Artifact Spirit said with a bitter smile.
"Is that so? Was the first owner of the Shura Blood Devouring Map the same Overseas visitor that gave the map to the Shura Master?" Yuan Ming's gaze flickered as he probed further.
"Yes, actually, the Shura Master was also forced by that person to take a heavy oath, but he probably reckoned he would die anyway and didn't keep the promise, telling you quite a bit about the Overseas World," the Artifact Spirit said.
"Why would that Overseas visitor want to seal your mouths like this?" Yuan Ming pondered, pressing for an answer.
"I'm not too clear about that," the Artifact Spirit replied vaguely, obviously insincere.
Yuan Ming stared at the Artifact Spirit for a while, making it feel very uncomfortable before he finally averted his gaze.
"Blood Shadow, Hong Ling, what about the two of you? Are you also cultivators from Overseas?" Yuan Ming turned to look at the blood-colored skull and the red-clothed woman.
Through the previous exchange, he had already learned their names.
"Of course not. I am an elder of the East Sea Blood Transformation Sect, and Hong Ling is a cultivator from the Southern Border Silk Island. We were both refined into the Shura Blood Devouring Map by the Shura Master back in the day," Blood Shadow quickly said.
"The Blood Transformation Sect? Does your sect have a Cultivation Technique named the Blood Transformation Technique?" Yuan Ming asked, surprised.
"You've heard of the Blood Transformation Sect, Fellow Daoist Yuan? Could it be that there is still a lineage existing today?" Blood Shadow asked with surprise.
"I haven't heard of the Blood Transformation Sect, it's just that I previously slew a cultivator and obtained a Blood Transformation Technique classic from his body, as well as two Magic Artifacts of the Blood Transformation Sect," Yuan Ming took out the Blood Star Tube and the Blood Transformation Saber as he spoke.
"The Blood Star Tube, the Blood Transformation Saber! These are the two great secret Magic Treasures of our sect! It's a pity that the refining techniques are rough, and there are many mistakes and omissions. It seems even if the Blood Transformation Sect still has a lineage, it must have already declined greatly," Blood Shadow examined the two artifacts and sighed.
"Since you are an elder of the Blood Transformation Sect, I shall entrust these two artifacts to you. Help me repair them, and preferably, elevate them to the level of Magic Treasures," Yuan Ming casually tossed the Blood Star Tube and the Blood Transformation Saber over.
He was not in need of Magic Treasures for his use, but as the scale of the Moon Sect grew, he needed to reward his subordinates, and having more Magic Treasures was naturally better.
"Understood," Blood Shadow took the items and stood silently to the side.
Yuan Ming then inquired about Hong Ling's origin. Her sect was from the Southern Domain of the Southern Border, said to be one of the largest sects great in Illusion Techniques and seduction techniques.
Yuan Ming was very interested in Hong Ling's Magic Treasure; after asking, he learned it was the Binding Immortal Spider Web, a unique Magic Treasure of Pan Si Island.
"There is no need for you here now; you may leave," Yuan Ming waved his hand.
The three gave Yuan Ming a salute and merged back into the Shura Blood Devouring Map.
Yuan Ming reached for the Shura Blood Devouring Map, about to put it away.
"Don't put away the Blood Devouring Map yet; the body of the Shura Master contains an abundance of Qi-Blood that would be a waste not to utilize," Xi Ying said, appearing by his side and raising her hand to stop him.
"I promised the Shura Master that if I ever have the chance to set foot on the Overseas Continent, I would carry his body there for burial; I cannot damage it now," Yuan Ming was tempted by the idea but ultimately shook his head.
"The Shura Master asked you to take his body for burial, not the power contained within it. Surely you can sense that the Qi-Blood power within the Shura Master's body is gradually dissipating; if you don't use it, it will simply be wasted," Xi Ying said.
"This place is not suitable right now; let's talk about it later," Yuan Ming said, his face expressing hesitation, still shaking his head.
He carefully manipulated the forbidden power and slowly returned the Shura Master's body back into the blood-colored coffin.
Yuan Ming turned to the Void Stone, channeled his Mana and Divine Sense into it, and his eyebrows quickly rose.
Inside the Void Stone, four bubble-like silver light spots were suspended, which his Divine Sense touched one by one. Each silver light spot represented a separate space, completely independent from each other.

chapters.title: Chapter 448 - 425: Four Voids
chapters.content:
"This Void Stone actually opened up four spaces; treasures from the Overseas World are indeed mystical," Yuan Ming thought to himself.
The first space was the plaza where they had first entered the cave mansion, which was relatively the smallest in area.
The second space was where Yin Capital City was located, spanning a hundred miles in size, much larger than the plaza in the first space.
The third space housed the Black Tower and was the largest of them all, dwarfing the Yin Capital City space. It contained the Cold Martial Realm, the Extreme Fire Realm, and the Netherworld.
However, aside from the three regions such as the Cold Martial Realm, there was also a mysterious place draped in unpredictable white fog that even the exploration prohibitions within the Shura Palace could not sense.
The fourth space wasn't large, being at most two to three miles in circumference. Like the third space, it too was shrouded in a dense mist, appearing greenish and equally unclear about its insides.
Yuan Ming's brow raised, and he activated the spatial movement restriction. He and Xi Ying disappeared into thin air, and the next moment, they appeared within the white fogged area.
A powerful Illusion Power assaulted them, and before Yuan Ming could stabilize his stance, his Sea of Consciousness buzzed, and countless illusions emerged before his eyes, his consciousness quickly sinking into oblivion.
Xi Ying's situation was the same, unable to resist the erosion of the white fog's Illusion Power, her gaze rapidly turning dazed.
Fortunately, Yuan Ming had anticipated this and bit his tongue without hesitation before his consciousness fully succumbed, his spirit slightly vibrating.
Taking advantage of this brief clarity, he immediately pulled Xi Ying, and the two of them vanished without a trace, with the Stealing Heaven Tripod left floating where they had stood.
Entering the space within the Stealing Heaven Tripod, the Illusion Power from outside was instantly blocked, and both quickly regained consciousness.
"What formidable Illusion Power!" Xi Ying exclaimed in shock.
Although she was a Soul Cultivator and not specialized in Illusion Techniques, her Illusion Technique was still quite powerful. She could not withstand the erosion of the white fog, which had never happened even when facing the Six Desires Venerable before.
"I have a rough idea of what's inside the white fog," said Yuan Ming thoughtfully before waving his hand and casting a spell to activate the spatial restriction.
A flash of golden light on the surface of the Stealing Heaven Tripod, and it vanished from within the white fog, relocating to the edge of the white fog space.
The nearby void fluctuated, and the Three-eyed Crow materialized.
The crow was thrilled upon sensing the Illusion Power contained within the white fog; its third eye revealed a look of surprise as it quickly absorbed the demonic power and prayed to the Nether Moon God.
Yuan Ming utilized the crow's Desire Power as an anchor point and extended his Divine Sense into the depths of the white fog.
The Illusion Power within the fog tried to erode along his Divine Sense but was completely blocked by the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
A slight relief in Yuan Ming's heart, he continued to push his Divine Sense deeper, soon reaching the very depths of the white fog.
A bright white spirit light floated there, and at the heart of the light was a white rune, exceedingly complex, rivalling even the "Curse" rune, emitting dreamlike and endlessly changing white spirit light.
"It really is it," Yuan Ming's eyes gleamed with delight.This is a sample from *. Read the rest on *.
While he had never seen this white rune before, he recognized at a glance that it was the "All Living Beings' Dream" rune, previously mentioned by the Shura Master.
This rune was indeed formidable; even Xi Ying, the Sleeping Witch, couldn't resist it.
Yuan Ming pondered briefly before once again activating the Shura Palace's spatial restriction, and with a flash, the Stealing Heaven Tripod appeared near the "All Living Beings' Dream" rune.
The next moment, Yuan Ming appeared beside the "All Living Beings' Dream" rune, an overwhelmingly strong Illusion Power washing over him.
Almost simultaneously, a black shadow passed in front of Yuan Ming, and the Night Parade of Hundred Demons emerged from nowhere, shielding against this power.
Within the Night Parade of Hundred Demons, several Ghost Slaves became expressionless, lost in illusion.
Seizing the moment, Yuan Ming urged the Night Parade of Hundred Demons, a black light enveloping the "All Living Beings' Dream" rune, and with a 'swoosh', brought it into the space of the Night Parade of Hundred Demons.
As the "All Living Beings' Dream" rune was taken away, the omnipresent Illusion Power within the white fog area vanished without a trace, and the white mist also dissipated as quickly as clouds parting after a storm.
"So this is the 'All Living Beings' Dream' rune obtained by the Shura Master, a truly powerful rune. This thing seems to contain the ultimate essence of the art of illusion; you're lucky to have it and should take the chance to hone your skills," Xi Ying said as she appeared beside Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming nodded. His Dream Butterfly Illusion Technique had not progressed for a long time. When he had seen the "All Living Beings' Dream" rune just now, he had contemplated using it to practice his Illusion Technique.
Moreover, the Three-eyed Crow's Illusion-breaking Demon Eyes could absorb Illusion Power and refine its eyesight. The "All Living Beings' Dream" rune had an endless power of Illusion; it could also enhance the potency of the Illusion-breaking Demon Eyes.
Yuan Ming summoned the Shura Stone Tablet and gestured in the air.
The two disappeared once again and appeared inside the fourth space created by the Void Stone, the only place Yuan Ming had not yet fully explored.
A rich green fog surged towards them, which was actually Wood Attribute Spiritual Energy condensed to the extreme. With a single breath, Yuan Ming felt a slight increase in his internal Mana.
"Such rich Wood Attribute Spiritual Energy; this must be the Medicine Garden that the Shura Master cultivated," suggested Xi Ying.
Yuan Ming had also come to this conclusion and flew forward.
A resilient force radiated from within the green fog, seemingly a protective barrier that stopped them in their tracks. Their Divine Senses were also held back, only probing a few feet into the fog.
Yuan Ming took out the Thunder God Hammer, and a thick bolt of lightning struck deep into the green fog.
Xi Ying also unleashed the Golden Dragon Scissors, with two golden Flood Dragons crisscrossing and slashing into the green fog.
Though the barrier within the green mist was robust, it was no match for the Thunder God Hammer and the Golden Dragon Scissors. A tearing sound echoed as the forbidden barrier was breached with a single strike, and the Divine Senses of Yuan Ming and Xi Ying spread into it.
A wail came from ahead as a shadowy figure flickered within the green mist, fleeing into the distance.
"Where do you think you're going!" Yuan Ming shouted lowly, flipping his hand to draw the Soul Destroying Sword.
A force of Curse Power burst forth, striking the fleeing shadow.
The shadow turned into a solid form, surprisingly a child around three feet tall, looking about seven or eight years old, with soft and fair arms and legs, two goat horn braids atop the head, dressed in a multicolored garment, appearing incredibly adorable.
Although this individual seemed but a young child, their strength was extraordinarily formidable, in no way inferior to that of a Nascent Soul cultivator, and yet the aura emitted was that of demonic power.
The child in the colorful garment was now in agony, with its vitality greatly diminished.
The figure of Hong Ling appeared beside Yuan Ming, and with a flick and a pull of her ten fingers, the Binding Immortal Spider Web shot out, enveloping the body of the child in the multicolored garment as if capturing a large fish.
The child glared furiously at Yuan Ming and Hong Ling. A flash of golden light crossed the child's body, and it vanished from within the Binding Immortal Spider Web.
"Golden Escape Technique! This person could actually discern that the weakness of the Binding Immortal Spider Web was the Golden Escape!" Hong Ling was taken aback.
Hong Ling had the constitution of three spirit roots but had later refined a foreign object, and a fourth type of Mana had emerged within her body. Within the Five Elements, only the Gold Attribute Mana was missing.
The Binding Immortal Spider Web contained the power of the Five Elements—Gold, Wood, Water, Fire, Earth—and could bind all cultivators with the Five Elements Spirit Root, yet due to Hong Ling's lack of Gold Attribute Mana, the web had limited effect on attacks of the Gold Attribute.
Hong Ling had always tried her best to keep this a secret, yet the child in the multicolored garment saw through it at first glance and was even adept at the rarely seen Golden Escape Technique, which was truly astonishing.
At that moment, Xi Ying made a move, with the Golden Dragon Scissors shooting out like lightning, slashing at the void not too far away.
A myriad of golden lights erupted from the Golden Dragon Scissors, forcing a figure out of the void, and it was indeed the child in the multicolored garment.
The child's little face showed surprise. With a delicate raise of its hand, five beams of gold, green, blue, red, and yellow light shot out, striking the Golden Dragon Scissors.
Each beam of spirit light contained an astounding level of Spiritual Power, one more astonishing than the next; the Golden Dragon Scissors let out a loud noise, being knocked away.
The child in the multicolored garment was also repelled a few steps by the rebound force of the Golden Dragon Scissors, turning into a golden shadow and dashing towards the depths of the green mist.
Not getting far, the child suddenly saw a blurry vision, returning to its original place as the Golden Dragon Scissors thunderously descended again.
With a look of shock, the child once again emitted the five-colored light to repel it, continuing towards the depths of the green mist; however, its vision blurred yet again, returning to its original spot as two golden flood dragons intertwined and descended in a slash.
"What's going on?" The child in the colorful garment's expression turned completely dark.
The Golden Dragon Scissors paid no heed and swept forward with the might to cleave through the void.
Within the green mist, the child in the colorful garment had a look of alarm on its face. Its hands flailed ceaselessly, firing beams of five-colored light outward, but striking nothing, clearly falling completely into an illusion.
Yuan Ming secretly marveled at the sight. Xi Ying's Illusion Technique was indeed extraordinary, subduing the child in the colorful garment with mere ease.
At this point, he had not entered the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space and could not see soul threads, but Xi Ying must have used that ability to trap the child in the illusion.
Xi Ying's figure flashed, appearing behind the child in the colorful garment, and tapped on the back of the child's head.
The child's body stiffened and fell forward to the ground, only to be swept up by Xi Ying's flick of a sleeve.
"Not killing this demon?" Yuan Ming inquired.
"This demon is no ordinary creature, it must not be killed. I will explain more later. Let's first check the situation with the Medicine Garden," Xi Ying said, looking forward.
With the capture of the child in the colorful garment, the green fog dispersed, revealing a large Medicine Garden within the view of the two.
"It is indeed a Medicine Garden!" Yuan Ming's eyes lit up with joy.
Having existed for three thousand years, if this Shura Palace's Medicine Garden was well preserved, wouldn't it mean there were numerous thousand-year-old spiritual grasses, an incalculable fortune!
He quickened his pace, stepping into the Medicine Garden.
The entire Medicine Garden was divided into dozens of areas, with no less than a hundred kinds of spirit grass planted. Yuan Ming examined them carefully, his joyful expression slowly fading away.
All the spirit grasses in the Medicine Garden were thriving, but they were only four or five hundred years old. Not a single thousand-year-old spirit grass could be found, let alone those of three thousand years.
"How can this be? Could it have been that child in the colorful garment who's responsible?" Yuan Ming considered a possibility.
"Correct, the older spirit grasses have all been devoured by that child," said Xi Ying, her expression still calm.
"Xi Ying, it seems you had already guessed the state of the Medicine Garden. Do you know the origin of that child in the colorful garment?" Yuan Ming asked.
"Hmm, that child in the colorful garment should be a sentient being transformed from the Five Elements Creation Tree," Xi Ying nodded and said.
"The Five Elements Creation Tree... What is that? The name does sound quite intimidating," Yuan Ming said with a somber tone, murmuring.
He had previously looked forward to reaping a Medicine Garden filled with thousand-year spiritual grasses, only to find that an inner demon had devoured them all, leaving no one pleased.

chapters.title: Chapter 449 - 426: This Day Next Year
chapters.content:
"Why are you upset? This might just be your lucky break! The Five Elements Creation Tree is a type of Ancient Spiritual Wood, possessing extremely pure Spiritual Powers of the Gold, Wood, Water, Fire, Earth elements. Even obtaining a section of it could greatly boost one's Cultivation progress. It is said that in ancient times, a Qi Refining Stage cultivator accidentally came across a dying Five Elements Creation Tree, and he chopped off its branches to brew and drink, finishing the whole plant. His Cultivation level, as a result, soared directly to the Nascent Soul Stage," Xi Ying remarked with a glance at Yuan Ming.
"Is there really such a miraculous Spiritual Object that can steal the creation of heaven and earth?" Yuan Ming couldn't help but draw a sharp breath.
"Whether this is true or fabricated by someone, I can't say for sure, as rumors always tend to be somewhat exaggerated. However, this does illustrate the wondrous nature of the Five Elements Creation Tree, which, after all, money can't buy in the outside world," Xi Ying explained.
"So, this Five Elements Creation Tree should help in forming a Nascent Soul, right?" Yuan Ming thought to himself and asked.
"You do have a knack for catching the crucial points. Indeed, the resin secreted by the Five Elements Creation Tree aids the transformation of the Golden Core. The wondrous elixir, Five Elements Infant Condensing Pill, is primarily made from this resin and can increase the chances of breaking through to the Nascent Soul by thirty to forty percent," Xi Ying said nonchalantly.
"Do you have the recipe for this pill?" Yuan Ming asked incredulously, his surprise mingled with disbelief.
"This recipe is a secret passage of the Wuyue Sect, said to be provided by none other than the Wu Yue God herself. A Five Elements Creation Tree grows within the forbidden grounds of the Wuyue Sect, which is also why there are constantly Nascent Soul cultivators emerging from the sect. By chance, my ancestor also got ahold of this recipe," Xi Ying revealed.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming no longer harbored any doubts, his eyes filled with excitement.
Everything at the Shura Palace had come to an end, and unexpectedly, there was this final gain.
"The Five Elements Creation Tree requires a substantial supply of spirit grass's spiritual energy to survive; thus, it has consumed all thousand-year-old spiritual grasses within this Medicine Garden. No more sorrows now, right?" Xi Ying pointed out the reason for the disappearance of the thousand-year-old spiritual grasses.
"If it means consuming this entire Medicine Garden, I would not mind. Now that we have the primary material and the recipe, what about the other auxiliary materials?" Yuan Ming joked lightly, since he didn't own the Medicine Garden and it really wasn't his place to feel regret.
"You don't need to worry about that; I'm confident in gathering them. With this pill, our chances of forming a Nascent Soul will greatly increase," Xi Ying responded.
"Us? Didn't Ni Mu and the others say that your original body had long since broken through to the Nascent Soul Stage and is even considered the most outstanding prodigy of the Xi Family for a thousand years? Do you intend to allow this clone to also form a Nascent Soul?" Yuan Ming asked in surprise.
Thiscontentoriginatesfrom*,MyVirtualLibraryEmpire.
"Ni Mu doesn't understand the Xi Family. It wasn't me who spent over a hundred years forming a Nascent Soul; it was my sister. Due to a particular reason, my sister's existence must remain hidden, hence the proclamation that I was the one who formed the Nascent Soul. Please keep this matter confidential," Xi Ying clarified.
"Of course. But how old are you really?" Yuan Ming asked curiously.
"About your age," Xi Ying replied.
Yuan Ming, who was not much more than forty years old, was considered middle-aged by mortal standards. However, for a Core Formation Stage cultivator, forty was exceedingly young.
Ordinary Core Formation cultivators who could form a core at two hundred were rare, and a forty-year-old Core Formation cultivator would undoubtedly cause many to drop their jaws in awe.
Yuan Ming wasn't concerned about this, but another aspect of Xi Ying greatly intrigued him.
"It's one thing to talk about magic practitioners, but Xi Ying, using only forty years, not only did you significantly advance your main body's Soul Cultivation, but you also cultivated this clone to the Sleep Witch Realm, which is truly impressive. I am nowhere close to you," Yuan Ming sighed.
Having benefited from the Desire Power of the Stealing Heaven Tripod, his Soul Cultivation had only reached the Love Witch Realm, thus his admiration for Xi Ying was sincere and profound.
"This matter is a long story, tied to some of the Xi Family's secrets, which ordinarily shouldn't be revealed to outsiders, but sharing it with you is harmless," Xi Ying said after a brief hesitation.
Yuan Ming's expression shifted, indicating he had more to say but hesitated.
"Although our Xi Family is a branch of the Wuyue Sect, we also have our own fortune. The Wuyue Sect, desperate to have us rejoin, is partly due to this. Our family has a secret technique allowing a dying Soul Cultivator to pass on their Soul Power to their descendants. My ability to reach the Sleep Witch Realm at such a young age is due to this, and when it comes to innate talent in Soul Cultivation, I may not even match up to you," Xi Ying revealed.
"There is such a secret technique?" Yuan Ming widened his eyes slightly.
"There are millions of secret techniques in the world, what we know is merely a drop in the ocean," Xi Ying stated.
"I was ignorant," Yuan Ming nodded.
"With the affairs of Shura Palace finally settling, I plan to return to my family soon to prepare for refining the Five Elements Infant Condensing Pill. Moreover, with the Six Desires Venerable's fall, the Wuyue Sect is bound to be shaken, and the Xi Family must prepare early," Xi Ying said, looking into the distance with a deep gaze.
"Then take care in your endeavors and contact me immediately if you encounter any difficulties," Yuan Ming said.
"Once family matters are settled, I will make a trip to the East Sea. An important spiritual material required to refine the Five Elements Infant Condensing Pill can only be found there," Xi Ying mentioned relaxedly.
Yuan Ming chuckled inwardly, realizing Xi Ying was indirectly inviting him to join her to the East Sea, yet she was too proud to ask outright.
"I will also be heading back to Da Jin to bring my parents out from under Chang Chun Temple's watchful eyes and settle them in a safe place. After that, I too will visit the East Sea to lend you a hand," Yuan Ming spoke up.
"With your help, things might indeed go more smoothly; let's plan to meet in the Dragon King City in the East Sea a year from now," Xi Ying said with a slight smile, which she quickly concealed.
"Dragon King City?" Yuan Ming had never been to the East Sea and hadn't heard the name Dragon King City before.
"Dragon King City is a renowned city in the East Sea, and you will know as soon as you ask about it in the East Sea," Xi Ying said.
"Okay," Yuan Ming nodded.
The two then discussed some details about their meeting, and Xi Ying asked Yuan Ming to escort her out of the Shura Palace.
When Xi Ying left, she took Yan Sijing with her, saying that she wanted to rescue Yan Siyun and use Yan Siyun's ability to foresee fortunes and disasters to accomplish some tasks.
In the blink of an eye, only Yuan Ming was left in the entire Shura Palace.
He was silent for a moment, closed his eyes to control his breathing and cultivate, restoring his mana and divine soul, then continued to manipulate the Shura Stone Tablet to move the location of the Shura Palace.
Three days and nights later, Yuan Ming moved the Shura Palace to a remote boulder field far from the Soul Burying Abyss and concealed it underground, which finally gave him peace of mind.
Yuan Ming sat down near the Black Tower, waved his sleeve, and dozens of storage magic tools appeared around him, all belonging to the cultivators who had entered the Shura Palace.
Now controlling the entire Shura Palace, regardless of where those cultivators died, their storage magic tools couldn't escape his eyes.
Yuan Ming first checked the storage magic tools belonging to the Core Formation Stage cultivators, most of whom had entered the palace with Ni Mu and the others.
These people generally came from humble backgrounds. The items in their storage magic tools were not very valuable, mostly consisting of common magic treasures, elixirs, and spirit stones.
Somewhat valuable were the items belonging to Core Formation Stage cultivators who had entered with Dugu Feng, Thunderbolt Ancestor, and others.
A moment later, Yuan Ming completed the inspection of all the Core Formation Stage cultivators' storage magic tools, ultimately obtaining nearly a million spirit stones, thirty to forty magic treasures, a large number of elixirs, spiritual materials, and other items.
Yuan Ming waved his hand to store these items, leaving only three jade scrolls in red, white, and blue, a set of blue inner armor, and a silvery-gray strange weapon, about a zhang long, resembling a three-pointed two-bladed saber.
The three jade scrolls came respectively from Hai Dafu, a blond youth who accompanied Su Zimo, and a Core Formation Stage loose cultivator.
The red jade scroll contained the complete mnemonic of the Transplanting Technique, many years of research on secret techniques by Elder Hai, and a detailed process of refining demon cores by cultivators from the Guiyuan Sect, quite valuable.
With this jade scroll, Yuan Ming could refine demon core cultivators immediately as long as he gathered the demon cores and cultivators.
The white jade scroll contained the identity and origin of the blond youth, as well as a Body Cultivation Method.
The blond youth came from a Body Cultivation Sect in the Western Region called Vajra Sect, and it was unknown how he mingled with Su Zimo.
Having spent many years in the Black Wind Desert, Yuan Ming had some understanding of the Western Region. Like the Northern Desert, it was quite isolated, rarely interacting with the outside world. The cultivation world there was very different from the Central Plains, mainly focused on Body Cultivation.
Due to the climate, residents there differed greatly from those in the Central Plains and were called Rong people, generally tall and robust with strong bones and muscles, naturally suited for the path of Body Cultivation.
The Vajra Sect was a leading Body Cultivation Sect in the Western Region with strength not inferior to the Five Thunder Sect or the Guiyuan Sect.
The technique recorded in the jade scroll was named "Vigorous Vajra Skill," known for its power, capable of moving mountains and seas when cultivated to the extreme.
Although Yuan Ming already possessed the Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill, understanding several more Body Cultivation Methods was always beneficial.
As for the last blue jade scroll, it contained several methods for making high-grade spirit incense, all for use against enemies and poisonous incense.
What caught Yuan Ming's attention most was a spirit incense called "Common Poppy," colorless and odorless. Those affected by this incense would feel their heart fire rise and desires escalate, eventually turning into monsters that only knew intercourse, which even Core Formation Stage cultivators could hardly resist.
As Yuan Ming's cultivation surged, the Incense Making Secret Manual he had obtained from Immortal Xuanhua was gradually becoming inadequate, and the Stealing Heaven Tripod's ability to enhance the efficacy of spirit incense was almost wasted. Unexpectedly, he found several high-grade spirit incense here.
The storage magic tool of the loose cultivator contained quite meager items, apart from a subpar magic treasure, only four to five thousand spirit stones, few elixirs, and sparse spiritual materials.
As for this person's identity, his name was known to be Qian Tong, but where he came from or how he obtained this Spirit Fragrance Jade Scroll was unknown.
Yuan Ming carefully examined the three jade scrolls, studied them repeatedly, and then picked up the blue inner armor and the three-pointed two-bladed saber to examine them.
These two items were also obtained from the blond, blue-eyed youth. The blue inner armor had certain protective capabilities, but that was not its greatest effect.
The armor was refined from celestial materials and could automatically resonate with the star power in the sky, allowing the wearer to rise from the ground and soar through the skies without needing mana to activate it.
The blue inner armor and the abilities of the Tongqiao Body were somewhat similar, presumably the Vajra Sect had imitated the effects of the Tongqiao Body and refined this magic armor, allowing Body Cultivators who had not reached the Tongqiao Realm to fly out of their bodies.
The three-pointed two-bladed saber was hard and extremely sharp. Injecting mana into it had no effect, but it was a weapon specifically tailored for Body Cultivation.

chapters.title: Chapter 450 - 427: Tailor-Made
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming set the Jade Scroll and inner armor blade aside, slightly pondered, then with a wave of his hand, the figure of Vajra emerged out of nowhere.
"Master, what do you need me for?"
"Take a look at these two Body Cultivation Methods and see if they are of any help to you," Yuan Ming handed over the Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill and Vigorous Vajra Skill Jade Scrolls.
Vajra took the Jade Scroll, his Divine Sense plunged into it, then his body shuddered, a pained expression appeared on his face, and he began to scream while clutching his head.
Yuan Ming furrowed his brows and quickly realized the problem was with Vajra's Divine Soul. He hurriedly applied a secret technique to stabilize the Divine Soul, and the painful expression on Vajra's face slightly eased.
After a long while, Vajra finally recovered.
"Master, where did you obtain this Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill?" His eyes were unusually bright, and he looked at Yuan Ming with an eager gaze, impatiently asking.
"It came from the Shura Master. This cultivation technique is quite exquisite; I thought it might suit you for cultivation," Yuan Ming replied.
"Indeed, this technique is very suitable for me. As soon as I saw this technique, some unfamiliar information emerged in my mind - I seem to have been searching for this technique all along..." Vajra said.
"If this technique suits you, that's good. Practice well and work hard to enhance your strength," Yuan Ming said thoughtfully as he nodded.
Vajra was imbued with Demonic Qi, and the Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill also carried the word 'demon,' suggesting some connection between them.
"With this Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill, I am confident that I can break through to the Tongqiao Body realm within three years!" Vajra exclaimed, patting his chest.
"Good! I'll be waiting for that. However, my constant running around might impact your cultivation," Yuan Ming remarked.
"You know me well, Master! Indeed, Vajra has been thinking of leaving for a while to find a place for rigorous cultivation of the Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill," Vajra said earnestly.
"That's fine. I'll gift you these two treasures to protect yourself," Yuan Ming replied readily, as he did not have an immediate need for Vajra by his side.
As they spoke, he swept up the blue inner armor and the Three-pointed Two-bladed Saber with his sleeves, presenting them to Vajra.
Vajra caught the two items and circulated his inner breath into them.
The blue inner armor automatically dressed him, and Vajra's feet left the ground, levitating.
The Three-pointed Two-bladed Saber also emitted a silver sharpness, reaching twenty to thirty yards away.
Whoosh!
A small mountain was hit by the silver sharpness, shearing off the top as though it were tofu.
Vajra was overjoyed and with a twist of his wrist, emitted another wave of silver sharpness onto the ground.
The ground trembled slightly as a bowl-sized black hole was pierced, reaching dozens of yards into the ground.
"This Three-pointed Two-bladed Saber, perfectly compatible with my inner breath, is even better to use than the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear. Thanks for bestowing this treasure, Master!" Vajra said, stowing away the saber in gratitude.
"If it suits you well, then good," Yuan Ming was slightly surprised by the power of the Three-pointed Two-bladed Saber, but he didn't take it back, raising his chin as he spoke.
"Now that I have this saber, the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear is redundant. Master, please take it back." Vajra gestured, and the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear shot towards him.
Without any formalities, Yuan Ming swept up the spear with his sleeve and stored it away.
He then activated the Shura Stone Tablet and sent Vajra out of the Shura Palace.
Yuan Ming collected his thoughts and continued examining the storage magic tools of Lei Ming, Dugu Feng, and Su Zimo, three Nascent Soul cultivators.
The belongings of Nascent Soul cultivators were by far more substantial than those of Core Formation Stage cultivators. Each one possessed between four and five hundred thousand Spirit Stones and many varieties of elixirs, spiritual materials, and talismans, among other items.
Unfortunately, the most valuable Magic Treasures of the three powerful Nascent Souls were mostly lost; only Lei Ming's Thunder Seal remained, whereas Dugu Feng's Black and White Dual Swords and Su Zimo's Heavenly Sand Gourd were damaged and unusable.
Yuan Ming picked up the Thunder Seal Treasure and examined it closely.
The Thunder Seal was engraved with countless lightning-shaped patterns, giving off a tingling sensation just by looking at it. At the base of the seal, three small characters were written: "Thunder Shocking Seal."
"Thunder Shocking Seal... this name is quite fitting," Yuan Ming muttered to himself, practiced the mnemonic, and quickly understood the general situation of the Thunder Shocking Seal.
The Thunder Shocking Seal was refined from a type of Thunder Attribute mineral, resembling the legendary Thunder Attribute Spiritual Material, known as Thunder Shocking Stone, in the Cultivation World.
The Thunder God Hammer was also forged from the Thunder Shocking Stone, which contained immense powers of thunder and lightning, making it the top-tier material for refining Thunder Attribute Magic Treasures.
Like the Thunder God Hammer, the Thunder Shocking Seal also had nine Thunder Runes engraved within, forming a dragon-shaped Thunder Rune Array.
However, unlike the Thunder God Hammer, the grade of the Thunder Shocking Stone used in the seal was not high; the powers of thunder and lightning contained within were considerably mixed and nowhere near as refined as the Thunder God Hammer.
The power of the Thunder Rune Array inside the Thunder Shocking Seal was not enough to perfectly control the immense powers of thunder and lightning within the Seal, let alone absorb external forces of thunder and lightning to use as its own.
Thus, while the power of the Thunder Shocking Seal seemed impressive, if one could discern its pattern, it was not difficult to break through.
Yuan Ming weighed the seal in his hand, his eyebrows suddenly raised, and with a flip of his hand, he took out the Thunder God Hammer and pointed into the void.
A silver thunderbolt shot out, striking the Thunder Shocking Seal with a crack.
The Thunder Shocking Seal and the Thunder God Hammer shared the same origin of thunder attribute. The silver thunder penetrated directly into the Thunder Shocking Seal, fiercely striking the Thunder Rune Array.
The Thunder Rune Array immediately trembled, showing signs of instability.
Sensing this, Yuan Ming formed a hand gesture and pointed, causing the silver thunder to change shape into a blade-shaped thunder, which fiercely struck the Thunder Rune Array of the Thunder Shocking Seal.
The Thunder Rune Array was breached, creating a small gap through which a shocking amount of thunder power leaked out.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
The entire Thunder Seal was enveloped by a blinding blue arc of lightning, forming a blue Thunder Ball about a zhang in size, emitting a rumbling sound of thunder.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming smiled and summoned Lei Yu from the Spiritual Beast Bag.
Lei Yu had been without the power of thunder and lightning for a while and looked weak. Sensing the blue Thunder Ball outside the Thunder Shocking Seal, Lei Yu's eyes immediately showed excitement. It let out a piercing screech that seemed to penetrate the heavens and flapped its wings to rush towards it.
Moisture nearby rapidly gathered, forming a dense dark cloud around Lei Yu, enclosing the Thunder Shocking Seal within it.
The thunder power inside the blue Thunder Ball was immediately absorbed by the dark cloud and then merged into Lei Yu's body.
The Thunder Shocking Seal was a Magic Treasure refined by a Nascent Soul cultivator and contained an abundant power of thunder and lightning. Although Lei Yu was only a Second Lower Rank spirit beast, absorbing this thunder power caused its aura to surge rapidly, and it would soon reach the Second Middle-Level.
Yuan Ming did not bother with Lei Yu and let it absorb the thunder to cultivate.
He then took out four items, which were obtained from the Silver Void Tree Demon: a black gourd, a white jade plate, a green round bead, and a silver banner.
The black gourd, similar to the Wish Power Gourd he obtained from the Black River God Envoy earlier, was cast from Nine Nether Iron. The core of the gourd was embedded with a white jade fragment, holding a considerable amount of Wish Power.
Yuan Ming smiled slightly. This black gourd was much larger than the previous one; adding the previous piece of Nine Nether Iron, it was definitely enough for inscribing the second rune.
The white jade plate recorded the entire content of the Six Desires Breaking Emotion Great Method, which, like the Moonlight Technique, had six levels of mnemonics.
Compared to the relatively peaceful Moonlight Technique, the Six Desires Breaking Emotion Great Method was much more powerful.
However, Yuan Ming's disposition did not match the domineering Six Desires Breaking Emotion Great Method. Although this cultivation technique could sever the connection between Divine Soul and Physical Body, achieving immortality, he had no plans to abandon the Moonlight Technique and switch to cultivating the Six Desires Breaking Emotion Great Method.
Nevertheless, he did not withdraw his Divine Sense from the white jade plate and continued to read.
There were many Soul Cultivation Secret Skills recorded after the Six Desires Breaking Emotion Great Method, which greatly broadened Yuan Ming's horizon.
Given the status and position of the Six Desires Venerable, the secret techniques recorded on the white jade plate were naturally incomparable to the Soul Cultivation Jade Scroll left by Xi Cangqiong.
As he read through each secret technique, the joy on Yuan Ming's face grew more pronounced.
The power of these Soul Cultivation Secret Skills far exceeded his expectations, including offensive and defensive techniques, as well as intriguing methods such as charming, dreaming, and long-distance control, almost opening a new realm of soul cultivation for Yuan Ming.
"The Six Desires Venerable truly lived up to being a Great Soul Cultivator who lived for three thousand years. It's fortunate that I and Xi Ying previously struck down its main soul with lightning speed. If it had escaped and played hide and seek, it's hard to say who would have won," Yuan Ming thought somewhat relievedly.
These Soul Cultivation Secret Skills did not necessarily require the Six Desires Breaking Emotion Great Method for cultivation; the Moonlight Technique could also be used to perform them.
Yuan Ming reckoned that if he could cultivate all these secret techniques and raise his mana level a bit to reach the late-stage of Core Formation, even without entering the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space, he could match a Nascent Soul existence and at least ensure his own safety.Lovethisstory?Showsupportat*.
Among these secret techniques, the "Great Black Sky God Palm" that the Six Desires Venerable had previously used was clearly listed.
According to the jade plate's records, this Divine Skill was not purely condensed from Soul Power but was a combination of Soul Power, Mana, and Wish Power, created personally by the Wuyue God.
The Great Black Sky God Palm could not only attack the Divine Soul but also cause Mana damage and had a strong sealing effect, especially adept at sealing various magic treasures, and no matter how powerful the treasures were, they could not escape this Divine Skill's grasp.
The sealing effect was just an accessory; the most formidable aspect of the Great Black Sky God Palm was its astonishing attack power. When cultivated to the extreme, it could shatter the void and rightly claim the title of a divine palm. It was recognized as the number one offensive skill by the Wuyue Sect.
Although the Great Black Sky God Palm was powerful, it was extremely difficult to cultivate. The integration of Soul Power and Mana was secondary; the hardest part was incorporating the Wish Power.
Wish Power contained the myriad emotions of thousands of believers. To cultivate the Great Black Sky God Palm, one had to absorb this Wish Power into the body. Without methods to resolve it, no matter how strong one's will was, one would be driven mad over the long term.
Thus, although this Divine Skill was formidable, almost no one in the Wuyue Sect had managed to cultivate it apart from the Wuyue God himself.
The Six Desires Venerable used Yuan Ming's method of refining Wish Power, splitting off a separate soul to bear the erosion of Wish Power, and the main soul concentrated on condensing the Great Black Sky God Palm, barely managing to cultivate this technique.
However, the second split soul could only bear limited Wish Power; the Six Desires Venerable had only cultivated the Great Black Sky God Palm to thirty to forty percent of its potential before he dared not continue; otherwise, Yuan Ming and Xi Ying would not have been able to withstand this technique previously.
Having finished reading the cultivation method of the Great Black Sky God Palm, Yuan Ming couldn't help but rejoice.
He could now directly extract Wish Power from the Stealing Heaven Tripod, and that Wish Power had been refined, devoid of any emotional impurities, available for him to draw upon for cultivation at will.
This Great Black Sky God Palm almost seemed tailor-made for him!

chapters.title: Chapter 451 - 428: New Plan
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming took a deep breath, suppressed his excitement, and picked up the green round bead again, rubbing it in the palm of his hand.
As he infused mana into the round orb, it emitted circles of green halos that enveloped the nearby area within seventy or eighty feet.
However, this green halo seemed to possess neither offensive power nor defensive capabilities.
Yuan Ming, utterly puzzled, released his Divine Sense into the bead, attempting to sense the runes contained within.
Contrary to Yuan Ming's expectations, there were no runes inside the green round bead; only a whirlwind-like green spiritual power, spinning rapidly, which turned out to be Wind Attribute Spiritual Power.
"It seems that this bead is not a magic treasure," Yuan Ming thought to himself.
Nevertheless, since it was given to the Silver Void Tree Demon for safekeeping by the Six Desires Venerable, it must be a precious item.
After a moment's thought, Yuan Ming immediately began using various Divine Skills to test the effect of the green round orb.
At first, he merely used the Exorcism Technique to suspend the orb in the air nearby and tested it with various Five Elements Techniques and Soul Cultivator powers among others. However, the green round bead showed no response; he also noticed that regular attack techniques seemed unable to inflict any damage on the orb.
Yuan Ming was not discouraged. After standing in place for quite some time, he seemed to think of something and took out a green talisman, crushing it.
A door-sized green Wind Blade appeared out of nowhere, striking towards the green round bead.
Yet, as soon as the green Wind Blade entered the illuminated area of the bead, it abruptly stopped, then disintegrated and dissipated.
Yuan Ming's eyebrows raised, and he took out an even more powerful Wind Attribute Talisman but did not activate it immediately.
This talisman, found in Thunderbolt Ancestor's storage magic tool, was a third-level Talisman, and its might was probably fearsome; it was uncertain whether the round orb could withstand it.
After mulling over it several times to ensure he could prevent the talisman from damaging the orb, he finally crushed the talisman.
The next moment, a green Wind Dragon, seven or eight feet long, appeared out of thin air, with clearly defined scale armor, baring its teeth and claws as it pounced towards the green round orb.
Where the Wind Dragon passed, a violent wind rose in the air, and the ground was scored with deep marks.
However, as soon as the Wind Dragon entered the halo of the green round bead, it crumbled just like the Wind Blade, visibly collapsing bit by bit, turning into numerous particles of green light that scattered, and the gale it whipped up could not blow into the area of the green halo at all.
That area appeared to be a forbidden zone for Wind Attribute attacks!
"Could it be that this object is the legendary Wind Stabilizing Pearl, capable of restraining Wind Attribute attacks?" Yuan Ming thought to himself, the more he considered it, the more likely it seemed.
This was a treasure famous in legend!
Delighted, he played with the green round bead for a while before carefully storing it away, then picked up the last item, a silver banner, and charged it with mana to sense the runes inside.
His eyes brightened, the silver banner housed only five runes forming an array, barely reaching the Magical Treasure Level. These five runes all emitted fluctuations of space, revealing that it was indeed a Space Treasure!
Space artifacts weren't uncommon; Storage Bags and Spiritual Beast Bags fell into the category of space artifacts, but Space Treasures were extremely rare.
The reason for this was the spiritual materials.C@atch& the f&o^r^m.a%tt#e!d ve*r^sio+n$ at M|V&|LE^M%_PYR.
Space artifacts like Storage Bags mostly relied on the power of forbidden restrictions to barely create a storage space, which didn't demand much from the materials.
However, to elevate an artifact to the rank of a magical treasure was a different story altogether, requiring the integration of a considerable amount of space-attribute spiritual materials; yet space-attribute materials were scarce, getting snatched up quickly whenever they appeared, making them almost invisible in the market, and Space Treasures were even rarer.
Yuan Ming activated the silver banner with mana, whereupon the banner unfolded into a gargantuan silver flag, spinning lithely around his body.
Containing an array of runes, he quickly grasped the capabilities of the silver flag.
The silver flag had a very singular ability, able to slightly manipulate the surrounding Space Power.
This ability might seem unimpressive, but it was exceptionally formidable: it could create a Space Restriction shield, deflecting an enemy's attacks, and when used at the right moment, it often produced miraculous effects.
Yuan Ming ceased operating the small flag and stored it in his Storage Ring, falling silent.
Though he had been in dangerous situations during his journey to the Shura Palace, caught between Nascent Soul cultivators far stronger than himself, facing crisis after crisis and even confronting the supreme power of the Six Desires Venerable, his final gains were astonishingly high. Solely the number of Spirit Stones exceeded two million, which by his current expenses, was probably enough to support his cultivation all the way to the Nascent Soul Stage.
After all, a sect of Chang Chun Temple's scale would likely not exceed this amount in resources when nurturing a Nascent Soul cultivator.
In addition to Spirit Stones, there were various elixirs, magical treasures, and even secret skills - enough to keep him busy for a while.
"That said, the cultivation of the Moonlight Technique demands more and more Desire Power, and with the current small-scale efforts, there seems to be a shortage. It's time to vastly expand the Moon God Sect," Yuan Ming pondered quietly to himself.
Previously, with his limited strength, he had only dared to preach with caution among the mortals, afraid to draw the attention of the Cultivation Sects.
But now the situation was different; his strength had greatly increased, and having entered the Stealing Heaven Tripod, he was effectively equivalent to the Sleeping Witch, sufficiently powerful to contend with Nascent Soul cultivators. With so many Magical Treasure Secret Techniques now at his disposal, there was no longer a need to proceed with the same caution as before.
And more crucially, large-scale preaching, whether in the Mortal World or in the Cultivation World, required a substantial investment. Cultivators were not like mortals; without a similar level of resource investment, it was impossible to truly win over a group of cultivator believers.
With this thought, Yuan Ming's mind shifted as he entered the Stealing Heaven Tripod and found that there were more than a dozen new points of Believer's Desire Power near the White Jade Lotus Platform than before.
Yuan Ming sensed these additional Desire Powers; they were all Loose Cultivators in distress from the Black Wind Desert, likely believers converted by Xu Che.
Their cultivation levels were not high, most of them Qi Refining Stage Cultivators, with only two at the Foundation Establishment Stage, but all together, their Desire Power was still significant.
Yuan Ming felt greatly relieved and located the Desire Power light spot belonging to Xu Che, extending his Divine Sense towards it.
At this moment, Xu Che was resting in an inn within an underground city. Sensing the arrival of Yuan Ming's Divine Sense, he immediately sat up and respectfully said, "My lord."
"You have been doing quite well recently, having developed quite a number of Cultivator believers," Yuan Ming commended.
"These are all duties that your subordinate should fulfill," Xu Che respectfully replied.
"Continue to maintain this momentum. Do not stint on resources, nor pay too much attention to those Cultivation forces. Fully devote yourself to the development of Cultivator believers, and contact me directly when necessary," Yuan Ming instructed.
"Yes," Xu Che replied joyfully upon hearing this.
He knew that Yuan Ming could descend with divine majesty across the distances, and with Yuan Ming's assistance, his effort to win over believers would go much more smoothly.
In the following time, Yuan Ming transmitted several formidable secret techniques to Xu Che and, after some consideration, also bestowed upon him the mnemonic for the first three layers of the Heart Cleansing Technique.
After following Yuan Ming, Xu Che's knowledge greatly improved, and he no longer held much resistance towards Soul Cultivation. He immediately expressed his gratitude with great joy, and his confidence in following Yuan Ming grew even more steadfast.
After withdrawing his Divine Sense, Yuan Ming sat silently for a moment and formed a hand seal to open the top of the altar.
An intricate Array Map appeared, and he reached for the Silver Crystal Stone that had exhausted its Spiritual Power.
Recently, he had experienced many things and his knowledge had also greatly increased.
This Silver Crystal Stone looked very similar to a Void Stone; if he was not mistaken, it should be a type of Space Spirit Stone.
Yuan Ming left the Stealing Heaven Tripod and activated the Space Restriction, his figure flickering as he appeared inside the Stone Chamber beneath the Black Tower.
He walked slowly towards the Void Stone, bringing the Silver Crystal Stone close to it.
The Void Stone shone faintly, and the Space Power within it began to resonating, emitting waves of silver radiance.
"Indeed, they are of the same origin," Yuan Ming muttered to himself, summoning the Shura Stone Tablet and channeling the Space Power from the Void Stone into the Silver Crystal Stone.
The Silver Crystal Stone immediately lit up with a layer of silver radiance, which grew from faint to bright.
Yuan Ming's eyes brightened with a look of pleasant surprise.
He had only been trying to see if it were possible to transfer the Space Power from the Void Stone into the Silver Crystal Stone, and to his astonishment, it was indeed possible.
Yuan Ming immediately continued to infuse the Space Power into the Silver Crystal Stone.
As time slowly passed, the Space Power within the Silver Crystal Stone became increasingly abundant, correspondingly, the Space Power inside the Void Stone diminished significantly.
The spaces carved out by the Void Stone vibrated, gradually beginning to shrink. The space housing the Black Tower shrank the fastest, already reduced by over ten miles; the spaces where the Medicine Garden and the entrance to the Shura Palace were located, being smaller, did not seem much affected.
Yuan Ming's brows furrowed but he did not stop.
A half-hour later, the Space Power within the Silver Crystal Stone was fully charged and could no longer contain any more.
Yuan Ming hurriedly stopped casting, as a considerable amount of Space Power had been depleted from the Void Stone, with the space where the Black Tower stood having shrunk by a considerable near hundred miles.
However, obtaining a complete Silver Crystal Stone was not a bad deal.
Yuan Ming placed the stone into the Altar Formation and activated it. He then took out a bulging Storage Bag and placed it on the altar.
A golden light enveloped the object and sent it towards Xu Che's location.
Within the mystical Array Map atop the altar, the Silver Crystal Stone burst forth with a stream of silver light, infusing it into the map.
A thread of silver radiance flickered within the golden light encasing the Storage Bag, which then vanished in a flash.
"This altar's Restriction could not previously transmit objects; it must have been because the Silver Crystal Stone's Spirit Power was depleted!" Yuan Ming's eyes sparkled with excitement.
With the ability for remote object transmission, he could do so much more.
Inside the Nameless Inn, Xu Che's vision was suddenly filled with golden and silver light, rapidly condensing into a ghostly image of a door that was several feet high.
He took a surprised step back.
The golden and silver door creaked open and a Storage Bag shot out from within, falling to the floor in front of Xu Che, as the door then faded away.
Xu Che looked at the Storage Bag on the ground, not daring to touch it.
"Do not panic; this Storage Bag is a gift from me," Yuan Ming's voice resounded in Xu Che's mind.
Xu Che's body trembled greatly, as he bowed his head deeply, "Your divinity is boundless, my lord!"
Remote object transmission was unheard of, and even those major factions with Nascent Soul cultivators might not be capable of it; Yuan Ming's Divine Skills were becoming ever more inconceivable.
"Inside the Storage Bag is a batch of spiritual materials, magic artifacts, and quite a few Foundation Establishment Stage elixirs. You may handle them as you see fit. While attracting believers, do not neglect your own Cultivation," Yuan Ming continued.
"Thank you, my lord. Your subordinate will certainly not let you down," Xu Che knelt to the ground.

chapters.title: Chapter 452 - 429 Limit
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming was very satisfied with Xu Che's reaction and immediately left the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
He made a hand gesture to activate the Shura Stone Tablet and arrived at the crimson square inside the Extreme Fire Territory, heading straight into the dark palace on the left.
Inside the palace was a tall Artifact Refining Room, with a three-zhang-tall Artifact Refining Furnace placed in the central position, which was the secret refining chamber of the Shura Master.
On the other side of the square was a dark hall, a cultivation fire chamber containing strong Fire Attribute Spiritual Power, where one could practice Fire Attribute Divine Abilities twice as effectively.
Similar places existed in the Cold Martial Realm and within the Nine Nether Mirror. These three areas were opened by the Shura Master for the cultivation of various secret techniques and Divine Skills.
Yuan Ming looked at the Artifact Refining Furnace, which was shaped like a gourd, larger at the bottom and smaller at the top, with patterns of the sun, moon, and stars painted on its body, and nine orifices on the lid.
This furnace was made of unknown materials, shone brightly all over, with layers of spirit light flowing over its body like clouds and mist. From the orifices on the lid, streams of red spirit light resembling flames burst out intermittently, condensing into various spiritual birds and beasts, appearing very lively.
Below the Artifact Refining Furnace on the ground was an intricate Earth Fire Array with a nearly transparent orange flame burning at its center, yet not much heat was radiating out.
"Pure Yang Flame! The Shura Master really left me a lot of good stuff," Yuan Ming thought to himself.
The Pure Yang Flame could be considered the dream fire for Artifact Refiners in the Cultivation World, with astonishing power, completely contained, and even more rare was its gentle nature, which made it most suitable for Alchemy and Artifact Refining.
This Artifact Refining Furnace, called the Sun and Moon Flame Sunrise Furnace, combined with the Pure Yang Flame from this place, not only had a very high success rate, but the Magic Treasures refined were also of excellent quality.
The Shura Master had refined the Night Parade of Hundred Demons and the Cold Moon Ring here many years ago.
Yuan Ming took out a black gourd and the piece of Nine Nether Iron and threw them into the Sun and Moon Flame Sunrise Furnace, using hand gestures to control the Pure Yang Flame to refine the two materials.
The Nine Nether Iron was exceptionally hard, and it had taken him ten days to melt it previously. Now, with the Pure Yang Flame, he was able to melt both materials in less than half an hour, turning them into a pool of black molten iron.
Yuan Ming placed the Soul Destroying Sword into the furnace and applied the "Same Material Compression Method" to fuse the black iron into the sword body.
Three days and nights later, a new Soul Destroying Sword was born.
This sword didn't differ much from the previous one in appearance, but the Spiritual Power within had increased substantially. The sword's body was permeated with a dark glow, as if it could absorb one's Divine Soul.
Yuan Ming was secretly delighted. The Sun and Moon Flame Sunrise Furnace and the Pure Yang Flame were indeed extraordinary. Not only did they perfectly incorporate the newly acquired Nine Nether Iron into the Soul Destroying Sword, but they also refined the sword again, eliminating many impurities and producing a much purer spirit light.
He took the sword into the Stealing Heaven Tripod and sat on the White Jade Lotus Platform, starting to inscribe new runes stroke by stroke.
Yuan Ming chose the new rune "Annihilation."
The Soul Destroying Sword began to tremble with a "humming" sound, but with the increase in Yin Power within the sword, it didn't crack as before and was quickly inscribed.
Yuan Ming took a deep breath, channeled his Mana into the sword body, and began the Enriching process.
Time passed moment by moment, and in the blink of an eye, a day and a night had passed.
As the door to the Artifact Refining Room opened, Yuan Ming stepped out, his face slightly pale, indicating significant consumption, but his expression was filled with excitement.
The Soul Destroying Sword had been successfully refined and also had the "Annihilation" rune inscribed on it as he had wished. It circled and danced around him, shooting out black Sword Qi.
With six runes inscribed on the Soul Destruction Sword Rune Array, not only did the sword gain the "Annihilation" ability, but the power of the sword itself had also greatly increased. Each strand of Sword Qi emitted powerful fluctuations, much stronger than before.
Yuan Ming's figure flickered and disappeared. In the next moment, he teleported near the Black Tower within a forested area beside a lake that was several miles wide.
The lake rippled with a faint gray fog, which contained a whiff of chilling demon energy, making the temperature around the lake much colder than other places.
Yuan Ming made a hand gesture, and a black Sword Qi entered the lake.
A few breaths later, with a "splash," a giant python thick as a water barrel and dozens of zhang long, akin to a Flood Dragon, rolled out of the water, breaking the surface of the lake.
The python's scales shone an icy blue, appearing like Cold Jade, with a surrounding dense demon energy that had already reached the third level.
The Black Tower's space was vast, and the Shura Master kept many demon creatures here, including Third-level Demon Beasts. The Blue-Scaled Python before him was one of the most distinguished among them.
This demon, known as the Blue-Scaled Python, had scales that were incredibly hard and resistant to Magic Treasures. It was also venomous, posing a difficult challenge even for Core Formation Stage cultivators.
The Blue-Scaled Python's pair of green eyes stared at Yuan Ming on the shore and let out a roar.
The water near it erupted loudly as a crystal-clear water column, several zhang thick, was suddenly ejected towards Yuan Ming with intense force, stirring up a gale.
Yuan Ming stood still, not moving. However, the Silver Banner before him spun slightly, materializing in front of him and emitting strands of silver light with nearly half of the banner apparently melting into the void.
He grabbed the Silver Banner and gave it a gentle tug, causing the space in front of him to twist suddenly.
The huge water column was abruptly deflected, as if someone had fiercely pulled it through mid-air, directing it towards the trees to Yuan Ming's right, flattening a large swath of the forest.
As Yuan Ming pointed upwards, a surge of black light burst from the Soul Destroying Sword above his head, forming a black vortex several zhang large, which began to spin with a rumbling noise.
A tremendous suction force emerged from the black vortex, sweeping across a range of several dozen zhang.
This was the characteristic of the Nine Nether Iron to absorb souls, coupled with the power of the Six Rune Array. Yuan Ming had given it a name, "Soul Absorption Vortex."
The soul absorption vortex enveloped the range of insects, birds, and even the fish swimming in the lake; they all shuddered, their divine souls leaving their bodies, being sucked into the black vortex, turning into lifeless corpses.
The Blue-Scaled Python was also enveloped by the soul absorption vortex; its body trembled, its divine soul quivering nonstop, seemingly about to leave its body as well.
But the Blue-Scaled Python was, after all, a third-level demon beast; compared to ordinary demon beasts, its divine soul was also strong and barely withstood the devouring of the soul absorption vortex.
Yuan Ming's eyebrows raised slightly; he spurred the annihilation rune into action.
In the next moment, the form of the Blue-Scaled Python froze, feeling as though its snake eyes had plunged into endless darkness.
At this time, it couldn't see anything, hear any sound, smell any scents; its divine sense was also swallowed by the darkness, unable to sense anything, as if it had fallen into the deepest depths of the Nine Netherworld.
A great fear rose in the heart of the Blue-Scaled Python, and its already unstable divine soul could no longer hold on.
"Whoosh," a phantom of a large snake flew out from within the snake's head, directly entering the soul absorption vortex and being instantly shredded.
Without the control of its divine soul, the body of the Blue-Scaled Python powerlessly sank to the bottom of the lake, having lost all signs of life.
A trace of surprise crossed Yuan Ming's eyes; the annihilation rune was indeed formidable.
He had originally thought the effect of this rune was to weaken an enemy's five senses and divine sense. From the situation just now, the annihilation rune directly severed the Blue-Scaled Python's five senses and divine sense.
Although the Soul Destroying Sword had only six runes inscribed on it, the "curse" and "annihilation" runes were astonishingly powerful, each worth two or three ordinary runes.
Just with its ordinary sword qi power, the current Soul Destroying Sword was certainly not inferior to a magic treasure with nine runes. If you added the "curse" and "annihilation" two extraordinary runes, the potential of the Soul Destroying Sword was even harder to estimate.
Yuan Ming waved his hand and swept up the corpse of the Blue-Scaled Python, tossing it into the Shura Blood Devouring Map.
The Blood Devouring Map rumbled, quickly melting the body of the Blue-Scaled Python, refining it into a stream of pure qi-blood.
