Yuan Ming then sat down cross-legged by the lake, took out the Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill classics, and once again looked through them carefully.
Now that everything had been dealt with, it was time for him to thoroughly examine the Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill.
He pondered over the Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill three times carefully, confirmed there were no mistakes, and then according to the records, he slowly circulated his qi-blood.
The Shura Blood Devouring Map floated above his head, a stream of pure blood light flew out of the map, merging into his body.
A look of pain appeared on Yuan Ming's face, as the entrance of the blood energy made his entire body feel as if it was being sliced by numerous dull knives, the pain reaching deep into his marrow.
Even with his current state of mind, he couldn't bear it; his body trembled like a sieve.Lоvе this stоry? Shоw yоur suppоrt оn М9VLЕМРYR.
"Indeed, there's no such thing as a free lunch in this world! The more powerful the skill, the more difficult it is to cultivate. The Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill can directly refine others' qi-blood, making rapid progress, yet one has to endure torture-like suffering!" Yuan Ming let out a miserable groan, hurriedly circulated the Heart Cleansing Technique, combined with his Emotion Manipulation Ability, and finally managed to barely suppress the excruciating pain.
Time trickled by, and half a day passed in a flash.
Yuan Ming ceased his cultivation, his face deathly pale, his eyes also revealing a look of fatigue.
However, this ordeal was not in vain. His body had become much more robust. With a flex of his muscles, patterns reminiscent of elephant skin faintly appeared on his skin.
At this rate, it wouldn't take long for him to achieve the first layer of the Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill, developing the copper skin.
The qi-blood of the Blue-Scaled Python inside the Shura Blood Devouring Map was not entirely used up, but Yuan Ming didn't continue to practice.
The pain of the Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill cultivation was too intense. Right now, both his body and divine soul were at their limits; he needed a good rest.
Yuan Ming activated the Shura Stone Tablet and moved to the Medicine Garden, starting to circulate the Nine Elements Technique.
The rich Wood Attribute Spiritual Energy from the surroundings gathered, and his body rapidly recovered.
As for his divine soul, Yuan Ming had already taken back the soul-splittings within Xi Ying and Yan Sijing, refining their Desire Power with the Heart Cleansing Technique to recover from the exhaustion of the divine soul.
In the blink of an eye, three months had passed.
A loud and clear roar resonated within the Medicine Garden. There were no traces of mana fluctuations within it, yet it was as if a giant elephant was bellowing, shaking one's spirit.
The green mist in the Medicine Garden was stirred into ripples, the wind and clouds rolling smoothly.
A good while later, the roar finally subsided.
Yuan Ming stood up; his entire skin was marked with clear black patterns, which were precisely the demon image patterns formed upon the perfect completion of the first layer of the Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill.
He cultivated the Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill, his skin akin to that of the demon image—extraordinarily robust, much stronger than the copper skin of ordinary Body Cultivators. His stature had now grown by a head, and his hands and feet had also swelled in size.
Yuan Ming vanished from the spot with a flicker and then reappeared out of thin air next to a dark red tree several yards away. His fingers formed into claws, and with a light scratch—
The bark of the dark red tree cracked, and a large chunk of the red wood beneath was torn off.
Joy flashed in Yuan Ming's eyes. This dark red tree was no ordinary wood but was known as "Iron Plow Wood." It contained the power of the Five Metals, harder than some minerals, and was material for building warships and Flying Boats. Yet, in his hands, it was as fragile as tofu.
This was merely the first layer. If he could cultivate the Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill to the Innate Body, or even the Tongqiao Body, his strength would be unimaginably powerful!

chapters.title: Chapter 453 - 453: 430
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming took a deep breath and dispelled the power of the Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill, his body returning to normal.
At this moment, the fluctuations of his mana had also increased considerably compared to before. Over these three months, in addition to painstakingly practicing the Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill, he had not neglected the cultivation of the Nine Elements Technique.
Many cultivators had perished within the Shura Palace, leaving behind a large number of Core Formation Stage elixirs. For him, there was no shortage of elixirs for the next two to three years.
With the ample supply of elixirs and the rich Wood Attribute Spiritual Energy in the Medicine Garden aiding him, Yuan Ming's mana had improved significantly, though he was still some distance away from reaching the mid-stage of Core Formation.
In the aspect of Soul Cultivation, as Xu Che had begun to step up his efforts to recruit cultivator believers, gathering more and more Desire Power, Yuan Ming's Divine Soul had also grown considerably stronger, steadily making progress toward the late stage of a Love Witch.
Yuan Ming sat cross-legged in the original spot and took out the Jade Scroll of the Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill, his brows slightly furrowed.
As long as there was sufficient Qi-Blood, the first layer of the Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill could be mastered quickly. However, the second layer could not.
The second realm of Body Cultivation was the Iron Bone Body, which required practicing and strengthening all the bones in the body. This process was the most crucial foundation for Body Cultivators, and one should not rush; it required steady and methodical work.
The Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill was the same. The Jade Plate clearly recorded that the second layer could not be broken through quickly by leveraging the power of Qi-Blood; one needed to practice a set of "Incense Xiang Bone Forging Skill" for three years to solidify the foundation before continuing to draw in and enhance with the power of Qi-Blood.
Yuan Ming was unconcerned. He was not in a hurry to use Body Cultivation Divine Skills against enemies. After reading the Incense Xiang Bone Forging Skill several times and committing it to memory, he began to cultivate.
"Incense Xiang Stepping Sky!"
"Incense Xiang Spits Water!"
"Incense Xiang Crossing the Sea!"
...
Yuan Ming moved his limbs, mimicking the punches and kicks of each form.
Every bone in his body was engaged; completing a set of the Incense Xiang Bone Forging Skill made his whole body feel as if the bones had cracked open, leaving him unable to muster any strength as he lay on the ground.
Yuan Ming had anticipated this. He lay resting for a moment before managing to sit cross-legged and start the Nine Elements Technique to recover.
After a day and a night, Yuan Ming opened his eyes.
His body had recovered, his bones no longer throbbing with pain, but instead radiating a warm sensation.
Yuan Ming nodded, knowing his cultivation was on the right track.
However, he did not continue to cultivate further. The Incense Xiang Bone Forging Skill could not be mastered overnight, and he had already stayed in the Shura Palace for quite some time—it was time to leave.
The Shura Palace, hidden underground, was very safe and he needed not worry about being detected.
Yuan Ming summoned the Shura Stone Tablet, reducing the restrictions of the Shura Palace to the minimum and closed off all the forbidden areas within the palace, before vanishing in a flicker.
...
Two months later, one night.
As night fell, Yuan Ming sat cross-legged in front of a window at an inn, the moonlight pouring in like water through the window.
This was Linyuan City. After leaving the Shura Palace, he didn't immediately return to Da Jin but came here instead, trying to understand the reactions of the major forces in the Black Wind Desert after the incident with the Shura Palace.
It turns out that after he moved the Shura Palace from the Soul Burying Abyss, the major forces of the Black Wind Desert searched in vain and could only eventually let it go. The Shura Palace had now become a topic of conversation among the cultivators during their leisure time.
Yuan Ming was bathed in the bright moonlight, enveloped in a layer of hazy glow, with the Moonlight Technique automatically circulating within him.
Under the dark expanse of the sky, it was as if the quiet whispers of devotion rose from the ethereal void, streams of Desire Power converging toward this place, being refined and absorbed by Yuan Ming bit by bit.
Xu Che had recently developed a dozen more cultivator believers, and along with many mortal believers, the Desire Power had become much more substantial than before. Now, as he cultivated with the Stealing Heaven Tripod, it felt like being enveloped in warm spring water, both body and spirit sinking into an indescribable comfort.
Yuan Ming's eyes were lightly closed, his brow relaxed, as he intently felt the continuous stream of Desire Power converging towards him.
As the number of Nether Moon God believers increased, his understanding of Desire Power also strengthened.
Generally, most of the Desire Power consisted of devout faith and heartfelt support, and though it contained the individual whims of each believer, such thoughts were too insignificant, drowning in the torrent of faith and unknown to Yuan Ming.
Only when a particular thought was so strong that it approached obsession did Yuan Ming separate it from the complex Desire Power to thoroughly investigate.
This usually happened when a believer found themselves in a difficult position or even a plight, unable to resolve the issue on their own, leading to an outburst of intense longing to seek the Nether Moon God's help to escape hardship, carrying a clear intention.
This kind of Desire Power was often much stronger than the usual devotion or prayers for favorable weather and family health, thus contributing more to the increase of Yuan Ming's Soul Power.
Crucially, if such a longing was responded to or genuinely helped to overcome hardship, its Desire Power would become purer.
However, with his own time and energy being limited, Yuan Ming found it difficult to grant every request. He could only choose to handle some matters that were convenient for him, while delegating many other tasks by contacting Xu Che to deal with them.
If more devoted and loyal cultivator believers like Xu Che were to join in the future, he could naturally allow them to act as his agents, responding to the believers' pleas.
The foundation of all this was the investment of resources, or rather, the need for a continuous supply of Spirit Stones. Now that he had dealt with the Shura Palace, he was finally in a position to proceed.
Yuan Ming was immersed in the comfortable feeling brought by the condensation of Desire Power when suddenly his Sea of Consciousness felt completely empty. Immediately following, his vision was flooded with brilliant, variegated lights, and a pink mist began to spread throughout the surrounding void.
"Eh, what is this?" Yuan Ming couldn't help but feel astonished.
However, before he could investigate it thoroughly, he smelled a series of overly sweet and rich fragrances, and soon after, the air was filled with the sound of women's playful laughter, sounding charming and alluring.
The voices, coming from far and near, quickly turned mellifluous, and were interspersed with embarrassing panting sounds.
At the same time, vague silhouettes began to appear within the pink mist.
When Yuan Ming focused his gaze, his expression froze, and he felt his mouth and tongue become dry.
He saw within the mist numerous female figures without a thread on them, each with skin as smooth as cream and enchanting figures, displaying various seductive poses in the mist that made his ears burn.
Alluring calls also rose up simultaneously, tempting Yuan Ming to join them, but despite the operation of soul splitting and the Heart Cleansing Technique, it was ineffective.
"Have I... entered demonic possession?"
Although Yuan Ming felt a bit agitated, he was still a Soul Cultivator; such levels of temptation couldn't affect him much. His mind remained unguarded, and he promptly began to reflect.
Immediately, he retracted his Divine Sense and stopped cultivating, trying to break free from the illusory void.
Yet, when he ceased his practice of the Moonlight Technique, he realized that the illusions around him hadn't stopped. Instead, the scenes that stirred up carnal thoughts not only didn't disappear but grew even more rampant.
Yuan Ming looked at the increasingly close illusion of the seductive women, his brows slightly furrowed.
In the next moment, he abruptly let out a low shout, and his Divine Soul Power shook, transforming into an invisible torrent that rushed in all directions.
Amidst the surges of Soul Power, the surrounding pink mist quickly dissipated, and the silhouettes of the seductive women vanished like bubbles, with all sounds disappearing instantly.This chapter was uploaded by the team at *.
Yuan Ming looked around and found himself still sitting cross-legged in front of the window inside the room.
He furrowed his brows in contemplation, silently recalling the details of the Moonlight Technique and the key points of cultivation that Xi Ying had once reminded him of. He found no related content to the strange phenomena he had just experienced.
"There can't be anything wrong with the Moonlight Technique, and there was no issue in my cultivation. It seems that the problem most likely lies with the Desire Power..." After reflecting for a while, Yuan Ming came to such a conclusion.
He had heard from Xi Ying that the Wu Yue Sect had once used its heretical arts to bewitch people, creating various evil gods for believers to worship, collecting their twisted Desire Power.
Such evil gods often controlled believers by amplifying negative emotions such as hatred, sorrow, and lust, causing them to sink into depravity and thereby gaining control over them.
The Desire Power obtained in this way, although twisted, was often much stronger than the Power of faith brought about by conventional worship.
What Yuan Ming didn't understand was that these were methods used by Soul Cultivators to control believers. As a deity himself, to a certain extent, how could he be affected instead?
"Could it be that there is an issue with one of the believers?" Yuan Ming thought to himself.
He immediately took hold of the Stealing Heaven Tripod and once again absorbed and refined the Desire Power. The bewitching women appeared again.
While resisting the impact of these illusions, Yuan Ming searched for the source of the anomaly. After a prolonged search, unfortunately, he still came up empty-handed.
Although he didn't find an answer, Yuan Ming's intuition told him that the problem lay with the believers.
With a thought, he entered the Stealing Heaven Tripod to try and locate Xu Che.
After a moment, Yuan Ming slowly opened his eyes, but his brows couldn't help but knit tighter.
Xu Che had vanished.
Normally, during this time of the night, Xu Che should be praying to prepare for Yuan Ming's Divine Presence at any moment, but not this time.
A sense of foreboding began to rise in Yuan Ming's heart.
Without any hesitation, he let his Divine Thought dive back into the Stealing Heaven Tripod and began to sense carefully.
Soon, he found a believer in Wuyun City.
He had recently contacted Xu Che, who had been in Wuyun City at that time.
With a move of his thoughts, Yuan Ming instantly traveled thousands of miles. Using this believer as an anchor, he ignored the distance and descended upon Wuyun City.
In Wuyun City, an elderly man with dark skin and a face full of deep wrinkles was kneeling before the Divine Statue of a young man, murmuring prayers fervently.
Unbeknownst to him, a mighty Divine Sense was radiating from his position, spreading in all directions and enveloping almost the entire Wuyun City within its reach.
At this moment, Yuan Ming's Divine Thought roamed the vast void, as if flying above Wuyun City, overlooking the city and watching the lights of thousands of households below, continuously searching for Xu Che's presence.
However, after examination, he still came up empty-handed.
It seemed that Xu Che was not in Wuyun City.

chapters.title: Chapter 454 - 431: The Impure Glimmer
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming's brow furrowed, and he quickly selected another believer to start searching elsewhere.
After tossing and turning for most of the night, Yuan Ming felt his Divine Sense deplete, leaving him somewhat fatigued. He had inspected more than a dozen underground cities without finding any trace of Xu Che.
Xu Che seemed to have vanished into thin air.
Yuan Ming put away the Stealing Heaven Tripod and massaged his somewhat swollen brow, almost certain that something must have gone wrong with Xu Che.
Given the extent of his search, unless the other party had fallen, there was no way he couldn't find him.
But Xu Che was a very cautious person and mostly active within the city, so the possibility of an accidental demise was slim.
The key issue was the current problem with the Desire Power, and the sudden loss of contact with Xu Che couldn't possibly be a coincidence.
The believers' Desire Power was crucial for his Soul Cultivation; naturally, it couldn't be taken lightly. After a series of fluctuating expressions, Yuan Ming no longer hesitated, stood up, and left Linyuan City immediately.
...
Half a month later.
At dusk, at the entrance of an underground city some five hundred miles away from Wuyun City, Wusu City, a tall figure wearing a cone-shaped bamboo hat passed through the worn and low city gate and entered the town.
The small border city located in the desert boasted nothing of prosperity. Few houses in the city were built with bricks, most were low dwellings constructed from irregular stones.
The windows of the houses were tiny, giving the appearance of a series of misplaced watchtowers and bunkers.
Few shops lined the streets, and there was no sight of open-air vendors, even the passersby were in a hurry, their heads wrapped in fabric.
No reason other than the ravaging Black Wind, which carried sand and dust everywhere, filling the air with a dry, earthy stench.
Yuan Ming adjusted the cone-shaped bamboo hat on his head and continued along the street, slowly walking towards the location he had discovered during a patrol the previous day.
Before long, he arrived at a small courtyard in a back alley.
As Yuan Ming knocked on the gate, a thread of his consciousness also entered the courtyard.
Immediately after, he heard something being knocked over, followed by a series of hurried footsteps.
With a "creaking" sound, the yellow wooden door of the courtyard opened, and a rough face full of stubble peered out. The wrinkles and scars on his face merged together, resulting in an expression of both panic and suspicion.
"Hu Ji, how have you been recently?" Yuan Ming removed the bamboo hat from his head, revealing his face upon seeing this.
The middle-aged man with the rough face saw Yuan Ming and his wrinkles instantly smoothed out. The suspicious look disappeared, leaving only panic and joy. He hastily turned and knelt on the ground.
"Divine..."
Hu Ji immediately cried out and then crawled over to Yuan Ming's feet, kissing his boots.
"What are you doing?" Yuan Ming was startled and quickly withdrew his foot.
At that moment, he saw a weak woman walking out from the bunker-like house behind him, apparently Hu Ji's wife. Her high cheekbones were flushed as she tidied her slightly disheveled clothing and walked briskly towards them.
Although the woman looked feeble, she was evidently not sick. She, too, like Hu Ji, cried out "Divine..." and rushed to Yuan Ming's feet, kneeling to kiss his boots.
Yuan Ming couldn't bear it any longer and hastily asked them to stand up, entering the courtyard.
The couple followed behind Yuan Ming, looking awkward and anxious, their eyes filled with evident joy and fear.
Yuan Ming noticed this, but his mind was filled with doubts. He had never instructed Xu Che to behave in such a manner, nor had he ever commanded that believers show such extreme reverence towards himself, and Xu Che had never mentioned such a thing.
Yuan Ming wondered why it had come to this.
Yuan Ming sat down on a stone bench in the courtyard and looked at the couple as he asked, "Have there been any strange events happening around you recently, or have you encountered any strange people?"
Upon hearing this, Hu Ji's eyes flickered with astonishment. He exchanged glances with his wife, and both shook their heads.
"Since moving to Wusu City, I have been busy preaching. Occasionally, I dispense alms with the money and grain sent by the Divine Envoy, and I haven't encountered any strange events," Hu Ji explained hastily, thinking Yuan Ming was testing his preaching efforts.
"Divine Envoy?" Yuan Ming asked with confusion.
"It's Mr. Xu Che. He said commoners won't rise early if it's not for profit; they need to be enticed with benefits, then inspired by the deeds of the Nether Moon God, taught the rituals of the Moon God Sect, shown the miracles of the Sect, so they can achieve spiritual liberation and devoutly worship the True God," explained Hu Ji, noticing Yuan Ming's expression and speaking with flustered fear.
"When was the last time he came?" Yuan Ming asked with a frown.
"About a month and a half ago, after the Divine Envoy brought money, grain, and a new Divine Statue, he hasn't visited here since," said Hu Ji.
Only then did Yuan Ming remember that, being caught up in cultivation and various matters, and because he trusted Xu Che, he indeed hadn't initiated contact with Xu Che for a long time.
Just then, Yuan Ming suddenly heard a barrage of disordered footsteps approaching from outside the courtyard, reaching all the way to its perimeter.
Shortly after, the sound of knocking on the wooden door arose.
Hu Ji glanced toward the doorway, not in a hurry to open the door, but rather, with a hint of excitement, he explained to Yuan Ming, "These are all your followers, they've come here to pray together. Are you going to bestow your blessings and let them see the true form of the divine?"
"You go forth to welcome them; I will observe from the side. Do not mention my presence," Yuan Ming said in a grave voice.
"Yes, yes... It is already a great blessing for them to be in your presence," Hu Ji hastily agreed and turned to open the door.
As the wooden door swung open, a noisy crowd entered, and in no time, nearly a hundred people had gathered, filling the already small courtyard to the brim.
The throng bustled with life and excitement, most of whom brought their families, wholeheartedly devoted to the Nether Moon God.
Among them were quite a few pregnant women, supporting each other, presenting a very harmonious and friendly scene.
Initially worried, Hu Ji, upon noticing that everyone seemed completely oblivious to Yuan Ming seated on the stone bench in front, sighed in his heart, thinking "Truly divine," and decided not to say anything further.
Those squeezed into the courtyard were excitedly sharing with each other the changes they had experienced since following the "Nether Moon God" and the miracles they believed they had witnessed.
Some said their health had markedly improved, some claimed their illnesses had completely healed, some boasted they could travel in the desert for three days without tiring, and some mentioned they could now carry a large basin full of water. There were even those who claimed that, all of a sudden, their wife had given birth to twin sons...
The more Yuan Ming heard, the more he frowned. Faith in him offered protection and a certain degree of enhanced health and evil expulsion, but when had it ever ensured offspring?
With regard to the so-called miracles, Yuan Ming found them even more absurd.
One person said they had dreamt of a large python entering their body, after which they became pregnant; another saw a golden snake in the desert, and still, another claimed to have seen an illusion of the Nether Moon God during prayer...
Some people even linked witnessing the birth of wolf cubs during a journey to the miracles of the Nether Moon God.
""How has Xu Che been preaching, and what exactly has he been preaching?"" Yuan Ming pondered with a frown.Part of a series hosted by * (MV&LEMP&YR).
Thinking Yuan Ming was displeased by some follower's random outbursts potentially offending the divine, Hu Ji hastily intervened.
The crowd, having great respect for their local leader, quickly fell silent.
Hu Ji bowed slightly towards Yuan Ming, then turned and went inside. Shortly after, he returned carrying an object shrouded in red cloth, which he reverently placed on the stone table beside Yuan Ming.
From its outline, Yuan Ming immediately knew it was his own "Nether Moon God Statue."
Seeing the divine statue brought out, the atmosphere in the courtyard became even more solemn; all present knelt to the ground in unison.
His wife also carried out one high-footed dish after another from inside the house, each filled with fruit offerings like apples and fragrant pears, which she placed in front of the divine statue.
At this moment, Hu Ji looked up at the sky.
Above them, a hazy crescent moon had begun to show. He then addressed the crowd, shouting, "The Ming Yue has appeared; begin your prayers."
With that said, he, like the others, knelt down to the ground.
All the people prostrated themselves, murmuring prayers, and began to pray earnestly.
Watching their devoutness, Yuan Ming momentarily felt an increased sense of solemnity.
As they prayed, Yuan Ming noticed faint light spots beginning to appear above these people, scattering over their heads like a myriad of fireflies, soon gathering toward the statue on the table.
All the light spots were absorbed by the divine statue, and there crystallized strands of Desire Power closely related to Yuan Ming.
At the same time, in other parts of this small city, a similar luminescence emerged and converged toward this location.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming took out the Stealing Heaven Tripod and initiated the Moonlight Technique Cultivation Technique in an attempt to draw in these Desire Powers.
The next instant, a ray of white light surged up from the divine statue and fell directly into the Stealing Heaven Tripod in Yuan Ming's hand.
Yuan Ming's pupils constricted, and he immediately stopped the circulation of the Cultivation Technique.
He distinctly saw that within the light, threads of dark red glimmers were mixed in, not purely white.
As he interrupted his casting, the light that was returning to the divine statue dissipated in part, drifting over the worshippers like a gentle breeze, instantly bringing them relief and inadvertently being perceived as another divine sign.
However, Yuan Ming at this moment had no interest in these matters. He lifted the red cloth covering the Nether Moon God Statue and examined it carefully.
At first glance, he detected no anomalies, as the style of the statue was not appreciably different from the one he had provided to Xu Che, and the carvings seemed even more meticulous and lifelike.
But as he looked more closely, Yuan Ming noticed that the statue's hands now held an intricately carved black disc that was not there before.
The disc appeared to be made of stone or jade, slightly translucent, with complex and strange patterns engraved upon it, and at its center lay a prominent blood-colored crescent.
The craftsmanship of the black disc was clearly of a higher level than that of the divine statue, and placing them together showed a stark and obvious disharmony, at a glance suggesting they were not parts of the same whole.

chapters.title: Chapter 455 - 432: Tailgating
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming looked at the crescent pattern on the disk and couldn't shake off a strange feeling. It seemed familiar, as though he'd seen it somewhere before or someone had described it to him, but he couldn't quite recall.
At that moment, the blood moon pattern on the disk suddenly flashed with light. After absorbing a massive amount of Desire Power, its blood-colored light flared up, emitting an eerie glow that began to cover the body of the Divine Statue.
Yuan Ming's heart stirred as he noticed the most intense blood color was at the chest of the statue, becoming fainter towards the head and feet.
But as time passed, this blood color would inevitably cover the entire statue.
At the same time, he noticed that the fruits in the bowl on the table, originally fresh, were rapidly shriveling up at a speed visible to the naked eye, as if something was absorbing all their moisture.
The Nether Moon God Statue had been tampered with!
Yuan Ming's expression shifted subtly with the realization, and his first instinct was to destroy the statue, but reason told him not to act rashly.
Thus, with great reluctance, he observed the entire prayer process.
When the crowd had dissipated, Yuan Ming called over Hu Ji and his wife again.
"You said this Divine Statue was brought by Xu Che two months ago to replace the original one?" Yuan Ming asked.
"Yes," Hu Ji replied respectfully.
"Was this black disk with the blood moon pattern on it there at that time?" Yuan Ming continued.
"The disk was there at that time, but the blood moon pattern only appeared recently; I thought it was a divine sign," said Hu Ji.
Yuan Ming's gaze darkened; it appeared the abnormalities in the Desire Power were related to the blood moon pattern.
"Do you know where Xu Che is?" he inquired.
"The Divine Envoy is busy spreading the faith and travels between cities; I do not know his current whereabouts," Hu Ji shook his head, answering honestly.
"When he delivered the Divine Statue, did he say anything to you? Or display any strange behaviors?" Yuan Ming pressed further.
"He didn't say much... he just gave us a prayer script and urged us to recite it with sincerity, nothing else," Hu Ji answered, somewhat puzzled. Weren't the actions of the Divine Envoy guided by Yuan Ming? Why was Yuan Ming asking him about it?
Despite his confusion, he did not dare to question, as the prayer script mentioned that doubting the Divine was the greatest disrespect to the Divine, and after death, one would descend into the heart-plucking purgatory.
Yuan Ming knew the prayer script he mentioned must be what everyone had been chanting softly earlier. He had assumed it was something Xu Che concocted to fool people, but now it seemed the matter was not so simple.
Xu Che had either met with an accident or betrayed him.
Whatever the case, Yuan Ming would not ignore it.
"Lord Nether Moon God, do you wish to find Envoy Xu Che?" Hu Ji attempted to ask.
"Can you contact him?" Yuan Ming's brow lifted.
"I cannot, but perhaps other Divine Envoys can," said Hu Ji with a shake of his head.
Yuan Ming paused, surprised. There were other Divine Envoys? Could they be other Cultivator followers?
But he did not voice his question; instead, he merely nodded, signaling Hu Ji to continue.
"At the end of every month, a Divine Envoy comes to collect the statue. Perhaps you could inquire about Xu Che when the next one arrives," Hu Ji suggested.
"Collect the statue?" Yuan Ming frowned.
"Yes, at the end of each month, someone comes to take the statue away, saying it needs to be baptized," Hu Ji said slowly, his face filled with doubt.
He found the Divine in front of him quite strange for being seemingly ignorant of these matters.
"Just so happens, tomorrow is the end of the month, and the two Divine Envoys should be coming," Hu Ji added.
"Very well," Yuan Ming uttered, nodding.
…
The next day, at dusk once more.
Shortly after everyone finished praying and dispersed, two figures streaked in from outside.
The newcomers were cloaked in large black robes with half-moon masks on their faces, one male and one female, both Foundation Establishment Cultivators.
As soon as the two entered Hu Ji's courtyard, they were caught in Yuan Ming's Illusion Technique. Despite Yuan Ming being right in front of them, the pair could not see him at all.
Hu Ji and his wife had already been controlled by Yuan Ming's Illusion Technique, their memories of his presence erased.
After entering the yard, Hu Ji and his wife performed the same kneeling ritual as before, just without the kissing of the shoes.
Throughout the entire process, the two remained silent, not speaking to Hu Ji or his wife at all but just picked up the Divine Statue from the stone table and left.
Yuan Ming followed suit, trailing behind them quietly.
They saw two individuals take away the divine statue from Hu Ji's home and then proceeded to two other courtyards in the city, one of which was the residence of the Wusu City Lord himself.
The Wusu City Lord, at the early stage of Foundation Establishment, turned out to be a faithful believer of the Moon God Sect, not only presenting the Nether Moon God Statue but also a chest of gold and silver treasures.
After taking away these three divine statues, the two Divine Envoys finally left Wusu City.
Yuan Ming originally thought that they would return directly, but to his surprise, they went to several nearby cities, retrieved a few more divine statues, and did not return to their lair until late at night.
It was a nameless temple built into a mountain cliff.
The mountain gate, not much different from ordinary temples, was inlaid into the mountain side like an archway.
The red lacquer door studded with copper nails was open outward, revealing a deep passage that led directly into the cliffside, with flickering flames visible within.
The two Divine Envoys entered, and Yuan Ming took out a grey cloak, then cast the Hidden Element Technique to conceal his aura and followed them in.
The corridor, one zhang high and two zhang wide, was clearly man-made, with fire basins hanging from the walls every fifteen steps, casting patches of light and shadow that endowed the place with a mystical ambience.
After advancing inward for over a hundred yards, Yuan Ming followed them into a spacious stone chamber.
Th@is c&o.py. was ge.n#erated^ f$r!om co.ntent at *+.
The walls of the chamber were painted with various scenes of goddesses flying through the heavens and the worship of deities. On the left and right sides, as well as directly ahead, stood bizarre-looking divine statues.
On the left, there was a statue of an angry muscular figure with black skin and hair standing on end, bare-chested and eyes wide open, holding a treasure basin in one hand and a golden mace in the other, looking fierce and menacing.
On the right, stood a three-headed, six-armed Armored Evil Ghost holding chains, shackles, and scimitars as torture instruments, looking even more terrifying and dreadful.
Only the statue directly in front was a reclining figure with an exposed chest and flowing hair, with a kind and compassionate face, holding a lotus, indistinguishable as male or female, exuding a look of sorrow.
The appearance of these divine statues was quite different from the Immortals Yuan Ming knew of, and he wondered if they were unique deities worshiped only in the Black Wind Desert.
However, when his gaze landed on the chest of the reclined statue, his eyes suddenly fixed on a particular spot.
There on its chest was a pattern of two overlapping moons.
Yuan Ming recognized this pattern; it was the mark of the Wuyue Sect.
No wonder he had felt a strangely familiar sense of oddity when he first saw that black disc and the crescent mark.
"Is this related to the Wuyue Sect?" Yuan Ming couldn't help wondering in surprise.
Before he could figure it out, he saw the two people turn around and walk towards the statue on the left.
Yuan Ming followed the two, and behind the statue, he discovered a cave entrance as tall as a person built into the wall next to the statue.
Just stepping into the entrance of the cave, Yuan Ming sensed the presence of a forbidding aura, although the techniques used were not very sophisticated.
He muttered to himself, and his body surfaced with strands of black light, gradually becoming semi-transparent and stepping forward as if his body, like a Spiritual Body, passed through the forbidden barrier.
This was the Void Transformation Technique, a secret technique transcribed on the White Jade Plate from the Six Desires Venerable, which could temporarily turn the Physical Body into a ghostly form, passing through Forbidden Light Screens.
Yuan Ming, a novice in practice, could only barely wield the basics of the Void Transformation Technique, but it was more than enough to pass through the crude prohibition before him.
After walking several dozen steps further in, the path ahead suddenly brightened up.
Yuan Ming, following the two men who were deceived by his Illusion Technique, entered a spacious stone chamber and was immediately met with blinding Golden Light.
Inside, everything shimmered brightly, reflecting the luster of all manner of gold and gemstones. Piles of golden sand and Gold Coins littered the ground like leaves and soil, adorned with colorful jewelry and jade artifacts.
To an ordinary mortal, this would be a stupendous wealth, yet in Yuan Ming's eyes, it was no different from dirt.
However, a few Magic Artifacts placed on the shelves in the corner could still catch his attention, but that was about it.
Seeing that the two Divine Envoys casually dumped the treasure presented by the Wusu City Lord into the pile of gold and silver before exiting the chamber, Yuan Ming followed them once more.
This time, the two headed towards the benevolent-looking Divine Statue in the center, behind which was another cave.
This passage was even longer, and before they reached the end, intermittent voices could already be heard from inside.
Listened to those voices sounded somewhat familiar to Yuan Ming, could it be Xu Che's voice?
When they arrived at the entrance of the cave, the two men stepped in, while Yuan Ming stopped at the doorway and carefully peeked inside.
The space outside the cave was enormous, the size of seven or eight rooms, and was also brightly lit.
However, unlike the previous place where gold and silver treasures were stored, in the center of this area stood a towering three-zhang-tall black statue.
The statue resembled a young Goddess in royal attire, with a fan-shaped adornment atop her head, hair tied up high, eyes covered with a black ribbon, hands slightly outstretched in front, exuding a domineering presence.
In one of her palms rested a black disc, etched with the crescent mark of the Wuyue Sect.
At the feet of the black Goddess statue, on a round altar, were placed palm-sized Golden Lotus Lamps, each with a Nether Moon God Statue positioned behind it.
A rough count by Yuan Ming revealed there were startlingly more than three hundred.

chapters.title: Chapter 456 - 433: The Argument of True or False
chapters.content:
As Yuan Ming was surveying the circular altar, the two Divine Envoys who had followed him all the way here also stepped up the dais with solemn expressions and placed the Nether Moon God Statue they brought back on the altar.
Afterward, the two of them moved back to an area against the wall, where already stood more than a dozen pairs of men and women wearing the same attire and masks, all standing in solemn silence.
At that moment, Yuan Ming saw a familiar figure walk to the front of the altar.
Despite the fact that he was cloaked in a large black robe and wore a mask, Yuan Ming still recognized him at a glance—it was Xu Che, who had lost contact with him for a long time.
Yuan Ming's gaze darkened as he suppressed the urge to confront Xu Che, wanting to see what exactly they were up to, only to see Xu Che begin to form a strange spell with his hands, interlocking them in front of himself as he chanted some unknown spell.
At the same time, the pairs of men and women surrounding them also began to mimic the same gestures, chanting the spell.
A moment later, Xu Che suddenly raised one hand while drawing a line across the palm with a finger from the other hand.
He immediately made an incision in his palm, letting the blood drip onto the ground.
"Drip-drop"
"Drip-drop"
The droplets of blood, like pearls off a string, fell to the ground, slowly merging into the indented impressions in the earth, seeping bit by bit into the ground.
The next instant, the ground began to glow red as a circular Array with a radius of three zhang lit up from underneath.Theoriginalsourceis*.
As a surge of red light rose, all the flames on the altar's Lotus Lamps turned from gold to red, casting reflections of sinister light upon the statues.
Yuan Ming's eyes sharpened, and he soon saw light emitting from the Divine Statues, as strands of white light began to ascend and converge toward the tall goddess statue in the center.
"Absorbing Desire Power?" Yuan Ming wondered.
Had Xu Che truly betrayed him and converted to the Wu Yue God Sect, offering the Desire Power he had collected to this new deity?
All the white light was absorbed by the pitch-black goddess statue, gradually converging onto the black disc in the goddess statue's hands, illuminating the crescent mark upon it.
The next instant, the crescent mark lit up with a bloody glow as slender beams of light burst forth, each directed at every Nether Moon God Statue below.
"What is this..." Yuan Ming's pupils constricted slightly.
He could tell that the aura within the slender blood-colored light was reminiscent of the pink mist he had seen in the depraved illusion, it was the same substance, only more concentrated here.
So the "baptism" Hu Ji had spoken of was to corrupt his Desire Power and store it within the Nether Moon God Statue.
If he continued his cultivation unaware, the long-term influence of this power would likely lead him to lose his mind eventually.
After returning a small portion of the contaminated Desire Power back to the Nether Moon God Statue, the operational Array ceased.
"Clap, clap..."
At this moment, a clapping sound suddenly echoed in the spacious hall.
A Bald man, bare-chested, slowly emerged from behind the statues, his skin sickly pale, with green veins clearly visible beneath it.
The man was completely bald, but he had an androgynously perfect face, his eyes pitch black with just a hint of red at the bottom, and he wore two large metal hoops in his ears, exuding an indescribable eerie aura.
At his side fluttered seven or eight naked young men and women, with shaved heads like his and the same sickly pale skin.
These young men and women seemed like pets vying for favor in front of him, each twisting their graceful figures, flocking and rubbing against him.
As if being a bit closer to him was a great honor and pleasure.
While holding a strange-looking golden staff, the Bald man, followed by his pets, approached Xu Che.
Xu Che immediately knelt, proclaiming, "Greetings, Honorable Priest."
"Xu Che, since joining our sect, you have done well," the Bald Priest acknowledged, tapping Xu Che's shoulder with the golden staff.
"Thank you for the praise, Honorable Priest, I am deeply humbled. To be favored by you is my great honor. Among all the gods in the world, only the Wu Yue God is the True God, all others are demons, false gods. I swear to worship the True God forever," Xu Che said, still kneeling and not rising, while loudly proclaiming his loyalty.
The Bald Priest seemed very satisfied, nodding as he said,
"Don't worry, the Wu Yue God sees all your sacrifices. We still haven't enough Believers to completely purify the False God of Nether Moon and reclaim it for the True God, it will take some more time. Once the purification is complete, you will receive direct succession from the Wu Yue God and become the new Priest for the entire Black Wind Desert region."
"Thank you for your grace, Honorable Priest, may you bestow upon me the Divine Talisman, to atone for my past sins," Xu Che thanked him, bowing his head in respect.
The bald priest heard this, raised his hand with a wave, and a blood-red talisman shot out, landing on Xu Che's back. The light of the talisman flashed and then completely merged into his body.
"Ugh..."
Xu Che couldn't help but arch his neck high, letting out a low, satisfied growl from deep in his throat, like that of a wild beast.
The black-robed masked people watching around them also let out roars, envy apparent in their eyes.
Yuan Ming saw this and for a moment couldn't discern whether Xu Che had truly defected of his own volition, or if he had been controlled by the strange blood talisman?
By this point, Yuan Ming felt no further need to remain concealed.
The bald priest was likely a Soul Cultivator, and not having detected him after so long, his cultivation probably wasn't that high.
The moment Yuan Ming touched his forehead with two fingers, his powerful Divine Thought surged forth like a tide.
Everyone inside the cave immediately felt the torrent of Divine Power rushing toward them, their faces showing terror.
The Divine Envoys, the naked men and women, including Xu Che, were overwhelmed with countless illusions filling their minds when they came into contact with the flood of Divine Power, as if their Sea of Consciousness was being swallowed whole.
With the next moment, the powerful Divine Power mixed with the force of the Illusion Technique caused their Sea of Consciousness to collapse, one by one their eyes rolling back as they fainted and fell to the ground.
Before passing out, Xu Che glared at Yuan Ming, filled with resentment, as if Yuan Ming was his mortal enemy!
Yuan Ming was taken aback by this; he had shown benevolence in nurturing Xu Che, and even if Xu Che had betrayed him to join the Wu Yue God Sect, his attitude should not have been this way.
The bald priest's eyes showed a brief confusion, but quickly a pink glow rose from the back of his head, and an abnormally strong Divine Power erupted, dispelling Yuan Ming's illusions and restoring clarity to his eyes.
A flicker of surprise crossed Yuan Ming's eyes; the Soul Power released by the bald priest was stronger than his, almost reaching the Sleep Witch Realm. He had truly misjudged.
"It seems that you are Yuan Ming, the one who meddled with the Nether Moon God. Your cultivation appears to be even stronger than what Xu Che has described," said the bald priest with a cold laugh, after looking Yuan Ming up and down.
"It seems like you knew I was coming all along," said Yuan Ming indifferently.
"The Wu Yue God had already given the revelation; you would return to the embrace of the True God ahead of time," the bald priest said as he kicked aside the naked men and women at his feet and took a step forward.
Yuan Ming's eyes narrowed, and then he noticed that the figure of the bald priest, who had taken a step forward, began to blur.
In the next instant, the body of the bald priest split open, and out emerged a bare-chested bald woman and a similarly naked bald man who swiftly moved to Yuan Ming's left and right sides.
Their faces bore some resemblance to the bald priest, but their sexual characteristics were distinctly different. They clung to Yuan Ming's arms like boneless snake women.
Yuan Ming's arms trembled, and black light burst forth from his palms.
Blasts of Soul Destroying Sword Energy surged out, splitting into two and striking the bald woman and the bald man.
Both their bodies were penetrated with large holes, yet there was no blood spurted, and they showed no signs of injury, exhaling murmuring sounds full of bewitching intention.
The sounds were not distinct words, more like a unique, wordless chant, carrying waves of Sound Waves impact, shaking Yuan Ming's Sea of Consciousness.
Yuan Ming's eyes instantly glazed over, his body stiffened, and he subconsciously began to chant, saying softly, "Believe in the God of Wuyue, avoid descent into the hell of reincarnation, and achieve eternal freedom..."
Pleased with this, the bald priest took a step closer to Yuan Ming, raising the staff in his hand and aiming it at Yuan Ming's forehead.
"False Gods are not worthy of redemption. Come, return to the embrace of the True God, become a part of the True God," he declared.
However, the moment the staff touched Yuan Ming's forehead, a fierce white light instantly burst out from around him.
In the blink of an eye, as if by the burning of a fierce sun fire, the illusionary forms created by the bald priest were burned to evaporation, vanishing without a trace.
As for the bald priest himself, he was already bound by a series of dark chains around his hands, feet, and neck, hung from a gallows.
"Illusion ... when?" The bald priest, realizing he had been trapped, showed a look of surprise on his face but no signs of panic.
He had always been aware of the waves of Yuan Ming's Divine Soul and had not noticed any particularly violent fluctuations, which usually would indicate whether the other side was using the power of the Divine Soul to launch illusions; this time, however, it had failed.
At that moment, Yuan Ming's figure slowly approached from the side.
"I had initially thought you were a minor character, yet you indeed possess some ability. If you are willing to seek refuge in the Wu Yue God's protection now, I might consider letting you join the sect to manage the preaching affairs across the Black Wind Desert. What do you say?" said the bald priest, his eyes shimmering with a hint of admiration.
"If I'm not mistaken, the one tied up is you. Shouldn't you be the one begging for mercy?" Yuan Ming said leisurely.

chapters.title: Chapter 457 - 434: Who on Earth Is It?
chapters.content:
"Stubborn cultist, I gave you a chance, but you gave it up yourself," the Bald Priest sneered coldly.
His glabella split open, revealing a red crystal stone embedded within, from which a red light radiated outwards, illuminating the surroundings. The illusory realm that had solidified around him instantly lost its color, gradually receding to reveal its true form.
The gallows that had bound him also dissipated into nothingness like ashes.
Yuan Ming's face showed surprise, as a black sound wave shot out from his forehead, enveloping the Bald Priest.
The Bald Priest raised the staff in his hand and swung it, causing a surge of green ghostly light to burst forth and collide with the black sound wave, shattering it with ease and casting its light upon Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming suddenly felt his body stiffen, and soon realized that his legs had lost all sensation.
Looking down, he saw that his legs had turned ashen and had petrified into stone, and with the spread of a gray light, his thighs and waist also began to petrify bit by bit.
In just a few breaths, his body from the neck down had turned into rigid stone.
"Are you a peak Soul Cultivator of the love witch? But this rigid Soul Power seems not to be cultivated by yourself," Yuan Ming managed to move his neck and looked at the Bald Priest, asking.
The latter was slightly startled and frowned slightly, not expecting Yuan Ming to remain so composed under such circumstances.
Thus, without any further nonsense, he flashed in front of Yuan Ming, and his eyes suddenly widened, his pupils turning pitch black as if they were deep wells.
Thick black mist surged within the eyes of the Bald Priest. Two metallic, foot-long green-eyed black snakes emerged from within, raising their heads, flicking their tongues, and darting straight towards Yuan Ming's eyes.
However, a black screen-like phantom flashed in front of Yuan Ming, and the two green-eyed black snakes disappeared into thin air.
The Bald Priest was startled, and again his eyes shot out two black snakes aiming at Yuan Ming's body.
But the figure of a green-robed old man materialized in front of Yuan Ming, who stretched out his hands and grabbed the two black snakes; it was the Heavenly Ghost Wanderer.
Two Three-eyed Soul Doves shot out from the body of the Heavenly Ghost Wanderer, and their sharp hooks grabbed one of the soul snakes each.
The Three-eyed Soul Doves screeched sharply, their claws pulling and tearing the soul snakes apart with ferocious and violent force.
The Bald Priest let out a scream, his eyes immediately shedding crimson tears, his spirit greatly weakened.
Silver lightning flashed on Yuan Ming's body, and the petrified marks all over him shattered, freeing him once again.
He raised his hand as if to do something but then stopped and flicked his sleeve.
A black screen appeared, the Night Parade of One Hundred Demons, from which a white light was emitted.
Yuan Ming's forehead also released a black ripple, which merged with the white light.
Before the eyes of the Bald Priest, the scene blurred, and he found himself in a white space, once again bound to a gallows, not with chains but directly through the scapula.
"Tell me, why did you move against me?" Yuan Ming approached the Bald Priest, lightly patting his sleeve, and asked.
"Another Illusion Technique? Unfortunately, you are only a love witch, and such a level of illusion can't hold me!" the Bald Priest said dismissively, as a pink light circle rose again behind his head.
An even more violent burst of Divine Soul Power erupted, viciously assaulting the white space.
However, the white space only rippled slightly and then returned to calm, with no sign of breaking.
"How is this possible!" exclaimed the Bald Priest, showing a look of shock.
The illusory space before his eyes was unimaginably strong; he had stimulated all his Soul Power, as well as the power left by that 'great person' within his Divine Soul, but it was still like an ant trying to shake a tree.
Yuan Ming, upon seeing this scene, flashed a trace of joy in his eyes.
In the past three months, besides practicing the Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill, he had also spent his leisure time researching the "All Living Beings Dream" runes in the Night Parade of One Hundred Demons, using them to enhance the level of the Dream Butterfly Illusion Technique.
His Dream Butterfly Illusion Technique had long been stagnant. With the aid of the All Living Beings Dream Rune, he had finally reached the "Mirage" level and was able to slightly harness the Illusion Power of the runes, greatly increasing the power of the illusion.
Today's test proved to be as hopeful; even the Bald Priest's Soul Power, infinitely close to that of the Sleeping Witch, could not break through. Cоntеnt first rеlеаsеd оn М_VLЕМ_РYR.
Yuan Ming waved his hand, and the hooks that pierced through the chest of the Bald Priest suddenly pulled apart, bringing an intense pain that caused sweat to instantly break out on the Bald Priest's forehead.
"Even though these are illusions and your physical body is not harmed, the feeling of this pain is entirely real. It is a wound to your Divine Soul and can be ten times more painful than real physical injuries," Yuan Ming said calmly.
The Bald Priest clenched his teeth. The flesh on his glabella split open again, and the gem embedded there lit up once more.
But this time, before it could fully burst into light, a straight-shooting black longsword, the Soul Destroying Sword, pierced his forehead.
A "crack" sound of shattering rang out.
The gem on the Bald Priest's forehead was penetrated by the Soul Destroying Sword and exploded into crystal powder, as blood flowed down from his forehead.
For the first time, the Bald Priest showed an expression of terror, his fingers twitching imperceptibly.
On his right hand, he wore a small golden ring that was so inconspicuous it suddenly shattered into pieces.
The golden staff in his hand suddenly lit up with a blinding light, and "bang," it exploded.
A golden light enveloped the Bald Priest's body, and in an instant, a golden formation was formed. The nearby void shook violently—it was a Teleportation Array.
"Trying to escape?" Yuan Ming's eyebrows lifted, and he flicked his sleeve.
The Silver Banner shot out, expanding several times in the wind and enveloping the Bald Priest's body.
The space rune formation within the Silver Banner was activated, and the nearby void twisted, momentarily halting the operation of the golden formation.
A flash of silver light crossed Yuan Ming's palm, and a silver hammer appeared, the Thunder God Hammer. It shot out a thick bolt of thunder, striking the golden formation hard.
There was a loud "boom," and one corner of the golden formation was shattered!
The series of changes were faster than lightning. Before the Bald Priest could react, the golden formation had completely ceased to operate.
"You are not Yuan Ming! Yuan Ming is just a cultivator who hasn't yet reached Core Formation. It's impossible for him to have such Divine Skills! Who on earth are you?" The Bald Priest said, dumbfounded and screaming at the top of his lungs.
Yuan Ming did not answer, merely flicked his finger.
Another thick chain appeared out of thin air, piercing through the Bald Priest's chest, forcing another scream of agony from him.
He used the Soul Searching Divine Ability and grabbed at the air. A cloud of black mist enveloped the Bald Priest, seeping toward his Divine Soul, and the Bald Priest's eyes immediately became clouded.
The Bald Priest's Divine Soul was actually pink in color and exceptionally resilient. The Soul Searching Divine Ability could not penetrate it.
Yuan Ming frowned and stopped using the Soul Searching Divine Ability.
"If you dare to kill me, the Wuyue Sect will not let you go," the Bald Priest said, his eyes clearing and his voice filled with both ferocity and vulnerability.
"If I feared the Wuyue Sect, I wouldn't have appeared here today. If you want to live, tell me everything about this place!" Yuan Ming said with a cold smile.
Panic flashed across the Bald Priest's face, his eyes darting about, but he remained silent.
"It seems you plan to try other means. Since that's the case, let's give you a proper taste," Yuan Ming's expression darkened.
Without any visible movement from him, the gallows instantly grew larger, and the hook's tearing force doubled. The Bald Priest felt as if his chest bones were about to be torn apart, and under the unbearable pain, he let out a muted growl.
That wasn't the end of it. Countless sharp blades appeared around the Bald Priest, one after another piercing into his body.
The Bald Priest's body was soon riddled like a honeycomb, his entire body convulsing in agony.
"You won't deceive me... Telling you means death... Not telling you means death as well. I will never betray the Wuyue Sect..." the Bald Priest said with trembling voice.
"It seems your backbone is harder than I thought. Well, let me take things more seriously then. Since you are a member of the Wuyue Sect, you must have heard of an interrogation secret technique called 'Ten Thousand Threads Soul Drawing Technique,' capable of turning a person's soul into threads and drawing them out one by one, a full ten thousand times before the person's soul is scattered and they can never reincarnate. I haven't used this secret technique since I got it. Let's practice on you today," Yuan Ming stopped the Illusion Technique torture and said with an expressionless face.
"Ten Thousand Threads Soul Drawing Technique!" The Bald Priest's expression changed drastically, his body shuddering uncontrollably with immense fear of this secret technique.
Yuan Ming caught the Bald Priest's reaction in his eyes and silently smirked.
The Six Desires Venerable's Jade Plate did indeed describe this secret technique, but the Ten Thousand Threads Soul Drawing Technique required a long time of practice to master. He had been too busy recently to practice it, only understanding the basics and not yet having the time to cultivate—it was merely a bluff.
Muttering under his breath, a layer of red light appeared on Yuan Ming's right palm, which gradually transformed into numerous fine red threads.
"I'll give you one more chance. Tell me everything, and I can spare you from death. Otherwise, prepare to taste the exquisite agony of your soul shattering," Yuan Ming said.
The Bald Priest's face turned to one of grim resignation, his lips moved a few times, but still, he showed no sign of speaking.
"It seems you've made your choice. You disregard the chance for a clean death, opting instead for a painful one. I'll oblige you," Yuan Ming snorted coldly, as countless red threads shot out, penetrating the Bald Priest's head.
The Bald Priest felt as though millions of needles were piercing the depths of his soul all at once, tearing his soul into countless pieces. He screamed in agony, his facial muscles contorting grotesquely.
"Crying for mercy already? And here I am, just getting started. Wait until I truly start extracting your soul threads—that pain will be dozens of times worse!" Yuan Ming chuckled evilly as one red thread wound around the Bald Priest's Divine Soul.
"Dozens of times!" The Bald Priest's mind buzzed.
He could barely endure the pain now—if it intensified dozens of times over, he doubted he would survive without his soul shattering.
Seeing Yuan Ming change the spell and begin to execute the Ten Thousand Threads Soul Drawing Technique, the Bald Priest finally could not suppress his inner terror and blurted out in panic, "No, I'll talk, I'll talk..."
As his psychological defenses broke, the red threads flew out, still not retracted and suspended above the Bald Priest's head, ready to fall at any moment.
"Speak frankly, who are you really? And why are you targeting my Moon Sect?" Yuan Ming asked indifferently, also breathing a sigh of relief internally.
Executing the Ten Thousand Threads Soul Drawing Technique to this extent was already his limit. If it went on for a few more breaths, he would likely be exposed.

chapters.title: Chapter 458 - 435 Free Venerable
chapters.content:
"My name is Lu Da, and I am the Priest of the Wu Yue Sect in the Black Wind Desert. The Moon Sect destroyed the Black River God that we fostered in Xiansha City, so I was sent by my superiors to destroy the Moon Sect," the bald priest said dejectedly.
"The Black River God was supported by your Wu Yue Sect?" Yuan Ming raised an eyebrow.
Lu Da nodded.
"Why would you support the Black River God?" Yuan Ming pressed on.
"I really don't know. I'm just a lowly Priest. The higher-ups only tell us to carry out tasks and never disclose the reasons to us. I guess they are afraid of leaking secrets," Lu Da glanced at Yuan Ming and cautiously spoke.
Yuan Ming wasn't surprised by this response. If the Wu Yue Sect hadn't kept its resurgence secret, it would have been detected by the major factions long ago.
"What about that statue?" He pointed to the goddess statue nearby.
"That object was distributed by the higher-ups. It can accumulate Desire Power. Every once in a while, someone from above comes to take it away and replaces it with a new one," Lu Da seemed resigned as he spoke.
Yuan Ming waved his hand, sending out a streak of green light to draw the statue over, and examined it carefully, a hint of disappointment flashing in his eyes.
Indeed, the statue had accumulated a considerable amount of Desire Power, but it was carved from a kind of black wood, not made of Nine Nether Iron.
"It seems the Wu Yue Sect is collecting Desire Power. The Black River God did so, the Nether Iron Gourd obtained from the Six Desires Venerable did so, and this statue does the same. What exactly is the Wu Yue Sect's purpose in resurfacing this time?" Yuan Ming pondered silently.
He waved his hand to take the Storage Bag from Lu Da's waist. Lu Da's face twitched, but he said nothing.
Yuan Ming's Divine Sense entered the bag, which contained quite a few items: about fifty thousand Spirit Stones, numerous spiritual materials, elixirs, two Jade Scrolls, and other miscellaneous items.
He casually picked out an item from the Storage Bag. It was a luminous blue glove, thin as a cicada's wing, with a flowing water-like luminescence on its surface and emitting fluctuations of Soul Power.
"What is this?" Yuan Ming didn't rashly touch the gloves but looked at Lu Da.
"This is a soul artifact bestowed by the higher-ups called Empty Gloves. Only Soul Cultivators above the rank of a love witch can use it. It can alter the memories of others," Lu Da honestly explained.
Yuan Ming's eyes flickered. The ability to alter memories was a capability of the Sleeping Witch; these gloves were indeed a valuable item.
"Did you use these Empty Gloves to alter Xu Che's memories?" He recalled something and looked at the unconscious Xu Che beside him.
"Yes, but I was forced into it. The higher-ups ordered me to do so, and I had no choice but to obey," said Lu Da.
Yuan Ming suddenly understood. No wonder Xu Che had looked at him with hatred in his eyes just now; it was very likely that Lu Da had altered Xu Che's memories to make himself appear as Xu Che's enemy.
"Can memories altered by the Empty Gloves be restored?" he asked.
"As long as it hasn't been more than a year, they can be," Lu Da hastily said.
Yuan Ming felt relieved. Xu Che was an important subordinate of his, so it was good that his memories could be restored.
He stowed away the Empty Gloves and continued to look through Lu Da's other possessions. He quickly went through everything and finally picked up two Jade Scrolls and a white Jade Album.
One Jade Scroll contained a Soul Cultivation Method: Dream-Entering Technique.
This method was very special. When cultivating, it would cause the practitioner to fall into deep sleep. Even ordinary people, once asleep, would automatically start to recuperate their Divine Soul. The Dream-Entering Technique allowed one to enter deep sleep and strengthen the Divine Soul Power in their dreams.
The deeper the cultivation of the Dream-Entering Technique, the deeper the sleep and the better the effect on training the Divine Soul. Quite mysterious.
"Good, I've obtained another Soul Cultivation Method," Yuan Ming was pleased inwardly and then looked at the other Jade Scroll, his expression changing slightly.
This Jade Scroll recorded the distribution of Wu Yue Sect's power in the Black Wind Desert, the location of various strongholds, their strength, and so on.
The Wu Yue Sect did not only support the Black River God but also the Wuxiong God, the Crow Snake God, and many other deities, widely spread across underground cities in the Black Wind Desert, recruiting mortal followers and collecting Desire Power.
A cold light glinted in Yuan Ming's eyes. With the Wu Yue Sect and his own Moon Sect becoming sworn enemies, with this Jade Scroll, he could turn the tables on the Wu Yue Sect and root them out entirely.
He put away the two Jade Scrolls and picked up the white Jade Album, frowning immediately.
Seeing this, Lu Da quickly lowered his head.
The white Jade Album was an artifact similar to an Image Capturing Pearl. Each page displayed scenes of intercourse between men and women, with Lu Da being the man and the women being different people—innocent maidens, mature women, a whole range of them, reaching into the hundreds.
Yuan Ming closed the Jade Album and a cold glint flashed in his eyes as he looked at Lu Da.
In those scenes, the women all had vacant expressions and were in a state of captivity; obviously, they were coerced by Lu Da.
This man had harmed so many women and even used a Recording Artifact to record each incident. The purpose was clear without asking; he surely often took it out to enjoy, which was truly despicable.
"Fellow Daoist, please spare my life. I didn't want to do this. My Divine Soul has been tampered with. Every month, I would be overwhelmed with desire. If I did not consort with women, I would fall into a frenzied and out-of-control state. Only by practicing Dual Cultivation of the Divine Soul can I quell these fires," Lu Da pleaded urgently.
"Your Divine Soul was tampered with?" Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming sent his Divine Sense toward the man's Divine Soul once again.
Like during the previous Soul Search, his Divine Power was swiftly blocked.
Yuan Ming's expression hardened, and with a flick of his finger, a soul crow shot out, diving straight into Lu Da's forehead and disappeared within.
Caught off guard, Lu Da's body stiffened, and a look of intense terror appeared in his eyes.
The soul crow unleashed the Soul Collision Divine Ability, slamming fiercely into Lu Da's pink Divine Soul.
At this moment, a surge of violent pink light suddenly burst forth from within Lu Da's Divine Soul, transforming into a chaotic and disordered pink halo that exploded outwards.
Part of a series hosted by * (MV&LEMP&YR).
Yuan Ming's soul crow bore the brunt of it and was instantly dispersed by the pink halo.
Yuan Ming hurriedly redirected the power of his Divine Sense to stabilize his own Sea of Consciousness and resisted the impact of that force.
At the same time, a sudden change occurred!
A pink light ring re-emerged in Lu Da's mind, and a phantom figure appeared, seemingly a woman, who looked towards Yuan Ming.
A shock ran through Yuan Ming's heart, and he quickly operated his Cultivation Technique to protect his body.
On that towering black goddess statue, a strong fluctuation suddenly surged, and bright crystal light burst from its eyes, appearing as if the stone statue were opening its eyes.
The Desire Power within flowed out like a tidal wave, transforming into two beams of light that entered the body of the phantom woman.
The phantom woman quickly solidified into a figure, a woman in a pink dress holding an item resembling a tree branch with five forks, from which dazzling pink light radiated.
"Free Venerable! Don't..." Lu Da's face showed an extremely frightened expression as he let out a terrified scream.
In the next instant, the phantom woman merged into the top of his head, and Lu Da's frightened expression returned to calm, his eyes turning pink. A majestic Soul Power fluctuation immediately emanated from his body, remarkably reaching the Sleep Witch Realm.
The pink tree branch also appeared in his hand, nearly solidified, emitting strong fluctuations of Desire Power as if all the Desire Power from the goddess statue was gathering there.
"Body seizing?" Yuan Ming stepped back, his expression becoming serious.
His thoughts raced, and he swiftly slapped his waist.
A gray shadow shot out from the Spiritual Beast Bag, it was the Three-eyed Crow, which merged into the nearby white Illusion Space and disappeared without a trace.
"Who are you to dare to forcefully intrude the Sea of Consciousness subordinate to my Divine Sect?" "Lu Da" shifted his gaze onto Yuan Ming, questioning him sharply.
At this moment, although he still had his original appearance, his voice had changed to a woman's tone, crisp and pleasant, like the tinkling of spring water, directly flowing into one's heart.
With the sound, the surrounding Illusion Space hummed as if vibrating from a sonic boom, showing signs of collapse.
Yuan Ming quickly activated the Night Parade of Hundred Demons, and a white light shot out, restoring stability to the Illusion Space.
Dozens of thick chains appeared out of thin air, tightly entwining Lu Da's body.
"Hehe, quite a sophisticated Illusion Technique, capable of condensing into an Illusion Space. However, it's ineffective against me," "Lu Da" scanned the surroundings, smiling slightly, waving the pink tree branch in his hand.
A burst of pink light erupted, containing immense Desire Power, which melded into the chains and the white space.
The chains and the white space quickly turned pink, and numerous feelings of panic, hatred, and despair, along with negative emotions from the Desire Power connection with Yuan Ming's Sea of Consciousness, transferred into it.
These emotions seemed magnified many times over, much more intense than the Desire Power transmitted by the believers of the Moon Sect.
Yuan Ming, startled, quickly severed the mental connection with the Illusion Space and leapt backward.
However, the white space did not disappear and was rapidly dyed pink.
Suddenly, Yuan Ming's view shifted, and the white space vanished, revealing a vast open plain with lush green grass and drifting White Clouds.
"A new illusion? However, this is my Dream Butterfly Illusion Space!" At first, Yuan Ming was taken aback, but then he sensed the familiar aura rippling through the surrounding space—it was his Dream Butterfly Illusion Technique.
Yet, the Dream Butterfly Space was being controlled by someone else, turned against him.
"This pink light can actually directly control my Illusion Technique! Just now, Lu Da called out to the Free Venerable? Could it be another Venerable from the Wuyue Sect has descended?" Yuan Ming's heart grew wary.
At that moment, he suddenly felt a gust of wind pressing down from above and hurriedly looked up, only to see Lu Da appearing in mid-air, swinging the pink tree branch again.
Bang!
A massive pink hand appeared from thin air, descending straight from above as if to swat an insect, heading straight for him.
This pink hand wasn't an illusion, but a tangible attack, infused with both the essences of Soul Power and Desire Power, similar to the Great Black Sky God Palm, except without the presence of mana.
An overwhelming pressure, like a torrential deluge, crashed down, leaving Yuan Ming as a piece of seaweed in a storm-tossed sea, wavering and on the verge of destruction.
Yuan Ming stepped forward, and a shadowy black light suddenly emerged from his lower half, sweeping aside dozens of feet in distance with incredible speed, his movements as elusive as a specter, using the Ghost Shadow Escape Technique from Dugu Feng.
He had found this Escape Technique in Dugu Feng's storage magic tool; the Ghost Shadow Escape was a form of Yin Escape Technique. Since Yuan Ming was a Soul Cultivator and his Lifebound Magical Treasure possessed Pure Yin Attribute, his practice of it was particularly synergistic.
Over the past few months, he had been continuously studying and had begun to grasp its principles.
With a "bang," the pink giant palm struck where Yuan Ming had been standing, blasting out a ten-foot-wide crater.

chapters.title: Chapter 459 - 436: No Martial Ethics
chapters.content:
"Ghost Shadow Escape Technique! Are you from the Black Desert Alliance?" "Lu Da" showed a look of surprise, and the giant pink palm that had risen from the ground stopped.
"I..." Yuan Ming's eyes flickered as he was about to fabricate a lie to buy some time.
"Heavenly Ghost Wanderer! How come you are here?" "Lu Da" glanced at the Heavenly Ghost Wanderer not far away and once again exclaimed in surprise.
Yuan Ming's gaze shifted. The Free Venerable inside Lu Da's body, could it be that he knew the Heavenly Ghost Wanderer?
The Heavenly Ghost Wanderer was from the Wu Yue Sect. Listening to the familiar tone of "Lu Da," Yuan Ming even felt that the Heavenly Ghost Wanderer had a close relationship with the Free Venerable.
The Heavenly Ghost Wanderer stood there woodenly, without speaking.
Affected by the All Living Beings' Dream Rune, the ghost slaves in the Night Parade of Hundred Demons fell into an illusion, unable to move. Yuan Ming's recent advancements in his illusion technique had finally allowed him to slightly affect the All Living Beings' Dream Rune, enabling the Heavenly Ghost Wanderer to move a little, but there was still a long way to go before regaining his previous agility.
He inwardly cursed; the Heavenly Ghost Wanderer had now transformed into a ghost slave. Ordinary people might not notice, but the Venerables of the Wu Yue Sect would surely see through it at a glance.
"No, why has the body of the Heavenly Ghost Wanderer become a Ghost Spirit Body! The screen contains your mana signature, did you play tricks on it?" "Lu Da" indeed immediately sensed something was wrong, suddenly turned to look at Yuan Ming, and pointed a finger.
The giant pink palm shot out like a meteor, coming down again.
Yuan Ming used the Ghost Shadow Escape Technique again to dodge, but the giant pink palm changed direction and heavily struck the Night Parade of Hundred Demons.
A wave of pink light rapidly invaded inside, quickly dyeing half of the screen pink.
Anxiety flashed through Yuan Ming's eyes; the pink light had an amazing ability to control. If it invaded the Night Parade of Hundred Demons, there was a great possibility that the item would change hands.
The Night Parade of Hundred Demons was his important Magic Treasure. It contained the All Living Beings Dream Rune and could not be lost.
His mind raced as his figure already flew towards it, his finger pointed.
A black sword rainbow tens of feet long tore through the sky like a black flood dragon—it was the Soul Destroying Sword.
However, a disturbance in the void in front of him emerged, and a pink branch appeared out of thin air, blocking the black sword rainbow.
Strong Desire Power invaded the Soul Destroying Sword, and the black blade rapidly turned pink.
"Damn!" Yuan Ming was startled and tried to retrieve the Soul Destroying Sword, but the sword was already beyond his control.
The pink Desire Power followed the connection of the Soul Destroying Sword to his life essence and invaded his body.
Yuan Ming's mana inside his body suddenly boiled over, like in the Illusion Space it was wrested from his control, and he could not move a bit, fly, or summon his Magic Treasure—his complexion turned pale.
"A mere Early-stage Core Formation cultivator, yet you possess so many fine Magic Treasures. Seems like you are no simple character, can't let you live!" "Lu Da" flashed a hint of murderous intent in his eyes and with a sword-like light shot from the pink branch, he slashed through the air towards Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming didn't panic and stimulated his physical strength.
His legs suddenly grew much thicker, with wrinkle-like black patterns emerging on them, resembling the strong legs of an elephant.
Yuan Ming's feet stomped the ground, giving off a sense of cumbersomeness as though an elephant wading through a quagmire. However, his movements were incredibly nimble; the perfect blend of heaviness and lightness in his movements was infuriatingly difficult to comprehend.
With a flicker of his form, he darted more than a dozen feet to the side, dodging the pink sword energy's slash.
The Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill's movement technique, Demon Elephant Flying Crossing!
"Still an individual cultivator! You do have quite a variety of tricks up your sleeve, what a pity!" "Lu Da," with even more killing intent in his eyes, watched as the pink branch suddenly exploded, turning into countless pink lights that flooded the entire space.
Waves of pink light surged towards Yuan Ming, coming in layers, with no escape.
Yuan Ming was swallowed by the pink light, feeling unbearably hot and restless, his Qi-Blood Power and Sea of Consciousness Soul Power also boiling, and it seemed that he was about to lose control of his physical body and soul power too.
"Worthy of being a Wu Yue Sect Venerable, even if it's just a Clone descending, it's not something I can contend with!" Yuan Ming thought to himself and immediately connected with the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
A powerful current of Desire Power surged out, and the boiling Soul Power within his Sea of Consciousness instantly calmed down.
He summoned all his Soul Power to form a semi-transparent Soul Power protective shield around himself.
Yuan Ming barely managed to summon a bit of mana and took out the Silver Token from his Storage Ring, throwing it onto the ground.
