Silver light, like a liquid, poured out from the token, expanding swiftly and almost instantly forming a silver barrier within the Soul Power shield, keeping the pink light outside.
The silver barrier's isolation capability was exceptional, restoring much of his control over his mana and physical body.
Yuan Ming took out the Stealing Heaven Tripod and entered it, sitting atop the White Jade Lotus Platform.
Once inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space, the influence of the pink light was completely eliminated, and his mana, Soul Power, and Qi-Blood circulation returned to normal.
Yuan Ming sighed with relief and activated his vast Divine Sense, spreading it from a Desire Power anchor point, which was the Three-eyed Crow he had earlier released. The entire stronghold of the Wu Yue Sect was suddenly under his control.
"Lu Da," looking at the silver barrier, showed a look of surprise and reached out with a gesture.
The surrounding pink light converged again, forming a gigantic palm that slapped fiercely towards the silver barrier.
Yuan Ming wouldn't let it succeed, and from his hand, he took out the Thunder God Hammer, unleashing all the Power of thunder and lightning stored within.
Boom Boom Boom!
A bolt of Silver Thunder, thick as a water barrel, shot through the air and struck the giant pink palm.
The Thunder God Hammer had the ability to absorb external thunder and store it within. The Power of thunder and lightning contained in this hammer was left by the Shura Master, and it was exceptionally powerful.
Previously, during the great battle in the Shura Palace, he had used a lot, but the remaining power of thunder and lightning was still very strong, not inferior to the attacks of a Nascent Soul cultivator,
The giant pink palm, a concentration of Desire Power and Soul Power, was restrained by the power of thunder and lightning, and instantly shattered into countless disordered specks of pink light.
A trace of annoyance flashed through "Lu Da's" eyes, if her true body were here, she wouldn't care about this mere thunder and lightning. At this moment, she was only present in spirit, able to exert only thirty percent of her strength.
The silver thunder and lightning that crushed the giant palm did not dissipate.
Yuan Ming waved the Thunder God Hammer, directing the remaining Silver Thunder to strike towards Lu Da herself.
"Lu Da," although she had temporarily boosted the soul power of this body to the Sleep Witch Realm using the Desire Power within the goddess statue, Lu Da's Mana remained the same, not even having reached the Core Formation stage, so how could she dare to directly intercept the Silver Thunder's attack.
He frowned and hastily dodged backwards.
However, the direction of the Silver Thunder suddenly shifted, striking the Night Parade of Hundred Demons.
The Night Parade of Hundred Demons was immediately sent flying, its spirit light dimmed, and the screen itself trembled unceasingly. It was wounded by the Silver Thunder, but the invasive pink light was also shattered.
Yuan Ming pointed into the void with his hand. Mana and Soul Power descended from the sky, entering the Night Parade of Hundred Demons, enveloping the All Living Beings' Dream Rune. With a pull outward, he tossed it towards where Lu Da was.
A burst of white light shot out from the Night Parade of Hundred Demons, meteor-like, striking towards "Lu Da."
Lu Da, not knowing the severity, waved his hand to disperse the white light,
But at that moment, the All Living Beings' Dream Rune suddenly erupted in blinding white light, filling Lu Da's field of vision.
His Sea of Consciousness "buzzed," countless illusions appeared before his eyes, his consciousness quickly sank, and the surrounding Illusion Space also collapsed with a thunderous crash.
A dark shadow shot towards him like electricity. It was the Three-eyed Crow, whose sharp beak like a blade fiercely pecked at Lu Da's chest. Thank you for reading. This was brought to you by *.
A large hole was pierced through Lu Da's chest and abdomen, and his body flew backward, crashing onto a series of Nether Moon God statues on the altar, and ultimately collapsing onto the Wu Yue Goddess statue.
Yuan Ming channeled his Mana into the Thunder God Hammer, and another power of thunder and lightning fell, striking Lu Da's head, entering his Sea of Consciousness.
"Lu Da" suddenly convulsed, the Desire Power swiftly overflowed, the Sleep Witch level Soul Power also rapidly fell, returning to its previous level.
The lingering pink light nearby also dispersed, and the pink inside the Soul Destroying Sword vanished, restoring the connection with Yuan Ming's spirit.
Yuan Ming was secretly delighted and pinched a spell formula.
The Soul Destroying Sword trembled and disappeared, reappearing in front of "Lu Da." The sword tip emitted a strand of Soul Destroying Sword Energy, piercing his head.
The pink phantom that had appeared earlier was penetrated by the Soul Destroying Sword Energy, and was flung out.
"Good, a Core Formation Stage cultivator, I'll remember you, wait for the revenge from my Divine Sect…" The pink phantom looked towards the silver barrier, its eyes full of viciousness.
After saying this, the phantom collapsed, turning into a mass of pink light and scattering away.
"Hmph, defeated and running away? Think you can escape?" The silver barrier crumbled, and Yuan Ming stepped out.
The Soul Destroying Sword emanated a great black light, forming a black vortex, drawing back all the pink light, reconstituting the pink phantom.
Whoosh!
A soul crow shot out from Yuan Ming's brow, rushing towards the wisp of phantom, tearing it apart in a matter of seconds.
"You…" The phantom yelled in frustration, but before it could finish speaking, it was devoured, not expecting Yuan Ming to be so dishonorable.
Yuan Ming recalled the soul crow, sat down cross-legged, and began to rotate the Heart Cleansing Technique.
Although the phantom was formed of Soul Power, it contained quite a bit of Desire Power as well, which could only be refined by the Heart Cleansing Technique.
Luckily, not much Desire Power was contained within the phantom. Yuan Ming quickly refined it completely and began to examine the phantom's memories, his eyes lighting up.
The pink phantom's identity was shattered, but with some effort, he found some useful information. First of all, the identity of the pink phantom was indeed one of the Six Great Venerables from the Wu Yue Sect, the Free Venerable.
Regarding this man's Divine Skills, Yuan Ming also discovered a thing or two.
The Free Venerable had cultivated a Soul Cultivation Method from the Wu Yue Sect called the "Great Freedom Heart Sutra," which could absorb Desire Power to enhance the Divine Soul, without fearing the influence of the myriad emotions and thoughts contained in that Desire Power.
Furthermore, the "Great Freedom Heart Sutra" could control the complex emotions within Desire Power, using them to attack enemies.
Yuan Ming's gaze slightly flickered, feeling somewhat intrigued.
The emotions in Desire Power could corrupt one's will, making them incredibly hard to deal with; he could only rely on the Heart Cleansing Technique to refine it. He had not expected there to be a Secret Technique that could manipulate these emotions.
Unfortunately, the memories he had explored were too scattered, lacking the specific Cultivation Method of the "Great Freedom Heart Sutra." Otherwise, he would have been truly interested in comprehending this method. It would undoubtedly be of great help in controlling the Desire Power of his followers in the future.
In addition, the Free Venerable had descended upon Lu Da in the form of a Clone, using a secret skill called "Soul Descent Technique."
This technique used special contract runes to allow Soul Cultivators to use Desire Power as a bond, projecting their split souls across space onto their followers.
Simply put, it was about planting contract runes in the Divine Soul of the follower, so that in times of danger, the Soul Power could descend across space.
The pink hue of Lu Da's Divine Soul was precisely due to the contract rune placed by the Free Venerable.

chapters.title: Chapter 460 - 460: 437 year Rescue
chapters.content:
About the contents of the Soul Descent Technique, Yuan Ming had already gotten a rough understanding through searching the memories of the Residual Soul of the Free Venerable.
To execute this technique, one must be able to control the Desire Power to a certain extent.
Desire Power, intangible and colorless, is elusive and unpredictable. Besides those who cultivate something like the "Great Freedom Heart Sutra," most Soul Cultivators cannot truly perceive and control Desire Power; therefore, very few within the Wu Yue Sect can execute the Soul Descent Technique.
However, Yuan Ming's eyes brightened.
He sat on the White Jade Lotus Platform inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod. Without any direction, the Desire Power within the platform would spontaneously merge into his Divine Soul, and it was without any side effects, naturally fulfilling the conditions needed for cultivating the Soul Descent Technique.
It was just unknown whether the Soul Descent Technique could function like a Desire Power anchor, allowing his Divine Sense to descend from the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space.
If possible, it would provide him another way and means to influence the outside world from within the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
Beyond these, there were no more valuable pieces of information in the Residual Soul of the Free Venerable.
Yuan Ming collected his thoughts and stood up.
Lu Da lay on the ground, surprisingly not perished yet, but his breath grew weaker and weaker, like the flame in the wind, which could extinguish at any time.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan… you promised to spare my life… please save me…" he said with difficulty.
"I can," Yuan Ming said indifferently, flicking his finger and shooting a green light that merged into Lu Da's body.
The wound on Lu Da's chest healed significantly, and his breath stabilized considerably.
"Thank you, Fellow Daoist Yuan… no, Lord Nether Moon God, from now on, I am willing to follow at your side and work for the Moon Sect!" Lu Da exclaimed with tearful gratitude, expressing his loyalty.
"How foolish to really let an enemy go because of a single phrase. Once the injury is healed, immediately plan to escape and report to the higher-ups, the previous intelligence about the Moon Sect had been greatly misleading…" he thought disdainfully of Yuan Ming's behavior of keeping promises, secretly turning thoughts in his mind.
"I trust you." Yuan Ming smiled faintly and flicked his sleeve.
The nearby Night Parade of Hundred Demons flew over, emitting a black light that coiled around Lu Da's body like tentacles and dragged him toward the painting.
"Lord Nether Moon God, what are you doing! Ah…" Lu Da felt his body getting colder and colder, with a fear of being dragged into the abyss of the underworld, and he yelled in alarm and anger.
"Lu Da, having been a pawn of the Wu Yue Sect, you have committed many atrocities against the heavens, did you really think you could continue to roam freely? Since you promised to serve the Moon Sect, serve me as a Ghost Slave from now on," Yuan Ming said emotionlessly.
The black light emitted by the Night Parade of Hundred Demons intensified, and "whoosh," it completely dragged Lu Da's body inside, cutting off his screams abruptly.
Yuan Ming then took the All Living Beings Dream Rune back into the Night Parade of Hundred Demons and thoroughly checked the entire cave again, finding a few Foundation Establishment Cultivator's Magic Artifacts, all common items. The only somewhat valuable item was a Warm Jade Pendant that aids the cultivation of Soul Cultivators, but it was of no use to him.
Additionally, Yuan Ming also found some cultivation elixirs and various blood-red forbidden talismans, which looked like the "Divine Talismans" Lu Da had previously implanted into Xu Che, but they were just deceptive tricks.
Afterwards, Yuan Ming moved beside Xu Che, took out the Empty Gloves and put them on, and mustered his Soul Power into them.
The gloves emitted a flickering blue ethereal little hand that moved flexibly with rings of blue light at the fingertips, easily permeating into the void.
"So it is, using this method to alter memories…" Yuan Ming carefully sensed the blue little hand and nodded slightly.Chaptersource:MyVirtualLibraryEmpire(*).
He had already mastered the Soul Searching ability; the black light emitted by the Soul Searching Divine Ability could only probe the surface of the memory, but this blue hand had stronger penetration, able to delve deep into the sea of memories and rewrite them.
Yuan Ming plunged the blue hand into Xu Che's head, quickly found the memory altered by Lu Da - Xu Che had been altered to see Lu Da as the murderer of his mother and had been controlled by him for many years with Illusion Techniques to serve his purposes and propagate the Moon Sect.
And in Xu Che's mind, the Moon Sect was also modified into a cult that exploited ordinary people for money and committed all kinds of evil deeds.
Yuan Ming shook his head, controlling the blue hand, and began correcting Xu Che's memories.
A sound person, especially a Cultivator, possesses self-healing abilities for the Divine Soul. Therefore, correcting memories is much easier than rewriting them. Since the altered memories hadn't been in place very long and were discovered in time, Yuan Ming did not take much time to complete the task.
Xu Che's eyebrows twitched a few times, and he opened his eyes.
"My lord! How are you here? What happened to me? My mind is very confused…" he said bewilderedly.
"You were captured by someone from the Wu Yue Sect…" Yuan Ming recounted the events.
"So it was like that. I, your subordinate, was controlled and made a grave mistake. Please punish me," Xu Che said after hearing everything, overcome with shame, and knelt on the ground.
"The Wu Yue Sect has existed for ten thousand years. Back then, even Chang Chun Temple along with various factions couldn't destroy it. You couldn't resist on your own power, so don't blame yourself too much, get up," Yuan Ming said, flicking his sleeve, and a tender force lifted Xu Che up.
"This time, we are lucky you discovered it in time and eliminated Lu Da and others, otherwise the Moon Sect would truly have disintegrated," Xu Che said, adjusting his emotions and speaking with lingering fear.
"With the growing strength of the Moon Sect, it will certainly encounter various crises, so there's no need to worry too much," Yuan Ming said.
"My lord, please forgive my frankness, but the power of the Moon Sect is too weak; without you, any sect could uproot us at will. Now does not seem to be the time for widespread preaching," Xu Che hesitated before expressing his view.
Last time Yuan Ming had him preach extensively, he felt it was inappropriate, yet he dared not speak directly.
"In the future, you must indeed be more cautious when you preach, and if you encounter any problems, pray and report to me immediately; I will find a way to handle it," Yuan Ming uttered affirmatively.
He insisted on expanding the preaching area as he had his own plans. He could not just abandon such a beneficial method to enhance Soul Cultivator's strength just because of some difficulties. Since they had provoked the Wu Yue Sect, a colossal entity, he indeed had to be more careful in his actions.
"Yes," Xu Che agreed.
"Also, do not make any more statues of the Nether Moon God; it makes it easy for others to criticize us, just like this time. From now on, when recruiting believers, just let them know what I look like," Yuan Ming spoke again.
Through his recent assessments, he had discovered a pattern in collecting Desire Power. The believers of the Moon Sect did not necessarily need to pray in front of a statue; as long as they knew his appearance, the Desire Power could be transmitted to him.
These statues of the Nether Moon God were sufficient to be seen once; there was no need to view them daily.
As for whether there were other patterns in collecting Desire Power, he was still uncertain.
"Yes, I will take care of it immediately," Xu Che said, bowing his head.
He hesitated for a moment, then his expression solidified, and he bowed deeply to Yuan Ming, "My lord, please implant the Soul Descent Technique rune inside my Divine Soul!"
"Do you know how overbearing the Soul Descent Technique rune is? Once implanted, you will have no secrets before me. I can easily monitor your every action and thought whenever I choose," Yuan Ming looked at Xu Che and said slowly.
"I am aware, but for the well-being of the Moon Sect, there can't be any issues here. Only the Soul Descent Technique rune can ensure that," Xu Che responded.
"Well, if that is the case, I will cast it on you once I am familiar with the Soul Descent Technique," Yuan Ming had been wanting to test the effects of the Soul Descent Technique on a believer and did not refuse.
Then, through identification by Xu Che, some of the Divine Envoys turned out to have been brought by Lu Da, and Yuan Ming took action and annihilated them.
The remaining individuals were mainly believers of the Nether Moon God; either their power was lacking, or their identities were not significant, their memories were not altered, and they had merely fallen under Lu Da's control through his Illusion Technique.
Yuan Ming, not wanting too many people to know his whereabouts, dispelled their illusions and concealed his presence.
When these people learned from Xu Che that it was Lord Nether Moon God who had descended to personally save them, they were exceedingly moved and thanked him endlessly.
It was with great difficulty that Xu Che managed to calm their emotions.
Thereafter, Xu Che told these people about what Lu Da had done and instructed them to deliver the elixirs to the believers' homes in various cities for treatment. He also ordered that they distribute the accumulated gold and silver to the common people.
These items were useless to Cultivators, but to the ordinary folk, they were undoubtedly the best "miracle."
A group of people, deeply grateful for the mercy of Lord Nether Moon God, thanked him repeatedly before leaving.
In this cave, besides them, there were over three hundred women Lu Da had collected from various cities, who were imprisoned.
Most of them had been tortured to a state less than human, and many had perished, forever remaining here.
After rescuing them, Yuan Ming did not force them into becoming believers out of gratitude, but erased their memories related to this place and sent them back.
At this moment, the Night Parade of Hundred Demons had entirely refined Lu Da into a Ghost Slave, and through a Soul Search on him, Yuan Ming learned much about the Wu Yue Sect.
The Jade Scroll that listed the Wu Yue Sect's strongholds contained truthful information.
Lu Da had collected information on the other strongholds because he was ordered by the Free Venerable, which involved a power struggle among several Venerables of the Wu Yue Sect.
In Lu Da's memory, Yuan Ming also unexpectedly learned the identity of the Heavenly Ghost Wanderer, which matched his previous speculation that the Heavenly Ghost Wanderer was indeed a subordinate of the Free Venerable.
The Heavenly Ghost Wanderer and Lu Da were both dispatched by the Free Venerable to the Black Wind Desert. Lu Da gathered Desire Power, while the Heavenly Ghost Wanderer was ordered to collect Soul Power at all costs, and the more, the better. This led to his mad act of slaughtering the entire Earth River City.
Yuan Ming frowned slightly. The Free Venerable cultivated the Great Freedom Heart Sutra, requiring Desire Power for his practice, so why did he desperately need to collect a vast amount of Soul Power?
"My lord, what are your plans next? Although we have destroyed this stronghold of the Wu Yue Sect, other strongholds in the Black Wind Desert still exist. I feel that if we want to preach here peacefully, we must eliminate all those strongholds," Xu Che approached and said.
Yuan Ming returned to his senses, a trace of surprise flashing in his eyes.
He had just been considering this matter and had already drafted a plan; unexpectedly, Xu Che had come to the same conclusion.
Aside from being capable in his duties, this person also had quite a far-reaching vision.
"Do not worry about this matter; I will arrange everything," Yuan Ming responded.
"Do you plan to destroy them one by one? With your strength, you certainly can, but this method is too time-consuming and somewhat risky," Xu Che said hesitantly.

chapters.title: Chapter 461 - 438: Qu Jiang is Still the Same Qu Jiang
chapters.content:
"I naturally won't do it myself, as long as the situation of Wu Yue Sect's resurgence and the locations of those strongholds are divulged to Five Thunder Sect, Spirit Talisman Sect, and other great forces, they will naturally send people to root them out completely," Yuan Ming said with a slight smile.
"The master's method is truly good, achieving our goals without expending a single soldier," Xu Che's eyes lit up as he complimented.
"You thought of this method too, haven't you? There's no need to deliberately flatter me. I want genuine work, not boastful flattery," Yuan Ming glanced at Xu Che and said indifferently.
Although he had not yet implanted the Soul Descent Technique rune in Xu Che, his Emotion Manipulation Ability could still sense Xu Che's thoughts.
"Yes," Xu Che's expression stiffened as he bowed his head and responded.
The two of them then left the place. Yuan Ming first visited Spirit Wind City, retrieved the items from the cave mansion there, and informed the Spirit Talisman Sect about the situation of the Wu Yue Sect strongholds.
He then went to Five Thunder City and Guiyuan City controlled by the Guiyuan Sect, disclosing the information of the Wu Yue Sect to the two great sects.
Yuan Ming did not reveal his true form. The two great sects were skeptical but, given the alarming situation of the Wu Yue Sect's resurgence, they still immediately dispatched forces to act.
As for the Black Desert Alliance, knowing it was controlled by the Wu Yue Sect, he did not waste his effort.
The actions of Five Thunder Sect, Guiyuan Sect, and Spirit Talisman Sect mobilized their subordinate forces as well, surrounding and suppressing the Wu Yue Sect.
Due to the disappearance of the Shura Palace, the recently calmed Black Wind Desert was once again stirring with activity.
In the midst of the chaos in the entire Black Wind Desert, the instigators, Yuan Ming and Xu Che, quietly stayed in a subterranean cave in the Black Wind Desert.
"Are you ready?" Yuan Ming asked.
"Ready," Xu Che nodded.
Yuan Ming waved his hand, casting the Dream Butterfly Illusion Technique, completely shielding Xu Che's senses.
Xu Che's expression froze, as if turned into a statue.
Yuan Ming grabbed Xu Che, entered the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space, and sat upon the White Jade Lotus Platform. Immense Will Power from the platform infused into his Divine Soul.
Yuan Ming exhaled lightly, raised his hand to press on Xu Che's head, and chanted a spell.
A pure black light emerged from his palm, a fusion of Soul Power and the Lotus Platform Will Power, slowly sinking into Xu Che's Sea of Consciousness, permeating his Divine Soul.
Yuan Ming's chant shifted, many black runes appeared within the black light, namely the Soul Descent Technique runes.
Feeling delighted inside, with the aid of the Will Power from the White Jade Lotus Platform, he found it exceedingly easy to execute the Soul Descent Technique.
Yuan Ming steadied his emotions and continued casting.
The black runes swiftly integrated into Xu Che's Divine Soul, which gradually turned black.
After a quarter of an hour, the two left the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space and returned to the subterranean cave.
Yuan Ming lifted the Dream Butterfly Illusion Technique, and Xu Che slowly came to his senses.
"Is it over?" Xu Che, feeling as though he had just taken a nap, found it somewhat surreal and asked.
Yuan Ming, showing signs of fatigue on his face, nodded before closing his eyes to recuperate.
Executing the Soul Descent Technique had drained him greatly.
Seeing this, Xu Che did not dare to disturb him, moving aside to sense the changes in his Divine Soul.
With the help of the Stealing Heaven Tripod's Will Power flow, Yuan Ming quickly recovered.
Xu Che also became clear about the effects of the Soul Descent Technique runes. Although this technique controlled his Divine Soul, it greatly enhanced it as well.
Xu Che had already begun practicing the Heart Cleansing Technique, but his talent in soul cultivation was not very good; he had just started learning the first level.
Yuan Ming had left considerable Soul Power within the Soul Descent Technique runes, hence they had a beneficial effect on the Divine Soul. Whenever Xu Che activated the Soul Descent Technique, his Soul Power would surge, comparable to the perfect completion of the first level of the Heart Cleansing Technique.
Additionally, with the Soul Descent Technique runes providing Protective Body, his resistance to Illusion Techniques and other Divine Soul-class attacks increased considerably, making it easier to resist Soul Searches.
Hearing Yuan Ming had bestowed him these techniques, Xu Che recognized the preciousness of "Earth Core Magnetic Skill" and expressively thanked him.
Surprised by Xu Che's enthusiasm, Yuan Ming realized that despite possessing many advanced techniques, he had overlooked the allure a suitable supreme technique held for cultivators, especially Loose Cultivators.
After a moment, he took out several supreme techniques of different attributes and handed them to Xu Che.
"Take these techniques and use them to attract believers, strive to convert all leftover faithful from the Wu Yue Sect after their defeat," Yuan Ming instructed.
Xu Che watched as Yuan Ming casually took out and handed over several Jade Scrolls containing the core cultivation techniques of various Sects, leaving him completely stunned and nodding blankly.
Yuan Ming encouraged Xu Che a few more words before he stood up and left.
A moment later, Xu Che also emerged from underground, his expression had calmed down, and he summoned a Flying Shuttle artifact, flying off into the distance.
Yuan Ming's figure flashed in mid-air, watching the tunneling light of Xu Che fading into the distance, then he entered the Stealing Heaven Tripod space.
Yuan Ming activated his Soul Power, sensing the Soul Descent Technique runes, feeling a connection between his and Xu Che's minds. Through the runes, they could communicate, and he could control Xu Che's thoughts at any time.
Yuan Ming wasn't particularly concerned about this; generally speaking, he trusted Xu Che. This was more of a precautionary measure, not to be used unless absolutely necessary.
He composed himself and tried to use the Soul Descent Technique rune as an anchor to project his Soul Power and Mana.
As soon as the Soul Descent Rune in Xu Che's Divine Soul stirred, a vast amount of Soul Power descended out of nowhere.
"My lord? Do you have any other instructions?" Xu Che stopped his Flying Shuttle and asked through a mental transmission.
Before he could finish speaking, a flash of silver lightning suddenly shot down from the void above, striking the sandy ground below, and blasting a deep crater several meters wide.
Xu Che was startled and hurriedly looked around, thinking it was an enemy attack.
"Don't worry, that was just me testing the effects of the Soul Descent Technique. It seems quite satisfactory. You continue on your way," Yuan Ming's voice resounded in Xu Che's Sea of Consciousness.
Hearing this, Xu Che breathed a sigh of relief, bowed to the void, and continued his journey into the distance.
Inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod, a pleased expression spread across Yuan Ming's face.
The Soul Descent Rune indeed allowed his Soul Power and Mana to descend, and he didn't need a believer's prayer; he could display his Divine Skills at any moment.
With this technique, his actions in the future would be much more convenient.Brought to you by *.
Yuan Ming soon left the Stealing Heaven Tripod, transforming into a green long rainbow, and flew towards Da Jin.
...
Qujiang City.
The noonday sun was as scorching and dazzling as ever.
At the city gate, people queuing to enter the city tried their best to hide their bodies in the shadow of the city wall, seeking some coolness.
This inevitably led to jostling, but even those with hot tempers did not dare to cause any major disturbances in front of the gate guards; at most, they would only utter a few harsh words.
In the crowd, a young man in a long robe moved through the throng like a fish, yet the nearby pedestrians subconsciously avoided him, leaving a relatively spacious area around him.
No one noticed anything unusual, as if it were all perfectly natural.
When the young man passed by, the guard merely glanced at him briefly, didn't even bother to ask any questions, simply nodded, and let him into the city.
This young man was Yuan Ming, returning from the Black Wind Desert.
With his current strength and cultivation, unless the Nascent Soul Elders of the Chang Chun Temple intervened, no one could trouble him.
However, his visit was primarily to see his parents; he might not fear for himself, but he still needed to consider his parents' situation. This was why he entered the city discreetly and even altered his appearance slightly to avoid recognition.
It had been a while since his last visit to Qujiang, and the city had undergone many changes: new buildings erected, old ones collapsed. However, Qujiang remained the same Qujiang with the highest building in the city center always being the Imperial Palace, no one daring to challenge its authority, at least outwardly.
Yuan Ming followed the streets he remembered home, but suddenly, he stopped, his gaze falling on a street-side sign that read "Rice Wine Sweet Dumplings."
Looking at the familiar characters on the sign, he suddenly remembered, this was his favorite stall from his childhood. The stall owner was a middle-aged man, who looked very honest and would push his cart out before dawn to set up his stall here selling rice wine sweet dumplings.
Yuan Ming, mischievous as a child, would sometimes run out when bored with his studies, always drawn by the unique sweet and rich aroma of the sweet dumplings, shamelessly coming over to eat.
Since he snuck out, he naturally wouldn't carry money, but the stall owner never minded and would even add a few more dumplings to the bowl he served.
Every time after eating, Yuan Ming would earnestly promise to bring money next time. However, as his parents were quite strict about his allowances, although he managed to pay a few times later, he mostly ate for free.
Only when he grew a bit older did he learn that each time he sneaked out, his father would secretly send someone to follow him, and the dumplings he ate were always paid for in advance.
The dumplings of his youth were never a stranger's kindness, but an undisplayed fatherly love.
The last time he returned to Qujiang, the rice wine stall was still there, but now there was a teenager helping the stall owner, who appeared to be his son. According to the owner, this son initially intended to make a living through education, but lacking aptitude, he learned little from years of private tutoring, so he finally pulled him in to help, continuing the family business.
Now, the sign was still there, but the familiar stall was gone, replaced by a small shop along the street, modest in size but fully equipped.
Yuan Ming entered the shop and saw numerous plaques hanging on the wall, advertising not just rice wine sweet dumplings but also other snacks. Behind the wooden counter stood a woman in cotton clothes, about thirty years old, busy with an abacus in one hand and holding an infant in the other.
"What would you like to eat, sir?" Hearing someone enter, the woman quickly looked up and greeted him.

chapters.title: Chapter 462 - 439: Seeking an Explanation
chapters.content:
"Boss, do you still have sweet fermented rice balls?" Yuan Ming asked the plain-clothed woman.
"Yes, yes, please have a seat, sir. Dazhu, one bowl of sweet fermented rice balls!" The woman nodded her head, turned, and lifted the curtain to shout an order to the kitchen.
Soon, a middle-aged man around thirty brought out a bowl of steaming rice balls.
As he put down the bowl and was about to leave, Yuan Ming called out to him.
"Li Dazhu, where's your father?"
"You know my dad?" Li Dazhu turned, surprised to see Yuan Ming's youthful appearance.
"I used to eat his fermented rice balls a lot when I was young. I never imagined that the little stall from back then has now become a shop. How is he doing nowadays?" Yuan Ming said with a smile.
"Thank you for asking, my dad passed away two years ago." Li Dazhu's expression darkened.
Yuan Ming was stunned, "Passed away? Two years ago, was he over seventy?"
"That's right, seventy-eight. As the saying goes, 'To live past seventy is rare in olden days,' my dad passed away peacefully," Li Dazhu sighed, seemingly reluctant to dwell on the topic any longer. With a "take your time" he went back to the kitchen.
In the tavern, the clacking of an abacus echoed as Yuan Ming sat dazed at the table, staring at the bowl of rice balls in front of him, feeling a heavy, indescribable emotion in his heart.
Suddenly, he stood up swiftly and walked quickly toward the exit.
"Hey, sir, you haven't paid yet!" the woman called out hurriedly upon hearing the commotion.
Without turning back, Yuan Ming flicked his wrist, and a silver ingot landed precisely on the counter.
At the same time, alarmed by his wife's shouting, Li Dazhu ran out of the kitchen, intending to chase after Yuan Ming, but his wife stopped him.
Upon learning that Yuan Ming had casually left behind a silver ingot, Li Dazhu was greatly surprised and even more puzzled to see the untouched fermented rice balls.
"What a strange man," he murmured, watching Yuan Ming's retreating figure.
...
Fifteen minutes later, at Yuan Mansion.
Anxious for his parents, Yuan Ming was about to enter through the main gate when he suddenly furrowed his brows and stopped.
A sense of being watched rose within him, and without hesitation, he released his Divine Sense to search the area, quickly locating a Qi Refinement cultivator in green robes in a nearby alley.
The cultivator was carrying a Concealing Talisman, thinking himself well-hidden, but he couldn't fool Yuan Ming's Divine Sense.
Yuan Ming felt a familiar Mana from the man and instantly knew he was a disciple of the Chang Chun Temple. His heart sank with displeasure, but he didn't lash out. Instead, he deceived the cultivator with an Illusion Technique and leaped into Yuan Mansion.
Without alerting anyone, he stealthily made his way to the entrance of the study, and before he got too close, he saw Fu Qing standing vigilantly at the door.
"Commander Fu, is my father inside?" Yuan Ming removed his disguise and approached directly.
Fu Qing, sensing someone approaching, became irritable, but upon hearing the voice realized something was off. Looking up, he saw it was Yuan Ming, and, rubbing his eyes in disbelief, called out.
"Young master? Is it really you?" he exclaimed.
Yuan Ming nodded with a smile, about to speak, when a noise came from behind Fu Qing in the study.
With a creak, the door opened, and Yuan Zuochong stepped out briskly, giving Yuan Ming a thorough look. At first, he was overjoyed, but then his expression turned sorrowful.
"Ming'er, you shouldn't have come back!" he sighed deeply.
Frowning, Yuan Ming, recalling the Chang Chun Temple disciple guarding the gate, asked immediately, "Father, what has happened at home these years I've been away, and why is there a Chang Chun Temple cultivator outside? Is it still about the State Preceptor's business?"
"Alas, now is not the time to discuss this. Ming'er, you must quickly leave through the secret passage before the others from Chang Chun Temple arrive. They mustn't catch you. Commander Fu, lead him away now, I'll go to the main hall. If people from Chang Chun Temple come, I will try to delay them," Yuan Zuochong said hastily.
Fu Qing nodded and took the orders, but Yuan Ming, like a specter, swiftly moved in front of Yuan Zuochong, speaking calmly:Note: Check * for any corrections.
"Father, don't panic. I was aware of being watched as I entered the mansion, but didn't let them notice me. Chang Chun Temple doesn't know I'm back yet."
"Ming'er, you must not be careless. Now there is a Core Formation Elder from Chang Chun Temple stationed in the Capital, and his methods are formidable; you won't be able to deceive him," Yuan Zuochong hurriedly said.
Unexpectedly, Yuan Ming suddenly smiled, showed a hint of his aura to his father, and then opened his mouth to summon the Soul Destroying Sword.
"Father worries too much, it's just Core Formation after all. If I wish to deceive him, he will definitely not notice," Yuan Ming said with a smile.
"Ming'er, have you also reached Core Formation?" Staring at the Soul Destroying Sword, Yuan Zuochong widened his eyes, his face filled with disbelief.
"It's been some time, but I was entangled with some trivial matters and couldn't return home in time, please forgive me, Father," Yuan Ming said.
A mix of emotions flickered across Yuan Zuochong's face—excitement, relief, and even a hint of envy.
In the study, Yuan Ming sat opposite his father and began to recount his experiences over the years.
Yuan Zuochong listened silently, his eyes filled with surprise, and when he heard about Zuo Qinghui's visit and threats, which led to Yuan Ming having no choice but to kill him, a complex expression flashed in his eyes, and his emotions shifted.
"Was that Chang Chun Temple Core Formation Elder named Zuo Qinghui really killed by you, Ming'er?" Yuan Zuochong suddenly asked.
"Indeed, Father, your question suggests that you knew about this beforehand? Could it be that Chang Chun Temple has also found out?" Yuan Ming was no fool; hearing his father's question, he immediately realized something.
"Since your departure, Chang Chun Temple appointed another Foundation Establishment cultivator as State Preceptor. I have put down my responsibilities and no longer handle government affairs. He has no intention of becoming enemies with the Yuan Family and has kept to his side of the bargain," Yuan Zuochong explained.
Yuan Ming listened silently, not interrupting or speaking, just listened as Yuan Zuochong paused before continuing:
"However, six years ago, he suddenly visited me and repeatedly mentioned wanting to meet you, but I turned him away each time. He didn't say much openly, but since then, more cultivators have been surveilling our Mansion. They think they're well-hidden, but I, who have had military experience, still have that power of observation. At the time, I was puzzled as to why they suddenly took an interest in finding you."
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming's face remained calm as he watched Yuan Zuochong.
"I wanted to leverage my connections to inquire, but even the letters to and from were controlled by them, so I couldn't obtain any useful information. Until one day, a Jade Scroll suddenly appeared in my study, stating that a Chang Chun Temple elder had mysteriously disappeared and they suspected it was you, Ming'er. Therefore, they dispatched another Core Formation Elder to investigate this matter fully. That Core Formation Elder is now in charge of the Capital, overseeing the surveillance of Yuan Mansion; it was his idea to wait and catch you," said Yuan Zuochong.
At this, a trace of emotion momentarily flickered in Yuan Ming's eyes.
"At first, I thought there was something more to the matter, and that Chang Chun Temple was just looking for an excuse to make things difficult for you, Ming'er, but it turns out that it really was you who killed him," Yuan Zuochong said with a wry smile.
Hearing this, Yuan Ming also sighed helplessly. Killing Zuo Qinghui had been a last resort, and although he had predicted that Chang Chun Temple would eventually find out, he had not expected that in failing to find him, they would resort to targeting his parents.
Not to mention that his parents had long resided in the Capital, even the Iron Law of separation between immortal and mortal was utterly disregarded by Chang Chun Temple, which was truly outrageous.
"Aside from surveillance, has Chang Chun Temple taken any other actions?" Yuan Ming asked with concern.
"Under the cover of night, they've secretly infiltrated the mansion several times, retreating after a search. Uncle Fu and I discovered them on a few occasions, but they hardly cared," Yuan Zuochong recalled, a flash of anger in his eyes.
"What about the Imperial Family lineage within Chang Chun Temple? Did they not respond?" Yuan Ming asked expressionlessly.
"Considering this involves a Core Formation Elder, they might not find it easy to openly oppose. However, I suspect that the Jade Scroll that appeared in my study was left by someone from the Imperial Family lineage," Yuan Zuochong said.
He paused, then with some worry, advised, "Ming'er, although you have achieved Core Formation, you're still alone against a powerful entity like Chang Chun Temple. It's best not to confront them directly; in my opinion, you should leave quickly. Your mother and I would understand."
"Father, after so many years out there, I've come to realize a few truths; running and hiding won't lead to peace. With a Sect like Chang Chun Temple, the more you give in, the more they will push. Only by showing a strength that they fear can we sit down and have a proper discussion," Yuan Ming said calmly, glancing at the white hairs at Yuan Zuochong's temples.
Yuan Zuochong opened his mouth as if to say something, but before he could speak, Yuan Ming's tone grew firmer:
"Besides, their humiliating treatment of you and mother shows they no longer take us seriously. If I leave today and they lose their patience, what if they do something even more despicable? How would that be handled?"
Yuan Zuochong grimaced and remained silent at these words.
"They are looking for me, right? Fine, I won't hide. I'll return home openly. If they want an explanation for Zuo Qinghui's death, I also have my grievances about Zuo Qinghui belittling me and trying to force me into servitude!" A flash of cold light appeared in Yuan Ming's eyes.
Seeing Yuan Ming like this, Yuan Zuochong was half relieved and half worried, still advising, "Chang Chun Temple is powerful, Ming'er. You must not act rashly."
"Don't worry, Father, I will not act blindly," Yuan Ming nodded in assurance.
Seeing Yuan Ming's composed demeanor, not swayed by anger, Yuan Zuochong felt slightly reassured and began to talk about the household matters of the past twenty years.
Older people tend to become a bit long-winded, but Yuan Ming didn't find it tedious at all. He listened attentively, occasionally chiming in with playful comments, making Yuan Zuochong laugh heartily.
The father and son were enjoying their conversation, so much so that they lost track of time, until the sound of a door creaking open interrupted their exchange.

chapters.title: Chapter 463 - 440: Mountains and Rivers Eventually End
chapters.content:
"Zuo Chong, tomorrow you..." As Yuan Ming's mother spoke, she walked into the study. The moment her eyes met Yuan Ming's, she froze.
Yuan Ming's mother had no talent for cultivation and had always been an ordinary person. Once a woman of outstanding beauty, she could not escape the ravages of time. Her skin was no longer smooth and tender; her figure had become somewhat thin. Wrinkles crawled across her forehead and the corners of her eyes, and her once black hair now bore many strands of white.
She looked at Yuan Ming, her body trembling, unable to speak. Tears fell in large drops, quickly soaking her cheeks.
She slowly walked towards Yuan Ming, carefully touching his cheek with her hand, not daring to apply any pressure, as if afraid that everything she was seeing was just a dream, that she might awaken if she pressed too hard.
Yuan Ming grasped his mother's hand on his cheek, feeling the warmth coming from her palm. Many words welled up within him, but in the end, they all condensed into a simple phrase.
"Mother, I am back."
...
"Elder Cha, a disciple responsible for surveilling Yuan Mansion has come to report that Yuan Ming has returned home," a middle-aged man in a purple gold Daoist robe reported respectfully to a Core Formation female cultivator at the center of Chang Chun Temple in Qujiang City.
The man was the new State Preceptor from Chang Chun Temple, named Miao Qing. His cultivation level was much higher than Master Yu Hu's, even reaching the peak of Foundation Establishment.
In Da Jin Country, the title of State Preceptor might sound impressive, but for a cultivation sect like Chang Chun Temple, it essentially made no difference from being a steward in charge of external affairs.
In Chang Chun Temple, any cultivator with a bit of talent would not want this position, but ironically, it was an important one. In a way, it acted as the face of Chang Chun Temple; thus, one needed certain connections and skills to hold it.
Fortunately, Chang Chun Temple had no shortage of Foundation Establishment disciples with decent backgrounds but lacking in talent.
Master Yu Hu was such a person, and so was Miao Qing.
However, compared to Yu Hu, who was only at the early stage of Foundation Establishment, Miao Qing's former identity and status had been much higher.
He was the only son of an elder with the surname Miao in Chang Chun Temple, destined for an unlimited future but during an exploration of a secret realm, he was severely injured, damaging his foundation permanently, making it impossible to ever break through to Core Formation.
Without a choice, he extinguished his aspirations for further advancement and started handling the sect's mundane affairs. Due to his exceptional methods, he earned the admiration of several Core Formation elders.
After Master Yu Hu perished, there had been relentless disputes within Chang Chun Temple about who would take over as the next State Preceptor.
Candidates from the Imperial Family line were certainly not considered, as the position of State Preceptor was originally created to limit the power of the Imperial Family; having one of their own in the role would be completely counterproductive.
Yet, apart from the Imperial Family line, there were very few who were willing to take over the mess left by Yu Hu.
What Yu Hu did was supposedly for the good of the young Emperor Liu Tianming, but in reality, it was an indirect suppression of the Imperial Family's authority. If it had been successful, it might have been fine, but now, not only had he failed, but he had also tarnished the reputation of the State Preceptor.
Stepping into this role now would not only attract targeted opposition from the Imperial Family line, but any minor mishap could further deteriorate the public's perception of Chang Chun Temple.
In such conditions, Miao Qing was pushed into the role, selected by several elders together, taking over this hot potato.
The elders didn't intend to target him; after all, if he could turn a bad situation into a good one, the prestige and benefits he could gain were incomparable to those from a hundred good postings.
However, Miao Qing was much more pragmatic than them. After taking office, he strictly adhered to the principle of 'do no wrong by doing nothing'. Besides the duties he had already agreed to, he didn't concern himself with anything else, epitomizing the policy of non-involvement.
As it turned out, his strategy was effective. After the initial troubles had passed, hardly anyone cared how well he performed as State Preceptor.
If nothing unexpected happened, he simply had to complete thirty years in office to arrange a transfer to manage the Cultivators' Market near Qujiang City, where real benefits awaited.
Unfortunately, an anomaly occurred six years ago.
"Why didn't the disciple at the city gate report this, instead of the one responsible for surveillance?" the Core Formation female cultivator opened her eyes and asked calmly upon hearing Miao Qing's words.
She had phoenix eyes, her eyebrows curved like the crescent moon, her lips as red as fire, and a blue robe outlined her shapely figure, stunningly alluring.
Hanging from both of her ears were blue jade earrings wrapped in a faint spirit light, with runes faintly flickering, looking quite extraordinary.
"This... perhaps Yuan Ming disguised himself when entering the city, and they failed to recognize him in time," Miao Qing replied, bowing his head.
"Didn't I issue a magic artifact that could see through disguises? It's just carelessness after all. Pass down my order, deduct their monthly allowances, and award each of them ten whippings with a magic whip as punishment," Elder Cha said placidly.Always read from the source: *.
Miao Qing quickly nodded in agreement, though he couldn't help sighing internally.
The disciples responsible for surveillance and guarding were merely refining Qi, while Yuan Ming had already been at Foundation Establishment when he left the Capital. After nearly twenty years outside, his cultivation might have improved. Even if those disciples had magic artifacts, it would be easy for Yuan Ming to deceive them, and it wasn't really the fault of those Qi Refining disciples.
But these thoughts he dared only keep to himself, not daring to voice them to this "impartial and stern" elder.
"Moreover, since Yuan Ming has already returned home, withdraw the personnel arranged elsewhere and redeploy them outside Yuan Mansion. Go there personally and bring Yuan Ming to see me," Elder Cha commanded.
Miao Qing sighed deeply, unwilling in his heart, but under the pressure of Elder Cha, he could only nod and agree, turning to make the arrangements.
The night deepened.
Yuan Ming, already feeling sleepy, sent his mother back to her room and had a long talk with his father before returning to his own cottage.
The furnishings inside the cottage were exactly as he had left them, despite the lapse of twenty years, still immaculate.
Yuan Ming looked around the cottage, feeling a wave of nostalgia, but he knew that now was not the time to reminisce about the past; he needed to clarify the intentions and movements of Chang Chun Temple as soon as possible.
Soon, Yuan Ming took out a Sound Transmission Talisman from his Storage Bag and silently began casting.
"Your Majesty, I have returned to the Capital and found that an elder of the Chang Chun Temple is monitoring from outside because of Zuo Qinghui's matter. How much do you know about this, and can you share the details with me?" Yuan Ming whispered to the talisman.
A blue light rose from the talisman, but it dimmed after a moment, seemingly having transmitted Yuan Ming's message to another corresponding talisman.
However, the talisman in Yuan Ming's hand lit up again shortly after, and Liu Tianming's voice emerged, but it only contained one phrase:
"Tianming Book Society's backyard, landscapes eventually end."
Following that, the talisman turned to ash and floated away.
Yuan Ming's brow twitched, and he silently thought to himself, as expected.
The content of the Jade Scroll on his father's desk was simple, yet only someone from the Chang Chun Temple could know such precise information; among the imperial lineage, only the Emperor, Liu Tianming, could have such closeness to his Yuan family.
As the saying goes, new ruler, new subjects; even Liu Tianming's grandfather, the Emperor, did not pay much attention to Yuan Ming and Yuan Zuochong.
However, Yuan Ming did not expect that Liu Tianming was also in the capital, and the meeting place was set at the Tianming Book Society; using coded communication might indicate he had sneaked out for this very occasion and it was not convenient to meet face to face.
As Yuan Ming was pondering, a sudden knock came from outside the cottage.
"Young Master, the State Preceptor Miao Qing has come to visit and wishes to see you," Fu Qing's voice came from outside.
"...Tell him that I went out to handle some affairs in the market and am not currently at home. Ask him to come again tomorrow," Yuan Ming murmured and then instructed.
"Yes," Fu Qing responded and started to leave.
"Hold on, if he doesn't believe it and insists on seeing me, let him wait in the front hall. Just tell him I have been informed and will return shortly. Make sure not to disturb my parents," Yuan Ming suddenly recalled and swiftly opened the door to stop Fu Qing, adding to his instructions.
"Understood," Fu Qing nodded.
Watching Fu Qing leave, Yuan Ming contemplated the purpose of Miao Qing's visit.
After reuniting with his parents, he had not deliberately concealed his identity, and hence many servants in the mansion knew of his return.
If the person watching the house was not blind, he would certainly notice such developments; moreover, it was yet unknown whether any of the servants were mundane spies from the Chang Chun Temple.
While an ordinary cultivator might not value the role of mortals, a State Preceptor at the heart of Da Jin's politics certainly would not overlook these secular methods.
Master Yu Hu was one example.
Regardless of how Miao Qing had learned of his return or the purpose of his visit, Yuan Ming had no intention of dealing with him.
Any response would have to wait until he met with Liu Tianming.
...
Thirty minutes later, at Tianming Book Society.
Disguised, Yuan Ming evaded the Chang Chun Temple cultivators monitoring Yuan Mansion and quietly arrived at the already closed Tianming Book Society's backyard.
Many rooms in the backyard were still lit; the bookstore's workers were proofreading typeset by candlelight, printing the next batch of books for sale.
Yuan Ming scanned the bookstore with his Divine Sense and quickly located the residence of the shopkeeper.
He walked up and knocked on the door, and soon an elderly shopkeeper, over fifty years old, quietly opened the door and, seeing a stranger standing outside, showed a surprised expression.
"Who are you?"
"Landscapes eventually end," Yuan Ming said calmly, without removing his disguise, stating the coded language.
Upon hearing this, the shopkeeper's surprised expression quickly vanished, and he opened the door a bit wider to let Yuan Ming in.
"Strangers meet in the strangest places. Please come this way, our lord has been waiting for you for a long time," the shopkeeper said softly, and swiftly walked to the wall, removing a book from the shelf.
With a soft sound, the floor slowly opened, revealing a flight of stairs leading down.
Yuan Ming walked composedly towards the basement. The shopkeeper did not follow, but after Yuan Ming had descended, he closed the secret passage again.
The staircase was not long, but at the end, a stone door engraved with a forbidden rune blocked the way. Before Yuan Ming could react, the door slowly opened, and Liu Tianming, all smiles, came out to greet him.

chapters.title: Chapter 464 - 441: The Urge to Kill
chapters.content:
"Brother Ming, it's really been a long time since we've seen each other, almost twenty years without contact. I thought you had forgotten about me," Liu Tianming said with a smile.
"Your Majesty is too kind. I've always been entangled in trivial matters, and after several turns, I ended up in the Black Wind Desert, truly having no time at all," Yuan Ming replied with a bitter smile.
"Never mind, never mind, I was just speaking offhand. You've been alone outside, and cultivation isn't easy after all. How could I hold this against you? Besides, I've been a former monarch for quite some time now, so there is no need to address me as Your Majesty. It feels strange, just call me Tianming," Liu Tianming said as he led Yuan Ming into the house to sit down.
This underground stone house seemed not to have been built in haste. The space inside was not small, large enough to accommodate dozens of people living here, and it was furnished with all kinds of furniture, all of which bore the signs of use. It seemed that someone had lived here for a considerable time.
"When I was in power, I wanted to turn this place into a secret base for our agents. The framework had just been set up when I inadvertently stepped onto the Immortal Path and had to leave it unfinished. I didn't expect it would come in handy now," Liu Tianming explained upon seeing Yuan Ming's curiosity about the stone house.
Yuan Ming nodded and, noticing Liu Tianming fetching a jar of wine from who knows where, asked, "Tianming, it seems you have reached the peak of Foundation Establishment. Why not stay in the Chang Chun Temple and cultivate diligently, striving for an early breakthrough to Core Formation? Did you come to the Capital also regarding the matter of Zuo Qinghui?"
"Haha, you can't hide anything from Brother Ming! Indeed, I came for this matter, but the issue with Zuo Qinghui might be somewhat different from what you think."
"At first, when Zuo Qinghui disappeared, nobody took it seriously. After all, he was just an ordinary Core Formation Elder with modest cultivation, and he was old. He had only been missing for a little over ten years, and usually, even his disciples didn't see him much in the sect, let alone other elders. It was even possible they wouldn't notice he had gone missing."
"However, Cha Yancai, the elder responsible for thoroughly investigating this matter in the Capital seems to have had some private dealings with Zuo Qinghui. It was she who first reported to the sect that Zuo Qinghui was missing, and she even claimed with certainty, despite lacking evidence, that Zuo Qinghui must have been murdered."
"For some reason, the sect suddenly took this matter very seriously and assigned Cha Yancai to thoroughly investigate it. They ultimately traced it back to you, but they were still unable to find conclusive evidence that Zuo Qinghui had been killed by you. Cha Yancai spent years unable to trace your whereabouts and later came up with the distasteful idea of using your parents as leverage. However, with me manoeuvring within the temple and lobbying several Core Formation Elders of the Imperial Family lineage, in the end, they only monitored and searched without using any other means," Liu Tianming said as he poured wine for himself and Yuan Ming.
Hearing that a Chang Chun Temple elder had once thought of harming his parents, Yuan Ming's expression darkened. Then, he stood up and solemnly bowed to Liu Tianming, expressing his gratitude:
"Ah, Tianming, I really owe you for this one. Otherwise, I dare not think of what might have happened."
Liu Tianming waved his hand dismissively: "It's actually a minor thing. Those old fellows also have their own descendants. If they were to set a precedent for harming relatives, they too would suffer the consequences in the future. Besides, there was a dispute about this within the temple itself. Many elders disagreed with that approach. I merely went with the flow."
"Moreover, so many years have passed; to be honest, aside from Cha Yancai, there are not many now within the temple who still pay attention to this matter. They are much more concerned about the recently emerged Shura Palace," Liu Tianming continued.
"But, Brother Ming, give it to me straight – did you kill Zuo Qinghui?"
Yuan Ming raised his cup: "He died by my hand, indeed, but it was accidental. He took an interest in my ability to earn Spirit Stones, wishing to make me his servant. At first, he underestimated me, and I seriously injured him using a formation. Yet, he still retained formidable combat power. I nearly exhausted all my means before finally defeating him and killing him."The reference version of this on *.
Hearing this, Liu Tianming was surprised and repeatedly praised Yuan Ming for his formidable strength.
After drinking together for a while, Liu Tianming suddenly asked, "By the way, Brother Ming, you mentioned you ended up in the Black Wind Desert. If I remember correctly, the Shura Palace also appeared there. Do you know the inside story?"
"Not only do I know about it, but I even entered it myself. Fortunately, with the protection of the Nascent Soul Ancestor from the Spirit Talisman Sect, I was able to come out unscathed," Yuan Ming said, partly in truth and partly fabrication.
"Ah? I heard that a peerless devil emerged from within the Shura Palace. Except for the Nascent Soul Ancestor from the Spirit Talisman Sect, only a few lucky individuals who managed to take treasures and leave early survived. I didn't expect you, Brother Ming, to also be involved? Tell me, what exactly happened inside?" Liu Tianming asked with even greater surprise and curiosity.
Yuan Ming found himself obliged to narrate his experiences briefly but only up to the battle for the Spiritual Treasures on the third layer of the high tower. Afterwards, he lied, claiming he was thrown out of the Shura Palace by Golden Dawn Fairy and knew nothing about what happened later.
Sometimes, knowing too much is not a good thing. Yuan Ming might soon be facing the Wuyue Sect, and if Liu Tianming were to learn of this, he would certainly get involved. Since he had not yet reached Core Formation, it was better not to get involved.
"…So that's how it was. To think so much happened within the Shura Palace. Sigh, it's also fortunate that you were thrown out at that time; otherwise, you might have been in trouble as well, given that even Ancestor Wan Qi met his end in there, the danger was unimaginable," Liu Tianming reflected after hearing Yuan Ming's account.
"Oh, and do you know how Golden Dawn Fairy managed to survive in the end?" Yuan Ming asked, pretending to be casual.
"How would I know about that? I've merely heard that even the Supreme Grand Elder, who had long been in seclusion, was stirred by this event. He personally took action, joining forces with the Five Thunder Sect and the Guiyuan Sect's ancestors to approach the Spirit Talisman Sect for inquiries, and they have yet to return," Liu Tianming said.
Yuan Ming nodded silently, contemplating the possible countermeasures that Golden Dawn Fairy might have taken.
So many Nascent Soul cultivators died because of the Shura Palace incident. If Golden Dawn Fairy couldn't give a good explanation, she probably wouldn't get off easily.
But soon, he shrugged it off with a self-deprecating laugh. Having dealt with Nascent Soul cultivators for so long, he had almost forgotten that he was just a minor Core Formation cultivator. As long as Golden Dawn Fairy did not expose his identity, no one would associate the deaths of the Nascent Soul cultivators with him.
"Since no one is paying attention to the matter of Zuo Qinghui's disappearance anymore, Tianming, why don't you return to Chang Chun Temple?" After some thought, Yuan Ming shifted the conversation back.
"Ah, it's all for the sake of finding an opportunity to break through to Core Formation. To be honest, I'm puzzled. Isn't it said that Brother Ming, your talent is lacking? How come you not only have superior methods but also reached Core Formation faster than I did?" Liu Tianming rolled his eyes, asking in confusion.
"Hehe, I was just lucky. I found a treasure in the Southern Border, and later, in the Black Wind Desert, I was able to make use of a specialty there, the Insect Pill," Yuan Ming didn't elaborate.
His ascension to Core Formation was something he couldn't hide. Rather than trying to conceal it, he simply acknowledged openly that he had encountered an opportunity in the Southern Border.
While it was enviable to be able to make use of the Insect Pill through such an opportunity, it wasn't of much use to Core Formation Cultivators. Besides, with his current strength, even a Nascent Soul Early Stage wouldn't necessarily be able to detain him.
"The Southern Border, huh... Well, if there's a chance, I may also take a look. Maybe I'll find my own opportunity," Tianming said thoughtfully.
"That's a good idea. If you run into any trouble there, just call me over. I have some acquaintances there who can help you out a lot," Yuan Ming nodded.
"Hehe, don't worry, I won't be shy if I really need it."
Liu Tianming chuckled twice, raised his cup to clink with Yuan Ming's, and then both of them drank their wine in one gulp.
"But although most people in the temple no longer care about Zuo Qinghui's disappearance, Brother Ming, you still shouldn't be careless," Liu Tianming took a deep breath, caressing his cup before speaking again.
"Oh? How so?" Yuan Ming placed his cup down and asked.
"It's still about Cha Yancai's issue; this woman has a cruel temperament and is extremely strict with her subordinates. During the Foundation Establishment Stage, she even caused a scandal where a disciple was pressured to death. It caused quite an uproar at the time, but ultimately, her master suppressed the incident. Since then, even though she has restrained her temper quite a bit, her persistent and severe approach to things hasn't changed, and only after she broke through to Core Formation and stopped handling mundane affairs did the news about her decrease," Liu Tianming said.
"Sounds like a tough nut to crack," Yuan Ming mused.
"Indeed, and moreover, she seems to have had a personal relationship with Zuo Qinghui. They were quite close, so even up to now, Cha Yancai is still obsessed with this matter and refuses to give up," Liu Tianming put down his cup as well and said.
"Speaking of which, I also have some doubts. While it's true that Zuo Qinghui died by my hand, with no witnesses and no evidence, Zuo Qinghui's disciples didn't realize it immediately; why is Cha Yancai so certain it has something to do with me?" Yuan Ming asked again.
"Actually, there are two main reasons; one is that before his death, Zuo Qinghui used his connections to inquire about you, and the second is because of the clerk from your Spiritual Fragrance Shop," Liu Tianming said.
"Hu Tu? Or Mu Yang?" Yuan Ming's brows furrowed.
Liu Tianming nodded: "Both were caught by Cha Yancai. She once personally visited Little Lake City in Thunder Continent, there she pinpointed your false identity, Hagon, and then followed the trail, eventually finding Hu Tu and the others. After being captured, Cha Yancai tortured them for information, and they quickly caved under the pressure, spilling everything about you and mentioned that after you left with Zuo Qinghui, you never showed up again."
"Are Hu Tu and the others still alive?" Yuan Ming suddenly asked.
"They are just minor characters, Cha Yancai didn't pay much attention to them. Although they are still alive, they've been reduced to almost invalids," Liu Tianming sighed.
Hearing this, Yuan Ming clenched his fists tightly.
He didn't blame Hu Tu and his accomplice for revealing information, as they were merely Qi Refinement cultivators, without any power to resist against a Core Formation being.
But what did they have to do with Zuo Qinghui's death? Now, simply because of their association with him, they had been tortured into invalids. Yuan Ming felt a sense of guilt and his killing intent towards Cha Yancai intensified.
"As I said, the idea of using your parents as leverage was also first proposed by Cha Yancai. Although I managed to persuade her otherwise, and it was not adopted by the other Core Formation Elders, given her unscrupulous nature in achieving her goals, she might take matters into her own hands. I'm still in the Capital primarily to prevent the worst-case scenario," Liu Tianming said.
Yuan Ming fell silent for a moment, then suddenly said, "What if Cha Yancai also died, who would Chang Chun Temple send to investigate?"
"Brother Ming, I advise you not to entertain such thoughts. The Imperial Family's influence in the Chang Chun Temple isn't strong. The death of a Zuo Qinghui could still withstand the pressure, but if Cha Yancai were to die as well, they might not be willing to exonerate you anymore. By then, you could really end up on Chang Chun Temple's wanted list, pursued relentlessly," Liu Tianming was startled by Yuan Ming's words, spilling some of the wine he'd just raised in his cup, and immediately advised him.
"So what if that happens? I haven't been idle these years outside; if they dare come after me, they'd better be ready to join Cha Yancai in the afterlife," Yuan Ming's eyes flashed coldly, calmly refilling Liu Tianming's cup, while saying this.

chapters.title: Chapter 465 - 442: Escape
chapters.content:
Liu Tianming was surprised by Yuan Ming's attitude, but compared to that, he was even more confused about Yuan Ming's current strength.
"Brother Ming, tell me the truth, what is your cultivation level now?" Liu Tianming filled Yuan Ming's cup and asked.
"My cultivation is still at the Core Formation Stage, but I have several heavy treasures in my hand. Even if a Nascent Soul arrives, I can protect myself," Yuan Ming picked up his cup and slowly drank.
Liu Tianming was so shocked he couldn't speak. If he hadn't known that Yuan Ming was never the type to boast, he would have thought Yuan Ming was bragging.
However, soon he became worried again. No matter how bad Chang Chun Temple was, it was still his sect. Moreover, if things continued to develop like this, and Yuan Ming killed too many Core Formation Stage cultivators, the elders from the Imperial Family lineage couldn't possibly stand by idly. His great-grandfathers and great-great-grandfathers might even end up fighting to the death with Yuan Ming, which would be troublesome.
"Sigh, Brother Ming, even if just for my sake, let's not kill Cha Yancai yet… at least not now. She is currently responsible for investigating the connection between you and Zuo Qinghui's death. If something happens, everyone will think it was you," Liu Tianming sighed and said.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming looked up at Liu Tianming but did not speak.
"If it really comes to that, you need to think of a method that won't expose you, at least not let people connect it to you," Liu Tianming said with a bitter smile.
Yuan Ming nodded slightly, "Fine, I'll spare her life for now. However, my return this time was actually just to relocate my parents out of the Capital, to find a secluded place for them, to avoid being targeted by enemies. I didn't expect Chang Chun Temple to act so hastily.
"Well, that's a good plan. But, Brother Ming, have you chosen a place to hide? Not to boast, but the Central Plains are vast and there's hardly a place that Chang Chun Temple can't reach. If the location isn't well chosen and Cha Yancai finds it, it will be troublesome," Liu Tianming said worriedly.
"This… is indeed a problem. After all, it's also the place where my parents will reside for a long time. I still need to consider their opinion," Yuan Ming also seemed troubled.
"I see… Otherwise, Brother Ming, why don't you take them to the East Sea? I have some connections with the son of the Island Master of Thousand Dragon Island, and I can help you find a good location within the domain of Thousand Dragon Island. You could first take General Yuan and his wife out of the Capital, travel by water to Haomiao, and set out to sea. As an elder of Chang Chun Temple, Cha Yancai won't likely venture to the East Sea casually without important matters, or she would be seen as hostile by the sects there, and you would be able to rest easy," Liu Tianming thought for a moment, then suddenly suggested.
"The East Sea? From what I recall, because of the issue with Three Immortals Island, the situation there is somewhat chaotic. It hardly seems like a peaceful place," Yuan Ming hesitated.
"Ah, Brother Ming, you don't understand the situation, the East Sea is the region with the most loose cultivators among the Five Regions of Yunhuang. Though it seems chaotic, it's relatively speaking, due mainly to the conflicts among loose cultivators. The territories governed by the great sects there barely have any disputes. And most importantly, they are extremely open to loose cultivators. Even if you don't join them, as long as you abide by their rules, you can find a place to rest and recuperate under their jurisdiction. Although it's not as resource-rich as the Central Plains, its bustling level is not inferior, and it's even more lively," Liu Tianming explained, waving his hand.
Yuan Ming nodded thoughtfully, showing a trace of interest.
"Besides, Mrs. Yuan is also getting older. Though the Capital is bustling, the spirit veins are not of high quality, and Thousand Dragon Island has many islands with abundant spirit veins. Going to the East Sea, you can choose for yourself. If you find a place with excellent spirit veins, even if you can't cultivate immortality, you can still extend your life. Perhaps General Yuan might also breakthrough the Foundation Establishment Heavenly Barrier," Liu Tianming enthusiastically recommended.
Liu Tianming's words indeed struck a chord with Yuan Ming, making him nod repeatedly, saying he would discuss this with his parents when he got back.
The two then talked for a while longer, ironing out some details, and they no longer dwelt on these distressing matters. Instead, they drank and laughed together, sharing anecdotes and experiences of the recent years, until dawn when Yuan Ming finally bid his farewell and left.
...
In the front hall of Yuan Mansion, Miao Qing put down his iced tea, which he had refilled countless times, and couldn't help showing some anger on his face.
Since his foundation had been damaged, he had adopted the creed of being kind to others, always greeting even loose cultivators with a smile, never initiating conflicts with anyone.
However, even with such a temperament, sitting here drinking iced tea all night, it was hard to avoid feeling irritated.
After all, he was the Great Jin National Master from Chang Chun Temple, a late-stage Foundation Establishment cultivator. Even if Yuan Ming had the capability to kill Yu Hu years ago, he wasn't Yu Hu after all. Being so discourteous was really annoying.
However, rather than being angry, Miao Qing was more worried about how Cha Yancai would react when he went back.
Given Cha Yancai's personality, even if Yuan Ming was intentionally avoiding him, as long as he didn't bring the man back, a hat of incompetence was sure to be slapped on him. This was the main reason he preferred to endure the long wait here.
Although Cha Yancai wouldn't punish him as she would a common disciple, just listening to her scolding was painful enough.
As Miao Qing was considering whether he should actively try to force Yuan Ming to show up, suddenly footsteps approached from outside.
Miao Qing's eyebrows raised, and he promptly stood up to look toward the doorway.
With his hearing, he could naturally distinguish the identity of the person by the footsteps; it was neither the surname Fu's guard nor a servant coming to refill the tea.
Just as he expected, the footsteps soon stopped in front of the door, and the Yuan Ming he had been waiting for all night finally appeared before him.
"The National Master has honored us with your presence. Forgive me for not coming out to meet you," said Yuan Ming politely, but he merely gestured with his hand casually, not waiting for Miao Qing to respond, and directly sat down in the main seat.
A flicker of anger passed through Miao Qing's eyes, but when he sensed the fluctuations of spiritual energy far surpassing his own from Yuan Ming, a smile reappeared on his face.
"Haha, I have long heard that Young Master Yuan is accomplished beyond his years. Now seeing you in person, the reputation is well deserved. So young and yet already in the Core Formation Realm, truly enviable indeed," Miao Qing laughed.
"The State Preceptor overpraises me. If it had not been for Master Yu Hu plotting against me, causing me to be stranded in the Southern Border, I might not have achieved what I have today. Speaking of this, I should, in fact, be grateful for the grace of Chang Chun Temple," Yuan Ming replied with a smile that did not reach his eyes.
Miao Qing's smile froze once more, knowing Yuan Ming would not show him any goodwill, so he cut straight to the point without beating around the bush.
"I wonder if Young Master Yuan has heard of the name Zuo Qinghui. He is an elder at our temple in the Core Formation Stage and has been missing for some time. It is said he last met with you before his disappearance. Elder Cha of our temple wishes to inquire about the situation at that time. If Young Master Yuan is available, perhaps you could accompany me now to meet Elder Cha," Miao Qing said, then turned and gestured politely.
"Is that necessary?" Yuan Ming looked up, glancing at Miao Qing nonchalantly.
"...This matter is of great importance. Elder Zuo is closely connected with Elder Cha. If Young Master Yuan does not come, I'm afraid Elder Cha might overthink things, and so might the other elders of our temple," Miao Qing slowly said, his smile fading with a hint of a threat.
"Heh, you misunderstood. I meant that Elder Zuo's disappearance has nothing to do with me. After he met and conversed with me, he left straight away. Where he went afterwards, I have no idea. I have only just returned home after many years, intending to spend more time with my parents. Since these troubles are unrelated to me, why should I bother cooperating?" Yuan Ming said, smiling.
Miao Qing took a deep breath, his expression turning ugly. "Young Master Yuan's word alone cannot serve as proof. Please do not refuse any longer; come with me, and Elder Cha will get to the bottom of this."
"Your Chang Chun Temple suspects I am involved in the disappearance of this so-called Zuo Qinghui, is that not also just a claim from one party? Ha, if Elder Cha Yancai wants me to go, that is fine. But only if you provide concrete evidence that Zuo Qinghui's disappearance is indeed related to me will I cooperate with the investigation. Otherwise, please do not disturb my reunion with my parents. Sorry, but I won't see you out," Yuan Ming said, standing up and sweeping his sleeve as he walked out.
Miao Qing watched Yuan Ming leave with an iron blue complexion, then stood in the room pondering for a moment before suddenly striking his chest with mana.The r&ef#eren$c.e v-e!r#sion% of this* cha*p@ter! is on M^*-V#*L-EMPY&R*.
Immediately, his body flew uncontrollably out of the house, even breaking through the door, rolling on the ground once before barely stopping.
Outside, Yuan Ming, who had not gone far, looked up to see Miao Qing flying out and was momentarily startled.
"I tried to persuade you kindly, yet Young Master Yuan is so domineering. Today's events, I will report in full detail to Elder Cha, and then let her personally question Young Master Yuan," Miao Qing said with a trace of blood on his lips, speaking out loud.
The words had just left his mouth when Miao Qing took out a magic artifact, flew straight away, and sped toward the National Master Mansion.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming merely smiled slightly and did not stop him, continuing onward.
National Master Mansion.
This place, built by several historically famous architects, served as the residence of successive Great Jin National Masters. Whether it was the landscape architecture or the pavilions, towers, and pavilions, each bore an ethereal aura of immortality, and the scenery even surpassed that of the Imperial Palace.
After Yu Hu's death, it naturally became Miao Qing's residence. However, after Cha Yancai's arrival, it had become her temporary dwelling.
