When the seriously injured Miao Qing returned to the National Master Mansion, Cha Yancai had just finished her cultivation practice.
"What about Yuan Ming? You didn't bring him back? And what happened to you, getting hurt like this?" Cha Yancai frowned upon seeing how badly injured Miao Qing was.
At this moment, Miao Qing, with more wounds than when he left Yuan Mansion, did not hide anything from Cha Yancai and relayed Yuan Ming's words verbatim, only slightly glossing over the details at the end.
"...At that moment, Yuan Ming was about to walk away, and I went up to stop him, hoping to persuade him further. But he immediately became furious and attacked me. He has reached Core Formation; I, being no match for him, could only flee for my life, thus failing to bring him back. I ask Elder Cha to punish me," Miao Qing said, looking remorseful.
Upon hearing this, a flash of sharp light appeared in Cha Yancai's eyes, showing an expression that seemed to confirm her suspicions.
Miao Qing was somewhat surprised, but soon after, Cha Yancai composed herself and shook her head slightly.
"It is not your fault that you could not bring back Yuan Ming, who bullied his way out. No punishment is needed. Your injuries are serious, and you need not worry about this matter anymore. Go and rest," she said.
"Thank you, Elder Cha, for your grace," Miao Qing said tearfully, bowing to Cha Yancai before slowly exiting the room.
Cha Yancai watched this scene, her expression subtly shifting.
She knew all too well that Yuan Ming did not cause Miao Qing's injuries.
However, since Miao Qing, being Elder Miao's son, wanted to use this situation to disengage, she did not mind obliging with a favor in return.
Besides, the pretext Miao Qing had set up for his own escape could also be useful to her.
The most pressing matter now was dealing with Yuan Ming. Zuo Qinghui had once mentioned to her about a new money-making doorway that he intended to share with her, promising to return in a few days to discuss it further. However, since then, he had vanished without a trace.
She had been tracking him down and although she had pinpointed Yuan Ming, she always felt that he was not powerful enough.
But now Yuan Ming had advanced to Core Formation. Being a loose cultivator without much talent, where had he gotten the ability to break through so quickly, if not by scheming against Zuo Qinghui and taking his inheritance, thereby achieving his current success?
Cha Yancai felt certain of her suspicions, pondered for another moment, when suddenly a flash of white light enveloped her and in the next instant, she disappeared from the National Master Mansion.

chapters.title: Chapter 466 - 443 I was just defending myself
chapters.content:
Meanwhile, at the Yuan Mansion.
After Miao Qing left, Yuan Ming immediately went to see his parents.
He wasn't particularly concerned about Miao Qing's strange behavior; what really mattered were his parents' thoughts and opinions on leaving the Capital.
Upon hearing Yuan Ming's thoughts, before Yuan Zuochong could speak, Mrs. Yuan took the lead and said:
"Wherever Ming'er goes, I will follow. This time you'd better not think about leaving your mother behind!"
When Yuan Ming heard this, he pursed his lips, a trace of guilt flashing in his eyes.
"That's just your mother's way, don't take it too much to heart. But she's right; as long as the family is together, it doesn't matter where we live. I've also heard about the situation in the East Sea, and I once longed to go there when I was young. I never thought that now, in my old age, I'd actually have the chance to settle down there," Yuan Zuochong said, patting Yuan Ming on the shoulder and laughing.
Yuan Ming looked at his parents with deep emotion. Although they sounded casual, he knew that leaving behind friends and relatives, and the Capital where they had lived for nearly sixty years, was not an easy decision.
His lips moved as if he wanted to say something else, but suddenly, his expression changed.
"Mother, Father, please stay inside the house. No matter what happens outside, don't come out."
Having said that, Yuan Ming quickly walked out of the house, took out the Night Parade of Hundred Demons, and released a group of Core Formation Ghost Slaves, ordering them to guard the house and allow no one to enter.
The ghost slaves immediately complied with the command, burrowing into the ground to conceal their presence.
After making these arrangements, Yuan Ming felt a little more at ease. He looked up to the sky, only to see a streak of light rapidly approaching, hanging over the Yuan Mansion in the blink of an eye.
When the light dissipated, Cha Yancai's figure was revealed.
Her Divine Sense swept unscrupulously over Yuan Mansion, and when she found Yuan Ming, her gaze followed suit and she spoke aloud, "Yuan Ming, your past offense against our temple is hereby overlooked. However, you have not learned your lesson; not only did you injure a disciple of ours, but you even secretly harmed an elder of our temple. The list of your crimes is endless. Now that I am here personally, why not give yourself up without further struggle!"
Her voice spread throughout the alleys and streets of the Capital; the commotion of her arrival had already alerted the city's populace, and now her pronouncement caused the entire Capital to boil over like water reaching a rolling boil.
Yuan Ming's expression darkened, and he flew straight up into the sky as well, his eyes fixed on Cha Yancai, murder boiling in his heart. As he was about to make a move, he remembered Liu Tianming's distressed expression from the previous night and, for the moment, suppressed his anger, saying in a deep voice:
"National Master Miao's injuries were self-inflicted, and I had nothing to do with that, as you well know. As for what happened to Elder Zuo, that's nothing but a fabricated charge. I ask you, on what evidence do you base these accusations?"
"Ha! Evidence? In the whole of Central Plains, no one discusses evidence with Chang Chun Temple," Cha Yancai scoffed, raising her hand without hesitation as an Ice Crystal whip materialized in her palm.
As she clenched her fingers, white frost emerged from the handle of the whip, enveloping both the whip and Cha Yancai's arm in white mist.
Having stepped into the Core Formation Realm nearly a hundred years ago, and only half a step away from reaching the Late-stage Core Formation, she viewed Yuan Ming, no matter how formidable, as merely a junior who had just broken through to Core Formation and a Loose Cultivator at that. How could he be compared with a Sect Cultivator like herself?
Therefore, her intent in coming here was to take action first and report later. Regardless of whether the Imperial Family in the temple wanted to protect Yuan Ming or not, if she killed him, there would be no more trouble.
In the Cultivation World, no one would go to war over a dead man without any value for usage. In her view, aside from Liu Tianming, Yuan Ming did not have any other significant background to take into account.
Upon seeing Cha Yancai making the first move, Yuan Ming sighed heavily, a trace of helplessness crossing his face.
But then, he no longer concealed the murderous intent in his heart—his look towards Cha Yancai was like that of seeing a dead person.
In the next instant, he opened his mouth and spat out the Soul Destroying Sword, which flew from his mouth. While it was still in mid-air, Yuan Ming sent a spell towards it, causing runes on the blade to light up immediately. An invisible force surged toward Cha Yancai, followed closely by a black sword light.
Meanwhile, Cha Yancai swung her right arm, seemingly wanting to activate her Magic Treasure. However, her heart suddenly skipped a beat as an invisible force enveloped her body in an instant, causing her to stiffen.
A look of shock appeared on Cha Yancai's face; for some reason, she felt that she was not facing an early-stage Core Formation Cultivator, but rather a Nascent Soul powerhouse.
At that moment, all thoughts of battle left her, and the only thought that flashed through her mind was to "escape quickly."
Just then, on the eastern side of the Capital, Liu Tianming was hurriedly flying over on his Magic Artifact, while shouting loudly as he channelized his Mana:
"Elder Cha, hold your hand! The temple has sent a message, saying..."This соpy соmеs frоm соntеnt оn М|V|L0ЕМРYR.
Before he could finish his words, from afar, he saw the space above Yuan Mansion, where a black sword light sliced through Cha Yancai's neck. Before he could get close, her headless body fell stiffly to the ground below.
"You're too late," Yuan Ming said to Liu Tianming with a shrug, sounding somewhat helpless.
"Brother Ming, this... well, what do we do now?" Liu Tianming sighed, frustrated as he scratched his head.
"She's already dead, and worrying is useless. Besides, she was the one who attacked first, and to do so this close to my parents... I was just defending myself. I didn't expect her to be so weak," Yuan Ming said, stowing away the Soul Destroying Sword.
"Sigh, those old fellows at the temple just don't care about these things; they'll only feel like you've attacked their pride and will definitely seek reprisal. We need to move up our plans and set out before they can react. Brother Ming, it's imperative that you get your parents to the East Sea as soon as possible, lest you really be stopped and thwarted," Liu Tianming said anxiously.
"Alright, I'll have them pack immediately, and we'll leave at once," Yuan Ming, bolstered by his parents' earlier words, no longer hesitated and promptly replied.
...
About two hours later.
Da Jin Central Continent, Chaotian Mountain Range.
Thin mists enveloped the layered mountains, pierced here and there by dazzling golden light as if hiding a sun within.
Graceful immortal cranes emerged from the mist, their snow-white feathers coated in spirit light; clouds swirled around their bodies, undulating with the beating of their wings, like silk, ethereal and otherworldly.
Amidst the clouds, a series of golden palaces built along the mountains shimmered. With roof tiles of glazed ceramic and bricks of warm jade, materials precious and unseen in the outer world were used here merely for decoration, a sight of splendor and opulence as far as the eye could see.
Between the towers and palaces, cultivators in light purple robes moved to and fro, their gestures exuding cultured ease.
This place was the home of the premier sect of the Central Plains — Chang Chun Temple — whose outer environs alone put nameless small sects like Biluo Cave, even the Shengye Sect, to shame, unable to hold a candle to it.
"Ding--Ding--Ding--"
Suddenly, three solemn bell tolls echoed throughout the sect, surprising the disciples who looked up and exchanged uneasy glances, some of them clearly unsettled.
According to ancestral rules, the Mountain Suppressing Ancient Bell, located at Unblemished Peak, only rang out when an important personage had fallen.
Three tolls meant the death of a Core Formation Elder.
While this was a rare event, it wasn't enough to disturb the disciples to this extent on its own.
The true cause harked back to several months prior.
Then, the bell had tolled four times, the mournful sound for a Nascent Soul cultivator's death lingering amongst the mountains, refusing to fade away.
And now, in less than six months, a Core Formation Elder had fallen.
Even the most blindly loyal disciples of Chang Chun Temple couldn't help but feel a premonition of a storm approaching.
As the bell tolled, within the grand hall at the summit of Unblemished Peak, eleven figures sat around a long table, silently looking at the Jade Scrolls laid before them.
The purple-haired man sitting at the first seat to the right of the table glanced around and, seeing everyone had finished reading the contents of their scrolls, said, "The reason I've called you all here today is to discuss four matters; first is the news from the Capital. Elder Cha, who was in charge of investigating Zuo Qinghui's disappearance, was slain in public by Yuan Ming. Based on Elder Cha's investigation before his death, this matter is not unrelated to Yuan Ming. What do you think we should do about him?"
Core Formation Cultivators don't involve themselves in trivial matters, but when it comes to their own realm or major sect decisions, they do need to step forward and make determinations.
However, with a multitude of Core Formation Elders within Chang Chun Temple, it would be inefficient to convene everyone for every matter. Therefore, under the guidance of the Nascent Soul Ancestors, some Core Formation Elders were selected to represent the rest in discussions.
The eleven Core Formation cultivators seated around the table varied in age and cultivation level, but they shared one commonality.
They all had connections with a Nascent Soul Ancestor from the temple.
Even if not related by blood or direct discipleship, at the very least they were approved by a Nascent Soul Ancestor. Consequently, their statements and actions represented the wills of those Ancestors.
For instance, the purple-haired man, named Qu Liang, the great-grandson of a Nascent Soul Ancestor surnamed Qu. Although he was only at the Early-stage Core Formation, he had gained the right to lead the meetings because his great-grandfather had been in the Nascent Soul Middle Stage for hundreds of years.
Hearing Qu Liang's words, a man with a full beard and open chest turned his gaze to an empty chair next to the long table.
"Is this even within our power to decide? Has the message been sent to Ancestor Ming Quan, and what does he say?" The burly man asked in a leisurely tone.
"Ancestor Ming Quan is not in the temple currently, and I have relayed the news to him via Sound Transmission Talisman, but he has not responded," Qu Liang shook his head as he spoke.
"Is he implying that we should decide on our own? However, Cha Yancai was a favorite apprentice of Ancestor Ming Quan, and Yuan Ming has long held grievances against our Chang Chun Temple. Now, he's openly slain Cha Yancai. Why even discuss this? We should just order a siege and kill him," the bearded man said, setting down the Jade Scroll as if there was nothing more to discuss.
His words garnered the agreement of many elders, all voicing support. They seemed to agree that Yuan Ming, bold enough to act so recklessly, must be utterly extinguished as an example to others.
Of course, Yuan Ming's rise from an obscure Qi Refining Stage Cultivator to the Core Formation Realm in just a few decades was also extraordinarily rare in the history of Chang Chun Temple, stirring among them an indescribable sentiment.
Yet at the table, four Core Formation Elders remained silent, not joining in the consensus.

chapters.title: Chapter 467 - 444: Accelerate Action
chapters.content:
At that moment, a female cultivator with phoenix eyes burst into a cold laugh and said, "I've long said that Yuan Ming is a calamity. Since he killed Cha Yancai, we should have used thunderous methods to capture him back. As for whether his disappearance has anything to do with him, if he refuses to speak, just use some unconventional methods, aren't we afraid he won't confess? If anyone else speaks up to stop us, or tries to make excuses for him, when Ancestor Ming Quan looks into this afterward, these people should also bear some responsibility."
Upon hearing these words, the faces of the four elders from the Imperial Family's line by the long table darkened considerably, evidently, although the female cultivator with phoenix eyes did not specify in her words, her insinuations were directed at the Imperial Family's line.
One of the cultivators among them, tall and thin like a bamboo pole, glared at the female cultivator with phoenix eyes and rebuked angrily, "If we are really to talk about this matter, I would like to ask Elder Hua a question. Why would Yuan Ming be dissatisfied with our Chang Chun Temple Sect? Isn't it the good deeds of your very own disciple? If it were not for his scheme and assassination attempt, perhaps Yuan Ming might now be another one of our Core Formation Elders!"
"Heh, so according to what you're implying, are you saying that Elder Cui, who was in charge of recruiting disciples back then, was also at fault?" Elder Hua responded with a cold laugh.
No sooner had the words fallen, a Daoist with long hair and beard immediately retorted, "You can't say that. I personally verified back then that Yuan Ming had only the Four Spirit Roots talent, which clearly did not meet the minimum standard for our recruitment. Now that he has advanced to Core Formation, he must have encountered some special opportunity in the Southern Border or elsewhere—an extremely low-probability event. Our Chang Chun Temple Sect, as a prestigious and established sect, cannot simply break the rules when recruiting disciples."
"Heh, by that rationale, the fault would still lie with Elder Hua's beloved disciple, right? I remember his Daoist name was Yu Hu, wasn't it? Not only did he cultivate a Core Formation Cultivator who harbors enmity against us, but he has also smeared our reputation with his life, his careful scheme ended up in vain, quite impressive indeed." The tall and thin cultivator said with a sarcastic smile.
These words were met with varying expressions from the other three elders of the Imperial Family's lineage—some shook their heads, some sighed, and some wore an enigmatic smile on their faces.
Being closely related to the Da Jin Imperial Family, they were well aware of the true purpose of those State Preceptors sent by the Chang Chun Temple Sect. Each one of them had been marginalized in those days, so they naturally harbored schadenfreude toward Yu Hu's death.
Elder Hua's brows slightly raised, "Hmph, could it be that Elder Liu has forgotten? During the abdication ceremony years ago, didn't your Imperial Family's lineage give out two copies of the 'Nine Elements Technique' secret manual? One copy was given to the newly ascended Emperor Jin, and as for the other, we are all well aware of its whereabouts. Yuan Ming's achievements today are largely thanks to your Imperial Family's lineage. I suspect that maybe all that Southern Border opportunity was fake, and that Yuan Ming is actually a sword you're cultivating for those dirty deeds unseen by others, and this time he has just killed the wrong person and can no longer be protected, right?"
"Don't slander us with wild accusations! Every year during the inventory check of the 'Nine Elements Technique,' there are extras given out. Have you actually investigated where those secret manuals have gone?" Elder Liu's face turned ashen.
"I don't care about the whereabouts of other secret manuals, but those two from your Imperial Family's lineage... Hehe, if I remember correctly, the traitor from back then also came from your lineage. Now another Yuan Ming has emerged. Whether your hearts truly stand with the Chang Chun Temple Sect, I dare not say." The female cultivator with phoenix eyes said with a mocking smile.Thе оriginаl sоurсе is М|V|L5ЕМРYR.
"What nonsense are you talking about! Our lineage has contributed so much to the Chang Chun Temple Sect—do you see it as worthless? On the other hand, you spend your days within the sect, not venturing beyond your doorsteps, agitating this and that, claiming to plot for the development of the sect while wishing we would wage war against all the sects in the world at once. If we continue like this, the Chang Chun Temple Sect will sooner or later be dragged down into the mire by you all!" The tall and thin cultivator suddenly stood up, reproaching angrily.
Elder Hua also stood up undaunted, ready to retort, but just at that moment, the elder in a black robe seated at the head of the long table suddenly spoke up, "Enough."
His voice was not loud, but as soon as he spoke, everyone immediately became quiet and dared not make any further sound.
The elder appeared very old, with a head full of gray hair, a face full of wrinkles, a hunched body, and thin limbs. He seemed to be on the brink of death.
Yet, none of the Core Formation Elders present dared to resist his words, simply because he was the direct disciple of the Supreme Grand Elder.
It was rumored that he was only one step away from achieving Nascent Soul, and if he appeared weak and elderly, it was due to his cultivation technique; in actual age, he might be younger than any of those present.
"All of you present are devoted to the public good, and no one wishes to drag our Chang Chun Temple Sect down. Such words should not be said in the future." The elder raised his eyelids slightly and spoke in a flat tone.
"Yes." Elder Hua and Elder Liu both bowed and admitted their faults to the elder, then they sat down and exchanged unconvinced glances before turning their heads away.
After settling the matter, the elder closed his eyes again, no longer speaking, as if he had fallen asleep.
Seeing this, Qu Liang cleared his throat and continued, "Since most of us here agree to take action and surround Yuan Ming for assassination, then who should be assigned to this task? Do any of you have recommendations?"
Immediately after this statement, the entire gathering fell silent, nearly all the elders present kept their eyes down and remained noncommittal.
Taking a stand on the Yuan Ming issue was one thing; actually sending someone to deal with it personally was another matter altogether.
None of those who had attained such positions to be present were fools.
Cha Yancai was no weakling, just half a step away from late-stage Core Formation, the favorite disciple of Ancestor Ming Quan, and possessed a few trump cards. However, according to the reports, she had initiated the attack, yet couldn't complete even a single move before being slain by Yuan Ming.
Even if Cha Yancai underestimated his opponent, the swiftness of his defeat also serves to illustrate Yuan Ming's strength.
Let alone whether Yuan Ming will flee afterward, even if he stays put, without mobilizing several late-stage Core Formation Elders, he might still not be an easy opponent to defeat.
This matter is so thorny, and the best outcome would only be to earn Ancestor Ming Quan's appreciation. Who among those present doesn't have a Nascent Soul Ancestor backing them up? It's not worth damaging the combat power of their own factions for this.
Moreover, as a newly ascended Nascent Soul, Ancestor Ming Quan himself is uninterested in the power struggles within the temple. With only Cha Yancai as his disciple, his lineage is even more short-staffed.
"Ahem, in my opinion, for a mere Loose Cultivator, it's not good for us to make such a big fuss. Besides, his whereabouts are uncertain, and after killing Cha Yancai, he will surely flee the Capital with his family. I think it's better to first issue a bounty, letting those small sects and Core Formation Loose Cultivators get involved. If they can kill him, great; if not, they can at least provide us with intelligence. Once we confirm Yuan Ming's location, then it's not too late to send people to besiege and kill him." Seeing no one speaking up, the bearded member of the assembly who first suggested the siege gave everyone a way out.
His words won the support of many elders, and seeing that no one objected, Qu Liang also nodded in agreement.
"All right, then let's arrange it as such. Moving on, the next topic is about the Western Region and Qin Country. With the fall of a Nascent Soul Ancestor, Guiyuan Sect has been in continuous retreat on the battlefield against Qin Country and the Western Region. In order to reverse the decline, they have sought aid from all sects in the Central Plains. This has already received the approval of the Supreme Grand Elder, and we must also offer our support. At least ten Core Formation Elders must go, and we need to finalize this list today." Qu Liang surveyed the crowd as he started discussing the next topic.
…
Capital, Yuan Mansion.
"Dad, Mom, please take this Fasting Pill first." In the study, Yuan Ming took out two elixirs and handed them to his parents.
According to Liu Tianming, there are special means of communication between the Capital and Chang Chun Temple. The fact that he killed Cha Yancai is now known at Chang Chun Temple, and they will likely send people to hunt him down soon.
Currently, he was not aware that the higher-ups in Chang Chun Temple had already quarreled fiercely over this matter, and they were indeed close to dispatching a large number of people to besiege him.
In any case, he knew he did not currently have the strength to face an entire pursuit from Chang Chun Temple and needed to hasten his departure without sitting idly by.
For the moment, Yuan Ming had no suitable Flying Artifact to facilitate a swift escape with his parents. After thinking it over, he finally came up with a plan.
Yuan Zuochong took the elixir, swallowed it, and then dissolved it with mana. He then helped his wife do the same.
"Okay, next, I will put you both to sleep first, and then put you in a space that can hold living people, so we can leave as soon as possible." Yuan Ming said, and his Soul Power slowly drifted out from his Sea of Consciousness, wrapping gently around his parents.
Soon, Yuan Ming's parents were fast asleep, and Yuan Ming promptly summoned the Stealing Heaven Tripod and put them inside.
He then carefully stored the Stealing Heaven Tripod within his body and pushed open the door of the study to step outside.
Outside the room, Liu Tianming and Fu Qing were already waiting.
Liu Tianming was surprised to see only Yuan Ming coming out alone, with no sign of Yuan Zuochong and his wife in the study.
However, he did not ask questions and simply stepped forward, saying, "Brother Ming, I've already made the arrangements. Take this Jade Pendant, show it to the people in Thousand Dragon Island's territory, and they will know you are someone I have sent."
"Thank you." Yuan Ming accepted the Jade Pendant, nodding in gratitude.
"It's a small matter. It's just a pity that although we brothers have just reunited, we have to part again so soon," Liu Tianming said with a touch of regret.
"Circumstances compel it. Once I have settled my parents and dealt with what needs to be done, I will come to have a drink with you," Yuan Ming said, quite nonchalant about it.
"Agreed, a promise is a promise," Liu Tianming said, then suddenly stretched out his right fist slightly.
Yuan Ming understood and also extended his right fist, ready to bump it against Liu Tianming's when he suddenly sped up.
Coincidentally, Liu Tianming also accelerated at the same moment. The two fists smashed together hard, causing a slight pain that made them both frown instinctively and cast a blaming glance at each other. But as their eyes met, they both paused and then burst out laughing.

chapters.title: Chapter 468 - 445: Deceiving Heaven to Cross the Sea
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming smiled, then turned his gaze to Fu Qing.
"Young Master, we have packed all the important items from the mansion, they are all right here." Before Yuan Ming could speak, Fu Qing immediately handed over a Storage Bag.
"Uncle Fu, are you really not coming with us?" Yuan Ming asked as he took the Storage Bag, not bothering to check its contents.
"Thank you for your concern, Young Master, but I still have elders at home, and many children to care for. If I brought everyone, I'm afraid it will only bring trouble to you. Moreover, there are still many servants in the mansion who need to be dismissed, and some properties that could not be sold in such a short notice. Someone needs to stay behind to handle these matters," Fu Qing shook his head.
"Well, if you insist. However, Uncle Fu, since you're staying in the capital, be cautious of Chang Chun Temple. Should anyone come to you, there's no need to hide anything on my behalf, you may reveal everything you know to avoid bringing disaster upon yourself," Yuan Ming advised.
"Thank you for your concern, Young Master. Although I am a close attendant to the general, I reckon Chang Chun Temple, priding itself as a reputable Sect, would hardly bother with a nobody like myself," Fu Qing replied with an easy smile.
"It's hard to say, better to be cautious."
While talking, Yuan Ming took out another Storage Bag, "Uncle Fu, you have accompanied my father for many years. Now that we part, please keep this Storage Bag as a memento. It doesn't contain much, and I hope you won't find it too modest."
"You're too kind, Young Master."
Fu Qing accepted the Storage Bag and quickly inspected it, only to find it contained hundreds of Spirit Stones, a top-grade magical tool, and a Jade Scroll.
A trace of surprise flashed across his face as he promptly attempted to refuse, but when he looked up, Yuan Ming was already nowhere to be seen.
"Tianming, Commander Fu, farewell until we meet again," Yuan Ming's voice came from the sky.
Liu Tianming and Fu Qing looked up to see Yuan Ming walking on air, saluting them from above. He then turned into a streak of light and flew out of Qujiang City.
At the National Master Mansion, Miao Qing stood atop a tall building and also witnessed Yuan Ming transforming into a light and flying away. A sigh of relief filled his heart as he turned to instruct his disciple behind him,
"Quick, send another message to the Sect, tell them Yuan Ming has left and that his tunneling speed is very fast; we cannot catch up."
The disciple took the order and left, leaving Miao Qing alone on the high building, watching the light fading into the horizon, his eyes filled with relief.
...
An hour later,
Yuan Ming, who was speeding towards the East Sea, suddenly changed his expression and stopped his tunneling light.
Suspended in mid-air, he flipped over his palm, and a Storage Ring appeared in his hand.
This was scavenged from the body of Cha Yancai, who was only at the mid-stage of Core Formation, and since Yuan Ming had been short on time before, he hadn't bothered to check what was inside the Storage Ring, simply putting it away.
However, just now, golden arcs of electricity had suddenly emerged from the ring, creating chaos within Yuan Ming's own Storage Ring.
Even now, as Yuan Ming took it out, the golden arcs continued to flash incessantly, looking terrifying, but their actual power was not strong; they didn't even cause a tingling sensation when hitting Yuan Ming's hand.
Yuan Ming probed the Storage Ring with his Divine Sense and was surprised to find it contained quite a lot: not only tens of thousands of Spirit Stones and various elixirs and spiritual materials, but also a Feather Fan Magic Treasure as well as a strange spiky ball flashing with electric light.
The spiky ball had a unique appearance, with a pure white center and light grey spikes. The golden light was shooting out from the tips of these spikes, flashing for a moment within the Storage Ring and then penetrating space to appear outside the ring.
In the center of the spiky ball, there was a pattern that resembled a serpent's eye. Had Yuan Ming not been sure that the spiky ball was not a living thing, he would have thought it was some kind of unique demon beast.
After a moment of contemplation, Yuan Ming took the spiky ball out and continued to explore it with his Divine Sense. He was then startled to discover that it seemed to be a third-level peak demon core.
When his Divine Sense touched the golden light, he suddenly felt connected to something hundreds of miles away. That thing, too, seemed to be carried by someone rushing towards him.
Frowning slightly, Yuan Ming pondered for a moment and then wrapped the demon core with his Soul Power, causing the electric arcs on the demon core to weaken significantly.
After that, he put the demon core back into the Storage Ring, looked around, determined his direction, and with a flash of tunneling light, flew towards the northeast.
After he had left, about 15 minutes passed before a pale blue tunneling light arrived from the sky, hovering over the spot where Yuan Ming had just been.
An elegant male cultivator in a light blue robe, wearing a jade crown and with skin as white as snow and eyes like clear water, appeared. He scanned the surroundings and without mercy, his Divine Sense at the level of a Nascent Soul swept down, searching the area rapidly, but failed to locate his target.
The handsome male cultivator furrowed his brows, and with a pat on his Spiritual Beast Bag, a completely red creature instantly leaped out.
It was neither cow nor tiger, with two large horns on its head, beneath which were four pairs of ears. From the ears, bursts of orange flames gushed continuously, forming thick rings of fire like patterns encircling the creature's body.
"Yan Gua, employ your full Divine Skills to locate the position of Lei Zheng's demon core," the handsome male cultivator ordered in a cold voice.
The creature known as "Yan Gua" roared and from its ears, surging flames burst out, enveloping its body completely in flames.
The handsome male cultivator, upon seeing this, also extended his hand to hover above Yan Gua's body, with flames lapping at his palm as if he felt no heat at all.
But after a brief moment, the handsome male cultivator suddenly looked towards the northeast, apparently confirming the location of something, then he packed up Yan Gua and once again mounted his tunneling light, quickly chasing after it in the northeast direction.
At the very spot where he had just been standing, within the body of a flying insect, Yuan Ming's soul splitting had observed everything that just took place, thinking to himself, "Trouble."
This male cultivator was clearly after the demon core in Cha Yancai's storage ring, and he was a genuine Nascent Soul cultivator. It looked like he might be one of the Nascent Soul ancestors from Chang Chun Temple.
Liu Tianming had previously informed Cha Yancai of the presence of a Nascent Soul master, and Yuan Ming was also aware of this. It seemed that this handsome male cultivator was Cha Yancai's master, Ancestor Ming Quan.
He hadn't expected him to arrive so swiftly, but even so, Yuan Ming's course of action would remain unchanged.
With Yuan Ming's current strength, he wasn't afraid to confront a Nascent Soul cultivator, but making a move against Ancestor Ming Quan would be more detrimental than beneficial and would greatly affect his future plans. If possible, it was better not to act.
However, following his recent observations, Yuan Ming also discovered that the man had found him by the connection between his own demon core and the spirit beasts nearby. If handled properly, he might well be able to avoid detection.
After a brief period of reflection, Yuan Ming immediately came up with a plan.
...
About fifteen minutes later, Yu Ning Square.
At the entrance of the square, a guard tasked with keeping watch yawned, carelessly collecting the entrance fees from the Loose Cultivators.
But suddenly, a pale blue tunneling light arrived from the sky, reaching the square in the blink of an eye.
A terrifying pressure descended like a waterfall, and the guard at the city gate shivered into alertness, becoming much more awake.
In the sky, Ancestor Ming Quan frowned, his Divine Sense sweeping unreservedly over the square, capturing every face within.
The cultivators in the square, sensing that someone was prying, felt displeasure, but upon looking up and seeing the newcomer floating in mid-air with the boundless expanse of Spiritual Power radiating like an ocean, they didn't even dare to breathe too heavily.
Before long, Ancestor Ming Quan's Divine Sense had scrutinized every corner of the square without omission, yet he found no trace of Yuan Ming.
His brow furrowed deeply; with a slap on his Spiritual Beast Bag, Yan Gua immediately flew out and, without waiting for his command, once again exerted his Divine Skills to their fullest.
"Esteemed senior, may I inquire what brings you to Yu Ning Square?" At the same time, in the square, a Core Formation Cultivator flew out from the City Lord Mansion, approaching Ancestor Ming Quan with a respectful expression and giving him a bow.
However, Ancestor Ming Quan didn't show the slightest intention of responding, simply resting his hand on Yan Gua's back, his frown deepening further.
"Senior, if you are searching for someone, allow me to assist you…"
The Core Formation City Lord hadn't finished his sentence when he was interrupted by Ancestor Ming Quan.
"Nonsense," Ancestor Ming Quan irritably cursed. With a thought, a long saber Magic Treasure materialized out of thin air, and in an instant, it severed one of the Core Formation City Lord's arms.
The Core Formation City Lord cried out in pain but immediately clamped his other hand over his mouth, daring not to stop the bleeding. He simply let his severed arm fall and blood gush from the wound.Th-i-s% c-o@n!t+en#t$ o&rig*i#n%ates* from M%1VLEMP&Y^R, My Vi%r@t*ua&l! L^i&br$ary E*mpi&re.
However, Ancestor Ming Quan paid no attention to his reaction, once again sweeping his Divine Sense over every corner of the city, ensuring that no one was in disguise.
For some reason, Yan Gua was now unable to detect the position of Lei Zheng's demon core, only knowing that the last appearance of the demon core was nearby.
In this hundred-mile radius, there was only Yu Ning City. Most residents were Loose Cultivators. Yuan Ming, a Core Formation, could not possibly exceed his own Nascent Soul in tunneling speed and Divine Sense. If not using some Secret Technique to escape, he must be hiding in this city.
However, Ancestor Ming Quan's second search yielded the same result.
Seeing this, his expression turned displeased, and with a cold snort, he withdrew Yan Gua and continued to chase in the northeast direction.
It was only after his figure had completely vanished beyond the horizon that another Core Formation Cultivator hurriedly flew out from the City Lord Mansion, approached the pale-faced Core Formation City Lord, and clumsily reattached and healed his severed arm.
In the square, a Foundation Establishment cultivator with an ordinary appearance looked up, watching the events in the sky silently like the other Loose Cultivators, showing nothing unusual.
Yet, this person was actually Yuan Ming in disguise. Using the Blood Bone Mask and Hidden Element Technique, he had flawlessly deceived Ancestor Ming Quan's search without being recognized.
Of course, in addition to that, he had sent Cha Yancai's Storage Ring into the Stealing Heaven Tripod. Thanks to this divine item, the connection between the demon core and Yan Gua had been completely severed.
However, he could not confirm if this was truly effective. Perhaps he would need to travel by a different method to be more secure in the future.

chapters.title: Chapter 469 - 446 Reunion
chapters.content:
Dragon Abyss River, as the largest river of Wu Country, stretches for thousands of miles. Its vast waves are magnificent, and the river spans as far as the eye can see. Occasionally, the water churns, forming gigantic whirlpools or waves several dozen feet high, as if true flood dragons lurked beneath the surface.
This river, with its broad waters, almost crosses half of Wu Country. Throughout the year, a thousand sails pass by, and countless ships flow along it. Merchants from various cities along the route travel on it, making it the most important waterway for commerce in Wu Country.
At the end of the Dragon Abyss River, it flows directly into the East Sea. There, towering by the seashore, stands a gigantic city named "Dragon King City," the largest trade hub between Wu Country and the East Sea. Numerous ships of all sizes are moored at the docks outside the city.
Every year, pearls, kelp, salt, and more from the East Sea flow into Wu Country from this place, and Wu Country's grains, textiles, and other goods enter the East Sea through here. Dragon King City is extremely prosperous, surpassing even the capital of Wu Country.
Dragon King City is not only a major trading city for ordinary people but also a city for cultivators. Countless cultivators from the Central Plains come here to enter the East Sea, hunt demon beasts, seek treasures, and sell their findings in Dragon King City.
When it comes to this aspect, Dragon King City can be considered one of the leading cultivation cities in Wu Country.
A massive green ship, a hundred zhang long, cuts through the water, slowly approaching the dock of Dragon King City. This is a large cargo ship headed for Dragon King City, loaded with grains and various goods, along with a few passengers who are traveling to the city.
"Finally, Dragon King City," a young man of average build with slightly dark skin muttered to himself as he stood by the ship's railing, gazing at the great city before him.
This person was none other than Yuan Ming, who had once again disguised himself with a Blood Bone Mask.
After shaking off Ancestor Ming Quan in the workshop, he did not fly to the East Sea but instead chose to travel by ship.
Ancestor Ming Quan, searching up ahead, would not find him and would likely gather forces to check anyone traveling by flying. Traveling by ship on the ground surface, firstly, could evade Ancestor Ming Quan's search, and secondly, Yuan Ming also wanted to test if Ancestor Ming Quan had other means to locate him.
Yuan Ming could not allow any slip-ups in settling his parents, and he had to dodge the other party's detection completely before reaching the East Sea.
Fortunately, on the way, the Nascent Soul cultivator did not appear even once, which likely meant Yuan Ming had shaken him off completely.
The green ship soon docked, and the merchants and travelers on board hurriedly disembarked.
Yuan Ming also blended in with the crowd to step onto the dock and walk into Dragon King City.
The sights and architecture within the city were different from those of Da Jin, Zhao Country, and the Southern Border, with many buildings primarily constructed from wood rather than bricks and tiles. The local people lived in affluence, and numerous trees and flowers, meticulously cared for, lined the roads.
Compared to the solemnity of Da Jin and the rusticity of Zhao Country, everything here was more refined. Even the streets selling goods featured a picturesque scene every five steps and a painted landscape every ten steps, with elegant buildings and pavilions, and small bridges over flowing water, like a garden.
Dragon King City covered a vast area, with the outer city being the residential area for ordinary people and the inner city designated for cultivators, forbidding ordinary people from approaching.
Yuan Ming slightly revealed his mana aura, disguising himself as an ordinary Foundation Establishment cultivator, and entered the inner city.
The situation in the inner city was similar to the outer city, but the streets were more spacious, more refined, and more beautiful.
There were many cultivators in the inner city, both in number and cultivation level, surpassing places like Little Lake City, Wangyue City, and others.
In just a moment, Yuan Ming's Divine Sense had already sensed several Core Formation Stage presences.
What was most peculiar was that one of the Core Formation Stage cultivators carried demon energy, his cheeks showing a bluish-black color with scale-like patterns visible.The authentic version is on *.
"I've heard that the East Sea has a half-human, half-demon race. It seems to be true," Yuan Ming thought to himself but did not look further to avoid any misunderstanding.
Besides these, the cultivators in Dragon King City had one special feature: nearly everyone wore a Spiritual Beast Bag at their waist, and some even rode directly on spirit beasts.
A yellow-clad, middle-aged cultivator rode on a two-zhang-long blue Spiritual Tiger, passing by Yuan Ming. The nearby people all acted as if this was perfectly normal.
"The East Sea really is quite different from Da Jin and the Southern Border," Yuan Ming thought as he headed to a shop selling books in the inner city.
At this moment, there was still half a year until the appointed time with Sister Xi Ying, so he was not in a hurry to meet her. The priority was to find a secure place to settle his parents.
Yuan Ming picked a few classic books introducing the geography of the East Sea and was about to pay when a strong wave of Desire Power came his way, actually originating from within the city.
Judging by the intensity of the Desire Power, it was undeniably a Core Formation Stage believer.
Yuan Ming purchased the classics and headed to a nearby inn. After taking out his Silver Token and unfolding the barrier, he entered the Stealing Heaven Tripod and extended his Divine Sense.
A praying girl in white came into view—it was Yan Sijing.
"It is indeed her," Yuan Ming saw and was not surprised.
Currently, he only had two Core Formation Stage believers under his control: Yan Sijing and the Three-eyed Crow. With the Three-eyed Crow currently inside the Spiritual Beast Bag, the only one left was Yan Sijing.
Yuan Ming spread his Divine Sense further from Yan Sijing's location and couldn't help but smile wryly.
At this moment, Yan Sijing was staying in a large inn that resembled a manor. The two rooms next to hers were occupied by acquaintances, namely Xi Ying and Yan Siyun, and many from the Hundred Pills Square were also staying here.
After giving it some thought, Yuan Ming left the Stealing Heaven Tripod, dispelled the silver barrier, and left the inn.
Yan Sijing prayed fervently in her room for a full quarter of an hour before stopping, feeling uneasy.
During this period, she had been busy with the affairs of the Hundred Pills Square, running around in a daze, and had forgotten to pray to Lord Nether Moon God. She wondered if he would blame her?
"My sister and I have brought the people from the Hundred Pills Square to Dragon King City, which can be considered laying the foundation for the expansion of the Moon Sect. Lord Nether Moon God surely won't blame us," Yan Sijing thought to herself, gradually calming down. She took out the golden beast shadow treasure sword and tirelessly continued her incantations for its refinement.
The golden treasure sword circled around her body, creating substantial-looking Sword Shadows, and even emitted the roars of a hundred beasts, as if she was practicing a profound sword technique.
The great battle at the Shura Palace had made Yan Sijing realize her lack of combat experience. After leaving the Shura Palace, apart from the affairs of the Hundred Pills Square, she had been tirelessly compensating for this day and night.
"Hmm, who is there?" Yan Sijing suddenly opened her eyes and looked towards the living room outside.
"Hehe, being able to sense my presence, it seems your strength has greatly improved," a phantasmal figure slowly materialized, revealing Yuan Ming, who had returned to his original appearance.
"Sijing pays respects to Divine Envoy Yuan," Yan Sijing quickly stood up and respectfully greeted him.
After their experience at the Shura Palace, Yan Sijing clearly understood the terrifying strength of Yuan Ming and felt both reverence and fear, no longer daring to address him as a fellow daoist.
"No need to be so formal. We are, after all, friends who have faced life and death together. You may address me as a Fellow Daoist," Yuan Ming said with a slight smile.
"Yes, Fellow Daoist Yuan," Yan Sijing replied without further words, lowering her head as she spoke.
"I see you've moved all the people from the Hundred Pills Square here? Are you planning to seek development in the East Sea?" Yuan Ming then inquired.
"Yes. It was Sister Xi Ying who suggested we do this. She said that while there may not be a lot of Spirit Grass and other spiritual materials in the East Sea, the variety of demon beast materials and underwater spiritual materials is abundant. Moreover, the East Sea, being vast and boundless, doesn't run into the problem of material shortages caused by overharvesting like the Central Plains does. Thus, the East Sea provides an inexhaustible source of materials that is more suitable for the development of the Hundred Pills Square. The others in the Square were also relocated here with her help," Yan Sijing explained.
Yuan Ming's mind stirred. Why would Xi Ying go to such lengths to help the Hundred Pills Square? Was it out of consideration for him?
And when did Xi Ying and Yan Sijing become so close? During their time at the Shura Palace, they'd certainly had their share of friction.
"The resources here in the East Sea are indeed plentiful and suitable for Alchemy. If you need my help with anything, feel free to ask. Even if I can't resolve it, I can ask for Lord Nether Moon God's assistance." Since it was Xi Ying's idea, Yuan Ming did not probe further.
Upon hearing that Lord Nether Moon God was willing to help, Yan Sijing was overjoyed.
The divine might of the Nether Moon God, which she had witnessed with her own eyes, could even slay the millennium-old demon Six Desires Venerable, so any enemies the Hundred Pills Square faced would naturally be no challenge.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, due to the recent relocation, the Hundred Pills Square has many things to take care of and hasn't gotten the chance to have our people devote themselves to Lord Nether Moon God. My sister is already planning this, and soon, we will have everyone join the Moon Sect," Yan Sijing hurriedly added, remembering the promise made before.
"Good," Yuan Ming nodded.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, rest assured. Since you helped us kill Thunderbolt Ancestor and saved the Hundred Pills Square, my sister and I will naturally honor our promise," a pleasant voice came, and there was Yan Siyun approaching.
In the eyes of this girl, which used to be vacant, there was now an inexplicable hint of vitality, and she was looking right at Yuan Ming, making him feel as if she was not blind at all.
What's more, her Cultivation had increased significantly, having reached the Peak of Foundation Establishment. In some time, she would be ready for Core Formation.
Even more curious was the indescribable aura that surrounded Yan Siyun.
"You're here," Xi Ying's figure also appeared in the room with a flicker.
"I rushed here immediately after dealing with the matters in Da Jin. How are things on your end?" Yuan Ming nodded at Yan Siyun and turned to Xi Ying, asking.
"I've already found out where the materials are located, but it'll be about a year before we can obtain them," Xi Ying said.
"A year, the timing should work out just fine," Yuan Ming's eyes flickered, and he murmured thoughtfully.
Yan Siyun began to serve, personally brewing several cups of Spiritual Tea.
"This is Golden Chalice Tea, a specialty of Dragon King City. It has a unique flavor and also has the effect of refreshing the mind and invigorating the spirit, Fellow Daoist Yuan, you should try it."
Yuan Ming lifted the teacup for a sip. It was slightly bitter at first but quickly turned to a sweet fragrance. His Dantian felt warm, his lips and teeth fragrant, and his spirit was indeed much more alert.
"Fellow Daoist Yan, I've heard that you're meticulous and have a strong memory. Before coming to the East Sea, you must have collected a lot of information about this place. Could you share the information with me?" Yuan Ming put down his teacup and looked at Yan Siyun.
"To be recognized by Fellow Daoist Yuan is an honor for me," Yan Siyun said with a slight smile. She took out a white Jade Scroll and handed it over, then stood up and personally brewed another cup of Spiritual Tea for Yuan Ming.

chapters.title: Chapter 470 - 447 East Sea Islands
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming took the Jade Scroll, activated his Divine Sense, and delved into it.
The Jade Scroll contained a vast amount of information about the East Sea, recorded in great detail.
The East Sea encompassed a vast area, surpassing the Central Plains and the Southern Border. However, the East Sea was different from other regions; it was an endless sea with countless islands.
In fact, the so-called East Sea region primarily refers to these islands, whether they are inhabited by mortals or cultivators, they are all distributed across these islands.
The climate of the East Sea was harsh, with frequent natural disasters such as hurricanes, tsunamis, and earthquakes. Without the protection of cultivators, it was difficult for mortals to survive, so the inhabited islands were mostly spirit islands with Spirit Veins.
The East Sea had no nations; each island was managed by the Sects of cultivators residing there, each island equivalent to a city-state.
Based on the condition of the Spirit Veins, the islands of the East Sea were divided into three grades.
Third-class islands were the most numerous, with records showing two to three thousand such islands. These islands had thin Spiritual Energy, only sufficient to support Foundation Establishment cultivators in their cultivation.
Second-class islands had more abundant Spirit Veins, enough to meet the daily needs of Core Formation cultivators, but were much fewer in number, only a few hundred.
The islands with the highest level of Spirit Veins were known as first-class islands. These had vigorous Spiritual Energy, sufficient to cultivate Nascent Soul cultivators, on par with the Spirit Veins held by the Five Thunder Sect, Spirit Talisman Sect, and even the Chang Chun Temple.
Interestingly, according to the map of the East Sea collected by Yan Siyun, the closer to the coastal area, the higher the proportion of third-class islands, while deeper in the sea, both second and first-class islands increased in number, giving a sense that the further one was from the mainland, the richer the Spiritual Energy became.
"It seems the Spiritual Energy of the overseas world is indeed richer than that of the Yunhuang Continent, or else the Spirit Veins of the islands would not be distributed in such a manner." Yuan Ming thought to himself.
First-class islands were scarce; there were only thirteen throughout the East Sea, and each island had a Nascent Soul cultivator in command, with formidable strength.
Among the thirteen first-class islands, the one with the greatest strength was known as Fusang Island.
This island was named after a huge Fusang Tree that grew on it, an Ancient Divine Wood that was said to be the dwelling place of the Three-legged Golden Crow that could morph into the Sun in ancient times.
Though the Ancient Golden Crow had long vanished without trace, and the Fusang Tree on Fusang Island could not compare to the Divine Wood of ancient times, a fire spirit demon beast that resembled a Golden Crow lived in that tree. It was incomparably strong, having reached the fifth level; no one in the entire East Sea could match it.
Fortunately, that Golden Crow spirit bird had a gentle disposition and coexisted peacefully with the people of Fusang Island—there had not been any reports of it voluntarily harming anyone over the years.
The strength of the master of Fusang Island was also extremely formidable, having reached the late stage of the Nascent Soul, and he held significant influence over the East Sea.
"Fusang Divine Wood! I've read about it in the classics; it possesses incredible power. I never imagined such Divine Wood could actually exist in the Yunhuang Continent! And there's also a demon beast resembling a Golden Crow, the foundation of the East Sea's cultivation world is truly unfathomable," Yuan Ming exclaimed at this juncture.
"What! Fusang Divine Wood!" A voice came from inside the Spiritual Beast Bag as Hua Zhi poked her head out, her face showing surprise.
Yan Si Jing and Xi Ying had seen Hua Zhi before and paid no mind, but it was Yan Siyun's first encounter with Hua Zhi, so she scanned her a few extra times with her Divine Sense.
"What, you also know about Fusang Divine Wood?" Yuan Ming asked.
"I absorbed the Blood Willow and refined its last bit of Primordial Spirit. During that process, I extracted quite a few secrets from it, including some memories about Fusang Divine Wood. The Shura Master once acquired a piece of Fusang Divine Wood, and it was used to refine the frame of your Night Parade of Hundred Demons," Hua Zhi said.
Yuan Ming's eyes showed surprise as he sensed the frame of the Night Parade of Hundred Demons with his Divine Sense. Indeed, its aura was extremely unique, and it was hard to tell what material it was made from.
"The Fusang Tree is a close relative of the World Tree, known as the Ancestor of Ten Thousand Trees. It contains a trace of the Ten Thousand Wood Origin and is not afraid of attacks from any Five Elements including Gold, Wood, Water, Fire, Earth. Magic treasures refined from Fusang Divine Wood can withstand attacks from all five elements' Spiritual Power, and they are particularly good at counteracting all Wood Attribute Divine Skills," Hua Zhi continued.
Yuan Ming heard this and slowly nodded his head.
"You actually know about the World Tree?" Xi Ying, who had been sitting quietly there, could not help but raise an eyebrow upon hearing this.
"That is what the Shura Master told the Blood Willow," Hua Zhi replied.
"What is so special about this World Tree that's revered as the Ancestor of Ten Thousand Trees?" Yuan Ming curiously asked.
"The World Tree is said to be a Chaos Spiritual Root born at the time of the creation of heaven and earth, known as the source of all wood. Every wood attribute being in the world evolved from the World Tree. Legends say that the Fusang Tree was one of the first wood spirits derived from it, and thus, it possesses incredible abilities," Hua Zhi explained.
Xi Ying heard this with a neutral expression on her face, seemingly already familiar with these details.
Yuan Ming, Yan Siyun, and the others who heard such ancient secrets were marveled, greatly broadening their horizons.
"Master, take me to Fusang Island, let me sneak into the Fusang Tree. As long as I can enter it and absorb the immense Wood Spirit Energy within, advancing to level 4, or even level 5, will soon be within reach. Then, whether it's Chang Chun Temple or the Wu Yue Sect, I can wipe them out for you! Plus, your Nine Elements Technique is also a wood attribute cultivation method. If you can obtain a piece of Fusang Divine Wood's core, it would greatly benefit your cultivation!" Hua Zhi turned to Yuan Ming, excitedly proposing.
"We'll talk about it later," Yuan Ming said noncommittally, knowing Hua Zhi's ability to lurk and burrow very well. With his own assistance, it might indeed be possible to sneak into the Fusang Tree.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, this matter is probably not so easy. Although I have never visited Fusang Island, I have also heard that the inhabitants of Fusang Island highly value the Fusang Tree, guarding it very strictly. They have placed numerous prohibitions over the entire gigantic tree. Moreover, there are Nascent Soul cultivators stationed there year-round, plus the Golden Crow Demon Beast that inhabits the Fusang Tree. Approaching that place is extremely difficult," Yan Siyun cautioned, sensing that Yuan Ming seemed intent on taking action.
"What are you, a mere Foundation Establishment Cultivator, babbling about? The divine skills of my master and me are beyond your imagination!" Hua Zhi angrily rebuked.
Yan Sijing showed a look of anger, but Yan Siyun remained calm, showing neither joy nor anger.
"Hua Zhi, do not be rude," Yuan Ming admonished with a frown.
Only then did Hua Zhi fall silent.
"Since the Fusang Tree is so precious, it makes sense for Fusang Island to guard it carefully. I will consider this matter further," Yuan Ming remarked.
"Yes," Hua Zhi somewhat reluctantly agreed, retreating back into the Spiritual Beast Bag.
"Fellow Daoist Yan, now that we understand the situation concerning the Fusang Wood, have you found any specific information about that Golden Crow Demon Beast?" Yuan Ming asked, turning to Yan Siyun.
"That Golden Crow Demon Beast has always kept itself hidden, like a dragon showing its head but not its tail. I have not been able to find more specific information," Yan Siyun replied, shaking her head.
"I visited Fusang Island many years ago and saw that Golden Crow Demon Beast. Its divine skills are extraordinary and should not be underestimated," Sister Xi Ying suddenly spoke up.
"Sister Xi Ying, you have been to Fusang Island? What is the situation there? Is the Fusang Tree really towering into the clouds, obscuring the sun? And is that Golden Crow truly of the Fifth-level Demon Beast Realm?" Yan Sijing asked curiously.
"The situation with the Fusang Tree is indescribable in words. Should you be fortunate enough to visit one day, you will understand. As for the Golden Crow's strength, I only caught a glimpse of it from afar and can't confirm its real power, but it must at least be equivalent to a late-stage Nascent Soul existence, otherwise, it wouldn't have survived to this day," Xi Ying said, a strange light flickering in her eyes.
Yuan Ming, noticing this look in Xi Ying's eyes, suddenly had a thought.
Xi Ying's Divine Soul Transformation took the form of a spiritual bird resembling the Three-legged Golden Crow. Could it be that the blood used for her transformation was taken from the spirit bird on Fusang Island?
With the Yan sisters present, Yuan Ming refrained from asking further questions and let the matter rest.
The latter part of the Jade Scroll introduced the situation of cultivators in the East Sea, mentioning not only the Human Clan but also peculiar mixed-blood races of demon and human heritage, with the stronger ones being the Merfolk, Snake-man Clan, and Water Ape Clan.
The Merfolk and Water Ape Clan were relatively mild-tempered, whereas the Snake-man Clan was much more brutal, often killing people and bearing strong hatred towards the Human Clan.
The strength of these three alien races was not to be underestimated, each occupying a first-class Spirit Island. They possessed the dexterity and intelligence of the Human Clan and the innate divine abilities of the Demon Clan, their combat power considerably exceeding that of ordinary Human Clan's cultivators, especially in underwater battles where their advantages were unmatched.
The three clans had formed an alliance with each other. The islands controlled by the Human Clan dared not probe too deeply, maintaining a generally peaceful coexistence with them.
The Jade Scroll also recorded the physical characteristics and preferred divine skills of these three races.
"So, there indeed exist alien clans in the East Sea. The individual I saw earlier in the city must be a member of the Merfolk," Yuan Ming thought to himself.
The earlier sections of the Jade Scroll contained brief but important information, while the latter sections provided detailed descriptions of thirteen first-class islands, over a hundred second-class islands, and several thousand third-class islands, which were quite detailed.
"Fellow Daoist Yan really is an expert at gathering information. It would take an ordinary person years to collect such extensive information, and even then, it might not be as detailed, yet you only took a few months," Yuan Ming expressed his satisfaction with Yan Siyun.Note f!ro^m! the ed@ito^r@: Alwa-y&s c#h*e.c#k* MV2LE#M&P-YR for c-o^r^r^ection!s@.
"You flatter me, Fellow Daoist Yuan," Yan Siyun said with a faint smile.
For her, since she planned to establish Hundred Pills Square in the Dragon King City, it was natural to gather as much information as possible.
"This Jade Scroll is quite useful to me. May I keep it?" Yuan Ming asked, holding up the Jade Scroll.
"Of course, you can," Yan Siyun said without hesitation.
"Then thank you, Fellow Daoist Yan. Given that Hundred Pills Square is starting its business in Dragon King City, you must be in need of funds. Here are five hundred thousand Spirit Stones, consider it thanks for this Jade Scroll," Yuan Ming said, taking out a bulging Storage Bag and placing it on the table.
"This…" Yan Siyun caught her breath.
Hundred Pills Square had narrowly escaped a disaster, but it had also greatly depleted its resources. Most of the wealth accumulated over the years had been plundered by Thunderbolt Ancestor, leaving only about a hundred thousand Spirit Stones available.
This was what Yan Siyun had foreseen of the impending catastrophe and had moved ahead of time.
A hundred thousand Spirit Stones might not be little for a Core Formation cultivator, but they were hardly sufficient to maintain the operations of a medium-sized commerce house.
She had been considering selling some currently unnecessary assets to exchange for Spirit Stones for emergency use. Unexpectedly, Yuan Ming had willingly given five hundred thousand Spirit Stones, truly alleviating their urgent need.

chapters.title: Chapter 471 - 448: Nurturing the Soul
chapters.content:
"This Spirit Stone is far too much, the information inside the Jade Scroll isn't worth this much. If Fellow Daoist Yuan doesn't mind, I'm willing to transfer 50% of the Hundred Pills Square's shares to you. We can manage the Square together, what do you think?" Yan Siyun, who was blind but had a clear heart, didn't try to take advantage, and made a suggestion.
"I agree with Fellow Daoist Yan," said Yuan Ming, who had indeed been considering this idea, and was happy that the other party had brought it up on their own.
Although Hundred Pills Square was currently in a difficult situation, Yan Sijing was an Alchemy genius, and Yan Siyun was even more skilled in strategic management. Given the chance, the Merchant's Association was sure to rise again.
Xi Ying, standing to the side, glanced subtly. She too saw the potential in Hundred Pills Square, and that was why she got close to the Yan sisters. She had intended to use the Hundred Pills Square as a starting point to cultivate her own forces in the East Sea.
However, she hadn't been back to the family recently and her Spirit Stones were running low. Yuan Ming had beat her to the punch, which made her feel depressed as she took a big sip of the Spiritual Tea.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, this is the contract for the transfer of shares in Hundred Pills Square. Please keep it safe," said Yan Siyun as she took out a dark red piece of paper, wrote a few lines of text—the content of the share transfer—and then cut her finger, dripping a drop of fresh blood on it.
The dark red paper lit up with a weak Blood Light, which then dimmed.
An indescribable aura spread out from it and merged into Yan Siyun's body.
Yuan Ming recognized the dark red paper as Yin Blood Paper from the Cultivation World, made with special Yin Attribute Spiritual Materials. Writing on it with blood was akin to making a vow with a Heart Demon.
He took the Yin Blood Paper and placed it on the table beside him.
"We sisters still have matters to attend to, Fellow Daoist Yuan, please take your time," said Yan Siyun as she packed up her Storage Bag and stood up to leave with her sister.
Soon, Yuan Ming and Xi Ying were the only two left in the room.
"Xi Ying, I have no interest in managing the Merchant's Association. You manage these 50% of shares for me," said Yuan Ming, passing the Yin Blood Paper to Xi Ying.
"There's no need. There are many promising businesses in the East Sea, it's not only Hundred Pills Square. If I want to cultivate power, I have plenty of choices—I don't need your charity," said Xi Ying curtly, without even glancing at the Yin Blood Paper.
"Currently, you have left the Wuyue Sect and if the Xi Family finds out about this, they probably won't treat you kindly. It would be beneficial to have more assets in case of future needs. I am already overwhelmed managing the Moon Sect and truly lack the energy to manage Hundred Pills Square. Consider this as helping me," Yuan Ming could tell that Xi Ying was displeased and tried to persuade her halfway between coaxing and urging.
He gave five hundred thousand Spirit Stones to Hundred Pills Square to help it rise again, and also for Xi Ying.
"With Yan Siyun's ability, even if you play the role of a hands-off shopkeeper, she can manage Hundred Pills Square well," said Xi Ying, picking up her cup of tea again, her manner of speech now not as harsh as before.
Yuan Ming simply thought Xi Ying was too proud to accept his gift and didn't want to embarrass her further, so he did not insist.
He flicked his finger, releasing a drop of fresh blood onto the Yin Blood Paper.
The Yin Blood Paper immediately glowed with a dense Blood Light and a similar aura to before surged out, entering his body, as the Blood Light on the paper again grew dim.
A strange aura spread out from the Yin Blood Paper, wrapping around Yuan Ming, seeping into his Divine Soul.
This power was quite similar to Soul Power, yet mixed with some sort of rule-like energy, vague like looking at flowers through fog, hard to discern.
"Are you seeking out Yan Sijing and her sister right now for information on the East Sea?" Xi Ying asked after putting down her cup.
"I'm planning to find a place among the thousands of islands to settle my parents," Yuan Ming said straightforwardly, without concealment.
"Then why don't you just let Yan Siyun look for you? She's good at summarizing and collecting all kinds of information. She'll find you a suitable place quickly. Plus, as a Believer in the Moon Sect, she is also trustworthy," Xi Ying suggested.
"I don't wish for anyone to know about my parents, including the Yan sisters. The more people who know, the greater the danger for them," Yuan Ming shook his head.
"Right, where are your parents now? In the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space?" Xi Ying nodded, then inquired.
"I have used an Illusion Technique to keep them perpetually asleep. Knowing about the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space would be more harmful than beneficial for them," Yuan Ming explained.
"Your father is just a Qi Refining Stage Cultivator, and your mother is even a mortal. Being trapped in an illusion for a long time, even the mildest one, is still not good for their bodies and Divine Souls. My Xi Family has a secret technique, the Soul Nourishing and Returning to Origin Secret Technique, which can help them to regulate their bodies and Divine Souls, to avoid any hidden dangers," Xi Ying suggested after a moment's silence.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming looked at Xi Ying in surprise.
"What are you looking at?" demanded Xi Ying, straightening up.
"Ever since we met, you've always gone straight for the kill without much care for the details. I didn't expect you to consider such meticulous matters," Yuan Ming remarked.
"Hee hee, if one wants to please their in-laws, they surely have to be thoughtful," said Hua Zhi with a laugh, having been listless all day without Vajra to bicker with, and thus speaking up from inside the Spiritual Beast Bag again.
Xi Ying's face turned cold and she unleashed a wave of Soul Power.
Countless illusions appeared before Hua Zhi's eyes, both real and fake, indistinguishable.
Its senses distorted in an instant, and continuous heart-wrenching pain surged into its head as if it were being split open. It wanted to scream, but no sound came from its mouth as its body trembled incessantly.
"Xi Ying, show mercy!" Yuan Ming sensed Hua Zhi's condition, a wave of Soul Power emanated from his brow, enveloping Hua Zhi and forming a Soul Power barrier.
Hua Zhi's pained expression eased slightly as she caught her breath.
However, a strange vibration followed the flow of soul power, transmitting to Yuan Ming's Sea of Consciousness.
His soul power became chaotic, and his five senses were also thrown into disorder.
Yuan Ming's face showed surprise, and he hurriedly summoned a force of Desire Power from within the Stealing Heaven Tripod into his Sea of Consciousness. All his soul power retreated into his Soul Pill, and by using a secret technique to stabilize his Divine Soul, he barely neutralized the vibration.
Xi Ying withdrew her soul power, her expression still calm.
Hua Zhi caught her breath incessantly, looking at Xi Ying with both shock and fear, not daring to say another word.
Yuan Ming sent a soothing message to Hua Zhi, then glanced at Xi Ying beside him, feeling elated, and couldn't help but smile slightly.
"What are you smiling at? I didn't mean what Hua Zhi said," Xi Ying said with a stern face.
"I know, Hua Zhi likes to spout nonsense, I'll reprimand her later. Regardless of what's in your heart, what I said before was for the sake of my parents, and I thank you on their behalf." Yuan Ming said deeply, bowing in thanks.
"I have many matters to attend to and can't delay here any longer. If you don't need my casting, then I will take my leave," Xi Ying said as she got up and walked towards the outside.
"Of course, we need it." Yuan Ming quickly got up to stop Xi Ying, waving his sleeve to emit a Green Light Shield that covered both of them and swept them into the Stealing Heaven Tripod in a flash.
Mr. and Mrs. Yuan were lying near the altar, sound asleep.
Xi Ying approached the elders, flipping her jade hand and chanting an incantation.
Countless thin green threads shot out from the palm of her hand, a mixture of soul power and mana, entering the bodies of the two and guiding their Divine Souls and bodies.
Even though the elders were asleep within the illusion, the expressions on their faces relaxed considerably.
Yuan Ming was delighted to see this and stood quietly to the side without speaking.
Xi Ying continued casting for a full quarter of an hour before stopping. The faces of Yuan Ming's parents glowed with a healthy color, their Qi-Blood circulating more vigorously than usual, showing a better state than on normal days.
"The Soul Nourishing and Returning to Origin Secret Technique is indeed profound," Yuan Ming praised.
"This technique was created to guide the bodies of those seriously injured and unconscious. Here are the specific casting mnemonics; you should cast it once a day. Even if they sleep for a long time, there won't be any impact," Xi Ying said as she took out a Jade Scroll and passed it over.
Yuan Ming thanked her and accepted the Jade Scroll, his Divine Sense delving into it.
The Soul Nourishing and Returning to Origin Secret Technique was not complex; as long as one could meticulously control soul power and mana, one could cast it.
The finer the control, the better the effects of the secret technique.
"Your Xi Family is indeed a soul cultivation family with a heritage of ten thousand years, with countless Divine Soul Secret Techniques emerging one after another. The one you used on Hua Zhi just now is also one of them, isn't it?" Yuan Ming put away the Jade Scroll and said.
"That was the Divine Soul Cutting Technique of my Xi Family. It can disrupt an enemy's five senses and slice their Divine Soul apart. I've only just mastered this technique and didn't use it when I confronted the Six Desires Venerable earlier. If you want to learn it, I can teach you," Xi Ying said.
This is part of a series from * (*).
"No need. I already have many Soul Cultivation Divine Powers, and I've obtained several secret techniques from the Six Desires Venerable that I haven't had the chance to practice yet. Learning more now would actually be inappropriate," Yuan Ming shook his head.
"It's good that you understand. You currently have many Soul Cultivation Divine Powers. The Great Black Sky God Palm exhibits incredible power, and the runes on the Soul Destroying Sword are also strange and special, but these are external forces. The most fundamental aspect of soul cultivation is the cultivation technique and the awakened Divine Skills. You need to put more effort into this area," Xi Ying reminded.
"I understand what you mean. Speaking of Divine Soul Transformation, I have something else to ask you. Your Divine Soul Transformation is like that of a Golden Crow. Now, in the entire Yunhuang Continent, probably only Fusang Island here has a Golden Crow demon beast. The Essence Blood you used for your transformation, could it be related to the Golden Crow of Fusang Island?" Yuan Ming nodded, then asked the question that had puzzled him earlier.
"Correct. An elder of the Xi Family came to Fusang Island many years ago and by chance obtained a drop of blood from that Level 5 Golden Crow. The family needed an exceptionally powerful Divine Soul for a major event they were planning, so during my Divine Soul Transformation, they had me use that drop of blood," Xi Ying revealed openly.
"What major event, is there danger?" Yuan Ming's interest was piqued, and he probed further.
"There are naturally dangers, but that's a matter for the Xi Family and doesn't concern you, so don't inquire further," Xi Ying glanced at him and shook her head.
Yuan Ming frowned but refrained from pressing the matter.
"Don't worry, this matter will happen much later on. If you want to follow when the time comes, that's also alright," Xi Ying added after a moment's hesitation.
"What are the abilities of your Golden Crow Soul? From what I've seen a few times, it seems able to directly burn the opponent's Divine Soul," Yuan Ming, relieved after hearing her words, inquired further.
"The Soul Burning Divine Ability is the core power of the Golden Crow Soul," Xi Ying made a gesture, and a Three-legged Golden Crow emerged from her forehead and soared within the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space.
This was the first time Yuan Ming observed Xi Ying's Divine Soul Transformation closely. A violent and powerful wave of soul power erupted from the Golden Crow Soul, far exceeding his own soul crow.
"Such powerful soul power fluctuations — truly befitting the transformation of a Golden Crow," he couldn't help but praise.

chapters.title: Chapter 472 - 449: Living Peacefully in a World Apart
chapters.content:
"You needn't envy my Golden Crow Soul, as Soul Cultivation, Magic Practitioner, and Body Cultivation are different. Although the power of Divine Soul Transformation is important, versatility is of utmost significance. The White Feathered Crow you use for transformation is known for being a common demon beast that is renowned for its agility and versatility, which matches perfectly with Illusion Techniques, Emotion Control, and even later Sleep Witch Dreams among other Divine Skills. Solely in terms of potential, my Golden Crow Soul may not surpass your soul crow," said Xi Ying.
"So, you're saying that the White Feathered Crow is an excellent choice for Divine Soul Transformation, then why have I hardly seen any other Soul Cultivators assume its form?" Yuan Ming curiously asked.
"After transforming into the White Feathered Crow, the Divine Soul becomes agile and versatile, but the White Feathered Crow's strength is too weak, and its innate foundation is shallow, which makes it difficult to achieve great accomplishments later on. That's why hardly anyone chooses it. You are different, however, because the Stealing Heaven Tripod constantly nurtures your Divine Soul, giving you a strong foundation. Even transforming into a White Feathered Crow won't have much impact," explained Xi Ying.
Yuan Ming, having heard this, understood and slowly nodded.
The two chatted for a bit longer but did not stay in the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space for too long before quickly leaving.
Xi Ying, excusing himself to return to his room to cultivate, stood up to take his leave.
Yuan Ming sat quietly inside his room, his Divine Sense continuing to delve into the Jade Scroll, searching for a suitable island.
After a good hour, his eyebrows suddenly twitched, and he muttered to himself, "This place seems quite suitable."
Yuan Ming did not act immediately. He continued to check the Jade Scroll until the end and found no better island at which point he made up his mind.
