He only sent a message to Xi Ying, and just like when he arrived, he left Dragon King City silently and flew into the vast East Sea.
Time flew, and half a month passed.
Yuan Ming arrived at a third-class island in the northwest area of the East Sea, Evergreen Island.
Just as its name implied, Evergreen Island was lush with trees, abuzz with birds and fragrant with flowers, reminiscent of a paradise.
This was precisely the place he had carefully chosen, planning for his parents to settle down for their later years.
Underneath Evergreen Island, many coal and sulfur deposits were buried, and the climate was warm with spring lasting all year round. Moreover, the island was close to the mainland, with few storms and tsunamis, and the Cultivation forces on the island were unusually low-key. With no significant resources worth vying for, almost a century had passed without conflicts among Cultivators, making it very suitable for mortals to live.
Yuan Ming, having altered his appearance, purchased a secluded courtyard in a small mortal town on the island named Gu Town.
"Father, Mother, is this place passable for living in?" After everything was settled, Yuan Ming asked.
"It's lovely. The air is clear, the water is Blue, and the environment is more conducive to cultivation and nurturing than the Capital," Yuan Mu, who hailed from the Shengye Sect and had a fondness for arranging various gardens and flowers while in Yuan Mansion, was very satisfied with everything here.
Yuan Zuochong had no great demands for accommodation, and already quite admired the East Sea, so he was also very satisfied with the situation here.
Seeing this scene, Yuan Ming was also very happy. He arranged the household items brought from Yuan Mansion, and though the area was smaller than Yuan Mansion, it regained much of the old home's ambience.
Although Gu Town was far from being as prosperous as Da Jin Capital, it was not lacking in full-time and part-time labor. Yuan Ming hired two house servants, two cooks, and a maid to serve his parents.
The sudden appearance of a new family in Gu Town initially sparked the curiosity of nearby residents. However, the next day, people in the town interacted with the Yuan Family as if they had been neighbors for years, no longer pointing and inquiring, as if the Yuan family had lived there for many years.
At night, Yuan Ming used the Empty Gloves to alter the memories of everyone in the town, making them remember that the Yuan family had been living there for over a decade.
"Ming'er, is Soul Cultivation really so miraculous that one can easily alter others' memories?" Yuan Mu curiously asked.
"Soul Cultivation is different from Magic Practitioner, and it's more mysterious. Only when one has cultivated to a very profound realm can they edit another person's memories. I can't do it now; I need to rely on this Soul Cultivation magic treasure." Yuan Ming took out the Empty Gloves and briefly explained how they worked.
Yuan Mu curiously held it in her hand, flipping it over to examine.
"Mother, you don't have a Spirit Root, so you can't practice Magic Practitioner or Body Cultivation, but you could try Soul Cultivation. Although this method doesn't extend life, if you cultivate to a certain realm, I have ways to let you continue living in this world in an alternative form," Yuan Ming said.
If Yuan Mu could reach the first level of the Moonlight Technique, he would be able to use the Night Parade of Hundred Demons to refine her and transform her into a Ghost Spirit Body.
The ghost spirits from the Night Parade of Hundred Demons might not promise immortality, but living an extra two to three hundred years was still feasible.
"Ming'er, your intention is well-received, but I have no regrets in my life. Maybe in my youth, I might have wanted to venture into the world of Cultivators. Now, I no longer have that ambition; I just want to live out the rest of my days in peace," Yuan Mu returned the Empty Gloves and said.
"Ming'er, your mother and I have already discussed it. Being able to raise a Core Formation Stage cultivator like you, we have no regrets. You needn't spend too much effort on us," Yuan Zuochong said.
"Father, you possess a Spirit Root. With my current abilities, I'm fairly confident, if not in Core Formation, then at least in helping you to establish your foundation. If Mother can achieve success in Soul Cultivation, our family could enjoy another two hundred years together," Yuan Ming looked at his father and encouraged.
"If we could spend more time together, of course it would be ideal. However, your mother and I lack the ambition to traverse the world and witness the wonders you have. We simply desire a tranquil life. To us, the length of our lifespan doesn't really matter anymore; we just don't want to become too much of a burden. You needn't work too hard for my Foundation Establishment," Yuan Zuochong said with a carefree smile.
Yuan Ming looked at his father and then at his mother, and after a long silence, said, "You two just settle down here comfortably, and make sure to keep this jar of Spiritual Wine."
A green shadow flashed on the table next to him, and a light green wine jar appeared, about three feet tall.
Despite the sealed mouth of the jar, wisps of an invigorating scent still wafted out.
"What kind of wine is this?" Yuan Zuochong always appreciated fine liquor, and upon smelling this fragrance, the wine bug in his stomach began to stir.
Yuan Mu gave Yuan Zuochong a look, and he quickly suppressed his greedy appearance.
"This is a jar of Spiritual Wine I brewed with several types of Spirit Grass. Not only does it taste excellent, but it also has the effect of dredging the meridians and prolonging life," Yuan Ming said.
"This is really good stuff," Yuan Zuochong said as he picked up the jar and examined it closely.
Check for the latest updates on * (*).
"Ming'er has brought us Spiritual Wine, don't be careless and break it," Yuan Mu said reproachfully.
"Don't worry," Yuan Zuochong said nonchalantly, taking a large bowl, filling it, and draining it in one gulp.
"It really is good wine," Yuan Zuochong said with an intoxicated expression, unable to resist pouring himself another bowl.
"Father, this wine packs a strong punch, and the Spiritual Power within it is also very abundant. Drinking too much is actually not beneficial. You and mother should be fine with just a bowl each half-month," Yuan Ming hastily interjected.
The jar of Spiritual Wine might look unremarkable, but it was carefully brewed by him using Spirit Grasses that were hundreds of years old from the Shura Palace's Medicine Garden. Ordinary people and low-level cultivators couldn't consume too much, or they'd risk being overwhelmed by its potency.
"Only one bowl every half a month, that's not satisfying at all," Yuan Zuochong said with a look of disappointment.
"Evergreen Island has an abundance of grains and produces several fine liquors. If you're craving a drink, Father, you can try the excellent wines here, but you shouldn't drink too much of this jar of Spiritual Wine," Yuan Ming said with a smile.
"Alright," Yuan Zuochong agreed reluctantly.
"Mother, you should have a cup too. I remember you can hold your liquor quite well," Yuan Ming said, pouring a cup for his mother.
Yuan Mu didn't decline, and she took a small sip.
A surge of warmth rose from her lower abdomen and spread through her limbs, making her body feel much lighter.
The family, in high spirits, chatted merrily for much of the day.
Feeling a bit tired, Yuan Mu went inside to rest.
Curious about Evergreen Island, Yuan Zuochong went out to explore.
"Ming'er, we've settled in nicely here, and the townsfolk are simple and honest. There shouldn't be any trouble. If you have important matters to attend to, there's no need to stay here just to keep us company," Yuan Zuochong said.
"It's no trouble; I don't have any pressing matters lately. Moreover, I haven't been home for many years, and I've always felt guilty about it. Now that I finally have some free time, let me spend more of it with you two," Yuan Ming said.
"Ming'er, your filial piety is clear to your mother. However, if you truly want to do something for us, bring us a daughter-in-law and give us the joy of hugging a grandchild," Yuan Mu said with a smile.
At the mention of this, Yuan Ming was taken aback, his mind unwilfully flashing with the image of Xi Ying.
"Matters of marriage are not to be taken lightly. I'm still considering it, and besides, it also requires the other party's consent."
"So you do have someone in mind? What kind of girl is she?" Yuan Mu's eyes sparkled as she sat up excitedly.
Yuan Ming forced a wry smile and somehow managed to calm his mother's enthusiasm.
He stayed with his mother for a while, waiting until she fell asleep, then rose to go to the side hall.
Though Yuan Father and Yuan Mu seemed to have accepted moving to Evergreen Island, he could sense an underlying lack of comfort in them.
He had made a promise to Xi Ying for a year later. Yuan Ming planned to accompany his parents for a year, to fulfill his filial duties.
In this year, he naturally wouldn't neglect his cultivation.
First, Yuan Ming went through his routine practice of the Incense Xiang Bone Forging Skill, then he took out a stack of Array Flag Array Plates and laid them out in various spots in the room, forming the Five Elements Illusion Destruction Array.
Though Evergreen Island was but a small island in the East Sea, as it concerned the safety of his parents, he didn't want to leave any flaws exposed.
After setting up the Five Elements Illusion Destruction Array, Yuan Ming sat cross-legged on the bed, took out the Stealing Heaven Tripod, and began to refine Desire Power.
Owing to the Yan sisters, everyone in Hundred Pills Square had now become followers of the Moon Sect. There were six at the Foundation Establishment Stage, more than thirty in the Qi Refinement Realm, and although their levels of devotion varied, overall, the Desire Power transmitted to him had increased significantly.
Furthermore, with the investment of resources, Xu Che's efforts in recruiting followers were going smoothly. Alongside ordinary believers, several cultivators had joined the faith. Unfortunately, the distance from the East Sea to the Black Wind Desert was too great, and a lot of the Desire Power dissipated during transmission.
If Yuan Ming could successfully cultivate to the later stages of being a Love Witch, and then strive for a few more years to reach the peak, he could attempt to break through to the Sleep Witch Realm.
As long as he could reach the Sleep Witch Realm and combine it with the Desire Power within the White Jade Lotus Platform inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod, he was confident he could face anyone on the Yunhuang Continent!

chapters.title: Chapter 473 - 450 Soul Split
chapters.content:
Half a year later.
In the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space, Yuan Ming sat cross-legged on the ground beside an altar, with the Night Parade of Hundred Demons floating above his head, slowly rotating, as twelve soul crows circled and danced around him.
These soul crows, both in speed and agility, were much stronger than before.
Yuan Ming abruptly opened his eyes and raised a hand to give a light wave.
The twelve soul crows cried out in unison, but the black sound waves of the past did not appear. Instead, the space nearby suddenly revealed a boundless grassland, with lush grass and towering trees, complete with sounds of birds and beasts roaring from afar, no different from reality.
Yuan Ming took out the Soul Destroying Sword with a flip of his hand and slashed.
A sword qi tens of yards long viciously cleaved the nearby void. The Illusion Space trembled slightly but immediately returned to stability.
"Fusing the Illusion Power of the All Living Beings Dream Rune with the Crow Formation turned out to be quite difficult. It took me half a year to achieve it, but the result is worthy of my efforts. Not only is the casting more concealed, but the Illusion Space has also become much more stable. Even if the Sleeping Witch were trapped, it would be hard to get out in a short period," Yuan Ming was very satisfied with the power of the Illusion Space before him.
If he used the power of the White Jade Lotus Platform as well, not even the Sleeping Witch could hope to escape from here.
Yuan Ming checked the other aspects of the Illusion Space and was very pleased with all of them.
He unraveled the Illusion Space to return to the Stealing Heaven Tripod, preparing to leave when his expression suddenly shifted. He picked up a Spiritual Beast Bag from his waist.
The Spiritual Beast Bag bulged, its surface flickering with faint purple arcs of electricity.
"After such a long time, has it finally made a breakthrough?" Seeing this, Yuan Ming's face lit up with joy.
The occupant of the Spiritual Beast Bag was Lei Yu, who had endured three months of arduous cultivation within Shura Palace, absorbing the power of thunder and lightning for the same duration.
The Thunder Seal, a treasure of Nascent Soul cultivators, contained immensely powerful thunder and lightning energy. Although it wasn't as pure as the thunder and lightning from the Thunder God Hammer, it was certainly enough for Lei Yu, whose strength soared rapidly, reaching the Second Rank Upper Stage.
Lei Yu was Yuan Ming's mount. Since Shura Palace was hard to relocate, he had placed Lei Yu into the Spiritual Beast Bag upon leaving the palace and let it continue to absorb the Power of thunder and lightning from the Thunder Seal.
Seeing the situation now, it seemed to be on the cusp of another advancement, breaking into the third level.
The demon power of a third-level spirit beast was no small matter. The Spiritual Beast Bag couldn't support it; taking Lei Yu to somewhere near Evergreen Island for breakthrough would certainly not go unnoticed.
Even if he managed to cover it up, he couldn't guarantee there wouldn't be slip-ups, which could lead to unnecessary troubles.
Yuan Ming pondered for a moment, then once again stimulated the All Living Beings Dream Rune and the Crow Formation. The environment inside Stealing Heaven Tripod Space transformed dramatically, turning into a vast sea area, with salty sea breezes and waves crashing rhythmically.
He urged the Spiritual Beast Bag, and Lei Yu's figure appeared in mid-air, surrounded by a dense cluster of black thunderclouds, with blinding arcs of electricity darting within, producing terrifying roars.
From the aura of demon energy emanating from Lei Yu, it indeed had reached the peak of the second level, fluctuating violently, ready to break through to the third level realm at any moment.
The Thunder Seal also floated within the black thunderclouds, continuing to release threads of pure thunder and lightning.
After such a long period of absorption, the Power of thunder and lightning within the Thunder Seal had been consumed by more than half, but it was still enough to support Lei Yu's breakthrough.
Yuan Ming waved his hands, and the Spiritual Energy in the space slowly flowed, converging towards Lei Yu bit by bit.
He had begun to refine Stealing Heaven Tripod, enabling him to slightly control the Spiritual Power contained within this space.
Time ticked away, and soon most of the day had passed. Lei Yu's demon energy was still rising and falling dramatically, but it couldn't make the breakthrough to the third level.
"Why is it like this? Could it be that the Spiritual Energy in Stealing Heaven Tripod Space is insufficient?" Yuan Ming furrowed his brow.
The Stealing Heaven Tripod Space was not large, and the Spiritual Energy it contained was not particularly dense, which indeed was not conducive to breakthroughs.
However, he quickly came up with an idea and took out an item with a flip of his hand. It was the Third-level Peak Thunder Attribute Demon Core he had obtained from Cha Yancai's storage magic tool, and he threw it into the black clouds.
Not only did this Demon Core contain powerful Power of thunder and lightning, but it also contained pure demon energy, making it very suitable for the current situation.
In the Cultivation World, it was a common practice for spirit beasts facing a bottleneck in strength to use a Demon Core of the same attribute to assist with breakthroughs.
* (*) hosts the original.
Lei Yu let out a joyous chirp, grasped the Demon Core in its mouth, and swallowed it down to refine the demon energy within.
The demon energy inside the black clouds quickly became denser. The Power of thunder and lightning surged once more, and ordinary lightning began to show dazzling golden arcs.
With the support of the demon energy from the Demon Core, Lei Yu's breath steadily climbed.
Seeing this sight, Yuan Ming settled down, took a seat on the White Jade Lotus Platform, and kept an eye on Lei Yu, ready to assist at any moment.
Half a day later, the sounds of thunder roared tremendously as the black thunderclouds in mid-air suddenly expanded several times, covering a span of more than ten miles in the sky. The aura from inside the clouds finally broke through to the third level realm.
Boom!
Dozens of thick bolts of lightning fell from the clouds, striking the sea below, creating a rain of thunder and lightning.
The sea beneath burst open, throwing up waves several yards high, followed by the emergence of countless foam and arcs of electricity darting through the water, stirring up waves of after-effects.
Everything within this space is a simulation of the outside real world, and the effects of the thunderstorm and thunder attacks are basically true.
A loud and clear shriek rose from within the dark clouds, filled with joy.
Yuan Ming's mouth curved into a smile; although Lei Yu's potential was not as great as that of Vajra or Hua Zhi, it still had value for training and had not disappointed him.
The dark clouds in midair did not dissipate but continued to churn for half a day before retracting like a long whale sucking in water.
Lei Yu's figure appeared, its size more than doubled than before, with a longer beak and claws, especially its talons, which flickered with a sharp cold light as if they could tear through any obstacle.
Its most significant transformation was the thunder patterns on its body, which became even more distinct, especially the wing-shaped thunder patterns on its wings, making it look as if it had grown an additional pair of wings.
"Master... Master..." Lei Yu turned its head toward Yuan Ming, flapped its wings, and disappeared into thin air, immediately reappearing beside Yuan Ming like instantaneous movement.
Lei Yu looked surprised, as if it was not yet accustomed to its own speed.
"You can speak now? Your speed has also increased significantly. Not bad, it seems like after advancing to the third-level, your strength has improved a lot," Yuan Ming nodded and said.
"All thanks to the... Demon Core Master just gave me... Nearly half of the demonic power from that core is still within my body... The Thunder Strike Treasure too, after completely refining the power of thunder and lightning within these two, I should be able to reach the Third-level Middle Stage," Lei Yu initially spoke with some hesitation but soon became fluent.
Yuan Ming hummed in response, then began to inquire about Lei Yu's ability changes after the breakthrough.
Lei Yu's Divine Abilities were still the same three as before, but their power had greatly increased.
Thunder Strike Divine Ability's power had surged several times, and possibly due to refining the Demon Core at the Third-level Peak, the Thunder Strikes that Lei Yu emitted were no longer ordinary thunder and lightning but were mixed with the Golden Thunder contained within the Demon Core.
The power of Golden Thunder far surpassed the thunder and lightning Lei Yu had mastered before and had a feeling of pure Yang that banished evil, significantly increasing the damage dealt to Yin Spirit Ghosts and the like.
"This Golden Thunder is somewhat similar to the power of thunder and lightning in the rune Shura Master gave to Xi Ying; could it be that the two have the same origin?" Yuan Ming thought to himself.
Unfortunately, his understanding of the power of thunder and lightning was limited, and he could only wait to slowly consult the classics and investigate later.
Like Thunder Strike, the range and power of Lei Yu's ability to summon thunderclouds also improved to varying degrees.
Yuan Ming had the Thunder God Hammer, so he was not particularly concerned about these two abilities of Lei Yu; what he cared most about was Lei Yu's flying Divine Ability.
Once Lei Yu became accustomed to its own speed, it carried Yuan Ming to trial fly in the Illusion Space.
After the breakthrough to the third level, Lei Yu's tunneling speed had greatly increased, especially after activating the wing-shaped thunder patterns on its wings. Wrapped in the power of thunder and lightning, Lei Yu could cross distances of a hundred yards in an instant.
One could see an arc-encased shadow appearing far away above the sea one moment and disappearing close by the next, flickering erratically as if a ghostly specter.
"Haha, after Lei Yu's breakthrough to the third level, its tunneling speed is truly exquisite, almost comparable to the legendary Thunder Escape," Yuan Ming felt exhilarated and exclaimed with great joy.
With Lei Yu's current tunneling speed, let alone Core Formation Stage cultivators, even those Nascent Souls would have difficulty catching up if they were not skilled in Escape Techniques.
"Well done, Lei Yu. Continue to cultivate inside the Spiritual Beast Bag, absorb the power of thunder and lightning from the Demon Core and the Thunder Strike Treasure, and strive to break through to the Third-level Middle Stage as soon as possible," Yuan Ming encouraged.
Lei Yu, planning to continue its arduous cultivation, offered no objection and flew back into the Spiritual Beast Bag.
Yuan Ming dispelled the illusion and left the Stealing Heaven Tripod, heading outside.
He did not continue to cultivate, but instead went to visit his parents, where laughter and cheerful voices soon followed.
Cultivation could happen at any time; during his stay on Evergreen Island, his main focus was to accompany his parents.
When he was a teenager, he yearned to grow up every day, yearning for strength, but now, that yearning has turned into worry; worried that his own strength was insufficient to protect his parents, worried that his parents were aging, he wished that time could slow down a little, to give him more time to spend with his elders, and to become strong enough to better protect them.
In the blink of an eye, another half a year passed, and the day of his appointment with Xi Ying was near.
Despite his reluctance, Yuan Ming had no choice but to part from his parents.
However, before leaving, he still needed to make some preparations.
Yuan Ming sat cross-legged in his residence, his hands moving through gestures like turning wheels, finally stopping abruptly and touching his temples; his Divine Soul within the Sea of Consciousness slowly undulated.
"Soul Split!"
He gritted his teeth, uttered a low shout, and a piece of his Sea of Consciousness's Divine Soul suddenly split off, forming a fist-sized black sphere containing a faint image of Yuan Ming's face.
What Yuan Ming was performing was the "Soul Splitting and Soul Merging Technique" taught to him by Shura Master, attempting to split off a soul that was one with his own.
An excruciating pain erupted from his Sea of Consciousness!
Yuan Ming's head felt as if it had been cleaved in two with a blunt ax, and even his strong will teetered on the edge of endurance; his entire body collapsed to the ground, clutching his head and screaming in agony, curling up and rolling uncontrollably.
Not only was there physical pain, but the two Divine Souls in his Sea of Consciousness were also trembling violently, like flames swaying in a gale, as if they could be extinguished at any moment.

chapters.title: Chapter 474 - 451: Red Mulberry Immortal Fruit
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming, enduring heart-wrenching pain, focused his mind and began communicating with the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
Before long, a stream of warmth flowed from inside the tripod, splitting into two and merging into the two Divine Souls.
The originally trembling main soul and clone stabilized immediately, the chaotic Soul Power rapidly steadied, and the insanity-inducing pain greatly decreased.
Yuan Ming felt a slight relief in his heart. The Desire Power's warm flow from the Stealing Heaven Tripod was indeed extremely effective in healing the wounds of the Divine Soul. The most difficult hurdle had passed.
He took a deep breath, forcefully propping himself up into a sitting position, and continued to rapidly form hand signs.
The split clone quickly stabilized, Yuan Ming's appearance within the light sphere became clearer, and the Six Senses of the main soul were also connected to it.
After a long half-day, Yuan Ming walked out with a pale face but with an uncontrollable excitement in his expression.
This time, the application of the Soul Splitting and Soul Merging Technique was very smooth. He had now split off a completely concentric clone, laying a solid foundation for a future breakthrough into the Nascent Soul Stage.
Zuo Qinghui walked out with him from the inner room, his eyes lively, clearly with another clone controlled by him.
The clone controlled within Zuo Qinghui was precisely the third clone just split off by using the Soul Splitting and Soul Merging Technique.
Although this clone had already stabilized, it still needed to painstakingly cultivate the Moonlight Technique to solidify completely.
"From now on, I'll be counting on you," Yuan Ming told Zuo Qinghui.
He planned to leave both Zuo Qinghui and the third clone on Evergreen Island. Since the potential of this embodiment of Zuo Qinghui was not high, continuing to take it with him was of no great use. It would be better to leave it to protect his parents.
With Zuo Qinghui's Foundation Establishment Stage cultivation level, coupled with the clone and a large array of Magic Artifacts and talismans left by Yuan Ming, even facing a Core Formation Stage cultivator, there would be no problem protecting his parents for a short duration.
Moreover, this third clone also needed time to recuperate, and Evergreen Island was just the right place.
"You and I share one heart, there is no need for such words. Leave the care of the elders to me," Zuo Qinghui spoke, a flash of yellow light passed over his body, and he submerged into the ground.
Yuan Ming closed his eyes for Breathing Control, absorbing Desire Power to restore his Divine Soul. His pale complexion rapidly revived. He headed to the main hall outside.
Yuan Zuochong and Yuan Mu were already waiting there, knowing that Yuan Ming was about to leave.
"Father, Mother, your son has been unfilial, unable to keep you company for long," Yuan Ming said somberly.
"What nonsense are you talking? Even a fledgling eagle will leave the nest when it grows up, aiming to soar in the vast sky. Ming'er, you have already carved out your own piece of the sky, how could you stay with us old folks forever?" Yuan Zuochong said.
"Ming'er, you have been with us for a year, and we are already very satisfied. Go and do your own things. If there is a chance, come back later," Yuan Mu said tenderly, patting Yuan Ming's head.
"Yes, I will strive to handle things quickly and come back to continue serving you," Yuan Ming said.
"Good, we will wait for your early return," Yuan Mu said, tears flickering in her eyes.
"Zuo Qinghui is my clone, hiding here. If you have any matters, just order him to do it," Yuan Ming knelt down before his parents, kowtowed, and his figure flickered, vanishing into thin air.
Yuan Zuochong and Yuan Mu stared at the empty ground, their expressions filled with melancholy.
...
Dragon King City.
Merely a year had passed, but when Yuan Ming returned, he found the Hundred Pills Square premises had changed significantly from the past.
Originally, the premises had only one building resembling an inn, but now, closer to the street, another four-story building had risen sharply, constructed of blue bricks and tiles, with exterior decorations that appeared rather modest and elegant.
The walls and roofs of the original building were also renovated. While the materials were not as good as the new building, the style had been unified.
The new building seemed to be used for receiving guests daily. A large golden nanmu plaque hung above the front door, inscribed with the words "Hundred Pills Square" in a script that seemed to be from a famous hand. Even with Yuan Ming's calligraphy skills, he could not find any faults.
As he crossed the threshold, he saw that the interior was much more spacious than it appeared from the outside. The furnishings inside were also simple and elegant. The shelves were neatly arranged with porcelain bottles containing elixirs, each bottle marked by a flaming elixir symbol. While it did not enhance the potency of the pills, such uniformity elevated the grade of the elixirs being sold.
Inside the shop, many attendants in light blue long gowns embroidered with the elixir symbol were busy organizing and stocking shelves. They looked very busy, but on closer inspection, Yuan Ming noticed that there seemed to be very few customers in the store.
As they say, all beginnings are difficult. Yuan Ming did not expect Hundred Pills Square to be thriving immediately after opening, but having invested money and seeing such sparse customer flow in such a large shop, he felt slightly discontented.
At the same time, the shop assistants inside also noticed new customers entering. Most of them were newly hired, so they did not recognize Yuan Ming's identity. One of them approached to greet the arrivals.
Before he could speak, he suddenly saw Yuan Ming wave his hand, indicating that he wanted to browse alone, so he tactfully retreated.
However, when Yuan Ming attempted to enter the manor directly, he suddenly noticed that the manor was enveloped by a formation. The quality of the formation seemed rather high. Although he could break it, it would inevitably cause some disturbance.
This practice of separating a customer-facing shop from the living area made Yuan Ming nod in approval internally. However, the thought that this was his own territory and that he couldn't even enter the door after being away for only a year caused him to touch his nose unconsciously.
Just then, Yuan Ming suddenly saw a young girl in white emerging from behind the shop. It was Yan Sijing.
She walked into the shop and looked up to see Yuan Ming, her eyes instantly brightening.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan," Yan Sijing smiled, "my sister just mentioned that you might return in a few days and asked me to wait for you here in the shop. I didn't expect to meet you so soon."
Yuan Ming nodded, "Indeed, it's a coincidence. How about Xi Ying? Is she still in the manor?"
"Yes, Sister Xi Ying is in her residence, in deep meditation practice. She also instructed that if you returned, you could go directly to see her," she said.
As she spoke, Yan Sijing took out a token from her storage bag, "Fellow Daoist Yuan, my sister purchased a formation set for protection four months ago. Take good care of this entry token."
Yuan Ming took the token and then chatted with Yan Sijing as they walked.Chapter source: * (*).
"The shop doesn't seem to have many customers. Didn't you do any advertising when you opened?" Yuan Ming asked.
Yan Sijing felt a bit wronged as she responded, "We did advertise, but there are already numerous shops selling elixirs in Dragon King City. Being new with limited resources and not having any distinctive elixirs to offer, it's truly hard to make a name for ourselves. My sister is also worried about this."
Yuan Ming furrowed his brows slightly, acknowledging the truth in Yan Sijing's words. In the East Sea, the market for elixirs was just so big. Opening a shop without any unique features could perhaps maintain a balance of income and expenses through other means, but it would be difficult to grow significantly.
Putting aside the reasons that Xi Ying supported the Hundred Pills Square, since Yuan Ming had invested in it, he naturally had certain expectations for Hundred Pills Square and would not just watch idly.
"Fellow Daoist Yan, later arrange to find a few trustworthy people who are clever. It's not necessary for them to know alchemy, but having some basic skills would be best. Later, I will teach them how to make Spirit Incense. The shop can bundle Spirit Incense and Spirit Pills for sale, which could serve as a unique feature," Yuan Ming said.
"Spirit Incense? I think I've heard of that, but it seems its effects aren't as good as those of elixirs. Can it really attract customers?" Yan Sijing asked, blinking her beautiful eyes with some concern.
"Heh, people always like a little advantage," Yuan Ming chuckled, "especially Loose Cultivators who are more frugal with their Spirit Stones. Say a pill costs ten Spirit Stones, they might find it expensive. But if you offer them an extra stick of Spirit Incense, even if the total cost doesn't reach ten Spirit Stones, they'll think it's a good deal."
Yan Sijing nodded thoughtfully, memorizing Yuan Ming's words, then hurried off to arrange for the staff and to relay Yuan Ming's suggestions to Yan Siyun.
Soon, Yuan Ming arrived outside the room where Xi Ying was staying. Just as he was about to knock, the door opened by itself, and Xi Ying was already sitting at the table, her eyes fixed on him.
"Long time no see." Yuan Ming smiled as he entered the room, feeling a slight fragrance in the air.
"Are your parents well settled?" Xi Ying asked.
Yuan Ming sat by the table and poured himself a cup of tea. "Yes, I chose an inconspicuous island and left a soul split there to guard it. How about here, are we ready to collect that spiritual material?"
"Almost, we can set off tomorrow," Xi Ying nodded.
"Where exactly is it?" Yuan Ming asked, his expression altering.
"Remember the Fusang Divine Tree mentioned in the information you looked at last time? The spiritual material we need is the Red Mulberry Immortal Fruit that grows on that tree. This fruit is extremely precious: the flesh, core, and even the stem can all be used as materials for refining Nascent Soul Stage elixirs, and the fruit only ripens once every three hundred years, with only twenty-one fruits each time," Xi Ying explained slowly.
"Such a divine item must have many contenders. I'm afraid they are mostly Nascent Soul cultivators. It seems we will have to go to some lengths to acquire it," Yuan Ming frowned.
"That's not necessarily the case. Since the Fusang Divine Tree is occupied by Fusang Island and protected by the Golden Crow, other islands cannot forcefully take it. They can only obtain it through exchanges of interest. Fusang Island thrives and prospers for thousands of years because of this," Xi Ying said.
"How does the exchange work? Tell me more," Yuan Ming's brow rose slightly, asking.
"The Red Mulberry Immortal Fruit is ultimately limited. Over time, a tradition has formed. Every three hundred years, when the Red Mulberry Immortal Fruit ripens, Fusang Island hosts an Immortal Fruit Conference, inviting the Eastern Sea Islands to participate. The fruits are distributed by lottery and competition, ultimately deciding the top sixteen islands. These islands each receive a Red Mulberry Immortal Fruit, and of course, the required exchanges of interest still take place. They are merely competing for eligibility," Xi Ying explained.
Yuan Ming nodded thoughtfully, "So, we just need to be among the top sixteen? But it seems that participating in the Immortal Fruit Conference requires representing an island. Under what identity should we join? Also, will Nascent Soul cultivators participate?"
"You needn't worry about that. Although the Immortal Fruit Conference only allows the Eastern Sea Islands to participate, it doesn't require the on-stage competitors to be the direct disciples of those islands. Apart from Nascent Soul cultivators, the islands can send any cultivator to fight. However, a single person can only fight once, win or lose, and cannot compete again," Xi Ying said with a smile.
"That's a relief," Yuan Ming breathed a sigh of relief.
(There have been many events recently, but Wang Yu will try to ensure stable updates)

chapters.title: Chapter 475 - 452: Inner Sea? Outer Sea?
chapters.content:
"But this only applies to the battles that determine the top sixteen. After the top sixteen have been decided, the Immortal Fruit Conference will move onto the next stage of competition, where the specifics of each competition vary and aren't necessarily in the style of an arena match. However, our goal is the Red Mulberry Immortal Fruit, so once we've successfully broken into the top sixteen, whether we continue to strive for a higher ranking isn't as important. Besides, since the battles to determine the top sixteen are a single-match victory and elimination system, losing just once means a complete loss of eligibility, so every time the Immortal Fruit Conference comes around, each island will recruit powerful Loose Cultivators to ensure they have commendable candidates for every match," Xi Ying continued.
"What do you need me to do?" Yuan Ming asked.
"I've already made arrangements in advance. When the time comes, we will represent a second-class island known as Red Ganoderma Island in the conference. With the strength of you and me, winning the championship wouldn't be difficult, let alone merely getting into the top sixteen to secure trading rights," Xi Ying said confidently.
Yuan Ming, hearing that she had everything arranged, said no more and simply chatted briefly about the situation with Hundred Pills Square.
"Not bad, the profits from Incense Making have even caught the attention of Core Formation Stage cultivators from Chang Chun Temple. It's a good way to boost the reputation of Hundred Pills Square," said Xi Ying, nodding in approval when she learned that Yuan Ming intended to reveal his Incense Making skills.
While Yuan Ming empathized, he suddenly paused.
"How did you come to know of this?" Yuan Ming asked in surprise.
"Hmph, I naturally have my channels of intelligence. Speaking of which, you seem to have used one of the three Green Spirit Communication Talismans I gave you earlier. Although I sensed it at the time, I couldn't make out what you were saying due to the distance. Judging by the timing, it seems to coincide with when you were in Thunder Continent. So, what was it you wanted to say then?" Xi Ying thought for a moment before asking in return.
Recalling the situation at the time, Yuan Ming's face showed a hint of embarrassment, and he didn't have the heart to disclose what he had been thinking, simply saying vaguely, "At that time I encountered a disciple of Xi Cangqiong, and I wanted to ask if you had any methods to break Illusion Techniques. Nothing else really."
Xi Ying looked at Yuan Ming with suspicion, but at that moment, the voice of Yan Siyun came from outside.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, Fellow Daoist Xi, may I come in now?"
Xi Ying glanced at Yuan Ming, saw him nod, and with a wave of her hand, the door opened again. Yan Siyun, sensing this with her Divine Sense, also entered the room and bowed to Yuan Ming and Xi Ying.
"Sorry to intrude. Just now, my younger sister told me that Fellow Daoist Yuan has a brilliant strategy for attracting business. I couldn't wait and wanted to ask for details, please forgive the bother," Yan Siyun said slowly.
"It's fine. We were just discussing that. I've explained the general situation to your sister, if you have any questions, Fellow Daoist Yan, you may ask them directly," Yuan Ming said, raising his hand to indicate Yan Siyun should sit down.
Yan Siyun nodded, took a seat, and went straight to the point: "I wonder about the Spirit Incense mentioned by Fellow Daoist Yuan. How high is the threshold for making it, what's the value of spiritual materials needed, how much can it be sold for, and how does its effect compare to elixirs?"
"The making of Spirit Incense is not difficult, the threshold is much lower than Alchemy, as for the used spiritual materials..." Yuan Ming went on at length.
Having had practical experience with these matters before, he was not unfamiliar with them. Since everyone present was not an outsider, he did not hold back, explaining all the aspects of Incense Making Skill he mastered.
Yan Siyun listened in silence, weighing the pros and cons of also selling Spirit Incense.
Meanwhile, Xi Ying, utterly bored, yawned and began cultivating quietly, uninterested in what Yuan Ming was discussing.
After a long discussion, Yuan Ming and Yan Siyun finally settled all the details concerning the sale of Spirit Incense.
"... For the next few days, you arrange some manpower and prepare the necessary spiritual materials. Once Xiying and I return from the Immortal Fruit Conference, I will take some time to personally teach them how to make incense, starting with Qi Refinement Realm Spirit Incense. It will not take much time for them to be proficient," Yuan Ming said.
However, Yan Siyun was surprised to hear this, "Fellow Daoist Yuan and Fellow Daoist Xi are also going to attend the Immortal Fruit Conference?"
"Also? Do you mean to say that you plan to compete in the Immortal Fruit Conference as well?" Yuan Ming asked, puzzled.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan misunderstands. During the period when the Immortal Fruit Conference is convened, with all the major islands gathered at Fusang Island for an event that occurs once every three hundred years, there will be activities beyond the competition, such as auctions. I initially planned to take my younger sister and some of the people from Hundred Pills Square to shop for spiritual materials and to spread our fame. If we can use this opportunity to secure some deals with other islands, that would be even better," Yan Siyun explained.
"I see. In that case, let's put the Spirit Incense matter aside for now. You should also start preparing; we'll set off together, it will be safer on the road," Yuan Ming said, nodding.
He glanced at Xi Ying, wanting to get her opinion.
Xi Ying, feeling his gaze, came back to reality, and after Yuan Ming repeated the matter, she waved her hand indifferently, "That's fine. Everything with Red Ganoderma Island has been settled. Being a few days late won't matter."
...This chapter first appeared on *.
Several days later.
Thick grey clouds blanketed the sea, and torrential rain fell like curtains, obscuring everything between heaven and earth. The raindrops, large as beans, plummeted towards the sea, only to be devoured by the crashing waves before they could touch down.
The howling wind whipped up waves tens of feet high, reaching for the sky with magnificent force, as though intending to tear the clouds apart.
Amidst the dark clouds, a small white boat slowly navigated through. Neither the violent rain nor the fierce wind could reach it. Before touching the boat, an invisible force pushed them aside, leaving it untouched.
At the bow of the small boat, Yuan Ming stood alone, his gaze sweeping the surroundings before suddenly looking off into the horizon, lost in a fixed stare.
"What are you looking at?" Suddenly, Xi Ying approached from behind and casually asked.
"The scenery," Yuan Ming returned to his senses and smiled.
Xi Ying walked up beside him and looked around, somewhat speechlessly, "What's so good about a storm?"
"The waves deep in the East Sea are much more fierce than I imagined. Does such a scene occur often here?" Yuan Ming asked.
"It's not common, but it's not rare either. Fusang Island is still in the Inner Sea. The waves in the outer sea deep in the East Sea are towering, far more intense than this," Xi Ying shook her head.
"Inner Sea? Outer Sea?" Yuan Ming was taken aback, these two terms were not mentioned in the Jade Scroll Yan Siyun had given him.
"The East Sea has thousands of third-class islands, over a hundred second-class islands, and thirteen first-class islands close to the mainland with relatively calm environments, which are known as the Inner Sea; the sea areas beyond the Inner Sea are called the Outer Sea. The distinction between the Inner and Outer Seas is arbitrarily made by the East Sea Demon Hunting Cultivators and rarely appears in the classics. It's normal for Yan Siyun, who hasn't been in the East Sea for long, to not know about these," Xi Ying explained.
"Have you been to the Outer Sea?" Yuan Ming asked.
"I went once before with the elders of my clan," Xi Ying looked off into the distance.
"What's the situation like in the Outer Sea?" Yuan Ming's curiosity piqued.
"It's much harsher than the Inner Sea, with giant waves touching the sky, fierce storms and thunder, common occurrences there. There are also the Mist Sea, Song Demons, and other more dangerous disasters. However, the spiritual materials in the sea there are superior to those in the Inner Sea. Especially abundant are demon beasts, with third-level and even fourth-level ones aplenty. Core Formation Stage cultivators can't survive in the Outer Sea without banding together, or without the leadership of a Nascent Soul cultivator," Xi Ying spoke confidently.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming's interest in the Outer Sea grew considerably.
An area where even fourth-level demon beasts were common; one couldn't help wonder what it was like.
"The Outer Sea is where the resources of the East Sea are densely collected. After the Immortal Fruit Conference, we might as well go there and see, hunt some demon beasts and accumulate some wealth. Don't think that having over a million Spirit Stones makes you rich; those Demon Hunting Cultivators who frequent the Outer Sea are almost all as wealthy as you are," Xi Ying said again, eager to try.
"Sure," Yuan Ming agreed readily.
With his and Xi Ying's strength, even if they encountered several fourth-level demon beasts, there was no need to fear. He also had the Stealing Heaven Tripod, a treasure with which he could hide if they were unable to win.
There was no need to worry about demon beasts seeing the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
But compared to the Outer Sea, he was more interested in the Overseas World.
"Xi Ying, is the world beyond the Outer Sea the Overseas World?" Yuan Ming asked.
"Exactly," Xi Ying nodded.
"I heard from Shura Master that the Overseas World is not only dangerous but also possesses exotic treasures not found on the Yunhuang Continent. Are there cultivators here in the East Sea who explore the Overseas World?" Yuan Ming inquired.
"Of course, there are," said Xi Ying.
"Really?" Yuan Ming was surprised.
"They're called Tide Makers, and their numbers are extremely scarce. To my knowledge, there are only about a dozen. Most are solitary wanderers. Each Tide Maker is incredibly powerful, and even the powers on first-class islands of the East Sea do not want to provoke them casually," said Xi Ying solemnly, seeming to hold a certain wariness toward these Tide Makers.
"Tide Makers? That name is quite novel," Yuan Ming remarked.
"The moniker of the Tide Makers originated from a legendary Scatter Alliance in the East Sea a thousand years ago—the Tide-rider Alliance, composed of cultivators who dared to explore the Overseas World. They had ventured deep into the Overseas World several times, securing many exotic treasures. At its peak, the Tide-rider Alliance was so powerful that even Nascent Soul cultivators numbered five or six," Xi Ying shared.
"Five or six Nascent Soul cultivators! The strength of the Tide-rider Alliance was almost comparable to that of a major Cultivation Sect," Yuan Ming said in astonishment.
"Yes, at the time even Fusang Island had to be wary of the Tide-rider Alliance, engaging with them strategically to acquire some treasures from the Overseas World. However, those who walk by the river often get their shoes wet. After the last voyage of the Tide-rider Alliance, they vanished without a trace, and the entire group perished. But their deeds were passed down, and the later cultivators exploring the Overseas World declared themselves as Tide Makers," Xi Ying stated indifferently.
"I see," Yuan Ming responded.
"Despite the downfall of the Tide-rider Alliance, it sparked an upsurge among the East Sea cultivators to explore the Overseas World. Before their emergence, the Overseas World was a place of death for East Sea cultivators, whom none dares to approach. The harvests of the Tide-rider Alliance greatly stimulated some desperate cultivators in the East Sea, and over the years, some Tide Makers have emerged, although they also dare only skirt the edges of the Overseas World and cannot compare to either the Tide-rider Alliance or the Shura Master," Xi Ying elaborated.

chapters.title: Chapter 476 - 453: First Arrival in Fusang
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming nodded slightly, looking up at the sky, his gaze seemingly piercing through the clouds to see the distant overseas world.
"If you're curious about the overseas world, when we go demon hunting in the outer sea, we can take a detour and explore a bit. However, neither of us has condensed a Nascent Soul yet, and relying solely on the Soul Cultivation Divine Power of a Sleeping Witch is far from sufficient for venturing overseas. It's best not to go too deep," Xi Ying said upon seeing this.
"The outer sea region must also be vast, right? Although we have the Stealing Heaven Tripod, attempting to cross the outer sea is still too risky," Yuan Ming furrowed his brows.
"The outer sea is extremely vast, far surpassing the Inner Sea. Even with flying escape, it would probably take years. However, on Fusang Island, there's an ancient transmission array that can send people directly to an island close to the overseas world. Those Tide Makers who go to the overseas world also often use this ancient transmission array," Xi Ying explained.
"An ancient transmission array! That's great. With this array, we can take a peek at the overseas," Yuan Ming said joyfully.
At that moment, the dark clouds in mid-air suddenly surged, and streaks of blinding thunder and lightning appeared from nowhere, like electric snakes weaving through the air, their range growing wider and wider.
"Not good, a thunderstorm is coming!" Xi Ying's expression changed slightly, and she gestured at the Flying Boat beneath them.
Thunderstorms are one of the natural disasters in the East Sea, forming in the midst of fierce winds and heavy rains. Their power mainly depends on the size of the thunderclouds. A minor thunderstorm can be barely withstood by Foundation Establishment Cultivators, while a large-scale thunderstorm must not be taken lightly even by Nascent Soul cultivators.
The bright white Flying Boat descended towards the seabed, and a blue light screen emerged around it, quickly closing up.
Yuan Ming's figure suddenly shot out, flying out just before the blue light screen completely sealed shut.
"What are you doing? The power of this thunderstorm is no small affair. Even you would be in great danger if caught up in it," Xi Ying, manipulating the Flying Boat, stopped.
"Don't worry, this amount of thunder and lightning can't hurt me. The Power of Thunder and Lightning in the Thunder God Hammer was depleted when dealing with Free Venerable earlier. Since the thunderstorm is coming my way, I'll take the opportunity to absorb some," Yuan Ming replied through sound transmission, his figure flickering and vanishing into the dark clouds in mid-air.
Seeing this, Xi Ying said no more and maneuvered the Flying Boat to sink into the sea.
Yuan Ming, swift as a shuttle, went straight into the depths of the thunderclouds. With a push of his hands, the Silver Banner emerged, expanding several times in the wind to envelope his body.
The approaching lightning arcs touched the Silver Banner and immediately changed direction, gliding past it.
Yuan Ming gestured, and the Thunder God Hammer flew out to several dozen feet away, hovering in the void.
He activated the Thunder Rune Array within the Thunder God Hammer; threads of silver light spread out. The electric arcs in the thunderclouds seemed to be drawn to the hammer, converging wave after wave upon it, striking the hammer's body.
The Thunder Rune Array inside the Thunder God Hammer spun rapidly; circles of Spiritual Patterns flashed on its surface. Expanding and contracting, the array absorbed all the incoming Power of Thunder and Lightning, storing it away.
After a full hour, the thunderstorm finally passed, and the fierce winds and heavy rain also ceased.
Yuan Ming's figure fell from the sky, his face showing a look of satisfaction.
The Spiritual Energy in the East Sea was dense, and the Power of Thunder and Lightning generated was especially abundant. Although the rune formation of the Thunder God Hammer hadn't been filled to the brim, it had nonetheless gathered a great deal. With a few more occurrences like this, it could return to its full might.
Meanwhile, Xi Ying maneuvered the bright white Flying Boat to ascend from the sea, picking up Yuan Ming and continuing on their journey.
Two days later, a red dot appeared ahead, indistinct and unclear.
As the Flying Boat continued to advance, the red dot rapidly became clear—it was an island, and their destination, Fusang Island.
Fusang Island was a hundred miles in size, full of mountains and rivers, and beautifully scenic. From a distance, the dense Spiritual Energy was palpable, indicating that the island's Spiritual Vein was of extremely high quality.
The entire Fusang Island was lush and green. The reason it appeared as a red dot from afar was due to the vast expanse of red clouds hovering over the island, resembling fiery clouds, connecting to the heavens above, with no vision of what lay beyond.
On the eastern side of the island, a gigantic brown tree stood tall like a mountain peak. Only the extremely large trunk could be seen, as the canopy was completely covered by the red clouds. It seemed to be the famous Fusang Tree of the East Sea.
"Such rich Spiritual Energy on Fusang Island, worthy of being a first-class island. But what's with the red clouds above the island?" Yuan Ming observed the island ahead and asked.
"It's the doing of that Golden Crow demon beast. It prefers tranquility and doesn't want to be seen, so it releases demonic power to form this vast fire cloud as a warning to outsiders that it's its territory, not to be violated," Xi Ying explained, then suddenly gestured a spell, lowering the altitude of the Flying Boat until it landed on the sea surface, continuing toward Fusang Island like an ordinary boat.
A group of people emerged from inside the Flying Boat, namely Yan Si Yun, Yan Si Jing, and several Cultivators from Hundred Pills Square.
Journeying across the sea had been rough, and with insufficient cultivation, Yan Si Yun and the others had been cultivating inside the Flying Boat these past days. Now that they had arrived at Fusang Island, they finally showed themselves.
The view of the island left the Cultivators from Hundred Pills Square visibly astonished.
As they approached, more varied Flying Artifacts appeared nearby, along with some Core Formation Cultivators directly traveling by tunneling light, flying with their physical bodies. But without exception, all of them, just like Yuan Ming's small boat, lowered their altitude to nearly level with the sea surface.
Seeing Yuan Ming's puzzled look, Xi Ying explained, "Fusang Island prohibits anyone from flying into the space above the red clouds, to avoid alarming the Golden Crow Demon Beast. In the past, they only restricted altitude, but now they've outright banned flying. Even Nascent Soul cultivators will not be accommodated."
Before Xi Ying's words finished, a green long rainbow shot from the distance, extremely fast, and in the blink of an eye, it reached nearby, revealing its true form—a Tower Ship more than a dozen zhang in length.
The bottom of the Tower Ship harbored a giant azure python which was almost the size of the ship itself, carrying it as it swiftly flew away.
Surprisingly, the azure python Tower Ship didn't descend to the sea surface but headed directly for Fusang Island, stirring up a foul-smelling gale in its wake.
The bright white Flying Boat was swept by the gale, but Xi Ying had activated the Flying Boat preemptively and was not shaken.
However, she had just mentioned that the area near Fusang Island was a no-fly zone when the azure Tower Ship sped past, leaving her with a somewhat embarrassed expression and a hint of puzzlement.
Other Flying Artifacts nearby were caught off guard, resulting in chaos as people were thrown off balance, and an impatient, burly man couldn't help but curse out loud.
"Shh! Are you courting death? That's the Heavenly Snake Tower Ship from Thousand Snake Island. If they hear you, they could take your life with a flick of their wrist. Those from the Half-demon Clan are overbearing and won't care for Fusang Island's rules," whispered someone next to the man, quickly covering his mouth.
Yuan Ming's gaze followed the receding Heavenly Snake Tower Ship with a flicker of interest.
As the Tower Ship had swiftly passed by, a Divine Sense had descended from within, quickly scanning over their group.
The Divine Sense was incredibly powerful, likely that of a Nascent Soul cultivator, though with unclear intentions.For a smoother reading experience, visit MV&LEMPYR.
"So the people on that Tower Ship are from the Snake-man Clan of the East Sea, right? Today has really been an eye-opener, how domineering!" Yan Sijing puffed her cheeks, clearly dissatisfied with the overbearing behavior of the Heavenly Snake Tower Ship.
"The Snake-man Clan is formidable and counts among the best on the first-class islands. Moreover, these Alien Clans are far fewer in number than the Human Clan, and they maintain their clan's dignity with an almost pathological harshness. Fusang Island is also reluctant to provoke them. If you come across them in the future, avoid them if possible, and don't get into conflict," advised Yan Siyun.
"Never mind them, let's go," Xi Ying guided the Flying Boat forward.
Soon, their small vessel finally sailed into the area shrouded by the red cloud.
Yuan Ming gazed at the red cloud from afar, finding it dazzlingly bright. Now beneath it, he felt a grandeur approaching him face-on. Looking up, he saw a vast, endless expanse of crimson clouds forming a new sky, covering hundreds of miles.
As they drew nearer, the giant tree became clearer, with its branches and leaves hidden within the red clouds in the sky and its ancient brown trunk etched with the traces of time, standing like a lofty pillar above the sea.
"So, this must be the Fusang Divine Tree? Truly magnificent," Yuan Ming gazed at the tree that seemed to pierce the heavens, his eyes filled with wonder that lingered for a long time.
Beneath the giant tree lay a large city bustling with residents coming and going, a scene of prosperity visible from a great distance.
"Correct, and the city below it is Fusang City," Xi Ying confirmed.
"Shall we go directly there?" asked Yan Sijing, seemingly eager to visit Fusang City.
"No rush. We don't know anything about Fusang Island yet. We should first land at Xia Guang City, meet up with the people from Red Ganoderma Island, find out the situation, and then proceed to Fusang City together," Xi Ying proposed.
Xia Guang City was a coastal city on the southern side of Fusang Island, and there were several such cities on the island. Cultivators who came to this island usually settled in these cities first.
Yan Sijing felt she was too impatient and nodded in agreement.
Half an hour later, the group arrived at a secluded inn in Xia Guang City.
"Fellow Daoists, this inn has been reserved by someone already, and we cannot ..." the Shopkeeper began apologetically.
He was only halfway through his sentence when he suddenly stopped, because Xi Ying had taken out a pink Token and swiftly flashed it before the Shopkeeper's eyes.
"So you are the guests that Fairy Bishui has been waiting for. Please, come in," the Shopkeeper hurriedly smiled, stepping aside to make way.
Xi Ying entered the inn first, proceeding to a spacious private room inside, flicking her sleeve to open the door wide and walking straight in.
Yuan Ming followed closely behind, and with a slight shift of his gaze, he saw three stunning beauties seated in the room, but only the one in the center was at the mid-stage of Core Formation, while the other two were at the Late Foundation Establishment.
Among the two Foundation Establishment female cultivators, Yuan Ming recognized the one seated on the left—it was the green-robed female cultivator he had encountered in the East Sea while inhabiting Guoguo's body.
"You've finally arrived, Fellow Daoist Xi. You've made your sister wait a good while. This must be Fellow Daoist Yuan you spoke of? He certainly looks distinguished," greeted the leading Core Formation female cultivator with a laugh upon seeing Xi Ying.
She was dressed in a radiant pink cross-collared shirt with an orange silk sash tied around her waist, her pale red hair parted into two buns fixed with three golden hairpins on each side, and her egg-shaped face featured lightly touched brows and soft lips, seemingly natural but enhancing her exquisite and sweet appearance.
The woman before him was the Island Master of Red Ganoderma Island, who bore the surname "Bishui" and was known by the name "Rou."
"Fellow Daoist Bishui flatters me," replied Yuan Ming with a slight bow of his fists.
At this moment, he was not showing his true face, but a handsome young appearance crafted by the Blood Bone Mask.
There was no guarantee that Ancestor Ming Quan wouldn't track him to the East Sea, but his parents were here, so he couldn't take any risks.

chapters.title: Chapter 477 - 454: Eve of the Conference
chapters.content:
"Hehe, these two sisters are quite pretty, but they seem somewhat unfamiliar. Could it be their first time in the East Sea?" Bi Shuirou appeared to be a very sociable person, grabbing the hands of Yan Sijing and Yan Siyun, pretending as if they were long-time friends and sisters who cared deeply for each other.
On a regular basis, the Yan sisters managed Hundred Pills Square and naturally had to deal with all sorts of people, so they exchanged greetings with Bi Shuirou and chatted idly for a few moments.
After the pleasantries, everyone found their seats.
"Fellow Daoist Bishui, the Immortal Fruit Conference is drawing near. What is the situation on Fusang Island?" Xi Ying got straight to the point.
"The islands participating have mostly gathered. The situation in the Central Plains is unstable, and I heard that the Wuyue Sect has re-emerged in the Northern Desert, affecting us here in the East Sea as well. The islands attending the conference are all determined to win over the Red Mulberry Immortal Fruit, aiming to strengthen their own power; the situation is much more dire than we previously anticipated." Bi Shuirou wore a look of concern, seemingly not very hopeful about the outcome of the assembly.
Yuan Ming's expression flickered slightly upon hearing this.
He had not expected the news of Wuyue Sect's resurgence to have reached the East Sea so quickly; it seemed they had caused quite a stir recently.
Having secluded himself for over a year to cultivate, he was out of touch with current events and decided he would need to contact Xu Che later to inquire about the situation in the Black Wind Desert and the Wuyue Sect's movements.
"Speaking of which, Sister Xi Ying, the assistant you've brought along is Fellow Daoist Yuan, isn't it?" Bi Shuirou observed Yuan Ming and inquired.
"Indeed, I am the person in question. Does Fellow Daoist Bishui believe that I am too weak and unreliable?" Yuan Ming spoke indifferently.
"Since Sister Xi Ying has invited Fellow Daoist Yuan, naturally I trust her judgment. It's just that Fellow Daoist Yuan's early-stage Core Formation cultivation level might be a bit insufficient." Although Bi Shuirou had a smile on her face, there was a faint hint of doubt in her eyes.
"The competition is about personal strength and means, not merely the level of cultivation. Otherwise, one could simply showcase their cultivation level on stage to determine the victors and losers, eliminating the need for an elaborate conference," Xi Ying said dismissively, shaking her head.
"Fellow Daoist Xi is right, but I, Sister Bishui, am in urgent need of the Red Mulberry Immortal Fruit for alchemy. With only sixteen spots available at the conference, and those first-class islands nearly guaranteed to take twelve of them, that leaves only four for second-class islands like ours. Therefore, I must be cautious. Would it be possible to exchange a few moves with Fellow Daoist Yuan, just to set my heart at ease?" As Bi Shuirou spoke, she suddenly beamed a smile at Yuan Ming.
Her smile seemed to carry a unique charm, reminiscent of a delicate, dew-laden lotus blooming after the rain, making her appear even more alluring and delicate.
However, when Yuan Ming saw her smiling face, his expression was like that of a still well, unfazed.
"Fellow Daoist Bishui, competing is one thing, but let's forgo such petty tricks," he said coolly, while casually gesturing with his hand to the side.
At the tips of his fingers, a faint glimmer of lightning shimmered as he halted a nearly invisible slender shadow midair—a three-inch long transparent embroidery needle with a plum blossom pattern etched on its end.
Seeing this, Bi Shuirou's eyes twitched.
This Shadowless Plum Blossom Needle was a magic treasure she had painstakingly refined. It could conceal its presence, suppress fluctuations of aura, and was exceptionally sharp.
With this artifact, she had successively defeated several cultivators of the same rank. Two of them had even died without realizing what had struck them. Yet Yuan Ming had nonchalantly blocked the needle with a simple gesture as if he hadn't paid it much mind.
"I didn't expect Fellow Daoist Yuan to hide his abilities so well. My little move has indeed become a joke in front of you," Bi Shuirou said awkwardly, standing up and giving a bow.
Yuan Ming withdrew his finger, his countenance as calm as still water.
He had already learned about the situation on Red Ganoderma Island from Xi Ying. The island's strength was average among the second-class islands, and its most notable features were seduction technique and hidden weapons. Yuan Ming had easily seen through her tactics with his Divine Sense. Although there had been no real confrontation, from this incident alone, Bi Shuirou could tell she was no match for him.
As Yuan Ming revealed his strength, the atmosphere in the elegant room eased considerably. Bi Shuirou yielded willingly, threw in a few good words, and when the moment was right, steered the conversation toward the intelligence she had gathered in the past few days.
"There are a total of one hundred twenty-eight islands registered for the conference. To decide the top sixteen, there will be three rounds of competition. The specific grouping and opponents will only be known once the competition officially begins, but I have already summarized a few second-class islands worth paying attention to, each with a Late-stage Core Formation Cultivator in residence," Bi Shuirou analyzed earnestly.
Yuan Ming was not particularly concerned, but Xi Ying was attentively listening, occasionally asking for more details.
"Merely Core Formation Stage cultivators, even if they are at late-stage, with your strength, they are but a wave of the hand away from defeat. Is there a need to be so cautious?" Yuan Ming communicated telepathically with Xi Ying, somewhat dismissive.
"The East Sea Immortal Cultivation World is a mixed bag of dragons and fish; it's possible that a master could emerge at any moment, so it's better to be careful," Xi Ying replied.
"With our abilities, taking down two rounds of the competition shouldn't be a problem. However, it seems that Bishui's abilities aren't quite up to par; she has to take part in one of the rounds, and if she loses, all our efforts will be in vain," Yuan Ming shared his concerns.
"Out of the one hundred twenty-eight islands, we can't possibly face only the strong ones. Bishui's seduction technique is useless against us, but it can still threaten ordinary cultivators, and together with her hidden weapons and Divine Skills, winning the first round should not be an issue," Xi Ying communicated back.
"That said, there must be some other reason you chose Red Ganoderma Island, right?" Yuan Ming asked.
"Indeed, first, I developed some acquaintance with Bi Shuirou during my Foundation Establishment, and I thoroughly understand her background; second, it's because she only needs the seed of the Red Mulberry Immortal Fruit for alchemy, while the Five Elements Infant Condensing Pill requires the flesh of the fruit, so our needs do not conflict, which can spare me some trouble afterward," Xi Ying explained.
"Speaking of which, there must be quite a few islands like those Bi Shuirou has asked to assist in inviting Core Formation Cultivators. It's fine when they encounter us, but if there are Loose Cultivators harboring malicious intentions, wanting to monopolize the Red Mulberry Immortal Fruit, how would they deal with it?" Yuan Ming suddenly thought of something and asked with curiosity.
"There's no need to worry about that. If such a situation indeed occurs, Fusang Island will personally dispatch people to hunt down that Loose Cultivator until the Red Mulberry Immortal Fruit is retrieved," said Xi Ying.
"Would Fusang Island be so kind as to stand up for the Second-class Islands?" Yuan Ming was somewhat surprised.
"No, they do so to ensure that each Red Mulberry Immortal Fruit is given out according to their arrangements," explained Xi Ying.
"It seems like a show of authority," Yuan Ming mused thoughtfully.
"Indeed, there was an incident where a Loose Cultivator refined the Red Mulberry Immortal Fruit into an elixir and consumed it before being caught. However, after being captured by Fusang Island, a Nascent Soul Ancestor personally took action to refine that cultivator into an elixir, reportedly managing to retain forty percent of the original potency of the fruit. In the end, it was returned to the island that suffered the misfortune, and the Island Master consumed it," Xi Ying slowly recounted.
Yuan Ming was silent. For some reason, he suddenly thought of the Chang Chun Temple. Fusang Island, as the dominator of the East Sea, shared a style of operation that was strikingly similar to that of Chang Chun Temple.
Perhaps, in the other Three Domains, it was the same: the rules set by the top Sects and powers had to be followed by everyone, without exception.
Some called it tyranny, some called it oppression, but there were also those who called it order.
At least, Yuan Ming did not dislike such practices; after all, to some extent, they also served to maintain the peace and stability of the Immortal Fruit Conference.
Although he yearned for freedom, he also knew well that freedom without any constraints and limitations would only drag everyone into an abyss of indulgence and chaos.
Yuan Ming and his companions lingered in Xia Guang City for a day, collecting and organizing the information they had gathered before setting off for Fusang City.
...
As the largest city among the Eastern Sea Islands, the prosperity of Fusang City could be said to be the greatest Yuan Ming had ever seen in his life.
In order to please the Golden Crow that lived atop the Divine Tree, the buildings in Fusang City were predominantly in shades of gold and red, and from the sky above, the whole city looked like a Golden Crow spreading its wings, coexisting harmoniously with the Fusang Divine Tree.
As a result, the city was divided into five distinct districts by six broad avenues and one ring road, namely the Crow Head District, Tree Heart District, Left Wing District, Right Wing District, and Wuzu District.
Connected closely with the Tree Heart District, which encircled the Divine Tree, was the Crow Head District to the north; only direct descendants of Fusang Island could enter these areas.
The largest sections, the Left Wing and Right Wing Districts, were designated for cultivators to reside in, with most dwellings open for temporary stay in exchange for Spirit Stones.
The 128 residences in the Right Wing District were specifically vacated by Fusang Island, intended for the use of the 128 islands that were qualified to participate in the Immortal Fruit Conference.
Each of the 128 residences has its own separate garden courtyard, set far apart from one another, ensuring that competing islands would not interfere with each other due to close proximity.This copy comes from content on *.
The Wuzu District, although smaller, was exclusively for trade and was even busier than other areas, with shops of all sizes crowded together, vying to attract customers. The merchandise sold was incredibly varied, including specialties from the other four domains.
Red Ganoderma Island, as one of the participating islands, was promptly placed in a spacious residence in the Right Wing District, thanks to the reception and arrangement by Fusang Island cultivators upon their entrance into Fusang City.
There were enough rooms in the residence that even Yan Siyun and others who had come with Yuan Ming had more than enough space after moving in.
With several days still left before the official opening of the Immortal Fruit Conference, the delegation from Red Ganoderma Island was busy right after settling in. From Bi Shuirou to those in Foundation Establishment, every disciple was employing their own methods, trying to gather intelligence on the islands participating in the conference.
Meanwhile, Yan Siyun and the others who followed Yuan Ming did not rest for a moment, heading to the Wuzu District to discuss potential partnerships with the merchants who had come for the grand event.
Consequently, Yuan Ming and Xi Ying found themselves with no obligations.
Xi Ying, who had already been to Fusang City and was not too interested in its sights, went back to her room to cultivate.
Yuan Ming did not go out either and returned to his room to sit cross-legged.
He set up a Forbidden array inside the room, then took out the Silver Token, unfolded the silver barrier, and entered the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space.

chapters.title: Chapter 478 - 455: A Comprehensive View of Fusang
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming sat cross-legged upon the White Jade Lotus Platform, extending his Divine Sense outward, beginning to communicate with Xu Che.
At this moment, Xu Che was sitting cross-legged underground, his body enveloped in a dense glow. The nearby soil, illuminated by the yellow light, had transformed into a flowing, water-like substance, rippling in waves.
Xu Che's cultivation had also made significant progress, having reached the Late Foundation Establishment stage.
"It seems Xu Che is quite suited for the 'Earth Core Magnetic Skill,'" Yuan Ming mused quietly.
Unlike the progress in his mana, the growth of Xu Che's Divine Soul Power was slow and had almost no significant difference compared to a year ago.
Yuan Ming sighed, it seemed Xu Che was not material for cultivating as a Soul Cultivator, he would have to find another Divine Skill to teach him.
He steadied his mind and communicated with Xu Che.
"My lord!" Xu Che hastily stopped cultivating and knelt to salute.
"Your cultivation has greatly progressed, you have not failed my expectations," Yuan Ming said.
"It's all thanks to the 'Earth Core Magnetic Skill' and elixirs bestowed by my lord, that I was able to advance so boldly," Xu Che said tearfully grateful.
"How is the Moon Sect's missionary work progressing?" Yuan Ming asked.
"Reporting to my lord, the Wu Yue Sect's strongholds within Zhao and Qin countries have all been uprooted. Following your instructions, I quickly took over those areas. The progress is satisfactory. The Moon Sect has established eight outposts and recruited several cultivators as believers..." Xu Che thoroughly reported the situation there.
"You have done well, what about the situation with the Wu Yue Sect?" Yuan Ming hummed and inquired about the matter he was most concerned about.
"The Wu Yue Sect has formally announced its resurgence in the Northern Desert. The Black Desert Alliance's controlled region saw a massive overnight increase in Wu Yue Sect believers. Zhao Country's Five Thunder Sect and Spirit Talisman Sect, as well as Qin Country's Guiyuan Sect, have all dispatched more personnel to the Black Wind Desert. I heard that people from Chang Chun Temple are also coming. The situation in the Black Wind Desert is extremely tense. Many Loose Cultivators have started to retreat, and the Moon Sect's development has also been greatly affected. Otherwise, with the resources previously bestowed by my lord, the situation would not be merely like this," Xu Che lowered his head, speaking regretfully.
"Do you know who from Chang Chun Temple has been sent there?" Yuan Ming's eyebrows moved as he asked.
The situation in the Black Wind Desert had deteriorated to such an extent that the Five Thunder Sect, Spirit Talisman Sect, and even Chang Chun Temple had sent people. Could it be that they intended to blockade the Wu Yue Sect within the Black Wind Desert?
"It is said to be a Nascent Soul Mid-Stage cultivator, but his exact name is unknown," Xu Che shook his head.
"Nascent Soul Mid-Stage…" Yuan Ming sneered silently. It seemed Chang Chun Temple was merely going through the motions and had no intentions of clashing decisively with the Wu Yue Sect in the Black Wind Desert.
The Wu Yue Sect had unfathomably deep roots. With it resurfacing like this, it wouldn't be as simple as it appeared on the surface. The Late-Stage Nascent Soul Great Cultivator from Chang Chun Temple probably wouldn't emerge, fearing it could hardly be stopped.
"It seems the Black Wind Desert is going to become the eye of a storm. We have been enemies with the Wu Yue Sect for some time and are already mortal enemies. If their army presses in, it would be a situation of certain death. Withdraw all personnel, leave the Black Wind Desert," Yuan Ming instructed.
Xu Che's body shuddered, and his face showed reluctance.
He had spent too much effort in the Black Wind Desert, finally carving out a bit of a scene, and now he had to abandon it.
"My lord, could it be that even with Chang Chun Temple, the Five Thunder Sect, and the Guiyuan Sect combined, they cannot resist the Wu Yue Sect?" Xu Che couldn't help asking.
"The strength of the Wu Yue Sect is beyond your imagination. Even if the sects like Chang Chun Temple and the Five Thunder Sect can withstand the Wu Yue Sect, the Black Wind Desert would still be utterly disrupted. The Moon Sect has just risen and cannot withstand such turmoil. Cutting off the tail to survive is the best choice," Yuan Ming said.
"Yes, I will immediately organize a retreat," Xu Che dared not say more and complied.
"Take all the cultivator believers with you. As for those mortal believers, if they wish to come with you, find a way to bring them along," Yuan Ming instructed again.
"Yes, but to where are we relocating?" Xu Che asked.
"Jin Country," Yuan Ming said after a brief contemplation.
If the Wu Yue Sect occupied the Black Wind Desert, the next step would surely be to invade Zhao Country.
