With the strength of the Five Thunder Sect and Spirit Talisman Sect, it would be difficult to resist the Wu Yue Sect. Only by retreating to Jin Country could they be somewhat safe.
"Visit that village in Qiao Saibei too. If they are willing to leave, take them along. Regarding the ores stored there, try to sell them. The situation in the Black Wind Desert is chaotic now, making it a good time to sell those ores," Yuan Ming thought and added.
Xu Che complied with each instruction, and Yuan Ming withdrew his Divine Sense, descending along another anchor point of Desire Power.
This Desire Power anchor point was a Qi Refining Stage Cultivator from the Hundred Pills Square, named "Miao Xian."
This person was quite devout in his belief in the Nether Moon God, and he was compliant, but unfortunately, he was mediocre in talent and had never been valued in Hundred Pills Square.
Before coming to Fusang Island, Yuan Ming had secretly sought out this person and, in exchange for a Foundation Establishment Pill, planted a Soul Descent Rune in his Divine Soul.
Although everyone in Hundred Pills Square was a follower of the Nether Moon God, lowering his Divine Sense required them to pray to the Nether Moon God, which was somewhat troublesome. He simply developed another follower for Soul Descent.
Miao Xian was currently with others from Hundred Pills Square in the Wuzu District, purchasing alchemy spiritual materials.
Yuan Ming's Divine Sense spread from the Wuzu District, grasping the entirety of Fusang City. All restrictions were virtually nullified before the Divine Sense augmented by the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
"Fusang Island truly lives up to its reputation as the premier island of the East Sea, having five Nascent Soul cultivators, including one Late-stage powerhouse and one Mid-stage one," Yuan Ming muttered to himself.
Of course, there might be other Nascent Soul cultivators on Fusang Island who are not present here.
The Fusang Island Master had a towering figure, with golden eyebrows and sharp, eagle-like eyes, exuding an overwhelming aura.
Yuan Ming's Divine Sense lingered briefly on this man before quickly moving on, sweeping across the man's residence and soon pausing on a wall.
The wall didn't look like much, but it possessed multiple formidable layers of restrictions, including Prohibition God Restrictions which would be impenetrable if not for the augmentation from his Stealing Heaven Tripod.
Behind the wall's restrictions was a secret chamber filled with numerous treasures, including Magic Treasures, elixirs, spiritual materials, etc., each radiating profound Spiritual Energy fluctuations.
"Tsk tsk, Fusang Island is indeed wealthy; each of these Magic Treasures is no less inferior to the Thunder God Hammer, and this Jade Pipa even has a stronger aura. Could it be a mimic of a Spiritual Treasure? These elixirs aren't bad either…" Yuan Ming inspected the items in the chamber as if admiring his own collection.Content first released on *.
However, only his Divine Sense could visit and feast his eyes upon them.
Yuan Ming's Divine Sense stopped at a square cyan wooden box adorned with several Sealing Talismans, appearing extremely solemn.
However, such measures were naturally ineffective against him; his Divine Sense easily permeated it.
Inside the box were rows of fist-sized red Spirit Fruits, neatly stacked.
"Red Mulberry Immortal Fruits!" Yuan Ming exclaimed spontaneously, moved by the sight.
Xi Ying had shown him the pattern of Red Mulberry Immortal Fruits; the fruits in the box were indeed Red Mulberry Immortal Fruits, amounting to thirty-six in total.
"Rumors had it that the Fusang Divine Tree bears twenty-one Immortal Fruits every three hundred years. I've always found it odd how they could part with twelve fruits. It turns out the rumors were mistaken; it bears thirty-six fruits. It must be a false narrative deliberately released by Fusang Island," Yuan Ming thought to himself.
Although it was his first time seeing the Red Mulberry Immortal Fruits, the spiritual power within the fruits in the box was incredibly abundant, surely not picked three hundred years ago.
"Sadly, I can only look…" Yuan Ming sighed in diminishing interest, shifting his Divine Sense to explore other areas of the island.
The area of his main interest was the Right Wing District, where twelve foreign Nascent Soul cultivators were now located, each undergoing secluded cultivation. Even though restrictions were set up in their rooms, how could those block Yuan Ming's Divine Sense?
Yuan Ming had encountered many Nascent Soul cultivators before, but only the Nascent Soul cultivators of the Snake-man Clan, Merfolk, and Water Ape Clan slightly piqued his interest.
These three half-demon Alien Clans bore some demon traits; the Snake-man and Merfolk had scales, while the Water Ape Clan was covered in dense fur.
However, once they advanced to the Nascent Soul, all demon traits were refined away, transforming them into human form.
The Nascent Soul of the Snake-man Clan was a thin middle-aged man with a cold aura, pale face, and an extremely large mouth. His eye corners almost extended to his temples. Although human in form, he resembled a giant snake in any way one looked.
Yuan Ming, with his advanced Soul Cultivator skills, was exceptionally sensitive to Divine Sense. The Divine Sense that had descended from the sky upon entering Fusang Island came from this Snake-man Nascent Soul cultivator. Yuan Ming wondered why this man had specifically released his Divine Sense.
The Nascent Soul cultivator of the Merfolk was a woman with a phoenix hairpin and wearing a purple skirt, with a graceful figure, bright eyes, and white teeth, her beauty nearly unmatched by Xi Ying's True Face.
Unlike Xi Ying, the Purple Skirt woman had a cold demeanor, acted imperiously, and every gesture carried tremendous authority, appearing almost like an Empress.
"Could this woman be the Clan Leader of the Merfolk?" Yuan Ming speculated quietly.
As for the Nascent Soul cultivator from the Water Ape Clan, he was a muscular great man, his body intensely powerful.
"Rumors said that the Water Ape Clan possesses formidable physical bodies, almost akin to Body Cultivation, seeing is truly believing," Yuan Ming's gaze sharpened.
After briefly sensing these three Alien Clan Nascent Soul cultivators, he withdrew his Divine Sense, extending it towards the Fusang Divine Tree.
This time, his main intention for deploying his Divine Sense was to investigate this legendary Divine Tree.
The Fusang Divine Tree was surrounded by five layers of great arrays, corresponding to Gold, Wood, Water, Fire, Earth, each layer incredibly resilient, posing a significant challenge even for Nascent Soul cultivators to break through.
Between the five layers of arrays, there seemed to be a resonance, potentially forming a more powerful Forbidden.
"A Five Elements Restriction? Somewhat similar to my Five Elements Illusion Destruction Array, but naturally of incomparable magnitude. It seems somewhat fanciful now to think Hua Zhi could sneak into the Fusang Divine Wood," Yuan Ming sighed, voicing his findings to Hua Zhi through a message.
Inside the Spiritual Beast Bag, Hua Zhi cursed silently, yet displayed no violent reaction, to Yuan Ming's surprise.
Previously, Hua Zhi had been almost frantic in persuading him to sneak her into the Fusang Divine Wood; now, she seemed to have calmed down for some reason.
As he pondered, Yuan Ming's Divine Sense continued upward, soon encountering fire clouds that swept across the sky.
Upon his arrival at Fusang Island, he had covertly activated his Divine Sense to sense the fire cloud, believing every Core Formation Stage cultivator attempting to withstand Fusang Island would uncontrollably do so.
Unfortunately, the fervent fire inside the red cloud had easily intercepted his Divine Sense.
Now, housed in the Stealing Heaven Tripod, the fire power within the cloud could no longer block him, allowing him to easily penetrate through and quickly reach above the fire cloud.

chapters.title: Chapter 479 - 456: Chance Encounter in the Martial Arts World
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming's vision cleared as the clouds dispersed, leaving a vast expanse in sight.
The sky, a pure and clear azure, looked like the clearest sapphire, its beauty heartbreakingly stunning. In the distant horizon, a red sun slowly rose, bathing the world in a brilliant light.
Such a sunrise in the east was a scene Yuan Ming had witnessed countless times elsewhere, yet it was an exceptionally spectacular sight from above Fusang Island, taking even his breath away for a moment.
Yuan Ming quickly calmed his mind and looked straight ahead.
Above the Fire Clouds, the Fusang Divine Tree fully revealed its true face, with lush green leaves and sprawling branches forming an immense canopy that shone brilliantly under the sunlight.
Within the immense green tree sat a bird's nest, hundreds of feet in size, constructed from red spirit wood piled up one on top of the other, emitting intense Fire Attribute fluctuations. Even the surrounding temperature rose significantly, causing visible ripples in the air.
"Could this red spirit wood be the legendary Phoenix Perch Wood?" Yuan Ming's eyes lit up.
Phoenix Perch Wood was also one of the legendary spirit woods, said to be stained with the flames where a phoenix rests, no less extraordinary than Fusang Wood. Where could this Golden Crow demon beast have obtained it?
The red nest within was empty; the Golden Crow demon beast was clearly not there at the moment. Yuan Ming felt quite disappointed, not knowing where it had gone.
Just as he was about to withdraw his Divine Sense and leave the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space, his expression suddenly changed, and he paused.
Another Nascent Soul cultivator had arrived at Fusang City, and this one was at the Nascent Soul Middle Stage.
This individual paid no heed to the island's prohibition and directly entered Fusang City using an Escape Technique.
"Water Escape Technique? But this casting is truly exquisite. Not only can he use Water Escape in a place without water, but he can also cover more than ten miles at once. Impressive!" Yuan Ming watched the person's casting process with admiration.
This new Nascent Soul cultivator appeared to be in his forties, with a pale, beardless face and a gloomy aura. He was wrapped in an extremely heavy killing aura, which flickered coldly as his eyes opened and closed.
"He must be a Demon Hunting Cultivator," Yuan Ming guessed, with a vision and insight that weren't comparable to his past. A killing aura as dense as this was a sure sign of heavy slaughter.
The man entered Fusang Island and headed straight for the market in the Wuzu District, seemingly intending to purchase something.
Yuan Ming didn't inquire further, withdrawing his Divine Sense and leaving the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space.
After half a day's Breathing Control, he too left his residence and headed towards the Wuzu District workshop.
As the Immortal Fruit Conference approached, more and more cultivators flooded into Fusang City. The market was also bustling with Loose Cultivators setting up stalls, their wares varied, with no guarantee of their exact value from these small setups. Snatching good deals depended entirely on the cultivator's own judgement.
Yuan Ming strolled through the stalls, casting casual glances, and indeed found some spiritual objects of not bad quality. Unfortunately, they weren't what he needed, and even if he bought them, they would be of little use to him.
However, suddenly, as he passed by one of the stalls, his wandering gaze abruptly fixed in place.
The stall owner was a dark-skinned old man with only Foundation Establishment Cultivation, and in front of him were mostly common Spiritual Medicines, not many kinds, but plenty in number.
"How much for these Red Core flowers?" Yuan Ming reined in his aura and stepped forward to ask.
"Thirty Spirit Stones for five stems," the old man replied, extending a hand as black as ink and gesturing the number five.
After hearing the price, Yuan Ming surveyed the Spiritual Medicine on the stall and then nodded, "All right, I'll take them all."
The old man's face lit up with joy as he quickly fetched a wooden box to pack up the red core flowers on the stall and handed it to Yuan Ming.
Red Core Flowers were a type of Middle-level Spirit Grass, useful for refining Healing Pills during the Foundation Establishment period. However, because they grew so quickly, the price was quite low.
Yuan Ming quickly counted the number and then handed over the Spirit Stones before turning and walking away, leaving the old man alone, excited about closing a big deal.
When Yuan Ming reached a secluded corner, he quickly took out the wooden box containing the Red Core Flowers and carefully picked out a tender red blossom.
The bud of the Xiao Hua was bashfully closed, with a simple and elegant color, and even upon smelling it, there wasn't much of an aroma, seeming every bit the Red Core Flower. Yet, when Yuan Ming carefully peeled back the petals, a citrus-like sweet fragrance spread from the red powder clusters in the flower's stamen.
With the aroma of the flower invigorating his spirit, Yuan Ming became even more certain that what he had bought was not Red Core Flowers, but Red Beautiful Flowers.
The appearance of the Red Beautiful Flower was almost identical to the Red Core Flower, except the fragrance was even more subtle, and the vein patterns on the stems and leaves had slight differences. If one were not familiar with them, it would be very hard to distinguish the two.
Compared with the Red Core Flower, the Red Beautiful Flower not only ranks higher in quality, but its essence is also condensed within the powder clump in the flower's pistil, containing a more potent medicinal power than the common Spirit Grass.
But the most crucial point was that the Red Beautiful Flower was the main ingredient required for refining Common Poppy Spirit Incense. Yuan Ming had intended to search diligently for it after the Immortal Fruit Conference; unexpectedly, he managed to purchase quite a few here.
Yuan Ming stowed away the Red Beautiful Flowers, feeling even more pleased and refreshed in his heart. He turned to continue browsing the market but with a tad more seriousness than before.
However, just steps away from the alley, his expression suddenly shifted, and he looked up towards the front left, his gaze landing on a Foundation Establishment Cultivator who was haggling with a stall owner.
"Two hundred Spirit Stones is just too expensive. Although this piece of spiritual material is rich in spirituality, it's far too small to serve as the main material for refining Magic Artifacts. Using it as a supplementary material would be excessive and not worth it," the Foundation Establishment Cultivator complained while pointing at a fragment the size of a baby's palm on the stall.
His appearance was plain and would blend into a crowd so well that if one looked away for a moment, it would be impossible to spot him again. And with his Early-stage Foundation Establishment Cultivation, there was nothing about him that would catch Yuan Ming's attention.
However, Yuan Ming sensed a faintly familiar aura emanating from him—seemingly similar to a spell he knew.
While Yuan Ming observed him, the man seemed to sense something and suddenly turned his head, locking eyes with Yuan Ming.
"Fellow Daoist, do you have any advice for me?" the man asked with a hint of caution in his eyes.A$l-w%ay+s* r.e!a!d* at the sour.c@e!—MV#@&L+EM&P*@Y%R^.
Yuan Ming did not respond but scrutinized the man's face. With the aid of his powerful Divine Sense, he easily saw through the man's disguise.
Upon seeing that familiar face, Yuan Ming chuckled with a mix of nostalgia and teasing, "No important matter, I just thought you look somewhat like an old friend of mine who used to wear a tiger's skin."
At these words, a flicker of surprise crossed the man's eyes. He stared intently at Yuan Ming, as if he had come to some realization, with a trace of joy emerging in his expression.
To avoid trouble, Yuan Ming also used a Blood Bone Mask to alter his appearance while out and about. But judging by the man's reaction, it seemed that he had recognized Yuan Ming through his words.
"I feel an instant connection with Fellow Daoist. There seems to be a tea house nearby; why don't we move there and continue our conversation?" Yuan Ming invited with a smile.
The man burst into laughter, tossed down two hundred Spirit Stones, picked up the broken piece, and headed to the teahouse with Yuan Ming.
Soon, the two sat down in an elegant booth in the teahouse, shedding their disguises to reveal their true faces.
"Heh, Brother Wu Lu, it's been a long time indeed. I didn't expect that you've also advanced to Core Formation. Congratulations," Yuan Ming said with a smile.
Indeed, the man he had encountered was none other than Wu Lu in disguise. The barely noticeable aura of the spell was the effect of the Hidden Element Technique.
Now that Wu Lu had ceased using the spell, his Core Formation aura was unmistakable.
"Hehe, congratulations to us both. It's all thanks to Brother Yuan saving me in the mine back then that I could undergo such a transformation. Even though I've reached Core Formation, I've merely caught up a little with Brother Yuan's pace," Wu Lu laughed as he poured a cup of tea for both himself and Yuan Ming.
They lifted their cups, substituting tea for wine, and toasted each other.
"When I left those years ago, I said we'd meet again in the martial arts world. I didn't expect to encounter you here in the East Sea today. With Brother Yuan's strength, you must have come for the Immortal Fruit Conference as well. Do you already have an identity to participate? If you haven't found a suitable island yet, I've got some connections," Wu Lu offered.
"Thank you for the kind offer, Brother Wu Lu. However, I've already formed an alliance with Red Ganoderma Island and plan to participate in the conference under their banner," Yuan Ming declined Wu Lu's offer.
"Red Ganoderma Island? Yes, Island Master Bishui does have some capabilities and prefers not to conflict with others. The most crucial point is, I've heard there are many beauties on the island. Brother Yuan is quite lucky," Wu Lu said with a teasing smile, indicating he was familiar with Red Ganoderma Island.
"You misunderstand me, Brother Wu Lu. I am hardly a man greedily after beauty; it's just that I happened upon this doorway. Let's not talk about this. It sounds like you're here for the Immortal Fruit Conference too. Which side are you representing in the competition?" Yuan Ming inquired.
"It's the same as Brother Yuan; just a Second-level Island named Blood Bird's Nest Island. If we cross paths there, I'll have to ask Brother Yuan to show mercy," Wu Lu responded with a bitter laugh, continuously bowing his hands in respect.
"Brother Wu Lu, are you after the Red Mulberry Immortal Fruit? That fruit is greatly important to me; I'm afraid I cannot yield it to you," Yuan Ming frowned slightly, expressing some discomfort.
"Hehe, don't worry about it. I am here mainly to witness the grandeur of the Immortal Fruit Conference. Although the Red Mulberry Immortal Fruit is precious, it's not indispensable for me. Brother Yuan need not have any reservations," Wu Lu waved his hand dismissively.
Yuan Ming sighed lightly and poured another cup of tea, toasting Wu Lu, "I've put you at a disadvantage."
After draining his cup, Yuan Ming suddenly recalled a matter and asked, "Brother Wu Lu, back then you mentioned being coerced by your clan. Are you still troubled by this? Would you need my assistance?"
"There's no need for that. Since escaping from the Guiyuan Sect's mine, that Elder Niu tried to find me several times but ultimately I managed to evade him. When I wanted to plot his demise after reaching Core Formation, he mysteriously disappeared. Perhaps some major event occurred within the clan. I'm not aware of the details. So many years have passed, and now that I'm at Core Formation and in the East Sea, it's not possible for the clan to send a Nascent Soul after me. Thus, that matter has also come to pass," Wu Lu said.

chapters.title: Chapter 480 - 457: Large Auction
chapters.content:
Wulu spoke, and recalling the experiences of these past years, he couldn't help but sigh with emotion, "Ah, Brother Yuan, maybe you don't feel much about it, but back when you freed the mines, perhaps it was just a whim, yet it truly changed the fate of many people including myself. For this alone, I should toast to you."
Wulu stood up, picked up his teacup, looked at Yuan Ming, and drained the contents of the cup in one gulp.
Yuan Ming also felt quite moved, and afterwards, the two of them talked about their experiences and amusing stories over the years, chatting until the sky darkened and the teahouse closed, yet their enthusiasm remained unabated.
It wasn't until they agreed to meet again the next day that they each returned to their respective temporary residences.
In the blink of an eye, several days passed, and Bi Shuirou and Yan Siyun had collected intelligence on potential attendants from various islands, summarized and sorted through it, and identified threatening competitors.
Yuan Ming didn't pay attention to this matter; he practiced his cultivation daily, as scheduled, spending his free time drinking and chatting with Wulu, or going to the workshop to collect other materials for Common Poppy, leading a quite joyful life.
One morning, when Yuan Ming emerged from his residence, the Yan sisters were discussing something in the courtyard.
Seeing Yuan Ming come out, Yan Sijing waved at him excitedly, "Fellow Daoist Yuan, I heard that there is a large auction in Fusang City today, do you want to go take a look with us?"
"A large auction? Who's organizing it?" Yuan Ming walked over to them.
Yan Siyun nodded at Yuan Ming, "It's Fusang Island. During the Immortal Fruit Conference, Fusang Island always has a series of auctions arranged. Small auctions every seven days, and large auctions every twenty days. Today marks the first of the large auctions, and the finale is a Nascent Soul Stage Magic Treasure. I wonder if Fellow Daoist Yuan might be interested?"
"I'm free anyway, so going to take a look won't hurt," Yuan Ming nodded and said.
He had already collected most of the auxiliary materials for Common Poppy, and for the two components he was still lacking, he had been planning to check out the workshop in Wuzu District. Now that the opportunity arose, going to see an auction in the East Sea would be good too; he might even find the two types of spiritual materials he needed.
Just then, not far away, Bi Shuirou also came out of her house and walked towards them with leisurely steps.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming took the initiative to invite her, "Fellow Daoist Bishui, you've come at the right time. There's a large auction in the city today, would you care to join us?"
Keepusgoingbyreadingon*.
"A large auction? So it's that time already, huh? But I won't be going. The Spirit Stones I have are all earmarked for specific uses, and there really isn't any surplus to spare," Bi Shuirou said with a wry smile.
Yuan Ming wasn't surprised by this. Although these Island Masters commanded sizable territories and had some Third-class Islands as vassals, ensuring a decent income, their expenses were equally considerable. It wasn't easy to tamper with the reserves of Spirit Stones. In truth, they weren't as free as a small-scale cultivator like him.
"However, if you all are going, you can use the identity of Red Ganoderma Island. By the rules, the one hundred and twenty-eight participating islands can directly enter a private box without paying an entry fee. Here, just show this Token to the people at the auction," Bi Shuirou said, taking out a token and handing it over to Yuan Ming.
After that, she hurried off as though she had another tea party with other island masters to attend.
Before leaving, Yuan Ming went and specially invited Xi Ying as well, but Xi Ying seemed to lack interest. After pondering for a moment, she declined Yuan Ming's invitation and continued with her secluded cultivation.
...
The Golden Feather Auction House was located at the northernmost end of Wuzu District, an enormous three-layered structure with a bowl-shaped design that somewhat resembled a bird's nest.
When Yuan Ming and Yan Siyun arrived, there were already quite a few people lined up at the entrance of the auction house, waiting to get in.
However, as soon as Yuan Ming presented the token to a servant at the auction house, the servant promptly and respectfully showed Yuan Ming and the other two to a private box on the second layer.
The outer walls of the box were made of black crystal, and special forbidden spells were laid within. One could see clearly into the area below from here, but those below could not see into the box.
After making some inquiries, Yuan Ming learned that the ground floor of the auction house only required an entry fee of ten Spirit Stones for general seating, while the private boxes on the second floor were available to cultivators with proofs of identity and had no specific assignment. Apart from the auction house staff, no one knew which island's owner or which Scatter Alliance's member was sitting in each box.
The third layer, on the other hand, was the exclusive domain for Nascent Soul Ancestors.
Yuan Ming sent the servant away and, while waiting for the auction to start, he idly flipped through the auction list that was placed in the box.
There were many items to be auctioned this time, including elixirs and Magic Treasures suitable for use by Core Formation Stage cultivators, as well as large objects like Formations meant for island powers.
Yuan Ming scanned through the list and found that the two types of spiritual materials he wanted weren't included. There were a few other items he found interesting, but none were critically needed. If the final auction prices were exorbitant, he wouldn't engage in a bidding war to the death.
However, perhaps to maintain mystery, the last five auction items did not have detailed introductions on the list, with only a general mention of their categories.
The Water attribute Magic Treasure mentioned by Yan Siyun as the final auction item was also not elaborated upon, merely noting that it was a Water attribute treasure.
Yuan Ming put down the auction list, was about to close his eyes and replenish his spirit, when out of the corner of his eye, he caught sight of a figure in a grey cloak with a wide-brimmed hat entering from outside. The figure quickly entered a private box on the second floor not too far from him.
"Is it him?" Yuan Ming's eyes flashed with surprise as a very faint divine sense spread out.
The mysterious figure wore a vestment robe that blocked the probing of divine sense, but Yuan Ming wasn't trying to probe the person, merely sensing his aura, and he quickly made a discovery.
"Indeed, it's him. Why would he come here?" Yuan Ming mused to himself.
The grey silhouette was none other than Wu Yuezhi, who had appeared at the Shura Palace with Ni Mu from the Dawn Alliance. What was he doing at this auction, acting so surreptitiously?
Once Wu Yuezhi sat down in the private box, he waved his hand and a cloud of Black Mist enveloped the area, rendering Yuan Ming's divine sense unable to penetrate.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, what seemed to have happened?" Yan Siyun seemed to notice the change in Yuan Ming's expression and asked.
"It's nothing. I thought I saw someone I knew, but after they entered a private box, I couldn't see them anymore," Yuan Ming replied casually.
"Which private box? Would you like me to send someone to greet them?" Yan Siyun offered.
"There's no need. We're not particularly close. At this auction, do you have any specific targets in mind?" Yuan Ming shook his head, changing the subject.
"Hmm, we plan to bid on some precious spiritual materials and Demon Cores to refine a batch of fine elixirs and establish the reputation of Hundred Pills Square sooner," Yan Siyun said.
Yuan Ming nodded and asked no more.
Time passed and with more cultivators arriving, the auction soon officially commenced.
"Looking at this auction list, Golden Feather Auction House is indeed offering quite a lot of good items. Brother Lin, have you prepared to secure any treasures?"
"With my modest means, you already know, Brother Wang, if real treasures surface, it wouldn't be our turn. I've heard that big names like White Scale Master from Thousand Snake Island, Queen Ming Kong from Bijiao Island, and Golden Transformation Master from Thousand Dragon Island, all Nascent Soul powerhouses, are here. It's better for us to just buy some valuable items quietly," came the reply.
"True, if I can get those Bishui Soft Crystals and cultivate my Canglan Technique to the Eighth Layer, I would be perfectly content," another voice chimed in from a neighboring private box.
Hearing this, Yuan Ming glanced toward the third layer of the venue but didn't pay it much attention.
The auction was hosted by a Core Formation stage colorful-robed female cultivator.
"I am Xiao Jing of Golden Feather Auction House! Greetings to all Fellow Daoists. I will be hosting this auction. I hope everyone can purchase their desired items..." the colorful-robed female cultivator said with a smile.
With the sound of a gong, the auction officially started, and one after another, items were brought up for bidding.
The colorful-robed female cultivator was not only beautiful but also extremely eloquent. Under her lead, many items were sold for higher prices than usual, which, in turn, spurred the participating cultivators to become more enthusiastic about bidding.
However, Yuan Ming remained calm and composed in his private box, unaffected by the atmosphere, and only bid sparingly.
As a result, of the few items he was interested in, he only managed to acquire two.
One was a Wood Attribute Demon Core, intended for Hua Zhi to devour and refine; the other was a set of formations called the Yimu Gathering Spirit Array.
The effect of this array was quite simple: it harnessed the power of the array and Wood Attribute Spirit Stones inside it to condense the surrounding Wood Attribute Spiritual Energy, creating a richer environment of Spiritual Energy to enhance the speed of cultivation.
Although the Yimu Gathering Spirit Array could enhance the concentration of Spiritual Energy by up to fifty percent, it consumed a significant amount of Spirit Stones, leaving it somewhat lacking, which is why not many were inclined to bid on it, allowing Yuan Ming to secure it.
In contrast, Yan Siyun had come well-prepared.
Whenever valuable spiritual materials or Demon Cores came up, she did not hesitate to place a bid. She seemed to have thoroughly researched the identities of her fellow bidders, always offering a price that was neither too high nor too low, which made her competitors hesitant without overbidding too much for the item.
As a result, although she won numerous bids on spiritual materials and Demon Cores, her actual expenditure wasn't as enormous as one might expect.
Yuan Ming watched from the side, and couldn't help but admire her tactics. If it weren't for her limited talent and strength, her mastery of information gathering and use alone could very well make her the leader of a significant force.
"...And so the next item for auction is a Fire Seed of apricot wood green fire. As the saying goes, 'Born from the Five Elements, the world contains a rich variety of Five Elements wonders,' among which True Fire, Strange Water, Weird Wood, Heavy Stone, and Bizarre Gold are the most mysterious. This apricot wood green fire that our auction house has spent great effort to collect is one of those True Fires. Unlike ordinary True Fire, this fire's nature is Wood. It's less useful for attack, but it has the capacity to promote growth and healing. After refinement, it can nourish a cultivator's physical body, repairing past subtle injuries. Also, because of its gentle nature, it is particularly suitable for refining elixirs, although, unfortunately, its power is too weak for Artifact Refining," the colorful-robed female cultivator's voice flowed gently from the stage and reached the private boxes, brightening Yan Siyun's expression. As soon as the starting price was announced, she immediately made a bid.

chapters.title: Chapter 481 - 458: The Struggle for True Fire
chapters.content:
"Fellow Daoist Yan seems interested in this True Fire, but I remember that your sister has already nurtured a strand of True Fire within her body. Without a special technique, two True Fires cannot merge. Could it be that Hundred Pills Square now has another Alchemist capable of wielding True Fire?" Yuan Ming said, surprised by Yan Siyun's move.
"Alas, Fellow Daoist Yuan is not aware of our situation. The Alchemy Technique of the East Sea differs significantly from that of the Black Wind Desert. Most elixirs are refined with Demon Cores and demon beast flesh and blood, with Spirit Grass Alchemy being quite rare. Among them, the elixirs refined from Demon Cores have the best effects. However, Demon Cores are hard to find, and Hundred Pills Square cannot afford to use Demon Cores in refining all elixirs. Thus, we have to follow suit with other stores, utilizing demon beast flesh and blood in our alchemy," Yan Siyun sighed and explained from the start.
Yuan Ming, who had just arrived in the East Sea and possessed plenty of elixirs, hadn't paid attention to the local elixir situation. Hearing this, he was quite surprised and said, "Using Demon Cores in Alchemy is not uncommon, but I didn't expect that demon beast flesh and blood could also be used here. Aren't there any side effects to such elixirs?"
"Strictly speaking, it's not so much side effects; it's that the demon beast flesh and blood have mixed and muddled auras, making the effects of the refined elixirs significantly weaker than those made from Demon Cores. There are also many impurities. Although I possess Ice Core Yin Fire, I'm not adept at removing impurities from elixirs. The elixirs I refine are no different from those of other stores, which is why our business here is nowhere near as smooth as it was in the Black Wind Desert," said Yan Siyun quite helplessly.
Yuan Ming suddenly understood and continued to ask, "Does Fellow Daoist Yan want to bid for the apricot wood green fire to replace the Ice Core Yin Fire within your sister's body, or is there another method that allows your sister to use both Types of True Fire at the same time?"
"It's true that nothing escapes Fellow Daoist Yuan's notice. Indeed, ever since the store opened, I have been looking for a way to solve this problem. As luck would have it, I stumbled upon a damaged Two-Orifice Pill Furnace in the black market of Dragon King City. If I can secure the apricot wood green fire, I might resolve our current predicament," Yan Siyun said.
"What is a Two-Orifice Pill Furnace?" Yuan Ming asked curiously.
"It is the name for a high-grade pill furnace. A Two-Orifice Pill Furnace contains two Fire Spirit Formations, capable of producing two completely different flames. Not only can they enhance each other's firepower, but they also do not conflict with one another, resulting in a much more effective pill refining than a single formation furnace. If an Alchemist has two kinds of True Fire, they can be infused into the fire formations to achieve even better results," Yan Siyun explained.
Yuan Ming's eyes lit up, "Such a marvelous pill furnace exists, Fellow Daoist Yan is indeed fortunate."
"It's all thanks to my sister's efforts. Pill furnaces with multiple orifices have excellent alchemy effects, and I have long wanted one. Unfortunately, such treasures are incredibly precious. A Two-Orifice furnace alone costs at least two to three hundred thousand Spirit Stones, which Hundred Pills Square simply can't afford. Thankfully, my sister found this damaged furnace in the black market. Although much of its array patterns were damaged, the core remained intact. I found an Artifact Refiner to repair most of the furnace, so with the apricot wood green fire, I'm confident I can refine exceptionally pure demon meat elixirs," Yan Sijing said excitedly.
"I see. It seems this apricot wood spirit fire is crucial for Hundred Pills Square. Since I have invested in it, I should also contribute. Fellow Daoist Yan, go ahead and bid. If you fall short, you can make up the difference from me," Yuan Ming said with a smile.
"How can I impose on you? You have already helped Hundred Pills Square so much, and we haven't been able to repay you. How can we let you spend more?" Yan Siyun hurriedly declined.
"If you feel uneasy about it, just give me a larger share of the profits once you start earning," Yuan Ming waved his hand and said nonchalantly.
Deeply appreciating Yuan Ming's generosity, Yan Siyun immediately assured him that if she acquired this True Fire, she would definitely increase the profits of Hundred Pills Square by at least fifty percent.
Meanwhile, although the apricot wood spirit fire was just a common auction item, many were interested in it. Despite Yan Siyun's efforts to control the price, she couldn't stop it from continuously rising.
Fortunately, the rate of price increase eventually slowed down and stopped completely after Yan Siyun's final bid.
"Alright, the Fellow Daoist in Booth Yi-73 bids seventy-three thousand Spirit Stones. Is there anyone willing to offer more?" The female cultivator hosting the auction looked around the hall. After waiting for quite a while with no one responding, she was about to lower the gavel.
But just at that moment, from the third floor of the auction house, a hoarse voice suddenly rang out:
"Seventy-four thousand Spirit Stones."
In the booth, Yan Siyun's expression changed slightly. A Nascent Soul cultivator on the third floor had unexpectedly joined in, beyond her expectations.
Quickly thinking, Yan Siyun decisively raised her bid: "Eighty thousand Spirit Stones!"
Nascent Soul powerhouses were wealthy individuals. Increases of two or three thousand Spirit Stones wouldn't deter them, so she immediately added five thousand.
Inside a private room on the third floor stood seven or eight members of the Thousand Snake Clan, including that Nascent Soul stage effeminate man.
"A mere Core Formation cultivator dares to compete with the ancestor in bidding, clearly showing contempt for our Thousand Snake Clan. Let me capture them!" A cold young man with green skin and blue eyes said angrily.
The other members of the Thousand Snake Clan also appeared full of righteous indignation.
"This is the Fusang City auction. We are here to bid with our financial power, not to cause trouble," White Scale Master spoke indifferently, then slowly raised the bid:
"Ninety thousand Spirit Stones."
Yan Sijing was in great distress; the True Fire that seemed it was about to come into her possession had suddenly run into an issue!
The apricot wood green fire was critical for the development plans of Hundred Pills Square, and Yan Siyun did not give up, "One hundred thousand Spirit Stones!"
"One hundred and twenty thousand." White Scale Master's face was slightly cold. Although his voice remained unhurried, it clearly began to carry a hint of displeasure.
Yan Siyun's face turned a bit pale, the price had already far exceeded her expectations. Although she still had a surplus of Spirit Stones, judging by the attitude of the Nascent Soul powerhouse on the third floor, he would definitely continue to bid. If the bidding went on, she feared that not only would she fail to acquire the True Fire, but she might also anger the other party, resulting in a loss greater than the gain.
Yan Siyun turned her head to glance at Yuan Ming, seemingly seeking his opinion.
"Let it be, apricot wood green fire, though precious, is far too expensive at one hundred and twenty thousand Spirit Stones. Since a Nascent Soul cultivator is interested, we might as well let him have it. As for the other True Fire needed for the Pill Furnace... I will find another solution when I get back, and perhaps I can find a better one." Yuan Ming glanced at the private room of the Thousand Snake Clan and said.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan is right. However, the Immortal Fruit Conference is approaching, and you needn't worry too much about the True Fire. Though it's scarce, it's not that precious. I will continue to mobilize my subordinates to collect information. We'll find another one sooner or later." Despite some regret, Yan Siyun's face also showed a trace of relief.
Brought to you by the folks at *.
Yan Sijing was clearly unhappy, as True Fire suitable for Alchemy was not so easily found. The people from Hundred Pills Square had inquired around the East Sea for about a year before learning that True Fire would appear during the Immortal Fruit Conference. Missing this opportunity, they didn't know how long they would have to wait next.
On the stage, the colorful-robed female cultivator waited for a few moments. Seeing that there were no more bids from the second-floor private rooms and knowing that a Nascent Soul cultivator had made a bid, it was unlikely that anyone else would bid again, she knocked the auction hammer three times, announcing the winner of the lot.
"Congratulations to guest number seven in compartment 'A' for acquiring the apricot wood green fire. After the auction concludes, our establishment will deliver the auction items in a unified manner. If the Senior wishes, you can also command your attendants now to have the item sent over," she said respectfully.
Having said that, and seeing that White Scale Master did not respond, she waved her hand toward the attendants behind her, signaling them to bring up the next auction item.
In the private room on the third floor, White Scale Master looked toward the compartment where Yuan Ming and the Yan sisters were, eyes brimming with a thick layer of dark, ghostly light, which seemed to be some kind of Pupil Technique. His mouth quickly revealed a strange smile.
"So it's them; no wonder they were competing for the apricot wood green fire."
"Does the ancestor know these three people?" The green-eyed young man also had traces of black light in his eyes, looking down curiously and asking.
This person's Pupil Technique was clearly not as advanced as White Scale Master's, but he had begun to understand the basics and was able to see through the Forbidden protections surrounding Yuan Ming's compartment.
"Hmm, Qing Tong, do something for me..." White Scale Master beckoned with a wave of his hand.
Amid the free seats on the first floor, many cultivators couldn't help but whisper among themselves.
"Who would have thought that this auction would see a Nascent Soul powerhouse participating in the bidding, and it's just for a piece of True Fire. Could it be that this apricot wood green fire carries some sort of secret?" A green-robed cultivator whispered.
"I don't think that's necessarily the case. The owner of Golden Feather Auction House, Liao Shun, is a direct disciple of Qiong Hai Island Master. Although his cultivation isn't outstanding, his skill in treasure identification is not inferior to his master's, and there haven't been any treasures that have slipped past his inspection. Besides, do you know who the Nascent Soul Ancestor that bought the True Fire is?" The green-robed cultivator's neighbour, a cultivator dressed as a Taoist, shook his head.
"How would I know that?" The green-robed cultivator was taken aback.
The Daoist monk cultivator smiled mysteriously: "If my guess is correct, he's probably White Scale Master from Thousand Snake Island."
"That old monster? Wait, the private rooms in the auction house are all protected by Forbidden arrays, how can you know his identity?" The green-robed cultivator couldn't help but wonder.
The Daoist monk cultivator chuckled, "Ah, you don't know. Half a year ago, there was an auction held on Ping Mountain Island where a True Fire emerged. It wasn't really a big deal, but who knew that White Scale Master would actually show up and bid on that True Fire. I just happened to be there, and the voice of that Nascent Soul powerhouse just now was exactly the same as White Scale Master's. Who else could it be but him?" he explained.
"I see, but that's a bit strange. Of the three major Alien Clans in the East Sea, the Snake-man Clan has the greatest aversion to fire. It's quite curious as to why White Scale Master is collecting True Fires and to what end." The green-robed cultivator said in surprise.
"The motives of a Nascent Soul powerhouse are beyond our comprehension as Core Formation cultivators. We should just mind our own business. Oh, I've been so caught up talking to you that another lot has come up. It's actually the one I've had my eye on, so I'd better stop chatting now," the Daoist monk cultivator glanced at the item on the stage and quickly called out a bid.
Yuan Ming, having heard their conversation, remained composed.
He had already deduced from the voice that the person on the third floor was White Scale Master, but it was curious why he was collecting various kinds of True Fires and what purpose he had in mind.

chapters.title: Chapter 482 - 459 Tide Makers
chapters.content:
The auction continued, and as various valuable items kept appearing, the powerful Nascent Soul cultivators on the third floor also began to make frequent moves.
Amid the continuous sounds of bidding, the auction finally came to its closing stages. The most anticipated items took the stage one by one. The previously noisy main hall gradually quieted down, but from the private rooms on the second and third floors, many voices of bidding could still be heard.
"Next, we have the final item of this auction, the long-awaited finale treasure—the Tide Rising Misty Sea Ring."
As the colorful-robed female cultivator introduced the item, three Core Formation cultivators walked onto the stage from different directions. One of them carried a jade box, placing it on the display table, after which the other two cultivators stepped forward and cast different spells, striking the jade box.
Then, with a light "click," the seal on the jade box was temporarily lifted, opening a small crack from which a surging water attribute spiritual energy rushed forth, creating the illusion for everyone in the auction house that they were being hit by ocean waves.
In the second-floor private room, Yuan Ming couldn't help but grow more curious about this final auction item, which was making such a grand entrance. He wondered what mysteries it possessed.
After a momentary release, the spiritual energy flowing from the jade box gradually ceased, and the colorful-robed female cultivator then stepped forward to fully open the jade box.
Inside the jade box lay a palm-sized pale blue bracelet, whose surface resembled rippling water. Even without being touched, it was continuously undulating and drifting. A faint blue glow accompanied the ripples, making it look hazy like a shadow—as if, if one wasn't careful, they would be unable to find its location.
"This Magic Treasure was obtained from a ruin in the outer sea. After appraisal, we've established that this treasure's rune formation contains twelve runes, surpassing the level of a Magic Treasure and is an imitation of the legendary Spiritual Treasure—the Azure Sea Ring!"
The colorful-robed female cultivator's astonishing words solidified the atmosphere in the auction house. Almost everyone's gaze fell fixated on the bracelet, and even those who knew they couldn't compete couldn't help but reveal a hint of greed in their eyes.
Over the past few days, many auctions had been held in Fusang City. Numerous precious Magic Treasures had appeared, but this was the first time an imitation Spiritual Treasure had surfaced.
Yuan Ming also sat up a little straighter, showing an interested expression.
During this time, he had refined the Night Parade of Hundred Demons and Cold Moon Ring to completion using the Nameless Refining Secret Technique taught by the Shura Master, deepening his understanding of imitation Spiritual Treasures.
A Magic Treasure's runes number from five to nine. When they exceed nine, it becomes a Spiritual Treasure. The Night Parade of Hundred Demons and the Cold Moon Ring contained twelve and ten runes respectively.This соpy wаs gеnеrаtеd frоm соntеnt аt МV|LЕМРYR.
However, a true Spiritual Treasure contains a spirit besides the runes. Whether it's the Night Parade of Hundred Demons, the Cold Moon Ring, or the Tide Rising Misty Sea Ring in front of him, none possess this, hence they can only be considered imitation Spiritual Treasures.
Although Yuan Ming already owned a true Spiritual Treasure and two imitation treasures, no one deems their collection of treasures too large. He was somewhat interested in the Tide Rising Misty Sea Ring but was yet to ascertain its abilities.
"This Tide Rising Misty Sea Ring is without any damage and is more powerful than ordinary imitation Spiritual Treasures. According to the experts of our company who have tested and estimated it, once a cultivator has refined seven runes, it can possess the power of a Nine Rune Magical Treasure. If one refines nine runes, its power could match an ordinary imitation Spiritual Treasure, and as for the full might once all twelve runes are refined, only the owner of the treasure will know," the colorful-robed female cultivator said with a smile, intentionally leaving the audience in suspense.
Just then, from one of the third-floor private rooms came a clear, pleasant voice, yet it was filled with authority.
"Hehe, spoken in such a grandiloquent manner. If this Tide Rising Misty Sea Ring truly had such power, why would your Golden Feather Trading Company put it up for auction?"
"Fellow Daoist Ming Kong is right. Little girl, just tell us the real situation about this ring. After all, only a few of us here can actually bid. Stop exaggerating," Bai Lin Master's voice also emanated from another private room.
"Everything this humble one has said earlier was verified through the personal inspection and testing by Nascent Soul Ancestors and is by no means an empty boast. Furthermore, the Tide Rising Misty Sea Ring is more auxiliary in nature, with average offensive capabilities. After being refined by our company's Nascent Soul Cultivators, the ring's abilities have been identified as threefold: first, it can rapidly convert the surrounding water vapor into pure water spiritual energy for the holder's cultivation. In other words, for cultivators who practice water attribute cultivation methods and are at sea, the Tide Rising Misty Sea Ring eliminates almost all concerns about mana exhaustion," the colorful-robed female cultivator responded confidently to the Nascent Soul cultivators' probing.
"Oh, then it seems that this Tide Rising Misty Sea Ring is quite fated for me. Fellow Daoist Ming Kong, Fellow Daoist Bai Lin, both of you possess water spirit bloodlines and have unique physiques, thus you can freely utilize the spiritual energy of the sea without needing this ring's ability. How about you leave the Tide Rising Misty Sea Ring to me to avoid spending a great deal of money on something useless," another Nascent Soul Ancestor said with a hearty laugh, his voice resounding and metallic like the friction of metals.
This person had a straightforward appearance, eyes fierce like a dragon's, nose solid as a rock, and his thick hair resembled the Dragon King from storybooks; however, there was no demon energy around him, and he was a pure Human Clan cultivator.
"It's the Master of Thousand Dragon Island, Golden Transformation Master! The ones who spoke just now were Bai Lin Master of Thousand Snake Island and Queen Ming Kong of Bijiao Island. With this finale treasure up for grabs, these Nascent Soul Ancestors are indeed vying for it," the crowd below murmured.
"Master of Thousand Dragon Island." Yuan Ming glanced upward, remembering that Liu Tianming had asked him to seek out this man's son upon his arrival in the East Sea.
However, not wanting anyone to know the whereabouts of his parents, he hadn't even made use of the contacts of Hundred Pills Square, much less go to Thousand Dragon Island. He had made some inquiries about the island, and had carefully read the information collected by Yan Siyun about the various forces of the East Sea.
Thousand Dragon Island was a first-class island with formidable strength. The territory it controlled had many high-grade mines, making it very wealthy, with many second-level and third-level islands under its dominion.
In terms of the number of subordinate islands, Thousand Dragon Island was almost unrivaled among first-class islands.
The Master of Thousand Dragon Island, Golden Transformation Master, was only at the Nascent Soul Early Stage, but the island had passed down an Exotic Treasure called the Nine Dragon Pearl for generations.
This remarkable treasure caused dramatic changes in the body once refined; not only was the resultant strength incomparable, akin to a Body Cultivator of the same tier, but it also endowed the features of the Dragon Clan, allowing the user to contend with opponents a stage higher than themselves.
"Give it to you? What a joke, Golden Transformation Taoist, your face isn't that big." White Scale Master sneered coldly, appearing to have some grudges with the Golden Transformation Master.
"Golden Transformation Daoist, this treasure has three abilities, yet only one has been revealed so far, isn't it too early to draw conclusions?" Queen Ming Kong said faintly.
Hearing this, the Golden Transformation Master laughed 'heh heh' but did not retort.
Seeing this situation, the colorful-robed female cultivator quickly announced the remaining two abilities: "The second ability of the Tide Rising Misty Sea Ring is to allow the bearer to transform into a water form, almost immune to all physical attacks and injuries."
"As for the third ability of this treasure, it is Concealing Breath and Invisibility; combined with the water transformation ability, it can elude detection even by cultivators one tier higher."
"What a fantastic treasure." Hearing the introduction from the colorful-robed female cultivator, Yuan Ming began to feel tempted.
With this Tide Rising Misty Sea Ring, one could almost be invincible in the East Sea.
The eyes of Queen Ming Kong and the others all flashed with keen interest. They probed each other with their Divine Sense. Though no one had yet made a bid, the atmosphere of pointed competition was clearly evident.
"Of course, the Tide Rising Misty Sea Ring also has the ability to control great waters, to cause giant waves, and to summon thick fog. However, compared to the first three abilities, these can only be considered ordinary," the colorful-robed female cultivator continued.
"Then, let the bidding begin, starting at 200,000 Spirit Stones!"
Just as White Scale Master and Queen Ming Kong were about to bid, an aged voice suddenly emanated from a private room on the third floor.
"500,000 Spirit Stones."
Queen Ming Kong and the others were all taken aback and turned their heads in unison to look up. Although the auction house's restrictions were exquisite, they could not block the probing of their Divine Senses. Very soon, they made out the face of the person sitting in the private room, a middle-aged man with a pale face without a beard and a gloomy demeanor.
Queen Ming Kong and the others all frowned slightly, not recognizing the man.
"It's him!" Yuan Ming's Divine Sense also spread over, and he inwardly exclaimed.
This man was the foreign Nascent Soul cultivator whom he had seen a few days ago when he used the Stealing Heaven Tripod to investigate the Fusang Tree.
Noticing the probing of the cultivators, the middle-aged man snorted coldly, and a wave of invisible, dark killing intent suddenly rose, causing the air in the private room to become turbulent and directly devouring the Divine Sense of the three.
Yuan Ming retracted his Divine Sense as soon as he spread it out, avoiding the effect.
Queen Ming Kong and the others felt an intense pain in their Divine Souls, as if they had been viciously bitten, and they also sensed an immense and startling surge of malevolent energy. They hummed angrily in their hearts, but they also shuddered with trepidation.
The three Nascent Soul cultivators had made many kills, but the malignant aura on the middle-aged man was more than ten times theirs. Such an evil spirit was not one to be trifled with; even someone as narrow-minded as the White Scale Master refrained from speaking rashly again.
The Golden Transformation Master's brows were tightly furrowed, as if he were recalling something.
Suddenly, a look of shock spread across his face.
"Could you possibly be... Tide Maker Jia Sifang!"
At these words, the crowd below burst into an uproar, all turning their gaze to the private room where Jia Sifang was.
The Tide Maker is a target of adulation for all East Sea demon hunting cultivators. However, the Tide Maker usually operated in the outer sea and seldom came to the Inner Sea, enigmatic as a dragon that shows its head but not its tail. The last appearance of the Tide Maker had been more than a decade ago.
Even though everyone was highly curious, no one dared to activate their Divine Sense for investigation.
"Is this person the Tide Maker?" Yuan Ming also showed a look of surprise on his face.
"Hehe, it turns out to be Fellow Daoist Jia's presence, welcome, welcome." A man with a broad face in a blue robe emerged from behind the auction stage. He was also a Nascent Soul powerhouse, and he greeted Jia Sifang's private room with a cupped fist.
"It's the Qiong Hai Island Master! The old owner behind the Golden Feather Trading Company, he's also here," the crowd discussed animatedly.
"Fellow Daoist Qiong Hai is too courteous. Let's talk about old times later; please continue the auction for now," Jia Sifang said with a cool tone.

chapters.title: Chapter 483 - 460 Unexpected Discovery
chapters.content:
"Fellow Daoist Jia is right. Xiao Jing, you may continue," the Qiong Hai Island Master said without any hint of anger, turning to speak to the colorful-robed female cultivator.
"Yes, Senior Jia has offered five hundred thousand spirit stones. Is there a higher bid?" the colorful-robed female cultivator asked, glancing over the crowd.
White Scale Master kept a tense face, his wide mouth pursed into a line, while Queen Ming Kong furrowed her brows without saying a word, and Golden Transformation Master wanted to bid but was worried about angering the other party.
Jia Sifang, who was at the center of it all, seemed oblivious to these matters. After waiting for a moment, he looked back at the colorful-robed female cultivator to speak again.
Yuan Ming didn't place a bid either. Although the several abilities of the Tide Rising Misty Sea Ring were good, they weren't worth the risk of offending several Nascent Soul cultivators.
"If there are no other bids, you should bring down the hammer," Jia Sifang said indifferently, his tone slightly impatient.
"Since no other Fellow Daoists have bid, then this Tide Rising Misty Sea Ring goes to Senior Jia!" The colorful-robed female cultivator glanced at the box where Queen Ming Kong and the others were, but seeing no reaction from them, she brought down her wooden hammer.
Thus, in a somewhat eerie atmosphere, the auction finally came to an end.
...
Yuan Ming and his two companions followed the crowd out of the auction house.
The nearby people were abuzz with excitement, talking animatedly among themselves.
The auction was truly thrilling, with the appearance of an imitation Spiritual Treasure and the emergence of a Tide Maker, leaving even those who had obtained nothing feeling that the trip had been worthwhile.
"Who would've thought a Tide Maker would appear, could it be for the Red Mulberry Immortal Fruit?" Yan Sijing couldn't help but glance back, her tone quite excited, evidently having recovered from her disappointment at losing the apricot wood green fire.
"Only Core Formation cultivators can participate in the Immortal Fruit Conference. That senior must have had other business, maybe he came for the Tide Rising Misty Sea Ring. With this treasure, traveling through the sea would indeed be much more convenient," Yan Siyun said calmly.
Yuan Ming didn't join in the conversation, his mind harboring a trace of curiosity towards Jia Sifang.
This person had brazenly flown into the city despite the ban and had dominated the auction, suppressing three other Nascent Soul cultivators from even daring to bid. Such a character, also known as a Tide Maker, naturally piqued his curiosity.
As Yuan Ming pondered, suddenly his expression changed, and his divine sense reached out behind him.
Wu Yuezhi, wearing a bamboo hat, also emerged from the auction house.
During the auction, Yuan Ming had specifically observed the box where Wu Yuezhi was located for a while, but Wu Yuezhi hadn't participated in any bidding from beginning to end, as if he were just there to watch.
Read ahead and get updates at *.
Was there nothing that caught his eye? Or did he have some other purpose?
As soon as Wu Yuezhi left the auction house, he blended into the dense crowd and disappeared in the blink of an eye.
Yuan Ming looked in the direction where the man had gone and soon withdrew his gaze.
He took a short stroll around the workshop with Yan Siyun and the others before returning to their residence.
...
Back in his quarters, Yuan Ming immediately unfurled a light screen and sealed it with a silver barrier, entering the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space.
His divine sense followed Miao Xian's Soul Descent Rune down, enveloping the entire Fusang City in search of Wu Yuezhi's trace.
With the revival of the Wu Yue Sect and the Dawn Alliance being the sect's external force, Wu Yuezhi's secretive appearance on Fusang Island was undoubtedly with ulterior motives.
Yuan Ming would have ignored this man if he hadn't noticed him. But now that he had, it was safer to investigate, just in case he was targeting him and Xi Ying.
Strangely, even after scouring Fusang City with his divine sense, he couldn't find any trace of Wu Yuezhi.
"Has he already left?" Yuan Ming furrowed his brows.
But this wasn't a problem for him.
Yuan Ming exited the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space and took out a stick of Possession Black Incense. After lighting it, he used it to possess Wu Yuezhi's body.
At this moment, Wu Yuezhi was speeding across the sea's surface, with Fusang Island's silhouette faintly visible behind him.
"He really did leave, and quickly at that," Yuan Ming muttered to himself. Then, he channeled his Divine Soul Power to imprint Wu Yuezhi's soul and tried to make him reveal his purpose on Fusang Island.
Wu Yuezhi just furrowed his brows for a moment before returning to calm, effectively resisting the influence of the Soul Seal.
Yuan Ming was surprised by Wu Yuezhi's strong will.
He decided not to force the man further, to avoid arousing suspicion.
After flying forward for a short while, Wu Yuezhi encountered a figure on the sea before him, clad in plain clothes with a white complexion surrounded by a murderous air—it was the Tide Maker, Jia Sifang!
"Senior Jia!" Wu Yuezhi stopped in front of the Tide Maker and offered a salute.
"Why is it you? Where is that youngster Ni Mu?" Jia Sifang glanced at Wu Yuezhi and asked indifferently.
"The Alliance Hierarch has recently ascended to the high position of Venerable, managing all the affairs of the Divine Sect in the East Sea. It's quite overwhelming for him, so he sent me to liaise with you, Senior," Wu Yuezhi respectfully explained.
"Ni Mu has become a Venerable of the Wu Yue Sect? The younger generation is indeed formidable. It's hard to believe that the Core Formation junior who once followed us Tide Makers around to handle various chores has now made a name for himself," Jia Sifang chuckled, his voice devoid of any real joy.
"No wonder Wu Yuezhi went to the auction but bought nothing—turns out he was there to meet with Jia Sifang..." Yuan Ming suddenly understood.
"The Alliance Hierarch says he has never forgotten the help Senior offered him back then. Working together with you this time is his way of repaying that debt," Wu Yuezhi continued.
"Recompense? The task he asked of me is extremely dangerous, lose concentration for a moment, and I could very well be crushed to pieces," Jia Sifang huffed.
"Such dangers might pose a risk to others, but for an elder like you, it would merely be a trivial effort. And not to mention, the reward is rather substantial," Wu Yuezhi said with a smile.
"Enough, considering I had an acquaintance with Ni Mu back in the day, I'll take on the task. How should I go about it?" Jia Sifang asked.
"The details are all here. You can look over them at your leisure. If there's anything you're unsure about, feel free to contact me anytime," Wu Yuezhi took out a black jade scroll and passed it over.
Yuan Ming immediately operated his Divine Sense, attempting to probe the contents of the jade scroll, but Jia Sifang had already stowed it away.
"Good, in terms of scheming, I can trust Ni Mu. When do we start?" Jia Sifang inquired.
"The Alliance Hierarch said it's best to start making arrangements after the Immortal Fruit Conference begins," Wu Yuezhi stated unhurriedly.
"That works," Jia Sifang nodded, then turned to leave.
"Elder, please wait, the Alliance Hierarch has another matter to entrust," Wu Yuezhi called back.
Jia Sifang stopped and looked back.
"The Alliance Hierarch mentioned that another friend of his is very likely to be involved in this matter. He wants you to be extremely careful while acting," Wu Yuezhi said.
"Who is it?" Jia Sifang's brow furrowed.
"A woman named Xi Ying," Wu Yuezhi replied.
"Xi Ying? A name I've not heard of, does she belong to the Xi Family of Xiankong Mountain?" Jia Sifang asked.
"Exactly," Wu Yuezhi nodded.
"So, it's those turtles who've tucked their heads in for thousands of years. What, have they finally mustered the courage to come out after lurking for so long?" Jia Sifang said scoffingly.
"The Xi Family patriarch Xi Zheng has even secured a Venerable position within the Wuyue Sect. With thousands of years of heritage, the Xi Family should not be underestimated," Wu Yuezhi gently remarked.
"I'm already well aware of the Xi Family's methods. I'll keep an eye out for that person you mentioned." Jia Sifang stated before abruptly turning around and transforming into a stream of blue tunneling light, disappearing into the distance.
Wu Yuezhi did not linger in the spot either, flying off in another direction.
Yuan Ming lingered in Wu Yuezhi's body for a moment longer until the possession ended, and his consciousness returned to his body.
His expression shifted, taking a while to settle down.
Though this possession of Wu Yuezhi didn't expose his true intentions, it inadvertently provided insight into other information.
Xi Ying's family, it turns out, hailed from a place called "Xiankong Mountain."
And Xi Ying's knowledge of the forthcoming Immortal Fruit Conference surpassed his own. It seemed she was plotting something, and Ni Mu was likely involved as well, not to mention the formidable Tide Maker Jia Sifang... The situation was becoming increasingly convoluted.
He rose and headed out, intending to seek out Xi Ying for an explanation, but stopped at the doorstep.
"Fine, since Xi Ying hasn't spelled it out, it mustn't be time yet. It's better not to ask. As for the others, let's see what you're plotting," Yuan Ming murmured to himself, walking back to sit at the edge of his bed and sweeping his sleeve.
A tall artifact refining furnace, completely lustrous white, appeared in the room—the Sun and Moon Flame Sunrise Furnace. When he had left the Shura Palace before, he had taken the furnace with him.
Although this action would slightly damage the formation set up in the Shura Palace's Artifact Refining Hall, it wouldn't be difficult to repair with Xi Ying around.
Yuan Ming flicked his fingers in a spellcasting gesture, and the Sun and Moon Flame Sunrise Furnace glowed with spirit light, splitting into two.
The body of the furnace slowly lifted into the air, the base remaining on the ground, revealing a large glob of Pure Yang Flame inside.
He put on the Cold Moon Ring and chanted under his breath as a thread of white light shot out, winding around the Pure Yang Flame.
The Pure Yang Flame seemed to sense danger and immediately lashed back, enveloping the white thread, attempting to incinerate it.
However, the Cold Moon Ring, now fully refined, increased vastly in power. No matter how fiercely the Pure Yang Flame blazed, the thread showed no sign of dissipating.
With a sudden slash of the light thread, about one-tenth of the Pure Yang Flame was cut off, hanging in mid-air without dispersing.
Then, Yuan Ming also took out a blue jade bottle. With his finger, which wore the Cold Moon Ring, touching it, a layer of white crystal film instantly surfaced on the bottle wall, resembling an ice crystal.
This was a new ability mastered after the Cold Moon Ring was fully refined—adding a layer of Cold Moon Crystal Film to any object. The membrane, containing the cold power of the Cold Moon Ring, was difficult to breach, especially adept at withstanding Fire Attribute attacks.
The only downside was that the Cold Moon Crystal Film had a time limit. It could only last for a day before dissolving.
Yuan Ming raised the jade bottle and gestured with a spellcasting motion.
A suction force emerged from the mouth of the bottle, drawing in the small glob of Pure Yang Flame.
Yuan Ming immediately placed a Sealing Talisman on the jade bottle, which brought him peace of mind.
The True Flame he had promised to Yan Sijing was precisely this Pure Yang Flame.
Not only was this True Flame useful for Artifact Refining and Alchemy, it was especially good at purifying impurities, far stronger than any such apricot wood green fire.
Yuan Ming looked at the blue jade bottle in his hand, an expressionless visage on his face, though his thoughts were racing internally.
All things considered, he had helped the Yan sisters quite a bit, and he had many tasks of his own to tend to. Moving forward, he'd leave it to them to make their own way. If Yan Sijing and her sister couldn't make a name for themselves after this, he wouldn't continue to invest any further.

chapters.title: Chapter 484 - 461: Yan Sijing Goes Missing
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming put away the Jade Bottle and the Sun and Moon Flame Sunrise Furnace, dissolved the silver barrier, and left the room.
Just at this moment, a flurry of hurried footsteps came from ahead. It was Miao Xian, sprinting towards him with a look of panic on his face.
"Master, something terrible has happened. The workshop owner has suddenly disappeared, and the young lady has asked me to request your presence for consultation," Miao Xian said urgently upon seeing Yuan Ming, as if he had found his pillar of strength.
"Alright, I know," Yuan Ming replied.
"Yan Sijing has gone missing? We've only just returned not long ago; how could she disappear in such a short time?" Yuan Ming's brows furrowed. Miao Xian had just turned to leave when he immediately flashed back into the room and reestablished the silver barrier.
He entered the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space, sat cross-legged on the White Jade Lotus Platform, and triggered his Divine Sense to sweep down through the anchor point, searching Fusang City once again, but he found no trace of Yan Sijing.
Yuan Ming expanded his Divine Sense to its limits, spreading it over a dozen miles outside of Fusang City, but still couldn't find Yan Sijing.
He wore a contemplative expression, left the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space, dissolved the silver barrier, and a flash of black Qi passed over him, causing him to vanish instantly.
Over the past year or so, he had become increasingly adept at the Ghost Shadow Escape Technique, scarcely inferior to Dugu Feng from those years ago.
The next moment, Yuan Ming appeared in Yan Siyun's room, where Xi Ying and Bi Shuirou were present.
"What has happened?" Yuan Ming asked in a grave tone.
"We had just returned to our residence when Si Jing suddenly received a commission for alchemy. Someone wanted her to refine a rare elixir and had requested a face-to-face meeting. Si Jing suspected nothing and immediately rushed over; I didn't think much of it. But then, just moments after she left, she was kidnapped and lost all contact," Yan Siyun said with self-reproach.
"Si Jing has only been gone for a short while; how can you be sure she's been kidnapped?" Yuan Ming inquired.
"My sister and I each have a Blood Marrow Jade Pendant, a magic artifact that allows us to sense each other's location and state of vitality using Bloodline Power—far more sensitive than ordinary sensing artifacts. Just now, Si Jing's energy signal suddenly vanished, and I can no longer sense the location of her Jade Pendant. Something must have happened," Yan Siyun said, showing Yuan Ming a dark red Jade Pendant.
"I see. Xi Ying, since Yan Sijing has only just disappeared, she couldn't have gone too far. You're proficient in various secret techniques; is it possible for you to track down her whereabouts?" Yuan Ming looked towards Xi Ying.
"I have already tried, to no avail. I fear Yan Sijing may have been confined within some sort of Space Artifact or covered by an exceptionally adept Forbidden," Xi Ying shook her head as she spoke.
Yuan Ming's brows knitted together. He hadn't practiced any particular Tracking Secret Technique. Although the Ancient Shadow Soul Seeking Technique of the Six Desires Venerable had fallen into his hands, he had been preoccupied with too many things lately to have the chance to practice it.
"You've already searched with the Stealing Heaven Tripod?" Xi Ying's voice sounded in Yuan Ming's Sea of Consciousness.
"Yes, I found nothing. It seems Yan Sijing has been taken away from Fusang City, but I've just used the Stealing Heaven Tripod's possession ability and it's a bit troublesome now," Yuan Ming communicated back.This copy comes from content on *.
"In such a short time, unless a Transmission Array was used, Yan Sijing shouldn't have been taken too far away," Xi Ying suggested through their mental link.
"For the time being, we can only resort to the tedious method of searching. Later, you take Miao Xian and fly out of the city. Circle the island, and I will use him as the anchor point for Wish Power to search for Yan Sijing's whereabouts," Yuan Ming instructed.
"Alright," Xi Ying agreed.
The two immediately informed Yan Siyun of their plan to go out searching.
"Should we ask Fellow Daoist Bishui for help, or ask the people of Fusang Island for assistance as well?" Yan Siyun asked.
"There's no need for now; wait for our news. If we need the help of Fusang Island, I will let you know," Yuan Ming said, his mind flashing with the image of Jia Sifang as he shook his head.
After saying this, the two of them took their leave.
"Why not seek Fusang Island's help?" Xi Ying asked once they were outside.
"Our identities must not be exposed. It's best we deal with Yan Sijing's disappearance ourselves and try to avoid attracting the attention of others," Yuan Ming explained.
"Why be so overly cautious?" Xi Ying was skeptical.
"A cautious man sails a thousand years," Yuan Ming replied.
Xi Ying took Miao Xian and sneaked out of the city. With the Immortal Fruit Conference drawing near and cultivators from various islands gathering, the Protective Arrays around Fusang City had been dismantled for ease of access, leaving only one or two layers of ordinary sensing restrictions in place.
Xi Ying and Miao Xian quickly left the city, tunneling along the island's edge.
Yuan Ming turned and headed back, entering the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space, and used his Divine Sense to probe along the way.
Xi Ying's tunneling speed was astonishing, and they had soon covered nearly half of Fusang Island, still finding nothing.
"Yan Sijing has never been to the East Sea before, and this is her first time in Fusang City; she couldn't possibly have enemies here. Who would want to capture her? Could it be Jia Sifang? He had long since discovered Xi Ying's presence here. Could he have captured Yan Sijing to use against Xi Ying?" Yuan Ming pondered over the possibilities, quickly dismissing this speculation.
Based on the previous conversation between Jia Sifang and Wu Yuezhi, their plotted actions were to be initiated after the start of the Immortal Fruit Conference. Capturing Yan Sijing at this juncture seemed unwise.
But besides Jia Sifang, who else has the guts to abduct someone in Fusang City?
Yan Sijing is just a Core Formation Stage cultivator. What does she possess that others would covet?
"Ice Core Yin Fire!" Yuan Ming's eyes flashed with a sharp light, and he immediately called a halt to Xi Ying.
"What, have you found Yan Sijing's whereabouts?" Xi Ying asked.
"I haven't found her yet, but I just remembered something that might be related to Yan Sijing's disappearance..." Yuan Ming recounted meeting the White Scale Master from the Thousand Snake Clan at today's auction, how this person was collecting True Fire, and how the White Scale Master had used Divine Sense to probe them when they first entered Fusang Island.
"When we entered Fusang Island, I also sensed the Divine Sense from the White Scale Master. According to what you've said, he is indeed a prime suspect," Xi Ying said after pondering for a moment.
"I just used my Divine Sense to search the territory of the Snake-man Clan but didn't discover Yan Sijing's whereabouts. Do you know of any other strongholds the Snake-man Clan might have near Fusang Island?" Yuan Ming asked.
These past few days, Xi Ying had been organizing information about each island's attendees along with Bishui Rou and Yan Siyun, so her understanding of the Snake-man Clan was surely greater than his.
"I know where Yan Sijing is," Xi Ying suddenly said, transforming into a tunneling light and shooting toward the other side of the island.
Yuan Ming's Divine Sense closely followed, quickly reaching the other side of Fusang Island.
Three giant ships of different shapes were docked at the edge of the island, evidently belonging to the Snake-man Clan, Merfolk, and Water Ape Clan. There were also many people aboard the ships.
"Although the Snake-man Clan, Merfolk, and Water Ape Clan have been thriving in the East Sea for some time, the concept of a deep divide between humans and demons is entrenched, so only a few members of each clan have entered Fusang City, with the majority staying outside the island," Xi Ying said softly, stopping in the distance.
Yuan Ming nodded slowly and activated his Divine Sense to investigate. He quickly located Yan Sijing at the bottom of the Snake-man Clan's ship, covered by layers of flickering blue forbidden spells.
At the moment, Yan Sijing was unconscious, her clothes in disarray, with bloodstains faintly visible on her chest, seemingly comatose due to severe injuries.
A cold light passed through Yuan Ming's eyes as he examined Yan Sijing's condition more closely, and he heaved a sigh of relief.
Although Yan Sijing was gravely injured, her life was not in danger, and the Ice Core Yin Fire within her body was still present, not yet extracted.
In another room on the ship, the White Scale Master was sitting cross-legged with his eyes closed, in front of him was a green Alchemy Furnace about a zhang tall with a dragon and a tiger carved on it, appearing almost lifelike.
