The lodgings of the people on Red Ganoderma Island were dim, and in the courtyard, apart from the sound of insects, there were only bursts of crows cawing.
In one of the guestrooms, Bi Shuirou, who had finally calmed her emotions and drifted off to sleep, suddenly felt an intense pain in her chest and jolted awake, sitting up on the bed.
She clutched the clothing over her chest tightly with both hands, beads of sweat the size of beans rolling continuously down her pale face to the extreme.
The gnawing pain from her chest caused her to clench her silver teeth; she didn't even have the strength to shout.
"Thud..."
Just then, she heard a muffled drum sound from outside the courtyard.
As the drumming started, a strong palpitation arose from within her chest.This text was acquired from *.
"Thud thud…"
With the drumming becoming more distinct, Bi Shuirou's palpitations grew more intense, and her head felt as though it had been clubbed fiercely, growing heavier and more confused.
Before she could react, a drumbeat rang out right outside her door, and she lost consciousness.
Two sneaky figures quietly slipped into the room, naturally Luo Wanshan and Island Master Liu.
At this time, a small black drum was hanging from Luo Wanshan's chest.
In the center of the drumhead was a patch of fresh blood, which came from Luo Wanshan's middle finger and index finger.
"This Silkworm Heart Gu and the Insect Capturing Drum really are a perfect match, to think we could take down Bi Shuirou so easily," Island Master Liu glanced at the supple form of the woman lying on the bed, a flash of eagerness in his eyes.
However, he always knew how to prioritize, aware that now was not the time for such distractions, hence he reined in his stray thoughts.
"Perfect match my ass, forcibly using the Silkworm Heart Gu like this severely depletes my Essence Blood and Divine Soul. By the time the Silkworm Heart Gu grows, this woman will be ruined, turned into a walking corpse. What fun would there be in keeping her?" Luo Wanshan spat out and said.
This deal had him at a significant loss, not only did it fail to achieve his goal, but it also wasted his Essence Blood and Divine Soul. Furthermore, he would have to give up his treasured secret technique to this old fellow Liu—what a frustrating ordeal!
Now, his only hope was to poison the two men together; given their strong cultivation, they were sure to have valuable treasures to compensate him.
"Enough talk, let's get down to business," Island Master Liu urged.
Luo Wanshan did not speak further but fixed his gaze on Bi Shuirou. With his bloodied fingers, he made a gesture, pointing towards her chest.
A centipede-like shadow within her chest emerged instantly, its numerous legs spreading rapidly toward Bi Shuirou's heart and slowly wrapping around it.
The next moment, her eyes opened once more, and she sat up from the bed.
Her pupils seemed slightly listless, but if one did not look closely, it would be undetectable.
Luo Wanshan then took out a white jade wine jug from his bosom and handed it to her, silently reciting the command in his mind.
Bi Shuirou accepted the wine jug and walked out the door, heading straight for the chamber where Yuan Ming was staying.
"Let's hope your poison goes undetected," Luo Wanshan sighed softly, cautiously following her.
Since the Silkworm Heart Gu was not yet mature, he needed to control her closely to ensure nothing went awry; otherwise, he wouldn't have risked coming here personally.
In the courtyard, Bi Shuirou made her way through the corridors and halls to Yuan Ming's door.
"Knock knock…"
After two knocks, there was no sign of light inside, but the door creaked open.
Yuan Ming, just roused from his cultivation, looked puzzled at the slightly disheveled Bi Shuirou at his door, asking, "Fellow Daoist Bishui, at such a late hour, is there something you need?"
"May I come in for a chat?" Bi Shuirou asked softly, her eyes and eyebrows lowered.
Yuan Ming pondered for a moment before raising his hand to ignite the candles inside the room and then stepped aside to let her in.
After the door closed, two figures crept into the courtyard, shrouded in a dim light that isolated their presence. They hid in the shadow of an old tree, cautiously looking towards the house.
The light cast the silhouettes of Yuan Ming and Bi Shuirou on the door, depicting only their blurry profiles.
Nobody knew what the two had discussed, but suddenly, a wisp of smoke emerged from behind Bi Shuirou and quickly disappeared.
"How did it go?" Island Master Liu dared not speak aloud and communicated through a transmission.
"It should be done. That smoke just now must have been from her opening the bottle of Crumbly Wind Powder. It seems that both of them must have been poisoned by now," Luo Wanshan nodded and transmitted back.
"If that's the case, we can withdraw," said Island Master Liu with a look of joy, gesturing to leave.
But Luo Wanshan hesitated, standing still without moving.
"What's wrong?" Island Master Liu asked in confusion.
"I still think it's not secure enough. Why not take this opportunity to kill the lad? If he recovers his mana in three days, wouldn't he become a great threat to us? Who knows how many valuables he still has on him," Luo Wanshan pondered.
After hearing this, Island Master Liu also fell silent for a long moment before slowly nodding, making a gesture as if he was about to strike down someone with his palm.
Once they had made up their minds, they quickly approached the house.
Just as they were ready to launch a surprise attack, a voice came from inside the house, "Fellows, you've made us wait quite a while..."
The two men were startled by the words, realizing that something was amiss, and immediately tried to escape.
As they turned and dashed away, the scenery in front of them suddenly shifted, and two doors swung open on their own, causing them to collide headfirst into another room.
The room was brightly lit, with two figures sitting face to face calmly, and a woman who appeared to have fainted lying on the other side of a round table.
The two people sitting were none other than Yuan Ming and Xi Ying, while the one who had fainted on the table was Bi Shuirou.
"You said they would come tonight; I didn't believe it, but it seems you were right again," Xi Ying said to Yuan Ming with a frustrated expression on her face, as if she had lost a wager with him.
"If they did not come tonight, I would have had to look for them. Today is the second day; the Silkworm Heart Gu within Fellow Daoist Bishui can still be extracted. If it's left until after three days, when the Silkworm Heart Gu has wrapped around the whole heart and fused with it, it will not be so easy to remove," Yuan Ming said with a smile.
Luo Wanshan and Island Master Liu, seeing them chatting casually without taking the situation seriously, felt fear, doubt, and even anger boiling up inside them.
"Let's flee," the two said, exchanging a glance, and then spoke in unison.
With that, Luo Wanshan raised his hand and flung it toward Yuan Ming and Xi Ying. Two blood-red talisman papers ignited, and from the smoke, two green-faced, fanged evil ghosts emerged, opening their bloody maws and lunging at Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming remained indifferent to this, merely giving Luo Wanshan a scornful glance.
Luo Wanshan and Island Master Liu, however, did not dare to look back, leaving the two evil ghosts to cover their retreat as they aimed to escape as quickly as possible.
Yet, they had hardly taken a step when the scene before them changed again, and they found themselves enveloped in darkness amidst swirling mists.
Suddenly, a series of green lights appeared in front of them, with gloomy green lanterns floating on their own, and a massive red archway loomed out of the fog, bearing the bold characters for "Ghost Gate."
"Damn, it's an Illusion Technique," Island Master Liu cried out in dismay.
"Force subdues the many; never mind what Illusion Technique it is, quickly cast and break through," Luo Wanshan tried to remain calm and shouted his orders.
Immediately after, from within the Ghost Gate emerged lanterns dancing in the air, followed by a horde of ferocious ghosts with various appearances rushing out towards the two men.
One of the ghosts, a colossal Red Robed Fire Ghost, was clutching two green-faced, fanged ghosts in its hands, stuffing them into its mouth.
It was clearly the very same two talisman-ghosts Luo Wanshan had used to cover their retreat, now being crunched and swallowed by the Red Robed Fire Ghost, eliciting a chilling sensation in both men's scalps.
Only then did they realize why the young man was so composed—he was an Evil Cultivator skilled in Ghost Path.
Suddenly, both men felt their courage waning.
At that moment, the darkness overhead parted like clouds dispersing to reveal light.
Before the two could relish the sight, they were struck with an even more terrifying vision.
A gigantic figure loomed above them, dwarfing their own bodies as if they were mere toys.
The figure held a pitch-black sword overhead, slashing down towards Island Master Liu.
In his panic, Island Master Liu hastily maneuvered a Silver Shield above him for protection.
However, the sword emitted a yard-long Black Sword Qi, exuding a wild aura as it cleaved through the void. The Black Sword wailed like a banshee.
In a flash, a black light streaked across, and the Black Sword Qi instantly penetrated the Silver Shield, striking Island Master Liu.
Simultaneously, a Curse Power invaded his body.
"Uh…"
A faint sound emerged from deep within Island Master Liu's throat. His body instantly stiffened, and he fell to the ground, lifeless.

chapters.title: Chapter 492 - 469: Squeeze Dry
chapters.content:
Luo Wanshan had never seen such a scene and was scared out of his wits. He immediately gave up resisting and kneeled on the ground.
"The two seniors have vast divine skills, I admit defeat, I admit defeat," he begged for mercy with trembling legs and clasped fists.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming waved his hand and retracted the Night Parade of Hundred Demons and the Soul Destroying Sword.
Luo Wanshan saw the illusions around him dissipate and only the lifeless body of Island Master Liu lay rigidly beside him. He was so terrified that he didn't dare to lift his head to look at Yuan Ming and the other.
"Fellow Daoist Bishui's Silkworm Heart Gu was planted during the competition yesterday, and it's been less than three days; it shouldn't be hard to remove, should it?" Yuan Ming asked, his tone neither hurried nor slow.
"Not hard, not hard at all," Luo Wanshan quickly replied.
"Then don't dally," Yuan Ming snorted coldly.
Luo Wanshan didn't dare to delay and immediately walked over, then stopped hesitantly and said, "To release the Silkworm Heart Gu, I must cut open a gash on her wrist..."
"Do whatever you need to do, and if you dare any trickery, you know what your fate will be," said Yuan Ming indifferently.
"I understand, I understand," Luo Wanshan said anxiously and in fear.
With that, he promptly made a cut on the pale wrist of Bi Shuirou, then he cut his own palm, using his own blood as a lure. He beat the Insect Capturing Drum to entice the Silkworm Heart Gu to leave the body of Bi Shuirou.
Soon enough, an incredibly fat, red flesh worm wriggled out of Bi Shuirou's body.
As soon as the Silkworm Heart Gu had left, Yuan Ming tapped Bi Shuirou's forehead, and a halo faintly flashed.
Afterward, Bi Shuirou's eyes trembled slightly, and she slowly came to.
Looking at the scene before her, she was first startled, then faintly recalled being controlled and coming to find Yuan Ming involuntarily.
"What's going on... Why am I here?" Bi Shuirou rubbed her throbbing head, unable to remember clearly, so she asked.
"These two colluded with each other, planting the Silkworm Heart Gu inside you, then attempted to control you to poison me. Now, Island Master Liu is dead, and for Island Master Luo, I'm leaving him for you to deal with," Yuan Ming explained succinctly.
After hearing this, Bi Shuirou massaged her temples and rested for a while before she finally recovered.
She forced Luo Wanshan to recount the whole story, only then did she fully understand what had happened.
"Had it not been for the assistance of the two Daoist friends, my Red Ganoderma Island might have been finished," Bi Shuirou thought more and more about the close call and promptly got up, bowing deeply in gratitude to the two.
"I didn't do much; he was the one brainstorming and handling matters the entire time. If you're going to thank anyone, thank him alone," Xi Ying waved his hand nonchalantly.
"No need for thanks. Now, what do you plan to do with Island Master Luo?" Yuan Ming asked.
"Island Master Luo, why don't you tell us, how much is your life worth?" Upon hearing this, Bi Shuirou turned to Luo Wanshan and asked.
"I, I am willing to take out half the reserve resources of Luoshan Island as an apology to present to Fellow Daoist Bishui," said Luo Wanshan hastily.
"Only half, huh? Well, Island Master Luo, why don't you choose whether you want to keep the left half of your body or the right half?" Bi Shuirou asked, her voice soft with an amused smile.
"All of it, I'll give it all to Fellow Daoist Bishui. From now on, Luoshan Island will be a vassal to Red Ganoderma Island!" Luo Wanshan immediately amended, speaking rapidly.
"I've heard that your Luoshan Island possesses a certain Beast Taming Secret Technique?" Yuan Ming suddenly asked.
Upon hearing this, a hint of resentment flashed in Luo Wanshan's eyes, but he maintained a fearful expression and said, "Yes, if you desire it, I shall hand it to you immediately."
With that said, his wrist flicked, and an ancient, pale golden booklet materialized in his palm.
Yuan Ming glanced at it and saw that its cover bore the simple characters "Golden Sunflower Beast Taming Technique." He immediately thought of a rumor he had heard, and with a gesture, he took the booklet into his hand.
"The Golden Sunflower Beast Taming Technique... could it be related to the legendary Golden Sunflower Immortal Island, one of the Three Immortals Islands?" Yuan Ming asked.
"Senior has keen eyesight. This technique is indeed from the Golden Sunflower Heavenly Book, the supreme secret treasure of Golden Sunflower Immortal Island. Sadly, the Golden Sunflower Heavenly Book has long been lost, and even this Golden Sunflower Beast Taming Technique is incomplete," Luo Wanshan hurriedly explained.
Yuan Ming looked through it for a moment and discovered that the Beast Taming Technique recorded within it was far more exquisite than what the Three Cave Masters of Biluo Cave had taught him, and some of its profound parts were even beyond the Ten Thousand Beasts True Mirror of the Zhenling Sect.
By cultivating this technique, one could not only command spirit beasts but even merge with their mana and borrow the spirit beasts' divine skills directly.
Unfortunately, as Luo Wanshan said, the "Golden Sunflower Beast Taming Technique" was incomplete, with more missing content than what remained, and only the parts about merging with spirit beasts' mana were intact.
Without saying much more, Yuan Ming naturally took the secret technique for himself.
"Senior, as you can see, I've handed over the secret technique, and I promise never to be an enemy of Red Ganoderma Island in the future. Could you perhaps spare my life?" Luo Wanshan glanced at Yuan Ming's expression before pleading.
Yuan Ming, however, didn't even look at him and instead turned to Bi Shuirou, saying, "Fellow Daoist Bishui, how you deal with this man is still up to you to decide."
Upon hearing this, Luo Wanshan's face turned pale, and he hurriedly began to beg Bi Shui Rou as well.
"Fellow Daoist Bishui, I know there has been some misunderstanding between us..."
"Misunderstanding?" Luo Wanshan didn't get to finish his sentence before Bi Shuirou interrupted him.
"It's not a misunderstanding, not a misunderstanding; it's my audacity that's to blame for harboring inappropriate thoughts about Fellow Daoist Bishui. Every fault is mine, and I have no complaints about whatever punishment you deem fit, Fellow Daoist Bishui. I only beg for you to spare my life," Luo Wanshan pleaded continuously.
"Harboring inappropriate thoughts about me..." Bi Shuirou sneered coldly and questioned, "And the matter of you conspiring with Island Master Liu to annex my Red Ganoderma Island is to be glossed over just like that?"
Luo Wanshan's face turned white, and he grew nearly desperate.
"It's not impossible for me to spare you," Bi Shuirou suddenly changed the subject and said.
Luo Wanshan, who had lost all hope, suddenly saw light again and hurriedly asked, "Just say it. What do I need to do? As long as you spare my life, I'll agree to anything."
"Now that Island Master Liu is dead, I want your assistance to annex Liulan Island," Bi Shuirou slowly spoke.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming's gaze flickered slightly, and a smile that was not quite a smile appeared on his face.
He saw Bi Shuirou in a new light.
Facing an enemy who humiliated her so, Bi Shuirou was able to suppress the desire to kill and instead proposed cooperation; it was clear that her composure and vision were extraordinary.
Upon hearing these words, Luo Wanshan's expression immediately relaxed.
"If that's the case, Fellow Daoist Bishui has come to the right person... To be truthful, I've been in clandestine collusion with the Deputy Island Master of Liulan Island for many years, and now that their Island Master has perished, taking down Liulan Island for Fellow Daoist Bishui will be as easy as flipping a hand," Luo Wanshan calmed himself and quickly said.
"Island Master Luo truly has a wide network of connections. I wonder if you have your pawns on my Red Ganoderma Island too?" Bi Shuirou asked coldly, without any sign of joy, upon hearing his words.
"No, definitely not. Honestly, I have considered planting pawns there, but with Fellow Daoist Bishui's strict control and the united hearts of everyone on Red Ganoderma Island, I have not succeeded," Luo Wanshan, whose heart had just settled, was anxious again.
"I can't completely believe your words, Island Master Luo. In the current situation, even you must feel it's not right for me to just let you go, right?" Bi Shuirou said casually.
"No... not right, then what would Fellow Daoist Bishui require?" Luo Wanshan asked stiffly.
"I have here a secret medicine refined by our Red Ganoderma Island; Island Master Luo just needs to take it obediently. Every month, I will provide you with an antidote on time to help you control the medicine's effect," Bi Shuirou replied, satisfied with Luo Wanshan's answer, and spoke softly.
"What secret medicine?" Upon hearing this, Luo Wanshan's face turned ugly.
"This secret medicine hasn't been used outside before; it has a nice name, 'Vermilion Birthmark.' Once taken, a vermillion birthmark will appear on Island Master Luo's forehead. If you take the antidote on time, you can be safe and sound. But without it, once the poison activates, the vermillion birthmark will immediately release the toxin, penetrating the Sea of Consciousness, and not even gods can save you," Bi Shuirou's smile widened as she explained patiently.
"Fellow Daoist Bishui, I am willing to help you take Liulan Island and then hand over Luoshan Island to the control of Red Ganoderma Island afterward. Can we avoid using this poison?" Luo Wanshan almost begged.
He preferred to give up Luoshan Island rather than be subjected to someone else for life.
"Do you think I'm negotiating with you?" Bi Shuirou retorted.
Luo Wanshan's expression darkened, but he was still struggling internally.
"This Vermilion Birthmark is not unremovable; it just requires taking antidotes consecutively for thirty-six months to be completely eradicated," Bi Shuirou paused before continuing.
In other words, Luo Wanshan only had to serve her for three years to be freed.
After all, she and Yuan Ming had already nearly drained him, and if they didn't offer him any hope, they feared that he might become desperately difficult to manage, which wouldn't be enjoyable.
"How can I trust you?" Luo Wanshan looked towards Bi Shuirou and asked.
Bi Shuirou, tired of talking, reached into her bosom and took out a White Jade Porcelain Bottle, tossing it onto the ground.
Check for the latest updates on * (*).
"You either take the Vermilion Birthmark or die now; you don't have any other choice," Bi Shuirou said with a cold voice.
Luo Wanshan took a deep breath, no longer hesitated, picked up the White Jade Porcelain Bottle, poured out a brightly colored pill, and swallowed it.
Immediately after, he felt a warm current rising from his Dantian to his forehead, where it stopped.
A small, dark red flesh mound the size of a grain of rice appeared on his forehead, resembling a vermillion birthmark.
After the Vermilion Birthmark had been planted, Luo Wanshan had no more intentions of fighting back, collapsing to the ground, drenched as if soaked in water, and went silent.
"You can go back for now. When needed, I'll contact you," Bi Shuirou said with a wave of her hand.
Luo Wanshan, as if soulless, slowly stood up and opened the door.
Just then, a crow suddenly took flight from the tree in the courtyard outside the house, flew into the room, and dove straight into the forehead of Island Master Liu, who had just died, disappearing into it.
Following this, the body on the ground began to struggle to its feet, moving its limbs around, then like the living, removed its storage magic tool and placed it on the table.
This sudden turn of events startled Luo Wanshan.
"You... you're a Soul Cultivator?" He looked towards Yuan Ming with disbelief and asked, filled with regret.

chapters.title: Chapter 493 - 493: 470
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming didn't bother to pay attention to Luo Wanshan's intentions. Instead, he said to Bi Shuirou, "Let Island Master Liu 'live' to return. Dying here now would complicate things later."
Surprise flashed in Bi Shuirou's eyes, and she hesitated before nodding.
"Then I will trouble Island Master Luo to take Island Master Liu back with you, and be careful on the way," Yuan Ming said, turning his head toward Luo Wanshan with a smile.
Upon hearing this, Luo Wanshan felt as if his liver and gallbladder were about to split, and he quickly agreed, taking "Island Master Liu" in a panic to flee.
"Fellow Daoist Bi Shui, tomorrow I will have 'Island Master Liu' hand over full authority of handling Liulan Island's affairs to the Deputy Island Master. He himself will claim to be roaming the outer sea. Afterwards, you can just have Luo Wanshan cooperate with you," Yuan Ming instructed.
With his current cultivation, soul crow corpse control was naturally a trivial matter for him; however, the corpse would ultimately decay over time, so it was imperative to handle the situation swiftly to avoid complications from arising with the passage of the night.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, your great kindness is truly difficult to repay. Please accept my bow," said Bi Shuirou, bowing deeply as she realized he had thought everything through so thoroughly. She knew that without Fellow Daoist Yuan before her this time, she would inevitably be doomed.
If it weren't for the presence of Daoist Xi Ying by Yuan Daoist's side, she might have even offered herself in marriage.
"You are a friend of Xi Ying, and thus a friend of mine. Among friends, there's no need for such formality," Yuan Ming said, waving his hand with a smile.
Xi Ying, who had been standing aside and had said little, now slightly curled the corners of her mouth into a smile.
After Bi Shuirou had left, Xi Ying suddenly raised her eyebrows and asked, "Fellow Daoist Yuan, you've really put a lot of thought into helping Fellow Daoist Bi Shui, incredibly thorough indeed!"
"It's just to make sure we can successfully get the Immortal Fruit," Yuan Ming said, startled, feeling that the comment wasn't really a compliment, and quickly responded.
Xi Ying showed no sign of anger, just huffed lightly and then turned around to leave, returning to her room.
Yuan Ming touched his nose and shook his head before also returning to his room.
Once he closed the door, he took out the incomplete volume of the Golden Sunflower Beast Taming Technique again and started to examine it carefully.
About half an hour later, Yuan Ming put the book volume away and began to meditate with his eyes closed, imagining the intricacies of the technique.
Shortly after, he slowly opened his eyes and tapped the Spiritual Beast Bag at his waist.
In a flash of lightning, Lei Yu's figure appeared inside the room, landing at Yuan Ming's feet.
Yuan Ming, feeling a connection of minds with it, immediately conveyed his intention to practice the Melding Spirit Secret Technique together using Divine Thought.
Lei Yu, upon learning this, was extremely thrilled and cooperatively flew onto Yuan Ming's shoulder.
Yuan Ming smiled knowingly, holding the Stealing Heaven Tripod, and then started channeling his mana according to the content recorded in the Golden Sunflower Beast Taming Technique.
The Melding Spirit Secret Technique, which usually could only be performed between a master and a spirit beast, had a higher success rate the better their rapport. Lei Yu had grown up under Yuan Ming's care, sharing a deep mutual understanding, which was exceptionally strong. Combined with the immense Desire Power within the Stealing Heaven Tripod, Yuan Ming's cultivation speed was extremely fast.
After only trying a couple of times, Yuan Ming quickly managed to channel his mana into Lei Yu's body, establishing a communicative bridge between them.
Then, Yuan Ming let Lei Yu fly off his shoulder, creating some distance between them.
Their connection did not break; the bridge still existed.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming was delighted and officially began the Melding Spirit process, trying to draw Lei Yu's demonic power into his body.
At the initial attempt, Lei Yu felt its demonic power surge out suddenly, causing it some panic and distress as it flapped its wings and walked back and forth in the room.
"Don't be afraid, it's okay," Yuan Ming said quickly to comfort it, allowing it to settle down.
After a few moments, the sensation of the demonic power flowing outward quickly disappeared, replaced by a unique feeling of interconnected blood and energy channels between the two, almost as if they were one entity.
However, Yuan Ming and Lei Yu's Divine Thoughts remained independently intact, not merging into one, otherwise they both would have felt the illusion of truly becoming one entity.
Soon, Yuan Ming was pleasantly surprised to find that after Melding Spirit, his own mana had become much thicker, already comparable to the mid-stage of Core Formation.
He could feel that with just a thought from him, the blended mana and demonic power could flow like water between him and Lei Yu, seamlessly integrated.
"Let's go out and try it," Yuan Ming said with a smile, patting Lei Yu's back, and the man and bird quickly left the courtyard.
Before long, the two appeared above the outer sea surrounding the island.
On the dark sea surface, waves churned, reflecting the moonlight and stirring the shimmering waves.
Yuan Ming's gaze sharpened as he formed a spell with his hand, bringing Lei Yu into the Illusion Space.
He stood on Lei Yu's back, reaching out his arm and spreading his fingers.
The next moment, a golden thunder light sparked in his eyes, and a thick golden thunderbolt branched into dozens of lightning bolts, forming a net of golden electric light that covered the area ahead.
In the void covered by the electric net, golden electric arcs violently collided, emitting bursts of thunderous noise.
The form was different from Lei Yu's Thunder Strike Divine Ability, but the power was superior.
"By merging your demonic power with my Mana, both the range and effect of our attacks have greatly been enhanced," Yuan Ming said joyfully.
Lei Yu chirped cheerfully in response.
Afterward, Yuan Ming raised his palm to the sky, and layers of dark clouds immediately began to rush together, forming a massive stretch of dark thunderclouds, as if the very sky was being churned.
Having tested these two Divine Skills, Yuan Ming was very pleased and then proceeded to try flying.
While channeling the power of thunder and lightning to attempt flying, wing-shaped thunder patterns emerged on both his arms. Then his whole body was engulfed by the force of the lightning, covering a hundred yards in an instant.
Suddenly, a figure wrapped in arcs of electricity appeared high above the sea—now in the distance, now disappearing nearby, fluttering uncertainly like a ghostly specter.
When he stopped, the wing-shaped thunder patterns on his arms also disappeared.
"Indeed, with this Melding Spirit method from the Golden Sunflower Beast Taming Technique, I can now harness the Divine Skills of spirit beasts as well," Yuan Ming expressed with extreme delight.
He then summoned Hua Zhi and the Three-eyed Crow, informing them about the Melding Spirit.
Being Yuan Ming's Believer, the Three-eyed Crow naturally had no objections, while Hua Zhi reacted enthusiastically, vying to be the first to try it out.
Yuan Ming successively completed the Melding Spirit with both of them.
The results of the experiments greatly satisfied him; these two fellows had a higher cultivation level than Lei Yu, so after melding spirits with them, his Mana increased more significantly, roughly to the level of a Late-stage Core Formation.Find this chapter's source on *.
Yuan Ming praised each of the three creatures several times. After consoling them, he collected them back along with Lei Yu.
Subsequently, he dispelled the illusion and returned to his dwelling, thoroughly satisfied.
...
The next morning, the third round of the selection began.
Among the remaining sixteen group islands, one advancing spot would be decided in turn, making today's competition notably more fierce than the previous two days.
Apart from the four second-class islands' groups, the participants sent by the first-class islands were almost exclusively Late-stage Core Formation Cultivators.
Whether by design or coincidence, today's first four matches were all between second-class islands. The four islands that won in the last session—Winter Crystal Island, Wuyun Island, Blood Bird's Nest Island, and Golden Lotus Island—still emerged as winners this session.
And in the following dozen matches, the first-class islands dominated overwhelmingly, securing victories.
By an hour after noon, it was time for the last match of the day—Karma Fire Island versus Red Ganoderma Island.
The spectacular performance of Red Ganoderma Island before had raised some expectations among the cultivators from many islands for this match.
In the history of the competitions, no second-class island had ever managed to overthrow a first-class island, so apart from the cultivators from Luoshan Island and Liulan Island, almost all the cultivators from second-class islands secretly hoped that Red Ganoderma Island, the dark horse, could make history in this tournament.
They were powerless to oppose the unfair competition system, but that did not mean they harbored no resentment.
Most of the first-class island cultivators, while indifferent, nonetheless harbored a faint hope, curious to see Karma Fire Island embarrassed.
These mixed thoughts silently shifted everyone's expectations, and strangely enough, most of the crowd present actually hoped for Red Ganoderma Island to win.
When Xu Fu announced the start of the match, Yuan Ming was the first to leap onto the Martial Arts Arena.
After a short wait, the competitor from Karma Fire Island finally arrived fashionably late, stepping onto the Martial Arts Arena as well, and his arrival immediately sparked a murmuring among the spectators.
"It's him, Karma Fire Island has actually sent him."
"Cui Yu, Karma Fire Island actually let Cui Yu fight—they've really left nothing to chance this time..."
"Tsk, Karma Fire Island must really be scared of losing to send out Cui Yu?"
...
Various noisy voices erupted.
On the stone platform in the square, the heads of the first-class islands also showed their surprise.
The person in charge of Red Rain Island looked astonished, turned to Yan Xiang, and asked, "I remember that Nephew Cui Yu entered seclusion a month ago to attempt a breakthrough to the Nascent Soul Realm. How is he participating in the competition now?"
"His talent is dull, and failing to achieve a breakthrough, he volunteered to participate in the competition, hoping to find an opportunity to break through during a real battle," Yan Xiang replied, his eyes not straying and his tone steady.
The crowd, upon hearing this, scorned inwardly.
Who didn't know that Cui Yu was the direct disciple of the Master of Karma Fire Island, possessing exceptional cultivation talent? Before reaching the age of two hundred, he had already achieved the peak of Core Formation, making him the most likely within Karma Fire Island to advance to the Nascent Soul Realm before turning two hundred.
To say he had dull talent was a fool's belief in this grand-sounding nonsense.
Moreover, attempting a breakthrough to the Nascent Soul Realm isn't something determined within a month of seclusion; normally, it requires a year and a half to three to five years.
It must have been Yan Xiang's realization of something unusual in Red Ganoderma Island's participation this time, fearing some mishap, that led him to summon the secluded Cui Yu for an emergency participation in this match, ensuring absolute safety.

chapters.title: Chapter 494 - 471 Creating History
chapters.content:
On the Martial Arts Arena, Yuan Ming slightly bowed his fist towards the young man in the white robe across from him, his face as handsome as jade.
However, the other party had a cold expression and did not return the gesture. Instead, his gaze towards Yuan Ming was quite gloomy.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming was also a bit surprised. After carefully recalling, he still could not remember when he had met this person, let alone any past conflicts. Naturally, he did not understand where the anger was coming from.
At this moment, Cui Yu was already impatiently slapping his Spiritual Beast Bag at his waist.
The next instant, a scorching wave of air surged from his side, like walls of fire from all directions, pushing towards the surroundings.
Yuan Ming immediately felt a scorching breath coming straight at him, causing his breathing to stall.
Next to Cui Yu, there was now a Red-horned Fire Flood Dragon, about four to five zhang in length, its head bearing a Fiery Red Horn, its body covered in red scales, spouting large swathes of red miasma, with its massive form partly obscured within, much like a dragon showing its head but hiding its tail.
"This is a Red-horned Fire Flood Dragon! It seems to have reached the Third-level Upper Stage!"
"Red Ganoderma Island won two consecutive battles, and it was originally thought that there might be a chance in the third battle, but now it seems impossible."
"Of course, the status of a First-class Island is not something that a Second-class Island like Red Ganoderma Island can shake! Cui Yu seems to be in a bad mood. Whether that kid can even survive is questionable!"
"Karmic Fire Island actually sent such a person to the competition, isn't this making a big deal out of a small issue?"
The spectators gasped and discussed, with voices doubting Yuan Ming's chances rising from all around.
"Red-horned Fire Flood Dragon! It looks like the Flood Dragon bloodline is quite strong. Could it possibly be the direct bloodline from the Red Flood Dragon clan?" the person in charge of Red Rain Island asked with brightened eyes.
"Brother Xu has a good eye. You guessed it right. To capture this Flood Dragon, even the Island Master personally took action, and it took some effort," Yan Xiang said with a hint of pride on his face.
"Congratulations to Karmic Fire Island for adding another powerful spirit beast!" laughed the Cultivator from Red Rain Island.
Bi Shuirou's face flashed with unease, and she couldn't help but look towards Xi Ying.
"Don't worry," Xi Ying said calmly.
Yuan Ming observed the Red-horned Fire Flood Dragon for a moment, then pressed his hand on his own Spiritual Beast Bag.
"Show yourself, Lei Yu." Visit * (*) for more.
The next moment, a flash of lightning passed by him, the dazzling light stinging the eyes of many onlookers.
Accompanied by a clear and distant cry, a huge Thunder spiritual bird appeared above Yuan Ming's head, slowly spreading its wings and fluttering them, with electric light swirling under the feathers, making a "zzt zzt" sound of electric current.
At the same time, dark clouds gathered above the arena, forming a huge mass of pitch-black clouds with flickering lightning inside and the sound of muffled thunder coming from within.
The astonishing momentum of Lei Yu's arrival gradually quieted down the chatter in the plaza, until everyone fell silent.
"This help that Red Ganoderma Island has brought is not simple. Everyone was shocked in the last match, and this match's Cultivator is also not weak. Looking at the appearance of this spiritual bird, it seems like the Thunder Wing Bird recorded in the encyclopedia. This bird is said to be a descendant of the Ancient Thunder Peng, and in terms of potential, it's even above the Red-horned Fire Flood Dragon," said the person in charge from Red Rain Island.
"The potential of the Thunder Wing Bird is indeed extraordinary, but it's currently only at the Third-level Lower Stage, not worth worrying about," Yan Xiang said unconcerned.
On the Martial Arts Arena, Cui Yu stared at the Thunder Wing Bird with a covetous look in his eyes.
"Thunder Wing Bird! I've been searching for this bird for many years, to think I would encounter it here. It seems coming here was truly the right decision! Kid, I am in a good mood. If you hand over this Thunder Wing Bird, I can spare your life!" Cui Yu said, the corner of his mouth twitching into a haughty laugh.
Yuan Ming ignored the raving opponent and directly ordered Lei Yu to attack.
With a thunderous roar in mid-air, Lei Yu's figure disappeared in an instant.
In almost a blink of an eye, Lei Yu reappeared but had already surfaced right in front of Cui Yu. As it opened its beak to cry out, a thick silver Thunder Strike instantly formed and shot towards him.
Cui Yu's spirit beast, the Red-horned Fire Flood Dragon, reacted just as quickly. The horn atop its head suddenly brightened intensely, shooting out a thick beam of fire that collided with the silver lightning.
A tremendous "boom" resounded.
Lightning and firelight exploded at the same time, dissipating into strands of electricity and sparks scattering everywhere.
Before the shock wave from this impact dissipated, Lei Yu was already wrapped in circulating electric light, and in a flash, disappeared again.
The next instant, it appeared behind Cui Yu, once more opening its beak to cry out and executing the Thunder Strike Divine Ability.
Silver lightning lanced out, aiming straight for the spot behind Cui Yu's heart.
"As expected from a spirit beast with Thunder Peng bloodline, truly swift!" Cui Yu turned around and struck out a palm behind.
As his sleeve billowed, a streak of red firelight shot out, turning into a sharp spike that swiftly shattered the golden lightning and thrust towards Lei Yu at his rear.
However, by this moment, Lei Yu had already flown swiftly to another side, attacking again with the Thunder Strike Divine Ability.
This time, it was the Red-horned Fire Flood Dragon that blocked the attack.
With its incredibly fast speed, Lei Yu successfully managed to delay Cui Yu by itself, and Yuan Ming, who was at a distance, was not idle either, performing the rain praying technique.
With Yuan Ming's current cultivation, the effect of the rain praying technique was far beyond what it was before, and the water vapor within the East Sea was even more abundant. The thunderclouds that were originally only a few dozen zhang wide above the platform rapidly expanded, quickly enveloping half the sky above Fusang City.
Layer upon layer of dense thunderclouds kept accumulating and thickening the cloud layer substantially.
Yuan Ming looked up at the dark clouds and nodded slightly.
The black curtain of clouds seemed to press down the sky above the Martial Arts Arena, emanating a formidable oppressive sensation that made the surrounding audience feel an atmosphere of tension.

chapters.title: Chapter 495 - 471 Creating History_2
chapters.content:
"Tsk tsk, Fellow Daoist Yan Xiang, it seems the situation of your disciple Cui Yu is not looking too good," said the person in charge of Red Rain Island, frowning.
"Hmph, those cultivators from Red Ganoderma Island do have some tricks, but judging by his cultivation, it's only at the early stage of Core Formation. The gap in realms is there for all to see, and he's just barely suppressing Cui Yu by relying on that spirit beast's divine abilities," Yan Xiang snorted lightly, speaking dismissively.
He believed that if he could notice this matter, Cui Yu would not be unaware of it.
Cui Yu was, of course, very clear about this. He had also discerned Yuan Ming's intentions, which were to suppress him through the spirit beast. He gathered his strength once again and launched a big move, attempting to settle the outcome with one blow.
The reason Cui Yu had not taken immediate countermeasures was also that he was waiting for an opportunity.
The Thunder Wing Bird was too fast for him to catch, but he firmly believed that such swift speed could not be maintained for long, and once it showed signs of fatigue, it would be time for his counterattack.
As for whether Yuan Ming's accumulated big move would be launched before that, Cui Yu did not care.
Just as Yan Xiang had said, the difference between early-stage Core Formation and late-stage Core Formation could not be measured in mere distance. He was confident that no matter how much Yuan Ming built up his attack, he could not defeat him.
Through the Emotion Manipulation Divine Ability, Yuan Ming could essentially sense Cui Yu's thoughts, which left him speechless.
He was already quite confident, and yet the confidence of the Cui Yu before him seemed even greater, allowing himself to proceed with his maneuvers.
"Since that's the case, then I won't be polite," Yuan Ming thought to himself as he controlled Lei Yu to cast the divine ability to summon thunderclouds.
The thunderclouds in the sky once again thickened, with arcs of lightning flashing through them, though the speed of Lei Yu had slowed down.
Cui Yu's eyes flashed brightly as he quickly formed seals with his hands and threw out a golden silk net.
The golden silk net flew out rapidly, expanding in mid-air, and suddenly, flames burst forth from it, enveloping Yuan Ming inside.
"Go, kill him!" Cui Yu ordered in a low shout.
The Red-horned Fire Flood Dragon, feeling stifled for quite some time, received the command from its master and immediately twisted its body, soaring on the mist with the momentum of a rainbow, charging fiercely towards Yuan Ming.Brought to you by the folks at *.
As it neared, flames flared around its body, the scorching heat evaporating the surrounding moisture instantaneously, causing even the mist that shrouded it to disappear.
The scales on the Red-horned Fire Flood Dragon tightened inch by inch, with its fiery power converging into the single horn on its head.
With a thunderous roar!
A golden light beam ablaze with flames shot out from its horn, heading straight for Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming, seeing the golden light beam speeding directly towards him, showed no sign of panic and formed a hand seal to draw upon something in the air, executing the Golden Sunflower Melt Spirit Technique.
His entire body was shrouded in a sheet of silver lightning, and his figure disappeared within the electric light.
Almost simultaneously, thunderous noises crackled at the back of Lei Yu, and Yuan Ming's figure abruptly appeared.
"The Thunder Escape Technique!" Yan Xiang's brows furrowed, sensing that something was amiss.
"Cui Yu, stop fooling around, the opponent is strong and not to be underestimated!" he communicated to Cui Yu through a transmission.
Cui Yu also realized that something was wrong and quickly retracted the fire net to envelop his body, forming a spherical protective barrier around himself.
With his hands spread open, he fully activated his mana, pouring it into the fire net, from which a vast expanse of crimson flames erupted, creating a sea of fire around him.
"Acting now is far too late," Yuan Ming said as he sat cross-legged atop Lei Yu, lending all of his mana to Lei Yu.
The aura of Lei Yu surged suddenly, breaking through the third-level middle stage and continuing to rise until it peaked at the third-level middle stage.
"Let's add a bit more force," Yuan Ming said as he took out an object from his hand and turned it into a silver streak, shooting it into Lei Yu's mouth.
The silver lightning stopped inside its body, turning into a silver hammer, the Thunder God Hammer.
A force of exceptionally fierce power of thunder and lightning erupted from the Thunder God Hammer and poured into Lei Yu's body.
Suddenly, a shattering sound reverberated from within Lei Yu, as the not yet fully refined Thunder Demon Pill shattered, transforming into streams of pure demonic power and merging into its being.
Lei Yu's strength was at the peak of Third-level Lower Stage, and after absorbing the Demon Pill, it finally made further progress, reaching the Third-level Middle Stage.
The demonic power it exuded surged once more, breaking through to the Third-level Upper Stage.
Feeling an unprecedented strength within its body, Lei Yu let out an excited and piercing cry.
"Boom..."
Within the pitch-black thunderclouds overhead, there sounded a roar like that of an enraged deity, causing everyone present to have their ears buzzing, as countless thick thunder and lightning bolts burst forth from the clouds and converged towards Lei Yu.
"That is the Thunder Control Divine Power of the Ancient Thunder Peng, how can this third-level Thunder Wing Bird possibly exhibit it! Cui Yu, retreat quickly!" Witnessing this scene, Yan Xiang could no longer remain calm and suddenly stood up and shouted.
The Red-horned Fire Flood Dragon also turned and flew back to assist its master.
Cui Yu's forehead was covered in cold sweat, finally realizing the foolishness of his actions. He spat out two Magic Treasures, a fiery red Ruyi and a red gauze scarf, and quickly set up two layers of defense around himself.
Before he could do more, an immensely thick bolt of silver lightning split the clouds, forming a column of silver Thunder as wide as a grindstone.
The terrifying Silver Thunder descended like a torrent from the sky, effortlessly tearing through the sea of flames, and the light screen formed by the fiery Ruyi and red gauze scarf instantly shattered into pieces, with Cui Yu's body being engulfed in the silver lightning.
The platform's ground was blasted open with a huge crater, and thick bolts of lightning shot in all directions, effortlessly tearing up the platform's surface and leaving behind black scars.
Nearly half of the Martial Arts Arena was submerged in silver lightning, stirring up gusts of wild wind.
Yuan Ming watched this scene, his expression calm.
Lending it his Mana and aided by his own rain praying technique, the power of the Thunder God Hammer, Lei Yu's strike, now rivaled the full-force attack of a Nascent Soul cultivator, so such might was quite normal.
Now, he was only concerned that Lei Yu might lack restraint, and unintentionally kill Cui Yu.
The "rumble" lasted for several breaths before finally ceasing.
When the silver lightning had completely dissipated, the net of flames had turned into flying ash, completely destroyed.
In the center of the ground, the figure of Cui Yu was curled up, unmistakably charred all over and emitting wisps of black smoke, as if burnt to a crisp.
The Red-horned Fire Flood Dragon too was caught in the devastating attack, half of its body charred and it lay on the ground wailing.
The outcome of the bout was clear—Yuan Ming had won, and Red Ganoderma Island had emerged victorious.
There was a moment of silence all around the square, followed by a tsunami of cheers and applause.
Xu Fu was slightly taken aback but got up to announce Red Ganoderma Island's victory!
On this day, Red Ganoderma Island made history, becoming the first second-class island in the history of the Immortal Fruit Tournament to defeat a first-class island, a feat that would be passed down through the ages.
At this moment, Yan Xiang could no longer concern himself with anything else; he immediately went to the Martial Arts Arena. After checking, he found that Cui Yu was not dead. His injuries, though serious, did not result in irreparable damage to his meridians and Dantian, clearly, the opponent had shown mercy.
He breathed a sigh of relief and ordered people to carry Cui Yu away.
Yan Xiang cast a deep glance at Yuan Ming, who had just stepped down from the arena, then informed the host of the event, Xu Fu, and also took his leave.
Afterward, under the moderation of Xu Fu, all the contestants from the sixteen islands that had secured their spots for the next round were invited onto the Martial Arts Arena for a round of congratulatory praise.
Yuan Ming glanced over and saw that besides their own group, the winning teams from the other groups were exactly the same as in the previous tournament. Wulu was currently standing with the team from Blood Bird's Nest Island, even giving Ming a subtle wink.
After Xu Fu announced the names of the sixteen islands that had won their berths, he declared the end of this round of the tournament, and then instructed everyone to go back and recuperate, waiting for the next round of the event to continue.

chapters.title: Chapter 496 - 472: Opportunity of the Returning Void
chapters.content:
Red Ganoderma Island residence.
Yuan Ming closed his eyes and cultivated, absorbing Desire Power.
After a while, he opened his eyes, revealing a hint of joy.
Through his recent cultivation efforts, the Soul Power he'd lost while using the Soul Splitting and Soul Merging Technique had finally begun to recover.
He did not continue to cultivate; instead, he took out more than a dozen materials, all auxiliary to create the "Common Poppy" Spirit Incense.
The last two auxiliary spiritual materials required for the "Common Poppy" had also been procured by Yan Siyun, who had just delivered them.
Yuan Ming took out the Red Beautiful Flower, carefully parting the outer shell of the pistil, allowing a puff of pink mist to escape.
He swiftly moved his hands, a Green Light Shield enveloping the pink mist, preventing it from spreading.
The mist seemed to permeate mana, quickly penetrating the green light. Yuan's body heated up, as if flames had ignited in his lower abdomen, ascending desire. He couldn't help but recall some erotic books he'd seen when he was younger, as well as the intimate scenes between a man and a woman inside that Recording Artifact of the Bald Priest not long ago.
"This Red Beautiful Flower truly lives up to its reputation. Before even being made into Spirit Incense, it has such potent effects to enhance desire. If made into incense and activated by the Stealing Heaven Tripod, I fear even Nascent Soul cultivators would hardly escape its influence," Yuan Ming muttered to himself, pleasantly surprised.
Yuan Ming circulated the Nine Elements Technique through his body to suppress the internal heat and took out a gourd-shaped Magic Artifact that emitted a suction, capturing all of the pink mist.
He retrieved a set of high-quality Incense Making utensils and began crafting the Common Poppy.
The quality of the Common Poppy was far superior to Qingxuan Incense and Purple Mysterious Incense, and this was Yuan Ming's first attempt at making such high-grade Spirit Incense, so he was extremely cautious.
Note from the editor: Always check * for corrections.
His Divine Sense was powerful and coupled with his previous experience in Incense Making, he managed not to make any mistakes and successfully produced three sticks of Common Poppy.
Yuan Ming stored the three sticks of Common Poppy and the Incense Making utensils and entered the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space, his Divine Sense following Xu Che's Desire Power anchor.
Xu Che was currently leading nearly a thousand Moon Sect believers on a giant boat, slowly sailing along a great river in Zhao Country towards Jin Country.
Xu Che only led a small fraction of believers. With a large investment of resources, the Moon Sect had now gathered nearly ten thousand loyal followers in the Black Wind Desert and had begun migrating southward.
After discussing with Yuan Ming, Xu Che decided to divide the followers into more than a dozen groups, some traveling by water, others by land, relocating to various places in Jin Country. Xu Che's group was the first.
As the conflict in the Black Wind Desert was about to erupt, many cultivators and mortals were moving southward. This group did not attract any special attention.
To Yuan Ming's delight, because the Wuyue Sect had re-emerged, the Loose Cultivators in the Black Wind Desert were in a panic. Taking advantage of this, Xu Che recruited an additional dozen or so Cultivator believers, one of them a somewhat renowned talismanic master.
To ensure these individuals were wholeheartedly devoted to the Moon Sect, Yuan Ming had not been sparing in resources. And the massive migration was coslty. Even though Xu Che had sold all of the ore from the villages north of Qiao Sai, there was still a considerable shortfall, so he had no choice but to ask Yuan Ming for help.
"These are the resources I've just gathered; take care of them," Yuan Ming spoke to Xu Che, producing a bulging Storage Bag and activating the Altar Formation, sending it through space to appear in front of Xu Che.
"Thank you, my lord," Xu Che bowed in thanks, feeling a twinge of guilt and rue, as if he could only keep asking for more.
His lord had entrusted the Black Wind Desert believers to him, yet he hadn't managed them well and still required his lord to provide resources for support.
"Is this the influence of the Soul Lowering Rune? Does it make one gradually forget oneself and plan solely for the devotees of their faith?" Yuan Ming noticed Xu Che's thoughts and sighed internally at the domineering nature of the Wuyue Sect's secret technique.
Yuan Ming's understanding of the Soul Lowering Rune was not profound. His attempts to mimic its use without deep knowledge meant he had no control over the rune's gradual erosion of the mind.
Even if Yuan Ming had the ability to change this, he chose not to intervene. Followers who have lost themselves to the Soul Lowering Rune are much easier to manage than regular followers—there's no need to worry about betrayal.
"Once all the followers are settled in, bring all the Cultivator believers to the East Sea," Yuan Ming instructed.
He planned to offer significant rewards to turn those followers into Soul Lowering followers.
If anyone was unwilling, Yuan Ming would not force them. After all, he had the Empty Gloves, which could simply erase their memories of coming to the East Sea, thus not exposing his position.
"Yes," Xu Che responded.
Yuan Ming offered Xu Che a few words of encouragement, withdrew his Divine Sense, and looked towards the Altar Formation.
He had been in close communication with Xu Che these past few days, sending items several times to win over those newly joined Cultivator believers.
The Silver Crystal Stone within the Altar Formation was now less luminous than before, with much of its Space Power depleted.
"It seems I need to be sparing with teleporting items; replenishing the Space Power in the Silver Crystal Stone comes at a great cost," Yuan Ming thought to himself, leaving the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space.
Just then, a knocking sound came from outside.
"Come in," Yuan Ming said, putting away the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
A female disciple of Red Ganoderma Island walked in, bowed to Yuan Ming and said, "Senior Yuan, the Island Master invites you to come over."
The girl was about eighteen or nineteen years old, with delicate features painted like a portrait, pure and charming, with watery, peach blossom eyes that captivated the soul. She wore a tight-fitting pink dress that perfectly articulated her curvaceous figure.
Since Yuan Ming's victory yesterday, Bi Shuirou had been extremely enthusiastic towards him, providing tea and Spirit Fruit to the highest standards, and had even reassigned this pink-dressed maiden to Yuan Ming's side to serve as his maid.
Yuan Ming vaguely remembered this girl; she seemed to be a direct disciple of Bi Shuirou, called Lian'er.
"What's the matter?" he asked indifferently, without so much as glancing at the pink-dressed maiden.
"Lian'er is not sure, but a messenger from Fusang Island came not long ago, so it probably has to do with the upcoming competition," the pink-dressed maiden said disappointedly, yet without showing it, speaking respectfully.
Yuan Ming's expression changed slightly, and he stood up and walked outside, quickly arriving at the living room.
Bi Shuirou and Xi Ying stood there.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, Fusang Island has sent over the details of the next competition," Bi Shuirou said, handing over a red Jade Scroll with an unintentional hint of respect in her voice.
Yuan Ming took the Jade Scroll; his Divine Sense entered it, and his expression quickly darkened.
The content of the Jade Scroll was not much, mainly saying two things. The first was that the upcoming competition would only involve those who won in the third round, and no one else could replace them.
The second was that the sixteen contestants would no longer engage in platform battles, but would instead join forces to venture into a Secret Realm. Their ranking would be decided by what they obtained within the Secret Realm.
That Secret Realm was located in the depths of the East Sea, close to the Overseas World, and it was only accessible through Fusang Island's ancient Transmission Array.
Adventuring into the Secret Realm was not a problem, but one rule on the Jade Scroll greatly annoyed Yuan Ming: all of the top sixteen contestants must enter the Secret Realm, or they would be considered to have forfeited. Fusang Island would then take back the Red Mulberry Immortal Fruit and award different resources instead.
Yuan Ming had already made it into the top sixteen. He wasn't very interested in continuing, and if the upcoming competition was dangerous, he would just find a way to muddle through. After all, they only needed one Red Mulberry Immortal Fruit.
Now, with the rule change, not participating in the Secret Realm seemed out of the question.
"In previous Immortal Fruit Conferences, there have been similar mixed competitions, where the order is decided based on battle outcomes. Generally, they aren't dangerous," Bi Shuirou added in a soft voice upon seeing Yuan Ming's troubled expression.
Yuan Ming remained silent, as if he had heard nothing.
"After receiving the message, I immediately investigated. This Secret Realm has only recently emerged, but signs of it appeared a few years ago. It's quite vast. Fellow Daoist Yuan must have also heard the rumors about the emergence of the East Sea Three Immortal Islands. In fact, it was triggered by this Secret Realm," Bi Shuirou said again.
"Is Fellow Daoist Bishui trying to get me to participate in the Secret Realm competition? Red Ganoderma Island has already made it into the top sixteen, and all the fame and fortune that should be earned are already at hand. To covet more would be inviting disaster," Yuan Ming glanced at the graceful island master and said.
In these past few days, he had learned more about the Immortal Fruit Conference from Yan Siyun. Getting a good ranking at the Immortal Fruit Conference offered benefits beyond just a Red Mulberry Immortal Fruit.
Every Immortal Fruit Conference was an opportunity to showcase an island's strength and intimidate opponents.
Many participating islands were more interested in the latter.
Red Ganoderma Island's victory over a First-class Island and advancement into the top sixteen had greatly enhanced its reputation. Many Second-class Islands with only average relations were now fawning over them, while islands like Luoshan Island, which had enmity with Red Ganoderma Island, were terrified and treated the people of Red Ganoderma Island as if they were cats seeing mice.
If Yuan Ming could achieve more results in the Secret Realm competition, Red Ganoderma Island would gain even more.
Bi Shuirou indeed had such calculations in mind, and now that Yuan Ming had directly pointed them out, her face turned slightly awkward.
However, upon carefully considering Yuan Ming's words, especially the mention of inviting disaster, her heart, which had been somewhat elated by flattery over the past two days, gradually sobered up.
The achievements of Red Ganoderma Island were all thanks to the combat strength of Yuan Ming and Xi Ying.
Neither Yuan Ming nor Xi Ying were subordinates of Red Ganoderma Island. Although they were currently on good terms, they could leave at any moment, perhaps never to return to the East Sea.
In the short term it might be fine, but over time, other powers would surely discern the true state of Red Ganoderma Island. Why would they stop there? If so, the advantages Red Ganoderma Island had gained by then would have to be surrendered, and worse still, the island might even face a catastrophe that could lead to its extinction.
"Thank you for your advice, Fellow Daoist Yuan. I indeed got a little greedy. If Fellow Daoist Yuan is unwilling to participate, I will not force you," said Bi Shuirou, breaking out into a cold sweat and bowing politely.
Yuan Ming did not pay much attention to Bi Shuirou, lost in thought.
To break through to the Nascent Soul stage in the future, he had to obtain a Red Mulberry Immortal Fruit at all costs.
It was detestable that Fusang Island had unilaterally changed the rules, but after all, the Red Mulberry Immortal Fruit was theirs to give. They had no choice but to follow these rules, which meant the Secret Realm was a must-visit.
Yuan Ming looked towards Xi Ying, who seemed to be leisurely drinking tea as if this matter was of no concern to him.
With a wry smile, Yuan Ming turned to Bi Shuirou: "Fellow Daoist Bishui, you just mentioned that this Secret Realm is related to the tales of the Three Immortal Islands that have spread to the Central Plains?"
"The emergence of the Secret Realm was signaled by the ethereal shadows of three Spiritual Mountains, reminiscent of the East Sea Three Immortal Islands widely spoken of," Bi Shuirou explained.
"I've also heard some rough details of the East Sea Three Immortal Islands, but I'm not very familiar with the specifics. Could Fellow Daoist Bishui enlighten me further?" Yuan Ming inquired.
"Of course, the Three Immortal Islands are among the most widespread legends in the East Sea, namely Penglai Immortal Island, Lank Immortal Island, and Golden Sunflower Immortal Island. They are said to have been created by three Returning to Void high cultivators, each containing opportunities to breakthrough to the Returning to Void Stage," Bi Shuirou said eagerly.
"Opportunities to Return to Void," Yuan Ming muttered to himself.

chapters.title: Chapter 497 - 473 Divination Skill
chapters.content:
"Regarding Three Immortals Island, there is another rumor. It is said that the island is a practice ground for Overseas Immortals, and anyone who enters can reach the Overseas World," Bi Shuirou suddenly recalled, speaking thus.
A flicker of realization crossed Yuan Ming's eyes. No wonder the Shura Master came to the East Sea years ago in search of the Three Immortals Island, intending to use it to travel to the Overseas World.
"Although Three Immortals Island is legendary, the opportunities it involves are significant. After the signs of the Secret Realm manifested, the first-class islands of the East Sea have been closely monitoring this matter. When the Secret Realm emerged recently, its entrance was immediately sealed by Fusang Island in collaboration with Jin Ao, Kongling, and Di Hua, three other first-class islands, who then sent people to investigate but were severely defeated, losing many hands," Bi Shuirou continued.
Yuan Ming furrowed his brows upon hearing this.
Jin Ao, Kongling, and Di Hua, these three islands have Mid-Stage Nascent Soul cultivators stationed, their power only second to Fusang Island. That four islands joined forces and still suffered a severe defeat in exploring that secret realm?
"This Secret Realm contains forbidden seals, and Nascent Souls cannot enter. Fusang, and the other three islands only sent some Core Formation cultivators to investigate," Bi Shuirou seemed to notice Yuan Ming's doubts and hurriedly explained.
"I see," Yuan Ming nodded thoughtfully. If the great powers of the Four Islands were also defeated within the secret realm, he would turn around and leave without a second word.
"The entrance to the secret realm was sealed by the four islands, and other islands were unaware that it had opened. After the last exploration failed, somehow the news leaked out, and the rest of the first-class islands, not wanting to miss out on the benefits, rallied together and challenged them. Faced with resistance, the four islands of Fusang decided to let the top sixteen cultivators from the Immortal Fruit Conference enter, partly to explore the secret realm and partly to complete the competition, which actually isn't a bad thing," Bi Shuirou said.
"So, there is such a complication involved. Fellow Daoist Bishui, you are quite well-informed," Yuan Ming looked at Bi Shuirou, his words carrying a hint of meaning.
"Not at all. I, a mere female disciple, have a Daoist companion who is a powerful elder in Thousand Dragon Island. That is how I was able to learn a bit," Bi Shuirou modestly claimed, yet there was a hint of pride in her expression.
Yuan Ming suddenly realized why she dared to urge him to participate in the trials of the Secret Realm. She had connections with Thousand Dragon Island.
"What are your plans for this Secret Realm competition, Fellow Daoist Yuan?" Bi Shuirou asked cautiously.
"If I do not participate, wouldn't all my previous efforts have been in vain?" Yuan Ming stated.
Bi Shuirou was secretly delighted but did not show it on her face and said, "Then I will reply on behalf of the Daoist to Fusang Island."
Saying this, she rose to leave.
"Island Master Bishui, please wait a moment," a voice came from outside. It was Yan Siyun who walked in.
The woman appeared unwell, her cheeks unusually pale, and her aura weakened, as if she had endured a tough battle.
"Sister Yan, do you have something to say?" Bi Shuirou asked softly.
"Yes, I have something important to tell Fellow Daoist Yuan. May we step aside?" Yan Siyun apologized to Bi Shuirou and then directed the last part of her statement to Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming glanced at Xi Ying, who was still leisurely sipping tea, seemingly relaxed. Seeing Yuan Ming looking over, she even blinked meaningfully before shifting her gaze away.
Yuan Ming sighed inwardly, stood up, and accompanied Yan Siyun to the adjacent side hall.
"My cultivation is limited, so please, Fellow Daoist Yuan, use your divine skills to isolate this room to prevent others from spying," Yan Siyun requested.
Yuan Ming formed a mana light screen with a hand gesture, took out his Silver Token, and expanded a silver barrier within the room, completely isolating it from the outside.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan's divine skills are impressive. This silver barrier is powerful, and in terms of isolating aura, it is more mysterious than any restriction I've seen," Yan Siyun exclaimed.
"It's merely the power of a magic treasure. Let's not dwell on it. Please, Fellow Daoist Yan, speak about the main matter. Is it related to this Secret Realm?" Yuan Ming prompted.
"Indeed, this trip to the Secret Realm might not be simple. It would be best, Fellow Daoist Yuan, if you did not go," Yan Siyun said with a grave expression.
"Why do you say that?" Yuan Ming was not surprised and pressed for details.
"Fellow Daoist may know a bit about my situation. I was born blind, but my intuition is better than most. I even have a bit of divine ability to sense fortune and misfortune. Recently, with the help of Daoist Xi Ying, she taught me a divination secret technique, and my predictive ability has improved significantly. Fellow Daoist, you previously saved my younger sister, and I have no way to repay you. Just after learning about the secret realm, I divined for you, drawing a hexagram of great misfortune with only a slim chance of survival," Yan Siyun slowly explained.
As Yuan Ming listened, a flicker of astonishment crossed his eyes.
No wonder he sensed that inexplicable aura around Yan Siyun when he saw her in Dragon King City. It was a manifestation of her enhanced predictive ability.
Xi Ying also knew the art of divination. Back in the Shura Palace, when she volunteered to replace Yuan Ming in rescuing Yan Siyun, was she trying to train a divination master?Br+ou-ght. to you by *.
"Could Fellow Daoist pinpoint any specific details through your divination?" Yuan Ming inquired after a moment's contemplation.
"My divination skills are still shallow. I can only discern a general outline but couldn't forecast the specific details..." Yan Siyun shook her head.
As she spoke, her voice suddenly weakened, and her breath became irregular. Her already pale cheeks turned ghastlier, devoid of any blood color.
Yuan Ming uttered a soft "hmm," and with a flick of his finger,
a green light entered Yan Siyun's Dantian, helping her stabilize her breath.
A moment later, Yan Siyun eventually caught her breath and said thanks.
"I have read in miscellaneous books that the art of divination defies the Dao of heaven, and each execution diminishes one's life span and fortune. Fellow Daoist Yan, did you just suffer a backlash?" Yuan Ming withdrew his finger and asked.
"It seems that Fellow Daoist Yuan also understands divination. Indeed, divination is essentially peering into the future, and naturally, there is a price to pay," Yan Siyun said with a wry smile, wiping the sweat from her forehead.
"If that's the case, it's wise for Fellow Daoist Yan to use the art of divination sparingly. Try to undertake Core Formation first; using divination with only the cultivation of the Foundation Establishment Stage is too burdensome," Yuan Ming advised.
Just now, while he had helped suppress the backlash for Yan Siyun, he had also taken the opportunity to probe the nature of her spirit root. She had Water and Fire Dual Spirit Roots with quite exceptional aptitude. With the help of Washing Elixir Spirit Liquid, her chances of forming a core were significant.
Moreover, since Xi Ying intended to cultivate this girl, she would likely offer some help, so he need not interfere too much.
"Thank you, Fellow Daoist Yuan, for your guidance. Sister Xi said the same thing. Once younger sister is completely familiar with the True Fire you bestowed and the Hundred Pills Square stabilizes, I will devote myself to secluded meditation to condense a Golden Core," Yan Siyun said, bowing slightly.
Yan Sijing had already awakened, and Yuan Ming had bestowed the Pure Yang Flame upon her.
Pure Yang Flame, being a high-grade True Fire, was incomparable to Apricot Wood Green Fire and had even caught the eye of the Shura Master. Although Yuan Ming had only bestowed a small flame, it was still challenging to control.
These past few days, Yan Sijing had been hiding deep within the estate, refining Demon Blood Elixirs with a new Pill Furnace while acquainting herself with the Pure Yang Flame.
The Pure Yang Flame was extremely effective in refining impurities. Yan Sijing had not yet fully mastered it, and could only use it to aid in alchemy, but the Demon Blood Elixirs she refined were already highly pure. If not for the slightly weaker medicinal effect, anyone would think they were genuine Demon Pills.
Once she completely masters the Pure Yang Flame, she might be able to refine Demon Blood Pills comparable to Demon Pills.
With such elixirs, the Hundred Pills Square could firmly establish itself in the East Sea.
"True Fire and the Pill Furnace are merely external aids. If the Hundred Pills Square wants to grow and strengthen, you sisters need to work together," Yuan Ming encouraged.
"Yes, Si Yun will certainly bear in mind the teachings of Fellow Daoist Yuan," Yan Siyun respectfully responded.
"I will also consider the suggestions of Fellow Daoist Yan," Yuan Ming said, putting away the Silver Token and walking outside.
A figure was leaning casually against the door frame; it was Xi Ying.
"Have you finally had enough tea?" Yuan Ming walked over and said with a smile.
"What plans do you have regarding the secret realm?" Xi Ying asked, giving Yuan Ming a sidelong glance.
Yuan Ming fell silent for a moment before revealing what Yan Siyun had divined for him.
"It seems this venture into the secret realm is far from being as straightforward as it appears," Xi Ying said, her expression also showing slight ripples.
"Of course, the Fusang Four Islands allowing the top 16 from the Immortal Fruit Conference to enter the secret realm isn't just because the news of its opening leaked; perhaps this leak was orchestrated by them to lure more people in, using them to test the waters," Yuan Ming said with a slight cold sneer on his face.
"Indeed, that's highly possible. What are your plans then?" Xi Ying asked.
"Although this journey is dangerous, to obtain the Five Elements Infant Condensing Pill I might have to take the risk. Considering most of the Core Formation Cultivators from first-class islands make it out alive, with my strength, as long as I am careful, I should be able to protect myself. If I encounter any insurmountable dangers, I could always hide in the Stealing Heaven Tripod," Yuan Ming was well-versed in how to stay alive.
"In that case, I will accompany you. Hidden within the space of the Stealing Heaven Tripod, I should be able to avoid detection by Fusang Island," Xi Ying suggested.
"That works," Yuan Ming didn't try to dissuade her, and with a flick of his robe, he ushered Xi Ying into the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
Xi Ying also seemed to have some plans for this Immortal Fruit Conference. Given the competition in the secret realm, it might involve her arrangements. In any case, having an additional person along was always good for mutual support.
Xi Ying sat down next to the altar inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod, taking out a green jade scroll, and immersing her divine sense into it.
This item was the jade scroll that recorded the "Ju Mang Spirit Technique," which, after much consideration, Yuan Ming had given to Xi Ying.
Xi Ying was quite interested in this secret technique and had been studying it whenever she found time over the past few days, although she hadn't mentioned whether she would cultivate it.
"Xi Ying, do you also know the art of divination?" Just as Yuan Ming was about to retract his divine sense, he suddenly remembered something and asked via a mental transmission.
"Years ago, I accidentally acquired a divination secret method in a ruin," Xi Ying replied nonchalantly without looking up.
"Having acquired this art so long ago, why have I never seen you use it over the years?" Yuan Ming asked, puzzled.
"Do you think divination is like eating or drinking, that one can perform it just because they want to? Divining the future is an act against heaven, and not everyone can cultivate it. Only those with a special fate or those possessing certain special spirit roots or spiritual bodies can comprehend it. Yan Siyun is one of such people," Xi Ying explained lightly.
"I see, that's really unfortunate," Yuan Ming said, seemingly skeptical.
"Are you interested in the art of divination? If so, take this and see if you can understand it," Xi Ying said, pulling out a white jade scroll.

chapters.title: Chapter 498 - 474: A Gathering of Talent
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming's mind stirred, and he retrieved a white jade scroll from the Stealing Heaven Tripod. His divine sense entered it, and four golden characters came into his view.
"Heavenly Destiny Skill? What a domineering name..." he muttered to himself, continuing to read on.
According to the jade scroll's records, mastering this secret technique to a high level would allow one to divine the trajectories and changes of all things.
Not only could this technique be used for divination of the future, but it could also deduce other things, such as deciphering the changes in formidable illusion arrays, comprehending obscure and complex secret skills, and so on—the utility of this one technique was manifold.
Yuan Ming's interest was piqued as he immediately began to examine the detailed cultivation method that followed.
"Taiji produces the dual polarities, the dual polarities produce the sun and moon, the sun and moon produce the four seasons, the four seasons produce the Five Elements, the Five Elements produce the twelve months, the twelve months produce the twenty-four solar terms, totaling fifty...."
"Each hexagram has six lines, six by eight is forty-eight, plus two special lines for Qian and Kun...."
Yuan Ming read for a while, furrowing his brows.
The sentences were almost a discourse on Taoism and the mysteries of the universe; every word was recognizable, but pondering them revealed profound meanings, leaving him clueless despite his insight and knowledge.
He shook his head and temporarily put away the jade scroll, heading to the main hall.
Bi Shuirou was still waiting there, showing no sign of impatience.
"My apologies for the wait, Fellow Daoist Bishui. Please relay to Fusang Island that I will be participating in the secret realm competition," Yuan Ming said.
"Understood." Bi Shuirou's eyes brightened as she agreed with a nod and quickly left.
Yuan Ming did not linger in the main hall and returned to his dwelling, activating a soundproofing barrier and continued to ponder over the Heavenly Destiny Skill.
However, no matter how much he contemplated, trying every possible method to grasp the basics, he gained nothing but a throbbing headache and utter exhaustion.
Yuan Ming helplessly stopped, centered his spirit with breathing control, and quickly recovered.
This version is sourced from MV3L3MPYR.
He did not continue to delve into the secret technique but rose and left his residence, heading toward the workshop area of Fusang City.
Since he was about to enter a mysterious secret realm filled with unknown perils, it was natural to make some preparations in advance.
The jade scroll sent by Fusang Island specifically emphasized one point—to prepare more magic tools talismans with star attributes, and it would be even better to obtain a Star Magic Artifact.
Yuan Ming didn't know the meaning behind these words but figured they had no ill intent.
Even if Fusang Island dared to plot something big, as long as he placed those items in the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space, no scheme or conspiracy would have any effect.
Early the next morning, the top sixteen from the Immortal Fruit Conference gathered in front of a secluded, gray-white hall in Fusang City.
