The grand hall was quite spacious and constructed in a very peculiar fashion, shaped like a pyramid. The base was a square, tapering up to the top, ending in a pointed spike giving it an ancient and primitive feel that distinctly differed from the other buildings in Fusang City.
A plaque hung above the entrance of the hall, inscribed with the three characters for "Void Temple," where Fusang City's ancient transmission array was housed.
Those Nascent Soul cultivators from the first-class islands were now entering the Void Temple.
Although the ancient transmission array of Fusang Island could reach the outer sea's border, its activation came with many restrictions. It could only be used once every three months and the number of people it could transport at one time was very limited.
As they needed to send seventeen people at once this time, the group of Nascent Soul cultivators had made some modifications to the ancient transmission array.
"Void Temple? The name is indeed a bit strange. I thought it would be called something like 'Transmission Hall' or 'Outer Sea Hall'?" Yuan Ming stood alone at one corner, conversing with a silver-haired youth through a voice transmission.
"I know about this, the Void Temple wasn't constructed by Fusang Island. It is said to have existed since the Ancient Times and is a contemporary of that ancient transmission array. Despite countless years of exposure to the elements, it still stands tall to this day. As for the name of the hall, it too was passed down from the Ancient Times," the silver-haired youth replied.
Yuan Ming raised his eyebrows; the ancient transmission array was rumored to have existed for tens of thousands of years—could this peculiar hall have also stood undisturbed for just as long?
His divine sense spread out, trying to probe the Void Temple, but it was blocked by an invisible force before getting close.
Yuan Ming was not surprised; the ancient transmission array was of great significance to Fusang Island, naturally guarded by numerous prohibitions.
"How are your preparations? Were you able to buy any Star Magic Tools and Talismans?" Yuan Ming steadied his mind, paying no further attention to the Void Temple, and asked the silver-haired youth.
"It's okay, Blood Bird's Nest Island provided some, and I've prepared a few items myself," the silver-haired youth said nonchalantly.
The silver-haired youth was a cultivator from Blood Bird's Nest Island taking part in the third contest, but in reality, it was Wulu in disguise, managing to fool everyone present but not Yuan Ming.
Last night, Yuan Ming had entered the Stealing Heaven Tripod to attempt to uncover Fusang Island's true intentions. He didn't glean much about Fusang Island's plans, but he unexpectedly discovered Wulu transforming into a silver-haired youth.
"You really are bold as brass to transform your appearance and impersonate someone else. You won't be lightly forgiven if found out," Yuan Ming communicated through a voice transmission.
"I was quite confident in my transformation technique initially, but I didn't expect you to uncover it so easily. Now that the arrow has been shot, I have no choice but to forge ahead," Wulu replied with a wry smile.
Yuan Ming, however, was not overly concerned. Wulu's art of transformation was indeed wondrous; if not for the Stealing Heaven Tripod-enhanced divine sense that could perceive everything, even he would not have detected it.
"Be careful after entering the secret realm. I have a feeling that this trip will not go smoothly," Yuan Ming pondered for a moment and still sent a warning to Wulu through voice transmission.
Wulu, seeing Yuan Ming's solemn expression, contemplated for a moment and slowly nodded in agreement.
The others outside the hall were much like Yuan Ming and Wulu, gathered in twos and threes, chatting leisurely, forming small circles.
These people were almost uniformly at the late stage of Core Formation, with many reaching the peak; even the cultivators from the other three Second-level Islands were at least at the mid-stage of Core Formation. Even Wulu, it was unknown by what means, displayed an aura that was also at the mid-stage of Core Formation.
Yuan Ming, at the early stage of Core Formation, stood out conspicuously.
Yuan Ming himself didn't mind it. He chatted idly with Wulu while observing everyone present.
The most eye-catching was a golden-haired woman dressed in gold, who looked to be just over twenty. She was ordinary in appearance but had a superb figure with curves in all the right places. There was a faint golden light shimmering all around her, and she possessed an excellent demeanor.
At the moment, the woman sat cross-legged at the entrance of the great hall, cultivating with her eyes closed, as if no one else was around. A powerful fluctuation of fire attribute magic power wandered around her, indicating that she was at the peak of late-stage Core Formation, just one step away from advancing to the Nascent Soul stage.
Yuan Ming had been on Fusang Island for several days and was quite familiar with the situation on this island. The golden-haired woman was named Golden Cloud Fairy, the Closed-door Disciple of the Island Master of Fusang.
Speaking of Golden Cloud Fairy, Yuan Ming did witness a good show last night.
In previous Immortal Fruit Conferences, Fujian Island cultivators did not participate; this was the first time they had broken the rule.
Yesterday, when it became known that Golden Cloud Fairy would participate in the trial, representatives from the other twelve First-class Islands jointly opposed the move. The Fusang Island Master made concessions, and Golden Cloud Fairy, regardless of her earnings, would not be included in the rankings of the Immortal Fruit Conference. Only then did the other islands calm down.
"Wulu, do you know anything about Golden Cloud Fairy?" Yuan Ming asked via telepathy.
"Golden Cloud Fairy? She's the direct disciple of Fujian Island Master. Despite her youth, she has already reached the peak of Core Formation. Her mastery of fire attribute divine skills is extraordinary, making Nascent Soul Early Stage cultivators hesitant to provoke her. She is widely recognized as one of the cultivators in the East Sea with the most potential to advance to the Nascent Soul stage. Some also say that she's deliberately suppressing her cultivation; otherwise, she would have broken through long ago," Wulu said after a start.
"Impressive lady. Besides that, do you have any other information?" Yuan Ming had already learned these details from Yan Siyun.
"Aside from that, I don't know much. However, there's a rumor that Golden Cloud Fairy is not pure and has unclear relations with numerous male cultivators at the Core Formation stage. Some have even seen strange men entering and leaving her cave mansion. Tsk, despite her young age, she seems insatiable," after a moment of thought, Wulu added mischievously.
Hearing this, a trace of surprise flickered across Yuan Ming's face; this was the first time he had heard of it.
"What? Are you interested in that lady?" Wulu's eyes shifted slyly as he nudged Yuan Ming.
"Stop talking nonsense. Don't you know 'know thy enemy, know thyself, and you will never be defeated in a hundred battles'?" Yuan Ming glared at Wulu, quickly distancing himself from the conversation.
In his Sea of Consciousness, a golden shadow floated, the soul of Xi Ying's Golden Crow.
Xi Ying, hiding in the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space, wanted to observe the outside world, so she placed a soul of the Golden Crow in Yuan Ming's Sea of Consciousness. Through Divine Soul Transformation and the connection of the five senses with her main body, she could monitor the outside situation.
Of course, this was with Yuan Ming's permission; if he were unwilling, with a single thought he could sever the connection between the Golden Crow's soul and Xi Ying.
While Yuan Ming continued to chat haphazardly with Wulu, his gaze drifted towards a pavilion not far away, where three figures sat, chatting merrily.
One of them, a man in green fur, had sharp brows that reached his temples, giving him a somewhat stern appearance; another youth in white held a feather fan, elegant and scholarly. The last was a short and fat man, seemingly only in his twenties or thirties, his face always wore a smile.
All three had uncommonly substantial cultivation and demeanor. Although they didn't compare to Golden Cloud Fairy, they were clearly a cut above the rest.
Yuan Ming had seen the three men in the information Yan Siyun had given him. The man in green fur was named Daoist Qian Bao, a cultivator from Golden Turtle Island and, it was said, a sword cultivator.
The youth in white was called Huan Ling Zi, a representative of Kongling Island, skilled in illusion techniques.
The last short, plump man was named Tu Sheng, a cultivator from Earth Beauty Island, with unparalleled mastery of earth attribute divine skills, especially adept at the Earth Escape Technique.
Just then, Huan Ling Zi seemed to sense Yuan Ming's gaze and looked over.
As their eyes met, a variety of illusions emerged before Yuan Ming's eyes, and a subtle force of illusion power descended from afar, penetrating into the depths of his Divine Soul.
Yuan Ming furrowed his brows, slightly adjusting his Soul Power, and dissolved the force of illusion.
A hint of surprise flickered in Huan Ling Zi's eyes, but he did not continue his attack.
"Did that Huan Ling Zi just make a move on you? Just to be safe, check your Divine Soul to see if you've been hit with an Illusion Seed! That Huan Ling Zi looks decent enough but harbors devious intentions. He's most fond of planting Illusion Seeds in others, taking root quietly and corroding the Divine Soul without one's awareness until one becomes completely his puppet," Wulu noticed the exchange and warned Yuan Ming through telepathy.
Yuan Ming realized then that the subtle force was meant to plant itself in his Divine Soul, which explained its subtlety.
A chill flashed in his eyes; Huan Ling Zi was resorting to such underhand tactics from the get-go. He clearly had malicious intentions, and Yuan Ming wouldn't go easy on someone like that.
Yuan Ming shifted his gaze away from Huan Ling Zi and towards three cultivators from the Snake-man Clan, Merfolk Clan, and Water Ape Clan.
He had already met Qing Tong of the Snake-man Clan; the Merfolk cultivator was a green-dressed young girl with a face like an egg and eyes that sparkled with life. She might not be stunningly beautiful, but she was sweet and appealing, offering a very comfortable presence.
The girl was named Xue Jiao, who had displayed powerful water attribute divine abilities in the third round of the competition.
The Water Ape Clan cultivator was called Hou Santong, a towering figure standing around ten feet tall, with thick limbs, looking much like a small hill with an extraordinarily strong physical body presence, almost matching that of a Vajra.
Among the three, Hou Santong had the most distinct characteristics of the Demon Clan. His ape fur had been thoroughly refined away from his hands and feet, but fine white fluff could still be seen on his face.
Qing Tong and the other two stood there, occasionally speaking to each other but with little interaction with others, as if there was a deep barrier between them.
As for the other cultivators, although their cultivation was also profound, compared to those mentioned before, their presence was noticeably weaker.

chapters.title: Chapter 499 - 499: 475 Enter the Formation
chapters.content:
"Heh heh, it's Fellow Daoist Yuan and Fellow Daoist Hong, what a pleasure," just as Yuan Ming was scanning his surroundings, he was brought back to focus by a male voice.
He looked in the direction of the voice and saw a man and a woman walking shoulder to shoulder towards him.
Both of them looked quite young, the man tall and slender with a virile aura, the woman statuesque with a sharp gaze, resembling a javelin at first glance, quite unlike ordinary women.
Yuan Ming recognized the two as Long Chong from Thousand Dragon Island and Qiong Yun from Red Rain Island.
"So it's Fellow Daoist Long and Fellow Daoist Qiong," Yuan Ming said politely while internally remaining on guard.
In the Eastern Sea Islands, power was fragmented. While it seemed disorganized, due to interests, territories, race, and other factors, many small groups had formed.
For instance, Thousand Snake Island, Bijiao Island, and Water Ape Island were all half-human, half-demon of the Alien Clan. Even though they sometimes disputed over interests, they always advanced and retreated together on major issues.
Golden Turtle Island, Kongling Island, and Earth Beauty Island had a rather close relationship as well, in order to counter Fusang Island.
And then there were Thousand Dragon Island, Red Rain Island, and Karmic Fire Island which, being close to the outer sea and to each other, were rather intimate.
There was a Violent Sea Area near the Three Islands where the weather was horribly severe. The Flood Dragon Clan, some of the most famous demon beasts in the East Sea, lived there. To withstand the Flood Dragons, Thousand Dragon Island, Red Rain Island, and Karmic Fire Island formed an alliance to lend each other support.
Yuan Ming had eliminated Cui Yu from Karmic Fire Island in the third round, so he suspected that these two might not have come with good intentions.
"Heh heh, Fellow Daoist Yuan, please don't misunderstand. The Immortal Fruit Conference is a contest of abilities, after all. You defeated Cui Yu fair and square in the competition, and the two of us are not so narrow-minded as to seek revenge," Long Chong said with a smile.
Qiong Yun didn't speak, her calm expression also indicating she bore no malice.
"It seems I was overthinking, please forgive me. May I know what advice do you two have for coming here?" Yuan Ming inquired, clasping his hands together.
"Advice would be too presumptuous. Fellow Daoist Yuan, your Divine Skills are indeed remarkable, and the two of us greatly admire that. Of course, the methods of Fellow Daoist Hong of Blood Bird's Nest Island are also very impressive—who wouldn't want to make friends?" Long Chong said with a sincere look in his eyes, not appearing to be in disguise.
Wulu knew that they weren't targeting him, so he quickly declined any suggestion of his own merit and stepped aside.
Yuan Ming activated his Emotion Manipulation Divine Ability, sensing Long Chong's emotions, and he found that the man indeed bore no animosity toward him but actually a fair bit of friendliness. Qiong Yun seemed to feel the same.
While chatting with the two, he quietly speculated about their true intentions.
At that moment, the sound of footsteps came from inside the Void Temple, and a middle-aged man with greyish-white hair and a desolate expression emerged. He was a Nascent Soul cultivator from Fusang Island.
"That's enough, everyone come in," the desolate man spoke indifferently.
The seventeen people outside heard him and gathered, following him into the entrance of the Void Temple.
Behind the door was not the spacious hall they had anticipated, but a dimly lit passageway, slightly inclined upwards like a gentle slope.
Yuan Ming looked around and noticed the hall was enveloped by that invisible force.
Outside the hall, the sensation wasn't very clear, but now that he had entered the Void Temple, he had a more intuitive feeling of this invisible force. His Divine Sense, Mana, and even Physical Body were greatly restricted.
Especially his Divine Sense, which could only extend a mere ten feet.
"Could it be triggered by the Ancient Transmission Array?" Yuan Ming privately conjectured.
The others also seemed to have noticed the anomaly, but nobody spoke up about it.
The inclined passage quickly came to an end, and a new pathway appeared on the left, sloping downwards this time.
The group continued forward and soon came across a third passage.
"Just how many passageways are there..." Wulu couldn't help but mutter.
Yuan Ming slowed his pace and raised his hand to touch the walls of the passageway, feeling a cool, coarse sensation.
"What's wrong?" Wulu stopped and asked.
"Nothing, I just feel something strange about this place," Yuan Ming whispered.
He could faintly sense that nature's spiritual energy within the Void Temple followed the pathway they had just traversed, slowly flowing forward.
Besides nature's spiritual energy, it seemed other energies were mixed in.
Unfortunately, his Divine Sense could only extend ten feet, unable to fully uncover the truth.
Yuan Ming was slightly annoyed. The several times he had used the Stealing Heaven Tripod to probe Fusang City before, he hadn't paid attention to this place, otherwise he might have grasped some clues.
Now, it was too late to enter the Stealing Heaven Tripod to investigate.
Although Xi Ying was inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod, since the tripod had already acknowledged a master, others sitting on the Jade Lotus Platform couldn't activate its Desire Power.
"Wait, my real body can't enter the Stealing Heaven Tripod, but my soul splitting can. I have never tried it before. I wonder, if the first soul sits on the White Jade Lotus Platform, can it receive the boost of Desire Power?" A thought suddenly occurred to Yuan Ming. Immediately, he commanded the first soul in his Sea of Consciousness to fly out, entering the Incense Burner Mark on his arm and into the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space.
The first soul turned into a semi-transparent figure and sat down on the White Jade Lotus Platform.
Boom!
The Desire Power surged out from within the platform, merging into the first soul.
Yuan Ming was overjoyed and quickly manipulated the Soul Power of the first soul, descending through the Desire Power anchor point provided by Miao Xian.
The first soul's Soul Power was far inferior to Yuan Ming's main body. Even with the support of Desire Power, it only barely reached the Love Witch Realm, and its investigative range was limited to less than half of Fusang City. Miao Xian was currently in the Wuzu District, unable to see the situation at the Void Temple here.
However, this matter was not enough to stump him.
Yuan Ming used his Divine Thought to communicate with the Three-eyed Crow in his Spiritual Beast Bag, asking it to pray to the Nether Moon God. The first soul's Soul Power descended along this anchor point, easily enveloping the entire Void Temple.Publication courtesy of *.
The structure of the great hall appeared before his eyes, with many passageways crisscrossing inside, as many as twenty or thirty, like a labyrinth.
At the end of the passageways was a Stone Hall, exceptionally empty, without a single supporting Stone Pillar or any decoration on the four walls.
A silver Formation several zhangs in size sat in the middle, surrounded by eight silver-white Stone Pillars about a zhang tall, deeply embedded in the ground and integrated with the Formation.
The Stone Pillars were engraved with strange runes, similar to the space transfer Forbidden Array Patterns within the Shura Palace, but much more complex.
"Is this the Ancient Transmission Array of Fusang Island?" Yuan Ming thought to himself.
At this moment, Xu Fu, White Scale Master, Queen Ming Kong, and more than a dozen other Nascent Soul cultivators were sitting around the silver Formation, each holding a silver Array Flag, infusing streams of silver light into the Teleportation Array.
Yuan Ming glanced at it twice, withdrew his gaze, and carefully sensed the flow of Spiritual Energy within the Void Temple.
Just as he had anticipated earlier, the nature's spiritual energy within the Void Temple moved along the passageways and eventually poured into the Ancient Transmission Array, stored within the eight silver Stone Pillars.
The silver Stone Pillars were somewhat similar to Void Stones, but their insides were murky. They stored a large amount of Spiritual Power, seemingly to stimulate the operation of the Transmission Array.
However, he was very curious about one thing.
Why would the nature's spiritual energy automatically flow along the passageways and into the Transmission Array without a single Array Rune on the pathways and stone walls of the Void Temple?
Yuan Ming inspected it several times but still found nothing, ultimately sighing at the unfathomable depth of the Ancient Transmission Array.
He didn't unravel the mystery of how the Void Temple attracted nature's spiritual energy. However, he did manage to investigate the unusual energy contained in the Spiritual Energy of the hall. Surprisingly, it was Space Power, although it was quite mixed and far less pure than the Space Power in Void Stones.
As for the source of this Space Power, it was from the sky.
Threads and streaks of Space Power descended from the heavens, joining the nature's spiritual energy and pouring into the eight silver Stone Pillars.
Yuan Ming used the Soul Power of his first soul to probe upwards, trying to find the origin of the Space Power.
The Silver Crystal Stone on the Stealing Heaven Tripod Altar also required Space Power. If he could find a way to harness Space Power, it would be greatly beneficial to him!
Unfortunately, even with Yuan Ming's first soul pushing its Soul Power to the limit, it still failed to sense the origin of the Space Power.
He couldn't wait to leave and find a safe place to enter with his own body and clarify everything.
"I must maintain a normal state of mind. After all, the Void Temple has always been here, and I can investigate it after returning from the Secret Realm," Yuan Ming let out a breath, suppressing his emotions.
Although the space power that gathered was far less than the spiritual energy, over time, the eight silver Stone Pillars had already stored quite a lot.
"With the wealth of Fusang Island, as much nature's spiritual energy as desired can be brought in. It seems that what restricts the use of the Ancient Transmission Array is Space Power, with three months of accumulation needed for one use," Yuan Ming thought to himself.
Just then, Yuan Ming and the others, following the melancholy man, finally arrived at the Stone Hall where the Transmission Array was located.
Xu Fu and the others had finished casting, and the Spiritual Power contained within the eight silver stones had doubled, though it seemed very unstable.
The Ancient Transmission Array shone with extremely bright light and revolved rapidly, stirring up gusts of wind within the Stone Hall.
Yuan Ming secretly observed the Nascent Soul cultivators. Their attention was all on the Transmission Array and they paid no heed to Wulu, apparently not having seen through Wulu's Disguise.
Not only that, but he also noticed something else.
The Divine Sense that descended veered to the side, where a bald, red-nosed Nascent Soul cultivator from Fusang Island stood.
The man appeared lax, occasionally taking a sip from the wine gourd on his waist. There was nothing wrong with his demeanor or expression, but Yuan Ming's Divine Sense was supported by the Stealing Heaven Tripod, and nothing could escape his investigation.
The appearance and aura of the red-nosed cultivator were a Disguise, hiding someone else inside.
Yuan Ming recognized the person. It was the Tide Maker, Jia Sifang.
"Why is Jia Sifang here? And why is he disguised as another person using a secret technique? Could this be the task Ni Mu assigned Jia Sifang?" Yuan Ming thought to himself and informed Xi Ying of the situation.
"So that's how it is. Ni Mu was plotting this all along..." Xi Ying wasn't surprised.
"Do you want me to use a method to expose Jia Sifang?" Yuan Ming asked through telepathy.
Though the first soul was weak, it could still take Jia Sifang by surprise and reveal his true form.
"There's no need. Don't concern yourself with this person. Just focus on the competition in the Secret Realm. Leave Jia Sifang and Ni Mu to me," Xi Ying said.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming knew that Xi Ying had a plan in mind and said no more.
"Golden Cloud Fairy pays respects to all the predecessors," Golden Cloud Fairy was the first to salute the assembly of Nascent Soul cultivators in the Stone Hall.
The others followed suit with their greetings.
"Everyone, there's no need for formalities. The modified Transmission Array can't hold for long, so hurry and enter the Formation!" Xu Fu continued to work his spells with both hands and nodded slightly to Yuan Ming and the others, urging them on.
Seeing this, the seventeen people didn't dare to delay and made their way towards the Teleportation Array.

chapters.title: Chapter 500 - 500: 476
chapters.content:
Seeing that all seventeen people had entered the Teleportation Array, Xu Fu flipped his hand to produce a Silver Token, rapidly muttering incantations; a layer of silver radiance illuminated the token.
"This token…" Yuan Ming's eyes shifted.
The token in Xu Fu's hand was very similar to his own Silver Token, whether in shape or material, and even the patterns engraved on the surface were alike. Only, Xu Fu's token seemed all show and no substance, lacking the ancient and mysterious aura of his token.
Xu Fu's finger made a false tap, and a beam of silver light shot out from the token, disappearing into the Ancient Transmission Array.
The light within the Array suddenly surged, engulfing everyone's line of sight, and the figures of Yuan Ming and the others vanished in a flash.
It was Yuan Ming's first time traveling such a long distance via a Teleportation Array; his body felt like it was plunging into a Bottomless Abyss, and currents of spatial distortion tugged at his body.
At that moment, the Silver Token inside Yuan Ming's Storage Ring suddenly stirred, starting to absorb something. The tearing forces around him abruptly intensified multiple times, threatening to grind him to pieces in the depths of the void.
Even with Yuan Ming's physical strength, it was hard to bear; his organs felt like they were being overturned, and blood trickled from the corner of his mouth.
The others were no different. Except for a few with sturdier bodies, they all vomited blood.
Inside the Void Temple of Fusang City, Xu Fu saw that the group had been successfully teleported away and breathed a sigh of relief.
However, at that moment, the eight silver Stone Pillars suddenly began to buzz with vibration, and the accumulated Space Power within them was instantly drained. The silver light in the Ancient Transmission Array became chaotic, threatening to collapse.
"How is this possible! The accumulated Space Power in the Array was enough for a round trip. How could it be insufficient for even one transfer!" Xu Fu's eyes widened incredulously as he exclaimed.
Near the Array, Jia Sifang's face also flashed a peculiar expression.
He made some minor adjustments to the Array per Ni Mu's instructions. Could those changes have caused the Array's loss of control?
If those Core Formation Stage cultivators died in the Void Turbulence, his and Ni Mu's plans would amount to nothing more than a wasted effort.
At that moment, Jia Sifang suddenly raised one hand and produced the Silver Command Flag, exerting all his strength to activate it, and a thick beam of silver light poured into the Array.
The others also reacted, quickly pulling out their Silver Command Flags in an attempt to stabilize the Array, but to little effect.
Xu Fu's eyelid twitched as he gritted his teeth, pulling out two fist-sized silver Crystal Balls and throwing them into the Teleportation Array.
The Crystal Balls, which looked like jade stones, instantly melted like liquid when they touched the Array, merging into it and calming the chaotic light.
Just a moment ago, Yuan Ming and the others were still experiencing nearly suffocating tearing from the Space Power. Suddenly, they all felt lighter, and then their surroundings blurred, and they found themselves inside an almost identical Stone Hall.
The group was weak at the knees; they all collapsed to the ground with pale faces, all except for Qing Tong, Xue Jiao, Hou Santong, and Golden Cloud Fairy who seemed unaffected.
Upon seeing this, Yuan Ming, while gasping for breath, felt something strange in his heart.
It made sense that Qing Tong and her companions, with their Demon Clan bloodline, had tougher bodies, far superior to ordinary people, but how did Golden Cloud Fairy seem completely fine?
"What just happened? It felt like we were about to be sucked into the Void Turbulence!" someone whispered.
Others nodded in agreement, still with fear in their eyes.
Golden Cloud Fairy's brows were tightly furrowed. She had used this Ancient Transmission Array to travel to the outer sea more than once and had never experienced what just happened.
Yuan Ming's thoughts also turned in that direction. Suddenly, he remembered something and immersed his Divine Sense into his Storage Ring.
Inside the ring, the Silver Token was radiating a bright silver glow, a stark contrast to its previous lifeless appearance.
"Sure enough, it's this damned token..."
Yuan Ming invoked his Mana and Divine Sense to probe the Silver Token. As the silver light on it flickered, the space within the ring trembled, showing signs of splitting open.
Yuan Ming quickly ceased his actions; the spirit light on the Silver Token faded, and the space inside the Storage Ring stabilized.
With so many people around, it wasn't convenient to investigate further, so he planned to examine it later.
The group took some time to recover their breath before they all gradually regained their composure.
"Rest up? Now, follow me," came a voice as a thin and tall man in his thirties stepped out from the corner of the hall.
Hearing this, Yuan Ming's heart skipped a beat.
As soon as he had regained consciousness before, he had habitually surveyed the Stone Hall. There had been no one else in the hall at that time; when had this thin man appeared? He had completely eluded Yuan Ming's Spiritual Sense!
The thin man was wearing a green scholar robe covered in grease stains as if it had not been laundered in years. His headband was carelessly placed upon his head, and he was fiddling with a bamboo fan, most of its ribs broken, presenting the image of a down-and-out scholar.
"Junior Master Luu," Golden Cloud Fairy greeted the disheveled scholar with respect, performing a formal bow.
"Elder Luu!" Daoist Qian Bao, Huan Ling Zi, and Tu Sheng also seemed to recognize the man, showing signs of reverence.
The others followed suit in greeting, and amidst low murmurs, Yuan Ming overheard someone mentioning phrases like "Great Elder Luu Changfeng of Fusang Island."
Yuan Ming, controlling his first soul, sent out his Divine Sense again, his eyes flickering.
Luu Changfeng was indeed a Nascent Soul Mid-Stage expert. His previous conjecture proved correct; Fusang Island's underlying strength was far greater than what most people saw on the surface.
"Follow me," said Luu Changfeng, waving his hand as if he disliked overly complicated formalities, and started walking toward the exit of the Stone Hall on his own.
The group hurried to keep up, and a long corridor appeared ahead, similar to the situation in the Void Temple of Fusang City.
Yuan Ming extended the Divine Sense of his first soul and quickly surveyed the surroundings of the Stone Hall.
This Teleportation Array was also within a pyramid structure similar to the Void Temple, with a winding corridor that was exactly the same. The only difference was the plaque outside the building, which read: True Sea Hall.
The group passed through several corridors and soon stepped outside.
A desolate island came into view, covered with grayish-white rocks and devoid of any grass or trees, let alone signs of human life. If not for the True Sea Hall standing in the center of the island, anyone would have taken it for an uninhabited, deserted island.
A tall stele stood not far from the True Sea Hall, inscribed with the words "Two-World Island" in large characters.
"Two-World Island... After passing this island, will I reach another world? The name is indeed interesting," Yuan Ming mused silently.
Two-World Island was not large; a few miles ahead lay a boundless sea, and an overwhelming aura rushed toward them.
The sky was dense with dark clouds and thunder rumbled, with thick bolts of lightning occasionally striking down, splashing up towering columns of water.
The sea was filled with monstrous waves, with some reaching thirty to forty feet high and visible everywhere, and the terrifying sound of their crashing was like the roaring of thousands of thunderclaps, making everyone's eardrums buzz.
It seemed that Two-World Island was protected by a barrier, which kept the giant waves at bay, as they loomed only in the distance. Whenever a wave approached the island, it would automatically dissipate.
"So this is the outer sea. As expected, the environment is harsh. I wonder what the actual Overseas World looks like?" Yuan Ming looked around, not showing much fear but rather full of interest.
However, not everyone had the courage of Yuan Ming; several Core Formation Cultivators who had never been to the outer sea were frightened by the scene before them, their faces turning somewhat pale.
"Is this the extent of the courage of young people these days? Scared silly already, heh," Luu Changfeng scoffed.
Flustered and ashamed, those few quickly composed themselves.
"That looks a bit more proper. Follow me; I'll take you to the entrance of the Secret Realm," Luu Changfeng said, then soared into the sky, transforming into a white light that shot into the distance.
The rest followed closely, quickly leaving Two-World Island behind.
While they stood on the island, the barrier had blocked everything; now that they had left Two-World Island, Yuan Ming and the others sensed that the spiritual energy of the outer sea was exceptionally dense, much richer than the Spirit Vein of Fusang Island, yet also very tempestuous.
If the spiritual energy of Fusang Island was like a docile sheep, then here it was like an enraged chimpanzee.
It was probably this abnormal tempestuousness of the spiritual energy that caused the cataclysmic scenes here; a tempestuous wind swept through, and they, being Core Formation Stage cultivators, felt like floating duckweeds in water, their tunneling lights easily blown off course if they were not careful.
"I used to hear that the environment of the outer sea is harsh and that even Core Formation Stage cultivators struggle to survive. I always thought it was an exaggeration, but it turns out to be true. Now, I truly admire those Demon Hunting Cultivators who dare to come to the outer sea," Wulu said to Yuan Ming, lowering his voice.
"This is just the border of the outer sea, close to the Overseas World; other areas of the outer sea should not be as dangerous," Yuan Ming said.
For a better reading experience, visit *).
The group had a difficult journey, and after much hardship, they finally reached their destination—a large island that spanned a hundred miles.
Their journey over the past half-day was no easy feat. They experienced violent winds, thunderstorms, ghostly mists, and other natural disasters, and even encountered an attack by a group of third-level demon beasts.
The demon beasts of the outer sea were quite different from those Yuan Ming had encountered before. Each one had low spiritual intelligence but was fearless, bloodthirsty, and aggressive. Were it not for Luu Changfeng's protection, some of them might have already perished.
Exhausted, the group landed and immediately sought places to sit down and practice Breathing Control to restore their Mana.
Luu Changfeng did not stop them and simply instructed everyone to gather in half an hour.
Yuan Ming's Mana was also significantly depleted, so he found a flat rock to sit on.
The spiritual energy here in the outer sea was dense, but its turbulence made it difficult to refine and absorb, and much effort was needed for a modest harvest.
All in all, the efficiency of cultivation here was basically on par with that on Fusang Island.
Yuan Ming wasn't too concerned; he set up a protective barrier around himself and began Cultivating with the Nine Elements Technique.
This island was different from Two-World Island. It was lush green inside, with dense Wood Attribute Spiritual Energy, and Yuan Ming soon restored his Mana.
While others were still cultivating, Yuan Ming took out the silver Token from his Storage Ring.
With Luu Changfeng nearby, he didn't probe directly. Instead, he put the Token into the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space and then started infusing it with Mana and Divine Sense.
The silver Token had no barrier or runes on it, but as Mana and Divine Sense were infused, its silver radiance grew brighter.
When the silver light reached a certain intensity, it suddenly expanded, forming a square silver screen that covered the entire altar, creating the silver barrier that would usually only appear in an enclosed space.
Yuan Ming was inwardly delighted. Before, to expand this silver barrier, he had to first construct an enclosed environment, which was quite troublesome.
Now that he could activate the silver barrier at any time, it was much more convenient to use.
But the changes in the silver Token didn't stop there. Compared to before, the silver barrier was now much more solid, and the space within the barrier was completely isolated, as if it had indeed formed an independent space.

chapters.title: Chapter 501 - 477: Two Major Dangers
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming raised his fingers and circulated his mana, casting the Burning Explosion Skill.
Before long, a palace-sized red fireball appeared within the silver barrier, rapidly expanding before swiftly compressing, a terrifyingly high temperature like volcanic lava spreading out, twisting the air around it.
After a few breaths, the scorching fireball shot forth, slamming violently against the silver barrier.
A thunderous "boom" erupted!
A red mushroom cloud rose within the barrier, the silver barrier shook violently, but it did not shatter.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming nodded silently to himself. The silver barrier of the past had no defensive strength to speak of, shattering with the slightest attack.
The silver barrier of today was finally living up to its name, capable of being used as a forbidden barrier. It should be able to withstand one or two attacks from a Core Formation Stage cultivator.
Xi Ying appeared nearby at some point, standing outside the silver barrier, sizing it up.
Just as Yuan Ming was about to consult Xi Ying, he deactivated the silver barrier and detailed the odd sensation during teleportation, as well as the changes in the silver token.
"I have recently been researching Transmission Arrays. Short-distance is one thing, but long-distance teleportation always requires a massive amount of space power. It's astounding that those two pyramid-shaped bizarre buildings could automatically accumulate space power. The divine skills of ancient cultivators are indeed unimaginable," Xi Ying's eyes lit up upon hearing about the effects of the True Void Hall and the True Sea Hall.
"That is to say, the space power required by other long-distance Transmission Arrays is not accumulated in this way? Then what method is used?" Yuan Ming asked.
"Naturally, spiritual materials are used as substitutes. Void Stones and other spatial spiritual objects are rare and hard to find, but spiritual materials that contain a trace of space power can still be found on Yunhuang Continent," Xi Ying explained.
Yuan Ming nodded thoughtfully, suddenly recalling something.
Yan Siyun had once implied to him that Xi Ying had been collecting special spiritual materials like Cloud Dream Stones and Capturing Space Wood through the Hundred Pills Square, but never mentioned their purpose.
It seems that among these spiritual materials, there should be some that contained a bit of space power.
"As for Xu Fu's silver token, named the Teleportation Order, its effect is very single—activating the operation of a Transmission Array; it's not considered much of a treasure," Xi Ying continued.
"My silver token is very similar to that Teleportation Order, could it also be one?" Yuan Ming inquired.
"The aura of your silver token is indeed very similar to that of the Teleportation Order, but this object can form a barrier that isolates auras, and it's significantly different from an ordinary Teleportation Order," Xi Ying shook her head and said.
Yuan Ming fell silent; the recent change in the silver token had revealed some of its details, and encountering an item similar to it, he had thought he would be able to understand the origin of his item. Unexpectedly, he was still clueless.
"Regardless of whether this token is a Teleportation Order or not, it is undoubtedly a Space Treasure. During the recent teleportation process, it absorbed the space power from the ancient Transmission Array, which led to the change," Xi Ying picked up the silver token and toyed with it as she spoke.
Yuan Ming had the same thought and posed another question, "Then, from your perspective, if I were to use a long-distance Transmission Array again in the future, would the token continue to absorb space power?"
"I can't be certain about that either. To be safe, you'd better leave the token here. If the Transmission Array's space power is absorbed, it could lead to teleportation failure, and one would be cast into Void Turbulence. Even Returning to Void cultivators would have no tomb for their remains," Xi Ying advised.
Yuan Ming deeply agreed. Although he was very curious about what changes would occur if the silver token continued to absorb space power, his life was more important.
The Stealing Heaven Tripod Space had extremely stable void energy compared to Storage Bags or Spiritual Beast Bags and other Space Artifacts. It should be able to isolate the token's absorption.
Yuan Ming left the silver token in the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space and retracted his Divine Sense.
Once everyone had recovered their strength, Luu Changfeng led them deeper into the island, quickly arriving at a clear blue lake.
The lake was azure blue, like the purest blue crystal, extraordinarily beautiful.
Near the lake stood several crude stone huts, appearing to be hastily constructed.
As soon as Yuan Ming and the others arrived, three people emerged from the stone huts: a white-bearded elder, a fur-clad young madam, and a valiant, strong man.
The aura of the three was inscrutable, all of them Nascent Soul cultivators, at the early stage of Nascent Soul.
"Elder Qi!"
"Madam Chi!"
"Elder Tu Shan!"
Daoist Qian Bao, Huan Ling Zi, and Tu Sheng hurriedly stepped forward to greet the three personages with proper salutes.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming's expression shifted slightly; these three must be Nascent Soul cultivators from Golden Turtle Island, Kongling Island, and Earth Beauty Island.
The secret realm here had been discovered jointly by Fusang, Golden Turtle, Kongling, and Earth Beauty islands, so it was quite normal for these three to appear here.
"Is everyone ready?" Luu Changfeng asked.
"We can reopen the entrance to the secret realm at any time," the white-bearded elder stated.
"Good, follow me," Luu Changfeng called to everyone and dove into the blue lake.
"Could the entrance to the secret realm be within the lake?" Yuan Ming wondered to himself, following the crowd as they submerged into the lake, heading toward the bottom.
The lake was not large in surface area, yet it was unfathomably deep. Unknown if it was connected to the sea, the group had descended nearly a thousand fathoms and still had not reached the bottom.
Water repulsion was but a minor technique, easily performed by any Core Formation Stage cultivator. However, as they descended to such depths, the water pressure was no trivial matter, and some had already begun to show signs of discomfort.
Yuan Ming's Spirit Root was inferior, and if it weren't for the help of Magic Treasures, his proficiency in magic cultivation was quite low. He was also gradually finding it difficult to withstand the astonishing water pressure and was just about to use a Water attribute Magic Artifact to assist him when he suddenly remembered a Divine Skill.
He recited a spell, and his body rapidly became semi-transparent. It was the Void Transformation Technique.
The Void Transformation Technique could not only pass through barriers and turn into a Void Spirit form, but it also allowed unhindered movement in water, soil, and even seas of fire and magma. However, achieving such a feat was much more difficult than simply walking in water and placed higher demands on the Void Transformation Technique.
Once transformed into the Void Spirit form, the formidable water pressure instantly reduced by ninety percent, and his movement became free again.
"This Void Transformation Technique has significant potential. It might be worth studying closely. Fortunately, Xi Ying is also proficient in this technique so I can learn from her later without having to painstakingly cultivate it myself," Yuan Ming secretly planned.
After descending several hundred more fathoms, nearly half of the Core Formation Stage cultivators began to falter.
Luu Changfeng flicked his sleeve, and dozens of crystalline lights shot out, entering the bodies of several Core Formation Stage cultivators.
Fоr сhаrасtеr shееts аnd glоssаriеs, visit МV|LЕМРYR.
A flash of spirit light encircled everyone, and a jellyfish-shaped white protective shield materialized around them, dispelling all the water pressure.
Yuan Ming was astonished. The power rippling within the jellyfish shields was not Mana but demonic power.
"Luu Changfeng is not of the Alien Clan, yet he can wield demon beast powers. Could it be..." He controlled his first soul, casting Divine Sense to inspect Luu Changfeng, his eyes flashing with understanding.
On Luu Changfeng's wrist was a blood-colored bracelet, which turned out to be a Space Artifact housing a spirit beast with the form of a jellyfish, the source of the demonic energy within the white shield.
Blood-colored tendrils grew from the bracelet, embedding themselves into Luu Changfeng's arm, linking the two together, different from the completely sealed condition of a typical Spiritual Beast Bag.
Luu Changfeng's Mana and the jellyfish's demonic power merged, employing the Golden Sunflower Beast Taming Technique.
"Luu Changfeng indeed knows the Golden Sunflower Beast Taming Technique and has even cultivated it to the extent that he can use the spirit beast's powers. It seems he possesses the complete secret skill!" Yuan Ming's heart surged with excitement.
The version of the Golden Sunflower Beast Taming Technique he had obtained from Luo Wanshan was incomplete. If he could acquire the complete secret technique from Luu Changfeng, it would greatly benefit his strength.
Yuan Ming secretly calculated how to obtain this technique from Luu Changfeng.
Even in the worst-case scenario, joint action with Xi Ying to subdue Luu Changfeng should not be difficult. However, the priority was the secret realm for now; considering that, they would wait until after the secret realm expedition was over.
With the jellyfish shields, the journey below became extremely smooth. The group descended another seven or eight hundred fathoms and quickly arrived at the bottom of the lake.
The Core Formation Cultivators displayed looks of amazement as towering buildings of extraordinary height stood erect on the lakebed, with giant structures visible everywhere, and the doorways of the buildings all exceeding thirty feet in height.
Gathered together, these tall buildings formed an immense city sprawled over dozens of miles, seeming unlikely to be a place for ordinary members of the Human Clan to reside.
"Madam Chi, what is this place?" Huan Ling Zi asked the woman in fox fur, looking on.
"There is no need for you to know too much. Just follow us," the woman in fox fur said indifferently, flying towards the largest palace structure within the city, and quickly landing in front of the palace.
This gigantic city seemed to have sunk beneath the sea many years ago, with buildings covered in mud and moss, obscuring sight. Only the doors of this palace had been cleared, revealing ancient murals and some bent, twisted, and strange characters.
"This is Wanqu script. Could this place be the ruins of the Wanqu Clan?" Xi Ying softly exclaimed from within the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space.
"The Wanqu Clan?" Yuan Ming had not heard of this name before.
"The Wanqu Clan is an Alien Clan from the East Sea, all of whom are thirty feet tall with immense strength. They appeared briefly in the East Sea and then vanished altogether, leaving not a trace behind. Unbelievably, this place turns out to be a remnant of the Wanqu Clan! Hurry, use your Divine Sense to carefully investigate this place and see if you can find any books or Jade Scrolls," Xi Ying said with a hint of excitement, urging him on.
"Why look for these things?" Yuan Ming asked. Nonetheless, he did as Xi Ying suggested, deploying his soul power from within the Stealing Heaven Tripod to search the city.
"The Wanqu Clan were skilled in creating Flying Boats powered by Star Power, incredibly fast, surpassing any Flying Magical Treasure. They were said to have crafted a kind of Starry Sky Snail Boat that soared above the Nine Heavens Gang Wind, as large as mountains, covering tens of thousands of miles in a day. The Wanqu Clan appeared and disappeared suddenly aboard this Snail Boat," Xi Ying spoke with a look of longing.
Hearing this, Yuan Ming grew more intrigued by this so-called Wanqu Clan, and his Divine Sense searched throughout the underwater city.
Unfortunately, with the weak soul power of his split soul, he could only scout a small part of the city and found nothing.
At this moment, Luu Changfeng and others opened the grand doors and entered the palace.
A distorted Light and Shadow Gate floated in the middle of the palace, radiating pulses of power that repelled the seawater in the hall, creating a dry seabed space.
"Could this light gate be the entrance to the secret realm?" Daoist Qian Bao asked, his eyes lighting up.
"Indeed, the entrance is currently sealed and requires casting to open. However, before we open the secret realm, there's something you all need to know—about the two major dangers inside the secret realm," Luu Changfeng said slowly.
Upon hearing this, everyone listened intently. Yuan Ming also collected his thoughts, no longer distracted by searching.

chapters.title: Chapter 502 - 478: Entering the Country
chapters.content:
"The first danger within the secret realm is Star Rain," Elder Luu Changfeng said.
Seeing the crowd's puzzled expressions, Luu Changfeng wasn't surprised. After clearing his throat, he continued to explain:
"No one knows how this rain forms. You can simply think of it as rain made of starlight. It occurs periodically. There is nowhere to hide from this rain; you cannot evade it by flying high into the sky or tunneling into the ground. One can only resist it using magic artifacts, magic treasures, or defensive magic. Among these, magic treasures and spells with star attributes are the most effective. This has already been mentioned in the mission jade scrolls given to you earlier."
Only then did everyone understand why Fusang Island had asked them to prepare several star treasures.
"Star treasures are extremely rare, and you might not be able to purchase them. Here are some Heavenly Star Shield talismans specially made by Fusang Island; I bestow upon each of you three to prepare for emergencies." Elder Luu Changfeng took out a stack of blue talismans and tossed them out with a wave of his hand; three landed in front of each person.
The crowd looked at one another and collected the talismans.
"Elder Luu, what about the second danger?" Long Chong asked.
"The second danger comes from the Starry Sky Beasts. These beasts are formed from the power of stars, lacking common weaknesses of demon beasts, and are nearly indestructible. If you encounter one, your best option is to flee," Elder Luu Changfeng explained.
"What if we can't run away?" a young man with dark skin, looking like an ordinary farmer, hesitantly asked.
"If you can't run away, you'll die!" Elder Luu Changfeng glanced at the dark-skinned youth and said indifferently.
The young man's complexion turned pale, and a trace of fear gleamed in his eyes.
Standing beside the dark-skinned youth were two people, a man and a woman, both seemingly young.
The man carried a fish basket and a fishing rod, looking like a fisherman; the woman wore a blue cheongsam and a flowered hat, similar to a tea picker.
The pair, wearing worried expressions, discussed in low voices with the dark-skinned youth, debating whether to give up their journey into the secret realm.
"Three little cowards," Qing Tong spat disdainfully.
Others looked at the trio with similar disapproval in their eyes.
In the information Yan Siyun had provided, Yuan Ming had seen the profiles of the three; the dark-skinned youth was named Baili Zhui, the fisherman was named Hua Ping, and the tea picker was named Zhong Ling. They belonged to the first-class islands of Red Leaf Island, Wanhua Island, and Yuzhu Island.
Red Leaf, Wanhua, and Yuzhu, while first-class islands, were at the bottom of the tier and not adept at combat; instead, they specialized in arrays, talismans, and the cultivation of spirit grass, among other auxiliary skills.
Being aware of their own weaknesses, the three islands had a very conservative approach to their affairs. They barely left their own islands except for necessary trade activities and refrained from participating in the power struggles among the islands of the East Sea. They were often mocked by other first-class islands as the "Turtle Shrinking Three Islands."
Yuan Ming, without any prejudice like the others, approved of Baili Zhui and his companions' cautious approach. If he had not possessed the Stealing Heaven Tripod, a heaven-defying lifesaver, he too might have chosen to retreat.
"You may choose to withdraw now if you wish, just wait outside the hall," Elder Luu Changfeng said calmly.
After exchanging looks, Baili Zhui and his companions decided to stay.
Elder Luu Changfeng and the others then each took out a white jade plate and began casting.
Countless white spiritual patterns materialized in the void around the Light and Shadow Gate, binding the gate firmly and forming a sealing array.
As Elder Luu Changfeng and the others continued their casting, the spiritual patterns of the sealing array swiftly dissipated, revealing the Light and Shadow Gate.
A massive force burst out from within the gate, causing the entire hall to shake. The spiritual energy in nature became completely rampant, forming giant spiritual energy vortexes one after another.
Three mountain illusions, one red, one white, and one gold, rose slowly from within the Light Gate, rapidly growing in size as they ascended.
"This is the phenomenon of the Three Immortals Island..." Yuan Ming raised his eyebrows.
Wulu gazed at the three mountain illusions, a flicker of excitement crossing his face as he clenched his fists in secret.
The others also fixated on the mountain illusions with various expressions.
"Quick, the outbreak of the spiritual mountain illusions is accelerating. We can't allow them to fully manifest!" Elder Luu Changfeng barked, rapidly forming hand seals.
The other three did the same, pouring forth their mana like raging waves into the white jade plates.
Four beams of white light shot out from the jade plates, transforming into four giant white hands that grasped both sides of the Light and Shadow Gate and pulled with great effort.
A crevice emanating a deep, dark light slowly appeared within the Light and Shadow Gate, as if it led to another world.
Elder Luu Changfeng and the others exerted their full power on the jade plates and the Light and Shadow Gate was soon fully opened, revealing a pitch-black passageway that plunged into the depths below.Thаnks fоr rеаding—brоught tо yоu by М|VL|ЕМРYR.
"Hurry inside; in thirty days, we will reopen the entrance to the secret realm and bring you back out. The amount of treasures you'll obtain depends entirely on your own fortune!" Elder Luu Changfeng announced.
Hearing this, the seventeen people inside the hall did not delay, quickly flying out and into the dark passage.
After the last person entered the passageway, Elder Luu Changfeng and the others stopped casting and the Light and Shadow Gate closed with a loud bang.
The four rapidly operated the white jade plates, and the Sealing Array reemerged, sealing the Light and Shadow Gate once again.
The mountain illusions, barely peeking above the surface of the lake, emitted an indignant roar as they slowly dissipated.
Luu Changfeng and his three companions let out sighs of relief, with their faces slightly pale, as if the spellcasting had greatly diminished their vitality.
The four didn't leave; instead, they sat down cross-legged inside the grand hall to recover their energy.
...
Thousands of miles out on the sea of the outer sea, a blue flying boat, over a dozen meters long, hovered low in the air. The entire ship was inscribed with countless star patterns, emitting thousands of dazzling starlights that enveloped the boat within.
All demon beasts within a hundred miles sensed the terrifying pressure of the flying boat and fled in terror.
Waves roared to the skies and dark clouds shrouded the heavens, with thick thunderbolts occasionally crashing down.
However, neither the waves nor the thunder could touch the blue flying boat. They would be repelled from a distance, and the flying boat stood firm as a mountain, as if it could remain unshaken even if heaven and earth shattered.
Inside a room of the flying boat, a burly man who was eight feet tall sat. His beard was like spear grass, bristling, and his eyes, large as copper bells, radiated an awe-inspiring majesty. He toyed with a white crystal ball the size of a fist.
Inside the crystal ball, spirit light flickered, revealing the vague shadows of three mountain peaks in red, white, and gold.
"Three Immortals Island has indeed reappeared. It was worth the many years of searching," the man cackled with a laugh that seemed to pierce the clouds, causing the nearby void to buzz in response.
Three figures stood opposite the man. To the left was a young man with white frosty brows and pupils as bright and white as snow, radiating a bone-chilling coldness.
In the middle was a middle-aged man with red hair, holding a blood-red walking stick, his eyes faintly gleaming with blood light, and his body enshrouded in a dense and extreme aura of evilness, coalescing into a revolving Black Wind.
To the right was a tall and attractive woman with purple hair and purple eyes. She seemed quite beautiful but wore a silver mask that covered the left side of her face.
"The information from Jia Sifang seems very accurate, not wasted our decades of accumulating star power to send him to the Inner Sea," the woman with purple hair said with a giggle, her voice as clear and melodious as a bubbling spring.
"What should we do next? According to his message, it's not easy to enter Three Immortals Island," the middle-aged man with red hair asked.
"According to the response of this Earth Vein Pearl, Three Immortals Island is to the northwest. Let's head there first," the burly man said.
The blue flying boat changed direction, turning into a stream of light and shooting northwest.
...
Yuan Ming and the others felt darkness descend before their eyes, as if they were plunging into a bottomless abyss, but soon light was restored, and they found themselves in a strange space.
The sky was a brilliant blue, similar to the outside world, except for the countless stars suspended above, each magnified several times larger than those outside, their bright starlight illuminating much of the sky.
Below the sky dome was an unfathomably deep black abyss that sent shivers down one's spine.
At the interface of light and dark, several continents floated—some extended as far as the eye could see, while others were only a few miles wide. The group currently stood on a piece of land about a dozen miles across.
The nature's spiritual energy of this space was exceptionally dense, no less than that of the outside world, and it was quite gentle, lacking the wildness of the outside.
The small continent they were on, though not large, was full of various flowers, plants, and trees, brimming with life. Unfortunately, no spiritual materials had formed. The many continents in the distance were also lush with vibrant life.
The individuals who had entered the secret realm were the elite of the various islands, worldly and well-informed, but they were still stunned by this bizarre world, and it took them a while to regain their composure.
"Ladies and gentlemen, we are to stay here for thirty days. This secret realm is fraught with danger, likely more than the two types Elder Luu mentioned. As we have just arrived, it might be better to move together initially, and after we become familiar with the realm, we can then go our separate ways. How about it?" came a hearty voice. It was Huan Ling Zi, who had stepped forward and made a proposal.
The others looked at each other with varying expressions, and for a moment, no one spoke.
"I appreciate Fellow Daoist Huan Ling's kind intentions, but I have always been accustomed to being alone and would rather not join in your cooperation," Daoist Qian Bao chuckled lightly, nodded at Huan Ling Zi, and turned into a golden light that shot into the distance.
The Golden Cloud Fairy transformed into a streak of red light and left without a word.
"Fellow Daoist Huan Ling, I will also take my leave first," Tu Sheng also chuckled, his plump body turning into a billowing yellow smoke that tunneled into the ground and disappeared.
Huan Ling Zi's face turned somewhat unpleasant upon seeing this scene.
The interest of those present in Huan Ling Zi's proposal was already minimal. They had refrained from openly opposing it due to the prestige of Kongling Island, but now with the Golden Cloud Fairy and Daoist Qian Bao taking the lead, they scattered like stars.
In a moment, only Huan Ling Zi was left alone.
"Shortsighted fools! Do they really think I need their help to succeed? Just wait until we get there, I'll show them!" Huan Ling Zi huffed coldly and, with a stomp, turned into a white light and went far away.
A few miles away, behind a large rock, four figures emerged—it was Yuan Ming, Long Chong, Qiong Yun, and Wulu in disguise.
"It seems the individuals from the first-class islands are indeed plotting something," Wulu remarked, eyeing the direction of Huan Ling Zi's vanishing light.
"Let them squabble amongst themselves; it has nothing to do with us. Let's start looking for treasures quickly. With the spiritual energy here so dense, there must be plenty of heavenly materials and earthly treasures. We can't leave empty-handed," Yuan Ming said, looking towards several distant continents.
"Indeed, I shall depart first. May we meet again if fate allows," Wulu nodded at Yuan Ming and the others, then transformed into a tunneling light and left.
"Fellow Daoist Long, Fellow Daoist Qiong, I think we should part ways here," Yuan Ming said, greeting Long Chong and the other and turning to leave.
"Please wait, Fellow Daoist Yuan. Although Fellow Daoist Huan Ling had his own agenda, there was some truth in his words. This secret realm is unpredictable, and it is quite dangerous to act alone. How about us three traveling together? It would be safer," Long Chong suddenly suggested.

chapters.title: Chapter 503 - 479: Guidance
chapters.content:
"Thank you for the kind offer, Fellow Daoist Long, but since we are fundamentally strangers, it would be better if we acted separately," Yuan Ming shook his head and declined politely.
Although these two were not bad people, he was not accustomed to traveling with strangers.
"We're not exactly strangers, Brother Yuan Ming. I've heard of your great reputation long ago," Long Chong said nonchalantly, grinning.
"Yuan Ming? Who is that?" Yuan Ming was startled, yet his face remained expressionless.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan's temperament is truly as Brother Tianming described—impermeable and as stable as a mountain," Long Chong exchanged glances with Qiong Yun, chuckling.
Yuan Ming had not expected to hear Liu Tianming's name, yet he still kept his composure.
"You don't need to be so guarded, Fellow Daoist Yuan. Qiong Yun and I owe Brother Tianming a great debt from many years ago. Over a year ago, we received his message mentioning that you had come to the East Sea, asking us to look out for you. Unfortunately, we never got the chance to meet. Now that we have encountered each other at the Immortal Fruit Conference, it is naturally my duty as the host to do the honors," Long Chong said with a smile.
Yuan Ming suddenly realized why Long Chong had specifically come over to make his acquaintance in front of the Void Temple previously.
But how had the two recognized him? The illusion technique of the Blood Bone Mask was nearly flawless; even Nascent Soul Cultivators could not see through it. How had Long Chong managed to discern his identity?
"Your Illusion Technique is profound, Fellow Daoist Yuan, and I cannot see through it. Yet you carry the Blood Dragon Jade Pendant I gifted to Brother Tianming. This object shares the same origin as my lifebound magical treasure, allowing me to sense it naturally," Long Chong seemed to have guessed Yuan Ming's doubts, pointing at the storage ring on his hand and a spot of blood light shone at his fingertip.
Yuan Ming was stunned, and his Divine Sense entered the storage ring.
The jade pendant given by Liu Tianming lay there quietly, currently emitting a faint layer of blood light.
"It seems I have been too careless," Yuan Ming thought to himself.
When Liu Tianming gave him the jade pendant, he hadn't looked closely and had simply stored it away, oblivious to its secrets.
"You've caught me in a predicament, Fellow Daoist Long. I've been troubled and had to change my appearance. Since we're all among friends here and meeting here is fateful, let's travel together," Yuan Ming nodded.
Since his identity had been recognized, maintaining a distance was pointless. Long Chong and his companions did not harbor any ill intentions, so traveling together might even be beneficial.
"Great, with Fellow Daoist Yuan joining us, our team will be as powerful as a tiger with wings. We might even take the top spot," Long Chong said joyfully.
Yuan Ming shook his head, "I'm afraid I must disappoint you, Fellow Daoist Long. The competition scores based on the number of treasures found, and I'm not skilled at locating items. With so many floating continents around, even adding me, it might still be quite difficult."
"Haha, when it comes to that, the two of us are quite similar. However, Qiong Yun has other methods. We'll just need to escort her," Long Chong laughed aloud.
Hearing this, Yuan Ming curiously glanced at Qiong Yun. She smiled slightly, suddenly raising her hand and waving it, a Black Wood Compass flew out from her storage ring, floating in front of the trio.
"This is a magical treasure my master specially bestowed for the competition, capable of indicating the location of the richest spiritual energy within a hundred miles. We merely need to follow its guidance to find the treasures," Qiong Yun explained proudly.
With that, she immediately began casting, activating the compass. A pale blue spiritual light burst forth from the center of the compass, manifesting a circular spoon-like phantom in mid-air.
The phantom spun swiftly and soon pointed far toward the southeast.
Following the guide, the trio quickly arrived at the edge of the Initial Continent. Looking southeast, a continent slightly lower than the one they were on was quietly floating, much larger in area and hard to estimate in size, its flora all a dark purple hue, presenting a rather picturesque scene upon looking from afar.
Qiong Yun's compass continued to point toward the southeast of the Purple Grass Continent. The trio exchanged glances, then targeted that land and flew towards it with tunneling light.
But just as they had left the Initial Continent, a tremendous rumbling noise suddenly filled their ears. A massive suction force erupting from the void beneath their feet ensnared them like they were caught in a deep oceanic whirl, uncontrollably pulling their bodies downwards.
The expressions on their faces changed dramatically. Long Chong suddenly bellowed, his body emanating a layer of pale blue mana that condensed into a lustrous water membrane on his surface, staunchly resisting the suction force.
Qiong Yun, meanwhile, released a Flying Sword Magic Treasure, stepping on it, riding it beneath her feet. A flash of purple thunder swiftly supported her body diagonally upward, using lift to counter the suction, stabilizing her form as well.
Yuan Ming was in a far worse state; his Cultivation was only at Early-stage Core Formation, far inferior to both Long Chong and Qiong Yun, unable to withstand the suction force, falling downwards.
"Damn it!" he cursed quietly, quickly imitating Qiong Yun's action. A streak of thunder flashed beneath him, and the Thunder God Hammer appeared out of nowhere.
Yuan Ming stood on the Thunder God Hammer, channeling his mana into it.
The Thunder God Hammer shot out several silver thunders, releasing a burst of formidable power, barely resisting the suction force from the Bottomless Abyss.
"Are you alright?" Long Chong shouted over.
"I'm still holding on," Yuan Ming countered the suction from below, pushing himself forcefully towards the Purple Grass Continent.
Long Chong and Qiong Yun also advanced with all their might, but the suction below was alarmingly strong, reducing their speed to less than one-tenth of their usual rate.
Furthermore, the closer they moved forward, the heavier the suction from the abyss below became. Soon, both Long Chong and Qiong Yun began to show signs of strain, and fine beads of sweat also appeared on Yuan Ming's forehead.
Fortunately, as they gradually neared the Purple Grass Continent, the suction force gradually weakened and suddenly vanished as soon as they stepped back onto solid ground.
The authentic version is on *.
"Phew, we've finally made it through. This secret realm is truly bizarre; if the distance between these two continents had been any greater, we might not have been able to cross it," Long Chong said with some relief.
"It seems the secret realm restricts us to only moving between nearby continents," Qiong Yun sighed.
Yuan Ming had the most difficult time crossing; wiping his forehead, he quietly worried.
The distance between these two continents wasn't very far, and he was able to hang on, but if it had been any farther, it would be a different story.
Fortunately, he had the golden sunflower Beast Taming Technique, which could enhance his Mana level. If push came to shove, he would have to reveal this secret technique.
Upon this thought, Yuan Ming's mood stabilized. He looked around, his eyes narrowing slightly, "These purple flowers and grass are quite odd, and they likely contain potent poison. The two of you should be careful."
Upon hearing this, Long Chong and the other also started inspecting the surrounding flora.
From a distance, the purple flowers and grass appeared dazzling, but only upon closer inspection did one discover the hidden malice.
Like a carpet, the dark purple grass leaves covered the entire continent. Both the grass leaves and the flowers had tiny, sharp teeth around their edges, looking like gaping mouths waiting for prey to come along.
Seeing this, Long Chong casually took out a piece of fresh red meat of unknown origin and threw it onto a plant.
The purple plant's leaves and flowers suddenly sprang to life, pouncing on the meat and biting into it.
Numerous cuts appeared on the meat, and a foul smell of decay wafted from it.
Long Chong retrieved the meat with a spell, only to find it largely corroded by the poison. Embedded within the black, smelly mass of decayed meat were seven to eight dark purple sharp teeth, as if they had grown right inside the meat.
"It seems these poisonous plants and flowers have developed some level of spiritual intelligence. Not only do they actively attack prey, but they also release poisonous teeth that penetrate into the body of their prey," analyzed Long Chong.
"That piece of meat came from that second level peak demon beast, the Black Rock Lizard Snake, that you killed not long ago, right? This snake contains intense poison, and its flesh naturally possesses considerable resistance to poison. Yet, it was corrupted so quickly; it seems that the purple poisonous flowers are quite potent. It's best not to touch them," Qiong Yun advised.
Yuan Ming nodded silently, then asked in his Sea of Consciousness, "Xi Ying, can you identify these types of poisonous plants?"
"I've never seen this type of poisonous plant either, but since the toxicity is so intense, you might try collecting some. Once we exit the secret realm, you could show them to Yan Sijing and the others. They are adept at alchemy; perhaps they could figure something out," Xi Ying suggested.
That was exactly Yuan Ming's intention. Waving his hand, he emitted a blue light hand that uprooted all the nearby dark purple poisonous grass. After some thought, he sent a poisonous plant into the Spiritual Beast Bag.
"Hua Zhi, you consume these poisonous plants and see if there's anything special about them," Yuan Ming transmitted.
Hua Zhi soon replied, "Master, these poisonous plants taste very strange, and they're just intensely toxic without any other abilities."
Understanding this, and perceiving that Hua Zhi didn't like the poisonous plants, Yuan Ming decided not to release it.
In a spot slightly further away, clusters of delicate bright purple flowers were about to bloom. The tender buds contracted and expanded, spewing out light purple pollen from the gaps. From a distance, they looked like miniature fountains.
Perhaps it was because Yuan Ming had uprooted all the dark purple grass leaves, but the bright purple flowers suddenly turned towards the three of them. Only the size of a baby's fist, the buds drooped down as the petals, glowing with a purple light, suddenly opened wide. Revealing a dense set of sharp teeth, they sprayed a stream of purple poison mist towards Yuan Ming and the others.
With the Cultivation levels of Yuan Ming and the others, such an attack naturally couldn't harm them. Long Chong swept his sleeve, and a strong wind emerged from nowhere, blowing away the purple poison mist.
Qiong Yun's brow twitched, and the Purple Thunder Small Sword appeared in a flash, cutting down all the purple flowers.
Possibly reminded by Yuan Ming's earlier actions, Long Chong and the other, like Yuan Ming, also picked a few from the remains of the purple flowers and collected them.
Yuan Ming, too, once more sent the purple flowers into the Spiritual Beast Bag, receiving from Hua Zhi the same evaluation of being unpleasant and worthless.
Afterward, the trio briefly rested for a moment, regaining the Spiritual Power they had consumed while flying and then continued to follow the Compass's direction, flying southeast.
The Purple Grass Continent was much larger than the previous one they had visited; they flew almost twenty to thirty li without seeing its edge.
And at that moment, a large mulberry forest appeared in front of them.
The trunks of the mulberry trees maintained their original brown color, but the leaves had also taken on a dark purple hue.
The spreading purple grass and flowers seemed to stop at the foot of the mulberry trees, where the soil appeared to have been turned over by someone. Amongst the mounds of loose earth and debris, bits and pieces of purple plants appeared, seemingly torn apart by something.
"Is the Compass guiding us to enter this mulberry forest?" Yuan Ming looked ahead and estimated the size of the forest before turning to ask.
Upon hearing this, Qiong Yun activated the spell again, and the circular dial on the Compass spun around, ultimately still pointing towards the southeast.
"It looks like we have no choice but to go in," Long Chong chuckled, taking the lead into the forest.
Just then, Yuan Ming's expression shifted slightly, and he suddenly looked up towards the top of the mulberry trees: "Be careful, there are demon beasts hiding in the canopy."
As his voice dropped, the purple mulberry leaves suddenly shook violently, and one by one, round, grayish-white heads popped out.

chapters.title: Chapter 504 - 480 Star Rain
chapters.content:
Those grey-white heads looked quite creepy, with a pair of black compound eyes on top like those of a fly. Beneath the eyes were four sharp fangs, half-wrapped in flesh and crisscrossing each other, forming a terrifying mouthpart. Behind it was a somewhat plump body, reminiscent of a silkworm, all emitting strong fluctuations of demonic power.
"Second-level demon beasts!" Qiong Yun uttered softly.
The mouthparts of these silkworm demon beasts suddenly elongated, spewing out purple threads towards Yuan Ming and the other two, wrapping towards them.
War Intent ignited in Long Chong's eyes. He extended his right arm to the side, and a long spear Magic Treasure, shimmering with a blue spirit light, suddenly appeared, which he grasped with a backhand grip. Then, he performed a sweeping strike, creating a half-zhang-wide Water Blade that slashed towards the threads.
Although formed from water, the Water Blade Long Chong slashed out was sharper than imagined. The fine purple threads were split in half the moment they were hit, falling to the sides in two separate streams.
Several silkworms were cut in half, splattering purple fluid everywhere. The Water Blade instantly turned purple, its sharpness greatly diminished.
Whiz whiz whiz!
More threads shot out from the Mulberry Forest, quickly enveloping the Water Blade.
Seeing this, Long Chong's eyebrows slightly rose. He retracted his right hand with the spear to the front, followed by his left hand gripping it too, channeling Mana from both arms into the long spear.
A dozen or so spear flashes appeared out of thin air, with pale blue water light surging, all condensing into Water Blades that covered the sky and hit towards the forest.
A strong demon energy burst from the forest, reaching the Third Level Realm. Several much thicker purple-black threads shot out from the forest, coiling towards those Water Blades.
Seeing this, Qiong Yun's right hand rapidly formed a spell.
Her Flying Sword Magic Treasure reappeared. It flew above her head and began rapidly spinning midair, with the purple Thunder Light flickering on the blade growing more numerous. In an instant, it merged with the long sword to form an electric light disc.
As Qiong Yun pointed forward, the electric disc instantly released a dozen arcs of lightning that caught up with Long Chong's Water Blades in a blink of an eye, merging with them.
The moment the Thunder Water mingled, the transparent form of the Water Blades was interlaced with traversing arcs of lightning, quickly filling it and transforming them into the even more formidable Thunder Light Long Blades.Thе саnоniсаl sоurсе fоr this соntеnt: М|V|L2ЕМРYR.
The Poisonous Silkworms sensed this imposing energy and immediately spat out more threads, intertwining with the purple-black threads to weave a massive shield, seemingly in an attempt to block the Thunder Blades.
