However, as soon as the two touched, the surging Thunder Light ignited the threads, emitting an unpleasant burnt scent. The purple thread shield almost instantly turned to char.
The Thunder Light Long Blade continued its unstoppable trajectory, fiercely striking into the Mulberry Forest.
Large swathes of the forest collapsed and shattered, and the bodies of the Poisonous Silkworms inside burst open, turning into splatters of purple liquid.
The body of a two-to-three zhang long purple-black Poisonous Silkworm appeared, relatively intact, seemingly the third-level Silkworm King.
The Silkworm's body was covered with seven or eight wounds, all scorched and heated by the electric light, even reddening slightly, with a meaty fragrance emanating.
Long Chong flicked his sleeve, emitting a ray of blue light, collecting the Silkworm King's body.
Having witnessed the Joint Attack Skill of Long Chong and Qiong Yun, Yuan Ming couldn't help but nod to himself.
Both Long Chong and Qiong Yun were only at the late stage of Core Formation, not standing out among the Core Formation Cultivators who entered this place, but with this Joint Attack Skill, even Peak Core Formation Cultivators would probably not fare well against it, not to mention these Poisonous Silkworms.
Moreover, seeing how smoothly the two coordinated, it was clear that this was not their first collaboration. They probably had even more powerful joint techniques up their sleeves.
Yuan Ming glanced at the Mulberry Forest and saw that some Poisonous Silkworms had survived. Noting that Long Chong and Qiong Yun seemed to have no intention of making another move, he instantly understood they wanted to gauge his strength.
He smiled nonchalantly, rubbing the Cold Moon Ring on his left hand while chanting a spell under his breath.
A vast expanse of white frost immediately poured from the ring, rushing towards the Poisonous Silkworms before they could flee, quickly enveloping them.
Accompanied by a crackling sound, the now ice sculpture-like Poisonous Silkworms fell like hail to the ground, shattering into a pile of ice chips.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan has impressive Divine Skills," Long Chong couldn't help but praise.
Yuan Ming smiled and modestly said, "It's just the power of a Magic Treasure, not worth mentioning..."
He had only spoken halfway when the three of them suddenly changed their expressions. In the next instant, they simultaneously looked up at the sky.
In the dark blue sky, a slightly dim star suddenly lit up with a pale blue light, waves of invisible fluctuations spreading with the light, rapidly engulfing the entire Secret Realm in moments, drawing the attention of everyone present.
Spread across the various continents, people involuntarily looked up, quickly locking their gaze onto the star that was supposed to fade into obscurity.
Under their watch, the star suddenly plummeted, dragging a pale blue tail flame behind it, leaving a thin trail of light across the sky. It continued to descend until it was caught by a continent suspended midair, with the light slowly fading away.
Yet, this falling star was merely a small beginning.
In the heavens, the pale blue light that had just faded lit up again. But this time, it wasn't just one star shining alone, but like a tidal wave, thousands upon thousands of stars lit up. The light was so abundant it made the entire Secret Realm much brighter.
Immediately following, star after star slid across the sky, countless streaks of light plummeting straight down to the earth, like a torrential downpour.
Rain, it's only beautiful when you're a bystander.
And for the people in the secret realm, the stars falling with roaring sounds, the Star Rain arriving in a dazzling flow of light, were like death warrants claiming their lives.
The stars falling from above, at first glance were just specks of light, but as they neared, the specks grew larger and eventually became as big as a person. The cyan tail flames tore through the air, emitting sharp howls that made everyone's heart sink.
"It seems this is the Star Rain, hurry into the forest, these mulberry trees might help us block some of it!" Long Chong immediately said.
Yuan Ming nodded, but he did not agree in his heart. Before entering, the people of Fusang Island had said that there was nowhere to hide from the Star Rain, and these mulberry trees nearby might not be able to help them withstand the incoming meteors.
Long Chong also knew this, but he still harbored a sliver of hope.
After entering the forest, the three of them still looked up at the sky. Through the gaps in the leaves, they saw the meteors getting closer, soon arriving right above their heads.
It was at this moment that something shocking happened. The fist-sized meteors that struck the mulberry trees seemed as if they had hit water, creating ripples before passing through, continuing to plummet towards the trio without harming the trees in the slightest.
The meteors had arrived, and without time to think further, Yuan Ming and his companions immediately deployed their countermeasures.
Long Chong took out a azure copper ring with starlight faintly visible on it, and tossed it toward the meteor.
The ring flickered in the air, then split into hundreds of phantoms, all striking the meteor simultaneously. In an instant, dozens of phantoms shattered and disappeared, but they managed to nudge the meteor off course slightly to the left, which then buried itself into the ground beside Long Chong, vanishing from their sight.
Qiong Yun too pulled out a blue Treasure Mirror, which also seemed to be a Star Treasure.
A hint of helplessness flashed in Yuan Ming's eyes as he summoned the White Bone Knife with a flip of his hand.
He had searched for some in the Fusang Island workshop as well, but to no avail; he had been too late, all the Star Treasures and Magic Artifacts had already been bought. He had no choice but to make do with the White Bone Knife.
Fusang Island provided only three Heavenly Star Shields, and with the Star Rain currently manageable, they naturally did not want to waste them.
The three of them each urged their Magic Treasures to fend off the attack of the Star Rain.
However, very quickly, Yuan Ming was the first to detect something amiss. Upon closer observation, he noticed that each time his Bone Knife collided with a meteor, a very faint cyan light would penetrate it. As time passed, he could feel his Magic Artifact gradually slowing down, to the point where it would only execute a command a moment later than he directed.
Long Chong and Qiong Yun's Magic Treasures were likewise affected, only because their treasures had Star Attributes, the degree of erosion was much lighter than the White Bone Knife.
"No wonder Luu Changfeng said that Star Treasures are the best at withstanding the Star Rain," Yuan Ming thought to himself.
"We don't know how long the Star Rain will last; we can't keep fighting separately. Let's take turns using our Magic Treasures to defend, and try to reduce the damage to them as much as possible!" Long Chong suggested.
Yuan Ming and Qiong Yun nodded at the same time. The three of them moved closer to each other and then followed Long Chong's idea, taking turns deploying their Magic Treasures to fend off the Star Rain.
After who knows how long, Yuan Ming's White Bone Knife was on the verge of collapsing. Long Chong's and Qiong Yun's Magic Treasures, although in better condition, had also greatly weakened in spiritual light.
Yet the Star Rain still did not relent and seemed to grow even more intense.
This made Yuan Ming and his companions inwardly curse their luck, each calculating whether it was more cost-effective to damage another Magic Treasure or use the Heavenly Star Shield talisman.
Just when the increasingly intense Star Rain suddenly ceased, the cyan light that filled the sky unexpectedly vanished without a trace, as if all that had happened before never occurred.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming and his companions were all taken aback, as unaware of why the Star Rain came as to why it went away.
But this also meant they no longer needed to expend their Magic Treasures.
Quickly setting aside their questions, all three breathed a sigh of relief and began to check their Magic Treasures.
Yuan Ming's White Bone Knife had been entirely corroded, rendered completely unusable while Long Chong's and Qiong Yun's Magic Treasures could still be activated. But judging from the recent situation with the Star Rain, they could probably only be used one more time at most.
The three felt a tinge of pain, but no amount of regret could change the reality of the damaged Magic Treasures. They could only sigh and put them away.
It was at this moment, Yuan Ming suddenly noticed that the scenery around them seemed to have changed.
The once straight mulberry trees had suddenly became taller, and the traces left by their fight with the Poisonous Silkworms had disappeared. The trees that had been hacked at were restored, and the bodies of the Poisonous Silkworms scattered on the ground were gone without a trace.
Yuan Ming immediately extended his Divine Sense and then discovered, to his surprise, that at the spots where the Poisonous Silkworms had just been, hundreds of silkworm eggs were rapidly maturing, containing an abundance of Spiritual Power, as if they were about to hatch at any moment.
As thoughts raced through his mind, he quickly informed Long Chong and the others of the situation.
Long Chong and Qiong Yun were surprised to hear this, but there was no time to research these changes now. To avoid being further delayed by newly hatched Poisonous Silkworms, the three did not linger. They each collected some Poisonous Silkworm eggs and continued on their way, quickly moving through the Mulberry Forest.

chapters.title: Chapter 505 - 481: The Visitor Comes with Ill Intent
chapters.content:
When Yuan Ming and his two companions saw the familiar purple flower and grassland again, they were surprised to find that the flora around them not only showed no signs of damage, but also seemed even more vibrant, as if they had just been enriched by rain, their beauty almost dripping with freshness.
Yuan Ming and his two companions looked at the scene before them, each gaining some insight.
Perhaps, the sudden star rain for the living beings and plants in the secret realm was a blessing from the sky that nourished all creatures.
However, for Yuan Ming and his companions, it was a genuine natural disaster.
"Sigh, we haven't even seen a hint of the treasure yet, and we've already lost a Magic Treasure. If I had known it would be like this, I might as well have used the talismans given by Fusang Island," Long Chong sighed deeply, complaining.
"You better save your words. Unless you don't care about your ranking, those three talismans should be used at critical moments. How could you waste them on something like this?" Qiong Yun raised her eyebrows, not in agreement.
Long Chong helplessly nodded. However, he then looked up at Yuan Ming, and soon after, he communicated with Qiong Yun using a voice transmission.
"You're right; we can't waste the talismans. It's fine for us, who have wealth and resources, to lose one or two Magic Treasures, but Yuan Ming is just a Loose Cultivator. He doesn't have that many Magic Treasures to lose. In my opinion, if we encounter another star rain, we should do our best to endure it a bit longer to spare Yuan Ming from losing too many, lest he have no Magic Treasures to use when facing enemies," Long Chong said quietly.
Unexpectedly, Qiong Yun gave him a puzzled look in response to his voice transmission:
"When resisting the star rain earlier, that's exactly what I did. You didn't just realize this, did you?"
Long Chong's face turned red, and he cleared his throat a few times, too embarrassed to say anything further.
On the other hand, Yuan Ming, relying on his powerful Divine Sense, overheard the voice transmission between Long Chong and Qiong Yun and silently nodded.
These two were truly loyal and seemed worth befriending.
He didn't say anything, however, and continued to let Hua Zhi consume the flowers and grass in the area, still only rating them as unappetizing.
After Long Chong and Qiong Yun finished their exchange, Qiong Yun activated the compass. The shadow of the round scoop still pointed southeast.
The three of them set off again, and this time, to find the treasure before the next star rain, they unconsciously quickened their pace. Whenever they encountered demon beasts on the way, they avoided them if possible, choosing not to engage them directly.
About thirty minutes later, the land still had no end in sight, and a swamp appeared before them, shrouded in drifting purple fog.
The swamp was filled with purple reeds that stretched to both sides endlessly, like a high wall blocking their path.
The clustered reeds left almost no space between them. The purple tassels seemed limp but on closer inspection, they looked like the breathing muzzles of living creatures. The purple toxic fog lingered around them, connecting with each other and forming a nearly non-existent giant net of poison fog, enveloping the entire swamp.
Amidst the dense reeds, there were occasional strange sounds of insects, but every time Yuan Ming and his companions listened attentively, the noises would abruptly cease as if they had never existed.
Moreover, heavy dark purple clouds hung above the swamp, layer upon layer, exuding an ominous aura, heavy and stifling. The dazzling starlight from the sky above was also devoured by it.
"What a powerful natural poison cloud, capable of devouring even the power of starlight. It's best not to touch it carelessly," Long Chong clicked his tongue in awe.
Yuan Ming and Qiong Yun also did not rashly enter. They stopped at the edge of the swamp.
The Black Wood Compass hovered in front of Qiong Yun, trembling as it pointed towards the swamp ahead.
"There's no mistake, the treasure is inside the swamp. The Black Wood Compass is reacting so strongly; it must be something extraordinary!" The woman's face showed excitement.
Hearing this, Yuan Ming's interest was also piqued, and his Divine Sense probed ahead.
However, his Divine Sense only penetrated a hundred yards into the swamp before being stopped by an inexplicable force.
Long Chong and Qiong Yun also expressed their astonishment, clearly having also noticed the suppression of Divine Sense by the swamp.
"This treasured place indeed has some tricks. It seems we'll have to take a risk and go in. Both of you should prepare some detoxifying items," Long Chong said.
A rainbow light flashed across Qiong Yun's body, and a Five-Colored Cloud Bag appeared out of nowhere, transforming into a five-colored Light Shield that protected her body.
"That's the Five-Colored Cloud Bag! A secret Magic Treasure of the Southern Border Five Immortals Sect, how do you have one?" Long Chong was quite surprised.
"Five Immortals Sect!" Yuan Ming's eyebrows twitched.
Hong Ling hailed from Southern Border Silk Island, and Yuan Ming had learned quite a bit about the Sects of the Southern Border from her, including the Five Immortals Sect.
The Five Immortals Sect was a very mysterious Cultivation Sect in the Southern Border, specialized in using poison and proficient in Gu Techniques. The Hundred Poison Cave in the Southern Border and Northern Territory also specialized in using poison, but when compared to the Five Immortals Sect, it was merely a dwarf facing a giant—not on the same level.
"I took it by force, of course," Qiong Yun said indifferently.
"You killed someone from the Five Immortals Sect? Anyone with a Five-Colored Cloud Bag must be a core disciple of the Five Immortals Sect, and the current Hierarch, Granny Gu Xian, is extremely protective of her followers. Be careful not to bring trouble upon yourself," Long Chong's face showed concern.
"Don't worry. That person was a traitor to the Five Immortals Sect. The Five Immortals Sect is grateful for what I did. They couldn't thank me enough," Qiong Yun stated.
Upon hearing this, Long Chong finally relaxed and brought out a purple seashell Magic Treasure, forming a purple protective shield around himself.
Yuan Ming had no detoxifying items, but the toxic fog of the swamp couldn't trouble him either.
Hua Zhi shot out from the Spiritual Beast Bag, transforming into a purple-black figurine about one foot tall sitting on Yuan Ming's shoulder, as he employed the Golden Sunflower Beast Taming Technique, a stream of purple-black demonic power swirling around him.
"This place is filled with severe poison, and to be cautious, you two should take these Detoxification Pills first. I prepared them especially for the Immortal Fruit Conference; they can resist the invasion of most poisons. Also, take these Detoxification Pills and keep them with you. If you notice any signs of poisoning, take them immediately to avoid any accidents," Long Chong said as he took out four porcelain bottles and handed them to Yuan Ming and Qiong Yun.
Qiong Yun didn't decline and directly followed his instructions, taking the Detoxification Pill.
Yuan Ming smiled slightly, knowing that Long Chong's primary concern was for him.
He didn't reject the other's kindness either. After secretly confirming with Divine Sense that the elixirs were safe, he swallowed them down.
Once the pills were ingested, Yuan Ming felt a refreshing sensation all over his body, and the air around him seemed to become fresher as well.
After all three had taken their pills, they didn't linger long and quickly used their Magic Treasures to cut through the reeds, stepping into the swamp.
The deeper they went into the swamp, the more luxuriant the reeds grew, and in those dark corners, numerous venomous creatures lay in wait, silently waiting for prey to pass by.
Toxic mosquitoes with six pairs of wings the size of fists, toads with purple ghost faces on their backs, and emaciated venomous snakes standing in the mire like reeds...
The trio avoided what they could and quickly dealt with any they couldn't. In less than thirty minutes, they had cleared out seven or eight third-level Demon Beasts, even obtaining a Demon Core that Long Chong temporarily stored away for safekeeping.
After another cooperative kill of a poisonous lizard, Long Chong was about to wipe his sweat and check if the Lizard Demon Beast had a Demon Core, but Yuan Ming, standing behind him, suddenly changed expression and stopped him with his hand.
"Wait, there's movement from the southwest. There's a considerable number of them, and it seems they're not Demon Beasts," Yuan Ming whispered a warning.
His main body's Divine Sense couldn't spread too far, but the soul force of the first soul within the Stealing Heaven Tripod could reach easily.
Upon hearing this, Qiong Yun immediately released his Divine Sense to investigate but soon looked puzzled. "I didn't detect anything from that direction. Could you have sensed it wrong?"
"No, I trust Brother Yuan's judgment. Throughout our journey, it has always been him who first detected lurking Demon Beasts. His Divine Sense is stronger than ours; he wouldn't make a baseless claim," Long Chong murmured for a moment and then shook his head.
Yuan Ming didn't respond to them, just silently continued to scan the southwest direction with Divine Sense.
Suddenly, he raised his eyebrows, a mysterious look flashing in his eyes as he quickly whispered, "They've also discovered us, and they're heading this way. There are five Cultivators using Illusion Techniques to conceal their presence."
"Illusion Techniques? Could it be Huan Ling Zi?" Long Chong asked.
"Indeed, it's him, and he looks like he's coming with hostility," Yuan Ming said.
"Hostility? I see. Huan Ling Zi is good friends with Cui Yu from Karma Fire Island. You defeated Cui Yu in the grand competition; perhaps he's come after you because of that," Qiong Yun glanced at Yuan Ming.
"I see," Yuan Ming nodded, now understanding why Huan Ling Zi had been hostile toward him from their first meeting.
However, his fight with Cui Yu had been fair and square, with no underhanded tactics.
And although Cui Yu lost, he didn't suffer serious injuries, so why would Huan Ling Zi take the trouble to come after him over such a trivial matter?Find this chapter's source on *.
"Heh, it's just as well, I've never liked that guy who likes to stab people in the back. It's a good opportunity to teach him a proper lesson today," Long Chong snorted dismissively, gripping his spear Magic Treasure tightly.
Qiong Yun's eyes showed a hint of coldness, not seeming fond of Huan Ling Zi either.
"They're coming, from the east side," Yuan Ming alerted them through telepathy.
Even though Long Chong saw no changes around him, he trusted Yuan Ming's judgment implicitly. He swung his spear, slashing and sweeping out seven or eight Water Blades one after another, all toward the direction Yuan Ming had indicated.
"Haha, Fellow Daoist Long, there's no need to attack. I'm not some Demon Beast," a voice laughed.
Along with the laughter, a pale red spirit light suddenly flashed, striking the Water Blades and easily scattering them.
At the same time, in front of Long Chong and the others, the reeds suddenly seemed to twist as if someone were stirring murky water, adding ink to it. But after a brief moment, the twisting reeds abruptly returned to normal, and five figures of varying stature appeared in front of them.
The one in the lead was Huan Ling Zi, clad in white. His face bore a gentle smile, seemingly untroubled by Long Chong's recent attack, nor did he appear to have come seeking revenge.
The four behind him were the other competitors who had entered the top sixteen from Second-level Islands.
The foremost among them was Yun Jiuxiao from Golden Lotus Island, dressed like a scholar, his outfit marked with black ink stains, accompanied by a Three-eyed Octopus less than half his height, its body monochrome black and white.
Standing shoulder to shoulder with him was the Fairy Bing Xin from Winter Crystal Island, her hair and brows as white as frost, with an expressionless face that revealed no emotions.
Behind the two stood Mi Luo from Wuyun Island, dressed in tender green with a kindly wrinkled face, but his expertise lay in Poison Skills.
The person at the rear, disguised as Hong Chang from Blood Bird's Nest Island, was Wulu, with conspicuous silver hair. Upon his arrival, he gave Yuan Ming a significant look, and then avoided any further eye contact with Yuan Ming.
"Huan Ling Zi, why are you sneaking around like this, making me almost mistake you for a Demon Beast?" Long Chong huffed.
"With so many Demon Beasts in this reed patch, I had to be careful, just in case. But to be honest, I wasn't expecting to run into you and Qiong Yun here, along with Fellow Daoist Yuan," Huan Ling Zi said nonchalantly, casting a meaningful glance at Yuan Ming.
"Hmph, Huan Ling Zi, I know what you're after. Fellow Daoist Yuan and I have been old friends for a long time; as long as I'm here, don't think about harming him!" Long Chong declared.

chapters.title: Chapter 506 - 482: Shattering Illusion
chapters.content:
Huan Ling Zi's expression turned cold, "Oh, I wonder if Fellow Daoist Long has received your father's permission for such thoughts. Karma Fire, Thousand Dragon, Red Rain—these three islands have always advanced or retreated together. And yet, you actually side with outsiders. Or is it that Thousand Dragon Island no longer wishes to maintain an alliance with Karma Fire Island?"
"Our relationship between the three islands is not something for you to worry about," Long Chong answered.
"Fellow Daoist Huan Ling, on the arena strength determines the victor. Cui Yu lost because his skills were inferior. Right now we are focused on treasure hunting; why bother over such a trivial disagreement?" Qiong Yun said.
"Fine, fine, fine, it seems you're determined to protect this person. Then don't blame me for being ruthless and forcing you to withdraw from this competition prematurely!" Huan Ling Zi said coldly and indifferently.
Yuan Ming watched with a cold eye. Huan Ling Zi's visit seemed to be purposefully looking for trouble with him, and avenging Cui Yu was probably just an excuse.
A glimmer of cold light passed through his eyes. Whatever Huan Ling Zi's real intention, since he had come to him, Yuan Ming did not mind adding another Core Formation Stage Ghost Slave to the Night Parade of Hundred Demons within.
However, with Long Chong and Qiong Yun present, he couldn't employ many of his methods.
"Fellow Daoist Long, Fellow Daoist Qiong, there's no need to delay on my account, as you both need to compete for rankings for your own islands. Since Fellow Daoist Huan Ling has come for me, let the two of us settle this matter," Yuan Ming spoke up.
"Hehe, you heard him. Long Chong, Qiong Yun, do you really intend to forcefully defend him?" Huan Ling Zi laughed heartily.
Long Chong held his spear pointing to the ground, sweeping its tip across the surface, tracing a deep blue water streak across it.
A vast chill surged forth, and countless falling ice crystals dispersed all around. A blue and white Flood Dragon with scales like snowflakes and horns as clear as carved crystal appeared, transparent and shining.
"Brother Yuan, there's no need for further words. I have already promised Brother Tianming that no matter what happens, I will ensure your safety. Moreover, although we have not spoken much on this journey, we are already friends. Am I, Long Chong, the type to break my word and abandon a friend?" Long Chong laughed loudly, his eyes brimming with war intent.
Hearing this, Yuan Ming's expression paused, and he silently let out a bitter smile.
"Fine, since you, Long Chong, seek death, I shall grant your wish!" Huan Ling Zi let out a cold laugh as a green oil lamp appeared in his hand, the flame burning low.
Without any visible casting, the flame on the lamp flared up sharply, a green fire shot straight towards Long Chong.
Long Chong seemed to be quite wary of the green fire, as the blue and white Flood Dragon opened its mouth and spewed out a thick stream of cold air to meet the oncoming green fire.
His Flying Sword manifested dozens of sharp Water Blades.
Qiong Yun wielded the Thunder and Lightning Flying Sword, and together with Long Chong, they executed a Combined Attack Divine Power. Electric arcs flickered on the Water Blades as they headed straight for Huan Ling Zi.
Behind Huan Ling Zi, the four Wulu shouted and swung into action, their Magic Treasures shooting out like meteors to block the watery thunderblades.
The seven engaged in intense combat, their spirit lights fiercely intertwining, shredding the reeds of the swamp for tens of meters around them into dust.
"To instantly plunge high-level fighters like Long Chong and Qiong Yun into an illusion without their awareness, what a masterful Illusion Technique," Yuan Ming commented lightly.
"You flatter me," Huan Ling Zi replied indifferently, standing a few meters away, holding the oil lamp.
The four Wulu also stood quietly aside, not lifting a finger, while Long Chong and Qiong Yun wielded their spear and Flying Sword, swinging and striking at empty space, battling against illusory enemies.
"It is said that Kongling Island possesses an Empty Illusion Reincarnation Skill that can utilize Heart Fire to create the most pure Illusion Power, a coveted source of nourishment for all Illusionist Demon Beasts. The Illusion Spirit Fox Clan of the East Sea Hidden Mist Mountain has even signed a contract with Kongling Island, willingly serving as the spirit beasts for Kongling Island's cultivators. Is this green flame the Illusion Spirit Fox Fire, or the Void Illusion Heart Fire, or is it perhaps a fusion of the two?" Yuan Ming looked at the green oil lamp, his words tinted with a mocking smile.
Huan Ling Zi's expression shifted slightly. Whether the Empty Illusion Reincarnation Skill or the Illusion Spirit Fox Clan, they were both secrets of Kongling Island. How did this person know about them?
What alarmed him even more was that after just a glance at the green lamp fire, Long Chong and Qiong Yun had fallen into the illusion, yet Yuan Ming, who had been looking at it for so long, seemed completely unaffected?
Huan Ling Zi clapped his hands together, and instantly three pale pink flames ignited on his shoulders and atop his head. A shadow of a Demon Fox, twice the height of a human, briefly appeared behind him.
Seeing this, the four Wulu quickly closed their eyes and fled backwards.
Huan Ling Zi paid no attention to the four Wulu, his hands forming seals as the three pink flames increased tenfold in intensity. His own body vanished in a flash, leaving only the pink flames hanging in the air, burning quietly.
"So, this is Kongling Island's Empty Illusion Reincarnation Skill? To be able to control someone's innate Heart Fire and cast Illusion Techniques is indeed unique," Yuan Ming remarked with a smile.
"I don't know where you've obtained knowledge of Kongling Island's secrets, but don't think that with just this bit of information, you can break through the methods of Kongling Island!" Huan Ling Zi yelled out, and the three pink flames also abruptly disappeared.
Yuan Ming just smiled slightly, "Then I truly look forward to it."
Provoked by Yuan Ming's attitude, Huan Ling Zi let out a cold snort from the void. Darkness, like a tide, surged forth swiftly, engulfing everything in the vicinity, even the spirit lights emitted during the exchanges between Long Chong and Qiong Yun were swallowed by the encroaching darkness.
Before long, only dark shadows remained around Yuan Ming, and the faint spirit light that enveloped his body still provided some illumination.
Yuan Ming observed his surroundings with interest as Soul Power surged in his Sea of Consciousness, forming a barrier outside his Divine Soul, blocking the influence of external forces, yet he still could not see through the darkness.
He suddenly felt surprised because, with his current strength of Divine Soul, unless a Soul Cultivator of the Sleep Witch Realm took action, no one should be able to trap him in an illusion without making a sound.
Huan Ling Zi's Divine Soul Power was quite strong, but it was only comparable to that of an Illusion Witch, not even reaching the level of a Love Witch. How could such power cause him to fall into an illusion?
"So that's how it is, this Huan Ling Zi does indeed have a talent for Illusion Technique," Xi Ying's voice sounded at that moment.
"You've seen through his tricks? His Divine Soul strength shouldn't be as strong as mine, yet I can't break through this Illusion Technique," Yuan Ming immediately asked.
"On his own, he naturally wouldn't be able to cast an Illusion Technique that could trap you," Xi Ying stated.
Yuan Ming raised an eyebrow, recalling the Demon Fox phantom that had appeared behind Huan Ling Zi when he was casting his Divine Skills.
"The Empty Illusion Reincarnation Skill of Kongling Island is quite mysterious. You should experience it well, as it will benefit your Illusion Technique cultivation," Xi Ying said again, his voice becoming deeper.
Before Yuan Ming could ask, he suddenly heard a rapid series of "bangs," and hundreds of pink Fox Fires suddenly appeared above his head, illuminating the surroundings.
For this reason, Yuan Ming suddenly realized that he was actually standing in a spacious Green Stone plaza, and not far in front of him, a three-story-tall Demon Fox Stele stood, with long slender eyes looking towards Yuan Ming, which, although inanimate, held an inexplicable spirit light.
Above the head of the Demon Fox Stele, Huan Ling Zi stood with his hands behind his back, looking down at Yuan Ming from a high position, with a cruel smile on his face, he said, "Hehe, this is the execution ground I've specially prepared for you. I wonder if you find it satisfactory?"
Yuan Ming didn't pay attention to Huan Ling Zi, he looked around and spread his Divine Sense, scanning all around.
A strange force enveloped the surroundings, like a layer of water film, completely sealing him off from everything outside.
"I see," Yuan Ming's lips revealed a slight smile, and a powerful Soul Power swept out and hit the water film around him hard.
The water film shattered in response, easily broken by Yuan Ming's formidable Divine Sense.
Yuan Ming saw the darkness that had enveloped him dissipate quickly, the Fox Fires above his head also went out in succession, and everything returned to how it was, with him still standing in the swamp. Not far away, Long Chong and others were fiercely engaged in battle, various spirit lights flying chaotically, but they seemed to be influenced by something, deliberately avoiding the spot where he stood.
And the tall Demon Fox Stele that was in front of him also disappeared without a trace, replaced by a white-based demon fox with red patterns, two human heights tall, with three tails, each tip bearing a slowly burning pink flame.
As for Huan Ling Zi, who had been standing atop the Demon Fox Stele, he was now to the right side of Yuan Ming, staring at him with a cold gaze, seemingly unaware that his Illusion Technique had been broken.
Seeing Yuan Ming observing his surroundings, he immediately spoke up, "What, are you so frightened that you can't speak? Or do you still delude yourself into thinking you could see through my Illusion Technique?"
Oddly enough, although he was standing to Yuan Ming's right and speaking, the voice came from the body of the three-tailed Demon Fox, it was unclear by what means.
Yuan Ming suppressed a smile, turned his gaze towards the demon fox, and pretended to still be trapped in the illusion, "Your Illusion Technique does have some merit, but unfortunately, not much."This сhаptеr wаs first sееn оn МV^LЕМ^РYR.
Hearing this, Huan Ling Zi's anger flared, and he immediately let out a cold laugh, "At this point, you still dare to be so arrogant. Let's see if you're still so tough after I nail you to death with Ten Thousand Blades Piercing Heart!"
As soon as he finished speaking, he spat out a Stele Magic Treasure wrapped tightly with nine Black Iron Chains. The Magic Treasure grew to the size of a person upon catching the wind and then plummeted down in front of Huan Ling Zi.
Right after that, Huan Ling Zi's fingers tapped rapidly on the Stele, unleashing one spell after another. Instantly, five iron chains rose into the sky from the Stele, with Triangular Iron Blades at the ends aimed at Yuan Ming, poised like giant snakes ready to strike.
Curious about the situation within the illusion, Yuan Ming temporarily dispersed his Soul Power, and darkness enveloped the surroundings once again.
Among the myriad Fox Fires above his head, Black Iron Chains as thick as an arm appeared out of thin air, with Fox Fire blazing on the chains, and on the tips of the Triangular Iron Blades, the Fox Fire even condensed into fox heads that opened their mouths wide and lunged at Yuan Ming.
This attack was particularly intimidating, but Yuan Ming, who had already seen through the truth, remained calm.
He formed a spell with his fingers, and a Bronze Small Tripod flew out instantly. From within the tripod, five mighty eagles, forged of blazing fire, surged towards the sky, aiming for the actual position of the five chains, pecking and clawing at them, effectively intercepting them.
The other illusionary chains arrived in an instant, with Triangular Iron Blades stabbing straight into Yuan Ming's body, but they were like shadows, leaving no mark whatsoever.
When Huan Ling Zi saw Yuan Ming accurately intercept his attack, his expression changed immediately. Just as he was about to cast another spell, he saw Yuan Ming suddenly turn his head to look at his real position and then actually burst into a smile.
Huan Ling Zi's forehead instantly broke out in a sweat, and he quickly altered his spell to activate the Stele to protect his body.
But just then, Yuan Ming suddenly turned his head again, gazing over at the three-tailed Demon Fox, his right hand shaped like a sword finger, and gave it a flick.
In an instant, a hazy white mist spewed from the Cold Moon Ring, forming a dozen slender Ice Cones in midair, shooting towards the three-tailed Demon Fox.

chapters.title: Chapter 507 - 507: 483
chapters.content:
However, whether intentionally or not, the Ice Cones were not aimed directly at the Three-tailed Demon Fox but towards the position above it—that is, the spot where Huan Ling Zi was battling within the illusion.
Seeing this, Huan Ling Zi suddenly felt uncertain, unsure whether Yuan Ming had truly seen through his illusion. For a moment, he even forgot to call for the Three-tailed Demon Fox to dodge.
However, an attack destined to miss required no evasion; the Three-tailed Demon Fox didn't take the incoming Ice Cones seriously, allowing them to fly over its head.
Upon realizing this, Huan Ling Zi took a deep breath and immediately controlled his illusion to dissipate into Fox Fire and with a sneer, said, "You think what you see is me? How naive!"
But before he could finish, Yuan Ming chuckled lightly at that moment, and his right hand suddenly hooked.
At this point, the Ice Cones, whose momentum had just faded and were about to fall to the ground, paused mid-air under Yuan Ming's control. They then spun around in unison and shot suddenly at the Three-tailed Demon Fox from behind.
This took both Huan Ling Zi and the Three-tailed Demon Fox by surprise. Almost instantly, the Ice Cones deeply pierced the body of the fox, large patches of White Frost climbing up its trunk, turning the red patterns snow white. The blood from the wounds was already frozen, while the cold air reversed along the bloodstream, heading straight for the heart.
With a pained howl, the Demon Fox collapsed weakly, its towering fox body turning into a white ice sculpture, which then exploded with a bang, shattering along with the body of the fox inside.
With the fall of the Three-tailed Demon Fox, the illusions created by Long Chong and Qiong Yun were also lifted.
The two glanced around and quickly grasped what had happened.
Long Chong and Qiong Yun, thinking back to their previous belief that Yuan Ming was weak and recalling his various performances along the way, felt their faces burn with embarrassment and anger. They then turned their rage towards Huan Ling Zi but were interrupted by Yuan Ming's voice at their ears.
Long and Qiong exchanged glances and flew off into the distance.
Yuan Ming watched them leave, about to do something, when streaks of pink Fox Fire shot out from the shattered ice blocks, merging in mid-air into a pink fox shadow. It appeared to be the Three-tailed Demon Fox, but now with only two tails remaining and its aura greatly diminished.
"What kind of Divine Ability is this?" Even someone with Yuan Ming's experience was taken aback upon witnessing this scene.
"This is the Illusion Fox Clan's tail-breaking replacement death divine power, using a fox tail to fend off a fatal attack, similar in principle to that of the Heavenly Ghost Wanderer's Substitution Divine Ability," said Xi Ying, her voice echoing in his Sea of Consciousness.
"I see." Yuan Ming suddenly understood, a cold smile appearing on his face as he exhaled a black Sword Shadow that disappeared into the void.
With the severe injury to the Three-tailed Demon Fox, the Illusion Power enshrouding the area vanished suddenly, and the illusionary scene, which he had already seen through, shattered like a mirror. Even without using Soul Power, he could see everything around him clearly.
Huan Ling Zi was taken aback, clearly understanding that Yuan Ming had already seen through his illusion, but he quickly regained his composure and began casting spells onto the Stele with both hands.
Yuan Ming had obviously already seen through the illusion, so why the pretense if not for fear of being unable to defeat me head-on?
Now, even without the illusion, as a cultivator in the late stage of Core Formation, it would be easy for me to kill one in the early stage!
Huan Ling Zi channeled his Spiritual Power wildly into the stele, and the Two-tailed Fox Demon, with a resentful gaze at Yuan Ming, also mobilized its remaining demonic power, pouring it into the stele.
Besieged by the Fire Hawk, the five chains instantly unleashed a powerful force that scattered the Fire Hawk, and the remaining four chains shot out in kind, intertwining with the previous five.
The nine chains twisted and coiled together, and in just three breaths' time, they transformed into a giant iron serpent, with a nine-blade serpent head radiating a chilling light. In the next instant, it charged straight toward Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming let out a faint cold chuckle, as Lei Yu shot out from the Spiritual Beast Bag at his waist, landing on his shoulder and executing the Golden Sunflower Beast Taming Technique.
As Lei Yu's demonic power converged, Yuan Ming's Mana surged, skyrocketing to late-stage Core Formation level.
However, he was currently wearing the Blood Bone Mask, an item with the effect of concealing fluctuations in aura, so the soaring Mana did not leak out in the slightest.
Yuan Ming opened his mouth to spit out the Thunder God Hammer. As the iron chain spear was about to pierce him, he met the spear tip with a strike.
When the two Magic Treasures collided in the air, the resulting shockwave swept across the surroundings, flattening the nearby reeds to the ground.
In the midst of the raging wind, Yuan Ming stood unflinchingly close by, without blinking an eye.
Meanwhile, Huan Ling Zi beside the stele was forced to take three steps back by the shockwave, his face showing an expression of disbelief.
With his late-stage Core Formation Mana, plus the aid of the Three-tailed Demon Fox, how could he be at a disadvantage in a clash of Mana?
"Damn it, this person is definitely not at the early stage of Core Formation. He must have concealed his true strength, no wonder he managed to defeat Cui Yu at the Immortal Fruit Conference! If I had known earlier, I would not have agreed to Cui Yu's request to help him secure that Thunder Wing Bird!" Huan Ling Zi silently regretted.
The Two-tailed Fox Demon was also sent flying, with a streak of golden lightning penetrating its body, which was precisely the power of Golden Thunder that Lei Yu had gained by refining a third-level Demon Pill.
The demonic power of the Illusion Fox Clan is of pure Yin attributes, quite similar to that of ghosts, and golden thunder is their nemesis.
Trails of golden electric arcs appeared across the Two-tailed Fox Demon's body, causing its demonic power to greatly diminish again, and its second tail began to regress. Fear appeared on its face as it transformed into a pink shadow and shot toward Huan Ling Zi's Spiritual Beast Bag.
However, the void in front of it fluctuated, and the Soul Destroying Sword materialized out of thin air, descending in a slash above its head.
The Two-tailed Fox Demon was greatly startled and tried to dodge, but suddenly its vision plunged into endless darkness. Its sense of smell, hearing, and Divine Sense were all severed, transforming it into a complete blind and deaf creature.
The black Sword Shadow fell upon the head of the Two-tailed Fox Demon, cleaving it in half, and blood mixed with red and white contents splattered.
Controlled by the Annihilation Rune of the Soul Destroying Sword, the Two-tailed Fox Demon was unable to cast its tail-breaking replacement death divine power in time. Its Divine Soul was annihilated by the Soul Destroying Sword, completely falling.
"Three tails!" Huan Ling Zi cried out in shock and anger.
The Three-tailed Demon Fox was his most capable spirit beast. On Kongling Island, there was a Secret Technique that could temporarily fuse the demonic power of the illusion fox with the Soul Power of Kongling Island's cultivators to enhance the power of illusion techniques, quite similar to the Golden Sunflower Beast Taming Technique.
Huan Ling Zi was renowned partly because of the Three-tailed Demon Fox and this secret technique. Just now, it was by leveraging this method that he had temporarily dragged Yuan Ming into an illusion.
Now that the Three-tailed Demon Fox had been slain, his divine powers were directly halved, and he was unable to explain himself to both the Kongling Island Master and the Illusion Fox Clan.
"You treacherous thief, how dare you kill my spirit beast!" Huan Ling Zi's eyes were blood-red as he flipped his hand and brought out that cyan lamp, which hovered mid-air.
The cyan flame expanded, turning into a cyan fireball ten feet in diameter, resembling a mini sun as it rolled toward Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming's expression was indifferent as he waved his hand and summoned a black screen—it was the Night Parade of Hundred Demons.
The screen instantly expanded tenfold and collided with the cyan fireball.
Huan Ling Zi, upon seeing this scene, was not alarmed but pleased.
The cyan fireball was no ordinary fire-based divine power; the wick of this cyan lamp was made from refining the essence of a fox tail from a Level 4 Six-tailed Demon Fox, containing powerful illusion power. Coupled with his use of the Empty Illusion Reincarnation Skill to activate it, the cyan fox fire could easily infiltrate within a magic treasure, seizing control of it.
This black screen flickered with incredibly strong mana fluctuations, even greater than those of the cyan lamp. If he could take control of it, it would somewhat compensate for the loss of the Three-tailed Demon Fox.
Upon this thought, Huan Ling Zi used all of his mana to pour into the cyan lamp. The cyan fireball grew by another thirty percent, and the moment it touched the Night Parade of Hundred Demons, the immense fireball transformed into a cyan shadow and merged into the screen.
"I have it now!" Huan Ling Zi flew toward it with joy, a large cyan hand reaching out for the Night Parade of Hundred Demons.
A Black Robed Elder burst out from the Night Parade of Hundred Demons, wielding a black cane—it was the Heavenly Ghost Wanderer. With one strike from his black cane in mid-air, he shattered the large cyan hand.
The black cane then shot out, turning into a dark flood dragon enveloped by surging black mist. The dragon's massive claws lunged forward, aiming for Huan Ling Zi.
The dark light on the Night Parade of Hundred Demons flickered slightly, appearing completely unaffected just as before.
"How is this possible!" Huan Ling Zi was shocked. His cyan fireball had always been infallible in seizing magic treasures, yet it had failed.
The sharp claws of the dark flood dragon descended from above, their fierce wind tearing through his clothes and causing blood to gush from his chest.
Huan Ling Zi abruptly came back to his senses and pointed at the cyan lamp above.
The cyan flame burst with a pop, flickering intensely and Huan Ling Zi's figure disappeared in an instant; he reappeared several feet away, easily dodging the dark flood dragon's attack.
However, unaware to Huan Ling Zi, the dark flood dragon changed its course and dove toward the mid-air cyan lamp, biting it firmly. Strands of green light shot from the dragon's body, merging into the lamp.
The spirit light of the cyan lamp was rapidly sullied by the green strands, leaving it immobilized.
The dark flood dragon turned and flew back, landing in the hands of the Heavenly Ghost Wanderer and disappearing into the Night Parade of Hundred Demons with him.
This series of swift changes happened as quickly as lightning, and before Huan Ling Zi could react, the cyan lamp had vanished without a trace.
In a hurry, he attempted to summon the lamp using a spell, but there was no response; it seemed to be thoroughly sealed, and he stood there dumbfounded.First seen on *.
"If I were you, with neither illusion techniques nor magic treasures working, I'd have taken my own life long ago to save myself the embarrassment," Yuan Ming said, looking at Huan Ling Zi with a mocking smile on his lips.
"You... I'll put an end to this!" Bloodshot with rage and like a starving wolf driven to desperation, Huan Ling Zi roared as he lunged forward in a life-and-death struggle with Yuan Ming.
After all, Huan Ling Zi was a Late-stage Core Formation Cultivator. Yuan Ming recalled the Soul Destroying Sword and the Thunder God Hammer, readying himself for the confrontation.
Yet, unexpectedly, Huan Ling Zi spun around and fled without hesitation.
As he flew, he tore open his clothes, bit his fingertip, and pressed it against his chest.
A palm-sized Golden Light Talisman was hidden on his chest. As his blood touched the talisman, a beam of golden light emerged, wrapping his body within it.
With a "whoosh," the golden light took him into the swamp, and in the blink of an eye, he was gone without a trace.
Yuan Ming was surprised but then nodded slightly.
Having lost his magic treasure and spirit beast, Huan Ling Zi's strength had diminished greatly. Although his actions seemed cowardly, they were not without reason.
Yuan Ming didn't rush to pursue. During their brief clash, he had already secretly marked Huan Ling Zi. Whenever he wished, he could find his location. There was no urgency at this moment.
With a wave of his hand, the cyan lamp flew out from the Night Parade of Hundred Demons.
The cyan fireball's technique of seizing others' treasures with illusion power was indeed extraordinary, but within the Night Parade of Hundred Demons hid the All Living Beings Dream Rune, any divine illusion technique that entered it was irretrievable and ineffective.
The flame on the cyan lamp had returned to its normal size, with the spirit light behaving obediently. It had been infiltrated by the All Living Beings' Dream illusion power, thoroughly erasing the mark of Huan Ling Zi's consciousness left inside it.
Yuan Ming looked at the lamp, a trace of joy on his face.
This lamp was also a Nine Rune Magical Treasure, its spiritual power fluctuations were not less than those of the Thunder God Hammer, and it could better support the casting of illusions, making it more valuable.
Yuan Ming attempted to inject his mana into the lamp to imprint his consciousness and completely subdue it, but repeatedly failed.
At the core of the cyan lamp's rune formation seemed to be a force preventing him.

chapters.title: Chapter 508 - 484: Escape
chapters.content:
"Kongling Island is not only adept at Illusion Techniques, but also has a unique secret skill in refining Magic Treasures. To prevent some important treasures from being stolen, they set Forbidden seals using a special technique called the Heart-lock Seal. If you want to refine this lamp, it's going to take quite some effort," Xi Ying's voice sounded in the Sea of Consciousness.
Yuan Ming nodded slightly and put away the green oil lamp.
He looked around and flew toward the distance, quickly reaching the other side of the Swamp.
Long Chong, Qiong Yun, and Wulu, along with Yun Jiuxiao, were intensely clashing at that location.
Having just escaped the illusion, Long Chong and another had been sent by Yuan Ming to hold off Yun Jiuxiao's group, preventing them from interfering with his confrontation against Huan Ling Zi. He had not immediately pursued Huan Ling Zi because he was concerned about the situation with Long Chong.
It seemed that Yun Jiuxiao's group had not noticed Huan Ling Zi fleeing, and they continued their fierce battle, each summoning their spirit beasts.
Among them, Qiong Yun's spirit beast was a Thunder Flood Dragon, which greatly resembled the Winter Flood Dragon summoned by Long Chong, except its scales were adorned with purple thunder patterns, and its twin horns resembled purple crystals, constantly flickering with electric light.
Yun Jiuxiao's Three-eyed Octopus was also extraordinary; it could spray a large amount of black ink, which possessed strong Sealing capabilities, even capable of sealing the attacks of Qiong Yun's Thunder Flood Dragon.
Compared to them, Mi Luo's Poisonous Toad and Wulu's Blood Crocodile appeared fairly ordinary, with no particular features worth mentioning.
However, from Winter Crystal Island, the Immortal Bing Xin's summoned spirit beast was an Ice Spirit Qishou, covered in Frost Scale Ice Horns, with four jade-like hooves treading on clouds of snow, causing snowflakes to fall around it during battle.
This beast was said to contain the bloodline of the ancient Frost Qi Lin and had reached the Third-level Middle Stage in strength, proving to be an equal match for Long Chong's Winter Flood Dragon.
However, even though the spirit beasts were similarly matched in strength and possessed numerical superiority, Yun Jiuxiao's group did not gain the upper hand.
Long Chong and Qiong Yun were a notch higher in cultivation than the four, and having been tricked by Huan Ling Zi in front of Yuan Ming, they were filled with shame and anger, looking to save face; thus, every move they made was full-hearted, even willing to trade blow for blow.
In contrast, Yun Jiuxiao's group was restrained, unable to fully display their strength, and were forced to keep retreating.
In the battlefield, Wulu was undoubtedly the most leisurely one; although he put on a troubled front, in reality, he was muddling his way through.Enjoying the story? Discover more on *.
His summoned spirit beast, the Blood Crocodile, also appeared to be the most fierce, but whenever the Winter Flood Dragon or Thunder Flood Dragon launched a harsh move, it happened to push others forward, allowing other creatures to bear the brunt.
It can be said, the awkwardness of the other three, in part, owed to Wulu's efforts.
Yuan Ming's arrival quickly caught his attention, yet he remained unsurprised. After noticing Yuan Ming, he simply nodded slightly and then subtly signaled with his eyes, seemingly asking if he should cooperate with Yuan Ming to capture the three from Yun Jiuxiao.
Yuan Ming pondered briefly but gently shook his head and revealed his figure, invoking his Mana and declared loudly, "Huan Ling Zi has been defeated. Yun Jiuxiao, do you wish to follow in his footsteps, or will you surrender now?"
His voice resonated around, causing Yun Jiuxiao's group's hearts to tremble simultaneously, and they all turned their heads to look. Seeing him unharmed and flying in the sky, their faces flashed with shock.
Yun Jiuxiao immediately ceased fighting, recalled his spirit beast Mo Zhang, and, with a forced smile, saluted towards Yuan Ming:
"Fellow Daoist Yuan is astute. We were also compelled by Huan Ling Zi to come here, forced to obey him. Now that you have defeated him, we naturally have no reason to fight. We are willing to surrender; may we ask for a chance to live?"
Immortal Bing Xin and Mi Luo also hurriedly made a salute.
They were not willingly following Huan Ling Zi but were forcibly conscripted in the name of Kongling Island. The four came from Second-level Island, where they would not dare to provoke Kongling Island.
Since only Thousand Dragon Island and Red Rain Island were First-level Islands which they dared not offend, they could only lower their stance as much as possible, hoping to escape the ordeal.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming did not respond but looked towards Long Chong and the other.
"Brother Long, Miss Qiong, what do you think?"
"We can stop fighting, but you assisted Huan Ling Zi in ambushing me and Qiong Yun. I will not forget this. After leaving the Secret Realm, I must personally visit each of your islands for a thorough lesson," Long Chong said, anger burning within him.
Yun Jiuxiao's group's faces instantly turned as unsightly as if they had swallowed excrement. After exchanging glances, hesitating for a long time, Yun Jiuxiao was the first to speak, "Fellow Daoist Long, we were wrong. After leaving the Secret Realm, each of our families will offer up 100,000 Spirit Stones as compensation. Will this satisfy you?"
"Do you think my Thousand Dragon Island lacks those Spirit Stones?" Long Chong scoffed coldly.
Yun Jiuxiao's group's expressions stiffened, and they could only secretly discuss compensation details among themselves.
Long Chong ignored them and flew next to Yuan Ming, asking:
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, although Huan Ling Zi was not powerful, that Illusion Technique of his was incredibly difficult to break, almost making him unbeatable. How did you manage to force him to flee?"
Just as Yuan Ming was about to answer, he suddenly heard a thunderous booming sound coming from above.
"Moo"
Before the sound ended, several similar deep tones followed, emerging from the toxic clouds above everyone's heads.
The thick toxic cloud churned like ocean waves, with bursts of pale blue spirit light lighting up like lightning intermittently, revealing the silhouettes of a group of giant beasts.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming's eyes twitched, and he immediately had a bad feeling. He quickly said:
"This place is not suitable to stay long; we should first..."
But before he could finish, another even louder moo, like muffled thunder, exploded above their heads.
Through the rolling poisonous clouds, two five-foot-long blue ox horns broke through, full of cracks with a pale blue spirit light emerging from within, resembling patterns.
Following the horns, a huge ox head, pieced together from blue Crystal Stone, emerged, its eyes like copper bells without pupils but flickering with pale blue ghostly light.
"Intruders!"
The ox head, seeing Yuan Ming and the others, actually spoke human language and let out a thunderous roar that echoed through the heavens.
Immediately after, one after another, tall blue monstrous oxen charged out of the poisonous clouds, each one ten yards in length, far outnumbering Yuan Ming and the others, without mention.
Although these monstrous oxen had no fluctuations in demonic power, they were huge in stature and possessed startling strength; they were clearly not to be trifled with. The rumbling sound of their hooves, like thunder and ocean waves, made even the ground beneath the people tremble.
Seeing this, everyone's countenance changed simultaneously. Without a word, they all turned and fled.
These blue monstrous oxen were extremely large yet their speed was not slow, relentlessly chasing behind Yuan Ming and the others.
"These monstrous oxen are flickering with starlight; could they be Starry Sky Beasts?" Yuan Ming thought to himself.
"No, what is happening here! Quick, save me!" Just then, Mi Luo, who was lagging behind everyone else, shouted in terror.
Everyone looked back and saw Mi Luo's face vein-popped, he frantically formed spell signs, trying to summon tunneling light to escape from the blue monstrous oxen. Though his body moved forward, he slowly retreated inch by inch as if being dragged backward by something, flying towards the monstrous oxen.
At the same time, Yuan Ming suddenly glimpsed one of the blue monstrous oxen opening its mouth wide and inhaling sharply towards Mi Luo; its mouth was pitch black, like a void, void of teeth, lips, or even a throat.
And at that moment, the other blue monstrous oxen also began to open their mouths.
Yuan Ming immediately felt a bizarre sucking force coming from behind, similar but lighter to the force he felt while flying across the continent, without the massive weight pressing on his shoulders.
Yuan Ming grabbed the Thunder God Hammer and struck backward.
A blade-shaped thunder surged backward, striking one blue monstrous ox on the head.
A burst of dazzling thunder exploded, and the blue monstrous ox was repelled, the bizarre sucking force disappearing with it.
Seeing this, the others turned around and began manipulating their Magic Treasures, releasing spells at the blue monstrous oxen behind them.
Mi Luo, in particular, exerted himself greatly; he was next to the blue monstrous oxen and it was a critical moment.
His Magical Treasure was a green poisoned fork, from which he immediately spewed a four-colored poisonous mist, rolling towards the Meteorite Iron beasts. His spirit pet, the Poisonous Toad, suddenly exploded its fist-sized poison cysts on its back, spraying out a foul-smelling Poisonous Slime that mixed with the poison mist and attacked.
However, the poison mist and slime, which could corrode iron and dissolve gold, merely left a small dent when they hit the blue monstrous oxen.
The green poisoned fork did leave three feet-long gashes on the monstrous oxen, but a blue light flashed from the wound, and strands of starlight fell from the torn poisonous clouds.
The wounds of the blue monstrous oxen healed instantly as if they had never been hurt, showing no effect on their movements as they snapped one of Mi Luo's arms in their vast mouths.
Mi Luo's expression turned ashen. However, he remained calm, his body shimmering in golden light as he donned a full set of golden armor that appeared indestructible.
Yet, with one snap, the blue monstrous ox bit down, breaking off the golden armor and Mi Luo's right arm in one go, blood spraying everywhere.
"Ah!" Mi Luo screamed, quickly retracting the golden armor and dashing forward to escape.
Yuan Ming's expression was grave; these blue monstrous oxen were not only amazingly resilient but also immensely strong, making them difficult to handle.
The group fled for a while longer, but gradually they were caught up due to the disturbing sucking force of the monstrous oxen.
With his injuries, Mi Luo was the first to falter. He was pulled to the side of a monstrous ox, which suddenly closed its mouth and lowered its head, aiming its dual horns at Mi Luo and charging fiercely.
Panicking, Mi Luo quickly took out a Jade Ring Magical Treasure and fiercely activated it, hurling it at the monstrous ox to block the attack, but then he heard a "crack!" The Jade Ring shattered on impact with the horn, not even managing to block for an instant.
His body was instantly pierced by the ox's horns, but this strike was not fatal. He wailed as the ox lifted him over its head with its horns, and the nearby oxen squeezed in, opening their mouths wide to bite.
In the blink of an eye, Mi Luo was swallowed up by the herd, only to re-emerge as a blur of blood and flesh.
Seeing Mi Luo devoured, everyone trembled in their hearts, hurriedly deploying more techniques to fend off the monstrous oxen and buying time for their escape.

chapters.title: Chapter 509 - 485 Little Huazhi's Clone
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming's situation wasn't any better, as he was entangled by several blue demon beasts.
Two of the demon beasts opened their mouths to suck him in, with two streams of force enveloping his body.
Yuan Ming had already cut off his connection with Lei Yu. Lei Yu was no Xiao Hua; during the previous exchange with Huan Ling Zi, Lei Yu had appeared only for a moment and was still poisoned. At the moment, Lei Yu was in the Spiritual Beast Bag, refining the potent poison.
Without the assistance of Lei Yu's demonic power, Yuan Ming's magic practitioner strength declined significantly, and he found himself involuntarily flying backward.
Several other demon beasts pounced at him, with their thick and sharp horns aiming at his body.
"Master, be careful!" Xiao Hua shrieked in alarm.
However, Yuan Ming didn't panic and brought out a silver banner.
In the bright silver radiance, the banner unfurled in the wind, transforming into a giant silver flag that entwined around him.
The blue demon beasts' horns struck the large silver flag, creating a harsh scraping noise. They immediately shifted aside and did not harm Yuan Ming.
Nonetheless, Yuan Ming, along with the flag, was still knocked backward, and more demon beasts closed in on him.
Yuan Ming didn't have time to think too much. His Soul Power whirled in his Sea of Consciousness and, unnoticed by others, he fired a Crow's Call Wave from his forehead, hitting a nearby demon beast.
But in the next instant, he witnessed a scene that greatly surprised him.
The black sound waves penetrated the demon beast's body, yet the creature didn't show the slightest change in movement; not even an instant's pause in stiffness.
Yuan Ming couldn't believe it. With his current Divine Soul strength, the Crow Caw Illusion Technique he used would have affected a Nascent Soul cultivator or an equivalent level Soul Cultivator. Yet these blue demon beasts seemed unaffected.
"Be careful, these demon beasts don't have Divine Souls. Your illusion techniques have no effect on them!" Xi Ying suddenly warned from within the Sea of Consciousness.
Yuan Ming also noticed this. There were no Divine Soul fluctuations on these demon beasts, they were like puppets.
"Incredibly strong and capable of immediate recovery even after being wounded, and not fearing Divine Soul attacks. It seems that these demon beasts are undoubtedly Starry Sky Beasts; no wonder Luu Changkong said that it's impossible to fight against these things, one can only flee!" Yuan Ming's expression turned grave as he swung the Thunder God Hammer to collide head-on with one of the Starry Sky demon beasts.
The Starry Sky demon beast's head was smashed in half, but Yuan Ming was also sent flying. However, this also enabled him to escape the encirclement of the other demon beasts.
"Everyone, these demon beasts are likely the Starry Sky Beasts mentioned by Elder Luu. We cannot fight directly against them. First, we must join forces to drive them back, then scatter and flee!" Yuan Ming shouted loudly, channeling Mana into the Thunder God Hammer, releasing the power of thunder and lightning accumulated within it.
Scores of branches of lightning burst forth, creating a forest of thunder and lightning that struck among the group of Starry Sky demon beasts. Each bolt of lightning emitted a frightening presence.
Explosions of thunder sounded, the ground was blasted with charred craters and a dozen or more demon beasts were flung away.
Long Chong held his Frost Long Spear in front of him, eyes slightly closed, reciting spell incantations. His arms crossed and hands formed a peculiar Dharma Seal, channeling the Mana throughout his body into the spear. Meanwhile, the Winter Flood Dragon at his side spat out frost, coating the spear with a thick layer of frost.
First publishеd оn М|V|L!ЕМРYR.
He suddenly opened his eyes, and the long spear in front of him burst out with a pure white spirit light, and in the next instant, like a javelin, it shot toward the herd of beasts.
The Frost Long Spear arrived in a flash, piercing directly through the bodies of three Starry Sky demon beasts, freezing them into ice sculptures.
Then, the bodies of the demon beasts suddenly exploded, turning into countless ice cones that shot towards their companions, filled with bone-chilling frost that turned half of their bodies white.
The others also made their moves, with ice blades and bolts of thunder striking the herd.
Nearly half of the Starry Sky demon beasts were sent flying, throwing the herd into chaos.
The group hurriedly took the chance to shake off the Starry Sky demon beasts and scattered to flee.
Seeing their prey escape, the Starry Sky demon beasts were enraged and immediately gave chase.
The group barely escaped from a dead end, ignoring the poisonous cloud within the swamp, they used all their might to fly away, distancing themselves from the Starry Sky demon beasts.
Yuan Ming was one of the fastest fleeing, and although the sky above the swamp was covered with poison clouds, he could only fly at low altitude.
Yuan Ming utilized the Golden Sunflower Beast Taming Technique, merging it with Xiao Hua's demonic power, raising his Mana to a late-stage Core Formation level, and advanced using the Ghost Shadow Escape Technique.
Although he hadn't practiced this escape skill to a profound level, with the foundation of late-stage Core Formation Mana, he was still faster than the others. He soon left the pursuing demon beasts far behind, able to see only a shadow.
Yuan Ming pushed his speed to the limit, preparing to completely shake off the Starry Sky demon beasts.
Just at that moment, the poison clouds overhead dispersed, and countless stars began to fall like rain, with star rain pouring down.
The Starry Sky demon beasts behind him cried out excitedly. Their bodies glowed with bursts of starlight as they greedily absorbed the falling stars, and their speed increased significantly.
"Star rain at a time like this..." Yuan Ming's face turned somber, summoning a shield Magic Treasure to fend off the star rain, his escape speed greatly reduced.
With the gap closing rapidly due to this disparity, Yuan Ming's mind raced for a strategy.
"Master, I'm ready," the voice of Lei Yu came from the Spiritual Beast Bag.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming breathed a sigh of relief and immediately summoned Lei Yu to his back.
The protective range of the shield Magic Treasure expanded several times, covering Lei Yu as well, but the speed at which the starlight eroded it increased greatly.
Yuan Ming didn't mind; after the battle in the Shura Palace, he had obtained numerous Magic Treasures, so losing a few was of no concern.
"Master, relying solely on Lei Yu may not be secure. I'll help out as well and hold down these Starry Sky Beasts from underground, buying you some time," Xiao Hua said, seeing Yuan Ming increasingly relying on Lei Yu and seemingly afraid of being neglected, she volunteered eagerly.
"These Starry Sky Beasts do not have the ability to tunnel through the earth, so striking from below is indeed viable, but there's a star rain falling outside, which will also cause you considerable harm," Yuan Ming pondered before speaking.
"Master doesn't need to worry about that, my strongest ability is regeneration, I will only lose some primordial energy at most," Hua Zhi replied.
"Then please take care, don't overexert yourself, and if things get tricky, tunnel underground and escape immediately," Yuan Ming instructed.
Hua Zhi nodded, a green light flashed over its body, and its figure actually split into two, creating a slightly smaller Hua Zhi.
"This Clone Divine Ability?" Yuan Ming asked curiously.
"Hmm, after my breakthrough to Level 3, my ability to split my body has become more and more exquisite, and I've recently comprehended this cloning ability. This clone contains part of my demonic power and can withstand the poison mist for you for a while," Hua Zhi explained.
After saying this, Hua Zhi plummeted down, burrowing into the ground.
Yuan Ming, through the Divine Sense of his first soul, sensed Hua Zhi's condition; star rain was permeating the depths of the earth, affecting even the deep underground.
However, Hua Zhi's strong regenerative ability came into effect, immediately healing the inflicted damage, although its demonic power was being continuously consumed.
Yuan Ming breathed a sigh of relief and combined the Beast Taming Technique of the Golden Sunflower with Lei Yu's demonic powers.
Lei Yu spread its wings outward, shooting arcs of electricity that transformed into a thunder shadow, moving forward at a speed several times faster than before, disappearing into the fog in the blink of an eye.
"Roar..." The pursuing Starry Sky Beasts behind them were a mix of shock and anger as they forcefully gave chase.
At that moment, dozens of purple-black vines burst from the ground, entangling the legs of the Starry Sky Beasts.
The Starry Sky Beasts struggled vigorously; with their immense strength, they soon tore through the vines and cleared them away.
However, the Hua Zhi underground repeated its tactics, using wave after wave of vine attacks, successfully holding several beasts in place and preventing them from moving forward.
The Starry Sky Beasts were raging like thunder without a way to overcome the obstruction.
Yuan Ming flew ahead for thirty minutes, completely losing the Starry Sky Beasts that were trailing him, and finally stopped as the star rain also began to cease slowly.
He placed Lei Yu into the Spiritual Beast Bag and sent a message to Hua Zhi for regrouping, then hovered in mid-air, quietly waiting.
A quarter of an hour later, the ground beneath him suddenly cracked open, and Hua Zhi emerged.
"Master! I have returned!"
Yuan Ming inquired, "You've worked hard, did you encounter any trouble?"
"No, that bunch of dumb bulls were really stupid; they only knew that the vines were blocking the path but didn't realize I was the one casting them. Until the end, they never found my location. After a standstill for a while, the dumb bulls gave up the chase and returned the way they came," Hua Zhi reported.
Yuan Ming nodded his head. Were the Starry Sky Beasts alarmed by us? Or did they come searching for us on purpose?
He pondered for a while but was unable to come to a conclusion.
"Eh, your demonic power doesn't seem to have weakened? You withstood the erosion of the star rain without harm?" Yuan Ming suddenly noticed something unusual about Hua Zhi and asked in surprise.
He had previously used the Divine Sense of his first soul to view Hua Zhi's side, and the star rain had indeed caused it substantial harm.
"Of course not, this damned star rain cost me a third of my demonic power, but on my way here, I encountered a Level 3 Lizard Demon Beast and casually killed and devoured it, which is how my power recovered," Hua Zhi said.
Yuan Ming realized the situation and felt quite envious of Hua Zhi's devouring ability.
"I must obtain the complete version of the Golden Sunflower Beast Taming Technique!" he clenched his fist in secret.
"Speaking of which, master, when I killed that Lizard Demon Beast, I came across a strange place, do you want to check it out?" Hua Zhi suddenly asked.
"What place?" Yuan Ming looked over.
"It seems to be a pond surrounded by an exceptionally rich poison mist, where the nature's spiritual energy is also very dense, as if it's hiding some Heavenly Materials and Earthly Treasures. I wanted to explore it, but as soon as I approached, I felt dizzy and quickly retreated," Hua Zhi said, still feeling the aftereffects.
"Is that so?" Yuan Ming's curiosity was piqued, and he asked Hua Zhi to lead the way.
They soon arrived at the site; the dense poison mist formed a thick fog wall, blocking their path, with the faint sound of flowing water coming from beyond.
Yuan Ming looked puzzled, as this place exerted an unusually strong suppression on his Divine Sense, limiting the reach of his original body's Divine Sense to just over thirty feet.
He sent down the Divine Sense of his first soul to investigate the situation and quickly made some discoveries.
Beneath this area lay a substantial amount of mineral veins, more abundant than other places, which was why the effects of the natural formation had increased to such an extent.
The reason Hua Zhi felt dizzy upon arriving here was also the intensified effect of the natural formation.
As for the situation behind the fog wall, Yuan Ming had also probed clearly: there really was a pond, but the water was purple-black with occasional viscous bubbles rising—a complete poison pond. The nearby ground was also corrupted into a pitch-black hue.
Nestled in the depths of the pond was a purple lizard with a five-colored comb on its head, resembling a bloated rooster.
The Lizard Demon Beast might look ugly, but its strength was formidable, having reached the third-level peak; it seemed to be slightly superior to the Three-eyed Crow and was just half a step away from Level 4.
This lizard was squatting on a several-foot-large, round and smooth purple object, surrounded by scattered demon beast bones—possibly remnants of what the Lizard Demon Beast had devoured.
The purple object, which looked like a big, round stone, was actually alive and breathing; its body expanded and contracted slowly with every breath.
