chapters.title: Chapter 510 - 486: Deadly Treasure
chapters.content:
A faint purple mist slowly released with each breath.
The lizard demon beast exhaled a fist-sized, five-colored orb, which floated before it, seeming to be its Demon Core.
The five-colored Demon Core was absorbing the purple haze emitted by the purple substance, the mist ethereal and seemingly beautiful.
"What a treasure," Yuan Ming muttered, his eyes lighting up.
"Master, what did you say? Have you already scouted out the situation behind the fog wall?" Hua Zhi asked.
"Yes." Yuan Ming didn't hide anything and described what he had seen.
"This is Purple Extreme Tai Sui!" Before Hua Zhi could reply, Xi Ying in the Stealing Heaven Tripod exclaimed excitedly.
"Purple Extreme Tai Sui? Are you referring to the purple substance?" Yuan Ming asked.
"Exactly, this object has long been extinct in the outside world. It's unexpected to find it here. I must say, your luck is quite good," Xi Ying said cheerfully.
"Xi Ying, what exactly is this thing?" Yuan Ming asked, puzzled.
"You might have heard of 'Tai Sui' before?" Xi Ying said with a serious expression.
"I've heard a bit; it's a special species that lies between plants and animals, similar to mushrooms and wood ear, without recognition or consciousness, yet it can grow rapidly," Yuan Ming said.
"Right, Purple Extreme Tai Sui is also a type of Tai Sui, but quite different from the usual ones. Its body has completely transformed into flesh and can devour various things, such as the flesh of demon beasts, Spirit Grass, and even some minerals to extract nutrients and grow," Xi Ying explained.
"This doesn't sound all that extraordinary; there must be some other Divine Skills it has that excite you so," Yuan Ming interjected, curious.
"Indeed, Purple Extreme Tai Sui likes to consume poisonous objects and then merge various poisons into a new lethal poison, hence it is also known as Ten Thousand Poison Tai Sui. Each Purple Extreme Tai Sui is a treasure trove of deadly poisons. As long as it is continuously fed with poisonous items, it can continuously produce various kinds of deadly toxins. For cultivators who practice poisonous divine powers, the Purple Extreme Tai Sui is an irreplaceable gem," Xi Ying explained.
Upon hearing this, a hint of joy appeared in Yuan Ming's eyes.
Although he wasn't proficient in poisonous divine powers, Hua Zhi contained poison, and the Purple Extreme Tai Sui should prove useful for him.
Even if Hua Zhi couldn't use it, the value of Purple Extreme Tai Sui was immensely high; a slice of its flesh could sell for a high price.
Although Hua Zhi hadn't heard the conversation between Yuan Ming and Xi Ying, it was also very interested in the situation inside the pond; however, recalling past lessons, it dared not rashly enter the fog wall.
"Master, what do you plan to do? Your Divine Soul Power is far stronger than mine; perhaps it can resistant the environment inside the fog wall," Hua Zhi looked toward Yuan Ming.
"You stay here and watch over things; I'll be right back," Yuan Ming said and then flew off into the distance.
Without any doubts, Hua Zhi stayed put and split into two clones, each patrolling one side of the poisonous fog wall.
Yuan Ming flew several hundred yards, took off the Spiritual Beast Bag containing the Three-eyed Crow, dropped it on the ground, and then directly entered the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space, leaving the Stealing Heaven Tripod's main body crashing into the bushes.
He sat on the White Jade Lotus Platform; powerful soul force at the level of Sleeping Witch surged through the anchor point of desire power of the Three-eyed Crow, enveloping the lizard demon beast.
The lizard demon beast screamed, paralyzed under Yuan Ming's overpowering soul force, its body trembling uncontrollably, attempting to resist, but utterly no match against Yuan Ming's soul oppression.
"I am the Nether Moon God, submit to me, believe in me, and I can grant you unimaginable benefits and power!" An imposing voice echoed within the soul of the lizard demon beast.
The soul of the lizard demon beast trembled wildly, like a candle in the wind, almost extinguishing at any moment.
However, the inherent wildness and stubbornness of the demon beast made it refuse without hesitation.
Yuan Ming wasn't surprised; he employed illusion techniques to torment the beast's soul, either morphing into a huge beast to battle with the lizard demon beast or directly manifested the image of the Nether Moon God to suppress the creature.
Yuan Ming's Dream Butterfly Illusion Technique had already reached the Mirage Realm level; coupled with Sleeping Witch level soul power, the lizard demon beast was in agonizing pain, its wildness constantly waning.
After a short time, the beast finally cried out in submission, and a stream of thick desire power was sent out.
A smile appeared on Yuan Ming's lips, not just because he had subdued this lizard demon beast, but also because he had discovered an excellent method of gaining believers.
This secret realm, isolated from the world, provided a relatively safe environment for the demon beasts residing here; he could gather them in large numbers to increase his own power of desire.
The only concern was whether the desire power of the demon beasts here could still be transmitted outside once he left the secret realm.
Yuan Ming shook his head and stopped pondering these matters, ordering the lizard demon beast to bring the Purple Extreme Tai Sui outside.
Upon hearing the command, the lizard demon beast evidently reluctantly wavered in its faith.
"It seems this lizard isn't too dumb; it knows the value of the Purple Extreme Tai Sui and has been using it to enhance its strength. Don't worry, the Purple Extreme Tai Sui has a strong reproduction ability. Command that lizard to bring out mostly everything, leave it a small portion, and it can regrow," Xi Ying said.
Following the advice, Yuan Ming instructed the lizard demon beast and flicked his finger.
A black Sword Qi shot out from the void above the Purple Extreme Tai Sui, slicing it into two parts, one large and one small.
A large amount of purple liquid flowed out, resembling fresh blood.
The Lizard Demon Beast quickly opened its mouth and sucked away all the liquid, leaving not a single drop behind.
The wound of the Purple Extreme Tai Sui quickly moved, and the purple liquid soon ceased to flow.
The Lizard Demon Beast picked up most of the Tai Sui and stealthily approached the surface of the water, quickly passing through the wall of poison fog.
Hua Zhi's expression changed drastically upon seeing the Lizard Demon Beast, and she was about to make a move immediately.
"Hua Zhi, stop your hand, this beast is one of us," Yuan Ming's voice resounded in Hua Zhi's mind, causing her movements to pause.
The Lizard Demon Beast didn't even glance at Hua Zhi, set down the Purple Extreme Tai Sui on the ground, and turned back to the poison fog wall.
Yuan Ming's expression was slightly joyful as he left the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space and quickly arrived before the wall of poison fog.
"Master, what just happened?" Hua Zhi quickly asked.
Yuan Ming didn't rush to explain and approached the Purple Extreme Tai Sui.
The creature had completely recovered, transformed into a slightly smaller mass of flesh than before, and continued to lie on the ground, slowly swelling and shrinking.
"Although the Tai Sui is a creature between animal and plant, its spiritual intelligence is extremely low. As long as it's not starving, it will be too lazy to move," Xi Ying said.
Yuan Ming was somewhat speechless and took out a Spiritual Beast Bag to store the Tai Sui inside.
"It's nothing much, I was casting remotely and subdued that Lizard Demon Beast," he explained to Hua Zhi after doing all this.
Hua Zhi nodded, her expression still somewhat confused.
Yuan Ming also took out several pieces of poison-attribute spiritual materials from his body and threw them into the wall of poison fog, as a small compensation to the Lizard Demon Beast.
"Master, my clone has found someone approaching. It's Wulu, and he seems to be confronting Long Chong and Qiong Yun," Hua Zhi said, her expression shifting.
Yuan Ming breathed a sigh of relief upon hearing this. It was good that Long Chong and the others were alright; he then submerged himself in contemplation.
Wulu's purpose for entering the Secret Realm was unclear, but at least he harbored no ill will towards himself. Although he had only a shallow acquaintance with Long Chong and his group, their recent actions had won his favor. Now that the two parties were confronting each other, he couldn't stay out of it.
With this thought, he put away Hua Zhi and, following the direction she had mentioned, flew away.
Before long, in a clearing within the Swamp, Yuan Ming saw Long Chong and others.
Unexpectedly, Long Chong and Wulu were not confronting each other but seemed to be getting along quite well.
Upon seeing Yuan Ming arrive, Long Chong's eyes showed a pleased expression.
"That's great, Fellow Daoist Yuan, you also escaped safely."
"Although those Starry Sky Beasts are formidable, they are not very agile. Finding an opportunity to shake them off was not difficult," Yuan Ming explained briefly, turning his gaze towards Wulu.
Before he could speak, Wulu smiled and gave a salute, saying, "Fellow Daoist Yuan, the situation was pressing just now, and I offended you greatly. I hope you can forgive me."

"It's nothing, but Fellow Daoist Hong, why were you following Huan Ling Zi earlier, letting him command you?" Yuan Ming played along with Wulu, feigning curiosity.
Wulu sighed, looking somewhat helpless, "After entering the Secret Realm, I hadn't even managed to leave the initial large island when I was targeted by Huan Ling Zi, who forced me to serve him. Otherwise, he would have killed me on the spot. Under duress, I temporarily agreed. To control me, he planted a special Illusion Seed within me, which normally hides in the Sea of Consciousness and would explode as soon as he willed it, making me completely succumb to the illusion, leaving me no choice but to follow his commands."
"Oh, is that so? Now that Huan Ling Zi has been driven away, you don't have to worry about the Illusion Seed for the time being, but keeping it is still a hidden danger. I have some unique methods that can remove it," Yuan Ming inquired about Wulu's opinion.
Wulu quite trusted him: "Please, Fellow Daoist Yuan, proceed as you see fit."
Yuan Ming nodded, stepped forward, and placed his hand on Wulu's shoulder, muttering a spell while his body also flashed with spirit light. However, in reality, he was just extending his Soul Power-infused Divine Sense into Wulu's Sea of Consciousness, easily locating the Illusion Seed.
Qiong Yun watched the scene, a strange look flashing in her eyes.
"To a Cultivator, the Sea of Consciousness is second in importance only to the Golden Core. That Fellow Daoist Hong can be so trusting as to let Yuan Ming help remove the Illusion Seed shows that their relationship is not ordinary. Perhaps, he also knows Yuan Ming's true identity?" she quietly communicated to Long Chong.
"Well, everyone has a few trusted friends, and besides, Fellow Daoist Yuan came to our East Sea precisely to avoid disaster. It's not strange that he has old friends and close contacts," Long Chong was nonchalant.
Qiong Yun also felt that his words made sense and said no more.
A moment later, Yuan Ming withdrew his hand, suggesting, "I have helped you remove the Illusion Seed, but although that Huan Ling Zi escaped in a sorry state, his strength was not damaged. If Fellow Daoist Hong encounters him again, you might suffer. I think it's better if you join us from now on. Fellow Daoist Long, Fellow Daoist Qiong, what do you think?"
"Indeed, this Secret Realm is no safe place. It's too risky for Fellow Daoist Hong to venture alone," Long Chong agreed.
Having noticed that Wulu had not been putting much effort in their previous clashes, Long Chong clearly felt this and did not think poorly of him.
Wulu's eyes flickered for a moment before he nodded and accepted their invitation, "Very well, since my fellow daoists do not mind, I shall rely on you all for support."

chapters.title: Chapter 511 - 487: Star Tempering Body
chapters.content:
"We foreign cultivators, facing various dangers within this secret realm, should naturally join hands and help each other. Only those with narrow minds like Huan Ling Zi, who lack the ability to discern right from wrong, would create internal strife," Long Chong said with a laugh.
Wulu beamed a smile, about to say something, when he suddenly looked up into the sky.
The rest of the group also looked up in unison to see a solitary bright star in the sky, wobbling as if it was about to fall.
"Eh, the star rain just stopped not long ago, how can it start again? It's really troublesome! Brother Hong, we should use our magic treasures in turn to resist it, to minimize the losses. This way, although it will damage the treasures, at least it will save a talisman for emergency use," Long Chong clicked his tongue and then reminded Wulu.
Upon hearing this, a trace of hesitation flickered imperceptibly across Wulu's face.
Qiong Yun's brows furrowed slightly without a word.
Wulu had just joined their team and their relationship was still distant; she was not willing to use her magic treasures at the expense of protecting him.
Yuan Ming noticed this and wanted to lend Wulu a few low-level magic treasures that he didn't need, but he had only just met Wulu openly, so this seemed inappropriate.
"Brother Hong might not have many magic treasures, but I happen to have two spare items here which I can lend you first," Long Chong generously took out a pair of black short spears engraved with dragon patterns and a roll of snow-white silken scarf, and handed them over.
"Although I am poor, I cannot simply take Brother Long's magic treasures without due cause. Don't worry about me, fellows; I still have a few reserve magic treasures in hand. While they are not of the star attribute, they can still withstand a thing or two and won't be a burden to you three," Wulu hastily waved his hand in refusal, saying.
Hearing this, Long Chong and Qiong Yun didn't insist any further.
As they spoke, the star rain appeared in the sky again.
The stars fell like continuous raindrops, rapidly plummeting downward. After a brief discussion, the four of them decided on the order of their moves and then took out their magic treasures one by one, taking turns to resist the star rain, each sustaining only for fifteen minutes.
However, this time's star rain lasted much longer than the last, and all of their first magic treasures were completely eroded by the blue starlight and rendered useless, yet the star rain didn't stop.
Having no other choice, the four had to take out a second magic treasure to continue defending against the assault of the star rain.
The nearby flowers, grass, and trees, bathed in the sky full of star rain, seemed more vigorous than ever.
Yuan Ming had been wondering why the flowers, plants, and demon beasts within the secret realm, which seemed no different from those outside, were unhurt and even benefited from the star rain?
He controlled his first soul sitting on the White Jade Lotus Platform, descended his divine sense to investigate but came up empty. Suddenly, he remembered the lizard demon beast he had just subdued.
If he couldn't figure it out through investigation, perhaps the demon beasts of the secret realm knew something. It was worth asking.
The first soul looked for the Desire Power light of the lizard demon beast, but the creature had not made any wishes and thus could not communicate directly within the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
"A miscalculation, I should have directly implanted the Soul Descent Rune in that lizard demon beast," Yuan Ming muttered to himself in regret.
Luckily his current location was not far from the pond, and so the divine sense of his first soul spread out and quickly enveloped the lizard demon beast.
At that moment, the lizard demon beast, once again, spat out the Five-colored Demon Core and began absorbing the falling starlight.
"Master!"
Feeling Yuan Ming's divine sense, the lizard demon beast quickly ceased cultivating.
With its strength reaching the Third-level Peak, it had vast spiritual intelligence and was able to communicate via telepathy.
"Don't stop, continue cultivating. I just have something I need to confirm with you..." Yuan Ming voiced his confusion.
"Master, I do not know either. I have lived here since I was born, and ever since I had spiritual intelligence, the star rain has always been like this," the lizard demon beast replied.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming felt disappointed.
It seemed he might have been thinking too much. The lizard demon beast was born in this space and naturally would not be harmed by the star rain; there was no specific reason behind it.
"Have you encountered any peculiar events in all these years? Other than cultivating and hunting other demon beasts, anything that's inexplicable or without an apparent reason," Yuan Ming persisted inquiring, unwilling to give up.
"Peculiar events? None that I recall, but since I gained spiritual intelligence, every time I go to sleep, I dream of being in an endless starry sky. Does that count?" the lizard demon beast inquired.
"A dream..." Yuan Ming paused.
That did sound unusual, but it wasn't related to his current considerations.
Yuan Ming asked a few more questions to no avail, and then he withdrew his divine sense.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, it's your turn," Qiong Yun looked over as it was soon Yuan Ming's turn to take over the cooperation.
Currently, Long Chong was resisting the star rain, and the two black short spears engraved with dragon patterns that he would have lent to Wulu hovered in the air above their heads.
The short spears had expanded several times in size and were rapidly rotating, forming a black protective shield that blocked all the falling starlight.
However, the bodies of the short spears were already eroded by the starlight, and the black shield was growing thinner.
Yuan Ming gestured with his hand, and a purple spirit light instantly flew out, landing above everyone's head.
Long Chong and the other two looked up to see that Yuan Ming had brought out a purple spear engraved with nine dragons. As Yuan Ming performed the hand seals to activate it, the spear spun rapidly above their heads, transforming into a purple protective shield that enveloped everyone.
This spear was the Purple Star Nine Dragons Spear that Yuan Ming had procured a long time ago. At the time, before he had reached Core Formation, he had given the treasure to Vajra to use. Once he formed his Golden Core and had better magic treasures at his side, the Purple Star Nine Dragons Spear was returned to him, only after Vajra came into possession of the Three-pointed Two-bladed Saber.
Now possessing a multitude of magical treasures, Yuan Ming had long forgotten the Purple Star Nine Dragons Spear in a corner until the sight of Long Chong's dragon-engraved twin spears reminded him of its existence.
He had never refined the spear and wasn't familiar with its materials and runes, but since the Purple Star Nine Dragons Spear bore a character for 'star', it might contain a bit of star attribute, making it more durable than ordinary magic treasures.
Since he had not nurtured it, the energy fluctuations of the Purple Star Nine Dragons Spear weren't strong. When Long Chong and the others saw it, they simply thought Yuan Ming had pulled out another magic treasure and paid it no mind.
However, as they were about to look away, they saw the falling stars hit the purple protective shield, and in the blink of an eye, they completely dissolved. There was not even a hint of cyan spirit light left, let alone the bodies of the stars themselves.
Even Yuan Ming was taken aback by such a scene.
"Brother Yuan, where did you find this star treasure? Why does the Star Rain have such a weak effect on it? And since you had this treasure, why didn't you bring it out sooner?" Long Chong asked in astonishment.
"This magical treasure is something I stumbled upon years ago. Because it didn't match the attributes of the cultivation technique I practice, I've been keeping it in a storage magic tool. I didn't know it was so miraculous; otherwise, I wouldn't have wasted two other treasures," Yuan Ming replied.
Long Chong didn't inquire further and simply marveled at the appearance of the purple spear.
Yuan Ming's expression remained calm, but his heart was in turmoil. Controlling the Purple Star Nine Dragons Spear now, he felt more attuned than anyone else. The Star Rain that fell upon the spear not only didn't cause any erosion, but instead, all the starlight was absorbed by the spear, even slightly increasing its might.
"It seems I was too careless before. This Purple Star Nine Dragons Spear isn't a common Star Treasure," Yuan Ming thought silently.
He was about to refine the spear when he suddenly recalled the introduction of the Purple Star Nine Dragons Spear at the auction in Little Lake City years ago. It was the lifebound magical treasure of Long Xinghe, a rather famous Core Formation Stage cultivator from the East Sea, apparently related to a secret realm within the East Sea—could it be related to this place?
"Brother Long, have you ever heard of the name Long Xinghe?" Yuan Ming asked, turning toward Long Chong.
"Long Xinghe? Never heard of him. Who is that?" After reflecting for a moment, Long Chong responded with a shake of his head.
"Just an acquaintance from the East Sea. I suddenly thought of him and asked on a whim." Considering the spear might be related to the current secret realm, Yuan Ming spoke evasively.
Long Chong uttered an 'oh' and didn't dwell on it, but Qiong Yun gave Yuan Ming a skeptical look.
With the protection of the Purple Star Nine Dragons Spear, Long Chong and the others no longer needed to use their treasures in turns to withstand the Star Rain. Initially, Long Chong and Qiong Yun were worried that, even with minimal erosion, the spear would eventually reach its limit and they would have to replace Yuan Ming.
But Yuan Ming wanted to see if the spear would continue absorbing starlight and what changes might occur, so he politely declined their offer.
As time passed, there seemed to be no significant changes to the Purple Star Nine Dragons Spear; its spirit light grew brighter instead of dimmer, which reassured everyone, and they continuously praised Yuan Ming for his good fortune.
After half an hour, the Star Rain finally ceased.Alwаys rеаd frоm thе sоurсе: М|V|LЕ4МРYR.
Yuan Ming recalled the Purple Star Nine Dragons Spear and saw that its surface glowed with a subdued purple light, each scale of the nine dragons engraved on it twinkling with faint cyan starlight, as if reflecting a galaxy twinkling in the depths of the night sky.
When Yuan Ming touched the Purple Star Nine Dragons Spear, a surge of pure Star Power suddenly flowed from the spear into his body, integrating into his bones.
His entire skeleton glowed brightly, as if his bones were gemstones.
"What's happening?" Yuan Ming was startled.
But before he could investigate more closely, a crackling sound emanated from within his body, and fine cracks began to appear along every bone, including his skull.
Taken aback and bewildered, he was about to throw away the Purple Star Nine Dragons Spear when suddenly the fractures started to rapidly absorb the all-permeating Star Power in his body and began to heal swiftly.
Within a few breaths, all the cracks disappeared.
This series of changes happened so quickly that it wasn't until now that Yuan Ming fully processed what had occurred. He hurriedly performed an Inner Observation to check his bones and his expression shifted subtly.
The glowing cyan starlight had vanished, and his bones were now whiter and seemed to have a layer of shimmering translucence flowing over them, looking much tougher than before.
Upon meticulous examination, Yuan Ming confirmed that the density of all his bones had greatly increased, with the improvement nearly equaling a whole year's effect of the Incense Xiang Bone Forging Skill.
He was both shocked and delighted, as the absorbed Star Power had an amazing bone tempering effect!
And under the nourishment of the Star Power, he didn't feel any pain throughout the entire process.
At this rate, after a few more Star Rains, he could complete the transformation of his bones to reach the Iron Bone Realm, saving him two years of effort.
A glint of joy flashed in Yuan Ming's eyes as he turned to the other three and said, "Please wait a moment."
Long Chong and the others nodded in confusion, then watched as Yuan Ming sat down cross-legged, placing the Purple Star Nine Dragons Spear on his lap and began to refine it with hand seals.
The Purple Star Nine Dragons Spear contained five runes and was the most common type of Five Rune Magical Treasure. Its only special feature was that all five runes were Star Runes.
With Yuan Ming's cultivation level, it took less than thirty minutes to thoroughly refine the rune formation, causing the spearhead to shoot out a purple light nearly a zhang long.
Yuan Ming nodded slightly. Although the Purple Star Nine Dragons Spear was just a Five Rune Magical Treasure, its offensive power was extraordinary, far surpassing the Golden Sun Ruler and the White Bone Knife.
He swung the spear, about to put it away, when suddenly a shadowy purple light emerged on the body of the Purple Star Nine Dragons Spear. Within the depth of that light, five eyes appeared, endlessly rotating, exuding an extreme sense of eeriness.

chapters.title: Chapter 512 - 488: Earth Core Fire Lotus
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming's eyes suddenly widened slightly, showing a look of astonishment.
His Divine Sense suddenly sensed that inside the spear, there seemed to be something hidden, emanating strands of Star Power; if not paying close attention, one would hardly notice it.
"What is this? Could there be more mysteries inside the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear?"
Yuan Ming activated his Divine Sense to probe there, but a tough Star Power blocked the deep penetration of his Divine Sense.
"This Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear can devour Star Power and nourish its master, tempering the bones. Indeed, it's no ordinary Magic Treasure!"
Yuan Ming suppressed the excitement in his heart, stood up, and put away the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear, saying, "My friends, thank you for waiting."
"It's no trouble, but Brother Yuan, was there any problem with that Magic Treasure just now?" Long Chong asked curiously.
"There was no problem. This treasure is even more extraordinary than I thought. If we encounter Star Rain again, it can still be used for protection," Yuan Ming said with an unfazed smile.
"Oh? Is that really so? Then I'm very thankful to you, Brother Yuan," Long Chong said joyfully.
Qiong Yun and Wulu also showed delighted expressions. With Yuan Ming's statement, they would have no worries if they encountered Star Rain again in this Secret Realm.
As for why Yuan Ming's Magic Treasure had such effects, the three of them did not ask any further. Even Long Chong, who was fond of using spears, only marveled at Yuan Ming's Magic Treasure without harboring any other thoughts.
Yuan Ming sensed the emotions of the others through Emotion Manipulation, and his smile deepened considerably.
"Let's go. The treasure that the Black Wood Compass is pointing to is just ahead," Qiong Yun said, taking out the compass treasure and casting a spell.
A shadow of a round spoon appeared, initially pointing northeast, then suddenly began spinning erratically.
Qiong Yun's expression darkened, and she quickly cast spells with both hands, but the shadow of the round spoon kept spinning uncontrollably, unable to stabilize.
Read ahead and get updates by visiting *.
"What's going on?" Long Chong asked.
"I don't know. Suddenly, I can't sense the aura of that treasure anymore. Could someone have gotten there first?" Qiong Yun stopped casting and looked quite upset.
Yuan Ming glanced in the northeast direction, where the Lizard Demon Beast was located. Could it be that the treasure Qiong Yun mentioned was the Purple Extreme Tai Sui?
Qiong Yun and Long Chong, unwilling to give up, searched for a while but found nothing.
The two could only helplessly give up and search for other treasures, and they did indeed make some gains.
Yuan Ming, using the Divine Sense of his first soul as a guide, gathered a bunch of highly toxic spiritual materials and placed them in the Spiritual Beast Bag where the Purple Extreme Tai Sui was located.
Two hours later, the four of them finally arrived at the edge of the Purple Grass Continent and looked ahead.
Several continents floated in front, with the closest one being a much larger entity than the Purple Grass Continent, covered in red with barely any flora visible.
After a brief discussion, they unanimously decided to head to this continent.
All having experienced traveling to new continents before, they each used their respective techniques to protect their bodies and then soared towards the new continent with tunneling light.
As before, as soon as they left the Purple Grass Continent, the bizarre suction force reappeared, and this time, it was three times stronger than the last, causing their bodies to uniformly plunge downward.
This turn of events was both expected and somewhat sudden for the four of them.
Long Chong immediately roared angrily, and an Azure Orb appeared above his head, from which a blue Spiritual Power fell and enveloped his body, barely stemming the falling motion.
Meanwhile, Qiong Yun performed some Secret Technique, purple Lei Guang flickering frequently under her feet, barely lifting her up.
Wulu used both hands to make a strange spell, and surging blood plasma appeared out of nowhere, completely enveloping him in blood, just barely stopping the descent.
Yuan Ming was the one who found it most taxing, but when he fell, he almost instinctively took out the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear, and a surge of Star Power burst out, countering the suction from below—making it much less strenuous than before.
However, activating the Magic Treasure also required Mana. As they continued to move away from the Purple Grass Continent and the suction increased, the Mana of the four was rapidly depleted, and Yuan Ming soon became the first to fall short.
At that moment, he acutely felt his inferior Cultivation, facing such a challenge that demanded a high limit of Mana, he was ultimately unable to cope.
To reach the next continent, he had no choice but to use Spirit Stones to replenish his Mana expenditure.
Eventually, after nearly depleting their spells, the four managed to escape the suction and arrived at a new continent, with several high-grade Spirit Stones in Yuan Ming's hands drained of Mana, turning into shattered debris and falling.
Yuan Ming and the others finally set foot on the new continent, catching their breath while taking in their surroundings. They saw the ground was barren, devoid of any vegetation or living beings, with only the exposed red soil and dark red rocks everywhere.
Hot air flowed up from the ground in waves. Walking among them felt like being in a hot spring, the constant steaming heat making them somewhat irritable.
"Such rich Fire Attribute Spirit Qi, this place is simply a Cave Heaven Blessed Land for Cultivators who specialize in Fire Technique," Long Chong, who cultivated the Water attribute cultivation method, said without distaste, feeling the aura around the void and chuckled.
"This godforsaken place counts as a Cave Heaven Blessed Land?" Qiong Yun rolled her eyes and said.
"Setting aside other factors, why wouldn't it count?" Long Chong laughed.
After entering the Secret Realm, Long Chong and Qiong Yun initially got along without issues, but gradually they began to show their true colors, constantly bickering.
It seemed like their dispute was more akin to playful banter.
Suddenly, the ground beneath a large rock ahead cracked open, and a crimson afterimage burst forth like a flash of lightning, heading straight for Qiong Yun's ankles—it was a red scorpion the size of a washbasin.
Qiong Yun was startled and was about to retreat to dodge when a purple spear shot from the side with even greater speed, slicing the crimson scorpion into two.
"You two should not just focus on talking, this place also possesses its strangeness, caution is paramount," Yuan Ming said after retrieving his Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear, reminding them.
They had just been treasure hunting on the Purple Grass Continent where a Star Rain had fallen, and the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear had absorbed a considerable amount of Star Power, which enhanced its might once again.
"Thank you, Brother Yuan," Qiong Yun said with a blush, glaring fiercely at Long Chong as she expressed her thanks.
"What should be our next move might still require Miss Qiong's assistance," Wulu said with a smile.
Qiong Yun took out the Black Wood Compass and activated it. The shadow of the round spoon spun dizzily, pointing straight ahead.
Having trusted the Black Wood Compass during their treasure hunt on the Purple Grass Continent, they proceeded according to its direction.
The Red Continent was even more vast than the Purple Grass Continent, and after more than half a day, the expanse of crimson land ahead showed no sign of coming to an end.
The deeper they ventured into the continent, the richer the Fire Attribute Spirit Qi became, and Fire Attribute Spiritual Materials appeared more frequently, greatly enriching their collects.
Although the Red Continent did not have the deadly poisons of the Purple Grass Continent, it was home to various Fire Attribute demon beasts, many of which possessed unique Divine Skills. Not only were Yuan Ming and his companions amazed, but even Xi Ying had never seen such creatures.
Fortunately, all four of them possessed exceptional Divine Skills, and although they faced crises along the way, they were not gravely injured.
As the group crossed a scorching desert, Qiong Yun took out the compass again. The shadow of the round spoon trembled incessantly, pointing to the front left.
"Such a strong reaction indicates a heavy treasure in this place!"
Yuan Ming followed the direction indicated by the round spoon and saw the terrain gradually elevate. Behind a distant ridge, faint smoke rose, and the Spiritual Energy there was noticeably dense.
Yuan Ming led the way towards that ridge, with Wulu closely following behind.
Long Chong and Qiong Yun didn't say anything but followed them.
Maybe they hadn't realized it themselves, but after the events that had happened earlier, Yuan Ming had invisibly become the leader of their small team.
This new continent was exceptionally hot, and they did not dare to proceed too quickly. It took some time before they crossed that ridge, only to be met by an even hotter blast of air, mixed with the pungent smell of sulfur.
Yuan Ming stood on the ridge and looked towards the other side. Ahead, the terrain began to dip low, the ground cracked open with huge fissures that were filled with dark red magma.
At the center of that region, there was a vast Magma Lake spanning several miles. Inside, the crimson magma churned, continuously emitting gases from below which formed large bubbles that then burst open.
Smoke rose everywhere over the rolling magma, and from time to time, flames shot up like Fire Flood Dragons, flashing before vanishing.
Feeling the scorching air wave and the pungent odor, everyone instinctively squinted their eyes.
Qiong Yun took out the Black Wood Compass again to sense, and Long Chong's tightly furrowed brows suddenly relaxed, his figure leaped up, and he jumped down towards the fragmented landscape at the edge of the Magma Lake.
Seeing this, although the others did not understand why, they followed suit.
After they stopped near the edge where the magma flowed, Long Chong still had a posture of peering out on tiptoes.
"Are you from the Fire Ape tribe? So anxious, what exactly did you find?" Qiong Yun asked with a frown.
"Haven't you noticed? Over there in the center of the lake," Long Chong called out without turning around, pointing ahead.
Yuan Ming followed his pointing hand diligently, looking intently, and saw that at the center of the Magma Lake there was a small lake within the lake, enclosed by a circle of black rocks and spanning only about thirty feet. Inside, however, grew a cluster of red lotuses.
The flowers were peculiarly grown; the leaves were sparse, but there were plenty of red lotuses. The red petals reflected a crystal-like luster, and from a distance, they looked like they were carved from Blood Crystals.
The stems of the lotuses had a slightly darker color, but they bore thin red lines that looked like channels connecting the magma and the flowers, pulsating with molten liquid like flowing blood.
"Could this possibly be an Earth Core Fire Lotus?" Qiong Yun said, her eyes shining with excitement as she hesitated to ask.
"What possibly? This is an Earth Core Fire Lotus! I once saw one at an auction. This is a valuable item, birthed from the Magma Spiritual Power and Earth Essence. It doesn't need to be used in Alchemy, but can be directly consumed for absorbing, which tempers the body and enhances Mana. The benefits are most apparent for practitioners of Fire Attribute Techniques, but it is also effective for other attribute Magic Practitioners," Long Chong excitedly explained.
As soon as these words were spoken, everyone, including Yuan Ming, had their eyes light up, intrigued.
"Heaven's gifts, if not taken, are wasted. This is a divine gift, get it quickly!" Wulu said excitedly, about to leap forward, but Yuan Ming stopped him.
"Wherever a rare treasure grows, there must be Exotic Beasts guarding it. Let me explore first, and then we can act," Yuan Ming said.
"Brother Yuan makes sense; I was too eager," Wulu admitted somewhat sheepishly.
Yuan Ming closed his eyes and extended his Divine Sense toward the Magma Lake.
After a short while, he opened his eyes again with a hint of confusion on his face.

chapters.title: Chapter 513 - 489: Fire Lotus Enters the Body
chapters.content:
"Brother Yuan, did you notice anything amiss?" Wulu frowned and asked when he saw this.
"Not really, I didn't detect any breath in the lake, but this makes it seem even more abnormal... In any case, let's all be careful later on," Yuan Ming pondered slightly and shook his head as he spoke.
He hadn't used his first soul to extend his Divine Sense for exploration, as the soul power of soul splitting was weak, and manipulating the Desire Power within the White Jade Lotus Platform was even more difficult than with his main body.
Having conducted consecutive explorations earlier, his first soul was now completely exhausted and was currently practicing Breathing Control.
"Alright." Long Chong rubbed his hands, already somewhat impatient.
After the discussion, the group immediately took to the air and headed toward the center of the Magma Lake. With Yuan Ming's warning, everyone was not moving too quickly.
However, they had only flown about seventy or eighty feet when the molten lava beneath them in the Magma Lake suddenly began to boil tumultuously, and the violently churning magma spat flames several zhang high, scattering Yuan Ming and the others.
Following that, an enormous bubble swelled up, and within it appeared a gaping maw lined with sharp teeth; as the bubble rose, it surged upward.
"Be careful!" Yuan Ming shouted a warning as he twisted his body to dodge.
"Bang"
The huge bubble burst, revealing a gigantic crocodile over 30 feet long, covered in fiery red Scale Armor, which opened its ghastly mouth and lunged at Yuan Ming.
A firelight ignited in its throat and suddenly spurted out a stream of scorching molten lava, thick as a man's arm, shooting straight toward Yuan Ming's chest like an arrow.
In his haste, Yuan Ming summoned a Silver Shield in front of him, its surface gleaming with rotating light.
This item had been recently acquired from Island Master Liu of Liulan Island, and Yuan Ming had casually refined it, finding it quite solid and durable.
The arrow-like molten lava struck the Silver Shield.
With a "sch" sound, the Silver Shield melted like a candle, being burnt through to create a large hole, though the burning magma continued toward Yuan Ming's chest, its force significantly diminished.
Yuan Ming's heart chilled, and he raised a Silver Banner to block the magma, shifting his body laterally to move aside.
The Red Fire Crocodile was huge but exceptionally agile; it slapped its tail fiercely in the magma, effortlessly changing direction and continuing its pursuit of Yuan Ming.
At that moment, Yuan Ming's figure suddenly flickered, turning into multiple indistinct afterimages, scattering across the Magma Lake, causing the Red Fire Crocodile to lose sight of its target and lunge at nothing.
Elsewhere, Long Chong and the others also faced gigantic fiery crocodiles; Long Chong gripped his spear tightly, moving through the air like a dragon, dodging a stream of molten arrows from one of the crocodiles and thrusting his spear.
If not for Yuan Ming's timely warning, he would almost certainly have been burnt by the molten lava by now.
This thought turned Long Chong's anger into strength, channeling it through the tip of his spear.
His figure spun in mid-air, seemingly merging with his spear, transforming into a conical water spout that rapidly pierced towards the top of the Fire Crocodile's head.
"Hiss hiss..."
The dense water vapor clashed with the fire energy emitted by the Fire Crocodile, creating a thick white steam that enveloped both of their figures, accompanied by a sharp metallic clashing sound.
"Clang clang clang"
As sparks flew continuously, Long Chong's figure receded backward, cursing as he shouted:
"Everyone be careful, these beasts' skin is just too thick; I struck with nearly full force, yet I couldn't even penetrate the crocodile armor!"
Having freed himself, Long Chong subconsciously glanced over at Qiong Yun.
She was currently maneuvering the Jade Ruyi to form a circular Protective Light Screen, fending off the pincer attack from two Fire Crocodiles.
The two Fire Crocodiles incessantly spewed molten lava that was even more terrifying than that in the Magma Lake, quickly causing her protective screen to waver as if it was about to collapse.
Seeing this, Long Chong hurriedly flew over, thrusting his spear at one of the Fire Crocodiles.
His Winter Flood Dragon Spirit Beast manifested, its body shrinking several times, resembling a small snake coiled around his spear, spitting at the Fire Crocodile. CheckMyVirtualLibraryEmpire(*)forthelatestupdates.
A dazzling blue light burst from the tip of the spear, along with an extreme chill that overwhelmed the surrounding intense heat.
One side of the Fire Crocodile's body was immediately covered with white Frost, its movements becoming stiff, and it was knocked flying by the spear.
Long Chong's body was also blasted backward; he quickly pulled Qiong Yun and flew out of the Magma Lake.
After landing, both of them breathed lightly, the situation having been extremely critical just moments earlier. This brief battle had significantly drained both of them.
Not far away, Wulu had also escaped the magma area, his body charred black, with half his hair burnt off.
Wulu had just been attacked by two Fire Crocodiles; he had managed to fend off an attack of Magma from one of them with a Magic Treasure, escaping but also sustaining serious injuries.
"Where's Brother Yuan?" After catching his breath, Long Chong looked around and asked.
He had not paid attention to Yuan Ming's situation just now, but the area above the Magma Lake was now empty, Yuan Ming nowhere to be seen.
However, he was not overly worried in his heart as, in his view, Yuan Ming's strength and experience in dealing with emergencies were no less than his own, and he naturally had ways to protect himself.
"There's nowhere to hide here, could he be there?" Qiong Yun suddenly looked up at the center of the lake and said.
At the center of the lake at that moment, the magma surged violently, forming soaring magma waves several meters high from all directions, targeting the Earth Core Fire Lotus at the center of the lake and enveloping it layer by layer, obscuring the view.
Just as Long Chong and Wulu turned their heads in response, strands of white light crisscrossed like blades, chopping nearly half of the magma waves into fragments.
Accompanied by a rumble of thunder, a thick bolt of silver lightning shot out from the center of the lake. It crossed dozens of meters in an instant and landed near the three of them, revealing Yuan Ming and Lei Yu.
Lei Yu's body was scorched in many places, and many feathers were burned off. Yuan Ming's sleeves were half burned, slightly disheveled, but his right hand was flickering with red light, clearly holding an Earth Core Fire Lotus.
"Haha, as expected, Brother Yuan is highly skilled and managed to get a Fire Lotus," Long Chong laughed heartily.
"It was a lucky catch," Yuan Ming laughed.
He had just cast a wide-range Illusion Technique on the fire crocodiles in the lake, used the Void Transformation Technique to conceal his traces, and amidst the chaos, he moved to the black rock area at the center of the lake, intending to steal a few Fire Lotuses. Unexpectedly, seven or eight even larger fire crocodiles suddenly leapt out from the center of the lake, able to sense his presence and control the lava to smash towards him.
Under urgent circumstances, Yuan Ming used the Cold Moon Ring to forcibly break through the magma wave and caught an Earth Core Fire Lotus, then summoned Lei Yu and escaped.
However, there were too many fire crocodiles in the center of the lake and they were also strong, so Yuan Ming didn't completely avoid them and suffered some minor injuries.
About a dozen fire crocodiles with blazing eyes chased after them, and Yuan Ming and his group quickly retreated again.
The fire crocodiles only pursued them to the edge of the lake and did not come ashore. They roared a few times at the group and then began to sink back into the Magma Lake.
"It seems these fire crocodiles will not leave the Magma Lake," Wulu said.
Yuan Ming and the others deeply agreed, watching the fire crocodile figures slowly sinking into the magma, completely disappearing without a trace.
All four of them looked astonished. Their Divine Sense had been tracking these fire crocodiles; as soon as they dived into the lake, they suddenly disappeared, and everyone's Divine Sense completely lost them.
"How is that possible? Could these fire crocodiles' bodies be composed of magma? Do they melt into it as they enter the lake?" Qiong Yun widened his eyes, incredulous.
"As I see it, those fire crocodiles have flesh and blood bodies, and might be proficient in some advanced Concealment Technique," Long Chong guessed, stroking his chin.
Yuan Ming didn't pay attention to the fire crocodiles, instead, he applied a Recovery Spell to his right hand while examining the Fire Lotus in his hand.
"So this is the Earth Core Fire Lotus? Hurry up and try it, see if its effects are really as good as the rumors suggest?" Qiong Yun urged, his face full of curiosity.
Wulu swallowed two Healing Pills, his burns had already mostly healed, and he was now intently watching the flickering red light of the Fire Lotus in Yuan Ming's hands.
Yuan Ming nodded, settled down on a nearby large rock, with Lei Yu and Hua Zhi squatting on either side, and Wulu with the other two stood further away, serving as protectors for Yuan Ming.
According to Long Chong, Yuan Ming didn't need to do anything special; he immediately broke off a petal of the Earth Core Fire Lotus.
This petal was thin, like thin Ice Crystals, warm to the touch, with a jade-like texture.
After examining it briefly, Yuan Ming put the petal into his mouth.
A faint scent of incense wafted in his mouth, the thin petal dissolved instantly, mingling with the saliva emerging in his mouth and slipping into his stomach.
After waiting a moment, Yuan Ming felt no discomfort, but likewise, he felt no change, and couldn't help but turn to Long Chong.
"Don't look at me, I haven't eaten this thing either... Maybe you ate too little of it?" Long Chong spread his hands and suggested.
After a brief contemplation, Yuan Ming broke off petal after petal and put them into his mouth.
When he had swallowed all the petals, and the remaining pistil and stem as well, a faint heat appeared. It wasn't intense.
Yuan Ming channeled Mana, trying to refine this hint of heat, when suddenly within his lower abdomen, there was a "bang" sound as if a flaming fire had risen. A scorchingly hot current surged, instantly reddening his entire face.
He immediately felt a rich Spiritual Power uncontrollably roaming his body, straining his Eight Extraordinary Meridians immensely, causing unbearable burning sensations, almost ready to burst if not dealt with.
In excruciating pain, Yuan Ming gritted his teeth and smiled inwardly, immediately Cultivating in meditation, refining and absorbing the Spiritual Power.
The surrounding nature's spiritual energy was also drawn, flowing into his body like a tide, subtly forming a Spiritual Energy Vortex.
Seeing this, Long Chong and the others relaxed at first, their faces showing envy.
In just a brief moment, that current of Spiritual Power was completely refined by Yuan Ming into Mana, which entered into his Dantian.
In his Dantian a boiling scene of Mana ensued, Yuan Ming's Cultivation achieved great progress in just this brief moment, reaching the peak of early-stage Core Formation, barely a step away from mid-stage.
Yuan Ming could feel that just one more Earth Core Fire Lotus would allow him to break through directly to the mid-stage of Core Formation.
Furthermore, his body was tempered, pores exuding many black impurities, and both his muscles and bones were significantly strengthened.

chapters.title: Chapter 514 - 490: Be Reasonable as a Person
chapters.content:
"Brother Yuan, how do you feel?" Seeing Yuan Ming open his eyes, Long Chong hurriedly asked.
Qiong Yun and Wulu also looked at him with an inquisitive expression.
"Very good," Yuan Ming summoned a stream of water to wash away the impurities from his body and nodded.
"That's it?" Long Chong seemed quite unsatisfied with that answer.
"The wonders of it cannot be summarized in words, one must experience it for oneself," Yuan Ming said, intentionally leaving them in suspense, his mood very good at the moment.
Qiong Yun rolled his eyes, while a smile appeared in Wulu's, clearly familiar with Yuan Ming's character.
"Just kidding. Seriously though, this Earth Core Fire Lotus is indeed an extraordinary flower. After taking it..." Yuan Ming said with a smile, carefully recounting the process of refining the Earth Core Fire Lotus.
"Brother Long, you just mentioned the Earth Core Fire Lotus is formed from the convergence of magma spiritual power and earth essence, so the spiritual power it contains should primarily be of the fire attribute. Brother Yuan practices a wood attribute cultivation method, so why did it have such a significant effect on him?" Wulu asked, puzzled.
"That's the remarkable thing about the Earth Core Fire Lotus. Swallowing the lotus does not only grant you the spiritual power it contains, but it also draws in nature's spiritual energy into your body. Hence, even those who practice cultivation methods other than the fire attribute can benefit greatly. Brother Yuan's cultivation method is of the wood attribute, and since wood generates fire, the Earth Core Fire Lotus has an especially potent effect on him, second only to cultivators of the fire attribute," Long Chong explained.
"I see," Wulu said, enlightened. He turned to look at the magma lake with a glint of eagerness in his eyes.
They had been caught off guard initially, resulting in mostly fruitless attempts. The four of them discussed on the spot, preparing to join forces to harvest all the Earth Core Fire Lotuses from the center of the lake—after all, it was a rare opportunity that only comes once in a thousand years.
Just at that moment, bluish light flashed again above the firmament.
"Everyone, the Star Rain is coming again!" Wulu looked up and warned after a glance.
"No worries, let's gather together," Yuan Ming said, taking out the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear.
The others had already witnessed the might of this divine weapon and did not hesitate to move closer to Yuan Ming.
Meanwhile, above the sky, the blue tide rose again, with bright and dazzling star trails, like waves surging over the ocean, hammering down towards the floating continent.
This time, the force seemed even stronger than the previous one.
In the urgency of the whistling sounds, Yuan Ming raised his hand and tossed the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear into the air.
With a flick of his wrist and a pinch of his spell, whooshing sounds filled the air as he twisted his wrist. The Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear rapidly spun in the high sky, tracing afterimages in the void to form a massive purple light shield.
Star Rains bombarded the purple light shield formed by the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear, with countless starlights splashing, all being deflected.
As Yuan Ming felt heavy impacts transmitted from the spear, he also distinctly sensed that it was absorbing more star power.
Having refined the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear, he could now draw star power from a distance. A continuous stream of star power flowed into his body, ceaselessly tempering Yuan Ming's bones and making them increasingly resilient.
In that moment, Yuan Ming suddenly had a realization and his hand controlling the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear trembled inadvertently, causing a star from the Star Rain to be missed and whiz by close to them, narrowly avoiding injury.
The full series lives on * (*).
"Brother Yuan..." Long Chong couldn't help calling out.
Yuan Ming gave an apologetic smile without explaining anything.
The reason for his lapse was the shocking discovery that as star power continued to pour in, the seal within the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear seemed to be weakening imperceptibly.
"Could it be that when enough star power is absorbed, the seal within the spear can be completely broken?" Yuan Ming thought excitedly to himself.
With that thought, he no longer just passively defended against the Star Rain's assault, but actively shattered the falling star showers to collect as much star power as possible.
Seeing this, Long Chong thought it was his earlier call of "Brother Yuan" that made Yuan Ming think he was being chastised for not blocking well, which was why he actively attacked.
He wanted to tell Yuan Ming not to overexert himself, but he was somewhat uncertain how to express it.
Fortunately, this round of Star Rain didn't last long and quickly disappeared.
When the extensive star trails vanished, everyone breathed a sigh of relief, but a hint of regret flickered in Yuan Ming's eyes.
His bones had been strengthened once more, barely giving off a metallic luster, getting ever closer to the Iron Bone Body of the Bone Refinement culturing stage.
If the Star Rain could have lasted for another half a moment, his Body Cultivation would have reached a new level.
As for the seal within the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear, it hadn't broken, but the might of the spear had greatly increased, the radiated purple glow becoming more intense, and a chilling Qi Force lingered around the shaft.
Yuan Ming called back the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear and after looking at it for a moment, he put it away.
"We need to hurry, while the next round of Star Rain has not yet fallen, let's collect these Earth Core Fire Lotuses, lest we encounter unexpected complications over time," Qiong Yun said.
"First we need to think of how to deal with those Fire Crocodiles," Wulu said, looking at the seemingly peaceful Magma Lake, feeling somewhat troubled.
Yuan Ming opened his mouth to speak but suddenly frowned and looked towards the other side of the ridge.
At this moment, on the nearby slope, a dozen figures were hurrying over towards them.
These people subtly divided into four teams, leading the way were two individuals, precisely the Golden Cloud Fairy from Fusang Island and Daoist Qian Bao from Golden Turtle Island.
The team beside them consisted of Huan Ling Zi, Immortal Bing Xin, and Yun Jiuxiao from the two second-level islands. The cultivators looked rather displeased, their expressions grim, possibly due to the death of Mi Luo.
A little distance away were Qing Tong from Thousand Snake Island, Xue Jiao from Bijiao Island, and Hou Santong from Water Ape Island.
As for the last team, which maintained a further distance from the others, it was composed of cultivators from Yuzhu Island, Red Leaf Island, and Wanhua Island.
Apart from Tu Sheng from Earth Beauty Island, all cultivators who had entered the secret realm had now gathered here.
As Yuan Ming and his companions noticed this group, the group likewise saw Yuan Ming and his three companions.
Huan Ling Zi had an unpleasant look on his face, especially when his eyes swept over Yuan Ming—it sparked with deeply ingrained spitefulness and bitterness, yet he did not step forward to seek revenge.
He took a deep breath and turned to look at Wulu, who stood beside Yuan Ming.
"Fellow Daoist Hong, why are you following them? Hurry over here," he called out.
As he spoke, Huan Ling Zi's gaze did not linger on Wulu; instead, he glanced fleetingly at Yuan Ming as if to gauge his reaction.
Yuan Ming snorted inwardly but didn't speak up to stop him.
"Fellow Daoist Huan Ling Zi, we teamed up only temporarily before, and now I have already joined this group. It's unnecessary for me to come over," Wulu replied with a smile.
"Teaming up with them? Have you really thought this through?" Huan Ling Zi chuckled coldly, his intent to intimidate clear.
Wulu just gave Huan Ling Zi an apologetic smile and said no more.
Seeing such an attitude, Huan Ling Zi's face darkened, and the veins on his temple throbbed with anger. He silently channeled his soul power, attempting to manipulate the Illusion Seed within Wulu's Sea of Consciousness.
However, the Illusion Seed within Wulu had already been expelled by Yuan Ming, so no matter how Huan Ling Zi tried to cast spells, there was no response.
At that moment, Huan Ling Zi frowned slightly, a flash of astonishment in his eyes. Then, remembering something, he looked again at Yuan Ming, his gaze colder than before.
Qing Tong and others were hoping for some excitement, but seeing that Huan Ling Zi didn't react, they all felt a shade of disappointment.
"Fellow Daoist Huan Ling Zi, aren't you going to teach someone who doesn't appreciate kindness a lesson?" Qing Tong asked with her tongue flicking over her teeth, always eager for chaos.
"Have you forgotten what we're here for?" Huan Ling Zi glanced at her, asking in response.
"Right, right, right, you said there was the aura of heavenly materials and earthly treasures around here." Upon hearing this, Qing Tong began to scan the surroundings, and soon she discovered the Earth Core Fire Lotus in the center of the Magma Lake.
"Is that the Earth Core Fire Lotus?" Hou Santong also spotted the treasure, exclaiming in surprise.
Everyone's attention was suddenly drawn to his words as they looked towards the lake, each letting out exclamations of surprise, including Golden Cloud Fairy and Daoist Qian Bao. For the moment, no one paid any attention to Yuan Ming and his companions.
Daoist Qian Bao gently patted the Spiritual Beast Bag at his waist, and a blue little creature flew out, landing on his shoulder.
This beast had the head of a tiger, the body of a leopard, and the tail of a dragon, not appearing like an ordinary spirit beast.
"This is the auspicious beast, Pixiu!" Xi Ying exclaimed inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
"Pixiu? The legendary beast with a mouth, no anus, and the ability to devour all things without excretion, capable of seeking treasures?" Yuan Ming communicated back.
"It seems so. However, a true Pixiu is born with six legs, but this one has only four. It seems it's not a purebred Pixiu," Xi Ying responded.
The blue little beast lazily yawned before finally opening its eyes and looking towards the center of the Magma Lake. Its little ears perked up with excitement, letting out eager cries and leaping towards the lake.
Daoist Qian Bao grabbed it back, placed it on his shoulder again, and smiled at the Golden Cloud Fairy beside him, "It seems it indeed is the Earth Core Fire Lotus. Fairy, you're in luck, just two blossoms and your odds for breaking through to the Nascent Soul Stage will increase significantly."
Golden Cloud Fairy's eyes also flashed with joy as she looked ahead.
"Hey, you guys got here early. Why haven't you picked the Fire Lotus yet? What are you waiting for?" Qing Tong, hearing the two's conversation, flashed a look of joy and pointed at Yuan Ming's group, asking outright.
"Naturally, we're not waiting for some useless thing like you!" Long Chong abruptly changed his normally enthusiastic demeanor, retorting unkindly with a cold snort.
"What did you say?" Qing Tong's slit pupils narrowed, and her eyes brimmed with murderous intent.
Yuan Ming wasn't surprised by this. Thousand Snake Island and Thousand Dragon Island were always at odds, a fact known by anyone in the East Sea with a bit of experience, although it's not always openly acknowledged.
The conflict between the two stemmed from the names of their respective islands: Thousand Dragon Island took the dragon as its emblem, while Thousand Snake Island identified with the snake.
The Snake-man Clan aimed to shed their snake skins and transform into dragon forms. With Thousand Dragon Island adopting the dragon as its symbol, it massively offended the Snake-man Clan. The two had been enemies for over a millennium. Both sides were sore in each other's eyes, ready to oppose each other at the slightest provocation.
"I mean, there's an order to everything. Since you arrived later, you should wait for us to pick them and then take what we leave behind. Don't you agree that we should play fair?" Long Chong, unabashed, said with a mix of jest in his voice.
However, his words immediately caught the attention of all the cultivators who had arrived later.

chapters.title: Chapter 515 - 491: Join Hands in Cooperation
chapters.content:
"Fellow Daoist Long, we are all here to seek opportunities in this Secret Realm, each on their own path. There is no such thing as first come, first served," Huan Ling Zi said, his eyes narrowing as he spoke slowly.
The cultivators who had followed him also took a step forward.
"If that's the case, then it's all about skill," Long Chong said. He had no sooner finished speaking than he lit up with a glow.
Thinking that Long Chong was going to snatch the Earth Core Fire Lotus, Qing Tong didn't have time to think. His figure flashed, turning into a tunneling light that sped toward the center of the Magma Lake.
However, he had only flown out about ten zhang when he saw Long Chong stop at the edge of the Magma Lake, not stepping into the lake's area at all, the corners of his mouth curving into a subtle smile.
Qing Tong inwardly cursed, realizing something was amiss and hastily stopped in his tracks.
But before he could steady himself, the Magma Lake below suddenly churned violently, and several Fire Crocodiles leaped out of the lake, opening their huge mouths to spew molten lava at him.
Qing Tong was startled by the formidable demonic power of the Fire Crocodiles and swiftly dodged.
However, the Fire Crocodiles, which had already been disturbed once by Yuan Ming and the others, were furiously enraged and simultaneously launched an attack, effectively blocking all of Qing Tong's escape routes.
Qing Tong barely evaded the attacks of two Fire Crocodiles, but a stream of molten lava came at him from a blind spot and hit him hard.
Qing Tong did not panic and quickly raised his hand, calling forth an ancient round shield enveloped within a hazy purple aura to block the molten lava.
The intense molten lava hit the round shield, immediately emitting billows of purple smoke and a "puff puff" sound.
Just like Yuan Ming's Silver Shield, the purple round shield was instantly burned through, creating a large hole.
The molten lava that burst in landed on Qing Tong's Protective Treasure Light, scorching him so severely that he screamed in agony and fell toward the sea of fire below.
Two Fire Crocodiles were already waiting there, opening their mouths to bite at Qing Tong.
Just then, a streak of blue light, like a rainbow, shot from the distance. It arrived beneath Qing Tong in an instant and spread out with a "whoosh," forming a blue light screen that caught his body.
The two Fire Crocodiles bit down hard on it. The crystalline light screen twisted and deformed but didn't shatter.
Qing Tong caught his breath and stepped on the blue light screen, using it to propel himself out. His figure flickered like a ghost, leaving behind a trail of serpentine illusions that dazzled the eyes.
The surrounding Fire Crocodiles were confused by the illusions, becoming sluggish for a moment.
Seizing the opportunity, Qing Tong broke out of the encirclement and shot towards the shore.
The group of irate Fire Crocodiles gave chase, and over a dozen Magma Fire Columns vied with each other to strike at Qing Tong's back.
The previously horizontal blue light screen suddenly stood erect, blocking the Magma Fire Columns for a moment, and Qing Tong successfully escaped from the lake.
After landing, he didn't dare to stay put. Guarding his burned chest with mana, he continued his escape without noticing the Fire Crocodiles that had stopped pursuing at the lakeshore.
"Haha"
Long Chong, having returned to Yuan Ming and the others, watched Qing Tong's wretched state and laughed so hard he could hardly stand straight.
The others, upon seeing the scene, also struggled to suppress their laughter.
Yuan Ming did not laugh but instead gave Xue Jiao a glance.
The blue light screen that had just saved Qing Tong was emitted by this woman. It was not a Magic Treasure but merely an ordinary flow of water, yet it had twice blocked the attack of the Red Fire Crocodiles, which was quite extraordinary.
Moreover, Xue Jiao was not purely defensive. During the two instances when she countered the Fire Crocodiles, she launched attacks as well. Many extremely fine Water Needles were shot from within the blue light screen, targeting the vulnerable areas such as the Fire Crocodiles' eyes and nostrils. Otherwise, Qing Tong would not have been able to escape so smoothly.
Those Water Needles were so fine that they were difficult to detect by a slightly weaker Divine Sense.
Yuan Ming silently marveled, noting that the Merfolk were incredibly adept in water control. He knew he would have to be extremely careful if he ever fought with this woman in the future.
Having reached a place of safety, Qing Tong quickly tended to his wounds and immediately turned to Long Chong.
"Long Chong, you and I are irreconcilable!" Flames nearly shot from his eyes as he raised his hand and grasped two thin, black, glossy swords that gleamed with a faint black light, hurling them at Long Chong.
"It's not my fault you went there. Are you blaming me?" Long Chong sneered, fearless. As a flash of light appeared in his hand, a blue spear materialized, and he prepared to meet the attack.
Just when the two were about to clash, a figure suddenly flashed out and stood between them. It was Daoist Qian Bao from Golden Turtle Island.
He pushed out his palms to the left and right, meeting Qing Tong and Long Chong respectively. In his palms, he held a round jade and a square seal.
The round jade surged with blue light, forming a vertical mighty round shield like a giant shield in front of Qing Tong, while from the square seal emerged a peak made of yellow light that blocked Long Chong.
"Fellow Daoists, please calm down and hear me out," he interjected.
The slender long swords in Qing Tong's hands struck the azure giant shield, and with a flash of blue light, they were rebuffed, vibrating with a hint of blue light and moving twice as fast as before.
The long spear held by Long Chong only struck out halfway before stopping in front of the yellow mountain peak.
Qing Tong hastily made a series of hand seals, managing to regain control over the slender swords and said in a deep voice, "Thousand Treasures, what is the meaning of this?"
"Fellow Daoists, a harmonious atmosphere breeds fortune. We've come into this secret realm in search of the numerous heavenly materials, earthly treasures, and opportunities, have we not? To start fighting to the death over treasures we haven't even acquired yet would surely be a loss," Daoist Qian Bao chuckled.
"Just now, Long Chong deliberately lured me into danger. Everyone present here saw it; he was the provocateur!" Qing Tong said coldly.
"What a joke, it's your own greed that made you so eager to feed the crocodiles. What does that have to do with me?" Long Chong retorted with disdain.
Enraged, Qing Tong's swords glowed with dark light once more in her hands.
"Have you two come here to quarrel and make a spectacle of yourselves? Please move elsewhere and don't hinder our gathering of the Earth Core Fire Lotuses," Golden Cloud Fairy said with a trace of impatience and a cold voice.
"Qing Tong, I have important business to take care of and have no time to bicker with you. Once we're out of the secret realm, we can settle our differences once and for all," Long Chong, apparently wary of Golden Cloud Fairy, was the first to put away his weapon and backed away.
Unable to contain his anger, Qing Tong opened his mouth to say something more, but Xue Jiao's lips moved slightly as if she was transmitting a message to him.
Qing Tong's expression changed subtly, and after taking a deep breath, the anger on his face receded like the tidewater, and he too withdrew.
"Brother Long, be careful. Qing Tong is one to bear grudges, having been thwarted by you, he likely won't let the matter rest," Yuan Ming transmitted a warning.
"Rest assured, I'm well aware of Qing Tong's little tricks," Long Chong said nonchalantly.
"Thousand Treasures is right; there is something very strange about Magma Lake, as no sign of life can be detected. Just now, each of those Fire Crocodiles possessed the strength of a third-level demon beast. Fighting them one-on-one, it will be quite difficult to obtain those Earth Core Fire Lotuses. Since we are all gathered here by fate, why not join forces and gather the lotuses together?" Huan Ling Zi said regretfully, but his face showed a smile as he stepped forward to propose.
"Huan Ling Zi's proposal is indeed brilliant. I wonder what the others think?" Daoist Qian Bao nodded in agreement.
* (*) appreciates your readership at the source.
"Given the strength of the demon beasts at present, joining forces to confront them is indeed the best strategy," Yun Jiuxiao voiced his approval.
Golden Cloud Fairy, Qing Tong, Xue Jiao, Hou Santong, and others also nodded their heads in succession, but Long Chong's group and Zhong Ling's party of three abstained from expressing their agreement.
"Fellow Daoist Long, do you perhaps find this proposal unsuitable?" Daoist Qian Bao asked, looking over at him.
"Brother Yuan, what do you think..." Long Chong said.
At this moment, Daoist Qian Bao finally took notice of Yuan Ming, a look of surprise flashing in his eyes.
Long Chong was the son of the Island Master of Thousand Dragon Island and was known for his unruly character. Yet now, he was actually seeking Yuan Ming's opinion, which was quite unexpected.
"As for the proposal made by Daoist Qian Bao and Huan Ling Zi, we naturally agree," Yuan Ming said after a brief contemplation.
Daoist Qian Bao nodded with a smile towards Yuan Ming and looked towards Zhong Ling's party.
"We three practice wood attribute cultivation methods, and our spirit beasts are also of the Wood type, which are greatly restrained by these Fire Crocodiles. We would rather not take this risk," Zhong Ling communicated with the other two using transmitted messages and declined.
"What Zhong Ling has said is also my thought," Baili Zhui of Red Leaf Island added.
"We three are of inferior strength and truly wouldn't be of much assistance. Rest assured, we shall take our leave immediately and will not disturb you in claiming the treasure," Hua Ping said with a bow, and the three turned to walk away towards the distance.
"This..." Suddenly short of three allies, everyone was momentarily taken aback.
Yuan Ming smiled faintly, as the three were consistent in their prudence; yet, this was also a correct decision. They knew when to hold back and when to act, for one must give up something in order to gain something else.
"I knew they would shrink back, a bunch of turtles withdrawing their heads," Qing Tong clicked his tongue and snorted disdainfully.
"Please wait, the talismanic technique of Yuzhu Island, the Arrays of Red Leaf Island, and the Ten Thousand Wood Nourishing Essence Secret Skill of Wanhua Island are well known throughout the East Sea cultivation world. You three are selling yourselves short," Daoist Qian Bao hurriedly urged them to stay.
"It is not that we are being modest; our strength is indeed lacking, and we do not wish to take this risk," Zhong Ling explained.
"Fellow Daoists act with caution, which I respect. How about this offer? You need not engage directly. Just set up the Ten Thousand Wood Formation on the shore and help restrain some of the Fire Crocodiles from afar," Daoist Qian Bao proposed after a moment's thought.
Upon hearing they could avoid the risk, Zhong Ling and the others exchanged looks and then nodded in agreement.
Others who heard this wore expressions of suppressed annoyance, but none raised objections.
"Brother Long, what kind of Array is the Ten Thousand Wood Formation? Why does Daoist Qian Bao put such value in it?" Yuan Ming inquired through transmission.
Yan Sijing had gathered a lot of information about the East Sea, but hadn't mentioned this formation.
"The Ten Thousand Wood Formation is a combined Array from Yuzhu Island, Red Leaf Island, and Wanhua Island. They specialize in Wood Attribute Divine Skills and have a close relationship. The predecessors of the Three Islands shared and exchanged their Divine Skills, creating this powerful Ten Thousand Wood Formation, which has been a renowned tale in the East Sea Cultivation World. The Formation is incredibly powerful, especially suited for defense and trapping enemies. Zhong Ling and the others are outstanding Core Formation cultivators from their respective islands; the Array they set up is likely capable of trapping even Nascent Soul cultivators for a while," Long Chong explained.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming realized that with this Formation's help, obtaining the Fire Lotuses would indeed be twice as effective with half the effort and safer as well.

chapters.title: Chapter 516 - 492: Covertly Accepting Qi-Blood
chapters.content:
"Haha, since everyone has no objections, then it's settled this way. As for how to obtain the Earth Core Fire Lotus, please share your ideas. Let's have Fellow Daoist Yuan speak first." Daoist Qian Bao laughed and looked at Yuan Ming with an inquisitive look in his eyes.
"These Fire Crocodiles are not weak, and their numbers are unknown. It probably won't work to kill them all before gathering the lotuses. The best way is to have some people who are skilled in Escape Techniques gather the Fire Lotuses, while the rest assist by engaging and blocking the Fire Crocodiles. This way, we can obtain the Earth Core Fire Lotus with the smallest losses." Yuan Ming was secretly cautious of Daoist Qian Bao. His expression was unchanged as he spoke.
As his words fell, everyone, including Daoist Qian Bao, fell silent. Many eyes landed on Yuan Ming as they considered the feasibility of his method.
"I think this method is feasible," said Golden Cloud Fairy, breaking the silence, and nodded.
"Indeed, this method is appropriate, but as for who to send to gather the lotuses, who will take on this task?" Daoist Qian Bao agreed, then asked.
"I'll go." Qing Tong was the first to volunteer, holding the initiative once he got the Fire Lotus in hand.
"I can also give it a try." Relying on her Ice Qilin Spirit Beast, Bing Xin also wanted to try her luck.
"I think I can do it as well..."
Suddenly, the noisy voices of self-recommendations erupted, with nearly everyone volunteering eagerly.
"Rather than who goes to gather the lotuses, I'm more concerned about how the Fire Lotuses we collect will be distributed," Huan Ling Zi suddenly said.
At these words, people exchanged glances and fell silent again for a moment.
"I think, since everyone is working together, naturally, after collection, they should be put together and distributed fairly," Long Chong spoke.
"How can distribution be even when the number of people doesn't match the number of Fire Lotuses gathered? We surely cannot chop them up and weigh them out," Qing Tong sneered.
"Compared to the task of guarding, the risk of gathering lotuses is obviously greater. Even if it's distributed evenly, it wouldn't be fair," Hou Santong spoke at this time.
Everyone had their own thoughts, speaking one after another, leaving no reliable ideas.
"If we're going to quibble like this, then why cooperate at all? Let's just compete based on our abilities. If you die, no complaints, and if you're injured, no blaming," Qing Tong scorned seeing that the discussion was going nowhere.
"Why put us through such trouble? The gatherer should at least ensure one Fire Lotus per person is collected. As for any extra, they should be equally divided among everyone. If the number is insufficient, compensate with Spirit Stones and spiritual materials. How about that?" Yuan Ming spoke.
"This method is indeed not bad," Golden Cloud Fairy glanced at Yuan Ming with a flash of admiration in her eyes.
"I agree," said Hou Santong.
"I also agree," Long Chong nodded.
Seeing no objections, Daoist Qian Bao spoke, "Since everyone thinks it's reasonable, then it's decided. Those who just volunteered to gather the lotuses, please step forward."
His words echoed for a long time, yet no one responded.
They were initially eager to volunteer for fear of losing their interests, but now that each was assured a Fire Lotus, naturally, no one wanted to risk themselves.
"I'll do it," Yuan Ming said.
During the competition the day before, everyone had witnessed his Divine Skills, almost akin to Thunder Escape, hence no one objected.
"Count me in," Golden Cloud Fairy volunteered.
Seeing this, Qiong Yun was about to step forward but was stopped by a transmission from Yuan Ming.
"Fellow Daoist Qiong Yun, you and Long Chong need to protect me. I don't trust the others," Yuan Ming's voice echoed in her Sea of Consciousness, prompting her to retreat.
"With only two people, the collection speed will be too slow. It's best if we can resolve this swiftly to avoid complications," Huan Ling Zi spoke.
"If that's the case, why not ask Fellow Daoist Huan Ling Zi to join us?" Yuan Ming said with a smile.
"As you all know, I'm not skilled in Escape Techniques. If I go to gather the lotuses, I might just slow you down," Huan Ling Zi cursed inwardly and declined.
