"Fellow Daoist Huan Ling Zi isn't skilled in Escape Techniques? How come I remember that you can transform into Golden Light and tunnel through the earth, or am I mistaken?" Yuan Ming stroked his chin, feigning confusion.
Huan Ling Zi recalled how Yuan Ming had forced him to use the "Vertical Earth Golden Light Talisman" and couldn't help but feel a rush of anger as veins popped on his forehead, yet his emotions were well-controlled, and the veins disappeared quickly.
"Haha, perhaps the Fellow Daoist is mistaken," Huan Ling Zi clenched his fists inside his sleeves while keeping a smile on his face.
"Well, although I'm not skilled in Escape Techniques, I do have some Magic Treasures with me. I'll join in gathering the lotuses too," Daoist Qian Bao saw no one else responding and felt compelled to speak.
"Three people should be enough," Yuan Ming nodded.
"Everyone, whether it's gathering lotuses or leading away the Fire Crocodiles, neither task is easy. Here, I declare in advance that no one, during the gathering, should attack others. If anyone breaches this, not only will they lose their qualification to obtain Fire Lotuses, but they will also have to surrender all their previous gains and be expelled from the team!" Golden Cloud Fairy warned.
Her warning alone might not weigh much, but with Fusang Island backing her, no one dared to take it lightly.
"That's only natural. Engaging in petty actions at such a time, it wouldn't be too much for us all to kill him," Long Chong said with a meaningful look at Qing Tong.
"Right, such people who neglect the greater good are indeed a bane."
"It should be so..."
Everyone responded simultaneously, and their gazes involuntarily swept over Qing Tong and Long Chong.
Neither of them looked anywhere but straight ahead, ignoring everyone's stares.
After the discussion was concluded, everyone began to prepare.
Zhong Ling and two others took out stacks of Array Flag Array Plates and many green wooden columns, beginning to set up the Ten Thousand Wood Formation. The leaders of each team also started assigning tasks to their members.
Yuan Ming, Long Chong, and two others gathered together to discuss their next moves.
"We'll be acting together with Huan Ling Zi, Qing Tong, and others. Everyone, be cautious and on guard against any underhanded tactics they might deploy," Yuan Ming reminded the three.
"As if they would dare," Long Chong snorted coldly as he spoke.
"You shouldn't be careless," Qiong Yun said discontentedly.
Yuan Ming, using his Emotion Manipulation Ability, sensed Huan Ling Zi and Qing Tong were filled with resentment and might not hesitate to take a risk. He was about to say something when he suddenly heard Hong Ling's voice in his Sea of Consciousness:
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, Blood Shadow and I are getting extremely bored in the Shura Blood Devouring Map. The Fire Crocodiles are tough to handle, but we can help if needed."
"Fellow Daoists, I appreciate your offer, but in this situation, it's not appropriate for you to join," Yuan Ming hesitated slightly before replying mentally.
The authentic version is on *.
"Don't worry, we'll be very careful not to let others notice," Hong Ling said.
"No need, the two of you just stay in the Shura Blood Devouring Map," Yuan Ming didn't hesitate this time and refused outright.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, let me be frank with you. Surely you know that we Blood Slaves of the Shura Blood Devouring Map need pure Qi Blood Power to live and cultivate. The Qi Blood Power inside the map has been exhausted, and those Fire Crocodiles in the Magma Lake are huge and full of vigorous blood energy; we can smell it even through the Magic Treasure. There are many of them, perfect for refining into Blood Origin Power," Blood Shadow chimed in.
"Oh, is that so?" Yuan Ming was noncommittal.
He naturally knew Hong Ling and Blood Shadow needed Qi Blood Power for cultivation. Both were at the Nascent Soul Stage, favored by the Shura Master to be refined into the Shura Blood Devouring Map. Their talents were undoubtedly excellent, and a continuous supply of Qi Blood Power could potentially enable them to break through to even higher realms.
Yuan Ming's cultivation was only at the early-stage Core Formation, and his understanding of the Shura Blood Devouring Map's sacrifice rituals was not profound enough. Having Hong Ling and Blood Shadow being too powerful was not necessarily a good thing.
"Collecting Qi Blood Power isn't just for us. Fellow Daoist Yuan, I hear that the second layer of your Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill is about to reach perfection. You'll need a lot of Qi Blood Power for cultivation, and opportunities to store Qi Blood Power like this are rare," seeing Yuan Ming starting to hesitate, Hong Ling hurriedly added.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming was somewhat tempted.
If he encountered one or two more Star Rains soon, his Iron Bone Body could be completed, and indeed he would need a lot of pure Qi Blood afterward.
"Alright, I can let you capture some Fire Crocodiles later, but no one must notice it's my doing," he pondered briefly before replying mentally.
"Don't worry, we have our ways. No one will find out it's related to you," Hong Ling quickly said.
Soon, the rest of the group was also ready, and everyone began to move.
Although it was a joint effort, the various parties largely kept to their own teams, dividing into three groups to attack the Fire Crocodiles in the lake's center from three different directions.
Yuan Ming only had Wulu, Long Chong, and Qiong Yun to help him hold off the Fire Crocodiles on his side, making them rather underpowered. Unable to spare anyone to assist, he had to discuss with Huan Ling Zi to have someone from his side join them.
Expecting Huan Ling Zi to refuse, Yuan Ming was surprised when he agreed quite readily, promptly sending Qing Tong over.
When Yuan Ming saw that Qing Tong was the one sent over, he considered refusing, but Golden Cloud Fairy had already started urging, "Don't dawdle, if we encounter another Star Rain, things will only get worse. Let's get started."
"Fellow Daoist Qing Tong, who would have thought we'll be acting together next. Please give us your guidance," Long Chong turned to Qing Tong and said with a chuckle.
The latter merely grinned nonchalantly.
Once everyone was ready, Daoist Qian Bao gave the command, and Zhong Ling, Hua Ping, and Baili Zhui were the first to take action.
They sat cross-legged on the edge of the Magma Lake, each holding a blue disc in their hands, beginning to press the discs while closing their eyes to cast.
As their Mana flowed into the discs, the discs quickly lit up with blue-green light, forming rings of blue-green light under them that rippled outward like water.
Where the blue light passed, the ground thrived, growing a layer of blue moss.
Along the lakeshore, the blue wooden stakes they had previously buried came to life one by one, twisting and growing into towering blue trees.
The trees had no leaves, but rather hung down thick vines.
"Begin," Daoist Qian Bao commanded loudly.
The dozens of towering trees immediately twisted their trunks and, like living creatures, began to swing their vines towards the lake's surface.
"Pa pa"
A series of cracking sounds followed as the tree vines, which were highly fire-resistant, splashed innumerable sparks in the rolling magma, yet did not burn up.
The previously calm Fire Crocodiles were disturbed anew and surfaced again.
However, because the vine's impact area was so extensive, this time dozens of Fire Crocodiles were stirred up simultaneously, each fiercely snapping at the vines.

chapters.title: Chapter 517 - 493 Golden Lotus
chapters.content:
Facing the sharp teeth of so many Fire Crocodiles and the spewing molten lava, the giant tree's vines, despite their fire resistance, could not last too long. They were quickly bitten and burnt off by a large margin.
However, over the broken vines, a green light soon flowed, and the severed parts regrew at a speed visible to the naked eye. It was as if they were not affected at all, continuing to attack the Fire Crocodiles.
Even so, the vines ultimately had limited strength. They restrained about half of the Fire Crocodiles, and then had no extra strength to spare. Even so, this greatly reduced the risk of crossing the Magma Lake.
"Fellow Daoists, I'm taking the lead!" Daoist Qian Bao said to Yuan Ming and the Golden Cloud Fairy.
Before his words fell, his figure had already darted forward, leaping over the vines toward the direction close to the center of the lake.
Below, in the lake, several Fire Crocodiles turned their attention and, while spitting molten lava, also pursued him.
Seeing this, Daoist Qian Bao calmly drew his hands apart and then brought them together in front of him. A burst of golden light suddenly surfaced, enveloping his entire body, making it impossible to discern what Magic Treasure was inside.
Without any visible signs of Daoist Qian Bao's activation, seven or eight fluttering golden talisman papers fell from the golden light, bearing runes that looked quite unusual, resembling humanoid figures.
A few golden talismans flashed with spirit light and astonishingly transformed into several Daoist Qian Baos. They were identical to the real one in terms of shape, appearance, and even aura fluctuations, with no flaws visible.
"Is that an Illusion Talisman?" Yuan Ming, about to take off, said with some surprise.
"It's a Yin Yang Shadow Transformation Talisman, much more powerful than ordinary Illusion Talismans," Xi Ying's voice rang in his Sea of Consciousness.
The clones of Daoist Qian Bao scattered in all directions, instantly attracting several Fire Crocodiles away.
Xue Jiao and Hou Santong, covering for Daoist Qian Bao, hurriedly flew into the Magma Lake and each used their means to attract the attention of the Fire Crocodiles in the lake, leading them away from the center of the lake.
Without the interference of the Fire Crocodiles, the pressure on Daoist Qian Bao significantly decreased, and he accelerated toward the center of the lake at high speed.
Yuan Ming and the Golden Cloud Fairy no longer hesitated and almost simultaneously flew into the Magma Lake.
Long Chong and Qiong Yun shot out like lightning, rushing ahead of Yuan Ming into the Magma Lake. They took out their Magic Treasures and provocatively attacked the nearby four or five Fire Crocodiles, drawing their attention.
Wulu did not hurry to act. He waited until Qing Tong started and flew into the range of the lake, then followed closely behind.
On the other side, Huan Ling Zi, Yun Jiuxiao, and Bing Xin were responsible for protecting the Golden Cloud Fairy. Huan Ling Zi glanced in Yuan Ming's direction, then immediately led the other two into the lake above.
More than a dozen Core Formation Stage cultivators took action together, and the Magma Lake erupted like a boiling pot, splashing up countless flaming waves. Meanwhile, more than a dozen Fire Crocodiles emerged, but most were consciously led away by the few cultivators covering for them.
Suddenly, near the lake center, there appeared a circle where Fire Crocodiles were scarce.
Seeing this, Daoist Qian Bao's feet flashed with green light, revealing a leaf-shaped Flying Shuttle emitting a faint green light. His figure flickered, and he turned into a stream of light, shooting full speed toward the center of the lake.
Immediately following him, the Golden Cloud Fairy waved her hand, and a spirit bird of several zhang in size and golden all over appeared out of nowhere, lifting her up.
This golden Spirit Bird, shaped like a crow, had exceptionally brilliant feathers, like a bundle of golden flames.
The Spirit Bird spread its wings and traced a golden streak across the Magma Lake, heading toward the center of the lake with a speed not much slower than Daoist Qian Bao, who had sprinted ahead earlier.
Behind them, Yuan Ming gave the golden Spirit Bird another glance, then likewise summoned Lei Yu, mounting it and ordering it to use its Flying Escape Divine Ability.
Under a splendid cover of lightning, Yuan Ming and Lei Yu disappeared from their spot, and the next moment they arrived above the rocks at the center of the lake.
Lei Yu, having refined that Demon Core during the previous arena battle, now had its strength at the Third-level Middle Stage, and tunneling speed was also much faster than before. However, the Magic Treasures and spiritual bird of Daoist Qian Bao and the Golden Cloud Fairy were also of extraordinary origins; thus, the three of them arrived almost simultaneously.
Daoist Qian Bao and the Golden Cloud Fairy saw that Yuan Ming's speed was not inferior to theirs; if truth be told, there was even a sense of being last to start but first to arrive. Both were quite surprised.
But with time pressing, they had no spare time to bother with much else. Each released a light palm, grabbing towards the Earth Core Fire Lotus below.
Just at that moment, a sudden change occurred!
The surface of the Magma Lake near the Earth Core Fire Lotus suddenly exploded, and amidst the splashing molten lava, several massive crocodilian beasts emerged.
They were unequivocally nine Fire Crocodiles, double the size of those outside and also much stronger than the ones outside. Each one had reached the Third-level Upper Stage.
These giant Fire Crocodiles snapped their jaws, easily shredding Daoist Qian Bao and the Golden Cloud Fairy's light palms.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
Nine thick Magma Fire Columns erupted, each fiercely striking at the three cultivators.
"These strongest ones had indeed appeared as expected," Yuan Ming wasn't surprised by the appearance of these colossal Fire Crocodiles. He commanded Lei Yu to cut diagonally forward, easily dodging in the nick of time.
Daoist Qian Bao and the Golden Cloud Fairy were not as composed as Yuan Ming; they were surrounded by several Magma Fire Columns with no time to dodge.
However, the two of them did not panic. Daoist Qian Bao spat out a black net that soared towards the four Magma Fire Columns attacking him.
The unimpressive black net emitted only a faint black light, yet it blocked all the magma flames without trembling at all.
Golden Cloud Fairy's spirit bird beneath her spread its wings, and a vast expanse of golden fire clouds unfolded, into which the searing magma fire columns crashed and vanished without a trace as though they had sunk into the sea.
Yuan Ming nodded to himself. Daoist Qian Bao and Golden Cloud Fairy had come to pick the Fire Lotuses with careful consideration, clearly having their own means at hand.
He lightly tapped his finger, and two streaks of white cold light fell, striking two giant Fire Crocodiles that were closest to him.
Crack! Crack!
The two Fire Crocodiles, about to leap up, turned into ice sticks upon being struck by the white light and plummeted into the Magma Lake, the frost on their bodies melting rapidly.
Although this move couldn't truly harm the Fire Crocodiles, it was enough to restrain them for a moment.Firstseenon*.
In the blink of an eye, Yuan Ming, riding Lei Yu, approached the Fire Lotuses at high speed, and with a swoop of a green palm, he grabbed two Fire Lotuses and plucked them.
"Two Fire Lotuses in hand!"
Yuan Ming collected them joyfully. Lei Yu had already climbed to a higher altitude, evading the attacks of two giant Fire Crocodiles that had just freed themselves.
Had these giant Fire Crocodiles concentrated their attacks on him alone, Yuan Ming would have been somewhat wary, but now that they had divided into three groups, they posed no threat to him at all.
Seeing Yuan Ming successfully pluck two Fire Lotuses, Daoist Qian Bao, still entangled by several Fire Crocodiles, had a flicker of urgency cross his face. He shot a golden, dazzling rope from his sleeve, binding two giant Fire Crocodiles.
A dark net also shot down like a shooting star, covering the remaining two giant Fire Crocodiles.
Taking advantage of the Fire Crocodiles' struggles, Daoist Qian Bao flew a curve downward on his Flying Shuttle and with both hands rapidly picked two Fire Lotuses and gathered them into his pouch.
On the other side, Golden Cloud Fairy formed hand seals; strands of golden thunderfire fell from the fire clouds, striking the remaining few giant crocodiles.
The golden thunderfire, of some unknown Divine Skill, easily penetrated the scale armor of these Fire Crocodiles; several of them were severely wounded, their innards exposed, and they hurriedly dived into the depths of the Magma Lake.
Yuan Ming raised an eyebrow; although these Fire Crocodiles dived into the magma, their presence leaked out clearly, starkly different from before when their presence completely vanished as soon as they submerged.
"Could it be that the reason these Fire Crocodiles can conceal their presence is due to their crocodile skin? With the scale armor of these three giants broken, they can no longer hide their presence," he mused silently.
In the meantime, Golden Cloud Fairy sent down a golden spirit light, enveloping three Earth Core Fire Lotuses and collecting them.
With no Fire Crocodiles harassing them, the three people swiftly picked the Earth Core Fire Lotuses, and soon each had gathered seven or eight. There were not many Fire Lotuses left.
"Forget the other Earth Core Fire Lotuses. Pick that Golden Lotus ahead!" Just then, Xi Ying's voice rang in Yuan Ming's ears.
Yuan Ming looked forward and saw that beside a black rock, under a lotus leaf, there grew an Earth Core Fire Lotus that did not seem to have fully bloomed. The crimson petals tinged with flecks of gold, emitting a faint golden shimmer, more mysterious than the other Earth Core Fire Lotuses.
His eyes lit up as he soared over to it, preparing to continue picking, when an unusual fluctuation emitted from the black rock beside him, revealing a layer of earthy yellow halo.
Suddenly, a figure emerged from the halo, arms outstretched, grabbing at the Golden Lotus and another Earth Core Fire Lotus.
Yuan Ming frowned slightly. The person was none other than Di Hua, the cultivator from Earth Beauty Island, who had yet to show himself.
This fellow hadn't come with the others but had somehow stealthily tunneled here using some secret technique, taking advantage of the opportunity others had fought for to covertly pick the Earth Core Fire Lotuses.
Yuan Ming snorted coldly and stimulated the Soul Destroying Sword nurtured in his Dantian. The Annihilation Rune on the sword lit up, and a wave of invisible fluctuation spread out.
Everything went dark before Tu Sheng's eyes; he could see nothing, hear nothing, and his sense of smell and Divine Sense were also suddenly cut off.
"Who's messing with me!" Tu Sheng bellowed in shock and anger.
Before the words fell, his vision cleared, and his hearing, sense of smell, and Divine Sense returned to normal.
However, the golden lotus that he had held in his hands had vanished without a trace, now appearing in Yuan Ming's hands a few meters away.
Tu Sheng stood there, stupefied, not understanding what had just happened or how Yuan Ming had used some technique to take the Golden Lotus.
However, he didn't argue with Yuan Ming, gathered the Earth Core Fire Lotus in his hand, and reached out to pick a third one.
But at that moment, without any warning, a wave of magma several meters high surged up from beneath Tu Sheng, crashing onto him with a force that seemed enough to move mountains.
The Protective Light Ring around Tu Sheng shattered on impact, his bones snapping audibly, his plump body flying away as he spat blood profusely.
From the appearance of Tu Sheng stealing the Golden Lotus, to Yuan Ming employing a technique to take it away, to Tu Sheng being struck and sent flying, although the sequence seems complicated, it all happened in just two to three breaths' time.
Daoist Qian Bao and Golden Cloud Fairy, upon witnessing this event, ceased their picking of the Fire Lotuses and retreated in flight, both inwardly taken aback.
Tu Sheng, seemingly harmless with his short and plump figure and always smiling countenance, possessed Earth Attribute Divine Skills that were profound and mystical, particularly his defensive abilities, and yet he had been grievously injured in one strike!
Yuan Ming was also somewhat surprised, controlling Lei Yu to retreat while he also looked toward where the Magma Lake had surged.

chapters.title: Chapter 518 - 518: 494 Chapter: Outbreak
chapters.content:
Under the watchful eyes of Yuan Ming and his two companions, the surface of the Magma Lake suddenly bulged, forming a colossal blister.
Inside the blister was the enormous skull of a Fire Crocodile, its eyes shining with a dark golden luster, emitting a terrifying aura far superior to the others in the lake, albeit slightly unstable.
"A Level 4 Fire Crocodile King! With the advantage of the terrain, even a Nascent Soul cultivator might not be its match, retreat quickly!" Daoist Qian Bao immediately summoned his Green Leaf Shuttle and fled towards the outside.
The Golden Cloud Fairy's eyes also became solemn, and with a slap on the Spirit Bird beneath her, she turned into a beam of Golden Light and shot toward the shore.
Though severely injured, Tu Sheng had not lost the ability to move; he struggled to reach a nearby black rock.
Yuan Ming's eyes flickered, and, carrying Lei Yu, he too took flight to escape, only his movements were a moment slower than the other three.
The Fire Crocodile King's eyes nearly spat fire. It had just been at the bottom of its nest in the Magma Lake, attempting to break through to the middle level of Level 4, when these damned Human Clan's cultivators arrived at this critical moment, causing its efforts to fail and stealing most of the Earth Core Fire Lotuses.
Without killing all the intruders, it would be hard to quell the hatred in its heart.
The Fire Crocodile King spat out a Round Orb burning with red flames. The terrifyingly high temperature swept through the area as if a miniature Sun had descended into the mortal world, merging with the Magma Lake.
Boom!
The temperature at the center of the lake instantly skyrocketed, causing nature's spiritual energy to boil, various auras surged violently, turning the entire lake surface into a chaotic mess.
With a flick of its tail, the Fire Crocodile King caused half of the lake's Molten Lava to surge, forming a sky-high tide that crashed towards the four people at the heart of the lake.
"Good, just when I was hoping for it!" Yuan Ming felt a surge of elation within his heart, but on his face, he displayed an expression of terror and stopped his flight.
In his hands, the chill surged, and large pieces of Ice Crystal appeared out of nowhere; in the blink of an eye, they condensed into a massive ice sphere, enveloping his body within.
Tu Sheng's face turned pale, but fortunately, he had already reached the black rock and merged into the rock with a flicker, vanishing in an instant.
Golden Cloud Fairy and Qian Bao were also startled and hurriedly increased their tunneling speed.
However, the Fire Crocodile King's attack was too vast in range, and despite fleeing with all their might, they were still engulfed by the sky-darkening Molten Lava.
Yuan Ming's figure was swallowed by the molten rock and pulled to the bottom of the lake.
Amid the assault of the searing Molten Lava around him, the white ice sphere kept melting away; however, the Frost formed by the Cold Moon Ring was extremely solid and contained astonishing coldness. Along with Yuan Ming continually stimulating and pouring more chill into it, it did not melt quickly.
"I can finally act freely!" Yuan Ming moved his shoulders and stimulated the Cold Moon Ring to shoot out a ray of white frost light to resist the erosion of the Molten Lava while quietly unfolding the Shura Blood Devouring Map.
Hong Ling and Blood Shadow flew out and dove into the Magma Lake.
The Fire Crocodile King propelled its limbs and rapidly moved through the Magma, pouncing towards Golden Cloud Fairy at the lake's bottom, its aura completely Concealed, not a trace leaking out.
The complexion of Golden Cloud Fairy was slightly pale, but judging from her aura, she was not injured.
The Fire Cloud around her thickened several times, easily keeping the blazing Molten Lava at bay. She controlled the Golden Spirit Bird to fly upwards, unaware of the approaching danger.
Within moments, the Fire Crocodile King leaped within several feet behind Golden Cloud Fairy and viciously bit down with its gaping jaws.
Suddenly, the Spirit Bird beneath Golden Cloud Fairy let out a terrified shriek, and only then did Golden Cloud Fairy notice the danger behind her, her face dramatically changing.
At that moment, a Blood Shadow shot from the side – it was a red-clothed woman.
The woman seemed unaffected by the intense heat of the Molten Lava, not displaying any Protective Body methods. With a casual reach of her hand, she made a grabbing motion.
The Fire Crocodile King's body tensed as if ensnared by an invisible net, completely unseen, its sword-like fangs halting an inch behind Golden Cloud Fairy.
Golden Cloud Fairy was greatly startled, gave a brief glance to the red-clothed woman, and continued to fly upward.
Enraged and shocked, the Fire Crocodile King lashed out at the invisible net around it, trying to tear it apart.
Yet its claws seemed to stick to the net, and its entire body was as trapped as a fly in a spider's web, struggling even for the slightest movement, with no strength to call upon.
A Blood Cloud shot from the other side, enveloping the Fire Crocodile along with the blood-colored net.
"Such rich Qi-Blood! Haha, today I can finally drink to my heart's content!" Nine Blood Shadows shot out from the Blood Cloud with eerie cackles, merging into the Fire Crocodile King's body.
A chill spread through the Fire Crocodile King's body as its strength rapidly drained and a sense of impending doom arose. A large area of red Flames burst forth from its body, and the nearby Molten Lava suddenly surged like tidal waves.
Golden Cloud Fairy flew out of the Magma Lake, immediately ascended into the air, and only after gaining a little distance dared to turn back and look.
The turbulent surface of the Magma Lake bulged once more, as several Magma Fire Columns, each dozens of feet high, rose from the lake, colliding violently.
Within the tumultuous Magma Lake, two blood-red demonic shadows battling fiercely with the Fire Crocodile King could be vaguely seen. The power they unleashed was astonishing, far exceeding the Core Formation Stage.
"The red-clothed woman just now must be a Nascent Soul existence! But aren't Nascent Soul cultivators not allowed to enter the Secret Realm? Who is she?" Golden Cloud Fairy's brows furrowed deeply.
As she pondered, she didn't halt but continued her escape toward the outside.
Below the Magma tidal waves, suddenly burst forth a thick blood-red radiance so intense that it even surpassed the Magma itself, as if an abundance of thick blood had been poured into it.
Yet, when the tidal waves had passed, the blood-red radiance abruptly disappeared as if it had never existed.
And with it, the figure of the Level 4 Fire Crocodile King also vanished.
Like lightning, Golden Cloud Fairy swiftly reached the lakeside and landed on a high piece of ground.
Long Chong, Qing Tong, and others who had been restraining other Fire Crocodiles, seeing the unfavorable situation, had all withdrawn and returned.
The Fire Crocodiles did not pursue them, they all pounced towards the center of the Magma Lake with a mix of shock and fury in their eyes.
At that moment, intense Blood Light surged once again from within the Magma Lake, and around a dozen Fire Crocodiles suddenly sank to the bottom of the lake as if dragged down by something.
In the next instant, the intense Blood Light abruptly disappeared.
A group of people on the shore watched with cold sweat streaming down; these Fire Crocodiles should have had the advantage in the Magma Lake, dragging down other prey, yet now they themselves had been pulled under!
What monster were those Blood Lights?
Golden Cloud Fairy's heart was shocked and incomprehensible, then her pupils suddenly constricted.
In the churning center of the Magma Lake, the ring of reefs had been destroyed almost completely, and within the black reefs, the remaining Earth Core Fire Lotus had vanished without a trace at some unknown time.
"Fellow Daoist Jin Yun, what's happening? Where are Qian Bao and Fellow Daoist Yuan?" Long Chong asked the Golden Cloud Fairy with a somber look on his face.
A stumbling green tunneling light shot out from the Magma Lake and landed near everyone, revealing the battered figure of Daoist Qian Bao.
Almost simultaneously, a yellow light flashed over the ground behind everyone, and Tu Sheng burst out from the Earth.
He was already severely injured and had forcibly used the Earth Escape Technique, exacerbating his wounds, and he collapsed onto the ground with a heavy thud.
Tu Sheng took out a green Jade Bottle and without regard for how much was inside, he poured all the elixirs into his mouth and swallowed them, making his pale complexion slightly better looking.
Seeing the two appear, Long Chong was overjoyed and was about to inquire about Yuan Ming's situation.
But at that moment, another change occurred!
A dull roaring sound emanated from beneath the Magma Lake, resembling the howl of an ancient beast or thunder suppressed by heavy clouds.
The ground nearby began to shake violently soon after.
"Gurgle, gurgle, gurgle..."
In the Magma Lake, large bubbles emerged like in a boiling hotpot, accompanied by thick smoke rising up. The bottom of the lake seemed to have suddenly gained a spring that was spewing out Molten Lava, with scorching breaths puffing out, and diffusing an intense sulfur smell.
"Something's not right, this Magma Lake is about to erupt, let's go!" Qian Bao's expression changed slightly as he shouted.
He maneuvered the Green Leaf Shuttle and hastily retreated, with the Golden Cloud Fairy closely following on a golden bird.
Tu Sheng, pushing through on his last breath, used the Earth Escape Technique again to dive into the ground.
No one dared to linger, all fleeing immediately.
Zhong Ling, Hua Ping, and Baili Zhui, who were guarding the outermost perimeter and controlling the Ten Thousand Wood Formation, were the furthest away but fled the fastest. They even left behind the wooden stakes used for the array, escaping towards the edge of the continent.
In a blink, only Long Chong, Qiong Yun, and Wulu were left by the lake, not yet moving.
"Let's go, what are you dawdling for?" Qiong Yun urged Long Chong to leave.Enjoying the story? Find more at *.
"Brother Yuan hasn't come out yet, how can we abandon him?" Long Chong did not move and anxiously looked at the turbid lake surface.
"Brother Long, Brother Yuan is very strong. If he's still alive, he must have a strategy to escape unscathed. By staying here, you may harm others as well as yourself. It's better to leave now," Wulu also urged urgently.
With a "boom," the suppressed Magma Lake finally erupted!
A huge crimson pillar of fire ascended from the Magma Lake, reaching for the sky with intensely hot Molten Lava and dark smoke, mingled with countless fragments of rock shooting in all directions!
Not only that, the ground near the Magma Lake was also slowly swelling.
So was the ground under the feet of Wulu and the others, as thick smoke drilled out from beneath, seemingly also about to spew out volcanic lava.
"No good, the terrain nearby is going to collapse as well, run!" Wulu couldn't care less about Long Chong anymore and turned into a black light flying towards the distance.
Seeing the situation, Long Chong dared not insist any longer and, along with Qiong Yun, took to the air.
The moment the two had taken off, the ground beneath them burst open, and a thick column of Molten Lava surged towards them.
"Dodge quick!" Long Chong pushed Qiong Yun away with force while he used the momentum to shoot backward, barely avoiding the scorching lava.
Boom, boom, boom!
One Magma Fire Column after another rushed into the sky, the dispersing Molten Lava turning into a sky full of fiery rain, bringing up countless thick smokes, submerging the Magma Lake and a vast area nearby in a scene of apocalyptic destruction.
Long Chong was the last to leave, and now, with Molten Lava and thick smoke all around him, he didn't dare to be careless. He rushed this way and that, struggling to escape.
With a roar, another hot Magma Fire Column burst from the ground.
Long Chong quickly moved sideways to evade, but from the smoke behind, a green light suddenly flashed, and Qing Tong's figure appeared abruptly.
"Die," a trace of mad killing intent surfaced in his eyes.
A flash of green shadow passed, and Long Chong suddenly felt a chilly sensation from behind. Sensing danger, he promptly released his Protective Treasure Light.
But in the next moment, a powerful force struck him in the lower back.
Caught off guard, Long Chong was sent flying, heading straight for the Magma Fire Column.

chapters.title: Chapter 519 - 495 Ambush
chapters.content:
"Qing Tong, you thief..."
Long Chong cursed angrily but did not have time to counterattack. He struggled to control his body that had been flung away.
Yet the hit from the other party was somehow strange; a kind of insidious power entered his body, making the circulation of his mana sluggish, and for a moment, he couldn't control his own body. He could only watch helplessly as he hurtled toward a Magma Fire Column.
What was worse, a Fire Crocodile suddenly emerged from within the Magma Fire Column with a splash, seemingly swept up by the underground magma and utterly panicked.
Seeing Long Chong crashing toward it, the Fire Crocodile opened its gaping maw and bit towards his waist.
The two were extremely close, and with Long Chong's mana disobedient, it seemed he would be bitten in half.
At the critical moment, a streak of cold light flew out from his body—it was Long Chong's Winter Flood Dragon Spirit Beast rushing out, placing itself in front of him.
"Han'er, move away!" Long Chong saw this and shouted anxiously.
However, the Winter Flood Dragon, focused on protecting its master, did not hesitate and crashed into the Fire Crocodile.
The Fire Crocodile's massive jaws snapped shut, sharp crocodile teeth piercing through the Winter Flood Dragon's scales and fiercely biting into its neck.
Shattered scales, accompanied by blue blood, splattered; the Winter Flood Dragon let out a piercing scream, yet it did not dodge and clutched the Fire Crocodile's body with its powerful claws, holding it fast to prevent it from harming its master behind it.
The cold aura emanating from the Winter Flood Dragon clashed with the heat from the magma, causing large swathes of vapor to rise.
The next moment, Long Chong's body collided with the Winter Flood Dragon's, finally stopping his momentum and he immediately leaped to the rescue.
He stepped on the back of the Winter Flood Dragon and, regardless of the sluggish mana, forcefully spurred his spear, stabbing at the Fire Crocodile's head.
Alas, his mana was restricted at the moment, and the skin of the Fire Crocodile was particularly tough; the spear only pierced through a few scales, hardly causing much damage.
In pain, the Fire Crocodile rolled, biting and pulling the Winter Flood Dragon towards the Magma Fire Column.
The body of the Winter Flood Dragon was half-dipped into the scorching magma, its fine scales immediately turning red-hot.
Just as the dragon was about to be completely submerged by the Magma Fire Column, a flash of lightning burst from the mist.
Amidst the "crackle and buzz" of electric current, the figures of Yuan Ming and Lei Yu appeared.
Lei Yu unleashed his Thunder Strike Divine Ability, a thick bolt of lightning striking the Fire Crocodile's head.
Bright arcs spread and danced over the crocodile's body. The creature convulsed, and its mouth that was clamped on the Winter Flood Dragon instantly loosened.
Long Chong was overjoyed and swiftly pulled the Winter Flood Dragon, flying away to a distance.
Yuan Ming flicked his finger, sending a streak of white cold light at the Fire Crocodile.
With a "crack" sound, the body of the Fire Crocodile froze into an ice lolly.
Yuan Ming shook his hand and shot out a stream of Blood Light, wrapping around the Fire Crocodile and pulling it into the Shura Blood Devouring Map. He then rode on Lei Yu, quickly catching up with Long Chong.
Qiong Yun had just arrived in time, summoning his Thunder Flood Dragon Spirit Beast, carrying Long Chong and fleeing outward.
The Winter Flood Dragon Spirit Beast was nowhere to be seen, apparently having been taken into its Spiritual Beast Bag.
"Brother Yuan, you're unharmed? That's great!" Qiong Yun, seeing Yuan Ming, showed a relieved expression.
"Barely escaped with my life. This place is not safe; let's get out first," said Yuan Ming, controlling Lei Yu to fly forward.
"Brother Yuan, I cannot thank you enough for your great kindness. Did you see Qing Tong on your way here?" Long Chong clasped his hands towards Yuan Ming and spoke through gritted teeth.
"No, he vanished immediately after the sneak attack on you; he wouldn't possibly be lingering nearby," replied Yuan Ming, shaking his head.
"That scoundrel, I will never let him off the hook!" Long Chong's eyes were bloodshot, like a furious beast, he uttered with hatred.
As they spoke, the three of them sped away, the erupting volcano behind them grew smaller and smaller, and they soon arrived at a safe area.
The crowd that had escaped ahead of them was there, except for Tu Sheng, all were present, including Wulu.
Seeing the three of them arrive and that Yuan Ming was among them, the crowd had varying expressions, most of them joyous.
Yuan Ming had quite a few Earth Core Fire Lotuses on him, and his survival meant an increase to everyone's gains.
"Qing Tong! Come out and face your death!" A thunderous roar erupted, disrupting everyone's thoughts.
Long Chong, his face twisted with rage, morphed into one with his spear, turning into a blue streak of light, lunging directly at Qing Tong in the crowd.
After regaining his breath, the sense of sluggishness in his body had disappeared, leaving only a burning rage to be vented.
Qing Tong, fearless, drew a pair of black swords from his hands, making a cross-cut.
A loud clang of metal striking metal echoed!
The spear and the swords clashed, then separated, causing a strong wind to blow, making several people nearby stagger back.
"Stop it, you two! Fellow Daoists have just fought side by side, why is this happening?" Daoist Qian Bao frowned and asked.
"What's this? If you want to fight, take it elsewhere!"
"The two of you might as well settle life and death directly, once and for all. Don't waste our time," one commented.
The others, eager to divide the Earth Core Fire Lotus, also looked at Long Chong with displeasure.
"Long Chong, don't be impulsive. Tell us what happened to you; I believe everyone will give you justice," said Qiong Yun, stepping forward and giving Long Chong a tug.
Upon hearing this, the others realized that there was more to the story and became curious.
Long Chong took a deep breath, calmed down, and looked around. "Fellow Daoists, before we cooperated to retrieve the treasure, we agreed that no one shall attack a companion during the cooperation period. Otherwise, the offender shall be treated as a traitor, expelled, and must return all the treasures obtained in the secret realm. Do you all remember this?"
"Indeed, we did agree to this," Daoist Qian Bao nodded.
"Just now, when the Magma Lake erupted, and everyone was fleeing, this scoundrel took advantage of my distraction and suddenly attacked me, almost causing me to die at the jaws of the Fire Crocodile. Tell me, shouldn't I kill him?" Long Chong suppressed his anger and pointed at Qing Tong as he questioned the crowd.
Upon hearing that, everyone's expressions changed.T+hi@s copy was gene#ra+t+e$d fr%o$m c-on*ten-t at MV|LEMP&Y-R&.
It was already made clear that no one should attack a companion. Would Qing Tong really take such a great risk and harm Long Chong?
"You say I ambushed you, so I ambushed you? Baseless accusations, fabricating lies—I could also claim that you ambushed me!" Qing Tong, certain that during the previous chaos, everyone was too focused on saving themselves to notice anything here, scoffed.
After that, he looked Long Chong up and down and said, "He claims I ambushed him. Look at him—does he have the slightest sign of being attacked?"
Upon hearing this, everyone examined Long Chong closely, displaying hesitant expressions.
Although Long Chong indeed looked disheveled before, he did not seem to have any injuries, and his appearance seemed intact, not at all like someone who had been ambushed.
Long Chong's eyes flared with greater fury as he slapped his Spiritual Beast Bag at his waist and brought out his spirit pet, the Winter Flood Dragon.
"I wasn't injured because my loyal spirit pet protected its master and took all the injuries for me," Long Chong declared indignantly.
People around looked at the ground, only to see that half of the scales on the Winter Flood Dragon were already off, its body severely burned, with several appalling bloody holes on its neck, blackened and charred.
"These injuries are not light…" Daoist Qian Bao frowned.
East Sea cultivators highly valued their spirit beasts; it was unlikely Long Chong would use his own spirit pet to stage such defamatory theatrics.
"Fellow Daoist Long, this is the Cold Dew Jade Skin Powder produced by my Golden Turtle Island, which can reduce some of the pain for your spirit pet and also aid its recovery. Use some on it," Daoist Qian Bao took out a White Jade Porcelain Bottle and handed it to Long Chong.
"Thank you, Daoist Qian Bao." Long Chong was not bashful, took the Jade Bottle, and applied the blue ointment inside to the Winter Flood Dragon's wounds.
The wounds on the Winter Flood Dragon immediately emitted a blue glow, forming a thin blue membrane that covered the wounds, radiating silken strands of coldness, greatly alleviating its pain.
Long Chong's face showed joy, and he thanked Daoist Qian Bao once again.
"Fellow Daoist Long, your spirit beast is indeed gravely injured, and I do sympathize. However, sympathy aside, you cannot use your spirit beast to garner sympathy and blame me. If you don't have solid evidence, I can only consider your words as slander," Qing Tong said, feeling inwardly delighted to see the Winter Flood Dragon's severe injury but claiming otherwise with his mouth.
"You thief..." In a surge of rage, Long Chong was about to curse vehemently.
"Fellow Daoist Long, what Fellow Daoist Qing Tong said is not entirely without reason. To accuse him of an ambush, you still need direct evidence; otherwise, it will be difficult for everyone to administer justice for you," Huan Ling Zi said.
Upon these words, the rest looked toward Long Chong, waiting for him to present more evidence.
Long Chong was momentarily at a loss for words. The anomaly on his body had disappeared and couldn't serve as evidence against Qing Tong. Additionally, since no one witnessed the event, he indeed lacked substantial evidence.
Seeing him speechless, Qing Tong's smile began to grow more insolent.
"See for yourselves, everyone? Long Chong has no evidence because he is simply slandering me, trying to strip me of my right to divide the Earth Core Fire Lotus and coveting the treasures I obtained from the secret realm. Such behavior is utterly despicable. I suggest depriving him of his right to the Fire Lotus distribution!" Qing Tong advocated arrogantly.
"If it is indeed false accusation, such a request doesn't seem excessive," Huan Ling Zi stroked his chin, feigning contemplation.
"To slander a fellow daoist is no different from dark treachery. He should also hand over the treasures obtained from the secret realm and share them with the rest," Hou Santong said with disdain, his voice booming.
"Indeed..."
"That's right..."
Hearing they might gain additional loot, the rest responded eagerly.
"I too believe what you are saying is utterly correct," just then, Yuan Ming's voice suddenly rang out.
Upon hearing this, Long Chong looked incredulously towards Yuan Ming.
Qiong Yun was also shocked, while only Wulu remained serene, even with a slight smirk on his lips.
He knew Yuan Ming too well; that demeanor of his usually meant he was about to stir up trouble.
"However..." Yuan Ming paused, drawing all eyes to him.
"If I produce evidence, should Fellow Daoist Qing Tong also pay the appropriate price? Hand over the treasures, lose the qualifications, expel him from the team, and no one else shall ally with him anymore?" Yuan Ming asked slowly and methodically.
"Of course," everyone agreed, given the previous discussion, they didn't mind the escalation of the proposed punishment.
"If Fellow Daoist Yuan has evidence, then please present it, and we will deal with it impartially," said Daoist Qian Bao.
Qing Tong, seeing Yuan Ming's confident tone, felt an unreasonable tightness in his heart, sensing that something was amiss.
As Huan Ling Zi watched this, his expression hardly changed, but he watched Yuan Ming intently without blinking.

chapters.title: Chapter 520 - 496: Exposing in Public
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming looked around at everyone, then twisted his wrist and took out a white jade album, which was the Imaging Jade Album he had obtained from Lu Da of the Wu Yue Sect.
"This object is a Recording Artifact that can record the recent images. I believe everyone is familiar with it. Unfortunately, the scene of Qing Tong's sneak attack on Brother Long was recorded in it," Yuan Ming said with a smile as he held the jade album and looked at Qing Tong slowly.
Qing Tong's face turned stiff, and cold sweat seeped out from his back.
After Yuan Ming finished speaking, he activated the Imaging Jade Album by casting, and displayed a series of images for everyone to see.
From Qing Tong sneaking up on Long Chong and attacking him, to invisibly leaving, every action was captured, including the subtle expressions on Qing Tong's face after his successful attack, leaving no room for denial.
Yuan Ming had actually escaped from the Magma Lake much earlier. Blood Shadow and Hong Ling, those two bastards, capturing the Fire Crocodile, was nothing like the quiet affair they claimed, but rather earth-shattering and almost universally known.
To avoid suspicion, Yuan Ming had to stay hidden and not show himself. From his hiding, he saw Qing Tong attacking Long Chong and recorded it with the Imaging Jade Album.
The people present all fell silent after seeing the recording. Those who had previously supported Qing Tong now wore embarrassed expressions.
Hou Santong's face turned even redder. Being honest and straightforward, he loathed deceitful acts the most. He had just defended Qing Tong, only to discover that the real liar was Qing Tong himself.
Xue Jiao's brows slightly furrowed, and she remained silent.
As for the others, their looks towards Qing Tong were filled with disdain.
They were the elites of the various islands of the East Sea. Although not all of them were paragons of virtue, they each had their pride; even if they truly killed for treasure, they would boldly own up to it and looked down upon framing and setting up others.
More importantly, today Qing Tong could sneak attack Long Chong, and tomorrow he could target them!
The gazes of the crowd were like invisible slaps, hitting Qing Tong's face hard, causing him searing pain.
However, facing the collective anger, Qing Tong offered no excuses.
"How this matter truly unfolded, I believe everyone has seen clearly enough, and there is no need for me to elaborate further," Long Chong said gratefully after glancing at Yuan Ming, then spoke in a solemn voice.
"Qing Tong, what do you have to say?" Daoist Qian Bao's sharp gaze fixed on Qing Tong.
Qing Tong looked around at the others, finding no one to argue in his defense, while Hou Santong and Xue Jiao turned their heads away, ignoring him.
To the others, dividing Long Chong's treasures was no different from dividing Qing Tong's; both were advantageous.
Qing Tong, with a dour expression, snorted coldly and shook his Storage Bag.
Clattering...
A large amount of spiritual materials, ores, and demon beast materials fell to the ground.
"As per the agreement, just leave on your own and hereafter, you shall not team up with anyone else!" Daoist Qian Bao expelled him unapologetically.
Qing Tong swept his gaze across Daoist Qian Bao, Long Chong, and Yuan Ming, his eyes filled with deep hatred. Then, without saying a word, he turned and fled into the sky.
Long Chong was very satisfied with this outcome and nodded in thanks to Daoist Qian Bao, then retrieved the Winter Flood Dragon back into the Spiritual Beast Bag.
Yuan Ming also withdrew the Imaging Jade Album and stepped aside.
"Since Qing Tong plotted against Fellow Daoist Long and severely injured his spirit beast, half of these gains should go to Fellow Daoist Long as compensation. I believe no one has any objections?" Daoist Qian Bao remarked.
Given the circumstances, everyone agreed, though some were reluctant; they did not show it.
Long Chong unhesitatingly took half of the loot.
"As for the remaining items, let us divide them evenly. Fellow Daoist Yuan used the Recording Artifact to reveal Qing Tong's true face, earning a merit. He should pick two items first," Daoist Qian Bao stated.
Yuan Ming nodded at Daoist Qian Bao, and was about to step forward.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan indeed earned significant merit this time, and that Recording Artifact is quite mystical. However, I do not condone Fellow Daoist Yuan's penchant for secretly recording others' privacy," Huan Ling Zi said peculiarly.
"Isn't Fellow Daoist Huan Ling Zi also not too old? Yet your memory seems quite poor. As for why I used this Imaging Jade Album, others might not know, don't you know?" Yuan Ming glanced at Huan Ling Zi and said lightly.
"What do I know?" Huan Ling Zi, not understanding the implication of Yuan Ming's words, asked in surprise.
"Earlier when we fought, I inadvertently overexerted and killed your spirit beast, and you fled with your tail between your legs. Now that we meet again, I was worried that you might harbor grudges and use some underhand methods against me, so I took precautions. Little did I know that I would inadvertently record Qing Tong's despicable actions. It looks like I was too narrow-minded; Fellow Daoist Huan Ling Zi's character is much more honorable than Qing Tong's," Yuan Ming said with a smile.
As the gathering continued, he didn't want to draw attention and had always been quite low-key, but Huan Ling Zi kept picking faults, so naturally, he wouldn't be polite either.
"Huan Ling Zi was defeated by this man? Even his spirit beast was killed?"
"Kongling Island's Illusion Techniques are powerful, and combined with the Illusion Fox Clan, they are almost unbeatable at the same level. How could he be defeated!"
"Huan Ling Zi's spirit beast, I remember, was a Three-tailed Demon Fox. Without his spirit beast to aid him, Huan Ling Zi's strength has greatly diminished," the others commented, their faces showing surprise and whispering among themselves.
Huan Ling Zi's expression was gloomy, like a layer of frost had settled on his face, yet he did not speak out again.
Yuan Ming had killed his spirit beast and seized his Lifebound Magical Treasure. Huan Ling Zi had always harbored hostility towards Yuan Ming. After everyone gathered here, Yuan Ming had remained silent, and Huan Ling Zi had tried to suppress Yuan Ming with his words. He had not expected Yuan Ming to be so relentless, directly exposing his weaknesses.
"Fellow Daoist Huan Ling Zi was just joking, Fellow Daoist Yuan need not mind. Let's quickly choose the spiritual materials," Daoist Qian Bao, feeling a headache coming on, hastily tried to smooth things over.
Yuan Ming ignored Huan Ling Zi as well, stepping forward to take a brownish-red third-level Demon Core and a deep purple Spirit Fruit.
Daoist Qian Bao watched this scene, a trace of something peculiar flashing through his eyes.
Yuan Ming had returned safely from the Magma Lake, appearing unharmed. This surprised Daoist Qian Bao even more. He had let Yuan Ming choose the spiritual materials first both as a gesture of goodwill and also to probe Yuan Ming's capabilities.
Both materials appeared to be highly poisonous. Apart from the Divine Skills he had shown earlier, was Yuan Ming also a master of using poison?
Others also stepped forward to take the treasures, quickly dividing up the spiritual materials on the ground.
"With these trivial matters settled, let's start distributing the Earth Core Fire Lotus," Daoist Qian Bao said.
Upon hearing this, everyone's spirits were lifted.
Yuan Ming, Daoist Qian Bao, and Golden Cloud Fairy took out the Earth Core Fire Lotuses they had collected, totaling twenty-six.
"Excluding Qing Tong, there are now fourteen of us left. According to our prior agreement, each person may first take one lotus. The remaining twelve will be discussed later," Daoist Qian Bao waved his sleeve, and fourteen Earth Core Fire Lotuses floated up, hovering over everyone.
The people present put away their Fire Lotuses, all showing smiles, feeling their journey had not been in vain.
"As for these twelve Fire Lotuses, I think each person should take one, and Golden Cloud Fairy and I will not need any," Daoist Qian Bao said.
Golden Cloud Fairy remained calm, clearly having no objection to this arrangement.
The others were quite surprised to hear this.
"In that case, Fellow Daoist Qian Bao and Golden Cloud Fairy seem to be at a loss. Let us each take out some spiritual materials to make up for your losses," Long Chong said.
"There's no need for that. We willingly give up this Fire Lotus. In return, Golden Cloud Fairy and I would like to ask for a favor from everyone," Daoist Qian Bao said, shaking his head.Thistranslationispoweredbythereadersat*.
"May I ask what it is that Fellow Daoist Qian Bao wishes?" Qiong Yun asked.
"To be honest, Golden Cloud Fairy and I came to this secret realm in search of these two types of spiritual materials. If Fellow Daoists come across them while treasure hunting, please notify us with this Communication Talisman. We would be most grateful," Daoist Qian Bao summoned a water curtain displaying a plant.
A fiery-red Spirit Grass, its shape quite peculiar, resembling a soaring Fire Phoenix.
The other was a vibrant green Spirit Vine with round leaves and many pearl-sized purple-red berries.
The names were written beside the two types of spiritual plants: Fengming Grass and Purple Jade Vine.
"Fengming Grass, Purple Jade Vine? Xi Ying, do you know of these two items? They actually made Daoist Qian Bao give up the Earth Core Fire Lotus," Yuan Ming asked cautiously, examining the water curtain and communicating with Xi Ying.
"I've never heard of them," Xi Ying shook her head.
Yuan Ming was quite surprised. Xi Ying was usually extremely knowledgeable, yet even she did not recognize these two types of spiritual plants, which indicated they were exceptionally rare.
"It's just such a small thing. Rest assured, Fellow Daoist Qian Bao, if I come across these two herbs, I will surely pick them for you," Long Chong said.
"These two types of spiritual plants are quite delicate and difficult to gather. A moment of carelessness can lead to a loss of their medicinal properties. If any of you encounter them, just contact us with the Communication Talisman. We will come personally to harvest them," Daoist Qian Bao explained.
"Agreed," Long Chong nodded.
Daoist Qian Bao handed out twelve Communication Talismans, distributing them to everyone. Everyone also put away their Earth Core Fire Lotuses, very pleased.
With the Earth Core Fire Lotus matter concluded, the group did not continue together.
Huan Ling Zi's face was a complete loss of composure, and having been exposed by Yuan Ming, he left first with Yun Jiuxiao and Bing Xin. The others dispersed as well.
As Yuan Ming, Long Chong, Qiong Yun, and Wulu were about to leave, they were stopped by Daoist Qian Bao.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, when the volcano at the Magma Lake erupted earlier, we left first to save ourselves. Please do not take offense. Fortunately, you were unharmed," Daoist Qian Bao said with a smile.
"Fellow Daoist Qian Bao is too serious. Under those circumstances, if I were in your place, I would have made the same choice," Yuan Ming replied.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, when you were at the Magma Lake picking Fire Lotuses, did you happen to see a 'Blood Light'?" Golden Cloud Fairy asked.
Daoist Qian Bao also looked this way, his gaze scrutinizing.
Yuan Ming suddenly realized that Daoist Qian Bao had stopped him to inquire about Blood Shadow and Hong Ling.
"Golden Cloud Fairy is referring to the 'Blood Light' that swallowed that Level 4 Fire Crocodile, right? I saw it too, it was terrifying," Yuan Ming cursed Blood Shadow and Hong Ling inwardly, yet his face showed a grave expression, appearing frightened.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, when you were also in the Magma Lake, did you see anything unusual?" Golden Cloud Fairy continued to ask, staring into Yuan Ming's eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 521 - 497 Covet
chapters.content:
"There was nothing of the sort; I was struck by that Level 4 Fire Crocodile King and plunged deep into the magma, then stealthily attacked by several fire crocodiles. It was not without difficulty that I managed to escape with the aid of a Magic Treasure. Other than seeing that Blood Shadow, I didn't notice anything unusual," Yuan Ming shook his head as he spoke, his expression revealing not a single flaw.
As his Soul Cultivation deepened, his control over emotions and subtle shifts in his gaze became more precise and natural.
Golden Cloud Fairy stared at Yuan Ming but saw no change in his expression, so she quickly looked away.
"I also saw that Blood Shadow, and it was indeed astonishing. It must be some sort of demon beast within the secret realm. Fortunately, it didn't act against us. Given this, the deeper we go into the secret realm, the more dangerous it becomes. It would be safer for everyone to travel together," Daoist Qian Bao suggested.
"Daoist Qian Bao's proposal is kind, but we have other matters to attend to, so we won't accompany the two of you," Yuan Ming politely declined.
The secret buried within his Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear was most likely related to this secret realm, and he didn't want more people knowing about it.
"If that's the case, I won't insist. Take care," Daoist Qian Bao said with a cupped fist salute, then he and Golden Cloud Fairy flew away.
Soon, only Yuan Ming, Long Chong, and a few others remained.
"Brother Yuan, we owe you a great deal for your help earlier. I, Long Chong, will remember this kindness," Long Chong said to Yuan Ming with a sincere cupped fist salute.
"There's no need for such formalities between you and me," Yuan Ming replied with a shake of his head.
"That was truly exhilarating just now. With just a slight effort from Brother Yuan, not only did you punish Qing Tong, but you also left Huan Ling Zi half-dead with anger. I am impressed," Qiong Yun said with an admiring expression.
"Brother Yuan hasn't even used much force yet, and they are already struggling to cope," Wulu said with a laugh.
"Alright, let's not make jokes at my expense anymore. This is not a place to linger; we should hurry and leave," Yuan Ming suggested.
After a short rest, the group prepared to set out again.
Once Yuan Ming and his companions had vanished, the ground where the four of them had been standing began to tremble faintly, and a small yellow mouse emerged, the size of a palm with unusually large and long ears. It looked like an unusual demon beast, but it lacked any demonic power.
The Big-eared Yellow Rat leaped out swiftly, covering ground quickly, and soon reached a low mountain a dozen miles away.
Two figures were standing there—Golden Cloud Fairy and Daoist Qian Bao.
The Big-eared Yellow Rat jumped and landed on Golden Cloud Fairy's shoulder, nuzzling against her.
Golden Cloud Fairy played with the rat briefly before pressing a finger to its forehead, causing a golden rune to slowly emerge and then disintegrate.
A wave of demonic power emanated from the Big-eared Yellow Rat, reaching the Second Level, and it squeaked as if trying to communicate something.
Golden Cloud Fairy frowned and then placed the rat into her Spiritual Beast Bag.
"So, no useful information was gathered?" Daoist Qian Bao asked upon seeing this.
"It was all irrelevant chatter; let's hope that Long Ears wasn't discovered," Golden Cloud Fairy said as she gently stroked the rat's head.
"The Long Ear Rat can use the power of the earth to conceal its presence, and even a Nascent Soul cultivator might not detect it. You're being overly cautious, sealing away the rat's demonic power just to eavesdrop on a conversation among Core Formation cultivators," Daoist Qian Bao commented with disapproval.
Check * (*) for the latest updates.
"The others may be of no concern, but being cautious about Yuan Ming can't hurt," Golden Cloud Fairy retorted.
"So the person's name is Yuan Ming? You think highly of him," Daoist Qian Bao noted.
"If we truly clashed, let alone against you alone, even if we joined forces, we might not be his match," said Golden Cloud Fairy, speaking indifferently.
"Surely that's an exaggeration! Yuan Ming is only at the Early-stage Core Formation; he's only made it this far thanks to that Thunder Attribute spirit beast. How could he possibly defeat us together?" Daoist Qian Bao initially reacted with surprise, then laughed it off.
"If you don't believe me, you can try fighting Yuan Ming and see for yourself. Don't blame me if you end up dead without a warning," Golden Cloud Fairy said calmly.
"Is Yuan Ming truly so skilled?" Daoist Qian Bao, seeing the seriousness in Golden Cloud Fairy's demeanor, put away his smile and asked earnestly.
"He easily captured a Level 4 Fire Crocodile King; what do you think of his divine skills?" Golden Cloud Fairy replied.
"What did you say! Was the Blood Shadow in the Magma Lake his doing? Are you certain?" Daoist Qian Bao was taken aback.
"Of course I cannot be certain; but just now, only you, Tu Sheng, and Yuan Ming were in the Magma Lake. We know Tu Sheng's abilities; apart from Yuan Ming, who else could it be?" Golden Cloud Fairy elaborated.
"Could it be other Level 4 demon beasts? You've said before that this secret realm is enigmatic and unpredictable; any kind of demon could feasibly appear," Thousand Treasures spoke with a moment's hesitation, still unable to believe.
"If you truly think so, I have nothing more to say. Take care, Fellow Daoist Thousand Treasures," Golden Cloud Fairy said with a twist of her slender waist, transforming into a golden tunneling light that shot off into the distance.
After the golden light had completely faded, Thousand Treasures turned to look in the direction Yuan Ming and his party had left. The shocked expression on his face disappeared, replaced with suppressed excitement.
"Yuan Ming's cultivation is only in the Early-stage Core Formation; there's no way the Observation Treasure Mirror could be wrong. Someone at the early Core Formation stage capturing a Level 4 Fire Crocodile King so easily... That Blood Shadow must be an incredibly powerful Magic Treasure, very likely a replica of a Spiritual Treasure. I cannot miss this opportunity!" Thousand Treasures took out a blue, luminescent disc, with a hint of unrestrained greed flashing in his eyes.
His eyes shimmered, and a moment later he transformed into a cyan tunneling light, flying in a different direction.
A dark red bird unknowingly flew over, landing on a large rock, gazing into the distance.
"Who would have thought my real name would be known to Golden Cloud Fairy. Blood Shadow and Hong Ling have almost been exposed too. I've been cautious enough; how did she figure it out?" The bird's body was hosting a Divine Soul, which was Yuan Ming's Second Split Soul, gently undulating.
Previously, near the lake when distributing the Earth Core Fire Lotuses, Yuan Ming had a premonition about a prying gaze from below. He had his nearly recovered first soul pause its Breathing Control to scout the environment.
Although the Big-eared Yellow Rat's Concealment methods were extraordinary, there was no way to escape the detection of the Stealing Heaven Tripod. He allowed his Second Split Soul to reside in this bird to monitor the Yellow Rat's movements.
"This Golden Cloud Fairy has some tricks up her sleeve; it seems I need to be cautious with her from now on," Yuan Ming thought silently.
As for Thousand Treasures's greed, Yuan Ming didn't take it seriously. If the man did indeed make a move against him, he wouldn't be polite in response; it would make a good opportunity to gather a new batch of Magic Treasures.
In the earlier battle, Thousand Treasures had consecutively brought out several powerful Magic Treasures, truly living up to his name. Yuan Ming also couldn't help but covet them.
Yuan Ming didn't have his Second Split Soul continue to track them. This dark red bird was just an ordinary bird; it could barely keep up with the Big-eared Yellow Rat and certainly wouldn't be able to follow Golden Cloud Fairy and Thousand Treasures.
He controlled the dark red bird, flying in another direction.
...
Golden Cloud Fairy flew a hundred miles before slowing down her light of flying escape.
"Father, is it safe now?" she muttered softly.
"Mm, we've thrown off that soul-powered bird; no one is watching you now," an imposing voice emanated from within Golden Cloud Fairy.
Golden Cloud Fairy breathed a sigh of relief, unable to help complaining, "Father, although Yuan Ming is remarkable, judging from how he subdued the Fire Crocodile King, the difference in strength between them shouldn't be great. If I unleashed my Bloodline Power and with your clone, we could suppress even Nascent Soul Middle Stage cultivators. Why resort to such roundabout tactics?"
"My daughter, you've kept your trump cards hidden; how can you be certain that what Yuan Ming showed before is all his strength? There are many talented individuals in the world, and although you are exceptionally gifted, you shouldn't underestimate others," the imposing voice lectured.
"Father's teaching is correct; your daughter has learned her lesson," Golden Cloud Fairy said solemnly.
"To deal with the Fire Poison in your body, endure this hardship for a bit longer. Thou hast piqued Thousand Treasures' greed, and with his temperament, he will soon help us test Yuan Ming's true strength. Just follow behind and watch," the imposing voice said.
"Yes, but Father, does Yuan Ming really possess a way to resolve my Fire Poison?" Golden Cloud Fairy asked.
"Of course, the Frost Ring he holds is powerful. If I am not mistaken, it should be a replica of the Ancient Spiritual Treasure, the Nine Palaces Cold Moon Ring. I have been searching for the method to refine this treasure for many years without a clue. I did not expect to encounter it here," the voice spoke with a tinge of excitement.
"The Nine Palaces Cold Moon Ring! The Jiugong Sect's sect-defending Spiritual Treasure; Father, are you sure you're not mistaken? Wasn't the method to refine it lost when the Jiugong Sect perished?" Golden Cloud Fairy said, her body shaking, a look of disbelief on her face.
"I do not know where Yuan Ming got that treasure, but I will not mistake the Cold Moon Profound Light triggered by that Frost Ring," the imposing voice replied.
Golden Cloud Fairy's face brightened at the words.
"Your Bloodline Power is too strong and burns your body. It has even evolved into Fire Poison. You need a vastly powerful cold-attributed treasure for Protective Body. Though I've collected several for you, none are satisfactory. The Nine Palaces Cold Moon Ring will definitely suffice. With the Frost Spiritual Materials I've gathered over the years, I dare not claim that I can elevate the replica to the level of a Spiritual Treasure, but restoring fifty to sixty percent of its power is undoubtedly possible. Then, not only will you be safe, but you will also gain a heavy treasure," the imposing voice assured.
"Thank you, Father," Golden Cloud Fairy said joyously.
"Magic Treasures are ultimately external forces. The best way to solve the Fire Poison within you is to find a man and engage in Dual Cultivation. Give birth to offspring, and I can use a Secret Technique to transfer the excessively vigorous Bloodline Power in your body to the fetus. Not only will you be free from the troubles of Fire Poison, but your offspring will also have an extremely high innate talent. Why not do it?" the imposing voice suggested.
"Father, why do you bring this up again? My future husband must be a hero, a great man who stands tall and traverses the world, just like the Shura Master of yore! Those men from Fusang Island, each one is either cowardly or sly; I do not fancy them. You promised me before that I could decide on my own marriage matters, and you cannot go back on your word!" Golden Cloud Fairy pouted, speaking somewhat discontentedly.
If the cultivators of Fusang Island saw Golden Cloud Fairy's charming and endearing expression, their eyes would probably pop out.

chapters.title: Chapter 522 - 522: 498
chapters.content:
"As a father, I would never go back on my word, but I fear for you, my child, whose ambitions are too lofty and whose standards are too high. I really shouldn't have sent you to Fusang Island. You hardly learned any abilities, but you perfectly picked up the Human Clan women's arrogance," the majestic voice sighed.
Golden Cloud Fairy chuckled and remained silent.
"Enough, you make your own decisions about your affairs. However, you must keep an eye on Yuan Ming; it's crucial. You can't afford any mistakes!" the majestic voice instructed again.
"Father, rest assured. Although my Golden Crow Fire Pupils are not as powerful as yours to probe all things and see through depths, I am still capable of keeping track of Yuan Ming," Golden Cloud Fairy said, fire sparking in her pupils, shooting out dazzling golden beams.
"That's good to hear," the majestic voice spoke and then fell silent.
Golden Cloud Fairy withdrew the golden light from her eyes and continued flying forward.
...
After moving a distance, Yuan Ming furrowed his brows suddenly, then regained his composure and looked down.
A canyon appeared in front of them, looking very deep, its bottom invisible to the eyes.
"This place is not bad, sufficiently secluded and abundant in nature's spiritual energy. Let's settle here," Yuan Ming declared.
Heeding his words, Long Chong and the other two looked down, nodded, and leapt downward.
All four of them had two Earth Core Fire Lotuses each. Inside this secret realm full of dangers, they were seeking a safe place to refine the Earth Core Fire Lotuses and transform them into tangible combat power.
The group quickly reached the bottom of the canyon. Although the rocks here were still red, the moisture increased at the valley floor, stimulating the growth of various plants.
The four of them each looked for a spot and started establishing temporary cave mansions for seclusion.
"Fellows, I just recalled some personal business I need to attend to. I'll have to leave for a bit," Yuan Ming suddenly slapped his head and stood up to say.
"Then be careful; make it quick and come back soon," Long Chong said urgently, eager to cultivate, without asking further.
Yuan Ming deployed the Ghost Shadow Escape Technique, turning into a shadow chasing in the direction Qing Tong had left.
Wulu watched Yuan Ming's disappearing figure, his eyes flickering.
Hundreds of miles away in a mountain valley, a green shadow descended from the sky, transforming into Qing Tong's figure.
"Damn it! Daoist Qian Bao, Long Chong, that Yuan fellow! You all deserve to die!" Qing Tong's face was full of malice.
As the Snake-man Clan's pride, he had never endured such humiliation before. Recalling the previous contemptuous and disdainful looks from the others, Qing Tong felt like cotton was stuffed in his heart, and it was suffocating. He wished he could kill them all to relieve his anger.
"Ah!" He roared as he punched the mountain wall.
A loud "boom" resonated, and the mountain wall had a huge hole blasted into it, with countless large and small stones falling like rain.
With that punch, Qing Tong's twisted expression eased somewhat, but the hatred in his heart deepened.
He pulled out a Communication Talisman and whispered a few words before crushing it.
On the other side of the Red Continent, Huan Ling Zi, accompanied by Bing Xin and Yun Jiuxiao, moved swiftly through a dense jungle, looking for a safe and peaceful place to consume and refine the newly acquired Earth Core Fire Lotus.
At that moment, a blue light glowed on Huan Ling Zi.
He stopped in his tracks, took out a Sound Transmission Talisman from his chest, and projected his Divine Sense into it.
"Qing Tong? Do you have a way to deal with Long Chong and the Yuan surname scoundrel?" Huan Ling Zi's eyes sparked.
Now that the Earth Core Fire Lotus was in hand, the immediate need was to consume and refine it to boost his strength. But Yuan Ming had destroyed his Lifebound Magical Treasure and killed his spirit beast, not to mention the recent public humiliation—Huan Ling Zi's hatred for Yuan Ming was also immensely deep, a hatred so vast that not even the East Sea could wash it away.
If there was a way to kill Yuan Ming, he would be exceptionally eager.
After weighing the options in his heart, Huan Ling Zi's hatred for Yuan Ming ultimately prevailed. He led the other two towards the distant mountains and quickly reached the valley where Qing Tong was speculated to be.
However, the valley was empty; Qing Tong had vanished without a trace.
"Eh, where is he? Look around," Huan Ling Zi directed.
Bing Xin and Yun Jiuxiao acknowledged and searched around, but found nothing.
However, Yun Jiuxiao discovered a purple Spiritual Flower at the end of the valley, which resembled a Spiritual Snake and emitted a faint fragrance, prompting him to call everyone over.
"This spiritual flower seems to be the Purple Snake Flower, containing a certain toxicity, yet also stimulating mana and potential unleashing effects. It can be used to refine elixirs to break through cultivation bottlenecks, quite precious indeed. Since you discovered it, keep it," said Huan Ling Zi.
Upon hearing this, Yun Jiuxiao was overjoyed and carefully stored the purple spiritual flower.
"Hehe, Fellow Daoist Huan Ling, you arrived so quickly." Just then, Qing Tong flew over from a distance.
"Brother Qing Tong invited us, so naturally I had to come, but why weren't you here just now?" Huan Ling Zi asked with a frown.
"I had just chased a rare snake demon outside the valley, which delayed me a bit. Have you been anxious, Fellow Daoist Huan Ling? Being hasty against Long Chong and that Yuan thief is not advisable," Qing Tong said with a smile.
As soon as these words came out, Yun Jiuxiao and Bing Xin exchanged glances, secretly lamenting in their hearts.
Huan Ling Zi had brought them here, and they thought it was to find a suitable place for secluded cultivation. They hadn't expected that Huan Ling Zi's purpose was to join forces with Qing Tong to deal with Yuan Ming and others.
After the previous volcanic battle, both were utterly reluctant to have any more conflicts with Yuan Ming and Long Chong. However, Huan Ling Zi had planted illusion seeds in their Sea of Consciousness, so where could they possibly have any freedom?
"Much obliged for your guidance, Brother Qing Tong. In your earlier communication, you mentioned a way to deal with Long Chong and others. What is it? Although I hate to admit it, that Yuan Ming, as well as Long Chong and Qiong Yun, have considerable divine skills. Even if we join forces, we may still not be able to handle them," Huan Ling Zi said.
"I am well aware of their toughness, but my Snake-man Clan has many methods. We don't need to confront them directly. Fellow Daoist Huan Ling, have you ever heard of our clan's One Rihong?" Qing Tong whispered.
"One Rihong? The one that's said to be colorless and odorless, undetectable even by Nascent Soul cultivators. After being poisoned, one's body turns red, and they endure pain intense as the marrow, suffering endlessly for a day and a night before death?" Before Huan Ling Zi could speak, Yun Jiuxiao, standing beside him, blurted out with a trace of fear in his voice.
Golden Lotus Island also had a legacy of poisonous divine powers, and they were somewhat familiar with the Snake-man Clan's One Rihong, extremely dreaded.
"Fellow Daoist Yun is well-informed," said Qing Tong, somewhat surprised.
"The reputation of One Rihong is well known in the East Sea to those with any insight. However, I heard that it's extremely difficult to refine, and even our entire Snake-man Clan doesn't possess many bottles. Do you have one, Brother Qing Tong?" Huan Ling Zi glanced at Yun Jiuxiao and asked.
Qing Tong remained silent, flipping his hand to produce a wine-red jade bottle, on which a large "一" character was written.
"Excellent, with this bottle of One Rihong, whether it's Long Chong or that Yuan, both are undoubtedly doomed!" Huan Ling Zi exclaimed excitedly.
"If they are poisoned by One Rihong, they are indeed doomed, but as you just mentioned, Fellow Daoist Huan Ling, the divine skills of Long Chong and others are not insignificant. If they are vigilant and don't get poisoned by One Rihong, the situation could revert back to the current state. To make sure nothing goes wrong, we should split up and proceed in two directions. I'll go and invite Xue Jiao and Hou Santong for assistance, and I'll leave the task of poisoning to you, Fellow Daoist Huan Ling," Qing Tong handed over the wine-red jade bottle.
"Me to act? I know nothing about poisoning; I'm afraid I might botch things up. It would be better if you, Fellow Daoist Qing, do it yourself. We will go to invite Xue Jiao and Hou Santong." Huan Ling Zi furrowed his brows, making no move to take the jade bottle.
"Fellow Daoist Huan Ling, don't worry; using this poison is actually very simple. Just open the stopper, throw it near Long Chong and the others. One Rihong's penetrative power is extremely strong. Regardless of whether they deploy a mana shield or conjure a protective magic treasure, they will be unknowingly corroded and penetrated," Qing Tong explained with a smile.
"If so, wouldn't it be better for you to do it yourself, Fellow Daoist Qing?" Huan Ling Zi countered, his refusal obvious in his words.
This poison was so formidable, colorless and odorless; one could be affected without notice.
Even if not poisoned, going to poison Yuan Ming and others meant a direct confrontation, and he was not willing to undertake such risky actions.
"Since we have decided to join forces, is Fellow Daoist Huan Ling really unwilling to handle even this simple task? That seems rather insincere," said Qing Tong.
To support our work, please read on *.
"You jest, Fellow Daoist Qing. Since it's a simple task, it would be better for you to take action," Huan Ling Zi replied coldly with a sneer.
"So you really won't go?" Qing Tong asked again.
This time, Huan Ling Zi couldn't be bothered to reply and began walking toward the valley exit, Yun Jiuxiao and Bing Xin quickly following behind.
