"Fellow Daoist Huan Ling, you are well-informed, having heard of our Snake-man Clan's One Rihong. Have you heard of another poison of our clan, the Hundred-day Drunk?" called Qing Tong from behind.
Huan Ling Zi did not stop walking, seemingly disinclined to listen to any more of Qing Tong's ramblings.
"This poison was created by our clan's ancestors, equally famous as One Rihong. Unlike One Rihong, Hundred-day Drunk is a chronic poison that slowly infiltrates the enemy's body, taking a full hundred days to manifest. When it does, it causes no pain; the target will die in a sleep-like drunken stupor, unaware, and afterward, no trace of poison can be detected. Thus, although Hundred-day Drunk is formidable, capable of killing imperceptibly, it's not widely known," Qing Tong continued, sitting there unmoved.
Upon hearing this, Yun Jiuxiao couldn't help but turn back and glance.
"Another difference between Hundred-day Drunk and One Rihong is that this poison cannot be stored in medicine bottles or gourds; it can only be kept in the pistil of the Purple Snake Flower, making it quite inconvenient to use." Qing Tong pulled out a wine flask and continued speaking indifferently.
Upon hearing this, Huan Ling Zi abruptly stopped in his tracks, his expression drastically changing. Yun Jiuxiao and Bing Xin also instantly broke out in a cold sweat.
"Those affected by Hundred-day Drunk show no unusual signs on their bodies; however, in those just poisoned, while the poison is still superficial, faint purple patterns will appear on the skin over their chest. Once the poison fully penetrates, the purple marks will vanish. You three might want to check your chests before deciding whether to proceed with the poisoning," Qing Tong leaned back, took a large swig of alcohol, and chuckled.
Huan Ling Zi suddenly pulled open his clothes, his face instantly turning ashen.
On his chest, several patterns resembling spirit snakes in purple were vividly visible, threatening as if proclaiming their presence.
Yun Jiuxiao and Bing Xin had similar marks on their chests as well, especially Yun Jiuxiao, whose markings were the most pronounced, his eyes filled with despair.

chapters.title: Chapter 523 - 499 Mysterious Continent
chapters.content:
"Qing Tong, you little bastard, how dare you poison me!" Huan Ling Zi roared furiously, a red light flashed in his palm, and a white Spiritual Fan appeared, which he violently fanned towards Qing Tong.
Several white gusts of wind, a foot long, burst forth, and after blowing some distance away, they suddenly turned into several fiercely violent tornadoes, lunging towards Qing Tong with teeth and claws bared.
For a moment, sand and stones flew all around, and where the hurricane passed, it was nearly impossible to see anything.
"Huan Ling Zi, to be so rampant in your current situation is laughable!" Qing Tong laughed heartily, his body radiating a bright green light, as he took a step forward.
His entire figure became blurred, bringing forth several snake-shaped Illusions; in a flash, he had passed through several tornadoes and appeared in front of Qing Tong and his companions, moving almost twice as fast as he had by the Magma Lake.
At this moment, Qing Tong had undergone a dramatic change in appearance, his legs fusing into one to form a thick snake tail, with green Snake Scales emerging on his face and arms, transforming into a half-human, half-demon form. He opened his mouth and spewed a stream of green poison fog at Huan Ling Zi and the other two.
Huan Ling Zi and the others quickly retreated, casting spells to protect their bodies. However, the green poison fog effortlessly infiltrated their Protective Light Rings and merged into their bodies.
Purple snake patterns on the chests of the three began to glow with spots of green; a strange pain in their chests ensued, their gathered Mana suddenly dissipated, and the Protective Body Light Ring also crumbled and dissolved.
Qing Tong pounced forward, and three green shadows harshly struck Huan Ling Zi, Yun Jiuxiao, and Bing Xin.
Bang Bang Bang...
The three were sent flying, crashing into the mountain wall behind them, simultaneously spitting out mouthfuls of blood, with several bones broken in their bodies.
Physical damage was the least of their concerns, as a strange force invaded their bodies, causing their Mana circulation to become sluggish.
Huan Ling Zi included, the three lay listlessly on the ground.
"How about it, are you willing to poison now, or does someone want to suffer some more physical pain? I'm in a rather foul mood right now, and I can definitely satisfy you!" Qing Tong grabbed Huan Ling Zi by the collar, hoisting him up, his face twisted in ferocity.
"Damn it! How could I have been so foolish to cooperate with Qing Tong!" Huan Ling Zi was filled with extreme regret at this moment.
Though he had lost his Spiritual Beast Treasure and couldn't compete with others, finding a safe continent to quietly wait out the Secret Realm was still feasible. All because he wanted revenge on Yuan Ming, he had ended up in this miserable state.
"I didn't expect your tactics to be so formidable. I admit defeat. You can take One Rihong to poison, but you must tell me all about One Rihong's characteristics and swear by your Heart Demon that after we succeed, you will help us remove the poison of Hundred-day Drunk!" Huan Ling Zi's face was unsightly, yet he was forced to bow his head, teeth clenched under the circumstances.
"Agreed," Qing Tong readily accepted, which took Huan Ling Zi by surprise.
"What? You're still hesitant, or do you want me to help you 'loosen up' your muscles?" Qing Tong said, cracking his knuckles with a series of snaps.Part of a series hosted by * (MV&LEMP&YR).
"No need..." Huan Ling Zi hastily shook his head.
Qing Tong snorted, threw Huan Ling Zi to the ground, and began to carefully explain the precautions for using One Rihong, which Huan Ling Zi and the others earnestly memorized.
"From here on out, it's up to you." Qing Tong said, and with a single gesture, threw the red bottle containing One Rihong their way.
But the red Jade Bottle drew an arc mid-air and flew into a nearby jungle.
"Who's there?" Qing Tong's thick snake tail transformed into a massive green shadow, bringing with it a terrifying gust of wind as it swept into the jungle.
Countless trees and plants were shredded by the wind, and the ground also exploded with a loud boom, creating a large pit with dust and smoke billowing and dispersing.
However, there was no sign of anything amiss in the jungle; the red Jade Bottle that had flown into it had disappeared without a trace, as if it had vanished into thin air.
Qing Tong's eyes instantly turned deep black, emitting strands of black light, and he sharply turned towards a mound near the jungle.
A transparent figure stood behind the mound, not revealing the slightest breath; obviously, a powerful Invisibility Divine Ability was used. If not for Qing Tong's innate odd pupil and having cultivated the Snake-man Clan's Pupil Technique, he wouldn't have been able to see through it.
The One Rihong was exceptionally precious, and he had only this one bottle, which must not be lost.
Qing Tong growled, and his thick snake tail swept over again.
Different from just before, layers of water light shone on the tail, making a "whooshing" sound like surging tides, and moisture rose significantly within an area of approximately dozens of feet.
The transparent figure let out a light yelp and formed a hand seal.
A silver banner, several tens of feet tall, appeared out of nowhere, colliding with the green snake tail.
Qing Tong's snake tail struck the silver banner, but it felt as if it had hit a thick, slippery layer of butter, sliding to the side and causing Qing Tong to stagger slightly.
A slender white light shot out from behind the silver banner, striking Qing Tong's snake tail.
Instantly, Qing Tong's snake tail turned into a white ice stick, with white Ice Crystals spreading upward along the tail, quickly reaching his waist in the blink of an eye.
"This white Frost Divine Ability... you are the White Bone Scholar!" Qing Tong screamed in horror, spitting out a green Round Orb from his mouth that flickered with green Flames.
The surrounding area of ten feet became extremely hot, the ground cracking from the heat. The spread of white ice was greatly slowed, but it continued to climb upward.
Qing Tong fiercely struck his chest with his right hand, spitting out a mouthful of green Essence Blood, which merged into the green Round Orb.
The Round Orb burst with a "bang," turning into a green flame, enveloping his body.
The intense heat vanished, all the heat converging into the green flame, temporarily halting the spread of the white ice.
Qing Tong breathed a sigh of relief, then hurriedly used a Flying Escape, shooting backwards while two black Flying Forks shot out from his body, crossing and striking towards the transparent figure behind the mound.
However, before Qing Tong could fly far away, seven or eight black soul crows suddenly appeared from nowhere, arranging themselves into a rather peculiar formation and cawing in unison.
A vast expanse of black sound waves descended from the sky, and before Qing Tong could react, she felt a buzzing in her Sea of Consciousness, and countless illusions surfaced before her eyes. She plunged down from her fleeing flight.
Before she hit the ground, a slender beam of white light shot out from behind a mound, striking Qing Tong in the back.
Icicles suddenly formed on the surface of Qing Tong's body, enveloping her completely. She was frozen solid and could not move an inch as she fell to the ground with a "bang."
At the same time, the transparent figure behind the mound rapidly solidified into a vague shadow.
From the appearance of the transparent figure to Qing Tong's capture, only a couple of breaths had passed. Although Huan Ling Zi and the other two were exhausted and weak, they still witnessed the event with their own eyes, utterly dumbfounded.
However, as soon as Qing Tong was frozen into an ice stick, the strange pain in the chests of Huan Ling Zi and the others also vanished, and they sprang up from the ground and scattered in escape.
The black shadow let out a cold snort and lightly waved a sleeve, from which shot a dreamlike white glow.
The seven or eight soul crows cawed in unison again, but this time no sound waves fell.
However, the vision of Huan Ling Zi and the others blurred, and they suddenly found themselves in a white and hazy space, with their bodies firmly bound by chains.
"Illusion Techniques!" Huan Ling Zi was startled and his Divine Soul Power burst forth in his Sea of Consciousness, striking against the illusionary space.
Yet the white space did not shake at all; instead, the chains binding Huan Ling Zi thickened significantly.
A restrictive force permeated Huan Ling Zi's body, and his Mana began to stagnate.
Huan Ling Zi couldn't help feeling a bit desperate, but he refused to give up. Just as he was about to employ other methods, his body suddenly became extremely cold, as if submerged in a spring of perennial frost, leaving him unable to move even a finger, and his Mana was completely frozen solid.
His vision blurred once more, and he found himself back in the valley. Apart from his head, his entire body was frozen in a huge chunk of white ice crystal.
Yun Jiuxiao and Bing Xin were in the same predicament.
The shadow slowly revealed its True Face; it was indeed Yuan Ming.
A dark red bird flew in from nearby and landed on his shoulder.
Yuan Ming and Qing Tong had already sworn a deadly feud, and the Snake-man Clan had previously kidnapped Yan Sijing. Naturaly, Yuan Ming would not allow Qing Tong, this threat, to leave. He just had the dark red bird track her down and immediately pursued once he found Qing Tong's trail.
What he hadn't anticipated was the presence of Huan Ling Zi and the two others. However, this was just as well; it offered a chance to take care of all the nuisances at once.
Huan Ling Zi, seeing Yuan Ming, showed a look of fear on his face but not much surprise.
The Frost Divine Ability that Yuan Ming had just used was employed several times previously when dealing with the Fire Crocodiles. Huan Ling Zi had guessed who the newcomer was as soon as Qing Tong turned into an ice sculpture.
He opened his mouth, wanting to beg for mercy, but considering the grievances between him and Yuan Ming, he felt that pleading was somewhat futile and ended up not saying anything at all.
Yuan Ming couldn't be bothered to waste words with Huan Ling Zi. He put on the Empty Gloves and grabbed Huan Ling Zi's head.
Black and blue light emanated from the Empty Gloves and penetrated Huan Ling Zi's head.
The Empty Gloves could seep into the depths of the Divine Soul, rewrite memories, and enhance Soul Search abilities.
Normally, probing a Cultivator's memories would require at least one tael of time, but with the help of the Empty Gloves, it only took Yuan Ming a moment to complete the process.
From Huan Ling Zi's memories, he learned quite a few things.
Leaving the matters of Kongling Island aside for now, Yuan Ming was more concerned with the secrets of the Secret Realm.
Through Huan Ling Zi's memories, he found out that Fusang, Jin Ao, Kongling, and Di Hua islands were hiding a lot of information. These four islands were searching within the Secret Realm for a special continent that harbored items desperately sought by the four islands and was related to Three Immortals Island.
About that continent, Huan Ling Zi didn't know much, only that it bore many Spirit Grasses and demon beasts not found on the Yunhuang Continent. This included the Fengming Grass and Purple Jade Vine that Daoist Qian Bao and Golden Cloud Fairy had previously tasked others to search for.
Yuan Ming finally understood why Daoist Qian Bao and Golden Cloud Fairy had been willing to give up the Earth Core Fire Lotus; they wanted to use the collective effort of others to find that continent as soon as possible.
Yuan Ming looked at Huan Ling Zi in his hands, hesitation flickering in his eyes for a moment before returning to calmness.
The blue light from the Empty Gloves intensified, and a small blue hand seeped into Huan Ling Zi's head.
At the same time, he took out a Silver Token with a flip of his hand and channeled Mana into it.
A giant silver barrier suddenly appeared, engulfing Huan Ling Zi, Yun Jiuxiao, Qing Tong, and the others within it.
An hour later, the silver barrier collapsed and dissipated.
Yuan Ming stood with his hands behind his back, facing several people opposite him, who were Huan Ling Zi, Qing Tong, Yun Jiuxiao, and Bing Xin.
Including Huan Ling Zi and Qing Tong, all four had peaceful expressions and looked at Yuan Ming with grateful and devout eyes.
"You may go now," Yuan Ming said indifferently after a long silence.
The four bowed to Yuan Ming and each flew away into the distance.

chapters.title: Chapter 524 - 500 Disposal Methods
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming stood in place for a moment, gazing toward a nearby grove and said, "Brother Wu Lu, since you're here, why bother hiding?"
The grove remained still for a moment, then Wu Lu emerged, his eyes unmistakably flashing with surprise.
"Heh, it's been a while since we've met, Brother Yuan, and your strength has become even more alarming. My method of concealment is quite unique, so much so that even ordinary Nascent Soul cultivators may not notice it. Yet, you saw through it at a glance—impressive."
"Just a little trick in sensing, nothing worth mentioning," Yuan Ming said indifferently.
Upon hearing this, Wu Lu couldn't help but be speechless. To think that an ability to detect what even Nascent Soul cultivators couldn't was considered a small trick?
"Why is Brother Wu Lu not at the canyon below refining the Earth Core Fire Lotus? What brings you here?" Yuan Ming inquired.
"Just passing by," Wu Lu said with a somewhat embarrassed look, forcing a smile.
"I see. My business here is finished; I'll be leaving now. Brother Wu Lu, please feel free to do as you wish," Yuan Ming said without exposing Wu Lu's lie, turned around, and his figure soared up, flying away.
Just at that moment, a blue and a white tunneling light shot from afar, rapidly approaching.
Wu Lu's expression subtly changed, and a ripple-like blue light flashed across his body, making him disappear into thin air.
Yuan Ming raised an eyebrow. He had already detected Wu Lu's invisibility, but it was the first time he witnessed the process of Wu Lu's disappearing act.
Whether it was a spell or a magic treasure, the technique was exceedingly mystical. It not only rendered his form into nothingness but also completely concealed his aura. Even with Yuan Ming's current level of divine sense, bolstered by the Stealing Heaven Tripod, he could barely sense Wu Lu's presence.
His own Void Transformation Technique could achieve a similar effect, but it paled in comparison to Wu Lu's invisibility.
As he pondered this, the blue and white lights reached the valley's airspace in a blink of an eye, revealing Xue Jiao and Hou Santong's figures, who looked down.
Seeing Yuan Ming, a look of surprise appeared on both their faces.
Yuan Ming ignored them, proceeding to leave directly.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, please wait a moment. Have you seen Qing Tong?" Hou Santong blocked Yuan Ming's path and asked with a bow.
His manner seemed polite, but his tone was very forceful, brimming with the stance that he was ready to capture someone if they disagreed.
The three major clans of the Eastern Sea possess incredibly strong innate talents, far surpassing those of the Human Clan, only restricting themselves due to their small numbers.
The clans fundamentally scorned the cultivators of the Human Clan, considering them worthless except in numbers. They feigned cooperation with the Eastern Sea Islands on the surface, but behind the scenes, they ceaselessly schemed to strengthen themselves, aspiring to expel or even eradicate the Human Clan's cultivators from the East Sea.
Having just performed a Soul Search on Qing Tong, Yuan Ming was well aware of the clans' situation and disgusted in his heart. He used the Ghost Shadow Escape Technique, swiftly bypassing the other to continue flying toward the distance.
"Are you deaf? I'm talking to you," Hou Santong bellowed, pivoting to punch.
A house-sized blue fist shadow shot forth, carrying endless might. Wherever it passed, the void was slashed with white lines, thundering toward Yuan Ming's back.
Yuan Ming's figure flickered again, appearing several dozen feet away, evading the strike of the blue fist shadow.
Enjoy the story by reading on *.
"Is this how the Water Ape Clan converses? Resorting to killing without agreeing?" he said, turning to look at Hou Santong with an indifferent expression.
"Where is Qing Tong? Did you kill him?" Hou Santong's eyes harbored a cold gleam, while Xue Jiao also bore a fierce look.
Not long ago, they had received a message from Qing Tong to meet here to discuss an action for revenge against Yuan Ming and Long Chong.
Following the events before, although Hou Santong and Xue Jiao disdained Qing Tong's character, the three, being from alien clans, would unite against the external enemy—the Human Clan's cultivators.
As for Daoist Qian Bao's prior statement prohibiting Qing Tong from teaming up with others, neither Hou Santong, Xue Jiao, nor Qing Tong took it seriously.
The valley below clearly showed signs of a battle; now, with no sign of Qing Tong and Yuan Ming standing unharmed, Hou and Xue couldn't help but suspect that Qing Tong might no longer be alive.
Yuan Ming sneered and turned to walk away.
Seeing Yuan Ming's even more defiant attitude, Hou Santong's fierce nature surged, his momentum suddenly increasing, and his body size quickly swelling. He burst out a powerful Qi Force, tearing his clothes to shreds, transforming into a massive white-haired giant ape three meters tall.
Xue Jiao emanated ripples of light, the moisture in the nearby void becoming exceptionally dense, condensing into wave-like blue shadows, while the ground and rocks were dotted with fine water droplets.
Yuan Ming halted, turning to face Hou Santong and Xue Jiao, his eyes sharpening, as a great battle readied to unfold.
"Stop!" A green tunneling light flew from the distance, arriving nearby in the blink of an eye, revealing Qing Tong's figure.
"Qing Tong, are you alright?" Hou Santong and Xue Jiao hurried over to him.
"Of course, I'm fine. Why are you confronting this person?" Qing Tong glanced at Yuan Ming and said.
"Didn't you send a message asking us to seek revenge against Yuan Ming and Long Chong? We came here, but couldn't see you and saw signs of a battle on the ground. We thought you had perished at this person's hands," Xue Jiao communicated telepathically.
"It wasn't my idea to seek revenge against Long Chong and this person; it was Huan Ling Zi who proposed it. The traces here were also caused by Huan Ling Zi and Yuan Ming fighting fiercely. Their clashes among the Human Clan's cultivators have nothing to do with us. This Yuan Ming is very strong. Even Huan Ling Zi, Yun Jiuxiao, and Bing Xin, three against one, still suffered a huge defeat. We have no need to make an enemy of him; it's better to focus on treasure hunting," Qing Tong moved his lips slightly, transmitting this message telepathically.
"Indeed, let us depart," Xue Jiao had no intention to fight with Yuan Ming. A blue light enveloped the three of them, and in the blink of an eye, they disappeared into the distance.
A slight smile appeared on Yuan Ming's lips as he looked around. The Divine Sense of his first soul descended from the Stealing Heaven Tripod, detecting no trace of Wu Lu nearby; he must have already left.
Yuan Ming did not linger, fleeing into the distance.
"Yuan Ming, I thought you would directly kill Huan Ling Zi, Qing Tong, and the others. I never expected you would think to use the Empty Gloves to modify their memories, making them devout believers of the Moon Sect, and then implant Soul Descent runes within their Divine Souls. I must say, that move was incredibly slick," Xi Ying's voice echoed in his Sea of Consciousness.
"Why kill them? I'm not a bloodthirsty maniac. Even if I wanted to vent, controlling them in this way relieves more frustration than killing them, and I also gain a significant amount of Desire Power. Moreover, Huan Ling Zi, Qing Tong, and the others are prominent young figures from the Eastern Sea. Killing them rashly would certainly stir up a great upheaval, which would not be beneficial for the Moon Sect or Hundred Pills Square. Handling it this way is more appropriate," Yuan Ming articulated.
"Tsk tsk, it seems your methods of handling affairs are becoming more and more sophisticated—you truly are a capable sect leader," Xi Ying commented with a laugh.
"I have no interest in being a sect leader," Yuan Ming retorted, shaking his head. All of this was just to accelerate his training as a Soul Cultivator and enhance his strength.
"What do you plan to do about that Wu Lu? His Invisibility Divine Ability is quite exceptional, and he seems interested in your affairs. Should we expel him from the team to avoid trouble? With his skills, he can survive on his own in the Secret Realm," Xi Ying suggested.
"We'll discuss this matter later," Yuan Ming said, pausing briefly.
He had not yet decided how to deal with Wu Lu.
The man had mysteriously appeared on Fusang Island, unexpectedly representing Blood Bird's Nest Island at the Immortal Fruit Conference, and even entered the Secret Realm in disguise. All his actions were enshrouded in mystery.
Nevertheless, the two of them had been friends since they met in the Southern Border. As long as Wu Lu did not interfere with him, Yuan Ming had no intention of taking action against him. They should proceed with their own affairs without interfering with each other.
At that moment, the sky rumbled loudly, and the stars suddenly shone brilliantly, illuminating the ground.
"Another Star Rain?" Yuan Ming halted his escape, excitement flickering through his mind as he conjured the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear.
At that very moment, thousands of meteors fell from the sky, transforming into thousands of blue giant beasts shaped like lions, and heavily landed on the ground.
In the past, Yuan Ming had encountered a Starry Sky Beast within the Highly Poisonous Swamp; however, the swamp's sky was covered in toxic clouds, and he hadn't seen the beginning and end of the Starry Sky Beast's appearance—he now realized these beasts came down from the sky.
And the Starry Sky Beast seemed to have no fixed form; it could be a giant bull or a lion.
As soon as the Starry Lion Beast landed, it immediately spotted Yuan Ming nearby. Thirty to forty Starry Lion Beasts charged at him, while others ran in different directions.
Knowing the ferocity of these Starry Sky Beasts, Yuan Ming immediately summoned Lei Yu and attempted to escape.
Roar roar...
The Starry Sky Beasts, being murderous by nature, relentlessly pursued him.
These Starry Lion Beasts, with strong limbs that ran as if flying, were much faster than the previous Starry Bulls and could keep up with Lei Yu.
The lead Starry Lion Beast opened its huge mouth and bit fiercely.
Yuan Ming patted Lei Yu's back, causing its body to dip sharply, narrowly avoiding the Starry Lion Beast's bite.
The Starry Lion Beast roared angrily, its mouth agape again as blue light surged around its lips, emitting a blue light orb the size of a millstone towards Yuan Ming's back.
Yuan Ming was slightly startled; the Starry Lion Beast could actually launch an attack similar to a spell.
He maneuvered Lei Yu to dodge again, sweeping the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear backwards.
A dazzling purple light flashed, slicing the blue light orb in half, which then integrated into the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming paused. It seemed that the blue light orb was also formed from Star Power, which the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear could absorb.
If that was the case...
Yuan Ming immediately communicated with Lei Yu through his thoughts, transforming into a bolt of lightning and charging at a nearby Starry Lion Beast.
He conjured the Thunder God Hammer and unleashed a thick bolt of thunder, striking hard on the chest of the Starry Lion Beast. The electric arcs on Lei Yu's wings intensified, and dozens of thick Silver Thunders struck the Starry Lion Beast.
The huge body of the Starry Lion Beast couldn't dodge in time, and its body was immediately hit with numerous holes, stumbling back several steps.
A purple spear shadow arrived like lightning, piercing into the head of the Starry Lion Beast and penetrating deeply.
The body of the Starry Lion Beast stiffened, a look of horror on its face, bright starlight emanating from all over its body, converging towards the head like a long whale sucking water, seemingly being sucked away.
The massive body of the Starry Lion Beast rapidly shrank, and in a few breaths, it completely vanished, leaving only the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear floating there, its body emanating bright purple light.
A surge of Star Power came from afar, significantly more abundant than the starlight transmitted by the Star Rain, merging into Yuan Ming's bones.
His bones tingled and their strength noticeably increased by several notches.

chapters.title: Chapter 525 - 501: Where the Spear Points
chapters.content:
"These Starry Sky Beasts are all condensed from the power of the stars; the Purple Star Nine Dragons Spear really can restrain them!" Yuan Ming's heart leaped with joy, and he immediately ordered Lei Yu to fly high into the sky.
The Purple Star Nine Dragons Spear flashed out, transforming into a life-stealing purple shadow that attacked the other Starry Lion Beasts.
Before the might of the Purple Star Nine Dragons Spear, these Starry Sky Beasts had no power to fight back and were easily slaughtered.
One, two, three...
In the blink of an eye, more than a dozen Starry Lion Beasts were killed.
The purple light of the Purple Star Nine Dragons Spear had become extraordinarily dazzling. From a distance, one could only see a dragon-like purple light sweeping across; wherever the light touched, the Starry Lion Beasts would disintegrate, turning into countless starlights that were devoured by the Purple Star Nine Dragons Spear.
The other Starry Sky Beasts showed looks of fear and scattered in all directions.
A look of pain flashed across Yuan Ming's face. The transmission of such strong star powers from more than a dozen sources was more than his bones could absorb in time. A vast amount of star power accumulated within his bones, causing an exceptionally stinging pain throughout his body.
He sat cross-legged on Lei Yu's back, operating the Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill to refine this star power while urgently calling back the Purple Star Nine Dragons Spear, not to continue the killing.
Who knew that the Purple Star Nine Dragons Spear seemed to have its own will and completely ignored Yuan Ming's summoning, pursuing the fleeing Starry Lion Beasts on its own.
Bang, bang, bang...
Several more Starry Lion Beasts were penetrated by the purple light, their huge bodies exploding and turning into countless starlights that merged into the spear.
It was only then that the Purple Star Nine Dragons Spear stopped, hovering in mid-air, buzzing and vibrating.
Sounds of cracking came from inside the spear. The seals within it suddenly shattered, and twelve star patterns emerged on the surface of the spear, shining brilliantly, resembling twelve purple eyes.
The purple light of the Purple Star Nine Dragons Spear transformed, turning into nine purple dragon shadows that coiled around the spear's body.
Boom!
A meteor-like grand purple light shot forth from the tip of the spear, striking a nearby mountain peak.
A majestic hundred-zhang tall peak was pierced through by the purple light, which, with its unfading momentum, plunged into the ground, leaving behind a charred great hole in the mountain and earth that was daunting to behold.
Yuan Ming stared at the scene before him, hardly daring to believe his own eyes.
The twelve star patterns inside the Purple Star Nine Dragons Spear were actually twelve runes. This spear turned out to be a replicated Spiritual Treasure with twelve runes!
At that moment, an unprecedentedly strong star power came from across the space, interrupting his thoughts, and exceeding the bearing capacity of his bones. Excessive star power seeped into his flesh and meridians.
Yuan Ming's entire body was in unbearable pain. He quickly gathered all his focus and operated the Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill with all his strength.
As time passed bit by bit, half an hour quickly went by.Fоr сhаrасtеr shееts аnd glоssаriеs, visit МV|LЕМРYR.
Yuan Ming opened his eyes, his muscles and bones rhythmically writhing and crackling like popping beans.
The demon image patterns on his body became distinct several times over, and from within him emerged a profound black light. The demon image patterns seemed alive, contracting, expanding, and circulating in a continuous cycle.
With a 'hum', an astonishing aura burst forth from Yuan Ming!
His body swelled to twice its size, transforming into a black giant, eyes flashing with electric light, exuding a chilling and heavy oppressive aura, like a war demon standing tall between heaven and earth!
Lei Yu, beneath him, let out a pained cry, seemingly unable to withstand Yuan Ming's current might.
Yuan Ming leaped forward, not summoning any Magic Treasure, and just like that, he fell toward the ground below.
At this point, Lei Yu was flying in mid-air, at least a hundred zhangs from the ground.
A black shadow tore through the sky, heavily crashing into the ground below.
A huge boom!
Clouds of dust rose, mixed with large and small stones that were flung in all directions.
The mountain breeze blew, dispersing the dust quickly and revealing the scene within.
The hard ground had been smashed into a deep pit several zhangs in depth, with Yuan Ming standing inside, completely unharmed.
He moved his limbs and showed a smile on his face.
With the help of the star power, the second layer of the Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill had reached perfection. His bones were as solid as refined iron, and the Iron Bone Body was thoroughly refined!
Perhaps due to absorbing too much star power, Yuan Ming's bones were not only exceptionally hard, but also exhibited faint star patterns, markedly different from the ordinary Iron Bone Body.
"This looks more like the legendary Star Body described in the tales. Could it be due to absorbing an abundance of star power?" Yuan Ming mused.
Since he began cultivating the Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill, he had collected many classics concerning Body Cultivation. The Star Body was a top-tier Spiritual Body within Body Cultivation, capable of sensing star power and incorporating it into one's body, significantly faster than the cultivation speeds of ordinary Body Cultivators, especially in perceiving the Innate Body. The Star Body had an extraordinary advantage.
However, Yuan Ming did not possess such a Spiritual Body; it must be because his bones absorbed too much star power, causing some sort of mutation.
Yuan Ming shook his head, no longer caring about the matter, and sensed the condition of his physical body.
He had already achieved the Iron Bone Body, and his bones even bore traces of the Star Body, with his defensive power increasing by more than three times than before.
The Demon Image Skin formed by the Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill was originally incredibly tough, comparable to a Second-level Demon Beast, and now, with the explosive increase in defensive power, it was not much inferior to the Fire Crocodiles in the Molten Lava Lake.
Yet, defensive ability was secondary. The greatest change to Yuan Ming's body after achieving the Iron Bone Body was strength.
The power contained in each of his bones was extraordinarily sharp. Each punch he threw, the strength of his bones layered on top of one another, and unless it was particularly hard, even a Core Formation Stage Magic Treasure could be shattered in one blow.
"Good, the Iron Bone Body has laid down such a solid foundation. Once I advance to the Innate Body and generate inner breath, I wonder how powerful my physical strength will become. I'm afraid it might directly surpass that of a Magic Practitioner," Yuan Ming let out a long breath and muttered to himself.
His Spirit Root was inferior, and even though he practiced the Nine Elements Technique, his progress as a Magic Practitioner was quite unsatisfactory. Fortunately, his accomplishments in Body Cultivation and Soul Cultivation were rather significant.
Yuan Ming beckoned with his hand, and the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear floating in mid-air flew down, making a "whoosh" as it landed in his hand.
He had already sensed the changes in the spear, but now, holding it personally, his feelings were still numerous.
The seals inside the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear were now completely gone. Twelve Star Runes formed a Star Rune Array, and combined with the special material of the spear body, its destructive power was terrifying, far surpassing all the Magic Treasures he possessed.
Yuan Ming channeled his mana into the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear, causing the tip to emit a whizzing sound, and burst forth a sharp and unparalleled purple Qi Force, as if it could pierce through anything.
"This feeling, it seems that your Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear has some connection with the God-slaying Spear, likely an imitation of it. No wonder it has such astonishing offensive power," Xi Ying's voice rang out.
"God-slaying Spear?" Yuan Ming was stunned.
"The God-slaying Spear is a Spiritual Treasure passed down by the Western Region's number-one Body Cultivation Sect, the Martial God Palace. Its original name is 'Nine Dragons Nightmare Moon Spear'. Purely in terms of offensive power, it far surpasses the Canghai Xuan Water Pearl of Chang Chun Temple. Ten thousand years ago, when All Major Sects besieged the Wu Yue Sect, it was this spear that severely wounded the Wu Yue God, hence it gained the name 'God-slaying Spear'," Xi Ying explained.
Yuan Ming's eyes gleamed with surprise, not expecting the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear to have such a background.
Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear, Nine Dragons Nightmare Moon Spear, the two names were so similar, as to call the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear an imitation Spiritual Treasure, he was very much in agreement.
Just recently, when the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear killed the Starry Lion Beast, it suddenly escaped his control as if it had its own life. Could it be that this spear already had the hint of advancing to a Spiritual Treasure?
At that moment, a deep growl came from behind, and two Starry Lion Beasts rushed over. They must be Starry Sky Beasts that were scattered earlier and attracted by the noise.
Yuan Ming was just looking for someone to test the power of the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear and immediately threw it with one hand.
A purple shadow tore through the sky, and the bodies of the two Starry Lion Beasts were penetrated, even entering a small mountain behind them.
Bang!
The small mountain burst apart, and the ground was even blasted into a deep pit.
Yuan Ming nodded inwardly, his Magic Treasures were many, but he lacked one that specialized in attack. Facing enemies with strong defenses, it would be difficult to be effective, and this Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear just made up for this shortfall.
A vigorous Star Power suddenly emerged from the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear, merging into the bones of his body.
Yuan Ming's entire skeleton tingled pleasantly, so much so that he almost groaned, and the star patterns on the bones became slightly clearer.
Overjoyed, he had already achieved the Iron Bone Body, but he didn't expect his bones to continue strengthening. If he absorbed more Star Power, not only could his physical body grow stronger, the star patterns on his bones could further increase, and perhaps one day, he would truly reach the realm of the Star Body.
Yuan Ming's expression suddenly shifted, his Divine Sense detected a guiding force emerging from within the star formation in the spear, pointing toward a certain direction in the Secret Realm.
"I had suspected that this Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear was related to the Secret Realm, and it seems to be true. I wonder what lies in the direction the spear points to?" he looked in that direction, which was to the west of the continent.
At that moment, the Qi-Blood within Yuan Ming's body suddenly surged, whether it was triggered by the Star Power that had transferred to him, he did not know.
The mana within him also started to circulate, speeding up more and more.
Yuan Ming's face paled. Ignoring the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear, he carefully probed the situation inside his body.
His internal mana surged like a tide, showing signs of a Breakthrough.
Yuan Ming was ecstatic. His mana had reached the peak of the Early-stage Core Formation, and he needed only one opportunity to break through. The opportunity seemed to have arrived.
He went to a nearby secluded spot, created a temporary Cave Mansion, and set up two Arrays around it. He also placed the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear above the Cave Mansion to prevent the fall of the Star Rain. Then, he sat down cross-legged.
Hua Zhi, Lei Yu, and several Core Formation Stage Ghost Slaves from the Night Parade of Hundred Demons stood guard nearby, not allowing anyone close.
Yuan Ming took out an Earth Core Fire Lotus and swallowed it in a few bites.
Even though the opportunity for a breakthrough had arrived, he still decided to use an Earth Core Fire Lotus to ensure a smooth process.
One day and one night passed quickly.
A howl piercing through the heavens emanated from the Cave Mansion, nearby mountains and the ground vibrated with a hum, and there was faintly the majesty of dragons roaring and tigers howling.
This howling continued for about thirty minutes before dissipating. Inside the Cave Mansion, Yuan Ming sat cross-legged with his eyes closed, surrounded by a cyan light that swayed like waves, and the aura he emitted was much more solid than before.

chapters.title: Chapter 526 - 502: Blood Puppet Technique
chapters.content:
"I don't know how much time, effort, and resources I spent, but I finally broke through to the mid-stage of Core Formation," Yuan Ming slowly opened his eyes, a sharp light swirling within them.
This breakthrough was largely due to the Earth Core Fire Lotus which played a significant role.
However, compared to before, the enhancement to mana from consuming the Earth Core Fire Lotus had significantly weakened.
"It seems the remaining fire lotuses should be taken back and refined into elixirs," Yuan Ming thought to himself.
At the Magma Lake, aside from the eight or nine fire lotuses seen by Golden Cloud Fairy and Daoist Qian Bao, he secretly took away the remaining dozen or so while Hong Ling and Blood Shadow were capturing the Fire Crocodile King. Now, all were stored inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space.
Earth Core Fire Lotus was exceptionally rare. After the competition in the Secret Realm ended, Yuan Ming had no plans to take them out.
With so many Earth Core Fire Lotuses, he should be able to refine numerous elixirs, enough to elevate his mana to the late stage of Core Formation.
Black impurities flowed out of Yuan Ming's skin once again—this was the result of a second refinement process by the Earth Core Fire Lotus.
Unlike the enhancement to mana, the refinement effect of the Earth Core Fire Lotus had not weakened, and his tendons, bones, and flesh had been strengthened once more.
During this day and night, two showers of star rains had fallen, both intercepted by the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear.
The star pattern on Yuan Ming's bones became clearer, vaguely connecting with the vast stars above, giving him a sense of embodying the Star Body.
Yuan Ming's mana flowed out from his body, shaking off the black stains, and he got up and went outside.
"Congratulations, Master, your cultivation has greatly improved!" Hua Zhi had been waiting outside, and she knelt to the ground, while Lei Yu flapped its wings and cried out.
"You are considerate. Here's a reward!" Yuan Ming, in high spirits, waved his sleeve.
A green and a blue demon pill, both Level 3, flew out.
Hua Zhi and Lei Yu opened their mouths to catch and swallow the pills, refining them.
Yuan Ming stored Heavenly Ghost Wanderer and other Ghost Slaves into the Night Parade of Hundred Demons, then commanded Lei Yu and Hua Zhi to fly back into the Spiritual Beast Bag. Afterwards, he took down the two arrays surrounding the cave mansion and retraced his original path, soon returning to the bottom of the canyon where Long Chong and others were in seclusion.
The cave mansion opened by Long Chong and others shimmered faintly with the light of forbidden spells, clearly showing that they were still inside cultivating and had not come out.
The same was true for Wulu's cave mansion, surrounded by even more exquisite forbidden spells, impenetrable even by Yuan Ming's Divine Sense.
With a thought, Yuan Ming controlled the Divine Sense of his first soul split to descend easily and peer inside.
Wulu had already restored his original appearance and was cultivating inside the cave mansion. His body flickered with red light from time to time, refining the Earth Core Fire Lotus just like the others.
Hanging on the wall beside him was a dark red full-body armor made of countless jade pieces the size of fingernails.
Yuan Ming examined it closely, and his expression subtly changed.
The face part of the dark red armor eerily revealed a human face, which was none other than Hong Chang's visage transformed by Wulu on Blood Bird's Nest Island.
The expression on Hong Chang's face was slightly changing, particularly the eyes that slowly turned as if alive.
This dark red armor, resembling a magic treasure, emanated a strong fluctuation of magic power, mixed with pulses of Divine Soul. It was unclear what it was.
"What did you see?" Xi Ying, sensing Yuan Ming's change in emotion, asked.
Yuan Ming described everything he had seen in detail.
"This dark red armor must be Blood Puppet Armor. How is that possible? Are you sure that armor was hanging on the wall?" Xi Ying asked incredulously.
"Absolutely certain," Yuan Ming replied.
"It shouldn't be like this..." Xi Ying still couldn't believe it.
"What is the origin of this armor that surprises you so much?" Yuan Ming asked.
"Blood Puppet Armor originates from a secret technique called the Blood Puppet Technique, somewhat similar to the Fur Cloak Skill of Biluo Cave. It refines a person into an armor, allowing both mana and Divine Soul to be stored inside. Anyone else who wears it can assume that person's appearance without showing any flaws," Xi Ying explained, regaining her composure.
Yuan Ming suddenly understood. No wonder Wulu's transformation had fooled even Nascent Soul cultivators; it was because he had used such a secret technique.The full series is hosted on *, known as *.
"Where did the Blood Puppet Technique originate from? Could it also be from the Southern Border?" he then asked.
"Blood Puppet is a secret technique from the East Sea, passed down from the Lank Jade Book. It has long been lost, and I wonder where Wulu got it from," Xi Ying said thoughtfully.
"Lank Jade Book? Previously, Luo Wanshan mentioned that the Golden Sunflower Beast Taming Technique came from the Golden Sunflower Heavenly Book. Both are related to Three Immortals Island; could there be some special origin to this?" Yuan Ming recalled and asked.
"That's a long story. The legend of Three Immortals Island has persisted in the East Sea for tens of thousands of years, enduring through the ages due to three books: the Golden Sunflower Heavenly Book, Lank Jade Book, and Penglai Immortal Book," Xi Ying explained.
"Golden Sunflower Heavenly Book, Lank Jade Book, Penglai Immortal Book..." Yuan Ming muttered to himself.
"These three books, having originated from Three Immortals Island long ago, contain many incredibly exquisite Magic Power Divine Abilities, each with unbelievable effects, far surpassing the legacy of other East Sea sects. Among them, the Golden Sunflower Heavenly Book is the most widely spread, containing twenty-four pages with each page documenting one secret technique, covering Five Elements Magic, Artifact Refining, Alchemy, talismans, Beast Taming, and cultivation of Spirit Plants. Fusang Island once obtained three pages of the Golden Sunflower Heavenly Book, one of which recorded the Beast Taming Secret Technique. It was with this technique that Fusang Island managed to make the Level 5 Golden Crow settle on the island, establishing its exalted status as the number one island in the East Sea," Xi Ying said.
"And the other two pages of the Golden Sunflower Heavenly Book?" Yuan Ming nodded slightly, no wonder Luu Changfeng had mastered the complete Golden Sunflower Beast Taming Technique, he asked.
"I wouldn't know about that, but if you want to find out, you just need to catch the Golden Cloud Fairy and perform a Soul Search," said Xi Ying.
"You only mentioned the Golden Sunflower Heavenly Book—what about the Lank Jade Book and the Penglai Immortal Book?" Yuan Ming changed the topic and asked.
During the battle at the Magma Lake, the Golden Cloud Fairy did not exhibit exceptional strength but she gave him an inexplicable sense of danger. Unless absolutely necessary, he did not want to conflict with her.
"The information about the Lank Jade Book and Penglai Immortal Book is very limited. The Lank Jade Book is alright; there are several secret techniques that have been leaked, with the Blood Puppet Technique being one of them. Originally called the Jade Puppet Technique, the effect is not as I just explained to you. The Jade Puppet Technique is actually a formula for refining artifacts, using a precious material called Innate Bone Jade to craft a set of Jade Puppet Armor. This armor has an incredible effect. Once worn, the wearer will fall into a slumber. Their life will be preserved, even if they are on the brink of death. No matter how much time passes, whether thousands or tens of thousands of years, as soon as the armor is unsealed, the person inside can wake up again as if from a long dream," said Xi Ying.
Being able to preserve life? That is indeed magical. This Jade Puppet Technique must be a powerful sealing skill, capable of completely sealing vitality!" Yuan Ming exclaimed, trying to understand.
Some people think so. The Jade Puppet Technique is used by some powerful cultivators near the end of their lives to extend their lifespan and works very well. Hence, some major forces from the East Sea traveled across the continent, frantically collecting Innate Bone Jade, and managed to refine a few pieces of Jade Puppet. Unfortunately, Innate Bone Jade is incredibly rare and was quickly exhausted. Those who were undeterred tried to use similar materials to make Jade Puppets but always failed. No matter what material they used, they couldn't form the armor properly, and it would disintegrate at the last moment, leading people to gradually forget the Jade Puppet Technique," Xi Ying stated, pausing briefly as her mouth went dry.
"What happened later?" Yuan Ming asked, engrossed.
"Until about four or five thousand years ago, a refiner from the East Sea, obsessed with the Jade Puppet Technique, spent his entire life trying different materials to refine the Jade Puppet, but to no avail. He was also a genius and, as his lifespan was nearing its end, he used a large amount of his essence blood, soul, and over a dozen yin attribute materials, to create a material very similar to Innate Bone Jade, which he called Blood Demon Jade. Blood Demon Jade could also be used to make puppet armor, only the color turned blood red. He renamed the original armor to Blood Puppet, and the Jade Puppet Technique was thus renamed to the Blood Puppet Technique. Once the Blood Puppet Armor was worn, it also had a life-preserving effect, though the wearer wouldn't fall into slumber but could move normally. However, this armor also had a flaw—it would merge with the body once worn and could not be taken off," Xi Ying explained.
"That powerful? In that case, isn't the Blood Puppet even more useful than the original Jade Puppet? Although being unable to take it off can be troublesome, someone on the brink of death probably wouldn't mind," Yuan Ming said.
"Initially, as you say, the cultivators from the East Sea indeed had seven or eight Nascent Soul cultivators with lifespans nearing their end, who approached the Blood Demon Ancestor to buy the armor. The Blood Demon Ancestor readily agreed and refined a batch of Blood Puppet Armor, selling them at a high price. Those Nascent Soul cultivators successfully extended their lifespans using the Blood Puppet Armor, creating a huge stir in the East Sea. Others who were skeptical had to believe and competed to buy Blood Puppet Armor. However, afterward, the Blood Demon Ancestor mysteriously disappeared for no known reason, couldn't be found by anyone, leaving many deeply regretful. Then, decades later, an anomaly occurred. Those Nascent Soul cultivators who had extended their lives with the Blood Puppet began to be slowly consumed by their armor, eventually completely merging into it, leaving no remains," Xi Ying continued.
"Indeed, everything has its price," Yuan Ming wasn't surprised.
"The relatives of those Nascent Soul cultivators were furious and searched everywhere for the Blood Demon Ancestor, but he had vanished many years ago, forcing those people to reluctantly let go of their grievances. However, they later discovered by chance that the magic power and divine souls of the Nascent Soul cultivators devoured by the Blood Puppet still lingered within the armor. Others who wore the Blood Puppet could transform into the appearance of the previous person and inherit their magical abilities and divine skills. This discovery delighted the forces of those Nascent Soul cultivators immensely. A major force cannot deter others without high-level cultivators. The reason those Nascent Soul cultivators had wanted to use the Blood Puppet to extend their lives was also to continue their dominion over their islands. If a Blood Puppet could permanently retain the power of a Nascent Soul, it would also be a good thing. However, the development of events was beyond anyone's expectations; the second generation of Blood Puppet Armor bearers were all Core Formation Stage cultivators who, after controlling the power_attribut of a Nascent Soul for decades, were also consumed by the Blood Puppet Armor. Furthermore, the situation inside the armor drastically changed, the originally sealed Nascent Soul power vanished into thin air, replaced by the magic and souls of those Core Formation Stage cultivators. These forces, undiscouraged, tried several more times, finally confirming that the Blood Puppet Armor could only retain the divine skills of the previous user," Xi Ying continued to explain.
"So it turns out, Blood Puppet Armor is rather useless," Yuan Ming shook his head and said.

chapters.title: Chapter 527 - 503: The Legend of the Three Books
chapters.content:
"Indeed, once this situation became known, the once-famous Blood Puppet Armor quickly declined. Those islands that tried to extend their rule through the Blood Puppet Armor were soon subjugated by other islands, and several pieces of Blood Puppet Armor were lost in the chaos of war. Now, almost no one remembers the existence of Blood Puppet Armor, otherwise Wulu couldn't have passed through the inspection on Fusang Island so easily," Xi Ying said.
"That's not right, didn't you say once the Blood Puppet Armor is worn, it cannot be taken off? Then how could Wulu take off the armor?" Xi Ying raised the question, prompting Yuan Ming to suddenly remember something.
"I also find it unbelievable, which is why I was so surprised when you just said that the Blood Puppet was hanging on the wall. It seems that either Wulu's Blood Puppet Armor has been modified by a master, or this person possesses some other Divine Skills that allow him to remove the Blood Puppet Armor," Xi Ying explained.
"Besides the Jade Puppet Technique, are there other secret techniques passed down in the Lank Jade Book?" Yuan Ming slowly nodded first, then continued to inquire.
"As far as I know, there is one more technique, one that you are aware of. It's the Transplanting Technique that you acquired from Elder Hai of the Guiyuan Sect," Xi Ying explained.
"The Transplanting Technique originated from the Lank Jade Book!" Yuan Ming showed a look of surprise, then calmed down.
The Transplanting Technique was indeed magical and worthy of the reputation of Lank Jade Book.
"The version of the technique you obtained must be incomplete. The Guiyuan Sect could only use it to cultivate a group of Demon Core cultivators. As far as I know, near the East Sea in Southern Border, there was once a sect called the Flower Sect that possessed the complete Transplanting Technique. They performed many miracles, such as transplanting a Level 4 Demon Beast's core into cultivators' bodies to produce Nascent Soul cultivators, implanting demon beast bloodlines into cultivators to enhance their cultivation potential, and even infusing two Divine Souls into one body, cultivating dual-souled cultivators. The founding master of the Flower Sect even based the supreme Divine Skill 'Shifting Flower and Jade' on the Transplanting Technique, which is said to be able to transfer any attack, making them invincible. Unfortunately, that sect has long since declined, and the Transplanting Technique has been lost," Xi Ying sighed.
Yuan Ming also felt regretful, then asked further, "Is there any secret technique revealed from the Penglai Immortal Book?"
"Of the three books, only the Penglai Immortal Book has remained unseen from beginning to end. There is only word of such a book's existence. However, there is a legend in the East Sea that the Penglai Immortal Book records the method of becoming an immortal, and obtaining this book would allow one to become immortal instantly," Xi Ying said.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming shook his head, finding the rumor completely absurd.
To ascend to immortality required steady and arduous cultivation, how could there be a shortcut to instant immortality?
He remained silent, his heart quite yearning for these three Immortal Books, but since he came to the East Sea for the Red Mulberry Immortal Fruit and would soon leave, he probably wouldn't have the chance to encounter these three books. He could only let Qing Tong, Huan Ling Zi, and others try to investigate.
Yuan Ming didn't stay outside for long and went to sit down inside the residence he had established. Using the Silver Token, he opened a barrier and then took out the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear.
The Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear, being an imitation Spiritual Treasure with twelve runes, must not be aimless. There must truly be some guidance within it.
Since the Earth Core Fire Lotus had been completely distributed, Long Chong and others likely didn't have a clear goal. Afterwards, he could lead them in the direction indicated by the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear, which might bring some surprises.
With this thought, Yuan Ming once again purified the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear, fully mastering the rune formation within it, and then put it away.
He composed himself and took a Storage Bag out of his body, performing a gesture with a flick.
With a "clatter," a small pile of items appeared on the ground, consisting of spiritual materials, elixirs, Jade Scroll Books, and the like.
These items all came from what Yuan Ming had acquired from Qing Tong, Huan Ling Zi, and the others. Although he had let them go for some reasons previously, he hadn't been shy about taking quite a bit from them.
The Third-level Demon Pills he had previously granted to Hua Zhi and Lei Yu had also been taken from Huan Ling Zi and others.
Yuan Ming first extended a thread of Spiritual Power and picked up a brown-yellow Spirit Grass.
This grass appeared no different from ordinary Spirit Grass but emitted a pungent odor, staining his Spiritual Power yellow.
This was an extremely poisonous Spirit Grass, its origin unknown to Huan Ling Zi, and even Hua Zhi, who didn't recognize it, merely commented on its fierce toxicity and dared not touch it.
After a brief moment of thought, Yuan Ming tossed the yellow poisonous grass into the Spiritual Beast Bag of Purple Extreme Tai Sui.
Feeling the presence of the poisonous grass, the plump body of Purple Extreme Tai Sui immediately crawled over and devoured the grass in a few bites.
A few breaths later, a yellow stripe appeared on the body of Purple Extreme Tai Sui.
From within the yellow stripe, Yuan Ming sensed a fierce poisonous aura similar to that of the brown-yellow poisonous grass, a flash of understanding crossing his eyes. He then fed Purple Extreme Tai Sui all the highly toxic materials from the ground, along with the brown-red Demon Pill and the Purple Spiritual Fruit he had previously obtained from Qing Tong.
Soon, several more poisonous stripes appeared on Tai Sui, each emitting a distinctly fierce toxin.
The body of Purple Extreme Tai Sui writhed, the several poisonous stripes slowly converging, and eventually merged into one, forming a brown poison stripe.
Yuan Ming flicked his finger, sending a Sword Qi into the Spiritual Beast Bag, and made a small incision on the merged poison stripe, causing a small puff of brown poisonous mist to escape.
He took out a Jade Bottle, applied a layer of Cold Moon Crystal Film to it, collected the brown poisonous mist into it, and then threw the bottle to Hua Zhi.
"See how potent this brown poisonous mist is?"
Catching the Jade Bottle, a tendril from Hua Zhi stretched into the bottle. Instantly, countless brown spots appeared on the tendril, spreading rapidly toward Hua Zhi's main body.
Startled, Hua Zhi immediately severed the contaminated tendril like avoiding a plague, and retracted.
The tendril left in the bottle rapidly turned brown, then crumbled inch by inch into a powdery dust.
"Such potent Earth Attribute poison, and it spreads extremely quickly, extremely effective against Water attribute demon beasts," Hua Zhi said.
"How toxic is it?" Yuan Ming asked again.
"I can only say the toxicity is very strong," Hua Zhi hesitated slightly, saying somewhat helplessly.
"Without a reference, it's indeed hard to judge. Let's do this, set your own toxicity as one point, how does this brown poison fog compare?" Yuan Ming thought for a moment, then said.
"Considering the intensity of the toxicity, the erosion speed, the difficulty in neutralizing it, and other factors, this poison should be around five points," Hua Zhi weighed for a moment and gave an answer.
"Five points, huh, that's not bad. What about this bottle of One Rihong?" Yuan Ming tossed the wine red medicine bottle into Hua Zhi's Spiritual Beast Bag; a burst of white light emerged from the bottle stopper, and many white Spiritual Patterns appeared on the entire bottle.
Yuan Ming formed a gesture with his hands, and the white Spiritual Patterns collapsed, the white light on the bottle stopper also dissipated, and with a bang, it automatically opened.
"What are you doing? Trying to poison me to death?" Hua Zhi had also heard Qing Tong and Huan Ling Zi's conversation earlier and screamed in horror as if faced with a dreadful creature.
"Don't worry," Yuan Ming waved the silver token in his hand, making a point in the void.
A silver barrier about a foot in diameter appeared around the wine red medicine bottle, and many transparent water droplets, which were virtually imperceptible to the naked eye, emerged from the bottle's mouth; Yuan Ming, supported by the Divine Sense of the Stealing Heaven Tripod, was the only one who could capture these transparent droplets.
The transparent water droplets moved swiftly within the silver barrier, rebounded when they hit the barrier.
Over the past few days, his proficiency with the silver token had improved significantly, and he was able to open several spatial barriers simultaneously.
The toxicity of One Rihong was intense, capable of penetrating any Magic Treasure or protective shield formed by secret techniques, yet the spatial barrier was of a special nature that even One Rihong could not affect.
He had already verified this before; otherwise, he wouldn't dare to toss the medicine bottle directly into Hua Zhi's Spiritual Beast Bag.
Hua Zhi then relaxed, moved closer, but could see nothing.
"One Rihong is colorless and odorless; you won't be able to see it. Here, split off a tendril and try twining it around the silver barrier," Yuan Ming said.
Hua Zhi did as instructed.
CheckforthelatestupdatesonMyVirtualLibraryEmpire(*).
Yuan Ming pointed with the token once more, and a larger silver barrier enveloped both Hua Zhi's tendril and the silver barrier.
The silver barrier trembled and collapsed, and seven or eight transparent water droplets touched Hua Zhi's tendril, merging into it.
Hua Zhi's tendril quickly turned red, the previously lively tendril instantly stopped moving, losing all its vitality.
Although One Rihong is said to inflict pain for a day before causing death, if the life force of the creature is too weak, it can also quickly succumb to poisoning and die.
Hua Zhi's expression changed drastically, and he fell silent.
"How about that? Can you sense it clearly now?" Yuan Ming asked.
"Almost, only that your silver barrier completely cut off my mental connection with the tendril. Could you take the tendril out so that I can sense it more clearly?" Hua Zhi said.
"Certainly," Yuan Ming swung the token.
Hua Zhi's tendril fell downwards, the silver barrier cracked a tiny slit, and the tendril dropped down, the slit immediately closed, and those pale red droplets did not leak out.
Hua Zhi looked at the lifeless tendril, controlled another tendril to gently touch it, but the redness did not spread.
"Don't worry, once One Rihong penetrates a creature's body, its toxicity fully integrates with the creature, sharing life and death. When the creature is poisoned to death, the toxicity of One Rihong will also disappear," Yuan Ming said.
Hua Zhi's expression relaxed, continued to sense the completely lifeless tendril, soon retracted the tendril, and said, "Truly a terrifying poison. One Rihong is far more potent than the poison I contain and the brown poison fog from earlier. According to the previous assessment standard, this poison's toxicity should reach... twenty points."
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming slowly nodded, now having a rough idea of the toxicity of One Rihong.
He waved the silver token, and the silver barrier wrapping the wine red medicine bottle quickly shrank, compressing all the transparent water droplets back into the bottle.
The bottle stopper fell, resealing the jade bottle, and the white Spiritual Patterns reappearing, resealing the bottle.
Yuan Ming continued to examine the items on the ground, quickly went through all the spiritual materials, and categorized and stored them properly.
Afterward, he opened the remaining medicine bottles and examined each one attentively.
Most of these medicine bottles contained elixirs for enhancing Cultivation, which appeared very potent and perfectly suited for his use; the rest were for healing, Detoxification Elixirs, all very precious.

chapters.title: Chapter 528 - 504 Different Purposes
chapters.content:
After storing the medicine bottles, Yuan Ming picked up several jade scrolls and began to inspect them one by one.
Contained within these jade scrolls were the inherited cultivation techniques and various secret techniques from the Thousand Snake Island, Kongling Island, Winter Crystal Island, and Golden Lotus Island.
At first, Yuan Ming skimmed through the scrolls casually, but as time went on, his expression gradually became more serious.
A long while later, he set down the last jade scroll and let out a deep sigh.
By now, Yuan Ming had mastered the Nine Elements Technique, the Moonlight Technique, the Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill, and many other exquisite techniques. In Shura Palace, he had also acquired a multitude of techniques and secret skills from the Six Desires Venerable, Dugu Feng, and others; he considered his knowledge to be extremely broad.
However, the techniques like the Empty Illusion Reincarnation Skill from Kongling Island, the Heavenly Snake Mysterious Skill, the Hundred-Transformed Snake Shadow Body Technique from the Snake-man Clan, the Extreme Cold Xuanming Technique from Winter Crystal Island, and the Nine Palace Divine Seal Path from Golden Lotus Island all gave him a feeling of revelation, as though he was seeing something new. Merely a cursory glance opened up many new horizons for him.
In particular, the Empty Illusion Reincarnation Skill from Kongling Island, which integrated illusion techniques with cultivation techniques, and to some extent, merged soul cultivation with magic cultivation, gave him numerous insights. The creator of this technique must, like him, have been practicing both soul and magic techniques and reached an extremely high level in both aspects.
Inspired by the Empty Illusion Reincarnation Skill, he might be able to combine the Nine Elements Technique with the Moonlight Technique for his cultivation.
However, this goal was still far too distant for him. At the very least, he had to wait until he achieved a breakthrough in his magic cultivation to the Nascent Soul Stage and soul cultivation to the Sleep Witch Realm before considering it.
Yuan Ming stored the several jade scrolls and sat in meditation with his eyes closed.
Time passed by slowly, and a day went by in the blink of an eye, with Long Chong and the others finishing their cultivation one after another.
"As expected, the deeper we enter the secret realm, the stronger the pull of the abyss. Crossing it will undoubtedly be much harder than the previous two times," Yuan Ming thought to himself before looking towards the mainland on the far right.
The Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear was pointing towards that continent.
"How should we choose among these three continents?" Long Chong looked at the other three and asked.
Qiong Yun took out the Black Wood Compass to sense the surroundings. The shadow of a spoon spun around in the air, but it couldn't stabilize.
"It's probably too far to sense the situation on the far continents," the woman said, shaking her head.
"All three continents look similar; if we can't get a reading, let's head to the one on the right first—it looks the closest," Yuan Ming took the opportunity to suggest.
"That works," none of the three had any objections, and they started discussing how to cross the abyss.
"This abyss has incredible suction, and considering the distance, acting alone is likely to be unsustainable. It's better for the four of us to join forces and use a magic treasure to cross," Wulu was the first to propose.
Yuan Ming had also thought of this method and nodded in agreement.
"I'm afraid that won't work," Qiong Yun disagreed, however.
"Why not?" Wulu didn't understand.
Qiong Yun didn't explain; instead, she took out two jade scrolls and handed them to Yuan Ming and Wulu.
Yuan Ming received the jade scroll and used his Divine Sense to investigate its contents which included information about many secret realms, among them details about the abyss.
According to the scroll, the Secret Realm Abyss possessed a certain sentience, as if being controlled by someone behind the scenes, making it impossible to cheat in crossing. If two people tried to cross together, the pulling force would double, and for four people, it would quadruple.
Whether people were stored in a Spiritual Beast Bag or another space treasure, it made no difference.
"This jade scroll was exchanged from Zhong Ling of Yuzhu Island when we gathered to pick the Earth Core Fire Lotus; its content, summarized by Zhong Ling, Baili Zhui, and Hua Ping, is absolutely accurate," added Qiong Yun.
Yuan Ming nodded, looking ahead while pondering.
While crossing with many people had its advantages and disadvantages, the key lay in whether the combined effort could overcome the increased pull.
After weighing their options, they decided to cross in pairs; Long Chong and Qiong Yun formed one group, and Yuan Ming and Wulu formed another.
Qiong Yun conjured a Purple Jade Flying Boat to carry Long Chong, while Yuan Ming operated the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear, taking Wulu with him. They transformed into two purple tunneling lights and simultaneously entered the abyss.
A suction force, twice as strong as the one that had pulled away the Flying Knife, emerged once again, dragging both tunneling lights downwards.
Qiong Yun and Long Chong shouted in unison as the Purple Jade Flying Boat surged with purple electrical arcs, resisting the pull of the abyss and moving quickly forward.
The same was true for Yuan Ming, who, with their combined efforts, caused the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear to radiate intense purple light, resisting the pull from below.
Yuan Ming's expression was intense, yet he felt quite at ease on the inside.
With the seals of the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear broken, its power had surged, making it much more capable of resisting the abyss's suction than before. He even had to deliberately suppress the spear's power to prevent Wulu from noticing any flaws.
Yuan Ming and Wulu worked together to operate the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear, standing close to each other. Wulu dared not draw upon the mana within his Blood Puppet Armor and, so as not to expose his true level of cultivation, he was constantly pushing his mana to its limits.
"Brother Hong, there's no need for you to exert your mana to such an extent," Yuan Ming gently warned.
"No trouble, I can still manage," Wulu replied.
"Brother Wulu, there's no need to strain yourself in front of me. The Blood Puppet Armor is a dangerous item; you should conserve some mana to prevent it from backfiring on you," Yuan Ming transmitted his voice.
"You..." Wulu's face changed.
The Blood Puppet Armor was one of his greatest trump cards, but he never expected that Yuan Ming had already seen through it, and he was none the wiser.
His back was drenched in cold sweat. Amidst the shock, he almost developed a sense of fear towards Yuan Ming.
"Brother Yuan, who exactly are you? What's your purpose for coming to this secret realm?" Wulu paused for a few breaths before barely regaining his composure, and then he asked through a mental message.
"I am who I am, with no other identity. As for my purpose in coming to this secret realm, naturally, it's for the Red Mulberry Immortal Fruit," Yuan Ming responded indifferently through mental communication.
"Is that all?" Wulu pressed.
"I didn't delve into your secrets, Brother Wu Lu, yet now you're probing into mine?" Yuan Ming chuckled and said.
"I dare not pry into Brother Yuan's affairs. It's just that those who enter this secret realm typically have goals beyond just the Immortal Fruit. I'm such a person, and I presume Brother Yuan is as well," Wulu hurriedly stated.
Yuan Ming neither confirmed nor denied, simply waiting for what would come next.
"We have now ventured deep into the secret realm, and the situation will only become more perilous. To put it bluntly, if we encounter life-threatening danger, the current team could disband at any moment. Why don't we speak openly and join forces if our interests don't conflict? What do you say?" Wulu proposed.
Yuan Ming's eyes moved. This was a good opportunity to probe Wulu's purpose.
After obtaining agreement through Divine Sense from Xi Ying, he replied, "That's acceptable. Please proceed to speak of your purpose then, Brother Wu Lu."
"I am here in this secret realm to go to Three Immortals Island to retrieve an item," Wulu said directly, without any hesitation.
Yuan Ming's eyebrows lifted slightly. As it turned out, this secret realm indeed had a connection to Three Immortals Island.
Within the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
Xi Ying had been keeping track of the outside world through the Golden Crow Soul and spoke up, "This secret realm does indeed lead to Three Immortals Island. The entrance to Three Immortals Island is at the depths of the secret realm, and we should not be far now."
Yuan Ming, manipulating the first soul beside the White Jade Lotus Platform, looked up at Xi Ying, "No wonder you insisted on coming to this secret realm. You've been plotting for some time now. Out with it, what are you planning to do this time?"
"There are treasures scattered all across Three Immortals Island, which cannot be compared with the resources found on these floating continents. Moreover, it might even contain a method to reach the Overseas World. I am going there, naturally, to seek treasure," Xi Ying giggled.Thanksforreading—broughttoyouby*.
"Just opportunistic treasure hunting? You don't have a specific goal?" Yuan Ming was skeptical.
"Not exactly. If possible, I want to get my hands on the Penglai Immortal Book," Xi Ying stated after a slight pause.
"The Penglai Immortal Book! It's on Three Immortals Island? Wasn't it said to have circulated out?" Yuan Ming was quite surprised.
"To my knowledge, that item is still on Three Immortals Island, preserved in the Penglai Hall of Penglai Immortal Island," Xi Ying explained.
"How do you know so clearly?" Yuan Ming couldn't help but ask.
"I've mentioned before that I visited the East Sea with my kin in the past, even venturing to the outer sea. It was in search of the Penglai Immortal Book. Although I didn't find it, I did uncover some clues," Xi Ying explained.
"I see. But what do you want with the book? Don't tell me you believe in the shortcuts to immortality recorded within?" Yuan Ming frowned.
Xi Ying was intelligent and astute, not below him; how could she believe that there were alternative, deviant paths to immortality in the world?
"Let's just give it a try," Xi Ying said slowly, a hint of sadness seemingly flickering in her eyes before she quickly regained her composure.
However, Yuan Ming, with his Divine Sense keenly focused on Xi Ying, caught the fleeting change in her expression.
"Fine, as long as the Penglai Immortal Book is on Three Immortals Island, I will help you obtain it," Yuan Ming said.
"Thank you," Xi Ying spoke softly.
...
After Wulu stated his purpose, he saw that Yuan Ming fell silent and did not speak for a while, which made Wulu somewhat anxious. Unable to resist, he urged, "May I know Brother Yuan's purpose for coming here?"
Yuan Ming then came back to his senses and mentally replied, "Naturally, I am also going to Three Immortals Island to fetch an item for a friend. I just hope that what you and I are seeking is not the same, otherwise not only will we fail to cooperate, but we may also have to fight it out."
"It shouldn't be the case; the item I need is on Lank Immortal Island of the Three Immortals Island. It's quite obscure, so it's unlikely that anyone else would require it," Wulu stated.
"What I need is on Penglai Island; it seems we have no reason to fight," Yuan Ming nodded and said.
Relief flooded Wulu's heart at this news.
He had believed that with Yuan Ming's profound and unfathomable divine skills, even though he had other cards to play, he had no confidence to compete with Yuan Ming; he had even prepared for the worst, ready to give up if their goals clashed.
Although the Abyss was vast and both the Purple Jade Flying Boat and the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear were fast, they quickly covered most of the distance and were soon to reach the opposite shore.
Just at that moment, a turbulence suddenly emerged from the dark depths of the Abyss. A swirl of wind rose up, forming numerous large and small vortexes of airflow.
The Purple Jade Flying Boat and the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear were effortlessly tossed around like leaves in the wind, making it nearly impossible for the four individuals to maintain their stance, let alone avoid being swallowed by the storm.
The four of them hastily tried casting to stabilize themselves, but to no avail; they could only drift with the storm.
Suddenly, a massive shadow loomed at the far end of the Abyss, appearing to be a giant azure bird, with only half of its head and one wing visible; from afar, it nearly rivaled the size of a continent.
The sight of such a colossal beast was new to all four, leaving them momentarily stunned.
It was then that the azure giant bird's enormous pupil shifted, seemingly glancing at Yuan Ming and his companions from afar before suddenly opening its beak, emitting a piercing screech!
The tangible sonic waves spread out and approached, dispersing the nearby storms with their force.
Yuan Ming and the others had no time to dodge or to react, caught in the onrush of the deafening sound. Like thunder exploding beside their ears, their Sea of Consciousness vibrated with a buzz, the world spinning around them as they seemed to fall into an illusion.
They couldn't muster their Mana; their bodies fell directly toward the depths of the Abyss.

chapters.title: Chapter 529 - 505 Bone Horned Horse
chapters.content:
"Wake up quickly!"
As Yuan Ming rapidly descended, golden light burst forth within his Sea of Consciousness, and the soul of the Golden Crow from Xi Ying emitted a grandiose sound!
