Yuan Ming suddenly awoke, no longer bothering to conceal himself, and quickly maneuvered his hands to cast a spell, unleashing all the power of the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear.
"Whoosh," a dragon-like purple light lifted his and Wulu's bodies, rushing towards Long Chong and Qiong Yun and scooping them up as well.
Boom!
The suction from the abyss once again doubled in strength, and the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear couldn't withstand it, plummeting downwards.
"Hong Ling, Blood Shadow! Lend me a hand!" Yuan Ming's heart sank, and he connected with the Shura Blood Devouring Map through his Divine Sense.
Two grand jets of blood light shot out from his body, infusing into the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear, which then emitted a joyous and incomparable whistle as all twelve runes were fully activated, and the rune formation rapidly spun.
Under the explosive increase in power of the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear, it shot up into the sky once more, like a frenzied dragon breaking through the heavens, bursting out of the storm of air currents.
The purple light moved like lightning, instantly covering a distance of several hundred yards, escaping from the region of the abyss and landing upon the continent; the terrifying suction instantly dissipated.
At the same time, Hong Ling and Blood Shadow withdrew their Mana, and the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear reverted to its original form.
Yuan Ming heaved a sigh of relief, flipped his hand to store the long spear, and Wulu, Long Chong, and Qiong Yun three dropped to the ground.
The three of them were still in a daze at this moment, not yet recovered from the screeches they had just endured.
Yuan Ming sent out three streams of Soul Power to help them awaken, then turned to look back into the Bottomless Black Abyss where the azure giant bird had already disappeared, and the violent currents within the abyss were gradually calming.
"What was that giant bird just now? How could it be so huge?" Yuan Ming was still taken aback.
"If I'm not mistaken, that should be an Overseas Demon Beast, possessing part of the Kunpeng's bloodline," Xi Ying slowly said.
"Indeed, it's only the Demon Beasts from the Overseas World that could possibly have such a massive size, but why would such a creature appear in this Secret Realm?" Yuan Ming was puzzled.
"Who knows? Three Immortals Island is indeed extraordinary; not even seeing the entrance yet and we've already encountered an Overseas Demon Beast. I wonder what kind of surprises await once we truly enter Three Immortals Island," Xi Ying stated with considerable excitement.
"You talk as if it's simple. If there are such Overseas Demon Beasts all over inside Three Immortals Island, we'd better head back immediately. Otherwise, even multiple lives wouldn't be enough to spare," Yuan Ming shook his head and said.
The pressure that the azure giant bird had left on him far exceeded that of a Nascent Soul cultivator, at least a Level 4 Upper Stage, or even a Level 5 existence. He admitted that although his strength was not weak now, he didn't have the audacity to engage in combat with a Level 5 Demon Beast.
"Don't worry, it shouldn't be so perilous inside Three Immortals Island," Xi Ying assured.
"Let's hope so," Yuan Ming said as he rubbed his forehead.
Wulu and the others had strong Divine Souls, and with Yuan Ming's assistance, they quickly came to their senses.
"We're still alive? Ha ha, I actually thought for sure we were going to be swallowed by the abyss and die without a complete corpse!" As Long Chong leapt up, he laughed heartily.
"Brother Yuan, could it be that you saved us?" Qiong Yun steadied himself and turned to ask Yuan Ming.
"I'm hardly that capable. I had also been immobilized by that azure bird's cry just now. But at the last moment, when I saw the azure bird flap its wings, raising a sky-high gale, we might have been blown here by that wind," Yuan Ming shook his head, a hint of lingering fear crossing his face just right.
"You're becoming more and more smooth and natural at talking nonsense; it seems you're naturally suited for lying and acting—no wonder you were able to awaken the 'Emotion Manipulation' ability," Xi Ying chuckled lightly.
Yuan Ming secretly smiled bitterly; he did not want to lie, but with the continuous crises in the secret realm and the unclear objectives of others, he could not reveal his true strength.
Wulu looked at Yuan Ming but remained silent.
"Is that so? I wonder what the origins of that azure giant bird are? To be able to move so freely within this Black Abyss, it's probably a Level 4 Upper Stage Demon Beast, or possibly even Level 5," Qiong Yun said with a frown.This сhаptеr's truе sоurсе is Мy Virtuаl Librаry Еmpirе (М|V|LЕМР-YR).
"Why worry so much about that? The point is that we are alive," Long Chong stated nonchalantly.
Qiong Yun rolled his eyes at Long Chong but temporarily set aside his confusion, turning his head to view the continent in front of them.
An intense wave of Spiritual Energy hit them in the face, several times more concentrated than the previous continent.
Qiong Yun felt the Spiritual Energy penetrate into his body, rejuvenating his nearly depleted Dantian and Qi Sea, without even actively cultivating.
"Such dense Spiritual Energy, comparable to the effect of the Third-Rank Gathering Spirit Array on Thousand Dragon Island—is there a Gathering Spirit Stone or Gathering Spirit Spring here, one of those spirit-gathering treasures?" Now Long Chong had also noticed this and exclaimed in surprise.
The so-called Gathering Spirit Stones and Gathering Spirit Springs are manifestations of a Spirit Vein, and only extremely potent Spirit Veins, through tens of thousands or even hundreds of thousands of years of evolution, have the possibility of crystallizing into such treasures. These divine items can automatically draw in nature's spiritual energy; even if they are placed in a barren area lacking in Spiritual Energy, they can eventually form a Spirit Vein over time, a much-coveted treasure for any Cultivation Sect.
Yuan Ming's heart stirred as he considered the thin nature's spiritual energy within the space of his Stealing Heaven Tripod. If he could obtain one or two Gathering Spirit objects, the situation would greatly improve.
"What a pity, if it weren't for the Star Rain and Starry Sky Beast, this place would really be an excellent place for cultivation," Qiong Yun said with a shake of his head.
Hearing this, Long Chong and Lu nodded in agreement, their expressions filled with regret.
Seizing the opportunity to rest after landing, Yuan Ming surveyed the surrounding scenery.
On the vast plains, a gentle breeze flitted by, allowing the tender green shoots to relax their posture while tickling the ankles of passersby.
Tiny streams crossed the land like silver mirrors, reflecting the star-filled sky, yet their origins and destinations were a mystery.
Green grass and clear water were scattered with verdant trees, standing like stars among the grassland. They were spaced far enough apart from each other not to form a dense forest.
Yuan Ming suddenly uttered a sound of surprise and approached a nearby thicket, waving his hand to part the thick shrubbery and revealing several small green plants that emitted faint fluctuations of spiritual energy.
These small green plants, known as Green Leaf Grass, were not of high grade, but they were genuine Spirit Grass.
He moved to another thicket, and after parting it, revealed a few purple Spiritual Flowers, which were also a kind of low-level Spirit Grass.
Yuan Ming's Divine Sense spread out, his eyes showing a look of disbelief.
This grassland was filled with Spirit Grass and Spiritual Flowers everywhere. Although they were all low-level, the sight was still shocking.
His figure lifted off and landed on a nearby hill. The other side of the hill was also an endless prairie where many beasts roamed.
Closest to him were a herd of plump gray deer, all of which were demon beasts, bowing their heads to forage for the Spirit Grass.
These gray deer were all First-level Demon Beasts, not high in grade but quite numerous. The group before him had at least a hundred individuals.
With Spirit Grass everywhere and herds of demon beasts, Yuan Ming found himself at a loss for words to describe this continent.
Just then, a cloud of dust rose from the distance, and amidst the rolling dust approached a type of Bone Horned Horse, with large horns on their heads, grey fur, and white manes. Their bone-hooves were pale, and though horse-like in shape, their eyes flashed with ferocity as they charged directly at the gray deer.
The deer immediately fled, but unfortunately, their speed was no match for the Bone Horned Horses. Many of the deer were impaled by the horses' horns and fell into pools of blood.
There were a dozen Bone Horned Horses, most of them Second-level Middle Stage demon beasts, but three reached the Second Rank Upper Stage, and there was a leader at the Third-level Lower Stage, all of which were larger than the other Bone Horned Horses.
In a matter of moments, the dozen or so Bone Horned Horses scattered and hunted the entire herd of deer, devouring their flesh, revealing that these horses were carnivorous as they gnawed on the bodies of the gray deer.
The Bone Horned Horse King sensed Yuan Ming's presence. Their carnivorous nature drove them to advance, yet they hesitated, snorting loudly while loitering in the distance.
"Wow, a Third-level Bone Horned Horse, I didn't expect to be so lucky to find such good items upon our arrival here," Long Chong and his companions flew over and saw the figure of the beast, becoming excited at once.
"Brother Long, is this Bone Horned Horse really rare?" Yuan Ming asked, puzzled.
Long Chong smiled and explained, "Heh heh, Brother Yuan may not know, the Bone Horned Horse itself isn't anything special. Their horns are used to refine Healing Pills, leading many islands to establish ranches specifically to breed such demon beasts, even my own family owns an island dedicated to raising them."
Yuan Ming grew increasingly curious, "Then why does Brother Long say it's a good find?"
"Because the Bone Horned Horse is commonly recognized for its mixed bloodlines, not to mention third-level, ordinary ranches scarcely see any that reach the Second Rank Upper Stage. Only at my Thousand Dragon Island, having made considerable achievements in refining bloodlines, have we been able to breed a Third-level Bone Horned Horse. This also revealed that upon reaching the third-level, the Bone Horned Horse's singular horn undergoes a transformation; its previous bone-healing effect shifts to bone strengthening. The Bone Forging Blood Pills refined from this have the miraculous effect of strengthening bones and tendons, which is particularly helpful for Body Cultivation practitioners to break through the Innate Body realm," Long Chong elaborated with pride.
Yuan Ming nodded thoughtfully. He was currently cultivating the third layer of the Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill and felt somewhat tempted by the elixir Long Chong mentioned.
Seeing Yuan Ming's interest, Long Chong immediately laughed and said, "This Third-level Bone Horned Horse seems to be a mutant species, much larger than normal. Taking its horn should yield enough for four or five bottles. But currently, our Mana is depleted, and that's why those horses hesitated earlier. If we wait any longer, they might flee to avoid danger. How about we jointly attack? You help me block the other Bone Horned Horses for a moment, and I'll handle the leader. Once the pills are refined, I'll share two bottles with you, Brother Yuan."
"Thank you for your generous offer, Brother Long. I'll not stand on ceremony," Yuan Ming responded with a bow of gratitude.
Long Chong waved his hand nonchalantly, then gripped his spear, stirring up the small amount of Mana he had just recovered, and shot towards the Bone Horned Horses.
Yuan Ming followed immediately.
Qiong Yun and Lu, listening to the conversation between Yuan Ming and Long Chong, lacked interest in the Bone Forging Blood Pill. A mere Third-level Bone Horned Horse was not worth their intervention, so they looked on from the sidelines while cultivating to restore their own Mana.
The Bone Horned Horse King, upon seeing Long Chong and Yuan Ming charging, showed a glint of human-like caution in its eyes. Still, it was enticed by the weakened Mana fluctuations emanating from Long Chong and Yuan Ming, and with a loud neigh, it led its henchmen in a charge.
In an instant, the herd thundered across the field, grass flying everywhere as the spiritual light gathered at the tip of the horses' single horn, then quickly joining together to envelop the horses, like a sharp arrow slicing through the plains with an imposing momentum.
This group of Bone Horned Horses was proficient in the Joint Attack Technique, their force synergizing together, and the overall power was no weaker than a Third-level Upper Stage.

chapters.title: Chapter 530 - 506: The Giant Elephant
chapters.content:
Facing the stampeding herd of horses, Long Chong was not frightened but delighted. He immediately channeled all his recently recovered Spiritual Power into his spear, and the majestic momentum burst forth with a sound as if a rainbow were tearing through the sky, resembling the roar of a water dragon in the mysterious void.
Behind Long Chong, Yuan Ming waved his hand and shot out two streaks of Black Sword Qi, striking first at the spirit light connecting the unicorns of the horse herd.
A Sword Qi capable of extinguishing souls directly penetrated into the Divine Soul of the Bone Horned Horse, causing the herd to panic and scatter in disarray, breaking the continuous stream of spirit light with ease.
Overjoyed, Long Chong charged directly at the flustered Bone Horned Horse King and with a "puff" sound, pierced through its head, splattering red and white matter.
The unicorn and most of the skull of the Horse King were blown away; Long Chong lifted his spear, wrapped it around the remains, and collected them.
With the Bone Horned Horse King killed, the rest of the horses dispersed in terror, running off in all directions. Naturally, Yuan Ming paid little attention to this.
"Haha, Brother Yuan, choosing this continent was truly a brilliant move. We've just arrived and already we've had such a harvest," Long Chong carefully cut off the unicorn, saying happily.
"It's just luck. This continent seems to hold many treasures, but we should restore our Mana first before exploring further," Yuan Ming said.
Long Chong nodded in agreement, and flew back with Yuan Ming to a hill where they sat cross-legged to recover their Mana.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, we just assisted you and allowed you to escape a dangerous situation, consuming a lot of our Mana in the process. You really should compensate us well," Hong Ling's proud voice rang out in Yuan Ming's Sea of Consciousness, reverting back to addressing him formally.
"That's right, there are demon beasts all over this continent. Fellow Daoist Yuan, just capturing some and refining them into Blood Origin Power should be enough for us to recover," Blood Shadow said.
"Don't worry, you won't be short-changed," Yuan Ming said then stopped paying attention to the two, focusing on practicing the Nine Elements Technique.
The nature's spiritual energy on this continent was incredibly dense, and the four quickly recovered, proceeding deeper into the continent and advancing hundreds of miles quite rapidly.
Along the way, the four expanded their horizons; the continent was truly full of Spirit Grass and swarming with demon beasts.
In these hundreds of miles, relying on the Black Wood Compass from Qiong Yun, the four gathered many valuable spiritual materials.
Yuan Ming also hunted many large and Qi-Blood filled demon beasts, refining them into Blood Origin Power for Hong Ling and Blood Shadow to absorb.
"I've sensed another precious spiritual material, this item is extraordinary!" Qiong Yun summoned the Black Wood Compass, and the shadow of the spoon shook violently, pointing to the front left.
"Let's go." Long Chong took the lead and flew towards the left front, with the others quickly following until they soon arrived in front of a valley.
Without needing the guidance of the Black Wood Compass, everyone clearly sensed powerful Earth Attribute Spiritual Power fluctuations filling the valley.
However, they did not rashly enter. On this continent where demon beasts abound, all precious spiritual materials encountered along the way were guarded by demon beasts.
The spiritual object in the valley had such immense power, far greater than those materials they had encountered previously; securing it would inevitably require a battle with the demon beasts inside.
Long Chong and the others extended their Divine Sense to probe inside the valley but detected no trace of demon beasts.
"What's going on... Could it be that this spiritual material is unguarded?" Wulu said.
The group exchanged glances, then entered the valley.
They proceeded with caution, yet they did not shrink back from seizing the opportunity, especially since their strength had greatly increased with the power of the Earth Core Fire Lotus, enough to retreat unscathed even if attacked by a swarm of third-level demon beasts.
The four entered the valley, following the vibrations of the Spiritual Power, quickly arriving in front of a huge pit. Powerful Earth Attribute vibrations were emanating from the bottom of the pit.
Yuan Ming activated his Divine Sense to probe, quickly sensing the source of the strong Earth Attribute fluctuations at the bottom of the pit—it was a massive piece of yellow jade, several meters tall, enveloped in swirling yellow light, clearly a treasure.
"This is the Houtu Mountain Stone! Such a large piece could refine two or three Nine Rune Level Earth Attribute Magic Treasures!" Long Chong sensed the presence of the yellow jade, his face showing wild joy.
Qiong Yun and Wulu also showed joy on their faces.
Yuan Ming too, his expression more intense than the others, almost dumbstruck.
"Although the Houtu Mountain Stone is splendid, Brother Yuan, there's no need to be so thrilled," Wulu communicated telepathically.
"I have lost my composure," Yuan Ming regained his senses and smiled sheepishly.
It wasn't the Houtu Mountain Stone in front of him that excited him, but rather, when the Divine Sense of his first soul probed nearby, he made an unexpected discovery deep beneath the pit, hundreds of meters underground.Please read this chapter on its original platform—*.
Seven or eight hundred meters below the ground, there was another piece of Houtu Mountain Stone, even larger.
To call it Houtu Mountain Stone might be an understatement; this stone was two to three hundred meters tall, nearly the size of a small mountain, and could almost be considered a Houtu Mountain Peak.
Near the Houtu Mountain Peak, astonishing gravitational fluctuations of earth filled the area, attracting the Earth's lethal gas and Primordial Magnetic Power from below, forming a strange magnetic field, which made it impossible for Divine Sense to approach.
Only with the enhanced Divine Sense from the Stealing Heaven Tripod could one explore it smoothly without being affected.
"Such a huge Houtu Mountain Stone would fetch an astronomical price if extracted, but the Houtu Mountain is simply too huge to be taken out, and even if it could be, there's no Storage Bag that could hold it," Yuan Ming pondered.
As he was deep in thought, Long Chong flew into the deep pit, attempting to retrieve that piece of Houtu Mountain Stone.
"Brother Long, be careful, there are demon beasts lurking underground!" Yuan Ming urgently warned.
There were demon beasts lurking near the Houtu Mountain Stone at the bottom of the pit, but their presence was hard to detect due to the influence of the Houtu Mountain.
Long Chong, hearing Yuan Ming's warning, did not pay heed. His body blurred, and he landed at the bottom of the pit, his sleeve sweeping towards the yellow jade.
The ground near the Houtu Mountain Stone cracked open, and seven or eight yellow lizards emerged from the earth, biting towards Long Chong, each with the strength of a Second Level Upper Stage.
Yuan Ming, Wulu, and the others did not take action, not out of disregard for their ally, but because Long Chong was filled with war intent and his momentum was like a rainbow. Any premature intervention by others would have hindered Long Chong's enjoyment of a vigorous battle.
Long Chong let out a long howl, his spear splitting into two, streaks of it slashing through the heads of two yellow lizards.
The lizards' heads burst open, the rest, shocked and enraged, surrounded him and attacked. The yellow demon light emitted by several lizards unexpectedly merged into one, similar to the previously encountered Bone Horned Horses, they knew Joint Attack Skill.
Long Chong was fearless, his body and spear moving as one. He charged directly at the weak spot of the joint attack by the lizard demon beasts.
Yuan Ming silently nodded in approval. Long Chong, having broken through to the Peak of Late-stage Core Formation, had significantly improved not only in strength but also in insight.
Just then, a strong demon energy surged from beneath the ground. It entered the range of the first soul division's Divine Sense and headed straight for Long Chong at an alarmingly fast speed.
Just as Yuan Ming was about to warn, the ground near Long Chong suddenly shook and cracked. From a fissure appeared a thick grey elephant trunk without warning; it whipped out and shattered the yellow light encapsulating the yellow lizards in an instant.
The remaining yellow lizards cried out in unison, their body's Spiritual Light dimming rapidly, fear evident in their eyes as they turned to flee.
Seeing the sudden change, Long Chong did not stop his attack. His spear glowed with a dazzling cyan Spiritual Light, crashing like a tsunami against the elephant trunk. However, as the light faded, only a shallow white mark was left on the trunk — it hadn't even pierced the skin.
Long Chong's complexion changed dramatically. He didn't even think of landing another blow but shouted, "No good, it's a Level 4 Demon Beast, flee quickly!"
Then, he no longer cared about retrieving the Houtu Mountain Stone and, like the yellow lizards, turned to escape.
A deafening roar erupted from below. The ground split open once more, emitting a strong suction force.
The yellow lizards fell one after another into the fissure and disappeared while the trunk whipped towards Long Chong.
At this moment, drained of Mana and unable to escape far, Long Chong was about to be struck by the trunk. Just at the critical moment, he saw a flash of silver lightning zip past him. A hand reached out from within the lightning, quickly pulling him into it.
The moment the trunk was about to strike, the silver lightning shot forward, narrowly dodging the attack, then without a pause, it ascended rapidly into the sky.
Within the lightning, Long Chong breathed a sigh of relief at his narrow escape and bowed, "Thank you, Brother Yuan, for saving me."
Within the silvery lightning, it was indeed Yuan Ming and Lei Yu. Sensing the surge of the powerful demonic power, he had called upon Lei Yu to escape immediately. However, seeing Long Chong in danger and recalling the care taken throughout their journey, he couldn't bear it and took the risk to save him.
Yuan Ming nodded slightly, did not respond immediately, but urged Lei Yu beneath his feet to quicken their flying escape. In a blink of an eye, they dashed out of the deep pit and fled towards the valley outside.
Qiong Yun and Wulu, hearing Long Chong's shouts, followed suit.
Qiong Yun's gaze was full of worry and concern as she looked at Long Chong, who managed a smile and was about to reassure her when a thunderous roar echoed through the sky. Turning his head, he saw a large fissure splitting the valley floor, and a gigantic dark shadow rising rapidly— it was a massive demon elephant.
The demon elephant stood ten Zhang tall, its body dark gray except for an earth-yellow pattern that extended from its trunk to its back, and its long, thick tusks were stained with dark red blood. Dangling from them were several barely alive yellow lizards, emitting intermittent cries of agony.
Unlike its massive body size, the demon elephant's eyes were as small as beans, yet they exhibited deeper emotions. Its gaze towards Yuan Ming and the others was filled with both wariness and murderous intent.
The demon elephant opened its mouth wide, a torrential sucking force enveloping the several lizard bodies and swallowing them. Then, it stepped forward, chasing after Yuan Ming and the others.
It seemed sluggish, but with each step, it lunged tens of Zhang forward, making it appear not so much that it walked but rather the ground whisked backward away from it.
The four darted side to side, constantly changing directions. The demon elephant, set in its resolve to kill them, relentlessly pursued.
Despite the demon elephant's stature suggesting sluggishness, its speed acclaimed it better suited than even typical Nascent Soul cultivators. Yuan Ming and his companions, while being outstanding in the Core Formation stage, were still slower in escape speed than Nascent Soul cultivators, and the distance between them continuously closed.
Seeing this unfold, Yuan Ming's heart sank. Even with Lei Yu's extraordinary escape speed, they were not eluding the chase. Soon, they would be caught and forced to confront this demon directly.
This demon elephant had just lunged from underground to attack Long Chong, making it clear that an escape by burrowing was also futile.

chapters.title: Chapter 531 - 507: The Relic Spire
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming asked himself with his current means, if he really had to confront this giant elephant, he could manage, but that would expose all his strength, which would be a loss greater than the gain.
Just at that moment, the voice of Xi Ying echoed in Yuan Ming's Sea of Consciousness, "Head southwest; there's a place there to hide. If you move quickly, you should be able to reach it before the giant elephant catches up."
Yuan Ming was startled by these words; however, trusting Xi Ying, he didn't ask further questions but simply commanded Lei Yu to change their direction of flight.
He was naturally the fastest, and his previous direction was south; now, he only had to adjust slightly. The Qiong Yun and Wulu behind him unconsciously followed without any suspicion.
Fifteen minutes later, the giant elephant was only a hundred yards from the four of them, looking like it was about to catch up.
"This giant elephant is relentless in its pursuit; we might as well fight it! The four of us together should be able to handle a Level 4 demon beast!" Long Chong, frustrated by being chased, said angrily.
At that moment, on the distant horizon, a huge city wall appeared, stretching across the grassland.
Behind the city wall, dozens of tall but dilapidated buildings stood. Among the ruins and broken walls were the marks left by ages.
Yuan Ming narrowed his eyes; he was familiar with the ruins before him—they were indeed the remnants of the Wanqu Clan from the ocean depths!
"An underwater relic at the entrance to the secret realm? There's one here too? Could it be that someone lives within this secret realm?" Long Chong and the others also recognized the buildings ahead and expressed their surprise.
"Let's enter the ruins first; we might find a way out," Yuan Ming called out, Lei Yu transformed into a flash of lightning, carrying everyone as they disappeared into the ruins, with Qiong Yun and Wulu closely following.
As soon as the four had entered the ruins, the giant elephant followed closely behind, its huge body ramming into building after building, creating a thunderous noise and stirring up clouds of dust.
Yuan Ming and the others lowered their tunneling light and used the buildings' interference with the giant elephant to slightly increase their lead.
Just then, an intact pyramid-shaped tall tower appeared in front of them, identical to the Void Temple on Fusang Island and the True Sea Hall on Two-World Island.
The pyramid-shaped structure was also enveloped in a faint layer of white spirit light, which was especially conspicuous under the starlight.
A flicker of astonishment passed through Yuan Ming's eyes. He communicated with Xi Ying using Divine Sense, "How did you know there were Wanqu Clan ruins here?"
"I detected fluctuations stemming from a formation here; it's likely coming from this tower. This formation is no trivial matter. If I'm not mistaken, it should be the Wanqu Clan's Star Shifting Array. You can take refuge inside for now. Once you fully activate the formation, it should be able to block the giant elephant for a while," explained Xi Ying.
Yuan Ming nodded and relayed Xi Ying's words to Long Chong and the others, mentioning only that the tower might be protected by a formation, which could help them evade the giant elephant.
For character sheets and glossaries, visit *.
Upon hearing this, Long Chong and the others hesitated somewhat, as what Yuan Ming said was still speculative. If they indeed entered and found no formation or were unable to activate it, delaying their escape could lead to despair.
And at that moment, the giant elephant that had been relentlessly pursuing them suddenly vanished without a trace, along with its upsurging demon energy.
"What, did the giant elephant give up?" Long Chong was astonished.
"Brother Hong, be careful; it has tunneled into the earth, and it's targeting you!" Yuan Ming urgently exclaimed.
Before he had finished speaking, a yellow light flashed under Wulu, and the giant elephant's huge form unexpectedly emerged from nowhere, its trunk sweeping at Wulu like a giant pillar.
Wulu reacted extremely quickly, immediately shifting to dodge.
However, as the giant elephant opened its mouth, a torrential sucking force enveloped Wulu, and visible ripples appeared in the void, pulling Wulu's fleeing form back.
The thick trunk twisted and coiled toward Wulu's body.
Yuan Ming and the others were some distance from Wulu and wanted to help but were too late.
Just as Wulu was about to be struck, suddenly, in front of everyone, Wulu's figure disappeared into thin air, and the giant elephant's trunk grasped at nothing.
The giant elephant blinked its enormous eyes, showing a hint of confusion as its trunk flailed aimlessly in the air for a moment, hitting nothing.
The elephant then appeared stunned, its trunk groping its head akin to a human hand, even its footsteps halting.
At this moment, Yuan Ming and the others also couldn't sense any trace of Wulu with their Divine Sense as if he had completely disappeared.
Yuan Ming was already aware of Wulu's Invisibility Divine Ability and didn't pay much attention, directing the first soul of his Divine Sense to descend and search for Wulu's trace.
But the next moment, his heart tightened, and his eyes showed disbelief, as even the first soul's Divine Sense failed to sense Wulu's presence!
Waves of shock surged in Yuan Ming's heart. Ever since he entered the Stealing Heaven Tripod, his Divine Sense had been enhanced by this treasure, always effective, never failing to detect any forbidden or treasured objects. What method had Wulu now used?
Just at that moment, Wulu's figure suddenly appeared near Yuan Ming and the others, looking quite wan. He glanced their way without stopping to explain and hurriedly sped toward the tower.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming and the others quickly followed.
Behind them, the giant elephant let out a thunderous roar and charged, its four legs moving as if flying, tightly following them.
Yet its huge form was far less agile than Yuan Ming and his group, and even though it could charge recklessly through the ruins, it gradually fell behind over time.
The entrance to the tower was open, with a sign hanging above it, already mottled and deteriorating but still faintly showing the characters "Cloud Top Hall."
Four people flew into Cloud Top Hall, and the interior of Cloud Top Hall, just like the Void Temple and True Sea Hall, had a winding passageway extending forward.
In the blink of an eye, their figures, swift as lightning, vanished into the passage.
Yuan Ming took the lead, his feet not touching the ground as he flew forward.
"Use the Void Transformation Technique to head downward!" Xi Ying's voice rang out.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming didn't hesitate and immediately executed the Void Transformation Technique, penetrating the stone walls of the passage and flying downward.
Seeing this, Long Chong and the other two, although not understanding Yuan Ming's intentions, quickly took out an Earth Tunneling Talisman and followed closely behind.
Yuan Ming tunneled dozens of yards underground and entered a rather large stone chamber.
The furnishings within the stone chamber were simple; other than candle lamps, there were only six wide, old meditation cushions placed on the floor, surrounding a formation emitting a faint blue light. Several of the array patterns had dimmed, appearing unused for a long time, but it had not completely collapsed.
"The formation here does not seem to be fully activated," Yuan Ming hurried to the formation.
Long Chong, Lei Yu, and the others now arrived at this spot, their expressions stiffened: "Doesn't that mean we're doomed? Can we still escape in time?"
"Continuing to flee will only lead to us being caught eventually; this formation is not complicated. Help me buy some time, and I can quickly find a way to activate it," Yuan Ming rapidly said.
"Are you sure that the formation here, combined with this building, can stop that giant elephant?" Qiong Yun suddenly asked.
"I'm sure," Yuan Ming nodded vigorously.
Qiong Yun took a deep breath: "Alright, I trust you. Long Chong, I know you still have a trump card. There's no need to hide anymore. Let's take action together. I refuse to believe that we cannot even hold off a Level 4 demon beast for a moment!"
Noticing her resolute tone, a hint of admiration flashed in Long Chong's eyes, and he laughed loudly as he grasped his long spear and walked beside Qiong Yun.
"Alright, since you put it that way, Qiong Yun, how can I lag behind?"
With that, he slapped his waist and another object emitting spirit light, a white jade treasure pearl with six flood dragon shadows coiling inside it, flew out of his storage bag.
"The pearl reveals, Nine Dragons coil… Fellow Daoist Long, is this treasure not the legendary Nine Dragon Pearl? No, the count of flood dragon shadows doesn't match; it must be a replica," Wulu exclaimed in surprise.
Long Chong smiled proudly, but before he could speak, a thunderous elephant roar rolled towards them.
The giant elephant reached the front of Cloud Top Hall and didn't stop its momentum; its massive body slammed directly into Cloud Top Hall.
Boom!
Cloud Top Hall trembled violently, the area of impact caved in, but did not collapse like other buildings in the ruins.
"The three of you, please hold off that giant elephant for a moment, don't let it tunnel in!" Yuan Ming said.
"Don't worry, leave it to us!"
Long Chong roared, immediately used the Earth Tunneling Talisman to return to the surface, and the treasure pearl instantaneously merged into his forehead.
His features transformed rapidly; his eyes became like those of a flood dragon, his nose and mouth like a dragon, two narrow dragon horns pierced through his forehead, and his neck was covered with iron-like blue dragon scales, emitting an abnormally vast aura.
The giant elephant, having failed in its initial charge, did not continue to barrel forward with brute force. Instead, yellow patterns on its body suddenly burst forth with spirit light, and it stomped powerfully!
The ground trembled along with it, a vast chasm appeared under the elephant's feet, continuing to extend toward Cloud Top Hall.
"Is this the Earth Splitting Divine Power?" Long Chong, almost escaping from underground, sensed this scene, his expression drastically changed, and he immediately lunged forward with his spear, colliding with the rapidly spreading chasm.
An explosion like a thunderclap boomed underground, and Long Chong was sent flying backward, his hands wielding the spear cracked, and he spat out blood; however, the spreading chasm was also halted.
"What a beast!" Sensing Long Chong was injured, Qiong Yun roared furiously and executed a secret technique, covering her entire body with a fluid-like purple thunder as though she was clad in an armor.
She darted out of the ground rapidly, her hands gesturing downward, and dozens of liquid-like thunderbolts struck the giant elephant.
Wulu also emerged from underground, shooting seven or eight crescent-shaped blood lights at the giant elephant's eyes.
However, the giant elephant merely shook its body and appeared unharmed, slightly lowering its head and aiming its tusks at the spire before charging once again, like a flash of yellow lightning, toward Cloud Top Hall.
Seeing this, Long Chong and the others gritted their teeth and braced themselves to clash with the giant elephant!
Boom!
All three were sent flying, but the giant elephant was also repelled!
Its eyes flared with blood light, seemingly enraged, the yellow spiritual patterns on its body shining several times brighter and growing much larger, with beams of yellow light several yards long shooting from its tusks as it charged again at Cloud Top Hall.
"We must stop it at all costs!" Long Chong shouted, lunging forward again, and their spirit beasts appeared to assist their masters!

chapters.title: Chapter 532 - 508 Because You Are Yuan Ming
chapters.content:
A louder crash exploded, and Long Chong, along with the spirit beast, were blasted into the air, but the demon elephant was blocked once again!
As a Level 4 demon beast, the elephant had never been stopped by these insignificant pests before. It let out a roar that shattered the void, causing cracks to spread across the ground within a radius of a hundred meters.
Countless fragments of rock and dust burst forth from the ground, forming an enormous torrent that struck Long Chong, Wulu, and the others.
Caught off guard, the trio was swept helplessly into the air.
Although the demon elephant was furious, it did not lose its composure and ignored the trio as it charged once again towards Cloud Top Hall!
Compared to Long Chong and his companions, its instincts told it that the person who had disappeared inside Cloud Top Hall posed a greater threat!
Wulu and the others were in a panic, about to stop the demon elephant at all costs.
"Good, it's activated!" The next instant, Yuan Ming's words drained Long Chong and Qiong Yun of their momentum. As they began to return to their original forms, the preparations they had half activated rapidly dissipated.
At that moment, a pale blue spirit light descended from the sky, striking the top of Cloud Top Hall. Invisible waves of Spiritual Energy suddenly burst forth, repelling the demon elephant.
The elephant staggered backward, its head swaying slightly in dizziness. When it looked up, it saw that the exterior of the square-pointed tower was completely covered with a pale blue membrane, dotted with white spirit light twinkling like stars in the night sky.
Disbelieving, the elephant stomped and used its Innate Divine Ability to wield the power of the earth in an attempt to directly bring down Cloud Top Hall.
But no matter how much the ground shook or how harshly the elephant rammed the membrane, Cloud Top Hall remained immovable.
Seeing this, Long Chong and his companions couldn't help but breathe a sigh of relief.
A beam of blue light shot out from the hall, enveloping Long Chong and the others. Their vision blurred for a moment, and the next second, they found themselves in an underground stone chamber.
The Formation in the stone chamber had been largely repaired and was quickly operating.
Long Chong took out a healing pill and swallowed it, then started to complain, "Sigh, if I had known Brother Yuan would work so fast, I wouldn't have taken out my Six Dragon Balls. This replica isn't as good as the real thing. If used too much, the Spiritual Energy inside it will eventually dissipate."
Yuan Ming laughed a couple of times, unable to respond to that comment directly.
However, he did speak a word of thanks in his Sea of Consciousness, "Xi Ying, thank you. After all, you understand Arrays better and solved it faster."
"Hmph! You should see how long I stayed with the Xiao Family and how much I learned from them, not to mention the time I spent studying afterward. Hehe, even the Xiao Family's Ancestor might not match me in Array mastery now," Xi Ying proudly stated.
"Hehe, of course! But it's strange, this Formation should have existed for a long time. I didn't place any Spirit Stones on it just now, yet I don't know why it still has such power. Master Xi, why don't you explain it to me?" Yuan Ming chuckled in his Sea of Consciousness.
"It's not an issue with the Formation, but a special technique of the Wanqu Clan. If I am not mistaken, this Formation should have channeled the power of the stars as its energy source, driving itself without the need for Spirit Stones. Once activated, as long as the Formation's base remains undamaged, the Formation can sustain itself indefinitely, regardless of how long it lasts; it won't dissipate or collapse due to depletion of Spiritual Energy," Xi Ying explained after a pause.
Upon hearing Xi Ying's words, Yuan Ming's eyes flickered slightly, his curiosity and amazement at the techniques of the Wanqu Clan deepening.
It was a pity, though; he had already searched through Divine Sense, and apart from this Formation, there wasn't much else of note inside the square-pointed tower. Any classics or Jade Scrolls regarding the Wanqu Clan were utterly absent.
"Phew, what bad luck. How many Level 4 demon beasts are in this wretched Secret Realm? We've been here only a few days, and we've already encountered two," Long Chong gasped for breath, unable to resist complaining.
"Who knows? Elder Luu did mention two dangers when we first came here. Although Star Rain is hard to withstand and Star Beasts are elusive, if you ask me, neither is as troublesome as dealing with this actual Level 4 demon beast," Qiong Yun said with furrowed brows.
"Talking about it now is pointless. We should think about how to deal with this demon elephant. The people from Fusang Island said that Nascent Soul cultivators can't enter the Secret Realm. Relying on someone else to save us is unrealistic, so we have to fight our way out," Yuan Ming shook his head.
Long Chong sighed. "Sigh, if it were any other Level 4 demon beast, it would be a different story, but it's the Heavy Mountain Elephant. Even if we attack with all our might, we can't even scratch its hide. Moreover, this one has awakened the Shrinking Land Divine Power, making escape impossible. Getting out of here is as hard as ascending to heaven."
Yuan Ming pondered for a moment, then suddenly asked, "If we don't aim to harm it, Brother Long, how long can you hold the Heavy Mountain Elephant?"
Long Chong was stunned for a moment, then frankly replied, "With the power of the Six Dragon Balls, just to hold it, I should be able to last fifteen minutes."
"Fifteen minutes... That should be enough time," Yuan Ming nodded his head and then suddenly turned to look at Wulu, asking,
"Fellow Daoist Hong, the technique you used earlier to avoid the Heavy Mountain Elephant, how did you manage to conceal your aura so completely that even a Level 4 demon beast couldn't detect you?"
Hearing this, Long Chong and Qiong Yun also turned their puzzled gazes towards Wulu.
Wulu's eyes flickered slightly, knowing that he could no longer hide his methods, and reluctantly explained, "Years ago, I obtained an Invisibility Stone Talisman in a Secret Realm, which allows me to enter an invisible state. However, to completely conceal my aura also requires additional Mana expenditure, and it can't last long."
Yuan Ming nodded noncommittally, not delving deeper into the truth of Wulu's words, but he asked, "That Stone Talisman, can it make others invisible as well?"
"It can, but the more people there are, the more Spiritual Power is required, and the shorter the duration of invisibility. It's manageable with just me, but if all four of us were to turn invisible at the same time, it would probably last less than ten breaths."
Wulu spread his hands, implying without directly stating it, that escaping through invisibility was not feasible.
However, Yuan Ming did not care, "What if there are two people, how long can it last? And can one use Magic Treasures or Magic while invisible?"
"For two people, at most it can last for 15 minutes. As for whether you can use Magic Treasures, I need to concentrate on activating the invisibility and have never tried to activate Magic Treasures at the same time," Wulu said vaguely.
While he spoke, there were slight fluctuations in his deep emotions, and Yuan Ming, detecting this through his Emotion Manipulation Divine Ability, immediately guessed that Wulu was obviously hiding something.
However, just the information he disclosed was enough for Yuan Ming to utilize, and moreover, he had no intention of fully exposing Wulu's secrets in public. He nodded at Wulu's words, pretending to be unaware, and did not reveal the matter.
"Brother Yuan, do you have a plan? Do you need our help? If there's anything we can do, just give the order," Long Chong offered proactively.
"I indeed thought of a method, but it's very risky, and also, I wonder, Brother Long, do you trust me?" Yuan Ming suddenly looked up, staring directly into Long Chong's eyes.
"Brother Yuan, you've helped me a lot along the way, and if I doubted anyone, it wouldn't be you," Long Chong said, patting his chest, his gaze not flinching at all.
"Good, then later on, I will take the initiative to reveal the Array. You and Miss Qiong will draw the Heavy Mountain Elephant's attention. Fellow Daoist Hong and I will approach using the Invisibility Stone Talisman and launch a surprise attack from both sides. We're sure to kill the Heavy Mountain Elephant," Yuan Ming revealed his plan, observing Long Chong's reaction as he spoke.
"Alright, then we'll leave it to Brother Yuan," Long Chong said with a laugh, without any hesitation.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming felt rather helpless, "Aren't you worried that I will just use the invisibility to escape with Fellow Daoist Hong, leaving you and Miss Qiong alone to face the Heavy Mountain Elephant?"
"No."
"Why not?"
"Because you are Yuan Ming," Long Chong said frankly, his eyes clear and utterly unclouded.
Yuan Ming was taken aback, as if he was meeting Long Chong for the first time, looking him up and down, making Long Chong suddenly feel somewhat uncomfortable.
"Brother Yuan, if you have something to say, just say it, you're giving me goosebumps with that stare," he said exaggeratedly, rubbing his arms as if he couldn't stand it.
Yuan Ming smiled, "After we leave the Secret Realm, I definitely want to have a drink with you, Brother Long."
"It's a promise."
...
Thirty minutes later, everyone had replenished their mana. Long Chong and Qiong Yun stood at the entrance of the Square-pointed Tower, one taking out the Six Dragon Balls, the other forming a spell with his hands.
Within moments, dragon scales and Lei Guang once again climbed up their bodies.
Meanwhile, beside the Array, Wulu took out a grey Stone Talisman the size of a palm, lowered his head and chanted a spell for a while, and then nodded at Yuan Ming and the others.This chapter's true source is * (*).
Receiving the signal, Long Chong immediately let out a wild laugh, gripping his spear tightly, his eyes, now like those of a Flood Dragon, staring intensely at the Heavy Mountain Elephant outside the tower.
"Haha, Heavy Mountain Elephant, I'm here; come and meet your death!" he roared.
As he roared, the blue light shield enveloping the tower disappeared instantly.
The next instant, a blue and a purple spirit light burst from the tower, directly attacking the body of the Heavy Mountain Elephant.
The moment Long Chong and Qiong Yun made their move, inside the tower, Wulu's hand also pressed on Yuan Ming's shoulder.
In an instant, Yuan Ming felt an inexplicable force spread throughout his body, enveloping him in a transparent membrane.
"Brother Yuan, I have now bestowed upon you the invisibility power of the Stone Talisman, but do not stray too far from me, or the invisibility will immediately fail," Wulu said in a low voice, withdrawing his hand.
Yuan Ming nodded, and then he and Wulu flew out of the tower.
Outside the tower, Long Chong, in his half-dragon form, hovered in the air. In the blink of an eye, his spear thrust out in a deluge of spears, shooting like raindrops towards the Heavy Mountain Elephant.
At the same time, a purple shadow moved among the spears, the endless purple Lei Guang it brought forth weaving a giant net, covering the Heavy Mountain Elephant.
The next moment, the Lei Guang and spear shadows struck the Heavy Mountain Elephant simultaneously, but just then, a yellow spiritual light burst forth from the body of the Heavy Mountain Elephant like a fountain, enveloping the surroundings and swallowing all the Lei Guang and spear shadows.
When the light dissipated, there was not a single mark left on the body of the Heavy Mountain Elephant.
Seeing this, both Long Chong and Qiong Yun's expressions darkened.
At the same time, a hint of mockery flashed in the eyes of the Heavy Mountain Elephant, and it suddenly stomped its foot. The yellow patterns on its body lit up instantly, the ground trembled for a moment, then dirt spires rose like small mountains, stabbing towards Long Chong and the others.

chapters.title: Chapter 533 - 509: Slaughter Elephants
chapters.content:
Long Chong and his companion hastily dodged, but despite their timely reactions, they were still grazed by several earthen spikes, leaving trails of wounds.
"We need to pick up the pace, Long Chong and the others won't be able to hold out much longer," Yuan Ming said quickly after glancing at the situation on the battlefield.
Wulu nodded, a flicker of light in his eyes, and suddenly opened his mouth as if he wanted to say something.
Yuan Ming sensed his thoughts and interrupted him preemptively, "Once you've taken me to the side of the Heavy Mountain Elephant, focus on fleeing with all your might, you don't need to maintain my invisibility anymore."
"Do you have a sure chance of victory?" Wulu was startled, then frowned immediately.
"I can't guarantee it, but even if things don't go as planned, I can still escape, so don't worry about me," Yuan Ming shook his head and smiled.
Wulu nodded silently, though his face still showed a hint of worry.
The two circumvented the fiercely contested front battlefield, taking a detour around the earth walls created by the Heavy Mountain Elephant, and soon arrived behind it to its left.
As a Level 4 demon beast, the Heavy Mountain Elephant possessed a not-so-low spiritual intelligence and naturally noticed that two people were missing from the group of four that had been pursuing it earlier.
While clashing with Long Chong and his companion, it had always been searching in all directions for Yuan Ming's whereabouts.
It was because of this that Long Chong and Qiong Yun had been able to fight it to a standstill.
However, even though the Heavy Mountain Elephant was on guard, it ultimately failed to detect the two "insects" that had quietly approached, thanks to their invisibility.
Yuan Ming looked up at the Heavy Mountain Elephant's body, suddenly raising his right hand, and the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear flew out in an instant, landing above his head.
At the same time, his left hand, unbeknownst to anyone, now held a wine red Jade Bottle.
"Brother Hong, after three counts, please immediately flee far away," Yuan Ming said, turning his head to instruct.
Wulu nodded, his gaze falling on the Jade Bottle in Yuan Ming's left hand. Although he didn't know what was hidden within, he inexplicably felt a chill.
"One!"
Yuan Ming suddenly cast a spell that landed on the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear. The spirit light on the spear grew significantly, and the twelve runes hidden inside lit up one by one, bringing forth a terrifying aura. This converged at the tip of the spear and thrust towards the Heavy Mountain Elephant's flank in an instant.
"Two!"
Yuan Ming shouted, abruptly wrapping the Jade Bottle in his left hand with Mana, and threw it forward. The bottle rotated as it flew, driven by Spiritual Power, following the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear.
"Three!"
The moment the word was spoken, Wulu retreated explosively, and the invisible force that had been shrouding Yuan Ming disappeared instantly, revealing him from his state of invisibility.
Simultaneously, the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear struck the Heavy Mountain Elephant's body, causing a surge of earthy yellow spirit light to erupt. It turned out the Heavy Mountain Elephant had been cautious and protected its body with Divine Skills.
However, there was no standoff, as the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear, now infused with the power of the stars, was transformed. The moment the earthy yellow spirit light shone, it shattered like glass. The spear penetrated the body of the Heavy Mountain Elephant, tearing a hole as it spun.
In an instant, crimson blood sprayed into the sky, and the Heavy Mountain Elephant's agonized cries echoed through heaven and earth, causing the earth walls it had summoned to crumble away.
But this was not the end. In the moment the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear tore open the wound, Yuan Ming reached into the air and the Jade Bottle, wrapped in Spiritual Power, shattered suddenly, releasing the colorless liquid inside. The liquid exploded and also fell into the Heavy Mountain Elephant's wound.
A chilling hissing noise ensued, and wisps of white smoke rose from the wound on the Heavy Mountain Elephant. The already mangled flesh turned rapidly black and decayed, exuding a stench, and even reached the nostrils of Long Chong and the others.
The Heavy Mountain Elephant let out another painful roar, its vitality suddenly diminished.
The One Rihong poison was fierce, but Yuan Ming felt it was not secure enough, so he obtained some intense poison from the body of the Purple Extreme Tai Sui, mixing it in.
While this made the One Rihong less inconspicuous, it significantly enhanced the poison's potency.
Seeing the Heavy Mountain Elephant break through its defenses, everyone's spirits were lifted.
However, contrary to everyone's expectations, just as the black poison spots were about to spread from the wound to other parts of the body, an earthy yellow spirit light flashed on the Heavy Mountain Elephant, and it forcefully stopped the spread of the poison spots.
Then, with an angry glance to the side, the Heavy Mountain Elephant swung its trunk towards Yuan Ming.
It truly lived up to its reputation as a Level 4 demon beast—despite suffering consecutive heavy injuries, it was still capable of launching a swift and ferocious attack.
But Yuan Ming didn't expect the One Rihong poison from the Snake-man Clan alone to be enough to slay the giant beast.
As he dodged the Heavy Mountain Elephant's trunk, Yuan Ming summoned the Night Parade of Hundred Demons, flooding the beast's body with a massive amount of dark Qi.
A burst of white light shot out from the Night Parade of Hundred Demons, the hidden All Living Beings' Dream Rune flashing momentarily before disappearing into the Heavy Mountain Elephant's body.
The Heavy Mountain Elephant's trunk froze mid-air, and its angry eyes were quickly clouded by confusion.
At this sight, Yuan Ming flipped his right hand, taking out the Silver Token, and immediately began casting, forming a large barrier that enveloped both him and the Heavy Mountain Elephant together.
Having deployed the silver barrier, Yuan Ming finally felt at ease. He took off the Spiritual Beast Bag containing the Three-eyed Crow and threw it on the ground, then took out the Stealing Heaven Tripod and entered it.
He sat on the White Jade Lotus Platform and, with a flip of his hand, summoned the Soul Destroying Sword. He activated all his Mana and Soul Power and slashed through the air.
A magnificent black sword light descended from the sky, a fleeting flash that buried itself into the head of the Heavy Mountain Elephant.
From a distance, Long Chong and the others were initially elated by Yuan Ming's serious injury to the Heavy Mountain Elephant, and were about to call out to Yuan Ming to take the chance to escape, but seeing what Yuan Ming did, they were somewhat stunned.
However, the silver light shield blocked any Divine Sense probes, so they had no idea what Yuan Ming was doing inside.
As they were hesitating whether to go forward to help or to just watch for now, the silver protective shield rapidly dissipated, reverting back to a Token, and falling into Yuan Ming's hand as he reappeared.
Yuan Ming put away the Token and called back the Purple Star Nine Dragons Spear. Without a glance at the Heavy Mountain Elephant, he flew towards Long Chong and the others.
At this moment, the Heavy Mountain Elephant lay on the ground, seemingly without any new wounds, yet it no longer breathed.
Pleasereadthischapteronitsoriginalplatform—*.
"Brother Yuan, you..." Long Chong looked at the approaching Yuan Ming, then at the fallen Heavy Mountain Elephant, momentarily at a loss for words.
"It was nothing but a fluke. If it were not for a bottle of top-grade poison I had obtained earlier, which weakened the Heavy Mountain Elephant's strength, and the power of Brother Hong's Stone Talisman that allowed me to get close to the Heavy Mountain Elephant, it might have been difficult to kill it," Yuan Ming said modestly.
However, having the ability to kill a Level 4 Demon Beast by skipping a level with just a mid-stage Core Formation Cultivation, their tacit in silence for a moment led everyone to shake their heads, even if they didn't say it out loud.
They couldn't do it.
"Gentlemen, our confrontation just now was not small, and now that the Heavy Mountain Elephant is dead, we should quickly divide its body and leave this place, lest we attract other Level 4 demon beasts," Yuan Ming changed the subject, avoiding further discussion on his strength.
Hearing this, Long Chong earnestly replied, "Brother Yuan is right. However, killing this Heavy Mountain Elephant, both Qiong Yun and I didn't exert much force. You and Brother Hong can divide the body amongst yourselves."
"Ah, if it weren't for Brother Long and Miss Qiong attracting the attention of the Heavy Mountain Elephant, we wouldn't have been able to succeed so easily. Moreover, the Daoist Skills you deployed must have incurred some expenditure, it wouldn't be right not to take something substantial," Yuan Ming insisted.
Long Chong insisted, "Even so, you and Brother Hong should pick first. If there is anything you don't need, then Qiong Yun and I will take them."
Seeing his sincere words, Yuan Ming nodded in agreement, no longer refusing.
Eventually, Yuan Ming proactively chose the Physical Body of the Heavy Mountain Elephant as his spoils of war, while Wulu took the Demon Core, and Long Chong and Qiong Yun each obtained an ivory tusk.
Long Chong and others still felt somewhat embarrassed; the flesh and blood of the Heavy Mountain Elephant was extraordinary, but ultimately it could not compare to the precious elephant tusks and Demon Core. Long Chong and Qiong Yun insisted that Yuan Ming was at a loss in the end, supplementing him with some Spirit Stones before giving up.
However, Yuan Ming wasn't intentionally conceding to them. He had many Magic Treasures at hand now, and even if he took the ivory tusks, he wouldn't be able to refine a better Magic Treasure immediately.
He valued the flesh and blood of the Heavy Mountain Elephant before him more; its massive body and exuberant Qi-Blood were far superior to the previous Fire Crocodile King. Although it was tainted with the severe poison of One Rihong and Purple Extreme Tai Sui, with some refinement it could be purged and would not affect the value of the elephant's physical body.
The Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill was a Cultivation Technique created with reference to the power of a giant elephant. The Qi-Blood of elephantine demon beasts was the most beneficial for this technique, which could definitely help him advance the Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill into a further stage.
After dividing the spoils among themselves, Wulu suggested they leave quickly.
"Wait a moment, I want to confirm something," Yuan Ming said as he turned and entered the Cloud Top Hall.
Seeing this, although puzzled, the others followed him.
This time, they didn't use Earth Tunneling, but instead followed the corridors inside the hall.
The palace was dilapidated from years of neglect, and the corridors were also badly damaged, with many areas collapsed. However, this naturally posed no difficulty for Yuan Ming and company, who quickly reached the end of the corridor.
In front of them appeared a vast Stone Chamber, in the center of which was a Silver Formation, surrounded by four silver-white Stone Pillars that extended deep into the ground, integrating with the Array.
This place was identical to the Teleportation Array in the Void Temple and True Sea Hall, only much smaller, appearing to be a miniaturized version of a Teleportation Array.
"A Teleportation Array! I wonder where the other side leads?" Long Chong and the others exclaimed with both shock and joy.
This continent was filled with treasures, could this Teleportation Array possibly connect to some hidden treasure trove?
"Unfortunately, this Array is already damaged." Yuan Ming shook his head regretfully; the Array Patterns of the Silver Formation were severely damaged, and the four Stone Pillars no longer stored any Space Power, rendering it unusable.
"I can try to repair the Array Patterns, but I have no clue on how to channel the Space Power," Xi Ying's voice resounded.
"It doesn't matter. Obtaining the corpse of this Heavy Mountain Elephant is already a great gain," Yuan Ming replied, shaking his head.
The four of them briefly searched the ruins and, upon finding no other treasures, swiftly left the place.
However, just as they left, a streak of Golden Light shot from the distance, arriving in front of Cloud Top Hall—it was the Golden Cloud Fairy.
Her gaze swept over the chaotic scene on the ground, her expression slightly stern.
"Who would have thought that Yuan Ming had such strength to kill the Heavy Mountain Elephant by himself. Fortunately, we didn't make a move just now, otherwise, we really might not have been able to take him down..." she murmured to herself.
"This silver barrier he deployed is quite extraordinary, blocking my Golden Crow Fire Pupil and preventing me from seeing how he killed the Heavy Mountain Elephant. However, I did clearly see the process of Yuan Ming casting the Heavy Mountain Elephant into an illusion. He has a terrifyingly powerful illusory Magic Treasure on him, which took effect from a distance and almost dragged me into the illusion as well," the dignified voice came from within the Golden Cloud Fairy.

chapters.title: Chapter 534 - 510: Three Immortals Hall
chapters.content:
"Father, you can't see through the barrier created by that token either? Could it be that it's also a counterfeit Spiritual Treasure? How did he, a Loose Cultivator at the Core Formation, come by so many treasures?" Golden Cloud Fairy was greatly surprised.
"That's why I told you before, never underestimate anyone in this world. In every era, there are always some individuals who go against the current and leap from obscurity to become influential figures. Shura Master was exactly like that," the majestic voice said.
"You're right, Father. Now it seems that Yuan Ming genuinely has the combat power of the Nascent Soul Level. Trying to forcibly seize the Cold Moon Ring might be troublesome," Golden Cloud Fairy frowned slightly.
"You, always so spoiled and willful, think only of seizing by force whenever you encounter something. There's more than one way to get the Cold Moon Ring," the majestic voice said helplessly.
"Do you mean for me to buy the ring from Yuan Ming's hands? But it's a counterfeit Spiritual Treasure; he might not be willing to sell it," Golden Cloud Fairy said.
"There's nothing that can't be obtained through the exchange of benefits. If it's not possible, it's either because the price offered isn't high enough or the benefits put forth don't suit the other party's taste," the majestic voice said indifferently.
"I understand..." Golden Cloud Fairy nodded slowly and soon turned into a streak of golden light, continuing to chase after Yuan Ming.
An hour later.
In a tranquil valley, a clear and broad stream flowed through, washing the pebbles on both banks smooth and round.
At the bottom of the river, clumps of water weeds that emitted a faint spirit light swayed gently, like a galaxy of stars echoing the starlight in the sky.
Many fish demons swam and hunted among the water weeds. Their Cultivation wasn't even on par with a First-level Demon Beast; they mostly fed on the water weeds. Although there were occasional skirmishes among them, blood was rarely seen.
But suddenly, a green-tailed fish demon about a zhang long darted out from nowhere, biting down on a small green-skinned fish and began to feast contentedly.
This demon's appearance resembled a carp but it had sharp teeth in its mouth and emitted the fluctuations of a Third-level Demon Beast's demonic power, startling the other fish demons so much that they dared not approach or even think of resisting it.
The green-tailed carp's eyes were blood red as its sharp teeth tore through the scales and flesh of the small fish, with the blood blooming in the river like a red lotus unfolding.
Just then, a sudden strong gust of wind swept down from the sky, causing the river water to surge towards the banks, fully exposing the green-tailed carp under the starlight.
However, as a Third-level Demon Beast, it wouldn't simply die from being out of water.
The fish demon's body reacted by instinctively conjuring several streams of water, enveloping itself and shooting off towards the distant river.
But in the next instant, a pair of blue-black claws descended from the sky, effortlessly tearing through the water currents and piercing the body of the green-tailed carp.
A towering oppressive might descended, and the once unassailable green-tailed carp rolled its eyes back, immediately falling unconscious.
The captor of this fish was a colossal blue-black eagle over a dozen zhang long. Its wings were as hard as steel and as sharp as swords, able to shoot feathers and run an enemy through effortlessly.
The giant eagle's talons exuded a piercing aura, as if they could penetrate all defenses, but the most frightening aspect was its eyes - startlingly bright, giving one the feeling that a blade or spear had pierced one's chest and leaving one terrified at heart.
Having caught its meal for the day, the eagle prepared to return to its nest to feast. Its sharp gaze suddenly swept towards the riverbank with a trace of confusion in its eyes.
But seeing nothing else around, the eagle dismissed the matter and soared into the sky, flying towards its nest.
Not long after the giant eagle left, the empty riverbank saw the sudden appearance of Yuan Ming and the others.
"I was scared to death; I thought we were discovered by the Sword Feathered Eagle. If it had set its sights on us, we probably wouldn't have had a chance to even run," Long Chong said with palpable relief.
"It might have sensed us when we were in the sky. But luckily we had Brother Hong's Invisibility Stone Talisman. Otherwise, we would have really had trouble," Yuan Ming speculated.
After leaving Cloud Top Hall, they returned to that valley and retrieved the Houtu Mountain Stone from the bottom of the pit.
As for the Houtu Mountain deep underground, Yuan Ming was powerless and could only watch helplessly as the treasure mountain lay beneath the earth.
Leaving that place, the four of them continued deeper into the continent. Despite the many perils along the way, their gains were substantial.
Long Chong nodded and asked casually, "On our way here, how many Level 4 Demon Beasts have we encountered so far?"
Мy Virtuаl Librаry Еmpirе (М-VLЕМРYR)
"Including the Heavy Mountain Elephant, that makes five," Qiong Yun answered.
"Alas, the Spiritual Energy on this continent is too abundant. It's capable of nurturing so many Level 4 Demon Beasts. If I could move the Spirit Vein below to my Thousand Dragon Island, I reckon I wouldn't need a year to attempt breaking through to the Nascent Soul Stage," Long Chong sighed.
"Daydreaming should be saved for sleep. Even if you had a way to extract the Spirit Vein here, do you think the four islands guarding the entrance would let you take it away just like that? If it wasn't for the heavy losses during the initial exploration, even if the islands united against us, Fusang's Four Islands wouldn't allow us to come in for a joint exploration. Should we get greedy, they won't be so easy to talk to anymore," Qiong Yun shook her head.
"Miss Qiong is right. Compared to the Spirit Vein that we can't obtain, the treasures hidden here are what truly deserve our attention," Yuan Ming agreed.
"While treasures are appealing, there are many Level 4 Demon Beasts around. Continuing to venture deeper, we don't know what dangers we'll encounter. Perhaps we shouldn't proceed and just look around here. The gains should still be considerable," Qiong Yun suggested.
Long Chong dismissed the idea with a careless wave of his hand, "We've come this far; it would be too shameful to run away at the mere prospect of dangers we haven't even seen. If we really encounter a beast of that level guarding treasures, we can always retreat. It's not necessarily going to pursue us relentlessly like the Heavy Mountain Elephant."
"Quite right. Without entering the tiger's den, how can one capture its cub?" Yuan Ming immediately nodded in agreement.
In his Dantian, the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear hung silently, its tip pointing ahead, and the guiding force inside it became increasingly strong, as they got closer to the targeted location.
"With so many treasures on this continent, we've already made such progress after only a short time here. It would be a pity to stop now," Wulu added.
All four agreed to move forward, and Qiong Yun reluctantly accepted, so the team continued towards the deeper parts of the continent.
They hadn't traveled far when Wulu suddenly stopped with a soft exclamation, his eyes fixed on a patch of red flowers nearby.
"These..." Yuan Ming also showed surprise in his face, as the flowers were in fact dozens of red Spirit Grass shaped like a Phoenix with spread wings – the very Fengming Grass that Golden Cloud Fairy and Daoist Qian Bao entrusted them to find.
"It seems this is precisely the place that the Fusang Four Islands are looking for," he said, looking around.
"It's definitely Fengming Grass," Qiong Yun confirmed after carefully inspecting the Spirit Grass with a nod.
"If that's the case, let's quickly inform Golden Cloud Fairy and Daoist Qian Bao. This will also repay the favor for that Earth Core Fire Lotus from before," Long Chong said, taking out the Sound Transmission Talisman.
Yuan Ming glanced back but didn't refuse.
Golden Cloud Fairy was trailing behind them, and naturally, he had noticed her presence long ago; she must have already seen the Fengming Grass. Therefore, there was no use in trying to stop her.
After Long Chong notified Daoist Qian Bao, the group continued their journey along the riverside.
After an indeterminate amount of time, the meandering river reached its end, and a wide valley clearing appeared before Yuan Ming and his companions.
The ground was lush with fragrant flowers and plants, all basked in a faint glow of Spiritual Energy, illuminating the place brightly.
However, what captivated their attention the most was the massive palace standing at the center of the clearing.
The two-story palace was supported by twelve columns engraved with dragons, with a roof covered in four-colored glazed tiles, and its doors and windows were all intricately carved from jade, emitting a faint white luminescence under the stars, resembling a pavilion in the moon or a phantom in the water.
"Look at the plaque above!" Long Chong said, looking at the hall and suddenly widening his eyes.
Above the doors hung an ancient plaque with three characters shining in golden light – Three Immortals Hall.
A glimmer of excitement flashed in Yuan Nei's eyes, and the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear inside his Dantian trembled violently, pointing towards the interior of the hall.
"Three Immortals Hall? It is said that this Secret Realm might be related to the Three Immortals Island; it could well be right here," Qiong Yun mumbled.
Suddenly, without a word, Wulu flew forward with a haste that suggested urgency.
This action startled Long Chong and the others to their senses, and they hastily followed, flying towards the palace.
Yuan Ming followed behind as well but moved neither hurriedly nor slowly.
As they were about to draw close, a three-colored barrier of Green, White, and Gold Spiritual Light suddenly rose up around the palace, enveloping it like petals and forming an impenetrable protective shield that pushed back Yuan Ming and his companions.
Long Chong immediately took out a Magic Treasure spear and struck the protective shield fiercely, but only a faint ripple flickered across the shield before it returned to calm.
"Such a sturdy barrier, it must be a Divine Skill of the Nascent Soul Level," Long Chong said with a darkened expression.
Wulu's eyebrows furrowed tightly, as if he was about to say something when a beam of golden light suddenly shot from behind towards them; it was Golden Cloud Fairy arriving on a streak of Golden Light, descending above the crowd.
"It's the Three Immortals Hall! We've finally found it!"
As Golden Cloud Fairy spoke, a twinge of excitement flashed across her eyes. Without caring to communicate with Yuan Ming and the others, she suddenly produced a silver Treasure Mirror from her palm, casting spells on it before tossing it above the palace.
Simultaneously, five more lights flew rapidly from the horizon; these were Daoist Qian Bao, Tu Sheng, Zhong Ling, Baili Zhui, and Hua Ping. Quickly, they too landed in front of the Three Immortals Hall.
Yuan Ming had already sensed the approach of the five and wasn't surprised.
"Haha, the Three Immortals Hall, my master was right; this is where my opportunity to advance to the Nascent Soul lies!" Daoist Qian Bao said ecstatically, looking at the grand hall in front of him.
Tu Sheng didn't speak but a flash of excitement passed through his eyes. Surprise was more prevalent on the faces of Zhong Ling and the others.
"Daoist Qian Bao, you invited us here for treasures, may I ask what treasures are inside the Three Immortals Hall?" Zhong Ling asked.
"Rest assured, Fellow Daoist Zhong, the treasures inside this hall will surpass your imagination. I can't elaborate on the specifics, but once we break through this barrier, you'll know," Daoist Qian Bao replied briefly to the three before ignoring them, then summoned a golden Magic Treasure shaped like a grinding disc to fiercely strike the Three-colored Shield.
Tu Sheng too summoned a broad and heavy battle sabre, slicing at the shield.
Zhong Ling and the others communicated in whispers, quickly summoning their Magic Treasures to strike at the barrier up ahead.
The situation took a dramatic turn; Long Chong and the others were unsure of what to do next.
"Brother Yuan, what should we do?" Long Chong asked Yuan Ming instinctively.
"Golden Cloud Fairy and Daoist Qian Bao hold this place in high regard; this Three Immortals Hall must be extraordinary. Since we're here already, we can't let go of such an opportunity. Let's join in and make a move as well," Yuan Ming said as he summoned the Thunder God Hammer, a thick bolt of thunder striking the Three-colored Shield.
Seeing this, Long Chong and the others also hurriedly summoned their Magic Treasures.
For a moment, various Magic Treasures and their Spiritual Light fiercely struck the Three-colored Shield, resulting in deafening booms. Ripples spread across the shield, growing more and more intense.

chapters.title: Chapter 535 - 511: Making a Move
chapters.content:
Fusang Island, beside the Ancient Transmission Array in the Void Temple.
A small and delicate silver round mirror floated in midair, slowly rotating, occasionally reflecting dazzling silver light. By its appearance, it was no different from the one in Golden Cloud Fairy's hand.
Below the round mirror, five cultivators with profound auras sat cross-legged, seemingly engaged in Breathing Control and resting.
The one leading them was tall and burly, with golden eyebrows, exuding a sense of majesty. He was none other than Wan Tianren, the Fusang Island Master, whom Yuan Ming had once spied upon.
Behind Wan Tianren sat three people: a Green-clothed man with a broad face and eagle nose, whose eyes looked somewhat sinister; another was a woman in a white dress, simple and plain-looking, resembling a well-bred young lady; and the last one was a tall man, over two Zhang tall and very obese, with layers of fat that made him resemble a meat mountain.
Besides these three, there was also a red-clothed middle-aged man sitting next to Wan Tianren, who appeared to be just over thirty, with flaming red hair and eyebrows, yet his eyes were golden, occasionally flashing with a hint of golden light.
Fire attribute magic power fluctuations were extremely strong around this man, giving the impression that he could burst into flames at any moment, transforming into towering flames. The other four, including Wan Tianren, occasionally glanced at him with the corners of their eyes.
Suddenly, the silver round mirror in midair stopped spinning and trembled slightly. Then, within its previously empty surface, a spiral suddenly appeared.
In an instant, the surrounding nature's spiritual energy was drawn in by an invisible force, converging towards the location of the silver round mirror and forming a semi-transparent spiritual energy vortex visible to the naked eye.
The five people below immediately became alert, all looking up at the mirror in midair with varying expressions, yet none made a move.
As more spiritual energy continued to gather, the silver round mirror grew visibly larger at a speed noticeable to the naked eye.
In just a moment, the round mirror seemed to have absorbed enough spiritual power and had grown to the size of a building. The spiral on the mirror's surface suddenly vanished, replaced by the sight of the valley palace within the secret realm.
In the image, a group of Core Formation Cultivators, including Yuan Ming, gathered in small groups in front of the huge palace, sparing no effort to activate their magic treasures, launching fierce attacks on the three-colored shield enveloping the great hall.
The shield's surface rippled continuously but showed no sign of failing. Clearly, although the attacks of the group of Core Formation Cultivators were not weak, it would take quite some time to break through this shield.
