None of the five paid attention to the Core Formation Cultivators; their gazes were all fixed on the Three Immortals Hall revealed in the mirror, with a sharp light flashing in their eyes.
"Haha, good, good, good! The Three Immortals Hall that we couldn't find even after losing so many men has indeed been discovered by them!" Fusang Island Master Wan Tianren laughed loudly, saying 'good' three times.
"Hehe, we should thank Brother Wan for his ingenious plan. Rather than continuously sacrificing our own men, why not let the people from other islands make a contribution? After all, at most they can only send Core Formation cultivators here. The most significant opportunities are still ours to share, aren't they?" said the Green-clothed man sitting behind Wan Tianren, who was the Golden Turtle Island Master, Gu Xuanyang, clapping and laughing.
As for the woman in white dress, she was the Kongling Island Master, Murong Yanyu, and the imposing fat man was the Earth Beauty Island Master, Tu Shixiong.
Murong Yanyu nodded and smiled faintly, saying leisurely, "It's laughable that those people think they've forced us to make concessions by banding together. They each send their core disciples in to die, really believing that they can gain much benefit."
Tu Shixiong squinted his eyes, the fat on his face trembling slightly as he laughed silently.
Just then, the red-clad, golden-eyed middle-aged man suddenly spoke up, "Alright, let's save the chatter for later. Now that the Three Immortals Hall has appeared, we should quickly break the forbidden seal outside the hall lest we have complications during the night."
Hearing this, the four others including Fusang Island Master all uttered their agreement and then each performed a spell, launching various Daoist Techniques at the silver round mirror.
Their spells, upon touching the round mirror, rippled like they had hit the surface of water and then vanished without a trace.
At the same time, in the secret realm, within the silver round mirror floating above the Three Immortals Hall, streaks of blinding spiritual light appeared out of nowhere. Each ray was far more powerful than that of Yuan Ming and the others, ruthlessly striking the three-colored shield.
"Such attacks must be from a Nascent Soul cultivator! Who could it be?" Yuan Ming saw this and his pupils contracted. While he uttered a low cry, his figure retreated over ten Zhang, looking up at the silver treasure mirror and casting a glance at Golden Cloud Fairy.
Long Chong, Zhong Ling, and the others were also startled, halting their actions and retreating, widening their distance from the silver treasure mirror.
Daoist Qian Bao and Tu Sheng, while also ceasing their attacks, remained calm, apparently having anticipated this.
The number of spiritual light falling from the sky was increasing, the flashes getting more furious, and waves of aura surged out. The three-colored shield trembled violently, and cracks began to appear.
In that instant, an invisible fluctuation surged out from within the Three Immortals Hall, passing through the shield without stopping, sweeping over the bodies of the cultivators, and then disappearing into the valley.
Yet none of the Core Formation Cultivators in front of the Three Immortals Hall noticed this at all.
Only Yuan Ming suddenly furrowed his brows and turned to look back at the valley.
A few breaths later, a roar like thunder echoed through the valley.
…
At this moment, the entrance to the secret realm shook once more as the Light and Shadow Gate vibrated, disturbing the nearby Sealing Array. The Three-colored Spiritual Light burst forth anew.
This time, the Three-colored Spiritual Light did not transform into the shape of three mountain peaks, but coalesced into the phantom of the Three Immortals Hall, even displaying a glimpse of the current scene in front of the hall, although considerably more blurred compared to the silver Round Mirror above Wan Tianren and the others.
"What's this? It looks like Jin Yun, Qian Bao, and the others have found the entrance to Three Immortals Island!" Luu Changfeng excitedly stood up.
Elder Qi, Madam Chi, and Tu Shan also showed delight on their faces.
"With four Island Masters presiding over Fusang Island, breaking through the Three Immortals Island's entrance restrictions should be no problem. It's a pity that we Nascent Soul cultivators cannot enter the secret realm; otherwise, there wouldn't be a need for such trouble," Elder Qi added regretfully.
"Oh, you four want to enter the secret realm? There is a way, but it requires your cooperation," a cold voice suddenly sounded from behind Elder Qi, as if someone was speaking right up against his body.
Elder Qi was greatly alarmed and flew forward, his body instantly lighting up with several layers of light.Keepusgoingbyreadingon*.
However, a white hand palm pierced through the layers of light like paper and even punctured Elder Qi's Dantian, protruding from his front and grasping tightly onto a green little figure with its lustrous jade-like fingers.
Elder Qi, looking at the white hand protruding from his abdomen, had his eyes wide open with disbelief written all over his face.
A white-pupiled, white-browed youth had appeared at some point behind Elder Qi, and powerful cold air erupted from his palm. With a "crack" sound, Elder Qi was frozen into an ice sculpture.
"Who are you?" Luu Changfeng, enraged and shocked, spat out a yellow great sword, slashing at the white-browed youth.
Eight ferocious tiger phantoms rose from the sword, roaring with an earth-shattering force that made the entire hall shake.
"Eight Tigers Sword!" The youth's eyebrows rose slightly, and with a flick of his finger, a white Ice Cone about a foot long shot out, colliding with the great sword.
An overpowering chill spread from the Ice Cone, forming a thin mist visible to the naked eye. Before the yellow great sword even arrived, the eight tiger phantoms had already dashed towards it, only to be trapped by the mist and unable to advance even an inch further.
A "ding" sound echoed as the tip of the yellow great sword was met by the white Ice Cone, held back two feet away, despite the great sword's yellow light piercing the heavens and its sword qi surging like a tide, unable to come any closer.
Madam Chi and Tu Shan were shocked, realizing the white-browed youth's formidable strength and ill intentions, and immediately took action.
Madam Chi waved her hand, and an Azure Jade Hairpin flew from her head, quickly expanding dozens of times into a massive green hairpin, slashing through the air towards the white-browed youth.
Numerous shimmering green Flames spun out of the hairpin, twisting and distorting the space it passed through. The seemingly chaotic green flames formed a vast cage, nearly cutting off the white-browed youth's every escape route.
At the same time, Tu Shan pressed his hands onto the ground, a flash of yellow light from his palm.
The hall's floor melted away, transforming the entire hall into a yellow Swamp, and from it, several murky yellow hands emerged, grabbing towards the white-browed youth from all directions.
"The Empty Illusion Reincarnation Skill and Nili Mysterious Technique are indeed formidable. If Murong Yanyu and Tu Shixiong were the ones using them, I might have some apprehension. However, you two useless wastes wielding these techniques is like brandishing a toy before me; you're really not taking me seriously," boomed a voice like a bell, and a tall figure suddenly appeared in the hall, slapping horizontally with a large hand.
Two blood-colored palms materialized out of thin air, casting the hall in a blood-red light, swiping swiftly around the white-browed youth. They obliterated the green Flames and all the yellow hands as easily as crushing dry weeds, then vanished in a blink and reappeared, brutally slamming into Madam Chi's and Tu Shan's Protective Spiritual Light.
Before Madam Chi and Tu Shan could even let out a scream, their bodies exploded, turning into two clouds of Blood Mist.
Their Nascent Souls shot out, terror written on their tiny faces, and landed behind Luu Changfeng.
The hulking figure now revealed his True Face: a robust man with beard like swords, exuding an overwhelming presence.
"Yuan Wuji! You dare to attack us? Have you forgotten the pact between Fusang Island and your Tide-rider Alliance?" Luu Changfeng shouted sternly, looking quite flustered.
At the same time, a green Firefly emerged from under his foot, silently burrowing into the ground.
A cold laugh issued as another man with red hair appeared in the hall, his Blood-red Walking Stick slamming heavily on the ground.
The hall's walls and floor lit up with intense blood light, forming a Blood Barrier intertwined with swirling black malevolence. The Firefly Luu Changfeng released touched the Blood Barrier and dissolved into pus with a 'sizzle'.
"Blood Realm Venerable!" Luu Changfeng's complexion drastically changed. He retreated hastily, flinging his hands forward.
Dozens of soybeans flew out, transforming midair into dozens of Luu Changfengs, each exuding the power of around the Core Formation Stage, charging towards Yuan Wuji and the red-haired man.
These Luu Changfengs, each wielding an Eight Tiger Sword, slashed down from the air.
Droves of Eight Tigers Sword Qi descended from the sky, with a hundred tigers roaring in unison, the sound echoing to the heavens, the void shaking and humming as if about to be torn apart by the intersecting sword qi!

chapters.title: Chapter 536 - 512: Stand Firm
chapters.content:
"Eh, 'Planting Beans into Soldiers'?"
The Blood Realm Venerable let out a light exclamation, but his face showed little change in expression. He raised his arm, and the blood light from the cane in his hand flourished immensely.
"No rush, let Xiao Wu handle it. It's a good opportunity to test the might of the newly refined Wind Snow Sword," Yuan Wuji lifted his hand and said.
Upon hearing this, the white-browed youth flew forward, a white light flickering in his right palm, and suddenly there was a three-foot-long white sword in his grasp, emitting a powerful chill.
The youth raised his arm and swung the sword in the air.
A boundless frost erupted, and in the void, snowflakes appeared out of nowhere, swept up in a wild, howling wind.
Large icicles and ice cones emerged throughout the hall, transforming the entire hall into a world of ice and snow, and the blood-colored barrier too became frozen solid.
The Eight Tigers Sword Qi that filled the void was instantly frozen, suspended in mid-air, and dozens of Luu Changfengs were eroded by the chill, turning into dozens of ice statues. Madam Chi and Tu Shan's Nascent Soul, unable to avoid in time, were directly frozen inside an ice pillar, rendered immobile.
Luu Changfeng himself had already retreated dozens of feet away; although his real body was still being attacked by the cold and had not turned into an ice sculpture, he was half-encased in ice, his face pale, and his movements considerably slowed.
"I've always heard that the Great Elder of Fusang Island, Luu Changfeng, is very powerful, and that he swept through the thirty-six islands of the East Sea with an Eight Tiger Sword. Seeing him today, he seems to be nothing special," a soft, enchanting chuckle that tickled the mind whispered into Luu Changfeng's ear. A tall, purple-haired, purple-eyed beauty had appeared behind him at some point, her hands gently pressing on Luu Changfeng's shoulders.
Luu Changfeng was shocked and immediately projected himself forward, but his shoulders became numb and as hard as stone, petrification quickly spreading to other parts of his body.
With a mixture of shock and anger, Luu Changfeng's right hand suddenly erupted with a strong demon energy, which he channeled into his body. His cultivation soared, reaching the peak of the Middle-stage Nascent Soul in an instant, forcibly halting the petrification at his shoulders.
Just as Luu Changfeng's form continued to fly away, a hint of surprise flashed in the eyes of the purple-haired beauty. She gathered her sleeves together.
A dozen yellow threads shot out from her sleeves, resembling slender demon insects that spanned a distance of over ten yards, and landed on various parts of Luu Changfeng's body.
Luu Changfeng's body petrified once more, this time unstoppably, and shortly after he turned into a statue with stiff limbs and an expressionless face unable to move.
"Do not kill him. This Luu Changfeng still has uses later on. Moreover, this man has learned two Divine Skills from the Golden Sunflower Heavenly Book—'Planting Beans into Soldiers' and the Golden Sunflower Beast Taming Technique. Remember to use the Heart-Loss Gu to extract them," Yuan Wuji said slowly.
"Yes," the purple-haired beauty replied, catching and lowering the petrified Luu Changfeng with a sweep of her sleeve.
The Blood Realm Venerable approached Madam Chi and Tu Shan's Nascent Soul, tapped the void with his blood-colored cane, and a blood light wrapped around the two Nascent Souls, pulling them out of the ice pillar.
No sooner had the two Nascent Souls been freed than they immediately began casting spells in an attempt to flee, but under the cover of the blood light, they were completely unable to break free.
The Blood Realm Venerable extended his tongue and licked his lips, revealing a beast-like smile. He then spat out a stream of blood light, wrapping it around the two Nascent Souls and swallowing them in one gulp.
A viscous layer of blood light appeared over his body, his eyes tinged with streaks of blood, and the surrounding overwhelming evil aura grew even thicker.
The purple-haired beauty's eyes showed a hint of wariness as she subconsciously stepped a few paces back.
Yuan Wuji paid no attention to the others and strode to the center of the hall, looking toward the changing Light and Shadow Gate.
"Big brother, are we going in now? According to our previous agreement, weren't we supposed to wait for news from third brother?" the white-browed youth asked as he approached.
"Considering the situation inside the Light and Shadow Gate, Wan Tianren has actually bestowed the Two-Phase Mirror to those Core Formation disciples who entered the Secret Realm. Thus, the entrance to the Three Immortals Island will soon be opened. It's better to avoid potential problems by moving quickly," Yuan Wuji said, emanating a layer of blood light from his body, which transformed into a suit of blood puppet armor, visibly the same Blood Puppet Armor.
Unlike Wulu's Blood Puppet Armor, Yuan Wuji's Blood Puppet Armor had a ferocious blood-colored mask on its face, giving the appearance of an evil ghost that had stepped out of the netherworld.
Yuan Wuji's immense presence rapidly diminished, settling at a Late-stage Core Formation level.
The next moment, the white-browed youth chanted a spell, and a flash of blood light passed over his body, creating a Blood Puppet Armor of his own, with his aura greatly reduced as well.
The Blood Realm Venerable and the purple-haired beauty also summoned their Blood Puppet Armor, and their cultivation levels plummeted from the Nascent Soul Stage to the Core Formation Stage.
Yuan Wuji retrieved four white Jade Plates from the storage magic tool of Luu Changfeng and the others, activated them with a flick of his fingers, and soon opened the seal on the Light and Shadow Gate.
Four beams of blood light shot out and disappeared into the gate in the blink of an eye.
The Light and Shadow Gate, without the seal, radiated dazzling waves of light that struck the walls of the hall.
The hall trembled incessantly, and cracks appeared on its walls.
Although the hall, built by the Wanqu Clan, was very sturdy, it had been soaked at the bottom of the sea for many years, and much of its strength had been eroded away, leaving only an empty shell.
The spirit light bursting from the Light and Shadow Gate became stronger and stronger, and a few breaths later, the hall's capacity to endure reached its limit, collapsing completely.
The outside seawater surged inward but was repelled by the spirit light from the Light and Shadow Gate.
The spirit light emitted from the Light and Shadow Gate was completely erratic, stirring up the nearby seawater into a chaotic upheaval, gradually forming an unstable underwater vortex, causing the entire seabed ruin to shake unstably.Themostup-to-dateversionison*.
At that moment, a ripple in the void occurred, and a vague silver figure appeared near the Light and Shadow Gate.
This person seemed to be a phantom Spiritual Body, unaffected by the swirling water around him.
"Ah, I had intended to go to the Overseas World to take a look, but who would have thought I'd encounter the emergence of the Three Immortals Island. I can't miss this opportunity." The silver figure excitedly muttered to himself, then tilted his body and headed toward the Light and Shadow Gate.
However, the spirit light inside the Light and Shadow Gate flared up, directly repelling the silver figure.
The person's silver light receded, revealing his true form—a man in a silver robe.
If Yuan Ming were here, he would undoubtedly recognize the silver-robed man, who was the Silver Void Tree Demon Yinkong, from the Six Desires Venerable.
"Those people just now used blood puppet armor to suppress their Cultivation to the Core Formation Stage. Could it be that the Three Immortal Island Secret Realm does not allow high-level cultivators to enter?" Yinkong stroked his chin, murmuring to himself.
He formed a few hand seals, tapping several points on his body, causing a silver light to shine on his head, which he slashed vertically downwards with swift motion.
Yinkong's body split in two, each half undulating like a liquid, rapidly forming two Yinkongs with substantially reduced strength, dropping to the third-level realm.
"This should do it..." The two Yinkongs flew out and entered the Light and Shadow Gate. This time, they encountered no resistance at all and, in a flash, successfully flew through.
...
In the secret realm, outside the Three Immortals Hall.
Countless roars of beasts, thunderous in the valley, caused the ground to shake violently.
A group of Core Formation Cultivators looked toward the distance in trepidation, only to see dust rolling over the valley's entrance and the surrounding slopes, within which the vague shapes of demon beasts could be seen. There were herbivorous first-level demon beasts, second-level demon beasts, and even quite a few massive third-level Great Demons.
These demon beasts were not fighting each other but were gathering together, forming a flood of beasts surging towards this side.
Golden Cloud Fairy's face changed dramatically, looking back at the three-colored Light Shield covering the outside of the hall, a trace of urgency flashing in her eyes.
"It must be the commotion here that has triggered a beast rampage, what should we do?" Tu Sheng frowned deeply.
Daoist Qian Bao was equally anxious, turning to look at Golden Cloud Fairy, clearly regarding her as the leader.
"With the scale of this beast horde, it's impossible for us to hold them off with our strength. Maybe we should retreat now?" Before Golden Cloud Fairy could speak, Zhong Ling had already made a suggestion.
"Indeed, compared to treasures, one's life is more important," Baili Zhui nodded, ready to put away his Magic Treasure.
Once they spoke, setting aside the others, Long Chong and Qiong Yun were ready to beat a retreat as well.
"Fellow Daoists, please wait. I must be honest, the ones currently attacking the Forbidden Light Screen with the Silver Mirror are the Island Masters of Fusang, Jin Ao, Kongling, and Di Hua. It will soon be broken open. Just bear with me and fend off these beasts; in a moment, we will all be able to enter the Three Immortals Hall together and gain an incredible opportunity," Golden Cloud Fairy said hurriedly, her voice clear and forceful, clearly audible to everyone present amidst the booming attacks against the protective shield and the commotion of the rampaging herd.
Upon hearing this, hesitation appeared on everyone's faces.
They could guess that the opportunity behind the Three Immortals Hall might very well be the long-rumored Three Immortals Island. Compared to other spiritual materials treasures within the secret realm, the various opportunities hidden on the island were a temptation they couldn't resist.
With this thought, even the steady ones like Zhong Ling were moved.
After all, such opportunities were rare and not guaranteed; if they missed this chance, they might never come across it again in this lifetime.
"Fellow Daoists, a heaven-sent opportunity is right before us. If we give up now, all our previous efforts will have been wasted. Since Golden Cloud Fairy said it would take just a moment, should we not work together once more, like we did before?" Seeing their reaction, Daoist Qian Bao took the opportunity to suggest.
"Heh heh, actually, even if we want to flee now, it's too late, unless your Earth Tunneling technique is as strong as mine; then perhaps you still have a chance to escape," Tu Sheng licked his lips and grinned.
Long Chong and Qiong Yun looked to Yuan Ming for a decision.
Yuan Ming shifted his gaze away from Golden Cloud Fairy, pondered a bit, and nodded.
He had an inkling that the current beast rampage had something to do with the invisible fluctuation previously emitted from the Three Immortals Hall. Although he did not know the specifics, he reckoned that a rampage of this scale posed little threat to him. With the Three Immortals Island right before him—an opportunity even the Shura Master could not seize in the past—he naturally did not wish to give it up.
Seeing Yuan Ming and the others agreeing, Zhong Ling and the others looked at each other and, without further hesitation, agreed to cooperate.
"Good, since Fellow Daoists have decided to seek this heaven-sent opportunity together, let's not hold back now that matters have come to this!" Golden Cloud Fairy said, feeling relieved.

chapters.title: Chapter 537 - 513: Hold Fast
chapters.content:
"Be careful, it's coming," Yuan Ming said, looking toward the distant sky.
As his words fell, within the rolling clouds of dust in the distance, shrieks suddenly emanated, and one after another, creatures resembling eagles, yet ten times larger—Second-level Demon Beasts, the Red Demon Falcons, had already flown above their heads.
"Whoosh whoosh"
With a sudden increase in the whistling of the wind, flames sparked in the eyes of the Red Demon Falcons, and their feathers seemed half ablaze. With a fierce flap of their wings, countless flames poured down like a torrential rain towards the ground.
"Boom boom boom"
The fiery rain pounded the earth, but was blocked by protective shields raised by Yuan Ming and the others, scattering countless sparks.
Such an attack would normally be trivial to Yuan Ming and his group, but the sheer number at this moment was no small matter. Naturally, they immediately deployed various Magical Treasure Talismans to defend themselves.
While the attacks in the air had not yet ceased, the ground suddenly shook violently. Huge fissures cracked open beneath their feet, and Demon Vines, resembling spiritual snakes, suddenly extended from underground, wrapping towards them.
Seeing this, almost everyone felt a shiver of fear, glad that they had not recklessly used the Earth Escape technique. Otherwise, encountering these things underground, they might have been entangled and trapped by the Demon Vines, ultimately leading to their deaths.
Just then, a green light suddenly spread from the ground.
Zhong Ling, Baili Zhui, and Hua Ping were seen sitting back-to-back on the ground, each holding a green disk, channeling Mana and casting with their eyes closed.
As the green halo spread from beneath them, thick vines burst from the ground, reaching toward the depths and intertwining with the Demon Vines below.
Earlier at the Magma Lake, they had lost most of the stakes used for setting up the array, so now the power of their Ten Thousand Wood Formation was significantly diminished.
"Fellow Daoists, we'll do our best to hold off the attacks coming from underground. The rest is up to you," Zhong Ling said while casting, without waiting for everyone else's response, clearly struggling to manage the formation.
Unperturbed by the reaction of others, she continued to focus deeply on managing the formation.
Yuan Ming raised his hand and tapped his Spiritual Beast Bag at his waist, releasing Lei Yu into the sky to fight on its own.
Lei Yu let out a joyful cry, showing no fear as it soared into the sky, transforming into a streak of lightning. It plunged into the swarm of Red Demon Falcons. With flashes of lightning, it instantly turned several falcons to char, tearing a gap through the flock.
While the Red Demon Falcons tried to encircle Lei Yu, it had already turned into a streak of light, rushing to another area.
Clearly, Lei Yu's goal was not to truly engage with so many falcons, but to disturb them.
This disruption broke the falcons' overwhelming momentum, and indeed, the number of fiery rains plummeting from the sky abruptly decreased.
Seeing this, everyone else was greatly heartened, releasing their own flying spirit beasts to join Lei Yu in harassing the flock in the sky.
Meanwhile, on the ground, the charging demons finally reached them, including Wind Blade-spitting Green Wolves, huge Tiger Demons, and giant Serpents covered in green scales with eyes shining like lanterns, each of different forms and numerous in types.
Fortunately, most were Level 1 and Second Level Demon Beasts, with a mix of third-level ones, and no Level 4 Great Demons had appeared yet.
However, the sheer number of demons, increasingly close, grew ever more oppressive to everyone present.
Qiong Yun couldn't help but swallow spit, glancing at her Spiritual Snake, Lei Guang.
The latter, seemingly attuned to her heart, also showed a grave expression in its eyes but showed no intention of retreating. As it faced the rapidly approaching Green Wolves, it opened its mouth and unleashed a torrent of thunder, forming a Thunder Wall blocking the beasts in front of it.
However, within mere moments, the Thunder Wall was slashed to tatters by tens of Wind Blades, with a dozen Green Wolves breaking through first and pouncing towards her.
Seeing this, Qiong Yun swiftly gestured with her hands, and flung them forward forcefully. The remnants of the shattered Thunder Wall suddenly spun rapidly, transforming into swirling Thunder Blades, retaliating against the Green Wolves.
Where the Thunder Blades sliced through, blood sprayed, and sounds of bones snapping and tendons tearing rang out. The leading two Green Wolves collapsed, but even more demons surged forward.
At the same time, Yuan Ming, Long Chong, and Wulu each took action. One purple and one blue spear shot out, sweeping through the torrent of demons, creating whirlwinds of blood and continuous roars and booms wherever they passed.
Wulu raised a blood-red crescent-shaped Magic Treasure, and as he waved it, large crescent moons of blood fell within the pack of beasts. The blood-colored crescents were exceptionally sharp, easily slicing multiple Demon Beasts into two, creating a blood mist filling the air.
Golden Cloud Fairy, Daoist Qian Bao, and Tu Sheng were guarding in front of the Silver Mirror, their Magic Treasures bursting with spiritual light as they continuously launched fierce attacks, holding off another legion of beasts.
The seven of them seemed tiny within the vast sea of demons, yet as they bravely rallied, the light from their Magic Treasures and spirit beasts joined together, forming a massive wall of light, successfully blocking all demons for the moment.
In the midst of the seven's protection, Zhong Ling and the other two were fully focused on operating the damaged Ten Thousand Wood Formation, managing to block all underground sneaking beasts.
Although these demons were not particularly strong and had limited spiritual intelligence, they had previously relied on an overwhelming momentum that was formidable. But now, this momentum had been shattered by the concerted efforts of Yuan Ming and the others, greatly reducing the threat.
Just when they were about to breathe a sigh of relief, a roar erupted.
A towering black ape, five zhang tall with a massive body, sprang out from the crowd of beasts. Its eyes were like two purple crystal stones the size of millstones, and its body was enveloped in potent demon energy. Clutching a huge ironwood log in one hand, it ran causing the ground to tremble beneath it, clearly a Level 4 Demon Beast!
Zhong Ling and the other two's expressions changed drastically, and Long Chong and Qiong Yun also showed signs of fear.
Golden Cloud Fairy's expression was solemn, yet she showed no fear as she waved her hand to summon the golden spiritual bird.
The golden spiritual bird let out a piercing screech that seemed to penetrate the heavens, and its body emitted golden flames, forming a vast fiery cloud of gold several tens of zhang in size. The spirit of the bird soared rapidly, reaching the Third-level Upper Stage Peak in the blink of an eye, and it swooped down from the sky, heading straight for the black ape.
The black ape showed fury, and with one hand, it grabbed two Second-level Green Wolf Demon Beasts by its side and hurled them at the golden spiritual bird, only to see them swallowed up by the golden fire clouds.
The golden spiritual bird was staggeringly fast, and in an instant, it appeared above the black ape, its claws reaching down.
The black ape roared angrily, abruptly halted in place, held the gigantic ironwood log with both hands, and spun around swiftly, swinging the ironwood log to meet the golden spiritual bird's claws.
With a loud "bang", the golden spiritual bird's body was drastically shaken, and it was sent flying by the impact.
A Third-level Peak and a Level 4 Demon Beast—the gap was indeed too vast.
However, at that moment, a figure suddenly flashed out—it was Xue Jiao from Bijiao Island.
She was enveloped in a flash of blue light, her body elongated significantly, and her slender legs sprouted fine scales, transforming into a gracefully moving fish tail, revealing her true form.
The water surged forth, lifting Xue Jiao's body like a wave.
In her eyes, a sorrowful expression flashed, and teardrops rolled down like beads off a string, but instead of falling to the ground, they hovered before her, flicked one by one by her bending fingers.
Dozens of teardrops shot out, striking the black ape and quickly penetrated into its body, transforming into a green light that spread from the impacted area to the surroundings.
Wherever the green light passed, the body of the ape slowly turned into a greenish color, astonishingly transforming into green crystal stones.
The black ape, shocked and furious, swung its arm and a claw tore through the air, appearing instantly in front of Xue Jiao. The massive claw fiercely grasped her body, moving faster than anyone's eyes could follow.
With a "sizzle", Xue Jiao's body was sliced into several segments, but no blood sprayed out. Instead, her body transformed into scattered flowing water, flying to the side.
The blue light flashed and the scattered water reformed Xue Jiao's body, seemingly unaffected by the attack.
She softly began chanting a melancholy and mournful song, her voice ethereal and piercing, resonating throughout the valley.
The surge of demon beasts was influenced by this Illusion Sound, and their rampaging speed slowed down.
The black ape too was affected by the song, its eyes momentarily clouded.
A thick pillar of golden fire shot towards it, as the golden spiritual bird took the chance to fly at the ape again, fiercely striking the black ape.
With a loud "boom", the massive body of the ape was sent flying, crashing into a large group of demon beasts. The black ape fur was coated in golden flames that burned fiercely and quickly spread, turning the gigantic ironwood log in its hands into charred timber as well.
Find the translation on MV&LEMPYR.
Shadows flickered mid-air, and Bing Xin and Yun Jiuxiao also appeared, summoning their spiritual beasts to join the group battle.
Seeing three more reinforcements arrive, the spirits of those who were holding the line were greatly lifted.
"Daoist Xue Jiao, thank you," Golden Cloud Fairy communicated her thanks through telepathy.
"Let's skip the formalities, break the light barrier later, and we'll share in the benefits," Xue Jiao said with a light chuckle.
"Naturally," Golden Cloud Fairy promptly assured.
While the two women communicated through telepathy, the others continued launching attacks, and with the addition of Xue Jiao and her party, the defensive line became even more solid, methodically repelling wave after wave of assaults.
Yuan Ming formed a hand seal, and the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear emitted a vast purple light, slicing through two rugged, Third-level Black Bear Demon Beasts. The black bears were cleaved in half, blood streaming on the ground.
"This Black Bear Demon Beast's Essence Blood is abundant, Fellow Daoist Yuan, don't waste it," Hong Ling's voice sounded in Yuan Ming's Sea of Consciousness.
"Nagging!" Yuan Ming frowned and coldly huffed, but he also flicked his sleeve, sending out a blue light that gathered the two corpses into the Shura Blood Devouring Map.
During this time, his spear continued, killing several more demon beasts, his efficiency astonishing, making Golden Cloud Fairy and the others take notice.
His brow suddenly furrowed, and he peered into the distance, seeing behind the multitude of demon beasts a hundred-zhang-long Demon Python raising its head, crashing through a vast number of beasts, making its way directly towards them.
The Demon Python's demon energy was deep and potent, clearly a Level 4 Demon Beast that was even stronger than the previous black ape.

chapters.title: Chapter 538 - 514: Entering the Palace
chapters.content:
Xue Jiao and Golden Spirit Bird barely managed to hold off the injured Black Giant Ape, and the others had no time to pay attention to anything else. If a giant Demon Python were to join in, the barely stabilized front line of the group would instantly collapse.
"In this critical situation, it's necessary to hide one's true strength, but hiding too much can also mean missing opportunities," Xi Ying's voice echoed in Yuan Ming's Sea of Consciousness.
"I understand," Yuan Ming said.
"I'll leave this to you all!" He told Long Chong, Qiong Yun, and the others, as he took the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear in his hand and charged towards the hundred-zhang-long Demon Python.
By the time he reached the forefront, the Demon Python had also closed in.
Its head, as big as a house, was raised high, with a dark crimson snake tongue spitting out from its gaping mouth, and two Poison Fangs on each side revealed the openings of two poison glands, spraying directly at Yuan Ming.
One could see the rolling Poison Liquid spewing out like a flood, corroding the air in mid-air and making a "puff puff" sound, emitting large plumes of purple smoke.
The surrounding demon beasts that couldn't dodge in time were tainted by the poison liquid, and their skin dissolved and bones melted, turning them into a pool of blood.
Seeing this, other demon beasts scattered like birds startled by the mere twang of a bow, fleeing to both sides.
But Yuan Ming remained still, getting submerged in the billowing poison smoke.
In his hand, the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear released a splendid light, forming a shield that protected him within, blocking all the poison liquid outside. A streak of purple light slashed across the Demon Python's head.
The Demon Python's head was torn open, its neck slashed with a wound about a zhang long, and blood gushed out.
The Demon Python's head thrashed wildly, letting out an earth-shattering screech as its massive tail swept over like a black wall with a whoosh.
Yuan Ming was startled and quickly thrust his spear out, clashing with the python's tail.
The python's tail was pierced through, leaving a bloody hole, but Yuan Ming was also sent flying by the overwhelming force.
The Demon Python's thick body suddenly turned into illusions, wrapping around Yuan Ming's body with exceptional agility, pressing hard with muscles as strong as refined iron.
A "crack" sound rang out lightly!
Yuan Ming's body was crushed into a patty, and a large amount of blood splattered everywhere.
The hundred-zhang-long Demon Python let out a smug cry, biting towards Yuan Ming's corpse, intending to swallow this detestable person and vent the hatred in its heart.
At that moment, its vision suddenly fractured, and Yuan Ming's shattered body disappeared without a trace; everything that had just happened seemed to be nothing but an illusion.
Meanwhile, thick purple-black vines shot through the surrounding poison smoke, unaffected in the slightest, tightly wrapping around the Demon Python's body, binding it into a zongzi, and even attempting to pierce the python scales and drill inside.
The Demon Python was shocked and enraged, its body abruptly rolled, and it effortlessly tore apart all the purple-black vines.
Yuan Ming's figure appeared in mid-air, waving his hand, and the Star Power on the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear burst forth, transforming into a Star Light falling down and piercing through the Demon Python's body, nailing it to the ground.
A fierce light flickered in the Demon Python's eyes, its body twisting violently, and it managed to break free from the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear, but its wound was enlarged to several times bigger, and blood gushed out.
"A good opportunity!" Yuan Ming's eyes lit up with joy as his Divine Sense enveloped downwards, casting the Illusion Technique once again.
Within the Stealing Heaven Tripod, the Divine Sense of the first soul also descended, assisting the main soul.
The Demon Python's gaze became dazed, its movements momentarily stagnating again.
A shadow of purple-black shot out from the ground, it was Hua Zhi, who flashed once and entered the Demon Python's wound.
The broken vines nearby, like living creatures, shot out and drilled into three separate wounds on the Demon Python's body.
It didn't take long for the Demon Python to break free from the illusion, suffering unbearable pain within, and its gigantic body rolled and twisted on the ground, unintentionally crushing many demon beasts to death.
Long Chong and the others saw this and felt both shock and joy.
"That powerful wave of Divine Soul just now, could it be that Yuan Ming is..." Golden Cloud Fairy's gaze flickered as she looked over.
With the Demon Python suppressed by Hua Zhi, Yuan Ming immediately charged towards the Black Giant Ape with his spear, joining with Xue Jiao in forcing the already flame-injured Black Giant Ape to retreat repeatedly.
Although the two Level 4 Demon Beasts were held back, more and more demon beasts were pouring into the valley, and as the group fought and retreated, the situation became increasingly dire.
Daoist Qian Bao looked at the increasingly numerous demon beasts in the front, then turned to ask, "Golden Cloud Fairy, how much longer will it take for you to finish?"
"Almost there!" Golden Cloud Fairy replied with a frown, her eyes never leaving the Three Immortals Hall.
At this moment, the attacks coming from the Silver Ancient Mirror became more and more fierce, and the three-colored light shield was showing signs of faltering; but to completely break through, it clearly still needed some time.
Just then, there was a sudden disturbance from beneath the ground.
"Fellow Daoist Zhong Ling, watch out for the ground!" Golden Cloud Fairy's eyes flashed with Golden Light, her expression drastically changing as she warned.
Zhong Ling and the others were startled and were about to leap into the air, when the ground, entangled like a tangle of roots by the Ten Thousand Wood Formation, suddenly cracked, forming a huge fissure that tore the Great Array apart.
Zhong Ling and the other two, while sitting together, were suddenly overturned by a massive force.
From the rift in the ground, suddenly shot out more than a dozen dark red thick roots, like more than a dozen dark red spears, piercing towards the three of them.
On Zhong Ling's waist, a green wooden token shone brightly, turning into a suit of Green Vine Wood Armor that protected her entire body.
The dark red roots stabbed at her body, the Green Vine Wood Armor barely blocked for a moment before instantly collapsing.
However, that brief moment was enough for Zhong Ling, who summoned two pairs of nimble wings on her back, which whisked her away rapidly, dodging the pursuit of several other roots.
Zhong Ling narrowly escaped disaster, but Baili Zhui and Hua Ping were not so lucky; Baili Zhui was pierced in the chest by a dark red root, which then also skewered his Banyan Wood Spirit Beast, impaling them together.
Hua Ping fared similarly; his Flower Demon Spirit Beast stepped forward to block the attack from the front, but another dark red root came around from behind and directly pierced through Hua Ping's Protective Treasure Light.
Read ahead and get updates by visiting *.
A streak of red light shot from the tree root into the bodies of Baili Zhui and Hua Ping, and immediately, a blaze rushed out from their chests, turning them to ashes in the blink of an eye.
The ambush by the dark red tree root was abrupt, with everyone fighting their own battles, they couldn't even react, let alone come to the rescue.
"Brother Baili, Brother Hua!" Zhong Ling's heart was wrung with pain, but she did not recklessly rush forward to seek revenge.
This tree demon that appeared underground was extremely powerful, definitely a Level 4 Demon Beast; to rashly charge down now would be a death sentence.
As the underground position was lost, the area before the Three Immortals Hall descended into chaos, and even the likes of Daoist Qian Bao and Tu Sheng began to consider retreat.
At this moment, the silver ancient mirror behind the Golden Cloud Fairy suddenly flared with light, emitting a scintillating silver radiance that bathed the entire valley in its glow.
A green pillar of wind shot out from the ancient mirror, rapidly expanding dozens of times in size, transforming into a towering column of wind that enveloped the whole valley.
The wind roared like the tide, and the valley was instantly filled with flying sand and rocks, accompanied by the sound of rolling thunder.
Yuan Ming and the others were caught up in the wind column, tossed about like leaves in a storm, completely powerless to resist, and the same was true for the demon beasts in the valley.
Loud cracks of thunder rang out within the wind column, countless small and large green Wind Blades swooped down like locusts, spinning and slashing at the three-colored light shield.
The three-colored light shield trembled violently, only holding for two or three breaths before it completely collapsed, bursting apart and dissipating into countless sparkles that vanished into thin air.
The green wind column stopped and quickly dissipated, leaving the main body of the Three Immortals Hall exposed to the air.
Yuan Ming, Long Chong, Daoist Qian Bao, and the others rushed towards the Three Immortals Hall with joy.
Halfway in flight, Yuan Ming turned back to summon Lei Yu. At that moment, Hua Zhi had also killed the hundred-zhang Demon Python, draining it into a dried husk, and burrowed from the ground back to Yuan Ming's side.
The aura of Hua Zhi had once again grown stronger, reaching the Peak of third-level, approaching the brink of breaking through to the Level 4 Realm.
"Let's go," Yuan Ming said, leading the two spirit beasts, and proceeded towards the Three Immortals Hall.
The demon beasts seemed to have been spurred on as well, becoming even more frenzied and recklessly charging at the group, trying to prevent them from getting close to the Three Immortals Hall.
Although the giant black ape had been killed by Yuan Ming and Xue Jiao, several massive figures of demon beasts were rushing over from a distance, all of them were powerful Level 4 Great Demons.
Tu Sheng twisted his wrist, revealing a fist-sized, somewhat worn brown copper bell in his palm, which seemed to have a layer of aged yellow earth around it, giving it a considerable heft.
He held the copper bell in one hand while chanting resonated from his mouth.
As the chanting filled the air, the brown copper bell emitted a series of trembling sounds, suddenly expanding into a bell over a dozen zhang tall.
Tu Sheng clenched his fist, enveloped in a yellow halo, and hammered the giant bell with his fist, creating a deep 'dong' sound of a bell.
Rings of brown halos spread out, enveloping all the approaching demon beasts.
Suddenly, the bodies of the demon beasts became heavy by tens or even hundreds of times, pressed to the ground and unable to move, giving the group the opportunity to land in front of the Three Immortals Hall.
"Earth Splendor Island Master actually allowed you to bring the Thick Earth Bell. You've really helped us out this time," Daoist Qian Bao said joyfully.
"Quick, open the entrance to the hall, I can't hold on for much longer," Tu Sheng said, landing with the giant bell and sweating profusely, urging the others.
Seeing this, the Golden Cloud Fairy waved her hand, and a three-colored Jade Talisman attached itself to the gate of the Three Immortals Hall. The spirit light on the heavy gate quickly faded, and the door creaked open a crack.
She put away the silver ancient mirror, kicked open the gate, and flashed into the hall.
The others immediately followed suit, rushing into the hall.
Tu Sheng also put away the Thick Earth Bell and flew into the Three Immortals Hall.
Without the suppression of the Thick Earth Bell, the demon beasts outside regained their freedom, howling relentlessly at the Three Immortals Hall but not daring to rush in; the Level 4 Great Demons did the same.
...
In front of the grand hall, there was a long passage, its depths invisible to the eye.
Yuan Ming's brows twitched; the space was permeated with an invisible Forbidden, preventing Divine Sense from spreading out.
With countless demon beasts outside, and several terrifying Level 4 Great Demons, the group promptly sprinted deeper into the passage.
"Everyone calm down, those demon beasts have not pursued us," the Golden Cloud Fairy said.
Hearing this, everyone looked back and saw silence; indeed, no demon beasts were there.
"It seemed to me that those demon beasts stopped once they reached the entrance of the great hall, as if they didn't dare to step foot inside," Long Chong remarked.
"Could it be that there is something more terrifying than demon beasts here that is preventing them from entering?" Qiong Yun said, hesitantly.
Everyone felt a chill in their hearts and turned to look at the Golden Cloud Fairy.
This woman had used the silver ancient mirror to break the light shield outside the Three Immortals Hall and opened the hall door with a three-colored Jade Talisman. She certainly knew a lot about this place.
"Rest assured, there is no danger inside the Three Immortals Hall," said the Golden Cloud Fairy briefly, without further explanation, and continued onwards.
Yuan Ming's gaze flickered subtly as he stepped forward to follow.
Seeing this, everyone else quickly kept up.
With the demon beasts behind not giving chase, the group felt their raised hearts drop slightly, and began to take notice of their surroundings.
The corridor was constructed of golden material, resplendent and luxurious, adorned with dragons and phoenixes, showcasing the grandeur of the Immortals.
However, apart from the ostentatious patterns, meticulously carved murals, and reliefs, there were no treasures to be found here.

chapters.title: Chapter 539 - 515: Mother and Child Formation
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming and his group continued forward, the passage soon came to an end, and they were met with a tall, black stele. Engraved with numerous cloud patterns, it bore a large "Immortal" character written in ancient seal script.
The group halted their steps, sizing up the stele, probing it with their Divine Sense. Upon discovering nothing unusual, they moved past the stele and a golden hall appeared before them.
The interior of the hall was exceptionally spacious, with only a stone platform located in the center, upon which a silver-white round Array was set up. The dense patterns were complex to behold, very similar to the Array Patterns in the Void Temple and the True Sea Hall, evidently another Teleportation Array.
However, a corner of the Array was damaged, its patterns dull and lightless.
Golden Cloud Fairy walked over, took out various materials, and began to repair the Array Patterns as if she had known about the condition beforehand.
Tu Sheng and Daoist Qian Bao appeared behind Golden Cloud Fairy in a flash, casting vigilant glances towards the others.
"Fellow Daoist Jin Yun, Thousand Treasures, what's going on here? Weren't there supposed to be a plethora of treasures inside the hall? Why is there no trace of them, did you deceive us?" Zhong Ling asked in a hoarse voice.
She, along with Hua Ping and Baili Zhui, were close friends who grew up together, having made a pact before entering the Secret Realm to not take unnecessary risks. They stayed behind on this adventure out of greed for the treasures inside the hall. Now with Hua Ping and Baili Zhui dead, Zhong Ling couldn't allow their deaths to become a joke and leave empty-handed.
"Fellow Daoist Zhong, rest assured, although there are no treasures in this hall, this Transmission Array leads to the greatest treasure in the East Sea," Daoist Qian Bao said.
"Three Immortal Island?" Zhong Ling said slowly.
"Exactly," Daoist Qian Bao answered with a slight hesitation, nodding.
Upon hearing this, Zhong Ling walked over to one side and sat down.
The others too had guessed where the Teleportation Array led to, and now that it was confirmed by Daoist Qian Bao, excitement was evident on their faces. They all took their positions nearby, protecting Golden Cloud Fairy as she worked.
Yuan Ming stood off to the side, directing his first soul to descend with his Divine Sense, surveying the interior of the hall, trying to find some concealed items.
However, after searching, he found that the hall, aside from the Array, was truly empty, concealing nothing at all.
"How stingy, to have such a grand hall and not place anything good inside," Yuan Ming muttered in his heart, his expression suddenly shifting.
Golden Cloud Fairy's knowledge of the situation in the hall, even the fact that the Teleportation Array was broken and that she specifically brought items for repairs, clearly indicated that she had obtained information through some channel before coming here.
Yuan Ming's Divine Sense reached towards the silver Array. Buried beneath the Array were four silver Stone Pillars, filled with pure Space Power, distinctly different from the Space Power stored beneath the Void Temple and the True Sea Hall.
As time passed, after half a day, the last Array Pattern was also repaired.
Golden Cloud Fairy stood up, took out a silver Token, which was the Teleportation Order, and made several virtual taps with her fingers.
Hum...
The Teleportation Array lit up brightly, spinning at high speed.
The others, seeing this scene, were overjoyed and prepared to leap into the Array.
Golden Cloud Fairy waved her hand, tossing the Silver Ancient Mirror she had on her, landing it precisely in the center of the entire Array, integrating with it.
Yuan Ming's Divine Sense was continuously sensing the Teleportation Array and distinctly felt that as the Silver Ancient Mirror merged with the Array it vanished from sight, turning into dozens of Silver Runes, which formed a smaller Array Map within the Teleportation Array, reflecting its light.
A stream of silver radiance burst forth from the surface of the mirror, spilling like quicksilver and instantly filling the entire Array.
Hums of "humming" rose, and the Teleportation Array shone even more brilliantly, upward rays of silver light pierced through the roof of the Three Immortals Hall and soared into the skies.
"Fellow Daoist Jin Yun, what are you doing?" Zhong Ling asked with a grave voice.
Golden Cloud Fairy did not answer, instead, she activated her Protective Treasure Light around her and was the first to leap into the silver light.
The bright silver light engulfed her figure, which quickly disappeared.
Daoist Qian Bao and Tu Sheng followed, one after the other, stepping in as well.
With a flickering gaze, Zhong Ling also jumped into the Array, followed by Xue Jiao, Bing Xin, and Yun Jiuxiao.
With a flash of silver, the four figures vanished, leaving only Yuan Ming, Long Chong, Qiong Yun, and Wulu in the large hall.
"We should hurry too, don't let them take all the advantages," Qiong Yun urged, leaping into the Array, with Long Chong closely behind.
Yet Yuan Ming remained standing where he was, clearly with no intention of entering the Array, and Wulu also stayed motionless.
Qiong Yun and Long Chong showed surprise, but before they could ask any questions, a dazzling flash of silver light occurred, and they were transported away.
"Brother Yuan, are you not going to Three Immortals Island? Or do you think there's something wrong with this Transmission Array?" Wulu looked over, seemingly also aware of Golden Cloud Fairy's recent actions.
"Of course, I intend to go, and there's nothing wrong with the Array. However, I have something to do right now, so Brother Wulu, you go ahead," Yuan Ming said.
"If that's the case, then I will go first. If we meet on Three Immortals Island, let's proceed as we have previously agreed," Wulu stepped into the Array, and his figure vanished in a flash.
"Finally, they're all gone, you told me to stay until the end for what purpose?" Yuan Ming walked up to the Array and waved his hand as he spoke.
Ripples of void fluctuation arose nearby, and the figure of Xi Ying suddenly emerged from thin air.
Xi Ying said nothing, taking out a silver orb Magic Treasure that flickered with spirit light like the ebb and flow of the tide.
She activated the Treasure Bead, and a crystal light struck the Array, turning into layer upon layer of ripples undulating within the Array.
"Just as I thought, it's the Yin Yang Mother-Child Array," Xi Ying nodded and said.
"Yin Yang Mother-Child Array?" Yuan Ming asked, not understanding.
"This is a type of 'nested array' in arrays, simply put, it's when two Arrays are connected together. With your intelligence, you should be able to guess which Array the Golden Cloud Fairy has connected this one to, right?" Xi Ying looked over.
"The ancient Transmission Array on Fusang Island?" Yuan Ming's thoughts raced as he slowly spoke.
"Correct, this must be the plan of the old folks from Fusang, Jin Ao, Kongling, and Di Hua islands. Those Nascent Soul cultivators cannot enter the Secret Realm, so they thought of this method to enter Three Immortals Island," Xi Ying said with a light snort.
"Then what are your plans? Are you going to destroy their plan?" Yuan Ming asked.
"There's no need for that; I have another plan." Xi Ying threw the silver orb she held into the Array.
The silver orb merged into the interior of the Array, turning into a stream of silver radiance that coiled around the Yin Yang Mother and Child Array Diagram.
Yuan Ming's face showed a look of surprise, and just as he was about to ask Xi Ying the meaning of her actions, his expression suddenly changed slightly.

"What's wrong?" Xi Ying asked, seeing this.
"Someone else is coming. Eh, these four people are all wearing Blood Puppet Armor! This isn't good, they're all Nascent Soul cultivators, I fear they're not here with good intentions. We need to leave quickly!" Yuan Ming grabbed Xi Ying and leaped into the Array.
A dazzling burst of silver light exploded, and the two figures vanished.
Just after the two had teleported away, four Blood Shadows appeared within the hall. It was Yuan Wuji and his companions.
...
At the same time, the ancient Transmission Array on Fusang Island was also buzzing, lighting up with a silver glow. Within the silver radiance, a small Array Map appeared, exactly the Yin Yang Mother and Child Array Diagram.
"Hehe, not bad, they've activated the Transmission Array," the Island Master Wan Tianren's eyes revealed a look of delight, and he too threw the silver ancient mirror in his hand into the Array.
A silver light gushed out like a fountain, becoming a soaring brightness, but was blocked by the forbidden enchantments of the Void Temple.
"We shouldn't delay any further, let's go in now," Tu Shixiong urged hastily.
"Hmm." Wan Tianren nodded, and several people stepped onto the ancient Transmission Array.
The Yin Yang Mother-Child Array could only sustain transmission once, so there was no need to worry that after they left, other people would use this Array to also enter Three Immortals Island.
Wan Tianren took out a Teleportation Order, ready to teleport away.
But just at that moment, ripples of void fluctuation arose nearby, and four figures materialized out of thin air.
The front two, one a middle-aged man with white, unblemished skin and a gloomy temperament, the other a man around thirty in a cyan robe, with an average build and square face, distinguished eyebrows—it was none other than Jia Sifang and Ni Mu.
As for the two behind them, a man and a woman, they were Wu Yuezhi and the stunning young woman who had appeared at the Shura Palace together previously.
As soon as Jia Sifang appeared, he immediately raised his right hand, pointing casually towards the ancient Transmission Array.
A surge of rolling black evil energy, tangible as reality itself, rushed toward the ground-bound ancient Transmission Array, and a silver talisman mixed within the evil energy turned into a streak of light, striking one corner of the Transmission Array.
The entire Transmission Array shook violently, a powerful Space Power appeared out of nowhere, locking the five people within the center of the Array, and the transmission capability of the ancient Transmission Array was also sealed.
Above the locked Array, a silver "Prohibition" rune floated, seemingly hanging in isolation but in fact tightly connected to the entire Array.
Wan Tianren's face changed drastically, his body's mighty Mana surged, attempting to break the Prohibition Rune. Yet the entire Transmission Array began to shake as if Wan Tianren was attacking the Array itself.
"Haha, Island Master Fusang, your Mana is indeed formidable, I am far from your match. Still, it's better not to move recklessly since you're standing within the Transmission Array. This ancient Transmission Array is quite fragile, it cannot withstand the overwhelming Divine Skills of you gentlemen," Jia Sifang laughed.
"You're Jia Sifang, how dare you trespass into the forbidden ground of my Fusang Island!" Wan Tianren quickly stopped his Mana, shouting sternly.
They had been focused on breaking the Three Immortals Hall's forbiddances and were elated with the opening of the Transmission Array, slackening their vigilance for a moment, and they hadn't noticed these people sneaking in.
Although they still didn't know Jia Sifang and company's purpose, their appearance at this crucial moment was definitely not with good intentions.
Destroying the Prohibition Rune would be easy, but it could also destroy the ancient Transmission Array. They had been plotting to enter Three Immortals Island for a long time, and they couldn't let their efforts go to waste.
"With just one talisman, it's impossible to have such strong restraining power. You must have tampered with this ancient Transmission Array beforehand, haven't you?" The red-robed middle-aged man with a flash of golden light in his eyes, spoke calmly as if uninvolved.
"Are you Senior Jin Chao? Indeed, as sharp as thunder, you saw through my little trick at a glance," Jia Sifang seemed very wary of the red-robed middle-aged man, and his words were very polite.
"When the ancient Transmission Array is not in use, it's sealed by Fusang Island's Array, strictly forbidding anyone to approach. When did you get close to this Array? Could it be during the time when the Array was being tuned?" Wan Tianren furrowed his brows, then seemed to recall something.

chapters.title: Chapter 540 - 516: Sensation
chapters.content:
"Lord Wan is quick-witted, but I must also credit Alliance Leader Ni for lending me this Hundred Transforming Talisman, or else I wouldn't have been able to deceive the eyes of Fellow Daoists from Fusang Island," Jia Sifang said as he expelled a white jade talisman and shot a glance at Ni Mu.
"Alliance Leader Ni? Are you the Alliance Hierarch Ni Mu from the Dawn Alliance?" Wan Tianren looked toward Ni Mu.
"He is not only the Alliance Hierarch of the Dawn Alliance but also the Heavenly Puppet Venerable of the Wuyue Sect, in charge of overseeing all affairs of the Wuyue Sect in the East Sea," Jia Sifang said with a smile, introducing him before Ni Mu could speak.
As soon as these words were spoken, they were like a bolt from the blue, and everyone's expressions changed drastically.
The resurgence of the Wuyue Sect, though the strife was still confined to the Black Wind Desert north of the Central Plains, had already shaken the East Sea.
Wan Tianren revealed the emergence of the Three Immortal Island to promote the entrance of Core Formation talents from various islands into the secret realm, thereby activating the teleportation array within; one reason being to swiftly enhance their strength to face the major changes due to the emergence of the Wuyue Sect.
Yet, none of them had expected a Venerable of the Wuyue Sect to appear before them.
"Jia Sifang, you have betrayed and forsaken your faith, revealing the identity of the Alliance Hierarch!" Wu Yuezhi roared in shock and anger.
The reaction of the beautiful female cultivator was similar; her gaze toward Jia Sifang flashed with a hint of murderous intent, but Ni Mu remained calm, as if the person Jia Sifang was talking about was not him.
"Brother Ni has become quite composed nowadays, aren't you angry that I've revealed your identity to others?" A hint of surprise flickered in Jia Sifang's eyes as he chuckled.
"Why should I be angry? The agreement between Brother Jia and myself was to cooperate without stipulating that our identities must remain secret. Do not be impolite toward Brother Jia," Ni Mu stated, his expression placid as ever, finally giving Wu Yuezhi and the beautiful young lady a glance.
"Brother Ni has indeed come a long way; truly, 'a day apart seems three autumns.' We should all look at you in a new light," Jia Sifang laughed heartily.
"Brother Jia flatters me. Let's not waste time on idle chat; Yuan Wuji, the elder brother, should have already prepared by now and might have already entered Three Immortal Island. We should hasten our actions," Ni Mu stated.
Jia Sifang's expression stiffened. He had deliberately exposed Ni Mu's identity, hoping to shift Wan Tianren and others' attention towards Ni Mu. Unexpectedly, Ni Mu turned the strategy back on him by revealing his hidden gambit.
"Yuan Wuji!" Wan Tianren's pupils contracted.
If there was someone in the East Sea that he genuinely dreaded, aside from the red-robed middle-aged man beside him, it would be Yuan Wuji, the Alliance Hierarch of the Tide-rider Alliance.
The two had once clashed, ending in a draw. Wan Tianren had not used his trump card at the time, but Yuan Wuji clearly also held back.
"Lord Wan, now that everything is out in the open, we would also like to visit Three Immortal Island. May we accompany you?" Ni Mu asked with a bow.
"Exactly, if you gentlemen do not agree, then we part ways and destroy this ancient teleportation array, so no one can go!" Jia Sifang stated, his expression now composed.
Wan Tianren's face turned sour, and the other three island masters also looked displeased, only the red-robed middle-aged man remained silent, seemingly unconcerned about the struggles of the few.
"It seems you gentlemen have agreed, then thank you," Ni Mu said with a smile, lifting his hand slightly.
The barrier imprisoning Wan Tianren and the others shrank by half, pushing the five people towards the array, leaving an empty space within the teleportation array.
Ni Mu stepped into the array, seemingly unworried that Wan Tianren and the others would lash out in fury.
Wu Yuezhi and the beautiful young lady followed closely behind; Jia Sifang was the last to enter.
Ni Mu flipped his hand and pulled out a silver jade talisman, crushing it forcefully.
Chapterprovidedvia*.
The prohibition runes above the heads of Wan Tianren and others halved in size, significantly reducing the imprisoning force as the ancient teleportation array's transmission power was restored.
A beam of silver light shot out from the shattered talisman, striking the array.
The dazzling silver light erupted, and the figures within the array vanished in a flicker.
The Yin Yang Mother and Child Array Diagram within the ancient teleportation array rapidly dissipated, on the verge of collapse.
Suddenly, a ripple undulated through the nearby void as a silver small beast appeared out of nowhere and descended in front of the ancient teleportation array, clearly being Xi Ying's spiritual beast, Guoguo.
Guoguo showed no signs of life, its body semi-transparent, seeming almost like an illusion, and it opened its mouth to exhale.
A silver orb flew out from its mouth, identical to the treasure bead Xi Ying had thrown into the Three Immortal Hall teleportation array.
The silver orb transformed into a stream of silver light, wrapping around the Yin Yang Mother and Child Array Diagram, the array diagram that was about to collapse suddenly halted, and quickly regained stability and brightness.
Guoguo opened its mouth again, emitting eight sharp white beams of light that flashed and disappeared into eight silver stone pillars.
With a 'boom' sound, the eight pillars exploded, releasing the space power stored within, which merged into the ancient teleportation array.
The entire teleportation array shook violently, and the surging silver light around it immediately became chaotic.
The silver light within the Yin Yang Mother and Child Array Diagram flowed quickly, driven by the array diagram, affecting the turbulent silver light within the ancient teleportation array, rapidly consolidating into a silver light gate several meters high within a few breaths.
But then, the light on the silver gate surged, and a huge silver light pillar burst forth, penetrating the seal of the Void Temple, shooting straight up into the high sky, and merging into the clouds above.
The silver light pillar, like a pillar reaching into the heavens, emitted a tremendous roar, exceptionally eye-catching.
At this moment, nearly everyone on Fusang Island had put down what they were doing to stare at this shocking phenomenon, unsure of what had happened.
Just then, silver spirit light surged beside the pillar once more, condensing into a line of immense text: "This teleportation array leads to the Three Immortals Island; time is limited, take heed!"
Inside the Void Temple, Guoguo dispersed the silver light from around its mouth, its gaze flickering slightly, clearly very satisfied with its own masterpiece.
After completing the task its master had assigned, it leapt up and dove into the silver light gate, disappearing without a trace.
Seeing the huge characters next to the silver light pillar, the entire Fusang Island, along with the surrounding seas, began to seethe.
Anyone from the East Sea knew of the secret realm of the Three Immortals Island, and now a teleportation array leading there had appeared!
"What's going on? Isn't the island master at the Void Temple? Why has it turned out like this? Quickly send someone to check!" In a large building within Fusang City, Xu Fu's complexion turned ashen as he stood up abruptly.
Standing next to him were three Nascent Soul cultivators, seemingly discussing matters. Hearing this, two of the Nascent Soul cultivators hastily rushed out, heading toward the Void Temple.
"Deputy Island Master, should we destroy these huge characters?" asked the remaining Nascent Soul cultivator, a round-faced female cultivator.
"By now, likely everyone in the city has seen these characters. Acting now to destroy them would only make more people believe those words are true!" Xu Fu chided sternly.
The round-faced female cultivator meekly agreed, not daring to speak further.
"Now, immediately mobilize all available forces on the island to the Void Temple. We must block everyone, not letting them get close to the great hall!" Xu Fu quickly regained his composure and instructed sternly.
The round-faced female cultivator acknowledged and swiftly exited.
...
Above the vessels of the Snake-man Clan, Merfolk, and Water Ape Clan outside the city, White Scale Master, Queen Ming Kong, and a burly man from the Water Ape Clan stood in space, looking toward that line of characters.
"The two of you, do you believe these words?" White Scale Master asked, looking toward Queen Ming Kong and the burly man.
"During previous Immortal Fruit Conferences, Wan Tianren would always show his face once or twice, but this time, not only has he not appeared, when we inquired about him, the people of Fusang Island were evasive. Now it seems, Wan Tianren was likely plotting to open the transmission array to the Three Immortals Island. These words are very likely true." Queen Ming Kong said.
"Fellow Daoist Ming Kong's words make sense, but such crucial information would surely be tightly controlled by Fusang Island. How could it leak like this, causing such a shocking phenomenon, unless… there is internal strife on Fusang Island?" White Scale Master speculated.
"Whoever caused it, since it concerns the Three Immortals Island, we cannot sit idly by. Let's go and see!" The burly man could hardly wait and zipped out flying.
White Scale Master, greedy by nature, had long intended to go there and explore, and in talking with Queen Ming Kong and the burly man, was simply encouraging others to go first.
Seeing the burly man take the bait, he secretly rejoiced and immediately followed.
Queen Ming Kong had long seen through White Scale Master's intentions, disdained him in her heart, but after a brief contemplation, she instructed a steward of the Merfolk, and also transformed into a streak of blue light, chasing after them.
Seeing this scene, the Nascent Soul cultivators from other first-class islands, harboring thoughts not dissimilar to those of White Scale Master and the others, also flew toward the source of the silver light pillar.
Inside Fusang City, Nascent Soul cultivators from second-class islands, as well as numerous Loose Cultivators, seeing the characters hanging in mid-air, naturally had their interests piqued.
As the first-class island's Nascent Soul cultivators did not conceal their tracks, others saw this and followed suit.
In no time, numerous cultivators from all directions congregated, rushing toward the Void Temple.
With the secret of the Three Immortals Island ahead, no one heeded Fusang Island's no-fly orders.
In the residence on Red Ganoderma Island, Yan Sijing and Yan Siyun stood in the courtyard, looking toward the sky phenomena.
"The Three Immortals Island has actually emerged. How could it be such a coincidence, happening just as Fellow Daoist Yuan and the others are participating in the trial in the secret realm? Could this be related to them?" Yan Sijing wondered.
"Quite likely. My intuition tells me that this matter is closely related to Fellow Daoist Yuan and Fellow Daoist Xi. Now that they are in the secret realm, we need to figure out a way to inform them of the situation outside." Yan Siyun said.
"How do we notify them? They're in the secret realm, means like communication talismans won't work." Yan Sijing frowned slightly.
"Let's inform Lord Nether Moon God. Fellow Daoist Yuan is the Divine Envoy of the Nether Moon God, and Lord Nether Moon God can definitely contact him. Perhaps Lord Nether Moon God is also paying attention to the situation in the secret realm now." Yan Siyun suggested.
...
In Fusang City, within a secret room of the Golden Feather Auction House, two Nascent Soul cultivators sat opposite each other, drinking tea. One, a tall man in a blue robe with a broad face, was the Qiong Hai Island Master who had previously appeared at the Golden Feather Auction House.
The person opposite him, wearing a jade crown and having a youthful and handsome appearance, was none other than Ancestor Ming Quan of Chang Chun Temple, who had previously pursued Yuan Ming.
"Fellow Daoist Ming Quan, leave this matter to me. Although Qiong Hai Island has only recently emerged, our island has a thriving trade and close relations with the islands of the East Sea. A mere Core Formation Stage cultivator, even if he hides in a mouse hole once he's in the East Sea, I'll be able to find him," Qiong Hai Island Master said confidently with a smile.
"Thank you then, Fellow Daoist Wei. Please notify me immediately once Yuan Ming is found," Ancestor Ming Quan also responded with a smile.

chapters.title: Chapter 541 - 517: Incitement and Chaos
chapters.content:
"Well said, since Fellow Daoist Ming Quan has gifted me with these Ancient Beast Breeding Spirit Pills and Beast Food Pills, how could I not handle matters diligently? Who would have imagined that Fellow Daoist Ming Quan would be so fortunate to have obtained the inheritance of Ten Thousand Beasts Mountain from the Ancient Beast Taming Sect? Where did you discover this?" Qiong Hai Island Master chuckled.
As he spoke these last words, the hand hidden in his sleeve gently rotated a green jade ring, aiming it at Ancestor Ming Quan.
A faint luminous glow emanated from the ring, slowly turning.
"It's quite the coincidence. Over a century ago, as I was traveling deep in the Wu Country's Feiyun Mountain Range, I stumbled upon the ruins of Ten Thousand Beasts Mountain," Ancestor Ming Quan said with a hint of trance, speaking as if he were dreaming.
"Feiyun Mountain Range in Wu Country? Are there others who know of this matter?" Interest flickered in Qiong Hai Island Master's eyes as he pressed on.
"Yes, on that day, White Scale of the Snake-man Clan was with me, and he took half of the inheritance of Ten Thousand Beasts Mountain," Ancestor Ming Quan continued to murmur.
"White Scale Master..." Qiong Hai Island Master's brow furrowed, just about to inquire further when the glow from the ring quickly dimmed and disappeared after a few breaths.
"My Soul Power is still insufficient; I can only activate this Soul Stealing Ring for a few breaths..." Qiong Hai Island Master muttered to himself, pocketing the ring.
"The Beast Food Pills are a secret elixir from Ten Thousand Beasts Mountain. They not only accelerate a demon beast's cultivation but also increase its chances of breakthrough. Fellow Daoist Wei's Sea Flipping Beast has been stuck at the Third-level Peak for nearly a hundred years. With prolonged intake of Beast Food Pills, it should break through in less than ten years," Ancestor Ming Quan's expression gradually returned to normal as he continued, oblivious to the fact that he had just been mentally manipulated.
"Really? If my Sea Flipping Beast could break through, I, Wei, will certainly offer a grand reward," Qiong Hai Island Master happily said.
Just as Ancestor Ming Quan was about to speak, a white light shot in from outside, transforming into a Sound Transmission Talisman fluttering about.
Qiong Hai Island Master's brows slightly furrowed as he grabbed the talisman, his Divine Sense entering it and his expression changing.
"Has something happened on your island? If so, Fellow Daoist Wei, please go ahead and deal with it. Don't worry about me," Ancestor Ming Quan said as he sipped from his teacup.
"Hehe, it's not Qiong Hai Island that has an issue, but rather a situation has arisen on Fusang Island. If Fellow Daoist Ming Quan is free lately, perhaps you could also go take a look," Qiong Hai Island Master stood up and suggested.
Upon hearing this, a flicker of surprise crossed Ancestor Ming Quan's eyes.
The two soon stepped outside and were greeted by a soaring silver column and a row of characters that appeared before their eyes.
"Three Immortals Island has actually emerged!" Ancestor Ming Quan exclaimed, visibly shaken.
"Whether this is true or not remains to be confirmed, but all the Nascent Soul cultivators on the island have gone to the location of the Light Pillar. Since we're free as well, why not join the crowd and see what's happening?" Qiong Hai Island Master proposed.
"Of course, that sounds good," Ancestor Ming Quan agreed, nodding.
The two immediately soared into the sky, quickly arriving at the location of the Light Pillar.
A dense crowd of cultivators gathered here, at least four to five thousand in number. The cultivators from Fusang Island had already surrounded the Void Temple, allowing no one to approach. The leader was Xu Fu.
"Fellow Daoist Xu, what is the meaning of this? With Three Immortals Island emerging, does your Fusang Island intend to monopolize it?" a brawny man from the Water Ape Clan shouted sternly.
"Marshal Hou, fellow daoists, this silver light pillar is merely due to a problem with Fusang Island's Ancient Transmission Array that caused a dispersion of Spiritual Power. As for the appearance of Three Immortals Island, it's entirely fictional. You are all well-informed individuals. Even if Three Immortals Island were to truly emerge, it would definitely be in the Endless Deep Sea. How could the entrance possibly appear at Fusang Island? The characters in the sky were deliberately fabricated to cause discord. I implore you all to discern truth from falsehood and not be deceived," Xu Fu earnestly said with a bow.
His words made many hesitant, seemingly convinced.
"I have some insight into formation arrays. Since it's a problem with Fusang Island's Transmission Array, let me take a look. I might be able to offer some help," a voice rang out, belonging to Yan Xiang of Karma Fire Island.
Cui Yu stood beside him, having recovered but still looking somewhat pale with other cultivators from Karma Fire Island also present.
Karma Fire Island had already been eliminated, and as the person responsible, Yan Xiang was leading his disciples away when this unusual change occurred, prompting them all to fly over.
"The goodwill of Fellow Daoist Yan is noted and appreciated by Fusang Island, but the Transmission Array inside the Void Temple is an Ancient Formation, fundamentally different from modern arrays. I'm afraid Fellow Daoist Yan might not be able to assist," Xu Fu said, shaking his head.
"Since it's an Ancient Formation, I am even more eager to see it. Since this silver light pillar is unrelated to Three Immortals Island, allowing me to have a look should be harmless, right?" Yan Xiang said, his eyes sparkling.
Xu Fu's expression shifted subtly, then returned to calm, as he smiled, "Of course, other daoists might also want to observe. If so, let's select a few representatives to enter with me. However, which few will go, I ask fellow daoists to decide among yourselves."
Upon hearing this, nearby people began discussing amongst themselves.
"Fellow daoists, do not be deceived by Xu Fu. He's intentionally delaying. The cultivators of Fusang Island are inside shutting down the Transmission Array. The chance to enter Three Immortals Island is fleeting—rush in!" a volatile voice suddenly erupted, its source indiscernible.
