At these words, Xu Fu's gaze shifted slightly, and the crowd outside stirred further.
A figure clothed in red shot out from the crowd, a middle-aged man with thin blood-colored lips, heading straight for the doors of the Void Temple.
"It's the Blood Yan Island Master; to think he would act so boldly, directly confronting Fusang Island!" whispers emerged from the crowd.
"How audacious! Who is this madman, arrest him!" Xu Fu thundered in anger.
Not far from his side, a middle-aged man with red hair from Fusang Island leapt into the air. With a single wave of his hand, dozens of blinding flames shot out, instantly forming a giant net of fire that appeared above the head of the Blood Yan Island Master and enveloped him with extraordinary swiftness.
However, two streaks of blood light shot from the back of the Blood Yan Island Master, condensing into two broad blood wings. They fluttered nine times in succession, instantly transforming into a streak of blood-colored lightning, flashing out from the range of the fiery net and disappearing into the grand gate of the Void Temple.
"The Blood Wing Escape Technique of Blood Yan Island, who would have thought that the Blood Yan Island Master had already mastered the Blood Wings Nine Flashes to such an extent!" an exclamation arose from the crowd.
The red-haired middle-aged man, in a rage, immediately pursued.
Xu Fu's expression changed, about to reprimand the man to return and stabilize their formation as that was of the utmost importance.
However, as the Blood Yan Island Master and the red-haired cultivator fled and chased, the extremely tense atmosphere surrounding them immediately exploded. Numerous Nascent Soul cultivators shot out, rushing toward the Void Temple.
Seeing this, Xu Fu and other Nascent Soul cultivators from Fusang Island were greatly alarmed and also flew into the Void Temple.
With Nascent Soul cultivators leading the charge, the rest of the cultivators followed suit, forming a torrent that surged forward, easily breaking through the defensive circle formed by hundreds of Fusang Island cultivators. The cultivators in a frenzied rush were the first to enter the Void Temple.
There were too many people at the entrance of the Void Temple, and it was too crowded to enter. Some impatient cultivators, due to pushing and shoving, broke out in conflicts and started arguing and cursing.
Sudden piercing screams erupted; a young cultivator stumbled out of the crowd, clutched at his neck, and fell down, blood spilling everywhere. He quickly breathed his last.Fоr сhаrасtеr shееts аnd glоssаriеs, visit МV|LЕМРYR.
The nearby crowd instinctively stepped back a few steps, dead silent.
At that moment, several beams of light, origins unknown, flew into the crowd, causing blood to spray and screams to rise.
The crowd erupted into chaos, scattering in all directions. However, magic artifacts and treasures were rapidly brought out, whether for self-defense or to attack enemies. In an instant, the area near the Void Temple was ablaze with dazzling lights. Countless treasures appeared, and the flashing lights were so intense that they hurt the eyes.
Deadly lights shone in every direction, and the group of cultivators was in extreme panic.
Someone shouted loudly, and a magnificent treasure light was brought out.
This action seemed to ignite a powder keg, with countless magic treasures striking out all around, targeting everyone but themselves.
Screams of agony and curses filled the air, and the area around the Void Temple was a scene of blood and violence, with no one knowing the reason for the slaughter. But the urge to kill surged in everyone's heart, and they saw red, slashing at anyone they encountered.
The cultivators who arrived later were shocked to see the melee near the Void Temple and didn't know what had happened.
"This is a scheme by Fusang Island, using Three Immortals Island as bait to incite everyone to slaughter each other!"
"Fellows, Three Immortals Island has already been occupied by those Nascent Soul powers, we can no longer enter, but Fusang City itself hides countless treasures. Since the people of Fusang Island want us all to die here, let's not blame each other for being ruthless, let's break in and loot!"
"Break in and loot!"
A group of people clothed in black emerged from nowhere, wielding magical artifacts and charging toward the buildings near the Void Temple, killing anyone they saw.
Boom! Boom! Boom!
A series of explosions suddenly occurred, and a cluster of nearby buildings burst into flames, igniting one house after another, and the fire spread rapidly.
The situation took a drastic turn for the worse as a large number of unknown cultivators appeared out of nowhere and stormed into various key areas of Fusang Island, killing and looting. In moments, the area was filled with the sounds of fighting, dying screams, and the laughter of those who seized treasures.
Seeing this scene, some bold Loose Cultivators couldn't suppress their greed, used spells to disguise their faces, and joined in the looting.
Loose Cultivators, already the lowest and most unrestrained group in the Cultivation World, could easily turn into red-eyed beasts when massive chaos broke out, tearing down the constraints of order.
Moreover, with Fusang Island's usually aloof attitude, many were envious, jealous, or even hateful. Having the opportunity to bring them down from their high pedestal was something many were eager to partake in!
"Kill!"
"Break in and loot!"
"Storm into Fusang Island, seize Spirit Stones, Magic Treasures, Red Mulberry Immortal Fruits!"
More and more Loose Cultivators turned into robbers, rushing toward various places in Crow Head District.
Soon, some medium and small faction cultivators also couldn't hold back. After disguising their appearances, they too joined the fray, and a greater chaos slowly brewed in Crow Head District, sweeping through everything.
Due to the appearance of Three Immortals Island, several Nascent Soul cultivators from Fusang Island had been dispatched, with Wan Tianren entering Three Immortals Island. Only a few remaining Nascent Soul cultivators, including Xu Fu, had just entered the Void Temple. At that moment, Fusang Island had no Nascent Soul cultivators in charge, only some Core Formation cultivators left.
Facing this sudden, immense chaos, these Core Formation cultivators could not form an effective defense. One by one, the heavily guarded key areas within Crow Head District were breached by the frenzy of cultivators, and everything inside was looted.

chapters.title: Chapter 542 - 518: Escaping from Fusang
chapters.content:
"How could this happen?"
"Where is the Island Master? Where has Deputy Island Master Xu gone?"
The Fusang Island cultivators were extremely frightened, having no idea what had happened.
Inside the Void Temple, Xu Fu and others had learned about the chaos outside through the Communication Talisman and were shocked and pale.
Fusang Island was their foundation, even more important than Three Immortals Island. After a brief discussion, they could not bother to stop others from entering Three Immortals Island and shot outwards.
Above the Void Temple, a figure flickered, and a woman in white appeared out of thin air, her fair jade-like feet lightly touching the top of the Void Temple.
This woman had hair like clouds and skin like creamy jade; her features were so delicate and flawless that they gave an unreal feeling.
"Tsk tsk, Fusang City is really a nice place, but it also has more value in destruction," said the woman in white with a light laugh, lifting her right hand to brush aside the hair blown by the wind.
Her right hand was a snow-white bone hand, devoid of any flesh, and so was the left.
"Venerable, everything is going smoothly as planned, but Xu Fu and the others are about to come out of the Void Temple. If they return to the midst of Fusang Island cultivators and maintain the situation, things may become very tricky," said a shadowy cold-looking young man who appeared behind the woman in white.
"I know." The woman in white flicked her finger and conjured a palm-sized bone cage, dropping it downwards.
A massive bone cage appeared out of thin air, crashing down with a roar, covering the entire Void Temple.
A strange fluctuation emitted from within the bone cage, causing everyone's bones inside the Void Temple to shake uncontrollably, and their bodies also became immobile.
Xu Fu and the other Nascent Soul cultivators were no exception, filled with both alarm and anger.
"Leave this place to me. You go and incite chaos among the people all over Fusang City, and be sure to provoke infighting among the inhabitants! Both Wan Tianren and the Level 5 Golden Crow are absent; the opportunity is rare. Today, we must destroy the lineage of Fusang Island," the woman in white said with a flickering gaze.
"Yes." The shadowy young man responded and vanished in a blink.
"Everything is indeed as Ni Mu predicted; greed truly can make one lose their mind, even those at the Returning to Void Stage are no different," the woman in white looked down, her arms slowly extending and thumbs pressing downwards.
Inside the Void Temple, the trembling of the bones in Xu Fu's left arm suddenly intensified, and no matter how he tried to suppress it through cultivating, it had no effect.
With a "snap" sound, the bone in his left arm broke, a piece of bone attached to flesh pierced through the skin and emerged.
Xu Fu had a horrified expression in his eyes, wanting to scream in pain, but he couldn't make any sound.
Another "crack" sounded, and the flesh on his right leg split open, another bone protruding.
Successive sounds of bones breaking rose, more and more bones emerged from Xu Fu's body, and he quickly turned into a monster covered with bone spikes, his body submerged in blood.
A blue light shot out from Xu Fu's body, in which was a small blue Nascent Soul with a face full of terror, tunneling away.
However, at that moment, a powerful suction force came from above, enveloping Xu Fu's Nascent Soul.
A chilling force seeped in, the Nascent Soul's mana was frozen, utterly powerless, and it flew upwards.
...
Fightings quickly spread to the depths of Fusang City, soon reaching other areas within the city.
In the Right Wing District, within the residence of Red Ganoderma Island.
The people of Red Ganoderma Island had not gone to the silver light pillar and were now gathered together. Yan Siyun, Yan Sijing, and the others from Hundred Pills Square were also present, all with anxious expressions.
No one spoke; it seemed they were waiting for something.
Two streaks of tunneling light flew from the distance, landing in the courtyard and revealing the figures of two Red Ganoderma Island disciples.
"Island Master, we have clarified the situation. For some reason, there is rampant burning, killing, and looting in Crow Head District. Green Brow Sister and I didn't dare to get close; we just watched from afar, and among those looting, some are unidentified black-clothed people as well as loose cultivators and cultivators from small and medium-sized forces on the island," said a slightly plump female cultivator.
"It seems that the higher-ups of Fusang Island have suddenly disappeared, and the cultivators below the Core Formation stage simply can't resist. I'm afraid it won't be long before everything will be looted," said another girl with verdant eyebrows, continuing the conversation.
"How could this be? Who dares to cause trouble on Fusang Island?" Bi Shuirou couldn't believe it.
"The key lies with those unidentified black-clothed cultivators. Moreover, this place is not safe. In not much time, the looting army will come to this location; we must make plans early!" Yan Siyun, pointing to her brow, said.
Having witnessed Yan Siyun's prescience over this period, Bi Shuirou's complexion changed upon hearing this.
"Gather everyone immediately, take the supplies, and leave Fusang Island!" she ordered as she rose to her feet.
Upon hearing her words, the Red Ganoderma Island cultivators immediately got busy.
"Prepare the people from Hundred Pills Square as well, and leave this place," Yan Siyun instructed a Hundred Pills Square cultivator behind her.
The cultivator agreed and hurried away.
Inside the Wuzu District workshop, as shouts from far away reached, the people inside were all terrified, unclear about what had occurred.
However, the news quickly spread: Crow Head District was in total chaos, and someone was looting the wealth of Fusang Island. The workshop's people were shocked and horrified.
Amidst the horror, a bizarre atmosphere spread, and the cultivators walking on the street slowly began to show greedy gleams in their eyes, eyeing the nearby treasure-filled shops.
The shopkeepers' faces turned even uglier, and some began closing their doors, all trying their best to be gentle with their movements, as if afraid of stirring something up.
Just at that moment, an enormous "boom" resounded!
The center of the workshop area, where an elixir shop was located, suddenly exploded, sending a fire column shooting up into the sky, affecting nearby shops, collapsing walls, and scattering a myriad of goods across the ground.
"Rob them..."
The cultivators on the streets had their eyes turn red as they charged towards the nearby shops.
The once bustling and lively workshop area of Fusang City was instantly transformed into a purgatory battlefield, filled with frantic slaughter and looting.Uploadedbythe*)team.
...
While the chaos in Fusang City rapidly fermented, those within the secret realm remained completely oblivious.
On a beach spread with fine white sand, waves surged from the sea, layer upon layer, slapping against Yuan Ming's cheeks.
Stimulated by the sea waves, Yuan Ming, who had been in a deep slumber, suddenly opened his eyes and rose from the sand.
He looked around and realized he was on a lush and verdant island, teeming with plant life.
The light breeze wafting through the environment carried with it an exceptionally rich nature's spiritual energy, far surpassing that of the mainland where the Three Immortals Hall resided.
Simply being there, without even trying to absorb it, he could feel the spiritual energy washing over his pores again and again, bringing him a sense of comfort and relaxation he had never known before.
However, Yuan Ming only allowed himself a brief indulgence before immediately refocusing his attention, looking around him.
Xi Ying, who had just been transmitted with him, was nowhere to be found.
Yuan Ming released his Divine Sense to search the surroundings but couldn't find any trace of Xi Ying.
The Golden Crow Soul that resided within his Divine Sense was still there, but it had become confused, and when he tried to mentally communicate with it, there was no response.
"Could it be that the transmission array sends people to random locations?" Yuan Ming wondered internally.
The Golden Crow Soul being in such a state suggested it had lost connection with Xi Ying, seemingly blocked by some kind of prohibition.
Considering Xi Ying's Divine Skills, self-preservation wasn't an issue, so Yuan Ming wasn't too worried. He looked deeper into the island.
At the farthest distance his gaze could reach, he could indistinctly see three towering peaks standing side by side, each radiating blue, white, and gold lights respectively.
"Could this be the Three Immortals Island? So it's not about three separate islands, but three peaks on one island?" Yuan Ming muttered to himself as he gazed at the mountains.
Just then, he received a message from the first soul within the Stealing Heaven Tripod; Yan Siyun was praying to him.
"Yan Siyun? What could she want?" Yuan Ming's expression shifted as he dove into the sea.
He summoned a silver barrier with the Silver Token, isolating the surroundings, then entered the space of the Stealing Heaven Tripod and sat atop the White Jade Lotus Platform to sense Yan Siyun's prayers.
Yuan Ming's expression changed as his Divine Sense, using Yan Siyun as an anchor point, descended upon Fusang City, taking in everything at a glance.
Fusang City was currently engulfed in warfare. Everywhere, there was burning, killing, and looting. The once prosperous city was now severely damaged and nearly half-destroyed.
Fortunately, Red Ganoderma Island and Yan Siyun's Hundred Pills Square had reacted swiftly, sensing that something was amiss. They had immediately left and were now outside of Fusang City, making their escape from the island.
"Those men in black, they look very much like members of the Dawn Alliance. Could this be the work of the Wu Yue Sect?" Yuan Ming pondered, growing more convinced as he thought about it.
The Wu Yue Sect aspired for world dominance, and overtaking Fusang Island, the leader of the East Sea Islands, would not only showcase the Wu Yue Sect's strength but also severely demoralize the East Sea Immortal Cultivation World, potentially causing other islands in the East Sea to submit.
The old fogeys from Fusang, Jin Ao, Kongling, and Di Hua islands used these people to enter Three Immortals Island, but Wu Yue Sect cut them off from behind. It was a case of stealing chickens only to end up losing the rice.
"Fusang Island has become a place of conflict, and those men in black are likely followers of the Wu Yue Sect. Hurry and leave, head back to Dragon King City!" Yuan Ming instructed.
Upon hearing this, Yan Siyun was greatly shocked and promptly acknowledged with respect, urging their group to hasten their pace.
At that moment, dozens of white shadows shot from the ground below, heading straight for the Hundred Pills Square and Red Ganoderma Island group, swiftly reaching them. They were dozens of white bone arrows as thick as arms, their tips glowing with a faint green light, obviously coated in a potent poison.
Yuan Ming had already sensed the ambush below and took the Thunder God Hammer to make a feigned strike.
In front of Yan Siyun, the void fluctuated, and a fan-shaped thunderbolt shot out, sweeping past the dozens of white bone arrows, knocking them all aside.
Both the Red Ganoderma Island and Hundred Pills Square people were initially shocked but then breathed a sigh of relief, looking at Yan Siyun with admiration.
Yan Siyun too was startled by the sudden appearance of the thunderbolt but soon realized it was Lord Nether Moon God who had taken action, which gave her great peace of mind.
"Thank you so much, Fellow Daoist Yan," said Bi Shuirou through mental communication and then instructed the Red Ganoderma Island members to form a defensive array, while she herself stepped forward, challenging loudly, "Who's lying in ambush here? If you have the gall, show yourselves!"
"Hmph!"
A snort came from below, and a streak of black light revealed five men in black, the leader of whom was a formidable man who had reached the Core Formation Stage.
The other men in black had their faces covered with black veils, concealing their true faces, but the pressure they exuded revealed that they were also of the Core Formation level, albeit their aura seemed quite strange.
Sensing the cultivation level of these men in black, Bi Shuirou's heart sank, silently realizing that something was wrong.

chapters.title: Chapter 543 - 519 Lick The Plate Clean
chapters.content:
"I didn't expect you people to have some insight, actually detecting our presence. Unfortunately, Lord White Bone Venerable has already laid out the Heaven and Earth Net. Today, you will find no escape even if you had wings. Surrender now, and perhaps you can still spare your lives!" the formidable man snorted.
"White Bone Venerable... these men in black are indeed disciples of the Wu Yue Sect," Yuan Ming murmured to himself inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
Ever since he learned from Xu Che about the stand-off between the Wu Yue Sect, Chang Chun Temple, and the Five Thunder Sect in the Black Wind Desert, he had been closely monitoring the situation there.
He had gathered quite a bit of information from Moon Sect followers reluctant to leave, which included that one of the Six Venerables of the Wu Yue Sect, the White Bone Venerable, had arrived at the Black Wind Desert and had become well-known after several interventions.
When Yuan Ming previously rescued Yan Sijing, he chose the pseudonym 'White Bone Scholar' intending to make the White Scale Master believe he was a Soul Cultivator from the Wu Yue Sect. Little did he expect that within a few days, White Bone Venerable would actually come to the East Sea, and might even have reached Fusang Island.
"You don't need to pay attention to these people; just leave," Yuan Ming transmitted to Yan Siyun.
Yan Siyun responded with her Divine Thought and led everyone away directly.
Bi Shuirou didn't understand the intention behind Yan Siyun's action but remembering that this woman always had meticulous strategies, she signaled for the people of Red Ganoderma Island to follow.
"You're seeking death!" The formidable man, furious at being ignored by Yan Siyun and the others, refrained from acting but took out a black token to activate.
The clothes of the four men in black beside him ripped apart, revealing their true faces—they were actually four half-demon cultivators.
These people had dull expressions, but their eyes were filled with a murderous intent, revealing they were four Demon Core cultivators, pouncing towards Yan Siyun and the others.
However, just as the four Demon Core cultivators had flown halfway, they suddenly stopped in their tracks and turned to face the formidable man, their eyes brimming with even more ferocity.
"What are you doing?" The formidable man showed a panic-stricken expression, and was about to activate the token in his hand again when his face suddenly went blank.
The four Demon Core cultivators roared and lunged at the formidable man, with several fierce attacks falling on him.
The formidable man stood rooted to the spot, his body instantly chopped into several sections, dying a gruesome death on the spot.
Immediately after, the four Demon Core cultivators also fell straight down to the ground, lifeless.
The people from the Hundred Pills Square and Red Ganoderma Island hadn't gone far when they witnessed this scene, all shocked, their gazes towards Yan Siyun filled with awe.
The group continued on their way, encountering several ambushes along the path.
To avoid complications, Yuan Ming didn't wait for the attackers to act but directly subdued those people with Illusion Techniques beforehand, enabling the group to quickly leave Fusang Island and board a Flying Boat that vanished into the vast sea.
Yuan Ming withdrew his Divine Sense and left the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space, looking toward the three giant peaks far away, then he summoned Lei Yu and flew straight toward the mountains.
The island was vast in size. Instead of draining his energy searching everywhere for people, it was better to head straight for the most conspicuous spot. Others would likely think the same, and there was a chance he could encounter Xi Ying along the way.
On the sandy beach laid with white sand was a verdant green forest. Ancient trees that had stood for countless ages under the sunlight stretched toward the three giant peaks, spreading like a green carpet welcoming honored guests.
The sunlight overhead reminded Yuan Ming that this was no longer the Secret Realm he had been in before. However, he did not let his guard down.
Legends of the Three Immortals Island had been passed down for thousands of years, yet there was never any detailed intelligence about it. Even though everybody claimed that opportunities were rife here, who could guarantee that behind the opportunities, there weren't heaps of skeletons?
Yuan Ming flew into the jungle, and not long after he advanced, his expression suddenly brightened. He controlled Lei Yu to land beside several stalks of crimson spirit bamboo.
This was Fire Dragon Bamboo, close to a thousand years old, a precious material for refining Fire and Wood Dual Attribute Magical Treasures, commanding a high price on the outside.
Yuan Ming carefully dug out several stalks of the spirit bamboo and stowed them in his Storage Ring.
He didn't continue forward with Lei Yu but instead darted towards the left front, quickly arriving beside a pond.
The pond, only about ten zhang in size, continuously emitted billowing white cold mist, with two white spirit grasses resembling tobacco from the mortal world growing by its side.
"This is Cold Tobacco, excellent material for refining Ice Attribute Elixirs, and judging by its age, it's over a thousand years old. Three Immortals Island truly lives up to its reputation," Hong Ling's voice rang out.
Yuan Ming ignored Hong Ling, gathered the two stalks of Cold Tobacco, and commanded Lei Yu to continue forward.
Time quickly passed, and an hour later, Yuan Ming was still far from the three-colored giant peak.This copy was generated from content at *.
It wasn't that Lei Yu was slow; it was that there were too many spiritual materials in this jungle. Thousand-year-old spiritual grasses, which were incredibly rare on the outside, were quite common here. Occasionally, he would come across one or two, and his hands were starting to feel a bit sore from digging.
The only odd thing was that despite finding countless spiritual grasses and ores, he had not encountered a single demon beast.
Yuan Ming didn't mind; he just focused on driving Lei Yu towards the three mountains.
But suddenly, he frowned, immediately controlling Lei Yu to swerve to the left.
The next instant, a black branch thick enough to be embraced by two people brushed past where Lei Yu had just been.
The attack from the branches fell through and immediately split into four parts mid-air, changing their target, and once again thrust toward Yuan Ming on Lei Yu's back.
At that moment, without Yuan Ming's control, Lei Yu also sensed the danger. It let out a cry, flapped its wings forward, and while dodging backward with Yuan Ming, the thunder patterns on its body also flashed. Two electric arcs as thick as bowls crackled fiercely toward the branches.
However, the brilliant thunder light struck the branches and, although pushing them back, only resulted in a wisp of blue smoke, and failed to disperse them.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming's eyes narrowed. He followed the branches downward and saw a tall Demon Tree in the forest finally shedding its disguise and revealing its massive body. It resembled a banyan tree on the outside, but it was actually a Banyan Demon.
The Banyan Demon was enveloped in a vast demon energy, clearly at the Level 4 stage, and its thick aerial roots pulled out of the ground, flipping soil and revealing heaps of white bones that were the remains of various demon beasts.
"No wonder there are no demon beasts in this place; it looks like this fiend has eaten them all," Yuan Ming murmured to himself.
As the Banyan Demon revealed its Level 4 aura, several banyan roots shot out of the ground like tentacles attacking Yuan Ming.
"Tree Demon! Master, let me at it!" Hua Zhi said excitedly.
Its strength had already reached the peak of third-level, just one step away from the Level 4 realm. If it could absorb this tree, it would certainly break through smoothly.
"Hong Ling, Blood Shadow, leave it to you," Yuan Ming said, choosing not to let Hua Zhi come out. He took out the Shura Blood Devouring Map and released Hong Ling and Blood Shadow.
"Haha, I can absorb Essence Blood again... Wait, a Tree Demon?" Blood Shadow burst out laughing upon appearing, charging forward, but his face fell instantly when he saw his opponent.
Hong Ling's expression didn't change much; she simply raised her hand and blocked all the attacking aerial roots and branches.
Although both of them were at the Nascent Soul stage, their abilities were specialized in attacking Qi-Blood creatures, and were limited in effectiveness against plant demons, especially facing a Level 4 Tree Demon. It wasn't troublesome, but they weren't as relaxed and comfortable as when they dealt with the Blood Crocodile.
However, this Banyan Demon's Divine Skills were more inclined towards Concealment, and its combat strength wasn't particularly formidable. Facing Hong Ling and Blood Shadow's combined efforts, it wasn't getting any upper hand and was quickly entangled, unable to break free.
Upon seeing this, Yuan Ming raised his hand and the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear instantly flew out and positioned itself in front of him. As he cast spell after spell onto the spear, its purple light surged even more intensely.
The Banyan Demon, sensing the presence of the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear, became greatly anxious. Its massive body attempted to sink into the ground.
Hong Ling raised her Binding Immortal Spider Web, directly binding the body of the Banyan Demon to prevent it from escaping underground.
Blood Shadow opened his mouth and sprayed out a beam of Blood Light, which merged into the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear.
With a light shout from Yuan Ming, the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear let out a long whistle, carrying a dragon-like purple light as it pounced on the Level 4 Tree Demon.
The Banyan Demon, unwilling to sit and await its demise, used all its tricks to withdraw all the branches hidden in the canopy, gathering them in front of itself to form a large green shield, attempting to block the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear.
However, could the things on the ground ever match the fallen stars of the canopy? Upon impact, the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear pierced through the branch shield as if it were a meteor falling to earth, boring a hole through it instantly.
The wild blast of air sliced off the branches and leaves of the surrounding trees like razors. Dust shot up to the sky, obscuring the heavens, and lingered for a long time without dispersing.
Lei Yu's back, Yuan Ming slightly motioned with his hand, and the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear immediately flew out from the dust cloud, once again landing in his hand.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, we've helped you out once more. You'll have to find us some Blood Food later," Hong Ling said.
"Of course," Yuan Ming replied indifferently, retracting them into the Shura Blood Devouring Map and then summoning Hua Zhi.
Hua Zhi cheered and plunged like an arrow toward the corpse of the Tree Demon on the ground, merging into it.
Watching Hua Zhi gleefully absorbing the Level 4 Tree Demon, Yuan Ming couldn't help but feel a sense of reflection.
In the future, when killing demon beasts, aside from skinning them and harvesting their Demon Cores, the remaining flesh could be fed to the Shura Blood Devouring Map, while plant demons without Qi-Blood would be consumed by Hua Zhi. Truly not a speck wasted.
As he envisioned future scenarios, his gaze was suddenly drawn to the forest below.
Due to the blast clearing the branches and leaves of nearby trees, the lush forest below appeared bare, but because of this, Yuan Ming suddenly noticed that the color of the soil on the ground was not uniform.
"Could this be a Formation?"
Yuan Ming observed closely for a moment, and to his surprise, he discovered that the light-colored soil dispersed among the trees, like strands of silk matching certain trees as nodes, formed a massively large Eight Trigrams Formation. However, it seemed inactive, lacking any Spiritual Power.
At the place of the Formation's Life Gate, which also happened to be where the Level 4 Tree Demon was growing, was Yang Ming's destination.
Yuan Ming asked Lei Yu to descend. He followed the vein of the Formation to the position of the Life Gate, where there was only an ordinary-looking large tree, apparently not over a hundred years old and with nothing seemingly special about it.
But when Yuan Ming extended his Divine Sense, he found that the tree was disguised as Golden Iron, with only a layer of bark on the outside and disguise runes on the inner side of the bark. Within the Golden Iron, there was a rune formation that seemed to be waiting to be activated.

chapters.title: Chapter 544 - 520: Xi Ying's Handiwork
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming didn't rush to activate the runes atop the golden iron. Instead, he waited for Hua Zhi to finish devouring the Tree Demon before taking it back into the Spiritual Beast Bag.
The aura of Hua Zhi surged, and numerous vines grew out, wrapping around its body, quickly forming a giant vine ball.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming knew that Hua Zhi was beginning to break through. If successful, he would have another Nascent Soul level combatant by his side.
After withdrawing his Divine Sense from the Spiritual Beast Bag, he took out the Thunder God Hammer and held it in his hand before slowly feeding Spiritual Power into the iron tree.
The next instant, Yuan Ming's figure disappeared, and then he appeared in a large underground hall.
The walls and ceiling were made of dark grey stone bricks. Luminous Pearls embedded in the cracks provided a bit of light to this fairly spacious area.
But compared to this firefly-like light, another pale green Spirit Light Shield was even more eye-catching.
Like an eggshell, the shield occupied half of the hall. Within the shield, two figures stood face to face. One had a refined appearance and was holding a compass, seemingly making calculations, while the other was clad in a red robe, with a resolute face but a somewhat sullen look between his brows.
"Oh, lucky me. Someone else has arrived," the refined man said as he glanced at Yuan Ming with the corner of his eye, stopping his calculations and turning around to wave at Yuan Ming with a smile.
The man in the red robe also noticed Yuan Ming's arrival, frowning slightly.
Yuan Ming wasn't surprised by his reaction. After all, the man was Yan Xiang, a Nascent Soul cultivator from Karma Fire Island. Considering Yuan Ming had defeated Cui Yu, pushing Karma Fire Island out of the top sixteen, it would be strange for Yan Xiang to look pleased to see him.
As for the refined man, Yuan Ming had also seen him at the Immortal Fruit Conference on Red Rain Island, though he didn't know his name.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, your timing is impeccable. I am Lei He of Red Rain Island, and this is Yan Xiang of Karma Fire Island, whom I believe you've already recognized. We're trapped in this Daoist Formation, worried about how to get out. Do you think you could help us break this formation?" asked the refined man in a friendly and unhurried manner.
"So it's Senior Lei He and Senior Yan Xiang. May I ask how the two of you got here?" Yuan Ming said as he bowed with his hands clasped.
Based on the information he currently had, the Nascent Soul cultivators from Fusang, Jin Ao, Kongling, and Di Hua might have already entered Three Immortals Island. Lei He and Yan Xiang, however, should not be here. Could it be that the Fusang Island Master was so magnanimous as to bring other First-class Island Nascent Soul cultivators from the Eastern Sea as well?
When he previously investigated the situation in Fusang City inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod, he indeed did not find any Nascent Soul cultivators from the Eastern Sea Islands within the city, no wonder the Wuyue Sect could capture Fusang City so easily.
"Oh, Fellow Daoist Yan Xiang and I were passing by and happened upon this place which had Array Maps inscribed. Captivated by curiosity, I studied them and found the Life Gate. Then, by activating the iron tree with Spiritual Power, we arrived here, accidentally triggering the mechanism and getting trapped," Lei He explained with a sigh.
"Senior, you misunderstand. I was asking how you came to be on Three Immortals Island. The Transmission Array leading here is within the Secret Realm, which you two cannot use. Is there some upheaval outside the Secret Realm?" Yuan Ming shook his head, continuing his inquiry.
Lei He nodded slightly, his expression still calm, "It is indeed a strange tale. We were all staying on Fusang Island, waiting for you to emerge from the Secret Realm. Unexpectedly, a Silver Light Gate appeared on the island, and an inscription on the rock wall beside it stated that the gate led to Three Immortals Island. Naturally, we wanted to explore."
Hearing this, Yuan Ming began to understand something.
Previously, Xi Ying had tampered with the Transmission Array in the Three Immortals Hall. Yuan Ming didn't know what Xi Ying had done, but the Silver Light Gate mentioned by Lei He was most likely Xi Ying's doing.
But what was Xi Ying's intention? Allowing numerous Nascent Soul cultivators to enter Three Immortals Island would only exacerbate the chaos and struggle there. How could that benefit her?
"With so many Nascent Soul cultivators entering Three Immortals Island, it greatly benefits the actions of the Wuyue Sect. Could it be that Xi Ying is collaborating with them this time?" Yuan Ming mused to himself, feeling increasingly unable to see through Xi Ying.
"So, Fellow Daoist, do you have any more questions, or can you help us with this Formation now?" Lei He asked, seeing Yuan Ming lost in thought.
Yuan Ming snapped out of his reverie, examined the pale green Spirit Light Shield for a moment, and then bowed to them, "I fear I must disappoint Seniors. My abilities are limited. If both of you cannot break the formation, how could I possibly resolve it? But according to Senior Lei He, there should still be many seniors on the island. I will go and find one to help free you two."
With that, Yuan Ming quickly stepped back.
He had just probed the underground hall with the Divine Sense of his first soul and discovered a Transmission Array hidden at the entrance—possibly the way out of this place.
Seeing this, Lei He sighed and was about to explain when Yan Xiang stopped him.
"Fellow Daoist Lei He, it's clear he doesn't want to let us out. Why demean ourselves by begging? But his point is not wrong. If I weren't trapped by this formation, I would indeed like to test the abilities of this dark horse who has unexpectedly entered the top sixteen," Yan Xiang chuckled, his tone laced with chill.
"Fellow Daoist Yan Xiang, we both witnessed Fellow Daoist Yuan's arena battle against Cui Yu; Yuan Ming won fair and square without resorting to any underhanded trickery. Why harbor anger over this matter? Besides, with even greater opportunities now before us, what significance does the ranking of the Immortal Fruit Conference hold?" Lei He advised.
Yan Xiang's face remained cold, and it was unclear whether he took Lei He's words to heart.
Yuan Ming paid no attention to them and reached the hall entrance. He took out the Thunder God Hammer and fired a silver thunderbolt as thick as a bowl at the nearby wall.
"Boom"
The wall was blown open, leaving a hole about a foot in diameter.
Lei He and Yan Xiang showed surprised expressions at this scene.
The pale-green protective shield did not restrict Divine Sense. They had been trapped here for a while and had already used their Divine Sense to thoroughly explore the entire stone chamber, finding nothing unusual behind this wall. Yet this Core Formation Stage cultivator had detected it in one glance!
Yuan Ming continuously operated the Thunder God Hammer, quickly enlarging the hole to about three feet high and stepped inside.
Inside was a secret room with an Array laid out on the ground. The Spirit Stones embedded within had turned grayish-white and transparent, clearly indicating the Spiritual Power within had long been depleted, with dust covering the Array.
Yuan Ming replaced all the Spirit Stones in the Array and cast a spell.
Bright white light illuminated the Array as it began to hum and rotate.
A gleam of joy appeared in his eyes as he was about to maximize the activation of the Array when suddenly the white light died down, and the Array stopped moving.
Yuan Ming's brows furrowed, and he knelt down to examine the Array closely.
"It seems the Array has not been used for many years and has malfunctioned. There's no need to worry, Yuan. Fellow Daoist Yan Xiang is proficient in Arrays. Once we get out, he'll surely be able to fix it," said Lei He, having seen this, spoke again.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming's expression shifted, and he took out the Silver Token and opened the silver barrier.
Lei He was taken aback, not understanding the significance of Yuan Ming's actions.
He activated his Divine Sense to probe, but the silver barrier was as solid as a rock; even with his strength in Divine Sense, he could not penetrate it.
"What is that Silver Token? How can it open such a barrier? This young man's background is unfathomable," Lei He thought to himself.
Yan Xiang's gaze also flickered slightly, his thoughts unknown.
Within the silver barrier, fearing it might not block a Nascent Soul cultivator's probing, Yuan Ming set up several layers of restrictions around himself to block detection before entering the space of the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
A moment later, the silver barrier collapsed with a bang, and Yuan Ming stepped out, bowing and saying, "It's not that I'm unwilling, but if the two Nascent Soul seniors are helpless against this green protective shield, how could I, a mere Core Formation Stage cultivator, have the power or ability to rescue you both?"
"Yuan, we've seen your strength. Don't underestimate yourself. Besides, this green protective shield is actually a trapping Array; it prevents escape from within but not from without. We are helpless inside, but you on the outside, just need to attack the Array at its weak spots with a Magic Treasure, and you can break it," Lei He, not bothering to ask what Yuan Ming had done inside the silver barrier, said with a smile.
"A trapping Array? I see," Yuan Ming nodded, his gaze turning to Yan Xiang.
* (*) appreciates your readership at the source.
"You can rest assured, Yuan. What Fellow Daoist Yan Xiang said just now was merely jesting. Isn't that right, Fellow Daoist Yan Xiang?" Lei He quickly said, while giving Yan Xiang a meaningful look.
"What I said earlier was ill-considered, please forgive me, Yuan," Yan Xiang's eyebrows twitched and, after a few breaths, he managed to force out.
"If Yuan is still unsure, I, Lei, am willing to swear by my Heart Demon. After we break the Array, if Fellow Daoist Yan Xiang makes a move against you, I, Lei, would rather perish on this Three Immortals Island than fail to protect you fully," Lei He solemnly swore.
With Senior Lei having put it this way, how could Yuan Ming continue to decline? He chuckled and took out the Thunder God Hammer.
He just entered the Stealing Heaven Tripod and contacted Yan Siyun to inquire about Lei He's information. Learning that Lei He was the Island Master of Red Rain Island and the respected master Qiong Yun, known for being amiable and upright without a bad reputation, he decided to help.
"May I ask the seniors, should I just attack the Array, or is there something more?" Yuan Ming asked.
"Exactly, exactly, you just need to attack the Kan and Li nodes," Lei He said joyfully, pointing to two positions on the green protective shield.
Yuan Ming then channeled Mana into the Thunder God Hammer, and in an instant, two bolts of thunder appeared out of thin air, striking the two spots Lei He had pointed out.
A burnt smell instantly spread, and the Spirit Light Shield flickered but returned to stability.
Yuan Ming's brow furrowed as he infused his full Mana into the Thunder God Hammer, firing off two even larger bolts of Silver Thunder at the green protective shield. The shield shook violently but still didn't break.
"The Power of Thunder and Lightning contained in your treasure is extraordinary, but it seems you are not adept at using it. The power is dispersed rather than condensed, which is why it's not very effective. I happen to have a Gathering Thunder Skill that could enhance the hammer's power, which you might want to review—it could increase its potency," Lei He's voice sounded in Yuan Ming's ears, soon after a secret technique appeared in his Sea of Consciousness.
Seeing no results from the Thunder God Hammer, and just as he was about to try the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear, Lei He unexpectedly imparted to him a Secret Technique. Yuan Ming immediately began to study it.
The Gathering Thunder Skill wasn't complicated; it was a Secret Technique to condense the Power of Thunder and Lightning.
As Yuan Ming practiced the technique, the Silver Thunder inside the Thunder God Hammer began to gather toward the center. Soon it had condensed by almost half, the silver electrical arcs on the hammer's body mostly disappearing, but the air of thunderous destruction it emitted grew much stronger.
It was his first practice of the technique, and condensing the Power of Thunder and Lightning to this degree was already his limit. He pointed into the air.
Two much finer bolts of Silver Thunder shot out again, striking the two nodes on the green protective shield.
A sound of cracking rang out, holes were blasted through the green protective shield.
The massive shield collapsed with a bang, turning into countless green streamers that scattered and soon disappeared without a trace.

chapters.title: Chapter 545 - 521: Gu Poison Dagger
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming withdrew his gaze and looked at the Thunder God Hammer in his hand, his eyes showing delight.
The effect of the Gathering Thunder Skill was unexpectedly good, he had only just started to practice it and yet had already enhanced the attack power of the Thunder God Hammer by about thirty to forty percent. If he could fully master this skill, the power of the Thunder God Hammer would likely increase significantly.
In fact, although Thunder Attribute Techniques are powerful, the power of thunder and lightning is erratic and unstable, easily dissipating and leading to losses of concentrated power. The Gathering Thunder Skill cleverly reduces the loss of power during casting and focuses the scattered energy in one place, achieving the effect of doubling the result for half the effort.
Lei He and Yan Xiang walked out of the Formation, and putting aside the excited Lei He for now, even Yan Xiang flashed a hint of relaxation in his eyes.
"Yuan, this time we really owe you—Yan Xiang, what are you doing!" Lei He turned to Yuan Ming, about to offer some praise, but suddenly noticed that Yan Xiang beside him had slightly raised his right hand, sending a black light shooting straight towards Yuan Ming.
Anger appeared on Lei He's face as he slapped out a Purple Thunder in an attempt to intercept the black light, but he was a bit too late.
Yuan Ming, who was already on his guard, did not need his help. With a raise of the Thunder God Hammer in his hand, a streak of Silver Thunder appeared out of nowhere, striking precisely upon the black light.
To everyone's surprise, there was just a crisp "snap" sound as the black light, hit by the Silver Thunder, wavered before dropping to the ground, revealing its true form—a black dagger.
Yuan Ming frowned slightly. As a Nascent Soul cultivator, even a covert strike from Yan Xiang shouldn't have been so feeble.
"What's the matter, you all thought that I, Yan Xiang, was the kind of despicable person who would turn his back after receiving a favor?" Yan Xiang's mouth curved into a cold smile.
"I wouldn't dare assume so, may I ask about the meaning behind Fellow Daoist Yan Xiang's actions?" Yuan Ming asked indifferently.
Yan Xiang did not answer Yuan Ming, instead, he turned his head to Lei He, "Lei He, today I will give you this face. On Three Immortals Island, I will let go of the matter of the tournament. But once we're off Three Immortals Island, if you still try to stop me, don't blame me for not recognizing you anymore."
Lei He gave a bitter smile, "Fellow Daoist Yan Xiang, why do you have to do this?"
"No need for more words. Throughout the many sessions of the Immortal Fruit Conference, it's the first time that an island of the first class has dropped out of the top sixteen. If I don't regain this face, I will not be able to explain to everyone on Karma Fire Island!" Yan Xiang said, then turned his gaze to Yuan Ming, "Boy, your Divine Soul Power is extremely strong, no less than that of a Nascent Soul existence. Now that you have learned the Gathering Thunder Skill from Red Rain Island, combined with that hammer and the Thunder Wing Bird, your combat power is already comparable to that of a Nascent Soul cultivator. Once we leave Three Immortals Island, I will give you thirty minutes. Whether you seek help or flee for your life, I will not interfere. But after thirty minutes, I will personally take action to claim your life."
"If Fellow Daoist Yan Xiang insists on pursuing the matter of the tournament, then I shall accompany you to the end," Yuan Ming said calmly, without showing annoyance.
"What courage! Since Lei He taught you the Gathering Thunder Skill, I will not be petty. That black dagger, consider it a reward for helping me escape from the trap. It was originally a treasure placed here, not made by me. If you're worried, Lei He can also bear witness. If not, just leave it here," Yan Xiang said with a flip of his hand, directly walking past Yuan Ming and entering the secret room to check the Teleportation Array.
"Yan Xiang wasn't lying, this thing is indeed a chance hidden here. Based on my estimation, it is likely left by predecessors as a reward for finding this place and was originally placed in the center of the Great Array. When we removed this item, the Array was triggered. Indeed, Yan Xiang didn't leave any traps on it, so you can keep it with confidence," Lei He picked up the dagger from the ground, examined it with his Divine Sense, and then handed the dagger over.
Yuan Ming took the black dagger and probed with his Divine Sense, a hint of surprise crossing his face.
The black dagger turned out to be a Poisonous Dagger, containing fearsome poison that could easily corrode and dissolve his mana.
Yuan Ming hurriedly increased his mana and integrated the power of the Cold Moon Ring to barely resist the poisonous erosion of the dagger.
What shocked him was that the poison on the black dagger was almost as potent as One Rihong.
Moreover, the nature of the poison on the dagger kept changing.
Having spent a long time learning from Hua Zhi, who was skilled at identifying poisons, and Purple Extreme Tai Sui, which could fuse thousands of potent poisons, Yuan Ming had an ever-growing understanding of poisons.
The poison on the black dagger would sometimes be Wood Attribute poison, sometimes lean towards Earth Attribute, and then change to Fire Poison, truly baffling him.
It was a pity Hua Zhi was in a breakthrough, or else it could have been asked to identify the poison on the black dagger.
"Be careful, the poison on this dagger is fierce. Even Nascent Soul cultivators like us would be in big trouble if infected. Don't touch it directly," Lei He warned.
"Fellow Daoist Lei He is experienced and knowledgeable, do you know the origin of this poison? I have seen many potent poisons, but never one that changes attributes continuously like this," Yuan Ming asked.
"Oh, you are able to discern the depth of this poison, good eyesight. Indeed, this is not a common poison on the black dagger, but a Gu Poison," Lei He said with a hint of surprise in his eyes.
"Gu Poison?" Yuan Ming was taken aback.
"It's not surprising you don't know. Gu Poison is a secret concoction of the Southern Border Five Immortals Sect. It is extracted from several types of severe poison from gu worms and then cultivated with the secret techniques of the Five Immortals Sect. Gu Poison is a fusion of many poisons; hence it has multiple attributes and is very difficult to resist. Once infected by Gu Poison, it is also hard to cure," Lei He explained in detail, with the intention of befriending Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming's heart stirred. This Gu Poison was quite similar to his Purple Extreme Tai Sui.
"Fellow Daoist has profound knowledge of poisons, which I admire. I have heard that the Snake-man Clan is also skilled in using poison, with their most powerful poison called One Rihong. In terms of poisons, who is stronger, the Snake-man Clan or the Five Immortals Sect?" he took the opportunity to ask.
"It's hard to compare. In the research of poisons, the Snake-man Clan and the Five Immortals Sect have taken two extremes. The One Rihong of the Snake-man Clan is a Water Attribute poison; it takes the variability of Water Attribute poisons to the extreme. However, the Gu Poison of the Five Immortals Sect is the fusion of multiple poisons; the more types of poison integrated, the stronger the power of the Gu Poison," Lei He explained.
Yuan Ming understood that the Snake-man Clan specialized in one type of poison, while the Five Immortals Sect sought broader mastery.
"Thank you for the guidance, senior," he expressed his gratitude. After a moment of contemplation, he tossed the black dagger into the Spiritual Beast Bag of the Purple Extreme Tai Sui.
The Purple Extreme Tai Sui sensed the Gu Poison on the black dagger. It writhed over, its body splitting open to reveal a mouth-like opening, and swallowed the dagger whole.
A patch of black toxin appeared on the Purple Extreme Tai Sui's body, rapidly spreading outwards.
A purple light emanated from the surface of the Purple Extreme Tai Sui, enveloping the black toxin. The spread of the toxin dramatically slowed, but it still crept outward.
Yuan Ming's eyebrows lifted slightly. The Gu Poison was indeed comparable to the potent One Rihong; even the Purple Extreme Tai Sui struggled to neutralize it immediately.
However, the Purple Extreme Tai Sui was reputed to assimilate all poisons, so given more time, it likely wouldn't have any issue neutralizing this Gu Poison.
"Yuan, Fellow Daoist Yan Xiang is just that kind of person; you shouldn't worry too much. Once we're out of the Three Immortals Island, I'll call on the Golden Transformation Daoist, and together we'll talk to Yan Xiang. He won't really try to hurt you," Lei He spoke up, seeing Yuan Ming remaining silent, trying to offer some consolation.
Yuan Ming nodded, though, in reality, he didn't take Yan Xiang's threat to heart.
As they conversed, Yan Xiang had already discovered the problem with the Transmission Array and began fixing it.
"Speaking of which, there was a Level 4 Tree Demon guarding outside. Yan Xiang and I relied on Concealment techniques to get past without alerting it. How did you manage to avoid that Tree Demon?" Lei He struck up a conversation with Yuan Ming, seemingly to break an awkward silence.
Yuan Ming looked up, blinking with a blank expression, "Wasn't that Tree Demon killed by the two seniors?"
"What? The Tree Demon has already perished?" Lei He's eyes widened slightly.
"Yes, I came across the corpse of a Tree Demon in the forest above and stopped to investigate. That's when I was transported here by triggering a forbidden mechanism," Yuan Ming explained.
"Oh, is that so..." Lei He furrowed his brow.Part of a series hosted by * (MV&LEMP&YR).
The issue with the Teleportation Array was minor, and Yan Xiang quickly fixed it.
The three of them stood on the Array, and after a flash of white light, they left the underground hall and returned to the forest.
Lei He soared up and headed to where the Hua Zhi had devoured the Banyan Demon.
The Banyan Demon's corpse had been mostly consumed by the Hua Zhi, leaving only some remnants.
Lei He glanced over it and then looked aside, noting the impact of the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear's earth-shattering strike.
On the ground, a pit several zhang in size and fathomless lay conspicuously open—a chunk seemingly gouged out of the forest floor.
The trees, their branches sheared off by the blast wave, stood desolately without a single leaf falling from them. The scenery stretched far and wide; from above, it was shockingly vivid.
"Which Fellow Daoist performed this technique?" Yan Xiang flew over and was taken aback by the scene.
Lei He didn't answer but turned to look at Yuan Ming, who was slowly ascending into the sky.
"I don't know either. This was the scene when I came over earlier; I thought it was the work of the two seniors," Yuan Ming maintained his bewildered look.
Yan Xiang's gaze flickered momentarily, as if he believed Yuan Ming's words, then turned away, "Perhaps it was the deed of some passing Nascent Soul Daoist. It seems we are quite behind; someone has already raced ahead of us. We shouldn't linger here any longer. Let's quickly head towards those three peaks."
Lei He nodded, and after one more look at the devastated forest, he took out a palm-sized Flying Boat and tossed it forward. The boat expanded against the wind, soon returning to its original size.
Seeing this, Yan Xiang directly boarded the Flying Boat, while Lei He turned his head and called out:
"Yuan, come on up."
Yuan Ming hesitated briefly before flying onto the boat as well.
Since many from Fusang Island had arrived at the Three Immortals Island, he couldn't afford to continue at his leisurely pace.
Moreover, with Lei He and another present, if they encountered another Level 4 Demon Beast, he wouldn't have to risk facing it alone.
Lei He took his place at the helm, pinched a spell, and the Flying Boat instantly accelerated, racing towards the mountains at an exceptionally fast rate, second only to Lei Yu at full speed.

chapters.title: Chapter 546 - 522: Dragon Tooth Crystal
chapters.content:
The expanse of this forest was unexpectedly vast, Yuan Ming and his two companions flew for half a day before they finally traversed it and arrived before a massive lake.
The journey had been peculiarly smooth, probably because two Nascent Soul cultivators were present, and though they didn't encounter any demon beasts blocking their path, neither did they come across any other cultivators who had come to the Three Immortals Island.
This fact secretly worried Lei He and Yan Xiang, but Yuan Ming appeared calm and composed throughout the journey.
The lake before them stretched boundlessly, with a faint mist covering the tranquil surface, showing not a single ripple.
In the distance, at the center of the lake, one could vaguely see three intersecting islands, which, when viewed from the lakeshore, resembled cone-shaped mountains carved by human hands.
These were parts of the same mountains Yuan Ming had seen earlier on the beach.
The closest to Yuan Ming and the others was a mountain of a golden hue that rippled with circle after circle of sun-like waves, dazzling to the eye.
At the bow of the Flying Boat, Yan Xiang and Lei He stood side by side, gazing at the golden mountain.
"The mountain shines like gold, radiant as the sun, it cannot be mistaken, this is the Golden Sunflower Immortal Island!" Yan Xiang said, unable to hide the excitement in his eyes.
"Three Immortals Island, Three Immortals Island, I originally thought it was three islands in the sea, but it turned out to be three islands in the lake. Even if the area is extensive, it probably isn't as vast as Fusang Island, nor does it have the extraordinary spectacle of the Fusang Divine Tree visible for thousands of miles. Does it truly deserve the name of an Immortal Island?" Lei He murmured to himself, shaking his head slightly.
"Well, what of it? After all, Three Immortals Island is known throughout the world, not because of its size, but because it is an Immortal's Dojo, home to countless opportunities. It doesn't matter if they are merely three lake islands, even a mound of earth inhabited by an Immortal can be called an Immortal Mountain," Yan Xiang retorted, his eyes blazing with fervor as he cast aside his previous indifference.
"Fellow Daoist Yan Xiang has a point," Lei He said noncommittally.
He looked back at Yuan Ming briefly before continuing to cast spells to drive the Flying Boat, speeding towards the three central islands through the mist above the lake.
However, shortly after the boat entered the lake, a sudden gust of wind swept in, catching Lei He off guard. The Flying Boat he was controlling shook violently under the assault of the wild wind.
At the same time, the sky darkened instantly, as clouds from nowhere blocked the sun. On the lake's surface, the howling wind whipped up murky clouds into a tornado that stretched to the sky, rushing towards the Flying Boat.
From a distance, the boat rocked violently, nearly being lifted by the tornado.
Lei He's face paled as he immediately began casting spells, struggling to stabilize the boat.
Yan Xiang flung his sleeve, and a green Feather Fan flew out, fanning towards the five tornadoes.
In an instant, a vast expanse of green wind rolled out like sea waves, charging towards the tornado in an attempt to block the fierce winds.
Understandingly, Lei He hastily maneuvered the Flying Boat to the side.
However, as the green wind approached the tornado, it was as if it was being pulled in, easily engulfed and swallowed by the tornado, disappearing in the blink of an eye.
The tornado swept in, lifting the Flying Boat and hurling it towards the center of the vortex.
"Not good! This tornado is too powerful; we cannot withstand it, retreat quickly!" Yan Xiang shouted.
No need for his reminder, Lei He had already seen the situation on the lake, and his hands moved quickly to change the spell.
Dragon-shaped bolts of lightning surged from the boat, tearing through the surrounding wind and retreating towards the shore.
Fortunately, the three had just entered the lake, and the Flying Boat quickly returned to the shore.
The moment the trio returned to the lakeshore, all the wind and tornadoes on the lake disappeared, along with the clouds in the sky, as if they had never appeared.
"It seems that the tornado was a restriction set over the lake to prevent anyone from approaching the Immortal Mountain," Lei He took a deep breath, slowly speaking.
"Perhaps it is a trial, since it is an Immortal Mountain, naturally it will not allow us to approach casually," Yuan Ming added.
"Yuan makes sense, but according to your view, how should we pass this trial?" Yan Xiang looked over.
"With two seniors present, how could I, a mere Core Formation cultivator, dare to show off? I completely defer to both of you to make decisions," Yuan Ming replied with a smile.
"In that case, please Yuan, try entering the lake," Yan Xiang said coldly, not mincing his words.
At this, Yuan Ming raised an eyebrow.
"Ahem, Fellow Daoist Yan Xiang, none of us have figured out the exact nature of the lake's restrictions yet, and Yuan is just a Core Formation cultivator. It really might be too dangerous for him to fly in alone," Lei He coughed, trying to persuade him.
"Yuan is no ordinary Core Formation cultivator, his strength is not less than ours. We have both already made our move earlier, and entering now would only result in the same outcome as before. If this tornado really is a trial, it might react differently to Yuan," Yan Xiang said with a light laugh.
"Well..." Lei He faltered, his eyes showing hesitation.
"Fellow Daoist Yan Xiang makes sense, let me give it a try. But if I encounter any danger, I will return immediately, please don't blame me," Yuan Ming said with a brisk smile.
"Of course," Yan Xiang replied indifferently.
Yuan Ming looked towards the lake, not responding further.
Although Yan Xiang had concealed it very well, Yuan's Emotion Manipulation Ability penetrated everywhere, and he still sensed the faint murderous intent constantly rippling in the other's heart.
Lei He seemed apologetic, taking a talisman from his Storage Bag and handing it to Yuan Ming, "We came in a hurry this time and didn't bring much. Here's a Golden Body Protection Talisman. Once activated, it can block a full-force attack from a Nascent Soul cultivator. Just take it."
Yuan Ming accepted the talisman and earnestly thanked, then took a deep breath and flew toward the lake surface.
As soon as he had crossed the lakeshore, the sky darkened instantly again. However, this time, although the wild winds churned on the lake, they did not form a tornado, and the force of the winds was considerably less than before.
Even so, when the ferocious wind struck his face, Yuan Ming still felt as if he were being scraped by knives. Simultaneously, a tremendous force continually pushed his body, driving him toward the shore.
He boosted his Mana to seventy percent, only then maintaining the Protective Spiritual Light around his body, barely isolating the wind as he flew towards Immortal Island.
On the lakeshore, Lei He and another person saw the scene over the lake and both showed delight.
The gusts Yuan Ming faced were strong, but they were far weaker compared to the unstoppable, towering tornado they had faced just moments prior.
"It seems Fellow Daoist Yan Xiang guessed correctly. The Gale Restriction displays different strengths when facing different people," Lei He thoughtfully said.
"Not only that, but the power of that wind pillar was overwhelming, probably because all three of us were on one boat, causing the wind's force to stack. In my opinion, it's better for us to proceed separately from now on," Yan Xiang murmured, looking down as he spoke.
"Indeed, let's also make our move," Lei He said.Thelatestchaptersarealwaysavailablefirston*.
But Yan Xiang did not move. Gazing at the struggling figure of Yuan Ming, his eyes flickered and he said, "Yuan has just started and hasn't gone far. We might as well wait until he gets deeper in; there might be other changes."
Upon hearing this, Lei He did not speak, tacitly agreeing with Yan Xiang's suggestion.
Under the watchful eyes of the two men, Yuan Ming struggled onward and quickly flew more than a dozen miles.
At that moment, the void ahead fluctuated, and a palm-sized, crescent-shaped white crystal appeared out of nowhere, exuding an enticing scent.
Despite the turbulent winds around, the white crystal remained unaffected, hanging silently in the air.
"What is this?" Yuan Ming was astonished, but he did not miss the opportunity and waved his sleeve to send a green light sweeping over it.
"That is..." When Yan Xiang saw the white crystal, his eyes immediately brightened, and he hastily plunged into the lake.
Lei He's eyes also lit up, and he steered his tunneling light to catch up, maintaining a distance of several dozen yards between them.
As soon as the two had crossed the lakeshore, they too felt a gust of wind far stronger than what Yuan Ming had encountered, but it was still within their endurance.
Realizing their speculation was correct, they felt greatly reassured and continued their tough journey toward Immortal Mountain against the wind.
The three of them moved forward against the violent wind. Lei He and Yan Xiang, being Nascent Soul cultivators, faced stronger winds than Yuan Ming, but their speed was still significantly faster.
Thus, after the time it takes two sticks of incense to burn, they almost caught up with Yuan Ming simultaneously.
Just then, the void to their left flashed with white light again, and another white crystal appeared.
Red light surged around Yan Xiang's body, and his speed suddenly doubled as he raced toward the white crystal.
Although Lei He transformed into a Purple Thunder trying to snatch it, he was still a step too slow, and the white crystal was grabbed first by Yan Xiang.
As the distance between the two men narrowed to ten yards, a slightly smaller tornado column than before spontaneously appeared, lunging towards them.
Yan Xiang and Lei He were startled and quickly scattered.
However, the tornado column split into two and struck their Protective Spiritual Light.
"Bang," "bang," two loud noises erupted!
Yan Xiang and Lei He were blown away, flying backward a hundred yards before finally stabilizing their forms. Blood dripped from the corners of their mouths, clearly injured by the wind column.
Yan Xiang, unconcerned, flipped his hand to store the white crystal and continued flying forward.
A trace of annoyance crossed Lei He's face, obviously unable to forget the white crystal.
Ignoring his injuries, his body's Lei Guang surged, and he immediately continued forward.
"Senior Lei He, what is this white crystal?" Seeing the two men risking danger to snatch the white crystal, Yuan Ming sent a sound transmission to Lei He.
"Yuan, don't you recognize Dragon Tooth Crystal? It's no wonder, it hasn't appeared for nearly a thousand years," Lei He transmitted back.
"Dragon Tooth Crystal? What is that?" Yuan Ming asked.
"No one knows the exact origin of Dragon Tooth Crystal. It is said to be a substance formed from the condensed dragon Qi after the fall of an Ancient Divine Dragon. This material has little use for cultivators like us but is excellent for feeding spirit beasts. For spirit beasts like snakes or flood dragons, it even has miraculous effects on enhancing Bloodline Power," Lei He quickly explained.
Even as he spoke, he transformed into a Lei Guang and hurriedly chased Yan Xiang.
Yuan Ming's eyes brightened, then dimmed again.
The Dragon Tooth Crystal seemed to be a reward from the Gale Restriction, randomly appearing ahead. His speed was nowhere near Lei He's and Yan Xiang's, so it seemed he would not be able to obtain any.
Still, this was an unexpected fortune. Fortunately, he had managed to secure one already.

chapters.title: Chapter 547 - 523: First Arrival on Immortal Island
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming gazed at the increasingly distant figures of Yan Xiang and Lei He, took a deep breath, and took out two high-grade Wood Attribute Spirit Stones to replenish his Mana as he continued forward.
After about an hour, Yan Xiang and Lei He had flown far ahead, visible only as two indistinct black dots.
The prohibitive barrier above the lake did not affect Divine Sense, so though Yuan Ming was slower in tunneling speed compared to Yan Xiang and Lei He, he was still clear about the situation ahead.
In the past hour, two Dragon Tooth Crystals appeared ahead, with Yan Xiang and Lei He each snatching one. No more appeared afterwards.
Yuan Ming felt unwilling in his heart, but he kept pushing his Mana forward without stopping; the replenishment from the Spirit Stones was simply not fast enough. He was now showing signs of weariness, and the distance to Yan Xiang and Lei He was growing larger, let alone vying for Dragon Tooth Crystals.
His concentration divided, the protective shield around his body began to tremble, and an inadvertent gust of wind swept from the side, pushing him back several yards.
Yuan Ming quickly stabilized his mind and barely managed to stop his body, struggling to maintain the protective shield.
He wiped the sweat from his forehead and looked again at the still distant Immortal Island, sighing inwardly.
His ability to contend with Nascent Soul cultivators relied on the sharpness of his Soul Cultivation Divine Power and Magic Treasures, but against the relentless towering winds, his Soul Cultivation Divine Power and those few Magic Treasures were useless, and the gap in Mana between him and Nascent Soul cultivators was undeniably exposed.
At this rate, solely relying on his own Mana, he might not be able to cross this lake.
Yuan Ming came to a halt and simply stopped to ponder a strategy.
Considering the situation when he approached Yan Xiang and Lei He earlier, summoning Lei Yu would only increase the wind force.
The only plan for now was to rely on himself, in other words, he had to think of a way using a Magic Treasure.
Only his Magic Treasures were earmarked for combat, which offered little effect against this natural disaster.
Yuan Ming's eyes suddenly brightened, and with a pat on his Storage Bag, he took out a green round orb.
"I had almost forgotten about this Wind Stabilizing Pearl after putting it aside for so long," he said with a smile, pouring his Mana into the pearl.
In a flash, rings of green light rippled out, covering an area of several yards around him, weakening the oncoming fierce wind by ninety percent.
The remaining ten percent of the wind pressure was no longer a concern for him.
"The Wind Stabilizing Pearl really is useful!" Yuan Ming exclaimed joyfully, flying forward.
At that moment, however, his body suddenly paused, and a thought emerged in his heart, "Could this Wind Stabilizing Pearl from the Six Desires Venerable have been meant specifically for use here?"
He immediately shook his head to dispel this somewhat absurd thought and accelerated his speed toward the Immortal Mountain.
Thirty minutes later, Yan Xiang and Lei He, who were struggling to move forward in the wind, simultaneously turned their heads in disbelief to look at Yuan Ming, who seemed to be strolling leisurely through the wind.
"In my earlier years, I was fortunate enough to acquire a Magic Treasure that provides wind resistance. I just remembered it. If the two venerables have something similar, it should also greatly reduce the pressure," Yuan Ming bade them cheerfully with a cupped fist salute, then continued to fly ahead, easily widening the not-so-short distance from Yan Xiang and Lei He.
Just at that moment, a flash of white light ahead revealed another Dragon Tooth Crystal.
Yuan Ming's tunneling light intensified, and he doubled his speed in an instant, capturing the Dragon Tooth Crystal into his bag.
Yan Xiang and Lei He intended to snatch it, but Yuan Ming had already secured the crystal.
A flash of helplessness crossed Lei He's face, while Yan Xiang clenched his fist in secret, a flash of coldness in his eyes.
Reader support at * made this translation possible.
However, soon Yan Xiang took a deep breath, adjusted his mood, and flew toward the left front, widening the distance from Yuan Ming in hopes that a Dragon Tooth Crystal would appear there as well.
The golden summit seemed so close ahead and became increasingly clear, yet the distance was far greater than any of the three had imagined; regardless of how they flew, there was no sense of getting closer—it felt very much like a fool's errand.
Fortunately, aside from the fierce wind, there seemed to be no other danger over this lake.
Clenching their teeth, the three of them persevered and finally reached the golden summit on the third day.
Yuan Ming was the first to set foot on the golden lake heart island. The moment he left the lake surface, he felt that the spiritual energy of heaven and earth in the void around him was much richer, and the Mana he had just exhausted seemed to surge back to fullness.
He sat down cross-legged to practice Breathing Control, and after a while, his Mana was fully recovered, returning to the state he was in three days before.
In that short period of time, Yan Xiang and Lei He also set foot on the Immortal Island, sensing the primordial Qi around them. Their gloomy and weary faces brightened slightly.
In these three days, Yuan Ming, relying on the Wind Stabilizing Pearl, had gathered most of the Dragon Tooth Crystals into his bag, and even though Yan Xiang and Lei He spread out, their harvest was still scanty.
After all, they did not possess a treasure like the Wind Stabilizing Pearl and could only blame their bad luck.
Of course, this was also because Yuan Ming, although at the Core Formation Stage, already possessed the power to battle those at the Nascent Soul Stage and could protect himself even if not victorious. Given the current situation, Yan Xiang and Lei He would not dare to fall out rashly because of various entanglements, otherwise, how could Yuan Ming dare to snatch the treasures right from under their noses.
Yan Xiang and Lei He collected their emotions and turned their gaze to a large stele not far away.
The stele was inscribed with four flamboyant golden characters - "Golden Sunflower Immortal Island."
"It really is Golden Sunflower Immortal Island." Yan Xiang and Lei He showed a hint of a smile on their faces. After a brief breathing control, they headed toward the stele.
Yuan Ming had already reached the stele ahead of them. Before they could get close, he stepped over the stele.
As Yuan Ming stepped over the stele, he immediately felt as though he'd passed through an invisible curtain. The scenery before his eyes dramatically brightened. The original vista had vanished, replaced by a world bathed in gleaming gold.
Right in front of him lay a mountain forest. As far as the eye could see, trees and plants were all a golden yellow color. It seemed as if a layer of gold juice had been poured over the leaves of all the trees, reflecting a metallic luster that made Yuan Ming instinctively raise his hand to shield his eyes.
Accompanying the dazzling golden light was a wave of intense heat, as if he'd suddenly returned to the volcanic area where the Earth Core Fire Lotus was located.
Wisps of vapor evaporated from every pore on Yuan Ming's body. His throat began to itch, and even the air he exhaled from his nostrils seemed particularly scorching.
He looked up to the sky and saw three enormous incandescent fireballs hanging above, arranged in a line, continuously emitting scorching brilliant light.
"There are actually three suns here..." Lei He's lips also felt dry from the heat, prompting him to speak out.
After speaking, he took out a round jade pendant and hung it around his waist.
As mana flowed into it, the round jade pendant began to ripple with blue waves, akin to water, transforming into a clear light that enveloped him completely.
Yuan Ming also produced a piece of blue jade belt magic treasure, forming a blue protective shield around himself.
This blue waist belt, taken from the Qingtong Storage Bag, was of high grade and had some fire resistance and cooling effects.
"I've never seen such an abundance of spiritual power before, it's truly invigorating." Yan Xiang spoke with ease, not bothered by the intense heat.
The spiritual power on Golden Sunflower Immortal Island was indeed bountiful, surpassing even that of Fusang Island, except here the balance of nature's spiritual energy was severely skewed. Other types of spirit qi were thin, with only the Fire Attribute Spirit Qi being excessively dense.
Being a cultivator of fire techniques, Yan Xiang felt especially invigorated in this place, enjoying the sensation immensely.
Yuan Ming ignored him and turned to glance behind him. He could still see the lake outside, which seemed to be not entirely blocked off, so he took a step toward the outside.
However, the foot he lifted collided with an invisible light screen, stopping him in his tracks.
Lei He glanced over, stepped forward, and touched the invisible light screen with his hand, then said, "There's a barrier. It seems to be one-way; we can come in but not go out."
Yuan Ming lifted a fist and directed his mana at the invisible light screen.
With a "bang," a muffled sound echoed.
Where his fist collided with empty space, a layer of golden ripples spread, and a pale golden light screen emerged, rising hundreds of feet upward, with no end in sight.
Yuan Ming slowly retracted his fist, now roughly understanding the situation. The barrier was exceptionally sturdy, not something brute force could shatter. At least, he couldn't manage it.
"Who would have thought that Yuan not only possesses remarkable divine skills but also cultivates his physical body," Lei He said, evidently surprised.
"Years ago, I happened upon a body refining technique by chance, and I cultivated it rashly, hardly reaching any height of sophistication. This barrier is extraordinarily tough. It was easy for us to enter, but it seems difficult to leave. Do either of you have a method to break through?" Yuan Ming spoke casually, deftly steering the topic back to the barrier.
"Considering retreat as soon as we enter, isn't Yuan being overly cautious? Instead of thinking about that, we should explore ahead. There might also be a way out further on," Yan Xiang said indifferently, his words laced with sarcasm.
