"Senior Yan Xiang is right. With that said, let's move forward," Yuan replied, not taking offense.
Yan Xiang cast a glance at Yuan Ming, then turned and strode toward the front.
"Fellow Daoist Yan Xiang, since the three of us entered together, it's natural to stick together. We are all ignorant of this place, and traveling together can provide mutual assistance, preventing situations like before where we were trapped in an array and unable to escape," Lei He caught up with him, with Yuan Ming following in step.
Without stopping or objecting, Yan Xiang seemed to agree with Lei He's suggestion.
Thus, the three of them walked deeper into the island in silence, the conditions on the island unknown. They chose to walk on foot rather than flying.
After walking for about an hour, the three finally emerged from the golden wood. However, a gentle slope not far ahead rose to reveal a vast peach forest with fiery red colors.
Yuan Ming looked up at the sky, where the three blazing suns hung high, each like a fiercely burning white orb. The surrounding temperature seemed to rise even more, and despite the blue belt's protection, he felt uncomfortably warm.
Yuan Ming quickly withdrew his gaze and looked toward the fiery red peach forest ahead.
This peach forest was immense, extending in both directions with no end in sight, seemingly much more vast than the golden woods.
The distribution of the peach forest appeared methodical, as if it hadn't grown naturally.
Having encountered too many strange things on the way, they dared not be careless and thus stood still in front of the peach forest, not daring to step into the woods immediately.

chapters.title: Chapter 548 - 524: The Mysterious Peach Forest
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming stood at the edge of the forest, his gaze swept back and forth through the peach forest, and while doing so, he released his Divine Sense into the forest to explore, his face suddenly showing a look of surprise.
Just as he released his Divine Sense into the peach forest, this thread of Divine Sense rapidly dissipated. He then tried to use his Divine Sense in another direction, but it was still the same, completely unable to form an effective probe.
"This peach forest indeed contains its mysteries; I have seen many Divine Sense barriers, but this kind of barrier, which scatters the Divine Sense, is the first I have encountered," Yuan Ming thought to himself.
While considering his options, he controlled the first soul within the Stealing Heaven Tripod, sitting upon the White Jade Lotus Platform, and extended his Divine Sense for exploration.
The barrier within the peach forest naturally couldn't block the exploration of the first soul; however, the first soul's Soul Power was limited, and it could at most explore a range of twenty to thirty miles, unable to glimpse the full extent of the peach forest.
While Yuan Ming was continually attempting exploration, not far from him, Lei He and Yan Xiang stood still, faces also very solemn, clearly having also noticed the anomaly within the peach forest.
"Such a strange peach forest, could it be another trial?" Lei He pondered aloud.
Yan Xiang did not speak, but waved his hand over his Spiritual Beast Bag. Immediately, a ray of red light flew out from his waist and lightly landed on the ground, transforming into a fiery red Fire Mink with bright fur.
Upon landing, the creature immediately circled around Yan Xiang, then made "squeak squeak" noises, obviously very fond of the environment of the Golden Sunflower Immortal Island.
"Go," Yan Xiang commanded.
The Fire Mink spirit beast immediately began pulling its fiery red tail, turning into a red streak of light, and quickly entered the red peach forest.
"My Fire Mink is more intelligent and sensitive than ordinary cultivators; any danger it detects will be communicated to me through our connection of minds. With it scouting ahead, you can rest assured..." Before he could finish saying the word "assured," Yan Xiang's expression abruptly changed, and his unfinished sentence was cut off.
"What's wrong, Fellow Daoist Yan Xiang?" Lei He asked hesitantly.
After calling out twice, Yan Xiang finally snapped back to reality, his expression slightly stiff as he said, "The connection of minds has been severed, I can't sense the Fire Mink anymore."
Hearing this, Lei He and Yuan Ming exchanged glances.
Neither of them had any intention of mocking Yan Xiang; instead, a look of seriousness passed through their eyes.
"It seems this peach forest is no benevolent place, it would be best if we detoured around it," Lei He suggested with a frown after a moment of silence.
Yuan Ming thought for a moment, then nodded in agreement.
Yan Xiang seemed reluctant to leave his Fire Mink behind but after a moment's hesitation, he chose to take the detour.
The three of them chose a direction and began to bypass the side of the peach forest.
They walked for nearly two hours but still hadn't reached the edge of the peach forest.Visit * (*) for more.
Walking like this, it was unclear when they would reach the end, so Yuan Ming decided to fly up, intending to fly directly over it.
But then a bizarre spectacle occurred.
As soon as he began to fly up, the peach forest in front of him grew taller in tandem, blocking his way no matter how high he flew.
"Ah, it seems detouring won't work," Yuan Ming said as he landed, shaking his head.
"Why do you say that?" Yan Xiang inquired.
Yuan Ming shared with the others what he experienced after trying to fly over.
"Let me try," Lei He said as he patted his Spiritual Beast Bag, and two Golden Eyebrow Swallows flew out.
With a wave of his hand, the two Golden Eyebrow Swallows immediately flapped their wings and flew at high speed toward the peach forest above.
Just as they entered the airspace above the peach forest, the trees below suddenly stretched upwards at a visibly fast pace, growing significantly taller in a short time.
One of the Golden Eyebrow Swallows, caught unprepared, was obscured by the surging branches and quickly vanished from sight.
The other swallow shot straight up into the sky.
As it continued to rise, the branches of the peach forest extended incessantly, showing no sign of stopping.
Just as the Golden Eyebrow Swallow was about to fly higher, it seemed to have been attacked by something, suddenly changing direction and hastily flying back toward them.
It almost crashed into Lei He's palm, looking extremely disheveled.
Yuan Ming and the others quickly looked over, only to see that the back of the Golden Eyebrow Swallow was scorched black, as if it had suffered serious burns. Had it not turned back in time, it probably would not have been able to return.
"It seems flying too high is also not an option; the higher you go, the hotter it becomes, and even spirit beasts cannot endure," Yuan Ming said, glancing skyward and narrowing his eyes.
"Since we can't fly over it, let's try tunneling under it," Yan Xiang said, with furrowed brows.
"The Fire Attribute Spiritual Power beneath the ground is even denser than in the air; tunneling here is extremely challenging unless one is particularly adept at the Earth Tunneling Technique, otherwise the only outcome is being burnt to death underground," Yuan Ming replied slowly, shaking his head.
"It seems our only option is to pass through the peach forest," Lei He said with a sigh after healing the Golden Eyebrow Swallow's wounds and putting it away.
"It seems that's all we can do, this place is likely, just as Fellow Daoist Lei He previously said, another test for us," Yuan Ming commented.
With no other option available, the three of them briefly conferred and then reluctantly proceeded to walk into the peach forest.
As soon as they entered the Peach Forest, the three of them found that the reason the trees appeared to be a reddish color from afar was not only because the peach blossoms were in full bloom, but also because the tree trunks themselves were an unusual, glowing red.
The Fire Attribute Spiritual Power in the forest was even more abundant, causing Fellow Daoist Yan Xiang to let out an exclamation of surprise after stepping into it.
"There's something odd about this forest. We'd better spread out like we did when crossing the lake, but of course, not too far apart. It's enough that we can support each other," Fellow Daoist Lei He suggested.
Yuan Ming and Fellow Daoist Yan Xiang also had this in mind and expressed their agreement.
So the three spread out in a "品" shape: Yan Xiang at the front, Yuan Ming, and Lei He to the left and right behind, forming a triangle of support, ready to aid each other at a moment's notice.
In the beginning, nothing unusual was found within the initial distance of about thirty feet.
But after walking for some time, Yuan Ming suddenly noticed that Yan Xiang, who was leading the way, disappeared suddenly after walking around a peach tree.
"Stop right there," Yuan Ming commanded loudly.
"What's wrong?" Lei He asked in surprise when he heard the shout.
"Yan Xiang is gone," said Yuan Ming immediately.
"He was just... Eh, where did he go?" Lei He's voice suddenly rose.
The surroundings fell into silence.
"Who is missing?" At this moment, however, a voice suddenly rang out.
Yet, upon hearing this voice, the look of bewilderment in Yuan Ming's eyes intensified.
There was no doubt that the voice belonged to Yan Xiang, but the direction it came from was behind and to the right of Yuan Ming.
"Yan Xiang? How did you get over there?" Lei He also noticed something was wrong and asked in astonishment.
Yan Xiang's voice came from behind again, "What happened to you two? How did you get in front of me?"
"The Peach Forest is strange. Both of you come over here and regroup with me," Yuan Ming shouted loudly.
"Alright." Replies from the other two quickly followed.
When Yuan Ming turned to look in Lei He's direction, he was still within sight.
However, while Lei He was on his way, the Peach Forest in front of Yuan Ming fluctuated slightly, and then Lei He, who had just been visible, suddenly disappeared.
"Fellow Daoist Lei He?" Yuan Ming called out.
But this time, there was no response.
When he turned again to look over his right shoulder, he could no longer see Yan Xiang; it was as if he had vanished into thin air, and no matter how Yuan Ming called out, there was no answer.
The area fell into silence, the only sound was the rustling of the breeze through the trees. It seemed as if Yuan Ming was suddenly the only one left in the entire Peach Forest.
A chill went through Yuan Ming's heart, and he quickly made the first soul in the Stealing Heaven Tripod sit on the White Jade Lotus Platform, extending his Divine Sense to cover a twenty-to-thirty mile radius.
However, within the range of his exploration, he found no trace of Yan Xiang or Lei He.
"In just a dozen breaths, could they have already gone beyond a twenty-to-thirty mile radius? Could there be some kind of teleportation matrix or trap here that escapes the naked eye? Or perhaps..." Yuan Ming frowned in thought.
He didn't rush to withdraw his Divine Sense, instead observing quietly for a moment longer.
And in doing so, he indeed discovered some clues.
Within the range of his Divine Sense, the Peach Trees which looked motionless seemed to be moving, changing positions without a trace.
This movement was extremely subtle, without the slightest sound, and the Peach Trees were similar enough to each other that without the perspective of his first soul, he would hardly have noticed.
"It appears there is indeed some kind of teleportation forbidden mechanism in this Peach Forest, no wonder Lei He and Fellow Daoist Yan Xiang vanished in an instant," Yuan Ming pondered.
Now that he had discovered the secret of the Peach Forest, passing through this place seemed to become less difficult.
Looking up at the three suns hanging in the sky, which were directly above the giant peak, Yuan Ming quickly discerned his direction, then used the Ghost Shadow Escape Technique and flew towards the Golden Sunflower Immortal Island.
He had not gone far before his vision blurred slightly, and he found himself in a strange Peach Forest.
"Eh, have I been moved as well?" Yuan Ming murmured, but he wasn't overly concerned.
This Peach Forest couldn't possibly be infinite. No matter where he was teleported, if he kept heading in the right direction, he would eventually find a way out. He estimated that this challenge shouldn't be too difficult to overcome.
But when Yuan Ming looked up, his expression suddenly froze.
The three suns that had been in the sky were now on his right, and the Golden Sunflower Giant Peak appeared on his left.
"How can this be? They were together just now; could the suns and the Golden Sunflower Giant Peak have also shifted positions?" Yuan Ming blinked, his mind struggling to grasp the possibility.
"No, I mustn't jump to conclusions. The giant peak and the sun shouldn't move randomly. It's more likely that there's something wrong with my eyes. The three suns and the Golden Sunflower Giant Peak hang in a place my Divine Sense can't reach, but I can be sure that they are real, not illusions," Yuan Ming quickly regained his composure, piecing together the various clues and information he had, and began to organize his thoughts.

chapters.title: Chapter 549 - 525 Fire Peach
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming pondered over countermeasures while also halting his movement.
His previous thought process had been correct, as long as he could find a way to determine the right direction, no matter how the Peach Forest changed, he would be able to find a way out.
He had initially thought he could use the sun in the sky to determine the direction, but now it seemed he had oversimplified the challenge.
However, given the unpredictable changes in the Peach Forest, even if the sun truly existed, there was no guarantee that its current position wasn't an illusion. What other methods could he use to discern the direction?
Yuan Ming thought for a long while and took out a compass, a common magic artifact in the Cultivation World that could sense the stars in the sky and determine direction.
The blue compass needle spun ceaselessly, unable to stabilize at all.
Yuan Ming was not surprised by this, and he put away the compass and continued to ponder.
"Right, how could I have forgotten this method!" A moment later, he slapped his thigh sharply, his Divine Sense merging into the mark on his arm, sensing the convergence of the Desire Power in the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
He was in a secret realm, possibly impeded by a Forbidden barrier; the Desire Power collected by the Stealing Heaven Tripod was less than half of what it was outside.
However, as long as there was some Desire Power, it would be enough.
Yuan Ming sensed the strongest surge of Desire Power and took its transmitted direction as a benchmark to move forward.
He wasn't certain if this direction was correct, but as he was completely clueless for now, he decided to treat this desperate attempt as a viable remedy.
The Peach Forest couldn't be infinitely large. By walking in one direction, even if the path deviated or even looped back, he would eventually find his way out, which was better than just wandering around in the same spot.
Time passed little by little, quickly marking an hour.
Yuan Ming moved swiftly within the Peach Forest, which began to change more drastically around him, and he found himself being teleported more frequently.
However, Yuan Ming, who had already seen through the underpinnings of the Peach Forest, remained calm and composed, ignoring the changes in the surrounding environment, steadfastly advancing by relying on the Desire Power to judge direction, even allowing a smile to slip onto his face.
Since the Peach Forest's barriers tried so hard to hinder his progress, it appeared that the direction he was heading in wasn't severely off.
Yuan Ming utilized the Ghost Shadow Escape Technique to its limits, transforming into a black ghostly shadow.
At that moment, a peach tree ahead suddenly came to life; its trunk elongated several times over in the wind and lashed out at him.
"Not deceived, so you resort to this tactic?" Yuan Ming sneered slightly, his wrist twisting as a flash of light appeared in his palm, and the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear appeared in his hand, which he thrust forward.
A brilliant purple light erupted from the tip of the spear, unleashing the power of the stars that instantly shredded the peach tree ahead, sending wood chips flying and blasting a large hole in the ground.
Yuan Ming continued forward, with peach tree branches occasionally striking towards him. However, they were all in vain in front of the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear. After all, the restrictions of the Peach Forest were meant to bewilder, not to excel in offense or defense.
Soon another hour had passed.
Yuan Ming stopped walking, his breath heavy, his face already soaked with sweat.
He had solved the issue of the Peach Forest's illusions, but a new problem had emerged.
Just then, the three suns in the sky had turned into four, and the surrounding temperature had abruptly risen, making it much hotter. Although he allotted some of his mana to protect his body, he still struggled to withstand the increasing heat.
Yuan Ming licked his dry lips and couldn't help but look up. Four massive incandescent fireballs hung in the sky, constantly emitting scorching heat.
The surrounding Peach Forest, under the scorching heat of the four fireballs, showed no signs of wilting; instead, it appeared even more vibrant. The green leaves accentuated the peach blossoms, which bloomed even more brightly on the branches like numerous small suns, clustering around Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming's brow furrowed, his expression turning increasingly grave.
Not only had the temperature risen, but the Fire Attribute Spirit Qi in the nearby void had also become denser, adding to the scorching aura.
Under such high temperatures, Yuan Ming's sweat was quickly evaporated, his skin becoming more dry and painful. The protective shield formed by his blue belt was barely holding.
With no other choice, Yuan Ming had to channel mana into the Cold Moon Ring on his finger. An instant layer of frost spread from the Cold Moon Ring, melding into the protective shield around him.
The Cold Moon Ring, a Frost Attribute imitation Spiritual Treasure, was far superior to the blue belt in resisting heat. It enveloped Yuan Ming like a layer of cool coat, relieving him from the burning dehydration.
With the protection of the Cold Moon Shield, the burning dehydrating sensation immediately subsided, allowing Yuan Ming to breathe a sigh of relief, though it also sped up his consumption of mana.
He switched to a High-grade Spirit Stone in his hand and reevaluated his position before continuing full force.
About an hour later, Yuan Ming slowed his pace.
Continuous use of the Cold Moon Ring and Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear, along with the Ghost Shadow Escape Technique, his Mid-stage Core Formation mana was becoming too thin and was nearly depleted, so he had to slow down.
While absorbing mana from the Spirit Stone, he also constantly took out elixirs to restore his mana, ensuring his internal Spiritual Power barely kept up with the consumption. However, as the surrounding temperature climbed even higher, the rate of mana loss began to exceed replenishment.
Yuan Ming had to adjust again, stopping the use of the Ghost Shadow Escape Technique altogether and switching to walking. Faced with attacks from peach trees, he primarily dodged, minimizing the use of the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear to conserve mana.
However, no matter how much Yuan Ming tried to conserve, his Mana was uncontrollably depleting and quickly running out.
Yuan Ming, helpless, stopped in his tracks.
The scorching environment before him wasn't without solutions; as long as he entered the space within the Stealing Heaven Tripod, no matter how hot it was outside, he would remain unharmed.
However, the Peach Forest was full of prohibitions, and he did not know if anyone was watching; he dared not take out the Stealing Heaven Tripod recklessly.
"Forget it, now is not the time to economize," Yuan Ming muttered to himself, flipping his hand to take out a green lotus seed, which was the Spiritual Lotus Seed he had picked within the Shura Palace Yin Capital City, known for its remarkable effects in rapidly restoring Mana.
He swallowed the lotus seed, and a warm flow spread throughout his body, restoring most of his dried-up Mana in a few breaths.
"Back when I was in the Yin Capital City, a single lotus seed could restore all my Mana. It seems that as my Cultivation has improved, the restorative effects of the lotus seeds have weakened," Yuan Ming thought to himself, but he did not mind and continued on.
Before long, the temperature in the Peach Forest climbed once again to a terrifying degree. Even with the protection of the Cold Moon Shield, Yuan Ming still felt a dryness in his mouth and tongue.
He stopped, looking up at the sky once more.
Indeed, as he had feared earlier, four suns were not the limit of this space because another incandescent Fireball had appeared, hanging alongside the other four.
Needless to say, these five might not be the limit either; a sixth and a seventh could appear afterward...The genuine article resides on M|V|L&EMPYR.
One thing was certain: if the limit was reached and Yuan Ming had not yet escaped from this Peach Forest, his troubles would greatly increase.
Yuan Ming had no choice but to increase the Mana infused into the Cold Moon Ring, enhancing the power of the Cold Moon Shield, and continue moving forward.
Time passed bit by bit, and soon more than an hour had passed.
Yuan Ming once again used the Ghost Shadow Escape Technique and moved quickly forward, his face looking extremely grim.
The high temperature within the Peach Forest had reached an unbelievable level. The Cold Moon Ring's consumption of Mana was greater and greater, forcing him to consume over a dozen lotus seeds, and still, there was no sign of an end ahead.
These lotus seeds, capable of rapidly restoring Mana, were life-saving items in critical moments. He had been reluctant to use them since obtaining them in Yin Capital City, but now he had used more than half in just this brief period.
Yuan Ming continued to hurry along tirelessly, his mind constantly weighing options, considering whether to awaken Hua Zhi or to release the two from the Shura Blood Devouring Map to help find a way out.
In the midst of his tangled thoughts, he suddenly smelled a strange fragrance and immediately opened his eyes.
At that moment, he witnessed a scene that astonished him.
He saw the nearby peach trees continuously absorbing the sun's heat. The peach blossoms blooming in the sunlight began to fall, creating a shower of petals, which, the moment they touched the ground, spontaneously ignited and vanished.
Beneath the blooming buds, the bare fruits grew quickly at a visible rate into bright red peaches, the source of that strange fragrance.
The peach tree above Yuan Ming bore heavy fruit, some so large that they bent the branches down in front of him, seemingly inviting him to taste them.
Yuan Ming's first thought was to keep his distance from these unusual peaches.
However, overpowering curiosity made him unable to resist picking one to examine closely.
The peach looked, even felt, no different to a normal peach, but it emitted strong fluctuations of Spiritual Power; it appeared not only harmless but more like a Spirit Fruit nurtured by nature itself.
The rich fragrance even carried a hint of sweetness. Just the smell of it made his mouth water, especially under the scorching sun, and it was difficult to resist its allure.
Yuan Ming swallowed his saliva, but did not rashly eat it, looking towards the Spiritual Beast Bag where Purple Extreme Tai Sui was kept.
Purple Extreme Tai Sui could devour all poisons, likely possessing the ability to detect toxins, so he needed its verification before he could be at ease with the Red Peach.
With a probe of Divine Sense into the Spiritual Beast Bag where Purple Extreme Tai Sui was, Yuan Ming's expression changed slightly.
Purple Extreme Tai Sui's body had grown nearly half as big, but half of its body had turned black, contrastingly opposing its other half's normal purple color.
"Could it be that Purple Extreme Tai Sui has not yet refined those Gu toxins?" Yuan Ming was quite surprised internally.
Purple Extreme Tai Sui had previously suppressed the spread of the Gu toxins; how could it have not refined them after so much time had passed?
He activated his Divine Sense to inspect closely, and soon found the reason. The nature's spiritual energy inside the Spiritual Beast Bag had been depleted, and though Purple Extreme Tai Sui's body had swollen nearly half in size, its aura was extremely weak, and the purple spirit light it emitted felt lifeless.
"So the Spiritual Energy has run out." Yuan Ming hurriedly took out several High-grade Spirit Stones and threw them inside.
Purple Extreme Tai Sui writhed its body and devoured the Spirit Stones, its purple light immediately blossomed, quickly overpowering the black toxins.
After a moment's hesitation, Yuan Ming also threw the Red Spirit Peach he held into the bag.
Purple Extreme Tai Sui did not refuse the newcomer, swallowing the Red Peach in one gulp. Before long, its purple light brightened slightly, and the speed at which the black toxins dissipated seemed to quicken as well.

chapters.title: Chapter 550 - 526 Leaving the Forest
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming saw this and hurriedly communicated with the Purple Extreme Tai Sui using his Divine Sense, attempting to inquire its opinion on devouring the Red Spirit Peach.
With his current Divine Soul Power, as well as a series of Soul Cultivation Divine Powers including Soul Search and Emotion Manipulation, he could communicate and inquire even with beings like Tai Sui that lie between animals and plants.
The spiritual intelligence of the Purple Extreme Tai Sui seemed very low, and it took a good while before it slowly replied with one word: non-toxic.
Yuan Ming had been waiting for this response, his mana once again nearing depletion; upon hearing this, he immediately bit into one.
"Crack..."
The crisp texture and the sweet taste instantly brightened Yuan Ming's eyes.
The sweet juice slid down his throat and into his stomach, where a rich surge of Spiritual Energy instantly circulated in his body, transforming into strands of mana flowing into his Dantian.
This peach contained a rich Spiritual Power, quite similar to lotus seeds, a magical fruit for replenishing mana.
An ancient saying goes: where there is extreme harm, a remedy can be found within seven steps.
Perhaps the Fire Spirit Peach is the "antidote" for this inescapable Peach Forest, providing a means to survive as long as one could endure until the peach trees flower and bear fruit.
Yuan Ming swallowed the peach in two or three bites, and to his surprise, he found that this peach had no pit.
At the same time, his mana was rapidly recovering.
The Spiritual Power contained in the Fire Spirit Peaches was far inferior to that of lotus seeds; Yuan Ming's mana had only recovered by a small amount.
He picked another ripe Spiritual Peach and swallowed it in a few bites.
After eating three peaches, Yuan Ming's mana was fully restored.
Just as he was pleasantly surprised, a strange itching suddenly spread through his arm, making him unable to resist the urge to scratch.
But before Yuan Ming could move his hand, the intensely itchy spot also developed a sharp pain.
Yuan Ming quickly rolled up his sleeve and looked, only to discover a lumpy, uneven, reddish sore had formed on the exterior side of his forearm.
There was a slight depression in the middle, with a trace of blood visible, clearly a poison sore.
Feeling the burning sting and intense itch from the sore, and glancing at the bright peach in his hand, Yuan Ming immediately understood the situation.
"Although this Spiritual Peach is rich in Spiritual Power, it mainly contains the Fire Attribute. The fiery poison is intense and accumulates heavily, making it difficult to endure," Yuan Ming sighed and tossed the peach in his hand to the ground.
Even though he possessed a Fire Spiritual Root, his cultivation was not based on Fire Technique; the Nine Elements Technique was a wood attribute cultivation method, naturally countered by the Fire Attribute, making it difficult to fully refine the Fire Attribute Spiritual Power within the Fire Spirit Peach, which eventually turned into poison, forming sores outside.
Yuan Ming took out a Detoxification Pill and swallowed it, then immediately circulated its medicinal power towards the site of the fire sore to heal it.
Yet, as soon as the medicine power made contact, the burning sensation at the fire sore location instantly intensified, followed by a crawling sensation of itchy pain like biting insects spreading throughout his entire arm, nearly making him cry out loud.
Yuan Ming hurriedly suppressed the medicinal power of the Detoxification Pill, forcefully stimulating the Cold Moon Ring to use its icy power to temporarily suppress the burning, painful itching.
He didn't have a Detoxification Elixir specifically for this kind of fire poison and dared not rashly try any others now.
If Hua Zhi were here, perhaps there would be a way, but it was currently at a critical moment in refining the Level 4 Tree Demon, and Yuan Ming did not want to disturb it. He could only endure the pain and continue on his way.
However, just as Yuan Ming stepped forward to continue the journey, he paused again and stopped.
Consuming these Fire Spirit Peaches was like drinking poison to quench thirst for him at the moment, but it was better than having nothing. Fire sores were not an incurable disease; once he left this Peach Forest, he knew various methods to slowly refine it away.
Moreover, these Fire Spirit Peaches contained abundant Fire Attribute Spiritual Power and were rare treasures.
With this thought, he waved his sleeve, stirring up gusts of wind, plucking all the Fire Spirit Peaches from the peach trees he passed and collected most of them into his bag, sending a few into the Purple Extreme Tai Sui and Hua Zhi's Spiritual Beast Bag.
Having delayed for so long and resuming his journey, Yuan Ming noticed that the sun overhead had become increasingly scorching.
Sure enough, not much further, another sun appeared in the sky.
Six blazing suns hung high, and the heat they emitted had reached an alarming level. Yuan Ming pushed the Cold Moon Shield to its limits but still struggled to block the intense heat.
The Three-eyed Crow and Lei Yu, hidden in the Spiritual Beast Bag, became restless from the heat as well.
Feeling their emotional changes, Yuan Ming knew that if this continued, his spirit pets might succumb before he did.
With no other choice, Yuan Ming applied a Sealing Array to the Spiritual Beast Bag of the Three-eyed Crow, Lei Yu, Hua Zhi, and the Purple Extreme Tai Sui, then placed them into the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space.
While fully stimulating the Cold Moon Ring, he also employed the Ghost Shadow Escape Technique to advance with all his might, with mana being consumed at a rapid pace.
Although eating the Fire Spirit Peaches would result in an accumulation of fire poison in the body, he could not care less at the moment; whenever his mana was depleted, he would consume a Fire Spirit Peach to recover.
As time passed, Yuan Ming's arms and calves developed more and more fiery red poison sores, but his pace did not stop; instead, it quickened.
The temperature within the Peach Forest continued to climb as if there were no ceiling to its rise.
Just as Yuan Ming was almost unable to bear the torture of burns that were painfully itchy and unbearably searing, at the end of his vision, a green hue appeared.
The sight of this green seemed like a dark blotch growing on red skin. Yuan Ming's eyes were blurred by sweat dripping over them, and the view was so indistinct that he thought he was seeing an illusion.
"It looks like I really can't hold on any longer," Yuan Ming thought with a silent sigh. He rubbed his eyes and planned to rest inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
As for the possibility of being spied upon, he could no longer care about that.
But at that moment, a slight coolness suddenly came from ahead, like a breeze sweeping across Yuan Ming's cheeks.
He paused the motion of rubbing his eyes and focused his gaze ahead.
It wasn't an illusion!
In front of him, more than a hundred yards away, there truly was a stretch of dark green woods, completely different from the surrounding peach forest scenery, and that trace of coolness was coming from there.
Yuan Ming's spirits lifted instantly, and he flew towards it with all his might.
Just as he was about to reach it, the scene in front of him blurred suddenly, and the surrounding peach trees seemed to shift again.
Yuan Ming frowned and immediately his body flickered with electricity. In a burst of speed, he transformed into a bolt of lightning, shooting through the last ten yards of peach forest and into the green area.
At this moment, he could no longer concern himself with whether the place was safe or not. Anything was preferable to staying in that scorching, purgatory-like peach forest—even if what lay ahead was a sea of swords, he was willing to take the risk.
Fortunately, his decision was correct. As soon as he burst into the area, the surrounding temperature instantly dropped.
Feeling the cool relief, Yuan Ming didn't have time to feel excited, but quickly looked around and found that he was surrounded by ancient trees with dark green trunks, their branches twisted and the shade dense, offering immense coolness. The spiritual energy of heaven and earth in the void had also returned to normal, with all Five Elements—Gold, Wood, Water, Fire, Earth—present.
Overjoyed, Yuan Ming wasted no time. He sat down cross-legged under an ancient tree, took out two pieces of elixir for restoring mana, refilled his mana to the brim, and expanded his Divine Sense into the depths of the dark green forest.
He raised his eyebrows; there was a village deep in the forest that looked very dilapidated, with no signs of life, seemingly a relic of the past.
A stinging pain coursed through the poisonous sores spread across his body. Yuan Ming had no time to investigate further, so he set up an array around him, formed three silver barriers inside with a Silver Token, and then sat down to activate the Cold Moon Ring, beginning to extract the Fire Poison from his body.
The extreme cold power of the Cold Moon Ring had a very obvious effect on restraining the Fire Poison, but previously in the peach forest, Yuan Ming had neither the advantage of timing, location, nor human harmony.
Now it was different. He no longer needed to spare any effort to resist the scorching of the sun and could focus solely on removing the Fire Poison, which made the process much faster. Before long, he had removed all the burns one by one.
Without the torment of those painful and itchy burns, Yuan Ming felt much better.
However, the sores were not completely gone; faint red marks remained. The burns formed by the Fire Spirit Peach were stubborn, and the Cold Moon Ring had not fully extracted them, with a wisp of Fire Poison lingering persistently.
Yuan Ming didn't care about this, as the condition would be nothing once Hua Zhi awoke.
Thinking of Hua Zhi, he extended his Divine Sense into the Stealing Heaven Tripod to check on her condition.Content sourced from * – *.
Hua Zhi was still asleep, ignoring even the Fire Spirit Peaches, and it seemed she would not awaken any time soon.
Just as Yuan Ming was about to retract his Divine Sense, it suddenly halted and spread into the Spiritual Beast Bag of the Purple Extreme Tai Sui.
Unlike Hua Zhi, the situation with the Purple Extreme Tai Sui had changed dramatically. The black poison spots on its body had completely disappeared, and its body had grown much larger, almost twice its original size.
A faint demon energy radiated out, reaching the peak of the Second Rank Upper Stage, fluctuating vigorously.
"Is it about to break through?" Yuan Ming's eyes brightened, and he quickly took out the Purple Extreme Tai Sui's Spiritual Beast Bag and threw three Fire Spirit Peaches into it.
The ones he had previously thrown in had already been devoured by the Purple Extreme Tai Sui.
Still as voracious as ever, the Purple Extreme Tai Sui swallowed the three Fire Spirit Peaches, and the fluctuations in its energy intensified slightly.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming settled down and waited quietly.
However, as time ticked by, not only did the Purple Extreme Tai Sui fail to make any further progress, but its energy also showed signs of fading.
"Squeak, squeak," a noise like that of a rat came from the body of the Purple Extreme Tai Sui, filled with anxiety and a plea for help.
Yuan Ming grew anxious too, but he knew too little about the Purple Extreme Tai Sui to figure out how to assist it.
"Right, how could I forget this!" He took out a white crystal, the Dragon Tooth Crystal, and tossed it into the Spiritual Beast Bag without hesitation.
As Lei He had said, this Dragon Tooth Crystal was very beneficial to demon beasts. Although the Purple Extreme Tai Sui was an unusual demon beast, it should still have some effect.
Feeling the presence of the Dragon Tooth Crystal, the Purple Extreme Tai Sui seemed very excited, crawling rapidly towards it and swallowing the crystal, its energy surging once more.
Not only that, but the Divine Soul of the Purple Extreme Tai Sui was also strengthening gradually.
"I never expected this Dragon Tooth Crystal to also enhance the Divine Soul of demon beasts!" Yuan Ming was surprised.
Compared to the cultivators of the Human Clan, demon beasts naturally had weaker Divine Souls. Many demon beasts could not advance further because their Divine Soul Power was limited. Therefore, any spiritual materials that could strengthen a demon beast's Divine Soul were exceptionally precious; no wonder Lei He and Yan Xiang had fought over it so desperately.

chapters.title: Chapter 551 - 527: A Small Village in the Forest
chapters.content:
As Yuan Ming's thoughts were turning, he continued to closely monitor the changes in the Purple Extreme Tai Sui.
Its Divine Soul's growth, after continuing for a while, gradually came to a halt, and the growth of its aura also began to slow down.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming immediately took out another Dragon Tooth Crystal and threw it in.
On the lake above before, he obtained more than twenty Dragon Tooth Crystals and had planned to use them on his spirit pet. Since they were effective for the Purple Extreme Tai Sui, of course, there was nothing to hesitate about.
Fueled by the addition of the Dragon Tooth Crystal, the Purple Extreme Tai Sui's Soul Power continued to increase, and its aura also continued to rise.
Unlike before, this time as the aura of the Purple Extreme Tai Sui strengthened, its fluctuations suddenly intensified several times over.
"It's finally going to break through," Yuan Ming finally let out a sigh of relief.
This Purple Extreme Tai Sui, different from ordinary demon beasts, had no particular talent for Advancement; breaking through was indeed not easy, not at all like Hua Zhi, who could advance by casually devouring a few demon beasts.
"Poison... poison..." The aura of the Purple Extreme Tai Sui suddenly paused and showed a trend of weakening, perhaps because its Divine Soul had been greatly enhanced, transmitting a notion.
Yuan Ming's expression darkened, but he still took out all the extreme poison materials he had on him and threw them to the Purple Extreme Tai Sui.
After a slight hesitation, he took out the bottle of One Rihong. Although it pained him, he still threw it in.
"If you can't break through, don't blame me for chopping you up and selling you for Spirit Stones!" Yuan Ming said viciously.
Perhaps it was Yuan Ming's words that had an effect; after swallowing so many poison materials, the Purple Extreme Tai Sui's fluctuations went wild, and after persisting for a full quarter of an hour, it finally broke through smoothly. Its aura surged greatly, reaching the third-level standard, and inside its body, a purple Round Orb formed, which appeared to be a Demon Core.
The size of the Purple Extreme Tai Sui didn't continue to grow, but it took on a more crystalline appearance than before.
Yuan Ming waved his hand and summoned the Purple Extreme Tai Sui, proceeding to apply the Beast Taming Technique on it.
His Divine Soul Power was strong, and collecting seven or eight spirit beasts was well within his capability. Although the Purple Extreme Tai Sui's talent was mediocre, its ability to refine poisons was still quite unique, and he didn't want to let it go.
Even though the Purple Extreme Tai Sui had broken through to the third level and had its Divine Soul enhanced by the Dragon Tooth Crystal, it was still far too inferior compared to Yuan Ming.
Moreover, the beast seemed very close to Yuan Ming and didn't resist at all, calmly accepting the Beast Taming mark.
Through the Beast Taming Technique, Yuan Ming understood that the Divine Skills of the Purple Extreme Tai Sui were only two, one was Melting poison and the other was Poison Release.
Yuan Ming immediately ordered it to perform the Poison Release Divine Skill.
The lump of flesh on the top of the Purple Extreme Tai Sui moved, as if nodding, then fell silent, without any further action.
"Go on, release the poison," Yuan Ming waited a while and urged.
In response, the Purple Extreme Tai Sui transmitted a somewhat aggrieved notion; it had already released it.
Yuan Ming was taken aback, then his expression dramatically changed. He unleashed all his Divine Sense, covering a range of more than ten feet around him, yet he detected nothing.
His expression became completely serious; his first soul's Divine Sense descended, and his eyes narrowed.
Around the Purple Extreme Tai Sui, many completely transparent droplets had appeared at some point, similar to One Rihong, yet even more concealed.
Yuan Ming considered for a moment, and his heart began to pound.
The Poison Release Divine Skill of the Purple Extreme Tai Sui was too powerful.
His Divine Sense was no less than that of a Nascent Soul cultivator, and he was even better at controlling the details, yet he had not detected it. Those Nascent Soul Stage cultivators would be even less likely to sense it.
"A fine ability. What is the toxicity of those water droplets?" Yuan Ming asked.
The Purple Extreme Tai Sui gave an answer that was slightly stronger than One Rihong.
Yuan Ming suppressed the excitement in his heart. If it was as the Purple Extreme Tai Sui said, this Poison Release ability, if used correctly, could potentially poison and kill a Nascent Soul cultivator.
Yuan Ming asked a few more questions, completely mastering the abilities of the Purple Extreme Tai Sui, before he collected it.
Having gained another powerful spirit beast, his mood was great, and he began to survey the surrounding black trees.
At this moment, the light in the forest suddenly brightened. Yuan Ming felt the temperature around him, and "whoosh," it rose again by several degrees, even the fire poison lingering in his body became more vigorous.
Yuan Ming's heart chilled, and he looked up through the gaps in the tree leaves at the edge of the forest.
Above the high sky, to his surprise, another fireball had appeared at some point, making it seven Suns.
Yuan Ming stood at the edge of the forest, feeling the scorching heat waves constantly buffeting the woods but being blocked by an invisible force. Only a small amount of heat dissipated into the forest, keeping the temperature inside still not high.
It was just a fine line away, yet it was like two worlds.
Aside from his amazement, Yuan Ming did not continue to stay there, but walked deeper into the dark green forest.
The deeper into the forest he went, the cooler the temperature around him, and the more refreshing it felt.
After walking about a hundred steps, the forest in front of him revealed cottages made of earth, stone, and wood, scattered around an area of about a hundred feet. It looked like an ancient and dilapidated village, exactly the place he had just sensed.
Yuan Ming had been in a hurry to get rid of the fire sore and hadn't had the chance to take a close look. Just as he was about to carefully investigate the situation, a figure suddenly burst out from the forest ahead.
That was a half-naked monster with fiery red skin all over his body, with a pair of curved horns atop his head, and his eyes were round and bulbous, making him look like some kind of half-human, half-demon creature from an alien clan.
Yuan Ming was stunned; when he had used his Divine Sense just now, he hadn't detected any signs of living creatures in the area. Where did this fiery red alien come from?
As soon as he saw the other party, the latter also spotted him.
"Someone's here, we have an intruder," the half-naked monster immediately shouted loudly.
Suddenly, the village was in turmoil, and instantly over a dozen similar-looking monsters rushed out. Some were clad in half pieces of beast skin, while others wore skirts made of Qing Gui leaves and hemp twine, all holding spears and other weapons in their hands, and without a word, they surrounded Yuan Ming.
Seeing this display, Yuan Ming's brows couldn't help but furrow.
His Divine Sense swept over these people and found that their cultivation was all at the Second-Level Demon Beast tier, and many of them had poisonous sores on their bodies, some with just one or two, and others with a dense cluster spreading across their entire chests and arms.
Check * (*) for the latest updates.
Yuan Ming glanced over and frowned slightly, looking at those individuals with fewer sores.
These people looked at him with hostile expressions, each holding a spear, gradually pressing in on him.
"My friends, I mean no harm; there's no need to be afraid," Yuan Ming quickly extended his hands, trying to communicate with them.
No matter what he said, it was as if they hadn't heard him at all and didn't stop their movements. Instead, they each grabbed their spears, ready to throw them.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming had no choice but to bring out the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear, readying himself in a defensive posture.
Just as conflict was about to erupt between the two sides, a steady voice that also carried a hint of vicissitude suddenly came from behind the group of monsters.
"Everyone, stop."
Following the sound of the voice, those red-skinned monsters obediently halted their actions and spontaneously parted to create a pathway through the crowd.
An old man, looking nothing like them, with his hands behind his back, walked out from within their midst.
He wasn't half-naked; he wore a coarse cloth cape over his shoulders and a hat woven from hemp on his head; his appearance resembled that of an old farmer who had toiled in the fields for a long time.
The man was not one of the red-skinned, horned monsters and looked no different from an ordinary person.
Yuan Ming examined the newcomer, his eyes showing a trace of solemnity.
His Divine Sense could not detect the man's cultivation, which, to a great extent, meant that the man's strength was far above his own.
Even when facing a Mid-Stage Nascent Soul cultivator like Luu Changfeng, he did not have this kind of completely inscrutable feeling.
"Senior, due to a fortuitous encounter, I have mistakenly entered this Golden Sunflower Immortal Island. I almost perished in the vast Peach Forest before and had to escape to this place out of necessity; I truly have no ill intentions," Yuan Ming said, greeting the man with a cupped fist.
"For you to make it here means you've got some ability, and some luck. Come on in," the old farmer said nonchalantly, waving his hand.
After speaking, he dismissed the other half-naked monsters and invited Yuan Ming into the village.
Yuan Ming followed cautiously and soon entered the village.
He had only scanned briefly with his Divine Sense earlier and hadn't looked closely. Now that he was inside the village, he realized it was even more rundown than it appeared from the outside.
All the houses were round and half-subterranean, with half dug into the ground and the other half covered with earth, stone, and wood materials, appearing both crude and primitive.
Most of the returning red-skinned monsters went back to their dwellings, while a small portion scattered into the forest, seemingly with some purpose.
Yuan Ming followed the old farmer to the center of the village.
There, stood the only structure in the village not built in the half-subterranean style: a fenced wooden building, just as rudimentary and rugged in construction but somewhat sturdier than the other houses.
Yuan Ming entered the squat wooden building at the invitation of the old man.
To his surprise, inside the wooden building were furnishings and tables similar to those found in the Central Plains Region.
After both of them sat down, the old farmer flipped his palm, and a dark-colored earthen teapot and two black pottery tea cups appeared on the table.
After pouring a cup of tea into each cup, he didn't rush to speak but instead took a sip first.
Then, the old farmer showed a slight expression of contentment on his face.
"This tea is brewed from Qing Gui leaves from outside, it has some effect on removing Fire Poison. Seeing that you're not deeply poisoned, it should help you fully rid your body of the residual toxicity," the old farmer said.
"Thank you, senior," Yuan Ming thanked as he held the tea cup with both hands.
However, he didn't rush to drink it but instead asked, "Senior, may I inquire what place this is?"
As he spoke, he had already quietly collected a bit of the tea into his Spiritual Beast Bag.
After the Purple Extreme Tai Sui inside the bag identified it and gave a safe verdict, he then discreetly sipped the tea.
"This is Qing Gui Village, the name comes from the surrounding Qing Gui Forest," the old farmer replied nonchalantly.
The tea brewed from Qing Gui leaves was bitter, but shortly after swallowing, a sweet aftertaste emerged, lingering on the lips and teeth. Once it entered the stomach, it turned into a coolness.
This coolness clashed with the lingering Fire Poison in his body, and the two quickly neutralized each other, vanishing without a trace.

chapters.title: Chapter 552 - 528: Immortal Servant
chapters.content:
"Many thanks to the senior for the tea. My surname is Yuan, may I know how to address the senior?" Yuan Ming thanked him and asked.
"Zhao Gui." The old farmer did not mind that Yuan Ming gave only his surname and responded.
"The junior sees the senior has an extraordinary demeanor, and you're clearly not of the same clan as those outside, could it be that you are an Immortal from Golden Sunflower Island?" Yuan Ming complimented him before asking again.
"Haha, I am just an old servant, how can I be considered an Immortal? Even my ancestors were nothing more than servants to the Golden Sunflower Immortal." Zhao Gui laughed self-deprecatingly and said.
"Golden Sunflower Immortal?" Yuan Ming's eyes lit up.
"Indeed. The Golden Sunflower Immortal is the master of this Immortal Island. Unfortunately, he has left the island for who knows how many years. Originally, my ancestors' clans have been following him. Regrettably, when he left, he did not take my ancestors with him, leaving them to live or perish on this Golden Sunflower Island. Now all of my kinsfolk have perished, leaving only me behind," Zhao Gui explained.
"Then, what about those outside?" Yuan Ming asked, puzzled.
"Those are the Fire Horned Tribe who were originally on the island. With their low spiritual intelligence, they pose no threat to you, so there's no need to harm them without cause," Zhao Gui advised.
"The junior is just a passerby who stumbled in by mistake, naturally I won't make troubles without reason. But could the senior tell me about the situation of this Golden Sunflower Immortal Island? Despite bearing the name of an Immortal Island, why are there such scorching suns and a peach forest that traps and kills?" Yuan Ming quickly said.
"Since it is where Immortals dwell, this place naturally contains extraordinary mysteries. For Immortals who live here, it may be as sweet as honey, but for us mortals, it feels like living in purgatory," Zhao Gui answered, shaking his head.
"Senior has a point. As circumstances prevent me from staying here long, could you possibly tell me how to get out of this peach forest?" Yuan Ming inquired.
"Not to worry, let me first tell you about the situation on this island. As you have seen, there is not just one sun in the sky here; to be precise, there are seven suns," Zhao Gui said, gesturing with his hand.
On hearing this, Yuan Ming felt a chill in his heart and did not speak, just nodding noncommittally.
"The concept of time here is different from the outside world. There are no twelve-hour day and night cycles. Typically, after every two hours, one more sun will appear in the sky. When seven suns hang together for seven days, that is the most scorching time for the entire Golden Sunflower Island. After surviving that two hours, the remaining six suns will set, leaving only one sun in the sky. At that time, the temperature will fall to its lowest," Zhao Gui explained.
Hence, the sky of Golden Sunflower Island never darkens. After the extreme heat passes, all that remains is a brief respite, followed by the cycle of one sun rising after another.
As the two spoke for a while, suddenly cheers could be heard coming from outside the house.
Yuan Ming looked at Zhao Gui in surprise, but the latter had already stood up.
"Let's go, it's a good time to go out and see," said Zhao Gui calmly, without a hint of surprise on his face.
Yuan Ming, who wanted to continue asking about how to leave, saw this and could only follow him outside.
Upon stepping outside, he was astonished.
He felt the surrounding void darken slightly, and the temperature noticeably dropped a lot.
He quickly looked up, eyes peering through the gaps in the leaves above, and saw that in the sky there was now only one solitary sun, its radiance softer.
At this moment, the village was bustling with Fire Horned Tribe members, crawling out of their simple semi-subterranean houses. One after another, they let out excited shouts, running into the peach forest, disappearing outside the village.
"What are they doing?" Yuan Ming wondered aloud.
"They are collecting a type of Spirit Grass in the forest, which can alleviate the fire sores on their bodies," Zhao Gui answered.
"But don't Qing Gui leaves alleviate Fire Poison? Why do they still need to go out and find it?" Yuan Ming was confused.
"Qing Gui leaves can only alleviate mild Fire Poison. Besides, the Fire Horned Tribe's physical structure is different from ours; they more readily absorb Fire Attribute Spiritual Energy and are also more prone to accumulate Fire Poison. The poisons in their wounds have festered over so many years, they can no longer be cured by just Qing Gui leaves," Zhao Gui shook his head as he explained slowly.
"I see. But they just run out like that, aren't they afraid of getting lost in the peach forest?" Yuan Ming nodded and asked.
"There's no need to worry. The Peach Forest on the periphery of this area doesn't have those drastic changes, and since they have lived here for many years, they will not lose their way," Zhao Gui assured him.This content is presented by *.
Yuan Ming felt a bit disappointed upon hearing this.
He had thought that these Fire Horned Tribe members had some special method of finding their way.
"Right, senior, you mentioned earlier that you would inform me of the way out..." Yuan Ming's words were not yet finished when a rumbling noise came from the Peach Forest outside the village.
Immediately following that, the wails of the Fire Horned Tribe members resounded.
Yuan Ming's brows furrowed, and he quickly hurried towards the direction of the noise, with Zhao Gui taking a step at his side, his figure floating effortlessly towards the outskirts of the village, his movement incomparably smooth.
By the time the two arrived in the Peach Forest outside the village, they saw a group of about a dozen Fire Horned Tribe members surrounding Lei He and Yan Xiang in the middle, each one wielding spears and poised to attack.
Although they appeared brave, they had already suffered a heavy loss; not far in front of Yan Xiang lay the bodies of two members of the Fire Horned Tribe.
Yan Xiang, with fury flashing in his eyes, had cultivated a Fire Attribute Technique, but being trapped in the peach forest for so long, his body was already covered in fire sores. During the time when the seven suns were at their peak, he felt as if his blood was boiling and he was about to burst into flames.
Fortunately, he held on until the end.
Just when he thought he was about to find an oasis, he was blocked by these red-skinned members of the Alien Clan. All he wanted now was to kill all of these uncivilized red-skinned beasts.
Hence, he held a large red sword in his hand, which was painted with swirling patterns of brightly burning flames, and slashed it towards a Fire Horned Tribe member in front of him.
As the sword's fiery pattern flashed, several balls of flame burst forth with a whoosh, flying straight at the Alien.
As the fireball drew near, the flames surged violently, resembling a fierce beast of fire, about to engulf the creature.
"Stop." Zhao Gui's face showed anger, and his figure suddenly disappeared.
The next moment, a dilapidated hoe emanating a faint yellow light materialized in front of the great sword.
With a clangorous boom!
The hoe blocked the great sword, and the fiery red flames dispersed, causing Yan Xiang's body to tremble violently as he staggered back three steps.
Yet the worn hoe remained immovable, and Zhao Gui's figure appeared beside it, holding the handle with one hand.
"Who are you?" Yan Xiang exclaimed in shock and rage, ready to attack Zhao Gui immediately.
However, Lei He, who was nearby, remained calm. Seeing how effortlessly Zhao Gui had blocked Yan Xiang's assault, he couldn't help but feel surprised.
When he noticed Yuan Ming was also present, a look of delight clearly spread across his face.
"Fellow Daoist Yan Xiang, hold your hand, we're all friends here," Lei He quickly intervened.
Yan Xiang was puzzled by his reference to "friends" and didn't know how to react, so he didn't continue to attack.
"Why are you killing people here for no reason?" Zhao Gui put down the hoe and asked with a cold voice.
"This... Fellow Daoist, it's not that we were killing without reason, they attacked us suddenly, and we had no choice but to fight back," Lei He explained with a bow.
Yan Xiang started to speak but a glance from Lei He silenced him.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, please explain to this Daoist. We are companions who inadvertently stumbled into this place, and we mean no harm to the people here," Lei He then said, turning quickly to Yuan Ming.
"You know each other?" Zhao Gui frowned and asked.
"Senior, I did come here with them. We got separated earlier in the Peach Forest," Yuan Ming explained.
Hearing this, Zhao Gui's expression softened somewhat.
"Let it be, the ignorant are not guilty. Considering this is your first offense, I'll let it pass this time. But, let there not be a second," Zhao Gui glanced at Yan Xiang and spoke indifferently.
Feeling his gaze, Yan Xiang felt a surge of annoyance flare up within him.
Even he didn't understand why he was so irritable today.
Zhao Gui walked over to the two dead bodies of the Fire Horned Tribe and placed their severed heads back onto their necks. Numerous black tendrils, resembling roots, emanated from his palm and entered their bodies.
The battered bodies of the Fire Horned Tribe swiftly healed and, within a few breaths, they shakily stood up again.
Yuan Ming and the other two couldn't believe their eyes.
Those two members of the Fire Horned Tribe were undoubtedly dead, yet they were revived!
"Senior really is an expert. May I ask if you could guide us out of the Peach Forest?" Yuan Ming bowed respectfully.
Witnessing the farmer's resurrection technique, and realizing that this unremarkable-looking farmer knew how to leave this cursed place, Yan Xiang's expression became much more restrained.
Lei He, too, was visibly elated and quickly said, "Please enlighten us, Daoist friend."
"I can tell you how to leave the Peach Forest, but you must first do something for me," Zhao Gui replied.
"What is it?" Yuan Ming sighed, sensing it wouldn't be so easy.
"I need you to go thirty li northeast from here and collect some Golden Sunflower Spiritual Grass for me," Zhao Gui said.
The three exchanged looks, filled with questions.
"Fellow Daoist seems to reside here. You are more familiar with the surroundings than us. Why don't you go and pick the herb yourself?" Lei He asked, puzzled.
"I naturally have my reasons for not going, and you don't need to worry about them," Zhao Gui replied with no intention of explaining.
"How do we know you're not deceiving us? How can you prove that you have a way out of the Peach Forest?" Yan Xiang couldn't help but ask.
"The reason you can't leave this Peach Forest is due to the influence of the Liu Ren Qimen Formation within it, which continually shifts your position. Being unable to break the illusions that misguide you, I have a way to let you remain unaffected by the Qimen Formation. Otherwise, had you not gotten lost upon entering the forest, how could you possibly bring back what I need?" Zhao Gui said, not bothering to look at Yan Xiang.
Yuan Ming was taken aback. He had not heard of Qimen before, but Lei He and Yan Xiang's expressions changed drastically.
"Senior Lei, what is Qimen?" Yuan Ming inquired through a message to Lei He.
"Qimen is a type of Formation that incorporates Array Patterns, changes in Spiritual Energy, and even Mathematics, earth veins, Sun and Moon, Stars, and so forth. The most accomplished Qimen Formations even merge the elements of time and space, far more complex than ordinary Formations. On the Yunhuang Continent, there are many Array Masters but very few who are proficient in Qimen Formations," Lei He replied through a message, his voice unable to hide his astonishment.
"I see. Since the senior has commanded it, we will naturally go," Yuan Ming said, nodding at Zhao Gui.
"I can try as well," Lei He stated.
Yan Xiang didn't speak, but his expression was no longer opposed.
"Good. Since that is agreed, I must say something in advance. My method will only last for a quarter of an hour, during which you'll be completely unaffected, so don't think about using this time to escape. The distance of thirty li and the collection of the Golden Sunflower Spiritual Grass will be quite pressing on time. I hope you don't try any tricks," Zhao Gui said flatly.
"Our words are trustworthy, and we will carry through with our actions. We will not break our word," Lei He declared.
Yuan Ming and Yan Xiang both nodded in agreement.

chapters.title: Chapter 553 - 529 Stone Forest Basin
chapters.content:
"That's best. Pay attention when you collect them, the golden sunflowers with only leaves and no flowers are of no use; I need the ones in full bloom." Zhao Gui reminded them.
"Senior, we have never seen the golden sunflower spiritual grass you mentioned. Do you perhaps have a picture?" Yuan Ming inquired.
Upon hearing this, Zhao Gui raised his hand and waved in the air, and a beam of light condensed into a phantom of the golden sunflower spiritual grass, displaying it before the three of them.
"Make sure you remember it well, it is this kind." Zhao Gui said.
The three of them silently memorized the appearance of the golden sunflower spiritual grass and nodded.
"Besides, the three of you have slightly different tasks. Fellow Daoist Yuan, you need to collect three blossoming golden sunflowers. You need to collect six. And you... Killing my two men as compensation, you need to collect twelve." Zhao Gui pointed at each of them in turn.
Yan Xiang, upon hearing this, immediately felt great anger, but on thinking of the method for leaving, he could only bite down and endure it.
Seeing that there were no objections from the three, Zhao Gui stepped forward, his fingers coming together to form a magic seal, and he cast a spell on the three of them.
Yuan Ming only felt as if an obscure force had entered his body, not feeling any abnormalities, he asked with some uncertainty, "Is that it?"
"You'll know once you try it outside." Zhao Gui waved his hand indifferently.
The three of them didn't dare delay and immediately followed the direction Zhao Gui had indicated, walking toward the outskirts of the village.
"Remember, not even one less golden sunflower will do." Zhao Gui's voice came from behind, drifting along.
Yuan Ming didn't look back, waving his hand.
Lei He approached Yuan Ming and asked, "Fellow Daoist Yuan, how was your fire poison cured?"
Not far away, Yan Xiang, who was pressing a hand to his forearm to suppress a fire sore, also pricked up his ears to listen carefully.
"Oh, the leaves of the trees grown in that village can cure fire poison." Yuan Ming replied.
Upon hearing this, Lei He hesitated, then sighed, "Why didn't you say so earlier?"
Yan Xiang's eyes reddened, feeling that his fire temper was somewhat rising again.
"Why didn't you ask sooner? Moreover, even if I had told you, that senior might not have been willing to let you into the village to pick leaves, right?" Yuan Ming spread his hands and retorted.
With a sigh in his heart, Lei He felt some regret for not having stopped Yan Xiang from going mad earlier.
For now, they could only continue to endure, and the matter of detoxification would have to wait until after they had gathered flowers.
To save time, Yuan Ming and the others did not dare delay; after leaving the village, they followed the instructions and headed in the northeast direction.
After walking roughly twenty to thirty li, they saw that the peach trees around them were gradually thinning out, and their view became much clearer.
In the distance, tall stone pillars with rugged shapes rose straight from the ground like small mountains reaching into the skies.
And between the stone pillars, a faint red mist almost swallowed up a large portion of the pillars, leaving only the tips exposed outside, which were not simply bare. Dense golden grass grew in disorder upon them, resembling treetops from afar.
On these "treetops," one could occasionally spot a bright golden flower, its species completely different from any plant Yuan Ming and his companions had seen before, with buds as big as a carriage wheel.
The buds consisted of four layers from inside to outside, with the innermost resembling thin petals while the outer three layers were like small blades with fine hairs on their edges. The sunlight filtering through the hairs created a hazy halo, enveloping the buds.
These appeared to be the golden sunflower spiritual grass that Zhao Gui wanted them to collect. Though not abundant, they were not hard to find.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming and his companions were quite surprised, but soon, as they drew closer, they realized where the true difficulty of the task Zhao Gui had given them lay.
All the golden sunflowers they could find within their field of vision were only in bud, not even willing to extend a petal, tightly closed, unwilling to reveal the inside of the flower heart.
It seemed in order to collect the required golden sunflowers, they would need to venture deep into the stone forest.
The three approached the edge of the stone forest, looking at the mist before them, with Yan Xiang immediately complaining.
"This damned place, why are there so many strange and bizarre restrictions everywhere?"
Need character sheets and glossaries? Visit *.
Yuan Ming, on the other hand, was silent as he extended his divine sense, attempting to penetrate the fog to understand the situation within the stone forest.
However, as soon as his divine sense touched the red mist, a surge of hot poison instantly emerged, invading his sea of consciousness through his divine sense.
Yuan Ming's expression changed, and he immediately withdrew his divine sense, but by then, the fire poison had turned into fierce flames within his sea of consciousness, directly rushing towards his divine soul.
He decisively stimulated his soul power to block the fire poison, continuously purging it, and after much effort, managed to extinguish it, albeit at the expense of a substantial amount of his soul power, leaving him slightly pale.
After steadying himself, Yuan Ming turned to remind Lei He, but seeing that he and Yan Xiang looked even worse than him, it was clear they too had suffered from the fire poison, so he closed his mouth and said no more.
Moments later, Lei He and his companion temporarily suppressed the fire poison and reassessed the red mist before them. Just then, Yan Xiang turned to glance at Yuan Ming.
"Kid, it's time to let your spirit beast scout ahead."
Yuan Ming's expression remained unchanged, "Junior's spirit beasts have all been carefully raised, and there are only one or two of them—it's really not convenient to use them for scouting. Please forgive me, senior."
Hearing this, Yan Xiang glared at Yuan Ming and was about to speak, but Lei He persuaded him not.
"Alright, time is pressing, let's not quarrel over such trivial matters. I'll do it."
As he spoke, Lei He raised his hand and summoned a palm-sized sparrow from his Storage Bag. It immediately dove into the red fog upon command and reappeared after a few moments.
After sensing the state of the demon sparrow, Lei He let out a sigh of relief: "It seems that merely coming into contact with the red fog doesn't attract Fire Poison. Zhao Gui didn't specifically warn us when he asked us to come here, so it should be safe."
"Since that's the case, let's follow our previously agreed plan and search separately to save time," Yan Xiang nodded and promptly said.
Among the three, he needed to find the largest quantity of Golden Sunflower Spiritual Grass. Hearing Lei He mention the urgency of time, a sense of impatience arose in his heart.
Seeing him like this, Lei He then suggested, "Good, but let's all try to find a bit more, just in case someone has bad luck and can't find enough."
Upon hearing this, Yan Xiang immediately gave Lei He a grateful look. These words were clearly meant to accommodate him who needed the most Golden Sunflower Spiritual Grass.
Yuan Ming silently nodded, not planning to clash with Yan Xiang over these matters.
Afterward, the three no longer delayed and each chose a direction before they entered the red fog.
After walking through the fog for a short while and seeing no one around, Yuan Ming multitasked, quietly controlling the first soul in the Stealing Heaven Tripod, instructing it to sit on the Lotus Platform.
In an instant, the Divine Sense of the first soul covered Yuan Ming's surroundings, easily piercing through the red fog without any hindrance.
However, at that moment, waves of Fire Poison climbed onto the Divine Sense cast by the first soul, attempting to locate the soul splitting and burn its soul body.
Yet, as the Fire Poison spread within the Divine Sense cast by the soul splitting, it failed to overcome the spatial barrier and enter the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming thought to himself as expected, and then he stopped caring about the Fire Poison that could not cause damage. He started probing the Stone Forest through the Divine Sense of the first soul.
At the same time, both Lei He and Yan Xiang were groping their way through the mist. Yuan Ming briefly looked into their situation and was about to shift his attention when he suddenly noticed that two Fire Breath Beasts were lurking on the path ahead of Yan Xiang.
The Fire Breath Beasts resembled old rats in appearance, only they were the size of a full-grown man, their fur red as flames, eyes a tarnished yellow. They could spew fierce flames from their mouths to burn their enemies. Even a Core Formation Cultivator would find them a nuisance.
The red fog of the Stone Forest limited the explorations of a Cultivator's Divine Sense, but the Fire Breath Beasts didn't seem to be overly affected. The two that Yuan Ming had noticed had already detected Yan Xiang and were approaching stealthily, as if planning a surprise attack.
The time to find the Blossoming Golden Sunflower was already short. If they were to be entangled with demon beasts, even if they were not injured, it would greatly hinder the search.
It was unclear whether Yan Xiang was truly unlucky or had incurred some strange Curse from slaying a member of the Fire Horned Tribe; he hadn't found a single Golden Sunflower Spiritual Grass but had already encountered the Fire Breath Beasts. It seemed difficult for him to gather enough Golden Sunflower Spiritual Grass.
Yuan Ming chuckled and no longer paid attention to Yan Xiang who was now engaged with the Fire Breath Beasts. The Divine Sense of the first soul spread out to assist him in searching for traces of Blossoming Golden Sunflower.
...
Thirty minutes later.
In a small clearing in the Stone Forest, a Fire Breath Beast lay sound asleep. Suddenly, the sound of air being split echoed not far away. The beast immediately became alert, raising its head, ready to spew flames to fend off the attacker. But at that moment, it paused, confusion flashing in its eyes.
In the next instant, a small hammer wrapped in Lei Guang smashed over, crushing the beast's skull and killing it instantly.
Then, Yuan Ming slowly emerged from the red fog, looked up and summoned back the Thunder God Hammer.
He hurried over, ignoring the corpse of the Fire Breath Beast, and carefully squatted five steps away from it, digging up a Blossoming Golden Sunflower Spiritual Grass by the root.
This was already the third Blossoming Golden Sunflower he had found, thus completing the task given to him by Zhao Gui.
It turned out that Zhao Gui hadn't made things difficult for them. Even the blooming Golden Sunflowers were not rare in the Stone Forest. The only obstacle was the red fog covering the area. Why Zhao Gui couldn't come here himself was a mystery.
With the aid of the Divine Sense from the first soul, Yuan Ming considered the red fog as nothing, and it took even less effort than he expected.
Furthermore, during his search, he found several millennial Fire Attribute Spirit Grasses. Although they were all guarded by Fire Breath Beasts, having discovered these demon beasts in advance, he had the upper hand, making the beasts not too difficult to deal with.
Yuan Ming collected the Golden Sunflower Spiritual Grass and the carcasses of the Fire Breath Beasts, and, finding he still had some time, decided to continue searching in the Stone Forest since it was rich in Spirit Grass.
Suddenly, he let out a small sound of surprise, a flash of astonishment crossing his face.
Through the Divine Sense of the first soul, he suddenly discovered a basin much larger than the area he was in, surrounded by Stone Pillars connected to each other, with only one entrance.
The Spirit Grass in the basin thrived exceptionally well, including Golden Sunflowers, of which six or seven were blooming, not to mention the buds yet to open.
The first soul's Divine Sense scanned the area, finding no signs of Fire Breath Beasts or other demon beasts in the basin, which surprised Yuan Ming even more. After all, where Spirit Grass thrives, there must be a concentration of Spiritual Energy, and demon beasts typically love to make their nests in such areas unless they encounter an incompatible element.
And with the red fog in the Stone Forest containing Fire Poison and all the growing Spirit Grass being of the Fire Attribute, could there be a gathering place for Spiritual Energy that doesn't match the nature of the Fire Breath Beasts?

chapters.title: Chapter 554 - 530 Fire Essence Palace
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming, carrying the doubts in his heart, briskly walked toward the basin.
Soon, he arrived at the center of the basin. His soul splitting Divine Sense swept the surroundings and did not detect any Formations or other traps. The Stone Pillars around were no different from elsewhere, the red fog filled with Fire Poison was still dense, and even the Spiritual Energy here felt almost the same as in other places.
Besides the lush growth of Spirit Grass, this place seemed indistinguishable from any other.
"This is indeed strange."
Unable to decipher the mystery, Yuan Ming could only sigh, pushing his doubts to the back of his mind, resolved to dig out the Blossoming Golden Sunflowers growing in this place.
However, as he began to dig, he suddenly discovered that the soil here was richer in Spiritual Energy compared to other places, not only containing Fire Element Spirit Qi but all Five Elements Spiritual Energy.
It meant that only Fire Element Spirit Grass could grow in the Stone Forest; otherwise, even if Water Element Spirit Grass were planted here, they might not thrive poorly given the unchanged exterior environment.
Yuan Ming, realizing this, immediately controlled his first soul to probe into the ground with his Divine Sense.
After a moment, his eyes lit up. He quickly walked to the center of the basin and began to dig.
Soon, within the brown soil, a fist-sized clump of differently-colored soil appeared, shrouded in five different colors of light. Once the ordinary soil covering it was swept away, Five Element Spiritual Energy emitted from it, seemingly affecting the surrounding Spirit Grass. Even the closed buds of the golden sunflower began to slowly reveal a sliver of petals.
"Five Elements in five colors, vitalizing the growth of grass, could this be the legendary Five-Colored Breath Soil?"
Yuan Ming was overjoyed. In legends, the Five-Colored Breath Soil could alter the terrain within a certain range, accelerating the growth of Spirit Grass. If there was enough of it, it could even make a hundred-year Spirit Grass grow to maturity within a year. Unfortunately, with the small amount Yuan Ming had in hand, such miracles were unlikely.
Even so, Yuan Ming was quite content. After carefully collecting the small clump of Five-Colored Breath Soil, he used his soul splitting Divine Sense to search the basin inside and out one more time, making sure nothing was missed before he departed.
In the time that followed, Yuan Ming attempted to find other Spirit Grass or treasures. However, it seemed that having found the Five-Colored Breath Soil, he had used up all his luck; he couldn't even find a single Blossoming Golden Sunflower, let alone other Spirit Grasses.
Leaving the Stone Forest with some regret, Yuan Ming started his return journey, but he did not encounter Yan Xiang and Lei He on the way.
Because of the time limit of one quarter-hour, he naturally could not afford to delay longer. After waiting to no avail, he made his way back to the village on his own.
In the wooden building, Zhao Gui was still sitting peacefully, sipping tea. Seeing Yuan Ming return safely, a trace of a smile appeared on his aged face.
"Oh, you've returned? You are much quicker than I anticipated. I just wonder if you found the Golden Sunflowers I wanted?"
"Fortunately, I have not failed," Yuan Ming said as he placed the harvested Golden Sunflowers on the table.
The genuine article resides on M|V|L&EMPYR.
