"One, two… Eh, you managed to bring back a full ten blossoms, not bad, truly not bad!" Zhao Gui counted the number of Golden Sunflowers, his face showing delight.
"As long as the senior is satisfied," Yuan Ming bowed with his hands folded.
Upon hearing this, Zhao Gui laughed twice, "Haha, It's admirable that you could find so many Blossoming Golden Sunflowers. But as we agreed before, if you brought back three blossoming Golden Sunflowers, I would share with you the method to leave the Peach Forest. Since I have spoken, I will naturally not go back on my word."
As he spoke, Zhao Gui's right hand swept across the wooden table, collecting three Golden Sunflowers into his pouch. He then stood up, formed a magic seal with his hands, and cast a Daoist Technique on Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming immediately felt an unfamiliar power entering his body, the sensation much clearer than the previous time.
"The Daoist Technique I just cast will last for a day and a night. With it, you will have more than enough capacity to traverse the Peach Forest," Zhao Gui said with a smile as he sat back down.
A slight smile appeared on Yuan Ming's face, and he looked again at the remaining Golden Sunflowers, offering, "Then these remaining Golden Sunflowers, consider them a token of thanks for the senior's tea earlier. Please accept them."
While Lei He had subtly suggested earlier that the extra Golden Sunflowers should be given to Yan Xiang, not only had Yuan Ming not agreed, he also had no obligation to worry about Yan Xiang, especially since Yan Xiang had always been rather hostile toward him.
Instead, it seemed more reasonable to reciprocate the kindness shown by Zhao Gui, who had been fairly decent to him from the start. He was naturally more willing to repay the favor.
However, Zhao Gui fell silent for a moment before speaking,"The value of these seven Golden Sunflowers is much higher than the tea I offered you. I won't just take advantage of you. This Qing Gui Grass Hat is crafted from Qing Gui Tree Branches, made by my own hands. Wearing it on the head can resist the scorching sun, a fair exchange for your seven Golden Sunflowers."
With that, his right hand swept across the table again, and the Golden Sunflowers vanished, replaced by a hat woven from dark green tree branches.
As Yuan Ming picked up the hat, he immediately felt a cool sensation coursing through his hands, and the surrounding air seemed much cooler.
Overjoyed, he quickly thanked Zhao Gui with a bow, "Thank you, senior, for this treasure."
"What treasure, not treasure, you traded Golden Sunflowers for the hat, it's a fair exchange," Zhao Gui spoke.
As he talked, the smile on his face slowly faded, and his expression gradually stiffened.
"Senior, is there a problem with these Golden Sunflowers?" Yuan Ming asked upon seeing this.
"No, since you've already got what you wanted, leave quickly!" Zhao Gui suddenly spoke in a cold tone.
Yuan Ming, puzzled, thought they were having a good conversation just moments before, wondering why Zhao Gui's attitude had changed so abruptly.
At this moment, hurried footsteps came from outside the wooden building, Lei He and Yan Xiang rushed into the building looking somewhat disheveled, but without any signs of injuries on them.
They looked up and saw Yuan Ming sitting inside, Yan Xiang immediately snorted coldly, with a glint of displeasure flashing across his face, while Lei He tried to squeeze out a smile but soon his expression turned somber as if he was in a bad mood as well.
Seeing the two returning, Zhao Gui stopped and asked indifferently, "Have you two gathered the Golden Sunflower Spiritual Grass?"
"We've gathered them." Yan Xiang, suppressing his anger, stepped forward and handed over the sunflowers—however, there were only ten.
"If I remember correctly, you're supposed to give me twelve." Zhao Gui glanced at Yan Xiang.
Just then, Lei He stepped forward, "The rest are with me."
After saying that, he took out eight blossoming golden sunflowers and placed them on the table.
Seeing him complete the number on his behalf, a fleeting look of gratitude passed through Yan Xiang's eyes, but it was quickly gone, revealing no more than that flash of emotion.
Yuan Ming suddenly realized that they might have exchanged information on the way back and had reached some sort of agreement.
Zhao Gui didn't care who provided the sunflowers; after a brief count, he took them and then extended his hand to cast a secret technique on Lei He and Yan Xiang.
"That's it, the deal is complete, you can leave now. Don't linger in the Peach Forest any longer, farewell." Zhao Gui issued an eviction order and got up to walk towards the inner room.
"Please wait, Fellow Daoist Zhao, since you've been living here for a long time, do you know where on the island the Immortal's residence is located, and how should we proceed to get there? Besides this Peach Forest, are there any other taboos or restrictions in other places?" Lei He saw this and hurriedly asked with cupped hands.
"You have quite a lot of questions. Well then, I assume you came here for opportunities, so I'll show you a clear path." Zhao Gui stopped in his tracks, stood up, and walked out of the wooden building.
Yuan Ming and the others immediately followed, only to see Zhao Gui stop at the doorway, raise his arm, and point at the golden peak outside the Peach Forest, speaking slowly:
"The greatest opportunity on the island is none other than the Fire Essence Palace on that mountain summit, which used to be the Golden Sunflower Immortal's palace. Inside, not only are there the hubs controlling all the island's restrictions, but because the Immortal left in a hurry, there are still a great number of Immortal Pills and treasures stored inside. Even the Immortal's personal Spiritual Treasure is hidden somewhere in the palace, waiting for the destined one to appear."
Upon hearing the words "Spiritual Treasure," the eyes of Lei He and Yan Xiang lit up, and Yan Xiang, even more excited, shed his previous gloom and irritation, asking eagerly, "How then should we proceed to the Fire Essence Palace? Please clarify, Fellow Daoist."
"Haha, reaching the Fire Essence Palace is quite simple. Just head north from here, and you can cross this Peach Forest to reach the foot of the giant golden peak. However, there are many traps and dangers there as well, and my Daoist Technique can't deal with so many of them. You will have to find your own way to enter."
Having said this, Zhao Gui stopped talking, turned back to the wooden building, and with a "snap," shut the wooden door.
At this moment, Lei He and Yan Xiang were too excited to care about Zhao Gui's actions, they looked at the golden peak for a moment, and then immediately set off, flying toward the north.
Yuan Ming, about to follow, suddenly turned around and looked back at the wooden door.
Zhao Gui's presence inside the wooden door suddenly vanished without a trace, not leaving behind a single sign.
He furrowed his eyebrows, his first soul's Divine Sense descended, inspecting the inside of the house, but could not detect any trace of Zhao Gui either. Moreover, the Fire Horned Tribe in the village also suddenly disappeared without a trace.
"It was the same when I first arrived at this village; I didn't sense any living creatures inside. Zhao Gui and the Fire Horned Tribe suddenly appeared, and now they have disappeared just as suddenly, quite mysterious…" Yuan Ming thought to himself.
He looked at the empty village, the green tree leaves rustling "whoosh whoosh," giving off a sensation of deathly stillness.
A chill passed through Yuan Ming's heart, and he turned to leave.
As the trio's figures vanished into the Peach Forest, the previously closed wooden door slowly opened, and Zhao Gui stood by the door, seemingly unmoved.
He looked out expressionlessly in the direction Yuan Ming and the others had left, his skin gradually taking on a shade of green.
...
Yuan Ming and the others proceeded onward, protected by Zhao Gui's Daoist Technique, they were no longer affected by the illusions of the Peach Forest, moving ahead quickly. However, the Peach Forest was still expansive, and after several hours, they were still unable to fly out of it.
At this time, more and more suns began to appear in the sky, the temperature rising higher and higher, to the point of burning the skin. Lei He and Yan Xiang had to use some of their Mana to cast spells to protect themselves, slowing their pace as a result.
At that moment, Yuan Ming took out the Qing Gui Grass Hat and put it on his head.
In an instant, Yuan Ming felt a cooling sensation from head to toe, as if enveloped in cool water, and without having to utilize Protective Spiritual Light, he was already exceedingly comfortable.
Yan Xiang turned his head and saw this, a look of surprise crossing his face, "Kid, where did you get that grass hat from?"

chapters.title: Chapter 555 - 531: Going up the Mountain
chapters.content:
Although Lei He didn't speak, he looked at the Qing Gui Grass Hat atop Yuan Ming's head with a flash of astonishment in his eyes.
"Senior Zhao Gui knew my Cultivation was insufficient, and it was inconvenient for me to move around in the Peach Forest, so he gave me this hat to provide some cover," Yuan Ming explained.
"Why is he so good to you? Could it be that you have some shady deal with him!" Yan Xiang, revealing a jealous expression, said rudely.
Since meeting Zhao Gui, he had been seething with frustration, but was unable to vent it. It appeared Yuan Ming was treated quite well, which only made him even more irritated.
"Senior Yan Xiang is taking it too seriously. There's nothing indecent. It's just that previously in the Stone Forest, I had better luck and found a few Blossoming Golden Sunflowers. Senior Zhao Gui said he wouldn't take advantage of me and gave me this item in exchange for the extra sunflowers," Yuan Ming replied cheerfully, not minding at all.
Upon hearing this, a fierce light flashed in Yan Xiang's eyes, and he clenched his fists tightly, seemingly about to strike and snatch it any moment.
Seeing the situation going south, Lei He was about to say something when an unexpected change occurred.
Suddenly, there was a crackling sound. The ground under Yan Xiang's feet split open, and a dark green-black vine shot out like a Spiritual Snake, quickly entwining his legs.
Yan Xiang cried out in alarm, but reacted swiftly. A Red Light flashed over the palm of his hand, and the large red sword appeared out of thin air, striking sharply without hesitation, chopping fiercely at the dark green-black vine.
With a muffled "bang", the sword was rebounded, and only a shallow mark was left on the vine.
"How is this possible!" Yan Xiang was shocked, as the red sword was an Eight Rune Treasure!
Yuan Ming and Lei He also looked alarmed.
Lei He was about to turn around and rescue him, but in the next moment, his eyes widened, his body paused, and his expression changed unpredictably.
Suddenly, Yan Xiang let out a miserable scream, and his legs shriveled visibly as numerous tiny thorns sprouted from the vine and pierced into Yan Xiang's legs.
Not only that, numerous hair-like dark green-black fine roots shot out densely from the vine, prickling into Yan Xiang's other body parts.
Yan Xiang continued to struggle violently, but he was utterly unable to free himself from the vine entwining him. His body began to shrink as if being drained, and his vitality rapidly faded.
Lei He's pupils constricted, and without hesitation, he turned and fled into the distance.
Given the discord between Yuan Ming and Yan Xiang, naturally, Yuan Ming ran even faster.
Boom Boom!
Several thick vines, like long dragons, burst from the ground, lunging at Yuan Ming and the other.
Yuan Ming used the Ghost Shadow Escape Technique and narrowly avoided the entangling vines.
However, before he could catch his breath, countless dark green-black tree trunks and vines surged from the surrounding ground, intertwining in mid-air. In an instant, they formed a dense green-black forest, enveloping Yuan Ming and Lei He.
Under the shadow of innumerable towering trees, the originally scorching environment turned instantly gloomy, the air even tinged with moist vapor.
The lush green-black forest seemed vibrant with life, yet within its reach, all peach trees withered instantly, and the spiritual energy of heaven and earth within several hundred feet vanished in a moment, turning it into a land of death.
Suddenly, intense cold surged in a part of the forest, and the branches and leaves of the trees there were covered in solid white ice.
"Boom"
A few breaths later, a purple spear shadow broke through the ice, revealing Yuan Ming's figure.
Almost simultaneously, another part of the green-black forest burst forth with thousands of Lei Guang, and a figure enveloped in Thunder sped out—it was Lei He.
Both Yuan Ming and Lei He had pale faces now, panting heavily.
These green-black trees were terrifying. The moment they were covered by the forest, they felt their Mana, Soul Power, and Qi-Blood Power being drained rapidly at an incredible rate.
If it weren't for their respective techniques and their prompt full-strength breakouts, they might have been drained dry by now.
"Where did that monster come from, it's not something we can handle, let's go!" Lei He, his face filled with fear, pulled out an elixir, swallowed it, and transformed into a streak of Lei Guang, shooting into the distance.
Yuan Ming, having lost a great deal of his Mana and Soul Power, now with only less than thirty percent left, also took out a lotus seed, swallowed it, and his Mana rapidly recovered. Simultaneously, a flash of Lei Guang appeared beneath him, and Lei Yu's figure emerged, carrying him as they shot forward.
A loud "boom" resounded from behind them!
A Red Fire Phoenix, bursting through the green-black forest, pursued Yuan Ming and the others, turning everything it touched along the way to ash.
Lei He, without slowing down, looked back and his face showed surprise.
Yuan Ming glanced at the Fire Phoenix, also startled.
Wrapped within the ferocious Fire Phoenix was a figure—remarkably, it was Yan Xiang.
At that moment, his legs were severed at the knees, his clothes in disarray, and his appearance utterly wretched, but his eyes burned with a fiery red glare.
In his hand, he held a red feather fan, somewhat similar in appearance to the green feather fan he had earlier. At the base of the fan, there was a Phoenix embossment, and the fan itself was adorned with golden-red feathers.
The surface of the red feather fan radiated brightly, emitting a terrifying Spiritual Pressure, causing Yuan Ming's chest to feel tight even from a distance.
"This fan must be a replica of a Spiritual Treasure; its power is probably not inferior to my Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear," Yuan Ming marveled inwardly, acknowledging that Nascent Soul cultivators were indeed no ordinary people.
Suddenly, a roar came from within the green forest, and the myriad trees rapidly receded, vanishing in the blink of an eye, replaced by a tall figure with green skin and hair—the strange man.
This strange man looked similar to Hua Zhi when transformed into human form, and he was rapidly approaching Yuan Ming and the others.
The green strange man ran extremely fast, on par with those practicing Body Cultivation, his legs flashing with a layer of green light. With each step, he advanced tens of meters through the air as if using the Wood Shield Technique, quickly closing in on the three men.
"Scatter and escape, regroup at the base of the giant peak," Lei He shouted loudly, transforming into a streak of thunder and shooting to the left front.
Yuan Ming almost simultaneously slapped Lei Yu beneath him, turning into a streak of thunder, sweeping to the right.
Yan Xiang, seriously injured, was half a beat slower in reacting, cursing the others for their cunning, and he could only continue forward reluctantly.
The spiritual intelligence of the green strange man seemed not high, instinctively following the previous direction and chasing after Yan Xiang.
Sensing this scene through his Divine Sense, Yuan Ming breathed a sigh of relief, controlled Lei Yu to circle a wide path, and then headed towards the giant peak.
...
One day and one night later.
The towering mountain peaked into the clouds, covered in brilliant golden color, seeming as if crafted from gold, like the sun from the heavens, fallen to earth.
At the foot of the mountain, three streaks of light flew out from a nearby peach forest, it was Yuan Ming, Lei He, and Yan Xiang.
A cloud of dust closely followed the three, the ground vibrating under them, as over a dozen green strange men chased after them.
Yuan Ming and the others had initially scattered to escape, but another dozen green strange men emerged from within the peach forest, chasing after Yuan Ming and Lei He separately, forcing the trio back together.
With this episode, the conflict between Yan Xiang and Yuan Ming naturally had to be put aside.
With the tunneling speed of the three, they arrived at the base of the peak in the blink of an eye, where a winding path led up the mountain, with several palaces faintly visible along the sides, arranged somewhat irregularly.
"These Tree Men are persistently haunting us from behind; continuing like this is not a solution," Lei He said in a muffled voice.
"Forget about them, just climb up the mountain!" Yan Xiang said with a cold snort.
Along the way, he had used some secret technique to heal his legs, his tunneling light showing no intent to pause, directly changing direction and flying toward the mountaintop.
However, just as Yan Xiang stepped over the mountain's base and hadn't yet flown higher, he suddenly plummeted heavily, crashing to the ground.
In a cloud of dust, Yan Xiang coughed as he rose, dispersing the dust, his face displeased as he watched Lei He and Yuan Ming land steadily behind him.
"Fellow Daoist Yan Xiang, you were too hasty. In a place like this, how could there not be a flight restriction?" Lei He shook his head and said.
"We have to try. Those Tree Men are right behind us. How could we outrun them by climbing the mountain slowly!" Yan Xiang huffed, flying up the mountain path.
Lei He and Yuan Ming followed closely behind.
The green strange men also caught up, but stopped short in front of the golden peak.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming and the others were all pleased.
"It seems the Tree Men are a trial of the peach forest, they stop at the peak," Lei He exhaled lightly, expressing his happiness.
Although the mountain path was forbidden for flying, it did not prohibit using Escape Techniques, and the three quickly disappeared ahead.
The green strange men flailed their arms and legs, letting out roars of anger, but did not climb the mountain.To report errors, please visit the original post on *.
Yuan Ming and the others ran a good distance, seeing that the green strange men indeed did not follow, they finally let their tense hearts relax.
However, they did not slow their pace, climbing with all their might.
Soon, the trio reached the nearest palace, but the great doors of the palace lay fallen to the side, the adjacent walls covered in marks from swords and axes, as if forcefully breached.
The three quickly searched inside, and as expected, found no treasures.
"Humph! Just as I thought, someone got here ahead of us, took everything, and if we don't move faster, we'll miss out even on the soup!" Yan Xiang emerged from the palace, his face looking extremely gloomy.
Afterwards, the trio hastened their steps, encountering several more palaces along the way, all similarly broken into, with their contents taken.
Lei He and Yan Xiang hurried along increasingly faster, while Yuan Ming wasn't as rushed, following behind them, constantly using his Divine Sense to scan the surroundings.
It wasn't just the palaces; some paths on the mountain showed signs of battle, clearly indicating the mountain path was also dangerous and not to be underestimated.
A quarter of an hour later, the three reached an area near the middle of the mountain, their expressions changing slightly as sounds of fighting faintly came from ahead.
Lei He and Yan Xiang exchanged glances and immediately swept towards the direction of the sounds, quickly arriving at a flat area on the mountain waist.
There stood a majestic golden hall with its door tightly shut, yet unbreached.
In the open space before the hall, Island Master Gu Xuanyang was controlling a golden Flying Sword Magic Treasure, clashing with two Golden Stone Strange Beasts, whose bodies resembled those of fierce lions, towering more than three meters tall and tough as iron. Gu Xuanyang's Flying Sword, however, was incomparably sharp, nearly every strike able to shear off parts of the beasts' bodies.
The two Strange Beasts Gu Xuanyang was facing were already covered in wounds, with one having nearly half of its body cleaved off, and the other missing a hind leg, various sizes of gold and stone fragments scattered around on the ground.
In contrast, the Jade Dust Brush wielded by Daoist Qian Bao managed to have little effect on the Golden Stone Strange Beasts, with the white silk he spun being frequently severed by the fire spewed by the beasts.
Daoist Qian Bao, through the use of talismans and other methods, barely managed to maintain an unbeatable position, appearing quite embarrassed with his clothes also having some scorched marks, evidently scorched while dodging carelessly.

chapters.title: Chapter 556 - 532 Dragon King
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming and his two companions did not conceal their approach, so Gu Xuanyang detected their presence immediately.
His face showed no significant change of expression. He simply quickened the movements of the sword technique in his hand, as if to hurry up and finish off the two Golden Stone Strange Beasts before him.
Just as he swung his sword to decapitate the one creature left with only half a body, planning to turn and kill the other, a bizarre scene unfolded.
The slightly smaller beast that was entangled with Daoist Qian Bao suddenly leaped into the air, its body emitting a dazzling golden light.
The next moment, including the two beasts entangled with Gu Xuanyang and fragments of golden stone of various sizes scattered on the ground, they all converged toward the smaller beast and fused together, transforming into a gigantic golden beast several zhang high.
The golden giant beast leaped down, not pursuing the ill-fated Daoist Qian Bao anymore, but instead lunging ferociously towards Gu Xuanyang, its huge mouth faintly spitting white, fierce flames.
At the same time, Gu Xuanyang had already launched several Sword Qi from his golden flying sword towards the giant beast, slicing off chunks of gold and stone. However, for such an enormous creature, these were but superficial wounds, barely making an impression.
When the golden giant beast was only two or three zhang away from Gu Xuanyang, he no longer controlled the flying sword. Instead, with a sudden change of his sword technique in one hand, he swept his other hand out from his sleeve.
In the next breath, a piercing green Sword Qi spiraled out from Gu Xuanyang's sleeve, splitting into nine as it cut horizontally across the massive Golden Stone Strange Beast.
The Golden Stone Strange Beast was instantly sliced into several segments, as if it had suddenly become as fragile as tofu. In an instant, its body fell apart, scattering into a pile of gold and stone debris on the ground, dead on the spot.
The nine strands of green Sword Qi merged back into one, forming a single majestic Sword Qi that continued to shoot forward without losing speed, striking the golden palace behind it.
A corner of the palace was cut off as if it was made of mud, and the grand Sword Qi continued unabated, striking the golden mountain behind it.
With a booming rumble, a gigantic sword mark, tens of zhang long, appeared on the mountain, causing the golden mountain to shake. Countless small stones fell as if an earthquake was occurring.
Seeing the situation turning grim, Yuan Ming and the others had already retreated. They stopped their bodies a hundred zhang away.
Yuan Ming's heart was secretly shocked. This golden mountain was extraordinarily sturdy, and Gu Xuanyang's previously controlled flying sword did not possess such formidable power. The sword that was wielded from his sleeve had left behind such an alarming mark, and he wondered what kind of exotic treasure it was!
After Gu Xuanyang finished killing the strange beast, he recalled his golden flying sword, glanced at Yuan Ming and his two companions, and gave a light command, "Qian Bao, go and check inside the hall."
"Yes!"
Daoist Qian Bao agreed with a sound and entered the palace through the sliced opening.
However, before he went in, he suddenly turned his head and glanced at Yuan Ming.
"Master, that Core Formation Cultivator is Yuan Ming," he quietly transmitted.
Gu Xuanyang's eyes flickered slightly, but his expression did not change.
Although Yuan Ming was unaware of their private communication, he noticed Gu Xuanyang's gaze on him, which made him frown.
On the other side, Lei He and Yan Xiang managed to rein in their shock and came forward with hands clasped, "We didn't expect to meet Fellow Daoist Gu here, you..."
Unexpectedly, Gu Xuanyang did not let them finish and interrupted both dismissively, "What are you two doing here? Did you use some kind of trick to sneak onto the island?"
Lei He, sensing that Gu Xuanyang seemed to be blaming them, quickly replied, "Fellow Daoist Gu has misunderstood. We were all on Fusang Island waiting for the Immortal Fruit Conference to end when suddenly something unusual happened on the island..."
Lei He repeated the process of coming here he had told Yuan Ming earlier.
While listening to his words, Gu Xuanyang's frown deepened, and anger surfaced on his face.
"Hmph, this must be the doing of that bastard, the Heavenly Puppet Venerable!" Gu Xuanyang couldn't help but curse in anger.
Upon hearing this, the expressions of Yuan Ming and his companions changed slightly.
"The Dawn Alliance's men also reached Fusang Island?" Yuan Ming's mind stirred, and he asked.
Upon hearing this, Gu Xuanyang glanced at Yuan Ming and seemed to realize he shouldn't have mentioned this. He immediately let out a cold snort and closed his mouth in silence.
However, seeing his reaction, Yuan Ming guessed part of it – it was likely Ni Mu had shown up.
"Fellow Daoist Gu, since you have important matters to attend to here, the three of us will not disturb you any further. We shall part ways here," Lei He stepped forward and said, cupping his fist.
"Life is precious, and the mountain is unpredictable with fortune and misfortune. If you return now, you might be able to keep safe," Gu Xuanyang said with just a faint smile.
"We don't need you to worry about that," Yan Xiang replied, not at all politely.
Gu Xuanyang, surprised by the response, suddenly had an unfriendly look in his eyes, and asked word by word, "What did you say?"
Yan Xiang, not intimidated at all, let out a cold laugh, about to speak, when Lei He cut in.
"Fellow Daoist Gu, Fellow Daoist Yan Xiang is just hot-tempered, please don't mind him. We'll take our leave now. We each go our own way, without conflict. How about that?" Lei He did not want to confront this seasoned Nascent Soul cultivator and tried to smooth things over.
Gu Xuanyang was not receptive at all and said, "I've told you it's not suitable for you to go up the mountain, and that means it's not suitable. If you really think you are capable, why not try to pass me first?"
"This..." Lei He was angry but did not dare to show it, his face showing his dilemma.
"No more nonsense. If you truly wish to obstruct us today, then let's give it a try," Yan Xiang's anger had surged, his eyes glaring as he shouted.
Upon seeing this, Gu Xuanyang did not get mad but laughed and said, "Then I would really like to see how much weight you hold."
With that said, he suddenly raised his hand and threw a palm strike towards Yan Xiang.
Yuan Ming saw a "break" character within a golden rune emerge in the palm of his hand, emitting a golden light.
A gold-colored giant palm, about a dozen feet tall, immediately condensed, carrying the oppressive aura of a Nascent Soul cultivator. It pressed the air so violently that it emitted a buzzing sound, and swiftly descended upon Yan Xiang's head.
The dust and smoke swirling in the void around them shattered under the might of the giant palm.
Although Yuan Ming stood quite some distance away, he could still distinctly feel the forceful and piercing oppression emanating from the palm strike. It was as if the palm were even sharper than the edge of a blade.Readaheadandgetupdatesat*.
Amidst his surprise, he recalled the information about Golden Turtle Island that Yan Siyun had helped him to gather earlier, which seemed to mention one of the Six Extremes of Golden Turtle Island, the Golden Turtle Mountain Breaking Strike.
Judging from the current circumstances, it was likely that Gu Xuanyang was using that very technique.
Seeing this, a flash of solemnity crossed Yan Xiang's eyes.
With a twist of his wrist, a crimson Feather Fan appeared in his palm and he brandished it towards the golden giant palm.
As he shook his wrist, the feathers of the crimson fan fluttered, its surface glowing with increasing brightness.
Suddenly, it was as if the Feather Fan had caught fire, stirring up a surge of intense, undulating red light that drew a circle in the air before charging fiercely towards the giant golden palm.
"Whoosh, whoosh, whoosh"
The flying red light ignited in the air, transforming into a flaming lion that crashed into the golden giant palm.
A resounding boom echoed.
A dazzling blaze of fire exploded, and the golden giant palm disintegrated into tiny specks of light, dispersing into the void.
"Is that Feather Fan the one from before?" Yuan Ming felt the residual ripples in the void, a peculiar emotion arising in him.
Just as shocked were Lei He and Gu Xuanyang.
"Is that the Mystic Fire Fan, a replica of the Ancient Spiritual Treasure, the Heavenly Fan?" Gu Xuanyang frowned slightly and asked, revealing a serious demeanor.
"What do you think, want to try again?" Yan Xiang tugged at the corner of his mouth and asked.
"I originally thought this treasure was in the hands of the master of Karma Fire Island. I had no idea it was in your possession." Instead of anger, Gu Xuanyang looked at Yan Xiang with newfound respect.
Just then, Daoist Qian Bao rushed out of the hall, his eyes narrowing slightly upon seeing the standoff.
As he was about to speak, two figures hurried over.
Long Chong, who arrived in a rush, immediately saw Yuan Ming and exclaimed with joy, "Brother Yuan, I've finally found you."
Without waiting for the others' reactions, he rushed to Yuan Ming's side and clapped him on the shoulder.
"How did you end up here?" Yuan Ming asked, puzzled, but slightly relieved to see that Long Chong was unharmed.
"Sigh, after entering that Transmission Array, I knew nothing. When I woke up, I found myself on Golden Sunflower Island. Luckily, I met my father or I wouldn't have been able to come here," Long Chong sighed and said.
Hearing this, Yuan Ming looked toward the "Dragon King," who was walking toward them with Long Chong, the Golden Transformation Master and Island Master of Thousand Dragon Island.
"Greetings to my senior," Yuan Ming greeted with folded hands.
The Golden Transformation Master, without much expression, nodded in acknowledgment, scanning the surroundings before asking, "What happened here?"
"That Golden Turtle Island Master was trying to claim the mountain for himself, barring us from climbing further," Yuan Ming said, seizing the opportunity now that reinforcements had arrived.
Gu Xuanyang furrowed his brow upon hearing this.
So they're not allowed to climb the mountain, but what's this nonsense about claiming the mountain as his kingdom?
"Heh, Venerable Gu, you're still as domineering as ever," Golden Transformation Master commented with a smile at Gu Xuanyang.
Gu Xuanyang's brow creased slightly as he looked at the group before him.
He might have dismissed the others, but the arrival of Golden Transformation Master warranted his cautious consideration.
"Hmph, let's go," Gu Xuanyang snorted coldly and turned to leave.
Daoist Qian Bao glanced at Yuan Ming and the others, quickly following Gu Xuanyang.
Lei He and Yan Xiang, not bothering to greet Yuan Ming's group, immediately chased after them.
"Let's go," called out Golden Transformation Master, and the three of them hastened toward the peak.
"Brother Yuan, do you have any news of Fellow Daoist Yun and Brother Hong?" Long Chong followed beside Yuan Ming, his voice filled with concern.
"After we entered, we all got separated. I haven't seen Fellow Daoist Yun on my way here, and Yan Xiang and the others haven't mentioned him either. But you know their strength; they'll definitely be fine," Yuan Ming reassured, patting Long Chong's shoulder with a smile.
Long Chong managed a forced smile at Yuan Ming's words but was clearly not much relieved.
However, now was not the time to dwell on these concerns, so he hurriedly caught up with the others.

chapters.title: Chapter 557 - 533 Fire Burning Stick
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming and his two companions closely followed Yan Xiang and his companion, quickly heading towards the peak. Shortly thereafter, they arrived at a slightly more level platform where two grand palaces with golden roofs and red walls stood facing each other at a distance.
Gu Xuanyang and Daoist Qian Bao, who were at the forefront, had already rushed towards the palace on the right.
Around that palace, golden circular arrays emerged on the ground, forming a golden light Forbidden that enveloped the entire building in the manner of a Golden Bell.
Without a word, Gu Xuanyang continuously bombarded the golden light Forbidden with the Golden Turtle Mountain Breaking Strike. Huge palm prints kept beating against the Golden Bell protective shield, causing the Forbidden to tremble violently, issuing "clang clang" sounds of golden iron clashing.
Yan Xiang and Lei He, following closely behind, saw this and did not hesitate to fling themselves at the palace to the left, also beginning to attempt to break the Forbidden.
The two palaces were identical in style, and there was no difference in their Forbidden.
Even under Gu Xuanyang's sustained attacks, the Forbidden had yet to be broken, and Yan Xiang and his companion were falling even further behind.
Yuan Ming and his companions arrived and immediately took action as well.
With the combined efforts of the five, the speed of breaking the Forbidden visibly accelerated. Observing the Forbidden's golden light fading bit by bit, it seemed that in just a short while, they would be able to enter the palace and search for treasures.
Expressions of joy appeared on everyone's faces involuntarily. Gu Xuanyang, on the other hand, had a slightly unpleasant expression and increased the intensity of his attacks.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan..."
As Yuan Ming was exerting himself in the attack, a voice from the Shura Blood Devouring Map Artifact Spirit suddenly sounded in his Sea of Consciousness.
"What is it?" he couldn't help but feel a slight shock, asking the question through transmitted thought.
"This Forbidden is about to be broken, and I have something extremely important to inform you of beforehand," said the Artifact Spirit.
Yuan Ming's attack slowed instinctively, as he sensed something amiss. He was very familiar with the Artifact Spirit's voice but the tone was entirely different from before.
"What is it?" Yuan Ming asked while continuing to use the Magic Treasure to attack the palace's Forbidden.
"After you enter this palace, nothing else matters but the black stick leaning against the wall by the door. It is of utmost importance, and must not fall into the hands of others. Remember, remember," the voice of the Artifact Spirit urged.
"Shura Blood Devouring Map Artifact Spirit wouldn't know these things. Who exactly are you? Have you controlled the Artifact Spirit?" Yuan Ming's voice suddenly turned cold, as he questioned through transmitted thought.
Although not a Cultivator, the Artifact Spirit was also an entity with a Divine Soul. His Divine Soul was growing increasingly powerful, and Yuan Ming could feel that the Artifact Spirit's Soul Wave at this moment was different from before.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan has keen observation, indeed. I am not the Artifact Spirit. I merely have some connection with the Shura Blood Devouring Map and am communicating with you through this treasure. The matter is of great importance; I hope you don't take offense," said the Artifact Spirit with a chuckle.
"Of great importance? Who are you, if I may ask?" Yuan Ming's thoughts raced as he inquired.
"You may call me Qi Ye," said the Artifact Spirit.
"Qi Ye? Please forgive my ignorance; I have never heard of Fellow Daoist's esteemed name. Are you a native of the Eastern Sea?" Yuan Ming asked thoughtfully.
"I come from the Overseas World and am not a person from the Eastern Sea. Naturally, you wouldn't know of me," chuckled Qi Ye.
"Fellow Daoist comes from the Overseas World! The world beyond the outer sea?" Yuan Ming exclaimed in surprise.
"Indeed," said Qi Ye calmly.
Yuan Ming fell silent. He had only heard of one person from the Overseas World, the foreign visitor who had given the Shura Blood Devouring Map to the Shura Master. And now, another such individual had appeared.
Wait, this person just said they had some connection with the Shura Blood Devouring Map, which was how they could control the Artifact Spirit to communicate with him—could it be...Need character sheets and glossaries? Visit *.
"It turns out the senior is the foreign visitor from Overseas. My apologies for any disrespect. Presently, there are many Cultivators on Three Immortals Island, including several at the Nascent Soul Stage. Why would senior divulge matters of the black stick to me, a mere Core Formation Stage cultivator? With senior's capabilities, even without the Shura Blood Devouring Map as a medium, communication with others should not be difficult," Yuan Ming probed purposefully.
"I divulged this information to you for two reasons. Firstly because you possess the Shura Blood Devouring Map, and secondly, I sensed the aura of the Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill on you and felt some connection between us. As for the others, I do not trust them," chuckled Qi Ye.
With these words, Yuan Ming was almost certain that this individual was the foreign visitor who had entrusted the Shura Blood Devouring Map to the Shura Master.
"I see. Senior must also be on Three Immortals Island at this time, right? Why not show yourself in person?" he inquired.
"Ah, it's not that I'm unwilling, but rather incapable. You must have guessed my identity since you subdued the Shura Blood Devouring Map. To be candid, I am currently trapped on an isolated island and utterly unable to free myself. My reaching out to you, aside from the two reasons mentioned before, is that I hope you could help release me from my predicament for the Shura Blood Devouring Map's sake," sighed Qi Ye as he explained.
"How does senior wish for my help?" asked Yuan Ming after a brief contemplation upon hearing this.
"Speaking now would be of no use; first, you need to acquire that black stick. Once you have it, you will know what to do next. Of course, I won't let you make the effort in vain. As a reward, I will help you obtain a real Spiritual Treasure on Three Immortals Island," Qi Ye offered.
"Spiritual Treasure!"
Upon hearing these two words, Yuan Ming's heartbeat involuntarily quickened.
The significance of this item in the heart of any Core Formation, no, any Nascent Soul cultivator was immeasurable. After all, even a mere imitation of a Spiritual Treasure could exert great power beyond what a Magic Treasure could, significantly enhancing one's own strength, let alone a real Spiritual Treasure.
Although he already possessed the Shura Blood Devouring Map, when it came to treasures like Spiritual Treasures, more was always better.
However, Yuan Ming was not so easily swayed by Qi Ye's tempting words. He could not confirm the truth of what he'd said, nor even the identity of Qi Ye.
Who knows if this is one of the trials of Three Immortals Island?
"If senior cannot explain how you can help me clearly, I think it's better to wait until after we have broken through the forbidden restrictions, and then we can discuss," Yuan Ming said indifferently.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan... I can communicate with you through the Artifact Spirit for only a short time, and if we continue talking, he will discover us. You must trust me, I have no intention to harm you, and you must do as I say, or not only will I remain trapped on Three Immortals Island, but you, Fellow Daoist, will eventually be unable to escape death..." Qi Ye's tone became somewhat urgent, but before he could finish, his voice gradually silenced.
His last words, nearly pleading in tone, made Yuan Ming rather believe him a bit.
However, his reason was always present; he could not simply trust someone he had never met based on their words alone. He remained skeptical in his heart, ready to wait and see what would happen.
"Speaking of which, who is this 'he' that Qi Ye is referring to in his speech? He seems quite afraid of that 'he'," Yuan Ming pondered with curiosity.
As he was musing, the sound of a dragon's cry filled the air, and Golden Transformation Master struck down heavily with his palm, the restriction that had been jointly attacked by several people finally collapsed, unable to maintain itself any longer, and turned into golden light that scattered and shattered.
They were all overjoyed, jostling each other to push open the doors of the great hall and enter.
Almost at the same moment, the great hall opposite also burst open, and Gu Xuanyang and Daoist Qian Bao slipped inside.
After walking through a short corridor, the space in front of Yuan Ming and his companions suddenly opened up, revealing a spacious hall about fifty or sixty zhang in length and width.
The light inside the hall was rather dim, yet it did not affect everyone's vision. Almost at the same time, everyone's gaze was drawn to a golden desk set up in front of them.
On the golden desk lay a wholly red furnace, an ancient dark red painting, a fist-sized red orb, and an exquisitely made red shuttle.
Yuan Ming's gaze was drawn over only for a moment; he immediately subconsciously looked toward the wall beside the door behind him.
Just as Qi Ye had said, behind the door on the right side of the wall, there was an arm-thick, forearm-length black stick, slantingly inserted into a crack in the wall, looking like a dirty fire-burning stick, not at all eye-catching.
Taking advantage of the others' hasty rush toward the golden desk, Yuan Ming quietly pulled the black fire-burning stick from the wall without making a sound, and without even having time to look closely at it, he immediately stored it in his storage magic tool.
And at the moment he pulled out the fire-burning stick, a golden light suddenly lit up in the gap in the wall, and a fluttering golden page flew out from inside.
"This is..." Without any hesitation, Yuan Ming immediately grabbed it, discreetly taking the golden page into the palm of his hand.
As he touched the golden page, it turned into a speck of golden light that entered his palm, and at the same time, a message also directly penetrated his mind.
Yuan Ming's expression slightly changed, his gaze flickered a few times before quickly returning to calm.
Fortunately, the others were currently hotly disputing over the treasures on the desk, immersed in their excitement. None of them noticed Yuan Ming's small movements and the change in his expression at the back.
Yuan Ming's mind sank into his Sea of Consciousness, and he discovered that an additional golden page had appeared there, densely covered with text totaling several thousand words.
In the blank space on the right side of the page, four large characters were written vertically in ancient seal script: "Golden Sunflower Heavenly Book."
"Golden Sunflower Heavenly Book... could this be the Golden Sunflower Heavenly Book?"
Yuan Ming's face remained calm, but a storm had already risen in his heart.
Suppressing his excitement, he began to read the text on the golden page carefully.
The page contained a secret technique known as "Six Jia Qimen." The content was not much, but it was profound. If one did not have a foundation in mathematics, it would not be easy to understand.
Luckily, Yuan Ming had a broad range of knowledge and quickly understood the crux of it. He learned that it was a secret technique based on the Eight Diagrams Directions that incorporated Qimen Changes. It enabled one to take objects out of thin air and also allowed for the swapping of one's spatial position with other things through secret techniques; if applied properly in combat against an enemy, it could lead to surprise victories.
While he was contemplating the "Six Jia Qimen" secret technique, the others had already finished distributing the treasures on the table and had reached a preliminary agreement.
Golden Transformation Master took the red furnace into his bag, Lei He seized the ancient painting, and Yan Xiang got the red orb. The only thing was that when Long Chong tried to take the red shuttle, an accident occurred.
The object was quite odd; when Long Chong grabbed it, its surface flashed with a red light, and it disappeared instantly from his hands.
When Long Chong attempted to grab it again, the object, like a living thing, flashed away, heading toward the direction of the hall's doors.
Yan Xiang was delighted and quickly waved his palm forward. Before his hand could reach it, flames condensed into a red palm which grabbed the red shuttle.
However, just when he thought he had succeeded, the red shuttle within the red palm flashed again and disappeared without a trace.
Golden Transformation Master, who had taken up the red furnace, arrived with a flash, and raised his hand to condense a blue mass of water to engulf the red shuttle. Yet the moment it touched the object, it flashed once more with light and turned into a red beam, heading straight outside the hall at an extremely fast speed.
Standing at the doorway, Yuan Ming instinctively moved to act, but his expression suddenly shifted. The hand he had just raised lowered once again.
At that moment, two figures hurriedly approached from outside the hall, it was Gu Xuanyang and Daoist Qian Bao.
They also noticed the red shuttle speeding towards them, and their faces immediately showed a look of surprise and pleasure, inwardly cursing Golden Transformation Master and the others as useless.
Gu Xuanyang made sealing motions with both hands in front of him, and golden light burst forth from his palms. Unlike the sharp aura when he had performed the Golden Turtle Mountain Breaking Strike earlier, it was now a soft force like golden silk wrapping around his hands.
With his palms pushing forward, a golden vortex sprang from his hands, aiming for the red light.
As the red shuttle neared the golden vortex, it was suddenly pulled in as if jerked forward, despite there being some distance, and crashed directly into the vortex.

chapters.title: Chapter 558 - 534 Groove
chapters.content:
"Golden Turtle Swallowing Sky Technique..." Yuan Ming muttered to himself with a slight frown upon seeing this.
The technique that Gu Xuanyang was using was also one of the Six Extremes of Golden Turtle Island, capable of devouring the spiritual power of any magic treasure. He would have to be extremely careful when battling against it.
This time, the red shuttle did not disappear in a flash of light as it had before.
In just a moment, the red light on the red shuttle had completely faded, and it wobbled slightly as it fell to the ground.
Daoist Qian Bao's eyes lit up with excitement, and with a flash, he rushed towards the red shuttle.
However, before he could reach it, a golden silhouette flashed out from the hall's entrance and snatched the shuttle first, retreating back outside the grand hall.
The crowd turned their gazes in that direction, only to find that it was none other than the Golden Cloud Fairy.
"Fellow Daoist Jin Yun, what is the meaning of this?" Daoist Qian Bao asked in a deep voice.
"Fellow Daoist Qian Bao, securing treasure in the secret realm is what counts. Next time, you should be a bit faster," Golden Cloud Fairy replied coolly and without a smile.
"Is this a treasure we secured that you really want to claim for yourself?" Daoist Qian Bio asked, frowning deeply.
Having his seized treasure snatched away was something he could least tolerate in his life. Seeing that Golden Cloud Fairy had no intention of returning it, forgetting the camaraderie of fighting side by side earlier, a trace of ruthlessness flashed through his eyes.
"Fellow Daoist Qian Bao, you jest, this..." Before Golden Cloud Fairy could finish speaking, Daoist Qian Bao had already made his move.
He waved both sleeves simultaneously, and three streams of treasure light immediately shot out from his sleeves. These were a gold-colored short axe, a silver long sword, and a yellow flying wheel, rapidly streaking toward Golden Cloud Fairy.
All three magic treasures were clearly extraordinary; even from a distance, their intense spiritual pressure could be felt.
"These are the Golden Turtle Axe, Silver Turtle Sword, and Copper Turtle Wheel! With all three combined, Daoist Qian Bao is truly striking with deadly force," Yuan Ming thought to himself.
Golden Cloud Fairy, however, appeared utterly fearless. She made no motion to dodge, and with an upward gesture, her palm lit up with a golden-red glow.
In her palm, flames surged, and a bowl-shaped cover made of fire-red feathers appeared.
Then, flames erupted from the bowl-shaped feather cover, emitting sharp, piercing cries like those of birds.
Suddenly, nine Golden Crow illusions burst forth, each wielding crimson gold wings and streaking rapidly forward. Three of them collided with the three magic treasures, instantly causing a booming sound to echo.
The space trembled from the impact, and the Golden Turtle Axe, Silver Turtle Sword, and Copper Turtle Wheel were all forcefully repelled by the Golden Crows.
The remaining six Golden Crow illusions continued their assault directly towards Daoist Qian Bao.
The spiritual power upheaval caused by the repelled treasures left Daoist Qian Bao's breathing disordered, and in his haste, he could not muster enough mana for defense.
"Audacious!"
Gu Xuanyang, who was on guard against Yan Xiang and Golden Transformation Master, saw Daoist Qian Bao in danger and immediately shouted sharply, rushing forward to shield Daoist Qian Bao.
He raised his hand and struck out with another Golden Turtle Mountain Breaking Strike, forming a wall-like palm print in the void, blocking the four Golden Crows head-on.
As the Golden Crows crashed into the golden palm print, they exploded, dispersing the fiery waves that also scattered the golden palm print.
The two remaining Golden Crow illusions bypassed the sides and continued their direct charge at Daoist Qian Bao.
Without retracting his previously swung hand, Gu Xuanyang reached out into the void with his other hand, summoning an ancient golden round mirror in his palm, which he then directed towards the two Golden Crow illusions.
Uploaded by the *) team.
The mirror emitted golden light, and the moment it bathed the two Golden Crows, they seemed to be fixed in place, hovering motionlessly over the spots illuminated by the mirror's light.
Then, with a wavelike motion, Gu Xuanyang's hand grasped a gold-patterned ancient bronze sword from the void, slashing directly at Golden Cloud Fairy's head.
A piercingly sharp cyan sword light burst forth, its sharp force slicing through the void; in almost a blink, it was right above Golden Cloud Fairy's head.
The Golden Cloud Fairy quickly maneuvered her Fire Feather Cover above her head, transforming it into a massive red light shield to protect her figure.
The golden sword light, incomparably sharp, touched the light shield for just an instant, tearing through the red light shield emitted by the Fire Feather Cover, striking down on its body.
The Fire Feather Cover trembled, each feather releasing its protective power, but ultimately it could not withstand the piercing sword light. Amidst fluttering fire-red feathers, it was torn to shreds.
Just as the Fire Feather Cover split in two, and the protected Golden Cloud Fairy seemed doomed, a streak of red light dashed out from Golden Cloud Fairy's body, transforming into a middle-aged man in red clothes who stood in front of her.
The moment the red-clothed man appeared, the temperature of the surrounding air instantly rose by several degrees, with ripples of heat waves emanating from him.
He reached up with his hand, and a golden light claw materialized in the void, directly grasping the piercing sword light.
Intense heat emitted from the golden claw, causing the piercing sword light to collapse and dissipate in moments.
"I wondered which Fellow Daoist it was, turns out it's Senior Jin Chao making an appearance, no, you are just a clone," Gu Xuanyang, seeing the abruptly appearing man in red, paused in surprise before bursting into laughter, sheathing the ancient bronze sword.
"Jin Chao! This man is none other than the Level 5 Golden Crow under the Fusang Tree!" Yuan Ming exclaimed in shock upon hearing this.
Yan Siyun had been collecting intelligence in the East Sea Immortal Cultivation World, and the Level 5 Golden Crow, naturally being of vital importance, was none other than the great demon Jin Chao.
"What's the matter, Fellow Daoist Gu, do you find my clone insufficient and wish to test my strength?" the man in red said coldly.
"Where are these words coming from, Senior Jin Chao? How dare I compare myself in front of you! Just now, my young disciple was in peril, and I had no choice but to lend a hand. I hope Senior Jin Chao can forgive me," Gu Xuanyang apologized with a bow.
Since their previous encounter, Gu Xuanyang had always been arrogant and despotic, yet he was so humble and submissive before this man in red, but Yan Xiang and the others did not mock him.
A Level 5 Golden Crow is indeed the pinnacle of the East Sea Immortal Cultivation World, and any island master who meets one must rightly call themselves the younger generation.
"Let it be, considering this is your first offense, let this matter rest here, but not again," the Jin Chao clone said indifferently.
"Thank you, Senior Jin Chao, for your magnanimity. Your Nine Transferences Spirit Attachment technique is even more mystical than before; I was completely undetectable, no wonder Jin Yun acts with such confidence—it's because she has Senior Jin Chao to protect her. But I wonder, why is it just a clone of yours here?" Gu Xuanyang said with a smile.
"Enough, there's no need for further probing. My true body is elsewhere on the Three Immortals Island. Here on Golden Sunflower Island, just one clone is enough to protect Jin Yun," the Jin Chao clone admitted candidly without any concealment.
Upon hearing that Jin Chao's true body was not present, Gu Xuanyang felt slightly relieved.
"Everyone, I don't care about the rest, but since Jin Yun has taken the red shuttle, it belongs to us now, and I plan to take it away. Who agrees? Who objects?" Jin Chao glanced over the crowd with a commanding gaze.
"I have no objections," Lei He was the first to shake his head and speak.
Yan Xiang shook his head; he had obtained the Red Orb and was not empty-handed, so naturally, he did not think of competing.
Jin Hua glanced at Long Chong and then shook his head too.
Gu Xuanyang remained silent, but Daoist Qian Bao stepped forward, shook his head, and said, "If Senior Jin Chao takes it, we have no objections."
"Haha… that's good then, Jin Yun, let's go," Jin Chao laughed heartily upon hearing this and called Jin Yun to leave.
The latter's face remained as cold as ever, as if all this was of no concern to her.
Just as Jin Chao turned to leave, he suddenly turned back around, making everyone tense up once again.
However, he then directly approached Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming felt a slight tightness in his heart, yet his expression only showed a trace of surprise.
Seeing this, Long Chong instinctively moved forward but was held back by Jin Hua's glance.
"Yuan, would you like to leave with us? If you travel with us, as long as I am present, I can guarantee your safety along the way. What do you say?" Surprisingly, the Jin Chao clone extended an olive branch to Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming himself did not expect this and hesitated noticeably.
"Thank you for your kind offer, Senior, but I have my own matters to attend to and do not wish to trouble you for protection," Yuan Ming quickly recovered and replied with a smile, shaking his head.
Hearing this, the Jin Chao clone did not insist but simply nodded and then turned away with Jin Yun.
After they had left, everyone finally relaxed completely. Gu Xuanyang was the first to call out and, together with Daoist Qian Bao, continued on their way.
Yuan Ming and the others did not immediately set off; they thoroughly searched the great hall before following the others on their journey.
...
The mountain path was long. As they ascended, they lost track of how far they had gone. The sixth sun quietly rose in the sky, and the air became steamy, causing the surrounding scenery to appear somewhat distorted.
The Immortal Mountain loomed higher; the closer they got to the sun, the hotter it became compared to the foot of the mountain, forcing the group to expend more energy on protecting themselves from the heat and to slow down their pace.
However, Yuan Ming, who followed at the back, remained comfortable. The Qing Gui Grass Hat on his head consistently maintained a cool temperature on his skin, making the sun's harshness irrelevant to him. The only downside was the overly bright light around him, which he found slightly glaring.
"Brother Yuan, that hat of yours is really something else, where did you get it?" Long Chong looked back at the composed Yuan Ming and couldn't help but ask.
At this moment, he was drenched in sweat. If not for Jin Hua's intermittent protection, he would have probably collapsed by now.
"Obtained by chance, a gift from a friend," Yuan Ming replied with a slight smile.
Hearing this, Long Chong immediately felt envious, repeatedly calling it good luck.
The group continued onward, with not much of the path left to travel, and soon they neared the summit but saw no sign of the Fire Essence Palace; instead, they were stopped by a towering wall.
The wall was painted red. Though not taller than two stories, because it was built against the mountain, it completely blocked their view. Only a cluster of treetops and the spires of several great halls could be seen beyond it.
At the entrance of the wall, Jin Chao and Gu Xuanyang were already there waiting quietly, but it was unclear why they had not entered.
However, when Yuan Ming and the others approached, they immediately understood why.
On the wall's gate, there were five different-sized recesses, and apart from these, there were no other openings; it seemed only by filling all the recesses with objects could they enter.
At that moment, two objects were already in the recesses—one was the red shuttle that Jin Chao had taken, and the other was a red gourd carved with cloud patterns.
Seeing Jin Hua and others arrive, Gu Xuanyang immediately spoke, "As you can see, to open this door, we must embed the treasures you obtained earlier. The greater opportunity and treasures lie beyond this gate. Those who do not wish to give up should step forward willingly to place their treasures; it would save everyone's face."

chapters.title: Chapter 559 - 535 Allocation
chapters.content:
Golden Transformation Master and his two companions' expressions darkened upon hearing the words, realizing that Jin Chao, standing beside Gu Xuanyang, had the same thoughts.
"Golden Transformation Daoist, what he said makes sense too. The treasures inside the Fire Essence Palace are no fewer than those outside. As they say, to gain something, one must let go of another. Handing over those treasures doesn't constitute much of a loss, plus, once the door opens, we might be able to retrieve them," Lei He secretly transmitted his thoughts.
"The logic is sound, but who are Jin Chao and Gu Xuanyang? For now, the items are still in our hands. If we hand them over, and they turn against us once the door is open, how could we possibly overpower them?" Yan Xiang seemed to distrust Jin Chao and Gu Xuanyang greatly, transmitting back.
"Alas, Fellow Daoist Yan Xiang's worries are not unfounded. The two of them have aligned interests and both covet those three treasures. The three of us might stand a chance against Gu Xuanyang alone, but with the addition of a Jin Chao clone, how could we possibly compete? In essence, their current inaction is merely to conserve Mana," Golden Transformation Master stroked his beard.
"Indeed, in my view, it might be better to do this..." Lei He suddenly came up with an idea.
Meanwhile, Gu Xuanyang, seeing that Golden Transformation Master and his group were hesitating to make a decision, instantly became annoyed, "The three of you, have you reached an agreement yet, or do I really need to fetch them myself?"
"Fellow Daoist Gu jests. With fortune before us, how could we cling to mere external objects? It's just that certain things need to be clarified in advance, otherwise we would truly be uneasy," Golden Transformation Master said with a smile.
Gu Xuanyang's brows furrowed, as if he was about to lose his temper, while Jin Chao Clone, who was beside him, suddenly spoke up, "What conditions are they? Let's hear them."
"Thank you, Senior Jin, for your understanding. Since we've come here, the gate must indeed be opened. Yet the road here was fraught with dangers, and the Fire Essence Palace is surely even more perilous. Our strengths are not formidable; hence, we wish to trade these three treasures for two promises from you and Fellow Daoist Gu," Golden Transformation Master replied.
"What promises?" Gu Xuanyang asked, frowning.
"Should we encounter danger within, we will naturally exert our full strength. However, both of you need to swear by your Heart Demons that you will not turn against us. Secondly, the treasures obtained within the Fire Essence Palace must be distributed proportionally, and no one should overpower others to seize them! Of course, those who discover treasures first or contribute the most should have priority in choosing," Golden Transformation Master said, looking towards Gu Xuanyang and Jin Chao Clone as he bowed his hands.
Gu Xuanyang sneered at this, "There's such a promise in this world? Restricting just us two while you can act freely?"
"With your strengths, how could we dare to oppose you? If anyone is foolish enough, you can naturally retaliate," Lei He quickly said.
"If that's the case, we can agree to the first promise; how is the ratio for the second promise calculated?" Jin Chao Clone inquired.
"Senior Jin and Fellow Daoist Gu each take thirty percent, and the remaining forty percent would be divided equally among the three of us," Lei He said.
"Impossible, you think you can take the larger share with just your capabilities?" Gu Xuanyang said with a sneer.
"Why would you say that, Fellow Daoist Gu? You and Senior Jin would each take thirty percent, while the three of us would only divide forty percent. Besides, opening the door requires five Magic Treasures, and we are providing three. If the share is any less, it won't be enough to go around, so it might as well end here," Golden Transformation Master shook his head, his tone firm.
"Well put, then let it be forty percent. I agree," Jin Chao Clone consented.
Gu Xuanyang's expression darkened, feeling reluctant in his heart, but he was also wary of Jin Chao Clone, and now that the others agreed, if he continued to object, it could easily make him the target of everyone's arrows - after a moment's consideration, he had to let it go.
In just a few words, the anticipated benefits were properly distributed among them, and no one paid any attention to Yuan Ming, Long Chong, Daoist Qian Bao, and Golden Cloud Fairy, as Core Formation Stage cultivators had no say in this matter.
Yuan Ming was not upset either; standing with Long Chong to one side, he silently observed the dialogue and expressions of Gu Xuanyang and the others, remaining silent.
Seeing that an agreement had been reached, Golden Transformation Master and his companions were instantly relieved; they each took out their treasures and moved forward, placing them in the slots in sequence.
When Yan Xiang placed the last treasure into the slot, everyone suddenly heard a "hum" sound, and small Arrays appeared around the five slots on the door, temporarily sealing the treasures inside.
Contentsourcedfrom*–MyVirtualLibraryEmpire.
Under everyone's gaze, the treasures sealed in the slots suddenly lit up with an orange spirit light, shooting strands of spiritual light from the slots, which interconnected and formed an even larger Array.
The moment the Array appeared, the wall-like door gradually virtualized and faded. After a few breaths, both the door and the Array disappeared, and the five treasures embedded in the slots were suspended in midair. They paused momentarily then fell to the ground.
Seeing this, Jin Chao Clone suddenly raised his hand and swept up the red Flying Shuttle into his palm.
Golden Transformation Master and his companions, seeing that Jin Chao Clone had no intention of seizing more treasures, were also pleased and immediately stepped forward to pick up their respective treasures.
Meanwhile, Gu Xuanyang, watching this scene, rubbed his fingers hidden behind his back, but ultimately did not attempt to seize anything and merely retrieved the Red Cloud Gourd.
With the disappearance of the door, the scenery behind the walls was fully revealed.
The first thing that caught everyone's eyes seemed to be a courtyard with several red-stone paths crisscrossing it into various sections; each area grew all sorts of golden and red flowers and grasses. While none were precious spiritual materials, their fragrance and appearance were unforgettable.
However, what was most eye-catching in the courtyard was the fiery-red peach tree situated in the center of the flowerbed.
The peach tree was about as thick as five people hugging it together and appeared to be the same species as those in the peach forest below the mountain. Only, its bark was rough and ancient, seemingly much older than those in the peach forest. The spiritual power within was reserved and profound, not showing off, but the flourishing vitality hidden within the trunk commanded respect.
The treetop that the people had seen over the wall originated from it.
The group approached the peach tree and looked up to find it had five fist-sized Big Red Immortal Peaches hanging from it, each containing an extremely rich concentration of spiritual power, brightening Golden Transformation Master and his companions' eyes.
Yuan Ming activated his Divine Sense to investigate. These Big Red Immortal Peaches had purple stripes on their surfaces and contained peach kernels, which were a pale yellow.
"Purple Striped Core, these are Yaochi Peaches!" Gu Xuanyang exclaimed with joy.
"Yaochi Peaches? Are they the legendary peaches that can extend one's life by a thousand years and greatly benefit one's cultivation?" Yan Xiang asked, thrilled.
"It's unmistakable. I've seen pictures of Yaochi Peach trees in classics, and this one is exactly the same!" Gu Xuanyang said, very sure.
Lei He, Golden Transformation Master, and others, upon hearing this, were also delighted, except Jin Chao's Clone who remained impassive.
"There are exactly five immortal peaches. Why don't we each take one?" Yan Xiang suggested immediately.
"Heh, how come I remember that according to the allocation ratio you mentioned earlier, it shouldn't be calculated like this?" Gu Xuanyang sneered.
Yan Xiang's expression stiffened, while the Golden Transformation Master shook his head and stepped forward to explain for him, "Fellow Daoist Yan Xiang merely feels that since there are exactly five precious peaches, there's no need to further divide them, especially since dividing these five immortal peaches in half, as per the previous distribution method, would waste so much of the peaches' Spiritual Power."
Hearing that this involved Jin Chao's interest, Gu Xuanyang furrowed his brows, about to argue, but was interrupted by Jin Chao's Clone.
"What the Golden Transformation Daoist said makes sense. Let's distribute them as Yan Xiang suggested," Jin Chao's Clone said, and with a gesture, plucked a peach using Mana from the tree. Without looking, he casually handed it to Jin Yun Fairy next to him.
Seeing this, Gu Xuanyang reluctantly swallowed his words of objection and silently plucked a peach, storing it in his Storage Ring.
The Golden Transformation Master and the others quickly stepped forward and each picked a peach, delightedly storing them in their Storage Rings.
Yuan Ming's gaze flickered, but he said nothing.
Everyone then passed by the peach tree and continued onward, soon crossing the courtyard and arriving in front of a surrounding wall.
Here was the highest point of Immortal Mountain. The sun, which had once hung high, was no longer far away, and everyone could even feel the surging heat waves and terrifying heat coming from it.
By this point, even Yuan Ming, wearing a straw hat, also felt a slight warmth, but it was still within a tolerable range, and he did not need to deploy any protective methods.
The wall in front of everyone was different from the outer one. The entrance had no door, only an empty doorway that revealed the scenery behind the wall.
Inside was a very spacious grand square, the floor paved with red jade bricks, as fiery in color as they were pure in form, without a single flaw.
The square also housed several grand halls, but merely through the doorway, the details of the halls were unclear. They too were constructed from red jade, matching the square's bricks, resembling the inner walls of a Pill Furnace during the refinement of elixirs, surrounded by intense flames from all directions.
Just as everyone was about to cross the doorway, Jin Chao's Clone suddenly stood at the forefront.
"Wait first," he said, looking at the square, without turning back.
Gu Xuanyang was a bit surprised and immediately asked, "Senior Jin, have you noticed something wrong?"
"Just wait," Jin Chao's Clone said, shaking his head without explaining.
Gu Xuanyang frowned and said no more, standing quietly to the side.
Seeing this, the Golden Transformation Master and the others dared not ask further, only conversing quietly among themselves through transmitted messages, guessing the purpose of Jin Chao's Clone's action.
Time trickled by; shortly, as the seventh sun rose in the sky, everyone felt the surrounding heat intensify, leaving them with no mood to discuss their plans, each reinforcing their Protective Body techniques against the heat.
Yuan Ming, still wearing his straw hat, though feeling the heat, remained calm and composed. Jin Chao's Clone and Jin Yun Fairy also appeared similar, seemingly not using any methods to stave off the heat.
Indistinctly, Yuan Ming noticed Jin Yun Fairy glancing at him, her expression carrying a slight surprise.
"It's time," Jin Chao's Clone suddenly said, stepping forward, crossing the second surrounding wall, entering the square. Seeing this, everyone hurriedly followed.
As soon as they stepped into the square, before they could even look around, everyone suddenly felt the temperature around them soar. The Protective Body techniques they had applied proved almost useless, as the heat waves relentlessly seared their skin. All present showed pained expressions, and Core Formation Stage cultivators like Long Chong and Daoist Qian Bao were nearly suffocating.
Even Yuan Ming felt the extreme heat unbearable, his body no longer cool, as his bodily fluids rapidly evaporated, fearing he would soon be dried out.
Facing such conditions, Yan Xiang and the others couldn't help but consider retreating. Under such sustained high temperatures, even Nascent Soul cultivators found it hard to endure.
Although they were eager to find treasures and return fully rewarded, if they were to lose their lives, no treasure would be of any use. Those present, having reached this stage, naturally understood the logic of "it's better to keep the green hills under you than to burn out."
Just then, everyone suddenly heard a "boom" sound as a tightly closed door dropped heavily behind them, completely sealing everyone inside the square.

chapters.title: Chapter 560 - 560: 536
chapters.content:
Yan Xiang turned his head to see the retreat blocked, his shock and anger surging simultaneously.
The temperature in the square continued to rise, and without a retreat, even if they found treasures, they would all be trapped alive here.
With this thought, he unhesitatingly summoned the Red Orb he had obtained earlier, and the red light from the orb intensified, conjuring hundreds of fireballs the size of millstones out of thin air above Yan Xiang's head.
Yuan Ming swept the fireballs with his Divine Sense, a flash of astonishment crossing his eyes, and he immediately stepped back a few paces from Yan Xiang.
Almost simultaneously, Golden Cloud Fairy made the same move.
Yan Xiang pointed a finger, and all the fireballs rained down like a torrent on the stone cave's door, exploding with a bang!
A string of deafening booms followed, one by one, as sizzling mushroom clouds rose, and surging waves of fire engulfed the walls near the door before exploding in flames and smoke, shaking the entire square.
Waves of impact caused all the Nascent Soul cultivators to falter, while Long Chong and Daoist Qian Bao, two Core Formation cultivators, staggered back several steps before stabilizing themselves.
Yuan Ming and Golden Cloud Fairy had already retreated and were thus not affected by the impact waves.
Yuan Ming wasn't surprised; when those fireballs appeared, he sensed their potent explosive nature. His own Fire Cloud Secret Technique's fireballs also possessed explosive properties, but they paled in comparison to these.
However, despite the remarkable power of the Red Orb, as the smoke cleared, everyone saw that the gate remained unscathed, without even a trace of scorching, let alone pits or cracks.
Now, with the exception of Jin Chao Clone and Golden Cloud Fairy, everyone's faces darkened.
Yan Xiang had not anticipated that his barrage would have no effect, and with a grim expression, he stared at the door for a moment before leaping up, attempting to bypass the gate and flee over the surrounding wall out of the square.
Just as his feet left the ground, a sharp whoosh of arrows suddenly came from the sky.
Everyone hastily looked up, only to see seven huge suns hanging directly above the square, and in this moment, numerous Blazing Flames Arrows poured down from the suns, quickly reaching the space above Yan Xiang.
Yan Xiang's expression drastically changed, and he hurriedly summoned a red gauze magic treasure, forming a translucent, crimson protective shield around himself.
Yet, the Blazing Flames Arrows easily pierced through the crimson protective shield.
Yan Xiang screamed as numerous arrows penetrated his body, his fate unknown.
The cultivators on the ground, struck by fear, quickly summoned their protective magic treasures.
Suddenly, a burst of golden spirit light shot into the sky, enveloped Yan Xiang, and dragged him out of the arrow rain, dropping him on the ground.
The subsequent Blazing Flames Arrows halted and did not pursue further, dissipating slowly after a few breaths.
People on the ground let out a breath of relief and put away their protective magic treasures.
The golden spirit light spit out Yan Xiang, then flew back into Jin Chao Clone.
Yan Xiang's body had numerous charred wounds, looking like a torn bag, but fortunately, his Dantian and other vital areas like his head had not been penetrated by arrows, and he still had a faint breath.
Jin Chao Clone turned his head to glance at Lei He and the others, speaking indifferently, "Don't you quickly heal him, or do you wish to see him pass away here?"
Golden Transformation Master and Lei He came to their senses and hurried forward, taking out various elixirs and applying spells to treat him, but to no avail.
"That Flat Peach we just had not only extends life and enhances cultivation but also has significant healing effects," Jin Chao Clone said.
Realizing this, Golden Transformation Master hurriedly took Yan Xiang's storage magic tool, fetched the Flat Peach, and fed it to him.
The Flat Peach, worthy of being an Immortal Spiritual Fruit, swiftly restored Yan Xiang's breath, and he awoke from his near-death state at Ghost Gate.
"I, cough, cough, cough..." As Yan Xiang woke up and barely uttered a word, he spat out a mouthful of fresh blood, then couldn't stop coughing.
Golden Transformation Master and Lei He hurriedly stuffed another Healing Pill into his mouth, helping to disseminate its medicinal effect, finally stopping the cough.
Gu Xuanyang, witnessing this scene, suddenly looked up at Jin Chao Clone, "Senior Jin Chao seemed to have anticipated this situation, didn't he?"
At this remark, Golden Transformation Master and Lei He also looked towards Jin Chao Clone, their eyes filled with questions.
The appearance of the arrow rain was too sudden, even for those with higher cultivation, there should be a reaction time, but Jin Chao Clone managed to act just in time, it seemed unlikely he wasn't prepared.
Earlier at the wall, Jin Chao's action of stopping everyone was also suspicious.
Facing the questioning, Jin Chao Clone expressed no intent to defend himself, "Indeed, I don't hide it from you anymore. Years ago, I had the fortune of coming to Three Immortals Island, and I am somewhat familiar with the situation here."
With that statement, the others couldn't help but look perturbed.
"This square is surrounded by the Nine Palaces Fine Fire Array; now that the Array door is sealed, we are all trapped inside. We cannot escape by force alone; we must find the Array node and break it in order to leave with our lives," Jin Chao Clone continued without waiting for questions from the others.
Upon hearing this, everyone hurriedly looked around, trying to locate traces of the Array.
The square was wide and empty, with only nine identical ruby palaces standing tall, and the ruby-built floor and walls seamlessly fused, showing no visible Array marks, making it seem as if there was no Array present.
But soon, everyone discovered that the positions of the nine palaces on the square were somewhat peculiar.
Of the nine palaces, only one was located in the center of the square, directly under the seven suns, while the other eight were located at the edges of the square, close to the surrounding walls, and were also arranged according to the positions of the Bagua.
While observing, Yuan Ming secretly contacted the first soul inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod, instructing it to ascend the Lotus Platform and extend its Divine Sense towards the suns in the sky.
