The rain of arrows attacking Yan Xiang had fallen from the suns, which also indicated that the seven suns above the square might also be part of the Nine Palaces Fine Fire Array.
The first soul's Divine Sense soon made contact with the fierce sun in the sky. A fire poison, even more intense than the red mist in the Stone Forest, instantly invaded the Divine Sense, but the Stealing Heaven Tripod blocked it, preventing any harm to the first soul.
It quickly discovered that the seven suns seemed to be subtly connected to the seven palaces on the square, except for the central palace and the one located at the position of Deviation, which had no connection to the suns in the sky. "Ladies and gentlemen, there's no need to search any longer," Jin Chao Clone hurriedly explained. "The key to the array actually lies within these nine palaces. By breaking all of them, we can easily escape this formation. However, the core of the array inside the central palace in the middle is the most powerful. Even if all of us join forces, we cannot break it. Fortunately, we don't need to deal with it if we just resolve the other eight keys, which will allow us to escape the peril."
At that moment, Yan Xiang had temporarily suppressed his injuries and regained some strength. Hearing Jin Chao speak so lightly yet recalling the recent desperate situation, he couldn't help but question, "Since you knew the situation here, why did you still lead us into this deadly trap?"
"Heh, even if I had informed and stopped you beforehand, would you really not have entered?" Jin Chao Clone sneered back, questioning in return.
Yan Xiang opened his mouth but found himself at a loss for words.
"Senior Jin Chao, why did you have us wait outside for a while before entering only when the seven suns were aloft?" Yuan Ming suddenly asked.
Hearing this, everyone turned their gaze towards Jin Chao Clone.
"The seven suns in the sky are also a derivative of the Nine Palaces Fine Fire Array. Although the seven suns being aloft will make this place hotter, it also concentrates most of the power in the sky, giving us a greater chance of breaking the array," Jin Chao Clone explained.
"I see, I spoke too soon," Yuan Ming said, nodding in understanding.
Gu Xuanyang frowned, "Enough, now is not the time to argue about this matter. We must break the Nine Palaces Fine Fire Array quickly. If we delay longer, we may all perish here."
"Indeed, but since the person who laid the array dared to place the nodes in plain sight, breaking them certainly won't be easy. Senior Jin Chao, do you have any advice on this?" Golden Transformation Master chimed in, turning to inquire.
Jin Chao Clone nodded his head and flipped his right palm, revealing a golden light in his hand, from which eight red talismans flew out and landed in front of everyone.
"These are Forbidden-breaking Talismans I refined specifically for breaking the Nine Palaces Fine Fire Array. They can shatter the barriers surrounding the palaces. However, there might be other obstacles inside the palaces, and you will need to resolve those yourselves," Jin Chao Clone explained.
Golden Transformation Master, seeing that Yuan Ming and Long Chong also received a Forbidden-breaking Talisman, immediately furrowed his brows.
"Senior Jin Chao, do you intend for the juniors in Core Formation to also handle a palace's forbidden barriers?" he cautiously asked.
"Time is pressing, and every moment we delay, our hope for breaking the array fades a little more. I am aware of the capabilities of Jin Yun and Daoist Qian Bao; each can handle a palace on their own. As for your son and Yuan, the two together might be able to break through a node," Jin Chao glanced at Yuan Ming and Long Chong.
Golden Transformation Master expressed some concern: "That may be so, but their cultivation is still inadequate. We cannot even assure we can break a node, let alone them."
"Don't worry, I have made preparations for this as well," Jin Chao Clone reassured.
As he said this, Jin Chao Clone waved his hand, prompting Golden Cloud Fairy, who was standing quietly by the side, to take two Fire Feathers from her Storage Bag and distribute them to Yuan Ming and Daoist Qian Bao.
The Fire Feathers were soft and warm to the touch, fluttering gently even without any wind, resembling a living flame. Although they appeared delicate and powerless, they contained intense evil energy, causing even Gu Xuanyang to feel somewhat daunted.
"These are Evil Feathers I have condensed over a hundred years. Once sacrificed, they can unleash a blow equivalent to that of a Nascent Soul Middle Stage Cultivator, ample for breaking the array," Jin Chao Clone explained.
Seeing him so thoroughly prepared, Golden Transformation Master had no further arguments to offer, taking Long Chong aside to carefully instruct him.
Yuan Ming stored the Fire Feather, and while he wasn't particularly nervous, he thoughtfully glanced at Golden Cloud Fairy.
For Jin Chao to entrust such a valuable item to Golden Cloud Fairy, there must be some relationship between them.
Could they be father and daughter? Yet since Jin Yun exhibited no demon energy, she likely wasn't a demon beast transformation.
Jin Yun felt Yuan Ming's scrutiny and glared back at him. Seeing this, Yuan Ming chuckled awkwardly and immediately averted his gaze.
Having decided to break the array, the group wasted no further time, quickly determining their targets and dispersing to act.
Yuan Ming and Long Chong were assigned to the Exchange palace. They quickly arrived at the palace doors which, upon their approach, manifested a crimson array that blocked their path.
Upon seeing this, Yuan Ming immediately took out the Forbidden-breaking Talisman given by Jin Chao, infused it with Mana, and threw it towards the door.
The talisman transformed into a streak of light that burrowed into the door. Immediately afterward, Yuan Ming and Long Chong heard a muffled bang. The array on the door instantaneously shattered, and the door itself showed dozens of cracks of various sizes, then burst inward, crumbling into countless fragments.
Yuan Ming and Long Chong exchanged a glance, each extracting their Magic Treasures, and cautiously stepped into the palace.
In the center of the palace, a large array slowly revolved, with countless red runes emerging from it, intertwining in the air into a spherical shape that seemed to envelop something. Intense heat surged towards them, making the temperature inside the hall even hotter than on the square.
"Is this the node of the array that Senior Jin Chao mentioned? We just need to attack it? Is it really that simple?" Long Chong couldn't believe his own words.
Yuan Ming didn't respond and extended his Divine Sense to cover the surroundings, yet he detected no hidden dangers.

chapters.title: Chapter 561 - 537: Golden Crow Divine Arrow
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming's eyes revealed a hint of confusion, and just as he was about to speak, Long Chong by his side took a step forward.
Suddenly, the entire hall came to life. The floor flipped outward from beneath their feet, transforming into a land full of charred pits and divots. The walls around them disappeared in an instant, and the ceiling above turned into a sky of blazing red. In the blink of an eye, the two men found themselves on an open battlefield.
Shrill screeches echoed all around, and numerous fireballs fell from above like meteors, their long trails filling the sky as if even the heavens themselves were set ablaze.
Long Chong's expression changed. As he swung his long spear, he prepared to counter the rain of fire.
However, suddenly his vision darkened as if someone had fiercely struck his head, and he instantly fell unconscious.
Behind him, Yuan Ming sighed and silently apologized in his heart before storing the unconscious Long Chong, who had been knocked out by his illusion.
Fireballs rained down on Yuan Ming, passing through him like illusions, revealing that everything around him was an illusion.
He flipped his palm to retrieve a Spiritual Beast Bag, simultaneously linking his Divine Soul to the Shura Blood Devouring Map.
In the next instant, the Three-eyed Crow and Hong Ling appeared before him.
"Hong Ling, help me break the array," Yuan Ming said as he channeled a spell toward the Three-eyed Crow with both hands.
When Yuan Ming had arrived at this place, he hadn't felt any spatial displacement; he speculated that he was trapped by another formation, not actually on a battlefield showered with meteoric fireballs.
As the demonic power of the Three-eyed Crow flowed in, Yuan Ming's mana steadily climbed and soon reached the standard of the late-stage Core Formation level.
Yuan Ming concentrated the demonic power of the Three-eyed Crow at his brow, extended his finger, and drew on his forehead. The skin of his forehead suddenly split open, revealing a bird's eye filled with Blood Light, identical to one on the forehead of the Three-eyed Crow.
His Golden Sunflower Beast Taming Technique was incomplete, but he had used it repeatedly and was already very skilled in this secret technique. By leveraging his powerful Divine Soul, he had gradually learned to borrow the Divine Skills of spirit beasts.
Immediately after, Yuan Ming exerted his mana, and Blood Light shot out from the bird's eye at his brow, sweeping around him.
Under the illumination of the Blood Light, the surroundings twisted and shifted, revealing the scene inside the hall once more. However, under the cover of the Blood Light, the scene acquired a hazy feel, as if it was very distant from Yuan Ming.
Knowing this was the effect of the formation, Yuan Ming focused even more on searching for the formation's flaws.
The Illusion-breaking Demon Eyes of the Three-eyed Crow could break illusions and were further enhanced after the melding. Without the Stealing Heaven Tripod, Yuan Ming's Divine Sense was not as sharp as the Pupil Technique.
But this did not mean that the Three-eyed Crow's melded Divine Soul was stronger than Yuan Ming's; they simply specialized in different areas.
Perhaps sensing Yuan Ming's probing, the sky suddenly flashed, and the number of falling meteors increased manifold, causing one's scalp to tingle.
However, Hong Ling remained calm. Her hands moved through the air as if strumming a harp, causing the blazing meteors roaring toward them to suddenly veer off course, crashing into uninhabited areas.
In an instant, booming explosions, howling winds, and deafening noises enveloped the entire battlefield, mixed in with flames and smoke.
Yet around Yuan Ming and Hong Ling, there seemed to be an invisible wall that blocked all the encroaching fire and smoke.
"Found it." Amidst the flying dust, the Blood Light shooting from Yuan Ming's brow pointed toward the eastern sky.
The moment he spoke, Hong Ling's eyebrows raised, and with a flick of her wrist, a beam of red light surged out, striking the area illuminated by the Blood Light like lightning.
With a "crack," in the east, a fist-sized Treasure Bead suddenly appeared. Cracks spread across its surface, and within moments, the bead exploded into fragments, scattering on the ground.
The scenery shifted once more, and Yuan Ming found himself back in the grand hall without having moved an inch.
Using the Blood Light in his brow to observe his surroundings, and seeing no other forbidden barriers, he finally stepped forward and walked up to the formation at the center of the hall.
Yuan Ming observed the sphere wrapped in rune chains, thought for a moment, and instead of taking out the Evil Feather, he took out the black Fire Burning Stick that he had obtained earlier and threw it into the formation.
As soon as the Fire Burning Stick entered the realm of the formation, several chains made of flaming spiritual light violently extended from the formation like serpents, lashing toward the Fire Burning Stick.
However, the moment the rune chains touched the Fire Burning Stick, they reverted to spirit light and dissipated into the air, incapable of even obstructing it momentarily.
This stick seemed to be the bane of flames.
The Fire Burning Stick continued to spiral forward, easily piercing through the rune chains enveloping the sphere like puncturing paper, and with a "puff," it plunged into the sphere at the center of the formation.
The Great Array shook violently, all the rune chains turned into spirit light and faded away, and within a few breaths, it completely collapsed.
As the rune chains dissipated, the object inside the sphere also revealed itself—a strangely shaped Red Arrow; its arrowhead was like a bird, the feathers resembled fire, and its shaft bore series of rune imprints.
With the chains no longer entangling it, the arrow suddenly burst forth with an unbelievably intense heat.
At the same time, outside the palace, a sun in the sky transformed into a stream of light and plunged into the Dui Palace.
Yuan Ming immediately noticed the walls and ceiling brighten sharply as an unknown force surged into the arrow not far from him.
Thick spirit light, like tangible clay, emerged from the arrow, rapidly transforming and solidifying its form, eventually turning into a fiery, ethereal Fire Bird, which let out a piercing shriek at Yuan Ming and Hong Ling.
Then, the Fire Bird Illusion opened its mouth and spewed a ball of golden flames toward him.
The moment the golden flames appeared, the temperature inside the palace soared again, and the ruby floor and walls seemed to spontaneously combust, emitting bursts of orange-red flames.
The palace had completely turned into a sea of fire.
Yuan Ming tightened as he watched the golden flames flying toward him.
In the obscure depths of his mind, he felt as though he had been locked onto by something and no matter how he tried to flee, he could not avoid the incoming golden flames.
The golden flames contained an extremely high temperature; Yuan Ming believed that anything that came in contact with it would instantly burn into green smoke, leaving not even a trace of residue.
At his side, Hong Ling saw the golden flames flying toward them and an uncontrollable panic surged in her, rendering her unable to move.
Yuan Ming was also terrified, but he was not immobilized. He formed a hand seal with a flick.
Beneath the Fire Bird Illusion, a Fire Burning Stick that had fallen to the ground due to the dispersion of a Formation wobbled and then suddenly leaped up, striking at the Fire Bird Illusion in midair.
The Fire Bird Illusion didn't notice the attack of the Fire Burning Stick in time and immediately let out a terrible scream, transforming back into viscous spirit light and burrowed back into the arrows.
Next, Yuan Ming controlled the Fire Burning Stick to fly towards the golden flames, twisting in midair, scattering the golden flames, and with them, the terrifying sensation in his heart vanished, no longer feeling as if he was being locked onto by the intangible.
The blazing ocean within the hall dissipated concurrently, and the insufferable heat rapidly cooled down.Thi@s c*hapte!r% was up+lo#ad!ed- by the t^ea-m at *.!
Seeing this scene, Hong Ling let out a long breath and then asked, "Fellow Daoist Yuan, what exactly was that Divine Bird Illusion just now?"
She had been completely immobilized facing the Fire Bird Illusion!
"If I'm not mistaken, that should have been the legendary Three-legged Golden Crow," Yuan Ming didn't conceal the truth.
Hong Ling was taken aback, her expression trembling with shock. Seeing her reaction, Yuan Ming knew she had misunderstood and immediately explained.
"Fellow Daoist Hong Ling, do not be nervous. That wasn't the ancient world-ending Golden Crow of legend, but rather a replica created by the Golden Sunflower Immortal. He sealed the Divine Souls of several Level 5 Golden Crows into arrows after exterminating them, and as you saw, although it is a replica, its power is truly unbeatable," he explained.
Meanwhile, Yuan Ming stepped forward and picked up the Red Arrow that had fallen to the ground.
The arrow concealed the Divine Soul of a Golden Crow, which he placed in a Sealing Stone Box and sealed with several Sealing Talismans.
But just at that moment, an unexpected change occurred.
Two rays of golden light shot out from underneath the ground without any warning—two golden ropes, binding him and Hong Ling's bodies tightly together at an incredible speed.
"What is this!" Blood Light shimmered over Hong Ling. Her body suddenly swelled several times in size, then abruptly shrank back.
However, those golden ropes were truly wondrous, firmly binding Hong Ling no matter how her form changed.
Though startled, Yuan Ming was not thrown into disarray. He executed the "Six Jia Qimen" technique he had just grasped, and his body flickered, transforming into a purple lumpy mass—the Purple Extreme Tai Sui.
His body reappeared several meters away, freeing himself from the binds.
"This Six Jia Qimen's ability to switch form and substance is indeed useful, even the ropes that even Hong Ling could not break free from could be escaped," Yuan Ming rejoiced inwardly.
From outside the doors came a sound of surprise, clearly shocked that Yuan Ming had escaped the golden ropes.
"Who's there?" Yuan Ming looked toward the entrance.
The rope that had bound the Purple Extreme Tai Sui suddenly loosened, shooting out and wrapping around Hong Ling, nearly turning her into a rice dumpling.
The Blood Light on Hong Ling dissipated greatly, and she fell to the ground, unstable.
"Hehe, Fellow Daoist Yuan, your skills are indeed exceptional, even breaking free from the Fairy Binding Rope. May I know what secret technique that was? Please enlighten me," a figure walked in, it was Daoist Qian Bao.
"Fellow Daoist Qian Bao! I wonder what offense Yuan has caused you, to make you strike against me?" Yuan Ming asked in a deep voice.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, why pretend to be ignorant? We have come to Three Immortals Island precisely to seize treasures. The innocent would not be encumbered by possession. Hand over all treasures, including the Golden Crow Divine Arrow you just collected, and I can promise on behalf of my master to spare your life," Daoist Qian Bao stood ten yards away, his face displaying a cold smile.
"The necessary questions of course must be asked clearly. You and I have fought side by side after all; Yuan must understand your motives thoroughly before we can fight wholeheartedly," Yuan Ming said calmly.
"A fine declaration of a whole-hearted fight. It's rare to see you, Fellow Daoist Yuan, so spirited. Use whatever hidden cards you've got! At Magma Lake, you summoned two being of Nascent Soul level power, this red-clothed woman being one of them. Call out the other too, let's see just how formidable they are," Daoist Qian Bao laughed out loud.
He had harbored no small dread of Yuan Ming initially, but now that he had captured Hong Ling, he was full of confidence. A beam of golden light shot from his head, transforming into a Nine-story Scripture Pillar. It was densely covered with Spiritual Patterns that shifted continuously, emitting streaks of golden light.
"Is that so, then I shall comply with respect, Blood Shadow!" Yuan Ming glanced at the Nine-story Scripture Pillar and shouted out.
Blood Shadow had been waiting impatiently and shot out from Yuan Ming's body. Its body spun, transforming into a gigantic blood-colored palm several meters wide and fiercely struck toward Daoist Qian Bao!
He struck with full force immediately; the blood-colored palm appeared to be a Great Divine Power, emitting nine distinct forces from the palm. The entire hall trembled unstably, seemingly unable to withstand a single strike from the blood palm!
Daoist Qian Bao was unintimidated, forming a hand seal and pointed!
The golden light emitted by the Nine-story Scripture Pillar suddenly intensified, deluging the entire hall and forming a tough Barrier, enveloping Yuan Ming, Hong Ling, and Blood Shadow within.
The trio instantly felt as if they were at the depths of an ocean, struggling to even lift a hand; the blood-colored palm also slowed for an instant.

chapters.title: Chapter 562 - 538: The Name of Qian Bao
chapters.content:
Daoist Qian Bao's lips curved into a cold sneer, as he flicked his sleeve, the scripture pillar flashed with brilliance, and shot out over a dozen magic treasures, including golden turtle axe, silver turtle sword, and copper turtle wheel, all of which were particularly powerful.
Each magic treasure shone with brilliant light, clearly fully activated, and collided with the massive blood palm.
The formidable blood palm was pierced through, and the figure of the Blood Shadow was revealed, moaning as it was sent flying backward, evidently injured!
Yuan Ming's face showed a look of astonishment. The magic treasures' internal rune formations made them much more difficult to operate compared to magic artifacts, unless they were specially made sets. Normally, a Core Formation Stage cultivator could only manage four or five pieces, as controlling more would not bring out their full power.
Yet Daoist Qian Bao was able to manipulate over a dozen magic treasures simultaneously; it was unimaginable!
The dozen magic treasures, without a moment's delay, turned into a vast array of differently colored spiritual lights, continuing to attack Yuan Ming.
"Since you seek death, you can't blame me," Yuan Ming said indifferently, not dodging or casting a protective spell, allowing the magic treasures to strike his body.
A dozen beams of spiritual light swept past, and his body instantly split into pieces, yet no blood flowed out, instead dispersing into specks of light and shadow.
"Illusion Technique!" Daoist Qian Bao's expression darkened, and he immediately pinched several spells on the Nine-story Scripture Pillar.
A gush of golden light fell from the scripture pillar, enveloping his body as his field of view shattered.
Yuan Ming stood quietly about several feet away, not taking the opportunity to attack him.
A trace of surprise flashed in Daoist Qian Bao's eyes, but his actions did not slow as he commanded over a dozen magic treasures to shoot at Yuan Ming once again.
But at that very moment, he suddenly felt intense pain throughout his body, as if countless knives were piercing through him from within, disrupting his control of his mana.
The golden light from the Nine-story Scripture Pillar dimmed and fell to the ground. The dozen magic treasures also dropped to the ground, clanging loudly as they scattered everywhere.
The two Fairy Binding Ropes that were restraining Hong Ling fell off, and she flipped over to stand up, exceedingly annoyed as she pounced towards Daoist Qian Bao, only to be stopped by Yuan Ming's transmitted message.
Purple poison spots appeared all over Daoist Qian Bao's body, spreading rapidly, and the intense pain suddenly increased by several times, causing him to fall to the ground.
"Poison! When did you poison me…" Daoist Qian Bao moaned in agony.
Yuan Ming ignored Daoist Qian Bao and walked over to Purple Extreme Tai Sui.
"Well done," he gently patted Purple Extreme Tai Sui.
As soon as Purple Extreme Tai Sui came out of the Spiritual Beast Bag, he began to release poison. The transparent poison liquid was undetectable even to Nascent Soul cultivators, let alone to Daoist Qian Bao, who only had Core Formation Stage level of cultivation.
While it was not difficult for Yuan Ming with his strength to kill Daoist Qian Bao, it would have inevitably led to a tough fight; thus, letting Purple Extreme Tai Sui take action not only saved trouble but also tested the potency of the transparent poison.
"Squeak, squeak…" Purple Extreme Tai Sui squeaked twice, appearing quite smug.
The purple poison spots had spread over Daoist Qian Bao's entire body, the venom reaching his brain. His vision became blurred, and his pitiful screams echoed within the hall.
Yuan Ming's eyebrows slightly furrowed as he gestured in the air.
A Sword Qi pierced through Daoist Qian Bao's head, silencing his screams abruptly as the radiance from the Nine-story Scripture Pillar and several Magic Treasures completely faded.
Yuan Ming waved his sleeve and gathered the Scripture Pillar, his Divine Sense delved into it, and he quickly understood its rune formation and Divine Skills.
The base of the Nine-story Scripture Pillar was inscribed with the item's name: Thousand Treasures Scripture Pillar, containing nine runes. Each layer of the pillar was densely packed with around a hundred small squares, adding up to exactly one thousand—the name of Daoist Qian Bao was probably related to this.
Unfortunately, most of the thousand squares were damaged, with only about a hundred intact.
The Thousand Treasures Scripture Pillar was a unique Magic Treasure, not usable for attacking or defending, possessing only one ability: driving Magic Treasures.
The hundred or so small squares inside the Thousand Treasures Scripture Pillar could store Magic Treasures, and as long as the Magic Treasures were placed inside, it could drive them, theoretically allowing dozens or even hundreds to be used simultaneously as long as Mana and Divine Sense were sufficient.
"To think there is such a marvelous Magic Treasure in the world," Yuan Ming couldn't help but admire the ingenious design of the treasure.
It was a pity that most of the squares in the Thousand Treasures Scripture Pillar were damaged, and with his current Mana, he couldn't witness the spectacle of a thousand Magic Treasures being activated at once.
However, these hundred-plus squares were more than enough for his use.
Always read from the source: *.
Yuan Ming exhaled a breath of Mana, wrapping around and refining the Scripture Pillar, then made a hand gesture, and seven or eight Magic Treasures flew out.
These Magic Treasures included a Jade Bottle, scrolls, and dusters, which were not meant for direct attacks. Daoist Qian Bao had not used them just now. Unfortunately, it seemed there was no Golden Crow Divine Arrow among them.
Yuan Ming paid no attention to the other items and looked towards a golden scroll filled with runes, which greatly resembled the Heavenly Talisman Strategy Magic Treasure of Golden Dawn Fairy from Zhao Country's Spirit Talisman Sect.
"Golden Dawn Fairy's Heavenly Talisman Strategy fell into Daoist Qian Bao's hands? Unlikely, the East Sea is extremely far from the Black Wind Desert. It's unlikely that Daoist Qian Bao would travel so far to kill and rob." Yuan Ming thought to himself quietly.
He then shook his head and ceased to dwell on this thought, placing the few Magic Treasures back into the Thousand Treasures Scripture Pillar and also gathering the dozen or so Magic Treasures on the ground into the squares of the Scripture Pillar.
The quality of these Magic Treasures was not low, several among them were Nine Rune Magical Treasures, and even the worst were Six Rune Magical Treasures.
Yuan Ming pondered briefly, stored the Magic Treasures he couldn't use on his person into the small squares, and managed to gather about thirty Magic Treasures in total.
His Divine Sense was unmatched, far surpassing Daoist Qian Bao and, in terms of Mana, if he used the Golden Sunflower Beast Taming Technique, he could elevate it to the Late-stage Core Formation, barely managing to simultaneously drive these thirty Magic Treasures.
Thirty Magic Treasures attacking at once, even a Nascent Soul Middle Stage cultivator might not withstand it.
Yuan Ming put away the Thousand Treasures Scripture Pillar, then raised the Shura Blood Devouring Map, sweeping Daoist Qian Bao's corpse into it and refining him into a Blood Slave.
As a precaution, Yuan Ming checked Daoist Qian Bao's Storage Bag again but still did not find the Golden Crow Divine Arrow. It seemed that the man was too eager for the treasures and had not collected it; perhaps at this moment, the Divine Arrow was still within the Kan Palace.
Hong Ling and Blood Shadow also flew back into the Shura Blood Devouring Map to heal their injuries.
Having done all this, Yuan Ming did not linger any longer, left the Dui Palace, and came outside.
The plaza was silent, devoid of any people, and of the suns in the sky, only four remained, greatly reducing the intense heat.
Upon seeing this scene, Yuan Ming used the Void Transformation Technique to conceal his tracks and silently moved toward the Li Palace.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, why head to Li Palace? Daoist Qian Bao's assault on you suggests that the Golden Crow Divine Arrow within Kan Palace, which he oversees, is still there. Shouldn't we go there and secure that arrow?" Hong Ling asked upon seeing this.
"Li Palace is more important; do not ask further," Yuan Ming said indifferently.
Upon hearing this, Hong Ling closed her mouth.
Yuan Ming also thought about going to Kan Palace to collect the Golden Crow Divine Arrow. With the assistance of the black Fire Burning Stick, securing the arrow would not be difficult.
However, when he had previously pulled out the black Fire Burning Stick, the golden book had conveyed a message left by Qi Ye, urging him to rush to Li Palace and secure the Golden Crow Divine Arrow there immediately.
Yuan Ming did not trust this Qi Ye, but given the choice to believe it rather than not, he decided it was wise to head to Li Palace first.
With Yuan Ming's speed, he soon reached the entrance of Li Palace.
He fully activated the Void Transformation Technique and stealthily made his way inside.
The Illusion Technique Restriction of Li Palace had already been broken by someone, allowing Yuan Ming to enter easily. The innermost hall's restrictions were also broken, and he went directly to the main hall.
A series of explosive noises rang out, the entire hall flickering with violent clashes of thunder and flames, deafening to hear.
The one engaged in fierce battle was Lei He, holding a black dagger-shaped Magic Treasure, radiating astonishing thunder fluctuations, not inferior to the Thunder God Hammer.
The dagger-shaped Magic Treasure emitted thin streams of lightning, striking towards the opposite side.
Yuan Ming frowned slightly, he was familiar with this thin lightning, which was the effect of the Gathering Thunder Skill, only the lightning generated by the black dagger was many times stronger than when he himself performed the Gathering Thunder Skill.
The opponent was a giant Golden Crow, dozens of times bigger than the one Yuan Ming had just dealt with, spewing out streams of fire snakes from its mouth, catching all the lightning attacks Lei He released, leaving the array beneath the Golden Crow unscathed.
"Such a formidable Golden Crow, even the Nascent Soul Middle Stage Lei He can't stand against it," Yuan Ming stayed hidden and continued to observe from nearby.
Lei He seemed to grow anxious, swiftly changing his hand seals.
After spinning around, the dagger-shaped Magic Treasure transformed into a streak of black lightning that shot into the sky and vanished into the void at the top of the hall.
The next moment, intense thunder fluctuations transmitted from above the hall, as nature's spiritual energy frantically congregated, instantly forming a dark thundercloud with countless Thunder Runes swirling within.
Bang, bang, bang!
Dense bolts of lightning, as thick as bowls, shot out. Each bolt of lightning was well-defined, leaving visible traces in the air, half striking the giant Golden Crow and the other half aiming directly at the ground array.
The giant Golden Crow's eyes flickered with a mocking anthropomorphic sneer, spreading its wings wide.
Surges of Golden Crow True Fire gushed out, instantly forming a sea of golden flames. The intense heat caused even the void to ripple, and Yuan Ming, hidden outside, felt intense heat assaulting him as if he were inside a furnace.
The lightning attacks Lei He released were swallowed up by it, disappearing without a trace, utterly ineffective.
"How could this be!" Lei He was dumbfounded, and Yuan Ming's eyebrows raised in surprise.
Just then, a series of loud bangs came from outside, causing Li Palace to also shake continuously.
Yuan Ming wielded the first soul to drop Divine Sense, his expression changing suddenly.
About a dozen Green-Black Tree People appeared outside the Fire Essence Palace square. The square's gates were already shut, and the tree people were attacking the entrance gate.
"It seems these tree people are extraordinary, not just a trial from the Peach Forest," Yuan Ming thought to himself.
Lei He, lacking Yuan Ming's exploratory means, hesitated for a moment before dashing outside.
Yuan Ming was pleased to see this and, once Lei He had left Li Palace, immediately revealed himself and swung the Fire Burning Stick at the giant Golden Crow.
The giant Golden Crow showed disdain at the sudden appearance of Yuan Ming, opening its mouth to emit a stream of True Fire, prepared to turn the unremarkable Fire Burning Stick to ash.
However, as soon as the flames touched the Fire Burning Stick, they collapsed. The black Fire Burning Stick turned into a shadow and struck the back of the giant Golden Crow.
With a loud "bang," the massive body of the Golden Crow was flung away, emitting a piercing scream, as if a household dog had been hit with a stick!
Yuan Ming motioned with his hands, and the Fire Burning Stick's speed surged, continuously lashing out at the giant Golden Crow.
The giant Golden Crow kept screaming, flying chaotically around the hall, no longer possessing its earlier imposing aura.
"This Fire Burning Stick is incredibly useful; I wonder what kind of magical treasure it is," Yuan Ming mused delightedly, continuing to control the Fire Burning Stick to forcefully hit the Golden Crow.
Having endured several blows, the Golden Crow couldn't take it anymore and turned to fly back towards the Golden Crow Divine Arrow.
Only then did Yuan Ming clearly see the Golden Crow Divine Arrow inside Li Palace, much larger than the one in Dui Palace, and its aura extraordinarily fierce, almost comparable to the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear.
He waved his sleeve, and the black Fire Burning Stick shot out, penetrating the ground array like before and entering the center of the formation.
Although this array was more formidable, it had no way to resist the black Fire Burning Stick, which caused it to catastrophically collapse. The Golden Crow Divine Arrow, exposed in the air, transformed into a red shadow and shot towards the outside.
Yuan Ming's palm flashed with a purple light, and the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear appeared, its spear tip hitting the Golden Crow Divine Arrow, knocking it backwards.
Simultaneously, a golden Scripture Pillar emerged above his head, exactly the Thousand Treasures Scripture Pillar.
Two Fairy Binding Ropes shot out from within the Scripture Pillar, wrapping around the Golden Crow Divine Arrow.
The Fairy Binding Rope was an Eight Rune Treasure, capable of binding both people and restraining magical treasures. The Golden Crow Divine Arrow, trapped by the two ropes, halted in place.
Yuan Ming lifted his hand, recalling the black Fire Burning Stick to his hand, and delivered a fierce blow to the Golden Crow Divine Arrow.
The red spiritual light on the Golden Crow Divine Arrow scattered, and a piercingly tragic scream emerged from within, echoing the cry of the Golden Crow.
Yuan Ming nodded, noting that the black Fire Burning Stick was also effective against Fire Attribute magical treasures. The blow he had just delivered had almost completely crushed the Fire Attribute Spiritual Power of the Golden Crow Divine Arrow.
"Are you still running?" he held up the Fire Burning Stick and spoke in a chilling tone.
The Golden Crow inside the arrow hurriedly cried out twice, indicating submission.

chapters.title: Chapter 563 - 539: Killing from a Hundred Miles Away
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming saw that the Golden Crow had finally submitted and thus put down the Fire Burning Stick. He raised his hand and shot out a cyan light that wrapped around the Golden Crow Divine Arrow, storing it inside a long jade box, which also contained the previously collected Divine Arrows.
After closing the lid, he took out several Sealing Talismans and stuck them on it, and then used the Cold Moon Ring to apply a layer of Frost Sealing around it. Only then did he rest assured and properly stored away the jade box.
Yuan Ming activated his Divine Sense to sweep across the great hall, but after finding no other gains, he turned and walked towards the exit. He had only taken a few steps when his footsteps suddenly halted.
Standing at the doorway was a figure—it was Lei He who had just left.
"When did Fellow Daoist Lei He return?" A hint of surprise flashed in Yuan Ming's eyes as he asked.
The first soul was resting inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod, and all this while, he had been using his true body's Divine Sense to scan the surroundings without detecting Lei He's presence, which indicated that, as a Nascent Soul cultivator, Lei He must possess some sophisticated method of Concealment.
"Hehe, Fellow Daoist Yuan is indeed remarkable, subduing this Divine Arrow in such a short period of time," Lei He chuckled without a change in his expression.
"It's nothing but the might of a Magical Treasure. I wish to refine a Fire Attribute Magical Treasure, and the material of these arrows is perfectly suitable with their Spiritual Power. Thus, I presumptuously took the Divine Arrows from this hall. I hope Fellow Daoist Lei He won't take offense," Yuan Ming said as he bowed to Lei He.
"Of course not. I couldn't handle that massive Golden Crow myself, and if Fellow Daoist Yuan can take care of it for me, I'm not just unbothered—I'm grateful," Lei He responded with a hearty laugh.
"As long as Fellow Daoist doesn't blame me, it's all good. The Nine Palaces Fine Fire Array hasn't been completely unraveled yet, so I'll take my leave first," Yuan Ming said, bowing to Lei He before walking toward the outside.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, wait. This Nine Palaces Fine Fire Array cannot be broken!" Lei He raised his hand to stop Yuan Ming, speaking with a serious tone.
"What do you mean by that, Fellow Daoist Lei He?" Yuan Ming, upon hearing this, was taken aback and stopped in his tracks.
Lei He formed a hand seal and extended a blue light screen to cover them both before saying, "Does Fellow Daoist Yuan remember what Zhao Gui told us in the Peach Forest, about how there is a Spiritual Treasure left by the Golden Sunflower Immortal stored inside the Fire Essence Palace?"
"Of course, I remember," Yuan Ming nodded.
"That Spiritual Treasure is also within the Nine Palaces Fine Fire Array. If I'm not mistaken, it is currently stored in the Middle Palace," Lei He remarked.
"Fellow Daoist Lei He seems to know quite a bit about the Fire Essence Palace," Yuan Ming observed with a deep look in his eyes.
"That Spiritual Treasure is called Hou Yi's Sun Shooting Bow. Used in combination with the Golden Crow Divine Arrow in Fellow Daoist's hand, it has the power to destroy heaven and earth," Lei He said slowly, neither confirming nor denying Yuan Ming's observation.
"Hou Yi's Sun Shooting Bow? Could it be that this treasure has some relation to the great deity of the ancient legend who shot down suns?" Yuan Ming asked.
"It merely borrows the reputation of the ancient deity. Although the bow isn't an ancient treasure, it is indeed a very powerful existence among Spiritual Treasures," Lei He explained.
"I see. But how did you come to know all this, Fellow Daoist Lei He? Could it be that you've been to Three Immortals Island before?" Yuan Ming inquired.
"I'm not that fortunate. If it weren't for the assistance of you all, I wouldn't even dare to hope to set foot on Three Immortals Island. However, I do have some understanding of it," Lei He shook his head and said.
"I'm a bit slow-witted. Could Fellow Daoist Lei He please elaborate?" Yuan Ming furrowed his eyebrows and asked.
"Of course. How much does Fellow Daoist Yuan know about the affairs of the East Sea, especially regarding Three Immortals Island?" Lei He smiled and asked in return.
"Not much, to be frank. Although Yuan Ming is not a cultivator from the East Sea, having been here for only a year or two at most, I only know Three Immortals Island as the largest legend of the East Sea, replete with countless treasures and three Immortal Books," Yuan Ming admitted candidly.
"Then I must start from the beginning. What Fellow Daoist Yuan understands is not false; it is merely the most superficial information about Three Immortals Island. The island is not as illusory as legends suggest. In fact, Three Immortals Island appears in the East Sea every few hundred years," Lei He stated.
"Is that so? I've never heard of it," Yuan Ming said in surprise.
"This is the East Sea's biggest secret. It seems Fusang Island has some Secret Technique that can predict the location where Three Immortals Island will emerge each time. Whenever Three Immortals Island appears, Fusang Island almost always races there first and blocks the news from the outside world. Aside from a few islands with close ties to Fusang Island, no one in the East Sea domain really knows about this. A predecessor from my Red Rain Island just happened to be nearby during the last emergence of Three Immortals Island and witnessed everything, thus learning some insider information," Lei He confessed.
"So that's how it is. But if Three Immortals Island appears once every few hundred years, why are the doors to the Fire Essence Palace temples we passed tightly shut and their prohibitions intact, as if no one has been here?" Yuan Ming realized and then raised another doubt.
"Although Three Immortals Island has appeared multiple times, it is extremely difficult to enter. Each emergence, like this time, gives rise to a secret realm, and only by passing the tests of the secret realm can one enter the real Three Immortals Island. According to Red Rain Island's deductions, the times Fusang Island has successfully set foot on Three Immortals Island are very few, possibly only once or twice, and with very few people, which is why there are not many traces left on the island," Lei He explained.
Yuan Ming heard this and said nothing, but nodded thoughtfully.
"Although few people have set foot on Three Immortals Island, the gains from entering the secret realm are immense. The treasures within the secret realm are all from Three Immortals Island, whether they are extinct spiritual materials, secret techniques, cultivation techniques, elixirs, or the methods for refining Spiritual Treasures. The Mystic Fire Fan in Yan Xiang's hand as well as the Exterminating Immortal Sword wielded by Gu Xuanyang were both made using secrets passed down from Three Immortals Island," Lei He continued.To report errors, please visit the original post on *.
"The bronze sword that Island Master Gu wields is called the Exterminating Immortal Sword? That's such a domineering name," Yuan Ming sighed softly.
"The sword's power is awe-inspiring, meant for execution and killing, far surpassing Yan Xiang's Mystic Fire Fan. Fellow Daoist Yuan should be wary of this sword," Lei He hinted ominously.
"Lei He, you seem to be overly concerned. I hold no grudge against Island Master Gu, so why should I be wary of the Exterminating Immortal Sword?" Yuan Ming's heart went cold, but he kept a composed face.
"Daoist Qian Bao appears to be a disciple of Gu Xuanyang on the surface, but in reality, he is Gu Xuanyang's illegitimate child. You killed his son, so if Gu Xuanyang learns of this, how could he not fight you to the death?" Lei He said with a smile.
Yuan Ming's brow furrowed. The body of Daoist Qian Bao had long been taken into his Shura Blood Devouring Map, and right before Lei He arrived, Yuan Ming had also put away the Thousand Treasures Scripture Pillar. How did this man find out he had killed Daoist Qian Bao?
"Lei He, you've said so much, yet you haven't gotten to the main point. Why can't we just destroy the Nine Palaces Fine Fire Array?" Yuan Ming asked, changing the topic.
"I, Lei, might have strayed far from the topic, my apologies. Inside the Jinghuo Palace lies Hou Yi's Sun Shooting Bow. Not only am I somewhat aware of it, but Gu Xuanyang and the Jin Chao Clone are crystal clear about it. They are all scheming to obtain this Spiritual Treasure. Once we break the Nine Palaces Fine Fire Array, Hou Yi's Sun Shooting Bow will emerge. No matter who among them gets this treasure, we will likely not escape being silenced. Hou Yi's Sun Shooting Bow possesses an astounding Divine Skill, capable of killing from a hundred li away, always successful. Let alone the fact that the Fire Essence Palace plaza has already been closed off, even if it was open, it is already too late to escape now," Lei He spoke with a grave expression, his voice dropping a few notches while he stepped a few paces closer to Yuan Ming.
"Killing from a hundred li away!" Yuan Ming exclaimed in surprise, then fell into deep thought.
"The only plan for now is to strike first and eliminate Gu Xuanyang and the Jin Chao Clone. At the very least, we must severely injure them to prevent them from obtaining Hou Yi's Sun Shooting Bow, only then can we save our lives! I have already contacted Yan Xiang and Golden Transformation Daoist, and they have both agreed to this plan. Does Fellow Daoist Yuan wish to join us?" Lei He's eyes flickered with killing intent as he invited Yuan Ming.
After pondering for a moment, Yuan Ming nodded. "Since Gu Xuanyang and the Jin Chao Clone harbor ill intentions towards us, I, Yuan, am not a pedantic fool blind to the truth."
"Excellent! With Fellow Daoist Yuan joining us, the success rate of this plan will greatly increase!" Lei He said joyfully.
"Both Gu Xuanyang and the Jin Chao Clone are extremely powerful, far surpassing us. Lei He, who do you think we should deal with first?" Yuan Ming inquired further.
"Although Jin Chao itself is a Level 5 Demon Beast, this clone isn't as much of a threat to us. It's more important to concentrate our efforts on Gu Xuanyang. I have already made contact with Yan Xiang and Golden Transformation Daoist, and they have both agreed to this plan," Lei He explained.
Yuan Ming had this intention as well and was about to ask for details of the plan when his tongue suddenly went numb, unable to make a sound.
His limbs were the same, stiff and powerless, as if turned to stone.
A dazzling bolt of thunder suddenly shot forth from the front, released from the black short spike in Lei He's hand, striking Yuan Ming's head in an instant.
Yuan Ming's head exploded on impact, turning into a messy splatter of blood and brain, and his headless body flew out, landing on the ground with a "thud."
Lei He relaxed his expression and lunged to retrieve Yuan Ming's storage ring.
Yet at that moment, Yuan Ming's body turned into a shadow and vanished, reappearing several meters away.
Within the Night Parade of Hundred Demons, Heavenly Ghost Wanderer's body shuddered, causing the Divine Soul Transformation of the Three-eyed Crow in his Sea of Consciousness to shatter.
He had used his Substitution Ability to take the fall for himself just now.
Although Yuan Ming avoided death, his body still couldn't move. Fortunately, his Mana and Divine Soul could still circulate, and with a flash of golden light, he brought out the Thousand Treasures Scripture Pillar.
A black disc and a bloody shield shot out from the Thousand Treasures Scripture Pillar, forming protective shields of black and red, blocking a second dazzling bolt of thunder that shot their way.
"Lei He, why did you try to assassinate me?" Yuan Ming's mouth couldn't move, but his Divine Sense was still functioning, and he communicated telepathically.
Lei He did not answer, instead pouring all his Mana into the black short spike.
Boom, boom, boom!
The thunder on the black short spike surged, emitting a thunderous roar as if lightning had exploded. Seven or eight thunderbolts as thick as bowls shot out, hitting the black and red protective shields.
The shields swayed and quickly dissolved.
"If that is the case, then do not blame Yuan for being ruthless!" Yuan Ming coldly snorted telepathically, and the Thousand Treasures Scripture Pillar shone brightly. With a tremendous roar, thirty Magical Treasures shot out, bombarding Lei He with an overwhelming barrage.
Lei He was taken aback and his body turned into a bolt of lightning, shooting to one side. However, Hong Ling appeared in front of him.
Hong Ling spread her fingers and a blood-red net enveloped Lei He.
The Blood Shadow also appeared elsewhere. This time he did not use his Blood Palm Divine Ability. Instead, nine Blood River Pearls transformed into a vast, encroaching blood-red river.
At the same time, Heavenly Ghost Wanderer and the rest of the Ghost Slaves all burst forth, with various Magical Treasure Secret Techniques raining down from the sky.
Following the barrage of Magical Treasures and Secret Techniques, twelve Soul Crows appeared in an instant, forming the Crow Formation, and emitted the Crow's Call Sound Waves toward Lei He, creating a massive black sonic tide.

chapters.title: Chapter 564 - 540: Demon Heart Vine
chapters.content:
Lei He was startled by Yuan Ming's overwhelming barrage of attacks, surprised by Yuan Ming's tactics at the same time. His hands, holding a black short cone, had already unleashed seven or eight thunderbolts, slashing towards Blood Shadow and Hong Ling.
Simultaneously, a red light flashed in front of him as the ancient red painting he had just acquired materialized out of thin air and unfurled with a "whoosh".
The painting depicted a crimson mountain peak. With a loud "boom", a vast crimson mountain erupted from within the painting, nearly filling the entire palace, facing the dense array of magic treasures and secret techniques.
However, the Crow Formation's black sound waves were faster, easily penetrating the crimson mountain and engulfing Lei He's body.
A look of stupor crossed Lei He's face in an instant, and the spirit light on the black short cone and the crimson mountain dimmed as well.
The Fairy Binding Rope emerged from the ground, wrapped around Lei He's ankles, and pulled him out, exposing him beyond the protection of the crimson mountain.
Dozens of magic treasures and secret techniques engulfed Lei He's body, a flash of blood appeared, and was then submerged by a blinding light.
After a few breaths, a small purple figure, covered by Hong Ling's Binding Immortal Spider Web, was delivered next to Yuan Ming.
The facial features of the small figure bore a seventy to eighty percent resemblance to Lei He, but its eyes were tightly shut, seemingly unconscious.
The numb sensation in Yuan Ming's body spread again. Spots of gray-white appeared on his skin, making it look like stone. His mana circulation had begun to stall, but he still pushed himself to take out the Empty Gloves, and with Hong Ling's help, put them on.
A black and blue interwoven hand emerged and entered Lei He's Nascent Soul.
It wasn't long before the black and blue hand dissipated.
Yuan Ming had already gleaned the desired information from Lei He's memories. He was now completely numb, afflicted by a potent Earth Attribute poison: Sandman Poison.
Once afflicted by this poison, one's entire body becomes numb, then petrifies, including the blood, bones, and internal organs. Eventually, it completely turns into a stone statue before shattering into a pile of gravel.
When it reaches this stage, both flesh and divine soul disappear entirely from this world, leaving not a trace behind.
In terms of virulence, Sandman Poison is not inferior to the Snake-man Clan's One Rihong.
Like One Rihong's poisonous liquid, Sandman Poison is colorless and tasteless, appearing as dust—indistinguishable from dust without any smell or essence, unnoticeable when scattered on the ground.
The only weakness of this poison is its slow activation, requiring a long time to take effect after contamination. Lei He talking with Yuan Ming for so long had been for this purpose.
Sandman Poison came from the Southern Border Five Immortals Sect. Lei He slew an expert from this sect years ago and acquired this poison. He had never used it until now; this was its first deployment.
Yuan Ming bitterly smiled inwardly, feeling "honored" to be so valued by a Nascent Soul cultivator like Lei He.
As for Lei He's reason for attacking Yuan Ming, it was similar to Daoist Qian Bao's motive—coveting what was on him. However, Lei He was not after the Golden Crow Divine Arrow but his Thunder God Hammer.
The black short cone in Lei He's hand was called God Bombarding Cone, and along with his Thunder God Hammer, they were a set of magic treasures known as the Thunder God Bombarding Divine Hammer.
The Thunder God Bombarding Divine Hammer was not a replica spirit treasure like the Cold Moon Ring or Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear but a genuine Thunder Spirit Treasure, just lacking an artifact spirit.
This treasure did not originate from Three Immortals Island but was the sect's treasure of Shenxiao Island, a mysterious force from the East Sea ten thousand years ago.
Shenxiao Island was once a major island in the East Sea, on par with Fusang Island, specialized in Thunder and Lightning Divine Power. The island housed an excellent Thunder and Lightning Spirit Vein, rumored to autonomously absorb the celestial power of thunder and lightning, supplying it to the cultivators of Shenxiao Island.
However, for unknown reasons, Shenxiao Island suddenly sank ten thousand years ago, and not even the island remained visible. Only a few disciples who were outside survived.
Red Rain Island inherited the Daoist Lineage from Shenxiao Island, but only the God Bombarding Cone survived as the inherited treasure; the Thunder God Hammer's whereabouts were unknown until it was acquired by Shura Master.
Lei He saw Yuan Ming using the Thunder God Hammer at the Immortal Fruit Conference, and felt both shocked and incredulous. He used a secret technique called "Circular Light Technique" to spy on him, investigating whether the Thunder God Hammer was the lost treasure of Shenxiao Island while conspiring to snatch it.
Though Yuan Ming had only a Core Formation stage cultivation, his true strength was unfathomably deep. After careful consideration, Lei He decided to show goodwill first, to gain Yuan Ming's trust before making a move, leading to their current situation.
"Crafty old fox!" Yuan Ming cursed inwardly.
As for the Circular Light Technique, it was a secret technique passed down by Three Immortals Island. Lei He's previously mentioned news about the Three Immortals Island was not false. A Red Rain Island elder once encountered Three Immortals Island reemerging and obtained a page from the Golden Sunflower Heavenly Book, which listed this technique, allowing one to spy on others silently and far more covertly than with Divine Sense.
Yuan Ming halted his thoughts and no longer dwelled on Lei He, starting to consider the Sandman Poison in his body.
There was no cure for this poison, and Lei He carried no antidote. Yuan Ming, lacking an Earth Spirit Root, found it even harder to resist the poison.
His thoughts raced, not bothering that Hua Zhi was still breaking through, and he telepathically awakened her.
"Master, what has happened?" Hua Zhi appeared from within the vine cocoon, her aura improved, already stepping into Level 4 realm.
But, her breakthrough being interrupted, Hua Zhi's demon energy was chaotic, clearly suffering significant backlash.
Yuan Ming had no time to deal with these matters and told Hua Zhi in detail about how Lei He had secretly manipulated him.
On hearing this, Hua Zhi hurriedly emerged from the Spiritual Beast Bag and several vines pierced into various parts of Yuan Ming's body, deploying the Absorption Poison Divine Ability.
As time passed bit by bit, a layer of grayish-white color appeared on the vines of Hua Zhi, but the numbness in Yuan Ming's body did not subside at all.
"It won't work, my Absorption Poison Divine Ability comes from the Poisonous Toad, which is just a common demon beast of the Southern Border. As my strength continuously improved, my divine abilities tended towards devouring and regeneration, and the Absorption Poison Divine Ability gradually became a side path. It's fine against common deadly poisons, but this Sandman Poison is a severe poison from the Five Immortals Sect. I am powerless against it," Hua Zhi said dejectedly.
A sense of dread sank in Yuan Ming's heart; he had no other antidote, and Hua Zhi was powerless. The Sandman Poison was probably incurable.
"Damn, am I really going to perish here today?" he thought to himself, forced to consider the ultimate life-saving measure of a Soul Cultivator: body seizing.
Body seizing was an ability of the Sleeping Witch, and he was still some way off from being a Sleeping Witch, but with the help of the Stealing Heaven Tripod, he could perform the body-seizing technique.
However, doing so would ruin the results of his years of hard work in Magic Practitioner and Body Cultivation.
"You need not lose heart, my friend, I have a way to break the deadly poison in your body," suddenly, Qi Ye's voice rang out at that moment.
"Senior Qi Ye! Are you serious?" Yuan Ming exclaimed with joy upon hearing this.
"Of course, I am serious. The antidote is actually already by your side, you just didn't know it," Qi Ye said.
"Which do you mean, senior?" Yuan Ming quickly communicated through a spiritual message to inquire.The most up-to-date version is on *.
"This demon vine by your side, it's surprising to see a Demon Heart Vine here in the Yunhuang Continent," Qi Ye said.
"Demon Heart Vine?" Yuan Ming swept his Divine Sense over Hua Zhi.
Hua Zhi sensed Yuan Ming's Divine Sense and was puzzled.
"Demon Heart Vine is a creature from the Demon World, capable of devouring all living things and transforming them into its own nourishment. It is also very rare in the Demon World. Yuan, you're indeed fortunate to have tamed a Demon Heart Vine as your spirit beast," Qi Ye said, his tone revealing a hint of envy.
"The Demon World? Does it truly exist in this world?" Yuan Ming couldn't help but ask curiously.
"This world is vast beyond your imagination, and the Yunhuang Continent is just a secluded corner of it," Qi Ye said with a laugh.
"We can talk about the Demon World some other time. Senior, you mentioned Hua Zhi could rid me of the deadly poison, how should this be done?" Yuan Ming was very interested in the outside world, but the increasing numbness in his body was overpowering his curiosity.
"The Demon Heart Vine's ability to devour other beings is astonishing, but it has an even more powerful ability—through the Symbiosis Technique, it can plunder the primary essence of other beings and claim their divine abilities as its own," Qi Ye explained.
"Symbiosis Technique!" Yuan Ming was greatly shocked, a flicker of realization crossing his eyes.
Hua Zhi, when it was still a demon vine, had no ability to release or neutralize poison. It acquired the Absorption ability after absorbing the Poisonous Toad.
He had found it strange before, but now everything made sense. Hua Zhi could refine other beings and plunder their divine abilities.
"This Demon Heart Vine's absorption ability comes from a low-level demon beast, so it is ineffective against the Sandman Poison. I sense that you possess a Purple Extreme Tai Sui, which is of a considerably high level. Purple Extreme Tai Sui is the king of all poisons. Have the Demon Heart Vine employ the Symbiosis Technique again to absorb the Purple Extreme Tai Sui, and its absorption ability will significantly improve. Let alone Sandman Poison, even poisons several times stronger could be devoured and refined," Qi Ye continued.
Yuan Ming's face showed delight, but then he frowned.
"Do you still have any doubts, young friend?" Qi Ye asked upon seeing this.
"Hua Zhi seems unaware of its own ability for Symbiosis Technique. Its merging with the Poisonous Toad was also a fortuitous accident. Even if it can employ the Symbiosis Technique, it might require a considerable amount of time. I'm afraid I won't be able to hold on that long," Yuan Ming said with a shake of his head.
The Sandman Poison had already seeped deep into his body and would claim his life before long.
"Your Demon Heart Vine is about to enter Level 4, and even if it hasn't awakened the Symbiotic Divine Ability, it can still instinctively employ it. You don't have to worry about that. And as for your time, worry not. I have a Cultivation Technique that can effectively delay the Sandman Poison. Using this technique, you can gather and compress the Sandman Poison in a specific part of your body. Even if Hua Zhi and Purple Extreme Tai Sui's symbiosis still cannot drive out the Sandman Poison, you can then sever the region where the poison is concentrated, and it will not threaten your life," Qi Ye explained.
"If that's the case, I am tremendously grateful to you, Senior Qi Ye," Yuan Ming expressed his gratitude.
"It's a trivial matter. Now, remember the Cultivation Technique mantra…" Qi Ye transmitted a stream of consciousness into Yuan Ming's Sea of Consciousness, which turned out to be a profound Cultivation Technique.
This Cultivation Technique, called the "Taiyin Refining Spleen Technique," was an Earth Attribute Cultivation Method, capable of channelling Earth Essence into the body and integrating it into the spleen.
Common techniques stored Mana in the Dantian, but the Taiyin Refining Spleen Technique was entirely different.
The human organs also correspond to Yin Yang and the Five Elements, and the spleen belongs to Earth. Storing Earth Essence in the spleen complements each other and is much more exquisite than common Earth Attribute Cultivation Methods.
According to the technique, once cultivated to advanced levels, the Taiyin Refining Spleen Technique becomes the King of Ten Thousand Earth, able to wield all Earth Attribute Spiritual Power and even control Earth Core Primordial Magnetism. It can utilize Earth God Thunder, Earth Escape Technique, Mountain Moving Technique, Earth Concealing Skill, and other profound Earth Attribute Divine Skills.
The Sandman Poison, being an Earth Attribute deadly poison, could not escape the scope of the Taiyin Refining Spleen Technique.

chapters.title: Chapter 565 - 541: The Tree Man Turmoil
chapters.content:
"This Taiyin Refining Spleen Technique is indeed exquisite, but I, Yuan Ming, lack the Earth Spirit Root, and I'm afraid it will be difficult to cultivate this method," Yuan Ming hesitated slightly before sending a message through his divine sense.
"Don't worry, others without the Earth Spirit Root indeed cannot cultivate the Taiyin Refining Spleen Technique, but you are an exception," Qi Ye said.
"Oh? How so?" Yuan Ming asked, puzzled.
"You possess the Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill and the Shura Blood Devouring Map. The combination of these two can resolve the issue of lacking the Spirit Root," Qi Ye said with a smile.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming's face showed a contemplative expression, as if he had realized something.
"The main function of the Spirit Root is to channel nature's spiritual energy into the body, which is why mortals without Spirit Roots cannot cultivate. Cultivators who lack the Earth Attribute Spirit Root cannot cultivate Earth Attribute Cultivation Methods. But you are different. Your Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill has already achieved a certain level of proficiency, having refined a large amount of Blood Origin Power from various demon beasts. Among these, there are quite a few with the Earth Attribute. In other words, your physical body has already stored a substantial amount of Earth Spirit Power, and there's no need for a Spirit Root to channel it. You can directly refine and absorb it," Qi Ye explained.
Yuan Ming also realized this and immediately tried to operate the Taiyin Refining Spleen Technique; streams of Earth Spirit Power indeed surged from all over his body, converging within his spleen.
His spleen lit up with an earthy yellow glow, growing increasingly intense, before transforming into a pure Earth magic power.
The mana of the Nine Elements Technique was stored in the Dantian, whereas the power of the Taiyin Refining Spleen Technique was stored in the spleen. The two did not interfere with each other and coexisted peacefully.
It seemed that Qi Ye's method was indeed effective, and Yuan Ming was secretly delighted. He paused his cultivation, relayed Qi Ye's words to Hua Zhi, and took out the Purple Extreme Tai Sui, cutting off half of it and tossing it into the Spiritual Beast Bag where Hua Zhi resided.
After hearing Yuan Ming's words, Hua Zhi stood there stunned for a good while before regaining her composure, with her Divine Soul fluctuating quite differently from before.
"Thank you, Master, and senior Qi Ye. I have remembered many things, including the Symbiosis Technique! Rest assured, Master, I will certainly complete the Symbiosis Technique, absorb the Purple Extreme Tai Sui, and enhance my Absorption ability to refine the Sandman Poison for you!"
After Hua Zhi said these words, she immediately returned to the Spiritual Beast Bag, and countless vines sprouted from her body, wrapping around half of the Purple Extreme Tai Sui.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming nodded and continued to operate the Taiyin Refining Spleen Technique.
The earthy yellow glow on his spleen became brighter, exuding a sense of solidity and grandeur, seemingly connected to the earth beneath his feet as one.
Yuan Ming's face showed a look of surprise, and he continued to operate the Taiyin Refining Spleen Technique, gathering more Earth Spirit Power.
The Sandman Poison within his body was also affected by the Taiyin Refining Spleen Technique, converging towards his spleen, and the numbness quickly receded.
"It's really effective!" Yuan Ming suppressed the excitement in his heart and focused on operating the Taiyin Refining Spleen Technique.
As time passed slowly, nearly half of the Sandman Poison in his body converged in his spleen. His hands and feet were now barely movable, and his tongue had regained its softness, so he could speak.
However, at this moment, Yuan Ming's spleen suddenly ached intensely, as if pierced by countless red-hot knives, and the previously fulgent organ rapidly exhausted.
Yuan Ming was greatly alarmed and hastily stopped operating the Taiyin Refining Spleen Technique.
"I didn't expect the Sandman Poison to be so formidable. Your Taiyin Refining Spleen Technique is too superficial and cannot withstand the erosion of a substantial amount of the poison. However, don't panic, Yuan. I anticipated this," Qi Ye's voice rang out again, still as calm as ever.
As soon as his voice fell, the Shura Blood Devouring Map flew out from Yuan Ming's body, emitting a thick Blood Light.
Qi Ye chanted a spell, and the Shura Blood Devouring Map rapidly shrank until it became a dazzling fist-sized ball of blood-colored light, slowly merging into Yuan Ming's spleen.
* is the home of this chapter
Rolling Blood Origin Power gushed out from the Shura Blood Devouring Map, mixed with a perpetual and strange spiritual power that entered his spleen.
The previously exhausted spleen was injected with an astonishing vitality and began to recover at a speed visible to the naked eye, quickly becoming full and plump, and the stabbing pain vanished.
Yuan Ming breathed a sigh of relief and resumed operating the Taiyin Refining Spleen Technique.
A moment later, all of the Sandman Poison converged in his spleen, and the numbness in his body disappeared completely. He rolled over and stood up.
Just as Yuan Ming was about to thank Qi Ye, the mark of the Stealing Heaven Tripod on his arm suddenly became abnormally hot. Then, the mark slowly faded away, soon disappearing altogether.
Although the Incense Burner Mark disappeared, the Stealing Heaven Tripod did not.
Furthermore, Yuan Ming felt that his connection with the Stealing Heaven Tripod had deepened unknowingly.
In addition, drastic changes took place within the Stealing Heaven Tripod. The white mist swirling around the altar roared and dissipated quickly, expanding the visible area by several times.
In front of the altar was a plaza-like open area, with a huge trench some twenty to thirty zhang wide stretching across it, pitch-black and bottomless. The edges were extremely smooth, as if cut by a knife, appearing like a massive sword mark.
The first soul told Yuan Ming of the changes within the Stealing Heaven Tripod. He was inwardly astonished, yet his expression remained calm to avoid alerting Qi Ye.
"Senior Qi Ye, I was able to suppress the Sandman Poison thanks to your guidance. I cannot thank you enough." Yuan Ming conveyed his thanks through his divine sense.
"It's a trivial matter, not worth mentioning. You are too kind, Yuan," Qi Ye responded with a hearty laugh.
"Senior Qi Ye, regarding the Golden Crow Divine Arrow from the Li Palace that you asked me to collect, I have obtained it. I wonder what the next step is?" Yuan Ming, who had started to trust Qi Ye, inquired.
"Next, there's no need for Yuan to do anything specific. Just store the Golden Crow Divine Arrow carefully and don't let anyone discover it. When the time comes, I will contact you again..." Qi Ye said.
Speaking halfway, Qi Ye abruptly stopped and then cried out in alarm, "Not good! It's awakening ahead of time!"
"What exactly is awakening ahead of time?" Yuan Ming, also startled, hurriedly asked.
"The island will be extremely dangerous for the next three days, Yuan, you must protect your life at all costs! I can say no more, or it will discover me..." Qi Ye spoke in a rush, his voice rapidly weakening until it fell silent.
Yuan Ming furrowed his brows, clueless about the situation.
It was clear from Qi Ye's urgency that some major disaster had occurred on the island.
After a moment's thought, he enveloped the Sealing Stone Box containing the Golden Crow Divine Arrow in a Barrier with the Silver Token, and then stored it within the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space.
The Shura Blood Devouring Map was currently housed within Yuan Ming's spleen, but it didn't affect its usage.
A stream of Blood Light shot from Yuan Ming's palm, pulling Lei He's corpse and the Nascent Soul into the Shura Blood Devouring Map, refining them into a Blood Slave.
"Boom Boom Boom"
Just then, a series of thunderous roars suddenly came from outside the palace, shaking the very ground beneath their feet.
Yuan Ming, sensing trouble, quickly rushed out.
Upon exiting, his brow furrowed even deeper.
The sky outside had become enveloped in a thick layer of Black Mist, almost completely blocking out all sunlight. The dim light and the incessant shouting and killing noises echoed in the distance.
From afar, Yuan Ming saw that the grand doors of the plaza had been breached, an uncountable number of black Tree Men were pouring into the Fire Essence Palace non-stop.
The Jin Chao Clone, Golden Cloud Fairy, and Yan Xiang, among others, had been scattered by the Tree Men and were now engaged in fierce combat with them.
Loud explosions roared in the distance, and an entire palace rooftop was blown off.
The figure of Golden Transformation Master burst out from it, only to have just reached mid-air when several thick black tendrils extended from the ruins of the great hall below and wrapped around him, yanking him back down.
A furious roar emanated from the ruins as a two-zhang tall black Tree Man stood up, its vast figure appearing almost like a dark god worshipped in some primitive religion.
Elsewhere, Yan Xiang was besieged by hundreds of black Tree Men. Although there were no particularly odd-shaped Tree Men among them, the relentless waves of attackers still left him overwhelmed.
More and more wounds on his body ignited Yan Xiang's already irritable mood to the brink of eruption. He let out an angered roar as he wildly poured magical power into the Mystic Fire Fan in his hand.
The feathers of the Mystic Fire Fan vibrated violently as the surging mana transformed into a torrent of Flames. With Yan Xiang's swing, a gigantic and ferocious Fire Dragon was drawn forth, encircling him before forming a circular flame wall over a zhang high, pouring out intense flames in every direction.
The black Tree Men close to him were immediately engulfed by Flames and turned to ashes in short order.
Yan Xiang managed to catch a moment's breath but could hardly rejoice.
His magic power had been consumed greatly, and without a chance to replenish, more black Tree Men were already stepping over the ashes of their companions, converging on him once again.
Seeing that Yan Xiang's attacks were effective, the Jin Chao Clone's body ignited with golden Flames, and from its chest, as if a vortex, a thick stream of golden Flames was violently ejected, piercing through the chests of three ordinary black Tree Men.
The ferocity of these black Tree Men was beyond imagination. Not only did they fight without fear of death, but their bodies were also incredibly sturdy. Only the most intense Flames could incinerate them; otherwise, it wasn't easy to defeat them with strength alone.
These creatures were numerous, seemingly endless in their assault.
Besides the mass of ordinary black Tree Men, there were also some with significantly larger bodies, or with plate armor formed on them, or with spiked vines—all sorts of odd-shaped Tree Men.
Yuan Ming, watching everyone else struggling in battle, was reluctant to join in the fray, but before he could return to the grand hall, he noticed that a dozen Tree Men had already spotted him and were charging his way.
Without any hesitation, he retreated back into the palace and closed the doors behind him. A cacophony of sounds resembling the clashing of metal against stone immediately erupted outside.
Yuan Ming's gaze swept over the interior of the hall, but he couldn't find anywhere to hide.
In the current situation, if he were entangled by these black Tree Men, it was doubtful that even releasing Hong Ling and Blood Shadow would allow for a quick escape.
After briefly contemplating, Yuan Ming leaped up to the rafters of the grand hall.
He then took out the Stealing Heaven Tripod, placed it against the wall at the base of the rafters, and in a swift movement, concealed himself within the Tripod.
No sooner had he hidden himself than the doors of the Li Palace were smashed open by a great force, and a dozen black Tree Men squeezed into the grand hall, stumbling over each other and even falling to the floor.
Fortunately, these creatures seemed to lack high spiritual intelligence and, failing to see Yuan Ming, furiously rampaged throughout the grand hall. Some even thrust their tendrils into the ground, peeling back a layer of the floor.
After their destructive bout, the black Tree Men rushed out once more, leaving the hall in complete disarray.

chapters.title: Chapter 566 - 542: Divine Bow Shows Its Power
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming, within the space of the Stealing Heaven Tripod, had just approached the enormous Sword Trace Rift in front of the altar when he sensed an intensely fierce aura emanating from within and immediately halted his steps.
He took out several Fire Spirit Peaches from his storage magic tool, which he had previously picked in the Peach Forest, and threw them into the rift.
The Fire Spirit Peaches traced an arc in mid-air before falling into the rift.
The initially calm rift suddenly churned with mist, and before Yuan Ming could see clearly what had happened, he saw that the peaches had turned into dust and vanished in smoke.
Yuan Ming swallowed his saliva, felt a chill in his heart, and immediately stopped, no longer daring to approach any closer.
He walked a distance away and then sat down cross-legged, separating his Divine Sense from his body and extending it outside of the Stealing Heaven Tripod to survey the area beyond the Li Palace.
At this moment, the situation outside had already turned terribly dire.
The group that had just been fiercely battling now seemed to have fallen into a disadvantageous position.
The Golden Transformation Master was surrounded by three black Tree Men over six meters tall, tightly entwined by vines and roots, which had woven into a giant black cocoon, trapping him completely with no hope of escape.
Yan Xiang was still continuously swinging the Mystic Fire Fan in his hand, creating a circular wall of intense flames that kept hundreds of black Tree Men at bay.
His hair disheveled, his body showed clear signs of injury, blood drenched, with even his legs and waist bearing marks of being entwined by tree vines; his overall condition looked extremely grim, evidently nearing his limit.
As for the Golden Cloud Fairy, she had vanished without a trace, leaving one to wonder whether she had escaped or met with some misfortune, while Jin Chao was still struggling in the fierce battle.
The demonic power of Jin Chao's clone had diminished considerably for unknown reasons, and he faced far more Tree Men than the others, already showing signs of exhaustion.
On the other side, Gu Xuanyang, holding the Ancient Bronze Sword, saw patterns on the blade light up, emitting rings of faint azure light. Every strike of his sword released a beam of azure sword light, severing black Tree Men wherever it passed.
However, his expression was not good; wielding his sword, he darted through the army of Tree Men, continuously shattering those ordinary Tree Men, seeking a path to break out.
Yet, those black Tree Men seemed endless, no matter which direction he broke towards; he always met an unending sea of trees, and his attempts to break through were repeatedly thwarted.
"Ha!"
With a long cry from his mouth, he suddenly switched from holding his sword with one hand to both hands. The fluctuation around his body surged dramatically, and with an axe-like chop, he slashed forward.
The Ancient Bronze Sword emitted a sword light hundreds of meters long that fell alongside the blade.
Under the sword light, the void trembled, shattering hundreds of black Tree Men into dust.
A crack about a meter wide appeared on the ground, stretching over a hundred meters, even slashing a huge gap in the distant palace wall.
Seeing this, Gu Xuanyang leaped forward, rushing along the sword trace he had created towards the outside of the palace wall.
The others, seeing this, also found their direction and began to charge towards that side.
Suddenly, from within the nearly completed cocoon, a dazzling blue light shone, followed by sounds of dragon's roars.
Nine enormous Azure Dragon phantoms burst out of the cocoon, bringing with them huge waves, shattering it.
Not far away, the Golden Transformation Master held a green round bead that revealed dragon shadows, riding on an Azure Dragon formed from condensed water waves, flying away into the distance.
But before he could leave the range of the Fire Essence Palace, thousands of black wood fibers flew towards him like rain, forcefully stopping him.
The three Tree Men that had previously trapped him were now sprinting after him, their vines stretching out to each other, entangling and connecting.
In no time, the three black Tree Men merged with each other, ultimately forming a giant nine meters tall.
The giant Tree Man's aura surged, emitting an imposing pressure that had reached the Nascent Soul Middle Stage, its might extremely astonishing.
With one step, covering more than ten meters, it caught up with the Golden Transformation Master, who was being pelted back by the rain of wooden fibers, and a gigantic hand, like a cage, enveloped him.
As a layer of black light shone in its palm, no sign of resistance came from the Golden Transformation Master within that cage.
