On the other hand, Yan Xiang, who had consumed a vast amount of mana but had no time to replenish, found the power of his Mystic Fire Fan greatly reduced. Pressed by a dozen Tree Men with wood vine armor on their chests, he was overwhelmed and captured near the flames.
Not far from him, Jin Chao's clone had depleted his strength, unable to muster even a trace of Flame Sun Power, and the power of the flames he released diminished drastically, unable to hold for a moment before being captured by a bizarre Tree Man with three heads and six arms.
One of that Tree Man's palms had formed a vine cage, inside of which was the unconscious Golden Cloud Fairy.
Gu Xuanyang, reaching the breach in the palace wall, felt a glimmer of hope to escape, but suddenly a figure flashed in front of him.
Its appearance was similar to other Tree Men, but it wore a tattered coarse cloth robe and a hat woven from straw, resembling a peasant from the fields.
In other places, Gu Xuanyang might not even spare such a strangely dressed individual a glance, but here it set off alarm bells in his heart, filling him with dread.
At this moment, Yuan Ming, observing this scene with his Divine Sense, was even more shocked.
That person's attire was all too familiar to him; wasn't that Zhao Gui from Qing Gui Village who had offered him tea?
He was actually a Tree Man as well?
"Move aside." Gu Xuanyang gasped for breath and bellowed angrily.
As he shouted, he lifted the Ancient Bronze Sword in his hand again and cleaved towards the bizarre Tree Man.
The latter did not utter a word, nor did it show any signs of dodging. Instead, it charged straight towards him with a speed that was astonishing.
Just as the sword light fell, Zhao Gui's palm suddenly lifted, unveiling a short-handled hoe enveloped in a dull yellow glow, blocking the strike.
With a loud bang!
A ripple of light spread in all directions, and the Ancient Bronze Sword seemed to have struck a mountain, rebounding back with immense force, causing Gu Xuanyang to stagger.
In contrast, Zhao Gui remained unmoved, only slightly sinking his form before rushing forward, pressing his shoulder against Gu Xuanyang's chest.
A surge of yellow light exploded from his shoulder, forming a yellow halo, seemingly revealing a miniature Array.
There was a muffled bang!
Gu Xuanyang's chest sank inward as if struck by a huge rock, blood spurting from his mouth, and his body fell backward like a kite with its string cut, severely wounded.
Before he could hit the ground, Zhao Gui's extended palm transformed into vine-like tendrils that wrapped around him, binding him like a rice dumpling.
In less than half an hour, these Nascent Soul cultivators, who had once dominated the East Sea, were all defeated and captured.
Yuan Ming was shocked and bewildered, unable to understand how these Tree Men suddenly appeared in such numbers, among them some of Core Formation Nascent Soul level.
What puzzled him even more was the nature of Zhao Gui's existence.
Before he could figure it out, another anomaly occurred.
Suddenly, from within the main hall of the Fire Essence Palace, a thunderous noise erupted, and a majestic golden light shot straight out, hovering above the Fire Essence Palace.
Upon sensing it with his Divine Sense, Yuan Ming felt an overwhelming power that made it impossible for him to look directly.
In the dazzling light, an ancient golden Divine Bow emerged from thin air!Catch the formatted version at *.
The moment the Golden Divine Bow appeared, it seemed as if the majesty of heaven had descended, emitting a pressure that overpowered everything.
The black Tree Men rampaging in the Fire Essence Palace, as if summoned, all turned their gaze toward the floating golden Divine Bow, their bodies involuntarily trembling slightly.
Zhao Gui, dressed like an old farmer and one of the strange Tree Men, after staring at the Divine Bow for a moment, turned with Gu Xuanyang and left.
The nine-meter-tall giant Tree Man holding Golden Transformation Master also followed suit and departed.
Similarly, the two other oddly-shaped Tree Men who had captured Yan Xiang, Golden Cloud Fairy, and Jin Chao Clone also hastened towards the outside of the Fire Essence Palace.
At that moment, a severe fluctuation of Spiritual Power emanated from the sky-bound golden Divine Bow, and a swirling golden light vortex emerged.
From the direction of the Kan Palace, five golden lights rapidly approached, transforming into five Golden Crow Divine Arrows that landed on the bowstring, pulling it taut like a full moon.
The next instant, the stretched bowstring snapped back, making a sound like thunder.
The five Divine Arrows whooshed out, turning into five thick beams of golden light that struck different parts of the Fire Essence Palace.
The arrows landed with a booming sound, continuously exploding!
Threads of fine golden light, like thousands of serpents, burst forth, shooting in all directions. Wherever they passed, hundreds of black Tree Men were pierced by the light, their chests burnt into large crimson holes.
Clusters of black Tree Men fell like harvested wheat, the majority dying instantly, while those Tree Men fortunate enough to survive scrambled towards the palace exit in a panic.
After a round of arrowfire, the divine power of the golden Divine Bow retracted and transformed back into a golden light, returning to the central palace.
Yuan Ming, hidden within the Stealing Heaven Tripod, watched this scene unfold. Although not present at the scene, he couldn't help but feel his heart race.
Although calm seemed to have temporarily returned outside, he did not rush to leave. Instead, he took out Lei He's Storage Bag and began to examine it.
Soon, Yuan Ming took out the black short cone.
Among the Magic Treasures Lei He carried, what interested him the most was the God Bombarding Cone that could be paired with his Thunder God Hammer.
Yuan Ming held the God Bombarding Cone carefully in his hands. Despite being less than a foot long, all-black, and unevenly surfaced as though hammered thousands of times, it felt ice-cold to the touch, with a faint tingling sensation like a mild electric shock.
In terms of material and texture, the God Bombarding Cone was not exactly the same as the Thunder God Hammer, but when Yuan Ming placed them together, the two Magic Treasures inexplicably generated a connection fluctuation.
Trace electric currents led them closer, the two artifacts drawing near like long-lost friends, sharing some ineffable, profound connection.
Without any hesitation, Yuan Ming held the God Bombarding Cone and began to refine it right away.
Before long, after refining the God Bombarding Cone, the gentle electric sensation that came from it had vanished. At the flick of Yuan Ming's finger, bursts of blue electric arcs leaped forth, crackling loudly.

chapters.title: Chapter 567 - 543: The Fall of Fusang Island
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming took a deep breath, holding the God Bombarding Cone in one hand and the Thunder God Hammer in the other, as he edged closer to the Sword Trace Rift.
He glanced at the fog shrouded in the rift and took another deep breath, channeling his mana into both the God Bombarding Cone and the Thunder God Hammer.
As the mana flowed in, the surfaces of the two magic treasures bubbled with blue and purple arcs of electricity that danced exuberantly, as if releasing long-suppressed emotions in one joyful burst.
Yuan Ming raised the Thunder God Hammer high and struck down fiercely onto the God Bombarding Cone.
With a "boom," the sound of thunder exploded.
A surge of thunder energy seeped out from the Thunder God Hammer, and the moment it entered the God Bombarding Cone, its power amplified tenfold.
Seven or eight thick bolts of bluish-purple thunder, as thick as the mouth of a bowl, intertwined, writhing and snaking like multiple thunder flood dragons.
"Boom! Boom! Boom!"
A series of thunderous explosions roared, with countless sparks and flashes rolling tumultuously, resembling the storm clouds of the Nine Heavens.
Yuan Ming watched, thrilled with the spectacle.
"Indeed, when combined it's akin to a Thunder Spirit Treasure, far more powerful than when used separately. Even when Lei He used it before, it probably wasn't this powerful," he reflected before pushing down his excitement.
The seven or eight thunder flood dragons shot out, heading straight for the Sword Trace Rift. However, as soon as they entered the range of the rift, they immediately dissipated without a trace, as silently as when he'd previously thrown a Fire Spirit Peach.
"Even the attacks from the Thunder God Bombarding Divine Hammer can be easily eradicated—what on earth is the origin of this sword trace?" Yuan Ming grew even more curious about the Sword Trace's origins.
He shook his head, put away the Thunder God Bombarding Divine Hammer, and continued to search for Lei He's Storage Ring, soon finding a golden page.
"Could it be the Golden Sunflower Heavenly Book? How could Lei He have it on him?" Yuan Ming's heart raced inexplicably faster.
From Lei He's memories, he knew of the existence of a page from the Golden Sunflower Heavenly Book and knew that it detailed a magic called "Circular Light Technique," but he hadn't expected to find the page on Lei He.
After a careful examination, his smile grew even brighter.
Just as he had guessed, this golden page was indeed from the Golden Sunflower Heavenly Book, and it detailed the "Circular Light Technique."
The Circular Light Technique was not complex, or at least, it wasn't complex for Yuan Ming, who had a background as a Soul Cultivator. Ultimately, it was also a magic for divine sense exploration.
However, what set it apart from other similar magics was its ability to conceal one's divine thought. Even cultivators with higher cultivation might not detect the Circular Light Technique's probing, and it was also immune to divine-sense-restricting arrays.
Although the technique was easy to pick up, belonging to the category of "easy to learn but difficult to master," there were virtually no barriers at the learning stage. However, mastering it to perfection, especially in terms of concealing divine sense and extending its range, was extremely challenging, with many limitations.
Yuan Ming made a brief attempt and mastered the technique with ease. However, due to the short learning time, his probing range was not extensive, stretching only about a hundred yards.
But within this hundred-yard range, if he used the Circular Light Technique to explore others, even a Nascent Soul cultivator would find it extremely difficult to detect.
"This technique has infinite ingenious uses. I must practice diligently in the future," Yuan Ming told himself.
Then, after searching a bit more, he took out an ancient red scroll, which was precisely the treasure that Lei He had acquired in the golden hall earlier.
Yuan Ming slowly unrolled the ancient scroll and, upon seeing its content, couldn't help but frown.
The scroll had a lot of blank space and only depicted a simple two-storied wooden building barrenly, with nothing else, making the entire scene seem discordant.
However, as his fingertips brushed over the surface of the scroll, a ripple of illusory light vibrated, and a distinct spatial fluctuation emerged, causing a tingling sensation on his fingertips.
Yuan Ming furrowed his brows slightly, realizing that this object was no simple thing.
He immediately held the scroll in his hand, poured mana into it, and tried to refine it. Content sourced from * – *.
The moment the ancient red scroll was fully refined, Yuan Ming finally understood what it was.
Turns out, it was an exceedingly rare Space Treasure. The space within it was vast beyond Yuan Ming's imagination.
The small wooden building wasn't just a picture drawn on it but was in fact the actual building held within. In other words, everything stored in the scroll would be displayed as an image on the scroll.
Yuan Ming tried storing a short sword inside and found only a grain-sized pattern appearing on the scroll. If his eyes and heart hadn't been so keen, he would have almost missed it.
"It seems that the size of the image displayed depends on the original item's volume. This is far more convenient than a storage ring or storage bag," Yuan Ming muttered to himself, as thoughts of Houtu Mountain in the secret realm's underground came to mind.
Considering the amount of blank space in the scroll, it seemed collecting Houtu Mountain wouldn't be a problem, right?
Yuan Ming steadied himself, and after another round of inventory, found more than 200,000 spirit stones and seven or eight magic treasures.
Given Lei He's identity as a Nascent Soul cultivator, these magic treasures were not of a low grade, all adorned with at least six runes, treasures that could enrich the Thousand Treasures Scripture Pillar.
Besides, Lei He's Storage Ring contained many spirit grasses and demon cores, with dozens of thousand-year-old spiritual grasses and several hundred year-old spirit grasses reaching into the hundreds. Yuan Ming wasn't sure if Lei He had collected these on the Three Immortals Island or had always carried so many spirit grasses with him.
As for the demon cores, there were several dozen, all above the third level.
These spirit grasses and demon cores could be refined into a large batch of elixirs, enough for his cultivation until the late-stage of Core Formation, or even reaching perfect Core Formation.
"Truly, killing for loot is the fastest way to accumulate resources," Yuan Ming thought to himself.
After tallying everything, Yuan Ming released his Divine Sense again to check the outside, ensuring there were no dangers before leaving the space of the Stealing Heaven Tripod and returning to the great hall of Li Palace.
Looking at the mess inside and outside the hall, and then recalling the eerie, strange Tree Man Zhao Gui and the majestic golden Divine Bow that followed, Yuan Ming couldn't help breaking out in a cold sweat.
Throughout his journey, he had assumed that Three Immortals Island might be in danger, but believed it would be within his control, and with Xi Ying's abilities, survival wouldn't be an issue—hence he had been exploring with peace of mind.
However, the current situation was such that even though he knew Xi Ying must be more familiar with this place than he was, Yuan Ming couldn't help worrying about her safety.
He glanced at the Stealing Heaven Tripod in his hand and with a flick of his wrist, he took out a stick of Black Incense and inserted it into the tripod.
Yuan Ming lit the Black Incense and began to visualize Guoguo's appearance in his mind.
After the failed attempt to summon Xi Ying before, Yuan Ming had hardly tried again; every time, he would summon through Guoguo to check on Xi Ying's status.
Before long, his Divine Thought descended upon Guoguo.
To his surprise, instead of a dangerous battle or a perilous situation, Xi Ying was currently situated in a lush and vibrant, peculiar space filled with flowers and plants.
Surrounded by a riot of blooming flowers and rich vegetation, towering ancient trees could be seen everywhere, vines draping down like verdant curtains, and even with the mere contact through Divine Thought, he could sense an abundance of Spiritual Energy and burgeoning life.
What astonished Yuan Ming even more was that there were two suns hanging above the sky of this space.
Unlike the Seven Suns over Golden Sunflower Immortal Island, one of these suns was brilliantly white, dazzling, with no halo of light around it, while the other was pitch-black, round and plump, as if painted with ink.
Despite being two completely opposite entities, they were hanging together in the sky harmoniously, with no extreme temperatures around them; on the contrary, the atmosphere was remarkably comfortable.
At this moment, Xi Ying was sitting cross-legged on a verdant lotus flower, enveloped in a radiant aura, evidently in deep cultivation.
Through Guoguo's vision, he could tell that she was vigilantly surveying her surroundings, yet she showed no sign of nervousness, indicating that this place was relatively safe.
Seeing that Xi Ying was not in danger, Yuan Ming finally relaxed. Unwilling to disturb her cultivation, he withdrew from Guoguo and his Divine Thought returned to his own body.
Upon waking, Yuan Ming extinguished the still-burning Black Incense and put it away.
With the three-day period advised by Qi Ye not yet passed, he didn't hastily leave but entered the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space once more.
"Right, I wonder what's the situation outside now?" Yuan Ming suddenly recalled something and contacted Miao Xian at Hundred Pills Square via a Desire Power anchor point.
...
In the East Sea, on Red Ganoderma Island.
Within a room in a secluded garden, Yan Siyun, with hair somewhat disheveled, sat at a table, flipping through Jade Scrolls containing intelligence gathered from various places, her beautiful face looking complex and weary.
On the day she and Bi Shuirou left Fusang Island and returned to Red Ganoderma Island, several days had already passed.
She thought the chaos on Fusang Island would soon end, but unexpected events followed one after another, too fast for the eye to follow.
The chaos had now spread across the entire East Sea. Many islands were in a state of panic, fearing for their security. Even Red Ganoderma Island was preparing to activate its protective Array and temporarily seal off the island.
With a furrowed brow, Yan Siyun had thought that the situation in the East Sea Immortal Cultivation World was stable, which is why she had relocated Hundred Pills Square here; little did she expect that right after gaining a foothold in the region, the entire East Sea would be thrown into turmoil, significantly impacting the business of Hundred Pills Square.
Fortunately, Hundred Pills Square had the support of Lord Nether Moon God; as long as devotion was sincere, they should avoid the catastrophic downfall they faced during the time in the Black Wind Desert.
"I wonder how Divine Envoy Yuan is doing?" Yan Siyun lamented in her thoughts.
For the past few days, her concern for Yuan Ming's well-being never ceased, and she had been praying devoutly to the statue of Nether Moon God every day, but without receiving any response.
Yan Siyun fetched a Compass-like Magic Treasure, inscribed with numerous complex lines and star patterns.
This object was called the Heavenly Star Plate, a Magic Artifact given to her by Xi Ying, which could aid in the use of the Heavenly Destiny Skill.
Gather her thoughts, she was about to divine Yuan Ming's fortunes when she suddenly felt inexplicably drawn to look towards the statue of Nether Moon God placed on an adjacent table.
The next instant, an immense Divine Sense descended from the heavens, enveloping the woman's form and making her shudder slightly.
"Lord Nether Moon God," Yan Siyun immediately sat up straight and called out with reverence.
"What is the situation on Fusang Island?" the dignified voice of Nether Moon God inquired.
"Lord Nether Moon God, I was just about to report to you that Fusang Island has been overtaken by the Wu Yue Sect," Yan Siyun replied.
Yuan Ming's eyebrows twitched, but he wasn't surprised.
With the Level 5 Golden Crow currently at Three Immortals Island, it was probable that the Island Master of Fusang Island was also there, making it a time when defenses were at their weakest.
It wouldn't have been difficult for the Wu Yue Sect, which had dispatched a Venerable to come here, to capture Fusang Island.
"Any other news?" Nether Moon God spoke again, his voice still as calm as water.
Upon hearing this, Yan Siyun couldn't help but be moved; gods indeed remain unshaken by any changes, their divine spirit undisturbed.
"After conquering Fusang Island, Wu Yue Sect did not stop there; instead, they continued to aggressively attack other islands of the East Sea. For some reason, several First-class Islands have also fallen one after another. At this time, Wu Yue Sect's influence is growing stronger, and they seem poised to sweep across the entire East Sea Immortal Cultivation World," Yan Siyun continued reporting.
"This was to be expected," said Nether Moon God indifferently.
If Wu Yue Sect had taken action, they wouldn't have just set their sights on Fusang Island; they would take advantage of the opportunity to bring the entire East Sea under their tyranny.

chapters.title: Chapter 568 - 544: The Ancient Undying Tree
chapters.content:
"Um... Divine Envoy, still in the Trial Secret Realm, I'm not sure how he..." Yan Siyun saw that Lord Nether Moon God didn't care about these matters and felt an inexplicable sense of calm, but then hesitated to ask again.
"My Angel Envoy will receive my protection; it's not something you need to worry about," Yuan Ming said.
"Subordinate understands the error," Yan Siyun quickly bowed her head upon hearing this.
"Next, continue to gather information about the other islands in the East Sea and the Wu Yue Sect, and pray to report in a timely manner," Yuan Ming instructed after some thought.
"Yes," Yan Siyun replied eagerly, delighted.
She feared that Lord Nether Moon God would ignore her, but the more tasks he assigned to her, the safer Hundred Pills Square would be.
"Considering your recent hard work, I wish to reward you with some spiritual materials and Demon Cores. You may keep some for yourself, and the rest should be sent to Hundred Pills Square for Yan Sijing to refine into elixirs," Yuan Ming continued.
"Thank you, my lord," Yan Siyun said joyfully, quickly expressing her gratitude.
The next instant, a golden and silver light burst forth in front of her, quickly coalescing into an illusory gate a few feet in size.
With a "creak," the golden and silver gates swung open.
A Storage Bag shot out from within and landed on the ground in front of Yan Siyun.
Yan Siyun, sensing through her Divine Sense that the golden and silver light gate hadn't dissipated, didn't immediately pick up the Storage Bag.
On the other side, Yuan Ming hadn't forgotten to remove the Space Restriction. It was just that a sudden idea had come to him as he threw out the Storage Bag, causing him to hesitate for a moment.
This idea was connected to the Six Jia Qimen, which could retrieve objects from afar by exchanging spaces.
There are significant limitations to the Six Jia Qimen; the object for space-time exchange must be within the range of his Mana and Divine Sense.
Yuan Ming's Divine Sense was powerful enough to spread dozens of miles, but his Mana had a much narrower range of radiation. The Six Jia Qimen was limited in effect, thus he didn't highly regard this secret technique.
However, at this moment, Yuan Ming suddenly realized a new use for the Six Jia Qimen.
"Using the Stealing Heaven Tripod, I can extend my Mana and Divine Sense to a great distance. I wonder if I can combine the Six Jia Qimen with the space restriction within the Stealing Heaven Tripod?" Yuan Ming pondered.
This wasn't a whimsical idea that popped into his head; the space restriction could only send items to others and not the reverse.
If the space restriction could transport items both ways, its usefulness would be greatly increased.
Upon thinking of this, Yuan Ming couldn't help but praise it as "brilliant" and began to experiment immediately.
He formed hand seals and cast the Six Jia Qimen Secret Skill. An illusory circle of inscriptions appeared before him, with light circulating within it and emitting waves of spatial fluctuations.
Yuan Ming reached out, and the circular rune formation approached the space restriction until they adhered to each other.
Though they didn't merge completely, there was no rejection between the two.
Yuan Ming felt the spatial fluctuations from both became much stronger.
With a thought, he pictured the Storage Bag he had sent earlier in his mind. With an imaginary grasp of his fingers and a silent shout in his heart:
"Come back!"
The next moment, Yuan Ming could feel a weight in his hand; he now held the very Storage Bag he had gifted to Yan Siyun.
"It really works, it really works..."
While Yuan Ming was overjoyed, Yan Siyun was panicked.
She had "seen" the Storage Bag being pulled by an invisible force, flying backward into the golden and silver light gate and disappearing before her eyes.
In an instant, she thought she had done something wrong that had upset Lord Nether Moon God, prompting him to take back the bestowed treasure.
But no matter how hard she thought, she couldn't figure out where she had erred.
Just as she was conflicted about whether to admit a mistake, the golden and silver light gate in front of her "creaked" open again, and the Storage Bag flew out once more.
This time, the light gate closed immediately and disappeared quickly.
"Lord Nether Moon God..." Yan Siyun said, still stunned, trying to call out.
For a long time, there was no response, and the immense Divine Power also dissipated.
Clearly, Lord Nether Moon God's presence had ended.
She hurriedly picked up the Storage Bag from the ground, still somewhat dazed, not understanding why Lord Nether Moon God would do such a thing.
On the other side, Yuan Ming was also aware that his actions were inappropriate, but he didn't offer any explanation, nor did he continue the experiment.
If he tried it two or three more times, Yan Siyun's loyalty to the deity might begin to waver.
However, just because he couldn't experiment with Yan Siyun, it didn't mean he couldn't test it on someone else.
So Yuan Ming immediately contacted Xu Che to understand the situation on his end and continued to try using the Six Jia Qimen to retrieve items, quickly mastering this ability.
Yuan Ming didn't do many trials, as the Space Power within the Crystal Stone was limited.
He felt quite pleased in his heart. With this ability, he would no longer be limited to one-way gifting of items to others; bilateral exchanges of items would become incredibly efficient and simple.
Thereafter, Yuan Ming continued to stay in the Li Palace for approximately three days.
During these three days, he continued to cultivate the two Divine Power Secret Techniques he had just mastered, the Six Jia Qimen and the Circular Light Technique.
When the fourth day was almost upon him, and seeing that everything outside was calm, whether it be the tide-like Tree People or the mighty golden Divine Bow, none had appeared. Even the layer of black mist that had blocked out the sky had dissipated without a trace, he finally stepped out of the Li Palace.
The plaza outside was a mess, with corpse of Tree People killed by the golden Divine Bow strewn everywhere.
These beings, unlike flesh and blood humans, showed no sign of decay and still looked as they did when they died in battle.
As Yuan Ming walked through this dense pile of Tree People corpses, a strange feeling suddenly arose in his heart. He released his Divine Sense to sweep over the corpses and his expression subtly changed. He subconsciously took out the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear and held it in his hand.This copy comes from content on *.
Just now, while inspecting them, Yuan Ming suddenly sensed a tenacious life force emanating from these Tree People corpses, almost causing him to mistake these beings for having come back to life.
However, upon closer inspection, he realized that these Tree People were indeed as dead as can be.
The tenacious life force on them was more akin to the natural Spiritual Power found within Heavenly Materials and Earthly Treasures, a robust energy, not actual Life Force.
Yuan Ming's eyes shifted and he immediately made contact with Hua Zhi through his Divine Sense.
Having received an affirmative response, Yuan Ming started running all over the plaza, throwing the remaining corpses of the Green-Black Tree People, one after the other, into the Spiritual Beast Bag for Hua Zhi to devour and nourish herself.
Although Hua Zhi was in closed-door cultivation, her Vines sensed the existence of the Tree People and immediately extended towards them, beginning to frantically devour the corpses and absorb that force within them, which drastically accelerated the integration process with the Purple Extreme Tai Sui.
It took Yuan Ming nearly two hours to feed all the corpses of the Green-Black Tree People to Hua Zhi.
Just as he was about to finish up and leave, a formidable pervasive pressure suddenly emanated from the palace behind him.
Yuan Ming felt his scalp tighten. Before he could use his Escape Technique to flee, a beam of Golden Light zipped towards him and coalesced into a golden Divine Bow hanging in mid-air in front of him.
"Who are you?"
The golden Divine Bow stirred with ripples of golden light, from within which an authoritative male voice rang out.
Artifact Spirit of the Divine Bow?
"I am an East Sea Wondering Cultivator. A while back, I attended the Immortal Fruit event on Fusang Island and accidentally strayed into the Three Immortals Island," Yuan Ming, without time to think further, quickly cupped his fists and said.
"Your aura is clean and doesn't seem to be tainted by that old monster, so it appears you indeed arrived here recently," the golden Divine Bow said after hearing him, its bow's snout bending slightly as if nodding slowly.
"Old monster?" Yuan Ming asked, perplexed.
"That's the Old Tree Demon from Penglai Island. You've managed to evade its offspring and the pursuit of its Tree People; you must be quite capable," said the golden Divine Bow.
Yuan Ming sensed a probing look and felt a chill in his heart, his body's hairs standing on end.
This golden Divine Bow seemed so perceptive—had it been observing him all this time? Had it detected the presence of the Stealing Heaven Tripod?
"I happen to possess a treasure that conceals my aura, which is why I was fortunate enough to survive," he thought quickly and spoke calmly.
"No need to worry, I am merely the Spiritual Treasure Artifact Spirit left by the Golden Sunflower Immortal, and I have no covetous desires for the belongings of someone like you," the golden Divine Bow huffed.
"Indeed, the things I carry would certainly not catch Your Excellency's eye. Have you appeared now because there's something I can assist with?" Yuan Ming asked cautiously.
"I've been confined to this Golden Sunflower Immortal Island for countless years and have been unable to communicate with the outside world. What is the state of the outside world now?" the golden Divine Bow inquired.
"The outside world? Are you referring to the East Sea Immortal Cultivation World? That place…" Yuan Ming narrated the events of the East Sea, omitting the attack of the Wuyue Sect to avoid having to explain.
"What about the rest of the Yunhuang Continent?" The golden Divine Bow seemed very interested in the outside affairs and pressed further.
Yuan Ming concealed nothing, revealing everything he knew to the golden Divine Bow, this time not hiding news of the Wuyue Sect's resurgence.
The golden Divine Bow fell silent, seemingly deep in thought.
"Senior, may I ask what those Green-Black Tree People were? And this Old Tree Demon of Penglai Island you mentioned, what is it?" With the golden Divine Bow seemingly easy to talk to and showing no intent to trouble him, Yuan Ming plucked up the courage to inquire.
"The Old Tree Demon from Penglai Island is an Undying Tree. All those Tree People are its controlled offspring," said the golden Divine Bow.
"Undying Tree? The ancient marvelous tree from the legends that produces Undying Immortal Fruits?" Yuan Ming's eyes lit up.
Ever since learning about the existence of the ancient Fusang Divine Tree on Fusang Island, he had Yan Siyun gather plenty of information on ancient trees. The Undying Tree was certainly not less than the Fusang Divine Tree and appeared to be even more mysterious. It was said that the Immortal Fruits from the Undying Tree could grant eternal life or even bring the dead back to life—truly wondrous.
"Yes, those who eat the Undying Fruit produced by the Old Tree Demon can indeed achieve eternal life. If you wish, I can send you to Penglai Island right now," the golden Divine Bow sneered coldly.
"What do you mean, Senior? Are there dangers around the Undying Tree?" Sensing the golden Divine Bow's sarcasm, Yuan Ming inquired.

chapters.title: Chapter 569 - 545: White Desert Island
chapters.content:
"You youngsters truly are naive, to believe that the Three Immortals Island is a safe haven devoid of danger for Immortals? Do you think the spirit herbs and spiritual objects on the island are there for the taking? There's no such thing as a free lunch in this world! Every time the Three Immortals Island opens, it is the Old Tree Demon behind it all, orchestrating to lure cultivators like you to the island. You think it's a rare opportunity from the heavens, but in reality, you're just new puppets for the Old Tree Demon." The Golden Divine Bow vibrated with golden light as it slowly responded.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming immediately recalled the words Qi Ye had previously mentioned, his expression becoming somewhat unnatural as he spoke,
"How can this be? Why would the Undead Tree Demon do this?"
"Naturally, it is for power. You are also a cultivator and should understand that pursuing power is an instinct for all cultivators, the Old Tree Demon is no exception. With each puppet it adds, its power grows stronger. Sooner or later, it will break the seal left by the Penglai Immortal and escape this prison," the Golden Divine Bow's voice contained a trace of desolation.
Yuan Ming was slightly stunned; for them, the outsiders, the Three Immortals Island was a treasure land, but for the Golden Divine Bow, it felt like a prison.
"Senior, please tell me how to leave the Three Immortals Island, and give me a way out," Yuan Ming took a deep breath, clasped his fists, and spoke respectfully.
"There is no way out. From the moment you stepped onto the Three Immortals Island, you were no different from the dead," the Golden Divine Bow's voice was calm, devoid of any emotional fluctuations, apparently having grown accustomed to this fact.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming's expression grew even uglier.
"The exit of the Three Immortals Island is on Penglai Island, which is precisely the lair of the Old Tree Demon. The only way you think you can leave is by killing the Old Tree Demon, but likewise, that method is hardly a method at all," the Golden Divine Bow sighed and said.
"What is the Old Tree Demon's cultivation?" Yuan Ming, still unwilling to give up, asked.
"The Old Tree Demon is a being whose strength is comparable to that of a Returning Void existence. Its life force is incredibly vigorous. Not only would it be difficult for a cultivator like you, but even if several Returning to Void Cultivators came together, they would still find it difficult to kill him," the Golden Divine Bow unabashedly said.
At the mention of "Returning Void," Yuan Ming's heart also sank.
If it were only a Nascent Soul-level existence, Yuan Ming would risk it all to attempt to take it down, at the very least he would be able to protect himself.
But the gap between Core Formation and Returning Void was too wide; it wasn't a gap that could be bridged by magical treasures or numbers, especially since the Jin Hua's Nascent Soul cultivators had been captured, leaving him unable to find more assistance.
"Kid, not to hide it from you, I am the Lifebound Magical Treasure left by the Golden Sunflower Immortal, called Hou Yi's Sun Shooting Bow. In this Fire Essence Palace, my influence still remains; the Old Tree Demon rarely dares to come here to cause trouble. If you do not wish to die, you can stay here with me, and I can still ensure your safety," the Golden Divine Bow circled around Yuan Ming and said.
"Thank you for your kindness, Senior, but I still have other urgent matters and must leave soon," Yuan Ming pretended to deliberate for a moment, then said with difficulty as he shook his head.
He didn't fully believe the words of the Golden Divine Bow before him, and still had to find Xi Ying, so staying here wasn't an option.
Seeing his response, the Golden Divine Bow did not insist, saying,
"Everyone has their own aspirations. If you seek death, I will not stop you. However, according to the rules left by the Golden Sunflower Immortal, as long as someone reaches the Fire Essence Palace, I must grant a reward. Tell me, what do you want?"
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming pondered for a moment before responding,
"May I ask if there is a place on this island where in the sky hangs a black and a white sun?"
"What you are referring to is Lank Island," the Golden Divine Bow said without hesitation.
"Then, the reward I seek would be a way to reach Lank Island," Yuan Ming responded with a smile upon hearing this.
"Any reward you could ask for, and you only want this?" The tone of the Golden Divine Bow conveyed a mix of disbelief and astonishment.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming firmly nodded his head.
Compared to other things, he was more eager to find Xi Ying soon. He had many doubts he wanted her to clear up.
"You haven't had even a slight thought of wanting to make me your own?" the Golden Divine Bow asked.
"Has anyone ever had such a thought?" Yuan Ming asked.
"It might be said, few people have not entertained that notion," the Golden Divine Bow seemed to chuckle slightly as it responded.
"And the result?" Yuan Ming asked.
"The result is that I'm still here, and they failed the test, turning into ashes," the Golden Divine Bow stated.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming's Adam's apple moved up and down as he swallowed hard.
"Senior, if there is a way to go to Lank Island, could you please enlighten me?" Yuan Ming asked again.
The Golden Divine Bow did not say anything further, but its body vibrated with ripples of golden light.
Not far from the square, suddenly a golden light shone from the ground, revealing a golden formation.
"A Teleportation Array?" Yuan Ming's eyes lit up, his heart filled with great joy.
"By passing through this Teleportation Array, you can reach Lank Island," the Golden Divine Bow declared.
"Thank you," Yuan Ming immediately bowed with his fists and walked toward that direction.
"Forget it, merely pointing the way would be contrary to the rules left by the Golden Sunflower Immortal. Let me give you one more Hidden Bow Talisman. Do you have talisman paper?" the Divine Bow asked.
Yuan Ming nodded, swiftly taking out a piece of the highest quality talisman paper and spreading it flat on his palm.
The Golden Bow swayed slightly, and a stream of golden light flowed from it onto the talisman paper, condensing into a miniature image of the Golden Bow.
"This Hidden Bow Talisman contains a portion of my power and can be used three times. If combined with the Golden Crow Divine Arrows, the power is beyond your imagination," the Golden Bow said, seemingly implying something as it "gazed" at Yuan Ming intently for a moment.
Looking at the Golden Bow staring straight at him, Yuan Ming felt somewhat guilty.This content is hosted at *.
He thought the bow probably already knew he had secretly kept two Golden Crow Divine Arrows, and just as he was about to confess, he heard the Golden Bow speak again, "I have given you the reward, leave now if you're going to."
Hearing its urging, Yuan Ming then realized that the Golden Bow did not intend to blame him.
"Thank you," Yuan Ming bowed again and turned to walk toward the golden formation.
Once he stepped onto the golden formation, the sensation of the world spinning overwhelmed him immediately. When he came to his senses, he found himself already standing on a white island.
After steadying himself, Yuan Ming looked up at the sky, only to be surprised to find the sky still a vast expanse of white, with absolutely nothing, not even a sun, let alone the previously mentioned black and white suns.
He immediately looked around. Everything he saw, whether it be tree leaves or soil, was pure white, with only faint gray lines outlining the contours; otherwise, all things were the same color, and he could truly not distinguish whether what was before him was a white stone wall or a large tree with white leaves.
Yuan Ming felt as if he was in a painting of mountains and waters, only the colors were dull. But what was even more disturbing was the total silence of the island, which was unnerving.
He plucked a leaf from a tree, and with a pinch, crushed it between his fingers, the friction making a soft grinding sound as white sap oozed out, staining his fingers white.
The texture of the leaf was no different from normal, and it seemed the island had no soundproofing Array. Aside from the color, there appeared to be no other difference between here and the outside world.
However, Yuan Ming always felt an eerie sense enveloping him, as if some indescribable force covered him, yet he found nothing unusual upon scanning with his Divine Sense.
Putting aside the unsettling feeling, the scenery here greatly contrasted with the black and white world where Xi Ying was, making Yuan Ming somewhat doubtful.
Is this really Lank Island?
Logically speaking, since the Golden Bow, as the Spiritual Treasure Artifact Spirit left by the Golden Sunflower Immortal, promised to bring him here, it should not deceive him, right?
He shook his head, deciding not to dwell on this matter for now, as he currently could not go and confirm anything with anyone else.
Yuan Ming took a deep breath, activated his Soul Power, and tried to sense Xi Ying's location through the Golden Crow Soul within his Sea of Consciousness, but after much effort, he achieved nothing.
Having no other choice, Yuan Ming set out on his own to find some clues.
As Yuan Ming ventured deeper into the island, his doubts grew.
The island was exceptionally desolate. Other than a few pale large trees, there was nothing else, the soil was dry and crackling, there was not a single blade of grass, and the ground was covered with chunks of earth and stones that crumbled into white sand at a touch.
An hour later, Yuan Ming stopped, frowning deeply, and sighed.
Along the way, he had not seen a single soul, and the surroundings were nearly unchanged. Had he not seen the markers he had deliberately left when he started, he would even think he had been circling the same spot.
Continuing this aimless search might just be a waste of time.
Yuan Ming thought for a moment, found a place to sit cross-legged, took out the Silver Token and activated it to form a protective shield, then set down the bag containing the Three-eyed Crow. Subsequently, he summoned the Stealing Heaven Tripod and entered it physically.
Inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod, his first soul was cultivating on the Lotus Platform. Seeing Yuan Ming, it immediately vacated the platform and flew into Yuan Ming's Sea of Consciousness.
Yuan Ming sat on the Lotus Platform, and through the Three-eyed Crow, cast his Divine Sense down to Lank Island.
However, even with the Divine Sense of the realm of a Sleeping Witch, which could search far beyond the ordinary, Yuan Ming still saw nothing but soil and white trees.
Yuan Ming withdrew his Divine Sense, frustratedly rubbing his temples.
Lank Island was mysterious, and finding a way out now seemed to rely on either continuing the search to move beyond the area just scanned or possibly finding someone who might know about this place to ask.
After pondering for a while, Yuan Ming decided to first try the latter option. Yet among his followers, few met the criteria, the most likely knowledgeable ones being Qing Tong and her group.
As people of the Eastern Sea, they certainly knew more about the Three Immortals Island than Yuan Ming, who was from the Central Plains.
With this thought, Yuan Ming closed his eyes and immediately tried to sense the situation of Qing Tong and her group.

chapters.title: Chapter 570 - 570: 546
chapters.content:
Before long, Yuan Ming's Divine Sense landed on Qing Tong.
At this moment, Qing Tong was clashing with a group of hairy, bizarre insects, alongside Huan Ling Zi and Hou Santong, who were fighting the strange creatures by his side.
The sky above them was still filled with stars, seemingly showing that they had not left the Secret Realm. Yuan Ming hesitated for a moment, and seeing that they were too occupied to be distracted, he decided not to bother them. He then shifted his focus to sensing Yun Jiuxiao and Bing Xin.
Initially, they too had entered the Transmission Array, so they should be on Three Immortals Island by now.
Yuan Ming thought thus, but when his Divine Sense reached nearby Yun Jiuxiao, he found him in a natural cave.
In his hands, Yun Jiuxiao held a Luminous Pearl, whose faint glow illuminated the grey stone walls and the stalactites above.
Cold air condensed into dew on the stalactites then slowly slid down the walls, and suddenly trickled onto Yun Jiuxiao's neck, causing him to tremble from the cold, his expression becoming tense.
Yuan Ming noticed that Yun Jiuxiao was filled with unease and fear, as if worried about something.
At this moment, Bing Xin and Xue Jiao were also by his side, their emotions generally similar, while a little farther away, White Scale Master, Queen Ming Kong, and a robust Water Ape Clan man from the Nascent Soul level were discussing something together.
Unaware of Yuan Ming's Divine Sense arrival, he did not intend to startle them and made contact with Yun Jiuxiao using his Divine Sense, and a faint voice soon echoed in his Sea of Consciousness.
"Yun Jiuxiao, where are you now?"
When Yun Jiuxiao suddenly heard the unfamiliar voice by his ear, his heart gave a start, but with his memory altered by Yuan Ming, he quickly recalled that this was the way the Nether Moon God contacted believers and immediately became extremely respectful.
"Responding to Lord Nether Moon God, I am currently underneath Lank Island," he silently thought.
Yuan Ming was surprised; he had not expected Yun Jiuxiao to also be on Lank Island.
"Having reached Immortal Island, why are you not seeking treasure above ground but hiding here instead? Or is it that the treasures of this place are underground?" Yuan Ming continued to ask.
Yun Jiuxiao gave a wry smile, "You have misunderstood. I have had to hide here out of necessity. The Tree Demons on the island are numerous, and being spotted would mean certain death; even White Scale Master and the others could barely escape."
"Tree Demons? Are they like the ones in this image?" Yuan Ming was taken aback and portrayed an image in Yun Jiuxiao's Sea of Consciousness, which showed the Green-Black Tree People they had encountered in the Fire Essence Palace.
"Yes, exactly them," Yun Jiuxiao nodded repeatedly.
Yuan Ming's heart sank. He had thought the Tree Demons only appeared on Golden Sunflower Island, but now it seemed they might have attacked all three Immortal Islands simultaneously.
However, why hadn't he encountered even one on his way here?
Yuan Ming pondered for a moment then spoke again, "Tell me in detail what happened after you arrived at Three Immortals Island."
"After I stepped into the Three Immortals Hall Transmission Array, I found myself alone on the outer sea beach of the island. Since then, I have been searching for treasures in the island's forest. I encountered Bing Xin along the way, and we decided to try our luck at Lake Heart Island. It took a great deal of effort to reach Lank Island, but wandering the island for several days, we found nothing until three days ago, when a vast number of Tree Demons appeared out of nowhere. Bing Xin and I barely escaped their pursuit, and it was only yesterday when we happened to meet Xue Jiao and White Scale Master that we escaped one disaster and finally found this refuge," Yun Jiuxiao replied candidly.
At these words, Yuan Ming felt somewhat disappointed.
It seemed that he had overestimated Yun Jiuxiao, but then again, for a Secret Realm of Three Immortals Island's caliber, even the leaders of East Sea Core Formation might find it difficult to comprehend.
The attempt proved fruitless, and it seemed they would have to return to more straightforward methods. Yuan Ming sighed and was about to retract his Divine Sense when he inadvertently glanced again at White Scale Master and the others in discussion.
It was this look that suddenly sparked an idea in Yuan Ming's mind.
"Yun Jiuxiao, do as I instruct..."
...
While Yuan Ming was communicating with Yun Jiuxiao, an argument had broken out among White Scale Master and the others. Initially harmonious, the three were now in dispute.
"This won't work, that won't work, do you plan to hide here all your lives?" the robust Water Ape Clan man bellowed.
"What do you mean 'you plan'? Look at the rotten ideas you've got. If it's not luring the enemy deeper in, it's sneaking up for a surprise attack. Round and round we go but can't get past the moment of killing. I'm really starting to doubt whether you cultivated your brains away too. Looking at the number of Tree Demons outside, I'm afraid the moment you make a move, the entire island's worth will swarm over here. Do you really think we could kill them all by ourselves?" White Scale Master said, exasperated.
"So here you wait, planning to see them off to their graves? Or have you taken a fancy to this feng shui haven, willing to forsake the fortunes of Thousand Snake Island, and are you determined to stay here and cultivate into an immortal?" The Water Ape Clan robust man crossed his arms and spit to the side.
"Enough, both of you, stop arguing. Don't either of you have the appearance of a clan leader? All this squabbling, will that solve our crisis?" Queen Ming Kong scolded, frustrated by their noise.
White Scale Master snorted and turned his head away, while the Water Ape Clan robust man still glared at White Scale Master but his tone softened.
"In any case, we cannot just sit and wait for death. Ming Kong, you always have ideas, I trust you. Just tell us what to do now."
Upon hearing this, Queen Ming Kong let out a long sigh and rubbed her brow, but she did not have any good solution at hand.
It was at this moment that Yun Jiuxiao suddenly stepped forward.
"Venerables, I have something to say, though I'm not sure if it is appropriate."
"Heh, you..."
The White Scale Master let out a scornful laugh, about to mock him with a few words, but he was met with a fierce glare from Queen Ming Kong. His expression turned cold, but he remained silent.
Queen Ming Kong was not in the mood to consider the thoughts of White Scale Master, and turned her head directly to Yun Jiuxiao: "Speak."
"I wonder if the three venerables have ever heard of the Lord Nether Moon God?" Yun Jiuxiao took a deep breath in his heart under the gaze of the three Nascent Souls and spoke slowly.
"Nether Moon God? Could it be, are you a Wu Yue Sect believer?" Queen Ming Kong's pupils tightened, as something came to her mind.
Read ahead and get updates at *.
Under pressure, Yun Jiuxiao firmly shook his head and repeated the words he heard: "No, venerables, the Lord Nether Moon God I worship is not a Wu Yue Sect Venerable, but another deity. Though not equal to Wu Yue God, he also possesses some Divine Skills."
"Ha, if he has some Divine Skills, why not communicate directly with us? Why send you to relay the message?" The Water Ape Clan brute scrutinized Yun Jiuxiao.
"That's because only believers can receive Lord Nether Moon God's gaze and hear his call. However, the Lord is currently watching over me, so he can also hear the venerables' voices. Whatever the venerables wish to ask, please speak directly," Yun Jiuxiao bowed towards the sky.
"Hmph, stop talking nonsense, what is your purpose in seeking us out, speak plainly!" White Scale Master's eyes flashed coldly.
Fearing in his heart, but with the support of the Nether Moon God, Yun Jiuxiao still gathered his courage and said: "Lord Nether Moon God told me that he has seen chaos arise in the East Sea. Currently, outside Three Immortals Island, Wu Yue Sect followers are taking advantage of the absence of the Island's Nascent Souls to wreak havoc. Fusang Island is bearing the brunt, and other First-level Islands are also experiencing disturbances."
Upon hearing this, Queen Ming Kong and the others were shocked.
Being Nascent Souls themselves, as well as leaders of their clans, the fate of their races took precedence over personal achievements.
Unlike the Human Clan, as members of Alien Clans, the islands under their command are the lifeblood of their races. Should they fall, the Human Clan would never allow them to occupy another island again. What awaited them was a return to the sea, to abide among demon beasts.
However, they would not panic just because a Core Formation junior said so.
"Do you have any proof to back up your claim?" Queen Ming Kong asked.
"Indeed, words alone are not proof. Upon entering Three Immortals Island, we have lost all means of communication with the outside world. How could you, a mere Core Formation junior, know what is happening outside?" The Water Ape Clan brute also interrogated.
"Venerables, as I have already said, it was Lord Nether Moon God who told me. His Divine Skills far surpass those of a Nascent Soul, and he can naturally communicate both inside and outside Three Immortals Island. If the venerables do not believe me, please look at this," Yun Jiuxiao said.
As Yun Jiuxiao spoke, he brought his hands together in prayer towards the sky for a moment, and then several Imprint Talismans appeared out of thin air, slowly floating down in front of him.
Seeing this, the Water Ape Clan brute's eyes widened, suddenly turning to look at Queen Ming Kong and White Scale Master, only to see a similar astonishment on their faces.
With their level of Cultivation, they didn't notice at all how these Imprint Talismans appeared, and with Yun Jiuxiao's level of Cultivation and skills, it was utterly impossible for him to accomplish this.
Could it be that this Nether Moon God he spoke of truly existed?
Unconsciously, a flicker of doubt arose in the hearts of Queen Ming Kong and her companions.
Yun Jiuxiao, completely unaware of the astonishment of Queen Ming Kong and the others and with a modified memory, held unreserved trust and admiration for the Nether Moon God. In his view, the minor feat of teleporting items was hardly worth mentioning.
He picked up the Imprint Talismans in front of him, one by one activating them through casting. The scenes recorded within the talismans depicted the dire situation on Fusang Island.
What was once a bustling city had been turned into an inferno, corpses littered everywhere. The Cultivators fighting in the sky above the city were blinded by rage, unable to distinguish friend from foe.
Screams of agony and cries of mourning were both incessant yet drowned out by the sounds of battle and deranged laughter. Amid the ruins, a group of black-robed Soul Cultivators was wantonly slaughtering and looting, reaping flesh and souls.
Viewing scene after scene, the eyes of Queen Ming Kong and the others were filled with rage, especially upon seeing the corpses of their clan members lying among the dead.
"No, we can't wait any longer, we must leave Three Immortals Island now!" The Water Ape Clan brute bellowed, standing up at once.
White Scale Master did not speak, seemingly still reluctant to leave behind the opportunities on Three Immortals Island.
After taking a deep breath, Queen Ming Kong looked up at Yun Jiuxiao: "What price must we pay for the Nether Moon God to inform us of the current situation on our islands?"

chapters.title: Chapter 571 - 571: 547
chapters.content:
In the Stealing Heaven Tripod, Yuan Ming was startled and hadn't expected Queen Ming Kong to be so astute, discerning his purpose for informing them about the outside world in a glance.
Facing the woman's inquiry, Yun Jiuxiao remained silent for a moment before finally receiving further instructions from Yuan Ming's side.
"Lord Nether Moon God says, as long as you believe in him, he will tell you about the situation of Bijiao and the other Two Islands. Furthermore, if your faith is sincere, he can even deliver your orders, along with some items, to the outside world, into the hands of your trusted followers," Yun Jiuxiao retold.
Queen Ming Kong's gaze flickered, "Just by believing in him? Is it that simple?"
The Eastern Sea Three Tribes, all valuing strength as their hero, did not place much importance on faith. Worshiping a deity was no big deal for them.
"Yes, but it has to be a true belief; otherwise, if it's just lip service, Lord Nether Moon God, sensing insincerity in your hearts, will not lend a hand," Yun Jiuxiao replied earnestly.
However, upon hearing this, White Scale Master scoffed coldly: "Such bold claims. Does your Nether Moon God really think he's a deity? Demanding the belief of three of us Nascent Souls, how preposterous! With such deceptive tricks, does he not see whether he is worthy or not!"
Queen Ming Kong and the burly Water Ape Clansman said nothing, but the expressions on their faces indicated that both harbored doubts, clearly not truly believing in Yun Jiuxiao's words.
Within the Stealing Heaven Tripod, Yuan Ming had already anticipated that things wouldn't be so simple. If winning the faith of Queen Ming Kong and her two companions were that easy, they probably wouldn't have achieved the Nascent Soul Stage.
Still, with all the kind words spoken and the transaction proposed, what remained was to demonstrate his special skills.
Yuan Ming took a deep breath, sitting upright on the White Jade Lotus Platform, took out the Night Parade of Hundred Demons, silently mobilizing the All Living Beings Dream Rune hidden within, projecting strength onto White Scale Master.
In the cave, White Scale Master had just finished speaking and hadn't made any other moves when the scenery before his eyes suddenly changed. He found himself back on the Heavenly Snake Tower Ship, which now also found itself in a sea of fire, with corpses of the Snake-man Clan strewn all around. As far as the eye could see, not a single living Snake-man was visible.
White Scale Master was stunned for a moment, then immediately realized that he had fallen into an illusion.
Just then, the corpses of the Snake-man Clan on the ground began to rise, staggering towards White Scale Master.
"Why didn't you come back? Why didn't you save us!"
"Ancestor, being burned by the fire hurts so much, it really hurts!"
"My hand! My hand is gone! Ancestor, please, help find my hand, okay?"
Countless Snake-man Zombies wailed as they lunged towards White Scale Master.
"Try to make me submit with mere illusions?" White Scale Master scoffed inwardly, ignoring the cries of these Snake-man Zombies, conjuring a black gourd the size of a palm.
Countless sword-like black beams shot out from the gourd, and as the spirit light flickered, the Snake-man Zombies were slain one by one.
However, those Snake-man Zombies that he killed fell to the ground, rose again shortly after, still bearing wounds. Even those chopped in half; the upper and lower bodies both struggled towards White Scale Master, the wailing even louder.
Loud cries pierced into the core of White Scale Master's being, screaming as if in his own heart, conveying countless fears, resentments, and helplessness into his thoughts.
Even as a Nascent Soul Stage being, White Scale Master was shaken.
"This is..." White Scale Master's face changed color, quickly steadying his mind, once again activating the black gourd, smashing the Snake-man Zombies even more brutally.
Meanwhile, more Snake-man Zombies with indistinct faces continued to appear from all directions, relentlessly surging toward White Scale Master, and the originally different cries gradually united into two words.
"Traitor!"
The Snake-man Zombies cried out hoarsely, blaming their deaths solely on White Scale Master.Chесk Мy Virtuаl Librаry Еmpirе (МV1LЕМР1YR) fоr thе lаtеst updаtеs.
The vast sound uniformly entered White Scale Master's Sea of Consciousness, and the chaotic emotions all turned to resentment, battering the will of White Scale Master like a raging tide.
Sweat appeared on White Scale Master's forehead; clenching his teeth, he ceaselessly wielded his Magic Treasure to slay the zombies while desperately searching for a way to break the illusion, yet to no avail.
At the same time, outside the illusion, Queen Ming Kong saw White Scale Master suddenly freeze, his gaze beginning to dull, his aura unstable, and was instantly alarmed.
"Lord Nether Moon God, White Scale Master is just used to speaking recklessly. Please spare him, don't harm his life!" Queen Ming Kong immediately shouted.
Even if she didn't get along with White Scale Master on ordinary days, she wouldn't just sit by and watch him die under such circumstances.
"Right, Lord Nether Moon God, we agree to your demands; please release White Scale Master from the illusion!" the burly Water Ape Clansman also cried out.
Yuan Ming hadn't intended to kill White Scale Master either; although this person had once captured Yan Sijing, punishing someone wasn't as simple as just killing them.
"Pfft,"
With the dispelling of the illusion by Yuan Ming, White Scale Master finally returned to reality, and at that moment, he violently spewed out blood, his aura plunging and his spirit flagging, clearly his Divine Soul had suffered no small shock.
"Cough cough, many thanks to Lord Nether Moon God for showing mercy," he coughed, respectfully clasping his hands towards the sky, resentment and bitterness sprouted in his heart, but soon, they were drowned by fear.
For Yuan Ming, this was enough.
As Yun Jiuxiao watched White Scale Master's miserable condition, his fear of the staggering power of the Nether Moon God grew, and his faith deepened.

chapters.title: Chapter 572 - 547 Shock_2
chapters.content:
Queen Ming Kong and the burly man from the Water Ape Clan both had heavy expressions on their faces. To be able to ensnare a Nascent Soul in illusion without their awareness, regardless of whether the name of the Nether Moon God was real or fake, he had to be at least more powerful than a Sleeping Witch who was a Great Soul Cultivator.
A hidden Great Soul Cultivator from the Sleeping Witch sect, if they were to act against them, they wouldn't stand a chance to resist. For now, they could only feign compliance and try to ascertain their true intentions before making a plan.
With this thought in mind, Queen Ming Kong and the burly man from the Water Ape Clan exchanged glances and then continued to let Queen Ming Kong take the lead in conversation with Yun Jiuxiao.
"We have witnessed the power of the Nether Moon God, but we don't know what kind of offerings of faith he requires from us," Queen Ming Kong asked.
Yun Jiuxiao was silent for a moment before continuing to relay the words conveyed by the Nether Moon God, "Honored seniors only need to put your hands together and pray towards the sky, silently chanting the name of the Nether Moon God in your hearts. As long as your intentions are sincere, the Nether Moon God will respond."
"Is that all we need to do? We don't need to understand what the Nether Moon God looks like?" the burly man from the Water Ape Clan asked with surprise.
On the Yunhuang Continent, the path of worship also existed, and understanding the external image of the being you believed in was fundamental so that you could offer your faith. Without even knowing what he looks like, how could you truly connect with this Nether Moon God?
"There is no need. As long as the three of you have sincere hearts, Lord Nether Moon God will naturally feel it," Yun Jiuxiao said.
Queen Ming Kong slightly furrowed her brows. Yun Jiuxiao kept emphasizing the need for sincerity, but there was no standard for what constituted sincerity, and the method of offering faith was incredibly simple. Could they really connect with the Nether Moon God that way?
Inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod, Yuan Ming noticed Queen Ming Kong's expression and roughly guessed what she was thinking. After pondering for a moment, he gave new instructions.
"Perhaps the honored seniors could think of it this way: your island is currently in a moment of crisis, and you are powerless to do anything. You can only pray to a more powerful being for assistance. Praying with that mentality should count as devout," Yun Jiuxiao relayed.
Queen Ming Kong nodded slightly, said she understood, then turned to discuss with the burly man from the Water Ape Clan and White Scale Master.
Soon, they came to a decision: "We will do as the Nether Moon God says, but we have conditions. First, for the initial prayer, we must take turns and not pray at the same time. Secondly, we cannot be devout in prayer every moment. At most, we will pray once every two hours, and each time we pray, we hope that the Nether Moon God will respond, informing us of the outside situation and relaying our commands along with some items."
"Lord Nether Moon God has other important matters to attend to and cannot respond to each of your prayers, nor will he become a tool for you to relay commands and items to the outside world at will! Do you not think that this request is too excessive?" Yun Jiuxiao's face changed as he said angrily.
"Such a small request can't even be agreed upon, yet they expect us to offer our belief. This Nether Moon God really thinks too highly of himself," White Scale Master snorted.
"Now, you are in the Secret Realm of the Three Immortals Island, cut off from the world. To transmit the news and items from here, Lord Nether Moon God doesn't know how much power he must expend, yet what you three are offering is nothing more than your faith. What a clever calculation," Yun Jiuxiao scoffed.
White Scale Master's face flushed with blood at being mocked by a Core Formation junior, but remembering the previous illusion, he refrained from lashing out.
"Since the three of you are not sincere, then let's just drop this matter. You can figure out how to deal with the crisis outside on your own," Yun Jiuxiao said, turning to leave.
"Fellow Daoist Yun, please hold on, Fellow Daoist Bai Lin didn't mean it that way," Queen Ming Kong quickly intervened to keep him from leaving.
Yun Jiuxiao stopped in his tracks.
"Since Lord Nether Moon God does not agree, let's amend the conditions. We will sincerely pray to Lord Nether Moon God every two hours, and the Nether Moon God does not need to respond but only needs to relay our commands and items once," Queen Ming Kong proposed.
"That is acceptable," Yun Jiuxiao waited for a moment, got the Nether Moon God's approval, and agreed to their request.
The deal was struck, and Queen Ming Kong, along with her two companions, did not delay, immediately beginning their first prayer.
Need character sheets and glossaries? Visit *.
The first to pray was the brawny man from the Water Ape Clan.
At first, his attitude was guarded, but when he thought about how the young monkeys on his island might now be in dire straits, his mood grew heavy. Although he still had many doubts, there was a trace of sincerity in his prayers that he did not even notice himself.
Soon, inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod, Yuan Ming felt a surge of robust Desire Power coming from the void, thick as a golden dragon, circling above the White Jade Lotus Platform for a moment before pouring into his body.
He immediately activated his spell to devour and absorb this power.
However, the Desire Power was so immense that even with his main soul and first soul splitting working at full capacity, they couldn't keep up with the speed at which the power was entering. After only a short while, his Sea of Consciousness began to feel slightly swollen, and the speed at which he could absorb the Desire Power couldn't keep up with the rate of its influx.
Fortunately, he was inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod at that moment, and any Desire Power he couldn't absorb in time was channeled and stored into the White Jade Lotus Platform, giving him a brief respite and a chance to dedicate a portion of his divine consciousness to respond to the Water Ape Clan brawny man's prayer:
"I have felt your devotion, now, state your request."
The moment Yuan Ming's voice emerged, the Water Ape Clan brawny man immediately felt a powerful Divine Sense enveloping him, causing his heart to tremble. He hurriedly took out half a Jade Pendant and held it towards the sky.
"Please convey this object to my brother, instructing him to temporarily take the position of Grand Marshal of the Water Ape Island, to lead our people in repelling the Wu Yue Sect, and additionally tell him, if he encounters a dire predicament which seems insurmountable, he may take the risk of awakening the Ancestor Ape," said the man from the Water Ape Clan.
Inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod, Yuan Ming cast the Six Jia Qimen Secret Skill, collecting the half Jade Pendant from the Water Ape Clan brawny man's hands.
In the cave, as the Water Ape Clan brawny man was wondering how the Nether Moon God would take the object away, he suddenly saw a golden and silver light gate forming in front of him.
He was startled and immediately probed with his Divine Sense, but he couldn't see through the essence of the golden and silver light gate or find the source of the power that formed it.
Following that, an invisible force emerged from the light gate, intending to take the half Jade Pendant from his hands.
He instinctively wanted to resist, but he found that with his strength alone, he couldn't even budge this intangible force, and could only watch helplessly as the half Jade Pendant flew into the light gate and disappeared.
"When you pray again, I will inform you of the outcome."
Yuan Ming left that message and then temporarily withdrew his Divine Sense that enveloped the Water Ape Clan brawny man.
On the other side, White Scale Master and Queen Ming Kong witnessed the entire exchange between the man from the Water Ape Clan and the Nether Moon God, observed the golden and silver light gate, and saw the futile resistance of the brawny man.
The reason they prayed one after another was both to confirm whether there were any traps behind this transaction and from the perspective of a bystander, to better assess the real strength of the Nether Moon God.
If until recently they had retained a glimmer of doubt, they now could finally be certain that the Nether Moon God was no ordinary Soul Cultivator, and his true realm might even surpass that of the Sleeping Witch.
After the Water Ape Clan brawny man's prayer was over, Queen Ming Kong and her companions did not immediately start the next prayer. Instead, they each employed their own techniques to check the man's condition, making sure he had not been afflicted with any Dark Curse, before they completely let down their guard.

chapters.title: Chapter 573 - 548: Bloodline Inheritance
chapters.content:
White Scale Master exchanged a glance with Queen Ming Kong before stepping forward a few steps and began to pray.
Although he had just been trapped in an illusion, causing significant damage to his Divine Soul, his prayers now were unexpectedly devout. It was unclear whether he genuinely succumbed to the power of the Nether Moon God or if he harbored some ulterior motive.
Yuan Ming had little interest in guessing White Scale Master's true intentions. After all, even if the latter had a scheme in mind, the Desire Power he offered was real and beyond tampering.
Yuan Ming quickly took note of the orders he had communicated to his clanspeople and collected two Magic Treasures, ready to transfer them as requested by White Scale Master.
The last to pray was, of course, Queen Ming Kong.
Compared to the other two, she was more calculating, and the Desire Power she offered was slightly inferior. Nonetheless, its richness far surpassed that of any at the Core Formation Stage, let alone Foundation Establishment cultivators or mortals.
She also had Yuan Ming convey some orders on her behalf and took out two talismans and a Jade Scroll to be transferred. However, at the end, she posed an intriguing question.
"If someone else from my clan were to pray to you, seeking your help to save Bijiao Island, would you respond?"
Yuan Ming instantly understood Queen Ming Kong's thought and couldn't help but laugh, "As long as the prayers are sincere, I will naturally offer aid."
Queen Ming Kong nodded noncommittally, no longer speaking, and concluded her prayer.
...
An hour later.
On Lank Island, Yuan Ming emerged from the Stealing Heaven Tripod and tucked away the Silver Token, continuing deeper into the island.
He had already given orders to Yan Siyun to get the people from Hundred Pills Square to establish contact with the Three Bijiao Islands. Soon, he would be able to transmit the orders and items of Queen Ming Kong and the others through the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
After dealing with these matters, Yuan Ming spent some time refining part of the Desire Power provided by Queen Ming Kong and her companions, which greatly enhanced his Divine Soul Cultivation.
Although Queen Ming Kong and her companions' devotion paled in comparison to that of Yan Sijing and others, the sheer amount of Desire Power they provided as Nascent Souls was too vast for Yuan Ming to absorb at once. Moreover, the urgent task at hand was still to explore the Immortal Island, so he did not linger within the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
As time slowly passed, the scenery Yuan Ming saw remained unchanged, and the joy that had lifted his spirits from acquiring Desire Power gradually became weighed down again.
After an indeterminate amount of time, he suddenly heard faint sounds of explosions from afar.
He was instantly energized and hastened towards the source of the sounds. However, halfway there, he suddenly stopped in his tracks, his gaze sweeping across to his left.
Surrounded by several large trees, there was a small depression on the ground. In the center of the depression lay a black chess piece, quiet and unassuming. Though the piece wasn't large, it was particularly conspicuous against the backdrop of pure white.
Yuan Ming approached, picked up the chess piece, and channeled Mana into it, but like a stone dropped into the ocean, there was no response. He probed with his Divine Sense, and still, he detected neither runes nor any Forbidden within the piece.
It seemed to be just an ordinary chess piece.
Yuan Ming furrowed his brows and pondered for a moment before placing the chess piece into his Storage Ring. Then he continued towards the direction of the sounds.
The place where the chess piece was located wasn't far from the origin of the sounds.
Circling a few large trees, Yuan Ming soon saw an open area far ahead, where two groups stood facing each other.
For safety's sake, he did not approach but quietly released his Divine Sense towards the clearing.
There were five people on the clearing. One group consisted of Nascent Soul cultivators who had participated in activating the outer sea Teleportation Array; thus, Yuan Ming roughly recognized them.
The leader was a gaunt old man wearing a bamboo hat and straw raincoat, holding a black bamboo stick—it was none other than Nascent Soul Old Man Hei Zhu from Yuzhu Island.
Beside him were a male and a female cultivator. The man, named Shi Yanshi, was a Nascent Soul from Red Leaf Island. He was dressed in light blue scholar's attire with a goat beard, resembling a private school teacher.
The woman was Aunt Wan Hua from Wanhua Island. She was petite, with a Flowers Crown on her head and clothes woven from fine leaves. Her delicate fair skin set against the green made her look like a Fairy born from a flower bud, evoking an instinctive tenderness from those who beheld her.
All three had only reached the early stage of Nascent Soul cultivation, whereas one of the two they faced was a mid-stage Nascent Soul figure.
This mid-stage Nascent Soul cultivator was a sickly-looking man with red hair. His complexion was so pale it lacked any trace of blood, and a long scar across his nose split his face in half—as if it had once been severed.
In his right hand, he leaned on a Blood-red Walking Stick. A cross-shaped wound on the back of his hand oozed bright red blood, which seemed to possess life, hovering and connecting him to the walking stick like a ribbon.
Behind him was a young man with white pupils and eyebrows, looking just like an ice sculpture with a chill enveloping his entire body.
"Blood Realm Venerable, with many Tree Men roaming the island now, even if we join forces, we might not gain any advantage. Are you really intent on fighting with us here?" Old Man Hei Zhu spoke with a grim expression, questioning loudly.
"Otherwise, what? The Tree Men are all dry inside, just sawdust, not satisfying to eat at all. Now that I've finally encountered you, Blood Food teeming with vitality, even if I wanted to let you go, my stomach wouldn't agree." The Blood Realm Venerable chuckled.This content is presented by *.
"Hmph, boasting shamelessly. Do you really think the two of you alone can keep us here?" Aunt Wan Hua snorted coldly.
The Blood Realm Venerable stared at Aunt Wan Hua, a hint of joy suddenly flashing in his eyes: "Oh, my luck today is good. I've actually met a Green Wood Evergreen Body. To tell you the truth, I've grown tired of those dirty Blood Foods from the past. I haven't had much chance to eat a pure one like you—it must have a unique flavor, huh? Heh heh!"
As he spoke, he even stretched out his blood-red tongue and licked his lips, his Adam's apple bobbing with the action.
Aunt Wan Hua felt goosebumps all over from his gaze and immediately yelled angrily, raising her hand and swinging it. A flower basket filled with blooms soared from her grip, flying into the air.
The basket spun in mid-air, releasing a large cloud of pale yellow pollen that enveloped the Blood Realm Venerable.
The Blood Realm Venerable showed no fear. He stamped his blood-red walking stick on the ground, and instantly a Blood Pond appeared in front of him. A Blood Dragon shot out and met the pale yellow pollen, opening its mouth to inhale, easily swallowing all the pollen.
Yuan Ming, observing the scene through his Divine Sense, heard a surprised and joyful voice emanate from the Shura Blood Devouring Map in his Sea of Consciousness.
"It's the Blood Transformation Technique! Wonderful, there's actually a cultivator who has cultivated this technique to the Nascent Soul level. It seems my Blood Transformation Sect has not declined; there's still a legacy left in the world!"
Upon hearing the words "Blood Transformation Technique," Yuan Ming's expression shifted slightly. He was just about to inquire for more details but noticed that the battle had taken another turn.
The Blood Realm Venerable had easily cracked Aunt Wan Hua's move. He was about to scoff when he suddenly paused, apparently surprised.
A variety of colorful flowers had unexpectedly begun to sprout on the Blood Dragon he had conjured, blooming rapidly. From their buds, they sprayed out more pollen that floated toward the Blood Realm Venerable.
At this moment, the young man with white eyebrows behind the Blood Realm Venerable took action.
He raised his hand slightly, and an Ice Cone shot from his fingertips, releasing a vast fog of frost, wrapping around the Blood Realm Venerable's body like two arms.
The pollen entered the frost mist, floating for less than a moment before being encased in ice and falling to the ground.
Old Man Hei Zhu, upon seeing the young woman's move, suddenly flicked his fishing pole, and the line pierced the void, appearing behind the young man with white eyebrows.
