Right then, the Blood Realm Venerable let out a sinister laugh. Countless blood threads suddenly grew on the Blood Dragon, wrapping around the flowers, and then the dragon turned its head, accurately finding the position of the hook and biting down on it.
Old Man Hei Zhu's expression changed; he immediately tried to retract the hook, but the young man with white eyebrows also acted at the same time, sending waves of cold towards the fish hook, drastically slowing it down.
In the next moment, the Blood Dragon bit the fishing hook, and the blood threads from its body followed the line into the void opened by the fishing pole, lunging at Old Man Hei Zhu.
Suddenly, Shi Yanshi flipped his right hand, and a brush covered in ink appeared in his palm. As he started to write swiftly, a dark "Forbidden" rune emerged in the air in just moments.
As the rune appeared, the void tunnel opened by Old Man Hei Zhu's fishing pole abruptly closed, barely managing to block the incoming blood threads.
However, due to the backlash, Old Man Hei Zhu coughed twice, spitting out mouthfuls of blood while his aura became chaotic.
Nevertheless, Old Man Hei Zhu still gave Shi Yanshi a grateful look, since the main body of his Magic Treasure, the fishing pole, remained undamaged and could possibly be restored. But if the blood threads had corrupted it, it would have been completely unusable.
The Blood Realm Venerable, having not managed to fully corrupt Old Man Hei Zhu's Magic Treasure, was not bothered and simply chuckled:
"Hehe, I've long heard that Old Man Hei Zhu's fishing skills are unmatched, that every cast guarantees a catch. What's wrong, now that you've hooked this big fish, are you too scared to reel in the line?"
Old Man Hei Zhu did not respond to his mockery, instead he sent a message to Shi Yanshi: "Fellow Daoist Shi, with your knowledge of formations, is there a way to deploy one to get us out of here?"
"Difficult," Shi Yanshi shook his head.
"Difficult means there's still a chance, right? How long would we need to hold them off if I and Fellow Daoist Wan give it our all?" Old Man Hei Zhu pressed.
Shi Yanshi was silent for a moment: "Two hours."
Hearing this, Old Man Hei Zhu looked toward Aunt Wan Hua and conveyed Shi Yanshi's words to her. However, Aunt Wan Hua sighed.
"The vitality of the plants here is weak. Relying only on Magic Treasures, I'm no match for them." She shook her head slightly.
Old Man Hei Zhu's expression darkened, and with gritted teeth, he pulled out three Jade Talismans that shone with subdued spirit light.
"These were left by our island's founding ancestor..."
He hadn't finished speaking when the Blood Realm Venerable burst into laughter: "Are you done discussing? Once you're finished, you can go die!"

chapters.title: Chapter 574 - 549 Lifesaver
chapters.content:
As soon as the Blood Realm Venerable's voice fell, he formed a bizarre spell with his hands, and in an instant, a blood pond appeared beneath his feet, rapidly swallowing his body. Meanwhile, in the sky, the Blood Dragon roared and pounced toward Old Man Hei Zhu and the other two.
From a distance, Yuan Ming saw this scene, shook his head with a sigh, and turned to leave.
With his current strength, it was extremely difficult for Yuan Ming to even think of engaging in battle, let alone try to save someone under the eyes of the Venerable.
Moreover, Old Man Hei Zhu and his companions were neither kin nor friends to him; he had no obligation to risk his life to save them.
It was just regrettable that although he finally encountered others, he could not reveal himself for an interaction, and moreover, continuing to explore the island would not only require caution of the Tree Men but also this Blood Realm Venerable, which was truly a troublesome matter.
As Yuan Ming pondered, an inexplicable chill ran through his heart, as if something had set its sights upon him.
"Not good, he has discovered you already, and that move just now was aimed at you!" the Blood Shadow urgently called out from within the Shura Blood Devouring Map.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming did not hesitate. He immediately slapped his Storage Bag and leaped onto Lei Yu that had appeared, speeding away into the distance.The M|V|LE&MPYR team worked hard on this chapter.
"Huh?"
Accompanied by a light exclamation, the pale ground not far behind Yuan Ming was instantly stained red with blood, and a massive Blood Dragon burst forth, rapidly closing in to engulf both Yuan Ming and Lei Yu in the blink of an eye.
Within the Blood Dragon, a tangible evil aura intermingled, invading the bodies of the two.
At that moment, Yuan Ming turned and cast a spell, summoning the Shura Blood Devouring Map out of thin air. An unseen suction force emerged from it, directly absorbing the Blood Dragon.
Since the Blood Dragon was a manifestation of blood energy, it had no choice but to be captured by the Spiritual Treasure like the Shura Blood Devouring Map which specifically countered blood energy.
From the blood pond where the Blood Dragon had emerged, the Blood Realm Venerable's body slowly rose. Seeing Yuan Ming entirely capturing the Blood Dragon, his eyes immediately brimmed with intense interest.
"Interesting, Core Formation junior, leave the treasure behind, and I shall spare you." The Blood Realm Venerable said and rode upon the Blood Light, chasing after Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming, however, turned a deaf ear and simply patted the back of Lei Yu, signaling it to maximize its Flying Escape.
Lei Yu let out a low cry, and as its demonic power flowed, the Wing-shaped Thunder Pattern on its wings simultaneously activated. In an instant, it transformed into a black shadow wrapped in Thunder Light, and after a flash, it was already a hundred yards away.
Seeing this, the Blood Realm Venerable's interest grew stronger, and he began channeling all his mana. The Blood Light enveloping him sped up, yet it was still not as fast as Lei Yu.
Yuan Ming looked back and saw this, feeling somewhat relieved. It seemed like although the Blood Realm Venerable was fierce in combat, his Escape Skill was still not as swift as Lei Yu's.
"Blood Shadow, since the Blood Transformation Technique is the treasured Cultivation Technique of your sect, I wonder what Divine Skills it grants at the Nascent Soul Stage and what drawbacks it has. Tell me in detail!" Seizing the opportunity, Yuan Ming inquired from the Blood Shadow inside the Shura Blood Devouring Map.
Previously, Yuan Ming acquired the secret book of the Blood Transformation Technique that could only be cultivated up to Core Formation, and he had not actually begun cultivating it. He had no way of knowing the subsequent Secret Techniques. He hadn't been concerned about it before, but now, being hunted by the Blood Realm Venerable, he needed to understand it clearly.
Although Blood Shadow was pleased that the Blood Transformation Technique had found a new practitioner, he also understood that his fate was closely tied to Yuan Ming's; one's glory was the other's glory, and one's loss was the other's loss. He did not conceal anything and responded, "The Blood Transformation Technique is an orthodox Blood Dao Technique passed down from the ancient times by our sect's founder. It places great emphasis on the word 'transformation,' capable of refining other beings' Essence Blood to aid in cultivation and transforming the Qi-Blood Power into Lifebound Essence Qi for healing and detoxifying. At the Nascent Soul Realm, one can even transform into blood; as long as the blood energy is endless, the Physical Body will not die. This has some similarities with Body Cultivation, which uses Qi-Blood Power to channel Divine Skills, yet it also has its differences."
"The Blood Transformation Technique is indeed extraordinary," Yuan Ming remarked.
"Of course, our sect's Blood Transformation Technique is absolutely one of the top Cultivation Techniques in the Yunhuang Continent. One of the main reasons the Shura Master captured me was to obtain the Blood Transformation Technique," Blood Shadow said proudly.
"Spare me the boasting, just tell me about the drawbacks of the Blood Transformation Technique. Otherwise, if the Blood Realm Venerable catches up, neither of us will fare well!" Yuan Ming said impatiently.
"You've seen the content of the Blood Transformation Technique yourself. The drawbacks are clear. While the Blood Transformation Technique can quickly elevate one's Cultivation and has great power in combat, absorbing others' Essence Blood is an act that diminishes one's own essence, and that will inevitably trigger a backlash. The deeper the cultivator's level, the stronger the backlash will be. Once the Blood Transformation Technique reaches the Nascent Soul Stage, although one is extremely powerful in combat, the backlash of the technique becomes unimaginably intense. The Qi-Blood within no longer requires the master's control, and it will operate on its own, consuming Qi-Blood at all times, craving new Essence Blood and turning one into a bloody, murderous fiend. It was the same for me. Every once in a while, I had to kill a Cultivator or a demon beast, absorb their Essence Blood, to calm my mind. Otherwise, I would be controlled by the urge to kill and completely become a madman. Plus, my own Qi-Blood would also be refined by the technique. Without an enemy's touch, I would disintegrate and die," Blood Shadow explained.
Yuan Ming's brows furrowed upon hearing this.
His Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill was similar to the Blood Transformation Technique, both refining and absorbing other beings' Qi-Blood Power for cultivation. Would he also face a backlash in the future?
He composed himself; now was not the time to consider this.
"According to what you said, doesn't that mean, if I fight the Blood Realm Venerable, I need only withstand for some time, and he will fall into disarray?" Yuan Ming inquired.
"In theory, that's true. But how can you know how much Qi-Blood he has in reserve? Moreover, our sect also possesses a Sealing Life Secret Technique which can put living beings or demon beasts into a state of feigned death and store them in storage magic tools. If there's no one to kill when the time comes, they can be used as Blood Food reserves. How many reserves do you think he has in his Storage Ring now, and will it be enough for him to kill you?" Blood Shadow said in a dark tone.

chapters.title: Chapter 575 - 549: Life-Saving Benefactor_2
chapters.content:
"The Blood Transformation Technique really is difficult to deal with. Aside from the technique itself, are there any particular secret techniques that we need to be especially wary of?" Yuan Ming asked after a brief silence.
"Our sect's secret techniques that complement the Cultivation Technique are naturally not few, but most of them are not applicable at the moment. There are only two secret techniques worth noting. One is the Blood Concealing Technique, which can temporarily suppress one's cultivation, hiding their Qi-Blood to avoid the need to kill people. because their high cultivation would make the interval time between killings too short," Blood Shadow explained.
"I see, so the Blood Realm Venerable's true cultivation might be even higher than the mid-stage of Nascent Soul," Yuan Ming commented.
"Based on my estimation, his true cultivation should also be at the peak of the Middle-stage Nascent Soul. However, the Blood Transformation Technique is not good at Flying Escape. Unless there's an unexpected development, even if he dispels the Blood Concealing Technique, his speed should still be a bit slower than your spirit beast," Blood Shadow speculated.
Just as Yuan Ming's concerns were alleviated, he heard Blood Shadow suddenly say, "However, within the Blood Transformation Technique is a secret technique called the Blood Shadow Escaping Technique, which can burn Qi-Blood to boost the tunneling speed. If he uses it, his tunneling speed might just..."
Before Blood Shadow could finish, Yuan Ming saw the Blood Realm Venerable behind him weaving spells with both hands, as blood threads resembling flesh sprouts burst forth from his hands and swiftly enveloped his entire body.
Immediately after, the Blood Realm Venerable completely merged with the blood-colored tunneling light, and his tunneling speed surged, drastically closing the distance between him and Yuan Ming.
In just a few breaths' time, the distance between them was only a hundred yards or so.
Yuan Ming's eyebrows furrowed, but he didn't panic. He channeled mana into Lei Yu, striving to boost Lei Yu's tunneling speed, while he said, "Give me the mnemonic for the Blood Shadow Escaping Technique!"
Without hesitation, Blood Shadow transmitted the Escape Technique into Yuan Ming's Sea of Consciousness.
Yuan Ming quickly reviewed it once, a smile appeared on the corner of his mouth, and he raised his hand and waved.
A purple figure appeared on Lei Yu's back; it was Lei He.
His body had become skeletal, only his head remained unchanged, having been transformed into a Blood Slave just like Hong Ling.
However, Lei He's gaze was blank, showing very little spiritual intelligence.
After Lei He had been refined by the Shura Blood Devouring Map, he should have regained his spiritual intelligence like Hong Ling and Blood Shadow. However, since Yuan Ming was still at Core Formation, and Lei He had a grudge against him, in order to avoid trouble, he deliberately erased his consciousness.
Yuan Ming casually took out the Thunder God Hammer and the God Bombarding Cone, handing them to Lei He.
The treasures that Lei He coveted in life were finally being used by him after his death; if he still had his consciousness, one would not know whether he would be happy or sad.
At that moment, Yuan Ming wasn't concerned about this somewhat comical scene. With a thought, Lei He immediately infused mana into the two Magic Treasures, then he hoisted the Thunder God Hammer and smashed it toward the God Bombarding Cone with all his might.
In an instant, seven or eight flood dragon-like bolts of thunder crisscrossed and shot out, striking the Blood Realm Venerable directly with the force of a thunderclap.
The Blood Realm Venerable clearly hadn't expected Yuan Ming to pull off such a move, and was caught off guard, instantly hit by the thunder.
Accompanied by a burst of blue smoke and the smell of scorching, the blood light covering his body was easily torn apart, his body mostly destroyed, and from the charred gap, it was visible that he had no internal organs inside, only waves of blood Qi churning.
As the power of thunder and lightning pulsed within his body, the bloody flesh buds that covered the exterior of the Blood Realm Venerable rapidly retreated, burrowing back into his body and not emerging again.
Lei He, who was unable to utilize the Blood Shadow Escaping Technique, was immediately left far behind by Lei Yu.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, you have keen eyes. How did you discern that the bane of the Blood Shadow Escape is thunder and lightning?" Blood Shadow asked.
"I have been comprehending the Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill for several years now, and my understanding of Blood Dao Techniques is quite profound. The Blood Shadow Escaping Technique is based on Qi-Blood and, according to the mnemonic, must ensure that the circulation of blood in the body is unobstructed. If an external force causes injury and interference, then the residual power within the body must be cleared before it can be used again! Blood Dao power leans towards yin, so using the force of thunder and lightning to disrupt it is best," Yuan Ming said, hastening Lei Yu's flight even further and soon leaving the Blood Realm Venerable far behind.
The expression of the Blood Realm Venerable finally turned dark as he watched the receding figures of Yuan Ming and Lei Yu, a flash of ferocity passing through his eyes, yet he could only temporarily stop the pursuit and silently clear the remaining thunder power within his body.
Before long, Yuan Ming had lost all sight of the Blood Realm Venerable. But he didn't let his guard down and continued to have Lei Yu flee at full strength towards the white giant peak, in order to completely avoid the Blood Realm Venerable's pursuit.
With Lei Yu's tunneling speed, they soon arrived near the giant peak.
The reference version of this on *.
However, just then, the ground in front of Lei Yu suddenly split open, and dozens of Green-Black Tree People emerged. They were startled upon seeing Lei Yu flying towards them, but then they roared and attacked in unison, their arms transforming into countless vines rushing towards Lei Yu.
Yuan Ming didn't want to entangle with them and immediately slapped Lei Yu, instructing it to change directions and flee to the right.
Nevertheless, those Tree People pursued relentlessly, and from time to time, vines and tree spears were shot at Lei Yu—some were dodged, others were scattered by Lei He manipulating the Thunder God Hammer and God Bombarding Cone.
But as a result, Lei Yu's speed was inevitably affected. To make matters worse, Yuan Ming noticed a Blood Shadow frequently flickering behind him. It turned out to be the Blood Realm Venerable, following him like an unshakable shadow.
FacEd with this situation, Yuan Ming's thoughts raced, and eventually, with gritted teeth, he recalled both Lei He and Lei Yu, plummeting towards the earth and, the moment he touched the ground, he vanished into it like diving into water, tunneling towards the interior of the white giant peak.
Tunneling underground was also a risky move. His speed was definitely not as fast as when riding Lei Yu, but the Blood Realm Venerable was not proficient in Escape Skills, and the Blood Shadow Escaping Technique couldn't tunnel through the earth. Heading to the interior of the white giant peak was a good choice.
Just as he thought this, Yuan Ming suddenly discovered that the ground beneath Lank Island was filled with thick Green-Black tree roots.
These roots spread to extreme distances, and his Divine Sense couldn't probe their ends. They were intertwined with each other, seemingly covering every corner under Lank Island.
Yuan Ming's heart startled, and before he could react, one of the roots snatched at him like lightning.
He quickly dodged to the side, narrowly avoiding the root's grasp, but more roots surged towards him, giving him no room to evade.
In that critical moment, Yuan Ming suddenly felt someone pulling him back, and then he disappeared instantaneously, leaving no trace behind.
The roots passed through where Yuan Ming had just been, and finding no one there, returned to their original place as if they had never moved.
Not far from where the roots had just passed through, Yuan Ming held his breath and concentrated. Seeing that the roots didn't continue to search for him, he finally let out a sigh of relief and turned to look at the one who had lent him a hand—the lifesaver, Wulu.

chapters.title: Chapter 576 - 550: Time Cave, Black and White Light
chapters.content:
"Follow me," Wulu said, and instantly turned to walk ahead.
Yuan Ming knew this was not a place for conversation and followed silently.
Shielded by the Invisibility Stone Talisman, the two quickly left the perilous area dominated by tree roots and, after several twists and turns, arrived at a concealed cave.
By now, Wulu had reached his limit, his face pale. He closed his eyes for a moment of Breathing Control before he recovered.
"For today's events, thank you, Brother Wulu," Yuan Ming said, bowing in gratitude.
"It's a trivial matter. With Brother Yuan's Divine Skills, I believe you would have found a way out even without me," Wulu said with a smile.
"I had already run out of tricks. Without Brother Wulu's intervention, I would have surely fallen victim to those roots and turned into fertilizer. I truly couldn't rest in peace if that were to happen," Yuan Ming said with a shake of his head and a bitter smile.
The two looked at each other and laughed, easing some of the gloom from their hearts.
The two discussed their experiences over the past few days. Yuan Ming shared everything about his ordeal on Golden Sunflower Island, except for a few details that were inconvenient to mention.
Wulu listened, utterly captivated. Upon hearing about Zhao Gui, his expression shifted slightly and he asked, "Are you certain that person claimed to be Zhao Gui and wielded a hoe Magic Treasure?"
"Indeed, Brother Wulu, do you know of this person?" Yuan Ming asked, his interest piqued.
"I know a little. If I'm not mistaken, this person was a Nascent Soul Stage elder of the Guiyuan Sect in Qin Country three thousand years ago, famous for his mastery in nurturing Spirit Plants. However, he mysteriously disappeared over two thousand years ago. It's unexpected to find him on Three Immortals Island," Wulu said thoughtfully.
Without showing surprise, Yuan Ming transformed to show Zhao Gui's face for Wulu to identify.
"That's right, this man is indeed Zhao Gui. I saw his likeness in our family's secret archive many years ago. It's unbelievable he's still alive," Wulu said, astonished.
Yuan Ming dispelled his Mana, remaining silently contemplative.
During the grand battle at Fire Essence Palace, Zhao Gui transformed into a blackish-green Tree Demon. Is he now the Undead Tree Puppet mentioned by Hou Yi's Sun-shooting Bow, surviving till now by the power of the Undying Tree?
"Brother Yuan, it seems you know something about Zhao Gui. Would you mind sharing with me?" Wulu asked, looking at Yuan Ming's solemn expression and bowing slightly.
"Brother Wulu, there's no need to hurry. My ordeals on Golden Sunflower Island are not yet fully told. Listen further and you'll understand," Yuan Ming said with a slight smile, continuing his story.
Wulu's expression changed repeatedly as he learned about the Undead Demon Tree and the real reason for the activation of Three Immortals Island, leaving him stunned.
"So it turns out that Three Immortals Island is a deathtrap! No wonder it has remained a legend in the East Sea for so many years without detailed information about the island coming to light. Truly a monstrous calamity at work. Brother Yuan, what should we do now?" Wulu said gravely.
"Our best course now is to find some like-minded individuals and investigate the situation of the Undead Tree Demon, then figure out a way to escape this place," Yuan Ming said.
He did not inform Wulu about Qi Ye, partly because Qi Ye's matter involved Shura Blood Devouring Map, and also because he couldn't be sure of Qi Ye's trustworthiness.
"I know where some cultivators who arrived at Lank Island are hiding. Perhaps we could inform them about the Old Tree Demon and collectively think of a plan," Wulu suggested.
"Not for now. The minds of those on the island are varied, and we must not let the existence of the Undead Tree Demon be known, otherwise, the demon will definitely target us with its full might, and we would stand no chance of survival!" Yuan Ming considered for a moment before shaking his head.
"You're right. I was too hasty," Wulu sighed.
"I have just arrived at Lank Island. Brother Wulu, how long have you been here, and what do you know? Who are the cultivators here?" Yuan Ming inquired.
"I've been here for two days…" Wulu didn't hesitate and meticulously recounted the information he had gathered.
Yuan Ming frowned slightly, finding the situation Wulu described to be similar to Yun Jiuxiao's account.
However, Wulu had climbed the giant peak and knew the situation on the mountain; the Tree Men grew more numerous the higher one climbed, seemingly trying to prevent people from ascending.
As for the cultivators on Lank Island, Wulu had only encountered Bai Lin the White Scale Master and his party, which was less than what Yuan Ming had uncovered.
"Brother Wulu, have you found such a place on the island where there are simultaneously a black and a white sun?" Yuan Ming suddenly asked.
"A black and white sun? I haven't found such a thing," Wulu shook his head.
Hearing this, Yuan Ming's brow furrowed, hinting that Xi Ying was hiding in some secret place, and finding him might take some time.
"I don't know about a place with a black and white sun, but there is a location quite similar to what you described," Wulu said thoughtfully.
"Where is that?" Yuan Ming asked eagerly.
"At the top of Lank Island. I previously used the Stone Talisman to sneak up to the mountain top, where I discovered a peculiar cave. The entrance bore the inscription 'Time Cave', and it emitted a black and white light from within," Wulu said.
"Time Cave, black and white light! Although it might not be the place I'm looking for, it should hold some clues," Yuan Ming said, his eyes flashing with excitement.
"Brother Yuan, the mountain top isn't an easy place to reach. You just heard my account—further up the mountain, the more the Tree Men are perched, and unlike elsewhere, these Tree Men are exceptionally sensitive to aura and very difficult to deal with. There's also a very formidable Tree Man at Time Cave, whose strength has reached the Fourth-level Peak. This requires careful consideration," Wulu advised.
"Thank you for the warning, Brother Wulu. However, I have some reasons for needing to go there." Yuan Ming bowed slightly, his resolve firm.
"Where are you headed, Brother Yuan? On a treasure hunt?" Wulu inquired.
"Searching for a person." Yuan Ming did not conceal the truth.
"Searching for someone? It seems this person is very important to you, Brother Yuan. I happen to be free myself, so let me accompany you on this trip. Together, we might just have a chance to get through," Wulu said with a chuckle upon hearing this.
"Brother Wulu, your willingness to help is deeply appreciated. However, the situation on the mountain is perilous, and you are taking a significant risk. I wonder if there's anything you desire or wish to do, I will certainly do my utmost to assist you," Yuan Ming replied joyfully, earnestly. Wulu's invisibility Stone Talisman could indeed be a great help.
"That won't be necessary. To be honest, I too wanted to explore the Time Cave, but my Heavenly Escape Stone Talisman is difficult to activate. Once my mana is depleted, I would be at the mercy of others, which has deterred me from exploring. Now that you are with me, Brother Yuan, I couldn't ask for more," Wulu said with a smile.
"The Heavenly Escape Stone Talisman, is that the name of your Invisibility Stone Talisman?" Yuan Ming asked, slightly puzzled.
"Indeed, Brother Yuan. You might find the name a bit presumptuous, but the invisibility effect of the Heavenly Escape Stone Talisman is genuinely effective. Ever since I acquired this treasure, no one has been able to see through it, not even the Level 4 Peak Demon Trees from the Time Cave," Wulu stated confidently.
"If that's the case, let's join forces once again, Brother. I don't believe a Tree Man can stop us!" Having experienced the effect of the Heavenly Escape Stone Talisman himself, Yuan Ming wholeheartedly agreed.
"Indeed, we shouldn't delay. Shall we set off now?" Wulu asked, his spirits lifted by the conversation.
"We've just escaped from outside; we're not in top form yet. Let's practice Breathing Control for a while first," Yuan Ming suggested calmly.
Wulu nodded, and the two immediately sat down cross-legged, each restoring their mana.
A moment later, both had fully recovered and rose to set out.
Yuan Ming employed the Void Transformation Technique, transforming himself into a transparent phantom.
Wulu, having applied some kind of Divine Skill, also turned into a phantom, walking shoulder to shoulder with Yuan Ming.
"Earlier, Brother Wulu, you mentioned coming to Lank Island to search for something. Did you find it?" Yuan Ming remembered and asked.
"Not yet. I suspect that the item might be inside the Time Cave. This time I have entered to search for it," Wulu responded.
"And what exactly is this treasure?" Yuan Ming asked curiously.
"It's a chessboard, known as the Lank Chessboard, a Spiritual Treasure left by the Lank Immortal!" Wulu said after a slight hesitation.
"The Lank Chessboard?" Yuan Ming's interest was piqued.
"This treasure, reportedly the lifelong endeavor of the Lank Immortal, can manipulate the flow of time using Star Power," Wulu elaborated with longing.
"Manipulate time! There's actually such an Exotic Treasure in the world!" Yuan Ming exclaimed in surprise.
"I've only heard the rumors. Whether the Lank Chessboard can truly manipulate time, I do not know," Wulu shook his head.
Yuan Ming nodded, not asking any further.
The two quickened their pace. Before long, they encountered a group of Tree Men.Thе mоst up‑tо‑dаtе vеrsiоn is оn М4VLЕМР4YR.
"Brother Yuan, don't release your Divine Sense. These Tree Men are not only sensitive to aura but can also detect the presence of Divine Sense," Wulu said as he pulled Yuan Ming into hiding.
"Can they really detect it? Let me try," Yuan Ming expressed his intent to use his Divine Sense.
Knowing Yuan Ming's decisive nature and that he would want to personally test the capabilities of the mountain's Tree Men—and with no immediate danger present—Wulu did not stop him.
No sooner had Yuan Ming's Divine Sense drawn near than the Tree Men became alert and looked towards their hiding spot.
"They really can detect it!" Yuan Ming said in surprise, yet he did not flee.
The sense of the first soul descended, casting an Illusion Technique on several Tree Men.
With the enhancement from the Stealing Heaven Tripod, the Divine Sense remained undetectable. Unaware of anything amiss, the Tree Men were immediately caught in an illusion, spinning around in place.
"Let's go." Yuan Ming smiled slightly, pulling Wulu as they continued toward the summit.
"Brother Yuan, what did you just do?" Wulu asked, filled with curiosity and admiration.
Previously, he had struggled immensely with the sharp senses of the Tree Men, relying entirely on the Heavenly Escape Stone Talisman for invisibility to approach the Time Cave, while Yuan Ming had effortlessly resolved this issue with a wave of his hand.
"Just a little Illusion Technique, nothing noteworthy," Yuan Ming spoke ambiguously.
Seeing that Yuan Ming did not wish to elaborate, Wulu did not press further.
Under the surveillance of the first soul, the pair easily bypassed waves of Tree Men and soon arrived at the mid-mountain.
As Tree Men grew more abundant, even Yuan Ming's ability to locate them ahead of time with the first soul and cast Illusion Techniques to confuse them could not avoid all enemies. They soon had their tracks discovered.
The two had no choice but to flee across the mountain, confronting lone Tree Men by attacking and large groups by escaping. When the pursuit became too intense, Wulu activated the Heavenly Escape Stone Talisman to hide their tracks.

chapters.title: Chapter 577 - 551: Drawing Trouble Away
chapters.content:
Wulu had previously reached the summit alone. Now, with their combined efforts, it was naturally even easier as they easily broke through multiple obstacles and arrived at the top of the white giant peak.
"Brother Wulu, where is the Time Cave you mentioned before?" Yuan Ming surveyed the surroundings before asking.
"Cross over the mountain ahead, and you will see the Time Cave." With these words, Wulu activated the Heavenly Escape Stone Talisman, concealing both of their traces as they continued to move forward.
Yuan Ming followed closely behind, quickly crossing over the mountain ahead.
In front of them, a slanted mountainside appeared with a rift in the slope, forming an entrance several zhang in size, from which black and white lights flickered, expanding and contracting unpredictably.
Next to the cave, the characters for "Time Cave" were carved flamboyantly from top to bottom.
Yuan Ming's pupils contracted as he pulled Wulu to crouch behind a large boulder.
Seven towering black and green ancient trees surrounded the Time Cave, each one emitting an overpowering presence, clearly at the Level 4 Upper Stage.
A dense mass of roots hung down, tightly wrapping around the entrance of the Time Cave.
"Brother Wulu, didn't you say there was only one Level 4 Upper Stage Tree Man around the Time Cave? Why are there seven?" Yuan Ming communicated through a voice transmission.
"I'm not sure either. When I came up here before, there indeed was only one giant tree," Wulu replied, just as bewildered and perplexed.
Yuan Ming had no time to inquire about the past; since they needed to find a way into the cave, the urgent task was to deal with these seven trees sealing the entrance.
He looked at the cave mouth firmly shielded by tree roots, his eyebrows tightly knitted.
The Heavenly Escape Stone Talisman could conceal their traces, but their bodies were still physically present there, unable to pass through the tree roots blocking the cave entrance.
The powerful and profound strength of these giant trees meant their roots were no ordinary roots; typical escape techniques would probably fail to deceive them.
"Now what do we do? The time for the Heavenly Escape Stone Talisman is almost up," Wulu asked somewhat anxiously.
Yuan Ming didn't respond. At that moment, he had already mobilized his divine sense from his first soul, descending to inspect the interior of the Time Cave. Suddenly, his heart stirred, and he looked towards a concealed hollow a hundred zhang away.
The entire hollow was enveloped by a transparent protective shield, within which black and white energies could be vaguely seen flowing. From outside, it appeared completely normal, but Yuan Ming's first soul's divine sense penetrated through the transparent shield with ease.
Five figures stood inside. The Blood Realm Venerable and the white-browed young man they had seen before were there, standing with a burly man whose beard was as sharp as a sword and a purple-haired beautiful woman.
The burly man had unfathomable mana within him, clearly a late-stage Nascent Soul great cultivator.
The purple-haired woman was also a Nascent Soul cultivator, her cultivation having reached the Nascent Soul Middle Stage.
On the opposite side of the Blood Realm Venerable and the others stood a Blood Robed Man, looking to be in his thirties or forties, with stern features and quite handsome, except for a black eye patch over his right eye.
"It's him..." Yuan Ming's expression showed surprise.
He had seen this Blood Robed Man at the Immortal Fruit Conference, who was the Master of Blood Yan Island.
The occurrence of an anomaly on Fusang Island and coming across the Master of Blood Yan Island here was not strange. What surprised Yuan Ming was the man's cultivation.
During the Immortal Fruit Conference, the Master of Blood Yan Island was still a perfect Core Formation cultivator, but now his revealed cultivation was that of the early stage Nascent Soul!
"Hehe, Master Blood Yan, your Heavenly Concealment Cover is truly impressive. Even those Tree Men cannot see through it. With this cover, our entry into the Time Cave is even more assured," the burly man looked around and laughed as he spoke.
"Alliance Leader Yuan flatters me. This mere magic treasure is nothing significant. We still rely on the members of the Tide-rider Scatter Alliance for entering the cave," the Master of Blood Yan Island replied modestly.
Yuan Ming's expression shifted, gauging from the conversation that these people could be members of the Scatter Alliance. After he had encountered Jia Sifang, the Tide Maker, he collected quite a bit of information about them. Could it be that this burly man, called Master by the Master of Blood Yan Island, was the renowned Alliance Leader of the Tide-rider Scatter Alliance, Yuan Wuji?
It seemed, for the moment, that both the Master of Blood Yan Island and the Scatter Alliance wanted to enter the Time Cave.
"Brother Yuan, my mana is nearly depleted. I cannot hold out much longer," Wulu said, his face paling as he urged again.
"Follow me," Yuan Ming said, his eyes darting about, leading Wulu swiftly towards the Master of Blood Yan Island and the others, landing near them without a sound.
"It's fine now. Brother Wulu, release the concealing effect of the Heavenly Escape Stone Talisman," Yuan Ming instructed.
"Right here?" Wulu looked surprised.
"Yes. And later, Brother Wulu, don't use any secret techniques to conceal yourself. Reveal your presence directly," Yuan Ming continued.
"But why?" Wulu didn't understand.
"There's no need to ask, Brother Wulu. I have a plan," Yuan Ming assured.
Though Wulu didn't understand the meaning behind Yuan Ming's actions, out of trust for Yuan Ming, he lifted the invisible effect of the Heavenly Escape Stone Talisman.
Their figures appeared out of nowhere, exposed in midair.
The Blood Yan Island Master and the others were taken aback at the scene.
"What's going on? Who are these two, and why did they suddenly appear here?" Yuan Wuji frowned.
"Wu Lu!" The Blood Yan Island Master's pupils shrank when he saw Wu Lu, and he was greatly alarmed.
The seven black-green giants trees near the distant Time Cave also sensed the presence of Yuan Ming and Wu Lu; several branches from one of the trees stretched in the wind, shooting towards the two men like enormous black-green crossbow bolts.
Yuan Ming and Wu Lu were standing right behind the Blood Yan Island Master and the others, and the black-green branches struck the transparent protective shield.
Since all of this happened too suddenly, the Blood Yan Island Master had no time to react, and Yuan Wuji was unable to control the Heavenly Concealment Cover; the transparent shield shattered at the sound, revealing the forms of the Blood Yan Island Master, Yuan Wuji, and the others.
"Island Master!" Wu Lu was shocked when he saw the Blood Yan Island Master and immediately understood Yuan Ming's intention; Yuan Ming intended to use the Blood Yan Island Master and the others as a shield.
Several branches continued lashing towards Yuan Ming and Wu Lu, with Yuan Wuji and the others inadvertently blocking them in the middle.
"Damn it!" Yuan Wuji had no choice but to take action, blood light flashed in his palm, and he produced a blood-colored long saber.
This saber had a two-headed wolf embossed on the hilt, the blade was long and narrow, thin as a cicada's wing, emitting dazzling blood light, and a stream of black air flowed within the blade, looking extremely sinister.
As soon as the saber appeared, before Yuan Wuji even stirred it, it began to hum and tremble, radiating a sky-high stench of blood that filled the area.
Yuan Wuji gripped the long saber in his hand, threads of blood light flickering in his eyes; he no longer had time to be bothered with Yuan Ming and the others, and swung his saber in mid-air towards the incoming branches.
A majestic swath of blood-colored saber light flashed by, severing several thick branches.
In the blink of an eye, Yuan Ming had already pulled Wu Lu away, flying into the distance. Seeing this scene, his heart skipped a beat, too.
The power of this blood-colored long saber was in no way inferior to Gu Xuanyang's Immortal Slaying Sword Qi.
"This is the Blood Transformation Divine Saber! The treasure that guards our sect; it's actually in this person's hands!" Blood Shadow exclaimed again from within the Shura Blood Devouring Map, his voice filled with delight and shock.
"Blood Transformation Divine Saber? It sounds similar to that Blood Transformation Saber with only a single character difference. Could it be a magic treasure of the same type?" Yuan Ming asked.
"Our sect's Blood Transformation Saber was refined in imitation of this Blood Transformation Divine Saber, so naturally, its power is incomparable! The Blood Transformation Divine Saber is a treasure of our sect, its power beyond measure. Some believe it's a damaged Spiritual Treasure; I never expected it to still exist, let alone see it again! Master, can you seize this saber for me? With this Blood Transformation Divine Saber, my strength could increase manifold, allowing me to triumph over a Nascent Soul Mid-Stage Cultivator in battle!" Blood Shadow said excitedly.
"We'll see if an opportunity arises," Yuan Ming responded inaudibly to himself.
Yuan Wuji was a real Late-stage Nascent Soul Great Cultivator, his strength far beyond an ordinary Nascent Soul Mid-Stage Cultivator. Blood Shadow really overestimated him, wanting him to snatch a treasure from the hands of a great cultivator – that was practically suicidal.
Wu Lu, witnessing this situation, simply let Yuan Ming lead, taking out an elixir and swallowing it, then cultivating to refine the elixir and restore his mana.
The authentic version is on *.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming handed over a green lotus seed and transmitted a message swiftly:
"Take this, it will help you rapidly restore your mana."
Without hesitation, Wu Lu swallowed the lotus seed, cultivating to refine it and entrusting his safety to Yuan Ming.
With so many cultivators suddenly appearing, the giant trees that sealed off the Time Cave were naturally a mix of shock and anger.
The ground began to shake, rumbling ominously!
Four of the giant trees uprooted themselves from the ground, their tall bodies quickly shrinking, and branches and leaves doing the same; in a blink of an eye, they transformed into four ten-foot-tall black-green giants, racing towards Yuan Wuji and the others to pounce.
The strong presence emanating from Yuan Wuji, along with his previous readiness to act, naturally made him the target of concentrated attacks.
The ordinary Tree Men nearby, sensing the commotion here, also uprooted and surged towards this place.
At the same time, Yuan Ming immediately deployed the Void Transformation Technique and cast a Concealing Divine Power on Wu Lu, fleeing into the distance.
Yuan Ming and Wu Lu, both Core Formation cultivators, coupled with being furthest from the Time Cave at this moment, naturally were of no concern to the four black-green giants who were solely focused on attacking Yuan Wuji and the Nascent Soul level beings like the Blood Yan Island Master.
The pursuit towards Yuan Ming and Wu Lu was left to ordinary Tree Men.
With the help of his first soul's Illusion Technique, Yuan Ming easily broke free from the encirclement of the Tree Men and vanished near a cliff in the distance.
"Interesting, a Core Formation junior actually saw through the Heavenly Concealment Cover," Yuan Wuji said, his face showing curiosity. His fingers moved secretly from within his robe, and two subtle blood lights appeared beneath his feet, chasing after Yuan Ming and Wu Lu.
"The bastard won't get far! Big brother, let me go kill him!" The Blood Realm Venerable was fuming with vengeful anger for new and old grudges as he watched Yuan Ming escape, gnashing his teeth in fury and ready to pursue.
"No need. It's wiser to leave this place first. This score can be settled with them later," Yuan Wuji said, stopping the Blood Realm Venerable with an unhurried tone.
Yuan Wuji and his group, powerful as they were, were also reluctant to confront the numerous Level 4 Upper Stage Tree Demons and countless Tree Men head-on. They exchanged blows only briefly, seizing the moment to turn and flee.
The Level 4 Tree Demons pursued relentlessly, vanishing into the distance soon after.
Yuan Ming did not go far; after employing the Illusion Technique, shaking off the pursuing Tree Men, he led Wu Lu around in a circle, returning to the vicinity of the Time Cave.
With Yuan Wuji and the others drawing away the four Level 4 Upper Stage Tree Demons, only three remained near the Time Cave, and even the entwined roots at the entrance of the cave had thinned considerably.

chapters.title: Chapter 578 - 552: Entering the Cave
chapters.content:
"Haha, truly worthy of Brother Yuan! With such ease, you've resolved most of our troubles, and now with only three Tree Demons left, our chances of sneaking into the Time Cave have greatly increased," Wulu praised.
He had already recovered his Mana and was about to activate the Heavenly Escape Stone Talisman again to conceal both of their presences.
"Wait a moment, we still have a small problem to deal with," Yuan Ming looked back at the ground behind him.
Some hundreds of feet underground, two blood-colored shadows lay in hiding, precisely the objects released by Yuan Wuji earlier.
The two blood-colored shadows were barely visible and their presence was almost non-existent; had it not been for the Divine Sense of his first soul division, he would have had difficulty detecting them.
"These are the Blood God Puppets of my Blood Transformation Sect," Blood Shadow, upon noticing Yuan Ming's actions and extending his Divine Sense, said in surprise.
"Blood God Puppets? I see," Yuan Ming nodded.
Earlier, while he was in seclusion beneath the mountain practicing Breathing Control, he had obtained the complete Blood Transformation Technique Jade Scroll from Blood Shadow, which included the method for refining Blood God Puppets. It required a complete Cultivator's body, using blood as the medium, inscribing the unique talismans of the Blood Transformation Sect on the corpse, and then using the Yin Fire to forge it for ten years, refining every part of the puppet's flesh and bones, thus creating the Blood God Puppet.
Once made, the Blood God Puppet could transform into a Blood Cloud, capable of flying or tunneling through the earth without issue. Its aura of blood could even defile Magic Treasures, making it quite versatile.
The higher the Cultivation of the Cultivator who refined the puppet, the more formidable the resulting Blood God Puppet would be. According to the records on the Jade Scroll, the Blood Transformation Sect once fortuitously acquired the corpse of a late-stage Nascent Soul Great Cultivator. The entire Sect spent a hundred years painstakingly refining it into the highest-quality Blood God Puppet.
This Blood God Puppet was formless and shadowless, its body existing somewhere between material and immaterial, not only impervious to Magic Treasures but also capable of transforming into an intangible Blood Shadow when fighting a person. It could pounce onto an enemy's body and breach even the strongest Protective Body Magic Treasures. The Blood Shadow passing through could instantly suck away the opponent's Essence Blood and Divine Soul.
For every bit of Essence Blood and Divine Soul it absorbed, the Blood God Puppet would grow stronger, until eventually, it developed spiritual intelligence and escaped the Blood Transformation Sect, leaving the higher-ups profoundly regretful.
"These two Blood God Puppets appear to be freshly refined. Someone used the Sect's secret Blood Concealing Talisman to hide their forms and auras so well, making them not difficult to deal with!" Blood Shadow spoke confidently, volunteering himself.
"No need, I can handle it," Yuan Ming controlled the first soul division to cast an Illusion Technique on the two blood-colored shadows.
The Blood God Puppets, in a state of confusion, had no power to resist the Illusion Technique of the first soul division and quickly became motionless on the spot.
Yuan Ming dived underground and activated the Cold Moon Ring with a flick of his fingers.
Two rays of white light shot out and struck the Blood God Puppets, instantly freezing them into ice sculptures.
Blood Shadow also revealed his true form, and he turned out to be Luu Changfeng and Elder Qi, the ones who had led Yuan Ming and others into the Secret Realm previously.This chapter was first seen on *.
Yuan Ming displayed a look of surprise, then he waved his sleeve.
A streak of azure light flashed by, and the two puppets vanished into thin air.
After taking care of the two puppets, Yuan Ming returned to the surface without delay, joining Wulu in front of the Time Cave.
...
As soon as the two men neared the cave entrance, the remaining three giant trees began to twist, their hanging vines retracting and their bodies becoming more compact. Faces emerged on the dry trunks, each contorted and lunging towards them.
Upon seeing this, Wulu quickly grabbed Yuan Ming and immediately activated the Heavenly Escape Stone Talisman.
The two vanished into the void with a flash, leaving behind the three Tree Men, who looked around the empty space with a look of bewilderment.
Inside the Time Cave, Yuan Ming and Wulu quietly leaped in, concealing themselves within the void.
They had yet to steady themselves when they were immediately drawn to a pitch-black ancient tree not far ahead.
This old tree was no more than ten feet tall, with rough bark and convoluted branches, spiraling into complex configurations. It bore metallic luster and numerous descending black vines.
A huge and ancient human face grew amidst the tree trunk at mid-height.
Unlike the twisted faces of the Tree Men, this face was identical to that of a human, except for its black hue. Its eyes were slightly closed, and the face was cross-hatched with wrinkles, exuding a serene and even somewhat kind expression.
Wulu and Yuan Ming exchanged glances, about to examine it closely when the old human face on the tree suddenly moved its eyelids and opened its eyes.
The eyes revealed a pair of murky pupils, frosted over and misty, which in a flash turned into two swirling vortexes of chaos.
An air of wild chaos immediately emanated from the eyes, and countless vines on the black tree came to life all at once, thrashing wildly in every direction like dancing demons.
Billowing black fog spread from the old tree, quickly filling the entire cavern.
As Yuan Ming's gaze met those vortex-like eyes, his Sea of Consciousness seemed to be struck by a heavy blow, as if a great bell had rung, freezing him in place.
His vision shifted as he suddenly saw an enormous black tree with a vast canopy and tendrils that blotted out the sky, its branches like the arms of demons, covered in black scales and sharp barbs.
Before Yuan Ming could react, those demonic arm-like vines were already lunging towards him, piercing into his body.
Yuan Ming only felt a dizzying vertigo as his consciousness plummeted sharply downward, as if he were falling into an endless abyss, constantly tumbling into the darkness, gradually losing all perception of himself.
He vaguely realized that his Soul Power was being rapidly extracted, but his chaotic consciousness could no longer sustain any counterattack.
Meanwhile, inside the Time Cave, the effect of the Heavenly Escape Stone Talisman wore off, and both Yuan Ming and Wulu's figures appeared.
Wulu's condition was much like Yuan Ming's, even worse, with his face showing an even more serious color of defeat.
Just then, the ground behind them suddenly cracked open, and two black Demon Vines shot out, each stabbing toward their backs.
"Ugh..."
Both Yuan Ming and Wulu couldn't help but let out a muffled groan, a flash of pain crossing their faces.
As the sound rang out, their skin began to turn a rapid shade of gray-white, but it was not the gray-white of a dried corpse when its moisture has been drained.
The muscle patterns on their bodies began to bulge, and grooves started to form along the edges, irregular hard plates sprouting over their skin; they were quickly transforming into something resembling trees.
Once their appearance had changed unnaturally, their skin color also began to darken gradually, and they now bore a striking resemblance to the wooden puppets they had seen earlier.
As their bodies transformed and their consciousnesses fell into oblivion, unable to resist, the first soul division hidden inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod immediately sprang into action.
At its call, streams of pure Desire Power gathered, infusing into Yuan Ming's Divine Soul.
The Soul Power that had formerly been extracted in large amounts was suddenly replenished, and his Divine Sense, which had already sunk into the abyss, finally saw a speck of light in the endless darkness.
Yuan Ming didn't give up on this glimmer of light, struggling desperately to reach upward.
His eyes, which had gradually turned to a gray-white color, suddenly brightened with spirit, and he finally regained some consciousness.
Seizing this fleeting opportunity, Yuan Ming immediately summoned the Night Parade of Hundred Demons, and a burst of white light flew out from it— the hidden All Living Beings Dream Rune, which flashed into the body of the black Tree Demon and disappeared.
The previously wildly thrashing Demon Vine tendrils suddenly paused, hanging in mid-air, as did the swarming black mist in the cave, which also solidified in the air.
In the Tree Demon's face carved in the black tree, the swirling mists in its widened eyes came to an abrupt halt, as if frozen in time.
Not knowing how long the All Living Beings' Dream Rune would hold, Yuan Ming dared not delay for even a moment; a Golden Light flashed above his head, and a gleaming Scripture Pillar emerged.
Within the sea of Golden Light, dozens of Magic Treasures, including the Thunder God Hammer and the God Bombarding Cone, were launched at once, various colors shining brightly as they bombarded the black tree in unison.
Yuan Ming, while grabbing the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear, activated nearly all his Star Power, channeling it into the spear.
Thunder, lightning, and sparkling lights like flint rained down on the black tree, producing a series of heavy booms, yet the results were no better than a mantis trying to shake a tree.
Only the Thunder God Hammer and the God Bombarding Cone managed to carve a crack in the trunk of the tree; the attacks from the other Magic Treasures barely broke its surface and could not inflict serious damage.
Even Yuan Ming's Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear only penetrated halfway before it became stuck, unable to advance further.
The toughness and resilience of the black tree far surpassed his imagination.
Seeing that the black tree was starting to awaken from his attack, Yuan Ming grew deeply anxious.
At that moment, he suddenly recalled something and immediately twisted his wrist, taking out the talisman paper that had been given to him by Hou Yi's Sun-shooting Bow, and poured his Mana into it to activate the talisman.
As the Mana flowed in, the talisman paper lit up, and a virtual image of a Golden Bow identical to Hou Yi's Sun-shooting Bow appeared in Yuan Ming's palm.
He reached out to grasp the virtual image of the Golden Bow and immediately felt a vast and scorching force seeping into his arm.
Without any hesitation, Yuan Ming took out a Golden Crow arrow, nocked it to the bowstring.
The more he pulled on the bowstring, the more the image of the Golden Bow was drawn, and a blinding light began to emerge around the Golden Crow arrow; a power both scorching and overwhelmingly luminous began to concentrate on it.
The temperature around the void rose sharply, and even Wulu, lost in the illusion, suffered burns that made him tremble uncontrollably.
The black tree seemed to sense the impending crisis and began to struggle violently; the gray-white mist in its pupils shook and swirled, as though it was fighting with all its might against the control of the All Living Beings' Dream Rune.
Seeing its eyes convulse and its gaze gradually clear, Yuan Ming did not waver, pulling the Golden Bow to its full crescent before releasing the bowstring.
"Whoosh," a sound rang out.
A golden arrow shot forth, tracing a fleeting arc before directly embedding into the black tree.

chapters.title: Chapter 579 - 553: A Day A Year
chapters.content:
Unlike when Yuan Ming previously attacked with his Magic Treasure, this Golden Crow Arrow pierced through the dark old tree's trunk with ease, half of the arrow's shaft penetrating the tree.
"Aaah..."
The Old Black Tree, controlled by the All Living Beings' Dream Rune, suddenly came to its senses, its ancient human face emitting a miserable and low moan as countless black vines wildly danced upward, thrusting towards Yuan Ming.
At the same time, white mist once again streamed from its eyes, staring straight at Yuan Ming.
The golden divine bow in Yuan Ming's hand gradually turned into specks of starlight and dissipated, leaving only a charred, crimson wound in his palm. Despite the pain, he didn't mind, quickly casting a spell and once again activating the All Living Beings' Dream Rune.
But the moment his gaze met with the old tree's, that feeling of being struck by a giant bell suddenly hit him again.
Just when he was about to fall for the attack once more, the Golden Crow Arrow embedded in the black tree suddenly exploded with a burst of blinding golden light. Golden beams shot out from it, and in an instant, bisected the black tree.
The upper half of the tree's body "boom" collapsed, and the black vines that had pierced their bodies also retracted at the same time.
Yuan Ming and Wulu felt an immediate release throughout their bodies, then their legs gave way, and they fell to the ground.
"What's happened?" Wulu's voice was tinged with weakness, his tone somewhat hoarse as he asked.
"Let's get out of here first; I'll explain on the way," Yuan Ming said, without the time to explain further. He quickly took out some elixirs and swallowed them, also feeding a few to Wulu.
After taking the elixirs, Wulu hastily worked on circulating the medicinal efficacy with Breathing Control.
Yuan Ming approached the severed body of the Old Black Tree, looking at that ghostly black and ancient face, he couldn't help but shudder.
Although the eyes of the old black tree were closed for good, with no trace of life left in it, like those black Tree Men, it surged with rich Life Energy.
Yuan Ming waved his hand and collected the half-piece of the black tree.
Afterward, he and Wulu quickly made their way through the cave, recounting the events that had taken place while on the move.
"Brother Yuan, you've saved my life again," Wulu said, having recovered quite a bit, unable to help feeling grateful.
After about the time it takes to brew a pot of tea, a hazy light became visible at the end of the cave.
With joy in their hearts, they rushed towards it, only to find upon closer inspection that there stood a black and white round Light Gate, from within which dense nature's spiritual energy emanated.
Yuan Ming sensed the same atmosphere he had felt when possessing Guoguo a few days earlier, in that black and white space, and a thick smile spread across his face.
"There's no mistake, it's there," he said, and charged towards the Light Gate.
Wulu, although puzzled that Yuan Ming seemed so certain despite his first visit, had no time to ask questions and hurriedly followed.
The figures of the two men disappeared one after another into the black and white Light Gate.
...
On the Three Immortals Island, within an unknown dark space.
As the Old Black Tree Demon had its lifeline severed by Yuan Ming's arrow, a painful and muffled groan came from the depths of the darkness, sounding as though it had suffered an attack.
Almost simultaneously, the Tree Men guarding the entry of the Time Cave, all transformed from giant trees, knelt to the ground, their tendrils burrowing into the earth while their crowns shook violently. Their deformed faces opened their mouths wide and issued painful howls.
The Tree Men who had gone to chase after Yuan Wuji and the others were in the same predicament, their expressions filled with pain, momentarily halting their attack on Yuan Wuji and his group.
Unaware of what had happened, they looked at each other in bewilderment.
A blood-colored figure shot out, heading straight for the Time Cave—it was the Blood Yan Island Master.
"Follow him!" Yuan Wuji saw this and with a decisive look, ordered sternly.
Several figures soared into the sky, racing towards the Time Cave swiftly.
In the dark space, that voice sounded once more, this time a brief cold snort.
As the voice echoed, the surface of the white mountain below Yuan Wuji and the others exploded amidst a roaring sound, fissuring apart.
Instantly, boulders tumbled, dust billowed, and huge cracks formed across the mountain. Hundreds of gigantic tree roots, like great dragons, burst from within, swinging towards Yuan Wuji and his group. It appeared to be the same giant roots that had previously been lurking underground.
The roots were covered with countless branching tendrils, like tentacles, reaching for the people who were frantically scattering.
The group was shocked and scrambled to dodge using their spells.
But the multitude of roots, with their terrifying pressure and uncanny agility, quickly blocked the paths of most, and in a moment, they had nowhere to hide, nearly to be seized by the roots.
Just then, the unexpected happened!
The genuine article resides on M|V|L&EMPYR.
A rumbling sound that echoed through the heavens erupted in the distance, carrying with it the force of heavenly might, causing the entire earth to shake.
As they looked up in panic, they saw a golden light streak across the sky from the direction of the Golden Sunflower Immortal Island, shooting straight towards Lank Island above them.
The immense golden light suddenly broke apart into hundreds of golden arrows, raining down in this area.
Each golden arrow targeted a thick tree root with unerring accuracy.
Among the rain of arrows, seven were particularly large and powerful.
The arrows rent the air, leaving dark streaks as they sped straight towards the seven Level 4 Upper Stage Tree Demons at the entrance of the Time Cave.
The seven Tree Demons' faces distorted with fear as they tried to flee, burrowing into the earth or soaring into the sky.
However, the seven massive arrows pursued the demons like maggots to a corpse, relentless in their chase!
"Boom boom boom!"
Explosive sounds continued unceasingly on Lank Island, as the golden light and flames scattered, and a cloud of dust rose up to obscure the sky, creating an apocalyptic scene.
Yuan Wuji and others turned pale, scattering in panic, no longer concerned about the Time Cave but solely focused on avoiding the terrifying attack.
The white mountain was almost destroyed. The White Scale Master and his group, as well as Old Man Hei Zhu and others, were forced to flee from their hiding places, joining in the chaotic escape.
Fortunately, the golden light arrow rain attack only lasted for a few breaths before it stopped.
When the dust gradually cleared, everyone on the island was unharmed; however, the vast roots emerging from the ground were mostly destroyed, and the tree people on the mountain were nearly all wiped out, with no trace of those seven Level 4 Upper Stage tree demons.
Half of Lank Island bore terrifying cracks everywhere, a sight that was appalling to the eye.
Yuan Wuji and others, having survived the calamity, dared not stay any longer and all rushed towards the Time Cave like mad.
With their life energy severely damaged, the giant roots no longer had the strength to block them.
Meanwhile, White Scale Master, Old Man Hei Zhu, and the others were completely unaware of what had happened, standing there in confusion.
"Hmph, Hou Yi's Sun Shooting Bow, Lank Chessboard, even if you aid those outsiders, it's nothing but a struggle at death's door, a futile effort. Once I complete my task, you will all submit to me," said the indifferent voice in the dark space, its echo lingering in the empty void.
As soon as the voice faded, the ground of Lank Island cracked open once again, countless tree people emerged, and pounced towards White Scale Master and the others.
...
As the light that filled his vision gradually dissipated, Yuan Ming could see his surroundings clearly again.
Ancient trees climbing with vines soared into the clouds, the earth was covered with lush green grass, and in the sky, a black sun and a white sun shone upon each other, harmoniously intertwined.
Everything was the same as what he saw while possessing Guoguo.
Yuan Ming looked around and connected with the Golden Crow in his Sea of Consciousness, silently sensing Xi Ying's location.
Soon, a hint of joy flashed across his face, "Brother Wulu, please follow me."
Upon hearing this, Wulu nodded slightly and followed Yuan Ming.
The two traveled swiftly and soon arrived at a valley filled with bird songs and fragrant flowers.
The valley was strewn with fresh flowers, shaded with green trees, and a clear pond, brimming with sparkling water, was situated in the middle.
Lotus leaves and flowers filled the pond; they were as green as jade and so large they could accommodate a person sitting upright.
In the center of the pond, a majestic ancient tree radiated spirit light as it stretched its branches towards the sky. Its canopy was vast, countless vines hung from the treetops, lightly touching the water, causing ripples with every sway in the wind.
Yuan Ming and Wulu arrived before the pond and discovered that the Spiritual Energy here was several times denser than anywhere else. Just breathing in the pure Spiritual Power lifted their spirits noticeably.
While they were still marveling at this, a beastly roar suddenly echoed.
"Roar... meow?"
A small beastly figure pounced to Yuan Ming's feet and rubbed against his leg.
Yuan Ming looked down and immediately laughed, picking up the little creature and stroking its back, "Guoguo, where's Xi Ying?"
Guoguo meowed comfortably twice, shaking with pleasure, then lifted its right paw and pointed towards the ancient tree at the center of the pond.
Carrying Guoguo, Yuan Ming walked around the pond and, indeed, on the opposite shore, he saw Xi Ying sitting in the lotus flower.
Whether Xi Ying sensed the Golden Crow within Yuan Ming's Sea of Consciousness was uncertain, but when Yuan Ming looked at her, she also just happened to open her eyes. Meeting his gaze, she revealed a playful smile, "You're here!"
Yuan Ming, watching her, found himself unconsciously smiling in response, "Have you been waiting long?"
Seeing this, Wulu behind him let out a faint sigh and then silently stepped aside, as if to enjoy the view elsewhere.
At the same time, Xi Ying got up, gliding over the pond surface, to join Yuan Ming, "Indeed, it's been quite a while. Why did you take so long to come here?"
"I didn't quite know the way, I first ended up at Golden Sunflower Island... Huh, you've made a breakthrough to the Late-stage Core Formation?" Yuan Ming stated, then suddenly expressed surprise.
Xi Ying smiled proudly, "It's the peak of Late-stage Core Formation, and it won't be long before I break through again!"
Yuan Ming became even more astonished, "So quickly? Haven't we been on the island for only about six or seven days?"
"It has been six or seven days outside, but in here, it's already been six or seven years," Xi Ying shook her head nonchalantly.
Yuan Ming's eyes widened, "Time flows differently here than in the outside world?"
"Exactly, otherwise why would the entrance to this place be called the Time Cave? It's because the time here differs from the outside world," Wulu, who seemed to overhear Yuan Ming talking about serious matters, came back and casually explained.
"If that's the case, could there be some treasure related to time here?" Yuan Ming speculated.
"Perhaps, but I spent half a year searching this place without finding any treasure or clues. However, the Spiritual Energy here is much denser than the outside world, making it a sacred place for cultivation," Xi Ying said.
"This is indeed a sacred cultivation place. This tree must be the legendary Gathering Spirit Tree, right? Such a colossal Gathering Spirit Tree, I fear, is second to none in the entire Yunhuang Continent," Yuan Ming said, looking towards the giant tree in the center of the lake.
In the Cultivation World, the main Gathering Spirit Objects are the Gathering Spirit Stone, Gathering Spirit Spring, and the most superior, the Gathering Spirit Tree.
Liu Tianming had mentioned in a casual chat with Yuan Ming that within Chang Chun Temple, there was a Gathering Spirit Tree, only a few dozen feet tall, which was nothing compared to the one before him.
No wonder Xi Ying's cultivation had improved so quickly. After all, meditating in such a place, it would be hard to slow down even if one wanted to.
"The natural spiritual energy here is extremely dense. Aside from this Gathering Spirit Tree, there are also two other places where Gathering Spirit Objects grow. If you're interested, we can go and take a look later," Xi Ying offered.
Yuan Ming nodded at her words.
"Enough about me. How did you get here? This place is isolated from the outside world, and all my means of communication are useless. What has happened in the outside world in the past six or seven days?" Xi Ying asked, waving her hand dismissively.
Yuan Ming was about to speak when he saw a streak of spirit light falling from each sun in the sky above, landing not far from where they stood.
After landing, the two streaks of black and white spirit light quickly merged at one spot, and then, like clay being molded, they formed into a man clad in black and white clothes.
His hair was as black as ink, skin as white as snow, with a white iris on a black sclera in his left eye, and a black iris on a white sclera in the right; both devoid of any brilliance, resembling stone-carved eyes, giving him a particularly stiff appearance.
Yuan Ming could not sense any cultivation level or Spiritual Energy from him, but this made him cautious, showing no negligence in his attitude.

chapters.title: Chapter 580 - 580: 554
chapters.content:
Wulu had a similar expression, whereas Xi Ying's demeanor was calm, as if she had long been aware of this person's existence.
"May I ask how to address the senior?" Yuan Ming looked at the man clad in black and white, whose eyes lacked any brilliance, and asked with a bow.
"I am the Artifact Spirit of the Lank Chessboard. It is by the command of the Venerable Master above that I situate myself within the Time Cave Secret Realm. You were allowed to enter here because of my consent, so there is no need for such formality," said the man clad in black and white, waving his hand as his gaze landed on Yuan Ming, though his eyes remained hollow and lusterless.
"I would not presume, thank you, Senior, for opening this convenient gateway. However, I am not sure why you allowed us to come in. Is there something you require us to do?" Yuan Ming asked cautiously.
The Artifact Spirit was straightforward: "Indeed, I do have a task for you, which is connected to your own interests as well, not just mine."
"Please speak plainly, Senior," Yuan Ming said, glancing at Xi Ying and Wulu before continuing.
"The existence of the Undead Demon Tree, you must have heard about it from Hou Yi's Sun-shooting Bow, correct?" the man in black and white asked.
"Yes," Yuan Ming nodded.
"As such, that makes things simpler. The power contained within the Lank Chessboard is limited and cannot maintain this place for long. By the reckoning of the outside world, I can maintain the Time Cave Secret Realm for no more than thirty days. In other words, you can stay here for thirty years. After thirty years, the space of the secret realm will completely collapse, and then you will face the Undead Demon Tree directly; whether you live or die will depend on your own fate," the Artifact Spirit spoke bluntly.
"Senior means to suggest that we cultivate here for thirty years and then go to slay the Undead Demon Tree? We are already trapped on the island and are enemies of the Undead Demon Tree, so indeed, this matter does relate to us. However, why would you be willing to help us?" Yuan Ming asked, somewhat surprised.
"The ambitions of the Undead Demon Tree are vast, and its power is growing stronger. Sooner or later, it will break through the forbidden constraints of the Time Cave and seize my original body. Rather than sitting here awaiting doom, I prefer to take a stand through your hands, to fight a battle to the death. If it can be exterminated, then trouble will be forever averted. Hou Yi's Sun-shooting Bow also considered this, which is why it bestowed power upon you," the Artifact Spirit, with its black and white pupils fixed on Yuan Ming, answered.
Yuan Ming recalled the attitude of Hou Yi's Sun-shooting Bow towards him and suddenly felt a moment of clarity in his heart.
"What needs to be said has been said, maintaining the entrance of the Time Cave requires a substantial amount of Spiritual Power, which I will soon close. You must take care of yourselves hereafter," the Artifact Spirit said, its form gradually turning into light.
"Senior, please wait, I still have one favor to ask. Please hold on for a moment longer. I have some allies stranded outside; I will notify them to come here now, and you can close the entrance after they arrive," Yuan Ming thought quickly and called out urgently.
"Agreed," the Artifact Spirit gave Yuan Ming a glance, its form blurring into black and white spiritual lights, merging into the black and white sun above.
Knowing time was precious, Yuan Ming did not delay, turning to Xi Ying, about to urge her, but saw Xi Ying nodding directly.
"I know what you want to say. Don't worry, I'll protect you here. Do whatever you need to do," she said, glaring at Wulu with a hint of threat in her gaze.
Wulu, quite understanding, immediately turned and walked outside: "I'll guard outside the valley."
Seeing this, Yuan Ming took out the Silver Token, covering both himself and Xi Ying with it, and then entered the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
He quickly sat on the White Jade Lotus Platform and soon contacted Yun Jiuxiao, who was in the midst of fleeing.
At that moment, he was fleeing on the island with the White Scale Master and others. However, in their path of escape, numerous Green-Black Tree People were violently swinging their arms, launching a ferocious assault on them.
In midair, White Scale Master in his fluttering robe, held a black gourd, summoning thousands of dark sword lights from it, cutting through the vines and branches launched by the Tree People below. Not far off, Queen Ming Kong, holding a cerulean treasure mirror, summoned several avatars of spiritual water from the mirror, resisting the Tree People's attacks, while a strong man from the Water Ape Clan wielded a golden rod, grappling closely with the Tree People.
The three of them were barely maintaining the situation, unable to break free from the surrounding Tree People. As for Yun Jiuxiao and the other two, it goes without saying, possessing only Core Formation Cultivation, were it not for Queen Ming Kong and the others intentionally protecting them, they would have already been overwhelmed by the vast army of Tree People and left without a place to be buried.
Seeing this situation, Yuan Ming made a quick decision, directly activating the All Living Beings Dream Rune, drawing the Tree People around them into the illusion.
"Hurry to the peak's Time Cave Secret Realm and meet up with Divine Envoy Yuan Ming!" His voice also rang in everyone's ears at the same time.
Queen Ming Kong and the others, seeing the Tree People around them momentarily halt their attacks, were in a state of shock when suddenly they heard the voice of the Nether Moon God, thus coming to a realization.
Although the group didn't know what was happening on the island, they trusted that the Nether Moon God wouldn't harm them and immediately followed his instructions, running towards the peak.
On the other side, Old Man Hei Zhu and his companions, seeing this scene, briefly discussed before quickly following him.
However, as they approached the entrance of the Time Cave, they saw even more Tree People blocking the road, and among the Tree People were Yuan Wuji and others struggling in combat.
The Tree People on the peak were too numerous; Yuan Wuji and the others were blocked.
At this very moment, on Lank Island, aside from the three of Yuan Ming, all others were gathered in front of the Time Cave.
However, an endless number of Tree People were blocking their path, relentlessly attempting to slay them on the spot.
No sooner had Queen Ming Kong and the others arrived than a large number of Tree People surrounded them, plunging them into a predicament even more severe than before.
Soon, doubts and anger began to surface in their hearts; Queen Ming Kong and the others even began to suspect that the Nether Moon God had summoned them here to have them completely perish in this place.
However, just as this thought emerged in their minds, a terrifying and inexplicable Illusion Power descended from the sky, split into hundreds, and poured onto the Tree People.
In just an instant, the bodies of several hundred nearby Tree People stiffened, standing motionless, without exception, even the Level 4 Tree People.
Seeing this scene, everyone was stunned; Old Man Hei Zhu and the others gazed at Queen Ming Kong and the others in shock, suspecting that this terrifying Illusion Power was some hidden secret technique from one of them.
However, Queen Ming Kong and her companions understood that they simply did not possess such power.
The only one who could unleash such terrifying power was the Nether Moon God alone.He$lp us c!on%t$inu!e by r.e#adi$n*g at the sou#rc^e&: MV2^L*E+M&P%YR+.
"What are you staring at? Hurry into the light gate inside the cave!"
The voice of the Nether Moon God resounded once again by the ears of Queen Ming Kong and others, startling them. Not daring to linger, they pushed back the tree men whose momentum had greatly decreased and rushed into the Time Cave.
Seeing this, Yuan Wuji and others also came to their senses. While repelling the tree men, they too poured into the Time Cave.
Soon, everyone on the island had rushed into the light gate. Then, a flash of black and white light from the gate made it vanish into thin air right where it was.
In the dark space, an indifferent voice sounded once again, this time with a hint of surprise.
"Such impressive illusion power! Who exactly is it?"
Afterward, everything returned to silence once again.
The crowd entered the secret realm of the Time Cave, saw the gate disappear behind them instantly, and could not help but heave a sigh of relief, feeling like they had survived a catastrophe.
The crowd was immediately captivated by the situation before them, curiously looking around in all directions.
At that moment, a streak of light suddenly flew toward them and landed in front of everyone, revealing Wulu's figure.
"It's you, kid! You had us running around like fools earlier. Prepare to pay with your life!" said the Blood Realm Venerable, his eyes emitting a cold light filled with murderous intent.
"Hold on a moment, younger brother," Yuan Wuji said after sizing up Wulu, stopping the Blood Realm Venerable.
"Venerables, Fellow Daoist Yuan has urgent matters to discuss with you all. This affair relates to the lives and fortunes of everyone here. Please follow me and make sure not to be absent," Wulu said, ignoring the threats of the Blood Realm Venerable and bowing to everyone.
Hearing this, the crowd looked at each other, their eyes filled with wariness and confusion. The atmosphere was incredibly tense, leading to a deadlock.
The Blood Yan Island Master looked at Wulu but did not speak.
Wulu was not in a hurry; he just calmly looked at everyone, the corners of his mouth bearing a faint, almost imperceptible, smile.
"Lead the way," Yuan Wuji broke the silence and said.
Wulu nodded and then turned to lead the way, with Yuan Wuji and the members of the Tide-rider Alliance following behind him.
Seeing someone take the initiative, the rest of the crowd hesitated for a bit before following suit.
The space inside the secret realm of the Time Cave was not large, merely a hundred miles in radius, so it didn't take much time for everyone to reach a valley. They immediately saw Yuan Ming and Xi Ying sitting on a Jade Lotus.
