Yuan Ming surveyed the crowd, his attitude neither servile nor overbearing, "Thank you all for coming. Before discussing the main matter, perhaps some seniors are not aware of some of the mysteries here. Allow me to briefly introduce them first."
"Those things aren't urgent. First off, shouldn't we settle our previous accounts?" Yuan Wuji waved his hand and looked at Yuan Ming with interest, saying so.
"I, Yuan Ming, never regret the things I have done in coming to the Three Immortals Island to strive for treasure. If sirs wish to speak to me about grievances, I naturally accept, but might I be allowed to finish speaking first before we address other matters?" Yuan Ming stood up, bowed, and said.
"Humph, what can a Core Formation junior like you possibly say? It's just alarmist talk," sneered the Blood Realm Venerable from behind Yuan Wuji.
"Senior, you misunderstand. I simply mean to relay the original words of the host of this place, the Lank Chessboard Artifact Spirit senior. All the information was told to me by him, not something I knew beforehand," Yuan Ming said, without looking at the Blood Realm Venerable, in a calm and unhurried manner.
"The Lank Chessboard Artifact Spirit? Is that venerable truly here?" the Blood Yan Island Master suddenly exclaimed in delight.
Yuan Ming looked at him thoughtfully, slightly puzzled, and nodded, "Yes, I arrived here earlier than the rest, so the senior personally appeared and told me about an Ancient Undying Demon Tree on the island..."
He informed everyone about the existence, strength, and purpose of the Undead Demon Tree.
"... The Undead Demon Tree is extremely cunning. Every time the Three Immortals Island opens, it deliberately does so to attract cultivators to the island, then transforms them into puppets to increase its cultivation. Those tree demons you saw earlier are its subordinates, and according to the senior Artifact Spirit, in no more than thirty days, it will be able to break into this place and confront us directly. By then, all will be lost," Yuan Ming said.
Upon hearing this, everyone was shocked, except the Blood Yan Island Master who, upon hearing Yuan Ming's confirmation, was overcome with enthusiasm and paid no attention to what Yuan Ming said afterward.
He suddenly knelt down, kowtowing towards the sky and began speaking, "Descendant of Luo Yan, Luo Qi, following the ancestral command to enter the Time Cave, please allow the Artifact Spirit senior to show yourself."
No sooner had he finished speaking than everyone saw two beams of black and white spiritual light emerge from the sun in the sky, merging together and forming the figure of the Artifact Spirit.
"Descendant of Luo Yan, for what purpose have you come?" The eyes of the Artifact Spirit Kong, hollow and unruffled, simply posed the question.
The Blood Yan Island Master Luo Qi raised his head to see the figure of the Artifact Spirit, recognizing him as identical to the ancestor's portrait, and immediately took out a black and white chessboard, holding it above his head.
"It was commanded by the ancestors that any descendant who refines the Daluo Chessboard may ascend the island. Please, venerable Artifact Spirit, inspect it. Now that the chessboard is complete, I ask the senior to review it," Luo Qi said, staying on his knees, his head bowed respectfully.

chapters.title: Chapter 581 - 555 Each Retreats for Cultivation
chapters.content:
The Artifact Spirit waved his hand, and the black and white chessboard in Luo Qi's hands flew into his palm, his emotionless gaze sweeping over it, yet his expression was indecipherable.
"Not bad, come with me," suddenly, the Artifact Spirit put away the chessboard and spoke.
Luo Qi was overjoyed, hurriedly stood up, and immediately positioned himself beside the Artifact Spirit.
The bystanders observed the exchange between Luo Qi and the Artifact Spirit, showing varied expressions; seeing that the Artifact Spirit was about to leave, Old Man Hei Zhu's face tightened, and he pointed at Yuan Ming, calling out, "May I ask the senior, the Ancient Undying Demon Tree spoken of by this junior, is it true or false?"
"It is true."
Without turning back, the Artifact Spirit left just those words behind, his robe flaring as a flash of black and white spirit light enveloped him and Luo Qi, disappearing into the valley.
The faces of Old Man Hei Zhu and the two others instantly paled, all bearing a look of impending doom.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming immediately comforted, "Seniors need not despair like this; time flows differently here compared to the outside world, we still have thirty years to prepare."
"Hmph, thirty years? What can be achieved in such a short time? Even if we were to meditate to death, how could we cultivate to a level capable of contending with the Returning Void?" White Scale Master shook his head, skeptical.
"That's not necessarily true; after all, the spiritual energy here is abundant, and there are three places rich with Gathering Spirit Objects. If the seniors were to cultivate there, perhaps a breakthrough opportunity could be found," Yuan Ming continued to persuade.
Upon hearing this, everyone marginally lifted their spirits; and just then, among the group, the Blood Realm Venerable suddenly laughed, saying:
"Junior, that tree behind you, is it one of the Gathering Spirit Objects you mentioned? It does look promising; this place will be ours, you should go cultivate somewhere else."
No sooner had the Blood Realm Venerable spoken than he was about to approach, but Xi Ying, who had been silently by Yuan Ming's side, suddenly looked up and glanced at the Blood Realm Venerable.
The Blood Realm Venerable's expression froze, his eyes losing much of their luster, clearly having fallen into an illusion.
At the same time, next to Xi Ying, Guoguo roared, his body quickly enlarging and, in the blink of an eye, he transformed into a giant white beast, with the head of a lion and the body of a tiger, a winding horn on its head, dark hairs growing on its feet, and a fluffy long tail like clouds and mist, the tip tinged with specks of ink.
"Bai Ze?" the purple-haired beauty exclaimed.
Yuan Ming's body also instantly lit up with a surge of blood light, nearly dyeing the valley a bright red, as two distinctly different yet subtly connected Nascent Soul auras suddenly erupted from him, making everyone's heart shudder.
Wulu also at the same moment, disappeared under the cover of the Nascent Soul Divine Senses and could no longer be traced.
"Everyone, with such a formidable enemy before us, it is best to avoid conflict. There are two more Gathering Spirit sites within the secret realm, each as valuable as this one; would Senior Yuan be interested in seeing them?" Yuan Ming looked at Yuan Wuji and smiled.
Yuan Wuji looked at Yuan Ming, his expression seemingly unchanged.
"Blood Realm is impulsive; a small punishment is fine, but do not overdo it," he said, tilting his head slowly.
Yuan Ming gave a slight smile and nodded at Xi Ying.
Xi Ying nodded, lifted the Illusion Technique, and the Blood Realm Venerable staggered, his face pale as he struggled out of the illusion; but his Nascent Soul was damaged, and his aura was somewhat unstable.
Seeing this, Yuan Wuji said nothing more, looked once more towards Yuan Ming, then turned and led the Tide-rider Alliance away.
"To the west, there is a Bishui Lake, in the middle of which on a small island lies a Gathering Spirit Spring, and to the east, there is a Twin Peaks, atop which sits a Gathering Spirit Stone; seniors may meditate and cultivate at these places, and if anything arises, it would be convenient to contact each other," Yuan Ming cautioned.
Yuan Wuji continued walking, soon disappearing with his followers beyond the valley.
"Brother, this junior has insulted us too much, how can we let him off!" the Blood Realm Venerable said immediately after leaving the valley.
"Their strength is not to be underestimated, and clashing with them is not an easy task, not to mention the Undying Demon Tree lurking outside. If we really killed them, we would only lose a helping hand later," the purple-haired beauty advised.
Lan Xiao is right; it's just one Gathering Spirit site; there's no need for a huge fight," Yuan Wuji agreed with the purple-haired beauty.
"So we just let this go?" the Blood Realm Venerable was somewhat unwilling.
"I have my plans," Yuan Wuji shook his head.
In the valley, with the strongest among them, Yuan Wuji, and others unwilling to conflict with Yuan Ming, no one else dared to make a move. Old Man Hei Zhu and his companions left first, and knowing Yuan Ming's status as a Divine Envoy, Queen Ming Kong and her companions hesitated, not knowing what to say. After hearing from Yuan Ming to first find places to cultivate while they awaited the will of the Nether Moon God, they also turned to leave.
After everyone had left, Wulu reappeared, "Brother Yuan, the Blood Yan Island Master has called me to help refine the Daluo Chessboard; I might have to say goodbye to you for now."ThefullserieslivesonMyVirtualLibraryEmpire(*).
Yuan Ming nodded and asked curiously, "Speaking of which, Brother Wu Lu, what exactly is your relationship with Luo Qi?"
"Actually, it's nothing much. Initially, on my way to the East Sea, I accidentally obtained a Blood Puppet Armor. Out of curiosity, I used it once and ended up being entangled by the Blood Puppet Armor. To solve this, I sought help far and wide, and eventually turned to Luo Qi, the Blood Yan Island Master. He had a secret technique that could save my life, but in exchange, I had to help him obtain the Lank Chessboard," Wu Lu sighed, speaking somewhat helplessly.
"I see, then I won't stop you, Brother Wu Lu. However, you have helped me quite a bit, so if there's anything you need, just call on me. I will help with all my might," Yuan Ming nodded and said earnestly.
"Thank you." Wu Lu clasped his hands together, and then bowed towards the sky. A black and white light suddenly descended from the heavens, wrapping around his body and carrying him away.
After sending off Wu Lu, Yuan Ming pondered for a moment and realized there was still one minor matter he hadn't dealt with.
He steadied his mind, waved his hand, and took out the frozen statues of Luu Changfeng and Elder Qi from the Shura Blood Devouring Map, and extended his Divine Sense to inspect their corpses.
He intended to see if he could convert these two Blood God Puppets for his own use, but as soon as he probed, he discovered that Luu Changfeng's Nascent Soul was sealed by another secret technique, which would self-destruct upon being unsealed.
This kind of method was not something used in making Blood God Puppets, but rather seemed like a secretive method used by certain organizations to prevent leaking of secrets.
Yuan Ming instantly became curious and, after hesitating for a moment, he took out the Empty Gloves, channeled his Soul Power, and forcibly broke the seal. He managed to review Luu Changfeng's memories just before his Nascent Soul was completely destroyed.
The seal was broken, and Luu Changfeng's Divine Soul rapidly deteriorated and vanished, with only a tenth of the memories remaining, retaining only those contents he remembered most vividly for a moment.
Among these memory fragments, three were the clearest.
One was the scene where he fought against Yuan Wuji and others before he died; the other two were scenes from when he made progress in practicing the Planting Beans into Soldiers and the Golden Sunflower Beast Taming Technique.
Yuan Ming was delighted, and he quickly focused on the memories of him practicing the secret techniques, silently memorizing the techniques he practiced.
Unfortunately, Luu Changfeng's Nascent Soul deteriorated too quickly, and ultimately, Yuan Ming was only able to completely memorize the contents of the Golden Sunflower Beast Taming Technique. When he tried to look at the Planting Beans into Soldiers Technique, Luu Changfeng's Nascent Soul had already completely deteriorated and dissipated into the cosmos.
Yuan Ming sighed, but his joy still outweighed his disappointment. Then, he tossed Luu Changfeng's corpse, now devoid of a Nascent Soul, into the Shura Blood Devouring Map, completely refining it into Qi.
Just as he broke the seal on the Nascent Soul, among the group from the Tide-rider Alliance who had already reached Bishui Lake, a purple-haired beauty suddenly groaned.
"The seal inside Luu Changfeng's body has been broken," she said in a low voice, frowning.
"Damn it, it must be that Core Formation junior's doing. We don't want to fight him, yet he thinks we're scared. By provoking us this way, he truly doesn't see us as a threat! Brother, let me go. He clearly isn't prepared right now, even if we don't kill him, we should at least teach him a lesson!" Blood Realm Venerable's face flashed with anger, and he immediately turned, taking a white-browed young man towards the direction of the valley.
However, Yuan Wuji just shook his head, "Forget it, don't go. I haven't finished refining my Blood God's Son yet, let's endure it for now. In three to five years, we can settle scores with him then."
As the elder brother spoke, even if the Blood Realm Venerable was reluctant, he could only nod in agreement and turn back.
In the valley, Yuan Ming and Xi Ying ensured that everyone else had left the area, then raised a soundproofing shield to start discussing their next steps in cultivation.
"My cultivation has already reached the peak of the late stage of Core Formation, and it is meaningless to continue to seclude myself and cultivate mana. With thirty years to use, I plan to practice Ju Mang Spirit Technique to enhance my aptitude and prepare for breaking through to the Nascent Soul Stage," said Xi Ying.
"That's good. But this secret realm with its crowd and multiple eyes is hardly a stable place to practice Ju Mang Spirit Technique," Yuan Ming initially nodded and then thought of something and cautioned.
"Of course not here. I plan to transplant this Gathering Spirit Tree to the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space and cultivate the Ju Mang Spirit Technique there," Xi Ying shook her head and explained.
"Oh, you have a way?" Yuan Ming had long thought of transplanting one or two Gathering Spirit Objects into the Stealing Heaven Tripod to enhance the spiritual energy there, so he readily agreed.
"Just do as I say," Xi Ying winked and smiled.
The two immediately got to work. Transplanting Gathering Spirit Objects was not easy, and Xi Ying had Yuan Ming act as protector, setting up a fairly complex Array around the Gathering Spirit Tree to temporarily sever its connection with the local Spirit Vein. Only then did they carefully dig it out and transport it to the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space.
The process of digging out the Gathering Spirit Tree was rather complicated, but planting it was very simple.
Yuan Ming chose a vacant spot near the altar and planted the tree there.
No sooner had the tree been planted than its roots took hold deep underground, and streams of spiritual light began to spread from the roots, coursing into the void.
Moments later, streams of nature's spiritual energy were drawn over by the Gathering Spirit Tree and then diffused from the tree, enriching the spiritual energy of the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space at a rate visible to the naked eye.
"Such a gathering effect, truly worthy of the highest grade of Gathering Spirit Objects!" Yuan Ming exclaimed with joy.

chapters.title: Chapter 582 - 556 The Solution
chapters.content:
Since the Gathering Spirit Tree was transplanted into the Stealing Heaven Tripod, Yuan Ming also prepared to cultivate within it, after all, though he had lured Yuan Wuji and others to other places, one couldn't guarantee that someone wouldn't get any ideas, which would lead to troublesome matters later.
Thus, Yuan Ming took the Stealing Heaven Tripod and quietly left the valley, arriving at a fairly large lake.
He hid the Stealing Heaven Tripod at the bottom of the lake and captured a low-level fish demon beast from the lake, transformed and planted a Soul Descent Rune in it, ordering it to guard near the tripod, before entering the tripod himself.
At this time, Xi Ying had begun the preparations for cultivating the Ju Mang Spirit Technique, clearing a piece of land within the Stealing Heaven Tripod, covering it with various spirit soils, and irrigating it with specially made spirit water - clearly, she had done much homework for the cultivation of this technique and was now at ease.
Xi Ying seemed to have quite the knack for nurturing spirit plants, employing several profound secret techniques one after the other, and quickly cultivated a spirit field nearly identical to the one in the Shura Palace's Medicine Garden.
She took out a five-colored seed, indeed the Spiritual Seed of the Five Elements Creation Tree, buried it in the spirit field, and nurtured it with the Ju Mang Spirit Technique.
Meanwhile, Yuan Ming was not idle either. He sat cross-legged on the other side of the altar, closed his eyes and began to cultivate, when he suddenly became aware of some movement in the Storage Ring. His Divine Sense delved into it, and his face showed a look of surprise.
The source of the disturbance was the half of the Black Demon Tree he had previously put away. It seemed to have life once again, wildly waving its branches and causing a ruckus inside the Storage Bag.
Yuan Ming hastily took out the Black Demon Tree, and upon contacting the rich Spiritual Energy inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod, every branch of the Black Demon Tree showed numerous pores, greedily devouring nature's spiritual energy and making hissing sounds as they moved more intensely.
He couldn't help but sigh inwardly; this Black Demon Tree was truly terrifying, that it could still do this even after being cut from its roots.
Though the tree was magical, it was related to the Undead Tree Demon and couldn't be kept at all costs.
Yuan Ming threw the Black Demon Tree into the Spiritual Beast Bag where Hua Zhi was, and its vines immediately wrapped around it, rooting into the Black Demon Tree.
It seemed the Black Demon Tree sensed danger and immediately counterattacked. However, it had been previously heavily injured by the Golden Crow Divine Arrow, and what little strength it had just recovered was no match for Hua Zhi. After a brief struggle, it was quickly bound up by countless vines.
Vines pierced into the demon tree, and the once full trunk quickly shriveled up, transforming into decayed wood, and in the end, it turned to dust and smoke.
After absorbing the Black Demon Tree, Hua Zhi's presence grew even more vibrant, and it seemed that its breakthrough was just around the corner.
Yuan Ming was quite pleased with this, ready to withdraw his Divine Sense, but then he suddenly stopped and performed a hand gesture to beckon something forth.
A fist-sized black object flew out from the dust where the demon tree disintegrated, appearing to be a seed.
"Could this be the seed of the Black Demon Tree? It wasn't drained by Hua Zhi, how odd," Yuan Ming caught the seed and observed it closely.
He could sense that this black seed still contained a fair amount of vitality.
At that moment, the black seed suddenly burst forth with a cloud of black gas, and within the mist, an old and ferocious face appeared, clearly the face of the Black Demon Tree.
"What is this?" Yuan Ming exclaimed, opened his mouth and spat out a blast of Soul Destroying Sword Energy, without any hesitation, he slashed at the ferocious face within the black gas.
However, as the sword struck, the face within the black gas split into two, and then it blinked into Yuan Ming's body, and the seed also vanished, reappearing within his Dantian.
Reader support at * made this translation possible.
Several black roots sprouted from the seed and took root there.
Only then did Yuan Ming react, but it was already a step too late. The Mana in his Dantian was flowing uncontrollably, quickly being absorbed by the black seed.
Not just Mana, the abundant Qi-Blood within Yuan Ming's body was also being rapidly drained.
With the nourishment of Yuan Ming's Mana and Qi-Blood, the black gas around the seed became several times more concentrated. The ferocious face that had just appeared showed a bloodthirsty and ecstatic expression.
Countless roots continued to sprout from the seed, taking root in other parts of Yuan Ming's body, devouring his Qi-Blood even more aggressively.
Yuan Ming was a mix of shock and anger in his heart. The Soul Sword in his Dantian fired out with a roar, fiercely striking the black seed.
With a "clang," the black seed remained unscathed, while the Soul Sword was knocked back.
His Dantian ached sharply, and he spurted out a mouthful of fresh blood.
"What's going on? It's so hard!" Yuan Ming frowned deeply, not daring to swing his sword at the black seed again, instead he activated the Curse Rune of the Soul Sword.
An invisible curse seeped into the black seed. The spirit light on the seed dimmed instantly, and the ferocious face showed a pained expression, slowing down the rate at which it was devouring Yuan Ming's Mana and Qi-Blood significantly.
A glimmer appeared in Yuan Ming's eyes; the black seed contained some sort of consciousness, and the Curse Rune had proven to be effective.
He didn't dare to relax, continuing to activate the Curse Rune of the Soul Sword. All the Soul Crows in his Sea of Consciousness flew out, arriving at the Dantian.
The twelve Soul Crows opened their mouths and emitted waves of Crow's Call Waves, engulfing the black seed. The devouring force of the black seed weakened once more, yet it still did not stop draining his Mana and Qi-Blood.
Yuan Ming had finally caught his breath at this point, his hands formed a gesture, and two streams of gold and black spirit light shot out from his palms, entering the black seed.
This was the complete Golden Sunflower Beast Taming Technique he had just mastered; since the black seed possessed its own consciousness, the Beast Taming Technique should also have an effect.
Yuan Ming didn't stop; a crack pierced through the blood light of the Shura Blood Devouring Map in the spleen area.
A yellow light shot out from the crack, entered the Dantian, and coiled around the black seed.
The Sandman Poison entrenched in the spleen traveled along the yellow light, invading the black seed.
Yuan Ming, as if facing a formidable enemy, had exhausted all the means at his disposal.
Under such consecutive attacks, the black aura enveloping the black seed was almost dispersed.
However, this seed was incredibly resilient, firmly guarding the last wisp of black air; if Yuan Ming's assault even slightly faltered, the black seed would immediately counterattack.
Time passed by, and soon half an hour had passed.
Yuan Ming's forehead was covered in sweat, both his mana and Soul Power were running low, yet the black seed remained intact, its counterattacks growing fiercer, with more roots appearing, one of which had even taken root near the Sea of Consciousness.
Even the Soul Power in his Sea of Consciousness was drawn out, converging towards the black seed.
Yuan Ming's heart chilled, he dared not hold back any longer, took out a green lotus seed and swallowed it, then his body shot out and landed on the White Jade Lotus Platform at the altar, and sat down on it.
Boom!
Pure Will Power surged from within the White Jade Lotus Platform, Yuan Ming's Soul Power instantly recovered and surged to a level infinitely close to that of Sleeping Witch.
The twelve soul crows grew significantly in size, and the Crow's Call Waves they emitted thickened several-fold.
As the lotus seed dissolved, his mana quickly restored, and both the power of the Soul Destroying Sword's Curse Runes and the Golden Sunflower Beast Taming Technique increased greatly once again pushing down the black seed.
However, the black seed was too obstinate. No matter how fiercely it was assaulted by the Crow's Call Waves and Curse Runes, it held onto its last line of defense, unable to be completely destroyed, and kept draining Yuan Ming's Qi-Blood and mana, waiting for him to exhaust his strength.
"How could this black seed be so troublesome, what is its origin?" Yuan Ming's face looked ugly as he muttered to himself.
"What's wrong, what happened?" Xi Ying had already noticed something unusual on Yuan Ming's side, halted what she was doing, and flew towards Yuan Ming while asking.
Yuan Ming didn't conceal anything and while continuing to cast spells to suppress the black seed's draining, he quickly told Xi Ying about the origin of the black seed and the recent developments.
"A Black Demon Tree? Let me see…" Xi Ying's face showed a look of surprise, she reached out and pointed towards Yuan Ming.
A five-colored light flashed by and disappeared into Yuan Ming's Dantian, enveloping the black seed.
The black seed seemed to devour everything, and the five-colored light was rapidly consumed.
Xi Ying seemed to have anticipated this, her hands twirling like wheels, a continuous stream of five-colored light shot towards Yuan Ming ceaselessly for a quarter of an hour before stopping.
"This black seed is related to the Undying Tree you mentioned before, and it is even closer to the essence of the Undying Tree than those Green Black Demon Trees transformed by the tree men outside. That's why its vitality is so tenacious. No matter how frantically you attack, you cannot shake it," Xi Ying said, her chest heaving slightly, seemingly at great expenditure, as she spoke.
Yuan Ming's heart sank; he had long had a premonition about this. Indeed this Black Demon Tree was also an Undying Tree, no wonder it was so difficult to deal with.
"However, you shouldn't worry too much; I already have a solution in mind," Xi Ying suddenly said with a smile.
"What is it?" Yuan Ming asked, delighted.
At this point, he had exhausted all his techniques. If someone else had said this, he might have doubted them, but not with Xi Ying.
"You're already familiar with the technique, the Ju Mang Spirit Technique," Xi Ying continued.
"The Ju Mang Spirit Technique! You mean to let me use the Ju Mang Spirit Technique to refine the black seed into my Lifebound Spirit Plant? This indeed could be a solution, but refining a Lifebound Spirit Plant requires the Spirit Roots of both parties to be completely identical. Could it be that the black seed possesses the Four Spirit Roots lacking Earth of the Five Elements?" Yuan Ming, taken aback, asked.
"Actually, the Undying Tree is the spirit wood closest to the Ancestor of Ten Thousand Trees—the World Tree and, like the World Tree, the Undying Tree has Gold, Wood, Water, Fire, Earth, Yin, and Yang Seven Spirit Roots. The black seed is the same," Xi Ying revealed.
"Seven Spirit Roots! Then there's even less of a chance that I and the black seed could be a match," Yuan Ming shook his head.
"On the contrary, you match perfectly," Xi Ying said with a hint of a smile.
Yuan Ming stood still, slightly puzzled.
"You originally had Gold, Wood, Water, and Fire Four Spirit Roots. Because of the Taiyin Refining Spleen Technique, your spleen contains an abundance of dense Earth Attribute Spiritual Power, which is akin to having an Earth Spirit Root. Moreover, you practice Soul Cultivation and Body Cultivation. Soul Cultivation is a Pure Yin Attribute technique, and your Lifebound Magical Treasure, the Soul Destroying Sword, is a Pure Yin Magical Treasure. When it comes to sensing Yin Spiritual Power, you are even more sensitive than cultivators with the Yin Spiritual Root," Xi Ying explained with conviction.
"Then what about the Yang Spiritual Root? I've not cultivated any Yang Attribute techniques or Yang Attribute magical treasures," Yuan Ming nodded thoughtfully and replied.
"No, you have cultivated a Yang Attribute technique, and it's quite advanced," Xi Ying shook her head and said.

chapters.title: Chapter 583 - 557: Harmonizing the Seven Spirit Roots
chapters.content:
"I practiced a Yang attribute cultivation technique? How come I don't know about that?" Yuan Ming said, greatly surprised.
"You really are ignorant. Aren't all body cultivation techniques Yang attribute techniques?" Xi Ying said with a smile.
"Is that so?" Yuan Ming was startled.
"You heard right, body cultivation fundamentally pursues the path of utmost Yang and rigidity, and naturally belongs to the Yang attribute," Xi Ying explained.
Yuan Ming fell silent, carefully recalling the cultivation process and external manifestations of the Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill, which indeed followed a path of Yang and rigidity.
"The Great Thousand World possesses the origin powers of metal, wood, water, fire, earth, Yin, and Yang. Magic practitioners mainly cultivate the Five Elements Spiritual Power of metal, wood, water, fire, and earth, while body and soul cultivators correspond to the Yin and Yang powers. Yin power primarily stems from the moon, while Yang power comes from the sun. Your body cultivation realm is not yet profound enough. Only by reaching the Tongqiao Body can you truly understand the essence of body cultivation, channel the Power of the Sun into your body, and experience a qualitative leap in your physical body," Xi Ying explained earnestly.
"So that's how it is," Yuan Ming suddenly understood.
Originally, when he was hiding in Xiansha City for cultivation, Vajra didn't want to stay underground but instead went to train hardship in the Black Wind Desert. That was the reason.
And the body of the Shura Master emitted a blood light that was exceedingly scorching, almost like a blood-red sun.
"Soul cultivation is the same. Only when you cultivate to the Sleep Witch Realm will you be able to comprehend the true intent of the Moonlight Technique," Xi Ying added.
Yuan Ming slowly nodded. Xi Ying's explanation deepened his understanding of body and soul cultivation by a layer.
"Since you cultivate both soul and body, and in addition to the Taiyin Refining Spleen Technique, along with the Innate Four Spirit Roots, though there's an element of ingenuity, you've also assembled the Seven Spirit Roots, perfectly matching with the Undying Tree," Xi Ying said.
"If that's what you say, then I will give it a try," Yuan Ming said, quite excited.
"This matter, though a calamity for you, is also a great opportunity. The mystery of the Undying Tree even surpasses that of the Five Elements Creation Tree. If you can refine it into your lifebound spirit plant, it will not only solve the problem of inferior spirit roots but also bring immeasurable benefits to your future growth," Xi Ying stated gravely.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming was very moved. He left the White Jade Lotus Platform, closed his eyes briefly for breathing control, then started to operate the Ju Mang Spirit Technique.
He had previously been very keen on the effects of the Ju Mang Spirit Technique, had studied it secretly for a long time, and had already become proficient enough to cultivate at any time.
Yuan Ming's mana and soul power operated in an unusual manner, eventually permeating into the black seed.
The Ju Mang Spirit Technique and the Beast Taming Technique were quite similar, both involving the appropriation of external objects for one's own use, but whereas the Beast Taming Technique forcefully subdues demon beasts for use, the Ju Mang Spirit Technique does so in a much gentler manner, taming spirit plants.
The black seed was from the Undying Tree, bearing a ferocious and tenacious will. Despite the gentler approach of the Ju Mang Spirit Technique, it still faced significant resistance from the black seed.
Yuan Ming grappled with the black seed for a long time, well aware of its tenacious will, and was not surprised, continuously operating the Ju Mang Spirit Technique.
The Soul Extinguishing Sword, Crow Attack, Sandman Poison did not stop either.
The essence of the Ju Mang Spirit Technique lies in taming, but the spirit of the black seed was stubbornly recalcitrant and a mere soft approach might not be very effective, a bit of force was also necessary.
Time passed slowly, and three days went by in the blink of an eye.
The will of the black seed weakened somewhat, but its resistive attitude did not diminish at all.
"Very well! You really think I have no way to deal with you!" Yuan Ming roared in anger, once again sitting cross-legged on the White Jade Lotus Platform.
His soul power surged once again, and the powers of the Soul Extinguishing Sword, Crow's Call Wave, and even the Ju Mang Spirit Technique, all significantly increased, relentlessly bombarding the will of the black seed.
This time, Yuan Ming was determined. He summoned the All Living Beings Dream Rune, as well as ghost slaves like the Heavenly Ghost Wanderer who had the ability to attack the divine soul.
The illusion power of the All Living Beings Dream Rune, as well as the attacks from the ghost slaves like the Heavenly Ghost Wanderer, also infiltrated the black seed.
Moreover, Yuan Ming also channeled the gathered Desire Power, not using the Heart Cleansing Technique to refine it, but directly transmitted countless chaotic thoughts into the black seed.
However, the will within the black seed was terrifyingly tenacious. Facing such an onslaught, it still managed to hold off the attacks.
Yuan Ming was secretly shocked. If it were him, he wouldn't have been able to withstand so many attacks either; the Undying Tree truly was an extraordinary object.
Nevertheless, he did not back down and continued to maintain various attacks.
Time passed bit by bit, and a month flew by in a flash.
Yuan Ming sat cross-legged on the White Jade Lotus Platform, deploying various divine skills and launching attacks at the black seed.
At this point, his body was covered in red sores, exactly the result of consuming the Red Spirit Peach that produced fire poison.
The tenacity of the will within the black seed far exceeded his expectations, remaining unyielded even after a whole month had passed.
During this month, Yuan Ming's soul power was in peak condition thanks to the supplement of Desire Power, but his mana was not sustained.
He had used up all the recovery lotus seeds on his body, unable to continuously support his mana, so he resorted to consuming the Red Spirit Peach to persist, accumulating a large amount of fire poison in his body, resulting in a body full of poison sores.
Yuan Ming was not worried, knowing that with the Cold Moon Ring, Hua Zhi, Xi Ying, and others around, the poison sores definitely had a solution.
His efforts over the past month had not been in vain, facing the relentless bombardment of attacks, the will of the Black Seed was already on the verge of collapse.
Moreover, the continuous casting for over a month, although arduous, had brought unexpected gains.
The All Living Beings' Dream Rune was now floating above Yuan Ming's head, radiating brilliant light, as a shower of dream-like white light fell from it, sinking into the Black Seed.
The All Living Beings' Dream Rune would cast illusions indiscriminately against friend and foe alike. Previously, Yuan Ming could only control this rune while simultaneously preventing its influence on himself, unable to unleash the full power of the All Living Beings' Dream Rune.
Over the past month, he had been relentlessly invoking the All Living Beings' Dream Rune day and night, wavering between being subjected to illusions and regaining clarity. Unbeknownst to him, his skill in illusions had greatly improved, and the Dream Butterfly Illusion Technique had reached the Illusion Dream Realm, allowing him to control the All Living Beings' Dream Rune relatively smoothly.
The white light of the All Living Beings' Dream Rune, mixed with other attacks, blanketed the Black Seed completely for another two days.
The Black Seed finally could not withstand it anymore, conveying a willingness to be recycled.
Yuan Ming breathed a sigh of relief, operated the Ju Mang Spirit Technique, and his mana and soul power permeated into the Black Seed.
While the Black Seed was somewhat reluctant, it still released a peculiar spiritual power that contained seven different types of spiritual powers.
"The Black Seed does indeed contain the Seven Spirit Roots." Yuan Ming thought to himself as he cycled the mana in his body, the Earth Attribute mana of the Taiyin Refining Spleen Technique, soul power, and Qi-Blood power intertwined with the seven types of spiritual power from the Black Seed, attempting to connect them together.
This step was crucial as the spirit roots of both parties needed to fully integrate before proceeding to the next step of cultivation.
Yuan Ming had gathered the Seven Spirit Roots, just like the Black Seed, and did not take much effort for the two to completely merge together.
"Indeed, it is possible, the Ju Mang Spirit Technique is successful indeed!" He felt a great joy in his heart and continued to operate the Ju Mang Spirit Technique.The authentic version is on *.
The Black Seed was already tamed by him, and the matching of spirit root attributes was also smoothly completed. The subsequent cultivation went very smoothly, as his mana, soul power, and Qi-Blood slowly merged with the Black Seed.
Yuan Ming breathed a sigh of relief, temporarily stopped operating the Ju Mang Spirit Technique, and prepared to deal with the fire sores on his body.
But at that moment, the Black Seed grew more roots that pierced into the fire sores on Yuan's body.
The numerous fire sores quickly shrunk and soon disappeared completely.
Yuan Ming wore a look of joy, as the Black Seed could actually help him resolve the fire poison.
Not only the fire poison, but the sandman poison in his spleen also weakened a lot.
With no more worries, Yuan Ming continued to operate the Ju Mang Spirit Technique, his brows quickly raising.
Compared to mana and soul power, the Black Seed seemed to favor the Qi-Blood power more. The black roots embedded themselves throughout his body, and had he not tamed it already, the black roots would have almost drained all his Qi-Blood.
"What a sinister demon tree." Yuan Ming murmured to himself, drawing some Qi-Blood power from the Shura Blood Devouring Map to feed the Black Seed.
The vitality of the Black Seed suddenly became very active, and its surface cracked with a "crack", sprouting a black bud.
Yuan Ming viewed this with surprise, as the Black Seed had just absorbed a bit of Qi-Blood power and had already started to sprout?
After a brief moment of thought, he continued to draw Qi-Blood power from the Shura Blood Devouring Map to supply the Black Seed.
Time flew by, and in the blink of an eye, a year had passed.
Yuan Ming sat cross-legged on the altar, his skin showing bark-like patterns, his hair long and wild like countless roots, and even his fingers had grown black leaves; he looked much like the Tree Man he had seen before.
Suddenly, he opened his eyes, spread his fingers, and his arm skin completely turned dark, transforming into a tree branch that grew several meters in length upon meeting the wind, piercing into a lying Green Wolf demon beast beneath the altar.
The corpse of the Green Wolf demon beast quickly withered, all its essence blood drained and flowing into Yuan Ming's Dantian through the black branches.
The Black Seed in his Dantian had undergone a complete transformation, turning into a small black tree.
The small black tree absorbed the blood of the Green Wolf demon beast, its branches waving as if quite pleased.
"This Undying Tree is growing really fast; in just a year, it has reached such a stage, the Ju Mang Spirit Technique probably counts as reaching the First Level now," Yuan Ming muttered to himself.

chapters.title: Chapter 584 - 584: 558
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming withdrew his gaze and looked at his own arm that had turned into a tree branch, sighing as his shoulders slightly moved.
The branches that his arms had turned into quickly shrank and soon reverted back to the shape of arms.
Compared to Xi Ying's orthodox cultivation, his Ju Mang Spirit Technique encountered quite a few problems from the very beginning, as it didn't take root outside for nurturing but instead in his Dantian.
Now that the seed had grown into a small tree, it still took root in his Dantian, turning him into a being that was half-human, half-tree.
However, this wasn't entirely a bad thing. The Undying Tree and Yuan Ming's body had completely grown together, their connection much closer than that of ordinary Ju Mang Spirit Technique cultivators. The astonishing vitality of the Undying Tree flowed within his body, and the Sandman Poison in his spleen had long been neutralized.
The tempering of the Spirit Root was also better than cultivating a Spirit Plant externally.
Although the Ju Mang Spirit Technique had only completed the First Level, Yuan Ming's Spirit Root had already been considerably enhanced, and the speed at which he refined nature's spiritual energy was now no less than that of someone with three spirit roots.
Yan Sijing on the other side had not yet finished refining the elixir, so for more than a year, Yuan Ming relied solely on meditation and practice for cultivation.
With the Gathering Spirit Tree displaying its effect, the spiritual energy within the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space became even denser, surpassing any of the cultivation sacred lands he had stayed in before by quite a bit. He set up the Yimu Gathering Spirit Array he had obtained at the auction to enhance the concentration of spiritual energy.
After a year of arduous cultivation, his mana had increased significantly, steadily moving toward the Late-stage Core Formation.
Having learned the true intent of Body Cultivation from Xi Ying, in order to balance the Spirit Root and prevent problems with the Ju Mang Spirit Technique, Yuan Ming hadn't neglected his Body Cultivation exercises.
With the help of ample Blood Origin Power, his Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill had also improved a lot, and he was not far from achieving the Innate Body.
As for Soul Cultivation, the progress was minor.
It wasn't due to Yuan Ming's negligence; rather, this Time Cave Secret Realm cut off most of the Desire Power from the outside world, with only a tiny fraction being able to penetrate inside and not playing a significant role.
Fortunately, Yuan Ming had thought of this issue in time and had brought Yun Jiuxiao, Bing Xin, and White Scale Master into the Time Cave before.
Bing Xin and Yun Jiuxiao prayed daily, providing Desire Power.
However, White Scale Master and the others were becoming increasingly perfunctory towards their prayers to the Lord Nether Moon God, worshipping sporadically and not earnest in attitude, which resulted in not much Desire Power being produced.
"These Nascent Soul cultivators are all so proud, it seems necessary to suppress them and fully subdue them," Yuan Ming thought to himself. He sat down on the White Jade Lotus Platform, and his Divine Sense descended along Yun Jiuxiao's Desire Power anchor point.
In the secret realm within a pair of twin peaks, White Scale Master, Queen Ming Kong, and a stout man from the Water Ape Clan had each established a Cave Mansion for cultivation.
Underneath the twin peaks lay a human-head-sized piece of blue jade, drawing spiritual energy from all directions, making the spiritual energy of the Twin Peaks much denser than other places.
"This blue jade is the Gathering Spirit Stone…" Yuan Ming's expression stirred slightly.
Yun Jiuxiao and Bing Xin were also there, with the Cave Mansions they opened up situated in a corner of the Twin Peaks, far from the Gathering Spirit Stone.
Yuan Ming observed the Gathering Spirit Stone for a moment with his Divine Sense and quickly moved on, enveloping White Scale Master.
White Scale Master was forming hand seals, practicing a secret technique of the Snake-man Clan when the vast cover of Divine Sense descended, startling him immediately.
"Lord Nether Moon God!"
"Hmm, you still remember there's a Lord Nether Moon God? Have you been conducting the promised prayers four times a day recently?" Yuan Ming said slowly.
"This…" White Scale Master's face stiffened.
Initially very wary of the Nether Moon God, White Scale Master's concerns declined after the drastic changes on Lank Immortal Island. They escaped into the Time Cave, but the Nether Moon God had not shown up at all, nor was there any sign of activity.
After consulting privately with Queen Ming Kong and the stout man from the Water Ape Clan, White Scale Master concluded that the Lord Nether Moon God most likely did not enter the Time Cave, so they became lax in their prayers. Little did they know that the Nether Moon God would come looking for them today!
"Lord Nether Moon God, please forgive me. It's not that I wasn't diligent, but recent affairs have been so numerous that I neglected my prayers…" White Scale Master hurriedly said.This tеxt wаs асquirеd frоm М|V|L0ЕМРYR.
"Is that so?" Yuan Ming sneered coldly, his powerful Divine Soul casting Illusion Techniques and invoking the help of the All Living Beings' Dream Rune.
A tremendous Illusion Power descended from the sky, forcibly tearing through White Scale Master's Sea of Consciousness defenses and invading his Divine Soul.
Yuan Ming was capable of plunging White Scale Master into an illusion with the aid of Desire Power while casting illusions before, and now that his Dream Butterfly Illusion Technique had significantly advanced and he had begun to grasp the All Living Beings' Dream Rune, his Illusion Technique power had greatly increased. White Scale Master immediately fell into an illusion.
He found himself in a white space, his body bound by thick chains, with countless blades shooting from the void, piercing every inch of his body.
"Ahh…" White Scale Master let out a wretched scream.
The blade attacks did not stop, with waves of blades coming from all directions, piercing White Scale Master's body time and again without giving him a moment to breathe.
The flow of time within the white space was peculiarly strange, as if it had halted altogether, making the pain of thousands of blades piercing the body feel eternal and leading to despair.
The Dream Butterfly Illusion Technique had reached the Illusion Dream Realm level and could now control the flow of time within the Illusion Space. A moment outside could lead to days passing inside the Illusion Space, and no matter how steadfast one's will, it could not withstand the continuous torment.
White Scale Master was just like that, enduring a day and a night before his will finally completely collapsed.
However, at that moment, his vision blurred, and his consciousness returned to his physical body.
White Scale Master trembled uncontrollably, his whole body covered in cold sweat, gasping for breath, and it took a while for his collapsed consciousness to recover.
"I thank Lord Nether Moon God for your mercy…" At this moment, White Scale Master finally understood the might of the Nether Moon God's divine skills—it would take almost no effort for the deity to kill him.
"From now on, pray five times a day without any negligence, or else I won't be as lenient as I was today!" Yuan Ming's voice was icy cold.
"Yes." White Scale Master's body shook as he knelt on the ground.
"As long as you worship sincerely, I will not treat you unfairly. I'm well aware of your circumstances. After thirty years, I will have a way for you to leave the Three Immortals Island," Yuan Ming said.
He sought Desire Power and could not simply suppress others; the right approach was to offer a sweet jujube after a beating.
"Really? Thank you, Lord Nether Moon God!" White Scale Master exclaimed joyfully upon hearing this and immediately knelt down again.
This time his gratitude was genuine and heartfelt.
Thirty years might seem long, but for a Nascent Soul cultivator, it was only enough to study one or two secret techniques, and a significant increase in strength was simply not possible.
The existence of the Undead Demon Tree had always been a heavy burden on his heart, and now Lord Nether Moon God had actually promised to take them away from Three Immortals Island!
White Scale Master was somewhat skeptical of Nether Moon God's boasting, but given the god's formidable strength, as long as he could help deal with the Undead Demon Tree, White Scale Master was willing to worship him day after day.
Yuan Ming's Divine Sense shifted away, settling on the Water Ape Clan's strong man and Queen Ming Kong, swiftly cajoling and reassuring them in turn to gain two substantial streams of Desire Power.
He was quite pleased and was about to withdraw his Divine Sense when he suddenly remembered something and connected his Divine Sense with another person.
In a cave mansion within a mountain hollow dozens of miles away, a figure stood up, it was Long Chong.
"I have a task for you…" Yuan Ming said.
"Yes, I shall heed the sacred command!" Long Chong replied reverently after listening and walked outside, quickly arriving at another cave mansion.
"Senior Shi, I have something to report," he said respectfully.
One year after settling down in the secret realm, Yuan Ming had released Long Chong and informed him of how his father had been captured by the Undead Demon Tree.
After grieving, Long Chong resolved to take revenge on the Undead Demon Tree.
Seizing the opportunity, Yuan Ming guided him to join the Moon Sect, and, feeling weak, Long Chong agreed without hesitation.
Since Thousand Dragon Island and Red Leaf Island had some connections, Yuan Ming sent Long Chong to stay with Shi Yanshi and the other two for protection and also to keep an eye on them.
"This matter is of great importance; may I come in to discuss further?" Long Chong asked.
"Certainly, come in," replied Shi Yanshi, a bit surprised.
Long Chong walked into the cave mansion and soon arrived in a stone chamber.
The floor of the stone chamber was engraved with a red Array, filled with numerous fiery Spirit Stones, with a huge Artifact Refining Furnace erected above the Array, currently enveloped by surging spirit flames, seemingly refining a Magic Treasure.
"Long lad, just speak your mind," Shi Yanshi said, looking a little tired.
"Senior Shi, are you refining a magical treasure? Since that's the case, I'll keep it brief. What I have to disclose is related to the Undead Demon Tree and the situation outside," Long Chong said with a slight bow.
Upon hearing this, Shi Yanshi's expression turned serious.
"That Undead Demon Tree is overwhelmingly powerful. Feeling my own strength to be too weak, some time ago I was introduced and joined the Nether Moon God Sect..." Long Chong repeated the same reasons Yun Jiuxiao had given when guiding White Scale Master and others to join the Moon Sect and also told Shi Yanshi about the destruction of Fusang Island.
Shi Yanshi's face turned pale upon hearing these details.
"Are you certain?" he asked, his gaze sharp as a knife.
"I wouldn't dare deceive you about such a significant matter. This is the Imprint Talisman given to me by Lord Nether Moon God, which records the current state of Fusang Island," Long Chong said, taking out an Imprint Talisman and passing it over.
Shi Yanshi's Divine Sense dived into it, and his expression changed once again. He halted his refining, called over Aunt Wan Hua and Old Man Hei Zhu, and repeated the information.
They too were taken aback upon hearing it.
"Young Master Long, what is Lord Nether Moon God's purpose in informing us of this news?" Old Man Hei Zhu inquired.
"Lord Nether Moon God possesses vast Divine Skills and can transfer items from the secret realm to the outside. All three seniors are island masters, and given that the outside situation is changing rapidly, Lord Nether Moon God said he could help send out your commands and items, to prevent Yuzhu Island, Red Leaf Island, and Wanhua Island from being affected by the chaos," Long Chong explained.
At this news, joy appeared on the faces of the trio.
"We are truly grateful if Lord Nether Moon God can help us in this way. But we are not sure what price we need to pay," Aunt Wan Hua inquired.
"The Moon God Sect is now spreading its influence throughout the East Sea, and Lord Nether Moon God hopes that the three seniors will believe in the Nether Moon God and join our Sect," Long Chong revealed.
"Join the Moon God Sect..." Old Man Hei Zhu and Shi Yanshi did not find this surprising.
"Lord Nether Moon God also mentioned that he can ensure the three seniors leave Three Immortals Island safely," Long Chong then threw out another piece of significant news.
Upon hearing this, all three of them abruptly stood up.
"This matter is of great importance; may we speak with Lord Nether Moon God directly?" asked Old Man Hei Zhu after pondering for a moment, and after exchanging glances with the other two, he continued.
"Of course," Long Chong replied.
Yuan Ming couldn't help but smile as his vast Divine Sense enveloped them.
Old Man Hei Zhu and the others had their vision blur and entered an Illusion Space.
A quarter of an hour later, Long Chong left the cave mansion and returned to his own dwelling to continue his cultivation.
Within the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space, three more robust Desire Power streams were conveyed to him.
Yuan Ming revealed a satisfied smile, sat cross-legged, refined and absorbed the three new streams of Desire Power, and his Soul Power progressed rapidly.

chapters.title: Chapter 585 - 559: Taking Another Look
chapters.content:
While Yuan Ming was immersed in his cultivation, the others were not idle either; they all secluded themselves for arduous cultivation in an effort to advance their cultivation levels within the limited time, to better face the unknown situations to come.
But this was, after all, within a secret realm, where each person's carried resources were limited; once exhausted, it would not be easy to find more.
Spiritual materials that were readily available outside seemed priceless and hard to find in the secret realm.
Queen Ming Kong looked at the transparent zither in front of her, resembling crystal, with a slight frown on her face and a faint worry in her expression.
Her delicate fingers gently brushed across the four strings on the zither, silently mouthing, "Water, Fog, Frost, Ice," yet no sound emerged from the instrument.
She had been refining the Ice Soul Zither for many days, but due to the lack of a spiritual material called "Ice Soul Silk," she had been unable to succeed.
Over these days, she had tried substituting with over a dozen different spiritual materials, yet still not achieved the desired result.
"It seems that there are no other options but to go to them," Queen Ming Kong sighed heavily as she looked off into the distance.
Having said that, she put away the unfinished Ice Soul Zither and set off for the territory of the Tide Makers.
Upon seeing Queen Ming Kong arrive, Yuan Wuji was the first to stand, his face displaying an amused smile, "How is it? Have you thought it over? Our terms aren't really that excessive."
"I can't simply accept all of your conditions as they are. To have the entire Bijiao Island join your Tide-rider Alliance isn't something I can decide on my own. As for myself, as long as I can safely leave Three Immortals Island, I'm willing to join you in a personal capacity," Queen Ming Kong replied with a furrow in her brow.
"Heh, big brother, it seems Fellow Daoist Ming Kong has made a good calculation. Only if she can safely leave Three Immortals Island will she join us. So, should we offer her some proper protection?" Blood Realm Venerable sneered and asked.
"I only need the Ice Soul Silk, which outside isn't even worth as much as a defensive Magic Treasure. I've already said that if you want to trade with Magic Treasures or Spirit Stones, that can be discussed. Why must you make things so difficult?" Queen Ming Kong said with indignation.
"As you said, that's outside. In this secret realm, no matter how many Magic Treasures or Spirit Stones you have, they won't get you what you want," Blood Realm Venerable replied with a shake of his head and a smile.
"Do you really intend to make things this difficult for me?" Queen Ming Kong asked coldly.
"Let's do this, we understand you have gained much since you came to Three Immortals Island. Why not hand over the items you've obtained to us? That way, it can't be considered making things difficult for you, right?" Yuan Wuji sighed lightly before saying.
Upon hearing this, Queen Ming Kong's brows deeply furrowed, then gradually relaxed.
"Hmph."
Knowing they had no sincerity, Queen Ming Kong left behind a cold snort and turned to leave.
"Big brother, do you really intend to trade with her?" Bing Li asked with a slight frown as she watched the Queen's departing figure vanish in the distance.
"The Ice Soul Silk has such value only within this secret realm, and only in her hands. Of course, I want to make the trade. But since we have the item, there's no need to rush this. If she can come a second time, she can come a third time, and each visit allows us to probe her bottom line." Yuan Wuji said with a proud smile.
"That may be the case, but aren't you worried she might give up altogether, and that we'll have worked in vain?" Bing Li asked.
"Similarly, she must have had no other choice to come to us a second time, which is enough to prove the importance of the item to her. There's no need to worry; she will definitely come again. Next time, we just need to show a little leniency, and she will certainly come to trade," Yuan Wuji replied, shaking his head with a smile.
"If big brother says so, then don't worry about it," laughed Blood Realm Venerable.
...
After departing from the Tide-rider Alliance, Queen Ming Kong still couldn't suppress the rage in her heart, her expression cold as frost.
"Fellow Daoist Ming Kong, what's the matter? Why do you seem so displeased?" At that moment, a questioning voice suddenly sounded from beside her.
Queen Ming Kong turned towards the source of the voice and saw that White Scale Master had somehow followed her.
"It's still about the Ice Soul Silk; those bastards from the Tide Makers…" she began to curse, but White Scale Master already knew what had transpired.
Last time, he and Queen Ming Kong had gone together to seek out the Tide Makers, needing to purchase similar spiritual materials, but the Tide Makers also had none.
"Why bother dealing with those people? Why not try your luck with the Divine Envoy?" White Scale Master suggested with a smile on his face.
"You mean Fellow Daoist Yuan? Does he have it?" Queen Ming Kong asked in surprise.
"I don't know about the Ice Soul Silk, but in recent days, many have gone to him to purchase spiritual materials or Spiritual Medicine, and most have been able to obtain what they want—or if not immediately, then within a few days," White Scale Master explained.
"What does this mean? The thing that couldn't be obtained at the time will be able to be acquired after a few days? Could it be that he has a channel to communicate with the outside world, capable of obtaining things from outside the secret realm?" Queen Ming Kong was greatly shocked.
"I'm not clear about the specifics either, but what I'm thinking is similar to yours," White Scale Master said.
"How is that possible? He's just a Core Formation Cultivator, how could he achieve that? Could it be that he has a space-related Magic Treasure? No, to penetrate the Forbiddens of Three Immortals Island, it should at least be of the Spiritual Treasure Level, right?" Queen Ming Kong said incredulously.
"Of course not, but if it were relying on the power of the Nether Moon God, it would be a different story," White Scale Master shook his head and pondered.
Upon hearing this, Queen Ming Kong was taken aback. If it were with the aid of the power of a deity, it really might be possible.
As soon as she thought of this, she felt somewhat guilty. Although she had already become a Believer of the Nether Moon God, she knew that her devotion was not sincere enough.
Despite this, Queen Ming Kong still steeled herself to find Yuan Ming and presented her request.
Yuan Ming hesitated for a moment before finally agreeing to her request and merely charged a slightly higher price than the outside market.
This almost made Queen Ming Kong unable to believe her ears, as compared to the opportunist attitude of the Tide Makers before, Yuan Ming could be said to be extremely kind. She was filled with gratitude towards Yuan Ming and immediately promised to pray to the Nether Moon God with even greater devotion.
After Queen Ming Kong left, Yuan Ming stood in place, lost in thought.
The reason for his moment of hesitation was that in the past few days, many people had sought him out to buy spiritual materials, many of which required him to use the Stealing Heaven Tripod to contact Yan Siyun to help collect them.
In these exchanges, a significant amount of the Space Power in the Silver Crystal Stone inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod had been consumed, and now not much was left.
Therefore, he thought of constructing a structure similar to the Void Temple to draw down the power of the stars and help restore the power of the Silver Crystal Stone within the Stealing Heaven Tripod. Now, the materials had almost all been collected.
Two days later, Yuan Ming began to construct a peculiar building with the appearance of a four-sided pyramid, following the likeness of the Void Temple from his memory.
Once the construction was complete, he immediately entered it and began to meditate, attempting to draw down the power of the stars.
This version was sourced from *.
But there was no reaction whatsoever, almost no different from sitting in meditation elsewhere in the secret realm; in fact, due to the obstruction of the building, the attraction of nature's spiritual energy had even decreased significantly.
Yuan Ming clearly knew where the problem lay. His knowledge of the Void Temple was vague, understanding only the general structure; as for some more detailed aspects, he did not grasp them fully enough.
"The construction of a place like the Void Temple is fully considered and based on Arrays. Some may seem ordinary or even rough, but in reality, simplicity embodies the profound truths of nature. It's just a pity, when I saw the Void Temple, I didn't study it in detail. I vaguely remember there were some Qimen Changes inside, but I don't know if that could be of any help?" Xi Ying said carefully after inspecting the strange building Yuan Ming constructed.
"Certainly better than me trying to figure it out blindly," Yuan Ming exclaimed joyfully upon hearing this and immediately asked Xi Ying to assist him.
Thus, the two of them spent several more days modifying this replica of the "Void Temple."
When Yuan Ming tried again, he found that after integrating the Qimen Changes and adding some Arrays, this peculiar building finally wasn't just an ordinary decoration. While cultivating inside, he was now able to circulate spiritual energy.
However, the Star Power that Yuan Ming wanted still did not come as he wished.
"As expected, it's still not working. With my understanding of the Void Temple, I'm afraid this is as far as I can help you," Xi Ying sighed regretfully and said helplessly.
"If only I could take another look at the Void Temple," Yuan Ming sighed softly.
Unfortunately, the Void Temple was located on Fusang Island which was now occupied by the Wu Yue Sect. Even if he wanted to contact his Believers to help him take a look, it was no longer possible.
Just at that moment, a flash of spirit light suddenly struck Yuan Ming's mind, causing him to slap his palm involuntarily.
The crisp "smack" startled Xi Ying.
"What's wrong?" she asked in surprise.
"I've seen a Cloud Top Hall on the continent where the Three Immortals Hall is located. The structure of that great hall is quite similar to the Void Temple. I can't get someone to look at the Void Temple for me, but I can go see the Cloud Top Hall," Yuan Ming said excitedly.
He remembered that he had just been in contact with Huan Ling Zi two days prior, who was then staying near the Three Immortals Hall.
Yuan Ming immediately contacted Huan Ling Zi, who was searching for treasures on the outskirts of Three Immortals Hall, through the Stealing Heaven Tripod and asked him to hurry to the Cloud Top Hall.
In less than half a day, Huan Ling Zi had found the Cloud Top Hall.
Fortunately, it was well-preserved and had not suffered much damage, and the various Arrays inside were mostly still in their original state.
Yuan Ming immediately instructed him to closely observe everything inside the Cloud Top Hall and inform him in great detail.

chapters.title: Chapter 586 - 586: 560
chapters.content:
According to the description given by Huan Ling Zi, Yuan Ming prepared a thick stack of blueprints, on which he detailed every aspect with meticulous annotation.
With Xi Ying's assistance, Yuan Ming demolished the previously constructed replica of the "Void Temple" and, following his own blueprints, endeavored to imitate the structure of Cloud Top Hall and rebuilt a brand new replica hall.
Standing before the peculiar structure that now stood before him, Yuan Ming felt a touch of unease in his heart, yet it was overshadowed by a greater sense of anticipation.
He paced slowly into it, sat down cross-legged with his eyes closed, and began trying to draw on the power of the stars.
In a short while, specks of starlight fell from above the grand hall, transforming into flowing radiance that poured into the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
"It has finally succeeded!" Yuan Ming's mouth curled into a smile as he looked towards Xi Ying.
"There's still one final step," Xi Ying said with a laugh.
She then stepped forward and began engraving and arranging something on the central open space of the grand hall.
In just a moment, a complex array appeared on the floor.
"Give it a try," Xi Ying suggested.
Yuan Ming nodded, took out the Silver Crystal Stone from within the space of the Stealing Heaven Tripod, and placed it in the center of the array.
Splinters of silver light peeled off from the surrounding star power, converging into the crystal stone. As they merged, the light from the Silver Crystal Stone suddenly flared brilliantly.
Seeing this scene, the tension Yuan Ming had been holding in his heart was finally relieved—he no longer needed to worry about not having enough space power.
Xi Ying also smiled knowingly and then turned to leave.
...
Inside Cloud Top Hall, where Huan Ling Zi had been waiting for contact from Yuan Ming, he felt a bit anxious.
He worried that any oversight on his part could delay the important matters of a Divine Envoy.
However, it wasn't long before Yuan Ming contacted him.
"You've done very well in this matter," Yuan Ming expressed his satisfaction.
"Being able to serve the Divine Envoy is my honor," Huan Ling Zi replied, a mix of delight and anxiety in his voice upon receiving the Divine Envoy's praise.
"These are your rewards," Yuan Ming's voice sounded, and a virtual light gate with gold and silver colors appeared.
As the gate opened, numerous spiritual medicines and fairy grasses flew out, landing before Huan Ling Zi, causing his eyes to brighten and his face to break into a smile.
"Many thanks, Divine Envoy," Huan Ling Zi quickly bowed in thanks.
"Now, there is another matter that needs your attention," Yuan Ming continued.
"Please, Divine Envoy, command me, and I shall diligently fulfill the task," Huan Ling Zi promptly said.L.ov.e thi+s s.t^or%y?^ Show yo-ur% s!u.ppo&r!t+ on M-9&VL-EMPYR!.
"Not too far from your location, there is a hidden valley. I need you to rush there, enter its underground, and retrieve a piece of Houtu Mountain Stone hidden within the earth veins, and deliver it to me," Yuan Ming instructed.
"Please wait, Divine Envoy, I'll attend to it right away," Huan Ling Zi immediately responded.
"No rush… I have a space treasure here for you to take when you retrieve the Houtu Mountain Stone," Yuan Ming hurried to intercept the overeager Huan Ling Zi and added.
Huan Ling Zi was momentarily surprised; it was just the retrieval of a piece of Houtu Mountain Stone—why was a special space treasure needed when any storage magic tool could easily handle it?
But in spite of his confusion, Huan Ling Zi didn't question the Divine Envoy and simply acknowledged the instruction.
When Yuan Ming transmitted the Red Ancient Scroll, Huan Ling Zi did not scrutinize it closely but respectfully accepted it.
"If you encounter demon beasts along the way, feel free to slay them all. However, do not waste their corpses; collect them inside this ancient scroll. The more, the better," Yuan Ming added with emphasis.
Subsequently, he taught Huan Ling Zi the exact location of the Houtu Mountain Stone and a temporary method to activate the Red Ancient Scroll.
After noting all the details, Huan Ling Zi departed on his own.
On his journey to the valley where the Houtu Mountain Stone was located, Huan Ling Zi kept Yuan Ming's instructions in mind, and along the way, he slew every demon beast he encountered that wasn't too troublesome, activating the Red Ancient Scroll to collect their corpses within it.
By the time he reached the valley, he had already slain no fewer than two hundred third-level demon beasts, and the count of second-level demon beasts exceeded a thousand.
If it weren't for not wanting to delay the matters of the Divine Envoy, he could have slain even more.
Clearly, however, retrieving the Houtu Mountain Stone was the primary task.
Yet when he finally descended underground and located what the Divine Envoy referred to as the "Houtu Mountain Stone," he was rooted to the spot in shock.
"The hell is this 'Houtu Mountain Stone'? Is this not more of a 'Houtu Town Mountain Peak'? " Huan Ling Zi began to doubt his life choices.
It was only then that he understood why the Divine Envoy needed him to bring this particular space treasure for the retrieval—it seemed that his own storage magic tools could not even fit the "foot" of this 'Houtu Town Mountain Peak,' could they?
"Having collected so many corpses of demon beasts earlier, could it be that there won't be enough space to fit this mountain peak?" Huan Ling Zi couldn't help but mutter his concerns aloud.
Still, he activated the Red Ancient Scroll and attempted to collect the Houtu Town Mountain Peak.
The volume of the mountain peak was immense, but it was essentially still a piece of Houtu Mountain Stone, not a real mountain peak, and so it lacked deep roots into the earth veins, meaning there was no need to sever the roots before collecting it.
When the light from the Red Ancient Scroll flared up, the entire valley began to tremble violently.
However, just as that patch of light became unbearably bright, the Houtu Town Mountain Stone, which appeared as massive as a mountain, suddenly flashed and vanished into thin air right before Huan Ling Zi's eyes.
Huan Ling Zi was initially taken aback, then immediately overjoyed.
"Boom boom boom"
But his joy was short-lived as a dull booming sound suddenly came from above his head.
With such a large chunk of Houtu Town Mountain Stone removed, a huge void appeared under the mountain valley instantly, and the soil and rocks above began to collapse downwards, pressing towards Huan Ling Zi.
Huan Ling Zi immediately used his Escape Technique, transforming into a streak of light and shooting out from the ground onto the valley above.
At this point, the center of the valley below collapsed, creating an enormous pit nearly five hundred zhang in diameter at the already sunken center of the valley, filled with dust and smoke that lingered for a long time.
A vast number of demon beasts in the valley were disturbed, running out like a flood.
Seeing this, Huan Ling Zi immediately dove toward the mouth of the valley, launching attacks on the fleeing demon beasts.
…
Unaware of the situation outside, Yuan Ming continued his cultivation and comprehension of the Six Jia Qimen and the Golden Sunflower Beast Taming Technique, the two new magic arts he had recently acquired, after contacting Huan Ling Zi.
In the blink of an eye, more than half a year had passed.
During this period, White Scale Master, Old Man Hei Zhu, and others prayed devoutly, providing him with plenty of Desire Power.
He also contacted Yan Siyun to acquire various spiritual materials needed from the outside world for them.
Queen Ming Kong, having received the Ice Soul Silk, immediately went into Artifact Refining seclusion, and after forty-nine days, successfully refined the Ice Soul Zither.
One day, Yuan Ming suddenly felt the sincere prayers of Huan Ling Zi, knowing that the latter had completed his task, and quickly contacted him.
True to his expectations, the Red Ancient Scroll sent back by Huan Ling Zi now contained a Houtu Town Mountain Peak.
What delighted Yuan Ming even more was that there were also more than two thousand demon beast corpses inside.
After rewarding Huan Ling Zi, Yuan Ming immediately fed those demon beast corpses to the little black tree.
The black roots that this creature extended pierced into each demon beast corpse, sucking up all the essence from their bodies as if nursing from a mother.
Watching its growth, Yuan Ming felt immensely gratified.
On the other hand, the members of the Tide-rider Alliance who had waited for half a year could no longer wait for Queen Ming Kong's plea for help and doubt began to rise in each of their hearts.
"Big Brother, what's going on with Queen Ming Kong? So much time has passed, and she has not come back to us. Could it be that she no longer wishes to refine that Magic Treasure?" Blood Realm Venerable said, furrowing his brows.
"That's impossible. The Ice Soul Zither is of great significance to her. Once refined, it would greatly enhance her survival chances in this Secret Realm. She wouldn't give it up unless..." Yuan Wuji said with a frown, pondering.
"She found a substitute or got Ice Soul Silk from elsewhere?" Bing Li, the white-browed youth, interjected.
"That can't be." Blood Realm Venerable shook his head firmly.
"Indeed, it doesn't make sense. If she could have gotten it, she would have done so long ago, and wouldn't have lowered herself to plead with us before," the white-browed youth also denied his previous statement with a shake of his head.
At that moment, a small dark green Gu Worm suddenly flew in from outside, landing on the fingertip of the purple-haired woman.
The purple-haired woman, Poison Shadow, stared unblinkingly at the Gu Worm on her fingertip as if communicating with it.
Just moments later, her brows furrowed tightly, and she turned to the others and said, "Queen Ming Kong has already succeeded in refining the Ice Soul Zither."
"What?" Blood Realm Venerable exclaimed in disbelief.
Bing Li let out a deep sigh.
"How did she get the Ice Soul Silk? Besides us, who else in this Secret Realm would have such a thing?" Yuan Wuji asked with knit brows.
"She got it from outside the Secret Realm," Poison Shadow replied.
The moment she said this, the other three's expressions shifted from puzzlement to shock.
"She got it from the outside? Poison Shadow, clarify what you mean. What exactly happened?" Blood Realm Venerable asked urgently.
"Based on the information gathered by the Gu Worm, we can basically tell that Queen Ming Kong's Ice Soul Silk was very likely obtained from a deity named 'Nether Moon God.' In fact, it wasn't just her—White Scale Master and Old Man Hei Zhu also got some items from the outside world by worshipping the Nether Moon God," Poison Shadow answered.
"With the power to transcend the barrier of the Secret Realm and acquire items from the outside world, who exactly is this Nether Moon God, capable of such Divine Skills?" Bing Li said, deep in thought.
"While we had been foolishly waiting for Queen Ming Kong to relent, could we have been set up?" Blood Realm Venerable said, feeling some anger.
"Nether Moon God... if he truly has the ability to acquire things from the outside, wouldn't I also be able to get the Immortal Blood Jade that I need?" Yuan Wuji said, unable to shake off his astonishment.
Upon this thought, Yuan Wuji immediately spoke up, "We need to meet this Nether Moon God."
With that, he led the others to find Queen Ming Kong.
"What brings you here? I no longer need your Ice Soul Silk," Queen Ming Kong said with a slight frown as she suppressed a trace of contempt in her eyes upon seeing the group arrive.
"Congratulations, Fellow Daoist Ming Kong, on the successful refinement of the Ice Soul Zither," Yuan Wuji said, a brilliant smile spreading across his face as he clasped his hands in congratulation.
His smile was genuine, as if all the prior unhappiness had never existed.

chapters.title: Chapter 587 - 561: Tribute
chapters.content:
"If you have nothing sincere to say, then don't speak at all. What exactly do you want? If there's nothing important, please leave," Queen Ming Kong said, her expression cold.
"I wish to meet with Lord Nether Moon God," Yuan Wuji stated, dropping all pretense and speaking directly.
"Hmph, do you think you can see the Lord Nether Moon God just because you want to?" Queen Ming Kong glanced at him, her tone indifferent.
"You..." The Blood Realm Venerable was furious upon hearing this and was about to explode in anger.
Yuan Wuji stopped him with a hand gesture, still wearing a smile, and asked, "May I know how Fellow Daoist Ming Kong would be willing to make an introduction?"
Seeing him lower his posture like this, the anger in Queen Ming Kong's heart dissipated somewhat, considering that she might be able to increase the number of believers for the Nether Moon God, she stopped making things difficult for him.
"Whether Divine wishes to see you or not, I would know only after I pray to him," Queen Ming Kong said solemnly.
"Then I shall be in your debt," Yuan Wuji said, nodding in agreement.
Queen Ming Kong did not speak further, closing her eyes and sitting in meditation, earnestly praying to the Nether Moon God in her heart.
In this secret realm, Yuan Ming's believers were few, and he soon heard Queen Ming Kong's call and prayer, making contact with her immediately.
Upon knowing that it was Yuan Wuji who wished to contact the Nether Moon God, Yuan Ming wore a contemplative expression.
After having taken Old Man Hei Zhu and two others as believers, he also considered recruiting the Tide-rider Alliance, but Yuan Wuji was a Late-stage Nascent Soul Cultivator. Even with the Desire Power of the Stealing Heaven Tripod, Yuan Ming was not necessarily his match, which is why he had given up the idea.
Now that Yuan Wuji had come to him, if he were to refuse to meet, it would appear as though he had something to hide.
After a brief moment of thought, Yuan Ming agreed.
Yuan Wuji glanced at the Divine Statue and quickly shifted his gaze, signaling to Lan Xiao beside him to start praying.
Lan Xiao got the hint, silently invoking the name of Lord Nether Moon God in her heart, but there was no response.
After a while, she raised her head to look at Queen Ming Kong, her eyes inquiring.
"Clear your mind of distractions and pray with focus," Queen Ming Kong said coldly, as if she had anticipated this.
Lan Xiao pondered for a moment, steadied her spirits, and put aside the miscellaneous thoughts in her mind. Looking at the Divine Statue again, she suddenly felt a strange connection.
The next instant, Yuan Ming's Divine Sense descended, and a voice resonated within her Sea of Consciousness.
"What business do you have to seek an audience?"
Lan Xiao's face changed. Although she was only an Early-stage Nascent Soul Cultivator, the Cultivation Technique she practiced was unique, and in terms of Divine Soul Power, she was not inferior to a Mid-stage Nascent Soul.
