Yet the voice just now easily invaded deep into her Sea of Consciousness; the Soul Power within her Sea of Consciousness had no indication of an external force entering.
"Respectful Divine, I heard that by earnestly praying to you, we can receive Divine's blessings?" She quickly returned to her composure and respectfully replied telepathically.
Yuan Ming was taken aback upon hearing this.
He wondered who had spread this rumor, making him out to be a wish-granting stone that responded to every plea?
"Every sincere devotion will receive a response from Divine," Yuan Ming responded cryptically.
Lan Xiao was overjoyed at the reply and quickly said, "I am willing to offer up my most genuine devotion and most earnest prayers to you."
"You are not a member of my Moon Sect and cannot be called a believer of the God. However, God loves all people and treats them equally. If you wish to plant the divine seal, you may become my believer and receive my protection and blessings," Yuan Ming continued.
If it were possible to plant the Soul Lowering Technique rune in the Sea of Consciousness of Lan Xiao and the others, it would save a lot of trouble in the future.
Of course, Yuan Ming knew this was unlikely. His offer was merely an opening move to improve his position for later negotiations.
"Divine, I have only a shallow understanding of your Sect and am not yet worthy to be your believer. After I have prayed diligently and earned the qualification, I will come to serve you," Lan Xiao tactfully declined.
"If that's the case, I won't insist. Normally, only my believers receive blessings, but seeing your sincerity, you can offer a Tributor to exchange for what you seek," Yuan Ming replied, as he had anticipated.
Lan Xiao was not disappointed but rather delighted to hear this.
She never believed the story that she could receive blessings merely by praying fervently. Now knowing she could exchange goods, the anxiety in her heart finally subsided.
For her to actually become a believer of the so-called "Nether Moon God" was ridiculous, almost as preposterous as worshiping the Wuyue God.
"Divine, I want some Immortal Blood Jade and am willing to offer these four types of spiritual materials as Tributor: Nine-leaf Flower, Ice Soul Silkworm Silk, Red Mulberry Immortal Fruit, and Flesh Jade Bodhi. May I ask if this is acceptable?" Lan Xiao telepathically proposed.
She was confident that the Nether Moon God would not refuse the trade since the four spiritual materials she offered were far more valuable than the Immortal Blood Jade she sought.
If it were outside, aside from the Ice Soul Silk, any of the items would suffice to exchange for the Immortal Blood Jade.
However, this was a Secret Realm isolated from the outside world, where many treasures were destined to be priceless.
The other materials, although precious, did not cause much of a stir in Yuan Ming's ears.
But the Red Mulberry Immortal Fruit was a different story entirely. Their initial goal in attending the Immortal Fruit Assembly, which subsequently led them into a series of troubles, was to obtain the Red Mulberry Immortal Fruit.
"How much Immortal Blood Jade do you want?" Yuan Ming asked.Brought to you by the folks at *.
"Just four pieces," Lan Xiao hastily replied.
"Agreed, but you will need to provide four portions of the spiritual materials you're offering in return," Yuan Ming said.
Lan Xiao was taken aback, she had only planned to offer one portion of each material, not trade four for four.
"Divine, this..." Lan Xiao began, but was interrupted before she could finish.
"Do not attempt to haggle with me. If you are unwilling to make the exchange, then let us consider this matter terminated. From henceforth, do not try to communicate with me again, for a divine does not need believers filled with doubt," Yuan Ming spoke indifferently.
"My lord, please don't misunderstand me. I'm not trying to bargain. It's just that of the four spiritual materials, I can only spare two at most, and really can't provide all four," Lan Xiao said with a bitter smile.
"If that is the case, then I will only give you two pieces of Immortal Blood Jade. Do you still wish to make the exchange?" Yuan Ming asked.
"Yes," Lan Xiao pondered briefly before responding without delay.
She feared that if she took too long to consider, that damned divine would criticize her lack of decisiveness again.
She must obtain the Immortal Blood Jade to help Yuan Wuji accelerate the refinement of the Blood God's Son. That was of utmost importance.
"Come back here after half a month, and do not forget to bring your tribute," Yuan Ming stated.
The Immortal Blood Jade was no trivial matter, definitely not as readily obtainable as the Ice Soul Silk.
Yuan Ming needed to contact Yan Siyun to handle the affair. With all the back and forth, there was no telling how long it would take, so he could only afford to wait half a month, which was comparatively generous.
After leaving Queen Ming Kong's place, Yuan Wuji erected a barrier and asked, "What is your assessment of that Lord Nether Moon God?"
"Extremely formidable. I couldn't detect any Divine Sense invading my Sea of Consciousness at all. The voice just resonated in my Sea of Consciousness without warning. Had he opted to strike at me, I'm afraid I would have had no chance of withstanding it," Lan Xiao said, her expression rather grim.
"From the look of things, this Lord Nether Moon God has some Divine Skills indeed. Let's hope he can actually obtain the Immortal Blood Jade," Yuan Wuji reflected.
In the meantime, Yuan Ming did not immediately inform Xi Ying of the matter but promptly got in touch with Yan Siyun.
To his surprise, Bi Shuirou from Red Ganoderma Island happened to have the Immortal Blood Jade.
Yan Siyun did not mention that it was needed by Yuan Ming, but nevertheless, she spent no small sum to acquire it from Bi Shuirou.
As a result, the transaction they thought might not be completed even after half a month was finished in just three days.
When Queen Ming Kong arrived with the Immortal Blood Jade ahead of schedule, proposing to complete the transaction early, even Yuan Wuji found it hard to believe. However, his disbelief was swiftly replaced by immense joy.
After Queen Ming Kong left with the spiritual materials, the Blood Realm Venerable spoke with some displeasure, "Why didn't we just kill that woman and take the Immortal Blood Jade? This deal was a loss for us."
"The main priority is to assist me in creating the Blood God's Son. It's not wise to introduce complications. Once I have succeeded, we will settle our accounts with them. The resources of our Tide-rider Alliance are not so easily taken advantage of," Yuan Wuji waved his hand dismissively and said indifferently.
"I knew it, big brother. You would never stomach such a loss," Lan Xiao laughed.
"In the upcoming days, you all must diligently cultivate and maintain yourselves in peak condition as we have a tough battle ahead," Yuan Wuji stated with a smile.
"Understood," the other three quickly responded.
On the other side, Yuan Ming collected the treasures Queen Ming Kong brought back and immediately went to find Xi Ying.
"Red Mulberry Immortal Fruits? Where did you acquire these?" Xi Ying's eyes widened with delight and surprise upon seeing the treasures Yuan Ming presented.
"A hermit has his own ingenious ways. With these Red Mulberry Immortal Fruits, you can try refining Five Elements Infant Condensing Pills, right? It's just a pity there are only two," Yuan Ming said with a smile.
"It's enough," Xi Ying replied, her eyes twinkling as she nodded.
Feeling somewhat bashful under her intense gaze, Yuan Ming quickly urged her, "Then go and refine the elixir. I will protect you while you do it."
"Wonderful," Xi Ying beamed with a bright smile.
Time quickly flew by, and seven days passed.
Xi Ying successfully refined the Five Elements Infant Condensing Pills and took the opportunity to begin her retreat, attempting to break through to the Nascent Soul Stage.
Since she was within the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space, there were no concerns for her safety. All Yuan Ming needed to ensure was his and the Stealing Heaven Tripod's security; he no longer had to go to the effort of protecting Xi Ying.
One day, within the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space.
Yuan Ming suddenly raised an eyebrow and flicked his fingers.
A stream of purple light surged out of the Spiritual Beast Bag, swiftly condensing in front of Yuan Ming into a purple-robed young girl—it was Hua Zhi.
She had grown taller, her features more delicate than before. Any trace of her Vine Demon heritage had vanished, leaving her entirely in human form.
Hua Zhi's aura had undergone dramatic changes, her powerful demon energy spreading widely, apparently at a Level 4 standard.
"Having slept for so long, you've finally awoken," Yuan Ming snorted.
Hua Zhi had broken through to Level 4 more than a year ago, but ever since then, she had been sleeping within the Spiritual Beast Bag, for reasons unknown.
Yuan Ming did not use any Illusion Technique to conceal the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space at the moment.
Hua Zhi had followed him for a long time; there was no harm in letting her see the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space.
"Master, it wasn't that I intentionally fell into deep sleep. It's a side effect of the Symbiosis Technique. After each use, I need to sleep for a lengthy period to recover my Primordial Qi," Hua Zhi explained, looking aggrieved.
"So, does that mean you have completed the integration with the Purple Extreme Tai Sui?" Yuan Ming's eyes lit up.
"Of course, I have mastered all of the Divine Skills of the Purple Extreme Tai Sui, and the power of the Absorption Poison Divine Ability has greatly increased. Master, how is your Sandman Poison? I will immediately help you expel it," Hua Zhi said, lifting her palm, from which a purple vine shot out.
"The poison has already been resolved. If I had waited for your rescue, by now I would likely be nothing more than a corpse," Yuan Ming replied irritably.
"Master is blessed with good fortune, turning misfortune into a blessing. How could a little poison trouble you? I knew you would resolve it, which is why I could sleep so peacefully," Hua Zhi chuckled smugly.
"Enough, tell me about your integration with the Purple Extreme Tai Sui and the details of your advancement," Yuan Ming directed.

chapters.title: Chapter 588 - 562: Attempt
chapters.content:
Hua Zhi, upon hearing these words, put away her playful expression and meticulously began recounting the changes she experienced during this breakthrough.
Yuan Ming listened with eyes shining brightly, nodding continuously.
"I was able to break through smoothly this time, thanks to the continuous supplies you sent, Master. Otherwise, it wouldn't have been possible to break through so quickly. Rest assured, Master, let me take on any tough battles in the future," Hua Zhi said confidently with a laugh, patting her chest.
"Hearing you say that, I'm much more at ease," Yuan Ming nodded.
...
Time flowed, and several months passed quickly.
Yuan Ming, who was sitting cross-legged near the altar, suddenly opened his eyes and stood up.
Inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space, dense Spiritual Power surged, forming a huge Spiritual Energy Vortex, converging towards Xi Ying.
From the Gathering Spirit Tree, dazzling white light shone, and streams of pure nature's spiritual energy flowed out, forming a Light Pillar that also entered Xi Ying's body.
Vivid light glowed around her, and Mana surged through her meridians like tidal waves, converging towards her Dantian.
"Is it finally time to form the Nascent Soul…" Yuan Ming muttered.
Mighty Mana poured into Xi Ying's Golden Core, which emitted waves of brilliance, growing brighter and brighter.
The Nascent Soul formation required a lengthy process, not something achieved in one go.
Time passed bit by bit, and soon a month had gone by.
The Golden Core within Xi Ying's Dantian had become brilliantly dazzling, hard to gaze upon directly.
A lively aura was poised, ready to break free from its shell.
"Now is the moment!" Xi Ying suddenly formed hand seals, her Sea of Consciousness and Divine Soul separating a part, which merged into the Golden Core.
Yuan Ming's brow twitched. Xi Ying was using the soul splitting method to form her Nascent Soul, which was slightly different from his own third soul, lacking a bit in agility and rather stiff.
The soul splitting and the Golden Core merged, Mana and the Divine Power also began to gather, and the Golden Core started transforming into a fist-sized, semi-transparent Crystal Core.
As the Mana in her body surged relentlessly, that Crystal Core twisted as if alive, gradually growing limbs and a round head.
Yuan Ming watched this scene from afar, his eyes filled with astonishment.
He was far from his own breakthrough to the Nascent Soul stage, but from this observation, he still gained many insights.
The rounded head displayed gradually emerging facial features, sharpening from vague to clear, and from flat to three-dimensional.
By the time her features had fully solidified, her form had also become more vivid, strikingly resembling a miniature version of Xi Ying.
Just then, as the Divine Power continually condensed and entered the miniaturized Xi Ying's body, her tiny eyes suddenly opened, and a gleam of lively Divine Light shone through, full of curiosity about the outside world like a newly born child.
Her figure floated about, emerging from Xi Ying's Sea of Consciousness, circling around her own body once, glanced at Yuan Ming who had been watching from a distance, and then flew back.
The next instant, Xi Ying's eyes opened, her aura erupted fiercely, revealing that she was now a genuine Cultivator in the Nascent Soul Stage.
"Congratulations, after many years of arduous cultivation, you have finally stepped into the Nascent Soul Stage." Yuan Ming's face relaxed as he transmitted his congratulations.
Xi Ying nodded from a distance to Yuan Ming and continued to sit cross-legged, steadily drawing spiritual energy from the Gathering Spirit Tree to solidify her Cultivation.
...
Meanwhile, at a resting spot of the Tide-rider Alliance, a burst of thunderous laughter suddenly filled the air.
A figure swiftly burst from beneath the ground and landed in front of several members of the Blood Realm Venerable.
"Big brother, have you finished your seclusion?" Bing Li, seeing this, immediately approached.
"Is the Blood God's Son refined?" asked the Blood Realm Venerable, a look of joy on his face.
Yuan Wuji nodded slightly, a hint of dark red flashing in his eyes, which quickly disappeared.
But in that brief moment, a dense and thick aura seemed to emanate from him, causing the hearts of the Blood Realm Venerable and the others to tighten, a chill rising up their spines.
Fortunately, this sensation was fleeting, and soon everything returned to normal.
"That's great, big brother. With the Blood God's Son to assist us, our strength against the Undead Demon Tree has greatly increased," Lan Xiao said excitedly after the shock.
"Exactly, our chances of making it out alive have also greatly increased," Bing Li added with joy.
"Big brother, what are the combat capabilities of the Blood God's Son?" the Blood Realm Venerable asked.
"I haven't tried it yet, so it's hard to say," Yuan Wuji pondered briefly before responding.
"It's a pity that in this Secret Realm, there are no demon beasts to test it," Bing Li sighed and said.
"If you ask me, why not just go challenge Queen Ming Kong as a warm-up? Didn't she just refine the Ice Soul Zither? It's a good chance to teach her a lesson and also vent a bit," the Blood Realm Venerable suddenly suggested, raising his eyebrow.
"Not a bad idea," Bing Li, rubbing his chin, nodded in agreement.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Wuji said nothing, but the words of the Blood Realm Venerable reminded him, and he couldn't help but reveal a hint of a smile.
"Is a Queen Ming Kong worth using the Blood God's Son? Isn't there a Lord Nether Moon God behind her? It could be a chance to gauge the depth of this so-called Divine," Yuan Wuji spoke indifferently.
"Is this not too risky? We know nothing about that divine being, and if he can fetch things from outside this secret realm through spatial means, he must possess considerable power," Lan Xiao said somewhat hesitantly.This chapter first appeared on *.
"No matter, if this Lord Nether Moon God were to show himself as a result of this, even if we lost, it wouldn't be a bad thing. The stronger he is, the better our chances of defeating the Undead Demon Tree in the future," Yuan Wuji said, waving his hand, unconcerned.
"Brother is right, and with the Blood God's Son here, how could big brother possibly lose?" the Blood Realm Venerable laughed.
"As long as big brother wins, those people will have to obey his commands from now on. That way, when we fight the Undead Demon Tree, if necessary, we could also…" Bing Li began, but the others understood her implication without needing her to finish.
They exchanged smiles and immediately sought out Queen Ming Kong.
Seeing the group approaching her once again, Queen Ming Kong's expression remained cold and unwelcoming.
"What do you want now?" she frowned and asked.
"I want to see that Lord Nether Moon God," Yuan Wuji said with a smile.
"What business do you have with Lord Divine?" Queen Ming Kong asked.
"Tell him to appear before me, I wish to speak with him in person," Yuan Wuji stated.
"Hmph, what nonsense are you spouting? I devoutly worship Lord Nether Moon God and pray sincerely every day without being granted the sight of his divine form, and you think you can see him just by asking? Are you worthy?" Queen Ming Kong scoffed, her tone mocking as if she had heard the funniest joke.
"So, you're saying that you've never met this Nether Moon God? What about White Scale Master and the others?" Yuan Wuji frowned and asked.
"If everyone could see him, how would he still be considered a divine being?" Queen Ming Kong retorted.
"Could it be that this so-called Nether Moon God isn't really in this secret realm, or simply can't descend into it?" Yuan Wuji's brows furrowed tightly as he asked.
Then, reconsidering, he found this unlikely.
Last time, the Divine Thought of Nether Moon God indeed descended into Lan Xiao's Sea of Consciousness and communicated with her, using some means to procure the Immortal Blood Jade for her, something that someone unable to enter the secret realm should not be able to do.
Queen Ming Kong momentarily hesitated, not knowing how to respond.
Yuan Wuji immediately noticed that she genuinely did not know the answer to this question.
"You'd better pray he chooses to appear before me," Yuan Wuji's expression darkened as he spoke to Queen Ming Kong.
Realizing something was amiss, alarm bells went off in her mind. While she prayed fervently to Yuan Ming, a shimmer of silver light flashed, and she clutched a crystal pipa in her arms.
Seeing her action, Yuan Wuji and his companions did not panic at all, instead observing her with interest.
"So, this is your Ice Soul Zither, it looks to be of fine quality," Yuan Wuji remarked with a nod of approval after a brief inspection.
With that, he raised his hand and waved, and a surge of Blood Light erupted from his sleeve. Three blood-red flying needles shot out, directly targeting Queen Ming Kong's face.
The latter stepped back, steadied her stance, and with one hand on the strings and the other plucking them,
immediately produced a sound akin to rapid rain, sending wave after wave of faint blue Sound Waves visible to the naked eye that collided with the three blood-red needles.
The forward-thrusting needles suddenly paused, suspended mid-air, coated in a thin layer of ice crystals. Before Yuan Wuji could recall them, they shattered to dust in midair.
Seeing this, Yuan Wuji and his companions were somewhat surprised.
The Three-in-One Blood Needle was one of Yuan Wuji's early favored Magic Treasures, and although it no longer matched his current strength, it had helped him slay many foes and was not weak.
Yet unexpectedly, it was completely destroyed at the first encounter.
"It is you who sought death; blame me not," Queen Ming Kong rapidly flashed in front of Yuan Wuji, striking a somewhat abrupt appearance as she plucked the strings again.
Another burst of noisy rain sounds ensued, more dense blue Sound Waves cascading out, hitting Yuan Wuji right in the chest and abdomen.
The areas where he was struck immediately frosted over, encased in ice.
Yuan Wuji's eyes flickered as he suddenly felt his entire body plunge into an ice cellar, nearly unable to move.
Seeing her successful hit, Queen Ming Kong's face briefly lit up with a smile, staying alert for any retaliatory actions from the others, and quickly retreated, widening the distance between herself and the group.
Strangely, however, the Blood Realm Venerable and the other two showed no indication of attacking Queen Ming Kong or aiding Yuan Wuji, merely observing the unfolding scenario tacitly.
In that moment, a Blood Light illuminated from Yuan Wuji's chest, and a blood-red phantom emerged, dissolving the blue ice crystals covering it instantly and disappearing.
Queen Ming Kong saw only a blur as a blood-red figure suddenly appeared right in front of her, the blurred bloodied face almost touching hers.
Her breath hitched, her body frozen in place, feeling as if her blood was uncontrollably attempting to exit her body and enter the figure's.
The Ice Soul Zither in her hands, meanwhile, became visibly tarnished, its surface corroded with pitted marks.
However, Yuan Wuji did not intend to kill her.
With a simple wave of his hand, the blood-red phantom flew back to him, vanishing into his body.
Only then did Queen Ming Kong break free from the suffocating oppression, gasping heavily.
Looking at her now tainted Magic Treasure, she felt both distressed and furious, and also somewhat fearful. Only at this moment did she realize the vast gap between her and Yuan Wuji.
"What if I had decided to kill you? Would your worshiped Lord Nether Moon God have intervened?" Yuan Wuji asked.
Queen Ming Kong merely glared coldly at Yuan Wuji, remaining silent.

chapters.title: Chapter 589 - 563 Eager to Try
chapters.content:
Yuan Wuji saw that Queen Ming Kong remained silent, and the blood light in his eyes lit up again as the terrifying aura of the Blood Shadow was released once more, this time without any reservation.
"I don't know, it's most likely not going to happen. Perhaps only the Divine Envoy can summon the descent of a deity." Queen Ming Kong's heart trembled, and she spoke subconsciously.
Yet no sooner had she spoken, she regretted it, but it was already too late.
"Divine Envoy! An apostle of Lord Nether Moon God? Who is it?" Yuan Wuji immediately became interested and asked.
"That Fellow Daoist Yuan." Knowing she could no longer hide the truth, Queen Ming Kong had no choice but to reveal.
"That Core Formation Stage cultivator?" Yuan Wuji frowned, somewhat surprised.
Queen Ming Kong said nothing more, but at this moment, her silence served as an acknowledgment.
"Where is he?" Yuan Wuji immediately pressed on.
"I don't know." Queen Ming Kong shook her head.
She genuinely didn't know Yuan Ming's current whereabouts. Earlier, she had secretly visited the valley where Yuan Ming was supposed to be but didn't find him, and her contacts with Yuan Ming had also been one-sided.
What she couldn't possibly know was that Yuan Ming had long been aware of what was happening here.
Initially, when Queen Ming Kong was praying, he had noticed the situation here. However, he had chosen not to respond because he wanted to assess Yuan Wuji's strength through Queen Ming Kong.
Even after observing, he was still somewhat bewildered, unsure what to make of the Blood Shadow that had burst forth from Yuan Wuji's body, which closely resembled the Blood God Puppet that had followed them at Lank Mountain Peak, yet was somewhat different.
After Yuan Ming described everything that happened outside, Xi Ying furrowed her brows in contemplation for a long time before saying,
"It seems that Yuan Wuji has no intention of fighting to the death. The reason he came knocking was not only to figure out the worth of Lord Nether Moon God but also to establish his dominance, probably to hold more sway when it comes time to confront the Undead Demon Tree together."
"I think so too," Yuan Ming nodded in agreement.
"What's your plan, aren't you going to meet him?" Xi Ying asked with a smile showing on her face.
"That blood-red shadow of his is somewhat strange; if a real fight were to break out, I'm afraid many trump cards would have to be played," Yuan Ming said slowly.
He didn't want to reveal too much of his strength at this time, but judging from Yuan Wuji's demeanor, it seemed unlikely he would leave easily.
"Master, shall I give it a try?" At this moment, Hua Zhi, who had been standing by the side, suddenly spoke up.
"You may be Level 4 now, but facing the Late-stage Nascent Soul Yuan Wuji, your chances of winning are slim. He won't strike me harshly, but I can't say the same for you. It'd be a real injustice if he mistakes you for a descendant of that Undying Tree," Yuan Ming shook his head.
Hearing this, a look of defiance appeared on Hua Zhi's face as she said, "Rest assured, in terms of resistance, no one in this Secret Realm is stronger than me, and though I've just entered Level 4, I also have my Divine Skills. It's perfect to try them out with this opportunity."
"If you want to try, it's not out of the question, but follow my commands," Yuan Ming said after a slight hesitation, his gaze sweeping towards the Sword Trace Canyon in front of the altar.
...
Outside the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space.
Yuan Wuji, getting no reply from Queen Ming Kong, gradually grew colder.
Just as he was about to make a move, suddenly, dense vine branches burst from the ground nearby, twining and coalescing into a beautiful girl dressed in purple.
The crowd, witnessing this scene, all raised their Magic Treasures, instinctively regarding her as akin to the Undying Tree.
Yuan Wuji's gaze swept over her, and his Divine Sense scanned from Hua Zhi's body, only to find her aura dissimilar to that of the Undying Tree's kin, his brows furrowing even tighter as he asked in a deep voice, "Who are you?"
"I am a servant of Lord Nether Moon God; aren't you looking for Lord Nether Moon God?" Hua Zhi, following Yuan Ming's instructions, said.
"Does Lord Nether Moon God intend to dismiss me with just a servant?" Yuan Wuji understood his implication and scoffed.
"My master said, with me taking action, it's more than enough," Hua Zhi glanced at him disdainfully and said.
Yuan Wuji chuckled coldly and said, "A mere Level 4 Demon Beast, you do talk big."
No sooner had his words fallen did his figure suddenly vanish from everyone's sight only to appear abruptly in front of Hua Zhi, raising a hand to strike fiercely towards her chest.
A giant blood-colored palm emerged out of thin air, sweeping across with a thunderous force.
Hua Zhi, startled by this sudden attack, was fortunate her strength had reached Level 4, increasing her reaction speed. She promptly flew backward, her palms meeting Yuan Wuji.
The palms she pushed out turned into vine tendrils, rapidly extending and twining together quickly forming a huge circular Vine Shield.
The blood-colored giant palm struck the Vine Shield, resulting in a 'boom' sound as it burst.
The Vine Shield exploded instantly, turning into countless fragments scattering everywhere.
Even though Hua Zhi had pulled back far enough, the extended arms still burst simultaneously, only stopping near her shoulders, dissipating the residual force.
"Fellow Daoist, such a sudden attack might not be much, but failing to succeed is rather embarrassing," Hua Zhi, with a sparkle of purple light at the site of her severed arms, quickly grew back two new arms and said, wearing a smile.
A flicker of surprise crossed Yuan Wuji's eyes, amazed at Hua Zhi's reflexes; his intention had been to force Lord Nether Moon God to appear by killing the opponent with a bolt from the blue, so though his strike seemed casual, it actually carried nearly eighty percent of his strength.
"Little demon, quite sharp-tongued you are, but I'm not interested in toying with you. Let your master come out instead, or don't blame me for not holding back on the next strike," Yuan Wuji dissipated the blood light in his hand as he spoke.
"Beat me, and you can surely meet my master," Hua Zhi, somewhat awkwardly grinning, said.
"Courting death," Yuan Wuji's eyes abruptly intensified with blood light, and a streak of blood light burst forth from his chest.
The blood light revealed a blurry figure within it, moving extremely fast towards Hua Zhi, and in an instant, it was right in front of her.
Hua Zhi immediately felt an overwhelmingly powerful aura of bloody malevolence enveloping her. This aura was distinct—ruthless, bloodthirsty, dirty, and somewhat malicious—instilling an involuntary fear and repulsion in her.
"Don't be afraid, the time is now!"
At that moment, Yuan Ming's voice rang out in her Sea of Consciousness, instantly dispelling her fear.
Hua Zhi's eyes hardened, and her body suddenly transformed into countless vine branches, forming a gaping maw that devoured the sky. Rather than dodging, she swallowed the blood-red figure in one gulp.
This move stunned everyone else.Find the source of this chapter at *.
"Seeking death!" Yuan Wuji sneered coldly, his Blood God's Son excelled in devouring the enemy's Mana. Once inside the opponent's body, it thrived like a fish in water.
If this Level 4 Vine Demon sought death, he didn't mind giving his newly developed Blood God's Son a boost.
At the same time, a thick white fog appeared out of nowhere, enveloping everyone present.
The fog contained a bizarre power that made it difficult to operate Divine Sense, and many illusions appeared before their eyes, Yuan Wuji included.
Within the fog, Hua Zhi's body swiftly retreated backward, splitting in two. Carrying the clone of the blood-red figure, she dived underground and vanished from sight, appearing inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space.
The Stealing Heaven Tripod Space was also filled with dense white fog, obscuring everything.
Two blood-red eyes appeared on the blood-colored figure's head, passing straight through Hua Zhi's clone.
The clone of Hua Zhi instantly turned into a dried-up corpse, not a trace of vitality remained, and it fell downward.
The Blood Shadow moved, transforming into a streaking blur shooting forward, its eyes warily sweeping the surroundings.
Just then, the fog in front of him suddenly cleared, revealing a long, black gorge. There was no white fog above it, making it strikingly conspicuous and eerie.
The Blood Shadow abruptly stopped beside the gorge and did not continue forward.
"Quite clever," a voice came from the white fog nearby.
The Blood Shadow turned abruptly toward the voice and darted towards it like lightning.
A palm reached out from the white fog, grasping at the void towards the Blood Shadow.
The scene before the Blood Shadow blurred, and the next moment, for some reason, the vast gorge appeared before him.
A look of terror crossed the eyes of the Blood Shadow, who quickly shot out of the gorge. However, terrifying Sword Qi erupted from within the gorge, devouring everything above.
With a slight hissing sound, the blood-colored figure evaporated instantly, leaving no trace behind.
...
Outside, a violent wind suddenly appeared out of nowhere, easily dispersing the white fog by a great deal.
Yuan Wuji held a yellow Feather Fan in his hand and was about to fan again when his expression suddenly changed.
He suddenly discovered that Hua Zhi was standing fine in front of him, yet the connection to his Blood God's Son had been severed, and it wasn't just being blocked; he could no longer sense its existence at all.
Yuan Wuji felt a surge of Qi-Blood and bellowed loudly, "Where is my Blood God's Son? What have you done with him?"
"Your thing was indeed formidable, I couldn't defeat it, but my master only needed to lift a finger to destroy it," Hua Zhi calmly stated.
"Kill her!" Yuan Wuji roared in a fury, no longer caring about testing the waters, and shouted loudly.
Behind him, the Blood Realm Venerable and others, seeing Yuan Wuji's sudden loss of composure, although still unclear about what had happened, also realized the severity of the issue and were about to take action."
Just then, streams of light flew over from a distance, it was White Scale Master and Old Man Hei Zhu coming to help on the instructions of Lord Nether Moon God.
Queen Ming Kong hesitated slightly, then also stood by Hua Zhi's side.
The two sides faced each other, the atmosphere tense to the extreme, a major battle imminent at any moment.
But just then, another abrupt change occurred.
All of a sudden, a layer of pink fog arose on Yuan Wuji, the Blood Realm Venerable, and others, and vivid red fleshy flowers abruptly sprouted from their skin, blooming enchantingly.
At the same time, Yuan Wuji and the rest felt their Mana rapidly draining.
"What is this?" The group's faces changed, their bodies glowing with various colors of light, easily tearing apart the fleshy flowers.
However, more flowers continued to grow, making them impossible to kill.
In just a moment, they felt a void in their Dantians, their eyes filled with disbelief, and hastily retreated."
"Hehe, these are my spores. They parasitized inside you when you first attacked me, and now they are just flowering and fruiting," Hua Zhi said with a smile, clearly enjoying herself.
This was a "Parasite" ability she had awakened after advancing to Level 4.
This ability combined the properties of the transparent Poison Liquid of the Purple Extreme Tai Sui, making the spores not only incredibly fine but also undetectable, just like the Poison Liquid. Yuan Wuji had not noticed it.
"How about it, still want to fight? My master thinks you're somewhat capable and would like to play with you some more," Hua Zhi said provocatively, looking at Yuan Wuji.
Yuan Wuji's face turned livid, blood light re-emerging in his eyes, and suddenly a vague blood shadow covered him.
The fleshy flowers all over his body rapidly decayed under the invasion of the blood shadow, quickly peeling away, and the parasitic spores inside him were also dissolved by the blood light.
Seeing this, Hua Zhi's expression darkened."
Three beams of blood light shot out from Yuan Wuji's palm, merging into the bodies of the Blood Realm Venerable, Lan Xiao, and Bing Li, eradicating the spores within them as well."
Let's go, we're leaving," Yuan Wuji said, looking at Hua Zhi. After a few breaths, he turned and left.

chapters.title: Chapter 590 - 564: Heart Demon Tribulation
chapters.content:
The others, seeing this, followed with grim expressions on their faces.
It was not until they had gone a considerable distance that the Blood Realm Venerable, steeling himself, asked from behind, "Big brother, what exactly happened here?"
"I had refined two Blood God's Sons, and just now, I lost one of them," Yuan Wuji responded without turning back.
"What, lost one of the Blood God's Sons?" Bing Li exclaimed in shock.
"It seems that the Nether Moon God is indeed unfathomable. Fortunately, it appears he had reservations and did not truly aim to deal with me. This time, it was my miscalculation," Yuan Wuji sighed and said slowly.
His mood at the moment was quite complex. This incident had confirmed the Nether Moon God's formidable strength, which was a good thing for dealing with the threat of the Undying Tree in the future. However, he had lost a Blood God's Son for nothing, suffering a great loss.
On the other hand, as a servant of the Nether Moon God, Hua Zhi pacified Queen Ming Kong and several others before leaving to return to the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space.
The battle had cost her a significant amount of power, and she needed to recover properly before she could fully heal.
Yuan Ming, through the recent events, had learned about some of the divine skills of the Blood God's Son, which could be considered as not wasting Hua Zhi's efforts.
But the biggest gain was deterring the Tide-rider Alliance members. He believed that those fellows, having learned their lesson, would be quiet for a while.
As a result of this incident, the Tide-rider Alliance indeed no longer provoked them; the various factions coexisted peacefully. They occasionally held exchange meetings, and when the Tide-rider Alliance needed items from the outside world, they asked for help from the Nether Moon God with much more respect. Harmony the likes of which had never been seen before began to emerge within the secret realm.
...
In the blink of an eye, twenty years had passed.
Within the Stealing Heaven Tripod, the White Jade Lotus Platform shone with golden light as always.
Next to the altar, the Gathering Spirit Tree ceaselessly harnessed spiritual energy, enveloped in a faint glow that resembled fireflies, mystical and splendid.
However, inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod now, it was not the only ancient tree growing in solitude.
In the nearby spirit field, the Five Elements Creation Tree had grown to about ten feet tall, its branches and leaves displaying five colors, seemingly chaotic but in fact orderly.
Xi Ying was currently seated cross-legged under the tree, with five-colored light swirling up from her body like dragons and snakes, heading towards the Five Elements Creation Tree and melding with it. From the tree's roots, five-colored spiritual light also poured into Xi Ying's body. This cycle of Circulation kept improving the progress of her Ju Mang Spirit Technique.
However, as an Ancient Spiritual Wood, the growth of the Five Elements Creation Tree was incredibly difficult. Its stature of just about ten feet was the result of Xi Ying's careful cultivation over the past twenty years. Yet even so, her Ju Mang Spirit Technique was still revolving within the First Level.
Xi Ying was already on the verge a breakthrough before, and the improvement in aptitude brought about by reaching the First Level of the Ju Mang Spirit Technique had indeed helped her break through the Heavenly Barrier and smoothly enter the Nascent Soul Stage.
After the breakthrough, Xi Ying continued to practice the Ju Mang Spirit Technique diligently, with no intention of giving up.
With the aid of the Ju Mang Spirit Technique and the Five Elements Creation Tree, her mana had become much more refined, and she was not far from the peak of the Nascent Soul Early Stage.
Xi Ying also didn't spend all her time on the Ju Mang Spirit Technique and occasionally took time to practice other secret techniques and Cultivation Techniques.
The five-colored light on her body rapidly dissipated, replaced instead by an extremely rich earthy-yellow spirit light that slowly lifted her body.
At this moment, Xi Ying was practicing the Taiyin Refining Spleen Technique.
Unlike Yuan Ming, she was not lacking an Earth Spirit Root, and practicing this technique was indeed complementary. Ever since she had broken through to the Nascent Soul and received this technique from Yuan Ming, she enthusiastically began to practice it, and by now had achieved a very profound level of mastery.
In these twenty years, Yuan Ming's gains were also tremendous.
The once small Undying Tree had now grown into a towering black tree of several dozen feet high, with spread branches and leaves.
As it grew, it had emerged from Yuan Ming's body and taken root within the Stealing Heaven Tripod, occupying a considerable space inside.
Compared to the Five Elements Creation Tree, the growth of the Undying Tree could only be described as rapid. Thanks to this, Yuan Ming's Ju Mang Spirit Technique made leaps and bounds, reaching the Third Realm.
But since the Undying Tree had grown from within Yuan Ming, half his body was fused with the tree, making it difficult to distinguish himself from it.
Yuan Ming's face bore a wry smile—he had indeed been thoroughly duped by the Ju Mang Spirit Technique and Xi Ying.
The Undying Tree had taken root in his body and fused deeply. Even if he perfected the Ju Mang Spirit Technique or gave it up, whether he could separate from this peculiar tree remained uncertain.
One misstep and he might have to stay forever with this black Undying Tree.
However, merging with the black tree was not without its benefits. The Undying Tree could autonomously absorb nature's spiritual energy, so now Yuan Ming had an additional source of spiritual energy, making his mana recovery speed far exceed that of other cultivators; naturally, his stamina increased significantly.
In these past twenty years, he had not slackened in his cultivation of the Nine Elements Technique.
Outside Three Immortals Island, Yan Si Jing had refined all the demon elixir and spirit grass he had given her into pills and sent them back to him.
With the power of the elixirs, Yuan Ming's mana rapidly increased, and he had now reached the late-stage Core Formation.
Apart from being a Magic Practitioner, Yuan Ming had also made progress in Soul Cultivation and Body Cultivation.
He had already broken through to the Innate Body Realm ten years ago, and he was now at the middle stage of the Innate Body Realm. The inner breath he refined was as red as fresh blood, and it also possessed the refining effectiveness of the Shura Blood Devouring Map.
The main reason the Body Cultivation Realm's advancement slowed down was because of the black great tree.
To complete the Ju Mang Spirit Technique as soon as possible, Yuan Ming prioritized supplying the abundant Blood Origin Power from within the Shura Blood Devouring Map to the growth of the Undying Tree. The demon beasts delivered by Huan Ling Zi and others were also thrown to the black great tree for absorption.
As the Undying Tree grew larger, its demand for Qi Blood Power increased, and the Blood Origin Power within the Shura Blood Devouring Map was quickly drained. It was also not easy for Huan Ling Zi and the others to capture demon beasts outside, which is why the advancement in the Body Cultivation Realm relatively slowed down.
In terms of Soul Cultivation, the Ju Mang Spirit Technique did not bring about any constraints. With the Will Power supplied by Yun Jiuxiao and others, Yuan Ming's Divine Soul had also reached the peak of being a love witch fifteen years ago, just half a step away from the Sleeping Witch Realm.
For a smoother reading experience, visit MV&LEMPYR.
Originally, Yuan Ming prepared to breakthrough to the Sleeping Witch Realm in one go. However, at this time, Xi Ying told him to wait and not rush the breakthrough, and she even asked him to temporarily stop absorbing Desire Power.
Yuan Ming was puzzled and wanted to ask for the reason, but Xi Ying, going against her usual behavior, did not give a direct answer. She only told him that she would explain when the time came and that before this, she hoped Yuan Ming would temporarily forget about breaking through to the Sleeping Witch Realm.
Although Yuan Ming did not understand, he still did as told, and he had his first soul absorb the excess Desire Power, which now was not the least inferior to the original in terms of Soul Power.
Twenty years have passed, and Yuan Ming indeed began to forget about the breakthrough to the Sleeping Witch Realm. Perhaps it was due to his integration with the tree, but his temperament had become more stable and he favored quietness over action.
Half a year passed in this manner, and one day, as Yuan Ming was meditating, Xi Ying's voice woke him:
"Now, you should be able to try breaking through to the Sleeping Witch Realm."
Yuan Ming nodded, inspected his Divine Soul, and voiced his doubt, "After all these years, there has been almost no change in my Divine Soul. Why was I not able to try for a breakthrough before, and now I can?"
"Because at that time, you had absorbed too much Desire Power. You must know that Desire Power contains a large number of miscellaneous thoughts of living beings. The presence of these thoughts would greatly increase the difficulty of breaking through to the Sleeping Witch Realm. Therefore, to break through, you must temporarily cease absorbing Desire Power," Xi Ying answered.
"But I have already used the Heart Cleansing Technique to refine away the miscellaneous thoughts in the Desire Power. Moreover, after the transformation through the Stealing Heaven Tripod, it's all purely refined Desire Power without miscellaneous thoughts that can be directly absorbed. It shouldn't affect the breakthrough," Yuan Ming said, growing more puzzled.
"The refinement of the Heart Cleansing Technique isn't perfect. Desire Power is born inseparable from miscellaneous thoughts, and even if they are removed later through various means, while it may not affect daily practice, it will still have an influence on the Heavenly Tribulation that descends during the breakthrough to the Sleeping Witch Realm. This is the law of nature, and no one can change it," Xi Ying shook her head.
"How then did those Sleeping Witches of the Wu Yue Sect manage to breakthrough?" Yuan Ming asked, curious.
"The sect uses various secret techniques to reduce this impact, and the most effective one is for the Wu Yue God herself to personally assist in the breakthrough. It's said that only those who have accomplished great things for the Wu Yue Sect and caught the eye of the Wu Yue God as chosen children can receive such treatment," Xi Ying explained.
Yuan Ming suddenly understood, recalling the scene when Xi Ying had broken through to the Nascent Soul Stage. He asked further, "You just mentioned the Heavenly Tribulation that comes with breaking through to the Sleeping Witch Realm. Are you referring to thunder tribulation?"
"There's no such thing as thunder tribulation when breaking through to the Sleeping Witch Realm. After all, Soul Cultivators refine their Divine Souls, and if they faced calamities like thunder, I fear no one could break through," Xi Ying shook her head.
"Then, it must be the Heart Demon Tribulation," Yuan Ming realized.
"Correct. Soul Cultivators advancing to the Sleeping Witch Realm will undoubtedly face the test of the Heart Demon Tribulation. This barrier is extremely difficult to overcome. There are many love witches within the Wu Yue Sect, but very few Sleeping Witches, and this is because of the Heart Demon Tribulation," Xi Ying said.
Yuan Ming's expression turned serious, and he asked, "It seems this tribulation is no trivial matter. Do you know what exactly the Heart Demon Tribulation is like, and are there any tricks to resolve it?"
"The Heart Demon Tribulation manifests differently for different people. The method I used may not suit you, and talking about it now might even mislead you," Xi Ying shook her head.
"Does that mean I can only leave it to fate?" Yuan Ming furrowed his brows.
"Not necessarily. While I can't tell you the specific method of resolution, the general approach is always eight words—'adhere to oneself, never forget one's initial resolve.'"
As she spoke, Xi Ying suddenly handed a Jade Scroll over to Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming took the Jade Scroll, which outlined a technique called "Three Souls and Nine Refinements."
"Before entering Three Immortals Island, I didn't expect you would attempt to break through to the Sleeping Witch Realm here, and didn't prepare supporting elixirs in time. Now, this secret technique is the only thing that can help refine your Divine Soul to its ultimate, thereby increasing the chances of your breakthrough. You must concentrate on understanding and practicing this technique until you've completely mastered it before attempting to breakthrough," Xi Ying instructed, concern flickering in her eyes.
Seeing her like this, Yuan Ming was not very anxious, "Don't worry, I've already experienced the power of the Sleeping Witch Realm in advance through the Stealing Heaven Tripod. Now making an actual breakthrough shouldn't pose any problems."
Xi Ying merely nodded slightly, hiding her worries deep within her heart, not saying anything further.

chapters.title: Chapter 591 - 565: Illusory World Reincarnation
chapters.content:
Ninety-one days later.
Within the Stealing Heaven Tripod, Yuan Ming sat cross-legged within the tree, calming his heart and concentrating his spirit, making the final preparations before his breakthrough.
After a period of arduous cultivation, he had refined the "Three Souls and Nine Refinements" to its extreme, and he could now clearly sense the bottleneck of the Sleeping Witch Realm.
Not far away, Xi Ying held Guoguo in her arms, one hand gently stroking its back fur, looking at Yuan Ming who was preparing for his breakthrough, and finally reminded, "If anything seems amiss, I will forcibly help you dispel the Heart Demon."
The Heart Demon Tribulation would not affect others, so there was no need for Xi Ying to leave too far.
Yuan Ming gave Xi Ying a reassuring look, then quietly closed his eyes and began the final attempt at a breakthrough in his state of mind.
All the Soul Power in his Sea of Consciousness was activated, circulating in a strange and unpredictable way, as his consciousness gradually grew dim.
Yuan Ming did not resist this process, and soon fell into a deep sleep.
...
In Da Jin, at Qu Jiang, within the Prime Minister's Mansion.
The night was deep, yet Yuan Ming still sat at his desk handling documents.
As the Prime Minister of Da Jin, although Yuan Ming held a position of extreme authority, he had never considered indulging in pleasure, instead devoting all his attention to his official duties.
For the good days of the people of the entire world, what did it matter if he toiled for a few more hours?
"Tap, tap, tap"
Outside the room, a series of light footsteps suddenly arose. The guard at the door moved, identified the person approaching, and let him into the room.
"Prime Minister Yuan, there is an imperial edict from His Majesty," said the person who had just entered, none other than Liu Tianming's personal eunuch, Eunuch Zhang.
Yuan Ming raised his head, his expression becoming tense: "Eunuch Zhang, has something significant happened in the palace?"
Eunuch Zhang shook his head, took out a memorial from his sleeves, and placed it on Yuan Ming's desk.
Seeing the familiar handwriting on the cover of the memorial, Yuan Ming's face darkened instantly: "This is the memorial I presented today. Why has His Majesty specifically sent Eunuch Zhang to return it?"
"Prime Minister Yuan, His Majesty said that your intentions with this memorial were good, but the widespread promotion of Spirit Root detection would offend too many people, and Chang Chun Temple would not agree," sighed Eunuch Zhang.
"Why is that? There are countless subjects in Da Jin, many of whom possess Spirit Roots yet suffer from having no way to step onto the path of cultivation. If the court steps in and organizes Spirit Root detection for them, wouldn't all the major sects gain more disciples? This matter is beneficial in every way and harms none. How could it offend people?" Yuan Ming frowned.
"Alas, Prime Minister Yuan, you see, although our Da Jin has a population far exceeding tens of millions, only one in ten thousand may possess Spirit Roots, and among them, those with Four Spirit Roots and Three Spirit Roots are the most common. Just like you... ahem, in short, these people are not wanted by Chang Chun Temple. They can only be taken in by other sects. Therefore, a unified Spirit Root detection has no benefit for Chang Chun Temple, and moreover, throughout Da Jin, there are countless large and small Cultivation Families. Even the disciples within their ranks have inadequate talents. They don't even have enough spots for their own, let alone spare any for commoners with Spirit Roots?" Eunuch Zhang shook his head.
"Absurd! Such an act that benefits the nation and the people is hindered due to opposition from these Cultivation Families, and thus cannot be implemented? Is our Da Jin the Da Jin of the people, or is it theirs?" exclaimed Yuan Ming in anger.
"Prime Minister Yuan, please be cautious with your words," Eunuch Zhang, startled, quickly looked around and whispered a reminder.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming took a deep breath and calmed himself: "If it cannot be implemented, then let it be rejected by His Majesty. Why did you have to bring it here personally?"
"His Majesty thought it would be best for you to burn the memorial yourself to be safe, to prevent Chang Chun Temple from catching any wind of it and secretly bringing harm to you," Eunuch Zhang said, lowering his voice even further.
Yuan Ming looked at the memorial, pondered for a long time, and finally took it upon himself to fetch the brazier and throw the memorial into it.
Eunuch Zhang watched the memorial turn to ashes and also breathed a sigh of relief: "Please forgive my blunt words, Prime Minister Yuan, but it's best if similar memorials are presented less often in the future, to avoid making things difficult for His Majesty. Although he is the Emperor, he still has Chang Chun Temple above him. There are some matters out of his control."
Yuan Ming remained expressionless, muttering to himself, "Tianming, though he is the Emperor, is still imprisoned by invisible chains and not free."
Eunuch Zhang nodded, ready to turn around and leave. However, on reaching the door, he unexpectedly added, "Prime Minister Yuan, to tell the truth, this Da Jin is actually the Da Jin of Chang Chun Temple. How could we, mere mortals, ever contend with those Immortals?"
Yuan Ming didn't answer. After Eunuch Zhang left, he turned back to the memorials on his desk but could not manage to read a single word further.
Decades later, Liu Tianming advanced to Foundation Establishment and passed the throne to his eldest son before entering Chang Chun Temple for arduous cultivation. Yuan Ming took the opportunity to seize complete control of the court, joined forces with all major sects except Chang Chun Temple, and once again petitioned to open the Immortal Examination to select cultivation talents from among the common folk.
The whole court and country were shaken, yet no one came forward to stop it. Just when everyone thought the matter was settled, a Core Formation Elder from Chang Chun Temple personally arrived in Qu Jiang, and the State Preceptor Yu Hu captured Yuan Ming, imprisoning him in the Heavenly Prison. Within a day, the charge of plotting rebellion was confirmed, and he was executed on the streets.
Legend has it that before Yuan Ming's death, he was neither happy nor sad as he stood in the street and questioned the State Preceptor, Yu Hu, asking why he refused to bestow immortal fate upon the world's common people. Yu Hu did not answer, but simply hastily ordered his henchmen to execute Yuan Ming.
Although Yuan Ming died, his deeds and aspirations spread widely with the support of those who shared his vision.
Decades passed, and many loose cultivators with unclear origins emerged among the people of Da Jin. The major sects also secretly formed an alliance to incite a wave of resistance against Chang Chun Temple.
...
Southern Border.
Once prosperous, Biluo Cave had been completely destroyed by the Dawn Alliance, and Yuan Ming, as a closed-door disciple of Ling Songhua, had received news early and, together with his brothers from the Fire Refining Hall, had avoided that crucial battle.
After the war, Yuan Ming bid farewell to Li Zhui and his master Ling Songhua and embarked on a solo journey to regain his lost memories.
After several twists and turns, he achieved Foundation Establishment through a stroke of fate and spent several years in the Central Plains before finally returning to Qu Jiang and saw his biological parents.
However, even after living with his parents day and night, he still could not recover the memories he had lost years ago. After a few years, he left Qu Jiang again and returned to the Southern Border to find Li Zhui and Ling Songhua once more. He shared his experiences during that time and made a request.
"Senior Li, Master, I have the audacity to ask if you could take on the role of elders in the reconstruction of Three Stars Mountain. There is no need to involve yourselves in everything, just lending your names would suffice," Yuan Ming respectfully said.
Li Zhui fell silent, while Ling Songhua directly asked, "Now that you've found your parents in the Central Plains and have a brother in Chang Chun Temple, why have you returned to the Southern Border to start anew? Wouldn't it be more delightful to stay in a major sect in the Central Plains than to suffer here?"
"I have mediocre talent, and even if I relied on Liu Tianming's favor to stay in Chang Chun Temple, I would achieve nothing significant in my life. Moreover, as a former Beast Slave, I understand the suffering of the loose cultivators and common people in the Southern Border and Northern Territory the most. Even with Biluo Cave destroyed, can the other four sects truly be any better than Biluo Cave? I returned to provide the cultivators of the Southern Border and Northern Territory with another option and to bring civilization and education to the common people here," Yuan Ming explained.
Li Zhui sighed, "What you are trying to do is difficult. Even with our support, it will not be easy to establish a foothold in the Northern Territory."
Fi-rs%t! se.en on MV4#L$E@MP+|&YR..#
"As long as I give it my all, even if unsuccessful, I can do so without regrets," Yuan Ming insisted.
After a long silence, Li Zhui and Ling Songhua eventually agreed to Yuan Ming's request.
Years later, through Yuan Ming's relentless effort, an agreement was finally reached with the other four sects to rebuild Three Stars Mountain. Yuan Ming became the Sect Leader and disciples from the Fire Refining Hall returned to contribute to the sect.
Using his connections in the Central Plains, Yuan Ming quickly rallied the Green Rock Association to his side after establishing his sect, and with their influence, it took him several years to finally secure a foothold in the Southern Border and Northern Territory.
Afterward, he actively recruited disciples and set up schools in the various Wild Man tribes under his jurisdiction, educating them while discovering many cultivation seeds.
Gradually, under Yuan Ming's leadership, Three Stars Mountain's influence grew. But this also attracted the covetous eyes of the Green Rock Association. Fortunately, at a critical moment, Yuan Ming achieved Core Formation and publicly defeated the president of the Green Rock Association. With both kindness and authority, he eventually absorbed the Green Rock Association into his own force.
In the subsequent decades, aside from cultivating, Yuan Ming also subtly maneuvered until at the age of one hundred and twenty, when he finally broke through to the late stage of Core Formation, he completely subdued the other three sects, nearly unifying the Southern Border and Northern Territory.
Yuan Ming's philosophy of cultivation spread throughout every corner of the Southern Border and Northern Territory.
Thirty years later, on Yuan Ming's 150th birthday celebration, Core Formation elders from various major sects of the Southern Border and Northern Territory gathered to offer their congratulations. Three Stars Mountain was adorned with lights and decorations, buzzing with excitement.
"Where is Yuan Ming?" Suddenly, from the sky descended an overwhelming pressure from someone at the Nascent Soul level. Everyone on Three Stars Mountain fell silent, too afraid to speak.
However, Yuan Ming, despite the pressure, flew up into the sky and bowed to the visitor, "I am Yuan Ming. I apologize for not welcoming you from afar, please forgive me."
"I am the Supreme Elder of the Gu Xian Sect in the Southern Domain of the Southern Border. Yuan Ming, do you know your crime?" the visitor declared his identity, then took on a posture of reprimanding.
"May the senior please clarify what crime I have committed?" Yuan Ming raised his head.
The Supreme Elder of Gu Xian Sect looked at Yuan Ming and chuckled softly, then said in a low voice, "You're only 150 years old, aren't you? So young, yet already half a step into Nascent Soul stage; you're indeed talented. Unfortunately, the Southern Border and Northern Territory must not be unified, nor should another Nascent Soul be born here. However, I can give you an opportunity to join my Gu Xian Sect. All past issues will be wiped clean, and you won't be troubled by anyone further."
"...And what of my disciples and the Southern Border and Northern Territory afterwards?" Yuan Ming suddenly asked.
"The way things were before, that's how they should remain," said the Supreme Elder of Gu Xian Sect, his words heavy with implication.
Yuan Ming fell silent, then resolutely shook his head, "Thank you for your kind offer, but I must decline."
Upon hearing this, the Supreme Elder of Gu Xian Sect's eyes flashed with a cold glint, "Hmph, obstinate fool! Since you insist on seeking death, I shall grant you your wish!"
Unexpectedly, just as he finished speaking, Yuan Ming sighed, "I had anticipated the intentions of the Southern Domain long ago; I just didn't expect this day to come so soon. It's a pity I'm just one step away from reaching Nascent Soul. Ah well, since everything is already in place for what comes after, what's there to regret?"

chapters.title: Chapter 592 - 566 For Freedom
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming finished speaking, and suddenly, a sinister rune emerged on his body, bursting forth with a dazzling golden light that was impossible for others to stare directly at.
The Supreme Elder of the Gu Xian Sect had no time to react before a blinding spirit light exploded from Yuan Ming's body. A spiritual pressure assaulted from all directions, causing the elder to gasp for breath, completely unable to make any move.
Then came a "boom," and the sky was instantly enveloped by thick smoke and dust.
A moment later, the Nascent Soul of the Gu Xian Sect's Supreme Elder staggered out of the smoke, looked back resentfully, and then quickly fled.
The people on the mountain were at a loss due to the sudden turn of events, and at this time, a forbidden seal within Yuan Ming's cave mansion suddenly opened. A Sound Transmission Talisman flew out, floating before everyone's eyes, spontaneously combusting, and Yuan Ming's resounding voice emanated from within.
"Everyone, the appearance of this talisman proves that I have been killed by a Nascent Soul from the Southern Border Southern Domain. They are also from the Southern Border, yet they only regard the Northern Territory as their breeding ground for gu creatures and a chess piece to block the Central Plains, preventing us from ascending to immortality and forever being under their control. Now, although I am dead, the Nascent Soul Meat and physical body that killed me have also been destroyed by my dying counterattack. There are still a few elders in Three Stars Mountain who know of such methods. As long as everyone here works together, we from the Southern Border Northern Territory will certainly no longer be ants under the Southern Domain's control!"
Yuan Ming's words were not loud but fell into the ears of all present with crystal clarity, causing the cultivators' hearts to surge tumultuously.
Seeing Yuan Ming exchange his life to repel a Nascent Soul, the cultivators one by one declared their stance, willing to regard Three Stars Mountain as their leader. Indeed, for the following decades, they truly united, shared a common enemy, while the major sects of the Southern Border Southern Domain fell into a strange silence, with no Nascent Soul cultivator coming to the Northern Territory again.
Sixty years later, Fang Ge, the new Great Elder of Three Stars Mountain, advanced to the Nascent Soul Stage, and Three Stars Mountain definitively became the ruler of the Southern Border Northern Territory, a neutral force between the Central Plains and the Southern Border Southern Domain.
...
Black Wind Desert.
After overcoming numerous hardships, Yuan Ming advanced to Core Formation in this place and occupied an underground city, taking on the role of City Lord. From then on, he strictly cracked down on slave trading, rescuing many commoners and Loose Cultivators. However, this also led to him offending the stubborn forces within the Black Wind Desert, and ultimately, he was ambushed, plunged into the Soul Burying Abyss, yet because of this mistake, he accidentally broke through the sealing of the Shura Palace.
After the reappearance of Shura Palace, Nascent Soul cultivators like Thunderbolt Ancestor arrived together, competing overtly and covertly within the palace. However, they were all eventually subdued by the Six Desires Venerable. Seeing Six Desires about to succeed, the Residual Soul of the Shura Master had no choice but to initiate the last resort, choosing Yuan Ming as the Successor and sending him and the Shura Blood Devouring Map out of Shura Palace. Then, he activated the seals and once more sealed the Shura Palace.
Hundreds of years passed, and after enduring numerous tribulations, Yuan Ming finally achieved Late-stage Nascent Soul, returned to Shura Palace, and after battling the Six Desires Venerable for three days and three nights, he killed him.
Having resolved all past grudges, he then set off to explore overseas, but ultimately was lost in the search and perished.
...
In the Western Region, Yuan Ming accidentally arrived here while escaping from the Central Plains.
Using his identity as a Soul Cultivator and traveling incognito, he diligently cultivated, and his skills steadily climbed. Eventually, as a person from the Central Plains, he defeated all the Nascent Souls of the Western Region, was hailed as the Western Regions Sovereign, and ended the war between the Western Region and the Central Plains. He received the Ancient Body Cultivation inheritance, achieved the Body of Wanxiang, and unified the Five Domains within several years. He gathered the strength of all cultivators of the Yunhuang Continent to explore overseas together and ended up perishing in the process.If yоu'rе nоt оn М*VLЕМ*РYR, yоu'rе viеwing а соpy.
...
In the East Sea, Yuan Ming, after many travels, joined the Tide-rider Alliance and devoted his life to seeking the path overseas. Although he died, he left behind countless valuable exploratory data for future generations.
...
In the Northern Desert, former Venerable Yuan Ming of the Wu Yue Sect, upon learning the true intentions of the Wu Yue Sect, resolutely raised the banner of revolt against the Wu Yue God.
...
Inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod, a day had passed since Yuan Ming began his breakthrough.
Xi Ying's face was calm, but her eyes revealed a hint of worry.
Yuan Ming was still in a deep sleep, with his Soul Power operating in the manner of Three Souls and Nine Refinements. A crystal light flickered in his brow, as if a flame was burning.
His Soul Power was much weaker than before, not even half of its peak.
The terror of the Heart Demon Tribulation lay in its insidious unpredictability. It did not simply and brutally attack a cultivator's Divine Soul; instead, it would find a weakness and cause the cultivator to sink in different ways.
Those who were cowardly and feared death would experience countless ways to die and dissolve their own Divine Soul; those with great ambitions would find everything going their way until they were lost in the illusion.
Xi Ying didn't know what exactly Yuan Ming had gone through during this time, but she firmly believed that, with Yuan Ming's temperament, he would definitely not fall to the Heart Demon Tribulation like other mediocre cultivators.
In reality, the so-called secret technique of Three Souls and Nine Refinements was essentially burning the Divine Soul, forcibly comprehending the truth of the Sleeping Witch. If successful, one would leap over the dragon gate to an unlimited future.
If unsuccessful, the result would be the disintegration of the soul, perishing without leaving a trace.
For thousands of years, too many members of the Xi Family had burned their Divine Souls and fallen while practicing this secret technique.
With the sacrifice of so many lives, the Xi Family had come to a fairly accurate conclusion about breaking through the Sleeping Witch with the Three Souls and Nine Refinements.
If the secret technique of Three Souls and Nine Refinements consumed seventy percent of one's Soul Power and still showed no sign of a breakthrough, there would only be failure.
"You need to speed up the process..." murmured Xi Ying.
In the pure white space, Yuan Ming slowly awoke, feeling as if he had just had a very long dream.
In front of him, a white figure suddenly appeared, with an especially familiar voice: "After countless lifetimes, you have never died a natural death. Why do you strive so relentlessly and recklessly? What are you truly seeking?"

chapters.title: Chapter 593 - 566 For Freedom_2
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming was still in a state of half-sleep, half-consciousness when he heard the question and subconsciously answered, "For freedom."
Upon hearing this, the white figure was somewhat surprised and let out a laugh, "With great power at your disposal and glory beside you, aren't you free? As the sole ruler, with the Five Domains bowing down, aren't you free?"
"But the things I wish to do, and am capable of doing, I've never been able to achieve—how is that freedom?" Yuan Ming retorted.
The white figure seemed stumped by the question and, after a long time, suddenly sighed, "But how do you know that those who restrict your freedom aren't doing so to protect you? And the things you do for so-called freedom might not necessarily be right."
"If there were ironclad evidence that I am wrong, I would give up. But without it, it's not just a few lifetimes, but thousands, even tens of thousands of lifetimes, I will never give up," Yuan Ming said with an unprecedented determination.
No sooner had the words left his mouth than everything around them violently shattered, with Yuan Ming's vast Divine Soul Power dissipating by seventy percent, yet the remaining Soul Power became purer, and his Divine Soul as clear and transparent as colored glaze.
At that moment, his Divine Soul shook violently, a weak but brand-new force surged out from his Sea of Consciousness, and his Divine Soul began to undergo a transformation.
Xi Ying looked at Yuan Ming, half-embedded in the black tree, without daring to relax for even a moment.
Guoguo also stared intently at Yuan Ming, motionless, as if afraid of startling him.
The flickering crystal light between Yuan Ming's brows suddenly stilled, and strands of moon-like light appeared in the void, converging towards his Sea of Consciousness, halting the weakening trend of his Divine Soul, which then started to strengthen.
Guoguo's face revealed joy, emitting excited cries, and Xi Ying too was overjoyed, finally letting go of the heart she had been holding up.
"I knew you could do it..."
More and more moonlight merged into his Sea of Consciousness, Yuan Ming's Soul Power slowly intensified, the pace accelerating from slow to fast.
After an indeterminate amount of time, under intense stimulation, Yuan Ming's physical body suddenly opened its eyes, and his consciousness returned to his body.
The dream was over.
...
Instantly, a mighty wave of Soul Power spread out, resonating throughout the entire Stealing Heaven Tripod Space, like a powerful storm washing over Xi Ying's body.
Unknowingly, Xi Ying felt a hint of fatigue, her eyelids slowly drooping, about to close.
However, her Divine Soul in her Sea of Consciousness snapped alert, waking from the brink of drowsiness, a flash of alarm crossing her eyes.
Having been in the Sleep Witch Realm for many years, she had nearly been unable to withstand Yuan Ming's unconscious soul assault.
"Stabilize your realm quickly, don't let your Soul Power dissipate naturally!" Xi Ying glared at Yuan Ming, her tone chiding but with a hint of happiness at the bottom of her heart.
Yuan Ming smiled and closed his eyes again, reining in the scattered Soul Power and stabilizing his realm.
It took three full days and nights for Yuan Ming's Soul Power to become completely calm.
His Divine Soul suddenly floated out from his body, taking human shape, and hovered in midair.
The Divine Soul spread both hands, gathering specks of moonlight that fused into its body,
"After reaching the Sleep Witch Realm, I can directly absorb the Yin Qi of moonlight to temper my soul body. Is this the true intent of the Moonlight Technique you mentioned before?" Yuan Ming's Divine Soul asked Xi Ying.
"Indeed, only by attaining this realm can the Divine Soul undergo a true transformation," Xi Ying replied.
Yuan Ming nodded and flew down to land in front of Xi Ying.
"After breaking through the Sleep Witch Realm, the Divine Soul can leave the body for a longer time. Now that my physical body cannot separate from the black tree, I can indeed use the soul body to walk around," Yuan Ming said with a smile.
"You're thinking too simply. The soul body is such an important thing. Most people would hide it if they could, unless they possess Divine Skills. Otherwise, who would expose it so carelessly? It's only used as a last resort or for escaping, much like a Magic Practitioner's Nascent Soul," Xi Ying shook her head.
"You're right." Yuan Ming nodded with a smile, then sat his Divine Soul down on the White Jade Lotus Platform.
Pure Desire Power immediately flowed into the Divine Soul, briskly pushing its cultivation to the peak of the Sleep Witch Realm in just a moment.
However, Yuan Ming shook his head slightly, "Unfortunately, I thought that with the White Jade Lotus Platform, I could elevate my Divine Soul to another Great Realm. It seems it's still not enough."
"Be content. It's not so easy to break through to the Word Witch Realm. Across the entire Yunhuang Continent, aside from the Wuyue God, a Word Witch, no one else has ever reached the Word Witch Realm," Xi Ying rolled her eyes.
Yuan Ming casually made a note of the name of the next realm of soul cultivation, "Speaking of which, after cultivating to the Sleep Witch Realm, the Moonlight Technique has reached its limit. I wonder if there are any more techniques to cultivate afterward."
"The 'Moonlight Technique' has been passed down in my clan until now, there should be no continuation. And as I said, the entire Yunhuang hasn't seen another Word Witch. How could there possibly exist a technique to cultivate to that level?" Xi Ying shook her head.
With a sigh, Yuan Ming then began to use Inner Observation to check the changes in his Divine Skills.
The number of soul crows doubled, reaching twenty-four, and the distance of Far Travel also skyrocketed to one hundred and twenty li.
The power of "soul collision" and "Crow Cry" had doubled once again.
Need character sheets and glossaries? Visit *.
As for the "Soul Search" ability, it was now faster and could directly modify other people's memories. Additionally, this ability could be extended to soul crows over long distances, but the effect and speed would weaken as the distance increased.
The "Soul Feeding" ability was now effective on stronger living creatures, while "Corpse Control" had improved to the point where controlled corpses could move like ordinary people.
The effect and duration of the "Emotion Manipulation" ability were considerably enhanced, allowing easy control over a person's emotions, causing them to fall into extreme sadness or fury, creating a Heart Demon-like existence to dominate their life and death.
In addition to these existing abilities, the breakthrough to the Sleep Witch Realm brought Yuan Ming a brand new ability called "Nightmare."
This was a wide-ranging ability that allowed him to force those within his Divine Sense's coverage to fall into a deep sleep. Anyone whose Soul Power was weaker than his own could not escape.
"Nightmare" could also provoke the deepest and most terrifying memories in a person's heart, turning them into an endless bad dream. Those trapped in the nightmare would continually suffer from fear, unable to extricate themselves, and could eventually die from fright.
Unlike Illusion Techniques, the nightmares created by the "Nightmare" ability were not entirely constructed by Yuan Ming, so even if his victims feared something Yuan Ming had never seen, it would still appear in their nightmares.
The "Nightmare" ability was immensely powerful, but it also consumed a significant amount of Soul Power. The more people dragged into the dream, the greater the consumption of Soul Power, so it was not to be overused.
Afterward, he discussed with Xi Ying some insights about the cultivation of the Sleep Witch Realm, and then each of them returned to their closed-door cultivation, continuing their own cultivation journeys.

chapters.title: Chapter 594 - 567: Striking at Nascent Soul
chapters.content:
Time passed, and in the blink of an eye, another eight or nine years had gone by.
In the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space, the Undying Tree had grown significantly taller, its lush branches and leaves nearly covering the altar beneath them.
Yuan Ming's body was still embedded in the Undying Tree, wrapped in a radiance of green light, extremely dazzling.
Suddenly, he opened his eyes, emitting two captivating beams of brilliance, like two bolts of lightning piercing the night.
"It wasn't in vain that I cultivated day and night, I've finally reached the peak of Late-stage Core Formation at the last moment," Yuan Ming said with joy on his face.
The Blood Origin Power from inside the Shura Blood Devouring Map had already been exhausted long ago; Huan Ling Zi and the others had limited strength. Given that time flowed differently outside compared to the Time Cave Secret Realm—only eight or nine days passing outside—they had only managed to kill a few Third-level Demon Beasts to feed the growth of the Undying Tree. His advancement in Body Cultivation remained unchanged, still at the Mid-stage Innate Body.
Likewise, due to the lack of Qi-Blood Power, the progress of the Ju Mang Spirit Technique had slowed down, still stuck at the third layer.
In terms of Soul Cultivation, thanks to the Divine Soul offerings from Nascent Soul cultivators like White Scale Master and Old Man Hei Zhu, he made some progress, although he was still far from reaching the Mid-stage Sleep Witch.
However, the first Split Soul was creating a significant stir. His main soul had broken through the Sleep Witch stage, and the first Split Soul also showed faint signs of a breakthrough.
But Yuan Ming didn't pay much attention to Body Cultivation or Soul Cultivation, as he devoted most of his efforts to the cultivation of the Nine Elements Technique.
Yuan Ming reined in his surging mana, showing a pensive expression.
Now, only a few months were left before the thirty-year deadline set by the Black and White Artifact Spirits. The Time Cave Secret Realm was peaceful, and the nature's spiritual energy within the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space was becoming increasingly dense, a prime opportunity to attempt the breakthrough to Nascent Soul.
Although it was a bit rushed, Xi Ying had long ago refined a Five Elements Infant Condensing Pill for him. After completing the third level of the Ju Mang Spirit Technique, his Spirit Root situation was comparable to that of Dual Spirit Roots, and the chances of success were quite significant. If he could indeed be so fortunate to succeed, his ability to confront the Undead Tree Demon would be much improved.
