With this thought in mind, Yuan Ming closed his eyes once more and began to circulate the Nine Elements Technique.
Half a month later, all preparations were complete. It was only the third soul used for the Nascent Soul Advancement that remained outside, which needed to be summoned back.
Yuan Ming controlled a branch of the Undying Tree to descend, touching the White Jade Lotus Platform.
Now, merged as one with the Undying Tree, using its branches to touch the White Jade Lotus Platform had the same effect as if he himself were sitting upon it.
...
East Sea Changqing Island.
As a third-level island, the turmoil and flames of war that troubled the East Sea had not yet spread to this unremarkable little island.
However, the relatively hard-earned peace had attracted numerous mortals and low-level cultivators from other islands seeking refuge from disaster, temporarily bringing bustle to Changqing Island and its neighboring isles.
In Gu Town, Zuo Qinghui was sitting upright in a quiet room while a well-dressed middle-aged man in front of him was reporting something in a low voice.
"...I've already arranged for people to blend in with the mortals who have come here seeking shelter, and it shouldn't take long for them to also become believers of Lord Nether Moon God," the middle-aged man said with the utmost respect.
Zuo Qinghui nodded. As Yuan Ming's Clone, he didn't have a great demand for improvement in strength. Instead, he was particularly focused on safeguarding the safety of Yuan Ming's parents.
Almost all the mortals on the entire Changqing Island had subtly become believers of the Nether Moon God, and most of the servants under the island cultivators were also his informants.
He didn't require these people to do much, just to pray to the Nether Moon God in case of emergencies, especially when it came to the safety of Gu Town.
In doing so, Yuan Ming could descend through the Stealing Heaven Tripod from anywhere, no matter the distance, and ensure his parents' safety.
The man in front of Zuo Qinghui was the Mayor of Gu Town, a Nether Moon God believer whose memories had been personally altered by him, responsible for overseeing the island's mortal worshipers.
However, Zuo Qinghui hadn't called him here to report.
"You've done well. The Nether Moon God has decided to bestow a divine reward personally. Close your eyes and pray," Zuo Qinghui instructed.
The middle-aged man was ecstatic and immediately knelt, starting to pray to the Nether Moon God.
Soon, a formidable Divine Sense enveloped the surroundings, and Zuo Qinghui also quickly stood up and bowed toward the sky.
Following that, a golden and silver illusory light gate appeared in the quiet room, the summoning Light Gate.
The third soul within Zuo Qinghui flew out and entered the Light Gate, then in the next moment appeared inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
Ever since he was able to wield Space Power, Yuan Ming had been attempting to utilize the Silver Formation in the Stealing Heaven Tripod to grant items. He had figured it out quite clearly.
Not just items, soul bodies could also travel between two places through the Space Array of the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
Unfortunately, living beings were not permitted. The altar's Silver Formation vehemently rejected living creatures, even low-level Demon Beasts, and forced teleportation would only lead to their demise.
Yuan Ming nodded in satisfaction and dropped the Second Split Soul down, injecting it into Zuo Qinghui's body to control this clone.
The safety of his parents was not to be neglected. Zuo Qinghui had to remain on Changqing Island.
As another elixir was sent flying out, the golden and silver light gate quickly dissipated, and Zuo Qinghui spoke again, "Open your eyes. For your hard work and dedication, the Nether Moon God has specially bestowed a Divine Pill that can revive the dead and mend bones. You must strive harder in your duties in the future and not disappoint the Nether Moon God."
In the Stealing Heaven Tripod, Yuan Ming gathered his third split soul and continued to concentrate on his closed-door cultivation, preparing to assail the Nascent Soul.
...
ThefullseriesishostedonMyVirtualLibraryEmpire,knownas*.
Several days later.
Yuan Ming sat opposite his third split soul, his spirit, energy, and vitality all adjusted to their optimal condition, and he officially began the attempt to break through to the Nascent Soul Stage.
Xi Ying also stopped her cultivation and stood by as Yuan Ming's protector.
After ten years of arduous cultivation, Xi Ying's advancement was insubstantial; her mana was still at the early stage of Nascent Soul, and her soul cultivation hadn't made much progress—what she had been busy with was a mystery.
Soul Cultivators form their Golden Cores differently from regular Magic Practitioners. For instance, Xi Ying had relied on a secret technique named "The Fusion of Qi and Spirit" to form her Nascent Soul, and Yuan Ming's "Soul Splitting and Soul Merging Technique" was similar in this way.
"It's about time."
With his eyes closed, Yuan Ming murmured to himself. The third split soul seated before him crossed its hands in a strange gesture, while Yuan Ming's original body operated the latter half of the "Soul Splitting and Soul Merging Technique" at the same time.
The next instant, Yuan Ming immediately felt an indescribable emptiness within his Golden Core, accompanied by a force that seemed to be pulling his Divine Soul out from his Sea of Consciousness.
It was at this moment that the third split soul turned into a streak of light, rushing into his Dantian ahead of everything else and merging with the Golden Core as one.
The feeling of emptiness vanished instantly, and Yuan Ming's Golden Core began further transformations.
Above Yuan Ming's head, bunches of spirit light twinkled like stars, filling every space within the mist.
The spirit light converged rapidly, and within the span of two breaths, it formed a swath of five-colored radiance, its edges disappearing into the mist and stretching to the unknown.
It seemed as if even the air inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod had solidified; countless spirit lights gathered, completely submerging Yuan Ming's body. Streams of nature's spiritual energy entered his body, assaulting the Golden Core in his Dantian.
Thus, a month passed by.
By this point, Yuan Ming's Golden Core had completely turned into a crystal-clear, translucent color, through which one could see a small figure sitting cross-legged inside, bearing the likeness of an infant but with a face identical to Yuan Ming's.
Perhaps sensing the change in his Golden Core, a thrill of excitement surged in his heart, prompting him to continue channeling nature's spiritual energy to strike his core.
At that moment, the converging spiritual energy suddenly burst forth with two rays, one gold and one silver, exuding utmost Yin and Yang auras, as if two bolts of lightning had struck his Golden Core.
"Pfft."
Yuan Ming spat out a mouthful of blood, and suddenly, a crack appeared on his crystal-like Golden Core, and his aura weakened all at once.
Within his body, tiny golden lights flashed and jumped about relentlessly, wreaking havoc on his flesh.
His Divine Soul also trembled violently, with countless silver lights flickering within it, almost on the verge of collapse.
"What's happening?" Yuan Ming could hardly bear it and swiftly invoked the Shura Blood Devouring Map. A dense Qi-Blood Power instantly poured into his body from it, repairing his damaged organs.
That was the last of his Pure Blood Origin Power that he had reserved especially for his breakthrough to the Nascent Soul Stage.
Pure Will Power also emanated from within the White Jade Lotus Platform, mending the damage in his Divine Soul.
However, the sudden turn of events didn't give him a chance to catch his breath. Within just a few moments, another eight strands of gold and silver light descended in succession, leaving Yuan Ming's body as withered as dried wood, his Divine Soul trembling, his life force precarious.
"Do not panic; this is the challenge of the Yin Yang Power for you! You possess the Seven Spirit Root Physique, making your advancement to Nascent Soul more difficult than mine, but once you succeed in forming your Nascent Soul, your Divine Skills will be even more formidable," Xi Ying's voice came.
Yuan Ming took a deep breath, exerted all his strength to rotate the Nine Elements Technique and the Moonlight Technique, and struggled to stabilize his body and Divine Soul.
If he could just endure it, his breakthrough to the Nascent Soul would be almost certain.
Yet the consecutive nine strikes of Yin Yang Power had so severely damaged his body and Divine Soul that, had his foundations not been relatively solid and his Divine Soul supported by Will Power, he might have already collapsed with serious injuries.
Just then, the Undying Tree behind Yuan Ming suddenly trembled, emanating a unique vitality unique to the Undying Tree.
As a Heaven and Earth Spiritual Seed, this vitality was effective for injuries to both body and Divine Soul. Yuan Ming's condition finally began to improve.
His Divine Soul quickly stabilized, and an exceptionally rich vitality emerged throughout his tattered body, swiftly mending his wounds.
"Good!" Yuan Ming rejoiced as a multicolored elixir that had already been taken out floated up and directly entered his mouth.
The time had come for the Five Elements Infant Condensing Pill refined by Xi Ying to show its effect.
As the pill entered his stomach, it immediately transformed into multicolored spirit light that surged into his Dantian, enveloping the crystal-like Golden Core and rapidly shrinking, fusing with the Golden Core.
When the multicolored spirit light disappeared, the Nascent Soul inside the Golden Core was as lifelike as if it were real, while the shell of the Golden Core was covered in cracks.
Radiant vermilion, green, blue, red, and yellow light rose from Yuan Ming's body, intermixed with gold and silver lights, immersing him in their depths.
The nature's spiritual energy within the space of the Stealing Heaven Tripod converged, forming a massive Spiritual Energy Vortex, thunderously spinning, presenting even greater mystical phenomena than when Xi Ying had broken through.

chapters.title: Chapter 595 - 568: Nascent Soul, Exiting the Cave
chapters.content:
Time passed quickly, and another month flew by.
A crisp sound of an eggshell cracking rang through heaven and earth, and the rosy light surrounding Yuan Ming rapidly contracted, forming a funnel that absorbed all the Spiritual Energy from the Stealing Heaven Tripod into his body.
However, at the same time, Yuan Ming seemed to fall into a trance, his eyes closing involuntarily as if he had fallen asleep.
This was the Heart Demon Tribulation that one must face during the breakthrough to the Nascent Soul Stage. Yuan Ming had already experienced the Heart Demon Tribulation during his Sleep Witch advancement, so undergoing it a second time would not present too much difficulty.
Nature's spiritual energy surged toward him, and when the last wisp of spiritual energy flowed into his body, Yuan Ming suddenly opened his eyes, shooting out two captivating beams of light.
Following that, he let out a long howl toward the sky, his voice resembling the roar of a dragon and the growl of a tiger, causing the surrounding mist to tremble and then rapidly roll back in retreat.
With the howl, a hundred-zhang silhouette appeared above Yuan Ming's head, surrounded by seven-colored spiritual light, majestic and handsome, resembling a god from heaven, compelling one to worship involuntarily.
But soon, the silhouette vanished abruptly, transforming back into a Nascent Soul and entering Yuan Ming's body.
"Very good, congratulations on successfully forming your Nascent Soul," Xi Ying said with a smile, walking over and bowing her hands in a somewhat ceremonious manner as his breakthrough had ended.
Her Ju Mang Spirit Technique only required a mana connection with the Five Elements Creation Tree to function even within the space of the Stealing Heaven Tripod, allowing her to move freely, unlike Yuan Ming who was trapped within the Undying Tree, with difficult movements.
Yuan Ming had also returned to his senses, and he was extremely excited in his heart.
To be honest, he had not held much hope for this Nascent Soul advancement, but to his surprise, he succeeded in one go.
"I owe it to your guidance and the Five Elements Infant Condensing Pill; otherwise, my success would have been impossible," Yuan Ming thanked her, glancing behind him.
The biggest help for this Nascent Soul formation was the Undying Tree behind him.
Had it not been for the life force of the Undying Tree that had come just in time, the likelihood of success in this breakthrough would have been greatly reduced.
Xi Ying looked at Yuan Ming, feeling quite moved.
The Beast Slave youth she had encountered by chance in the Southern Border had now grown into a formidable Nascent Soul Stage cultivator.
"With your current capabilities, the world is wide open to you, allowing you to roam freely," she said.
"Don't make fun of me. Even though I've stepped into the Nascent Soul Stage, I'm still bound to this Undying Tree, unable to move, and besides, the Undead Demon Tree is covetously lurking outside. There's no room for talk of roaming freely," Yuan Ming replied with a wry smile.
"That may be true, but in today's Yunhuang, those like you, who are both Sleep Witches and Nascent Soul cultivators, are few and far between. Although you still fall a bit short compared to me, I'll allow you to be proud this once!" Xi Ying said with her hands on her hips and a smile in her voice.
Yuan Ming watched her playful manner and couldn't help but laugh out loud.
The two of them chatted and laughed for a while, after which Yuan Ming looked around, a touch of surprise on his face.
"I didn't expect that my advancement to Nascent Soul would bring changes within the Stealing Heaven Tripod too."
Compared to his Core Formation stage, the internal space of the Stealing Heaven Tripod had expanded two to three times larger, and the white mist that shrouded the surroundings had receded even further, revealing more of the ground paved with Warm Jade Stone Bricks.
The Sword Trace Abyss revealed even more, but still did not show its entirety.
"It's just that, while the space has greatly increased, there isn't any particularly notable change," Xi Ying said after examining her surroundings.
"Well, each time a magic practitioner's realm breaks through, the Stealing Heaven Tripod undergoes new changes. Perhaps when it reaches the Returning Void, there will be some different situation," Yuan Ming said rather optimistically.
After chatting casually with him for a while, Xi Ying re-entered her closed-door cultivation.
Yuan Ming, after consolidating his realm, attempted to use Nascent Soul Cultivation to drive his magic treasures.
The power of the magic treasures he had seized from the Core Formation Realm hadn't changed much, but artifacts like the Night Parade of Hundred Demons, the Cold Moon Ring, and other replicas of Spiritual Treasures, as well as the genuine Spiritual Treasure, the Shura Blood Devouring Map, had significantly increased in might under his urging.
As for his Lifebound Magical Treasure, the Soul Destroying Sword, there was no need to say more. Yuan Ming felt that with his current cultivation, if he were to activate the three Divine Runes on it, the effects they could produce would likely far exceed his expectations.
However, he currently had no target to test his abilities on, so after a brief attempt, he stopped.
"Right, now that I've broken through to the Nascent Soul Stage, my Divine Soul Power has greatly advanced once more. I wonder what level my soul power can reach if I now merge it with the Desire Power within the White Jade Lotus Platform," Yuan Ming recalled something and produced a thick Undying Tree root in his palm, placing it on the White Jade Lotus Platform.
Boom!
The Desire Power within the Lotus Platform surged out, pouring into his Sea of Consciousness and Divine Soul.
Yuan Ming's soul power soared, swiftly reaching the Peak of Sleep Witch but it didn't stop there, continuing to leap forwards.
"Could it be that it will reach the Word Witch Realm?" Yuan Ming exclaimed joyfully, concentrating on operating the Moonlight Technique.
His soul power continued to rise and finally came to a halt after a short time.
A vast soul power surged through his Sea of Consciousness, at least twice as potent as the Peak of Sleep Witch, and the nature of his soul power was no longer ethereal but incredibly dense, almost condensing into a liquid form.
"Soul power turning liquid! This is a hallmark of the Word Witch, but unfortunately, it has not completely liquefied. It can only be considered a Half-step Word Witch!" Yuan Ming said happily.
He spread his hands and took a deep breath.
Since stepping into the Cultivation World, he had for the first time grasped such tremendous power, as if he was a deity ruling over myriad beings. It didn't matter whether it was Xi Ying or the others in the Time Cave—if he wished, with a mere gesture, he could annihilate them all.
"This is the feeling of a Spoken Witch, determining life and death with a single word..." Yuan Ming sighed inwardly.
Xi Ying suddenly opened her eyes and looked towards Yuan Ming.
Feeling the terrifying fluctuations of Soul Power on Yuan Ming's body, Xi Ying, who always had a calm demeanor, showed a look of shock: "Have you reached the realm of a Spoken Witch? No, that's not right, not yet a Spoken Witch, you're just at the Half-step Spoken Witch!"
"Indeed, I've only managed to reach this level by luck with the Desire Power within the Stealing Heaven Tripod," Yuan Ming retracted the Undying Tree Root from his palm, and his Soul Power level returned to that of the Sleep Witch Realm.
A trace of weariness appeared on his face, the power of a Half-step Spoken Witch was too overwhelming; although his Soul Power had broken through the Sleep Witch Realm, and his magic cultivation had advanced to the Nascent Soul, he still felt tremendously drained.
"Even as a Half-step Spoken Witch, it's terrifying. Now that you possess such power, our chances of dealing with the Undead Tree Demon have increased significantly!" Xi Ying said joyfully.
Yuan Ming was also pleased. Xi Ying shared some key points about the realm of Spoken Witch with Yuan Ming, and the two entered into cultivation once again.
...
Two months later.
Within the Time Cave, two beams of spirit light shot out from the black and white suns, merging into the figure of the Black and White Artifact Spirits.
After he appeared, two flashes of light appeared beside him, and the Blood Yan Island Master Luo Qi and Wulu arrived, following behind the Artifact Spirit.
The trio ventured off to an unknown destination. Wulu and Luo Qi's cultivation had improved significantly since they entered the Time Cave; Wulu had stepped into the late stage of Core Formation, while Luo Qi had even broken through to the mid-stage of Nascent Soul.
"Ladies and gentlemen, the appointed time has come; please speed your way here for a meeting." The Artifact Spirit's loud voice echoed, spreading to every corner of the Time Cave.
In just a moment, several streaks of light flew from different directions of the Time Cave and landed in front of the Black and White Artifact Spirits.
The first to arrive was a group from the Tide-rider Alliance. Compared to before, their cultivation hadn't changed much; at most, their Mana had solidified a bit.
Among the group, Bing Li and Lan Xiao both showed a hint of surprise and envy in their eyes when they saw Blood Yan Island Master Luo Qi who had reached the mid-stage of Nascent Soul.
They had been stuck at the early stage of Nascent Soul for quite some time without a breakthrough. Although Luo Qi's cultivation was on par with them before, he had been slightly weaker. Now, having seized an opportunity, he had surpassed them, how could they not envy him?
But soon, with the arrival of Queen Ming Kong and her group, Bing Li and Lan Xiao were even more surprised.
They saw that among the three, it was White Scale Master taking the lead, standing tall and proud, with a smile on his face that was seemingly indifferent but actually smug.
He indeed had reason to be proud, for now he too was a mid-stage Nascent Soul cultivator.
"Hehe, how has everyone been?" White Scale Master's gaze swept across the crowd.
Bing Li and Lan Xiao turned their heads away, showing no intention to respond, while Yuan Wuji didn't even shift his gaze once, his face remaining expressionless.To r&ep-or%t# e.rro#rs, pl^eas^e& vis%it the o+r.igin.al po#st@ on *%.
It was Blood Realm Venerable who glanced at White Scale Master, lingering for a moment, then suddenly licked his lips: "I've heard that snake blood is a great tonic; I wonder if you, White Scale, would be willing to share some for me to taste?"
"That would depend on whether you have the ability to take it," White Scale replied with a cold snort.
For a moment, the tension between the two was palpable, but with a formidable enemy ahead and the Black and White Artifact Spirits watching, neither of them really intended to start a fight.
After a short while, Old Man Hei Zhu, Long Chong, and others also arrived at the location; their cultivation had not changed much either.
Almost everyone had arrived, yet Yuan Ming and Xi Ying had yet to show up. After waiting a while longer, a beautiful, petite girl suddenly burrowed out from the ground in front of them.
Most of those present were Nascent Soul cultivators and instantly recognized the demon energy swirling around the girl. Wulu also recognized her as Yuan Ming's spirit beast Hua Zhi and quickly asked before anyone else.
"Hua Zhi, why hasn't Fellow Daoist Yuan arrived yet?"
Hua Zhi scratched her head, looking troubled: "I don't know either. The Divine Envoy asked me to cultivate on my own years ago, and I haven't met him since. I thought I could see him here again."
Hearing this, the crowd's expressions varied. For a Level 4 spirit beast like Hua Zhi, they wouldn't have cast her aside casually, let alone the fact that she was a servant of the Nether Moon God. Yuan Ming, as the Divine Envoy, had not met with her for years, could something unexpected have happened?
Perhaps out of respect for Yuan Ming's status as the Nether Moon God Envoy, people did not ask further questions. As for why Hua Zhi, a spirit beast, would appear by herself, although strange, it wasn't worth discussing in the current situation.
Just then, the Black and White Artifact Spirits suddenly spoke up: "It's getting late; you should all leave the Time Cave. There's no need to wait for those who haven't arrived."
Old Man Hei Zhu hesitated for a moment before bowing: "Predecessor, since you oversee the Time Cave, may I inquire whether you can tell us the current whereabouts of Yuan Ming and Xi Ying?"
"They are no longer in the cave," the Black and White Artifact Spirits replied outright.
Everyone was surprised; Aunt Wanhua immediately asked, "Then where did they go? Have they found a way out?"
"I was only responsible for protecting you for thirty years; I don't care what happens during that time, and your questions are irrelevant to me," the Black and White Artifact Spirits shook their heads.
Old Man Hei Zhu and the others looked at each other, their expressions growing darker.

chapters.title: Chapter 596 - 569: To Penglai
chapters.content:
Old Man Hei Zhu and his companions had long since reached a bottleneck in their cultivation, and after thirty years of arduous practice without significant improvement, they had pinned all their hopes on the Nether Moon God. With Yuan Ming, the Nether Moon Divine Envoy, suddenly disappearing, everyone's spirits sunk, and they silently withdrew.
Seeing no objections, the Black and White Artifact Spirits waved a hand, and a black-and-white Teleportation Array appeared beneath everyone's feet.
"This Array will transport you to Penglai Island. As for what you encounter there, whether it be life or death, it all depends on your own fate," said the Black and White Artifact Spirits indifferently, their figure flickering into invisibility.
Luo Qi's figure also vanished along with the Black and White Artifact Spirits, leaving not a trace behind.
The entrance to the Time Cave, too, disappeared, leaving only an ordinary cave behind.
"What's going on here?" Yuan Wuji turned to Wulu.
"I'm not entirely sure myself. The Island Master and the Black and White Artifact Spirits seem to have come to some agreement and won't be accompanying us any longer," Wulu replied.
At these words, everyone's frowns deepened.
First, Yuan Ming and Xi Ying vanished, now Luo Qi had disappeared with the Black and White Artifact Spirits; everyone's mood grew heavier.
"What should we do now, my fellow cultivators? Are we really going to challenge the Undead Tree Demon? It's a Returning to Void Stage entity, and we are just a group of Nascent Soul cultivators. Not to mention facing the Undead Tree Demon, even if a few Level 4 Upper Stage Tree Demons came, we might not be able to overcome them," said Old Man Hei Zhu.
At the entrance to the Time Cave previously, as many as seven or eight Level 4 Upper Stage Tree Demons had appeared. If it weren't for the arrows shot from Golden Sunflower Immortal Island, they wouldn't have been able to enter the Time Cave at all.
Heavy-hearted, everyone fell into a moment of silence.
"Has the Nether Moon God given you any instructions?" Yuan Wuji looked towards Old Man Hei Zhu and the White Scale Master, among others.
"The Lord Nether Moon God has been silent lately; there has been no response to our prayers either..." Old Man Hei Zhu shook his head as he spoke.
Mid-sentence, his body suddenly shook as the grand voice of the Nether Moon God resonated within his Sea of Consciousness.
"Do not hesitate, head to Penglai Immortal Island."
The White Scale Master and the others almost simultaneously heard this same message, and their tense expressions relaxed slightly.
"Since the Nether Moon God has instructed us to go, let's move on. Rather than staying here with no way out, we might as well take a chance! Besides, Hou Yi's Sun-shooting Bow and the Lank Chessboard, these two Spiritual Treasures won't stand by while the Undead Tree Demon dominates alone," Yuan Wuji said, after hearing the divine transmission from the Nether Moon God, relayed by Old Man Hei Zhu.
Hearing this, the others nodded one after another and stepped into the Transmission Array.
Once everyone had stepped into the array, blinding spirit light burst forth from the Teleportation Array and then faded.
All of the people vanished, and the Teleportation Array slowly disappeared.
In mid-air, fluctuations appeared and two figures, one silver and one green, emerged. They lingered for a few breaths before rapidly disappearing again.
...
On the fringe of Penglai Immortal Island, dazzling spirit light shot up, and Yuan Wuji and the others appeared. They had barely stabilized their stances when they looked around vigilantly.
The island was dimly lit as if it was nighttime.
Gigantic trees on Penglai Island towered into the clouds, vibrant and teeming with life. The Penglai Giant Peak soared sky-high, brimming with greenery, shrouded in mist, with an ethereal full moon suspended in mid-air, a breathtaking sight to behold.
However, none of them had the interest to admire the scenery, as they immediately probed their surroundings with their Divine Senses, fearing an attack from the Undying Tree.
As time ticked by, all was serene nearby, with no sign of anything untoward.
Yuan Ming and Xi Ying were currently hiding inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod. Hua Zhi had already witnessed the inside of the Stealing Heaven Tripod with her own eyes; Yuan Ming did not avoid her and kept the Stealing Heaven Tripod in his storage magic tool.
And the Spiritual Beast Bag of the Three-eyed Crow now hung on Hua Zhi's body, convenient for Yuan Ming to cast spells.
Yuan Ming, with his Half-step Word Witch level Divine Sense, used the Three-eyed Crow as an anchor, spreading out for hundreds of miles, covering the entire Penglai Immortal Island.
After a while, he showed an expression of surprise. Though the island was full of treasures, he didn't detect any particular presence, especially that of the Undying Tree.
"Wasn't it said that the body of the Undying Tree is on Penglai Immortal Island? Why can't I find it; could it be underground?" He projected his Divine Sense deep into the ground.
The underground world was filled with turbid and vicious energies, Primordial Magnetic Power, and countless other complex presences, which could greatly hinder the penetration of Divine Sense. However, Yuan Ming's Divine Sense was unparalleled in strength and, augmented by the Stealing Heaven Tripod, he easily probed dozens of miles into the underground with no results.
By this point, he had thoroughly explored the underground world. Going deeper, there was a chaotic flow of energy intermixed with various Space Powers, much like the legendary Void Turbulence.
"Could it be that the Three Immortals Island exists within the Void Turbulence?" Yuan Ming wondered in surprise.
Unable to find it underground, he meticulously examined the surface of Penglai Island and soon made a discovery.
Among the lush green trees on Penglai Island, several grey saplings grew inconspicuously. Yet within these saplings lurked a faint essence of the Undying Tree.
This essence was exceedingly weak, and it would have been difficult to detect if not for Yuan Ming's powerful Divine Sense and the support of the Stealing Heaven Tripod, which could discern all things.
"What do we do now?" Old Man Hei Zhu cleared his throat with a cough, looking to the others.
"We came here with the purpose of hunting demons. Now that we're on Penglai Immortal Island, we naturally can't be timid. Let's take a look around the island first," said Yuan Wuji calmly, taking a step forward, with the other three of the Tide-rider Alliance following him.
Seeing this, the rest of them also stepped forward.
The cultivators were highly skilled and quickly searched a wide area, arriving at the foot of a giant peak, where stood a majestic palace complex.
A golden plaque hung over the main gate of the palace, inscribed with the words "Penglai Immortal Palace." Several other structures stood behind the palace, looking like part of an estate.
The void around the entire manor sparkled with spirit light, with prohibition spells laid out that Divine Sense could not penetrate.
"Interesting," Yuan Wuji raised a blood-colored wheel Magic Artifact to protect his body and entered the main hall.
Passing through the main door, a vast courtyard appeared in front, with two flower gardens on either side. They were filled with eldritch flora, including bright red vines, purple jade-like bamboo, and lustrous blue Spiritual Flowers...
"This is the Red Snake Vine, so thick it must be at least two thousand years old in medicinal age!"Enjoying the story? Discover more on *.
"Purple Jade Bamboo, with thirty-two segments, this bamboo is known to grow one segment every hundred years!"
"These Blue Butterfly Flowers aren't bad either..."
When everyone saw the spiritual grass and Spiritual Flowers in the flower gardens, they were instantly shocked and overjoyed.
Any of these items would be a precious spiritual material in the outside world, yet they were casually planted in the flower gardens.
The group immediately used their Divine Skills, reaching for these spiritual grass and Spiritual Flowers.
However, these Spiritual Flowers and spirit grass also had prohibitions on them; the group's Mana hadn't even touched them when they were repelled by golden light shields.
A purple spear shadow shot out, striking the golden light shield surrounding an orange Spirit Tree, rapidly poking it over a dozen times.
The light shield shattered upon contact, and the orange Spirit Tree was swept up by the shadow of the spear, uprooted and hidden within Hua Zhi's sleeve.
A blood-colored saber light slashed onto a golden protective shield, which shattered at the sound, and it was Yuan Wuji who made the move, taking a silver-white spirit grass into his pouch.
Seeing this, the others were both shocked and envious, each raising their Magic Treasures to break the golden light shields.
But the golden light shields were exceptionally tenacious. Apart from Yuan Wuji and Hua Zhi, the others found it quite challenging to destroy the shields with their Magic Treasures; naturally, their efficiency was nowhere near that of Hua Zhi and Yuan Wuji.
Hua Zhi paid no attention to others and continued to control the purple long spear, easily shattering each golden shield and harvesting the spiritual materials within.
"How does she do it? Is it because of that purple long spear?" Everyone was greatly puzzled.
Many eyes flashed with greed, but when they thought of the Nether Moon God behind her, they all dismissed the thought.
Wulu recognized that the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear was Yuan Ming's Magic Treasure, but he was somewhat puzzled about how it ended up in Hua Zhi's hands, but he didn't think much of it and hastily seized as many spiritual materials as he could.
Yuan Wuji's Divine Sense swept over Hua Zhi's body and her actions, quickly noticing some clues.
"So that's it, using poison, huh..."
Many transparent droplets floated around Hua Zhi, falling onto the golden protective shields around her, which seemed to be the transparent Poison Liquid droplets released by the Purple Extreme Tai Sui.
Hua Zhi had merged with the Purple Extreme Tai Sui using the Symbiosis Technique, gaining this ability.
These droplets of Poison Liquid had not only a potent effect on humans and demons but also possessed a strong corrosive ability. The golden shields were eroded with numerous pits and indentures.
Although this could not completely break through the golden shields, it was enough for the Purple Star Nine Dragons Spear to attack from the flaws in the shields, easily breaking them open.
One after another, spiritual materials appeared in the space of the Stealing Heaven Tripod, settling next to Xi Ying.
The Five Elements Creation Tree needed a large amount of thousand-year-old spiritual grass and Spirit Plants to grow quickly.
Xi Ying, not shy with Yuan Ming, urged the Five Elements Creation Tree into action. Roots of five colors burst from the ground, wrapping around the spirit grass thrown in, quickly devouring the Spiritual Power within.
The Five Elements Creation Tree lit up with five-colored brilliance, growing slowly.
"Excellent, with the aid of these Spirit Plants, the time needed for my Ju Mang Spirit Technique to be cultivated will be greatly reduced," Xi Ying said, a joyful expression on her face.
Although there were many spiritual materials in the two flower gardens, they couldn't withstand everyone's harvesting, and they were quickly picked clean, most of them falling into the hands of Hua Zhi.
After dividing up the spiritual materials, the group continued on their way and soon came to a hall opposite the gardens. It appeared to be a reception hall with several purple wooden chairs laid out, glowing and looking far from ordinary.
On the walls of the hall, besides sconces and murals, hung four landscape paintings surrounded by spirit light.
Since Divine Sense could not be used inside the Penglai Immortal Palace, no one knew if there were life-threatening prohibitions inside the room, so they dared not rashly enter.
Hua Zhi was also hesitant, but Yuan Ming's voice echoed in her Sea of Consciousness.
"There's no danger inside the hall."
Hua Zhi's eyes lit up, and she immediately flew in. Two beams of green light shot from her hands, wrapping around the two landscape paintings on the wall.
The other two landscape paintings were also taken by others—Yuan Wuji and the Blood Realm Venerable.
"Mountain River Scenic Map! It turned out to be a dual water-earth attribute Nine Rune Magical Treasure. Too bad it needs all four paintings to unleash its full power," the Blood Realm Venerable laughed loudly, his eyes full of menace as he looked toward the two paintings in Hua Zhi's hands.
Hua Zhi paid no attention to the threat from the Blood Realm Venerable and casually stored the two paintings away.
Seeing this, the others deeply regretted their excessive caution, allowing Hua Zhi, Yuan Wuji, and others to get the upper hand again.
Now that they saw there was no danger in the hall, they hurriedly swept in, scavenging around for more treasures.
Yuan Wuji, Lan Xiao, and Bing Li didn't stay in the hall any longer either, sweeping into the side halls to search for other treasures.

chapters.title: Chapter 597 - 597: 570
chapters.content:
While everyone was busy scavenging, Hua Zhi refrained from joining the commotion.
She had already received a transmission from Yuan Ming, informing her that there were no more treasures in this place. She immediately started refining the two Mountain River Scenic Maps with her demonic power, only to notice a figure standing in the hall and not leaving, the very Blood Realm Venerable.
"You vine demon, if you know what's good for you, hand over those two Mountain River Scenic Maps, or don't blame me for being rude," the Blood Realm Venerable said, looking at Hua Zhi, his eyes filled with a bloodthirsty glimmer, as if his desire for slaughter was rising again.
"How exactly do you plan on being 'rude'? I'm actually very curious to learn," Hua Zhi said, unwavering with Yuan Ming's support behind her.
"If that's the case, then you can die!" Bloodlust surged in the Blood Realm Venerable's eyes, and a ferocious smile appeared at the corner of his mouth.
A dragon-shaped Blood Shadow shot out from the ground at Hua Zhi's feet, writhing towards her.
However, Hua Zhi seemed to have anticipated the attack coming from below. A purple light flashed in her palm, and the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear materialized out of thin air, "clang," deflecting the dragon-shaped Blood Shadow.
The Blood Shadow dissipated, revealing its true form—a cane belonging to the Blood Realm Venerable.
The Blood Realm Venerable's face darkened, and he withdrew his cane and then vanished into thin air.
A large, viscous Blood Cloud materialized out of nowhere, almost drowning the entire hall with a nauseating odor as it lunged at Hua Zhi.
A blood-colored Light Domain enveloped the hall. The air became abnormally heavy, squeezing towards Hua Zhi from every direction.
Under the pressure, Hua Zhi's body was immobilized, and the starlight from her Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear dimmed significantly, seemingly suppressed by the blood-colored Light Domain.
"This is the Blood Spirit Great Method from the Blood Transformation Technique," Yuan Ming narrowed his eyes within the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space.
The Blood Spirit Great Method was one of the most powerful secret techniques of the Blood Transformation Sect. With the Blood Realm Venerable's strength at the Nascent Soul Mid-Stage, it might be challenging for Hua Zhi to deal with it alone.
With this thought, he immediately started casting the Golden Sunflower Beast Taming Technique, channeling a robust Mana that seeped out of the Stealing Heaven Tripod and merged into Hua Zhi's body.
Hua Zhi's demonic power surged, reaching Level 4 Middle Stage. A low roar emanated from her Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear, as nine dragon-shaped beams of starlight emerged and effortlessly tore apart the pressure from all sides.
With a flick of her arm, Hua Zhi launched the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear like a bolt of lightning.
A glaring beam of starlight tore through the nearby Blood Cloud and struck an empty spot in the air.
In the next instant, a splash of fresh blood appeared out of nowhere, and the Blood Realm Venerable's body emerged with his right arm severed by the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear, screaming as he was hurled backward.
The greatest strength of the Blood Spirit Great Method was its ability to conceal the caster's presence. The Penglai Immortal Palace was a place where Divine Sense couldn't unfold, which should have made it the perfect venue for using the Blood Spirit Great Method. However, the Blood Realm Venerable had terrible luck meeting Yuan Ming.
Facing the Divine Sense boosted by the Stealing Heaven Tripod, all concealment powers were futile, except for the Heavenly Escape Stone Talisman in Wulu's possession.
Hua Zhi gestured with her hand, and the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear returned to her, bringing along the Blood Realm Venerable's severed arm.
Hua Zhi removed a blood-colored thumb ring from the severed finger, the Blood Realm Venerable's storage magic tool.
She casually took it off and stored it away.
Watching this scene, the Blood Realm Venerable's eyes bulged with rage, almost spewing fire, but he did not make another move.
Just when Hua Zhi made her move, countless illusions suddenly appeared before his eyes. Had it not been for the illusions vanishing at the last moment, causing him to shift his body in time, it would have been his head shredded by the spear instead.
Content presented by *.
Considering this, the Blood Realm Venerable was drenched in a cold sweat.
"What happened?" Old Man Hei Zhu, Yuan Wuji, and others flew over.
Seeing the Blood Realm Venerable with an arm severed, anger appeared on Bing Li's face, and Lan Xiao furrowed her brows.
Yuan Wuji also frowned. They had heard the sounds of combat in the hall and had immediately flown over, spending only one or two breaths of time, which meant Hua Zhi had defeated the Blood Realm Venerable in just one or two moments.
A hint of wariness flashed in Yuan Wuji's eyes, realizing that even if he took action, he might not be able to defeat the Blood Realm Venerable that quickly.
Had the strength of this spirit pet improved? Or had Lord Nether Moon God secretly intervened?
Either reason was not good news for him.
"Blood Realm Daoist attempted to measure my abilities. I merely played along with him for a bit," Hua Zhi said lightly as she tossed the severed arm over.
The Blood Realm Venerable caught the arm, his expression gloomy, and remained silent.
"Since it was just an exchange, let's leave it at that. We now share a common enemy and shouldn't be fighting amongst ourselves," Yuan Wuji spoke up.
"Of course," Hua Zhi readily agreed.
The Blood Realm Venerable pressed his severed arm back onto his shoulder, and a writhing Blood Light appeared at the severed joint, quickly vanishing as his arm was reattached.
"Give me back my storage thumb ring!" He moved his arm, extending his hand towards Hua Zhi and said coldly.
Whether it was because his severed arm was heavily injured or some other reason, the murder in the Blood Realm Venerable's eyes had significantly lessened, and he seemed to have regained his composure.
"Since you made a move against me, you must pay the price. I'll keep this ring on my finger. If you have what it takes, chop off my arm and take both the principal and interest," Hua Zhi wore the thumb ring on her finger, transformed into a streak of green light, and shot towards the outside.
Bai Lin, Old Man Hei Zhu, and others, knowing Hua Zhi's identity as an attendant of Lord Nether Moon God, quickly followed her.
Wulu swept his gaze around the hall as if searching for something, then followed them out, leaving only the Tide-rider Alliance's four members inside.
Blood Realm Venerable's face turned ashen, but he did not make a move.
"Second brother, what exactly is going on?" Yuan Wuji asked.
Blood Realm Venerable took a deep breath, barely suppressing the rage in his heart, and roughly recounted what had just happened.
"It seems it was your fault then! I had already warned you not to engage in conflicts with the people of the Nether Moon God at will; why did you not listen?" Yuan Wuji said with a stern voice.
Upon hearing these words, the complexion of Blood Realm Venerable grew even darker, but he remained silent.
"Big brother, second brother's cultivation technique is taxing him; sometimes it's difficult for him to control the killing intent, let's not blame him for that," Bing Li tried to smooth things over.
Upon hearing this, a cold sneer flashed in Lan Xiao's eyes.
"Burdened by the cultivation technique? I think he's just greedy for the numerous Spirit Grasses that Hua Zhi had previously collected. I can't believe that after so many years, you still haven't been able to change your short-sighted greed!" Yuan Wuji huffed.
The face of Blood Realm Venerable gradually turned more ashen, as if Yuan Wuji's words had ignited his True Fire.
"Enough, you handle your own affairs," Yuan Wuji said, seeing Blood Realm Venerable like this, and added no more.
"Second brother, big brother means well for you. Is there anything we brothers can't say to each other?" Bing Li walked up to Blood Realm Venerable and whispered.
Blood Realm Venerable nodded, his expression easing a great deal.
"Second brother, are you alright?" Bing Li looked Blood Realm Venerable up and down and asked with concern.
"I only lost a bit of Primordial Qi, it's nothing significant," Blood Realm Venerable shook his head.
"Your Blood Transformation Technique has already achieved great success, yet that Vine Demon, merely a Fourth-level Lower Stage, managed to injure you. Could it be she used some sort of underhand tactic? If she really resorted to despicable methods, we of the Tide-rider Alliance will not let her get away with it easily; we must make her pay the price!" Bing Li said with righteous indignation.
Blood Realm Venerable remained silent for a moment, then carefully recounted the details of his battle with Hua Zhi.
"It looks like the Vine Demon didn't use any underhand tactics after all; she must have relied on the power of the Nether Moon God," Yuan Wuji said.
"These people only know how to rely on external forces, how utterly shameless," Bing Li spat with disdain.
"Whether it's one's own power or an external one, the ability to hold it in your hand is real strength. The Nether Moon God seems to be quite fond of this girl. Before we clarify the details of that god's cloak, let's avoid getting into disputes with that Vine Demon in the future," Yuan Wuji admonished.
The other three people agreed upon hearing this.
"Big brother, the Nether Moon God has appeared so frequently, it must mean he's definitely in the Three Immortals Island Secret Realm. Could one of these people be pretending to be him?" Lan Xiao asked.
Yuan Wuji also harbored such suspicions. Shadows of the vanished Yuan Ming and Xi Ying flickered through his Sea of Consciousness, suspecting that one of them could be the Nether Moon God, although he had no evidence at the moment.
He decided not to worry further and to wait and see how things would unfold, walking towards the outside, with Bing Li and the others hurrying to follow.
Blood Realm Venerable watched Yuan Wuji's retreating figure, a chilling gaze flashing briefly in his eyes but vanished just as quickly.
After searching the hall clean, they proceeded along the stone path behind the house and soon came to a stop.
In front of the stone path appeared three forks in the road; beside each fork stood a Stele, bearing the names: Evergreen Garden, Gold-plated Hall, and Black Cloud Tower, respectively.
At the end of the three paths, one could vaguely see a garden estate, a golden hall, and a black tower.
Here, Divine Sense could not be extended either, preventing them from scouting ahead.
"All three places don't seem ordinary, and they should contain treasures. We will take our leave first," Yuan Wuji said and led the way down the road towards the Black Cloud Tower with Blood Realm Venerable and the others.
Inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod, Yuan Ming remained silent.
The Penglai Immortal Island was shrouded in mysteries, and it was relatively safer for people to move together.
However, since the Tide-rider Alliance was not his Believer, and there had been many unresolved grievances from before, he had no right to stop them when they chose to leave.
"Let's go to Evergreen Garden," Hua Zhi said under Yuan Ming's direction.
Old Man Hei Zhu and the others had no objections and walked towards it while Bai Lin Master, Queen Ming Kong, and the sturdy man from the Water Ape Clan did not follow.
"Fellow Daoist Bai Lin?" Old Man Hei Zhu asked.
"Since there are three places here, let's split up. The three of us will go have a look at the Gold-plated Hall," Bai Lin Master said.
"Fellow Daoist Bai Lin, this Penglai Immortal Island belongs to the Undead Tree Demon; it may seem safe for now, but it's certainly not a peaceful place. We should still move together for safety," Old Man Hei Zhu eagerly advised.
"Old Man Hei Zhu, we appreciate your kindness, but we've come to the Three Immortals Island to seek treasures; how could we not take some risks," Bai Lin Master refused directly.
"Are you really going to split up?" the voice of the Nether Moon God echoed in the Sea of Consciousness of Bai Lin Master, Queen Ming Kong, and the sturdy man from the Water Ape Clan.
"Lord Nether Moon God!" The faces of the three of them changed.
Seeing the reaction of Bai Lin Master and his group, Old Man Hei Zhu and the others realized something. Although they did not hear the message from the Nether Moon God, they still showed respectful expressions.
"Lord Nether Moon God, it's not that we are unwilling to travel together. Your Vine Demon servant is too adept at collecting treasures; if we follow her, we're afraid we'll end up with nothing," Bai Lin Master said, glancing at Hua Zhi, responding in his Sea of Consciousness.

chapters.title: Chapter 598 - 571: The Same Old Trick
chapters.content:
"This Penglai Island is infested with an Undead Tree Demon, its whereabouts unknown. If you insist on splitting up, I may not be able to protect you all," Yuan Ming continued to transmit his voice.
"We thank Lord Nether Moon God for your kind intentions. While we may not be powerful, we are still capable of protecting ourselves," White Scale Master said.
Queen Ming Kong and the burly man from the Water Ape Clan did not speak, but their expressions were resolute, clearly determined.
"If that's the case, I will not insist," Yuan Ming said no more.
White Scale Master, Queen Ming Kong, and the strong man from the Water Ape Clan gave a slight bow to the others and then swept toward the golden hall.
Only Hua Zhi, Old Man Hei Zhu, Aunt Wan Hua, Shi Yanshi, Wulu, and Long Chong remained on the spot, their combat power greatly reduced.
The expressions on Old Man Hei Zhu and the others were unpleasant, but Hua Zhi remained composed and continued toward the direction of Evergreen Garden.
A strange scene unfolded.
The path leading to Evergreen Garden seemed not far away, yet no matter how much they accelerated their Flying Escape, they still could not reach it. The gates of Evergreen Garden appeared to be at the far reaches of the horizon.
"Something is not right. Could it be that we've fallen under an Illusion Technique? Should we retreat first and make long-term plans?" Aunt Wan Hua spoke with an uneasy look.
"This isn't an Illusion Technique, it's a type of spatial extension restriction," Shi Yanshi shook his head and said.
"Spatial extension?" Old Man Hei Zhu asked.
"It's a kind of Space Restriction indeed. As the name implies, it can extend what is originally a short distance into an unbelievably long one. However, this restriction poses no danger; it simply requires some extra effort," Shi Yanshi explained.
Hearing this, the others relaxed slightly and felt more confident, immediately increasing their Flying Escape speed.
Just as Shi Yanshi said, the group, giving their all to fly, finally reached the entrance of Evergreen Garden after a quarter of an hour.
The place indeed looked like a garden. Through the gates, they could see tall green trees, courtyards, and towers, with a very pleasant landscape.
Beyond the beautiful scenery, just like the previous flower gardens, a large number of spirit grasses and spirit trees were planted in Evergreen Garden. Several could be seen just by looking through the gates.
Yuzhu, Aunt Wan Hua, and the others from the Three Islands had been planting various Spirit Plants for generations and held a special fondness for spirit grass and Spiritual Flowers. Old Man Hei Zhu, Shi Yanshi, and Aunt Wan Hua could not wait and flew into the garden eagerly.
With a "bang," a wisp of azure light rose from the gates of Evergreen Garden. A green light screen had actually appeared, blocking the three of them from entering.
Old Man Hei Zhu, angered and embarrassed, shone with black light, ready to make a move.
A series of coughs came from within the garden. A short-statured elder wearing a bamboo hat, with a red smoking pipe in his mouth, appeared inside the garden.
"I've been here for many years, and today I've finally seen people. Are you Cultivators who've come to Penglai Island in search of treasures?" the elder walked to the gate with a smile, completely unaffected by the green light restriction on it.
"Who might you be?" Old Man Hei Zhu and the others showed a cautious look.
Having previously encountered Zhao Gui, Old Man Hei Zhu and the others had also encountered other puppets of the Undead Tree. Since Penglai Immortal Island was the lair of the Undead Tree, they were even more careful, with their Magic Treasures ready to strike at any moment.
While questioning the elder, they also simultaneously used their techniques to sense the elder's aura.
Although the Penglai Immortal Palace had forbidden the spread of Divine Sense, the Cultivators present had profound Cultivation, and without the use of Divine Sense, they had all learned a secret technique or two for such investigation.
Surprise showed in the eyes of Old Man Hei Zhu, Aunt Wan Hua, and Shi Yanshi. The elder before them possessed profound Cultivation and had already reached the Nascent Soul Mid-Stage. His aura was pure, bearing not a trace of the Undead Tree Demon.
"I am Zhu Yu, servant to the Penglai Immortals and in charge of this Evergreen Garden. If you Fellow Daoists wish to enter the garden in search of treasures, you can, but you must first pass my test," the elder took off his bamboo hat to reveal a shiny bald head.
Old Man Hei Zhu, Aunt Wan Hua, and Shi Yanshi exchanged glances, wondering if this man could be an Undead Tree Puppet?
Inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod, a cold smile emerged on Yuan Ming's face.
The bald elder before them was the same as Zhao Gui, an Undead Tree Puppet. To Yuan Ming, it was just the same trick being used again, only this one was better concealed.
Yuan Ming had been using his Divine Sense all along, not only aware that the bald elder was an Undead Tree Puppet but also clearly observing the process of his appearance.
The elder had suddenly emerged from a grey tree growing within a cluster of trees inside the garden.
Yuan Ming activated his Divine Sense to delve into the grey tree, meticulously searching it inch by inch. He soon detected some unusual and hidden fluctuations of aura seeping out from the core veins of the grey tree.
As his Divine Sense probed towards the core of the tree trunk, the core veins suddenly enlarged, revealing an odd black rune, resembling a doorway and currently emitting a faint spatial fluctuation.
"This is a space rune? It seems that the bald elder has been teleported from another place," Yuan Ming mused silently, scrutinizing the black rune.
"Lord Nether Moon God, is this person a puppet of the Undead Tree?" Old Man Hei Zhu's voice came through the power of desire.
"Correct, kill him quickly!" Yuan Ming halted his study and commanded coldly.
Old Man Hei Zhu, Aunt Wan Hua, Shi Yanshi, and Long Chong all received Yuan Ming's transmission and did not hesitate to attack.
Old Man Hei Zhu flipped his hand and brought out a black fishing rod, the very one that had been destroyed by the Blood Realm Venerable before. It seemed to have been repaired over these thirty years.
A black fishing line shot out, transforming midway into seven or eight shadowy figures, barely visible, enveloping the bald elder.
Aunt Wanhua invoked her basket Magic Treasure, and a rainbow-like pale yellow mist shot out.
Shi Yanshi's black brush danced in the air, and two large "trap" runes appeared out of thin air, enveloping the bald old man from above and below.
Long Chong also summoned his War Spear Magical Treasure, stabbing in the air, and a large number of water-jar-sized water thunders exploded towards the bald old man, emitting a deafening roar.
Seeing this scene, Wulu's gaze flickered before he too summoned his Magic Treasure to assist.
The bald old man saw the sudden attack from several people and his originally smiling face grew dark.
However, he did not flee into the garden; his legs suddenly transformed into thick black tree roots that plunged deep into the ground, his body turned into a trunk, and his arms became thick branches.
In the blink of an eye, the bald old man transformed into a green-black Tree Man standing over a dozen meters tall, emitting a Mana fluctuation that had greatly changed, carrying a strong aura of the Undying Tree.
Not only that, but the green-black Tree Man's Mana realm soared dramatically, from the mid-stage Nascent Soul to the late-stage Nascent Soul!
"Is this the Golden Sunflower Beast Taming Technique? Can it merge two types of Mana, greatly enhancing the Tree Man's strength?" Yuan Ming pondered with a flicker of surprise in his eyes inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
The seven or eight Level 4 Upper Stage Tree Demons that had suddenly appeared at the Time Cave Entrance were likely also transformed in this way.
The green-black Tree Man moved, and countless branches and leaves swept across with lightning speed, filling the sky with shadows, rushing forward like a mountain and an ocean.
Bang bang bang!
The attacks from Old Man Hei Zhu, Aunt Wanhua, and even Shi Yanshi were all repelled. As for Long Chong and Wulu, they were not even worth mentioning—Their Magic Treasures had not even neared the shadows of the leaves before they were blown away by the residual airflow.
Hua Zhi, who had been standing by without any movement, immediately took action upon seeing this scene.
Her legs transformed into vines and drilled into the ground.
The next moment, the ground beside the green-black Tree Man exploded, and two purple-black Vines shot out, piercing into the Tree Man's legs.
The green-black Tree Man had its roots deep into the ground, making it difficult to move, and was instantly struck by the purple-black Vines.
The legs of the Tree Man started to turn purple, spreading rapidly, and its once plump legs quickly shriveled.
"You think you can flaunt your paltry poison in front of me?" the green-black Tree Man snorted angrily as its legs suddenly turned pitch-black, halting the spread of the deadly purple poison.
The blackness of his legs intensified quickly, and whoosh—black flames burst into life, burning fiercely.
The two purple-black Vines wrapped in black flames withered swiftly, turning to ash in mere moments.
Hua Zhi's face showed shock. After breaking through to Level 4, her body had become more resilient, and her regenerative abilities had reached an astonishing level; even the previously feared fire Divine Skills were no longer a concern. Yet she had no defense against these black flames!
Inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod, Yuan Ming's eyebrows also furrowed slightly.
Under his Divine Sense, he saw the black flames more clearly—they could even burn Spiritual Power, first consuming the demonic power within Hua Zhi's vines, then burning the body, which easily destroyed Hua Zhi's tendrils.
Old Man Hei Zhu and the others were also shocked. However, under the command of the Nether Moon God Order, they did not dare to slacken and continued to manipulate their Magic Treasures to attack, but they couldn't get close to the green-black Tree Man and were knocked away by the branches from a distance.
"Although there's some trickery involved, this Tree Man does possess the battle power of a late-stage Nascent Soul. It seems that Hua Zhi and the others alone cannot take it down," Yuan Ming thought to himself without continuing to watch the battle, and shot out a beam of Soul Power.
The black flames on the surface of the green-black Tree Man spread quickly, and in the blink of an eye, its entire body was burning with raging black fire. His legs pulled out from the ground, and he charged straight towards Hua Zhi and the others.
Everyone's faces changed color as they flew away, but how could they outrun the green-black Tree Man? It looked as though several people were about to be caught by the burning branches.
Just at that moment, a vast Divine Soul Power enveloped from above. Forabetterreadingexperience,visit*).
The green-black Tree Man's actions froze instantly, it stood still as if asleep, and the black flames on its surface quickly extinguished.
Yuan Ming nodded slightly, finding the Nightmare ability indeed very useful, stronger than his Illusion Technique, the only downside being the considerable consumption of Soul Power.
He shook his head and flicked his finger.
A dozen-meter-long black Sword Qi shot out, disappearing into the void.
Immediately following that, a ripple appeared in front of the green-black Tree Man, and Soul Destroying Sword Energy burst out of nowhere, "whooshing" down on the Tree Man, penetrating it.
The green-black Tree Man let out a mournful cry, its tall body crumbled, and all signs of life dissipated, soon losing its vitality.
Hua Zhi's eyes glinted with golden light and then quickly recovered as she flew up to appear beside the corpse of the green-black Tree Man, pressing her hand on its head.
A flow of gold and black surged into the Tree Man's head—the Soul Searching Divine Ability from Yuan Ming.
He used the Golden Sunflower Beast Taming Technique to lend this Divine Ability to Hua Zhi for casting.
But the next moment, Hua Zhi's expression became puzzled as the inside of the green-black Tree Man's head was empty, devoid of a Divine Soul.
Yuan Ming's face showed a look of astonishment. The Soul Destroying Sword Qi he had just used had been restrained to avoid killing the green-black Tree Man, leaving it heavily injured but still alive. Could it be that he hadn't controlled his strength properly, directly obliterating the Tree Man's soul?

chapters.title: Chapter 599 - 572 Overlapping
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming's eyebrows furrowed slightly; after a moment of contemplation, he reached out with one hand and grasped the void.
The corpse of the green-black Tree Man disappeared in a flash, and in the next moment, it appeared within the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space.
Suddenly, from within an unknown black space on Three Immortals Island, came a curious and light "Eh?"
After what seemed like a moment of reflective musing, the voice spoke again, "Send a squad of Wood Emperor Guards to Evergreen Garden."
As his voice faded, there was a rustling noise, into which a few unclear acknowledgements of "Yes" were intermixed.
No long after the noises quieted down, another voice echoed in the darkness.
"These little things are more troublesome than the ones before. Send two more squads of Wood Emperor Guards to deal with the ants in the Gold-Plated Hall and Black Cloud Tower as well," the voice said again, with no sign of anger in the words, at most a hint of impatience.
The tone was like that of an owner, fed up with the antics of his pets, instructing the housekeeper to discipline them.
After a few more muffled acknowledgements of "Yes," the black space was once more plunged into dead silence.
...
Inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space, the Undying Black Tree that had nearly merged with Yuan Ming sent out roots on its own initiative. The roots thrust into the corpse of the green-black aged tree like sharp cones, starting to absorb the remaining Qi-Blood Power and the unique Primordial Qi of the Undying Tree.
Yuan Ming's expression changed, but he did not interfere.
The corpse of the balding elder rapidly shriveled and contracted, soon looking no different from a segment of a withered stump.
And with the branches and leaves of the black Undying Tree trembling, it grew another two to three Zhang taller.
Yuan Ming was both shocked and delighted; the Qi-Blood Power of the balding elder was so robust that it made the Undying Tree grow so much!
But he soon realized that this was not the case. The Undying Tree's growth was not due to the Qi-Blood Power of the elder, but rather the Original Spiritual Power of the Undying Tree contained within the green-black tree.
This Spiritual Power was of the same origin as Yuan Ming's black Undying Tree, greatly promoting the growth of the black Undying Tree.
As the black Undying Tree grew taller, the Ju Mang Spirit Technique advanced significantly.
"Fantastic, there should be more Undying Tree Puppets appearing on Penglai Immortal Island. Killing them all and allowing my Undying Tree to devour them might even propel the Ju Mang Spirit Technique to the Perfect Realm!" Yuan Ming thought to himself in delight.
Just at this moment, the black Undying Tree suddenly lit up with streaks of Blood Light, and a rich Qi-Blood Power transferred into Yuan Ming's body.
"Is this nurturing back?" Yuan Ming's face showed surprise.
In the past, the Undying Tree would absorb the Qi-Blood Power of demon beasts entirely for itself, but now it was nurturing him back. Could this be the effect of advancing in the Ju Mang Spirit Technique?
Although the Qi-Blood Power transmitted from the black Undying Tree was quite pure, Yuan Ming did not directly absorb it. Instead, he activated the Shura Blood Devouring Map to collect the incoming Qi-Blood Power, refining it thoroughly to ensure there were no hidden concerns before completely absorbing it using the Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill.
This Qi-Blood Power was abundant, half of the balding elder's Qi-Blood Power. After Yuan Ming absorbed it, he immediately found that his Body Cultivation Realm had increased significantly.
Meanwhile, after a short rest, Hua Zhi and Old Man Hei Zhu and the others started to break the Forbidden Array at the entrance to Evergreen Garden.
The Forbidden Array was quite profound but could not withstand several Nascent Soul Level existences, and it was soon broken.
The group set off once again, heading deeper into the garden.
Yuan Ming's Divine Sense swept over a grey tree within the woods behind the gate without making a move against it.
That grey tree was most likely arranged by the Undead Tree Demon as a trap. Since he had already seen through the ruse, there was no rush to destroy it, as doing so might startle the snake.
The deeper they went into the garden, the more astonished the group became. Spiritual Flowers and Strange Grasses were everywhere, and rare trees were abundant. It did not resemble a perilous place occupied by an old demon but seemed more like the garden of an Immortal.
Each member of the group hurriedly began to collect their finds, gaining substantial rewards.
"Master, I gave you all the spirit grass and spirit trees from before, so let me take the spirit grass here. Penglai Island is becoming ever more dangerous, and I need to strengthen myself as well," Hua Zhi communicated telepathically with Yuan Ming.
"That's fine," Yuan Ming agreed with a nod.
"Thank you, Master," Hua Zhi showed a delighted expression, directly extending her roots into the ground and from underneath, she began to draw out the dense Spiritual Power contained within these spirit trees and grasses, causing various Spiritual Flowers and Strange Grasses to wilt and wither one after another.
The group continued to advance and soon arrived at the central area of the garden, which was surprisingly covered by a dirt-colored circular Great Array resembling an inverted bowl. Inside, the Spiritual Flowers and Strange Grasses appeared to be of much older age, and waves of incredibly dense Spiritual Energy and the fragrance were diffusing outwards, making Yuan Ming and the others covet it.
"Is that the Nine-leaf Hundred-Ginger Grass? It looks like it's at least two thousand years old, isn't it?" Old Man Hei Zhu stared intently at a purple spirit grass about half a person tall, his gaze ablaze, unable to look away.Conte&n*t f!ir@s$t re@l-eas@ed on M@_V*LE%M_PY&R^.-
"Next to the Nine-leaf Hundred-Ginger Grass, is that the Dragon Blood Earth Daisy? The quality is unexpectedly high; this place is truly a treasure trove," Aunt Wan Hua couldn't help but exclaim in admiration.
The others also wore expressions of pleasant surprise.
Yuan Ming's Divine Sense reached out, covering a tall, bluish-green tree within the enclosed Forbidden area.
The tree had a rounded canopy with dense, holly-like round leaves. The veins of the leaves emitted a faint golden sheen, making the entire tree appear to shimmer with hidden Golden Light, and four or five dark golden Spirit Fruits hung from the branches.
"There's no mistake, this is indeed a rare thousand-year-old Spirit Origin Tree," Yuan Ming acknowledged, unable to hide his excitement.
This tree was no ordinary species and was well-known. Although its actual name was Spirit Origin Tree, many Cultivators preferred to call it the Golden Core Tree, because the Spirit Fruit it bore could greatly enhance the chance of Core Formation for Cultivators.
Therefore, that Spirit Origin Fruit was also known as the Golden Core Fruit, a precious treasure coveted by many Cultivators.
Moreover, the fruit's medicinal properties were mild, and it could be consumed directly without needing to be refined into elixirs.
It was just a pity that Spirit Origin Trees had long been extinct on the Yunhuang Continent, and it was unexpected to find one here.
"There are indeed many Heavenly Materials and Earthly Treasures inside. We should quickly break the Forbidden Array and take what we need," Hua Zhi suggested on Yuan Ming's bidding.
"Indeed, delays could lead to complications. Let's hurry up," Shi Yanshi was the first to respond.
The rest had no objections, so they all started to work on breaking the Forbidden Array.
The yellow bowl-shaped array protecting this place glowed erratically with spirit light, while circles of earth-yellow Spiritual Charm Array Patterns lit up on the surrounding ground. The ceaseless power of the earth veins was drawn upwards, merging into the protective shield.
Long Chong took out his War Spear Magic Treasure first, channeled his mana, and with a rapid surge forward, he thrust at it.
The yellow bowl-shaped array did not wait for his attack to arrive; it seemed to have already sensed something. In the place that had been a yellow aura, the light suddenly condensed, revealing a hexagonal shield heavy with weight.
Long Chong's War Spear Magic Treasure struck squarely onto the massive shield, instantly emitting a muffled "clang" noise.
The spear tip sparked a series of sparks on the shield but failed to penetrate it. Instead, it was repelled by a sudden surge of tremendous force and was violently knocked back.
Seeing this, Long Chong did not pause. He accelerated and launched attacks from different directions.
But the array was like it had grown a heavenly eye, able to precisely predict his every move and mount targeted defenses each time.
After several unsuccessful attempts, the others also made their moves.
Shi Yanshi was seen waving his brush in the void. The character "Break" emerged mid-air, transforming into a sharp ray of light that struck the array.
Aunt Wan Hua waved her hand, and her basket Magic Treasure spun out, crashing into it.
Old Man Hei Zhu flicked his wrist, and the fishing line on his rod shone brightly, whipping out like a long spear for the thrust.
Hua Zhi also charged forward, her palms powerfully slamming down.
Wulu likewise concentrated his mana, fiercely smashing his fist toward the front.
"Boom boom boom"
Continuous thunderous explosions sounded, and patches of solid light lit up on the bowl-shaped yellow protective shield, with the spirit light trembling intensely.
But after all the noise subsided, the shield remained as stable as Mount Tai.
Even with everyone launching their attacks at once, the forbidden array could still split off hexagonal shields, one for each attacker, blocking all of their assaults. And it was a case of one-to-one defense, where the defense was precisely where the attack was aimed, never wasting the slightest force elsewhere.
Seeing that a prolonged assault was ineffectual, Yuan Ming, in his identity as Nether Moon God, signaled for the others to pause and started to ponder closely.
"Xi Ying, have you ever seen such an array?" Inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod, Yuan Ming couldn't help asking.
"It somewhat resembles the Eight-direction Returning Origin Array, but the mechanism seems quite different. It's a bit strange," Xi Ying replied after thinking for a while.
"Oh? What kind of strangeness?" Yuan Ming asked persistently upon hearing this.
"The Eight-direction Returning Origin Array is an Earth Attribute Defense Magic Array combined with the Eight Diagrams Directions. For anyone attacking the array while standing on the ground, the array can sense them, determining their position and the direction of the attack. Thus, the characteristic emerges of the enemy attacking a certain spot and the array focusing its defenses there. However, such an array usually requires eight spiritual eyes to be buried in advance—with magic treasures containing dense spiritual energy for support—otherwise, it would not be able to operate for long," Xi Ying explained with a frown.
"But the array we're facing now doesn't seem to have this problem. Clearly, we can't detect any spiritual eyes, yet the spiritual power is abundant, nowhere close to being exhausted, right?" Yuan Ming grasped the point immediately and spoke.
"Exactly. So this must be a variant of the Eight-direction Returning Origin Array, but as to how it varies, I need to observe it further," Xi Ying noted.
"I've heard of layered arrays, which connect two types of arrays to each other, inside and out. Do you think this could be one of those?" Yuan Ming suddenly recalled something and hurriedly spoke up.
"You mean, beneath this great array, there's another array dedicated to powering it? They complement each other and provide mutual support?" Xi Ying's eyes sparkled as she asked.
"Hua Zhi, go check underground," Yuan Ming ordered without answering directly but instead instructed Hua Zhi.
"You got it!" Hua Zhi agreed and began to take root, burrowing towards the depths of the earth.
Shortly after, the ground started to shake violently, and a series of muffled roars came from below.
The enveloping Eight-direction Returning Origin Array above also trembled mightily, with the spirit light flaring unstably.
Not much later, Hua Zhi resurfaced, having returned to her human form.
"Master, indeed there was an array connected below that seemed rather simple. It was continuously drawing Earth Vein Spiritual Power to supply the array above, and it has now been destroyed by me," Hua Zhi, brushing the dirt off herself, reported telepathically.
"Well done," Yuan Ming praised.
Then he ordered Old Man Hei Zhu and the others to once again employ their methods to attack the array.
Old Man Hei Zhu and the others, unaware that Hua Zhi had already sabotaged the underlying array, distinctly felt the great array's shield change following Hua Zhi's sudden disappearance and reappearance.
In a short while, as the array's spiritual energy was depleted, it could no longer withstand their attacks and finally erupted into a loud explosion, dissipating into specks of light that vanished into the void.
The moment the forbidden array collapsed, a rich fragrance and spiritual energy suddenly flooded towards them.
The group immediately surged in, beginning their search for Spiritual Flowers and Strange Grasses inside.
Yuan Ming, with a clear target in mind, directed Hua Zhi straight to the Spirit Origin Tree. They dug it out roots and all and transported it into the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space, where it was replanted.
As they were occupied, a powerful surge of mana began to emanate from the surroundings.
"Watch out, we are under attack," Hua Zhi suddenly spoke up, warning everyone.
Aunt Wan Hua, Shi Yanshi, and Old Man Hei Zhu swiftly retreated back, regrouping together.
Then, the trees around them began to sway as thirty-six Core Formation Stage Tree People emerged from all directions, encircling everyone in the center.
Immediately afterward, a grey light shone on the ground in front of the thirty-six Core Formation Stage Tree People, and five figures emerged from it.
These five people varied in age and appearance, but they all had greenish skin tones and wooden expressions on their faces, with little light in their eyes.
Yet, when Long Chong and the others saw them, they couldn't help but stiffen.
The aura emanating from these few individuals was all at the Nascent Soul Level. Although somewhat weaker than Zhao Gui, it was clear they were no ordinary opponents.

chapters.title: Chapter 600 - 573: Siege
chapters.content:
Before Hua Zhi and the others could act, the Tree People had already made the first move.
Accompanied by silent murmurs of the five Nascent Soul cultivators, the thirty-six Core Formation Stage Tree People rooted themselves where they stood, their foreheads lighting up with the image of ethereal runes, and the outlines of veins glowing all over their bodies.
In an instant, the entire garden seemed to come to life. The surrounding trees began to bend inward, and dense vines crisscrossed through the air, quickly weaving into a huge cage-like Array.
Old Man Hei Zhu flicked the fishing rod Magic Treasure in his hand, black fishing line shot out, as if a large knife slashed at the surrounding vines.
The black fishing line, seemingly flimsy, was extremely sharp, and it split open a large gash in the vines.
However, within the Array, the overwhelming Wood Attribute Spiritual Power flowed endlessly, rapidly healing the cuts in the vines, and in the blink of an eye, they were as good as new, twining towards the black fishing line.
Old Man Hei Zhu's expression darkened, and he hastily retracted the fishing line.
"Tsk, it's these damned things again," Shi Yanshi couldn't help cursing.
At this moment, the five Nascent Soul cultivators simultaneously performed hand-signs, beginning to activate the newly formed Array.
The entire cage-like Array lit up intensely, with green points of light, akin to stars, rising from the Array. They seemed like countless green fireflies, gently floating upwards into the sky, exceptionally beautiful against the backdrop of the Round Moon.
It was a pity that the ones trapped in the center of the Array had no time to appreciate this view. They felt the air around them suddenly thicken, as an invisible binding force constricted around them like a lasso.
Following this, Hua Zhi noticed that the vegetation beneath them started to wither at an alarming rate, the previously moist ground quickly drying up to reveal cracked and parched lines, and the robust nature's Spiritual Energy also rapidly thinned out.
"Cough cough..." Aunt Wan Hua started coughing dryly.
Long Chong and the others also felt their throats itch and their skin tightening.
"Not good! These Tree People are using the Great Array to draw out the moisture and the nature's Spiritual Energy. What kind of Formation is this?" Wulu exclaimed.
"We can't delay any longer, hasten to Break the Array, or else we'll all be trapped here to die!" Old Man Hei Zhu's hoarse voice shouted.
