No sooner had he spoken than he rushed towards the wall built from interwoven vines, throwing a red talisman with a flick of his hand toward what was in front of him.
The talisman paper flew swiftly, gradually igniting mid-air, and from it emerged a massive fireball of brilliant reddish-gold color, "bang", it smashed into the vine wall.
Fierce Flames burst forth, a fiery wall surged upward quickly, engulfing a large swath of vines.
However, instead of the fire spreading and intensifying, the Flames abruptly shrank and eventually extinguished completely.
Seeing this, Long Chong thrust his spear forward, the spear tip vibrating and unleashing a dazzling blue light that swept outwards. Amid the foggy mist, it was as if a tsunami was surging towards the wall of vines.
There was a thunderous "boom".
The vine wall trembled violently, vast amounts of steam visibly absorbed by it, and many of the previously damaged spots on the wall quickly repaired themselves.
"Fire can't attack, water can't flood, how shall we Break the Array?" Old Man Hei Zhu's complexion turned utterly somber.
...
Elsewhere, within the Gold-plated Hall.
White Scale Master, Queen Ming Kong, and the man of the Water Ape Clan stood back-to-back, supporting each other while fending off the assault from a circle of thirty-six Core Formation Stage Tree People.
Just like Hua Zhi and his group, they were also trapped by a Wood Attribute Array. However, due to the environment here being less lush, the power of the Array was considerably weaker.
Even so, they were still driven to a desperate state, barely able to hold on.
Just then, five figures suddenly emerged from beneath the ground, revealing five tall silhouettes, all with green skin and expressionless faces, devoid of anything but clear intent to attack in their eyes.
Feeling the aura from these five, comparable to Nascent Soul Stage cultivators, the three almost plunged into despair.
For character sheets and glossaries, visit *.
"White Scale Master, you've doomed us. If only we knew we wouldn't have separated from Old Man Hei Zhu and the others. Now look what's happened, we're all finished," the Water Ape Clan's strong man said bitterly, unable to help but complain.
White Scale Master's face was grim; he said nothing.
"At this point, what's the use of these complaints? We should think of a way to escape," Queen Ming Kong said.
"With the Array already beyond our ability to break, and now five Nascent Soul Stage opponents added to the mix, what can we do besides die?" The strong man of the Water Ape Clan said, nearly on the verge of breaking down.
Queen Ming Kong glanced disdainfully at the grimacing strong man of the Water Ape Clan and said, "Fellow Daoist Hou, instead of howling in vain, why not pray to the Nether Moon God and see if you can receive his protection."
"Do you think I haven't done that? Lord Nether Moon God hasn't responded at all," the strong man of the Water Ape Clan said, his face full of despair.
Queen Ming Kong sighed inwardly. Her prayers had also gone unanswered, unsure if the Great Array had blocked them or if the Nether Moon God had given up on them.
"Fellow Daoist Bai Lin, as things stand, if you have any methods at your disposal, then use them now. If we delay any longer and our Mana is exhausted, we'll truly have no strength left to fight back," Queen Ming Kong said to White Scale Master.
It was precisely because of White Scale Master's strong advocacy that the three of them broke away from the main group. White Scale Master was a man of meticulous thought and surely had not made baseless decisions.
"Do not panic, my fellow Daoists. I have a method that could break the current deadlock and even resolve this crisis," White Scale Master finally spoke up.
"What method?" the strong man of the Water Ape Clan asked eagerly.
"At this moment, we cannot speak freely, as we may be under surveillance. Both of you, follow my lead. Shortly, I'll need Fellow Daoist Ming Kong to abandon the Ten Thousand Waters Mirror and to detonate it, releasing a vast amount of Water Power. Afterwards, using the Ice Soul Zither, try to freeze these Tree People. Fellow Daoist Hou can take the opportunity to deploy the Sea Covering Stick Technique, and make an all-out break in one direction. Leave the rest to me," White Scale Master transmitted via voice transmission.
Queen Ming Kong's eyebrows knit together. The importance of the Ten Thousand Waters Mirror to her was self-evident, but compared to that, her life was of course more important.
"Agreed," she nodded her assent.
The Water Ape Clan's man naturally had no objections.
Queen Ming Kong immediately took action, taking a deep breath and waving one hand in front of her. The Ten Thousand Waters Mirror emerged forthwith.
She held up both hands, and the Treasure Mirror ascended into the sky, hanging above the trio's heads.
Queen Ming Kong raised her hands high, her Mana starting to continuously pour into the Ten Thousand Waters Mirror.
The suspended Treasure Mirror lit up with a dazzling glow, within its surface a cerulean surge appeared, waves billowing tumultuously. The Water Power, like a flood about to burst a dam, kept slamming against the restrictive barrier of the mirror.
"Ready," Queen Ming Kong shouted, preparing to self-detonate the Ten Thousand Waters Mirror.
Yet as soon as her voice rose, it abruptly stopped.
She was blindsided by a heavy blow to the back, her body thrust forward, as she suddenly spat out a mouthful of fresh blood. The Ten Thousand Waters Mirror, hanging in midair, simultaneously plummeted, rolling on the ground before coming to a stop.
Along with her, the Water Ape Clan's man was also launched into the air.
He too was attacked from behind, sustaining even graver injuries—a fist had utterly crushed his back to his lower abdomen, sending his body flying like a torn sack, with the wound quickly darkening to a bruise-black color, evidently poisoned severely.
Below them, the ground cracked as dozens of vines burst forth, entwining around their bodies.
A confining force seeped in, instantly binding their Mana and making their bodies difficult to move.
Behind them, White Scale Master bent down to pick up the Ten Thousand Waters Mirror from the ground, then swiftly knelt, raising the mirror above his head and shouting loudly, "White Scale, a Cultivator from Thousand Snake Island, offers his life to the service of the Undying Immortal Tree, to serve eternally."
This sudden betrayal caught not only Queen Ming Kong and her companion off guard but also perplexed the five Nascent Soul cultivators, whose wooden expressions turned to puzzlement.
"White Scale, have you lost your mind?" the man from the Water Ape Clan roared as he spat out blood.
"I haven't lost it; you're just too foolish. Did you really think that we could stand against the Undying Immortal Tree with just us? Instead of dying a worthless death here, I would rather submit to the Undying Immortal Tree. Those servants of the Immortal Trees not only wield great power but also have eternal life. That is the greatest opportunity on Three Immortals Island, and yet you overlook it, sheer foolishness!" White Scale Master shouted fervently.
Queen Ming Kong watched this scene, her lips trembling slightly, yet ultimately she said nothing.
...
Within the dark tower.
The five green-skinned Nascent Soul Stage cultivators, along with thirty-six Core Formation Stage Tree People, also formed a Great Array.
Yuan Wuji and the other members of the Tide-rider Alliance were trapped in the center. Their situation was slightly better than that of Queen Ming Kong, each bearing some injuries, but not too serious.
"Big brother, it looks like we're in trouble," Bing Li said, her expression becoming increasingly unsightly as she looked at the five Nascent Soul cultivators.
Yuan Wuji remained calm, seemingly not too worried, as he looked toward one of the Core Formation Stage Tree People.
Though this person had become a Tree Man, his original appearance could still be seen—it was Wu Yuezhi from the Dawn Alliance.
Wu Yuezhi, noticing Yuan Wuji's gaze, turned his head to look back, a flicker of lucidity passing through his wooden eyes.
Just then, all five of the green-skinned cultivators lit up with a glow.
...
Inside Evergreen Garden.
Hua Zhi and the others had repeatedly failed in their attacks, and before they could find a way to break through the blockade, the counterattack from the five Nascent Soul cultivators had already arrived first.
The five Nascent Soul cultivators altered the spell in their hands, and at the same time, a light illuminated from them.
In the next instant, the previously restraining Array sprang to life, with emerald light twisting around the vine walls—aiming and thrusting crazily towards them.
Within the Formation, green dust began to waft everywhere, quietly drifting toward the crowd.
Aside from Hua Zhi, nearly all reflexively sealed their breaths to avoid inhaling the green dust.
The force of the vinous walls, drawing water from the atmosphere, intensified. The cracks on the dry, fissured ground widened, and the skin of all present visibly dehydrated and shriveled at a rapid rate.
A "bang" resounded with a dull thud.
Old Man Hei Zhu's bamboo pole was struck by an emerald tendril, sending him and the pole flying.
Immediately after, the sound of impacts continued; Aunt Wan Hua and several others were hit in succession. As they landed, they were rapidly bound and dragged towards the wall by converging vines.
Long Chong was the most pitiful; caught off guard, he was impaled by a vine through the shoulder and hoisted above, as the approaching vines quickly wrapped him into a zongzi-like bundle.
In a mere few breaths, within the entire Formation, only Hua Zhi remained with any room to move.

chapters.title: Chapter 601 - 574: Emerging from the Void
chapters.content:
As they watched others being wrapped by vines, their body's moisture beginning to rapidly deplete, on the verge of turning into dried corpses, Hua Zhi suddenly stomped her foot and shouted, "Bloom quickly for me!"
As her voice echoed, pink mist rose from the walls around, one after another, fleshy flowers bloomed, frantically absorbing the spiritual power of those Tree Men.
Within moments, the vines binding the others became somewhat withered, and the speed at which they drained everyone's moisture greatly slowed, even the tightness of their binding loosened somewhat.
Hua Zhi was using the parasitic method to draw a large amount of spiritual power, attempting to replenish Long Chong and the others.
But, just then, the spell gestures of the five Nascent Soul cultivators outside suddenly changed, pointing simultaneously at Hua Zhi.
The next instant, a circular green light Array formed out of thin air beneath Hua Zhi's feet, and strands of green light condensed into magic chains shot out from it, piercing into Hua Zhi's body.
Hua Zhi immediately felt her mana circulation sluggish, unable to control those parasitic flowers anymore.
As one faltered and the other rose, the recently suppressed vine strength surged, and the parasitic flowers began to wither and soon fell off.
The lifeline Hua Zhi had just managed to win for everyone vanished in an instant.
Once again, everyone found themselves in a dire situation, when suddenly, an overwhelming Divine Power appeared out of nowhere, instantly enveloping the five Nascent Soul cultivators and thirty-six Tree Men nearby.
The five Nascent Soul cultivators, who had been fully controlling Hua Zhi, were caught off guard by the sudden intrusion of Divine Sense and fell into an illusion, all standing rigidly in place.
The extending vines all retracted back, the controlled people fell out one by one, each struggling to stand up, coughing dryly.
Seeing the scene before them, the group couldn't help but feel a rush of surprise and joy.
Hua Zhi knew it was Yuan Ming who had taken action, she instinctively wanted to voice her thanks, but hastily caught herself, saying, "Thank you, Lord Nether Moon God, for your assistance!"
"Thank you, Lord Nether Moon God!" Others, hearing this, also came to their senses and expressed their gratitude.
Inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod, Yuan Ming nodded slightly.
The force of Divine Soul Power that had just acted was from his true body's Divine Soul, not enhanced by the Lotus Platform Will Power, only utilizing the power of the All Living Beings Dream Rune, to instantly control five Nascent Soul cultivators and thirty-six Core Formation cultivators. His years of hard cultivation on the Nether Moon Technique were not in vain.
Before Yuan Ming could continue casting, suddenly a powerful force of Divine Soul Power burst forth from the five Nascent Soul cultivators.
Yuan Ming's Divine Thought was impacted, and the illusion he had constructed nearly collapsed.
He forcefully stabilized his Divine Soul while striving to activate the All Living Beings Dream Rune again, pressing down with a formidable Soul Power.
This time, however, he let the thirty-six Tree Men at Core Formation Stage go and focused all his power on controlling the five Nascent Soul cultivators.
Seeing the Great Array broken, the Tree Men who had broken free from the illusion quickly fled in panic.
"Don't let those creatures escape, kill them," Yuan Ming ordered in the tone of Nether Moon God.
Upon witnessing this, the rest didn't hesitate, ignoring their significant energy loss, they quickly gave chase to kill those creatures, all except Hua Zhi who didn't move.
"Hua Zhi, once I have these five completely under control, you move to kill them," Yuan Ming transmitted a message instructing her.
"I'll follow the master's command," Hua Zhi immediately replied.Y-our* s^u&pp^ort* at MV^L&EM%P&^Y.R^ kee@ps^ the se*r^i*e*s& goi.n#g.&
Yuan Ming mumbled an incantation, his five fingers spread wide, shooting five rays of crystal light from his palm, which flew out of the Stealing Heaven Tripod space.
The five crystal rays flashed and disappeared into the heads of the five Nascent Soul cultivators, entangling around their Divine Souls.
But just at this moment, an unexpected change occurred!
Among the Nascent Soul cultivators, the tallest's eyes, previously clouding over, suddenly snapped open, a flash of dark light on his forehead, and an incredibly powerful Divine Soul Power burst forth, colliding with the crystal light wrapped around the Divine Souls.
By the time Yuan Ming realized something was wrong, it was already too late.
The crystal light was torn apart, crumbling into nothing.
Inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod, Yuan Ming was also affected; it was as though a sound of rocks crumbling thundered in his Sea of Consciousness, causing his vision to blur and his ears to ring.
The illusion he had built with the assistance of the All Living Beings Dream Rune could no longer hold and immediately shattered.
The Nascent Soul cultivators, who had been on the verge of passing out, all woke up at that moment, gathered together, and fled into the distance.
Hua Zhi took action to block them without delay.
She thrust both hands forward, countless vine tendrils surged over, blocking the path of those Nascent Soul cultivators.
However, the strength of those five was not at all weak; they conjured a wave of green light together, cutting through where they passed, causing Hua Zhi's vine tendrils to droop to the ground, taking root on the spot, completely out of Hua Zhi's control.
But it was also in the moment bought by Hua Zhi's intervention that Yuan Ming soothed the turbulence in his Sea of Consciousness with his mighty Divine Soul Power, his eyes suddenly focused, and he stepped forward.
"Hua Zhi, back off," Yuan Ming ordered.
Without the slightest hesitation, Hua Zhi immediately withdrew, retreating explosively backward.
As Yuan Ming chanted, he raised a palm and harshly slapped it towards the front.
Five Nascent Soul cultivators at the center of a fluctuating void overhead, a pitch-black glow materialized out of thin air, transforming into a colossal palm the size of a palace, emanating circles of black light that pressed down—none other than the Great Black Sky God Palm.
Within a radius of several dozen yards, everything froze as if space itself had solidified.
Having spent thirty years in the Time Cave, he had painstakingly cultivated the Moonlight Technique, and the Divine Soul Secret Techniques he had acquired from the Six Desires Venerable had also been mastered.
The bodies of the five Nascent Soul cultivators were also immobilized, unable to move, yet a green light converged at their foreheads and simultaneously launched a green beam.
Each beam contained astonishing Divine Soul Power, converging at a single point and managing to pierce through the frozen void.
However, before the five beams could merge, the Great Black Sky God Palm had already collided head-on with them.
A thunderous explosion echoed.
The five green beams shattered, dispersing into countless green fluorescent fragments.
The black giant palm did not pause for an instant, striking the five Nascent Soul cultivators squarely.
Their bodies shuddered violently, cracking with numerous tiny fissures, and they collapsed.
The black giant palm suddenly stopped, its fingers grasping at the void and retrieving the bodies of the five cultivators with a jerk.
With a flicker, all five disappeared, reappearing within the space of the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
The space of the Stealing Heaven Tripod was once again shrouded in dense white fog, enveloping the altar and the Sword Trace Abyss among other key locations.
Yuan Ming's Divine Sense swept over the five, and without any surprise, their Sea of Consciousness was utterly empty, not a trace of Divine Soul could be felt.
"The Divine Soul has disappeared again?" Xi Ying, standing at his side, asked.
Yuan Ming nodded, not uttering a word, but instead closed his eyes, his fingers pressed against his forehead.
After a moment, he suddenly opened his eyes, a look of astonishment on his face.
"Did you find it? Where?" Xi Ying asked abruptly.
"An unexpected place, within the white round moon mid-air," Yuan Ming answered.
Previously, the bald elder's Divine Soul had vanished mysteriously. To clarify the matter, Yuan Ming and Xi Ying had planted a Divine Sense Imprint within each of their Divine Souls while secretly engaging with these five cultivators.
One imprint was destroyed, but the other four were now inside the round moon in the open air.
"How can it be over there?" Yuan Ming muttered to himself.
"That round moon is indeed quite peculiar, the real body of the Undead Tree Demon may very well be hiding there," Xi Ying replied thoughtfully after a moment's suspense.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming immediately activated his Divine Power, extending it upwards in an attempt to probe the white round moon.
However, the moon that seemed to hang just above the treetops was much further away than he had imagined. Even when Yuan Ming turned all his Divine Power or even sat upon the White Jade Lotus Platform, using the Desire Power there to boost and extend his Divine Thought to its utmost limit, in the end, he still couldn't touch that place.
"It's too far, my Divine Sense can't probe it," Yuan Ming sighed.
"The sun and moon within a Secret Realm often differ from those in the real world. Usually, they aren't truly unreachable. However, I also sense that this moon may be some kind of spatial artifact, or perhaps there is a spatial treasure hidden there which used some kind of spatial extension Divine Skills to greatly increase the distance," Xi Ying explained.
"Such elaborate concealment suggests there truly is something strange within the white round moon. Perhaps the real body of the Undead Tree Demon is indeed hidden inside," Yuan Ming said.
"Is there a way to break through this Divine Skill to allow us to reach the round moon? After all, if the Undead Tree is indeed there, it means the exit from the Three Immortal Island Secret Realm is also there," Yuan Ming hesitated to say.
"There is a way... However, if it's as you predicted, and that round moon is indeed the lair of the Undead Tree, then the danger it poses is extraordinary. At this point when nothing is clear, rushing there recklessly could be fatal," Xi Ying replied, his voice carrying slight hesitation.
"Don't worry, I naturally won't act rashly. At the very least, we'd wait for everyone to gather before making a plan," Yuan Ming replied with a smile.
"Then we could give it a try. Reaching it isn't difficult; I can set up a Teleportation Array. Just by sending a Space Array Plate to the inside of the white round moon, I can directly transport everyone over," Xi Ying said, revealing the solution upon hearing this.
"I'll figure out a way to send the Space Array Plate into the white round moon, you go ahead and refine the Space Array," Yuan Ming said after a moment's thought.
Xi Ying nodded, moved aside, and sat down cross-legged, taking out various materials and starting to refine.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming did not disturb him further and conveyed his thoughts to the Artifact Spirit of the Shura Blood Devouring Map.
"Is there any news of Qi Ye?" Yuan Ming asked.
Waiting for a while, the Artifact Spirit finally responded, "That guy hasn't sent any news for a long time, and I have tried to contact him just now to no response."
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming's brows furrowed tightly.
Meanwhile, those like Long Chong who had gone to pursue the Tree Men were beginning to return one after another, most returning empty-handed.
"And what of those five Nascent Soul cultivators? Could they have escaped?" Old Man Hei Zhu looked around and asked.
"How could Lord Nether Moon God fail? Those five have been captured. He's instructed us not to wander about and to rest and regain our strength here," Hua Zhi said.
The others, indeed weary, divided up the Spirit Tree and Spirit Grass of the area and began to meditate and restore themselves on the spot.

chapters.title: Chapter 602 - 575: The True Self
chapters.content:
In the space of the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
The black Undying Tree couldn't wait to stretch out its roots, wrapping around the corpses of the five Nascent Soul cultivators, and the essence of the Undying Tree originated from them.
The black Undying Tree grew a segment taller once again, its branches and leaves spreading out, and its black roots rapidly growing in all directions.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming waved his sleeve, causing two figures to fly out from behind the altar not far away. It was Yun Jiuxiao and Bing Xin, who were kept far away from the black Undying Tree.
The two sat cross-legged there, expressions wooden, oblivious to the outside world.
Yun Jiuxiao and Bing Xin, being weaker, would've merely rushed to their deaths on Penglai Immortal Island. When leaving the Time Cave earlier, Yuan Ming took the opportunity to control the two with an Illusion Technique and took them into the space of the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
This action was partly to protect them, and partly because Yuan Ming wanted to test something: whether being controlled by an Illusion Technique could generate Desire Power. Indeed, Desire Power was generated.
Yun Jiuxiao and Bing Xin, controlled by the Illusion Technique, prayed with unusual devotion, generating more Desire Power than on ordinary days.
The two were enveloped by Yuan Ming's Mana and set down near Xi Ying.
The black Undying Tree rapidly absorbed the five essences of the Undying Origin, growing several meters taller, and the Ju Mang Spirit Technique made considerable progress once again.
After absorbing the essence of the Undying Tree, the black Undying Tree continued to absorb the Qi-Blood Power within the bodies of the five.
Five Nascent Soul cultivators, even being corpses, had vast and boundless Qi-Blood Power; the black Undying Tree absorbed half for itself, and the other half was fed back to Yuan Ming in full.
Yuan Ming was not courteous, immediately activating the Shura Blood Devouring Map to refine it, and then he began to absorb it on the spot.
As the surging Qi/Blood Power flowed into him continuously, Yuan Ming frantically operated the Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill. His body surged with Qi-Blood, shrouded in a layer of dark red mist, his presence swelling uncontrollably.
In just half an hour, he reached the pinnacle of the Innate Body, only a step away from Breakthrough.
At the same time, within the black space, that mysterious voice sounded again, this time with a hint of solemnity.
"San Jue."
As the voice echoed, numerous light spots like fireflies emerged, illuminating the entire space and revealing its True Face.
This was a vast and open soluble cave space, with only a massive and towering black tree standing tall within.
The colossal trunk had a human face almost occupying half of the tree, with barely open eyes and countless wrinkles in the bark that made the face appear incredibly ancient.
The illuminating light of the space originated from the eyes of the human face.
Those sparkling lights seemed to be Spiritual Energy not fully absorbed.
The tree, lush and leafy, had numerous oval-shaped black cocoons hanging from its branches, which could roughly be divided into three layers from bottom to top.
In the lowest layer, there were the most cocoons, densely packed with at least a thousand, but nearly half of them had split open, leaving nothing inside.
The black cocoons in the middle layer were several times larger than those in the lowest layer, but there were only about a hundred of them, and only twenty or thirty had split.
At the very top, there were only three gigantic cocoons, each as large as a palace.
Perhaps because the face on the tree's bark had opened its eyes, the giant cocoon on the far left suddenly began to shake, and fiery flames spurted out from the vines' interwoven gaps.
The heat wave surrounding the flames alone was enough to melt metal in an instant.
Yet, when the orange flames fell on the branches and leaves, they merely shook slightly without leaving any burn marks.
At the same time, in response to the call of the black tree, the vines of the giant cocoon on the far right began to crackle crisply. They quickly split open, and an elder with eyes tightly shut fell out.
The elder, with his unkempt gray hair and a bulbous red nose as if he had drunk too much, had likewise flushed cheeks, appearing inebriated.
Falling from the cocoon without any reaction, it was not until he hit the ground with a 'bang' that he sleepily opened his eyes, staggered to his feet, unscrewed his hip flask, and poured a mouthful of wine into himself.
"Belch—"
Accompanied by a loud burp, the elder's aura surged dramatically, stepping past the Nascent Soul stage, even reaching the Returning to Void Realm.
"What a rarity, it seems the old Undying Tree Demon still has times when it calls me out," mumbled San Jue as he staggered over to the roots of the tree, leaning on the trunk with his elbow, continuing to pour wine into his mouth as he spoke.
"Some more people have come outside; they need you to handle it. You must stop them from getting close to this place at all costs," said the Undying Tree Demon without chastising the elder for his disrespectful words, speaking slowly.
"Ah, so the opponents are that troublesome this time? We just caught a batch, and now more have come? It's one thing to send me, but you're actually telling me to do it at all costs?" San Jue's sleepy eyes opened a bit wider, seemingly invigorated.
"Among those who have come this time, there are even those in the Returning to Void Realm. I am at a critical moment and cannot afford any mistakes," declared the Undying Tree Demon.
"Oh? It's only been so many years, and yet another has reached the Returning Void? Interesting, I'd really like to meet them," said San Jue, briefly glancing at the black cocoon on the top left.
"Then go. Take these hands with you and don't disappoint me."
As the Undying Tree Demon spoke, fifteen cocoons from the second layer started to crack, and fifteen Nascent Soul Green-Black Tree People fell out. After standing up, they woodenly followed behind San Jue.
San Jue responded with an acknowledgment, took another sip of wine, then wiped his mouth with his sleeve before staggering off, leading a group of Nascent Soul Tree People to disappear into the depths of the Soluble Cave.
The Undead Tree Demon fell silent for a moment, then spoke again, "Bring the people in."
As soon as these words were spoken, several Nascent Soul Stage Tree People brought Queen Ming Kong and her two companions before the Undead Tree Demon.
Queen Ming Kong and the brawny man of the Water Ape Clan had a waning aura and showed a hint of fear in their eyes upon seeing the Undead Tree Demon.
Meanwhile, White Scale Master showed an excited expression and knelt directly before the Undead Tree Demon, folding his hands in salute and saying,
Chapter source: * (*).
"Elder of the Undying Immortal Tree, these two are gifts that I present to you, hoping only that you will bestow upon me the chance for immortality. White Scale is willing to be at your disposal, to go through fire and water, and refuse no task."
"Heh, you certainly know how to please," the deep voice of the Undead Tree Demon reverberated.
Despite their fear of the Undead Tree Demon's power, the deep resentment Queen Ming Kong and her companion harbored towards White Scale Master's shameless words ignited a fire in their eyes, wishing they could flay him thousands of times over to alleviate the hatred in their hearts.
However, in front of the Undead Tree Demon, their rage ultimately found no outlet.
"Since you are willing to submit, I am accepting like the vast ocean and will naturally take you in, but before that, I have a question for you," said the Undead Tree Demon.
"Whatever you wish to ask, I will tell all I know," White Scale Master said obsequiously.
"When you hid in the Time Cave, I planted a Black Tree of Undying close to its entrance. Who destroyed this tree?" the Undead Tree Demon asked.
"A Black Undying Tree? I was too flustered when I entered the Time Cave earlier and did not notice such a tree," White Scale Master said after careful recollection, his voice tinged with fear.
"What about you? If you can answer this question for me, I will certainly not treat you unfairly," the Undead Tree Demon turned to Queen Ming Kong and the brawny man of the Water Ape Clan.
Queen Ming Kong and the brawny man of the Water Ape Clan were equally ignorant and pale, unable to utter a word.
"Useless trash." The Undead Tree Demon snorted coldly as three tendrils, thick as arms, suddenly descended and penetrated the flesh of White Scale Master and the other two.
An eerie force emanated from the tendrils, spreading into the trio's Nascent Souls, taking root and sprouting within them, and transforming their minds from the inside out.
This process was not quick, so the three of them could acutely feel their own changes.
A moment of hesitation flickered in White Scale Master's eyes, then he relaxed his mind, submitting to the influence of the Undead Tree's power.
Queen Ming Kong and the brawny man from the Water Ape Clan, however, were fraught with horror and unease, desperately trying to shake off this power's grip, but with their Mana and Divine Souls being restrained, they were powerless to resist the corrosion from the Undead Tree Demon and their minds were gradually subjugated.
The tendrils spread quickly, soon enveloping the three in a dark cocoon, which hung in the second layer of the Undying Tree.
Despair gripped the hearts of both from Queen Ming Kong's group, but unwilling to give up, they continued to resist the Undying Tree's influence, and simultaneously, they each invoked the name of the Nether Moon God in their hearts, praying for the power to save themselves.
…
Within the Stealing Heaven Tripod, Yuan Ming was savoring the advancement of the Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill, feeling the prayers from Queen Ming Kong and her companion, and showed a look of surprise.
He closed his eyes and sensed their location, finding it to be within the White Round Moon. His expression quickly turned joyous, and he reached out with his branches to touch the White Jade Lotus Platform.
Yuan Ming's Soul Power improved greatly and, riding on Queen Ming Kong's anchoring Desire Power, he descended into the Soluble Cave.
His Divine Soul Power, fortified by the Stealing Heaven Tripod, escaped everyone's notice, even the Undead Tree Demon remained unaware that there was now another person covertly observing within the Soluble Cave.
Yuan Ming's gaze shifted; the true form of the Undead Tree Demon indeed resided within the White Round Moon.
His expression turned serious; the terrifying aura emanating from the Undead Tree Demon instilled a silent dread in him, but even more concerning were the black cocoons hanging from the treetops.
The number of Tree-man Puppets controlled by the Undead Tree Demon greatly exceeded his expectations.
Yuan Ming steadied his mind and dispersed his Divine Sense to carefully inspect the Soluble Cave, soon discovering a burning black cocoon.
The aura of flames within the cocoon resembled that of the Jin Chao Clone yet far surpassed it, it must be the Level 5 Golden Crow from Fusang Island; unexpectedly, it too had been captured and did not seem to have been subdued yet.
Golden Cloud Fairy was also enveloped in a black cocoon, hanging from the tree near Queen Ming Kong's group.
Judging by the aura, she had not been subdued either, though Golden Cloud Fairy's current state seemed off, trapped in a slumber with fluctuating breath.
Having surveyed all the black cocoons on the Undead Tree Demon, Yuan Ming expanded his Divine Sense to envelop the whole White Round Moon, his expression turning to one of surprise.
The White Round Moon turned out to be a vast spherical Barrier, suspended in mid-air. Within the Barrier, a world unfolded, comparable to a minor Secret Realm. The Undead Tree Demon's Soluble Cave was located underground, while above there lay a city complete with a gate inscribed with three big characters: Guanghan City.
Buildings as unique as the halls of the starry sky rose within the city, channeling Star Power.
Whether because of the Undead Tree Demon or the numerous buildings within Guanghan City, the concentration of nature's Spiritual Energy within the White Barrier was exceptionally rich, far superior to Penglai Immortal Island.
While Yuan Ming was observing, he did not forget to respond to the prayers from Queen Ming Kong and her companion.
He might not know the exact method the Undead Tree Demon was using to reshape their minds, but Yuan Ming sensed that the unnamed power was subtly similar to Soul Power.
Realizing this, he immediately activated his Soul Power and stealthily entered Queen Ming Kong and her companion's bodies, stabilizing their Nascent Souls, aiding them against the encroachment and transformation of that mysterious force.

chapters.title: Chapter 603 - 576: The Undying Tree's Hidden Ailment
chapters.content:
All of this may seem a lengthy tale, but it actually occurred in the blink of an eye. As a result, the Undead Tree Demon did not notice anything unusual, only feeling that compared to White Scale Master, the speed of eroding and transforming Queen Ming Kong and the Water Ape Clan's strongmen was much slower.
However, the Undead Tree Demon did not find this strange, merely assuming that compared to White Scale Master, their resistance was stronger. Moreover, as members of an Alien Clan residing in the East Sea, they faced different survival pressures. Compared to Human Clan's cultivators, their mental fortitude was stronger, naturally slowing down the transformation process, and even White Scale Master experienced the same.
The Undead Tree Demon soon dismissed this and extended more vines from the treetops, enveloping Queen Ming Kong and the other two in black cocoons and hanging them on the second layer of the tree, planning to slowly refine and control them.
Meanwhile, the other two with Queen Ming Kong sensed another force aiding their Nascent Souls in resisting the erosion, and they immediately realized that it was the Nether Moon God intervening, greatly uplifting their spirits.
Despite being seasoned veterans in the martial arts world, they showed no trace of their emotions, lest the Undead Tree Demon notice.
"Do not worry, continue praying, and don't stop for a moment. I have a way to rescue you," Yuan Ming soothed them upon seeing this.
Hearing his words, both companions of Queen Ming Kong were overjoyed and silently vowed to keep praying, their piety unmatched in this life-and-death situation.
Seeing that he had temporarily halted the transformation of the two with Queen Ming Kong, Yuan Ming then turned his attention back to the Undead Tree Demon.
At this time, the Undead Tree Demon was unaware that Yuan Ming watched all its actions. After dealing with White Scale Master and his companions, it spoke up again, calling out to another figure.
"Qi Ye, you come out as well, assist me in refining the Golden Crow."
As the Undead Tree Demon spoke, the giant black cocoon at the very center split open instantly, and a black silhouette flew out, landing before the huge black cocoon on the left.
The person who emerged from the cocoon was dressed in black and was also a Returning to Void Stage Cultivator. Moreover, his appearance looked quite young, his features gentle and handsome, seemingly like a young prodigy who had just started his journey not long ago.
"So, he is Qi Ye..." Yuan Ming thought to himself.
The young man in black showed no extra expressions, his eyes filled with indifference. Upon appearing, he followed the instructions of the Undead Tree Demon, casting ray after ray of black light that entered the cocoon on the left.
The cocoon gradually stopped vibrating and no longer spewed flames from its cracks. However, Yuan Ming could still feel the indomitable will inside the cocoon.
"We don't have much time, we must speed up, even faster!" whispered the Undead Tree Demon, its half-open eyes closing again, and the cave returned to darkness.Readersupportat*madethistranslationpossible.
...
After observing for another moment, Yuan Ming started searching around, hoping to find an exit from Penglai Island, but he found nothing after a complete search.
For safety's sake, he did not act rashly and, after retracting his Divine Sense, left the White Jade Lotus Platform and recounted everything he observed to Xi Ying.
"So the situation inside the Round Moon is like this. To deal with that Undead Tree Demon, the first challenge we face is his entourage of Nascent Soul Stage Tree-man Puppets," Yuan Ming explained.
"With all my strength, I can only restrain seven or eight Nascent Souls, but facing such numerosity with the Undead Tree Demon coordinating them, facing them head-on is as difficult as ascending to heaven," Xi Ying said, furrowing her brows.
"Yes, their numbers are indeed too great. Even if I sit on the White Jade Lotus Platform, supporting with Desire Power and risking damage to my Divine Soul, I can handle a few more. But for the rest, we can't possibly rely on Yuan Wuji and his group, can we?" Yuan Ming sighed.
"If we could release the Level 5 Golden Crow, it would probably be much easier," Xi Ying suddenly mentioned.
"He has never had faith in me, and besides, he's too far from Queen Ming Kong and the others for me to aid in freeing him," Yuan Ming shook his head.
A moment of silence followed within the Stealing Heaven Tripod as both fell into deep thought.
Right then, the voice of Qi Ye unexpectedly came from within the Shura Blood Devouring Map: "Yuan, do not worry. I have a way to deal with the Tree-man Puppets."
Yuan Ming was startled, remembering the scene he had just witnessed. He tentatively asked, "Senior Qi Ye, is that you? Are you able to communicate with me now because the Undead Tree Demon has fallen back into sleep?"
"Almost, but he isn't really asleep, just preoccupied with something else and not paying attention to me for the moment, which is why I'm able to contact you," Qi Ye replied.
Hearing this, Yuan Ming paused momentarily. He wasn't sure if Qi Ye had overheard him discussing the situation within the moon with Xi Ying, but he still pretended to realize something.
"I see, by the way, senior, you just mentioned that you have a way to deal with the Tree-man Puppets. Could you elaborate?" Yuan Ming diverted the topic.
"At this point, you should also know. The Undead Tree Demon I've been discussing with you is hidden within Guanghan City, that is, inside the White Round Moon above Penglai Island. The Tree-man Puppets you've encountered are all controlled by this demon using the Undying Tree Heart, and you might have guessed by now that I am also one of the puppets of the Undead Tree Demon. The Undying Tree Heart is where the demon's soul resides. If I find an opportunity to attack there, I can temporarily disrupt the Undead Tree Demon's control over the Tree-man Puppets," Qi Ye swiftly responded.
"How can I create an opportunity for you, senior?" Yuan Ming immediately recognized the critical point.
"This demon is extremely cautious. Without an external disturbance, it would be almost impossible for me to succeed, so we need you to find a way to storm into Guanghan City. Then with your help from outside and mine from within, I am eighty percent confident that I can succeed," Qi Ye declared confidently.
Yuan Ming frowned slightly: "The Undead Tree Demon has reached Level 5, with a large number of Tree Demons at his disposal, just storming into Guanghan City might not be enough to distract him to the point of allowing an attack, right?"
"Yuan, do not underestimate yourself. With your current strength, the Undead Tree Demon must also be wary of you," Qi Ye chuckled as he spoke.
"What do you mean by that, senior?" Yuan Ming asked in a deep voice.
Currently, as both a Soul Cultivator and a Magic Practitioner, he had indeed made significant strides in strength, but without the help of the Desire Power within the White Jade Lotus Platform, he was far from being able to contend with the Undead Tree Demon.
Could it be that Qi Ye had detected the existence of the White Jade Lotus Platform?
The Stealing Heaven Tripod was Yuan Ming's biggest secret, known only to Xi Ying, who was aware of the tripod's divine skills. Hua Zhi was merely allowed to stay within the space of the Stealing Heaven Tripod and was unaware of the effects of the White Jade Lotus Platform. That such a major secret had been leaked to an outsider!
At this thought, Yuan Ming felt extremely perturbed.
"Through the Shura Blood Devouring Map, I sensed a powerful residual Divine Soul fluctuation on you. You must possess a Soul Cultivator's treasure that can amplify the Divine Soul, right? With this treasure, you're already capable of posing a threat to cultivators at the Returning to Void stage," Qi Ye explained.
"I see, senior, that's quite a tactic." Yuan Ming chuckled, though he did not believe Qi Ye's words, his mind quickly spinning with various thoughts.
"Even if what you say is true, senior, and even if we manage to subdue the Tree-man Puppets, the Undead Tree Demon's own strength is too formidable. Even if we join forces, we might not be able to defeat it," he then said.
"The Undead Tree Demon suffers from a hidden affliction within its body. As long as I can catch it off guard with a sneak attack and injure its Demon Soul, with your cooperation and that of the sleeping witch next to you, plus the help of other Nascent Soul cultivators, the chances of success are not low," Qi Ye said.
Yuan Ming wondered, "May I know what kind of affliction it suffers from?"
"Many years ago, the Undead Tree Demon was entangled by a curse-powered evil object. Since then, it has had to be careful day by day, often undergoing seclusion to suppress the encroachment, and its strength has also been considerably limited, unable to fully demonstrate its capabilities. Otherwise, it would have broken free long ago and wouldn't have had to wait until today," Qi Ye openly stated.
Seeing that Qi Ye did not provide a detailed explanation of the injuries suffered by the Undead Tree Demon, Yuan Ming immediately speculated some possibilities.
It was then that a blood-colored Jade Scroll suddenly flew out from the Shura Blood Devouring Map and fell into Yuan Ming's hands.
"I cannot stay here too long, lest the Undead Tree Demon discovers me. This contains the information I have collected over the years about the tree puppets. Yuan, please scrutinize carefully. It will be of great help when you confront it. I will not say more; I ask you to act according to the plan as soon as possible and not miss the opportunity," Qi Ye said as his voice gradually faded away.
Yuan Ming's eyes flickered. He suppressed his speculations, employed multiple methods to completely shield the Shura Blood Devouring Map from external perceptions, and then carefully began to examine the contents of the Jade Scroll.
Under the Undead Tree Demon, there were more than a thousand Core Formation Stage Tree-man Puppets and one hundred and nine Nascent Soul Stage Tree-man Puppets. However, during this opening of the Three Immortals Island, nineteen Nascent Soul Puppets had been destroyed, leaving only ninety still usable.
Above the Nascent Soul, there were also two puppets; one was Qi Ye, and the other was named Elder San Jue.
Additionally, the Jade Scroll mentioned that the Undead Tree Demon controlled an array called the Wood Emperor Array, which at a minimum requires five Nascent Soul cultivators to lead, with thirty-six Core Formation Cultivators coordinating the formation.
This array has a strong confinement ability; once formed, it can literally consume individuals alive within it.
Moreover, the Wood Emperor Array can also increase the number of people forming the array, such as configurations of seventy-two, one hundred and eight, or three hundred and sixty people, with its power increasing with the number of participants.
Realizing this description, Yuan Ming instantly recalled the array he had just broken through. It seemed to be the Wood Emperor Array.
Since there were too many people and their cultivation was relatively low, the part about the Core Formation Cultivators in the Jade Scroll was not very detailed, but for those one hundred and nine Nascent Soul Cultivators, not only their cultivation levels and identities were listed, but even their cultivation techniques, magic treasures, and weaknesses were clearly enumerated.
Yuan Ming quickly skimmed through the list, memorizing all the information, and also noted the names of Wan Tianren, Gu Xuanyang, Murong Yanyu, Tu Shixiong, Jia Sifang among others.
As he reunited with Xi Ying and learned about the situation inside the Void Temple on Fusang Island from Guoguo, seeing these names now did not come as a surprise to him.
However, upon finishing the list, he found that it did not contain the name of Ni Mu.
Seeing Yuan Ming put down the Jade Scroll, he passed it to Xi Ying beside him.
Xi Ying inserted her Divine Sense into it, and soon set the Jade Scroll down.
"Can we really trust this Qi Ye?" Xi Ying asked, full of doubt.
"I'm not sure, but considering his actions previously, he should have no ill intentions, at least in terms of dealing with the Undead Tree Demon, where our interests align," Yuan Ming shook his head as he responded.
"I'm not talking about this, but about the Stealing Heaven Tripod," Xi Ying slowly said.
"Let's discuss that later. For now, let's focus on dealing with the Undead Tree Demon," Yuan Ming said after a moment of silence.
"Alright, what should we plan next?" Xi Ying asked.
Yuan Ming pondered for a moment, then sighed helplessly, "We'll have to take it one step at a time. Let's set up the Space Array first. Once we have the ability to step into the Round Moon, we can think about other things."
Xi Ying nodded and continued to work on refining the array plate, while Yuan Ming touched the White Jade Lotus Platform again, bringing his Divine Sense into the Round Moon.

chapters.title: Chapter 604 - 577: Fermentation
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming searched the area once again, ensuring that Ni Mu was not trapped here. It appeared that he had hidden himself and had not been captured by the Undead Tree Demon.
Although this man came from the Wu Yue Sect, his ambition was great. Now that he had entered Three Immortals Island, it was unclear what schemes he had in mind.
Nonetheless, at least he was not siding with the Undead Tree Demon.
Yuan Ming shook his head, deciding not to concern himself with Ni Mu's whereabouts for the time being. Instead, he extended his Divine Sense into the Undead Tree Demon's body, searching for the strange and vile object mentioned by Qi Ye.
Soon, he found an ancient-looking black mirror inside the black giant tree, seemingly of considerable age.
There was a thick demonic power protective shield surrounding the mirror, which was precisely the Undead Tree Demon's demonic power.
Within the demonic power, black chains appeared, wrapping around the mirror in layers, resembling a Sealing Array.
Flashes of light shimmered on the black mirror, continuously striking the Sealing Array. The demonic power inside surged, stabilizing the array.
"It seems Qi Ye was not lying; the Undead Tree Demon is suppressing this black mirror," Yuan Ming thought to himself.
He tried reaching out with his Divine Sense toward the mirror, and quickly broke through the demonic power array, touching the black mirror.
The black mirror suddenly emitted a powerful suction force, drawing his Divine Sense into it.
Not only that, a force of Curse Power followed his Divine Sense, crossing the void, and began encroaching upon his physical body.
Yuan Ming's whole body broke out in a cold sweat, as if a monstrous beast capable of swallowing the sky had fixed its gaze on him. His back was drenched, and his innermost being was shrouded in deep shadows.
In a daze, it was as if a skeletal hand, wound with countless resentful spirits, reached out from the black mirror and grasped towards him.
Yuan Ming was horrified and quickly summoned the Desire Power within the White Jade Lotus Platform to counteract the Curse Power. Then he severed that strand of Divine Sense, cutting off the connection to the other side, thereby completely isolating himself from the erosion of the Curse Power.
"What was that thing just now, so terrifying!" He still felt lingering fear, wiping the sweat from his forehead while murmuring to himself.
Qi Ye's words were true; the Undead Tree Demon harbored such a terrible hidden ailment that it would surely be constrained in battle.
Yuan Ming took a deep breath to calm his spirit. Now that he had investigated everything he needed to, he shifted his attention back to the Evergreen Garden.
While he and Xi Ying were discussing a plan, Old Man Hei Zhu and his group were not idle. After a brief rest, they could not stand the boredom and continued their exploration of the Evergreen Garden, plundering all the spirit grass and spirit trees they encountered along the way.
Yuan Ming kept an eye on their actions, occasionally using Hua Zhi to acquire some precious Spirit Grass essential to them, which he then handed over to Xi Ying for devouring and refining.
And while refining the Array Plate, Xi Ying did not cease her cultivation. As she consumed the Spirit Grass, the nourished Five Elements Creation Tree grew taller, and her aura also became more refined.
However, what they were most short on was time.
Seeing that Old Man Hei Zhu and his people were about to reach the end of the Evergreen Garden, Yuan Ming took the initiative to issue a decree, ordering them to rest for a while to avoid any battles that might arise later.
Old Man Hei Zhu and the others dared not neglect such an order. They nodded in agreement and began to meditate to recuperate, restoring their Mana.
An hour later, seeing that everyone had mostly recovered, Yuan Ming didn't want to delay any longer and ordered them to continue on their journey.
After the rest, Old Man Hei Zhu and the others actually sped up considerably, and they quickly arrived at the end of the Evergreen Garden.
Outside the exit gate, a winding mountain path extended all the way to the summit of the Penglai Giant Peak.
Looking up from the foot of the mountain, one could faintly see a glorious great hall shining with treasure light at the peak, which from afar looked like a resplendent Bright Pearl, almost vying with the Sun for brilliance.
When their Divine Senses spread out, they found the great hall at the peak, just like the Penglai Immortal Palace, was protected by Prohibition God Restrictions, so they were unable to investigate its interior.
"Such a majestic hall, the treasures inside must not be few," Aunt Wan Hua's eyes gleamed with excitement, barely able to hide her enthusiasm.
Old Man Hei Zhu shook his head, dampening her spirits, "The Penglai Island is now under the control of the Undead Tree Demon; it's true that there are treasures in the great hall, but the body of the Undead Demon Tree might also be located within. With our current strength, going there would be suicidal. What use are treasures to the dead?"
At his words, Aunt Wan Hua's expression stiffened, and she couldn't help but sigh.
Just then, Shi Yanshi, who had kept silent, frowned slightly, "Someone's coming."
No sooner had he spoken than several figures were seen walking up the path from afar—it was the Tide-rider Alliance.
At this moment, they were rather bedraggled compared to when they separated. Besides Yuan Wuji, nearly every one of them was injured. The Blood Realm Venerable looked slightly paler as though he had expended too much blood energy, Bing Li had a freshly healed wound on her face, and Lan Xiao's aura was weak, not as stable as before.
As they met, the Blood Realm Venerable, seeing that Old Man Hei Zhu and others were unharmed, could not hide his surprise, "You all didn't encounter any dangers?"
"Naturally, we did, but thanks to the assistance of Lord Nether Moon God, we were fortunate to escape," Old Man Hei Zhu promptly replied.
The Blood Realm Venerable snorted coldly at that.
Seeing this, Old Man Hei Zhu and the others were also curious. After a series of inquiries, they learned that the Tide-rider Alliance had faced similar predicaments but had to fight their way out on their own. They felt grateful and shocked for their good fortune.
Meanwhile, after a brief discussion among themselves, Lan Xiao suddenly stepped forward.
"Given the unimaginable crisis on Penglai Island, since we have encountered each other again, why not join forces for the journey ahead?" she proposed.
Old Man Hei Zhu and the others exchanged glances before turning to Hua Zhi, evidently waiting for her decision.
Hua Zhi glanced at the Blood Realm Venerable but said nothing.
"Fellow Daoist Hua Zhi, there was some misunderstanding between you and my second brother earlier. With crises lurking around every corner, we should unite our efforts against common threats. Rest assured, we're willing to take an oath, promising there will be no internal conflicts until we leave Three Immortals Island," Lan Xiao said earnestly.
"Very well, with a formidable enemy before us, it's indeed better to join hands. But if we come upon treasures, how will they be distributed..." Hua Zhi spoke.
"Each person's gains will depend on their own skills. Once obtained, no one shall forcefully take them," Yuan Wuji raised his eyebrows, setting the rule.
Hua Zhi's face lit up with joy, "Good, then it's a deal."
Within the Stealing Heaven Tripod, Yuan Ming's lips also curled into a faint smile.
It was he who had just instructed Hua Zhi to join forces with the members of the Tide-rider Alliance, after all, they would need to assault the White Round Moon in the future, and the more people they could bring on board, the better.
"Have you encountered White Scale Master or Queen Ming Kong on your way here?" Old Man Hei Zhu suddenly asked.
"No, weren't they traveling with you?" Lan Xiao asked.
Old Man Hei Zhu shook his head and briefly explained how White Scale Master and the others had split up to act independently.
"Having not shown up for so long, it seems likely that they have met with misfortune rather than good fortune," said Lan Xiao.
"With that level of strength and still daring to go alone, if they're dead, they only have themselves to blame," the Blood Realm Venerable coldly huffed.
Hearing this, the rest of the group fell silent, and then set forth.
At that moment, Hua Zhi frowned and shouted sternly, "Who's there? Stop hiding and show yourself!"
With a sweep of her hand, three Vine Swords flew from her body, shooting toward a large blue rock not far away.
At her command, everyone was taken aback, thinking the Tree Man had made a comeback, and they all drew their Magic Treasures and cast their spells.
The rock was sliced into several pieces, and the three Vine Swords spiraled, cutting towards the clear ground behind the rock.
Suddenly, the void on the ground twisted, and the three Vine Swords moved sideways out of nowhere, shooting towards the distance.
"Space Divine Power!" Seeing this, Old Man Hei Zhu's heart chilled.
His Lifebound Magical Treasure, the black fishing rod, was also spatial in nature, and he had a little experience with the use of Space Power, but the controller's manipulation of spatial power surpassed him by far.
The distorted space did not dissipate but expanded and interconnected, forming a crack wide enough for two people to walk through side by side.
From within the crack, two figures stepped out leisurely.
One of them was clad in a silver robe, with big lips and small eyes, and an odd appearance — it was Yinkong.
The other person, dressed in green, was tall and strong, with robust limbs, a hawk-like hooked nose, triangular eyes, and looked fierce and ferocious, with an indomitable ferocity in his gaze.
What was most crucial was that this person made no attempt to conceal the heavy demon energy emanating from him, and even the aura of his Cultivation reached the standard of Level 5.
The appearance of a Level 5 Demon Beast changed everyone's expressions drastically, even Yuan Wuji's face grew tense, but the Green-clothed man seemed as if he didn't regard them at all, not even deeming it necessary to glance at them.
"Hehe, who would have thought that I would encounter an old acquaintance here," Yinkong's eyes swiveled as he looked at Hua Zhi seemingly in surprise.
"Shouldn't that line be mine?" Hua Zhi returned a dubious gaze.
Inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod, Yuan Ming's face also showed a hint of surprise.
It was he who had communicated psychically for Hua Zhi to take action, as he had only sensed that someone was approaching in hiding nearby without having fully identified them. Unexpectedly, it was the old acquaintance Yinkong.
What concerned him even more was the Green-clothed man beside Yinkong. Almost at first sight, Yuan Ming recognized him as the same giant green bird he had encountered in the Starry Sky Secret Realm. The aura emitted from the two was exactly the same, with no difference whatsoever.
This Level 5 Demon had also come to Three Immortals Island, and his purpose was unknown.
"Fellow Daoist need not ponder too much, Six Desires is dead, and I am now free. Hearing that Three Immortals Island had emerged, I came to witness it. It is indeed fortunate to meet here, but fellow Daoist, how did you detect our approach? My Concealing Space Divine Power shouldn't have been that easy to see through," Yinkong asked Hua Zhi curiously.
Hua Zhi shook her head without giving a direct answer, "I just had a feeling, that's all."
"Is that so? It seems fellow Daoist has greatly advanced in divine skills after breaking through to Level 4, congratulations," Yinkong chuckled.
"My divine skills are nothing compared to Fellow Daoist Yinkong, seeing as you both have also come to explore Three Immortals Island, meeting here must be fate,
why not join us? You may not be aware, but this place is extraordinarily dangerous, even for those at the Returning Void level, it's not very safe," Hua Zhi suggested, her peripheral vision keeping an eye on the Green-clothed man.
This chapter first appeared on *.
Her words naturally followed Yuan Ming's guidance.
Although they had been enemies, Yuan Ming didn't really hold any grudge against Yinkong. Moreover, now that everyone was in the same boat, he didn't want to miss out on any potential help, even if it was a demon beast.
Facing Hua Zhi's suggestion, Yinkong put away his smile, glanced around with his goldfish eyes, and said, "Where is your master? Do you not need to ask for his opinion before inviting us to join you?"
"My master is not present at the moment, and besides, your relationship with Six Desires wasn't that deep, right? There is no enmity between us, even if he were here, he would agree to my decision," Hua Zhi said calmly.
Upon hearing this, Yinkong's expression did not change, but inside he could not help but agree. Freed from Six Desires, his life was indeed better than before. In fact, he ought to thank Yuan Ming and the others.
It's one thing to say so, but to actually join forces was another matter, especially since he still wasn't in charge himself and still had to consider others.
Thinking this, Yinkong turned to look at the Green-clothed strong man. Seeing him nod slightly, he put on a smiling face again.
"It's not out of the question, but are you really in the position to decide?" Yinkong glanced at the Tide-rider Alliance members as he spoke.
"What do you think?" Hua Zhi also looked towards the members of the Tide-rider Alliance and asked.
No one spoke, they all looked to Yuan Wuji.
Yuan Wuji stared at the Green-clothed strong man, paused for a moment, and then spoke:
"It's possible," he said.

chapters.title: Chapter 605 - 605: 578
chapters.content:
At the summit of the Penglai giant peak, within the majestic great hall, spaces near a several zhang tall grey tree fluctuated continuously as one figure after another emerged. The leader among them was the elder known as San Jue.
Over a dozen figures stood behind Elder San Jue, all of them Nascent Soul cultivators. Among them were Tu Shixiong from Earth Beauty Island and Murong Yanyu from Kongling Island.
Among those Nascent Soul cultivators, there was astonishingly one Late-stage Nascent Soul Great Cultivator, four Nascent Soul Middle Stage, and the rest were all in the Nascent Soul Early Stage.
The spatial fluctuations beside the grey tree did not settle down but kept flickering; hundreds of figures appeared, turning out to be three hundred and sixty Core Formation Stage cultivators, their expressions wooden.
"Senior San Jue, may I inquire where the enemy is and what our next move will be?" A red-haired elder asked.
Surrounding this person was a layer of gauzelike red light, which seemed to contain an extremely high temperature that caused ripples in the air it touched. He was indeed that Late-stage Nascent Soul Great Cultivator.
His eyes were bright and seemed no different from ordinary people, unlike the other Nascent Soul cultivators and Core Formation cultivators whose expressions were wooden. The Nascent Soul cultivators such as Tu Shixiong and Murong Yanyu fared somewhat better in comparison.
"Do not act recklessly; I will scout ahead first," Elder San Jue said as he sat down cross-legged and flicked his fingers onto the ground.
A ball of yellow light emerged at his fingertips, expanding and contracting rapidly and forming waves of yellow ripples that spread out.
Inside the space of the Stealing Heaven Tripod, Yuan Ming's gaze pierced through the tripod and looked toward the top of the Penglai giant peak.
His Divine Sense had always been extended, sensing the situation at the summit of the mountain. The great hall's prohibitions naturally could not block his search.
"So many Nascent Soul Stage and Core Formation Stage cultivators have appeared all at once, and there's even a Returning to Void Stage presence. It seems the Undead Tree Demon plans to wipe us all out in one fell swoop..." Yuan Ming stroked his chin.
...
"One Returning Void, one Late-stage Nascent Soul, one Nascent Soul Middle Stage, seven Nascent Soul Early Stage, two Core Formation Stage. Indeed, it's a force to be reckoned with," Elder San Jue quickly withdrew his finger, speaking slowly.
This chapter was originally posted on *.
"To think that there really is a Returning Void presence descending upon the Three Immortals Island. Weren't the cultivators from the Cultivation World outside said to be waning in talent, with Late-stage Nascent Soul individuals being rare as phoenix feathers and unicorn horns?" The red-haired elder expressed surprise.
"The Yunhuang Continent may seem desolate, but its foundation is quite profound. Many capable individuals are hidden everywhere, and the Overseas World is boundless. Unknown are the numbers of powerful beings in hiding. We should never underestimate them. I will cast an Alcohol Command Spell on you to conceal your auras. You will lie in wait halfway up the mountain, setting up the Wood Emperor Array. When those people reach halfway up the mountain, use the Formation to trap them and eliminate them all in one fell swoop!" Elder San Jue said slowly.
As he spoke, he took a big gulp from the wine gourd at his waist and then sprayed towards the people.
A mist of transparent alcohol enveloped all present in an instant, rapidly merging into their bodies.
The next moment, the bodies of those in the hall suddenly became transparent, and all their auras vanished without a trace.
The bodies of the group lit up with strands of green light as they all burrowed into the ground.
After completing all this, Elder San Jue's figure flickered and he too disappeared from sight.
Yuan Ming sensed the actions of the cultivators led by the Returning to Void elder on the summit and also heard their conversation, his eyebrows knitting together.
With the support of the Stealing Heaven Tripod, no large array or prohibition could obstruct his Divine Sense. He had already experienced the effects of the Wood Emperor Array. No matter how much the power of the Formation increased, it would not be difficult for him to handle.
However, he was not confident that he could deal with that Returning Void elder.
Using the Desire Power within the White Jade Lotus Platform, Yuan Ming's Soul Power had reached the threshold of the Word Witch Realm; his Soul Power might not be stronger than that of the elder. Yuan Ming's eyes moved, and his Divine Sense enveloped the Green-clothed strong man, transmitting a message through Divine Sense, "Greetings, Fellow Daoist."
"Soul Power at the level of a Word Witch! Who are you?" The Green-clothed strong man's expression changed slightly, and his Sea of Consciousness Soul Power vibrated, forming a voice.
"I am known as the Nether Moon God," Yuan Ming replied with an air of mystery.
"So it's the Nether Moon God who has descended. It's unexpected that beside the Wu Yue God of the Wu Yue Sect, there is another Word Witch presence in the Yunhuang Continent. Fellow Daoist, what brings you here?" the Green-clothed strong man asked without surprise, his tone noncommittal.
Yuan Ming's eyebrow shot up; from the Green-clothed man's words, it seemed he had some connections with the Wu Yue God of the Wu Yue Sect.
"I have a matter to discuss with you, Fellow Daoist. May I know your esteemed name?" he asked, suppressing his curiosity.
"You are a Word Witch yet you ask for my name; isn't that quite impolite?" remarked the Green-clothed strong man coldly.
Yuan Ming was taken aback, then realized that the Green-clothed strong man thought it inappropriate for a Word Witch to ask for his name. Could it be related to the abilities of a Word Witch?
Xi Ying's knowledge about Word Witch abilities was incomplete, so he was even more in the dark.
"I was in a rush. Please do not take offense, Fellow Daoist," Yuan Ming replied vaguely.
"Judging by your articulate tone, you must be from the Human Clan of Yunhuang Continent. We of the Demon Clan are different from your Human Clan; we do not appreciate beating around the bush. Just speak your mind," the Green-clothed strong man said with a cooling tone.
"Since Fellow Daoist prefers straightforwardness, I will just say it. How do you view the current situation on Three Immortals Island?" Yuan Ming asked.
"The situation is grim. The Undead Tree Demon controls most areas of Three Immortals Island and the secret realm space is sealed. We all have been detained and cannot easily leave this place," the Green-clothed strong man replied after a pause.
"You're right. With your divine abilities, you wouldn't have come to Three Immortals Island on a whim. Would you be interested in joining forces with me to slay the Undead Tree Demon and seize all the treasures on the island?" Yuan Ming suggested.
"Although you are a Word Witch, that's quite a boastful claim. Do you have any idea of the Undead Tree Demon's strength? The Undying Tree is an ancient rare tree; its abilities far exceed your imagination," the Green-clothed strong man scoffed.
"So, you seem to have quite a deep understanding of the Undying Tree Demons?" Yuan Ming asked with a moved expression.
"Understanding is a big word, I only know a little," the green-clothed strong man said vaguely, obviously not yet ready to share what he knew with Yuan Ming.
"The Undying Tree is indeed formidable, but I firmly do not believe that something truly undying exists in this world. With your divine skills, you must already know the purpose of the Undying Tree Demon. We and it are destined to only have one survive. Why the hesitation, Fellow Daoist?" Yuan Ming said.
The green-clothed strong man stayed silent.
"Let's put aside the matter of the Undying Tree Demon for now. Haven't you noticed that a group of Undying Tree Puppets has appeared at the top of the giant peak, among which exists a Returning Void presence, lying in ambush below the mountain, preparing to ambush us? What do you plan to do, Fellow Daoist?" Yuan Ming's eyes twinkled as he asked again, not hiding any information.
"A Returning Void Puppet! Who is it? An old man, or a youth?" the green-clothed strong man suddenly changed color and asked urgently through a transmitted message.
"An old man with a red nose," Yuan Ming replied, his eyes moving.
"This man is called Elder San Jue, said to come from Chang Chun Temple in the Central Plains. He is well-versed in Artifact Refining, wine brewing, swordsmanship, and calls himself 'San Jue,' with very formidable strength!" the green-clothed strong man slowly said.
"Elder San Jue is a disciple of Chang Chun Temple!" Yuan Ming's heart was tumultuous, but then he returned to calm.
Chang Chun Temple had stood in the Central Plains for tens of thousands of years; it wasn't strange for one or two Returning to Void cultivators to emerge from there.
However, each existence at the Returning to Void Stage should be well-known throughout Yunhuang, why had he never heard of the name San Jue?
"This person was locked here thousands of years ago, at the time only possessing Late-stage Nascent Soul Cultivation. In the last hundred years, he broke through to the Returning to Void Stage," the green-clothed strong man said.
"I see, Fellow Daoist. Have you thought about how to act, or would you be interested in joining me to confront Elder San Jue and eliminate one of the Undying Tree Demon's strong subordinates?" Yuan Ming didn't ask the green-clothed strong man how he knew about Elder San Jue, instead he asked.
"Elder San Jue has formidable divine skills and has the Undying Tree as his backing. Although I have reached Level 5 realm, I am not confident I can handle him. If Fellow Daoist Nether Moon God is willing to take the lead, I would be willing to join hands," the green-clothed strong man said with a sly smile on his face.
"Agreed, I will take the lead, and you just need to find the right opportunity to act," Yuan Ming said without minding the green-clothed strong man's craftiness.
After all, his true body was hidden within the Stealing Heaven Tripod, and Elder San Jue could never attack him no matter what; whether he led the charge or brought up the rear made no difference.
"Really?" the green-clothed strong man asked in surprise.
"Of course, just wait for my signal," Yuan Ming said.
...
While the two were talking, Elder San Jue led a group of Nascent Soul cultivators and Core Formation Tree People, swiftly moving underground, and soon arrived at the mountainside.
The group stopped in a dense forest full of trees.
"Spread out here, everyone heed my command, immediately set up the Wood Emperor Array," Elder San Jue ordered.
More than a dozen Nascent Soul cultivators responded at once, each leading a group of Core Formation Tree People in different directions into the woods, preparing to set up an array with three hundred sixty Core Formation Stage Tree People, powerful enough to trap a Returning to Void cultivator.
Murong Yanyu, leading thirty-six Core Formation Stage Tree People, rushed to the eastern part of the forest. As one of the key Array Eyes in the large-scale Wood Emperor Formation, she had to finish setting up earlier than the others.
Upon reaching the predetermined location, the thirty-six Core Formation Stage Tree People immediately spread out and each merged into an ancient tree, concealing their forms.
Murong Yanyu also sat down cross-legged in the center of these thirty-six people.
The other nine teams, just like her, were led by one or two Nascent Soul cultivators to their designated positions and began setting up the array.
After the whole array was completed, Elder San Jue went behind a large rock, restrained his aura, and quietly awaited the arrival of those from below within the encirclement.
It wasn't long before a noisy commotion came from not too far away.
A group of people hurried along, approaching in this direction, seemingly still arguing about something.
Compared to when they were below the mountain, the number of people who had come up had obviously decreased.
Long Chong, Aunt Wan Hua, and Old Man Hei Zhu were all there, but Hua Zhi, Silver Kong Tree Demon, and the green-clothed man were missing.
Elder San Jue, sensing a discrepancy from his earlier perception, clearly hesitated, but upon hearing the arguing of those people, realized they had disputes on the way and some had left the team.
Seeing that the group had already stepped into the array, he no longer hesitated and immediately gave the order:
"Take action!"
Murong Yanyu, Tu Shixiong, and the other Nascent Soul cultivators did not dare to delay, rapidly leading the Core Formation Stage Tree People to activate the array.
"Boom boom boom!"
Loud explosive sounds erupted all around.
What was activated was not any Wood Emperor Array, but the Eight-direction Fire Element Formation.

chapters.title: Chapter 606 - 579: The Youth Are to be Feared
chapters.content:
Originally, Yuan Ming, having learned of Elder San Jue's ambush plan, immediately instructed the green-clothed strong men to come to this location, rich in Wood Attribute aura, and set up the Eight-direction Fire Element Formation.
At the same time, within the Stealing Heaven Tripod space, Yuan Ming was seated on the White Jade Lotus Platform, having already utilized the rune power of "All Living Beings' Dream" to overlay a powerful Illusion Technique on the Eight-direction Fire Element Formation.
Those brought by Elder San Jue had, in fact, entered Yuan Ming's illusion as soon as they stepped into this mid-slope area, with their sense of direction, north, south, east, and west, already disturbed.
Thus, the busy arrangements they previously made for setting up the Wood Emperor Array were actually under Yuan Ming's manipulation, leading them to run around aimlessly without any proper method, naturally failing to set up any real array.
Only when they were deep within the illusion did the Eight-direction Fire Element Formation begin to reveal its fangs.
The scenes woven by the illusion technique gradually lost their color, and the group led by Wulu, which had appeared in the center, had already vanished.
Instead, those Nascent Soul cultivators and Core Formation Stage Tree People who thought they were dispersing to set up the Array were led by Yuan Ming in several circles and ended up neatly surrounded at the center like lambs waiting to be slaughtered.
Around their perimeter, figures such as Aunt Wan Hua, Old Man Hei Zhu, Shi Yanshi, Wulu, Long Chong, and others appeared one by one, each holding a golden talisman in their hands, raised high.
As these individuals chanted, the talismans shimmered with golden light, each emitting a beam of golden light that shot into the sky, interconnecting to form a giant Golden Light Formation with runes burning a crimson glow.
Meteor-like fireballs, trailing long flames, tore through the night sky, smashing towards the Nascent Soul cultivators and Core Formation Stage Tree People within the formation.
In an instant, the sound of booming explosions rose continuously.
The tremendous impact shook the entire mountaintop, and the exploding fireballs, with their mighty force and fierce flames, engulfed a large number of Core Formation Stage Tree People.
The unmatched Tree People, who had yet to complete the Wood Emperor Array and thus could not harness the Earth Vein Spiritual Power of the land, were physically strong but not to the extent of being immune to fire and water, suffering heavy losses in just a few breaths.
The Nascent Soul Tree People tried to defend against the overwhelming fireball attacks using various methods but were suppressed for the time being.This content originates from *, *.
"It's just a pity that we didn't have more time, otherwise, if we had layered several more Attack Arrays outside this Eight-direction Fire Element Formation, we could have wiped out those Nascent Soul cultivators as well," Blood Realm Venerable remarked with delight and a hint of regret as he watched the scene unfold.
"We owe much to Fellow Daoist Hua Zhi's prior arrangements; otherwise, we would be the ones trapped in the formation now," Lan Xiao replied.
"It's all guided by the Nether Moon God…," Old Man Hei Zhu and others earnestly sighed.
Behind a massive rock, Elder San Jue, changing from his previously drowsy demeanor, widened his eyes and swiftly scanned back and forth.
He too was startled by this sudden turn of events, never having expected that they would be the ones ambushed.
No sooner had he thought to attack the Eight-direction Fire Element Formation himself than his feet suddenly became sluggish, and vine tendrils that had unbeknownst to him already covered his legs, seemed to connect him to the ground.
At the same time, a numbing sensation spread from his shins toward his knees.
"Poisoned!" Elder San Jue furrowed his brows.
With a light cry from his mouth, without even forming a spell with his hands, sword qi burst forth from his body, and his legs, like two exquisitely sharp divine swords, easily sliced through the entwining vines, suppressing the numbness in his legs.
At the same time, Elder San Jue's cheeks flushed with a tinge of red, and he couldn't help but belch a hiccup.
With the sound of a "hic~", a faint alcoholic scent immediately emanated from his body, only slightly pink to the eye but with a rich fragrance when smelled.
