However, as the scent of alcohol spread, the numbness in his feet was instantly relieved, while Hua Zhi, hidden underground, suddenly felt her head sink as if she had drunk a hundred casks of fine wine, becoming slightly bleary-eyed and struggling to circulate her demonic power.
Although she was intoxicated, Yuan Ming, who was hidden within the Stealing Heaven Tripod, was not.
At this moment, he was seated on the White Jade Lotus Platform, once again activating his Divine Soul Power, but not to cast Illusion Techniques on all enemies, instead focusing solely on battling Elder San Jue.
Just as Elder San Jue had shaken off the effects of Hua Zhi's poison, his vision blurred again, and he saw dark metallic chains piercing through his chest, abdomen, and limbs.
His body was dragged and hung on a massive black ancient tree, and no matter how much he struggled, he couldn't break free.
"It's another illusion, those sneaky Soul Cultivators, the most despicable, must be killed," Elder San Jue angrily shouted.
The word "kill" burst out with a suddenly heightened voice, mixing a strong Soul Power and sharp Sword Intent, instantly shattering the illusion constructed by Yuan Ming as if a mirror had broken.
However, before Elder San Jue could make a move, a silver light abruptly brightened in front of him, and a green-clothed figure appeared out of nowhere, wielding a sharp Magic Treasure, thrusting towards him.
A force as sharp as the sky shot towards him, in no way inferior to the Sword Intent that Elder San Jue had just unleashed!
Elder San Jue was taken aback and hastily summoned a green round bead to block in front of him.
Boom!
A vertical and horizontal green hurricane burst forth from the green round bead, attempting to blow the green-clothed man away.
The latter however shouted angrily, emitting a sharp avian cry from his throat, and a giant green predatory bird phantom directly appeared trailing a green light behind him.
The green hurricane had no effect on him; the green-clothed strong man passed directly through it, his figure blurred as he moved through Elder San Jue's chest, directly tearing out his heart.
Elder San Jue's body became sluggish and he collapsed onto the ground listlessly.
The green-clothed strong man rubbed his palms back and forth, gradually crushing the heart into dust.
"Don't be careless, crush his entire body thoroughly," Yuan Ming's reminder resounded from his Sea of Consciousness.
The green-clothed strong man furrowed his brows slightly, seemingly discontent with being commanded like this.
But thinking about how everything that had transpired since the beginning had unfolded just as the Nether Moon God had predicted, and considering the achievements under his plans and commands were the same as he had stated, he proceeded to attack Elder San Jue as instructed.
He raised his hand and spread his fingers, slapping down abruptly, and a massive green light hook claw appeared from the void, entwined with countless green light blades, slashing towards Elder San Jue below.
Elder San Jue's feet stomped, and a ring of blue-gold light emerged from the ground, forming into a round blue-gold Sword Array.
Crazily emerging like bamboo shoots after a rain, countless blue swords rimmed with gold surged upwards.
In the "whiz whiz" sounds, hundreds to thousands of sword glimmers shot out, thrusting at the green light hook claw.
However, after a brief clash, the green light hook claw couldn't withstand it and directly shattered.
At the center of the green-gold Sword Array, Elder San Jue slowly stood up, his face still flushed, but now with a hint of excitement and madness in his eyes.
From his chest to his abdomen, there was a terrifying longitudinal wound, almost completely hollowing out his entire chest and abdomen, such that one could see cleanly straight through from front to back.
However, as a gray little tree's phantom appeared on his forehead, the battered body inside was rapidly repairing a heart enveloped in green light, and the other wounds were also healing at a visible speed.
In just a few breaths, Elder San Jue had completely recovered.
"So this is the Undead Tree Puppet..." The green-clothed strong man slightly raised his eyebrows.
"These juniors really have some capabilities; one cannot help but exclaim that the younger generation is to be feared indeed," Elder San Jue murmured to himself, though it was unclear whether he was speaking to the green-clothed man or to himself.
But as his voice fell, a glaring blue-gold light suddenly burst from behind him, and an even more magnificent, much larger round Sword Array emerged.
Above the round Sword Array, exquisite runes were distributed layer by layer, with thousands of blue and gold swords densely arranged on it, each vibrating slightly, emitting a chorus of low hums like sword chants.
A deadly sharp Sword Qi emanated from the Sword Array, overwhelming and solid-like, providing everyone with an indescribable intense oppressive feeling.
The moment they saw this enormous Sword Array, Silver Kong Tree Demon's body involuntarily stiffened, and the face of the green-clothed strong man also displayed a few shades of solemnity.
Fellow Daoist Hua Zhi finally awakened from a drunken stupor, and by fusing with the powers of Purple Extreme Tai Sui, she could quickly neutralize the toxins, but the strange alcoholic effects were not so easily removed.
As she returned to the ground, seeing Elder San Jue releasing his formidable prowess also caused her to startle.
"I'll block his attack this time, you'd better control him quickly, otherwise I'll have to leave you guys behind," the green-clothed strong man frowned, and with a forward surge, he rushed towards Elder San Jue.
Fellow Daoist Hua Zhi, knowing that the green-clothed strong man's words were meant for Yuan Ming, made no reaction.
Inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space, Yuan Ming sat cross-legged on the White Jade Lotus Platform, his eyes tightly closed, concentrating all his power on gathering the Divine Power. His first soul had also returned to the Sea of Consciousness at this time, cooperating with the main soul to activate the All Living Beings' Dream Rune, launching the Nightmare Divine Ability.
Xi Ying and Guoguo guarded nearby, ready to provide support at any moment.
Outside the tripod, Elder San Jue pinched a Sword technique and waved forward, whereupon the blue-gold Sword Array behind him flashed brightly, and numerous blue and gold Flying Swords burst out like an iron torrent, rushing towards the green-clothed strong man.
"Clang clang clang"
The continual sound of metal friction was almost grating to the ears.
The torrent of Flying Swords continuously burst with numerous Sword Shadows, attacking like a sky-covering onslaught.
With a sudden cry of a giant bird, rolling Sound Waves carrying heart-shaking power charged towards the sky full of sword light, accompanied by two hundred-meter-high green hurricanes.
The powerful Sound Waves shook the entire mountain to tremble, causing all nearby cultivators' eardrums to throb with a sharp pain.
The sky full of sword light collided with the Sound Waves, and for a moment, they were evenly matched, both quickly disintegrating.
After a few breaths, the Sound Waves dissipated, and the sword light was completely depleted, but the torrent of Flying Swords that had formed did not disappear and continued unstoppably into the two green hurricanes.
The two green hurricanes rubbed against each other, like two sharpening millstones, pulling those Flying Swords into their midst.
In a series of "clang" sounds, nearly a hundred Flying Swords were forcefully broken by the green hurricanes, but many more passed through the hurricanes, shooting towards the green-clothed strong man and the others behind.

chapters.title: Chapter 607 - 580: Shared Fate
chapters.content:
The green-clothed man sighed as he looked at the scene before him.
The strength of Elder San Jue was higher than he had anticipated, and although he still had some strength left, he no longer had much confidence in his ability to kill him.
Just then, within the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space, on the White Jade Lotus Platform, Yuan Ming's eyes suddenly opened wide.
An immense Divine Sense Power immediately radiated from his body, subsequently manifesting outside and enveloping Elder San Jue.
While Elder San Jue was exerting all his power to drive the Sword Formation, planning to wipe them all out in one go, his vision suddenly became engulfed in boundless darkness, blinding him completely.
"It's that rat again!"
His gums clenched tightly, and his hatred for the soul cultivator who had been hiding all this time reached its peak.
Just as he was about to activate his Divine Soul Power and use a secret technique to break the Illusion Array, a voice suddenly echoed in his ear:
"It seems the lessons you've been given are still not enough. Would you also turn against me?"
The moment this voice sounded, Elder San Jue's whole body shivered uncontrollably.
He knew this voice all too well - it was the voice of the Undying Tree that enslaved him.
Over the past millennium, he had been tormented too many times by the Undying Tree. His original spirit of rebellion had been worn away, leaving behind only fear, a fear that had seeped into his very bones toward that immortal being.
This had become a habit.
Elder San Jue suppressed his instinctual fear and looked ahead, only to see that within the darkness, the silhouette of a colossal tree gradually became clearer.
Vines hung down from the tree trunk, and at the bottom, they wrapped around numerous large cocoons.
The topmost one, with an opening that resembled a gaping maw of blood, was constantly opening and closing as if waiting to choose its next victim.
Elder San Jue carefully examined the aura emanating from the giant tree, and there was no mistake – it was indeed that old monster.
"Come back. This is where you truly belong," the voice of the Undying Tree rang out again.
With that call, which seemed to hold a kind of magical power, Elder San Jue found himself irresistibly drawn towards the giant tree, despite the extreme resistance in his heart.
That was the terrifying aspect of "Nightmare." The illusions it brought were not constructed by the spellcaster, but instead, it triggered the deepest fears in the heart of the person subjected to it, drawing them into the illusion.
The Undying Tree, which filled Elder San Jue with fear, was a construct of his own memories and fears; all details, including the aura he perceived, were fabricated by himself, making it impossible for him to see through the illusion.
In essence, his own fear and memory had deceived him.
Caught in the Nightmare, Elder San Jue's consciousness was almost entirely lost, only a fraction of his instinct remained, still resisting obstinately.
His Green Gold Sword Formation could no longer be maintained and vanished without a trace.
The green-clothed man, overjoyed at this development, immediately leaped forward to completely annihilate him.
"Wait, leave it to me," Yuan Ming's voice suddenly rang out in the green-clothed man's Sea of Consciousness.
The latter, momentarily startled, ultimately respected Yuan Ming's wishes and stopped.
At that moment, a streak of Blood Light shot out from Hua Zhi's hand; the Shura Blood Devouring Map unfolded with a "whirring" noise, enveloping Elder San Jue and directly drawing him inside the map.
However, just as Elder San Jue had fallen into the Shura Blood Devouring Map, his Sea of Consciousness suddenly shook violently.
His Divine Soul was engulfed by a force, intending to abandon the physical body and break through the void.
Yuan Ming had already seen this technique in the Jade Scroll provided by Qi Ye; he knew it was the secret technique used by the Undying Tree to control all its wooden puppets, allowing it to summon and directly extract the Divine Soul of its puppets.
If the Divine Soul was retrieved, the Undying Tree could simply spend some time to create another body for the puppet, and once the two were merged, it would be restored as before.
Naturally, Yuan Ming wouldn't just watch it succeed, and immediately summoned Xi Ying to assist. Together, they used their immense Divine Soul Power to forcefully suppress Elder San Jue's Divine Soul, preventing it from immediately flying back.
Outside, Hua Zhi acted swiftly, quickly stepping forward and grabbing the Shura Blood Devouring Map that was flying back.
In the next instant, with a flash of the map, Yuan Ming drew it into the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space.
And just as the Shura Blood Devouring Map returned to the Stealing Heaven Tripod, Elder San Jue's Divine Soul suddenly ceased its resistance.
Yuan Ming was first taken aback, then swiftly realized the situation.
"Haha, it seems the space within the Stealing Heaven Tripod has blocked the Undying Tree's summons; this will save me quite a bit of effort," Yuan Ming laughed heartily.
Then, he transmitted his voice to the green-clothed man and Silver Kong Tree Demon and the others, instructing them to swiftly assist the others in dealing with the remaining Nascent Soul cultivators and Core Formation Stage Tree People.
As they were unable to set up the Wood Emperor Array, the puppets had already suffered heavy losses, with many Core Formation Stage Tree People being eliminated and several Nascent Soul cultivators dead. Now that even their leader, Elder San Jue, had been dealt with, the rest had no more fighting spirit, and they promptly scattered and fled in all directions.
Within the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space, Yuan Ming pressed his hand onto the Shura Blood Devouring Map, and a stream of soul-searching black light penetrated it, probing Elder San Jue's memories.Sоurсеd dirесtly frоm МV6LЕМР6YR.
It was only moments later he withdrew his hand, took out a jade scroll, and engraved upon it a Cultivation Technique — the Nine Elements Technique, which contained all mnemonics from the Qi Refinement Realm to the Returning to Void Stage.
Elder San Jue had been cultivating the Nine Elements Technique, and such an opportunity was rare. Even though pressing circumstances prevailed, Yuan Ming took the time to obtain this cultivation technique.
Yuan Ming refrained from delving further into his memories, and continued to propel the Shura Blood Devouring Map, extracting Elder San Jue's Qi-Blood.
Having reached the Nascent Soul Stage, Yuan Ming's activation of the Shura Blood Devouring Map no longer felt like a child swinging a heavy hammer; the refining process was incredibly smooth. In no time, he completely drained Elder San Jue's Essence Blood and refined it, and his physical body was processed into a Returning to Void Stage Blood Slave.
Feeling the abundant Qi-Blood from Elder San Jue, Yuan Ming could hardly contain his excitement.
He didn't supply his Qi-Blood to the Undying Black Tree, but activated the Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill to absorb this extremely pure Qi-Blood Power and refine it into his body.
Outside the tripod, Murong Yanyu, covered in wounds, lay in a mountain depression, the Seven Emotions Zither she was holding had already broken all its strings, yet her facial expression wasn't as panicked as at the beginning, but revealed a sense of relief.
"Given that we follow the same path, make it quick, destroy my Divine Soul. I don't want to return to that dark place and be enslaved by that old monster again," Murong Yanyu said.
"Do you have any last words you wish to be carried back to the sect?" Long Chong asked.
"Everything that needed saying was said when I left the sect, there's nothing more to say. If you can make it back alive, just don't reveal the fact that I was enslaved," Murong Yanyu shook her head and replied.
"Alright, we promise you," Long Chong glanced at the others, saw them all nodding, and then answered.
"Go ahead, thank you," Murong Yanyu said, and then closed her eyes.
Long Chong thrust his spear forward, aiming straight at her glabella, and Shi Yanshi simultaneously swung his brush, writing a "destroy" character in the void that entered her Sea of Consciousness.
Elsewhere, the Green-clothed man had already snapped Tu Shixiong's neck, incidentally destroying his Divine Soul as well.
In the dark space.
"Dead? How could he be dead... Impossible!" The Undying Tree sensed Elder San Jue's death and immediately let out a roar of rage.
When the anomaly was first noticed, it had already attempted to summon his Divine Soul back but failed miserably.
Moreover, the Spiritual Treasure inside it acted up again, and it had to suppress the urge to forcibly exit seclusion; it did not expect Elder San Jue to actually fall.
That was one of its most important sources of strength; such a loss was far heavier than the death of thousands of Core Formation Tree People.
"Just wait, you all belong to me, all mine!" A roar of indignation echoed in the dark space.
...
Inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space, Yuan Ming had finally completely refined Elder San Jue's abundant Qi-Blood. His Body Cultivation Realm rose to a new level, and inside his body, his Qi-Blood surged like a tide, breaking through to the Tongqiao Body.
Yuan Ming sat cross-legged, all his acupoints fully opened, and from within the surrounding void, streaks of white light roamed toward him, converging into his body.
That power was both intense and powerful, filled with the righteous and radiant presence of the sun, it was indeed the Power of the Sun.
The acupoints on Yuan Ming's body, like numerous gaping mouths, greedily swallowed the Power of the Sun, making his pores seem bathed in sunlight, receiving the baptism of the True Sun Fire.
As the Power of the Sun infused continuously, his Qi-Blood roared like a dragon in every part of his body, tempering his limbs and bones. His tendons, muscles, and bones were all strengthening at a terrifying rate.
Xi Ying, watching this scene, felt gratified yet couldn't help but worry, and reminded him,
"The Power of the Sun within the Stealing Heaven Tripod is too rarefied, I'm afraid it's not sufficient to bring your Tongqiao Body to perfection, it could leave flaws in your future cultivation."
Hearing this, Yuan Ming remained undisturbed.
With a twist of his wrist, a Golden Crow Divine Arrow appeared in his palm.
Upon seeing this, Xi Ying's eyes brightened, and her worry vanished.
In terms of the purity of the Power of the Sun, the Golden Crow Divine Arrow naturally contained a higher essence than the Power of the Sun in the void outside, and the Golden Crow True Fire inside it was the concentrated essence of the Power of the Sun.
Yuan Ming grasped the arrow, and the surface of the Divine Arrow immediately shone with a dazzling white light. Then, intense flames burst forth from it and spread rapidly, enveloping Yuan Ming completely.
However, the flames that wrapped around his entire body didn't inflict any harm; instead, they seemed to be forging his Physical Body, continuously burning away the impurities within and releasing them as streams of black air from his pores.
Yuan Ming's profound Divine Soul Power and Mana were also drawn into the transformation of his Physical Body.
Time slowly passed, and the flames surrounding Yuan Ming gradually shrank before being absorbed into his body until they completely vanished.
At that moment, Yuan Ming's Tongqiao Body was finally perfected.
His eyes snapped open, bursting with scorching light, and his entire demeanor seemed to have undergone some transformation.
When Xi Ying looked directly at him, she involuntarily felt the urge to shield her eyes, as if she were staring at the blazing sun.
But this illusion did not last long. As soon as Yuan Ming stabilized his realm, his breath became restrained once more, and he resumed his usual appearance.
"How do you feel?" Xi Ying was curious about his transformation and asked.
"Just as you said before, the Tongqiao Body is a threshold for Body Cultivation. After this transformation by absorbing the Power of the Sun, my physique has greatly improved, feeling clear throughout. My acupoints seem to store a vast amount of the Power of the Sun. My strength has increased more than tenfold, and my defensive power has grown substantially. Even taking direct attacks from the Magic Treasures of Nascent Soul cultivators doesn't pose too much of a problem for me now," Yuan Ming flexed his hand and couldn't conceal his joy as he spoke.
"Advancing to the Tongqiao Body requires understanding a conception. Have you comprehended any?" Xi Ying continued to ask.
"Of course," Yuan Ming responded with determined eyes.
"What conception have you grasped?" Xi Ying inquired.
For a Tongqiao Body cultivator, the comprehension of conception is extremely important as it directly determines their future growth direction.
Yuan Ming hadn't been practicing Body Cultivation for long, but he had a solid foundation, and both Magic Practitioner and Soul Cultivation had reached exceedingly high realms, which unexpectedly helped him a lot in comprehending conceptions.
"Shared Fate!" Yuan Ming closed his eyes and, after a moment, spoke.
"Shared Fate?" Xi Ying clearly heard this conception for the first time and repeated it in confusion.
"As the name suggests, my conception can link my life with that of my enemy's, sharing prosperity and suffering together," Yuan Ming looked at his fist and slowly explained.

chapters.title: Chapter 608 - 581: Entering Guang Han
chapters.content:
Xi Ying listened to Yuan Ming's words, pondered for a long time, seemingly still contemplating the deeper implications within.
"The Shared Fate power that I've awakened can be divided into two stages. The first stage is called 'Life-lock', which can be activated as long as there's physical contact with the target, hence merging our life force together and locking it in place. The second stage is 'Shared Fate' itself, which, through the Life-lock of the first stage, shares life force between both parties, meaning life and death together; any injury I sustain will also manifest on the other person, and similarly, their injuries will appear on me," Yuan Ming explained.
"Is it only the person who shares fate with you that, when injuring you, will have this effect? Or once Shared Fate is complete, no matter who injures you, the person sharing fate with you will also sustain the same injuries?" Xi Ying asked.
"It's the latter situation," Yuan Ming said.
"In that case, as long as you share fate with the other party, if you were to injure yourself, could you also harm them?" Xi Ying quickly caught onto this possibility.
"Correct," Yuan Ming nodded.
"If it were an ordinary person who possessed this ability, it would be nothing more than a trifling matter, but you practice the cultivation of spell, body, and soul, possess a spirit beast like Hua Zhi, and you've now refined the Undying Tree into your Lifebound Spirit Plant. Purely in terms of withstanding injuries, there are few on the Yunhuang Continent who surpass you. This Shared Life Divine Power in your hands can play a role beyond imagination," Xi Ying nodded, a slight smile appearing at the corner of her mouth as she instantly envisioned many ways to employ this divine power.
"Perhaps it's precisely because I have these conditions that I was able to awaken this power," Yuan Ming suggested.
"Indeed," Xi Ying concurred.
While Xi Ying and Yuan Ming were discussing, Hua Zhi had already sent news that the Nascent Soul cultivators and Tree People outside had been almost entirely eliminated, including the red-haired Late-stage Nascent Soul old man.
Xi Ying also took out an Array Plate and said, "The Transmission Array Plate is also ready."
Yuan Ming looked at the Array Plate in her hand, his expression a bit hesitant.
Although the bow was drawn, was this truly the right opportunity to strike Guanghan City?
Or were there really no other means of leaving Three Immortals Island?
Seeing him silent, Xi Ying knew his concerns and hesitations and didn't attempt to persuade him, merely saying, "Whether you go or not, I will support your decision."
Yuan Ming pursed his lips, nodded slightly, and was about to speak when, from within the Shura Blood Devouring Map, Qi Ye's voice emerged.
"Yuan, do not hesitate any longer. A heaven-sent opportunity lies before us. Please hasten to Guanghan City for the decisive battle; otherwise, we will never have hope to defeat the Undead Tree Demon!"
Yuan Ming's brow slightly furrowed, "Senior Qi Ye, has something happened in Guanghan City?"
"Indeed, the Undead Tree Demon is currently afflicted with its hidden illness and is fully engaged in dealing with it. If you strike now, Yuan, it will certainly not be able to defend itself. The opportunity must not be missed," Qi Ye urgently said.
Yuan Ming's eyes flashed, "If that's the case, I will set out immediately."
"Good. However, the Shura Blood Devouring Map may be of significant use during the decisive battle. Since you'll be hiding within the Space Treasure, so as not to delay its use, you'd better entrust it to someone you trust to keep as a reserve measure," Qi Ye's voice lowered again.
Yuan Ming did not blindly trust Qi Ye. After his voice faded, he immediately used the desire power marker from Queen Ming Kong to project his Divine Sense into Guanghan City.Broughttoyouby*.
He saw the Undead Tree Demon within the soluble cave concentrating all its demonic power inside its body, struggling against the black Magic Mirror which was agitating for unknown reasons.
Yuan Ming observed for a moment, confirmed that Qi Ye's words were true, retracted his Divine Sense, and after deliberating, he finally made a decision.
"Time waits for no one; we will enter Guanghan City now!"
Xi Ying silently nodded, while Yuan Ming once again used the power of the White Jade Lotus Platform to issue a decree to everyone as Lord Nether Moon God.
Unlike the private transmissions of the past, this time, the voice of Lord Nether Moon God directly rang in everyone's ears.
"Everyone, I have ascertained that the spatial passage for leaving Three Immortals Island is located within the White Round Moon, and I also have a way to transport everyone to the interior of the Round Moon. However, the core of the Undead Tree Demon is also guarding the passage. If you want to leave, you'll have to fight a decisive battle with it," Nether Moon God announced.
Upon hearing this, everyone was startled, their expressions changing rapidly.
Ignoring their reactions, Yuan Ming continued, "The Undead Tree Demon is now troubled by a hidden illness and is temporarily unable to make full effort in combat, making this the perfect opportunity to escape. The choice is yours whether to risk your life for a chance at freedom or to stay here and become puppets of the Tree Demon. You have at most a quarter of an hour to decide."
The voice of Lord Nether Moon God gradually faded away, but his speech lingered in everyone's hearts.
The group exchanged glances, fell silent for a moment, then Yuan Wuji was the first to express his stance.
"Heh, if we don't go, we'll eventually be trapped here to die; if we go, we might not necessarily die. What is there to hesitate about? However, once we're in, we'll decide how to act on our own," he said.
The Green-clothed man also spoke up, "The two of us feel the same. Once we're inside, we won't just follow your orders."
"I've already made it clear that the choice lies in your hands," Yuan Ming replied with a faint smile, responding as Lord Nether Moon God.
The white round moon today is hardly a safe place, rife with tree-man puppets. The moment one enters, confrontation with the Undead Tree Demon becomes inevitable unless Yuan Wuji and others surrender like the White Scale Master did. Otherwise, there is no possibility of remaining uninvolved.
Moreover, splitting up into three groups works better for Yuan Ming, as he only needs to protect his own people.
While Yuan Wuji and the green-clothed man had made their stances clear, Old Man Hei Zhu and his two companions still hesitated.
They understood the principle of mutual dependence for survival but, after all, Yuan Wuji was at the late-stage Nascent Soul and the green-clothed man was a Level 5 demon beast, each with a certain capacity to fight the Undead Tree Demon. However, the three of them were only at the early Nascent Soul stage and not inclined to fight. Rashly jumping into the battle in the Returning to Void Realm might not make even a splash and could be tantamount to delivering their heads on a plate. They would rather stay here than be a hindrance.
Just then, Wulu suddenly spoke up, "Lord Nether Moon God, may I also contribute to the decisive battle?"
"Of course, you can. Although you are at the Core Formation stage, the Undead Tree Demon also has Core Formation tree-man puppets. The more you can entangle, the better we can focus on dealing with the Undead Tree Demon," Yuan answered.
Wulu nodded, "Good, since that's the case, I also wish to go to the round moon and act alongside the Flower God Servant."
As Wulu's voice died down, Yuan's voice echoed in his Sea of Consciousness, "Wulu, my friend, your willingness to join is a great comfort to me. I will surely do everything in my power to ensure your safety. However, just before we enter the white round moon, activate the Heavenly Escape Stone Talisman to hide at once and do me a favor. There's no need for you to confront the tree-man puppets head-on."
Wulu was startled, not knowing when the Nether Moon God became aware of his possession of the Heavenly Escape Stone Talisman. While his thoughts raced, he still silently said in his heart, "I will heed the decree of the Nether Moon God."
Hearing this exchange, Old Man Hei Zhu and the others had unnatural expressions on their faces.
Even a Core Formation Stage cultivator like Wulu showed such resolve whereas they, at the Nascent Soul stage, hesitated. It indeed reflected poorly on them, appearing excessively cowardly. But since their lives were in the balance, they couldn't avoid careful deliberation.
At that moment, Long Chong suddenly asked, "Lord Nether Moon God, I have a question. Can those who have been transformed into tree puppets be restored to their original state?"
Yuan understood he was asking whether there was any hope for his father. After a silent sigh, recalling the experience gathered from multiple encounters with tree-man puppets, he shared his judgment.
"There may be a possibility of restoration. However, those made into tree puppets are firmly controlled by the Undead Tree Demon, be it their physical body, Divine Soul or Nascent Soul. Only by completely annihilating the Undead Tree Demon is there a sliver of hope."
Long Chong's face brightened upon hearing this. While the notion of killing the Undead Tree Demon was nearly fantastical to him, the news that his father could be saved outweighed all worries.
"Thank you, Lord Nether Moon God, for resolving my doubts. I too am willing to enter the round moon and contribute to the slaying of the Undead Tree Demon," Long Chong bowed toward the sky.
Seeing Long Chong willing to join the final battle made Old Man Hei Zhu and his companions exchange looks before finally setting their expressions with determination.
"We are also willing to go," Old Man Hei Zhu and his two companions declared loudly.
Inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod, Yuan Ming smiled faintly and then presented the Transmission Array Plate to Hua Zhi.
"Wait here for a moment, and as soon as the Array Plate lights up, you can fully activate it, using the Transmission Formation to enter the inside of the round moon."
He also took the opportunity to hand over the Shura Blood Devouring Map to Hua Zhi and whispered a private instruction, "Keep this treasure safe and follow my commands once inside."
After seeing Hua Zhi acknowledge the command, Yuan Ming wasted no more time. He used Queen Ming Kong as an anchor and sent an Array Plate down into the underground Soluble Cave inside the white round moon.
The Tree-man Puppets near Queen Ming Kong immediately looked over, but before they could react, the Array Plate was already shining brightly.
Simultaneously, the Array Plate in Hua Zhi's hands sensed the other end activating, and a silver light instantly gleamed on it.
Seeing this, Hua Zhi immediately began casting to activate the Array Plate, and in the next instant, a silver Formation several zhang in size appeared beside her.
Everyone quickly stood on the Formation, and then they saw a flash of silver light and found themselves in the Soluble Cave.
It was pitch black all around, with no light to be seen. The group immediately cast their own light to illuminate the surroundings. Before they could get a clear view, they heard a surprised voice.
"Eh? It's you? How did you get in here?" Qi Ye shot over and hovered a few zhang away.
Hua Zhi, Yuan Wuji, the green-clothed man, and the others could now see the surroundings, especially the extremely large Human-faced Giant Tree dominating the cave, which left them in utter shock.
But the Undead Tree's eyes were tightly shut, seemingly in deep slumber.
"Is that the Undead Tree Demon?" fear flickered in Old Man Hei Zhu's eyes.
"Lord Nether Moon God has deceived us!" Yuan Wuji realized immediately.
The emergence point of the Transmission Array was so close to the Undead Tree Demon that there was no chance for any freedom of movement. Whether they liked it or not, they had to confront the Undead Demon Tree head-on.
"Don't just stand there, follow me!" Hua Zhi yelled out. Before anyone could respond, she led them away from the Undead Demon Tree.

chapters.title: Chapter 609 - 582: Chaos Battle
chapters.content:
As soon as they heard the words, Old Man Hei Zhu and the others immediately followed instinctively, distancing themselves from the main body of the Undying Tree in an instant.
"Eh! Wulu has disappeared!" Long Chong noticed something was amiss during the escape.
"Never mind him, just stick close to me and don't fall behind!" Hua Zhi called out without looking back.
At this moment, the Undying Tree Demon was trapped by the Black Magic Mirror, suppressed into slumber, but there were numerous Tree-man Puppets in the cave, many of which had their own consciousness. With the enemy pressing in, they would not sit idly by and let Hua Zhi and the others escape.
"Kill them!"
With the roaring fury of the Undying Tree Demon, most of the black cocoons hanging from the canopy began to shake, splitting open from the middle. A swarm of Tree-man Puppets emerged, rushing toward the group under Qi Ye's command.
Wan Tianren, Gu Xuanyang, Jia Sifang, Golden Transformation Master, and many other cultivators were among them, including White Scale Master, who had voluntarily been transformed.
Yuan Wuji had also come to his senses by now, turning to flee as well, but he didn't get away as easily as Hua Zhi and the others and was quickly entangled by the nearby Tree-man Puppets.
By this time, Hua Zhi had already led Old Man Hei Zhu and the others away from the Undying Tree Demon and had not been surrounded by the countless Tree-man Puppets.
However, they hadn't gone far before they quickly found a semicircular recess close to the cave's walls and stopped.
As Hua Zhi and the others flew in, a series of golden Array Flags appeared out of nowhere, landing around the recess and immediately sinking into the ground, turning the nearby area of several dozen feet into a golden expanse where the ground seemed to transform instantly into an extremely sturdy form of gold and stone.
"Pointing Ground as Steel? Could it be this Formation?" Shi Yanshi stared at the surrounding Golden Light, eyes widened, murmuring to himself.
Upon hearing him, Old Man Hei Zhu and the others all turned to look at him, and he immediately began to explain.
"This formation can temporarily turn the ground into solid golden iron, but whether it is setting up the array or the transformation, it requires time. To complete the formation in the blink of an eye, the talents in the Dao of Array Formation of the one who arranged it are extraordinary. If I could learn from him, that would be so..." Shi Yanshi exclaimed in amazement.
Seeing that he still contemplated learning about the formation amidst such a situation, both Old Man Hei Zhu and the other were speechless, but it was Hua Zhi who spoke up to interrupt him:
"We can discuss these matters later. Don't forget our current situation. This Formation can help us defend against enemies from below and behind, but for those charging from the front, we need to deal with them on our own."
Upon hearing this, Old Man Hei Zhu and the others agreed and took out their respective Magic Treasures.
Many Tree-man Puppets noticed their action and lunged over to kill them, and the group began to confront the onslaught of the massive Tree-man Puppets.
Naturally, the Pointing Ground as Steel Formation was Xi Ying's handiwork. The space within the Soluble Cave wasn't large, and had they been surrounded by the Tree-man Puppets from all sides, Hua Zhi and the others certainly couldn't have withstood the attack. Therefore, Yuan Ming had used his Divine Sense to scout ahead for this recess, and with Xi Ying's hand in setting up the Formation, they were able to temporarily alleviate the trouble of being attacked from both front and rear.
Hua Zhi and the others managed to escape in time, avoiding the danger of being attacked from both sides, but Yuan Wuji and the others, who were slightly slower, were caught up by the Tree-man Puppets.
In the air, the Green-clothed man surged ahead, his robe billowing. He didn't use his Transformation Divine Ability; instead, with a continuous motion of his hands, Green Light Hooks appeared out of nowhere, shredding all incoming Spirit Light Techniques.
Just as he was about to break through the encirclement, a snake-like black Qi twisted around the attacks from the Green Light Hooks and struck him in the back.
The Green-clothed man reached back to grab it, capturing the black Qi with a green claw shadow, preparing to crush it.
The black Qi suddenly shrank rapidly, turning into a slender black snake as thick as a finger, and with a swift motion, it shot into the center of the green claw shadow.
The Green-clothed man's expression shifted slightly, and he inwardly cursed his bad luck.
As expected, the next moment he frowned and grunted, feeling a chill and strange Qi entering his body, spreading through his limbs and body, forcing him to circulate his demonic power to forcibly suppress the spread of this peculiar Qi.
"Demonic Qi!" Hua Zhi, from a distance, turned his gaze toward the Green-clothed man, showing a look of surprise on his face.
Meanwhile, Qi Ye appeared not far from the Green-clothed man's side, his indifferent gaze landing on the man. With his right hand forming a sword finger, he pointed, and several streaks of black light coalesced into serpents, biting towards the Green-clothed man once again.
Seeing that there was a Returning to Void Stage Tree-man Puppet blocking him and with Demonic Qi churning within, the Green-clothed man knew that he couldn't escape, so he turned around and spread his arms, unleashing two green hurricanes, enveloping his body and lunging at Qi Ye.
The two tangled in battle, both beings of the Returning to Void existence, with every move they made filled with a terrifying force. The sounds of ravenous winds and bird cries reverberated through the cave, and as limitless black light spilled from the hurricanes, any Tree-man Puppet that came too close and got splattered with a thread swelled up and exploded in moments with a "bang".
Not long after, the area surrounding the clash of the two Returning to Void Stage warriors was cleared out. Whether friend or foe, no one dared to approach. Before the Undead Tree Demon made its move, although the green-clothed strong man could not break out from the encirclement, he was no longer troubled by attacks from all sides.
As for Yinkong, being a spatial demon beast, he had left the green-clothed man's side right at the beginning. He darted among the Tree-man Puppets, moving like a silver Illusion, frequently flickering in and out of sight.
This beast's Innate Divine Ability seemed to be short-distance instant teleportation. Just as a Nascent Soul Tree-man Puppet caught a glimpse of it, before it could strike, Yinkong had disappeared, only to reappear not far away, accompanied by a flash of silver light.
In contrast, the situation for the Tide-rider Alliance members was much worse.
More than a dozen Nascent Soul Tree-man Puppets blocked their path, with the leader being none other than the Fusang Island Master Wan Tianren.
Wan Tianren was seen holding a green Palm Fan. As wind patterns flowed on the fan leaves, which resembled banana leaves, he would raise his hand to wave the fan, and a terrifying gale would strike the faces of the Tide-rider Alliance members. It was so forceful that it stung their entire bodies as if someone was trying to tear their flesh apart.
At the same time, the remaining Nascent Soul Tree-man Puppets took advantage of the situation and attacked from within the fierce wind.
Jia Sifang was among them, his eyes dull.
The Tide Rising Misty Sea Ring was fitted around his arm, and his entire being turned into a semi-illusory blue shadow. With a wave of his hand, he hurled hundreds of blue water orbs, which contained blinding arcs of blue lightning, towards the four members of the Tide-rider Alliance.
"Third Brother, it's us!" Bing Li dodged the water orbs, shouting out.
"Fifth Brother, the third has been controlled by the Undead Tree Demon, you can't wake him. Strike with all your might!" Yuan Wuji roared, gripping a blood-red long blade in his hand and slicing forward. A flood of Blood Light burst forth in an instant, dispersing the fierce winds from Wan Tianren like a stubborn rock in water.
The Blood Light continued forward, cleaving the dozen Nascent Soul cultivators in two.
Seeing their opportunity, the Blood Realm Venerable and the others also swiftly employed their techniques, engaging in battle with the Nascent Soul Tree-man Puppets. Meanwhile, Yuan Wuji took large strides forward, his Blood Blade emitting dozens of blade lights, tearing through the fierce winds, trying to force Wan Tianren into a direct confrontation.Catchtheformattedversionat*.
However, Wan Tianren had no intention of engaging. He retreated while maintaining distance from Yuan Wuji, continuously waving his palm fan to send one fierce gale after another, forcing the Tide-rider Alliance members to constantly divide their attention to defend.
Besides Wan Tianren, among these dozen individuals was another Late-stage Nascent Soul Great Cultivator, bare-chested with a Thunder Dragon tattoo on his chest.
This person seemed to cultivate a Thunder and Lightning Technique, with lightning coiling around him. His speed was incredibly fast, and his attacking power was terrifyingly strong. Each strike was like thunder falling from the sky, making the void tremble incessantly, bringing the Tide-rider Alliance members great distress.
On another front, Hua Zhi and others who had escaped the encirclement earlier also encountered the chasing army of Tree-man Puppets.
But they were prepared. Despite facing an enemy force several times their size, they managed better without appearing too flustered.
Old Man Hei Zhu and his two companions, with one before and one behind, had an emerald rune suspended above their heads. The rune was interwoven with faint green spirit light, forming a large Formation that enveloped them all.
At the forefront, Old Man Hei Zhu and Shi Yanshi frequently activated their Magic Treasures, one vigorously waving a fishing rod, and the other lifting a brush swiftly scribbling. The black fishing line sliced through the Tree-man Puppets' bodies like a Spiritual Snake. Whenever it made a cut, the inky characters that Shi Yanshi wrote would fly into the wound, burrow into the Tree-man Puppets, and explode with magic.
The two coordinated silently with each other. However, the continuous use of Magic Treasures was rapidly depleting their Mana, and they likely wouldn't last long.
But whenever their Mana was half depleted, a streak of faint green spirit light would flow down from the rune above their heads, penetrating their bodies and swiftly replenishing the Mana deficit.
Behind Old Man Hei Zhu and Shi Yanshi, Aunt Wan Hua manipulated her Magic Treasure, the flower basket, with one hand, producing pollen to meet the enemy, while her other hand clutched a Spirit Stone, continuously drawing Mana from it.
A stream of faint green spirit light connected her to the overhead rune on her body as well. Unlike the others, however, this spirit light wasn't replenishing her Mana but rather extracting it.
Furthermore, any Tree-man Puppet that entered the Formation was also drained of a portion of its Mana, which was then integrated into the rune above the heads of the three, refilling their deficit.
Their Formation, known as the "Yimu Formation," could automatically absorb nearby Spiritual Energy and the Mana of those within the array, converting them into Yimu Spiritual Energy for storage. When needed, it would automatically channel into those with Mana deficiencies. In this way, not only could it replenish their consumption, but it could also accelerate healing, making the Formation virtually self-sustaining during battle, free from the troubles of Mana exhaustion.
However, since Old Man Hei Zhu and his companions were only at the Nascent Soul Early Stage, facing the Tree-man Puppet army, if all three exerted their full strength, even the Yimu Formation wouldn't be able to compensate for the depletion. Therefore, they had no choice but to have Aunt Wan Hua stay behind, drawing Mana from the Spirit Stone for them.
Yet such a reluctant move naturally left a fatal vulnerability in the Formation.
Aunt Wan Hua had just depleted a Spirit Stone and was about to retrieve the next when she suddenly felt a shock. Raising her head, she saw a cloud of white mist quickly bypassing Old Man Hei Zhu and Shi Yanshi, transforming into a blue-skinned woman wielding a long halberd, her Cultivation reaching the Late-stage Nascent Soul. With a raise of her hand, she thrust the weapon forward.

chapters.title: Chapter 610 - 583: Saving the Golden Crow
chapters.content:
Aunt Wan Hua was terrified, but the opponent appeared too suddenly, and the two were too close for her to react in time.
Just at the critical moment, however, a burst of wild laughter reached her ears.
Following that, a streak of Blood Light flew out from behind her and, with a "bang," blocked the attack of the blue-skinned woman, then countered, forcing her back.
Aunt Wan Hua turned her head in shock, only to see an old man wrapped in Blood Mist standing behind her, who had transformed into the Blood Slave form of Elder San Jue.
At this moment, Elder San Jue's gaze seemed lost, his appearance and aura had greatly changed, and the other Tree-man Puppets naturally could not distinguish him.
Beside Elder San Jue, a red-clothed woman and a Blood-colored Skull appeared. It was Hong Ling and the Blood Shadow.
"Do not panic, everyone. We are here to aid you by the command of the Divine Envoy!" said Hong Ling. As she spoke, a group of Blood Slaves emerged behind her and charged towards the Tree-man Puppets, while Elder San Jue did not move.
Yuan Ming knew that Old Man Hei Zhu and the other two were not strong enough to fight alone, so he naturally wouldn't let them struggle by themselves. However, given Lei He's sensitive identity, Yuan Ming still concealed him for safety and didn't immediately use Elder San Jue, his trump card, to prevent any unforeseen incidents.
To maintain the battlefront, it was already enough for Hong Ling and the Blood Shadow to take action.
With the assistance of the Blood Slaves, Old Man Hei Zhu and the others grew more confident. The situation which had been desperate slowly became easy to handle.
Meanwhile, Hua Zhi certainly wasn't idle, moving continuously among the Tree-man Puppets.
However, her mind wasn't entirely on the fight.
She kept an eye on the overall situation. Whenever she found a Tree-man Puppet grievously wounded by Old Man Hei Zhu and the others, she would immediately act, ensnaring the Tree-man Puppet with vines and sending it into the Shura Blood Devouring Map.
As the master of the Shura Blood Devouring Map, though having handed over the Spiritual Treasure itself to Hua Zhi, Yuan Ming was still able to control the Shura Blood Devouring Map effortlessly, taking the Tree-man Puppets that Hua Zhi sent in and feeding them to the black tree inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod, making it grow faster.
With Hua Zhi's current strength, plus the help of the Shura Blood Devouring Map, ordinary Core Formation Stage Puppets were no match for her at all. If they encountered tough Nascent Soul Stage Puppets, Yuan Ming would also lend a hand.
Working together, they acted with incredible efficiency. In just a short while, they had already fed four or five Nascent Soul Stage Puppets and more than ten Core Formation Stage Puppets to the black Undying Tree without anyone noticing.
The black Undying Tree kept growing taller, and the Ju Mang Spirit Technique was also gradually approaching the fourth level.
A smile appeared on Yuan Ming's lips. This underground cave was a dangerous place for others, but for him, it was a rare treasure trove.
He was not fully focused on collecting the Tree-man Puppets, though. His Divine Sense was watching everything within the cave.
At this moment, all the puppets of the Undead Tree Demon had left the black cocoon, but not all had joined the battle. Many Tree-man Puppets still guarded near the giant tree.
Because of the Demon Mirror's anomaly, the Undead Tree Demon was no longer focused on refining the Level 5 Golden Crow. The black cocoon wrapping the Golden Crow shook again, and the Flames that were sprouting from the gaps grew more vigorous, as if sensing the change outside and trying to take this chance to escape.
However, beside the black cocoon, a Late-stage Nascent Soul Tree-man Puppet stood guard, vigilantly scanning the area without any laxity.
Just as it was fully focused on surveilling the surroundings, the base of the cocoon suddenly split from left to right, breaking nearly in half.
This sudden development caused the Late-stage Nascent Soul Tree-man Puppet to pause in shock, but it immediately regained composure and angrily struck out, raising and clenching its right hand.
The air within a hundred meters exploded suddenly, filled with burst-air currents everywhere.
A figure became visible, and it was Wulu.
The powerful impact struck Wulu instantly, sending him flying backward, crashing into a nearby stone wall, embedding him within it.
Wulu spat out a mouthful of blood, feeling as if all his bones were shattered, but more than the pain, what surged in his heart first was frustration.
The task given to him by the Nether Moon God was to sneak in with the Heavenly Escape Stone Talisman and release the Level 5 Golden Crow, which could reverse the tide of the battle.
Wulu cursed his own weakness for, although he successfully sneaked in and made the first move, it ultimately fell short by a crucial step.
The Heavenly Escape Stone Talisman only let his form completely disappear from sight but couldn't actually make his body vanish. When attacked, he would still become visible.
The Nascent Soul Puppet, seeing that Wulu was still alive after taking its strike, flashed a hint of surprise in its eyes and immediately lunged towards Wulu, firing dozens of white qi blades at him.
Numerous other Tree-man Puppets also pounced towards him.
Seeing this, Wulu endured the pain, gritted his teeth, preparing to activate the talisman again, when suddenly he noticed that the Late-stage Nascent Soul Tree-man Puppet had become rigid, standing still, motionless, and those white qi blades also dissipated.
The other pouncing Tree-men were the same.
"Quickly rescue the Golden Crow!" The voice of the Nether Moon God resounded in Wulu's ears.
Wulu's spirits lifted. Ignoring all his injuries, he used Flying Escape to appear in front of the cocoon entrapping the Golden Crow, took out a black dagger, and slashed again at the root of the torn cocoon.
The black cocoon was finally completely cut through. An extremely indignant cry from the Golden Crow rang out, causing everyone's body to stiffen, even the Green-clothed man and Qi Ye, who were locked in a fierce fight, seemed to pause for an instant.
The blinding sunlight, accompanied by piercing, heartburning Essence Fire, engulfed the black cocoon, turning it to ashes and then spreading to every corner of the cave.
Within the raging flames, a huge Golden Crow spread its wings and flew out, appearing like the rising sun, causing everyone to involuntarily squint their eyes—it was indeed Jin Chao.
Yuan Ming was about to communicate with Jin Chao to clarify the pros and cons and draw it to his side, but Jin Chao spread its wings and shot forth, instantaneously appearing beside the Late-stage Nascent Soul Tree Puppet, its burning claws striking down.
The Late-stage Nascent Soul Tree Puppet, trapped in an illusion, had its head explode and fell on the spot.
"Was it you who saved me? I'll remember this favor," said Jin Chao to Wulu, not waiting for a response before it flapped its wings and transformed into a golden illusion, disappearing.
Wulu's complexion was pale at the moment. He didn't bother with Jin Chao's gratitude, took out two pieces of healing pills to swallow, and was about to activate the Stone Talisman for concealment again when he suddenly saw the corpse of the Late-stage Nascent Soul Tree Puppet not far away.
His eyes moved, and he immediately flew toward it, a stream of Blood Light emitting from his palm, wrapping around the corpse.
With a flash of Blood Light, the corpse vanished into thin air, and Wulu's figure also disappeared.
Jin Chao's figure flickered and landed in front of a black cocoon in the middle layer of the giant tree, and with a swipe of its claw,
The black cocoon shattered upon contact, and the person wrapped within fell out—it was Golden Cloud Fairy.
At this moment, Golden Cloud Fairy's eyes were tightly closed. Even having been saved by Jin Chao, she was still in a state of unconsciousness, and her aura fluctuated erratically, as if she was at a critical juncture.
Seeing this, Jin Chao's eyes immediately showed concern. It then spat out fierce flames, forming a ring of fire around Golden Cloud Fairy, enveloping her in a protective shield.
Meanwhile, inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod, Yuan Ming raised his eyebrows.
Seeing Jin Chao like this, well aware of the situation inside the stone cavern, there's no need to go out of my way to recruit it.
He flipped his hand and produced a golden long saber, and swung it through the void.
Not far from where Golden Cloud Fairy was located were the black cocoons where Queen Ming Kong and the Water Ape Clan's brawny man were trapped. The space near the roots of the black cocoons fluctuated, and two streaks of golden saber light appeared out of nowhere, severing the black cocoon at its base.
* (*) appreciates your readership at the source.
Queen Ming Kong and the Water Ape Clan's brawny man had been waiting for this moment and turned into two tunneling lights shooting out.
The momentum of this action was completely covered by Jin Chao's presence and was not noticed by other people in the cave, nor by the Undead Tree Puppets. To outsiders, it seemed as if Jin Chao had casually saved the two.
But Jin Chao noticed that someone had made a move in secret and was shocked.
Its Divine Sense enveloped the surroundings, yet it failed to detect where the recent golden saber light had come from. The saber light was not very powerful, but it was this untraceable method that surprised it.
However, given the current urgent situation, Jin Chao did not delve deeper into it and simply spread its two fiery wings, grabbing the protective shield outside Golden Cloud Fairy with its claws, and flew out from beside the tree, entering the battlefield where the Green-clothed man and Qi Ye were engaged in combat.
The Green-clothed man looked over, and without a word, after a brief exchange of glances, they attacked Qi Ye at the same moment in the next instant.
Jin Chao was the first to act, spewing out a magnificent and colossal column of fire. The orange-yellow flames danced like snakes and dragons, carrying an extremely terrifying force.
At the same time, the Green-clothed man clapped his hands in front of his chest, and in an instant, endless green winds appeared out of nowhere, also forming into a massive tornado, merging with the fire column.
As the wind impeded the fire, and the fire drew strength from the wind, the two continuously combined, swelling to many times their size in an instant, even engulfing some nearby Tree-man Puppets and instantly reducing them to white ash.
Bathed in the light of the fire, Qi Ye's figure seemed as small as an insect. Despite his rapid speed, he could not escape the fierce onslaught of the firestorm.
At the critical moment, Qi Ye suddenly formed a hand seal, and multitudes of black lights surged from his sleeves, enveloping him into a black sphere before the column of fire could reach him.
The next moment, as the firestorm bore down, the spherical black light rapidly dissolved away, yet even more black light surged from within, mending the sphere's surface.
This tactic, however, could not withstand the tremendous power produced by the merger of wind and fire, and the black light sphere surrounding Qi Ye was pushed backward by the fire column, ravaging and absorbing countless Tree-man Puppets along the way before it could just barely stop close to the Undead Tree Demon.
The black light dissipated, and Qi Ye reappeared in mid-air, but at this moment, his momentum had also declined, evidently due to overexertion from fending off the previous strike.
As Jin Chao and the Green-clothed man joined forces, Queen Ming Kong and the Water Ape Clan's brawny man, who had escaped their confinement, flew out and joined the battle.
After rescuing them, Yuan Ming had immediately ordered them to fight and retreat, heading towards the position where Old Man Hei Zhu and others were, while also cautioning them not to get close to Jin Chao's battlefield.
Queen Ming Kong and the brawny man took the order and acted on it, but being close to the Undead Tree Demon, the area was swarming with Tree-man Puppets, escalating the difficulty of their escape.
Whether by accident or design, the combined strike of Jin Chao and the Green-clothed man, coupled with Qi Ye's resistance, had not resulted in severe injuries on them. However, the tremendous power dissipating from their clash cleared the nearby Tree-man Puppets.
Queen Ming Kong and the Water Ape Clan's brawny man were delighted at this sight and took the opportunity to bypass Qi Ye, traveling through the cleared area towards Old Man Hei Zhu and his companions. The unaffected Tree-man Puppets attempted to stop them, but Yuan Ming interfered from the shadows, using Illusion Techniques to delay them.
Eventually, Queen Ming Kong and the brawny man managed to meet up with Old Man Hei Zhu and the others before being surrounded by other Tree-man Puppets.
Meanwhile, members of the Tide-rider Alliance attempted to seize the opportunity to flee, but Wan Tianren and others entangling them had not been affected by the battling triad's magic. Seeing the Tide-rider Alliance trying to escape, Wan Tianren waved his Palm Leaf Fan, instantly summoning a gale towards them, while another Late-stage Nascent Soul Cultivator wielded his hands, sending out hundreds of bolts of thunder, effectively halting their escape.
"Big brother, these Tree Puppets are too numerous. If we keep delaying, we might suffer severe injuries. Let's use our trump card," Lan Xiao communicated.
"Wait a bit longer," replied Yuan Wuji, exhaling a dense Blood Cloud to block the incoming thunder and shook his head.
With the addition of Jin Chao, a Returning Void entity, everyone apart from the Tide-rider Alliance felt invigorated, momentarily gaining supremacy over the Tree Puppet army and seemingly gaining the upper hand.

chapters.title: Chapter 611 - 584: The Way Out
chapters.content:
The good times didn't last long; soon, everyone discovered that even though they fought desperately and killed many Tree-man Puppets, the aftermath of the battle among the three Returning Void combatants also obliterated many. However, the remaining number of Tree-man Puppets was still enormous.
What was most critical was that if their attacks didn't manage to kill the Tree-man Puppets, the injured Puppets would retreat from the battlefield under the cover of their companions and fly back to the side of the Undead Tree Demon.
Many roots hung from the Undead Demon Tree. As soon as the injured puppets approached, these roots would pierce into the puppets' bodies, infusing them with Spiritual Power and healing their injuries.
Often, it only took a few moments for the injured Tree-man Puppets to recover to their original state. Even if they suffered severed hands or feet, these could regenerate, allowing them to rejoin the encirclement battle. Consequently, the people, who couldn't catch a breath, were quickly overwhelmed again.
Inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod, Yuan Ming also noticed this and rapidly contemplated a solution, but couldn't think of a good way to resolve the issue. He could only closely observe the Tree-man Puppets receiving healing from the Undead Tree Demon, trying to find a flaw.
Soon, he suddenly realized that, because of the mixed battle spells, the natural Spiritual Energy of the cave mingled with the Magic Spiritual Power emitted by the cultivators, scattering everywhere.
However, these seemingly disordered energies were subtly being pulled by some force towards the main body of the Undead Tree Demon, where it was completely absorbed and refined. A part of this became demonic power which enhanced its strength, and another part was used for healing the Tree-man Puppets.
This cycle was somewhat similar to the Yimu Formation that Black Bamboo Elder and the other two had established.
Yuan Ming shared his observations with Xi Ying, and after a brief moment of contemplation, Xi Ying guessed the truth.
"The Undead Tree Demon itself has a natural gift for absorbing all the Spiritual Energy from nature. Typically, the Magical Spiritual Power we deploy dissolves rapidly into the atmosphere, but now we are in Guanghan City, presumably covered by a massive Forbidden barrier creating a closed space, locking all Spiritual Energy inside, allowing entry but no exit. Consequently, the Spiritual Power we expend becomes sustenance for the Undead Tree Demon. This place is the most suitable battlefield for it. If we continue fighting, as consumption grows and it strengthens, our defeat is inevitable!" Xi Ying said, her expression grave.
"Is there really no way to solve this problem?" Yuan Ming worried.
"There is. Frankly, the current situation all relates to the white barrier enveloping Guanghan City. If we can break it, we still stand a chance to win. That's our only way out," Xi Ying immediately said.
Hearing this, Yuan Ming turned his gaze towards Guanghan City outside the cave. He had previously discovered that many great arrays were established among the cluster of buildings in the city, among them likely the source of the white barrier's restriction.
However, he didn't have an anchor point nearby, so he couldn't unleash powerful magic to break the Forbidden barrier.
As Yuan Ming pondered a solution, a new situation developed in the cave.
Near Hua Zhi and the others, a figure flickered, and Wulu appeared out of nowhere, raising a white Array Plate into the air with a wave of his hand.
As the Array Plate spun around, it burst out in a dazzling white light.
Streams of white Array Patterns flew out from it, rapidly spreading and forming a white Array, similar to the Teleportation Array Xi Ying had created.
Just then, a piercing screech rang out, as a black long spear and a blood-red curved blade flew towards them, launched by two nearby Nascent Soul Puppets wielding their Magic Treasures directly at the Array Plate.
Wulu, visibly alarmed, flicked his sleeve to block with two Flying Knife Magic Treasures. However, his Cultivation level was far different from his opponents'; the black long spear and the blood-red curved blade flashed past the Flying Knives' block and crossed towards the white Array Plate.
Inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod, although Yuan Ming didn't know what Wulu intended to do, he assumed it wouldn't harm their side.
He controlled his Soul Power and projected it over; the black long spear and the blood-red curved blade suddenly shifted direction, brushing past the white Array Plate.
The shadows within the white Array blurred, and three figures appeared: Luo Qi, a golden longbow, and a black and white chessboard.
The golden longbow was indeed Hou Yi's Sun-shooting Bow, and the chessboard, both in Spiritual Pressure and momentum, was not inferior to the Sun-shooting Bow.
"So the Sun-shooting Bow has indeed come, and that black and white chessboard seems to be a Spiritual Treasure, could it be the Lank Chessboard?" Yuan Ming thought to himself.
The mysterious shift in the direction of the black long spear and the blood-red curved blade left the nearby two Nascent Soul Cultivators baffled, as they controlled their Magic Treasures to attack once again.
The black and white chessboard shot out and expanded when met with air, instantly growing to the size of a palace, blocking in front of Luo Qi and the Divine Bow, bursting out in black and white light.
The moment the black long spear and the blood-red curved blade touched the black and white light, their originally lightning-fast speed suddenly slowed down tremendously, moving as slow as a snail's crawl.
Suddenly, after a tremor, the two weapons transformed into a black and a white chess piece, landing on the black and white chessboard.This chapter was first seen on *.
The others, witnessing this scene, were dumbstruck.
Yuan Ming was also surprised; what kind of Divine Skill was this, capable of forcibly altering an object's form?
He activated his Divine Sense to investigate further, soon discovering that the black and white chess pieces were not physical objects, but rather the result of a combination of Sealing Skill and Illusion Technique.
The black and white chessboard flew forward, moving unusually fast, and in a flash, it struck the army of Tree-man Puppets, directly crashing into them.
Contrary to expectations, no loud explosion occurred; as the chessboard contacted the Tree-man Puppets and their Magic Treasures, they all transformed into either black or white chess pieces, landing on the board and engaging in a battle of chess tactics.
One by one, the chess pieces shattered, turning into fragments of Magic Treasures or the bodies of Cultivators, utterly perishing.
"I see; this black and white chessboard first transforms the enemies into chess pieces, then utilizes the chess array to attack and kill..." Yuan Ming roughly understood the chessboard's Divine Skill.
Hou Yi's Sun-shooting Bow also radiated brilliantly, and a Golden Crow Divine Arrow appeared on the bowstring, drawn and shot.
Whoosh...
A streak of golden light burst forth, piercing through the bodies of dozens of Tree-man Puppets.
White Scale Master was there among them, his lower abdomen pierced through with a charred hole, his body nearly torn in two.
His face bore an expression of incredulity and unwillingness, his mouth opened and closed, but he uttered not a word before collapsing to the ground lifelessly.
"Good riddance!" the burly man from the Water Ape Clan scoffed coldly, but a trace of sorrow flashed through Queen Ming Kong's eyes.
The golden rainbow did not head straight for the body of the Undead Tree Demon, instead, it struck the wall near the Soluble Cave.
The rainbow ignited intense Golden Flames, melting into the wall like through decayed soil, its speed unslowed as it continued to shoot forward. In the blink of an eye, it penetrated the stone wall and reached a white barrier, hitting it hard.
A thunderous bang resounded!
The golden rainbow exploded, transforming into a sun of golden radiance. The white barrier was blasted open, creating a hole a hundred feet wide, from which dense natural spiritual energy rapidly escaped.
A smile crossed Yuan Ming's face, then his expression slightly changed.
An invisible figure flew in through the shattered hole, using the Invisibility Divine Ability—it was the very familiar Void Transformation Technique.
This person disregarded the ongoing battle inside the cave and flew straight toward the ground level of Guanghan City.
"It's him!" Yuan Ming murmured to himself.
Though the person employed the Invisibility Divine Ability, the Divine Sense augmented by the Stealing Heaven Tripod sees through everything easily, revealing his true face to be Ni Mu.
"This person is indeed still alive," Yuan Ming thought privately and tracked him with his Divine Sense.
Ni Mu was very fast and reached Guanghan City in a few breaths, flying directly to the largest palace there and soon landing in front of it.
The grand plaque above the palace read "Guanghan Palace." Guanghan Palace was a pyramid-like structure similar to the Void Temple, designed to draw in nature's spiritual energy and the power of starlight.
Brilliant spirit light flashed at the gates of Guanghan Palace, clearly guarded by formidable seals.
Ni Mu produced a white talisman and affixed it onto the gate.
The sealing spirit light at the gates of Guanghan Palace quickly dissipated, splitting apart to reveal a three-foot-wide gap.
"This is a Forbidden-breaking Talisman, a kind of talisman specifically designed to break various seals. Such talismans are almost extinct in the Cultivation World. This Forbidden-breaking Talisman easily breached the seals of Guanghan Palace, which is not simple at all," Xi Ying commented upon hearing Yuan Ming's description.
Yuan Ming nodded and continued his surveillance.
Ni Mu's body moved forward, going straight through the gap created by the Forbidden-breaking Talisman, entering Guanghan Palace where a serpentine corridor opened up before him.
He seemed extremely familiar with the interior of Guanghan Palace, ignoring the corridor and continued using the Void Transformation Technique to fly towards the top of the palace, traveling through several walls before arriving at a spacious hall at the top.
This space was quite ample, with twelve silver stone pillars erected around the room, each carved with complex array patterns.
Countless intricate array patterns were engraved on the ground between the twelve stone pillars, forming a grand Array that radiated thousands of beams of white light, appearing immensely majestic.
However, these beams of light quickly vanished into the void, leaving no trace.
Ni Mu ignored the white light from the Array, his gaze fervently fixed on the center of the Array where a silver-white orb floated, adorned with countless star patterns, slowly rotating.
When Yuan Ming had previously investigated Guanghan City, he merely glanced over it without paying special attention to the specific details inside, but seeing this grand Array and the silver-white orb, his eyes also lit up.
The might of the silver-white orb was in no way inferior to Hou Yi's Sun Shooting Bow and the Black and White Chessboard—could it be a Spiritual Treasure from Penglai Immortal Island?
Without hesitation, Ni Mu lunged at the silver-white orb, reaching out with a great grasp.
Several star patterns on the silver-white orb suddenly lit up, emitting a beam of white light that shot directly toward Ni Mu's chest.
Ni Mu lightly exclaimed, spewing a beam of red light from his mouth—it was a Red Flying Sword, blazing bright with light, and eight runes vaguely visible within.
The Red Flying Sword moved to intercept, blocking the white light.
With a "snap" sound, the Red Flying Sword was actually broken in two.
The white light did not pause at all, continuing to cut towards Ni Mu.
Ni Mu's expression shifted slightly, but he did not panic. He turned his right hand to block in front of him, his palm now wearing a golden armored glove—it was his Lifebound Puppet Tongchen.
With a loud "bang," Ni Mu was struck by the beam of white light and sent flying backward, landing outside the Array.
The golden armored glove was marked with a deep gash, but it quickly began to heal, returning to its original state within a few breaths.
"Who dares to steal my treasure!" A voice resounded from the Soluble Cave below, as a face on the black giant tree opened its eyes, looking upwards with an expression of shock and anger.

chapters.title: Chapter 612 - 585: Stalemate
chapters.content:
The enraged roar of the human face on the black giant tree echoed throughout the soluble cave, an invisible wave of sound waves rolling through, shaking the entire cavern, with countless fragments of stone falling down.
The numerous tree-man puppets seemed to have received some unified command and retreated toward the giant tree, halting their advance, and no one pursued, including the wielders of the Black and White Chessboard, Hou Yi's Sun-shooting Bow, the green-clothed man, Jin Chao, Hua Zhi, and others. They all ceased their attacks and looked up to the sky, releasing their Divine Sense to see what was happening above.
Seeing this, the black giant tree huffed coldly once more, and a layer of luminescence emerged on the stone walls of the cave in all four directions, stopping everyone's Divine Sense.
"Lank Chessboard, Hou Yi's Sun-shooting Bow! I didn't expect you would truly dare to come here. Good, it saves me the trouble of finding you!" The Undead Tree Demon's eyes turned to the opposition, its massive voice resonating in the cave.
"Undead Tree Demon, it's unexpected that over the years you have slain so many cultivators, creating so many puppets. Such annihilation of humanity will surely bring divine retribution!" A black and white figure emerged from the chessboard, it was the Black and White Artifact Spirits.
"Humph! I am a Tree Demon, not of the Human Clan. I don't need your feigned humanity, and it's not your place to judge my cultivation path right from wrong! Since you dared to come today, then all of you shall stay here!" The Undead Tree Demon sneered.
Before the echo of its words had faded, the ground near the Black and White Chessboard, Hou Yi's Sun-shooting Bow, and the green-clothed man, among others, suddenly cracked open without warning, revealing almost a hundred cracks of varying sizes.
The next moment, countless black tree roots shot out from the cracks, stretching as they met the wind, rising in unison and lashing towards everyone.
Almost simultaneously, the army of tree-man puppets, which had stopped earlier, followed the tree roots and once again charged towards everyone.
Just as the battle was about to erupt, a black shadow shot out from the top of the black giant tree at a startling speed, vanishing into the cavern's ceiling with just a flash, with everyone in the cave too preoccupied to see clearly as they prepared to face the enemy.
Inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod, Yuan Ming's gaze flickered slightly.
Despite its incredible speed, the black shadow could not escape his Divine Sense, which revealed a completely black tree-man, different in appearance from the common tree-man puppets, and possessing extraordinary strength, having reached the half-step Returning Void stage, but it had used some special technique to conceal its power.
Moreover, the aura of the black tree-man was exactly the same as the Undead Tree Demon, and based on Yuan Ming's speculation, it seemed to be some sort of clone.
At this moment, including the green-clothed man, everyone in the cave naturally had no time to worry about the black shadow, as they each employed their Divine Abilities to face the wildly dancing tree roots and the swarming army of tree-man puppets.
Hou Yi's Sun-shooting Bow, however, floated toward the direction of the black giant tree, its surface radiating golden light, with countless runes revolving and flickering around it. The Lank Chessboard flew above the Sun-shooting Bow, spinning continuously, emitting large swathes of black and white radiance.
Amidst the intertwining lights, black and white chess pieces shot out from the board, flying around above and below, faintly forming some sort of formation, repelling any tree-man puppets or tree roots that came its way.
At this moment, including Yuan Wuji, the members of the Tide-rider Alliance made a move that surprised the others.
The four of them suddenly withdrew from the battlefield and rushed towards the top of the cave.
The human face on the black giant tree's eyes darkened, the black tree roots originally targeting the crowd now split in half, enveloping Yuan Wuji and the others.
Yuan Wuji and his comrades were prepared, their bodies emanated thick Blood Light, and armor of blood appeared within it—the Blood Puppet Armor.
With the summoning of the Blood Puppet Armor, their speed increased greatly, nimbly evading the entanglement of the black tree roots and reaching the wall above them.
Their figures flickered, turning into four Blood Shadows that passed through the wall's luminescence and entered the stone wall, fleeing toward Guanghan City.
"Could it be that Yuan Wuji and the others showed up on Three Immortals Island this time with the unset goal relating to that silver-white Orb?" Yuan Ming thought silently inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
He had heard from Guoguo about the conversation between Ni Mu, Jia Sifang, and Wan Tianren within the Starry Sky Hall. Ni Mu and the Tide-rider Alliance seemed to have deep ties; could they have had a premeditated plan?
"Yuan Wuji and the others have also gone to Guanghan Palace! In that case, I should also take a look." Xi Ying suddenly spoke up.
"You're going? How can you leave the Stealing Heaven Tripod to go?" Yuan Ming was taken aback and quickly asked.
"Using Guoguo," Xi Ying replied, then beckoned Guoguo over, applied the Golden Sunflower Beast Taming Technique, with most of his mana and Divine Soul leaving his body to merge into Guoguo's.
Guoguo's demonic power surged, reaching the Level 4 Middle Stage.
"That works. Here, take the Spiritual Beast Bag of the Three-eyed Crow with you; if necessary, I can lend a hand." Yuan Ming took off the Spiritual Beast Bag from his waist and handed it over.
Without hesitation, Guoguo swallowed the Spiritual Beast Bag and then transformed into a Spiritual Body, becoming invisible.
Yuan Ming discreetly released Guoguo from the Stealing Heaven Tripod space, and Guoguo immediately sped upwards.
Although Guoguo's Invisibility Divine Ability was exquisite, it couldn't escape the Divine Sense of the green-clothed man and Jin Chao. However, they were too busy dealing with the Undead Tree Demon's fury to pay much attention to the suddenly emerging Guoguo, allowing it to leave.
Yuan Ming breathed a sigh of relief and looked at the situation in the cave, his brows tightly furrowed.
The battle in the cave was extremely unfavorable for everyone; the black tree roots of the Undead Tree Demon, although seeming soft like vines, were exceptionally tough. Except for those protected by the Lank Chessboard around Hou Yi's Sun-shooting Bow, the others were all pressed to the point of being overwhelmed.
Even the green-clothed man's green claw shadows could only sever a few roots at a time, not to mention the attacks from the others.
