It would be bad enough if they were merely tough, but these black tree roots also possessed the ability to absorb Mana, rendering attacks from everyone's Magic Treasures and Spells not only ineffective but quickly absorbed, and not even the Golden Crow True Fire unleashed by Jin Chao was an exception.
With the containment of these roots, the attacks of the tree-man Puppets became even more ferocious, and everyone's protective magic talisman were successively shattered. Had it not been for the Lank Chessboard bearing the brunt of the attacks, they would have almost been unable to hold on.
Just then, Hou Yi's Sun-shooting Bow shone brightly with golden light, and once more, a Divine Arrow with an aura far surpassing the previous ones appeared on the bowstring, drawn to the full crescent.
"Whoosh"
Visit * (*) for more.
A burning golden rainbow shot out, and everything it passed—whether it was the obstructing black roots or tree-man Puppets—was shattered in a single strike, piercing through directly.
The golden rainbow tore through the void, crossing a distance of a hundred zhang in an instant, heading straight for the Undead Tree Demon itself.
The vines hanging in front of the Undead Tree Demon rose up one by one, and dozens of roots also shot out from the ground, joining together to face the golden rainbow head-on.
Bang, bang, bang...
More than twenty roots and vines were shattered in succession, but the momentum of the golden rainbow was completely spent, reverting to the state of a Divine Arrow and getting firmly entangled by the remaining vines and roots.
"Impossible! Even if you have cultivated to the Upper Fifth Level, it's not possible for you to so easily catch my Golden Crow Divine Arrow!" Hou Yi's Sun-shooting Bow exclaimed in disbelief.
"Ignorance!"
The Undead Tree Demon laughed wildly as the black tree roots entangling the Golden Crow Divine Arrow suddenly exerted force, rapidly draining the Spiritual Power within; the once brilliantly golden color completely turned dull and grey.
The soul of the Golden Crow within the arrow's body let out a scream and fell silent as it perished.
Yuan Ming witnessed this scene and was greatly surprised. The roots of the Undead Tree Demon were so terrifying that they could devour all kinds of Spiritual Power. They were incredibly sturdy, far more formidable than any Magic Treasure he had seen before. It was simply inconceivable.
"Although the Undying Tree is very tough, and its roots are even more tenacious, it should not be possible for them to be this powerful. What's going on?" Xi Ying was also deeply puzzled.
Her Divine Soul had separated from her body, and some Divine Soul still dwelled in her Nascent Soul, so unlike Yuan Ming, who had lit the Possession Black Incense to possess another, she had not completely lost consciousness.
With Hou Yi's Sun-shooting Bow's desperate charged attack failing, the morale of the Green-clothed man, Jin Chao, and the others plummeted further. Despite the defense of the Lank Chessboard, they were pushed back step by step and soon cornered in an area of the Soluble Cave, just near where Hua Zhi and her group were.
Hua Zhi and her group had been hiding on the outskirts and hadn't faced many attacks thus far. But now, with the Lank Chessboard, Green-clothed man, and others retreating nearby, Hua Zhi and her group also got involved, facing increased pressure.
Hua Zhi had already transformed into a half-human, half-vine state, with large amounts of transparent Poison Liquid and parasitic spores spreading out, attacking the black roots and tree-man Puppets that came forth.
At this juncture, Old Man Hei Zhu and others also dared not hold back any longer and unleashed all sorts of bottom-of-the-box Divine Skills. Under Yuan Ming's order, Blood Shadow, Hong Ling, and even Elder San Jue spared no effort and went all out.
However, Elder San Jue's strength was merely comparable to that of the Green-clothed man and Jin Chao. It didn't make much difference, and the situation of Hua Zhi and the others grew increasingly perilous.
Seeing this scene, Yuan Ming could no longer stand by idly. He activated the Soul Power of the Half-step Word Witch and cast the Nightmare Technique.
The originally ferocious expression on the Undead Tree Demon's face momentarily stiffened, showing a hint of daze, and its eyes clouded over, consciousness rapidly blurring as if about to plunge into deep slumber.
But at that moment, wisps and strands of Black Mist began to appear on the many roots of the Undead Tree Demon, spreading rapidly and enveloping the Undead Tree Demon within it.
A force of attraction came from within the Black Mist, Yuan Ming's Divine Sense was swiftly absorbed, the Nightmare Divine Ability was interrupted, and the eyes of the Undead Tree Demon cleared up once again.
Yuan Ming's heart sank with a clunk, never in his dreams had he imagined the Undead Tree Demon possessed such a Divine Ability; it could directly absorb Divine Sense, rendering any illusion-based Divine Skills completely ineffective against it. How were they supposed to fight this?
"Who dares to launch a sneak attack on me!" The Undead Tree Demon instantly realized what had just happened, and its demeanor became even more ferocious as it bellowed angrily.
Yuan Ming, of course, did not reply, but quickly pondered his next move while his Divine Sense reached out to Qi Ye, who was currently entangled with the Green-clothed man.
Qi Ye had lured him here under the pretense of having a method to counteract the Black Mist.
Yuan Ming activated the Divine Sense and communicated with him through the Artifact Spirit in the Shura Blood Devouring Map.
However, Qi Ye simply kept fighting the Green-clothed man, with no indication of responding at all.
"Could this person be colluding with the Undead Tree Demon, and I was deceived?" Yuan Ming murmured in alarm.
Fortunately, he had kept a backup plan. The Transmission Array Plate that had just sent them into the White Round Moon was still on Penglai Mountain. It was not impossible to leave this place if they wanted to. If the situation became truly dire, he couldn't care less about the potential consequences.
However, Guoguo had gone to Guanghan City. It would be necessary to call her back, otherwise, with Xi Ying's soul attached to her, encountering any mishap could lead to serious trouble.

chapters.title: Chapter 613 - 586: All In
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming thought of this and activated his Divine Sense, attempting to communicate with Guoguo and Xi Ying.
However, no matter how he tried, Xi Ying did not respond at all, and even its body had its eyes tightly shut, showing no reaction, which inevitably made Yuan Ming somewhat anxious.
The Undead Tree Demon swept its gaze heavily towards the people inside the cave, but it could not find Yuan Ming hidden inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod. However, its gaze quickly fell upon Hua Zhi and the others.
"San Jue! How did you turn into this?" The voice of the Undead Tree Demon contained both surprise and anger.
The ground near Hua Zhi and the others cracked open again, and about a dozen black roots burst out, shooting straight towards Hua Zhi and the others.
"Quick, dodge!" Yuan Ming, unable to care about anything else, urgently transmitted his thoughts to Hua Zhi and the others while simultaneously grabbing the Thunder God Hammer and the God Bombarding Cone.
On hearing this, Hua Zhi, Queen Ming Kong, and the brawny man from the Water Ape Clan scattered and fled immediately.
However, the roots spread out and their speed also suddenly increased considerably.
Bang bang bang!
Tens of blinding bolts of thunder, compressed to the extreme, appeared above Hua Zhi and the others, striking the black roots. Nearly half of the black roots were blown away, but the remaining roots continued to stab downward.
Piercing screams erupted as Queen Ming Kong and the brawny man from the Water Ape Clan were impaled by several black roots.
Old Man Hei Zhu, Aunt Wan Hua, and Shi Yanshi did not flee and hid within the Yimu Formation, trying to resist with the help of the array.
However, the formation only held for a few moments before it was penetrated by the roots, and Aunt Wan Hua's abdomen was also pierced by a root.
The roots emitted strands of black light, and the bodies of Queen Ming Kong, the brawny man from the Water Ape Clan, and Aunt Wan Hua quickly shriveled up. Their Divine Soul Power was rapidly drained, their Nascent Souls began to wither, and their consciousness gradually faded.
The three were extremely terrified and desperately prayed to the Lord Nether Moon God.
Yuan Ming's expression was intensely solemn; he had previously promised to lead all believers out of the Three Immortals Island. If things continued this way, the three would perish here.
But the power of the Undead Tree Demon was too terrifying. Even if he showed himself, he was no match for it.
"There's no other way..."
Yuan Ming's expression suddenly became resolute; he waved his sleeve, and a thick white fog spread throughout the Stealing Heaven Tripod space, also obscuring his Divine Sense.
He activated the Space Array in the altar, opening a spatial passage to Queen Ming Kong and the others, employing the Six Jia Qimen.
The Nascent Souls, storage magic tools, and magic treasures within the three's Dantian vanished into thin air, and in the next moment, appeared inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
A stream of pure Spiritual Power shot forth, infusing into the three's Nascent Souls.
"Where is this?" The consciousness of Queen Ming Kong and the others cleared up, looking around in bewilderment.
"This place is my Divine Country; stay here, it is very safe," echoed Yuan Ming's grand voice around them.
On hearing this, Queen Ming Kong and the others breathed a sigh of relief and each stored their magic treasures and storage magic tools.
Since this was the Divine Country of Lord Nether Moon God, the three did not dare to roam or inspect the surroundings carelessly, just floating quietly there, each stabilizing their Nascent Souls.
Though they had lost their physical bodies, as long as the Nascent Souls survived, they could find a suitable body in the future to seize and be reborn, which was much better than perishing here or falling into the hands of the Undead Tree Demon to be refined into puppets.
The Undead Tree Demon sensed that the Nascent Souls of Queen Ming Kong and the others, as well as the storage magic tools, had suddenly disappeared, and uttered a light "eh."
Relying on the characteristics of the Undying Tree and the spatial treasures within Guanghan City, he could remotely capture the Nascent Souls of the Tree-man Puppets. Could it be that the enemy hiding in the dark could do the same?
The Undead Tree Demon's mind raced, and the majority of the black roots shot out, continuing to chase Hua Zhi and the others.
An Illusion flashed by, and the Lank Chessboard appeared behind Hua Zhi and others, the black and white chess pieces shrouded in black and white light blocking the majority of the incoming black roots.
The few roots that broke through suddenly halted when they touched the Lank Chessboard, and in a flash of black and white light, they transformed into black chess pieces.
However, the Undead Tree Demon did not care and drew nearly all the roots swarming towards the Lank Chessboard, hundreds of roots almost simultaneously surrounding it, mixed with plenty of tree trunks and vines, and dense black leaves shooting out, striking the Lank Chessboard.
The incoming attacks were too numerous. Although the Lank Chessboard struggled to resist, it could not transform all into chess pieces in time and was quickly wrapped up by black roots, like a large fish caught in a net, unable to move.
"The divine ability of the Lank Chessboard can also be broken like this!" Yuan Ming saw this scene, his eyes flashing with sudden realization.
In that moment, he raised the Thunder God Hammer and the God Bombarding Cone, unleashing massive bolts of lightning that intertwined and formed a blazing silver thunderstorm, fiercely striking the black roots.
The Green-clothed man and Jin Chao also acted swiftly, rescuing the Lank Chessboard, with several impressive green tornadoes and an extremely hot pillar of fire shooting forth simultaneously.
If the Lank Chessboard were truly broken, then under these circumstances, their defeat was not far off, and one could imagine what would happen then.
"A mere speck of light, daring to compete with the bright moon!" The Undead Tree Demon scoffed disdainfully, more black roots emerging, twining around the Lank Chessboard, with black mist once again spilling from the roots.
The silver thunderstorm, green tornadoes, and golden pillar of fire struck the black roots, instantly destroying a significant portion, but the remaining roots still tightly wrapped around the Lank Chessboard.
Not only that, the black mist penetrated the Lank Chessboard, which quickly shrank from the size of a palace back to its original size.
The chessboard turned black at a visible rate, the bright black and white spirit light dissipated completely.
"Not good, it's tainted!" Yuan Ming's brows furrowed deeply, he reopened the spatial channel, attempting to summon the Lank Chessboard into the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
However, the black roots contracted fiercely, taking the Lank Chessboard towards a huge black tree.
A tremendously powerful demonic force sealed off the area, the void too was confined, Six Jia Qimen couldn't invade it either.
"Lank, I will soon break the Three Immortals Restriction and leave this damned place. I am in dire need of a powerful spiritual treasure, and since you've come to me, I'll gladly accept it first! Don't worry, Hou Yi's Sun Shooting Bow will join you soon!" The Undying Tree Demon laughed heartily, utterly pleased with itself.
Yuan Ming's expression turned ugly, and he seriously began to consider retreating.
While continuing to attempt communication with Xi Ying, he scanned the Hou Yi's Sun Shooting Bow inside the soluble cave with his divine sense. The bow seemed unusually calm, as if it didn't care that the Lank Chessboard was seized.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming was taken aback.
Just then, the previously still Lank Chessboard suddenly trembled, emitting dazzling black and white light, enveloping the roots of the Undying Tree Demon in a two-toned light.
"Thinking of self-destructing? Think again!" The Undying Tree Demon's smile ceased abruptly, and it shouted gravely.Content sourced from * – *.
More black mist crazily surged from the roots, invading the inside of the Lank Chessboard, but the black and white light from the Lank Chessboard grew brighter, as if it was burning.
An earth-shattering wave of spiritual power erupted from inside the Lank Chessboard, the black mist could no longer stop it.
Green-clothed men, who were engaging the tree-man puppets, also changed their expressions dramatically and hurriedly withdrew.
"Do you really want to self-destruct? Have you lost your mind?" The tone of the Undying Tree Demon carried a hint of panic, and it dragged the Lank Chessboard, throwing it outside.
Yuan Ming narrowed his eyes and employed the Nightmare Divine Ability once more, enveloping the Undying Tree Demon with a wave of Divine Soul Power.
The black mist quickly absorbed his Divine Soul Power again, yet the Nightmare Technique still took effect, causing a momentary daze in the eyes of the Undying Tree Demon, and its actions paused briefly.
Bang!
The Lank Chessboard exploded, turning into a mass of black and white radiance, engulfing most of the Undying Tree Demon, with the whole underground cavern shaking violently, cracks appearing on the rock walls and debris falling in various sizes.
...
Meanwhile, within a clearing in Guanghan Palace, a humanoid shadow suddenly drilled out, revealing its true body.
It appeared as an elderly man in a black robe, with vine-like long beards hanging over his chest, eyes as deep as ancient wells yet carrying a cruel and cold light, it was a clone created by the Undying Tree.
No sooner had this Undying Tree Avatar appeared did it sweep its gaze around.
Ni Mu, who had been attacking the Great Array just moments ago, had now disappeared, nowhere to be found.
The Undying Tree Avatar was surrounded by black mist, its eyes gleaming with a bizarre light within the mist, seemingly casting a spell to probe something.
Suddenly, it raised its hand and slapped toward a nearby void.
In the void, the black mist condensed, suddenly forming a huge black palm imprint, striking down.
With a muffled 'bang', a sound suddenly came from the void.
Following that, a figure fell out of the void, it was Ni Mu.
His arms crossed in front of his chest, each wearing a golden arm protector shining with flickering light, after landing, he forcefully slid back several feet before stabilizing himself.
Ni Mu, seeing the black-robed elder could see through his Void Transformation Technique, felt the pain transmitting from his arms and noticed the cracks in the golden arm protectors, his eyebrows raised slightly.
"Who are you to dare sneak in here to steal treasures?" The black-robed elder sized Ni Mu up and down.
The Undying Tree Demon had placed surveillance measures all around Three Immortals Island, watching every person who landed on the island. However, he had never seen this person before.
At that moment, several streaks of blood light flew in from outside; it was Yuan Wuji leading the Tide-rider Alliance.
The black-robed elder frowned and retreated next to the white array inside the hall.
"Ni Mu, they say a day apart in the army changes a man. It's only been a few years, yet you not only became a Venerable of the Wuyue Sect but also advanced beyond the Late-stage Nascent Soul. Truly impressive," Yuan Wuji laughed heartily.
"You flatter me, Alliance Leader Yuan," Ni Mu replied with a bow.
"Ni Mu, what's going on? We have already restrained the Undying Tree Demon below, why haven't you succeeded yet?" The Blood Realm Venerable looked at Ni Mu, a hint of jealousy flashing in his eyes, and coldly said.
"This place is the treasure stash of the Undying Tree Demon, heavily guarded. How could it be easy? Be careful yourselves, this old thing is not simple," Ni Mu didn't get angry but merely smiled, looking towards the black-robed elder.
Everyone's gaze fell on the black-robed elder, sensing the aura of the Undying Tree, and their brows involuntarily knitted together.
"Let's go together, quick battle to a quick decision!" Yuan Wuji ordered with a shout.
As the words dropped, the armor on his chest lit up with dazzling blood light, turning into a streak of blood shadow that darted at high speed towards the avatar of the Undying Tree.

chapters.title: Chapter 614 - 587 Undying Tree Avatar
chapters.content:
The Blood Realm Venerable, Lan Xiao, and Bing Li also burst into a dazzling blood light. The Blood Realm Venerable slammed his cane on the ground, and instantly a blood pond appeared on the earth in front of him. A ferocious Blood Dragon emerged and pounced towards the Undying Tree Avatar with its fangs and claws bared.
Bing Li raised her Wind Snow Sword, slashing out a massive Sword Qi enveloped in harsh winds and snow, causing white icicles to form throughout the hall.
Lan Xiao's fingers writhed, and she shot out five purple rays. Midway, the rays suddenly dispersed, transforming into countless tiny purple spots that turned out to be numerous purple poison bees, darting towards the Black Robed Elder.
"Delusions of grandeur!" the Black Robed Elder sneered coldly, his hands striking out.
Two enormous black palm prints appeared out of thin air, colliding with the Blood Dragon and the massive Sword Qi.
Two massive booms echoed!
The Blood Dragon and the Sword Qi shattered and exploded. The Blood Realm Venerable and Bing Li were blasted away, crashing heavily against the hall's walls.
The wild wind raised by the collision easily blew away Lan Xiao's purple poison bees, preventing them from getting anywhere close to the Black Robed Elder.
At that moment, behind him in the void, a flash of blood light appeared, and two gigantic, blood-colored palms emerged from nowhere, pressing down.
The Black Robed Elder, unflinching, endured the blow of the blood palms. His body merely swayed before he seemed unfazed, spewing out a black, thunder-like beam of light that disappeared into the nearby void.
A tremendous explosion sounded from the void, and a figure was forced out — it was Yuan Wuji, looking somewhat disheveled.
"With just a few pitiful clowns like you coveting my Treasure, you really overestimate yourselves!" the Black Robed Elder scoffed derisively.
However, just then, a gold metallic arm abruptly stretched out from the void behind the Black Robed Elder, piercing through his chest like a giant spear.
Threads of golden light emerged from the golden arm, and the flesh near the Black Robed Elder's chest rapidly turned to gold, transforming into metal.
The Black Robed Elder's expression darkened, and he spat out another black thunderbolt towards the golden arm.
The golden arm quickly retracted, seemingly wary of the black thunder.
The Black Robed Elder grabbed at his chest, tearing off the metallic part. The wound then rapidly healed, significantly reducing his breath.
Behind Ni Mu, a flash of golden light appeared, and a towering golden Puppet emerged.
"It seems you've successfully refined Tongchen into your Lifebound Puppet. Not bad, Tongchen is quite apt for dealing with this Undying Tree Avatar," Yuan Wuji laughed heartily, darting out again as a Blood Shadow.
The Blood Realm Venerable, Lan Xiao, and Bing Li continued their attacks.
The Black Robed Elder's expression grew serious, his long beard stirring and quickly growing longer, transforming into black branches that formed a cage around him, shielding himself within.
This wooden cage was extremely tough. Although it deformed and dented under the fierce attacks from Yuan Wuji and the others, the Elder inside remained unharmed.
Although Tongchen could turn the wooden cage into gold and iron, it hardly affected the Black Robed Elder.
The Black Robed Elder recited incantations, seemingly casting some secret technique.
Seeing this, Ni Mu grew inwardly anxious. He twisted his wrist, revealing a small azure mirror in his palm — the Thousand Illusion Treasure Mirror.
"Go." Ni Mu uttered a light command.
Instantly, spirit light shone from the center of the Thousand Illusion Treasure Mirror, which then suddenly cracked and disintegrated, transforming into a blue mist. It moved with the speed akin to instantaneous movement, shooting towards the Black Robed Elder, penetrating the vine cage, and disappearing into his forehead in a flash.
The Black Robed Elder's face showed a look of horror. His casting was interrupted, his hands flailing as he fell into an illusion.This& ch#a^p&t&e*r's^ tr&u$e& s@our&c*e@ is My V-irt-u&a+l L#i$b&rar*y Emp%i+re@ (%*).%
Ni Mu flipped his hand and raised the Bronze Treasure Mirror, a beam of crystal light enveloping the Black Robed Elder. He uttered a low shout with a trace of force.
The body of the Black Robed Elder rapidly shrank and was pulled by the crystal light, flying towards the outside.
Seeing this, Yuan Wuji and the others were overjoyed. Clenching their Magic Treasures, they readied themselves to unleash a flurry of attacks as soon as the Black Robed Elder's body left the wooden cage.
At that moment, a layer of Black Mist surged around the Black Robed Elder, and his expression quickly cleared.
He let out a roar, and a thick black energy burst out from his orifices.
A blue mist was forced out, reforming into the Thousand Illusion Treasure Mirror.
The Black Robed Elder glanced at Ni Mu, but suddenly virtualized, transforming into a shadow that slipped into the white Array within the hall, appearing beside the silver-white Orb in a flash.
Seeing this, Ni Mu felt a sense of foreboding.
Sure enough, once the Black Robed Elder returned to the Array, he immediately rooted himself to the ground, black roots growing from his feet and connecting with the entire Great Array.
Following that, the twelve giant pillars in the hall lit up with runes, shooting out beams of white Sword Qi-like radiance, which were the same beams that had repelled Ni Mu earlier, striking at the group.
The white radiance was astonishingly powerful and numerous. In the blink of an eye, Ni Mu and the others were injured and had to retreat a great distance to ensure safety.
Yuan Wuji felt aggrieved and led the group to launch several attacks, but not only did they fail to break the Great Array, the increasingly powerful attacks from the Array nearly forced them out of the hall.
"If we delay further, those folks below might also catch up," Yuan Wuji said, looking worried.
"The Undead Demon Tree's Avatar shows no anomalies, which means its main body isn't dead yet. Those people won't be able to reach here anytime soon," Ni Mu remarked.
"What does it matter if those people come or not? Our current trouble is that we can't break this Great Array, and we can't get to the Spiritual Treasure. Ni Mu, you had assured there would be no failings, yet now we face such a significant oversight," the Blood Realm Venerable said somewhat angrily, his words clearly targeting Ni Mu.
"The agreement I awaited was to jointly seize the treasure, not to bear the burden alone. Instead of blaming me, Blood Realm Daoist, you might consider how we should now break the Array!" Ni Mu said, sparing no courtesy as he glanced at the Blood Realm Venerable.
He knew the Blood Realm Venerable well; the latter had once been a member of the Wu Yue Sect, aspiring to ascend to the rank of one of the Six Great Venerables. Unfortunately, the Blood Realm Venerable lacked the strength, and his Cultivation Technique even affected his sanity, leading to a direct rejection from the upper echelons of the sect and a loss of face.
Seeing himself as superior, the Blood Realm Venerable, in a fit of rage, defected from the sect and joined the Tide-rider Scattered Alliance.
Incidentally, Ni Mu had managed to join the Wu Yue Sect by leveraging the Blood Realm Venerable's past connections, hence he had shown much forbearance towards him, but he was not about to let himself be pushed around either.
Blood Realm Venerable burst into fury, his eyes flashing fiercely, about to explode.
"Who is hiding over there!" Yuan Wuji suddenly shouted coldly, his finger like a knife, as a slash of blood-colored Sword Qi cut towards a certain area outside the hall.
A white figure popped out of nowhere, shifting several meters to dodge the slash of the blood-colored Sword Qi. It turned out to be a silver cat, its fur pure white without any trace of other colors.
"Is that the Bai Ze?" Lan Xiao recognized Guoguo at a glance.
The others also looked over, their expressions varying.
However, Guoguo entirely ignored their scrutiny, her gaze fixed on the Array inside the hall.
Ni Mu's gaze fell on the silver cat. After briefly scanning it with his Divine Sense, his expression suddenly changed.
"This aura... you are Xi Ying," he said, his eyes filled with a mix of surprise and confusion.
Xi Ying had used the Golden Sunflower Beast Taming Technique, lodging most of her Divine Soul and Mana into Guoguo. Being identified by Ni Mu didn't surprise her in the slightest.
"Are you that young woman accompanying Yuan Ming? Have you also come here to seize the treasures within Guanghan Palace?" Yuan Wuji asked, his face calm but his eyes flashing with a hint of killing intent.
"Alliance Leader Yuan, do not act rashly; her appearance might not be bad news for us," Ni Mu communicated through a whisper.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Wuji's expression shifted.
"Ni Mu, it seems you've been stopped by this Great Array." Controlled by Xi Ying, Guoguo spoke in a human voice.
"The Undead Tree Demon, being a creature of the Returning Void Stage, set up a very powerful Array. We are not well-versed in formations; naturally, it's difficult to break through. Why are you here, Fellow Daoist Xi? What's the situation below?" Ni Mu asked.
Around the Soluble Cave, the Undead Tree Demon had erected forbidden barriers, preventing people inside from extending their Divine Sense outward and those outside from probing the situation inside.
"Rest assured, those below are entangled by the Undead Tree Demon and won't be able to come up anytime soon," Xi Ying said.
"I see, since Fellow Daoist Xi has come, how about we join forces?" Ni Mu asked, visibly relieved, as he tentatively spoke.
"Oh, what sort of joining forces?" Xi Ying asked in response.
"You help us break this Great Array and kill that avatar. Afterward, that silver Treasure Orb will belong to Alliance Leader Yuan and the others, while you and I divide the Undead Demon Tree and jointly refine the Immortal Elixir. How about that?" Seeing her not refuse, Ni Mu quickly proposed with a hopeful look in his eyes.
Yuan Ming had been using his Divine Sense to monitor the situation here, and upon hearing this, his eyebrows raised.
Xi Ying wanted to use the Undead Tree to refine the Immortal Elixir—could this be her purpose in coming to the Three Immortals Island?
"Joining forces is not out of the question, but as for breaking the Array, you must follow my command; otherwise, all deals are off," Xi Ying said after a moment of thought.
No matter what, if she wanted to break this Great Array of Guanghan Palace right now, relying solely on her power was difficult. Regardless of whether these people would keep their promises later, she needed their help.
"Since Fellow Daoist Xi has a way to break the Array, we will naturally follow your lead," Ni Mu said, joyously, seeing that she hadn't refused.
Yuan Wuji and the others frowned, somewhat dissatisfied with Ni Mu's presumption.
They were unclear about the sudden appearance of Xi Ying, let alone her mastery in Formation techniques, and naturally took her words with a grain of doubt.
However, given the circumstances, breaking the Array and retrieving the treasure was paramount, so Yuan Wuji simply stayed silent, deciding to observe the situation and plan accordingly.
Seeing Yuan Wuji's reaction, the others naturally didn't say more.
"This Array shares about seventy to eighty percent similarity with the Moon Killing Twelve Formation; it isn't easy to break. Therefore, listen carefully to what I'm going to say next," Xi Ying glanced at Yuan Wuji and the others, finally fixing her gaze on Ni Mu as she spoke.
"Good," Ni Mu replied.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Wuji and the others, who had originally shown disdain, now couldn't help but look doubtful.
Xi Ying, indifferent to what they were thinking, immediately recounted the process of breaking the Array.
After listening, the initial doubts of the others had already diminished by half.
"If we do it this way, it just might work," Bing Li said, rubbing her chin thoughtfully.
"There's no time to delay, let's start right away," the Blood Realm Venerable urged impatiently.
"Begin."
At Xi Ying's command, she charged forward first.
Ni Mu and Yuan Wuji quickly followed suit, heading towards different directions in the palace, while the remaining few also set off towards their respective positions immediately.
The Undying Tree Avatar within the Array had already heard their conversation and controlled a white rainbow light, striking at each person individually.

chapters.title: Chapter 615 - 588: Deep Integration
chapters.content:
In the Soluble Cave.
The aftermath of the Lank Chessboard's self-destruction had not yet dissipated, and the entire cavern was still racked with rampant shockwaves surging back and forth, mixed with thunderous echoes that caused everyone's eardrums to ache and heads to throb.
After a long while, the terrifying aftermath gradually subsided.
The Undying Tree's hanging branches were now motionless, not a trace of life emanating from it, seemingly heavily damaged and having perished along with the Lank Chessboard.
Nearby, the many Tree-man Puppets that were too close and got caught in the blast were also shattered by the terrifying force, some injured, some dead, with corpses strewn all about in a moment of devastation.
Such a ghastly scene left the many cultivators in astonishment, and for a while, no one dared to approach and investigate.
Yuan Ming, however, did not let slip this prime opportunity. He sent Hua Zhi rushing over to swiftly collect the dead bodies of the Tree Puppets from the ground, pulling them into the Shura Blood Devouring Map, even acquiring seven or eight Nascent Soul level puppets.
He then transferred these bodies into the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space where the Black Tree immediately extended its roots into their bodies, frantically absorbing the remaining Undying Tree Power.
The crowd that had fled far earlier were now poking their heads out one by one, looking towards the Undead Demon Tree.
Seeing the hellish sight here, everyone's expressions were filled with lingering fear.
Even the Green-clothed man and Jin Chao, Level 5 Demon Beasts like them, were startled by the Lank Chessboard's act of self-destruction, escaping in a panic and looking somewhat disheveled.
"This is too reckless!" Jin Chao couldn't help but sigh.
"We also owe it to that Artifact Spirit's fearlessness. Otherwise, we would have had no chance to turn the tables! Unfortunately, the Lank Chessboard is now lost to the world," the Green-clothed man sighed and a look of regret appeared on his face.
He too had been very interested in the magical abilities displayed by the Lank Chessboard.
Old Man Hei Zhu, Shi Yanshi, and others did not share the Green-clothed man's sentimentality, their faces beamed with ecstasy.
They had almost despaired, but the valiant Lank Chessboard took the Undead Tree Demon down with it.
At that moment, Luo Qi, from within the crowd, turned his wrist, and with a flash in his palm, the Daluo Chessboard — forged in imitation of the Lank Chessboard — flew out of his hand, spinning endlessly.
To the surprise of everyone present, black and white lights shone on the Daluo Chessboard, and the silhouettes of the Black and White Artifact Spirits took shape.
"The Artifact Spirit actually survived?" In an instant, the same question climbed into everyone's minds.
"It seems that the Black and White Artifact Spirits have been plotting for a long time, preparing to self-destruct to deal with the Undead Tree Demon, thus enabling the creation of the Daluo Chessboard on the outside," Yuan Ming mused inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod, admiring the Black and White Artifact Spirits' machinations.
"Do not let your guard down. The Undead Demon Tree has only been severely injured by me and has not truly fallen. Take advantage of its weakness now, continue your attacks, and do not give it a chance to recover," the Black and White Artifact Spirits said urgently as soon as they took form.
Upon hearing this, everyone was shocked; even Yuan Ming was taken aback.
They had all probed the Undead Demon Tree and found no signs of life, assuming it to be dead, but how could they not believe the words of the Black and White Artifact Spirits?
Immediately revitalized, the crowd launched their most powerful attacks without holding back, all striking towards the Undead Demon Tree.
The once silent Hou Yi's Sun Shooting Bow now glowed brightly once more, and three Divine Arrows, slightly smaller than before, emerged on the bowstring, poised to launch, heading straight for the Undead Demon Tree.
A "whoosh" of a Wind-breaking sound!
Three streaks of light shot out, each hitting the top, middle, and bottom of the Undead Demon Tree, penetrating its core.
"Boom, boom, boom"
Three earth-shattering blasts rang out, the gloomy depths of the underground cave momentarily eclipsed by dazzling Golden Light, blinding nearly everyone's sight temporarily.
Then, the explosive gale, with its immense force, spread out in all directions, stirring up the scattered corpses and loose stones everywhere, throwing the entire cave into chaos.
People quickly put up their Magic Treasures for defense, while Jin Chao, bathed in the Power of the Sun, widened his eyes to look toward the blast.
He saw the body of the Undead Demon Tree being torn into four pieces in the fierce explosion, scattering apart.
Inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod, Yuan Ming activated his Divine Sense to carefully probe the interior of the Undead Tree Demon, quickly making a discovery.
The aura of the Undead Tree Demon had already dissipated completely, its remaining Divine Soul Power also rapidly crumbling, while the actions of the Tree-man Puppets in the cave slowed down, falling one by one.
He secretly breathed a sigh of relief; having sustained consecutive fatal injuries, even the Undying Tree with its astonishing Life Force would find it difficult to survive.
Yuan Ming collected his thoughts and continued to have Hua Zhi transport the Tree-man Puppets; he focused on controlling the Black Undying Tree, drawing upon the Primordial Qi of these puppets, and the immense tree grew even taller once more.
A rich Life Force emanated from around Yuan Ming, surging intensely.
His Ju Mang Spirit Technique progressed further, finally reaching the Fourth Realm and beginning to break through.
Yuan Ming was overjoyed and fully activated the Ju Mang Spirit Technique.
His connection to the Black Undying Tree grew even stronger, his Mana and the vigorous Life Force of the Undying Tree completely merged as one, indistinguishable from each other.
Ju Mang Spirit Technique Fourth Realm, breakthrough success!
In the instant that the Ju Mang Spirit Technique broke through to the fourth level, a violent fluctuation suddenly erupted from the black Undying Tree. In the span of a single breath, it drained all the Primordial Qi from the Tree Puppets in the space.
At the same time, a spiritual energy vortex suddenly emerged within the trunk of the black Undying Tree, beginning to incessantly absorb nature's spiritual energy and converging toward it.
The majestic Life Force on the Undying Tree also converged towards it, and even Yuan Ming's own Blood Qi was drawn in by the vortex, continuously gathering toward it.
Yuan Ming was initially startled but soon turned from shock to joy and couldn't help laughing out loud.
After absorbing these three types of power, the spiritual vortex gradually shifted from intangible to tangible, and a Undying Tree Heart condensed out of it, a speed far beyond Yuan Ming's expectations.
"Quick, while you can, split a portion of your Divine Soul and merge it with the Tree Heart. In doing so, you can completely control the Undead Demon Tree," Xi Ying, who had been silent up until now, suddenly opened her eyes and urgently reminded him.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming's gaze shifted, as Xi Ying had not mentioned this before.
However, out of trust for Xi Ying, he immediately activated the Soul Splitting and Soul Merging Technique. Fi&n%d& the t%ran&sl^a$ti&o*n on M%V&&+LE!MP&YR.$
Yuan Ming's Divine Soul had grown increasingly powerful, with the aid of Desire Power supplementing it, and his understanding and utilization of the Soul Splitting and Soul Merging Technique had become more refined, shortening the time required to execute the technique.
In just a few breaths, a soul splitting separated from his Divine Soul, was drawn out by Yuan Ming from the Sea of Consciousness and flew towards the Undying Tree Heart, vanishing into it.
The instant the soul splitting entered the Tree Heart, Yuan Ming's split soul immediately felt as if it had entered another Sea of Consciousness, which was vastly different from his own.
This Sea of Consciousness was quite vast yet cold and deathly still, like a barren wilderness that had not been cultivated.
As his split soul entered, the uncultivated wilderness seemed to receive a gentle spring rain. Wisps of Soul Power began to converge, like nourishing moisture silently invigorating life, and gradually life began to burgeon.
Yuan Ming swiftly controlled the split soul to fuse with the Undying Tree Heart, and the black Undying Tree grew rapidly.
It was like a ravenous beast, greedily absorbing the spiritual energy within the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space. Its body began to ripple with demonic power fluctuations, emitting a pure demon energy, full of vibrant life.
Perhaps since the split soul residing within the Undying Tree Heart was his, this Undying Tree's demonic power was somewhat different from the Undying Tree Demons in the Soluble Cave, less wild and more spirited.
Upon sensing it, Yuan Ming quickly realized that the strength of the Undying Tree's demon energy had reached the Third Level Realm.
With the transformation of the Undying Tree into a Tree Demon, Yuan Ming immediately controlled it with a thought, trying to direct its actions.
But since the soul splitting had just merged and was in the form of a Tree Demon, Yuan Ming was initially unskilled, still subconsciously trying to control it as though it were human.
At the thought of stretching an arm, the vines and branches on the Undying Tree began to move, but the movements were so extensive that many branches collided and entwined, causing numerous knots to form.
And when Yuan Ming wanted to move the legs, the roots buried underground trembled and soon pulled out of the soil, supporting the massive body as it began to shift bit by bit.
However, before it had moved a zhang, the roots beneath became tangled, nearly tripping him over.
Although Yuan Ming was greatly pleased in his heart, he immediately suppressed the feeling.
He quickly retracted his Divine Sense and stopped controlling the tree's movement. Instead, he carefully sensed every inch, every millimeter of the Undying Tree body, attempting to disperse his Divine Thought and explore every part of this body.
This feeling was very special, like piecing together a shattered porcelain vase through continuous exploration, only by passing Divine Thought through each part could he clearly and completely perceive this body.
Fortunately, the fusion of the split soul and the Tree Heart made this process incredibly smooth. In just a short while, Yuan Ming had completely grasped every vine and root of this body.
When he once again controlled this body to move, the action had become extremely smooth, without the earlier issues of entangled vines or tripping roots.
Yuan Ming continued to test other capabilities of the Undying Tree, especially the roots.
The roots of the Tree Demon were exceptionally sturdy and had a terrifying absorbing effect. Although his own tree was still young, its essence was not much different, so it should not be significantly lacking.
Feeling the Undying Tree roots, his face soon showed a smile.
After becoming a Tree Demon, the power of the black Undying Tree's roots to devour had significantly improved. Although it could not dispose of a Nascent Soul Being in just a few breaths like the Undying Tree Demon in the Soluble Cave, dealing with Core Formation Stage cultivators was not difficult.
However, the root system of his own Undying Tree was not as resilient, which was a significant difference from the roots of the Tree Demon in the Soluble Cave.
"It seems that the Tree Demon must have used a special method to strengthen its roots," Yuan Ming thought to himself.
He shook his head, controlling a black root to extend towards the front, trying to see its limit of extension.
However, the root extended only about ten zhang before it stopped growing further.
"Only a mere ten zhang..." Yuan Ming sighed, feeling somewhat disappointed.
But at the same time, he felt something strange. Although the root had stopped growing, he still had the illusion of a limb extending.
"Could this sensation be a phantom limb?" Yuan Ming couldn't help frowning as he spoke.
Was it a phantom limb sensation because the fusion with the Undying Tree Heart had just been completed?

chapters.title: Chapter 616 - 589: Revival
chapters.content:
While thinking this, Yuan Ming suddenly felt something poking his back and instinctively thought it was Xi Ying.
"What's..." Yuan Ming turned around to ask, but his words suddenly halted.
He stared blankly behind him, where there was neither Xi Ying nor anyone else, but a segment of black root suspended in mid-air, its tip pointing directly at his chest.
The black root dangled in the air with no base, as if it had sprouted from thin air.
Yuan Ming, showing a look of curiosity, raised his finger and poked the root, feeling a clear sensation as if he were poking himself.
After a brief moment of being dazed, a look of excitement appeared on his face.
This suddenly emerging black root was part of the Undying Tree Roots, and the Undying Tree Roots could actually pierce the void!
"The Undying Tree is the closest to the Ancestor of Ten Thousand Trees, the World Tree, in terms of its spirit kind. Its greatest Divine Skill is absorbing and refining various kinds of nature's spiritual energy, which, for the most part, is transferred through the Void Turbulence, thus the Undying Tree Roots can pierce the void," Xi Ying explained.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming nodded and controlled more roots, probing into the void.
After some experimentation, he quickly grasped the full picture of how the roots pierced the void.
Just as Xi Ying had said, the Undying Tree Roots could root deeply in the void, drawing various types of nature's spiritual energy from the Void Turbulence.
However, the spiritual energy in the Void Turbulence was too violent, and the black Undying Tree was still very weak, making the absorption inefficient. A better method would be to use the ability of the Undying Tree Roots to pierce the void to draw spiritual energy from elsewhere.
Unfortunately, the black Undying Tree Roots were weak and could only spread out about ten feet. Even with the Divine Skill to pierce the void, they could only extend the range of the roots to about a hundred feet or so, which was still insufficient.
Fortunately, this range would extend as the strength of the black Undying Tree increased.
With the strength of the Undying Tree Demon in the soluble cave, the range of the roots should have encompassed the entire Three Immortals Island.
"No wonder the Undying Tree Demon stays within the Round Moon in mid-air, yet can send Tree-man Puppets all over the Three Immortals Island," Yuan Ming thought to himself.
Controlling the Undying Tree Roots to pierce the void was very draining on Yuan Ming's Divine Sense, and after some experiments, he was already exhausted.
Yuan Ming immediately absorbed a considerable amount of Desire Power to replenish himself, and quickly recovered.
"Since it can pierce the void, why not try to see if it can pierce through the spatial barriers?" he thought, taking a short rest while suddenly coming up with an idea.
The black Undying Tree was now growing inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space and couldn't leave. If he could extend its roots outside, many things would become much more convenient.
With this thought, he immediately concentrated his Divine Power and fully controlled a strand of the Undying Tree Roots, continuously stabbing toward the space outside the Stealing Heaven Tripod, trying to extend it to the outside world.
However, as the root thread entered the void, the Divine Thought Yuan Ming attached to it was as if entering a chaotic region, where he could perceive nothing at all.
The root thread also continuously explored in the chaotic void, but never made it to the outside world.
After what seemed like forever, and just as Yuan Ming's Divine Power was about to run out, that root thread still couldn't pierce through the barrier to reach the outside world.
It was as if the space between the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space and the outside world was blocked by insurmountable distances, something a mere root could not break through.
Seeing that it was infeasible, Yuan Ming decisively gave up continuing the attempt. However, his mind did not stop, but instead worked even more actively.
"Since direct piercing through the space won't work, I wonder if doing it indirectly might?" Yuan Ming pondered.
With this thought in mind, Yuan Ming immediately started controlling the Array on the altar, to try it out.
Outside the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space, Old Man Hei Zhu, having just slain a Tree-man Puppet and about to pursue another, suddenly felt a sensation and looked aside.
He saw gold and silver lights shining out of nowhere beside him, and a Light Gate emerged into existence.
Old Man Hei Zhu, seeing the Light Gate that would only open when Lord Nether Moon God's Treasure was activated, instinctively went to bow, but instead he saw a black root thread slowly emerging from the open Light Gate.
"Undying Tree!" Old Man Hei Zhu was instantly shocked.
Just as he was about to shout out, Lord Nether Moon God's voice echoed in his Sea of Consciousness, "Do not make a big fuss, the control over this Undying Tree Root is now mine. Keep quiet about it."
"Lord Nether Moon God, you have control over the Undying Tree Root? You truly possess vast Divine Skills." Old Man Hei Zhu immediately suppressed the thought to shout, genuinely admiring in his heart.
"Just do what you need to do, don't worry about it," came Lord Nether Moon God's command once again.
Old Man Hei Zhu immediately complied, continuing to pursue those Tree-man Puppets.
Yuan Ming just needed Old Man Hei Zhu as an anchor point to open the spatial channel; seeing him leave, he then controlled three black roots to extend outward, searching for targets.
Seeing a Nascent Soul stage Undead Tree Puppet lying on the ground, its head half-severed by someone, Yuan Ming immediately controlled the Undying Tree Root to extend towards it and pierced into its body.
The moment the roots pierced in, the corpse of the puppet quickly shrunk, soon turning into a withered, emaciated husk.
With the Undying Tree Heart, the absorption speed had clearly accelerated considerably.
In the space of the Stealing Heaven Tripod, the black Undying Tree continued to grow taller under the supply of this power.
Seeing this scene, Yuan Ming nodded in satisfaction and immediately controlled the three roots of the Undying Tree, extending them toward more Tree-man Puppets.
The next instant, Yuan Ming raised his eyebrows, revealing a hint of surprise.Thе оriginаl sоurсе is М|V|L5ЕМРYR.
When he connected the roots to the external Tree-man Puppets, he unexpectedly sensed that inside these puppets, there lingered shreds of dissipating Undying Tree Souls.
It was not unusual for the Undead Tree Demon, which controlled puppets with its tree soul, to have Residual Souls remaining after its death.
However, these Residual Souls were not silent like dead water; instead, they faintly converged towards a broken section of the trunk.
Could it be, that the very heart of the Undead Tree Demon's body resided there?
With this thought, Yuan Ming was about to send a message to Old Man Hei Zhu, asking him to approach the trunk so he too could control the black Undying Tree's roots to absorb the trunk.
But before he could speak, he suddenly saw Qi Ye's figure blur, appearing directly next to that section of roots.
Qi Ye swept his gaze over the trunk, his expression unchanged, but a black long sword had appeared in his hand.
Yuan Ming instantly recognized that this long sword was also forged from Nine Nether Iron. Remembering its properties, Yuan Ming was momentarily uncertain.
Having summoned the long sword, Qi Ye did not hesitate at all, lifted his hand and thrust forward, the tip of the sword pierced the tree bark, heading straight for the Undying Tree Heart.
However, in the next instant, before the Nether Iron long sword could strike the tree heart, a black soul shadow emerged from within the tree heart and instantly appeared before Qi Ye, grabbing his neck.
"Hmph, you wouldn't think that I'm without the power to fight back now, would you?" the soul shadow sneered.
With his neck squeezed, Qi Ye couldn't speak for the moment and could only emit a rasping sound, trying to resist, yet a black light from the soul shadow's hand penetrated his body, making him rigid and immobile.
Yuan Ming watched this unfold, and although he did not recognize the face of the soul shadow, from its words, it definitely was the divine soul of the Undying Tree Demon.
Above the Nascent Soul Stage, a Magic Practitioner's Divine Soul merges into the Nascent Soul and cannot appear externally, but as a demon beast, the Undying Tree Demon possessed an Innate Divine Ability, making the manifestation of its divine soul a possibility.
Realizing this, Yuan Ming immediately messaged Hua Zhi.
At this moment, Hua Zhi and the others were still in the excitement of their narrow escape, not noticing the abnormality at the trunk of the Undying Tree Demon.
Hearing Yuan Ming's message, Hua Zhi's expression changed immediately, raising her hand and pointing towards the trunk: "Look quickly, everyone, the Undying Tree Demon's divine soul is still here, hiding within the trunk. Quick, let's strike together, we must eradicate it and not allow it to rise again!"
Upon hearing this, everyone was shocked and turned their gaze towards the trunk. At the same time, the Undying Tree Soul also turned its head to look at them, a mocking smile appearing on the corner of its mouth.
Seeing this, everyone felt a chill in their hearts and immediately attacked.
Jin Chao and the Green-clothed man were the first to cast their spells. With a flick of their robes, masses of Fireballs and Wind Blades swept out like a dense net in a rain curtain, heading towards the Undying Tree Soul.
Hou Yi's Sun-Shooting Bow was drawn again, a golden arrow made of Spiritual Power manifested in between the bow, and in the next instant, it sped out with endless blazing flames, directly aimed at the head of the Undying Tree Soul.
Following them, the other people also launched their Magic and Magic Treasures without holding back.
However, as soon as they acted, the scattered remains of the Undying Tree suddenly flew up, as if pulled by threads, converging into five spots, and in just a moment, aggregated into five small tree-men.
The faces of these five tree-men were identical to the Undying Tree Demon, and the aura emanating from their bodies almost reached the Returning Void stage.
Facing the attack of the people, four of the tree-men raised their hands and shook their arms, scattering leaf-blades that collided with the Fireballs, Wind Blades, and the Magic and Magic Treasures unleashed by the people, exploding into countless sparks and smoke in mid-air.
Behind them, another tree-man used the cover of flying leaves to step forward boldly, growing many roots and vines from its body, forming a wall-like thick and towering giant shield. With a slam downward, dust flew up and the ground trembled fiercely.
The next instant, a golden arrow fiercely collided with the giant shield, making a sound like a giant bell, and the terrible force and scorching flames together struck the shield surface, pushing both the shield embedded into the ground and the shield-bearing tree-man backward, leaving a deep trench in the ground.
Although the robust giant shield seemed unassailable, it ultimately could not withstand the arrow shot from Hou Yi's Sun-Shooting Bow. However, the subsequent powerless arrow, after piercing through the giant shield, could no longer continue forward, burning the shield-bearing tree-man half black before regrettably dissipating into spiritual light.
Despite seeming severely injured, the shield-bearing tree-man's aura remained completely unaffected. After a slight shake, new roots sprouted on its body, quickly restoring it to its original state.
Seeing this, everyone's expressions turned grave. Just then, countless roots emerged around the five tree-men, connecting them to each other, and their branches and vines on the surface rapidly burst into growth. In the blink of an eye, they grew back into a towering giant tree, with no less imposing than before.
The next moment, countless roots burst forth from the black giant tree, plunging straight into the void.
Everyone was horrified, feeling a chill crawling up their spines.
The Undead Demon Tree was not dead, or rather, it had revived!

chapters.title: Chapter 617 - 590: Internal Response
chapters.content:
Jin Chao made a decisive move, spewing out a mouthful of orange-yellow flames that covered his entire body. The green-clothed man's figure also vanished into the green Wind Roll surrounding him, and on Hou Yi's Sun-shooting Bow, a fierce golden spirit flame surged like a halo, protecting its true form.
Seeing this, the other people hurriedly deployed their techniques to protect their bodies, but before they could even form the hand seals, everyone heard the two demons and one spirit grunt in unison.
In the void, three extremely thick roots emerged from the space cracks, ignoring their Protective Body techniques and piercing directly into their bodies.
The creepy black Protective Spiritual Light continuously crept over their bodies, completely swallowing their Protective Spiritual Light, and then, more roots reached out from the void, seeking to completely bind them.
"Yinkong, help me!" the green-clothed man suddenly shouted.
Yinkong's face showed a struggle, but in an instant, his expression turned fierce again.
He raised his arms, and demonic power surged into them like a tide. His silver hair moved on its own, floating into the air.
Right after, a tall silver willow tree appeared behind Yinkong, its willow branches dancing, causing nearby space to fluctuate wildly.
Yinkong aimed his arms at where the green-clothed man was, then his palms slammed together forcefully.
The space between the green-clothed man and Yinkong suddenly twisted, folding upon itself.
In the next instant, the green-clothed man's figure disappeared on the spot and reappeared beside Yinkong, having escaped the tree roots that had pierced his body.
Meanwhile, the space twisted behind Yinkong, and countless pitch-black space rifts uncontrollably appeared around his body, some even on his torso, dividing his body into pieces in a particularly spine-chilling manner.
"Hmm, Space Folding? This little demon has some skills," the Undead Demon Tree uttered with a hint of interest, taking a closer glance at Yinkong.
Yinkong had no spare energy to speak. The tall silver willow tree behind him had dimmed significantly.
This Divine Skill was still beyond his complete mastery. Forcibly using it now, he even risked damaging his origin.
After sending the green-clothed man away, he resolutely dispersed his Divine Skill, the silver willow behind him vanished, and the surrounding space rifts instantly closed. However, the parts of his body devoured by the space rifts disappeared as well, scattered into the chaotic space currents.ThisisasamplefromMyVirtualLibraryEmpire.Readthereston*.
As Yinkong made his move, Jin Chao and Hou Yi's Sun-shooting Bow also tried to save themselves.
After being pierced, Jin Chao immediately activated his Divine Skills. From his eyes, a lava-like liquid flame poured out, landing on the roots. It instantly turned into a golden expanse of sea of flames, which was the extremely pure Golden Crow True Fire.
The terrifying temperature even caused the ground beneath his feet to evaporate instantly, turning into white smoke.
However, within the sea of flames, the roots of the Undead Demon Tree remained unscathed, showing no signs of being burnt or destroyed.
Just as Jin Chao was about to be completely enveloped by the roots, cracks suddenly emerged on the shell-like flame protective shield beside him.
"Jin Yun? Not good, run!" Jin Chao realized this and felt joy, but then his expression changed once more.
Before Jin Chao's words fell, another root burst from the air, aiming to pierce through the flame protective shield beside Jin Chao as well.
Then in the next breath, the flame protective shield completely shattered, and the Golden Cloud Fairy leaped out, her aura completely different from before, now reaching the Nascent Soul Stage.
Golden Cloud Fairy opened her mouth and spat out a mass of gold and white True Fire that swarmed out, wrapping around the root attacking her.
The black root caught fire with a booming sound, turning to charcoal ash. The gold and white True Fire continued to fly forward, incinerating the roots that had pierced into Jin Chao as well.
"True Sun Fire! You've cultivated it!" Jin Chao exclaimed in joy, escaping the predicament together with the Golden Cloud Fairy.
"Only half cultivated, otherwise the True Fire would've completely transformed into white," Golden Cloud Fairy shook her head slightly, her eyes looking towards the Undead Demon Tree with extreme solemnity.
Compared with the green-clothed man and Jin Chao, Hou Yi's Sun-shooting Bow was in a much worse situation. It had already used up all its Golden Crow Arrows and had no other assistance. After a short struggle, it could only be completely bound by the roots, utterly immobilized.
The three strongest individuals were all hit by the attacking roots. Although two had successfully escaped, the rest of the people were still shocked, continually retreating.
However, the Undead Demon Tree did not intend to use this move against them. Not a single root aimed at them appeared. Instead, the surrounding Tree-man Puppets were reconnected with his roots, encircling the people once again.
"Hehe, this tit-for-tat makes things interesting. Use whatever techniques you have left, don't let me be disappointed," the Undying Tree Soul saw that Jin Chao was rescued and took another look at the Golden Cloud Fairy but still appeared to be completely at ease.
Old Man Hei Zhu and the others, upon hearing this, immediately felt a sense of desperation. The attack they had just launched was the result of their utmost effort, yet it hadn't even scratched the Undead Demon Tree. Could it be that they were truly destined to meet their end here today?
But at that moment, Old Man Hei Zhu's eyes suddenly became misty, his body and mind controlled by an overwhelmingly powerful Illusion Technique, making him pray wholeheartedly to the Nether Moon God.
The next moment, Old Man Hei Zhu's eyes regained their clarity, and no one noticed any abnormality.
Inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod, Yuan Ming saw that Old Man Hei Zhu was controlled by his own Illusion Technique, nodded slightly, and then turned his gaze toward the Undead Tree Demon.
Upon realizing that the Undying Tree Soul was still present, he immediately stopped using the black Undying Tree to absorb the Puppets to avoid detection by the Undead Demon Tree.
Although the Undead Demon Tree in front of them seemed unharmed, Yuan Ming sharply noticed that the number of Tree-man Puppets surrounding them was a full ten percent less than before.
These ten percent of Tree-man Puppets were now lying on the ground, mixed in with the other fallen puppets. Moreover, with everyone's line of sight obstructed by the active Tree-man Puppets and unable to look elsewhere, only he could detect this detail with the help of his all-encompassing Divine Sense.
What's more, if the Undead Demon Tree was truly unharmed, it wouldn't have hidden its Divine Soul in the heart of the tree, giving them a breather before reappearing.
Perhaps the Undead Demon Tree had indeed entered a state of suspended animation earlier, which was why it didn't react to his absorption of the puppets until Qi Ye stabbed at the heart of the tree, forcing it to reveal itself.
While Yuan Ming's thoughts were racing, on the other side, the Undying Tree Soul cast its gaze toward Qi Ye, whom it held in its grasp.
"Hmph, I sent out so many hands to hunt down this group of people, but they've repeatedly escaped. Now, they have conveniently invaded Guanghan City. I've been wondering where they got their information and who leaked it. It seems now that the insider was you," the Undying Tree Soul said slowly with a dark gaze.
"Haha! For so many years, there hasn't been a single day that I haven't thought about how to kill you. Now that I've failed, my only regret is not understanding you enough, otherwise I would never have given you a chance to resurrect," Qi Ye laughed wildly.
"This is truly odd, you Cultivators fight to the death in Cultivation just to have a lifespan as eternal as the heavens, aren't you? Under my command, you'll never have to worry about the depletion of your life span. Moreover, as a Returning Void, I've granted you a certain degree of freedom. Such a good deal, why are you still not content?" A trace of puzzlement surfaced in the Undying Tree Soul's eyes.
"Ridiculous! The freedom you speak of, does it involve being at the mercy of your control at any time, carrying out orders against my will under your manipulation? I Cultivate for eternal life indeed, but even more so for the freedom to roam the world, not for a false eternity bound by another. I would rather fight to the death than be forever controlled by you," Qi Ye sneered and said.
"So stubborn, well then, Qi Ye, I'll give you one last chance. Everyone who has been turned into a puppet by me should be completely under my surveillance. Even though I grant a certain autonomy, there's no way any would harbor thoughts of rebellion. If you reveal how you freed yourself from control, I might consider it making up for your transgressions and spare you from death, otherwise, don't blame me for being heartless!" the Undying Tree Soul said coldly.
"If I feared death, I wouldn't have rebelled from the start. As for how I did it, heh, why don't you take a guess?" Qi Ye said contemptuously.
"Unforgivable!" A flash of cold light appeared in the eyes of the Undying Tree Soul.
A black tree root shot out instantaneously from its body and pierced into Qi Ye's Dantian, utterly devouring his Mana and Qi-Blood in just a moment. Even the Nascent Soul wasn't spared, being crushed and absorbed by the root, with not even a Residual Soul left behind.
Qi Ye fell on the spot, his black sword also clattered to the ground. The Undying Tree Soul, without a glance, flicked its left hand and looked toward Jin Chao and the others.
Seeing the Undead Demon Tree devour a Returning Void cultivator in an instant filled everyone with even greater horror.
But just then, from within the line of people, a streak of red light silently flew out from Hua Zhi's body.
"You—" Just as the Undying Tree Soul started to speak, it suddenly saw an additional blood-colored screen above everyone's heads—it was the Shura Blood Devouring Map.
A Blood Shadow emerged from the screen; it was the Shura Blood Devouring Map Artifact Spirit.
"Spiritual Treasure!" Upon seeing this, the Undying Tree Soul's face showed delight, ready to capture the Shura Blood Devouring Map, but it suddenly felt a sharp pain in the chest.
It looked down in astonishment, only to see the tip of a black sword piercing through its chest.
This was Qi Ye's sword? But he was already dead, why would...?
The thought barely formed in the Undying Tree Soul's mind when a black Thunder burst forth from the black sword that had impaled its chest. Crackling fiercely, the Thunder quickly spread across its entire body, forming a massive black Thunder Ball that engulfed it.
In the blink of an eye, all the Tree-man Puppets stood frozen, as if they had lost their minds, leaving everyone bewildered by this sudden turn of events, uncertain of what had just transpired.
Inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod, Yuan Ming was even more shocked. He and Hua Zhi hadn't manipulated the Shura Blood Devouring Map; the treasure had taken flight on its own. Recalling Qi Ye's instructions before they entered this place, Yuan Ming's heart chilled, and several guesses crossed his mind.
But he knew that this was not the time for hesitation. Almost instantly, he ordered Hua Zhi to retract the Shura Blood Devouring Map and directly controlled Old Man Hei Zhu to fly towards the Undead Demon Tree.
As the black Thunder dispersed, the Undying Tree Soul reappeared.
However, its left arm was severed by the Thunder, its remnant soul body not only covered in wounds but also flickering with countless tiny sparks of electricity, with its aura much diminished from before.

chapters.title: Chapter 618 - 591: Using Mirrors to Craft Trees
chapters.content:
The Undying Tree Soul coughed twice, just recovering from the sneak attack of the thunder, only to look up and see Old Man Hei Zhu flying towards it recklessly, almost landing in front of it.
Anger flashed in its eyes, and it promptly spurred its main body to thrust roots at Old Man Hei Zhu. But at that moment, a giant black hand formed from Soul Power shot out in front of Old Man Hei Zhu, striking the Undying Tree Soul hard. It was the Great Black Sky God Palm.
Caught off guard, the Undying Tree Soul was struck directly by the palm, scattering its Divine Soul that had just stabilized.
After being heavily injured twice, the Undying Tree Soul's control over its main body was also affected. The tree-man puppets that had stood motionless began to tremble uncontrollably, emitting groans that overlapped one after another, and the roots that had been entangled around Hou Yi's Sun Shooting Bow became loose one by one.
Seizing this opportunity, golden light suddenly shone on the body of Hou Yi's Sun Shooting Bow, which then forcefully broke free of its restraints and regained its freedom.
At the moment of its release, a golden light flashed before it, and a red arrow many times thicker than usual materialized out of thin air. It was the Golden Crow Divine Arrow that Yuan Ming had retrieved from the Li Palace upon Qi Ye's command.
Although it had absorbed the Power of the Sun from the Golden Crow Divine Arrow during the breakthrough to the Tongqiao Body, the Divine Arrow had not been destroyed.
A few dozen yards away, Old Man Hei Zhu emotionlessly withdrew his hand.
Seeing this, Hou Yi's Sun Shooting Bow was overjoyed and hastily grabbed the huge Golden Crow Arrow, mounting it to the bow. The bowstring was pulled back with tremendous speed, and under the brilliant glare of the golden light, a rainbow shot through the sky, whistling as it aimed for the main body of the Undead Demon Tree.
The golden rainbow, like a meteor chasing the moon, instantly pierced the main body of the Undead Demon Tree with roaring golden flames, cutting it in half again, and continued on its unstoppable path, plunging straight into the stone wall behind, before once again striking the broken white Barrier.
Amidst the thunderous roar, a proud sun reappeared, leaving a second hundred-yard-wide hole in the white Barrier.
With its main body suffering such a heavy blow, the situation of the Undying Tree Soul became even more dire. Soul Power shaping its soul body was rapidly dissipating, and its soul body already had several gaping wounds.
Focusing solely on self-preservation, it once again dove back into the tree heart to avoid the collapse of its soul body.
Seeing this situation, Yuan Ming immediately used the Nightmare Divine Ability.
The Undying Tree Soul had just burrowed into the heart of the tree and was about to regain control of its body and the tree-man puppets when the scenery before its eyes suddenly changed from the pitch-black gloom of the soluble cave to a sunny garden.
Its once towering form had also diminished to something tiny and frail, much like a freshly sprouted seedling, while in front of it, a white silhouette was holding a watering can, seemingly pouring Spiritual Nectar.
The Undead Demon Tree trembled at the sight of the silhouette.
"No, it's not possible, you are..."
While the Undead Demon Tree was trapped in the Nightmare Illusion Realm, all of the tree-man puppets completely lost control and collapsed powerlessly.
Yuan Ming hurriedly released all the roots of the black Undying Tree from the Stealing Heaven Tripod, even bypassing the tree-man puppets and plunging directly into the main body of the Undead Demon Tree.
Despite several significant injuries, the Origin Power within the Undead Demon Tree remained incredibly abundant. Yuan Ming relentlessly drew power from it, injecting it into the black Undying Tree he had cultivated.
As streams of Origin Power flowed into it, the black Undying Tree within the Stealing Heaven Tripod grew higher and higher, its demonic power surged at an unbelievable rate, and the Ju Mang Spirit Technique rapidly improved.
Before long, the demonic power of the black Undying Tree reached the Third-level Peak, just a step away from a breakthrough.
Content sourced from * – *.
Yuan Ming was delighted and ran the Ju Mang Spirit Technique to its full capacity, aiding the black Undying Tree in absorbing the demonic power of the Undead Demon Tree.
As if there was a soft "bang" the black Undying Tree suddenly grew further, its branches and leaves excitedly flailing about, finally surmounting the Level 4 barrier.
Around Yuan Ming's Nascent Soul, seven different colors of radiance appeared, emanating Gold, Wood, Water, Fire, Earth, Yin, Yang – seven kinds of breath that merged into the Nascent Soul.
Reaching Level 4, the Ju Mang Spirit Technique also finally achieved the Perfect Realm.
The Nascent Soul briefly connected with the seven-colored lights, and the natural powers of the seven elements swiftly gathered, more responsive than ever, dramatically easing the effort compared to before.
"At last, perfected. Is this what the Heavenly Spirit Root feels like? Truly wondrous," Yuan Ming channeled the surrounding nature's spiritual energy, displaying a satisfied expression.
With such a Spirit Root, even without elixirs, his Cultivation would not slow.
Yuan Ming calmed his mind and executed the final step of the Ju Mang Spirit Technique: severing the connection with his Lifebound Spirit Plant, attempting to extract himself from the black Undying Tree.
At that moment, the dense Heaven and Earth Spiritual Power within the Stealing Heaven Tripod surged like a furious wave, all converging onto the black Undying Tree while its form shrunk rapidly. In the blink of an eye, it burrowed back into Yuan Ming's body, lying quietly in the Dantian next to the Nascent Soul.
Yuan Ming's eyes widened at this sight.
What was happening? The black Undying Tree didn't want to disconnect from him? It had voluntarily shrunk and stayed within his body.
The Ju Mang Spirit Technique did not record such a scenario. Was it because there was a problem with his use of the Ju Mang Spirit Technique from the start, or was it because he had let a clone reside in the heart of the Undying Tree?
While Yuan Ming was stunned, his Physical Body also repaired itself swiftly, quickly allowing him to escape the odd half-tree, half-human form, reverting to a human again.
However, Yuan Ming had previously touched the White Jade Lotus Platform with a branch of the black Undying Tree, and now, with its sudden shrinkage, he lost contact with the White Jade Lotus Platform. Caught off guard, his Soul Power ceased to flow, interrupting the Nightmare Divine Ability.
Within the soluble cave, the Undead Demon Tree jolted awake from the illusion, sensing the countless roots piercing its body, it immediately realized the situation and became furious.
The Undead Demon Tree bellowed in anger and instantly retracted its demonic power, gathering it at the heart of the tree where it swirled into a vortex of demon energy.
As the vortex spun, a powerful suction force instead grabbed hold of the roots Yuan Ming had extended, not only snatching back the Origin Power it had lost, but even began to extract the Primordial Qi of the Undying Tree from within Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming's heart chilled, and he immediately tried to pull back his roots. However, as the thought emanated, the roots trembled and seemed to be yanked by brute force, unable to retract in the slightest.
"It seems the one who refined the clone I left at the entrance to Time Cave is you! Utterly reckless! Although I don't know how you did it, if you think, by relying on this forcibly matured clone, you can overcome my true self, then you are greatly underestimating me!"
The mocking voice of the Undead Demon Tree came from the roots, and Yong Ming completely lost control over them in this moment.
"Since the boy dares to steal the Origin Power from my true self, then leave your life behind!"
As soon as the Undead Demon Tree finished speaking, Yuan Ming immediately felt the devouring force within the roots double in strength. The Origin Power of the Undying Tree inside his body rapidly drained, and he was on the verge of falling below the Level 4 Realm.
Yuan Ming felt the Qi-Blood and strength being drawn from his entire body, his expression becoming extremely grave. Thought after thought flickered through his mind as he desperately sought a solution to the present crisis.
Now, he and the Undead Demon Tree were like two participants in a tug-of-war, with the connecting roots acting merely as the rope, and it didn't matter who controlled them.
What truly mattered was the force at the ends of the rope: who was stronger and who was weaker. That was the decisive factor for the flow of Origin Power.
Realizing this, Yuan Ming had an epiphany, as if he had thought of something.
In the next instant, his Divine Soul left his body, sitting upon the White Jade Lotus Platform, and at the same time, he opened his mouth and spat out the Soul Destroying Sword that had been nurtured within him.
Immediately, he raised the Soul Destroying Sword, forming a spell with his hands. Spiritual Power and Soul Power surged towards the blade, as the runes representing the word "Curse" lit up instantly.
In an instant, a torrent of Curse Power burst forth, heading straight for the main body of the Undead Demon Tree.
The Undead Demon Tree, sensing the arrival of an unknown force from the void, was rather disdainful.
Having cultivated for more than a thousand years, its demonic power was beyond what ordinary people could imagine. Even individuals like Qi Ye, who were also at the Returning Void level, were nothing more than playthings at its mercy. The recent affliction was merely due to the cumulative effects of severe injuries. Now, as it absorbed Power from the clone, although not fully healed, its condition had stabilized, posing no further risk of deterioration.
Therefore, no matter what means the thief who had stolen its clone used, it would not lose control over the roots or cease extracting Origin Power from its enemy.
However, confident as it was, the Undead Demon Tree did not become complacent. It still mobilized a trace of demonic power, attempting to counteract the strange power falling from the sky.
To its surprise, though the strange power entered its body, it had no effect.
The Undead Demon Tree was startled, and then its expression abruptly changed to one of extreme terror.
"How could you possibly harness the power of the Evil King Mirror! This is impossible..."
It roared in anger, but was utterly unable to prevent that strange power from piercing its body and pouring into the black mirror.
The black mirror was already filled with a large amount of Curse Power, forcibly suppressed by the Undead Demon Tree's demonic power. Now, a different yet similar Curse Power surged in from outside. It was like a ferocious wolf entering the tiger's territory, immediately provoking the power within the mirror to explode violently outwards.
The curse power, like boiling water, pierced through the demonic energy barrier set by the Undead Demon Tree and spread at a much faster rate than usual, corroding and corrupting everything in its path.
Though the Undead Demon Tree was now severed in two, the lower half still had a connection with its upper half. The uncontrolled, severe damage to the lower half also affected the upper half.
