Its inner vortex of demonic power completely collapsed amidst the outbreak of the Curse Power, unable to absorb the Origin Power of the Undying Tree within Yuan Ming any longer.
At this point, the Undead Demon Tree could not worry about these issues, choosing instead to forcibly channel the chaotic demonic power across the void to the lower half of its body, lunging towards the Curse Power erupting from the black mirror, fully intent on suppressing the backlash.
Yuan Ming thereby gained the opportunity to retract his roots. However, the situation had now reversed, with Yuan Ming being the one reluctant to break the connection.
Even as the Undead Demon Tree was preoccupied with suppressing the backlash, it, in its awakened state, had an origin that was solid as rock, and Yuan Ming could not easily extract from it.
In the blink of an eye, Yuan Ming had a plan. Seated on the Jade Lotus Platform, his soul swiftly performed the Divine Soul Technique, summoning the All Living Beings Dream Rune before him.
"Go!"
With a wave of his hand, Yuan Ming sent the All Living Beings Dream Rune through space, striking the Undead Demon Tree squarely.
The Undead Demon Tree's Divine Soul shook as if an immobilization spell had been cast on it, halting in its actions, while the forcibly controlled demonic power, now unrestrained, became chaotic once again.
But soon, the soul inside the Undead Tree stewed with Soul Power, trying to break through the confinement of the All Living Beings Dream Rune. However, Yuan Ming wouldn't give it the chance, immediately using the Nightmare Divine Ability to trap the Undead Tree Soul in an illusion once more.
As the Undead Tree Soul fell into the Nightmare Illusion Realm, the Origin Power that had been firmly in its grasp was once again opened to Yuan Ming. He did not hesitate to extract the Origin Power from the Undead Demon Tree through his roots.
This time, however, he was cautious. While extracting the Origin Power, he cast his Divine Sense back into the Soluble Cave.
"Gentlemen, the Undead Demon Tree is now ensnared. Act immediately to eradicate all Tree-man Puppets under its command; you may kill or spare them, just ensure they are no longer under its control. Additionally, do not lay hands on the Undead Demon Tree itself; otherwise, it may find an opportunity to escape its bonds!" The thunderous voice of Ming Yue echoed throughout the Soluble Cave.
Shi Yanshi and the others immediately acknowledged the command and set about their task, slaying the Tree-man Puppets that lay scattered on the ground.

chapters.title: Chapter 619 - 592 Black Armored Demon General
chapters.content:
Among the group, Long Chong did not strike to kill the Tree-man Puppets and instead flew to one of them, which was his father, in front of the Golden Transformation Master.
At this moment, the Golden Transformation Master, like the other Tree-man Puppets, lay quietly on the ground with an expressionless face and no reaction, not even when his son approached.
"Father, your child has offended you."
Long Chong helped his father up, looking at that familiar face, he quickly took out several talismans and affixed them to his father's body, sealing him.
Inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod, after Yuan Ming had issued his orders, he began to absorb the Origin Power of the Undead Demon Tree with all his might.
Soon, Yuan Ming discovered that as the Origin Power from the upper half of the Undead Demon Tree's body rapidly drained away, its size also quickly shrank.
He was a bit surprised but then thought that this was a good thing.
When the upper half of the Undead Demon Tree's body had shrunk to the size of a normal tree, Yuan Ming once again made his move and directly took it into the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
Inside the soluble cave, everyone saw the upper half of the Undead Demon Tree's body being taken away into thin air, and at first, they were startled, but then they heaved a sigh of relief.
This time, the Undead Demon Tree had lost even half of its body; it surely wouldn't have any means to recover now, right?
Inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod, Yuan Ming did not relax. He knew that the Divine Soul of the Undead Demon Tree was still only trapped in the Nightmare Illusion Realm and had not been completely extinguished.
To completely eradicate the Undead Demon Tree and also for the enhancement of his own strength, Yuan Ming's body started to grow taller, and his skin became coarse and dry. In a short while, he transformed into a giant black tree, pressing the half-body of the Undead Demon Tree under its roots, attempting to devour and refine it.
At that moment, the Divine Soul of the Undead Demon Tree seemed to sense the imminence of destruction while still in its slumber. Its soul body trembled, struggling fiercely against the restraints, and the Nightmare Divine Ability together with the All Living Beings Dream Rune almost seemed unable to suppress it.
Yuan Ming was secretly shocked and, while operating the Nightmare Divine Ability, also used the Dream Butterfly Illusion Technique to minimize the Undead Demon Tree's sensory perception of the outside world.
But the next instant, something surprising happened to Yuan Ming. On the Undead Demon Tree, the All Living Beings Dream Runes suddenly rose up, actively absorbing the power from the Nightmare Divine Ability and the Dream Butterfly Illusion Technique.
In the runes, these two similar yet distinct powers merged and converged, eventually becoming one.
Yuan Ming sensed that at this moment, the power of his Nightmare Divine Ability had greatly increased, and he could even construct multiple layers of dreams to completely imprison the Divine Soul of the Undead Demon Tree.
The struggle of the Undying Tree Soul abruptly ceased, quieting down.
Without resistance, Yuan Ming's absorption and devouring of the Undead Demon Tree's body accelerated, and soon, he completely absorbed the upper half of the Undead Demon Tree's body.
The tremendous demonic power contained in half of the Undead Demon Tree was now nearly wholly poured into Yuan Ming's black Undying Tree inside him, significantly advancing his strength. His demonic power, which had just broken through to Level 4, soared once more, climbing to the peak of Level 4 before finally stabilizing.
Yuan Ming felt that at this moment, his inner Undying Tree was only half a step away from the fifth level.
At first, he was pleased, but then a look of puzzlement appeared on his face.
The Undead Demon Tree had already reached the Upper Fifth Level, and the demonic power contained in half of its body was extremely vast, even surpassing the two Level 5 demon beasts, the Green-clothed man and Jin Chao. Now that this power was entirely Yuan Ming's and half of the body had been refined, the strength returned was not enough to allow the Undying Tree within him to cross into Level 5.
Could it be that reaching Level 5 requires something else and not just the accumulation of strength?
Or is it that...
As Yuan Ming pondered, a chilling voice suddenly emitted from the lower half of the Undead Demon Tree's body within the soluble cave.
"Sigh, such waste. After cultivating for so long, to be beaten to death by a group of juniors and still dare to claim immortality, truly incapable of greatness."
Yuan Ming's expression changed and, with the Divine Sense enveloping the cave, he instantly found the source of the voice—it was the black magic mirror at the root of the Undead Demon Tree.
As that voice faded, a rich black light suddenly emanated from the black magic mirror.
The half Undying Tree, attracted by that black light, flew backward and directly landed on the black magic mirror. In the instant they touched, an unbelievable scene occurred.
The two unexpectedly merged into one.
The next instant, the half Undying Tree emitted an extremely strange and evil aura. The tall tree body gradually condensed and took shape, developing a head and limbs, transforming into a black-armored war general.
The war general's armor was like the bark of the Undying Tree, covered with tree-like patterns, but at the position of the chest, there emerged a black heart protector mirror, with wisps of black mist emerging from his body.
The sudden appearance of the black-armored general drew everyone's gaze, and upon a quick investigation, they all revealed a look of bewilderment.
The abruptly appearing black-armored general exuded an eerie and inscrutable aura, entirely different from the Undying Tree, yet its presence was just as formidable, evidently having reached the level of a Half-step Returning Void.
"This is Demonic Qi..." Yuan Ming frowned inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod, recognizing the origin of the black mist on the black-armored general.
"Haha..."
The Black Armored Demon General laughed wildly, with a thick black light shining from the black Heart Protector on his chest.
As the black light continued to emanate, a powerful force of attraction appeared once more, causing the broken limbs of the Undying Trees to rise uncontrollably and converge towards the black light.
At the same time, Tree-man Puppets controlled by the Undying Trees, including Wan Tianren and his group, had wooden expressions and offered no resistance, seemingly unaware that their bodies were moving uncontrollably closer to the Black Armored Demon General.
Before long, a blue-skinned female puppet, who was closer to the Black Armored Demon General, was forcibly pulled into his chest's black light. It was the late-stage Nascent Soul Tree-man Puppet that had previously attacked Hua Zhi and the others.
With the sound of "crack crack" of breaking, the blue-skinned woman's body was twisted by a strong force, bending in all directions, and finally compressed into a chunk that was swallowed up by the black light.
Not even half a remnant was left behind; she had been utterly devoured by the Black Armored Demon General.
After consuming the blue-skinned woman, the aura of the Black Armored Demon General instantly surged, his armor became sturdier and more substantial, and a Ghost Face Swallowing Shoulder even grew on the left side.
Seeing this scene, the green-clothed man and others couldn't help but change their expressions. This vеrsiоn wаs sоurсеd frоm М|V|L^ЕМРYR.
Silver Kong Tree Demon felt extremely terrified, panicking and instinctively wanting to escape from this place.
However, realizing that the force only affected the Undead Tree Puppets, he slightly relaxed.
"To become puppets of the Undying Tree is already a tragic fate, but to be devoured by this Black Armored Demon General, they might never find peace." The green-clothed man's brows furrowed slightly as he spoke slowly, seemingly recognizing the origin of the black mist surrounding the War General.
The Black Armored Demon General's gaze fell upon Wan Tianren and the other two. His eyes immediately revealed a greedy look, as if seeing delicious food. To him, these three were the best supplements, and he naturally couldn't miss this opportunity.
When his gaze fell on Wan Tianren, the attractive force intensified, and even though he was farther away, he moved towards the Black Armored Demon General at an even faster speed.
"We can't let him continue to recover," the Divine Bow suddenly spoke out loud.
As the voice fell, a golden light arrow had already condensed on the bow, shooting out towards the Black Armored Demon General.
Previously, in order to kill the Undying Tree, Hou Yi's Sun-shooting Bow had used a considerable amount of power. The arrow now fired wasn't a Golden Crow Divine Arrow, but a light arrow condensed from the Power of the Sun, naturally much weaker.
As the golden arrow flew, radiant with the Power of the Sun, right at the Black Armored Demon General, a figure suddenly flickered behind Wan Tianren, who was about to be pulled into the black light—it was Yuan Ming.
After perfecting the Ju Mang Spirit Technique, Yuan Ming was no longer bound by the Undying Tree, able to move freely.
The instant he appeared, Yuan Ming did not pause for even a moment. He reached out into the void to grab, and the Soul Destroying Sword materialized at once, its Curse Runes lighting up as he slashed at the Black Armored Demon General with his sword.
A majestic Black Sword Qi surged forth, spanning a few dozen feet in an instant, heading straight for the Black Armored Demon General's head.
The latter saw this and projected a black light from the black mirror on his chest, colliding with both the Soul Destroying Sword Energy and the golden arrow light, causing a violent explosion.
The Soul Destroying Sword Energy and the golden arrow light were both dispersed by the black light, turning into strands of aura containing Curse Power and golden light fragments, scattering about. The Black Armored Demon General's attraction to the puppets like Wan Tianren also experienced a brief pause.
Yuan Ming seemed to have timed this moment precisely, flashing past like lightning. With a "whoosh" he unfolded the Night Parade of Hundred Demons, within which the All Living Beings Dream Rune flickered, enveloping Wan Tianren with the light.
As a precaution, Yuan Ming first used an Illusion Technique to control him before absorbing Wan Tianren into the Night Parade of Hundred Demons.
Gu Xuanyang and Jia Sifang followed swiftly, also controlled by Yuan Ming's Illusion Technique and taken into the Night Parade of Hundred Demons.
Yuan Ming immediately rolled up the Night Parade of Hundred Demons to avoid any residual traction between the Black Armored Demon General and the three men, sending them into the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space.
Gu Xuanyang and the other two fell near the altar, landing haphazardly but still not awakening from the illusion.
Yuan Ming only glanced briefly before turning his attention back to the outside world.
Just then, an unexpected change occurred!
A sword light suddenly lit up on Gu Xuanyang's body, hovering autonomously, revealing itself to be Gu Xuanyang's replica of the Spiritual Treasure, the Exterminating Immortal Sword.
However, rather than exhibiting any intent to attack, the Flying Sword seemed to be drawn by an external force, heading straight for the Sword Trace Rift.
Yuan Ming's brows furrowed. As he anticipated the Sword would be torn apart by the dispersed aura in the rift, a surprising event unfolded.
The replica of the Exterminating Immortal Sword, upon reaching the Sword Trace Rift, not only remained intact but steadily hovered there, emitting a series of clear, ringing sword cries.
Accompanying those cries, the mist in the Sword Trace Rift suddenly roiled, and an astonishing Sword Qi seemed to burst from the very depths of the rift, becoming a dazzling white light that wrapped around the Exterminating Immortal Sword.
The Exterminating Immortal Sword let out a loud sword cry and released a shocking sword energy. The Stealing Heaven Tripod Space also trembled slightly, its power far exceeding its strength in Gu Xuanyang's hands by more than tenfold.
Although separated by the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space, Yuan Ming instinctively looked away to avoid the unbearable sharpness of that energy.

chapters.title: Chapter 620 - 593: Demon Mirror
chapters.content:
The Black Armored Demon General saw Yuan Ming's momentary distraction but did not take the opportunity to launch a surprise attack; instead, he leaped into the air and rushed toward Guanghan City on the surface at an incredibly fast speed.
Only then did Yuan Ming come back to his senses. As he was considering whether to pursue, a sudden voice from Qi Ye came from within his Sea of Consciousness.
"Yuan, hurry and chase after the Evil King Mirror! He's most likely going to seize the Great Wilderness Star River Pearl. You must not let him succeed, otherwise, all will be lost!" Qi Ye's voice carried an urgent tone.
"So Senior Qi Ye, you're still alive? Is the Evil King Mirror the black mirror inside the Black Armored Demon General? The Undead Demon Tree mentioned it before, but what is the Great Wilderness Star River Pearl?" Yuan Ming's gaze flickered, and instead of pursuing, he suppressed the impulse to move and sent a telepathic message back.
Seeing that Yuan Ming did not move, Hua Zhi and the others also refrained from chasing.
The Green-clothed man, however, turned into a green shadow and vanished; Yinkong, too, disappeared without a trace.
Jin Chao saw this, grasped the Golden Cloud Fairy beside him, and shot straight up into the sky.
"Why have you stopped, Yuan? There's no time to hesitate," Qi Ye said anxiously.
"What's the rush, Senior Qi Ye? Haven't Senior Jin Chao and that Green-clothed man gone after him? With them there, the Black Armored Demon General won't be able to get his hands on it easily. Let's talk about the Evil King Mirror and the Great Wilderness Star River Pearl," Yuan Ming replied with a light smile, beckoning with his hand.
A Blood Shadow shot out from Hua Zhi and landed in his hand—it was the Shura Blood Devouring Map.
"That's also true. The Black Armored Demon General who escaped just now is the transformation of the Evil King Mirror Artifact Spirit. He's heading for Guanghan Palace on the surface of the Soluble Cave to snatch one of the Spiritual Treasure Orbs, the Great Wilderness Star River Pearl," Qi Ye replied after a brief silence.Thischapterwasmadepossiblebythe*community.
"Judging from your words, Senior Qi Ye, it seems you know quite a bit about the Evil King Mirror. Why does it want to seize that Great Wilderness Star River Pearl?" Yuan Ming telepathically inquired.
"This..." Upon hearing his question, Qi Ye hesitated.
"Senior Qi Ye, with the situation at hand, I advise you not to continue hiding anything. It would be best for both of us to be forthright," Yuan Ming suggested through telepathy.
"What do you mean by that, Yuan? I've never deceived you. Our previous few communications have been quite brief because of the Undead Demon Tree. I am its puppet; I can only communicate with you during its suppression of the Evil King Mirror, and not for too long, or it risks detection," Qi Ye explained.
"Is that so? If Senior Qi Ye is indeed a puppet of the Undead Demon Tree, then how can you communicate with me? From what I've observed, the other Tree-man Puppets mostly lack spiritual intelligence, and those that have it dedicate themselves entirely to serving the Undead Demon Tree without any sign of betrayal. Clearly, both body and mind are controlled by the Undead Demon Tree, so why is it that you are an exception, Senior? Furthermore, when the Undead Demon Tree just killed your physical body, how did you survive and injure the Undying Tree Soul with that Black Sword?" Yuan Ming asked several questions in succession.
"Alas, I was unlucky to be refined into a puppet by the Undead Demon Tree. However, I once had the fortune to practice a secret technique called the Primordial Embryo Soul Storage Technique, which allows for part of one's consciousness to be separated from the main body and reside in another object, coexisting with the main soul's consciousness. It is thanks to this technique that I could remain spiritually alert and wasn't completely controlled by the Undead Demon Tree," Qi Ye explained.
"Primordial Embryo Soul Storage Technique? So, are you communicating with me using a detached consciousness, Senior Qi Ye?" Yuan Ming asked telepathically.
"Yes, my physical body perished previously, and it was also me who controlled the black sword to attack the Undying Tree Soul," Qi Ye said.
"I see, it's indeed a profound and mysterious technique. May I ask where your split soul resides, Fellow Daoist Qi Ye?" Yuan Ming inquired again through telepathy.
"This... Please forgive me, Yuan, for a detached consciousness has weak combat ability. If I reveal my hiding place to others, it would be extremely dangerous for me," Qi Ye apologized.
"Is that so? Since the Senior is unwilling to tell, then allow me to guess. You've placed that consciousness inside this Shura Blood Devouring Map, haven't you?" Yuan Ming raised the blood-red screen in his hand.
Qi Ye was silent.
"And it's not just the consciousness. The Artifact Spirit of the Shura Blood Devouring Map is also yours, isn't it? It must be some sort of split soul," Yuan Ming continued.
"You're thinking too much, Fellow Daoist Yuan," Qi Ye replied.
"Am I?" A cold glint flashed in Yuan Ming's eyes as he flipped his hand and stored the Shura Blood Devouring Map away in the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space, where the white fog still lingered densely.
A black arrow-shaped light shot from within the fog, launched by the first soul sitting on the White Jade Lotus Platform. It penetrated the Shura Blood Devouring Map and struck the Artifact Spirit fiercely.
Under the influence of the main soul, the first soul had also broken through the Sleep Witch Realm, and with the power of Desire endowed by the Lotus Platform inside, the first soul's Soul Power had reached the level of a Half-step Spoken Witch, making it unnecessary for Yuan Ming's true form to be present.
Although the arrow-shaped black light was a mere common Divine Soul attack, its power was still incredibly formidable.
A blood shadow flashed out from the Shura Blood Devouring Map, letting out uncontrollable screams; it was Qi Ye's voice.
"How about now?" A giant hand formed from condensed Soul Power emerged from the white mist, seizing the blood shadow in its grasp; it was indeed the Great Black Sky God Palm.
"Yuan, your insight is sharp; indeed, the Artifact Spirit of the Shura Blood Devouring Map is a soul split of mine. Nevertheless, the Primordial Embryo Soul Storage Technique I mentioned is not a lie; it does exist. I had placed that strand of consciousness in the Fire Burning Stick you obtained earlier. The split consciousness is too far from the main soul to provide mutual protection," Qi Ye said with a slight bitter smile.
"Rest assured, Yuan, after you obtained that Fire Burning Stick, my consciousness had already transferred to the Artifact Spirit of the Shura Blood Devouring Map, leaving not a trace within the Fire Burning Stick. You can use that treasure without concerns," he quickly added, as if remembering something.
"No matter what, tell me everything you know about the Evil King Mirror and the Great Wilderness Star River Pearl! My patience is limited; I don't want to hear another lie, or else don't blame me for being merciless," Yuan Ming said coldly.
Qi Ye had been a great help to him in taking down the Undead Tree Demon, and he didn't want to forcibly Soul Search him, but if Qi Ye were to deceive him again, he would show no mercy whatsoever.
"Let's just lay it all out. I am not a native creature here but come from the Demon World. The Evil King Mirror also originates from the Demon World, crafted by a vile and evil criminal, an odd Spiritual Treasure," Qi Ye sighed helplessly as he spoke.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming felt a jolt, quite surprised.
"Continue," he said, suppressing the urge to inquire further, urging Qi Ye to proceed.
"The Evil King Mirror can absorb negative emotions such as hatred, curses, enmity, jealousy, and it strengthens itself by feeding on these emotions, growing in power step by step. In order to gather more extreme negative emotions, the Evil King Mirror often incites various factions within the Demon World to kill each other, bringing great disaster to the creatures of the Demon World. However, the Evil King Mirror is also pursued by many cultivators there. For some unknown reason, it eventually escaped from the Demon World to the Yunhuang Continent," Qi Ye continued.
"Then you followed it to the Yunhuang Continent?" Yuan Ming asked.
"My clan was destroyed by the Evil King Mirror, many relatives dying by its hands. My grudge with the Evil King Mirror is irreconcilable, and at a great cost, I arrived at the Yunhuang Continent," Qi Ye said evenly, yet Yuan Ming heard in his voice a deep sorrow and self-blame, not seeming feigned.
"Why did the Evil King Mirror appear on the Three Immortals Island? And how did you get here?" Yuan Ming asked after a slight silence.
"Why the Evil King Mirror is here, I'm not quite clear on that myself. After I came to the Yunhuang Continent, after years of investigation, I found that the mirror was sealed in the Three Immortals Island, so I followed. However, according to my years of observation, someone intended to use the power of the Undying Tree to suppress the Evil King Mirror, but they underestimated its power. Over the years, not only has the mirror's evilness not been ground away, but it also influenced the Undying Tree, causing it to fall into the Evil Path. When I sought it here, I ended up enslaved by the Undying Tree." Qi Ye seemed not to hold anything back, telling all that he knew.
Hearing this, Yuan Ming finally understood why the Evil King Mirror appeared on the Three Immortals Island and decided not to delve into the unclear details.
It doesn't matter whether it was the Three Immortals Island or the Evil King Mirror; neither had much to do with him.
"What is the Great Wilderness Star River Pearl? Why would the Evil King Mirror want to snatch it?" Yuan Ming inquired.
"The Great Wilderness Star River Pearl is a Space Spiritual Treasure, like the Lank Chessboard and Hou Yi's Sun Shooting Bow, left by the Three Immortals. Its Divine Skill is to break open the void, creating void passages, allowing easy passage through Secret Realms or Forbidden Barriers. If the Evil King Mirror gains control of the Great Wilderness Star River Pearl, from then on, it could come and go as it pleases in heaven or earth, and no one would be able to catch it. The Yunhuang Continent would also endure an endless typhoon of blood due to the mirror," Qi Ye said in a grave voice.
"You've said so much just to get me to deal with the Evil King Mirror? Do you think with all this alarming talk, I would go head-to-head with an Evil Treasure from the Demon World?" Yuan Ming sneered suddenly.
"I wouldn't dare harbor such expectations. It's just that the spatial barriers of the Three Immortal Island Secret Realm are incredibly strong, and the only way out is the Great Wilderness Star River Pearl. If we let the Evil King Mirror escape with the pearl, I fear we may be forever trapped here," Qi Ye explained.
Yuan Ming frowned upon hearing this.
Qi Ye's words indeed touched on his Achilles' heel. If the Evil King Mirror indeed took the Great Wilderness Star River Pearl, he would truly be in trouble.
With that thought, Yuan Ming soared up and chased after them towards the upper levels.
Flower branches and the others remaining in the soluble cave saw Yuan Ming following the Black Armored Demon upward and also hastened to follow suit.
After a while, there was not a single person left inside the cave.
When the cave had fallen into utter silence, a faint sound suddenly came from a corner.
Then a heavy friction sound ensued, and a huge stone slab was suddenly propped up, then pushed over and smashed down, as a figure climbed out from underneath.
This man had a dirt-covered face, looking utterly disheveled, it was Wu Yuezhi.
Wu Yuezhi swept a cold glance around, then his face suddenly turned ruthless and his figure vanished from the spot in the blink of an eye.

chapters.title: Chapter 621 - 594: The Treasure of the Demon World
chapters.content:
Within Guanghan City, booming explosions echoed incessantly.
In that Guanghan Palace, of the twelve tall pillars, seven had already broken, and although the remaining five were still intact, the light from the runes upon them was no longer as bright as it was initially.
In the center of the Great Array, an Undying Tree over thirty feet tall stood in the middle of the palace.
Roots extending from its body were connected to the remaining five pillars, while another seven thick roots stood erect on the other side of its body, replacing the seven destroyed pillars, barely maintaining the operation of the Great Array.
In midair, the Blood Realm Venerable, his body covered with cuts from swords, had a look of joy in his eyes as he controlled the blood-red dragon to repeatedly crash against one of the pillars.
Above the Great Array, two white rainbow lights flanked from both sides and shot towards the blood-red dragon before they could hit, a Blood Shadow and a golden Puppet flew up to intercept them.
"Put in a bit more effort, just destroy one more Stone Pillar, and then the Undying Tree will no longer be able to compensate with its own power," Yuan Wuji said while controlling the Blood God's Son.
"This is also thanks to Fellow Daoist Xi's guidance..." Ni Mu looked over at Guoguo.
Xi Ying was controlling Guoguo, constantly spewing out silver light from her mouth, bombarding the Great Array, oblivious to their words.
"Bang!"
The blood-red dragon heavily collided with the Stone Pillar, its huge body rebounded by the impact, and before it could launch the next attack, there was Ni Mu's Lifebound Puppet Tongchen, which had already charged up again, lifting its golden palm and smashing down towards the Stone Pillar.
Its palm print on the Stone Pillar immediately rippled with a strange wave, as if a bizarre strength permeated into the interior of the Stone Pillar.
When the Stone Pillar was attacked, it immediately provoked a violent reaction from the Great Array, and seven or eight exceedingly sharp white Sword Shadows sprang towards the golden Puppet.T.h^is is p@art* of a s%eri+e!s f+r-om+ * ($M|V|L&1-EM@P*YR+).
Just as the golden Puppet and Blood God's Son helped the blood-red dragon block the attacks previously, this time, the blood-red dragon and Blood God's Son helped the golden Puppet intercept the attacks.
After a brief accumulation of power, the Blood God's Son once again surged forward, its forearm extending a broad Blood Blade, attacking the same spot on the Stone Pillar that had been hit by the blood-red dragon earlier.
This was precisely the effect of Xi Ying's guidance.
Having the three with the strongest attack power focus on the Stone Pillar while collaborating in defense, and having others attack from a distance to distribute the pressure, they cycled through this process, gradually grinding down seven pillars.
"Crack"
Finally, the eighth Stone Pillar also cracked open with a deep fissure.
The Undying Tree Avatar within the Great Array was shaking violently, not only due to the relentless attacks of everyone, but more importantly because it had just felt its main soul annihilated.
At that moment, the already crumbling Great Array in the palace suddenly burst forth with blinding brilliance, rendering all those besieging it unable to look directly at it.
"Damn, this Demon Tree is in desperate straits!" Sensing the suddenly intensified ferocious attacks, the expression of the Blood Realm Venerable twisted slightly as he couldn't help but exclaim.
He, Ni Mu, and Yuan Wuji, who had been collaborating to strike the Great Array's Stone Pillars, also slowed their attacks and retreated a few steps.
Just when everyone thought the Undying Tree Avatar was about to fight to the death, Xi Ying sternly reminded them through Guoguo's mouth:
"Don't be deceived, it's trying to escape!"
Indeed, just as Xi Ying's words fell, the Undying Tree that was ceaselessly shaking in the middle of the Great Array suddenly uprooted itself and the darkness on its body shrank, turning back into that Black Robed Elder in the blink of an eye.
He shot a resentful glance at Guoguo, then quickly snatched the Silver-white Orb, his body transforming into a black afterimage as he shot towards the outside of Guanghan Palace.
As the Silver-white Orb was moved and the Black Robed Elder retreated, the Great Array within Guanghan Palace finally collapsed completely, and the remaining Stone Pillars could no longer bear the burden and collapsed with a loud crash.
The white Barrier that enveloped the outside of Guanghan City also disintegrated, dispersing into countless sparkles of light.
A small continent appeared mid-air, silently suspended.
The Black Robed Elder, while fleeing, clutched the Silver Orb with both hands, continuously channeling mana into it.
The Silver Orb immediately shone with thousands of starlights, the star patterns engraved upon it lit up one by one, emanating fluctuations of Space Power.
"The Great Wilderness Star River Pearl is in his hands; we can't let him get away!" Yuan Wuji's voice suddenly rose, his figure rapidly shot out, hastily chasing after the Black Robed Elder.
Ni Mu waved his hand, and the Thousand Illusion Treasure Mirror immediately flew up into the sky, soon breaking apart into a blue mist which, in a flash, caught up with the Black Robed Elder, piercing into the back of his head.
Unsure whether the Great Wilderness Star River Pearl needed complete refinement or if its use naturally took time, the Black Robed Elder hadn't managed to activate its power before he was controlled by the blue mist and fell into an illusion.
However, within less than two breaths, thick Black Mist seeped from his body, directly forcing the blue mist out, allowing him to recover.
But this interruption meant that the lights lit up on the Great Wilderness Star River Pearl had all faded away.
The Black Robed Elder's face twisted with anger, but he dared not linger any longer, only managing to again attempt to activate the Great Wilderness Star River Pearl while fleeing.
But the brief pause just now had allowed two figures to block his way, one to the left and one to the right.
Bing Li stood suspended in the air, white eyebrows covered with a layer of frost, her eyes also radiating a cold murderous intent, cold air seeped out from the Wind Snow Sword in her hand, and a bright Sword Shadow slashed out.
As the sword light flew out, countless snow-white sword shadows spread, and "crack crack" sounds echoed throughout the void as a huge ice wall emerged, blocking the path of the Black Robed Elder.
On the other side, Lan Xiao swung his arm, and a sky full of poison insects, enveloped in purple poison fog, fell from above, rushing toward the Black Robed Elder.
"Get out of my way!" the cold voice of the Black Robed Elder rang out.
Two massive black palm prints flew out with a bang, directly shattering the ice wall, the resulting hurricane and ice shards scattering the purple poison fog and the swarms of poison insects.
The figure of the Black Robed Elder passed through the storm, and suddenly a thick white tail emerged from the nearby void—it was Guoguo's tail, which quickly wrapped around the Black Robed Elder's body.
The bald head of the elder flashed with golden light, and Ni Mu's Tongchen Puppet appeared out of thin air, with two golden palms striking from left and right, slamming fiercely onto the elder's body.
Bang!
The body of the Black Robed Elder shattered, scattering in all directions.
Ni Mu appeared above the Tongchen Puppet, his face showing joy, but the next moment his smile froze as the shards of the Black Robed Elder's body turned into ordinary pieces of wood.
The figure of the Black Robed Elder appeared in a forest dozens of yards away, sitting cross-legged and vigorously activating the Great Wilderness Star River Pearl.
"This is Yuan Ming's Six Jia Qimen…" Xi Ying murmured with a slight surprise from within Guoguo.
A streak of anger crossed Ni Mu's eyes as he lunged forward.
At the same time, the Blood Realm Venerable stood atop the head of a blood-red dragon, also rushing toward the Black Robed Elder.
Although Yuan Wuji was still far away, the Blood God's Son had already leaped into the air, coming right above the Black Robed Elder.
Just then, a silver light suddenly shone in the Black Robed Elder's profound eyes, like ancient wells, and a silver ring of light emerged from under his feet.
"Not good!" Xi Ying sensed the waves of Space Power emanating from the silver ring and immediately felt a sense of foreboding.
Ni Mu and the others, of course, also noticed and attacked with all their strength.
However, their attacks were ultimately a step too slow, as a dazzling light burst from the silver ring, engulfing the Black Robed Elder and making him disappear without a trace.
The expressions of Ni Mu and the others changed dramatically, and their faces revealed feelings of frustration and unwillingness.
Before they could start blaming each other, Xi Ying suddenly realized that the Divine Soul fluctuations of the Black Robed Elder had reappeared after a brief disappearance.
"He hasn't gone far, he's just outside Guanghan City," Xi Ying promptly shouted to the others through Guoguo's mouth.
Upon hearing this, Ni Mu and the others didn't bother with anything else and rushed out immediately.
"It can only get me this far…" Outside Guanghan City, the figure of the Black Robed Elder had just appeared, his face showing a look of astonishment, then quickly turning to mutter angrily to himself.
The destruction of the main soul had caused more damage than he had expected, and with both Soul Power and Qi-blood severely depleted, the Space Divine Power of the Great Wilderness Star River Pearl was greatly suppressed.
What was once a power he could use to teleport anywhere on the Three Immortals Island was now limited to being used only on this Round Moon.
In his anger, the Black Robed Elder did not lose his rationality. Such a teleportation distance was insufficient for him to escape. After briefly shaking off Ni Mu and the others, he began to activate the Great Wilderness Star River Pearl with all his might.
As long as he was able to activate this treasure successfully, he still had a chance to escape from this place.
The Black Robed Elder sped away, attempting to distance himself from Guanghan City, but he soon faced a figure clad in Black Armor, charging toward him.
"Evil King Mirror!" Upon feeling the familiar yet foreign aura on it, the Black Robed Elder roared in fury.
Had it not been for this damned thing, he would not have been reduced to his current predicament.
"Hehe, old friend, we meet again," the Black Armored Demon General couldn't help but laugh out loud upon seeing the Black Robed Elder.
But when he saw the Silver-white Orb in the hand of the Undying Tree Avatar, emitting a starlike glow, his expression suddenly became uneasy.
"The Great Wilderness Star River Pearl! Give it to me!" The Black Armored Demon General's eyes gleamed with frenzy, and he bellowed.
The Heart Protector Mirror on his chest suddenly burst forth with a powerful black light, and the incredible pulling force didn't scatter at all, coming at the Black Robed Elder like an enormous hand.
"Do you take me for some puppet?" the Black Robed Elder shouted in fury the moment he felt that pulling force.
Black light immediately shone all over his body, directly dispelling that force.
Right afterward, the withered tree-like sternum of the Black Robed Elder opened up to revealed a mass of dark green light, which quickly became a vortex spewing green light.
The Black Armored Demon General, who was confronting him from afar, suddenly made "crack crack" noises as his body, which had fused with the Undying Tree, began to show signs of falling apart under the influence of that power.
"Return what belongs to me," the Black Robed Elder roared.

chapters.title: Chapter 622 - 595: Encirclement and Interception
chapters.content:
The Black Armored Demon General's chest glinted with a flash of light from the Black Mirror, and a surge of Black Mist enveloped his body as if putting on an outer garment. The cracking sounds on his body ceased immediately, and there were no longer any signs of disintegration.
Just as he and the Black Robed Elder prepared to continue their assault, two figures rushed forward ahead of them—it was the Green-clothed man and Yinkong.
Almost at the same moment, golden light flickered in the nearby Void, and Jin Chao and the Golden Cloud Fairy also appeared, trapping the Black Armored Demon General and the Black Robed Elder in the middle.
The Black Armored Demon General and the Black Robed Elder immediately ceased fighting, with Demonic Qi swirling around the Black Armored Demon General. He let out two strange laughs, seemingly undisturbed by the situation at hand.
The face of the Black Robed Elder, however, changed color as a glimpse of despair flashed in his eyes, but he quickly regained his composure.
"So you lot have come too, also looking to snatch the Great Wilderness Star River Pearl?" he said in a deep voice.
"The Undying Tree Demon's main body is dead. You, as its Avatar, won't escape either. Hand over the Great Wilderness Star River Pearl, and I can grant you a swift death!" The Green-clothed man glanced greedily at the Silver Orb in the Black Robed Elder's hand.
At this moment, several more figures flew from afar, led by Yuan Wuji of the Tide-rider Alliance, along with Ni Mu and Guoguo.
Seeing the Green-clothed man and Jin Chao, Yuan Wuji's expression turned ugly. Neither the Green-clothed man nor Jin Chao were opponents they could contend with.
Without a word, Yuan Wuji waved his hand, signaling members of the Tide-rider Alliance to spread out and block every escape route of the Black Robed Elder and the Black Armored Demon General.
Ni Mu blended into the midst of the Tide-rider Alliance, trying his best to lower his presence.
At that moment, a flash of blue light appeared below, and the figure of Yuan Ming also swiftly arrived.
He had been focused on refining a piece of the Undying Tree and hadn't sensed the situation above. Seeing the current events, his brows furrowed slightly.
The others glanced at Yuan Ming briefly before turning their attention back to the Black Armored Demon General and the Black Robed Elder.
Only Ni Mu gave Yuan Ming a thorough up and down look, a hint of interest flashing in his eyes.
Yuan Ming saw Guoguo in the crowd and sent an inquisitive look his way.
But the next moment, Xi Ying's voice resounded in his Sea of Consciousness, quickly recounting what had happened in the Guanghan Palace.
As the crowd surrounded the Black Robed Elder and the Black Armored Demon General, they were also cautious of each other, none making the first move, creating a stand-off with a rather tense atmosphere.
"Who might you be? Our target is the Undying Tree Demon Avatar. If you do not wish to fall here, I advise you to leave immediately!" Seeing that both the Green-clothed man and Jin Chao remained silent, Yuan Wuji shrewdly spoke to the Black Armored Demon General.
With the Green-clothed man and Jin Chao encircling the Black Armored Demon General and the Black Robed Elder, it was unclear what grievances existed between them. If the Black Armored Demon General left now, there was a chance he could draw away the two Level 5 demon beasts.
"Ladies and gentlemen, this Black Armored Demon General is indeed the Spiritual Treasure Evil King Mirror from the Demon World, transformed by absorbing essence from the Undying Tree. It excels in manipulating people's hearts and inciting strife. Ensure it does not obtain the Great Wilderness Star River Pearl, or else it will surely flee at once. The Great Wilderness Star River Pearl, being a Space Spiritual Treasure, can open Void passages and allow for escape through space, which none of us could follow," Yuan Ming interjected before the Black Armored Demon General could speak up, issuing a warning.
"The Demon World? Does such a place truly exist?" The crowd was initially shocked, and then many showed expressions of amazement.
Clearly, many among them had never heard of the Demon World, just as Yuan Ming had not before.
The Black Armored Demon General was taken aback, seemingly not expecting someone to know his background so clearly.
Once Qi Ye was seized by the Undying Tree Demon, he kept a low profile and didn't reveal his identity as part of the Demon Clan. Since the Evil King Mirror had never encountered Qi Ye, it didn't realize it had an enemy lurking in its midst.
"The Evil King Mirror? Fellow Daoist Yuan, what exactly is going on? Please clarify," the Green-clothed man asked with a frown.
He seemed not to question the reality of the Demon World but was more interested in the Evil King Mirror itself.
Hearing this, Yuan Ming then recounted what Qi Ye had told him about the Evil King Mirror to the others.
He emphasized how the Evil King Mirror desired to absorb negative emotions such as hatred and fear, thereby provoking conflict, and he articulated the need to unite everyone's power to suppress the Evil King Mirror, to prevent it from harming innocent lives.
As for the source of this intelligence, Yuan Ming placed it all on the Nether Moon God, leaving Qi Ye out of it.
He also didn't tell the others that the Great Wilderness Star River Pearl could leave the Three Immortals Island.
"This is interesting. I initially thought you were just a peculiar Spiritual Treasure, but it turns out you come from the Demon World," the Green-clothed man commented after hearing this, scrutinizing the Black Armored Demon General with interest and chuckling.
His tone was curious rather than hostile.
"What Evil King Mirror? The beings of this world have nothing to do with us of the Tide-rider Alliance. As long as you don't interfere with our conflict against that Undying Tree Avatar, our Alliance will owe you all a favor," Yuan Wuji stated slowly.
Yuan Ming's brow furrowed, but he said nothing.
"Since it's an Evil Treasure from the Demon World, we can't ignore this matter," Ni Mu unexpectedly spoke up.
"This nuisance really is no small trouble; indeed, we cannot let him run away." Jin Chao also pondered briefly before agreeing.
Yuan Ming folded his hands and bowed to the two of them to express his thanks.
"Kid, we have been entangled for many years, and by any account, we are acquainted. In the current situation, if we do not join hands, I'm afraid neither of us will escape." Having heard the surrounding people's conversation, the Black Armored Demon General communicated with the Black Robed Elder via Divine Sense, attempting to ally with him.
"Join forces with you? The moment I let my guard down, you would probably swallow me and the Great Wilderness Star River Pearl in one gulp and then escape into the void," the Black Robed Elder transmitted back with a cold laugh.
"Fellow Daoist is too suspicious. I have never touched the Great Wilderness Star River Pearl, and even if I got hold of this treasure, I couldn't use it right away. It would only lead to death at the hands of these people here. I'm not a fool to commit such an unwise act," the Black Armored Demon General transmitted back.
"Do you truly intend to join forces? That's not impossible, but these people here are all quite strong. If we really fight, we have no chance of victory. Later on, you help me buy some time, and I'll use the Great Wilderness Star River Pearl to take you with me," the Black Robed Elder replied after a moment's thought.
"You want to use me as a shield to buy time for your escape? As ugly as you look, you do dream prettily! I was the one who proposed the alliance, but if you think you can control me with just that, then save it! I would rather not rely on the Great Wilderness Star River Pearl and dive into the Void Turbulence outside the Three Immortal Island Secret Realm. It might take a bit more time, but I can still leave this damned place. You, on the other hand, can die here holding the Great Wilderness Star River Pearl!" the Black Armored Demon General suddenly turned hostile, transmitting with a cold laugh.
"What do you propose then?" The Black Robed Elder's face turned sour as he transmitted his question.
"After you and I join forces to shake off these people's entanglement, we'll escape together using the Great Wilderness Star River Pearl. Before that, don't try any tricks, or else don't blame me for breaking the cauldrons and sinking the boats, ensuring mutual destruction," the Black Armored Demon General transmitted.
"Fine." Knowing this was his only chance at life, the Black Robed Elder agreed.
A smile crept over the face of the Black Armored Demon General, who, in a flash, stood beside the Black Robed Elder.
The surrounding people seeing this, their expressions all changed.
Yuan Ming's thoughts raced, and he swiftly took out the Soul Destroying Sword, slashing at the Black Armored Demon General in the air.
A black Sword Qi several zhang long shot out, materializing vaguely in front of the Black Armored Demon General, and slashed down at his head!
Although he didn't know what the Black Armored Demon General and the Undying Tree Avatar had agreed upon, it was definitely not good, and with everyone else unclear of motives and different in minds, it was better to stir up the fight and muddle the situation first!
As Yuan Ming swung his sword, he also quietly activated his Emotion Manipulation Ability, slightly stirring the war intent of others.
Aside from the Green-clothed man and Jin Chao, the nearby people also subconsciously brought out their treasures and attacked the two Black Armored Demons!
The eyes of the Black Armored Demon General darkened, and from the Heart Protector on his chest burst out a thick Demonic Qi, which then split into several black giant palms, clashing with the Soul Destroying Sword Energy and the treasures from the others!
A series of loud crashes erupted, and the black giant palms shattered into black mist.
However, the treasures of the people were also repelled, and the Soul Destroying Sword Energy was broken!
Moreover, within the black giant palms was a curse power that infiltrated the treasures, attacking the treasure owners.
Enjoy the story by reading on *.
The people who just took action changed colors in alarm, quickly casting to dispel it.
Yuan Ming channeled the Cure Runes on the Soul Destroying Sword, easily dispelling the curse power, and took to the air.
"Fellow Daoist, please hold your hand! I have something to say," the Black Armored Demon General looked at Yuan Ming in surprise and spoke.
Yuan Ming turned a deaf ear, sending out more than a dozen strands of Soul Destroying Sword Energy weaving through the air, striking fiercely towards the Black Armored Demon General.
"If you don't stop now, we will destroy the Great Wilderness Star River Pearl at once, and everyone will walk away!" The Black Armored Demon General dodged and shouted sharply.
The Black Robed Elder next to him raised the Great Wilderness Star River Pearl, and dazzling silver light burst out from the orb.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, please stop for now and listen to what they have to say," Jin Chao's face changed slightly as he flashed forward to block Yuan Ming.
"Senior Jin Chao, this Evil King Mirror is extremely cunning; we cannot give it a chance to catch its breath. Right now we have the upper hand, it would be best to wipe them out in one fell swoop!" Yuan Ming transmitted back.
"No need to worry, both the Evil King Mirror and the Undying Tree Avatar are trapped and cannot escape. Let's not risk damaging the Great Wilderness Star River Pearl," Jin Chao waved his hand and said.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming had no choice but to stop.
"Fellow Daoists, with the Tree Demon now fallen, only its weakened avatar remains, which is no match for its true self and not worth worrying over. Besides, there is no irresolvable enmity among us, so why not end this on a high note? What you seek, whether it's the treasures on Three Immortals Island, a way out of this place, or the Great Wilderness Star River Pearl, there are ways to resolve these issues. There's no need for us to come to a life or death conflict," the Black Armored Demon General spoke.
As these words were spoken, the expressions of everyone present changed.
"Indeed, what is your recommended resolution?" asked Jin Chao.
The Black Armored Demon General did not regard Jin Chao but turned to address the Tide-rider Alliance, saying, "I have learned quite a bit about the Tide-rider Alliance from the Puppet of the Undead Tree Demon. You few seek to possess the Great Wilderness Star River Pearl in order to explore the Overseas World, right? Let's strike a deal. As long as you don't make things difficult for me, I can promise to lead you deep into the Overseas World afterward. I have come from crossing the Overseas World, and I know much more about that place than any of you here."
Upon hearing this, Yuan Wuji and the others were taken aback, their expressions showing hesitation.

chapters.title: Chapter 623 - 596: Co-opting and Betrayal
chapters.content:
The original purpose of the establishment of the Tide-rider Alliance was to explore the Overseas World. It was only because the last expedition ended with the ancestors disappearing without a trace, leading to the near-destruction of the Tide-rider Alliance, that the exploration of the Overseas World was halted.
Yuan Wuji and others, as successors, had never forgotten this mission. Unfortunately, they weren't strong enough and could only linger around the edges of the Overseas World over the years. If there was someone from the Overseas World to lead the way, the exploration would undoubtedly go much smoother.
With this thought, many among them were moved.
"What do you mean by this? Are you toying with Jin Chao?" Jin Chao stood there, then said angrily.
He had stopped Yuan Ming to let Black Armored Demon General speak, only for the latter to attempt to divide them—it was as if he was treating him like a fool!
"You two, you want the Great Wilderness Star River Pearl to borrow the Space Power within it to refine your Bloodline Power, right? It's not that there isn't a way to fulfill both needs." Black Armored Demon General ignored Jin Chao and turned his gaze to the green-clothed man and Silver Kong Tree Demon.
The two looked at each other but didn't speak.
Seeing that the Black Armored Demon General continued to seek allies, Jin Chao could no longer restrain himself and pointed in the void.
A golden light flashed, and a golden thin needle appeared mysteriously beside Black Armored Demon General. With another flash, the Flying Needle turned into a golden thread aimed at Black Armored Demon General's head.
However, a feather-shaped cyan light flashed, shunting away the golden needle. The green-clothed man appeared between Jin Chao and Black Armored Demon General, and with a smile that was not quite a smile, said, "Fellow Daoist Jin Chao, since you just let Black Armored Demon General speak, why not listen to the end?"
Jin Chao's face soured, but he did not continue to attack, deeply regretting stopping Yuan Ming earlier.
Yuan Ming, on the other hand, had calmed down and stood there silently, lost in thought.
"If we squander the power of the Great Wilderness Star River Pearl just for this, it would really be a waste. As for methods to improve Bloodline Power, our Demon World has plenty. If you are willing to cooperate, I can help enhance your Bloodline Power further with Demonic Qi." Having nodded in thanks to the green-clothed man, Black Armored Demon General continued.
"Empty promises. Why should we believe you?" Silver Kong Tree Demon immediately questioned.
The green-clothed man, however, remained silent, neither agreeing nor disagreeing.
"That's simple." Black Armored Demon General chuckled with a heh.
As the laughter fell, a beam wrapped in dense black qi shot straight out from the Heart Protector on his chest. It hit Silver Kong Tree Demon almost instantaneously.
Silver Kong Tree Demon couldn't react quickly enough and had to step back with a drastic change in his expression.
Yet soon, the shocked look on his face turned to one of surprise.
As the black light entered his body, the Black Mist coating it seeped into him too, and he immediately felt a burning sensation throughout his blood, as if a new force had merged into it.
"That was only the most superficial use of Demonic Qi. I know a place in the Overseas World that contains abundant Demonic Qi and has formed a Blood Refining Demon Spring. Just soaking in it for seven days and nights will at least double your Bloodline Power," said Black Armored Demon General, pleased with his reaction.
Silver Kong Tree Demon's eyes shone with delight as he looked eagerly towards the green-clothed man, seeking his opinion.
"We are willing to cooperate, but we'll need the Great Wilderness Star River Pearl as collateral until you lead us to the Blood Refining Demon Spring," said the green-clothed man after a moment's intense frown, which then relaxed.
"No problem," laughed Black Armored Demon General, pleased with the reply.
The Black Robed Elder frowned, clenching his hand holding the Great Wilderness Star River Pearl a bit tighter.
"What about you? What have you decided?" Black Armored Demon General raised an eyebrow and looked at the members of the Tide-rider Alliance led by Yuan Wuji.
The Blood Realm Venerable, Bing Li, and Lan Xiao all fixed their gazes on Yuan Wuji, awaiting his final decision, and Yuan Ming and his companions also turned to look at him.
"Alliance Leader Yuan, those not of our kind have different hearts. This Demon's words can't be taken seriously!" Ni Mu advised.
Yuan Wuji remained silent for a moment, then distanced himself from Ni Mu and Guoguo to stand on Black Armored Demon General's side.
"Fellow Daoist Ni, please understand," Yuan Wuji spoke politely while Blood God's Son assumed an offensive stance in front of him.
Seeing this, the Blood Realm Venerable and others promptly followed.
"If you all are determined to go your own way, then there's nothing more to say. Let's see the truth in action," said Yuan Ming coldly.
As he spoke, he sent a telepathic message to the others:
"I ask for your help to obstruct the others for a while and leave Black Armored Demon General to me."
"Are you sure you can handle him? Although Black Armored Demon General hasn't reached the Returning Void level, he's not far off," Jin Chao had calmed down by this point and asked telepathically.
"If it's a contest of Mana, I'm naturally no match. I have another way to deal with him," Yuan Ming replied through telepathy.
"Alright, leave the green-clothed man and Silver Kong Tree Demon to us," answered Jin Chao.
Golden Cloud Fairy didn't speak. She simply glanced at Yuan Ming and subtly nodded her head.
"The members of the Scatter Alliance, I and Fellow Daoist Xi will find a way to stop them," Ni Mu's reply was the most straightforward.
No sooner had everyone finished communicating through transmitted voice than the Black Armored Demon General took the initiative. With a wave of his hand, a dark light wrapped in rolling Demonic Qi struck towards Yuan Ming with the speed of lightning.
He harbored the greatest hatred for the one who had started the attack on him.
Yuan Ming had anticipated the sudden attack from the Black Armored Demon General and waved his hand in response, his sleeve billowing out to meet the dark light with a burst of blue radiance.
There was a loud 'bang.'
The blue light suddenly exploded while the dark light continued undiminished, bearing down on Yuan Ming.
"Be careful, the Demonic Qi from the Evil King Mirror is extraordinary. Do not come into direct contact with it," at this moment, Qi Ye's warning suddenly resounded in Yuan Ming's mind.
Yuan Ming, already mindful of this, immediately took out his Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear and slashed through the dark light with several Spear Shadows.
The clash between the two was like the sounding of the horn for battle, triggering an immediate onset of the great war, with the rest quickly springing into action.
Jin Chao's body erupted in Golden Flames, sending waves of scorching heat as he lunged towards the Green-clothed man, who, fearless, lit up in a green glow and charged back in retaliation.
Both moved so swiftly they left only a golden trail and a green streak behind before crashing into each other with a thunderous explosion, sending out a titanic shockwave in all directions.
In the midst of the rolling shockwaves, neither party dispersed. Instead, they engaged in a fierce battle, morphing into intertwining streaks of green and gold light that shot up into the sky.
Golden Cloud Fairy spared only a glance before charging at the Silver Kong Tree Demon, clashing in another corner of the battlefield.
A Blood Shadow emerged from nowhere, revealing itself to be Elder San Jue. He took a swig from his wine gourd and spit a mouthful at the Black Robed Elder and the members of the Scatter Alliance, instantly turning the liquid into a surging mist.
The Scatter Alliance members hastily retreated, quickly escaping beyond the reach of the mist.
Bing Li, just a moment slower, immediately felt dizzy and congested in her chest, with the urge to vomit rising in her throat.
It was then that a fierce cry rang out beside her, "Watch out..."
Bing Li tensed up and quickly conjured her Wind Snow Sword, but before she could deploy her Divine Skills, she saw a huge figure charging towards her. A massive white paw struck down at her face, belonging to none other than Guoguo.
"Rise."
She barely managed to utter a hurried shout before an Ice Crystal shield formed in front of her was shattered by the colossal paw, and she was sent flying backward by the force of the blow.
In that brief moment, the Blood Realm Venerable waved his hand, and a giant blood-colored dragon opened its maw and charged at Guoguo.
However, before it could reach Guoguo, a golden figure already burst forth, a fist surrounded by a golden halo struck out fiercely and flung the Blood Dragon away.Catch the formatted version at *.
"Sorry about this, everyone," Ni Mu spoke in a low voice as he stepped forward with the Tongchen Puppet.
Yuan Wuji's expression turned ugly, and the Blood God's Son, turning into a silhouette, pounced towards Ni Mu.
Nearby, Lan Xiao rushed to Bing Li's side, who had been struck down and hadn't gotten up in a while. She was about to help her up when she realized that Bing Li's eyes were rolled back, and she had fainted.
Lan Xiao examined her quickly and frowned, while protecting Bing Li, he began to use his venomous insects to harass Guoguo and Ni Mu.
Meanwhile, the Black Robed Elder remained completely unaffected by Elder San Jue's alcohol breath. Instead, he spoke scornfully:
"You should stick to Artifact Refining or to practicing the sword. Not only do you mix the two, but you also divide your attention to brew wine and call yourself 'San Jue'... Haha, how ridiculous!"
A subtle killing intent briefly flashed across Elder San Jue's wooden face, as he waved his hand and a circular Sword Array appeared behind him.
The next moment, hundreds and thousands of Flying Swords vibrated, their reverberation merging into a resonant dragon's chant that surged towards the Black Robed Elder like a torrent.
Undaunted, the Black Robed Elder reached forward with both hands, instantly weaving countless black branches across the void, rapidly forming a vast black net.
The arrangement of the net's branches was meticulous, clearly not a haphazard construct.
As the Flying Swords charged in, the black net descended, ensnaring all within, creating a Sword Cage that trapped the blades.
The many Flying Swords, trapped within, continued their sharp ringing. Sword Qi shot out in all directions, pounding against their prison, yet they were tightly held by the dark green-glowing Sword Cage, unable to break free.
A little further off, Yuan Ming's Soul Destroying Sword slashed out once more, with Curse Rune glimmers releasing a powerful Curse Power that aimed to envelop the Black Armored Demon General.
The latter seemed to sense the power of the Curse Rune and grabbed, conjuring a Black Horse-Slaying Saber in his palm. Gripping it with both hands, he hacked at the sword shadows Yuan Ming had sent his way.
The Black Sword Qi was shattered, and the Curse Power from the Soul Destroying Sword was also torn apart by the Black Horse-Slaying Saber.
Yuan Ming's face showed surprise as his Curse Rune was broken for the first time.

chapters.title: Chapter 624 - 597 Defeated in One Fell Swoop
chapters.content:
"I noticed earlier that your sword was quite remarkable, I didn't expect it to also be a Magic Treasure endowed with Curse Power," the Black Armored Demon General's eyes flashed with greed as he swung his blade in another slash.
The black Horse-Slaying Saber in his hand was also wrapped with intense Curse Power. Although it was not as intricate as the soul runes on the Soul Destroying Sword, it was significantly denser.
Yuan Ming wasted no words as he maneuvered the Soul Destroying Sword and the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear to meet the attack, tangling with the black Horse-Slaying Saber.
In addition to the Curse Power, the black Horse-Slaying Saber was shrouded with a peculiar force of corruption.
The Soul Destroying Sword, forged from Nine Nether Iron, was unafraid of the corrupting force, but the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear struggled to resist, its spirit light dimming and signs of corrosion and decay appearing on its body.
"Break for me!" cackled the Black Armored Demon General as the Horse-Slaying Saber suddenly blurred, sending down a flurry of chilling black saber lights, viciously striking towards the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear.
Meanwhile, inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod, Yuan Ming's first soul sat upright on the White Jade Lotus Platform.
His main soul had long broken through the Sleep Witch Realm, and under its guidance, his first soul had also broken past bottlenecks over the years, smoothly advancing through the Sleep Witch Realm. With the aid of the White Jade Lotus Platform, its Soul Power swelled to the verge of a Half-step Spoken Witch's level.
The Night Parade of Hundred Demons floated above the first soul's head, spinning round and round. Runes from the All Living Beings Dream shot out, landing on the first soul, blending into it.
In the next instant, the first soul's eyes abruptly snapped open, a surge of potent Soul Power welled up without spreading indiscriminately, instead it shot through the Stealing Heaven Tripod, directly targeting the Black Armored Demon General transformed from the Evil King Mirror.
The Black Armored Demon General's body suddenly trembled, Yuan Ming's figure reflected in his eyes. His expression fell into a daze, succumbing to an illusion. The black saber lights from the Horse-Slaying Saber also retracted.
Yuan Ming flicked his fingers and the Soul Destroying Sword transformed into a streak of black light, slashing toward the Black Armored Demon General's head.
The Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear turned into a burst of purple shadow with an explosive aura, thrusting toward the Black Armored Demon General's chest.
However, a burst of black Qi suddenly erupted from within the Black Armored Demon General; it was the Demonic Qi formed by the Undead Tree Demon's power.
The Black Armored Demon General's eyes instantly cleared, the stiffness in his body faded, and he dodged the assault of the Sword Qi Spear with a light step, forming a strange spell with one hand.
A surge of demonic Qi gushed from the Heart Protector above his chest, shooting a stream of dark light straight at Yuan Ming. Midway, it turned into a massive black skull.
The skull was as large as a house, flickering inside with numerous phantom faces bearing expressions of terror, anger, resentment, and other twisted emotions, enough to crawl one's skin.
"Be careful, that's the Evil King Skull Seal! Don't let it bite you; otherwise, the Curse Power within, and the huge negative emotions, will infuse into your body, driving you to madness if not death!" Qi Ye's voice sounded.
Yuan Ming's heart chilled, and he summoned all his Mana and Soul Power, channeling them into the Soul Destroying Sword and Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear.
Inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod, the first soul also channeled Soul Power into the two Magic Treasures.
Boom, boom!
The Soul Destroying Sword and Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear suddenly went berserk, transforming into one black and one purple dragon, fiercely striking the black skull.
There was a deafening explosion, the black skull burst apart, but the Soul Destroying Sword and Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear were also repelled.
Despite the cushioning from the two Magic Treasures, two streams of terrifying Curse Power, as well as negative emotions, still passed into Yuan Ming's body. His eyes flashed with pain, but he immediately pushed it down and then reached out with both hands into the void.
Countless white mists poured out and in an instant engulfed an area tens of yards around them, obscuring everyone's vision. It was the White Mist Restriction from within the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space that could isolate Divine Sense.
At the same time, his body spun, his figure radiating dark light and his limbs transforming into tree trunks; he had taken on the peculiar form of a black giant tree.
"What is this..." The Black Armored Demon General expressed his shock upon witnessing this transformation.
The next moment, without another word, he turned and fled into the distance.
The black giant tree emitted a light snort as hundreds of black roots sprung out, all burrowing into the void.
Ripples appeared in the near space around the Black Armored Demon General, as hundreds of black roots emerged from all directions, entwining around the Black Armored Demon General, leaving no room to dodge.
Branches and tendrils of the Undying Tree also stretched over, rapidly enveloping the Black Armored Demon General into a mummy-like bundle.
Yuan Ming, channeling Divine Sense into the Stealing Heaven Tripod, made the black giant tree shimmy back into the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space, dragging the Black Armored Demon General with it.
"Where is this place?" Inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod was also shrouded in white mist, similar to the outside situation, but the Black Armored Demon General still keenly sensed a change in environment.
His eyes shifting rapidly, he suddenly coughed up Essence Blood, infusing it into the Heart Protector at his chest.MyVirtualLibraryEmpire(MVLEMPYR)appreciatesyourreadershipatthesource.
Instantly, a sky-high demonic light burst forth, and dozens of black skulls shot out, all embodying the Evil King Skull Seal, struggling within the light and emitting agonizing howls.
Those sounds seemed to penetrate one's Divine Soul, filling the entire Stealing Heaven Tripod Space with all sorts of chaotic negative emotions in an instant.
Yuan Ming's face showed a pained expression, his mind wavering, unable to remain steady.
Queen Ming Kong and others in the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space, having their Nascent Souls affected by the sound, were suddenly unstable, showing signs of collapse.
Sensing this, Yuan Ming hurriedly formed a spell and pointed out.
The vast Soul Power of the first soul spread out, the surrounding White Mist Restriction rolling and seething, dampening much of the howling, reducing the Nascent Souls' agony.
Yuan Ming immediately pulled the Black Armored Demon General's body and blinked to the vicinity of the Sword Trace Abyss.

chapters.title: Chapter 625 - 597: A Crushing Blow_2
chapters.content:
The Black Armored Demon General sensed the aura of the Sword Trace Abyss, his face showing panic, and his feet turned into a wooden form, sprouting numerous roots that penetrated the void. No matter how Yuan Ming pulled, he couldn't move him an inch.
Yuan Ming's face showed urgency, and out of the corner of his eye, he suddenly caught sight of the Exterminating Immortal Sword hanging above the Sword Trace Abyss.
His gaze shifted, and three roots immediately pierced through the void, appearing above the Exterminating Immortal Sword and reaching for the hilt.
The first root had just approached when it was wrapped in Sword Qi that surged upwards, snapping it apart. However, the other two roots took advantage of the situation to wrap around the hilt and sharply pulled back, dragging the Exterminating Immortal Sword into the void and instantly bringing it beside Yuan Ming.
A black light flashed on Yuan Ming's body as he returned to human form, grasped the Exterminating Immortal Sword, and slashed at the Black Armored Demon General.
A piercing sword cry echoed around, and a massive green Sword Qi soared into the sky, as if to puncture a hole in the void itself, shaking the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space.
The green Sword Qi cleaved the body of the Black Armored Demon General, splitting him in two as if slicing tofu.
The two halves of the Black Armored Demon General uncontrollably fell backward, plummeting straight into the Sword Trace Rift.
"No..." the Black Armored Demon General screamed in panic.
As his body just started to fall above the Sword Trace Rift, the surging mist swallowed him.
Accompanied by a series of "crackling" sounds, like shedding armor, the Black Armored Demon General's body fell apart, turning into countless pieces that sank into the abyss.
Suddenly, a mass of black light exploded, and a black shadow was thrown out of the mist, landing on the ground.
Yuan Ming fixed his eyes and saw a Black Magic Mirror rolling to his feet, a fine crack clearly visible on its surface.
Yuan Ming waved his hand to collect the Black Magic Mirror, immersed his Divine Sense into it, and after a careful investigation, he detected the aura of the Black Armored Demon General inside. However, the aura seemed abnormal, as if it had fallen into a deep sleep.
With no time to investigate thoroughly, he simply placed a Sealing Talisman on the mirror surface and stored it away.
Afterwards, he stepped outside the Stealing Heaven Tripod, and the swirling white mist also dissipated.
The Black Robed Elder had just noticed both the Black Armored Demon General and Yuan Ming enveloped in the swirling white mist. Now, seeing Yuan Ming emerge without a trace of the Black Armored Demon General, he immediately realized something was amiss.
"To brag so boldly, yet to be defeated in mere moments, what a fool capable only of ruining matters!" He cursed inwardly, activating the Star Map on the Great Wilderness Star River Pearl in his hand.
As soon as he noticed the disappearance of the Black Armored Demon General's aura, he was simultaneously dealing with Elder San Jue and secretly activating the Great Wilderness Star River Pearl.
A fully activated Great Wilderness Star River Pearl could break open the void, but even when half of the star map was lit, it also had the ability to teleport long distances.
Many star patterns quickly lit up, reaching halfway, and the Black Robed Elder instantly tapped on the Great Wilderness Star River Pearl.
Dazzling starlight shone from the silver Treasure Bead, surrounding him with a halo of brilliant light and transforming into a silver beam that shot off into the distance, leaving a clear white trail in the void.
At that moment, an arrow burning with golden flames suddenly pierced through the air and directly struck the silver beam.
Hou Yi's Sun Shooting Bow had unknowingly arrived nearby, its bow body radiating intense golden light.
With a loud "boom," an explosion echoed!
The silver light burst instantly, transforming into countless scattered stars, and the Black Robed Elder plummeted from the sky, a large hole torn open in his chest.
Yuan Ming glanced at Hou Yi's Sun Shooting Bow, then suddenly slammed down with the Thunder God Hammer and the God Bombarding Cone, as a thunderbolt pillar thick as a water barrel fell from the sky, striking the Black Robed Elder.
The Black Robed Elder, already injured by Hou Yi's Sun Shooting Bow, was just trying to get up when the thunderbolt pillar hit him, causing him to arch his body and remain unable to straighten up for a long moment.
Immediately following, a loud sound of a sword's cry came.
In the void, Elder San Jue pinched his fingers together and waved downwards, multi-layered sword lights and shadows converging together, forming a giant sword edge shining with white light, slicing open the thunderbolt pillar that suppressed the Black Robed Elder and heavily striking his body.
Read ahead and get updates at *.
A loud "boom" resounded as countless sword lights and shadows exploded apart.
Within the space surrounding the Black Robed Elder, a brief distortion appeared, with numerous sword lights crisscrossing and cutting through, the sharp Sword Qi continuously penetrating, causing him to let out a series of painful screams.
By the time the sword lights extinguished, the Black Robed Elder's body was already broken and battered, severely wounded.
It was then that Wulu Huazhi and the others, who had just arrived, witnessed this spectacular scene, all of them gasping in astonishment.
As a clone of the Undying Tree, his powerful life force allowed him to survive such severe injuries, and even his shattered body resisted the Sword Qi erosion, continuously repairing itself.
However, Yuan Ming would not give him any more chances. He flashed beside him, pressed a finger on his forehead.
A surge of powerful Soul Power was injected, while the All Living Beings Dream Rune also flew out, entering his Sea of Consciousness.
The Black Robed Elder's body stiffened immediately, trapped within an illusion.
Yuan Ming then grabbed the Black Robed Elder, taking him into the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space, intending to refine him later.
Afterwards, he turned to look at the silver Treasure Bead that had fallen to the ground, just as he was about to pick it up, it was suddenly enveloped by a red-golden light and flew towards a direction.
Yuan Ming's brows furrowed slightly as he looked in the direction of the light trail, only to see the silver Treasure Bead settle near Hou Yi's Sun Shooting Bow, then vanish after a flash in the void.
Clearly, the Great Wilderness Star River Pearl had been summoned back by Hou Yi's Sun Shooting Bow through some secret technique.
Seeing the Black Armored Demon General and the Black Robed Elder defeated in succession, and the Great Wilderness Star River Pearl snatched away, Yuan Wuji, who was fighting Ni Mu, twitched the corners of his eyes fiercely and sent a message to the others, shouting, "Leave!"
The faces of the Blood Realm Venerables also mirrored extreme dissatisfaction, following closely behind Yuan Wuji, they fled into the distance.
Ni Mu's expression shifted slightly, he did not pursue, letting the four of them leave.
Meanwhile, the Silver Kong Tree Demon, under the combined attack of "Guoguo" and the Golden Cloud Fairy, was already overwhelmed, completely at a disadvantage. Seeing the situation, he dared not hesitate any longer, employed his Innate Divine Ability, and escaped into the void.
However, a powerful Divine Soul swept past, pursuing into the void.
The Silver Kong Tree Demon's vision blurred, as he fell out of the void.
Almost simultaneously, a flame of gold and white shot towards him, it was the Golden Crow True Fire from the Golden Cloud Fairy, striking the Silver Kong Tree Demon.
The Silver Kong Tree Demon screamed as he plummeted down.
Below, Guoguo had already been waiting, Xi Ying's Divine Soul radiated from her body, transforming into a luminous Three-legged Golden Crow, and crashed into the Sea of Consciousness of the Silver Kong Tree Demon.
The Silver Kong Tree Demon's Divine Soul trembled violently, losing control over his own body instantly.

chapters.title: Chapter 626 - 598: Blood Demon Ancestor
chapters.content:
The situation took a sharp turn for the worse, and the complexion of the green-clothed man in the sky abruptly darkened as he spat out.
A fierce wind suddenly arose from the nearby void, howling loudly!
A massive green storm burst out, reaching up to the heavens and down to the ground, mixed with countless Wind Blades that emerged in the wind, flickering in and out of sight, and pounced toward Jin Chao.
Jin Chao's expression changed slightly, and he retreated with a flash, waving his hands and sending out two dazzling beams of golden light, which intersected and slashed at the green storm above.
