The sky-covering green storm suddenly dissipated, vanishing as if it were a flower in a mirror or the moon's reflection on the water, leaving Jin Chao dumbfounded.
The green-clothed man took the opportunity to blur his figure and withdraw from the engagement with Jin Chao, retreating dozens of yards away.
"Since the Undying Tree and Evil King Mirror have already been suppressed, there's no deep hatred between you and me, there's no need to pursue a vendetta to the bitter end, right?" said the green-clothed man.
"Everybody has to pay a little price for their own mistakes, don't they?" Jin Chao scoffed coldly.
"Then let's see if you have the ability to make me pay that price," the green-clothed man sneered in response.
As his voice fell, the green light on his body surged, and his body suddenly swelled and enlarged, revealing his monstrous true form as an immense green giant bird.
With a flap of its wings, countless violent hurricanes rose around it, stirring the surrounding void into chaos and keeping Jin Chao at bay.
"Fellows, the journey is long and arduous, we shall meet again!" said the green giant bird in human language, its voice deep and resonant, echoing through the skies above Guanghan City.
One of its huge and sharp claws violently swiped at the white mark left by the Great Wilderness Star River Pearl.
A piercingly sharp Space Power exuded from its claw, shredding the already chaotic void airflow inch by inch, and tearing the space open under this force, revealing a crack about a yard long.
The body of the green giant bird quickly shrank and turned into a streak of green light that shot into the spatial crack, disappearing from sight.
Jin Chao appeared in front of the spatial crack with a flash but did not pursue.
With a trace of Space Divine Power in the Kunpeng bloodline, it could survive in Void Turbulence, not something Jin Chao possessed.
…
Elsewhere, while everyone was distracted by the green-clothed man, Yuan Wuji and the others sped away, rapidly approaching their escape from this dire situation.
But just then, accompanied by a flash of blood-colored light, Luo Qi abruptly appeared in front of the four.
"After all the effort it took to get here, why the rush to leave?"
"Get out of the way!" Yuan Wuji did not stop moving, his arm flicked.
A whip-like blood-colored blade light fell down, aiming for Luo Qi's head, with a bloodthirsty aura filling an area of several dozen meters.
Luo Qi didn't dodge, slightly moving his arm.
A purple bell appeared in front of him and with a gentle shake, a purple halo, along with the crisp sound of the bell, swiftly swept over Yuan Wuji and the others.
In an instant, Yuan Wuji and the others' bodies stiffened, feeling as if the Blood Puppet Armor on their skin had come to life, continuously contracting inward and bonding with their flesh. Where it touched their skin, they experienced a burning pain. Upon scanning with their Divine Sense, they realized that the exterior of the armor was peeling their skin and embedding deep within their flesh.
The blood-colored blade light abruptly stopped, and in the next moment, it exploded violently.
At the same time, Wulu somehow appeared behind Yuan Wuji and the four, raising a hand and producing a Blood-colored Jade from which three figures wrapped in red light emerged – Xue Jiao, Tu Sheng, and Zhong Ling.
Yuan Ming noticed the commotion and looked over, his face revealing a look of surprise.
However, when Xue Jiao and the others appeared, their faces showed no shock. They immediately scattered and raised the Black and White Command Flags, beginning to cast.
At this time, Luo Qi waved his sleeve, sending out the Daluo Chessboard which burst forth with dazzling Black and White Spiritual Light.
"Formation start!"
Following Luo Qi's shout, the Daluo Chessboard erupted, the Black and White Spiritual Lights intertwined and created a phantom chessboard hundreds of yards large in mid-air, trapping Yuan Wuji and the others within it.
Black and White Spiritual Light swirled around the four, freezing the void as if it was solidified, immobilizing their limbs and rendering both their Mana and Divine Soul Power motionless.
"Luo Qi, you ungrateful wretch, don't forget who helped you enter the Time Cave!" Blood Realm Venerable roared upon witnessing this scene.
Yuan Wuji also wore a glum expression: "Blood Realm is right, Luo Qi. We have no past grudges, and even though we've been enemies just now, it was only to win the chance to travel overseas. Now that the Black Armored Demon is dead, we don't need to continue fighting, and you haven't been harmed by us, so why stop us?"
"Heh, Fellow Daoist Yuan, you've been longing to go overseas, and now that you've finally had the chance, it's ruined by us. If we let you leave, who knows if you'll harbor resentment. Besides, I have some questions I'd like to ask Fellow Daoist Yuan, so I had to stop you," Luo Qi said with a slight smile.
Yuan Wuji frowned, "What do you want to ask?"
"Simple, I want all the intelligence Fellow Daoist Yuan has about the Blood Puppet Armor," Luo Qi's smile grew wider.
Hearing this, Yuan Wuji thoughtfully glanced at Wulu, who remained unfazed and didn't even lift his head.
"How about it, for Fellow Daoist Yuan, this request shouldn't be too much, right?" Luo Qi called back Yuan Wuji's attention.
"I can give you the intelligence, but how can you ensure you won't turn on me after obtaining it?" Yuan Wuji asked.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, you should know that the choice is not in your hands right now," Luo Qi said with a shake of his head.
Yuan Wuji's expression darkened further, and he glanced at Yuan Ming and the others who were flying towards him. Suddenly, he sighed and raised his hand to produce a Jade Scroll.
"Fine, the information you want is here, catch."
With that, he flicked his finger, and the Jade Scroll instantly transformed into a streak of light that flew toward Luo Qi.
Seeing this, Luo Qi suddenly formed a spell, and the shadow of the Compass that trapped Yuan Wuji and the others shifted, making way for the Jade Scroll.Brоught tо yоu by thе fоlks аt МV|LЕМРYR.
But at that moment, the voice of the Blood Shadow suddenly rang in Yuan Ming's ear.
"This isn't right, this is the Blood Scroll Technique from the Blood Transformation Technique, you must not let him touch the Jade Scroll!"
Yuan Ming's mind raced, and he immediately called out a warning, "Island Master Luo, there's something wrong with the Jade Scroll!"
Luo Qi was startled, and his spell hand signs changed rapidly. The light from the Chessboard flared up, and two pieces of white chess pieces emerged from nowhere, hurtling towards the Jade Scroll. They collided with it amid a clang like that of metal against stone, causing the surrounding air to tremble violently.
Just as the chess pieces touched the Jade Scroll, a blinding Blood Light suddenly exploded, accompanied by countless wailing souls. It turned into a Blood Shadow, emitting a pungent smell of blood, easily penetrating the two white chess pieces and rushing at Luo Qi.
Luo Qi didn't panic in the slightest and quickly shifted his spell.
The Chessboard illusion flashed, and two black chess pieces appeared out of thin air.
Unlike the white pieces, the black pieces conveyed a sense of illusion as if they were not solid, meeting the Blood Shadow head-on.
Wretched screams filled the air as the Blood Shadow was knocked backward, its form dissolving, and the filthy Blood Light also scattered.
Yuan Ming, witnessing this, managed to glimpse some of the mysteries of the Daluo Chessboard.
This Chessboard illusion's main purpose is to trap, while the black and white chess pieces are meant to kill. The white piece is solid, the black piece is void; their attacks have different focuses.
"Since you refuse to see reason, don't blame me for being ruthless!" Luo Qi waved his arm, and black and white chess pieces appeared out of thin air and struck towards Yuan Wuji and the others. The menacing force even made the group show fear.
However, faced with this situation, Yuan Wuji suddenly smiled.
"Enough, enough. Having raised them for so long, it's time to reap the harvest."
No sooner had his words fallen than the Blood Puppet Armor on Yuan Wuji's body began to squirm. Four tendrils as thick as a grown man's thigh shot out, not targeting the white chess pieces, but rather impaled the bodies of the three Blood Realm Venerables.
The Blood Realm Venerables did not expect Yuan Wuji to turn on them and hadn't even thought to defend themselves. They were both shocked and angry, looking at Yuan Wuji in disbelief.
"Big brother, why…" Lan Xiao coughed up a mouthful of blood.
Yuan Wuji's smile faded, yet he didn't turn back, "If you have to blame someone, blame Luo Qi. Otherwise, I wouldn't have had to move against you so soon. I really detest doing this!"
After speaking, the three Blood tendrils on his back writhed together, completely piercing through the bodies of the three Blood Realm Venerables.
The black and white chess pieces arrived with a crash, colliding at one spot, with the gust sweeping out, even reaching those outside the illusion of the Chessboard.
However, when everyone looked toward the chess pieces, Yuan Wuji's figure was nowhere to be seen.
"He's up there!" Yuan Ming spoke up.
Everyone looked up and saw that Yuan Wuji had somehow broken free from the Chessboard and was suspended in mid-air.
Yuan Wuji's appearance had greatly changed, his body enshrouded in surging Blood Light that condensed into a long silk robe draped over his shoulders. His face was also covered in Blood Light, revealing new facial features, and his aura climbed steadily until it unexpectedly broke through the Nascent Soul boundary and reached the Returning to Void Realm.
"Senior brother?" a shocked exclamation came from within the Shura Blood Devouring Map.
Yuan Ming's gaze sharpened as he examined Yuan Wuji's current appearance.
Now much younger-looking, he seemed as if he were a man in his early thirties. Long hair cascaded over his shoulders, his Phoenix Eyes expressed neither joy nor sorrow, and a small blood-red mole at the corner of his eye added a touch of rakish charm.
Luo Qi's pupils shrank as he was shocked by Yuan Wuji's transformation, "You're not Yuan Wuji! Who on earth are you?"
"Yuan Wuji? He was nothing more than my Puppet," the Blood Demon Ancestor scoffed.
At these words, Luo Qi furrowed his brow as if he had not heard of the name Blood Demon Ancestor, but inside the Shura Blood Devouring Map, the Blood Shadow was extremely excited.
"Is it really Senior Brother? He has actually achieved Returning to Void? Hahaha, Master was right, Senior Brother is indeed a prodigy of heaven, destined to bring great prosperity to the Blood Transformation Sect!"
Hearing this response, Yuan Ming felt a stir in his heart as his mind raced.
The Blood Shadow and the Shura Master were from the same era, and the person he referred to as senior brother would naturally be from that era as well. While the Six Desires Venerable had lived so long by relying on Soul Cultivation Divine Power, how had the Blood Demon Ancestor survived until now? What method had he used?

chapters.title: Chapter 627 - 599 Fellow Daoist, Please Wait
chapters.content:
"I once heard that, over three thousand years ago, there was a first-level island named Blood Transformation Island that gave birth to two Late-stage Nascent Soul cultivators. Its power surged drastically, even surpassing Fusang Island to dominate the East Sea. Its influence covered several first-level islands and ultimately proclaimed itself as the Blood Transformation Sect, rather than Blood Transformation Island," Ni Mu said while looking at the Blood Demon Ancestor in the sky.
"Heh, indeed! Back then, the fame of my Blood Transformation Sect was known throughout the East Sea; who didn't know, who hadn't heard? I just regret that my foolish junior brother attracted the great enemy, Shura Master, to our sect. Otherwise, why would our sect have disappeared from the East Sea, unable to rise again to this day?" The Blood Demon Ancestor looked up and laughed bitterly.
"That's not right. If what you say is true, that you did not dare to rebuild the Blood Transformation Sect while Shura Master was alive, and considering Shura Master has perished for three thousand years now, you, as one Returning Void, why haven't you thought of rebuilding the Blood Transformation Sect these three thousand years?" Luo Qi shook his head and asked.
"You think I didn't want to? When I fought Shura Master back then, I barely escaped with my life, but my physical body was nearly destroyed. I had no choice but to use a secret technique to merge my Divine Soul with the Blood Puppet Armor, thus barely surviving within the armor," the Blood Demon Ancestor said candidly.
"And what about Yuan Wuji? How did the Blood Realm Venerables die? You being alive today must be because you've devoured who knows how many people's lives. You disseminating the inheritance of the Blood Transformation Sect is probably to have those who wear the Blood Puppet Armor ready as vessels for your descent to this world at any time!" Luo Qi continued.
"So what if it is? Over three thousand years, how many sects have risen and fallen, all like fleeting clouds! As long as I, the ancestor, am alive, our Blood Transformation Sect's inheritance will never break. And I only absorb the Qi-Blood of the chosen new Sect Leaders and their subordinates when they are on the brink of death. If it weren't for your aggressive pursuit today, why would I have even shown myself?" The Blood Demon Ancestor sneered defiantly.
In the Shura Blood Devouring Map, the Blood Shadow, upon hearing this conversation, fell silent. After a moment, a lengthy, lamenting sigh faintly drifted out.
"You say it's for the sake of the sect's inheritance, but in the end, isn't it just for your own immortality? The Blood Transformation Sect hasn't been rebuilt in three thousand years. Isn't it because each sect leader has been devoured by you as Blood Food? Island Master Luo, stop listening to his nonsense. He's just delaying to refine the Mana of the Blood Realm Venerable and others!" Yuan Ming pointed out sharply.
"Regardless, today there must be a conclusion!" Luo Qi spoke, while he spurt a mouthful of Essence Blood onto the Daluo Chessboard, then waved a spell toward the chessboard.
The chessboard phantom in the air suddenly swelled again, a series of black and white spiritual lights crisscrossing and once more ensnaring the Blood Demon Ancestor's figure.
Simultaneously, from the center of the Daluo Chessboard below, a white chess piece flew out and swiftly grew to over thirty feet in size, instantly exploding into thousands of white chess rains, blanketing the sky and striking toward the Blood Demon Ancestor.
Unexpectedly, the Blood Demon Ancestor suddenly burst into laughter, the Blood Light in his palm condensed into a long blade, and with a slight slash, waves of blade glow swept out, appearing like a vast bloody curtain that dyed the sky a filthy red.
The next instant, as the white chess pieces swarmed in, the sound of gold and iron clashing resounded.
Hundreds of white chess pieces easily turned the blade glow slashed by the Blood Demon Ancestor into a sieve but were also tainted by the corrupt blood qi contained in the blade glow, losing their spirituality and falling one after another.
Seeing this, Luo Qi immediately pointed, and another large wave of black chess pieces abruptly appeared, blanketing the sky as they struck toward the Blood Demon Ancestor.
Facing these black pieces that could harm the Divine Soul, the Blood Demon Ancestor seemed especially wary, quickly retracting the blade and, with a flicker of his form, transformed into countless Blood Shadows, chaotically flying around within the phantom of the chessboard, trying to dodge the crisscrossing black and white spiritual lights and leave the range of the Great Array.
Luo Qi immediately controlled the black pieces to split into several waves to pursue, but couldn't keep up with the speed of the Blood Shadows.
"Fellow Daoists, take these black and white pieces and enter the formation, lend me your strength, we cannot let him escape!" Luo Qi shouted, simultaneously flicking his right hand, scattering several pairs of black and white chess pieces, flying toward Yuan Ming and others.
Yuan Ming caught the black and white chess pieces with both hands and immediately activated them; then, a layer of black and white spiritual light enveloped him as he rushed into the phantom of the chessboard.
Ni Mu also caught the black and white chess pieces but hesitated for a moment; however, soon he made up his mind, flipping his hand to take out three palm-sized glazed bottles, opening the stoppers, and releasing a person from each—it was the striking female cultivator always by Ni Mu's side, as well as Ancestor Ming Quan and Qiong Hai Island Master.
The moment they appeared and saw the situation around them, they were greatly shocked, but before they could ask anything, they saw Ni Mu's lips move slightly, apparently transmitting a message to them.
Very quickly, the attractive female cultivator nodded and actively plucked a pair of black and white chess pieces from the air.
Ming Quan and the other's expressions changed for a while, but eventually, they also gritted their teeth and plucked the black and white chess pieces.
Just then, another person flew down, stopping next to Ni Mu.
"Elder brother," the man greeted Ni Mu with a bow.
Your support at * keeps the series going.
Seeing it was Wu Yuezhi, Ni Mu nodded, "You've come at the right time, follow me into the array to eradicate the Blood Demon Ancestor."
Wu Yuezhi silently nodded, about to take the black and white chess pieces, but as he looked up, his eyes met Luo Qi's.
In an instant, Luo Qi's eyes flickered with surprise, confusion, and anger, while Wu Yuezhi said nothing, simply lowering his head and slipping behind Ni Mu.
Luo Qi frowned, his lips moved slightly, but ultimately he said nothing more.
As Ni Mu and others charged into the formation, the Blood Shadows created by the Blood Demon Ancestor were successively chased down and annihilated, leaving less than fifty in number. Yet, his original body still had not appeared, and it was unknown within which Blood Shadow he was hiding.
"Blood Shadow, what is this move, and how can it be countered?" Yuan Ming silently asked in his mind while he was chasing the Blood Demon Ancestor.
However, the Blood Shadow within the Shura Blood Devouring Map remained silent without any response.
Yuan Ming frowned secretly, but he also knew that Blood Shadow was not intentionally disobeying; rather, it might have been dispirited by something the Blood Demon Ancestor had said.
At that moment, he had no time to persuade, so he could only sigh and guess the Blood Demon Ancestor's intentions on his own.
Now that Yuan Ming and the others had entered the Formation, even if the Blood Demon Ancestor could avoid them, he would eventually have to face their siege. Conjuring the Blood Shadow was just a temporary measure, and he was probably looking for a way to escape.
Suddenly, Yuan Ming thought of something, looked up abruptly, and called out to Wulu, "No, Wulu, be careful of the Blood Puppet Armor!"
The moment he spoke, he saw Wulu's body stiffen, his hands uncontrollably seizing the chess piece floating in front of him. A large amount of murky blood qi emerged on the Blood Puppet Armor, contaminating and corroding the chess piece.
In the phantom of the chessboard, a white chess piece suddenly froze, then shattered into spirit light and dispersed, and the phantom of the chessboard also seemed to be affected, shaking violently and revealing three small cracks.
Luo Qi was startled and quickly started casting spells to repair the cracks, but just then, a streak of Blood Light appeared next to the crack. The prepared Blood Demon Ancestor didn't wait for Luo Qi to mend the Formation and instantly burst out of the Formation, flying to Wulu's side.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming immediately locked onto the original body of the Blood Demon Ancestor with his Divine Sense and recklessly flew towards him.
The Blood Demon Ancestor still wanted to say something, but seeing Yuan Ming's aggressive approach, he hesitated and quickly swept up Wulu with his sleeve before turning into a streak of Blood Light and fleeing towards the horizon.
Yuan Ming was certainly not willing to let him go; he pursued relentlessly while taking out the Thunder God Hammer and the God Bombarding Cone to try to stop the Blood Demon Ancestor.
But right then, a space crack suddenly appeared next to the Blood Demon Ancestor.
The Blood Demon Ancestor quickly flashed into it, instantly disappearing without a trace.
Yuan Ming was both shocked and furious. He immediately smashed the Thunder God Hammer onto the God Bombarding Cone, sending dozens of bolts of thunder slicing down, but they couldn't stop the space crack from quickly closing and completely disappearing.
No one had expected this turn of events, and everyone's expressions turned gloomy.
Now, the Blood Demon Ancestor had fled into the space crack, his life and death unknown, and his whereabouts a mystery. It was clearly impossible to continue their siege on him for the time being.
Yuan Ming angrily glanced at the location where the space crack had appeared, but he also sighed deeply, put away his Magic Treasures, and flew back to the others.
Meanwhile, beside Ni Mu, Ancestor Ming Quan examined Yuan Ming's face with a slight frown, then suddenly took out a Jade Ring and quietly began to cast a spell.
Yuan Ming immediately sensed some fluctuations sweeping over his body, and his gaze fell on Ancestor Ming Quan, making him wary, thinking that the latter might take advantage of the chaos to attack. Although he didn't feel any War Intent emanating from him, he remained cautious.
However, the scene that unfolded next puzzled Yuan Ming.
In the center of the Jade Ring, a spirit light suddenly emerged, slightly quivering before splitting into two, one green and one purple. The green one was faint like a firefly, while the purple one was bright like a candle.
Ancestor Ming Quan, seeing this, was startled, seemingly unable to believe his own eyes, and activated the Jade Ring again, yet ended up with the same result.
While Yuan Ming was still puzzled, Ancestor Ming Quan hesitated for a moment, then suddenly flew towards him.
"Fellow Daoist, please hold. May I ask if your surname is Yuan?" he asked, clasping his hands.
Yuan Ming was not in a good mood, so he did not show a pleasant expression, "What does it matter if it is or isn't?"
A hint of indignation flashed in Ancestor Ming Quan's eyes, but feeling the aura Yuan Ming was emitting at the moment, he did not react impulsively.
"I am Ming Quan of Chang Chun Temple. I once had an inferior disciple who offended a Fellow Daoist named Yuan Ming in Central Plains Da Jin and was killed by him in public. Seeing that you look similar to that Yuan Ming and both cultivate the Nine Elements Technique, I had to ask," Ancestor Ming Quan said cautiously.
He was polite, but Yuan Ming knew that Ancestor Ming Quan obviously recognized him and initially wanted to confront him. However, this behavior was merely due to his concern about Yuan Ming's strength.
"Fellow Daoist, it seems it's not just a simple question, is it? Taking out your Magic Treasure so early, are you planning to make a move against me?" Yuan Ming asked deliberately.

chapters.title: Chapter 628 - 600 Weighing Options
chapters.content:
Who would have thought that Ancestor Ming Quan's expression would turn solemn at this moment, "Fellow Daoist Yuan, I won't lie, this Magic Treasure was specifically brought from the Sect to detect whether someone has cultivated the Nine Elements Technique. Now, there are two spirit lights within the Jade Ring, indicating that you have two strands of the Nine Elements Technique essence on you, the green represents Nascent Soul, the purple represents Returning Void."
Yuan Ming frowned instantly, realizing the bad omen.
With his current strength, being exposed wasn't much of an issue, but if the people from Chang Chun Temple were to find out that he had turned their missing Returning Void Ancestor into a Blood Slave, they would never let the matter rest.
"Back then, the affair with Qu Jiang was due to my unworthy disciple acting rashly, attacking Fellow Daoist without authority. I do not wish to argue with you about this now. However, please explain the strand of Returning to Void Stage Nine Elements Technique essence that you possess," Ancestor Ming Quan said earnestly.
"The one who cultivated the Nine Elements Technique to the stage of Returning Void has already been refined into a Puppet by the Undead Tree Demon. He was even directed by the Tree Demon to attempt to ambush us. Fortunately, I managed to subdue him using a Secret Technique, narrowly escaping with my life," Yuan Ming said, no longer concealing the truth.
"Indeed, our temple has records that three thousand years ago, an Elder San Jue ventured alone into the Three Immortals Island, only to vanish without a trace. According to your words, the one you subdued might indeed be him, and since the Magic Treasure could detect him, Elder San Jue must still be alive! I request you to return him immediately, so that our Chang Chun Temple can welcome back the ancestor!" Ancestor Ming Quan's eyes brightened.
"Heh, he offended me and was subdued by me after substantial effort. Chang Chun Temple wants to claim him back just by virtue of its name? How could there be such a good deal in this world!" Yuan Ming sneered.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, this is not about pride. I am aware you have made significant efforts. Once I'm back at the temple, I will surely speak favorable words for you, and perhaps once Elder San Jue recovers, he might even reward you. Moreover, it's a time of chaos, with the Wu Yue Sect rising from the ashes and causing unrest throughout Yunhuang. Our temple, as well as the people of the land, urgently need a great power at the Returning Void Stage to take charge of the Central Plains to resist the strength of the Wu Yue Sect. If Elder San Jue could be awakened by our temple, he could stabilize the Central Plains," Ancestor Ming Quan shook his head, speaking with significance and profundity.
"Heh, if Chang Chun Temple truly cared for the world, why would you, as a Nascent Soul Ancestor, not fight against the Wu Yue Sect and instead come to the East Sea? Could it be that you foresaw the attack on Fusang Island? In the end, it's all for your self-interest! Always moralizing, always using righteousness as an excuse, why should I comply with Chang Chun Temple's righteousness? Is it impossible for Elder San Jue in my possession to fight the Wu Yue Sect? They say the Wu Yue Sect aims to unite Yunhuang, but I see no difference between Chang Chun Temple and them!" Yuan Ming scoffed disdainfully.
In response to those words, Ancestor Ming Quan's face grew dark. He considered making a desperate move and attacking Yuan Ming directly but refrained due to Yuan Ming's formidable strength.
He was hiding inside Ni Mu's Space Treasure, merely hearing the situation secondhand, and knew little about what went on within the Three Immortals Island. But Yuan Ming's bold challenge to the Blood Demon Ancestor, as well as the fact that Elder San Jue had been defeated by Yuan Ming's hand, all reminded him that Yuan Ming, although seemingly just a Nascent Soul Early Stage Cultivator, was not an easy opponent to deal with.
The current situation actually required him to be wary of himself, as if Yuan Ming were to attack fiercely and kill him, it was unlikely anyone else would take action, and the matter of Elder San Jue might never reach Chang Chun Temple's ears.
With this thought, although Ancestor Ming Quan harbored deep resentment, he ultimately retreated without saying another word.
As for Yuan Ming, he indeed had contemplated killing Ancestor Ming Quan. However, unless he never used Elder San Jue's powers or killed everyone who had seen Elder San Jue's abilities, Chang Chun Temple would inevitably hear of it.
Given his current strength, he did not fear Chang Chun Temple that much. Furthermore, he was well aware that Ni Mu had released Ming Quan. If a conflict arose, it was hard to say whether Ni Mu would intervene.
After weighing the pros and cons, killing Ancestor Ming Quan didn't seem to be particularly beneficial. Moreover, Ming Quan wasn't the Blood Demon Ancestor, and there was no risk of letting a tiger return to its mountain. Yuan Ming's attention quickly shifted away from Chang Chun Temple and Ancestor Ming Quan, turning instead to worry about Wulu's situation.
At the same time that Yuan Ming was in conflict with Ancestor Ming Quan, elsewhere, Luo Qi, seeing the Blood Demon Ancestor escaping, collected the Daluo Chessboard with considerable irritation. His gaze swept around and finally landed on Wu Yuezhi.
Wu Yuezhi seemed to know he couldn't avoid the situation, and his expression imperceptibly shifted, revealing a glimpse of tiredness and guilt.
He looked up at Luo Qi, pursed his lips, and eventually stepped out from beside Ni Mu, bowing to Luo Qi.
"Master."
With just two simple words, Luo Qi's face darkened instantly, "You still have the face to call me that!"
Ni Mu had been focusing on the confrontation between Ancestor Ming Quan and Yuan Ming, but hearing the noise here, he immediately turned his head to look at Luo Qi.
Luo Qi noticed his gaze and his expression grew even worse, "Ni Mu, I haven't settled the score with you for the past incident. What, do you want to fight with me now?"
"I've said it many times. It was not my doing that my brother stole the Heavenly Star Chessboard, and besides, can't you see even now? With the Three Immortals Island completely under the control of the Undead Tree Demon, he did that for..." Ni Mu began with a frown.
"Elder brother!"
Wu Yuezhi interrupted Ni Mu, "No need to say more, no matter what, I let down master in this matter."
Unexpectedly, Luo Qi shook his head, "You think I am not aware of these things? Yuezhi has been raised by me since he was little; I know his thoughts better than you do."
"Then why do you..." Now it was Ni Mu's turn to be somewhat astonished.
"Three Immortals Island is a dangerous place, and even though there might be opportunities, I never intended to let Yuezhi enter. According to my original plan, he should be overseeing Blood Swallow Island by now. That way, even if something were to happen to me this time, the foundation and lineage of Blood Swallow Island wouldn't be affected. However, ever since he got mixed up with you, learned about the dangers pervasive throughout Three Immortals Island, and that nearly all who set foot on the island perish, he's been fixated on stealing the Heavenly Star Chessboard. His goal was to thwart me from refining the Daluo Chessboard and to venture onto Three Immortals Island alone."
Luo Qi said this with a curl of his lips, looking towards Wu Yuezhi, "To complete the Daluo, one must start with the Heavenly Star. You think you've fathomed its mysteries, but did you really think the Luo family, with its longstanding aspirations, would only prepare the materials for one refinement? After our ancestors mastered the technique of refining the Heavenly Star Chessboard long ago, countless bases for the chessboard were made as backups. Even if one were stolen, as long as the remaining materials were replenished, it's not difficult to refine another one."
Wu Yuezhi was somewhat surprised, yet also somewhat enlightened. No wonder, despite the theft of the Heavenly Star Chessboard, Luo Qi was still able to refine the Daluo Chessboard before Three Immortals Island opened.
"Since you know everything, why are you so angry now?" Ni Mu was even more puzzled.
"You still have the face to ask! Who was it that told me the true nature of Three Immortals Island years ago? And now, who brought him into this perilous place? I thought – Ni Mu, you might have great ambition and are ruthless in your methods – but deep down, you still valued brotherhood. But now, for your own purposes, you've brought Yuezhi into Three Immortals Island. Did you ever consider whether he was strong enough to face these dangers?" Luo Qi glared with furious eyes, and more spirit lights illuminated on the Daluo Chessboard in his hands.
"Master, please calm your anger. It's not big brother's fault; it was I who insisted on coming to Three Immortals Island to help him," Wu Yuezhi said, his eyes filled with even deeper guilt.
Luo Qi did not respond, his gaze swept over Wu Yuezhi's face, noticing the guilt there, as well as the pain hidden beneath it.
His eyes softened a bit, then filled with sorrow. After a long silence, he sighed deeply and put away the Daluo Chessboard.
"Enough, enough. From the moment you stole the Heavenly Star Chessboard, I knew you were a person with your own convictions. My arrangements might not necessarily be the best path for you. The sky's the limit, and in the end, you have to carve your own way. Just remember these two things," Luo Qi said with a stern face.
Seeing his familiar expression, Wu Yuezhi's eyes brightened again, "I am all ears for your teaching, Master."
Luo Qi glanced at Ni Mu irritably, "Your current strength is not enough for your brother's ambition. If you still want to follow him, you must advance to the Nascent Soul within five years. Otherwise, I'll drag you back to Blood Swallow Island for closed-door cultivation."
"Yes, your disciple will keep this in mind," Wu Yuezhi nodded vigorously.
"And remember to come back and visit when you have time," Luo Qi said with a smile.
Wu Yuezhi was stunned for a moment, and his eyes seemed to well up with tears.
This chapter was made possible by the community at *.
Ni Mu, watching from the side, couldn't help showing a slight smile.
Yet, despite having reconciled with Wu Yuezhi, Luo Qi still gave Ni Mu a cold look. After snorting disdainfully, he left. Ni Mu didn't take it to heart, and after exchanging a few words with Wu Yuezhi, he turned to leave as well.
What he didn't notice was that Wu Yuezhi, whose face had just been full of emotion, suddenly stiffened as Ni Mu turned away. In his tear-filled eyes, strands of gray smoke began to rise.
Not far away, Ancestor Ming Quan took a step back for the moment, giving Yuan Ming a chance to breathe. Although he had been in the middle of a dispute, he had heard Luo Qi and the others talking.
Yuan Ming wasn't particularly interested in the bygones of Luo Qi and the others, but seeing Ni Mu involved, he suddenly remembered that Ancestor Ming Quan had been released by him. There must be some deal between them, right?
However, it seemed like Ancestor Ming Quan was not aware of Ni Mu's identity as the Wu Yue Sect Venerable; otherwise, he wouldn't have mentioned in front of Yuan Ming that Chang Chun Temple was preparing to act against Wu Yue Sect.
But then again, considering what happened at Shura Palace, whether Ni Mu was truly loyal to Wu Yue Sect was also questionable. The deal between him and Ancestor Ming Quan, whether it was instructed by Wu Yue Sect or just for his own personal gain, was hard to say.
As Yuan Ming pondered the complex relationships between these matters, Hou Yi's Sun Shooting Bow flew over.
"Is everything settled between you all now?" It shone brightly with golden light.
Yuan Ming came to his senses and bowed to Hou Yi's Sun Shooting Bow, "Thank you for your assistance after several battles, Elder."
"Ah, enough of that. If we really get down to it, I should be thanking you all. Without you, the Lank Chessboard and I really couldn't have done much against the Undead Tree Demon," Hou Yi's Sun Shooting Bow shook its bow body, seeming particularly pleased.
"We were also fighting for our own survival," Yuan Ming said with a smile.
Hou Yi's Sun Shooting Bow was nonchalant, "Either way, you've helped me greatly, and as the Golden Sunflower Immortal once said, when you're helped by others, you must give appropriate rewards, otherwise karma will haunt you and sooner or later, you'll face big trouble. However, I don't have much I can offer now. I thought about it and there's only one thing that all of you would want."
Upon hearing this, everyone's faces showed curiosity, wondering what it was that he was referring to.

chapters.title: Chapter 629 - 601 Offer Everything to Me!
chapters.content:
Hou Yi's Sun Shooting Bow did not keep everyone in suspense; with a shake of the bow, several beams of golden light flew towards the crowd and transformed into palm-sized golden jade talismans.
"What I just gave you is the pass to travel Overseas. Whenever you wish to go, just crush the jade talisman, and I will lend a hand to help you set sail," Hou Yi's Sun Shooting Bow said, his tone relaxed and comfortable.
However, these words struck Yuan Ming and the others like a bolt from the blue.
On the Yunhuang Continent, every cultivator who stepped into the Nascent Soul Realm aspired to reach the legendary land Overseas. The tales were too ethereal, and the dangers that lay between them and that land were all too real. No one possessed both the courage and ability to face such dangers head-on. Thus, the legend remained merely a legend, and their longing never turned into reality.
But now, the pass to Overseas was in their hands.
This jade talisman was not particularly heavy, but Yuan Ming and the others felt as if a weight of thousands bore down on their fingertips, yet it also seemed as light and insubstantial as goose feather snow.
Seeing their reactions, Hou Yi's Sun Shooting Bow chuckled dryly a few times. He well knew what these jade talismans meant to Yuan Ming and the others. His carefree manner was but to savor the shock written on their faces at this moment, the rare bit of mischief he had indulged in over the many years.
"Alright, I've given you the items. Whether you use them or not depends on you. But let me tell you in advance, each jade talisman only allows one person to go. I recognize the jade but not the person. Even if you want to give this opportunity to someone else, you must appear in person and state your intentions; otherwise, I won't get involved," Hou Yi's Sun Shooting Bow reminded them.
"Naturally. But revered senior, can you really send us Overseas?" Yuan Ming asked, still somewhat incredulous.
"What, do you not believe me, or do you not believe the Golden Sunflower Immortal? When the Three Immortals established the Three Immortals Island, the intention was to select talent and grant them the qualifications to go Overseas. It's just that later, it was distorted by the Undead Tree Demon and has only now returned to the right path," Hou Yi's Sun Shooting Bow said, his tone tinged with a hint of nostalgia.
Yuan Ming stared blankly at the jade talisman in his hand, and the image of the Shura Master couldn't help but emerge in his mind.
As the saying goes, timing and fate are crucial. If the Shura Master had not been so desirous of reaching Overseas back then, perhaps he would have encountered the opportunity when the Three Immortals Island opened. With his talent and strength, he might have received Qi Ye's help to slay the Undead Tree Demon and earned the qualifications to travel Overseas.
But there are no ifs in life. Now Yuan Ming could only silently mourn for the Shura Master in his heart while also remembering the promise he had made to him.
"Alright, time is about right. You can think it over at your leisure. It's time for me to tidy up the island's mess," Hou Yi's Sun Shooting Bow said. As he did, another beam of golden light flashed across the bow, calling forth the Great Wilderness Star River Pearl.
Suddenly, countless beams of spirit light surged on the Great Wilderness Star River Pearl, condensing into a two-person-tall circle of light floating beside Hou Yi's Sun Shooting Bow.
Through the circle of light, everyone could see a calm sea area. Judging from the color of the water, it seemed to be a nearshore sea area.
Seeing this, Wu Yuezhi's body trembled slightly, and he walked impatiently toward the circle of light.
Yuan Ming didn't think much of it and was about to follow when he suddenly felt an inexplicable pressure emanating from Wu Yuezhi's body.
Yuan Ming was startled and looked around, but the others seemed not to notice anything odd. However, he did not think he was being paranoid or mistaken. He immediately tightened his grip on the Soul Destroying Sword and shouted.
"Fellow Daoist Wu, please hold on a moment."
Wu Yuezhi stopped in his tracks and turned around, revealing eyes that had completely lost their color, turning pitch black.
"Get out of my way!" Wu Yuezhi barked, an expression surfacing on his face that made Ni Mu and Luo Qi feel utterly unfamiliar.
In that moment, Wu Yuezhi's body suddenly erupted with a vast release of soul power, and blades of grey materialized out of thin air, slashing directly towards the unsuspecting Hou Yi's Sun Shooting Bow.
"He's not Wu Yuezhi!" Yuan Ming bellowed, swinging the Soul Destroying Sword. Multiple beams of sword light met the grey blades, blocking them all.
At the same time, Wu Yuezhi took out the Heavenly Star Chessboard. With a flick of his fingers, the chessboard burst into a seven-colored brilliance and then struck towards the Great Wilderness Star River Pearl.
"Not good, he's trying to self-destruct the chessboard!" Luo Qi recognized Wu Yuezhi's spell immediately and acted, activating the Daluo Chessboard.
Yuan Ming's heart chilled, as if he had guessed "Wu Yuezhi's" intention. He immediately formed a spell with both hands, infusing both soul power and mana into the Soul Destroying Sword, making the curse runes on the blade flash.
In a flash, a force of curse power enveloped Wu Yuezhi from above, causing his face to pale as he spat out a mouthful of blood. Inside him, the golden core instantly cracked and shattered into pieces.
Simultaneously, a massive chessboard phantasm enveloped him and the Heavenly Star Chessboard together. Under Luo Qi's full force, everything within the phantasm slowed down drastically, as if time itself had decelerated.
With his cultivation plummeting, "Wu Yuezhi" naturally couldn't maintain the manipulation of his magic treasure. The Heavenly Star Chessboard instantly lost control, slowed down by the phantasm, and before it could strike the Great Wilderness Star River Pearl, it exploded into nothingness.
The violent explosion of spirit light instantly erupted into dust, yet was also constrained within the chessboard's phantom, expanding so slowly that it seemed to unfurl like a flipbook.
"What a piece of trash!"
At this moment, "Wu Yuezhi" wiped the blood from the corner of his mouth and spat out a curse. Even though his body was riddled with holes, his face showed no signs of being affected.
Immediately afterward, a grey mist began to rise from "Wu Yuezhi's" body and condensed into an indistinct giant figure in mid-air.
Though the face of the giant was blurry, its eyes were exceptionally clear and animated. Pure black sclera like the night sky, scattered with countless dim stars. Upon closer inspection, its pupils were like a grey moon, seemingly dull but casting an enchanting, dreamlike glow. If one stared too long, one might feel an irresistible desire to plunge their divine soul into it.
As the giant appeared, Wu Yuezhi's body fell limply to the ground as if devoid of life, while Ni Mu's eyes flashed with extreme terror.
"You, you are..." Ni Mu murmured arduously, as if in a dream.
On the other hand, Guoguo, who was possessed by Xi Ying, stiffened, eyes filled with shock.
But the gaze of that giant figure did not fall upon them.
It was fixed on Yuan Ming, deep and mysterious, causing Yuan Ming to shiver, feeling as if he had been completely seen through.
"Offer everything to me," the giant's voice boomed like distant thunder, causing a nameless panic to stir in the hearts of all who heard it.
But to Yuan Ming, who faced the giant head-on, the voice was like music from the heavens, hauntingly melodious. In a trance, he seemed to see the sky darken, everything around him dissolve into nothingness, with only a pale grey moon rising slowly.This text was acquired from *.
The grey moon was so tranquil and tempting, emitting waves of mysterious, soft halos, urging one to offer everything to it unreservedly.
Unknowingly, Yuan Ming's spiritual power and soul power drained away rapidly, as if absorbed by the grey moon. Despite becoming aware of this, Yuan Ming felt no resistance, allowing his cultivation and vitality to dissipate together.
"Wake up, quickly!" Suddenly, another urgent voice rang in Yuan Ming's ears.
It was a familiar voice, yet Yuan Ming could not remember to whom it belonged. But soon, countless voices chanting the same phrase flooded his ears, including his parents, Xi Ying, and those who had received his kindness and admired him wholeheartedly.
The cacophony of voices was like a torrential flood, not causing Yuan Ming any pain or noise but feeling like warm currents flowing into his sea of consciousness, merging into his divine soul.
It was the Stealing Heaven Tripod sensing damage to his divine soul and automatically feeding back Desire Power, as well as the foundation and good deeds he had accumulated during his cultivation. Born from the countless beings, yet it all originated from the seeds he had sown.
Yuan Ming suddenly realized, the first voice to speak was not someone else's; it was his own.
Having cultivated to this point, having struggled to this point, he was no longer the small Fur Beast Slave struggling to survive in the mountains of the Southern Border. Now, he was protected by the blessings of countless desires, and no one, no one at all, could alter his mind or bewilder his divine soul!
In an instant, Yuan Ming, who was nearly lost to the dream, opened his eyes with fury, raised his head in defiance, and charged directly towards the giant figure under its watchful eyes.
"Interesting, you, should not be awake," the giant figure remarked impassively, his voice laced with a hint of curiosity.
In a flash, Yuan Ming felt a strong wave of sleepiness envelop him, and everything around him began to fade away once again, pulling him toward that dream leading to oblivion.
But this time, Yuan Ming was prepared. His mind was connected to the Stealing Heaven Tripod, relentlessly drawing Desire Power from the tripod, far more than what it provided automatically, enough to keep him standing and hovering between the dream and reality.
And as the giant spoke, all others had fallen into a deep sleep, causing Luo Qi's Daluo Chessboard to break on its own, leaving Yuan Ming free to rush to the giant's figure and throw a mighty punch.
The next moment, the air roared with the force of the punch, tearing the clouds asunder and shaking the ground, yet, it did not harm the giant figure in the slightest.
"Beyond foolish," the giant figure sneered, raising his hands for the first time, his soul power surging, preparing to use some magic.
His body, made of soul power and essentially akin to soul splitting, Yuan Ming did not activate any Magic Treasures nor use magic, only relying on brute strength to fight with his physical body against a soul-breaking entity, which was akin to punching cotton. Thus, the giant figure did not even bother defending, much less resisting.
Now that the monkey show was over, it was time for him to truly take action and end this farce.
But at the instant he raised his hands, he heard Yuan Ming's clear voice:
"You're too arrogant. If you want my life, how can you leave without giving something in return?"

chapters.title: Chapter 630 - 630: 602 Wu Yue God Descends
chapters.content:
Before Yuan Ming could finish speaking, the Soul Destroying Sword in his hand flew out of thin air, turned in the sky, and a ray of sword light sped forth, ultimately piercing into his own body.
This scene left the giant figure, who was preparing to defend, completely astonished, but immediately after, a fierce sense of tearing came, and a segment of his soul body was cut away, his aura plummeting sharply.
"Come, let's see if your soul splitting is strong enough, or if my Desire Power is abundant enough!" Yuan Ming roared with laughter, and with a thought, the Soul Destroying Sword began to operate on its own.
On the blade, streams of sword light danced out, continuously invading Yuan Ming's Sea of Consciousness, chopping at his Divine Soul, and for every portion taken away, Desire Power surged forth to help Yuan Ming mend his soul body.
On the other hand, the injuries Yuan Ming's Divine Soul sustained all manifested on the giant's figure, causing his soul body to constantly diminish, and his Soul Power to rapidly deplete.
At this moment, the giant figure was filled with bewilderment, not understanding why he was injured when Yuan Ming was clearly inflicting wounds upon himself.
Could it be... Fist Intent?
The breadth of the giant figure's knowledge was vast, and it didn't take long for him to realize the crux of the problem.
Yuan Ming's punch at that time, seemingly without any damage to himself, had secretly infused Fist Intent into the giant's soul body, completing the "Life-lock," as a result, whatever harm Yuan Ming suffered, would fully manifest on him as well.
But even so, the giant figure's Divine Soul Power was still much stronger than Yuan Ming's. If it really came down to a life-for-life exchange, Yuan Ming would likely be dead before the giant figure sustained more than severe injuries.
However, Yuan Ming possessed Desire Power to mend his Divine Soul, and the giant figure at this time was merely a soul splitting that had crossed realms, unable to receive supplementation and repair from Desire Power, and unable to unravel the Shared Life Fist Intent. Even if he could counterattack Yuan Ming, he would still be injured.
As one diminished and the other grew, he ultimately had no outcome but defeat.
In the blink of an eye, the giant figure understood all the key points, yet he had no emotions like regret.
"Very good, you really are interesting. If you truly have the ability, then come to see me. I look forward to the day we formally meet," the giant figure said, then his form quivered and voluntarily dispersed his soul splitting, transforming into ownerless Soul Power drifting in the world.
But Yuan Ming dared not be careless. He struck himself with a few more slashes, confirming that the Shared Life Fist Intent no longer had a target, before he finally breathed a sigh of relief.
Just as he relaxed, all the pain and fatigue surged to his heart, and Yuan Ming could no longer hold on, eventually collapsing to the ground.
At the same time, as the giant figure dissipated, the others also began to regain consciousness one after another.
Guoguo, who was possessed by Xi Ying, was the first to stand up. Seeing that the giant figure was nowhere in sight, she relaxed, but then she saw Yuan Ming lying on the ground as if dead, and a flicker of panic flashed in her eyes as she hurriedly rushed to Yuan Ming's side.
"Yuan Ming, no!" she cried out through the voice transmitted by her Divine Soul.
Yuan Ming mustered his energy, smiled at her, and replied softly, "Don't worry, I won't die. I'm fine."
At the same time, Ni Mu also flew over, his face carrying a hint of fright.
Seeing him, Yuan Ming's expression immediately darkened: "Now, do you have anything to say?"
Ni Mu's expression became grave: "I did not know that the Wu Yue God would hide a soul splitting inside Wu Yuezhi's body."
Yuan Ming's eyebrows raised; he had suspected as much during the fight, and now he had received Ni Mu's personal confirmation.
The giant with an unseen face was indeed the Wu Yue God!
Fortunately, it appeared to be only one of his soul splittings that came this time, using a Soul Descent Secret Technique that was much more sophisticated than what Yuan Ming had seen before.
"He is reviving faster than I imagined. There may still be many others like Wu Yuezhi around us, acting as his eyes and ears," Xi Ying's voice echoed in Yuan Ming's ear.
Ni Mu's lips were somewhat dry: "My second brother has been with me for many years; I never imagined that he too..."
"The Wu Yue God does not care about controlling someone, no matter the cost. You should know why he planted someone by your side," Yuan Ming sat up and spoke somberly.
Ni Mu was silent, seemingly unwilling to delve deeper into this issue.
"The most crucial point is, how much does he understand about us? With Wu Yuezhi involved in the Shura Palace incident, does the Wu Yue God have a full grasp of the underlying intricacies?" Yuan Ming's expression was grave.
Ni Mu shook his head: "He actually does not care about infighting among his subordinates, moreover, I am still alive."
Yuan Ming fell silent, the implication of Ni Mu's words was clear—if the Wu Yue God truly knew about the incidents within Shura Palace and was angered by it, Ni Mu would have already been dead.
At this time, Hou Yi's Sun Shooting Bow flew over: "Are you all right?"
"Thank you for your concern, we are alright. How about you, senior?" Yuan Ming regained some strength and looked up at the Sun-shooting Bow.
"Thanks to you, I am unhurt, and the Great Wilderness Star River Pearl is undamaged," Hou Yi's Sun Shooting Bow breathed a sigh of relief.
Yuan Ming nodded and then whispered to Xi Ying with some doubt: "Speaking of which, his initial target seemed to be to destroy the Great Wilderness Star River Pearl. Why is that?"
"Few can fathom his thoughts. When he wants to do something, he will issue orders to specific people, and unless it's the executor, even the Wu Yue Sect Venerable would hardly understand the reasons," Xi Ying shook her head as she spoke.
The expressions of everyone present grew grave, the excitement they had felt from defeating the Undead Tree Demon now tinged with a shadow.
At that moment, Luo Qi flew over holding the body of Wu Yuezhi: "Ni Mu, I need an explanation."
Anger tightly suppressed could be heard in everyone's voice.
Ni Mu sighed, seemingly reluctant to explain too much to Luo Qi for fear of revealing more information about himself, while Yuan Ming looked at Wu Yuezhi's body, his expression slightly moving.
"Both of you, there seems to be a strand of residual soul left in Wu Yuezhi's body. I can wake him up to say a few words, but after that, I can't say for sure," Yuan Ming said after examining with his Divine Sense.
Upon hearing this, Luo Qi's expression brightened with joy, but then the light in his eyes dimmed once again.
It was a long time before he spoke in a hoarse voice, "I'll have to trouble Fellow Daoist Yuan."
Yuan Ming nodded and wrapped a strand of Soul Power with his Divine Sense, injecting it into the residual soul of Wu Yuezhi.
Soon, Wu Yuezhi opened his eyes, his turbid pupils sweeping past Luo Qi, who was close at hand, then slightly turning towards Ni Mu.
"Master, big brother... where am I..."
Ni Mu stepped forward with a grave expression, going straight to the point: "When did he find you?"
Wu Yuezhi was puzzled, and then he seemed to recall something.
The Soul Descent Technique of the Wu Yue God was extremely domineering; it directly tore apart Wu Yuezhi's Divine Soul, but it also did not shield his perception, so he naturally knew what had happened.
Pain flickered in Wu Yuezhi's eyes, "It must have been in that Secret Realm in the Northern Desert."
"...Two years after we became sworn brothers? How did he convince you?" Ni Mu calculated the time and was somewhat shocked.
"He promised that as long as I worshipped and served him, he would grant me power," Wu Yuezhi said with a bitter smile.
"You, ah, foolish!" Ni Mu said, both angry and annoyed.
Wu Yuezhi gasped for a moment, struggling to shake his head: "Big brother, I don't have your talent, nor do I have master's genius. You always want to protect me, not wanting me to take risks, but how could I be content to hide behind you? Seeking his help... was the only method I could find."
As Luo Qi listened, something suddenly came to mind, and his face turned pallid, "You stole the Heavenly Star Chessboard... could it be that was also his doing..."
Wu Yuezhi closed his eyes, "It was his instruction as well."
Luo Qi was stunned, as if something in his mind had exploded, anger showing on his face. He wanted to push Wu Yuezhi away fiercely but hesitated.
"Your coming to Three Immortals Island was also his idea, right?" Ni Mu's eyes flashed with disappointment.
"Yes," Wu Yuezhi's voice dropped lower.
At this moment, Yuan Ming spoke up, "Wu Yuezhi, this is your last chance to meet with them. If you have anything to say, make it clear now, or you might never have the chance to explain again."
At his words, both Luo Qi and Ni Mu were slightly startled and quickly looked down at Wu Yuezhi, who also struggled to open his eyes, looking at Yuan Ming and then at his master and big brother.
"He told me that as soon as I entered the Immortal Island, I could replace master and forge the Daluo Chessboard, and then master would no longer need to take risks. He also promised to lend me power, so I could secretly protect big brother to prevent him from being captured by the Undead Tree Demon," Wu Yuezhi said in a low and slow voice.
"You foolish one! Being deceived initially might be excusable, but after being with us for so long, don't you know what kind of person he is? He only cares about his own goals!" Ni Mu clenched his fists, berating again.
"By the time I realized it, it was too late. As soon as I entered the island, he took over my body, and it was only just now in our conversation that he released my Divine Soul," Wu Yuezhi said with a bitter smile, helplessly.This text was acquired from *.
Yuan Ming suddenly understood, it was no wonder. Given the pride shown by the Wu Yue God in their fight, he indeed disdained to accompany Ni Mu and the others, and if he hadn't deployed his full power and sent down his soul splitting, Wu Yuezhi's Divine Soul would not have been shredded to pieces.
Truth be told, Yuan Ming was responsible for the current state of Wu Yuezhi.
But naturally, Ni Mu and the others wouldn't blame Yuan Ming.
"Then why didn't you explain things to us clearly at that time?" Luo Qi asked urgently.
"He was too powerful. If I had spoken out at that time and angered him, we all would have died. And although I don't know his true intentions, I can feel that he had no interest in taking action against big brother and master," Wu Yuezhi said with a bitter smile.
Yuan Ming looked thoughtful. Indeed, if he hadn't intervened to stop the Wu Yue God from destroying the Great Wilderness Star River Pearl, the Wu Yue God wouldn't have even spared them a glance.
"Big brother, and Fellow Daoist Yuan, listen to my advice, do not oppose him any further. He is very strong, truly very strong. The soul splitting that descended into my body possesses less than one-tenth of his strength, and if you continue to fight against him, you will die…" Wu Yuezhi's tone was filled with worry.
The atmosphere was exceptionally solemn; Yuan Ming wanted to say that might not be the case, but ultimately, he didn't have the confidence to make such a claim.
After saying so much, Wu Yuezhi's life finally reached its end.
His expression became vacant, and the last strand of his residual soul gradually withdrew from his body.
"Big brother, master, I'm sorry. If there is an afterlife..."
In his haziness, Wu Yuezhi seemed to see a series of scenes from his dreams.
Without having stolen the Heavenly Star Chessboard, he had an epiphany by chance, took an alternative path, and together with Luo Qi, refined the Daluo Chessboard. They ventured into the Three Immortals Island together and eventually returned to the East Sea.
Without being sought out by the Wu Yue God, through his own efforts, he finally reached the Nascent Soul stage, fought side by side with Ni Mu, becoming his right-hand man. The trio of siblings ventured the world, establishing an unparalleled empire.
If only these things were true, how wonderful that would be.
Amidst these dreams, Wu Yuezhi's eyes closed forever.

chapters.title: Chapter 631 - 603 Awakening
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming slowly lowered his hand, his face showing neither joy nor sorrow, but his eyes revealed a complex expression.
Just a moment ago, he had secretly utilized the All Living Beings' Dream, allowing Wu Yuezhi to experience those scenes in the last moments of his life.
Perhaps in some ways, the Shura Master wasn't wrong. For some people, being perpetually immersed in a dream is indeed more blissful than facing the harsh realities of life.
Life is but a dream; how much joy does it really bring?
Immortals devote their lives to arduous cultivation. Without opportunities and transformations, if they cannot continually break through, in the end, it all amounts to nothing — a grandeur that fades, leaving only a dream when the tune ends.
What a pity, what a lament.
Now, having experienced various adversities, I was fortunate enough to have stepped into the Nascent Soul Stage. However, the higher my cultivation, the less I can do as I please. Instead, I face more conflicts and restrictions.
It was even better than my time in the Ten Thousand Mountains of the Southern Border.
Back then, although I was confined, my heart was free.
However, it is also because of the continuous improvement in my cultivation and strength that I have gradually come to see many things I never knew before, slowly uncovering some secrets behind this vibrant world.
Especially the legendary world overseas, which fascinates me even more.
This has further solidified my resolve to pursue cultivation.
I must continue to enhance my cultivation and strength to forge ahead relentlessly, protecting those I cherish while seeking true freedom.
Beside the corpse of Wu Yuezhi, Luo Qi bowed his head, gazing at his disciple, silent.
Next to Ni Mu, the resplendent girl, seeing her second brother dead, could not speak, and her eyes were already reddening.
"Thank you, Fellow Daoist Yuan," Ni Mu's voice carried a bit of bitterness.
"It was just a small effort," Yuan Ming shook his head.
Nearby, after witnessing everything, the artifact spirit of Hou Yi's Sun Shooting Bow, though not as emotionally rich as humans, felt a strange sadness.
"You should go now." He sighed, opened a spatial passage with the Great Wilderness Star River Pearl, and then vanished.
Before leaving, however, he transmitted a message to Yuan Ming alone, "You have helped me once again. If you crush the jade talisman in the future, I will have another gift for you. Take care."
Yuan Ming nodded silently and bowed in the direction where Hou Yi's Sun Shooting Bow disappeared, as a gesture of thanks.
By some tacit understanding, the conversation among the three of them, including Yuan Ming, was very careful, so the others did not know that it was the Wu Yue God's soul splitting that had just arrived. They thought it was either the Undead Tree Demon's backup or some sinister cultivator with ulterior motives. Only Jin Chao sensed something wrong, but he had no intention to delve into it.
...
After a while.
In the outer sea, the spiritual energy of heaven and earth suddenly boiled, and three giant peak illusions appeared in the sky, emitting gold, cyan, and white lights respectively.
A white light pillar shot out from within the giant peak illusion, landing on the nearby sea surface and piercing a dark hole about thirty meters in diameter and unknown depth.
The nearby sea water churned with huge waves coming wave after wave, isolated by the white light pillar.
A white array spread out from within the light pillar, revealing the figures of more than a dozen people, including Yuan Ming, confined by the array and unable to move.
The white light pillar dissipated quickly, the giant peak illusions vanished, and Yuan Ming and the others regained their freedom.
Feeling the wet salty sea breeze blowing in their faces, everyone breathed a sigh of relief as if they had unloaded a great burden.
They had finally left Three Immortals Island and come to the outside world.
Chapter provided via *.
The spiritual energy of heaven and earth in the outer sea was far less rich than inside the Three Immortals Island, and the harsh, bitterly cold sea wind that lashed at their faces was filled with a long-missed scent of freedom.
Just at that moment, a vast expanse of starlight suddenly appeared in the nearby void, cascading down like a broken waterfall.
Three figures fell from within the starlight, none other than Huan Ling Zi, Qing Tong, and Hou Santong, who hadn't been able to enter Three Immortals Island.
Yuan Ming and the others were startled, but upon realizing it was Huan Ling Zi and his companions, they relaxed.
"It has been an honor to journey through Three Immortals Island with all of you," Ni Mu bowed to Yuan Ming and the others. "I have some mundane matters to attend to, so I will take my leave first. Farewell until we meet again." With the resplendent girl in tow, he transformed into a white rainbow and flew away quickly.
The Qiong Hai Island Master and Ancestor Ming Quan also hurried away without a greeting.
Yuan Ming chuckled inwardly. Whether it was Ni Mu, the Qiong Hai Island Master, or Ancestor Ming Quan, the looks they gave him all contained a trace of apprehension, fear, and even hatred and other complex emotions.
I am merely a novice in the Nascent Soul Stage with limited strength, relying solely on the support of the Stealing Heaven Tripod's desire power to contend with many powerhouses. Yet, these people fear me as if I were a tiger.
This incident also just proved how terrifying the Stealing Heaven Tripod is, elevating me, a mere early-stage Nascent Soul cultivator, to become a formidable figure in the Yunhuang Continent.
"We will also take our leave. Until we meet again if fate allows," Jin Chao nodded slightly to Yuan Ming, and together with Golden Cloud Fairy, prepared to leave.
"Senior Jin Chao, please wait. Although Fairy Jin Yun has broken through to the Nascent Soul Stage and seems to have cultivated a kind of Divine Skill with powerful flames, this technique has put a significant burden on her body. If it isn't properly resolved, the consequences could be grave. As it happens, I have some insight into this matter. Why don't I lend Fellow Daoist Jin Yun a hand?" said Luo Qi as he flew over, nodding slightly to Fairy Jin Yun nearby.
Fairy Jin Yun's eyebrows knitted at first. After glancing at Jin Chao beside her, she nodded slightly to Luo Qi without a word.
"Then I shall trouble Fellow Daoist Luo," Jin Chao said, looking at the Daluo Chessboard in Luo Qi's hand and nodding.
The three then walked away together and soon disappeared into the distant sky.
Yuan Ming frowned slightly. He had wanted to ask Luo Qi about Wulu, but he hadn't expected the man to just walk away.
It didn't really matter. No matter where the Blood Demon Ancestor fled, he had a way to find him.
Half the crowd had left, leaving only Yuan Ming, Old Man Hei Zhu, Shi Yanshi, Long Chong, Hua Zhi, Xue Jiao, Tu Sheng, and Zhong Ling on the sea surface.
Huan Ling Zi, Qing Tong, and Hou Santong, who had been removed from the secret realm, saw Yuan Ming and the others nearby and were about to approach them when the gathering of Nascent Soul powerhouses bid their farewells. Not daring to disturb them, the three stood to the side quietly.
Yuan Ming ignored the trio and turned to Xue Jiao, Tu Sheng, and Zhong Ling to ask why they were traveling with Luo Qi.
"Reporting to Senior Yuan, the three of us met by chance on Three Immortals Island and traveled together. Later, we encountered a Level 4 demon beast and were in a desperate situation when we couldn't overcome it. Suddenly, Senior Luo Qi appeared and rescued us. He has a Space Treasure, and since then, we have been hiding inside it," Xue Jiao said, sensing that Yuan Ming had already achieved the Nascent Soul Stage, speaking with a somewhat complicated look in his eyes.
Yuan Ming nodded, realizing that was the case.
He always felt that Luo Qi had a mysterious background and wasn't sure if he was friend or foe. Previously, he had even made efforts to ingratiate himself with Fusang Island, but Luo Qi holding the Daluo Chessboard could not be underestimated.
"Yuan... Senior, my father's condition is not good, and I ask for your assistance," Long Chong suddenly said urgently.
Yuan Ming looked over and saw that the skin of Golden Transformation Master was quickly turning black, revealing bark-like textures. His aura became murky, and the Divine Soul Power in his Sea of Consciousness grew chaotic.
At that moment, Wan Tianren, Gu Xuanyang, and Jia Sifang, who were inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod, also began exhibiting changes in their bodies, similar to what was happening to Golden Transformation Master—murky aura and wild Soul Power.
"Brother Long, don't worry. Leave this matter to me," Yuan Ming said, waving his sleeve to send a beam of green light, sweeping Golden Transformation Master in front of him.
The situation was the same for all four of them.
They had all once become tree-man puppets of the Undead Tree Demon, and now residual Undead Demon Power lingered within their bodies. Although the demon tree was dead, its demonic power had not dissipated and continued to erode their bodies and Divine Souls.
If not dealt with, it was possible the four individuals would be completely overtaken by the demonic power, possibly leading to the rebirth of the Undead Tree Demon.
Yuan Ming was not panicked. Others might find the situation tricky, but it was quite simple for him.
He asked everyone to stay put while he took Golden Transformation Master to a distant location, activating the Stealing Heaven Tripod to release a mist that hid their Divine Sense. He then moved Wan Tianren, Gu Xuanyang, and Jia Sifang outside, placing them around Golden Transformation Master.
Yuan Ming then sat cross-legged in the air in the middle, controlling the Undying Tree within his Dantian. Four roots shot out, piercing into the bodies of Wan Tianren, Gu Xuanyang, Jia Sifang, and Golden Transformation Master.
In less than the time it took to finish a cup of tea, the Undying Demon Power inside the four was completely devoured, and their consciousness gradually returned.
Yuan Ming took Jia Sifang back into the space of the Stealing Heaven Tripod and continued to suppress him, then used his Soul Power in an attempt to awaken Wan Tianren and the others, but the results were not satisfactory.
After a moment of thought, he controlled his first soul to sit on the White Jade Lotus Platform, drawing on the Desire Power within the platform to send out a massive Divine Soul shout, "Awaken!"
Wan Tianren and the others jumped, coming to their senses.
At first, they were somewhat dazed. After looking at each other, their eyes unanimously turned to Yuan Ming.
"Was it you who saved us?" Wan Tianren cautiously asked.
He had not fully awakened just then but had sensed a strong wave of Divine Soul, far beyond the Nascent Soul Stage, so he was very respectful.
Golden Transformation Master and Gu Xuanyang looked at Yuan Ming with surprise, scrutinizing him.
"Hehe, I, a mere Nascent Soul Early Stage Cultivator, do not possess such ability. Another individual saved you— a tremendously skilled senior known as the Nether Moon God. Give thanks to him instead," Yuan Ming shook his head, his gaze sweeping over the surrounding mist as he spoke.
Wan Tianren and the others' expressions changed slightly. Yuan Ming was also a Nascent Soul cultivator, and even he called this being a senior; clearly, it was no trivial matter.
"We deeply appreciate the help of Senior Nether Moon God, we will surely remember it in our hearts!" Wan Tianren bowed to the nearby mist.
Seeing Wan Tianren do this, Gu Xuanyang and Golden Transformation Master also bowed deeply, continuously thanking him.
Three potent forces of Desire Power gathered, especially from Wan Tianren, whose produced Desire Power far exceeded that of White Scale Master and Old Man Hei Zhu among others.
Yuan Ming did not absorb it, letting the Desire Power merge into the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
Though Wan Tianren and the others received no response, they were not surprised and soon stood up.
"Fellow Daoist seems to be a participant of the Immortal Fruit Conference. It appears you have broken through your cultivation on Three Immortals Island—congratulations! May I ask where we are? And where are those tree-men?" Wan Tianren said to Yuan Ming, bowing, seemingly having completely forgotten that he himself had once been a tree-man puppet.
"My surname is Yuan, and we are now outside the Three Immortals Island. As for those tree-men and the Undead Tree Demon behind them, I'll leave it to the senior to tell you," Yuan Ming said with a respectful expression.
A grand voice then fell. It was The Nether Moon God's voice transmitted by the first soul, "I am the Nether Moon God, called by the believers to come to Three Immortals Island. The Undead Demon Tree has been slain by me, you may rest easy!"
Hearing they had already left Three Immortals Island, and that the Undead Tree Demon had been slain, all were overjoyed.

chapters.title: Chapter 632 - 604: Sudden Change
chapters.content:
"So it is. Senior Nether Moon God, having slain the Undead Tree Demon and saved us, we are endlessly grateful and will surely repay you in the future!" Wan Tianren thanked him again and generated another substantial Desire Power.
"It is good that you know gratitude. Since you wish to repay me, each of you should offer up one precious treasure," the first soul said unapologetically.
Wan Tianren was stunned; he had merely made polite remarks and hadn't expected the Nether Moon God to actually take him up on his offer.
"What? Do you intend to renege and fatten yourselves on your words?" the voice of the first soul deepened, and a tremendous Divine Soul pressure descended.
Wan Tianren felt as if a huge mountain was pressing down on his Divine Soul, shaking him to his core. He hurriedly said, "How could I dare! What would Senior Nether Moon God like? We will offer it immediately."
"During the battle on the Three Immortals Island, that green palm fan was quite impressive; offer it up. As for the Golden Turtle Island Master, that Exterminating Immortal Sword of yours is also quite mighty. I've already taken it earlier, so consider it a tribute," the first soul declared.
At these words, the expressions of Wan Tianren and Gu Xuanyang changed.
These two Magic Treasures were their most cherished possessions, into which they had invested countless efforts and resources.
But given that the Nether Moon God had saved their lives and was far stronger than they were, neither dared to refuse. Wan Tianren instantly took out the green palm fan.
Yuan Ming channeled Mana into the Stealing Heaven Tripod, assisting the first soul in activating the Altar Formation to open a spatial gateway.
A golden and silver light emerged from the void, quickly solidifying into a door-sized shadow which creaked open slowly.
A spatial suction force burst forth from within the door, wrapping around the green palm fan and drawing it inside.
"This is a Gateway of Space!" Wan Tianren and Gu Xuanyang showed shock on their faces and hurriedly bowed their heads.
In their eyes, the ability to effortlessly open such a gateway was beyond even those at the Returning Void stage.
The forceful demands for their treasures by the Nether Moon God had initially sparked resentment, but that emotion now vanished completely.
An entity capable of easily opening a gateway of space could take their lives with merely a gesture.
"As for you…" the massive Divine Soul pressure loomed toward the Golden Transformation Master.
"My Thousand Dragon Island has meager resources and is not as affluent as Fusang Island or Golden Turtle Island. The only worthy item I have is this Nine Dragon Pearl, which I hope Lord Nether Moon God will kindly accept," the Golden Transformation Master said, his expression torn as he reluctantly took out the Nine Dragon Pearl.
"This treasure is nothing special; you need not bother. This pearl can enhance the Physical Body. It seems you are proficient in Body Refinement. Hand over all your materials related to Body Cultivation to me," the first soul instructed.
Yuan Ming was actually quite curious about the Nine Dragon Pearl, but since he was friends with Long Chong, he felt it inappropriate to forcefully take the Golden Transformation Master's treasure.
The Golden Transformation Master, relieved at the words, hastily offered up all the Jade Scroll Books related to Body Cultivation he had, totaling over a dozen jade scrolls and about twenty to thirty classics.
Yuan Ming covertly cast another spell, incorporating these Jade Scroll Books into the Stealing Heaven Tripod, and briefly examined them.
These scrolls and books contained seven or eight Body Cultivation Methods, along with many elixirs, spiritual materials, and secret techniques beneficial for Body Cultivation training—quite valuable in their own right.
He then sensed the contained Spiritual Power in the green palm fan, which was astonishingly immense, revealing sixteen runes engraved inside, all appearing to be Wind Attribute runes.
"Such astonishing Spiritual Power! Definitely at the level of a Spiritual Treasure, and this fan doesn't appear to be a reproduction. Could it be like the Thunder God Hammer and the God Bombarding Cone, once a true Spiritual Treasure that has now lost its Artifact Spirit due to certain reasons?" Yuan Ming, having seen numerous imitation and true Spiritual Treasures, was quite adept at identifying them.
"What is the origin of this green palm fan?" Yuan Ming immediately had the first soul ask.
"This fan is known as the Palm Leaf Fan, found by the junior in a secret realm. After many years of observation and cultivation by me, this fan was likely a Spiritual Treasure, but has lost its Artifact Spirit and much of its power," Wan Tianren honestly replied.
Yuan Ming nodded slightly and placed the palm fan on the altar, his Divine Sense sweeping towards a nearby bronze longsword, the Exterminating Immortal Sword.
He had already examined this sword, which also contained sixteen runes, all of a killing nature. The Sixteen Killing Sword Qi stacked together, making the Exterminating Immortal Sword look utterly terrifying, with murder filling the air.
"The offerings you have presented are satisfactory; I am pleased," the vast pressure that had loomed over their heads began to recede slowly.
As Wan Tianren and the others breathed a sigh of relief, they even felt a sense of gratification in having pleased the Nether Moon God, finding their sacrifices worthwhile.
The nearby white fog quickly dissipated, and their vision cleared, making the surroundings visible.
At the same time, the nearby void fluctuated, revealing the figures of Queen Ming Kong, the muscular Merfolk, Aunt Wanhua's Nascent Soul, and both Bing Xin and Yun Jiuxiao.
Seeing this, Wan Tianren and the others showed a hint of surprise but did not speak.
Having looked around, Queen Ming Kong and others quickly realized they had made it outside.
"Thank you, Lord Nether Moon God, for your protection. Only with it could we safely leave the Three Immortals Island. Your Majesty, I swear on the Merfolk lineage, from this day forward, my Merfolk will serve faithfully and never betray!" Queen Ming Kong's Nascent Soul prostrated earnestly.
"Wanhua Island feels the same; all our disciples will serve day and night," Aunt Wanhua said as well.
