The Water Ape Clan muscular man also wanted to make such a vow, but as he was not the leader of his clan, he could not decide for everyone and could only express his personal devout belief.
Bing Xin and Yun Jiuxiao, just having escaped from the illusion, were completely unaware of the events and stood aside, puzzled.
"Very well, the turmoil in the East Sea Immortal Cultivation World has reached its peak. As long as you remain loyal, I will protect you and help you survive this great calamity," the voice of the Nether Moon God once again echoed.
"Yes, thank you, Lord Nether Moon God!" Queen Ming Kong and Aunt Wanhua were overjoyed and bowed again in gratitude.
The stout man of the Water Ape Clan, upon seeing this, grew anxious in his heart, and he silently resolved to fully persuade the Clan Leader to worship the Nether Moon God upon his return to the Water Ape Clan.
Fellow Daoist Wan and two others, upon hearing that chaos had already arrived in the East Sea, were momentarily stunned.
From a distance, Long Chong, upon seeing his father return to normal, flew over with great joy.
"Your Majesty!"
"Marshal Hou! How did you end up like this?"
Xue Jiao and Hou Santong, seeing the situation here, hurriedly flew over.
Old Man Hei Zhu and Shi Yanshi also arrived in a flash, protecting Aunt Wan Hua's Nascent Soul.
Queen Ming Kong and the others briefly recounted their recent encounters and how they had been saved by the Nether Moon God.
Old Man Hei Zhu and the others couldn't help but feel a wave of gratitude toward the Nether Moon God, generating quite a bit of Desire Power.
Yuan Ming was overjoyed, silently grateful that his previous efforts had not been in vain.
"Senior Yuan, have you seen Tu Shixiong, the Island Master of Earth Beauty Island?" Tu Sheng asked, bowing to Yuan Ming.
"And the Island Master Murong of Void Island, Senior Yuan, have you seen him?" Huan Ling Zi also asked.
"How is the White Scale Master from my Thousand Snake Island doing now? Does Senior Yuan know?" Qing Tong also looked toward Yuan Ming.
Having just chatted and learned of the many Nascent Souls entering Three Immortals Island, as well as Yuan Ming's identity as a Divine Envoy of the Nether Moon God, they eagerly asked.
Yuan Ming did not conceal anything and revealed that Tu Shixiong, Murong Yanyu, and the White Scale Master had all perished.
Upon hearing this news, Tu Sheng, Huan Ling Zi, and Qing Tong were all stunned and took a long time to recover.
"My esteemed seniors, I dare to inquire about one matter. During your time on Three Immortals Island, did any of you come across Qiong Yun's whereabouts?" Long Chong asked the people present.
Everyone looked at each other and shook their heads.
Cоntеnt prеsеntеd by МV|LЕМР|YR.
Seeing this, Long Chong's cheeks gradually turned deathly pale.
Although Three Immortals Island held many opportunities, it was also extremely dangerous, especially with the presence of the Undead Tree Demon. Qiong Yun was not very powerful, and the likelihood of his demise somewhere was very high.
Long Chong had known Qiong Yun since they were children, and as they grew into adults, they developed feelings for each other. Now, to think that they were separated by life and death.
Cultivators deal with death every day, and dying unexpectedly at any time is not unusual. However, imagining Qiong Yun meeting an untimely death, Long Chong's vision darkened, and he staggered before stabilizing himself.
The Golden Transformation Master patted his son's shoulder in comfort.
Seeing Long Chong so grief-stricken, Yuan Ming felt somewhat guilty.
Qiong Yun also had some dealings with him, but during his many years of cultivation in the Time Cave, he never once attempted to use Black Incense to check on the other's life or death.
Determined, he silently resolved that he would use Black Incense Possession later to see if Qiong Yun truly had perished.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, may I have a word in private?" Just then, Wan Tianren came over, with Gu Xuanyang and the Golden Transformation Master following behind him.
"Fellow Daoist Wan, speak freely and without concern." Yuan Ming's gaze shifted as he followed the three away from the noisy crowd to a quieter area.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, it seems you have some connection with the Nether Moon God. May I inquire about it?" Wan Tianren asked.
"Years ago, I joined the Moon God Sect and because I managed affairs competently, Lord Nether Moon God entrusted me with the position of Divine Envoy to convey some of his decrees," Yuan Ming explained.
"I see, no wonder your cultivation improved by leaps and bounds in such a short time, progressing to the Nascent Soul Stage." Wan Tianren's eyes flashed with a hint of astonishment, and his estimation of the Nether Moon God rose further.
"Fellow Daoist Wan surely did not bring me here just to discuss this. Please, feel free to speak openly," Yuan Ming said with a smile.
"Since that is the case, I'll get straight to the point. Just now, Lord Nether Moon God mentioned that chaos had already struck the East Sea. What does this mean?" Wan Tianren inquired.
"The three of you are not aware, but we have been trapped inside Three Immortals Island for many days, and in that time, earth-shattering changes have occurred outside," Yuan Ming glanced at Wan Tianren and the others, explaining.
"Oh, what kind of dramatic changes might those be?" Wan Tianren's expression shifted slightly, and he quickly pursued the matter.
"This is something that Lord Nether Moon God informed me about, starting from the day we entered Three Immortals Island...." Yuan Ming recounted how the Wu Yue Sect attacked Fusang Island, almost completely destroying it, and how they were now attacking the other islands of the East Sea.
Upon hearing this, Wan Tianren, Gu Xuanyang, and the Golden Transformation Master were all greatly shocked.
"Fusang Island has been destroyed? Impossible! Although the Wu Yue Sect is formidable, they couldn't possibly obliterate my Fusang Island in one fell swoop!" Wan Tianren couldn't believe it.
Yuan Ming said nothing but threw an Image Retention Talisman over.
Wan Tianren immediately activated the talisman, and an image appeared, showing the badly damaged Fusang Island, with numerous houses collapsed and corpses everywhere, while only the Fusang Giant Tree still stood on the island.
Having devoted his life's work to Fusang Island, Wan Tianren's face turned completely bloodless upon seeing this scene.

chapters.title: Chapter 633 - 605: Late-Stage Nascent Soul Believer
chapters.content:
"The Wu Yue Sect had long been plotting this. After you entered the Three Immortals Island, the members of the Wu Yue Sect destroyed the ancient transmission array inside the Void Temple from the outside, completely sealing you all within the secret realm of the Three Immortals Island... They also took the opportunity to publicly expose your concealed entry into the secret realm, drawing almost all the Nascent Soul cultivators on the island to the Void Temple and sparking a direct conflict with the Fusang Island cultivators... Thereafter, they used magic treasures to seal off the Void Temple, capturing all the Nascent Soul cultivators of Fusang Island in one fell swoop," Yuan Ming said, his tone steady and unhurried.
As Wan Tianren listened, his face turned increasingly pale. His fists clenched tightly, and his body trembled slightly. Yuan Ming's words were detailed and convincing, aligning perfectly with the usual behavior of Fusang Island. He no longer harbored any doubts.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, do you know if there are any disciples from Fusang Island who have survived?" Wan Tianren, being a Late-Stage Nascent Soul entity, soon recovered and, after taking a deep breath, asked.
"I am not very sure about this matter. It is said that a small number of Fusang Island cultivators broke through the encirclement of the Wu Yue Sect and escaped to other places, their whereabouts unknown," Yuan Ming shook his head and said.
Wan Tianren's expression relaxed slightly. At this moment, no news might actually be the best news.
Suddenly, his eyes hardened into a menacing glare.
The Wu Yue Sect had taken advantage of their vulnerability to massacre the disciples of Fusang Island and destroy their foundations. This enmity was irreconcilable; he was determined to exact revenge on the Wu Yue Sect for this blood debt.
After his expression fluctuated between grim and light, Wan Tianren inquired about the whereabouts of the Golden Cloud Fairy, and after learning that she had been taken away by Jin Chao, he nodded thoughtfully, though he did not say much else.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, has Jin Ao Island been attacked by the Wu Yue Sect?" Gu Xuanyang, unable to wait after Wan Tianren had finished speaking, eagerly picked up the conversation.
"I do not know about that; Lord Nether Moon God did not inform me about Jin Ao Island's situation," Yuan Ming said.
Gu Xuanyang's eyebrows furrowed tightly, worried for Jin Ao Island, wishing he could immediately fly back to the Inner Sea.
The dialogue among Yuan Ming and others was not conducted through sound transmission, so the surrounding people all gathered around. Some who were unaware of the drastic changes outside were shocked and astonished at the extent of the upheaval during this period.
"Gentlemen, there is no doubt about the resurgence of the Wu Yue Sect, and its strength is even greater than it was a thousand years ago. I boldly predict that no force in the East Sea can contend with it; only my Lord Nether Moon God can rival the Wu Yue Sect!" Yuan Ming looked at the others and declared loudly.
"Lord Nether Moon God is indeed immensely powerful. Being sealed on Three Immortals Island, he not only protected us but was also able to send items from inside to the outside and vice versa. It is truly inconceivable," Old Man Hei Zhu said, quickly agreeing, realizing that Yuan Ming was seeking to recruit believers.
Upon hearing this, Wan Tianren and Gu Xuanyang's eyes once again showed hints of suspicion.
Three Immortals Island is the largest legend of the East Sea, always elusive. Could the Nether Moon God actually come and go at will?
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, from what you imply, does Lord Nether Moon God intend to intervene in the chaos of the East Sea?" Wan Tianren pondered briefly and tested the waters with his question, unconsciously elevating the honorific from "elder" to "Lord."
"My Lord does indeed have such an intention, but he will only protect his own believers," Yuan Ming said.
This couldn't be clearer. To receive the protection of the Nether Moon God, one must join the Moon God Sect and pray devoutly.
"I am willing to join the Moon God Sect and obey the commands of Lord Nether Moon God," Wan Tianren said without hesitation.
With Fusang Island no longer in existence and harboring deep animosity towards the Wu Yue Sect, his lack of strength meant that seeking revenge on his own wasn't feasible; joining the Moon God Sect was the best option at the moment.
"I am also willing to serve Lord Nether Moon God, only asking that he protect Jin Ao Island," Gu Xuanyang said after a slight hesitation.
He understood the principle of mutual dependency very clearly. With Fusang Island having been exploited by the Wu Yue Sect, he feared this might not be the end. With the grand ambition of the Wu Yue Sect, he wasn't confident he could safely protect Jin Ao Island alone.
Seeing Wan and Gu express their stance, Yuan Ming felt very gratified internally. With the faith of these two, the supply of divine power could take a significant step forward. Naturally, he would not fail their trust and would consider well how to deal with the Wu Yue Sect, as his own conflict with them was also irreconcilable.
More importantly, his parents were still in the East Sea.
The most up‑to‑date version is on *.
As Gu Xuanyang's words concluded, suddenly the scene before him blurred slightly, and then he found himself in a misty white space where solemn and tranquil sounds of bells and tripods echoed, and a huge, bright round moon floated in mid-air.
Above the moon, a divine statue appeared, as if a high and mighty deity looking down upon the earth, emitting endless majesty that made one involuntarily pay respect.
"This is my divine statue; you must pray earnestly every day. Those who are not sincere will not be protected," the majestic and solemn voice of the Nether Moon God echoed in Gu Xuanyang's Sea of Consciousness.
His Divine Soul shook violently, as if the voice of the Nether Moon God, if any louder, could blow it away.
"What a terrifying majesty; this Nether Moon God truly is a Returning Void presence, or perhaps a Spoken Witch!" Gu Xuanyang's eyes flickered with shock, and he lowered his head.
Just then, his vision blurred, the white space disappeared without a trace, and he was back in reality.
Gu Xuanyang instinctively looked up into the sky, and beside him, Wan Tianren did the same, seemingly having experienced the same event.
"Welcome, both of you Fellow Daoists, to the Moon God Sect. However, as I mentioned earlier, Lord Nether Moon God only protects his believers. Fellow Daoist Gu, if you want Lord Nether Moon God's protection over Golden Turtle Island, you'll need to convert the disciples of the island to follow the Moon God Sect," Yuan Ming's voice came from ahead.
"This... I understand," Gu Xuanyang said, slightly startled.
Yuan Ming glanced at the people present. The islands that the current crowd belonged to all worshipped the Moon God Sect. These islands almost dominated half of the East Sea Immortal Cultivation World. As long as he took action a few times in the upcoming battles with the Wuyue Sect and demonstrated divine might, converting all cultivators of the East Sea to believers was not a dream.
If such a day ever came, he wondered what immense Desire Power it would generate, and his Divine Soul Cultivation might significantly increase once again.
Thinking of this, he couldn't help but feel a surge of excitement within.
"Given the rapidly changing situation in the East Sea Immortal Cultivation World, you should all hasten back to your respective islands and take charge. If you encounter difficulties, you can seek help from Lord Nether Moon God!" Yuan Ming said.
The people present showed a look of distress upon hearing this.
According to what Yuan Ming had just said, the ancient Transmission Array in the Void Temple was destroyed, and using the Transmission Array of the True Sea Hall was no longer possible. Returning to the Inner Sea by Flying Escape would take years—everything was too late.
"You needn't worry, I have a Flying Magical Treasure here named the Nine Heavens Flowing Light Shuttle. It was refined by the Wanqu Clan and can harness the Star Power to achieve Flight, reaching astonishing speeds. If we do not consider the cost, it could cross the outer sea in a month," Wan Tianren said as he produced a white shuttle about a meter long decorated with many blue light spots, which looked rather mystical.
"The Nine Heavens Flowing Light Shuttle! I have read about it in the classics on this island. When fully powered, its speed could match that of the Returning Void beings. I had no idea you had such a treasure, Fellow Daoist Wan. How many people can it carry?" Gu Xuanyang said excitedly.
"I dare not say for too many, but it can still carry twenty to thirty people," Wan Tianren manipulated a spell, and the Nine Heavens Flowing Light Shuttle emanated layers of white light, quickly expanding in size and transforming into a white, giant shuttle about thirty meters long in an instant.
Thin blue light flowed around the shuttle, with many points of starlight twinkling amongst it, as if summoning the starry sky to the ground.
"Thank you very much, Fellow Daoist Wan. Yet, as Fusang Island is now gone, you will have a lot of expenses in the future and won't have much disposable wealth. Allow Golden Turtle Island to bear the cost of using this shuttle," Gu Xuanyang said, jumping onto the shuttle with a warm smile.
"It's just an item, I am not concerned about it, I appreciate your kindness, Fellow Daoist Gu," Wan Tianren said lightly, with a flash of sharpness in his eyes.
Yuan Ming observed their expressions, internally noting that Gu Xuanyang was indeed ambitious. Just as Fusang Island met its doom, this person was already coveting the title of the number one island of the East Sea.
But such trivial matters, he couldn't be bothered with and chose to ignore them.
Others also jumped on board, quickly occupying most of the space on the shuttle.
Yuan Ming was about to board when the voice of Xi Ying suddenly resounded in his Sea of Consciousness, directly advising him to stay behind.
Seeing Yuan Ming not moving, Hua Zhi also halted and looked toward him.
"Divine Envoy Yuan, aren't you coming?" Wan Tianren asked, noticing the situation.
"You go ahead. Lord Nether Moon God has other tasks for me; I need to stay in the outer sea for a while longer," Yuan Ming replied.
"Is that so? That's too bad. I was hoping to spend more time with Divine Envoy Yuan," Wan Tianren said, his expression showing regret, before leaping onto the shuttle.
"Fellow Daoist Wan, you are familiar with the East Sea. Could you help me gather information about the movements of the Tide-rider Alliance and any news on the Blood Demon Ancestor?" Yuan Ming asked.
"Of course, although Fusang Island has now fallen to foes, we still have quite a few strongholds in the East Sea, and our network of information hasn't been completely eradicated yet. I will contact you as soon as I have any news," Wan Tianren readily agreed, waving his hand to give Yuan Ming three Sound Transmission Talismans, then activated the Nine Heavens Flowing Light Shuttle, turning into a streak of blue light and leaving.
Watching the Nine Heavens Flowing Light Shuttle swiftly disappear into the sky, Yuan Ming stored Hua Zhi into the Spiritual Beast Bag, then turned to Guoguo, "You just mentioned having something to do; what is it?"
"Have you forgotten? We agreed earlier that once we are out of the secret realm, we would head to the outskirts of the outer sea to explore the Overseas World," Xi Ying snorted, her expression slightly discontented.
"Had you not mentioned it, I nearly forgot," Yuan Ming said, smacking his forehead, then remembered this matter.
He gave an awkward smile, took Hua Zhi in, and then, with a wave of his hand, summoned Lei Yu.
Lei Yu had also not been idle for thirty years in the Time Cave; its strength had significantly improved, and its body had grown again, with the thunder patterns on its wings becoming even more splendid.
Unfortunately, due to the lack of the Power of thunder and lightning in the space of the Time Cave, Lei Yu ultimately failed to break through to the Third-level Upper Stage.
Yuan Ming, with Guoguo, leaped onto Lei Yu's back. Lei Yu cried out into the sky and then flapped its wings, flying in the opposite direction to where Wan Tianren and the others had gone.

chapters.title: Chapter 634 - 606: Overseas World
chapters.content:
Three Immortal Island Secret Realm, atop Penglai Immortal Island.
Hou Yi's Sun Shooting Bow floated in mid-air, and a cluster of star-like spirit light surged in the sky, slowly dissipating.
The bow appeared to breathe a sigh of relief, then turned to look at the Great Wilderness Star River Pearl beside it.
"Stop sleeping, get up!" A large hand made of golden light emerged and strongly patted the Great Wilderness Star River Pearl.
The Great Wilderness Star River Pearl trembled twice, and a silver-clothed girl slowly emerged from within.
"Hou Yi's Sun Shooting Bow, why are you here? Why have you awakened me?" The girl appeared to be only about twelve or thirteen years old, looking drowsy.
"What time do you think it is, and you're still asleep? The Undead Tree Demon has already been eradicated!" said Hou Yi's Sun Shooting Bow.
The silver-clothed girl became completely alert, her eyes emitting two streaks of silver light a zhang long as she looked around, her face quickly showing excitement.
"So the Old Tree Demon is truly dead! That's great, finally no need to be forced into labor. Who did this?"
"It was a group of outsiders, not only the Undead Tree Demon has fallen but the Evil King Mirror was also taken by them. We can finally breathe easy," Hou Yi's Sun Shooting Bow said.
"The Undead Tree Demon is one thing, merely a Spirit Tree brought back from Overseas by our masters, but the Evil King Mirror is from the Demon World. With it being on Three Immortals Island, we could still keep an eye on it. Now that it has been taken away, who knows if it will significantly impact the outside world," the silver-clothed girl said, her smile slowly fading, her tone somewhat worried.
"Who cares? Since those three old geezers left the Evil King Mirror on Three Immortals Island, they implied that outsiders could take it. Why should we worry about that? Speaking of which, with no Undead Tree Demon to hold us back, we can continue what we discussed before," Hou Yi's Sun Shooting Bow said cavalierly, quickly changing the topic.
"You still plan to go to sea! Both of us know the dangers of the Overseas World. Although this Three Immortal Island space serves as a barrier, delving too deep into the Overseas is risky, no one can guarantee that Three Immortal Island space can protect us. Just the Whale Calamity alone, we can't break through, not to mention the subsequent Demon Song and the Wind Sea. You better drop that idea quickly," the silver-clothed girl's face showed fear, her head shaking like a rattle-drum.
"I am well aware of the dangers of the Overseas World. I don't plan to go too far, just need to get past the Whale Calamity to obtain some Three Light Divine Water, and refine our bodies, preparing for future advancement," Hou Yi's Sun Shooting Bow said.
"Are you sure you can get past the Whale Calamity?" the silver-clothed girl uttered softly, somewhat hesitantly.
Hou Yi's Sun Shooting Bow didn't respond; the bow's body shook slightly, and a figure appeared out of nowhere, it was the missing Qiong Yun.
Qiong Yun was in a deep sleep and had undergone a significant transformation, her skin now displayed many bizarre blue patterns that emitted a faint demon energy.
"This pattern…" the silver-clothed girl's expression changed.For a smoother reading experience, visit MV&LEMPYR.
"Indeed, these are the Azure Sea Whale Veins. This woman is a human-demon hybrid, and contains the bloodline power of the Azure Sea's Blue Whale King. If we can stimulate it, there's a great chance of getting past the Whale Calamity," Hou Yi's Sun Shooting Bow said.
"If it truly is the Bloodline Power of the Azure Sea's Blue Whale King, there really is a great chance of overcoming the Whale Calamity. Let's not delay, let's start right away! Wait, where's the Lank Chessboard? Stimulating the Bloodline Power takes time, his Lank Chess Formation would have been perfect to help delay time," the silver-clothed girl initially rejoiced, then looked around and asked.
"Black and White sacrificed his body, shifted into a replicated Spiritual Treasure brought by outsiders, taking the opportunity to break free from the island's Forbidden restrictions, and followed those people to the outside," Hou Yi's Sun Shooting Bow explained.
"Is that so? Lank schemed for many years and has finally left this cage, maybe he was right," the silver-clothed girl said.
"To each their own, let's not talk about him anymore, we better start preparing. We need to leave before the next storm in the Wind Sea, otherwise we'll have to wait another few hundred years," Hou Yi's Sun Shooting Bow urged.
...
The place where Hou Yi's Sun Shooting Bow sent Yuan Ming and the others wasn't far from the Overseas World; they arrived within half a day with the speed of Lei Yu.
"This is the Overseas World, truly magnificent!" Yuan Ming stood up, exclaiming in awe.
The sea area beneath him had wind and waves as well, at most about twenty or thirty zhang high, but several miles away the sea surface suddenly boiled, lifting waves ten times higher and visible tornadoes pulling the seawater into towering water columns reaching the heavens.
Above the sky, dark clouds piled up layer upon layer, many thick thunder and lightning moving about; occasionally when thunder and lightning collided and converged, it would create a dazzling area of thunder spanning several mu, or even tens of mu.
Many giant thunders, Thunder Balls fell from the thunder area, destroying the towering waves below, the void vibrated, and it seemed like the heavens and the earth were about to collapse.
Although Yuan Ming had heard about the harsh environment of the Overseas World several times, seeing it for the first time still left him astonished.
The environment of the outer sea was harsh enough, but compared to the Overseas World, it was practically a tranquil and peaceful paradise. No wonder even a Returning Void existence like the Shura Master couldn't cross it.
"Gaga…" Lei Yu flapped its wings excitedly, as if the violent scene of thunder and lightning stirred its innate demon beast ferocity.
"This Thunder Wing Bird of yours is quite exceptional. Ordinary demon beasts would be terrified by the atmosphere of the Overseas World, yet it shows no fear," Xi Ying's voice sounded in Yuan Ming's ear.
Yuan Ming looked at the Thunder Wing Bird beneath him. During the previous Immortal Fruit Conference, someone had discussed this bird, believing it contained the bloodline power of the ancient Thunder Peng. He had heard them but hadn't paid much attention. Could it possibly be true?
"Master, may I go to cultivate amidst the outer thunder clouds?" Lei Yu transmitted a message asking.
"There are numerous dangers ahead, and the thunder and lightning there are violent and brutal, incomparable to those in the inner and outer seas," Yuan Ming said.
"Master, rest assured, I know my limits. I will only cultivate nearby and not venture too far. Moreover, for some reason, the environment ahead gives me a long-lost sense of familiarity," Lei Yu said.
Yuan Ming raised his eyebrows and took out the Thunder God Bombarding Divine Hammer and threw it out, "If that's the case, then go ahead and take this Magic Treasure to protect your body."
The Thunder God Bombarding Divine Hammer needed to absorb a massive amount of the power of thunder and lightning to unleash its full might, and the thunderstorms rampant in the clouds of the Overseas World made it the perfect place.
With the Thunder God Bombarding Divine Hammer for protection, Lei Yu's safety would have an additional layer of assurance.
Knowing the Thunder God Bombarding Divine Hammer, Lei Yu thanked him profusely, swallowed it, and with a flap of his wings, entered the Overseas World. He struggled through the hurricane and finally plunged headfirst into the thunderclouds hanging mid-air.
Yuan Ming watched closely ahead while the Undying Tree Roots in his Dantian primed themselves for action.
The demon power of the Undying Tree had risen to the peak of Level 4 by now, and the reach of its roots had greatly increased, sufficient to rescue Lei Yu.
As soon as he flew into the thunderclouds, Lei Yu activated his divine power to summon thunder and lightning, forming a large swath of rain clouds around him and drawing in the nearby power of thunder and lightning.
Sizzle...
The thunder and lightning that wildly darted about in the cloud layer were drawn toward Lei Yu.
In the Overseas World, not only was the thunder and lightning intense, but it was also exceptionally violent; Lei Yu's body emitted crackling sounds, and many areas on his skin showed burnt marks.
Yet, Lei Yu did not scream in pain. Instead, excitement shone in his eyes, as if he immensely enjoyed the baptism of the violent thunder and lightning.
A sharp, piercing cry emanated from within the thunderclouds as Lei Yu stimulated the thunder-absorbing ability of the Thunder God Bombarding Divine Hammer within him and spread his wings.
Hundreds of lightning arcs shot out from above, attracting even more thunder and lightning power.
The burnt marks on Lei Yu's body multiplied, and he began to lose feathers, yet the demonic energy within him did not diminish but rather started to increase.
"To be able to directly use the power of thunder and lightning to temper your body, it seems this Thunder Wing Bird truly has a trace of the Thunder Peng bloodline; its future potential should not be underestimated," Xi Ying remarked.
"Lei Yu is indeed extraordinary, but Xi Ying, you wouldn't have brought me here just to enjoy the view of the Overseas World, right?" Yuan Ming replied.
"What, you have complaints about accompanying me here?" Xi Ying snorted softly.
"Of course not, but you've always been extremely methodical in your actions. Right now, with the Wu Yue Sect massively attacking the East Sea, the situation in the Inner Sea must be chaotic. You probably aren't in the mood to just enjoy the scenery, are you?" Yuan Ming remarked.
"In your eyes, am I someone who loves stirring trouble and is keen on conflicts?" Xi Ying said with an unexpected expression.
"I didn't say that, but you previously mentioned dealing with the Wu Yue Sect, and now they've already reached into the East Sea. Can you afford to continue staying here?" Yuan Ming said.
"You guessed right. Besides sightseeing, I indeed have another purpose here. I need to hunt a few Ghost-faced Fish and extract some fish oil, which thrive at the boundary between the Overseas World and the outer sea," Xi Ying said after a moment of silence.
Guoguo opened her mouth and spat out a Jade Scroll, which landed in front of Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming activated his Divine Sense to probe, and the Jade Scroll contained detailed information about the Ghost-faced Fish, a Level 4 demon beast skilled in Concealment and stealth attacks, though not particularly powerful in combat.
"So it's such a minor matter. Don't worry, leave it to me," Yuan Ming said without inquiring about Xi Ying's need for the fish oil and nodded.
The Divine Sense enhanced by the Stealing Heaven Tripod could penetrate anything, perfectly countering the Concealing Divine Power of the Ghost-faced Fish. With his current strength, a mere Level 4 Ghost-faced Fish was nothing more than an easy catch.
"Master, let me handle this. I, too, want to stretch my limbs in the Overseas World," Hua Zhi flew out from the Spiritual Beast Bag, patting her chest as she spoke.
"Sure, your regenerative ability is very strong, so wandering around the outskirts of the Overseas World should be safe," Yuan Ming, startled, handed the Jade Scroll to Hua Zhi.
Hua Zhi cheered excitedly, flew into the sea, and submerged.
Yuan Ming let Hua Zhi replace him for a reason; he was busy with many things at the moment and somewhat overwhelmed.
He put Guoguo into Stealing Heaven Tripod and then also dived into the sea, quickly reaching the seabed.
Yuan Ming opened up a simple Cave Mansion at the seabed, spread a Barrier with the Silver Token, took out a stick of Possession Black Incense, lit it, and placed it into the Stealing Heaven Tripod to activate the possessing divine power.
His consciousness plunged into darkness and soon regained clarity, now possessing Wulu's body.
Wulu was currently unconscious, the Blood Puppet Armor had already been retracted, lying within a blood-red space inside a Jade coffin, which appeared to be sarcophagus-shaped.
Many patterns were engraved on the coffin wall, faintly glowing with spirit light, clearly no ordinary object.
Yuan Ming carefully examined these patterns and soon determined they were Corpse Refining Runes, totaling eighty-one in number, similar to those of the Black Fire Sect but even more profound.
Strings of Blood Light emanated from the eighty-one Corpse Refining Runes and merged into various parts of Wulu's body, slowly transforming his flesh.

chapters.title: Chapter 635 - 607: Sinister Demon Mirror
chapters.content:
"This blood-colored coffin must belong to Blood Demon Ancestor. Is he transforming Wulu's body?" Yuan Ming thought to himself upon witnessing the scene.
Wulu's current strength wasn't too strong. With Blood Demon Ancestor's methods, if he really refined him into a refining corpse, Wulu probably wouldn't be able to put up any effective resistance and would be quickly turned.
Yuan Ming and Wulu had known each other for a long time and were intimate friends. Now that he had seen this, he naturally couldn't just watch him fall like this.
Thinking over it, he activated his Divine Sense, exploring outside of the Blood Jade Coffin to pinpoint Wulu's current location.
However, the coffin walls had some sort of forbiddance, and the Divine Sense affected by Black Incense, without the enhancement of the Stealing Heaven Tripod, was easily repelled.
Yuan Ming thought deeply for a moment, then tried to influence Wulu with his Soul Seal Divine Skill to awaken him.
But at that moment, an invisible force surged from within Wulu's Divine Soul, blocking the effect of the Soul Seal.
Yuan Ming was secretly alarmed. The possession of Black Incense was exceptionally covert and had never been discovered by anyone. His Soul Seal Divine Skill, even when used against those whose cultivation was far above his, might not affect the opponent but had never been detected—yet, today, an exception had occurred.
He saw Wulu's Divine Soul emit strands of blue light, slowly condensing into a grey Stone Talisman phantom, the same Heavenly Escape Stone Talisman he had seen once before.
Yuan Ming's eyebrows flickered, ceased applying the Soul Seal, and the Heavenly Escape Stone Talisman vanished accordingly.
"It seems the Heavenly Escape Stone Talisman is protecting Wulu's Divine Soul from being tainted. There's no trace of Blood Demon Ancestor's presence within Wulu's Sea of Consciousness. It seems he hasn't discovered this item yet. With the protection of the Heavenly Escape Stone Talisman, even if Wulu is turned into a refining corpse, his life shouldn't be in great danger for the time being." Yuan Ming thought to himself.
He was slightly relieved, and seeing that he was temporarily unable to awaken him, he turned to study the eighty-one Corpse Refining Runes on the walls of the blood-colored coffin.
The blood light emitted by these runes was a mix of Qi-Blood power and Yin Qi, infusing into various parts of Wulu's body, some in the muscles, some in the bones, some in the meridians.
Wulu's body was absorbing the blood light quickly, visibly enhancing his physical strength.
"Such a clever method of refining corpses, a pity I can't see the whole picture," Yuan Ming lamented.
He sensed for a moment longer until the possession time ended, and his consciousness returned to his own body.
Yuan Ming fell silent for a moment, then entered the Stealing Heaven Tripod space.
He told Xi Ying about the eighty-one Corpse Refining Runes he had seen, but Xi Ying knew little about the art of refining corpses and could not deduce Blood Demon Ancestor's purpose.
Yuan Ming shook his head, stood up, and walked to a corner of the Stealing Heaven Tripod space.Help us out by reading on *.
The Undying Tree Demon Avatar lay there, transformed into a black giant tree, its roots completely severed and firmly restrained by a Great Array—clearly Xi Ying's doing.
The Undying Tree Demon Avatar had already awakened. Seeing Yuan Ming approach, it roared, "What is this place? You outsiders are despicable and shameless, always claiming victory by outnumbering your opponents. If you have the guts, just kill me!"
"Then as you wish," Yuan Ming said with a faint smile, shooting several black roots from his palm, piercing into the Undying Tree Demon Avatar.
"Who are you? Why do you possess the power of the Undying Tree!" The Undying Tree Demon Avatar shouted, both shocked and furious.
Yuan Ming ignored it, more roots piercing into the adversary's body.
Streams of Undying Tree Demon Power were drawn forth, merging into his Undying Tree within him.
The power of the Undying Tree within Yuan Ming's Dantian once again increased, soon reaching the Half-step Level 5 stage.
The Demon Power within the Undying Tree Avatar was still abundant, and pleased with this, he absorbed it more fervently, aiming to make a final push to break through to Level 5 completely.
However, contrary to Yuan Ming's expectations, no matter how hard he tried to absorb it, the Undying Tree in his Dantian could not step over that threshold.
"Don't bother trying, one cannot forcibly break through to the Returning Void Stage with external force," the voice of Qi Ye came from within the Shura Blood Devouring Map.
"What do you mean by this, Senior Qi Ye? Why is the Returning Void Stage so special? Please enlighten me," Yuan Ming stopped and asked.
"The stages of Qi Refinement, Foundation Establishment, Core Formation, and Nascent Soul, although possessing power and lifespans beyond a mortal's imagination, are still mortal in essence. The Returning Void Stage, however, is different, representing the transition from being mortal to becoming immortal. One cannot break through using external force; enlightenment of the heavenly Dao is required," Qi Ye explained.
After hearing this, Yuan Ming fell silent for a while, then ceased his conflict and withdrew the black roots.
The black Undying Tree was now strong enough for his use.
Now debilitated, the Undying Tree Avatar lost consciousness.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming set up another layer of measures around the tree before departing.
The tree was of no great use to him, but the remaining Demon Power within it was substantial and could be absorbed by Hua Zhi to further enhance his strength.
"Now that the matters of Three Immortals Island are completely resolved, Senior Qi Ye, what are your plans going forward?" Yuan Ming sat near the altar, took out the Shura Blood Devouring Map, and asked simultaneously.
"I came to the Yunhuang Continent to find the Evil King Mirror, to destroy this object and avenge my kin. Now that the mirror is in your hands, and the Shura Blood Devouring Map has been refined by you, and I have fully integrated with the spirit of this map, naturally, I will follow you," Qi Ye said.
"Your origins are unclear, and you once existed at the Returning Void stage with many techniques at your disposal. Having you by my side, I can't be at ease," Yuan Ming said slowly.
"Then what do you suggest, Young Friend?" Qi Ye asked in a calm and unhurried manner.
"Senior Qi Ye, you may stay within the Shura Blood Devouring Map, but you must allow me to plant a forbiddance within you, otherwise, I will have no choice but to completely destroy you," Yuan Ming stated bluntly.
"Agreed," Qi Ye accepted without hesitation.
Yuan Ming's eyes flickered with surprise, but he quickly regained his composure. Placing a hand on the Shura Blood Devouring Map, swirling black Qi swarmed out and entered Qi Ye's body.
Qi Ye did not resist and calmly accepted Yuan Ming's casting.
A whole day and night passed before Yuan Ming finally ceased.
By then, Qi Ye's body was covered with black runes, resembling countless ants, which looked extremely eerie.
Yuan Ming quickly formed hand seals, bit the tip of his tongue, and sprayed out a mouthful of Essence Blood, merging it into Qi Ye's body.
A layer of Blood Light shone on Qi Ye, absorbing all the black runes into his body, completely vanishing within a few breaths.
This was a secret technique from the Six Desires Venerable, the Six Soul Heart Mantra, capable of completely controlling a person's body and mind. If the subject had any thoughts, the caster could sense them immediately.
The technique consumed a great amount of Divine Soul Power. Even with Yuan Ming's current Soul Power, his complexion turned slightly pale, and he took several deep breaths before recovering.
"Now, can you be at ease?" Qi Ye said.
"Rest assured, Fellow Daoist Qi Ye, I won't bind you forever. The day I no longer need it, I will naturally set you free," Yuan Ming said.
"Heh, I don't care about being free. In the future, when Yuan gives me the Evil King Mirror to destroy, appeasing the spirits of my deceased family will suffice," Qi Ye said indifferently.
Yuan Ming sensed the fluctuations in Qi Ye's emotions, using the Six Soul Heart Mantra to listen to his thoughts and found that Qi Ye's words just now were genuine and truthful, without deceit.
He did not say anything more at that moment, gathered up the Shura Blood Devouring Map, and then waved his hand.
A cracked black mirror flew towards him, the very Evil King Mirror.
Ever since he obtained this item, there had been constant chaos, leaving him without time to inspect this Demon World Spiritual Treasure.
Yuan Ming carefully activated his Divine Sense, probing into the Evil King Mirror.
Meanwhile, his first soul flew over, wrapping around the Soul Destroying Sword, hovering mid-air, ready to strike in case the Evil King Mirror showed any sign of activity.
The mirror was exceedingly strange, and he had to be cautious.
The Evil King Mirror lay quietly on the ground without any anomaly, seemingly having been heavily damaged and lost its power after being struck by Abyss Sword Energy.
Yuan Ming circulated his Divine Sense deeper into the Evil King Mirror and quickly his expression showed astonishment.
Magical treasures from the Demon World differed greatly from those of Yunhuang Continent. Yunhuang Continent's treasures contained only runes, nothing else, while the Evil King Mirror was engraved with many complex patterns resembling arrays, progressing in layers, extending deep into the mirror where a faint presence of rune essence was emitted.
"What are these patterns?" Yuan Ming pondered to himself, carefully probing the core area of the Evil King Mirror.
Boom!
Suddenly, the wailing of countless resentful souls echoed in his ears. A tremendous Curse Power surged from within the Evil King Mirror, far surpassing the Curse Power produced by Curse Runes, invading his Sea of Consciousness via his Divine Sense.
Yuan Ming's expression instantly twisted, veins bulged on his forehead, his head felt as if it was about to explode, leaving him unable to think or move.
His hair turned yellowish and dry, and his clothes quickly faded and rotted.
Seeing this, his first soul was shocked and immediately controlled the Soul Destroying Sword to strike, sending the Evil King Mirror flying.
The Divine Sense Yuan Ming had released dissipated, and the Curse Power also retreated back into the Evil King Mirror.
Yuan Ming gasped heavily, sat down with eyes closed, and it took him a while to recover.
"Indeed, it is a Demon Treasure from the Demon World. Such terrifying Curse Power…" He opened his eyes still showing a trace of lingering fear.
If his first soul had not made a quick decision, he could not imagine what state he would be in now.
Yuan Ming looked at the Evil King Mirror, deep in thought.
From what just happened, it was clear that the Evil King Mirror had been severely damaged and its spirit greatly lessened. If it were simply left here, it would pose no danger.
Yet, such an Exotic Treasure, being left idle would be too much of a waste. If he could control the Evil King Mirror, even just basic control, and mobilize the Curse Power contained within, the mirror could serve as an ace up his sleeve.
Qi Ye surely knew much about the Evil King Mirror, but Yuan Ming did not trust him; it would be safer to explore on his own.
After a slight pause, he formed hand seals and started refining the Evil King Mirror using the Sacrificial Refining Secret Technique taught to him by the Shura Master.
This Sacrificial Refining Secret Technique was very likely from the Demon World. Using it to refine the Evil King Mirror — a Demon Treasure — should yield unique effects.
As he expected, the refining of the Evil King Mirror went smoothly, and the patterns in the outer area quickly seeped into his Mana, creating a slight connection between him and the mirror.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming stopped casting and threw the Evil King Mirror out of the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
The virtual fluctuations of the sea bottom Cave Mansion stirred as the Evil King Mirror spontaneously emerged, "clang" it hit the ground, rolling twice before stopping.
Yuan Ming took a deep breath, circulated his Divine Sense out of the Stealing Heaven Tripod, and probed again into the Evil King Mirror.
The Curse Power within the Evil King Mirror was far too terrifying. Now, with some connection with the mirror, this might help him control the Curse Power within, yet it also increased the danger manifold. Only by casting from behind the protection of the Stealing Heaven Tripod could he feel somewhat safer.

chapters.title: Chapter 636 - 608: Solving the Drawbacks
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming's Divine Sense quickly touched the core of the Evil King Mirror, and a terrifying curse erupted again, assaulting the Stealing Heaven Tripod from inside along the path of his Divine Sense.
He was prepared in his heart and hurriedly tried to control this Curse Power using the connection he had obtained through refining.
Although this Curse Power was powerful, it seemed like a confused child and was very easily controlled, immediately stopping in its tracks.
"It really works!" Yuan Ming's eyes showed a hint of surprise.
He hadn't held much hope for this action, even planning to try other methods if this failed, but unexpectedly, it succeeded!
Although the Curse Power inside the Evil King Mirror was controlled, this power was highly infectious, attacking everything indiscriminately, and quickly followed Yuan Ming's Divine Sense into the space within the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
Yuan Ming once again suffered an excruciating pain that drove him insane, almost wishing he could chop off his own head.
However, this also caused his Divine Sense, which extended outside the Stealing Heaven Tripod, to collapse, breaking the connection with the Evil King Mirror.
Yuan Ming regained consciousness, closed his eyes to control his breathing for a long time, and then recuperated, his eyes bright and clear.
The previous effort was not in vain; he now had confidence in controlling the Curse Power inside the mirror.
But this Curse Power was too powerful, unconsciously infecting everything around it, and even he, the master, would suffer, so he had to find a medium that could insulate from the erosion of the Curse Power.
Yuan Ming quickly thought of a suitable medium and took out the Soul Destroying Sword.
This sword contained Curse Runes and could, to some extent, resist the Curse Power within the Evil King Mirror.
Yuan Ming activated the Curse Runes of the Soul Destroying Sword, and an invisible force merged into the Evil King Mirror.
The Curse Power inside the Evil King Mirror was immediately stirred, Yuan Ming quickly controlled this power and used the Soul Destroying Sword to block it, preventing it from entering the space of the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
The Soul Destroying Sword did not disappoint him; the power of the Curse Runes shielded the Curse Power of the Evil King Mirror from the outside, unable to cross the Thunder Pond.
However, the Curse Power of the Evil King Mirror was too strong, and the Soul Destroying Sword could not block it indefinitely; it barely lasted for about a dozen breaths before showing signs of weakening.
Yuan Ming did not mind; a dozen breaths had already been enough.
He retracted his Divine Sense, and the Evil King Mirror once again returned to calm.
After a moment's thought, Yuan Ming put away the Evil King Mirror and did not continue to experiment.
Having achieved this much, he was already satisfied. This treasure was too sinister; it was better not to have too much contact with it.
Yuan Ming did not get up; instead, he continued to close his eyes and control his breathing, then reached out his hand into the void.
A person flew out from the nearby fog and fell in front of him, it was Jia Sifang.
At this moment, Jia Sifang had regained consciousness but was sealed in his Mana and Divine Sense, glowering at Yuan Ming: "What place is this, what do you want? I am a member of the Tide-rider Alliance, if you strike me, the others from the Tide-rider Alliance won't let you off!"
"The Tide-rider Alliance is no more," Yuan Ming said indifferently.
"What did you say?" Jia Sifang was slightly stunned, his face incredulous.
Yuan Ming did not elaborate; he simply told Jia Sifang about how Blood Demon Ancestor killed all the people of the Tide-rider Alliance.
Jia Sifang's facial expression went through a series of changes, seeming to verify the truth of Yuan Ming's words, and after a long while, his eyes became somewhat vacant, muttering to himself.
"The Blood Demon Ancestor captured my friend, and you, the Tide-rider Alliance on Three Immortals Island, have never shown me any goodwill. Although we have no grudges, I cannot let you leave here alive," Yuan Ming lifted his right hand, and a shadow-like black palm pressed towards Jia Sifang's head.
"No! Fellow Daoist, please spare my life, Jia knows many secret techniques, the Tide-rider Alliance has obtained many precious spiritual materials from the Overseas World, I am willing to offer everything to Fellow Daoist, please spare my life..." Jia Sifang suddenly came to his senses, crying out loudly for mercy.
Yuan Ming remained unmoved, the black palm pressing on his head, invading inside.
This black hand was the Soul Searching Palm formed by Yuan Ming after breaking through the Sleeping Witch, similar to the blue palm of the Empty Gloves, which could not only search the soul but also modify the memory of others.
As the black hand intruded, Jia Sifang's fierce expression quickly calmed down, his eyes turning dull.
Yuan Ming quickly withdrew his hand, a trace of disappointment flashing in his eyes.
In Jia Sifang's memory, he found little of value, only discovering a few hidden strongholds of the Tide-rider Alliance.
Jia Sifang knew very little about Yuan Wuji, and even less about the Blood Demon Ancestor, so he was of no help in finding Wulu.
The only thing that surprised Yuan Ming was that Jia Sifang also had a set of Blood Puppet Armor sealed inside his Dantian, refined into something like a Lifebound Magical Treasure.
The other members of the Tide-rider Alliance also used secret techniques to refine the Blood Puppet Armor into Lifebound Magical Treasures, enabling them to wear and remove it at will.
According to Jia Sifang's memory, all the Blood Puppet Armors of the Tide-rider Alliance members were gifts from Yuan Wuji, who seemed to have many such armors.
"Yuan Wuji's Blood Puppet Armor must have come from the Blood Demon Ancestor, the very creator of such armor. It's not surprising he has many of them. Moreover, he's cunning and devious. I fear he might stir up some trouble yet," Yuan Ming thought to himself.
He then summoned the Shura Blood Devouring Map, and a wave of blood light enveloped Jia Sifang, dragging him into the map.
The blood light on the Shura Blood Devouring Map surged and flickered ceaselessly.
After a long while, a blood shadow flew out from the map and fell to the ground, turning into the blood slave that Jia Sifang had become, just like Hong Ling, leaving only the skin on his face while his body turned into a skeleton.
With a "plop", a blood-colored armor fell to the ground beside him, specifically Jia Sifang's Blood Puppet Armor.
Yuan Ming picked up the armor, and his Divine Sense briefly entered it to inspect, revealing a look of surprise on his face.
Inside the Blood Puppet Armor were channels of blood-red runes flowing throughout, much like the meridians in a human body, and at the locations corresponding to the Dantian and the top of the head, there were sections similar to the Dantian and the Sea of Consciousness, housing a surge of Mana and a clump of Divine Soul, respectively.
This Blood Puppet Armor was almost indistinguishable from a living person.
"The Blood Demon Ancestor really is formidable, to have created a person using the techniques of Artifact Refining," Yuan Ming couldn't help but exclaim.
He himself had some attainment in Artifact Refining, but he was far inferior to the Blood Demon Ancestor.
Yuan Ming sensed that the Mana stored inside the Blood Puppet Armor had reached the level equivalent to the Nascent Soul Middle Stage, yet it was definitely not Jia Sifang's Magic Power Divine Soul; it must have been sealed inside long ago.
Yuan Ming paused, a look of sudden joy appearing on his face.
The drawback of the Blood Puppet Armor was that the sealed Mana inside it was difficult to preserve for long. Once a new user was devoured by the armor, they would replace the Mana previously sealed inside.
Yet, just as Jia Sifang had perished, his Magic Power Divine Soul had been snatched away by the Shura Blood Devouring Map, leaving the stored Magic Power Divine Soul inside the armor unchanged.
This meant that the problem with the Blood Puppet Armor was now resolved. As long as the users were refined by the Shura Blood Devouring Map before they perished, there was no need to worry about the powerful Mana inside being replaced.
"The Blood Puppet Armor and the Shura Blood Devouring Map's Divine Ability are similar; both can seal and preserve a cultivator's Mana. It seems, however, that the Shura Blood Devouring Map is still the superior one," Yuan Ming thought to himself.
The Blood Puppet Armor would erode its wearers undoubtedly, so he would never wear it himself, but it might be useful for some expendable subordinates.
If properly used, the armor could create a supremely skilled expert, potentially very useful in future conflicts against the Wuyue God.
Yuan Ming put away the Blood Puppet Armor and the Shura Blood Devouring Map and was about to continue inspecting other items when a message from the first soul seated on the White Jade Lotus Platform came, notifying him that Xu Che had something to report.
During this time, the first soul had mostly been within the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space, diligently receiving the prayers of believers and responding when necessary.
Yuan Ming sat on the White Jade Lotus Platform and quickly understood the situation there.
By then, Xu Che had already properly arranged the followers who had moved to Da Jin and began vigorously developing secular believers.
This copy was generated from content at *.
The resurgence of the Wu Yue Sect had not only shaken the Cultivation World of Da Jin but also left the secular world in a state of panic. Religious faith was the best way to soothe people's hearts, and Xu Che took the opportunity to preach vigorously. The Ming Yue Sect's development was going well, with the number of believers increasing rapidly.
After everything was on track, Xu Che, accompanied by a few key members, was heading towards the East Sea.
"Secular believers, compared to cultivators, have a negligible effect, but their number is a thousand to ten thousand times that of cultivators and should not be underestimated. You've done well, Xu Che," Yuan Ming commended Xu Che's adaptability.
After leaving Three Immortals Island, the collection of Desire Power was no longer affected and continued to surge, with the vast majority generated by secular believers. Before subduing more Cultivator believers, the development of secular believers also must not be neglected.
"It's all because of the resources bestowed by the Lord; I simply did what I needed to," Xu Che didn't take credit for himself.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming was even more pleased with Xu Che.
"Your Cultivation has improved quite a bit. Good. Although preaching is important, as a Cultivator, strength is fundamental," he appraised Xu Che and nodded in approval.
"It was purely by chance; I stumbled upon an Earth Attribute Earth Dragon Stone some time ago, which unexpectedly has a miraculous effect in stimulating the Earth Core Magnetic Skill. That's how my Cultivation managed to advance," Xu Che replied.
"The Earth Dragon Stone is a rare Earth Attribute spiritual material possessing Primordial Magnetic Power, akin to the Earth Core Magnetic Skill, hence it can stimulate this skill. You've had a good opportunity. After a while, you may attempt Core Formation. I will grant you these two items now," Yuan Ming raised his hand and bestowed two items to Xu Che, which turned out to be a dark gold Spirit Fruit and a Jade Scroll.
"This... could this be the Spirit Origin Fruit?" Xu Che widened his eyes as he looked at the dark gold Spirit Fruit.
"I'm surprised you recognize it. Yes, this is the Spirit Origin Fruit, a recent find of mine, beneficial for Core Formation. As for the Jade Scroll, it contains a secret technique called the Hidden Vein Condensing Pill Technique, also beneficial for Core Formation. I'll give you a portion of Washing Elixir Spirit Liquid later. This time, you must succeed in Core Formation. As the Ming Yue Sect grows, your strength must also rapidly improve," Yuan Ming encouraged.
"Yes, I will definitely not disappoint you, my Lord!" Xu Che suppressed the excitement in his heart and quickly responded.
"Once you succeed in Core Formation, I have a task for you. Go to all the Major Sects and collect the incense ashes they use to worship their ancestors. The older the sect and the more people who have worshipped, the better the incense ashes will be," Yuan Ming thought for a moment and instructed.
The incense ashes needed for creating Black Incense were running low; a fresh batch was necessary.
Such tedious tasks were easier handed down to subordinates.
"Incense ashes? As you command," Xu Che was taken aback but agreed without hesitation.
Yuan Ming gave Xu Che a few more instructions and then withdrew his Divine Sense, beginning to contact Yan Siyun.

chapters.title: Chapter 637 - 609: Spore Avatar
chapters.content:
At this moment, the Yan sisters had returned to Dragon King City and were focusing their efforts on managing the business of Hundred Pills Square, which had already begun to establish a reputation.
Yan Siyun needs no further mention, as this woman had a unique insight into strategy, and her ability to collect and analyze information was impeccable. She had familiarized herself with the details of every cultivator in Dragon King City, their preferences, and the main competitors. Hence, she had already developed a clear plan on how to expand and strengthen Hundred Pills Square.
Yan Sijing was just as capable in practical implementation, meticulously executing her sister's plans step by step, creating a very favorable situation.
Furthermore, through her skilled manipulation of three kinds of True Fire, she made Hundred Pills Square's elixirs both high-quality and affordable, resulting in an increasingly booming business. Elixirs refined from demon beast flesh and blood were especially popular among Qi Refinement Realm, Foundation Establishment Stage cultivators, and even with some Core Formation Stage cultivators who were short on funds.
After all, with the current turbulence in the East Sea situation, everyone was on edge. The risk of obtaining Spirit Stone resources had increased, and as a result, the number of people wanting to have more elixirs on hand had also increased.
Upon hearing this news, Yuan Ming suddenly felt a tinge of annoyance.
The White Scale Master had initially captured Yan Sijing to extract the Ice Core Yin Fire from her body, with the intention of refining a Six Orifice Pill Furnace named Dragon Tiger Green Mysterious Furnace, which he presumably possessed.
During the fierce battle in the underground soluble cave, Yuan Ming had completely forgotten about this matter and failed to collect the body of the White Scale Master, thereby missing out on the opportunity to obtain the top-tier Dragon Tiger Green Mysterious Furnace.
Yuan Ming felt only a slight regret, as he did not dwell on past events. He quickly composed himself and inquired about the current war situation in the East Sea.
Yan Siyun knew that the Nether Moon God paid close attention to the situation in the East Sea, so she naturally devoted much of her effort to monitoring the war situation there. As for the business aspect, it was merely a byproduct, serving as a cover.
According to the latest information she held, the Wu Yue Sect, after capturing Fusang Island, was gradually coaxing other islands in the East Sea. Many third-class islands, second-class islands, and even some first-class islands had already aligned themselves, openly or covertly, with the Wu Yue Sect.
Moreover, the Wu Yue Sect did not remain idle; they were vigorously besieging the islands of Jin Ao, Di Hua, and Kongling, intending to eradicate the leading island powers in the East Sea in one fell swoop.
At the present, the Wu Yue Sect's expansion in the East Sea seemed unstoppable, with no one to contend against them.
"Very good, this intelligence is timely. You shall be commended," Yuan Ming expressed appreciation of Yan Siyun's competence.
"It is an honor for the Yan Family to serve the Nether Moon God," Yan Siyun replied humbly, not taking any credit.

"Your Cultivation progress is not insignificant; you've reached the Late Foundation Establishment. In time, you can consider advancing to Core Formation. This Spirit Origin Fruit is granted to you as a reward for this occasion," Yuan Ming plucked a Spirit Origin Fruit and placed it before Yan Siyun, also giving her some spiritual materials and other items.
Hundred Pills Square conducted elixir business, and with her extensive knowledge, Yan Siyun was well aware of the remarkable benefits of the Spirit Origin Fruit, so she thanked him profusely with great joy.
Yuan Ming then informed Yan Siyun about the impending arrival of Xu Che and others to the East Sea, instructing her to receive them and later bestowing a Washing Elixir Spirit Liquid upon Xu Che. Afterward, he withdrew his Divine Sense.
"It seems that the Wu Yue Sect has great ambitions; unifying the East Sea is probably just their first step. I wonder where Wan Tianren and the others have gone?" he murmured to himself, using the Desire Power anchor point to locate Wan Tianren and his party, informing them of the situation in the East Sea.
Wan Tianren, Gu Xuanyang, and the others were naturally anxious upon receiving this news and increased the speed of the Nine Heavens Flowing Light Shuttle.
...
Yuan Ming then communed with his Second Split Soul to understand that Evergreen Island, where his parents were, remained untouched by the war and everything was normal, before retracting his Divine Sense and stepping away from the White Jade Lotus Platform.
The affairs of the East Sea would be left to Wan Tianren and others to deal with. Although the Wu Yue Sect currently appeared unstoppable, once Wan Tianren and Gu Xuanyang returned in time, they should be able to halt the Wu Yue Sect's onslaught. These islands had been rooted in the East Sea for many years and would not be easily overcome. Yuan Ming would continue to stay in the outer sea, focusing on consolidating his Cultivation.
With a wave of his sleeve, Yuan Ming dropped a small pile of storage magic tools onto the ground.
These were collected by Hua Zhi into the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space during the grand battle in the soluble cave, belonging to the Tree-man Puppets.
He picked up a high-grade storage magic tool, likely belonging to a Nascent Soul Stage Tree-man Puppet. As his Divine Sense entered, his brow furrowed.
Aside from two or three mediocre magic treasures, the storage magic tool was empty; there were neither spiritual materials and elixirs nor Jade Scroll Books.
After a moment's thought, Yuan Ming realized that the contents of the storage magic tools were probably taken by the Undead Tree Demon.
Once the foreign cultivators were refined into Tree-man Puppets, the spiritual materials and elixirs were no longer of use to them and were taken by the Undead Tree Demon, leaving only a few magic treasures for combat purposes.
After all, in the eyes of the Undead Tree Demon, Tree-man Puppets relied more on quantity over individual strength and were even sacrificed when necessary—its concern wasn't with each puppet's Power.
Wan Tianren and the others still had their possessions, likely because the Undead Tree Demon didn't have time to plunder them amid the urgent need to send these newly created puppets into battle.
Yuan Ming quickly examined all the storage magic tools, which verified his speculation—they all contained only a few magic treasures.
This didn't matter much to him; with his considerable wealth, he was not concerned about this external wealth.
Yuan Ming quickly sorted through these magic treasures, totaling sixty-five.
He stored the five Nine Rune Magical Treasures and thirteen Eight Rune Treasures into the Thousand Treasures Scripture Pillar, taking the rest.
Having dealt with these matters, Yuan Ming simultaneously focused on Lei Yu's Cultivation progress and on refining the Desire Power gathering around to enhance his Divine Soul Realm.
Three days swiftly passed.
Lei Yu was still cultivating, but Hua Zhi had returned, bringing back five portions of Ghost-faced Fish Oil.
"You've completed the task so quickly?" Yuan Ming was quite surprised.
"Hehe, I was just lucky. I went out for a day and encountered a nest of Ghost-faced Fish with eight of them. I killed five by ambush, and the remaining three escaped." Hua Zhi said with a smile, handing the five Jade Boxes to Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming's Divine Sense swiftly swept through the Jade Boxes, seeing they were filled with a pliable, white, creamy substance, emitting a slightly pungent but fragrant scent, identical to the description of Ghost-faced Fish Oil in the Xi Ying Jade Scrolls.
"Very good, well done," he nodded in approval.
"Master, the reward must be substantive. Xu Che and Yan Siyun only did a little and you bestowed upon them many fine items. I've toiled for three days and do not wish for mere empty praise," Hua Zhi said, stretching out her hand.
Yuan Ming was taken aback as his Divine Sense spread out, but found nothing.
He lifted his right arm, which transformed into a branch of the Undying Tree, touching the White Jade Lotus Platform.
Desire Power surged from the Lotus Platform, blending with his Divine Soul, and his near Half-step Word Witch level Divine Sense instantly enveloped the space within the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
"How cunning of you, Hua Zhi, to start spying on me!" Yuan Ming flicked a strand of Soul Destroying Sword Energy, cutting through the Spirit Origin Fruit Tree.
A tiny figure formed from a transparent thread fell out of the trunk of the Spirit Origin Fruit Tree, devoid of any signs of life.
"Ow! Master, don't be angry, I was just trying out the Concealment Divine Powers of my spore avatar. I never thought it would even hide from you; seems it works pretty well," Hua Zhi said with a chuckle.
Yuan Ming had not genuinely become angry and instead grew quite intrigued by the spore avatar, inquiring for more details.
Hua Zhi did not conceal anything, explaining in detail that the spore avatar was formed from nearly a hundred spores, with each individual spore incapable of having sufficient spiritual intelligence.
The spore avatar could attach itself to plants or living bodies, completely merging with them, making it nearly impossible to detect.
Yuan Ming inwardly marveled at Hua Zhi's exceptional potential, contemplating that her future achievements might not be less than those of his Lifebound Spirit Plant, the Undying Tree.
However, since Hua Zhi dared to lay a trap within the Stealing Heaven Tripod, perhaps out of a desire to play a prank, she nevertheless should not be let off lightly, so he severely reprimanded her.
Realizing she had gone a bit too far, Hua Zhi quickly admitted her error and tearfully promised there would be no next time.
"Stop pretending, tell me directly what you have laid your eyes on," Yuan Ming said, sensing Hua Zhi's emotions and speaking with irritation.
"Master, since you have not fully refined the Undying Tree Demon Avatar, it must be of no use to you now. Thus, you might as well reward it to me," Hua Zhi said with a transition from tears to a smile, pointing towards the nearby Undying Tree Demon Avatar.
"You've had your sights set on it for a long time, haven't you? I was planning to give it to you anyway; consider this as giving it to you prematurely." Yuan Ming gestured indifferently, dispelling the restrictions around the Undying Tree Demon Avatar.
"Thank you, Master! These things are of no use to me, so I'll give them all to you," Hua Zhi cheered and threw a storage magic tool to Yuan Ming, then transformed into a purple shadow and merged into the Undying Tree Demon Avatar.
The next moment, countless Purple-black Vines emerged, completely engulfing the Undying Tree Demon Avatar.
The strength of the Undying Tree Demon Avatar had been greatly diminished, and it had also been severely injured; its most powerful roots had all been cut off, no match for Hua Zhi. Yuan Ming did not pay attention to the situation there and stood up to deliver the five boxes of fish oil to Xi Ying.
At the moment, Xi Ying exuded Gold, Wood, Water, Fire, Earth colored lights, forming a several zhangs large circle of five-colored light around her body. She had not shown any signs of movement for several days, seemingly engrossed in bitter cultivation.
As Xi Ying was at a critical juncture of her casting, she took the fish oil and exchanged a few words with Yuan Ming before continuing her closed-door cultivation.
Yuan Ming walked back beside the altar to inspect the storage magic tool Hua Zhi had just given him, finding seven to eight Magic Artifacts stored inside, all of high grade, likely from the great battle at Three Immortals Island.
"Eh!" His eyes lit up as he pulled out a black long sword from the pile of Magic Artifacts—the Black Sword used by Qi Ye to ambush the Undying Tree Demon.
This sword was forged from Nine Nether Iron, and Yuan Ming had already taken a fancy to it.
Due to the chaotic battle, by the time he recovered from the throes of the fight, the Black Sword had disappeared, only to have been surreptitiously taken by Hua Zhi.
Activating his Divine Sense to examine the sword closely, he revealed an excited expression.
This Black Sword was a Nine Rune Magical Treasure that seemed unimposing, but it was made with an abundant amount of Nine Nether Iron of exceptionally high quality, clearly forged multiple times through meticulous processes.
If he merged it into the Soul Destroying Sword, he could certainly increase the Yin Qi of the Soul Sword, and etch several more runes into it.
"Old friend, you really are lucky, falling asleep only to have someone bring you a pillow," Yuan Ming said, taking out the Soul Destroying Sword and lightly flicking the blade.
As Yuan Ming's cultivation rapidly improved, claiming the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear, the Cold Moon Ring, the Exterminating Immortal Sword, and other potent imitation Spiritual Treasures, the Soul Destroying Sword, his Lifebound Magical Treasure, quickly fell behind, only supported by "Curse" and "Annihilation" two runes.
Now, having obtained a large piece of Nine Nether Iron, he could finally elevate the power of the Soul Destroying Sword again.
However, he would need to carefully consider which runes to etch onto it after refining; the third rune "Frenzy Blood" obtained from the sword fragment would certainly be one of them, but the rest of the runes required careful thought.

chapters.title: Chapter 638 - 610: Three Runes
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming gazed at the Black Sword in his hands, deep in thought.
This sword was a Nine Rune Magical Treasure, and all its runes were of yin attribute. Each one was extraordinary and evidently handpicked by Qi Ye, among which a "Yin Thunder Rune" was particularly formidable, capable of converting Yin Qi into Yin Thunder for incredibly astonishing attacks.
During the great battle of Three Immortals Island earlier, it was under this Yin Thunder Rune that the soul of the Undying Tree Demon was wounded.
After integrating the Nine Nether Iron contained within the Black Sword into the Soul Destroying Sword, in addition to "Blood Frenzy" and "Yin Thunder," there should be enough capacity to inscribe one or two more runes.
Yuan Ming looked at the other yin attribute runes inside the Black Sword and quickly selected two more.
One was the "Shadow Transformation Rune," which could turn the Magic Treasure inscribed with this rune into a shadow, greatly enhancing its stealth and even allowing it to hide in an enemy's shadow to mount attacks.
The other was named "Soul Scattering Rune," capable of dispersing an enemy's Three Souls and Six Spirits, but requiring the Magic Treasure to touch the opponent's body to be effective.
Having made up his mind, Yuan Ming dispatched his first soul to oversee Lei Yu's cultivation to ensure that he could grasp any special situations immediately. He then took out the Sun and Moon Flame Sunrise Furnace to begin melting and refining the Black Sword.
Time flew by, and more than a month passed.
Inside the space of the Stealing Heaven Tripod, Yuan Ming sat cross-legged on the ground.
In the void before him floated a unique-looking black long sword, over two feet in length.
At a glance, the sword's body, which shimmered with an understated black light, appeared dull without any distinct sharpness—merely covered with a thin layer of black mist on its surface, seemingly not a particularly eye-catching treasure.
It was Yuan Ming's Lifebound Magical Treasure, the Soul Destroying Sword.
As Yuan Ming flicked his hand lightly on the sword's body.
"Clang..."
A loud metallic ringing sound emanated, and the unimpressive black long sword vibrated, stirring up invisible ripples, causing the mist on the sword's body to disperse along with it.
One after another, intricate runes on the sword's body lit up, reaching a total of nine.
After melting the Nine Nether Iron from the Black Sword into the Soul Destroying Sword, its Yin Power surged. With the help of Qi Ye, three runes were added: Blood Frenzy, Yin Thunder, and Shadow Transformation.
As for the Soul Scattering Rune, after inscribing Blood Frenzy, Yin Thunder, and other runes, the Soul Destroying Sword no longer had excess Yin Power to carry it, so they had to abandon the inscription.
"Rise," Yuan Ming uttered softly.
The Yin Thunder Rune on the Soul Destroying Sword suddenly lit up, and a "sizzling" sound emerged from the sword's body as slender black lightning bolts began to flicker.
"Go."
With a wave of Yuan Ming's hand, the black lightning on the sword's body that had lit up suddenly enlarged and shot out as a black electric current, swiftly flying dozens of feet away before flickering for a few moments in midair and then dissipating into nothingness.
Yuan Ming, seeing this scene, revealed a satisfied expression and nodded to himself in approval.
The attack he had just performed might have appeared ordinary to the naked eye, but the black lightning was not intended to harm through the Power of thunder and lightning. Instead, it was a manifestation of pure Divine Soul Power, capable of piercing directly through an opponent's Sea of Consciousness, causing severe damage to their Divine Soul.
Then, he made a gesture with his fingers and softly chanted the word "Hide."
The Soul Destroying Sword, suspended in midair, lit up with another rune as an odd light spread from that rune, enveloping the whole long sword.
A strange fluctuation rippled out from the Soul Destroying Sword, and the sword's glow dimmed as all its aura weakened significantly, with the sword's body transitioning from solid to spectral, turning into a fine black shadow.
With a wave of his hand, the long sword swiftly swept out and disappeared into the shadows beside the altar, reemerging from another shadow shortly thereafter.
This was another ingenious application of the Shadow Transformation Rune, allowing for travel between shadows.
"Not bad. Your Soul Destroying Sword has an even better foundation than my Black Annihilation Sword, and it can fully harness the power of the 'Yin Thunder' and 'Shadow Transformation' runes," Qi Ye said, appearing from within the Shura Blood Devouring Map.
Yuan Ming was also quite pleased with the effects of the Yin Thunder and Shadow Transformation runes.
However, these runes were of secondary concern. What he cared about most was the Blood Frenzy Rune, which he activated by channeling his Mana.
An invisible wave spread out, instantly enveloping the entire space of the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
Yuan Ming's eyes brightened with joy. Whether it was the Curse Rune, Annihilation Rune, or Blood Frenzy Rune, their activation was silent and effortless, much more convenient than other runes.
He composed himself and carefully sensed the fluctuation, soon understanding the effect of the Blood Frenzy Rune.
As he had initially speculated, the Blood Frenzy Rune could accelerate the circulation of blood, making one bloodthirsty and prone to aggression.
However, accelerating blood circulation was just the basic effect of the Blood Frenzy Rune. The rune could also speed up the flow of Mana and Soul Power, rendering one's emotions unstable. Combined with the Emotion Manipulation Ability, its effect was outstanding.
"Hmm? What's this? Is this the effect of the third rune you've inscribed?" Qi Ye's expression changed slightly as he looked around.
Suddenly, the Blood Light around him flowed intensely, clouds of Blood Mist emanated, and his face showed an expression of pain.
"Stop it, my form is about to disintegrate!" Qi Ye shouted, retreating into the Shura Blood Devouring Map.
Yuan Ming, upon hearing the words, hastily stopped the activation of the Blood Frenzy Rune. Qi Ye's mutation finally ceased, and he sighed in relief.
"What exactly is the origin of that complex rune of yours? Just now, my Blood Path Spiritual Light and my soul body almost collapsed!" Qi Ye asked.
"It is a rune I came across by chance. I don't know its specific name, so I refer to it as the Blood Frenzy Rune," Yuan Ming replied honestly.
The Blood Frenzy Rune could disrupt the flow of an enemy's Qi-Blood, Divine Soul, and Mana. Qi Ye, being the Shura Blood Devouring Map Artifact Spirit, was formed from the condensation of the soul body and Blood Path Spiritual Power and had no physical body, which left him utterly defenseless against the Blood Frenzy Rune.
"Blood Frenzy is an apt name. It seems to disrupt the circulation of Blood Qi and Soul Power, which is very dangerous for an artifact spirit like me, as well as for those who practice Body Cultivation," Qi Ye said, still shaken.
"Body Cultivation can be suppressed by the Blood Frenzy Rune too?" Yuan Ming's eyes flashed with a hint of surprise.
"Of course, Body Cultivators have abundant Qi-Blood and generally lower Divine Soul Power, so naturally they cannot withstand your peculiar rune," Qi Ye explained.
Yuan Ming nodded, realizing that the power of the Blood Frenzy Rune was even beyond his expectations.
He raised his hand and caught the Soul Destroying Sword flying back towards him, stroking the blade affectionately.
Now the sword, in all aspects, was not inferior to any ordinary imitation Spiritual Treasure and even surpassed them. For him, it would be another prized possession for future use.
Yuan Ming put away the Soul Destroying Sword and looked toward the distant Five Elements Creation Tree.
The five-colored halo under the tree still existed, gently rippling; Xi Ying showed no sign of leaving her closed-door cultivation.
Yuan Ming chose not to disturb her and instead flashed away from the Stealing Heaven Tripod.T^h#is co%py+ c%o.me%s& f#rom cont*en+t. on M|+V&|$L0E*MPYR-.

Meanwhile, over an expansive area of the outer sea.
