Today, the outer sea was unusually calm, with only minor waves rippling. A pile of disordered branches was haphazardly assembled into a rickety raft, silently floating on the surface of the sea.
At the front of the raft, a vertical branch bore a brilliantly large blossom, its petals fluttering in the wind as though they were a sail on the dilapidated raft.
A seabird flew from afar and landed on the raft, tilting its little head and pecking at the vivid blossom.
Just as it struck with its beak, the large flower suddenly swayed to the right, causing the bird to miss.
The bird cocked its head and pecked again, but the flower suddenly swayed to the left, making the bird miss once more.
Seeming puzzled by the flower, the seabird hopped around it in a circle before pecking at it again. The blossom continued to sway with ease, avoiding the bird's attempts.
The bird was persistent and did not give up. The flower and bird engaged in what looked like play, repeating the cycle of peck and dodge.
Just then, an undercurrent surged from beneath the calm sea.
A wave arose on the surface, rolling into a large bulge that rushed towards the raft.
The rickety raft met the wave head-on, suddenly flung upward.
The seabird, alarmed, immediately flew away.
As the raft was tossed by the wave, several root-like things beneath it were revealed, stretching deep into the water, extending a hundred zhang beneath the surface.
At a depth of a hundred zhang, amidst a seabed of rocks and silt, a colossal beast with the head of a bull and the body of a fish, thirty zhang in length, was bound by numerous tendrils and vines, struggling incessantly.
Its massive body writhed, emitting huge "mooing" sounds, its fins flapping like a screen, smashing the rocks on the seabed and kicking up silt that darkened the gloomy waters even further.
However, no matter how it struggled, it could not escape the grasp of those tendrils and vines, which grew tighter and caused large scales to peel from its body and blood to gush forth.
Soon, many of those tendrils broke through the surface of its skin and embedded into its flesh, sprouting more branches and roots that pierced even deeper.
The beast's immense Blood Qi began to drain rapidly, and its body quickly withered.
Before long, the tendrils that had stretched into the sea began to retract, all withdrawing back onto the dilapidated raft at the sea's surface.
The luminous raft transformed into a girl in a purple dress with a gentle face—it was Hua Zhi.
She lay on her back, hands supporting her head and legs crossed, floating on the now calm sea surface, watching the blue sky, her mouth twitching as if bored.
The Undying Tree Demon Avatar given to her by Yuan Ming greatly aided her, allowing her to break through to Level 4 Middle Stage with ease and not far from Fourth-tier Upper Stage.
At that time, Yuan Ming was busy refining the Black Sword and only communicated with her briefly through voice transmission, without meeting her in person, leaving her feeling a bit lonely without anyone to share her joy.
In these times, unable to bear solitude, she began hunting demon beasts everywhere to continue enhancing her Cultivation.
All the demon beasts in this maritime area with any Cultivation soon met with misfortune, as she had quickly killed most of them, with the rest either fleeing to farther seas or hiding in deep-sea lairs.
The Level 2 demon beast just now was the one she had dragged out from its seabed lair.

chapters.title: Chapter 639 - 611 Through
chapters.content:
Hua Zhi looked toward the distant Overseas World, the tumultuous waves there had also calmed significantly, most of the dark clouds in the sky had dispersed, and thunder and lightning were almost nowhere to be seen.
"Sigh, this foolish bird, when will it finish cultivating!" Hua Zhi stared at a certain spot in the sky and muttered to herself.
The dark clouds there were much denser than elsewhere, and a strong demon energy resided there, which was precisely Lei Yu.
The Soul Destroying Sword was advancing to a Nine Rune Magical Treasure, a process more difficult than imagined. Yuan Ming had summoned back his first soul to assist, and when Hua Zhi was out hunting, she had been instructed to watch over Lei Yu and prevent other demon beasts from disturbing it.
"How's Lei Yu doing?" Just then, the shadow behind Hua Zhi jumped, and Yuan Ming's figure appeared out of thin air.
"Master, why didn't you give a heads up before you come out!" Hua Zhi was startled.
Yuan Ming smiled without saying a word, quite satisfied with Hua Zhi's reaction.
The Soul Destroying Sword was his Lifebound Magical Treasure, and thanks to the Shadow Transformation Rune on the sword, he could now travel through shadows and appear suddenly, making it impossible for Hua Zhi to detect any traces.
Yuan Ming looked up toward the sky, letting out his Divine Sense.
By this time, Lei Yu's demon energy had greatly increased compared to before, reaching the Third-level Peak, and it was now absorbing the thunder and lightning from the dark clouds in an attempt to breakthrough to Level 4, albeit not smoothly.
"This stupid bird, reaching Level 4 isn't so easy to breakthrough. Even I took a long time to barely complete it, and it has just reached the Third-level Peak, a long way to go," Hua Zhi huffed.
Yuan Ming remained silent, having a deep understanding of Beast Taming and mastering the Golden Sunflower Beast Taming Technique, his grasp over demon beast cultivation had already far exceeded that of ordinary Nascent Soul cultivators.
Demon beasts cultivated both demonic power and their physique, essentially being a combination of Magic Practitioners and Body Cultivators, complementing each other, their combat power thus exceeding that of Human Clan's cultivators at the same level.
However, because of this hybrid mode of cultivation, advancing in realm is much more difficult for the Demon Clan than it is for Human Clan's cultivators, and Level 4 is a watershed-like existence for demon beasts. They need to temper their demon body first, accumulate enough demonic power, and then make a concerted effort to break through.
The Three-eyed Crow had reached the Third-level Peak long ago, but still had not managed to breakthrough, which was precisely because of this reason.
Having just reached the Third-level Peak, Lei Yu, without the ability like Hua Zhi to devour other demon beasts' demonic power, was attempting to breakthrough prematurely, which indeed was too soon and could risk being backlashed and severely injured.
Thinking of this, Yuan Ming transmitted a message to Lei Yu, telling it to give up on the breakthrough attempt and wait until there was a better chance in the future.
"Master, let me try once, I know my limits," Lei Yu insisted, its tone determined.
In its view, Yuan Ming had already broken through to the Nascent Soul Stage, and Hua Zhi had also made a smooth breakthrough. If it could not break through, it would gradually become worthless, something it refused to allow.
Yuan Ming sensed Lei Yu's firm belief and, with a thought, decided not to persuade further.
Feeling Yuan Ming's tacit approval, Lei Yu continued its assault. The clouds around it rapidly expanded, absorbing the thunder and lightning from within the dark clouds with all its might.
Strands of thunder and lightning converged upon it, almost forming a suit of Thunder Armor.
Unfortunately, the weather was calm today, and the thunder and lightning within the clouds were sparse, making the Thunder Armor seem somewhat thin.
"Has this foolish bird's brain gone bad? Today, with few clouds and little rain, and sparse thunder and lightning, it's hardly conducive for a breakthrough, yet it insists on forcing it!" Hua Zhi said, shaking her head.
Yuan Ming began casting the rain praying technique to help Lei Yu.
He had just finished chanting the spell when, boom! A vast expanse of Water attribute spiritual power gathered from the boundless sky and the ocean below, the dense enough to be almost tangible spiritual power formed a blue-colored Light Domain about a dozen miles in size.
The blue spirit light was ten times heavier than the seawater, making it difficult to breathe for anyone nearby, and all other attributes of spiritual energy were thoroughly repelled.
The blue Light Domain immediately shot into the sky, even more fiercely devouring the Water attribute spiritual energy, turning into a heavily darkened cloud.
Boom, boom, boom!
This voracious force was so astonishing that the nearby sea water was sucked up into the clouds, merging with them, and the sea level kept dropping.
In the sky, the dense dark clouds quickly spread out, covering a range of hundreds of miles in just a few breaths, and thick bolts of thunder and lightning moved across the clouds, filling most of the sky, more than during the storm in the Overseas World earlier.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming showed no sign on his face, but was greatly surprised in his heart.
Had the power of his rain praying technique increased to such an extent after his advancement to the Nascent Soul Stage?
He had a feeling that something wasn't quite right. He quickly tuned in to his Dantian within his body and, after some thought, he understood what had happened.
Inside the Dantian, black Undying Tree Branches spread and waved, and roots pierced into the Void, drawing in the Water attribute spiritual energy to assist him in casting.
Yuan Ming had long known that the Lifebound Spirit Plant cultivated by the Ju Mang Spirit Technique could assist the master in combat, yet he did not expect the help from the Undying Tree to be so significant.
"Thank you for the assistance, Master!" Lei Yu cheered, sending a grateful message before spitting out something.
A purple Round Orb flew out, seemingly Lei Yu's Demon Core, rapidly absorbing the nearby power of thunder and lightning.
The thunder and lightning covering much of the sky converged frantically and was absorbed by the purple Demon Core in just a few breaths.
With the power of thunder and lightning depleted, the cloud from the rain praying technique also quickly thinned out.
Yuan Ming raised his eyebrows, quickened his spell, and cast the rain praying technique again, creating new waves of thunder and lightning.
However, the purple demon core seemed like a bottomless pit, continuing to devour these thunderbolts, swallowing them all in just a few breaths' time.
"I want to see how many times you can absorb," Yuan Ming's eyes flickered slightly, and his spellcasting was unceasing as he continued to cast the rain praying technique.
Lei Yu's demon core truly possessed some unimaginable power; Yuan Ming cast the rain praying technique three more times, but the thunder and lightning produced from the clouds were absorbed by the orb every time.
Hua Zhi watched, dumbstruck, unable to believe that Lei Yu was capable of such a feat.
The purple demon core was enveloped in dazzling thunder, crackling like a miniature thunder sun.
"Master, enough..." Lei Yu said with a hint of pain.
At those words, Yuan Ming dispersed the spell in his hands and stopped casting the rain praying technique.
Lei Yu opened its mouth to inhale, and the purple demon core flew back towards it, effortlessly tearing through the layers of flickering dark clouds and heading straight into Lei Yu's mouth.
"Master, stop Lei Yu! With such an amount of the power of thunder and lightning, not to mention it's still third-level, even a Level 4 demon beast would struggle to endure it!" Hua Zhi said urgently, her face changing dramatically.
On hearing this, Yuan Ming merely smiled slightly, seeing that Hua Zhi, despite her sharp tongue, was still worried about Lei Yu.
However, he did not speak or take action to stop Lei Yu.
The Thunder Peng is an ancient Thunder Spirit Bird that can control the All Heavens Divine Thunder. With Lei Yu carrying the Thunder Peng bloodline, it should be able to neutralize the power of thunder and lightning.
The purple Thunder Ball had now flown back in front of Lei Yu, which opened its mouth and swallowed it.
Boom!
The Thunder Armor surrounding Lei Yu instantly deformed, shooting out thick strands of lightning, like roaring Thunder Dragons tumbling through the sky, tearing apart the dark clouds, while the sea below churned ominously, lit up with flickering thunder.
Yuan Ming and Hua Zhi quickly flew backwards, retreating to about ten miles away before stopping. Hua Zhi, reacting slightly slower, took a hit from a bolt of lightning on her arm, which immediately bore a charred scar.
"To condense the thunder and lightning to this extent, Lei Yu, that fool—it's as if it wishes to die quicker," Hua Zhi huffed, her arm shining with a purple glow as the charred wound rapidly healed.
Yuan Ming activated his Divine Sense and extended it toward Lei Yu.
At that moment, an unexpected change occurred!
The rampaging, thick thunder and lightning suddenly contracted, wrapping around Lei Yu and forming a giant Thunder Ball with a diameter of dozens of yards, its blinding electric lights flashing and emitting a terrifying sizzling noise, leaving one to wonder what was happening inside.
This chapter was made possible by the * community.
The surrounding spiritual energy was also drawn in, converging into the Thunder Ball.
Inside the Thunder Ball, Lei Yu's demon energy, far from weakening, was rapidly growing stronger.
Yuan Ming's eyes gleamed with clarity, and he realized that Lei Yu truly was not to be underestimated. Judging by the current situation, Lei Yu might indeed succeed in its breakthrough.
Hua Zhi sensed Lei Yu's condition and, while surprised, also relaxed her gaze.
Just as Lei Yu's demon energy continued to climb, nearly stepping over into the Level 4 Realm, with success close at hand, Yuan Ming's brows furrowed.
Although Lei Yu's demonic energy was advancing smoothly, its body was in terrible shape.
The Demon Clan practices dual cultivation of body and magic, and the immense power of thunder and lightning within the giant Thunder Ball was now forging Lei Yu's body to match the increased demonic power.
Lei Yu's strength was growing too fast, and its fleshly body was clearly insufficiently tempered and not strong enough. The Thunder and Lightning Body Refining exceeded its capacity to endure, tearing flesh in many places across Lei Yu's body, revealing stark white bone, and even the bones themselves were cracked.
"Master…" Lei Yu started in terror, communicating with Yuan Ming through spirit, its tone filled with urgency.
"Didn't you say you had a sense of measure? Now you're afraid!" Yuan Ming scolded through spirit, not kindly, but he didn't leave Lei Yu to die, and he made a hand gesture.
The roots of the Undying Tree in his Dantian shot out, appearing inside the giant Thunder Ball the next moment, piercing into Lei Yu's body, injecting strands of Undying Tree Demon Power into it.
The Undying Tree Demon Power, teeming with life, excelled in healing physical wounds. Although Lei Yu's demonic power did not match the Undying Tree, the effect was still good. Lei Yu's near-collapse body swiftly devoured this Demon Power, wounds quickly healing, and the bone cracks began to disappear.
"Thank you, Master!" Lei Yu exclaimed joyfully.
"Now is not the time to relax. Focus," Yuan Ming admonished with a serious tone through spirit voice, then he extracted the Blood Origin Power from within the Shura Blood Devouring Map and infused it into Lei Yu through the Undying Tree Roots.
The process of Thunder and Lightning Body Refining was still ongoing, and without enhancing the physical strength of Lei Yu's body, the situation would quickly recur.
Yuan Ming cast the Golden Sunflower Beast Taming Technique, lending his Demon Image Prison Suppression Divine Skill temporarily to Lei Yu. Lei Yu operated this skill, refining and absorbing the Blood Origin Power.
But Lei Yu's body structure differed too much from that of Human Clan cultivators. Its muscles, bones, and even the most basic meridians, as well as the Dantian structures, were very different, making the operation of the Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill extremely difficult.
Yet, in this critical situation, Yuan Ming had no time to consider other options. He was fully focused on operating the Golden Sunflower Beast Taming Technique, coordinating the discrepancies involved.
Inside his Sea of Consciousness, the Soul Power spun rapidly, activating every thought, his whole being engrossed in the Golden Sunflower Beast Taming Technique, cycling through the secret technique dozens of times with each breath.
Yuan Ming had never operated the Golden Sunflower Beast Taming Technique with such complete dedication. In a trance, he morphed into Lei Yu, his hands turning into wings, his feet into sharp claws, and his internal meridians and Dantian dramatically transformed but felt oddly familiar, with no discomfort—as if he were born in this body.
The content of the Golden Sunflower Beast Taming Technique flowed through his mind, clearer than ever before, revelations of many mysteries he had yet to grasp dawning upon him in this moment.

chapters.title: Chapter 640 - 612: The Reverse Scale
chapters.content:
"So that's how it is. The Golden Sunflower Beast Taming Technique doesn't simply borrow Mana and Divine Skills—more importantly, it involves the casting of one's intentions into them, allowing for the maximal unleashing of the borrowed Divine Skills' power!" Yuan Ming had a moment of enlightenment.
At this time, his understanding of the Golden Sunflower Beast Taming Technique had unknowingly reached a new realm, and the operation of the Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill had also become exceptionally smooth.
Streams of Blood Origin Power were infused into every part of Lei Yu's body, quickening the healing of his wounds and enhancing the strength of his demonic body, finally catching up with the increase in his demonic power.
After an unknown period, a piercing screech that penetrated the skies sounded, filled with excitement.
The widespread thunder and lightning quickly shrank, soon disappearing completely. The dark clouds in the sky also dissipated greatly, revealing Lei Yu's figure.
Lei Yu had undergone a significant transformation. His body had lengthened several times, appearing smoother. His originally thick feathers had thinned out, yet each feather felt like refined iron, seemingly indestructible. His claws beneath him were even sharper, flashing a chilling cold light.
The most significant change was Lei Yu's wings, which had grown much broader than before. When spread, they were almost longer than his body, densely filled with purple thunder runes.
With a single movement of Lei Yu's wings, numerous bolts of lightning leaped forth. His body vanished in an instant, appearing the next moment above the sea in front of Yuan Ming as if he had performed instantaneous movement.
Hua Zhi, upon seeing this, shivered internally; Lei Yu's speed was too fast. It seemed he had thoroughly mastered the Thunder Escape Technique. If he were to strike at her, she doubted she could evade it.
"Master, thanks to your help, otherwise my breakthrough would have been doomed without a doubt," Lei Yu, looking toward the closed-eyed, cross-legged Yuan Ming on the water surface—now capable of human speech—spoke in gratitude.
"It's good that you know. Next time you take such a risk, I might not be able to save you," Yuan Ming opened his eyes and slowly said.
His complexion was somewhat pale at that time.
To help Lei Yu break through, he had greatly exhausted his Primordial Qi. A significant amount of the Blood Origin Power stored in the Shura Blood Devouring Map had also been depleted, and the Undying Tree Demon Power within his Dantian was nearly exhausted.
"It was reckless of me. I won't dare again," Lei Yu hurriedly admitted his mistake.
Yuan Ming did not blame Lei Yu further but inquired about the changes in his Divine Skills after the breakthrough. He discovered an addition of a Thunder Escape Divine Skill. As for the other Divine Skills, there were no changes; only their power had significantly increased.
He was not disappointed; the Thunder Escape Divine Ability was renowned, rated as the foremost among all escape techniques. Mastering this skill was more useful than possessing ten ordinary Thunder and Lightning Divine Powers.
"You've already broken through to Level 4, still in demon beast form. Can't you transform into a human shape?" Yuan Ming thought of something else and asked.
"It seems not yet possible," Lei Yu moved his broad wings a bit and said.
"I've heard that the higher the bloodline level of a demon beast, the more difficult it is to transform. It seems that the Thunder Peng bloodline in your body is quite pure. Alright, you've just broken through Level 4; you need to stabilize your realm. Head back into the Spiritual Beast Bag," Yuan Ming said thoughtfully and then with a wave of his hand, stored Lei Yu inside it.
He did not continue to stay outside either and returned to the Stealing Heaven Tripod for further recovery.
…
Two days later.
Yuan Ming sat cross-legged under the Gathering Spirit Tree, slowly exhaling a breath of turbid air.
His recovery ability was already remarkable before. Now, with the help of the Undying Tree, his recovery speed was even faster. The lost Primordial Qi had almost been replenished, though the Undying Tree's demonic power had not yet recovered and needed more time.
Hua Zhi, influenced by Lei Yu's breakthrough, had taken the Shura Blood Devouring Map and gone to the Overseas World to hunt demon beasts, incidentally replenishing the map's depleted Blood Origin Power.
Yuan Ming suddenly felt a disturbance in his Divine Soul and abruptly opened his eyes.
Just then, his second split soul, residing in Evergreen Island, had suddenly sent a message: "Evergreen Island is under attack, and those people seem to be targeting my parents."
The moment he heard this message, Yuan Ming did not have time to think. He immediately leaped up and sat on the White Jade Lotus Platform.
This is a sample from *. Read the rest on *.
His expression grave, he closed his eyes and immediately spread his Divine Sense to the location of his second split soul as an anchor point.
The moment his Divine Thought descended, his Divine Power, having reached the Half-step Word Witch level, immediately enveloped the entire Evergreen Island. He soon saw that it was night in the city, but fires were lit everywhere, smoke billowed up, cries of distress filled the air, creating a chaotic scene.
In Gu Town, each with five members dressed in black, two squads were moving from the east and west sides of the town, searching house by house towards the center of the town.
Those who were a little uncooperative or dared to resist along the way were all slaughtered by them.
Standing inside the residence where Yuan Ming's parents were placed, was a figure clad in a large Black Robe and a hood.
This figure was exceedingly tall, over ten feet, but so thin that the robe seemed hollow, exuding a chilling aura all over.
Through the connection of Divine Souls, Yuan Ming quickly located Zuo Qinghui. His second split soul was residing within him, controlling his body, activating a Concealment Array set up by Xi Ying for him.
It had been agreed that should they encounter an enemy they couldn't handle, the clone was to hide his parents within this array, waiting for Yuan Ming's rescue.
Seeing that his parents were safe and had not been harmed for the moment, Yuan Ming's suspended heart was slightly relieved, yet his expression remained as still as water.
His parents were his greatest vulnerability; he had brought the elders here so that they could live their later years in peace, away from the conflicts of the Cultivation World. The actions of the adversary had now thoroughly infuriated him.
Yuan Ming looked at the figure, his brows tightly furrowed. Bolstered by the Lotus Platform Will Power, his Divine Soul Power surged forth and launched a "Nightmare" attack towards the man in the Black Robe.
The silhouette of the man in the Black Robe was holding a square bronze plate, above which a little bronze fish was suspended, turning its head from side to side as if searching for the hiding place of Yuan Ming's parents.
As he continued casting, the small fish suspended above the bronze plate swayed less and less until it finally came to a halt, pointing steadily towards a corner of the courtyard—towards a rockery made from Taihu stones.
"Come out, I have found you already." The shoulders of the silhouette of the man in the Black Robe shrugged as a hoarse voice tinged with a mocking laugh said.
No one responded as the voice fell.
The figure in the Black Robe wasted no more words and immediately raised a palm towards that direction.
A murderous aura emanated from his broad sleeves, and a dense Black Mist filled with a thick scent of death ballooned his sleeves outwards, revealing a ferocious ghost face with two eyes glowing blood-red from within.
Just as the evil ghost was about to emerge from the sleeve, the man in the Black Robe suddenly let out a muffled grunt.
"Who is it?" he bellowed, and a terrifying oppressive force erupted from around him instantly.
Inside the space of the Stealing Heaven Tripod, Yuan Ming was sitting cross-legged on the White Jade Lotus Platform, his eyebrows locked together and his face showing a look of surprise.
Just then, he had tried using his Half-step Word Witch Divine Soul Power to assault the Sea of Consciousness of the man in the Black Robe, only to find a very strong Divine Soul restriction inside that man's Sea of Consciousness.
Even with the aid of the White Jade Lotus Platform, he had not managed to break through that restriction, as his Divine Soul Power was completely repelled.
"It seems he knew I am a Soul Cultivator and came prepared!" Yuan Ming silently mused.
Meanwhile, back in the courtyard, with no one appearing, the figure in the Black Robe quickly waved his sleeve, and a bloody-eyed ghost shadow immediately rushed out from his sleeve.
It had a blurred body trailing like black smoke behind it, emitting ghostly howls and charging directly towards the rockery.
As it approached within three feet of the rockery, the Concealment Array laid down by Xi Ying gradually became visible, revealing a semi-transparent crystalline membrane glinting with seven colors in the void.
Behind that layer of membrane was another pale golden Defense Magic Array that, although not yet triggered, had already lit up with dense golden runes.
Just as the seven-colored light on the semi-transparent membrane flickered unstably, about to collapse, a Light Gate suddenly formed next to the Concealment Array, and ten thick black roots burst forth from it.
After absorbing most of the power from the Undying Tree Avatar, Yuan Ming's control over the Space Power had become even more skillful, and he could now penetrate the void with ten roots.
These roots were clutching a green Palm Leaf Fan, which resembled a banana leaf with wind patterns flowing across it and was in fact Wan Tianren's imitation Spiritual Treasure, the Palm Leaf Fan.
The root suddenly swung the Palm Leaf Fan, lighting up the wind patterns, and a howling sound erupted as terrifying gusts of wind swept out towards the blood-eyed ghost shadow.
As the gusts passed, the blood-eyed ghost shadow felt an irresistible tearing force assault it, lacking the pain of flesh being stripped from bone yet possessing a soul-scattering power. With only a mournful cry, it dissipated into smoke and vanished under the fierce wind.
"A Spiritual Treasure... Who are you exactly? Why don't you show yourself in your true form?" The man in the Black Robe, seeing his blood-eyed ghost shadow dispersed with a single strike, couldn't help but slightly furrow his brow.
His gaze fell upon that strange golden and silver Light Gate, and deep within the depths of his hooded eyes, a flicker of confusion shone through.
"And who are you, why attack this place?" Yuan Ming transmitted his voice through Divine Soul Power.
"I am the White Bone Venerable; since you have come to protect this place, how could you not know why we assault this place?" the man in the Black Robe retorted with a cold laugh.
"It's him!" Yuan Ming couldn't help but frown.
That a Venerable was sent to deal with his parents was somewhat unexpected yet seemed within reason.
"Surely you've heard of my notorious reputation. Do you still intend to meddle in the affairs of the Wu Yue Sect? If you leave now, I will not pursue this further, but if you insist on muddying the waters... hmph," the man in the Black Robe didn't finish his sentence, yet the threatening and intimidating tone was already more than clear.
"The Wu Yue Sect is nothing special. If you provoke me, it is you who will regret it!" Yuan Ming coldly snorted, speaking bluntly.
As his voice fell, the roots extending out from the golden and silver Light Gate suddenly raised high, with the Palm Leaf Fan once again shining brightly as it swung fiercely toward the man in the Black Robe.
"Boom, boom, boom"
A series of sounds like muffled thunder rang out, created by the fierce winds blown by the Palm Leaf Fan clashing against each other, each containing an immensely powerful oppressive force, as if capable of crushing everything.
Everything on the ground, including the bricks and all the furnishings in the courtyard, were caught up and ground into dust by the winds, and half of the house vanished under this strike.

chapters.title: Chapter 641 - 613: Protection
chapters.content:
The figure shrouded in a black robe, who called himself "White Bone Venerable," suddenly pushed his hands forward. From the billowing sleeves, black mist surged out, and one by one, ferocious ghost shadows flew out incessantly, intertwining and overlapping each other, stacking up into a semblance of arhats.
Within a fleeting moment, countless ghosts piled up, forming a ghost mountain over thirty feet tall, from which emanated waves of ghostly wails and wolf howls.
The fierce wind slammed into the ghost mountain, and under the thunderous roaring impact, the wind scattered, kicking up a sandstorm. The ghost mountain trembled violently, collapsing by more than half.
Yet, it still withstood the charged strike from the Palm Leaf Fan.
On the half-collapsed ghost mountain, numerous ghastly and terrifying ghost faces densely emerged, each one opening its distorted mouth wide, screaming and howling.
The sound was so piercing that even through the golden and silver light gate, Yuan Ming furrowed his brow.
The great array protecting his parents also vibrated with countless ripples from the wailing of the ghosts, unable to fully block the intrusion of this force.
Upon seeing this, the second split soul immediately controlled Zuo Qinghui's body to shield his parents. He formed a hand seal and faced the assault of the ghostly howls.
In just an instant, the second split soul felt a powerful impact invading, causing him a brief loss of control over his consciousness, nearly causing him to leave Zuo Qinghui's body.
Yuan Ming sensed the anomaly in the second split soul and immediately launched another attack.
The black roots protruding from the golden and silver light gate now stood upright, one on the left and one on the right, like two hands in front of the body. However, one of them was twined around a sharp cone, and the other around a large hammer, with faint sounds of "zzt zzt" electrical currents emanating from them.
"Try this," Yuan Ming called out in a low shout.
The runes on the Thunder God Hammer lit up, a glow of electricity enveloping the hammer's body, crackling and popping.
Above the sky of Guli Town, a thick layer of thunderclouds had gathered at some point, with faint traces of light flickering within.
As the root swung the Thunder God Hammer down, a thunderclap also resonated from the Nine Heavens above.
A dazzling bolt of lightning poured down from the Nine Heavens, striking the Thunder God Hammer and then smashing onto the God Bombarding Cone.
"Boom boom"
The sound of thunder roared explosively, countless bolts of lightning bursting from the tip of the God Bombarding Cone and spreading into a vast net of lightning, enveloping the ghost mountain.
"Zzzzz"
Innumerable streaks of electric light shot out, resembling fireworks blooming in the night, countless silver electric snakes scattering in all directions, penetrating the bodies of the numerous ghosts.
A true cacophony of ghostly wails and wolf howls erupted, devoid of any piercing offensive force, filled only with endless pain and lamenting.
The half-surviving ghost mountain under the Palm Leaf Fan was this time completely destroyed by the lightning, all ghosts turning to ash.
The spreading glow of the lightning didn't cease, but instead, after sweeping across the mountain, gradually fused and condensed into a brightly shining Thunder Python, which opened its maw to bite at the White Bone Venerable.
He grunted coldly and fiercely swept up his sleeve, summoning a vortex of black mist from thin air that enveloped the Thunder Python, grinding it to dust.
In the next instant, from the swirling sleeve, a withered pale hand suddenly stretched out, grabbing at the void, and a white bone sword materialized out of thin air in the palm.
The moment the bone sword appeared, an aura of deadly silence instantly spread from the White Bone Venerable, and the immense pressure characteristic of a Nascent Soul Realm cultivator began to manifest undoubtedly.
"To break my Yin Sha Ghost Mountain in two strikes, you are worthy for me to use the Bone Killing Sword," said the White Bone Venerable coldly, his tone full of arrogance, as if this were a great benevolence.
Yuan Ming scoffed at this, but facing the dangerous aura now emitted by the White Bone Venerable, he dared not take it lightly.
White Bone Venerable held the sword with one hand, pointing it straight in front of him, while the other hand formed a sword technique and pressed down towards the blade.
"Clang"
A sound of the sword ringing out, a surge of pure and intense killing intent first spread around, enveloping the entire Guli Town, then began to retract, concentrating back onto the tip of the bone sword.
In an instant, Yuan Ming felt his Divine Thought cast upon it was being cleaved apart by the Bone Killing Sword.
"It's the first time I've seen such pure, focused, and powerful killing intent," Yuan Ming thought to himself.
"Kill."
Hearing a low shout from the White Bone Venerable, the long sword in his hand violently slashed out.
In the next instant, a straight line of white sword light burst forth from the Bone Killing Sword, nearly tearing apart the void, slashing towards the golden and silver light gate.
Yuan Ming was prepared for this. The Shura Blood Devouring Map immediately flew out from the light gate, revealing a figure that emerged, raising both hands high as if embracing the heavens.
Behind him, a circular sword array appeared, countless sword lights and shadows bursting out, surging towards the white sword light like a torrent.
"Clang, clang, clang"
Sounds of metal clashes rang out continuously. Sword shadows shattered and vanished the moment they touched the white sword light, yet more sword shadows continued to plunge forward like moths to a flame.
Despite the continuous onslaught of sword shadows, the descent of the white sword light remained unabated, yet the pure and intense killing intent was no longer as sharp as at the beginning.
Even the sharpest sword would dull under such intense impacts.
"Your sword array is quite good, but alas, there are still too few swords," the voice of the White Bone Venerable came.
Sоurсеd dirесtly frоm МV6LЕМР6YR.
As the words fell, Elder San Jue's Sword Array's power finally exhausted, and all the sword lights and sword shadows vanished.
It was at this moment that Yuan Ming's transmission resonated in the White Bone Venerable's Sea of Consciousness:
"It's enough sword intent to wear you down."
As the voice resonated, a fierce sword whistle pierced the Nine Heavens, and a majestic azure Sword Qi soared into the sky, slashing diagonally upwards like a wildfire sweeping through the heavens.
At the instant when the azure and white sword lights collided, the already weakened white sword light almost instantly shattered.
And that azure sword light, though slightly diminished in power, still charged unstoppably towards the White Bone Venerable.
Before the White Bone Venerable could recover from his shock of having his sword light annihilated, that sword light had already reached him.
In his panic, he could only hurriedly raise his sword to block.
With a sharp "clang," the White Bone Venerable's sleeve robe burst apart, and his figure uncontrollably flew backward, only coming to a stop after reaching more than a hundred yards away.
His ever-present hood fell off, revealing a face with sunken eye sockets and prominent cheekbones, filled with an expression of disbelief.
"What kind of Sword Qi is this? How can it possess such formidable power?" His grip on the sword shook uncontrollably.
"Fellow Daoist Bai Gu, how do you like my sword? Care to try again?" Yuan Ming's voice rang out again from his Sea of Consciousness, filled with a teasing tone.
Immediately, a murderous aura condensed in the eyes of the White Bone Venerable. Just as he was about to speak, his Bone Killing Sword trembled slightly, and a faint "crack" echoed from the blade.
At that, the White Bone Venerable's expression drastically changed. He took one deep look at the golden and silver light gate and the strange root tendrils poking out from it, said nothing, and turned to leave.
Following his departure, the Wu Yue Sect followers who had been causing havoc in Guli Town and all over Evergreen Island also began to withdraw.
Inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space, Yuan Ming, transformed into the Undying Tree, slowly retracted his extended root tendrils and also took back all the Magic Treasures.
Afterward, he closed the golden and silver light gate and reverted to human form, releasing a long sigh of relief.
At this moment, he was far from the effortless demeanor he had displayed before. Not only had his Divine Soul Power been significantly drained, but his Mana had also been greatly depleted.
However, fortunately, the Exterminating Immortal Sword had absorbed enough Sword Qi from the Sword Trace Rift earlier; otherwise, he might not have been able to intimidate the White Bone Venerable just now.
Seeing that the surroundings were finally safe, the Second Split Soul controlling Zuo Qinghui then lifted the Forbidden encasing the area.
Yuan Ming's parents stepped out of the Barrier, their faces turning quite pale as they saw the ruins around them.
"Who were those people?" Yuan Zuochong asked solemnly.
The Second Split Soul, having received instructions from Yuan Ming, shook its head, offering no answer.
"They came for Ming'er, didn't they?" Yuan Zuochong asked again.
The Second Split Soul thought for a moment and then nodded.
"What can we do? Those people seemed very troublesome. Ming'er won't be in danger, will he?" Yuan Mu asked, her eyes filled with worry.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming felt a pang of guilt.
Now that he had become a Nascent Soul cultivator, an existence he once looked up to, he still let his parents feel scared because of him.
Thinking this, his resentment towards the Wu Yue Sect deepened.
"Haha..."
Unexpectedly, a hearty laugh suddenly came from Mr. Yuan's mouth at that moment.
Not only did Yuan Mu get startled, but even Yuan Ming himself was taken aback.
"You, as a father, not worrying about your son but laughing here, you really are heartless…" Yuan Mu glared at him, chiding.
"Wife, these fellows must have been powerless against our son, thinking of harming us as a way to get to him. What does that indicate? It shows that our son has grown to a point where even his opponents are at their wit's end," Yuan Zuochong said with a face full of pride.
"Is it really so?" Yuan Mu was still somewhat doubtful.
"Of course, it is. Don't forget, that's the only son of myself, Yuan Zuochong, and you, my wife," Yuan Zuochong declared confidently, thumping his chest.
Seeing him say this, Yuan Mu rolled her eyes at him, the worry on her face lessened a bit, replaced by a slight smile.
Mr. Yuan put his arm around his wife's shoulders and gently patted a few times, as a gesture of comfort.
In the depths of his eyes, he carefully hid his worries and silently prayed for his son in his heart.
Yuan Ming, witnessing this scene, felt somewhat relieved but also even more guilty.
At that moment, all he could do was send his First Split Soul to replace the Second Split Soul in occupying Zuo Qinghui's body, allowing it to continue protecting his parents.
Now, the First Split Soul had advanced to the Sleep Witch Realm, with a more stable Soul Power and was significantly stronger than the Second Split Soul.

chapters.title: Chapter 642 - 614: Immortal Elixir
chapters.content:
Under Yuan Ming's command, the first soul split controlled Zuo Qinghui, concealed his aura, and took his parents to leave Evergreen Island first, heading towards the inland direction.
Yuan Ming came out of the Stealing Heaven Tripod and waved his hand, summoning Lei Yu forth.
"Master." As soon as Lei Yu appeared, he immediately called out.
"We need to rush back to the area of the East Sea Inner Sea immediately, you must spare no effort to fly back as fast as possible," Yuan Ming said with a solemn expression.
"Alright." Seeing this, Lei Yu didn't ask anything and immediately replied.
Having said that, he spread his wings, his body wrapped in dazzling thunderous light, revealing his true form, the Thunder Wing Bird.
"Hua Zhi, take these elixirs with you. Replenish Lei Yu on the way as needed, take care of the Stealing Heaven Tripod, and also protect Lei Yu," Yuan Ming left two porcelain bottles filled with elixirs for Hua Zhi.
Hua Zhi had already been urgently summoned back by Yuan Ming from the Overseas World.
"Don't worry, Master, I will definitely protect Lei Yu," Hua Zhi patted Lei Yu's wings and promised.
"There's no time to delay, let's set off immediately," Yuan Ming nodded and then returned to the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
Lei Yu carried Hua Zhi, soaring into the sky.
Giant electric arcs shot out from his wings, bursting forth with a loud bang. His form turned into a bolt of lightning and vanished, stirring up two hundred-foot-high waves on the vast sea surface, disappearing in an instant.
Two days later, within the space of the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
Xi Ying's frown deepened as she listened to Yuan Ming talk about the events on Evergreen Island, her face showing a pensive look.
"I'm sorry, it's probably because of me that the Wu Yue Sect noticed your presence, and as a result, your uncle and aunt were implicated," Xi Ying said with a guilty expression after Yuan Ming finished speaking.
"This has nothing to do with you; don't overthink it. It's just that I must rush back to the Inner Sea as soon as possible. With the Wu Yue Sect's way of doing things, after failing once, they will certainly not give up but will attack again with even greater power next time. Relying on my first soul split alone, it will be difficult to protect them," Yuan Ming dismissed the issue with a wave of his hand, paying no attention to Xi Ying's words.
"I have a secret base in the East Sea area that not even my closest acquaintances know about. There, I have carefully arranged Concealment Arrays and Defense Magic Arrays. It is unlikely to be discovered, let alone easily breached. You can first settle your uncle and aunt there; it's safer than moving them around clandestinely in the East Sea," Xi Ying suggested.
"That's a good plan," Yuan Ming pondered momentarily and then nodded.
"These are the keys to activate and control the two Arrays," Xi Ying said, taking out two crescent-shaped jade plaques, one black and one white, and handed them to Yuan Ming.
Upon seeing this, Yuan Ming immediately contacted his first soul split, informed him of the location of Xi Ying's secret base, and the method to activate and operate the two Arrays.
In the end, he sent the two jade plaques over through the Altar Formation.Always read at the source—*.
After Yuan Ming did all this, his anxious heart eased slightly, but as the concern was for his parents, he couldn't help but feel worried.
"Lei Yu's speed of thunder is indeed fast, but compared to the power of space, it's still a bit slower. The task of traveling should be left to the Silver Kong Tree Demon," Xi Ying said again, noticing his demeanor.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming's eyes lit up, and he smacked his forehead, saying, "How could I have forgotten about it? But will it cooperate properly?"
"Don't worry, this demon has been subdued by my Golden Sunflower Beast Taming Technique and has become my spirit beast. It doesn't have the capital to defy my orders," Xi Ying smiled and assured.
With that, she waved her hand, and the figure of the Silver Kong Tree Demon appeared by her side.
After appearing, it first glanced at Yuan Ming unnaturally, then bowed its head slightly and called Xi Ying "Master," evidently still unaccustomed to its new status.
"Silver Kong, you are adept at using the power of space and have your own special talents in speeding through the void. I want you to take us back to the Inner Sea within a month," Xi Ying instructed.
Hearing this, the Silver Kong Tree Demon first inquired about their current location and, upon receiving the answer, immediately shook its head like a rattle drum.
"Impossible, impossible! This distance is too far; even if I exhaust myself to death without rest, it is not possible to bring you back to the Inner Sea within a month," Silver Kong Tree Demon hastily said.
Yuan Ming sighed inwardly, knowing this request was a bit too demanding, and was about to ask how long the Silver Kong Tree Demon would need to take them back when suddenly, Xi Ying spoke up again:
"What I told you is an order, not a request for your opinion. However, you can rest assured that you won't be relying solely on your Innate Divine Ability. I have a Space Treasure here that, once activated by you, should make it possible to return to the Inner Sea within a month," she said confidently.
While speaking, she waved her hand and a silver moon-shaped Flying Wheel appeared in her palm, shimmering with intricate runes and emitting waves of spatial energy.
"Is this... the Silver Moon Flying Wheel?" The Silver Kong Tree Demon exclaimed in surprise the instant it saw the Magic Treasure.
"You recognize this treasure?" Xi Ying asked, her brows furrowed.
"Without hiding the truth from you... My master, I have searched the entire Yunhuang Continent just to find this item, never expecting it to be in your possession. Rest assured, with this item, returning to the Inner Sea within a month will not be an issue," the Silver Kong Tree Demon immediately said.
"Good, as long as you do not mess this up, you may keep the Silver Moon Flying Wheel with you," Xi Ying nodded and said.
Upon hearing this, the Silver Kong Tree Demon was overjoyed, suddenly feeling that serving Xi Ying as a spirit beast might not be so bad after all?
After it refined the Silver Moon Flying Wheel, Yuan Ming handed over the Stealing Heaven Tripod to it for safekeeping and also took back Lei Yu and Hua Zhi.
Handing the Stealing Heaven Tripod to the Silver Kong Tree Demon was something he was initially worried about, but with Xi Ying's guarantee and his urgency to return to the Inner Sea to meet his parents, it became a reluctant move.
Back inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod, seeing Yuan Ming still troubled, Xi Ying opened her mouth to comfort him:
"Don't worry, the Silver Kong Tree Demon is a space demon beast. With the assistance of the Silver Moon Flying Wheel and spare no effort in traveling, its speed will definitely not be slower than Wan Tianren's Nine Heavens Flowing Light Shuttle."
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming nodded.
He maintained constant contact with his first soul split, always aware of his and his parents' movements. Upon learning there were no pursuers nearby and that they were not too far from the secret stronghold specified by Xi Ying, he finally felt relieved.
Only then did he stabilize his mind and begin to rethink everything.
"Xi Ying, I still don't understand what your objective is coming to Three Immortals Island. From the beginning, you had many arrangements in place, allowing so many Nascent Soul cultivators to enter the Secret Realm of Three Immortals Island. Now that matters there have more or less concluded, can you tell me what exactly you are here for?" Yuan Ming looked at Xi Ying and asked.
Xi Ying looked into Yuan Ming's eyes, which were firmly fixed on her. In them, she saw no suspicion, only confusion.
"I came to Three Immortals Island to obtain an Undying Fruit grown from the Undead Tree, to refine an Immortal Elixir that can rescue my sister. She was gravely injured while saving me many years ago and has since been in a comatose state between life and death, her life hanging by a thread sustained only by a Seven-Star Lamp Array. I fear that only the Immortal Elixir can bring her back to life," she said, meeting Yuan Ming's gaze.
"The Silver Kong Tree Demon is already dead, but earlier I didn't see any fruit on the tree?" Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming's brows slightly creased, and after carefully recalling, he spoke.
He had absorbed most of the body of the Undead Tree Demon, and he was certain whether there had been any fruit on the tree.
"I've already obtained the Undying Fruit," Xi Ying said with a sly smile in response.
After saying that, she produced a Storage Ring and lightly swept her palm over it before Yuan Ming's astonished gaze.
The next instant, a heap of items noisily tumbled out of it.
"When Guoguo and I went to Guanghan Palace, I actually brought along another spirit pet, the child transformed by the Five Elements Creation Tree. Back then, I told Yuan Wuji and the others that I could help them break the Great Array, and while that wasn't false, it was also to buy time so the Five Elements Child could help me garner the treasures of Guanghan City," Xi Ying said with a smile.
"Are all these...?" Yuan Ming, seeing the half-man-high pile of treasures on the ground, was astounded.
"That's right. The Five Elements Child is very proficient at this. He almost scoured the entire Guanghan City, acquiring so many treasures, among which were five Undying Fruits. With these five fruits, I will be able to refine five Immortal Elixirs," Xi Ying nodded and confirmed.
After speaking, from her own Storage Bracelet, she took out a fist-sized black fruit and presented it to Yuan Ming for inspection.
The fruit, rough and somewhat ugly on the surface, was radiating dense spiritual energy from nature, and it was even more special for not having any trace of the demon energy of the Silver Kong Tree Demon.
"The Undying Fruit is the crystallized essence of the Undead Tree Demon. The Immortal Pill refined from it probably has considerable hidden dangers," Yuan Ming remarked after a glance, feeling concerned despite acknowledging Xi Ying's meticulous thinking.
"You can rest assured on this matter. The Immortal Elixir is precious precisely because it has only one flaw: the one who consumes it will be controlled by the Undead Tree Demon. But with the Undead Tree Demon now dead, there's no need to worry about this anymore," Xi Ying assured with a laugh.
Hearing her confidence, Yuan Ming stopped questioning further.
"Xi Ying, can ordinary people consume this Immortal Elixir? And if they do, can it have the same effect as when it is consumed by cultivators?" Suddenly he recalled something and hastily asked.
"To be honest, I don't know... I suppose we will only find out after a trial," Xi Ying replied after a moment of thought, shaking her head.
Yuan Ming nodded, not dwelling further on the question.
He looked over the items on the ground and saw that most of them were spiritual materials, and the remainder were mostly remnants of arrays from around Guanghan City that had been destroyed.
Just then, Yuan Ming suddenly saw something dark and coal-like among the items, and his pupils constricted. He immediately reached out and a piece the size of a small brick levitated into his hand.
The piece much larger than a coal briquette now rested in Yuan Ming's hand.

chapters.title: Chapter 643 - 615: Key Spiritual Materials
chapters.content:
"Xi Ying, what is this?" Yuan Ming looked at the item in his hand and asked, suppressing the excitement in his heart.
The reason for his astonishment was none other than the fact that he sensed an aura very similar to Black Incense from this object.
It was not the replicas of Black Incense he had made himself, but the original three sticks of Black Incense he had first obtained.
Ever since then, he had been collecting various spiritual materials, all in order to truly imitate those few sticks of incense. Although, after numerous attempts and explorations, he was getting closer to this goal, he was never able to realize it completely, primarily due to the lack of the main material.
But now this "coal" finally gave him that familiar feeling.
Upon hearing his words, Xi Ying took the "coal" and examined it carefully, her brows suddenly knitting together.
Her expression changed from initially casual to somewhat serious, then to doubt.
"I… I don't recognize this item. However, upon closer inspection, I'm quite surprised to find that this dark, unremarkable thing contains a unique Divine Soul Power, mixed with nature's spiritual energy," Xi Ying murmured thoughtfully, frowning.
Seeing that even Xi Ying did not recognize it, Yuan Ming couldn't help but feel a bit disappointed, and he blurted out:
"Xi Ying, could you give this to me? I can exchange something for it. Just name it, and even if I don't have it, I'll find a way to get it."
"Is this item very important to you?" Xi Ying asked, looking at Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming did not hide anything and nodded emphatically.
"It's yours."
As she spoke, Xi Ying tossed the coal back to Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming hurriedly caught it and shook his head vigorously, "This item is precious, I can't take it for nothing."
"Consider it compensation for the danger your uncle and aunt faced this time. Just take it. In the future, I might need your help quite often, so don't worry about owing me favors," Xi Ying said with a smile.
"Alright," Yuan Ming replied, no longer declining.
"Take a look at these other items; if there's anything else you need, feel free to take it," Xi Ying suggested.
"No need, this is enough. However, if you get a chance, could you help me find out what this thing really is?" Yuan Ming asked, waving the black lump in his hand with a smile.
"Alright," Xi Ying agreed with a smile.
After that, she gathered the remaining treasures from the ground and continued her cultivation.
Yuan Ming, on the other hand, took out many materials used to make Black Incense from his Storage Ring. He wanted to test if he could use this "coal" to replicate the original Black Incense he had first obtained.
Although it had been quite a while since he last made Black Incense, Yuan Ming's skill in making spiritual incense was perfect, so it didn't take much effort to produce ten sticks of incense using a small piece of coal as the main ingredient.
These ten sticks of incense, in terms of scent, color, and the feeling they gave off, were almost identical to the original Black Incense.
Unable to contain his excitement and curiosity, Yuan Ming immediately stepped out of the Stealing Heaven Tripod, lit one stick, and placed it inside the tripod.
As the wisps of smoke rose, his vision began to blur until everything turned black, and his Divine Sense suddenly plunged into the depths.
The next instant, when he opened his eyes, he saw darkness all around, unable to see anything but vaguely sensing a cold and damp breath, with a "drip-drip" sound of water dripping in the distance.
Yuan Ming instinctively concentrated his eyes, and his vision gradually cleared up, allowing him to see an uneven black dome above him.
It was then he realized that he was in a vast and empty black cavern.
"Where has Brother Wu Lu been placed?" Yuan Ming wondered.
This time, the object of his incense possession was none other than Wu Lu.
As curiosity arose in his heart, Yuan Ming quickly regained his senses and immediately tried to control Wu Lu's body, lifting his arms.
"It worked, it really worked..." Yuan Ming looked at his arms held up in front of him and was instantly overjoyed.
The biggest difference between the imitation Black Incense and the original Black Incense was whether it could control the actions of the possessed person. Judging by the current result, he had succeeded without any doubt.
The "coal" was indeed the key spiritual material for making Black Incense.
Yuan Ming supported himself with his hands on the ground and stood up, moving his limbs slightly, then closed his eyes. The power of his Divine Sense began to spread out, scanning the entire cavern.
However, his Divine Power had barely reached ten yards when it encountered an invisible barrier, blocking it and sending it back.
"There's a barrier?" Yuan Ming frowned.
After saying this, he leaped toward the invisible barrier and, sure enough, found an Array there.
After a thorough investigation, Yuan Ming discovered that the Array was not only defensive, but if he attacked recklessly, it was uncertain whether he could break through quickly, and it would definitely attract the attention of the individual who set up the array.
A careless move could bring calamity to Wu Lu, so Yuan Ming dared not act rashly.
Unable to control Wu Lu to escape, Yuan Ming wanted to first determine Wu Lu's location.
Therefore, Yuan Ming clasped his hands together in front of his chest, closed his eyes, and began to pray sincerely to the Nether Moon God, which was himself, in an attempt to use the generated Desire Power as a marker to sense the location of this place.
However, after trying for a moment, he gave up.
Even though the body he controlled belonged to Wulu, the Divine Soul he used to make vows was his own, and one's own prayers to oneself could not generate Desire Power.
Just as Yuan Ming was pondering if there was any other way, footsteps echoing within the cave suddenly came from outside the Barrier.
Not daring to reveal himself, Yuan Ming immediately returned to his original spot and lay down at once.
In order to prevent his fluctuating soul waves from being detected, he quickly reined in his Divine Thought, feigning an unconscious state.
Before long, the footsteps grew nearer, passing through the Barrier and approaching his side.
The individual appeared young, with long hair cascading over shoulders and Phoenix Eyes expressing neither joy nor sorrow, the corner of the eye marked by a small blood-red mole, and a face wearing a faintly sinister smile.
If it wasn't the Blood Demon Ancestor, who else could it be?
The fellow came to Wulu's side and circled around him, examining him closely. As he did, the smile on his face vanished, and he frowned deeply as he stared at Wulu's face.
Yuan Ming's heart tensed, and he immediately grew nervous.
If discovered, his Divine Soul could return, but Wulu's fate was uncertain.
"Tsk, tsk, it's just this face that's not too pleasing, but this body is truly excellent. Rest assured, I will refine you into the most powerful Puppet, surely to surpass all my previous works," the Blood Demon Ancestor said after a long while.
Yuan Ming was speechless upon hearing this.
But in the next instant, the Blood Demon Ancestor's palm suddenly pressed onto Wulu's chest, where Blood Light shone from the center of his palm. His fingers began to elongate like the tentacles of an octopus, gripping tightly around Wulu's chest.
Immediately after, rolling Demonic Qi began to pour crazily into Wulu's inner body, seeping into his blood, muscles, and bones, starting to transform his physical body.
Yuan Ming's soul was connected to this physical body, and he instantly felt a bone-gnawing severe pain. But before he could react, the duration of the Black Incense Possession had already come to an end.
Assaulted by a feeling of dizziness, Yuan Ming's soul once again plummeted into darkness, promptly returning to his own body.
Once he came to, Yuan Ming's expression was grave.
The Blood Demon Ancestor could actually use Demonic Qi; could there be some connection between him and the Demon World?
As for Wulu, judging from the situation just now, he wouldn't die immediately. Refining a Puppet was not an overnight matter, the more powerful the Puppet, the longer it took.
Alas, he currently had no idea where Wulu was. Even if he wanted to rescue him, he wouldn't know where to start, not to mention that the most urgent matter at hand was to rescue his parents.
Despite his close relationship with Wulu, to Yuan Ming, his parents were ultimately his first priority.
He could only hope that Wulu would hold on for a while longer, giving him the chance to save him.
…* (*)
Inside the dark cave, the Blood Demon Ancestor stopped infusing the Demonic Qi.
Wulu's appearance had drastically changed by now; his skin had turned black and crimson, his eyes dark red, and black Qi swirled about his hands, making him look like a Rakshasa demon from legends.
Blood Puppet Armor appeared on his body, looking as though it had grown completely together with his body, and blood-colored bone spurs emerged from his head, elbows, and other places.
"Not bad," the Blood Demon Ancestor nodded slightly and walked outside.
Wulu, with a dull gaze, followed closely behind him.
Outside the cave was a dark corridor, with stone doors lining both walls, at least twenty or thirty of them.
The Blood Demon Ancestor quickly reached the end of the corridor, which opened up into a vast Abyss. The rock wall beside it was dotted with oddly shaped stones that were jagged and uneven.
A bridge suspended over the Abyss extended straight forward.
The two moved forward in silence, with countless thread-like Blood Lights writhing slowly below the bridge, forming a massive blood-colored vortex. The center was pitch-black, seemingly leading to an unknown place.
In the Blood Light, blood-colored human figures emerged, waving their hands in the air, silently howling with mouths agape, full of pain and resentment. Sadly, they were soon pulled back into the vortex once again.
The Blood Demon Ancestor glanced down, then hastened forward, swiftly crossing the stone bridge and arriving at another stone gate.
He looked hesitant, pondering for a long time before pushing the gate open and entering.
There was also a cave beyond the door, much smaller than the one where Wulu had been imprisoned. Inside stood a black Stone Pillar, half a person's height, topped with a black Flame that crackled occasionally.
"Lord Demon," the Blood Demon Ancestor didn't hesitate to kneel on one knee before the Stone Pillar.
"How are things?" After a few breaths, a grand voice emanated from the black Flames, causing the cave to tremble.
"Reporting to Lord Demon, there has been a change. The number of people entering the Three Immortals Island this time is several times more than expected, including Returning to Void Stage Cultivators and Level 5 Demons. The Evil King Mirror has been taken by others," the Blood Demon Ancestor spoke lowly.
"Waste! I provided you with so many resources, and you couldn't even secure the Evil King Mirror. What use are you to me!" The black Flames suddenly expanded several times over, revealing a huge and vague human face with eyes shooting out two beams of Blood Light, piercing through the Blood Demon Ancestor's body.
The Blood Demon Ancestor's chest was punctured by two holes but no blood spilled out, only eerie Blood Flames kindling at the wounds and quickly spreading over his body. In a moment, his entire body was engulfed.
The Blood Flames emitted neither the sensation of intense heat nor a chilling aura, as if it was something illusory, but it caused the Blood Demon Ancestor's body to shiver uncontrollably, his face twisted with the agony of pain.

chapters.title: Chapter 644 - 616: Counterattack (Happy Mid-Autumn Festival, Fellow Daoists)
chapters.content:
"Lord Demon, spare my life, spare me…" The Blood Demon Ancestor prostrated on the ground, continuously kowtowing, his fear of the Blood Flames on his body extreme.
The immense face watched all this with cold indifference, utterly ignoring the Blood Demon Ancestor's pleas for mercy.
The blood-colored Flames burned silently, the Blood Demon Ancestor's hair quickly turned grey, and wrinkles appeared on his skin—as if he was rapidly aging; even his cries for mercy became feeble.
After a few breaths, the Blood Demon Ancestor had completely transformed into an aged old man, lying on the ground unable to move, on the verge of death.
At that moment, two orbs of Blood Light shone in the eyes of the immense face, spinning rapidly. The Blood Flames on the Body of the Blood Demon Ancestor suddenly left his body and merged into the eyes of the immense face.
"Thank you, Lord Demon." The Blood Demon Ancestor struggled to his knees.
"This is my last act of mercy, mess up again, and I will personally capture your Divine Soul so you will never be reborn." The face said coldly.
"Yes, I understand." The Blood Demon Ancestor said.
"Tell me in detail about the situation on Three Immortals Island, who took the Evil King Mirror?" The immense face asked after a moment of silence.
"It was this person, surnamed Yuan, a Half-step Spoken Witch level Soul Cultivator. I do not know where he got the Soul Cultivation heritage from, but his methods are extraordinary." The Blood Demon Ancestor summoned a water-like light with a wave of his hand, showing the image of Yuan Ming and detailed the process of the Evil King Mirror being taken away.
The Blood Demon Ancestor was not sure of Yuan Ming's Soul Cultivation Realm, but he sensed a Half-step Spoken Witch level Soul Power on Three Immortals Island, so he conveniently blamed Yuan Ming to cover up his own failure.
"A Half-step Spoken Witch? No wonder you were defeated, but since when did such a formidable person appear on the Yunhuang Continent?" The immense face mused.
"I have not heard of this person before either, it's as if he appeared out of nowhere. Perhaps he's a hidden figure from the Yunhuang Continent." The Blood Demon Ancestor said.This content is presented by *.
"Regardless of who this person is, you must retrieve the Evil King Mirror at all costs!" The immense face ordered in a stern voice.
The order of Lord Demon will naturally be obeyed. However, this person is extraordinary, and he has several formidable helpers with him. Rash action may not only fail to retrieve the Evil King Mirror but may also result in capture. For the grand undertaking of Lord Demon, it's only right for me to sacrifice my life if necessary, but as you know, Soul Cultivators are most adept at gathering intelligence. If Lord Demon's plans were to be discovered by him…" The Blood Demon Ancestor hesitated.
The immense face fell silent for a moment, then opened its mouth to spit out two fist-sized illusions of blood-colored Crystal Stones.
Black Flames leaped quickly, casting countless black runes that merged into the illusions of the Crystal Stones.
The illusion of the Crystal Stones rapidly solidified from illusion into reality, transforming into two actual blood-colored Crystal Stones that landed in front of the Blood Demon Ancestor.
Within one blood-colored Crystal Stone, threads of lightning flickered, while in the other a blood-colored tornado whirled.
"I bestow these two Blood Soul Demon Crystals upon you," said the immense face in a deep voice.
"Thank you, Lord Demon. I will surely not fail the mission." The Blood Demon Ancestor, excited, caught the two blood-colored Crystal Stones.
"In addition to the Evil King Mirror, there's another item you need to find." The immense face exhaled a puff of Blood Flames.
A shadow emerged from within the Flames, quickly becoming clear—it was a black Stone Pillar.
"This object is called the Sky-reaching Demon Pillar, also a treasure of the Demon World. I have recently sensed its presence. No matter the cost or even if the Evil King Mirror is not found, this Sky-reaching Demon Pillar must be brought back." The immense face instructed.
"Yes, I will do my utmost to find it," replied the Blood Demon Ancestor.
"I have calculated that the Sky-reaching Demon Pillar should be in the south of the Yunhuang Continent, which is the Southern Border." The immense face spoke.
"Thank you for your guidance, Lord Demon." The Blood Demon Ancestor exclaimed in joy upon hearing this.
With this range in mind, it would be much easier for him to search.
'Do not disappoint me again," said the immense face, its form slowly dissipating, and the black flames returned to their previous size.
The Blood Demon Ancestor stood up, a Blood Light flashed on his body, and he transformed into a set of Blood Puppet Armor with a ghastly mask, which was precisely the one Yuan Wuji once wore.
He placed the Blood Soul Demon Crystal that contained lightning at the forehead of the mask and murmured incantations, activating some secret technique.
Blood Light surged from the Blood Soul Demon Crystal, slowly merging into the mask.
The Blood Demon Ancestor showed an expression of pain, gritting his teeth and enduring.
After a long while, the Blood Soul Demon Crystal had fully merged into the forehead of the Blood Demon Ancestor, as if it were naturally there from the start.
Boom!
Countless blood-colored lightning bolts shot out from within the Blood Soul Demon Crystal, flashing wildly throughout the cave; the Blood Demon Ancestor's Blood Puppet Armor became as translucent as the Blood Soul Demon Crystal, writhing swiftly as if coming to life.
The aura of this person also greatly increased, climbing one level, and the previously aged appearance had also recovered by seventy to eighty percent.
"The Blood Soul Demon Crystal is indeed powerful, absorbing one has raised my Cultivation to Middle-stage Returning Void. I have also mastered this Blood Demon Thunder, but it's a pity I'm still quite unaccustomed to using Demonic Qi, temporarily unable to accommodate the second one, I can only wait…" The Blood Demon Ancestor murmured to himself, then his voice suddenly halted as he looked towards his empty left hand.
The other Blood Soul Demon Crystal had clearly been in his hand just now, where did it go?
Not only that, but Wulu, who had just stood behind him, had also vanished without a trace.
Blood Light blazed from the Blood Soul Demon Crystal on the Blood Demon Ancestor's forehead, sweeping around like a massive eye, his expression turning to one of shock and anger.
With a crackle, a thick blood-colored lightning bolt burst from the Blood Soul Demon Crystal, shooting through the stone door and striking a certain void in the abyss outside, entering it.
Dazzling blood-colored thunder light exploded, and a silhouette emerged out of nowhere—it was Wulu who had just disappeared, blasted away by the blood-colored thunder light, and heavily crashed into the abyss's stone wall.
The normally vacant eyes of Wulu regained clarity at some unknown point. His Blood Puppet Armor across his chest was torn apart, revealing several deep bone-visible wounds, particularly a blood hole piercing through his left chest, where his entire heart had been stabbed and shredded, yet he did not fall.
In his right hand, he was clutching a piece of blood-colored crystal stone, indeed another Blood Soul Demon Crystal.
Hiss-crack!
A streak of blood-colored lightning shot down from above, coming from the Blood Demon Ancestor.
Wulu was not deprived of his ability to move; he stored the Blood Soul Demon Crystal in his hand and then, with a faint glimmer of gray on his body, he once again disappeared without a trace, leaving not the slightest hint of his presence behind.
The Blood Demon Ancestor shot over, his face showing a look of shock.
Wulu had vanished into thin air, and the fluctuation of Demonic Qi from the Blood Soul Demon Crystal that he just was able to detect could no longer be sensed, as if he had completely disappeared.
"Impossible! What invisibility divine ability could hide from the Blood Soul Demon Eye's investigation? This is the proudest investigation divine power of the Demon World's Three-Eyed Clan!" the Blood Demon Ancestor exclaimed in disbelief.
He quickly calmed down, performed a hand seal, and from the demon crystal between his eyebrows, hundreds of blood-colored thunderbolts were fired, all striking the stone wall as if a downpour of thunder and lightning had ensued.
Boom and rumble!
The stone wall completely collapsed, turning into countless large and small rocks, falling within the Blood Light tunnel, shaking the entire underground cave as though it was about to collapse.
A silhouette, covered in blood, appeared at the bottom of the abyss before the blood whirlpool—it was Wulu.
His body slightly swaying, he gritted his teeth and without hesitation, plunged into the whirlpool.
The Blood Demon Ancestor was taken aback and hurriedly gave chase, but was a step too late—as Wulu's figure had already been swallowed by the blood vortex.
The Blood Demon Ancestor stopped in front of the Blood Light tunnel, not pursuing further, his face ashen.
...
After a long month of waiting, Yuan Ming finally returned to the East Sea Inner Sea.
He had been traveling continuously, almost draining the Silver Kong Tree Demon's body. Fortunately, he had been working hard without any slack, thus Xi Ying left the Silver Moon Flying Wheel in his hands.
It was not given directly, but allowed to be kept and used by him.
Even so, the Silver Kong Tree Demon was overjoyed and extremely grateful.
Without stopping, Yuan Ming hurried to Xi Ying's secret base, only to discover upon arrival that it was a small island near the mainland called Pearl Island.
There were no Spirit Veins or Spiritual Energy on the island, so no Cultivation Sect had taken control. The islanders were ordinary people who led lives of fishing, hunting, and diving for pearls.
And that base was hidden deep beneath the island, within a water mansion in the sea.
Mr. Yuan and Yuan Mu finally relaxed their tense nerves upon seeing Yuan Ming.
More than their own safety, Mr. Yuan and Yuan Mu were actually more worried about Yuan Ming, who was running around outside.
"Ming'er, what on earth is going on?" Yuan Mu immediately took Yuan Ming's hand upon her return and wouldn't let go, asking.
"It's nothing serious, just some lowlife scum. They couldn't find me, so they targeted you, causing Mother to worry," Yuan Ming said remorsefully, patting his mother's hand back.
"Who are they?" Yuan Mu couldn't help asking.
"Let it be, Ming'er already said, they're just some lowlife scum, so stop asking so many questions," Mr. Yuan said, quickly intervening.
"I just can't help but worry..." Yuan Mu said, with her eyes beginning to redden.
"Mother, don't worry, I am unharmed. This time I come back, I will uproot those petty thieves," Yuan Ming immediately reassured her.
"Does that mean you will have to leave again?" Yuan Mu asked, unable to hold back.
"Ming'er has things to do, naturally he cannot always stay by our side. Don't say things that will make him worried," Mr. Yuan pulled Yuan Mu over, hugged her shoulders, patted her gently and said.
"Father, Mother, this time I will not leave, I will keep you by my side," Yuan Ming said with a smile.
In the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space, he had already made preparations; he decided to settle his parents there during his time back at the East Sea.
This was a decision he made after much consideration.
No matter where he placed his parents, there was a risk of exposure—it was safer to keep them by his side.
After settling his parents properly, Yuan Ming immediately contacted Wan Tianren, Gu Xuanyang, and others in the name of the Nether Moon God. They had also returned to the East Sea a few days earlier.
He wanted to gather his forces for a counterattack against Fusang Island.
The White Bone Venerable from the Wu Yue Sect's attempt to take away his parents had utterly touched his raw nerve.
This time, he would not only help Wan Tianren and the others reclaim Fusang Island and other Sect islands, but he would also make the Wu Yue Sect and White Bone Venerable pay a bloody price, letting them know the consequences of provoking him.

chapters.title: Chapter 645 - 617: Execute the Traitors
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming settled his parents and then entered the Stealing Heaven Tripod, sat on the White Jade Lotus Platform, and attempted to contact Yan Siyun.
Although he wished he could confront the White Bone Venerable and kill him right away, he was not blinded by his fury. He was well aware that his knowledge of the current situation in the East Sea was negligible; acting rashly might not only result in failing to find his target but might also expose his own weaknesses to the White Bone Venerable.
The most urgent task was to gather intelligence first.
Thus thinking, Yuan Ming searched for Yan Siyun's Desire Power aura near the Lotus Platform but failed to sense her prayers.
As Yan Siyun had been busy with many matters lately, she hadn't prayed often. It was not surprising that he couldn't sense her Desire Power.
After pondering for a moment, Yuan Ming applied the Soul Descent Secret Technique, and his Divine Sense descended upon Miao Xian.
He was in luck—Miao Xian was within the Hundred Pills Square at the moment.
Yan Siyun and her sisters were not at the Hundred Pills Square. Yuan Ming searched around but didn't see them. Miao Xian did not know where the two had gone, only that they had left a day earlier.
However, in a nearby Cave Mansion close to the Hundred Pills Square, Yuan Ming unexpectedly found Xu Che.
Xu Che had just successfully reached Core Formation; his internal Mana was still unstable, obviously having just broken through.
"Xu Che, do you know where Yan Siyun is now?" His voice resounded above Xu Che's head.
"Replying to my lord, after arriving at Dragon King City, I remained in seclusion to break through to Core Formation and do not know Master Yan's whereabouts," Xu Che replied, startled but respectful.
Yuan Ming grew more puzzled and asked about the current situation in the East Sea. Since Xu Che had recently arrived, the intelligence he had was minimal. Yuan Ming could only offer a few encouraging words and then withdrew his Divine Sense.
Yan Siyun's whereabouts were unknown, but locating people was Yuan Ming's forte.
He stepped out of the Stealing Heaven Tripod, lit a stick of Black Incense, and inserted it inside. It possessed Yan Siyun, allowing him to quickly discover her location—she was on Thousand Dragon Island.
Unfortunately, Black Incense Possession could only track a target's location, not communicate with them.
"Thousand Dragon Island... Well, that works. I have matters to discuss with Long Chong." Yuan Ming left a soul split on the White Jade Lotus Platform and summoned Lei Yu, then flew towards Thousand Dragon Island.
…
Find the source of this chapter at *.
Over the vast sea, a Flying Boat sped from the horizon, leaving behind a distinctly noticeable tunneling light.
About a hundred cultivators were on board the Flying Boat, mostly Qi Refinement and Foundation Establishment practitioners, but only four, who were managing the Flying Boat, were at Core Formation.
