The atmosphere on the Flying Boat was somewhat tense; most Qi Refinement and Foundation Establishment disciples were dispirited, neither interested in cultivating nor talking—bearing expressions of worry and unease about the future.
In contrast, the four Core Formation cultivators also showed signs of anxiety but hid a trace of determination in their eyes.
"It's been so long, how come no one has come after us yet?" a dark-skinned Core Formation female cultivator suddenly asked, her face full of confusion.
"The people of the Wu Yue Sect aren't fools. Given our noisy escape, they must suspect a trick, but they won't just watch us get away. I reckon people will come after us soon," the oldest among them, a middle-aged male cultivator, speculated.
"I just hope nothing goes wrong on the Island Master's end," the dark-skinned female cultivator said, worried.
"Sigh, I don't understand why those Wu Yue Sect followers are so adamant about targeting us," a young male cultivator with a pale, beardless face sighed.
"It's probably because of the East Sea Alliance's recent rally call. We're too close to Karma Fire Island, and the Island Master and I were considering whether to relocate under the pretext of responding to the call, away from the Wu Yue Sect's territory. We just didn't expect them to act so quickly. Maybe... there's a traitor on the island," the middle-aged male cultivator said gravely.
"Ah? If that's the case, wouldn't our baiting plan also be exposed?" another long-haired female cultivator anxiously interjected.
"Don't worry, the Island Master has already taken precautions..." the middle-aged male cultivator began, then shook his head and stopped talking.
Seeing his reaction, the other three understood that he and the Island Master might have another plan, but the thought of having a traitor among the comrades they lived with daily unsettled them, adding to their worries.
Just then, the sky outside the Flying Boat suddenly changed, as dark clouds, forming from nowhere, enveloped the sun. Fierce winds howled across the sea, raising giant waves hundreds of feet high. Raindrops pelting the Flying Boat sounded like drums, startling the four Core Formation cultivators.
"Don't panic, steady your minds. This must be an illusion from the Wu Yue Sect!" the leading middle-aged male cultivator called out, regaining his composure instantly.
"Haha, knowing this, how do you think a few pathetic fish and shrimp like you could break the illusion?" With a burst of laughter, three towering figures in black robes appeared in mid-air, surrounding the Flying Boat.
Seeing this, the Qi Refinement and Foundation Establishment disciples stirred into chaos, and simultaneously, the four Core Formation cultivators discovered that they had lost control of the Flying Boat.
"It's fake, all fake, don't be fooled!" shouted the beardless young male cultivator, desperately pinching his spell, trying to control the unresponsive flying boat.
In the sky, the three Wu Yue Sect followers watched with interest, as if watching a monkey show, apparently in no rush to make a move.
Just then, the lead middle-aged male cultivator's eyes flashed with cold light. He suddenly reached for the Jade Pendant at his waist, and in an instant, a gentle breeze rushed towards his Sea of Consciousness, allowing him to see the surrounding scenery clearly.
This was a Magic Treasure he had prepared in advance, capable of clearing the Spirit Platform and dispelling the disturbances of illusion techniques.
The dark clouds and torrential rain disappeared, and the giants in the sky reverted to normal human size, although their positions didn't change much. However, their flying boat was now firmly bound by a dark black chain and completely immobilized.
Seeing this, the middle-aged male cultivator took decisive action. Pinching a spell with his right hand, a small needle instantly flew out from his sleeve robe, catching them off guard and directly piercing the head of a Wu Yue Sect follower.
The next instant, the head of the Wu Yue Sect follower burst open like a watermelon, with brain matter and blood splattering across the sky, greatly startling the other two.
"Senior Brother Hua!" the Wu Yue Sect follower on the left exclaimed in shock.
Hearing this, the middle-aged male cultivator, Zhuang Lin, paused momentarily, recognizing the voice as identical to that of his dark-skinned junior sister.
"Zhuang Lin, well done! I knew you had the heart to join our Wu Yue Sect. I accept your declaration of allegiance today!" A loud laugh from a Wu Yue Sect follower then echoed from the sky.
Simultaneously, the surroundings before Zhuang Lin once again transformed, as dark clouds and torrential rain reappeared, and the sky once again harbored three giant figures. The Wu Yue Sect follower who had just been killed now appeared right before him, even dressed in his junior brother's clothes.
Next to the body, the dark-skinned female cultivator collapsed in tears, and when she turned her head to look at the middle-aged male cultivator, her eyes were filled with irrational hatred.
"No, this isn't—Junior Sister, I..."
Zhuang Lin widened his eyes in disbelief, grabbing the Jade Pendant on his waist, attempting to explain, only to find the pendant in his hand completely differed from the one he had secretly kept.
In that instant, he remembered meeting a junior brother when leaving the island; they had had brief physical contact, which now seemed rather deliberate.
"Liu Si, it was you!" Zhuang Lin roared, his voice filled with anger.
"Haha, Fellow Daoist Zhuang, don't rush, don't rush, I still have one more thing to show you." The Wu Yue Sect follower laughed loudly in the sky, tossing a spherical object into the flying boat.
Zhuang Lin looked closely and saw the spherical object was actually the Island Master's head.
"Your plot was indeed clever, openly having you, the Deputy Island Master, lead a team to escape, drawing attention, while the Island Master secretly led another group of elite disciples to flee. Most crucially, you left a true elite group on the island, covered by an Illusion Array, waiting for us to be distracted by your two operations before you attempted to escape. Unfortunately, you didn't know about my Soul Cultivation Divine Power. The arrangements on the island were entirely clear to my Soul Rats, and in the end, your efforts were in vain." The lead Wu Yue Sect follower chuckled, dropping another head, belonging to Junior Sister Qiu hidden on the island.
Zhuang Lin stared blankly at the two heads, their faces still etched with terror, as tears unknowingly streamed down his cheeks.
"Heaven has abandoned me, Qiuxiang!" he cried out to the sky, nearly spitting blood.
Seeing this, the Wu Yue Sect followers laughed even harder. But just then, a furious shout suddenly pierced through the heavens and earth.
"Wu Yue Sect followers? Die!"
The next moment, the clouds vanished, the storm abruptly halted, and all illusions returned to nothingness.
Zhuang Lin had yet to recover when he saw in the sky a dazzling sword light slashing down, splitting the heavens like the creation of the world, even causing the waves to roll back, leaving a long sword mark on the sea surface.
In an instant, the leading Wu Yue Sect follower was cleaved in two, the body vanishing into thin air before even hitting the ground.
The other two black-robed cultivators were each entwined in purple-black vines, covering every inch of their skin.
As the illusion disappeared, Zhuang Lin also recognized the person behind the three Wu Yue Sect followers—it was the same Liu Si who had swapped his Jade Pendant.
By now, Liu Si was paralyzed with fear, trembling uncontrollably. It took him a long while to regain his senses and think of fleeing, but just as he turned around, he saw standing behind him a handsome young man, his gaze filled with coldness.
"You..." Yuan Ming glanced at Liu Si's clothes, then at the clothing of Zhuang Lin inside the flying boat, noting they were of the same style.
"Elder, he is a traitor of this island, do not let him escape!" Not knowing where the courage came from, Zhuang Lin quickly shouted.
Hearing this, Yuan Ming's eyes grew even colder, possibly reminded of something, and with a cold snort, Liu Si instantly found himself plunged into an illusion.
Yuan Ming grabbed Liu Si by the collar, as if lifting a corpse, and slowly descended into the flying boat, throwing Liu Si in front of Zhuang Lin.
"Since he is a traitor, you should be the one to handle him."

chapters.title: Chapter 646 - 618: On the Brink of Danger
chapters.content:
Zhuang Lin did not speak; she immediately bowed to Yuan Ming, then drew a long saber and, with killing intent on her face, advanced toward Liu Si.
Yuan Ming also temporarily lifted the illusion from Liu Si, allowing him to clearly feel the pain inflicted by Zhuang Lin. As his screams rose, Zhuang Lin's two junior sisters also came to their senses, understanding the whole story. They walked forward with resentment in their eyes and began to take turns cutting into Liu Si, venting their fury.
After the time it takes an incense to burn, Liu Si was thoroughly dead, his body no longer resembling that of a human.
At this time, Zhuang Lin seemed to space out. She suddenly put down the saber, turned around, and shakily walked to the heads of the Island Master and Junior Sister Qiu. Remembering the past scenes, she finally could no longer hold up and collapsed to the ground with a "plop", covering her face with her hands and crying silently.
After a long while, Zhuang Lin composed herself, stood up, and gave Yuan Ming a bow.
"Zhuang Lin of Qiuxiang Island, thanks the senior for your rescue."
"I already have a personal grudge with the Wu Yue Sect, and wouldn't let them off easily since I've encountered them," Yuan Ming waved his hand, indicating that no further thanks were necessary.
"Even so, the senior has ultimately saved our lives. For such a great kindness, I will never forget it in my lifetime. If there's anything you command, I am willing to go through fire and water without hesitation," Zhuang Lin said, bowing again.
"No need for going through fire and water. Actually, I do have something I need your help with," Yuan Ming shook his head and said.
"Whatever the senior commands," Zhuang Lin hurriedly replied.
"When the turmoil of the Wu Yue Sect broke out, I was exploring the outer sea and have only recently returned to the Inner Sea; I am not too familiar with the current situation. Explain it to me in detail," Yuan Ming said.
"Alright, the current situation in the East Sea is that nearly half of the islands have fallen under the control of the Wu Yue Sect. Some were taken by force, but others joined them willingly, and there are yet others that were seized by Loose Cultivators impersonating Wu Yue Sect members, who then were eventually recognized by the Sect," Zhuang Lin said immediately.
"Nearly half… What about the First-level Islands?" Yuan Ming pondered for a moment.
"Among the First-level Islands, Fusang, Golden Turtle, Kongling, and Di Hua were taken over forcefully by the Wu Yue Sect. It is said that only a very few people escaped, so the islands were practically wiped out. The islands of Karmic Fire, Thousand Snake, and Red Rain voluntarily joined the Wu Yue Sect shortly after the upheaval. Thousand Dragon, Bijiao, Yuzhu, Red Leaf, and Wanhua now belong to the East Sea Alliance, but due to their geographical positions, the former two and the latter three are isolated by the Wu Yue Sect, making it difficult for them to communicate with each other. Moreover, there is news that the Wu Yue Sect is now launching a full-scale attack on the Yuzhu Three Islands, forming a siege," Zhuang Lin explained in detail.
"The East Sea Alliance?" Yuan Ming expressed his puzzlement.
"This begins with the initial unrest in the East Sea. I don't know if the senior is aware, but it started in Fusang, reportedly due to the appearance of a Transmission Array leading to the Three Immortals Island that attracted numerous Island Masters and Nascent Soul cultivators. The Wu Yue Sect took this opportunity to seize a number of islands. Not long ago, Wan Tianren, the lost Island Master of Fusang appeared with the Golden Turtle Island Master and others, calling for East Sea cultivators to join forces against the Wu Yue Sect. Thus, they gathered a large number of people under the banner of the East Sea Alliance, preparing to counterattack the Wu Yue Sect. Recently, to break the siege on the Yuzhu Three Islands, the East Sea Alliance issued a call throughout the East Sea, inviting cultivators to assemble at Purple Nan Island in the waters near Red Leaf Island for a decisive battle," Zhuang Lin explained.
"I see, but it seems the situation with the East Sea Alliance isn't very optimistic," Yuan Ming suddenly understood, murmuring to himself.
"Alas, the power of the Wu Yue Sect is too great; they have far more cultivators than the East Sea Alliance alone. Moreover, in terms of high-level combat power, there are two Venerables stationed within the Wu Yue Sect. It is said that Lord Wan once led an ambush against them and was utterly defeated, barely escaping with his life," Zhuang Lin said gloomily.
"Given the dire state of the East Sea Alliance, why would you still join them? Why not just surrender to the Wu Yue Sect like the Thousand Snake and Karmic Fire Islands did instead, and at least save your lives?" Yuan Ming inquired.
"By joining the East Sea Alliance, we may die, but at least we remain Eastern Sea people. Once we join the Wu Yue Sect, we may lose even the basic rights of being human, becoming nothing but slaves to the Wu Yue Sect members. Senior, do you know that the Wu Yue Sect enforces a Blood Tax and a soul tax? Each island must submit a certain number of people and living souls monthly, regardless of the source or means. Whether you refine the commoners under your rule or kill cultivators from other islands, as long as you pay the Blood Tax and soul tax, you can temporarily gain recognition and protection from the Wu Yue Sect. Otherwise, it results in endless pursuit and encirclement," Zhuang Lin spoke with lingering fear.
Yuan Ming fell silent. Although he had rushed here, he had also seen the tragic state of the islands under Wu Yue Sect's control—houses deserted, widespread lamentation, and even the words 'human purgatory' were not enough to encapsulate the bloodiness of those scenes.
If the Wu Yue Sect truly came to control the East Sea, it was feared that the boundless blue ocean would be tainted red with blood.
Having understood the situation, Yuan Ming did not stay long. After bidding farewell to the people of Qiuxiang Island, he boarded Lei Yu and headed straight for Purple Nan Island.
On the way, Yuan Ming made a Blood Slave of the Wu Yue Sect member he had just captured and also performed a Soul Search on them.
Compared to Zhuang Lin, these Wu Yue Sect disciples knew more and far more specific information.
Indeed, the Wu Yue Sect's army had surrounded the Yuzhu Three Islands, but contrary to Yuan Ming's expectations, White Bone Venerable, the commander of the Wu Yue Sect's Eastern Sea forces, did not order a full assault. Instead, he prepared to enforce a siege, compelling the islands to surrender.
The reason behind this seemed to be White Bone Venerable's desire to preserve as much of the resources stored on the three islands as possible, in order to fill the shortcomings in the sect's logistics.
It made sense, after all, the cultivators of the Yuzhu Three Islands were not adept at fighting, but they had notable achievements in alchemy, medicine cultivation, and talisman making. These three islands could be considered the wealthiest in the East Sea, with resources stored there nearly accounting for half of the total circulating supplies in the East Sea.
If the Wu Yue Sect could seize this place, they would no longer worry about logistics, and the East Sea would essentially fall into their hands.
The East Sea Alliance naturally realized this and thus gathered the East Sea cultivators, preparing to put their full effort into one decisive battle.
And the Yuzhu Three Islands were not sitting ducks; somehow, they managed to move all three islands to one place and arranged an extremely powerful Great Array around them. The Wu Yue Sect's several probing attempts were thwarted by the Formation, with not even a glimpse of the people from the Yuzhu Three Islands.
This perhaps was another major reason for White Bone Venerable's order to besiege them.
The Wu Yue Sect's siege was not just a simple encirclement; under White Bone Venerable's leadership, they also set up a Red Blood Sand Formation around the Grand Array that shrouded the three islands. They turned defense into offense and completely trapped the Yuzhu Three Islands inside, cutting off any possibility of communication with the outside world.
The East Sea Alliance was now ironically blocked outside by this Great Array, unable to access the logistical resources of the Yuzhu Three Islands and having to face the Wu Yue Sect's large army within the formation. They could not retreat, yet it was extremely difficult to advance—an utterly vexing and intractable situation.
Based on these disciples' memories, the situation in the East Sea was as bad, if not worse than what Zhuang Lin had described.
Despite being disappointed with Wan Tianren's performance, Yuan Ming considered that under circumstances where Fusang Island's forces were almost completely wiped out, and several First-level Islands had defected during the battle, for him to still maintain a battle line was already making the best of a bad situation.
With this thought, Yuan Ming sighed inwardly, then gently patted Lei Yu, signaling it to accelerate its tunneling speed.
...
Inside the central hall of Purple Nan Island, Wan Tianren sat at the head seat, flanked by several Nascent Soul cultivators.
This hall, though not grand, had now become the place of discussion for the upper echelons of the East Sea Alliance, bustling with people coming and going every day, fiercely debating amongst themselves.
But as the tide of war turned against them, the atmosphere in the hall became heavier with each passing day, filling the entire Purple Nan Island with an air of anxiety and worry.
Forcharactersheetsandglossaries,visit*.
"Today, people from four Second-level Islands responded to the call and came to join us, but we're running out of accommodation on the island. Some cultivators have already started arguing privately over this issue. Although it has not escalated to a fight, it's bound to lead to trouble if it continues," said an elderly Daoist in white robes with a head full of white hair, sitting to the left of Wan Tianren, with grave concern.
"The stock of elixirs, especially healing elixirs, is also running low. I've already gathered most of the island's Alchemists to refine elixirs day and night, but supply still can't keep up with demand. Moreover, there's a shortage of spiritual materials for alchemy. We must quickly find one or two stable sources," the green-robed middle-aged cultivator next to the old man spoke up.
"Small groups of Wu Yue Sect members have appeared near Smoke and Mist Island. The cultivators stationed there took them on, suffering tragic casualties. Only when people from nearby islands came to their aid were they able to drive off the Wu Yue Sect members. We'll have to find a way to squeeze out some compensation for the aftermath. In the future, it would be best to provide more lifesaving talismans and elixirs to those dispatched to garrison nearby islands; otherwise, sending them is tantamount to sending them to their deaths," as soon as they finished speaking, a Merfolk middle-aged man on Wan Tianren's right side took over the conversation.
"Alas, everyone's resources are scarce, and we hardly have extra talismans and elixirs to allocate. We'll have to make do for now, but the priority must be given to the teams in charge of sieges. If they can take back one or two islands from the Wu Yue Sect, it would greatly alleviate our situation here," the white-haired old Daoist lamented.
"Defending is already failing us, and you're thinking of launching a counter-attack? Besides, we currently don't have the spare capacity to reclaim lost territories. Every time we take an island, it's plunder and leave. At this rate, how are we different from the Wu Yue Sect? The only difference is that we are weaker in strength!" The Merfolk man looked upset.
"What kind of talk is that? We plunder resources to fight against the Wu Yue Sect, for the peace and stability of the entire East Sea. If we starve ourselves due to meaningless kindness, that would be truly foolish. Besides, the islands we plunder have sided with the Wu Yue Sect. If we don't take those resources, the enemy will end up offering them to the Wu Yue Sect, gifting the enemy for nothing," the Merfolk man's side, a young man from the Water Ape Clan said with a sneer.

chapters.title: Chapter 647 - 619 Timely Rain
chapters.content:
"True, some islands have indeed defected to the Wuyue Sect for their own interests, but many were simply forced by the circumstances, having no intention of actively supporting the Wuyue Sect. Yet, it's you, Hou Chou, that I've heard time and again targeting those rich islands, plundering all their resources and even capturing the cultivators on the island to enslave them. By doing so, you are tarnishing the reputation of our East Sea Alliance!" the Merfolk man rebuked.
"Hmph, reputation? Can reputation help us defeat the Wuyue Sect, can it help us break through the Red Blood Red Sand Formation? War relies on strength! Without plundering resources, what are my men supposed to eat and use? Should I have my people do those miscellaneous tasks instead of capturing slaves?" Hou Chou of the Water Ape Clan retorted coldly.
Wan Tianren's face was as grim as water, seeing several Nascent Soul cultivators starting to argue again, he suddenly rubbed his temples and let out a heavy sigh.
"Enough, let's drop it!"
His voice wasn't loud but carried an air of authority distinctive of those who had long held power. The Merfolk man, though reluctant, obediently closed his mouth. Hou Chou, however, threw a provocative look at the Merfolk man, seemingly indifferent to Wan Tianren's reprimand.
"Everyone's been working hard these days. I will find another way to resolve the resource shortage. For now, those who can afford it should share what they have until we weather this period. As for counterattacks, going forward we should target islands that have clearly defected to the Wuyue Sect, and unwanted capture of cultivators is also prohibited. Hou Chou, restrain your subordinates more, we can't afford any unrest over trivial matters in the current situation," Wan Tianren directed his gaze at Hou Chou and said.
"As you command, my lord Alliance Leader," Hou Chou replied with a low chuckle, his tone carrying a hint of sarcasm.
Wan Tianren's expression darkened, but he forcefully suppressed any outburst and turned his head to Gu Xuanyang on his left and asked:
"Fellow Daoist Gu, there hasn't been any news from the Thousand Dragon Island for a long time. When exactly is their army arriving? Have the envoys we sent out gotten any response?"
"Reporting to the Alliance Leader, fifteen days ago, Long Wenyang, the brother of the Golden Transformation Master, launched a surprise rebellion while the Golden Transformation Master was unguarded; he nearly killed him. Fortunately, Long Chong, the Golden Transformation Master's son, was able to catch Long Wenyang by forcefully activating the Nine Dragon Pearl at a critical moment. After interrogation, we learned that Long Wenyang seems to have been enticed by the Wuyue Sect to start the chaos," Gu Xuanyang reported.
With Golden Turtle Island having suffered substantial damage, barely faring better than Fusang Island, and Gu Xuanyang being far less powerful than Wan Tianren, he extinguished any thoughts of contending with him for dominance.
"It must be the work of the Soul Cultivators, I guess. Such an important matter, why am I only hearing about it now!" Wan Tianren's tone carried some displeasure.
"The Wuyue Sect somehow severed the alliance's communication with Thousand Dragon Island. After the incident, Thousand Dragon Island was so preoccupied with its own crisis that there was no time to send messengers, and our people encountered a storm on the way and were delayed for a long time before arriving, which took even more time...," Gu Xuanyang explained with a sigh.
Wan Tianren also felt somewhat helpless upon hearing this. The Wuyue Sect was powerful and even among his own people, loyalties varied. Coupled with the Soul Cultivators in Wuyue Sect, who possessed many bizarre methods, discerning the loyal from the traitors, and those secretly rebelling, was indeed difficult.
Just then, outside the great hall, a gaunt young man dressed in dark clothes dashed in, knelt down on one knee, and reported to Wan Tianren, "Alliance Leader Wan, another Nascent Soul elder has arrived, claiming to be Yuan Ming, asking for an audience with you..."
Before the gaunt young man could finish speaking, Wan Tianren stood up abruptly, his face lighting up with joy: "Quick, bring him in!"
Gu Xuanyang and others who knew Yuan Ming also rejoiced.
The gaunt young man replied and turned to leave, whereas the Nascent Soul cultivators in the hall were quite surprised, not knowing the significance of this Yuan Ming, who managed to evoke such an enthusiastic response from Wan Tianren and the others.
Soon, led by the gaunt young man, Yuan Ming entered the great hall with measured steps, his gaze sweeping across the Nascent Souls before settling on Wan Tianren and Gu Xuanyang.
Both Wan Tianren and Gu Xuanyang's auras were extremely unstable, as if they had suffered severe injuries and appeared to have their Primordial Qi drained.
Yuan Ming recalled what Zhuang Lin had said, that both Wan Tianren and Gu Xuanyang had been defeated by the White Bone Venerable and had narrowly escaped death. Now it seemed that it was not just a rumor spread by the Wuyue Sect to disrupt the morale of the troops.
"Alliance Leader Wan, I, Yuan Ming, have just returned to the Inner Sea and am late in joining the alliance. Please forgive me," Yuan Ming said with a gesture of respect in front of everyone.
"Haha, Fellow Daoist Yuan, you jest. How could you be late? I would say your timing is akin to timely rain! Quick, quick, bring another chair for Fellow Daoist Yuan, right next to me," Wan Tianren smiled at Yuan Ming and hurriedly ordered the attendants to bring a seat.
This astonished the people present even more. Now that they had met him, those who had witnessed the Immortal Fruit Conference naturally recognized Yuan Ming as the dark horse who had stood out at the event. Although he had now advanced to Nascent Soul, at most he warranted a mention as a genius, but where did he deserve such courteous treatment from the Late-stage Nascent Soul Wan Tianren?
Moreover, they had already found out that Yuan Ming was simply affiliated with the Red Ganoderma Island in name and was from an obscure Loose Cultivator background, without the backing of a prominent force. In the current East Sea Alliance, he wasn't considered much of a figure.
Facing the inquisitive eyes of the crowd, Yuan Ming smiled slightly and confidently accepted Wan Tianren's kindness, walking straight to the seat of honor and sitting down to the right of Wan Tianren.
No sooner had he seated himself than Hou Chou suddenly spoke up, "Alliance Leader Wan, Fellow Daoist Yuan has just arrived and is yet to establish any merits. Is it not against the rules for him to take a seat at the head of the table?"
As he spoke, he glanced at Yuan Ming with a hint of disdain.
"Alliance Leader Wan, may I ask who this is?" Yuan Ming asked Wan Tianren with a puzzled look.
"I am Hou Chou, Clan Leader of the Water Ape Clan!" Before Wan Tianren could introduce him, Hou Chou declared loudly.
It was obvious to anyone with clear sight that Hou Chou was utterly disregarding Wan Tianren. What was strange was that the other Nascent Soul cultivators present seemed to be accustomed to this, and even Wan Tianren only flashed a brief look of annoyance without rebuking him openly.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming appraised Hou Chou once more, noticing his fierce and defiant appearance and the peak of Middle-stage Nascent Soul cultivation that radiated from him, which immediately led Yuan Ming to several conjectures.
"I have heard that the Water Ape Clan is famous for its dual governance, where, aside from the Clan Leader handling major affairs, there is also a Grand Marshal in charge of military operations and external affairs. May I know who the current Marshal is?" Yuan Ming's gaze swept over the other Water Ape Clan Nascent Soul cultivators present.
However, they all kept silent, not even lifting their heads, making Yuan Ming's question seem to fall on deaf ears. But with the power of Emotion Manipulation, he sensed ripples in the heart of one of the slimmer Nascent Soul Water Apes present.
"Hehe, with the current precarious situation in the East Sea, adhering to archaic traditions would indeed be too rigid. Therefore, as the Clan Leader, I've taken special measures and now also hold the position of Grand Marshal," Hou Chou said with a light smile.
"Oh, could it be that you are the brother of Hou Shang?" Yuan Ming asked pointedly, though he already knew the answer.Theauthenticversionison*.
Hou Shang was the real name of the robust Water Ape clansman Yuan Ming met on Three Immortals Island.
"I am his clan uncle," Hou Chou replied, his expression darkening.
"Oh, then that is curious. I once met Fellow Daoist Hou Shang on Three Immortals Island, and I heard that he had temporarily transferred the position of Grand Marshal of Water Ape Island to his brother. However, he was trapped on Three Immortals Island at the time and didn't know much about the outside world. Therefore, the decisions he made naturally lacked the decisiveness and wisdom of Clan Leader Hou. In times of chaos, strict measures should be used, and Water Ape Island should now have only one voice, not allowing others to interfere," Yuan Ming said with a smile.
All the Nascent Soul cultivators present were old and experienced; they understood that Yuan Ming's words were indirectly accusing Hou Chou of being autocratic, disregarding the wishes of Hou Shang, who was also a Nascent Soul, just for the sake of his own position.
Moreover, as the Clan Leader and one of the most powerful cultivators in the Water Ape Clan, the position of Grand Marshal was ultimately under Hou Chou's command. To seek a mere title at the expense of his reputation showed how heavy his desire for fame and profit was.
Because of his previous encounter with Hou Shang, Yuan Ming had more understanding of Water Ape Island's situation than anyone present, which allowed him to comprehend Hou Chou's reasons for his actions.
Within Water Ape Island, there lived a demon beast known as "Ancestor Ape," extremely ferocious and powerful enough to rival a Late-stage Nascent Soul. The only issue was that the Ancestor Ape often fell into a state of mental confusion, becoming uncontrollable and attacking anyone in sight, friend or foe alike.
For safety, the ancestors of Water Ape Island covertly created a Magic Treasure known as the Tiger Talisman, capable of controlling the Ancestor Ape, and split it into two, entrusting it to the hands of the Clan Leader and the Grand Marshal. This was to prevent the Ancestor Ape from falling into the wrong hands and to guard against ambitious descendants who might try to use the Ancestor Ape to dominate the East Sea and lead the Water Ape Clan to ruin.
Hou Shang, as the former Grand Marshal, naturally carried half of the Tiger Talisman with him. However, he did not expect to be trapped on Three Immortals Island, and with the disruptions caused by the Wu Yue Sect in the East Sea, he had no choice but to send out his half of the talisman to be managed by his brother. He did not anticipate that Hou Chou would seize this opportunity.
Having his shortcomings pointed out by Yuan Ming, Hou Chou's face darkened momentarily, but then his expression softened, and he laughed heartily.
"Haha, a misunderstanding, a misunderstanding. My assumption of the Marshal position was merely a temporary measure. I was planning to hand over the role when Hou Shang returned. Unfortunately, after his ordeal on Three Immortals Island, he was left with only his Nascent Soul. He could not recover quickly, so I had to continue in his stead. It was also Hou Shang's own wish," Hou Chou explained.
"I see, well then, let's not dwell on trivial matters for now. Clan Leader Hou is right; I'm new here and not very familiar with the situation. I wonder if Alliance Leader Wan could explain in detail the troubles we face here. Perhaps I could be of some assistance," Yuan Ming nodded and, as if he had not been the one to bring up the issue just moments ago, settled into his seat quite naturally and began inquiring about the current situation of the East Sea Alliance.
Hou Chou's gaze tensed, and although a trace of irritation flickered through his eyes, he held back from reacting.
And the other Nascent Soul cultivators also came to realize that it was Hou Chou who had initially challenged Yuan Ming, yet within a few words, it had turned into Hou Chou defending his own status. The question of Yuan Ming's right to sit at the head of the table had been completely forgotten by him, and if he brought it up again now, he would appear petty and overly concerned with prestige.

chapters.title: Chapter 648 - 620 Breakthrough
chapters.content:
Those present marveled at Yuan Ming's gentle and nurturing methods, and Wan Tianren, who had been silently observing and watching Yuan Ming clash with Hou Chou, also had a hint of a smile in his eyes.
Ever since he and Gu Xuanyang were severely injured by the White Bone Venerable, Hou Chou's behavior had become increasingly arrogant and overbearing. Relying on controlling the Ancestor Ape, he had expressed dissatisfaction with Wan Tianren more than once, always trying to replace him and take complete control of the East Sea Alliance to become the overlord of the East Sea.
For many reasons, Wan Tianren naturally couldn't afford to completely fall out with Hou Chou. After all, the other party had value and had not yet crossed his bottom line, but letting him be would have a negative impact on his own authority.
He was pleased with the arrival of Yuan Ming, firstly because of his strength and the status as a Divine Envoy of the Moon God Sect, and secondly because he wanted to use Yuan Ming to balance against Hou Chou.
However, matters of power struggle could be set aside for now. As the Island Master of Fusang Island, with his home now fallen, he was the most dedicated to dealing with the Wu Yue Sect.
Upon Yuan Ming's inquiry about the situation within the East Sea Alliance, Wan Tianren also temporarily set aside other thoughts and began to introduce the situation to Yuan Ming.
The situation was largely the same as Yuan Ming understood, with the only difference being that the Wu Yue Sect had fewer people than the East Sea Alliance.
The Wu Yue Sect acted ruthlessly, their conquests often leading to rivers of blood. As a result, although they occupied a vast number of islands, they recruited few people, and many did not genuinely submit but only did so due to the situation. Many responded to Wan Tianren's call for support, such as Qiuxiang Island that Yuan Ming had encountered before, but unfortunately, they were encountered by Wu Yue Sect followers before they could take action.
Despite this, the battle situation still favored the Wu Yue Sect, as they had many Soul Cultivators with extraordinary strength and the home advantage with the Red Blood Sand Formation. In every major battle, as soon as the East Sea Alliance achieved some success, the Wu Yue Sect would activate the Great Array, rapidly reversing the situation.
The current stalemate was holding, but while the Wu Yue Sect could afford to wait, the East Sea Alliance could not. Yuzhu Three Islands were still trapped in the Formation, and if they were the first to falter, the Wu Yue Sect, with logistic reinforcements, would leave the East Sea Alliance without any chance of victory.
"... This, then, is the current situation of our alliance," Wan Tianren finished, sighing unintentionally.
Yuan Ming nodded, lost in thought, when suddenly Hou Chou spoke again:
"Fellow Daoist Yuan must have some exceptional qualities to receive such appreciation from Alliance Leader Wan. Surely, you must have a good strategy for defeating the enemy. Please, do not keep it to yourself."
"I have yet to see the Red Blood Sand Formation with my own eyes, so I do not dare to speak hastily. It is better to understand more intelligence first," Yuan Ming replied, shaking his head gently and unaffected by Hou Chou's provocative tone.
"Ha, I thought you had great abilities, but it turns out you're just an incompetent person in the end. Alliance Leader Wan better be cautious, don't be fooled by some who only put on an act and inadvertently let this alliance lose its advantage," Hou Chou laughed loudly with an insinuating tone.
Yuan Ming, however, did not get angry, not even casting an extra glance at Hou Chou.
"You needn't worry about my judgment, Clan Leader Hou. I think it's about time; let's conclude today's discussion," Wan Tianren said with a grand wave of his hand, signaling the others to leave.
Hou Chou snorted coldly and immediately got up to leave. The others looked at each other, some left directly, while some paid their respects to Wan Tianren before departing.
But Yuan Ming had personal matters to inquire about, so he did not get up, and Wan Tianren too appeared to have something he wished to discuss privately with him, so he also remained silent.Thispartofthecollectionon*.
After everyone had left, Wan Tianren was the first to speak, giving a wry smile towards Yuan Ming.
"I have made quite a spectacle for the Divine Envoy Yuan to witness," he said.
"Power struggles are common everywhere. It is just that the situation is so dire, yet Hou Chou still has the mind for internal conflict, which really leaves much to be desired," Yuan Ming spoke indifferently.
"Alas, with the Ancestor Ape at his disposal, and both Fellow Daoist Gu and I gravely injured, Hou Chou has the strongest combat power within our alliance, and I can't suppress him. I must ask Divine Envoy Yuan to bear with him," Wan Tianren said as he bowed slightly.
"Rest assured, I'm not so petty as to get frustrated over such a small-minded person," Yuan Ming replied calmly.
"Speaking of which, I couldn't say everything in front of everyone just now. But now, I must be frank with you—the situation of the East Sea Alliance is even worse than I described. With the large number of Cultivators stationed on the islands, resources are consumed at an alarming rate. At most, we can only hold out for twenty days. After that, if we can't break through the Wu Yue Sect's forces, we'll have no choice but to retreat," Wan Tianren said with a worried expression.
"Twenty days, huh... it should be barely enough. Alliance Leader Wan need not worry; I will find a Breaking Formation Technique before then," Yuan Ming pondered for a moment, then confidently declared.
"If that's truly the case, I would like to express my gratitude on behalf of all fellow Daoists to Divine Envoy Yuan in advance," Wan Tianren said, with a mix of anticipation and disbelief.
"Alliance Leader Wan just needs to spread the teachings of the Moon God Sect well, so more people will believe in Lord Nether Moon God. That way, any problem can be resolved easily," Yuan Ming said earnestly.
His purpose here was not only to assist the East Sea Alliance and eradicate the Wu Yue Sect but more importantly to grow the following of the Moon God Sect and increase its believers.
"Understood, I will do as instructed!" Wan Tianren responded respectfully.
"With that settled, then I'll take my leave," Yuan Ming said as he got up and left the grand hall.
A group of people flew over from a distance, escorting several large Flying Cars and Flying Boats. They appeared to be a merchant caravan, led by a red-robed woman with a red ribbon over her eyes—it was Yan Siyun.
"Fellow Daoist Yan, it's been a long time," Yuan Ming greeted her with a slight smile as he walked up to her.
He had just been in the great hall when he sensed that Yan Siyun had come with others, prompting him to take his leave.
Yan Siyun was initially shocked but, after sweeping the area with her Divine Sense and recognizing it was Yuan Ming, her face beamed with joy.
"Divine Envoy Yuan, you have finally come out from the secret realm!" she exclaimed with delight.
Yuan Ming nodded with a smile and then gave her a few appraising looks.
Nowadays, Yan Siyun was dressed in a light red tight-fitting attire, her long hair tied up high, making her appear much more dashing and far less delicate than before.
Not only had Yan Siyun's temperament changed drastically, but her cultivation had also greatly advanced. Her aura was smooth and well-integrated, evidently having reached the Core Formation Stage.
"I didn't expect that you would have formed your Golden Core by now, truly a matter for congratulations," Yuan Ming said.
"Thanks to Lord Nether Moon God's blessing, otherwise I may have never reached this step," Yan Siyun replied with a look of gratitude.
Ever since she started practicing the Divination Secret Skill given by Xi Ying, her lifespan and fortune had dwindled, making the advancement to the Core Formation Stage increasingly uncertain. She had almost given up on the pursuit of the Immortal Path. It was only after receiving the Spirit Origin Fruit bestowed by the Nether Moon God that she rallied herself and, with renewed vigor, finally broke through to Core Formation.
At the same time, Yan Siyun also noticed Yuan Ming's current level of cultivation, and surprise flashed across her beautiful face.
"Have you become a Nascent Soul cultivator?"
"In the secret realm, there is a place where the flow of time differs from the outside world. I had to engage in arduous cultivation for several decades there before I luckily made the breakthrough," Yuan Ming explained with a smile.
"I see. But there are countless cultivators in the world who are stuck in the Core Formation Stage, some spending a lifetime without breaking through. Fellow Daoist Yuan... no, Senior Yuan, to achieve so much at such a young age, it's no wonder you've gained favor from Lord Nether Moon God," Yan Siyun sincerely remarked.
"Heh, Fellow Daoist Yan, no need for formalities. Let's continue as peers as we did before; I still prefer you calling me Fellow Daoist Yuan. By the way, shouldn't you be at Dragon King City? What brings you here?" Yuan Ming asked with a slight smile.
Currently interacting with Yan Siyun as Yuan Ming, he had to be cautious with his words. Therefore, although he already knew that Yan Siyun had come here with the people from Red Ganoderma Island, he couldn't reveal it carelessly.
"It's a long story. I wished to remain in Dragon King City, but current disturbances in the East Sea have led to widespread rumors and hindered the flow of information, making it less convenient than before. The intelligence delivered has become increasingly sparse and sometimes even contradictory. Just so happens, the East Sea Alliance has placed an order with Hundred Pills Square for a batch of supplies and elixirs. With the situation in the East Sea being unstable and the transportation of supplies difficult, I led the merchant caravan to gather everything and deliver it to Purple Nan Island. Moreover, being at the frontline here makes it easier for me to acquire firsthand intelligence to report to Lord Nether Moon God," Yan Siyun explained.
"I see," Yuan Ming said, glancing at the token in Yan Siyun's hand while recalling that she had not been able to pray for several days in a row.
"Please wait a moment, Fellow Daoist Yuan, I need to deliver the elixirs and supplies to the East Sea Alliance," Yan Siyun said.
Hundred Pills Square and the East Sea Alliance seemed to have engaged in transactions before, and Yan Siyun quickly completed the handover. She then took Yuan Ming to her accommodations on Purple Nan Island.
The setup inside the house was similar to her residence in Dragon King City, with storage shelves on all four walls neatly arranged with various Jade Scrolls, all containing intelligence about the situation in the East Sea.
"Fellow Daoist Yan, do you have any intelligence regarding the Red Blood Sand Formation here?" Yuan Ming asked straightforwardly after seating himself.
He trusted Yan Siyun more than the East Sea Alliance.
Yan Siyun nodded, then took out several Jade Scrolls that included descriptions of the scenes when the Red Blood Crimson Sand Array was deployed, first-hand accounts of the sensations felt by those who entered the Formation, and extensive information on the Formation gleaned from various classics.
It was said that the Formation used Qi-Blood as its guide and living souls as a catalyst. During setup, a large number of living beings needed to be prepared for a Blood Sacrifice. Once the Formation was complete, it could be activated and deactivated at will. Once activated, violent winds would whip up a sky full of Red Sand, continually assaulting the enemy without rest. If one did not use magic to resist, the bloodthirsty Red Sand would invade the body, causing Qi-Blood to become chaotic and conflicted, eventually leading to an explosive death.
Throughout the conflict, the number of the East Sea Alliance's deaths due to this Formation was countless. If they managed to escape desperately and fall outside the Formation, it was still better; if they unfortunately perished within, their Qi-Blood would be absorbed by the Formation, serving to enhance its power further.
Moreover, this Formation could also disrupt space, such that no island within could use a Transmission Array to move. Otherwise, one would inevitably fall into chaotic spatial currents.
The East Sea Alliance spent a long time researching a Breaking Formation Technique and eventually discovered that the Formation actually contained several Array Eyes. If they could find the exact locations and send individuals to infiltrate and destroy them, the Formation would automatically collapse and cease to be a problem.
However, merely observing from the outside was not enough to find the Array Eyes. The East Sea Alliance had tried more than once to secretly send Array Masters into the Formation to locate them.
But the Wu Yue Sect had Soul Cultivators in place with Divine Sense far surpassing that of ordinary cultivators. The East Sea Alliance's every infiltration attempt was detected by the Wu Yue Sect's guards before they could get far, immediately activating the Great Array. In the end, the East Sea Alliance could only return empty-handed.
"Hmm... It seems I need to take a trip there myself to see this Formation with my own eyes. Where exactly is it located?" Yuan Ming put down the Jade Scroll and mused for a moment.
"Go north from here. Follow the line from Nanshan Island approaching Ting Chao Island, and you will find it. However, Fellow Daoist Yuan, please be careful. The Wu Yue Sect has stationed many people on the frontline islands. If they detect a Nascent Soul approaching, they might immediately activate the Formation," Yan Siyun cautioned as she handed over another Jade Scroll that recorded the battle lines between the Wu Yue Sect and the East Sea Alliance.
Yuan Ming nodded, stood up, and left. Soon, he found the location of the Red Blood Sand Formation, using the map as a guide.

chapters.title: Chapter 649 - 621: Affections Belong
chapters.content:
Before approaching the Red Blood Sand Formation, Yuan Ming had already used the Void Transformation Technique to conceal his presence. As he flew near Ting Chao Island, he indeed sensed a Core Formation Stage Divine Sense spreading out from the island, ceaselessly monitoring the surrounding sea.
Apart from the obvious Divine Sense, Yuan Ming could also detect many covert glances sweeping over the area. However, they were all unable to see through Yuan Ming's Void Transformation Technique, allowing him to enter the formation directly without any reaction.
Although it looked ordinary from the outside, when Yuan Ming flew over the airspace of Ting Chao Island, he felt as if he was passing through a thin membrane, entering something internally. The sky above him instantly changed color; the azure sky turned a bright red, as if the evening glow had spread across the entire sky.
However, perhaps because it had not been fully activated, there was no presence of Blood Qi in the air, and the free Spiritual Energy was similar to the outside world without being drawn and concentrated by the formation.
Yuan Ming looked around, and with his expertise in formations, it was still difficult for him to see through such a high-level Great Array at a glance. However, the guarantee he made to Wan Tianren about breaking the formation in twenty days was not an empty boast.
And the source of his confidence, of course, was the Array Master who was always with him.
"Xi Ying, what do you think?" Yuan Ming asked in a low voice.
"Hmm, this formation is indeed a bit complex, and the scope is too large. Just observing from this spot, I can't figure anything out. Where is the battle map Yan Siyun gave you?, and the two islands closest to Ting Chao Island under the control of the Wu Yue Sect? Take me to see them too," It seemed even Xi Ying found it somewhat challenging.
Without any objection, Yuan Ming took out the map, identified the direction, and swiftly headed to another island in the northeast direction.
Soon, he had explored the two closest islands, but Xi Ying was not satisfied and had him visit several more islands before finally reaching a conclusion.
"Alright, I've figured it out. It's not far off from what the East Sea Alliance deduced. This Red Blood Sand Formation is anchored by eight Array Eyes. However, since the formation's range is so vast, we only need to break any four of these Array Eyes to disrupt its operations and break through it in one fell swoop," Xi Ying said, and recorded the locations of the Array Eyes on a Jade Scroll, which he handed to Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming compared the Array Eye locations with the battle map provided by Yan Siyun and quickly realized that breaking four Array Eyes simultaneously would not be simple.
The entire Battle Formation of the Wu Yue Sect was arranged around the gathered Yuzhu Three Islands.
From north to south, the sea domain where Yuzhu Three Islands were located could be divided into three sections. The northernmost part, where the main base of Wu Yue Sect is located, had three Array Eyes. The middle part, the current location of the Yuzhu Three Islands, had an Array Eye on each side of the islands. The southernmost part was the frontline where the East Sea Alliance was confronting the Wu Yue Sect, where Yuan Ming was currently situated, had three Array Eyes.
Given the current situation, in order to prevent the Wu Yue Sect from being alerted prematurely, only a few Nascent Souls could be sent to attack the Array Eyes stealthily.
Yuan Ming believed that with his current strength, leading a team to break an Array Eye alone wouldn't be an issue. He could also have Elder San Jue handle another Array Eye in the northern part of the Red Leaf Sea Domain by himself. The remaining Array Eye could be tackled by the experts of the East Sea Alliance, which should not pose a problem.
But who would take care of the last Array Eye had become a problem.
For safety, they had to choose one of the two Array Eyes in the Yuzhu Sea Domain, but Yuan Ming could not separate too far from Elder San Jue, meaning they had to handle an Array Eye in the same sea domain.
Splitting the forces of the East Sea Alliance was even more unrealistic. If they could directly reach the Yuzhu Sea Domain, they wouldn't need to consider breaking the formation.
Moreover, the four Array Eyes needed to be broken simultaneously, and the speed definitely could not be slow. Otherwise, if there is any delay, the Wu Yue Sect would definitely notice their intent. At that time, if they activated the Great Array outright, all efforts would be in vain.
However, since they already had a way to break the formation, Yuan Ming did not stay long and quickly returned to Purple Nan Island to find Wan Tianren, informing him of both the method and the difficulties.
"If that's the case… we might have to ask Senior Jin Chao to make a move," Wan Tianren pondered for a long time, eventually showing a troubled expression as he sighed.
"Senior Jin Chao is also in the alliance?" Yuan Ming was somewhat surprised.
As a Level 5 Demon Beast, Jin Chao was virtually unmatched throughout Yunhuang. If he was present, the Wu Yue Sect, even aided by a Great Array, should have been defeated by the East Sea Alliance long ago. How could it have reached a point where the East Sea Alliance was in such a plight?
"Alas, Fellow Daoist Yuan, you do not know, Senior Jin Chao, although residing on Fusang Island, has always been indifferent to the conflicts among cultivators. Even now that Fusang Island has been occupied by the Wu Yue Sect, it is merely an insignificant matter to him. In the past, he might have lent a hand because of the Fusang Tree, but since leaving Three Immortals Island, he has other matters to deal with and has never again appeared in public; his whereabouts are unknown," Wan Tianren said, with a wry smile.
"So what Alliance Leader Wan meant just now was…" Yuan Ming queried.
"Although Senior Jin Chao doesn't care about the affairs of the East Sea, he still has some sentimental connection to our island's ancestors. He left behind a Fire Feather, allowing us to contact him in dire circumstances. Whether or not we can persuade him to take action after making contact, however, is another matter," Wan Tianren explained, looking at Yuan Ming with a plea in his eyes.
"Does Alliance Leader Wan want me to persuade Senior Jin Chao?" Yuan Ming slightly furrowed his brows.
"Divine Envoy Yuan saved our lives on Three Immortals Island. Senior Jin Chao also owes you a favor. It's only fitting that you should be the one to speak to him. Moreover, rest assured, Divine Envoy Yuan, that if you can persuade Senior Jin Chao, the East Sea Alliance will fully compensate for your efforts. Should you have any other requests, we can fulfill those as well," Wan Tianren rose and bowed deeply, his words earnest.
"Fine, I can try on your behalf, but I can't guarantee that I will be able to persuade Senior Jin Chao," Yuan Ming sighed and agreed to Wan Tianren's request.
Wan Tianren was overjoyed, and in front of Yuan Ming, he took out a continuously burning feather and infused it with Spiritual Power.
After a moment, the feather shot out of his hand, its flames suddenly surged, and in mid-air, it coalesced into the illusory form of Jin Chao.
"Why use the Fire Feather?" Jin Chao looked around, saw that he was in a quiet room, and Yuan Ming was also beside him, and he immediately became puzzled.
Wan Tianren quickly explained the current situation and his request.
After hearing this, a trace of impatience appeared on Jin Chao's face, but soon, his gaze suddenly fell on Yuan Ming.
"Wan Tianren, you go out first, let me talk with Yuan alone," Jin Chao ordered indifferently.
Wan Tianren nodded, but as he turned around, he discreetly sent a message to Yuan Ming.
"Divine Envoy Yuan, I entrust everything to you."
Yuan Ming nodded slightly, remaining silent, and waited for Wan Tianren to leave. Just as he was about to speak, Jin Chao interrupted him.
"I understand what Wan Tianren means. He just wants you to convince me. No need for more words; I indeed do not wish to get involved in this matter, but if Yuan is willing to agree to one condition, I might be persuaded to take action," Jin Chao said with a smile.
"Senior, please speak freely," Yuan Ming nodded.
"Before that, I have a few minor questions to ask Yuan. Have you lived more than a hundred years in your cultivation?" Jin Chao asked cheerfully.
"Not yet."
"Then, have you ever been married?" Jin Chao looked Yuan Ming up and down, his gaze revealing admiration.
"I have not," Yuan Ming shook his head, growing more puzzled.
"On the Immortal Island, you must have seen my daughter, Jin Yun, what do you think of her?" Jin Chao asked tentatively.
"Golden Cloud Fairy is upright and talented. Despite facing desperate situations, she still seeks life from death, advanced to Nascent Soul, and her spirit is truly admirable. Worthy of being the beloved daughter of Senior Jin Chao, she truly has her father's demeanor," Yuan Ming said, although bewildered, it didn't hinder him from flattering Jin Chao.
Jin Chao was very pleased upon hearing this, and his gaze shifted to an empty space on the left, as if glancing at someone.
"My daughter indeed has talent, but she is not as naturally gifted as you, Yuan. I can't protect her forever. For her future cultivation, she needs someone by her side to guide and support her, and to pursue the path of cultivation together. This would put me at ease. What do you think, Yuan?" Jin Chao returned his gaze and asked with a smile.Kееp us gоing by rеаding оn МV_LЕМ_РYR.
"What does Senior Jin Chao mean by this?" Yuan Ming was stunned.
Though it might have been his imagination, the moment he spoke, he seemed to hear two soft snorts, one hidden in front of him within the Fire Feather, and the other hidden within the Divine Cauldron inside him.
"What I mean is, would you be willing to form a Daoist companionship with my daughter, supporting each other and being companions for life?" Jin Chao got straight to the point.
Yuan Ming's eyes widened, hardly believing his ears, but then, he was suddenly alarmed, remembering something, and hurriedly shook his head.
"Thank you for your kind offer, Senior Jin Chao, but I... already have someone in my heart," Yuan Ming said earnestly.
Upon hearing this, Jin Chao's previously cheerful expression suddenly darkened, and just as he was about to say something, he instead turned his head slightly to the side.
"If that's the case, let it be. I'll make another request. Hand over the Nine Palaces Cold Moon Ring that you possess to me, and I will lend you a hand once. If you still aren't willing, we shall drop the matter," Jin Chao said with a cold tone after a moment, shaking his head.
"That would be fine; I agree to your request, Senior. May I ask how I should transfer the ring to you?" Yuan Ming sighed with relief.
Although he was somewhat reluctant to part with the Cold Moon Ring, the ring was after all just a replica of a spiritual treasure. Since Wan Tianren had promised compensation, with his own strength, Tianren would dare not renege later. Moreover, vanquishing the East Sea Witch Moon Sect was his top priority due to a great enmity with the White Bone Venerable. Even without compensation, he might still have agreed to Jin Chao's request.
Of course, the request to form a Daoist companionship with Golden Cloud Fairy was still out of the question for him.
"Ten days from now, Jin Yun and I will come to your location. You can then hand the ring directly to me." After saying this, Jin Chao's figure immediately disappeared, the Fire Feather floating in mid-air also completely extinguished and weakly drifted down.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming let out another sigh of relief, picked up the Fire Feather, and walked out of the quiet room.
Outside, Wan Tianren had been waiting for a long time. Seeing Yuan Ming emerge, he immediately cast an inquiring look at him.
"Mission accomplished," Yuan Ming nodded at him.
Wan Tianren, overjoyed, inquired about the price Yuan Ming had paid and immediately declared he would do his best to find a replica spiritual treasure of equivalent value to compensate him. He then proceeded to contact the Nascent Souls of the East Sea Alliance to organize a strategy meeting, with Yuan Ming himself presenting the plan.

chapters.title: Chapter 650 - 622: Dispute
chapters.content:
Meanwhile, in a secret realm beneath the sea.
Senior Jin Chao raised one hand, collecting the spell before looking toward Golden Cloud Fairy, who was sitting cross-legged in the center of the Formation.
By now, she was enveloped in gold and white flames while water-attributed Spiritual Energy continuously surged into the flames from around the Formation, suppressing the Fire Poison in her body.
"Wait a few more days, and the Fire Poison in your body will be temporarily suppressed. Once we get the Nine Palaces Cold Moon Ring, I shall hasten to refine it. We should be able to keep your Fire Poison at bay before its next outbreak," Senior Jin Chao said, looking at his daughter with pity.
Golden Cloud Fairy nodded, though her brows were tangled with an indescribable emotion.
"Alas, since you have feelings for Yuan Ming, why did you advise me against it just now? He is only committed, not yet married. To give up so easily, do you really wish it?" Senior Jin Chao sighed.
"Father, you misunderstand. I just feel... coercing him like this, even if successful, wouldn't make me happy. Besides, we've only met a few times, and if not for your fame, he probably wouldn't even remember my name," Golden Cloud Fairy shook her head, her expression forlorn.
Senior Jin Chao looked at his fiercely independent daughter and sighed once again.
Initially, she did not want to always be sheltered under Jin Chao's wings, so she went to Fusang Island. Starting as an ordinary disciple, she became Alliance Leader Wan's Direct Disciple through her own capabilities before revealing her identity as Jin Chao's daughter to him.
But at the stage of the Nascent Soul, such things were no longer a secret. In their eyes, as long as Golden Cloud Fairy did not reach the Returning Void, she would be overshadowed by Jin Chao's brilliance.
"Father, you are right, I will not give up. One day, I will become the sole Sun in everyone's eyes, not just in his. I will show them that I am not just anyone's daughter; I am myself, someone they must acknowledge and even look up to! Then, I will ask Yuan Ming face to face whether I, alone, without East Sea or Jin Chao's glory, am worth his attention and if he will regret saying 'no' today," Golden Cloud Fairy's eyes filled with determination.
Hearing this, Senior Jin Chao was touched, feeling deeply moved in his heart.
His daughter had truly grown up.
...
The next day, all Nascent Soul cultivators stationed across the East Sea Alliance were secretly recalled to Purple Nan Island to participate in a critical strategy meeting.
When the Nascent Souls arrived in the great hall, they saw Alliance Leader Wan and Yuan Ming already seated at the head. Unlike Yuan Ming's calm demeanor, Alliance Leader Wan's face was brimming with a smile that he hadn't shown since the battles that had left him severely injured.
The gathered Nascent Souls became curious, wondering what news could have made him so joyful, while Hou Chou, amidst the crowd, glanced at Yuan Ming with a premonition of unease in his heart.
"My fellows, please take your seats quickly, as I have an announcement to make," Alliance Leader Wan scanned the room, urging them.
Yuan Ming was also scrutinizing the Nascent Souls who entered the great hall, noticing that there were many more Nascent Soul cultivators present this time than before.
Before the meeting, Alliance Leader Wan had given him a detailed list of East Sea Alliance Nascent Soul cultivators. Now, observing these individuals, he could match them with the names on the list.
Most of these Nascent Souls originated from the First-level Islands, with only three having the same background as Loose Cultivator Yuan Ming, who were also at the Early Stage of Nascent Soul.
Among the rest, those from Water Ape Island were in the majority, including Clan Leader Hou Chou, two additional Early Stage Nascent Souls, and the former Grand Marshal Hou Shang, who had not yet acquired a physical body.
Subsequently, Nascent Soul cultivators from Fusang, Jin Ao, Kongling, and Di Hua Islands, not counting Alliance Leader Wan and Gu Xuanyang, totaled eight, with only two at the Mid-Stage Nascent Soul.
Finally, the Merfolk Nascent Souls included Queen Ming Kong, who also only had her Nascent Soul remaining, and another Early Stage Nascent Soul cultivator named Luo Duo. Currently representing Queen Ming Kong, he was responsible for the interests of the Merfolk within the East Sea Alliance. At this moment, he caught Yuan Ming's eye and nodded amiably; he likely knew of Yuan Ming's true capability and identity as the Nether Moon God Envoy from Queen Ming Kong.
Inclusive of these nineteen Nascent Souls, the three individuals on Yuzhu Island, along with the yet-to-arrive Golden Transformation Master, this constituted the visible supreme combat power of the current East Sea Alliance.
This number significantly outstripped the Wu Yue Sect's army, but the actual combat strength was evenly matched, with the Wu Yue Sect possibly having a slight advantage.
Soon, everyone was seated. Without waiting for Alliance Leader Wan to speak, Hou Chou took the lead and asked,
"Alliance Leader Wan, you called for this urgent strategy meeting, so you must have devised a brilliant strategy to defeat our enemy, right?" He addressed Alliance Leader Wan, but his gaze remained fixed on Yuan Ming.
Compared to yesterday, his attitude towards Yuan Ming seemed much more cautious, perhaps understanding Yuan Ming's real strength similarly to how he heard it from Hou Shang.
"Indeed, after Divine Envoy Yuan's field observation yesterday, he indeed found a method to break the Red Blood Sand Formation. Now, let him explain it to everyone." Wan Tianren was not annoyed and nodded towards Yuan Ming.
"Divine Envoy Yuan?" In the great hall, Loose Cultivator Nascent Soul Cultivator Fang Gu voiced his confusion.
"Indeed, as everyone might already know, Fellow Daoist Gu and others were saved by the Nether Moon God on Three Immortals Island, and since then, we have placed our faith under the banner of the Nether Moon God. This Fellow Daoist Yuan Ming is a Divine Envoy personally appointed by the Nether Moon God. In terms of identity and status, he is second to none, not even inferior to the White Bone Venerable of the Wu Yue Sect." Wan Tianren continued, satisfying the curiosity about Yuan Ming's identity.
As soon as these words were spoken, they immediately sparked discussions among the other Nascent Souls; however, the Nascent Souls from the Water Ape Clan and the Merfolk seemed to already know of Yuan Ming's identity, it appeared they indeed inquired about it from Hou Shang and Queen Ming Kong.
The discussions soon subsided. After all, the upper echelons of the East Sea Alliance had recognized Yuan Ming's identity, and though other Nascent Souls had their doubts, it was not appropriate to show them in such a setting.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming stood up, without any small talk, he detailed the method to break the Formation and also distributed the Array Eye maps, which Wan Tianren had prepared in advance, among the crowd.
"The method is good; Divine Envoy Yuan indeed has some skills, but how can Alliance Leader Wan guarantee that the method provided by Divine Envoy Yuan is not a scheme by the Wu Yue Sect to annihilate us all?" Hou Chou glanced over the map a few times and slapped a Jade Scroll onto the table with a "snap."
His words immediately made several other Nascent Soul cultivators alert.

"This Divine Envoy Yuan just arrived yesterday and already found a fault in the Wu Yue Sect's great Formation. I really don't believe this," Hou Chou's trusted subordinate Hou Mo shook his head.
"Given the unfavorable situation in the battle, we must be even more cautious and not put the entire East Sea Alliance at risk based on one person's word," the surviving Nascent Soul cultivator from Kongling Island, Chen Yunqian, coughed twice as he spoke.
Wan Tianren quietly listened to their debating until the voices gradually subsided, then he spoke.
"Senior Jin Chao will also be participating in this campaign," he said indifferently.
Instantly, that announcement astounded the group like a stone creating ripples in water.
"Senior Jin Chao, he also approved this plan? Then I think this matter indeed has great potential," Fang Gu altered his previous worried tone and immediately nodded in agreement.
"Indeed, with Senior Jin Chao assisting us, the Wu Yue Sect is no more than chickens and dogs, really not worth mentioning," Luo Duo echoed.
Hou Chou's expression darkened momentarily, but when he raised his head again, his expression had returned to calm.
"Since Senior Jin Chao has agreed to the plan, we have nothing else to say. Let's just carry it out, but there are four Array Eyes that need to be sabotaged, and how exactly we shall divide this task still needs to be discussed," he spoke slowly.
"That point has already been arranged by me, Hou Clan Chief need not worry. The task of sabotaging three Array Eyes will be taken up by me, Senior Jin Chao, and another Returning Void senior. The rest will be left to you all to disrupt together," Yuan Ming looked around at the crowd.
"Another Returning Void senior? I wonder who he is…" Hou Chou was taken aback and posed the question on the minds of most Nascent Souls present.
"This senior doesn't care about fame or revealing his identity. It's better if the Hou Clan Chief does not inquire too much," Yuan Ming gave Hou Chou a meaningful look.
Hou Chou frowned, displeased, suspecting that Yuan Ming was using the name of a Returning Void senior to intimidate him. Yet, he dared not truly challenge him, hesitated for a moment, then found another excuse to challenge.
"Since two Returning Void seniors are taking action, I am reassured about the two Array Eyes, but Divine Envoy Yuan is merely at the Early Stage of Nascent Soul, and he is also solely responsible for one Array Eye. Isn't that overconfidence? I'm not questioning your strength, but this matter decides the fate of our East Sea Alliance, and we cannot afford any mistakes," Hou Chou began, claiming the moral high ground.
"If Hou Clan Chief speaks in such a manner, perhaps we should step outside and have a duel now to settle your restless heart," Yuan Ming sneered.
"Everyone sees that I'm entirely considering the East Sea Alliance's interest, yet Divine Envoy Yuan here is being passive-aggressive, disregarding the interests of the East Sea Alliance. Since it has come to this and Divine Envoy Yuan insists on testing my abilities, let us take this to the sea for a battle, and I, Hou Chou, will keep up to the end!" Hou Chou, furious, slammed his hand on the table and stood up.
"Masking personal motives as public interests, Hou Clan Chief has cultivated quite a face. If I accidentally injure you later, don't blame me for not holding back," Yuan Ming stood up and turned to walk out of the hall.
But just then, Hou Mo stood up and grabbed Hou Chou, speaking:
"Clan Chief, quench your anger, Divine Envoy Yuan, also cool your fire. With a great battle imminent, injuries to either of you aren't favorable for our East Sea Alliance. I think it's better like this, with Alliance Leader Wan and Fellow Daoist Gu overseeing, we Nascent Souls together are more than enough to break one Array Eye. Clan Chief can accompany our Ancestor Ape alongside Divine Envoy Yuan and compete in terms of killing Wu Yue Sect followers—this won't harm our relations, yet it discerns the stronger party and provides mutual support. What do you think, Divine Envoy Yuan?"

chapters.title: Chapter 651 - 623: The Tail of a Rat
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming chuckled softly, by now fully aware they were merely putting on an act with Hou Chou; they probably never had the courage to truly strike out against him in the first place. What was just said allowed for facesaving and substance, if they failed to break the array, the fault would lie on his own planning, but if they succeeded, then Hou Chou would share in the credit—a rather clever calculation indeed.
Indifferent to exposing Hou Chou's ulterior motives publicly, he turned his head and glanced at Wan Tianren, signaling him to make the decision.
"That is well, the Wu Yue Sect certainly has heavy guards at the Array Eye. Divine Envoy Yuan going alone would still entail some risks," Wan Tianren hesitated for a moment then nodded at Yuan Ming.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming knew Wan Tianren also had his suspicions and was being cautious, so he didn't say more and accepted Hou Mo's suggestion.
Then, they discussed the finer details that could arise in the upcoming battle and set the date for action ten days later before dispersing.
However, when Wan Tianren also wanted to leave, Yuan Ming stopped him.
"Does Alliance Leader Wan have any Recording Artifacts on hand?" he asked.
"I do, but why do you ask, Fellow Daoist Yuan?" Wan Tianren wondered.
"Naturally, I've noticed some rats moving about within the alliance and wanted to see if I could catch their tails," Yuan Ming narrowed his eyes, a hint of sharp light flickering within.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan has discovered a spy from the Wu Yue Sect?" Wan Tianren was startled.
"Correct, but there's no evidence yet; Alliance Leader Wan, please do this..."
...
An hour later.
Chen Yunqian found an excuse to return to his temporary Cave Mansion on Purple Nan Island.
He carefully activated all the formations of the Cave Mansion to ensure no one could peer inside from outside before finally taking out a seemingly unremarkable nanmu box.
Inside the box was a palm-sized black Token, with no patterns or markings, and not a trace of Spiritual Energy, looking just like a wooden toy carved on a whim.
But Chen Yunqian handled the Token with extreme caution, not daring to relax even slightly.
He knew that by opening this wooden box, his life as an undercover agent was finally coming to an end.
As one of the many dark agents from the Wu Yue Sect, he infiltrated Kongling Island during the Qi Refinement Realm and then devoted himself to cultivation. As he made achievements, he ran side to side for the interests of Kongling Island, more than once facing life or death crises. Fortunately, his luck was good and he encountered some opportunities. Ultimately, he became one of the Nascent Soul Ancestors of Kongling Island, but he never once forgot his mission—to contribute towards the Wu Yue Sect's conquest of the East Sea.
He had played no small part in the fall of Kongling Island, and afterwards, he disguised himself as a leader of the survivors to gather followers, preparing to undermine the situation further when the opportunity arose. However, before he could make a move, he ran into Wan Tianren and others who had returned to the East Sea.
Thus, he turned the situation in his favor, joining the East Sea Alliance. To avoid suspicion, he had not contacted the Wu Yue Sect since then, just waiting for a day when he could provide critical information.
Now, that opportunity had finally arrived.
"Venerable, the dark agent Chen Yunqian reports that the East Sea Alliance has found the location of the Array Eye of the Red Blood Sand Formation and will launch an attack on Red Mountain, Fan Yun, Cui Lin, and Hongguang four islands in ten days. A mysterious Returning Void will join with Senior Jin Chao for the offensive. Please be extremely cautious," Chen Yunqian took a deep breath and, while pouring Mana into the Token, spoke swiftly.
Because the scope of the Red Blood Sand Formation was so vast and its power astonishing, it couldn't be run at full power all the time due to the high consumption. With advance preparation, they could catch the attackers unaware. At that time, the East Sea Alliance might weaken considerably.
The Token flickered with spirit light twice, with no response. Chen Yunqian felt puzzled, considering the White Bone Venerable was likely tied up with countless matters and might just be preoccupied.
But given the significance of this intelligence, Chen Yunqian couldn't be careless. As he was about to activate the Token again, he suddenly heard a cold voice from behind.
"Fellow Daoist Chen, there's no need to try anymore; the White Bone Venerable won't hear your report," the voice said.
Chen Yunqian shuddered, whirled around, and saw Yuan Ming standing behind him, holding a bronze mirror, watching him expressionlessly.
The mirror was playing back the scene of him just reporting to the White Bone Venerable, the sound clear and unmistakable.
"How, how did you get in!" Chen Yunqian stepped back in shock, pointing at Yuan Ming as he shouted.
"Instead of worrying about how I got in, Fellow Daoist Chen might want to think about how you're going to explain your recent actions to Alliance Leader Wan," Yuan Ming said with a sneer.
As soon as he finished speaking, Chen Yunqian's eyes flashed with murderous intent and he suddenly stomped forward, his right foot unleashing a swarm of White Frost, freezing Yuan Ming's ankles into ice pillars in an instant.
Yuan Ming, however, appeared nonchalant, his Emotion Manipulation Ability having long exposed Chen Yunqian's true emotions. Chen's astonishment was genuine, but he had harbored the intent to kill the moment he laid eyes on Yuan Ming.
At this moment, seeing Yuan Ming make no attempt to resist being frozen by Chen Yunqian, a trace of doubt flickered in Chen's mind, yet it did not hinder him from swiftly forming hand seals, activating the Forbidden Array within the cave mansion.
With the next instant, the floor of the cave mansion cracked open, and over a dozen Spiritual Power iron chains burst forth, but instead of lunging at Yuan Ming, they swirled through the air and locked Chen Yunqian's limbs in place.
"How is this possible!" Chen Yunqian cried out in shock.
"Heh, the array and restrictions you set up in the room were not meticulous enough; there were too many loopholes. I got bored waiting for you, so I took the liberty of patching them up for you. No need to thank me." Yuan Ming smiled faintly, and with a shake of his legs, he shattered all the ice on his ankles.
Chen Yunqian was both shocked and furious. He immediately spat out a Cold Frost Jade Ruler from his mouth, which drew through the air, scattering countless pale frost mists to envelop both Yuan Ming and himself.
However, Yuan Ming casually waved his hand, and with a flash of spirit light on the Cold Moon Ring at his fingertip, all the surrounding frost mist was absorbed into it.
As the frost mist dissipated, Chen Yunqian was once again exposed to Yuan Ming's view. He had been using the cover to attack the Spiritual Power chains with a magical treasure, and when the frost mist vanished in an instant, he was first taken aback, then quickly began reciting a spell, guiding the Jade Ruler to strike at Yuan Ming.
But at that moment, a Blood Shadow suddenly emerged from behind Yuan Ming and caught the Jade Ruler Magical Treasure squarely, with filthy blood qi immediately crawling up the Jade Ruler.
Chen Yunqian was terrified, trying to recall the Jade Ruler, but his limbs were again firmly locked by the Spiritual Power iron chains, preventing him from forming any hand seals. He could only invoke the magical treasure with a mnemonic, but it was utterly inadequate to unleash the full power of the magical treasure.
