Yuan Ming did not plan to continue fighting him, and after commanding the Blood Shadow to take the magical treasure away, he raised his hand slightly, and the door of the cave mansion thundered open automatically. Wan Tianren and other Nascent Souls from the East Sea Alliance, who had been waiting outside, walked in one after another.
In their hands, they too held a bronze mirror, which appeared to be identical to the one Yuan Ming was holding; and at that moment, it was displaying the scene of Chen Yunqian passing on intelligence.
"Fellow Daoist Chen, I need an explanation." Wan Tianren looked at Chen Yunqian, his expression grim.
Chen Yunqian was stunned. Gaping at the Nascent Souls before him, his lips moved as if wanting to defend himself, but he understood that anything he said now would be too late.
"...How was I exposed?" he asked with a bitter laugh.
At these words, Wan Tianren glanced at Yuan Ming, and the other Nascent Soul cultivators he had summoned also cast curious looks his way.
"The Lord Nether Moon God once bestowed upon me a Divine Skill that allows me to know what a person holds dear or dislikes. Earlier, during the meeting, when Alliance Leader Wan mentioned that Senior Jin Chao would also come to our aid, everyone else was pleased, but you, you alone, felt disgust towards this matter. It aroused my suspicion, so I came to your cave mansion in advance and made some preparations." Yuan Ming explained.
The facts were largely as he described, although he deliberately kept the description of the Emotion Manipulation Ability vague by using terms such as likes and dislikes. After all, most people do not wish to have their inner thoughts seen through by others. Downplaying the ability's strength would not only make the Nascent Souls from the East Sea Alliance less resistant to him but would also confuse any potential adversaries.This chapter was uploaded by the team at *.
"So that's how it is. I cannot believe that after all this time I've been undercover, I was undone by just that. The False God does possess some tricks after all. It's a pity, though—no matter how much you resist, you are no match for the divine authority of the Wu Yue God! It is only the Wu Yue God who is the True God! You should all surrender sooner rather than later—that's the righteous path!" Chen Yunqian suddenly let out a laugh, and his presence surged dramatically.
"Not good, he's going to detonate his Nascent Soul!" Wan Tianren realized with a start.
But just then, Yuan Ming stepped forward, and the soul splitting from within the Stealing Heaven Tripod took action, pulling Chen Yunqian into a Nightmare in an instant.
Chen Yunqian's previously building momentum plummeted, and his body completely relaxed as if he had been strangled to death mid-air by the Spiritual Power chains.
The members of the East Sea Alliance were startled, and then they saw Yuan Ming lay a hand on Chen Yunqian's face. After pondering for a moment, he sadly shook his head.
"No good, someone has placed a Forbidden spell on his Nascent Soul, preventing a Soul Search." Yuan Ming let go with a hint of regret and turned to speak.
"Then..." Wan Tianren looked at Yuan Ming, seeking his advice.
"Let's lock him up for now, to prevent the Wu Yue Sect from knowing his status through any means they might have." Yuan Ming suggested.
"We'll do as Divine Envoy Yuan says." Wan Tianren nodded.
Seeing his response, the expressions of the Nascent Soul cultivators from the East Sea Alliance varied.
It was common knowledge that Wan Tianren had put Yuan Ming forward to contend against Hou Chou. But looking at the current situation, whether Wan Tianren was really the leader of the East Sea Alliance started to seem uncertain.
However, the thought of Chen Yunqian's fate made them shiver inwardly. Aside from considering Yuan Ming's real strength, just the Mind Reading Divine Power and such calculating methods alone were enough to put them on alert—they did not want to be caught out, fearing they might share a fate like Chen Yunqian's. To die in humiliation, unable to showcase one's abilities or even self-detonate, was too great a loss of face for a Nascent Soul cultivator.
After all, this was Wan Tianren's worry. The various Nascent Souls exchanged glances and then dispersed to make their preparations for the forthcoming battle.

chapters.title: Chapter 652 - 624 Continue to Surge
chapters.content:
Several days later, Fan Yun Island.
Outside the island, in the sky, Yuan Ming and Hou Chou were using the clouds for concealment, stealthily sizing up the situation on the island.
According to intelligence collected by the East Sea Alliance, Fan Yun Island was originally just a third-level small island within the Red Leaf Sea Domain, not very large in area, but the Wu Yue Sect had deployed a considerable military force there and constantly had two Nascent Soul cultivators stationed for defense.
Moreover, numerous formations and prohibitions were deployed inside and outside the island, along with the envelopment of the Red Blood Sand Formation, making it easy to defend and hard to attack.
At this moment, the Wu Yue Sect disciples on the island had not noticed the approach of Yuan Ming and his companion, always keeping the island's Protective Array active without daring the slightest negligence.
"Shall Divine Envoy Yuan take the lead?" Hou Chou suddenly turned his head and asked.
Through Emotion Manipulation, Yuan Ming felt the surging War Intent in Hou Chou's heart and gave him a somewhat surprised look.
He hadn't expected this Hou Clan Chief, who was obsessed with power, to also have such a belligerent side; he wondered if it was a natural trait of the Water Ape Clan.
"If Clan Leader Hou is willing, feel free to make your move, I will support you from the sidelines," Yuan Ming considered and was happy to conserve his strength.
"Haha, then Divine Envoy Yuan, be careful. If I steal all the limelight, it won't look good for you when we return," Hou Chou laughed loudly, his hands forming a spell, and in a flash, a streak of light flew out from his body, which was the Tiger Talisman that Hou Shang had once asked Yuan Ming to pass on.
However, the Tiger Talisman was now complete on both sides, emitting bursts of fierce aura that made even Yuan Ming take notice.
As soon as the Tiger Talisman appeared, the great sea beneath their feet trembled, the surging waves paused abruptly, and then, as if under command, they furiously clustered under Hou Chou's feet, forcibly raising a hundred zhang high water column reaching up to the sky.
Immediately after, a streak of cyan spirit light shot out from the Tiger Talisman and entered into the water column, followed by a "boom", the water column slowly parted to both sides, forming a great water gate reaching up to the heavens.
The next instant, ten stone pillar-like fingers probed out from the water gate, each one nearly ten zhang thick, and forcefully grasped the two sides of the water gate, with the owner of the fingers following with a thrust forward, and a face that resembled the Thunder God's monkey visage emerged from the gate.
After the monkey head protruded through the water gate, its nostrils flared slightly. Without needing Hou Chou's command, its pair of blood-red eyes fell upon the nearby Fan Yun Island.
"Roar!"
The next moment, a heaven-shaking roar echoed through the skies, with invisible Sound Waves howling forth, causing tremendous waves to rise and the sea and sky to seem to turn upside down.
The Wu Yue Sect disciples on Fan Yun Island had already been startled by the strange phenomenon of the waves forming pillars, and now, seeing a fierce Exotic Beast push its head through the water gate with a roar that shook the heavens and earth, they were scared out of their wits.
"Enemies attacking!"
In the midst of rallying cries, two streaks of light flew out from the center of the island, stopping mid-air.
They were the Nascent Soul cultivators arranged by the Wu Yue Sect to watch over this place, one dressed in a red fire robe, named Jiang Lu, from Karma Fire Island, and the other with heterochromatic snake pupils, called Qing Xu, from Thousand Snake Island.
Logically, such a core location should not be entrusted to these surrendering East Sea cultivators, but unfortunately, the Nascent Souls that Wu Yue Sect had dispatched to the East Sea were few and all were important forces under White Bone Venerable. With Array Eyes scattered across eight locations, it was not realistic for each to have their own personnel in place.
Besides, this location was close to the front line—there was no reason to make their own people take the brunt in a battle. Plus, with the support of the Red Blood Sand Formation, the East Sea Alliance couldn't breach it anyway, and having them stationed here was just a precaution; there were no expectations for them to fight to the death with the East Sea Alliance.
Therefore, when these two saw an Exotic Beast attacking, they were also bewildered.
"Is that the Ancestor Ape from Water Ape Island? Has the East Sea Alliance come to attack? What are those islands on the front line doing, not even sending back a message?" Jiang Lu muttered, confused.
Qing Xu, who possessed Pupil Technique, scanned around and soon discovered Yuan Ming and his companion floating in the sky outside the island.
"No, there are only two Nascent Souls; they must have bypassed the defense line and snuck in without bringing others!" Qing Xu exclaimed in surprise.
"Ah? Has Hou Chou gone mad? Does he really think that just by having the Ancestor Ape, he is invincible?" Jiang Lu was even more puzzled.
"Who cares? If he wants to court death, let him be. That Ancestor Ape has the strength of a late-stage Nascent Soul; you and I are no match for it. We should just activate the Great Array," Qing Xu promptly suggested.
Jiang Lu naturally had no objection, and the two of them soon flew back to the island. At the same time, the Ancestor Ape summoned by Hou Chou fully appeared above the sea surface.
Its body, visible above the water, was a hundred zhang tall, its limbs as thick as mountains, covered with a layer of steel needle-like black hair. Towering over, even Fan Yun Island seemed somewhat insignificant.
Upon its appearance, it didn't need Hou Chou to control it. Its red eyes fixed dead on the Wu Yue Sect cultivators scurrying about on Fan Yun Island like ants. Its right arm violently reached into the sea and forcibly condensed the raging waters into a long spear. With a raise of its hand, it hurled the spear towards Fan Yun Island.
This throw, casual as a breeze, but understand, the water spear alone was half the length of the Ancestor Ape's body. With the fierce beast's incredible strength, the moment it was released, Qi Force filled the air, and the winds howled shockingly. When it struck Fan Yun Island's Great Array, it was like a tsunami striking, shaking the Array's Spiritual Light chaotically, as if it was about to shatter in the next moment.
The Wu Yue Sect cultivators on the island were scared out of their wits. They were known as Wu Yue Sect cultivators, but in reality, they were just surrendered cultivators from the East Sea Islands. They had long heard legends about the Ancestor Ape of Water Ape Island, thinking the Water Ape Clan exaggerated. Now facing it directly, they realized the legends had not even depicted the Ancestor Ape's true combat power. Those water monkeys had actually been modest!
For the Ancestor Ape, that water spear was just the beginning. After throwing it, it didn't stop at all, charging directly towards Fan Yun Island. The resistance of the sea seemed nonexistent, its speed not reduced in the slightest; if anything, the waves even pushed it forward.
As it charged, the Ancestor Ape kept hurling water spears. The terrifying long spears rained down on the protective shield like raindrops, frightening the group of cultivators on the island who desperately powered the Array, fearing the slightest flaw would let the Ancestor Ape break through.
However, under the bombardment of water spears, the island's Array was already on the brink of collapse. When the Ancestor Ape reached the shore, the Spiritual Power protective shield enveloping the island was already in shambles. The Ancestor Ape didn't use any technique, just a simple punch but with a momentum like a mountainous wave, striking the light shield and shattering it in an instant.
"Haha, the Array is broken. Divine Envoy Yuan, join me in the attack!" said Hou Chou, as a pair of double halberds suddenly appeared in his hands. He didn't wait for Yuan Ming's response and flew towards the island.
Yuan Ming, however, slightly frowned. The defense at the location of the Array Eye was extremely weak; not to mention how easily the defensive Array shattered, there were far too few cultivators stationed on the island. There were hardly any at the Core Formation stage; it wasn't just him—Hou Chou alone could probably break through with ease.
And as he was thinking this, the sky suddenly changed.
It began with a howling gale from nowhere, sweeping over the sea and the coast, grinding the corpses into fine Red Sand, scattering in the wind, barely noticeable and adding only a slight haziness.
But what followed was that the fine Red Sand, as if absorbing the strength of the wind, grew rapidly at an alarming rate. In just the blink of an eye, a breath, or perhaps even less time, the sky filled with Red Sand blocked all visibility, rendering everything in front indiscernible.
Hou Chou, who had not yet reached the island, instantly became alert, swiftly channeling Spiritual Power to form a Protective Spiritual Light. The Ancestor Ape, lacking much reason, had no protection on its colossal form. Countless sands turned into blood and surged into its body, intensifying the Blood Light in its eyes and its ferocity. Yet at the same time, it caused the blood vessels inside it to swell and burst, quickly turning it into a Blood Ape.
"Something's wrong. Divine Envoy Yuan, the power of the Array here has more than doubled than before!" shouted Hou Chou, turning his head.
Yuan Ming was also fully exerting his protective light shield to withstand the erosion of the red sand. Hearing Hou Chou's words, his expression slightly tightened, and his mood became somewhat heavy.
The Red Blood Sand Formation covered ten thousand li of the sea domain. No matter how they infiltrated and launched a surprise attack, as soon as something was amiss, the cultivator guarding the array eye would immediately activate the great array. They had anticipated this and were prepared to attack the array eye under the pressure of the formation.
However, all their plans were based on the power the Red Blood Sand Formation had shown in the past. But who could have expected that near the array eye, the power of this formation would actually increase? Even Xi Ying, who had calculated the position of the array eye, hadn't been able to predict this.
To prevent the red sand from invading their bodies, they had to maintain their protective spiritual light at all times. As the formation's power increased several-fold, their spiritual power consumption naturally increased as well, making it difficult to spare any for fighting the enemy.
And for the enemies, dealing with them was easy. They just needed to find a way to break through the protective spiritual light. They didn't even need to actually injure them—they could let the all-encompassing red sand torture them to death.
Fortunately, at this moment, the strength of the Wu Yue Sect on the island was weak. Though unaffected by the Red Blood Sand Formation and even with unobscured vision, they had no intention of moving forward to take advantage of the situation. Instead, they silently kept their distance, waiting for Yuan Ming and his group to either die in the red sand or depart of their own volition.
"We can't go on, Divine Envoy Yuan. The surprise attack has failed. We must retreat immediately. If we continue to hold on and the Wu Yue Sect at the front lines reacts and encircles us, it will be too late!" Hou Chou shouted.
Note#:* C-h%e#c$k * for any c@o*rrect&ions..
However, Yuan Ming's mind raced, and he felt there was still a chance of victory. If they gave up now, it would indeed be a waste of all their efforts. He immediately shook his head.
His divine sense surged out from the Stealing Heaven Tripod and quickly located the exact position of the array eye on the island. Braving the red sand, he flew toward the array eye.
Hou Chou's eyes widened as he glanced at the intensifying red sand around him. After hesitating for a moment, he gritted his teeth and followed Yuan Ming.
Moments later, the two of them arrived at a plaza. The red sand here was even denser than outside; Hou Chou's cultivation was such that he had to use all his mana for protection and could not spare any to control his magic treasure to fend off enemies. Yuan Ming was naturally in the same situation.
Below their feet on the plaza, visible through the red sand, a scarlet formation was rotating rapidly. Dozens of cultivators sat cross-legged within it, all chanting with closed eyes, seemingly unaffected by the red sand.
In the very center of the crowd, Jiang Lu and Qing Xu were making hand gestures, apparently overseeing the operation of the formation. Sensing Yuan Ming and his partner's arrival, they too were surprised.
"Not good, they're here for the array eye!" Jiang Lu immediately realized.

chapters.title: Chapter 653 - 625 Break Array
chapters.content:
"Hmph! What does it matter if you charge at the Array Eye? The formation is complete. We can move freely while they cannot muster their Spiritual Power to fight. Coming here is nothing more than courting death!" Qing Xu's eyes flashed with a cold light, and in an instant, his figure leaped up, transforming into a fierce giant python and directly lunging at Yuan Ming and his companion.
Jiang Lu also refused to show weakness, conjuring a Magic Treasure, and joined Qing Xu in the attack.
Hou Chou's heart shuddered. At this moment, he could ill afford to be distracted. He immediately turned to flee, his mind filled with immense regret.
He had actually believed in Yuan Ming's nonsense, thinking there was some formidable tactic at play. It turned out to be just a brainless brute. After all this time, he didn't even know the true state of the Array Eye, yet he had the audacity to claim one man was enough.
Without breaking the Red Blood Sand Formation, they would lose no matter how they fought. It would be better to seize the chance to flee while Yuan Ming was holding the front, in hopes of a slim chance of survival.
However, Yuan Ming showed no intention of running away. He observed the Cultivators on the plaza with his Divine Sense, a smile suddenly forming at the corner of his mouth.
At this moment, he also understood that the Red Blood Sand Formation was different from typical Formations. The Array Eye did not operate on Spirit Stones alone but required Cultivators to maintain it through casting spells. In other words, as long as they could slay all the Cultivators within the Array Eye, the Formation would cease to function.
In the next instant, an invisible force descended from the heavens, enveloping the entire island in its grasp.
In the blink of an eye, all Wu Yue Sect Cultivators below the Nascent Soul stage, no matter where they were on the island or what condition they were in, felt an overwhelming drowsiness overcome them, causing them to lose their strength. Their eyes closed, and they fell into a deep slumber.
Meanwhile, inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod, the first soul sitting on the White Jade Lotus Platform appeared somewhat languid. A significant portion of its Soul Power was drained in an instant. Thankfully, Desire Power soon surged from the Lotus Platform, rapidly replenishing the deficit in Soul Power.
In midair, Jiang Lu and Qing Xu also felt drowsiness surging in their hearts. However, at that moment, Yuan Ming did not specifically target them. As the two men used their Cultivation to forcefully suppress the drowsiness, preparing to continue their assault, they were stunned in the next instant.
They saw the omnipresent Red Sand that enveloped the surroundings suddenly stagnate, then dissolve rapidly like blood in the rain, disappearing into thin air. The sky regained its former appearance.
Could it be… The Array Eye was broken, and this place was no longer under the Formation's influence?
They were stupefied, their Divine Sense sweeping across the island at lightning speed, only to discover aside from a few Nascent Souls, there was not a single awake person; snores rose and fell in an absurdly comical and alarming cacophony.
In that instant, they even doubted whether they had withstood that wave of drowsiness - were they now trapped within a dream?
Hou Chou, standing behind Yuan Ming, was no better off at this point.
"Yuan, Divine Envoy Yuan, what... what move was that?" he asked, swallowing hard and speaking with difficulty.
"Fortunately, Lord Nether Moon God has favored me and bestowed another Divine Skill, which is quite powerful but also consumes a lot. I'm already at the end of my tether; I must request Clan Leader Hou's assistance," Yuan Ming casually explained.
Seeing this situation, Jiang Lu and Qing Xu exchanged a look, as if planning to take some action.
Yuan Ming thought they would seize the opportunity to strike at him, and he was ready to counter. But before they could make their move, he saw Jiang Lu and Qing Xu, one to the left and one to the right, turn around and flee.
Yuan Ming was taken aback, not expecting them to be so resolute. At that moment, Hou Chou's eyes shifted, and he suddenly shouted.
"Thinking of escaping? It won't be that easy! Divine Envoy Yuan, please rest while I capture these two and present them to Lord Nether Moon God," he called out.
No sooner had he spoken than he took out a Tiger Talisman and activated it. He then directly pursued Jiang Lu, while at the same time, the Ancestor Ape on the shore received an order and, with a blur, seemed to turn into flowing water as it chased after Qing Xu.
Yuan Ming opened his mouth, surprised that Hou Chou had become so proactive, but upon further consideration of Hou Chou's words, he understood somewhat.
This man had heard twice of Divine Skills bestowed by the Nether Moon God. He likely had his own designs, setting aside whether he truly believed; he saw an opportunity to curry favor with the Nether Moon God and perhaps be granted a few Divine Skills.
Yuan Ming chuckled to himself. Seeing that Jiang Lu and Qing Xu were soon intercepted by Hou Chou, he extinguished the thought of intervening. Instead, he took out a Jade Talisman from his chest and activated it with a spell.
"Fan Yun Island has fallen."
After that brief message, Yuan Ming's gaze drifted towards the locations of other Array Eyes.
He wondered how they were faring. Now that his own sector was vanquished, the overall Red Blood Sand Formation must have been impacted, likely easing their struggles to destroy the Array Eyes. Perhaps they would soon receive good tidings.
...
Meanwhile, on Hongguang Island.
Wildfires ravaged every inch of the land, leaving nothing but billowing smoke behind, staining the sky and the sea a dusky gray.
In the sky, Jin Chao stood with folded arms, his gaze cast down, watching the battlefield below where victory was nearly decided.
The plaza, surrounded by roaring flames, saw Jin Yun Fairy engaged in solo combat against two Wu Yue Sect Nascent Soul cultivators. Although she faced them alone, she was not at a disadvantage.
Suddenly, a Jade Talisman emerged from Jin Chao, floating into the air, broadcasting Yuan Ming's voice.
"Fan Yun Island has fallen."
The voice echoed around them, startling the two Wu Yue Sect Nascent Souls, while in Jin Yun Fairy's eyes, a flicker of an indiscernible emotion appeared.
In the next instant, she seized the Wu Yue Sect Nascent Souls' moment of shock, and two clumps of gold and white flames suddenly appeared behind their heads, effortlessly burning through their Protective Spiritual Lights and incinerating their bodies.
In the flames, two Nascent Souls clutching their Magic Treasures desperately flew out to escape; however, Jin Chao from the sky waved his hand and instantly turned them into ashes.
Seeing this, Golden Cloud Fairy ascended into the sky without hesitation and snatched the Jade Talisman.
"Hongguang Island has fallen," she said through gritted teeth as if she were competing with someone.
Jin Chao sighed at this scene, a hint of helplessness flickering in his eyes.
...
Not far off, above Cui Lin Island, Elder San Jue was holding the remains of a Nascent Soul cultivator in one hand, while taking a swig from a wine flask with the other.
A Jade Talisman flew out of his embrace, first resounding with Yuan Ming and Golden Cloud Fairy's voices.Reader support at * made this translation possible.
After a moment of contemplation, Elder San Jue slowly let go of the Nascent Soul cultivator's remains, took the Jade Talisman, and began casting.
"Cui Lin Island has fallen."
As soon as these words were spoken, he transformed into a Blood Shadow and flew towards Fan Yun Island, where Yuan Ming was located.
And beneath his feet, not a single living person remained on the entire Cui Lin Island.
...
Red Mountain Island.
In a sky filled with Red Sand, four Nascent Soul members of the East Sea Alliance, led by Wan Tianren, strained to hold on.
In front of them, a mid-stage Nascent Soul Black Robed Cultivator was manipulating spell gestures with one hand while shaking a Black Bell with the other, summoning countless ghosts and shadows to incessantly harass Wan Tianren and the others.
The Black Robed Cultivator's own strength was not remarkable, but with the aid of the Red Blood Sand Formation, he was able to fight on par with Wan Tianren's group, even gaining a slight upper hand, showing the might of the Red Blood Sand Formation.
"It's no use, Alliance Hierarch, we've underestimated the power of the Red Blood Sand Formation. If we continue fighting like this, defeat is certain, and we will all perish here!" Gu Xuanyang roared with difficulty.
Wan Tianren clenched his teeth, filled with unwillingness.
The East Sea Alliance had finally found an opportunity to counterattack and if they were to retreat now, attempting another surprise attack next time would not be so easy.
Moreover, even if they had underestimated the power of the Formation, he, Wan Tianren, was after all a Great Cultivator of the late-stage Nascent Soul. If not for being weakened in a previous battle with White Bone Venerable, how could he be obstructed by a mid-stage Nascent Soul cultivator?
Could it be, this was fate? Is the East Sea Alliance destined not to counterattack the Wu Yue Sect?
Wan Tianren sighed, about to order the retreat when suddenly, he felt the surrounding Red Sand thinning out.
Immediately after, the Jade Talisman in his bosom flew out, and as the voices of Yuan Ming, Golden Cloud Fairy, and Elder San Jue came one after the other, the Red Sand around them had thinned to a fraction of its usual density.
"Haha, wonderful, Divine Envoy Yuan and the others have indeed lived up to expectations. Fellow Daoists, the opportunity to defeat the enemy has arrived, follow me and counterattack!" Wan Tianren laughed loudly.
At the same time, the Black Robed Cultivator of the Wu Yue Sect sensed something was wrong and immediately turned to flee, but Wan Tianren and his group relentlessly pursued him. Only Gu Xuanyang flew out of the fight to break the Array Eye.
Before long, the Red Sand all around completely dissipated, and the Black Robed Cultivator fell victim to the concerted assault.
And with the fall of the fourth Array Eye, the cultivators under the Formation felt a shift within them, as if hearing a shattering sound in their ears. Even in the areas that were not breached, the red light in the sky suddenly vanished, revealing a stretch of azure.
The Red Blood Sand Formation had been completely broken!
...
On Purple Nan Island, a Nascent Soul Merfolk cultivator named Luo Duo gripped the Jade Talisman excitedly, listening to the four announcements coming from within. He immediately turned around, raising his arms high.
"My friends, by the grace of Lord Nether Moon God, the Red Blood Sand Formation has been broken by the Alliance Hierarch and Divine Envoy Yuan and the others. We have been in a stalemate with the Wu Yue Sect for a long time, but now the moment to counterattack has arrived. The liberation of East Sea is just within reach!" he proclaimed loudly, his voice carrying across the entire East Sea Alliance army.
Behind him, the already fully prepared cultivators of the East Sea Alliance lit up with fervor, shouting in unison.
Then, under his command, the grand army of the East Sea Alliance set off toward the islands occupied by the Wu Yue Sect.
The Wu Yue Sect Cultivators on those islands had no idea what had transpired; seeing a large army approaching, they frantically tried to activate the Red Blood Sand Formation, only to find the once responsive Great Array was now unresponsive.
They were already outnumbered by the East Sea Alliance, and now they were caught off-guard while the enemy was determined and led by Nascent Soul cultivators. Their defeat was almost instantaneous.
In just a few hours, the East Sea Alliance had completely breached the Wu Yue Sect's defenses, advancing into their territory. And within several days, they managed to completely clear the sea route between Purple Nan Island and Red Leaf Island, breaking the Wu Yue Sect's encirclement.
During this process, through covert and overt propaganda by Wan Tianren, Yan Siyun, and others, more and more people learned of Yuan Ming's pivotal role in reversing the situation in this battle, and how he received the favor of the Nether Moon God, gaining extraordinary Divine Skills. From a Core Formation no-name, he grew into the heroic figure who saved the East Sea Alliance.
As the story spread, more and more cultivators became interested in Yuan Ming, as well as the Nether Moon God mentioned in the tales.

chapters.title: Chapter 654 - 626: Eve of the Storm
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming, after breaching Fan Yun Island, did not continue to partake in the subsequent battles of the East Sea Alliance. Instead, he returned to Purple Nan Island and sought out a cave mansion to enter seclusion.
His intervention, though it carried some risk, however, had yielded considerable rewards.
After this battle, within the East Sea Alliance, the name of the Nether Moon God and his Nether Moon God Envoy was known to all.
The cultivators were not only grateful to Yuan Ming for his contributions to the salvation of the East Sea but were also curious about the existence of the Nether Moon God, and even more eager for the rumored blessings of the Nether Moon God.
Amid these intertwining thoughts and emotions, the Desire Power Yuan Ming harvested far exceeded that of his past, making him eager to go into seclusion to absorb it.
With the aid of these Desire Powers, Yuan Ming's Soul Cultivation soared, progressing to the mid-stage of the Sleep Witch before he finally managed to digest the surge brought by this tide of power.
In this period, thanks to the East Sea Alliance's successful surprise attack that broke the Red Blood Sand Formation blockading the Yuzhu Three Islands, the plan by the White Bone Venerable to sever the Alliance's supply lines and enrich his own had failed, catching the Wu Yue Sect off guard.
The East Sea Alliance had re-established connection with the Yuzhu Three Islands and was now fully engaging in transferring supplies, with most of their manpower being redirected near Red Leaf Island. There were hardly any people left on Purple Nan Island, and nobody realized that in just a few days, Yuan Ming's strength had significantly increased compared to before.
However, with the East Sea conflict still unsettled, Yuan Ming did not stay in seclusion for long. After slightly solidifying his Divine Soul Cultivation, he broke out from his seclusion, preparing to head to Red Leaf Island, but upon encountering the barrier outside his cave mansion, he discovered a communication signal from Jin Chao.
Yuan Ming was somewhat puzzled by this, but without dwelling on it, he quickly located Jin Chao and Fairy Jin Yun, who had been waiting for him for quite a while on Purple Nan Island.
"Senior Jin Chao, what urgent matter brings you to seek out this junior so eagerly?" Yuan Ming asked respectfully with a cupped fist gesture.
Earlier on, before the operation to Break Array began, Yuan Ming had handed over the Cold Moon Ring to Jin Chao, and now seeing Jin Chao coming to him again, he couldn't help but let his thoughts wander, wondering what it could be for.
"It's nothing serious, just that Jin Yun and I are leaving and wanted to notify you. If you had come out of seclusion any later, we might not have waited," Jin Chao said calmly.
"Senior is leaving?" Yuan Ming was stunned.
"Why, didn't I tell you earlier? I'm not interested in the matters of the East Sea conflict. Now that the agreement with you is complete, what's surprising about me leaving?" Jin Chao said indifferently.
"But Senior, Fusang Island is still in the hands of the Wu Yue Sect, and they control the Fusang Divine Tree on the island. Don't you wish to reclaim it?" asked Yuan Ming.* (*)
"I have more important matters to attend to. The Fusang Divine Tree can stay with the Wu Yue Sect for now. However, if you and the East Sea Alliance can reclaim it, that would indeed be a good thing, and I will owe you a favor," Jin Chao said, lacking enthusiasm.
Yuan Ming grew more puzzled, unsure what could be so important that it made Jin Chao temporarily disregard his own domain.
Seeing that Jin Chao had no intention of explaining, Yuan Ming did not ask further and simply made a cupped fist gesture,
"In that case, this junior won't keep you any longer. I wish Senior a smooth journey with the task ahead."
Jin Chao nodded and gave Yuan Ming a complex look.
Out of politeness, Yuan Ming did not employ his Emotion Manipulation Ability at this moment, thus remained ignorant of the implied meaning behind Jin Chao's gazes.
As Jin Chao rose to his feet, Fairy Jin Yun, who had been standing quietly by his side, suddenly approached Yuan Ming.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, I seem to have never properly introduced myself to you," her voice carried an unusual emotion.
Yet Yuan Ming, at this moment, failed to detect these subtleties. As soon as he saw Jin Yun, he was reminded of Jin Chao's earlier suggestion, not finding any issue with it himself but not wishing to cause any misunderstandings.
"Fairy Jin Yun is too kind; we cultivators need not be bogged down by elaborate formalities. Your name has long been known to me, and we have met several times in the secret realm. I must say, Fairy, your valiant stance then truly left a deep impression on me," Yuan Ming said with a genial smile.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, there is no need for such courtesies. Our understanding of each other was ultimately insufficient, but I do hope that there will be another opportunity to stand side by side with you in the future and to form a heartfelt exchange," Fairy Jin Yun said, smiling gently as if the warm sunrise brought brilliance to the entire room.
Yuan Ming was momentarily taken aback, not understanding the meaning behind her words. It seemed that Jin Yun, too, had no intention of elaborating as she nodded to Yuan Ming and then left with her father.
After the departure of Jin Chao and his daughter, Yuan Ming sat long in his room, still unable to comprehend the deeper significance behind Fairy Jin Yun's actions.
"What did she really mean by that?" Yuan Ming couldn't help but seek Xi Ying's opinion.
"Heh," the response that came was nothing but a cold laugh from within the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
...
Wu Yue Sect headquarters.
"Useless, all of you!" roared the White Bone Venerable from atop his grand hall, sending a sudden gust of eerie wind that silenced every Nascent Soul present, as if they were cicadas in winter.
"I expended so many resources to set up that Great Array, and all I asked was for you to guard it. Such a simple task, yet you couldn't even manage that?" the White Bone Venerable continued to berate them.
"Venerable, it's not fair to blame us," interjected Qing Ya, the surrendering Nascent Soul from Thousand Snake Island, unable to hold back his defense. "After all, who could have anticipated that the East Sea Alliance would dare to simultaneously attack four Array Eyes and coordinate their actions so well?"
"There is indeed something suspicious about this matter. In my opinion, it's possible that there's a traitor causing mischief, someone who has secretly leaked information," Li Wu, a Nascent Soul cultivator of the Wu Yue Sect, sneered as he cast a meaningful glance at Qing Ya.
"Venerable, please see clearly that ever since Thousand Snake Island joined the Wu Yue Sect, our loyalty has been unswerving, we wouldn't dare to harbor any second thoughts," Qing Ya glared back at Li Wu and hastily stood up to bow towards the White Bone Venerable.
The White Bone Venerable merely glanced at Qing Ya, noncommittally, saying nothing.
A chill ran down Qing Ya's spine. These Wu Yue Sect Cultivators had always looked down on them, the surrendered cultivators from the East Sea, and the strange breach in the Great Array was probably just what Li Wu had suggested—the same suspicion the White Bone Venerable harbored. It was just that they still needed their service for now, so no direct accusations or punishments had been meted out, at least not yet.
Meanwhile, a Black Robed Cultivator sitting to the left of the White Bone Venerable suddenly coughed twice before slowly speaking:
"In my view, the breaking of the Great Array does not necessarily point to the presence of a spy. If not, why would the East Sea Alliance wait until their supplies were nearly exhausted to break the Array, after it had been established for so long? I think it's best to investigate whether the East Sea Alliance has gained some powerful new ally," he said.
If Yuan Ming were here, he would have recognized the speaker as Ni Mu, the leader of the Dawn Alliance.
However, those present seemed unaware of his true identity, only knowing him as the Heavenly Puppet Venerable of the Wu Yue Sect.
"Enough! The Great Array has been breached, and assigning blame now accomplishes nothing. At this moment, there's only one thing we must do—the East Sea Alliance thinks that by breaking the Red Blood Sand Formation, everything will be fine. We must show them the true capabilities of the Wu Yue Sect!" the White Bone Venerable pondered for a moment, seemingly regaining his composure.
"Right now, the East Sea Alliance's morale is high, and we don't yet have a clear understanding of their current situation. It would be unwise to act rashly. Perhaps we should shift from offense to defense for the time being, take the opportunity to consolidate the areas we've conquered, and wait until we have a clearer picture before making a decision," suggested Ni Mu.
"Shift from offense to defense? Our Wu Yue Sect has come all this way to the East Sea, not to act with undue caution. If the Wuyue God holds us to account, none of us will be able to bear it," laughed Li Wu derisively.
"Indeed, even if the East Sea Alliance received reinforcements, how could they be stronger than Wan Tianren? It's unlikely that Jin Chao will exhaust her resources for the sake of the East Sea Alliance, or else the situation would not be what it is today. Plainly put, our previous siege was only a ruse to bide time. We're already prepared, even if the Array hadn't been breached, we would have advanced on Purple Nan Island in a few days. Now it's just happening a bit earlier!" the White Bone Venerable decided with a wave of his hand.
Beneath his black robe, Ni Mu's complexion turned ashen, clearly disagreeing with White Bone Venerable's unilateral decision.
He was privy to much more information than the White Bone Venerable, including that Yuan Ming had joined the East Sea Alliance.
Ni Mu had an intuition that Yuan Ming was likely tied to the breach of the Red Blood Sand Formation. Yet the White Bone Venerable's insistence on attacking now caused him some unease.
But after some thought, Ni Mu ultimately chose not to reveal the information he held.
After all, the one currently in charge of the Wu Yue Sect's affairs in the East Sea was the White Bone Venerable, not him. Whether the outcome was victory or defeat, the credit was not his, and neither was the responsibility.
If one chose to act alone, one must bear the consequences of that choice.
"Well then, I'll just wish White Bone Venerable an early victory," Ni Mu said with a light laugh, excusing himself from the council hall.
...
On Purple Nan Island, Yan Siyun had finished dealing with her immediate tasks and returned to her residence.
Since meeting with Yuan Ming, even Wan Tianren seemed to be aware of Yan Siyun's role as a subordinate to Yuan Ming, and thereafter she was no longer required to undertake missions, allowing her to devote herself entirely to serving Yuan Ming.
But for now, Yuan Ming had no orders for her, so aside from gathering intelligence and spreading the word of the Moon God Sect, she found herself with plenty of free time.
After arriving at her residence, she first sorted through the intelligence she had collected as usual, then took out an ancient tome related to divination and, using her Divine Sense, started to read with relish.
She didn't have many hobbies, but she had a particular interest in divination. However, since divination was so profound and sometimes the results were ambiguous, she never considered it her primary practice. It was more of an auxiliary technique for her, another way to interpret and analyze intelligence.
That day, however, as she read the ancient tome, she was suddenly inspired to take out her turtle shell and bamboo divination tools and cast a divination for herself.
"Hmm, this is..." Yan Siyun's casual posture straightened instantly as she examined the divination, her expression turning solemn.
After a moment's contemplation, she quickly stood up and sought a way to contact Yuan Ming.
"Divine Envoy Yuan, the Wu Yue Sect's forces will soon descend upon us," Yan Siyun said with certainty.

chapters.title: Chapter 655 - 627: Rout
chapters.content:
Several days later.
Hovering above Purple Nan Island, a massive White Bone Palace floated high in the sky, radiating waves of grim, ash-white aura. Its walls and floors were all forged from stacked beast bones, and at the tips of each of the rooftop corners rested the skeletons of exotic beasts—resembling dragons, tigers, turtles, and birds. Inside their skulls flickered ghostly flames, suggesting that they were not mere inanimates.
Surrounding the palace, numerous Flying Boats with the Wu Yue Sect's banners stood guard vigilantly, and on the island below swarmed figures cloaked in black robes.
Purple Nan Island had evidently fallen.
However, inside the White Bone Palace, the faces of the Wu Yue Sect Nascent Soul cultivators weren't entirely filled with joy; many bore traces of doubt.
"Venerable One, I've led people to search the entire island. Just like with Yuzhu Three Islands, the East Sea Alliance left nothing behind," Li Wu strode in from outside the hall, cupped his hands and reported.
Seated upon the skeleton throne in the great hall, the figure of the White Bone Venerable was still shrouded in a black robe, and though his face was unclear, his voice carried a hint of sarcasm.
"Heh heh, the East Sea Alliance is just so-so. As soon as they heard that our sect's armies were mobilized, they abandoned their lairs," he said with a wave of his hand and a laugh.
At these words, a stir went through the Nascent Soul cultivators, followed by the suppression of their doubts as they echoed the sentiment.
"I reckon the folks from the East Sea Alliance never intended to fight us head-on; they just wanted to quickly take away all the resources from the Yuzhu Three Islands. Otherwise, how could they have moved their goods so swiftly?" Qing Ya speculated.
"They must have paid a hefty price when they broke the Red Blood Sand Formation earlier. Now, seeing our forces bearing down, they dare not confront us directly," Li Wu, uncharacteristically, agreed with Qing Ya's conjecture.
For a while, such discussions filled the hall, the atmosphere exceptionally heated; although not a person was killed or an item seized, it was as if they had won a great battle.
Ni Mu sat upright at a lower seat beside the White Bone Venerable, his gaze sweeping over everyone, silent.
"Tian Gui, what do you think now? If we had taken your advice to stay put and let the East Sea Alliance flee, we would have become a laughing stock," the White Bone Venerable glanced at him and asked languidly.
Ni Mu still did not reply, his expression unchanged, but a cold laugh echoed in his heart.
Seeing his reaction, the White Bone Venerable lost the urge to mock him further. With a slight lift of his hand, he silenced everyone in the hall and gave the command, "That rabble from the East Sea Alliance can't have gone far. Don't linger here; press on in pursuit and ensure their total annihilation!"
"Yes!" The multitude in the hall responded in unison.
Before long, the Wu Yue Sect's army continued their march, tracking the East Sea Alliance's troops.
However, nature didn't cooperate. Not long after the Wu Yue Sect's forces set out again, massive dark clouds suddenly appeared in the sky and, with a clap of thunder, a torrential downpour descended upon the Wu Yue Sect's army.
"Send someone to disperse the rain clouds," the White Bone Venerable frowned slightly as he saw the heavy rain outside the hall, sensing that something was amiss.
Li Wu immediately took the command, but before he could leave the hall, several thunderbolts suddenly struck down from the sky outside the great hall, hitting the midst of the Wu Yue Sect's army.
The White Bone Venerable stood up abruptly, while the Nascent Soul cultivators in the hall were also greatly shocked. They clearly felt that the thunderbolts were unusually powerful and their occurrence rather abnormal.
"Snow! Why is it suddenly snowing?" Qing Ya suddenly widened his eyes and exclaimed.
Outside the great hall, large snowflakes gently fluttered down. The howling wind made everyone shiver uncontrollably.
Yet, immediately after, they all felt a wave of heat rushing toward them. The snow that had just been falling thickly evaporated in an instant, to be replaced by clumps of burning red flames, falling from the dark clouds like raindrops.
"Thunderstorms, freezing snow, fire rain—aren't these the weather phenomena exclusive to the Violent Sea Area? Why are they appearing near the Red Leaf Sea Domain?" Qing Ya suddenly realized something.
If you're not on *, you're viewing a copy.
Upon hearing this, the White Bone Venerable's heart skipped a beat, his foreboding feeling growing stronger.
"Pass my order, everyone prepare for battle immediately, we are being ambushed!" he amplified his mana, his voice thundering across the formation.
But just as he spoke, the figures of numerous cultivators suddenly materialized out of thin air on both sides of the Wu Yue Sect's army.
These cultivators, though dressed differently, each wore a piece of ribbon around their left arm, the insignia of the East Sea Alliance, and seizing the moment of disorder caused by the unusual weather, they launched their attack simultaneous.
"Haha, White Bone Venerable, since you've journeyed from afar, I believe it's only right for you to enjoy the special climatic features of the East Sea. The only question is whether they meet your standards or not?" Along with the laughter, Wan Tianren and other East Sea Alliance Nascent Soul cultivators also appeared in the sky.
"Humph, defeated dogs still dare to be rampant. Do you really think with these petty tricks unworthy of the stage, you can defeat our great Wu Yue Sect army, how arrogant!" the White Bone Venerable bellowed in fury.
Yet at that moment, behind him, a heaven-shattering sword light suddenly burst forth, like a bolt of thunder cutting through the hall and whitening everyone's field of vision.
Yuan Ming let out a roar, fully activating the Curse Rune on the Soul Destroying Sword, and at the same time, he executed the Nightmare Divine Ability aimed at the White Bone Venerable.
He had used the Void Transformation Technique to elude the eyes of all and arrived by the side of White Bone Venerable. Now that he had suddenly appeared, he naturally did not hold back. Even if he couldn't kill White Bone Venerable with a single strike, he intended to inflict serious injury.
The Wu Yue Sect Nascent Soul cultivators had not anticipated that the enemy had already infiltrated their ranks. By the time they saw the flash of the sword light, it was too late to save White Bone Venerable, and they could only watch helplessly as the formidable slash severed his head.
However, when the skull under the Black Robe of White Bone Venerable rolled to the ground, everyone discovered that what fell was merely a skeletal skull, seemingly long devoid of life.
Yuan Ming was also shocked to see this. His Soul Extinguishing Sword lifted the Black Robe from White Bone Venerable's body, only to find that it was also just a skeleton, devoid of any flesh.
In order not to be discovered, he had not used his Divine Sense since he had sneaked in, and the Black Robe of White Bone Venerable also had the effect of blocking investigations. Thus, he had never realized that this White Bone Venerable sitting on the Skeleton Throne was merely a skeletal Puppet.
"Very well, I'll remember you! My fellows, why haven't you captured him yet?" In the next instant, White Bone Venerable's voice suddenly echoed through the great hall, and the Wu Yue Sect Nascent Souls came to their senses, attacked in anger, and together besieged Yuan Ming.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming didn't dare to resist head-on. With a stroke of his spell, he once again used the Void Transformation Technique to disappear from sight and began to weave and dodge among his enemies.
Meanwhile, Wan Tianren and the others outside the hall naturally wouldn't stand idly by; they attacked White Bone Palace in succession, attempting to relieve Yuan Ming.
Just as a great battle was about to erupt, the four Exotic Beast skeletons on the roof of White Bone Palace unexpectedly came to life at once. They raised their heads, and despite having no flesh, each emitted a piercing roar simultaneously.
Countless pale spirit lights rose from the four skeletons, rapidly converging in mid-air to form a giant Array.
"Wu Yue Sect Cultivators, heed my command. Enter the Array at once and evacuate this place!" White Bone Venerable's voice once again thundered across the landscape.
No sooner had his words fallen than countless Wu Yue Sect cultists withdrew from the melee and threw themselves into the Array, vanishing from sight.
"This is bad, their palace has the ability to teleport through space, it's not a weapon for assault. We mustn't let them escape!" Wan Tianren immediately understood.
Under his lead, the East Sea Alliance Nascent Souls all made their moves, hurling various Magic and Magic Treasures towards White Bone Palace like rain, only to be intercepted by a Formation that had appeared outside the Palace.
Within the palace, Yuan Ming, still using the Void Transformation Technique to hold off the Nascent Souls, heard Wan Tianren's shout from outside and was contemplating ways to break through when he suddenly sensed something amiss.
Strange fluctuations began to waft through the void, seemingly activating some kind of spatial teleportation prohibition.
Looking at the Wu Yue Sect Nascent Soul cultivators facing him, he noticed they were circling but not attacking, or rather, they were defending but not attacking, as if they were only trying to delay him.
Could it be...
Yuan Ming's heart chilled. Could it be that he had fallen into the range of some kind of spatial transmission prohibition, and these people were trying to hold him back to transport him away as well?
Seeing this, Yuan Ming hesitated no longer. He swiftly glanced around and immediately employed the Void Transformation Technique, rushing out of the great hall.
Just as he had left the hall, the Array in the sky suddenly flashed, and following that, White Bone Palace vanished into thin air.
Yuan Ming stopped using the Void Transformation Technique and looked at the place where White Bone Palace had disappeared, his heart still in his throat.
By a hair's breadth, he might have been transported by White Bone Venerable to an unknown region, where if surrounded by a group of Nascent Soul cultivators and with White Bone Venerable, a powerful enemy, making the decisions, even with the Stealing Heaven Tripod to aid him, his chances of survival would likely have been slender.
"Divine Envoy Yuan, are you alright?" Wan Tianren and the others had now gathered around as well.
"I'm fine, it's just a pity we let them escape; fortunately, quite a few of the Wu Yue Sect cultivators didn't manage to completely flee. Alliance Leader Wan, please take care to execute them here," Yuan Ming shook his head.
"Of course," Wan Tianren replied, and seeing that Yuan Ming was unharmed, he led the others to annihilate the remnant Wu Yue Sect forces.
Yuan Ming stood mid-air, taking a deep breath, his gaze sweeping the surroundings, feeling somewhat relieved.
He hadn't expected the Wu Yue Sect's forces to arrive so swiftly, but fortunately, Yan Siyun's fortuitous divination had foreseen this timeously.
Moreover, their successful ambush was thanks to the cultivators from Thousand Dragon Island who happened to meet with the East Sea Alliance cultivators, carrying with them a unique Formation that could temporarily transform the astronomical phenomena of a sea region to emulate those unique to the Violent Sea Area.
This was originally prepared to break the Red Blood Sand Formation, but it ended up being used in the ambush instead.
Unfortunately, White Bone Venerable turned out not to be as simple as he appeared to be. The attack by the army seemed reckless, but they had in fact taken precautions and prepared an escape route in case of defeat. The true body of White Bone Venerable had not engaged in battle, instead directly allowing a White Bone Puppet to stand in.
He even began to doubt the true intent behind White Bone Venerable's actions.
Dealing with such an enemy, he still had to be extremely cautious.

chapters.title: Chapter 656 - 628: Scheming
chapters.content:
Despite the ambush battle having ended inconclusively, with not a single Nascent Soul cultivator from the Wu Yue Sect suffering any loss, the escape from the White Bone Palace was ultimately too hasty, leaving a considerable number of Wu Yue Sect cultivators killed or captured by the East Sea Alliance.
For the cultivators of the East Sea Alliance, this was deemed a major victory after a long period of setbacks, and when they learned that Yuan Ming and a Nether Moon God believer were the greatest contributors to this battle, their gratitude and faith in the Nether Moon God grew even more devout.
As a result, Yuan Ming once again gathered a large amount of Desire Power, larger than ever before. Even though Yuan Ming allowed both the first and the second split souls to join in the refinement, he still couldn't absorb it all and ultimately had to temporarily store the excess Desire Power within the White Jade Lotus Platform.
However, gradually, he began to harbor some doubts.
"Strange, is it my illusion? I always feel like the White Jade Lotus Platform seems to have changed somewhat," Yuan Ming stared at the White Jade Lotus Platform within the Stealing Heaven Tripod, sensing that it was somehow different with the influx of Desire Power.
"Indeed, it seems to have an extra layer of golden light," Xi Ying, also curious, came over to look.
After examining for a moment, Yuan Ming discovered that, as Xi Ying said, there were additional layers of golden light around the White Jade Lotus Platform.
"Is it because I stored too much Desire Power inside?" Yuan Ming felt uncertain, not knowing whether this change was for better or worse.
This was a question Xi Ying couldn't answer either. Yuan Ming cautiously observed for a few days and, seeing no other changes in the White Jade Lotus Platform, decided to leave it be for the time being.
After all, Desire Power was not easily come by; if it couldn't exist within the White Jade Lotus Platform, surely it couldn't just be wasted?
During the intervals of his closed-door cultivation to absorb Desire Power, he also took the time to meet with Long Chong.
A few days earlier, through Black Incense Possession, he had investigated Qiong Yun's life and death and unexpectedly found that she was not dead; she was still on Three Immortals Island, seemingly protected by Hou Yi's Sun Shooting Bow.
He truthfully conveyed this news to Long Chong, who, upon hearing it, wept with joy and even considered using the Jade Talisman given to him at that time.
Yuan Ming, after much persuasion, managed to dissuade him, informing him that Qiong Yun seemed to be in a special kind of deep sleep and that a day of awakening would surely come, and going to find her then would not be too late.
Convinced by Yuan Ming, Long Chong reluctantly put aside his thoughts, but still thanked Yuan Ming profusely.
Meanwhile, as Yuan Ming secluded himself, the East Sea Alliance's counterattack against the Wu Yue Sect continued unabated.
Unexpectedly, the Wu Yue Sect changed its usual strategy, gradually retreating their forces from the previously forcefully occupied islands and consolidating their defense on Fusang Island.
...
At this moment, Red Leaf Island was brimming with joy.
After a triumphant victory, Wan Tianren ordered recuperation and celebration for three days.
Red Leaf, Wanhua, and Yuzhu three islands brought out all their stored Spiritual Wine, allowing the alliance army to drink heartily and rejoice in the successive victories that had occurred recently.
The East Sea Alliance, having reversed the earlier continuous defeats, whether it was Nascent Soul higher-ups or Core Formation, Foundation Establishment cultivators, were all brimming with confidence, ready to expel the Wu Yue Sect from the East Sea in one fell swoop.
In a secluded small building on Red Leaf Island, Yuan Ming did not join in the merrymaking, instead fiddling with a piece of green Spiritual Pine Wood.
This object, known as Green Phoenix Pine, was one of the best materials for making Spirit Incense, cultivated on Red Leaf Island in the Immortal Cultivation World of the East Sea.
Yuan Ming had already developed a way to control the persons possessed by Black Incense, with the only flaw being that the burning time of the Spirit Incense was not long enough.
He planned to add this Green Phoenix Pine to see if he could extend the burning time of the Black Incense.
Yan Siyun, standing behind Yuan Ming, recounted the latest situations she had learned: "... Now the Wu Yue Sect has intensified the plundering of controlled islands, not just various spiritual materials and Spirit Stones, but also brutally slaughtering mortals and cultivators, seemingly collecting souls and fresh corpses."
Yuan Ming, whose status in the East Sea Alliance was now almost equivalent to Alliance Leader Wan Tianren, was increasingly taken seriously, so he simply assigned Yan Siyun to his side to gather intelligence.
"Killing for souls? Collecting corpses? This Wu Yue Sect really is defying the heavens and committing all sorts of atrocities, have you found out what they want with so many souls and corpses?" Yuan Ming put down the Green Phoenix Pine, a cold light flashing in his eyes.
"I have not found that out yet," Yan Siyun shook her head as she spoke.
"Try to find out as much as possible; if you really can't get any leads, just capture them directly—I have ways to make them talk," Yuan Ming said.
The Heavenly Ghost Wanderer has also been ordered to collect souls; now the Wu Yue Sect coming to the East Sea is doing the same, which must hold some hidden significance.
Since he had decided to confront the Wu Yue Sect head-on, he must clarify this matter.
As for collecting corpses, it was probably because the Wu Yue Sect was practicing some Evil Technique or refining some evil Magic Treasure.
"Yes," Yan Siyun responded.Thiscopycomesfromcontenton*.
"What's the situation with Fusang Island now? Are there any signs of a large-scale assembly of cultivators planning a counterattack?" Yuan Ming thought for a moment, then asked again.
"On the contrary, the Wu Yue Sect has retracted most of their forces back to Fusang Island, fortifying their hold on the island and refusing entry to anyone not from the Wu Yue Sect," Yan Siyun said.
"Oh, that's odd; for the White Bone Venerable to swallow such a blow, could it be that they are preparing to hold out for reinforcements, and the Wu Yue Sect's reinforcements are on their way?" Yuan Ming showed a look of surprise; he hadn't expected this situation.
"I've also considered this and have already sent a message to the spy in Dragon King City to keep an eye on the situation in the north; no news has come through yet," said Yan Siyun.
"Alright, you may go now," Yuan Ming slowly nodded and waved his hand.
Yan Siyun acknowledged and quickly left.
Yuan Ming sat down, remained silent, and speculated about the Wu Yue Sect's intentions.
Although the East Sea Alliance had won two major victories, the Wu Yue Sect should still have considerable strength remaining. What could their intention be in holding back their forces? The East Sea is extremely far from the Northern Desert; waiting for reinforcements from the Wu Yue Sect seemed unlikely.
He pondered for a moment without any clue and soon gave up.
The buffer for the Stealing Heaven Tripod would pass in two or three days, and he could directly use possession to investigate and immediately understand the Wu Yue Sect's intentions.
He took out the other materials for making Black Incense, mixed in the Green Phoenix Pine, and began crafting new Black Incense. Suddenly, his brow furrowed as the first split soul suddenly transmitted a message.
Under the Five Elements Creation Tree of the Stealing Heaven Tripod, Xi Ying once again entered seclusion, forming a five-colored light screen around herself.
At that moment, the light screen underwent a strange change, suddenly beginning to twist and shake, emitting beams of five-colored spiritual light.
After a moment, the light screen burst with a loud bang, transforming into countless fragments of light that scattered.
Xi Ying's figure appeared, her skin now showing many five-colored spiritual patterns, rapidly converging toward the center of her forehead, and within a few breaths, all were absorbed into it.
Her long eyelashes fluttered, and she slowly opened her eyes.
"Has the seclusion ended?" the first split soul flew over and asked.
Xi Ying nodded slightly.
Yuan Ming, observing Xi Ying through the first split soul, noted that her cultivation had not changed, with the Ju Mang Spirit Technique also remaining at the second realm, yet he vaguely felt that Xi Ying was different from before, though he couldn't pinpoint exactly how.
"Did you gain anything?" he asked, controlling the first split soul.
"Sort of, could you do me a favor and let me have a look at the array tools for the Red Blood Sand Formation?" Xi Ying suddenly requested.
"That... there's no problem to look at them. The array tools were stored in the Alliance warehouse after being salvaged, but they were not insignificant, even if we can find them, they would only be considered remnants," Yuan Ming responded, his expression showing surprise, then he said.
"That's no problem, if the Red Blood Sand Formation and other array maps from the East Sea could be obtained, please help me get some, the more the better," Xi Ying said.
"I will find a way to get them for you. But why do you need so many arrays? Could it be that your cultivation in array formation has advanced further?" Yuan Ming asked, puzzled.
"Yes, with this seclusion, my Dao of Arrays has entered a new level, and I need a large number of array maps to comprehend," Xi Ying said with a slight smile showing on her lips.
Yuan Ming, not being well-versed in array formation, did not know whether advancement in Array Formation cultivation required understanding unfamiliar formations, but since Xi Ying had achieved something from her seclusion, he was also happy for her.
As for obtaining a large number of array maps, that was a minor issue for him. With his current status and position, a simple request would make the islands of the East Sea offer up various arrays, and the damaged Red Blood Sand Formation was even less of a concern.
At that moment, seven or eight tunneling lights shot forth, landing outside the mansion, revealing the figures of Wan Tianren, Gu Xuanyang, Hou Chou, Shi Yanshi and others, who did not enter.
"Divine Envoy Yuan, may we disturb you for a moment?" Wan Tianren called out.
"With the battle just ended, the Alliance has many matters to attend to; how come you fellows have the time to visit me?" Yuan Ming went out to greet them.
"The situation in the East Sea has changed. We have just received the latest intelligence and have come to discuss our next move with you," Wan Tianren said.
"Please, come inside and talk," Yuan Ming shifted his gaze and invited them into the pavilion.
"Divine Envoy Yuan, after their two devastating defeats, the Wu Yue Sect has started changing their strategy, pulling back their defenses, and they have also recalled a significant portion of their combat power, firmly guarding Fusang Island! It seems they are frightened by our East Sea Alliance, hahaha..." Hou Chou, once inside, couldn't wait to speak, and burst into laughter at the end.
Having witnessed Yuan Ming's unfathomable strength, as well as his inscrutable relationship with the Nether Moon God, Hou Chou had completely abandoned the idea of contending with Yuan Ming, and just like the others, considered him a pillar of the East Sea Cultivation World.
"These arrogant bastards also have their day! Divine Envoy Yuan, I think we should take advantage of the Wu Yue Sect's recent defeat while their morale is unstable. The Alliance should directly storm Fusang Island and eliminate all the Wu Yue Sect cultivators who have invaded the East Sea," Hou Mo said.
"It's not that simple, the Wu Yue Sect might have pulled back, but they are increasing their efforts in scavenging resources from the islands of the East Sea. I think we should split the Alliance forces into two – one to conquer the islands under the Wu Yue Sect's control and the other to directly strike at Fusang Island to eradicate the Wu Yue Sect cultivators there. This would be a more balanced approach," Gu Xuanyang said.
Yuan Ming listened, understanding the purpose of their visit.
Hou Chou, Gu Xuanyang, and others, though they said they came to discuss, were in fact having differences on the next step and trying to get him on their side.
"Alliance Leader Wan, what do you think?" Yuan Ming did not express his opinion, instead looking towards Wan Tianren, who had not spoken yet.
"Although the Wu Yue Sect has been defeated repeatedly, their strength should not be underestimated. I think it's not advisable to divide forces. The suggestion by Fellow Daoist Hou Mo is more appropriate—focusing our efforts to eliminate the Wu Yue Sect cultivators scattered outside, or directly attacking Fusang Island would be better," Wan Tianren said slowly.
Yuan Ming, hearing this, inwardly nodded.

chapters.title: Chapter 657 - 629: Ghostly Soul White Bone Banner
chapters.content:
"Yuan Ming's thoughts are aligned with Alliance Leader Wan. But the Wu Yue Sect has drawn back to fortify its defenses, seemingly biding time and harboring other schemes. Rather than attacking other islands, it would be better to directly assault Fusang Island; simply eradicate the Wu Yue Sect Cultivators there, and they will no longer be able to stir up any significant trouble in the East Sea," Yuan Ming said.
Those who wanted to refute Wan Tianren were about to speak out but saw that Yuan Ming had already made his stance known, and his special status also represented, to some extent, the Nether Moon God. They all swallowed back their words.
With the recent series of fierce battles, the Nether Moon God's reputation had soared. Even if the cultivators of the East Sea Alliance had yet to regard it as a deity, they had to seriously consider its opinions.
"Since none of you have any objections, speed is of the essence in warfare. Everyone quickly muster your forces, and let's head to Fusang Island immediately!" Yuan Ming and Wan Tianren exchanged glances, and upon seeing a slight nod from the latter, he spoke thus.
Upon hearing his words, everyone naturally voiced their agreement and took their leave to carry out their orders.
Alliance Leader Wan slapped the armrest of his chair, feeling a great sense of satisfaction. A flash of excitement and joy glimmered in the depths of his eyes.
After escaping from the Three Immortals Island, he had rushed back to the East Sea day and night. Faced with the chaos caused by the Wu Yue Sect's attacks that left everything on the verge of collapse, he racked his brains to gather the scattered cultivators from the various islands of the East Sea and to form the East Sea Alliance. His ultimate goal was to reclaim the foundation of Fusang Island and stabilize the situation in the East Sea once again.
Though the journey had been arduous, it had finally reached this stage!
The warriors of the East Sea Alliance were brimming with the intent to fight. Learning that both the Alliance Leader and the Nether Moon God had agreed to attack Fusang Island, their morale soared, and they began to prepare in earnest, for many had been waiting for this day for a long time.
In the meantime, Yuan Ming tactfully communicated his desire for various Formation Array Patterns and the Red Blood Sand Formation array equipment to Wan Tianren.
From Alliance Leader Wan downward, there was a certain degree of gratitude toward the Nether Moon God, and since reclaiming Fusang and resetting the order in the East Sea also required its effort, they were worried about how to please this Divine Envoy. So, after a brief notice, the various islands offered up many Array Maps they controlled without hesitation.
The equipment for the Red Blood Sand Formation was retrieved from the Alliance's warehouse and sent over expressly.
It all happened in less than a day.
Yuan Ming looked at a storage ring filled with Formation Array Flags with some astonishment. Among these formations were some that had once been regarded as heritages of Sects, but now they had willingly been given to him, which moved him deeply.
The power of faith is indeed terrifying - faster than killing and plundering!
The Wu Yue Sect had been around for so long, and with countless followers both openly and in the shadows, it was no wonder they could easily mobilize vast resources and armies of cultivators. This was the accumulation of many years.
No wonder the Wu Yue Sect saw his own Moon Sect as a thorn in their side. To them, faith could only take one form, just like a mountain would not harbor two tigers. In the eyes of the Wu Yue Sect, his Moon Sect had become a stumbling block for gathering resources and Desire Power, which had to be removed swiftly.
After reflecting for a moment, he handed all these items to Xi Ying to study at leisure.
Several days later, after a series of orderly preparations, the East Sea Alliance army officially set out towards Fusang Island.
Before the Alliance army departed, numerous spies had already been mobilized, gathering intelligence through various channels about Fusang Island and other islands controlled by the Wu Yue Sect.
Just as the East Sea Alliance army was making its way, various messages began to arrive, the most important naturally concerning the situation on Fusang Island.
On a large Flying Boat of the Alliance, Yuan Ming's face was somber as he looked at a Jade Scroll in his hand, bearing intelligence from Yan Siyun.
According to the Jade Scroll, the Wu Yue Sect had set up a formidable Great Array on Fusang Island. It was a Wood Attribute Formation that enveloped the entire island. Replete with spirit light reaching to the skies, its power seemed even greater than that of the Red Blood Sand Formation.
"The Wu Yue Sect, as a mighty school with ten thousand years of inheritance, truly has a profound foundation, casually producing all sorts of powerful Great Arrays," Yuan Ming muttered to himself.
Based on this limited information, it was not possible to determine what kind of Formation the Wu Yue Sect had set up, so Yuan Ming did not inquire of Xi Ying.
Several days later, the Alliance army had arrived at Fusang Island.
Just as the prior intelligence had indicated, the entirety of Fusang Island was now enveloped by a green Array. The scope of this Formation was vast; not only did it cover Fusang Island, but also the expansive surrounding sea area was included within its embrace.
From a distance, the Formation was filled with layers of green spirit light, resembling countless tree shadows undulating and swaying.
Including Yuan Ming, the Nascent Soul Cultivators present were surprised upon investigating the Array.
The core of this green Great Array turned out to be the Fusang Giant Tree. Green rainbows extended from the tree, intertwining and coiling around each other, forming the Array.
Seeing this situation, many of the cultivators on Fusang Island showed no signs of preparing for battle and instead all shrank back within the green Great Array.
In Fusang City, inside the once-main hall of Fusang Island, Ni Mu, Li Wu, Qing Ya, and several other Nascent Soul Cultivators of the Wu Yue Sect stood there, but the White Bone Venerable was not present.
"Venerable Tian Gui, the people of the East Sea Alliance have already arrived nearby, and judging by their numbers, it seems they've all come out," a middle-aged man in a black robe knelt on one knee, reporting.
"So soon, and with their full force as well. It seems that White Bone Venerable's plan to lure the East Sea Alliance to divide their forces has not been successful," Ni Mu muttered to himself.
The White Bone Venerable had intensified the plundering of resources under his control. On the one hand, this was to gather resources, and on the other hand, he wished to make the East Sea Alliance divide its forces to put out fires. Now, facing the vast army of the East Sea Alliance, this naturally signified the failure of his plan.
"Venerable Heavenly Puppet, what should we do now?" Li Wu asked, unable to hide his reluctance.
The other Nascent Soul cultivators also looked over, their faces filled with unease.
In the battle at Purple Nan Island, the Wu Yue Sect cultivators suffered heavy losses, a third to a quarter of their number. They were no longer at an advantage in terms of numbers or combat power, yet the White Bone Venerable suddenly ordered an intensified search and occupation of the islands, along with the command to firmly hold Fusang Island.
The people of Fusang Island couldn't understand why. They thought they should use the advantage of the numerous Soul Cultivators of Wu Yue Sect to conduct guerrilla warfare against the East Sea Alliance. Even if they were to hold Fusang Island, they should recall the forces scattered across various islands. Executing both orders at the same time seemed tantamount to seeking death.
However, as the White Bone Venerable was assigned by the Witch Moon God, the highest commander of the East Sea Witch Moon Sect, the others had no choice but to follow orders.
"There is no need to worry, my friends. The Island Protection Array of Fusang Island is even more powerful than the Red Blood Sand Formation and is especially good at defense. Even if the East Sea Alliance attacks with all their might, they won't be able to breach it in two or three months. The White Bone Venerable is preparing a trump card. As long as we hold on until he emerges from seclusion, victory will still be ours," Ni Mu said.
"Is the Island Protection Array really that powerful?" Li Wu asked, both shocked and delighted.
The defense of Fusang Island was personally arranged by the White Bone Venerable, and they weren't very clear about the power of the Island Protection Array.
"Of course, the formation is called the Life Creation Array, and the array equipment was personally refined by Master Dian. If its power were not sufficient, would the White Bone Venerable seclude himself at this time?" Ni Mu said with a smile.
Upon hearing this, all the Nascent Soul cultivators present visibly relaxed.

"Although the Life Creation Array is powerful, we cannot just stand by idly. I will divide the area, and everyone will spread out to guard it," Ni Mu proposed.
...
A moment later, everyone in the hall had left, leaving only Ni Mu alone.
He turned and faced a stone wall, casting a spell toward it.
The stone wall emitted a "rumbling" muffled sound and slowly split to both sides, revealing a stone staircase leading downward.
Within the passage, a cold and gloomy atmosphere lingered. The deeper one went, the stronger the Yin Qi became, until at the bottom of the passage, the coldness could almost pierce through to the marrow.
"Who would have thought that Fusang Island would have such a level of Yin Cave. It is fortunate we have this place; otherwise, refining that Magic Treasure would not be easy," Ni Mu muttered to himself as he reached the end of the stone staircase.
There was a stone gate with two people standing at the entrance: a thick-browed middle-aged man on the left and a red-robed young girl on the right.
The auras of the two were quite strange, with no fluctuations of Mana. Despite standing in such a bone-chilling environment, they showed no signs of discomfort.
"Venerable Heavenly Puppet." Upon seeing Ni Mu approach, the two bowed stiffly and unnaturally with expressionless faces, their movements exceptionally rigid.
"Is the White Bone Venerable still inside?" Ni Mu asked nonchalantly.
"Yes," said the thick-browed man.
"What stage has the treasure's refinement reached?" Ni Mu inquired.
"Fifty percent of the bones sent from the various islands have already been used. The refining progress should be more than half complete," the red-robed girl answered.
Next to her, there was a wooden rack with nearly a hundred Storage Bags neatly arranged.
Ni Mu nodded and was about to turn away when a layer of white bone-colored light suddenly surged on the stone gate.
An immense and sinister aura leaked out, enveloping the entire underground space in an instant, and producing a bizarre crackling sound.
Ni Mu's bones creaked noisily as his skeleton convulsed violently, seemingly about to burst out of his body and move toward the inside of the stone gate.
His complexion drastically changed, and he hurriedly flew upward towards the passage while mustering all his Mana for protection. Only then could he barely suppress the turmoil within his bones.
The thick-browed man and red-robed girl beside the stone gate seemed unaffected. The girl took a Storage Bag from the rack and flung it forward.
Countless bloody bones appeared out of nowhere, nearly filling the space in front of the stone gate.
