Most of the bones were scattered fragments, but many were intact skeletons, seemingly made by flaying and deboning living people.
Upon contact with the sinister aura, all the bones began moving. The complete skeletons stepped toward the stone gate, while the scattered bones quickly assembled themselves into oddly shaped frames, also rushing towards the stone gate.
As soon as the skeletons touched the bone-white light on the gate, they immediately fused into it.
In a few breaths, all the skeletons vanished, and the bone-white light on the stone gate disappeared with them, as did the sinister aura.
From a distance, Ni Mu finally relaxed and joy soon appeared on his face as he murmured, "Only halfway through refinement, yet the Ghostly Soul White Bone Banner already possesses such might. If it truly recovers completely, it could indeed sweep through the Yunhuang Continent. It truly is a Spiritual Treasure of Ancient Times renowned for slaughter."

chapters.title: Chapter 658 - 630: Testing
chapters.content:
The East Sea Alliance's grand army did not immediately launch an attack, but stopped a hundred miles west of Fusang Island and arranged their formation.
Yuan Ming stood at the front of the Flying Boat, manipulating his first soul seated on the White Jade Lotus Platform, releasing Divine Sense of a Half-step Word Witch level, enveloping the green formation.
The Divine Sense empowered by the Stealing Heaven Tripod had an astonishing exploration capability, easily penetrating the formation, quickly uncovering numerous clues within the green formation.
However, the green formation's coverage was too vast; even with his current range of Divine Sense, it could not cover everything.
"This formation appears to be a Wood Attribute Array," Wan Tianren looked towards Old Man Hei Zhu and Shi Yanshi, "you two are proficient in Wood Attribute Divine Skills and Formations, can you discern what type of formation this is?"
Old Man Hei Zhu and Shi Yanshi had been observing the formation around Fusang Island from afar. Although they detected some changes, they were unable to determine the origin of the formation, admitting to their limitations.
"What about the other Fellow Daoists? Can anyone ascertain the origins of this formation?" Wan Tianren looked towards the other Nascent Soul cultivators.
The people present looked at each other, and no one spoke.
"Divine Envoy Yuan, you are proficient in formations, can you recognize this formation?" Wan Tianren looked towards Yuan Ming.
"I have no clues for the moment," Yuan Ming shook his head.
"This battle is a decisive clash between the East Sea Alliance and the Wu Yue Sect. We cannot afford to be even slightly negligent. Since we cannot discern the nature of this formation, let us observe it for a while, and only attack after we have ascertained its details," Wan Tianren said slowly, frowning.
"Alliance Leader Wan seems too cautious. Our allied forces are strong and well-prepared, and with Divine Envoy Yuan presiding, why fear a mere formation! I, Hou Chou, volunteer to be the vanguard and probe the reality of this formation," Hou Chou stepped forward, voluntarily asking to fight.
Upon hearing this, Wan Tianren looked at Yuan Ming.
"What Fellow Daoist Hou says is not without reason. Our decisive battle with the Wu Yue Sect is imminent. If we delay without advancing, it may affect morale. Let Fellow Daoist Hou lead a team to assault the formation, to scout it out. But do not venture too deeply to avoid falling into the enemy's trap and encountering danger, and pray for assistance from Lord Nether Moon God in a timely manner," Yuan Ming said after a brief contemplation.
"Rest assured, Divine Envoy Yuan," Hou Chou responded, leading dozens of cultivators, mostly from the Water Ape Clan, charging towards the green formation with the vanguard's stance.
"Alliance Leader Wan, with Fellow Daoist Hou making a move, this green formation will surely change. Perhaps you should send people to scout around and quickly gather information about this formation," Yuan Ming transmitted a message to remind Wan Tianren.
Wan Tianren nodded, ordering Old Man Hei Zhu, Shi Yanshi, and dozens of other cultivators proficient in formations, to fly to various parts of Fusang Island to investigate the formation.
Not only that, he also deployed personnel within a thousand miles nearby to prevent any sneak attacks.
Seeing Wan Tianren's orderly arrangements, Yuan Ming nodded secretly and shifted his gaze to Hou Chou and the others.
Hou Chou and the rest quickly charged into the range of the formation but did not approach further.
Taking the lead, Hou Chou raised his Double Halberds Magic Treasure, which expanded many times in the wind, and two rainbow-like streaks of golden light fiercely slashed at the green formation, emitting a piercing screech in the void.
The others also took action, bombarding the formation with various Magic Treasures.
In the midst of deafening sounds, the green formation unleashed wave-like glows, tearing open a large gap. Hou Chou seemed to hesitate slightly before continuing forward with his team, successfully penetrating the formation.
* is the home of this chapter
"Thought this formation was formidable, turns out it's nothing much, let's charge in!" Hou Chou sneered contemptuously as he rushed forward.
However, at that moment, countless green tree shadows suddenly appeared from nowhere, filling all the space in front, behind, left, and right, as if the group had entered a boundless forest.
Unfazed, Hou Chou's halberds emitted dazzling golden light, merging into a single golden war halberd, slashing open the tree shadows in front again, cleaving a pathway tens of yards long.
The other Water Ape cultivators followed closely, broadening the pathway significantly as they continued forward.
In the distance, the alliance's Core Formation and lower-level cultivators seeing this, many faces showed delight, uplifting their morale once again.
However, including Wan Tianren, all Nascent Soul cultivators frowned, seeing Hou Chou and others seemingly breaking through the formation while knowing that once they passed, the broken part of the formation and the shattered tree shadows rapidly reformed, fully restored within a few breaths.
It appeared everything was still under control; since they had to probe the formation, giving up now would be worse than not attempting at all.
Yuan Ming constantly used his first soul's Divine Sense sensing array, observing the situation more closely than others.
This green light formation was filled with numerous scattered Array Patterns, distinctly different from the continuous patterns of regular formations. What seemed like a breach by Hou Chou and others was merely a disruption of these loose patterns, like flotsam in water, merely scattered by the impact, which swiftly returned to normal once they moved on.
Determinedly charging forward, Hou Chou and his men quickly advanced several miles.
As they delved deeper, the situation gradually changed.
The further forward they went, the tougher the green light in the formation became, and the difficulty of breaking through the formation and its tree shadows increased, significantly slowing Hou Chou and his group's progress.
Moreover, invisible restraining forces seeped out from the surroundings, making Hou Chou and his group's movements increasingly difficult, as if entangled by robust ribbons.
Only then did the group realize the prowess of the green formation; though Hou Chou was arrogant, he was not foolish, and immediately ordered a retreat.
Meanwhile, Wan Tianren also commanded, planning to dispatch Hou Mo to lead a group of cultivators for reinforcement.
But the outer area of the green light formation, which was originally relatively easy to breach, had now become quite challenging, causing Hou Mo and his men to be momentarily stuck outside the formation.
Just at that moment, a sudden change occurred!
Near Hou Chou and others, a green shadow flashed past, and dozens of Wu Yue Sect Cultivators appeared out of thin air, their various magic treasures attacking like a storm.
The leader was none other than Li Wu, who shot a black bamboo whip from his hand, stabbing at Hou Chou's neck like a venomous snake.
Hou Chou swung his golden war axe. The cumbersome halberd was surprisingly agile in his hands, easily blocking the black bamboo whip before the halberd reversed, a rich golden light emerging from it.
Hou Chou's fingers moved rapidly, and the golden light suddenly condensed into a virtual image of a mountain tens of meters high, blocking the magic treasures of others as well.
"Don't love the battle, retreat with all your might, I'll cover the rear!" Hou Chou shouted loudly.
Li Wu and others immediately pursued. They were enveloped in a layer of green light, moving unhindered within the great array, seemingly unaffected by it.
Although Hou Chou and his companions retreated with all their might, their speed was not half what it usually was, and they had to break through the great array that had already closed behind them. They couldn't escape and were quickly overtaken, facing the prospect of severe injury.
"Lord Nether Moon God, my Water Ape Clan wishes to believe in you, please lend your aid!" Hou Chou recalled the portrait of the Nether Moon God and prayed in his heart.
Yuan Ming sensed Hou Chou's prayer, was slightly delighted, and immediately mobilized the first soul's massive soul power, casting the Dream Butterfly Illusion Technique.
Enhanced by the power of desire, the first soul's soul power reached the level of a half-step Spoken Witch. The green light formation could not stop it, and how could Li Wu and others resist? They instantly fell into an illusion, standing motionless on the spot.
The attacking magic treasures also stopped in mid-air, not falling any further.
Hou Chou was overjoyed and hurriedly led the Water Ape Clan and others to retreat frantically. After some turmoil, they quickly escaped the great array.
Yuan Ming did not withdraw his divine sense, carefully sensing Li Wu and the others, or to be precise, the layer of green light on them.
Regrettably, his expertise in formations was average and he could only discern that the green light contained some scattered array patterns similar to the green formation.
Yuan Ming shook his head and did not continue his investigation, controlling the first soul to increase the power of the Dream Butterfly Illusion Technique.
Aside from Li Wu, the sea of consciousness of the other Wu Yue Sect Cultivators trembled, their divine souls suddenly collapsing from within, their eyes becoming vacant, losing all signs of life.
Li Wu's divine soul also suffered heavy damage, blood flowing from his seven orifices, his face deathly pale.
However, he managed to break free from the Dream Butterfly Illusion Technique, his eyes regaining clarity.
He showed a look of indescribable terror, his body's green light surged, and his figure vanished in a flash.
Regret flashed in Yuan Ming's eyes as he controlled the first soul to withdraw his divine sense.
His soul power had greatly improved recently, and the Dream Butterfly Illusion Technique had risen along with it, vaguely nearing the trend of approaching the final level of Void Silence Realm.
The Illusion Dream Realm of the Dream Butterfly Illusion Technique can create an illusionary space that manipulates the flow of time. The Void Silence Realm goes a step further, allowing control over a person's life and death within the illusionary space, annihilating their divine soul.
Unfortunately, he was only close to reaching the Void Silence Realm, not yet there; he could only kill some individuals with weak soul power. He could only severely damage, but not kill, someone like Li Wu, a Nascent Soul being, with one blow.
"Xi Ying once said, the Wu Yue God could kill people with a word, which is somewhat similar to the Void Silence Realm..." Yuan Ming mused.
Old Man Hei Zhu and others had now reached various locations on Fusang Island, employing various methods to investigate the green formation.
However, the expressions of the group were unpleasant, indicating scarce findings.
Seeing this, Wan Tianren transmitted a message to have Old Man Hei Zhu and others return.
"Alliance Leader Wan, we are incapable of uncovering much useful information," Old Man Hei Zhu said regretfully.
"This formation is painstakingly arranged by the Wu Yue Sect, naturally it's not something that can be easily broken through, you need not take it to heart," Wan Tianren consoled.
Hearing this, Old Man Hei Zhu and the others felt better.
Yuan Ming communicated with Wan Tianren through divine sense, instructing Old Man Hei Zhu and others to record all findings about the green formation in a jade scroll to give to him, which he would present to the Lord Nether Moon God to seek advice on breaking it.
Upon hearing that the Lord Nether Moon God was willing to help, Wan Tianren was also overjoyed.
In his view, the Lord Nether Moon God was omnipotent; since He was willing to help, perhaps the green formation could be broken soon.
Old Man Hei Zhu and others quickly presented their findings, which Yuan Ming collected, nodded to Wan Tianren, summoned a small flying boat, and leapt into it.
A huge silver spherical barrier appeared out of nowhere, enveloping the flying boat within.
Seeing this, several Nascent Soul Cultivators from the East Sea Alliance were startled, and some, bolder ones, quietly cast spells to probe, without exception, all were blocked by the silver barrier.
"Divine Envoy Yuan is seeking advice from Lord Nether Moon God on breaking the green array. There's no need for alarm. Spread the word, no one must disturb Divine Envoy Yuan," Wan Tianren immediately commanded.
Upon hearing this, those who had been restless, both publicly and privately, deemed Yuan Ming's actions to be for the benefit of the entire East Sea Alliance and naturally dared not make another move.

chapters.title: Chapter 659 - 631: The Method to Break Through
chapters.content:
"Members of the East Sea Alliance, heed my orders, divide our forces into ten groups, and launch assaults against the Great Array to buy time for Divine Envoy Yuan!" Wan Tianren commanded with a sweeping gesture.
Blocked by the green Great Array, the members of the East Sea Alliance were simmering with frustration. Upon hearing the command, they immediately split into ten groups and launched an attack on Fusang Island.
Inside Fusang Island, the Wu Yue Sect Cultivators also reacted by dividing their troops to meet the attack.
...
Simultaneously, Yuan Ming arrived at a hidden room inside the Flying Boat and once again cast a silver barrier to enter the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space.
Being a Nether Moon God not adept in formations, he could only seek advice from Xi Ying.
At this moment, Xi Ying was sitting cross-legged under the Five Elements Creation Tree, toying with the damaged Red Blood Sand Formation array equipment.
Around her lay hundreds of Jade Scrolls, offerings from the islands of the East Sea, which recorded various Forbidden Arrays.
However, these Jade Scrolls were all shattered.
"What happened here?" Yuan Ming asked, somewhat surprised.
"I have comprehended all the contents of the scrolls; therefore, there was no need to keep them," Xi Ying said, pausing her work and speaking indifferently.
"You've comprehended them all?" Yuan Ming was taken aback.
Cultivators have far superior memories than mortals, and Soul Cultivators specifically train their Divine Souls, making their memory even sharper than those of Magic Practitioners and Body Cultivators. Once they achieve the Illusion Witch realm, they can generally remember anything they see at a glance.
However, remembering the contents of the Jade Scrolls is one thing, and comprehending them is entirely another.
Formations are known for their complexity. Yuan Ming had examined those Jade Scrolls, and each recorded formation was incredibly subtle, each no less sophisticated than his Five Elements Illusion Destruction Array, with many being several times more intricate.
Even for an Array Master, comprehending just one of these would require a considerable amount of time and meticulous study, and Xi Ying had deduced them all in just a few days?
"I didn't realize you had such a talent. You never showed it before," Yuan Ming remarked, smiling.
"During this retreat, I perfected a Secret Technique that transformed my Divine Soul. While my Soul Power did not increase, my comprehension improved significantly," Xi Ying disclosed.
"There's such a Secret Technique?" Yuan Ming asked, his interest piqued.
"The Great Thousand World is full of wonders, and many Secret Techniques are beyond our imagination. However, this particular technique is extremely difficult to practice, and the first prerequisite is a pure Soul Power. You have absorbed too much Desire Power, scattering your Divine Soul Power, making you unsuitable for this technique," Xi Ying, sensing Yuan Ming's thoughts, explained.
Yuan Ming was only briefly intrigued and did not insist on learning the technique.
He shared with Xi Ying the situation outside and handed over the recorded Jade Scrolls along with his own insights into the Great Array.
Having reviewed all the Jade Scrolls, Xi Ying's expression showed a flash of realization.
"Have you discovered something?" Yuan Ming asked with a glint of excitement in his eyes.
"Yes, if I am not mistaken, the Great Array on Fusang Island is the Life Creation Array," Xi Ying confirmed.
"The Life Creation Array? What is special about it?" Yuan Ming inquired further, relieved that Xi Ying recognized the array.
"The Life Creation Array is a secret Formation from the Ancient Jiugong Sect. This Array is quite unusual as it has no offensive capabilities; all its transformations are utilized for defense and confinement," Xi Ying replied.
"Jiugong Sect..." Yuan Ming murmured, startled.
His Cold Moon Ring was said to be a treasure of the Jiugong Sect, and he had always thought the sect was renowned for its Frost Divine Ability, not realizing they were also experts in formations.
"A Great Array without offensive capabilities? Quite peculiar indeed," he commented, his eyebrows arching.
"In Ancient Times, the effects of formations were singular, divided into four categories: Confinement, Defense, Illusion, and Killing. Precisely because their effects were singular, their power was naturally enormous. The Life Creation Array belongs to the Confinement class and is said to be the Jiugong Sect's Sect Protection Array. It has an extraordinarily strong self-repair ability and lacks an Array Eye or similar elements, making it very difficult to destroy. Even if two or three Returning to Void Cultivators combined forces, they might not be able to break through," Xi Ying elaborated.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming's expression turned grave.
Indeed, as Xi Ying described, when Hou Chou and others previously breached the Great Array, if this Array truly possessed the power to withstand two or three Returning to Void Cultivators, then even if the entire East Sea Alliance's army were deployed, they likely wouldn't be able to break through.
"I don't believe in an unbreakable formation in this world. Since you're so familiar with the Life Creation Array, you must also know the Breaking Formation Technique, right?" Yuan Ming asked after a moment of silence.
"What you said is correct; there is no indestructible formation in this world, and the Life Creation Array is no exception. To break this array, one must start at its root," Xi Ying declared.
"What do you mean?" Yuan Ming pursued the topic, his spirit lifted.
"It is quite difficult to lay out the Life Creation Array; it requires a Wood Attribute Spiritual Vein, or an object containing powerful Wood attribute spiritual power, to provide the Wood attribute spiritual power. The more abundant the spiritual power, the stronger the Life Creation Array. From the situation on Fusang Island, it seems the Wu Yue Sect is using the Fusang Giant Tree as the provider of the Array's spiritual power. To break the Life Creation Array here, the Fusang Giant Tree must be addressed," Xi Ying stated with a slight smile.
"What exactly needs to be done?" Yuan Ming inquired.
"The Array Patterns of the Life Creation Array are scattered and elusive, difficult to destroy. However, the core of the array is not so – it is hidden inside the Fusang Giant Tree. Destroy the core Array Patterns there, and even if the Life Creation Array doesn't collapse immediately, its power will be greatly diminished," Xi Ying explained.
"If we could get close to the Fusang Giant Tree, we wouldn't need to worry so much..." Yuan Ming said with a wry smile.
The Life Creation Array enveloped a vast area. Even when inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod, boosted by Desire Power, his Divine Sense couldn't reach the Fusang Giant Tree, let alone destroy the Array Patterns within.
"Right!" Yuan Ming suddenly thought of a method, that was Black Incense Possession.
The buffer period for the Stealing Heaven Tripod had just passed half a day ago, he had previously planned to first understand the situation in Fusang City, then choose who to possess to probe the Wu Yue Sect's situation, which is why he hadn't used it yet.
Now it was just perfect, killing two birds with one stone.
"It seems you have already thought of a way to break the array, so I won't bother myself, this is the core array pattern of the Life Creation Array, take it and refer to it." Xi Ying took out a Jade Scroll and handed it over.
"Good, I will still need to borrow your Silver Kong Tree Demon for the task of breaking the array," Yuan Ming said after receiving the Jade Scroll.
Xi Ying seemed to guess something and took a silver Spiritual Beast Bag from her waist and handed it to Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming left the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space with the Spiritual Beast Bag.
Visit * (*) for more.
Xi Ying stood up from the ground, stretched her waist, and her graceful curves drew the soul.
"Trapped here for decades, it's finally over," she murmured to herself and made a gesture in front of her.
Broken strands of five-colored light appeared in the void, one end connected to her body, and the other end connected to the Five Elements Creation Tree, this was her connection with the Five Elements Creation Tree, now completely severed, marking the failure of her practice of the Ju Mang Spirit Technique.
Xi Ying felt no regret, this body was not hers, and she had never really expected the practice of the Ju Mang Spirit Technique to be successful this time.
It should be noted that she had another purpose in practicing the Ju Mang Spirit Technique this time and having already achieved it, she had more important things to do afterward.
After leaving the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space, Yuan Ming cast a spell to disperse the silver barrier surrounding the Flying Boat and used a voice transmission to instruct Wan Tianren to attack with all his might, claiming it was the command of the Nether Moon God.
Upon hearing this, Wan Tianren did not dare to delay and conveyed the message to the commanders of the ten divisions.
The offensive of the ten divisions of cultivators quickly shifted from feigned harassment to a full assault, like ten fierce dragons viciously biting at the Life Creation Array.
Although the Life Creation Array was powerful, the East Sea Alliance had gathered the majority of the force of the East Sea Immortal Cultivation World, and now with an all-out effort, their power surpassed everyone's imagination, easily breaking into the deeper parts of the Great Array.
The previously steadfast Life Creation Array began to shake, like a large tree swaying in strong wind, pieces of green spirit light were brutally torn off, drifting in mid-air.
Inside Fusang City.
Ni Mu was shocked to see this scene and hastily dispatched the remaining cultivators within the city.
...
On the Flying Boat, Yuan Ming looked at the shaking Life Creation Array and nodded in satisfaction, then waved his sleeve.
A silver shadow flashed in the void in front of him, and the figure of Silver Kong appeared out of nowhere.
Having been locked in the Spiritual Beast Bag for a while, Silver Kong was desperately eager for freedom, and now he was excited at the chance to stretch his limbs.
"Your task is to take Hua Zhi and infiltrate Fusang Island, can you do it?" Yuan Ming handed the Spiritual Beast Bag containing Hua Zhi to Silver Kong and asked.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, rest assured, just leave it to me," Silver Kong looked at the shaking Life Creation Array, said confidently, slapping his chest.
After saying that, he turned into a streak of silver light and rushed towards Fusang Island, quickly arriving near the Life Creation Array.
Yuan Ming was very interested in how Silver Kong would infiltrate the Life Creation Array, his Divine Sense spread out to observe.
A flash of silver light covered the body of the Silver Kong Tree Demon as he entered the void, sneaking into the interior of the array.
"Could this be the Space Escape Technique?" Yuan Ming was somewhat moved.
He was right, this was indeed another ability of Silver Kong besides "Space Folding", the Space Escape Technique.
Like the Five Elements Escape Technique and Thunder Escape Technique, the Space Escape Technique was a technique that utilized the power of space and could only be executed by beings like Silver Kong, who carried the bloodline of space.
The Space Escape Technique was profound and complex, at its highest level, one could merge with the void, freely enter and exit any secret space, traverse spatial turbulence, and cover thousands of miles in an instant.
Silver Kong's Space Escape Technique was naturally not at such a high level; he merely utilized his bloodline power to barely master it.
Upon entering the range of the green array, a force of prohibition exuded from the space, hindering Silver Kong's escape.
"This array can actually combine with the power of space!" Silver Kong's heart sank as he realized the task Yuan Ming had given him was not simple.
However, Silver Kong did not back down; instead, his eyes shone with excitement.
Having spent time in the Spiritual Beast Bag doing nothing but eating and sleeping, he felt as if his bones were rusting out, and a challenge would be interesting.
Silver Kong pushed the Space Escape Technique to its limit in an attempt to break through the barrier of the prohibitive power, diving deeper into the array.
Watching Silver Kong infiltrate the Life Creation Array, Yuan Ming once again formed several silver barriers with the Silver Token, then with a flip of his hand, he summoned the Stealing Heaven Tripod and took out a stick of Black Incense.
The Black Incense he used did not have the Green Phoenix Pine added in, unsure of what effect it would have; to be safe, he used the previous Black Incense.
The duration of possession from Black Incense was not long, but if used properly, there was a good chance it could sabotage the Life Creation Array.

chapters.title: Chapter 660 - 632 Stealth
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming took a deep breath, lit the Black Incense, and the image of the White Bone Venerable appeared in his mind, his consciousness quickly sinking into darkness.
When he regained consciousness, he found himself possessing the body of a woman in white, whose arms were devoid of flesh and were instead bone hands – it was indeed the White Bone Venerable.
The consciousness of the White Bone Venerable was silent, and the control of the body had fallen into Yuan Ming's hands.
"Black Incense Possession is indeed powerful, even existences as strong as the White Bone Venerable cannot escape it," Yuan Ming rejoiced secretly.
He had previously engaged in a void battle with the White Bone Venerable on Evergreen Island, where the latter had forbidden enchantments within his Divine Soul, unaffected by the Nightmare Divine Ability. He had worried that the Black Incense wouldn't be able to possess the White Bone Venerable, but now it seemed his worries were unfounded.
He examined the Divine Soul of the White Bone Venerable and soon made out the situation within. The Divine Soul was filled inside and out with a strange blue glow, and numerous tiny blue runes were densely scattered throughout the Divine Soul of the White Bone Venerable.
"Are these the Soul Descent Runes?" Yuan Ming recognized these runes; they were quite similar to the Soul Descent Runes, but not exactly the same.
Pressed for time, he didn't continue to study them and instead looked around.
This place was a black stone chamber, where the White Bone Venerable was currently sitting cross-legged in front of an Artifact Refining Furnace. The furnace, several zhang high and completely white like bone, struck a material that seemed to be bone and shaped like a meditating giant.
The ground and walls of the stone chamber were inscribed with numerous Flame Runes, and the surrounding walls were adorned with more than a dozen dragon head reliefs – it was indeed an Artifact Refining Room.
Those Flame Runes were quite strange, pitch-black in color. The dragon head reliefs were currently wide open, spewing streams of pure Yin black fire into the Artifact Refining Furnace, emitting bursts of intense coldness.
Suspended within the white Artifact Refining Furnace was a long white banner, slowly rolling under the broiling of the black flames.
"Now that the East Sea Alliance's army is invading, instead of directing and commanding outside, the White Bone Venerable is actually refining a Magic Treasure?" Yuan Ming frowned slightly, puzzled.
He took a closer look at the bone white banner within the furnace, and his pupils shrank.
The bone white banner was somewhat damaged, and traces of repair were clearly visible, but that was of no consequence; what was shocking was that it contained twenty-four runes within, eight more than the Palm Leaf Fan and the Exterminating Immortal Sword.
After Yuan Ming had broken through to the Nascent Soul Stage, he had completely consecrated the Shura Blood Devouring Map once again, only to discover that it contained just eighteen runes, which were far inferior to the bone white banner before him.
He wasn't sure how the ranks of Spiritual Treasures were distinguished, but judging from the number of runes, the bone white banner was clearly superior to the Shura Blood Devouring Map.
Even though the Bone Banner was inside the Artifact Refining Furnace, it still emitted a supremely powerful aura, yet very unstable, indicating that it hadn't been fully consecrated yet.
Yuan Ming hesitated for a moment before casting a spell.
The twenty-four skull-shaped runes inside the bone white banner began to move, as if opening their mouths to snap together, creating a creepy "click-click" noise.
A bizarre and vicious immense aura burst forth from the bone white banner, instantly filling the entire stone chamber.
The White Bone Venerable's body trembled, as if at any moment the bones might leave her body and enter the bone white banner.
Yuan Ming was startled and quickly dispersed the spell he was casting, controlling the White Bone Venerable to move away from the Artifact Refining Furnace while circulating his Mana to suppress the turmoil within his body.
A stream of Mana, several times more vigorous than his own, traveled throughout the body, attempting to suppress the movement of the bones.
The mana of the White Bone Venerable was not only abundantly robust but also of a very peculiar nature. It emitted a white bone-colored light, as if it were the product of melted bones. As the Mana circulated, the whole skeleton pulsed in rhythm, effectively suppressing the agitation of the bones.
Yuan Ming had only cast a single spell, and now that he promptly retracted his Mana, the outburst of aura from the bone white banner rapidly dissipated, and soon returned to calm.
Wiping the sweat off his forehead, he cursed himself for being overly curious; what he needed to do now was to leave quickly, to break the Life Creation Array.
Yuan Ming turned and walked towards the exit, but after just a few steps, he stopped again, turned around, and cast another spell.
This spell wasn't targeted at the bone white banner, but at the Artifact Refining Furnace instead.
The lid of the white Artifact Refining Furnace opened with a "puff" sound, the bone white banner flew out, and directly collided with the Yin Fire spewing out from the dragon head sculptures.
Boom!
Dazzling black and white lights collided within the stone chamber, causing an intense impact.
Yuan Ming grinned, the bone white banner was impressive, with the White Bone Venerable even neglecting the Wu Yue Sect's army to refine a treasure, proving the banner's importance. How could he not create some trouble for it?
He pulled open the doors of the stone chamber and stepped outside.
The burly man with thick eyebrows and the woman in the red robe were still guarding outside. Seeing the White Bone Venerable suddenly emerge and hearing the loud noise from inside the stone chamber, expressions of surprise appeared on their otherwise wooden faces.
"Lord Venerable, is there a problem with the treasure refining?" asked the burly man with thick eyebrows.
"A small issue arose; I need to fetch some spiritual materials to handle it. Guard the door, and do not let anyone enter the stone chamber," Yuan Ming said gravely, closing the doors of the stone chamber behind him.
The burly man and the woman in red hurriedly responded, continuing to stand on the left and right sides of the stone gate like two wooden posts.
"These two, they do not seem to be alive…"
Yuan Ming glanced at the two of them but did not pay any attention and flew upward.
As he soared upward, he activated his Divine Sense and inserted it into the Storage Bracelet on his wrist to inspect the White Bone Venerable's Magic Treasure.
He didn't know what he would encounter next, so he needed to prepare in advance.
The White Bone Venerable's mana was incredibly profound, and although the Cultivation Technique and secret skills he practiced didn't quite match Yuan Ming's, his tunneling speed was extremely fast, and in the blink of an eye, he reached the ground.
A stone gate sealed the end of the passage, and Yuan Ming circulated his mana, casting the Void Transformation Technique.
The White Bone Venerable's mana and the Void Transformation Technique unexpectedly harmonized, instantly transforming into a Spiritual Body phantom, even more ethereal than when Yuan Ming himself cast it, and it penetrated the stone wall to arrive in the outer hall.
Yuan Ming had once carefully explored Fusang City and remembered this place, located in the Crow Head District, not far from the Fusang Giant Tree.
He was about to sneak towards the Fusang Giant Tree, but after a moment of thought, he canceled the Void Transformation Technique, shot into the sky, and headed straight for the Fusang Giant Tree.
The Void Transformation Technique came from the Wu Yue Sect, and they would certainly have countermeasures. Now possessing the White Bone Venerable, if he were discovered sneaking around stealthily, it would raise suspicion; openly going there instead might be better.
The Wu Yue Sect Cultivators were scattered, confronting the East Sea Alliance's grand army, and with not a soul in Fusang City, Yuan Ming almost faced no obstacles and arrived near the Fusang Giant Tree.
However, the Fusang Giant Tree was shrouded in a layer of yellow thick fog that reached the sky, looking like some sort of Array.
Yuan Ming narrowed his eyes: An Array in this place?
Black Incense Possession could not Soul Search the possessed person, so he had no way of knowing the origin of the Yellow Fog Array.
With time pressing and no time for further thought, Yuan Ming grabbed with one hand, and a two-foot long White Bone Knife appeared in his palm, looking like yet another formidable Magic Treasure, and he prepared to strike at the Yellow Fog Array.
Just then, two figures flew out from within the yellow fog, both Nascent Soul cultivators.
"Lord Venerable White Bone, why have you come here?"
Yuan Ming's eyes flickered slightly; he recognized both of them.
One was the Qiong Hai Island Master, and the voice that had just spoken belonged to him.
The other was that stunning female cultivator who had been beside Ni Mu; her Nascent Soul Stage aura was still unstable, indicating that she must have recently broken through.
"The Qiong Hai Island Master is here too! This man is indeed colluding with Ni Mu," Yuan Ming thought to himself and halted his Bone Knife.
The Yellow Fog Array was being guarded by these two, yet that was not without a solution.
"Since when do I need your permission to go somewhere? Disperse the Array; I have urgent matters to attend to!" said "Venerable White Bone" indifferently.
Upon hearing this, the Qiong Hai Island Master showed a look of difficulty.
The Yellow Fog Array had been arranged by Ni Mu, who, although relying on the Life Creation Array for defense, had made such preparations just in case, to prevent the East Sea Alliance's spies from infiltrating Fusang Island and sabotaging the core Array Patterns within the Fusang Giant Tree.
Ni Mu had given the two cultivators strict orders that until the battle was over, no one should be allowed anywhere near the Fusang Giant Tree.
"May I ask what matters Lord Venerable White Bone has? Both of us have been commanded by Lord Heavenly Puppet Venerable to guard this Array, to prevent anyone from infiltrating," said the Qiong Hai Island Master as he brought his hands together in a salute.
"I am here by the command of the Wu Yue God to lead the East Sea battle, even Ni Mu must heed my orders, and you dare use him to pressure me? Move aside quickly. If you hinder a matter of great importance for this Venerable, your hundreds of deaths will not make amends!" Yuan Ming felt an urgency inside and immediately released the immense pressure of a Late-stage Nascent Soul Venerable, enveloping the Qiong Hai Island Master and the stunning female cultivator.
The Qiong Hai Island Master and the stunning female cultivator both turned pale, stumbling back several steps before barely managing to stabilize themselves, with the yellow fog behind them also roiling tumultuously.
Both the Qiong Hai Island Master and the stunning female cultivator felt an inner panic, secretly lamenting.Content sourced from * – *.
Indeed, the Wu Yue Sect's affairs in the East Sea had been managed by Venerable White Bone, with Ni Mu also under his control. However, Ni Mu was also a Venerable of the Wu Yue Sect and had managed the East Sea for many years; the relationship between the two Venerables was quite delicate.
As far as the Qiong Hai Island Master knew, Venerable White Bone was aware of the existence of the Yellow Fog Array. Now, with this sudden forceful intrusion, could it be an attempt to suppress Ni Mu's faction?
"Very well, it seems you really do not take this Venerable seriously!" Yuan Ming saw that the two remained unmoved and, feeling desperate, couldn't help but contemplate murder. He considered killing the two outright and entering the Array with the Array Flags on their bodies.
The Qiong Hai Island Master and the stunning female cultivator sensed Venerable White Bone's murderous intent, their faces drastically changing as they hurriedly stepped back.
"Hehe, Venerable White Bone, what has angered you so?" A beam of Golden Light shot from a distance, revealing the figure of Ni Mu.
Yuan Ming cursed his bad luck internally and reining in his murderous intent said, "Ni Mu, your subordinates dare to block my path!"
"Subordinates are ignorant; please forgive them, Venerable White Bone! But why have you left seclusion? Has the Ghostly Soul White Bone Banner been successfully refined yet?" Ni Mu said as he brought his hands together in a gesture of respect.
"Not yet, I just received word that a spy has infiltrated the city, attempting to tamper with the Array Patterns inside the fusang Giant Tree, conspiring from within and without to destroy the Life Creation Array, so I came to check the condition of the Great Array!" Yuan Ming spoke solemnly.
"Oh, there is such a matter?" Ni Mu's brows furrowed.
To ensure the defense of Fusang Island, he had employed several Soul Cultivators, at the level of love witches or above, to thoroughly investigate all the Wu Yue Sect Cultivators inside and out several times, and he kept an eye on the island's situation at all moments, but he had not noticed any signs of traitors or spies.

chapters.title: Chapter 661 - 633 Possession Backlash
chapters.content:
"The news was passed on by a hidden stake I planted within the East Sea Alliance," the White Bone Venerable said. "The sudden strike of the East Sea Alliance's army was to coordinate with that traitor! Time is pressing; there's no time to explain in detail. We must first ensure the Life Creation Array is unharmed!" With that, he started moving forward.
Ni Mu's expression also grew solemn as he exchanged a meaningful look with the Qiong Hai Island Master and the gorgeous female cultivator.
Understanding his hint, the two took out several yellow Array Flags and activated them. The dense yellow fog dissipated, revealing the giant Fusang Tree within.
Yuan Ming was moved, quickly releasing his Divine Sense to explore inside the tree.
The Forbidden previously arranged on the giant tree of Fusang Island had been broken apart. His Divine Sense easily infiltrated it, quickly locating the core of the Array Patterns.
The Array Patterns of the Life Creation Array resembled a long, green dragon coiled at the heart of the Fusang Tree. Like a living creature, it greedily devoured the tree's Spiritual Power, generating countless scattered Array Patterns that merged into the Life Creation Array.
The White Bone Venerable swept up beside the colossal Fusang Tree and feigned a change of expression, "There indeed is a problem!"
While shouting fiercely, he slapped his palm onto the trunk. His robust mana surged in, surrounding one end of the green Array Patterns.
The Jade Scroll given to him by Xi Ying not only recorded the patterns of the Life Creation Array but also the methods to destroy them.
The head, middle, and tail of the green Array Patterns were its weaknesses. If he could completely destroy these three parts, the Life Creation Array would utterly collapse.
Hearing this, Ni Mu's face changed, and he hurriedly utilized his Divine Sense to probe as well.
Yuan Ming's wrist flicked, and a shadow-like white light mixed with mana shot into the giant Fusang Tree. It was the Bone Killing Sword of the White Bone Venerable, striking harshly on the tail of the green Array Patterns!
A cracking sound resonated; the tail of the green Array Patterns was cleanly severed.
The Life Creation Array covering the entire island shook violently; the green spiritual light within began to disperse.
"White Bone Venerable, what are you doing?" Ni Mu also sent his Divine Sense into the giant Fusang Tree. Sensing Yuan Ming's actions, he was both shocked and furious.
Yuan Ming ignored Ni Mu, the Bone Killing Sword turned into an ethereal white shadow, and in the blink of an eye, it reached the middle part of the green Array Patterns, slashing down fiercely again!Read ahead and get updates by visiting *.
"Stop!" Ni Mu roared in shock and anger. A huge Tongchen Puppet appeared behind him, its eyes emitting bright golden light like two Venus stars.
Two beams of golden light shot out, one penetrated the trunk of the Fusang Tree, aimed at the Bone Killing Sword, while the other targeted Yuan Ming himself.
Yuan Ming let out a cold laugh, striking at him now was already too late!
He grasped with both hands, and two white bone claw Magic Treasures shot out from his Storage Bracelet. With a bang, they burned with pale white flames, striking at Ni Mu himself.
With a loud "bang," the White Bone Venerable's chest was punctured with a bloody hole, his body sent flying backward.
Yuan Ming felt for a moment that it seemed his soul was about to be extracted from the White Bone Venerable and that he nearly couldn't control the body any longer.
Ni Mu too was caught by the bone claw Magic Treasure on the chest, opening several deep, bone-visible wounds, and he too flew backward.
The Life Creation Array shuddered violently again, the middle part of the green Array Patterns was sliced off, the green spiritual light becoming more chaotic and continuing to disperse.
...
At the same time, the originally dense green light had thinned by nearly half, and the defensive and restraining capabilities of the Array had also weakened substantially.
The many cultivators of the East Sea Alliance seeing this situation all revealed great joy.
"Protected by the Nether Moon God, the enemy is about to fail. Intensify the assault, let's break through at once!" Wan Tianren commanded, his thunderous voice echoing far and wide.
The Alliance's military offensive intensified, and troops swiftly penetrated within the Array.
Unlike the people of the East Sea Alliance, the cultivators of the Wu Yue Sect looked exceedingly dismal, trying hard to resist the advancing army of the East Sea Alliance.
"What's going on! Didn't Ni Mu say the Life Creation Array was infallible? Why is it about to fall apart so quickly?" Qing Ya's eyes rolled around, contemplating retreat.
Those who had surrendered to the Wu Yue sect had no loyalty at all. Some also began to harbor thoughts of retreat.
Briefly, silver light flashed in a part of the Life Creation Array, with Yinkong appearing, his face filled with joy.
The heavy damage to the Array greatly reduced the obstacles he faced.
He immediately employed his Divine Skills to merge into the void again, swiftly heading towards the Fusang Giant Tree.
At this moment, Yuan Ming, controlling the White Bone Venerable managed to stabilize his stance, disregarding the wound on his chest. He directed the Bone Killing Sword towards the upper area of the green Array Patterns, while the two white bone claws and the previously summoned White Bone Knife attacked Ni Mu simultaneously.
Ni Mu turned into a streak of golden light, sprinting out, and vanished into the Tongchen Puppet in the blink of an eye. The white bone claws and Bone Knife chopped onto the colossal Puppet.
"Clang, clang," several loud sounds resonated. The bone claws and Bone Knife were completely repelled, leaving only a few marks on the puppet.
The Tongchen Puppet's right palm reached out swiftly, like a phantom entering the Fusang Giant Tree without causing any damage to the bark.
At the same time, a golden shadow flashed near the Bone Killing Sword, a golden puppet hand appeared from nowhere, the same hand of the Tongchen Puppet, grabbing the Bone Killing Sword.
The Bone Killing Sword quickly turned golden and then was brutally crushed.
The Bone Killing Sword, being the White Bone Venerable's Lifebound Magical Treasure, now destroyed, caused extreme heart pain in White Bone Venerable. A torrent of retrograde blood surged out, and his mana became chaotic.
Yuan Ming felt almost on the verge of being pulled by some invisible force from the White Bone Venerable, and in his desperation, he circulated the Nine Elements Technique, forcibly suppressing the backfiring mana and Qi-Blood.
Yet at that moment, a ray of crystal light shot from the chest of the Tongchen Puppet, landing on him.
"Enlarge!"
Ni Mu's voice emanated from within the Tongchen Puppet.
Inside the White Bone Venerable, the mana became chaotic. His Qi-Blood surged violently, several times more intense than before; unable to bear it any longer, he spewed out a mouthful of fresh blood.
Yuan Ming was about to suppress the discomfort in his body when darkness suddenly engulfed his vision. When his sight returned, his consciousness had already returned to his own body.
He was momentarily startled, thinking that the time for possession was not yet up, but then he realized something.
It seemed that the repeated injuries to the White Bone Venerable's body had accelerated the time for his return to his own body.
He silently lamented that if he had moments more, he could have destroyed the last core of the Green Array Patterns and simultaneously eliminated both the White Bone Venerable and Ni Mu, ridding himself of two troubles.
However, having damaged the Life Creation Array to this extent was sufficient.
Yuan Ming stood up and was about to fly towards Fusang Island. Taking advantage of the critical injuries of both the White Bone Venerable and Ni Mu, he intended to completely obliterate the two when a sudden sharp pain erupted between his chest and abdomen.
He looked down in shock.
His upper body was covered in fresh blood, with a large hole torn through his chest, blood gushing out, severely damaging his internal organs.
"Someone has infiltrated the Flying Boat!" Yuan Ming's face instantly grew extremely solemn. Ignoring his injuries, he spread out his Divine Sense.
The Divine Sense of his first soul also descended, covering dozens of miles around.
However, neither his Divine Sense nor that of the first soul detected any signs of an intruder.
Yuan Ming frowned and reassessed his injuries, suddenly noticing something peculiar.
The wound on his chest, both in terms of position and severity, was almost exactly the same as the injury he had incurred while possessing the White Bone Venerable.
"Could it be that after I possess someone, the injuries on their body also reflect identically onto me? If so, it's somewhat similar to my Shared Life Divine Power," Yuan Ming thought, feeling fortunate.
Fortunately, he had not harbored any sinister thoughts about making the White Bone Venerable self-destruct, otherwise, he might have needlessly thrown his own life away.
With time pressing, he could not afford further thoughts. He took out a Healing Pill and swallowed it, simultaneously stimulating the Undying Tree within his Dantian.
Streams of Undying Tree Demon Power infused into Yuan Ming's body, rapidly healing his wounds.
Without waiting for his body to fully recover, Yuan Ming summoned Lei Yu. Together, they transformed into a bolt of Lei Guang, heading straight for Fusang Island.
...
On Fusang Island, as Yuan Ming's consciousness departed, the White Bone Venerable also regained consciousness.
"What happened? Why am I here?" The White Bone Venerable, seeing his surroundings, was shocked.
Ni Mu, unaware that the White Bone Venerable's consciousness had returned, controlled the Tongchen Puppet to attack, its eyes shooting out two deadly beams of golden light.
The Qiong Hai Island Master and the stunning female cultivator also flew over. The Island Master brought out a yellow seal while the female cultivator exhaled a purple mist dragon, both attacking the White Bone Venerable from either side.
"Ni Mu, what are you trying to do?" the White Bone Venerable yelled in shock and anger, retreating as his bony hands emitted a white glow, enlarging several times instantly, grappling left and right.
"Bang, bang," several loud noises sounded. The golden light from the Tongchen Puppet and the purple mist dragon were torn apart, and the yellow seal was knocked away, visibly scratched.
"White Bone, you destroyed the life-creating array patterns and committed treasonous betrayal, yet you have the audacity to question us!" Ni Mu's indifferent voice emanated from the Tongchen Puppet.
"What! I destroyed the Life Creation Array patterns? Impossible!" The White Bone Venerable's eyes widened.
"Many have witnessed this matter; why would I, Ni Mu, wrong you? Surrender peacefully, and perhaps the Wu Yue God will spare your life!" Ni Mu's cold voice warned, as a giant puppet palm descended from the sky, slamming fiercely downwards.
The White Bone Venerable's mind was in turmoil, but facing the attack from the Tongchen Puppet, he attempted to summon the Bone Killing Sword to counter it, only to realize that the sword had been destroyed.
He once again swiftly retreated.
The giant palm of the puppet smashed to the ground, creating a thunderous noise as smoke and debris sprayed everywhere, causing the ground within several hundred yards to collapse, forming a huge crater.
Seeing the incredible destructive power of the Tongchen Puppet, the White Bone Venerable's pupils constricted.
She knew Ni Mu possessed Venerable Puppets, but she had not expected their power to be so astonishing, almost exceeding the bounds of the Nascent Soul Stage.
Without waiting for her to speak, the Tongchen Puppet charged forward with large strides.
At the same time, a beam of Golden Light spread rapidly from beneath the feet of the Tongchen Puppet, turning the ground it passed over into gold sand and gold blocks.
The Tongchen Puppet's body glimmered with gold Spiritual Patterns, and the gold sand and gold blocks lifted off the ground, seemingly controlled by an invisible force, forming several golden Long Dragons, swooping towards the White Bone Venerable.
The White Bone Venerable, now calm, no longer tried to defend her actions. She spat out a Bone Cage, the same magical treasure that had once obliterated Fusang Island.
With swift hand seals, the white Bone Cage expanded with the wind, instantly transforming into a massive white cage of a hundred yards, enveloping herself within.
The golden Long Dragons struck the white Bone Cage, all repelled, and even the gravel failed to enter through the gaps of the cage.
The Tongchen Puppet lunged forward, its massive body slamming fiercely against the Bone Cage, creating a loud "boom." Both were shaken back, but it was an even match.

chapters.title: Chapter 662 - 634 Defeat
chapters.content:
While Ni Mu and the White Bone Venerable were fiercely clashing, a flash of silver light passed over the top of the Fusang Giant Tree, revealing the figure of Yinkong, who landed on a thick trunk.
He slapped the Spiritual Beast Bag at his waist, and Hua Zhi flew out, landing on the Fusang Giant Tree.
Hua Zhi looked down at the giant tree below her, her face filled with greed.
"Ah, I finally have the chance to get close to you!"
Having just arrived at the East Sea and learning about the existence of the Fusang Divine Tree on Fusang Island, she had wanted to devour this Heaven and Earth Spiritual Seed, but unfortunately never had the chance until now.
"How you choose to devour the Fusang Giant Tree is up to you, just don't forget Yuan Ming's instructions," Yinkong said.
Hua Zhi's expression became serious, and she nodded silently.
Though Yinkong and Hua Zhi had not deliberately erupted their aura, and had even concealed their demon energy, the highly perceptive Ni Mu and the White Bone Venerable below immediately noticed the disturbance atop the Fusang Giant Tree.
Feeling the cultivation of the two people below, Hua Zhi's complexion changed slightly, and she immediately transformed into a purple shadow and penetrated the Fusang Giant Tree.
Her regenerative ability was extremely strong, and she could also split her body. Merging with the Fusang Giant Tree, she did not fear anyone, as long as she didn't face a monster like Yuan Ming who possessed powerful, wide-ranging illusion techniques.
Yinkong wasn't idle either; his figure flickered as he also entered the Fusang Giant Tree, heading straight for the green Array Patterns at the core of the tree.
With two Nascent Soul Stage enemies appearing and heading straight for the Array Patterns of the Life Creation Array, Ni Mu could no longer concentrate on attacking the White Bone Venerable. The huge palm of the Tongchen Puppet once again turned into a phantom shadow, entering the Fusang Giant Tree to grab at the Yinkong Tree Demon.
The Yinkong Tree Demon, having had a previous encounter with Ni Mu's Tongchen Puppet, did not dare to let it get close and swiftly dodged to the side.
The White Bone Venerable didn't take the opportunity to attack Ni Mu, but instead activated her Divine Sense to scan her surroundings while trying hard to figure out what had just happened and why she had inexplicably appeared outside.
At that moment, a silver thunderbolt appeared in the distant sky, tearing through the already thin green light of the Life Creation Array, and in the blink of an eye arrived nearby.
A resounding peal of thunder echoed through the air, revealing Lei Yu's massive figure out of thin air.
Yuan Ming stood on the back of Lei Yu, looking down below.
Seeing Ni Mu and the White Bone Venerable below, as well as the surrounding ravaged landscape, he immediately guessed what had happened just now.
"Haha, Fellow Daoist Bai Gu is indeed a man of his word, having destroyed most of the Array Patterns. Rest assured, I will report your merits to Lord Nether Moon God and you will not be treated unfairly," Yuan Ming laughed loudly.
"Nether Moon God? It seems you are truly determined to betray the Wu Yue Sect!" Ni Mu's face darkened, he glanced at Yuan Ming, then looked towards the White Bone Venerable and snorted angrily.
"It's not what you think..." the White Bone Venerable quickly tried to explain.
Yuan Ming, of course, would not give them the chance to explain; he controlled his first soul to cast an illusion on Ni Mu, unleashing his Half-step Word Witch level Divine Power.
Inside the Tongchen Puppet, Ni Mu suddenly saw a blur in his vision, and the surrounding scenery drastically changed. Fusang Island disappeared without a trace, replaced by a boundless prairie with moist, warm winds blowing in his face.
"Illusion!" Ni Mu's face changed.
Seeing the Tongchen Puppet suddenly immobilized, the White Bone Venerable immediately guessed what had happened to Ni Mu.
As things had developed this far, the White Bone Venerable, although unwilling to admit it, could see that the dire situation before her eyes was most likely her own doing. With a powerful enemy at hand and Ni Mu in trouble, she had to act.
She flicked her fingers at the White Bone Knife next to her, which transformed into a white rainbow and slashed towards Yuan Ming and Lei Yu.
At the same time, the White Bone Venerable released a beam of azure light, aiming at the Tongchen Puppet to help it escape the illusion.
However, with a rumble of thunder, Lei Yu's massive body disappeared within a cluster of silver lightning, and in the next instant, ghost-like, appeared before the Tongchen Puppet.
A soul crow shot out from between Yuan Ming's eyebrows and collided with the azure light.
A "snap, crackle" sound was heard as the azure light released by the White Bone Venerable was shattered.
"Did you orchestrate all this? What trick did you use to bring me here and destroy the Life Creation Array Patterns?" the White Bone Venerable asked Yuan Ming.
Manipulating the White Bone Venerable had involved the Stealing Heaven Tripod; naturally, Yuan Ming would not respond to her.
Moreover, the White Bone Venerable had once made a move against his parents; Yuan Ming had nothing to say to her, only wishing to quickly end her life.
He waved his sleeve, and the God Bombarding Cone whistled out.
All Thunder Runes within the cone were activated, its body surging with thick thunderbolts, dragging a long tail of lightning, heading straight for the White Bone Venerable's chest.
Yuan Ming, having just possessed the White Bone Venerable, had already thoroughly understood her mana attributes, which inclined towards the yin attribute, making a thunder attack most effective.
The White Bone Venerable didn't expect Yuan Ming to strike so abruptly and hurriedly reached behind her head to slap her nape. A bone white bead spurted from her mouth, also appearing to be a bone-related Magic Treasure from its aura.
As soon as the Bone White Bead flew out, it grew several times larger in the wind and collided head-on with the God Bombarding Cone.
A sound of an explosion echoed, and the supposedly indestructible God Bombarding Cone was actually blocked by the Bone White Orb. The intense clash of bone white and purple lightning engulfed both artefacts, with only brief glimpses of the Bone White Orb sprouting numerous white bone chains, attempting to lock down the God Bombarding Cone.
On the God Bombarding Cone, thick arcs of electricity rapidly arose, shattering the white bone chains. The two Magic Treasures were locked in a stalemate.
Yuan Ming was unfazed and made a defining gesture.
A thick bolt of thunder shot out from his sleeve and struck the Thunder God Hammer, which hit the God Bombarding Cone with force.
As the hammer collided with the cone, the God Bombarding Cone's blinding electric arcs intensified dramatically, and with a "crack," the Bone White Orb was shattered.
The God Bombarding Cone surged forward in a flash, arriving in front of the White Bone Venerable instantaneously.
The White Bone Venerable was taken aback and hastily tapped the Bone Cage. The cage swiftly shrank to just about cover her body.
The God Bombarding Cone slammed into the Bone Cage, emitting an earth-shattering boom.
The Bone Cage was left with a deep indentation, spiderweb cracks sprouting around it, and along with the inside White Bone Venerable, was sent flying, crashing heavily onto the ground.
Yuan Ming did not pursue the White Bone Venerable, but instead waved his sleeve toward the Fusang Giant Tree.
A black longsword flew from his grasp, none other than the Soul Destroying Sword, which disappeared in a flash and shot towards a certain part of the giant tree.
The Soul Destroying Sword transformed into a black shadow and merged with the tree, swiftly reaching the core of the tree.
Entwined around the tree's core was a mass of green Array Patterns, the last essential area of the Life Creation Array.
The roaring sound of the Soul Destroying Sword thundered as it fiercely chopped the green Array Patterns into two clean pieces.
No sooner had the Soul Destroying Sword been seized than Yinkong and Hua Zhi teleported over. First seen on *.
"Master, didn't you say that we were the ones to destroy the last core of the Array Patterns? Why did you take matters into your own hands?" Hua Zhi grumbled unhappily.
"Time is of the essence, we cannot afford to delay. I have another task for you. Hua Zhi, you take care of those two Nascent Soul Early Stage Cultivators below, and Yinkong, head to the Crow Head District of Fusang City. Stay nearby and don't let anyone take the Spiritual Treasure from that secret chamber," Yuan Ming conveyed the location of the underground Stone Chamber to Yinkong.
"Understood," Hua Zhi responded, swooping towards the Qiong Hai Island Master and the glamorous female cultivator.
Yinkong nodded as well, vanishing into the void, heading straight for the location indicated by Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming's exchange with Hua Zhi and Yinkong was brief. As the last Array Patterns core was destroyed, the Life Creation Array began to collapse instantly, its green light disintegrating from within.
Seeing this, the cultivators of the East Sea Alliance cheered in unison, their shouts resounding for miles, greatly boosting their morale.
The army of the Wu Yue Sect turned pale with despair on their faces.
Qing Ya, who had already concealed his presence, retreated to the edge of the Wu Yue Sect's forces. As the Life Creation Array collapsed, he darted downward into the sea and frantically fled into the distance.
Others who were caught in two minds also scattered in a flurry, fleeing in all directions.
Despite their numbers, the East Sea Alliance's forces could not encircle the entire Fusang Island, and many managed to escape.
"Do not concern yourselves with those fleeing. All units concentrate your strength to annihilate the Wu Yue Sect followers! Any who wish to surrender will not be killed!" Wan Tianren excitedly ordered.
The Wu Yue Sect followers had not fallen into despair; placing their hopes in the White Bone Venerable and Tian Gui, they did not flee or surrender, instead, they gathered together to resist fiercely.
The White Bone Venerable saw the Life Creation Array broken, and her eyes almost burst with fury.
"You're courting death!" She roared, and the Bone Cage suddenly shone brightly, merging into her body.
Her body was suddenly covered in white flames, but emitted no heat, instead giving off an eerie chill.
With a soft 'bang,' the white flames dispersed, and the White Bone Venerable's form greatly changed, transforming into a white bone dragon, about seven to eight zhang long. Its bones seemed translucent as jade, seemingly indestructible, and its aura surged so markedly that it reached the pinnacle of the Late-stage Nascent Soul.
Yuan Ming's face showed surprise. The White Bone Venerable was not a human but a bone dragon transformed?
Amidst his thoughts, he once again spurred the Thunder God Hammer and the God Bombarding Cone, shooting out seven or eight thick bolts of silver thunder, viciously striking the bone dragon that the White Bone Venerable had transformed into.
With several 'bangs,' the bone dragon's body was blasted repeatedly, its translucent bone surfaces being hit but showing not even the slightest crack.
The white bone dragon let out a low growl, its white flames intensifying, warding off the incoming thunder as it twisted its body and, with a swoosh, turned into a white shadow darting towards Yuan Ming. In the blink of an eye, it traversed dozens of yards, reaching Yuan Ming.
The white bone dragon raised its front claws, aiming for Yuan Ming's head, apparently trying to catch him off guard and strike him dead with one blow.
Yuan Ming smiled faintly, casting a spell, and a shadow of a green sword shot out, emitting a terrifying Sword Qi fluctuation, none other than the Exterminating Immortal Sword.
At the same time, Lei Yu, on which Yuan Ming was standing, shone brightly with thunder, emitting arcs of electricity outward.
Just as the bone dragon's claws were about to strike, with a thunderous 'roar,' Yuan Ming and Lei Yu vanished, evading the white bone dragon's swipe.
The white bone dragon's gaze darkened, ready to pursue Yuan Ming, when suddenly a piercing screech resounded next to it. The Exterminating Immortal Sword was launching an attack from the side, striking with a vast green Sword Qi directly at the bone dragon's neck.
Boom!
The power of the Sword Qi blasted from the Exterminating Immortal Sword was several times stronger than before. It was the Sword Qi from the Abyss of Sword Traces within the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space, and it seemed as if even the void might be punctured.
The white bone dragon was shocked and desperately twisted its body to the side, but it could not fully evade the Sword Qi.
One of its front claws and half its body were hit by the Sword Qi of the Exterminating Immortal Sword, violently exploding into countless fragments.

chapters.title: Chapter 663 - 635: Ghostly Soul White Bone Banner
chapters.content:
The White Bone Dragon retreated a dozen yards in a flash, with white flames roiling over its form. The shattered parts of its body and its foreclaws were regenerating at a speed visible to the naked eye, and it seemed that it would be fully restored in just a moment longer.
In mid-air, a streak of lightning flashed by, revealing the form of a hawk, unmistakably Lei Yu. Accompanied by the rumbling sound of thunder, it disappeared within the electric light.
The next moment, Lei Yu's figure appeared above the White Bone Dragon, spreading its wings suddenly.
"Crackle and snap"
Bolts of thick Silver Thunder descended interweaving from the flapping of its wings, forming a terrifying net of thunderous electricity that enveloped the White Bone Dragon and struck it relentlessly.
The White Bone Dragon endured the slashing of the Silver Thunder with the white flames it raised around its body, not incurring further damage. However, its regeneration was impeded; its foreclaws had just started to grow back, and only a small part of its broken body had been restored.
After a flash of blood flame in its eyes, it seemed to have no desire to continue the fight. It transformed into a white shadow and darted away into the distance.
Just as Yuan Ming was about to pursue, he suddenly stopped and turned towards the stationary Tongchen Puppet.
"Leave Ni Mu to me," a voice suddenly came from within the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space—it was Xi Ying speaking.
"Leave him to you? What do you plan to do with him?" Yuan Ming asked in surprise.
"I've been here for decades; it's time to go out," Xi Ying said indifferently.
"Go out? Are you giving up on the Ju Mang Spirit Technique?" Yuan Ming asked with astonished expression.
"Indeed," Xi Ying replied.
Seeing Xi Ying calm and not acting impulsively, and knowing that the Five Elements Creation Tree grew extremely slowly and couldn't be much hastened even with a great quantity of spirit grass and spirit tree, Yuan Ming realized that giving up might not be a bad thing. It would take too long for Xi Ying to succeed with the Ju Mang Spirit Technique. With that thought, he didn't try to persuade her, but released Xi Ying with a thought.
Xi Ying raised the Soul Suppressing Kettle and began to chant while performing hand signs.
Billowing black clouds emerged from the Soul Suppressing Kettle and in no time engulfed hundreds of yards around, shrouding the Tongchen Puppet within.
The black clouds emitted intense Divine Soul fluctuations, seemingly the product of refined souls, and also served to block Divine Sense. Yuan Ming's own Divine Sense could not penetrate to see what was happening within.
T%h@is@ c*h.ap!te!r#'s! tru@e s^ou$r#ce$ is My V@i$rt*ua#l L&i-br%a$r-y Emp%i$re (M#|V!|%L^[email protected] &R).*
His eyebrows raised slightly, but he did not inquire further. Taking control of Lei Yu, he transformed into a streak of lightning and chased after the White Bone Dragon.
Although the White Bone Dragon was speedy in its escape, it was already seriously injured. Yuan Ming and Lei Yu possessed the Thunder Escape ability and within a few breaths of time, they caught up with it once again.
"Do you truly intend to fight to the death, sir? The power of our Wu Yue Sect is far beyond your imagination. Sir, please do not make a mistake!" The White Bone Dragon, gasping slightly, spoke human words.
"When you moved against my parents, you sealed our fates to a fight to the death. Meet your end!" Yuan Ming swung his arm, and the Exterminating Immortal Sword transformed into a Qing-colored Sword Shadow that was several dozen yards long and slashed down fiercely.
The White Bone Dragon let out a roar, and as the white flames around it surged wildly, its body suddenly enlarged, showing no sign of retreat. It opened its mouth, large as a palace, and viciously bit towards Yuan Ming and Lei Yu, clearly intending to fight Yuan Ming to the death.
Yuan Ming inwardly sighed at the White Bone Venerable's fearlessness in the face of death. He tilted back his arm, and with extreme agility, the Exterminating Immortal Sword struck the Bone Dragon's massive fangs.
With a "crack", a tooth of the Bone Dragon was severed by the Exterminating Immortal Sword. The blade of the sword deeply hacked into its skull, and after penetrating a short distance, it came to a halt.
The power of the Abyss Sword Energy had been used up in the Exterminating Immortal Sword, drastically reducing its ability to kill in a single blow as it had before.
The White Bone Dragon, seeing that Yuan Ming's move was artful and landed on its head, felt its soul almost flee its body, believing its end was certain. Now, it deemed itself lucky to be alive.
The Bone Dragon's skull shone brightly as hundreds of white bone chains shot out, revealing the same Divine Ability as the Bone White Orb before—entangling the Exterminating Immortal Sword and rendering it immobile.
"Without that Magic Treasure, let's see what you've got!" The White Bone Dragon laughed wildly as it swung its tail, a fierce blow that carved a white arc through the void, aiming harshly at Yuan Ming and Lei Yu with massive force.
Yuan Ming stamped hard beneath him, kicking Lei Yu downward and propelling himself upwards, evading the sweep of the dragon's tail but getting blown dozens of yards away by the wind it stirred up.
However, his arms were inscribed with dense Thunder and Lightning Spiritual Patterns, casting beams of lightning that faintly formed two thunderbolt wings.
With a thunderous crack, Yuan Ming's figure blurred and vanished, only to reappear atop the White Bone Dragon's back, using the Thunder Escape Divine Ability borrowed from Lei Yu's Golden Sunflower Beast Taming Technique.
His legs turned black as he took on the form of the Undying Tree, with numerous thick roots sprouting forth to wrap around the White Bone Dragon, almost binding it like a rice dumpling.
The White Bone Dragon now found itself in the same predicament as the Exterminating Immortal Sword, unable to move at all.
Some of the Undying Tree Roots took advantage of their ability to pierce through the void, bypassing the Bone Dragon's incredibly hard shell and penetrating its body to drain the Bone Venerable's Mana.
"What kind of devilry is this?" The White Bone Dragon, now truly enraged and panic-stricken, struggled with all its might.
Yet, the Undying Tree had grown to the peak of Level 4, just half a step away from Level 5, and its roots had undergone significant reinforcement. No matter how the White Bone Dragon struggled, there was no sign of them breaking.
Yuan Ming's arms also took on the form of the Undying Tree, reaching out more than a dozen yards to grasp the hilt of the Exterminating Immortal Sword, and he poured all his Mana into it.
The Exterminating Immortal Sword roared like a wild beast, emitting a Qing-colored Sword Energy over a dozen yards long, easily piercing through the White Bone Dragon's skull.
Grasping the sword's hilt, Yuan Ming pulled with all his might.
"Chi-la," a light sound echoed as the white bone dragon's head was cleaved in two, the larger half falling onto the ground.
The bone dragon's massive body also crashed to the ground, creating a thunderous noise.
Just at that moment, a blue light flashed from where the bone dragon's head had been severed, and a small azure figure shot out towards the distance at an electrifying speed. It was none other than the White Bone Venerable's Nascent Soul.
Yuan Ming had been prepared. He reached into the void with both hands, shooting out two thick silver arcs of electricity from his palms that spread out into a large silver net, enveloping the fleeing azure Nascent Soul.
But at this moment, a silhouette burst from the ground—it was the burly man with bushy eyebrows who had been guarding the entrance to the Artifact Refining Room. In his hands was a bone white long banner, the dreadful Magic Treasure from within the refining furnace.
The burly man with bushy eyebrows shook his arm, and a sword energy-like white light shot from the long banner, striking the thunder net.
Chi-la...
The silver net, as if made of paper, was torn apart effortlessly.
The White Bone Venerable's Nascent Soul escaped unobstructed, blending into the burly man's body without any resistance.
The burly man's body erupted with large swathes of white flames that swiftly spiraled around him, while "pop" and "crackle" sounds like that of popping beans came from within, his form rapidly changing.
"Is this... body seizing?"
Yuan Ming's expression shifted. Without hesitation, his hands flicked forward, sending over a dozen shadow-like black Sword Qi directly towards the burly man, unleashing the Soul Destroying Sword Energy.
At the same time, he opened his mouth and spat out a column of thunder and lightning energy, attacking the other.
The burly man's wooden expression broke into a grim smile as he moved his arm, placing the bone white long banner in front of him.
As soon as the Soul Destroying Sword Energy and the thunder column touched the white bone long banner, they disappeared without a trace.
The gushing white flames, like a whale swallowing water, receded back rapidly, and the burly man completed his transformation. His previously broad face narrowed into an oval shape, his skin turned paler, and his body became slender and graceful. In the blink of an eye, the coarse man had transformed into a tall and gorgeous woman, with a face about seventy to eighty percent similar to that of the previous White Bone Venerable.
The white bone long banner glowed with bone-white spirit light, and its twenty-four runes writhed relentlessly as an enormous, enigmatic aura burst forth.
Yuan Ming wanted to continue his assault, but everything had already ended, leaving him no choice but to stop.
A flash of silver light appeared by his side, revealing Silver Kong's figure. One of his arms was severed at the elbow, the wound ragged as if something had brutally bitten it off, and his body was injured in several places, appearing quite bedraggled.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, I apologize profusely. By the time I reached the place you mentioned, this fellow had already taken out this bone white long banner. I attempted to seize the treasure, but it was too powerful; I was no match for it," said the Silver Kong Tree Demon.
"This banner is likely a Spiritual Treasure. There's no need for concern, Fellow Daoist Yinkong. But as far as I know, there was another woman in the underground stone chamber. Where did she go?" Yuan Ming first consoled the tree demon, then inquired.
"That woman was directly devoured by this bone white long banner, and my arm was bitten off by it too. This treasure is truly bizarre. You must be extremely cautious, Fellow Daoist Yuan," warned the Silver Kong Tree Demon, still shaken by the ordeal.
Yuan Ming nodded slightly and gestured for the Silver Kong Tree Demon to stand aside.
The White Bone Venerable, reborn from fire, moved her body and looked up at Yuan Ming, a fierce smile appearing on her lips: "Your last chance to kill me was just now, unfortunately for you, it's gone!"
"Really? Whether you've seized that body or are simply possessing it, you dare to speak so boldly with only that tiny amount of mana in your Nascent Soul?" Yuan Ming sneered coldly, conjuring the Thunder God Hammer and the God Bombarding Cone and striking fiercely.
The God Bombarding Cone once again erupted with thunder and lightning, shooting out and transforming into a blurry black shadow, hurtling straight towards the White Bone Venerable.
The White Bone Venerable did not wait for the God Bombarding Cone to get closer; she immediately swung her right hand, sending out five crescent-shaped white beams to meet it.
Upon impact, the crescent white light was shattered by the power of thunder and lightning on the God Bombarding Cone, as fragile as if it had been struck.
Seeing this, the White Bone Venerable's face remained calm, but inside, she was secretly alarmed.
Her situation was indeed as Yuan Ming had speculated—her mana was sparse, and she was essentially an empty shell.
Still, she too had a chance to recover.
The White Bone Venerable formed a hand seal, and the bone white long banner grew several times larger in the wind, placing itself in front of her.
The dazzling thunder struck the white bone long banner, emitting a deafening thunderclap, incredibly imposing.
This time the bone banner did not absorb the thunder light but did succeed in blocking it completely, unable to advance even an inch.
"Insolent fool! Since you seek your own demise, let's see how you handle one of the Wu Yue Sect's three great Spiritual Banners, the Ghostly Soul White Bone Banner!" the White Bone Venerable channeled her scant mana into the bone banner, unleashing a strange fluctuation that enveloped half of Fusang Island and the nearby sea area.
Within the range of the strange fluctuation, the bones inside the bodies of cultivators and spirit beasts alike began to tremble as if they had come to life, trying to burrow out of their flesh.
