The closer they were to the Ghostly Soul White Bone Banner, the more intense the vibrations became.
Bang, bang, bang...
Several low-level cultivators from the East Sea Alliance and the Wu Yue Sect who were nearby blew apart, their blood-soaked bones flying toward the Ghostly Soul White Bone Banner.
In the sea, numerous demon beast carcasses hidden deep under the water and the skeletal remains of fish also started wriggling out, one after another heading towards Fusang Island.

chapters.title: Chapter 664 - 636: Great Victory
chapters.content:
At the bottom of the sea, demon beast skeletons, especially those of fish, were indeed plentiful. In the blink of an eye, all sorts of dense, assorted skeletons landed on Fusang Island, transforming the entire beach into a world of white bones as they rushed towards Fusang City.
Along the way, everything, whether trees or cities, was destroyed, leaving not a blade of grass.
The cultivators of the East Sea Alliance and Wu Yue Sect, who were still engaged in battle, were utterly shocked at this sight and hurriedly flew into the air to avoid it.
Yuan Ming, who was closest to the Ghostly Soul White Bone Banner, felt the bones in his body vibrating violently, as if they were about to break through his skin and exit his body. His mana also began to vibrate.
He quickly circulated the Nine Elements Technique and the Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill to suppress the anomaly in his body.
At that moment, the ground beneath Yuan Ming suddenly cracked open, and a section of the Bone White Long Banner shot out, rapidly wrapping around the Bone Dragon Corpse beneath him.
Ten zhang away, the White Bone Venerable had one end of the Ghostly Soul White Bone Banner burrowed underground. Taking advantage of Yuan Ming suppressing the anomaly in his body, she sneaked up unnoticed.
The White Bone Venerable cultivated a unique cultivation technique, storing most of her mana in the Bone Dragon Corpse. If she retrieved it, she could recover most of her mana and turn defeat into victory using the Ghostly Soul White Bone Banner.
However, just then, the massive Bone Dragon Corpse flickered and disappeared into thin air, and the Ghostly Soul White Bone Banner snapped at nothing.
"Heh, did you think I couldn't see the truth behind this Bone Dragon Corpse, letting you take it back so easily?" Yuan Ming scoffed mockingly.
Although an ordinary cultivator might not detect the mana within the Bone Dragon Corpse, the First Split Soul, empowered by the Stealing Heaven Tripod, spared no detail and had long seen through everything.
Moreover, having possessed the White Bone Venerable earlier, Yuan Ming had gained substantial insight into her mana characteristics, instantly recognizing the importance of the Bone Dragon Corpse and promptly storing it in the space of the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
The White Bone Venerable's expression changed, then twisted into a sinister smile. "In that case, swallowing you will achieve the same result!"
The Ghostly Soul White Bone Banner emerging from the ground grew longer in the wind, coiling around Yuan Ming's body like a viper flicking its tongue.
The vibrations in his bones intensified manifold, and neither the Nine Elements Technique nor the Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill could suppress them. His flesh was about to be torn apart and expelled from his body.
Yuan Ming was not panicked at all. He activated the Ju Mang Spirit Technique, and his skin swiftly darkened, his body rapidly grew taller, and he instantaneously transformed into a Tree Man, his flesh and bones turning wooden.
The Ghostly Soul White Bone Banner affected bodies of flesh but was ineffective against trees. The vibrations within him immediately lessened, and he quickly recovered.
He stretched out both hands, transforming them into two thick tree trunks that wrapped around the Ghostly Soul White Bone Banner, securely fixing it in place.
Yuan Ming executed this series of casts as swiftly as a hawk snatching a rabbit, completing them in the blink of an eye.
Only then did the White Bone Venerable react, her face drastically changing as she desperately tried to retract the Ghostly Soul White Bone Banner. But at that moment, a blood shadow flashed through the nearby void, and an old man with a ruddy nose suddenly appeared—it was Elder San Jue.
With a flick of his sleeve, two cyan Sword Qi shot out, slashing towards the body of the White Bone Venerable.
The White Bone Venerable was startled by the sudden appearance of this old man. After a sweep of her Divine Sense, she immediately realized his immeasurably deep Cultivation.
"A Returning Void presence!"
The White Bone Venerable was terrified and, disregarding the retrieval of the Ghostly Soul White Bone Banner, swept to the side in full force, narrowly dodging the lightning-like Sword Qi.
A thick scent of alcohol came from nowhere, causing the White Bone Venerable's body to go limp, her head dizzy as if she were drunk. Her remaining mana also chaotically surged out of her control, and she thudded to the ground.
The two cyan Sword Qi appeared above the White Bone Venerable, sweeping over her leisurely yet urgently.
With a soft "chi" sound, the White Bone Venerable's body was split from head to toe into two halves, and her Nascent Soul wasn't spared either—it was sliced into two parts and fell backwards.
With the White Bone Venerable's defeat, the Ghostly Soul White Bone Banner lost all its power and limply fell to the ground. The countless skeletons that had leaped from the sea also lost control, collapsing uniformly.
Near the Fusang Giant Tree, Hua Zhi and the Qiong Hai Island Master were engaged in a fierce battle with a dazzling female cultivator.
Hua Zhi faced two opponents. However, she had reached Level 4 Middle Stage, her Poisonous Divine Power was exquisite, her Spore Technique was extremely secretive, and her regenerative ability was astonishingly strong, firmly giving her the upper hand.
However, the Qiong Hai Island Master and the dazzling female cultivator were no pushovers. Although at a disadvantage, they maintained a tight defense without revealing much vulnerability.
Of course, the reason the three couldn't decide the outcome was more importantly because they were partially distracted by the battles involving Yuan Ming and the White Bone Venerable, as well as Xi Ying and Ni Mu.
Seeing the White Bone Venerable's downfall, the expressions of the Qiong Hai Island Master and the dazzling female cultivator drastically changed.
At that moment, not far away, the black mist enveloping the Tongchen Puppet abruptly burst, and Ni Mu's figure shot out.
His complexion was pale, indicating he was not lightly wounded, yet it wasn't to his core. His movement technique was still swift, reaching above the Qiong Hai Island Master and the dazzling female cultivator in an instant.
A Sword Qi-like Golden Light fell, aimed at Hua Zhi. It unfurled expansively, sweeping across all directions.
Hua Zhi was startled and swiftly dodged backward.
The direction of the Golden Light shifted, wrapping around the Qiong Hai Island Master and the dazzling female cultivator, shooting far away, reaching hundreds of zhang distant in the blink of an eye, then disappearing into the distant sky.
Just as Hua Zhi was about to give chase, Xi Ying flew out from the Black Mist, indifferently saying, "Let it be, Ni Mu's Divine Skills are formidable. Just the two of us can't hold him back, let him go."
Knowing Xi Ying's place in Yuan Ming's heart, Hua Zhi stopped in her tracks.The M|V|LE&MPYR team worked hard on this chapter.
...
Yuan Ming glanced in Ni Mu's direction, quickly withdrew his gaze, and looked toward the ground.
The Nascent Soul of the White Bone Venerable was severely damaged, the blue runes on it rapidly dissipating, seeming as if the restriction of possession were thoroughly broken.
The consciousness of the White Bone Venerable swiftly faded, on the verge of complete demise.
Yuan Ming flew over, raising his hand to emit a mixture of blue light and dark mist that enveloped the body and Nascent Soul of the White Bone Venerable; the dispersing consciousness immediately halted, but did not recover.
"The White Bone Venerable is dead, the Heavenly Puppet Venerable has fled! Followers of the Wu Yue Sect, surrender now!" Yuan Ming lifted the corpse of the White Bone Venerable into the air, and his booming voice echoed across the skies of Fusang Island.
As the news of the death and escape of the two Venerables spread, the fighting spirit of the Wu Yue Sect cultivators on Fusang Island swiftly declined. Even those who resisted were quickly overwhelmed and annihilated. The tide of the battle irrevocably tilted toward the side of the East Sea Alliance.
And when the last banner of the Wu Yue Sect fell and the flags of the East Sea Alliance blanketed every corner of Fusang Island, the cultivators of the East Sea Alliance simultaneously realized that the turmoil that had ravaged the entire East Sea had finally come to an end.
They cheered and congratulated each other, jointly savoring the fruits of victory, smiles almost overflowing on each person's face.
However, many noticed amidst the celebration, the buildings collapsed due to the war around them, like stark scars that would take a long time to heal.
The surviving Fusang Island cultivators felt both joy and sorrow at this moment.
Their once-familiar hometown, the streets, every grass and tree now lay devastated; companions who had once cultivated together now lay souls buried in the sea.
The war had ended, but the lingering pain still needed time to heal.
However, precisely because this victory was hard-earned, the cultivators of the East Sea Alliance were even more aware of who had changed the course of the battle, who had led them to victory, and who most deserved their gratitude—
Divine Envoy Yuan Ming, and the powerful deity behind him.
Up to this point, nearly every cultivator of the East Sea Alliance had become a "believer" of the Nether Moon God.
Belief is both costly and cheap. These naturally unruly cultivators perhaps never truly worshipped the Nether Moon God as a deity. "Belief" in the Nether Moon God sometimes stemmed from obedience to the East Sea Alliance's high command and policies, and partly from personal desires for blessings.
This type of belief was very superficial. Although, due to the large base, the quantity of Desire Power produced was quite significant, it still fell short compared to heartfelt, sincere belief.
But gratitude was different. Though it might fade with time, at the moment it arose, it was always fervent and genuine.
At this moment, Yuan Ming was basking in a sea of gratitude as vast as the ocean and in the immense Desire Power that it brought.
He hurriedly summoned all his Soul Power, operated the Heart Cleansing Technique, and refined the immense Desire Power. Both the first and second split souls, even the third that had merged into the Nascent Soul, were called upon.
Having continuously refined Desire Power for many years, his understanding of the Heart Cleansing Technique had become profoundly deep, and the speed of refining Desire Power was much faster than before.
The refined Desire Power flowed into his Sea of Consciousness like a cascading waterfall; Yuan Ming's Soul Power increased at an unbelievable rate and soon reached the pinnacle of the Mid-stage Sleep Witch.
The continuous influx of massive Desire Power kept pushing his Soul Power to progress.
In almost an instant, he broke through the barrier of the Mid-stage Sleep Witch and entered the Late Stage of Sleep Witch.
"It was only recently that I broke through the Mid-stage Sleep Witch, and now I have advanced to the Late Stage! Indeed, starting a sect and collecting Desire Power is the fastest cultivation method for a Soul Cultivator," Yuan Ming rejoiced upon seeing this.
At this rate, it wouldn't be long before he could attempt to reach the Word Witch Realm.
But at this moment, Yuan Ming suddenly felt a bout of dizziness, experiencing a surreal sensation of floating on clouds.
He hastily peered into his Sea of Consciousness, only to see his Divine Soul swollen like an overfed glutton, several times larger than before, paler in color, less solid than previously, and vaguely in disarray.
Yuan Ming was greatly alarmed and forcibly compelled his Divine Soul to stop absorbing Desire Power.
"What's going on? Didn't Xi Ying say that absorbing Desire Power would not affect the routine cultivation of a Soul Cultivator?" he said tensely, pondering over the issue of unstable Soul Power.
Meanwhile, Wan Tianren also flew over.
"Haha, Divine Envoy Yuan, this battle owes much to you; otherwise, not only Fusang Island but even..." Wan Tianren spoke unendingly, his face filled with irrepressible excitement and gratitude.
Thanks to this, Yuan Ming could clearly feel the immense and dense Desire Power from the other side flowing into him.
Normally, he might have felt excitement and desire, but for someone who had just overeaten, the last thing they wanted to see was more food. Yuan Ming felt just like that now.
"Alliance Leader Wan, let's hold off for now. I've suddenly gained some insight and need to go into seclusion for a while. I'll leave the rest to you," Yuan Ming interrupted Wan Tianren, and without waiting for a response, he flew toward the former seclusion site of the White Bone Venerable.
Seeing this, Xi Ying also immediately followed him, leaving Wan Tianren alone in mid-air, his brow furrowed in confusion.
"Fellow Daoist Wan, why are you standing there alone? Oh, where is Divine Envoy Yuan?" It wasn't long before Gu Xuanyang flew over, asking curiously.
"Oh, he's gone into seclusion. I was just thinking, you know, last time on Three Immortals Island when Divine Envoy Yuan and the Nether Moon God saved us, we at least had some treasures to show our gratitude. This time, liberating the East Sea and restoring Fusang Island, with such a great favor, how should we repay them?" Wan Tianren sighed, inquiring.
"That's indeed a problem. Now that the East Sea has much to recover, we really don't have any valuable treasures to offer... How about this? I noticed that Divine Envoy Yuan is enthusiastic about preaching. Why don't we hold a few days of celebration in his name? It would not only reward our soldiers but also announce to the entire East Sea the complete retreat of the Wu Yue Sect, uplifting people's spirits. At the same time, we could take the opportunity to promote the Nether Moon God and help Divine Envoy Yuan in his preaching, benefiting us in three ways," Gu Xuanyang suggested after some thought.
"Fellow Daoist Gu, your suggestion is excellent. You and a few other Daoists go and arrange it," Wan Tianren's eyes lit up, nodding in agreement.

chapters.title: Chapter 665 - 637: Searching for the Artifact Spirit
chapters.content:
Meanwhile, Yuan Ming had arrived at the White Bone Venerable's retreat. The Yin Fire spewing from the dragon head reliefs had been extinguished, most likely by the thick-browed man earlier.
The area was cold and damp, detrimental to Magic Practitioners but suitable for Soul Cultivators.
He had only had time for a brief exchange with Xi Ying, left Blood Shadow and Hong Ling to guard the entrance to the stone chamber, and then hurriedly began addressing the trouble in his Sea of Consciousness.
Xi Ying had mentioned that absorbing Desire Power was harmless and beneficial except when breaking through the Sleeping Witch barrier, but the current situation proved that her words had been too confident.
But who could have predicted Yuan Ming would obtain such a vast amount of Desire Power? Even within the Wu Yue Sect, perhaps only the revered Wu Yue God would encounter such a situation, so it was understandable that Xi Ying could not perceive the drawbacks of excessive Desire Power.
The Divine Soul is the foundation of a person; Yuan Ming's current situation was indeed quite dangerous. One misstep and he could have been overwhelmed by the excessive and chaotic Desire Power, scattering his Divine Soul to the point of becoming an ignorant fool.
Fortunately, he had discovered it in time and his Cultivation was robust enough to stabilize the situation. As long as he proceeded methodically, continuing to refine the already absorbed Desire Power through the Moonlight Technique, he should be able to resolve this issue.
As for the Desire Power that continued to flow ceaselessly, Yuan Ming allocated a portion of his consciousness to block it from his Divine Soul, allowing it to naturally return to the White Jade Lotus Platform.
Everything was proceeding in an orderly manner, and the Soul Power indeed began to ease.
He breathed a sigh of relief, continued the rotation of the Moonlight Technique, and took out a White Bone Ring, the storage magic tool belonging to the White Bone Venerable.
Consider, on the name of one of the Six Great Venerables of the Wu Yue Sect, it surely would not disappoint him.
Yuan Ming activated his Divine Sense to penetrate the ring and soon revealed a look of pleasure.
Indeed, the contents of the White Bone Ring were bountiful: there were over a million Spirit Stones, countless spiritual materials, and numerous High Grade Magic Treasures.
He had recently been urging the Yan sisters as well as Xu Che to fervently develop the Moon God Sect, attracting truly devout Believers, and the resources being poured in were mounting.
The Hundred Pills Square was just starting out with scant profits, and Yuan Ming was concerned that he would soon exhaust his resources, but the White Bone Venerable had delivered such abundance.
To him, the Wu Yue Sect was indeed like a timely Godsend. It had offered him a generous gift back at the Shura Palace, and now another great boon had come his way.
Yuan Ming took out the items from the Bone Ring and transferred them into his own storage magic tool.
However, he kept a few things for himself: three white Jade Bottles and a grey Bone Slab.
Yuan Ming opened a Jade Bottle containing snow-white pills emitting a fierce coldness; the other two bottles also had the same kind of pills.
He had found records of these pills in a Jade Scroll inside the White Bone Ring. The snow-white pills were called Snow Soul Pills, an elixir taken by Late-stage Nascent Soul Cultivators to improve their Cultivation.
Yuan Ming caressed the white Jade Bottle and after a moment, set it down.
His Soul Cultivation was progressing by leaps and bounds, and he had the Shura Blood Devouring Map to aid in Body Cultivation, so improvement would not be difficult. Magic Cultivation was the only area lagging.
Though his Spirit Root had been refined to rival a Heavenly Spirit Root through the Ju Mang Spirit Technique, Cultivation in the Nascent Soul Stage was slow. Even with a Heavenly Spirit Root, through mere meditation, advancing a minor realm would take at least a hundred years.
If it were peacetime, Yuan Ming could afford to wait. However, the Yunhuang Continent was currently teeming with turmoil, and he could not afford to Cultivate slowly; he had to rely on the power of elixirs, so these Snow Soul Pills arrived at just the right time.
The potency of the Snow Soul Pills was a bit too fierce for his current state, but luckily, he had the Undying Tree, his Lifebound Spirit Plant, which could completely neutralize it.
Yuan Ming put away the three bottles of pills and picked up the grey Bone Slab.
The Bone Slab detailed the Cultivation Technique practiced by the White Bone Venerable, called the Bone Emperor Technique. The higher the realm, the harder the bones would become, and the Practitioner's flesh would gradually recede, revealing white bones, just like the White Bone Venerable's arms.
When the Bone Emperor Technique reached the Returning to Void Realm, all flesh would vanish, completely transforming into an indestructible, Vajra-like skeleton.
Yuan Ming clicked his tongue in wonder at this bizarre technique; indeed, the world was full of marvels.
The Bone Emperor Technique had effects on Body Refinement, especially with innovative ideas for tempering bones and had many similarities with the Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill, valuable for reference and comprehension.
Moreover, the Bone Emperor Technique could hide Magic Power within the bones, which was another distinctive feature.
Yuan Ming closed his eyes to comprehend the Bone Emperor Technique, quickly mastering it, and then stored away the Bone Slab.
In truth, whether it be the Spirit Stones, the pills, or the Bone Emperor Technique, they were not what he was most concerned about.
He gestured, and a Bone White Long Banner appeared before him. This Ghostly Soul White Bone Banner was the greatest acquisition of the day.
Yuan Ming carefully examined the Ghostly Soul White Bone Banner, the tears in the banner's fabric had been repaired, and the twenty-four runes' energy flowed harmoniously, enhancing its power significantly compared to when it was inside the Artifact Refining Furnace.
He was somewhat speechless. Initially, when he opened the White Bone Artifact Refining Furnace, he had intended for the Bone Banner to clash with the Yin Fire inside the refining room, aiming to destroy it. Now, it seemed not only did his plan fail, but it also expedited the repair of the banner.
Fortunately, the Ghostly Soul White Bone Banner ended up in his possession.Readaheadandgetupdatesbyvisiting*.
After a slight hesitation, Yuan Ming began to consecrate the treasure, all the while ready to activate the Undying Tree within his Dantian, transforming into his Tree Man form.
However, the situation he had worried about did not arise. The Ghostly Soul White Bone Banner accepted his mana, and the twenty-four runes emitted a gentle glow, completely different from when it possessed the White Bone Venerable.
Yuan Ming couldn't be bothered to ponder why this was the case. He focused on sensing the Ghostly Soul White Bone Banner, as well as the twenty-four runes, and quickly understood the banner's condition.
The Ghostly Soul White Bone Banner was a Spiritual Treasure, with its material and runes both having reached the level of a Spiritual Treasure. The only thing it lacked was an Artifact Spirit.
Even so, the might of the Ghostly Soul White Bone Banner far surpassed the numerous imitated Spiritual Treasures in his possession, as well as the genuine Spiritual Treasure, the Shura Blood Devouring Map.
Compared to auxiliary treasures like the Shura Blood Devouring Map, the Ghostly Soul White Bone Banner was a pure slaughter weapon, with a very straightforward Divine Skill - Bone Control. It could manipulate an enemy's bones to cause internal damage or control the remains of those who had died long ago, harnessing their residual power for battle. In places abundant with remains, this treasure alone could easily form an army of skeletons.
Yuan Ming had seen the White Bone Venerable summon countless remains from the ocean using the Ghostly Soul White Bone Banner. If used well, this ability allowed a single person with a banner to rival a large army of cultivators.
He was very pleased with the Ghostly Soul White Bone Banner and examined it repeatedly.
"A mere slaying Spiritual Treasure, and it warrants such attention from the Fellow Daoist? The Shura Blood Devouring Map can control cultivators and extract their Essence Blood; its value far exceeds that of the Ghostly Soul White Bone Banner," Qi Ye's voice suddenly rang out.
"How come Fellow Daoist Qi Ye finds the time to appear?" Yuan Ming brought out the Shura Blood Devouring Map and said.
"Always lurking inside the Shura Blood Devouring Map is rather dull; I came out for some fresh air. Fellow Daoist is truly blessed with deep favor, having acquired another Spiritual Treasure," Qi Ye said.
"It's just luck," Yuan Ming responded. "Since Fellow Daoist Qi Ye is here, could you help me with something? I want to add an Artifact Spirit to this Ghostly Soul White Bone Banner, and I need Fellow Daoist Qi Ye's assistance."
"I've already told you about the risks and downsides; are you sure?" Qi Ye asked slowly, showing no surprise.
"Of course," Yuan Ming nodded without hesitation.
In recent times, Yuan Ming frequently chatted with Qi Ye, and they often discussed Spiritual Treasures.
From Qi Ye, Yuan Ming learned a lot about Spiritual Treasures. They are consecrated by cultivators Returning to Void, nurtured day and night with Magic Power Divine Soul, developing a spiritual nature, and their power far surpasses that of ordinary magic treasures.
As for the Artifact Spirits within Spiritual Treasures, most are cultivated over many years with Divine Souls by Returning to Void Cultivators. Such Artifact Spirits and Spiritual Treasures are perfectly matched and can unleash the treasures' maximum potential.
The effort required to consecrate a Spiritual Treasure is nothing like nurturing an ordinary magic treasure. It needs continuous infusion of Soul Power and Lifebound Essence Qi for an extended duration, leading to cultivators' cultivation becoming stagnant or even damaging their Dao Foundation and Divine Soul. Therefore, many Returning to Void Cultivators would at most refine one Spiritual Treasure and never dare to make a second.
To compensate for this shortcoming, the Returning to Void Cultivators in the Cultivation World dedicated themselves to research. They discovered they could capture powerful demon beasts, extract their souls, and refine them into the Spiritual Treasures as Artifact Spirits.
This approach had its pros and cons. If a suitable demon soul was found, it could double the Spiritual Treasure's power. If an incompatible demon soul was refined, it could instead greatly diminish the power of the Spiritual Treasure.
Moreover, refining a demon beast's soul into a Spiritual Treasure had an extremely low success rate, and few dared attempt it.
However, some time ago, during casual conversation, Qi Ye revealed to Yuan Ming that he had a method that could substantially increase the chance of transforming a demon soul into a Spiritual Treasure's Artifact Spirit, to about seventy to eighty percent.
The method was the Shura Blood Devouring Map.
The biggest issue in refining a demon soul into an Artifact Spirit was its wild nature and unwillingness to be refined. They would fiercely resist during the consecration, preferring to be shattered soul and spirit rather than compromise. This is what caused the low success rate. The Shura Blood Devouring Map, however, could erase the consciousness within a Blood Slave's Divine Soul.
Qi Ye suggested that they first refine the captured demon beast into a Blood Slave, erasing its conscious will. Then the oblivious demon soul could be refined into the Spiritual Treasure, significantly increasing the success rate.
However, a demon soul stripped of its consciousness was no longer complete, and such an Artifact Spirit would be much less powerful than a regular demon beast Artifact Spirit and greatly hinder the Spiritual Treasure's future enhancement.
"It doesn't matter. The Ghostly Soul White Bone Banner came to me out of sheer luck. If there are restrictions, so be it," Yuan Ming shook his head and said.
"In that case, I will first nurture the banner within the Shura Blood Devouring Map. Go and collect demon souls; remember, they cannot be too weak. You need at least a Level 4 Upper Stage demon beast soul. As for compatibility, the Ghostly Soul White Bone Banner is a yin-attributed bone Dao magic treasure, which is very much compatible with most demon souls," Qi Ye said, as a stream of blood light wrapped around the Ghostly Soul White Bone Banner, taking it into the Shura Blood Devouring Map.
Yuan Ming did not stop him, planning to deal with the Divine Soul issue before going to the outer sea to hunt demon beasts.
Demon beasts were numerous in the outer sea, and Level 4 Upper Stage ones should not be tough to find. If necessary, he could search in the Overseas World. With his current strength, he didn't need to worry too much about safety.
He took a deep breath and pointed to the ground.
A flash of green light passed, and the body of the White Bone Venerable appeared on the ground. This man had not yet fallen and held onto his last breath.

chapters.title: Chapter 666 - 638: Caught Off Guard
chapters.content:
The White Bone Venerable was one of the six great venerables of the Wuyue Sect and knew much. His Divine Soul's restrictions had already been removed, so naturally, he could not be allowed to just die.
Yuan Ming pressed his palm on the head of the White Bone Venerable, activated the Soul Searching Divine Ability, and quickly withdrew his hand, his expression turning grave.
The White Bone Venerable was now gravely injured and on the brink of death, his Divine Soul exceptionally weak. Moreover, having been split in two earlier and due to the collapse of the azure runes, much of his memory was destroyed.
However, the remaining memories still contained several crucial pieces of information, including why the White Bone Venerable and others gathered large numbers of cultivators' and even mortals' Divine Souls.
This matter was personally commanded by the Wuyue God, whose purpose for requiring so many Divine Souls was for recovery.
The last time the Wuyue Sect was overwhelmed and destroyed by the forces from all over the Yunhuang Continent, the Wuyue God suffered a near-fatal blow and had been sleeping for tens of thousands of years before gradually awakening. To this day, he had not fully recovered, which was why he needed a great number of souls for replenishment.
"So that's why the Wuyue Sect announced its return so long ago, yet it has only been making minor moves, never showing the Wuyue God himself. The reason is he has not fully awakened yet..." Yuan Ming murmured to himself.
Besides this astonishing news, he discovered another important piece of information: Ni Mu's entry into the Three Immortals Island was also dispatched by the Wuyue God.
Ni Mu's purpose, like Xi Ying's, was for the Undying Immortal Fruit. The Wuyue God planned to use the Undying Immortal Fruit to refine the Immortal Elixir to expedite his recovery process.
Moreover, according to the memories of the White Bone Venerable, Ni Mu had already obtained the Undying Immortal Fruit.
Yuan Ming furrowed his brows, considering whether to inform Chang Chun Temple and other high-ranking individuals across the regions of the Yunhuang Continent, to gather an army and strike at the Wuyue Sect while the Wuyue God was not yet fully awakened...
At that moment, the Shura Blood Devouring Map beside him suddenly started to tremble, emitting strands of chaotic Blood Light.
"What is happening? Oh no!" Qi Ye cried out in alarm, emerging from the form on the Shura Blood Devouring Map, his hands moving quickly in a spellcasting gesture, trying to stabilize something.
"What has happened?" Yuan Ming shifted the White Bone Venerable to one side and asked in a deep voice.
"This Ghostly Soul White Bone Banner of yours is too sinister; it is actually devouring blood slaves within the Shura Blood Devouring Map! How could I have forgotten? The blood slaves inside the map are all skeletal in form, brimming with vitality, the perfect nourishment for your Ghostly Soul White Bone Banner!" Qi Ye said vexingly, his hand movements becoming even faster.
Hearing this, Yuan Ming inwardly cursed Qi Ye for his carelessness and immediately lent a hand.
He shot out several strands of Undying Tree Roots from his palm, which entered the Shura Blood Devouring Map, entangling the Ghostly Soul White Bone Banner and pulling it outward.
However, the Ghostly Soul White Bone Banner seemed crazed, firmly biting into the Shura Blood Devouring Map. No matter how much it was pulled, it would not budge.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming got anxious and quickly weighed his options before summoning the Thunder God Hammer and the God Bombarding Cone.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, you must not! Now that the Ghostly Soul White Bone Banner and the Shura Blood Devouring Map are connected, rashly using thunderous methods will hurt both treasures," Qi Ye hurriedly intervened.
"Then what should we do?" Yuan Ming stopped and asked.
"I have a method that might be worth risking," Qi Ye said, his eyes flashing as he suddenly spoke.
This сhаptеr wаs mаdе pоssiblе by thе соmmunity аt МV|LЕМ|РYR.
Before Yuan Ming could respond, Qi Ye's form merged into the Shura Blood Devouring Map.
Yuan Ming frowned but remained silent, not wanting to disturb him.
The Blood Light on the Shura Blood Devouring Map continued to flash, but it gradually calmed down, no longer as violently chaotic as before.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming's heart, which he had been holding, was slightly eased, as it seemed Qi Ye's method was starting to work.
Time gradually passed, and half a day turned in a blink of an eye, the Shura Blood Devouring Map had already stabilized completely, but there was still no movement from the Ghostly Soul White Bone Banner and Qi Ye.
Yuan Ming, exercising patience, waited some more, but Qi Ye still had no movements.
His brows furrowed tightly, and just as he was about to send a message to inquire, a flash of white light crossed the screen, and the Ghostly Soul White Bone Banner flew out, hovering mid-air.
The Ghostly Soul White Bone Banner exhibited a crystalline color, emitting strands of white spirit light, seeming much more powerful than before.
Yuan Ming was slightly startled, activated his Divine Sense to probe, and his eyes lit up.
An Artifact Spirit had emerged within the White Bone Banner, and it was exceptionally powerful.
"No, this Artifact Spirit is Elder San Jue!" At first, Yuan Ming was delighted, but then once he realized the true nature of the Artifact Spirit, his face fell.
Elder San Jue was his greatest gain inside the secret realm of the Three Immortals Island, only to have been transformed into an Artifact Spirit!
"That's right, I just refined Elder San Jue's Divine Soul into the Ghostly Soul White Bone Banner, turning it into an Artifact Spirit. This Ghostly Soul White Bone Banner has just been repaired and needs a significant amount of Primordial Qi to replenish, which is why it suddenly lashed out to devour the blood slaves in the Shura Blood Devouring Map. Only by completing its missing Artifact Spirit could we calm it down; otherwise, if we let it continue devouring, the Shura Blood Devouring Map would also be in jeopardy. Please understand, Fellow Daoist," Qi Ye said, bowing.
Yuan Ming's expression turned sour, but since the event had already occurred, getting angry was useless. Moreover, considering the importance of the Shura Blood Devouring Map for Body Cultivation, Qi Ye's decision was not incorrect.
"This incident was also unexpected; I don't blame you, Fellow Daoist Qi Ye, but please exercise more caution in the future," he said, forcibly suppressing his anger and speaking slowly.
Qi Ye nodded, relieved and also inwardly regretting.
He told Yuan Ming that the Shura Blood Devouring Map could refine Artifact Spirits, intending to do Yuan Ming a favor and foster a closer relationship, but it backfired unexpectedly.
"How many Blood Slaves are left inside the Shura Blood Devouring Map?" Yuan Ming pondered, then asked.
"Aside from Blood Shadow and Hong Ling, who were released by you, all other Blood Slaves have been devoured by the White Bone Banner," Qi Ye said somewhat awkwardly.
Yuan Ming frowned and activated his Divine Sense to probe into the Shura Blood Devouring Map.
The Blood Bones inside had indeed vanished completely, but fortunately, the runes and the core of the map were intact, not affecting its ability to refine Essence Blood.
"These are the magic treasures from those Blood Slaves, and they are not damaged." Qi Ye waved his hand, and suddenly a small pile of magic treasures clattered to the ground, including Elder San Jue's wine gourd and a set of cyan Flying Swords.
Yuan Ming swept these magic treasures, and the Shura Blood Devouring Map into his sleeve and after a moment of silence, he gave a wry smile.
He had originally intended to add an Artifact Spirit to the Ghostly Soul White Bone Banner but hadn't expected to lose almost all the Blood Slaves in the Shura Blood Devouring Map in the process.
Fortunately, this incident confirmed the efficacy of Qi Ye's method. The Ghostly Soul White Bone Banner was refined, and he acquired his second real Spiritual Treasure.
Yuan Ming took the Ghostly Soul White Bone Banner and inspected it, finally revealing a trace of happiness on his face.
Having devoured a large number of Blood Slaves, especially powerful ones like Elder San Jue and Jia Sifang, the Ghostly Soul White Bone Banner had fully recovered. Its surface was fully restored, and radiated with a smooth, penetrative sense from inside out.
With Elder San Jue as the Artifact Spirit, the power of the Ghostly Soul White Bone Banner had increased significantly.
The only imperfection was that Elder San Jue's consciousness had already been erased earlier, making him far less agile as an Artifact Spirit compared to Qi Ye.
Yuan Ming wasn't concerned about this matter; he was wary of overly shrewd Artifact Spirits.
He performed the incantation for refining the Ghostly Soul White Bone Banner, quickly refining twenty-four runes and collected them.
He then reached out and the body of the White Bone Venerable flew over.
Yuan Ming scanned it, frowning.
He had been focused on the Shura Blood Devouring Map just now, and the White Bone Venerable's final trace of life essence had dissipated, but fortunately, its Divine Soul hadn't completely collapsed yet.
He swiftly took out a blood-colored armor, the Blood Puppet Armor, and pointed an incantation at it.
A stream of still-warm fresh blood flew out from the White Bone Venerable's body and merged into the Blood Puppet Armor, causing it to emit a strong Blood Light before it vanished, then reappeared on the White Bone Venerable's body, fitting itself perfectly.
As Yuan Ming activated the Blood Puppet Armor and refined the White Bone Venerable, he also took out the Bone Dragon Corpse, integrating it into the Blood Puppet Armor, replenishing the Venerable's Mana.
Now that Elder San Jue had unexpectedly become an Artifact Spirit, and lacking a powerful combatant, he decided to refine the White Bone Venerable into the Blood Puppet Armor.
This method was slightly inconsistent with the Blood Puppet Armor's principle. Still, since the White Bone Venerable had just died and its Divine Soul had not yet collapsed, there was hope for success.
Half a day passed in the blink of an eye, and Yuan Ming stopped his actions, his expression becoming more relaxed.
The late-stage Nascent Soul level Power and Divine Soul of the White Bone Venerable had all been integrated into the Blood Puppet Armor, replacing a previously mid-stage Nascent Soul Cultivator. Now, any person refining this armor would immediately transform into a late-stage Great Cultivator.
Yuan Ming collected the Blood Puppet Armor into his sleeve, closing his eyes to perform Breathing Control for a while, then continued circulating the Moonlight Technique to refine the Desire Power within his Divine Soul.
After a few days, the issue of his loosely bound Soul Power had significantly eased.
However, just as he was preparing to end his closed-door cultivation, an influx of newly gathered Desire Power unexpectedly reached a new peak. He failed to notice in time, allowing an excess of Desire Power to enter his Sea of Consciousness and violently impact his Divine Soul, which had just started to stabilize but then once again became loosely bound.
Yuan Ming was taken aback, and after a flurry of emergency adjustments, he finally had time to look into the source of this influx of Desire Power.
When he realized it all came from Wan Tianren and their complete eradication of the Wu Yue Sect's forces on other islands in the East Sea during a celebration event, he couldn't help but feel a mix of laughter and tears.
Fortunately, these events ultimately caused him no further harm. Though he couldn't absorb the excess Desire Power at once, it could still be stored in the White Jade Lotus Platform. So, Yuan Ming didn't interfere with the celebration event.
Still, his closed-door cultivation had been prolonged, and due to the injection of a large amount of Desire Power, the halo around the White Jade Lotus Platform, without anyone noticing, became increasingly bright.
...
Half a month later.
The fluctuations of Soul Power within Yuan Ming's Sea of Consciousness had become even more stable, and his overloaded Divine Soul had returned to a normal state, gradually becoming solid and stable once more.
And after this period of settling, the influx of Desire Power from the outside world was no longer as fierce as when he had just broken through Fusang Island. Though still vast, it no longer caught Yuan Ming off-guard with an excessive influx of Desire Power causing his Divine Soul to become loosely bound.
Grateful hearts are sincere, but only a few sustain their gratitude over time. Once the peak of the wave passes, what remains is merely a steady, delicate flow of continuous remembrance.
However, even this delicate flow is likely not to last long, as the belief of the Cultivators of the East Sea in gratitude is far more illusory than feelings of appreciation, and the time it endures may also not be lengthy.
If Yuan Ming wished to steadily gain Desire Power output, there were indeed ways to accomplish it.

chapters.title: Chapter 667 - 639: Don't Go to East Sea
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming either continually bestowed favors upon the East Sea, answering their prayers, satisfying their desires, in order to receive their continuous gratitude and faith,
or he would let the cultivators of the East Sea forever remember the majesty of the Nether Moon God, forever remember the cost of abandoning their faith, by forcefully suppressing the East Sea, making everyone sincerely fear, daring not to disbelieve or fail to worship.
The latter approach was indeed the pattern of the Wu Yue Sect before, and also one of the underlying purposes for stirring up the troubles in the East Sea.
Yuan Ming was not there to replace the Wu Yue Sect, so he would certainly not consider the second method; yet the first method was a sort of indirect bondage to Yuan Ming and also did not align with his own intentions.
He defeated the Wu Yue Sect, the East Sea Alliance provided Desire Power, and essentially, this was just a transaction, Yuan Ming was clear about this, and Wan Tianren and the others also understood this; it's just that no one pointed it out, with an unspoken mutual understanding.
The world of cultivators wasn't entirely cold-hearted, friendly feelings could exist, but more often than not, it was about interests.
Moreover, Yuan Ming had not yet broken through the secret skill of the Spoken Witch, and even if he obtained more Desire Power, he could not achieve a breakthrough; he could only save it all in the White Jade Lotus Platform for his own use. Therefore, he was not planning to do much about the foreseeable diminishment of the Desire Power.
When the "transaction" of pacifying the Wu Yue Sect ended, to believe or not to believe in the Nether Moon God would also become a choice for the people of the East Sea.
Having made up his mind, Yuan Ming subsequently ended his cultivation session and opened his eyes, preparing to leave seclusion.
"Have you dealt with all the problems of the Divine Soul?" Xi Ying noticed that Yuan Ming had awakened.
In the past half-month, Xi Ying had not left Yuan Ming's side and had always been nearby as Yuan Ming's protector.
"Almost taken care of. However, without a follow-up Cultivation Method, my Divine Soul Cultivation can only be temporarily slowed down, and the absorption of Desire Power also needs to be slowed, or a similar situation might occur again," Yuan Ming shook his head, saying with a wry smile.
"Sigh, the mnemonic for the Seventh Layer of the Moonlight Technique is still in the hands of the Wu Yue God. Until his orders are fulfilled, even my father can't get his hands on it; there's nothing I can do either," Xi Ying said.
"You've already helped me enough. Besides, now that we know the Seventh Layer Technique truly exists, we will have our chance to obtain it. But staying in the East Sea seems to be of no use anymore. I need to venture into other regions in search of opportunities, maybe I can find other Spoken Witch Techniques too," Yuan Ming said.
"Since that's the case, why don't you come with me back to the Southern Border first, starting from there, how about that?" Xi Ying pondered for a moment and then suddenly suggested.
"Southern Border? That's not a bad idea; I can also take the opportunity to see old friends again. But why are you suddenly thinking of going back there? Did you receive some news?" Yuan Ming asked, slightly taken aback.
"Not really, I just want to make a trip to Red Lotus Island along the way, to return this body to the Xiao Family," Xi Ying pointed to her own chest.
Yuan Ming then remembered that Xi Ying's current appearance was not her original form, but she had borrowed the body of Xiao Ying, a cultivator of Red Lotus Island. He had almost forgotten about this after being accustomed to her presence.
"Speaking of which, didn't you say initially that you just wanted to borrow her identity to have some fun? How did it end up being used until today?" Yuan Ming suddenly became curious.
"At first, I indeed only borrowed it to have some fun, but then, I happened to discover a Secret Technique that required her Physical Body for research. Previously, practicing the Ju Mang Spirit Technique was also for that Secret Technique. I've almost finished my research now, so there's no need to continue with the Ju Mang Spirit Technique. Naturally, the body should be returned to its original owner," Xi Ying explained.
"I see. In that case, I'll accompany you..."
As Yuan Ming began to agree to Xi Ying's invitation to the Southern Border, he suddenly felt a burning sensation on his right arm, making him retract his arm in pain, showing a pained expression.
"What's wrong?" Xi Ying became anxious.
Before Yuan Ming could reply, the Stealing Heaven Tripod suddenly flew out from the mark on his arm. A powerful suction emerged from the Tripod, and in the next instant, it pulled Yuan Ming's main soul and both his first and second split souls out of his Sea of Consciousness and into the Tripod.
Yuan Ming was caught off-guard and immediately tried to call back his Divine Soul, only to find that it seemed to be sealed by something, failing to respond to his summons for the moment.Ple$as$e r!ead t.h$i*s c*h!a$pter@ on its o%r*i&gina+l- p+lat-for!m#—#*-.
At the same time, Yuan Ming also sharply realized that his connection with the Stealing Heaven Tripod was rapidly weakening, to the point he could barely sense the space within the Tripod.
With his own Divine Soul no longer his immediate concern, Yuan Ming quickly moved his parents, as well as the items stored in the Stealing Heaven Tripod, out.
No sooner had he done this than the Stealing Heaven Tripod completely sealed itself off.
From that moment on, Yuan Ming found he had entirely lost his sense of the space inside the Tripod, and naturally, he could no longer enter the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
However, his connection to the Stealing Heaven Tripod hadn't completely broken off; although much weaker than before, it had merely returned to the level before he had advanced to Core Formation and opened the space within the Tripod.
Yuan Ming looked at the Stealing Heaven Tripod floating before him and once again became acutely aware that he knew far too little about this Divine Artifact that had been with him for so long.
He took a deep breath, first took his parents out of the retreat to settle them down, and then he and Xi Ying went into seclusion once more, studying the sudden change in the Stealing Heaven Tripod together.
Yuan Ming, who cultivated his soul, magic, and body, still had his Nascent Soul Cultivator maintaining his divine consciousness and operating his physical body, even though his divine soul was not within his body.
After sensing for a while, he unexpectedly discovered that although his main soul and split souls were all in a state of sealing that couldn't be recalled, they were still connected to his body, able to share what they saw and sensed with himself.
At the same time, Yuan Ming found that both his main soul and split souls were now in a hazy white space, surrounded by an exceptionally pure wish power that streamed around his divine soul like water.
Above this space, eight white jade dragon heads floated, each as lively as a true dragon, constantly spitting out white flames from their mouths, forming a dense fire net that covered the top of Yuan Ming's divine soul like a sieve.
Further above, countless chaotic wish powers fell from the void, and after being refined through the white fire net, their chaotic emotions were completely removed, leaving behind the most pure and refined wish power, which was stored around Yuan Ming's divine soul.
Could this be the inside of the White Jade Lotus Platform?
A guess emerged in Yuan Ming's mind; maybe the reason the wish power provided by the Stealing Heaven Tripod was so pure was due to the contribution of these eight white jade dragon heads and the fire net.
However, how should the divine soul leave this place?
Yuan Ming tried to let his divine soul approach the white fire net, and although he did not feel anything unusual as the distance closed, the moment his divine soul touched the white flames, an intense pain swept over his divine soul, forcing him to cry out in agony as his divine soul suffered severe damage and lost control, immediately plummeting into the pure wish power below.
But quickly, the pure wish power in the space flowed into his divine soul involuntarily, repairing the damage. In less than a breath's time, Yuan Ming's divine soul had returned to its original state, back under his control.
Meanwhile, Yuan Ming also discovered that after that ordeal, his divine soul had become much more solidified, and the soul power within seemed to have been further refined.
Yuan Ming was secretly thrilled, and the slight irritation that had sprung from the anomaly of the Stealing Heaven Tripod also vanished.
After a brief pause, he attempted once more to bring his divine soul close to the white flames. Each time it got burned and quickly repaired by the pure wish power, and although he couldn't break through the fire net's blockade or leave the white space, his divine soul gained considerable improvement.
Yet, this process of improvement was too painful. After a few attempts, Yuan Ming soon felt his spirit could no longer bear it, and he had to temporarily give up and let his divine soul rest for a while.
Through these trials, he also realized that the white flames seemed to be a natural bane to his soul power, and it was simply impossible for his divine soul to break through the fire net and escape the white space on its own.
But as a Soul Cultivator's methods all depend on the divine soul, and with Yuan Ming's main soul and both the first and second split souls trapped, his soul cultivation techniques naturally couldn't be used. This had a severe impact on his power, but for the moment, there was nothing he could do. He had no choice but to accept his fate and let his divine soul stay within the white space for now.
Next, Yuan Ming began to check the other abilities of the Stealing Heaven Tripod and found that except for not being able to enter the tripod's inner space, other capabilities, such as collecting wish power and incense possession, were not affected and could still be used as usual.
Yuan Ming let out a long, relieved sigh, his heart settling a bit.
Seeing this, Xi Ying also inquired about the current state of the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
"Could it be that you've injected too much wish power, causing the Stealing Heaven Tripod to transform again?" Xi Ying guessed after hearing Yuan Ming's description.
"Perhaps, but the important thing now is not to figure out the reason but to find a solution. Otherwise, my cultivation as a Soul Cultivator would be no different from being crippled," Yuan Ming replied with a wry smile.
"If you can't get out from the inside, why don't you try to approach it from the outside? I remember you said that you haven't fully refined the forbidden seals on the tripod, right?" Xi Ying asked.
"The banned seals on the tripod are complex. I have been studying them in my spare time, but with little progress," Yuan Ming contemplated.
"No matter the level of the treasure, the forbidden seals placed upon it all follow the same principles. You'd better continue to study knowledge about Forbidden Arrays; it should help you refine the Stealing Heaven Tripod," Xi Ying suggested.
"Alright. Since we are going to Red Lotus Island, the Xiao Family is known for their formations, and they should have lots of classics related to forbiddance. I can borrow and study them. On the trip there, you, being an Array Master, can also provide me with a lot of guidance. By the way, you know I can possess others using incense. Why don't you let me possess you for a bit to make learning easier?" Yuan Ming's eyes lit up, immediately making the suggestion.
"Absolutely not!" For some reason, Xi Ying gave Yuan Ming a glare and flatly refused his possession suggestion.
Yuan Ming was puzzled, and Xi Ying, as if fearing he would continue to ask, took out a number of Array Formation Manuals with a flip of her hand.
"You must learn about formations on your own; don't always think of taking shortcuts. Take these classics and read them. If there's anything you don't understand, organize your questions and ask me," Xi Ying insisted, handing over the Array Formation Manuals to Yuan Ming.
"Possessing to learn isn't really a shortcut; it allows for a deeper understanding of array setting techniques and the flow of spiritual power," Yuan Ming still seemed reluctant.
"Just read your books earnestly. For formations and cultivation techniques, whether you possess or not, the effect is much the same," Xi Ying was clearly not willing to discuss the matter further with Yuan Ming.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming had no choice but to let it go.
Now that they had a clear goal, the two no longer continued their seclusion and quickly began to arrange some matters before leaving the East Sea.

chapters.title: Chapter 668 - 640: Old Friend in Trouble
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming first settled his parents in a Mortal Town on a Second-level Island near Fusang Island. Since he had lost the ability to descend as a deity through the Stealing Heaven Tripod, and for the sake of his parents' safety, after much consideration, he decided to leave Hua Zhi behind.
Fortunately, Hua Zhi had absorbed a substantial amount of Spiritual Power from the Fusang Tree and was about to break through to Level 4 Upper Stage and needed time to seclude herself for this breakthrough, so she gladly agreed.
To ensure absolute safety, Yuan Ming also specifically left the Palm Leaf Fan and Jia Sifang's Tide Rising Misty Sea Ring with Hua Zhi to enhance her strength.
Afterward, Yuan Ming specifically sought out Wan Tianren to inform him that he would need to leave for a while. Furthermore, as Lord Nether Moon God was preparing for the great battle with the Wu Yue God, he would also enter a prolonged period of seclusion, during which time he would not be able to respond to the believers' prayers.
"Another thing, please remember this, Alliance Leader Wan," Yuan Ming admonished meaningfully just before leaving, "Lord Nether Moon God is a free deity. He is not the Wu Yue God, nor does he wish to be. The East Sea has always belonged to the Eastern Sea people. Its future should always be controlled and steered by you. However, Lord Nether Moon God hopes that the East Sea Alliance he has helped will not turn into another Wu Yue Sect."
"Rest assured, Divine Envoy Yuan, as long as I am here, the East Sea Alliance will always remain the East Sea Alliance," Wan Tianren replied with exceptional candor, feeling unexpectedly relieved.
"That is good to hear."
Having said this, Yuan Ming bid farewell to Wan Tianren, lingered a few more days on Fusang Island, and then secretly left the Eastern Sea and headed straight for the Southern Border.
...
Southern Border, Northern Territory.
Miles away from Biluo Cave, a thinly populated narrow valley.
In the valley, a stream meandered out from the deep mountains, gathering in a relatively flat and open area of the valley into a small pond that was no more than thirty feet in diameter.
Not far from the pond, under a sturdy old locust tree, stood a somewhat crude thatched cottage.
A child's playful laughter emanated from the yard, followed by a two or three-year-old girl, wearing red shorts and her hair tied in pigtail braids, who hopped and ran out the gate.Th@i&s ve+r*sion. is so!u*r%ced^ f!ro+m^ M@V3!L3&M&PY+R.@
Chasing behind her was a bright red Fire Mink, dragging its fluffy tail, carefully controlling its pace for fear of chasing too quickly and causing the little girl to fall.
"Giggle...,"
The laughter of the little girl echoed in the valley like tinkling spring water.
Squinting her crescent-moon-like eyes, she ran to the edge of the pond and jumped into the arms of an old man who was fishing by the river.
The old man wore a large hat and had white hair and beard, appearing to be of a very old age; however, the little girl continuously called out, "Daddy, Daddy, Huo Chan'er is chasing me!"
The old man was none other than Li Zhui, the former Cave Master of Biluo Cave and a close friend of Yuan Ming in his youth, while the little girl was his only daughter with the Third Cave Master, Ling Songhua, named Li Yu.
"Haha, let me see if Huo Chan'er has bitten my little carp's little feet?" Li Zhui threw aside his fishing rod and joyfully held up the little girl's feet, pretending to inspect them thoroughly.
By then, Huo Chan'er had also run over, rubbing against Li Zhui's feet.
Compared to when Yuan Ming had left, this little creature had grown a bit bigger, its rotund appearance exceedingly endearing.
"No bites, no bites..." the little girl struggled and jumped down.
Huo Chan'er immediately rubbed against her, but she pushed him away with annoyance.
"Daddy, did you catch any fish? I'm hungry," the little girl asked, looking at the nearby fish basket.
Li Zhui picked up the fish basket and showed it to her, "When has Dad ever come up empty-handed?"
The little girl was not much taller than the fish basket. Peering inside, she indeed saw two iridescent fish and one golden-red fish.
"Daddy, I want to drink fish soup," the little girl said, swallowing her saliva.
"Alright, Daddy will go cook it for you right now," Li Zhui laughed and stood up, picking up the fish basket with one hand and his daughter with the other, heading back to the cottage.
Back in the yard, Li Zhui put down his daughter and let her play with Huo Chan'er.
He then went to the makeshift kitchen, set up two small stoves, and began to stew the two different types of fish separately.
He then filled the stove with firewood and washed and chopped several vegetables, frying two plates of exquisite side dishes.
Soon, a rich aroma wafted through the yard.
When Li Zhui was setting the tableware, the little girl was already sitting nicely beside it, her eyes fixed on the dishes and fish soup on the table, shining brightly without even realizing a thread of saliva had dripped from her mouth.
"Little Carp, just wait a bit longer, your mother should be out soon," Li Zhui said with a smile as he glanced at a side of the thatched courtyard abutting a stone wall.
As soon as he finished speaking, a stone door on that wall slowly opened, and out walked a beautiful woman in red, wearing a high bun, voluptuous and with graceful features, none other than Ling Songhua, the former Third Cave Master of Biluo Cave.
The beautiful woman looked somewhat tired, but the moment her gaze met her husband's and daughter's, a gentle smile appeared on her face, revealing a unique charm that swept away all signs of fatigue.
Approaching the small square table, just as Ling Songhua was about to sit down, she saw Li Zhui serving a bowl of golden-red fish soup to their daughter and her brows unconsciously furrowed.
"I obtained that Earth Lung Fire Fish with great difficulty for your healing; why did you give it to our daughter?" she asked somewhat indignantly.
"Haha, whatever I consume seems useless for my condition now," Li Zhui laughed, "You see, my cultivation has been falling, and I've already returned to the Foundation Establishment stage. Using good things on me is a waste. Our Little Carp is different; she is a rare Thunder and Fire Dual Spirit Roots. Eating more good things now will make her cultivation smoother in the future," Li Zhui explained with a chuckle.
Li Yu was clearly frightened by his mother, holding a bowl of fish soup in his hands and blinking his big eyes, yet he dared not drink it.
"Drink it," Ling Songhua said with a helpless shake of her head, her expression softening.
"Yes, Mother!" The little girl instantly beamed with joy, not caring if it was hot or not, and began to drink heartily.
"How is it going, all smooth?" Li Zhui, seeing his wife's expression still somewhat downcast, changed the subject.
"It's just a mid-grade magical artifact, no problem there. The quality is quite good this time; we should be able to exchange it for more spirit stones," Ling Songhua replied, taking the bowl and chopsticks that Li Zhui handed her.
"That's good, these past days have been hard on you," Li Zhui said, serving her a bite of food with a slight guilt.
"We've been married for so many years, why say such things?" Ling Songhua chided, glancing at him.
"Ah, I..."
Before Li Zhui could finish, Ling Songhua cut him off.
"The decision to retire was made together by us, and I've never regretted it over these years. Since Little Carp came, I've regretted it even less. In fact, I'm very happy," she said earnestly.
While the couple spoke, the little girl couldn't understand half of it and just focused on eating her meal.
By the time the dishes on the table were finished and the soup was at the bottom of the bowl, the little girl, full and sleepy, had already fallen asleep with her head on the table, hands grabbing the bowl, and a sweet smile on her lips.
Ling Songhua smiled as she held her daughter in her arms, her expression gentle as water.
However, her gaze falling on Huo Chan'er gnawing on a fish bone beside her, she suddenly seemed to remember something, a shadow flickering across her eyes.
"Those people still won't give up, will they?" Li Zhui sighed and asked.
"They have their sights set on Huo Chan'er's awakened spiritual fire lineage; of course, they won't let go," Ling Songhua shook her head.
"Don't worry, Wangyou Valley is rarely visited and well-hidden; we haven't been out and about for over a year, they definitely won't find us," Li Zhui consoled.
"Hiding all the time is not a solution, if it really comes to it, should we contact some old friends to see if anyone can help?" Ling Songhua asked.
"With the turmoil in the Southern Border and Northern Territory these many years, there aren't many of our old friends left alive. Even if some really would help us, how could we burden them?" Li Zhui said with a bitter smile.
At her husband's words, Ling Songhua fell silent again.
Both of them thought of the same name simultaneously. If that young man were still around, he surely wouldn't stand by and watch them perish.
Yet, thinking this, they both couldn't help but show a bitter smile.
Let alone that they had lost contact for too long, even if they could find that person, how could he possibly stand against those people with his power alone?
"If worst comes to worst, just hand over Huo Chan'er. It might be better off with them than with us... How long has it been since it last ate a fire crystal stone?" Ling Songhua sighed and said.
Huo Chan'er, which had been lying at her feet, seemed to understand her words and immediately raised its head, eyes showing a look of panic.
"This little fellow has always regarded us as family. How could we possibly hand it over? If it really comes to it... well, we'll just have to see how things go," Li Zhui's harsh words hadn't even come out before his gaze fell on his daughter, and his tone involuntarily softened.
...
Meanwhile, a group of people was making their way up the stream in the valley.
Leading them was a man as tall as a horse, a bald man with a fierce face covered in scars.
"Hurry up, that couple is very cautious; at the slightest sign of trouble, they'll run. We've finally gotten a lead on them this time; we can't let them slip away again," the bald man barked.
He was a cultivator in the early stage of core formation; the seven or eight people following him appeared to be in the mid-to-late stage of foundation establishment. This group was quite a force in the entire region of the Southern Border and Northern Territory.
"Boss, why don't we just buy that fire mink, why resort to force?" At that moment, a green-robed youth spoke up.
"You must be new here, right? Don't you know what the boss is after?" Before the bald man could speak, a thin man with a pointy chin interjected.
"Actually, I am quite new," the youth said, smiling wryly.
The young man was none other than Yuan Ming, who had returned to the Southern Border not long ago.
He had intended to see how Li Zhui and the Three Cave Masters were faring in the Northern Territory, but upon reaching their former dwelling place, he found it long abandoned with no signs of habitation.
Later, he and Xi Ying rushed to Biluo Cave, only to find it changed beyond recognition, void of any familiar faces.
Having no other choice, Yuan Ming used Black Incense for possession and located this Wangyou Valley through occupying the body of Fisherman Li Zhui.
No sooner had they halfway approached the valley than they encountered this group.
Yuan Ming then cast an illusion spell, deceiving these people into thinking he was one of them and followed them along.

chapters.title: Chapter 669 - 641 Familiar
chapters.content:
"Heh heh, to tell you the truth, it's also because Ling Song Hua that woman didn't know what's good for her. If she had just given the Fire Mink to our boss from the start, none of this would've happened. But she just had to play the fool and ticked our boss off. Now, our boss wants both the mink and her, aiming for a windfall of wealth and beauty," the skinny guy with a sharp mouth and monkey cheeks said smugly.
"You have no idea, that broad is seductive enough to ensnare souls; that face, that figure…" Another fellow snickered lewdly, prompting laughter and jeers from the others.
"You, lad, are short-sighted, only caring about such trifles. What I value is the woman's Artifact Refining skills. Once we get our hands on her, she'll be a money tree we can keep at home, heh heh…" the bald man derided.
"But if I remember correctly, Ling Song Hua already has a Daoist companion, doesn't she?" Yuan Ming furrowed his brow and said.
"He's just old firewood nearing its end, hoarding such a beauty for himself, it's truly a waste of heavenly gifts. Heaven knows what that woman was thinking, even bearing him a child," the bald man scoffed dismissively.
"What does the boss plan to do with them?" Yuan Ming's eyes narrowed slightly as he asked.
"Naturally, we'll slaughter the old one to feed the Fierce Beasts, and sell the young one into slavery…" The bald man was saying, but he seemed to sense something amiss mid-sentence.
Yuan Ming was looking at him with a smile that was not quite a smile.
After a brief pause, the bald man suddenly turned to Yuan Ming with a fierce tone and asked, "How does a newcomer like you know about that woman's Daoist companion?"
"What do you think?" Yuan Ming's mouth curved into a brilliant smile.
The next instant, the ground cracked open as seven or eight roots broke through the soil, darting towards those men.To s&u%p.por-t- our w^o.rk,* p%l%e%ase re^ad* on *.
In a moment, the woods were filled with screams of agony.
When silence returned to the surroundings, only withered corpses littered the ground.
Yuan Ming's Divine Thought had already enveloped the entire valley, and naturally, he had spotted the small courtyard in the center of the valley.
He immediately leaped forward, hurrying towards it.
...
In the courtyard, Li Zhui was gently rocking Li Yu in a recliner in his embrace.
Under the thatched gate of the yard, a copper bell that hung there suddenly started to ring with a "clang, clang."
His expression suddenly changed, and the stone gate of the cave on the cliffside also shot up abruptly.
Ling Song Hua's figure charged out from inside, coming to his side.
"They've found us?" she asked, her eyebrows tightly furrowed.
"Not until the last Forbidden was breached did they alert us, we probably won't have time to escape." Li Zhui nodded, his expression solemn.
Ling Song Hua's gaze flitted back and forth between Huo Chan'er and her daughter Li Yu, already considering letting the Fire Mink take her and flee first.
"Don't be foolish, in these vast mountains filled with Fierce Beasts, Huo Chan'er couldn't possibly keep the child alive if he took her. Song Hua, don't be stubborn this time, take them and go quickly; I'll hold those people off," Li Zhui said without a hint of panic in his eyes, as if he had long been prepared for this scenario.
"With your current Cultivation, you can't stop them. Let me stay. They won't easily kill an Artifact Refiner like me. If I stay, there's still a sliver of a chance." Ling Song Hua spoke.
"Don't think I don't know what you've been refining these past days. A Sky Shattering Bomb, right? You're planning to go down with them. I can't let you do that. Little Carp can't grow up without her mother. Go now, if you don't leave now, it will be too late." Li Zhui patted her shoulder, urging her.
Ling Song Hua's eyes reddened, her firmness dissolving instantly into a sorrowful countenance.
So it had come to this.
If it weren't for her daughter, she would never choose to cling to life, but for her child, she couldn't die.
"Go on."
Li Zhui handed his daughter into Ling Song Hua's arms and took off a white Storage Bag from her waist.
He knew that the three Sky Shattering Bombs were inside it.
Just then, hurried footsteps suddenly came from outside, followed by a knocking at the door.
"So quick!" Ling Song Hua's face underwent a drastic change.
Li Zhui's brow furrowed as he gripped a Sky Shattering Bomb and walked towards the door.
Just before reaching it, he waved to his wife and daughter, signaling for them to hurry and leave.
"Is Elder Fisherman present?" a voice called out from behind the wooden door.
At this voice, at this address, Li Zhui was taken aback, seeming somewhat familiar.
Then another inquiry came.
"Are the Three Cave Masters present?"
At the same time this inquiry sounded, both Li Zhui and Ling Song Hua's expressions changed again, looking at each other with disbelief.
Elder Fisherman, Three Cave Masters... there were now very few who could call them by these names at the same time.
Before they could reply, Huo Chan'er, who had been right beside Ling Song Hua, suddenly stood up on his hind legs, peering towards the door while sniffing the air intensely.
Suddenly, Huo Chan'er's eyes lit up, and he leaped out at once, jumping over the courtyard wall and landing outside.
Ling Song Hua hurriedly followed.
What she saw when she "squeaked" the wooden door open was a young man in a green robe, cradling Huo Chan'er in his arms, smiling at them.
Huo Chan'er, as excited as if he had tasted the finest Fire Jade, snuggled up and down, licking the man's face with his tongue.
Recognizing the man's face, Ling Song Hua stopped dead in her tracks.
Although there were some changes from what she remembered, it was certainly him!
"Yuan Ming?" Li Zhui's voice came from behind, filled with disbelief.

chapters.title: Chapter 670 - 641 Deja Vu_2
chapters.content:
"Senior Li, Senior Ling, it's been a long time." Yuan Ming greeted with a smile, his gaze falling on the child in Li Zhui's arms, his eyes showing a gentle expression.
At that moment, the little girl also woke up from her mumbling dream and, rubbing her eyes, looked towards Yuan Ming:
"Daddy, who is he?"
"He is..." Li Zhui was momentarily at a loss for words, unsure of how to address him.
"I am a friend of your parents, just call me Brother Yuan." Yuan Ming offered.
"Brother Yuan?" the little girl murmured softly.
"Little girl doesn't see strangers often, Fellow Daoist Yuan, don't take offense, please, come in and let's talk." Li Zhui said with a laugh, quickly welcoming Yuan Ming inside.
Ling Songhua closed the courtyard door behind them, but a hint of hesitation flashed in her eyes.
Yuan Ming casually took out a Fire Attribute Spirit Stone and fed it to Huo Chan'er, placing it on the ground.
As they had just sat down at the table in the courtyard, Li Zhui stood up and said, "You seldom visit, and I happen to have a few Silver Scale Colorful Fish, perfect for stewing."
"Senior Li, I've longed for this fish soup for a while." Yuan Ming's eyes brightened as he spoke.
Seeing him get busy, Ling Songhua sat across from Yuan Ming and scrutinized him carefully.
After a long look, she couldn't ascertain Yuan Ming's depth, feeling that his aura seemed only at the peak of Foundation Establishment, yet something seemed off.
Yuan Ming had suppressed his cultivation level when he joined the group of Loose Cultivators, and he had forgotten to release it during the journey.
"What is the child's name?" Yuan Ming asked, looking at the little girl who was curiously staring at him with her big eyes.
"Li Yu, her nickname is Little Carp, all named by her dad," Ling Songhua said.
"Haha, that's very much in Senior Li's style," Yuan Ming laughed.
While they were talking, Li Zhui came over with a small red clay stove to the table.
While waiting for the fish soup to stew, Li Zhui asked about Yuan Ming's recent whereabouts, and Yuan Ming only mentioned that he had been in the East Sea area recently and had returned to the Southern Border to attend to some matters, taking the opportunity to visit them.
The couple didn't ask much, but the worry in their brows was somewhat hard to conceal.
After Yuan Ming finished his fish soup, Li Zhui and Ling Songhua exchanged a look and seemed to struggle before saying, "Fellow Daoist Yuan, I have a favor to ask, I wonder if you could agree?"
"What is it?" Yuan Ming asked.
"Could you possibly take Little Carp and Huo Chan'er to the East Sea for a while?" Li Zhui paused before saying.
Yuan Ming was taken aback, not immediately agreeing, but instead silently looked towards the couple.
"I won't hide it from you, because of some matters, we've made some enemies. The opposing side has many people, and they have a Core Formation Stage cultivator in charge. My wife and I are no match for them. So we're hoping you could help take care of them for a bit. If we can get away, we will definitely come to find you in the East Sea," Ling Songhua sighed and said.
"You finally spoke up, I was starting to get impatient," Yuan Ming said with a smile upon hearing those words.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, this matter is truly no joke. Those people are tough adversaries, and they have the Shichuan Alliance backing them. We really had no choice but to trouble you," Li Zhui said, his expression turning serious as he saw Yuan Ming laugh.
"The Core Formation Stage fellow you mentioned must be that bald man, right?" Yuan Ming asked.
"How did you know?" Ling Songhua asked, surprised.
"Don't worry, those guys ran into me as soon as they entered the valley. They won't be bothering you anymore," Yuan Ming said, while placing the bald man's Storage Ring on the table.
The reference version of this on *.
This news, like a bolt of thunder, shocked the couple so much that they struggled to regain their composure for a long time.
"They all... died?" Li Zhui asked, somewhat hesitantly.
"Rest assured, I left no survivors, it was handled very cleanly," Yuan Ming said with a smile.
Seeing him speak so confidently, Ling Songhua still seemed somewhat skeptical, but Li Zhui already started laughing loudly.
"Haha... Fellow Daoist Yuan, you've saved us once again. How can we ever repay this kindness?" After the laughter, he couldn't help but let out a wry smile.
"Let's not speak such formalities. I'm just curious, how did you two end up living in seclusion here?" Yuan Ming waved his hand and asked.
"You mean to ask, how did we fall into such a state?" Li Zhui said with a laugh.
"With both of your cultivation levels, plus Senior Ling's artifact refining skills, how could you possibly be bullied to such an extent?" Yuan Ming didn't deny it but continued to ask.
"Initially, we planned to completely retire and live like celestial beings. Then suddenly, three years ago, we had Little Carp. This child turned out to be quite promising, possessing Dual Spirit Roots of Fire and Thunder Attributes, with excellent aptitude. In consideration of her future, we decided to come out of retirement to build a foundation for her cultivation," Ling Songhua explained, pausing for a moment.
"Alas, the outside world changed too fast. By the time we emerged, the whole Southern Border and Northern Territory were already in disarray. When Song Hua and I went out to collect spiritual materials, people started eyeing Huo Chan'er, and a fierce clash ensued when they failed to make a purchase. Later, the opponents brought even stronger allies and began attacking us frequently, leaving us no choice but to flee here," Li Zhui explained.
"What happened in the Southern Border and Northern Territory, causing such chaos?" Yuan Ming asked.
"Actually, the Southern Border and Northern Territory have never been completely stable. They've only grown more chaotic since the fall of the Biluo Sect, as the struggles among the Four Great Sects intensified," Ling Songhua explained.
"The Green Rock Association, you know about them, right? They've always kept a low profile, but these past few years, they've been secretly gaining support from many in the Scatter Alliance, rapidly increasing their strength. They've now even suppressed the Hundred Poison Cave, Beast King Sect, and even the Black Fire Sect, and are on the verge of unifying the Southern Border and Northern Territory," Li Zhui added.
"The Green Rock Association possesses such capabilities?" Yuan Ming asked, somewhat surprised.
"The Loose Cultivators they've aligned with have also been growing stronger under the Green Rock Association's support, seizing territories rich in Spirit Veins on their instructions. The Shichuan Alliance is the strongest among all Loose Cultivators, and they now occupy the former site of the Biluo Sect," Ling Songhua continued.
"I hadn't imagined that Biluo Cave would become like this. Since that is the case, Senior Li, if you wish to take back Biluo Cave, I can offer my help," Yuan Ming said, pausing in surprise before continuing.
As he spoke, his tone was casual, as though discussing common family matters, like buying a couple of chickens in the afternoon.
As Li Zhui observed Yuan Ming, he noticed a barely perceptible intimidating aura emanating from him, which left him feeling both delighted and emotional.
"When I first met you, Fellow Daoist Yuan, I simply liked what I saw. After getting to know you, I found our temperaments matched, and now seeing how quickly you've grown, I feel both gratified and somewhat envious," Li Zhui said with a gentle smile, not answering directly but instead making this comment.
