chapters.title: Chapter 671 - 642 Turmoil in the Southern Border
chapters.content:
"If envy still lingers in your heart, it means that deep down, Senior Li still harbors grand aspirations. Why not reorganize and rise from the ashes? What I said earlier, about taking back Biluo Cave, was by no means an empty boast, so you need not have any concerns," Yuan Ming said with a smile before his expression turned serious.
"Heh, how could I doubt Fellow Daoist Yuan's words? It's just that Biluo Cave is, after all, a thing of the past. Now that I have my family to consider, my heart is filled with concerns, and with this frail body... even if you help me take back Biluo Cave, I'm afraid I won't be able to keep this foundation. It would be all in vain," Li Zhui replied with a bitter smile.
"May I take a look?" Yuan Ming asked, furrowing his brows.
"Why not?" Li Zhui said with a smile, extending an arm.
Without hesitation, Yuan Ming stepped forward, grabbed Li Zhui's wrist, and began to carefully examine his physical condition.
After a short while, he relaxed his brows and said, "The problem isn't serious. Your physical body has aged, causing old injuries to emerge and suppress your cultivation, leading to a regression in cultivation level."
Upon hearing Yuan Ming say "The problem isn't serious," Ling Songhua's face lit up with joy, but as he continued speaking, a worried expression couldn't help but reappear on her face.
"His cultivation is regressing instead of advancing, and his lifespan is diminishing without increase. With this decline, he will only become weaker—how can you say the problem isn't serious?" Ling Songhua said, unable to contain herself.
"One simply needs to replenish the origin of life, revitalizing the physical body, and coupled with healing pills to remove the lingering illness, I believe with Senior Li's foundation, regaining strength is merely a matter of time," Yuan Ming said, waving his hand dismissively.
Although his tone was calm, it caused a torrential wave to rise in the hearts of Li Zhui and his wife.
"Is... is that really possible?" Li Zhui asked incredulously.
Yuan Ming smiled without speaking, tightened his grip on Li Zhui's wrist, and a surge of the Undying Tree's Origin Power flowed from within him, entering Li Zhui's body through his arm.
Almost instantly, the furrow in Li Zhui's brows smoothed out, and his eyes widened involuntarily.
He could clearly feel an indescribable and tumultuous life force entering his body from Yuan Ming's palm and spreading throughout his limbs and bones via his meridians.
A sensation like that of withered wood meeting spring arose in his heart, and he felt himself becoming lighter. Even the beating heart in his chest seemed stronger.
Simultaneously, strands of black hair began to appear at his temples, turning his previously pure white hair to salt-and-pepper.
Ling Songhua, who stood by and witnessed the visible changes in her husband, felt her eyes redden and stood up, too moved to speak.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming slowly retracted his hand, merely smiling at them.
"Thank... thank you..." Li Zhui, who had not held much hope, stuttered.
In that moment, no matter how he expressed his gratitude, it seemed insufficient. He simply had no way to repay such a kindness.
"There's no need for such formalities between us. Now, how do you feel? Do you have the spirit to reclaim Biluo Cave?" Yuan Ming asked with a smile.
Upon hearing this, Li Zhui found himself somewhat moved.
However, when his gaze passed over his wife and daughter, a softness stirred in his heart and he slowly began to speak, "No need. I've grown accustomed to a life unburdened like the clouds and the wild cranes. To me, these things are no longer sweet dew, but shackles instead. Having once proclaimed a heart uninterested in the path to immortality, how can I return to being a mortal after traversing the Immortal Path? Now that I have them, my remaining years I only wish to protect and care for them, to accompany them through sunrise and sunset, to appreciate the autumn moon and spring breeze, and I will already be very content."
"Since that's the case, then I shall not interfere further," Yuan Ming said, knowing this was what Li truly desired. He did not insist any further.
"You have already helped us more than enough. If it weren't for you, we might not exist in this world," Ling Songhua said with tear-filled eyes and heartfelt gratitude.
"Speaking of which, how are the other regions of the Southern Border doing now?" Yuan Ming waved his hand, changing the subject.
"All the same. The entire Southern Border, whether it's the North Territory or the eastern and western domains, are stirring; a chaotic scene indicating imminent turmoil," Li Zhui replied.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, are you possibly planning to go somewhere in the Southern Border?" Ling Songhua asked, noticing the shift in conversation.
"Indeed, I do have to make a trip to Red Lotus Island in the Southern Domain," Yuan Ming nodded, without concealment.
"The Southern Domain might not be as chaotic as the North Territory, but it's still far from peaceful," Ling Songhua said with a slight frown.
"Oh, what has happened there?" Yuan Ming inquired with raised eyebrows.
"I'm not sure if you're aware, but the Southern Border Southern Domain is home to two top-tier sects, Pan Si Island and Senluo Sect. Each of them governs one area, one in the southern seas, the other mainly on land. Neither acknowledges the other's superiority, leading to constant strife. Recently, they've been locked in conflict over a newly emerged Spirit Vein, fighting back and forth for quite some time, with heavy losses on both sides," Ling Songhua explained.
Yuan Ming nodded, staying quiet.
"The Red Lotus Island you're heading to is one of Pan Si Island's territories," Li Zhui added.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, unless you have urgent matters, I would advise against going there. At least wait until the conflict between the two sides has subsided somewhat," Ling Songhua advised further.
"This is something I really cannot put off," Yuan Ming said, shaking his head.
"If that's the case, even if you go there, do not get involved in their conflict. Attend to your own matters and leave immediately," Ling Songhua sighed and said upon hearing this.
"Of course," Yuan Ming said with a smile.
After a short stay, Yuan Ming got up to say his farewells, and both Li Zhui and Ling Songhua were extremely reluctant to see him go, but they knew he had things to do and did not insist on his staying.
When the two saw Yuan Ming off and returned to the courtyard, somehow, a storage bracelet had appeared on the wrist of the young girl, Li Yu.
"This Fellow Daoist Yuan…" Li Zhui noticed this and, with a warm look on his face, shook his head with a smile.
The next moment, when he opened the storage bracelet, his expression changed again and again.
Inside it, there were not only many spirit stones, but also several bottles of extremely high-quality elixirs, some spiritual materials for artifact refining, and even three magic treasures with both offensive and defensive capabilities and two volumes of cultivation techniques.
"These elixirs are for you, the cultivation techniques are for Little Carp, and the spiritual materials are for me. He even left magic treasures and spirit stones to help us through tough times. I'm afraid we may never fully repay this kindness in our lifetime…" Ling Songhua said, with tears in her eyes.
Before Li Zhui could respond, Huo Chan'er was jumping up and down anxiously nearby.
"Hehe, I haven't forgotten you. Fellow Daoist Yuan left many fire attribute spirit stones for you too, some of which I don't even recognize. It seems your bloodline power has a chance to awaken once more," Ling Songhua said as she pressed down on Huo Chan'er's head with a laugh.
Li Zhui remembered how Yuan Ming, when departing, had also instructed them that if they encountered an insurmountable hurdle, they could seek refuge with Hundred Pills Square in East Sea, and a surge of indescribable emotions welled up in his heart.
"How high do you think Fellow Daoist Yuan's cultivation must be now?" Ling Songhua asked, unable to hold back.
"Hehe, definitely higher than just at the peak of Foundation Establishment, that's for sure," Li Zhui said, looking in the direction Yuan Ming had gone and laughing freely.
Meanwhile, outside Wangyou Valley.
Yuan Ming was sitting cross-legged on Lei Yu's back, thanking Xi Ying, "Thank you for the 'Fire Element Technique' and 'Xuanlei Scripture.'"
When Yuan Ming had earlier visited Li Zhui, Xi Ying was actually by his side all the time, merely using an illusion technique to conceal herself and not revealing her presence.
"It just so happens that the little girl has both a Fire Spiritual Root and a Thunder Spirit Root, which are perfect for her to use. But I didn't expect you to have such deep feelings for these two," Xi Ying said, somewhat surprised.
"During the early days in Biluo Cave, they were among the few who treated me kindly. Moreover, without the aid of the Three Cave Masters, I probably would have died silently at the hands of Hu Huo and Kun Tu..." Yuan Ming said, looking down at the undulating mountains of the Southern Border with a look of reminiscence.
Upon hearing this, Xi Ying seemed to be reminded of something and didn't continue the conversation via divine transmission.
"Before going to Red Lotus Island, I want to go to a certain place first," Yuan Ming suddenly said.
"Where is that?" Xi Ying asked, curious. This version was sourced from *.
"You'll know when we get there," Yuan Ming didn't give a direct answer but said with a smile.
...
Shortly thereafter, Lei Yu folded its wings and dove toward the ground below.
Soon after, it brought Yuan Ming to a landing by the banks of a tortuous river with treacherous terrain.
The river roared with its rapid current speckled with submerged rocks, and the muddy, yellow water formed enormous whirlpools in the channel. The thunderous sound of the water, like the roar of a ferocious dragon, echoed throughout the valley.
"Is this the place you wished to come to?" Xi Ying inquired with a hint of curiosity.
Yuan Ming looked at the rushing turgid water with a contemplative expression.
"It was at the upstream of this river where I was shot with an arrow and drifted here after falling into the water. Had it not been for a stroke of luck when I found the Stealing Heaven Tripod, I might have long since become fish food in this river, buried under the silt on the riverbed," Yuan Ming spoke slowly, after a long pause.
Upon hearing this, Xi Ying recalled the first time they saw Yuan Ming in Biluo Cave, picturing a frail young man struggling to survive in the fierce river currents.
"You didn't bring me here just to reminisce about the past, did you?" Xi Ying asked curiously.
Because Xi Ying knew that Yuan Ming was definitely not the type to do so for that reason alone.
"Of course not. I just feel that the Stealing Heaven Tripod, a treasure of such caliber, would not have ended up here without reason. Therefore, this time I returned to see if there were any clues here," Yuan Ming explained, shaking his head with a smile.
After speaking, he immediately spread his divine power around, extending it in all directions, and began to meticulously search every corner of the valley and riverbed.
The chaotic scene at the riverbed was soon thoroughly scouted by him.
At that moment, his eyes suddenly opened wide, flashing with a hint of delight.

chapters.title: Chapter 672 - 643: Hidden in the City
chapters.content:
"There's actually something to be found?" Xi Ying said with some surprise.
"Just give me a moment," Yuan Ming said, before leaping into the river.
Unlike the previous struggle for survival, Yuan Ming fell to the riverbed and no longer needed to struggle. His body was like an iron buffalo anchoring the river, unmoved no matter how the waters churned around him.
He made his way upstream along the riverbed, unobstructed by the murky sand and silt.
Soon, he arrived at the spot where he had found the Stealing Heaven Tripod years ago. Despite the passage of time and the erosion, a round, concave imprint still marked the rock where the tripod had been embedded.
A few steps upstream from that rock, on another in the water, lay a set of white bones.
They fit perfectly into a groove on the rock, and the robes wrapped around them were not yet fully decayed, trailing rags that swayed in the river's undercurrents like aquatic plants.
Yuan Ming approached and grabbed the bones, pulling them out of the crevice. Just as he was about to take them back, a glint of metal caught his eye.
He immediately stooped down and swept away the sediment, extracting a palm-sized golden token.
Yuan Ming furrowed his brow and saw that the token bore the ancient seal characters for "Double Immortals." Flipping it over, he found two more characters on the other side: "Kato."
After a thorough check to ensure there were no other items, he dragged the bones out of the water and surfaced.
Back on the bank, Xi Ying first examined the body, then the token.
"Did you find anything?" Yuan Ming asked.
After all, his time in cultivation was short. Although he had spent a long time in the Southern Border, his cultivation level was too low at the time, and as a guest reliant on others, he could only access limited information.
"I can't discern anything useful from these bones, but the words 'Double Immortals' remind me that there's some sect known as the Double Immortal Sect in the Southern Border Western Regions," Xi Ying pondered, then said.
"Double Immortal Sect?" Yuan Ming asked, puzzled.This part of the collection on *.
"That one is unlike other sects, more like a religious cult. Its followers worship the Turtle Immortal and the Snake Immortal. Its power spreads across the entire Southern Border Western Regions, but they only operate within their domain, seldom meddling in external affairs. Do you think this token and the skeleton have something to do with the Stealing Heaven Tripod?" Xi Ying put forth.
"It's too soon to draw conclusions, but in that watery area, the most likely ties to the Stealing Heaven Tripod would be these two items," Yuan Ming suggested.
"After we sort out the Red Lotus Island issue, let's investigate this Double Immortal Sect," Xi Ying proposed after some thought.
"I was indeed thinking the same," Yuan Ming said, and with a sweep of his hand, he stored away the token and the bones.
Following that, the pair continued on their journey.
...
Over half a month later.
In a vast valley in the Southern Border, lush with vegetation and pleasing to the eye.
On one side of the valley, a succession of terraced fields rose in elevation, planted with a variety of spiritual materials, many in bloom with vibrant flowers that created a stunning seascape of terraced fields.
Beyond the fields and near a lake stood a sprawling, impressive manor with courtyards and structures arrayed in orderly succession—an estate that clearly was no ordinary residence.
On the smooth road leading to the valley, Yuan Ming and Xi Ying walked side by side.
However, to avoid trouble, Yuan Ming had used the Blood Bone Mask to alter his appearance into that of a young man with thick eyebrows and large eyes, soon after leaving that river valley.
"Is this really the secret base of the Xi Family here in the Southern Border?" Yuan Ming asked, looking at the surroundings in disbelief.
"What, do you find it too conspicuous, not secretive enough?" Xi Ying asked with a smile.
"A bit," Yuan Ming admitted, smiling.
"The greatest concealment is in plain sight. This place has always functioned as a plantation for mundane spiritual medicines, and the business it runs is also related to spiritual medicine, so even if someone deliberately investigates, they won't discover anything," Xi Ying replied.
"Ultimately, hiding your physical body here is indeed quite bold," Yuan Ming said, not entirely convinced.
As they spoke, they arrived at the front gate of the manor.
The attendant at the gate noticed the pair stopping outside and hurriedly came to inquire.
"You both look unfamiliar. Are you new traders?" The attendant greeted and politely asked.
"Take this to your master, and he will know," Xi Ying replied as she produced a jade token and handed it to the attendant.
Though slightly hesitant, the attendant said, "Please wait a moment," and immediately went into the compound.
Shortly thereafter, a middle-aged man with a neat appearance, slightly thin stature, and a short beard came out quickly. When he saw Xi Ying, there was no joy in his eyes, but instead, a hint of puzzlement.
However, after examining her closely for a moment, that puzzlement turned to surprise, and with it, his eyes lit up.
"Girl, you have been gone for so many years. You've finally come back," the middle-aged man greeted her and said eagerly.
"I've seen Second Uncle," Xi Ying said with a smile, performing a ritual courtesy.
Yuan Ming did not speak and followed suit, cupping one fist in the other as a sign of respect.
The middle-aged man sized up Yuan Ming with a somewhat strange expression after seeing this but did not greet him.
Xi Ying introduced through a secret voice transmission, "This is my Second Uncle, Xi Dongliu. He has always been here with a few family members at the Core Formation Stage, responsible for guarding this place."
Yuan Ming nodded silently in his heart and maintained his silence.
"Come on, let's go inside and talk," Xi Dongliu said, leading the two towards the inner courtyard.
They passed through successive courtyards and as they moved further back, the fewer people were seen in the yards and the more hidden Forbidden Arrays there were.
After passing through four layers of courtyards, there were no longer any attendants to be seen in the whole area, and it was eerily quiet, with only the sound of their footsteps echoing in the courtyard.
When they reached the center of the courtyard, Xi Dongliu suddenly stopped, turned his head to look at Yuan Ming once more, and asked out of the blue, "He's not a Puppet?"
Yuan Ming was startled by the question and turned to look at Xi Ying, not understanding why her Second Uncle would ask such a thing.
"No, his surname is Yuan, and he is a friend of mine," Xi Ying simply stated.
After hearing this, Xi Dongliu furrowed his brows even more, looking as if he had heard something incredibly difficult to comprehend.
"Girl, don't blame your Second Uncle for thinking nonsense. I'm well aware of your lifelong aversion to men, and I've never seen you befriend a male in the family from your youth till now," Xi Dongliu said, unable to hold back.
"Second Uncle, it's just my nature, I don't like socializing with people," Xi Ying denied.
"Is that so," Xi Dongliu responded, noncommittal.
"By the way, Second Uncle, wasn't Uncle Chen the one who used to guard this place? Why has it changed to you now?" Xi Ying changed the subject and asked.
"I came to the Southern Border with the Clan Leader to attend to some matters. Just so happened your Uncle Chen needed to return home, so I'm standing guard here in his stead," Xi Dongliu replied.
"Father is also in the Southern Border?" Xi Ying expressed in surprise.
"Yes, but he's not on this side of the manor. You'll probably have to wait a few days if you want to see him," Xi Dongliu nodded and said.
"There's no rush. Second Uncle, please arrange a place for my friend to stay first. We will need to stay here for about half a month," Xi Ying said, not overly concerned.
Afterwards, Xi Ying left first, heading toward a deeper part of the courtyards, while Xi Dongliu brought Yuan Ming to a guest room in one of the four-connected courtyards.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, right? Please rest here for now. Meals will be sent over by attendants, and if you find it dull, feel free to visit the front courtyard or valley at your leisure," Xi Dongliu said, opening the guest room for Yuan Ming.
The tone was neutral, neither warm nor cold.
However, the underlying message was clear: he didn't want him wandering into the rear courtyard area without permission.
"Thank you. However, I may also need to be in seclusion for Cultivation these next few days, so I won't be going out or requiring meals," Yuan Ming said indifferently.
"If that's the case, I will make sure no one disturbs you here. You can cultivate in peace," Xi Dongliu said, nodding upon hearing this.
"Many thanks," Yuan Ming said, bowing with his fist in his palm.
Xi Dongliu then excused himself and left.
Once Yuan Ming closed the door, he took out a Forbidden Talisman and affixed it to the door. He then cleared a space in the room and set up a Forbidden Array before sitting down cross-legged within it.
He took out the Stealing Heaven Tripod and once again carefully examined the treasure that had accompanied him on his Cultivation journey, filled with emotion.
This time, he was going to attempt refining the Stealing Heaven Tripod once again.
His previous attempts had only allowed him to successfully refine the external prohibitions of the Stealing Heaven Tripod. To completely master this treasure, he needed to refine its internal prohibitions as well.
After a moment of Breathing Control, Yuan Ming held the Stealing Heaven Tripod in both hands and opened his mouth to emit a stream of Mana, enveloping the tripod.
He then began to attempt to refine the Stealing Heaven Tripod, invoking the Secret Technique taught to him by the Shura Master.
The golden patterns on the Stealing Heaven Tripod soon emerged, offering no resistance to Yuan Ming's Mana, which easily penetrated them.
However, at the same time, Yuan Ming's vision blurred and he found himself spontaneously inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod, sitting cross-legged on the White Jade Lotus Platform.
"I've entered the Stealing Heaven Tripod? No... that's not right," Yuan Ming was initially shocked but then sensed something amiss.
Although he was indeed on the White Jade Lotus Platform, the surroundings were an expanse of white, and it was not the same space within the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
"Now's not the time to think about this," Yuan Ming shook his head, casting aside stray thoughts, and immediately continued to guide his Mana towards the Lotus Platform beneath him.
The White Jade Lotus Platform lit up with brilliance, and more intricate patterns emerged. Starting from under Yuan Ming, they spread outward, eventually covering the entire platform.
As Yuan Ming's Mana entered these golden lines, he immediately felt a force of resistance and his progress became arduous again.

chapters.title: Chapter 673 - 644: Two Extremes Immortal Brew
chapters.content:
Feeling the hindrance, Yuan Ming was not anxious but pleased.
This indicated that the forbidden restrictions inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod were very likely right here.
He knew this would be a long battle, so he was in no hurry, methodically channeling his mana with a secret technique, like waves crashing against the shore, repeatedly surging toward the golden runes.
As time trickled by, however, Yuan Ming's progress was surprisingly slow.
Soon, a day and night had passed, but the golden runes had only faded a minuscule amount.
Yuan Ming's eyebrows furrowed tightly. A thought suddenly arose in his mind, and his form transformed into that of the Undying Tree, its roots covering the entire White Jade Lotus Platform, his mana penetrating into the runes on the platform without a single gap.
Under the massive mana refining, the golden runes on the White Jade Lotus Platform finally began to fade at a visible rate.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming's spirits lifted, and he immediately gathered all his focus, devoting himself wholly to the sacrificial refining.
...
Four days later, the last bit of golden light on the runes covering the White Jade Lotus Platform faded away, and they were completely refined.
Just as Yuan Ming was eager to check out any changes to the Stealing Heaven Tripod after the successful refining, his Divine Thought suddenly pierced through a barrier and fell into a much larger space of virtualization.
Yuan Ming's Divine Thought hovered in the void, looking around, only to see a myriad of golden chains crisscrossing everywhere in this space, layer upon layer, at least a thousand in number.
Approaching one of these chains, and upon closer inspection, he realized it was not actually a chain but an intricate Forbidden Rune, emanating an intensely powerful forbidding force.
"Could this be the true internal restriction of the Stealing Heaven Tripod?" Yuan Ming couldn't help but take another look around, his mind trembling with the thought.
At this moment, he felt as if he were surrounded by a maze of restrictions, and a sense of despair involuntarily arose in his heart.
"A skyscraper rises from the ground up; let's take it one by one." But Yuan Ming quickly adjusted his emotions.
He steadied his mind and, with his Divine Thought entwined with one of the restriction chains, began to refine the restriction with the Sacrificial Refining Method taught to him by the Shura Master.
Seeing the light of the Forbidden Rune fading little by little, Yuan Ming breathed a sigh of relief. As long as the refining process encountered no problems, completing the ritual was only a matter of time.
...
In the blink of an eye, another five days had passed.
A flash of light, and Yuan Ming's figure appeared within the guest room.
He held the Stealing Heaven Tripod in his hands, but his face showed a resigned helplessness.
These past several days of nearly non-stop refining had exhausted him, yet the speed of refining the first restriction had been surprisingly slow—it had only just begun to loosen today.
Yet before Yuan Ming had time to rejoice, he was disturbed by the Array he had set up, because someone had come looking for him.
"Knock, knock."
Hearing the knocking sound from outside the door, Yuan Ming put away the Stealing Heaven Tripod, got up to tidy up the Array he had arranged, then removed the talisman from the door and, with a "squeak," opened it.
Standing outside was none other than Xi Ying's uncle, Xi Dongliu.
Upon seeing Yuan Ming, the impatience between his eyebrows quickly faded, replaced by an eager smile.
"It turns out to be Senior Xi. I apologize for opening the door late; I was cultivating just now," Yuan Ming said with a bow.
"No harm done, no harm done. It was presumptuous of me to disturb you," Xi Dongliu replied with a smile and a wave of his hand.
"I wonder what brings Senior here?" Yuan Ming invited him in as he spoke.
"It's nothing serious. Xi Ying went straight to the forbidden lands upon her return, and I feared I had neglected you, Daoist friend, so I came to see you. Also, I have acquired a jug of Two Extremes Immortal Brew and wonder if you would honor me by sharing it?" Xi Dongliu naturally sat down at the table, turning towards Yuan Ming with a smile.
"It is my honor, Senior," Yuan Ming replied with a smile.
From their first meeting, Yuan Ming had sensed that Xi Ying's uncle did not hold much fondness for him, making his current demeanor somewhat baffling to Yuan Ming.
Once Yuan Ming had also taken his seat, Xi Dongliu swept his palm, and an old-fashioned bronze wine jug appeared on the table.
At first glance at the wine jug, Yuan Ming's eyes flashed, for on it was clearly a small rune formation.
"What kind of wine requires a rune formation to contain it?" Yuan Ming sensed that Xi Dongliu might have ill intentions.
As if noticing Yuan Ming's puzzled look, Xi Dongliu explained:
"Fellow Daoist Yuan must not misunderstand. This Two Extremes Immortal Brew was made with Extreme Cold Spirit Marrow and Fire Element True Liquid as ingredients—a top-grade ambrosia. Because the ice and fire elemental powers maintain a delicate balance, they are easily affected by outside influences and lose their spiritual energy. The Array on this wine jug is meant to preserve the fresh brew's spiritual power."
Yuan Ming was familiar with the names of Extreme Cold Spirit Marrow and Fire Element True Liquid. The former was a top-grade Ice Attribute spiritual material that could only be extracted from one out of a million ten-thousand-year-old Cold Crystals, while the latter compared to the True Sun Fire, a Fire Attribute spiritual material.
It was indeed no small feat to combine these two opposing attributes into an Immortal Wine.
"Such extreme cold and extreme heat, I suppose it's not something ordinary people can enjoy, right?" Yuan Ming had a vague idea of what Xi Dongliu was up to, but still maintained his composure as he spoke.
"Hehe, not bad. This Spiritual Wine is not for cultivators below the Nascent Soul Stage. Those beneath it who take even a single sip will be eroded by the extreme cold and extreme heat—minor consequences would be the complete dissipation of their cultivation; major ones, death and the vanishing of their dao...""
Xi Dongliu was halfway through speaking when he suddenly glanced sideways at Yuan Ming, feigning confusion, he asked, "Fellow Daoist Yuan, you haven't reached the Nascent Soul Stage, have you?""
Yuan Ming always acted with caution and was used to concealing his aura. Even upon arriving at this villa, the aura he displayed had always been that of someone in the mid-stage of Core Formation.""
Of course, Xi Dongliu didn't believe this.""
In his view, someone who could accompany his eccentric and reclusive niece to this place must be highly trusted and even closely related to her. How could such a person merely be at the mid-stage of Core Formation?""
"Whether or not I've reached the Nascent Soul Stage, does that mean I can't taste the Immortal Brew you've got there, senior?" Yuan Ming countered.""
"If you haven't reached the Nascent Soul Stage, I would advise you to know when to retreat," said Xi Dongliu upon hearing this, the corner of his mouth revealing a smirk, seemingly hinting at something.""
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming seemed oblivious to the implied message, and instead, his interest piqued as he said, "Since senior says so, I'm actually quite eager to have a good taste.""
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, do you really want to try?" Xi Dongliu frowned unconsciously upon hearing this.""
Yuan Ming had already gestured with a wave of his hand, placing two green jade porcelain cups on the table.""
Seeing this, Xi Dongliu stopped persuading him, smiled, lifted the jug, and poured the wine into both cups.""
"Then, please, Fellow Daoist Yuan, taste for yourself," he said, picking up a cup first.""
Yuan Ming was not polite; he picked up his cup, clinked it lightly against Xi Dongliu's, and brought it to his lips.""
A strong fragrance immediately assaulted his nostrils, and with an exclamation of "Good wine!" Yuan Ming tipped the cup into his mouth without hesitation.""
Xi Dongliu, seeing this, immediately showed a look of panic on his face.""
Even he dared only sip the Two Extremes Immortal Brew in small sips, waiting for a mouthful of its potency to dissolve before daring to drink another; to engulf it all in one go, as Yuan Ming did, was no different from seeking death.""
``"
"He had wanted to use the Two Extremes Immortal Brew to test Yuan Ming's cultivation level, but had not intended to kill him.""
"Fellow Daoist Yuan...""
Before he could voice his warning, Yuan Ming's Adam's apple moved as he swallowed the liquor.""Thank you for reading. This was brought to you by *.
"This is bad..." thought Xi Dongliu, a sinking feeling in his heart.""
However, after waiting a moment, the scenario he anticipated—with a mixture of searing heat and biting cold torturing Yuan Ming to the point of rupturing his intestines—did not happen.""
"Good wine," Yuan Ming suddenly exclaimed.""
Filled with puzzlement, Xi Dongliu suspiciously lifted his cup and took a sip.""
The next instant, a cold stream and a hot stream seemed to split his throat and esophagus in two, flowing simultaneously and converging into his stomach.""
The two forces intertwined, and after being processed, the rich spiritual energy entered his Dantian.""
Then, he couldn't help but shiver and shuddered in a chill, followed by a surge of heat rising from his Dantian, causing his back to break out in a faint sweat, while his face alternated between pale and flushed.""
It took a good while before he returned to normal.""
In contrast, Yuan Ming's face did not change at all, nor did his expression shift in the slightest.""
Seeing that Xi Dongliu was still motionless, Yuan Ming picked up the jug and poured himself another cup.""
"Senior, here's a toast to you," Yuan Ming offered, lifting his cup and then drinking down.""
When he drank the first cup, he had sensed that the Two Extremes Immortal Brew was indeed no ordinary Spiritual Wine; the spiritual energy within was very pure and extremely domineering. Had it not been for his robust physique and the power of the Undying Tree within him, he wouldn't have been able to consume it so easily.""
That single cup had nearly replenished all the mana he had depleted while refining the Stealing Heaven Tripod.""
Now that he knew it was good stuff, Yuan Ming naturally wouldn't let it go.""
After that cup, he immediately poured another, then another, drinking cup after cup.""
At first, Xi Dongliu was still immersed in shock, but soon he realized something was amiss. After several cups, Yuan Ming showed no sign of discomfort; on the contrary, he seemed to be getting into the drink.""
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, this Two Extremes Immortal Brew is too domineering; it's not suitable..." Xi Dongliu hurriedly warned.""
"It's fine, it's fine, come, let's drink another cup..." But Yuan Ming, with flushed cheeks, pulled Xi Dongliu into a toast, clearly drunk.""
Xi Dongliu, pained for his freshly brewed wine, quickly grabbed the jug, intending to take his leave.""
As he lifted the jug, he realized it was already empty, feeling as if he had swallowed a living fly, an unbearable discomfort assailed him.""
Once he left with a belly full of frustration, Yuan Ming closed the room door and couldn't help but let out a burp.""
Immediately, his reddened face quickly returned to normal, showing no signs of drunkenness. However, he was still puzzled—why had Xi Dongliu attempted to probe his cultivation level?""

chapters.title: Chapter 674 - 645: True Face
chapters.content:
Xi Dongliu came to a secret chamber in the rear courtyard with a face as dark as iron.
Before entering, he adjusted his emotions and then knocked and walked in.
Inside the chamber, a delicate white jade incense burner was placed on a desk, diagonally holding a stick of blue Spirit Incense, which was slowly burning and emitting curling smoke.
Next to the white jade incense burner, two paperweights were pressing down on a sheet of white rice paper. A young man wearing a white robe embroidered with golden patterns was painting a portrait of a woman.
The young man was handsome and carried an extraordinary aura, merely standing there with a brush made one think of the term 'divine elegance'.
The woman he was painting was even more ethereal and vivid.
"Young Master Ximen," Xi Dongliu greeted the man with a bow and then spoke.
The man paused in his actions and turned to look at Xi Dongliu, his face revealing a mild smile.
"Uncle Xi, come and see how my painting is progressing," the handsome young man said.
Upon hearing this, Xi Dongliu immediately approached, scrutinizing the drawing, his eyes showing deep admiration.
"The likeness is only seventy percent, but the spirit captures ninety percent. I didn't expect that after so many years without seeing Miss Xi, Young Master Ximen could still paint such a lifelike portrait, truly a testament to your devoted heart," Xi Dongliu praised as he clapped his hands.
The handsome young man called "Young Master Ximen" was named Ximen Rui, a favorite son of the Nine Yin Venerable, the leader among the Six Venerables of Wuyue Sect.
"My heart for Xiao Ying has never changed, but I wonder what she thinks?" Young Master Ximen said, a trace of sorrow in his expression.
"Miss Xi's thoughts have always been hard to predict, but I believe with her wisdom, how could she not understand Young Master Ximen's sincere heart? Moreover, everyone in the Xi Family believes that you two are a match made in heaven," Xi Dongliu asserted.
Upon hearing this, the sorrow on Ximen Rui's face disappeared, replaced by joy.
"Uncle Xi, the young man who returned with Xiao Ying, how is his strength?" Ximen Rui straightened up and inquired seriously.
"That guy is a bit strange..." Xi Dongliu hesitated, not quite sure how to describe him.
"Hmm? How much did he drink?" Ximen Rui frowned and asked.
The pot of Two Extremes Immortal Brew was in fact a gift he had given to Xi Dongliu to assess Yuan Ming's strength.
Xi Dongliu raised a finger.
"He only drank one cup. He must be in the Nascent Soul Realm, but at most he has just broken through, and his realm is not yet fully stabilized," Ximen Rui sighed with relief.
If Yuan Ming was just a Nascent Soul Early Stage Cultivator, he would not be a concern at all.
"No, that pot of Two Extremes Immortal Brew, I only drank one cup, and he drank the rest," Xi Dongliu shook his head and said with a wry smile.
Upon hearing this, Ximen Rui's pupils slightly constricted and the smile that had just formed at the corners of his mouth stiffened, showing an incredulous expression.
"You're saying he almost finished that pot of Two Extremes Immortal Brew?" Ximen Rui couldn't help but reconfirm, his voice involuntarily raising.
"Not only did he finish the Two Extremes Immortal Brew, but throughout, his expression was natural, without showing the slightest unusual demeanor, and his face didn't even flush," Xi Dongliu explained.
"This suggests that he's very likely a seasoned Nascent Soul Middle Stage Cultivator and possibly also a cultivator proficient in Body Cultivation with a formidable body," Ximen Rui analyzed, recovering from his initial surprise.
"That's what I was thinking too," Xi Dongliu nodded, agreeing.
Ximen Rui's eyebrows furrowed slightly, and he fell silent.
Just then, Xi Dongliu's expression suddenly changed, followed by a look of joy.
"What's the matter?" Ximen Rui asked, surprised.
"Miss Xi has finished her seclusion; let's go greet her," Xi Dongliu said.
"Good," Ximen Rui immediately exclaimed with joy.
They quickly arrived at the entrance to the final courtyard, just as Xiao Ying was walking out from the barrier of the gateway.
With just one glance, Ximen Rui was stunned.
The Xiao Ying before him bore little resemblance to the figure he could capture on paper.
She wore a water-blue gown, her black hair cascading like a waterfall casually pinned with a wooden hairpin, her face bare of any makeup, and devoid of any adornments. Her flawless visage alone brightened the entire courtyard like springtime.
Her slightly cold demeanor added a chilling touch to the spring aura, giving her whole presence an ethereal quality, as if she were a Nine Heavens Fairy residing alone in Chang Palace, untainted by any dust.
"Miss Xi..." Even Xi Dongliu showed a look of surprise.
Ximen Rui couldn't help but swallow hard, awakened by Xi Dongliu's soft call.
"Xiao Ying, congratulations on your successful emergence from seclusion. Here is an Ocean Relic Pearl that I spent many years acquiring from overseas, a congratulatory gift from me," he immediately stepped forward, presenting a fist-sized snowy white Treasure Bead.
The bead, similar to a clam pearl but containing immensely rich and vast Water attribute spiritual power, was evidently an exceedingly valuable treasure.
To their surprise, Xiao Ying didn't even glance at it, merely greeted Xi Dongliu and then asked,
"Uncle Xi, where have you placed Fellow Daoist Yuan?"
Xi Dongliu was momentarily caught off guard and casually revealed Yuan Ming's location in the courtyard.
By the time he realized his mistake, Xiao Ying had already left the courtyard, her figure disappearing from sight.
"Young Master Ximen..." Xi Dongliu said somewhat awkwardly.
Ximen Rui's eyes twitched slightly before he quickly put on an indifferent demeanor, laughing as he said, "It's no big deal..."
Meanwhile, Xi Ying swiftly reached Yuan Ming's door and knocked.
Yuan Ming had just refined all the spiritual power contained in the Two Extremes Immortal Brew, and the flush on his face had not yet completely faded.
Previously, he had suppressed the potency of the brew forcibly, waiting until Xi Dongliu left before releasing it, only to discover that the potency was even more domineering than he had anticipated. Despite his strong divine soul, he had almost succumbed to inebriation.
However, after refinement, the benefits were quite apparent; the intense heat from the Two Extremes Immortal Brew was somewhat similar to the Power of the Sun from the Golden Crow True Fire, greatly benefiting his physique.
As Yuan Ming stood radiating heat, he opened the door and instantly saw the elegant silhouette of the woman outside.
Even with his firm resolve, he momentarily lost his composure, thinking he had seen a fairy from the Heavenly Palace.
Ironically, in Yuan Ming's mind, a Nine Heavens Immortal should naturally bear an unadorned look, not clad in glittering, ornate Lingluo Immortal Robes.
It was for this reason that a brief look of confusion crossed Yuan Ming's face.
"Xi Ying?" However, he quickly regained his composure, though sounding somewhat uncertain.
He had never seen Xi Ying's true form before, always encountering her as Xiao Ying, and so, when her name overlaid her true self, Yuan Ming still felt slightly uncomfortable.
Xi Ying suddenly broke into a smile, the chilliness in her expression melting away in an instant, leaving only a captivating beauty.
At the same time, Yuan Ming, still slightly flushed from cultivating, turned an even deeper shade of red.
So much so that he hadn't even had time to notice any change in Xi Ying's aura.
"Let's go, we're heading to Red Lotus Island," said Xi Ying, her smile fading as she spoke.
"Alright."
Though it was somewhat abrupt, Yuan Ming did not hesitate even slightly.
Upon saying this, the two left the courtyard and walked toward the estate's exit.
However, just as they stepped out of the third courtyard, they were met by a middle-aged man in a dark purple robe standing there, his face stern, his brows like a swordsman's and his eyes fierce, sporting a short tufted beard, exuding a stable and imposing presence akin to a tiger lying in wait.
The moment Xi Ying saw the middle-aged man, her brows furrowed.
From the subtle expressions on her face, Yuan Ming read not disgust but a sigh, as if to say "this is bad."
"Father," Xi Ying spoke up.
Always read from the source: *.
The middle-aged man was none other than Xi Ying's father, Xi Zheng.
"You still know to call me father?" Xi Zheng responded, his voice deep.
"Father, I..."
Xi Ying hadn't finished speaking when she saw her father had already walked past her.
"Come with me," said Xi Zheng, his tone authoritative and brooking no denial.
Xi Ying had no choice but to nod slightly toward Yuan Ming, then silently followed her father.
The three of them arrived at a large banquet hall where they immediately saw Xi Dongliu and Ximen Rui waiting there.
"Uncle Xi." As soon as Ximen Rui noticed this, he quickly approached with eagerness.
The stern expression on Xi Zheng's face suddenly relaxed, and he smiled, saying, "Young Master Ximen, sorry to keep you waiting."
"Not at all, today is a great day for Xiao Ying's coming out, no matter how long it takes," Ximen Rui quickly replied.
"If only Xiao Ying were as considerate as you," sighed Xi Zheng.
Xi Ying's brow furrowed slightly, suppressing her displeasure, and hurriedly said, "Father, I have urgent matters and need to leave for a while."
"Even if you had the most pressing matters, you cannot leave today," Xi Zheng said lightly after a glance at her.
As Xi Ying tried to argue, Xi Zheng had already turned his gaze to Yuan Ming and asked, "And who might this Fellow Daoist be?"
"I am Yuan Ming, a mere East Sea Wondering Cultivator," Yuan Ming replied, seeing he was asked.
"He is with me," Xi Ying said, not wanting further questioning.
However, hearing Yuan Ming was just an East Sea Wondering Cultivator, Xi Zheng lost interest in asking further and instead turned to Ximen Rui:
"How has your father been recently?"
"My father has always been busy with sect affairs, unable to get away. He actually wanted to come as well, as he has wanted to meet Xiao Ying for a long time," said Ximen Rui, not forgetting to glance at Xi Ying again.
"Normally, we elders should not meddle in the affairs of the young, but I am quite satisfied with you, and it's only right for your father to want to meet Xiao Ying. He is busy with important sect duties, so let's prioritize the Divine Sect. I will take Xiao Ying to visit him another day," said Xi Zheng, his expression gentle.
"For Uncle Xi to personally visit is an honor for me, and my father will surely be pleased to hear of it," Ximen Rui responded excitedly.
"Since Xiao Ying has been in seclusion, you two rarely meet. Make sure to get along well this time," said Xi Zheng.
"Of course, I eagerly look forward to it," Ximen Rui replied, even more delighted.
Xi Ying listened with furrowed brows but refrained from speaking out against it.
Yuan Ming, left out of the conversation by Xi Zheng, listened to his and Ximen Rui's discussion, and observing Ximen Rui's handsome face, unexpectedly found himself feeling a trace of revulsion.

chapters.title: Chapter 675 - 646: Old Friends from Past Years
chapters.content:
It wasn't long before the banquet prepared for guests was ready, and everyone took their seats to eat.
Xi Ying was forcibly seated by her father between him and Ximen Rui, while Yuan Ming was arranged to sit at a slightly distant seat at the lower end of the table.
Throughout the meal, Xi Zheng didn't stop trying to set up Xi Ying with Ximen Rui in both overt and subtle ways.
Unable to listen any longer, Xi Ying claimed to feel unwell and left the banquet after a short while.
Yuan Ming also took the opportunity to leave.
However, before the two could get far, Xi Zheng followed them out with a displeased expression on his face.
"Yuan, I ask you to rest in the guest room for a while. I have something to discuss with Xiao Ying," Xi Zheng said without giving Yuan Ming a single glance.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming did not move. Instead, he turned his gaze to Xi Ying.
Xi Ying, with a look of helplessness, nodded at him, and only then did Yuan Ming turn around and leave.
As Yuan Ming walked away, he couldn't help but find it laughable that someone as extraordinary as Xi Ying had to endure such constraints due to arranged marriages.
"Come with me." After Yuan Ming left, Xi Zheng's face darkened, and he commanded.
Without a word, Xi Ying followed him.
"I just emerged from seclusion, and the first thing when I'm out is to clash with me?" they arrived in a secret room, Xi Zheng looked at his daughter, whom he had not seen in years, and finally softened, speaking with a gentler tone.
"If you don't force me, there won't be any clashing," Xi Ying replied, calm and unhurried.
"Force you? This is your duty as a member of the Xi Family," Xi Zheng retorted with dissatisfaction.
"Since when has the Xi Family fallen so low as to take female marriage alliances as their mission?" Xi Ying raised an eyebrow and countered.
"Nonsense, Xiao Ying, you have been exceptionally intelligent since you were young, and I have indulged you too much, allowing you to become so wilful! Do you really not know the current state of our family? Can you truly disregard the interests of the family?" Xi Zheng said angrily.
Note: Check * for any corrections.
"Did I cause the current situation of the family?" asked Xi Ying coldly.
"You..." Xi Zheng was momentarily at a loss for words due to his anger.
"Father, do you really believe that marrying into the Ximen Family will relieve us from our current predicament?" Xi Ying continued.
"At least the Nine Yin Venerable is the strongest among the Six Great Venerables, and marrying into his family would be most beneficial for our Xi Family," Xi Zheng finally admitted after hesitating for a moment.
"Father, continuing to submit to the Wu Yue Sect is fundamentally a misguided path of no return. Aligning with the Ximen Family through marriage is just a temporary relief. If the Xi Family truly wants to become strong, the only way is to break free from the Wu Yue Sect's control," Xi Ying coldly left these words and turned to leave.
No matter how much Xi Zheng called after her from behind, she did not stop for even a moment.
The father and daughter parted on bad terms, and Xi Ying went straight to Yuan Ming, and the two immediately left the villa, heading towards Red Lotus Island.
...
About a month later, at Red Lotus Island, the Xiao Family.
Outside a grand estate, Yuan Ming and Xi Ying stood shoulder to shoulder, with a woman dressed in water-blue clothes and a veil standing beside them.
"Is it really okay to let her go back like that?" Yuan Ming asked, frowning as he looked at the woman beside him.
"Don't worry, Xiao Ying's Divine Soul has grown stronger under my nourishment than before. It's just that her cultivation will have no choice but to fall back to the early-stage Foundation Establishment without my mana support. However, with the foundation I've laid for her, her future cultivation path will be much smoother without any side effects," Xi Ying said.
"What about her memories?" Yuan Ming inquired.
"Under normal circumstances, her memories will stay at the time she came to Biluo Cave, but over the years, I have been weaving dreams for her using Divine Soul Secret Techniques. Once she awakens, those dream experiences will become her memories. The time and place are roughly the same as mine, only the experiences differ. Without a High-level Soul Cultivator investigating, it won't be discovered," Xi Ying explained with a smile.
Yuan Ming nodded, understanding, and didn't ask any more questions.
"It's almost time. She can go back now," Xi Ying looked around and then snapped her fingers with a "pop."
Xiao Ying, who had been standing idly by, suddenly shuddered.
Under her veil, her originally vacant eyes began to shine, gradually regaining consciousness as if life were returning to them.
Unaware of the two people beside her due to the Illusion Technique, Yuan Ming saw her expression change from dullness to joy and then her eyes becoming moist as she ran towards the grand estate.
"What's happening to her?" Yuan Ming asked, surprised.
"The last part of the memories I fabricated for her was that she left home to travel to the East Sea, where she was attacked by someone of unknown identity, causing her cultivation to drop. After much difficulty, she finally returned to Red Lotus Island and the Xiao Family," Xi Ying clarified.
"You have thought of everything," Yuan Ming said, realizing and nodding with a smile.
From the distance, a cheer rang out from the entrance of Xiao Mansion. The gatekeeper, steward, and maids surrounded Xiao Ying and escorted her through the gates.
"That's that, let's be on our way," Xi Ying retracted her gaze and suggested.
The two turned to leave, heading in the direction away from Red Lotus Island.
But they hadn't gone a hundred steps before encountering a tall woman dressed in Southern Border attire, walking towards the Xiao Mansion.
Her features were delicate, with distinct facial structures and her hair braided into small twists, gathered at the back of her head. She clearly had the characteristics of the Southern Border People, yet around her was an aura of refreshing vigor.
As they passed by each other, Yuan Ming's pupils shrank suddenly, and he came to a halt.
The woman quickly walked away, but he turned his head sharply to gaze after her retreating figure.
Upon seeing this, Xi Ying frowned slightly and asked, "What's wrong?"
"It seems like I've encountered someone from the past…" Yuan Ming said hesitantly.
He did not recognize the figure himself; it just looked somewhat familiar to him. However, the aura emanating from her gave him a inexplicable sense of familiarity.
"Someone from the past?" Xi Ying scrutinized and asked.
"Forget it, better not to disturb her," Yuan Ming shook his head and said.
"If it is really an old acquaintance, you can't just let it go. She has the aura of a Soul-locking Array on her," Xi Ying said, frowning.
"Soul-locking Array?" Yuan Ming said in surprise.
"It's an Array to prevent the dispersal of Mana, usually employed to assist those who are severely injured or whose Dantian is destroyed in confining their mana," Xi Ying explained.
"She doesn't look like someone who has been gravely injured though?" Yuan Ming wondered aloud.
"That's exactly the issue. Cultivators without mana leakage problems would never imprint a Soul-locking Array on themselves, as it can interfere with the flow of Mana and, in serious cases, lock the Mana completely, making it impossible to cast Magic," Xi Ying explained.
Yuan Ming's eyes couldn't help showing a shade of worry upon hearing this.
"Is there a way to break it?" Yuan Ming asked.
"Of course there is, but you have to tell me first, who is she to you?" Xi Ying raised her eyebrows and asked.
"Do you remember Hagon?" Yuan Ming asked.
"Your friend who turned into a Human Demon at the Biluo Cave?" Xi Ying had some recollections of him.
"The girl who just passed by seems to be his daughter, Tuya," Yuan Ming said solemnly.
"If it's indeed her, then we definitely cannot stand idly by," Xi Ying nodded, at his words.
"But I remember that she was already taken in by a Sect for Cultivation, so how could she appear in the Xiao Mansion?" Yuan Ming pondered with doubt.
He vaguely remembered that when he possessed Divine Soul Tuya, he saw the veiled woman who once saved him recruit Tuya into her Sect.
Could that woman also belong to the Xiao Family?
Yuan Ming's eyes brightened, and a surprise joy emerged in his heart.
Over the years, he'd thought of finding that person to repay the life-saving favor of that elixir on the riverbank, but survival and constant wandering had never allowed his wish to be fulfilled.
"Just go and ask her, and you'll find out," Xi Ying said.
"Alright," Yuan Ming immediately nodded in agreement.
Soon, they arrived at the entrance of the Xiao Mansion. Xi Ying, unhurriedly, took out an antiquely designed bronze oil lamp. With a gentle rub on the wick, she lit a small flame.
Accompanied by the light of the flame, a layer of scarcely perceivable Divine Soul Power began to spread, covering the bodies of both Yuan Ming and Xi Ying.
"Let's go," Xi Ying said.
"Just walk in like this?" Yuan Ming asked in surprise.
"This lamp is called the Divine Concealing Lamp. With the support of my Mana, the fluctuations it emits can conceal our Divine Soul Aura and twist the perception of those around us through waves of Soul Power, preventing them from detecting our presence," Xi Ying explained with a smile.
That said, she then led Yuan Ming straight into the Xiao Mansion.
Just as she described, everyone they encountered along the way failed to see them or sense their presence.
"Don't worry, this is a Magic Treasure of very high rank. With my Soul Power supporting it, unless it's a Nascent Soul Late Stage Cultivator or someone with greater Divine Soul Power than mine, we cannot be detected," Xi Ying reassured Yuan Ming through a transmitted voice.
Therefore, they brazenly made their way deeper into the Xiao Mansion.
While Xi Ying occupied Xiao Ying's Physical Body, she lived there for a while and was quite familiar with the mansion. She quickly led Yuan Ming to the area where guests were accommodated.
However, upon reaching this courtyard, they searched but could not find Tuya.
Just as Yuan Ming was hesitating whether to use the White Jade Lotus Platform to fully scan the entirety of Red Lotus Island, a series of footsteps came from outside the courtyard.
Then, two figures walked in.
The brisk woman dressed in Southern Border attire with her hair in small twists was indeed Tuya.
Following her was a tall young man with a sycophantic smile plastered across his face, dressed in luxurious green robes, reaching out to pull on Tuya's sleeve.
"Uncle Master Xing Rong, I appreciate your kindness, but there's no need. I need to concentrate on studying arrays lately and really don't have time to go out with you," Tuya dodged his hand while maintaining basic civility with an air of resistance.
"Tuya, your Third Senior Sister asked me to take care of you. That includes not just your safety but also your mood is important. You've been down lately, and I feel troubled seeing that. Why don't you accompany me to the Beisha Sea Domain for a break?" The tall man, addressed by Tuya as Xing Rong, was persistent as he tried to persuade her.

chapters.title: Chapter 676 - 647: Soul-locking Array and Spirit Bone
chapters.content:
"Uncle Master, I speak to you courteously because of my respect for you as my uncle," Tuya finally lost her patience and said with indignation. "If you persist in this wearisome behavior, don't blame me for reporting everything that happened during these days to Master once he leaves seclusion."
"Tuya, I mean well too. Since you truly do not wish so, I will not insist," Xing Rong, clearly wary of Tuya's master mentioned, gave in immediately.
"Farewell," Tuya bowed with her fists clasped, turned around, went back to her room, and shut the door.
Xing Rong watched this scene, the smile on his lips slowly fading into a sneer.
"Tch, the same as your master?" he spat lightly, turned, and left with his hands behind his back.
Yuan Ming watched his departing figure, a frown tightening on his face.
"He was clearly already refused, yet he persisted—such a person is truly lacking in grace," Xi Ying said with disdain, as if recalling something.
With that, the two approached Tuya's room door.
Just as they stepped onto the doorway, a faint halo of light suddenly illuminated, revealing a secretly drawn Array which appeared out of nowhere.
However, as the flame on the oil lamp suddenly leaped, the newly appeared Array quickly vanished.
"Were we discovered?" Yuan Ming felt a tightening in his chest, the sensation of being caught red-handed.
"Not likely, it only stirred a slight ripple, nothing serious," Xi Ying shook her head and spoke through a transmission.
However, no sooner had her words fallen then a low shout came from inside the room, "Who's there? Who is it?"
As the words fell, the light from the Array on the ground suddenly expanded, and Array runes expanded towards Yuan Ming and his companion.
Seeing this, Xi Ying tapped the Divine Concealing Lamp she held, causing its wick to flare brightly.
The expanding Array patterns quickly swept over them, yet elicited no response.
"Strange, was there a misperception?" a voice of surprise came from inside the room.
"This girl has some talent in Arrays, being so sensitive to its activation is quite uncommon," Xi Ying murmured in surprise.
"It seems she also has her own remarkable experiences," Yuan Ming sincerely felt happy for her.
"Let's go meet her," Xi Ying said.
Having said that, the two revealed themselves and directly pushed open the room door.
The next instant, the light from the floor surged dramatically, and a Confinement Array surged upwards, enveloping Yuan Ming and his companion.
Xi Ying chuckled lightly, waved her hand, and the light from the Array dimmed immediately.
"Who are you?" Tuya's face showed a tense expression as she looked at the strangers who appeared suddenly.
Yuan Ming remembered he had altered his appearance, and immediately lifted his hand to swipe his cheek, restoring his original features.
"Tuya, it's been a long time. Do you remember me?" Yuan Ming asked.
Upon hearing Yuan Ming's voice, Tuya was instantly stunned. She stared at Yuan Ming's face, her gaze shifting from doubt to confusion, and then from confusion to disbelief.
"Is it really you?" she asked with a trembling voice.
"It seems you still remember me," Yuan Ming said with a smile, nodding his head.
"Remember, of course, I remember. Benefactor brother, I still keep the things you gave me," Tuya said, excitedly pulling out a delicately tied small cloth pouch from inside her collar.
Yuan Ming recognized it immediately—it was the peace charm he had given Tuya back then, containing the Martial Arts Mantra of the Biluo Skill.
"I didn't expect you to still have it," Yuan Ming also couldn't help but sigh lightly.
"Every achievement I have today owes to you, brother, for saving my mother and me. I will never forget it for as long as I live," Tuya's eyes slightly reddened as she spoke, and she was about to kneel in gratitude.Thе rеfеrеnсе vеrsiоn оf this сhаptеr is оn М*V*LЕМРYR.
"There's no need for that," Yuan Ming quickly stepped forward to support her.
Afterward, he closed the door, and the three sat down around a round table.
"How is your mother?" Yuan Ming asked.
"Mother was just a mortal after all, with a frail constitution. Even with elixirs to prolong her life, she has passed away," Tuya said, her expression slightly darker.
Yuan Ming sighed softly upon hearing this, then asked, "Then why are you here at Xiao Mansion on Red Lotus Island?"
"The ancestor of Xiao Mansion was an old friend of my master and had received some favors from my master. Recently, as my master went into seclusion for cultivation, and considering that I have some talent in Array cultivation, she sent me here to study under Xiao Family's Ancestor for a while," Tuya thought for a moment and explained.
Upon hearing mention of the veiled woman who had once saved him, Yuan Ming asked, "Your master... who is she?"
"She is... the Third Elder of the Senluo Sect," Tuya hesitated for a moment, but considering that Yuan Ming was her savior, she felt there was nothing that couldn't be told and thus she disclosed the truth.
"Oh, so she is a cultivator of the Senluo Sect," Yuan Ming thought to himself.
He did not continue to inquire about the veiled woman, planning to visit her personally later.
"Benefactor brother, did you come to Xiao Mansion specifically to find me?" Tuya asked with some anticipation.
"Not entirely..." Yuan Ming said after a slight hesitation.
"So, it includes seeing me as well." Tuya's eyes brightened and a joyful expression instantly appeared on her face.
Only then did her attention shift to Xi Ying, who was standing beside her.
Because she had used an Illusion Technique, the Xi Ying she saw was still beautiful, but there was a great disparity from her real appearance.
"This beautiful sister must be Brother's Daoist companion, right? Truly a match made in heaven." Tuya couldn't help but praise.
Just as Yuan Ming was about to explain, he saw Xi Ying had already grasped Tuya's hand, smiling as she complimented, "Little sister has really good eyesight. For our first meeting, big sister will give you a gift."
With that, she had already taken out an octagonal Array Plate and placed it in Tuya's hands.
Tuya merely glanced at it, at first stunned, then her eyes immediately showed surprise, but soon after, she repeatedly waved her hands to refuse, "Sister, this gift is too precious, Tuya cannot accept it."
Xi Ying glanced at Yuan Ming and subtly signaled with her eyes.
"Accept it, big sister sees that you have a talent for Formation and specifically chose this gift for you. Use it well in the future, don't waste big sister's kindness," Yuan Ming, catching the hint, said with a smile, encouraging her.
"Then... Tuya thanks big sister," Tuya said, bowing slightly to Xi Ying upon hearing this.
"Speaking of which, I noticed you placed a Confinement Array at the doorway. Are you guarding against something?" Xi Ying asked with a smile, unconcerned.
Hearing this, a slightly embarrassed expression appeared on Tuya's face.
"What's wrong?" Yuan Ming pressed on.
"This is to guard against that Uncle Master Xing Rong. He... he has always wanted me to become his Daoist companion, but I have no romantic feelings for him. Previously in the sect, he restrained himself somewhat, but after coming to the Xiao Family, he became much bolder, several times... several times..." Tuya said, somewhat embarrassed.
Yuan Ming and Xi Ying exchanged looks, communicating via Divine Thought, "That Soul-locking Array?"
"Whether it's related to him, I can't quite say yet," Xi Ying silently shook her head.
Seeing that the two of them did not speak, but their expressions were somewhat grave, Tuya quickly reassured them, "Don't worry, I'm just being cautious. With my master backing me up, Uncle Master wouldn't dare to truly do anything to me."
"It's evident, your master is very good to you," Yuan Ming nodded and said.
"Master is the kindest person to me, after mother and benefactor brother," Tuya immediately nodded in agreement.
"Seeing you like this now, I believe your father's spirit in heaven would also feel happy," Yuan Ming said, looking at her face that resembled Hagon's, showing a warm smile.
Upon hearing this, Tuya's eyes couldn't help but redden.
"Alright, we must leave now. Do not mention our meeting to anyone," Yuan Ming instructed.
"Will we meet again?" Tuya hurriedly asked.
"We will," Yuan Ming nodded and said.
Upon hearing this, Tuya's eyes instantly showed a delighted expression.
Yuan Ming and Xi Ying walked out of the door, declining Tuya's offer to see them off, and once again activated the Divine Concealing Lamp.
Upon reaching the courtyard, Xi Ying suddenly spoke, "I just examined her bones. Aside from finding that she's been implanted with a Soul-locking Array, I discovered something else."
"What?" Yuan Ming furrowed his brow and asked.
"She possesses a rare Dao Pattern Spirit Bone," Xi Ying explained.
"Dao Pattern Spirit Bone?" Yuan Ming asked in surprise.
"It's a special talent that complements her Spirit Root. With her natural gifts, she'll have a distinct advantage in practicing Formation arts. Her intuition and sensitivity to Formations will far exceed that of ordinary people," Xi Ying explained.
"In that case, it is indeed a good thing," Yuan Ming immediately brightened.
"Indeed it is a good thing, but good things can also turn into bad ones," Xi Ying suddenly added.
"What do you mean?" Yuan Ming asked, then quickly realized.
"Are you saying that the Soul-locking Array on her is related to her Dao Pattern Spirit Bone? Could it be that someone has targeted her Spirit Bone?" Yuan Ming asked, his brow furrowing.
"Let's first go see her Uncle Master," Xi Ying did not directly answer.
Yuan Ming nodded, not saying anything further. His mighty Divine Sense immediately enveloped the entire Xiao Mansion, his Divine Thought scaling from the sky above quickly locating Xing Rong.
He was at the Nascent Soul Stage of cultivation, unique in the entire Xiao Mansion, making him easy to recognize. However, there was another presence near him, also strong and just a hair's breadth from Nascent Soul as well.
The two of them didn't think twice, immediately made their way there.
When they arrived nearby, Yuan Ming realized that it was actually inside the Xiao Family's inner garden, a secluded lake.
"This Xiao Family's Ancestor truly has considerable skills in Formation arts. During the years I was absent, he seems to have altered the layout of the Xiao Family, arranging the entire area according to a Great Array, forming a completely new Great Array. Just the intricacy of the setup is already stronger than some sects' Mountain Protection Arrays. The lake here is brimming with Spiritual Energy, and it's one of the Formation Eyes," Xi Ying looked around and suddenly said.
"Indeed, there's a secret chamber below this Formation Eye, and Xing Rong is inside that chamber," Yuan Ming sensed briefly and nodded.
Both of them rode the Divine Concealing Lamp and immediately dived into the lake.

chapters.title: Chapter 677 - 648: Killing Intent
chapters.content:
Before long, Yuan Ming and Xi Ying found a small island hidden at the bottom of the lake, right in the middle of the lake.
The island was enveloped in an Anti-water Restriction, densely covered in green trees, and there was a quaint little courtyard built within it.
Yuan Ming and his companion easily passed through the restriction and arrived outside the courtyard.
They saw that the courtyard door was tightly shut, each bronze nail on it engraved with secret symbols that interlinked and formed a Forbidden Array.
Yuan Ming made his way to the courtyard wall and observed many wall bricks also carved with some kind of runes, causing him to furrow his brows.
"How is it? Can you break through?" Yuan Ming asked.
"Breaking through is not difficult, but making sure the people inside don't notice is not easy. The runes on the walls and doors of this residence are closely connected to the person who set up the array. It's not just about breaking through; even touching it might alert him," Xi Ying said thoughtfully.
"Then let me handle it," Yuan Ming considered, then said.
Having said that, he flipped his wrist and took out the Stealing Heaven Tripod and a stick of Black Incense.
The purpose of this visit was to investigate whether Xing Rong had any malicious intentions toward Tuya. Without any evidence, he certainly wouldn't resort to force, and the Black Incense Possession was the safest method.
Yuan Ming quickly lit the Black Incense and began visualizing Xing Rong's appearance in his mind.
Shortly after, he successfully possessed Xing Rong's body.
However, the Black Incense he used was a semifinished product he made earlier, which did not allow him to control Xing Rong's actions.
Once Yuan Ming could clearly see his surroundings, he found himself inside a secret room.
The walls and floor of the secret room were also protected by an array.
"Fellow Daoist Xiao, aren't you being too cautious? This is a secret room in your Xiao Mansion; are you still worried about information leaking out?" a voice suddenly spoke up; it was Xing Rong speaking.
"Better safe than sorry. Our Red Lotus Island isn't as large and influential as your Senluo Sect. If Pan Si Island learns of our plans, you may not suffer much, but we won't withstand Pan Si Island's wrath," the Xiao Family's Ancestor spoke up, his voice aged.
"Why worry? As long as this matter is successful, Pan Si Island won't pose a threat anymore. With Senluo Sect as allies, no one will dare to provoke your Red Lotus Island in the future," Xing Rong chuckled nonchalantly.
"I hope everything goes as smoothly as you say," the Xiao Family's Ancestor replied noncommittally.
"That depends on you, Fellow Daoist Xiao," Xing Rong chuckled, then said.
"Don't worry, the restriction in Bamboo Sea Square was originally set by me. After we agreed on this matter, I modified the array there; there won't be any problems," the Xiao Family's Ancestor assured after glancing at Xing Rong.
"That's great. By choosing Bamboo Sea Square for this negotiation over the newly found Spirit Vein with Pan Si Island, we wanted to utilize the geographic advantage of the restrictions in Bamboo Sea Square. Pan Si Island is definitely going to suffer a big loss this time," Xing Rong's laughter gradually became more unrestrained.
Yuan Ming listened but didn't care too much; with the current chaos in the Southern Border, he wasn't surprised by anything and had no interest in meddling.
"I can certainly do what we agreed upon, but what about what you promised me?" the Xiao Family's Ancestor suddenly asked.
"The person has been delivered to your doorstep, and the Transplanting Technique is already prepared. Just wait for success, and it will be given to you. What are you worried about?" Xing Rong said, somewhat dissatisfied.
"There is another matter I want to confirm with you. Have you figured out how to handle that girl's master? Don't let her come knocking on our door afterwards, as I won't be able to explain it on my side," the Xiao Family's Ancestor still hesitated.
"She has been forcibly ordered by the Sect Leader to enter seclusion; she won't come out anytime soon. Once she does, we'll pin the girl's death on Pan Si Island, saying she was accidently involved during the chaos in Bamboo Sea Square, hence losing her life. With no evidence, she can only vent her anger, unable to harm anyone," Xing Rong had already planned, he stated with a laugh.
"Good, that resolves any concerns for the future," satisfied, the Xiao Family's Ancestor nodded.
"Fellow Daoist Xiao, when it comes down to it, your Xiao Family will benefit the most this time. Freed from Pan Si Island, your Red Lotus Island's influence will only grow stronger, and with the Transplanting Technique, you will be able to successfully transplant that girl's Dao Pattern Spirit Bone, and advancing to the Nascent Soul Realm is just around the corner," Xing Rong said, clucking his tongue.
Hearing this, Yuan Ming was shocked.
The Xiao Family's Ancestor was actually plotting to seize Tuya's Dao Pattern Spirit Bone?
"It won't be that easy. The Nine Palace Array Heart Technique I cultivate is an approach of integrating formations into cultivation; advancing in cultivation is inherently difficult. Even with the Dao Pattern Spirit Bone, it just increases a few chances of success," the Xiao Family's Ancestor said slowly.
Hearing this, fury surged in Yuan Ming's heart, and he quickly exited the possession state.
"How did it go? Did you find anything?" Seeing Yuan Ming awaken, Xi Ying quickly asked.
With a stony-faced expression, Yuan Ming relayed all the information he had gathered to Xi Ying.
"The Transplanting Technique... Isn't that the untransmitted secret technique of the Flower Sect? I thought it was lost; I didn't expect the Senluo Sect to also have its heritage. These two are truly ruthless; once they transplant the Dao Pattern Spirit Bone, Tuya is only left with a dead end," Xi Ying said, somewhat shocked.
"I don't care about their plots and schemes, but if they dare target Tuya, they're courting death," Yuan Ming declared, a murderous intent sparked by the only kin of an old friend facing a life-and-death crisis.
"I'll break the formation, quick and decisive," Xi Ying didn't hesitate a moment, indicating her support immediately.
Having said that, she turned her wrist, and a golden compass appeared in the palm of her hand.
"This is the Chaotic Star Plate, which can seal off an area and briefly disrupt the spatial orientation of a region, causing the originally arranged array positions to become disordered and the Array Eye to be inverted, rendering the array temporarily ineffective. Soon, I will disrupt the orientation and open this barrier, and we will act immediately," Xi Ying instructed.
"Okay," Yuan Ming nodded.
The next instant, Xi Ying raised his hand and tossed it up, causing the golden compass to soar high above the small courtyard.
Immediately after, a golden light emanated from the compass, instantly forming an immense golden shadow of the compass that overshadowed the entire courtyard.
Xi Ying raised one palm and twisted it towards the void above the compass.
The central needle of the compass immediately began to spin dizzyingly, and the positions on the compass also twisted accordingly.
Yuan Ming immediately felt the spiritual energy around him become disordered, and the runes on the courtyard's doorways and walls dimmed as if they had lost the nourishment of spiritual power.
"Let's go," Xi Ying called out in a low voice.
The two of them instantly disappeared in a flash, entering the courtyard.
In the secret room, the Xiao Family's Ancestor furrowed his brows, sensing something was off, but before he could investigate closely, that strange sensation disappeared immediately.
"What's wrong?" Xing Rong noticed his unusual behavior and quickly asked.
The Xiao Family's Ancestor hesitated slightly and shook his head.
In the courtyard, Yuan Ming and Xi Ying once again used the Divine Concealing Lamp to hide their presence.
The two headed towards the location of the secret room.
Just as they had stepped into the central hall, a red light suddenly emerged from the ground, and a fiery red array rose from the floor, instantly enveloping them in the center.Catchtheformattedversionat*.
"That's not right, there wasn't an array set up here," Xi Ying exclaimed in surprise.
At that moment, a series of footsteps came from behind the hall.
"Who dares to trespass in the Xiao Family Ancestral Hall?" a stern shout rang out as the Xiao Family's Ancestor, with one hand forming a finger mnemonic and the other pressed on his wrist, walked out from behind the hall.
"Not relying on any magic artifact, yet able to activate an array at will, your skills in formation are indeed profound," Xi Ying, seeing this, did not panic but instead spoke in admiration.
"For you to advance stealthily all the way here, you are not an ordinary individual either," the Xiao Family's Ancestor said with a cold laugh.
"And there's another one hiding, what are you sneaking around for?" Yuan Ming accused.
"Fellow Daoist Xiao, I said there was no need to hide, yet you didn't listen. Now, it has turned into a joke," Xing Rong said with a laugh as he stepped forward.
The Xiao Family's Ancestor frowned and asked in a solemn voice, "Are you people from Pan Si Island?"
Yuan Ming and Xi Ying exchanged a glance, and neither spoke.
"It seems you are. Then I cannot let you leave," the Xiao Family's Ancestor stated on his own accord.
As his voice fell, he changed the spell in his hands, and the array enveloping Yuan Ming and Xi Ying immediately burst into intense red light, with eight Fire Pythons emerging from around the array, their mouths spewing fierce flames toward the two.
The intense flames charged toward the center, colliding and instantly rising into a towering pillar of fire reaching the roof.
However, with another wave of Xi Ying's wrist, the spatial orientation of the small courtyard was suddenly disrupted again.
The eight Fire Pythons headed straight for the center abruptly turned haphazardly, spraying intense flames in different directions.
Xing Rong, narrowly missing the flames, retreated in panic, cursing under his breath, "Fellow Daoist Xiao, what the hell are you doing?"
The Xiao Family's Ancestor also encountered this situation for the first time and was somewhat at a loss.
But before he could strike again, several sharp Sword Qi had already sprung from his side.
The Xiao Family's Ancestor was shocked to see a magnificent Sword Array appear out of thin air beside him, with numerous Flying Swords undulating within it, emitting incredibly powerful Sword Qi.
Seeing this, Xing Rong also turned serious, quickly raising his hand to take out a green palm fan.
Before they could act, Silver Kong Tree Demon emerged from behind the Sword Array, shaking the wine gourd in his hand, his face looking a bit uneasy as he belched towards the two men.
He was not San Jue, that old ghost; although he had inherited his Sword Array and wine gourd, he had not inherited his penchant for drinking, disliking the act and thus, not manifesting the full power of these treasures like San Jue.
However, they were sufficient to deal with the two men before him.
"Burp..."
As the loud belch resounded, a wave of pink alcohol fumes mixed with a rich fragrance enveloped the two men, rolling over them overwhelmingly.

chapters.title: Chapter 678 - 649: Trying the Puppet
chapters.content:
The moment he smelled the alcohol, Xiao Family's Ancestor suddenly felt his mind grow foggy, as if he had drunk a hundred barrels of fine wine, and his steps became wobbly.
In a flurry, he pulled out several talismans and stuck them to his body, trying to defend himself, but it was already too late.
Seeing that things were going awry, Xing Rong hurriedly held his breath and cursed inwardly.
