But he saw himself retreating more than a dozen steps, while simultaneously waving the fan in his hand. A yellowish fierce wind surged out, rapidly growing in scale and turning into a ten-zhang-tall tornado that spun around the area with a howl.
Even though the small courtyard was blessed with an Array, the rooftop of the hall was instantly torn off under the sweep of the tornado.
The pink alcohol vapor that had been filling the courtyard was blown away in an instant, and Xiao Family's Ancestor finally took a breath of relief, not collapsing on the spot due to drunkenness.
"Clang, clang, clang"
A series of sword ringing noises resounded one after another, and the Sword Array in mid-air, which was already poised for action, now emitted an even more brilliant sword light, with a dense swarm of flying swords shooting down from the sky, heading straight for Xiao Family's Ancestor and Xing Rong.
Xiao Family's Ancestor's pupils constricted. He twisted his wrist and a palm-sized round Array Plate appeared in his hand. He poured all his mana into it, trying to activate the Great Array of Red Lotus Island.
However, under the cover of the Chaotic Star Plate, his Array Plate couldn't even control the Array of the Xiao Family mansion, let alone the entire Red Lotus Island.
The only thing he could control at this moment was the Array of this ancestral hall courtyard.
It was fortunate he had not held back, pouring almost all his mana without reserve. Under the suppression of the Chaotic Star Plate, the runes engraved around the courtyard lit up one by one, and a powerful force began to gather towards him.
In the next instant, Xiao Family's Ancestor was enveloped in golden light, as if he were clad in golden armor, appearing like a divine being descending to the mortal world.
He raised his hand and pushed towards the torrent of flying swords. A golden shield, tall enough for a person, instantly condensed out of the void, standing in front of him.
One by one, the cyan-golden flying swords struck the golden shield, causing a series of golden iron-clashing sounds like the popping of beans, forcing Xiao Family's Ancestor to retreat repeatedly, while the golden light around his body scattered like dust.
"Aren't you going to help, quick!"
Xiao Family's Ancestor urgently shouted, but Xing Rong did not come to help.
Little did he know, Xing Rong had wanted to abandon Xiao Family's Ancestor and flee, but under the overwhelming pressure of Yuan Ming's Divine Soul Secret Technique, he had fallen into a nightmare and was now standing still in a daze.
With a sharp "clang" sound, the golden shield finally could not hold out and shattered.
Sword lights pierced through the body of Xiao Family's Ancestor, leaving him riddled with holes.
Yet Yuan Ming avoided his vital points, not taking his life directly but only rendering him temporarily incapable of resisting.Uplоаdеd by thе М|V|L(ЕМРYR) tеаm.
With an outstretched palm, he transformed into the vines of the Undying Tree, binding both the critically injured Xiao Family's Ancestor and the entrapped Xing Rong in the nightmare, bringing them both in front of him.
Xiao Family's Ancestor had completely given up resistance.
As a Peak of Core Formation Array Master, he was well-known in the Southern Border Immortal Cultivation World, never imagining that he would fall in such a way on Red Lotus Island, a place he had managed for years and filled with Arrays he had set up.
This was supposed to be his home turf, where he could wield the power of the entire island's Array and even take on Nascent Soul cultivators single-handedly if he could mobilize it.
But now, his once-prideful Formations were thoroughly suppressed, leaving him almost powerless to fight back.
"Fellow Daoists, I... I did not intend to betray Pan Si Island; it was all coerced by the Senluo Sect," Xiao Family's Ancestor tried to appear innocent as he spoke.
"Hmph, what Pan Si Island, Senluo Sect. I couldn't care less about your petty squabbles," Yuan Ming snorted coldly, speaking in an indifferent tone.
"You're not from Pan Si Island? Then I wonder how I have offended you, perhaps there has been some misunderstanding. Please give me a chance to explain," Xiao Family's Ancestor said, surprised but feeling a slight relief in his heart.
"Too late! You shouldn't have harbored bad intentions towards Tuya," Yuan Ming said with a cold smile, speaking slowly.
Upon hearing these words, Xiao Family's Ancestor's expression changed drastically.
"Your Excellency must see, Tuya is unharmed at the moment. I was just momentarily misled by others..." he had investigated Tuya's background, and could not understand why anyone other than her master would stand up for her.
Yuan Ming and his companion didn't bother to respond to him. Xi Ying placed a hand on Xing Rong's head and started to perform a Soul Search.
She wanted to know how Xing Rong had come to possess the Transplanting Technique.
Seeing this, Xiao Family's Ancestor's eyes revealed even more fear, knowing that lying was useless in front of these two, and his expression suddenly became strange.
"Go ahead, search. After the Soul Search, you will find out who is behind him," Xiao Family's Ancestor said.
Yuan Ming looked over in surprise, only to see Xi Ying frowning involuntarily.
A moment later, Xi Ying slowly opened her eyes but looked troubled, with a complex expression on her face.
"What did you see in his memory?" Yuan Ming asked.
"The Daoist Lineage of the Senluo Sect comes from the Flower Sect, and their Transplanting Technique is an orthodox cultivation practice. Also, from Xing Rong's memory, I discovered something interesting," Xi Ying pondered for a moment, then said.
"Oh? What is it?" Yuan Ming's interest was piqued when he heard this.
"The newly discovered Spirit Vein they wish to fight for this time is no ordinary Spirit Vein, but one that likely contains spirit marrow of the Five Elements Spiritual Veins," Xi Ying said thoughtfully.
"Five Elements Spirit Marrow... It is said to be Heaven and Earth Spiritual Object. Absorbing such marrow would increase one's cultivation speed by several times. If the spirit marrow is pure enough, it could even hasten the speed by tenfold," Yuan Ming's eyes shone brightly, and he exclaimed in surprise.
"This thing is different from those elixirs that speed up cultivation. There's no issue of developing a resistance to it if consumed too much because it doesn't contain nature's spiritual energy. Instead, it has the ability to widen a cultivator's meridians for a period of time, speeding up the circulation of mana and spiritual power inside their body, thus increasing the speed at which a cultivator absorbs spiritual energy," Xi Ying explained with a smile and a nod.
"My Spirit Root has been tempered by the Ju Mang Spirit Technique and is now not inferior to the Heavenly Spirit Root. If I can get this Five Elements Spirit Marrow, my cultivation speed will surely increase tenfold. It seems I'll have to go take a look at the excitement there," Yuan Ming said joyfully.
"There's also some bad news," Xi Ying's smile gradually faded, and she continued.
"What is it?" Yuan Ming asked, puzzled.
"This time, Xing Rong's visit to Red Lotus Island and colluding with the Xiao Family against Pan Si Island are orchestrated by Wu Yue Sect. They plan to annihilate Pan Si Island and then slowly take control of the entire Southern Border using Senluo Sect as their proxy. The one responsible for moving this plan forward is one of the Six Venerables of the Wu Yue Sect, 'Venerable Xian Kong,'" Xi Ying said with a slight hesitation.
"Venerable Xian Kong?" Yuan Ming felt the name was somewhat familiar.
The next instant, his expression changed, and he suddenly looked at Xi Ying and said, "Isn't Venerable Xian Kong your father?"
Xi Ying silently nodded.
The Xiao Family's Ancestor, standing nearby, had his expression change dramatically, a look of surprise flashing in his eyes.
"So we are all on the same side after all, isn't it like a flood washing over the Dragon King Temple—a complete misunderstanding." The Xiao Family's Ancestor quickly said.
Yuan Ming couldn't be bothered to respond and waved his hand, causing a tendril to wrap around the man's throat and mouth, making him only able to utter muffled sounds.
"Wu Yue Sect is making moves against both the East Sea and the Southern Border; it seems they have grand ambitions. What's your take on this?" Yuan Ming asked.
"My father following Wu Yue Sect is a path with no future—a dead-end," Xi Ying said without hesitation.
"Hearing you say that, I'm relieved," Yuan Ming nodded.
"So what are your plans going forward?" Xi Ying asked.
"My situation with Wu Yue Sect has become one where neither side can rest until the other is dead. If they hadn't been meddling, I wouldn't have bothered with the affairs of Southern Border. Now that I know they are the ones stirring the pot, naturally, I cannot let them have their way," Yuan Ming said with a smile.
"What about these two?" Xi Ying asked hesitantly.
"I've never refined Undead Tree Puppets before; they'll be perfect for a trial run. But before that, let's plant a Soul Descent Talisman in them," Yuan Ming stated.
Having said that, his gaze fell upon the Xiao Family's Ancestor.
The latter was already terrified out of his wits, struggling and twisting his body frantically while still making muffled noises.
Yuan Ming didn't give him the chance to speak again. With a wave of his hand, he cast the Dream Butterfly Illusion Technique, completely blocking the Xiao Family's Ancestor's five senses.
The latter's body stiffened, and he immediately stopped struggling, turning into a statue-like figure.
Yuan Ming sighed lightly and placed his hand on the Xiao Family's Ancestor's head, chanting a spell.
A pure black light emanated from his palm, and a vast amount of soul power slowly seeped into the Xiao Family's Ancestor's Sea of Consciousness, permeating his Divine Soul.
As Yuan Ming's chant changed, many black runes appeared in the black light, the runes of the Soul Descent Technique.
The black runes quickly merged into the Xiao Family's Ancestor's Divine Soul, slowly tinting it with the color of ink.
In just a short while, the Soul Descent Rune was completely implanted.
Soon, Yuan Ming applied the same method to Xing Rong, planting the Soul Descent Rune in his Divine Soul.
"Refining Tree Puppets will take some time, and this place is a good shelter," Yuan Ming said.
"You focus on refining; I'll act as your protector," Xi Ying offered.
Yuan Ming nodded. His figure began to expand rapidly, transforming in the blink of an eye into a ten-zhang tall black giant tree.
The bodies of the Xiao Family's Ancestor and Xing Rong were entwined and wrapped by layers of vines, turning into two large black cocoons hanging from the branches.
Yuan Ming didn't have an Immortal Elixir to feed them, and the method he used to refine them was slightly different from that of the Undead Tree Demons.
Inside one of the large cocoons, two vines respectively pierced into the left and right hands of the Xiao Family's Ancestor. The vine in the left hand greedily sucked away, draining the Essence Blood from the Xiao Family's Ancestor bit by bit.
From the right hand vine, a continuous flow of Undying Tree Juice seeped in at the same steady rate into his body.
This process involved replacing the Xiao Family's Ancestor's Essence Blood with Yuan Ming's Undying Tree Power and then through the integration of the flesh with the power of the Undying Tree, the refinement of a Tree Puppet was completed.
Inside the other cocoon, the same was happening to Xing Rong.

chapters.title: Chapter 679 - 650: Conspiracy
chapters.content:
Time trickled by, and in the blink of an eye, more than half a month had passed.
Inside the Xiao Family's Lake Mansion, an ancient black tree stirred restlessly, bearing two large black cocoons hanging from it like fruits.
Suddenly, with a "hiss" sound, a huge slit tore open on one of the black cocoons, and a figure tumbled out. It was none other than the Xiao Family's Ancestor.
His eyes slightly bewildered, he just lay there on the ground, motionless.
"Has he... failed?" Not far away, Xi Ying sat cross-legged, slightly surprised as she watched this scene unfold.
Before she could even extend her Divine Sense to investigate, she saw a blurred shadow of a Divine Soul fly out from the Undying Tree, landing on the Xiao Family's Ancestor's body. In a flicker, it melded into him.
The next instant, the Xiao Family's Ancestor on the ground took a deep breath and climbed to his feet.
The expression on his face was one of pain, confusion, and reluctance, but eventually, it settled into calmness. He turned and bowed to Yuan Ming, saying,
"My lord, I have seen you."
Seeing this, Xi Ying's lips curled up in a smile.
The very next moment, a tendril from the Undying Tree wrapped around a long sword and suddenly cleaved downward, striking the Xiao Family's Ancestor's shoulder.
He stood firmly in place, not dodging at all.
With a "sizzle" sound,
the Xiao Family's Ancestor's arm was severed by the sword's blade flush with the shoulder and fell to the ground.
Xi Ying frowned and looked over, only to see that no blood flowed from the severed shoulder. Instead, thin tendrils grew out on their own, intertwining and knitting together, eventually forming a new arm identical to the original.
At the same time, a face emerged from the body of the Undying Tree, speaking human words:
"My Tree Puppet and the Undying Tree Demon aren't comparable in strength, but their Divine Skills are similar. His flesh, to a certain extent, is also undying. I can also discard that body at any time, recall his Divine Soul, and condense a new shell for him, although it takes quite some time."
"To be able to do so is indeed commendable," Xi Ying said.
"With the Soul Lowering Talisman in place, my control over them far surpasses how the Undying Tree Demon controls Elder San Jue and the others," the face on the Undying Tree continued.
The implication was that the possibility of his Tree Puppets rebelling against him like Qi Ye did was absolutely impossible.
Xing Rong's Cultivation was higher, and refining him took slightly longer, yet it was only two days later than the Xiao Family's Ancestor.
However, at the same time as Xing Rong's refinement was completed, Yuan Ming encountered an unexpected joy.
After the Xiao Family's Ancestor absorbed the Origin Power of the Undying Tree transferred by Yuan Ming, his Nascent Soul Realm bottleneck, which had been unbreakable for many years, began to loosen.
Yuan Ming immediately ordered him to attempt a Breakthrough.
The Xiao Family's Ancestor was overjoyed and immediately consumed a Five Elements Infant Condensing Pill he had bought many years ago at great expense. Swallowing it, he then began his attempt to Breakthrough.
Yuan Ming's Divine Thought connected with him, and he too could feel the various inspirations during his Breakthrough.
It felt as though the tree roots clearly sensed each new bud bursting forth from the treetops, a truly peculiar sensation.
As the Xiao Family's Ancestor entered the Dao through the Formation, during his Breakthrough, the "Nine Palace Array Heart Technique" automatically operated within him, and the circulation of his Mana internally was as regulated as the operation of a Formation.
As his understanding deepened, his Mana started to uncontrollably disperse out of his body, and one Array after another formed by condensed Mana began to emerge around him, forming overlapping and intertwining patterns of light.
At this moment, Yuan Ming's mind seemed to be drawn by him, resonating and comprehending the way of the Array Formation together.
If it had been left to the Xiao Family's Ancestor's original Mana reserves alone, it would not have been enough to support such an Array Formation comprehension. Consequently, his understanding would have ceased, and his path to Breakthrough would have been severed.
It was for this reason that he had never forcibly tried to break his shackles and advance to the Nascent Soul Realm.
However, with the root foundation of Yuan Ming's Undying Tree God, he no longer had such concerns, and the abundant Mana and Life Essence Power sustained his continuous comprehension and evolution of the Array Formation.
Three days later, one Formation overlapped another, beginning to merge and converge, and eventually integrated into a Great Array with complex Array Patterns.
As the Xiao Family's Ancestor opened his eyes in that instant, the Great Array began to condense and shrink, turning into a miniature representation and returning into his Dantian.
At the same time, the rich Primordial Qi of the world around began converging into the center and surging into the Xiao Family's Ancestor's body.
Yuan Ming facilitated the rapid fusion of the Xiao Family's Ancestor's Divine Soul with the Mana pouring into his body, quickly transforming into a Nascent Soul little figure, returning to the Sea of Consciousness in the Xiao Family's Ancestor.
With this, his Breakthrough was successful, and he officially stepped into the Nascent Soul Realm.
In the following half month, Yuan Ming assisted the Xiao Family's Ancestor in stabilizing his Cultivation while also, combined with his inspirations, contemplating the true intent of the Array Formation comprised of hundreds of Array Formations within his Dantian.
His Array Formation Cultivation also rose with the tide, reaching unprecedented new heights.
"Thank you, Master." The Xiao Family's Ancestor bowed deeply towards Yuan Ming, his emotions complex.
Yuan Ming didn't mind and, after taking him into the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space, he returned to his human form.
He waved his hand, and streams of Mana burst from between his fingers, weaving and condensing in the void, quickly forming into a vast crimson Array several meters across.
Around the Array, eight Fire Dragons rose, each spewing fierce flames towards the center of the Array.
It remarkably resembled the Eight-direction Fire Python Formation previously used by the Xiao Family's Ancestor, but the one Yuan Ming displayed was more powerful, having transformed into the more formidable Eight-direction Fire Dragon Formation.
"This Wave Hand Array skill of yours is already at the level of a master," Xi Ying sincerely praised.
Brought to you by the folks at *.
The speed of Yuan Ming's development and his breathtaking learning ability made even her feel a bit alarmed.
"I can only perform a handful of Arrays effortlessly, I must continue to comprehend and learn to genuinely master this art," Yuan Ming said with a smile as he waved his hand to retract the Array.
What he didn't mention was that the reason he knew so few Arrays was that after his breakthrough in understanding, he had focused more energy on refining the forbiddances within the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
In just this past month, he had successively refined ten forbiddances.
Yuan Ming felt his connection with the Stealing Heaven Tripod growing stronger, and while the Divine Soul Power in his Nascent Soul had not noticeably strengthened, his Divine Sense had become sharper.
"It won't be long before the agreed time with the Xiao Family and the Senluo Sect; we should head to Little Silver Mountain," Yuan Ming said after getting everything ready.
"Hmm, you had sent Xing Rong back to the Senluo Sect earlier; counting the days, he should be arriving soon; indeed, it's time we left," Xi Ying nodded in agreement.
Soon after, the two left Red Lotus Island, heading towards Bamboo Sea Square.
...
Just as the Xiao Family's Ancestor began his Nascent Soul breakthrough, in the Southern Border Southern Domain, at a mountain range shrouded in thick fog.
A dazzling tunneling light flew from the horizon, directly landing before the mist, revealing the figure of Xing Rong.
Looking at the mist before him, he suddenly flipped his palm to retrieve a token and waved it forward, causing the valley's fog to immediately disperse to either side, unveiling a path leading to a towering gate.
The gate, seemingly forged from mysterious iron, appeared dark and solid, with carvings of all things in heaven and earth on the columns on either side, including plants and architectural structures as well as Immortal Demons and Exotic Beasts.
In front of each pillar stood a stone lion statue, which, upon seeing Xing Rong approach, seemed to come to life as they bowed their heads and spoke in human tongues.
"Welcome back, Ancestor Xing."
Xing Rong did not pause or react, simply passing through the gate and heading straight to the temple at the summit.
As he reached the entrance of the grand hall, before even pushing the doors, he heard a somewhat hoarse voice from inside.
"Junior Brother Xing is back? Come in. Did you accomplish anything on this trip?"
Xing Rong immediately entered the hall and looked up to see a middle-aged man wearing a black robe, with a hawk nose and wolf eyes—a decidedly difficult man to deal with—sitting at the head of the hall.
This was Luo Yongqi, the Late-stage Nascent Soul Ancestor of the Senluo Sect, and nominally, Xing Rong's senior brother.
"Senior Brother Luo," Xing Rong greeted him calmly with a cupped fist salute and then turned his head towards the three people sitting to the side.
Sitting to the left of Senior Brother Luo, wearing a dark purple robe, with sword brows and tiger eyes, exuding the serene air of a high-ranking leader, was Xi Zheng, Xi Ying's father.
Sitting opposite him was a tall man, unnaturally pale as if carved from stone. His eyes were gray and white, making him look blind, but he had a third eye on his forehead, its pupil deep purple, profound and sinister.
And beside Xi Zheng, Ximen Rui was leisurely sipping tea. Seeing Xing Rong's gaze, he put down his teacup and nodded with a smile.
"What did old Xiao Fangcheng say? Did he agree to trade with us?" Luo Yongqi asked without preamble.
"Heh, he's desperate to break through to the Nascent Soul stage. As soon as I mentioned giving him the Transplanting Technique, he immediately agreed to our terms," Xing Rong laughed disdainfully.
"That's good. With his help, our plan's chances of success increase by another notch," Luo Yongqi nodded, a flicker of joy in his eyes.
Xing Rong nodded in agreement.
At this moment, Xi Zheng suddenly gave Luo Yongqi a look, as if he had something to say.
Seeing this, Luo Yongqi immediately waved his hand, dismissing Xing Rong.
"Junior Brother Xing has done great labor this trip. Once successful, he shall be credited first. Now, having just returned, go rest," he said.
Xing Rong, having heard this, did not object. He saluted Luo Yongqi, gave the three-eyed man a final scrutinizing glance, then turned and left.
"We still can't be careless. Pan Si Island might not fully trust Xiao Fangcheng. They might have kept something back in the Array concerning their own safety; best to find out all there is, to avoid further complications," Xi Zheng cautiously said after Xing Rong had left.
"Venerable Xian Kong is right; however, although Xiao Fangcheng's cultivation isn't much, his skill in Arrays is possibly unmatched in the entire Southern Border. Even if Pan Si Island held something back, as long as he wants to scheme, it ultimately won't amount to much," Luo Yongqi asserted.

chapters.title: Chapter 680 - 651 Watching the Play
chapters.content:
Xi Zheng merely nodded silently in response to Luo Yongqi's answer.
For some reason, he always had an undefined premonition in his heart, feeling that this conspiracy would not proceed as smoothly as he imagined.
Upon this thought, he involuntarily shifted his gaze toward the direction Xing Rong had left.
It was at that moment when the man with three eyes sitting opposite him suddenly let out a low chuckle.
"Venerable Xian Kong, you are prudent and composed, but sometimes you lack the sharpness of youth. Besides, even after all your strategizing, there will always be oversights. Ultimately, some matters still depend on one's own strength. Wouldn't you agree, Fellow Daoist Luo?" the three-eyed man said, glancing at Luo Yongqi.
Hearing this, Luo Yongqi didn't concur, merely smiling lightly, his gaze rotating between Xi Zheng and the three-eyed man, detecting a subtle relationship between the two.
"If you have any discoveries, Evil Eye, just speak plainly. It's a matter of great importance. Why do you bother to engage in wordplay here?" Xi Zheng said with visible displeasure.
"You're thinking too much. What wordplay? As for the affairs of the Southern Border, you are the lead, and I am merely assisting, responsible for filling in the gaps. Naturally, I have to remind you from time to time, lest later on you blame me for not pulling my weight," the Evil Eye Venerable responded with another light laugh.
Xi Zheng's expression grew even more displeased, but in consideration of the Moon Sect's reputation, he did not want to quarrel with his own people in front of outsiders, so he suppressed his anger as if he had not heard the Evil Eye Venerable speaking.
"Evil Eye Venerable, Senior Luo, Venerable Xian Kong's worries are not without reason. Pan Si Island's power is formidable. Whether we can capture them all in one swoop hinges on the Xiao Family's Ancestor. We also need to give this more thought," at this moment, Ximen Rui suddenly spoke up in support.
This time, the Evil Eye Venerable did not continue to object.
"That's true. In that case, I'll trouble Junior Brother Xing to make another trip later, to clarify with Xiao Fangcheng in advance the construction of formations and forbidden areas in Bamboo Sea Square, and also to keep a close watch on that old guy Xiao Fangcheng, to prevent him from getting any other ideas," Luo Yongqi said, nodding in agreement at the situation.
The group then discussed the specific details of the plan for a while before dispersing.
However, 15 minutes later, Ximen Rui knocked on the door of the temporary residence of the Evil Eye Venerable.
"Venerable, those words you spoke in the hall earlier, was there a deeper meaning behind them?" As soon as he entered, Ximen Rui exchanged a few simple pleasantries before getting straight to the point.
Facing Ximen Rui, the Evil Eye Venerable was notably more amiable. When asked, he did not keep secrets.
"Of course there was. I just did not expect that Xi Zheng has regressed so much. Despite being at the Peak of Sleep Witch, he failed to notice such an obvious problem," the Evil Eye Venerable said with a cold smile on his lips.
"Oh? What seems to be the problem?" Ximen Rui asked, curious.
"That Xing Rong has been controlled by someone. The changes in his Divine Soul fluctuations on the hall earlier were quite significant compared to before. If nothing goes wrong, our plan should already be known by others. When we go to Bamboo Sea Square, it's really hard to say who will be ambushing whom. Young Master Ximen had better prepare in advance to avoid falling into a trap," the Evil Eye Venerable explained.
"I see. I hadn't thought of that. I only assumed there might have been some complications from the Xiao Family's Ancestor. Turns out the problem lies within our own ranks. Well, this is also good. We just have to watch the drama unfold. If this mission fails, we can simply place the blame on Xi Zheng. After all, the Xi Family has been growing increasingly influential in the sect. If they really succeed with the Southern Border affair, it will be difficult to suppress them later," Ximen Rui said with his usual refined demeanor, but his words were extremely cold.
"That's the idea. Just a bunch of deserters who flee from battle. Now that they see our sect rising, they want to come back. Those who sway like grass on both sides of the fence also dream of ruling a domain, how laughable," the Evil Eye Venerable said with a scornful tone.
"Indeed, if the Xi Family wants to come back, that's not impossible, but they need to recognize their position clearly. Now, even Xi Zheng's little daughter dares to show me attitude. It's sheer arrogance. I want to see, when they reach a dead end, if that noble Xi Family Princess still dares to lift her head in front of me," Ximen Rui revealed a chilling expression.
Hearing this, a barely noticeable sneer of contempt flashed across the Evil Eye Venerable's face, but he nonchalantly shifted the conversation.
"Wu Yue God designated Xi Zheng to oversee the Southern Border affair, and although I have supervisory power, it's not right for me to interfere blatantly. But since they've made mistakes on their own, we'll just wait and see the outcome. However, there's another matter that Wu Yue God personally entrusted me to do, and I'll need Young Master Ximen's cooperation with it," the Evil Eye Venerable said.
Ximen Rui gave him a curious look, then saw the Evil Eye Venerable produce a statue with a flip of his hand.
The statue depicted a man in a contemplative state, but the features were not clear—only the outlines of the eyebrows and eyes could be vaguely discerned.
"This is the statue of a False God called Nether Moon God. Young Master Ximen, you're aware that the Xi Family's Cultivation Technique is called 'Moonlight Technique.' Wu Yue God suspects that these two matters are related and thus sent me to covertly investigate the relations between the Xi Family and the Moon Sect. Young Master Ximen has been a guest at the Xi Family recently; have you discovered anything?" the Evil Eye Venerable inquired.
Examining the statue, Ximen Rui's brow furrowed slightly, then abruptly relaxed.
"I haven't seen this statue in the Xi Family's possession, but someone who looks somewhat similar to the one carved on this statue, I have met recently," Ximen Rui said slowly.
"Is that so, Young Master Ximen? May I know who that person is?" the Evil Eye Venerable asked eagerly.
"His name is Yuan Ming, he's a guest of Xi Ying. He has disguised his appearance, thinking that no one could see through him. As for the relationship between those two...well, it seems a bit ambiguous," Ximen Rui said, his words dripping with jealousy.
However, at that moment, Evil Eye Venerable had no interest in Ximen Rui's trivial and superficial concerns.
"Indeed, based on the intelligence I've gathered, there's a Divine Envoy in the Moon Sect who also has the surname Yuan. These two could very well be the same person. Young Master Ximen, could you provide more details? How advanced is this Yuan Ming's cultivation, and does he have any peculiar habits when he speaks or acts?" Evil Eye Venerable asked eagerly.
"Based on my estimation, he should at most be a Nascent Soul Middle Stage Cultivator. He might also have learned some Body Cultivation Method. As for habits, I haven't had much contact with him and haven't noticed anything," Ximen Rui said, shaking his head slightly.
"Hmm... his cultivation seems to differ from the information I have, but it's possible that he has made a sudden breakthrough. Anyway, let's not fuss over that. Since this person is suspicious, we should just capture him and perform a Soul Search. That way, we'll soon find out if he has any ties to the Moon Sect," Evil Eye Venerable murmured after a moment's thought.
"If the Venerable has such intentions, I will certainly provide my full support. However, I have one request; after the Venerable has finished searching his soul, may I take him into my own hands?" a cold glint flashed in Ximen Rui's eyes.
"If he's not someone of importance, that's possible. But if he is deeply involved with matters of the Moon Sect, we'll have to wait until I have comprehensively investigated the sect before deciding," Evil Eye Venerable did not agree immediately.The reference version of this on *.
"Of course, everything must prioritize the tasks set by Wu Yue God," Ximen Rui nodded.
...
One month later, Bamboo Sea Square.
The workshop was situated in the eastern coastal area of the Southern Border Southern Domain, bordered by the Nanyun Sea on one side and the Ten Thousand Bamboo Forest on the other. Whether sea-going cultivators wished to come ashore, or land-bound cultivators wanted to venture into the sea, they would all pass through here, stocking up on necessities.
However, with the discovery of a Spirit Vein nearby, the relations between Senluo Sect and Pan Si Island had gradually tensed. Thus, the workshop no longer bustled with the usual congregation of cultivators, and the Great Array outside the market was constantly in operation without a pause, with the streets revealing an atmosphere of tension everywhere.
Fortunately, there was recent news that Senluo Sect and Pan Si Island were about to negotiate. The war clouds that had been looming over the Southern Border had not yet formed before signs of dissipating appeared, which undoubtedly made the group of cultivators in the Southern Border breathe a sigh of relief.
However, as the Bamboo Sea Square was the designated site for the negotiations, security in the vicinity had increasingly tightened as a result.
In the sky, Xiao Family's Ancestor Xiao Fangcheng, accompanied by two Core Formation disciples, was flying towards the market at a leisurely pace. Before they could get close, a tunneling light shot out from the market and landed in front of them.
"Who might this Fellow Daoist be...eh, is that you?" As the figure emerged from the tunneling light, a burly man with a face full of meaty bulges appeared, ready to question the identity of the newcomer. Seeing that it was Xiao Fangcheng, he immediately showed surprise.
"Haha, Black Tiger Fellow Daoist, how have you been?" Xiao Fangcheng greeted with a smile and a cupped hand salute.
"Xiao Fangcheng, when did you achieve Nascent Soul? Why was there no sign of it?" The man called Black Tiger looked Xiao Fangcheng up and down with curiosity.
"Haha, it was just good fortune. Half a month ago, I unexpectedly received celestial aid and just managed to breach the Heavenly Barrier, stepping into the Nascent Soul realm. I was intending to seclude myself to stabilize my cultivation, but I couldn't stay away due to the imminent negotiations between Senluo Sect and Pan Si Island, which are of great importance. Furthermore, Bamboo Sea Square was a formation I had laid out with my own hands," Xiao Fangcheng said with a sincere expression.
"Fellow Daoist Xiao is quite thoughtful. Rest assured, as long as you're willing to help our Pan Si Island, we won't let you suffer any loss. When the Island Master arrives, I will personally report this matter and grant you some compensation," Black Tiger said prompt
"That's not necessary, not necessary at all," Xiao Fangcheng waved his hands with a beaming smile.
"Sigh, you should accept it. Consider it a congratulatory gift from our island for your breakthrough into Nascent Soul. But let's not talk more now, you know the situation. Senluo Sect has chosen our controlled workshop for the negotiations; they definitely have some scheme. I need to monitor the nearby movements in real-time, and also to keep an eye on the Great Array. Now that you're here, some of the burden can be taken off my shoulders," Black Tiger said with a laugh.
"Rest assured, Fellow Daoist, with me in control of the Great Array, I will not give Senluo Sect any chance to find a solution!" Xiao Fangcheng assured vehemently.
Black Tiger nodded, knowing that Xiao Fangcheng's skill in formations was almost unmatched, and the Red Lotus Island had long been a dependable ally to Pan Si Island, never once being rebellious. Thus, he confidently led Xiao Fangcheng into the workshop and handed over the methods of controlling the formation.
Throughout the entire process, Black Tiger's gaze never lingered on the two Core Formation disciples following Xiao Fangcheng. After completing the handover, he quickly left to take charge of patrolling and securing the vicinity of the market.
However, after Black Tiger left, Xiao Fangcheng, who had just been portraying the might of a Nascent Soul cultivator, suddenly turned around and presented the Compass that controlled the Great Array of the market to the two "Core Formation" disciples.
"Do you want to control this Dao Array?" asked the middle-aged male cultivator with a face full of pockmarks, turning his head.
"I'm not interested, let Xiao Fangcheng handle it," the plain-looking female cultivator by his side shook her head.
The two were, of course, Yuan Ming and Xi Ying.

chapters.title: Chapter 681 - 652: Testing
chapters.content:
In order not to arouse the suspicions of the Senluo Sect and Pan Si Island, Yuan Ming and Xi Ying specifically altered their appearances and concealed their cultivations, entering the workshop under the guise of the Xiao Family. With Xiao Fangcheng leading the way, neither party would pay much attention to them, which was perfect for their covert scheming to break the situation from within.
"That's good. Before the people from Pan Si Island and the Senluo Sect arrive, just put on an act, Xiao Fangcheng. Don't let anyone notice any flaws too early," Yuan Ming nodded and casually instructed.
Xiao Fangcheng nodded, put away his compass, and left the room. He took his role seriously, diligently ensuring the operation of the workshop's great array.
In the room, Yuan Ming and Xi Ying continued to discuss methods to break the situation.
"...The key actually lies with Pan Si Island. Our current identities are somewhat awkward, and it's not suitable for us to get involved directly," Yuan Ming analyzed.
"It's actually not much of an issue. Sooner or later, my father will see my stance clearly. You don't need to worry too much when making plans," Xi Ying shook her head slightly.
"I have my own considerations. Apart from the Wu Yue Sect, this matter is actually a sect rivalry between Pan Si Island and the Senluo Sect. There's no reason they shouldn't exert themselves while we take the brunt," Yuan Ming said with a smile.
"Yes, but that Five Elements Spiritual Vein is of great use to us, too. Rather than waiting for those two sects to take it, we might as well take the initiative. We'll extract the Five Elements Spirit Marrow from it and secure some benefits for ourselves first," her eyes sparkling with eagerness, Xi Ying said.
"You're really on the same page as me. However, Pan Si Island and the Senluo Sect's surveillance of that area is not weak. It will be somewhat risky for us to sneak in," Yuan Ming reminded her.
"That's why such tasks should be left to the experts," Xi Ying said with a smile. With a light tap on the Spiritual Beast Bag, Yinkong and the Five Elements Child emerged from the bag, landing in front of the two.
"...After infiltrating the Five Elements Spiritual Veins, just find and hide the Five Elements Spirit Marrow, no need to come back for now. Cultivating there for a while will benefit you as well, just be careful not to be discovered," Xi Ying simply described the location of the spiritual veins and gave her orders.
At this, Yinkong and the Five Elements Child showed great excitement, repeatedly ensuring they would complete the mission before vanishing in a flash of silver light.
...
One day later.
Above Bamboo Sea Square, Black Tiger and Xiao Fangcheng stood shoulder to shoulder, facing the sea, seemingly waiting for something.
Soon, a massive flying boat slowly emerged above the sea. The flying boat was a dark purple with a web of white patterns covering its hull, and a purple flag hung from its mast, adorned with the characters for "Pan Si," giving it an especially sinister appearance.
At the bow, two people, one seated and one standing.
The seated woman was strikingly attractive, her Nascent Soul Late-stage Cultivation apparent. She had crescent-moon, peach blossom eyes that were half-open, as if she was always on the verge of sleep, and her light red lips were slightly parted. She wore a tight-fitting dark purple robe that outlined her curvaceous figure, and her light purple hair was braided long over her left shoulder, with the end hanging in front of her chest without touching her body.
Behind the woman stood a man who bore a resemblance to Black Tiger, though his expression was more solemn and serious.
On the deck behind these two, ten Core Formation Cultivators stood, among them the shadow of Xiao Yao, brother of Xiao Ying.
Black Tiger and Xiao Fangcheng were both visibly pleased at the sight of the flying boat. However, at that moment, they heard a thunderous rumbling behind them. The ground trembled as if a colossal creature was approaching.
Surprised, they turned their heads only to see a ten-zhang tall creature emerging from the vast bamboo forest. The creature was a dark yellow, with the head of a cow and the body of a snake, ten long legs that resembled human hands crawling on the ground, yet its speed was very fast, comparable to the flying escape speed of a Core Formation Cultivator.MyVirtualLibraryEmpire(MVLEMPYR)appreciatesyourreadershipatthesource.
Atop the creature's head stood Luo Yongqi with his hands clasped behind his back, looking tranquilly at the flying boat on the sea. His gaze met that of the lady's on the bow, and he calmly nodded his head, a surprisingly composed gesture for encountering an elder from a rival sect in the Nascent Soul stage.
Behind him stood Xing Rong and another Nascent Soul-stage man with a back-carried sword, both standing quietly with their hands folded, their gazes sweeping over Xiao Fangcheng without any discernible expression.
Apart from the three Nascent Souls, eight more Core Formation Cultivators stood upon the back of the giant creature. Though fewer in number than those from Pan Si Island, their overall cultivation levels were subtly superior.
Shortly after, both the flying boat and the giant creature drew near to Bamboo Sea Square, and seemingly by some unspoken agreement, they both stopped ten miles away from the square. All the Core Formation Cultivators stayed at the giant creature and flying boat. Only the Nascent Soul Cultivators stood up and flew across, meeting above the square.
"Hehe, who would have thought — it's been a while since we've seen each other, and Fellow Daoist Xiao has broken through to the Nascent Soul stage. Island Master Luo has gained a formidable general. Congratulations are in order," Luo Yongqi was the first to speak, addressing something unrelated to the spirit vein.
However, at his words, Xiao Fangcheng's expression darkened, and the enchanting female cultivator and Island Master of Pan Si Island, Luo Zhu, also let out a cold laugh.
"Fellow Daoist Luo, as a venerable elder of the Senluo Sect, it's rather beneath you to use such words to stir up trouble, isn't it? My Pan Si Island has been on friendly terms with Red Lotus Island for generations and has never harbored any intentions of annexation. Such talk of subordinates is baseless," Luo Zhu said, crossing her arms.
"If you say so, let it be so," Luo Yongqi replied noncommittally, shaking his head.
"Enough of that irrelevant talk. Let's discuss the matter at hand. My Pan Si Island is set on that Five Elements Spiritual Vein. At most, we can offer some resources in compensation in exchange for the vein. What do you say, Fellow Daoist Luo?" Luo Zhu waved her hand and asked.
"Not much. We of the Senluo Sect are not willing to give up the vein lightly. If Fellow Daoist insists on monopolizing it, then there's no point in further discussion," Luo Yongqi shook his head, his tone still calm and steady.
"What does Fellow Daoist Luo imply?" Luo Zhu was not annoyed in the slightest, clearly aware that the Senluo Sect would never accept her recent proposal.
"Joint ownership, independent development," Luo Yongqi stated indifferently.
"Heh, that sounds simple coming from you, Fellow Daoist Luo. But even so, there should be some rules on how exactly to divide things up, right?" Luo Zhu chuckled softly.
"Of course, but such details, when have they ever needed the intervention of us Nascent Souls? Let the Core Formation Elders haggle over them. Alright, I've traveled for an entire day and am quite tired; let's start the detailed discussions and debates tomorrow," Luo Yongqi shook his head, turned around, and together with Xing Rong and the man carrying a blade on his back, flew back to where the great beast was.
Watching their departing figures, Luo Zhu's gaze flickered for a moment, but she did not speak up to stop them.
"Island Master, isn't Luo Yongqi being too easy-going this time? Could there be deceit involved?" Behind her, the Black Tiger couldn't help but speak up.
"Hmph, deceit is certain. With Luo Yongqi's character, the fact that he's willing to sit down and discuss this matter with us is already very suspicious. Tonight, you and Black Leopard keep a close watch on the Senluo Sect's camp, and remember to report immediately if you spot anything," Luo Zhu instructed.
"Yes." Black Tiger and another Nascent Soul cultivator who had accompanied Luo Zhu promptly responded.
"Tonight, I must also trouble Fellow Daoist Xiao; please ensure the Great Array runs without fault," Luo Zhu suddenly turned to Xiao Fangcheng, a glint flickering in her eyes.
"Rest assured, Island Master Luo, I will give it my all," Xiao Fangcheng clasped his hands, his expression candid, as though he never harbored any ulterior motives.
That night, at midnight, inside the City Lord Mansion of Bamboo Sea Square.
Soft knocking sounds echoed from outside the room.
"Come in."
Along with a languid voice of consent, Xiao Fangcheng pushed the door and entered, bowing to Luo Zhu, who was reclining on a soft couch.
"Island Master Luo."
"Ah, it's Fellow Daoist Xiao. What brings you to me so late? Could it be that there's an issue with the workshop's formation?" Luo Zhu asked.
As she spoke, an inconspicuous spider dropped from her hair, silently and stealthily creeping towards Xiao Fangcheng.
"The formation is intact. It's just that Island Master Luo and the disciples of Pan Si Island might be in danger," Xiao Fangcheng said, lifting his head.
"Oh? Why does Fellow Daoist Xiao say so? You've scared me quite a bit," Luo Zhu appeared somewhat surprised, sitting up a little straighter.
Outside, Yuan Ming, using the Void Transformation Technique, concealed himself and quietly observed everything happening inside the room.
At this moment, he could also faintly sense that Luo Zhu's speech carried an invisible power capable of subtly influencing Xiao Fangcheng's perception of her.
However, this did not interfere with his purpose for having Xiao Fangcheng meet with Luo Zhu.
"Has Island Master Luo heard of the Wu Yue Sect? That once destroyed Soul Cultivation Sect is stirring once more, seeking to unify Yunhuang again. They've made many arrangements across the Five Domains, and here in the Southern Border, their target is none other than Island Master Luo and Pan Si Island," Xiao Fangcheng earnestly relayed.
"Really? Where did Fellow Daoist Xiao hear this intelligence? Don't let others deceive you," Luo Zhu opened her mouth wide in a show of shock, but if one observed closely, her eyes were bright and unflustered, betraying no sign of surprise.
She seemed to have already known about this?
Yuan Ming caught the subtle change in Luo Zhu's expression and felt puzzled.
Nevertheless, he still instructed Xiao Fangcheng to speak of the Senluo Sect's schemes in detail:
"I am ashamed to say that it was Xing Rong from the Senluo Sect who informed me. Using the Transplanting Technique as bait, he wished to have me suddenly betray during the negotiations with your island, to control the workshop's Great Array and help them slay Island Master Luo and Fellow Daoists Black Tiger and Black Leopard on the spot, thus annexing the island and accomplishing the great task of unifying the Southern Border. And behind their scheme, the mastermind is none other than Venerable Xian Kong from the Wu Yue Sect."
"Oh, what a clever plan. But fellow Daoist Xiao, why didn't you say anything earlier and chose to tell me only now? Are you trying to leverage the situation?" Luo Zhu asked while her fingers made a slight movement.
At the same time, Yuan Ming noticed that a spider had climbed up behind Xiao Fangcheng's neck and, following the motion of Luo Zhu's fingers, was about to bite through his skin.
"What is the meaning of this, Island Master Luo?" Yuan Ming prompted, and Xiao Fangcheng's expression changed immediately as he reached behind his neck and crushed the spider with his hand.
Seeing this, Luo Zhu assessed Xiao Fangcheng with evident interest.
At the same moment, Yuan Ming also noticed that a strand of Divine Sense seemed to emerge from Luo Zhu's hair and sweep over Xiao Fangcheng.
This Divine Sense was extremely covert; if Yuan Ming hadn't previously experienced the power of a Half-step Spoken Witch's Divine Sense through the Stealing Heaven Tripod, and become very sensitive to such probing, he might not have even noticed it.

chapters.title: Chapter 682 - 653: Eight Core Formations
chapters.content:
"Hehe, Xiao Fangcheng didn't notice the abilities of my Silk-shedding Spider. I wonder which expert is helping me from behind. Would you show yourself?" Luo Zhu's voice had changed at this moment, no longer carrying a hint of seduction, but much more serious.
Yuan Ming's expression darkened as he thought about the unfamiliar Divine Sense he had just swept across. He could be sure that this Divine Sense was not extended by Luo Zhu, but rather, it was somewhat similar to the Divine Sense emitted by Blood Shadow and Hong Ling when they were spying on the outside from the Shura Blood Devouring Map.
After hesitating for a moment, he walked into the room and finally revealed his figure.
Seeing Yuan Ming appear silently next to Xiao Fangcheng, Luo Zhu's eyes flickered with a trace of surprise, although it was quickly concealed, but Yuan Ming sharply caught this detail.
At the same time, Xiao Fangcheng also took two steps back, retreating behind Yuan Ming like a servant.
Seeing this, Luo Zhu again showed an expression of great interest.
"Fellow Daoist is..." she probed.
"I am Nether Moon God Envoy, here specifically for matters concerning the Wu Yue Sect. Island Master Luo, you are courteous," Yuan Ming spoke blandly.
"Nether Moon God? Did Fellow Daoist come from the Northern Desert?" At this point, Luo Zhu was genuinely a bit perplexed.
Yuan Ming smiled, understanding Luo Zhu's concern, which was essentially about the relationship between the Nether Moon God and the Wu Yue God, suspecting that he belonged to another faction within the Wu Yue Sect, both venerating the Wu Yue God, just called by different names.
"To speak the truth, I came from the East Sea. Island Master Luo need not think too much. Nether Moon God is not the same as Wu Yue God, and I am certainly not from the Wu Yue Sect," he explained with a smile.
"In that case, Envoy, you and our Pan Si Island also seem to be fated. Our system for the division of the Nanyun Sea islands was modeled after the East Sea, although we've received fewer updates about East Sea lately due to some chaos there. I wonder if Fusang Island Master Gu Xuanyang is still alive?" asked Luo Zhu, feeling somewhat relaxed.
"Island Master Luo might have remembered incorrectly. Fusang Island's Master is Wan Tianren. However, due to the turmoil caused by the Wu Yue Sect, the current East Sea doesn't operate by island territories but is unified under the flag of the East Sea Alliance. Fellow Daoist Wan is recommended as the Alliance Hierarch, with my Moon Sect maintaining ties, fighting together against the Wu Yue Sect to keep the peace in the East Sea," Yuan Ming casually explained the current situation in the East Sea, avoiding falling into Luo Zhu's trap.
"Interesting. So, currently, the East Sea has been unified? In other words, although the Wu Yue Sect was driven away, what they aimed to achieve still happened; only the ones uniting the East Sea have changed. Am I understanding this correctly?" Luo Zhu smiled, her eyes and brows revealing a bit more allure.
"Correct, but the ruler of the East Sea is Wan Tianren, not the Moon Sect. This distinction, I believe, Island Master Luo can clearly see," Yuan Ming replied calmly.
"Then what capacity brings you to meet with me? Are you trying to replicate what happened in East Sea by intervening in the conflict between me and the Senluo Sect?" Luo Zhu scrutinized Yuan Ming, trying to discern his true intentions.
"Island Master Luo misunderstands my intentions. How the future of the Southern Border turns out, whether it unifies or divides, should be a decision made by the people of the Southern Border themselves. As I said before, my visit is solely concerning the Wu Yue Sect; it's not about anything else," Yuan Ming shook his head.
"Elaborate further." Luo Zhu finally restrained her expression.
"As for the plans of the Wu Yue Sect, Xiao Fangcheng has already discussed them with you. Since they choose to support the Senluo Sect, naturally, I would like to ally with your Pan Si Island. At the very least, we cannot let their schemes succeed. Of course, our Moon Sect's assistance isn't without strings attached; I hope later, Island Master Luo can lead and represent the sects of Southern Border in forming an alliance with the East Sea Alliance, jointly opposing the Wu Yue Sect," Yuan Ming revealed his thoughts.
Before coming here, he had already entertained this thought. The power of the Wu Yue Sect was tremendous, and the East Sea had temporarily repelled it, but inevitably, one day, they would return. Rather than waiting passively, it was better to make early connections with various forces, cooperate, and recreate the scene when Chang Chun Temple eradicated the Wu Yue Sect.
Hearing his words, Luo Zhu bowed her head in contemplation for a long while, then finally raised her head, her eyes meeting Yuan Ming's.
"Collaboration is possible, and I can agree to the Envoy's demands, but before that, the Envoy must show some sincerity, proving his capability to confront the Wu Yue Sect. Otherwise, our Pan Si Island is not willing to be the sacrificial pawn in a fight to the bitter end with an entity like the Wu Yue Sect," Luo Zhu said slowly.
"Isn't my helping Island Master Luo end the conspiracy of the Senluo Sect enough of a gesture of goodwill?" Yuan Ming countered.
Luo Zhu shook her_head slightly, then suddenly raised her hand. Instantly, twin Nascent Soul pressures rose from outside the house.
Yuan Ming didn't need to turn his head to know that the exit had been blocked by Black Tiger and Black Leopard, the two Nascent Souls; after all, he had already sensed these two lying in ambush nearby upon arriving here. Yet facing such a situation, he showed no fear at all, lightly snapping his fingers. The next instant, Xi Ying dissolved the Void Transformation Technique and appeared beside him.
Luo Zhu was taken aback, her expression finally turning serious.
"So, Island Master Luo wants to test our mettle? But isn't this timing for combat worrisome? Aren't you afraid of alerting the people from the Senluo Sect?" Yuan Ming smiled subtly, looking at Luo Zhu with a relaxed expression.
However, before he could finish his sentence, Luo Zhu again switched to that somewhat lazy and alluring smile.
"Ah, where has the Divine Envoy's thoughts wandered? I simply meant to say that even without the Divine Envoy's intervention, we would still capture Xiao Fangcheng tonight. I'm well aware of his betrayal, and not only that—I've also long known that the Senluo Sect is backed by the Wu Yue Sect, and I might even hold more information than the Divine Envoy imagines. For instance, it's not just Venerable Xian Kong scheming against the Southern Border, but there's also another, the Evil Eye Venerable, who is currently at the Senluo Sect's base," Luo Zhu said, waving her hand again, prompting the black tiger and black leopard outside to silently retreat, continuing to lurk in the shadows, vigilant of their surroundings.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming was somewhat surprised and turned to look at Xi Ying, only to see her shaking her head, clearly unaware that the Evil Eye Venerable was involved in this matter.
"I see; it seems we've underestimated Island Master Luo. But such information is not something ordinary people would know. How did Island Master Luo come by it?" Yuan Ming asked.
"I have my ways. The Divine Envoy need not ask further," Luo Zhu declined to explain further.
Yuan Ming's gaze flickered slightly. This secretive affair was unknown even to Xi Ying, Xi Zheng's daughter, and Xing Rong's memories contained nothing of the sort. Yet, Luo Zhu was aware and, coupled with the Divine Sense she had just revealed, this Master of Pan Si Island might not be as straightforward as she appeared.
"Let us return to our earlier conversation then. Since Island Master Luo has long been wary of the Senluo Sect's schemes, how might we demonstrate our sincerity?" Yuan Ming did not pursue the matter further, skillfully changing the subject.
"It's simple; the Divine Envoy just needs to help us kill one person," Luo Zhu said with a smile.
"As a late-stage Nascent Soul Great Cultivator, Island Master Luo would find it quite easy to kill someone. Why request our assistance? Or is the target Luo Yongqi?" Yuan Ming asked, surprised.
"Killing this person is easy, but the consequences are something we at Pan Si Island are currently unable to bear. I just don't know if the Divine Envoy dares take on this burden for us," Luo Zhu shook her head.
"Oh? Who exactly is this person?" Yuan Ming grew even more curious.
"Ximen Rui, does the Divine Envoy recognize this name?" Luo Zhu observed Yuan Ming's expression.
Upon hearing the name Ximen Rui, Yuan Ming's eyes flashed with surprise, not expecting that Luo Zhu intended to kill him.
"I have heard of him. However, Island Master Luo, you dare confront both Venerable Xian Kong and the Evil Eye, yet you fear killing this person, saying you can't bear the consequences. Isn't that an exaggeration?" Yuan Ming immediately asked.
"The son of Wu Yue Sect's strongest Venerable—the weight of this title is surely not much weaker than that of a Venerable. Moreover, Pan Si Island, after all, is but a sect in the Southern Border, weak and isolated. We are already struggling to deal directly with the Senluo Sect and the two Venerables. If we were to anger the Nine Yin Venerable at this critical juncture, I fear it might truly lead to our sect's destruction," Luo Zhu shook her head.
Hearing this, Yuan Ming indeed understood Luo Zhu's concerns.
Between Wu Yue Sect and Pan Si Island, there was actually only a conflict of interests. If one or two Venerables died, Wu Yue Sect would increase its attention to this area, but it would not immediately abandon its plans in the other four domains and attack the Southern Border in full force.
But if the son of the Nine Yin Venerable died by their hands, it was hard to say whether the furious Nine Yin Venerable would abandon his current affairs and focus all his forces on attacking Pan Si Island.
"Ximen Rui is cruel by nature, takes pleasure in tormenting others, and even secretly killed many disciples of my island, including one of my own direct disciples who was brutally murdered by him. This blood debt must be avenged. If the Divine Envoy could help us kill this miscreant, I, as the Master of Pan Si Island, can assure you that the Southern Border will definitely stand with the Moon God Sect," Luo Zhu's eyes flared with rage as she spoke, her tone filled with gritted teeth.
It was hard to imagine that the seductive, yet rational Luo Zhu showed such an emotional demeanor.Sourced directly from *.
Yuan Ming sighed, but he also became more aware of the potential reaction of the Nine Yin Venerable if he killed Ximen Rui.
Probably, he would be even angrier than Luo Zhu now, as he was his own son, after all.
Luo Zhu's request was indeed a troublesome matter.
"So, what is the Divine Envoy's answer?" Perhaps dissatisfied with Yuan Ming's silence, Luo Zhu urged with a slightly darkened expression.
To her surprise, Yuan Ming suddenly chuckled.
"Rest assured, Island Master Luo, I accept your request. No matter how powerful Ximen Rui's background may be, I will personally take his life. However, I will need some time to locate him. For now, let's focus on resolving the Senluo Sect issue first," Yuan Ming said.
"It seems the Divine Envoy is not aware that today, Ximen Rui, Venerable Xian Kong, and the Evil Eye Venerable were all among the eight Core Formation Cultivators who arrived with Luo Yongqi," Luo Zhu immediately stated.
Yuan Ming was taken aback, as he had seen those eight Core Formation Cultivators during the day, yet had not noticed Ximen Rui and the other two's disguises.
How could Luo Zhu possibly know this? Could there be a being stronger than a Nascent Soul backing her?

chapters.title: Chapter 683 - 654 Negotiation
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming thought about it and decided to suppress the doubts and curiosity in his heart.
No matter who stood behind Pan Si Island, at least in dealing with the Wuyue Sect, their interests were aligned. As for the rest, it was not yet time to delve deeper.
"The Senluo Sect will probably make a move in the next two days. By then, Ximen Rui and the others will certainly take action as well. During the chaos, it would be the best opportunity for the Divine Envoy to strike," Luo Zhu stated confidently.
"Indeed, if that's the case, I will make a move in secret when the time comes. However, if possible, it would be better than ever if Island Master Luo could hold off the others for me for a while," Yuan Ming nodded in agreement with Luo Zhu's assessment.
"I can only say I will do my best," Luo Zhu replied.
Yuan Ming did not expect her to guarantee anything. Hearing this, he chose not to say more and was ready to take Xiao Fangcheng and Xi Ying to leave the place.
But just then, Luo Zhu suddenly spoke up again.
"One more thing, please remember, the Wuyue Sect has already discovered that Xing Rong is being controlled. Whatever plans the Divine Envoy has, do not expect any help from Xing Rong anymore, and the subsequent plan should exclude him," she warned.
"Is this true, Island Master Luo?" Yuan Ming asked, his heart tightening.
"The information source is very reliable, and with such matters, it is better to err on the side of caution. The Wuyue Sect itself is proficient in exploring enemy intelligence through undercover brainwashing, so it's normal for them to be on guard against such tactics. Divine Envoy, you must be very careful in the future," Luo Zhu advised, her voice gentle as if instructing a loved one, which was very endearing.
However, Yuan Ming always maintained a lucid spirit platform and was not influenced by her charm. Moreover, at this time, his attention was entirely on the intelligence Luo Zhu had spoken of.
"Thank you, Island Master Luo, for the information. I will certainly be extra careful," Yuan Ming said with a bow of thanks.
Seeing this, Luo Zhu appeared somewhat disinterested and waved her hand, watching as Yuan Ming left the City Lord Mansion.
No sooner had Yuan Ming returned to his place than Xiao Fangcheng, who had yet to sit down and rest, suddenly showed a look of alertness and took out a palm-sized Jade Talisman from his Storage Ring.
This was a Magic Artifact for communication left by Xing Rong. At this moment, a blue spirit light was flashing on it, signifying that someone was trying to contact Xiao Fangcheng.
Without hesitation, Yuan Ming immediately had Xiao Fangcheng infuse the Jade Talisman with Mana.
"In thirty minutes, at Cloud Sea Tower."
Xing Rong's voice quickly came from the Jade Talisman, and then the spirit light went out.
"What do you think?" Yuan Ming pondered for a moment before looking at Xi Ying.
"It shouldn't be a trap. Our father and the Senluo Sect are currently targeting Pan Si Island. Even if what Luo Zhu says is true, and they have realized there is a problem with Xing Rong, they would only match their plan to ours, focusing on exterminating Pan Si Island as a priority and unlikely to act rashly," Xi Ying quickly judged.
"Then let's proceed according to the original plan. Xiao Fangcheng, you take the child plate later and deliver it to the Senluo Sect," Yuan Ming nodded.
When Xiao Fangcheng designed the Forbidden Great Array for Bamboo Sea Square, he specifically made the Array Plate that controls the array into a mother-child pair. Both plates could control the square's restrictions, but the mother plate had a higher level of authority and could take control from the child plate at any time.
He designed it this way to ensure that Pan Si Island would honor its promise to give two-tenths of the square's profits as compensation to Red Lotus Island. However, Pan Si Island had not reneged on their part of the profits, so this matter remained a secret hidden in Xiao Fangcheng's heart.
But after Yuan Ming refined him into a Tree-man Puppet, he had revealed all these secrets without reservation.
"Except for us, no one knows about the existence of the mother-child array plates. Even if the Senluo Sect suspects Xing Rong of betrayal, they won't find any flaws in the array plate. Even if they abandon it, we won't lose anything," Yuan Ming touched his chin.
"Father is a cautious man. If he realizes that the line with Xiao Fangcheng cannot be used, he might change the original plan and not trouble Bamboo Sea Square," Xi Ying analyzed.
"It doesn't matter. Unless they leave directly, the initiative is always in our hands. Even if they don't trouble us tomorrow, I will act directly against Ximen Rui and ensure to cut off an arm of the Wuyue Sect in the Southern Border," Yuan Ming stated decisively.
Hearing this, Xi Ying stared at Yuan Ming for a long while, making him feel uncomfortable all over, and it became difficult to maintain the serious expression on his face.
"Jealous?" Xi Ying asked softly.
"A little," Yuan Ming initially wanted to deny it but, facing Xi Ying's sly, cat-like gaze, he somehow ended up changing his response.
Xi Ying giggled, her eyes curving into crescents, seemingly quite satisfied with Yuan Ming's answer.
"Cough, alright, let's not talk about that now. Xiao Fangcheng, go to Cloud Sea Tower now and wait for Xing Rong. If he is alone, ask about the situation on his end. Remember, you have to beat around the bush and don't treat him as one of us, exposing our information," Yuan Ming said, a bit embarrassed, and coughed twice, changing the subject.
Xiao Fangcheng took his orders and left, and after two incenses, he returned to report.
"Xing Rong seems to have no abnormalities. Luo Yongqi still trusts him a lot. He said that contacting me this time was also an order from Luo Yongqi, telling him to bring the Forbidden Array Plate over as soon as possible. We might make our move tomorrow," said Xiao Fangcheng.
Yuan Ming pondered for a moment but ultimately shook his head.
If Xing Rong had been discovered, it was possible for someone of his abilities to be placed under a forbidden spell without any notice. This was also the reason why Yuan Ming had not met with Xing Rong.
Since Luo Zhu could tell that Xing Rong was also his man, then what she said couldn't be without reason. Moreover, both sides were currently in a state of cooperation; there was no need to deceive each other.
Fortunately, according to Yuan Ming's plan, Xing Rong was not the key to breaking the situation, and the general strategy would not change for the time being.
Everything would only come to light tomorrow.
...
Early the next day, the Senluo Sect and Pan Si Island began intense negotiations.
Although it was just a single Spirit Vein, there were many issues to discuss, such as how exactly to divide the sphere of influence, who would guard it, and whether the produced resources needed to be distributed uniformly, and so on.
The Core Formation Elders of both sides went at each other with verbal swords and spears, using almost every means short of physical confrontation to strive for benefits for their Sects.
Unexpectedly, on Pan Si Island's side, as the chief representative participating in the negotiations, it turned out to be Xiao Yao.
At the start of the negotiations, Yuan Ming, who was lying in ambush, realized the intention behind Pan Si Island's choice of representative.
In negotiations, the first thing to consider is the strength of both parties. With Wu Yue Sect lurking in the shadows, the Senluo Sect and Pan Si Island had comparable overt power, so naturally, there wouldn't be much difference in their say at the negotiating table. What comes next would be the personal abilities of the negotiators.
And Xiao Yao had two abilities that were very beneficial for negotiation—he was eloquent and had a thick face.
Everyone present was at Core Formation, and behind them sat the Nascent Soul Ancestors as spectators. Although they argued fiercely, they still took into account their status and face.
But Xiao Yao was different. As soon as the opponent revealed any verbal loophole, he could immediately develop a long-winded, hour-long argument around that point, and if the opponent caught his own flaws, he would then pretend to be deaf and ignore whatever was said.
With his help, the situation in the negotiations quickly tilted toward Pan Si Island. However, the Senluo Sect also quickly changed their tactics, rigidly holding onto several bottom lines, even if some of the conditions were absolutely unacceptable to Pan Si Island, they would not budge.
After all this wrangling, by the afternoon, the negotiations unavoidably hit a dead end.
"Fellow Daoist Luo, is this the attitude of Senluo Sect in negotiations?" Luo Zhu, looking over at Luo Yongqi who was leisurely tasting his tea, began with an overcast face.
Yuan Ming sneaked a peek at Luo Zhu, feeling that her performance was seamless. No one who saw her like this would guess that she already knew this negotiation was nothing but a facade for the Senluo Sect.
"Our Sect has its own bottom line. How can we simply discard it to reach a settlement?" Luo Yongqi spoke unhurriedly.
"Then what's the point of talking? Why don't we fight it out? Whoever wins takes that Spirit Vein!" Luo Zhu seemed to laugh in anger.
"That's what you said, Fellow Daoist." It was as if Luo Yongqi was waiting for these words. He scoffed coldly, his hand holding the tea cup shook, and the next instant it transformed into a flexible scorpion tail, stabbing towards Luo Zhu.Enjoying the story? Find more at *.
Seeing this, Luo Zhu put on a shocked appearance, but the gestures of her hands casting her spell were not a bit slow.
Subsequently, Yuan Ming saw something appear in front of Luo Zhu, while the scorpion tail unleashed by Luo Yongqi seemed to fall into a quagmire, its speed rapidly slowing until it froze mid-air.
Yuan Ming was somewhat astonished and immediately used his Divine Sense to scan the void in front of Luo Zhu, only to discover that the void in front of her was filled with fine, invisible threads; it was these threads that had stopped the scorpion tail transformed from Luo Yongqi's right arm.
"Fellow Daoist Luo's Thousand Silk Threads indeed live up to their reputation," Luo Yongqi said in praise, as the scorpion tail arm transformed again into a white monkey arm enveloped in flames. With a slight squeeze of its fist, the flames spread along the threads wrapped around the arm.
"Heh, spare me the flattery. You, Luo Yongqi, have been scheming for this day for a long time, haven't you? Good, I have long heard about your Transplanting Technique that integrates the Hundred Beasts. Today, let me get a good look at it," teased Luo Zhu with a mocking smile, though her expression turned more solemn. As her spell moved, the threads scorched by the flames broke apart.
"Afraid I'll have to disappoint Fellow Daoist Luo. Xing Rong, make your move!" Luo Yongqi's eyes flashed sharply.
As his voice dropped, Xing Rong, who was behind him, immediately took out the Array Plate given by Xiao Fangcheng the previous night, touched a point on it, and in an instant, the workshop's Great Array surged with countless pale-green spirit lights. Mysterious runes also materialized, converging into hundreds of Wind Blades shooting towards the Pan Si Island cultivators in the workshop.
"The Wind, Forest, Fire, Mountain Great Array that Fellow Daoist Xiao helped your island to set up is being fully activated for the first time against your own people. How does it feel, Fellow Daoist Luo?" Luo Yongqi laughed heartily as his right arm returned to its original appearance.

chapters.title: Chapter 684 - 655: Manhunt
chapters.content:
Unexpectedly, just as Luo Yongqi finished speaking, Luo Zhu retracted her previously shocked and angry expression and revealed a sly smirk of triumph, "Little sister here really wouldn't know, after all, only Fellow Daoist Luo and your people can truly understand the might of this formation."
Simultaneously, Xiao Fangcheng suddenly flipped his palm, retrieving the main disk and likewise pointing his finger at it.
In the next instant, a bizarre scene unfolded!
Wind Blades that were shooting through mid-air suddenly turned direction and attacked the Senluo Sect cultivators en masse.
The cultivators of the Senluo Sect were caught unawares and were instantly engulfed by the overwhelming Wind Blades, plunging into chaos, with cries of pain and curses rising all around.
Luo Yongqi, caught off guard, also struggled under the dense barrage of Wind Blades, but being highly cultivated, he quickly extricated himself from the predicament and protected his body.
"Xiao Fangcheng, you dare betray me!" However, by this point, his heart was aflame with raging anger, and his wolf-like eyes fiercely stared at Xiao Fangcheng, who was holding the main disk.
"What are you talking about, Fellow Daoist Luo? Fellow Daoist Xiao has always been an ally of Pan Si Island. How can there be talk of betraying you?" Luo Zhu chuckled lightly, her fingers shifted a spell, and countless fine silk threads attacked Luo Yongqi together with the Wind Blades.
At the moment she made her move, the already prepared Black Leopard and Black Tiger brothers also took out their magic treasures and attacked the Nascent Soul Zhong Changli of the Senluo Sect and the knife-bearing man.
The remaining Core Formation cultivators also made their moves, and the scene quickly descended into chaos.
Under the cover of the numerous Wind Blades, Yuan Ming still laid hidden.
However, his eyes were already fixed on a group of Core Formation cultivators from the Senluo Sect, his gaze swiftly scanning the crowd.
Xi Zheng, the Evil Eye Venerable, and Ximen Rui were also mingled among the Core Formation Stage cultivators of the Senluo Sect, equally unprepared for such a sudden change, and were busy dealing with the incoming assault of Wind Blades.
Suddenly, a shadow behind Ximen Rui darkened, and a Black Sword shot out, aiming straight for his head.
Exceptionally alert, the moment the Black Sword appeared, Ximen Rui's feet each conjured a rotating cyan light, his body blurred slightly, moving sideways with a series of afterimages, evading the Black Sword's thrust.
Yuan Ming's silhouette also emerged from the shadows, his hands forming a spell.
Ximen Rui turned to look at Yuan Ming, his pupils suddenly shrinking to the size of pinholes, he exclaimed in shock, "It's you!"
Yuan Ming was surprised; to avoid trouble, he had altered his appearance again, but Ximen Rui seemed to recognize him?
Nevertheless, it didn't matter. With a thought, he activated the Curse, Annihilation, and Frenzy Blood runes on the Soul Destroying Sword.
Ximen Rui, sensing Yuan Ming's action, the rotating cyan light on his feet flared up, moving sideways again, but it was already too late.
He felt a "buzz" in his head, his vision went dark, and his Divine Sense was cut off, unable to sense any situation around him.
"What's happening!" he exclaimed in shock.
However, before he could react, the Qi-Blood and Divine Soul inside him also became chaotically disturbed, he spat out a large glob of Essence Blood, his breath instantly weakened significantly.
Yuan Ming secretly lamented; his Divine Soul was sealed in the White Jade Lotus Platform, now only the Soul Power within his Nascent Soul was usable, reducing the power of the three runes, otherwise, he could have reduced Ximen Rui's Cultivation by a whole realm.
While sighing, he didn't stop; the Soul Destroying Sword transformed into a dark shadow, slashing towards Ximen Rui's neck.
Although startled, Ximen Rui instantly sensed the danger and without a word, flicked his hand upward.
A stream of Golden Light flew out from his robe, transforming into a small golden bell above his head, spinning swiftly, it burst forth with layers of golden light waves, instantly forming a semi-transparent golden protective shield.
The Soul Destroying Sword struck the golden protective shield, emitting a loud "clang," and was repelled.
Yuan Ming raised an eyebrow slightly, surprised that the Soul Destroying Sword, whose power was not inferior to that of a replicated Spiritual Treasure, had been easily blocked by the small golden bell, which seemed to be a replicated Spiritual Treasure as well.
His lips curling slightly, the Soul Destroying Sword suddenly became a thin shadow, attacking the golden protective shield again.
However, after another crisp "clang", the shadowy state of the Soul Destroying Sword was also blocked.
Yuan Ming raised his eyebrow; this small golden bell was quite formidable, capable of blocking even the Spirit Body form of the Soul Destroying Sword!
Ximen Rui, feeling the two vibrations on the golden protective shield, although he couldn't see, he could guess what had occurred, naturally losing any will to fight and only wishing to escape desperately.
The rotating cyan lights on his feet surged, as he swiftly fled outside of the Great Array.
Yuan Ming frowned, having finally cornered this man amid the chaos. If he allowed him to escape, it would be difficult to kill him for good.
He fiercely activated the Blood Frenzy Rune; Ximen Rui's Qi-Blood and Divine Soul were disturbed once again, slowing his flying escape momentarily.
At that moment, a black root erupted from the void beside Ximen Rui, piercing into his body and easily perforating a blood hole through him.
Ximen Rui cried out in pain, the cyan light around his body flaring up, transforming into a cyan long rainbow, he crashed into a nearby Forbidden Array, flashing through it and rapidly fleeing into the distance.
Yuan Ming immediately chased after him, employing the Void Transformation Technique to penetrate the Forbidden Array.
However, with a soft "bang", his figure was blocked by the Forbidden Light Screen, unable to pass through.
He hastily instructed Ancestor Xiao to open the Forbidden Light Screen for him, then continued the pursuit.
The exchange between Yuan Ming and Ximen Rui was swift; only now did the others notice the commotion here.
Upon seeing this, Luo Zhu, the Master of Pan Si Island, revealed a delighted expression.
In her view, Ximen Rui was highly cultivated, possessing many magic treasures; she wasn't sure she could prevail against him personally. Yet, Yuan Ming had effortlessly defeated Ximen Rui, his strength even surpassing her expectations.
Xi Zheng and the Evil Eye Venerable both changed their expressions, particularly Xi Zheng, whose face turned quite unpleasant as he summoned a silver-white Magic Treasure with a flip of his hand.
This treasure was quite peculiar, resembling a small silver door. He began cultivating Mana and channeling it into the object.
A silver door suddenly appeared in front of him, pitch black inside, leading to an unknown destination.
Xi Zheng stepped in, and the silver door immediately shut and vanished.
