"Ah, could this be the Xi Family's Dayan Void Gate?" The eyes of the Evil Eye Venerable flashed as he, too, flew outside.
At that moment, dazzling golden light suddenly brightened up the void ahead with a burst like a roar of the ocean, transforming an area of several tens of meters in radius into a golden sea instantaneously.
Xi Ying appeared amidst the golden light, blocking the path of the Evil Eye Venerable.
"Who are you to dare to block my way? Move aside if you don't wish to die!" the Evil Eye Venerable said, frowning.
Without speaking, Xi Ying just raised both hands, and countless faintly visible golden feathers shot out from the light, enveloping the sky and striking towards the Evil Eye Venerable.
The golden feathers flickered and moved quickly, dazzling and captivating to the eye.
"Minor tricks!"
The Evil Eye Venerable let out a low shout, unaffected by the feathers, as a beam of purple light shot from his forehead, condensing into a purple lion of about three meters in size. It roared thunderously.
A wave of purple Sound Waves swirled forward, easily scattering the golden feathers and preventing them from approaching within ten meters of the Evil Eye Venerable.
Undeterred, Xi Ying made a hand gesture.
The feathers in the sky began to whirl rapidly, surrounding the Evil Eye Venerable and forming a huge golden vortex, enveloping him and releasing an illusion attack many times stronger than before from within the vortex.
The Soul Power in the Evil Eye Venerable's Sea of Consciousness became chaotic, causing him a moment of alarm; he halted and concentrated on stabilizing his Soul Power.
A red light flashed between his brows, and a ferocious red tiger emerged, spewing gusts of red wind. Together with the purple lion's purple Sound Waves, they tried to tear apart the golden vortex.
Meanwhile, the Great Elder of the Senluo Sect was fiercely clashing with the Master of Pan Si Island. Other Nascent Soul cultivators, as well as Core Formation cultivators, were also engaged in intense combat.
With the support of the Forbidden Great Array, Pan Si Island's side was gaining the upper hand.
...
After escaping for a while, Ximen Rui's vision brightened, and his other senses also gradually returned. Even his weakened Mana showed signs of recovery, bringing him a moment of relief.
However, before he could enjoy this for long, a flash of Lei Guang appeared ahead, and Yuan Ming, standing astride Lei Yu, blocked his path.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, this is only our second meeting, and we hold no deep grudges. Must we fight to the death?" Ximen Rui's face stiffened as he spoke solemnly.
Yuan Ming showed no intention to speak; the Soul Destroying Sword once again blasted forth, and the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear also shot from his sleeve, striking vigorously against the golden protective shield, but unfortunately, they rebounded without effect.
He raised an eyebrow and again activated the Curse Rune to diminish Ximen Rui's cultivation.
A wave of invisible Curse Power emanated, enveloping Ximen Rui.
Just at that moment, the air ahead exploded, and a tangible blood-red fist wind struck, breaking through the Curse Power.
After the blood-red fist wind passed, Xi Zheng's figure appeared.
Yuan Ming looked towards Xi Zheng, slightly surprised.
This is part of a series from * (*).
This was the first time he had seen someone counter the Curse Power with such a technique.
"Who are you? Pan Si Island seems not to have someone like you," Xi Zheng stared at Yuan Ming and asked.
"Uncle Xi, this is Yuan Ming, the man Xi Ying brought the other day!" Ximen Rui caught his breath and said.
Xi Zheng showed a surprised look as he scrutinized Yuan Ming, his expression turning cold.
"Are you from Pan Si Island? To achieve your goals, Pan Si Island truly stops at nothing," Xi Zheng said coldly.
Yuan Ming did not expect Xi Zheng to think this way, but considering their previous meeting at the Xi Family Mansion and the current situation, it was normal for Xi Zheng to speculate so.
With the situation urgent, he had no time to explain to Xi Zheng and controlled the main soul within the White Jade Lotus Platform, heading straight for the white flames.
With a "sizzle," the main soul was seared by the white flames, creating a hole.
Behind Xi Zheng, Ximen Rui suddenly screamed in agony. A large hole formed in the Divine Soul within his Sea of Consciousness.
When Yuan Ming had struck Ximen Rui with the black roots earlier, he had invoked the Shared Life Divine Power, connecting himself and Ximen Rui to share any damage.
His Divine Soul was within the space of the White Jade Lotus Platform, and he was not sure if the damage could be shared. His earlier action was just an attempt, and from Ximen Rui's reaction, it seemed to work as expected.
"What have you done?" Xi Zheng hastily checked on Ximen Rui, then bellowed a question.
Yuan Ming ignored him and continued to steer the main soul toward the white flames.
"Ah!" Ximen Rui's Divine Soul suffered another blow, displaying a hue of utter despair.
His Divine Soul did not possess the same formidable regenerative abilities as Yuan Ming's and was on the verge of collapse.

chapters.title: Chapter 685 - 656: Soul Fight
chapters.content:
"Stop!"
Xi Zheng's eyes widened abruptly, as a blood-colored giant wearing a Flat Heavenly Crown and a bright yellow robe appeared behind him.
The giant was as large as a mountain, exuding an air of supremacy and unmatched nobility, as if the Heavenly Emperor had descended to the mortal realm, looking down on all creatures. To him, humans seemed as insignificant as ants.
Yuan Ming's will was momentarily captivated by the blood-colored giant, but his resolve was strong, and he soon broke free.
However, at that moment, the blood-colored giant suddenly turned its head toward him.
Yuan Ming's vision was immediately flooded with a vast expanse of hallucinatory smoke, and then everything blurred, and he found himself in a grand and spacious hall of the Golden Throne.
He was shackled, his hands and feet weighed down by heavy fetters, kneeling there.
A golden figure sat deep in the hall, appearing to be the blood-colored giant he had just seen, whose awe-inspiring gaze came his way, eliciting a profound reverence from the depths of his heart.
Yuan Ming involuntarily felt a sense of submission, merely wanting to kneel before the golden figure, to serve him, even if it meant dying in battle.
"Such a powerful illusion technique, capable of not only disturbing the senses but also affecting the mind!" He closed his eyes and focused, forcibly regaining his senses.
He was not surprised to be dragged into an illusion.
His main soul was sealed, and all he could use was the little soul power within his Nascent Soul. Facing the illusion attack of a Soul Cultivator, he was utterly defenseless.
However, Yuan Ming had prepared for this, quickly activating the Ju Mang Spirit Technique.
The Undying Tree in his Dantian exuded strands of black fog, enveloping the Nascent Soul within.
This Undying Tree Black Fog possessed the effect of devouring divine senses. When Yuan Ming had once used the Nightmare Divine Power as a Half-step Witch on the Three Immortals Island, it was instantly thwarted by it. His lifebound spirit plant was still far inferior to the Undying Tree Demon of the Three Immortals Island, but it was more than sufficient to break Xi Zheng's illusion.
Sure enough, Yuan Ming's vision quickly blurred, and he was freed from the illusion.
At that moment, Xi Zheng's palm shone with a white light, enveloping Ximen Rui's head, seemingly treating his divine soul. The formidable blood-colored giant had already vanished.
Seeing how quickly Yuan Ming had escaped his illusion, Xi Zheng was immediately shocked.
The illusion just now was no ordinary technique, but a great divine power he had created by combining Body Cultivation and Soul Cultivation; its power was astonishing, and it should have been impossible for even a cultivator of the same level to escape so quickly.
Xi Zheng was about to cast again, but Yuan Ming had already made the first move.
In the space of the White Lotus Platform, the main soul flew over for the third time and was severely injured by white flames.
The backlash of the Shared Life Divine Power took effect, and Ximen Rui's divine soul was severely damaged again. He didn't even scream, his body trembled, his eyes turned dull, and his breath rapidly faded.
"Young Master Ximen!" Xi Zheng exclaimed in shock, hastily channeling soul power to attempt to revive him.
However, Ximen Rui's divine soul had already collapsed; although Xi Zheng's secret technique could heal injuries to the divine soul, it could not save a collapsing divine soul.
Xi Zheng soon stopped his efforts, stood up, and turned toward Yuan Ming, a thick murderous intent emerging in his eyes.
With Ximen Rui perishing before him, not only was the marriage alliance between the Xi Family and the Ximen Family hopeless, but he had also unnecessarily offended the Nine Yin Venerable, making his already somewhat precarious position within the Wuyue Sect even more dangerous.
For the moment, the only solution was to simply take down the killer and hand him over to the Nine Yin Venerable, which might slightly appease the latter's anger.
Xi Zheng reached out with one hand toward Yuan Ming, a black shadow rushing straight at him, only to suddenly disappear silently into thin air halfway.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming's expression shifted slightly. Underneath him, Lei Yu's surroundings exploded with dense lightning, and both the man and the bird vanished into thin air, later reappearing several meters away.
Almost at the same moment, his original standing spot sprang a gray ghost claw, naturally grabbing at nothing.
Xi Zheng also charged at Yuan Ming like a shadow, slightly moving his hands, as a vast expanse of gray claw shadows spontaneously appeared, moving to encase Yuan Ming as if to shred him into countless pieces.
Lei Yu hurriedly used Thunder Escape again to dodge the intensive attack of claw shadows.
Yet at that moment, the gray claw shadows suddenly burst in midair, countless wisps of gray mist sweeping outwards, instantly covering a few miles around, and when Lei Yu reappeared, he was still within the range of the gray mist.
The gray concealed a phosphorescent gleam, and divine sense, upon contact, disintegrated, unable to unfold further.
"Let's break out!" Yuan Ming's body lit up with a layer of azure light, keeping the gray mist outside, he said to Lei Yu.
Before he finished speaking, a black silhouette flew out from the nearby gray mist, headed straight for him.
The silhouette appeared human-shaped, draped in a black robe, headless and faceless, with limbs skinny as skeletons, its identity unknown, yet its speed was incredibly fast, arriving within ten meters of Yuan Ming in the blink of an eye.
Despite his surprise, Yuan Ming remained unflustered. With a grasp into the void, five streams of Soul Destroying Sword Energy burst forth, blocking the black shadow's path.
Lei Yu also opened his mouth to emit a thick silver thunderbolt, striking toward the shadow.
The black shadow did not dodge, continuing to charge forward, allowing the Soul Destroying Sword Energy and the silver thunderbolt to strike it, piercing through creating several large holes.
It seemed to feel no pain; the Soul Destroying Sword Energy and the silver thunderbolt did not inflict much damage, as it continued to charge, its speed unabated, instantly coming within three meters of Yuan Ming.
The black cloth over the shadow's face split open, revealing what seemed like a ferocious, gaping maw.
A bizarre suction enveloped Yuan Ming, causing him immediate discomfort, readily draining away his positive emotions and leaving behind only gloom, negativity, and despair.
Yuan Ming's heart chilled as he wanted to resist, but waves of negative emotions surged toward him, and his will to resist seemed to sink into a quagmire, sinking deeper with each attempt, and his arms froze mid-air.
The most up‑to‑date version is on *.
The shadow continued to suckle, quickly draining Yuan Ming of all his positive emotions.
Yuan Ming's gaze turned into a pool of dead water, the Protective Spiritual Light around his body suddenly dissipated, and he let his arms hang down, seemingly resigning himself to his fate.
Beneath him, Lei Yu did the same, its massive body becoming rigid and falling downwards.
A black shadow closely followed, closing in on Yuan Ming's face with a gaping maw, continuing to exert its absorbing force.
Yuan Ming's Divine Soul trembled incessantly, and even his negative emotions were rapidly sucked away.
His lifeless eyes quickly became vacant, resembling a wooden puppet.
"This shadow can extract the Power of Seven Emotions? This is bad! If the Power of Seven Emotions is completely drained, the Divine Soul in the Nascent Soul might be in danger of collapsing!" Inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod, Yuan Ming's main soul wore a grave expression.
The Power of Seven Emotions is an essential component of a normal Divine Soul. If depleted, a Cultivator's Divine Soul might not collapse and die, but they would become an ignorant, unaware puppet.
But his main soul was sealed inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod and could not influence the outside, making him extremely anxious.
At that moment, an unexpected scene occurred!
The branches of the Undying Tree within Yuan Ming's Dantian suddenly started to sway, affected by the shadow's capability to devour the Seven Emotions.
The branches of the Undying Tree released a surge of Black Mist, protecting itself.
Yuan Ming's Nascent Soul was also in the Dantian, enveloped in the same Black Mist.
The Black Mist of the Undying Tree had the ability to isolate Divine Sense, and since the shadow's ability to devour the Seven Emotions was also a Divine Soul-class Divine Ability, it was largely blocked.
Yuan Ming's vacant eyes regained a bit of clarity, and he immediately activated the Ju Mang Spirit Technique, urging the Undying Tree inside his Dantian.
A dense Black Mist poured out, wrapping around the Nascent Soul layer by layer, and even spreading outward, completely isolating the shadow's devouring Divine Ability.
Yuan Ming's consciousness fully recovered, and his eyes revealed an exceedingly cold murderous intent.
"How is this possible!" Xi Zheng, witnessing this scene, showed a look of shock and immediately lunged forward.
Just then, a shadow-like Sword Qi burst out from within the Black Mist—it was the Soul Destroying Sword—heading straight for the shadow.
The shadow shrank its body and moved sideways to dodge.
The Soul Destroying Sword suddenly emitted a loud sword cry, lighting up nine runes, and its speed abruptly more than doubled, easily intercepting the shadow and chopping down directly onto its head.
With a light "schlick," the shadow was split in two, and then transformed into specks of black spiritual light that dissipated.
The shadow was slain, and Lei Yu also regained consciousness, hurriedly flapping its wings to stabilize its form.
From the time the shadow attacked to the moment it was killed, although the process was quite convoluted, it only lasted a few breaths.
Seeing this, Xi Zheng halted his advance.
The shadow that had attacked Yuan Ming was actually his Divine Soul Transformation, possessing the peculiar ability to devour an enemy's Seven Emotions; once it got close, even highly Cultivated individuals had no choice but to await their demise, and it had never failed over the many years.
The shadow attacking Yuan Ming appeared to be singular, but was actually a union of over a dozen Divine Soul Transformations, and yet it was shattered in a single encounter!
Who exactly was this Yuan Ming?
The Black Mist parted, and Yuan Ming slowly flew out.
"Worthy of being Venerable Xian Kong from the Wuyue Sect, your methods are remarkable; I am impressed!" Yuan Ming said.
"Exactly who are you?" Xi Zheng asked gravely.
"It's not necessary for you to know, my lord. Having witnessed the methods of Venerable Xian Kong, it would be impolite not to return the favor. Venerable Xian Kong, receive my strike!" Yuan Ming clasped his hands in a spell gesture, and a hundred-zhang-long gigantic Sword Qi appeared on the Soul Destroying Sword, emitting a piercing scream that seemed to pierce the skies.
Under the cover of the staggering Sword Qi, three major runes—Curse, Annihilation, and Blood Frenzy—were quietly activated.
Three strands of invisible force surged out, silently enveloping Xi Zheng.
Xi Zheng raised an eyebrow, twitched his wrist, and around his body, four streaks of silver light emerged, forming a silver door.
He stepped into it, his figure disappearing into thin air and reappearing tens of meters away, evading the assault of the runes Curse, Annihilation, and Blood Frenzy.
Xi Zheng's hands moved rapidly like spinning wheels, forming all kinds of spells. A dazzling blue light materialized in front of him and exploded violently.
A dense barrage of blue Ice Cones shot out, emitting a piercing screech, enveloping Yuan Ming and a large area around him.
The blue Ice Cones contained astonishing cold, causing the temperature within tens of miles to plummet abruptly, and snow started falling from a clear sky.
Yuan Ming furrowed his brow, knowing that Xi Zheng, also a high-level Soul Cultivator practicing the same Moonlight Technique, was already challenging enough, and could moreover detect the attacks of the Curse, Annihilation, and Blood Frenzy runes. He could no longer hold back in this battle.
With a wave of his sleeve, a yellow mountain peak several tens of meters high appeared before him.
The mountain emitted a bright yellow light, faintly displaying Spiritual Patterns, appearing to be a Magic Treasure, although many parts of the yellow mountain were quite rough, seemingly only halfway through its refinement process.
The blue Ice Cones struck the mountain and shattered into pieces, leaving many shallow pits on the mountain, but it seemed otherwise undamaged.
Yuan Ming nodded slightly; this yellow mountain Magic Treasure was none other than the Houtu Mountain Stone he had obtained from the secret realm of the Three Immortals Island, which he had begun to refine into a Magic Treasure on his way to the Southern Border, unfortunately only managing to complete half due to time constraints.
Although incomplete, the immense Houtu Mountain Stone contained immeasurably deep Earth Spirit Power, its power surpassing ordinary forged Spiritual Treasures, especially in terms of defense which was extremely formidable. None of Yuan Ming's many Magic Treasures could break through it.

chapters.title: Chapter 686 - 657: Blood Gang True Body
chapters.content:
"Go!"
Yuan Ming pinched a spell and pointed, and Houtu Peak shone brightly with a yellow light, breaking through the air, smashing towards Xi Zheng with the force of a thousand pounds.
An immense oppressive force descended from the sky, causing Xi Zheng's figure to shake, and he almost couldn't remain on his feet.
Although Xi Zheng's cultivation was not weak, the Xi Family was not known for Magic Practitioners, and he did not have any particularly powerful Magic Treasures on hand. He immediately grasped the silver door in his hand, trying to summon the silver door again to escape.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming wouldn't let him escape a second time and preemptively activated the Soul Destroying Sword.
The silver door had just formed when the Curse, Annihilation, and Blood Frenzy Rune attacks arrived first.
Xi Zheng's pupils shrank, and he immediately stopped casting, throwing a punch.
A streak of Blood Light flashed behind him, and the Blood Giant appeared again, also throwing a punch.
A massive blood-colored Fist Wind shot out, shattering the Curse, Annihilation, and Blood Frenzy attacks.
Not only that, the blood-colored Fist Wind also struck Houtu Peak. With a thunderous boom, Houtu Peak was actually sent flying away.
Yuan Ming's face showed a look of surprise; what kind of Divine Skills was the blood Giant of Xi Zheng, capable of not only casting Illusion Techniques but also possessing such terrifying attacking power?
A faint abnormal flush crossed Xi Zheng's face, which then quickly faded away, but not without catching Yuan Ming's eye.
Yuan Ming once again activated the Curse, Annihilation, and Blood Frenzy Rune.
Three invisible forces shot out, attacking Xi Zheng from three different directions.
Cursing Yuan Ming's craftiness, Xi Zheng did not dare to let the three invisible forces get close. He controlled the Blood Giant's arms to lash out left and right, again sweeping away the three invisible forces.
The sound of thunderous Lei Guang rang out as Yuan Ming and Lei Yu's figures vanished from afar, appearing not far in front of Xi Zheng.
Yuan Ming pinched a spell and guided it above his head. A golden light flashed, and the Thousand Treasures Scripture Pillar emerged.
Seven or eight Magic Treasures shot out from it, including the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear, Exterminating Immortal Sword, and Thunder God Bombarding Divine Hammer, among others resembling Spiritual Treasures. The rest were also Nine Rune Magical Treasures, all targeting Xi Zheng.
Each Magic Treasure released terrifying fluctuations that made the void tremble.
Xi Zheng hurriedly brought out a roll of red silk, transforming it into a thick layer of red silk curtain to protect his body.
Yuan Ming's expression was impassive as he urged the Undying Tree Root.
Within the red silk curtain, a disturbance rippled through the void, and two black tree roots suddenly emerged, piercing into Xi Zheng's body.
"Clang, clang!" Two muffled sounds.
Xi Zheng's body was extraordinarily tough, Undying Tree Root couldn't penetrate him, only piercing a few inches before stopping, barely causing much damage, with only a trickle of fresh blood flowing out.
"This Xi Zheng is actually an individual cultivator!"
Yuan Ming silently noted in his heart but did not pay much mind, controlling the main soul inside the White Jade Lotus Platform to once again crash into the white Flames above.
Just now, when the Undying Tree Roots hit Xi Zheng, he used the Shared Life Divine Power again.
With a slight sizzle, the main soul was severely injured by the white Flames, and Xi Zheng's Divine Soul suffered the same injury.
"Ah..." Xi Zheng let out a pained cry, the Blood Giant behind him crashed and disappeared, and the red silk curtain around him also became extremely dim.
The Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear, Exterminating Immortal Sword, Thunder God Bombarding Divine Hammer, and other Magic Treasures flew towards him, striking the red silk curtain.

Although the red silk was of exceptional quality, it could not possibly withstand such numerous replica Spiritual Treasures; it tore apart amidst the sound of ripping silk.
Xi Zheng, hidden behind the curtain, was also sent flying, spitting out a mouthful of fresh blood.
Unknown when, a suit of armor condensed from Blood Light had appeared around him, and he seemed to have suffered no great harm.
Yuan Ming gritted his teeth, not waiting for his Divine Soul to recover, and approached the white Flames again.
Xi Zheng's head throbbed violently once more as his Divine Soul was again severely damaged.
Not only that, three invisible forces fell, striking his body. They were the Curse, Annihilation, and Blood Frenzy Rune attacks.
Xi Zheng's head buzzed; his vision plunged into Endless darkness, the flow of Qi-Blood and Mana suddenly accelerating several times, causing chaos as they collided with each other. His Cultivation plummeted.
Yuan Ming once again raised his hand, and from the Thousand Treasures Scripture Pillar, seven or eight more Magic Treasures shot out with a howl.
"Damn it, who is this person, with so many tricks up his sleeve, it's impossible to guard against!" Fear appeared on Xi Zheng's face as he spat out a mouthful of fresh blood, turning it into a sphere of Blood Light that engulfed his body.
Whoosh!
The Blood Light turned into a breathtaking long rainbow, shooting far away at an astonishing speed, vanishing into the ends of the sky in an instant.
Yuan Ming retracted the Thousand Treasures Scripture Pillar and a few Magic Treasures, not pursuing any further.
After all, Xi Zheng was the father of Xi Ying, and he couldn't possibly fight him to the death.
Also, having continuously activated the Curse, Annihilation, and Blood Frenzy runes, his already thin Divine Soul Power was nearly exhausted and needed time for Breathing Control.
After briefly adjusting his breath, Yuan Ming was about to fly back to the workshop to take a look but suddenly turned his head towards the trees on the right, "Which Fellow Daoist is here, there's no need to hide and skulk."
A surge of green light fluctuated on a tall tree in the forest, slowly condensing into a figure; it was none other than the Evil Eye Venerable.
"It's you!" Yuan Ming's eyes flitted.
"Hehe, Fellow Daoist Yuan really has some skill, to actually make Xi Zheng run away with his tail between his legs. As expected of the Nether Moon God." Evil Eye Venerable said with a smile as he clapped his hands.
Yuan Ming's heart sank with a thud, but his face remained expressionless, "What do you mean by that?"
Evil Eye Venerable stared intently at Yuan Ming, his eyes flickering with a black light.
This was a secret technique for probing, capable of judging the truth of the opponent's words by sensing the fluctuations of their Divine Soul.
Evil Eye Venerable's face remained unchanging, but he let out a quiet yip in his heart. His previously infallible probing technique had failed to discern the truth of Yuan Ming's words.
The reason for the failure was strange—Yuan Ming's Divine Soul Fluctuations were too weak.
"If you've come here, is it to avenge Xi Zheng and Ximen Rui? If so, make your move. It would be good for Yuan to experience the abilities of two great Venerables from the Wu Yue Sect!" sensing something off with Evil Eye Venerable, Yuan Ming swiftly brought out the Soul Destroying Sword, and Sword Qi surged in front of him.
"Avenge them? Why would I? Whether Ximen Rui and Xi Zheng are dead or alive, what does that have to do with me? Today I had the good fortune to meet Fellow Daoist Yuan, I am quite pleased. Let's meet again in the future." Evil Eye Venerable laughed heartily, gave Yuan Ming a cupped fist salute, then turned into a streak of black light shooting off into the distance, disappearing from the edge of the sky in a few breaths.
Yuan Ming watched the distance, remaining silent.
It seemed that Evil Eye Venerable has recognized him as well, proving the Blood Bone Mask's disguise to be unreliable against Nascent Soul cultivators.
Moreover, the Wu Yue Sect's investigation into the Moon Sect was clearly very thorough, even suspecting that he himself was the Nether Moon God. He needed to be more cautious.
Thinking thus, Yuan Ming flew towards the direction of the workshop.
The Great Array inside the workshop had already stopped operating, and the battle had come to an end.
The cultivators from the Senluo Sect had disappeared, leaving behind three corpses, one of which was Xing Rong, and the other two were Core Formation Stage cultivators.
There were no casualties on Pan Si Island's side, and everyone wore looks of joy.
Somehow, more cultivators from Pan Si Island had appeared in the workshop, and Luo Zhu was directing them as they busily attended to various tasks around the workshop.
Xi Ying stood quietly at the entrance of the workshop, her clothes unmarred by dirt.
"How's the situation now?" Yuan Ming appeared beside Xi Ying with a flicker.
"As you can see, the people from the Senluo Sect have been repelled. Little Silver Mountain's Spirit Vein now belongs to Pan Si Island. But I doubt Senluo Sect will let it go easily," Xi Ying said.
Yuan Ming nodded. He had fulfilled his promise to Luo Zhu. What happened to Little Silver Mountain's Spirit Vein after that did not concern him.
"How about on your end?" asked Xi Ying.
"Ximen Rui has been killed by me, but it's a pity that his body was taken away by Elder Xi Zheng. I couldn't retrieve it," Yuan Ming said.
"You fought my father?" Xi Ying looked Yuan Ming up and down, suddenly speaking.
"Your father has a peculiar ability for Divine Soul Transformation, and I almost suffered a great loss. I had to retaliate heavily and scared him off. I hope you won't blame me," Yuan Ming said.
"Father has been swayed by the Wu Yue Sect and is quite devoted. Trying to persuade him to change his mind won't be easy," Xi Ying sighed, shaking her head.
Seeing that Xi Ying did not blame him, Yuan Ming breathed a sigh of relief and then began to inquire about Xi Zheng's Soul Cultivator abilities.
He now understood that the previous shadow was indeed Xi Zheng's Divine Soul Transformation.
"Father's Divine Soul Transformation is called Hei Jialuo, a rare Fierce Beast from the Northern Desert with the ability to devour the Seven Emotions. It's very difficult to deal with, and those whose Seven Emotions are devoured by Hei Jialuo will turn into puppets under my father's control," Xi Ying revealed without concealment and explained in detail.
Yuan Ming's expression stiffened. He had only asked out of curiosity, not expecting Xi Ying to reveal Xi Zheng's Soul Cultivation ability in such detail.
"I was merely curious; you didn't have to be so specific," he said with a wry smile.
"I understand my father's character very well. He's so resolute he's almost stubborn. If we can't convincingly defeat him, he won't seriously listen to us. This task, only you can achieve," Xi Ying said earnestly.
Yuan Ming hesitated, silent. He was already quite aware of Xi Zheng's strength after their previous bout; defeating him would not be difficult.
But Xi Zheng was Xi Ying's father, and if he defeated him time and again, it would surely cause Xi Zheng to resent and even despise him, which was not desirable.
"Don't worry, I make my own decisions about my matters. My father and the family can't influence me," Xi Ying's face flushed slightly, evidently seeing the reason for Yuan Ming's hesitation.
"Alright, I will find a way to handle this matter," Yuan Ming nodded in response.
"Do you have anything else to ask about my father?" Xi Ying quickly regained her composure and asked.
"Your father also summoned a blood-colored giant, which was extraordinarily powerful. What Divine Skill is that?" Yuan Ming asked again.
"That is my father's Body Cultivation Divine Skill, the Blood Gang True Body," Xi Ying replied.
"Blood Gang True Body? What is that?" Yuan Ming was astonished.
"I don't know much about Body Cultivation. I had heard my father mention it briefly before. When Body Cultivation reaches a certain realm, the Qi-Blood Power begins to transform and becomes Blood Gang. And upon reaching the Body of Wanxiang, one can rely on the robust Blood Gang as foundation to condense an immensely powerful Blood Gang True Body," Xi Ying explained after some thought.
"Has his Body Cultivation Realm reached the Body of Wanxiang?" Yuan Ming wondered.
Based on the previous battle, Xi Zheng's Physical Body strength did not seem all that impressive.
"No, my father's Body Cultivation only reached the peak of the Tongqiao Body. He cultivates the Xi Family's Emperor Sealing God Fist. Relying on an Exotic Treasure, he can temporarily condense the Emperor's True Body, which is less powerful than the genuine Blood Gang True Body," Xi Ying shook her head.
"Qi Ye, is this true? Can the Body of Wanxiang really condense the Blood Gang True Body?" Yuan Ming sent a message to Qi Ye, asking.
He did not distrust Xi Ying, but he wanted to have a clearer understanding.

chapters.title: Chapter 687 - 658: Birth of the Wu Yue God
chapters.content:
"That's right, after achieving the Tongqiao Body in Body Cultivation, one's inner breath starts to merge with the Qi-Blood Power, transforming into Blood Gang. After breaking through to the Body of Wanxiang, one can condense the Blood Gang True Body. This True Body can be said to be the mark of the Body of Wanxiang," Qi Ye said.
Yuan Ming's eyebrows lifted; his Body Cultivation had also reached the Tongqiao Body, but unfortunately, he had been too busy lately to contemplate in depth.
"Body Cultivation attack methods are simple, and when facing an enemy of equal realm, they often suffer a lot. However, once the Blood Gang True Body is condensed, the strength of a Body Cultivator will undergo earth-shattering changes, enough to rival, or even surpass, a Magic Practitioner or Spoken Witch at the Returning to Void Stage," Qi Ye continued.
Yuan Ming's heart trembled upon hearing this.
He practiced both Body and Magic Soul Cultivation and naturally had many impressions about their respective strengths and weaknesses.
Soul Cultivation, needless to say, focuses on attacking the enemy where they are unguarded. Although there are significant risks of backlash during cultivation and combat, its strength is often impressive enough to stand above other cultivators of the same rank, and even facing enemies above one's own rank is not a difficult task.
Magic Practitioners represent the mainstream path in the Cultivation World, emphasizing a gradual progression and balance of offense and defense. Their strength relies more on Magic Treasure Skills and their experience in battle.
Body Cultivators can refine their physical bodies to be as robust as demon beasts, and in the lower realms of Cultivation, they often depend on their powerful defensive capabilities to outlast their opponents. However, due to their limited offensive methods, as their Cultivation progresses, their original advantages naturally become less obvious.
Now that Qi Ye mentioned the transformative changes that would come with achieving the Blood Gang True Body, it seemed Yuan Ming would need to spend some time on this aspect in the future.
"Xi Ying, what is this Emperor Sealing God Fist technique you just mentioned?" Yuan Ming asked, after pondering for a moment and turning to Xi Ying.
"The Emperor Sealing God Fist is a technique passed down by a powerful Body Cultivator who had the Heavenly Phenomenon Body. In terms of power, it might not be inferior to your Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill," Xi Ying said.
"Nonsense, my Demon Clan's physical body is strong and our Body Cultivation Methods far surpass those of the Human Clan. The Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill is among the top Body Cultivation Methods in the Demon World, how could it be comparable to something like the Emperor Sealing God Fist," Qi Ye retorted dismissively, her voice carrying outward.
"In terms of attacking power, it's true that the Emperor Sealing God Fist is far from the Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill. However, the Emperor Sealing God Fist has its own mysteries; it can borrow momentum for one's own use, leveraging the forces of heaven, earth, and humankind. Every single strike is unstoppable and unavoidable," Xi Ying said.
"Borrowing momentum..." Yuan Ming's expression shifted.
During the previous great battle, the crimson giant's every move seemed indeed to have the feeling of invoking the forces of heaven and earth. Attacks such as Curse, annihilation, and Frenzy Blood, formless and shape-shifting, were easily blocked by the crimson giant.
"Another mystery of the Emperor Sealing God Fist is that it can borrow momentum to make breakthroughs in one's realm," Xi Ying continued.
"Borrowing momentum to make breakthroughs? What do you mean by that?" Yuan Ming asked in surprise.
"Literally, the Emperor Sealing God Fist can use the forces of the world to break through the realms. The reason my father joined the Wu Yue Sect was also to use the Sect's momentum of unifying the world to break through to the Body of Wanxiang," Xi Ying said.
"Such a method of breakthrough exists? It's indeed very profound," Yuan Ming's eyes revealed his interest.
Qi Ye fell silent, acknowledging that even the Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill did not possess this effect.
"Although the Emperor Sealing God Fist is profound, it's unfortunate that the Xi Family only has an incomplete version. Over the years, my father has been collecting various Body Cultivation Methods, trying to perfect the Emperor Sealing God Fist," Xi Ying said.
Yuan Ming nodded, then recalled something and asked, "During the recent battle in the workshop, you dealt with the Evil Eye Venerable, right? What abilities does his Divine Soul Transformation possess?"
"Take a look at this, I've recorded everything," Xi Ying handed over a talisman, which turned out to be an Imprint Talisman.
Yuan Ming activated his Mana and injected it into the talisman. The Imprint Talisman displayed the battle between Xi Ying and the Evil Eye Venerable.
Seeing that the Evil Eye Venerable's forehead revealed various different Divine Soul Transformations, Yuan Ming was astonished. "The Evil Eye Venerable has multiple Divine Soul Transformations... How did he accomplish that?"
"The Divine Soul Transformation of the Evil Eye Venerable is due to the Eye Demon. As far as I know, this creature can devour other people's Divine Souls and capture their abilities. He used the Eye Demon to devour many Soul Cultivators' Divine Souls, thus obtaining numerous Divine Soul Transformations," Xi Ying explained.
Yuan Ming sighed inwardly, the Wu Yue Sect of the Yunhuang Continent indeed deserved its reputation as the birthplace of Soul Cultivation, having such unique Divine Soul Transformations.
Just then, Luo Zhu flew over from within the workshop.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, Fellow Daoist Xi, my Pan Si Island was able to seize the Spirit Vein of Little Silver Mountain largely thanks to both of you," Luo Zhu expressed her gratitude.
"Island Master Luo is too polite. Ximen Rui is dead; it's just a pity that his corpse was taken away by other members of the Senluo Sect," Yuan Ming said.
"I am aware of that," replied Luo Zhu.
"You are?" Yuan Ming looked surprised.
During the recent battle, he hadn't sensed anyone lurking nearby or the probing of Divine Sense. How did Luo Zhu come to know of this?
"I have my ways of knowing. Since Divine Envoy Yuan has fulfilled his promise, Pan Si Island and the Moon Sect will from now on form an alliance," Luo Zhu cryptically answered, changing the subject.
"Alright," Yuan Ming did not press the matter further.
After concluding the discussion, the Five Elements Spiritual Veins fell into the hands of Pan Si Island. However, to prevent any retaliation from the Senluo Sect, Luo Zhu decided that Yuan Ming and Xi Ying should stay in the workshop area.
Having been on the go for a while, Yuan Ming was looking forward to some rest and thus did not refuse the invitation to reside in two separate Cave Mansions arranged by Pan Si Island.
Pan Si Island did not idle away, hastily organizing personnel to start mining the Five Elements Spiritual Veins.
...
Inside the Cave Mansion at the workshop, Yuan Ming sat cross-legged with closed eyes, cultivating with the Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill.
The immense power of Qi-Blood rumbled through his body, while the Demon Image Internal Breath followed suit, shaking the ground of the Cave Mansion relentlessly.
With his eyes tightly shut, Yuan Ming attempted to fuse the Qi-Blood Power with the Demon Image Internal Breath into one.
Time ticked away, and before long, a day and a night had passed.
Both the Qi-Blood Power and the Demon Image Internal Breath were defiant and untamed, and despite his efforts, there was no sign of them merging together.
"Condensing Blood Gang is not that easy. You haven't been in the Tongqiao Body for long, and you haven't settled down to truly feel it before. Take it slow," Qi Ye's voice sounded.
Yuan Ming nodded and continued to ponder.
At that moment, a green light flew in, a Sound Transmission Talisman.
Yuan Ming activated his Divine Sense to probe and formed a hand seal to disperse the restrictions within the Cave Mansion.
"Great news, the Five Elements Child and Yinkong discovered a Five Elements Spirit Cave deep within the Five Elements Spiritual Veins, containing a massive amount of Five Elements Spirit Marrow," Xi Ying entered, waving a white round orb in her hand with glee.
"Really? We've finally found it!" Yuan Ming too was overjoyed.
Xi Ying didn't say much more, channeling mana into the white round orb. The images of the Five Elements Child and Yinkong appeared inside the orb, both situated within a dimly lit Soluble Cave.
Stalactites hung everywhere within the cave, and deep inside, there was a spring eye bubbling with white vapor, occasionally dripping a droplet of five-colored liquid into a small pond below.
The pond was only about three meters in diameter, filled to the brim with Five-Colored Spirit Liquid emitting a soft multicolored luminescence.
"Is this the Five Elements Spirit Marrow?" Yuan Ming had never seen Five Elements Spirit Marrow, nor had he read about it, so he asked.
"Indeed, and it appears to be of very high quality," Xi Ying said, her gaze fixed on the white round orb with certainty.
Yuan Ming nodded slightly; his eyes also showed a fervent interest in the pond within the orb.
"You two, get started and collect that spirit marrow," Xi Ying directed towards the white round orb.
"Yes, but Master, how much shall we take?" Yinkong asked.
After pondering for a moment, Xi Ying said, "Take seventy percent."
Yuan Ming didn't speak. They had helped Pan Si Island secure this Spirit Vein and were personally guarding it, but Luo Zhu showed no intention of sharing any resources from the Spirit Vein with them.
As such, they had no reason to hold back.
Yinkong acknowledged and pulled out a white gourd, forming a hand seal to draw.
A slender column of Five-Colored Spirit Liquid rose from the pond, precisely pouring into the white gourd.
Before long, Yinkong had collected all the Five Elements Spirit Marrow within the pond, carrying the gourd back to the workshop.
The Five Elements Child did not come along but continued to stay within the Spirit Vein, searching for other Five Elements Spirit Marrow.
Two hours later, Yuan Ming and Xi Ying obtained the Five Elements Spirit Marrow.
Xi Ying gave half to Yuan Ming and returned to her Cave Mansion with the other half, seemingly eager to try the effects of the Five Elements Spirit Marrow.
Anxious to test the spirit marrow, Yuan Ming swallowed a droplet and began to refine it by circulating the Nine Elements Technique.
Boom!
The spiritual energy from around began to rapidly converge, more than five times the usual amount, almost condensing into a visible Spirit Fog around him.
His meridians filled with nature's spiritual energy, he felt incredibly comfortable.
Overjoyed, Yuan Ming hastily began cultivating to refine this abundant spiritual energy.
This influx of spiritual energy lasted for an entire day, and only then did the effects of the Five Elements Spirit Marrow gradually subside.Yoursupportat*keepstheseriesgoing.
"Good, I didn't expect the effect of the Five Elements Spirit Marrow to last this long. These marrows are enough for me to use for a considerable period. With my current speed of cultivation, plus the potency of the Snow Soul Pill, it'll take me less than ten years to reach the Mid-Stage of Nascent Soul," Yuan Ming thought with quiet excitement.
He then closed his eyes, immersing himself back into cultivation.
...
Time flew by, and three months passed in the blink of an eye.
While Yuan Ming and Xi Ying were each in secluded cultivation, constantly enhancing their cultivation levels, the outside world had changed dramatically.
One day, a frantic Luo Zhu rushed to the place where they were in seclusion and called them out.
Upon seeing her, Yuan Ming felt a sense of foreboding.
"Island Master, has the Wu Yue Sect made another move in the Southern Border, that you've urgently called us out of our seclusion?" Yuan Ming asked.
"Not the Southern Border, but the Central Plains and the Western Region," Luo Zhu said, furrowing her brows.
Hearing this, Yuan Ming was taken aback.
The sects in the Central Plains and the Western Region were far stronger than those in the Southern Border. If the Wu Yue Sect were to stir up trouble, those shouldn't be their targets of choice.
"Could it be trouble in the Black Wind Desert?" Xi Ying, however, sharply sensed something.
"Just one month ago, the Wu Yue God has emerged," Luo Zhu nodded solemnly.
"What?" Yuan Ming and Xi Ying exclaimed almost in unison, both their expressions and tones betraying unabashed astonishment.
This news was such a shock to both of them that after exclaiming, they remained speechless for a while.
According to their estimates, the Wu Yue God shouldn't have emerged this quickly.
"The forces that the major powers from the Central Plains and Western Region deployed in the Black Wind Desert were almost completely overrun without much resistance by the Wu Yue Sect with overwhelming force. Five days ago, the Wu Yue Sect has already breached into the territories of the Central Plains and Western Region. Now, the people there live in fear and panic," Luo Zhu continued after seeing their reaction.
"In that case, the situation isn't too terrible," Xi Ying, hearing this, unexpectedly breathed a sigh of relief.
"How is this not terrible?" Luo Zhu asked, puzzled.

chapters.title: Chapter 688 - 659: Possessed by Demons
chapters.content:
"If Wuyue God emerged a month ago and only began attacking the Central Plains and the Western Region now, it just shows that his power has not yet fully recovered. Otherwise, under his full strength, the Central Plains and the Western Region would likely have already fallen into major disarray by now," Xi Ying said.
"Is Wuyue God truly so terrifying?" Luo Zhu wondered with alarm.
"You'd best pray you never encounter him," Xi Ying said.
"All major sects of the Central Plains and the major powers of the Western Region have sent invitation letters to the sects of the East Sea and Southern Border, inviting all major sects to gather at the Chang Chun Temple to discuss strategies against the Wuyue Sect. Our Pan Si Island has also received an invitation, and I plan to attend. Would you two care to join?" Luo Zhu asked, furrowing his brows.
Yuan Ming was about to respond when suddenly a slight tremor at his waist alerted him. The Ten Thousand Miles Communication Talisman began to emit a blue light.
He frowned, pulling out the talisman and channeling mana into it.
The moment mana was infused, the Ten Thousand Miles Communication Talisman instantly lit up with a blue light, and a woman's figure emerged within it; it was none other than Yan Siyun.
"Divine Envoy, there has been a disturbance in the Black Wind Desert. Wuyue God has emerged," Yan Siyun stated succinctly.
"I already know," Yuan Ming replied.
"You already know... Also, the major sects of the Central Plains and Western Region are preparing to form an alliance at Chang Chun Temple and have sent us an invitation to join the meeting three months from now," Yan Siyun said.
Luo Zhu also glanced at Yuan Ming.
"Let's put that aside for now, allow me to consider it," Yuan Ming pondered and replied.
"As you command," Yan Siyun responded immediately.
As the light from the Ten Thousand Miles Communication Talisman dimmed, Luo Zhu couldn't help but ask, "Does your Moon Sect intend to remain uninvolved?"
"Under a broken nest, what eggs can remain intact?" Yuan Ming responded ambiguously.
"If that's the case, what's there to hesitate about?" Luo Zhu asked.
"Dealing with the Wuyue Sect is not a matter that can be resolved quickly. Island Master Luo, you might as well go ahead," Yuan Ming suggested.
"Forget it, I was just informing you both. Since that's the case, I'll go ahead," Luo Zhu said.
After he left, Xi Ying spoke up, "Are you really not planning to go?"
"The major sects of the Central Plains and Western Region haven't yet suffered significant losses, and the situation isn't as bad as imagined, so they don't feel a strong urgency. This alliance is bound to result in the election of a leading Alliance Hierarch, inevitably leading to much scheming. Right now, it's more important for me to enhance my strength as quickly as possible," Yuan Ming explained.
"You've analyzed it well, but I still feel we should go and see the actual conditions for ourselves," Xi Ying nodded in agreement and said.
"In that case, you can go in my place. Since Wuyue God won't show up, having the identity of a Divine Envoy should suffice," Yuan Ming said after a moment of contemplation.
"That's what I was thinking too. To hide my identity well, I will need to borrow your Blood Bone Mask," Xi Ying said with a sly smile.
Yuan Ming rotated his wrist, took out the Blood Bone Mask, and a light shone from his palm, enveloping a drop of Essence Blood and merging it into the mask.
"With my Essence Blood and the trace of mana, it won't be easily seen through," Yuan Ming said as he handed the Blood Bone Mask over.
Thinking further, Yuan Ming wiped his wrist again, and a set of Blood Puppet Armor with the White Bone Venerable sealed inside appeared in front of him.
"Take this Blood Puppet Armor as well; it contains the White Bone Venerable and will be additional support," Yuan Ming said.
Upon hearing this, Xi Ying's eyes softened with a gentle smile, and he accepted it without refusal.
"I also have something for you, which should help you enhance your strength significantly in a short time," Xi Ying said, leaving Yuan Ming with a Storage Ring. Without waiting for Yuan Ming to inquire, he turned and left.
After he left, Yuan Ming opened the Storage Ring to find only a Jade Scroll inside.
"Emperor Sealing God Fist.... This is the Body Cultivation Technique practiced by Xi Ying's father." As he recognized the contents described on the Jade Scroll, he couldn't help but be moved.
The Xi Family Patriarch's practiced technique was surely the core of the family's teachings, yet Xi Ying had just given it to him, an outsider.
After a moment of astonishment, Yuan Ming's attention was drawn to the content of the technique.
He had experienced the power of this fist in Xi Zheng's hands, and now seeing the complete content of the technique, he truly understood the formidable nature of the Emperor Sealing God Fist.
This was undoubtedly a highly profound Body Cultivation Technique, whereby the training encompassed not just the physical but also extended to techniques of battle that transcended mere 'skills' to reach the realm of 'the Way'.
It aimed to synchronize breathing with the heavens and earth, to align actions like the clouds and rain, polishing the body to the Body of Wanxiang and elevating the usage of the physical body to a level 'in harmony with the Way.'
Only thus could one be at one with heaven's air and earth's branches, borrowing the power of nature to display the prowess of gods and demons.
"Xi Ying has truly considered everything diligently; under the current circumstances, neither Magic Practitioner nor Soul Cultivation are likely to break through in a short time. Only Body Cultivation might still have potential for breakthrough, and it's crucial now to enhance my strength quickly to face the threat of Wuyue God," Yuan Ming thought to himself.
However, even with Emperor Sealing God Fist, it was not easy to quickly enhance the strength of the physical body.
"Fellow Daoist Qi Ye, if I continue to use the Shura Blood Devouring Map, when is the earliest I can break through to the Body of Wanxiang?" Yuan Ming transmitted his question.
"Didn't I tell you earlier that the Shura Blood Devouring Map is a double-edged sword for you? You can't always seek quick results when using it. You have to understand that the Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill is after all a cultivation technique of the Demon Clan. Since you are from the Human Clan, it's okay to cultivate slowly. If you enhance too quickly, it will destabilize your foundation, cause hidden concerns in your physique, and might even ruin your future in body cultivation," Qi Ye stated, his words carrying a hint of incomprehension.
"I am aware of that, of course, but the current situation is special, which is why I asked," Yuan Ming said, feeling helpless.
"Even if you don't mind that, on the Yunhuang Continent, demon beasts of the elephant class are indeed too scarce, and it's even harder to find those with strong cultivation. Using the essence blood of other demon beasts for a long time will only make the future bottlenecks of your Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill become bigger," Qi Ye sighed.
"That's not something to worry about. I plan to make another trip to the Black Wind Desert, to the Shura Palace, and use the Qi Blood Power from the body of the Shura Master to help me break through," Yuan Ming said with a smile.
"If that is the case, then it's not impossible," Qi Ye paused upon hearing this, then said.
Upon hearing these words, Yuan Ming's expression slightly relaxed.
Now that the Wu Yue God had appeared, with his grudges with the Wu Yue Sect, if he did not enhance his strength quickly, he would truly have nowhere to be buried. Therefore, he could not care less about an unstable foundation.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, are you prepared to enhance your strength as quickly as possible, regardless of everything?" Qi Ye seemed hesitant and pondered for a long while before asking.
"That is natural," Yuan Ming said.
"In that case, I do have another method that can help you avoid the problem of an unstable foundation and won't affect your future cultivation path; I just don't know if you dare to try it?" Qi Ye suddenly added.
"What method?" Yuan Ming asked.
"Entering demonism," Qi Ye said solemnly.
"You're suggesting I fall into the Demon Dao?" Yuan Ming's enthusiasm, which had just flared, instantly cooled upon hearing this.
For him to fall into the Demon Dao, Yuan Ming really couldn't accept it in a short time.
"It's not falling into the Demon Dao, but cultivating a demon body. The method involves absorbing Demonic Qi and integrating it with your body, turning your flesh into a Half-demon Body. That way, cultivating too quickly and having an unstable foundation will no longer be a problem," Qi Ye explained.
"What are the risks of this method?" Yuan Ming pondered for a moment, then asked.
As far as he knew, the Demon Clan was naturally strong in physical body, most were inherently body cultivators, and there were also those who grew quickly by devouring others' Qi-Blood Power. Thus, transforming himself into a Half-demon Body was indeed a method.
"Once demonized, it is irreversible, and you will become a Half-demon Body for life. Moreover, the process of demonization is extremely painful, and you might get overwhelmed by this pain and lose control at any moment. Additionally, the infiltration of Demonic Qi is subtle. While you make use of it, you must also learn to resist it," Qi Ye said.
"What happens if I fail to resist?" Yuan Ming frowned.
"The Demonic Qi will erode your Sea of Consciousness, and you will completely become a demon," Qi Ye responded.
"Okay, how do we do it? Teach me," Yuan Ming decided after a moment's consideration.
"This concerns your future path in cultivation, are you sure you don't want to reconsider?" Qi Ye hadn't expected Yuan Ming to agree so quickly and couldn't help but remind him.
"Entering demonism, that is my choice," Yuan Ming asserted.
"Hearing you say that, I'm suddenly not so worried," Qi Ye suddenly laughed.
"Why?" Yuan Ming asked, puzzled.This chapter first appeared on *.
"Drawing Demonic Qi into your body, the biggest taboo is not having a firm resolve. If your mind wavers, I would have advised you to give up because you wouldn't be able to withstand the erosion by Demonic Qi. But now, it seems I was overly concerned," Qi Ye explained.
"If that's the case, please tell me how to perform it," Yuan Ming asked.
"The cultivation method isn't complicated. You just need to follow the sequence I teach you. Start with the limbs, then the torso, and finally the Dantian, successively absorbing Demonic Qi into your acupoints," Qi Ye instructed.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming was relieved and felt more confident.
"However, Demonic Qi is scarce on the Yunhuang Continent, and pure ones even more so. If you want to cultivate a Half-demon Body now, I'm afraid you can only rely on the Demonic Qi from the Evil King Mirror," Qi Ye took a turn in the conversation.
"The Evil King Mirror is too sinister, even the Undead Tree Demon can't do anything about it. I don't want to get too involved with it," Yuan Ming pondered for a long while upon hearing this, then shook his head.
"Then there is no way... Now I am just a ghost and can't help you. But after all, the Evil King Mirror originated from the Demon World, and the Demonic Qi contained within it is still pure enough. Maybe you should reconsider?" Qi Ye persuaded.
"No, I have another place in mind," Yuan Ming thought for a moment, then suddenly smiled.
In the Underground Palace within the Southern Border Snake King Valley, there was also a good amount of Demonic Qi. As for whether it was pure, he didn't know, but it was certainly less risky than using the Evil King Mirror.
Hearing this, Qi Ye no longer tried to persuade him.
Yuan Ming stayed there for another seven days, absorbed the last trace of the Five Elements Spirit Marrow, and then set off for the Snake King Valley.

chapters.title: Chapter 689 - 660: Demon Ape of Snake Valley
chapters.content:
Southern Border, Snake King Valley.
Yuan Ming had spent nearly half a month traveling and had finally arrived once again at this dense forest thriving with miasma.
Despite the years that had passed, the place seemed to have changed little on the surface.
However, compared to his first two visits, Yuan Ming felt much more relaxed now. With his current cultivation, he could easily enter and exit these woods without needing the Obstacle Avoidance Pearl, relying solely on his strong physical body.
After they had killed the Snake King in the valley years ago, word had gradually spread. More and more cultivators entered the valley seeking fortune, turning a place almost forbidden into one that had become increasingly lively over the years.
Yuan Ming hadn't been in the valley long when he encountered a group of cultivators looking for treasure.
There were seven or eight of them, all Loose Cultivators, led by a man at the Early-stage Core Formation with a thick beard and a face full of cross flesh, which gave him a somewhat fierce appearance.
Seeing Yuan Ming alone resting under an old tree, they approached him to greet him.
"Fellow Daoist, are you here alone?" the bearded man inquired as he stepped forward.
His tone carried a hint of provocation.
Yuan Ming, not really considering them a threat but also not wanting to cause trouble, frowned and asked:
"Is there a problem?"
His question immediately made someone in the group discontent.
"Hey, kid, how do you speak to our master uncle?" a skinny man complained.
"No other meaning, just saw you were alone and thought to ask if you wanted to join us." the bearded man glanced at him, then turned and asked Yuan Ming again.
"No need," Yuan Ming responded without a second thought, directly refusing.
"Well, if that's the case, we won't disturb you further," said the bearded man, not persisting any further.This соntеnt wаs first rеlеаsеd оn МV_LЕМРYR.
Yet, just as he walked a few steps away, he suddenly turned back and loudly cautioned, "Fellow Daoist, just a heads-up, the Snake King Valley has not been peaceful recently. The demon beasts that usually dwell deep in the valley have sometimes been encountered outside; take extra care."
As soon as the bearded man finished speaking, the skinny man muttered under his breath, "Master Uncle, why bother telling him that? He's impolite. Just let him find his own trouble."
Yuan Ming overheard the conversation and his opinion of the fierce-looking bearded man improved slightly.
"May I ask why the demon beasts that live in the depths of the valley are now venturing out?" Yuan Ming asked, intrigued by his words.
"It's said that there's an exceedingly ferocious demon beast deep within the Snake King Valley, and many of the beasts that lived there have fled because they fear this creature," the bearded man stopped and explained.
Exceedingly ferocious?
Yuan Ming, unfazed, casually asked, "What kind of demon beast is it?"
"It seems ... to be a White Ape, some people have apparently seen it," the bearded man pondered before responding.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming felt a strange sensation in his heart. Could it be that creature?
Suppressing his excitement, he minutely sensed the surroundings and indeed detected that the psychic connection with Vajra was within this Snake King Valley. He immediately got up and hurried to catch up with the bearded man and his group.
"Fellow Daoist, it's my first time in Snake King Valley, and I'm unfamiliar with these lands, so I was overly cautious earlier. My apologies," Yuan Ming said as he clasped his fists in greeting.
"It's no bother. It's good to be careful when you're away from home," the bearded man clasped his fists in return.
"You're open-minded, and it makes me feel ashamed. May I know if I can still join your group?" Yuan Ming praised and then asked.
"Why not? The more people, the better the care we can take of each other," the bearded man replied with an easy smile.
"Thank you very much," Yuan Ming replied with a smile, clasping his fists.
Together, the group headed deeper into Snake King Valley.
Along the way, they encountered several demon beasts which weren't very strong and were quickly slain by the group's combined efforts.
However, Yuan Ming found it odd that every time they split up the demon bones and flesh, they would take out a black stone and wave it over the body of the demon beasts.
"Fellow Daoist Ha Chi, what are you doing?" Yuan Ming asked, puzzled.
Through casual conversation along the way, he had learned the bearded man's name was Ha Chi.
"This is a mission from the Shichuan Alliance, to search all the demon beasts in Snake King Valley that have been tainted with Demonic Qi," Ha Chi explained.
"What do they want with the demon beasts tainted with Demonic Qi?" Yuan Ming continued to inquire.
"To find that Demon Ape. It's said that any demon beast that has come into contact with the Demon Ape will be tainted with its Demonic Qi. The more of these beasts we find, the closer we are to finding the Demon Ape," Ha Chi responded.
"They want to kill that Demon Ape?" Yuan Ming furrowed his brow and asked.
"What else? Killing that Ape would yield countless treasures. How do you know so little? What exactly are you doing in Snake King Valley?" the skinny man impatiently said.
His words reminded Ha Chi that, throughout their journey, this man named Yuan who asked all sorts of questions hadn't specified his purpose.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, so you didn't accept a mission from the Shichuan Alliance?" Ha Chi asked, his eyebrows knitted.
Previously, he had subconsciously assumed Yuan Ming had taken up the task as well and had invited him to join their group.
"I'm not, I came here to collect Lost Grass, but I need those that are at least a hundred years old, which are hard to find," Yuan Ming made up an excuse to get by.
While they were talking, suddenly, a sharp arrow signal sounded.
They hastily looked towards the direction of the sound, only to see a fiery red arrow light shooting up into the sky from deep within Snake King Valley, lingering for a long time.
"Found them, they've found the Demon Ape," Ha Chi exclaimed excitedly.
"Uncle Master, let's hurry and follow, we might still get a share of the loot," the thin man urged anxiously.
The rest showed expressions of excitement as well.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, just by participating in this mission there are rewards to be claimed, bystanders included. Although you didn't take up the mission, we consider you one of us and you can claim an extra reward, do you want to come along?" Ha Chi looked at Yuan Ming and asked.
"Go, with such a good opportunity, how could I not go," Yuan Ming said immediately.
The group hurriedly followed the guidance of the soaring red light, rushing towards it quickly.
Yuan Ming had already recognized that the place indicated by the red light was the ruined castle deep within Snake King Valley.
Before they even reached there, they could hear intense fighting sounds and wails from afar, with powerful bursts of energy fluctuating continuously from that direction.
Ha Chi's pace involuntarily slowed down.
"What's wrong?" Yuan Ming, seeing the others stop, couldn't help but turn back and ask.
"This noise... something is not right," Ha Chi's forehead was covered in cold sweat as he spoke tremblingly.
The Shichuan Alliance had gathered at least two Nascent Soul stage powerhouses this time, and they were equipped with a formation. Logically, the ones screaming should be the Demon Ape, but now all they could hear were the cries of humans.
"No, no, we can't go through," the thin man wiped the sweat off his forehead and shook his head.
"We came here for the rewards, not to die," Ha Chi said, surprisingly calm at that moment.
"Since we're here, I'll take a look," Yuan Ming smiled.
Upon hearing this, everyone looked at him as if he were a fool.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, this isn't the time to be greedy. If you really can't bear it, let's wait a bit longer, wait for the noise inside to die down before checking it out," Ha Chi quickly tried to dissuade him.
"It's fine, you guys wait here," Yuan Ming said, then dashed out without looking back.
Ha Chi and the others exchanged glances and eventually clenched their teeth and followed.
However, by this time Yuan Ming was no longer concealing his cultivation, and his speed was extremely fast, beyond what they could keep up with.
In a short while, Yuan Ming arrived outside the ruined castle.
Around the castle was a pervasive smell of blood, and limbs were scattered everywhere on the ground; around a dozen bodies lay in disarray, none fully intact.
Inside the castle, an elder in a black robe, bathed in blood, was pressing down with both hands, controlling a huge, ten-zhang long black inkstone, firmly suppressing a giant white ape beneath it.
The giant ape was covered in snow-white fur, and except for its fists which were stained with blood, there was not a single spot of blood on its body.
Its eyes glowed fiercely, and its irregular Beast Teeth tightly interlocked. A faint Demonic Qi radiated from its body, showing not even a hint of panic or fear.
In contrast, the elder in the black robe using the black inkstone to suppress it had an expression of both fear and panic. The inkstone he was pressing down seemed like his lifesaver; any looseness, and he would lose his life.
Sensing someone approaching, the black-robed elder immediately looked in Yuan Ming's direction, his eyes flashing with a desperate hope.
"Fellow Daoist, are you also here to hunt the Demon Ape? I have it suppressed. Quickly move forward and strike its rear head, and we will surely succeed," the black-robed elder urgently shouted.
Yuan Ming, however, showed no reaction.
His gaze landed on the white giant ape, and he couldn't help but sigh, "Its aura is much thicker, its physical body much tougher, it has indeed grown a lot."
"What are you waiting for, hurry up, I can't hold it down much longer," the black-robed elder shouted anxiously.
He didn't actually want Yuan Ming to kill the Demon Ape, as a Nascent Soul Realm Cultivator who had previously come with him had already proven the robustness of the Demon Ape's physique, which was not easily harmed by ordinary means.
What he wanted was to use Yuan Ming's life, to help him carve a path to escape.
At this moment, the White Ape also noticed Yuan Ming, and a burst of joyous light exploded in its bright eyes.
"Roar..."
It let out a roar from its mouth, suddenly throwing the giant inkstone it was holding up high, heavily smashing it against the crumbling wall of the castle, causing it to shake violently and stones to collapse.
The Nascent Soul elder was shaken until he spat out blood, and his eyes also turned a bloody red.
"Evil beast, you forced my hand," he shouted angrily, swiftly taking out a black vial and pouring the viscous liquid inside into his mouth.
The next instant, the elder's body lit up with a dark glow, and strands of black smoke emerged from his orifices. His entire aura suddenly surged, reaching mid-stage Nascent Soul.
At the same time, black patterns appeared on his face and an indescribable malice burst forth from his body.
"Heh, what a rare encounter, to meet a cultivator here who practices the Cultivation Technique of my Demon Clan," suddenly the voice of Qi Ye resonated within Yuan Ming's Sea of Consciousness.

chapters.title: Chapter 690 - 661: Door Sealing Stone
chapters.content:
"No wonder I felt demonic Qi lingering around him earlier, turns out he has been practicing the Demon Clan's cultivation techniques. So, he's considered a demon cultivator," Yuan Ming suddenly realized.
"Barely, but it's not any high-level technique. It just barely allows one to absorb demonic Qi into the body to strengthen the physical body. Coupled with some fortuitous opportunities, he was able to cultivate all the way here, though it's not without great future trouble," Qi Ye's initial surprise quickly waned.
Yuan Ming didn't pay much attention to this, as his focus was entirely on Vajra and the Black Robed Elder.
After unleashing his killer move, the Black Robed Elder's magic treasure in hand immediately changed to an octagonal copper hammer that was pitch-black all over. He hurled it towards White Ape.
Vajra only wanted to recognize Yuan Ming right away, and upon seeing the Black Robed Elder blocking the way, he became furiously enraged at once.
With a roar from his mouth, two beams of gold light suddenly shone from his eyes. His body exuded an even crazier surge of Demonic Qi, wrapping around him as if he were wearing a black armor on the outside.
"Get out of the way."
Vajra's huge hand, like a fan, swung fiercely and heavily slapped the octagonal copper hammer.
With a "bang", accompanied by a circle of deep purple halos rippling out, the copper hammer, under the massive shock, indented half a palm print on its surface and uncontrollably spun back.
The Nascent Soul elder was startled, his two arms suddenly thickened, and with a crisscross motion in front, shrouded in black radiance, he managed to stop the hammer.
But the elder's expression was far from relaxed; his arms were trembling slightly, and his legs were forced to retreat a bit forcefully, apparently unable to completely block it.
Just at that moment, a white shadow flickered behind him, and White Ape's figure appeared out of nowhere, with its fan-sized enormous hands slamming down ferociously on the elder's head.
With a "pop", the Nascent Soul cultivator's head exploded, splattering brain matter like a shattered watermelon.
Seeing this scene, even Yuan Ming couldn't help but twitch the corner of his eye slightly.
Vajra's speed, coupled with the power of that strike, was definitely not something that could be achieved by someone below the Tongqiao Body realm, and given its physique, its physical strength was probably even greater than Yuan Ming's.
Immediately afterwards, they saw the Nascent Soul that was hidden inside the battered body become exposed, covered with strands of Demonic Qi and a fierce and evil expression, obviously having transformed into a Demon Infant.
Seeing its physical body destroyed, the Demon Infant, relying on its ferocity, turned into a black shadow and darted straight towards Yuan Ming's forehead, attempting to seize his body with lightning speed.
However, before it could get close, a streak of lightning burst forth from Yuan Ming's forehead and struck it.
The Demon Infant didn't even get a chance to cry out before it was annihilated in the exploding lightning, turned to dust.
Upon seeing this, White Ape rushed towards Yuan Ming with joy.
The ground thundered with its charging, causing the mountains and forests to tremble.
At this moment, Ha Chi and the others just arrived and saw this scene. Their faces changed dramatically, feeling like their souls had left their bodies.
"Run..."
Seeing Yuan Ming standing still, Ha Chi turned red with urgency.This chapter's true source is * (*).
The others, seeing the corpses scattered all around, were chilled to the bone and fled in panic.
However, in the next instant, they witnessed an absurd scene.
The White Ape that charged with imposing momentum stopped before reaching Yuan Ming, bowed with a clasped fist salute like a human, and called out "Master".
Master?
Hearing this word, Ha Chi and his companions' jaws almost dropped, and they even forgot to continue running.
"Vajra, you've grown a lot in these years," Yuan Ming said as he looked at the giant creature in front of him and smilingly patted it.
"Master, how did you come here? I was just about to leave to look for you," Vajra said with a surge of joy in his eyes, completely ignoring Ha Chi and his group.
Yuan Ming was about to speak when he suddenly remembered Ha Chi and the others and turned his head to shout at them, "You too, come here."
They shuddered in fright at his shout; who would dare to really come closer?
But they also dared not leave and could only stand stuck in a dilemma on the spot.
"Come here," Yuan Ming said with emphasis.
The group, chilled to the bone, didn't dare to hesitate any longer and hurriedly scurried over.
"Apart from the belongings on those two Nascent Soul cultivators, don't touch anything else. Search the others and share what you find," Yuan Ming waved his hand and instructed.
Ha Chi and his companions, already too frightened to breathe properly, were even more baffled at his words and stood dumbfounded without moving.
"Alright, pick up what you can and then leave quickly," Yuan Ming said.
Seeing an impatient expression on his face, Ha Chi and the others did not dare to hesitate any longer. They quickly scavenged the corpses and then scrammed from the place.
It wasn't until they had run a great distance that they still couldn't quite believe what had happened.
"Boss... Boss, who do you think that Fellow Daoist Yuan is?" the thin man asked, still shaken.
"Who knows? Let's get moving. With so much loot, we'll have to leave the Southern Border for a while," Ha Chi shook his head and said.
Meanwhile, after taking the storage magic tools from the two Nascent Soul stage cultivators, Yuan Ming, along with Vajra, re-entered Snake King Cave.
Yuan Ming, with Vajra in tow, reached the depths of the underground cavern and followed the green stone pathway to reach the grey Underground Palace inside.
This place was just as it had been years ago, the gray walls shimmering with black light, and clouds of black fog floating in the void. The black stone pillar, as thick as a millstone, now stood beside that black stone gate.
Inscribed all around it were ancient patterns, with a thick black fog swirling around its surface, giving it an incredibly heavy appearance.
As soon as he entered the place, Qi Ye's voice echoed in Yuan Ming's Sea of Consciousness.
"What... what is this place, to possess such rich and pure Demonic Qi?" he exclaimed in astonishment.
"This is the place I mentioned to you before. What do you think? Is the Demonic Qi here suitable for cultivating your Half-Demon Body?" Yuan Ming replied indifferently.
"It's sufficient. As long as there is ample Demonic Qi, I can assure you your cultivation will go smoothly," Qi Ye responded.
Yuan Ming ceased speaking with him, instead asking about the recent situation of Vajra.
He was told that it too had only recently broken through to the Tongqiao Body, after which its cultivation progress had slowed down.
"Master, did you come here for the Demonic Qi?" Vajra too was surprised to learn of Yuan Ming's purpose for coming here.
"Correct, I need Demonic Qi for body refinement," Yuan Ming confirmed with a nod.
Vajra, not particularly verbose to begin with, kept his doubts to himself despite his curiosity, and simply stood silently at the side.
Yuan Ming checked the black stone pillar and immediately swept his Divine Sense over it, but like before, he was deflected by an invisible force.
He furrowed his brows, gathering all his Divine Power, and turned it into a sharp Soul Blade that stabbed towards the black stone pillar.
This time, his Divine Thought effortlessly pierced through the invisible barrier, landing on the black stone pillar.
The patterns on the stone pillar immediately lit up, and a myriad of Forbidden Runes began to emerge on its surface, intricate and countless.
Yuan Ming was dumbfounded by the sheer number of restrictions, which he believed was second only to the Stealing Heaven Tripod among all the magic treasures and artifacts he had encountered in the past.
He tried using a secret technique to refine the black stone pillar but soon retreated in defeat.
The Forbidden Runes were indeed what was inscribed on it, but they were entirely different from those on ordinary magic artifacts. When Yuan Ming infused his mana, not only could he not refine it, but it was like pouring cold water into boiling oil, eliciting a fierce reaction.
In no time at all, the mana he had sent into it was completely evaporated.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, there's no use trying. The Sacrificial Refining Method of the Yunhuang Continent cannot refine this treasure from the Demon World," Qi Ye's voice chimed in his mind at the right moment.
"Why is that?" Yuan Ming asked, puzzled.
"The magic treasures from the Demon World, when activated, operate on Demonic Qi, and naturally, they must be refined with Demonic Qi as well. You don't even have a Half-Demon Body, let alone the ability to manipulate Demonic Qi to refine this treasure," Qi Ye explained.
"I see. Fellow Daoist Qi Ye, do you recognize what this is?" Yuan Ming inquired.
"This... Not to deceive you, I can only tell that this object is extraordinary, but what exactly it is, I cannot say for sure. However, its placement here seems to serve the purpose of sealing the door," Qi Ye said cautiously after some hesitation.
"For sealing the door?" Yuan Ming expressed his surprise.
He remembered that when he first discovered this stone pillar, it was not near the stone gate.
"Some of the patterns on this stone pillar are Sealing Runes from the Demon World. I can teach you the method to break them," Qi Ye offered.
"That would be great," Yuan Ming said, delighted.
Immediately, Qi Ye conveyed the Breaking Formation Technique to Yuan Ming.
Since he couldn't summon enough Demonic Qi, and the common arrays couldn't be utilized, he had to use an array to break the seals.
Following Qi Ye's instructions, Yuan Ming quickly set up an Array around the stone pillar. Once he infused his mana into it, the Array began operating on its own.
The surrounding void's Demonic Qi was drawn by the Array, converging towards it.
Suddenly, the Array driven by spiritual energy began to shift to black as the Demonic Qi poured in, and a Forbidden Breaking power emerged from within, shrouding the black stone pillar.
The runes on the stone pillar began to light up one by one, and an originally invisible black chain emerged from the void, stretching from the pillar to the stone gate.
"Indeed, it's a Door Sealing Stone," Yuan Ming murmured to himself upon seeing this.
He then rallied his full strength to activate the Array, starting to break the seals.
As the light from the ground Array flowed faster, the runes of the black stone pillar gradually dimmed, and the chain that connected to the stone gate began to virtualize.
"Bang"
