A faint sound was heard as the chain finally broke apart, and the runes and seals on the black stone pillar also vanished into thin air.
Yuan Ming was overjoyed.
He walked forward, caressed the black stone pillar for a while, and then collected it into his Storage Bracelet.
The moment the black stone pillar disappeared, a gust-like sound came from inside the stone gate, slamming into it so violently that it echoed throughout.
Then, incredibly rich black Demonic Qi surged out, filling the entire cave like a dense fog.
Upon seeing this, Yuan Ming's surprise was overwhelmed by his excitement.
"Who would have thought that the Yunhuang Continent possessed such vast and pure Demonic Qi. What exactly is behind this stone gate?" Qi Ye, too, couldn't help but marvel.

chapters.title: Chapter 691 - 662 Demon Eye
chapters.content:
Vajra was also full of amazement, clicking his tongue in wonder, "Master, I've been here for so many years, yet I've never seen such an outpouring of demonic Qi."
Yuan Ming did not speak, but with a flick of his wrist, he activated a storage bracelet he had prepared earlier. It lit up, beginning to attempt to collect the demonic Qi floating in the void.
However, no matter how the light on the storage bracelet flickered, the demonic Qi seemed not to perceive it at all, refusing to be collected.
Yuan Ming seemed to have anticipated this and unhurriedly took out a prepared spiritual beast bag from his bosom.
He raised his hand and threw it, the seven spiritual beast bags flying into the air simultaneously; their openings wide, the bodies of the bags expanded, seeming to have a vortex within them continuously drawing in the demonic Qi from the cavern.
"Hoo hoo hoo"
The seven spiritual beast bags voraciously absorbed the demonic Qi at a visibly rapid pace, but the chamber remained shrouded in black mist, as if not a bit of the demonic Qi had been lost.
Only then did Yuan Ming notice that the more zealously he tried to absorb the demonic Qi, the more it seemed to surge out from the crevices of the stone door, as inexhaustible as ever.
In no time at all, the seven spiritual beast bags were all bulging, unable to accommodate even a speck more of demonic Qi.
Looking around the entire underground palace, it was still permeated with demonic Qi, and the intensity of it had not changed in the slightest compared to before.
"I initially thought that, no matter how dense or abundant the demonic Qi here, preparing seven spiritual beast bags should be enough. It seems my understanding was still too naive. However, the demonic Qi in these seven bags should suffice for your cultivation for a while," Qi Ye lamented sincerely.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming felt somewhat reluctant.
Not only had Qi Ye underestimated the demonic Qi here, but so had he.
Seeing a treasure mountain before him, yet only being able to dig away a corner, this feeling was indeed maddening.
Just as this thought flashed through his mind, a sudden burst of inspiration struck Yuan Ming: "How could I have forgotten that item!"
As the thought arose, a red light flashed in his palm, and a red ancient scroll immediately appeared.
"Whoosh"
The red ancient scroll unfolded, promptly revealing a small wooden tower and a large mountain.
The mountain was none other than the Houtu Town Mountain Peak that Yuan Ming had Huan Ling Zi collect for him at the Three Immortals Island.
In addition to its offensive abilities, this treasure was also a special space treasure, its grade incomparable to ordinary spiritual beast bags; using it to collect the demonic Qi here was also feasible.
Yuan Ming's mana surged, and he immediately activated the red ancient scroll.
The next instant, a beam of light flowed across the surface of the scroll; originally a depiction of barren mountains and stagnant waters, in the illumination, it immediately became vivid.
In the gleaming flow of light, both the small wooden tower and the Houtu Town Mountain Peak also came to life.
"Collect," Yuan Ming pointed and uttered a low command.
In the flowing light of the red ancient scroll, a collapse suddenly occurred inside, forming a rapidly spinning vortex.
The rolling demonic Qi, drawn by the vortex, instantly converged into a stormy whirlpool, voraciously rushing towards the red ancient scroll.
The scroll, which had been arid land moments before, now seemed to have ink drops spilt on it, tinting a patch of black.
The demonic Qi floated lightly above the blank part of the scroll, gatherthing like imposing dark clouds, soon condensing into a large mass.
The red ancient scroll's rate of absorbing demonic Qi was hundreds of times faster than the spiritual beast bags; in just a moment, the entire underground palace was once again clear, and the cloudy demonic Qi was no longer visible in the void.
And the demonic Qi that seeped from the stone door's crevice, too, was absorbed so thoroughly it couldn't even disperse into the void.
Upon taking another look at the red ancient scroll, its blank parts still occupied a large area, clearly indicating ample space remained.
Vajra, watching this scene, was so amazed that he was rendered speechless.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, could this possibly be the legendary space treasure, the Map of Ten Thousand Realms?" Qi Ye couldn't help but ask.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming was slightly surprised, for although he had refined the item, he was unaware of its name; only upon Qi Ye's inquiry did he suddenly realize.
Indeed, other than the rumored Map of Ten Thousand Realms that could contain vast expanses of void, what other space treasure could possess such immense space?
Yuan Ming looked at the empty underground palace and the Map of Ten Thousand Realms that still had significant space, his gaze inevitably falling on the stone door.
Clearly, the source of the demonic Qi was behind the stone door. To obtain more demonic Qi, naturally, he had to explore behind it.
"Fellow Daoist Qi Ye, do you have a way to open this stone gate's seals?" Yuan Ming inquired.
"Remove the Door Sealing Stone, and with the Forbidden Breaking Techniques from your Yunhuang Continent, the stone gate's seals can be easily broken," Qi Ye replied.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming immediately began attempting to break the stone gate's seals.
About fifteen minutes later, a stream of flowing light suddenly brightened above the stone gate, then immediately turned into specks of light and disappeared.
Vajra stepped forward and heaved a push; amid the "clack clack" of heavy friction, the stone gate abruptly opened.
The moment the stone gate opened, an overwhelmingly thick Demonic Qi burst out like floodwaters released from a dam, instantly engulfing Yuan Ming and Vajra.
Yuan Ming, far from alarmed, was delighted and immediately activated the Map of Ten Thousand Realms again.
As the scrolls on the map swirled, the surging Demonic Qi rushed unstoppably, converging towards the Red Ancient Scroll.
This absorption lasted for two hours.
When the scroll had drained the last bit of Demonic Qi, over half of the sky within the Map of Ten Thousand Realms was obscured by the accumulated Demonic Qi, forming a vast expanse of incredibly dark clouds.
Yuan Ming, satisfied, put away the Red Ancient Scroll and stepped into the stone gate.
The space inside the stone gate was not small, the walls around it were also gray-black in color, but densely engraved with Forbidden Runes, seemingly set up to isolate the Demonic Qi.
In the center of this space on the ground, there was an altar about thirty feet in diameter.
Around the altar, thirty-six Array Eyes were distributed, each containing spirit light, as if stars were embedded within them.
In the center of the altar, there was a slightly elevated dark well on the ground, covered with a halo of stars, while thick Demonic Qi continuously surged upward, attempting to break through the thin film of light.
Between the edge of the well and the film, strands of Demonic Qi were continuously escaping.
"The Thirty-Six Star Constellation Sealing Array, here... there is actually a Demon Eye here?" Qi Ye's voice rang out in Yuan Ming's Sea of Consciousness, filled with unbelievable astonishment.
"Fellow Daoist Qi Ye, what is a Demon Eye?" Yuan Ming asked, frowning.
"In our Demon World, places where pure Demonic Qi converges are called Demon Eyes, and such things should not appear in your Yunhuang Continent, unless..." Qi Ye seemed to think of something, hesitatingly said.
"Unless what?" Yuan Ming urged with a frown.
"Unless there is a spatial rift here that connects directly to the Demon World, coincidentally linking a Demon Eye and allowing the Demonic Qi to seep through," Qi Ye pondered for a moment, then continued.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming was also moved and greatly surprised.
"Could our earlier actions have opened this spatial rift?" He suddenly thought of himself taking away the Door Sealing Stone and opening the stone gate's seal, and couldn't help but feel a bit scared.Thе full sеriеs livеs оn Мy Virtuаl Librаry Еmpirе (М|V|L0ЕМРYR).
If the passage between Yunhuang Continent and the Demon World were rashly opened, the Southern Border might become even more tumultuous and chaotic, leading to an era of great upheaval and misery.
"In my view, it should not. The Thirty-Six Star Constellation Sealing Array is still quite stable at this time, with just a slight seepage of Demonic Qi. It won't easily become a problem. Furthermore, you've removed the Demonic Qi that has been accumulating here for who knows how many years, reducing its erosion of the Array. The seal here will only become more stable," Qi Ye pondered and said.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming finally breathed a sigh of relief.
"The person who set up this Great Array is truly ingenious and extraordinary," Qi Ye couldn't help but exclaim.
After inspecting the Underground Palace, Yuan Ming saw that there was nothing else amiss and left the stone gate together with Vajra.
After closing the stone gate again, Yuan Ming repaired the Great Array and resealed the stone gate.
It would be very difficult for this location to accumulate Demonic Qi on the scale it had before for probably ten thousand years; thus, he did not need to worry about Demon Cultivators targeting this place again.
However, to prevent the Thirty-Six Star Constellation Sealing Array from being destroyed, Yuan Ming also set up a Sealing Array and an Illusion Array in the cave, masking this place as much as possible.
After everything was done, he left the area with Vajra.
As they were about to leave Snake King Valley, Vajra, having held back all this while, finally could not refrain from asking, "Master, why haven't we seen Hua Zhi?"
It was then Yuan Ming remembered he had not yet let this pair of quarrelsome lovers meet and promptly summoned Hua Zhi.
When Vajra saw the girl suddenly appearing in front of him, he thought he was hallucinating and rubbed his eyes repeatedly until, unable to suppress his astonishment, he exclaimed, "Are you Hua Zhi?"
"Stinky monkey..." Hua Zhi first felt joy, then glared with slanted eyes.
"Why are you a female?" Vajra, still in shock, blurted out.
"Nonsense, you uncultivated stinky monkey, why are you still all hairy to this day, what, can't you even transform?" Hua Zhi scolded angrily before mocking him.
"Who says? I just prefer my original form," Vajra retorted.
"Then transform and let me see if you've even shed your fur," Hua Zhi relentlessly pursued.
"Transform, then I'll transform," Vajra, successfully provoked, said.
In the next instant, a surge of white light enveloped him, his body rapidly shrinking, transforming into a short-haired young man dressed in a white robe, his hair and eyebrows completely white, but his features quite handsome.
"How about it, not bad, right?" the white-haired young man grinned, revealing two fangs, his handsome appearance mixed with the youthful vibrancy of a young man.
"A monkey without fur, even uglier." Hua Zhi stared for a moment, stubbornly sneering again.
"You..." Vajra was at a loss for words.
Yuan Ming silently watched the two bicker, not intervening, a faint smile appearing on his face.
Afterward, he summoned Lei Yu, revealed his true form, and together with Hua Zhi and the others, soared into the sky, leaving Southern Border and heading straight for the Black Wind Desert.

chapters.title: Chapter 692 - 663: Body Infusion
chapters.content:
Three months later.
Inside the Shura Palace, Yuan Ming sat cross-legged, his fingers flying as he quickly formed spells, shooting them one after another at the Shura Blood Devouring Map that hovered in midair.
The surface of the Shura Blood Devouring Map radiated with blood light, slowly consuming the corpse of the Shura Master bit by bit.
"To absorb Demonic Qi into the body, one must use the Demon Refining Array, which is a shortcut created by our Demon Clan to better guide the Demonic Qi into the body's acupoints," Qi Ye's voice rang out in Yuan Ming's Sea of Consciousness.
"How is the Demon Refining Array set up, and does it require any special spiritual materials?" Yuan Ming asked.
"A complete Demon Refining Array naturally lacks some spiritual materials, but with some modifications I've made, it can be used for now. Before that, there are some things I need to inform you of in advance," Qi Ye said.
"Please enlighten me," Yuan Ming said.
"Although Fellow Daoist Yuan is already well-versed in the path of Body Cultivation, having reached the Tongqiao Body, the physique of the Human Clan is unlike that of the Demon Clan; therefore, leading Demonic Qi into the body is akin to feeding a fierce medicine to the flesh. If you can successfully endure it, the Demonic Qi will merge with your flesh and greatly enhance the strength of your Physical Body. Then, using the Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill to refine Essence Blood and enhance your cultivation will be smooth and unobstructed. But if you cannot withstand it, the outcome will be the destruction of your Physical Body and the transformation of your Divine Soul into a demon," Qi Ye's tone was grave.
"You've mentioned this to me before, and I am well aware of it," Yuan Ming nodded.
"Very well, since you have made up your mind, I will say no more. Remember, once the Demon Refining Array is activated, it cannot be stopped until it is completely finished. Furthermore, when the Demonic Qi invades, it is not only the body that will suffer. Your Divine Soul will also be harassed by the Demonic Qi. If you fail to defend against either of these two challenges, your fate will be dire," Qi Ye continued.
Yuan Ming listened quietly without saying anything more.
He had already set up a protective Array outside, and Vajra and Hua Zhi were outside helping him protect the law. Unless a cultivator at the Returning to Void Stage came along, his Cultivation would certainly not be interrupted.
The biggest risk this time was whether he could withstand it himself.
"After entering the Array, you must stand on the ground and maintain a posture that reaches for the sky and stands upon the earth; move as little as possible to avoid disturbing the path of the Demonic Qi entering your body, lest you suffer even more," Qi Ye cautioned.
"Don't worry, I've noted everything," Yuan Ming nodded and responded, then began to set up the Array following Qi Ye's guidance.
Before long, an Array about thirty to forty feet in diameter, resembling a hexagram, appeared on the empty ground in front of Yuan Ming, shimmering with black light that flickered on and off.
"If you are ready, then enter the Array. After that, you will have to rely on your own luck," Qi Ye said after checking the Array that Yuan Ming had set up and seeing no issues.
Without any hesitation, Yuan Ming stepped into the center of the Array.
In accordance with Qi Ye's instructions, he did not sit cross-legged as usual but instead stood with his hands clasped in front of him at his chest, standing straight at the center.
"Once you release the Demonic Qi from the Map of Ten Thousand Realms, the Great Array will operate on its own," Qi Ye's voice sounded again.Find this chapter's source on *.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming raised one hand.
The Red Ancient Scroll immediately flew out from his robe and slowly unfurled a section in front of him.
"Open."
As Yuan Ming softly commanded, a light sparked at the center of the scroll, and a reversing vortex emerged from it.
At the same time, tumultuous winds and clouds surged within the scroll and all the dark clouds were whipped into motion, violently spewing out from the vortex.
Whisps of cloud-like Demonic Qi scattered in all directions but were blocked by the rune Arrays that had been previously inscribed on the surrounding walls, ensuring not even a shred leaked out.
As the Demonic Qi gradually filled the entire chamber, the Demon Refining Array on the ground started to operate.
The light on the ground suddenly brightened, and strands of dark purple runes intertwined and connected in midair, enveloping Yuan Ming's figure below. The Demonic Qi floating in the chamber was instantly drawn down, settling towards the ground and into the Array.
A black light shot towards the sky, and from all around the Great Array, black chains materialized out of thin air.
The black chains were as thick as a child's arm, each with a sharp pyramidal tip. They gleamed with the luster of Black Crystal and were adorned with a layer of mysterious purple patterns.
Before Yuan Ming could react, a "clang" sound rang out as the chains shot straight towards his body from every direction.
Yuan Ming instinctively wanted to dodge, but remembering Qi Ye's warning, he stood firm as if impaled on the spot, motionless.
The next moment, the pyramidal tips of the chains pierced through his hands and feet.
An acute pain accompanied by a burning sensation caused Yuan Ming's brain to tighten sharply, his body trembling slightly.
Then, a pulling force came from his arms, and the chains that had pierced through his palms began to tighten, pulling his arms up from his sides irresistibly.
Yuan Ming clenched his teeth hard, just getting used to the pain coursing through his limbs when seven chains consecutively shot towards his back, piercing through his Yangguan, Life Gate, Spirit Platform, Shendao, and other such seven major acupoints along his spine.
A pain that shot straight into his brain marrow nearly made Yuan Ming lose control. His lips trembled, and the corners of his mouth involuntarily oozed fresh blood.
This time, before he could even adapt, a chain had already penetrated the back of his head.
However, he didn't feel the slightest pain from the back of his head. Instead, a chaotic storm erupted in his Sea of Consciousness, an indescribable force directly stabbing into it.
Yuan Ming felt as if he had been hammered; his vision suddenly blacked out, and a wave of overwhelming dizziness hit him, almost causing him to collapse.
But fortunately, his Divine Soul was resilient enough, and soon the power of his Divine Soul began to circulate, smoothing over that chaotic sensation.
In just an instant, Yuan Ming's mind became clear again, but his awareness of the intense pain in his body also became even sharper.
Without hesitation, he moved his thoughts and, following Qi Ye's taught method, urged the Demon Refining Array to life.
With a soft "huff" noise,
The Demonic Qi deposited on the ground was pulled, immediately transforming into tiny streams, winding around the chains as they climbed up towards Yuan Ming and drilled into his body.
Before long, Yuan Ming could feel the Demonic Qi entering some of his acupoints, and an indescribable sensation of distention spread from those acupoints.
The Mana stored within the acupoints clashed with the invading Demonic Qi, the two forces immediately coming to blows.
In an instant, dozens of Yuan Ming's acupoints became dozens of hidden battlefields, the violent collision of the two forces acting on the acupoints, bringing an unprecedented intense stimulation.
Yuan Ming felt as if hundreds of ants were biting him, his body aching, tingling, swelling, and throbbing with pain, an ordeal worse than being flayed alive.
As the Demonic Qi continuously infused, more and more acupoints became battlefields.
A look of agony appeared on Yuan Ming's face, yet Demonic Qi continued to flow in and out of his body incessantly, interweaving with the surrounding Mana. His stature, however, remained perfectly upright and motionless.
Before long, his mouth was full of fresh blood, veins on his forehead bulged, and cold sweat flowed down like rain, yet he persisted with immense willpower, without waver.
This process was just the beginning of the fusion between his physical body and the Demonic Qi; the pain Yuan Ming had to endure had just begun.
...
In Da Jin, Yuhua City.
In the vast expanses of the Central Plains, countless Cultivation Markets are hidden amongst famous mountains and rivers. Yet, regardless of the market, all were inhabited by mortals doing servant tasks.
Only Yuhua City, as the only city under Chang Chun Temple where outsiders are allowed, is inhabited by people of all ages with Cultivation, making it a true Immortal city, untainted by the mortal world.
Naturally, Yuhua City has also become Chang Chun Temple's appointed site for the grand meeting. This city, already teeming with cultivators, is now witnessing an even grander confluence of emissaries from all directions.
Despite the Wu Yue Sect's invasion casting a heavy shadow over this grand meeting, the Central Plains cultivators walking along the streets didn't show much concern.
The years of peace in the Central Plains have been long. The tragedies once wreaked by the Wu Yue Sect had become but emotionless records in books. Moreover, in the eyes of these Central Plains cultivators, the so-called Wu Yue Sect was nothing but an underling defeated by Chang Chun Temple; even if it resurged, it was still a mere jumping clown, destined to be defeated by Chang Chun Temple eventually.
Even if some cultivators from the East Sea described the horror and ferocity of the Wu Yue Sect, it was still not as impactful as facing the flames of war head-on.
Driven by such attitudes, the entire atmosphere in Yuhua City was buoyant and fervent; everyone was preparing for the upcoming grand meeting.
In a large hall in the southern part of Yuhua City, dozens of Chang Chun Temple disciples were bustling about, ceaselessly dealing with documents related to the grand meeting.
"Aunt Master Lou, the welcoming disciple has reported that guests from Southern Border Silk Island have passed the checkpoint, they will reach Yuhua City within two hours," reported a Qi Refining Disciple handling communications, handing a Jade Scroll to Lou Lan.
Lou Lan, once the daughter of the Grand Jin Prime Minister, hadn't changed much in appearance, but her Cultivation had reached the Late Foundation Establishment.
After Liu Tianming abdicated the throne and entered Chang Chun Temple, he soon became her Daoist companion. Unfortunately, Yuan Ming, under pressure from Chang Chun Temple, was in hiding and couldn't attend the ceremony, only sending a piece of correspondence from Little Lake City as congratulations.
While regrettable, Lou Lan was understanding of Yuan Ming's situation, harboring no grudges in her heart.
Years later, when Yuan Ming returned to Qu Jiang and reunited with Liu Tianming, Lou Lan learned of the circumstances through his accounts and was pleasantly surprised at Yuan Ming's Core Formation advancement, concerned about his plight but helpless on her own.
Later, perhaps spurred by Yuan Ming, Liu Tianming left the Sect in search of an opportunity for Core Formation, only contacting the Sect after successfully forming his core to say he had found a secret realm suitable for secluded Cultivation, and then went silent.
However, before leaving, Lou Lan made a pair of Concubine Jade for Liu Tianming to carry with him, allowing them to know if the other was safe. Since the Concubine Jade remains intact, Liu Tianming was naturally of no concern.

chapters.title: Chapter 693 - 664: Tian Jizi
chapters.content:
As Liu Tianming's Daoist companion, Lou Lan now held a significant status within Chang Chun Temple.
Being inherently outgoing, and as the daughter of the Prime Minister, she was quite adept at handling various matters. With the sect gathering approaching, the Imperial Family, after obtaining her consent, straightforwardly assigned her to represent their lineage and take charge of the preparations for the specific affairs.
For instance, at this moment, as news of the gathering spread throughout Yunhuang Continent, All Major Sects and countless Loose Cultivators came flocking in. As the host, the Chang Chun Temple naturally had to send people for reception. However, different levels of sects could not be treated the same, and their lodging placement also needed careful attention. Without thorough investigation, if two sects with deep-seated grudges were arranged together, they might start clashing even before the Wu Yue Sect struck.
For this reason, Chang Chun Temple mobilized a large number of people to set up reception outposts outside Yuhua City, to transmit the incoming guests' information back to the city in advance and then urgently arrange for their accommodation.
Of course, for sects with the dominance of the Five Domains, Lou Lan had already memorized their intelligence thoroughly and prepared contingency plans. Upon hearing the Qi Refining Disciple's report, she immediately made a decision.
"This is a sect with a Late-stage Nascent Soul Great Cultivator at its helm; we must receive them with the highest standard of hospitality. Additionally, quickly inform Ancestor Ming Quan about this matter and request his presence to oversee the reception," Lou Lan said. After briefly scanning the list sent by Pan Si Island through the Jade Scroll, she passed it back.
Whenever Southern Border was mentioned, she would think of Liu Tianming. The last message from him mentioned that he found a Secret Realm in the Southern Border.
Now with upheaval in the Central Plains, the sect had issued a summons for all Chang Chun Temple disciples abroad to return and support, but there was still no word from Liu Tianming.
Fortunately, as a direct descendant of the Imperial Family, he had various uncles from the family behind him, ensuring he wouldn't be labeled a traitor to the sect.
Lou Lan sighed deeply and looked down at her documents, attempting to suppress the longing rising in her heart.
Unintentionally, her fingertips brushed another Jade Scroll, which contained the records of the East Sea Alliance cultivators who had arrived at Yuhua City a few days ago.
The news of the battle in the East Sea had already spread across Central Plains. Looking at the list, Lou Lan couldn't help but worry about Yuan Ming, who had gone to the East Sea with his parents.
She wondered how he was faring now.
With a sigh, Lou Lan's gaze remained on the documents, but her mind had unwittingly drifted far beyond the Nine Heavens.
...
On the Flying Boat of Pan Si Island, Luo Zhu looked toward the approaching Yuhua City, smiled, turned her head, and glanced at Xi Ying standing behind her, asking:
"There are quite a number of sects coming to the gathering this time. Fellow Daoist, you came alone; do you have any acquaintances to help with introductions?"
"No," Xi Ying shook her head.
This version was sourced from *.
She still maintained the disguise she used in the Southern Border, with some assistance from the Blood Bone Mask to make it even more difficult to detect, especially considering her relation to the Wu Yue Sect; it was not advisable for her to show her true face at the moment.
She did not use Yuan Ming's identity mainly because Yuan Ming's identity was too entangled, and since this was Chang Chun Temple's turf, revealing herself could lead to many complications.
She had also briefed Luo Zhu on some situations in advance, such as the past grievances between Yuan Ming and Chang Chun Temple, asking her to help conceal Yuan Ming's whereabouts.
Luo Zhu naturally did not refuse. As a Nascent Soul cultivator from the Southern Border People, her view of Chang Chun Temple was naturally not very favorable, not to mention that this was a small matter.
"In that case, Divine Envoy, why not stay and travel with me? If we encounter other Fellow Daoists, I can introduce you," Luo Zhu said cheerfully.
Xi Ying glanced at her and nodded silently.
As they spoke, the Flying Boat arrived near Yuhua City. To welcome the guests from various sects, the city's Great Array had been taken down early, and a special landing point for Flying Boats was designated. As Pan Si Island's Flying Boat approached, several Foundation Establishment cultivators drove Magic Artifacts forward to guide the boat to land.
As soon as the Flying Boat touched down, Luo Zhu and the others saw that three Nascent Soul cultivators came to greet them.
The leader was a Daoist-robed youth with a handsome appearance, fair skin, and red lips. He had emerald Spiritual Patterns on his forehead resembling branches, and there was a slight detached indifference in his eyes, yet his smile was so warm it instantly engendered goodwill.
Standing behind him were a handsome adult male cultivator and an old man dressed in a yellow Dragon Robe. The former was Ancestor Ming Quan, and the latter exuded an imperial aura, likely a Nascent Soul from the Imperial Family.
"Fellow Daoist Luo, it's been a long time since we last met; congratulations on the progress in your Cultivation," said the Daoist-robed youth as he greeted Luo Zhu with cupped hands.
"Tian Jizi, you're the one to talk. Your aura is increasingly profound and deep, so much so that even I can hardly make it out. You're probably just a few steps away from Returning to Void, right?" Luo Zhu restrained her flirtatious manner and became much more solemn.
At her side, Xi Ying seemed pensive as she observed the Daoist-robed youth. The name Tian Jizi resonated with some intelligence she remembered.
Chang Chun Temple's supremacy in the Central Plains had been established a long time ago, but the strategy to squeeze other sects out of the living space by adopting a strong posture to attract talents from all over the world in order to craft an immortal foundation for the temple, was determined only after the most recent Supreme Elder, the only Late-stage Nascent Soul Great Cultivator in the Central Plains, ascended to his position.
And his Daoist name was Tian Jizi.
It was said that in his early years, he had consumed a certain Heavenly Materials and Earthly Treasures which made him appear eternally youthful, forever bearing the visage of a young man, yet in reality, he had lived through several hundred springs and autumns, and was the eldest among all Late-stage Nascent Soul cultivators, with unfathomably deep strength.
"This Fellow Daoist seems somewhat unfamiliar, could you be a new colleague under Island Master Luo?" Tian Jizi turned his head toward Xi Ying and asked in an amiable tone.
"I am a Divine Envoy from the Moon Sect, in charge of affairs in the Southern Border. Fellow Daoist Tianji may call me Shadow." Xi Ying replied indifferently.
Upon hearing the words "Divine Envoy of the Moon Sect," Ancestor Ming Quan's expression shifted slightly as he fixed his gaze on Xi Ying for a few moments, his sleeve moving subtly as if intending to secretly initiate some kind of technique.
But at that moment, the yellow-robed elder standing beside him coughed once, causing Ancestor Ming Quan's body to stiffen, and a hint of helplessness to appear on his face.
At the same time, Tian Jizi also showed a look of surprise.
"Oh, I've only heard that your sect has a Divine Envoy Yuan who is active in the East Sea for a long time, but I wasn't aware that there was another envoy stationed at the Southern Border. However, thinking about it, the battle at the Bamboo Sea Square in the Southern Border not long ago, Shadow God Envoy, might you have also taken part in it?" Tian Jizi asked.
"Fellow Daoist is quite well-informed." Xi Ying nodded.
"Hehe, the Wu Yue Sect that lay dormant for thousands of years has been rekindled; as an elder of Chang Chun Temple, I naturally need to keep an eye on relevant news. Besides, your sect's military exploits are well known to me, especially that Divine Envoy Yuan, who should be credited with the most for the restoration of the East Sea. I actually wanted to meet him in person, but unfortunately, he seems to have other important matters and did not come with the people from the East Sea Alliance to the meeting. Since Shadow God Envoy is here, I wonder if you could contact him for me? Just say Tian Jizi is looking for him to discuss important matters," Tian Jizi said with a smile.
"We envoys do not necessarily have the means to contact each other at all times, and where Divine Envoy Yuan has gone, I am not clear either, I'm afraid it would be difficult for me to help Fellow Daoist make contact," Xi Ying tactfully declined Tian Jizi's request.
"Then... May I ask if Fellow Daoist has ever heard Divine Envoy Yuan mention the whereabouts of a certain Returning to Void Cultivator known as Elder San Jue?" Tian Jizi fell silent for a moment before asking again.
"Elder San Jue? I seem to have heard that name..." Xi Ying feigned contemplation.
"That's excellent, does Shadow God Envoy know of his whereabouts?" Tian Jizi asked eagerly.
"I am not sure of that. I only heard Divine Envoy Yuan mention him in passing when discussing the situation in the East Sea. He said that Elder San Jue was initially turned into a puppet by the Undying Tree, and after being defeated, Lord Nether Moon God personally intervened to restore his sanity. In gratitude, he promised to assist the Moon Sect twice in return, and in order to deal with the conflict in the East Sea, Divine Envoy Yuan had no choice but to use both opportunities against the Wu Yue Sect. After fulfilling the agreement, Elder San Jue left on his own without leaving any means of contact. His current whereabouts are truly unknown to anyone," Xi Ying shook her head, delivering the pre-constructed excuse.
Hearing this, Tian Jizi's face showed a hint of disappointment.
"Nonsense! If Ancestor San Jue were truly free, how could he not return to our temple?" Just then, Ancestor Ming Quan suddenly spoke out, unable to refrain from retorting.
"How could I possibly guess the thoughts of a Return to Void senior? Perhaps he feels there are more important tasks to attend to?" Xi Ying replied with a cold snicker.
Ancestor Ming Quan clenched his teeth and wanted to say more but at that moment, the yellow-robed elder beside him coughed twice more.
"Ming Quan, when there are guests present, Brother Tianji has not spoken, so what are you making a fuss about? Be mindful of your status!" The elder scolded sternly.
Ancestor Ming Quan was taken aback and also realized his impropriety, promptly holding his tongue.
"Hanyu, you needn't be so serious either; Ming Quan is also concerned about the sect, and it was out of impulsiveness that he spoke such words. Shadow Daoist, please do not take offense." Tian Jizi shook his head and then extended an apology to Xi Ying at the end.
Xi Ying couldn't be bothered to argue with Ancestor Ming Quan any longer, but hearing Tian Jizi call out the elder's name, she remembered the identity of the yellow-robed elder.
He was Liu Tianming's great-grandfather, the grandfather of his grandfather, named Liu Hanyu, and could be considered the current representative of the Imperial Family lineage within Chang Chun Temple.
Tian Jizi had come to welcome Pan Si Island, bringing along representatives of two factions; one couldn't help but wonder if this implied something.
"Alas, to think that even the envoys of your sect are now unable to contact Ancestor San Jue, it seems that the Ancestor indeed may have other considerations. Anyway, let's not dwell on this matter for now. However, Shadow God Envoy, there is another question I wish to ask you. When you came to attend this alliance meeting, did you come in your personal capacity or as a Divine Envoy of the Moon Sect?" Tian Jizi paused, then suddenly asked another question.
"Naturally, it is as a Divine Envoy of the Moon Sect," Xi Ying replied as a matter of course.
"Then, may I regard it as an indication that the Nether Moon God will also take action in this battle?" Tian Jizi's eyes flashed with a trace of sharpness.
"Perhaps, but I cannot say for certain, after all, I am just a Divine Envoy. Just like your Ancestor San Jue, Lord Nether Moon God operates on a different level, perceives things from a unique perspective, and considers matters differently. How could we, the lowly, presume to guess their thoughts? We can but follow orders," Xi Ying replied, neither confirming nor denying.

chapters.title: Chapter 694 - 665: Worries
chapters.content:
"Shadow Daoist sees through things clearly," Tian Jizi sighed and appeared to be enlightened.
Then, he turned his head to look at Luo Zhu.
"I was so engrossed in speaking with the Shadow God Envoy that I neglected Fellow Daoist Luo. There is something that must be communicated in advance now. Under the current circumstances, we can no longer afford to fight individually. In this meeting, I plan to propose the formation of the Cloud Desolate Alliance. I shall serve as the interim Alliance Hierarch and take charge of unified command and coordination. I hope for your support, Fellow Daoist Luo," Tian Jizi said, bowing slightly.
"You are rather forthright," Luo Zhu said with a light laugh.
"Haha, with our level of cultivation, there is little need to hide our intentions here in Yunhuang, and moreover, I believe everyone must have guessed my intentions upon receiving the invitation to this alliance. If I were to now put on a reluctant front, it would simply be laughable," Tian Jizi shook his head.
"Since that's the case, you should also be aware of our response," Luo Zhu crossed his arms and suddenly laughed coldly.
Tian Jizi just smiled faintly, without replying.
"Enough, after traveling such a long distance and standing here talking for so long upon arrival, I'm tired. Ming Quan, right? Where is our lodging arranged? Lead the way," Luo Zhu changed the subject, gesturing towards Ming Quan.
"Fellow Daoist Luo, please rest well. I won't bother you further," Tian Jizi said as he prepared to leave.
But Luo Zhu suddenly called out to him.
"Don't celebrate too early. Even if we acknowledge you as the Alliance Hierarch, it's only temporary," Luo Zhu stated bluntly.
"That's only reasonable," Tian Jizi left just one sentence behind, and then his figure completely vanished from everyone's view.
Soon, under the guidance of Ancestor Ming Quan and Liu Hanyu, the group from Pan Si Island arrived at their specially arranged accommodations at Chang Chun Temple.
Luo Zhu casually dismissed the Core Formation elders to set up defensive formations, and her whole demeanor relaxed immediately, sprawling unceremoniously onto the bed in her quarters.
"Ah, so we're really going to let Tian Jizi 'unify Yunhuang' now," she complained.
"It sounds nice, but it's just him being pushed out to take the fall," Xi Ying was not particularly concerned.
Just then, outside the room, a Core Formation elder suddenly announced.
"Island Master, the Alliance Hierarch of the East Sea Alliance, Wan Tianren, and the Clan Leader of the Water Ape Clan, Hou Chou, seek an audience."
Luo Zhu and Xi Ying exchanged a glance, then responded.
"Have them wait in the reception room for a moment; we'll be right there."
Thirty minutes later.
"Fellow Daoist Luo, it's been years, and your cultivation has improved," Wan Tianren greeted Luo Zhu with a bow and a smile as soon as he saw her in the reception room.
Upon hearing this, Luo Zhu immediately rolled her eyes.
"Cut the small talk. What are you here for?" she said impatiently.
Wan Tianren chuckled awkwardly, then noticed Xi Ying standing behind Luo Zhu.
"And this fellow Daoist is..." he asked politely.
"Shadow God Envoy of the Moon Sect, in charge of affairs in the Southern Border," Xi Ying answered calmly.
"Oh, so it's the Shadow God Envoy. It's a pleasure. Are you here representing the Moon Sect at the alliance? Did Divine Envoy Yuan come with you? Where might he be now?" Wan Tianren exchanged pleasantries, then asked.
"He hasn't contacted me, and since we are in charge of different areas, even if he were to come, it should be with the East Sea Alliance," Xi Ying replied.
Wan Tianren felt a bit awkward, not expecting the Shadow God Envoy to be so aloof, but he found it hard to say much more.
As they took their seats, Wan Tianren did not continue with small talk but got straight to the point, "Fellow Daoist Luo, I've come, in fact, to form an alliance with you."
"Isn't the purpose of this gathering organized by Chang Chun Temple to form such alliances? What does it mean for you to come knocking on my door personally?" Luo Zhu asked, puzzled.
"I just feel there are some situations we must consider. After all, the strength of the Wuyue Sect is far greater than we imagined. The difficulty of the battle in the East Sea is something I experienced firsthand. If not for Divine Envoy Yuan's help, the East Sea might now be under the Wuyue Sect's control. Honestly, I don't have much confidence in this alliance meeting," Wan Tianren immediately said.
Luo Zhu heard this and did not say a word, just looking at Wan Tianren expressionlessly.
"Ahem, it seems to me that with the Wuyue Sect advancing from Black Wind, the Central Plains and the Western Region are the front lines, then the East Sea and the Southern Border become the main rear of the entire alliance. If Tian Jizi genuinely intends to share lifetimes with the Central Plains, that's one thing, but if not, he might make arrangements in advance to relocate some disciples to these regions in preparation for a retreat," Wan Tianren coughed lightly and continued.
"Are you worried about them pulling off a nest takeover?" Luo Zhu asked.
"Not just that. In this confrontation with the Wuyue Sect, nominally it's about defending Yunhuang, but on a smaller scale, it's actually about protecting the Central Plains and the Western Region. Both of us have already been harmed by the Wuyue Sect, and entering this battle is like putting our all on the line. If Tian Jizi has any ulterior motives and has our forces take the brunt of the attack in exchange for an overall victory, even if we win, it would still be a loss for both our groups. Thus, I think it best that our two groups form a small alliance to share information and prepare against being exploited," Wan Tianren explained.
Xi Ying, standing nearby, immediately understood his implication. In plain terms, this was also a factional struggle. As the frontliners, the Western Region and the Central Plains, along with the Eastern Sea Region and Southern Border situated at the rear, surely did not share the same heart. Though their overall direction was aligned, there were definitely differences in some minor interests entanglements.
Wan Tianren had formed the East Sea Alliance and naturally had a deeper understanding of these matters than anyone else.Part& of a s!erie+s h$osted+ by My Virt^ual- Lib*r+ary E-m*pi#r&e+ (%MV%&$LE!MP&*Y$R^).&
"Moreover, Divine Envoy Yuan once conveyed a message to me, stating that Fellow Daoist Luo, you had reached an agreement with the Ming Yue Sect, willing to join hands with the East Sea to combat Wu Yue Sect. I had been thinking of meeting with you, Fellow Daoist Luo, to discuss this matter in detail, but due to being busy with various affairs, I couldn't find the time. I didn't expect Chang Chun Temple to send out an invitation to the alliance meeting before us," added Wan Tianren.
Luo Zhu glanced at Xi Ying, recalling the late-night secret discussion in the Bamboo Sea Square, and her heart eased slightly.
"What you said is right; a private alliance, I agreed," she decided.
"Then, may the Shadow God Envoy serve as a witness?" Wan Tianren smiled and turned his head to give Xi Ying a signal.
Xi Ying naturally had no reason to refuse.
Thus, under her witness, Wan Tianren and Luo Zhu clapped hands and took a step before Tian Jizi, forming an alliance.
...
Several days later.
All Major Sects gradually arrived at Yuhua City. Since the military situation was urgent, Chang Chun Temple skipped all other complicated formalities and immediately announced the formal commencement of the alliance meeting once the sects guarded by Nascent Soul cultivators were all present.
And the location for the first Nascent Soul discussion was selected to be in a floating grand hall at the center of Yuhua City.
It was said that the last time Chang Chun Temple convened All Major Sects for a meeting to encircle and suppress the Wu Yue Sect, it also took place in this grand hall.
Thousands of years had passed since then, and now, once again, the doors of this grand hall opened, the attending Nascent Soul cultivators were entirely different from the last time, but the enemy they faced remained the same.
As the congregation of Nascent Souls entered the grand hall, they all simultaneously nurtured a thought.
One could not help but wonder if the next time this grand hall is utilized, will it also be for the same reason?
Chang Chun Temple's preparations before the start of the meeting were very thorough. The hall had already been divided into different areas for cultivators from the same regions to take their seats.
When Luo Zhu arrived at the grand hall with Xi Ying, many people were already seated.
Her gaze first swept over the Nascent Souls sitting in the East Sea Region, Wan Tianren, Hou Chou, Old Man Hei Zhu, Queen Ming Kong, Golden Transformation Master, and so on, all of whom were familiar faces to Xi Ying.
Next were the Nascent Souls from the Southern Border. Perhaps because the Wu Yue Sect had not stirred up large-scale conflicts in the Southern Border, there were not many Nascent Soul cultivators from there. Seeing Luo Zhu, they all stood up and saluted, showing considerable awe.
The Nascent Souls from the Western Region were even fewer, and almost all were burly men who seemed worried for some reason.
Sitting in the foremost position on the Western Region side was a muscular bald man, his robust muscles covered by coarse hemp cloth, and a dark black brand on the left side of his face that seemed to contain some unique power.
"Huh, that's strange. Why didn't Old Man He himself come? His disciple came first," Luo Zhu muttered with curiosity upon seeing the robust man.
Xi Ying took the opportunity to inquire about the identity of the bald man.
"His name is Gu Yali, from the Western Region's Vajra Sect. Their sect's ancestor is called He Cha, the only Great Cultivator in the Western Region," Luo Zhu introduced through a voice transmission.
Xi Ying nodded, then turned her attention to the Nascent Soul cultivators from Central Plains.
The contingent from Central Plains was the largest. Notably, Fairy Jin Xi from Zhao Country's Spirit Talisman Sect was also seated in the hall. She seemed to have felt Xi Ying's gaze and turned her head to look back. Their eyes met and Fairy Jin Xi, not recognizing Xi Ying, merely nodded politely.
Xi Ying, for now, had no intention of recognising her and shifted her gaze, observing other Central Plains Nascent Souls.
Just then, a disheveled middle-aged male cultivator with hair like a bird's nest hurried into the hall, looking left and right. He quickly found the seating area of Yue Country, walked over, then suddenly frowned.
"Fellow Daoist, it seems you are sitting in the wrong spot. This is the seating for Yue Country's sect," the middle-aged male cultivator tapped another plump-faced male cultivator on the shoulder.
Noticing the commotion, and seeing that Xi Ying was also paying attention, Luo Zhu took the initiative to introduce the situation.
"That bird-nested fellow is Xia Shang, from Yue Country's Hundred Machine Sect, specializing in puppet making. Although his personal cultivation is not high, only at the early stage of Nascent Soul, the puppets he makes are extremely potent一there's a rumor that he hides a puppet capable of rivaling a Late-stage Nascent Soul cultivator, but whether it's true or not is uncertain," Luo Zhu chuckled.
"And the plump male cultivator?" Xi Ying focused on the man, sensing an inexplicable aura from him.
"Him? I don't know him. Maybe he really is in the wrong seat. Yue Country is close to Southern Border, and the only sect with Nascent Souls there is Hundred Machine Sect. What other forces could there be?" Luo Zhu shrugged.
Just then, the plump male cultivator stood up, smiling amiably at Xia Shang, and said,
"Fellow Daoist Xia, I've long admired your name. I am Cao Xiangqing, my family resides in Mist Mountain and rarely interacts with the outside world. I left the mountain because I heard that a major event concerning Yunhuang was happening, so please don't take offense, Fellow Daoist Xia."

chapters.title: Chapter 695 - 695: 666 Intelligence Sources
chapters.content:
"Mist Mountain? You even managed to stay in that haunted place? I'm impressed," Xia Shang examined the plump male cultivator with a few glances, expressing his surprise.
"Our ancestor was fortunate to have found a safe spiritual vein, and we have since taken root there," Cao Xiangqing explained.
Upon hearing their conversation, Xi Ying reminisced in her mind and indeed recalled the place known as Mist Mountain.
It was a dangerous area located at the border between Yue Country and the Southern Border, with complex terrain, variable climate, and constantly veiled in the fog year-round. Apart from the locals, very few cultivators from the outside world would enter.
On the other hand, Xia Shang seemed to believe what Cao Xiangqing had said, or perhaps because he rarely interacted with anyone within the borders of Yue Country, he was excitedly discussing the topic of puppet refining with Cao Xiangqing.
However, Cao Xiangqing was not interested in this topic, and after responding perfunctorily a few times, Xia Shang realized that this person knew nothing about puppets, and his interest waned. He found a place to sit down, closed his eyes to rest, and his divine soul traveled afar.
"Island Master Luo, can you do me a favor? After the meeting, could you send some people to Mist Mountain to investigate this Cao family?" Xi Ying thought for a moment, then sent a telepathic message to Luo Zhu.
Luo Zhu glanced at her, seemingly surprised, but didn't ask any further and simply nodded in agreement.
Thirty minutes later, most of the Nascent Soul cultivators had taken their seats. Tian Jizi also appeared at the entrance of the great hall, with Ancestor Ming Quan and Liu Hanyu still following behind him.
After entering the hall, he quickly walked to the foremost position and greeted the assembly of Nascent Souls with a cupped-hands salute.
"I appreciate the effort of all fellow Daoists who came here in haste. Given the urgency of the war situation, I will not waste words. With the Wu Yue Sect reemerging in Cloud Desolate, their momentum even greater than before, we must unite and recreate the historic grand coalition of the Four Domains that surrounded and annihilated the Northern Desert, to stand a chance of seizing a ray of life. Therefore, I propose we establish the Cloud Desolate Alliance today. Any forces resisting the Wu Yue Sect can join us. What say you all?"
As soon as Tian Jizi finished speaking, many cultivators voiced their support. However, some who harbored doubts, seeing the general trend, did not dare to speak out against it and chose to remain silent instead.
"Since all fellow Daoists agree, then I hereby declare that the Cloud Desolate Alliance is officially established today. However, as the saying goes, an army without a general is motionless, and a snake without a head cannot proceed. The Alliance is about to confront the Wu Yue Sect head-on, and we must have someone to preside over the overall situation. Would any fellow Daoist like to self-nominate? If not, I will temporarily assume the position of Alliance Hierarch. How do you all feel about that?" Tian Jizi continued.
For a moment, the hall was silent as a cemetery. Besides the cultivators from Central Plains, those from the other Three Domains turned to their respective leaders, waiting for their stance.
"If Fellow Daoist Tian Jizi wouldn't take the position of Alliance Hierarch, then no one else is more qualified. I don't think we need to waste any more time," Wan Tianren said indifferently.
"Fellow Daoist Tian Jizi will have to work even harder from now on," Luo Zhu said with a smile that was not quite a smile.
Gu Yali simply nodded silently. Having only mid-stage Tongqiao Body strength, he dared not speak as freely as Wan Tianren and the others.
"Since that is settled, let's discuss the most pressing issues. Our enemies, who are they and how strong they are," Tian Jizi calmly smiled, waved his hand, and six jade talismans flew out.
He first pointed to the talisman on the far left, and a great deal of spirit light burst forth from it, condensing into the figure of a giant with moons for eyes in front of everyone.
"The leader of Wu Yue Sect, Wuyue God, stems from an existence ten thousand years ago, his original name long forgotten. With Spoken Witch cultivation, his strength is unfathomable. He possesses the Curse Name Divine Skill, allowing him to curse and kill someone from afar, knowing only their name and birth details, and even escape is futile regardless of the distance," Tian Jizi said with a heavy expression.
Upon hearing this, the atmosphere in the hall became extraordinarily somber.
The chaos brought by Wu Yue Sect lies solely with Wuyue God. As long as he remains alive, even a temporary repulsion of Wu Yue Sect cannot be considered a victory.
Soul cultivators of the Spoken Witch level, even if encountered by Returning to Void cultivators, could not claim an easy victory, let alone them, mere Nascent Souls.
Chang Chun Temple was able to lead the Four Domains in eradicating Wu Yue Sect back then, entirely because of the inexplicable slumber of Wuyue God. But this time, with the reformation of the Cloud Desolate Alliance, could they be so fortunate again?
The cultivators present were silent, each harboring their own worries and sighs.
At the same time, Xi Ying couldn't help but be amazed in her heart.
Once a follower of Wu Yue Sect, she was not aware of the specific requirements of Wuyue God's Curse Name Divine Skill. That Chang Chun Temple could retain such intelligence was indeed worthy of being the sect that had contended with Wu Yue Sect the longest.
Tian Jizi then illuminated the second jade talisman, projecting the figure of a cultivator clad in purple garb.
He wore a candle dragon mask, concealing only the upper half of his face, slightly more robust than the average person, with somewhat thick lips and nose. However, his skin was as pale as snow, and his silken purple robe glowed radiantly, emitting an otherworldly aura.
"Nine Yin Venerable, one of the Six Venerables of Wu Yue Sect, at the peak of Sleep Witch. He was originally a man, but because of the cultivation method he practiced, he severed his lineage himself and has since considered himself a woman, also developing a fondness for wearing women's apparel. He possesses the thread-piercing divine power, which allows him to extract 'threads' from anything and everything to attack his enemies," Tian Jizi introduced.
Xi Ying's heart stirred, this was yet another piece of information she was unaware of, and the faces of the others present also slowly grew more solemn.
Tian Jizi, however, did not pause at all and directly activated the third Jade Talisman. This time, what appeared was a genuine female cultivator.
She was dressed in a pink robe, with a gentle and graceful demeanor, like a well-educated lady from a prominent family. In her hand, she held a five-branched, tree-like Magic Treasure, enveloped in a pink light, hazy and dreamlike.
"Free Venerable, one of the Six Great Venerables, and also at the peak of Sleeping Witch cultivation. This person is of a vile character and extremely fond of pleasure. She especially likes to see others' emotions undergo drastic changes and possesses the Divine Skill of Emotional Wound, which can manipulate negative emotions against foes. When you encounter her, be sure to protect your Nascent Soul carefully so as not to be affected," Tian Jizi warned.
At that moment, many cultivators in the hall showed looks of astonishment. The abilities and true forms of the Wu Yue God and Wu Yue Sect Venerables had always been a mystery in the Cloud Desolate Cultivation World. Although there were many fragmented rumors, it was rare for someone like Chang Chun Temple to have such detailed information. They must have put in considerable effort.
Tian Jizi's face still bore a tranquil smile as he continued to activate the fourth Jade Talisman.
"Evil Eye Venerable, also at the peak of Sleeping Witch soul cultivation. He is greedy, but his faith and loyalty to Wu Yue God are the strongest among the Six Venerables. He possesses the Devouring Transformation Divine Power, which allows him to gain the strengths of others by devouring their Nascent Souls or Divine Souls. As a result, he has the most means among the Six Venerables."
After briefly introducing them, Tian Jizi went on to activate the fifth Jade Talisman.
"Venerable Xian Kong, also at the peak of Sleeping Witch cultivation. He is shrewd in calculations, and has also cultivated a Body Cultivation Method. He possesses the Divine Skill of Emotion Stealing and can strip away and consume emotions. Once affected, if one cannot counteract it, they will lose consciousness completely in a very short time and become his controlled puppet."
Before Tian Jizi could finish speaking, Xi Ying's expression turned grave; she raised her head to look at Tian Jizi, her heart tumultuous.
The Divine Skills of Xi Zheng were known to only a few within the Xi Family; how could Tian Jizi be so well-informed?
Tian Jizi, seemingly oblivious to Xi Ying's gaze amidst the crowd, maintained his composure as he introduced the last Venerable.
"Heavenly Puppet Venerable has a relatively shallow history and only recently ascended to Venerable status. He is not a soul cultivator but a rare Puppet Master, with Nascent Soul Late-Stage Cultivation. However, he has a puppet called Tongchen, which is a hundred zhang tall, extremely hard in material, and difficult to damage with ordinary Magic Treasures or Magic."
As these words were spoken, Xia Shang, who had been silently listening, suddenly perked up.
"Fellow Daoist Tian Jizi, does your temple have any records of battle scenes with his puppet? Or even small fragments from the puppet, even just dust, would do," he stood and asked.
"Unfortunately, Fellow Daoist Xia, the Heavenly Puppet Venerable rarely makes a move, and we have never managed to inflict any damage on his puppet, so we do not have any related information," Tian Jizi shook his head.
Xia Shang showed a look of disappointment and quickly sat down.
Seeing this, Tian Jizi cleared his throat and continued to detail the situation.
"As everyone knows, there are now only these five among the Six Venerables of Wu Yue Sect. Besides them, there are also quite a few Nascent Soul cultivators in the sect. Additionally, some sects have chosen to ally with Wu Yue Sect, like the Overlord Sect from the Western Region, Guiyuan Sect and Five Thunder Sect from Central Plains, and Double Immortal Sect and Senluo Sect from Southern Border. Now, they have almost all been summoned to Black Wind Desert, joining forces with the main strength of Wu Yue Sect and heading towards Central Plains," he said.
Just then, Wan Tianren suddenly raised his hand to interrupt.
"Forgive me, Fellow Daoist Tian Jizi, I have a question. Since the information about these Venerables is so detailed, where exactly did you get it from? Is the source reliable?" Wan Tianren's question was clearly the doubt many present shared.
Tian Jizi looked surprised, as if he had not expected this question.Chесk fоr thе lаtеst updаtеs оn Мy Virtuаl Librаry Еmpirе (М-VL-ЕМР-YR).
But quickly, he revealed a mysterious smile.
"I believe there's no source of information more reliable than me," he said confidently.
Wan Tianren frowned, and a strange feeling suddenly surged in his heart.
He was about to ask further questions when, in the next instant, a bizarre scene unfolded.
Before all eyes, Tian Jizi's face suddenly blurred, as if a light gray mist had condensed into a veil, covering his visage, leaving only a pair of eyes exposed. The whites rapidly turned pitch black, as if day had turned into night, and under the twinkling of distant stars, his grey-moon-like pupils slowly rose.
"After all, I am the Wu Yue God," he said.
The voice of the Wu Yue God passed over everyone like a breeze in the night, seemingly dusting off a thin layer from their consciousness.
It was then when everyone realized that the grand hall they were in had vanished in the blink of an eye, replaced by an exposed platform. Not far away in the sky, Tian Jizi approached with Ancestor Ming Quan and Liu Hanyu, their faces also colored with shock.

chapters.title: Chapter 696 - 667: The Situation is Unpredictable
chapters.content:
"So you're the current head of Chang Chun Temple? Somewhat capable, but still not enough,"
Wu Yue God glanced at Tian Jizi who was flying toward them. His voice was neither hurried nor slow as he slowly stepped forward, as if ascending an invisible staircase, step by step, heading up above everyone's heads.
Meanwhile, "Ancestor Ming Quan" and "Liu Hanyu," who were originally by his side, had disappeared without a trace at some point.
At the same time, the group of Nascent Soul cultivators below finally reacted. They hurriedly suppressed the horrid shock in their hearts, raised their hands to form incantations, and attempted to attack Wu Yue God.
"I came here as a guest today, is this how you treat your guests?" Wu Yue God sighed softly.
Upon hearing this, the people were horrified to discover that they couldn't muster any desire to make a move against him. Even though they knew Wu Yue God was an enemy, and knew they couldn't listen to his words, they still felt in their hearts that he was right and that they should do as he said.
Among them all, only Luo Zhu and Wan Tianren showed signs of struggle, as if trying to forcibly break free of their restraints, but no matter how hard they tried, it was of no use.
Next to Luo Zhu, Xi Ying showed no intention of struggling. Having overcome her initial horror, her emotions gradually settled, and she was able to focus more on observing Wu Yue God and guessing his real purpose for being here.
Finally, Wu Yue God had ascended to a position directly above the crowd. He truly resembled a god, superior to all living beings, looking down upon the people below.
"In my eyes, you are but ants. I came here today merely to give you the chance to look up to a true god," Wu Yue God looked down at everyone, his voice spreading throughout Yuhua City.
"What exactly do you want to say!" Wan Tianren shouted.
"When I speak, you should listen quietly."
Wu Yue God slightly raised his hand, and in the next instant, Wan Tianren's eyes widened in shock as he found he could no longer open his mouth no matter how hard he tried.
"The death of an ant is of no interest to me. If you submit to me and worship me as your god, I will surely protect you. Those with sincere hearts may even have the chance to become Divine Envoys, receive my divine grace, and aspire to the great Dao. If you attempt to resist me and trample on the future territory of my Divine Country, be prepared to face death," Wu Yue God said indifferently.
"Wu Yue's false god, don't even think about it!" Luo Zhu burst out shouting.
"How dare you come here alone with your crooked practices! Let's gang up on him!"
"Let's fight him!"
The rest of the Nascent Soul cultivators, originally shocked by Wu Yue God's aura and slow to react, now spurred on by Luo Zhu, a late-stage Nascent Soul Great Cultivator's call to arms, began to openly scold in protest.
"Good advice is wasted on the damned, the gods and Buddhas do not ferry the self-doomed. It is pitiful, lamentable, and regrettable that you are all so stubbornly unenlightened," Wu Yue God seemed unfazed and, after finishing his words, his figure gradually faded, as if he was about to disappear from that place.
"Chang Chun Temple is not a place where you can come and go as you please!"
Just at that moment, Tian Jizi had already appeared above Wu Yue God and suddenly shouted loudly. He formed incantations with his hands, bowed toward the gate of Chang Chun Temple and then countless blue water lights fell from the sky, like rivers reversing and seas pouring out. Endless blue spirit light converged into tens of thousands of water dragons roaring towards Wu Yue God.
"Canghai Xuan Water Pearl? It must have been fully restored by now, but that's still not enough."
Wu Yue God spoke lightly and shook his head, making no move to resist as the water dragons tore at his body, shredding it to pieces.
But the next instant, before the water dragons had dispersed, the figure of Wu Yue God reappeared in the sky, unharmed.
"The Moon Sect intelligence I've just revealed is a meeting gift for you all. I hope it can arouse a bit of interest in you..."
Wu Yue God said, his figure fading once again, and this time, no matter how the water dragons tore and scratched, it was as if they were separated by a transparent screen, completely unable to touch him.
Soon, he disappeared completely into the sky, leaving behind only the water dragons filling the entire sky and Tian Jizi with a livid expression.
With the departure of Wu Yue God, the original platform also vanished, and the starry night turned back to daylight, the previously disappeared grand hall reappeared as well.
The crowd looked at each other, feeling as if what had just happened was all a dream, yet no one was willing to speak first.
Tian Jizi had now taken the seat at the top inside the hall, with Ancestor Ming Quan and Liu Hanyu standing to the left and right.
Everyone, both on and off the platform, looked exceedingly upset.
Wu Yue God's appearance had turned this assembly into a complete farce. All present were fooled and humiliated by him, yet none could even touch the hem of his garment, leaving these lofty Nascent Soul cultivators feeling utterly defeated and ashamed.
Tian Jizi looked at the silent crowd, and couldn't help but sigh.
After this ordeal, he wondered how many of those present had entertained the thought of defecting to the Wu Yue Sect?
The Cloud Desolate Alliance had just been established for one day, and perhaps it was about to disband.
It was laughable that the alliance was even announced by their enemies.
In the deathly silence, Xi Ying suddenly stood up and scanned the crowd.
"Fellow Daoists, there's no need to be so pessimistic. The fact that the Wu Yue God came here just proves that he hasn't fully recovered yet and isn't truly revived," she stated confidently.
Upon hearing this, everyone lifted their heads, and Tian Jizi, seeing this, quickly followed Xi Ying's lead.
"Your sect must have more understanding of the Wu Yue God than most of us here. Did the Shadow God Envoy notice anything?" he asked, eager to lift their spirits, even bringing up the Moon Sect.The full series lives on * (*).
Strictly speaking, soul cultivation was taboo on the Yunhuang Continent, partly because of the terrifying reputation of the Wu Yue God from the past, and because of the fame the Moon Sect and the Nether Moon God gained in the battle of the East Sea, which made Chang Chun Temple also cautious. However, now with the threat of the Wu Yue Sect, there was no time to deal with anything else.
"It's a simple logic, if the Wu Yue God had completely revived, with his Spoken Witch power, coming here to deal with us would mean death or release at a single thought. Why would he need to resort to grandstanding and declare war?" Xi Ying guessed Tian Jizi's thoughts and said as much.
Hearing this, many people's eyes lit up slightly.
"Besides, he implied that he wanted us to face his subordinates, doesn't that indirectly show that he can't easily take action now? Plus, I heard that after the Wu Yue Sect conquered Black Wind Desert, they assigned a large number of forces to slaughter mortals and low-level cultivators to collect Divine Souls, probably all for the Wu Yue God to hasten his recovery," Xi Ying pressed on, seizing the opportunity to speak.
"According to the information we've obtained, the Wu Yue God is currently in seclusion refining the collected Divine Souls every day, but how did the Shadow God Envoy acquire this intelligence?" Tian Jizi inquired, with some doubts.
"Chang Chun Temple has its spies, and our Moon Sect naturally has its own channels," Xi Ying laughed noncommittally.
Tian Jizi nodded and didn't ask further.
The others, hearing their conversation, gradually regained their spirits and began to discuss amongst themselves.
And the more they discussed, the more they felt that Xi Ying made sense.
Xi Ying watched the people with a smile, yet deep down, she hid a trace of concern.
Indeed, the Wu Yue God's arrival had a deterrent intention, but perhaps, just as he had said, he didn't want to rule over ruins in the future.
"Alright, Fellow Daoists, regardless of the intentions of the Wu Yue God, what we need to do now remains the same. The Wu Yue Sect's army is currently advancing on the Central Plains from the Black Wind Desert, and we must organize our forces to resist. We can't allow them to take over any more territory," Tian Jizi interrupted the discussions.
"Indeed, but we still need to trouble Fellow Daoist Tian Jizi to elaborate on the current situation," Xi Ying also nodded.
Seeing both of them say this, everyone else felt like they had found their backbone, steadied their hearts, remembered the purpose of this alliance meeting, and resumed discussing matters.
"Previously the Wu Yue Sect was repelled at the East Sea, and now it seems they plan to invade the Central Plains directly. Among the five countries in the Central Plains, only Qin Country and Zhao Country border Black Wind Desert. Qin is far away and closer to the Western Region; thus, the main advance of the Wu Yue Sect has been fixed towards Zhao Country. However, the Wu Yue Sect had previously dispatched forces to stir up trouble between the sects in the Western Region, leading to the Vajra Sect being heavily besieged. We can't ignore this; if the Western Region falls, we will have an additional enemy to contend with," Tian Jizi explained to everyone.
At the same time, Gu Yali from the Vajra Sect of the Western Region also stood up.
"Fellow Daoists, my Vajra Sect is now almost down to only its base, and my ancestor had to stay at the sect, sending only me to seek help. There is an old saying in the Central Plains, 'When the lips are gone, the teeth will be cold.' I implore you all to lend a hand, and my sect will surely repay the favor immensely, never going back on its word," Gu Yali pleaded with a distressed and extremely humble attitude.
"Fellow Daoist Gu, rest assured, we will not sit idly by and watch the Vajra Sect fall," Tian Jizi consoled him.
"That's easy to say, but with the Wu Yue Sect's main force pressing in, wouldn't it be difficult to divide our troops?" Luo Zhu worriedly remarked.
Upon hearing this, Gu Yali's face grew even more distressed, but he could only turn to Tian Jizi with a pleading look, pinning his hopes on him.
Tian Jizi was about to speak when Xi Ying unexpectedly beat him to it.
"I don't think that's necessarily the case. Although the Wu Yue Sect has always been accumulating power in the shadows, the number of low-level cultivators under their command is lower than ours. Even with the absorption of many sects, they won't have too many people. In this respect, we should still have the advantage," Xi Ying analyzed.
"Exactly, that was also my point. For this reason, I was planning to attack on four fronts. Three main forces would enter Zhao Country from different directions to attack the Wu Yue Sect's army, focusing on harassment tactics to wear down their living forces as much as possible, while the remaining force would enter from Qin Country and rush to aid the Western Region. We must resolve the siege of Vajra Sect as quickly as possible," Tian Jizi reclaimed the initiative eagerly.
Xi Ying smiled without saying anything further, indicating that she had no intention of disputing his command.

chapters.title: Chapter 697 - 668 Crystal Coffin
chapters.content:
Although Xi Ying and Tian Jizi believed that the cultivators from the Cloud Desolation Alliance held a numerical advantage, there were still many Nascent Soul cultivators present who harbored doubts.
Tian Jizi did not use his position as the Alliance Hierarch to pressure everyone, but instead addressed each doubt and concern individually.
In the end, through his efforts and leadership, he dispelled the worries of those present, and naturally, they all accepted the tactical arrangements he had proposed.
"Fellow Daoists, there is one more thing I must emphasize: Wu Yue Sect's followers are mostly Soul Cultivators, and their methods differ from those of Magic Practitioners and Body Cultivators. Please be sure to guard carefully during combat. I have asked Ming Quan to compile some methods for dealing with Soul Cultivators recorded in Chang Chun Temple, which will be delivered to your residences later. Furthermore, Fellow Daoist Jin Xi has also specially refined a batch of Soul Protection Talismans that can protect the Divine Soul and Nascent Soul. However, these talismans are not easy to refine, and at most, only one can be provided to each person. Please cherish it," Tian Jizi instructed.
All nodded in agreement, and after the meeting ended, many cultivators immediately surrounded the Golden Dawn Fairy, exchanging pleasantries, attempting to trade for some additional Soul Protection Talismans for emergencies.
"Shadow God Envoy, aren't you going to take a look?" Luo Zhu asked Xi Ying with a smile.
"No rush, I will pay her a visit alone later. Fellow Daoist Luo, please feel free to do as you like." Xi Ying returned the smile lightly.
...
Yan Siyun and the others followed Yuan Ming's instructions and also hurried to Yuhua City with the group of cultivators from the East Sea Alliance.
They didn't bring many people with them this time, and their cultivation was generally on the lower side. However, they were mainly responsible for logistics and intelligence and unlikely to come into contact with the frontline. Thus, their current level of cultivation was considered adequate.
After learning of the East Sea Alliance's arrival in Yuhua City, Xi Ying sought them out, choosing not to stay with the people from Pan Si Island any longer.
When Xi Ying returned from the council hall to their base, it seemed that Yan Siyun and her sisters were discussing something with Xu Che.
As soon as Xi Ying arrived, Xu Che let out a sigh of relief, hurried forward, and said, "Shadow God Envoy, not long ago, Wulu came to me and asked me to pass a message to you and Divine Envoy Yuan."
Xu Che had previously been instructed by Yuan Ming to avoid exposure, so whenever Yan Siyun was present, he would not refer to him as his lord.
Xi Ying was somewhat surprised to hear Xu Che's words, not expecting Wulu to have also arrived in Yuhua City. However, compared to Yuan Ming, she wasn't very familiar with Wulu and didn't trust him as much, so she didn't have any particular reaction.
"What did the message say?" she casually asked.
"Wulu said that his surname should have been Cao and that you and Divine Envoy Yuan should be very careful," Xu Che explained, seemingly not understanding the significance of Wulu's words.
But Xi Ying's heart stirred upon hearing this.
Yuan Ming had once mentioned Wulu's background to her, as well as the mysterious family behind him. Xi Ying had been in Yunhuang for many years and had come into contact with many forces lurking in the shadows, but she knew very little about Wulu's family and had never even learned their name.
However, with Wulu's reminder, she immediately thought of Cao Xiangqing, whom she had seen at the meeting.
The Cao family from Mist Mountain was indeed the mysterious family behind Wulu!
The family that should have stayed hidden was now out in the open, and the implications immediately led Xi Ying to many speculations.
"I understand. Don't repeat these words to others. Moreover, if Wulu comes to you again in the future, try to ask him for a way to contact him," Xi Ying said after some thought.
The three reverently accepted the order.
Next, Xi Ying briefly recounted the situation at the meeting and indicated that she would use her connections to ensure Xu Che and the others were tasked with logistics and other trivial matters, sparing them from having to go to the front lines.
Just as the three were about to leave, Xi Ying called Yan Siyun back.
"I remember you're quite skilled at divination, aren't you?" Xi Ying asked.
"It's just some minor techniques, nothing too impressive. The divination often seems ambiguous and requires personal interpretation," Yan Siyun didn't finish her sentence.
"It doesn't matter. Could you divine now and see whether this battle will bring us good or bad fortune?" Xi Ying requested.
Yan Siyun nodded and then entered the quiet room. After making some simple preparations, she took out the turtle shell divination and began the divination process.
Soon, Yan Siyun emerged from the quiet room. However, she didn't immediately disclose the divination outcome, seemingly confused and hesitant.
"What did you divine? Speak freely," Xi Ying gently urged.
"The divination shows that in this battle, proceeding we shall not conquer, retreating we shall not fail; no worries from all sides, but difficulties lie in the central sky," Yan Siyun was puzzled, seemingly uncertain about how to interpret the divination.
"...I understand," Xi Ying nodded thoughtfully, not inquiring further about the meaning of the divination.
Afterward, she sent Xu Che and the others away to make their preparations, while she herself entered an inner room that was off-limits to others.
In the room, a Pill Furnace emanating Five-Colored Spiritual Light was suspended in mid-air, beneath which fierce flames burned, seemingly in the process of refining something.
In front of the furnace, the Five Elements Child meticulously controlled the flames as if he were a Alchemist.
Upon noticing Xi Ying's entrance, he immediately divided a fraction of his attention.
"Master, this fruit is incredibly difficult to refine. It's been so many days, yet it looks just the same," he complained bitterly.
"If the fruit born from a Returning to Void Stage Tree Demon were easy to refine, I would rather suspect that you've brought back a fake. Continue your attempts. Being able to refine the Immortal Elixir is also part of your cultivation. Once it's done, you won't be without your benefits," Xi Ying ignored the complaints and offered a grand promise instead.
Upon hearing this, the Five Elements Child immediately showed an excited expression and hastily manipulated the flames with even greater effort, his little face full of concentration.
Xi Ying smiled at him, then her gaze shifted to the Pill Furnace.
She watched the five-colored light that flowed like mist over the body of the furnace, and her eyes gradually filled with determination.
