"Soon, very soon, just hold on a little longer, I can definitely bring you back to life... sister..."
She murmured to herself, her fingers absently fumbling with the Storage Ring, inside which a crystal coffin quietly floated in the void. In the coffin lay a woman who bore a striking resemblance to Xi Ying, holding an ever-burning oil lamp, as if asleep, eyes firmly shut.
Just then, as if responding to Xi Ying's words, the flame on the oil lamp trembled slightly and seemed to grow much more robust.
A hint of joy appeared on Xi Ying's face, and she turned and entered another room.
The walls of this room were covered with Silver Runes, forming a silver barrier that completely isolated the inside from the outside.Read ahead and get updates at *.
"This Sealing Void Array is not bad, but it's still far from the barrier formed by Yuan Ming's Silver Token," Xi Ying shook her head, sat down cross-legged, and waved her sleeve.
A flash of black light passed, and the Soul Suppressing Kettle appeared.
An intensely rich Yin Qi emanated from within the kettle, a faint Black Mist formed in the room, and the air became unusually cold.
Inside the Soul Suppressing Kettle was a dark space where thousands of black yin souls floated. There were seven or eight Nascent Soul yin souls, twenty or thirty Core Formation yin souls, and the rest were Foundation Establishment yin souls.
The Soul Suppressing Pearl at the top of the kettle slowly revolved, and the yin souls inside followed its motion, each with an expressionless face.
"Master, are you really going to refine the yin souls inside the Soul Suppressing Kettle to increase your Soul Power?" A white light flew out from Xi Ying's Spiritual Beast Bag, revealing Guoguo's figure.
"Indeed, all the yin souls I have collected over the years are in the Soul Suppressing Kettle. I've never used them before, all for this day," Xi Ying nodded.
"This Yin Soul Power is not as pure as the Desire Power channeled by Yuan Ming. Although you have the Soul Suppressing Pearl and the Golden Crow Soul to help refine them, it's still too risky! You're different from Yuan Ming; your path in Soul Power is about purity. This step could lead to endless trouble," Guoguo advised.
"It doesn't matter. With the emergence of the Wuyue God, if I don't fully enhance my strength, I'm bound to die without a place to bury myself. I'm not concerned about the consequences," Xi Ying said lightly, Yuan Ming's figure flashing through her mind.
"I can't just put all the burden on him, can I?" she whispered in her heart.
"That makes sense," Guoguo scratched its head.
"Alright, help me protect the law. I need to seize this final opportunity to enhance my strength as much as possible," Xi Ying said. A Golden Crow Soul flew out from the center of her eyebrows, opening its mouth to inhale.
A stream of black air shot out from the Soul Suppressing Kettle, wrapping around a Nascent Soul cultivator's Divine Soul that plunged into the body of the Golden Crow Soul.
The Golden Crow Soul ignited Golden Flames that enveloped the Nascent Soul Divine Soul, fiercely refining it.
The Nascent Soul Divine Soul let out a faint scream before completely losing its human form, dissolving into a mass of disordered Soul Power, less than a tenth of its original size yet exceptionally pure.
This was the ability of the Golden Crow Soul: Purification, capable of refining the memories, emotions, and other residues in the Divine Soul, turning it into pure Soul Power.
"It seems the effect of your Golden Crow refining the impurities of yin souls is better than expected," Guoguo said, pleased.
Xi Ying did not speak; although the Soul Power was pure, she could still detect impurities within it.
However, Xi Ying didn't mind and absorbed the refined Soul Power.
The Soul Power within her Sea of Consciousness surged, increasing significantly.
"The feeling of rapidly increasing Soul Power is indeed pleasant; no wonder Yuan Ming is obsessed with enhancing Soul Power with Desire Power! Given the Golden Crow Soul's excellent results in refining yin souls, I can increase the speed even more," Xi Ying thought to herself, her brow emitting a bright golden light as four Golden Crow Souls flew out.
The four Golden Crows formed an array, each emanating Golden Flames, which coalesced into a swirling golden flame vortex, exerting a powerful suction force.
Boom!
The yin souls shot out from the Soul Suppressing Kettle one by one, refined by the golden flame vortex and merged into Xi Ying's Divine Soul.
Xi Ying's Soul Power strengthened rapidly, and the speed at which she refined Soul Power grew even faster.
In the blink of an eye, three days had passed. The yin souls collected in the Soul Suppressing Kettle had been completely refined, and naturally, Xi Ying's Soul Power had advanced by leaps and bounds.
Her Soul Cultivation had originally reached the mid-stage of the Sleep Witch, but now she had broken through directly to the Late Stage of the Sleep Witch.
"Congratulations, Master, on your great advancement in Divine Soul Cultivation," Guoguo clapped its front paws, creating a clapping sound.
"Only at the Late Stage of Sleep Witch, it's far from enough," Xi Ying's face showed no joy, her brow furrowed.
Having made such a great sacrifice, she naturally wanted to raise her Soul Cultivation strength to the utmost. It was impossible to reach the level of a Spoken Witch, but at the very least, she aimed to reach the Peak of the Sleep Witch.
"It seems I need to collect more..." Xi Ying murmured to herself, taking out an object—it was a set of Blood Puppet Armor.

chapters.title: Chapter 698 - 669: Half-Demon Body
chapters.content:
A month later, the Yunhuang Alliance completed its preparations. Cultivators from all over gathered together, forming a vast and mighty army, neatly arrayed outside Yuhua City.
In the sky, Tian Jizi stood upon the void, conducting the final inspection and mobilization of the Yunhuang army below him.
Behind him, the leaders of the four armies waited quietly, among them only Gu Yali, who was responsible for leading the team to the aid of the Western Region, was a mid-stage Nascent Soul cultivator; the other three were all in the late-stage Nascent Soul.
Among these two, were Luo Zhu and Wan Tianren.
In the ranks of the Yunhuang army, a group of Nascent Soul cultivators looked up at the sky, yet their gazes converged unanimously upon the last late-stage Nascent Soul cultivator.
He was an old Daoist with white hair, and on his forehead was a pale green tree rune somewhat similar to that of Tian Jizi, albeit with a slightly different pattern and a somewhat dimmer radiance.
"Tsk, tsk, isn't that Tianyinzi? They said he failed to break through to the late-stage Nascent Soul a hundred years ago. How did he manage to achieve it now?" the ancestor of Bailuo Manor, Bai Nanshan, clicked his tongue.
"He must have been deliberately hidden by Chang Chun Temple. It's hard to tell who they were guarding against," Bing You Immortal commented with a cold laugh.
"Don't assume the worst of everything. Maybe he has only recently made the breakthrough and hasn't had the time to inform the other sects. Besides, with the Wu Yue Sect encroaching, the more late-stage Nascent Souls, the better," Mu Wanchun shook his head.
Not only were the Nascent Soul cultivators in the army discussing fervently, but Luo Zhu and Wan Tianren in the sky also exchanged glances, their expressions varied.
However, Tian Jizi paid no attention to these discussions and simply waved his arm.
"This battle, Yunhuang will be victorious!"
"Yunhuang will be victorious!"
Amidst the thunderous shouts that resembled mountains and seas, the four armies set off, three heading towards Zhao Country, while one headed straight for the Western Region.
On the outskirts of Yuhah City, a subtle blood light shot out, closely following the Yunhuang Alliance Army straight to Zhao Country.
...
Wu Yue Sect Camp.
"... The Yunhuang Alliance Army set out today and is expected to arrive at Zhao Country's front in half a month."
A grey-robed young man holding a Jade Scroll reported the situation to the Venerables.
"Chang Chun Temple has called in quite a few helpers this time; it might take some effort," Xi Zheng spoke indifferently.
"Heh, if it weren't for the setbacks in the East Sea and Southern Border, how would the situation have come to this?" Evil Eye Venerable sneered.
Ni Mu sat upright and still, and despite hearing the mocking words of Evil Eye Venerable, showed no reaction.
Free Venerable, on the other hand, had her eyes closed the entire time, as if asleep and wholly uninvolved in the conversation.
Xi Zheng was about to retort, but a neutral voice interjected in the tent.
"Since when is there a smooth-sailing affair in this world? Failure is no disgrace. It only matters that you learn from it, and that's stronger than anything else."
The voice came from behind a dusky purple curtain. Shrouded by the light veil, Xi Zheng and the others could only see a large figure reclining on a couch.
"Nine Yin Venerable's lesson is well taken," Xi Zheng nodded, showing no disrespect.
"Let's return to the matter at hand. Though the Yunhuang Alliance Army is nothing but a rabble, since Wu Yue God wishes to test their mettle, we should not treat them lightly. Transmit my order: let those gathered sects serve as the vanguard to attack Zhao Country, with the main force pressing on steadily. We must take down the Spirit Talisman Sect's sect before the Yunhuang Alliance arrives, and sweep clean Zhao Country's territory!" commanded Nine Yin Venerable from behind the curtain.
"Yes!" someone immediately responded to the command and left.
Xi Zheng seemed to have some reservations at this moment, but after hesitating for a while, he ultimately chose not to speak.
"Alright, disperse. Everyone go back and make the necessary preparations. This time, we must not disappoint Wu Yue God again," Nine Yin Venerable spoke again.
Xi Zheng and Ni Mu immediately agreed, and then they withdrew.
Free Venerable seemed to have woken up at this point, looking around with open eyes, then chuckled softly. With a wave of her hand, she was enveloped in a pink spirit light that whisked her away.
Only after the others had left did Evil Eye Venerable get up and bow to the silhouette behind the curtain, speaking slowly.
"You should be careful with Xi Zheng and Ni Mu. One's a snake, the other's a wolf; neither have good intentions," he warned.
"I'm well aware of that. But you got one thing wrong—Ni Mu should be fine. He's just filling the position for Six Desires, and in the East Sea, he was constantly hampered by that idiot Bai Gu, and now he has to take the blame for the loss. It would be strange if he didn't act cautiously. As for Xi Zheng, with all his scheming, does he really think that flattering my naïve boy will win my support? Naive!" Nine Yin Venerable scoffed.
Upon hearing this, Evil Eye Venerable's expression also seemed a bit unnatural.
"Regarding the affair in the Southern Border..."
"I know. The death of Rei does not rest on you. That Yuan Ming will pay the price sooner or later," Nine Yin Venerable said with an icy tone.
Sharing the same enemy, Evil Eye Venerable nodded in agreement without mentioning his own hesitation when facing Yuan Ming or his suspicions about Yuan Ming's identity.
"Anyway, you don't have to worry," he said, "I have already prepared ways to deal with Xi Zheng's ambitions. I just hope he realizes the reality. If he obediently follows orders, I won't move against him for now."
Behind the curtain, the Nine Yin Venerable seemed to merely lift his head to look in Xi Zheng's direction, but his words also conveyed a warning to the Evil Eye Venerable.
...
More than ten days later.
Outside the Shura Palace, Hua Zhi was sitting idly on a piece of broken stone, supporting her head with one hand on her knee and extending several tendrils of vine into the sandy soil in front of her with the other.
Not far from her, a large White Ape was practicing an unknown form of boxing. Its movements were vigorous and domineering. Each punch accompanied by a gust of wind, the whooshing sound never ceased.
Where each punch landed, there seemed to be thunder following, continuously booming and exploding.
The space around was echoing from the White Ape's Fist Gang, shaking continuously, with the Fist Intent unceasing, like rolling thunder.
Having returned to Yuan Ming's side this time, he had made minor progress in his cultivation after receiving several pointers from his master.
"Stinky monkey, stop practicing and come rest for a while," Hua Zhi called out, bored.
"How can you still be so lazy when you've been following the master all this time?" Vajra didn't stop practicing his boxing and asked somewhat dissatisfied.
"What does it have to do with whether I follow the master or not? I'm telling you, you unenlightened monkey, what do you know about cultivation? I'm naturally gifted and intelligent—I don't have to work as hard as you; do you understand?" Hua Zhi retorted angrily.
However, after speaking, she started to feel guilty. Indeed, her cultivation had slacked quite a bit since returning from the Three Immortals Island.
"Should I really continue to cultivate seriously?" While Hua Zhi was contemplating, she suddenly felt the earth beneath her shake violently, as if some fierce beast was awakening underground.
She was startled at first, but then the tendrils she had stuck into the ground conveyed the changes below to her.
Hua Zhi's expression turned from shock to joy in an instant, and she exclaimed excitedly, "Master should be coming out soon..."
At the same time, in the secret chamber of the Shura Palace, Yuan Ming's body was enveloped in Demonic Qi. His clothes had long since disappeared, and his skin exposed outside the Demonic Qi turned out to be pitch black.
He had a layer of black Scale Armor on his cheeks that gleamed with a metallic sheen, and above his brow, the flesh split open, revealing a black pointed bone horn about half an inch long. He no longer looked human and instead resembled a member of the Demon Clan.
Qi Ye could sense the changes in him but dared not voice her thoughts.
Because Yuan Ming was currently facing the most dangerous threshold. If he crossed it, he would successfully obtain the Half-Demon Body. If he failed, the best outcome would be completely losing his senses and degenerating into a mindless demon.
In the thick Demonic Qi, one could still see the chains piercing through Yuan Ming's body, especially the one that entered through the back of his head. The surface of that chain was so saturated with Demonic Qi that it had liquefied into a black fluid wrapping around the chain.
The black fluid slowly seeped into Yuan Ming's Sea of Consciousness through the chain.
Inside Yuan Ming's Sea of Consciousness, it was total chaos, with pervasive Demonic Qi enveloping the entire space. The cl ear area of his Spirit Platform was now reduced to a mere inch of ground, surrounded by rolling black waves, bringing with them the force of annihilation.Readaheadandgetupdatesbyvisiting*.
His Nascent Soul, standing tall at this moment, was similarly tainted by the Demonic Qi, wrapped in strands of black smoke, appearing somewhat languished.
However, his eyes remained exceptionally clear and bright.
Just as the darkness seemed about to engulf this last spot, the Nascent Soul released a silent roar.
Almost simultaneously, a burst of intense Golden Light erupted from its body, burning away the black smoke in an instant. The mighty Divine Soul Power, carrying the brightness and heat of the sun, dispelled all the Demonic Qi in the Sea of Consciousness.
The surging tide of black waves was pushed back entirely by the suddenly spreading Golden Light, compressed to the edges of the Sea of Consciousness.
As Yuan Ming's Divine Soul Power erupted, his body underwent drastic changes. Golden Light shone in his eyes, and the Power of the Sun that resided within him started to burst forth, blending with the Demonic Qi that had already been absorbed into his body.
The pitch black of his skin slowly began to fade, but it didn't vanish completely. Instead, it solidified into continuous, interconnected black patterns across his chest, abdomen, back, shoulders, and thighs.
These patterns, bizarre in shape and different from the runes of the Yunhuang Continent, emanated an indescribable and mysterious aura.
"Hah…"
Yuan Ming let out a contented low grunt, suddenly yanking his arms forward while stepping ahead.
"Crack, crack"
A series of chain-breaking sounds followed in succession.
The chains piercing his arms, ankles, and back all broke apart, turning into particles of dark light that dissipated.
Yuan Ming shook his head from side to side, tearing off the last chain that was linked to the back of his head; the scale-like markings on his face slowly faded, leaving only faint traces behind.
The pointed bone horn protruding from his forehead also visibly began to recede bit by bit until it completely disappeared.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, congratulations," Qi Ye finally dared to speak at this moment.

chapters.title: Chapter 699 - 670: The Fire of Life
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming did not reply to Qi Ye but instead took the time to minutely sense the changes in his body.
Once he clenched his fists, all the muscles on his body tightened at once, and lines resembling etchings from a knife emerged on his skin, revealing an aesthetic that seemed to contain an explosive power.
Especially within the black demon patterns on his body, a scorching sensation immediately arose, as if there was a force prompting the swift circulation of his blood, urging him to go forth to conquer and battle.
Yuan Ming suppressed this impulse as he felt that the strength of his physical body seemed to have enhanced further, bringing him one step closer to the Body of Wanxiang.
More noticeable, however, was an odd sensation of hunger.
This hunger did not stem from the spleen and stomach, nor did it come from the Dantian or Sea of Consciousness, but rather from his blood vessels.
It was as if his flesh and blood had suddenly developed their own consciousness, incessantly telling Yuan Ming that they were hungry, not satiated, and needing to consume and replenish.
Yuan Ming, feeling slightly surprised, relayed this to Qi Ye.
"This is a good sign, no need for worry. Your physical body is already strong. Having been refined through the Demon Refining Array into a Half-Demon Body is similar to doubling the capacity of a bottle previously filled with water. Now that it can contain twice as much, it's natural to feel emptiness," Qi Ye said, laughing heartily after hearing this.
"Are you saying that all I need to do is replenish the power of Qi-Blood?" Yuan Ming asked after pondering for a moment.
"Exactly," Qi Ye affirmed.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming no longer hesitated; he immediately waved his hand, took out a black magic robe to wear, and then spread out the Shura Blood Devouring Map.
After this period of refinement, the Essence Blood remaining in the corpse of the Shura Master had been completely refined.
Yuan Ming summoned with a gesture, and an immense Qi-Blood Power surged out, converging towards him.
Without the slightest hesitation, he straightaway absorbed these Qi-Blood powers, beginning to circulate the Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill.
Seven days later.
A thunderous explosion echoed outside the Shura Palace, blasting a column of dust into the sky from the earth.
A black silhouette shot up from the dust, leaping into the sky.
Hua Zhi and Vajra were both taken aback, fixing their gaze only to see that it was their master Yuan Ming, which allowed them to relax.
"Master's aura has gotten much stronger..." Hua Zhi exclaimed in awe.
"He's reached the pinnacle of the Tongqiao Body, and it's likely that the master is about to make a breakthrough to the Body of Wanxiang," said Vajra, who also cultivates the path of Body Cultivation and thus could see a bit more clearly.
High above, Yuan Ming briefly stabilized his breath, glanced down at Hua Zhi and Vajra, and then once again shot straight up into the heavens, seemingly aiming for the great sun above.
"Whoosh whoosh"
The only sound in his ears was the roaring wind as Yuan Ming's body rapidly ascended, soon plunging into the sea of clouds.
Above the cloud layer, the sky was even more azurine, but it was not Yuan Ming's destination.
He continued to ascend further, with the wind growing increasingly ferocious by his side, until he reached the deep sky where fierce winds reigned.
Here, without a cloud in sight and the temperature exceedingly cold, a wild wind howled constantly in his ears.
Only the great sun seemed larger, and beyond the glaring white central sun, a rainbow halo with a seven-color sheen enveloped it.
Yuan Ming distinctly felt that the Power of the Sun here was over ten times denser than that on the earth's surface.
Yet, where he intended to go was not here.
To break through to the Body of Wanxiang, he must ascend above the Nine Heavens Gang Wind to absorb the Power of the Sun without any interference.
Raising his head to look above, Yuan Ming saw a sky where Spiritual Energy was scarce and utterly chaotic, with numerous whirlwinds of Gang Wind tossing the space into disarray. Apart from demon beasts like Kunpeng, hardly any creature could traverse it.
His gaze was fierce, with not a trace of fear in his eyes. With a twist of his wrist, he firmly grasped the Wind Stabilizing Pearl and with a leap, he plunged straight into the midst of the Nine Heavens Gang Wind.
The moment he entered the Gang Wind, the thunderous noise churned by the massive wind deafened him, and even with the protection of the Wind Stabilizing Pearl, he could still feel those colossal forces surrounding him, intent on annihilating heaven and earth.
One moment it was a tearing force that seemed to rip his body apart, and the next, an unbearable compressive force, but thankfully Yuan Ming's physical body was strong enough to pass through this trial.
After what seemed an unknown duration of flight, Yuan Ming finally burst through the layers of swirling winds and emerged above the range of the Nine Heavens Gang Wind, arriving in the outer void even higher above.
The dome of the sky had turned into a deep blue tinged with black, and the temperature around the emptiness of space had risen considerably; there was no hint of wind in the air, only a blistering heat.
Looking upward, Yuan Ming saw the great sun was dozens of times larger than what he had seen from the ground. Its surface was no longer just a dazzling white but showed vivid flares, glaringly a massive orb of fire.
He could distinctly feel that the concentration of the Sun's Power here far exceeded that of the ground by hundreds, if not thousands of times.
Yuan Ming spread his arms wide, allowing the scalding air to hit his face head-on, bathing in the exceedingly fervent sunlight as if undergoing some baptism.
His eyes reflected the shadow of the blazing sun, and inside his body, the Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill started to operate frenetically.
The next instant, the sun-like fireball hanging above Yuan Ming surged with fierce flames. Pure and solar Power of the Sun gushed out, transforming into a scorching beam of light that enveloped Yuan Ming.Publicationcourtesyof*.
Yuan Ming's eyes opened wide in rage as he endured the indescribable scorching power and began to frantically absorb the Power of the Sun.
The clothes on his body were incinerated by the flames, turning to ashes and revealing the nearly perfect lines of his physique, exposed to the Power of the Sun, his skin quickly turning red.
But in just a short moment, Yuan Ming's skin began to crack and split, revealing terrifying trails of blood.
However, the blood within the wounds had no time to flow out before it was dried up and formed scabs due to the scorching temperature, only to be torn open again, in a continuous cycle.
Yuan Ming endured unspeakable waves of burning pain, but he did not have the slightest intention of giving up.
Far from retreating, he instead flew closer to the sun, against the light. Inside his body, the Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill ran wildly, constantly absorbing and refining the seemingly inexhaustible Power of the Sun.
However, before he could adapt to the pain, a sudden disturbance emerged from within his body.
The Power of the Sun he had absorbed was not completely refined, resulting in backlash. For a time, with the inner fire overflowing and the external fire scorching him, Yuan Ming fell into a state of desperate straits.
His Physical Body burned and blackened at a visible speed until it became charred.
Under unimaginable agony, Yuan Ming's Divine Sense eventually was unable to withstand and eventually, he lost consciousness, his body falling from the Nine Heavens, through the Gang Wind, and crashing straight down.
Vajra and Hua Zhi had both been watching worriedly from below since Yuan Ming began his attempt to Breakthrough.
Seeing a charred figure falling from the sky, a look of panic appeared in both of their eyes.
Vajra ran wildly toward the direction where Yuan Ming was falling, but Hua Zhi was a step faster.
Vines interlaced and rose, weaving together in mid-air to form a gigantic vine palm that steadied Yuan Ming's body. It rapidly shrank and retracted, placing him gently on the ground.
"Master..." Hua Zhi's eyes turned red the moment she saw what Yuan Ming looked like.
She quickly took out a bottle of elixirs, trying to open Yuan Ming's mouth to pour them inside.
But when she touched Yuan Ming's face, which had also been burned, a piece of charred flesh fell off at her touch, causing Hua Zhi's hand to stiffen mid-air, trembling uncontrollably.
Vajra arrived, quickly transforming into human form, and opened his mouth wide in shock as well. He knew that advancing to the Body of Wanxiang was not easy, but had not anticipated it to be so perilous.
"Don't rush to cry, the master isn't dead yet. We need to find a way to wake him up," Vajra spoke.
He could still feel a faint sign of life from Yuan Ming's body.
Hearing this, Hua Zhi hastily wiped her tears and pressed her hand onto Yuan Ming's head, trying to use her Divine Soul Power to wake him.
However, no matter how much she tried, Yuan Ming lay motionless on the ground, showing no reaction.
Vajra also extended his hand to press on Yuan Ming's head, trying to wake him as well.
The result, naturally, was of no use.
That faint spark of life seemed like it could go out at any moment.
However, just then, a green light suddenly appeared at the position of Yuan Ming's Dantian in his lower abdomen.
The light spread from his abdomen, covering other regions of his body, and within moments, it enveloped him completely.
Within the green light, the flickering flame of life that had been on the brink suddenly surged wildly, emitting a rich and powerful life force.
Hua Zhi watched in amazement as the charred skin on Yuan Ming's body, which was no different from charcoal, began to peel away, as if something was pushing it from beneath.
She came closer to observe and saw tender green sprouts growing from under the peeling skin, which rapidly turned into dark green tendrils, quickly wrapping around Yuan Ming's entire physique.
Seeing this, both Hua Zhi and Vajra let out a sigh of relief and felt reassured.
They stayed by Yuan Ming's side without moving, waiting from daybreak until nightfall, and then from nightfall to the next day's dawn.
By midday, the vines that had wrapped around Yuan Ming's whole body began to wither gradually, turning to ash and flaking away, revealing a naked, pristine body.
Yuan Ming held his head with both hands and slowly sat up.
"Master, how are you?" Vajra asked with concern.
"Master, are you alright?" Hua Zhi also hurriedly asked.
Though she took on the form of a woman, she did not possess the human sense of modesty and thus did not shy away.
Yuan Ming put on a Magic Robe, rubbed his brow, and after a while, said, "I'm fine, thankfully the Origin Power of the Undying Tree was there, otherwise I wouldn't have recovered so quickly."
Having said that, he took out several elixirs to swallow and then sat cross-legged to meditate, beginning to practice Breathing Control by himself.
Seeing this, Hua Zhi and Vajra tactfully moved back a bit, surrounding Yuan Ming in the middle.

chapters.title: Chapter 700 - 671 Intention
chapters.content:
After more than an hour, Yuan Ming looked up at the firmament and stood up again.
"Master, are you going to try again?" Vajra asked with furrowed brows.
Yuan Ming didn't speak, merely nodding silently; he never considered giving up.
Having said that, his figure once more soared into the sky, plunged into the clouds, and disappeared from Vajra and Hua Zhi's view.
An hour later, a figure engulfed in flames plummeted through the clouds and fell down.
This time, it was Vajra who caught him.
Compared to the last time, Yuan Ming's burns were more severe, but he didn't lose consciousness.
So the moment he touched down, he immediately activated the Origin Power of the Undying Tree to heal his bodily injuries and then swallowed an elixir, continuing to recover through Breathing Control.
This time, he sat in meditation for an entire day and night; when his physical condition was at its best, he commenced his third attempt.
Above the Nine Heavens, searing Power of the Sun poured into his body; Yuan Ming furiously operated the Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill to refine it, while simultaneously mobilizing the Half-demon Power within him to counterbalance it, forcibly achieving a state of equilibrium.
Thus, after a full two hours, apart from severe burns, Yuan Ming's flesh and blood did not burst into flames, which gave him a glimpse of success.
Yuan Ming firmly believed that as long as he could withstand this phase and accumulate enough Power of the Sun within him, breaking through to the Body of Wanxiang would come naturally.
However, after another hour had passed, Yuan Ming sensed that he had enough Power of the Sun inside him, to the point of almost overflowing, yet the shackles blocking his path to the Body of Wanxiang showed no sign of loosening.
Finally, the Power of the Sun inside Yuan Ming backlashed once more.
The inferno that ensued this time completely charred his flesh and bones to a crisp, and his consciousness inevitably slipped into unconsciousness.
It took three days for his body to fully recover and for him to awaken anew.
After meditating and regulating his breathing, Yuan Ming planned to try once again.
"Master, your injuries were extremely severe this time; you cannot force another attempt. I fear the next time you might not recover so easily," Vajra said with a frown.
"I can feel it, I'm just a bit away from the breakthrough," Yuan Ming said, shaking his head, his voice slightly hoarse.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, perhaps you should heed a piece of advice. Although Body Cultivation is based on toughening the corporeal body, that is not all there is to it," Qi Ye's voice also sounded from within his Sea of Consciousness at this time.
"Fellow Daoist Qi Ye, what do you mean by that?" Yuan Ming sensed there was more to his words and asked with knitted brows.
"I am not purely a Body Cultivator, but during my time in the Demon World, I have heard rumours about the titans of the Demon Clan who exclusively followed the path of Body Cultivation. It is said that upon reaching a certain stage in their Cultivation, they no longer simply pursue the growth of physical strength. Some great demons even halt their killing spree to focus on tranquil Cultivation instead," Qi Ye responded.
"Are you talking about 'intent'?" Yuan Ming asked with mild surprise and confusion.
"Indeed, it seems you are aware," Qi Ye remarked.
"When I was breaking through the Tongqiao Body, I had already realized the Conception," Yuan Ming stated, frowning.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, there's a considerable distance between realizing the Conception and truly integrating it," Qi Ye said with a laugh.
"Are you saying that my insufficient understanding of the Conception is leading to my inability to break the bottleneck?" Yuan Ming inquired.
"Well, I can't say for certain that it is the case. However, every overwhelmingly powerful Body Cultivator I know of in the Demon World has a profound realization of the Conception. They can integrate their understanding of the Conception with their Cultivation, nurturing the intent with their body, strengthening the body with intent. I believe that the key to your breakthrough to the Body of Wanxiang may lie therein," Qi Ye explained.
Hearing this, Yuan Ming fell into a prolonged silence.
Although Qi Ye's words were laced with many uncertainties, they undoubtedly pointed out a direction to him.
Previously, when he was absorbing the Power of the Sun, he actually felt a reaction; his absorption of the Power of the Sun was adequate, so the problem preventing the breakthrough to the Body of Wanxiang might lie elsewhere.
Perhaps, just as Qi Ye mentioned, what he lacked was the integration with "intent".
"Thank you, Fellow Daoist Qi Ye, for unraveling this puzzle," Yuan Ming expressed his sincere thanks.
"We share both glory and loss; there's no need for such formality," Qi Ye remarked.
With this enlightenment, Yuan Ming put aside his intention to soar into the sky.
"Master, you're not going to try anymore?" Vajra asked.
"Come, join me in entering the Black Wind Desert," Yuan Ming declared.
"To the desert, for what?" Vajra inquired, puzzled.
"Help me to further comprehend the 'intent' of Body Cultivation," Yuan Ming said, and without further explanation, he grabbed Vajra's arm and whisked him away in flight.
Seeing this, Hua Zhi also hurriedly followed suit.
...
Several days later, in the Black Wind Desert.
The wind swept up the remnants of the sandstorm under the scorching sun; two figures stood about a mile apart, their slanted shadows merging with the vast black sands.
The two figures were none other than Yuan Ming and Vajra. Yuan Ming stood with his eyes closed and hands drooping, his expression tranquil, while Vajra watched intently ahead, as if he were looking at Yuan Ming, yet also as if gazing into the distant expanse.
After a while, Yuan Ming suddenly opened his eyes, looked at Vajra, and spoke:
"Vajra, we both practice the Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill. Let's fight it out today using our Body Cultivation divine skills, how about that?"
"Is Master trying to comprehend that 'intent' through this?" Vajra inquired.
"Indeed." Yuan Ming nodded in affirmation.
"Alright." Vajra agreed without hesitation, nodding his head.
"You must give it your all, no holding back." Yuan Ming cautioned.
Vajra didn't speak again. In response to Yuan Ming, his body swiftly expanded, and in the blink of an eye, he transformed into the form of a giant ape.
Dark Demonic Qi revolved around his body, and his presence felt even more powerful than it had been back in Snake King Valley.
With a thunderous roar from Vajra, his burly body charged toward Yuan Ming.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming grinned and allowed the Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill to operate, propelling his body forward to meet the charge.
...
An hour later, a huge crater several miles in diameter appeared in the desert, and Vajra, somewhat drained, lay at the bottom of the sand pit, letting the surrounding flowing sands converge toward him.
Outside the sand pit, Yuan Ming sat cross-legged, his eyes tranquil and deep, seeming to pierce through the void as he contemplated the battle process with Vajra.
Vajra's "intent" is known as "Violent Blood," a mindset that involves burning one's Essence Blood as a sacrifice to greatly enhance fighting power, focusing on decisive, unyielding combat determination.
The stronger the War Intent, the stronger the power unleashed, and the demands for comprehending the "intent" are not too excessive.
Yuan Ming's "intent" is known as "Shared Fate," a mindset that binds one's own destiny to the opponent's. There haven't been many opponents worthy enough for him to use this tactic against, so his use and insight into it have hardly improved.
In the previous fierce battle with Vajra, although they both went all out, they were ultimately not fighting with their lives on the line. Therefore, Yuan Ming didn't apply Shared Life Fist Intent to lock himself with Vajra.
Consequently, his comprehension was still lacking by a lot.
At that moment, Hua Zhi came to the bottom of the pit, squatting beside Vajra, and asked, "Stinky monkey, what is Master doing?"
"How would I know? Go ask Master yourself," Vajra replied irritably.
He was, of course, aware that Yuan Ming intended to comprehend "intent," but the address "stinky monkey" made him lose interest in sharing the matter with Hua Zhi. Right now, he just wanted to recover his strength as quickly as possible.
My V^irtual Lib&ra!ry@ E+m-p%i-re ($*$) tha*nk.s% you for re*adin+g! at the so^urce#.
If Master needed him, he was prepared to fight Yuan Ming again.
However, just then, a rumbling sound suddenly came from afar.
Vajra suddenly noticed that the sand pit beneath him started to vibrate. He focused and saw the grains of sand beside him bouncing slightly.
"This is... Black Wind is coming!" Hua Zhi realized.
They both hastily got to their feet and leaped out of the pit, only to see Yuan Ming had already stood up, gazing into the distance.
Following his gaze, they saw the previously clear sky was now enshrouded by a vast swath of dark clouds, which were moving toward them at a visible pace.
Below the clouds, violent black tornadoes whipped up countless grains of sand, swirling into the high clouds like black demon dragons.
Hundreds of massive sand dust dragons moved side by side, forming a towering sandstorm wall hundreds of feet high, rapidly advancing toward them.
Farther away, the sand dunes on the desert floor seemed to come alive as well.
Grains of sand were whipped up and raced wildly across the ground. From a distance, they appeared like true, terrifying waves, cresting and rolling toward them wave after wave.
"Master..." Hua Zhi spoke upon seeing Yuan Ming unmoving from his spot.
Yuan Ming came to his senses at the sound, glanced at them, and his eyes returned to the pitch-black sandstorm engulfing the sky.
Then, he slapped the Spiritual Beast Bag at his waist, calling out Lei Yu.
"I'm going to cultivate within this Black Wind sandstorm. You two follow Lei Yu to find shelter elsewhere for now, and come to look for me later," Yuan Ming instructed.
Without waiting for their response, Yuan Ming's figure soared, darting into the Black Wind sandstorm.
Just as he entered the sandstorm, he felt the temperature around him drop sharply, and a sandstorm tornado was already howling towards him.
The "whoosh" of the wind, carrying sand particles, scraped across his cheek.
Yuan Ming's eyes narrowed. He immediately took up a stance and activated the Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill, harnessing the Demon Image Battle Intent to lock onto the approaching sandstorm tornado.
In that instant, the sandstorm tornado appeared not as a force of nature, but as if it possessed life, binding and locking its fate with his.
"Life-lock."
Yuan Ming uttered in a low voice and stepped toward the roaring Black Wind sandstorm tornado, his fist, long charged with power, clenched tightly as he threw a punch.
In a flash, the void vibrated as if a Demon Image had reared its head and roared. A punch from Fist Power collided with the sand particles in the empty air, solidifying into the head of a massive Demon Image that smashed toward the sandstorm tornado.
With a thunderous boom!
The sandstorm tornado, hundreds of feet high, shattered mightily, unable to withstand even a single punch from Yuan Ming.

chapters.title: Chapter 701 - 672: Shared Fate Epiphany
chapters.content:
"Hoo hoo"
Chaotic currents mixed with the Black Wind swept towards Yuan Ming, who didn't dodge in the slightest. With his head held high and chest outthrust, he let the force of the wind assault him.
He immediately felt the yin Qi of the Black Wind penetrate his body, passing through his Sea of Consciousness, directly brushing against his Divine Soul, causing even the Nascent Soul little man seated stably within his Sea of Consciousness to shiver uncontrollably.
Yuan Ming's eyebrows slightly furrowed, but he did not stop for a step and, instead, actively moved towards the sandstorm tornadoes.
His Gang Step was stable as he moved forward, following each step with a fist coiled with energy.
As time passed, Yuan Ming's pace grew faster, his punches grew quicker one after another, with layers of fist shadows continuously flying out, his Demon Image Battle Intent growing more intense, and the might of his fists increasingly heavy. Every punch was accompanied by the roar of the Demon Image.
However, after nearly a hundred punches, Yuan Ming's brow furrowed even more deeply.
He tried to lock fates with the Black Wind sandstorm, indeed managing to touch upon that Conception of confronting an enemy in battle, but his insight into Shared Fate remained stagnant and clueless.
Just as he once again scattered a Black Wind sandstorm tornado, and as he observed the dispersing sand and felt the yin Qi infiltrating his Sea of Consciousness, a flash of illumination crossed Yuan Ming's mind.
"Shared Fate... perhaps it's not just about sharing the enemy's fate with mine but also about sharing my fate with the enemy's. I need to not only lock both fates but also share emotions and understanding. My comprehension of Shared Fate isn't deep because I've failed to truly connect with my enemy. Like this Black Wind sandstorm, I only understood the sand, not the yin wind thoroughly. With half-baked knowledge, how can I talk about Shared Fate?" In an instant, thoughts rapidly swirled in Yuan Ming's mind.
He felt he had grasped something significant, yet it wasn't clear to him in that moment.
"Forget it, let's set comprehending the Black Wind sandstorm, resisting the Black Wind with Fist Gang and War Intent as my cultivation goal for now," Yuan Ming decided silently within his heart.
He no longer rushed to attack the Black Wind sandstorm, but instead held the Wind Stabilizing Pearl in his hand, standing amidst the storm, observing the Black Wind, trying to lock it with his Fist Intent.
However, wind was formless, elusive and hard to touch, and ever-changing. How could it be easily locked?
At this moment, Yuan Ming suddenly realized that the earlier illusion of locking fates with it was just due to locking onto the yellow sand carried by the wind, which was why he had no counter for the yin Qi within the Black Wind.
"That's right, I can also use the Qi Observation Technique of the Emperor Sealing God Fist," Yuan Ming suddenly remembered a technique, immediately feeling a surge of joy.
The Qi Observation Technique was the core of the Emperor Sealing God Fist. To cultivate this fist technique and utilize the power of heaven and earth, one needed to see through the operations of the universe, or else how could one lead by leveraging trends, how could one wield the might of heaven and earth?
Yuan Ming immediately carefully recalled the Qi Observation Technique and, according to its description, began to channel Mana to his eyes.
The first attempt left Yuan Ming feeling a surge of soreness and swelling in his eyes, and the brightness of the world he saw sharply increased, making things seem far clearer even amidst the swirling yellow sand.
After a few short moments, however, the soreness turned into acute pain, which he couldn't bear any longer, and he had to close his eyes.
Large teardrops started to roll down from the corners of his eyes, smeared across his face by the blowing sand.
Yuan Ming paused briefly, and feeling no major issues after that, he attempted to use the Qi Observation Technique again.
This time, his concentration was more focused as he intently observed the Black Wind. Indeed, he saw many subtle changes within it, and his heart rejoiced.
It was then he suddenly remembered: Xi Zheng had been able to see through his Curse Rune that day, likely relying on this incredibly powerful Qi Observation Technique.
After a period of observation, Yuan Ming put away the Wind Stabilizing Pearl and once again began to fight against the Black Wind sandstorm.
Yet, after seeing through the many subtle changes in the Black Wind, Yuan Ming's punches became more skilled; his Fist Gang was able, to some extent, to weaken the yin Qi of the Black Wind.
And, based on the principles of the Emperor Sealing God Fist, Yuan Ming even learned to share fates with the Black Wind sandstorm.
From that point onwards, he no longer acted as an unwavering pillar against the sandstorm, but to a certain extent started to comply with the direction of the Black Wind sandstorm, resisting it while borrowing its strength at the same time.
However, this leverage was still at a very basic stage; most of the time, his attempts to leverage failed, turning into going with the flow instead, like a leaf boat swept away by the storm, carried along by the Black Wind sandstorm.
…
Meanwhile.
The great army of the Wu Yue Sect was majestically entering Zhao Country from the Black Wind Desert, heading straight for the Spirit Talisman Sect.
The army didn't rush on their way but, reaching each area, sent out Cultivators to slaughter the Cultivators and common people of Zhao Country, sparing not even livestock, collecting Divine Souls with Magic Artifacts similar to the Soul-Attracting Bell.
In no time, wherever the army passed, the land was filled with bones; not a human or animal was left alive.
At one location within the Wu Yue Sect's great army, a giant Flying Boat, a hundred zhang long, was cutting through the sky.
Above the Flying Boat, a large Command Flag with the character "Xi" was hanging, and in a room on the Flying Boat, Xi Zheng sat cross-legged, his face solemn.
In midair in front of him floated a Big Banner, a huge ghost face pattern twisting on it, emitting a piercing wail of ghosts, as if countless suffering spirits were crying through the night.
In Xi Zheng's hands, he held a Black Gourd, from which yin Qi and yin souls gurgled out, continuously merging into the Big Banner.
An hour later, the yin Qi and yin souls in the gourd had been absorbed to emptiness, the ghost face pattern on the Big Banner became much clearer, and the room was filled with howling yin winds and surging ghostly Qi.
"Not bad, having absorbed this batch of yin souls, the Ghost King Banner has improved significantly. After some time, I can add the twelfth rune," Xi Zheng's face flitted with a trace of delight.
The Wu Yue Sect army slaughtered their way through, siphoning souls, while the Xi Family followed behind, mooching off the spoils and greedily consuming some souls for their own use—other powers were doing the same.
The Wu Yue God turned a blind eye to these actions, choosing to ignore them.
Over this period, the Xi Family, using these yin souls, had refined numerous yin attribute Magic Treasures, unknowingly increasing their strength by a significant margin.
Just at that moment, a white light flashed from outside and arrived in front of him, the light receding to reveal a Sound Transmission Talisman.
Xi Zheng took the Sound Transmission Talisman, his Divine Sense entering it, and a flicker of surprise crossed his face.
He waved his sleeve, put away the Ghost King Banner, and stood up, flying directly towards the outside.
...
In a certain location of the Wu Yue Sect's massive army, a palace hovered midair, approximately an acre in size and several dozen feet high, emanating wisps of black air, looking akin to a hunched, coiled black turtle.
Around the palace, hundreds of Wu Yue Sect Cultivators were stationed, securely surrounding the entire structure, strictly prohibiting any outsiders from approaching.
Near the black palace was another smaller grey palace, also guarded by Wu Yue Sect Cultivators.
A tunneling light flew from the distance and stopped at the entrance of the grey palace, revealing the figure of Xi Zheng.
He disregarded the Cultivators saluting him and went straight into the palace.
In the center of the grey palace was a circular stone table with five stone chairs, two figures were already seated there—it was Evil Eye Venerable and Ni Mu.
"You've both arrived quite early. Considering the distance from the Spirit Talisman Sect, I wonder what Nine Yin Venerable has summoned us here for so urgently," Xi Zheng took a seat on one of the stone chairs and was immediately served steaming Spiritual Tea by a shapely Maid.
"I don't know. Could there have been some unforeseen event at the Spirit Talisman Sect?" Ni Mu said.
As he spoke, golden patterns that appeared and disappeared regularly could be seen on his skin, on areas such as his arms and neck.
"Has Heavenly Puppet Venerable refined the Soul-rinsing Pill already? From the looks of it, you must have completely merged with your Lifebound Puppet, that is indeed good news," Xi Zheng looked at Ni Mu, congratulated him with folded hands, his tone laced with envy.
Ni Mu brought back the Undying Immortal Fruit from the Three Immortals Island and refined them into Immortal Elixirs, which he had offered to the Wu Yue God some time ago. The Wu Yue God was greatly pleased and rewarded him with a Soul-rinsing Pill.
The Soul-rinsing Pill was a wonder pill refined by the Wu Yue God, capable of enhancing Soul Power and purifying the Divine Soul. Even those who were not Soul Cultivators would greatly benefit from consuming it.
"All thanks to the grace of Wu Yue God," Ni Mu said.
Evil Eye Venerable sat quietly, sipping tea, taking no part in their conversation.
Suddenly, his pupils constricted.
On an empty stone chair beside them, a figure wearing a purple robe and a candle dragon mask unexpectedly appeared—it was Nine Yin Venerable.
Upon noticing the figure of Nine Yin Venerable, Xi Zheng and Ni Mu's expressions shifted slightly as they rose to salute, "Nine Yin Venerable."
"Sorry to keep you waiting. Have a seat," the Nine Yin Venerable said.
"Nine Yin Venerable, may I ask why you've summoned us here? And where is Free Venerable?" Evil Eye Venerable inquired as he sat down.
"There's been a complication at the Spirit Talisman Sect. It seems they've learned of our Wu Yue Sect army's movements and have abandoned their base, fleeing to Da Jin. I've sent Free Venerable after them," explained Nine Yin Venerable.
Upon hearing this, Xi Zheng, Ni Mu, and Evil Eye Venerable showed no surprise.
It was only natural for the Spirit Talisman Sect to not stand a chance against the Wu Yue Sect's army—fleeing was expected.This chapter was uploaded by the team at *.
"Let them be. I just received word that the Cloud Desolate Alliance's army has entered the borders of Zhao Country and will soon clash with us. I've particularly called you here to discuss strategies for the enemy ahead," Nine Yin Venerable said.
Hearing this, Xi Zheng, Ni Mu, and Evil Eye Venerable straightened up slightly.
So the great battle was finally about to begin...
"Has Wu Yue God provided any instructions?" Evil Eye Venerable asked tentatively.
Although all present were Venerables, most found it hard to even get an audience with the Wu Yue God on a regular day. Any instructions from the Wu Yue God were usually conveyed directly through Nine Yin Venerable.
"The Wu Yue God is still in seclusion," said Nine Yin Venerable slowly.
Evil Eye Venerable's expression shifted slightly, and he said no more.
"Here is the latest intelligence returned. Take a look at it," said Nine Yin Venerable, lifting a hand, and three Jade Scrolls appeared before Ni Mu, Xi Zheng, and Evil Eye Venerable.
The three exchanged glances and each took up a Jade Scroll, immersing their Divine Senses into them.
The Jade Scrolls contained detailed records of the number of Cultivators the Cloud Desolate Alliance had dispatched, the sects involved, as well as a list of prominent experts.
"With the great battle approaching, don't hesitate to speak your mind, whatever thoughts you may have," Nine Yin Venerable scanned over the three, inviting them to share their ideas.

chapters.title: Chapter 702 - 673: When to Speak and When Not to?
chapters.content:
"From this intelligence, the Cloud Desolate Alliance has only deployed about half of its forces, clearly not intending to fight a decisive battle. Their aim is likely to diminish our combat power or delay our advance to achieve some goal," the hall fell silent for a moment before Xi Zheng spoke up.
"Venerable Xian Kong speaks sense, what do you all think?" Nine Yin Venerable nodded and then looked towards Ni Mu and Evil Eye Venerable.
"Venerable Xian Kong is absolutely right. If the Cloud Desolate Alliance dares to underestimate us like this, then let's give them a good fight and ensure their half of the forces do not return," Evil Eye Venerable slammed the table, his voice thick with killing intent.
Ni Mu did not speak, which was taken as an agreement with Xi Zheng's conjecture.
"Good, since we are all in agreement, then let's give the Cloud Desolate Alliance a good fight. Now that the Cloud Desolate Alliance's troops are divided into three routes, I ask the three of you to lead your respective forces to meet the enemy: Venerable Xian Kong to intercept Tianyinzi's Chang Chun Temple cultivators, Evil Eye Venerable to face the Southern Border cultivators, and Tian Gui to handle the East Sea front," Nine Yin Venerable instructed.
"Yes," said Evil Eye Venerable and Ni Mu.
Xi Zheng remained silent for a few moments before he responded.
The three soon left the hall, leaving only Nine Yin Venerable there.
He took out a ring, which was Ximen Rui's storage ring.
"Rui, rest assured, I will not let anyone who has harmed you go unpunished... I will make them pay," Nine Yin Venerable gently caressed the ring, muttering to himself.
He didn't linger there and soon left, arriving in front of a black hall's door, where he formed a hand seal and shot out a streak of black light.
The firmly closed door opened a crack, and gusts of cold, black wind blew out from inside.
A nearby Wu Yue Sect Cultivator caught in the black wind immediately had his eyes turn dull, his body froze stiff, and he fell to the ground like a wooden stake.
Streams of soul light flowed out from this person's body and merged into the walls of the black hall.
The others nearby showed faces of terror and quickly moved aside.
The black wind hit Nine Yin Venerable, but he showed no reaction and walked inside.
The hall was pitch black, and even with Nine Yin Venerable's eyesight, he could only see about thirty feet ahead.
He walked further inside, and soon a square altar appeared before him, at the top of which lay a black object that resembled a coffin.
"Wu Yue God, I have relayed your orders as you requested," Nine Yin Venerable knelt on one knee and spoke respectfully.
"Do not spread the battlefield too far, or else this Black Mud Palace won't be able to absorb those scattered Divine Souls. I have not fully recovered yet. The trip to Yuhua City was taxing, and I need a substantial amount of Divine Souls to replenish," a vast voice emanated from the black coffin.
"Yes," Nine Yin Venerable said.
"What about the matter I asked you to investigate last time?" the grand voice continued.
"It's confirmed now, Yuan Ming is indeed the Nether Moon God," Nine Yin Venerable reported.
"Have you managed to clear up Yuan Ming's life background?" Nether Moon God hummed and asked.
Nine Yin Venerable's body shook, and he hurriedly said, "It's cleared up. Yuan Ming is the son of a common general from Da Jin, with an ordinary Spirit Root talent, was declined by Chang Chun Temple, later followed a Jin Country diplomatic envoy to the Southern Border and accidentally joined Biluo Cave..."
He recounted Yuan Ming's life story in detail, which would have surely surprised Yuan Ming if he were present.
The information Nine Yin Venerable held was exceedingly detailed, spanning from his birth to the recent battle at the Little Silver Mountain workshop, with virtually nothing overlooked except for matters such as the Stealing Heaven Tripod that were untraceable.
"According to what you've said, did Yuan Ming cultivate to at least the Sleep Witch Realm within just a few decades?" Wu Yue God asked after a moment of silence.
"Although it's unbelievable, according to the investigation, it is indeed so," Nine Yin Venerable said.
"Interesting, aside from the Xi Family's Soul Heritage Secret Technique, it's impossible for ordinary Soul Cultivators to advance so quickly. The Xi Family's Soul Heritage Secret Technique can only be transmitted to those related by blood, and since Yuan Ming's ancestors are all mortals, he couldn't have used this technique, so there is only one possibility," Wu Yue God stated.
"I also believe that Yuan Ming has an item that can rapidly enhance his Soul Power, but what exactly it is, I have yet to find out," Nine Yin Venerable reported."
"Isn't it obvious? According to what you just said, wasn't Xi Cangqiong slain by the Dawn Alliance during the period Yuan Ming joined Biluo Cave? After Xi Cangqiong's death, his Soul Suppressing Kettle vanished without a trace," Wu Yue God hummed.
"Are you saying the Soul Suppressing Kettle ended up in Yuan Ming's hands? Correct, the Soul Suppressing Kettle has the ability to refine Divine Souls, and if one disregards the dangers, it can indeed swiftly elevate one's Soul Cultivation Realm!" Nine Yin Venerable's body trembled, his eyes shining with excitement.
He had thought of this possibility early on, but as a subordinate, there were times he had to feign ignorance.
"The Soul Suppressing Kettle lacks the core Soul Suppressing Pearl, reducing its power greatly, but it is still a cherished treasure for Soul Cultivators. I currently need this item, and it must be reclaimed! Where is Yuan Ming now?" Wu Yue God's voice also carried traces of excitement, then he asked.
"I'm currently investigating; this person was last seen in the Southern Border and then disappeared," Nine Yin Venerable bowed and said.
"I give you one month to find Yuan Ming's location," Wu Yue God stated calmly.
"Yes!" Nine Yin Venerable hastily said.
"You may leave," Wu Yue God commanded.ThisispartofaseriesfromMyVirtualLibraryEmpire(*).
Wu Yue God, I have one more matter," Nine Yin Venerable quickly added.
"Speak," Wu Yue God said with a hint of impatience.
"According to the intelligence, Yuan Ming's cultivation is mostly likely based on the Moonlight Technique, though it is unclear how he obtained this cultivation technique, it is highly likely related to the Xi Family. Should the Xi Family be punished?" Nine Yin Venerable asked quickly.
"Such a trivial matter, you may handle it as you see fit," Wu Yue God said indifferently, his voice falling silent completely.
"That Yuan Ming, I don't know where he has fled to, Xi Zheng, now you can join me in a good game," Nine Yin Venerable sneered coldly, standing up and walking outside.
...
Xi Zheng left the gray palace and flew straight towards the back.
The vast army of the Wu Yue Sect had already stopped and begun to mobilize, with countless figures moving about without any sign of chaos, clearly well-trained for such maneuvers.
Xi Zheng soon arrived on the Xi Family's gigantic flying boat, where Nascent Soul cultivators and Sleeping Witch of the Xi Family were gathered, including Xi Dongliu, who Yuan Ming had encountered at the Southern Border.
Counting Xi Zheng, there were six individuals at the Nascent Soul stage, upwards of twenty to thirty at Core Formation stage, and even more cultivators at the Foundation Establishment stage.
With such profound strength, they were no less formidable than any Great Sect on the Yunhuang Continent.
"Patriarch, what has happened?" a tall, crane-haired but youthful-faced elder approached and asked.
This person was named Xi Lin, a Nascent Soul cultivator of the Xi Family.
Xi Zheng briefly explained the situation.
"The Central Plains Immortal Cultivation World has always been powerful, surpassing the East Sea and the Southern Border. Chang Chun Temple dominates the Central Plains with even greater might. Nine Yin Venerable asking our Xi Family to confront Chang Chun Temple is clearly a plot to weaken our power!" Xi Lin said angrily.
"Be cautious with your words!" Xi Zheng looked toward the direction of the grey palace, stepping lightly on the flying boat.
A multitude of stars rose from the giant flying boat, forming a thick blue barrier.
Elder Xi Lin isn't wrong, Nine Yin Venerable has tasked our Xi Family with confronting Chang Chun Temple, clearly out of personal vendetta due to the death of Ximen Rui—an insidious and petty man!" Xi Dongliu snorted.
The others were also filled with righteous indignation.
"Enough, Wu Yue God has entered seclusion again, and now Nine Yin Venerable holds the power alone; we must temporarily obey his orders. Do not discuss this matter privately!" Xi Zheng said.
"Patriarch, are we just to have no means at all, to be manipulated by Nine Yin Venerable?" Xi Dongliu asked.
"You all need not worry, I will find a way to resolve this. During the ensuing battle, be clever and prioritize preserving your lives," Xi Zheng paused briefly before speaking.
The members of the Xi Family agreed in unison.
Xi Zheng's face remained calm, but his heart was exceedingly bitter.
The Wu Yue Sect had completely become a dictatorship under Nine Yin Venerable; other than following orders, he had no other options.
Although he advised the Xi Family members to be clever, once the battle commenced, could life and death really be controlled by them?
Xi Zheng pursed his lips tightly; it had been his firm decision to align the Xi Family with the Wu Yue Sect. The conflict between the Wu Yue Sect and the Cloud Desolate Alliance could continue indefinitely, and by the time this great battle ended, who knew how many of the Xi Family would remain?
"No! Everything is for the future of the Xi Family. Without a Returning Void-Level expert in command, regardless of who dominates this Yunhuang Continent, the Xi Family could only be fading, merely a vassal. Only by rising to the Returning Void-Level can the Xi Family truly prosper!" Xi Zheng's eyes became resolute.
"Patriarch, where has Xi Ying the young lady gone? She has already broken through the Sleep Witch Realm, and her combat power is not weak. Now that the family is in trouble, she has just run off to enjoy herself alone, which is utterly inappropriate," Xi Lin suddenly asked.
"Ying'er has a peculiar temperament. She left with Qian'er in a huff to the Southern Border and has been untraceable since," Xi Zheng replied.
"Qian'er was taken away? Her physical condition is declining further. She was barely sustaining herself with the special power of the earth veins in the Southern Border; she can't afford such capricious actions!" Xi Lin's white eyebrows furrowed.
"I've failed in my duty as a father, truly shameful," Xi Zheng sighed.
"Patriarch need not worry. With Ying'er's skills, she should be able to ensure Qian'er's safety. It's better they are not here; Ying'er and Qian'er are intelligent and have boundless potential, they are the future of our Xi Family. This struggle between the Wu Yue Sect and the Cloud Desolate Alliance could continue for a long time, and even if all of us were to perish in battle, having Ying'er and Qian'er ensures that our Xi Family would have the chance to rise again," another dark-skinned, bald Nascent Soul man said.
Upon hearing this, everyone also slightly nodded their heads.
Xi Lin lightly stroked his beard, his brow slightly relaxing.
"Alright, the great battle is about to begin, don't linger here chatting. Return to your positions and prepare for the battle," Xi Zheng said.
Several people dispersed, but two remained: Xi Dongliu and the dark-skinned big man.
"Dongliu, Nanshan, is there something else?" Xi Zheng asked, startled.
"Patriarch, I heard from Dongliu that you went to the Southern Border on a mission, and Ying'er and a person named Yuan Ming appeared there?" Xi Nanshan asked.
"Indeed, why mention this all of a sudden?" Xi Zheng asked, a shadow crossing his eyes upon hearing Yuan Ming's name.
"Patriarch, as you know, I've recently been working with the Secret Investigation Department of the Wu Yue Sect, and I've found a situation I'm uncertain whether to speak of," Xi Nanshan glanced at Xi Dongliu, speaking slowly.

chapters.title: Chapter 703 - 674: Waiting for the Right Moment
chapters.content:
"Nanshan, if you have something to say, just say it; there's no need to beat around the bush," Xi Zheng said impatiently, his gaze fixed on the man in black armor standing before him.
Xi Nanshan was not only a Nascent Soul cultivator but also a Sleeping Witch. In terms of strength, he firmly held the second highest position in the Xi Family, just below Xi Zheng.
However, this man liked to speak in a mysteriously halting manner, saying one thing but implying another, which left others helpless.
"My apologies, Patriarch. The Wu Yue Sect is tightening its investigation on an organization called the Moon Sect. I've looked into the Moon Sect, whose followers worship a deity called the Nether Moon God. After extensive searching by the Wu Yue Sect, it turned out that this Nether Moon God is a Soul Cultivator, and his name is Yuan Ming," Xi Nanshan said with an awkward smile as he scratched his head.
"Can this really be true!" Xi Zheng exclaimed in surprise.
The Moon Sect's reputation was soaring, and he was naturally aware of this sect. Because its name resembled the Xi Family's Moonlight Technique, he had even dispatched people to investigate and confirmed that nobody from the Xi Family was involved, which had put him at ease. Yet, unexpectedly, it seemed they were still connected to this matter.
Xi Dongliu next to him appeared calm, evidently having already been informed by Xi Nanshan of these details.
"Did you manage to obtain any portraits or statues of the Nether Moon God?" Xi Zheng asked with a fluctuating expression, looking up.
"Yes." Xi Nanshan handed over a Jade Scroll.
Xi Zheng's Divine Sense entered the scroll, and he fell completely silent.
The portrait within the Jade Scroll wasn't identical to Yuan Ming, but it bore a seventy to eighty percent resemblance. Combined with what Xi Nanshan had mentioned, Yuan Ming was undoubtedly the Nether Moon God.
"To think that Yuan Ming is the Nether Moon God. According to recent intelligence from the East Sea, the Nether Moon God possesses at least the strength of a Half-step Word Witch. No wonder the always proud Ying'er took a liking to him and even asked me to leave the Wu Yue Sect! If Yuan Ming truly is a Word Witch, leaving the Wu Yue Sect might be a good choice..." Xi Zheng mused.
Although he wanted to use the power of the Wu Yue Sect to unite the world and break through to achieve the Body of Wanxiang, the Nine Yin Venerable had already started to target him, leaving him with too great a risk and potentially endangering his entire clan.
When faced with a choice between life and power, Xi Zheng was not foolish enough to gamble with the lives of his entire clan.
"Wait, during that encounter at the Southern Border, I didn't sense that Yuan Ming was a Soul Cultivator; on the contrary, his Divine Soul was quite weak. What's going on? Could this be the capability of a Word Witch, to freely control the strength of Soul Waves?" Xi Zheng pondered, his gaze wandering uncertainly.
"Patriarch..." Xi Nanshan, seeing that Xi Zheng had been silent for a long time, couldn't help but speak.
"Enough, let's end this matter here. Do not let a fourth person know about this! Nanshan, personally handle this and erase the memories of everyone in the Southern Border who has seen Yuan Ming!" Xi Zheng instructed solemnly, looking toward Xi Dongliu and Xi Nanshan.
"Yes," Xi Nanshan responded, and together with Xi Dongliu, he proceeded to carry out the order.
Xi Zheng looked forward, letting out a deep sigh.
...
In the following days, the army of the Wu Yue Sect advanced another thirty miles and camped near a brown-red mountain range, continuously dispatching spies to probe the situation of the Cloud Desolate Alliance's army.
News arrived constantly. The three divisions of the Cloud Desolate Alliance's forces from east, west, and south, all converging, suddenly stopped half a day's journey from the brown-red mountain range.
This chapter was made possible by the community at *.
At the forefront of the Chang Chun Temple's army, a huge white stone platform hovered, covering dozens of meters and glistening under the sunlight.
Tianyinzi stood on it, looking in the direction of the brown-red mountain range, as if waiting for something.
A crimson tunneling light shot from the distance and in the blink of an eye reached the platform, revealing Wan Tianren's figure.
"Fellow Daoist Tianyin, why did you ask us to halt?"
From another direction, a white rainbow streaked across the sky and instantly landed on the platform—it was Luo Zhu.
"I've asked the two of you here to discuss what our strategies will be for the upcoming battle," Tianyinzi said with a chuckle, before posing the question.
"The alliance's goal in striking the Wu Yue Sect is to wear down their combat strength. As for the method, we'll follow each of our styles," replied Luo Zhu.
"I and Fellow Daoist Luo share the same thought," said Wan Tianren, keeping the specifics unspoken.
"Both of you make good points. I have no intention of digging into the secrets of your sects, but I have an exotic treasure here that might serve some purpose in the upcoming battle, if you two would care to take a look?" Tianyinzi said.
Hearing this, Luo Zhu and Wan Tianren exchanged glances before approaching Tianyinzi.
Meanwhile, within a secluded valley ten miles away, silver light flashed revealing two figures—one was the Silver Kong Tree Demon, and the other a woman dressed in white, her long hair flowing and skin so flawless, her features were beyond reproach, looking exactly like the White Bone Venerable.
"Why have we suddenly stopped?" the Silver Kong Tree Demon looked up into the sky.
"We are almost about to encounter the Wu Yue Sect; naturally, we need to discuss our tactics. Let's just wait; there's no need to rush," the woman in white explained.
"Master, are we just going to watch this whole time?" Silver Kong sat beside the woman in white and asked.
"Our main task this time is to collect Divine Souls to enhance our own strength. As for the battle between the Wu Yue Sect and the Cloud Desolate Alliance, let's wait until we've collected enough Divine Souls to discuss," the woman in white reasoned.
The battle was uncertain for the Cloud Desolate Alliance. Since she was here, it made sense to contribute somehow.
Not wanting to get involved in the conflict, Silver Kong hesitated upon hearing the woman's words, looking slightly anxious, "Collecting Divine Souls is no easy task; I think it's best to focus on this. As for the battle, isn't Yuan Ming at the Shura Palace cultivating? It'd be better to have him come over."
The woman in white's expression shifted slightly, she pondered for a moment, then retrieved a green Communication Talisman, infused it with mana, whispered a few words before crushing it.
...
In the depths of the Black Wind Desert, Yuan Ming pursued the black winds, honing his fist intent and technique.
Immense Qi-Blood surged within him, sounding like the roar of rivers and waves. His body emanated substantial beams of blood light, vastly different from his previous inner breath.
"Who would have thought that advancing my fist intent and technique could promote the formation of Blood Gang power?" Yuan Ming thought happily to himself, even more diligently circulating his Qi-Blood Inner Breath.
He possessed the Shura Blood Devouring Map, which allowed him to rapidly enhance his Qi-Blood power. Unlike ordinary Body Cultivators who had to accumulate slowly, once he could form Blood Gang, he would be able to move to the next step—refining the Blood Gang True Body.
Just then, a green light shot out from Yuan Ming's bosom, revealing a green Communication Talisman.
"Xi Ying's Green Spirit Communication Talisman! Could she be near the Black Wind Desert?" he paused in his motion, crushed the talisman, and a stream of information entered his Sea of Consciousness.
"This is reckless, truly reckless!" Yuan Ming exclaimed sternly.
In the information, Xi Ying briefly described her current situation. She had sent a clone along with Yinkong to the battlefield, intending to collect souls.
As the clone was not strong enough, Xi Ying had it wear Blood Puppet Armor.
Yuan Ming paced back and forth, his expression grave.
He still hadn't figured out the details of the Blood Puppet Armor. Even if it was just a clone, wearing the Blood Puppet Armor was very risky.
Moreover, Xi Ying was directly absorbing souls to boost her Soul Power!
Yuan Ming had the ability to Soul Feed and was all too aware of the risks of absorbing Divine Souls directly—it was over ten times riskier than when he refined Desire Power. Xi Ying was normally cautious; why would she act so recklessly this time?
After a long while, he stopped pacing and sighed.
What's done was done; they could only discuss it upon his return.
"I can't believe the Wu Yue Sect's army and the Cloud Desolate Alliance are going to clash so soon," Yuan Ming mused, shifting his attention to another piece of information mentioned in the message.
Xi Ying had mentioned in the message that if it was convenient, he should come and take a look.
Yuan Ming indeed wanted to see for himself, as this might be the first genuine battle since the emergence of the Wu Yue God. However, he was deep within the Black Wind Desert, far too far from the battlefield; even if he wanted to rush there, it would be too late.
"Since my true body can't make it, I can only resort to this method..." Yuan Ming activated the Taiyin Refining Spleen Technique, his whole figure enveloped in a yellow light as he slithered into the sandy soil.
Under the illumination of the yellow light of the Taiyin Refining Spleen Technique, the nearby sand and rocks turned into yellow mud. He easily tunneled downwards without feeling any resistance and soon reached several humdreds of feet under the Earth's surface.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming inwardly praised the subtlety of the Taiyin Refining Spleen Technique. Even a seemingly minor effect like Earth Tunneling was so extraordinary; it seemed he had to delve deeper into this cultivation technique in the future.
He didn't continue to delve deeper. Parting his hands to the left and right, he exercised the earth-controlling Divine Skills of the Taiyin Refining Spleen Technique.
The nearby mud and rocks seemed to come to life, shifting backwards to swiftly create a square underground space with perfectly flat walls, resembling a stone chamber.
"I will be going into seclusion for a while. Protect me," Yuan Ming summoned Vajra from the Spiritual Beast Bag and instructed.
"Master, leave it to me!" Vajra assured, striking his chest.
Yuan Ming was quite confident in Vajra. He took out a Green Spirit Communication Talisman, whispered a few words into it, then crushed it.
Having done these preparations, he sat down, closed his eyes, and quietly began to wait.
Black Incense Possession time was limited; it had to be used at a critical moment. Since Yuan Ming couldn't see the situation at the scene, the timing and target for possession could only be chosen by Xi Ying's clone.
...
Xi Zheng, Ni Mu, and the Evil Eye Venerable led their respective forces and arrayed them in front of the Wu Yue Sect's main army, on the left and right, ready for battle.
Under Xi Zheng's command, there were not only the disciples from the Xi Family but also many from the Wu Yue Sect, though generally of lower cultivation, forming several large and small formations typical of the Guiyuan Sect's Battle Formation.
The situation on Ni Mu's side was similar to that of Xi Zheng. The main force was the Dawn Alliance, gathered from scattered places across the Yunhuang Continent, formidable not to be underestimated. Besides Ni Mu himself, there were as many as five Nascent Soul cultivators.
As for the Evil Eye Venerable, who had always stayed at the Wu Yue Sect's headquarters and had not developed his power outside, had under his command all Wu Yue Sect disciples. The number of his troops was not less than Xi Zheng or Ni Mu, except he didn't have many high-level experts.
To bolster his forces, the Nine Yin Venerable had transferred several sects that had joined the Wu Yue Sect over for the Evil Eye Venerable to command, among them unmistakably the Senluo Sect.
Disciples of the Senluo Sect stood at the very front, while Luo Yongqi hovered in the void, his expression complex, occasionally casting fearful and hateful glances at the Evil Eye Venerable.
"Fellow Daoist Luo, in the impending great battle, we will depend greatly on you and the members of the Senluo Sect," the Evil Eye Venerable, noticing Luo Yongqi's look, turned his head, bearing a smile.
Upon hearing this, Luo Yongqi stared intensely at the Evil Eye Venerable as if he could devour him.
The Evil Eye Venerable just chuckled and nonchalantly shifted his gaze forward.

chapters.title: Chapter 704 - 675: Soul Stealing
chapters.content:
Just at this moment, dots suddenly appeared in the sky ahead of the vast Wu Yue Sect army. They multiplied and grew larger, clearly tunneling lights hurtling toward this place.
The number of tunneling lights was astonishing, densely covering the sky in the blink of an eye, a force of twenty to thirty thousand strong.
For a moment, the sky was obscured!
"What's going on? Was the intelligence wrong?" the people of the Wu Yue Sect exclaimed in alarm.
The intelligence had said the allied army was divided into three groups, but now they had clearly joined forces and were charging over magnificently.
"All men, heed my command, maintain formation, and retreat steadily!" Xi Zheng shouted loudly, leading the Xi Family cultivators backward.
The enemy situation was severely inconsistent with the intelligence. Facing so many enemies, the Xi Family would suffer too many casualties if they resisted head-on.
Ni Mu and the Evil Eye Venerable, seeing that something was amiss, hurriedly led their troops to fly directly toward the front of the Wu Yue Sect's army to support Xi Zheng.
The tunneling lights of the Cloud Desolate Alliance moved extremely fast. Ni Mu and the Evil Eye Venerable had just reached the front and hadn't yet stabilized their position when countless tunneling lights descended upon them.
Dense Magic Treasures and spells rained down, striking the heads of the Wu Yue Sect's three groups of cultivators.
Xi Zheng inwardly cursed the incompetence of the spy he had sent out, and hurriedly summoned a large yellow flag embroidered with several Yellow Cloud patterns.
Thick Yellow Clouds emerged out of thin air, covering a vicinity of several hundred feet.
Nascent Soul cultivators like Xi Dongliu and Xi Lin also rushed to the forefront, unfolding their defenses to protect the younger generation behind them.
About a hundred streaks of treasure light struck the Yellow Clouds. Xi Zheng tensed his body, ready to withstand the impact.
However, the Yellow Clouds merely trembled slightly, far less intense than expected.
The other members of the Xi Family also showed expressions of surprise, experiencing the same situation on their side. Most of the incoming attacks shattered like bubbles upon touching their defenses.
