"These Cloud Desolate Alliance cultivators, most of them are illusions!" Xi Zheng's eyes flashed with a layer of luminescence as he urgently shouted.
Upon hearing this, the Nascent Soul cultivators of the Xi Family then realized the truth.
No wonder so many cultivators suddenly appeared out of nowhere; they were fake.
But how could such realistic illusions deceive their Divine Sense?
Just at this moment, vast patches of dazzling white light emerged from the void on both sides, and from within numerous tunneling lights sprouted, their numbers no less than those coming from the front.
This part of the collection on *.
The three streams of tunneling lights, like broken dam floods, directly charged into the armies led by Xi Zheng, Ni Mu, and the Evil Eye Venerable!
The already perturbed three groups of the Wu Yue Sect's army, some of whom were already fearful, saw their morale plummet further despite Xi Zheng exposing the trickery of the Cloud Desolate Alliance.
The three groups were thrown into disarray, appearing on the brink of complete collapse.
Atop the black hall deep within the Wu Yue Sect, a figure flickered. The Nine Yin Venerable abruptly appeared and, without saying a word, raised his hand and pinched out a spell.
Dense purple runes immediately emerged, flickering on and off on the surface beneath the black hall, appearing mysteriously exceptional.
As the Nine Yin Venerable lifted both hands, several spells flashed and disappeared into various parts of the hall.
The black hall trembled, suddenly emitting unceasing hums as countless large runes surged out from everywhere, exploding and transforming into rolling Black Mist. Within moments, a sea of black fog formed, engulfing the Nine Yin Venerable, whose figure appeared intermittently within the fog.
Changing the spell with his hands, the Nine Yin Venerable opened his mouth and spewed out a mouthful of Essence Blood. It gathered in front of him into an egg-sized blood mass that spun silently, then noiselessly shattered into a puff of Blood Mist blending into the surrounding fog.
The originally pitch-black sea of fog surged with Blood Light and started contracting around the Nine Yin Venerable as the center, becoming denser and soon solidifying into a black sphere about a yard in size.
No sooner had the black sphere formed than it shot out towards the battlefield. It quickly positioned itself above both armies.
"Not good!" In a location among the Cloud Desolate Alliance forces, Tianyinzi muttered under his breath.
But before he could react, with a "boom," the black sphere erupted into a deafening explosion, and rolling Black Mist instantly obscured the sky. Like black clouds, it engulfed the three groups from the Wu Yue Sect as well as the Cloud Desolate Alliance's cultivators.
Almost without time to react, everyone felt darkness before their eyes, falling into a black haze where they couldn't see the person next to them, nor could they distinguish north, south, east, or west.
"An illusion technique..." Seeing this, Tianyinzi quickly pulled out a Golden Giant Bell Magic Treasure. He activated his Mana and injected his Divine Sense into it.
Dong...
Huge sound waves spread out, containing not only immense Mana but also powerful Divine Soul Power. Wherever the sound waves passed, the black clouds quickly thinned.
At the same time, other Nascent Soul cultivators also exhibited their Divine Skills, attempting to dispel the black cloud illusion.
Although the black cloud illusion had an extremely wide range of attack, its power was not strong. It was soon completely dispersed, and everyone regained their senses.
The cultivators from both sides mingled closely, many standing less than three feet apart.
Without anyone instructing them, a thunderous cry of battle erupted, and the cultivators from both sides clashed furiously, numerous shards of flesh and blood raining down.
In such a disorganized melee devoid of tactics, neither the Cloud Desolate Alliance nor the Wu Yue Sect could accept it. While commanding the battle, they also ordered their respective cultivators to form formations and stabilize their positions for combat.
However, the two parties were completely locked in deadly combat, the situation entirely chaotic, making it difficult to separate. Piercing cries of the dying echoed continuously, and cultivators from both sides rapidly perished.
Far away, the Nine Yin Venerable not only did not help, but looked on at the scene with a smile.
The black palace beneath the Nine Yin Venerable now lay on the ground, emitting streams of black mist from the black walls. These merged onto the ground, extending underneath the battlefield.
The Divine Souls of the fallen cultivators, originally drifting about, now all flew downwards, merging into the dark mist beneath the ground, gathering towards the black palace.
Just at this moment, barely visible black ripples suddenly appeared underground, also extending from afar.
Underground at a distance from the battlefield, Silver Kong and the clone of Xi Ying, transformed into the White Bone Venerable, hid in this place.
The clone of Xi Ying raised a black kettle, the very Soul Suppressing Kettle, its dense black light engulfing this underground space.
The Soul Suppressing Pearl rapidly spun, stirring the black light within the space into a huge vortex and emitting black ripples outward, exerting a pulling force.
This was another Divine Skill of the Soul Suppressing Kettle besides Refining Souls, called Gathering Yin and Soul Collection, capable of collecting scattered Divine Souls over a large area.
The soul collection effect of the black ripples was clearly superior to that of the black palace, with the majority of Divine Souls being drawn in, flying into the Soul Suppressing Kettle which quickly filled up from being empty.
"Coming here to collect Divine Souls turned out to be the right choice," murmured the clone of Xi Ying.
"Hehe, congratulations to the master, this time you really reaped the rewards without effort," laughed Silver Kong Tree Demon.
"It's a mix of joy and worry. I've already activated the Soul Suppressing Kettle; I'll leave it to you to operate it from now. If there's any danger, immediately flee with it, without any hesitation," instructed the clone of Xi Ying as she dispersed the spell from her hands to Silver Kong Tree Demon.
Without the spell, the black light around the Soul Suppressing Kettle dimmed, and the speed of the black vortex's rotation also began to slow.
"Master, why is this?" Silver Kong Tree Demon hurriedly took over, stabilizing the situation of the Soul Suppressing Kettle.
"Just in case," said the clone of Xi Ying expressionlessly.
The clone of Xi Ying had just sensed another force collecting Divine Souls, coming from deep within the Wu Yue Sect army. If she guessed correctly, this was done by the Wu Yue God.
The clone of Xi Ying recited the mnemonic, her body swiftly becoming invisible, utilizing the Void Transformation Technique.
She flew upward, soon reaching the ground, looking towards the direction of the battlefield.
The cultivators of the Wu Yue Sect and the Cloud Desolate Alliance were still in a chaotic battle, with heavy losses on both sides.
The Xi Family was at the heart of the battlefield, with more fallen individuals than the armies led by Ni Mu and the Evil Eye Venerable.
The clone of Xi Ying's lips were tightly pressed, her face showing a complex expression.
However, she bit her lip and looked away.
Her father was stubborn by nature; he would not change his mind and leave the perilous Wu Yue Sect unless he experienced profound pain.
The Divine Souls scattered on the battlefield were being collected in large numbers, and Wu Yue God soon noticed the anomaly.
However, he was currently performing a secret technique to heal himself, and his Divine Soul could not travel too far from the black palace.
"Someone is stealing souls, probably at this location; the aura is somewhat familiar… Go and retrieve their soul-collecting Magic Treasure for me!" Wu Yue God's voice resounded in the Sea of Consciousness of the Nine Yin Venerable.
Taken aback by the words, the Nine Yin Venerable looked in the direction indicated by Wu Yue God, his figure blurring and vanishing.
The clone of Xi Ying kept a close watch on the battlefield while sensing the Divine Souls within the Soul Suppressing Kettle, which quickly numbered in the hundreds.
Although mostly these were weak Divine Souls from Qi Refinement Realm and Foundation Establishment Cultivators, with few from Core Formation Cultivators, small amounts added up. Fully refining them would significantly increase her Soul Power.
"Gathering so many Divine Souls should be nearly sufficient…" the clone of Xi Ying thought to herself.
Just at that moment, a chilling coldness surged in her heart, as if she was being targeted by an ancient beast, causing all the hairs on her body to stand on end; she somersaulted and flew to the side.
Several black lines brushed past her back, slicing her clothes into several slits.
The Nine Yin Venerable had appeared behind her at some unknown time, his face showing a look of astonishment.
"White Bone? No, you're not White Bone, merely using her Mana and Divine Soul. Such a strange method; who are you really?" the Nine Yin Venerable scrutinized the clone of Xi Ying, asking.
Without any hesitation, the clone of Xi Ying dived into the ground, flying in the opposite direction of where Silver Kong was located in the underground space.
"Quite the intelligent one, but do you think you can escape by burrowing into the ground?" the Nine Yin Venerable smirked coldly, his figure blurring as he vanished from the spot.
The clone of Xi Ying quickly dove deeper into the ground, groaning as she spat out a mouthful of blood.
Although she had not been hit by those black beams, the bizarre force within them had penetrated her body. Even the Blood Puppet Armor could not defend against it, severely injuring her internal organs and damaging her Divine Soul.
Fortunately, this White Bone Venerable was manifested from Blood Puppet Armor, not a genuine flesh-and-blood body; otherwise, she would have already fallen and been unable to get up.
The clone of Xi Ying activated the Blood Puppet Armor to heal her injuries, meanwhile taking out a Green Spirit Communication Talisman, quickly speaking a few words before she crushed it without any hesitation.

chapters.title: Chapter 705 - 676: Black Incense to the Rescue
chapters.content:
Though time seemed to slow, the Nine Yin Venerable appeared out of thin air ahead, launching several beams of black light from his sleeves that struck the Green Spirit Communication Talisman, revealing they were in fact Black Needles.
The Black Needles, five inches long and slenderly sharp, shimmered with a captivating Divine Soul aura, each with a black thread connected to its tail end.
Although the Black Needles were exceedingly fast, they were unfortunately a moment too late; the Green Spirit Communication Talisman had already disintegrated into specks of green light and dispersed.
Striking the Xi Ying Clone in the chest, the Black Needles easily penetrated through, raising puffs of Blood Mist.
The black threads on the tails of the needles wrapped around her, in an instant enveloping her in several layers, seemingly about to entrap her completely.
However, the Xi Ying Clone suddenly transformed into a stone about a yard high as her actual figure appeared dozens of yards away, utilizing Yuan Ming's Six Jia Qimen Divine Ability.
Once again the Xi Ying Clone spat out a mouthful of fresh blood, her eyes conveying an unusually pained expression, still straining to activate the Blood Puppet Armor.
A layer of Blood Light illuminated her figure, yet she turned into a Blood Shadow, continuing her escape towards the distance.
With a mere flick of his fingers, the Nine Yin Venerable summoned the Black Needles back to his sleeve, his eyes revealing a look of surprise.
His Sky Bright Needle was not an ordinary treasure, but a painstakingly crafted imitation of a Spiritual Treasure, constantly enhanced over the years with various precious materials, its power nearly rivaling that of a true Spiritual Treasure.
Furthermore, the Sky Bright Needle attacked not only the physical body but the Divine Soul as well. The fact that this person endured its strike twice and seemed virtually unharmed was astonishing.
"This person appears not to be a normal Cultivator, but rather something like a Puppet..." the Nine Yin Venerable pondered in silence, electing not to pursue the Xi Ying Clone any further; after all, his mission from the Wu Yue God was to recover the soul collection item.
The Nine Yin Venerable's form flickered with black light and once again vanished, transforming into a dark silhouette speeding ahead.
Though his Escape Technique was profound, it was considerably affected underground, and it was no longer traceless; a vague shadow could be discerned.
The Xi Ying Clone shivered as the Nine Yin Venerable's fleeing direction was precisely where the Silver Kong Tree Demon was located.
She hastily set off in that direction too, her Divine Sense sending a message to Silver Kong to pack up the Soul Suppressing Kettle and leave.
The Silver Kong Tree Demon had already sensed the clash between the Xi Ying Clone and the Nine Yin Venerable, and being already on edge, he heaved a sigh of relief upon receiving the Xi Ying Clone's message, quickly retracting the Soul Suppressing Kettle and melting into the void.
No sooner had his figure disappeared than several Black Needles shot out from the void, harshly striking where he had been standing.
The Nine Yin Venerable emerged, his expression fluctuating unpredictably.
...
Deep beneath the Black Wind Desert, a flicker of green light indicated the appearance of a second Green Spirit Communication Talisman beside Yuan Ming.
He crushed it without hesitation, and a stream of information flowed into his Sea of Consciousness.
"Nine Yin Venerable, Wu Yue God, soul collection..." Yuan Ming muttered to himself, pulling out a Silver Token as he unfolded a silver barrier around him, protecting his body.
He summoned the Stealing Heaven Tripod and took out a black incense tinged with a trace of green—the Black Incense.
This was a Black Incense capable of controlling another's actions, now incorporating a component acquired from Red Leaf Island, the Green Phoenix Pine.
In this period, Yuan Ming had tested the inclusion of Green Phoenix Pine and confirmed it did not affect the control over others while significantly extending the Black Incense's burning duration to half an hour.
Yuan Ming lit the Black Incense, recalling the Evil Eye Venerable's appearance, and inserted it into the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
The Xi Ying Clone's brief message had succinctly described the situation over there.
The situation was critical, and possessing the Nine Yin Venerable would yield the optimal effect.
However, unable to identify the Nine Yin Venerable by appearance and therefore unable to possess him with the Black Incense, he had no choice but to settle for a secondary target—the Evil Eye Venerable.
Yuan Ming's vision darkened, and by the time it cleared, he had already taken possession of the Evil Eye Venerable's body.
At that moment, the Evil Eye Venerable was engaged in combat with Tianyinzi.
Tianyinzi manipulated the same Golden Giant Bell he had used previously, along with a Green Flute, a Blue Pipa, a Red Konghou, and a Yellow Drum.
With the exception of the Golden Giant Bell suspended above his head, the other four treasures were positioned at Tianyinzi's sides.
Each instrument emitted different Sound Waves, some grand and magnificent, others gentle as water, all imbued with attacks on the Divine Soul, assailing from all directions.
The Evil Eye Venerable, not utilizing any treasures, released seven or eight differently shaped Divine Soul Transformations—lions, tigers, snakes, scorpions—all exhibiting various Soul Cultivation Divine Powers to engage with Tianyinzi's treasures in a tense exchange.
However, at the instant of Yuan Ming's possession, the consciousness of the Evil Eye Venerable sank into oblivion, and the movements of the Divine Soul Transformations became sluggish with no longer any attacks being launched.
Although Yuan Ming could control the possessed individual's Mana, he was unable to use the other's Divine Soul Power.
Tianyinzi immediately noticed the anomaly from the Evil Eye Venerable and quickly performed hand signs, pointing towards the Golden Bell above his head.
The Golden Giant Bell suddenly enlarged many times over, shooting forward rapidly to envelop the several Divine Soul Transformations within it.
Clang!
With a tremendous sound, the Divine Soul Transformations inside were all shattered to pieces.
Yuan Ming paid no heed, instead turning and flying off into the distance, vanishing from the chaotic battlefield in the blink of an eye.
Tianyinzi, taken aback by the sudden retreat, did not pursue but instead slaughtered the remaining Divine Soul Transformations, then dived into the melee against other Wu Yue Sect Cultivators.
After Yuan Ming, who was controlling the Evil Eye Venerable, completely got rid of Tianyinzi's pursuit, he found an empty space and burrowed underground, heading straight for the location of Xi Ying Clone.
The divine abilities of Nine Yin Venerable were astonishing, and the situation of Xi Ying Clone was precarious. He needed to get there to help as soon as possible.
As he flew his escape technique, he was also inspecting the physical body and storage bag of the Evil Eye Venerable.
"Eh, what is this?" Yuan Ming's face showed surprise.
Inside the Dantian of the Evil Eye Venerable were three black jade tokens, each surrounded by Blood Light, condensing into three tiny blood-colored figures. Each figure possessed clear facial features and appeared lifelike, as though they were living people.
Of the three figures, one looked exactly like Luo Yongqi from the Senluo Sect; the other two, a black-bearded man and a red-dressed young woman, were strangers to him.
"Could this be the Primordial Spirit Token?" Yuan Ming speculated in his mind.
He had learned of such items from Xi Ying; these were means by which the Wu Yue Sect controlled others, by infusing their Essence Blood into the token to gain complete control over the person's life and death.
Yuan Ming circulated his mana and injected it into the three Primordial Spirit Tokens.
On the battlefield above, Luo Yongqi, the black-bearded man, and the red-dressed young woman all shook violently, their faces showing intense pain.
The next instant, the three also used techniques to burrow into the ground and followed Yuan Ming as he flew towards the surface.
"It really is the Primordial Spirit Token." With a bright look in his eyes, Yuan Ming accelerated his tunneling speed through the sensing of Luo Yongqi and the others' statuses via the Primordial Spirit Token.
Having these three people to assist put him at a slightly better advantage in facing the Nine Yin Venerable.
Even though their progress was somewhat slowed by the underground terrain, the group rapidly left the battlefield, urgently heading towards Xi Ying Clone's location.
Meanwhile, at another place underground, Xi Ying Clone and the Silver Kong Tree Demon were battling fiercely against the Nine Yin Venerable.
Xi Ying Clone was enveloped in a dazzling yellow glow, a result of the Taiyin Refining Spleen Technique.
Around the clone's center, the Earth Core Primordial Magnetism twisted, forming a strange gravitational field, where anyone entering it felt like they were trapped in a vast quagmire, impeding their movement.
Drum-sized Earth God Thunders emerged from the ground, targeting the Nine Yin Venerable one after another.
Meanwhile, the Silver Kong Tree Demon sporadically appeared and vanished within the void around the Nine Yin Venerable, coordinating with Xi Ying Clone's attacks.
However, no matter how fiercely Xi Ying Clone and Silver Kong attacked, they couldn't touch the Nine Yin Venerable, whose movements were ghostlike and seemingly unaffected by the Earth Core Primordial Magnetism.
On the contrary, the Black Needles of the Nine Yin Venerable shot out like a viper's tongue, hitting their target with unerring accuracy.
Xi Ying Clone was injured in many places, appearing increasingly feeble.
Thanks to its Space Escape Technique, the Silver Kong Tree Demon wasn't hit by the Black Needles but found opportunities to launch attacks becoming exceedingly rare.
"The Nine Yin Venerable is truly formidable!" Yuan Ming inwardly exclaimed, scrambling for a strategy.
Feeling the approach of "Evil Eye Venerable" and the others, the Nine Yin Venerable's eyebrows knit together. He temporarily ceased his assault and retreated a hundred zhang, positioning himself near the newly arrived "Evil Eye Venerable" and company.
"Evil Eye, why have you brought people here? Our sect is currently clashing with the Cloud Desolate Alliance. Return to assist them immediately!" The Nine Yin Venerable glanced at "Evil Eye Venerable" and Luo Yongqi's trio, his tone clearly displeased.
Luo Yongqi and the others were also somewhat confused; lowering their heads under the Nine Yin Venerable's scrutiny, they dared not meet his gaze.
"Heh heh, does the Nine Yin Venerable think so little of me? The Wu Yue God requires Divine Soul nourishment, and the current chaos is exactly what He desires. If I were to repel the people of the Cloud Desolate Alliance, I fear it would trouble the Wu Yue God," "Evil Eye Venerable" laughed.
A flicker of surprise crossed the Nine Yin Venerable's eyes. He hadn't told anyone about Wu Yue God's plans, yet this Evil Eye Venerable had guessed it right. It seemed he had underestimated him before.
"Moreover, I recognize this woman and know a bit about her divine abilities," "Evil Eye Venerable" said, looking towards the white-dressed woman nearby who was on her guard.The latest chapters are uploaded first on *.
"Oh, who is this person?" the Nine Yin Venerable asked with a slightly serious expression.
"She is..." "Evil Eye Venerable" moved closer to the Nine Yin Venerable.
A huge black Sharp Claw Treasure, the size of a millstone and seemingly refined from the claw of a demon beast, emerged out of thin air, viciously clawing towards the Nine Yin Venerable's chest.
"Are you insane, Evil Eye!" The Nine Yin Venerable's voice turned cold as he quickly backed away.
His speed was ghostly, and even without any preparation for the Evil Eye Venerable's attack, he still managed to create a gap of several zhang instantly.
"Space Folding!" Silver Kong stretched out both hands, grabbing at the void towards the Nine Yin Venerable as if kneading dough.
The space between Yuan Ming and the Nine Yin Venerable suddenly twisted and folded, bringing the Nine Yin Venerable who had moved away instantly back to his original position.
The black Sharp Claw Treasure, carrying a ferocious and evil wind, harshly struck the Nine Yin Venerable in the chest.
A series of cracking sounds, the noise of breaking bones, reverberated as the chest of the Nine Yin Venerable caved in, with an unknown number of bones shattered, and blood spurting violently.
His face mask also flew off from the impact, revealing a strange face that was a mix of both yin and yang features.
Yuan Ming looked at the Nine Yin Venerable's face, committing his features to memory.
Seeing this, Luo Yongqi's trio was shocked, clearly unaware of what had transpired, not understanding why the two Venerables had suddenly started fighting.
Moments later, the voice of "Evil Eye Venerable" rang in the trio's ears: "You three don't just stand there. Attack the Nine Yin Venerable with all your might, or I will immediately crush your Primordial Spirit Tokens!"
The expressions of Luo Yongqi's trio changed rapidly. After exchanging looks, they each brought out their magic treasures, and for a moment, streams of rainbow light and the glint of weapons surged toward the Nine Yin Venerable.

chapters.title: Chapter 706 - 677: Another Approach
chapters.content:
"You're courting death!" roared the Nine Yin Venerable, rage soaring in his heart. With a low growl, his hands formed a strange seal.
His entire body radiated a dense, ink-like black light that flowed up and down like water. Upon closer scrutiny, many fine black threads were mixed within it.
These threads, fine as hairs, continually shot out from the black light, disappearing into the void in the blink of an eye, leaving no trace.
"Be careful!" The Xi Ying Clone's figure flew backward, the Blood Puppet Armor on his body bursting with blood light, wrapping around him in layers.
On the other side, the Silver Kong Tree Demon's surface flashed with silver light as it directly escaped into the void.
Seeing this, the "Evil Eye Venerable" possessed by Yuan Ming did not retreat but advanced, continuing to pounce toward the Nine Yin Venerable. In an instant, he was less than thirty feet away from him.
From his sleeves flashed spirit light, as several magic treasures shot out, emitting dazzling rays of light, striking fiercely towards the Nine Yin Venerable.
Luo Yongqi and the other two, seeing the "Evil Eye Venerable" charging forward, dared not retreat, yet neither did they dare to advance, so they stood in place manipulating their magic treasures to attack.
For a time, booming noises erupted. No fewer than seven or eight magic treasures from different directions simultaneously aimed at the Nine Yin Venerable. Various colored lights interwove mid-air, illuminating this area with blinding radiance.
However, at that moment, the trio's bodies suddenly stiffened, as if filled with lead, unable to move even a finger.
They couldn't mobilize their mana or soul power at all, and the magic treasures they had summoned also stalled, then began to fall with diminished spirit light.
The "Evil Eye Venerable's" body also stiffened in place, unable to move. The magic treasures he summoned naturally lost control, but his divine soul was unaffected, while it seemed as though the Evil Eye Venerable's divine soul was frozen in place just like he was.
"It seems I am not affected by the Nine Yin Venerable through possessing this body via the Stealing Heaven Tripod..." Yuan Ming thought to himself, activating his divine sense to probe the condition of the Evil Eye Venerable.
Many black threads, difficult to detect, had appeared within the divine soul of the Evil Eye Venerable at some unknown time, extending outward. It was unclear whether they had permeated from the outside or were emitted by the divine soul of the Evil Eye Venerable himself.
In short, the divine soul of the Evil Eye Venerable had become like a puppet on strings, completely controlled.
As for the body and mana of the Evil Eye Venerable, they were also controlled by these black threads.
While pondering, Yuan Ming tried to mobilize all his soul power to assault the black threads that restrained the body and mana of the Evil Eye Venerable.
Meanwhile, the Nine Yin Venerable brushed his hand across his chest as countless fine threads appeared on his broken bones, flesh, and even internal organs, rapidly merging together and healing.
The previously concave chest swelled rapidly, and within a few breaths, it had returned to its original condition, as if he had never been injured.
His gaze swept over the immobilized "Evil Eye Venerable" and Luo Yongqi and the others, then he shifted his eyes away.
Those restrained by his Nine Yin black threads would be unable to break free for at least half a month.
"Now only you remain, how do you wish to die?" the Nine Yin Venerable asked, looking toward the Xi Ying Clone who had retreated a great distance, as he floated forward.
The Xi Ying Clone did not hesitate, turning and fleeing into the distance, disappearing in an instant.
The eyes of the Nine Yin Venerable flickered slightly, not pursuing, and he let out a quiet sigh of relief.
Although the wound on his chest had been healed, the Black Claw Treasure wielded by the Evil Eye Venerable contained a bizarrely potent poison that had already seeped into his internal organs.
On the surface, the Nine Yin Venerable seemed unharmed, but in reality, his combat power was reduced to less than thirty percent. He had no choice but to bluff and scare away the Xi Ying Clone.
"I was really careless..." he muttered to himself, then took a deep breath and mobilized his profound mana to suppress the intrusion of the strange poison while gesturing with his hand.
The immobile "Evil Eye Venerable" flew towards him and landed by his side.
The Nine Yin Venerable pressed his palm against the head of the "Evil Eye Venerable", activating the Soul Searching Divine Ability to examine his memories.
However, with a soft "puff", the Nine Yin Venerable's abdomen was pierced through by an arm, a bloody hand emerging from behind, the deed of the immobilized "Evil Eye Venerable."
"How is this possible!" The expression on the Nine Yin Venerable's face was one of complete disbelief.
The "Evil Eye Venerable" also had his eyes wide in shock, showing an astonished expression.
Using divine soul power, he had barely managed to break the black threads on his right arm. He had been gearing up for this attack for a long time, hoping to take advantage of the Nine Yin Venerable's distraction to kill his Nascent Soul in one fell swoop.
But there was nothing inside the Nine Yin Venerable's Dantian, not even a Nascent Soul!
The "Evil Eye Venerable" moved his arm as if to do something, but the Nine Yin Venerable, finally reacting, roared furiously, spitting out several Black Needles aimed at the "Evil Eye Venerable's" head.
Under Yuan Ming's control, the "Evil Eye Venerable", except for his right hand, was still controlled by countless black lines and couldn't move. He had no choice but to summon a small amount of recently restored mana to bring forth a Bronze Round Shield to block the Black Needles.
Yet, the Black Needles turned shadow-like and penetrated the Bronze Round Shield, entering the "Evil Eye Venerable's" forehead.
A terrifyingly sharp Qi Force burst from within the Black Needle, similar to the Soul Destroying Sword Energy, but even more fierce, easily shredding the "Evil Eye Venerable's" divine soul.
Yuan Ming felt darkness before his eyes as the possession abruptly ended, and his consciousness returned to his original body.
He was about to stand up when overwhelming agony swept over him, his Nascent Soul within him suddenly tore apart, rapidly disintegrating, appearing as if he was about to have his soul shattered just like the Evil Eye Venerable.
It was the shared damage from Black Incense Possession!
Yuan Ming clasped his head with both hands, enduring the severe pain with all his might, and summoned the Night Parade of Hundred Demons.
The blurry image of the Heavenly Ghost Wanderer emerged from the chart, placing a single hand on Yuan Ming and activating the Divine Soul Transformation Three-Eyed Soul Pigeon's Substitution Divine Ability.
With a soft "bang," one of the Heavenly Ghost Wanderer's Sea of Consciousness's Three-eyed Soul Doves burst apart.
The collapsing momentum of Yuan Ming's Divine Soul dissipated, but only by a large margin, not fully substituting all the damage like before.
Although he couldn't substitute all the damage, he had managed to gather his strength, operating the Moonlight Technique at full force, attempting to collect his dispersing Divine Soul.
Meanwhile, the roots of the Undying Tree within his Dantian frenziedly grew and entwined around his Nascent Soul, wrapping layer upon layer, firmly enveloping his Nascent Soul.
The Undying Tree infused demon energy into the Nascent Soul, and billowing Undying Black Fog surged out, aiding him in stabilizing his Divine Soul.
After a long while, Yuan Ming opened his eyes, the power of his Nascent Soul's Divine Soul was mostly stabilized.
Yuan Ming looked at the Heavenly Ghost Wanderer and furrowed his brows slightly.
Ever since learning that injuries inflicted upon hosts during Black Incense possession would be returned to himself, he had been contemplating a solution, and, after much thought, decided to rely on the Substitution Ability of the Heavenly Ghost Wanderer.
The main reason why he had dared to manipulate the Evil Eye Venerable into reckless attacks was his reliance on the Heavenly Ghost Wanderer's Substitution Ability.
Only, it turned out that the Substitution Ability wasn't as effective as he had imagined, only substituting a large portion of the damage.
"Could it be that as my Cultivation grows higher, the gap between myself and the Heavenly Ghost Wanderer grows wider, and the efficacy of the Substitution Ability begins to wane? It seems that in the future, I must be even more cautious when using Black Incense on others," Yuan Ming muttered to himself.
Solving this problem might only be possible by enhancing the Heavenly Ghost Wanderer's strength.
However, the Heavenly Ghost Wanderer had been refined into a Ghost Slave and was not a living person anymore, so he probably couldn't do anything about it.
"To enhance the Heavenly Ghost Wanderer, others might not be able to, but you can," Fellow Daoist Qi Ye's voice suddenly sounded.
"How so?" Yuan Ming waved his hand, calling forth the Shura Blood Devouring Map, and asked.
"The Night Parade of Hundred Demons was refined by the Shura Master imitating the Shura Blood Devouring Map. This map has not completely wiped out the vitality of the Ghost Slaves; if you can find them a healthy, vibrant body for possession, it's not to say they will completely become a normal Divine Soul, but they can regain some vitality. The Heavenly Ghost Wanderer was originally at the pinnacle of a Soul Cultivator for love witches, with your resources on Divine Souls, it should not be difficult to promote them to Sleeping Witch Realm," Qi Ye said.
"This method seems feasible; when you speak of a body full of vitality, could it be you mean the Undead Tree Puppets?" Yuan Ming thought for a moment and spoke.
"Exactly, the Undead Tree harbors unimaginable vitality, and only an Undead Tree Puppet can restore a Ghost Slave," Qi Ye said.
"Thanks for the guidance, Fellow Daoist Qi Ye," Yuan Ming nodded slightly, expressing his gratitude with a bow.
"It's a trivial matter, not worth mentioning," Qi Ye laughed, but inwardly he was secretly pleased.
Because of his previous mistake, Yuan Ming had lost Elder San Jue as a Returning Void assistant. Yuan Ming hadn't said anything, but the trust between them had noticeably cooled off. After his efforts over this period, their relationship seemed to have mended somewhat.
Yuan Ming fell into deep thought; Qi Ye's method was worth a try, but he didn't have an Undead Tree Puppet at hand and needed to refine one first.Catch the formatted version at *.
He put away the Shura Blood Devouring Map and the Night Parade of Hundred Demons, took out a Green Spirit Communication Talisman, and once again contacted his Xi Ying Clone for an update on the situation.
Xi Ying Clone quickly responded that the Nine Yin Venerable had already left, and she was continuing to collect Divine Souls from the battlefield with Yinkong.
"The Nine Yin Venerable has left?" Yuan Ming was quite surprised.
At their level of Cultivation, physical injuries were insignificant. Even if limbs were lost or the heart gouged out, as long as the person wasn't dead, various Spiritual Medicines and secret techniques could be used, and recovery wasn't particularly difficult.
As the leader of the Six Venerables of the Wu Yue Sect, the Nine Yin Venerable surely had access to potent medicines and methods to recover his Physical Body. His own Black Silk Divine Ability even had the power to heal physical injuries, so why would he suddenly retreat?
Could the Evil Eye Venerable's Black Claw Treasure have additional effects apart from its powerful attack?
Yuan Ming pondered for a while, then decided not to rack his brains pointlessly. He took out another Green Spirit Communication Talisman, reminding his Xi Ying Clone to be careful. Given that the Stealing Heaven Tripod needed time to recover, he wouldn't be able to assist with possession again in the short term.
After taking care of all this, he sat down cross-legged.
His recent possession had been very fruitful. Not only had he severely wounded the Nine Yin Venerable, but he had also eliminated the Evil Eye Venerable. Controlling the host with Black Incense proved even more useful than he had anticipated.
As long as the enemy's appearance was known, they were almost certainly doomed!
The only regret was that the damage incurred after possession would return to him.
"No, the Heavenly Ghost Wanderer must be rapidly enhanced in strength, or else I cannot fully wield the power of Black Incense Possession, and my future actions will be restrained," Yuan Ming stood up with resolve, collected the surrounding silver barrier, and left the underground with Vajra.
He flew into the sky and quickly determined his location, then headed straight for a nearby underground city.

chapters.title: Chapter 707 - 678 Commitment
chapters.content:
In the Brown-red Mountain Range of Zhao Country, the major battle between the Wu Yue Sect and the Cloud Desolate Alliance had finally come to a close, with both parties retreating.
The three armies of the Cloud Desolate Alliance had now converged at a hilly area hundreds of miles away from the Brown-red Mountain Range, setting up camp to tally the losses.
Wan Tianren, Tianyinzi, and Luo Zhu all had very unpleasant looks on their faces.
In the aftermath of this chaotic battle, the Alliance had suffered heavy losses, with a full thirty percent of its cultivators fallen, and countless more injured, mostly mid and low-level cultivators.
"It is all my fault," Tianyinzi said somberly. "I thought that by using the Illusion Spirit Tree's illusion divine skills, we could confuse the members of the Wu Yue Sect, but instead, I led to our own demise. Once we return to Yuhua City, I will admit my guilt to the Alliance Hierarch."
"Fellow Daoist Tianyinzi, you mustn't blame yourself. Who could have expected the Wu Yue Sect to employ a strategy that inflicted damage to both sides?" Wan Tianren advised.
"Indeed, our losses are not small, but the Wu Yue Sect also suffered greatly. We did not come out at a disadvantage and, at the very least, we have successfully halted the Wu Yue Sect's offensive momentum," Luo Zhu added.
Hearing these words, Tianyinzi's face looked slightly better.
"This battle is inconclusive. As for our next move, I wonder if the two fellow daoists have any good suggestions," Tianyinzi inquired.
Just as Wan Tianren was about to speak, Luo Zhu raised a hand to stop him.
"Before we discuss this matter, there is something else I must bring up. During the previous battle, did either of you notice that there were also people fighting underground?" Luo Zhu inquired.
Wan Tianren, who had been fighting Xi Zheng during the battle and had been at a disadvantage the whole time, hadn't paid attention to what was happening underground and shook his head in surprise upon hearing this.
"Indeed, there were seven combatants. One side was the Nine Yin Venerable, and the six on the other side were the White Bone Venerable, Evil Eye Venerable, Luo Yongqi from the Southern Border's Senluo Sect, as well as Purple Thunder, Chi Xiao, and a Level 4 Tree Demon from the Double Immortal Sect," reported Tianyinzi with calm.
"It was them! Why would they slaughter each other? Could it be that some turmoil has occurred within the Wu Yue Sect? No, that can't be right. The White Bone Venerable has already fallen in the East Sea, so why would he reappear?" Wan Tianren interrupted with a start.
Neither Tianyinzi nor Luo Zhu could answer this question.
"What was the outcome of that battle?" asked Wan Tianren further.
"The Evil Eye Venerable was killed on the spot, and Luo Yongqi, Purple Thunder, and Chi Xiao were captured, while the White Bone Venerable and the tree demon both fled," Tianyinzi said.
"The Evil Eye Venerable has fallen! Are you certain?" Wan Tianren exclaimed with joy.
"It should be correct. I inspected it thoroughly with my divine sense; the Evil Eye Venerable indeed had no trace of life left, and his body was taken away by the Nine Yin Venerable," confirmed Tianyinzi.
"Good. Although we suffered heavy losses in this battle, the enemy is fighting among themselves, and with the fall of the Evil Eye Venerable on the battlefield, it seems our side has a slight advantage," Wan Tianren nodded.
"Fellow Daoist Luo, do you bring up this matter now because you feel the underground battle will affect our next steps?" Tianyinzi asked, looking towards Luo Zhu.
"Of course. Although we do not know the nature of the turmoil that occurred within the Wu Yue Sect that led to the venerables fighting each other, this matter cannot be overlooked. We should send this news, as well as the outcome of the battle, back to Yuhua City and ask the Alliance Hierarch and the others to help decide," Luo Zhu said.
"That would be wise," agreed Tianyinzi, and he took out a communication talisman.
...
Deep underground, far from the battlefield, a clone of Xi Ying looked at the Soul Suppressing Kettle filled to the brim with countless souls, amounting to thousands, and nodded in satisfaction.
Although most of these divine souls were from low-level cultivators, the sheer number was enough to make up for everything. So many divine souls would be sufficient for the main body's advancement.
"Master, now that we've collected enough souls, should we leave now?" asked the Silver Kong Tree Demon beside him.
"Wait a bit longer, I have something else to do." Xi Ying's clone put away the Soul Suppressing Kettle and gazed towards the Brown-red Mountain Range.
...
In the main camp of the Wu Yue Sect, within a black hall.
The Nine Yin Venerable sat cross-legged in front of a black coffin, while a body lay on the ground beside him, that of the Evil Eye Venerable.
A stream of black qi shot out from within the black coffin, like a thick black snake swaying its head and tail, entering the back of the Nine Yin Venerable before emerging again from his front.
His expression was one of pain, but he clenched his teeth and endured.
After a full quarter of an hour, the flow of black qi finally ceased, and the Nine Yin Venerable breathed a sigh of relief.
"It's done, the poison has mostly been cleared out," the voice of the Wu Yue God came from within the black coffin.
"Thank you, Wu Yue God," the Nine Yin Venerable bowed and thanked.
"Did you clearly see that the artifact used by that person to collect souls was the Soul Suppressing Kettle? And was there a Soul Suppressing Pearl embedded on it?" the Wu Yue God inquired eagerly.
"There's no mistake!" the Nine Yin Venerable asserted confidently.
"Based on your description, that person's strength is not bad, but still inferior to you. It's likely not Yuan Ming, but someone by his side," Wu Yue God deduced.
"The odds are that this is indeed the case," agreed the Nine Yin Venerable.
"Good, I thought we would have to find Yuan Ming to retrieve the Soul Suppressing Kettle, yet they have delivered this treasure right to me, and it's the complete Soul Suppressing Kettle at that. Hahaha..." Wu Yue God burst into laughter.
The Nine Yin Venerable also showed a smile.
"Nine Yin, follow my orders, pursue that person, and retrieve the Soul Suppressing Kettle. I permit you to break the seal and use the Divine Soul Transformation against the enemy!" The laughter of the Wu Yue God soon stopped, and he gave his orders sternly.
"Yes," Nine Yin Venerable answered. A complex pattern surfaced on the skin of his back, which appeared to be a sealing mark.
He immediately formed seals with his hands, and the mark swiftly began to disintegrate, completely dispersing after a few breaths.
Boom!
A vast surge of soul power erupted, and a black silhouette emerged from the seal, looking around excitedly. It occasionally let out a shrill laugh, much like that of a night owl, suggesting it was not entirely under the control of Nine Yin Venerable.
Though the shadow was formed from Divine Soul Power, the laugh was as tangible as reality, causing the entire hall to buzz with its vibrations.
"It has been so many years, and you still cannot master the soul of the Demon Crow?" Wu Yue God's displeased voice emanated from within the coffin.
"This subordinate is incompetent, please punish me," Nine Yin Venerable said with an expression of guilt.
"Forget it, the Demon Crow is not of this realm. It's understandable that it's difficult to control. Go, and bring back the Soul Suppressing Kettle within three days," Wu Yue God said indifferently.
"Yes." Nine Yin Venerable vanished in a flash, leaving the hall in utter silence.
After a long while, an intense killing intent suddenly pervaded the empty hall as if a bloodthirsty Fierce Beast had appeared, lurking in the depths of the hall and causing the air itself to freeze.
"You've come," Wu Yue God's voice came from the black coffin.
"Is everything ready?" A tall figure emerged from the darkness, enveloped in a black robe, his face obscured.
The only thing visible was a blood light glowing on his forehead, which was strikingly conspicuous in the dark.
"Everything is here." A large Storage Bag flew out from the coffin and landed in front of the tall figure, making the sound of something heavy hitting the ground.
This part of the collection on *.
The tall figure picked up the Storage Bag and swiftly nodded his head.
"Two thousand two hundred bodies, not bad. But still, these are far from enough. I ask that Venerable Wu Yue God make more arrangements to procure more complete bodies," the figure said.
"Hmph, you say that as if it's easy. Corpses of cultivators aren't so readily available. Without warfare, not to mention two thousand bodies, even two hundred would be hard to find," Wu Yue God retorted.
"Therefore, my master has provided a large quantity of resources to Venerable Wu Yue God. Otherwise, how could the Wu Yue Sect have recovered so quickly? It's just that the thirty thousand cultivator corpses you promised are yet to reach even a third," the tall figure remarked.
"The war has just begun, and gathering bodies is difficult. Tell your master that he will not be missing a single thing that this god has promised," Wu Yue God said after a moment of silence.
"Good, I shall wait a bit longer then," the tall figure reluctantly nodded and began to walk away.
"This is the body of a Late-stage Nascent Soul cultivator! The higher the cultivation of the body, the greater its value. I'll take this one with me," the tall figure stopped upon passing the body of the Evil Eye Venerable, waved his hand to collect it, and addressed the black coffin.
Wu Yue God remained silent. Seeing this, the tall figure said no more and melded into the darkness, disappearing from sight.
"Hehe..." Wu Yue God's low and cold laughter came from the coffin, echoing lightly throughout the hall.
...
Inside the Xi Family's Flying Boat, Xi Zheng stood in his room with a very unsightly expression.
After the battle, the Xi Family regrouped and counted their numbers.
As Luo Zhu and others had anticipated, the Cloud Desolate Alliance suffered heavy losses, and the Wu Yue Sect was not much better off.
The battle was too chaotic to command effectively. The Foundation Establishment and Core Formation disciples of the Xi Family had suffered heavy casualties, their combat strength reduced by as much as thirty to forty percent. There was even the loss of a Nascent Soul cultivator.
The people of the Xi Family were filled with complaints, and some were already regretting joining the Wu Yue Sect's faction.
"The first great battle has resulted in such heavy losses; if we continue at this rate, the Xi Family will be completely drained," Xi Zheng was feeling a tinge of regret at the moment.
On the table beside him lay two Storage Bags that Wu Yue God had just sent over, filled with a million Spirit Stones, several hundred elixirs, dozens of Magic Treasures, even an imitation Spiritual Treasure, and three Cultivation Technique books.
These were compensations for the Xi Family.
Xi Zheng looked at the two Storage Bags without the slightest alleviation in his expression.
The compensation was generous but could never match the loyal and diligently cultivated clan disciples. Those represented a significant investment of time and resources by the family.
Xi Zheng took a deep breath, regained his composure, and sent the two Storage Bags out for distribution among the clan members.
Regardless, it was still some consolation.
Xi Zheng soon returned and sighed before perusing the three Classics.
All three Cultivation Technique Books were Body Cultivation Methods.
Xi Zheng's eyes flickered. Directly receiving three Body Cultivation Methods showed that Wu Yue God had sensed his plans.
However, he huffed lightly, disregarding the implication and continued to comprehend them.
The first book was named Golden Bone Technique, particularly profound in bone forging. The second was called Iron Body Technique, offering formidable skin defense. The third was named Blood Battle Eighteen Hands, leaning more towards practical combat.
Xi Zheng quickly finished reading the three books and stood up to practice them slowly.
A huge force of Blood Gang Power erupted from him, expanding and intensifying with his movements, sending invisible ripples through the void around him.

chapters.title: Chapter 708 - 679: The Hidden Power
chapters.content:
"Drink!"
Xi Zheng's arm violently pulled back, and then he punched out like lightning. The power of Blood Gang burst forth, forming a blood-colored giant behind him, who likewise swung its fist in a strike.
The blood-colored fist wind swept through the entire room, grinding every item it encountered to dust, and slammed fiercely against the nearby wall.
A thick layer of blue Forbidden Light Screen emerged on the wall, trembling wildly, as numerous cracks spread across it.
"Still a bit short, it has already been more than a decade! It's always the same! Could it be that I must wait for the Wu Yue Sect to unify the Yunhuang Continent and the trend to become a reality before I can make a breakthrough in one fell swoop?" Xi Zheng slowly retracted his hand and the blood-colored giant behind him gradually dissipated as he muttered to himself.
But this was only the first battle, and the Xi Family had already suffered such great losses. If they continued to follow the Wu Yue Sect, complete annihilation of the Xi Family was also a possibility.
With this thought, his eyebrows tightly furrowed.
At this moment, a burst of white light suddenly illuminated his body, emitting a series of soft chirps.
Xi Zheng flipped his hand, and a white Round Orb appeared, flickering incessantly.
"Ying'er!" Xi Zheng's face showed a look of astonishment as he pointed at the white Round Orb.
Within the Round Orb, a burst of white light lit up, revealing the figure of a Xi Ying Clone.
"White Bone Venerable! Weren't you already fallen? That's not right, why is Ying'er's Transmission Pearl in your hands?" Xi Zheng asked with a grave voice.
"Father, do not worry, I am Xi Ying. The corpse of the White Bone Venerable fell into my hands in the East Sea, and I refined it into a Clone," said the Xi Ying Clone.
"You killed the White Bone Venerable?" Xi Zheng truly received a shock this time, glancing unconsciously around as if fearing that others might hear.
"Someone else is responsible for killing the White Bone Venerable," the Xi Ying Clone shook its head.
"Is it Yuan Ming?" A strange light flashed in Xi Zheng's eyes as he spoke.
"It seems Father is already aware of Yuan Ming's identity. Indeed, not only the White Bone Venerable, but also the Six Desires Venerable, as well as the recently fallen Evil Eye Venerable, were all slain by his hand," said the Xi Ying Clone.
"The Evil Eye Venerable has fallen too?" Hearing this, Xi Zheng's face became a mix of light and shadow.
"Father, the Wu Yue Sect has wild ambitions and merely treats us as pawns. If the Xi Family continues to follow them, a catastrophe that leads to our demise is inevitable. Please, Father, think thrice," urged the Xi Ying Clone.
"Ying'er, tell Father the truth, how strong is Yuan Ming really?" Xi Zheng looked at the Xi Ying Clone and asked.Forcharactersheetsandglossaries,visit*.
"Far surpassing your daughter, compared to the Wu Yue God, while there is still a gap, it is not much, and he is now focusing on making a breakthrough, which will happen in a matter of days," the Xi Ying Clone said.
Although he had already speculated, hearing that Yuan Ming's strength had truly reached such a realm, Xi Zheng still found it somewhat unbelievable, or perhaps he was, deep down, somewhat unwilling to accept this fact.
"Are you nearby? Why contact me at this moment, what do you intend to do?" he said after a moment of silence.
"The Wu Yue God is powerful but cruel, treating human lives as if they were worthless. Though the Wu Yue Sect may be at its zenith, its interior is fraught with dangers. With several Venerables either dead or injured, signs of decline are apparent. In contrast, the Cloud Desolate Alliance, though currently at a slight disadvantage, has rallied the power of a large part of the Yunhuang Continent, with many a talented individual and robust strength. Furthermore, with Yuan Ming and Ming Yue Sect secretly aiding them, it thrives. Comparing both sides, it's only a matter of time before the Wu Yue Sect falls again. Father, you are naturally insightful and have mastered the Heavenly Destiny Skill, adept at weighing pros and cons, and discerning the changes in the situation. Can you not see this point?" the Xi Ying Clone said.
"Of course, I am aware of that," Xi Zheng said slowly.
"If Father knows this, why not lead the Xi Family to join the Cloud Desolate Alliance? With your daughter and Yuan Ming negotiating, the alliance will surely welcome the Xi Family. As for Father's Emperor Sealing God Fist, if you could use the trend of the Wu Yue Sect unifying Yunhuang Continent for your breakthrough, you could also use the momentum of the Cloud Desolate Alliance rallying the heroes of the world to eradicate the Wu Yue Sect," the Xi Ying Clone continued to persuade.
"Ying'er, you do not understand. The method of borrowing strength for the Emperor Sealing God Fist involves one's Dao heart and macro factors. It's not something that can be changed at will. This matter requires further deliberation," Xi Zheng shook his head and said.
"Father, why use false words with your daughter? All things considered, you still favor the Wu Yue Sect," said the Xi Ying Clone.
"Indeed, Ying'er understands Father's thoughts. True, in my heart, I still favor the Wu Yue Sect," Xi Zheng said with a faint smile.
"Your daughter truly does not understand, why would you come to this conclusion?" asked the Xi Ying Clone, puzzled.
"How could I not know that the Wu Yue Sect, and even the Wu Yue God, may not achieve great things? Yet, after millennia of dormancy, the Wu Yue Sect suddenly rose rapidly in the past few hundred years, which doesn't logically add up. I sent people to investigate secretly and discovered that there is an obscured force behind the Wu Yue Sect driving things forward," said Xi Zheng after a moment of silence.
"This is indeed suspicious, but has Father found out the origin of this force?" asked the Xi Ying Clone, taken aback.
"This force acts extremely covertly; even after many years of investigation, I have found nothing. Using the Heavenly Destiny Skill to calculate, I received an eight-character prophecy: 'Heaven shall topple, Sun and Moon shall darken,'" Xi Zheng said.
Hearing this, the Xi Ying Clone was stunned, unsure of what to say.
Did this eight-character prophecy not imply that the force behind the Wu Yue Sect would engulf the world?
Having studied the Heavenly Destiny Skill for many years, Xi Zheng's insights were far deeper than Yan Siyun's, and his prophecies had never been wrong based on past experience.
The Xi Ying Clone's expression grew grave, realizing that such a force lay hidden on the Yunhuang Continent. What kind of entity were they?
Just as she was about to ask further, the urgent voice of Silver Kong suddenly reached her ears: "Master, it's not good, the Nine Yin Venerable is here again!"
After the Silver Kong Tree Demon reverted to its true body, it immersed its branches and roots into the surrounding void, constantly probing the movements around it.
Upon hearing this, the Xi Ying Clone quickly extended her Divine Sense, barely noticing a vague black shadow quickly approaching.
"Indeed, he has come!" The Xi Ying Clone did not panic, put away the white Round Orb, and began to operate the Taiyin Refining Spleen Technique.
A bright yellow light shone from her body as she swiftly dove towards the depths of the ground.
The Xi Ying Clone had no idea what kind of Escape Skill the Nine Yin Venerable employed but knew that underground, the Nine Yin Venerable would face significant constraints and that every move would leave some traces, which was why she dared to stay behind.
Silver Kong's body entered into the void, giving chase.
At a certain spot beneath the earth, the Nine Yin Venerable's face bore a cold smile as a black shadow emerged from his body, emitting astonishing Soul Power fluctuations – it was his Demon Crow, manifested from his Divine Soul. Its five fingers reached forward.
Hundreds of yards away, the head of the Xi Ying Clone buzzed as if a stick had been thrust inside it.
"This is bad... my Divine Soul... is being controlled... When did this happen..." The thoughts of the Xi Ying Clone grew sluggish, and her stealthy speed decreased.
Delight appeared on the Nine Yin Venerable's face, the soul thread controlled by the Demon Crow could only attack the enemy's Divine Soul, but the range of the soul thread's attack was far beyond what his own body could control with the black threads, and it had always been invincible.
He quickened his pace, spewing out nine Thousand Radiance Needles from his mouth, shooting towards the clone's head without holding back, clearly intending to kill her in one blow.
Just at that moment, a golden light, like Flames, suddenly shone upon the head of the Xi Ying Clone.
The soul thread connected to her Divine Soul was completely severed and burned by the Golden Flames.
The Xi Ying Clone immediately regained control over her body and without a word, dove deeper underground, easily dodging the attack of the Thousand Radiance Needles.
"Impossible!" The Nine Yin Venerable's expression shifted and he continued the pursuit.
The Xi Ying Clone kept diving and soon reached a space a thousand yards below the earth's surface.
Here, the rock began to melt, and bubbly, scorching lava could be heard everywhere.
The lava at the thousand-yard depth was entirely different from volcanic lava on the surface; its temperature was more than ten times higher, melting various underground spiritual materials, releasing many strange gases, most of which were toxic, with nature's spiritual energy in complete chaos.
The harshness of the surrounding environment was such that even Nascent Soul cultivators wouldn't be careless.
The Xi Ying Clone had no intention of stopping and plunged directly into the volcanic magma, poised to continue diving deeper.
A few breaths later, the Nine Yin Venerable's figure appeared in the underground space, looking at the volcanic magma before him, his eyebrows lifting slightly.
Was the opponent seeking death? If she truly perished in the underground lava, it would be easy for him; he could venture into it and retrieve her remnants.
However, the Nine Yin Venerable's expression quickly darkened.
Under his Divine Sense tracking, the Xi Ying Clone didn't die after diving into the underground lava; though her body was molten by the intense heat, her movement was not the slightest bit hindered, her body still radiantly aglow with yellow light as she continued to escape.
Only, she didn't continue to dive but instead headed north.
"It seems that this person is not immune to the underground lava. I want to see how long you can last in there!" the Nine Yin Venerable huffed coldly, his body emanating a surge of black Qi as he also chased northward.
...
Black Wind Desert, Fengping City.
This city was only considered mid-sized among the many underground cities of the Black Wind Desert, and its existence was due to a nearby Fire Iron Ore Vein, making it a mining city.
After the Wu Yue Sect took over the Black Wind Desert, Fengping City also fell into their control.
Following the ravages of war, the number of cultivators in Fengping City had sharply declined, leaving less than a third, most of whom were imprisoned by the Wu Yue Sect, although there were still quite a few mortals.
No matter which power occupied Fengping City, the mining of the vein would not cease; otherwise, there would be no need for the city's existence.
Near the Fire Iron Ore Vein, there stood a rather tall gray building where all the Wu Yue Sect cultivators lived, maintaining the operation of the mining field.
At this moment, within the rocky walls at the top of the underground city, a yellow light flashed, and Yuan Ming's figure emerged out of nowhere, his Divine Sense enveloping the area as he slightly furrowed his brows.
This was just a small city, and the Wu Yue Sect had only sent one Core Formation Stage cultivator to oversee it, far from what he had anticipated.
"Well, Core Formation Stage it is then," he muttered to himself, the branches of the Undying Tree within his Dantian shooting out, entering the void.
In a secret room on the top floor of the gray building, a red-faced man sat cross-legged, with a flame-like spiritual light shining from his body, exceptionally hot, the air around him distorted from being scorched.
Without a sound, a black tendril appeared out of the void in front of him and quickly stabbed towards his chest.
The red-faced man was taken aback, the red light around him surging, as he also leapt up.
However, even as his body had only just lifted halfway, the black tendril had already penetrated his lower abdomen, the Protective Spiritual Light futile.
The red-faced man's body stiffened, unable to move at all.
Shadows flickered in the secret room, and Yuan Ming's figure appeared out of nowhere, his eyes shining with two brilliant green lights, spinning rapidly.
The red-faced man looked into Yuan Ming's green lights in his eyes and his gaze quickly became muddled, as if he had lost his consciousness.
This was the Enchanting Soul Technique of Magic Practitioners, capable of temporarily controlling the minds of others, but could only be used on those far inferior in Mana.
"Without the methods of a Soul Cultivator, many things are indeed inconvenient," Yuan Ming shook his head and muttered to himself.

chapters.title: Chapter 709 - 680: Destroying the Demon Crow
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming looked at the man with the red face and started asking questions, mainly about his position within the Wu Yue Sect, and whether he had ever harmed innocent people. He received an affirmative reply.
Yuan Ming's figure rapidly expanded, and in a blink, he transformed into a huge black tree.
Broad branches and vines fell from the tree, entangling the red-faced man, quickly turning him into a large black cocoon suspended from the trunk.
Yuan Ming did not leave; he stayed right there.
In the blink of an eye, three days passed.
The black tree rapidly shrank, returning to human form in a few breaths.
The black cocoon disintegrated, with the red-faced man falling to the ground and bowing to Yuan Ming: "Master."
Yuan Ming looked the red-faced man up and down and nodded slightly.
The man was only a Core Formation Stage cultivator, so turning him into a Tree Puppet naturally didn't take much time.
Despite appearing unchanged, the man's body was filled with the vitality of the Undying Tree, and after some time to nourish him, he would be ready to attempt merging with the Heavenly Ghost Wanderer.
Yuan Ming waved his sleeve, collected the red-faced man into the Spiritual Beast Bag, and turned to walk outside.
At that moment, a silver light flashed in the secret chamber, revealing a silver figure – it was the Silver Kong Tree Demon, looking pale and gasping for breath.
"How come you're here? Has something happened over there?" Yuan Ming asked, his eyes showing a hint of movement.
"The Nine Yin Venerable has made another move, and his strength has increased dramatically all of a sudden. Neither I nor the master are a match for him! Left with no choice, the master had to hide in the magma beneath the earth, relying on the protective effects of the Blood Puppet Armor to endure, and is now hurrying here, requesting Fellow Daoist Yuan's assistance," Silver Kong said breathlessly and quickly.
"The Nine Yin Venerable! What's happening? Tell me more," Yuan Ming said, infusing a thread of Undying Tree Demon Power into Silver Kong, his expression grave.
As a Tree Demon, Silver Kong absorbed this Demonic Power and felt much better; his breathing immediately steadied.
He nodded gratefully and then detailed the situation of the Nine Yin Venerable taking action once again.
"Controlling someone's Divine Soul over hundreds of zhang away is truly formidable. That black shadow must be the Divine Soul Transformation of the Nine Yin Venerable. His strength suddenly growing so much probably has something to do with that," Yuan Ming mused.
"That's what my master believes, too. She asked me to remind you to be very careful of that shadow," Silver Kong said.
"Where is your master now?" Yuan Ming asked.
Although it was just one of Xi Ying's Clones, since it had to do with her Divine Soul, he wouldn't be stingy in offering his help.
"The underground magma is extremely hot, and even the Blood Puppet Armor cannot fully isolate the heat. The master's tunneling speed isn't fast; she has not yet entered the Black Wind Desert," Silver Kong replied.
"Leave this to me. You go back first and give her this item, with which she should lead the Nine Yin Venerable around for four more days," Yuan Ming said after a moment's thought, handing a black item to Silver Kong. It was the Fire Burning Stick he had obtained from the Three Immortals Island.
"Four days!" Silver Kong was startled, thinking that Yuan Ming was afraid of the Nine Yin Venerable, and a look of disdain flashed in his eyes.
"The temperature of the underground magma is astonishing; half of my master's Mana has already been drained. She can't endure that long! Please, Fellow Daoist Yuan, act quickly and at least allow my master to escape the Flame Purgatory and come up to the surface for a breather," he quickly reined in his emotions and pleaded.
"Give this item to Xi Ying, and she will know what to do," Yuan Ming said indifferently, rising into the air and flying up, passing through the wall and disappearing.
Silver Kong stood there stunned, then stomped his foot and merged into the Void, rushing back.
Half a day later, Silver Kong arrived at the edge of the Black Wind Desert.
As Xi Ying's spiritual beast, he had a connection with her Clone and could sense that it was rapidly approaching.
Silver Kong dove underground, silently waiting.
Above Silver Kong, in the air, a flock of black birds flew from the south, heading straight towards the Black Wind Desert.
The birds were called Black Spots; they liked the dark and feared the heat. Every summer, they would migrate in groups back to the Northern Desert, and now it was their migration time.
At that moment, the Black Spot flock suddenly changed direction and swooped downwards, crashing toward the ground.
During the dive, the bodies of these Black Spots blurred and transformed into shadows, swiftly merging into one, creating a black figure—it was indeed the Demon Crow, the Divine Soul Transformation of the Nine Yin Venerable. As soon as it touched the ground, it plunged into it, heading straight for Silver Kong underground.
Silver Kong had been hiding underground, constantly vigilant and monitoring the surroundings. When the Black Spot flock swooped down, he sensed something was wrong and immediately dove into the Void to flee using the Void Escape Technique.
"Kekeke... Can you escape?" the Demon Crow laughed strangely, pressing forward with its right hand again.
Silver Kong's head buzzed, his consciousness quickly sinking, and his form emerged from the Void.
"So that's how it attacks its enemies," said a transparent figure standing quietly in the distant underground, looking this way. It was Yuan Ming, who had used the Void Transformation Technique.
MyVirtualLibraryEmpire(*)hoststheoriginal.
Apart from his Void Escape Technique, Silver Kong's combat ability was not very strong. Worried something might go wrong with Silver Kong en route, Yuan Ming had followed all the way and was glad he did.
Yuan Ming brought out the Soul Destroying Sword, merged with the nearby shadows, while the Undying Tree Roots in his Dantian suddenly stretched and plunged into the Void.
In the Void in front of the Demon Crow, five black roots emerged, stabbing towards its body.
The aura of the Undying Tree Roots was weird, subtly restraining Soul Power; the Demon Crow didn't dare let them get close and dodged to the side.
At this moment, a dense shadow condensed before Silver Kong, and the Soul Destroying Sword emerged, slashing down through the air.
It seemed as if something was severed; Silver Kong's consciousness instantly cleared. He threw a startled glance at the Demon Crow, then at the Soul Destroying Sword, before his body once again dissolved into the void, fleeing into the distance.
The Demon Crow hurriedly raised a hand to press towards Silver Kong, but Silver Kong had already escaped far away and was unaffected.
"You're seeking death!" the Demon Crow roared in anger, turning its gaze towards where Yuan Ming was located, evidently having noticed him long ago.
The Demon Crow's body transformed into a black shadow and rushed over, reaching near Yuan Ming in an instant and transforming into a towering black beast several meters high. It opened its huge maw and viciously bit down towards Yuan Ming.
However, Yuan Ming did not pay any heed to the attacking Demon Crow; instead, he looked around himself.
His Divine Sense that he had spread around was quietly undergoing changes, with invisible fine threads emerging, casting towards the Demon Crow.
The whole process didn't produce much of an aura fluctuation, nor did it induce any Soul Wave; had he not just witnessed the entire process of the Demon Crow's attack on Silver Kong, it would've been extremely difficult to detect.
"So this is your 'thread-piercing' ability? Distracting me with a flashy performance while secretly and silently drawing out my soul threads - what a clever trick!" Yuan Ming said with a smile.
The Demon Crow did not respond at all. A layer of black light surfaced on its massive body, and the speed at which those soul threads shot over increased several-fold, about to land in its hands.
At that moment, thick Black Mist erupted from Yuan Ming's body, which was none other than the Undying Tree Black Fog.
The fine threads formed by his Divine Soul Power broke upon contact with the mist, leaving the Demon Crow grasping at nothing.
Without any hesitation, the Demon Crow turned and transformed into a black light, fleeing into the distance.
Yuan Ming slightly smiled and flipped his hand to take out a Silver Token.
The nearby void buzzed, and a silver, spherical Barrier a hundred meters in diameter appeared out of thin air, enveloping both Yuan Ming and the Demon Crow within.
The black light that the Demon Crow had transformed into slammed fiercely against the silver barrier, resulting in a loud boom.
The silver barrier shook slightly before returning to its original state, while the Demon Crow's body was bounced back, evidently surprised as it spoke, "This is ..."
"This is your grave!" Yuan Ming declared. The Soul Destroying Sword hovering in front of him shot out, reaching the Demon Crow above in an instant.
Black Sword Qi erupted, and the Soul Destroying Sword turned into a black rainbow streak, fiercely cleaving down!
Midway through its descent, the black rainbow suddenly split into ten identical black sword rainbows, crisscrossing as they slashed towards the Demon Crow's body.
The terrifying Soul Destroying Sword Energy filled the entire silver space, causing even the Barrier to tremble.
The Soul Destroying Sword Energy was especially potent against soul bodies; before the ten sword rainbows had even fallen, the Demon Crow's body was already immobilized, with wounds appearing one after another.
"Such mighty Soul Destroying Sword Energy - you are Yuan Ming!" the Demon Crow shouted fiercely.
"If your true form were here, we could have had a battle, but what a pity that you only sent a Divine Soul Clone," Yuan Ming replied, forming a hand seal and pointing.
The ten sword rainbows descended, and the oppressive might of the sword energy came with them. The already battered body of the Demon Crow was flattened and then burst open, turning into countless scattered black lights.
Yuan Ming raised an eyebrow; directly hit by the Soul Destroying Sword Energy, the Demon Crow had yet to completely disintegrate. Life force was clearly lingering within the scattered black lights, all flying towards him, apparently making a last-ditch counterattack.
Yuan Ming's gaze shifted as he activated the annihilation and Blood Frenzy Rune.
Immediately, the black lights lost their sense of direction and were thrown into disarray by the effect of the Blood Frenzy Rune.
The Yin Thunder Rune on the Soul Sword blazed brilliantly and amid the rumbling of thunder, dozens of black lightning bolts shot out, striking those black lights.
The silver Barrier also swiftly contracted at this time, compressing those scattered black lights towards the center.
"Go!" Yuan Ming pressed his hands forward, and the Undying Tree Black Fog around his body surged, drowning the silver space and absorbing the black lights.
Countless Undying Tree Roots also sprouted from within the Undying Black Fog, piercing into the black lights, devouring the Soul Power within.
A few breaths later, all the black lights had vanished completely.
"This Nine Yin Venerable doesn't seem so remarkable after all; that was taken care of quite easily," the voice of Vajra came from the Spiritual Beast Bag.
"That was only a soul splitting, its Soul Power was roughly equivalent to a love witch. That's why I could resolve it so quickly. If the Nine Yin Venerable itself had come, I'm not confident that I could have dealt with it," Yuan Ming shook his head as he spoke.
The capabilities of the Nine Yin Venerable might appear common, but they were in fact quite astonishing. Yuan Ming had personally experienced the control force of the thread-piercing Divine Skills, which was almost impossible to escape.
Yuan Ming had managed to break free earlier solely because he had been in a descended state, unnoticed by the Nine Yin Venerable.
Moreover, the soul splitting's speed of drawing soul threads just now was much slower than that of its main body. When Yuan Ming had possessed the Evil Eye Venerable, the Nine Yin Venerable had subdued him and Luo Yongqi and the others in an instant.
The thread-piercing power of the Nine Yin Venerable was undoubtedly mysterious, its only weakness being the short range, but now with Divine Soul Transformation, it could use divine abilities from several hundred meters away.
An irresistible control force, separated by several hundred meters, and able to complete the thread-piercing Divine Skills instantly...
Yuan Ming shook his head, dissipated the silver Barrier, and once again vanished into thin air using the Void Transformation Technique.

chapters.title: Chapter 710 - 681: Nascent Soul Appears in the Sea of Consciousness
chapters.content:
Hundreds of miles away in the depths of the subterranean world, the Nine Yin Venerable sensed that his Demon Crow Clone, which embodied his Divine Soul Transformation, had been killed, and his eyes immediately darkened.
"The person who just killed my soul splitting so easily is definitely not an ordinary cultivator."
Yuan Ming had remained in an invisible state and had not shown his face, and although the soul split of the Demon Crow later recognized him, the silver barrier could isolate its connection with the true body of the Nine Yin Venerable, so the Venerable was unaware that the man was Yuan Ming.
It was Yuan Ming's sudden appearance that made him feel uneasy.
The Nine Yin Venerable's mind raced with thoughts, and he suddenly turned around and flew into the subterranean magma, heading straight for the Xi Ying Clone.
The Xi Ying Clone was in very poor condition at the moment. Although its Blood Puppet Armor could block the subterranean magma, it couldn't stop the scorching heat within the magma, and the mana sealed within the armor was slowly evaporating.
After several days, the mana inside the Blood Puppet Armor had already fallen to that of the Nascent Soul Early Stage.
Although her strength had greatly diminished, the Xi Ying Clone's senses were still sharp. Sensing that the Nine Yin Venerable was steadily closing the distance, she had no choice but to clench her teeth and dive deeper into the magma at an increased pace.
Less than a thousand feet behind her, the Nine Yin Venerable sensed the Xi Ying Clone picking up speed, surrounded himself with numerous black threads, and with a blur, propelled himself forward over two hundred yards in a sudden burst, now only five to six hundred yards away from the Xi Ying Clone.
Although this divine power was quite costly for him to use and each usage required a certain interval, it allowed him to ignore terrain limitations and was extremely advantageous in pursuits and escapes.
As time went on, the Xi Ying Clone was still rapidly advancing through the subterranean magma, but could clearly feel the Nine Yin Venerable behind her steadily shortening the distance, leaving her helpless for the time being.
Accompanied by a sharp hooting laugh like that of a night owl, a black shadow silently appeared behind her and reached out to point a finger at her.
The Xi Ying Clone's vision darkened, and her consciousness once again became confused.
However, she was prepared; golden flames immediately appeared above her head, burning away the soul threads disturbing her consciousness, and she continued to flee deeper into the magma.
The deeper she went into the magma, the higher the temperature, the faster her body melted and her breath weakened at an accelerated rate.
"Very good, as long as this person's mana drops to the Core Formation Stage, they will be powerless to fight back," the Nine Yin Venerable swept a cold smile across his eyes and continued to chase forward, driving the Xi Ying Clone deeper into the magma.
The longer he stayed in this subterranean lava, the more it harmed him, but he could still endure.
The Xi Ying Clone kept diving deeper; the temperature around her rose higher, and she was no longer able to maintain her human shape. The mana was dissipating even faster, and her consciousness grew increasingly blurred.
"Is this the end? If I had known, I would have taken the risk and given the Soul Suppressing Kettle to Yinkong to carry away..." the Xi Ying Clone lamented in secret.
At that moment, both the Xi Ying Clone and the Nine Yin Venerable looked forward to see a red shadow appearing ahead, flying swiftly towards this location.
