The red shadow easily broke through the scorching layers of magma, flying with ease as if this were not the perilous depths below, but rather the open air above ground, unobstructed.
"It's that!"
The Nine Yin Venerable spread his Divine Sense, and quickly recognized the figure within the red shadow—it was the Silver Kong Tree Demon, holding a black Fire Burning Stick in its hand.
A faint red light glimmered at the core of the Fire Burning Stick, casting out strands of red light that protected Yinkong's body and effortlessly isolated the terrifying high temperatures of the subterranean magma.
"I never thought Yuan Ming would have such a Fire Resistant Exotic Treasure! No wonder he said that it would suffice to give this item to the master," Yinkong said with a joyful face, feeling ashamed for his previous bad thoughts about Yuan Ming.
"What's this? It can completely isolate the erosion of magma!" The Nine Yin Venerable also noticed the amazing power of the black Fire Burning Stick and was greatly surprised.
At this moment, he too had brought out several precious Fire Protection Treasures, but the subterranean lava was too scorching for them to be effective, unable to block even half of the intense heat.
A gloomy light flickered in the eyes of the Nine Yin Venerable. He no longer pursued the Xi Ying Clone and instead turned towards Yinkong in an attempt to block him.
Yinkong, unconcerned, turned his head and dove deeper into the magma, easily descending two to three thousand yards away from the Nine Yin Venerable, bypassing him to rush towards the Xi Ying Clone.
Lacking a Fire Resistance Treasure like the Fire Burning Stick, the Nine Yin Venerable dared not delve too deep into the magma and soon stopped reluctantly, casting a long-distance Illusion Technique.Al#w@a@ys r*ead at the s!our*c.e—^M&[email protected] $P@*YR.!
But because of certain special reasons, the Nine Yin Venerable was not proficient in Illusion Techniques, and the various auras in the subterranean magma, along with the terrible heat, greatly affected the operation of his Divine Sense, significantly weakening the effect of the Illusion Technique.
Yinkong's form only wavered slightly before he immediately broke free of the Illusion Technique and continued forward, eventually joining up with the Xi Ying Clone in a short while.
Surrounded by the red light, the intense heat around the Xi Ying Clone instantly vanished.
The Xi Ying Clone's body reformed, and as her mana ceased dissipating, she breathed a sigh of relief and said, "It's good that you arrived in time. If it were one or two hours later, I would have completely dissolved in this subterranean lava."
"This is what I should do. Oh, master, Yuan Ming had a message for you..." Yinkong repeated Yuan Ming's words.
"Stall for four days? I understand," the Xi Ying Clone said, nodding after a moment of surprise. She placed the Silver Kong Tree Demon into the Spiritual Beast Bag and urged the Fire Burning Stick to fly forward.
Seeing this, the Nine Yin Venerable's face was extremely dark.
The development of the situation had gone beyond his expectations.
And for some reason, he had a bad premonition in his heart as if continuing the pursuit might lead to unfavorable circumstances.
However, the Soul Suppressing Kettle was an artifact that the Nether Moon God had expressly ordered to be brought back; it could not be abandoned no matter what. After weighing the options repeatedly, the Nine Yin Venerable had no choice but to grit his teeth and continue to follow.
...
Yuan Ming did not linger on the fringes of the Black Wind Desert; he proceeded to the deeper parts of the desert and found a safe underground space to hide, attempting to recover the Divine Soul that had been damaged a few days earlier during the confrontation with the Evil Eye Venerable.
The Stealing Heaven Tripod quietly floated beside him, emitting a faint and soft light.
Ever since the Wu Yue Sect and the Cloud Desolate Alliance had gone to war, the situation grew increasingly tense. Guided by their own preemptive layout and the influence of scattered individuals like Xu Cheyan Siyun, more and more mortals and Cultivators began to believe in the Nether Moon God, praying for the God's blessing. Streams of enormous Desire Power began to converge like rivers flowing into the sea.
The Divine Soul and Mana within the Nascent Soul were intricately linked and of great consequence, permitting no errors. Despite having a significant amount of Desire Power readily available, Yuan Ming did not refine it.
All of the Desire Power merged into the Stealing Heaven Tripod; in just a short period, the amount of Desire Power accumulated within the White Jade Lotus Platform had already more than doubled since before.
Though the space within the White Jade Lotus Platform was not small, it seemed to be reaching saturation.
"It seems that although the Stealing Heaven Tripod is enigmatic and unpredictable, the amount of Desire Power it can hold is limited. I wonder what change will occur when it's completely filled with Desire Power?" Yuan Ming mused as he looked at the Stealing Heaven Tripod, harboring expectations in his heart.
His Divine Soul was drawn into the space of the White Jade Lotus Platform precisely because the Desire Power there had reached a certain level. If the White Jade Lotus Platform underwent another transformation, it's possible that his Divine Soul might be able to escape from its predicament.
Yuan Ming gazed at the Stealing Heaven Tripod and after a moment retracted his gaze, moving upwards through keen evasion to reach the surface.
It was night, the starry sky gleamed brilliantly, and a round moon hung in the sky, casting its pure and bright light down to earth.
Yuan Ming sat cross-legged, circulating the Moonlight Technique to absorb the power of the moonlight.
Streams of moonlight power fell and gradually merged into his Nascent Soul.
Having reached the Sleep Witch Realm, he could directly draw in the power of the moonlight to nourish his Divine Soul, the most reliable and orthodox method of advancing Soul Power.
The Divine Soul within his Nascent Soul felt as if it was soaking in cool spring water, slowly healing from its wounds.
Yuan Ming spent the nights cultivating the Moonlight Technique and during the day bitterly practiced the Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill, and in the blink of an eye, four days had passed. The buffering time for the Stealing Heaven Tripod had also elapsed.
He summoned the Stealing Heaven Tripod, took out a stick of Black Incense with descending effects, inserted it in, and recalled the face of the Nine Yin Venerable in his mind. His vision quickly faded into darkness.
In the deeper parts of the underground within the central region of the Black Wind Desert.
The Nine Yin Venerable was enveloped in a layer of yellow light, moving forward along the edge of the underground magma layer with a grim expression.
Four whole days had passed, and the Xi Ying Clone had been hiding in the depths of the underground lava, showing no intention of coming out.
During these four days, he had tried everything — luring, threatening, or even having soul splits flank and intercept yet to no avail, wracking his brain in the process.
The Xi Ying Clone was as crafty as a monkey, diving deeper into the magma whenever he got close, always narrowly escaping capture by a hair's breadth.
"This person must be deliberately leading me on, wasting my time here. Is he perhaps waiting for that guy who tried to kill my soul clone to come and help?" the Nine Yin Venerable took a deep breath, forcing himself to calm down.
If the Xi Ying Clone was indeed playing this game, it might not necessarily be a bad opportunity for him.
As long as he could capture that stealthy Cultivator, he could use him as a hostage. Even if he couldn't force the Xi Ying Clone to hand over the Soul Suppressing Kettle, the situation could take a turn for the better.
As for the prospect of being disadvantaged in a two-versus-one, the Nine Yin Venerable didn't even consider it.
Since he had acquired the Demon Crow with Divine Soul Transformation, coupled with his thread-piercing divine power, he was not afraid of facing four or five Nascent Soul Cultivators, or even a Sleeping Witch, and he even dared to contest a Returning to Void Cultivator.
Thus, in a direct confrontation, he was confident he could capture that Cultivator all at once, even if it cost him something. It was still better than wasting time like this.
The Nine Yin Venerable had a thought and was about to have the Demon Crow's soul split into a few additional soul threads to scout the surroundings.
At that moment, his eyes suddenly became vacant, and his consciousness quickly plummeted.
The Demon Crow within the Sea of Consciousness sensed the abnormality and immediately tried to resist, but a strange force invaded, effortlessly breaking through its defenses, compelling it into an almost sleep-like state.
Yuan Ming quickly regained consciousness to find himself surrounded by scorching lava, with foul odors assailing his nostrils; it seemed he had successfully possessed the Nine Yin Venerable.
His face showed delight; the Black Incense descent method was indeed powerful, so much so that even an entity like the Nine Yin Venerable could not resist it.
The Xi Ying Clone remained hidden in the depths of the underground magma, seemingly still in pursuit.
Yuan Ming circulated his Divine Sense, about to communicate with the Xi Ying Clone, when he suddenly stopped his action.
The previous possession of the Evil Eye Venerable had revealed that the Nine Yin's Dantian surprisingly lacked a Nascent Soul, a mystery he could not unravel.
Just now, as he spread his Divine Sense, he inadvertently discovered the reason behind this.
The Nascent Soul of the Nine Yin Venerable was actually within the Sea of Consciousness, in a state that was half illusory and half solid, and it was also fused with the Soul Power of the Sea of Consciousness.

chapters.title: Chapter 711 - 682: The Entire Army Strikes Out
chapters.content:
"The Nascent Soul and Soul Power have merged, and in such a form, it truly is strange," Yuan Ming marveled in amazement.
He activated his Divine Sense to communicate with the Xi Ying Clone while continuing to probe into the situation of the Nine Yin Venerable, his brows quickly raising twice in quick succession.
The Nine Yin Venerable's mana had reached the peak of the Late-stage Nascent Soul, and his Dantian was unusual, being nearly half larger than that of ordinary Nascent Soul cultivators. His mana was exceptionally thick, far surpassing that of other Late-stage Nascent Soul cultivators Yuan Ming had seen, including the Evil Eye Venerable and Xi Zheng.
Besides mana, the Divine Soul of the Nine Yin Venerable was also exceptionally powerful, especially the black shadow-like Divine Soul Transformation, which contained a terrifying amount of Soul Power, almost comparable to a Half-step Spoken Witch.
However, the Soul Power of the black shadow was very unstable, and even now, as it was submerged in a deep sleep due to the Black Incense, it still surged unconsciously from time to time as if it had not been cultivated.
After this round of investigation, Yuan Ming wore a somewhat strange expression.
There was something abnormal about every part of this Nine Yin Venerable. If not for his pure aura, Yuan Ming would have thought he was not a Human Clan's cultivator.
At that moment, the Xi Ying Clone flew over.
"Is he already subdued?" asked the Xi Ying Clone with a smile.
Previously, Yinkong relayed Yuan Ming's words, asking her to take the Nine Yin Venerable and run for four more days. She guessed that Yuan Ming planned to use the Black Incense against the Nine Yin Venerable.
"Hmm, the Black Incense is more useful than I thought. The Divine Soul of the Nine Yin Venerable is suppressed by it. Use your Soul Searching Divine Ability and see if you can find some valuable information," Yuan Ming said.
The Xi Ying Clone nodded, placed her palm on the head of the Nine Yin Venerable, and executed the Soul Searching Divine Ability.
A moment later, she retracted her arm with a somewhat disappointed look on her face.
After her exchange with Xi Zheng, what the Xi Ying Clone wanted to know most was the news behind the forces supporting the Wu Yue Sect, but unfortunately, the Nine Yin Venerable was also unaware, only knowing that indeed, someone was secretly helping the Wu Yue Sect by providing a massive amount of resources.
"What, didn't you discover any valuable information?" Yuan Ming asked upon seeing this.
"The Nine Yin Venerable's memory contains quite a lot, such as the Wu Yue Sect's next battle plans and some hidden special forces, which are greatly helpful to the Cloud Desolate Alliance," replied the Xi Ying Clone.
"These are important pieces of information, so why do you still look disappointed?" Yuan Ming asked, somewhat puzzled.
The Xi Ying Clone fell silent for a moment before carefully recounting the conversation she had with Xi Zheng on that day.
"Someone is secretly aiding the Wu Yue Sect? It's indeed quite possible, but with the barren resources of the Yunhuang Continent, is there really a power out there with such great capability to continuously provide the Wu Yue Sect with vast resources?" Yuan Ming remarked upon hearing this.
"This hidden force requires further investigation, but I found two unusual orders in the Nine Yin Venerable's memory. Both were issued suddenly by the Wu Yue God after taking over the Black Wind Desert, and no explanations were given. The first is to search for Wulu, demanding to see him alive or his body if dead, and the second is to collect complete and fresh corpses, the higher the cultivation, the better," said the Xi Ying Clone.
When Yuan Ming heard "Wulu," his heart skipped a beat, slightly puzzled as to why an existence like the Wu Yue God would set sights on Wulu, or rather, how Wulu was linked to the Wu Yue God.
"Do you think these two tasks are related to that hidden force?" Yuan Ming quickly regained his composure and asked.
"From the memory of the Nine Yin Venerable, both matters are not for the Wu Yue Sect itself, but for someone else. Given the value the Wu Yue God has placed on them and going to such lengths, other than the hidden force behind them, I can't think of any," the Xi Ying Clone replied.
"Makes sense," Yuan Ming nodded.
"We can't investigate the matter of the corpses, but Wulu is your friend. It should be easy to contact that person using Black Incense. I'll leave it to you to look into it later," the Xi Ying Clone said.
"I can do that," Yuan Ming did not refuse.
After finishing with the trivial matters, the two discussed the pressing issue at hand.
"Now that the memory search is complete, to avoid any complications, it's best to kill the Nine Yin Venerable straight away. Come on," Yuan Ming said, spreading his hands.
"If the one who descended perishes, won't your original body be hurt?" the Xi Ying Clone hesitated.
"True, but it's fine. I will use the Heavenly Ghost Wanderer's Substitution Ability to replace the damage. Just take it easy on him, do not ruin the Nine Yin Venerable's corpse—I have a use for it," Yuan Ming said.
The Xi Ying Clone nodded, her brow shone with a burst of Golden Light as a Golden Crow Soul shot out, invading the Sea of Consciousness of the Nine Yin Venerable.
As the Golden Crow Soul spread its wings, surging Golden Flames erupted forth, creating a sea of golden fire that enveloped both the Nascent Soul of the Nine Yin Venerable and the Demon Crow.
The Divine Soul within the Nascent Soul and the Soul Power of the Demon Crow burned fiercely, rapidly weakening.
Yuan Ming's vision darkened as the state of his descent began to waver, ready to be lifted at any moment.
"This kind of attack won't work. If my descended state is lifted, the Divine Soul of the Nine Yin Venerable might not perish. Use a more powerful attack!" he urgently reminded.
The Xi Ying Clone heeded the advice and formed hand seals.
The Golden Crow Soul rapidly changed shape, the golden flames quickly retracted, concentrating at a single point.
In a few breaths' time, the Golden Crow Soul transformed into a Golden Crow Rocket, bearing a strong resemblance to the Golden Crow Divine Arrow of the Three Immortals Island.
Whoosh!
The Golden Crow Rocket shot out, easily piercing through the Nine Yin Venerable's Nascent Soul and then impaling the Demon Crow's soul.
Yuan Ming's consciousness plunged into darkness, and just before losing consciousness, he heard an astounding sound of explosion and the dying scream of the Demon Crow's soul.
...
In the brown-red mountain range, within the Wu Yue Sect Camp, inside the black palace.
A crisp "snap" sounded from within the black coffin, as if something had shattered.
"Nine Yin actually... how is this possible!" The astonished and furious voice of Wu Yue God came from the coffin, shaking the black palace and the nearby ground violently, the tremors extending dozens of miles away, as if an earthquake had occurred.
The Wu Yue Sect Guards stationed nearby were shocked and turned pale, but no one dared to leave their post.
A figure flew from afar, landing in front of the black palace, it was Ni Mu.
"Wu Yue God, is there something that requires my assistance?" Ni Mu bowed towards the black palace and asked.
With Free Venerable having left the army to act alone, Evil Eye Venerable slain, and Nine Yin Venerable pursuing Xi Ying Clone, Wu Yue God had assigned Ni Mu to take charge of the army to counter the attack from the Cloud Desolate Alliance.
The Cloud Desolate Alliance's three-pronged assault had come, and after that great melee, suffered heavy losses.
However, contrary to most people's expectations, the Cloud Desolate Alliance did not retreat but instead set up camp, constructed defenses, and continued to harass the Wu Yue Sect forces, firmly holding them in place.
The Wu Yue Sect seemed unable to discern the Cloud Desolate Alliance's intentions and showed no hurry to march forward, engaging in small conflicts every day and large battles every three days, thus beginning a stalemate with the Cloud Desolate Alliance.
While the confrontations over the past few days were not as intense as the first day's great melee, both sides suffered thousands of casualties after several days of continued fighting, yet the Cloud Desolate Alliance showed no indication of withdrawing their forces.
"Send out the orders, the entire army must break camp and crush the Cloud Desolate Alliance cultivators ahead at any cost, and advance towards Yuhua City!" Wu Yue God's stern voice emanated from the hall.
This chapter was uploaded by the team at *.
Ni Mu was slightly stunned by the sudden major directive issued by Wu Yue God, but he immediately complied, summoned a messenger, and relayed the order.
Half a day later, the Wu Yue Sect's entire army set out, heading straight for the Cloud Desolate Alliance's camp.
Members of the Cloud Desolate Alliance had long since received intelligence about the unusual movement on the opposing side and had also broken camp, preparing to retreat. Faced with the full-on assault of the Wu Yue Sect army, Wan Tianren and others dared not clash head-on, sending the news back to Yuhua City while hurriedly retreating.
...
Meanwhile, Yuan Ming's consciousness had already returned to his own body, and his Nascent Soul's Divine Soul evaporated rapidly, as if also being burned by the Golden Crow Fire and was directly torn apart, nearly dissipating.
The Heavenly Ghost Wanderer had appeared long ago, placing his hand on Yuan Ming and once again using the Substitution Divine Ability.
Bang!
One of his Three-eyed Soul Doves suddenly burst, dissipating into green smoke and disappearing.
The agony in Yuan Ming's Sea of Consciousness had somewhat eased, and his Divine Soul no longer continued to tear, but the previous wounds did not vanish and still gave him a sensation that his Divine Soul was on the brink of collapse.
He quickly sat down cross-legged and began to run the Moonlight Technique to recover from the injuries.
Not long after, half a day passed, and Yuan Ming slowly stood up, his complexion slightly pallid.
Because the Divine Soul of Nine Yin Venerable was far stronger than expected, the backlash to his own Divine Soul had nearly caused him to disperse entirely. Although he had ultimately evaded it through the Substitution technique, the process was extremely perilous.
Now, while the trauma to his Divine Soul had not yet healed, it had stabilized and did not hinder his movement.
He emerged from the ground and flew toward the location of the Xi Ying Clone.
Half a day later, Yuan Ming arrived at the spot, but the Xi Ying Clone was no longer there; only Yinkong awaited him.
"Where is your master?" Yuan Ming asked with a frown.
"Reporting to Fellow Daoist Yuan, the master just received news that the Wu Yue Sect has suddenly mobilized its entire army, already repelling the Alliance's three-pronged forces, and is directly heading for Yuhua City. The master has returned to Yuhua City, she instructed me to wait here for you and to hand over this body and this treasure to you," Yinkong said respectfully, with a flick of his sleeve.
A flash of silver light, and the body of Nine Yin Venerable along with the Fire Burning Stick appeared in front of Yuan Ming.
Hearing this, Yuan Ming's expression became slightly serious.
Perhaps the fall of Nine Yin Venerable had provoked Wu Yue God, causing the Wu Yue Sect to suddenly go all out. It was uncertain whether the Cloud Desolate Alliance could withstand this, but fortunately, half of the Six Venerables of Wu Yue Sect had been eliminated, likely reducing the pressure on the Cloud Desolate Alliance a great deal.
And with Xi Ying Clone so anxious to return, she naturally wanted to transfer the collected Divine Souls to the real Xi Ying, to refine and enhance her power.
Yuan Ming looked at the body of Nine Yin Venerable, and suddenly his brows twitched.
The storage magic tool of Nine Yin Venerable was properly worn on her body, nine Sky Bright Needle magic treasures were inserted in her cuffs, and all the magic treasures and ornaments she wore were all present, not one was missing.
"Nine Yin Venerable was killed by both me and your master working together, why did she take nothing?" Yuan Ming asked.
"The master said that the death of Nine Yin Venerable was entirely your merit, so naturally, all her remaining possessions belong to you," Yinkong replied.
Hearing this, Yuan Ming did not decline any further and took the body and the Fire Burning Stick. He said to Yinkong, "Go back and tell your master that my Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill is nearing the Body of Wanxiang and requires three more months of intense cultivation. After three months, whether I've made a breakthrough or not, I will return to Central Plains to lend her my aid."
"The master already knew about this and asked me to inform Fellow Daoist Yuan not to worry. She will find a way to hold off the Wu Yue Sect. Even if Yuhua City falls, she will lead the alliance to fall back elsewhere, preserving their strength as much as possible. You should focus on your arduous cultivation," Yinkong stated.
Yuan Ming had great trust in Xi Ying's abilities. With her saying so, she must have had a great deal of confidence, and he felt somewhat relieved.

chapters.title: Chapter 712 - 683: Unexpected Gains
chapters.content:
"If there is nothing else, I will take my leave now," Yinkong bowed to Yuan Ming and turned to vanish into the void.
Yuan Ming watched him go, then left the place to find a safe spot to settle down.
He waved his hand, emitting a beam of blue light that gathered the storage magic tool and several magic treasures from the Nine Yin Venerable, quickly inspecting them.
As the leader of the Six Venerables of Wu Yue Sect, Nine Yin Venerable possessed immense wealth, countless spirit stones and spiritual materials, almost equivalent to three White Bone Venerables.
Now wealthy himself, Yuan Ming was indifferent to items like spirit stones and spiritual materials. He casually stored them away, keeping only three items: the set of Sky Bright Needles, a jade slip of black and white colors, and a blue jade scroll.
He picked up the nine Sky Bright Needles and began probing with his divine sense.
Each of these needles, adorned with twelve runes, was a replica of a spiritual treasure with astonishing penetrating power; even defensive treasures of the same rank could hardly withstand them.
Moreover, the Sky Bright Needles could temporarily transform into spiritual bodies to attack the enemy's divine soul, making them a deadly weapon.
Yuan Ming put away the set of needles and, after refining them with mana, picked up the black and white jade slip.
The jade slip recorded a cultivation technique named "Yin Yang Treasure," which was the cultivation technique practiced by Nine Yin Venerable.
He had previously glanced through the Yin Yang Treasure briefly and didn't inspect it in detail, but now with some free time, he began to read it carefully, his eyes lighting up more and more.
Long afterwards, he put down the jade slip and sighed deeply.
The content recorded in the Yin Yang Treasure was exquisitely profound, certainly not inferior to the Nine Elements Technique, and many of its odd facets even surpassed it.
In fact, this treasure was a technique for absorbing Yin Yang power to advance one's cultivation.
In the present cultivation world, the mainstream cultivation techniques for Magic Practitioners use the Five Elements Spiritual Power to enhance cultivation and strength. As for Yin Yang power, only used by soul and body cultivators, very few magic practitioners get involved with it.
However, the creator of Yin Yang Treasure genuinely deserved to be called a rare genius among magic practitioners, using his intellect to create this technique that utilizes Yin Yang power.
Once mastered, this technique greatly surpasses cultivators of the same rank in strength, particularly enhancing speed and allowing the user to sacrifice Yin Yang power to unleash various miraculous attacks.
The thread-piercing divine power of Nine Yin Venerable was derived from using Yin Yang power as its base.
But the entry-level practices of Yin Yang Treasure are extremely strict, requiring a person innately merged with Yin Yang power to cultivate it, yet such individuals are exceedingly rare.
The creator of Yin Yang Treasure, after much thought, came up with an inhumane method: castrating oneself.
Males are Yang; by castrating themselves, they switch from Yang to Yin, simultaneously inheriting both Yin Yang powers, meeting the entrance requirements.
Yuan Ming shook his head; although the Yin Yang Treasure was powerful, it was too bizarre. Those who cultivated it often underwent drastic changes in disposition, just like Nine Yin Venerable.
Just as he was about to put away the jade slip, he suddenly discovered a tiny segment of text at the end of the jade slip, barely noticeable without close examination.
Yuan Ming scrutinized carefully; this segment of text was a secret technique named "Mixed Hole Secret Technique," capable of expanding the capacity of the dantian to store more mana.
If one could cultivate the Mixed Hole Secret Technique to the Perfect Realm, it would double the dantian size compared to ordinary people, providing a significant advantage when facing enemies.
However, this secret technique took effect very slowly, requiring years to gradually show its benefits, and for it to reach perfection, one needed the assistance of a spiritual material known as "Mixed Hole Primordial Stone."
"No wonder the Nine Yin Venerable had such expansive dantian and unusually thick mana. It was due to this Mixed Hole Secret Technique! But seeing Nine Yin Venerable's situation, he hadn't cultivated it to perfection, probably because he didn't find the Mixed Hole Primordial Stone," Yuan Ming mused.
He had never heard of this Mixed Hole Primordial Stone before; if even Wu Yue Sect's massive power hadn't been able to find it, it must be an extremely precious material. He wondered if Xi Ying was aware of it.
Looking at the jade slip, he couldn't help feeling eager.
The benefits of expanding the dantian were not just having denser mana and an advantage over enemies; breaking through from the Nascent Soul Stage to the Returning Void Stage required a strong mana foundation. If he could cultivate the Mixed Hole Secret Technique to perfection, it would greatly aid his future breakthrough into the Returning Void Stage.
"This Yin Yang Secret Manual is useless to me, but the Mixed Hole Secret Technique is extremely useful. My cultivation has only reached the Early Stage of Nascent Soul; it's perfect to start practicing the Mixed Hole Secret Technique now. By the time I reached the peak of the Late-Stage Nascent Soul, the Mixed Hole Secret Technique should be nearly perfected, and if I could find the Mixed Hole Primordial Stone, my chances of advancing to the Returning Void Stage would greatly increase," Yuan Ming mused.
He put away the black and white jade slip and picked up the last blue jade scroll.
Yuan Ming had also glanced at this jade scroll before, which recorded a soul cultivation method, likely the one practiced by Nine Yin Venerable.
He carefully examined the content of the cultivation method, and his expression grew increasingly grim.
The soul cultivation method recorded in the jade scroll was named "Heavenly Silkworm Parasitic Technique," an extremely sinister soul cultivation method unlike others that progressed through steadfast cultivation. Instead, it improved by plundering.
The Heavenly Silkworm Parasitic Technique could transform soul power into a seed, parasitizing it inside some infants, controlling their consciousness, and forming a crucible.
Once these crucibles grew up and their souls strengthened to a certain level, Nine Yin Venerable would cast spells to devour their soul power completely, assimilating it into himself.
Newborns, being ignorant with pure thoughts and influenced by the Heavenly Silkworm Parasitic Technique, would remain incredibly naive even as they grew up, harboring few stray thoughts. Absorbing such soul power was much less risky than refining someone else's soul.
Despite this, the Heavenly Silkworm Parasitic Technique was still an Evil Path. Those who practiced it had inherently unstable Soul Power and could only rely on brute force to overcome their enemies, unable to use Illusion Techniques or other Divine Skills that required meticulous control.
"I don't know where this Heavenly Silkworm Parasitic Technique came from, but it is truly evil. The Nine Yin Venerable has killed countless innocents to obtain this powerful Soul Power. He truly deserved to die! This technique should not remain in the world, as it only brings harm!" Yuan Ming snorted coldly, his palm exerting force, crushing the green Jade Scroll into dust.
Having done this, his expression slightly cleared, and he took the corpse of the Nine Yin Venerable, nodding in satisfaction after a sweep with his Divine Sense.
When the Xi Ying Clone killed the Nine Yin Venerable, it had been exceedingly careful not to damage the body.
Not only that, but it seemed there was still some scattered Soul Power residue within the body of the Nine Yin Venerable, and his mouth and nose were gently breathing, his life force not yet completely severed.
Yuan Ming immediately initiated the Ju Mang Spirit Technique, his body rapidly expanding and instantly transforming into a vast black tree, countless vines hanging down and wrapping around the body of the Nine Yin Venerable.
Initially having no other choice, he had refined the red-faced man into a Tree Puppet, prepared for possession by the Heavenly Ghost Wanderer.
Now with the Nine Yin Venerable at hand, given that this person was a peak Soul Cultivator of the Sleeping Witch level, naturally far surpassing the red-faced man, the chances of the Heavenly Ghost Wanderer breaking through the limits of the Sleeping Witch greatly increased after the possession.
Yuan Ming injected Undying Demon Power into the body of the Nine Yin Venerable, beginning to refine the Tree Puppet.
At that moment, points of black light suddenly emerged from various parts of the body of the Nine Yin Venerable, swiftly converging to form a black shadow in the blink of an eye.
"What is this..." Yuan Ming's pupils constricted and he immediately activated the Soul Destroying Sword, slashing towards the black shadow.
Check for the latest updates on * (*).
However, the black shadow moved even faster, shooting outwards and entering a nearby stone wall.
Yuan Ming spread out his Divine Sense, but the black shadow's speed was unimaginable, already escaping beyond the range of his Divine Sense detection.
"Could that black shadow be the Residual Soul of the Nine Yin Venerable? I was a bit careless there," he frowned.
The original body of the Nine Yin Venerable had been killed by him, and the mere Residual Soul, even if it escaped, would hardly be a threat. Yuan Ming wasn't concerned about it.
Using Black Incense to kill enemies, although risky, was his current trump card, which under normal circumstances he wouldn't easily use. Apart from Xi Ying, no one else knew of it, but now with the escape of the Residual Soul of Nine Yin, this secret might no longer be safe.
"Forget it, nothing can be kept secret forever in this world." Yuan Ming shook his head, not dwelling further on this matter.
He carefully examined the body of the Nine Yin Venerable again, ensuring there were no abnormalities, then continued to rotate the Ju Mang Spirit Technique, refining the Tree Puppet.
Lacking a Divine Soul within the body of the Nine Yin Venerable made refining the Tree Puppet somewhat troublesome. After consulting with Qi Ye, Yuan Ming decided to integrate the soul body of the Heavenly Ghost Wanderer into it beforehand.
Although time was pressing, the Heavenly Ghost Wanderer was crucial to him, and the delay was worthwhile.
Half a month later, the Tree Puppet was finally refined, and the Heavenly Ghost Wanderer had successfully merged with the Nine Yin Venerable.
As Qi Ye had said, by leveraging the abundant life force of the Tree Puppet, the Soul Power of the Heavenly Ghost Wanderer slowly began to recover.
Yuan Ming was secretly delighted and did not linger, using Flying Escape to leave.
...
Black Wind Desert, outside Wangbei City.
"Get moving, if we don't meet the quota again today, I'll skin you alive!"
In an open-air mine, seventy to eighty Qi Refining cultivators clad in ragged clothing, chained at the feet, swung their miner's pickaxes under the scorching sun, while the Wu Yue Sect Cultivators overseeing them impatiently lashed their whips and cursed.
Among the crowd, an emaciated Qi Refining cultivator could no longer hold on, stumbling and falling among the exposed rocks.
"You lazy dog, don't even think about slacking!" The overseer showed no mercy, bringing down a whip.
Before the whip could strike, another Qi Refining cultivator also stumbled but managed to position his body right in the path of the whip.
"Uh—" He grunted, taking the hit and quickly helped his fallen comrade to stand without delay.
Seeing them stand and quickly take up their pickaxes again, the overseer snorted coldly and did not whip them again.
"Thank you," the Qi Refining cultivator who had fallen murmured, but then noticed a distinct burn mark on the left cheek of the man who had helped him up.
"You're welcome," Zhang Xiu shook his head, noticing the other's gaze carrying a hint of peculiarity, yet he made no attempt to hide the mark on his face.
It was rare for mortals in the Black Wind Desert to be born with a Spirit Root, and even those who were typically came from families of privilege. Someone of servant origin like him was exceptionally rare.
But having come this far was largely thanks to his father being a servant of the Sandtrap City Lord, who had unexpectedly discovered his Spirit Root talent and bestowed upon him a chance of Immortality.
Unfortunately, even as an Immortal Master as described by his father, he had still not managed to leave the Black Wind Desert, and now had become a mine slave, a status even lower than that of the City Lord's servants.

chapters.title: Chapter 713 - 684: What More Could Freedom Ask For?
chapters.content:
Zhang Xiu returned to the rocky wall nearby and resumed swinging his miner's pickaxe, recalling the recent events in his mind, his eyes filled with added sorrow.
The attack by the Wu Yue Sect on the Black Wind Desert was too sudden, and no one had anticipated the arrival of this disaster. The cities of the north, led by Wangbei City, changed sides overnight. Countless followers of the Wu Yue Sect swept through each city, executing all who dared to resist.
The City Lord of Xiansha City was among them.
At that time, Zhang Xiu had just begun his meditative cultivation when his door was kicked open, and a Soul Witch stormed in, easily overpowering him and clamping spirit-power-suppressing shackles on his ankles.
Afterward, as the Wu Yue Sect advanced towards the Central Plains, most of the captured cultivators were driven to the frontline, leaving only a few Qi Refining cultivators like Zhang Xiu to serve as slaves, tasked with mining and alchemy among other logistics work.
Heading to the frontline was undoubtedly a death sentence, but for Zhang Xiu, life as a slave was hardly any better.
Cultivation in the Black Wind Desert had always been a struggle due to resource scarcity, and now, most of the city's supplies had been taken by the Wu Yue Sect, leaving only the leftovers and scraps for the sect members who remained there.
Zhang Xiu and the others could only persevere through the hardships, mining and practicing alchemy for the Wu Yue Sect day and night.
The incident that had just occurred was merely a microcosm. In the current Black Wind Desert, similar events unfolded almost incessantly.
However, it seemed that heaven did not pity the suffering of Zhang Xiu and his companions.
Over the vast expanse of yellow sand, the sky darkened, and a cold wind howled through the mining pits, causing all the cultivators to shiver involuntarily.
"Black, the Black Wind is coming! Quickly, activate the Great Array!" Amidst the chaos, someone shouted.
The Wu Yue Sect members overseeing the mine, transferred from the Northern Desert, were far slower to react than these local cultivators. By the time they fumbled with the Array Plate to activate it, a pitch-black hurricane had already appeared on the horizon.
Quickly, the mine's Great Array rose, but before anyone could take a breath, the spirit light on the array flickered abruptly, and then it dispersed entirely.
Everyone was stunned.
"Dammit, those guys even skimmed on these life-saving Spirit Stones?" The guard was the first to react, cursing as he threw down the Array Plate in frustration.
At that moment, despondency overcame all the cultivators in the mine. Their Magic Artifacts had long been confiscated, and now they couldn't even flee for their lives.
In the midst of deep despair, Zhang Xiu suddenly calmed down.
In the end, he was unable to escape the Black Wind Desert.
His father was wrong after all. Even high and mighty Immortal Masters were not truly free. In the face of more powerful beings, they were all mere ants.
Swept up by the tides of destiny, whether an Immortal Master or a mortal, everyone was but a leaf on water, unable to control their own fate, tumbling with the waves, drifting without knowing the destination.
As Zhang Xiu reminisced about his life, someone nearby suddenly exclaimed.
"Wait, look, there's someone in the Black Wind!"
Zhang Xiu was startled and hurriedly looked up, only to see a handsome young man amidst the colossal black tornado, rising and falling with the wind, floating through the sky like a flying leaf, taking advantage of the wind currents.
Every now and then, he would throw a punch. With each movement, it looked as though he was following the wind's lead, yet also challenging the raging storm.
"Is he cultivating using the Black Wind?" someone in the mine realized.
"How is that possible? This is a natural disaster, something even Nascent Soul cultivators don't want to face. How could someone be using it for cultivation?" another person gasped incredulously.
Whether it was the voices of the cultivators in the mine that disturbed the young man in the wind, he seemed to turn his head and glance towards the mine, then he abruptly stopped his body in the midst of the wind.
Facing the towering winds, the young man appeared exceedingly slender yet as firm and majestic as a mountain, unmovable by any storm or thunder strike.
Then, the young man took a deep breath, his eyes flashed with spirit light, and he retracted his fists to his belly, before suddenly thrusting forward.
In an instant, the sky cleared.
The crowd of cultivators in the mine only heard a deafening sound, like a Demon Image roaring or a violent wind howling. Then, a large hole appeared in the middle of the towering tornado, and the dark clouds in the sky seemed to be pushed away rapidly.
In just a breath's time, the Black Wind Desert's calamity, a nightmare that instilled fear in countless, a silent reaper of lives, was dispersed by the young man's punch.
Everyone was stunned. They couldn't believe their eyes, unable to comprehend what they had just witnessed.
The joy of surviving the Black Wind was overshadowed by endless confusion; some even pinched their thighs to prove they were not dreaming.
After dispersing the Black Wind, the young man also flew into the mine. The crowd subconsciously lowered their heads, clearing a path for him, none daring to stand before him or raise their heads in his presence.
The young man seemed indifferent to the reactions of others, simply walking up to Zhang Xiu and sizing him up.
"You look somewhat familiar, what's your name?"
Zhang Xiu's lips trembled as he mustered up the courage to finally speak his name.
"Zhang Xiu?"
Yuan Ming chewed on this name, paused to think, and then located this person in his memory.
Back in Xiansha City, the first time he noticed the source of Desire Power in the Stealing Heaven Tripod, it had led him to this person.
At that time, he had still been a mortal, but now he too had become a Qi Refining cultivator, truly a reminder of the impermanence of life.
"We must have some fate, so I can fulfill one of your requests. Feel free to ask for anything," Yuan Ming reflected inwardly, and then said.
At this, Zhang Xiu also snapped out of his daze. Upon hearing Yuan Ming's words, he wanted to plead for Yuan Ming to rescue him from the mine, but as the words reached his lips, he recalled his recent epiphany between life and death, and he hesitated.
"Junior dares to ask Senior a question... What stage must I cultivate to in order to truly attain freedom?" Zhang Xiu asked.
"Why do you want to ask this?" Yuan Ming looked at him in surprise.
"Junior... is just a bit confused... Long ago, when I was still a mortal, my father said that only Immortal Masters could attain freedom. However, since I stepped onto the Immortal Path, I discovered that even Immortal Masters are hierarchized. As a Qi Refining stage cultivator, I could only follow the City Lord's orders and continue handling his sundry duties. At that time, I thought that maybe one day, if I could reach the Foundation Establishment stage, perhaps I could gain freedom. But when the Wu Yue Sect attacked, I realized that even beings at the Core Formation stage sometimes cannot control their own life and death," Zhang Xiu said, his face clouded with confusion.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming fell silent for a long time.
"This question... I too am searching for its answer," he eventually shook his head and said.
"Even someone as powerful as Senior can't attain freedom?" A trace of despair flashed in Zhang Xiu's eyes.
"There are always higher beings in the world, and moreover, freedom is something both cheap and priceless. Depending on where you stand and your perspective, the freedom you desire changes... Even at a point of no further advancement, there will be things one can't achieve, freedoms one can't grasp," Yuan Ming sighed.
"If that's the case, then the answer you seek... doesn't really exist, does it?" Zhang Xiu asked.
"Perhaps it doesn't, but if we stop searching just because the path ahead is bleak, wouldn't we be fettered once more? Besides, facing a problem and seeking an answer of one's own is in itself the greatest and most precious freedom a person can have." Yuan Ming smiled.
Zhang Xiu was stunned, his eyes, which had dimmed, seemed to reignite with light.
"What I just said doesn't count as an answer, so my offer still stands. You may make another request." Seeing this, Yuan Ming said again.
Zhang Xiu was silent, suddenly glancing around.
The monk slaves in the mine were all gathered here, while not far away, the pale-faced Wu Yue Sect guards inexplicably hadn't fled but stood rooted to the spot.
The monk slaves seemed indifferent to the conversation between him and Yuan Ming, feeling instead that Zhang Xiu had wasted a great opportunity, which made them somewhat irritable. Hearing that Zhang Xiu could make another request, they immediately perked up, their eyes filled with pleading as they looked at Zhang Xiu.Uplоаdеd by thе М|V|L(ЕМРYR) tеаm.
"Then... please grant me a Magic Artifact blade capable of splitting these shackles," Zhang Xiu said with a smile, turning to Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming also smiled, a look of admiration flashing in his eyes, then raised his hand to beckon. Moments later, Hua Zhi, Vajra, and Lei Yu flew over from afar, landing in front of Yuan Ming.
Immediately, Hua Zhi briskly rubbed her hands together, and countless purple-black vines grew out of her arms, quickly solidifying into a blade, which she handed to Yuan Ming.
"I don't have a suitable Magic Artifact for you, but this blade is transformed from part of my spirit beast's body. Although it lacks engraved runes, the material is hard enough for your use," Yuan Ming said as he handed the Purple-black Tree Blade to Zhang Xiu.
Zhang Xiu gratefully received the blade, nodding vigorously, then swiftly used it to sever the chains binding his feet.
But he didn't stop there. He went on to cut the chains off his fellow slave miners.
Once everyone was free, he lifted his arm and led the group of miners, with blades in hand, toward the bloodless-faced Wu Yue Sect guards.
The strong fighters of the Wu Yue Sect were all on the frontline, leaving behind guards who were poor in combat. They quickly fell to the miners' offensive.
As the dust settled, Zhang Xiu turned to thank Yuan Ming, only to find he had disappeared.
Just then, a message rang in his ear.
"Our destinies end here. From now on, pursue what you desire. Most of the Wu Yue Sect's cultivators are on the frontline. If you're cautious, they won't chase you. Also, I've hidden a Cultivation Technique inside the blade, which I obtained from the East Sea. It'll allow you to cultivate up to the Nascent Soul stage; you can do with it as you please."
Zhang Xiu's heart tightened upon hearing that, but then he remembered something.
"I still don't know your name, Senior!" he shouted.
"You can call me... Yuan Ming," Yuan Ming's voice soon faded from his ear.
Zhang Xiu's eyes widened, instinctively touching his chest.
In his bosom, lay a book—-the start of his dreams, the beginning of his Immortal Path he never forgot, the spiritual support that helped him endure countless harsh nights as a mine slave.
The book's title, "Mr. Sheng's Eastern Travelogue."
The author, Yuan Ming.

chapters.title: Chapter 714 - 685: Infiltrating the Rear
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming left the open mine and quickly put the minor incident he had just experienced behind him.
It had been half a month since the last great battle.
During that time, under the continual challenges of the Black Wind, he had mastered his Fist Intent to perfection, and the yin qi in the wind no longer affected him. Continuing his training would yield little benefit. Moreover, with the tense battle situation between the Wu Yue Sect and the sects of the Central Plains, he didn't have much time left for cultivation. It was time to leave the Black Wind Desert.
However, the recent event served as a reminder— with the Wu Yue Sect having fully mobilized, their rear base in the Northern Desert was definitely vulnerable. Instead of rushing to the front lines to support the battle, it might be more impactful to infiltrate the Northern Desert, cut off the Wu Yue Sect's supplies, and destroy their lair.
Conveniently, Wangbei City was located north of the Black Wind Desert, the closest city to the Northern Desert. Perhaps it was fate that the Black Wind had drifted through the desert and brought him here.
Yuan Ming pondered in his heart and quickly made a decision. After discerning the direction briefly, he took Hua Zhi and the others, and they sped toward the Northern Desert.
...
Qingshui Oasis.
Unlike other areas of the Yunhuang Continent, the Northern Desert hardly had any permanent cities.
The majority of mortal and cultivator settlements here were situated within oases, large or small. However, every oasis's water source would periodically dry up and reemerge, not in sync with one another. Thus, the people of the Northern Desert almost always gathered in tribal groups, moving to another oasis with a burgeoning water source before the current one dried up.
The spirit veins here were also mostly situated around the oases, and like the water sources, would periodically dwindle and flourish.
The reasons for this phenomenon were numerous and varied, but like with the Black Wind, few dared to assert with certainty that their theories were the truth.
Before reaching the Northern Desert, Yuan Ming made a point of acquiring a map of the area from Wangbei City, but although it marked the locations of the oases, it did not specify the periodicity of the water sources.
Thus, after passing three dried-up oases, Yuan Ming finally found one where water was still emerging.
However, to his disappointment, the inhabitants here were all mortals, with no trace of any cultivators.
Yuan Ming quickly realized that continuing this search was like looking for a needle in a haystack. The battle in the Central Plains might conclude while he was still going around in circles in the sandy desert, searching for traces of the Wu Yue Sect.
He needed intelligence. However, the Northern Desert was more than ten thousand miles away from Da Jin, making common methods like the Communication Talisman ineffective. After much deliberation, he resorted to using the Stealing Heaven Tripod and Black Incense to employ a possession ability.
In the midst of the elusive incense fog, Yuan Ming's consciousness soon descended upon Yan Siyun.
At that moment, Yan Siyun seemed to be discussing something with Xi Ying. When Yuan Ming's consciousness took her place, Xi Ying instantly sensed something was amiss.
"Yuan Ming, is that you?" Xi Ying eyed the suddenly silent Yan Siyun, her eyebrows slightly furrowed.
"It's me, how are things on your end?" Yuan Ming asked through Yan Siyun's body.
"Not very optimistic. After you killed the Nine Yin Venerable, the Wu Yue Sect switched from their lukewarm tactics to launching an all-out assault. The three armies of the Cloud Desolation Alliance were already lacking in strength, and we had to retreat while fighting. We barely managed to pull back under their encirclement, buying some time for the rear. However, most parts of northern Da Jin have fallen. The Wu Yue Sect's army is now close to Yuhua City and is expected to arrive within ten days at most. Tian Jizi has already ordered a full contraction of our forces, possibly planning to rely on the Sect Protection Array to fight a decisive battle against the Wu Yue Sect," Xi Ying said with a grave expression.
"Ten days? That's faster than I expected. I'm currently in the Northern Desert. I probably won't make it back in time. Tell me the location of the Wu Yue Sect's lair. I want to see if I can make a difference, perhaps forcing the Wu Yue Sect to retreat," Yuan Ming pondered for a moment then asked.
Nоtе frоm thе еditоr: Alwаys сhесk МV2LЕМРYR fоr соrrесtiоns.
"Your idea is good, but aside from that initial appearance, the Wu Yue God has never taken action in our previous encounters. I'm worried he might be staying back at the lair rather than with the troops," Xi Ying expressed her concerns.
"It shouldn't be so. I always felt that the Wu Yue Sect didn't accelerate their invasion into the Central Plains but slowly consumed the immortal and mortal forces of Zhao Country, likely with a certain scheme in mind," Yuan Ming said.
"Regardless, their lair won't be entirely unguarded, and with the Wu Yue God's vast divine powers, if you really encounter him, you must be extremely cautious," Xi Ying said.
"I will act cautiously. Even if I can't defeat him, escaping should still be possible. Plus, this battle nearly determines the fate of Yunhuang; the Wu Yue God should value it greatly. No matter the previous situation, he will likely show himself during the mountain assault," Yuan Ming nodded and responded.
"Well, all right. According to my clan's records, the lair of the Wu Yue Sect is located beneath the Black Witch Mountain in the Northern Desert. Be very careful when you go. Moreover, even if you arrive early, don't rush to take action. Wait until ten days later when the Wu Yue Sect's army officially starts the mountain assault, and their forces are tied up, then make your move, to prevent them from being able to quickly send reinforcements back to the Black Witch Mountain," Xi Ying hesitated briefly, then said.
"By the way, did you manage to locate Wulu, the one I mentioned last time?" Xi Ying suddenly remembered.
"I located him, but he is currently in seclusion in an uninhabited area, the exact location of which I'm not clear on. I dare not rashly control him to leave, and currently, I'm unable to communicate with him," Yuan Ming sighed regretfully.
Afterward, the two exchanged further intelligence, and Xi Ying detailed Chang Chun Temple's arrangements near Yuhua City to Yuan Ming.
As the possession time was about to end, and the important matters had been discussed, they both fell into silence.
"Well, I should go," Yuan Ming hesitated for a moment, then spoke.
Xi Ying pursed her lips, her gaze like a clear spring, filled with both worry and reluctance.
Yet for some reason, as she looked at Yuan Ming, who was possessing Yan Siyun, she suddenly felt irritated.
"Don't possess other women in the future, I don't like it," Xi Ying chided.
Yuan Ming paused, his Divine Sense sweeping over Xi Ying and seeing her cheeks slightly puffed up in a seemingly reproachful yet angry manner, couldn't help but smile wryly and replied,
"Alright, it won't happen again."
"Also, next time, I want to see the real you, standing in front of me unharmed!" Xi Ying added.
Yuan Ming heard the worry in her words, and his heart softened even more.
"I promise you," he said earnestly, as if making a vow.
...
Four days later, Black Witch Mountain.
This mountain, situated at the far northern edge of the Northern Desert, was remote, with neither grass nor trees growing upon it, only rough, cracked black stones covering every corner of the mountain.
In the thousand miles around the mountain body, there were few spirit veins or oases, making it an utterly desolate place rarely visited by humans.
However, the stronghold of the Wu Yue Sect lay beneath this desolate land.
Outside Black Witch Mountain, Yuan Ming used the Void Transformation Technique to conceal his form, hiding in the clouds and covertly observing everything on the mountain.
He soon noticed an incredibly vast Formation that enveloped the entire Black Witch Mountain within it.
This Formation was not only protective but also combined with Illusion Techniques. Even a Nascent Soul cultivator might not be able to see through the Formation to view the actual situation on the mountain.
Moreover, Yuan Ming felt the essence of Soul Power flowing from the Formation, leading him to speculate that the Formation might react to any external Divine Sense contact, potentially exposing the position of the investigator. In severe cases, it might even trigger a counterattack.
Faced with this Formation, Yuan Ming also found it somewhat tricky, but after some thought, he quickly figured out a way to bypass the Formation.
Within the clouds, Yuan Ming cautiously extended the Undying Tree Root, and with a thought, the root trembled and tore a small opening in the void, cautiously probing through it.
Simultaneously, in an inconspicuous corner atop Black Witch Mountain, an extremely tiny rift in the void suddenly opened, and the Undying Tree Root quietly poked its head out.
The Great Array enveloping Black Witch Mountain showed no reaction at this time.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming was overjoyed and immediately controlled the Undying Tree Root to rapidly investigate the situation on Black Witch Mountain.
The mountain was filled with numerous stone houses, and many members of the Wu Yue Sect in Black Robes were stationed in them. The number of people was even greater than Yuan Ming had anticipated. Their strengths varied, but most were in the late or peak stages of each cultivation realm.
Beyond those residing on the external sections of the mountain, Yuan Ming quickly discovered that the interior of the mountain had been hollowed out by the Wu Yue Sect, resembling an ant's nest with countless twisting tunnels that connected each stone house, forming a vast underground network.
Without a map or prior scouting, outsiders entering the place would likely soon lose their way in this complex terrain.
Among these tunnels and stone houses, members of the Wu Yue Sect had also laid countless forms of restrictions. Although currently inactive, the mere sight of them was enough to make one break out in a cold sweat, let alone facing them directly.
The more Yuan Ming observed, the more he was alarmed. The Wu Yue Sect had secured their stronghold impermeably. Without the Undying Tree Root allowing him to scout in advance, even several top-tier cultivators of similar strength to him might find it difficult to conquer this place.
However, since he was now aware of the setup here, these threatening difficulties seemed much less significant. Most crucially, after his investigation, he found out that although the cultivators left behind were strong, there was only one Black Robed Elder who had reached the Nascent Soul stage, and he was not a Soul Cultivator.
Soon, Yuan Ming had thoroughly scouted the situation at Black Witch Mountain. The only place he couldn't fully explore was a stone house located at the deepest part of the underground, covered by an exceptionally strong restriction. Even the Undying Tree Root couldn't penetrate the void to enter it, and Yuan Ming was unclear what was inside.
Apart from the enemy's setup, Yuan Ming discovered several locations within Black Witch Mountain storing spiritual materials, elixirs, and Cultivation Technique Books.
Unfortunately, the spiritual materials and elixirs had mostly been taken, leaving only a small portion for daily use by the stationed cultivators, but the collection of Classic Books was well-preserved.
Yuan Ming noted down these locations, then silently submerged himself, waiting for the day of the decisive battle to arrive.

chapters.title: Chapter 715 - 686 I'll Be There for You Soon
chapters.content:
Five days later, in Da Jin.
Inside Chang Chun Temple, the Sect Protection Array was fully activated. Cultivators from all paths had gathered solemnly, bracing themselves for the decisive battle that was about to erupt.
According to Tian Jizi's arrangements, Chang Chun Temple, or rather the Cloud Desolation Alliance, now had three lines of defense.
The first defense line was the plain outside Yuhua City. The terrain there was flat with no natural defenses, which should not have been included as part of the defense line. But Tian Jizi had long since ordered the construction of stone castles built from heaped up rocks on the plains, creating over a hundred fortresses. Each fortress was equipped with numerous Formation restrictions, and in case of emergency, the Cultivators defending the castles could be teleported to the rear, after which the castles would be directly detonated.
The second line of defense was Yuhua City itself. This city of Cultivators had been transformed by Chang Chun Temple into a fortress almost impossible to conquer. Most civilian houses in the city had been demolished. Various massive Exotic Beasts, agitated and restive, were lying in wait throughout the city. Ships armed to the teeth hovered above the city, ready to pour their fury onto the enemy once the decisive battle began.
The final line of defense was the Spiritual Mountain where Chang Chun Temple stood. The arrangements here were even more intricate, but to sum up, it could be simply described with a brief statement—
This place gathered the foundations accumulated over thousands, perhaps tens of thousands of years by all the Major Sects of the whole Yunhuang.
The distances between the three defense lines were not far, only about an hour or two's journey apart, but with layers of defenses, it would be no easy task for Wu Yue Sect to break through.
At this moment, Tian Jizi, accompanied by a group of Nascent Soul cultivators, stood on the mountain peak, looking toward the far horizon where a dark, "long line" was forming. His face was like still water, and he remained silent.
Meanwhile, within the forces of Wu Yue Sect, Ni Mu, along with Xi Zheng and the Free Venerable, respectfully bowed towards a black palace before turning around and raising his hand toward the plain, where one stone castle after another stood.
"Attack," he said in a flat tone, as if he was talking about a trivial matter.
The next instant, deafening shouts of killing erupted, resounding through heaven and earth.
...
Black Witch Mountain.
Concealed, Yuan Ming approached the great Formation outside the mountain slowly.
The size of the void fissure pierced by the Undying Tree Root was limited, preventing him from entering the Formation the same way, leaving no choice but to launch a direct assault.
Luckily for him, the Formation shrouding Black Witch Mountain was not operating at full strength, so Yuan Ming still had a chance to breach it.
However, if he failed to create an entrance on the Formation quickly, the Wu Yue Sect would immediately react, running the Formation at full capacity, and he would lose any chance to penetrate into the mountain.
Yuan Ming gazed at the Formation before him. Without using his Divine Sense, all he could see was the Void.
But in the next moment, Mana slowly flowed along his meridians and into his eyes, making his already bright eyes shine more brightly.
In an instant, countless spirit light veins emerged before him, with every stroke interwoven, connecting dozens of runes into one entity, forming a giant net covering the entire Black Witch Mountain within it.
This was the true form of Black Witch Mountain's Illusion Formation.
If Formations could be compared to humans, then runes would be their internal organs and spiritual energy their meridians, whereas the effects displayed by the Formation would be the flesh that filled its body.
No matter how skilled an Array Master is, they had to observe the Formation's effects to deduce the construction of its spiritual energy veins and find weak points to break the Formation.
It was like how doctors in the Mortal World would need to observe a patient's physical body in detail through inspection, listening, questioning, and pulse-taking in order to deduce the cause of illness.
But the Qi Observation Technique from the "Emperor Sealing God Fist" broke this principle.
At this moment, to Yuan Ming's eyes, every detail of Black Witch Mountain's Illusion Formation was laid bare, without the need to touch it or observe its operations. He could see the Formation's innermost secrets—as if he were the Array Master who created it—and identify its flaws.
Quickly, Yuan Ming leapt forward to the right spot, channeling the Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill with all his might. His muscles pulsed as though they were alive, and a surge of War Intent concentrated at his fingertips, ready to explode with his punching force in an instant.
At the same time, a towering Demon Image emerged above Black Witch Mountain, startling the Wu Yue Sect within. But before they could react, the Demon Image let out a roar and violently collided with the Formation outside the mountain.
Instantly, the sound of shattering echoed in everyone's ears as fragments of pale white spirit light appeared in the void. The once-concealed Formation was now completely exposed to all, with a giant hole torn through it and countless cracks spreading from the edges, looking on the brink of collapse.
"What's going on? Has the Cloud Desolation Alliance attacked?" The Wu Yue Sect on Black Witch Mountain were confused and shocked.
Some quickly rushed into the mountain to report to the Nascent Soul cultivators stationed there while others hurried to the Formation's hub, attempting to repair the breach.
However, just then, the Wu Yue Sect near the hub saw three streaks of light descend from the sky, transforming into a man and two beasts landing before them.
"Who are you!" one of the more courageous Sect members shouted out, as he stealthily made a move to ambush them.
But Yuan Ming had no intention of speaking with them. He unleashed a series of punches, killing all the Wu Yue Sect members in the vicinity.
Afterwards, he turned around and, relying on Fist Power, completely destroyed the Formation's hub.
"Kill them, spare none!"
Yuan Ming flexed his muscles and gave a cold command to the now revealed Hua Zhi and Vajra beside him.
What followed was a one-sided slaughter; none of the Wu Yue Sect followers guarding this place was a match for Yuan Ming and his companions.
Initially, when they saw that a Body Cultivator had come knocking, their hearts leaped with joy, thinking that their group of Soul Cultivators could work together to at least hold Yuan Ming off for a while, even if they couldn't defeat him.
But when they launched Soul Cultivation Divine Power spells one after another at Yuan Ming, they discovered to their dismay that all their attacks were as if thrown into the sea, with no response whatsoever. Sometimes they would even suffer from a backlash, and in severe cases, they didn't even need Yuan Ming to make a move – they would just drop dead on the spot.
This kind of situation would only arise when there was a significant disparity in the Divine Soul strength between the two parties.
But, by the Wu Yue God above, how could this mere Body Cultivator possess such formidable Divine Soul Power?
Was this person a Body Cultivator or a Soul Cultivator?
Before these Wu Yue Sect followers could figure out the answers, Yuan Ming's Fist Power had already descended upon them, blasting both their bodies and souls into smithereens.
In just half an hour, Yuan Ming had completely wiped out all the Wu Yue Sect followers stationed on the outside of the mountain, and he himself was almost drenched in blood, covered from head to toe in the fresh blood of his enemies, which made him look especially terrifying.
Yuan Ming swept his gaze around, seeing no more signs of Wu Yue Sect followers, then pinched a Clothes Cleaning Technique, cleaning the bloodstains from his body, and at the same time, looked up towards a cave not far away.
During his massacre, Wu Yue Sect members had continuously used the mountain's network of caves to flee into the underground of Black Witch Mountain, and the Nascent Soul cultivator who was left in charge had no intention of emerging to confront Yuan Ming, even as the Wu Yue Sect members above ground were being slaughtered. This person hadn't even deigned to show his face.
Perhaps, he was guarding something important?
Yuan Ming quickly thought of the mysterious space, deep underground, where not even the Undying Tree Root could penetrate.
He must be planning to use the underground space's forbidden spells to slay me.
Guessing the Nascent Soul guardian's thoughts, Yuan Ming's lips curved slightly, and then without any fear, he stepped forward and entered the cave.
In the underground of Black Witch Mountain, within a stone hall, a Nascent Soul elder in a black robe watched with a grim face as Yuan Ming entered the cave and wreaked havoc, all captured within the bronze square mirror before him.
"This person is somewhat peculiar; use the prohibitions in the underground passage to hold him off while I contact the Venerable," commanded the black-robed elder quickly.
"Yes," responded the surrounding Wu Yue Sect followers, their faces paling considerably, but they bowed in agreement and left to carry out the orders.
The black-robed elder then took out a wooden box, from which he pulled out a pale golden thread. As soon as it was removed from the box, black shadows resembling human ears emerged from the thread, floating up and down around it.
Suppressing the discomfort in his heart, the black-robed elder channeled his Mana into the thread. The human ear shadows then gathered together to form a palm-sized black human ear, suspended in front of the elder.
"Venerable, there has been a disturbance at Black Witch Mountain. A Body Cultivator with a Tongqiao Body, accompanied by a spirit beast, has forcefully broken through the array and entered the mountain. This person possesses anomalies; all of Sleeping Witch's Soul Cultivation spells couldn't harm him. Please instruct on how to proceed," said the black-robed elder rapidly.
No sooner had his words fallen than the pale golden thread in his hand turned ink black, and the human ear shadow disappeared into the stone wall above his head, leaving no trace.
Seeing this, the black-robed elder casually dropped the thread and took another from the wooden box, holding it in his hand as if waiting for something.
Thе саnоniсаl sоurсе fоr this соntеnt: М|V|L2ЕМРYR.
But at that moment, a Wu Yue Sect follower burst into the hall, stumbling and panicking.
"It's bad! That man seems very familiar with our layout; he even knows where the prohibitions are. We can't stop him at all—he's already made it to the elixir storehouse!" the Wu Yue Sect follower knelt on the ground, shouting with a trembling voice.
Shocked, the black-robed elder hastily formed a spell with one hand and struck the copper mirror before him.
The scene in the mirror shifted instantly, revealing a storeroom.
In the center of the image, Yuan Ming was unabashedly ransacking the storeroom's elixirs, indiscriminately taking every elixir regardless of its grade.
With the upcoming offensive into the Central Plains, the Wu Yue Sect had already taken many elixirs away, but this was still their main base, with elixir supplies reserved for the needs of all the sect's cultivators. Even just the leftovers here could be enough for a cultivator who had just entered the Nascent Soul stage to break through to a Late-stage Nascent Soul.
The black-robed elder watched this scene, his heart bleeding. He wished he could rush out and battle Yuan Ming immediately, but he had yet to receive a response from the pale golden thread in his hand, so he had to keep guarding his post and not confront the enemy rashly.
But suddenly, the black-robed elder saw Yuan Ming in the bronze mirror turn around and lock eyes with the mirror—and with him.
He felt a sudden inexplicable chill in his heart and instinctively averted his gaze.
Of course, the Yuan Ming in the mirror could not see this; he just silently stared in a certain direction, as if he had seen something, his lips moving slightly.
"Wait for me; I'll be coming to find you soon… Hmph, arrogant!" the black-robed elder read Yuan Ming's lip movements and couldn't help but snort coldly.
Just then, Yuan Ming in the mirror suddenly raised his fist and threw a punch in the direction of the black-robed elder.
The image in the mirror vanished in an instant, signifying to the black-robed elder that the Magic Treasure used for observation at the other end had been destroyed.
Angry and about to check other surveillance Magic Treasures he had set up, the elder felt the thread in his hand tremble. A palm-sized pair of lips formed from the thread, and Ni Mu's voice came through.

chapters.title: Chapter 716 - 687: Change in the Rear
chapters.content:
Da Jin, Yuhua City.
The sky was densely covered with dark clouds as torrential rain poured down, washing the bloodstains away from the earth and the bodies of the Cultivators.
The behemoth from the Southern Border roared as it charged into the enemy ranks, its toes matted with who knows how many remnants of flesh and blood, and thick, spiny vines like grinding wheels occasionally burst from the ground, coiling toward the crowd.
In the sky, seven Flying Boats from the East Sea thundered in unison, with pillars of dazzling spirit light erupting from their prows, plowing dozens of ravines into the ranks of the Wu Yue Sect's army.
Similar scenes played out here and there, with countless Cultivators battling in the heavens and the earth. The sounds of combat and cries of anguish intertwined, only to be crushed by the booming noises.
Faced with the fierce resistance of the Cloud Desolation Alliance, the Wu Yue Sect steadily pressed on without any rush or impatience.
Behind the army formation, nine love witches circled around a majestic purple cauldron, their hands forming rings of spells and chants unceasing, summoning dozens of Core Formation Evil Spirits from within the cauldron to wildly attack the Flying Boats in the sky.
Another group of Cultivators dressed as sacrificers erected over a hundred ashen Stone Pillars on the ground. From beneath these pillars, skeletal Exotic Beasts broke through the soil, rushing towards the giant beast from the Southern Border that was under siege by many.
Compared to the Nine Yin Venerable, Ni Mu's command style was more steady and conservative.
This made every battle between the Wu Yue Sect and Cloud Desolation Alliance inconclusive, with neither a decisive victory nor a catastrophic defeat, leading to a deadlocked situation where neither side could gain the upper hand.
But when the outcomes of all the battles were tallied, the Cloud Desolation Alliance was astonished to find that their defense line was being steadily eroded, as their defending Cultivators were forced to retreat time and again. Almost imperceptibly, they had lost most of their territory.
Once the upper echelons of the Cloud Desolation Alliance realized this, they immediately organized a counterattack, attempting to recapture several key strongholds from the Wu Yue Sect.
However, for every attack launched by the Cloud Desolation Alliance, the Wu Yue Sect seemed to have anticipated it, always having measures in place to counteract. And just like before, the Cloud Desolation Alliance neither achieved a great victory nor suffered a great defeat. Many of their dispatched Cultivators returned unscathed, but the goals they aimed to achieve were never met.
Gradually, a sense of powerlessness began to grow in the hearts of many Nascent Soul cultivators of the Cloud Desolation Alliance. They couldn't find any breakthrough that could change the tide of the battle. It seemed as if being crushed step by step by the Wu Yue Sect was their only inevitable outcome.
However, Tian Jizi did not reveal his stance on the matter, simply instructing everyone to continue holding their position and suggesting that they could abandon their defenses if necessary to preserve their strength as the priority.
The members of the alliance did not know where his confidence came from, but at that moment, they had no choice but to trust the judgment of their Alliance Hierarch.
Finally, after a whole day and night of fierce battle, the Cloud Desolation Alliance's first line of defense officially fell, and everyone retreated to Yuhua City to prepare for the continued defense against the Wu Yue Sect's onslaught.
At the same time, in the camp of the Wu Yue Sect army, Ni Mu and others were discussing their next strategies.
"Our losses in this attack are not great, but we have been engaged in battle for so long. And compared to those temporarily built Stone Castles, Yuhua City will certainly be harder to attack. I think it would be best to call our troops to rest for a day," Xi Zheng analyzed.
"I was thinking the same," Ni Mu nodded in agreement.
On the side, the Free Venerable, as usual, was lost in Divine Travel, completely oblivious to their discussion.
Just then, a Nascent Soul cultivator hurriedly approached the tent from outside.
"Heavenly Puppet Venerable, there's a message from Black Witch Mountain," said the messenger, presenting a wooden box enveloped in a black mist with both hands.
At this news, both Ni Mu and Xi Zheng were startled, and the Free Venerable suddenly snapped back to reality, his expression becoming much more serious.
Ni Mu didn't hesitate, immediately standing up to take the wooden box. As soon as he opened it, a faint golden thread flew out.
Ni Mu immediately recognized that the thread had been extracted from an Exotic Beast by the Nine Yin Venerable using his power, its effect akin to a Sound Transmission Talisman that disregarded distance. Because they were so rare, they were only used to communicate with the Cultivators left behind at Black Witch Mountain.
As Ni Mu channeled Mana into the thread, a vast expanse of black fog surged upon it, coalescing into a large mouth mid-air.
"Reporting to the Venerable, there's trouble at Black Witch Mountain..."
After hearing the words transmitted through the thread, the hearts of the three sank.
"A Body Cultivation of the Tongqiao Body realm... Could it be someone from the Western Region?" Xi Zheng pondered aloud.
"Impossible, the situation in the Western Region is set by me. Even if the Cloud Desolation Alliance sent reinforcements, the Vajra Sect couldn't possibly break free at this time. Moreover, not many are aware of Black Witch Mountain's location. Even if they broke free, how did they find it?" the Free Venerable shook his head.
Hearing this, Xi Zheng's heart skipped a beat, and an unsettling suspicion arose in his mind. He fell silent, no longer speaking.
"Let's not bother about these details right now. This matter is not for us to decide. I will go report to the Wu Yue God right away and ask for his decision," Ni Mu cut off the discussion.
The Free Venerable and Xi Zheng both nodded, and then Ni Mu went alone to the black hall, approaching the sarcophagus.
"Wu Yue God, there's a message from Black Witch Mountain. An unidentified Body Cultivator is attacking the mountain, seemingly immune to Soul Cultivation Divine Powers. I seek your guidance on how to respond," Ni Mu said, bowing respectfully.
"Transmit my command, release the eight Shura and slay them," after a brief silence, the voice of Wu Yue God resounded throughout the palace.
"Yes."This text was acquired from *.
Ni Mu immediately obeyed the order, directly taking out another golden thread and passing Wu Yue God's command to the Nascent Soul left in charge.
"Also, accelerate the attack, there's no need for caution, before nightfall, take down Yuhua City," but then Wu Yue God spoke again, his voice tinged with a hint of reproof.
"My Lord, forgive me, I will relay the order immediately, but our troops are understaffed, and after a day of fierce battle, everyone is wounded.
