Moreover, with Yuhua City's defense formation intact, it will be difficult to conquer before darkness falls. Please grant us a few more days," Ni Mu's face stiffened as he bravely spoke up.
"...Understood." Surprisingly, Wu Yue God did not blame Ni Mu but simply responded softly.
While Ni Mu was still puzzled, the next instant he suddenly heard an almost imperceptible strange sound and looked up to see that the coffin in front of him had slightly opened a crack.
In that moment, Ni Mu felt that something invisible in the darkness seemed to surge out from the coffin, brushing past him.
At the same time, Ni Mu suddenly felt a steep drop in temperature around him; black winds attacked from all directions, seemingly chasing after the entity that had emerged from the coffin, swirling and wandering around the great hall with it.
Even though Ni Mu was not the target of the black wind's attack, he still felt a bone-chilling coldness, as if even his Nascent Soul were about to be frozen.
Even so, Ni Mu did not move an inch, nor did he dare to summon the Tongchen Puppet to protect his body.
"Go, open the palace doors. My Divine Power will surely help you take the city," Wu Yue God spoke indifferently.
Relieved, Ni Mu nodded vigorously and quickly retreated to the front of the palace doors, using his spells to open them.
The next instant, fierce winds howled, and the icy air pushed Ni Mu forward, but with each step, another layer of frost formed on him.
Ni Mu couldn't even contemplate his action at this point; survival instincts compelled him to summon the Tongchen Puppet to cover his entire body, which saved him from being turned into an ice sculpture by the cold black wind.
And the black wind was not meant for him; after circling around him, it shot straight out the doors and flew towards the sky.
Outside the great hall, the rain was dense like a curtain, but as the black wind rushed out of the hall, the ceaseless rain turned into snow, spreading rapidly outward from the hall.
In an instant, everyone was stunned by the sudden change in the weather, also feeling a chill originating from their hearts that spread unchecked through their Sea of Consciousness, disregarding all Protective Body measures.
But all this was just an appetizer; in the blink of an eye, the cultivators of the Cloud Desolation Alliance felt an immense and terrifying pressure descending from the sky, crushing all, regardless of friend or foe, pushing everyone below the clouds, pinning them to the ground.
Then, a black palm as large as a mountain burst through the layers of dense clouds and pressed down on Yuhua City.
The sky, already darkened by clouds, but as the palm parted the mist, a dim moonlight filtered through the edges, as if casting a halo that belonged solely to the divine over the palm—a terrifying sight, yet with an indescribable purity.
Inside Yuhua City, Xi Ying looked up at the colossal black palm and immediately recognized it as the Great Black Sky God Palm.
However, such a display was not only ten times stronger than when cultivated by Yuan Ming and the Six Desires Venerable; it also seemed to bear a different kind of power.
Seeing the palm descending, nearly everyone in Yuhua City trembled in fear, but Tianyinzi, sitting at the center of the city, flashed a hint of ruthlessness in his eyes. He then bit his finger, using blood in lieu of ink, coagulating it in mid-air, and wrote a rune exuding an ancient aura.
The next moment, a blue-white spirit light ignited in various parts of Yuhua City. From a bird's-eye view, these lights interconnected, forming an extremely huge Formation with Tianyinzi standing at its core.
"ZzZzZ"
Accompanied by the spirit light, countless currents of electricity rose from every building in Yuhua City. These were guided by the Formation, and in the blink of an eye, they all converged above Tianyinzi's head.
At the same time, Tianyinzi completed the final stroke of the rune; the blood-colored rune flickered, and then it too rose above his head.
Simultaneously, the currents and the thunderbolt, as if receiving a command, also flowed towards the blood-colored rune. In an instant, a thick blood-colored Thunder Spear appeared in the skies above Yuhua City, shooting straight towards the descending black palm.
Everyone heard a booming sound as a dazzling white light exploded in the sky, forcing all to squint their eyes, and when the light dissipated, they looked up to see the black palm shattered by the Thunder Spear, turning into several indistinct Black Snakes that surged toward Yuhua City.
Tianyinzi snorted coldly, his right hand quickly forming spells and striking the ground beneath him. In an instant, silver arcs of electricity burst forth, swiftly creating a tight net of lightning that completely enveloped Yuhua City.
But when the Black Snakes reached the electric net, the arcs, as if sentient, slid aside, creating a pathway, allowing the Black Snakes to effortlessly penetrate inside.
Seeing this, Tianyinzi's expression changed dramatically; he quickly changed the spells in his hand, trying to control the Formation and rectify the situation.
However, at that moment, the arcs of electricity that had just avoided the Black Snakes turned in unison and struck directly at Tianyinzi.

chapters.title: Chapter 717 - 688: Variables
chapters.content:
Tianyinzi's heart chilled, and he immediately waved his hand to summon a golden giant bell, suspending it above his head.
The surface of the golden giant bell was wrapped in layers of golden runes that continuously encircled it, and sound waves like ripples spread out, scattering all the thunder arcs that struck towards it.
But it was this moment's delay that allowed the black snakes to enter the city, opening their mouths wide to consume the cultivators' divine souls within the city. The sucking force was so strong that visible wind rolls formed at their mouths.
Seeing many cultivators from Chang Chun Temple fall to their deaths, Tianyinzi's eyes were about to split with rage. He immediately summoned four other magic treasures and pinched the spell, sending rolling sound waves crashing towards the black snakes like ocean waves.
Who would have expected that the next moment, the black snakes simply turned their heads and swallowed all the sound waves Tianyinzi produced.
Tianyinzi was once again startled. Before he could understand what was happening, he saw the black snakes pouncing towards him in an instant.
In a critical moment, a golden firebird suddenly appeared over Yuhua City, spreading its wings, and feathers transformed into golden flames flying towards the black snakes.
Facing the golden flames, the seemingly insatiable black snakes met their nemesis, and without even a shriek, they were burned into black smoke, dissipating between heaven and earth.
"Black palms and black snakes are transformations of Xuanyin Qi, they can only be eliminated by methods containing the power of Flame Sun or Thunder Power," Xi Ying's voice transmission reached Tianyinzi's ear at the same time.
"But just now, the thunder great array had no effect at all!" Tianyinzi said urgently.
"That was because the soul power hidden within the Wu Yue God's divine skills took effect. A soul cultivator at the level of the Word Witch Realm can endow objects with souls using only their soul power. Even something intangible like thunder is not exempt; as long as it is tainted with his soul power, it will immediately become his believer and be controlled by him," Xi Ying explained.
"Doesn't this mean that all our methods could be turned against us and controlled by him? With such divine skills, how should we counter it?" Tianyinzi frowned deeply.
"Use your lifebound magical treasure that shares a bond with your life, or an item that has birthed an artifact spirit. As long as it is an object or magic that is clearly controlled by another consciousness, it won't be affected by the Wu Yue God's divine skill," Xi Ying advised.
However, upon hearing this, Tianyinzi was momentarily stunned, then hesitantly showed an indecisive expression, subconsciously caressing his storage ring and took out a jade talisman engraved with thunder runes, tightly holding it in his hand.
Meanwhile, inside the black hall, Wu Yue God witnessed the scene of the black snakes burning and became intrigued by the battle, which had not particularly concerned him until now.
"This power, is it that foolish bird from Fusang Island? No, not its true body, just carrying a breath of it, a mere semblance," Wu Yue God mused with interest, but he quickly lost interest again.
At the same time, Ni Mu released the possession of the Tongchen Puppet and flew back towards the command tent, transmitting his orders to his subordinates along the way.
He had barely started speaking when he raised his head and saw Xi Zheng and Free Venerable hovering in the sky, watching the battlefield of Yuhua City from a distance while waiting for him.
"What did Wu Yue God say?" Xi Zheng immediately asked upon his return.
Ni Mu raised his head to meet his gaze, quickly perceiving the flicker of worry deep in his eyes.
The commotion had naturally been noticed by Xi Zheng and the others, and as a father, Xi Zheng had almost instantly recognized the origin of the Golden Crow Illusion. At this moment, his heart was in turmoil, fearing that Ni Mu would suddenly turn against him and seize him.
Yet Ni Mu did not expose Xi Zheng's intentions, but pretended not to have noticed and reiterated Wu Yue God's instructions as if nothing happened.
"It looks like we should make our move too, or else we might struggle to fulfil Wu Yue God's requirements," Free Venerable immediately said.
"Hmm, it's just that the appearance of that Golden Crow Illusion was sudden, and with Wu Yue God's maneuver thwarted, while the great array is still intact, we may have to expend more effort," Ni Mu sighed.
"...You don't think that the probing just now was Wu Yue God's full extent, do you?" A hint of significance flickered in Free Venerable's eyes.
"Probing?" Ni Mu was taken aback, and then he suddenly felt a heavy weight on his shoulders, as if an invisible pressure had heavily descended upon him.
He immediately turned his head, only to see eight mountainous black giant palms parting the clouds in the sky, slowly pressing down towards Yuhua City. Each palm, whether in momentum or size, was no different from the one that appeared earlier.
Within Yuhua City, everyone looked up at the sky with faces of despair. A single black palm alone had already challenged Tianyinzi and the great array; now with seven or eight giant palms arriving simultaneously, what chance did they have of surviving?
But at that moment, in the midst of Yuhua City, Tianyinzi suddenly let out a long sigh, squeezing his right palm tightly and crushing the jade talisman to dust.
"Brother, I'm going ahead."
The next moment, endless thunder enveloped his body, and every street and house within Yuhua City simultaneously lit up with blue-white spirit light.
Electric arcs, like little snakes, appeared in every corner of the city, the cold white thunder illuminating the entire city, making it look like a blue sun without warmth, resting on the ground.
Within Yuhua City, countless tiny pieces of debris began to float up, and the hair of the cultivators in the city also moved without wind, pointing towards the sky.
Thunder moved and arcs flickered. In the blink of an eye, they all converged above Yuhua City. Like embroidery woven from bottom to top, from feet to head, in just the snap of a finger, a thunder giant stood tall above the city, and its face bore an eight parts resemblance to Tianyinzi.
At the same time, where Tianyinzi had just stood, as the thunder light dissipated, there was no trace of Tianyinzi's body, only his five Magic Treasures forlornly falling, as if they had lost their master.
He had merged himself with the formation, transformed into thunder.
Before anyone had time to mourn for Tianyinzi, they heard the thunder giant let out an angry roar and throw a punch towards the sky. Thunder roared, meeting the black giant palm in the air, and in an instant, a heaven-shaking boom erupted, dispersing one of the giant palms with a single blow.
However, the dispersed giant palm reverted to its old tricks, transforming into three black snakes that tried to bypass the giant and rush into the city.
Yet at this moment, the giant swung both arms and directly captured two of the black snakes. A surge of thunder in his hands turned them into ashes, and soon after, the giant looked towards the remaining black snake. With one stomp of his left foot, he leaped beside the black snake that couldn't flee in time, opened its mouth, and bit it into pieces with his teeth.
From scattering the black palm to killing the black snake, the thunder giant took only a few breaths. Compared to earlier, his might was truly frightening.
However, the other seven giant palms in the sky were not affected in the slightest and continued to press down on Yuhua City with a force like the collapse of mountains and overturning seas.
The crisis had not yet been resolved, and the thunder giant did not have much time left.
While everyone was worried about this, they saw the thunder giant's figure flash as if he had really turned into lightning, flickering frequently among the black giant palms.Findthischapter'ssourceon*.
He dispersed the black giant palms one after another, and the black snakes that split off from them were also unable to escape his interception.
Seeing this, a light shone in the eyes of the cultivators within Yuhua City, believing everything was settled. The next moment, the black giant palms suddenly accelerated. Even though the thunder giant desperately intercepted them, he could only manage to scatter five, allowing two to fall into the city.
However, just before they were about to touch the buildings of the city, a pale gray light suddenly shone from the center of the black giant palms. At first, there were only two small points of light, but in a single breath, they swelled, turning into two pale gray full moons that absorbed and swallowed the black giant palms.
The crowd stared blankly at this turn of events, at first thinking it was the handiwork of some Nascent Soul senior coming to the rescue. But in the next instant, the two pale moons shed vast dim moonlight onto the city, like a hazy misty gossamer, causing those it touched to plunge into deep slumber.
In an instant, most of Yuhua City's inhabitants were affected by the moonlight, falling into sleep while, outside the city, the sounds of battle rose as the Wu Yue Sect launched an attack.
Seeing this, the thunder giant in the sky was enraged. He furiously rushed towards the full moons, attempting to disperse them with his Thunder Power. But the moonlight approached him impartially and, upon touching his body, almost caused him to stop and nearly fall into slumber as well.
Within Yuhua City, Xi Ying's expression became solemn as she watched this scene. The pale gray moons were not a power the Great Black Sky God Palm could wield; they were surely a backup plan hidden within the divine skills of the Wu Yue God.
The situation now made it clear that Yuhua City was unlikely to hold. They must retreat to the last line of defense. But with so many lost in Yuhua City and so few cultivators left, how long could that last line of defense hold?
For a moment, she seemed to see the future where Chang Chun Temple would fall. She hesitated for an instant, thinking that Yuan Ming might have already begun his attack on Black Witch Mountain, but in the end, she clenched her teeth and made a decision.
Simultaneously, at the gates of Chang Chun Temple, Tian Jizi and other Nascent Soul cultivators watched the situation in Yuhua City through their Magic Treasures, feeling heavily burdened.
"Senior brother, we must use the Sect Protection Array," Ancestor Ming Quan bit out. "We can't let all these cultivators die in Yuhua City, otherwise, we're doomed to defeat!"
"The Wu Yue God's move is wicked and unpredictable. If we rashly use the Sect Protection Array and he seizes the chance to invade our gates, the consequences would be too dire to imagine," Tian Jizi sighed and shook his head.
Ancestor Ming Quan clenched his fists but knew Tian Jizi was right. Chang Chun Temple's gates were now the most crucial point; any decision that carried even a slight risk of losing them could not be carried out.
But just then, Wan Tianren started, suddenly pointing at the scene shown in the Magic Treasure.
"Wait, there's a new factor!" he exclaimed in surprise.
Everyone hurriedly looked over, only to see four Golden Crows wreathed in flames flying up from within Yuhua City. Ignoring the pale gray moonlight, they soared together into the heavens.
"Oh? Can't hold back any longer, hm? Then let me see what tricks you have up your sleeve," the Wu Yue God in the black hall also noticed the battlefield's change and chuckled lightly.

chapters.title: Chapter 718 - 689 Violent Blood
chapters.content:
In Yuhua City, all the cultivators who were still conscious looked up at the sky in unison, recalling the scene of the Golden Crows incinerating the Black Snake, and the extinguished flame of hope was once again ignited.
Under everyone's anticipation, the bodies of the four Golden Crows in the sky suddenly became blurry, transforming into the purest golden flames.
Each flame carried endless light and heat, illuminating both the sky and the earth, dispelling all darkness and subduing all bitter cold, warming the bodies and hearts of all present.
The clusters of golden flames spiraled in the heavens with increasing speed, showing signs of merging as the light they emitted grew ever more dazzling.
The twin gray moons appeared to sense a threat, and their pale moonlight instantly turned pitch-black, creating a dark surge in Yuhua City, like a tsunami churning, trying to swallow all the light and surging towards the golden flames.
However, the golden flames had already completely become brilliant suns, and as the dark surge rose like tidal waves crashing to the shore, it turned to dust the moment it drew close, with not a speck able to near the scorching sun.
More than that, from the sun erupted rings upon rings of golden fire, like hoops containing the berserk dark surge, ultimately shrinking it into oblivion.
Gradually, day broke, and all darkness melted away in the flames, the twin gray moons also became transparent, and finally, under the sun's relentless burning and shining, they completely exhausted their moonlight and dissipated into nothingness.
Sunlight touched every cultivator in Yuhua City, waking the slumbering ones with its warmth, who then opened their eyes anew, standing up bewildered as they bathed in the sunlight.
The Thunder Giant had also freed himself from the influence of the gray moons by this time, but whether time was up or not, its body began to deteriorate, with lightning arcs dissipating from the bottom up; yet the giant remained expressionless, only blankly looking up at the blazing sun overhead.
But in the final moment, just before the Giant completely vanished, Xi Ying saw through the blazing sun that the giant's lips moved slightly.
"Thank you." These were the Thunder Giant's last words left in the world, also the final parting words of the cultivator known as Tianyinzi as his soul dissipated.
Xi Ying did not respond. After ensuring that everyone in Yuhua City was awakened, he decisively ended his divine skill.
The blazing sun vanished abruptly, and Yuhua City once again fell into dimness, leaving the people somewhat disoriented by this sudden change. But then, the sky was again illuminated by a brilliant blue watery light.
Everyone looked at this scene in astonishment and then saw streams of resin-like water envelop them all, and before they could react, the scenery around them changed instantaneously, and they found themselves at the foot of Chang Chun Temple's mountain.
At the summit's main hall, Tian Jizi let out a sigh, retracted his spell from his hand, gave a nod to the few Chang Chun Temple Nascent Soul cultivators maintaining the Sect Protection Array, glanced once more at the Canghai Xuan Water Pearl positioned in the center as the array's core, and then turned and left the hall.
The Sect Protection Array of Chang Chun Temple, inherited for thousands of years, had effects beyond mere defense. The transference technique Tian Jizi had just used was only the tip of the iceberg, and this was precisely where his confidence lay in resisting the Wu Yue Sect's assault.
However, the saying goes that a protracted defense inevitably leads to failure, and even though he had absolute confidence in the Sect Protection Array, he could not place all his hopes on the Wu Yue Sect growing weary and retreating on their own.
Whether it was dispatching troops to harass or setting up defenses, he tried every means to weaken the Wu Yue Sect, to slow their advance, all for the hope of finding another possible winning strategy.
But now, everything came to naught.
Tian Jizi let out a deep sigh, then collected his emotions and continued orchestrating the various defenses, ready to face the Wu Yue Sect's final assault.
On the other side, within the army ranks of the Wu Yue Sect, Ni Mu and others witnessed the events that had just unfolded in Yuhua City. For a time, they were at a loss for words.
"Yuhua City is empty; there's no need to linger. Continue the advance on the gate of Chang Chun Temple. Also, the Soul Cultivator who took action in Yuhua City, you must bring him back along with everything on him. If necessary, the attack on Chang Chun Temple can be abandoned," the voice of the Wu Yue God suddenly sounded simultaneously in the ears of the three of them.
Ni Mu and the two others stiffened solemnly and immediately bowed in acknowledgment.
However, no one noticed that Xi Zheng's hand hidden under his sleeve was drenched in sweat.
...
At Black Witch Mountain, in the underground space.
Yuan Ming was currently in a secret chamber that stored Cultivation Technique Books. The varieties of classics here were vast, with seven or eight alone pertaining to Soul Cultivation Methods, not to mention Body Cultivation and Magic Cultivation Techniques, and countless secret techniques and forbidden arts. He did not have time to browse through them individually and thus collected them all in haste.
After sweeping the secret chamber clean of classics, Yuan Ming turned to leave.
He had just reached another spacious hall when eight shadows suddenly emerged from beneath the ground, encircling him in the center.
Out of the shadows came eight Black Armored Soldiers, each towering over ten feet tall, their entire bodies clad in Scale Armor, even their faces covered by visors, emanating a terrifying aura.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming did not dare to take it lightly and immediately called forth Vajra and Hua Zhi to stand with him against the enemy.
"Master, these guys look tough…" Hua Zhi remarked, feeling the fluctuations of the aura emanating from the individuals.
Vajra, however, had an eager look in his eyes, filled with a rising war intent.
"Master, let me test them out first." He spoke with a low shout and charged forward.
Based purely on their stature, none of those eight black-armored warriors could compare to him.
The moment Vajra charged over, two of the black-armored warriors promptly stepped forward to meet him. Each drew a black battle axe and a black warhammer from behind their backs and attacked Vajra from the left and right in a pincer movement.
The remaining six black-armored warriors stood their ground without moving, their eyes under the helmet lifelessly fixed on Yuan Ming and Hua Zhi as if they would not interfere unless those two made a move.
Yuan Ming knew Vajra was stimulated by his earlier battle with the Black Wind sandstorm and also wanted to improve his understanding of "Conception" through an exhilarating fight to the death, so he didn't intervene.
Hua Zhi was somewhat anxious, but seeing that his master said nothing, he too quietly waited at the side.
Vajra was suddenly shrouded in a layer of blood qi. A savage red light shone from his eyes, and his massive body proved to be unexpectedly agile as he easily dodged the battle axe from the warrior on the left with a slight shift in his stance.
Then he clenched his fist, which was charged with a great deal of strength, and a layer of dark light condensed around it as he took on the warhammer from his right, smashing towards it.
Yet, his control of the angle was so delicate that his fist was just slightly lower than the warhammer's head, striking precisely on the warhammer's handle.
A "bang" of a tremendous force was heard.
The black-armored warrior's warhammer shuddered violently, knocked back flying, dragging his body backward into a stumble.
Surprisingly, the warrior only took a step back, then stabilized his stance, still gripping the warhammer in his hand.
After his strike, Vajra did not pause but pursued the warhammer knight, dealing a punch straight to his chest.
His fist was gathered with Demonic Qi, and a dark light exploded into a small black cyclone blast, bursting the warhammer knight's chest, scattering his armor pieces, and slamming his body heavily onto the ground.
At the same time, the battle axe warrior rushed forth, his axe heading straight for Vajra's back.
A green light flashed over Vajra, and a set of bronze plated armor appeared at his chest and back, just in time to protect him, but was immediately hit by the axe blade, causing him to roll out of the way from the impact.
This life-for-life, injury-for-injury fighting style caused Hua Zhi to frown deeply while Yuan Ming's eyes inevitably narrowed slightly.
Vajra got up, and the bronze armored plates clanged as they broke and fell to the ground.
A streak of blood appeared on his back, but the injury was not serious.
However, when he turned his gaze to the warhammer knight, his eyes couldn't help but reveal a look of surprise.
He had just shattered the fellow's chest, thinking he could at least severely injure the opponent, yet the warhammer knight was already standing upright again, his chest wound healed as if he had never been injured.
"These two guys have strong physiques and the black armor on them is very strange, with a powerful regeneration ability. You must face them with all your strength," Yuan Ming's voice sounded in Vajra's ear at that moment.
Vajra was stunned for a moment and then nodded slightly.
He stood up straight, stretched his arms to loosen them, pressing on his back muscles to heal the wound on his spine rapidly.
Then the red light in his eyes suddenly intensified, and his hands moved in front of him into an embracing posture as he charged toward the two warriors.
After just two steps, a thick black stone pillar suddenly appeared in his embrace with a flash of dark light.Find thе trаnslаtiоn оn МV&LЕМРYR.
It was precisely the same one that Yuan Ming had brought out from the underground palace of Snake King Valley.
Vajra, holding the black stone pillar, rushed in front of the two black-armored warriors and unleashed a sweeping strike, releasing dense Demonic Qi from the stone pillar that enveloped the two warriors like a solid killing aura.
Both warriors experienced a moment of hesitation in their movements; by the time they reacted and tried to dodge, it was already too late.
However, they appeared unfazed, simultaneously stepping back to stabilize their stance. A vague glow lit up on their black scale armor as they swung their weapons, striking towards the black stone pillar.
A "boom" resounded loudly.
The entire underground hall vibrated intensely as the feet of the two black-armored warriors plunged deep into the ground like a plow, withstanding Vajra's nearly full-force blow.
Just as they prepared to counter-attack, their view was suddenly blurred, and Vajra, along with the black stone pillar, vanished from before their eyes.
Just now, when the black stone pillar blocked their vision, Vajra, who was embracing the stone pillar, had his eyes glowing with thick blood light, and his blood boiled, almost igniting.
He had initiated his "Violent Blood" Conception, not as he was during the battle with Yuan Ming, but his first time unleashing it fully.

chapters.title: Chapter 719 - 690: Human Puppet
chapters.content:
The Warhammer Knight and the Battle Axe Armor remained motionless for a moment as if looking for the suddenly missing Vajra. After a while, they came to their senses and suddenly looked up.
A gigantic figure had already leaped above them—it was Vajra indeed.
At that moment, Vajra was surrounded by a red mist that was thick yet did not disperse, enveloping him and containing all his radiating aura within it without a hint escaping.
Under the state of "Violent Blood" Conception, his attack power and speed had both significantly increased.
Now Vajra, from his cheeks to the top of his head and then to the hair on his back, had turned blood red due to Violent Blood, looking from afar as if cloaked in a crimson cape.
"Roar..."
Accompanied by an enraged roar, a layer of Blood Light enveloped the black Stone Pillar he held, which he then ferociously smashed downwards.
The two Black Armor Soldiers hurriedly swung their weapons upward.
With a bang.
The black Stone Pillar crashed down, bursting forth fresh blood and black armor pieces scattering in all directions.
The two Black Armor Soldiers were crushed into a pulp, with only their weapons falling beside them.
Seeing this, the remaining six Black Armor Soldiers began to move.
However, Yuan Ming and Hua Zhi were a step quicker and had already moved to protect Vajra at the center.
After that strike, Vajra also seemed drained, the blood color quickly receded from his body as he collapsed on the ground, his chest heaving fast—he couldn't move at all.
"Master..." He managed to utter just one word before he could speak no further. Thisfromthecollectionat*.
"You really know how to overdo it, you darn monkey," Hua Zhi couldn't help but scold.
But Vajra no longer had the strength to argue with her.
"Well done."
Yuan Ming showed a hint of a smile, praised him, and then casually waved, bringing him into the Shura Blood Devouring Map.
"Master, it's my turn now, I want to take on three," Hua Zhi, not willing to be outdone by Vajra, rolled up her sleeves preparing for a big fight.
"No need, just watch from the side," Yuan Ming said with a carefree smile.
He and Vajra actually had similar thoughts, having come across such suitable opponents, it would be a waste not to thoroughly battle them—how could he do justice to his previous grueling cultivation in the chasing Black Wind storm?
Moreover, his understanding of "Conception" was always slightly lacking, and this battle might just be the breakthrough opportunity he needed.
"Master, then let me cover for you," said Hua Zhi, feeling disappointed upon hearing this.
"Okay, but stay back farther and without my permission, do not intervene." As Yuan Ming spoke, he also transmitted a message to Hua Zhi, urging her to stay alert and prevent others from approaching.
Hua Zhi nodded and compliantly moved to a distant place.
Seeing this, the six Black Armor Soldiers did not relax their vigilance towards Hua Zhi; two of them stayed in place, keeping an eye on her.
The other four approached Yuan Ming.
Seeing this, Hua Zhi spread her hands, signifying she would not intervene, and then leaned against the wall, but silently thrust her roots into the ground.
At that moment, the two Black Armor Warriors clad in Black Scale Armor rushed towards Yuan Ming; the scales on their armor stood up, their muscles swelled beneath, and their arms thickened and lengthened, their fingertips sprouting sharp, black, claw-like blades.
"Whoosh"
Two gusts of wind sounded, and their speed suddenly increased, flanking him from both sides and instantly reached Yuan Ming's side.
Several black blades flashed with cold light in the void, crisscrossing and instantly tearing Yuan Ming's body apart.
But in the next instant, Yuan Ming's split figure blurred and dissolved into bubbles, disappearing without a trace.
Then, behind one of the Black Armor Soldiers, Yuan Ming's figure emerged out of nowhere, his fist smashing towards that soldier's neck.
Just as his fist was about to hit, a series of "whooshing" wind noises started from behind Yuan Ming.
A mass of black flames howled towards him, aiming straight for his back.
Yuan Ming's eyebrows furrowed slightly, but he made the same choice as Vajra, not to dodge.
Just as the black flames were about to hit him, Yuan Ming's fist landed first on the Black Armor Soldier's nape.
"Crack"
A sound of bone breaking echoed as the Black Armor Soldier's neck grotesquely bent forward, his head violently flinging backward.
Immediately after, Yuan Ming's back was hit by the Fireball, and he was flung outward with a bang.
Mid-air, he forcefully twisted his body and fell to the ground, his back immediately radiating a burning pain. Along with this, a subtle trace of Demonic Qi was making its way through the wound into his body.
"Demon Flames?" Yuan Ming was slightly surprised.
However, he did not care.
Now that he had become a Half-demon Body, this level of Demonic Qi invasion could not harm him at all.
Instead, the burning power of the flames exceeded his expectations. Given his current recovery ability, he was unexpectedly unable to heal the wound for a while.
"Crack, crack"
At that moment, a sound of bone friction arose.
The Black Armor Soldier, whose neck Yuan Ming had broken earlier, was slowly lifting his head backward. In just a few breaths, it had returned to its original state.
He twisted his neck left and right, but his body suddenly stiffened.
On his back, even in the places protected by Scale Armor, a seared wound had appeared, roughly the same size and location as Yuan Ming's.
The concept of "Shared Fate" had been activated when Yuan Ming had struck him earlier.
From that moment on, their fates had been tied together; all injuries Yuan Ming received, he would share as well.
The Black Armor Soldier tilted his head, seemingly puzzled about why he bore burn wounds.
But then he stopped caring and exchanged looks with the other three Black Armor Soldiers. The rest also took up attacking stances.
The two Black Armor Soldiers who hadn't acted yet suddenly had a gleam of fire in their eyes. Following that, plumes of black flames started emerging from the seams of their armors, transforming them into two figures of black fiery demons, emanating waves of Demonic Qi.
"Fellow Daoist Qi Ye, can you tell what these two are?" Yuan Ming communicated telepathically.
"Their aura is strange, carrying the scent of our Demon Clan, but it's not pure enough... they feel like living beings, yet also like puppets…" Qi Ye was also somewhat uncertain.
Hearing this, a light of realization suddenly flashed in Yuan Ming's mind, bringing forth the word "Human Puppet."
Previously, he had heard from Xi Ying that the Wu Yue Sect had eight Asuras, whose physical bodies were strong and battle prowess extraordinary, fearless of death. In fact, they were all Body Cultivators who had reached the Tongqiao Body level before being refined into "Human Puppets" using secret techniques.
After becoming Human Puppets, their strength not only remained but increased, retaining the robustness of their bodies and gaining additional powers.
Concerned about future encounters, Xi Ying's descriptions of these eight Asuras were exceedingly detailed.
The eight Asuras were all paired in refinement. The two previously killed by Vajra with the "Violent Blood" conception, known for their strength, were called "Giant Strength Asura." Those who transformed into blades were called "Ghost Blade Asura."
The two who had turned into figures of black fiery demons were "Demon Flame Asura," while those guarding Hua Zhi were called "Ghost Howl Asura."
The two Demon Flame Asuras charged at Yuan Ming first, molding a black Fireball in their palms as they ran and hurling it towards him.
The black Fireball sped towards him, and Yuan Ming swiftly dodged aside.
However, the moment the fireball neared his side, it exploded thunderously.
The dispersing flames instantly expanded, enveloping Yuan Ming within them.
The powerful impact sent him flying immediately, and before he could land, another fireball exploded in front of him.
Thus, Yuan Ming was thrust by the force, flung into the air again, and fell towards another side.
At his landing spot, a Ghost Blade Asura awaited, slashing two Ghost Claws that tore through the air, creating several black marks in mid-air and immediately slicing several bloody wounds on the arms Yuan Ming had used to guard himself.
Yuan Ming's body recoiled backward, while the Ghost Blade Asura sharing his fate endured the mysterious wounds appearing on his body and raised his Ghost Claw aiming for a thrust at Yuan Ming's back.
In mid-air, Yuan Ming sneered coldly. A long spear suddenly appeared in his hand, its tip facing his own chest, and he thrust it violently backward.
The Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear instantly pierced through his chest, its momentum unabated as it continued towards the figure behind him.
The Ghost Blade Asura sharing his fate hadn't reacted yet when his chest suddenly erupted in a spray of blood. His attack faltered under the excruciating pain, causing him to arch his back involuntarily.
Yuan Ming's long spear then pierced through his throat.
In mid-air, Yuan Ming forcefully twisted his body, reaching for the thrusting spear, while the bloody hole in his chest quickly healed under the envelopment of an ink-green glow.
The vast life force of the Undying Tree granted him formidable recovery capability and the confidence to harm himself and others.
The instant his arm grasped the spear, Yuan Ming's Mana surged into the weapon, stirring it single-handedly. The power of the stars burst forth from the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear, its dazzling light emitting tremendous power.
The head and chest of the Ghost Blade Asura exploded instantaneously. His shattered body fell forward, finally succumbing to death.
Yuan Ming flicked his hand casually, brushing off the stains on the spear, but suddenly heard a sharp, piercing howl.
It was as if a netherworld Evil Ghost had suddenly appeared, bellowing right next to his ears.
Although his Divine Soul Power was already quite substantial, the moment he suffered this ghostly howl, Yuan Ming still felt his Divine Soul being heavily struck. His mind went dizzy, and his vision momentarily darkened.
Vaguely, he saw three figures converging on him. In the midst of his confusion, he suddenly recalled how he had raced through the winds in the Black Wind Desert, surrounded by countless sandstorm tornadoes.
"Shared Fate, go feel the enemy's life," he suddenly remembered this phrase.
Yuan Ming immediately put away the Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear, closed his eyes, sank his thoughts, and stood with his arms hanging, feeling the trajectory of the three converging figures and capturing the aura they emitted.

chapters.title: Chapter 720 - 691: Body of Wanxiang
chapters.content:
In a flash, Yuan Ming suddenly moved. His footsteps twirling, his figure spinning and twisting, his fists flailing wildly; gusts of wind burst forth from his body, densely pounding towards the three men.
The blade of the Ghost Blade Shura swept through, and in the moment it crossed with the gusts, it was diverted to one side. The flames of the Demon Flame Shura, were even more torn apart by the gusts, scattering in all directions.
Almost instantly, the aura around Yuan Ming had completely transformed.
The gusts, as if alive, swirled constantly around his body, flipping and flying up and down, blocking every attack from the three men.
Hua Zhi originally wanted to help, but upon seeing this scene, she immediately retreated to the corner and frowned as she watched.
Seeing that the remaining Ghost Blade, Demon Flame, and the other three could do nothing to Yuan Ming, the two Ghost Howls Shura stopped paying attention to Hua Zhi and joined the battle as well.
Each held a black double-pronged fork in their hands, attacking Yuan Ming while simultaneously emitting piercing shrieks, continuously trying to assault Yuan Ming's Divine Soul.
However, at this moment, Yuan Ming's Divine Thought was entirely focused on sensing their movements; every tiny bit, every single motion, vividly presented before his eyes.
"Whoosh whoosh whoosh"
His fists roared through the air, shadows billowing like clouds; imperceptibly, the Shared Life Realm had enveloped the five Shuras attacking him.
No matter how high their spiritual intelligence, those five Shuras could not perceive it.
Gradually, Yuan Ming's shadow of fists grew denser, the gusts stronger, and his Fist Intent more refined, reaching the state where no one else existed to him, completely engrossed in his own world.
It was as if he himself was a raging Black Wind storm, and those five Shuras were merely grains of sand caught up in his storm, controlled entirely at his whim.
The attacks of the five Shuras got faster and more frantic, not by their own volition, but unconsciously driven by Yuan Ming.
But no matter how intense their attack, not once could they touch Yuan Ming.
"My lord has become so powerful!" Hua Zhi exclaimed upon witnessing this scene.
But then, the entire underground hall suddenly shook violently, the ground abruptly sinking downward, and an array of purple-black rose abruptly from the ground, countless black tendrils emerging and reaching for Yuan Ming and Hua Zhi.
Hua Zhi was startled; she had previously probed underground with her roots and vines and had noticed nothing unusual, yet she hadn't anticipated this Array's sudden emergence.
At that moment, an elderly Black Robed Elder, followed by a dozen Black Robed Cultivators, suddenly ran out from another passage.
He held a round Array Plate in his hands, operating it with a grave expression.
Hua Zhi hastily dodged the black tendrils, trying to move forward to assist Yuan Ming, but was forced to retreat step by step by the dense tendrils, the dozen Black Robed Cultivators also moving up to block her, preventing her from advancing.
Yuan Ming, immersed in the realm of Shared Life, did not react at first. His ankle was caught by a black tendril, causing his movement to falter, and the storm-like shadow of his fists and gusts were also disrupted.
In an instant, countless black tendrils surged crazily, seizing this opportunity to wrap around Yuan Ming's entire body, binding him layer upon layer like a rice dumpling, leaving only half of his body exposed.
"Kill him," the Black Robed Elder did not waste words, his command a chilling murmur.
The five Shuras did not hesitate at all, all furiously attacking Yuan Ming, who was immediately submerged in various assaults.
Unable to swing his fists, claws and blades, steel forks, ghost wails, and intense Demon Flames all hammered down on him, yet he seemed totally unaware, his eyes still tightly shut.
Gradually, various wounds began to appear on his body, and black Demon Flames burned on his skin. Even with the vitality of the Undying Tree supporting constant repair, it ultimately couldn't keep up with the frantic attacks of the five Shuras.
But just then, Yuan Ming's eyes suddenly snapped open.
The shackles that had been imprisoning him were finally undone at that moment.
From Yuan Ming's Dantian, a surge of intensely hot Power of the Sun burst forth, like a torch at the source, in an instant, igniting all the acupoints on his body.
The Power of the Sun that had been stored in the acupoints on his body also completely erupted in that moment.This version is sourced from MV3L3MPYR.
Yuan Ming felt himself burning up, not ignited by external Demon Flames, but a True Fire born from within, burning in his body.
His blood boiling, his body immensely hot, his temples throbbing like war drums, pounding with "thud, thud" sounds.
The Body of Wanxiang, was now!
Yuan Ming suddenly stood up, his body bursting forth with streaks of blood-colored flames striking the black tendrils that bound him.
The black tendrils touched the blood-colored flames and quickly disintegrated, like insignificant threads, easily torn apart, completely unable to bind him even slightly.
The attacks of the five Shuras were also blocked by the spouting Blood Flames.
Flames ignited in Yuan Ming's eyes as the Body Cultivation Methods and martial arts he had learned in the past flickered through his Sea of Consciousness like a montage, the blood light rapidly expanding, forming a Blood-colored Giant Elephant ten meters tall behind him.
He stepped forward, and the Blood-colored Giant Elephant swung its long trunk, as if to roar towards the sky, then lifted its legs high and stomped towards the two Demon Flame Shuras ahead.
With a thunderous roar, the entire underground hall shook violently.
Blood burst beneath the feet of the Blood-colored Giant Elephant, and the two Demon Flame Shuras shattered even more completely than those killed by a Vajra.
The remaining three Shuras, upon seeing this, didn't hesitate and quickly fled in all directions.
The Ghost Blade Shura, who had just run a few steps, found a figure enveloped in Blood Flames suddenly flash in front of him.
Yuan Ming grinned, stepped forward with a bow stance, and hurled a fist at him.
Immediately, a Blood-colored Giant Elephant charged out from behind him, smashing the Ghost Blade Shura into pieces.
The two Ghost Howl Shuras, seeing Yuan Ming catching up and unable to escape, turned around, tore off their masks, and revealed two somewhat similar, sallow and gaunt faces.
Then, they both opened their mouths, the upper and lower jaws stretching exaggeratedly, distorting and deforming their entire faces as they emitted a sharp, heart-wrenching scream from deep within their throats.
In an instant, two waves of sound, like tangible sharp knives, tried to pierce Yuan Ming's eardrums and tear apart his Divine Soul.
However, Yuan Ming, now a Body of Wanxiang, possessed no small resistance to such attacks, and his Divine Soul was immensely powerful. After only a brief moment of dizziness and headache, he quickly endured it.
As soon as the sharp sound waves weakened slightly, Yuan Ming used the Demon Elephant Flying Crossing movement technique and rushed in front of the two men, his iron fists simultaneously smashing into their chests.
The bodies of the two Ghost Howl Shuras exploded instantly, with flesh and blood spraying everywhere.
Under the strong impact, the entire underground hall shook violently, and spider-web-like cracks quickly spread across the ceiling and walls.
The Late-stage Nascent Soul elder, seeing this, became extremely panicked.
He didn't dare linger there any longer, shouted an order, sending a group of subordinates to attack Yuan Ming while he himself turned and dashed toward an entrance of a passage.
The Black Robed Cultivators, though terrified, dared not defy the elder's commands and all reluctantly charged at Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming, immersed in the joy of just having ascended to the Body of Wanxiang, felt as if he had endless energy.
Suddenly he turned, opened his mouth, and let out a roar.
"Roar..."
As he opened his mouth, an enormous head of a Blood-colored Giant Elephant also emerged behind him, raising its trunk and mimicking the roar.
The massive sound wave surged out, containing not only an incredibly powerful sonic wave but also Yuan Ming's Divine Soul Power. It instantly exploded in the cave like a thunderous boom from the Nine Heavens.
The relatively enclosed underground cave, acting like a natural megaphone, amplified Yuan Ming's voice tenfold. Under the relentless assault of the rolling sound waves, the Black Robed Cultivators were flung to the ground, fresh blood oozing from their eyes, ears, mouth, and nose, and they fainted.
The Black Robed Elder, who had just escaped into that passageway, was overtaken by the penetrating sound wave in the suddenly narrow passage. His Divine Soul violently shook and, unable to withstand it, he too collapsed.
"Master... Master..." Hua Zhi staggered over, clearly also somewhat affected.
Before she could finish speaking, a loud "boom" suddenly came from above.
The ceiling, unable to withstand the impact, collapsed.
Rocks and dust mixed together and fell en masse, pressing downward.
Yuan Ming, seeing this, grabbed Hua Zhi, flashed into the entrance where the Black Robed Elder was, and hurriedly picked up the elder by the back of his collar, running forward.
The sounds of the collapsing tunnel continued to come from behind, and billowing dust charged through the passage toward them.
Yuan Ming, carrying the two, ran a great distance before finally escaping the collapsed area.
By then, Hua Zhi had recovered, looking at the tunnel blocked with rocks behind them and then at her master, she joyfully said,
"Master, did you break through to the Body of Wanxiang?"
"Hmm, are you hurt?" Yuan Ming nodded and asked.
"No, I didn't take any action, I just got a bit dizzy from your sound wave earlier," Hua Zhi chuckled.
"Good, stay on guard here while I take care of something," Yuan Ming said.
"Okay," Hua Zhi immediately responded.
Yuan Ming didn't say more, and leading her, he found an empty secret room, raised his hand to set up an Array Plate, concealing their presence.
Then, Yuan Ming's body manifested wood patterns, his body elongated, soon showing the form of an Undying Tree. Hanging vines quickly wrapped around the Black Robed Elder, dragging him up and suspending him upside down.
About two hours later, a large cocoon hanging from the Undying Tree, amid a series of "crack" sounds, split open.
The figure of the Black Robed Elder fell down from it, crashing to the ground.
But he quickly got up, his gaze vacant and expression wooden, standing still nearby without any intention of fleeing.
By his side, Yuan Ming's body shrank back and resumed human form. He directly commanded the newly refined Tree Puppet,
"There is an area deep underground enveloped in strict forbidden restraints. Now, take me there."

chapters.title: Chapter 721 - 692: Magic Cloud Tree
chapters.content:
"Yes, Master." The Black Robed Elder replied and immediately turned to walk towards the exit of the secret chamber.
Yuan Ming waved his hand, withdrawing the prohibition and followed with Hua Zhi.
They passed through a series of corridors, heading deeper underground, encountering numerous fleeing Wu Yue Sect disciples along the way. But seeing the Black Robed Elder, they all panickedly saluted, calling out "Elder Pan Ji".
At Yuan Ming's instruction, the Black Robed Elder succinctly responded with one word each time: "Scram!"
The disciples often fled as if pardoned, few daring to ask further questions. Only one Black Robed Elder, sensing that something was amiss, stepped forward to inquire. The result, naturally, was Yuan Ming unhesitatingly blasting him away with a punch.
In less than the time it takes to finish a cup of tea, they had made their way downward to a spacious and empty underground hall.
At the entrance of the hall, there was a prohibition enshrouded in black light, which Elder Pan Ji casually unlocked.
As they entered the hall, Yuan Ming saw at its center a half-spherical forbidden light screen, ten zhang in radius, inverted on the ground.
It shimmered with multicolored brilliance, emitting an incredibly dense force of prohibition, and its contents were hazy and indiscernible.
"Open this prohibition," Yuan Ming ordered.
"Master, I only have the key to the prohibition of this hall, not of this Great Array's prohibition. Besides the Sect Hierarch, only the Nine Yin Venerable can open this Great Array," Elder Pan Ji said with a vacant look in his eyes, his tone wooden.
"Go, forcefully open it," Yuan Ming said, frowning slightly.
"Yes," replied Elder Pan Ji.
With those words, he stepped forward, waved his hand, and a pitch-black spiral cone appeared in his palm.
The cone was densely engraved with runes, exuding a sharp aura.
"Rise," Elder Pan Ji commanded in a low shout.
With his hands joined in front of him, the black cone rose into the air, spinning rapidly between his hands.
As the cone continued to spin, the runes on it lit up one after another, and a sharp and fierce power gathered from the spiraling cone to its tip.
Elder Pan Ji danced his hands, channeling all his mana into the cone and intoned woodenly, "Go."
The next instant, the black cone turned into a streak of black light and shot out, striking the forbidden light screen.
A loud "bang" resounded!
The light screen, impacted, distorted violently, with the hit area caving in to form a deep pit, seemingly on the verge of being breached.
However, at that moment, a circle of runes on the ground beneath the light screen lit up, and a surge of earthy yellow luminescence rose up, merging into the light screen.
The prohibition light screen, which had been about to break, suddenly surged in brightness and swelled outward abruptly.
The expansive radiance of multicolored light stretched outward, repelling the black cone back where it came from.
Struck by this force, Elder Pan Ji was sent flying with a "bang", crashing heavily into the stone wall.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming raised his hand and threw a punch forward, casually dispersing the incoming force.
"What a formidable prohibition," Hua Zhi remarked, unable to help but click her tongue in awe.
But Yuan Ming arched an eyebrow, a relaxed expression in his eyes.
He had observed Elder Pan Ji's attempt to break the prohibition in detail and had essentially figured out how this Great Array's prohibition worked.
The Great Array possessed both defensive and retaliatory capabilities. Ultimately, Elder Pan Ji had lost because his strength wasn't powerful enough, failing to breach it before the Array could retaliate.
Yuan Ming stepped forward, summoning the Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill and activating the Qi Blood Power within him to circulate wildly, emitting red steam from his body. He clenched his fists, took a step forward, and launched a punch at the forbidden light screen.
A deafening "boom" resounded!
A Blood-colored Giant Elephant materialized and charged at the forbidden light screen.
The earth shook fiercely as the multicolored prohibition light screen, rather than caving in as before, had its surface lights careen in disarray, clearly thrown off rhythm by the blow.
One punch had not shattered it, which was within Yuan Ming's expectations.
Hence, without pausing, he stepped forward, and another punch thundered out.
As the Blood-colored Giant Elephant collided again, the light screen appeared as if a layer of paint had been chipped off; a vast amount of the multicolored light flaked away, revealing an underlying layer of dull earthy yellow light.
Yet, it still refused to be broken through.
At that moment, the luminescence from the ground lit up, and a ring of rune light surged upward, with the array's counterattack about to launch.
But at that moment, Yuan Ming had already closed in on the array. Eager for swift action and with his punch charged to less than fifty percent, he struck again, emitting a thunderous roar.
The surging yellow light from the ground came to a sudden halt, and the multicolored prohibition light screen likewise shattered in response.
As specks of brilliant light dissipated into nothingness, the scene beneath the prohibition gradually became clear, revealing itself to Yuan Ming's eyes.
On the ground lay a twisted tree, black as a coiled dragon, towering over several zhang high, its canopy sprawling like a magnificent canopy, densely covered with black leaves.
Yuan Ming's eyebrows furrowed tightly as he felt the rich life essence emanating from the tree trunk, his heart inevitably filled with surprise.
At that moment, he suddenly raised an eyebrow as if he had discovered something, and quickly walked around the black ancient tree to the other side.
That's when he saw on the other side of the trunk, a section of the tree was indented inward. In that recessed hollow lay a person, curled up and lying at an angle.
Half of that person's body was embedded in the hollow, with arms crossed over the chest, the face buried within it, the entire body pitch black, as if fused into one with the entire tree.
Seeing this scene, Yuan Ming could not help tightening his scalp, which inevitably reminded him of the Undying Tree.
When he previously cultivated the Ju Mang Spirit Technique, he too had merged with the Undying Tree, a situation that was strikingly similar to what was before him now.
However, before he could take a closer look, Qi Ye's voice sounded in his Sea of Consciousness.
"Magic Cloud Tree, how could there be a Magic Cloud Tree here?" His voice was full of disbelief and amazement.
"You're saying this tree before us is a Magic Cloud Tree, not an Undying Tree?" Yuan Ming communicated through his Divine Soul.
"Having merged with the Undying Tree, can't you tell what an Undying Tree is? I can assure you with certainty, this one before us is definitely a Magic Cloud Tree," Qi Ye chuckled.
"Magic Cloud Tree, it should be exclusive to your Demon World, right? What characteristics does it have?" Yuan Ming inquired.
"Even in the Demon World, the Magic Cloud Tree is quite a unique existence. It not only contains a powerful life force but can also devour the Primordial Qi of heaven and earth, transforming it into Demonic Qi."
Hearing this, Yuan Ming did not pay too much attention; it was the black figure embedded in the tree that truly made him feel uncomfortable.
Thus, he once again activated the Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill and threw a punch toward it.
The Blood-colored Giant Elephant trumpeted furiously as it charged at the Magic Cloud Tree, its grand momentum shaking the void.
As if sensing the imminent crisis, the Magic Cloud Tree "shuddered," and both its trunk and leaves emitted rolling Demonic Qi that fused with a layer of grey light, forming a barrier to protect it.
However, having already achieved a Half-demon Body, Yuan Ming had held nothing back with his punch, and the formidable might of his Fist Power was near impossible to withstand.
A "bang" resounded.
The newly formed black barrier shattered instantly upon impact with the giant elephant.
The swirling Demonic Qi was dispersed by the punch's wind, scattering in all directions.
Yuan Ming frowned and delivered another punch.
This time, no Demonic Qi surged from the tree to form a barrier, but Yuan Ming was astonished to find that the black figure embedded in the tree suddenly moved. Cоntеnt sоurсеd frоm МV4LЕМРYR – Мy Virtuаl Librаry Еmpirе.
Sometime without notice, the figure had turned from its curled position facing the tree to now cover its ears with both hands, facing Yuan Ming.
The figure was emaciated, the face gaunt with tightly knitted brows, and the slightly twisted facial features indicated it seemed to be enduring some unspeakable pain.
Amid the howling sound, Yuan Ming's Fist Power scattered the Demonic Qi, heading straight for the figure's head.
But at that moment, the withered figure, which seemed lifelessly still, suddenly trembled at the eyelids and opened its eyes.
Yuan Ming only saw the thin lips of the other party moving up and down a few times before his Fist Gang "poofed" into nothingness in the void.
In the midst of his surprise, Yuan Ming's gaze met that of the black figure's eyes.
They were a pair of pitch-black eyes, without a hint of white, swirling with Black Mist within the pupils like two bottomless whirlpools.
In an instant, Yuan Ming felt as if his Divine Soul were about to fly out of his Sea of Consciousness, irresistibly drawn to those two swirling vortices of Black Mist, as if believing that was where he belonged.
"I so want to go..." A sigh from the Divine Soul resonated.
Yuan Ming snapped to awareness, his Divine Soul Power surging wildly to break free from that almost instinctual longing.
He hastily averted his gaze, not daring to lock eyes again, and immediately twisted his wrist, grasping the Soul Destroying Sword, and slashed a sword at the strange figure.
A black sword light swept across, transforming into an arc in midair and soaring toward the black figure.
The gaunt figure's eyes showed no spark of life, and its lips moved slightly again. The sword light that had nearly reached it once more "poofed," dissipating into nothing.
Yuan Ming felt a chill on his scalp at this sight.
He had not seen the black figure make a move, and he hadn't sensed any Mana fluctuations emanating from it.
But how was this accomplished?
Puzzled, Yuan Ming did not dare to approach any further but instead concentrated a Fireball on the tip of his finger, which quickly grew larger as the surrounding temperature rose sharply.
As Yuan Ming tossed the Fireball with a single hand gesture, it "whooshed" towards the black figure.
As the Fireball neared within a foot of the black figure, it paused as if blocked by something.
Without waiting for the black figure to employ that mysterious ability again, Yuan Ming shouted fiercely, "Explode."
The next moment, the Burning Explosion Skill was activated. The fiery Fireball erupted violently, a blaze lighting up the sky, and an intensely hot force spread out, churning up a scorching airwave.
Yuan Ming had infused his own Power of the Sun into the Burning Explosion Skill, hence the tremendous might.

chapters.title: Chapter 722 - 693 Speak and Follow
chapters.content:
Although the firelight burst, Yuan Ming showed no joy on his face because the exploding firelight was also blocked by an invisible barrier, leaving the dark figure unharmed.
However, this was all within Yuan Ming's expectations.
Through the range of the spreading firelight and the shape of the obstruction, he made out the invisible barrier encircling the dark figure at a distance of about a foot, which wasn't very large.
Understanding the situation gave Yuan Ming some confidence, and he quickly made a decision.
Since neither magical powers nor Soul Destroying Sword Energy could damage the barrier, he would have to forcefully break through and try using the Body of Wanxiang to shatter this defense.
With his plan in mind, Yuan Ming immediately grasped the Soul Sword tightly with his five fingers, his body transforming into a shadow that merged with the ground.
The next moment, his figure suddenly burst out from the shadow beside the dark figure, his Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill madly circulating, Qi Blood Power boiling within him. His hand was already clenched in a fist, ready to strike.
But just at this critical moment, the voice of Qi Ye, almost roaring, resounded in his Sea of Consciousness:
"Wake up! Yuan Ming, you've been tricked…"
Yuan Ming frowned, momentarily uncertain whether this voice was real or fake, but out of caution, he ultimately did not throw the punch he had readied.
He retreated explosively backward by over ten steps before trying to communicate with Qi Ye using his Divine Thought.
However, he quickly realized that there was no response.
He carefully assessed his own condition and found nothing unusual.
But suddenly, Yuan Ming was startled, then realized with shock that the lack of any anomaly was the greatest anomaly of all.
He had been battling the strange entity within this Magic Cloud Tree for half a day, yet he hadn't felt any depletion in his Qi Blood Power.
After advancing to the Body of Wanxiang, his sensitivity to his own body had become extremely keen. It was based on this that he could perfectly control his body, so after each action, he was clearly aware of the changes in his Qi Blood within.
But this time, there were no changes; his Qi Blood hadn't depleted in the slightest.
There was only one reason this could happen, that is, he was not in reality, but inside an illusion.
From the moment he faced those pitch-black eyes, he had fallen into an illusion.
What he previously thought was escaping from the illusion was actually part of the illusion. From the beginning to the end, he had never escaped the control of the illusion.
Since reaching the Soul Cultivation Realm of a Half-step Spoken Witch, Yuan Ming had always been very confident in his Divine Soul Power, which led to his carelessness this time, costing him dearly.
He hurriedly circulated the Moonlight Technique, concentrating all his Divine Soul Power, trying to break through the illusion.
For a brief moment, he experienced an indescribable feeling of suffocation, and it seemed like a wave of intense pain swept over him.
But that feeling vanished in a flash, replaced by a false sense of everything being calm and stable.
Alarm bells rang wildly in Yuan Ming's mind; he knew he was definitely caught in a deep crisis, and any slight mistake from now on could potentially doom him forever.
However, no matter how he urged his Divine Soul Power, he could not break out of the illusion.
Thinking back to that sensation of suffocation, Yuan Ming no longer hesitated and began to madly stimulate the Origin Power of the Undying Tree within his body, his body visibly swelling and expanding as wood patterns emerged.
The next instant, Yuan Ming's surroundings transformed again.
He then realized that he was suspended in mid-air, completely entangled in vines from the black ancient tree and hung up like a rice dumpling. A vine tightly coiled around his neck, attempting to strangle him.
Not far from him, Hua Zhi and Elder Pan Ji were also trapped by the vines, hanging from the tree.
This is part of a series from * (*).
But his body quickly transformed into a tree-man, causing the vines to no longer restrain his neck. Instead, the vines binding him were stretched apart.
Yuan Ming controlled his body as it plummeted down, rooting himself quickly after landing. The hanging vines from the branches turned into Spiritual Snakes, lunging at the Magic Cloud Tree.
The vines from the two trees immediately entangled, tearing and slashing at one another.
The scene resembled two women grabbing each other's hair and fighting; it didn't take long before the vines were torn to pieces and leaves fell all around, creating a mess.
Yuan Ming vigorously directed his vines toward the dark figure within the Magic Cloud Tree, trying to bind and refine it.
The person in the Magic Cloud Tree seemed to intend to devour the Undying Tree as well, directing his vines to entwine towards Yuan Ming. The two sides devoured each other, momentarily at a stalemate.
Seeing that he couldn't get the upper hand, Yuan Ming immediately extended a tendril to grab the Soul Sword and slashed towards the Magic Cloud Tree.
Free from the illusion, he believed that as long as he could severely damage the opponent's Divine Soul, he could devour the Magic Cloud Tree.
The Curse Rune within the Soul Sword flashed with light, and a streak of black sword energy spun out, heading straight for the withered figure within the Magic Cloud Tree.
When the sword energy approached within three feet of the figure, its lips slightly parted and moved faintly.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming instantly had a bad feeling.
The next moment, the streak of Soul Destroying Sword Energy vanished into thin air.
"Damn, could it be that I'm still not out of the illusion?" Yuan Ming's heart tightened, and he immediately tried to contact Qi Ye.
But after a long wait, there was still no response.
Just as Yuan Ming began to despair, the voice of Qi Ye finally emerged leisurely from his Sea of Consciousness:
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, are you finally awake?"
Yuan Ming responded uncertainly, "Fellow Daoist Qi Ye, can you be sure I'm truly awake?"
"What do you mean by that?" Qi Ye asked, puzzled.
"The person in this Magic Cloud Tree has extraordinary Divine Soul Power. I can't be sure if I have escaped his illusion," Yuan Ming said, then felt somewhat ridiculous.
If he was indeed still in an illusion, this conversation would be no different from talking to himself.
"I had to use the Chaotic Soul Demon Sound at the cost of damaging my Divine Soul to wake you up. I believe with your Divine Soul Power, as long as you remain alert, you won't fall into the illusion again," Qi Ye said after brief contemplation.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming's mind settled a bit. After checking his condition, he noticed that both his Divine Soul Power and Bloodline Power were depleted, and the sensations from the various wounds on his body were clear and distinct, which reassured him slightly.
However, a bigger question arose, how did that fellow neutralize his attack?
Yuan Ming suppressed the doubts in his heart and once again commanded the vines to wrap around the Soul Destroying Sword, slashing towards the withered man.
The moment the sword light rose, several vines shot out immediately, wrapped around the vines ensnaring Hua Zhi and Elder Pan Ji, and forcefully pulled them to safety.
He then swiftly retracted his form, regaining his human shape, escaped from the entanglement of the Magic Cloud Tree, and backed away.
The attack of the Soul Destroying Sword failed as expected, quietly dissipating three feet away from the shadowy figure.
After standing at a distance, Yuan Ming avoided staring directly into the eyes of the person in the Magic Cloud Tree, instead locking on him with his Divine Thought.
With a thought, he ordered Elder Pan Ji, who had become a Tree-man Puppet, to close in for an attack.
Elder Pan Ji, now a puppet, could not resist and immediately grabbed a pitch-black long sword, charging toward the withered man in the Magic Cloud Tree.
As he approached, the hanging vines on the trunk attacked him right away.
Yuan Ming was prepared for this: he raised his hand, and his fingers instantly transformed into vines, blocking the attack from the Magic Cloud Tree and allowing Elder Pan Ji to reach the withered man unimpeded.
Elder Pan Ji moved swiftly, and within a few dodges, he was close to the trunk of the Magic Cloud Tree. He raised his sword, dark light gathering on it, and fiercely stabbed towards the chest of the withered man.
Yuan Ming watched intensely, his gaze firmly on the withered man's lips, concentrating his Divine Thought there.
Soon, the withered man's lips moved.
Yuan Ming read from the lip movement and heard a faint whisper in his ears: "All beings are equal."
As the words fell, Yuan Ming's gaze abruptly sharpened, surprised to find that the connection between him and Elder Pan Ji was severed.
The empty gaze in the eyes of Elder Pan Ji in front of him lost its last bit of luster, and he collapsed forward.
"What Divine Skill is this?" Yuan Ming was astounded.
With just a single sentence, that withered man caused his control over the Tree-man Puppet to fail.
He stared at Elder Pan Ji for a long while, his brows furrowing tighter and tighter.
"Master, let me try to help you again," Hua Zhi, having just broken free from the illusion, saw this scene and volunteered.
Yuan Ming shook his head: "I haven't figured out what's going on yet; don't act recklessly for now."
Hua Zhi did not disobey, nor did she act rashly.
Her feet rooted into the ground as vine roots extended out and suddenly broke through the ground in front of the Magic Cloud Tree, stealthily attacking the withered man.
The withered man spoke again, his voice faint: "One year, one wither."
As the words landed, the vines protruded by Hua Zhi withered at a visible speed, quickly wilting away.
The withered traces followed the vines and rapidly spread underground.
Hua Zhi, frightened by this scene, hastily severed her roots and jumped back.
Yuan Ming's brow furrowed, and a sharp glint shot from his eyes.
He put away the Soul Destroying Sword, took out the Thunder God Hammer, and the God Bombarding Cone, raised them high, and smashed down on the withered man.
"Sizzle" a burst of electric light sounded.
A thick column of purple-gold Thunder light descended from the sky, striking towards the withered man.
"Magic does not survive," the withered man exclaimed.
The next moment, the Thunder light column that had reached above his head explosively dissipated, turning into fine threads of electricity, floating in mid-air briefly before quickly vanishing.
Yuan Ming's gaze deepened, and he took a deep breath.
"Master, have you figured out what's going on?" Hua Zhi, noting the change in Yuan Ming's expression, immediately came forward to ask.
"Spoken Witch, words break life and death, speak and follow," Yuan Ming said gravely.
Hearing Yuan Ming's response, Hua Zhi's face turned pale; having been with Yuan Ming for not a short time, how could she not know what a Spoken Witch was?
"How are we supposed to fight this?" she couldn't help saying pessimistically.

chapters.title: Chapter 723 - 694: The Path to Victory
chapters.content:
"Xi Ying once said that Spoken Witches are divided into different levels of strength based on their Cultivation Realm," Yuan Ming looked at the withered man, saying.
"So, is there still a chance to fight?" Hua Zhi's eyes lit up slightly.
"I observed his condition and it seems unusual, as he exists symbiotically with the Magic Cloud Tree, which indicates that he is not a true Spoken Witch. Besides, considering the results of the previous attacks, his 'speak and follow' influence is limited to a three-foot radius. There's still a chance to defeat him," Yuan Ming contemplated.
"Then what do you want me to do?" After hearing his analysis, Hua Zhi didn't quite understand but felt there must be some truth to it.
Yuan Ming knitted his brows in silence, thought for a moment, then waved his hand, and the Shura Blood Devouring Map rustled as it unfolded, with Blood Shadow and Hong Ling emerging and flying out at the same time.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan." Both of them cupped their fists at the same time.
Yuan Ming briefly explained the situation to the two, and Blood Shadow immediately said with a smile, "So, you mean we should all attack at the same time, preventing him from casting his 'speak and follow' Divine Skills, right?"
"Exactly," Yuan Ming nodded.
As his words fell, the four of them, including Hua Zhi, dispersed and attacked the withered man from different angles.
At the moment of their charge, the withered man also seemed to sense the crisis. The Magic Cloud Tree shook violently, its vines lashing out like crazy towards them.
The four maneuvered and dodged the assaulting vines, approaching closely.
Hua Zhi saw several vines stabbing at her like spears and immediately transformed her hands into vines to form a pitch-black Round Shield in front of her, charging towards the withered man with her body leading the way.
On the other side, Blood Shadow swung his Blood Transformation Saber, sending a blood-colored saber light flying diagonally towards him.
Hong Ling frowned slightly as she flipped her wrist, and a burst of red light surged out, aiming straight at the target.
In front of the withered man, Yuan Ming gripped the Soul Destroying Sword, swinging it in a slashing strike.
The three of them, attacking from different directions, kept a cautious distance of several meters from the withered man in the center of the Magic Cloud Tree, fearful of entering the range of his 'speak and follow' Divine Skills.
Only Hua Zhi, remembering what Yuan Ming said about the three-foot range, plunged headlong into the fray.
The three Daoist Techniques reached him first, but as they approached, the withered man suddenly shouted, "Magic shall not persist!"
This voice was much louder than any before, and before the three Daoist Techniques could get within a zhang of his body, they disappeared into thin air with a 'poof.'
"So his range has indeed expanded…" A chill went through the three simultaneously.
"Hua Zhi, come back quickly..." Yuan Ming called out loudly in a hurry.
It was too late, however, as Hua Zhi barged right in front of the withered man, her black shield rushing fiercely towards him.
Yuan Ming frowned but then noticed that Hua Zhi's attack hadn't dissolved, his eyes immediately revealing a hint of delight.
"Six Senses beclouded," the withered man's voice rang out again.
Hua Zhi, so close at hand, suddenly swerved off course, staggering like a drunken fool, missing her target and thudding into the void on the other side of the Magic Cloud Tree, tumbling out.
Several tree vines immediately stabbed towards her back.
Hua Zhi reacted fast, spinning the black shield behind her in an emergency. However, due to the disruption of her Six Senses, her movement was severely misshapen, and under forceful control, she managed to bring it to the right side of her back only.
Two of the vines pierced the shield, shattering it into pieces.
The other several vines stabbed directly into Hua Zhi's back, preparing to drag her back up the tree.
At that moment, a blood shadow flashed, and Yuan Ming arrived like a shadow, slashing the vines with his sword and retreating with Hua Zhi back to their original position.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, it won't work. His 'speak and follow' Divine Skills are not just aimed at one person; any magic, he can nullify all at once," Blood Shadow commented.
"However, it seems that he wasn't able to dissolve Hua Zhi's attack?" Hong Ling pondered.
"That's because Hua Zhi's attack wasn't a Daoist Technique and thus couldn't be obliterated just with the words 'Magic shall not persist,'" Yuan Ming said with a grin.
"Indeed, it seems he also said 'Six Senses beclouded' after that. Is that a word spell to confuse perception?" Hong Ling asked.
"Yes, he has to use different word spells to deal with two different forms of attacks," Yuan Ming nodded.
Upon hearing this, a bright smile lit up Hong Ling's face: "So, it's not about the number of attackers; it's the diversity in the methods of attack that's key."
"So, if we use different methods of attack, we can keep him too busy to counter with word spells at the same time?" Blood Shadow realized, speaking out.
Yuan Ming shook his head upon hearing this, saying, "The vulnerability might not be that significant."
"Why do you say that?" Hong Ling asked, puzzled.
"In reality, there are only three distinct types of attack: Body Technique attacks, Daoist Technique attacks, and Divine Soul attacks. For instance, whether it's magic, Magic Treasures, or talismans, no matter how diversely they're used, they'll all be affected by the phrase 'Magic shall not persist.' Moreover, we still don't know whether his 'speak and follow' can act directly upon a person," Yuan Ming mused.
There was a graver concern he hadn't voiced because he knew that with the power of a Spoken Witch, one could determine life or death with a single word.
Of course, the consumption it caused to the caster's Divine Soul was also tremendous.
But to cast a word spell powerful enough to dictate life and death with a single utterance, one must be sufficiently close, or in physical contact with the target; otherwise, it is very difficult to be effective.
This was also the reason Yuan Ming, after regaining his human form, chose to maintain his distance and avoid close combat.
"Continuing to guess isn't the solution. Let's try attacking again. I'll go in for a body technique attack. If it doesn't work, I, Blood Shadow, will just escape with Blood Shadow Flee. The two of you, one with magic and the other with divine soul attack, let's see the effect first," Blood Shadow said, growing impatient.
"That is feasible," Yuan Ming replied, frowning in thought for a moment before nodding in agreement.
As he spoke, Blood Shadow's figure immediately transformed into a blood light and in the blink of an eye appeared in front of the withered man, with the Blood Transformation Saber in his hand glowing brilliantly as he slashed horizontally at the man's head.
