Hong Ling followed closely, flicking her wrist and shooting a straight red beam of light.
Yuan Ming had already pressed his hand to his forehead and pointed forward, launching a soul crow wrapped in the All Living Beings Dream Rune at the withered man's forehead in a soul collision.
The withered man's black eyes showed no sign of change as he muttered lowly, "Six senses unclear."
The blade of Blood Shadow immediately lost its aim, missing the withered man's side and slashing at the empty air.
Immediately after, the man spoke again, "Magic nonexistent."
Hong Ling's attack dissipated out of thin air.
However, before he could speak the third word spell, Yuan Ming's soul crow had already crashed headfirst into his Sea of Consciousness.
The withered man's head jerked backward sharply.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming was overjoyed and immediately harnessed the power of the All Living Beings Dream Rune, casting an Illusion Technique in an attempt to control him.
Yet, in the next instant, his expression froze, and he soon witnessed the Magic Cloud Tree in front of him grow a thousand times bigger, with the withered man's body also swelling a thousandfold.
Standing beneath the giant figure, he felt as insignificant as an ant, instantly filled with the thought that he was unable to prevail.
However, after a moment of panic, Yuan Ming quickly came to his senses and urgently called back the soul crow.
Only then did the illusion in front of him finally vanish.
"Such formidable Divine Soul Power, truly worthy of someone capable of casting 'speak and follow the law' Divine Skills," Yuan Ming remarked as his sight returned to normal, taking a deep breath and revealing a wary look in his eyes.
Blood Shadow and Hong Ling both retreated and asked, "Failed again?"
"That fellow is very likely to have reached the Realm of Word Witch; my Illusion Technique can't control him. However, I've noticed that his Soul Power seems to have weakened," Yuan Ming said thoughtfully with furrowed brows.
"Why do you say that?" Hong Ling asked, puzzled.
"When I first saw him, I was controlled by his illusion. I struggled to break free from the illusion, but it wasn't as easy as it was just now," Yuan Ming explained.
Previously, when he locked eyes with the withered man, if it had not been for the power of the Undying Tree transforming him into a tree form, he could not have freed himself from the illusion; this time, however, he awoke from it quite easily.
"This indicates that casting his word spell actually consumes a great deal of Soul Power. As long as we significantly deplete his Soul Power and he can no longer cast word spells, that will be our moment of victory," said Hong Ling, her eyes lighting up.
"Exactly," Yuan Ming agreed with a nod.
"It's also fortunate that he's closely connected to that tree and cannot leave to attack. Otherwise, he would be even more difficult to deal with," Blood Shadow said sincerely.
Having settled on a strategy, the three of them began to take turns employing their Divine Skills, attacking the withered man.
When Hua Zhi had recovered a bit, she too immediately joined the assault.
As Yuan Ming attacked, he also stimulated the Qi Observation Technique, carefully watching the changes in the withered man.P#u@bl^icat^io.n! co@ur&t@esy of M|V&|*L-E-&M#PY!R.%
About an hour later, he noticed that the range within which the withered man could cast his word spells had shrunk by more than half, and the power of the spells was much reduced.
Several times, their attacks were only weakened by the word spells, but didn't completely disappear.
When Yuan Ming saw once again that the red light cast by Hong Ling had been weakened into a faint glow and scattered on the body of the withered man, he knew the opportunity had arrived.
After signaling with telepathy, Yuan Ming waved his hand, and the Night Parade of Hundred Demons unfurled in mid-air, with countless evil ghosts rushing out eagerly toward the withered man.
"Begone, hundred ghosts," the withered man shouted with a voice strained to the breaking point.
Many ghosts turned into a mist and vanished, but many did not disappear, showing that his power was greatly overtaxed and his word spell's potency was severely diminished.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming and the others hesitated no longer and launched their attacks with full force.
Hong Ling waved her hands, shooting red beams from various angles in rapid succession.
The Magic Cloud Tree seemed to dance like a host of demons as it brandished its vines and branches toward the red beams.
Following close behind, the blade light from Blood Shadow granted no reprieve, continuously hacking down one after another.
Yuan Ming waved his hand, launching several Fireballs imbued with the Power of the Sun, flitting up and down as they collided with the withered man.

chapters.title: Chapter 724 - 724: 695 Evil Ghost Swallows Name
chapters.content:
"Magic... is no more." Faced with the swift attack of Yuan Ming and the others, the withered man struggled to utter this sentence.
The attacks of the three lost their power at the moment of approach, and their spirit light dispersed.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming didn't panic but instead smiled, because he knew that the withered man was already at the end of his rope.
A glint flashed in his eyes, and under the urging of his thoughts, Elder Pan Ji, who had been lying motionless on the ground, suddenly rolled over and thrust a black long sword towards the withered man.
This time, the man was completely unprepared, and his chest was directly pierced by the long sword.
In fact, Yuan Ming had realized a quarter of an hour ago that the connection between himself and Elder Pan Ji, this tree puppet, had been restored.
But he had held back all this time, just waiting for this opportunity.
As the long sword pierced the withered man's heart, a streak of blood light slashed across, instantly flashing past the withered man's neck.
There was a "crack" sound.
A dark head flew up, bringing down the Magic Cloud Tree behind it as well.
As the Magic Cloud Tree collapsed, the vines that had spread from it immediately retracted and disappeared completely.
Yuan Ming quickly stepped forward, grabbed the black head off the ground, and threw it into the Shura Blood Devouring Map to temporarily seal it.
After that, he then looked at the fallen tree trunk and the stump connected to the withered man's body.
After a brief moment of thought, Yuan Ming waved his hand and stored them in separate storage magic tools, planning to study them in detail after leaving this place.B%roug+ht# to you by MV.6+L&EM.P*Y6R.@
...
Chang Chun Temple.
The rain had stopped, and the clouds in the sky had all dispersed, but the sun had already set, leaving only a crescent moon and a few stars hanging high in the sky, casting a sprinkle of silver radiance.
Under the night sky, the Sect Protection Array of Chang Chun Temple was constantly emerging with azure spirit light, rippling like water waves, or surging like a tsunami, filling the valleys between the mountains as if the sea had flooded the land, turning the mountain ranges into a marshland.
After the battle at Yuhua City, the Wu Yue Sect's army did not pause for a moment and went straight to the gates of Chang Chun Temple, launching a fierce attack on the Sect Protection Array.
This time, their attack was without reservation. All Nascent Soul cultivators of Wu Yue Sect joined the battle, and Ni Mu and two others took action personally, employing strategies to try to breach the Array.
Naturally, the Cloud Desolation Alliance did not stand aside, and apart from Tian Jizi and several Nascent Soul cultivators who were responsible for controlling the Array, the rest chose their opponents and engaged them under the protection of the Array.
The battle became intense right from the start.
Both sides were almost blinded by rage; there were no calculations, no arrangements, no strategies—everyone had only the thought of killing their opponent in their minds.
Outside the Great Array, a huge golden puppet silently swung its fists, pounding heavily on the Array time and again. Each time its fist fell, the part of the Array that came in contact with the fist would quickly turn to metal, and even the intangible Spiritual Energy would instantly be converted into heavy gold and iron.
However, the Array was not an inanimate object; the azure spirit light flowed like river water, constantly moving and winding, and whenever a part turned metallic, the Array would quickly shift, moving the metallic part elsewhere to prevent the puppet from exploiting it.
But stalling was never a long-term strategy. Even with its thousand changes, facing a golden puppet that could assimilate everything, the Array seemed powerless.
Fortunately, this huge golden puppet was not without its consumptions; it constantly required a massive supply of spirit stones to provide Spiritual Power.
Not far away, a dazzling sword light streaked across the sky, slashing towards Ni Mu, who rapidly formed hand seals, and his body flashed with spiritual energy. It seemed like nothing had changed, but when the sword light passed, it only split a wooden puppet in half, which fell from mid-air.
"Hehe, Ni Mu, you've hidden your capabilities quite deep. Such strategies have never been exposed before. Now that you are going all out, it really surprises me. It's just too bad that such talent is subservient to the Wuyue God, content to be a puppet at his behest. It's truly unwise." Wan Tianren spoke while continuously unleashing three sword lights, slashing towards Ni Mu, who appeared on another side.
"At this point, Wan Tianren, why bother with such verbal disputes." Ni Mu shook his head, raised his hand, and blocked the sword light with a magic artifact.
"Ni Mu, think for yourself—the Wu Yue Sect takes Soul Cultivation as its foundation. Even if it seized the world in the future, as a Magic Practitioner, you might not be able to hold a high position for long. Besides, I can see that your puppet perhaps has even further potential. Tell me, if Chang Chun Temple is demolished, would the Wuyue God still keep an existence that might threaten his position?" Wan Tianren continued trying to disturb Ni Mu's state of mind with his words.
"Threaten him? Haha, Wan Tianren, the fact that you can say that shows that you still don't understand him well," Ni Mu's face, however, revealed a self-mocking smile.
Seeing this, Wan Tianren suddenly grew puzzled. He had dealt with Jin Chao many times, and compared to other cultivators, he had a deeper understanding of the power at the Returning to Void Stage. Although the divine skills of the Wu Yue god were strange, they hadn't reached a despairing level yet.
So what exactly was it that made Ni Mu so fearful?
No sooner had this thought crossed Wan Tianren's mind than he suddenly felt a strong palpitation, causing a brief moment of chaos in his spiritual power.
In the battlefield of the Nascent Soul Stage, even a moment's mistake could be fatal. However, Ni Mu did not seize the opportunity to counterattack; instead, he abruptly turned his head to look behind him, his face mirroring Wan Tianren's shock and fear.
Meanwhile, from the black palace at the rear of the Wu Yue Sect's army, an extremely furious divine soul fluctuation suddenly erupted. The Wu Yue Sect cultivators who were stationed near the palace were swept by this fluctuation, and anger appeared on their faces.
But immediately after, the anger turned into pain. Blood swiftly poured from their eyes, ears, mouth, and nose, and with a collective scream of agony, they all collapsed to the ground.
Just then, the doors of the black palace burst open. Accompanied by a frenzied black wind, a tall figure enveloped by black smoke flew out and shot straight into the sky.
The battlefield instantly quieted down. At that moment, everyone felt an unprecedented sense of crisis. Instinctively, they turned their heads, looking towards the figure isolated high above, with eyes like the moon.
"Wu Yue God? Is he finally going to take action personally?" Inside Chang Chun Temple, Tian Jizi clenched his fists, his heart on high alert.
Unexpectedly, after the appearance of the Wu Yue God, he did not speak or launch an attack on the Great Array of Chang Chun Temple. Instead, he turned his back on everyone, staring intently into the distance with a fierce gaze.
"This is..." Ni Mu noticed that the Wu Yue God was looking towards the direction of Black Witch Mountain, and immediately, his heart skipped a beat.
And the next instant, everyone saw the Wu Yue God suddenly raise his hand, using his finger as a brush, he drew a horizontal line in the void.
In an instant, the sky changed color, and a black Abyss suddenly split open beneath the Wu Yue God's feet. The roaring wind sounded like the whisper of evil spirits, chaotic and noisy, causing headaches to those who heard it.
At the same time, the Wu Yue God also uttered a strange syllable, and anyone who heard this syllable felt their divine soul violently shake, as if impacted by some external force, and they experienced a moment of dizziness.
At this moment, everyone's divine sense was frantically warning them to stop looking further, yet they also felt an inexplicable attraction, making it nearly impossible for them to shift their gaze, and they could only stare blankly at the Wu Yue God's movements.
"No, don't look, block divine sense and all senses!" Ni Mu, using his willpower, forcibly shifted his gaze, sealed off his senses, and shouted aloud, his voice spreading across the battlefield.
Wan Tianren also broke free from watching the Wu Yue God's actions. Hearing Ni Mu's words, he didn't even have time to think and also sealed off his senses, shouting out the words again.
At that moment, on the battlefield, whether they were Wu Yue Sect cultivators or Yunhuang Alliance Cultivators, everyone desperately tried to resist the temptation and seal their divine sense, but except for those with great willpower, the rest not only failed to shift their gaze but even became more obsessed with watching the Wu Yue God's movements.
At this time, the Wu Yue God continued to write characters in midair, each stroke particularly forceful. And from his mouth, more strange syllables were uttered.
As more characters were written, many ferocious ghostly hands suddenly emerged from the black Abyss below him. They fiercely reached upward, clawing and scrabbling, and in no time, numerous malicious spirits and evil ghosts formed from malevolent spirits climbed out of the Abyss, racing towards the direction of the Wu Yue God.
These evil ghosts, eager not to be outdone by each other, began tearing at their comrades' bodies in midair, biting and scratching, only stopping once they had completely swallowed those stronger than themselves.
Consequently, these evil ghosts rapidly fell into an endless spree of mutual slaughter. And as the characters written by the Wu Yue God became clearer, and more syllables were uttered, even more evil ghosts appeared, with the scene growing increasingly intense.
And when the Wu Yue God completely wrote the character "Yuan," those cultivators who had neither shifted their gaze nor sealed their senses all screamed in agony. Instantly, their physical bodies exploded into a bloody mess, and their divine souls flew towards the black Abyss, continuously twisting in midair before also becoming evil ghosts, joining the relentless blood battle.
Among these dead cultivators were both Yunhuang Alliance Cultivators and Wu Yue Sect Cultivators, yet the Wu Yue God paid no heed to these insignificant lives and deaths. Instead, he began writing the second character.
Gradually, as the second character took shape, fewer evil ghosts crawled out of the black Abyss, and the fierce slaughter was nearing an end.
When the character "Ming" appeared in the void, above the black Abyss, only a four-armed evil ghost remained. Due to having swallowed all other evil ghosts, its body had grown three times larger, and countless lost souls orbited its form, their ethereal faces filled with bitterness and hatred.
At this moment, the Wu Yue God finally lowered his head, glancing at the remaining evil ghost, his eyes seemingly revealing a trace of dissatisfaction.
However, he did not hesitate; he directly pointed at the floating characters "Yuan Ming," and immediately, a cloud of black mist enveloped the name.
The four-armed evil ghost also seemed to notice this, and immediately it flew into the clouds. With a wide-open maw, it swallowed both the name and the black mist together.
Under the gaze of the Wu Yue God, the evil ghost that had swallowed the name patted its belly contently. Then, it turned its head to glance in the direction of Black Witch Mountain before exploding with a bang, transforming into pure malice which vanished into the void.

chapters.title: Chapter 725 - 696 Let Me Try
chapters.content:
Meanwhile, at Black Witch Mountain.
At this moment, Yuan Ming was besieging the remnants of the Wu Yue Sect. All of a sudden, he felt as if his Divine Soul had exploded. A strong sense of dizziness and weakness surged into his heart, causing him to stagger a few steps before he directly collapsed to the ground.
Vajra, startled, quickly stepped forward to check on him, but by then, Yuan Ming no longer had the energy to speak. All his focus was on his Divine Soul.
Within the White Jade Lotus Platform, a constantly expanding black spot had appeared in Yuan Ming's Divine Soul. Endless evil thoughts kept assaulting his Divine Soul, as if tens of thousands of evil ghosts were hiding within the black spot, incessantly gnawing at Yuan Ming's Divine Soul.
At this point, Yuan Ming didn't even know how to cope with the situation. His continuously damaged Divine Soul made his spirit delirious, unable to form a single complete thought.
Fortunately, the White Jade Lotus Platform seemed to have sensed something wrong with Yuan Ming. It voluntarily transferred the stored Desire Power into Yuan Ming's Divine Soul, filling the depleted Divine Soul Power from the outside in, suppressing the expansion of the black spot.
The Desire Power flowing into him like warm water soon took effect. Yuan Ming's pain was greatly alleviated, and his consciousness gradually became clear. Realizing his current state, he even began actively guiding the Desire Power to repair his Divine Soul and resist the evil thoughts.
"Vajra, I need to heal, cover me…"
In the outside world, Yuan Ming, having sent a fragment of his mind to prop up his body, posed himself in a five-hearted-to-heaven position and instructed Vajra, before fully immersing himself in the battle against the evil thoughts.​​
...
Elsewhere, outside the gate of Chang Chun Temple, Wu Yue God was staring in the direction of Black Witch Mountain, his brows gradually furrowing.
Perhaps because Wu Yue God had finished casting, the survivors on the battlefield no longer felt any sudden alarm, but most of them still dared not disable their sensory shields.
Only Tian Jizi, seemingly prompted by the Canghai Xuan Water Pearl, voluntarily opened his eyes and looked towards the position of Wu Yue God. Seeing that there was no longer any anomaly, he couldn't help but exhale in relief.
"Was that just now the Curse Killing Divine Skill of Wu Yue God? With my cultivation and a Spiritual Treasure protecting my body, can I not even observe? Such a powerful skill, who was it cursing?"
Tian Jizi muttered to himself. His Divine Sense swiftly scanned the battlefield, but found that none of the high ranks of the Yunhuang Alliance were missing. Though some Nascent Souls had disappeared, none were significant figures, definitely not enough to provoke such a reaction from Wu Yue God.
"It's Yuan Ming. He had contacted me earlier, saying he was going to launch a sneak attack on the main base of the Wu Yue Sect from behind. The direction Wu Yue God was looking at, something major must have happened there, causing him such anger. He even disregarded his injuries and directly used curse killing," said Xi Ying's voice at that moment.
"Are these speculations Shadow God Envoy mentioned," Tian Jizi asked urgently.
"Speculations, but very likely accurate. Haven't you noticed, Wu Yue God is appearing as a soul body. During the Alliance meeting, he at least disguised himself a bit, making it hard for us to guess his condition. But this time, he openly exposed himself, which means his physical body must be facing significant problems, perhaps even annihilated. If I'm not wrong, he will personally attack the Great Array soon. As long as we can hold out for a while, he will definitely withdraw, and the Wu Yue Sect can only retreat," Xi Ying confidently said.
Upon hearing this, Tian Jizi immediately observed the state of Wu Yue God, and quickly confirmed that Xi Ying's words were true.
A Soul Cultivator reaching the Sleeping Witch Realm can keep his Divine Soul active outside the physical body for a long time, but that doesn't mean he can completely abandon the physical body and stay unharmed, especially his original physical body. Once it's lost, it will certainly drain his Primordial Qi. Even a Spoken Witch can only endure a bit longer, not completely unscathed!
At the same time, Wu Yue God also noticed Tian Jizi's probing and immediately snorted coldly, turning around to face Tian Jizi.
The next instant, two streams of black light shot out from his eyes, directly merging into the Divine Sense Tian Jizi was using to observe the battlefield.
Tian Jizi's brow immediately darkened, and his body stiffened simultaneously. His eyes wide open, he felt an overwhelming weakness throughout his body, unable to even lift a finger.
It was the Nili Divine Eye!
Tian Jizi's heart sank as he recognized the Divine Skill of Wu Yue God but was utterly unable to counter it, only able to watch himself inch towards death.
Just then, a surge of water-colored spirit light suddenly rose from the Canghai Xuan Water Pearl in front of him, and a Goddess clad in a feather robe emerged from the water light. Raising her right arm slightly, the cloth draped over her shoulder immediately flew out, encircling Tian Jizi's forehead like a headband. Waves of water-colored spirit light washed over Tian Jizi's body, drawing out countless black mists.
Tian Jizi finally regained control over his body. Without time to thank the Artifact Spirit of the Canghai Xuan Water Pearl, he immediately began casting, powering the Sect Protection Array with all his might, teleporting back the Yunhuang Alliance Cultivators who had left the formation to fight, and also maximizing the power of the Formation.
In an instant, outside the Great Array, countless raindrops poured down, so dense that it seemed like an endless curtain, making it impossible even to see one's outstretched arm.
However, there were no clouds in the sky, and the rain seemed to come from the void, falling to the ground without leaving a single trace of moisture.
Yet, the Wu Yue Sect Cultivators caught in the rain felt a sense of stagnation, as if their bodies were covered in mud, their movements hindered by thousands of forces pulling at them. Even worse, the circulation of Spiritual Energy within their bodies was also affected; their meridians felt clogged by a thick fluid.
The Wu Yue Sect Cultivators had just removed their sensory shields and were still trying to determine where the recently encountered Yunhuang Alliance Cultivators had gone when they fell into such a predicament. For a moment, even Ni Mu and the others found it difficult to act again, attacking the Great Array of Chang Chun Temple.
However, although Wu Yue God was also standing in the rain, all the rainwater seemed to have its own consciousness, naturally bypassing him, not a single drop falling on him.
"Mere child's play."
Wu Yue God murmured softly, his figure flashed, and the next moment he appeared above the Great Array. With a push of his right palm downward, just this one action caused dozens of giant black palms to appear above the Great Array, smashing down without a moment's delay.
"Boom"
As the giant palms fell, the Great Array violently trembled, and its spirit light also dimmed by three parts simultaneously.
"Tian Jizi, support me with all your strength."
Within the array, the Artifact Spirit of the Canghai Xuan Water Pearl looked much more somber. As he spoke, his hands were constantly forming spells, and the radiance on the Canghai Xuan Water Pearl surged significantly.
Next to him, Tian Jizi quickly sat down cross-legged and with his right hand, he touched his forehead where the wood grain was, pulling out a green strand of spiritual silk and threw it forward directly into the Canghai Xuan Water Pearl.
Immediately after, a vast tree phantom emerged around the Canghai Xuan Water Pearl. Though it was transformed by the spirit light, everyone who saw the tree's shadow could feel an extremely dense life force and vitality emanating from it.
In an instant, the spirit light on the Canghai Xuan Water Pearl increased threefold compared to before.
As the core power improved, it also immediately influenced the Sect Protection Array, not only causing the spirit light on the array to surge several times but also quickly repairing the parts that just were scattered by the Great Black Sky God Palm. Even the rain outside the array at this moment fell like a waterfall, merging into a single line, pouring down like a river washing everything away.
Seeing this, Wu Yue God let out a displeased cold snort and raised his hand to strike again with countless Great Black Sky God Palms, but this time, his movements seemed to have a slight delay that was imperceptible to the naked eye.
Tian Jizi and the Artifact Spirit of the Canghai Xuan Water Pearl didn't notice this; at the moment, their minds were fully focused on withstanding the attacks, unable to care about anything else.
However, at this moment, Ancestor Ming Quan, a protector nearby, suddenly noticed something wrong and exclaimed:
"The power of the Canghai Xuan Water Pearl is too strong; the array patterns below can't hold on!"
Nascent Soul cultivators nearby, following his voice, saw beneath the Canghai Xuan Water Pearl a giant array's spirit light flickering chaotically, already showing signs of collapsing.Enjoy the story by reading on *.
The Sect Protection Array of Chang Chun Temple actually magnified and spread the power of the Canghai Xuan Water Pearl to every corner of the mountain through the array runes, thus forming an indestructible Spirit Light Shield. The various abilities and methods of the formation were merely extensions of the power of the Canghai Xuan Water Pearl.
Without the array runes, the Canghai Xuan Water Pearl still possessed the power of a Spiritual Treasure grade, but neither Tian Jizi nor the Artifact Spirit could maximize this power. Even though they could withstand Wu Yue God with it, they could neither protect the Yunhuang Alliance Cultivators on the mountain nor help them resist the attacks of the Wu Yue Sect Cultivators.
Seeing the signs of the array runes collapsing, the crowd of Nascent Souls also grew nervous, and many Cultivators skilled in formations stepped forward, trying to help sustain the operation of the array runes.
"It's no use; to solve the problem, we must add runes to the formation to share the load, but where do we have the time to find spiritual materials that can withstand the power of the Spiritual Treasure?" Old Man Hei Zhu shook his head.
Other Array Masters nodded in agreement, arriving at a similar conclusion.
"But we can't just sit here and wait to die either. What spiritual materials meet the requirements? Speak up, maybe one of us has them!" Luo Zhu urgently said.
Old Man Hei Zhu nodded, just about to answer when he saw Golden Dawn Fairy walking out from the crowd.
"Let me try." she said softly.
Then, she clapped her hands together, and a book shimmering with golden light instantly appeared before her.
"Is that... the Heavenly Talisman Strategy? You've actually found it complete!" a knowledgeable Nascent Soul exclaimed in surprise.
Golden Dawn Fairy nodded, showing no intention to explain, and immediately cast several spells towards the book.
Instantly, a powerful wave of spiritual energy surged from the book, causing everyone's clothes to flutter, while the book itself suddenly opened, its pages soaring into the air with the energy flow, circling slowly around Golden Dawn Fairy.
Before Xi Ying came to the alliance, Yuan Ming had given her the other half of the Heavenly Talisman Strategy. After the abrupt appearance of Wu Yue God at the conference, Xi Ying also found Golden Dawn Fairy alone and gave her that half of the book.
The Heavenly Talisman Strategy contained all the runes mastered by its previous owners. As the current owner, Golden Dawn Fairy could use the golden thread pages stored in the Magic Treasure to replicate the effects of the runes without reservation.
She didn't need to study or know how to write; she only needed to understand the effects of the runes to deploy their power, almost with no threshold.
Moreover, the golden thread pages in the Magic Treasure would always maintain a constant number, replenishing slowly over time, even if they were consumed.

chapters.title: Chapter 726 - 697: Frenzy
chapters.content:
Facing the imminent collapse of the Sect Protection Array, Golden Dawn Fairy soon found the needed rune among the thousands of runes.
With her delicate fingers plucking at the strings like a gentle tap, the Golden Light Book Pages that flew out of the Heavenly Talisman Strategy turned into a stream of golden light that surged towards the Array, transforming directly into shining golden runes that seamlessly integrated into the operation of the Array.
Soon, the power of the Canghai Xuan Water Pearl was dispersed among these newly added runes, and the flickering Spirit Light Shield over the Array gradually stabilized. However, on the protective shield that enveloped the entire mountain, a faint golden color could now be vaguely seen.
All the Nascent Soul cultivators witnessing this sighed in relief, but some couldn't help but glance at the Heavenly Talisman Strategy now flying back into Golden Dawn Fairy's hands, with a flash of greed crossing their eyes.
"Heh, Golden Dawn Fairy is really lucky. The complete Heavenly Talisman Strategy had been missing for almost thousands of years. If it wasn't for the Fairy defeating the Five Thunder Sect with half of it years ago, we wouldn't even know it had reappeared. Now it's whole again; it seems the Fairy is indeed its destined owner," lamented Old Man Hei Zhu in amazement.
"This is all thanks to two of my friends. Without them, I likely wouldn't have found the complete Heavenly Talisman Strategy," said Golden Dawn Fairy with a smile.
The reappearance of the Heavenly Talisman Strategy was astonishing, but with Wu Yue God strongly attacking the Array, everyone only focused on it briefly before turning their attention back to the battlefield.
With the help of Golden Dawn Fairy, Tian Jizi finally caught his breath and continued to struggle to maintain the Array against Wu Yue God's attacks. Before long, some of the Wu Yue Sect Cultivators managed to free themselves from the Array's interference and joined the siege.
Suddenly, the pressure on Tian Jizi increased significantly, and upon seeing this, all members of the Cloud Desolation Alliance did what they could to help maintain the Formation and provide Spiritual Power.
Eventually, several hours later, when a glimmer of dawn appeared between the mountains in the east, Wu Yue God suddenly stopped his attacks and withdrew all Attack Divine Abilities.
In the hazy Black Mist, no one could see his expression, but the furious aura emanating from him informed everyone that his mood was very foul.
"Retreat!"
His voice only reached Ni Mu's ears, carrying a trace of reluctance and resentment.
Ni Mu was startled and saw Wu Yue God vanish into mid-air, returning to the black palace. He then realized that Wu Yue God, unwilling to publicly announce a retreat due to pride, had him relay the command instead.
This realization made him glance again at the dimming Spirit Light Shield of the Chang Chun Temple Array, which had declined significantly compared to before and could not even maintain a curtain of rain. Perhaps a few more hours of attack from Wu Yue God could have completely breached it.
Normally, once Wu Yue God decided to act, he would never do something that could harm his dignity.
Thinking this, Ni Mu recalled Wu Yue God's actions when he had just emerged from the black palace and felt a slight shock.
Could it be that Yuan Ming actually managed to kill Wu Yue God's physical body?
Meanwhile, below the Array, the members of the Cloud Desolation Alliance, also significantly exhausted, looked at each other in disbelief when they saw Wu Yue God suddenly vanish, and the Wu Yue Sect Cultivators retreat.
"Is it over? Did we hold them off? Did the Wu Yue Sect retreat?" someone muttered.
"It seems... that's the case."
"Are we not trapped in an illusion?"
"The Soul Protection Talisman is still present, and if it were an illusion, we would probably be dead by now."
After a moment of silence and doubt, cheers suddenly exploded, and all the confusion and tension turned into excitement. People hugged each other in celebration, some wept with joy, and tears mixed with laughter were freely released, as everyone vented their emotions unabated.Thе gеnuinе аrtiсlе rеsidеs оn М|V|L&ЕМРYR.
Outside the Array, the sun also slowly rose from between the mountains, casting its light once more over the landscape, illuminating every figure.
...
An hour later, in the black palace.
"...Our troops have encamped at Yuhua City. Scouts monitoring Chang Chun Temple have also been properly arranged. However, regarding how to proceed after this battle, I await further instructions from Wu Yue God," reported Ni Mu with utmost respect.
At this moment, Wu Yue God sat cross-legged, floating above a black coffin, twisting a spell in each hand, and black mist continuously flowed out from the coffin beneath him, swirling around his body like water.
"Black Witch Mountain is in trouble. For now, I cannot directly attack the Great Array. Tell them, apart from those monitoring Chang Chun Temple, all others should capture mortals, making sure to gather a million within ten days. Also, select a group of elite, and at that time, I will personally perform the Blood Sacrifice Technique to grant them the power to break the Array," he instructed after a brief silence.
"As you command. However, the Blood Sacrifice Technique severely damages the physical body, and it may be difficult to find volunteers to receive the empowerments. Perhaps we should use some methods to persuade the Believers to sacrifice themselves?" Ni Mu hesitated for a moment before asking with gritted teeth.
"If Nine Yin were here, you wouldn't dare ask such a question," Wu Yue God said somberly, glancing at Ni Mu coldly.
"Forgive me, my lord, I spoke out of turn," Ni Mu shivered, hastily responding.
Wu Yue God coldly closed his eyes. Seeing this, Ni Mu tactfully retreated, but before he had stepped through the temple doors, he heard Wu Yue God's chilling voice come from behind.
"Go find Free Venerable. As for the rest, you know what to do. If necessary, I will also appear to boost morale."
Hearing this, Ni Mu turned around and bowed respectfully, then exited the temple doors.
After leaving the palace, Ni Mu immediately located Free Venerable and Xi Zheng, conveying Wu Yue God's will to them.
Thirty minutes later, the three of them convened all Wu Yue Sect Cultivators and surveyed the scene from an elevated position, with Ni Mu speaking first.
"Fellow believers, Wu Yue Sect is now in a moment of utmost peril. Only with the concerted efforts of all believers can we overcome this crisis..."
He spoke fervently, informing everyone about the situation in Black Witch Mountain and vehemently denouncing Cloud Desolation Alliance's cowardly surprise attacks. He concluded by mentioning that Wu Yue God had prepared a potent method to break the Sect Protection Array, but it required believers to willingly sacrifice themselves.
Meanwhile, Free Venerable subtly employed Soul Cultivator techniques to stir the emotions of the believers. As Ni Mu's speech approached its end, Wu Yue God also projected a Divine Thought form from the black temple.
"Believers of Wu Yue Sect, today, you are needed. Fear not, be not afraid. Remember, those who truly believe will ascend to my Divine Country and share in eternal life with me," Wu Yue God's voice resounded with tempting power.
At that moment, the faces of the Wu Yue Sect Cultivators showed fervor, and many stood up, loudly proclaiming their readiness to sacrifice their lives for Wu Yue God.
...
Ten days later, in Yuhua City, now occupied by Wu Yue Sect, countless bodies piled into hills, even surpassing the height of the city's houses. The blood-stained roads emitted a pungent stench from every crevice in the cobblestones, an odor so unbearable that even the Wu Yue Sect members found it difficult to stomach.
This city, once known as the Immortal City, had now been thoroughly defiled, turned into a filthy purgatory on earth.
Hovering above Yuhua City, Wu Yue God sat atop his coffin in the black temple. His Divine Thought surveyed the city and upon seeing the scenes of carnage, he also frowned.
It was not out of compassion or disgust, but rather he felt that too few had died, not reaching his desired number of a million.
However, as time was running out for him, he reluctantly accepted the reality. With the lives of only several hundred thousand as the price, he initiated the Blood Sacrifice Technique.
As he formed the spell, in an instant, all the corrupted blood in Yuhua City came to life. It rushed and converged between the buildings, eventually forming an enormous bloody Demon Array.
The bodies within the Demon Array dissolved one by one into blood plasma. Meanwhile, the chosen Wu Yue Sect members, each with a brown bag tied around their waist containing hundreds of thousands of living souls, stepped into the Demon Array.
Upon entering the array, they opened the bags and poured the living souls into the array. Watching the living souls, filled with reluctance, resentment, and fear, being devoured by the Demon Array, even these seasoned killers felt a chill up their spines.
But Wu Yue God felt it was too little. Only when all the living souls had been consumed by the array did he, somewhat unsatisfied, alter the spell, and tapped into the deep underground.
Suddenly, a thick Demonic Qi burst forth from beneath the ground, merging directly into the array, adding a sinister shade of black to the blood-soaked array.
Then, Wu Yue God waved his right hand, summoning countless nail-sized blood crystals from nowhere, and threw them all into the Demon Array, positioning them before each voluntarily sacrificing Cultivator.
Within the array, streams of black and red mist emerged, swiftly flowing into the blood crystals.
The blood crystals quivered and then, with a whoosh, embedded themselves in the Cultivators' foreheads, as though adding a new eye. Simultaneously, tendrils of blood filaments rapidly spread across their faces and soon covered their entire bodies.
The Cultivators screamed in agony, as if enduring immense pain, but soon, as the blood filaments covered their entire bodies, they suddenly straightened up. Their ordinary muscles had now swollen to several times their size, and their flesh-colored skin turned a blackish-red hue, appearing as if they were donned in armor.
"My believers, go forth and conquer Chang Chun Temple for me!" Wu Yue God slowly spoke, his voice echoing through heaven and earth.
The Cultivators in the Demon Array roared in unison. By then, they seemed to have lost the ability to speak coherently; there was no hint of rational light in their eyes, only a spreading, intense desire for slaughter.
They stepped forward simultaneously, rushing towards Chang Chun Temple—though they moved on the ground, their speed was even faster than Flying Escape.
Seeing this from outside Yuhua City, the Wu Yue Sect members followed suit. Under Ni Mu's command, in coordination with the Blood Sacrifice Cultivators, they launched a new attack on the Chang Chun Temple's Great Array.

chapters.title: Chapter 727 - 698: Breaching the Fortress
chapters.content:
In Chang Chun Temple, the Nascent Souls of the Cloud Desolation Alliance, led by Tian Jizi, had long noticed the temple's unusual movements. Although they occasionally sent people to harass the Wu Yue Sect's search teams, successfully preventing the Wu Yue God from gathering a million mortals for the blood sacrifice within the deadline, they lacked the strength to organize a large-scale operation or counterattack.
Now that the Wu Yue Sect was making a comeback, the Cloud Desolation Alliance reacted immediately. The Sect Protection Array was once again fully activated, blocking off the blood-sacrificed Cultivators, who were as frenzied as demons.
However, these Cultivators, enhanced by the blood sacrifice, were not only fearlessly brave; their strength had also increased significantly, and their Physical Bodies had become extraordinarily tough. They could even spew blood-colored Demon Flames, causing the Sect Protection Array of Chang Chun Temple to shake incessantly.
Just as the great battle erupted at the entrance of Chang Chun Temple, the Wu Yue God suddenly flew out of the black palace and arrived at the center of the Demon Array.
With his arrival, the ground at the center of the Demon Array cracked open, and a Physical Body with a large blood-colored crystal embedded in its forehead slowly rose.
This Physical Body had well-defined muscles, a square face, a high nose bridge, and although its eyes were closed, its eyebrows were slightly raised, exuding an unruly demeanor.
The Wu Yue God looked at this Physical Body and hesitated for a moment, but eventually, he sighed, and in a flash, merged into the body.
Soon after, the Physical Body's eyes snapped open, and with a wide-open mouth, it spewed out an incredibly thick blood-colored Demon Flame, which instantly struck the Sect Protection Array of Chang Chun Temple.
With that single blast, the Sect Protection Array of Chang Chun Temple shook violently, its movements far more severe than when faced with the onslaught of the blood-sacrificed Cultivators.
Inside Chang Chun Temple, Tian Jizi and the Artifact Spirit of the Canghai Xuan Water Pearl changed color simultaneously, once again working together to strengthen the Great Array, with all of the Nascent Soul Cultivators lending their aid.
All of this seemed like a continuation of the first great battle, but whether the members of the Cloud Desolation Alliance could still be as "lucky" as before was still uncertain.
What everyone did not know was that within Chang Chun Temple, a force that had lain dormant for a long time was beginning to stir, ready to deliver a fatal blow to the teetering Cloud Desolate Alliance.
…
Deep within Black Witch Mountain, Yuan Ming abruptly opened his eyes and then let out a long breath.
At last, he had finally exhausted the malicious thoughts that had appeared in his Divine Soul.
Reflecting on the past few days, Yuan Ming felt a lingering fear in his heart.
If it hadn't been for the aid of the Stealing Heaven Tripod, he would have been unable to withstand that inexplicable malice, and undoubtedly, his Divine Soul would have collapsed and disintegrated instantly, completely extinguished from the world.
The malevolence was truly terrifying. Not only was it powerful, but it was also extremely difficult to eliminate. It took Yuan Ming a full ten days to resolve it, from which it is evident that even if someone could survive the initial onslaught of instant death, they would likely struggle to endure the malice's subsequent expansion and diffusion.
Moreover, Yuan Ming realized that it was only because he relied on his main soul that he survived the attack. Otherwise, after obliterating his main soul, the malice would certainly not spare his soul splitting, and even his Nascent Soul would suffer as well.
Faced with such a terrifying attack that specifically targeted the Divine Soul, Yuan Ming didn't ponder much before confirming the origin of this Divine Power.
It must be one of the Wu Yue God's three Great Divine Powers, the Evil Curse Kill. It was because he had slain the Wu Yue God's Physical Body and provoked his wrath, regardless of the cost to employ such a technique, that he found himself in such a predicament.
But even without a Physical Body, the Wu Yue God was still capable of executing such a dreadful Divine Power. Was this the strength of the Spoken Witch?
At this thought, Yuan Ming felt both astonished and envious.
However, he quickly composed himself, glanced around, and found that he was still deep within Black Witch Mountain, with Vajra casting a concerned look his way.
At that moment, the remaining Wu Yue Sect members within the depths of Black Witch Mountain were either dead or had fled, leaving hardly any figures to be seen.
Knowing that no enemy would attack for the time being, Yuan Ming continued to check and search the underground caves.
By now, the old den of the Wu Yue Sect had been turned upside down.
Apart from the places Yuan Ming had destroyed and looted, many other caves have been purged by the fleeing sect members themselves, with signs of ransacking and robbery everywhere.
To leave no traces, some sect members even set fire to the areas they had plundered before fleeing for their lives.
After exploring a few caves and finding each in that condition, Yuan Ming lost interest.
But just as he was on his way out, he passed by a cave and noticed that the Forbidden on the stone gate was intact. He immediately destroyed it and entered.
Opening the gate, Yuan Ming discovered what appeared to be a Cultivator's secret chamber for cultivation.
The Stone Chamber was small, with a square stone bed in the center and Array Patterns etched around it to aid in cultivation. Against the wall, there was a shelf as tall as a person, on which were placed seven or eight wooden boxes and a variety of bottles and pots.
Next to the shelf stood a three-foot-tall purple-black Alchemy Furnace, still bearing the faint scent of the last batch of elixir, bitter and putrid, making one want to vomit.
Yuan Ming inspected the shelf and found it filled with powdered mineral stones and other alchemical ingredients, while most of the wooden boxes were empty.
As for the finished elixirs, not a single bottle was left; they must have been taken away for the battle.
Seeing no items of interest, Yuan Ming planned to leave.
Yet, as he turned to go, his gaze was caught by an Array carved at the center of the stone platform.
The more he looked at the Array, the more his brow furrowed.
At first glance, the Array seemed unremarkable, but upon closer inspection, it felt increasingly off to him.
"This isn't just a formation, the center piece... seems to be a separate concealment array, there's something hidden here," Yuan Ming quickly realized, a hint of joy flashing in his eyes.
It wasn't that he believed what was hidden had to be valuable, but that he was genuinely delighted by the unexpected discovery.
Yuan Ming walked up to it and pressed his palm against the array, beginning to attempt to break it.
After about the time it takes to drink a cup of tea, the glow emanating from the array gradually faded, and the array patterns inscribed upon it likewise began to disappear.
In the center of what had seemed to be a flat stone platform, a secret compartment three feet square was revealed, in which there lay a square white jade box.
After a brief investigation, Yuan Ming immediately took out the white jade box from within.
Upon opening it, a burst of red light rippled out like waves, instantly illuminating the entire dimly lit chamber.
Yuan Ming frowned and peered inside, only to see seven or eight thumb-thick, three-inch long golden red crystals neatly stacked inside the white jade box.
After ensuring there were no abnormalities, he pinched one of the golden red crystal stones between his fingers and examined it closely, marveling at its clarity and flawless interior, which reflected a lustrous glow, incredibly beautiful.
However, there were no fluctuations of spiritual power on the golden red crystal stones, and when he tried to infuse them with mana, there was no response. Not knowing their purpose, Yuan Ming decided to store them away for the time being.
Having done all this, Yuan Ming immediately left Black Witch Mountain and rode the thunderous rain towards Da Jin.
...
Several days later, in the southern part of Da Jin Country.
The citizens of Huaiji City witnessed a bizarre phenomenon the likes of which they had never seen before.
That day, above Huaiji City, Immortals, normally a rare sight, passed over the ancient city that had stood for a thousand years in great numbers like a swarm of locusts, walking on air, standing on swords, or riding flying shuttles.
The city's residents thought they were witnessing a miracle and rushed out of their homes to kneel and bow in worship.
Some went even further, burning incense and making offerings of animals in the hopes of receiving the Immortals' blessing.
Little did they know that these lofty Immortals were now concerned only with their escape; they had no capacity to care for the mortals they usually considered as insignificant as ants.
What good can come to the eggs when the nest is overturned?The g%en.uine@[email protected] @ res^i*d^es# on M%|V#|@L%&EMPY&R..
The wars between cultivators always have consequences that extend far beyond themselves, affecting all living beings.
Perhaps in a few days, tens of thousands of refugees would flood into Huaiji City from the North.
Somewhere high in the sky, Xi Ying was holding Guoguo, gliding through the air.
Her gaze fell on the mortals below, and she couldn't help but show a trace of compassion in her eyes.
Just then, Guoguo, in her arms, experienced a fleeting dullness in her eyes, as if she had fallen into a brief stupor, which quickly dissipated, restoring the spirit light.
Xi Ying immediately sensed a subtle change in the Divine Soul wave radiating from Guoguo and quickly enveloped both of them in an invisible barrier, separating them from the outside world.
"Yuan Ming, where are you now?" Xi Ying asked.
"I'm still in the Northern Desert. Just a few days ago, I overturned the lair of the Wu Yue Sect, and now I'm hurrying towards Da Jin Capital," Yuan Ming's voice came through with a liberating laugh.
Hearing this, Xi Ying's expression darkened as she said, "Then there's no need for you to come this way."
"What do you mean? What happened?" Yuan Ming asked urgently.
"The Cloud Desolate Alliance couldn't withstand the onslaught of the Wu Yue Sect. Chang Chun Temple has been breached. Every faction of the alliance has suffered heavy losses and no longer has the strength to fight to the death against the Wu Yue Sect. They are retreating en masse towards the Cloud Ridge Mountain Range in the south of Da Jin," Xi Ying explained.
"Defeated? How about you, are you hurt?" Yuan Ming was initially shocked, then quickly asked.
"I'm fine, don't worry," Xi Ying said, shaking her head.
"I guessed the Cloud Desolate Alliance wouldn't win, but I didn't expect them to lose this quickly. Is the Wu Yue Sect and that Wu Yue God really that powerful?" After a moment of silence, Yuan Ming's voice came from Guoguo's mouth once again.
"They are much stronger than we imagined, but that's not the main reason for our defeat," Xi Ying sighed with a hint of helplessness.
"It seems that the problem lies within the Cloud Desolate Alliance itself," Yuan Ming immediately guessed the situation.
"Exactly, the reason for our swift defeat is that the Cao Family turned traitor at a critical moment. Those people turned out to be dark agents cultivated by the Wu Yue Sect for many years, willing to fight to the death and directly sabotaged Chang Chun Temple's Sect Protection Array, allowing the Wu Yue God to enter. Once he made his move, the cultivators of the Cloud Desolation Alliance stood no chance and were quickly decimated," Xi Ying said.
As she spoke, a sigh escaped her heart.
Wulu had warned them in advance to beware of the Cao Family, but amidst the urgency of war and no concrete evidence, she was powerless to prevent it.

chapters.title: Chapter 728 - 599: Night Watchman
chapters.content:
After hearing Xi Ying's words, Yuan Ming was met with another long silence on his end.
Then, he finally spoke again, "If the people from Cloud Desolate Alliance have all withdrawn, then Da Jin Capital must have surely fallen too, right?"
"Da Jin Capital was breached even earlier than Chang Chun Temple. However, something happened just before the fall of Da Jin Capital." After a moment of hesitation, Xi Ying spoke.
"What?" Yuan Ming asked, sensing that the matter was likely related to him upon hearing her mention it.
"Previously, Chang Chun Temple had called for all external disciples to return to the Sect to jointly defend against the enemy. Liu Tianming had not responded at all. Unexpectedly, just the day before the Wu Yue Sect invaded Da Jin Capital, he suddenly appeared on the city wall," said Xi Ying.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming felt a heavy weight sink in his heart.
"Liu Tianming declared in his capacity as the sovereign that he would lead the Da Jin cultivators and fight to the death against the Wu Yue Sect, until the city fell," Xi Ying lowered her head to glance at Guoguo before continuing.
"Is he... still alive?" Yuan Ming asked.
"The initial attack on Da Jin Capital wasn't led by the main forces of the Wu Yue Sect, their leader was a Nascent Soul cultivator, but he was killed by Liu Tianming under the city walls. In a fury, the Wu Yue Sect sent a Venerable..." Xi Ying did not finish her sentence, but her meaning was clear enough.
"What happened afterward?" Yuan Ming asked in a grave voice.
"According to the news that came back, the Liu Royal Family was very resolute, preferring death to surrendering to the Wu Yue Sect, so the casualties were extremely severe. Except for the lineage of the current Crown Prince who had relocated earlier and escaped to Chang Chun Temple, preserving the dynasty, the rest perished for their country," said Xi Ying.
After speaking, Xi Ying waited a long time for Yuan Ming to compose himself, but he never continued the conversation.
"He originally had the chance to withdraw, at least to Chang Chun Temple first. The people who escaped said he declared that as the ruler of a nation, he had no reason to abandon his country and flee," Xi Ying thought for a while, then shared these details with Yuan Ming.
After a long time, Guoguo's bowed head was finally raised again.
"This fool, he never wanted to be the Emperor…" Yuan Ming sighed deeply.
"Yuan Ming, concern leads to chaos. Now, to say Da Jin Capital is like a dragon's lair and a tiger's den is an understatement; do not act impulsively and lose your life for nothing," Xi Ying advised upon hearing his words.
"Don't worry, I just raided the den of the Wu Yue God. He's probably itching to turn me into ash. I won't be walking into a trap. Moreover, no one has seen whether Liu Tianming is dead or alive, right? I'll possess him in a few days and then I'll know his whereabouts," Yuan Ming's voice came through, his emotions evidently more stable now.
"What are your plans next?" Xi Ying inquired.
"Since you followed them to the Cloud Ridge Mountain Range, I'll head over there to meet up with you, but I will definitely have to take a roundabout route, so it will be a bit later," Yuan Ming said.
"Alright, then we'll meet in the Cloud Ridge Mountain Range," Xi Ying agreed with him.
After Yuan Ming responded, he ended the possession, and his soul returned to his own body.
...
Seven days later, in the evening.
At Qu Jiang, outside North City Gate.
The remnants of the city wall were scorched black, the traces of being burned by war still vividly visible, everywhere showing breaches smashed by colossal beasts.
Inside and outside the city wall, corpses lay everywhere, the stench of decay filled the air, and crows pecked at the bodies all around.
The open city gates and the official road extending outward, the surviving citizens of the city were struggling to escape, all disheveled and filthy, wearing tattered clothes.
Although they had survived the horrific slaughter, their spirits had already suffered severe trauma.
One by one, they looked gaunt and numb, their eyes hollow as if they were living corpses, dragging their heavy footsteps, slowly moving out of this dead city.
Under the blood-red dying sun, the figure of a young man in a gray robe appeared at the city gate.
He looked up, glanced at several corpses hanging above the gate dressed in armor, his expression unchanged as he walked through the gate.
The person was none other than Yuan Ming.
Although he verbally promised Xi Ying he absolutely wouldn't risk coming to Da Jin, how could he possibly not come?
Yuan Ming passed through the gloomy city gate arch and stepped into the city.
Although he was prepared, the hellish scene before him still profoundly shook him.
The capital, once bustling with closely packed houses like smoke and lively streets, now where was any trace of its former self? As far as the eye could see, there were only broken walls and ruins.
The original orderly streets, now chocked with corpses and rubble, no longer showed the signs of living people, only the carrion-eating crows circling low in the sky.
Among the destroyed rubble of houses, one could see the mutilated corpses of citizens and traces of blood not yet completely dried.
As the sun set, the city was utterly silent, Qu Jiang like a city of the dead.
Yuan Ming followed the main street to where the General Mansion once stood, passing familiar shops and stores all now reduced to ruins, all that which was familiar, now irretrievable memories.
Since Yuan Ming's parents had left the capital, the Yuan Mansion had been stripped of its title as General Mansion, but it had not been reclaimed by the government, and direct and collateral relatives of the Yuan Family still lived there.
But when Yuan Ming came back, the entire Yuan Mansion had also been reduced to broken walls.
The full series is hosted on *, known as *.
Immediately, he saw the old doorman who had been his childhood companion, stiffly dead in a wooden reclining chair.
His head was pierced, his eyes looking towards the sky, half his face gruesomely pecked away by crows.
In the broken courtyard, decaying bodies lay everywhere,
Although Yuan Ming knew there were no survivors just by sweeping his Divine Sense, he couldn't help but wanting to see for himself.
After seeing, this debt could be clearly recorded on Wu Yue Sect's account.
Then, Yuan Ming activated the Corpse Control Technique, gathering over a hundred corpses from the courtyard, and in the central garden, he dug over a hundred graves, burying them all.
Afterward, he hurried all the way to the Imperial Palace.
The originally heavily guarded Imperial Palace had long since been devoid of any defense forces.
The situation here was even more severe than outside.
Because those living inside the palace were mostly the unfree palace maids and eunuchs who had no chance to escape until the very last moment.
Thus, the bodies here were even more numerous and densely packed than outside.
The palace, now enshrouded in night, was pitch-dark without a glimmer of light, silent as a ghost town.
Yuan Ming stood outside the Meridian Gate, his Divine Thought sweeping across the palace, detecting no signs of life.
He sighed, his form transforming into a Blood Shadow as he entered the palace, passing the Qianqing Palace where the Emperor held court and the Yangxin Hall where the Emperor rested, to no avail.
Among the many corpses, he did not spot Liu Tianming.
Perhaps he was still alive?
Yuan Ming, harboring a sliver of hope, halted his steps in front of the Yangxin Hall.
He walked into the palace, sat down cross-legged in the hall, flipped his hand to retrieve the Stealing Heaven Tripod and a stick of Black Incense, rubbed the incense head to light it, and then inserted it into the incense burner.
The fire on the incense flickered, wafting plumes of smoke upward.
But before the incense had burned down much, Yuan Ming's eyes suddenly snapped open, filled with a gaze of confusion and worry.
"Can't find him..."
He murmured to himself, his focused gazesuddenly turning frantic.
The attempt to possess Liu Tianming using Black Incense Possession had failed.
No matter how he tried to visualize Liu Tianming's voice and smile or shouted his name over and over in his mind, his Divine Sense couldn't sense the other's existence or complete the possession.
That largely meant the person he wanted to possess no longer existed in this world.
Liu Tianming might already be dead!
The thought made Yuan Ming's throat constrict, an emotion he had rarely experienced since becoming a cultivator.
In his mind, he kept seeing images of Liu Tianming, who would smile and say,"Brother Ming, in the future let's ride white horses and wield treasured swords together, adventuring through the martial arts world, and to hell with this Emperor business; let whoever wants it have it..."
The voice faded, leaving no trace of his existence in the empty palace.
Yuan Ming's emotions couldn't settle, a surge of murderous intent rising uncontrollably.
"Thump thump, dry wood prone to fire, be cautious with the candles." Just then, a shout suddenly came from outside the hall.
Yuan Ming frowned and immediately darted out.
Soon, he saw a solitary lantern lit in the distance on a plaza, hanging about five feet high.
Under the orangish-red light of the lantern, one could see a hunched figure, struggling to pull a wooden cart along the stone path.
Every few steps, the figure would stop to knock twice on the bamboo stick and gong in hand, then continue pushing the cart.
The voice was not loud, but through the empty and desolate palace, it carried very far, very far.
Yuan Ming moved his Divine Sense towards the figure and discovered no fluctuations of Spiritual Power or Divine Soul, clearly an ordinary person.
But what was an ordinary person doing here?
He didn't rush forward, instead watching from afar, only to see that person pull the cart straight into a palace.
When he came out, there were already five bodies on the cart, all neatly arranged and their clothes tidied, clearly someone had taken care of them.
Unable to contain his curiosity any longer, Yuan Ming flew to the person's side.
"Who? Who's there?" The sudden appearance of Yuan Ming obviously startled the person.
Yuan Ming did not answer but instead asked, "Who are you?"
Hearing someone talking, the person seemed less frightened than before, lifting the lantern closer to Yuan Ming, the light revealing an old, dark, and withered face.
He appeared very aged, with drooping brows and eyes, down-turned mouth corners carrying a trace of bitterness, and eyes that were all white with no black pupils, strikingly a blind old man.
"I am a night watchman at the palace," the blind elder honestly replied.
"Everyone in the palace is dead, what are you doing here?" Yuan Ming asked with a frown.
"Making rounds," the blind elder quickly said.
"Didn't you hear me? Everyone in the palace is dead, there are no living people left," Yuan Ming said, puzzled.
"I know there are no living people left, I have been collecting bodies in the palace these past few days, not even a living ghost to be found," the blind elder replied.
"Then why don't you leave?" Yuan Ming asked, perplexed.
"This is what I do; I've done it all my life. As for leaving... I don't even know where to go," the blind elder sighed and said languidly.
On hearing this, Yuan Ming was taken aback, thought for a moment, and then didn't try to persuade him further.

chapters.title: Chapter 729 - 700: A Drastic Change in Appearance
chapters.content:
"Do you know if anyone from the imperial family... managed to escape alive?" Yuan Ming hesitated for a while before asking again.
"I don't know... I only know that the Emperor didn't escape. He didn't escape when the Capital was broken through, nor when the Imperial City was taken, and he even led the palace guards to fight the enemy actively," the blind elder said, suddenly becoming somewhat agitated.
"Did he... die?" Yuan Ming asked.
"How could he still be alive? What are you laughing at?" the blind elder retorted.
After speaking, he couldn't help but mutter, "His Majesty was truly brave, and for that alone, I must recover his body. I won't leave until I find His Majesty's corpse."
"How can you, a blind man, discern which one is the Emperor?" Yuan Ming said with a bitter smile.
"I may be blind, but my nose isn't blind, and neither is my heart. If I can't tell which one is His Majesty, I will bury everyone in this Imperial Palace," the blind elder said with a smile.
Hearing this, Yuan Ming sighed, took out two porcelain vases, and placed them beside the blind elder's wooden cart.
Both were immortal elixirs for healing and nurturing the body. After taking them, the elder could eliminate all diseases and extend his lifespan.
Afterward, Yuan Ming transformed into a long rainbow and flew away.
...
Two days later, outside the gate of Chang Chun Temple.
A few cultivators dressed in the robes of the Wu Yue Sect disciples came out slowly, carrying a large brass vat.
The vat was murky inside, filled with round, bloody heads.
These people joked and laughed as they carried the vat to an empty space outside the temple gate where two half-constructed spires made of human heads stood.
They took the heads out of the vat one by one and placed them on the unfinished half-spires.
"It seems we're running out of heads in the temple; we can't build the last spire," a young man with a gaunt, sinister face said.
"What's the hurry? There're a dozen or so captives dying each day. Just save up for a few days, and it'll be enough," another plump, pale man with no beard said, laughing.
"That's too slow. How about we also go to the water prison to have some fun and get a few more?" a tall man busy stacking heads asked.
"Not a bad idea," the pale man, apparently their leader, thought for a moment and then nodded.
The Wu Yue Sect disciples guarding the temple gate looked at these people from afar, their eyes revealing a sense of disdain.
Just then, the middle-aged man who had just spoken suddenly stiffened, swung his comrades off, and walked towards the mountain's exterior.
"Hey, Senior Brother Yan, where are you going?" the sinister-faced young man frowned and shouted.
"Just a little nature's call. Want to come along?" the middle-aged man called back without turning his head.
Without waiting, he plunged into the dense forest outside and walked deeper into it.
He reached a sturdy ginkgo tree and suddenly stopped, standing still as if in a trance, swaying back and forth.
At that moment, a figure suddenly appeared from the side— it was Yuan Ming.
Before the man regained his senses, Yuan Ming had already reached out and touched his brow.
The middle-aged man, caught in an illusion, had no power to resist and was restrained by Yuan Ming, who began to search his soul.
After observing, Yuan Ming found that this man's cultivation was not high, only at the early stage of Core Formation. He was a minor leader among the Wu Yue Sect disciples, suitable for controlling and gathering intelligence.
After a short while, Yuan Ming quietly withdrew his hand and disappeared.
The disciple surnamed Yan shuddered and shivered, as if he had just finished relieving himself, subconsciously adjusting his trouser belt before turning to walk back.
After he left, Yuan Ming leaned against the tree trunk and slowly sat down.
From the man's Divine Soul memory, Yuan Ming learned that since the great battle at Chang Chun Temple concluded, the Wu Yue Sect had slowed their attack, seemingly planning to consolidate their gains before pushing forward again.
Perhaps because Yuan Ming had disrupted their base, the Wu Yue Sect had even dispatched a team to hurry back to their main temple at Northern Desert Black Witch Mountain overnight.
Furthermore, he learned that a batch of captives from the Cloud Desolate Alliance was now being held in the law cells of Chang Chun Temple.
However, this disciple surnamed Yan was ranked too low, knowing only the route to the Law Hall and the visible defenses. He was unaware of any hidden defensive forces.
Not to mention, the situation of higher-level cultivators stationed here.
Yuan Ming's action was just a small probe. If controlling this early-stage Core Formation disciple with illusion had not alerted the Nascent Soul and above cultivators stationed here, he was ready for a further attempt.
At night.
Inside and outside Chang Chun Temple was brightly lit, with the defense patrol's strength doubled compared to the daytime.
In the forest outside the temple, Yuan Ming's form transformed into an Undead Tree Demon, its roots and tendrils thrusting forward, immediately creating a ripple in the void as if about to open a teleportation gateway.
On the other side of the gateway was the disciple surnamed Yan, who had been deceived by his illusion during the day.
Yuan Ming had left a Divine Soul Mark on him and took control of him using the Divine Soul Secret Technique; at this moment, he intended to use him as an anchor, utilizing the ability of the Undying Tree to traverse the void and infiltrate Chang Chun Temple.
He planned to first locate the Law Hall of Chang Chun Temple and attempt to rescue those who were captured.
Regarding whether Liu Tianming was still alive, Yuan Ming still harbored an impractical fantasy deep in his heart.
After all, he had not found the other party's corpse.
However, just as he was about to break through the spatial ripples with his roots, a faint wave of mana suddenly emanated from behind him.
Yuan Ming immediately became alert; his body did not turn around, and his roots decisively pierced through the void.
However, the destination of the void traversal suddenly changed in an instant.
Behind him, a tall figure was suppressing the fluctuations on his body and cautiously approaching Yuan Ming, unaware of the vortex that had appeared in the void behind him.Thischapterwasuploadedbytheteamat*.
From within the vortex, an Undying Tree Vine suddenly thrust out, aiming straight for the back of his head.
At the critical moment, an alarm blared in the man's mind, and he abruptly tilted his head, narrowly avoiding the attack of the Undying Tree Vine.
But in front of him, the figure suddenly blurred and Yuan Ming had already closed the distance, raising his hand to reveal the Shura Blood Devouring Map, about to engulf him within.
"Yuan Ming, it's me..."
Just as the dense blood light from the Shura Blood Devouring Map was about to engulf the figure, a somewhat hoarse voice suddenly erupted.
Yuan Ming did not recognize this voice, so he did not stop his movements.
His gaze also concurrently swept over the man.
That was a creature eight feet tall, bulky and robust, with a human body but a head similar to that of a cow; reminiscent of a half-human, half-demon beast.
Its upper body was bare, covered in blood-red keratin, and it had extraordinarily large hands and feet. Its cow-horned face still vaguely resembled that of a human, but the flesh in the center of its forehead was parted, embedding a lychee-sized blood crystal.
The moment Yuan Ming saw the man's eyes, his attack abruptly stiffened, sensing a touch of familiarity.
Seeing no signs of aggression from the bull-headed beast, Yuan Ming forcefully stopped his actions, withdrew the Shura Blood Devouring Map, and stared at the other in surprise.
"Who are you?" Yuan Ming couldn't help but ask.
"It's me, Wulu." The hoarse voice emanated from the mouth of the half-human, half-demon beast.
Yuan Ming's expression immediately changed.
The person before him, whether it was his appearance, demeanor, voice, or the aura he emitted, was completely different from Wulu.
Only those eyes were exactly the same as his.
Seeing Yuan Ming seemingly incredulous, the half-demon beast quickly began to speak, "You and I met in Southern Border Biluo Cave, back then..."
Listening to his recounting of the past, Yuan Ming's expression gradually changed.
"Wulu, how did you become like this?" Yuan Ming couldn't help but frown as he asked.
"This is not the place to talk; follow me." Wulu did not answer but spoke thus.
With that, he quickly led Yuan Ming away from there and into a hidden cave concealed by a barrier.
Upon entering the cave, Yuan Ming couldn't help but ask, "What exactly happened? How did you turn into this? And it seems your cultivation has greatly progressed?"
"It was all done by the Blood Demon Ancestor. After he took me away, my body was forcibly infused with a massive amount of Demonic Qi. The puppet armor underwent a mutation, and its erosion of my physical body began to accelerate; I couldn't resist at all and ultimately ended up like this," Wulu said after a moment of silence.
"Was your cultivation also boosted because of this?" Yuan Ming asked.
"When the Blood Demon Ancestor left Three Immortals Island, he had already taken the corpse of a Late-stage Nascent Soul Cultivator with him. The residual power within the body was sealed in the puppet armor. After my body fused with the armor, this power also merged into my body, forcibly elevating my mana to Late-stage Nascent Soul," explained Wulu.
"That blood crystal on your forehead is..." Yuan Ming hesitated to ask.
"I seized it from the Blood Demon Ancestor's hands. When the puppet armor mutation was rampant, it embedded itself in my brow, and I can't remove it. But it turned out to be a blessing in disguise; this blood crystal contains a very powerful Demonic Divine Skill," Wulu said as he touched the crystal stone at his brow.
"Seeing you in this state really takes some getting used to," Yuan Ming sighed.
"Let's not talk about me for now,— how did you come here? Aren't you aware that the Cloud Desolate Alliance has already been defeated?" Wulu asked.
"I know; I came looking for someone," Yuan Ming nodded.
"Looking for whom? Could it be that Daoist Xi Ying was also captured?" Wulu's expression slightly changed as he asked.
"Not her; it's the Emperor of Da Jin Country, we have been friends for many years," Yuan Ming shook his head as he spoke.
"Emperor of Da Jin Country... indeed some people from Da Jin Country were captured here, but the 'Emperor' you mentioned, I haven't seen during my days of investigation here," Wulu frowned as he pondered for a moment.
"Perhaps he is already dead; I have just come to try my luck..." Yuan Ming sighed.

chapters.title: Chapter 730 - 701 Demonic Qi Billows
chapters.content:
"If that's really the case, it might not be a bad thing. Those who have been captured are truly living a fate worse than death," Wulu said with a bitter smile.
"Are those people being held in the Law Hall of Chang Chun Temple?" Yuan Ming asked.
"Are you thinking of rescuing them? Don't be foolish; they're not only captives but also bait. The reason the Wu Yue Sect hasn't killed them off immediately is to lure others into attempting a rescue. I've seen at least three different groups rush in to save them during this period, and not one has come out alive," Wulu shook his head.
"Why are you sticking around here then?" Hearing this, Yuan Ming dropped the subject and asked instead.
"I have to find the Blood Demon Ancestor. I became what I am now all thanks to him. If I want to revert to my original appearance, finding him seems to be my only hope," Wulu sighed with a sense of helplessness.
Upon hearing Wulu, Yuan Ming suddenly understood: the Wu Yue Sect must have been in contact with the Blood Demon Ancestor all along. Their previous order to capture Wulu was probably for the Blood Demon Ancestor's sake.
"Have you found any trace of the Blood Demon Ancestor?" Yuan Ming inquired.
"No, I've been staking out here for many days but have never seen the Blood Demon Ancestor show himself. However, I did discover something else that's worth more attention," Wulu said, his tone taking on a mysterious air.
"What is it?" Yuan Ming asked, curious.
"The Wu Yue Sect's objective in attacking Chang Chun Temple isn't just to crush the Cloud Desolate Alliance in one fell swoop; they have other schemes within Chang Chun Temple," Wulu stated.
"Tell me more," Yuan Ming urged, frowning.
"Didn't you sense the change when you got near Chang Chun Temple?" Wulu didn't answer directly but instead posed a question.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming concentrated on his thoughts, and after a moment, he hesitantly answered, "If there's any change, I feel that the spiritual energy at Chang Chun Temple isn't as rich as it used to be."
"Right, I've checked. Chaotian Peak, where the spiritual energy of Chang Chun Temple was most abundant, has been enveloped by a large array recently. As a result, the spiritual energy cannot overflow and spread, leading to the gradual thinning of the Heaven and Earth Spiritual Power around here," Wulu explained.
"Seizing the vast spiritual energy of Chang Chun Temple, what exactly are these fellows trying to do?" Yuan Ming's expression changed slightly as he asked.
"That is also what I'm most eager to figure out, aside from finding the Blood Demon Ancestor," Wulu said.
"Now that I'm here, let's take action together. Whether it's finding the Blood Demon Ancestor, rescuing those captives, or figuring out what the Wu Yue Sect is up to, succeeding in just one of these tasks would mean our trip here wasn't in vain," Yuan Ming declared with a resolute gaze.
"I was thinking the same," Wulu said with a smile.
"Wulu, you must have some special means of infiltration to uncover so much on your own, right?" Yuan Ming inquired.
"At the beginning of the conflict with Chang Chun Temple, several escape tunnels were secretly dug and teleportation arrays set up, most of which the Wu Yue Sect has destroyed. However, I was lucky to find a few hidden ones. It's through these tunnels I've been sneaking into Chang Chun Temple these days," Wulu nodded as he spoke.
"Being a Spoken Witch, the Divine Soul of the Wu Yue God is so powerful, and he never noticed you?" Yuan Ming was still somewhat incredulous.
"The battle to capture Chang Chun Temple was more horrific than you can imagine. The Wu Yue God expended a great deal, and rested after the battle. Now, it's the Venerables who are in charge of Chang Chun Temple. As long as I'm careful, it's not that easy to get caught," Wulu chuckled.
"So when do we act?" asked Yuan Ming.
"Chang Chun Temple's outer defenses are relaxed, but the inner defenses are tight. The night guards are especially vigilant, but at dawn, many sentries change shifts, which is actually the best time to infiltrate," Wulu explained.
"Alright, then let's make our move at that time," Yuan Ming nodded.
Afterward, the two discussed the details of the action plan and began to meditate separately, waiting for the time to act.
...
Inside Chang Chun Temple, Chaotian Peak.
This was a solitary peak standing apart from the contiguous mountain range. Though not the tallest within the Sect, its unique location, right at the convergence of the Spirit Vein, made it the peak where the Sect's spiritual energy was most abundant.
It used to be the cultivation ground for the Inner Sect Elders and Inner Sect Disciples, a place of scenic beauty and spiritual grace.
