Now, the entire peak was shrouded in dark clouds, and a massive black cloud, thick as ink, capped the summit, as if draping a dirty hat over the peak.
From that dark cloud descended a curtain-like layer of black light, enveloping the whole of Chaotian Peak within it.
From a distance, the entire Chaotian Peak seemed enshrouded in black mist, fraught with an oppressive and gloomy atmosphere.
At the foot of Chaotian Peak, outside the layer of the black light screen, near a hastily-built Stone Castle, a few Wu Yue Sect Disciples who had just come on for the night shift were chatting leisurely, looking relaxed.
A young disciple with puffy eyes and gaunt cheeks, hugging a long spear, leaned against the Stone Castle's outer wall, yawning.
A companion teased him, saying, "You should know how to pace yourself, the female prisoners in the Water Prison can't escape; there's no need to play them all at once like a starving ghost. Why exhaust yourself daily?"
"Heh heh, you can't blame me for that, as those female prisoners are the ones begging for my company; I really can't be faulted," the gaunt disciple replied with a lewd grin.
"True, being tossed around by you is probably more comfortable than being tortured in the dungeons," another person added with a laugh.
"Ah, you're not wrong. Those pampered Sect Disciples do have a different flavor indeed..."
As they chatted enthusiastically, one of them looked askance and suddenly noticed that a black tree root had grown on the wall beside the emaciated disciple without anyone knowing when it had appeared.
He rubbed his eyes, feeling his vision blur, but he saw that the black tree root didn't seem to have grown out of the cracks in the wall. Instead, it seemed to have sprouted out of thin air.
"Hey..."
Just as he was about to speak up and say something, a black root had silently crept up his spine without his knowledge and just as he opened his mouth, it fiercely pierced into it.
"Mmm..." A muffled sound arose, and his eyes trembled before he stopped struggling.
At the same time, the others also stiffened, plunging into an illusion.
Soon after, the black vines that had reached out from the void entwined them all, pulling them into the stone castle.
Within moments, these individuals walked back out, expressions normal as if nothing had happened, and they returned to their original places, resuming their previous conversations.
Inside the stone castle, two more figures had appeared; it was, in fact, Yuan Ming and Wulu.
"With your ability to pierce through the void, we could have gone directly into Chaotian Peak. Why waste time turning them into tree-man puppets?" Wulu wondered.For a smoother reading experience, visit MV&LEMPYR.
"These people have their uses. Now is just the right time; let's go in and take a look," Yuan Ming said with a smile, without giving away too much.
After speaking, he faced the rear of the stone castle, toward Chaotian Peak, and stretched out his palm forward, transforming it into vines of the Undying Tree. Utilizing his mana, he deployed his divine skills, and swiftly opened a spatial channel on the wall of the castle.
On the other side of the passage, it directly connected to a cliff terrace halfway up Chaotian Peak.
The moment the channel was opened, a thick Demonic Qi emanated from within, causing Yuan Ming and Wulu's expressions to change drastically.
Both had actively absorbed Demonic Qi before, the other having it forcibly infused, so they were naturally familiar with this substance.
"Demonic Qi? How can there be such dense Demonic Qi inside Chang Chun Temple?" Wulu couldn't help but ask.
"Just wait here; I'll go have a look," Yuan Ming said and was about to enter the channel.
Wulu reached out to hold him back, earnestly cautioning, "Be careful."
Yuan Ming nodded, slipped into the channel, and the spatial passage instantly vanished.
On the midway cliff terrace of Chaotian Peak, Yuan Ming's figure descended from the void.
No sooner had he steadied himself, Yuan Ming felt the intensely dense Demonic Qi swirling around heaven and earth, its richness and abundance almost on par with what he had seen beneath Snake King Valley, but not quite.
Looking around, a shock grew in his heart.
If it weren't for the Great Array enveloping the entire Chaotian Peak, this Demonic Qi once leaking out could very well have turned the entire Chang Chun Temple into a Demon Realm.
Suppressing the doubts in his heart, he walked towards the top of the mountain.
No sooner had he arrived in the mountain forest from the cliff terrace than Yuan Ming discovered that all the vegetation here had withered away, ancient trees standing tall as if they had endured a cataclysmic wildfire, now reduced to charred remains.
The bushes and grass on the ground were also scorched, crumbling into ash with a light touch of his foot.
"What on earth happened?" Yuan Ming's puzzlement deepened.
Climbing swiftly along the mountain ridge, he hadn't gotten far when his eyebrows furrowed tightly, and soon he saw an ancient black tree, bent like a coiling dragon, not far ahead.
The ancient tree soared over several tens of meters; its canopy spread wide like a cover, laden with dense black leaves, life vigorously pulsating within them.
A Magic Cloud Tree had been planted here!
Yuan Ming's pupils shrank as he cautiously moved closer, circling the tree to check for embedded human bodies and heaving a sigh of relief upon finding none.
Without a doubt, this was the Wu Yue Sect's doing.
An unpleasant speculation occurred in Yuan Ming's mind, and he promptly spread his form, racing toward the mountain's summit.
However, he hadn't gone far before another Magic Cloud Tree appeared in his field of vision.
After that, more and more Magic Cloud Trees emerged, becoming densely packed near the mountain's peak, having been thoroughly planted.
Yuan Ming's confusion dissolved.
The Demonic Qi filling the mountain was a transformation from these Magic Cloud Trees.
Still, he didn't understand why the Wu Yue Sect would do such a thing.
He lifted his head to gaze at the thick demonic clouds hanging above the mountain's peak and proceeded to hasten his pace towards the top.

chapters.title: Chapter 731 - 731: 702
chapters.content:
After reaching the peak, Yuan Ming immediately saw that the buildings that once stood on the mountaintop had all been leveled. The open square was densely packed with dark, black stone pillars, which connected to form a massive array that covered several acres of land.
In the center of the array, suspended above a circular demon pattern array map, coiled a black mist that was distinctly different from ordinary demonic Qi.
It was as if light and dark Qi had fused, interweaving into a cluster of thick black mist that shone with light, emanating astonishing waves of magic power.
Opposite it in the sky, within that terrifying cloud of demonic energy, there was a huge gap, through which countless rays of daylight leaked, illuminating the giant demon array below.
Countless primordial Qi from that funnel-like daylight poured into the array.
Yuan Ming was so stunned by the scene before him that he was at a loss for words; everything had surpassed his understanding.
"Fellow Daoist Qi Ye..." he called out softly, wanting to ask Qi Ye for an explanation.
But at that moment, the storage bracelet on his wrist suddenly lit up with intense black light, a force that seemed uncontrollable, as if it wanted to burst the confines of the storage bracelet.
Yuan Ming, feeling a premonition, turned his wrist.
A beam of black light shot out from the storage bracelet and rushed toward the demon array.
Within the black light was none other than the black stone pillar Yuan Ming had obtained from the Underground Palace of Snake King Valley.
Seeing that it seemed to be resonating with the demon array, Yuan Ming surmised there must be a connection and instantly became vigilant.
His thoughts raced; the black stone pillar was an object of the Demon World, and at this moment, if it were to fly into the demon array, it was likely not a good thing.
Without hesitation, Yuan Ming thrust out both hands, transforming them into Undying Tree Vines that bound the black stone pillar, pulling it firmly towards him.
However, the pillar's strength was immense, and it began dragging Yuan Ming towards the center of the demon array.
Yuan Ming's expression changed slightly as his feet transformed into Undying Tree Roots, stabbing into the ground. He tapped into the power of his Half-Demon Body, steadying his form and, with great effort, pulling the black stone pillar back, little by little.
But just then, within the giant array at the peak, the luminous black mist suddenly shot forth, autonomously penetrating the array's confines and rushing towards the black stone pillar.
Struggling against the black stone pillar, Yuan Ming had not anticipated the mist's self-directed approach and was too late to react, only able to watch helplessly as the mass of demonic energy smashed into the black stone pillar.
There was a "puh" sound.
The moment the glistening black mist collided with the pillar, it first scattered in all directions, then swiftly retracted, and thereafter completely merged into the stone pillar.This copy comes from content on *.
Yuan Ming could distinctly feel the black stone pillar trembling violently.
Suddenly, the force that wanted to fly away disappeared, and the black stone pillar heavily sunk and fell toward the ground.
The instant it hit the ground, there was a thunderous roar, as if Chaotian Peak itself had trembled.
Yuan Ming's heart also trembled violently.
He quickly gestured to bring the black stone pillar back to him, but it remained motionless.
Yuan Ming rushed forward and saw that the surface of the black stone pillar was covered with a thin mist that flowed slowly under the breeze.
During the mist's flow, mysterious and bizarre demon patterns started to emerge on the surface of the black stone pillar, grand and eerie, with a strange fluctuation.
At the same time, the originally dim surface of the black stone pillar lit up with dark light, like polished marble, shining with a luster unique to the stone material.
But in Yuan Ming's heart, a strong notion emerged, feeling as though something that had been asleep for countless years was awakening!
"No matter what, I must not leave this thing for the Wu Yue Sect," Yuan Ming thought resolutely to himself.
If he couldn't take the black stone pillar with him, then he would rather destroy it.
With a mindset to try one last time, Yuan Ming gestured towards the pillar. The black stone pillar instantly vanished and was stored inside his storage bracelet.
He was momentarily stunned, but quickly realized that the commotion here must have alerted the people of the Wu Yue Sect.
This was no place to stay for long.
Without hesitation, Yuan Ming employed his Divine Skills of the Undying Tree and reopened the void passage.
Inside the stone castle, Wulu, seeing Yuan Ming's return, wore an expression of urgent concern.
"Yuan Ming, what in the world are you doing? Did you blow up Chaotian Peak? What's with all this commotion?" he couldn't help but rebuke.
The tremendous shaking that had come from Chaotian Peak was also felt here, nearly indistinguishable from an earthquake.
"The situation has changed; let's get out of here first," Yuan Ming said as he tried to open the spatial passage again.
"Audacious villains, since you are here, don't even think about escaping," boomed a grand voice from outside at that moment.
Immediately after, a pressure so immense that it was unimaginable descended upon them.
"It's too late," Wulu said, frowning as he saw this.
Before the words were out of his mouth, the dome of the stone castle above them, under the pressure of the tremendous force, collapsed with a deafening crash.
The power was incredibly vast, almost beyond imagination; not only did it contain terrifying pressure, but it also held boundless Divine Soul Power. Wherever it passed, the void trembled, displaying waves of distortion.
Yuan Ming's space channel had not yet opened when it was twisted and interrupted under the influence of the force.
"Great Black Sky God Palm..." he couldn't help but frown.
Wulu's eyes sharpened, and his body twisted as his thick hands suddenly swept towards the sky.
In an instant, the space around him distorted, and a powerful, blood-colored tornado burst forth from his body, sweeping away the collapsing dome and the entire stone castle into dust.
Both men emerged, and at a glance saw that a chaotic storm was rapidly approaching them from afar.
Wrapped in black smoke was a tall figure; it was none other than the Wu Yue God.
Before he could draw close, the Wu Yue God's body erupted with billowing black smoke as he raised one hand high up and fiercely slapped it down towards Yuan Ming.
The void above the two men's heads suddenly vibrated violently, followed by a darkening of the sky, as if night had suddenly fallen, making everything unclear; only a colossal power as vast as the sea enveloped them.
"Great Black Sky God Palm, this is the true Great Black Sky God Palm..." Yuan Ming looked up, his heart filled with immense shock.
Above them, a black giant palm large enough to cover the sun and seemingly without boundaries revealed a vague halo, pressing down from above. Wave after wave of black fluctuations compounded on top of one another, displaying the massive power without a doubt.
At that moment, a hundred zhang radius of the void froze, space was petrified, and Yuan Ming's bodies were locked in place.
Even the thought of escape had become a luxury for them.
Wulu couldn't help but swallow hard, his heart filled with unspeakable shock.
But in Yuan Ming's eyes, after a moment of surprise, intense war intent replaced it.
His eyes twinkled, and his flesh seemed to come alive; facing this overwhelmingly powerful attack, he became completely exhilarated.
Fight, fight. His Body of Wanxiang was self-activating, urging him on to fight.
Yuan Ming's face gradually contorted into madness; facing the descending palm that threatened to obliterate him, he didn't retreat but advanced. His blood boiled, and wisps of red mist rose from his body.
He roared and stomped his feet fiercely, shooting up like a reverse meteor, punching towards the Great Black Sky God Palm.
In the high sky, the air crackled, elongated like the whistling of an arrow.
Yuan Ming's skyward punch, dead center in the black palm, suddenly brightened with a blood-red light, like a blood sun tearing through the pitch-black canvas, abruptly bursting with light.
In the "boom" of the explosion, all the might of the Great Black Sky God Palm disintegrated in an instant.
"He's become this powerful already?" Wulu, staring at Yuan Ming's silhouette, was somewhat stunned for a moment.
However, the next moment, Yuan Ming's urgent voice rang out in his Sea of Consciousness: "What are you standing around for, run for it!"
Wulu snapped back to reality and quickly chased after Yuan Ming's figure.
However, the Wu Yue God was obviously faster, and in the blink of an eye, he teleported to block their path.
When he saw Yuan Ming's appearance, surprise flickered in his eyes, and he bellowed angrily, "Yuan Ming, you're still alive? Impossible, no one can escape my Evil Curse Kill!"
Yuan Ming frowned upon hearing this, immediately recalling the event at Black Witch Mountain where his Divine Soul was nearly devoured by an Evil Ghost, and had a sudden realization.
But he knew this was not the time to think about such things. If they couldn't escape in time, there was no chance of survival from this powerful Wu Yue God.
While the Wu Yue God was still caught in shock, Yuan Ming did not hesitate, instantly executed the Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill, and mobilized all the power of the Body of Wanxiang; his body flared up as if ignited in red Blood Flames.
He charged a punch with full force, his blood boiling like never before, flowing through the Circulation pathways throughout his body, then gathering all the power in the punch he unleashed towards Yuan Ming.
This time, Yuan Ming employed the essence of the Emperor Sealing God Fist, using his own strength to harness the power of the heavens and the earth around him.
The void around him suddenly condensed, countless Primordial Qi gathered towards him, and a blood-colored Giant Elephant with a form as concrete as its spirit charged towards the Wu Yue God.
The Wu Yue God came to his senses, flames of Blood Flames ignited around him, and his form rapidly swelled and distorted, emitting a continuously escalating aura. It seemed he was about to transform into a one-eyed Evil Ghost.
However, Yuan Ming's Blood-colored Giant Elephant had already rushed to the front, forcing him to swing his Blood Claw at it.
The Blood Claw imprint instantly swelled by a hundred times, colliding with the Blood-colored Giant Elephant, resulting in a thunderous explosion.
In the violent aftermath, the Wu Yue God was struck back by the blow.
Without hesitation, Yuan Ming and Wulu each deployed their respective Escape Techniques, shooting toward the direction of the Chang Chun Temple at high speed.
Several hundred members of the Wu Yue Sect were pursuing them, flying into the air to intercept.
"Get out of the way..."
With a roar from Wulu, a blood-colored tornado whirled around him, instantly scattering these would-be blockers.
The two did not dare to linger and quickly swept away.
However, they had just reached the mountain gate when a Blood Shadow suddenly chased after them from one side, shouting:
"Don't run."
Along with the shout, huge blood-colored bolts of lightning shot from behind, interweaving to block all possible escape routes for Yuan Ming, set on annihilating them on the spot.

chapters.title: Chapter 732 - 732: 703
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming turned back to look and through the gaps between the flashes of blood-colored lightning, he immediately saw the Blood Demon Ancestor clad in crystalline, blood-colored armor, looking both anxious and furious.
"Old thief!" Wulu's eyes were about to split with anger, and he was ready to throw caution to the wind and turn back to settle the score with him.
"Now is not the time," Yuan Ming hastily reached out to stop him.
As he spoke, the blood light in his eyes hardened, and abruptly, a giant, blood-colored figure, tall as a mountain, materialized behind him.
This giant bore a stern expression with facial features only somewhat resembling Yuan Ming's, its overall presence was closer to that of the Nether Moon God, emanating a regal, mysterious aura that commanded respect and seemed sacrosanct.
This was the Blood Gang True Body that Yuan Ming had condensed after advancing to the Body of Wanxiang.
His Blood Gang True Body stepped forward and pushed out with a huge palm into the void, unleashing an overwhelmingly powerful Blood Gang force that surged out. The thick blood-colored lightning bolts were swept away by this force and exploded into pieces.
In the midst of thunderous booms, Blood Demon Thunder continually exploded, and one of the Blood Gang True Body's arms burst apart as well.
However, its massive body did not retreat a single step, moving with unstoppable force as it swung its other arm, sweeping it horizontally below.
In an instant, blood light surged dramatically, and the vast arm swept across like a wild wind clearing the ground, leveling both the Chang Chun Temple's main gate and the mountainside structures behind it and sending a large number of pursuing Wu Yue Sect disciples flying back.
Seeing this, Wulu's body flared with blood light, the blood crystal on his forehead shining blindingly as he spun like a top, sending out wildly violent hurricanes that transformed into a hundred-zhang tall, continuous Sky-reaching Wind Pillar, effectively blocking the pursuers.
Without any further hesitation, he and Yuan Ming used a Secret Technique to escape from the place.
By the time the Blood Demon Ancestor shattered the Blood Gang True Body and the Wu Yue God dispersed the Sky-reaching Wind Pillar, both of their figures had long since vanished.
"Fellow Daoist Wuyue, quickly use the Curse Killing Technique. We cannot let those two escape; otherwise, the trouble will be endless," the Blood Demon Ancestor hurriedly urged after catching up with the Wu Yue God.
The Wu Yue God had a gloomy expression and shook his head.
"Why not make a move?" asked the Blood Demon Ancestor, suddenly very anxious.
"I have already attempted to curse kill that Yuan Ming once before, but for some reason, he's still alive and unharmed," the Wu Yue God said, frowning and shaking his head.
"If once doesn't work, then try it again," the Blood Demon Ancestor said.
"Do you think the Evil Curse Kill is something you can just use whenever you want?" the Wu Yue God sneered dismissively.
"This… Ah…" Upon hearing this, the Blood Demon Ancestor instantly became annoyed and sighed deeply.
"I've just been to Chaotian Peak and although there was a disturbance, the Great Array was not destroyed—only delayed. So, there is no need for such worry," the Wu Yue God slowly said.Thischapterfirstappearedon*.
"You don't understand, Yuan Ming has a secret treasure of utmost importance to me. Now that he has escaped, it will be very difficult to get it back," the Blood Demon Ancestor lamented regretfully.
"A secret treasure? What could be more important than the matter we planned earlier? Better think about how to accelerate that instead," the Wu Yue God said, seemingly uninterested in the Blood Demon Ancestor's secret treasure.
"The Magic Cloud Tree has already matured; it's not difficult to hasten that process. It's just that your Wu Yue Sect's defenses are a bit too lax," the Blood Demon Ancestor said, now calm but with some dissatisfaction.
Just as the Wu Yue God was about to speak, a commotion suddenly arose from below.
At that moment, a figure flew over swiftly. It was a white-browed old man dressed in a black robe.
"Lord Wu Yue God, during the recent commotion, prisoners in the Law Hall Water Prison started a rebellion, and some have escaped," said the white-browed old man, who arrived and knelt bowing as soon as he landed.
"Those half-dead prisoners, what capacity do they have to rebel? Are you joking with me?" the Wu Yue God asked with a cold voice upon hearing this.
"Yes… Yes… It's because some disciples guarding them rebelled—no, some were controlled by Illusion Technique. They attacked the other guards and freed the prisoners," the white-browed old man stammered.
"Capture them at all costs," the Wu Yue God said coldly, his figure swiftly rushing back.
The Blood Demon Ancestor watched all of this with a cold eye, remaining silent. After the Wu Yue God had left, he lingered on the spot for about thirty minutes before returning inside the Chang Chun Temple.
Soon, he passed through several layers of forbidden seals to enter a rather secluded underground chamber.
The chamber was not large, around fifty to sixty zhang in size, and surrounded by walls that emitted layers of silvery light. In the center of the room stood a half-person-tall black Stone Pillar.
At the top of the black Stone Pillar, a black flame burned, its flames dancing and occasionally emitting a series of "crackling" noises.
"Lord Demon," the Blood Demon Ancestor hesitated for a moment before stepping forward, kneeling on one knee, and bowing in front of the Stone Pillar.
After a brief wait, the black flame flickered a few times, and a grand yet ethereal voice emerged from it:
"Is there new information?"
"Lord Demon, I have discovered the whereabouts of the Sky-reaching Demon Pillar and the Evil King Mirror," the Blood Demon Ancestor said.
"Since you have found them, why haven't you swiftly retrieved them?" an annoyed voice came from the flame.
"Both exotic treasures are in the same person's hands, but regrettably, his strength is so formidable that with my current power, I am unable to retrieve them for you," the Blood Demon Ancestor said carefully choosing his words.
The voice from within the black flame paused for a moment before replying, "On this matter, I will send Xue Li to handle it. Once the two treasures are reclaimed, you shall be generously rewarded."
"Thank you, Lord Demon." Blood Demon Ancestor said joyfully as he knelt in worship.
...
At the foot of Chaotian Peak, Wuyue God hovered midair, in front of him a sea of people, all followers of the Wu Yue Sect kneeling on the ground.
"Lord, most of the escapees have been executed, and those captured have also committed suicide." an elder reported.
"What about those rebels, what's the deal with them?" Wuyue God asked in a deep voice.
"After investigation, some were under the influence of illusion techniques, and a few seemed to have been turned into puppets," the person responded.
"You should strengthen the defenses of Chang Chun Temple and reinforce the Forbidden of Chaotian Peak. If such events happen again, behead yourselves as sacrifices," Wuyue God said with a cold gaze sweeping over his followers.
"Yes," the followers replied with trembling voices.
Just then, a voice suddenly appeared out of thin air, "Such methods might work on ordinary enemies, but I fear they'd be ineffective against Yuan Ming."
Wuyue God waved his hand and an ethereal figure materialized out of nothing—it was a Residual Soul of the Nine Yin Venerable.
"What do you mean by this?" Wuyue God asked.
"This young man Yuan Ming is a Soul Cultivator, and his cultivation might have already approached that of a Spoken Witch. His strength is not to be underestimated, and his methods are also unusually cunning. As far as I know, he possesses a very strange and secretive Divine Skill that allows him to possess others quietly and take control, leaving one utterly defenseless," the Residual Soul of Nine Yin Venerable said.
"Oh, possession?" Wuyue God murmured after a moment's thought.
...
With Yuan Ming and Wulu's speed, they arrived at the outskirts of the Cloud Ridge Mountain Range in no time.
"I will not go with you." Wulu suddenly stopped his tunneling light and said.
"Does Brother Wulu worry about the strange changes in your body?" Yuan Ming asked.
"Some time ago, the Wu Yue Sect used Demonic Qi when they broke through the Great Array of Chang Chun Temple. Now, for the Cloud Desolate Alliance, a person with Demonic Qi is certainly unwelcome, even hostile. I do not have Brother Yuan's means to conceal Demonic Qi, so I'll avoid causing you trouble by going there," Wulu said with a wry smile.
"Very well, Brother Wulu, just stay within the Cloud Ridge Mountain Range. When the Alliance makes its counterattack, we shall act together," Yuan Ming said.
He also had Demonic Qi within him, but it was contained by the Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill, along with the disguise of the Undying Tree, so naturally he did not need to worry about detection.
Wulu nodded, flew into the Cloud Ridge Mountain Range, and carved a Cave Mansion out of an inconspicuous cliff before eagerly flying in.
Thump!
The moment he entered the cave, he collapsed on the ground, shivering with his hands clasping his body, his cheeks flushing red as blood.
The Blood Puppet Armor was backfiring again!
It was not just the backfire of Blood Puppet Armor; Wulu's body contained too many powers that were not his own—Blood Puppet Armor, Mana sealed within the armor, Demonic Qi, and the power of the blood-colored crystal on his forehead.
All these distinctly different powers were beyond Wulu's control. Even without the backfire of the Blood Puppet Armor, they would clash within his body; the backlash of the Blood Puppet Armor only intensified this conflict tenfold.
After a long time, the blood color on Wulu's face gradually faded, and he slowly sat up.
"I must find the removal method for the Blood Puppet Armor soon, or I won't last long on my own…" he muttered to himself.
...
Yuan Ming continued his journey and soon arrived deep within the mountain range, at the temporary base of the Cloud Desolate Alliance.
On the way, he had already notified Xi Ying through a Communication Talisman, so when he reached the Alliance's base, a group of people was already waiting there, including Xi Ying, Tian Jizi, Wan Tianren, Luo Zhu, and other Sect leaders.
"Haha, I have long heard of Fellow Daoist Yuan's great name but never had the chance to meet. Today, I finally see you. There have been some misunderstandings between us in the past, but now resisting the Wu Yue Sect is the pressing matter. Let's call it even on past issues," Tian Jizi stepped forward, cupping his fists in greeting with genuine sincerity.
Ancestor Ming Quan stood nearby, maintaining a smile, yet the hostility in his eyes was not well concealed.
"Of course, Fellow Daoist Tianji is being too serious," Yuan Ming replied, disregarding Ancestor Ming Quan and returning the greeting to Tian Jizi.
Wan Tianren, Gu Xuanyang, Luo Zhu, and other acquainted individuals also stepped forward to greet him, their expressions slightly odd, as if hesitating to speak.
Yuan Ming saw everything and looked towards Xi Ying.
"To fight the Wu Yue Sect, the Cloud Desolate Alliance pooled all kinds of information to share with everyone. Your identity as the Nether Moon God has been exposed," Xi Ying communicated silently.
Yuan Ming's expression shifted slightly, showing no surprise.
The image of the Nether Moon God was none other than his true self. Wan Tianren and Gu Xuanyang were clueless because they didn't know what Yuan Ming looked like. Chang Chun Temple had the most prolonged interaction with him, and now that the Nether Moon God's reputation was widespread, if Chang Chun Temple were to investigate a little, they could easily figure out the details of the Nether Moon God.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, may I ask a presumptuous question? Are you the rumored Nether Moon God?" a voice suddenly asked. The speaker was a golden-haired old man clad in a loose yellow robe, his face deeply lined, conveying a very old and feeble appearance.

chapters.title: Chapter 733 - 704: Admission
chapters.content:
"Is Your Excellency He Cha from the Vajra Sect?" Yuan Ming looked over following the voice.
Based on the descriptions of the main figures of the Cloud Desolate Alliance provided by Xi Ying beforehand, he had recognized that the elder before him was indeed the senior ancestor He Cha from the Vajra Sect.
Despite his seemingly decrepit appearance, Yuan Ming could clearly sense the colossal Qi Blood Power lying dormant within the man's body, which had already reached the peak of the Tongqiao Body and was beginning to coalesce into the Power of Blood Gang.
It was just a pity that He Cha's Qi Blood couldn't be perfectly dormant; otherwise, there was a great chance for it to be completely transformed into the Power of Blood Gang, taking his strength to the next level.
As for breaking through to the Body of Wanxiang, given He Cha's age and talent, it was highly unlikely without some exceptional opportunity or fortune.
"I am indeed He Cha. Fellow Daoist Yuan, please do not take offense at the suddenness, but with the Cao Family's sudden betrayal causing the alliance a great defeat, we've decided after discussion that anyone who joins the Cloud Desolate Alliance must have their identity and background thoroughly verified. Please understand, Fellow Daoist Yuan," He Cha said.
Yuan Ming looked towards Xi Ying, who gave a slight nod.
After pondering for a moment, he nodded and said, "It is true. I founded the Moon Sect."
At these words, the people present looked at each other and began to discuss in low voices, many frowning.
In the past ten years, the fame of the Nether Moon God throughout the Cloud Desolate had grown so intense that it was almost on par with the Wu Yue God. Indeed, many in the Cloud Desolate Alliance even saw the Nether Moon God as their savior, especially now that the alliance was retreating into the Cloud Ridge Mountain Range, where many more were placing their hopes on the Nether Moon God.
However, the Yuan Ming before them was mere a Nascent Soul Early Stage cultivator, with a very weak Divine Soul fluctuation, far too distant from the legendary might of the Nether Moon God heard in the rumors.
Yuan Ming's Physical Body had already stepped into the Body of Wanxiang, with his Qi Blood Power being subtle and restrained. Fearing that the Demonic Qi within him might be exposed, he suppressed his Qi Blood Power to the extreme and used the Undying Tree to cover it up. As there were no beings of the same level present, none discovered the depth of his Body Cultivation.
He took in everyone's expressions, smiled faintly, and did not offer any explanation.
Tian Jizi's expression also turned strange, but he quickly settled back to calm and smiled, "Fellow Daoist Yuan speaks frankly, which shows your honesty."
"In that case, I should be considered a member of the Cloud Desolate Alliance now, right?" Yuan Ming said with a smile.
"Of course, Fellow Daoist Yuan, this way please." Tian Jizi gestured forward and led Yuan Ming into the residence.
"I heard from Fellow Daoist Xi that Fellow Daoist Yuan infiltrated Chang Chun Temple. Did you discover anything?" Tian Jizi asked as they walked.
Hearing this, others also stopped their discussions and turned to look.
Yuan Ming reported the information he had discovered, except he omitted the black Stone Pillar and the confrontations with the Wu Yue God and Blood Demon Ancestor, instead saying that he had been discovered and promptly escaped.
The faces of everyone present changed upon hearing this, with the cultivators from Chang Chun Temple displaying shock and anger.
What shocked them was the extent of the actions taken by the Wu Yue Sect, indicating significant ambition; what angered them was that the sect they had operated for generations had become a Demon Realm.
Tian Jizi immediately dispatched people to investigate the situation at Chang Chun Temple more thoroughly.
As they conversed, the group had already entered the compound.
The residence was temporarily erected, yet it was quite well established. The whole area was enveloped by a massive Barrier, and numerous sentinels, both visible and hidden, were set up around the perimeter, so there was no need to worry about safety.
The compound was large, divided into east, south, west, and north regions, housing cultivators from the East Sea, Southern Border, Western Region, and Central Plains, respectively.For a smoother reading experience, visit MV&LEMPYR.
With the base of the Moon Sect in Dragon King City, it was placed in the eastern region.
Upon hearing urgent matters, Tian Jizi had no time to chat leisurely with Yuan Ming. He entrusted Wan Tianren with hosting Yuan Ming and left in a hurry.
Yuan Ming had matters to discuss with Xi Ying and was not interested in engaging in conversation with Wan Tianren or Gu Xuanyang. After greeting them briefly, he followed Xi Ying into her dwelling.
Wan Tianren watched their figures disappear into the distance, his expression shifting between light and dark, remaining silent.
"Fellow Daoist Wan, what's your take on this Yuan Ming?" Gu Xuanyang's voice came from the side.
"This is not the place to talk. Let's go inside," Wan Tianren said with a change of expression, hastily sending a message through divine sense and leading Gu Xuanyang into his own residence.
Wan Tianren formed hand seals and set up seven or eight Barriers in succession before ceasing.
"Fellow Daoist Wan is really cautious," Gu Xuanyang said with a smile.
"Facing an entity like the Nether Moon God, no amount of caution is too much," Wan Tianren said indifferently.
"Does Fellow Daoist Wan truly believe that Yuan Ming is the Nether Moon God?" Gu Xuanyang asked.
"As far as I know, a Soul Cultivator who wishes to gather Desire Power must use their True Face for the godly image, otherwise, the Desire Power cannot converge upon them," Wan Tianren said after a moment of silence.
"Is that so? Then it seems that Yuan Ming really is the Nether Moon God. But why is his Soul Power so weak? Such a slight Soul Wave fluctuation is perhaps worse than an ordinary Nascent Soul cultivator," Gu Xuanyang said after expressing surprise.
Wan Tianren didn't reply; this was also his doubt.
Just now, he had used a secret technique to investigate Yuan Ming. It was true that Yuan Ming had only that small amount of Soul Power, and it wasn't due to intentional concealment.
His secret technique came from the Golden Sunflower Heavenly Book, which couldn't be wrong on this point.
"Could it be that Yuan Ming suffered injury from a battle with someone, leading to severe damage to his Divine Soul?" The thought suddenly occurred to Wan Tianren.
"What should we do next? If the Nether Moon God can no longer provide us with protection, there's no need to pray to him daily, offering up Desire Power, right?" Gu Xuanyang said lazily.
Wan Tianren also found the daily prayers to be a hindrance to his affairs, preventing him from going into long periods of seclusion as he used to do before—it was quite detrimental to his cultivation.
"Let's take a look before deciding," he said.
…
"You said in your message earlier that you had made a breakthrough with the Body of Wanxiang? Is that true?" Xi Ying formed hand seals and set up two barriers hurriedly, asking with a face full of curiosity.
Yuan Ming rarely saw Xi Ying with such an expression, and he smiled faintly as he activated the Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill.
A colossal Qi Blood Power burst forth from his body, turning him into a blood-red sun, unbearably scorching. The two newly formed barriers shook violently, nearly collapsing.
Xi Ying quickly set up several more barriers, but alas, to no avail.
Yuan Ming retracted his Qi Blood Power and the room's blood light vanished instantly without a trace.
"Is this the Qi Blood Power of the Body of Wanxiang? Indeed terrifying, still as an ancient well when calm, but like a tsunami shaking mountains when roused! To control the Qi Blood Power to such an extent, it seems your Power of Will has been tempered to an unimaginable level. I guessed right, didn't I? The key to breaking through to the Body of Wanxiang is the tempering of the Power of Will?" Xi Ying's eyes fixed on Yuan Ming as she asked.
Yuan Ming looked at Xi Ying with a bit of surprise and nodded slightly.
"So it is indeed. My father has been obsessively pursuing external aids, which I'm afraid is a diversion from the true path. No wonder there's been no progress all these years," Xi Ying said softly.
"Senior Xi's Emperor Sealing God Fist and its method for borrowing external forces can't exactly be considered a diversion. That secret technique is also a form of tempering the Power of Will indirectly and does help in breaking through to the Body of Wanxiang. It's just that Senior Xi practices magic, body, and soul cultivation simultaneously, which inevitably divides his attention. Moreover, his accumulation of power is still insufficient, which makes further progress difficult," Yuan Ming explained.
His own breakthrough to the Body of Wanxiang was largely due to his Divine Soul being sealed, leaving little room for progress in magic cultivation, thus he devoted himself entirely to body cultivation. Additionally, he had the help of Shura Master's pure and colossal Qi Blood Power along with Demonic Qi, which enabled his swift success.
Without these conditions, relying only on his own efforts, it was uncertain how long it would have taken him to make this step.
"I see," Xi Ying nodded.
She personally brewed a cup of Spiritual Tea for Yuan Ming, inquiring about the specific situation at the Chang Chun Temple.
Facing Xi Ying, Yuan Ming naturally did not conceal anything and recounted everything in detail.
"The Magic Cloud Tree! I had not imagined that such a miraculous Spirit Tree existed in the world, one that could transform nature's spiritual energy into Demonic Qi!" Xi Ying's eyes shone brightly, appearing very curious about the Magic Cloud Tree.
"Here's the Array Map of that Demon Array. Can you make anything out of it?" Yuan Ming took out a Jade Scroll and passed it to Xi Ying.
Xi Ying took the Jade Scroll and infused her Divine Sense into it.
Yuan Ming felt the fluctuations of Xi Ying's Divine Soul and his brow furrowed slightly.
As he continued to refine the forbidden elements of the Stealing Heaven Tripod, his sensitivity to Divine Souls became increasingly acute. The Divine Sense Xi Ying had just emitted was much stronger than before, having reached the Peak of Sleep Witch.
However, Xi Ying's Divine Soul had lost its former composure and seemed rather restless.
"No good, I have no understanding of Demon Realm Arrays, and can't make out much. It appears to be some kind of Teleportation Array," Xi Ying said quickly, withdrawing her Divine Sense.
Yuan Ming did not dwell on her words. He extended a finger towards Xi Ying's forehead, and a stream of Soul Power entered her Sea of Consciousness.
Xi Ying looked at Yuan Ming and remained still.
"Your Soul Power is restless and has started to affect the foundation. Why would you use such a rash method to enhance your power?" Yuan Ming withdrew his Soul Power, speaking with a hint of reproach.
"The Wu Yue Sect's forces have already reached our doorstep. If I don't enhance my strength, we'll all be dead, and then it won't matter what happens afterwards," Xi Ying sighed.
Yuan Ming fell silent, pondering a solution.
"Don't worry, my Divine Soul Transformation is a Golden Crow, adept at refining the impurities in Soul Power. Once the matter with the Wu Yue Sect is resolved, I should be able to purify the impurities completely with fifty years of refining," Xi Ying mentioned.
"That won't be necessary. Once I've finished refining the Stealing Heaven Tripod, I can use the white flames inside the White Jade Lotus Platform to help you refine away the impurities of your Divine Soul," Yuan Ming suggested.
"How far have you gotten with refining the restrictions of the Stealing Heaven Tripod?" Xi Ying asked with bright eyes.
"I have refined thirteen layers; it will take some more time," Yuan Ming replied.
Xi Ying felt a slight disappointment but did not show it, nodding gently before changing the topic:
"I remember you mentioned before that during the raid on the Wu Yue Sect's headquarters, you obtained many classics?"
"True. Would you like to see them?" asked Yuan Ming.
"Mm, lately my head often suffers sharp pains that are difficult to endure. Whenever that happens, no cultivation technique helps, but reading some unfamiliar books can alleviate it a bit," Xi Ying answered.
"Why is that?" Yuan Ming was taken aback.
"It could be a side effect of absorbing too many yin souls. As to why reading helps, I am not clear. Perhaps it is because reading nurtures a quiet mind," Xi Ying speculated.
"Then take these classics with you," Yuan Ming said without further inquiry, waving his hand and a large pile of classics appeared on the ground before them.
These were not just from the treasure trove of the Wu Yue Sect headquarters; the Wu Yue God's physical body had a storage magic tool on it that also contained numerous Jade Scroll Books.
When Yuan Ming first found that storage artifact, he was initially quite excited, but after a brief inspection, he was deeply disappointed. The value of the items inside was pitifully scant, save for these series of Jade Scroll Books, a couple of Spirit Stones, and elixirs, not even a single Magic Treasure.
The Jade Scroll Books, however, were quite valuable, all of them Soul Cultivation Methods. Unfortunately, they did not include the seventh layer of the Moonlight Technique he had longed for.

chapters.title: Chapter 734 - 734: 705
chapters.content:
Xi Ying's eyes brightened upon seeing such a vast collection of classics, and after a brief examination, she gently waved her sleeve.
Volume after volume of classical jade scrolls began to fly automatically, each heading towards the nearby bookshelves.
It was only then that Yuan Ming noticed the seven or eight bookshelves arranged in the corners of Xi Ying's room, each one piled high with classics, sorted by categories such as Magic Practitioners, Body Cultivation, Soul Cultivation, elixirs, spiritual materials, formations, and so on.
"Xi Ying, you're well-versed in various classics. Have you ever heard of a spiritual material called a Mixed Hole Primordial Stone?" Yuan Ming suddenly thought of something and asked.
"Mixed Hole Primordial Stone? I haven't heard of that," Xi Ying thought for a moment and shook her head.
Yuan Ming felt a slight sinking feeling in his heart. It would be even more troublesome to find something that even Xi Ying hadn't heard of.
"What is a Mixed Hole Primordial Stone?" Xi Ying inquired.
Yuan Ming did not conceal anything and explained the condition of Nine Yin Venerable's body as well as the Mixed Hole Secret Technique to Xi Ying.
"I see, but if even the Nine Yin Venerable couldn't obtain such a material, I fear it may not be an object of Yunhuang Continent. You might have to search in the Overseas World to possibly find it," Xi Ying said.
Yuan Ming nodded slightly. He had only just started practicing the Mixed Hole Secret Technique and didn't need the stone in the short term. He figured he would gradually look for it later.
Having discussed these minor matters, the two talked about the issues with the Wu Yue Sect.
"What's your plan going forward? The Wu Yue Sect planted the Magic Cloud Tree within Chang Chun Temple and set up this Demon Array. Their intentions are clearly significant. We cannot sit back and let them succeed," Xi Ying said.
"That's a given. However, with figures like the Wuyue God and the Blood Demon Ancestor of Returning Void level on their side, and with my Soul Cultivation Divine Powers sealed, a direct attack would be too risky. Let's wait until the effects of the Stealing Heaven Tripod have subsided. I'll use the Black Incense Possession again to discern the Wu Yue Sect's intentions before taking action. The Demon Array shouldn't be able to exert too much influence in just a few days," Yuan Ming articulated.
"This Demon Array is harnessing the power of starlight, probably as preparation to activate the array. It's similar to the pyramid structure we constructed earlier. Given the scale of that Demon Array and the speed at which you described the starlight converging, it indeed won't cause a significant change in a short time," Xi Ying pondered for a moment before stating.
"That's good. Tian Jizi has already sent someone to Chang Chun Temple. Perhaps we will soon have a grasp on the situation there," Yuan Ming's expression shifted before he said with a smile.
Xi Ying didn't respond, but just gave a slight, cold laugh, clearly not having much faith in the ability of the people dispatched by Tian Jizi.
"Elder Xi Zheng is within the Wu Yue Sect's army. You might try to get some information from him," Yuan Ming suggested.
"I have of course attempted that, but my father has been ignoring my transmissions. I'm afraid he's concerned about being detected by the Wuyue God," Xi Ying frowned slightly, worrying in silence for Xi Zheng's safety.
"That's to be expected. For the next few days, let's both make thorough preparations for the tough battle ahead," Yuan Ming declared.Thanks for reading—brought to you by *.
After some idle chat, Yuan Ming stood up to take his leave, intending to find a place to rest for a while.
Infiltrating Chang Chun Temple and the great battle with personalities like the Wuyue God and the Blood Demon Ancestor had drained him considerably; it was necessary to find a place to recuperate.
"Hold on, I have something here that I need your help with," Xi Ying suddenly interjected.
"Oh? What is it?" Yuan Ming inquired.
"About my sister, the Immortal Elixir has been refined, and her condition is deteriorating. She needs to take it immediately. However, the potency of the Immortal Elixir is far greater than I anticipated, and my sister's body may not be able to withstand it. I need you to use the support of the Undying Tree," Xi Ying explained.
"The Immortal Elixir can't be taken directly?" Yuan Ming's brow furrowed.
Xi Ying possessed several Undying Immortal Fruits, and Yuan Ming initially planned to have his parents consume the Immortal Elixirs. Now it seemed it wasn't going to be that simple.
"After consuming the Immortal Elixir, it will remodel the Physical Body from the inside out, rebirthing it entirely. The strain on the body and Divine Soul during this period is immense. If you're thinking of extending your parents' lives by having them consume the Immortal Elixir, I'm afraid that's hardly plausible," Xi Ying articulated, obviously aware of what Yuan Ming was thinking.
Yuan Ming remained silent, his expression quite grim.
"There's no need to rush. The Cultivation World does have things that can extend the lifespan of mortals. I alone know of three or four options. After the battle with the Wu Yue Sect is finished, I'll help you search," Xi Ying offered.
Yuan Ming nodded, then gathered his emotions and asked, "Do we administer the Immortal Elixir to your sister now?"
"I still need to make some preparations. Let's start tomorrow," Xi Ying replied, shaking her head.
Yuan Ming had no objections.
Xi Ying called for an attendant to take Yuan Ming to a neighboring room to settle in.
Yuan Ming took out the Silver Token and unfurled three layers of the silver barrier in the room, completely sealing the surroundings before stopping.
He closed his eyes to control his breathing, recovering the depleted mana, and then took out an item—it was that black Stone Pillar.
The Stone Pillar surged with black light, emitting astonishing fluctuations of Demonic Qi, even more intense than before back at Chang Chun Temple.
Yuan Ming looked serious as he injected a stream of Demonic Qi into the black Stone Pillar.
The black light on the Stone Pillar suddenly exploded, enveloping Yuan Ming.
This pure black light devoured everything—whether it was nature's spiritual energy, fluctuations of mana, or even sound—leaving nothing untouched.
"Be careful! This is True Demon Energy, quite tricky to handle!" Qi Ye's voice suddenly rang out.
Yuan Ming's eyebrows twitched, and he stepped back half a pace, flicking out a fingertip-shaped Blood Gang which he tapped onto the black energy.
This was a combat technique recorded in a Body Cultivation Method acquired from the Wu Yue Sect's main altar, the Bone-locking Finger Technique, renowned for its astounding Penetration Power.
Every Body Cultivation Technique has a different method for circulating Qi-Blood. Yuan Ming's Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill had already reached great achievement, and it was not advisable to casually practice other Body Cultivation Methods. However, there were not so many restrictions for combat techniques.
The black Qi attempted to devour the Blood Gang finger, yet the power contained within the Blood Gang finger was too tremendous. It tore through the black light instead and heavily struck the black stone pillar.
With a "clang" of a sound like metal striking metal, the black light on the stone pillar was mostly scattered, and the pillar itself was sent flying, crashing against the silver barrier.
Upon contact with the stone pillar, the silver barrier immediately shattered, as if it were fragile silver paper.
The black stone pillar did not stop its course, its speed barely reduced, as it continued to fly backward, colliding with the second barrier.
With a sound akin to ripping silk, the second barrier also easily shattered.
A look of surprise flashed across Yuan Ming's face as he raised his hand and shot out Blood Gang power, transforming it into a thick blood-colored elephant trunk that spanned the distance of several yards in an instant and wrapped around the black stone pillar.
A surge of True Demon Energy bubbled up from the pillar, trying to corrode the blood-colored elephant trunk.
But the blood-colored elephant trunk suddenly constricted, releasing an astounding force, ruthlessly strangling and causing the surrounding air to burst with explosive sounds.
It was the combat technique from the Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill, the Devil Elephant Strangling Sky Technique!
The True Demon Energy was ground to pieces and retreated back into the pillar.
The black stone pillar, as if subdued, let out a low, aggrieved hum, and the fluctuation of Demonic Qi also subsided greatly.
Yuan Ming brought the black stone pillar back and then activated the Silver Token to reestablish the two barriers before ceasing his actions.
"It's so animated; it seems this item is undoubtedly a Spiritual Treasure." A flash of Blood Light passed over Yuan Ming, and the Shura Blood Devouring Map emerged with Qi Ye's figure on it, his gaze intent as he looked at the black stone pillar.
"Do you recognize this item?" Yuan Ming asked.
"Perhaps, but I'm not certain yet, I need to investigate it further," Qi Ye shook his head, raising his hand to send out a surge of Blood Light, enveloping the black stone pillar.
Fearing Yuan Ming, the black stone pillar did not hold back against Qi Ye, immediately releasing pure True Demon Energy in retaliation, effortlessly swallowing the Blood Light.
However, another strand of Blood Light emerged from behind and merged into the root of the black stone pillar.
The root of the stone pillar began to show threads of Blood Light, revealing dense patterns and four strange characters.
"What are these characters?" Yuan Ming asked with a soft exclamation.
"Hehe, as expected, it is this treasure!" Qi Ye seemed not to have heard Yuan Ming's words, murmuring excitedly to himself.
A few breaths later, Qi Ye finally recalled Yuan Ming's earlier question and hastily said, "Fellow Daoist Yuan, you guessed correctly. These are indeed Demon Texts, and more specifically, they are the most ancient Ancient Saint Text of the Demon World. These four characters spell 'Sky-reaching Demon Pillar'."
"Sky-reaching Demon Pillar! Such a domineering name, is this treasure well-known in the Demon World?" Yuan Ming asked, not blaming Qi Ye for his previous distraction.
"Of course, the Sky-reaching Demon Pillar is very well-known in the Demon World. It's not an attacking Spiritual Treasure nor does it have defensive capabilities. Its sole effect is to break through the void. A seal was applied inside this pillar, and it absorbed a surge of True Demon Energy from the Demon Array in Chang Chun Temple before the seal was lifted, revealing its true form," Qi Ye elaborated.
"Breaking through the void…" A light of realization flashed in Yuan Ming's eyes. No wonder the Sky-reaching Demon Pillar had effortlessly broken through the two silver barriers earlier; it turned out that this pillar was the nemesis of Space Power.
At this moment, Qi Ye seemed to have thought of something, his expression becoming serious.
"What's wrong?" Yuan Ming asked.
After a moment of hesitation, Qi Ye finally spoke, "Fellow Daoist Yuan, regarding the grand Demon Array that Wuyue God and the Blood Demon Ancestor set up in Chang Chun Temple, I might have guessed their purpose."
"What's the function of that Demon Array? Speak quickly!" Yuan Ming urged.
"The answer is very important, it concerns not only your life but also the safety of the entire Cloud Desolate Alliance, even the Yunhuang Continent. I can tell you, but in exchange, Fellow Daoist Yuan, you must also promise me a request," Qi Ye said after a brief silence, his expression solemn.
Yuan Ming paused, scrutinizing Qi Ye with his gaze.
"You might think I am making an alarmist statement now, but once you hear the answer, you will understand that my words aren't false," Qi Ye held his gaze unflinchingly, asserting his point.
"What request do you want? Just say it," Yuan Ming said, his gaze sharp.
"I want the Evil King Mirror," Qi Ye stated.
"The Evil King Mirror? You want to destroy the mirror to appease your deceased relatives?" Yuan Ming asked.
"Exactly," Qi Ye replied with a hint of hatred in his eyes, speaking gravely.
"Sorry, the Evil King Mirror is involved in many matters. I can't give it to you until I understand its origin and function," Yuan Ming said, shaking his head after a moment of contemplation.
If it were someone else asking for the Evil King Mirror, it might have been fine, but Qi Ye had been following him and could have learnt many of his secrets.
He had not yet fully studied the Evil King Mirror. The possibility that the mirror had an unknown communication feature meant that he could not simply hand it over to the other party.
Qi Ye narrowed his eyes and after a long time said, "Fine, as long as you promise to give it to me after you have fully understood the Evil King Mirror."
"That's acceptable," Yuan Ming replied after a brief contemplation.
"So we have an agreement," Qi Ye's eyes flashed with a trace of joy.

chapters.title: Chapter 735 - 706: The Power of the Immortal Pill
chapters.content:
"So can we now discuss the function of that giant demon array?" Yuan Ming asked.
"If I'm not mistaken, I'm afraid that array is the Breaking Realm Transfer Array. Its effect is to break through the barrier between the Demon World and the Yunhuang Continent and establish a stable spatial passage," Qi Ye said.
"Is that really true!" Yuan Ming suddenly stood up, his expression extremely solemn.
"Eight or nine out of ten, it is so. Once the Sky-reaching Demon Pillar appeared, the Blood Demon Ancestor immediately came after us. That's the best proof. The Breaking Realm Transfer Array, although capable of breaking the barrier between the two realms, is not very effective, and the probability of failure is quite high. If we could get a Sky-reaching Demon Pillar, it would be almost a sure thing," Qi Ye explained.
Yuan Ming's expression was extremely grave. If the purpose of the Wu Yue Sect was really as speculated, the situation was serious.
The Wu Yue Sect's attempt to unify the Yunhuang Continent was just to establish hegemony. If people from the Demon World were to descend, who knows what would happen.
"Why would the Demon World want to attack the Yunhuang Continent?" He paced the room a few times before stopping and asking.
"Naturally, it's to plunder resources. Many tribes within the Demon World have a strong sense of aggression and will create spatial passages connecting to other realms whenever possible, to plunder their resources. As you know about the Magic Cloud Tree, even if the Demon Tribe can't directly use the nature's spiritual energy here, they can transform it into Demonic Qi through the Magic Cloud Tree. Therefore, the Demon World will not let go of any realm it can invade! The Sky-reaching Demon Pillar is specially refined by top experts of the Demon World to breach the power of realms. There are said to be eighty-one in total. Sadly, most of them have disappeared today, and who would have thought one would end up in the Yunhuang Continent," Qi Ye slowly said.
After hearing all this, Yuan Ming's expression turned somewhat ugly.
He had previously been wary of the Demon World and hadn't expected the people from the Demon World to be so ferocious and domineering. If they were to descend, the entire Yunhuang Continent would likely suffer a catastrophic blow.
"According to Wulu, the Blood Demon Ancestor should be a spy the Demon Tribe planted in the Yunhuang Continent. This person has lived for thousands of years; during such a long time, why hasn't he arranged a Breaking Realm Transfer Array to summon the people of the Demon World?" Yuan Ming pondered for a moment and then asked.
"The Breaking Realm Transfer Array is not an array that can be set up just anywhere. The stronger the Spiritual Power in a place, the greater the chance of breaking the barrier. The best Spirit Vein in the Yunhuang Continent belongs to the Spirit Vein of Chang Chun Temple. I suspect that the Wu Yue Sect's war that swept through the continent had, from the beginning to the end, only one goal, and that was to take down the Chang Chun Temple," Qi Ye continued.
"Indeed, that makes some sense," Yuan Ming nodded and said.
Although Qi Ye's analysis was logical, he was, after all, a person from the Demon World and not to be trusted lightly. The purposes of the Wu Yue Sect and the Blood Demon Ancestor still needed his own verification.
Yuan Ming summoned the Sky-reaching Demon Pillar with a wave of his hand, running Demonic Qi into it. This time, the Sky-reaching Demon Pillar did not resist.
Unlike previously in the Southern Border Underground Palace, as soon as he poured Demonic Qi into it, he immediately detected its condition.
Inside the Sky-reaching Demon Pillar, like the Stealing Heaven Tripod, there were many forbiddances, although not as many as the Stealing Heaven Tripod, there were still two or three dozen.
And at the center of these forbiddances, a giant rune was suspended, more than ten times larger than ordinary runes, shining a bright silver-white, like a silver lantern.
Always read at the source—*.
"It seems that this Sky-reaching Demon Pillar is indeed as Qi Ye said, sealed by casting, using the True Demon Energy within the Chang Chun Temple's demon array to revive," Yuan Ming murmured, then started to manipulate the Demonic Qi to refine these forbiddances.
Unlike the forbidances of the Stealing Heaven Tripod, the forbiddances of the Sky-reaching Demon Pillar were simple to refine. It took less than half an hour to refine most of them, and Yuan Ming's Demonic Qi reached the silver rune, trying to activate it.
Silver light appeared at one end of the Sky-reaching Demon Pillar, flickering into the void as if it was as simple as piercing into water.
Yuan Ming's eyes brightened. This Sky-reaching Demon Pillar really was a treasure against the force of space. With this item, he would no longer need to worry about spatial forbiddances in the future.
He continued to operate the Demonic Qi, quickly refining the forbiddances of the Sky-reaching Demon Pillar completely. Unfortunately, the Artifact Spirit of the Sky-reaching Demon Pillar did not appear, still hidden deep within the pillar.
Yuan Ming did not force the Artifact Spirit, planning to communicate with it over time.
He stored the Sky-reaching Demon Pillar away and continued to rest with his eyes closed.
A night passed in the blink of an eye.
Yuan Ming followed Xi Ying to a secret chamber where a crystal coffin was placed. Inside lay a woman who looked eighty percent like Xi Ying, with the oil lamp in her hand burning quietly.
Yuan Ming looked at the woman in the crystal coffin for a moment, then quickly withdrew his gaze.
With a sweep of her sleeve, Xi Ying opened the lid of the crystal coffin, which flew to one side on its own.
The figure of the Five Elements Child flew out of one of Xi Ying's Spiritual Beast Bags and exhaled a stream of verdant light, infusing it into Xi Qian's body.
A layer of green light illuminated on Xi Qian, and her pale cheeks regained a bit of color.
"Does your sister practice a wood attribute cultivation method?" Yuan Ming asked with a raised eyebrow.
"My sister possesses a wood attribute Heavenly Spirit Root Physique and is a Yimu Spirit Body, a genius in the realm of Magical Practitioners. Unfortunately, she was harmed by a sneak attack and has been lying in this crystal coffin ever since. Otherwise, with her talent, she would have already reached the late-stage Nascent Soul by now, and even advancing to the Returning to Void Stage would not be impossible," Xi Ying said with a trace of sadness in her eyes.
Yuan Ming had heard Xi Ying talk about Xi Qian before. It seemed she was wounded by someone from the Wu Yue Sect, which was also why Xi Ying hated the Wu Yue Sect so much and always wanted to eradicate them quickly.
"Next, I will feed my sister the Immortal Elixir. I need your help to protect her meridians," Xi Ying said, pulling herself together and looking at Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming nodded, operated the Ju Mang Spirit Technique, and pressed down into the void with his right hand.
Dozens of Undying Tree Roots appeared around Xi Qian, piercing into her body.
The roots emitted strands of Undying Tree Demon Power, turning into innumerable tiny fibers and merging into Xi Qian's meridians.
This was a variation of the Soul Cultivation Method by the Nine Yin Venerable, the Heavenly Silkworm Parasitic Technique.
Although the Heavenly Silkworm Parasitic Technique was cruel, it was undeniably a top-tier Soul Cultivation Method, and the technique of transforming the soul into threads was particularly exquisite.
Yuan Ming imitated the method as if drawing a gourd based on a model and, by casting with his mana, he transformed the spirit into silk, which possessed a piercing strength far greater than ordinary mana and also carried a certain ability to control.
"It's ready," Yuan Ming said.
Xi Ying exhaled softly and took out a white jade box, which revealed a thumb-sized black elixir that emitted multicolored lights upon opening.
Strong fluctuations of Spiritual Power emanated from the black elixir, instantly sweeping through the entire room, making the nature's spiritual energy in the air vibrate.
"This Immortal Pill is indeed hard for ordinary people to bear," Yuan Ming said, sighing inwardly as he looked at the black elixir.
Xi Ying fed the elixir to Xi Qian, and as soon as it entered her mouth, it dissolved and spread throughout her body.
Boom!
A tremendous wave of mana surged from inside Xi Qian's body, rushing through her meridians like raging waves, transforming her body and reawakening a hint of life.
The pressure on Yuan Ming increased sharply. Although Xi Qian's meridians had been fortified by his secret technique, the strength of the elixir's power was so formidable that he quickly intensified the activation of the Undying Tree Root.
Wave after wave of Undying Tree Demon Power poured into Xi Qian's body, barely countering the strength of the Immortal Pill's power. Even though her meridians occasionally tore, they quickly healed.
Yuan Ming continued to suppress the strength of the Immortal Pill's power while examining Xi Qian's body at the same time.
The main injury to Xi Qian was to her Divine Soul, which had suffered some kind of devastating damage. Her Nascent Soul's Divine Soul had almost completely dissipated, unable to sustain the body's functions, which was why she lay in a death-like slumber.
Moreover, Xi Qian's Nascent Soul had shrunk a great deal, appearing extremely withered.
Yuan Ming carefully sensed Xi Qian's Divine Soul and let out a light exclamation.
The Divine Soul was weak and exceedingly chaotic, split into several strands of power that were attacking each other, causing continuous internal consumption of her Soul Power, leading to decay.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming was quite astonished.
The power of the Immortal Pill rapidly merged with every part of Xi Qian's body, steadily strengthening her faint life force. The sound of her heartbeat grew stronger and stronger, pumping fresh blood throughout her body.
Her body's mana was also stimulated and began to flow smoothly.
Besides her physical body and mana, a burst of life force also infused into Xi Qian's Divine Soul, healing the soul's wounds and bolstering her Soul Power.
"To think it can thoroughly heal both the physical body and Divine Soul, it truly deserves the name of an Immortal Pill," Yuan Ming remarked with amazement.
Time passed by, and soon a quarter of an hour had gone by.
The power of the Immortal Pill showed no signs of weakening, and Xi Qian's body and mana had already recovered, but the chaotic force within her Divine Soul still existed.
Simply boosting Xi Qian's Soul Power without removing this chaotic force would not awaken her, and might even backfire.
Yuan Ming's Divine Soul was sealed within the Stealing Heaven Tripod, limiting the Divine Soul techniques he could use. After much contemplation, he failed to think of a solution and was about to discuss the issue with Xi Ying.
Suddenly, Xi Ying's hands formed seals and then pressed on Xi Qian's head.
"This is…" Yuan Ming's eyes moved.
The technique Xi Ying had just applied was his Six Jia Qimen.
A flash of spirit light passed through Xi Ying's palm, and the chaotic force within Xi Qian's head abruptly vanished. Xi Ying herself, however, let out a muffled grunt and staggered backward several steps, with blood flowing from her nostrils.
She quickly sat down cross-legged, a bright golden light emanating from her glabella, looking as if flames were burning.
"Xi Ying, you…" Yuan Ming's expression changed slightly.
The chaotic force that had just disappeared from Xi Qian's Divine Soul, at that moment, appeared within Xi Ying's Divine Soul.
The power of Xi Ying's Divine Soul immediately became turbulent. Her already unstable Soul Power became even more critical, causing her Sea of Consciousness to vibrate.
She uttered a low shout, and her Divine Soul transformed into a magnificent flaming Golden Crow. Its golden flames rolled and surged, enveloping that chaotic force within it and scorching it fiercely.
This chaotic force was exceptionally tenacious, but Xi Ying's Soul Power had reached the Peak of the Sleeping Witch, and the flames of the Golden Crow Soul were even more powerful, quickly incinerating it.
Only then did she breathe a sigh of relief, and her complexion improved slightly.
"Xi Ying, was that Six Jia Qimen you just used? Can this Divine Skill even transfer injuries?" Yuan Ming asked.
"The Six Jia Qimen recorded in the Golden Sunflower Heavenly Book is a Divine Skill of unforeseeable potential. Your previous application of it was merely scratching the surface," Xi Ying said, wiping the beads of sweat on her forehead.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming showed an interested look on his face.
Having mastered the Six Jia Qimen, he had not delved deeper into it. Unexpecting it to hold further mysteries, he decided that he should study it more when he had time.

chapters.title: Chapter 736 - 707: Reunion
chapters.content:
The dangers to Xi Qian's Divine Soul were dispelled, and the power of the Immortal Elixir immediately flowed unimpeded into her body and Divine Soul.
Xi Qian's Soul Power rapidly increased, and in just a moment, it recovered to the level of a typical Nascent Soul cultivator.
The power of the Immortal Elixir did not halt but continued to pour in, elevating her Divine Soul to a higher realm.
Xi Qian's body and Mana had also fully recovered by now, and had even improved significantly, especially her Nascent Soul, which had grown by nearly half, almost comparable to a Nascent Soul Middle Stage Cultivator.
"It seems the effects of the Immortal Elixir are better than expected. But should it continue? If this goes on, your sister's cultivation might breakthrough directly," Yuan Ming said as he turned to Xi Ying.
Advancing too rapidly in cultivation is not beneficial, as it could lead to an unstable foundation. Moreover, since Xi Qian is in a sleeping state without conscious awareness, if she really broke through to the Nascent Soul Middle Stage now, a mismanagement could lead to Mana backlash, or at worst, death on the spot.
Xi Ying slightly furrowed her brows, evidently contemplating whether to remove the remaining Immortal Elixir.
Just then, Xi Qian's body suddenly lit up with a layer of emerald light, emitting a vibrant vitality.
Under the glow of the emerald light, the depleted Mana and Divine Soul Power in Xi Ying began to quickly recover. Her pale complexion also began to improve. Nearby, Yuan Ming and the Five Elements Child were also bathed in the emerald light, beginning to regain their Mana and Divine Soul Power.
"What's happening?" Yuan Ming exclaimed in surprise.
As Yuan Ming and another person were stunned, the remaining power of the Immortal Elixir within Xi Qian quickly dissolved and integrated with her body.
Xi Ying's expression changed, and she hastily used the Six Jia Qimen Divine Ability, trying to extract the residual power of the Immortal Elixir, but it was still a step too late; the power of the elixir had already completely merged into every part of Xi Qian's body.
"I will use the Undying Tree to completely control Xi Qian's body. No matter what happens, at least it will ensure her life is not in danger," Yuan Ming said as he uttered a spell, and more roots of the Undying Tree emerged from his Dantian, piercing into various parts of Xi Qian's body.
The roots of the Undying Tree took control of every part of Xi Qian's body, ready to address any problems caused by a breakthrough in cultivation.
However, the subsequent developments were beyond Yuan Ming's expectations. After absorbing the remaining power of the Immortal Elixir, Xi Qian's cultivation did not surge explosively as anticipated; in fact, it did not increase at all.
Yuan Ming and Xi Ying exchanged glances, both feeling slightly relieved, yet neither understood why this happened.
At that moment, the nature's spiritual energy in the vicinity suddenly stirred, converging from all directions towards where Xi Qian was situated, forming a visible pale green Spiritual Energy Vortex, flooding into her body like a tide.
Yuan Ming raised an eyebrow, realizing that the incoming nature's spiritual energy was all Wood Attribute Spiritual Energy.
"What is this..." Xi Ying quickly noticed this too, her face showing a look of puzzlement.
"Have you figured out something?" Yuan Ming asked.
"This doesn't seem like a cultivation breakthrough for my sister; it's more like the signs of a Spiritual Awakening," Xi Ying pondered and said.
"Spiritual Body? Hasn't your sister already possessed a Yimu Spirit Body?" Yuan Ming asked.
"That's why I'm unsure. There's so little research on Spiritual Bodies in Yunhuang Continent. Could it be that her Yimu Spirit Body has mutated after absorbing the Immortal Elixir?" Xi Ying murmured.
"A mutation in the Spiritual Body?" Yuan Ming was startled.
The Ju Mang Spirit Technique also mentioned Spiritual Bodies. In certain specific situations, Spiritual Bodies indeed might undergo mutations.
As they observed, the influx of Wood Attribute Spiritual Energy did not cause any adverse effects on Xi Qian's body, so they did not intervene, but simply watched the changes.
As Xi Qian absorbed the Wood Attribute Spiritual Power, her body gradually underwent a transformation. Her meridians, flesh, bones, and skin slowly turned green. Even the Nascent Soul in her Dantian was no exception, turning a translucent emerald green, resembling a tiny green crystal person.
An hour later, the convergence of Wood Attribute Spiritual Energy ceased.
With a thought, Yuan Ming retracted the roots of the Undying Tree that were pierced into Xi Qian's body, while Xi Ying, who had been nervously watching Xi Qian the whole time, now showed a look full of concern in her eyes.
After a short while, Xi Qian's long eyelashes trembled twice and she slowly opened her eyes, looking around and whispering softly, "Where is this?"
"Sister, you're awake!" Xi Ying rushed over excitedly, no longer maintaining her usual composure.
"You're Ying'er!" Xi Qian's blurry eyes gradually cleared, and she sat up from the crystal coffin."
"It's me, sister. You're all right now," Xi Ying hugged Xi Qian, her eyes welling with tears.
"Ying'er, to think I could see you again, that's really wonderful." After a brief absent-minded moment, Xi Qian gently stroked Xi Ying's waterfall-like long hair, her face showing a tender smile.
Yuan Ming did not disturb them, and after speaking a word to Xi Ying through voice transmission, he quietly left the room.
"How has my body turned like this? The 'Heart of Chaos' has actually been resolved!" Xi Qian looked at her body, holding Xi Ying's hand as she flew out from the crystal coffin, her face filled with disbelief.
"I found the Undying Fruit and refined the Immortal Elixir. This elixir can bring the dead back to life. Not only did it cure your divine soul issue, but it also caused a mutation in your Spiritual Body. Please check if there's anything unusual with your body," Xi Ying said.
"Immortal Elixir! You took too great a risk this time!" Xi Qian paused for a moment, her graceful eyebrows slightly furrowed in reproach.
"Taking some risks is nothing, as long as you can recover, Sister. That's what's most important," Xi Ying said with a smile, her face revealing a touch of playfulness.
"You used to call me reckless, but I think you are even more impulsive now, luckily you are alright," Xi Qian glared at her sister, closed her eyes, and began cultivating.
Her body soon lit up with a layer of green light, which then burst forth like a tide, turning the entire room into a green sea.
Green spots appeared on the walls and quickly expanded, growing many green mosses, and green wild grass sprouted from the corners of the room.
"Does Sister's new spiritual body possess divine skills that accelerate the growth of flora?" Xi Ying said, her face showing surprise.
Just then, a series of 'crackling' sounds came, as the furniture placed in the corner of the room sprouted sturdy branches and grew fresh green leaves.
"Withered Wood Spring! No, wait, Sister, stop!" Xi Ying's pupils suddenly contracted as she seemed to realize something and quickly shouted.
The green light on Xi Qian's body reversed its flow, merging back into her body. She asked with a slightly pale face, "How is it? Did you see it clearly?"
"I saw it mostly. The green light just now contained divine soul power. If I'm not mistaken, this is a divine skill where you separate your own soul power and infuse it into wooden objects, providing them with vitality! The Yimu spiritual body doesn't have this capability, it looks like your spiritual body has really mutated," Xi Ying explained.
"Is that so? That sounds quite good; I could use this ability to help grow spiritual medicine," Xi Qian said thoughtfully, a look of happiness appearing on her face.
"No, you shouldn't. Soul power is not like mana; once consumed, it's extremely hard to recover. This new ability of your spiritual body should be used sparingly in the future!" Xi Ying quickly cautioned.
Xi Qian was a cultivation genius, surpassing anyone in the Xi Family, yet she was very carefree and almost reckless, requiring guidance throughout her life.
"That's boring then," Xi Qian muttered.
"Besides giving life to wooden objects, does your new spiritual body have any other divine skills? Like attracting nature's spiritual energy, has that rate changed too?" Xi Ying asked, casting a glance at her sister.
"It's more than doubled; my cultivation will be much faster from now on," Xi Qian raised her right hand, and the nearby wood attribute spiritual energy quickly replenished, with hints of green light emerging on her palm.
Xi Ying's face showed joy upon hearing this.
This copy was generated from content at *.
"Apart from that, my body's healing ability seems to have greatly increased too," Xi Qian lightly drew her left hand across her arm, a blood mark appearing on the skin.
Without seen cultivating, the wound emitted a flash of green light and healed rapidly.
"Self-healing divine skill! It's somewhat similar to Yuan Ming's Undying Tree ability," Xi Ying exclaimed with joy.
"Yuan Ming? Who's that? The guy who was just standing here?" Xi Qian's eyes twirled as she giggled.
"Yes, that's him," Xi Ying hesitated slightly before nodding in confirmation.
"Oh, our little Ying'er has finally grown up, starting to have someone in her heart! Such a pity I only glanced at him briefly; he seemed alright, but I wonder about his strength," Xi Qian said with a teasing smile.
"Sister, don't talk nonsense..." Xi Ying's face flushed with a hint of red.
...
