As the Xi Family sisters were reunited after a long time, chatting leisurely, Yuan Ming returned to his residence, set up a forbidden barrier, and then sat down to perform Inner Observation in his Dantian.
Casting spells had drained a lot of his mana.
However, due to the recent anomaly in Xi Qian's body, his Undying Tree Roots had merged with her body, causing his own mana to become much purer as well.
"It seems Xi Qian's newly awakened spiritual body is extraordinary. If this could happen a few more times, breaking through to the Nascent Soul Middle Stage would be much easier," Yuan Ming murmured to himself.
He then shook his head, deciding not to dwell on it further, whereas he cultivated to restore his mana and simultaneously took out the Stealing Heaven Tripod to refine it further, aiming to retrieve his divine soul from within it sooner.
Time passed swiftly, and seven days flew by.
A lot happened during this time; first, Xi Qian apparently heard about him from Xi Ying and tried to spar with him multiple times, but was always held back by Xi Ying.
Secondly, Yuan Ming learned from Xi Ying that although Tian Jizi had sent out many people, unfortunately, they couldn't even enter Chang Chun Temple, let alone investigate what Wu Yue Sect was up to.
The last thing was, among the East Sea cultivators, an increasing number were becoming lax in their prayers.
On Yuan Ming's first day in the Yunhuang Alliance, about ten percent of East Sea cultivators stopped praying.
The next day it was twenty percent, and on the third day, thirty percent...
By today, more than seventy percent of East Sea cultivators had ceased their prayers to the Nether Moon God.
A cold sneer flashed in Yuan Ming's eyes, noting the regular cessation of prayers, which he suspected was someone stealthily manipulating things, likely because those from the East Sea saw his weakened divine soul power, not fitting their image of the Nether Moon God, prompting them to act deliberately to test his response.
He had anticipated this, considering everything thus far a transaction. Now, if those from the East Sea no longer wished to worship the Nether Moon God, so be it. However, he wouldn't offer them his protection in the future if they faced troubles.

chapters.title: Chapter 737 - 708: Probing
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming steadied his spirit and took out the Black Incense. After pondering for a moment, he ultimately decided to attempt the possession on Blood Demon Ancestor.
He sat cross-legged, upright, recalling the appearance of the Blood Demon Ancestor while lighting the Black Incense and inserting it on the Stealing Heaven Tripod, and then he closed his eyes.
The incense smoke curled up, blurring Yuan Ming's vision, and his consciousness gradually became groggy, seemingly no different from usual.
But at that moment, an unforeseen change occurred; an inexplicable wave of Divine Soul Power bore down on him.
This extraordinary pressure made Yuan Ming feel as though he was submerged underwater, with invisible water pressure from all directions assaulting his consciousness. After holding on for a moment, his consciousness seemed unable to withstand such pressure and suddenly slackened, as if he had emerged from beneath the water, returning to his body.
Yuan Ming abruptly opened his eyes and rubbed his temples, easing the discomfort while his brows furrowed slightly.
He looked at the Stealing Heaven Tripod with a trace of uncertainty.
The Black Incense, which had just been lit, had inexplicably gone out. The Tai Chi Pattern on the incense burner was also dim and lusterless. Except for the Black Incense not being completely burnt out, everything else appeared much the same as after the usual end of a possession session.
This was the first time Yuan Ming had experienced a failed possession attempt.
He carefully recalled his sensations from just a moment ago, and a guess gradually formed in his mind.
Could it be that the possession failed because Blood Demon Ancestor's Divine Soul Power was much stronger than his own?
Most of the information about the Stealing Heaven Tripod was discovered through Yuan Ming's own exploration. He wasn't sure if his guess was correct and could only silently note it down.
However, given the current state of the Stealing Heaven Tripod, it definitely couldn't be used for another possession attempt right away.
Yuan Ming shook his head slightly in disappointment, stored away the Stealing Heaven Tripod, and then entered a state of cultivation, waiting for the next possession attempt seven days later.
The seven days passed in a flash, and when the Tai Chi Pattern on the Steaping Heaven Tripod lit up again, Yuan Ming had already prepared the Black Incense and began his second attempt at possession.
However, to be on the safe side, the target he chose this time was Free Venerable.
And this possession went very smoothly.
Amidst the swirling incense smoke, Yuan Ming's vision darkened and then brightened, and his consciousness arrived within the body of Free Venerable.
At that moment, Free Venerable seemed to be cultivating alone in his Cave Mansion, which saved Yuan Ming some trouble.
But no sooner had the possession succeeded, Yuan Ming immediately noticed something was amiss.
He felt that within Free Venerable's Sea of Consciousness, there seemed to be another force of Divine Soul Power.
Based on his past experience with possession, whenever Yuan Ming took control of another person's body, that person's Divine Soul would fall into a state akin to sleep, and the Divine Soul Power would gradually subside, beyond Yuan Ming's control.
But the Divine Soul Power Yuan Ming sensed now was unusually active.
He immediately turned his gaze inward on the Sea of Consciousness, trying to find the source of this Divine Soul Power, and quickly discovered a unique talisman within the already subdued Divine Soul of Free Venerable.
This talisman seemed to be made of Black Mist, floating within Free Venerable's Divine Soul and continuously emitting a cold Divine Soul Power to form a faint black protective shield on the outside of his Divine Soul. It swept through the Sea of Consciousness at regular intervals, as if searching for something.
This talisman appeared to be protecting Free Venerable's Divine Soul, and its power bore some resemblance to that of Wu Yue God's Divine Soul Power.
Yuan Ming cautiously investigated the talisman, suddenly feeling an ominous premonition.
Was this prepared by Wu Yue God especially for Free Venerable? Neither Nine Yin nor Evil Eye had received such treatment; did they have some special relationship, or could it be that...
Wu Yue God had discovered he could possess these Venerables?
Yuan Ming frowned and pondered for a moment, seeing that the talisman showed no particular reaction, and Wu Yue God had not instantaneously arrived to annihilate him, he temporarily suppressed his unease.
It was better to gather intelligence first; after all, with the Substitution Technique, even if he were discovered, it was Free Venerable who would die.
With that thought, Yuan Ming controlled Free Venerable to rise and leave the Cave Mansion, heading directly toward Chang Chun Temple's Chaotian Peak.
In no time, he arrived in front of Chaotian Peak.
Compared to when he had last come here in his own body, the Forbidden defenses here seemed to have been greatly strengthened. There were several Nascent Soul cultivators stationed around, their Divine Senses constantly sweeping the surroundings vigilantly for any possible abnormalities.
Therefore, as soon as he approached, a Green-clothed Nascent Soul Monk appeared before him.
"Lord Venerable Free, how come you are here?" the green-clothed monk looked at the "Lord Venerable Free" before him, a hint of puzzlement flashing in his eyes—as if he thought Lord Venerable Free should not be coming here at this time.
Of course, given Lord Venerable Free's transcendental status within the Wu Yue Sect, he naturally did not dare to ask too much.
"Are Venerable Tian Gui and Venerable Xian Kong present?" Yuan Ming spoke indifferently.
"Following the commands of Wu Yue God, both Venerables have other matters to attend to and are not stationed here," the green-clothed monk answered, but the confusion in his eyes deepened.
"Have they sent anyone here?" Yuan Ming continued to inquire.
"Venerable Xian Kong has not, but Venerable Tian Gui did send people here twice, though they only escorted some supplies and spiritual stones and did not stay for long," the green-clothed monk recalled briefly.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming nodded slightly. His hand hidden in his sleeve silently formed a gesture, his mana ready but not released, preparing to strike at any moment.
"Is there any new clue about Yuan Ming now?" Yuan Ming asked, his gaze fastened tightly on the face of the green-clothed monk, observing his reaction.
According to Yuan Ming's original plan, he intended to directly ask his subordinates, or people like Ni Mu, for information while impersonating Lord Venerable Free.
But the talisman in his Sea of Consciousness gave Yuan Ming a bad premonition.
If Wu Yue God had guessed that Yuan Ming possessed the ability of possession, then if Yuan Ming inquired carelessly, exposing an ignorance unbecoming of the possessor's identity, he might not only fail to obtain the desired information but could also alert Wu Yue God and provoke his intervention.
Whether he lived or died was secondary; the real trouble would be causing Wu Yue God to become more vigilant and strengthen his precautions again.
Therefore, Yuan Ming decided to change his approach—first to ascertain whether Wu Yue God knew of his ability to possess others, and then to use that as a pretext to achieve his goal.
"Yuan Ming? You mean... the matter of possession?" Upon hearing "Lord Venerable Free's" words, the green-clothed monk's expression immediately turned solemn.
Please read this chapter on its original platform—*.
Upon observing this, Yuan Ming's heart tightened, silently cursing that it was indeed the case, and then he raised his hand to set up a Soundproofing Technique, preventing the conversation from reaching anyone else.
"Not long ago, I had some interaction with Tian Gui, and he seemed somewhat different from usual, even asking me some questions he should have known the answers to. Therefore, I suspect that he might have been possessed," Yuan Ming pretended to say with a heavy tone.
"How is that possible? Didn't Wu Yue God embed a Divine Talisman in each of us? If an enemy attempted to possess Venerable Tian Gui and triggered the talisman, Wu Yue God would not have had no reaction!" the green-clothed monk's face changed.
"That's why I said it's possible, and I also haven't reported to Wu Yue God. I wanted to figure it out on my own first," Yuan Ming said earnestly.
The green-clothed monk pursed his lips tightly, subconsciously glanced around, and asked in a low voice:
"So, the reason you're telling me this is...?"
"The items at the top of the peak are of vital importance to our Wu Yue Sect. If Tian Gui has been possessed, he'd surely seek to cause some havoc. It might be okay to trust the people he sent, but those supplies might be problematic, so I want to go in and check them myself. If nothing is found, all will be well, but if something is discovered, it will serve both as evidence and as a means of nipping a potential danger in the bud," Yuan Ming said with a serious tone.
The green-clothed monk's expression changed several times, and after much hesitation, he finally made up his mind.
"All right, I'll take you in to have a look. However, as per the rules, I must follow you at all times, and I ask Lord Venerable not to take offense," he said.
"That's only proper. Oh, and before this matter is clarified, don't discuss it with too many people to avoid causing discord in case it turns out to be a misunderstanding on my part," Yuan Ming added with a smile.
The green-clothed monk nodded and asked the "Lord Venerable Free" to wait a moment before disappearing from the spot. Yuan Ming feigned ease as he let him go, but in reality, he was on high alert, wary of any potential attack.
Fortunately, the green-clothed monk reappeared before him soon after, with no one accompanying him.
"Please follow me," the green-clothed monk said, then turned to lead Yuan Ming up to Chaotian Peak.
The two proceeded in silence, passing through the dense Magic Cloud Forest. Compared to the last time, there were even more Magic Cloud Trees along the way, and the Magic Cloud hanging over the peak had become even thicker, almost suffocating.
Before long, the two reached the summit of Chaotian Peak, and the giant Formation in the center of the plaza continued to operate as it had before.
Last time, because of the disturbance from the Sky-reaching Demon Pillar, Yuan Ming had not scrutinized the entire Formation in detail. Now, returning to this place, he fixed his eyes on the Formation, memorizing every pattern and detail carefully, not overlooking anything.
This time, he also noticed that the Formation was, in fact, incomplete, as if many areas were only hastily constructed with a basic framework and were not yet fully built.
"Lord Venerable, the last time Venerable Tian Gui's subordinates came to replenish the spirit stones, they only had brief contact with the peripheral Stone Pillars. You are free to investigate, but please do not touch anything. Otherwise, I will not be able to explain it to Wu Yue God," the green-clothed monk spoke softly.
Yuan Ming nodded, his Divine Sense sweeping over each of the Stone Pillars in the plaza, discovering that every pillar was topped with a top-grade spiritual stone, continuously providing Spiritual Power to the pillars.
The Formation at the top of the peak was exceptionally complex, appearing to be a combination of multiple different Arrays. However, these black Stone Pillars, as the most fundamental part of the Formation, could be considered the source of its operation. If they were damaged, the Formation's function would be severely affected, and in worse cases, it could even collapse completely.
Yuan Ming quickly realized this and, with a flickering glance, a certain idea formed in his mind.

chapters.title: Chapter 738 - 709: Miscalculation
chapters.content:
"Wait a moment, something seems off with that black pillar," Yuan Ming suddenly raised his hand, pointing toward a distant stone pillar.
Upon hearing this, the Green-clothed Monk instinctively looked up.
Just as his attention shifted, Yuan Ming made his move, flipping his right palm to summon the Lifebound Magical Treasure of the Free Venerable—a branch—and channeling all his Mana into it, before hurling it toward the stone pillar closest to him.
The magical treasure of the Free Venerable, like the Soul Destroying Sword, required the simultaneous expenditure of Mana and Soul Power to unleash its greatest strength, but at this moment, Yuan Ming could not mobilize the Soul Power of the Free Venerable.
Moreover, with the stone pillar's inexplicably durable material, Yuan Ming wasn't sure if he could destroy it in such a short time, so he directly resorted to the last tactic most cultivators would use.
Self-destructing a Lifebound Magical Treasure of a peak Soul Cultivator should definitely be sufficient.
The Green-clothed Monk realized something was amiss but, due to his momentary distraction, he had also missed the best chance to stop Yuan Ming.
"Free Venerable, why would you..." he exclaimed with wide eyes, unable to believe what he was seeing.
Yuan Ming did not answer, and simply manipulated the spell, detonating the magical treasure.
In an instant, a blinding spirit light appeared on the branch magical treasure, and the runes hidden within burst one after another into Spiritual Power, unchecked by any constraints.
Then, with a loud "bang," the branch magical treasure exploded completely, sending a massive plume of smoke skyward and a wave-like shockwave hurtling around, knocking the Green-clothed Monk airborne, his body splattering with blood.
The Free Venerable, possessed by Yuan Ming, also "splat," sprayed a cloud of Blood Mist from its body and staggered backward several steps.
But just as the shockwave was about to hit the stone pillar, a vast amount of gray mist surged out of the pillar, rapidly enveloping the explosion's smoke and shockwave like closing flower petals, and quickly shrank to form a thumb-sized gray orb, floating between the undamaged stone pillars.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming was stunned.
Before he could react, the gray orb between the stone pillars suddenly vanished, and he felt a pain in his brow; reaching up, he discovered a small hole, the size of a thumb, leaking blood on his forehead.
"This is..."
Before he could finish speaking, the Free Venerable's body exploded instantaneously, as if the power of the treasure's self-destruction had rebounded onto him. It rapidly disintegrated his Physical Body into a mass of flesh, and his Sea of Consciousness was affected, tearing his Divine Soul apart and vanishing into the dust.
Simultaneously, at the summit of Chaotian Peak, Wu Yue God and Blood Demon Ancestor appeared instantly, looking around somberly.
"What happened? Someone tried to disrupt the Great Array!" Blood Demon Ancestor asked, his Divine Sense quickly sweeping over the Great Array; seeing that it was undamaged, he finally sighed in relief.
"I had set up the Reverse Yin Yang Restriction on the formation. The attacker is already dead," Wu Yue God quickly noticed the flesh and the blood-stained Green-clothed Monk beside the formation and shifted his gaze.
"Wu Yue God, I..." the Green-clothed Monk trembled, hastily trying to explain.
But Wu Yue God raised a hand, and the Green-clothed Monk's Nascent Soul was instantly enveloped by a dark light and yanked out of the body, falling into the palm of Wu Yue God.
Ignoring the pleas of the Green-clothed Monk, Wu Yue God searched through the memories inside the Nascent Soul. After finding the information he needed, he wrapped the Nascent Soul in Soul Power and absorbed it into his body, now unconscious.
"Who infiltrated this time? Did that Yuan Ming send someone again?" Blood Demon Ancestor immediately asked.
"No, there's a traitor from within our sect." A faint flicker of doubt crossed Wu Yue God's eyes.
"Hmph, at this critical moment, to have such an issue arise, your control over your subordinates is too weak. I need not stress the importance of the Demon Array. If something like this happens again, don't blame me for not showing you any respect," Blood Demon Ancestor snorted coldly.
"I will personally oversee the Demon Array from now on. You can be at ease now, right?" Wu Yue God said placidly.
"That's good," Blood Demon Ancestor nodded and, with a flicker, vanished from the spot.
Watching him leave, Wu Yue God's expression turned contemplative. After a moment, he suddenly looked up, spotting Ni Mu and Xi Zheng, who had come to the base of Chaotian Peak following the commotion.
"Both of you, come up here," he telepathically communicated.
Soon, Ni Mu and Xi Zheng passed through the demon clouds and arrived at the summit, bowing respectfully to Wu Yue God.
"Xi Zheng, use your Heavenly Destiny Skill. The Soul Talisman in the Free Divine Soul was not activated—what seems to be the problem?" Without waiting for Ni Mu and Xi Zheng to ask questions, Wu Yue God ordered.
Both Ni Mu and Xi Zheng were startled by the command, and Xi Zheng immediately commenced the Heavenly Destiny Skill.
Just then, Xi Zheng suddenly grunted, his aura instantly weakening, with traces of blood leaking from orifices.
Seeing this, Wu Yue God waved his hand, and a black jade flew in front of Xi Zheng. He quickly grasped the jade, refining and assimilating the stored Pure Will Power, which significantly improved his pale complexion.
"Did you find anything?" Wu Yue God asked.
"'Void Spirit Fake Soul, not oneself but possessed,' that's all I could deduce," Xi Zheng replied.
Wu Yue God's gaze sharpened as he quietly repeated the phrase Xi Zheng had spoken, seemingly realizing something.
Having resisted the Evil Curse Kill and escaped the Soul Talisman possession freely, his cultivation was still not at the Spoken Witch level...
Could it be that item was in his possession?
Wuyue God pondered this, waved her hand, and had Ni Mu and Xi Zheng leave. She then guarded the Demon Array alone, motionless for a long time.
...
In another place, the moment the Free Venerable died, Yuan Ming's consciousness returned to his body, and he was immediately overwhelmed by infinite pain.
Just like before, his Divine Soul nearly shattered, suffering the exact same damage as the Free Venerable.
Under the torment of pain, Yuan Ming gritted his teeth, one hand clutching his head, while his other hand hastily summoned the Night Parade of Hundred Demons.
The figure of the Heavenly Ghost Wanderer appeared again, placing a hand on Yuan Ming and once again performing the Substitution Divine Ability on him.
Everything seemed exactly the same as the last time, but when the Divine Soul Transformation of the Heavenly Ghost Wanderer burst open, Yuan Ming's Divine Soul had just stabilized when a mysterious sense of decay surged, quickly sweeping through his body.
This decay was not of the flesh or wilting of the divine soul, but a fatigue and dullness similar to one's life span being exhausted.
Yuan Ming suddenly realized that his thinking seemed much slower, his body's circulation of Spiritual Power was also five parts slower than usual, and a faint drowsiness lingered ceaselessly, as if he might fall into a deep sleep at any moment.
Yuan Ming struggled to pry his eyelids open, calling upon his Desire Power to attempt to repair his Divine Soul and thus mitigate the sense of decay.
This is a sample from *. Read the rest on *.
But the more he did so, the more he felt lack of energy, as if he was an old man at death's door, unable to change the outcome of his life coming to an end, no matter what methods he used.
He even tried having the Heavenly Ghost Wanderer perform the Substitution again, but it had no effect.
Could this be the price of possession at the moment of death? Not only would he suffer the same damage as the possessed, but would his Divine Soul's origin also be damaged?
As the saying goes, it takes more than one cold day for the river to freeze three feet deep.
At this moment, Yuan Ming realized that perhaps during those previous possessions when the host was injured, his Divine Soul's origin had already been damaged, and he had not noticed at all, just as this time, he was unaware of where exactly his Divine Soul was being affected.
"It seems I miscalculated."
Yuan Ming shook his somewhat dizzy head and coughed twice before sending a message to Xi Ying, asking her to come to him.
Soon, Xi Ying hurried into the room.
"How did you end up like this? Wait here, I'll go find someone right away!" Xi Ying, seeing Yuan Ming in a state as if he were at death's door, quickly got up to leave.
"No need, you... oh." Yuan Ming stretched out his hand trying to stop her, but he couldn't muster the strength.
However, Xi Ying did not leave for long and soon rushed back with Xi Qian.
"Sister, quickly take a look at Yuan Ming," Xi Ying said anxiously.
Upon seeing Yuan Ming's weakened state, Xi Qian was also shocked. After a brief inspection with her Divine Sense, she pondered for a moment, then pinched a spell with her left hand while placing her right hand over Yuan Ming's head,
"Don't resist," Xi Qian said.
Yuan Ming was about to nod when he immediately felt a warm current flowing from her palm into his body, circulating through his meridians before quickly withdrawing.
Xi Qian quickly retracted her hand, opened it in front of her, and a small clump of green spirit light appeared in her palm.
As she continued to pinch the spell and recite incantations, this small clump of spirit light grew like a seed sprouting roots and rapidly blossomed into an enchanting little spirit light flower in the palm of Xi Qian's hand.
"Open your mouth," Xi Qian said, and carefully plucked the spiritual flower to bring it to Yuan Ming's lips.
Yuan Ming immediately complied, and then he felt a drop of sweet flower dew drip from the spiritual flower into his mouth.
The moment the flower dew touched his tongue, Yuan Ming's body immediately warmed up, every muscle throughout his body seeming to cheer and nourish itself in excitement. The fatigue slightly receded, and Yuan Ming regained some vitality.
If Yuan Ming had seemed like a frail elderly mortal aged ninety or so just a moment ago, he now at least seemed to have returned to the vitality of a sixty-year-old, not quite robust, but not yet one foot in the grave either.
Although not fully recovered, Yuan Ming was already overjoyed by the effectiveness of Xi Qian's treatment.
"This secret technique is truly miraculous. Where did you learn it? Could you allow me also to study it?" Yuan Ming asked excitedly.
"I'm afraid that might be difficult. It's not that I am stingy with my techniques, but this Seeking Green Transformation Skill is really just an ordinary Wood Attribute healing technique. However, after waking up, my physique seems to have changed a bit. Not only has my Wood Attribute Divine Skills greatly improved, but when I implement some of the secret techniques I mastered in the past, they seem also to have different effects now, like this technique which was originally only for healing the physical body but now appears to also be effective for Divine Souls and Nascent Souls," Xi Qian said with some difficulty.
"I see. It seems, Fellow Daoist Xi Qian, you have also turned misfortune into a blessing," Yuan Ming smiled.
"Let's not talk too much for now. Since the divine technique works, sister, you should quickly treat Yuan Ming a few more times to completely remove the root of the ailment, to prevent any residual effects," Xi Ying urged worriedly.

chapters.title: Chapter 739 - 710: Attempt
chapters.content:
"There's no hurry on this. I'm much better now, and since Fellow Daoist Xi Qian has just awakened, I worry about overtaxing her. Let her recover some mana before she attempts any healing. Before that, Xi Ying, take a look at this." Yuan Ming shook his head as he took out a blank jade scroll, inscribed something with his divine thought, and handed it over to Xi Ying.
"This is..." Xi Ying received the jade scroll, and after looking over the contents, he quickly furrowed his brows.
"This is the precise layout of the demon array set up by the Wu Yue Sect at Chaotian Peak. Can you deduce the exact purpose of this demon array?" Yuan Ming asked.
"The arrangement of this formation uses ancient techniques, and there are some parts I'll need to check some classics to fully understand, but from what I can see, there's an eighty percent chance this is a spatial array." Xi Ying held the jade scroll and studied it intently for a while before handing it back.
"How can you tell?" Yuan Ming inquired.
"Look here, and here; the structure in these areas is similar to ancient transmission arrays I've studied before, and the runes used are also similar." Xi Ying pointed out the resembling aspects.
"I see. It seems Qi Ye was right, the goals of the Wu Yue God and the Blood Demon Ancestor are to open a spatial passage to let the Demon Clan enter the Yunhuang Continent. This matter must be promptly reported to Tian Jizi, organize personnel to counterattack Chang Chun Temple, and we absolutely must not allow the great array to be completed successfully." Yuan Ming nodded and said right away.
...
Cloud Desolation Alliance, Chang Chun Temple Headquarters.
"Is what Fellow Daoist Yuan said true?" Tian Jizi suddenly rose, his expression one of shock.
"This is the array map I recorded. If Fellow Daoist Tian Jizi does not believe it, you may invite someone else to calculate and verify it." Yuan Ming spoke as he pushed the jade scroll forward.
Tian Jizi took the jade scroll and read it carefully; his expression grew increasingly grave.
"This indeed looks like the construction of a spatial array, but to think that the Demon Clan, said only to exist in the writings of classics, truly exists!" Tian Jizi muttered to himself.
"Yunhuang is merely a corner of the world, and nobody knows what lies beyond the seas. Not to mention the Demon Clan, the existence of any other species wouldn't come as a surprise either." Yuan Ming sighed lightly, thus speaking.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan's point is well taken. This intelligence is crucial for our alliance. I am grateful on behalf of the myriad citizens of Yunhuang. We had already started planning a counteroffensive, but now it seems we must hasten our efforts to ensure the array is never completed," Tian Jizi said as he rose and bowed.
Yuan Ming graciously accepted the bow, about to rise and leave when Tian Jizi stopped him.
"Hold a moment, Fellow Daoist. There is something else for which I'd like to ask your assistance," Tian Jizi hastily said.
"Is it about confronting the Wu Yue God?" Yuan Ming quickly grasped the matter Tian Jizi was alluding to.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan is perceptive. Without the protection of the great array, even with the aid of the Canghai Xuan Water Pearl, I'm no match for the Wu Yue God. Senior Jin Chao from the East Sea is also hard to locate, and considering all of Yunhuang, perhaps only Fellow Daoist Yuan might stand a chance," Tian Jizi earnestly said.
Unlike others in the Cloud Desolation Alliance, for Tian Jizi, whether Yuan Ming was the Nether Moon God or not wasn't important; what truly mattered was if he had the strength to confront the Wu Yue God.
Even though Chang Chun Temple had past grievances with Yuan Ming, Tian Jizi saw these issues as reconcilable, especially because the Imperial Family had always maintained good relations with Yuan Ming. There was still a base of mutual respect and gratitude.
Moreover, with the current situation, preserving Yunhuang was a priority; anything else could be deferred.
"I fear I must disappoint you, Fellow Daoist. To obtain this intelligence, I have sustained serious injuries and need to recuperate for a while; I am truly not a match for the Wu Yue God at this moment," Yuan Ming said with a troubled expression.
"Then may I ask when Fellow Daoist Yuan might recover? If there is anything you need for your treatment, please speak freely, and our alliance will definitely find a way to assist," Tian Jizi quickly seized upon Yuan Ming's key point.
"You misunderstand, Fellow Daoist Tian Jizi. I am not haggling over terms. As for the healing of my injuries, even I have no clues presently. I can only seek solutions through seclusion," Yuan Ming explained.
Seeing that Yuan Ming's expression did not seem deceitful, Tian Jizi could only sigh deeply and speak no further.
Yuan Ming's words were not an excuse; after bidding farewell to Tian Jizi, he immediately returned to his residence to begin seclusion, operating the Moonlight Technique to try and eliminate the fatigue and weakness emanating from his Nascent Soul.
But several days passed, and his condition had not improved in the slightest.
During this period, Xi Qian visited several times, applying the Seeking Green Transformation Skill again, but compared to the first application, its effectiveness diminished with each attempt and eventually ceased altogether.
Having no other choice, Yuan Ming continued his seclusion, searching for a solution to his problems.
Meanwhile, the Cloud Desolation Alliance swiftly mobilized, widely broadcasting the news that the Wu Yue God intended to summon the Demon Clan to descend upon Yunhuang.
To emphasize the severity, Tian Jizi also specifically disclosed all secrets regarding the Demon Clan held within Chang Chun Temple to the public, informing them that if the Demon Clan invaded, they would completely transform Yunhuang by changing Spiritual Energy into Demonic Qi, forever severing the Human Clan's possibility of cultivation.
As the message spread, there were skeptics and those shocked, but no one dared to ignore the intelligence provided by Tian Jizi. Even hidden sects and loose cultivators, who had previously declined to join the fight for various reasons, began arriving at the headquarters of the Cloud Desolation Alliance, each harboring various thoughts and inquiries.
...
Southern Border, Black Scale Mountain.
Like every day, the loose cultivator Nascent Soul Daoist Yu He, carrying a wine jug, came to visit his good friend Hei Linzi.
But when he knocked on the grand doors of his friend's cave mansion, he found his typically sect-averse friend packing his belongings.
"Are you going on a long journey?" Daoist Yu He asked in surprise.
"I'm preparing to go to the Cloud Ridge Mountain Range," Hei Linzi replied without looking up.
""Don't tell me you're thinking about joining the Cloud Desolation Alliance. How strange, I heard their leader is from the Chang Chun Temple. Weren't you injured by their people years ago? How come you now think of joining them to confront the Wu Yue Sect?" Immortal Yu He asked curiously.
"See for yourself." Hei Linzi threw a jade scroll at him.
Immortal Yu He caught it and read it through; astonishment deepened on his face.
"The Demon Clan? There really are other races in this world?" he asked, putting down the jade scroll.
"True or false, we'll know when we see. It's better than staying here, blind even though our eyes are open," Hei Linzi said offhandedly.
Seeing that he was determined to leave, Immortal Yu He burst into laughter.
"Who would have thought, Hei Linzi, normally so wicked, would also have a day where he wishes to sacrifice himself for greater good," he laughed.
"Hmph, cut the nonsense. I just don't want to end up unable to quietly cultivate one day! Enough talk, in a word, are you coming or not?" Hei Linzi snorted.
"If you're going, how could I stay behind?" Immortal Yu He laughed loudly.
...
East Sea, Xufeng Island.
Zhang Zhifeng slipped cautiously outside the island, seeing that no one was around. Just as he was about to set up his magic artifact, a sudden shout startled him.
"Traitor, where do you think you're going?"
"Master, I, I just wanted to go to the workshop to buy some things..." Zhang Zhifeng turned around, smiling awkwardly.
Behind him, an old man with white hair was glaring at him furiously.
"You think I don't know? You want to go to the Central Plains to confront the Wu Yue Sect!" the white-haired elder barked.
Now that his intentions were exposed, Zhang Zhifeng stopped pretending.
* (*) hosts the original.
"Yes, I'm going to the Central Plains. During the battle in the East Sea, Master, you stopped me, saying the island was shielded by a Concealment Great Array and that I shouldn't worry about anything. But now the Wu Yue God wants to bring the Demon Clan here, and the whole Yunhuang is resisting. How can I stay here like a frightened turtle!" Zhang Zhifeng said angrily.
"Ha, what do you know, kid? In such chaos, many people wish they could be that frightened turtle but aren't able to. Besides, you're my only disciple. If you run off, what will happen to the passing down of my teachings?" the white-haired elder said unmoved.
"Passing down teachings, you old fart. If Yunhuang is defeated, you might as well wait to pass your teachings to the Demon Clan!" Zhang Zhifeng muttered angrily, turning around and setting up his magic artifact directly.
However, the white-haired elder lifted his hand and waved, pulling Zhang Zhifeng back along with his magic artifact.
"Nonsense! With your Foundation Establishment Cultivation, even if you go, what use could you be? A mere glare from the Wu Yue God would kill you. You'd better stay obediently on the island," he said.
"If you can, keep guarding me day and night, because I'll always find a chance to escape!" Zhang Zhifeng said unwillingly.
The white-haired elder remained indifferent and flicked his finger, sending a breeze to wrap around Zhang Zhifeng and send him back to the island.
Afterward, the island's formation activated on its own, leaving only the lonely figure of the white-haired elder on the sea surface.
"These days, it's not peaceful even trying to properly teach a disciple. Oh well, oh well, I guess it's time for this old bone to move around a bit, to leave a somewhat peaceful Yunhuang for that foolish boy," the white-haired elder sighed helplessly, his figure soon disappearing over the ocean.
He was confident in the formation he had laid down, after all, it was set with the strength of Nascent Soul Cultivation. Unless Zhang Zhifeng suddenly gained insight, there was no way he could break out of the formation.
However, not long after he left, Xufeng Island resurfaced on the sea. The island's great array had a small breach, though it healed quickly. But Zhang Zhifeng had already taken the opportunity to escape.
"Hehe, Little Qing, I owe you one this time." Zhang Zhifeng looked around, seeing that his master hadn't appeared, and immediately expressed his joy.
From his collar, a palm-sized little blue-scaled snake slithered out, proudly flicking its tongue at Zhang Zhifeng before leaping into the sea, transforming into a sleek blue Jiao, carrying Zhang Zhifeng towards the Central Plains, cutting through the waves.
...
Meanwhile, similar events were unfolding across Yunhuang.
With the addition of these Hidden Sects and Loose Cultivators, the combat power that the Cloud Desolation Alliance lacked in recent great battles was gradually being replenished, and the morale, once low, soared once again.
The Cloud Desolation Alliance seemed to have regained the strength to compete with the Wu Yue Sect. However, Tian Jizi, the Alliance Hierarch, knew that without the Returning to Void combat power, the Cloud Desolation Alliance, no matter how strong, would never truly defeat the Wu Yue Sect.
Therefore, he continued to desperately search for the whereabouts of Senior Jin Chao while occasionally inquiring about Yuan Ming's movements, hoping that this "Nether Moon God" would regain divine power to help him counter the Wu Yue God.

chapters.title: Chapter 740 - 711: Return to Position
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming's Cave Mansion.
Xi Ying looked at Yuan Ming who was fully immersed in cultivating to heal his injuries, worry written all over her face. She opened her mouth several times, wanting to ask about his condition, but feared disturbing him; so she could only swallow her words silently.
Not far away, Xi Qian's gaze shifted between her sister and Yuan Ming a few times before she gently shook her head.
Sometime later, Yuan Ming ended his cultivation, his face showing evident fatigue.
"It's no use, there's hardly any effect." Facing Xi Ying, who hesitated to speak, Yuan Ming shook his head.
During this time, Xi Ying had negotiated with Tian Jizi under the pretext of preparing for battle, forcefully gathering a plethora of potentially effective healing techniques from various sects that had joined the Cloud Desolation Alliance. She handed them all to Yuan Ming to try, but the results were obvious; they had not helped with Yuan Ming's condition at all.
"Your 'illness'... the problem isn't the Nascent Soul, but the part of the Divine Soul compatible with the Nascent Soul. To truly heal, we might have to start with your main soul." After several attempts at treatment, Xi Qian had roughly figured out the root of Yuan Ming's ailment.
"Currently, I still have many forbiddances unresolved, and releasing the main soul would require more time than I have," Yuan Ming sighed.
Upon hearing this, Xi Ying hesitated for a while, then suddenly made up her mind and said,
"I remember you telling me that comprehending formations could help you unlock the forbiddances. Why don't you possess my body so that I can carry you to comprehend arrays, enhance my Array Formation Cultivation, speed up refining the forbiddances, and release the main soul early, which might treat your 'illness'?"
"This... isn't that a bad idea? Haven't you always disliked when I possess your body?" Yuan Ming was slightly taken aback and shook his head.
"What time is it now to still care about these? Besides, I... I don't mind anymore, what are you still worried about!" Xi Ying flushed with embarrassment and annoyance.
Seeing this, Xi Qian smiled understandingly, sparing her sister some embarrassment, and found an excuse to leave the room immediately.
But after her departure, the atmosphere in the room grew even more awkward.
"Come on, come." Somehow, Xi Ying's voice trembled, her demeanor one of brave sacrifice.
Yuan Ming also couldn't help but laugh, then took out an ordinary piece of Black Incense and lit it.
This was the same Black Incense he initially used when he possessed Immortal Xuanhua. Later, he optimized the duration of the possession, which allowed for comprehension but not control over the possessed person, rendering it not very useful.
Using it this time was also a sign of respect towards Xi Ying.
Amidst the swirling incense smoke, Yuan Ming's consciousness quickly possessed Xi Ying, and she immediately took out the Array Formation Manual and began her comprehension.
...
As Yuan Ming prepared to possess Xi Ying to comprehend formations, a command from Yuan Ming also reached Xu Che and the sisters of the Yan Family, instructing them and other Nether Moon Sect believers to cease all other affairs and stay at their residence to pray intensely during this period.
With urgency pressing, relying solely on one method to release the main soul was not safe.
Yuan Ming had speculated before that filling the Stealing Heaven Tripod might cause some changes. Now, in a last-ditch effort, he decided to also try this path and see if it could benefit the current situation.
Yuan Ming's command quickly spread out, from the Central Plains to the Northern Desert, the Southern Border, and even reaching as far as the East Sea.
In passing towns and villages, not only cultivators but mortal believers also received this decree through their respective channels.
However, the higher the cultivation of the cultivator, the smaller the proportion of those who accepted and followed the command; on the other hand, many mortal believers who had received aid and responses from the Nether Moon God remained devout, responding en masse and beginning to pray.
Meanwhile, believers and cultivators on Red Ganoderma Island, Thousand Dragon Island, Red Leaf Island, Wanhua Island, and Yuzhu Island also responded actively, joining the ranks of those praying.
As for other islands in the East Sea, although they had heard of this, apart from a small group of cultivators who still deeply believed in the Nether Moon God, most cultivators ignored it.
Even so, after many years of accumulation and management, the concentrated prayers of the fairly significant Nether Moon Sect believers formed a sizeable amount of Desire Power, which was now continuously converging on Yuan Ming's location.
Time flew, and half a month passed quickly.
At Yuan Ming's residence, after this period of possession and comprehension, his mastery in formation techniques surged dramatically. He had refined over twenty forbiddances of the Stealing Heaven Tripod, his sensitivity of the Divine Soul sharpened, and the connection with the Stealing Heaven Tripod gradually deepened.
Meanwhile, under countless believers' prayers, the Desire Power within the White Jade Lotus Platform accumulated continuously and was finally filled.
But at that moment, an abrupt change occurred.
The entire space within the Stealing Heaven Tripod suddenly trembled violently, and the Desire Power within the White Jade Lotus Platform, as if propelled by some force, started to churn vigorously.
A vortex of condensed Desire Power began to operate on its own, drawing all the Desire Power towards the center.
At that instant, the white flames that had been burning fiercely in the void above the space also seemed to be drawn by this power, slowly descending towards the vortex and merging with it.
In the blink of an eye, a white flame vortex formed, continuously burning and refining the incoming Desire Power, seemingly purging all impurities and stray thoughts, turning them into ash.
Sensing the changes inside, Yuan Ming's heart swelled with joy.
He seized the opportunity when the white flames above descended completely unimpeded. His main soul and the first split soul immediately flew upwards toward the upper region, leaving only the second split soul staying behind in the space of the White Jade Lotus Platform.
As his main soul ascended continuously, it felt as if it passed through an invisible barrier. His vision suddenly blurred, and he entered the space within the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
After many days, Yuan Ming finally returned to the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space, barely able to contain his excitement.
He hurriedly controlled his Divine Soul to inspect the space and found that the situation inside had not changed much from before, except for a problem with the gold Array Map on the altar.
Compared to before, the light from the gold Array Map was now dim, seemingly lacking the power to continue operating.
As Yuan Ming's Divine Soul approached the altar, he peered inside and discovered that several Crystal Stones embedded in the center of the Array Map had depleted their Spiritual Power and turned grayish white.
The remaining Crystal Stones were also dim, clearly also significantly worn out.
Now that the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space was sealed, even if Yuan Ming wanted to replace the Crystal Stones and repair the Array Map, it was utterly impossible.
With a thought, he attempted to summon his Divine Soul to leave the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space, but after trying, his Divine Soul was still firmly bound and unable to leave this not yet fully unsealed space.
"As expected, it's still not working," Yuan Ming sighed inwardly.
At that moment, he suddenly remembered what Qi Ye had previously mentioned to him, that the Sky-reaching Demon Pillar was a treasure of the Demon World with the ability to open up spaces, and immediately a thought of trying this surfaced in his mind.
Yuan Ming immediately raised his hand and summoned it, and a thick, mysterious black Stone Pillar encompassed with Demon Patterns appeared beside him.
He placed one hand on the Stone Pillar and simultaneously cultivated his Half-demon Body, channeling the Demonic Qi inside his body into the Stone Pillar.
In just an instant, the runes on the Sky-reaching Demon Pillar lit up one after another, and then the light spread, causing all the Demon Patterns to light up as well.
A unique force extended out from it, following Yuan Ming's body into the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
Yuan Ming immediately closed his eyes, his Divine Thought sinking into the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space.

At that moment, he instantly felt a force not his own, attempting to open the spatial barriers within the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
Yuan Ming focused his mind and fully stimulated his Mana, guiding that Space Power into the spatial barriers.
The spatial barriers around the Stealing Heaven Tripod were like thick ice, and the Mana mingled with that Space Power was like coarse salt scattered on the ice, slowly melting it away, but at a very slow pace.
However, Yuan Ming was patient enough, fully focused on pushing this force, gradually wearing down the layer of spatial barriers.
Time slowly passed, and a continuously deepening crack gradually appeared in that layer of spatial barrier.
Two hours later, a trace of Space Power finally penetrated the spatial barrier, creating a tiny slit in it.
Without any hesitation, Yuan Ming's main soul and first split soul immediately passed through that slit, flying out of the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space, like children returning home after many days.
The two soul shadows successively entered Yuan Ming's forehead, the main soul promptly flying into the Nascent Soul to integrate with it.
The first split soul then sat cross-legged in the Sea of Consciousness, continuously absorbing Divine Soul Power to solidify itself.
The moment the Divine Soul returned to its place, Yuan Ming's eyes abruptly opened, a tangible divine light flashing through them, and his spirit dramatically revitalized.
After many days, his Divine Soul had finally recovered.
With a slight sensing, Yuan Ming immediately realized his Soul Power had become incredibly pure, the previously sloppy condition due to absorbing too much Desire Power no longer existing, and the hidden dangers in his Divine Soul were completely eliminated.
However, the weakened state of the Divine Soul within the Nascent Soul was not resolved.
After hesitating briefly, Yuan Ming had an idea, and with a thought, the first split soul sitting in the Space of Sea of Consciousness immediately stood up, leapt, and rushed into the Nascent Soul.
With the integration of the first split soul, the Divine Soul Power inside the Nascent Soul surged tremendously.
When Yuan Ming tried again, the Divine Soul Power operated smoothly, and he could channel Mana without any obstruction, instantly dispelling the last bit of his worries.
In the evening, he left the secret chamber and met Xi Ying.
"Congratulations, it looks like this retreat has brought you considerable gains," Xi Ying immediately noticed his changes and cheerfully said.
"Xi Ying, I've found a way to purify the Divine Soul, perhaps this time I can also help you," Yuan Ming said excitedly, ignoring these compliments.
Xi Ying's Soul Power was much purer compared to Yuan Ming's former condition, but she had previously become very difficult to advance further on the path of a Soul Cultivator due to her reckless attempt at breaking through.
Refining the impurities within the Divine Soul to achieve utmost purity might just be one of the methods.
"What method? Please, tell me in detail," Xi Ying also became interested upon hearing this.
Yuan Ming immediately shared the conditions of his recent retreat with Xi Ying.
After listening, a look of surprise flashed across Xi Ying's eyes. After pondering for a long time, she also felt that this method was feasible.
"We should not delay; let us try it right away," she said resolutely.
The two immediately returned to the secret chamber to prepare for a joint retreat.

chapters.title: Chapter 741 - 712: Word Witch Realm
chapters.content:
In the secret room.
Yuan Ming spent nearly four hours reactivating the Sky-reaching Demon Pillar, opening up the space within the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
Xi Ying's Divine Soul immediately flew out of her body, passed through the crack, and entered the Stealing Heaven Tripod, but she did not stop there. Instead, she sank further down, directly into the White Jade Lotus Platform.
As soon as Xi Ying entered, she caught sight of the vortex at the bottom, formed by the mingling of flames and Desire Power, and felt the surge of waves coming from within it, which surprised her momentarily.
It seemed to contain an immense amount of Divine Soul Power, yet it was different from the usual Divine Soul Power.
If one were to discern carefully, it was more like the combined pure force of all living souls.
It was just a thought that crossed Xi Ying's mind, and she understood that this was the All Living Beings' Will Power collected from all believers, refined and purified, a power so strong that it even made her feel wary.
However, after a moment's hesitation, Xi Ying still chose to trust Yuan Ming, and her Divine Soul flew towards the vicinity of the vortex of white flames.
The moment it landed, the white flames immediately enveloped her Divine Soul and began to refine it.
Thoughts and distractions bubbled up continuously from within Xi Ying's Divine Soul, only to be extinguished one after another.
Yet, after barely ten breaths, Xi Ying's Divine Thought had returned to tranquility, become singular, and no more stray thoughts emerged.
At the same time, her Soul Power had also been purified at this moment, becoming clear and free of impurities.
Feeling the changes in her Divine Soul, Xi Ying was naturally filled with joy.
She looked at the white flame vortex and couldn't help but feel a trace of greed; she somewhat didn't want to leave.
But when she thought of Yuan Ming still operating the Sky-reaching Demon Pillar, struggling to maintain the space crack for her, she immediately came to her senses, and her Divine Soul rushed upwards, planning to return.
However, at this moment, an unexpected scene occurred.
The white flame vortex, which had already been spinning rapidly, suddenly seemed to have completed refining all the Desire Power and abruptly stopped rotating.
The next instant, the center of the vortex suddenly collapsed inwards, with the surrounding flames and Desire Power rapidly collapsing inward as well.
Xi Ying immediately felt an incredibly powerful force of attraction pulling at her Divine Soul, dragging it toward the collapsing center.
Her heart sank. She immediately mobilized all her strength, trying to break free from the influence of that power.
Nevertheless, in this space, that force seemed impossible to contend against. No matter how much she struggled, her Divine Soul inevitably edged closer and closer towards the center of collapse.
Just when Xi Ying thought all hope was lost, the collapse of the Desire Power vortex below had been completed, and all the purified Desire Power refined by the white flames converged and compressed into a small white Round Orb.
The white Round Orb looked just like a pearl, crystal clear, yet within it floated strands of white luminescence.
The moment Xi Ying's Divine Soul gazed upon the white Round Orb, an invisible bond seemed to form between them, and the Round Orb, beyond control, sped towards her, rushing into Xi Ying's Divine Soul.
"Boom"
Xi Ying felt as if thunder had exploded within her Divine Soul.
An immense yet utterly pure Desire Power spread instantly, flooding every corner of her soul body with such powerful force that her Divine Soul involuntarily took on the appearance of roaring.
The next instant, streams of Golden Light burst forth from Xi Ying's Divine Soul's mouth, eyes, and ears. The light spread out and turned her entire soul body to gold.
Yuan Ming, who was waiting outside, suddenly saw a Golden Light emanate from the base of the Stealing Heaven Tripod and was instantly alarmed.
But at this moment, he did not know what was happening inside the tripod and could only continue operating the Sky-reaching Demon Pillar to maintain the space crack while silently praying for Xi Ying.
At this moment, Xi Ying felt her Divine Soul extremely heated, as if basking in the intense Sun. She could clearly feel the chains leading to the Word Witch Realm breaking away.
Once her Divine Soul returned to her body, she would truly be a Spoken Witch.
After the white Round Orb was absorbed by Xi Ying, the Desire Power within the Jade Lotus Platform's space had been depleted. Its original Divine Skills resumed their operation.
And as the Lotus Platform space began to accumulate Desire Power once again, the white flames that had disappeared started to emerge again and began to seal the space above.Always read at the source—*.
Seeing this, Xi Ying took the chance to fly upwards, while the space above had not been completely sealed, and left the white space.
After her Divine Soul returned to her body, Xi Ying did not wake up immediately.
Inside her Sea of Consciousness, her Divine Soul was re-merging with the Nascent Soul. Powerful waves of Divine Soul Power could not be suppressed, erupting from within her body.
Yuan Ming, who was on guard beside her, felt this change. The worry in his eyes was suddenly replaced with joy, and he could not help but breath out a sigh of relief.
After a long while, Xi Ying's Divine Soul fluctuations finally began to subside, and her Soul Cultivation Realm also stabilized.
The first words she uttered upon opening her eyes were, "Yuan Ming, I've reached the Word Witch Realm."
"Tell me in detail, how did you break through?" Yuan Ming was half amazed, half curious.
Xi Ying showed a hint of a smile upon hearing this and proceeded to recount the incident in the White Jade Lotus Platform to Yuan Ming in detail.
"So it turns out that the white flames could condense Desire Power into an elixir," Yuan Ming murmured thoughtfully to himself.
"Yes, but I've absorbed all the Desire Power in that space, so to refine that kind of Desire Power crystallization again will probably take quite some time," Xi Ying nodded, speaking with a trace of apology.
"No matter, as long as we know that with enough accumulation of Desire Power comes such benefits, time is not an issue, I can wait. Now that you've broken through to the Word Witch Realm, we're even more confident about dealing with the Wu Yue Sect," Yuan Ming said with an easy smile.
"I've just entered the Word Witch Realm, so there's probably still a significant gap compared to the Wu Yue God who has been steeped in this realm for a long time, but now when we face his Word Witch Power again, we are no longer so helpless," Xi Ying smiled and said.
"After breaking through to the Word Witch Realm, what kind of abilities have you awakened?" Yuan Ming was most interested in this and eagerly asked.
"It's still hard to say now, my power should be related to the Sun, and I need time to comprehend it," Xi Ying said after slight contemplation.

As cultivators from all over Yunhuang gathered from all directions, the Cloud Desolate Alliance's base became increasingly lively.
Temporarily forgetting the terror and pressure brought by the Wu Yue Sect, many cultivators began to set up stalls near the base to sell Magic Treasures.
In just a few days, what was originally a place with only a dozen or so people doing business had been turned into a sprawling trading event with hundreds of stall owners, showcasing an array of dazzling and varied treasures for sale.
After arriving at the Alliance's base, Wulu always kept a low profile, rarely exposing himself in front of others.
On one hand, it was because his nearly demonized appearance was destined not to be accepted by these Human Clan's cultivators.
On the other hand, it was also because the mix of Mana, Demonic Qi, the power from the Nascent Soul Late Stage Cultivator from Three Immortals Island, and the power of the Blood Crystal Stone in his forehead was torturing him all the time, causing him unbearable pain.
However, Wulu himself had a steadfast nature, or else he would not have been tasked with the secret affairs of infiltrating other Sects for many years, so he continued to bear the pain, not showing even the slightest sign of suffering, even in front of Yuan Ming.
But in reality, he desperately needed some elixirs or talismans that could suppress or neutralize the chaotic power within his body.
Now that the Cloud Desolate Alliance's base was a mixture of fish and dragons, many cultivators had begun to take out their treasured possessions for sale or exchange for their own survival, and as a result, many people were finding bargains at the trading event.
Wulu wasn't thinking about finding bargains; he was grateful to the heavens just to find spiritual materials that suited him.
He used a Secret Technique to disguise his appearance, transforming into an average-looking, middle-aged man, and he too arrived at the trading event.
This temporary trading event certainly could not compare to those originally situated in various State Cities or Immortal Sect workshops in scale, but was simply a place in an open field where an Array had been hastily arranged.
Beneath the Array, hundreds of stalls were closely arranged into three rows, some propped up a table, others simply laid out a layer of felt on the ground, people bustled through, browsing and bartering, and the atmosphere was buzzing.
Wulu looked over dozens of stalls in succession, but couldn't find what he wanted, feeling somewhat disheartened.
It was then that he noticed inconspicuously squeezed between two larger stalls with high tables at the end of the first row was a small booth.
In front of this modest stall was laid a black square of cloth, on which was painted a Cycle Star Map in white lacquer, utterly bare with no goods laid out for sale.
Behind the stall was a small stool, on which sat a dark-skinned elderly man who was grizzled with age.
He had saggy brows and eyes, downturned at the corners of his mouth, appearing somewhat sorrowful, and his eyes, lacking any black pupils, were filled with white, indicating he was blind.
Seeing him sitting there with his arms folded in front of his chest, hunched over, beside him an extinguished lantern, and nearby, a branch held up a plain banner with "Immortal Points the Way" written in black on white.
"A fortune teller?" Wulu was somewhat surprised to see this.
It was not that he had never seen a fortune teller before, but those who embarked on the path of cultivation were almost always contending with fate, where would you find someone who genuinely believed in it?
What if fate declared there was no chance of achieving Foundation Establishment? Could one truly give up on that possibility?
So, there were hardly any cultivators who took fortune-telling as their main profession.
Wulu immediately extended his Divine Sense to scan the man and discovered there were no fluctuations of Spiritual Power on him, even his Divine Soul fluctuation was no different from an ordinary person's; he understood right away.
This blind old man must be a mere mortal who had somehow wandered into this trading event, mistaking this place for a common market, hence setting up his stall.
"Old man, setting up a stall here will yield you no gains," Wulu bent down, squatted in front of the elderly man, and said.
"Foolish talk, you underestimate how a spoken prediction can define fate, you'll spoil this old man's business!" the blind elder responded, immediately agitated upon hearing this.

chapters.title: Chapter 742 - 713: The Mysterious Elder
chapters.content:
"Don't blame me for being talkative, but could you tell me, since you've set up shop here, have you ever actually done business?" Wulu laughed and didn't mind, speaking out.
"This..." Just as the blind elder began to speak, his stomach inopportunely grumbled.
Clearly, not only had he not done any business, but he also couldn't even fill his stomach.
Seeing this, Wulu gave a wry smile, intending to give him some Silver Coins, but realized he only had Spirit Stones. He wanted to offer some dry rations, yet he only had elixirs on him.
"Old man, I don't have Silver Coins on me, only a pot of brew. If you don't mind, please have a drink," Wulu said after some thought.
His brew was naturally an Immortal Brew filled with Spiritual Power. Just one cup could prolong the old man's life, let alone satisfy his hunger, though of course, he could not drink too much, as his mortal flesh could not withstand it.
"Some liquor? If only there was some meat to go with it," said the blind elder joyfully upon hearing this, only to immediately feel a bit disappointed.
"Then give me a moment," said Wulu.
Having said that, he turned and left the stall, and after a short while, he returned with an oil-paper package in his hand, containing a large chunk of Beast Skin meat that he had just gone to fetch.
"Old man, this meat is rich in vitality, and this liquor is highly potent. Both should not be consumed in excess, so keep them for gradual consumption," Wulu advised as he placed the meat and liquor before the blind elder.
After speaking, he turned to leave.
"Hey, don't go, old man. I always keep my word and never take without giving. However, I don't have any money to give you, so let me divine your fortune for free. How about that?" called out the blind elder hurriedly when he heard the movement.
"It's just a little food and drink, there's no need to worry about it," Wulu turned back and waved his hand, laughing as he spoke.
"Hey, what's the difference between feeding the destitute and tossing scraps to a beggar? Young man, don't break my rules. You've given me meat and drink today, so you will have your fortune told whether you like it or not," the elder raised his voice sharply, insisting.
Hearing this, Wulu thought the man certainly had a strange temperament, but he didn't plan to pay any heed and turned to leave.
"You, a trapped animal, might escape today, but can you escape tomorrow?" At that moment, the elder's voice, tinged with mockery, drifted lazily from behind.
Wulu's body stiffened suddenly, and he found himself unable to move forward.
After a moment, he returned and crouched before the blind elder, his gaze fixed on the shriveled, dark face, filled with bewilderment.
The blind elder paid him no heed, took a sip of liquor, and his parched frame shivered comfortably.
Next, he tossed a chipped bowl, having fetched from nowhere, spot on into the center of a cloth marked with a Star Map.
To Wulu's surprise, the bowl held a full cup of Water, but not a drop spilled out.
Wulu looked at the water in the bowl and then at the blind elder, somewhat puzzled.
"Put your index finger into the bowl, the Innate one on your left hand," noticed the blind elder, seeing Wulu's hesitation, and instructed.
Wulu, already aware that the man before him was no ordinary person, instinctively did as told, dipping his left index finger into the chipped bowl, letting it touch the water.
The blind elder made a swipe across the edge of the bowl, and it immediately emitted a humming vibration.
Subsequently, the water in the bowl began rhythmic pulsing, stirring up waves and ripples. One after another, the seemingly ordinary Stars on the black cloth lit up.
Wulu watched in amazement, while the elder's murmured voice reached his ears:
"Stars diverge at the horn of Taurus, a lionhearted spirit of its own kind,
Seeing Jiang Palace Immortal Mansion from afar, yet sadly mired in a tangle hard to unwind,
Even with ladders reaching the heavens, stuck in the mire, one cannot find.
To break free and find ease, within the root of both Immortal and Demon, nature undefined."
As his voice ceased, Wulu came back to his senses, not realizing he was drenched in sweat.
"Elder," he whispered, but the scenery before him shifted in the blink of an eye.
The bustling crowd and stalls all around had vanished, day turned to night instantly, and a solitary moon hung high. He found himself atop a mist-enshrouded peak.
Above the mountain peak, the Star Map still lay before him, and seated across, was still the withered, dark-skinned blind elder.
"I do not know who you are, elder, or why you enlighten me here today," Wulu stood up and bowed, only to find he has reverted to his original appearance without knowing when.
"Neither man, Immortal, nor Demon, your situation is a tough one," the blind elder showed no airs of an immortal, munching on Beast Skin and drinking from a jug with nonchalance.
Ignoring Wulu's question as if he hadn't heard it at all.
"Indeed, as the elder has said, beyond one's control," Wulu smiled wryly and replied.
"Still, there's hope for redemption," the blind elder casually remarked as he shook the liquor jug.
Seeing that the jug appeared to have been emptied, he pursed his lips, tossed it aside with a casual throw, and discarded it.
"I humbly request the elder to impart his teachings," Wulu said upon hearing this, his face alight with surprised joy.
As he spoke, he deftly produced another jar of Immortal Brew and passed it over.
"Not bad, for the sake of this brew, I shall teach you the Void Thought Technique," the blind elder snatched the jug, opened the lid to sniff it, and nodded in satisfaction.
"Thank you, elder, may I ask what sort of Cultivation Technique the Void Thought Technique is?" Wulu first expressed his gratitude, then asked immediately after.
"Why ask so many questions? Just try it and you'll find out," the blind elder couldn't be bothered to explain and responded dismissively.
Upon hearing this, Wulu ceased speaking and silently awaited the blind elder's instruction.
Once he took a few gulps of wine, the elder began imparting the technique of the Void Thought Technique, his voice resonating like an echo, humming in Wulu's ears.
At first, Wulu could clearly understand what was being said, but after a little while, the voice grew more and more indistinct, ethereal, and hard to grasp.
Yet, for some unknown reason, Wulu felt his very Mana begin to circulate along a peculiar pathway under the direction of this voice.
This circulation was entirely different from all the other Cultivation Techniques he had been training in the past; it was as though Mana was avoiding the Twelve Main Meridians and the Eight Extraordinary Meridians, these major pathways, and instead, oddly flowing through the minor meridians.
Quickly after, the Demonic Qi in him began to stir, followed by the Mana from the Nascent Soul cultivator which also wasn't his. Then, the Blood Crystal Stone on his forehead joined in, lighting up as well.
Wulu felt as if his body, with its myriad powers at work, was about to burst.
Indeed, that was the case; his flesh manifested magma-like bloody red fissures, edging toward collapse.
But as he endured the pain with tremendous patience, that explosive power gradually subsided. All the conflicting forces slowly harmonized, seemingly converging toward one focal point in an all-encompassing manner.
By this time, the blind elder had completed his teaching. Sensing the changes within Wulu, he could not help but praise, "Such a stalwart spirit is most fit to be my successor, only it's a pity... alas..."
His words trailed off into a deep sigh.
"But having passed you the Void Thought Technique, I'm now somewhat your mentor. With this technique by your side, the more diverse your learning and gains are in the future, the more beneficial it will be for your Cultivation. I only hope that you will remain true to your original aspirations!" the blind elder sighed, and said.
As his voice fell, Wulu had already quickly grasped the essence of the technique.
With a cooling sensation flowing through all his meridians, his expression went from initial distress to calmness, and the terrifying cracks on his body gradually healed, leaving only shallow patterns.
And the multiple forces within him slowly became balanced, coalescing swiftly, and finally merged into one without any signs of mutual repulsion.
The blind elder, with his empty gaze fixed on Wulu, who was steadily becoming more serene, put away the jug satisfactorily, stepped toward the distance, and merged into the void within one step, vanishing in an instant.
Wulu, meanwhile, found himself in a tranquil valley, still immersed in Cultivation, oblivious to everything else.U&pl*oad$ed by the M&|V@|@L(@E&MPYR@)@ team.!

Outside the main hall of Chang Chun Temple, a line of Wu Yue Sect disciples carried trays stacked with succulent foods like roast chicken, lamb legs, grilled fish, and various other delicacies, continuously flowing into the hall.
Inside the hall, around a large round table, sat a man dressed in Beast Skin with bloody-red hair, who was plowing through dish after dish of food with relish.
This man's skin was dark and shiny like fine steel, and although he wasn't large, he exuded the aura of a primordial Fierce Beast.
"How is it to your liking, Lord Xue Li?" Blood Demon Ancestor stood beside him, respectfully inquiring.
Wu Yue God was also present in the hall, seated at a distance, her expression neutral but her eyes held a trace of impatience.
"The flavor is too bland, but it has a unique taste," Lord Xue Li said inarticulately, with a roast chicken in his mouth.
Seeing that Xue Li was somewhat pleased, Blood Demon Ancestor heaved a sigh of relief.
"How is the preparation of the Breaking Realm Transfer Array going?" Xue Li suddenly halted his feasting to inquire.
"Lord Xue Li, the Star Power necessary for opening the Array had nearly been accumulated, but a significant amount was used to facilitate your descent. We will need another ten or so days to fully gather it," Blood Demon Ancestor reported.
"Very well, you must be on high alert these next ten days. The two of you should personally guard the vicinity of the Great Array, and ensure no further mishaps occur!" Xue Li ordered.
"Yes," Blood Demon Ancestor replied solemnly.
A flicker of displeasure passed through Wu Yue God's eyes, but she quickly concealed it and remained silent.
In her view, this Xue Li was merely at the Middle-stage Returning Void; yet, he dared to command her in such a manner. Her Soul Power had reached the Mid-stage of Word Witch, and she was closely approaching the Late Stage of Word Witch, unafraid of this man.
"What is it? Do you, Wu Yue God, have an objection to my words?" Xue Li sensed something and turned his gaze toward Wu Yue God.
"The only commands I heed come from Lord Demon. If you wish to direct me, obtain Lord Demon's orders first," Wu Yue God scoffed, stood up, and strode out.
Xue Li watched Wu Yue God's retreating figure, a cruel smile playing at his lips, and with a blur of motion, he disappeared from his spot.

chapters.title: Chapter 743 - 714: Battle with Wu Yue Sect Again
chapters.content:
The Wu Yue God had already been paying close attention in secret. As Xue Li's figure disappeared in an instant, a vast expanse of black qi suddenly surged from his sleeves, engulfing the area within dozens of feet around him, and several black evil ghosts appeared, raising their heads and letting out piercing screeches.
Bang, bang, bang...
The disciples of the Wu Yue Sect outside the hall hadn't figured out what was happening before their heads burst open, with blood and brains scattered all around, their bodies slumping to the ground in disarray.
Not far away, the Blood Demon Ancestor's face revealed shock, his body's blood light greatly intensified, especially around his head, where it was exceptionally thick. He hastily retreated.
Behind Wu Yue God, a figure blurred and Xue Li's form suddenly materialized, a black fist striking toward Wu Yue God's chest.
This strike was without any flourish, its only characteristic was its speed, like a streak of black lightning.
Wu Yue God swiped his sleeve, and a yellow shield appeared behind him.
The shield's surface manifested the phantom of a mountain peak, emitting fluctuations of spiritual power that were extraordinary, revealing that it was a replicated Spiritual Treasure. It spun rapidly, enlarging tenfold in an instant, protecting his rear heart.
The black fist struck like lightning, hitting hard against the shield.
With a "clang" sound, the yellow shield caved in, with spider-web-like cracks spreading across its surface before exploding into countless fragments.
A sliver of surprise flashed in Wu Yue God's eyes, but he didn't mind. The black mist around his body rolled as several black evil ghosts with bared fangs came forth, their screeching sound waves converging into a wave that struck at Xue Li.
Xue Li's mouth curled into a hint of mockery as he inhaled sharply.
His mouth suddenly became excessively large, almost bigger than his body itself, engulfing everything voraciously.
In the blink of an eye, it seemed as if a black hole had opened within his mouth, with strong winds wreaking havoc within a few miles, and space itself seemingly collapsing and pouring into his mouth.
Wu Yue God and the few black evil ghosts were swallowed without resistance, gurgling as they were devoured by Xue Li.
Xue Li's massive maw then returned to normal at a pace visible to the naked eye. His figure also began to descend slowly from midair. He stuck out his tongue to lick his lips, contentedly rubbing his slightly bulging stomach as if he had just enjoyed a hearty meal.
The Blood Demon Ancestor, witnessing this scene, was both shocked and pleased, clearly not expecting Xue Li's divine skills to be so formidable.
But Wu Yue God was an ally, the leader of the Wu Yue Sect, so he couldn't afford to have an accident.
"Lord Xue Li truly possesses boundless divine skills, but Wu Yue God is one of our own. Please show mercy for his rudeness this time," the Blood Demon Ancestor stepped forward and said.
Xue Li glanced at the Blood Demon Ancestor, spat out a figure from his mouth, and it was Wu Yue God.
Wu Yue God staggered as he landed, his face pale, a trace of fear in his eyes as he looked at Xue Li.
Those few breaths of time had felt like years to him.
He had fallen into a black void where an invisible current pervaded. His mana and soul power were involuntarily leaking out, merging into that current.
He tried to stop it but found himself utterly unable to, so he could only watch helplessly as his mana and soul power were drawn out bit by bit, and his strength continuously weakened.
He would not resign himself to fate, immediately activating various offensive measures in an attempt to puncture a hole in the black void.
Though Wu Yue God primarily cultivated the path of Soul Cultivators, his magic practitioner skills were equally strong. However, regardless of what attacks or magic treasures he employed, they all seemed to disappear without a trace when they hit the surroundings, unable to stir up the slightest ripple.
F&i^rst% p.ub$l%is@h$ed! on *.#
A trace of indescribable fear finally surged up from deep within his heart. It was a feeling he hadn't experienced in many years—the feeling of helplessness, as if he had returned to his early days in the Cultivation World, facing an opponent whose cultivation level he knew nothing about.
But just when he was about to despair, the darkness before his eyes cleared like clouds parting to reveal the sun, sweeping away in an instant, and he reappeared inside Chang Chun Temple's main hall.
One could say that had Xue Li not spat him out at the last moment, he might have been digested inside, his physical body and divine soul ceasing to exist, as if he had never existed in this world.
"Seeing as Fellow Daoist Blood Demon is concerned, I will let this matter slide this time. Go and guard the Great Array immediately," Xue Li said, glancing at Wu Yue God with a cold voice.
This time, Wu Yue God didn't speak another word, silently turning around and flying towards the peak of Chaotian Peak.
The Blood Demon Ancestor was about to follow when a streak of black light flew in from outside. It was a black Sound Transmission Talisman.
His divine sense entered, and his expression changed slightly, murmuring, "The Cloud Desolate Alliance really knows our purpose. To send so many people!"
Xue Li waved his hand, grabbing the Sound Transmission Talisman. After a probe with his divine sense, he showed a look of disdain, "Merely a rabble, not worth worrying about!"
"Lord Xue Li, now that the Cloud Desolate Alliance has gathered so many cultivators in their quest for self-preservation, our fight might be quite desperate. Shouldn't we think of a strategy to deal with them?" the Blood Demon Ancestor suggested.
"The Yunhuang Continent is just a remote place in the Chuyun Realm, with sparse spiritual energy and no substantial cultivation technique heritage, hardly worth mentioning. My Swallowing Heaven Demon Technique just needs a lot of high-level essence blood for nourishment. Their arrival is timely," Xue Li said, uncaring, with a light laugh. His form turned into a crimson rainbow that shot out of the hall and tunneled into the distance.
The Blood Demon Ancestor watched the receding blood-colored rainbow and sighed.
He had absolute confidence in Xue Li's strength, but he was worried about his arrogance.
Blood Demon Ancestor fell silent for a moment, then clapped his hands.
"Master," the nearby shadow darkened, and a tall figure in black armor emerged from nowhere. It was the same person who had made contact with Wuyue God in Zhao Country.
