"Summon all the Demon Guards without sparing the Blood Cave's consumption, and drive the power of all the guards to the extreme," Blood Demon Ancestor ordered in a deep voice.
"Yes," the Black Armor Soldier replied and quickly retreated.
…
Cloud Ridge Mountain Range, Cloud Desolate Alliance's main hall.
"Today, two more sects and eight families, nearly six hundred cultivators, joined the alliance. I have already settled them," Ancestor Ming Quan excitedly reported to Tian Jizi.
Wan Tianren, Gu Xuanyang, Luo Zhu, He Cha, Yuan Ming, Xi Ying, and others were all here.
In addition to them, leaders of sects that had recently joined the Cloud Desolate Alliance were also present.
"Unexpectedly, there are so many hidden sects and noble families on Yunhuang Continent, truly a fortune for the alliance. But have we thoroughly investigated these sects and families to ensure there are no spies from Wuyue Sect or Demon Clan lurking among them? We cannot have another incident like that of the Cao Family," Tian Jizi said.
"Alliance Hierarch, rest assured, I have already investigated thoroughly. There is no problem. Moreover, these cultivators have now been stationed on the outskirts of the alliance's territory and are being closely guarded. There won't be any more issues," Ancestor Ming Quan said.
Tian Jizi nodded, then waved his hand.
Ancestor Ming Quan bowed and left.
"Everyone must be aware of the current situation of the alliance. Cultivators from all over continue to come together. If we wait a few more days, we might increase our troops by a few thousand. However, Wuyue Sect's plans are pressing. If we keep waiting, there might be changes. I called you all here today to ask for opinions on how we should proceed," Tian Jizi said as he looked around at the people in the hall.
"Wuyue Sect is trying to open a channel to the Demon World. If they succeed, Yunhuang will be devastated. Time is of the essence. I think we should mobilize immediately, capture Chang Chun Temple, and destroy the Demon Array," Wan Tianren immediately said.
"Exactly, with our current strength, we are sufficient to contend against Wuyue Sect and those Demon Clan scoundrels. Waiting any longer is dangerously risky."
"That's right," others expressed their agreement.
Yuan Ming was not surprised by the current situation; everyone present was wise. Even if previously they had their own thoughts or were hostile to each other, on the brink of survival, they naturally came to a unanimous decision.
Tian Jizi held this meeting as a formality and also to show a stance to the recently joined sect leaders.
"Very well, since everyone agrees we should attack, the alliance naturally consents. Return immediately to gather your disciples, and today we set out for Chang Chun Temple!" Tian Jizi rose and declared.
Half a day later, hundreds of huge Flying Boats and Flying Cars of the Cloud Desolate Alliance, along with a swarm of tunneling light, soared up and headed straight towards Chang Chun Temple.
In a certain part of the Cloud Ridge Mountain Range, an old man holding a banner climbed up a low slope, gasping for breath. Facing the direction of Chang Chun Temple, it was the blind old man who had taught Wulu the Void Thought Technique.
"With the help of the Void Thought Technique, that boy can barely be considered a Returning Void presence. Coupled with the Body of Wanxiang and a Word Witch, he should be able to resolve this demonic calamity," the blind old man murmured to himself.
Footsteps approached, and a white-garbed young man emerged from the nearby woods.
If Yuan Ming were here, he would be greatly surprised, for this person was Liu Tianming.
However, Liu Tianming now stared blankly ahead, his eyes hollow, his expression stiff, like a soulless shell.
"It's time to deal with the tomb of the Reincarnation Demon Lord. Leaving it in Yunhuang Continent is a hidden danger after all." The old man, his eyes rolled back, glanced at Liu Tianming without concern and shakily set off towards the south.
Liu Tianming followed closely behind.
…
On a Flying Boat where the believers of the Moon God Sect were, Yuan Ming and Xi Ying stood side by side at the bow.
"What do you think are our chances in this battle?" Xi Ying asked.
"With my current strength, I can certainly deal with Blood Demon Ancestor. Your Soul Cultivation has broken through to the Word Witch Realm. It shouldn't be hard to restrain Wuyue God. The Cloud Desolate Alliance has the advantage in numbers. Furthermore, the aim of the alliance is not to exterminate Wuyue Sect, but to destroy the Demon Array. No matter how powerful Wuyue Sect is, it's unlikely that they can protect the Demon Array while resisting the attack of the Cloud Desolate Alliance. Therefore, if there are no unforeseen circumstances, the Cloud Desolate Alliance should have an 80% chance of victory," Yuan Ming said.
"My worry is exactly about such unforeseen circumstances. If the Demon World intends to open a spatial passage, how could they be unprepared?" Xi Ying commented.
"That does make sense, Fellow Daoist Yan. Yesterday, I asked you to divine the outcome of this battle. Did you discern anything?" Yuan Ming asked, turning to the three standing behind him: Yan Siyun, Yan Sijing, and Xu Che.
Yan Siyun and Yan Sijing's expressions were complex. They now knew Yuan Ming was the Nether Moon God.
The two women had known Yuan Ming far longer than the people from East Sea, always thinking that Yuan Ming was merely a Divine Envoy of the Nether Moon God. They could not have imagined that he was the Nether Moon God himself. The shock they received was much greater than others'.

chapters.title: Chapter 744 - 715: Give it a Shot
chapters.content:
"I'm sorry to have disappointed you, my lord, but the young lady has failed to divine any results," Yan Siyun said, shaking her head.
"Not only that, my sister has also been injured by the backlash of the divination skill," Yan Sijing added.
"Jing'er!" Yan Siyun scolded softly.
"Oh, Fellow Daoist Yan is injured?" Yuan Ming's expression changed as he carefully observed Yan Siyun.
"It's just a minor injury, not a big deal. After some rest, I will recover. The only shame is that I couldn't divine the outcome of the great battle," Yan Siyun said.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming's brow furrowed slightly.
He had been quite optimistic about the upcoming battle, an important reason being Yan Siyun's divination skill. Unexpectedly, the divination had failed and even inflicted injuries on the divinator. He wondered whether this was a blessing or a curse.
"Lord Nether Moon God, please forgive me. I will attempt to divine again and try to obtain some results," Yan Siyun said hurriedly, noticing the change in Yuan Ming's expression.
Yuan Ming was about to speak words of comfort.
"There's no point in trying again. Another divination would be futile," a voice interrupted. Xi Qian emerged from the cabin of the Flying Boat, holding a wine gourd, her speech tinged with drunken slurs.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming couldn't help but sigh.
He hadn't expected Xi Qian to be such a heavy drinker. Since her awakening, she had hardly been seen without a drink in hand, staying intoxicated for eight out of the twelve hours of the day.
"Elder Xi Qian, what do you mean by that?" First glancing at Yuan Ming, Yan Sijing asked.
"This great battle will determine the rise and fall of the Yunhuang Continent's Cultivation World—its causality is too vast. With your sister's cultivation level and her degree of proficiency in the Heavenly Destiny Skill, even risking her life would not yield any results," Xi Qian said, burping mid-sentence.
As soon as these words were spoken, the faces of those present changed.
"Elder Xi Qian, are you saying that the divination skill is also affected by the causality involved in the matter being divined?" Yan Siyun asked.
"Of course. The art of divination itself is an attempt to pry into the secrets of heaven. Revealing such secrets would change the course of the world. The harm suffered by the divinator and the impact it has on the world are related; the larger the impact, the greater the damage and the higher the chance of failure. You should feel fortunate that you didn't succeed earlier, or you'd be a corpse right now," Xi Qian said with a chuckle, taking a sip from her gourd.
Taken aback, Yan Siyun fell into a deep reverie.
"Is this true? You've never mentioned this before," Yuan Ming addressed Xi Ying.
"I know very little about this myself. Actually, my sister brought back the Heavenly Destiny Skill from a secret realm, not I, and since I can't practice it, my understanding is quite limited," Xi Ying explained.
"I see," Yuan Ming nodded.
"To think there were such restrictions on the divination skill. Why didn't you mention such an important thing before? There was no mention of this in the Heavenly Destiny Skill content!" Xi Ying said, looking at her sister and speaking in a serious tone.
"Did I not tell the family before? I thought I did," Xi Qian replied, slightly surprised by Xi Ying's scolding, and sobering up a bit in the process.
Remembering when Xi Qian returned from the secret realm and handed over the Heavenly Destiny Skill to the Xi Family, Xi Qian had also been drunk, her state half-sober at best, so forgetting to clarify wouldn't be unlikely.
"Drinking leads to trouble. You're not allowed to drink anymore!" Xi Ying snatched the wine gourd forcefully, speaking irritably.
"Give me back my gourd!" Xi Qian reached out to grab it back.
With a wave of her hand, Xi Ying prevented Xi Qian from moving, then dragged her back into the cabin.
Yuan Ming waved his hand, and the three Yan sisters withdrew as well.
"You heard what was just said, didn't you? What do you make of it?" Yuan Ming said softly.
"The Demon World will not sit idly by; they must have prepared countermeasures. We can't afford to be careless," ripples formed in the surrounding space, revealing a half-visible figure—it was Wulu.
"Good, but during the upcoming battle, you needn't worry about the fighting. Just infiltrate Chang Chun Temple and destroy the Breaking Realm Demon Array!" Yuan Ming commanded in a grave voice.
Wulu, capable of completely concealing himself using the Heavenly Escape Stone Talisman, was naturally the best choice to sabotage the Breaking Realm Demon Array.
"Understood," Wulu responded.
"Is your body holding up all right?" Yuan Ming asked, recalling something.
"It has improved considerably. Rest assured, Fellow Daoist Yuan," Wulu said with a smile.
Surprise flashed across Yuan Ming's eyes. He had already noticed the issue with Wulu's mixed energies when they infiltrated Chang Chun Temple together. However, Yuan Ming was powerless to help, and it surprised him that Wulu had found a solution himself.
...
The Wu Yue Sect had planted many spies around the Cloud Ridge Mountain Range early on, which by now had conveyed the movements of the Cloud Desolate Alliance back to the sect.
Upon receiving the news, the Wu Yue God and Blood Demon Ancestor made their own preparations.
The distance from the Cloud Ridge Mountain Range to Chang Chun Temple wasn't too far, and it took only half a day for the Cloud Desolate Alliance's forces to reach Chang Chun Temple. They arrayed their troops densely in front of the temple.
Tian Jizi, Yuan Ming, and other high-level cultivators of the Cloud Desolate Alliance hovered in the sky, looking ahead.
Previously, the Cloud Desolate Alliance's Sect Protection Array had been destroyed by Tian Jizi's self-destruction during their retreat. Now, the Wu Yue Sect had set up another Sect Protection Array, which roiled with countless demonic clouds. Occasionally, black thunder streaked across it, thundering like rolling thunder.
The Wu Yue Sect had adopted the same strategy as the Cloud Desolate Alliance before, keeping all their disciples behind the Great Array, evidently preparing to test the Cloud Desolate Alliance's mettle with this Demon Thunder Array.
The Demon Thunder Array also contained an erosive effect; within a hundred miles of Chang Chun Temple, all vegetation withered away, and nature's spiritual energy became much more sparse, hardly resembling the celestial mountain that it once was.
Tian Jizi, Ancestor Ming Quan, and other cultivators from the Chang Chun Temple saw what had become of the spirit land they had relied upon for their survival, and they were filled with righteous indignation.
Ancestor Ming Quan, known for his impetuous nature, immediately extended his Divine Sense to try and ascertain the condition of the Demon Thunder Array.
However, the moment his Divine Sense touched the array, the Demon Thunder Array reacted as if provoked, lighting up with a "buzz" where it had been investigated.
A black thunderbolt as thick as the mouth of a bowl shot out from the void, crossing a distance of more than ten miles in an instant and striking at Ancestor Ming Quan. Content first released on *.
Tian Jizi tried to intervene, but the speed of the black thunder was simply too fast; he couldn't stop it either.
Ancestor Ming Quan was shocked and tried to cast a Protective Body spell, but it was already too late. A blue shield appeared out of nowhere, positioning itself in front of the black thunderbolt.
This was one of his Spiritual Treasures, which could automatically protect its owner in times of crisis without needing to be activated.
The black thunderbolt struck the blue shield, emitting a deafening thunderous roar. The pitch-black thunderbolt engulfed Ancestor Ming Quan in an instant.
Ancestor Ming Quan's figure was suddenly flung backward, the blue shield was thoroughly penetrated, its spirit light terribly dimmed, and it seemed to be completely destroyed. A gaping hole was torn through his chest, and his body was charred all over; the man had long lost consciousness.
The onlookers nearby were all shocked, and they immediately scattered, flying away. Some who were about to investigate the Demon Array hastily retracted their Divine Sense, silently feeling lucky.
A white light shot forth, catching Ancestor Ming Quan's body, as Tian Jizi's figure appeared beside him. He took out a bottle of Healing Pills, pried open the elder's mouth, and without consideration for how many pills were inside, poured them all down his throat.
A green light emanated from Ancestor Ming Quan, rapidly stemming the decline of his vital signs, preventing them from completely fading away.
Yuan Ming glanced at Ancestor Ming Quan, then turned his attention towards the Demon Thunder Array, his eyes showing a trace of interest.
"Not bad for an array from the Demon World, truly extraordinary. Do any of you see through the mysteries of this array?" Tian Jizi stabilized Ancestor Ming Quan's injuries, handed him over to others, and asked with a cold huff.
The people nearby were all silent.
Most of them had only learned of the existence of the Demon World in recent days; how could they possibly understand the forbidden techniques of the Demon World?
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, you have infiltrated the Chang Chun Temple before, do you understand this array?" Tian Jizi looked at Yuan Ming.
"The last time I investigated, this Demon Thunder Array had not yet been deployed," Yuan Ming shook his head.
Tian Jizi felt slightly disheartened by this response.
"We're still lacking Returning to Void combat power; otherwise, we wouldn't have to be so constrained," he sighed inwardly, quickly regaining his composure.
"Fellow Daoists, today is the decisive battle with the Wu Yue Sect, a battle that involves the lives of countless beings on the Yunhuang Continent. Please do not hold back, show your hidden cards! Of course, the alliance won't let your efforts go unrewarded. Whoever can decipher the mysteries of the Great Array will be credited with a first-class merit," Tian Jizi announced loudly.
Upon hearing this, many in the vicinity showed signs of excitement.
To boost morale and fight this battle of life and death, the Cloud Desolate Alliance gathered resources from various sects and established a merit reward system, divided into three levels.
The reward for a first-class merit included five hundred thousand Spirit Stones, a replica of a Spiritual Treasure, a large amount of elixirs, and the opportunity to enter the Book Collection Pavilion of the alliance, where one could freely choose three classics—undoubtedly heavy rewards.
However, as the people looked at each other hesitantly, though many were somewhat tempted, no one actually stepped forward.
"Since the Alliance Hierarch has said so, I will give it a try," Yuan Ming stepped forward and said.
His personal wealth was such that he didn't care much for the first-class merit. Now that the alliance's forces had arrived at Chang Chun Temple, the impact on morale would be too great if the Demon Thunder Array couldn't be broken quickly.
"Please, Fellow Daoist Yuan," Tian Jizi said, pleased.
Without another word, Yuan Ming operated the Moonlight Technique, and a powerful Divine Sense surged forth, probing towards the black Demon Array.
This Divine Sense was astonishing, having reached the Peak of the Sleeping Witch and was on the verge of entering the Word Witch Realm.
The faces of Wan Tianren, Gu Xuanyang, and other East Sea cultivators changed; they were all too familiar with this fluctuation of Soul Power—it was the Divine Sense of the Nether Moon God!
A look of panic crossed Wan Tianren's eyes. He had been continuously probing lately, and had pretty much confirmed that Yuan Ming's Divine Soul had been greatly damaged and could no longer unleash the full combat power of his heyday.
But the current situation seemed to slap him hard in the face; Yuan Ming's Soul Power was clearly intact!
"Could this man have been concealing his true power all along? Or could it be that he was probing us?" Wan Tianren felt bitter regret within.
Yuan Ming previously assisted the East Sea in dismantling the invasion of the Wu Yue Sect. While grateful, Wan Tianren also felt deeply humiliated.
As time passed, his gratitude gradually faded, but the sense of humiliation grew with each recollection of that incident.
After all, the status he had once held unshakably in the hearts of East Sea cultivators was now being affected due to the continued worship of this Nether Moon God.
Being the uncrowned king of the East Sea for so many years, he couldn't stand being suppressed by another.
Once he guessed that Yuan Ming's strength might have diminished greatly, Wan Tianren's ambition grew uncontrollably. He had been scheming in the dark for some time, aiming to reclaim his status as the hegemon of the East Sea.
Previously, when Yuan Ming asked the Nether Moon God believers to provide Desire Power, Wan Tianren, to secure the support of his backers, covertly instructed people to disregard the request.
He conducted this secretly, something outsiders might not detect, but Yuan Ming, as the Nether Moon God, likely knew everything clearly. He had seriously offended the other party.
Gu Xuanyang and other East Sea cultivators who had stopped praying to the Nether Moon God looked at each other, also filled with regret.
For a moment, some were joyful and some were sorrowful, while the Golden Transformation Master, Shi Yanshi, and Old Man Hei Zhu were all delighted.

chapters.title: Chapter 745 - 716 A Small Matter
chapters.content:
Just as the minds of the cultivators were turning with numerous thoughts, Yuan Ming's divine sense had already touched the Demon Thunder Array.
"Boom"
As everyone had anticipated, a thick black thunderbolt shot out from the array, instantly crossing a distance of more than a dozen miles, striking towards Yuan Ming's chest.
Yuan Ming pinched a technique with one hand extremely skillfully, and then pointed towards the void in front of him, a dazzling yellow light flashed, and a yellow mountain-shaped magic treasure appeared in front of him. It was the Houtu Peak.
"Boom" A loud roar sounded as the black thunder struck the Houtu Peak.
In an instant, the surface of the yellow mountain flickered with black thunderfire, bursts of black thunder erupted, almost completely engulfing it.
At the same time, a grand yellow shadow burst out diagonally from the black thunder light, it was indeed the Houtu Peak, its surface covered with densely packed, conspicuous deep pits.
The black thunder had reduced by nearly half, its power undiminished as it continued straight for Yuan Ming's chest.
"To activate the Houtu Peak with the cultivation of the Nascent Soul Early Stage can't bring out its full power," Yuan Ming sighed secretly, but didn't panic. The Qi-Blood Power of the Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill within his body had long been in motion, spreading throughout his body in an instant.
A tangible blood light bloomed, engulfing his body. Within a radius of several meters, the temperature became extremely hot.
The black thunder struck the blood light, and with but a slight tremble, the blood light steadied. On the contrary, the black thunder, like waves crashing against a rock, directly shattered to pieces, dissipating into specks of thunder light.
Seeing this, the members of the Cloud Desolate Alliance widened their eyes in disbelief.
"This blood light is like the scorching sun, has Fellow Daoist Yuan already made a breakthrough to the Body of Wanxiang?" He Cha took rapid breaths, his whiskers trembling.
Yuan Ming did not intend to explain; the blood light around his body surged and retracted, condensing close to his skin. Inside, flowing lights turned, making it look like viscous blood.
"It really is so, indeed! Ever since the Shura Master disappeared, the Yunhuang Continent has finally seen another body cultivator who has reached the Body of Wanxiang! Fellow Daoist Yuan, no, Senior Yuan, could you perhaps offer some guidance? Everything within the Vajra Sect is at your disposal!" He Cha grew more excited, bowing deeply to Yuan Ming.
The other Vajra Sect cultivators were also agitated, bowing one after another.
It's no wonder He Cha and the others reacted this way; breaking through to the Body of Wanxiang was extremely difficult for body cultivators. In the thousands of years of the Vajra Sect's history, aside from the founder Vajra Master, no one else had taken this step.
Now that they had finally seen a body cultivator of the Body of Wanxiang, how could the body cultivators of the Vajra Sect not be ecstatic?
"Fellow Daoist He Cha overstates the matter. It's merely by fortune and coincidence that I managed to break through. I really don't have much experience to share, so I will have to pass on giving any guidance," Yuan Ming spoke indifferently.
He Cha's eyes dimmed, he had something to say but stopped himself, not continuing to plead.
"Good, good, good! Our Cloud Desolate Alliance has finally produced a Returning to Void combatant. Fellow Daoist Yuan, you truly keep a low profile!" Tian Jizi laughed heartily, his heart suddenly relaxing.
Many cultivators of the Cloud Desolate Alliance cheered, their morale greatly boosted, especially the disciples of the Moon Sect, all of whom were overjoyed and filled with pride.
Wan Tianren, Gu Xuanyang, and others, however, were ashen-faced, devoid of any hint of color.
Yuan Ming, not only a Half-step Word Witch, had also attained the realm of the Body of Wanxiang in his body cultivation practice. They were immensely frustrated and regretted that they hadn't maintained good relations with such a person when they had the chance.
Yuan Ming paid no attention to the various thoughts going through the minds of those present. He steadied his spirit before once again sending out his divine sense, probing slowly forwards.
Boom, boom, boom!
One black thunderbolt after another assailed him, yet they were easily blocked by the blood light around his body. Confirming that the black thunder could not affect him, he began to unrestrainedly use his divine sense to examine the Demon Thunder Array in detail.
Thanks to Xi Ying granting him possession earlier, his Array Formation Cultivation had increased significantly. Wanting to better counter the Demon World, he had also sought instruction from Qi Ye in the past days, learning numerous array knowledge of the Demon World from him. Combining this new knowledge with his previous understanding, he made rapid progress. Confusions he had before now became clear when pieced together with the array in front of him, leading to sudden enlightenment in many aspects.
This Demon Thunder Array comprises a combination of Demonic Qi, Yin Thunder, Underground Evil Qi, and Space Power. It can automatically lock onto those who affect the array and launch a counterattack. It is more intricate than the Life Creation Array and the Red Blood Sand Formation previously arranged by the Wuyue Sect, making it extremely difficult to break.
However, 'extremely difficult' applies to others, but Yuan Ming has a way.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, how goes it?" Tian Jizi initially did not dare to disturb Yuan Ming, but seeing that he remained silent for a long time, he couldn't help but ask.
"I have figured out the details of this array, but breaking the array is a bit troublesome. I need assistance from you all, especially Alliance Leader Tianji, He Cha, and Fellow Daoist Luo Zhu," Yuan Ming opened his eyes and spoke slowly.
Wan Tianren's face twitched when he heard Yuan Ming only named Tian Jizi, He Cha, and Luo Zhu for help, intentionally omitting him—a Late-stage Nascent Soul cultivator.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, please speak freely, what do we need to do to assist?" Tian Jizi, showing signs of happiness, immediately asked.
He Cha, due to Yuan Ming's previously demonstrated powerful body cultivation, looked at Yuan Ming with a trace of respect in his eyes, while Luo Zhu's look was slightly hesitant, seemingly undecided.
Without further ado, Yuan Ming quietly communicated with the three through whispered transmissions.
Tian Jizi and He Cha quickly nodded, flying off to the left and right sides respectively, leaving only Luo Zhu standing in place.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, the tasks of Tianji Alliance Leader and Fellow Daoist He Cha are not cumbersome, but isn't the task you've assigned to me a bit too much? What merits and abilities do I have that would enable me to seal the Spirit Vein beneath Chang Chun Temple?" Luo Zhu spoke calmly.
"Fellow Daoist Luo is too modest. I, Yuan, know that your Pan Si Island is not only adept at Illusion Techniques and seduction techniques, but also excels in Sealing Skills. Moreover, I am not asking Fellow Daoist Luo to seal the Spirit Vein for a long time; just half a moment will suffice. May I know what you think?" Yuan Ming said softly.
Luo Zhu's heart tightened, and she took a deep look at Yuan Ming.
Pan Si Island indeed inherited an exquisite ancient Sealing Skill, but this matter was extremely secretive and had never been revealed to outsiders. How did the Yuan Ming before her come to know of it!
Yuan Ming didn't speak further, merely quietly watching Luo Zhu, obviously waiting for her response.
"The Spirit Vein under Chang Chun Temple is massively vast and the Spiritual Power extremely robust; even sealing it for just half a moment far exceeds my abilities. This is not shirking the task but truly a lack of strength, so I ask Fellow Daoist Yuan to find someone more capable." Luo Zhu shook her head and said.
"It may indeed be difficult for Fellow Daoist Luo with your cultivation to seal the Spirit Vein here, but for that esteemed and capable senior by your side, such an action shouldn't be too troublesome." Yuan Ming glanced at the purple wooden hairpin on Luo Zhu's head and communicated telepathically.
"You..." Luo Zhu's pupils suddenly shrank.
Yuan Ming looked at Luo Zhu with a smile, not speaking any further.
"Hehe, Fellow Daoist Yuan has good eyesight, to actually discover my existence," an old woman's voice suddenly sounded in his Sea of Consciousness.
The voice contained astonishing Soul Power, causing his Sea of Consciousness to slightly ripple.
"Senior has powerful Soul Power, may I know your esteemed name?" Yuan Ming communicated into the purple hairpin.
"I'm just a wandering ghost in the world, a name is needless to mention, and I dare not claim the title of senior. Since Fellow Daoist Yuan has already broken through to the Body of Wanxiang, let's just address each other as fellow daoists," the old voice said.
"If that is the case, then I'll take the liberty," Yuan Ming replied without reserve through his transmission.
"I'm quite curious, how did Fellow Daoist Yuan discover me?" the old voice inquired.
"I, Yuan, naturally have my own methods," Yuan Ming responded reticently through his transmission.
In reality, it wasn't him who discovered the person's existence, it was Xi Ying.
Previously, when he met Luo Zhu in the Southern Border, he perceived something unusual about her, but failed to pinpoint the source as the purple wooden hairpin.
The hairpin had the effect of shielding the fluctuations of the Divine Soul, and with his current level of Soul Power, Yuan Ming couldn't see through it. Xi Ying, after breaking through to the Spoken Witch Realm, found the hairpin's hidden mechanism on the way to Chang Chun Temple and alerted him via telepathy.
"Hehe, it doesn't matter if Fellow Daoist Yuan doesn't say, but as for sealing the Spirit Vein here, please excuse this old soul's inability," the old voice chuckled and said.
"Of course, I won't force it, but in doing so, I fear your existence would have to be made public," Yuan Ming said unapologetically.
The old voice paused, falling silent for a few breaths before speaking again: "I can lend a hand, but since I am going to help you, if both you and Luo Zhu survive the upcoming battle, Fellow Daoist Yuan will also have to do me a favor."Forcharactersheetsandglossaries,visit*.
"What favor?" Yuan Ming asked.
"It's a trivial matter, simply requiring the help of your Body of Wanxiang. It will not expose Fellow Daoist Yuan to significant risk, and the specifics can wait until the conflict has ended," the old voice replied.
"Agreed," Yuan Ming replied, his mind turning swiftly as he nodded in consent.
"Then we have an agreement," the old voice said, sounding quite pleased.
The exchange between Yuan Ming, Luo Zhu, and the old voice seemed lengthy but actually took no more than a few breaths. Tian Jizi, whose gaze was shifting between them as if he noticed something, was the only other person who might have sensed an anomaly, while everyone else remained unaware.
Without waiting for Tian Jizi to speak, Luo Zhu's figure suddenly flew above the Demon Thunder Array. With a sweep of her arm, four thick yellow Stone Pillars emerged, each covered in dense Array Patterns.
Luo Zhu formed a hand gesture and chanted under her breath, as faint golden spirit light emanated from her, moving unpredictably before converging toward the four Stone Pillars.
The four Stone Pillars lit up with a dazzling yellow light, and Soul Power also seeped from the purple wooden hairpin, dividing and merging into the Stone Pillars.
The next moment, the Array Patterns on the Stone Pillars seemed to come alive, squirming rapidly.
"Go!" Luo Zhu commanded sharply, and the four Stone Pillars shot out, landing at the east, west, south, and north positions of the Demon Thunder Array, swiftly merging into the ground.
A thunderous boom!
Four thick beams of yellow light rose from the positions of the yellow Stone Pillars, shooting straight into the sky, while powerful Sealing Power surged from the depths, spreading rapidly, and the spiritual energy nearby the Demon Thunder Array vanished visibly to the naked eye.
With the Spirit Vein beneath sealed by the four yellow Stone Pillars, the underground evil Qi was also cut off, and the Demon Thunder Array dimmed as a result.

chapters.title: Chapter 746 - 717 Close Quarters Combat
chapters.content:
"All members of the alliance, attack the Demon Array with all your might!"
Upon seeing this, Tian Jizi let out a roar, raised his hand to summon the alliance's Commander's Flag, which flapped furiously in the wind.
At the same time, a glimmering blue light flashed before him as a colossal crystal-clear Round Orb appeared. Water light burst forth from nowhere around it, and standing within the Orb was the figure of a woman clad in Feather Robe—the Chang Chun Temple's sect's treasure, the Canghai Xuan Water Pearl.
Every Nascent Soul cultivator of the Cloud Desolate Alliance feared the counterattacking black thunder, but with Tian Jizi issuing the order publicly, they exchanged looks and still raised their Magic Treasures to strike at the Great Array.
The remaining Core Formation and Foundation Establishment cultivators, seeing this, also took action one after another.
In a moment, innumerable beams of light from Magic Treasures shot out, merging into a colossal torrent that bombarded the Demon Thunder Array.
The Great Array trembled violently under such an onslaught of attacks. However, the thunder lighting upon it also surged wildly as countless black Thunders, thick and thin, shot out towards the members of the Cloud Desolate Alliance.
Tian Jizi rose into the air, his robes billowing around him, his fingers moving swiftly in front of his chest as if spinning a wheel, and he lightly uttered the word "Swiftly."
The ground in front of him cracked with a "crack," opening several fissures over thirty feet long. Water gushed from beneath the ground and instantly congealed into a thick wall of water that stood before the members of the alliance.
The dense black lightning struck the water wall but failed to penetrate it. Instead, it followed the wall down into the ground, sparking a series of explosions.
The alliance members' worry was finally alleviated, and they continued to attack without any hesitation.
Strangely, their attacks, whether Magic Treasure or Spell, could easily pass through the water wall, but the black lightning from the Demon Thunder Array was completely blocked.
"This Canghai Xuan Water Pearl truly holds some mysteries," Yuan Ming nodded slightly.
He did not take action, his gaze locked tightly on the Demon Thunder Array, his Divine Sense having been released long ago, monitoring every minute detail around him.
A few breaths later, his eyes suddenly brightened as he activated the Ju Mang Spirit Technique.
The branches and leaves of the Undying Tree within his Dantian rustled, and dozens of Undying Tree Roots pierced through the void, stabbing into the various nodes of the Demon Thunder Array.
These nodes were precisely where the Array and Space Power merged. The penetration of the roots into these spots disturbed the Array's Spatial Power.
Parts of the Demon Thunder Array where it was pierced by the roots swelled into bulges, small ones spanned a few feet, and large ones even stretched over a dozen yards, emitting the sound like that of muffled thunder.
At this very moment, the faces of the Wu Yue Sect Cultivators behind the Demon Thunder Array changed, murmuring to themselves that the Array seemed quite unreliable. It was just the first clash with the enemy, and it was already showing signs of collapse.
Wu Yue God, Blood Demon Ancestor, Ni Mu, Xi Zheng, and others floated around different parts of the Array, casting Spells to stabilize the Demon Thunder Array. However, the attacks from the Cloud Desolate Alliance grew increasingly fierce. The Array's Earthly Evil and Spatial forces began to unravel, and the tremors of the Array became more intense, slowly showing the verge of collapse.
"Who could have thought that someone in the Cloud Desolate Alliance could recognize a Demon World Array and so quickly see through the secrets of the Moluo Evil Thunder Array! But the time was too hasty, and the setup of the Array was too rough, only able to unleash less than half of its power..." Blood Demon Ancestor deeply resented, looking towards the top of Chaotian Peak.
Countless Star Powers descended from the sky, almost forming a column of starlight, continuously merging into the Breaking Realm Transfer Array, with the transfer speed much faster than before.
However, opening a spatial channel connected to the Demon World required a vast amount of Star Power, and filling the requirements for breaking through the realm would still take several days.
"Strive to delay the time, by all means, to ensure we secure the activation of the Breaking Realm Transfer Array!" Blood Demon Ancestor sent a message to the other Nascent Soul cultivators, his hands moving in rapid gestures.
Right at that moment, a dazzling Golden Sun suddenly shone from behind Chang Chun Temple, its luminescence penetrating the Array's light screen which was unable to block the rays.
"Not good!" Blood Demon Ancestor's expression changed abruptly.
To resist the Cloud Desolate Alliance's attack, he had concentrated all of the Moluo Evil Thunder Array's power to the front mountain here, delegating the Array's controllers to this location as well, with only very few personnel left behind.
He quickly ordered to mobilize people to reinforce that position.
Outside the Great Array behind Chang Chun Temple, He Cha stood in the void, radiating a blazing golden light reminiscent of the midday sun.
His skin, once full of wrinkles and ridges, tightened up, becoming smooth. The old tree-like complexion turned from yellow to gold, looking like the purest gold, emanating a glazelike shine, and his stature grew considerably taller. Muscle upon muscle swelled robustly, and the sound of his tendons cracking echoed through the air.
In the blink of an eye, He Cha transformed from a withered old man into a huge golden giant, the peak aura of the Tongqiao Body revealing itself without any doubt. A spiky golden mace appeared in his hand.
He Cha vanished in a flash, reappearing beside the Moluo Evil Thunder Array in the next moment. The golden mace burst forth with sun-like golden light, striking down ferociously upon the Array.
A loud boom echoed as the Moluo Evil Thunder Array dented deeply.
The Array's light screen was unusually tough, taut but unbreakable, yet thick Demonic Qi was squeezed out, rapidly thinning the once substantial screen.
The Blood Demon Ancestor had focused all the black lightning to the front, so when faced with He Cha's assault, there was no thunder to counterattack.
The few Wu Yue Sect Cultivators behind Chang Chun Temple turned pale with fright and hurried to cast their Spells.
He Cha bellowed a thunderous roar, his entire body flared up with dazzling golden light and Qi-Blood, congealing behind him into a massive golden-red giant figure—it was his Blood Gang True Body.
Unlike Yuan Ming's Blood Gang True Body, the golden-red giant not only exuded Qi-Blood Power but also radiated strong Mana waves.
"Secret Skill, Vajra Triple Strike!"
The golden-red giant lunged forward, delivering three consecutive strikes in midair, each blow more powerful than the last; the second was twice as strong as the first, and by the third, the power had quadrupled!
The Moluo Evil Thunder Array, already on the brink of collapse, finally could no longer hold and cracked open a wide hole.
Wulu, following Yuan Ming's guidance, used the Heavenly Escape Stone Talisman to turn invisible nearby, and immediately flew through the hole, heading straight for Chaotian Peak.
The last time he had sneaked in with Yuan Ming, the Demon Array shrouding Chaotian Peak was nowhere to be seen, leaving the towering Chaotian Peak standing silently without a hint of protection.
Delighted, Wulu headed straight for the summit of Chaotian Peak, yet dared not fly too fast.
With the mountain's Great Array broken, the functioning of the entire Moluo Evil Thunder Array became even more strenuous.
"Fellow Daoist Blood Demon, the array can't hold up any longer, proceed with the plan," the Wu Yue God said to the Blood Demon Ancestor in a deep voice via telepathy.
The Blood Demon Ancestor nodded silently, flipping his hand to produce a black array plate, flickering with numerous black thunders.
A trace of regret flashed in the eyes of the Blood Demon Ancestor, but then he fell silent and forcefully crushed the array plate.
The Moluo Evil Thunder Array, on the verge of collapse, suddenly brightened intensely and expanded outward, knocking off all the incoming magic treasures from the Cloud Desolate Alliance. The alliance members were shocked, and many instinctively retreated.
But at that very moment, the Moluo Evil Thunder Array rapidly shrank and disappeared from everyone's sight.
At the same time, atop Chaotian Peak, a black Demon Array spanning dozens of feet appeared, engulfing the summit within it, with numerous black thunders flickering inside — it was the disappeared Moluo Evil Thunder Array gone miniature.
This scaled-down Moluo Evil Thunder Array was shiny black and seemed more refined and stable than before, showing no signs of its prior damage.
By this time, Wulu had already reached the vicinity of Chaotian Peak, poised to strike the Breaking Realm Transfer Array, but stopped as the summit was suddenly enveloped by the Moluo Evil Thunder Array.
After a brief contemplation, he didn't stay or try to break the array and turned to fly back outside.
With the Demon Array broken, the cultivators of the Cloud Desolate Alliance were overcome with joy and rushed towards the Wu Yue Sect disciples.
To combat the Wu Yue Sect more effectively, the members of the Cloud Desolate Alliance had also undergone some training during these days, and no longer charged haphazardly as before. They split into three tiers from bottom to top.
The first tier consisted of the most Qi Refinement Stage Cultivators, the second tier comprised Foundation Establishment Cultivators, and the third—Core Formation Stage cultivators—launched attacks simultaneously.
The attacks of the Qi Refinement Stage Cultivators mostly involved spells, and while individually weak, the cumulative effect of their numbers was formidable. The Foundation Establishment Cultivators deployed magic artifacts and spirit beasts as support, and the relatively fewer Core Formation Stage cultivators made precise attacks with magic treasures.
The attacks of the three tiers were clearly layered yet united as one, moving forward in a mighty wave.T^ex*t* a#cq.u!ire*d from% M.|.V%|[email protected] %&#YR.#
The Wu Yue Sect Cultivators hurried to meet the battle, with numerous magic artifacts and spells colliding in the void, causing earth-shattering booms and half of the sky to be awash with scattered light.
The Wu Yue Sect Cultivators were well-trained and adept at forming arrays to counter attacks. This advantage had given them superiority in previous battles against the Cloud Desolate Alliance, often allowing them to win against greater numbers. But now, the Cloud Desolate Alliance was equally organized, and the Wu Yue Sect no longer held the upper hand. They were forced to retreat under the barrage of attacks, and their originally neat formations started disintegrating into disorder.
"Lord Wu Yue God, the situation looks grim. We should make our move too," Ni Mu moved closer to the Wu Yue God and suggested via telepathy.
The Nascent Souls of the Wu Yue Sect and the affiliated sect's Nascent Soul cultivators also gathered nearby, looking towards the Wu Yue God.
The Wu Yue God's face was indifferent, and he glanced at the Blood Demon Ancestor but remained silent.
Just as the Blood Demon Ancestor was about to say something, Xue Li staggered out of Chang Chun Temple, holding a jar of wine in his hand and occasionally taking a swig.
However, the aura on his body was so restrained that he seemed unremarkable.
"There's no need," the Blood Demon Ancestor, noticing Xue Li's appearance, let out a sigh of relief, and then pulled out a blood-colored orb and tossed it towards the ground.
Yuan Ming, who was observing the actions of the high-level cultivators of the Wu Yue Sect, caught the Blood Demon Ancestor's movement. Although he didn't know the purpose, he would not stand idle while the spell was being cast and immediately activated the Ju Mang Spirit Technique.
Seven or eight Undying Tree Roots pierced the void, emerging near the blood-colored orb and entangling it.
What happened next was unexpected!
The blood-colored orb suddenly transformed into an illusory Blood Shadow, breaking free from the grasp of the Undying Tree Roots and continuing to shoot downward.
The speed of the Blood Shadow increased several fold and it vanished into the ground in an instant.
Just as Yuan Ming was bewildered, the ground beneath began to quiver and thin streams of blood light oozed out, quickly thickening into a massive blood-colored vortex.
One by one, black-red figures leaped out, nearly identical, covered in black-red scales with arms completely ossified resembling large cleavers, emanating waves of Demonic Qi, revealed as a horde of refining corpses.
The blood-colored vortex teemed with figures and in the blink of an eye, ten thousand had sprung forth.
Though turned into refining corpses, the faces of these beings were faintly recognizable, with nearly half startlingly appearing to be Central Plains people!

chapters.title: Chapter 747 - 718: Break Even
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming's Divine Sense swept across, dimly recognizing a few of the refining corpses identities—indeed, they were the Cloud Desolate Alliance's cultivators previously sent to Zhao Country to block the advance of the Wu Yue Sect's army.
These refining corpses were evidently mostly crafted from the cultivator corpses collected by the Wu Yue Sect.
Before Yuan Ming and others could react, thousands of refining corpses had already pounced over, forcing the Cloud Desolate Alliance's army to divert some of their manpower to deal with these black-red refining corpses.
In a certain battle group, a Foundation Establishment cultivator who was a large man took the lead, slashing at one of the black-red refining corpses with all his might.
With a "splurch," the refining corpse's right arm was chopped off.
However, the black-red refining corpse didn't care at all, its legs bent and it instantly leapt forward several feet. Its left hand effortlessly pierced through the Foundation Establishment big man's Protective Clothing and into his lower abdomen.
"You..." The man's mouth sprayed fresh blood, his face filled with disbelief.
The black-red refining corpse swung its arm upwards, almost splitting the man's body into two halves, dead beyond the shadow of a doubt.
At the same time, a blood-colored vortex on the ground shot out streams of Blood Light, merging into the body of the refining corpse, rapidly healing the broken bones at its right arm.
The black-red refining corpse continued to advance, searching for its next target.
Similar scenarios played out repeatedly, with the assistance of the blood light from this blood-colored vortex, these refining corpses, even if their arms and legs were severed, or even if they were sliced in two, as long as they weren't blown into fragments, could quickly recover and continue attacking as if nothing had happened.
Although these refining corpses possessed little spiritual intelligence, their fearless ferocity meant that ordinary Foundation Establishment cultivators couldn't stand against them, with a few powerful ones even matching the Core Formation cultivators blow for blow.
With the help of these black-red refining corpses, the pressure on the Wu Yue Sect cultivators suddenly decreased, and they quickly resisted the onslaught of the Cloud Desolate Alliance.
Seeing this scene, the seasoned Nascent Soul cultivators of the Cloud Desolate Alliance were about to take action, but they were stopped by a telepathic message from Tian Jizi.
"Do not act rashly, our target is to deal with Lord Nether Moon God and the Blood Demon Ancestor, we must not be reckless!"
Hearing this, they had no choice but to halt their movements.
Yuan Ming's gaze swept over the enormous blood-colored vortex, simultaneously releasing his Divine Sense into it, a trace of surprise flashing in his eyes.
This vortex was filled with an immensely abundant Qi-Blood Power, and its source seemed to extend to the very depths of the ground. Even with his Divine Sense, he couldn't probe its limit.
"Could this be some kind of transportation Forbidden?" he muttered to himself.
"This is not a Forbidden, but a Blood Spirit Vein," Xi Ying said.
"A Blood Spirit Vein? There is such a Spirit Vein?" Yuan Ming was startled.
"The Spirit Veins of the world are not limited to the Five Elements Spiritual Veins, there are also Yin Spirit Veins, Yang Spirit Veins, Blood Spirit Veins, Thunder Spirit Veins, and so on, just extremely rare. This Blood Spirit Vein looks quite substantial, having formed a Gathering Spirit Blood River, which is indeed uncommon," Xi Ying explained.
"Gathering Spirit Blood River, could it be similar to a Gathering Spirit Object like the Gathering Spirit Tree?" Yuan Ming asked.
"Exactly. Once transformed into a Gathering Spirit Blood River, this Blood Spirit Vein can move its location freely and won't be confined to one place," Xi Ying replied.
Atop a low hill in the distance of the battlefield, a woman in green robes stood in the void, it was Xi Qian, with Huazhi standing next to her.
Xi Qian had just awakened, her Mana unstable, hence Xi Ying had not let her join the battle.
Yuan Ming, concerned that the Wu Yue Sect might have some hidden tricks, instructed Huazhi to stay close and protect Xi Qian.
"This Gathering Spirit Blood River is interesting, Little Huazhi, want to go and explore it with me?" Xi Qian suggested.
"Okay." Huazhi was also interested in the blood-colored vortex.
Xi Qian raised her hand to Huazhi's shoulder, a thick layer of green light emerging on her body, then they flashed into the ground.
Yuan Ming glanced at the location where Xi Qian and Huazhi were, and said nothing.
Exploring the peculiarities of this Gathering Spirit Blood River might be good for the two of them.
"Regardless of what kind of Spirit Vein it is, Master, we should make a move quickly. That Tian Jizi is overly cautious, merely squandering our chance to fight!" Vajra said.
Before Yuan Ming could respond, Vajra had already transformed into a Golden Shadow and dashed out, heading straight for two Nascent Soul cultivators dressed in Southern Border attire—Zi Lei and Chi Xiao from the Double Immortals Sect.
"Vajra, do not act recklessly!" Yuan Ming urgently shouted.
However, Vajra moved like lightning, already arriving in front of the two from the Double Immortals Sect. His arms suddenly emitted loud "crack" sounds, abruptly bulking up as he smashed forth in the void.
With a "thundering" sound,
Two substantive gusts of fist wind swept across, wherever it passed, the void emitted bursts of thundering sounds.
Just then, a black long saber tore through the void, ruthlessly chopping toward Vajra.
The black saber was three feet long, with a ferocious ghost head on the handle and nine large copper rings embedded along the spine of the blade, slicing through the air. The potent Sword Energy formed an airtight field of air, easily shredding Vajra's fist winds, enveloping his body within it,
Yuan Ming's brow twitched, the aura of this black ghost head saber not inferior to his Ghostly Soul White Bone Banner. In terms of killing power, it was even greater than the White Bone Banner, and the saber even contained a malicious aura that shot towards the heavens.The latest chapters are always available first on *.
"Could this be the Heavenly Ghost Magic Saber?" he wondered internally.
Based on the information previously provided by Xi Ying, the Wu Yue Sect had three major sect-defining Spiritual Treasures, with the Ghostly Soul White Bone Banner being one of them, and this black long saber likely another Spiritual Treasure, the Heavenly Ghost Magic Saber.
In the midst of these thoughts, Yuan Ming's figure flickered and disappeared, then reappeared near Vajra, throwing a punch.
With a "boom," oscillations burst forth in the void ahead, a palace-sized blood-colored fist shadow shot forth, striking upon the Sword Energy field of the Heavenly Ghost Magic Saber, ruthlessly shattering it.
The blood-colored fist shadow transformed into a giant blood-colored hand, grabbing Vajra and flying backwards.
As Lord Nether Moon God's expression darkened, the Heavenly Ghost Magic Saber's dark light surged, slashing toward the giant blood hand.
However, Yuan Ming was quicker, his foot stomping the void.
Boom!
A blood-colored phantom leg appeared out of nowhere, carrying a force that could move mountains and seas, stomping toward several Wu Yue Sect Cultivators nearby.
The Nascent Soul cultivators of Wu Yue Sect below were about to scatter and escape, but a tremendous force arrived in an instant.
Their bodies felt as if they were being crushed by a giant peak, completely immobilized, and they were about to be smashed into a pulp by the blood-colored leg phantom.
"Turn the phantom leg into the intangible!" Lord Nether Moon God hadn't expected Yuan Ming to act so swiftly and, unable to pursue, he pointed in the air and commanded.
The blood-colored leg phantom suddenly dispersed, turning into scattered blood lights.
The pressure on the several Nascent Soul cultivators lifted, and they scrambled away as if they had been granted amnesty.
Yuan Ming, along with Vajra, retreated to his original position, looked at the scattered blood lights, and muttered to himself, "So that's how it is, the 'speak and follow' of the Spoken Witch works this way."
Now that his Divine Soul Power had recovered, his senses were much sharper than before. Just as the Nether Moon God had uttered the Magic Words, his Divine Soul Power had silently merged into the blood-colored leg phantom.
The soul power of the Spoken Witch had the Divine Skill to control others' mana, even objects, and could cause the blood-colored leg phantom to disintegrate from within.
The combat between Yuan Ming and the Nether Moon God was incredibly fast. It was only at this moment that Tian Jizi and the others reacted, hurrying forward.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, are you all right?" Tian Jizi asked.
"It's nothing." Yuan Ming shook his head.
Tian Jizi sighed in relief. Right now, Yuan Ming was the only one with Returning to Void Combat Power in the Cloud Desolate Alliance; he couldn't afford any mishaps.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, in your opinion, given the current situation, how should we proceed?" he asked through a transmission.
Although the Cloud Desolate Alliance was gaining the upper hand in the overall battle, the situation for them was not so clear.
If it came to general Nascent Soul cultivators, the Cloud Desolate Alliance had more, but Wu Yue Sect had two with Returning to Void Combat Power—Nether Moon God and Blood Demon Ancestor. Yuan Ming could at most handle one, and without a good strategy, acting rashly would definitely lead to a big loss, which was why Tian Jizi had hesitated.
Just then, Xi Ying flew over from behind and landed in front of everyone.
"Leave the Nether Moon God to me!"
"Sunset Envoy, you..." Tian Jizi was stunned.
"Then I'll leave it to you," Yuan Ming nodded and said.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, are you sure it's okay?" Tian Jizi asked through a transmission.
He knew Xi Ying was a high-level soul cultivator with great strength, but how could he possibly match the Nether Moon God?
Before Yuan Ming could speak, Xi Ying no longer hid his soul power, and the vast soul power of the Word Witch Realm burst forth.
"A Word Witch! How is that possible! Who are you?" The Nether Moon God was taken aback, staring fixedly at Xi Ying.
Soul cultivation in Yunhuang Continent had very few inheritances, especially high-level soul cultivators, most of whom came from Wu Yue Sect. The methods leaked out were only to the Sleeping Witch Realm, and he had never disclosed the way to breakthrough to Word Witch. How could there possibly be another Word Witch on Yunhuang Continent!
"You don't need to know," Xi Ying said indifferently, his third eye lighting up with a dazzling golden light, turning a few dozen steps around into a sea of gold.
The sea of gold was filled with flames-like soul power, which burnt away the Divine Sense of the Nether Moon God as he approached, making it impossible for him to investigate what Xi Ying was doing inside.
A magnificent golden pillar of light shot out from the sea of gold, flying straight towards the Nether Moon God like a giant arrow.
"Insect tricks!" The Nether Moon God snorted coldly, and billowing dark energy surged from his body, colliding with the golden pillar.
The fierce fluctuation of soul power exploded, yet they were evenly matched.
Xi Zheng, watching from a distance, remained calm, but his heart surged with astonishment.
Yuan Ming was a Body of Wanxiang Body Cultivator, and his own daughter had also advanced to Word Witch without so much as a whisper, no wonder the two had been so articulate and confident that they could challenge Wu Yue Sect and the Demon World.
Xi Zheng quickly calmed down; the current situation of Wu Yue Sect and the Demon World seemed increasingly complex and illusory, following them down one path might not necessarily be the best choice.
Not far away, Ni Mu watched expressionless, but his eyes flickered continually.
He and Yuan Ming and Xi Ying had faced each other many times before, being old rivals. Initially, inside Shura Palace, his cultivation was far above Yuan's and Xi's, but over these days, Yuan Ming and Xi Ying had made leaps in strength, entering the top realms of Yunhuang Continent.
Although Ni Mu's power had also improved, it was far less compared to Yuan and Xi.
His eyes narrowed, and he clenched his fist secretly.
"Big brother..." A stunning woman under Ni Mu's command looked over, murmuring in surprise.
Not only the high ranks of Wu Yue Sect, but also the high-level cultivators of the Cloud Desolate Alliance were greatly astonished at this moment.
Yuan Ming, being a Body of Wanxiang, was already shocking enough, but now another Word Witch had emerged. Could it be that Xi Ying was the true Nether Moon God?
"So that's why Xi Ying, being a Word Witch, was able to detect my presence. This is good; with another Word Witch to assist, that matter will be even more secure," an aged voice echoed in Luo Zhu's Sea of Consciousness from inside the purple wooden hairpin.
Lou Zhu breathed a sigh of relief, feeling somewhat frightened; the two people she had met in the Southern Border turned out to be such terrifying beings. Fortunately, she had always been on good terms with them and had not offended them.
Tian Jizi then breathed a long sigh of relief. Since Xi Ying was a Word Witch, he naturally could measure up to the Nether Moon God.
With Xi Ying's participation, the Cloud Desolate Alliance was now on par with the enemy in terms of high-end combat power.
However, he couldn't help but feel a bit resentful that Yuan Ming and Xi Ying had hidden their true strength, causing him to worry needlessly for so long.
"With Lord Nether Moon God and Sunset Envoy on our side, we must win this battle. Attack!" Tian Jizi quickly adjusted his emotions and shouted.
The Nascent Soul cultivators of the Cloud Desolate Alliance had already been eager to fight. Hearing his words, they immediately transformed into beams of tunneling light and shot forward.

chapters.title: Chapter 748 - 719 Verbal Clash
chapters.content:
Unlike the exuberance on the opposite side, the Nascent Soul cultivators of the Wu Yue Sect had somber expressions, all looking towards the Wu Yue God and the Blood Demon Ancestor.
Having clashed with Xi Ying, the Wu Yue God was now suspended hundreds of zhang in the air facing Xi Ying, his face indifferent as he glanced at the Blood Demon Ancestor without speaking.
"To arms!" the Blood Demon Ancestor commanded with a wave of his hand and a low shout.
The hearts of the Nascent Soul existences of the Wu Yue Sect slightly steadied as they met the charge head-on.
After a brief standoff, the Wu Yue God and Xi Ying once again used their Soul Cultivator techniques to engage in fierce battle.
For a time, the sky was filled with colliding colours of light, shaking the heavens with rolling thunder.
Yuan Ming did not make a move, instead silently watching the impenetrable black Demon Array at the peak of Chaotian Peak.
When He Cha had earlier broken through the Mountain Protection Demon Formation, Wulu should have followed his orders and infiltrated Chang Chun Temple in advance, but had he managed to reach the top of Chaotian Peak?
He quickly withdrew his gaze and put away his thoughts, turning his attention back to the battlefield.
In the current situation, the battle of cultivators below the level of Nascent Soul was not the focus, it was the contest of those above the Nascent Soul level that mattered.
The troublesome Nascent Soul cultivators of the Wu Yue Sect were Xi Zheng, Ni Mu, Luo Yongqi, and a giant man standing nine zhang tall with a build like an iron tower.
Before the second clash, Yuan Ming had thoroughly learned about the formidable figures in the Wu Yue Sect and knew that this iron tower of a man was Xiang Bai, the Sect Master of the Western Regions Overlord Sect, at the peak of the Tongqiao Body.
The Cloud Desolate Alliance had done their homework for this great battle and had already devised countermeasures for these tough characters of the Wu Yue Sect.Thе mоst up‑tо‑dаtе vеrsiоn is оn М4VLЕМР4YR.
Tian Jizi blocked Ni Mu, Wan Tianren dealt with Xi Zheng just as in the previous battle in Zhao Country, Luo Zhu was responsible for Luo Yongqi, and as for Xiang Bai's opponent, it was naturally He Cha.
Having clashed multiple times, they were well acquainted with each other. Although the fight was intense, it was hard to determine the winner in a short time, and they couldn't afford to be distracted.
As for the other Nascent Soul cultivators, the Cloud Desolate Alliance had the advantage in numbers and soon took the upper hand.
"Eh, there's someone who hasn't joined the fight!" Yuan Ming's gaze swept over the battlefield, landing on Xue Li nearby, confirming that he had never seen this person.
Xue Li continued to drink by himself, his eyes looking towards the distant horizon as if he hadn't noticed the Wu Yue Sect's disadvantaged position.
A flicker of surprise crossed Yuan Ming's eyes as he activated his Divine Sense to probe, but as soon as it touched Xue Li's body, it was absorbed by some force.
"What is this!" His expression grew tense.
In that instant, it seemed as if a giant maw's shadow flashed over Xue Li, making the hairs on his back involuntarily stand on end.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, be careful, this man is not simple," a voice appeared in Yuan Ming's Sea of Consciousness.
"Wulu? Were you unable to infiltrate the top of Chaotian Peak?" Yuan Ming's gaze imperceptibly shifted as he responded telepathically.
"Alas, the black Demon Array retracted too quickly, and I couldn't keep up," Wulu said with some regret.
"It doesn't matter. As long as we kill the Wu Yue Sect and the Blood Demon Ancestor, the black Demon Array will naturally collapse. By the way, you just said that this man with blood-red hair is not simple; did you discover something?" Yuan Ming asked.
"When I approached to investigate this person using the Heavenly Escape Stone Talisman just now, he radiated an extremely pure aura of Demonic Qi that was beyond the level someone like you or me, who is only tainted with Demonic Qi, could achieve, and he doesn't seem to be from the Yunhuang Continent," Wulu explained.
"Not a cultivator from Yunhuang Continent, could he be from the Demon Realm?" Yuan Ming said.
"Very likely," Wulu spoke with a heavy tone.
"If he really is from the Demon Realm, this person's strength is probably extraordinary," Yuan Ming said slowly.
With his and Xi Ying's capabilities, they could certainly handle Wu Yue God and the Blood Demon Ancestor, the two great Returning to Void combatants. Now, with this man with an aura of Demonic Qi, the situation was getting more troubling.
"Brother Yuan, don't worry, I'll handle the Blood Demon Ancestor," Wulu said.
"Are you confident about handling the Blood Demon Ancestor? His cultivation has already reached the mid-stage Returning Void," Yuan Ming communicated telepathically.
"My current situation is a result of the Blood Demon Ancestor's doings. Regardless of my confidence, I must kill him, even if it means perishing together. Otherwise, my Dao heart cannot be at peace," Wulu said resolutely.
"Alright, since you insist, then the Blood Demon Ancestor is yours," seeing Wulu's determination, Yuan Ming refrained from saying anything further.
As Yuan Ming and Wulu exchanged telepathic messages, the Blood Demon Ancestor also appeared beside Xue Li, who was still drinking, and respectfully said, "Lord Xue Li, the enemy is strong and we may not be their match. We can only ask for your help."
"This Cloud Desolate Continent is but a corner of the Chuyun Realm, and yet you can't even subdue the cultivators here, how will you assist our Demon Clan in conquering the entire Chuyun Realm in the future? It's truly a waste of the Blood Soul Demon Crystal gifted by Lord Demon," Xue Li said, putting down his wine jar with a displeased expression.
"I am ashamed. The divine skills contained within the Blood Soul Demon Crystal are too powerful, and with my current level of cultivation, I'm unable to master them," the Blood Demon Ancestor bowed and said.
"Well, I suppose I'll take it as an opportunity to stretch my muscles. However, I'll only deal with Yuan Ming and that Spoken Witch; the rest of the Nascent Soul rabble are your responsibility," Xue Li said indifferently.
"Many thanks, Lord Xue Li," the Blood Demon Ancestor's face lit up with joy.
Xue Li waved his hand, and the next moment, his figure streaked out like lightning, instantly appearing before Yuan Ming like a specter. In his hand was a blood-colored mace over a man tall, covered with fierce spikes and bursting with astonishing demonic qi fluctuations.
With a "boom," a blood-colored flame several zhang high surged on the mace, slamming down toward Yuan Ming's head with an overwhelming momentum.
A tremendous force approached, ripples visible to the naked eye spread through the air within a radius of several dozen zhang, emitting an unpleasant screeching noise as if it would be crushed.
All this may seem long-winded, but from Xue Li finishing his words to launching a swift attack in front of Yuan Ming, the whole process took less than half a breath's time.
Yuan Ming had been covertly on guard against Xue Li, utterly unflustered as he threw an upward punch.
A "sizzle" of ripping through the air!
Once again, a huge elephant leg shadow shot out, much more solid than the previous leg shadow, heading straight for the blood-colored mace.
The two unparalleled forces collided ferociously, creating a blood-colored hurricane that soared into the sky, roaring and sweeping in all directions.
The violent sound of air exploding and spiritual pressure prompted nearby combatants to temporarily cease fighting and flee into the distance, not daring to let the blood-colored hurricane approach.
After the strike, both Yuan Ming and Xue Li's bodies shook, each retreating several steps before stabilizing.
"Demonic qi! And this style of Body Cultivation Divine Skills, you are cultivating our Demon Clan's techniques?" Xue Li's expression was not one of shock, but rather, quite excited.
Yuan Ming didn't speak. The blood light around his body surged, forming a blood-colored giant elephant behind him with a thick trunk lashing toward Xue Li.
Secret Skill, Devil Elephant Strangling Sky Technique!
A figure appeared in mid-air, none other than the Blood Demon Ancestor.
The Blood Soul Demon Crystal at his brow "buzzed," shining brightly, and a bolt of blood-colored thunder shot out from it, slashing straight at Yuan Ming's head.
Yuan Ming's brows slightly knit, and he changed the direction of the blood-colored elephant trunk to sweep toward the blood-colored lightning.
At that moment, a blood-colored whirlwind over a dozen zhang tall appeared out of nowhere above Yuan Ming's head, colliding with the blood-colored lightning.
With a "pfft" sound, the thunder and whirlwind both dissipated into thin air.
The whirlwind's spatial fluctuations arose, revealing Wulu's figure.
"It's you!" The Blood Demon Ancestor's face changed color.
"Blood Demon Ancestor, it has been a long time," Wulu said, her eyes as cold as ice and snow.
Yuan Ming's eyes brightened. In just a few short days, Wulu had made significant progress in her strength, able to withstand an attack from the Blood Demon Ancestor. No wonder she was confident in facing the Blood Demon Ancestor.
"Who told you to get involved, get lost!" Xue Li waved his sleeve, a burst of blood light hit the Blood Demon Ancestor, blasting him away.
Yuan Ming and Wulu were also affected, with Wulu being knocked away, while the Blood Gang Power around Yuan Ming merely trembled slightly before returning to normal. He raised his eyes to Xue Li...
Meanwhile, the battle between Wu Yue God and Xi Ying, using Soul Cultivation techniques, had spanned several rounds with no clear winner.
Xi Ying pointed at her forehead with one hand, muttering words under her breath, as several Three-legged Golden Crows flew out from her forehead, circling around her with outstretched wings and screeching.
"So it was you who made a move within Yuhua City." Wu Yue God came to a realization, the spirit light in his eyes flickering, attempting to see through Xi Ying's disguise and catch a glimpse of her true face.
However, Xi Ying used Soul Power to mask her features and was naturally not ready to reveal herself at this time.
As the leader of the Wu Yue Sect, Wu Yue God knew the birthdates and eight characters of all the high-level members of the sect. As the daughter of Xi Zheng, Xi Ying was no exception. Once recognized by Wu Yue God, she would inevitably be subject to the Evil Curse Kill attack.
Therefore, Xi Ying promptly pointed with her hand, and the Golden Crows nearby flapped their wings together. The temperature around them soared abruptly as countless fiery wheels the size of grindstones emerged from the wings of the Golden Crows, roaring towards Wu Yue God.
The brilliant golden color tainted half of the sky, the dazzling light even making the other nearby combatants squint slightly, casting some attention this way.
However, Wu Yue God seemed unaffected by the golden light, looking towards Xi Ying with a faint gaze. He was surrounded by countless scarlet Demon Flames, from which an extremely cold wind emerged, encasing the flames and meeting the golden fire head-on.
In an instant, the explosions sounded like the roaring of the Nine Heavens' thunder, and the two flames containing completely different powers collided fiercely in mid-air. It was as if a high wall was erected between heaven and earth, one side bathed in the divine realm's rising golden light, the other side ablaze with the demonic realm's raging blood flames.
Under the cover of the blood flames, dark evil ghosts revealed their shapes, opening their fang-filled mouths and issuing chilling howls towards the other side of the "high wall," the Golden Crow Fire.
The invisible sound waves instantly pierced through the defensive line of the Golden Crow Fire, clearing out a clean area in the sky, which the Demon Flames took advantage of to surge forward. The dark evil ghosts followed suit, pressing towards Xi Ying like a ceaseless tide.
"Sound Expulsion Silence," Xi Ying's lips parted slightly, emitting a phrase imbued with Soul Power.
At the same time, the Transformed Golden Crows by her side also moved forward with the Golden Flames. Their beaks grew sharply, spitting out more Essence Fire to entangle with the evil ghosts.
Under the control of the Spoken Witchcraft, all the evil ghosts at this moment were as if their necks were being squeezed, unable to make any sound, flailing wildly as they mingled with the Demon Flames, avoiding the invasion and burning of the Golden Crow Fire.

chapters.title: Chapter 749 - 720: Recognizing the Identity
chapters.content:
"No spreading of wings," Wu Yue God said indifferently, also employing the power of "speak and follow."
When Spoken Witch performed "speak and follow," the words uttered were not just voiced through his throat. Each phrase, filled with Soul Power, would resonate in everyone's hearts, even without sound.
The next instant, all the wings of the Transformed Golden Crows stiffened at their sides, unable to move. Their bodies, soaring through the skies, abruptly plummeted and were caught by an Evil Ghost, which opened its bloody maw and bit into the neck of a Golden Crow, trying to tear off a piece of flesh.
"Claws hard, beak sharp," Xi Ying immediately said.
As the words ended, the Golden Crow grasped by the ghost struggled violently. Its sharp beak pecked directly at the eyes of the Evil Ghost, forcing it to release its grip and lean back, yet it stubbornly refused to let go of the wings it held.
Then, the Golden Crow instantly flapped its three legs, like daggers, their sharp claws easily tearing through the Evil Ghost's arms, freeing itself. It then transformed into Golden Light and flew back to the brow of Xi Ying.
However, these Evil Ghosts were not physical beings; they were essentially Divine Soul Transformations of Wu Yue God. The wounds appeared severe but were swiftly repaired by the Soul Power Wu Yue God emitted, and the lost arms regrew.
After this exchange, both sides seemed evenly matched, but Xi Ying sharply noticed that the aura of the Golden Crow returning to her Sea of Consciousness had weakened significantly, seemingly having permanently lost some of its power.
Wu Yue God suddenly shook his head and slapped downwards with his hand.
Endless black smoke rose up, gathering in the sky to form a massive hand that blotted out the sun. The multitudes of Golden Flames dispatched by Xi Ying now seemed like flickering flames within the palm, failing even to fully illuminate the gigantic hand.
Xi Ying opened her mouth, and the Golden Dragon Scissors burst forth, transforming into two golden dragons, instantly breaking through the heavens and flashing past the giant hand from outside.
The next instant, the giant hand cracked into pieces as though it were cut in half by someone. The fingers and the palm split apart and in a blink, transformed into six giant pythons, entangling the Golden Dragon Scissors in combat.
Wu Yue God slightly furrowed his brow, apparently recognizing the Golden Dragon Scissors and feeling somewhat puzzled.
Xi Ying showed no hesitation, her hands quickly forming a spell. From the brow came forth two more Golden Crows. Although unable to spread their wings, they merged into one and transformed into a blazing sun that slowly rose into the sky.
Under the scorching sun, the skin of the giant pythons, transformed from the Great Black Sky God Palm, quickly began to emit white smoke. In the blink of an eye, they were about to dissolve completely under the sunlight, just as had happened in Yuhua City.
But at this moment, Wu Yue God suddenly formed a spell with his hands. The Evil Ghosts within the Blood Flames gathered together. Their forms blurred and melded into each other, aggregating upward like mud into a hundred-foot-tall Cyclops Evil Ghost, which opened its mouth and unleashed a silent roar at the suspended "Sun."
Xi Ying inwardly cursed the situation, immediately forming a spell trying to call back the "Sun."
But just then, the Cyclops Evil Ghost suddenly inhaled deeply, its chest bulging as a powerful suction force formed a vortex before its tooth-filled maw, continuously pulling at the "Sun" transformed from the Golden Crow, directing its flames into the mouth of the Evil Ghost.
The purely Yang and utterly rigid flames of the Golden Crow, which could burn all filth, once inside the mouth of the Evil Ghost, seemed as ineffective as false flames, completely powerless.
Xi Ying's face paled slightly, aware that Divine Soul Transformation was akin to a form of soul splitting, and losing any part of it could severely impact a Soul Cultivator's Divine Soul.
And if devoured, with Wu Yue God's skills, it might not be impossible for him to obtain some of Xi Ying's memories!
Xi Ying immediately tried to forcibly recall the Golden Crow, when Wu Yue God spoke again:
"The soul appears and does not return."
As the words ended, Xi Ying immediately felt the connection with the "Sun" transformed from the Golden Crow being blocked by an inexplicable force, temporarily unable to recall it.
Xi Ying slammed her hands together furiously, then pulled at the void vertically. A fluctuation emerged momentarily, but upon closer examination, there was nothing between her palms, no spirit light appeared.
Wu Yue God also noticed Xi Ying's movements. Just as he looked up, he saw Xi Ying's arms suddenly shake, pushing outward with her palms, the invisible fluctuation flashed and was gone.
The next instant, Wu Yue God felt an intense pain in his soul. At this same moment, a large wound, as big as a bowl, appeared on the neck of the Cyclops Evil Ghost in the Blood Flames, as if pierced by a spear.
And at the edge of the wound, tiny golden flames burned intensely, blocking all Soul Power infusion, preventing the Evil Ghost from repairing the wound.
The suction from the mouth of the Evil Ghost diminished significantly, allowing the "Sun" transformed from the Golden Crow to seize the opportunity to struggle free.
Simultaneously, Xi Ying twisted her fingers, seemingly about to cast another Magic, but Wu Yue God would not let her succeed. His eyes flashed darkly, and in an instant, two beams of black light shot out, entering Xi Ying's Sea of Consciousness, causing her body to stiffen and stop moving altogether.
Yet after landing a successful hit, Wu Yue God frowned.
His Nili Divine Eye could indeed capture souls and subdue spirits, but as a Spoken Witch, he shouldn't have been caught by the initial attack so easily.
It was an Illusion Technique!
Wu Yue God quickly formed a spell, a Illusion-breaking Technique ready to emerge, but just then, he felt a sudden pain in his forehead.
A silver-white spear extended from behind his head, its tip piercing through his entire skull. Large patches of golden flames burst forth along the smooth blade, engulfing Wu Yue God's body.
Behind him, Xi Ying hovered in mid-air, holding the spear Magic Treasure in one hand and continuously invoking the Golden Crow Flame with the other hand, burning Wu Yue God's body.
In the fire, the Wu Yue God's physical body melted rapidly, and soon only his Divine Soul and the evil ghost form of his Divine Soul Transformation remained. They tried several times to break through the fire but were blocked by Xi Ying every time, ultimately dissipating completely in despair.
Along with the death of their master, the lone-eyed evil ghost also vanished rapidly, and the endless Blood Flames began to fade bit by bit.
Seeing this, Xi Ying let out a sigh of relief, about to retract her spear Magic Treasure, but her heart suddenly startled as if sensing something wrong.
Wu Yue God, was he really that easy to kill?
No, I've also fallen for an illusion!
Visit * (*) for more.
She abruptly realized this, flipped her right hand, and took out the illusion-breaking talisman specially prepared for her by Golden Dawn Fairy, then slapped it onto herself.
In an instant, Xi Ying's Divine Soul felt a cool relief, and the scenery around her instantly changed. She was still standing in the same spot, surrounded by raging Blood Flames, and the lone-eyed evil ghost reappeared in mid-air, now catching the Sun transformed by the Golden Crow.
