"The talisman is nice, but it's too late," Wu Yue God said, looking at Xi Ying from a distance, shaking his head with a light chuckle.
The first spell of "speak and follow" that Xi Ying had cast had lost its effect, and the oddly quiet sky was once again filled with the sounds of battle.
Then, a thunderous roar from the lone-eyed evil ghost overwhelmed all other sounds.
The sonic waves forced Xi Ying to cast magic in response, but this caused her to miss the last chance to save her Divine Soul Transformation.
The next moment, with a gulping sound, the lone-eyed evil ghost swallowed the Sun whole, and Xi Ying's face immediately turned pale, her Divine Soul Aura plummeting.
Wu Yue God narrowed his eyes, and after a moment's digestion, a hint of surprise flashed in his eyes.
"Xi Zheng is indeed fortunate to have a daughter like you," he said, seemingly genuinely praising her.
Xi Ying didn't respond, her hands suddenly loosened, and the spear she was gripping vanished once more, disappearing into the air, its point of attack unknown.
However, Wu Yue God waved his hand, and a half-human-tall stone statue appeared beside him, its figure identical to Wu Yue God except its face was blank, void of any features.
As soon as the statue appeared, Xi Ying immediately felt the presence of Desire Power emanating from it.
However, unlike the Desire Power collected by Yuan Ming through the Stealing Heaven Tripod, the Desire Power within the statue appeared to Xi Ying as dark mud, exuding a suffocating stench.
Just one extra glance made Xi Ying genuinely uncomfortable, and it seemed as though she could hear the painful screams of countless beings in her ears.
Desire Power, the product of faith and gratitude, is always influenced by human intent.
Killing in the name of faith, prayers containing evil thoughts, gratitude fulfilling desires...
And what the statue held was just that, Desire Power dominated by pain, resentment, fear, and other negative emotions.
After summoning the statue, Wu Yue God immediately raised his right hand, drawing characters in the void, evidently about to cast the Evil Curse Kill again.
This time, however, no Black Abyss appeared under his feet, instead a small split appeared on the forehead of the statue next to him, and the mud-like Desire Power emerged, rushing towards the characters he wrote in the air.
Normally, anyone with cultivation lower than Wu Yue God could not directly observe the casting process of Curse Killing, but Xi Ying's Divine Soul Power was now no less than Wu Yue God's.
Observing him casting, she promptly pinched a spell, and in the void, an invisible fluctuation flashed by as her Lifebound Magical Treasure, the Chenxia Spear, while remaining unseen, swirled and shot towards the statue.
As the Chenxia Spear approached the statue, a giant black hand suddenly appeared above it and grabbed it with the speed of lightning.
Although it was a Lifebound Magical Treasure, Xi Ying had been promoted to Spoken Witch too recently to refine the Chenxia Spear further; the runes on it were not strong enough. Once Wu Yue God was on his guard, it was hard for it to escape his notice.
Xi Ying's heart sank, and the spell in her hand changed instantly, causing massive Golden Flames to rise from the Chenxia Spear, instantly melting the giant black hand.
Simultaneously, Wu Yue God had finished writing, and the characters "Xi Ying" floating in mid-air finally took shape, then were rapidly enveloped by the negative Desire Power emerging from the statue, disappearing in mid-air and appearing inside Xi Ying's Sea of Consciousness.
Unlike Yuan Ming's account, the negative Desire Power appeared not inside her Divine Soul but seemed influenced by the strength of her Divine Soul.
Curse Killing was not lethal enough to harm a Spoken Witch!
Nevertheless, with the Curse Killing cast through the statue, its power still far surpassed what Yuan Ming had endured.
As the surging negative Desire Power struck her Divine Soul, Xi Ying experienced a moment of stupor. When she regained her senses, a giant black hand had already appeared above her head, reaching out to grab her.
It was too late to dodge at this moment, but just at the critical moment, Xi Ying suddenly pointed towards the Chenxia Spear, a white rune instantly lighting up on it, and suddenly her surroundings were enveloped by an unexpected burst of white light, vanishing from her original spot.
The giant black hand grasped down but caught nothing.

chapters.title: Chapter 750 - 721 Trap
chapters.content:
The Wu Yue God's brows twitched, and she turned to look several tens of steps away from herself, only to see Xi Ying reappearing beside the Chenxia Spear, holding the Magic Treasure in one hand with a look of lingering fear.
At this moment, the Wu Yue God's complexion had turned somewhat pale, but the vicious light in her eyes flashed, and she raised her hand again without hesitation, casting the Evil Curse Kill once more, clearly not intending to give her opponent any time to catch their breath.
However, a hint of ruthlessness flashed through Xi Ying's eyes as she raised her hand to her brow, releasing all the Divine Soul Transformations in her Sea of Consciousness at once.
"Space Confinement!" she spoke at the same time, using her speak and follow the law Divine Power.
The Wu Yue God felt a bad premonition and quickly stopped casting, withdrawing at once, but it was already too late.
The moment Xi Ying's voice fell, the surrounding space instantly became incredibly sturdy, preventing anyone from using any means to traverse through space or change their position.
At the same time, all the Golden Crows gathered in front of her merged into a fist-sized white dot surrounded by a hazy halo, as if something was distorting the light.
Suddenly, the white dot soared upward, rushing into the sky, and after just a breath's time, it violently exploded.
In an instant, everyone on the battlefield saw that the sky above their heads had been dyed gold.
It wasn't the original sky that had been colored, but a huge sun that had taken the place of the firmament.
For the first time, everyone saw the True Face of the sun from such a close distance. The dazzling golden light was like a sharp sword, making everyone who dared to look up feel their eyes sting as if they were about to be blinded.
At the same time, the temperature on the battlefield rose rapidly, the light was distorted by the high heat, and the scorching air entered their lungs with each breath, scalding their organs and throat.
The moment the sun appeared, the skin on the Wu Yue God's body immediately started to burn, and the intense pain made him clasp his head, wanting to cry out, but his throat, filled with burns, could not utter a sound.
He struggled to escape the burning range of the harsh sun, but the moisture in his body was rapidly depleting. In just five breaths, he completely turned into a dried corpse, and his Divine Soul, now left without the protection of his Physical Body, could only rely on his Soul Power to desperately hold on, clinging to the last thread of life.
Five breaths later, when the Wu Yue God's Soul Power was about to be exhausted, the harsh sun in the sky suddenly vanished, and the heat around them gradually decreased, no longer requiring the Wu Yue God to resist with his Soul Power.
Not far away, Xi Ying stood with a pale face, no longer having any Soul Power left in her Sea of Consciousness. Her Divine Soul Transformations were all consumed, leaving her completely incapable of using her Soul Cultivation Divine Power.
The Divine Power she had just used was called "Sunburn," a power she obtained when she broke through as a Spoken Witch. Although its might was terrifying, it required her to forcibly consume all Divine Soul Transformations to condense into a harsh sun that scorched all things.
And once the Divine Power was activated, it could not be canceled voluntarily; it could only naturally dissipate after her Soul Power was entirely exhausted.
At this moment, Xi Ying, due to the excessive consumption of Soul Power, was even struggling to stand, her body shaking, ready to collapse at any moment.
However, seeing this, the Wu Yue God had no intention of taking the opportunity to counterattack, as his own condition was not much better than Xi Ying's. The pain from twice losing his Physical Body greatly weakened his Divine Soul.
Therefore, he decisively used his Soul Power to sweep up the Faceless Divine Statue and flew away without hesitation toward a place beyond the heavens.
But just then, in the void next to him, the Chenxia Spear appeared out of nowhere, and without waiting for him to speak, the spear's tip simply stirred and directly tore his Divine Soul to shreds.
The Wu Yue God, who had rampaged for so many years, even once threatening the entire Yunhuang, now watched powerlessly as his Divine Soul perished between heaven and earth, without even managing to utter a final cry.
The Faceless Divine Statue and the Storage Ring hidden within the Wu Yue God's Divine Soul fell to the ground simultaneously, and Xi Ying, having depleted the last of her mental strength, collapsed powerlessly.
Fortunately, although Xi Ying's Soul Power was exhausted, she still had Mana within her, and the Chenxia Spear quickly flew back, automatically protecting its master, preventing her from falling into a state where others could easily slaughter her.
Fifteen minutes later, Xi Ying's dried-out Sea of Consciousness finally regained a trace of Soul Power, and her consciousness became clear once more.
She held the Chenxia Spear, barely supporting her body, and took out an illusion-breaking talisman to apply to herself. Then she looked around until she saw the Faceless Divine Statue and Storage Ring not far away, and finally, she breathed a sigh of relief.
This time, it was truly over.
She stood up tremblingly, circulated her Mana, and drew the Faceless Divine Statue and Storage Ring over from a distance.
To be safe, she didn't immediately open the Storage Ring but used her Mana to temporarily seal the two items, and then sat down again and took out an elixir to silently heal her wounds.
The battles of others were still ongoing, and Xi Ying's heart wished she could help Yuan Ming, but considering her current difficulty in even moving, rashly intervening in others' battles would only be a burden.
"You must win..."
Xi Ying pursed her lips, and while healing, she couldn't help but look in the direction of Yuan Ming's battle with Xue Li for a moment.
...
When the battle between Xi Ying and Wuyue God reached a pause, Wulu found himself embroiled in a bitter fight.
Even though he had obtained combat power comparable to the Returning Void stage through the Void Thought Technique, his actual cultivation was only at the late-stage Nascent Soul. In contrast, Blood Demon Ancestor was a genuine middle-stage Returning Void existence. Once the Blood Demon Ancestor had figured out Wulu's capabilities, they engaged in close combat, naturally resulting in Wulu being utterly at a disadvantage.
At that moment, the Blood Demon Ancestor was hovering mid-air, clad in blood-colored armor, enveloped in a blood light stretching for ten thousand feet, dyeing everything in its vicinity a deep red. At his side, a blood-red long saber continuously circled around, emitting ominous humming sounds.
However, Wulu's figure was nowhere to be seen on the battlefield, and though the Blood Demon Ancestor's Divine Sense tirelessly scanned the surroundings, he could not detect Wulu's presence.
It was as if Wulu had already left the area, leaving the Blood Demon Ancestor alone, full of doubts and suspicions.
But the Blood Demon Ancestor was not the least bit negligent, nor did he entertain any thought of withdrawing to assist others.
In the previous battle, Wulu had more than once utilized the Stone Talisman to become invisible and launch sneak attacks. The Blood Demon Ancestor was convinced that Wulu was also hiding somewhere at that moment, waiting for him to reveal a weakness.
And just as he expected, not far above his head to the left, Wulu was holding his breath and focusing his mind, relying on the power of the Stone Talisman to conceal his form, silently looking for an opening in the Protective Spiritual Light of the Blood Demon Ancestor.
His eyes flickered with spirit light, sometimes deep blue like the ocean, sometimes blood-red like fresh blood, with the colors of the light constantly changing, ultimately fusing into an ordinary white glow.
This chapter was made possible by the community at *.
In his early years, as a covert operative, he had cultivated numerous Cultivation Techniques and secret techniques from various Sects, so many that even he himself could not remember them all.
Each of these secret techniques had its focus, and depending on the battle situation, they could exhibit different effects.
However, when it really came to fighting, Wulu did not have the luxury to discern which secret technique would provide the desired effect; he could only roughly choose the most powerful one to use.
But through the Void Thought Technique, Wulu was now able to simultaneously use all the secret techniques he had mastered. He did not need to worry about conflicts arising from mixing Mana, and the power was stronger than using a single detection secret technique alone.
He had named this method the Insight Technique. With this technique, he had even gained an observation capacity not inferior to the Emperor's Qi Observation Technique, allowing him to roughly discern the flowing patterns of spiritual energy and the flaws within.
Under his gaze, within the blood light protecting the Blood Demon Ancestor, faint white spots quickly appeared, moving and shifting locations.
The movements of the light spots were rapid, but Wulu keenly noticed their pattern of change.
And when the light spots shifted to a position right above the Blood Demon Ancestor's head, Wulu suddenly made his move. He struck downwards with both palms, and the phantom of a ferocious tiger appeared behind him, roaring loudly. It lifted its front paw and swiped towards the Blood Demon Ancestor.
The moment Wulu acted, the invisibility effect of the Stone Talisman vanished, and the Blood Demon Ancestor instantly became aware of Wulu's presence. Seeing the attack coming, a cold smile appeared at the corner of his mouth.
The Blood Demon Ancestor simply pointed a finger, and the hovering Blood Transformation Divine Saber suddenly flew out, cleaving towards the tiger's claw.
The tide-like blood light instantly engulfed the tiger's claw, but in the next moment, the blood light suddenly exploded, and from it emerged swathes of red flames, completely obscuring the Blood Demon Ancestor's vision.
The flames seemed to be burning fiercely, but their temperature was not high. The vitality that radiated from them gave off an illusion of Wood Attribute Spiritual Energy.
A glint of cold light flashed in the Blood Demon Ancestor's eyes. He clapped his hands together with force, causing the Blood Transformation Divine Saber to shudder violently and slice out again. The blade radiated light like water, and without even getting close, the pressure from the air extinguished the red flames.
At this moment, Wulu once again became invisible with the aid of the Stone Talisman, disappearing into thin air. The saber light passed through, hitting nothing.
The Blood Demon Ancestor frowned slightly, seemingly sensing that Wulu could not have gone too far even though he was invisible. He quickly formed a spell with his hands, and the Blood Transformation Divine Saber repeatedly slashed out. The dense net of blood-colored saber light drowned everything before him.
Suddenly, behind the Blood Demon Ancestor, Wulu, whose eyes contained spirit light, reappeared once more, with only a few steps between them.
He had already figured out the pattern of the Blood Demon Ancestor's Protective Spiritual Light. The initial attack had been a feint, and now was the moment for his real killer move.
Wulu did not hesitate, nor did he have any more concerns. The instant he became visible, he threw a punch towards the Blood Demon Ancestor's back.
The Blood Demon Ancestor's head suddenly twisted around, bizarrely turning his face to his back.
"Did you think I was unaware of what you were planning?" he sneered coldly, his limbs bending unnaturally so that he faced Wulu without turning his body around.
And his back, or what could now be considered his "chest," suddenly split open, releasing countless meat balls the size of thumbs, which all shot towards Wulu.
Simultaneously, in Wulu's eyes, the two white spots on the Blood Demon Ancestor's blood light that had indicated vulnerabilities vanished completely. He no longer had any chance of making a hit.
At the same time, he heard the frenzied shriek of the Blood Transformation Divine Saber. The previously aimed blade light at the empty space had abruptly twisted in mid-air, sliding past the Blood Demon Ancestor's side, closing off any space Wulu had to dodge.
Clearly, from the beginning, this had all been a trap!

chapters.title: Chapter 751 - 722: Winning with a Surprise Strategy
chapters.content:
When Wulu realized this, he only had time to turn his body aside. The next instant, the flesh balls that sprayed out from the Blood Demon Ancestor hit him like raindrops, easily corroding the Protective Spiritual Light and burrowing directly into the left half of Wulu's body.
The Blood Poison contained within the flesh balls exploded instantly, turning Wulu's left side into pus and blood. The pale bones and the little flesh that remained were all exposed to the air, a sight so horrifying it was petrifying.
As a price for this, Wulu's right fist ultimately only struck the Blood Demon Ancestor's Protective Spiritual Light, causing no damage whatsoever.
"For a Late-stage Nascent Soul, to land this punch on me, you're somewhat capable," the Blood Demon Ancestor mocked.
However, a mysterious look flashed across the eyes of Wulu, who had been severely injured by the Blood Demon Ancestor.
"That might not be the case," he said softly.
Upon hearing this, the Blood Demon Ancestor frowned. He was about to speak when his face suddenly contorted in horror the next instant.
He sensed that from Wulu's right fist, a huge amount of chaotic and conflicting Spiritual Power had merged into his Protective Blood Light, dissolving it in just moments.
Then, taking advantage of the collapse of the Blood Demon Ancestor's Protective Blood Light, Wulu thrust his fist forward, hitting the Blood Demon Ancestor's body as the chaotic and conflicting Spiritual Power surged in as well.
In an instant, numerous types of Spiritual Power fought against each other within the Blood Demon Ancestor's meridians, turning his Mana into complete chaos.
"How is this possible!"
The Blood Demon Ancestor cried out in shock, hastily trying to suppress the foreign Spiritual Power that had swept into him.
But the types of Mana that Wulu had injected into him were so numerous, just the ones he could identify alone exceeded a dozen, and the remaining similar ones were even more numerous. With their inherent conflicts, the Blood Demon Ancestor's instinctive reaction was like pouring cold water into a boiling oil pot, provoking a more intense backlash.
Above all, the Demonic Qi and the power from the Blood Crystal on Wulu's forehead were the most violent.
They quickly tore through the Blood Demon Ancestor's meridians, breaking free from the remaining constraints and rushing towards a broader 'battlefield'.
With his Mana support gone, the Blood Demon Ancestor's body plummeted from midair, Wulu following close behind.
The impact of their landing further exacerbated the internal chaos in the Blood Demon Ancestor's body, and Wulu, falling alongside, gathered his last strength, sat on the Blood Demon Ancestor, and pounded his head with punch after punch.
With each punch, more of the strange Spiritual Power surged into the Blood Demon Ancestor's body, using his physical form as the battleground, waging fierce battles against each other.
The chaos in his Mana also affected the Blood Demon Ancestor's Nascent Soul. It was even locked within his body, unable to escape on its own.
After 15 minutes, under Wulu's watch, a loud explosion occurred out of nowhere. The Blood Demon Ancestor's body suddenly burst open, and the unrestrained Spiritual Energy scattered wildly in the air, with much of it, following the blast waves, burrowing back into Wulu's body.
The impacted Wulu, now devoid of the energy to dodge, could only allow the blast to fling him through the air, eventually crashing to the ground.
Grunting, Wulu looked at his body, now nearly only a right half remaining, and couldn't help but bitterly smile.
He was very aware of the gap in strength between himself and the Blood Demon Ancestor. From the beginning of the battle, he realized that his chances of survival were almost none, his only lifeline being the use of a clever trick.
After being trapped by the Blood Puppet Armor, Wulu had been searching for a way to take it off. During this time, he also acquired the secret manual of the Blood Transformation Technique and had trained in it for a while, trying to use it to break free from his restraints.
Although the result was a failure, he had understood the operation of the Blood Transformation Technique and could utilize the Void Thought Technique to simulate its operation, thus injecting all the chaotic powers within him into the Blood Demon Ancestor's Protective Blood Light.
If it had been any other opponent, Wulu would never have been able to so easily inject these conflicting forces into their Protective Spiritual Light.
His opponent had to be the Blood Demon Ancestor, and only the Blood Demon Ancestor.
Even so, in this battle, Wulu had sacrificed much. The left half of his body, eroded by Blood Poison, would take decades of recuperation to possibly return to its original state.
But at least, he had successfully killed the Blood Demon Ancestor.
Wulu thought so, but at that moment, the cold scoff of the Blood Demon Ancestor echoed again in his mind.
"Hmph, naive!"Br$o*u&gh*t to you by the fo@l-ks at M&V|LEMPYR+.
Startled, Wulu wanted to react, but found that his body was now immobile as if another will had taken over, gaining control of his physical body.
He suddenly noticed that a set of Blood Puppet Armor had surfaced just outside his Nascent Soul, enveloping it entirely. The Nascent Soul of the Blood Demon Ancestor was also emerging from the armor.
However, its appearance was ragged, its aura fluctuating wildly, clearly having sustained significant damage.
"Boy, you indeed surprised me, but the Blood Puppet Armor was my creation. Being controlled by the armor meant you were fated to become my second physical body," the Blood Demon Ancestor sneered. His Nascent Soul merged back into the Blood Puppet Armor, and immediately, myriad mysterious forces emerged from it, merging bit by bit with Wulu's Nascent Soul from the outside in, dissolving his consciousness, reshaping the Nascent Soul's form to increasingly resemble that of the Blood Demon Ancestor.
"Who told you I am controlled by this armor?" Wulu, however, appeared composed. As his gaze flickered, he suddenly muttered to himself.
While speaking, he mobilized the last of his willpower and fully operated the Void Thought Technique. The powers that had merged with his Nascent Soul were also drawn by the Void Thought Technique and began circulating within his Nascent Soul along the path dictated by the cultivation technique.
"No, how is this possible!" the Blood Demon Ancestor cried out in alarm.
Wulu paid him no heed. After integrating the powers that had merged with his Nascent Soul into his control, he regained control over his physical body, and the operation of the Void Thought Technique became even smoother and faster.
Noticing something amiss, the Blood Demon Ancestor immediately tried to escape from the Blood Puppet Armor and leave Wulu's body. However, Wulu was not about to let him go—he actively controlled the power of the Blood Puppet Armor and locked the Blood Demon Ancestor's Nascent Soul tightly within it.
Instantly, the tables turned. The Blood Demon Ancestor's power continuously flowed into Wulu's body, but rather than transforming his physical body and Nascent Soul, it all became a part of Wulu's cultivation.
Indeed, in order to recover his fighting strength as quickly as possible after seizing the body, the Blood Demon Ancestor had, before his death, actively gathered the power of his physical body, brought it along with his Nascent Soul, and drilled into the Blood Puppet Armor on Wulu's body.
As a being in the mid-stage of Returning Void, even his residual power was extremely vast. Now, with Wulu actively refining it, it not only helped heal the injuries to the left side of his body but also enhanced his cultivation.
However, this process was slow and lengthy. The consciousness of the Blood Demon Ancestor still lingered, constantly seeking means to escape. Wulu had to call upon all his focus and slowly grind down this unexpected influx of power until it was completely consumed.
Before that, Wulu diverted a wisp of his consciousness to activate the Stone Talisman, causing his body, lying on the ground, to vanish once again.
Thus, the battlefield where the two had been clashing fell silent, devoid of any activity.
...
In the distant void, Yuan Ming and Xue Li eyed each other across space, both slightly squinting, observing each other closely.
"Yuan Ming, if you hand over the Sky-reaching Demon Pillar and the Evil King Mirror now, I can let you go," Xue Li said with a faint smile.
"If you like letting things go, you might as well head to the Northern Desert—no need to waste words here," Yuan Ming said with a sneer.
Upon hearing this, Xue Li's face showed no anger, just a hint of disappointment as he shook his head.
"Considering you carry the aura of my Demon Clan, I thought you would be smarter than those pure fools of the Human Clan. I even thought of taking you under my command. Sadly, you too are a fool who fails to understand the situation. Pitiful, lamentable. Since you're set on seeking death, I'll grant you your wish," Xue Li said.
As his voice fell, he raised his hand and a beam of blood-colored light gleamed in his palm. A scimitar over four feet long with a dramatically curved blade, drenched in a vivid red as if soaked in blood, appeared, emitting a dense aura of murderous and demonic energy.
Yuan Ming didn't dare to be careless. He straightened his spear, concentrating Star Power at the spear point, ready to strike.
Xue Li's eyes flashed intensely. His body erupted in a "bang" into a cloud of Blood Mist, disappearing instantly.
Yuan Ming's pupils constricted, barely catching a glimpse of an afterimage. Xue Li's figure had already reached him instantly, his Blood Slaughter Scimitar's light surging, transforming into a blood-colored Light Blade that slashed directly at Yuan Ming's chest.
Yuan Ming hastily stepped back. With his Purple Star Nine Dragon Spear, starlight burst forth, scattering countless star particles throughout the void, colliding with the blood-colored Light Blade.
In the deafening noise, starlight scattered in all directions, but the blood-colored Light Blade broke through, pressing towards Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming swiftly turned, stabbing out with his spear again, fully dispersing the blade of light.
Shaken, he then immediately triggered his Divine Power to concentrate in his eyes and looked again at Xue Li, realizing that the explosion of blood light around him was a Blood Explosion Escape Technique. It was incredibly fast, and catching it with the naked eye was already very difficult.
"Yuan Ming, it seems I overestimated you," Xue Li sneered.
Yuan Ming chuckled dismissively at his words.
Quietly, his focus had already spread out, continuously expanding the affected area towards Xue Li.
"Die!"
Xue Li shouted lowly, his silhouette exploding in another cloud of Blood Mist, swiftly approaching and once again swinging his blade at Yuan Ming.
As he entered the range of Yuan Ming's focus, he was immediately aware but did not retreat. Instead, the muscles in his arms ballooned, and his blade's momentum doubled, vowing to kill Yuan Ming with one strike.
However, as the Shared Life Battle Intent unfolded, Yuan Ming instantly locked between himself and Xue Li. He reacted faster than before, quickly dodging after the slash, and immediately put away his long spear, which was not suitable for close combat.
He then grabbed the Soul Destroying Sword from the void, twisted at the waist, and with a Sword Drawing Slash, he swept across at Xue Li.
"Whoosh"
A swath of Soul Destroying Sword Energy, tens of feet long, swept across, arriving in an instant.

chapters.title: Chapter 752 - 723 Swallowing Heaven Demon Technique
chapters.content:
Xue Li sensed the soul-extinguishing aura contained within the Soul Destroying Sword Energy, his brow slightly furrowing as a single hand flipped, and a fist-sized pitch-black bell appeared out of thin air in his palm. With a fierce shake towards the Soul Destroying Sword Energy.
"Dang dang dang"
Accompanied by a rapid series of bell sounds, a hazy apparition of a giant bell, about a zhang in size, emerged, and from its center, a wave of black ripples spread outwards.
The Soul Destroying Sword Energy collapsed upon contact, utterly suppressed.
However, before Xue Li could take pleasure in his success, his head was already shrouded in darkness from above as a palace-sized black giant palm descended, emitting circle after circle of black light waves.
It was indeed the Great Black Sky God Palm.
In an instant, everything within several dozen zhang was frozen, space itself seeming to be immobilized. The black bell in Xue Li's hand was clearly pressured, nearly unable to emit any sound.
Xue Li's expression changed, immediately retracting the black bell and throwing a fierce punch towards the sky with his hand.
As he punched, his left arm thickened, a layer of fine blood-colored scale armor surfaced on his skin, and a visible wave of blood light propelled forward from his shoulder to the fist.
As his fist blurred ever so slightly, it suddenly transformed into countless overlapping blood-red fist shadows, then suddenly converged into a loft-sized fuzzy fist shadow. This shadow, filled with an unbearably dense force of Blood Qi, roared heavenward with a booming sound and slammed hard into the black giant palm.
Fist met palm with a thunderous explosion!
The moment the blood-colored fist shadow burst, it released an incredibly powerful force that tore apart the Great Black Sky God Palm.
The intense shockwave forced Xue Li back several steps before he could steady himself.
His expression gradually became solemn as he found himself having to reevaluate Yuan Ming.
From the few bouts of probing attacks, Yuan Ming had already roughly gauged Xue Li's strength. It appeared that his opponent had also broken through the Body of Wanxiang in Body Cultivation and excelled in both speed and strength. Yuan Ming wondered what other trump cards he might have hidden.
As his thoughts turned, the sound of air bursting interrupted him, signaling that Xue Li was once again charging towards him.
Facing his oncoming foe, Yuan Ming did not dodge again, but instead directly brandished his sword to meet him.
After completing the Shared Fate, and through several rounds of adaptation, Yuan Ming was now able to keep up with Xue Li's speed.
This time, both tacitly put aside their other flashy techniques and engaged in a pure test of their abilities as practitioners of Body Cultivation.
In mid-air, the sound of clashing sword and blade resonated powerfully, while the figures of Yuan Ming and his adversary had vanished. In the void, only intermittent afterimages remained visible, along with the ripples they stirred, attesting to their presence.
In the blink of an eye, they had exchanged dozens of moves.
Yuan Ming fought more and more composedly, while Xue Li's anxiety grew. To suppress Yuan Ming, he had unknowingly summoned his "intention," burning blood to gain a significant enhancement to his physique.
Consequently, his speed and strength were continuously increasing, having already exceeded triple their initial levels.
Yet Yuan Ming wasn't suppressed by him. Both his speed and strength grew with Xue Li's enhancement, revealing no flaws nor any signs of flagging.
Only then did Xue Li understand that sustaining this strange state was Yuan Ming's intention.
As Xue Li was briefly distracted, Yuan Ming suddenly closed in and cleanly struck down with his sword.
Xue Li snapped back to his senses and hastily blocked with his blade. As their weapons clashed and tussled briefly, Yuan Ming's fist landed on his chest.
The punch seemed slow yet was swift, simple and unadorned, striking squarely in the chest much like a punch thrown during a brawl between ordinary men.
However, a tremendous indescribable force struck, and Xue Li felt a jolt in his chest, his body involuntarily flung backward.
After that successful punch, Yuan Ming's figure blurred as he followed close on the heels of the retreating Xue Li.
As Yuan Ming raised his fist to strike again, he saw Xue Li press a hand to his nose and suddenly open his mouth to spew forth a wave of dark red smoke. It gushed out like a tidal wave, swiftly enveloping Yuan Ming's form.
Just as he entered the dark red smoke, Yuan Ming immediately sensed a corrosive presence. He instantly closed his eyes and nose and hastily retreated.
Yet, the pervasive mist was faster than him, sealing off his escape.
In an instant, Yuan Ming found himself within a dark red space, with everything around him cloaked in a hazy red.
"Not good." Yuan Ming extended his Divine Sense, and after a brief examination, he couldn't help but feel a sinking sensation.
Unexpectedly, the dark red smoke could also shield Divine Sense. Even with his strength as a Half-step Word Witch, he couldn't penetrate it.
As Yuan Ming reeled in surprise, a voice as resonant as a great bell suddenly came through the mist:
"Yuan Ming, to have forced me to use this Swallowing Heaven Demon Technique, you will not die in vain."
The moment the voice sounded, Yuan Ming felt a sudden darkness above him. Before he could retreat, he sensed the fog billowing below, casting an identical shadow surging towards him from beneath.
He attempted to employ an Escape Technique to flee, his form blurring slightly, then vanished from the spot.
The next moment, he still felt the surroundings shrouded in red mist, and the enormous shadows above him and beneath him remained, encroaching at a visibly rapid speed.
For a time, Yuan Ming was filled with a sense of confusion.
Why, after using his Escape Technique, could he not fly hundreds or thousands of feet away? Why was he still within the range of the shadows?
Could it be that his Magic had caused the heavens to sink and the earth to rise, leaving him nowhere to flee?
"Impossible, absolutely impossible. Even a Magic Practitioner of the Returning Void Realm couldn't do such a thing," Yuan Ming quickly dismissed his own speculation.
But as a Soul Cultivator who was a Half-step Spoken Witch, he also knew this was definitely not an Illusion Technique.
Thus, the only plausible explanation was that his Divine Sense had been affected by the dark red smoke, and amidst the confusion of his five senses, the Escape Technique had failed.
He was simply spinning in place.
And by now, it was already too late to think of escaping.
The vast shadows from above and below had already closed in; he felt the air around him tighten and his entire body was enveloped by an invisible colossal force, an indescribable tremendous pressure imprisoning him deeply.
Immediately after, Yuan Ming felt an irresistible force of attraction behind him, and with a sudden lightness of body, he was pulled backward and fell.
Soon, Yuan Ming's feet touched solid ground, but it felt soft beneath him, making it somewhat difficult to stand firmly.
Surrounding him was pitch blackness, without a trace of light, making it impossible to see anything at all.
Yuan Ming rubbed his fingers together, and a ball of firelight appeared at his fingertips, casting light around him.
He looked around and realized he had arrived in an irregularly shaped enclosed space; the meaty walls above, around, and beneath him were all of a dark red color, covered with something like a membrane.
"Could it be that I have been swallowed into the stomach of some demon beast?" Yuan Ming wondered with astonishment, but then he abruptly recalled the "Swallowing Heaven Demon Technique" that Xue Li had mentioned earlier.
Although he had never heard of such a Cultivation Technique, he could not help but speculate that he had likely been swallowed by Xue Li using this Swallowing Heaven Demon Technique.
"To refine such a space inside the belly is not easy," Yuan Ming murmured.
Yet, he wasn't too anxious in his heart; instead, he felt that Xue Li was being overly arrogant. Didn't he know some things should not be consumed rashly, especially humans?
Yuan Ming raised his hand to touch the dark red meaty wall beside him, and immediately, a wisp of white smoke arose from his palm, bearing an intensely strong corrosive power.
He then lifted his foot and looked down to find that the soles of his Magic Boots had been corroded full of holes, nearly worn through by the decay.
At the same time, a burning, itchy sensation began spreading from his throat and nostrils.
After a few coughs, Yuan Ming's eyes were so irritated they nearly teared up.
Only then did he realize that this meaty wall space was not as simple as he had imagined; if he stayed any longer, problems were bound to arise.This соntеnt wаs first rеlеаsеd оn МV_LЕМРYR.
With that thought, Yuan Ming no longer hesitated in his heart and held the Soul Destroying Sword in both hands, activating the Body of Wanxiang. He gathered strength in his arms and, with a forceful slash, struck forward.
"Whoosh"
A streak of black Sword Energy burst forth, extending for tens of feet, flashing through the void and striking the meaty wall in front of him.
With a "bang" sound, the wall trembled violently where the Sword Energy hit, distorted by the immense force into a deep indent but then instantly rebounded back to its original state.
Simultaneously, as the dark red meaty wall rebounded violently, a grayish gas rushed towards Yuan Ming's face.
Even before it reached him, a disgustingly foul stench wafted over.
Yuan Ming's brows furrowed as he swung his hand forward, unleashing mana that surged out, forming a translucent Light Shield in front of him to meet the approaching gray gas.
At the moment of contact between the semi-circular Light Shield and the gray gas, a piercing "sizzling" sound was heard.
An intense corrosive smell spread out, and the Light Shield dissolved instantly.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming's expression turned slightly stern, and he quickly put away the Soul Destroying Sword. With a wave of his hand, a Red Ancient Scroll flew out in front of him, slowly unfolding, with light flickering uncertainly on the blank scroll and faint booming sounds emitting from it.
It was the Space Spiritual Treasure known as the Map of Ten Thousand Realms.
"Consume," Yuan Ming pointed and uttered a low shout.
In the flickering light of the Red Ancient Scroll, a vortex suddenly collapsed inward, spinning at high speed.
The murky gas was immediately caught by a strong suction force, and it began to flow into the scroll like a thin stream.
In just a breath or two, the gray gas was entirely absorbed.

chapters.title: Chapter 753 - 724: Devour
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming's gaze shifted to the ancient scroll, only to see a grey vortex appear on it, with no signs of corrosion. This slightly reassured him.
But now, when he turned his attention to the flesh walls around him, he dared not force a breakthrough any longer.
Not to mention that the toughness of the flesh walls was unpredictable, the grey mist released by the counter shock of his attack was also quite strange and difficult to deal with.
"Well, since a forceful breach is not possible, leaving is the only option," he sighed and said.
No sooner had he spoken than Yuan Ming withdrew the Map of Ten Thousand Realms; his five fingers stretched forward, transforming into the roots of the Undying Tree, and he activated the divine skill to traverse the void.
A distortion appeared in the void at the tips of the roots, followed by the rippling of spatial ripples, as a spatial passage slowly emerged before him, revealing a dark-red void behind him that led to an unknown location.
Yuan Ming immediately extended the roots into the passage.
Just then, he felt a sudden tightness on his back as if something was pressing against him.
Startled, Yuan Ming hesitated not a moment and plunged headlong into the spatial passage, vanishing from sight.
But the next instant, he stumbled and fell from midair, once again landing in the slowly writhing space of flesh walls.
Steadying himself, Yuan Ming looked around and saw two spatial passageways, an entrance and an exit, facing each other, merely six feet apart.
His brow furrowed even tighter.
Despite his suspicions, Yuan Ming tried again, extending two more roots and opening two more spatial passages in the void.
He watched the six floating spatial exits in the void and fell into silence.
The space condensed by the Swallowing Heaven Demon Technique was self-contained and did not connect directly with the outside world, making it impossible for him to escape with the divine skill of the Undying Tree.
Upon this realization, Yuan Ming immediately waved his hand and took out the Sky-reaching Demon Pillar.
This object possessed the power to break forbiddances and was far more potent than the divine skill of the Undying Tree when it came to breaking through spatial locks.
He placed a hand on the Sky-reaching Demon Pillar and channeled Demonic Qi into it.
The pillar flashed with black light, and mysterious Demon Patterns lit up one after another, emitting a unique spatial fluctuation which was on the verge of unleashing divine skills.
But at that moment, a strange turn of events occurred.
The surrounding flesh walls suddenly began moving faster, a large amount of black Demonic Qi diffused from the Sky-reaching Demon Pillar and was quickly absorbed by the flesh walls, interrupting the imminent divine skill.
Seeing more and more Demonic Qi being absorbed by Xue Li instead, Yuan Ming had no choice but to put away the Sky-reaching Demon Pillar.
"Stop wasting your energy. Once inside my belly, you're no different from a dead man. Use the time to reminisce about your past life," Xue Li's voice suddenly emerged from the flesh walls, echoing ominously.
As his words ended, the ground under Yuan Ming's feet shook violently and the surrounding flesh walls began to move forcefully, squeezing towards him.
Yuan Ming was startled and split his hands to the sides, instantly transforming into numerous black roots that propped against the encroaching flesh walls.
Hundreds of roots pressed against the flesh walls, immediately leaving deep, embedded marks.
With a series of "puffing" sounds, the flesh walls seemed to release continuous farts, spewing out grey mist from inside, enveloping Yuan Ming.
In an instant, the corrosive aura in the void became incredibly potent.
A pungent smell hit Yuan Ming's nose, causing a burning sensation in his nose and throat, while his eyes uncontrollably teared up, rendering his vision blurry.
With the situation being difficult to defend against or to escape, he was decidedly uncomfortable.
Having no other choice, Yuan Ming summoned the Map of Ten Thousand Realms once again, spreading it above his head, continuously absorbing the ever-surging corrosive grey mist around him.
On the Map of Ten Thousand Realms, the grey vortex grew larger and more solidified.
"Since you wish to digest me, let's see if you consume me first or I absorb you," Yuan Ming's anger rose, and he bellowed.
As his voice fell, his body rapidly enlarged, directly transforming into the body of the Undying Tree.
The next moment, hundreds of black roots extended and spread toward the dark-red flesh walls, piercing them like sharp steel needles.
However, the flesh walls were incredibly tough; the piercing roots not only failed to break through but also caused a large amount of grey corrosive mist to gush forth.
Unfazed, Yuan Ming immediately employed his divine skills, distributing the Undying Tree's power of void traversal evenly across every root.
This time, he did not insist on breaking through the void directly, but only hoped to break the defense of the dark-red flesh walls, even if it meant just grazing the surface.
Indeed, feedback from the black roots soon came; hundreds of roots found weak points and pierced the walls, embedding themselves into the flesh.
However, within the dark-red flesh walls resided an intense corrosive force, even more violent and potent than the grey mist; half of the roots that had just penetrated were corroded and withered to ash in an instant.
The remaining half of the roots were also quickly withering.
At this moment, the trunk of the Undying Tree shook slightly, light of ink-green began to glow on the leaves, green veins stretching from the leaves to the trunk, and all the way down to the root system, drenching everything with green radiance.
Yuan Ming invoked the Origin Power of the Undying Tree, pouring it continuously into those roots.This content was first released on *.
Bolstered by the Origin Power, the graying roots immediately regained their vitality, starting to vigorously penetrate the fleshy walls and continuously struggling against the corrosive force.
The two forces were like the ceaseless cycle of seasons, locked in an endless struggle between flourish and decay, life and death.
Meanwhile, the Undying Tree's power to absorb vitality also kicked in; its roots acted like gaping maws hungry for life, greedily drawing in the power from within the flesh walls.
Soon, Yuan Ming felt a stream of Qi-Blood Power mixed with Demonic Qi slowly merging into his body.
This Blood Qi Power was different from anything he'd absorbed before, feeling incredibly vigorous and powerful, with an untameable sense of surging rage.
If it were an ordinary cultivator absorbing this power, they wouldn't have managed to integrate it before it burst their veins and arteries, dying without knowing how they died.
Outside, Xue Li, who had been planning to rush back to the battlefield, naturally noticed the strangeness occurring within the inner space of his abdomen, but he didn't pay it too much attention.
A mere Human Clan member daring to forcibly devour the Qi-Blood of a True Demon? That was no different from seeking death.
However, just when he was about to mock, he found that the Blood Qi Power in his body was rapidly depleting, not only had Yuan Ming absorbed his Blood Qi Power without exploding from it, but he was also speeding up the absorption.
"This isn't right… How is this possible?" Xue Li stiffened, a sense of foreboding washing over him.
Little did he know, Yuan Ming was not only the Body of Wanxiang but also had a Half-demon Body, the Blood Qi Power containing Demonic Qi would indeed buffet his veins, but it was not enough to kill him.
Instead, supported by the Undying Tree's Origin Power, Yuan Ming quickly adapted to Xue Li's Blood Qi Power and began to seize it greedily.
"You're seeking death," Xue Li shouted angrily.
He immediately flew down and settled into a cross-legged position within a mountain forest, stacking his hands on his abdomen and beginning to operate the Swallowing Heaven Demon Technique.
Inside him, the movement of the flesh walls of the internal space quickened, and the gray mist that was gushing out began to thicken, eventually turning into a dense black color.
In an instant, a large number of Undying Tree Roots were corroded into ash.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming also shivered, quickly allotting more mana to activate the Map of Ten Thousand Realms, desperately absorbing the corroding Black Mist.
Rolling Black Mist converged inside the Map of Ten Thousand Realms, immediately forming a dark vortex with a deep color.
Unlike the ever-expanding gray vortex, the black vortex shrank as it swirled, not condensing until it became a small black dot the size of a lump of coal.
Yuan Ming's gaze fell upon it, and he couldn't help but feel a sense of hidden worry.
It was like a drop of ink on white paper that, if thick enough, could seep through the sheet.
But at this moment, he had no other choice but to rely on the Map of Ten Thousand Realms to combat the Black Mist and to accelerate the seizure of Xue Li's Blood Qi Power.
Their struggle was like a tug-of-war on the edge of a cliff, just waiting to see who would lose their footing first and tumble into the Abyss.
Time ticked away.
The black dot on the Map of Ten Thousand Realms had condensed to an extreme point, and the moment it was about to corrode through the Spiritual Treasure was merely an instant away.
But simultaneously, with the Undying Tree's Origin Power desperately supporting him, Yuan Ming had already absorbed a substantial amount of Xue Li's Blood Qi Power.
In the end, it was Xue Li's psyche that collapsed first.
He couldn't fathom how a member of the Human Clan managed to survive for so long under the pressure of his Swallowing Heaven Demon Technique, continually draining his Blood Qi Power, causing him to weaken gradually.
Xue Li, his face deathly pale, suddenly stood up, his eyes surging with ferocity, and with a violent clap of his hands on his lower abdomen, he spat out something forthwith.
A stream of black light erupted from his mouth, enshrouding a dark green tree as it flew out from within.
The Undying Tree rose to midair and instantly wrapped in a light, transforming back into human form, naturally, it was Yuan Ming.
At this moment, his clothing was tattered, his shoes had even been corroded through, looking quite wretched, yet his eyes sparkled with intense vitality, clearly in excellent condition.
Having absorbed a large amount of Xue Li's Essence Blood and Demonic Qi, although it was crude and turbulent, it had realistically enhanced his Qi-Blood Power.
"Haha, Fellow Daoist Xue Li, your Essence Blood truly has a delightful taste, I almost didn't want to come out," Yuan Ming said mockingly with a laugh.
"You're seeking death," Xue Li howled in rage, grinding his teeth.
As he spoke, steamy blood-colored fog began to rise from his body, his form suddenly grew taller, and a layer of blood-red Scale Armor covered his entire body, not as if he was wearing any Magic Treasure, but as if it had grown out from his flesh and blood.

chapters.title: Chapter 754 - 725: Slaying
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming looked at the ferocious Xue Li before him, his eyebrows slightly furrowed, feeling that his opponent's stance bore some resemblance to Wulu's previous state.
Xue Li spread his arms outward, the blood on his limbs congealing to form two blood-colored Bone Knives attached to his arm bones. He emanated a strong, pungent smell of blood, and the fluctuations around him had noticeably intensified.
At the same time, two twisted, ferocious horns grew out from his forehead, and the flesh between his brows split open to reveal a walnut-sized, round blood-colored eye that kept rolling around chaotically, filled with wild and chaotic power.
"The True Demon Body!" Yuan Ming's eyes flickered as he murmured to himself.
Xue Li, displaying his True Demon Body, had flames of anger in his eyes. He immediately burst into Blood Light and rushed in front of Yuan Ming.
His arms crossed, the attached blood-colored Bone Knives on his arms lit up with a fiery red glow, slashing horizontally across in a crisscross pattern.
Two crescent-shaped beams of blood-colored knife light, like scissors, came slicing toward Yuan Ming, poised to cut him in half.
The instant Yuan Ming sensed the change in Xue Li's aura, he went on high alert and immediately activated the Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill. His blood boiling as if seething, he too emitted red steam from his body.
Just as Xue Li's attack was about to reach him, a blood-colored giant suddenly condensed out of thin air in front of Yuan Ming, its arms clasped together in front, firmly trapping the two beams of blood-colored knife light.
Yuan Ming's eyes sharpened as he took advantage of the Blood Gang True Body blocking the attack, his body turned into a streak of Blood Light, instantly moved behind Xue Li, and threw a punch fiercely at the latter's back.
Xue Li felt the disturbance behind him and immediately tried to turn around to counter.
However, the Blood Gang True Body suddenly erupted into action. Its arms collided, dispelling the blood-colored knife light, and one giant palm slammed out with an immense force of Blood Gang Power, surging forward.
Xue Li was taken aback, clearly not expecting this clone-like Divine Skill to possess such formidable attack power.
His arms smashed forward while his body took a step ahead to confront the Blood Gang True Body and at the same time, create distance from Yuan Ming, who was pursuing him from behind.
However, the distance was clearly not enough to escape Yuan Ming's pincer attack.
Yuan Ming smiled broadly, concentrating Blood Light on the fist he swung down, and a ferocious Blood Elephant's head condensed into being, suddenly enveloped in a layer of True Sun Fire, crashing down towards Xue Li's back.
Just as it was about to land a hit, an unbelievable scene unfolded.
Xue Li's body burst into Blood Light again, and under his ribs, blood condensed to form two large blood-red Demon hands, which reached out to grab Yuan Ming.
A heavy "bang" echoed!
The Blood Gang True Body's palm struck first against Xue Li's arms, pushing his burly figure back with tremendous force.
And the arms that formed behind him used this force, their palms condensing two balls of blood-colored vortexes, colliding with Yuan Ming's fist.
This clever counterattack changed the unfavorable situation of being attacked from both sides.
The two balls of blood-colored vortexes collided consecutively with the Blood Elephant's head, which was enveloped in True Sun Fire. The flames and Blood Light violently clashed, unleashing intense bursts of power waves.
Amidst the thunderous booms, Blood Light and fire both exploded simultaneously.
Yuan Ming's body flew back, while Xue Li also lost control of his form, tumbling forward.
However, different from Yuan Ming, who had nothing behind him, Xue Li faced the pursuit of the Blood Gang True Body.
The blood-colored giant stretched out its arms like hooks, tearing toward Xue Li.
In a rush, Xue Li braced his hands against the giant's arms, locking them both in place, at a standoff.
From the single eye on Xue Li's brow, Blood Light concentrated into a beam filled with violent and chaotic power, shooting straight out and directly at the Blood Gang True Body's forehead.
With a "bang," the Blood Gang True Body's head burst apart, its form turning into a wisp of light and gradually fading away.
However, before Xue Li could even rejoice, a heavy "rumble" echoed from behind.
He glanced back to see a gargantuan blood-colored elephant running wildly towards him.This chapter was made possible by the community at *.
It was Yuan Ming, seizing the opportunity while Xue Li was entangled with the Blood Gang True Body, fully invoking the Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill, burning his entire Blood Qi to launch this fierce strike.
Xue Li was instantly alarmed and, turning around abruptly, found there was no way to dodge. He let out an angry roar and faced the assault head-on.
He stepped forward, his Essence Blood boiled furiously, his form swelled, and the blood on his four arms condensed, turning them incredibly thick. Facing the oncoming blood-colored giant elephant, he brought his arms together.
At the center of his palms, a ball of tightly compacted blood-colored Thunder coalesced, with electrical strands crisscrossing, compressing a tremendous force.
"Go." Xue Li shouted lowly, pushing out all four palms simultaneously.
"Crackle and sizzle."
Blood-colored thunder shot forth into the sky, ever growing in length, as strands of electricity expanded into wildly swinging thunder-whips. Amidst the crackles and booms of the thunder, they smashed into the blood-colored giant elephant.
A "Boom" resounded, shaking the entire heaven and earth.
The burst blood-colored thunder transformed into an enormous expanse of lightning scattering in all directions, with radiant streaks shooting up into the firmament; the blast wave uprooted trees within a thousand zhang radius.
The shattered woods, under the merciless lashing of the lightning, turned a scorched black.
However, from within the chaos of the woods, a muffled bellow of an elephant sounded, and a vast figure, stepping over the broken rocks, charged out of the turbulent dust.
The clearly perforated blood-colored giant elephant, yet with a steady, unbroken pace, galloped out as if undeterred by the injuries inflicted.
Only because of the interception by the blood-colored thunder, its speed had slowed considerably.
Xue Li saw this scene, felt a tingling on his scalp, and all will to fight evaded him.
It was not until then that he finally understood the true strength of Yuan Ming, realizing that his Body of Wanxiang was even above his own.
Even at his pinnacle, he might not have been able to defeat Yuan Ming, let alone now when Yuan Ming had drained a great amount of his essence blood and demonic qi, greatly weakening him.
Without the intent to fight, a Body Cultivator's overall aura rapidly collapses. At this moment, Xue Li had no other thought than to escape.
As the blood-colored giant elephant charged towards him from behind, a blood light immediately gleamed from his body, intending to use the Blood Explosion Escape Technique once again to flee the scene.
"You can't escape now," Yuan Ming's indifferent voice suddenly emerged from behind him.
Xue Li tensed all over, and as he turned his head to look toward Yuan Ming, a blood light flickered in his third eye on his forehead. The chaotic and ferocious power was about to condense into a blood-colored light pillar and erupt forth.
But at that moment, a baffled expression appeared in his eyes, his entire demeanor froze, and the chaotic power in his third eye subsided.
He had been caught by an Illusion Technique.
But it lasted only an instant before his powerful Demon Soul shook off the effects of Yuan Ming's Illusion Technique and regained his senses.
But it was already too late.
Xue Li had lost his last chance to flee; the blood-colored giant elephant thundered towards him.
The next instant, his figure was engulfed by the vast blood light bursting forth from the blood-colored giant elephant, and before he could let out a miserable scream, he was sent flying, his body exploding with blood.
Yuan Ming was quick to act, flashing towards Xue Li, his long knife swung, ready to decapitate him.
In mid-air, a fierce light flashed in Xue Li's eyes. A reluctant roar came from his throat. His blood seemed to ignite, giving off puffs of white smoke, and a terrible power was accumulating, on the verge of eruption.
"Is this the strange Burst Blood Battle Intent again?" Yuan Ming thought in amazement as he twisted his wrist, and the Map of Ten Thousand Realms instantly appeared in front of him.
There, an intensely dark spot on the map, which seemed impossible to dissipate, was eroding the painting, trying to break free from its confines.
"This is yours; I'm returning it to you now," Yuan Ming shouted.
As his words fell, a bright light shone on the Map of Ten Thousand Realms, and the dark spot, as if it had found an outlet, turned into a jet-black stream vortex, violently breaking free.
The tide of corrosive black mist emptied in an instant, all pouring towards Xue Li.
The blood qi he was about to ignite was instantly inundated by the corrosive black mist, rapidly dissolving.
And he, like a firecracker that was about to explode, had his flames extinguished by a bucket of cold water; the power he had accumulated also fizzled out, and his last resistance was erased.
Yuan Ming's figure blurred slightly, without any delay, he caught up and swung his long knife across, easily plucking the head from Xue Li's heavily injured body.
The decapitated head, soaring through the air, flickered with blood light on the brow, and a tiny pitch-black figure burst forth, a small face shrouded in demonic qi, full of terror, bearing a striking resemblance to Xue Li.
The moment the dark infant appeared, it glimmered with dark light and hastily fled away.
But the Demon Infant's near-instantaneous escape ability proved futile in front of Yuan Ming, a Soul Cultivator.
Yuan Ming simply spread his hand, and the Great Black Sky God Palm descended, enveloping the surrounding space.
Soon, Xue Li's Demon Infant appeared in his palm, wrapped in Soul Power infused with the Power of the Sun, the face twisted in agony, the figure writhing, struggling in vain.
Yuan Ming, emotionless, raised his hand to stick a talisman on the Demon Infant's head, then easily scooped him up. With a wave of his hand, the Shura Blood Devouring Map unfurled, the blood-colored vortex within churning, and it effortlessly consumed Xue Li's broken corpse as well.
With that, Xue Li, who once considered himself unrivaled and did not even regard the Wu Yue God in high esteem, had finally been vanquished.
At this moment, Yuan Ming's expression slightly relaxed, his breaths heavy, sweat beaded on his forehead, and an unnatural flush tinged his cheeks.
Clearly, in this confrontation, although he had ultimately slain his opponent, it had not been a light effort, particularly the recent display of the Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill, which had depleted most of his strength.

chapters.title: Chapter 755 - 726 Break Array
chapters.content:
After a brief period of Breathing Control to regain some strength, Yuan Ming immediately returned to the front gate of Chang Chun Temple, where the battle had nearly reached its conclusion.
After Xi Ying had slain the Wu Yue God, the person most shocked was none other than her own father, Xi Zheng.
He had never imagined that his daughter had grown so powerful that even the Wu Yue God was no match for her.
It was not until this moment that he recognized his choice of path for the family was wrong, and so he ceased his resistance on the spot and chose to surrender.
Considering his relationship with Xi Ying, Wan Tianren and others simply detained him for the time being instead of taking his life.
Ni Mu only felt the tide had turned after witnessing Wulu slay the Blood Demon Ancestor.
However, he went even further than Xi Zheng, not only by stopping his resistance but also by turning his blade around on the spot, betraying his own and beginning to slay the disciples of the Wu Yue Sect.
Due to his betrayal on the battlefield, the already declining forces of the Wu Yue Sect suddenly displayed a rout.
This unexpected development even left Tian Jizi stunned.
Upon Yuan Ming's return, with the head of Xue Li in his hand, he bellowed, "Xue Li is dead, do you still wish to stubbornly resist?"
The followers of the Wu Yue Sect were intimidated by his voice, which was as imposing as the tolling of a great bell, and they were terrified.
On one hand, they were frightened by the consecutive deaths of their leader-level figures; on the other, they were suppressed by the Divine Soul Power embedded within Yuan Ming's voice.
"At this point, surrender is but a path to death," Luo Yongqi said through clenched teeth, his face fierce.
As one of the early cultivators who had joined the Wu Yue Sect, he knew that once defeated, the other Sects would surely not spare them, and their fate would be even more miserable than that of the Xi Family, which was originally a subordinate of the Wu Yue Sect.
Therefore, he had no intention of surrendering.
There were not a few who thought like him. A desperate battle became their last hope in the anticipation that they could delay long enough for the Breaking Realm Transfer Array to establish a pathway to the Demon World, possibly reversing the situation once more.
Apart from them, there were also the refining corpse puppet army, created by Demonic Qi, who continued to ruthlessly attack the forces of the Cloud Desolate Alliance, causing both sides to suffer extreme casualties.
The entire Chang Chun Temple was like a great grindstone of flesh and blood; no matter how many were fed into it, they would be ground into bloody remnants, leaving limbs and torsos scattered everywhere, rivers of blood flowing.
After a period of Breathing Control, Xi Ying approached her father.This is a sample from *. Read the rest on *.
The man, who had always been domineering, now seemed to have aged tenfold, his form slightly stooped, his expression complex.
As his daughter approached, his lifted gaze showed more confusion and guilt than anything else.
"You were right, I chose the wrong path and led the Xi Family astray, sacrificing too many of our people. I deserve to die," Xi Zheng said, unable to meet his daughter's gaze, sighing deeply.
"I didn't come here to hear this, father. There is still time, quickly tell me where the Breaking Realm Transfer Array is located and how to break it," Xi Ying asked with furrowed brows.
Wan Tianren and the others also looked over at this moment.
Xi Zheng's eyes flashed, knowing that his daughter was giving him one last chance at redemption, and he didn't hesitate to say:
"After the incident with Yuan Ming, the Wu Yue God and the Blood Demon Ancestor added a layer of the Soul Capturing Array on top of the original Protective Array. If you want to break it, you must have a strong will and a powerful Divine Soul. Otherwise, if the Array Restriction is triggered, the Array will capture your Divine Soul."
"I'll go and break the Array myself," Xi Ying nodded and said.
"Furthermore, apart from the external Protective Array, the Breaking Realm Transfer Array itself is a spatial Array and is inherently indestructible. Without a special Magic Treasure, it's impossible to break it. Merely shattering the black Stone Pillars will do nothing; by now, the power controlling that Array may no longer be on our side," continued Xi Zheng.
Upon hearing this, Xi Ying's gaze flickered briefly, and a sudden feeling of dread arose in her heart.
She immediately turned to Wan Tianren and said, "I'll leave him in your hands."
"Rest assured, with me here, he won't escape, nor will anything happen to him," Wan Tianren obviously understood her meaning and promptly nodded in assurance.
Xi Ying nodded, then leaped up, but instead of heading directly to Chaotian Peak, she flew beside Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming, about to further demoralize the remnants by killing Luo Yongqi, saw Xi Ying approach with a grave expression.
"Never mind these people for now, we need to hurry and destroy the Breaking Realm Transfer Array. According to my calculations, the portal to the Demon World is about to open," Xi Ying said urgently.
Yuan Ming's expression shifted slightly upon hearing this and he immediately turned his head towards Chaotian Peak.
He saw that the mountain top was still shrouded in Demonic Clouds, but within the tumultuous black clouds, a hint of Blood Light was already faintly visible; he could even feel the rippling of space from there.
"Good, let's go," Yuan Ming grabbed Xi Ying's wrist, and together they flew towards Chaotian Peak.
In an instant, the two arrived below Chaotian Peak and could immediately see the huge Array enveloping the entire mountain.
"Wait here for a moment, I'll break the Array," Yuan Ming said.
With a raise of his arms in front of him, the Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill roared into action. The Qi Blood Power churned within his body like boiling water, bursting forth with an unrivaled strength, as a Blood-colored Giant Elephant emerged out of nothingness.
Last time he came, he had used the spatial shuttling power of the Undying Tree to break in so as not to alert the enemy. Now, he had no such concerns, seeking only to breach the defenses as quickly as possible.
Just as Xi Ying was about to say something, Yuan Ming had already taken a vigorous step and charged forward.
The blood-colored giant elephant that shrouded his body also swung its trunk, colliding head-on with the vast light screen that enveloped the entire Chaotian Peak.
"Boom..."
A loud sound like a bell ringing erupted!
The whole Chaotian Peak shook violently, and streaks of black light lit up from the Forbidden Light Screen around it, converging at the waist of the mountain to form an immense pitch-black ghost face.
The ghost face, twisted in ferocity, with horns on its head, opened its abyss-like maw towards Yuan Ming and roared silently.
From the gaping maw, a profound black vortex emerged, exerting an incredibly strong suction force.
Yuan Ming only glanced at it and felt his Divine Soul tremble, almost giving him the illusion that it was about to be drawn out of his body by that force.
Fortunately, his Divine Soul was stable enough to not actually be captured.
At that moment, a dazzling golden light suddenly burst forth from beside Yuan Ming, followed by a basin-sized blazing sun appearing out of thin air, speeding towards the ghastly ghost face.
The vortex from the ghastly ghost face was meant to capture the Divine Soul, and since the golden sun contained a highly pure Divine Soul Power, it flew unobstructed into the gaping maw.
The mouth of the ghost face suddenly closed, as if it had swallowed the golden sun into its belly.
But in the next instant, golden cracks erupted all over the ghost face, followed by dozens of blinding golden rays piercing through, tearing it apart.
Accompanied by a "bang," the ghastly ghost face exploded into fragments.
Yuan Ming's body also slammed into the protective barrier of Chaotian Peak, causing the massive light screen that enveloped the entire mountain to collapse and dissipate.
As this layer of the barrier collapsed, the pure Demon Qi that was condensed all over the mountain suddenly scattered, flooding towards Chang Chun Temple like a torrential flood.
The puppets, which were originally refined from demonic Qi, became even more aggressive under the nourishment of the surging demonic Qi, attacking the Cloud Desolate Alliance's army with increased ferocity.
Although the alliance members had already gained an overwhelming advantage, they were exhausted and drained, with no choice but to brace themselves and charge into the fray.
As Yuan Ming and Xi Ying leaped toward the mountain peak, they both spontaneously sent out blazing flames towards the top, spreading a sea of fire that engulfed the Magic Cloud Trees translating Spiritual Power into demonic Qi.
Soon after, they reached the summit of Chaotian Peak and saw the Great Array.
Yuan Ming discovered that, unlike the last time he saw it, at the center of the array in front of him, instead of an intertwined mass of light and dark Qi, there was a blood-colored sphere as big as a giant's eyeball.
In the center of the blood-colored sphere was a vertical black crack, resembling the slit pupil of an eye, with strong fluctuations of space undulating around it and dense black mist seeping out, impossible to dissipate.
Above the sky, within the terrifying mass of demon clouds, a huge gap was still open, allowing streams of daylight to leak through and illuminate the massive Demon Array below.
Countless streams of Primordial Qi poured into the array like a funnel of daylight.
Yuan Ming was about to step forward when the Storage Bag once again transmitted a restlessness, with the Sky-reaching Demon Pillar nearly unable to be contained and about to burst forth on its own.
However, at that moment, Xi Ying suddenly spoke, "My father said that since this Great Array has harnessed the power of space and has taken on its full form, ordinary methods can't break it. Perhaps the Sky-reaching Demon Pillar is required."
"When it emerged last time, it absorbed a lot of the pure Demon Qi from the array and recovered its original form. If it comes out again, I'm afraid it will be the same. But this item also has the ability to break open the void. Once it is released, whether the outcome will be good or bad, I too, can hardly predict," Yuan Ming said hesitantly.
He didn't want to take the risk and chose to forcibly suppress the Sky-reaching Demon Pillar, not allowing it to emerge rashly.
"Your concerns aren't unfounded, let's try other methods first," Xi Ying replied thoughtfully, after hearing him.
Having said that, the two began to act simultaneously, launching attacks on the black Stone Pillars atop the mountain.
In an instant, the summit of Chaotian Peak was ablaze with fire, and the sound of explosions was incessant.
The black Stone Pillars shattered and exploded one after another, turning into dust.
In a short time, they had destroyed the entire Great Array made of black pillars.
However, the Magic Pattern Array Map suspended in mid-air did not change at all, and the blood-colored sphere, like a giant's eye, still hung in the air. The black slit in it, resembling a vertical pupil, had instead widened slightly.
Yuan Ming's gaze grew sharp, and he took a deep breath as the Blood Qi in his body boiled once again.
His figure shot out straight as a bullet, with the blood-colored giant elephant materializing in mid-air and directly colliding with the blood-colored giant eye.
However, his form along with the blood-colored elephant was stopped ten feet away from the blood-colored eye by an invisible barrier.
Folds visible to the naked eye rippled through the void; these weren't ripples from the impact of force but wrinkles formed by the space being solidified, under the impact of an external force.

chapters.title: Chapter 756 - 727 I Fall in Love with the Green Mountains at First Sight
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming's brows were tightly furrowed, his heart clear that relying solely on the power of the Blood-colored Giant Elephant would not be enough to break through the Great Array.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, the force of space here is solidified, and only the Sky-reaching Demon Pillar can break through it. If you can control the Sky-reaching Demon Pillar the moment it breaks open and retract it, perhaps there won't be a big issue," Qi Ye's voice rang out in his Sea of Consciousness.
Yuan Ming sighed inwardly, knowing that Qi Ye was right and that there was no other choice at the moment.
Made up his mind, he no longer suppressed the Sky-reaching Demon Pillar but instead opened his Storage Bag, granting it freedom.
In the next instant, a dark light shot out from the Storage Bag, heading straight for the Great Array without any need for Yuan Ming's encouragement, its body flickering with light, and it plummeted into the solidified void ahead.
One after another, the patterns on the Sky-reaching Demon Pillar lit up, emanating a Forbidden Breaking power, and the solid void in front of it, substantial as reality, disintegrated rapidly as if encountering its natural nemesis.
"Crack, crack," sounds of fracturing filled the air as the wrinkled void began to reveal a network of semi-transparent fissures crisscrossing each other.
After a moment's stalemate, the solidified space shattered immediately.
The Sky-reaching Demon Pillar, like it had punctured the sky itself, tore a gap in the void and charged straight for that Blood-colored Giant Eye.
At the same time, from all directions, black Demonic Qi surged forth, gathering ceaselessly toward the Sky-reaching Demon Pillar and gradually forming a black vortex around it.
A "humming" vibration emanated continuously from the Sky-reaching Demon Pillar. Along with its trembling, within the Blood-colored Giant Eye, the black "vertical pupil" began to split open at a speed visible to the naked eye.
The opening of the passage quickened.
At that moment, a claw covered in black Scale Armor suddenly reached out from the black fissure, seemingly attempting to grab the soaring Sky-reaching Demon Pillar.
"Not good!"
Yuan Ming's pupils suddenly contracted, and with a thought, he surged forth all the power within his body without reservation.
Wrapped in the Blood-colored Giant Elephant, he surged forward with great speed, leveraging its massive body to beat the Sky-reaching Demon Pillar to the punch, crashing into the Blood-colored Giant Eye.
With a "boom," a tremendous noise erupted, and a huge burst of blood-colored brilliance exploded from the Blood-colored Giant Eye. A large Blood Mist steamed up into the sky, forming a Blood Cloud that surged and spread, the shockwaves rolling out to a hundred miles around.
Gales, sharp as knives, swept through in all directions, cutting down trees on the peak and halfway up the mountain, whipping up countless fragments of smoke and dust, floating in the air, hanging there for a long moment without falling.
The Cloud Desolate Alliance cultivators and the last resisting Wu Yue Sect members, still engaged in battle at the foot of the mountain, were all startled by this earth-shaking tremor. They stopped fighting involuntarily, their faces filled with panic as they looked toward Chaotian Peak.
The peak was still a chaotic mess, nothing could be seen clearly.
But everyone knew that whether the Shura-like slaughter would come to an end depended entirely on the outcome there.
After a time, from the chaotic peak, there came an extremely pleasing female voice.
The voice was not loud, yet it carried a powerful Divine Soul Power that penetrated directly into everyone's Sea of Consciousness, shaking their spirits:
"The Demon Array is destroyed!"
The rolling sound waves reverberated in the Sea of Consciousness of the crowd continuously, crushing the last bit of hope of all Wu Yue Sect followers and their affiliates. They were thoroughly defeated.
Thus, with the exception of the Yin Corpse Puppets who were still fighting fiercely, the remaining followers and traitors who had followed the Wu Yue Sect began to flee or to surrender, completely reduced to pigs and dogs at the mercy of others.
The Cloud Desolate Alliance members, without time to cheer, took full control of the situation.
At the summit in the chaotic currents, Yuan Ming sat down on the ground, depleted. He glanced at the fallen Sky-reaching Demon Pillar and finally let his heart rest a little.
After Xi Ying made her announcement, she was also hurriedly rushing towards him.
However, as soon as her gaze fell upon Yuan Ming, her expression drastically changed, and she shouted sharply:
"The magic is gone, the Soul Power dissipated."
She had already expended much from the fierce battle, and after using two word spells in succession, she suddenly turned pale, a sharp pain shooting through her head.
But she could not afford to pay attention to these issues at the moment; she pushed herself towards Yuan Ming with all her might.
Yuan Ming was half a beat slower to react, but he too sensed something was amiss. By the time he wanted to defend himself, it was already too late.
From the void where the Blood-colored Giant Eye had vanished, a black crack appeared out of thin air, and from it, a grey shadow dashed out, closing in on Yuan Ming with the swiftness of thunder, not leaving time to cover one's ears.
As Xi Ying shouted the word spell and Yuan Ming raised his arm, the grey shadow collided with Yuan Ming's body.
