With a "puh" sound, the grey shadow shattered upon impact, dissolving into a shimmering grey light, while Yuan Ming, as if struck by thunder, stiffened violently. Blood streamed from his eyes, ears, mouth, and nose, and he tilted to the side, collapsing to the ground.
Xi Ying, shocked, rushed to Yuan Ming's side and caught him. She quickly realized his pupils were dilated, clearly having suffered a severe trauma to his Divine Soul.
She hastily examined him and was immediately shocked to discover that Yuan Ming's Three Souls and Seven Spirits were shaking violently, as if they were about to crumble and collapse at any moment.
Yuan Ming's trauma to his Divine Soul was identical to that suffered previously in the Shura Palace, but the extent of the damage was clearly far more severe.
Xi Ying had no idea what had injured Yuan Ming, and there was no time to investigate at the moment. She only knew that if she didn't act quickly, Yuan Ming's life would likely be lost.
At the critical moment, she raised her hand and wielded it, an octagonal compass flying out, landing on the ground and lighting up, transforming into a purple light array spanning over ten zhang, which enveloped both of them like a canopy.
Xi Ying supported Yuan Ming to sit down cross-legged, while she herself sat opposite him, their bodies close to each other.
A blush crossed her cheeks, and a hint of constraint passed through her eyes, but her movements were not the least bit delayed.
Xi Ying leaned forward slightly, pressing her snow-white forehead gently against Yuan Ming's, feeling his somewhat confused breathing, her heartbeat suddenly became a little erratic.
Although this was not their first time in such close contact, Xi Ying still couldn't erase a trace of embarrassment from her heart.
After all, the last time they employed Xiao Ying's body, but this time it was her own.
However, she quickly steadied her mind, a vast soul power emerged from between her eyebrows, forming delicate threads with glimmering points of light that slowly extended into Yuan Ming's Sea of Consciousness.
Their divine souls connected, and their soul powers merged.
Yuan Ming dreamt again.
He once again dreamt that his divine soul had freed itself from the confines of his physical body and entered that vast, white space.
The wind there was light and brisk, the water warm and gentle, like the tides' ebb and flow, ceaselessly whispering over and cleansing his divine soul, rescuing him from the pain of tearing and shattering.
But this time, he was not passively receiving the nourishment and purification from this space.
As his divine soul gradually stabilized, all the pain subsided, and a delightful joy overwhelmed him.
Immersed in it, he did not become obliviously joyful because, within this strange space, he felt an incredibly familiar presence that irresistibly attracted him, leading him to seek it out.
In the dream, his gaze scanned left and right, but the surroundings were shrouded in thick mist, preventing him from seeing clearly.
The more Yuan Ming wanted to see things clearly, the heavier the mist became, as though deliberately obstructing him.
"Why insist on blocking my view?" Yuan Ming couldn't help feeling a surge of irritation.
With this emotion rising, the fluctuation of his soul power suddenly became intense, and the warm waters around him seemed to be affected, boiling and steaming instantly.
"Yuan Ming, calm your mind and nurture your nature, do not act recklessly," Xi Ying's voice suddenly rang out as if originating from Yuan Ming's Sea of Consciousness.
Her words alone quieted Yuan Ming.
As he settled down, the chaos around him also subsided.
Yuan Ming composed himself, looking forward, he saw the mist gradually thinning until a graceful figure emerged before him.
How vain it is for cloud to obscure the eyes, when one is in the midst of the mountains.
Once the clouds dispersed, Yuan Ming saw Xi Ying at a glance, with her long black hair draped over her shoulders, her body bare, her skin lustrous as jade, her eyes subtly glowing, resembling a fairy bathing, spring beauty unfolded before the world.
With just one glance, Yuan Ming's heart seemed to stop beating, and he could no longer divert his eyes.
"Focus, this is the true form of our divine souls; I, I… am healing you," realizing Yuan Ming's gaze, Xi Ying's voice was somewhat stiff in her reminder.
Yuan Ming, however, didn't take it in at all. For a moment, he felt as if his mind had exploded, his mind in a tumultuous mess, all emotions rushing to his heart at once.
"When I see the green mountains, I am utterly enamored. Surely, the green mountains regard me in the same way," he thought nonsensically of his own past poetry.Thi^s c+o.ntent is p-res^e$n-te&d by M4$VL+E*M.PY&R.&
It seemed like a murmur to himself, yet also a query.
"Indeed," the voice of Xi Ying sounded, soft yet sincere.
"Haha..."
Yuan Ming heard clearly, and in that moment, he felt that such contentment was all one could wish for in life.
In the next instant, his thoughts became clear, and his divine soul achieved perfect harmony with Xi Ying's, guided and nourished by her Word Witch powers, finally taking that difficult step forward.
A small storm suddenly arose in his Sea of Consciousness, and his Divine Soul Power began to run wildly.
Yuan Ming felt empty, an indescribable emptiness, as if his Sea of Consciousness was a bottomless pit, filled with an insatiable void.
At that moment, he needed a substantial amount of Divine Soul Power to fill that emptiness.
Xi Ying abruptly opened her eyes and saw that Yuan Ming was breaking through his shackles, starting to assault the Word Witch Realm, and her heart was at first filled with immense surprise and then endless worry.
The last time she broke through to the Word Witch Realm, it was the Pure Will Power within the White Jade Lotus Platform that filled the void and led to her advancement.
But that was after Yuan Ming unknowingly accumulated for how long, refined and condensed into pure power, which she exhausted. Up until now, not much had been accumulated.
The situation was urgent now. If Yuan Ming's Sea of Consciousness did not quickly get the soul power it needed, his path to the Word Witch Realm would be severed, and his Sea of Consciousness would likely collapse, eventually turning into a pitiful soulless man.

chapters.title: Chapter 757 - 728: Life and Death Reincarnation Path
chapters.content:
Xi Ying's eyes were thick with urgency as she inadvertently glanced towards the battlefield below.
"There's no other way, it can only be like this," she decided with a resolute flash in her eyes, raising her hand and waving towards the sky.
A small black kettle flew up into the air, with its lid popping open by itself, as a beam of golden light burst forth, flying straight into Yuan Ming's forehead.
This golden light, nourished and refined by Xi Ying from a large number of residual souls, was exactly what Yuan Ming needed at the moment.
Unfortunately, this power was merely a drop in the bucket for Yuan Ming; he needed much more soul power infusion to fill the void of the Word Witch and stabilize his realm.
The purpose of Xi Ying summoning the Soul Suppressing Kettle, of course, wasn't just this paltry amount of soul power.
In the next instant, she pointed from afar, and the runes on the Soul Suppressing Kettle immediately lit up, with the silhouette of an exotic beast's head faintly emerging from the body of the kettle, abruptly opening its enormous maw.
Streams of yin wind originated from that gaping maw, emitting bursts of silent roars.
The cultivators below suddenly felt a chill up their spines, faintly sensing that their divine souls seemed to be targeted by something strange.
However, this sensation did not last long before it faded away.
But all around Chang Chun Temple, bursts of yin wind began to whip up, one by one, the yin souls of the dead — whether fearful, fierce, unwilling, or angry — all seemed called by some summons, competing to fly towards the top of Chaotian Peak.
Countless residual shadows of yin souls whistled like the wind, drawn by an invisible call, merging into the gaping maw of the monstrous beast on the Soul Suppressing Kettle.
The Soul Suppressing Kettle in mid-air shook violently as murky glows spewed from its mouth, continuously surging towards Yuan Ming's forehead, all rushing into his Sea of Consciousness, filling into the bottomless vortex.
As this motley soul power continued to pour in, Yuan Ming's face gradually twisted, and amidst his unconscious state, a carousel of emotions like joy, anger, sorrow, fear, and sadness played out on his face in rapid succession.
Finally, it settled into a bizarre expression, half-crying, half-smiling, with one side of the smiling face shedding tears and one side of the crying face squinting.
After a long while, the originally turbulent and gloomy atmosphere inside and around Chang Chun Temple cleared up, with all sorts of miserable scenes remaining, yet the sensation filled with malicious and malevolent aura had disappeared.
All of this, as if it had been a dream.
Tian Jizi and the other Nascent Soul cultivators of Chang Chun Temple were initially unsettled, but then they realized that, apart from this, no other anomalies occurred. Considering that Chang Chun Temple had been spared a great ceremony, even without their intervention, this place would no longer degenerate into a breeding ground for malevolent spirits.
At the mountain's peak, Xi Ying quietly guarded Yuan Ming.
After a good while, Yuan Ming slowly opened his eyes, with intense emotions flashing through his trembling pupils.
Xi Ying's gaze narrowed, and her heart sank suddenly.
Yuan Ming closed his eyes and after taking a deep breath, he smiled at Xi Ying and said,
"Don't worry, I'm fine."
Time passed unknowably.
Once Yuan Ming gathered the Divine Soul Power scattered during the breakthrough and completely stabilized his realm, he opened his eyes.
Greeting him was Xi Ying's embrace.
"You're not hurt... that's really great." Xi Ying tightly hugged Yuan Ming's body, burying her head in his shoulder, her voice tinged with a sob.
For her, Yuan Ming's safety was always the most important.
Therefore, compared to Yuan Ming's healing from his divine soul injury, the breakthrough into the Word Witch became an insignificant addition.
When you truly like someone, you don't care about their achievements; you only care about whether they are well or not.
Yuan Ming, feeling Xi Ying's emotions, gently stroked her back and rested his chin on her shoulder.
"I worried you," he whispered softly.
Intense emotions melted into the simple words, and the two held each other silently, enjoying the warmth that belonged only to them.
However, after a moment, as Xi Ying's emotions gradually settled, she finally realized what she had just done. The surging wave of emotion quickly ebbed away, ultimately exposing her shy vulnerability.
She grabbed Yuan Ming's shoulders and abruptly straightened her arms, wriggling out of his embrace. With her face already flushed with embarrassment, she didn't even dare to look up, to let Yuan Ming see her current expression.
"How... how does it feel to break through to the Word Witch?" Xi Ying awkwardly changed the subject, her speech stumbling a bit.
Yuan Ming smiled wryly, suddenly entertaining the thought of teasing her a bit further.
However, upon further thought, considering Xi Ying's temperament, if the teasing was taken too far, it wouldn't be surprising if she used the excuse of helping him get used to his power to pick a fight with him to disguise her embarrassed rage.
It's a rare moment of warmth; better not do something to ruin the mood, he thought.
"It's very different from before, it feels like stepping into an entirely new realm," Yuan Ming continued along the lines of what Xi Ying had said.
"Yes, I have that feeling too. The cultivation of the Word Witch God seems to also require the absorption of a special power as assistance. Although I am not clear about what it is at the moment, just this aspect alone distinguishes it from the former Soul Cultivation Realm," Xi Ying admitted.
Seeing Yuan Ming not teasing her, Xi Ying also breathed a sigh of relief. As the coy emotions within her heart settled, she lifted her head once again, reverting to her usual demeanor.
"Indeed, and after the breakthrough, several of my Divine Skills have undergone qualitative changes. For example, with soul collision, I now only need to touch the enemy's body for it to work rather than having to strike at the Divine Soul. There's also this one," she said.
Yuan Ming, on the other hand, felt a bit of regret, though he didn't show it and, while speaking, he suddenly raised his hand and released two soul crows, demonstrating the enhanced Crow Cry Divine Skill after the breakthrough to Xi Ying.
Both of the soul crows he released opened their beaks in unison, neither emitting sound nor generating sound waves. However, with Yuan Ming pointing forward, a powerful sonic explosion suddenly burst forth in the void not far away.
"I can now converge the Crow Cry from multiple soul crows at a single point for a combined explosion, which is more powerful than before," Yuan Ming explained.
"That's quite impressive. What about the new Divine Skill you've obtained? Tell me about it," Xi Ying nodded and then asked.
"Life and Death Reincarnation Path. As for the type... it should be considered an offensive tactic, I suppose. It's a bit like a combination of my previous abilities," Yuan Ming stroked his chin and said ambiguously.
"What do you mean?" Xi Ying grew more curious.
"Specifically, this new Divine Skill can create an independent space, trapping the enemy's Divine Soul inside, subjecting it to attacks from abilities such as Crow Cry, Soul Search, Emotion Manipulation, Nightmare, and so on, until the Divine Soul collapses into pure Soul Power and complete memories, which I can utilize at will," Yuan Ming detailed.
"Can you demonstrate it for me?" Xi Ying was interested and took out a soul from the Soul Suppressing Kettle and handed it to Yuan Ming.
"Besides me, nobody else can see what happens inside the space; there's nothing much to see," Yuan Ming said, yet he still took the soul and demonstrated for Xi Ying.
He threw the soul out with a flick of his hand, and a flash of dark light in his eyes created a black vortex out of thin air above the soul's head, which immediately sucked the soul in.The full series is hosted on *, known as *.
Then, to let Xi Ying see clearly what happened inside the space of the Divine Skill, he specifically used an Illusion Technique to project the scene for her.
In a pitch-black space, the soul thrown by Yuan Ming stood all alone, still confused by what was happening. It suddenly found itself assaulted from all directions by countless sound waves bombarding it.
After a barrage of sound waves, a large, murky hand appeared above the soul, forcibly extracting memories from it. It reconstructed parts of those memories with Illusions and subjected the soul to them.
The soul was forced to relive the most unforgettable experiences of its life over again, its emotions fluctuating violently, slowly collapsing from within.
The soul summoned by Xi Ying was not of a high class, so before it fully experienced all of Yuan Ming's Divine Skills, it completely dissipated within the black space, turning into the purest Soul Power and merging into Yuan Ming's Sea of Consciousness.
At the same time, a small, blue crystal the size of a pinky finger appeared in Yuan Ming's hand, which contained the life memories of that soul.
"This ability, when used, will consume additional Soul Power depending on the target and occupy soul crows. If the Soul Power runs out, the ability will also end by itself. With my current reserves of Soul Power, if I were to face the Wuyue God, I probably couldn't kill him in one strike. As for the lethality, it's actually not as good as your Divine Skills," Yuan Ming shook his head, seemingly not satisfied.
"Be content. My Word Witch Divine Skill is specifically geared towards attack and also has a restraining effect on the soul and evil entities. Besides, you've just broken through. With more familiarity with your abilities, the role they can play and the range of their application will be much greater than my Divine Skills," Xi Ying rolled her eyes.
Yuan Ming gave a slight smile, not denying it.
"By the way, about the Storage Ring of the Wuyue God, I feared he might have left some tricks behind, so I haven't checked it yet. Now that you've also made a breakthrough, we can join forces, and we won't have to worry about him causing any more trouble. Shall we take a look now?" Xi Ying said as she took out the Storage Ring surrounded by Soul Power and the faceless stone statue.
Yuan Ming naturally had no objections.
The two immediately utilized Divine Soul Transformation, sealing the space around them to prevent any bit of power from escaping before they undid the Soul Power seal on the Storage Ring.
However, their worries seemed to be unnecessary as the Wuyue God had clearly not anticipated his defeat and didn't leave any contingencies in the Storage Ring.
Or rather, there was hardly anything of significance inside the Storage Ring Xi Ying had captured.
A few top-grade spiritual stones, a large lump of mud-like spiritual materials, and six Soul Cultivation Methods - that was everything.
"That's all the Wuyue God had?" Yuan Ming was somewhat surprised.
"Why would he carry resources with him when the Wu Yue Sect would collect what he wanted?" Xi Ying realized.
"In other words, whatever he carried on him must have been extremely important. Let's not talk about the spiritual stones and the Cultivation Methods for now, but what is this spiritual material?" Yuan Ming asked curiously.
The mud-like spiritual material was dark red and very sticky; no matter how much Yuan Ming and Xi Ying pulled, they could not tear it apart.
On the outside, the material looked plain with no aura of light, but the moment they touched it, they could immediately sense the surging Spiritual Power within. Clearly, it was of a high grade.
Despite studying it for a while, Yuan Ming and Xi Ying couldn't determine its exact origin and had to put it aside, planning to investigate it later.

chapters.title: Chapter 758 - 729: Don't Want to Be Left Behind by You
chapters.content:
Among the relics left by the Wuyue God, other than spiritual materials, the only other objects worth paying attention to were the cultivation techniques.
Yuan Ming and Xi Ying, upon examining them, were both surprised and delighted.
Among the six soul cultivation methods in the ring, aside from the Moonlight Technique, the other five were the Moon Gazing Technique, the Six Desires Breaking Emotion Great Method, the Nine Nether Soul Transformation Technique, the Seven Emotions Rejoice Technique, and the Evil Spirit Splitting Shadow Technique.
The most crucial aspect was that all six methods could be cultivated to the Word Witch Realm without any content missing upon preliminary judgment.
"Tsk tsk, the Wuyue God really lived up to his reputation of domineering for so many years; his foundation is truly substantial. Across the entire Yunhuang, it's rare to see methods that can be cultivated to the Word Witch Realm, and here he has six of them," Yuan Ming took a while to recover his composure before showing amazement.
"It's true when they say the Wuyue God monopolized the soul cultivation techniques of Yunhuang. Before him, it's not that there were no soul cultivation legacies in Yunhuang. These likely were deliberately collected by him to prevent others from breaking through to the Word Witch Realm; for this, he did not hesitate to kill. The taboo against soul cultivation in all major sects of the Yunhuang Continent is somewhat related to the Wuyue God's massacre back in the day," Xi Ying said, shaking her head.
Yuan Ming deeply agreed and then began to examine the techniques with Xi Ying.
Soon, they discovered that aside from the Moonlight Technique and the Moon Gazing Technique, the other methods all had certain drawbacks.
The Six Desires Breaking Emotion Great Method was one of the most pure forms of soul cultivation techniques. However, when cultivated to the seventh layer, the previously sealed six desires had a significant chance to evolve into heart demons, counterattacking the host at regular intervals.
The Nine Nether Soul Transformation Technique was quite peculiar; it required the practitioner to disperse their previous cultivation progress and start over with each breakthrough, although with each repetition, their power would greatly increase. However, once the cultivator reached the seventh layer, they would temporarily lose their memory every ninety-nine years, which would only recover after nine days.
The Seven Emotions Rejoice Technique, in contrast to the Six Desires Breaking Emotion Great Method, sought the extreme of pleasure to sublime the divine soul. Nevertheless, after reaching the seventh layer, it made the cultivator crave a certain emotion intensely at regular intervals, possibly affecting their sanity to some extent. The o&ri#gin^a.l! s$o$urce@ is *..-
The Evil Spirit Splitting Shadow Technique would split the cultivator's divine soul into several parts as the technique's cultivation deepened. Normally, these split parts of the soul could be used as clones to face enemies. However, there was no hierarchy between the clones and the main body; each possessed their own consciousness, and a slight mistake could lead to a struggle for dominance...
"These techniques are truly eye-opening, uniquely eerie indeed," Yuan Ming couldn't help but sigh.
"The Wuyue God likely cultivated the Moon Gazing Technique. It seems that in some details, this technique has quite a few similarities with the Moonlight Technique," Xi Ying said with a frown.
"While the two methods have their differences, combined with your judgment, I have a guess that these two techniques might have come from the same creator," Yuan Ming pondered.
"Not impossible. The Moon Gazing Technique is false in external reliance, while the Moonlight Technique is refined in inner cultivation; there's a complementary meaning between the two," Xi Ying responded thoughtfully upon hearing this.
"Eh, the Moon Gazing Technique states that when cultivating to the seventh layer, a special altar must be built to invoke the power of moonlight for cultivation. Is this moonlight power the special force you mentioned that is needed for the Word Witch Realm cultivation?" Yuan Ming suddenly exclaimed softly.
"Indeed... but only the Moonlight Technique and the Moon Gazing Technique mentioned the existence of moonlight power. Could it be that this is a unique requirement for these two methods?" Xi Ying frowned.
"I don't think necessarily. Perhaps the Moon Gazing Technique and the Moonlight Technique were methods obtained by the Wuyue God from the Overseas World, while the other four techniques were indigenous soul cultivation legacies of Yunhuang Continent. The latter's numerous drawbacks might be due to the lack of means to extract the power of moonlight, thereby causing accidents in the cultivation to the Word Witch Realm," Yuan Ming thought for a moment and seemed to have reached a conclusion.
"Well, in that case, if we could supplement the other four techniques with the method of obtaining the power of moonlight, wouldn't that eliminate their drawbacks? It would also be a good test to see if your guess is correct," Xi Ying suddenly said eagerly.
"It's not a bad idea, but our current knowledge is still slightly lacking; we'll talk about it when we've made more progress," Yuan Ming shook his head.
Xi Ying appeared somewhat disappointed but quickly put the matter out of her mind and continued to examine the techniques.
At that moment, Yuan Ming discovered something unexpected from the Moon Gazing Technique.
"Not only can the altar invoke the power of moonlight, but it can also be used to perform a heaven-worshipping ritual, thereby attaining a revered title unique to oneself and gaining the power to collect Desire Power... Strange, it seems that I've never carried out a heaven-worshipping ritual, yet I've been able to collect Desire Power with the help of the Stealing Heaven Tripod," Yuan Ming wondered.
"It seems the Stealing Heaven Tripod has more secrets than we thought," Xi Ying also exclaimed upon hearing this.
"By the way, you once mentioned that you had seen the appearance and name of the Stealing Heaven Tripod in a Wu Yue Sect classic. Do you still remember the name of that classic?" Yuan Ming suddenly asked.
"I remember it being called the Seeking Heaven Record," Xi Ying recalled after a moment.
"Well... I didn't see that classic in Black Witch Mountain," Yuan Ming said helplessly.
"If I remember correctly, that book was actually a travelogue that described many sceneries of the Overseas World from a personal perspective. I thought it was all fabricated, but now, it seems that there might actually be more truth to it," Xi Ying speculated.
"A travelogue? Maybe it wasn't regarded as an important classic. Later, we could ask Xu Che and others to pay more attention to it and see if they can find it," Yuan Ming suggested after some thought.
The topic was quickly put aside, and the two resumed their study of the cultivation techniques left by the Wuyue God. After deep contemplation, Xi Ying made a decision:
"I want to try switching to the Moon Gazing Technique. According to the description, the Wuyue God's black palace should be his 'altar.' It's currently preserved by the Cloud Desolation Alliance and still in good condition; it should be directly usable."
"Are you really giving up on the Moonlight Technique? Have you thought it through?" Yuan Ming asked, somewhat puzzled.
"The key to the Moon Gazing Technique lies in the altar, and now that we have something ready-made, why not use it? Besides, I don't have the Stealing Heaven Tripod. If I continue to cultivate the 'Moonlight Technique', my progress might be much slower than yours, and I might not even be able to break through in the future."
As she spoke, Xi Ying raised her head and looked into Yuan Ming's eyes.
"I don't want to fall behind you, not in the slightest." Her tone was incredibly serious at that moment.
Yuan Ming couldn't help but smile when he saw the determination in Xi Ying's eyes.
The Xi Ying he liked was always like this—unwilling to be second to anyone, always maintaining an elegance and pride akin to a cat.
"Then you must be careful, I won't stop and wait for you," Yuan Ming said with a laugh.
"That's for the best. Who asked you to let me?" Xi Ying retorted grumpily, suddenly raising her hand to punch Yuan Ming.
The punch was without mana, but Yuan Ming, who practiced the triple path of soul cultivation, had an incredibly tough physical body. Xi Ying's punch did not relieve her frustration; instead, it was her own hand that began to hurt.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming laughed even louder.
After a bit of playful scuffling, Xi Ying left in a huff, giving Yuan Ming the space he needed for seclusion.
After all, he had just broken through and needed time to stabilize his realm, and he couldn't stop refining the Stealing Heaven Tripod either. The power of his Lifebound Magical Treasure, the Soul Destroying Sword, was also starting to fall behind his strength, and he still had unresolved Magic Cultivation Technique issues. Although he had annihilated the Wu Yue Sect, there was still much to be done.
But ultimately, it wasn't as urgent anymore.
...
A few days later.
"My lord, we have found the person you were looking for," reported a subordinate.
Xu Che, who was cultivating, immediately raised an eyebrow upon hearing this.
"Where is he?" he asked indifferently.
"He's locked up in the spirit prison. However, he claims to be an undercover agent sent by Elder Chu of the Fire Origin Sect. But since Elder Chu is absent, no one can verify his identity, so he's been temporarily detained," the subordinate conveyed the information in full detail.
"An undercover agent? With him? Hah, take me to see for myself," Xu Che said decisively, rising to his feet and gesturing for his subordinates to lead the way.
After the great battle, the Cloud Desolation Alliance built a prison specifically to detain the majority of the Wu Yue Sect Cultivators and those who had joined them.
However, due to the large number of prisoners, the Alliance had not yet decided how to deal with them. They were simply ordered to be closely guarded while they discussed the outcome.
For safety's sake, the guards were elite cultivators chosen from different sects, highly alert. As Xu Che and his group approached, they were immediately stopped by someone.
"Fellow Daoist, this place is for detaining prisoners. Without a writ, you must not enter," stated a middle-aged Core Formation Cultivator, wearing a Chang Chun Temple Daoist robe, seriously.
"I am Xu Che of the Moon Sect. There is a prisoner here with whom I share a past, and I wish to meet with him. Please grant me this favor," Xu Che said politely.
"So it's Fellow Daoist Xu. Your request is not difficult, but according to the rules, I must verify your identity. Also, I must accompany you when you meet the prisoner. Please understand, fellow Daoist," the middle-aged Core Formation Cultivator's attitude softened immediately upon hearing the words "Moon Sect", and a smile appeared on his face.
"That is only reasonable," Xu Che nodded.
After verifying Xu Che's identity, the Core Formation Cultivator became even more amiable, and Xu Che dismissed his subordinates, following the Core Formation Cultivator from Chang Chun Temple alone into the spirit prison.
Soon, under the Core Formation Cultivator's guidance, in the area for detaining Foundation Establishment cultivators, Xu Che saw the person he was looking for.
In the dim prison cell sat a young man with disheveled hair. Special shackles on his feet sealed the mana within his body, leaving him in a wretched state, a far cry from his usual well-kept appearance.
At the sound of footsteps outside the cell, he immediately looked up hopefully, rushed to the bars, and shouted out:
"Is it Elder Chu from Fire Origin Sect? It's Zhou Lu; do you remember me?"

chapters.title: Chapter 759 - 730: Let Go
chapters.content:
When Xu Che took a few more steps closer, Zhou Lu saw that the person was not the one he had been waiting for and immediately felt a sense of loss, silently letting go of the iron bars and sitting back down.
Seeing that he hadn't recognized him, Xu Che subconsciously touched his face, his gaze flickering, wondering about something.
Zhou Lu, noticing that the visitor had not left and was still standing in front of his cell, subconsciously lifted his head again and took another look at Xu Che.
"You are…" he asked suspiciously.
"Hehe, have I changed so much that even you can't recognize me, uncle?" Xu Che chuckled softly.
"You... you are Xu Che!" Zhou Lu exclaimed as if struck by lightning.
"It seems uncle has not forgotten his nephew, good, but think about it, how unpredictable life is. The year you had me thrown in jail, it was in front of a cell like this where you told me many things. Now that the situation is reversed, I wonder if uncle still remembers what was said back then?"
As Xu Che spoke, he suddenly reached out and tapped the iron bars in front of him, immediately producing a crisp sound that rang in Zhou Lu's ears and shook his heart.
"…from now on, you and the Zhou Family will have no more involvement… but, but Xu Che, blood is thicker than water, after all, I am your uncle, your mother's brother. When you were little, I even carried you, you can't just watch me die! You have to save me! Xu Che, you have to save me!" Zhou Lu said, suddenly becoming emotional.
"Yes, I will save you, but before that, I need you to answer one question for me—how did my mother die?" Xu Che said, suddenly stepping close to the iron bars, staring at Zhou Lu, and pausing between each word.
"She, she died… of illness," Zhou Lu's lips trembled, and large beads of sweat rolled down his forehead.
"Is that so? I see," Xu Che said expressionlessly as he stood up straight, turned around, and left without saying another word.
"No, Xu Che, please, save me, I am your uncle, your real uncle, Xu Che, Xu Che!" Zhou Lu seemed to sense something and cried out desperately, but Xu Che never looked back.
"Thank you, Fellow Daoist," Xu Che said to the Nascent Soul cultivator from Chang Chun Temple who had led him into the spirit prison as he was leaving.
"It's a minor matter, Fellow Daoist Xu shouldn't take it to heart. However, about that Zhou Lu, do you need me to…" the middle-aged Nascent Soul Cultivator said, making a cutting gesture.
"No need, let bygones be bygones. I came here only to confirm an answer. Besides, in my childhood, he truly did assist my mother and me a great deal. It was only for the Immortal Path that things turned out this way. Anyway, it's time to let go," Xu Che sighed deeply, speaking both to the middle-aged Nascent Soul Cultivator and to himself.
After saying this, he felt as if he had finally freed himself from a heavy shackle, feeling a sense of relief.
Being unchained from the past is the only way to move toward the future.
Now, he was free.
Xu Che reflected on this, ready to leave, but suddenly he heard an argument nearby.
"Fellow Daoist Chu, I'm sorry, but by the rules, I can't let you go in," a Nascent Soul Cultivator dressed in Shengye Sect's robe firmly refused.
"Why, I'm just here to find a junior in Foundation Establishment; can't you bend the rules a little?" the Nascent Soul Cultivator from Fire Origin Sect, Chu Changkuang, said angrily.
Suddenly, he caught sight of Xu Che leaving the cell and grew even angrier.
"Wasn't it said that without an order from a Nascent Soul senior, no one could go in? How come he can enter and exit, whose backdoor did he go through?" Chu Changkuang pointed at Xu Che, asking bluntly.
However, before Xu Che could speak, the middle-aged Nascent Soul Cultivator beside him coughed and stepped forward first.
"This is Fellow Daoist Xu Che from the Moon Sect; entering the spirit prison was approved by our temple's Junior Master Liu," he explained.
"The Moon Sect? Could it be… Um, Fellow Daoist Xu, I apologize, I was just irritated, please don't take my words to heart," Chu Changkuang said, startled, hurriedly smoothing his expression and bowing apologetically to Xu Che.
"No worries," Xu Che said somewhat dispiritedly, waving his hand dismissively and leaving without another word.
After he left, Chu Changkuang wiped his sweat, originally planning to argue further, but the middle-aged Nascent Soul Cultivator from Chang Chun Temple spoke again.
"If I'm not mistaken, Fellow Daoist Chu, you were here to see Zhou Lu, right? I heard he was an undercover agent you placed in the Wu Yue Sect… tsk tsk, I should remind you, this Fellow Daoist Xu is Zhou Lu's nephew, and there seems to be some old grudges between them," the middle-aged Nascent Soul Cultivator said coolly.
"This… I understand, thank you for the reminder. That Zhou Lu, well, actually he's a fraud, using my reputation to flaunt himself everywhere. I came here to sever ties as well, and since it's inconvenient to enter by the rules, I won't go then," Chu Changkuang chuckled sheepishly and turned to leave.
The middle-aged Nascent Soul Cultivator squinted his eyes watching this scene and, after a moment, suddenly transmitted a message to the disciple guarding the spirit prison.
"Apply some techniques to that one called Zhou Lu, but remember not to kill him, record the process in a jade scroll, and send it to Fellow Daoist Xu later under my name," he ordered softly.
At the same time that Xu Che went to see his uncle, Yuan Ming's retreat location also welcomed two "guests."
The gate to the cave mansion was opened from outside, and Vajra walked in with Purple Thunder and Chi Xiao, whose Mana had been sealed.
"Master, I have brought Purple Thunder and Chi Xiao with me," said Vajra, bowing to Yuan Ming, who was meditating cross-legged in his seclusion.
"Junior Purple Thunder (Chi Xiao), greets Senior Yuan," Purple Thunder hurriedly bowed with clasped hands, their attitude extremely humble.
Though they were Nascent Soul cultivators, they were now prisoners and their lives hung on Yuan Ming's whim, compelling their utmost respect and humility.
Moreover, when Vajra brought them here, he had not spoken a word to them; they knew nothing of Yuan Ming's purpose for summoning them, which left them deeply anxious.
In their fearful unease, Yuan Ming slowly opened his eyes; his indifferent gaze swept over the two, making them involuntarily shiver.
"What took you so long?" Yuan Ming looked at Vajra.
"They couldn't defeat me, but they were quite fast at fleeing, so it took more time, please punish me, Master," Vajra said apologetically.
"No matter, bringing them back is your merit," Yuan Ming nodded, then his gaze shifted back to Purple Thunder.
"As elders of the Double Immortal Sect, you must be quite familiar with the disciples within your sect, right?"
"This... There are numerous disciples in the Double Immortal Sect, we dare not claim to know all of them, but at least..." Purple Thunder hurriedly began.
"Kato, do you recognize this person?" Yuan Ming impatiently raised his head, cutting him off and directly asking.
At this name, Chi Xiao's eyes showed a blank expression, while Purple Thunder pondered thoughtfully, but after a long pause, they seemed unable to recall who exactly this person was.
Yuan Ming's gaze grew increasingly impatient, and under the pressure, Purple Thunder desperately racked their brains, finally remembering something.
"Senior, I remember now! There was indeed someone named Kato managing Foundation Establishment in our sect years ago, said to have climbed up from the Outer Disciple ranks with outstanding talent. He topped the Sect's grand competitions several times. I was in Core Formation back then and even thought of taking him as a disciple, but he disappeared during an outing and never returned," Purple Thunder said quickly.
"Do you know his origin and background?" Yuan Ming continued to inquire while contemplating.
"He is from Luota Town in the Western Regions of the Southern Border. I even sent people to investigate him; he was from a local farming family, never left the town, and has a very clean background," Purple Thunder explained in detail.
"I understand now. Vajra, take them to Tian Jizi," Yuan Ming got the information he wanted and had no desire to keep them any longer.
As soon as the words were out, Vajra stepped forward, blocking Purple Thunder's view.
"As commanded," he said in a muffled voice, turning around and dragging Purple Thunder and Chi Xiao away.
"No, Senior Yuan, give us another chance, we are willing to be your followers, even if you place us under a seal. Don't send us back, Tian Jizi will surely kill us! Senior Yuan, Senior Yuan..." Purple Thunder and Chi Xiao became frantic.
However much they shouted, Yuan Ming showed no intention of paying them any heed.
Two Nascent Soul followers would have been a tantalizing prospect in the past, but Yuan Ming was now uninterested in dealing with these scheming fellows.Мy Virtuаl Librаry Еmpirе (М V L Е М Р Y R) аpprесiаtеs yоur rеаdеrship аt thе sоurсе.
Furthermore, whether it was Tian Jizi or the Cloud Desolation Alliance, none would dare refuse his requests now, even if some were discontented, at least they would make a show of compliance.
After Vajra took Purple Thunder away, Yuan Ming resumed his cultivation.
Over these days, his realm had mostly stabilized, and thanks to his advancement to Spoken Witch, his Soul Power had greatly increased. He made new breakthroughs in his mastery over the Stealing Heaven Tripod, unlocking up to thirty layers of its seals, deepening his connection with the Divine Artifact significantly.
In time, he would once again wield this artifact.
But before that, he likely needed to visit Luota Town as Purple Thunder had just mentioned.
Without clarifying the origins of the Stealing Heaven Tripod, he would never be at peace.
Yuan Ming was contemplating this when he suddenly sensed something, casting a spell to open the grand door of his cave mansion.
Moments later, Wulu appeared in front of him out of thin air.
"Hehe, Brother Yuan, did you know I was coming?" Wulu asked with a grin.
At this time, the injuries Wulu had sustained from his fight with the Blood Demon Ancestor had healed, and his strength was considerably enhanced compared to before.
"You deliberately leaked a trace of your aura outside; if I couldn't detect even that, I would hardly deserve to be called a Spoken Witch," Yuan Ming replied with a smile, emphasizing the words "Spoken Witch."
"Sss— You rascal, how did you advance again? We both entered Biluo Cave together, I even started on the Immortal Path before you, so how can I not catch up to you now?" Wulu drew in a breath of cold air, greatly frustrated.
"I have my own opportunities, and you're not doing badly either. With your current cultivation, aren't you close to advancing to Returning Void?" Yuan Ming replied with a smile.

chapters.title: Chapter 760 - 731 Arrangements
chapters.content:
"My cultivation is nearly at its limit, but a breakthrough is still far away. The Returning to Void Sky Barrier has stumped many Nascent Soul powers; whether I can truly cross it is still a matter of debate," Wulu shook his head, seemingly not too hopeful.
"As long as you don't give up, you will ultimately find an opportunity. If not in Yunhuang, you could also head overseas. Have you forgotten the Jade Talisman we obtained from the Three Immortals Island? Now that Yunhuang is stabilized, after some time, once we've tied up loose ends, I plan to set off. You might as well come with me," Yuan Ming invited.
"I still have some matters to handle in Yunhuang, I'll see when the time comes," Wulu waved his hand and said noncommittally.
"All right, speaking of which, where have you been these past few days? I heard that after the battle both you and the Blood Demon Ancestor had vanished. Had I not needed to stabilize my realm, I would have come looking for you," Yuan Ming asked.
"Hey, I didn't go anywhere. I was just lying on the battlefield slowly recovering my primordial qi, just invisible thanks to a Stone Talisman. Nobody would have thought of that." Wulu detailed the process of his encounter with the Blood Demon Ancestor.
"You devoured the Nascent Soul of the Blood Demon Ancestor? As a Returning Void, his Divine Soul is much stronger than yours; doing this might have some hidden dangers. Do you need me to check it for you?" After hearing this, Yuan Ming frowned slightly and immediately suggested.
"Have a look for me, but it's probably not as serious as you think," Wulu frankly said.
After a thorough examination, Yuan Ming confirmed that there were no issues with Wulu's Divine Soul and finally breathed a sigh of relief.
The two of them talked for a while longer and as time approached, Wulu stood up to take his leave.
"Actually, I came here to bid you farewell. From the memory of the Blood Demon Ancestor, I found the location of his secret base and am planning to go there to see if there's a way to unlock the secret of the Blood Puppet Armor," Wulu said.
"I might be going to the East Sea to spend some time with my parents. If you need to find me, just go to places like Thousand Dragon Island and ask those who still worship the Nether Moon God to help transmit messages," Yuan Ming said immediately.
Wulu nodded and then took his leave.
After he left, Yuan Ming was about to continue cultivating but was suddenly disturbed by a transmission.
"Yuan Ming, Tian Jizi has sent someone to ask how we should deal with the remaining Magic Cloud Trees, what do you think we should do?" Xi Ying asked through the Sound Transmission Talisman.
"Remaining? I thought we burned a big area, didn't we completely burn them?" Yuan Ming was surprised.
"Quite a few were left behind. Tian Jizi wants to destroy them directly, but without any method to eradicate them at once, that's why he's consulting us," Xi Ying answered.
"Is Tian Jizi now at Chaotian Peak? Tell him to wait, I'll be right over to handle it," Yuan Ming thought for a moment and decided.
He ended the transmission and immediately got up to emerge from his seclusion, arriving at the Magic Cloud Tree's growing site, Chaotian Peak.
The peak was covered in signs of fire, and although the Great Array was broken, the Demonic Qi lingered, thick black clouds still shrouded the mountaintop, seemingly unchanged from last time.
Outside Chaotian Peak, Tian Jizi was discussing something with several Nascent Soul cultivators from the Chang Chun Temple.
Seeing Yuan Ming arrive, they unanimously ceased their discussion and Tian Jizi quickly stepped forward, approaching Yuan Ming.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, you're finally here. I heard from Fellow Daoist Xi that you have a method to eradicate the Magic Cloud Trees?" he asked.
"I'll give it a try," Yuan Ming didn't make any promises.
"Good, then I'll leave it to Fellow Daoist Yuan, but please try not to act too harshly, to avoid damaging the Spirit Veins of Chaotian Peak," Tian Jizi cautioned him.
Yuan Ming nodded and then flew up into the air, waving his hand to conjure the Red Ancient Scroll, which slowly unfurled in front of him, displaying countless streams of rosy light.
As he pointed his hand, the rosy light instantly sank inward to form a vortex, a powerful suction engulfing the entire Chaotian Peak.
The remaining Magic Cloud Trees, protected by their Demonic Qi, were not easy to destroy, but merely collecting them was not very difficult.
The Nascent Soul cultivators of the Cloud Desolation Alliance were helpless due to the lack of vast spatial storage treasures, and whether the Magic Cloud Trees were useful to them was also unknown, so naturally, they were unwilling to undertake this thankless task.* (*) hosts the original.
Some curious Nascent Soul cultivators had been hesitating about taking some Magic Cloud Trees back for research, but with Yuan Ming collecting them, even those who were dissatisfied dared not express it openly.
While Yuan Ming was collecting the Magic Cloud Trees, down below at the base of Chaotian Peak, Xi Qian and Hua Zhi suddenly emerged, startling at the sight of Tian Jizi and others standing around.
However, seeing Yuan Ming midair, they quickly relaxed, nodded at Tian Jizi and the others, and flew up to join Yuan Ming.
"Did you get it?" Yuan Ming transmitted.
"The area around the Gathering Spirit Blood River was well-guarded, it took some extra effort, and they almost got away with it. Luckily, Hua Zhi was clever, setting up an ambush ahead of time to stop them," Xi Qian praised with a smile.
On the side, Hua Zhi smiled shyly, not saying a word.
"Well done, Hua Zhi. Do you want a reward?" Yuan Ming asked.
"Being able to serve you is my honor, and I don't need any reward," Hua Zhi immediately cast away her smile, assuming a devoted and loyal demeanor.
"Perhaps you think there's nothing in my possession that you desire? Never mind, we'll remember this for now, and you can tell me later when there's something you want," Yuan Ming shook his head.
During their conversation, the Red Ancient Scroll had already swept clear the Magic Cloud Tree on Chaotian Peak, along with the thick Demonic Qi surrounding it. With the Demonic Qi gone, sunlight once again fell on the mountaintop, a pity though that the once pristine Immortal Mountain had lost its former glory.
Fortunately, the Spirit Vein of Chaotian Peak was still intact, and Chang Chun Temple would surely work towards its repair. Perhaps it wouldn't be long before the peak returned to its former splendor.
After putting away the Red Ancient Scroll, Yuan Ming greeted Tian Jizi and others, then immediately left Chaotian Peak with Xi Qian and Hua Zhi to find Xi Ying.
"Sister, you're finally back. I was so worried about you," Xi Ying rushed forward as soon as she saw Xi Qian return.
Xi Qian responded with a smile and after sitting down, she relayed to Yuan Ming and another the process of how she and Hua Zhi captured the Gathering Spirit Blood River.
"What do you plan to do with the Gathering Spirit Blood River?" asked Yuan Ming after hearing the story.
"I plan to take it back to my family's residence. The Spirit Vein we previously occupied wasn't very good. With this, we can certainly rise to the next level. However, Yuan Ming, if you need it, you can use it first," Xi Qian said.
"That's not necessary; for now, I am focusing on Body Cultivation and Soul Cultivation. 'Nine Elements Technique' has reached its peak at Nascent Soul, and without a new Cultivation Technique, I don't need such an advanced Spirit Vein," Yuan Ming kindly rejected her offer.
"Then when you need it, just send a message to me or Xi Ying," Xi Qian nodded.
Speaking of which, Yuan Ming, I also need to visit my clan. After the great battle, my father and our people left without saying goodbye. I'm worried about his condition and need to have a serious talk with him. Rituals related to honoring the heavens also need to be conducted back home. Staying here doesn't mean much anymore," Xi Ying explained.
"That's true. In fact, I'm also planning to return to East Sea to visit my parents. Staying here makes me uncomfortable, and Tian Jizi and the others are not pleased either. It's better to leave sooner and return to our own territory," Yuan Ming added.
"That sounds good. Once I've sorted everything out, I'll come find you in East Sea. Oh, almost forgot, take care of these items." Suddenly remembering something, Xi Ying took out a Storage Bag and handed it to Yuan Ming.
Curious, Yuan Ming accepted it and discovered that it mostly contained life-prolonging items.
"These are for your uncle and aunt. They aren't of high grade, but they should be useful to them," Xi Ying explained.
"...Thank you," Yuan Ming paused momentarily, then suddenly embraced Xi Ying, sincerely thanking her from the bottom of his heart.
"Hey, don't be like this, let go, your sister is watching!" Xi Ying was stunned for a moment, her face flushed red, struggling to break free, yet mysteriously unable to muster the strength.
Watching this scene, Xi Qian indulged in a doting smile, while Hua Zhi yelped, covering her eyes with her hands, yet her fingers spread wide open, seeing everything.
Fortunately, at that moment, there was suddenly a knock at the door.
"Fellow Daoist Xi Ying, is Lord Yuan Ming with you? We just went to his Cave Mansion and didn't find him," the voice of Yan Siyun came from outside.
On hearing her voice, Xi Ying somehow regained her strength, pushed Yuan Ming away, and sat huffily to one side, stubbornly looking away from him.
"Cough, I'm here, come in," Yuan Ming said, scratching his cheek awkwardly and coughing.
With permission, Yan Siyun and her sisters along with Xu Che entered in single file, approaching Yuan Ming and his group.
"What brings you here to see me?" Yuan Ming was somewhat surprised, not expecting them to come looking for him simultaneously.
"Lord, we've received a message from the Cloud Desolation Alliance preparing to organize forces to purge the major and minor sects that once followed the Wu Yue Sect, and they have also issued a call to action to the Moon Sect. However, as for whether to participate, we didn't dare make a decision without consulting you," Yan Siyun said, respectfully bowing.
"You don't need to participate in that. Continue to focus on developing the Moon Sect and recruiting believers. As long as they are not utterly irredeemable, try to absorb them into our sect. I will give you some talismans later, and if there's anything important, just send me a message," Yuan Ming quickly made his decision.
"Yes,"
Yan Siyun nodded and stepped back, letting Xu Che step forward.
"Master, here is the incense ashes you asked me to collect," he bowed and presented a Storage Bag.
Yuan Ming received it, looked inside to see it was fully packed, enough to last him a long time, and he couldn't help but smile.
"You've done well," he praised.
"Being able to serve you is my honor," Xu Che respectfully said.
At that moment, Yuan Ming glanced at Hua Zhi, realizing where those words had come from.
Later, he dismissed Yan Siyun and the others, and after talking with Xi Ying and her group for a good while, he returned to his residence, swiftly packed up, and prepared to leave for East Sea the next morning.

chapters.title: Chapter 761 - 732: Cause and Effect
chapters.content:
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, where are you planning to go?"
Early in the morning, as soon as Yuan Ming stepped out of his room, he was immediately confronted by Luo Zhu.
"Fellow Daoist Luo? You came looking for me because... oh, I remember now." Yuan Ming paused, quickly recalling the promise he had made earlier.
"Hehe, Fellow Daoist Yuan really has the memory of a noble, always forgetting things. I had thought you secluded yourself for healing. If I hadn't learned today that you were going back to the East Sea, I might still be foolishly waiting at the estate for your grand arrival!" Luo Zhu said, her smile not reaching her eyes.
"There have been many affairs after the battle; indeed, I had forgotten. Please forgive me, fellow daoist," Yuan Ming said, embarrassed.
"Oh, Fellow Daoist Yuan, I was just teasing you. If you are busy, go ahead first. It's not too late to come and help us after you're done. My elder said she is not in a hurry," Luo Zhu suddenly said with a particularly bright smile.
"This girl…" Yuan Ming felt as if he heard a murly voice grumbling from the wooden hairpin.
"No need, I don't have other matters at the moment. Let's fulfill the promise now. What would you like me to do?" Yuan Ming shook his head and looked at the wooden hairpin on Luo Zhu's head.
"Let's head to the Southern Border first; we need to go back to the Sect to make some preparations. Once that's done, I will explain everything to you," Luo Zhu said.
"If that's the case, I also need to visit a place in the Southern Border, so why don't we part ways for now and meet again once you are ready?" Yuan Ming thought for a moment and suggested.
"That works as well. But since you and I are both heading to the Southern Border, my Sect's Flying Boat is already prepared. Would you like a ride with me, Fellow Daoist Yuan?" Luo Zhu invited.
Yuan Ming nodded and readily agreed.
...
A few days later.
After arriving at the Southern Border, Yuan Ming parted ways with Luo Zhu and set off alone to the Western Region of the Southern Border.
Before they parted, Luo Zhu had made a promise to meet him in seven days at Tucha City in the Northern Territory of the Southern Border.
Considering the time, it wasn't too pressing.
He was heading to the Western Region of the Southern Border mainly to try his luck in Kato's homeland, to see if he could find any information about the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
Whether successful or not, it shouldn't take much time. The full series is hosted on *, known as *.
As Yuan Ming contemplated where to start once he reached Luota Town, he suddenly heard the sounds of a fight not far ahead. The dazzling spirit light appeared and disappeared within the clouds, clearly indicating that cultivators were clashing.
Since entering the Southern Border, such scenes had become quite common for Yuan Ming.
After the great war, the invasion of the Demon World had been halted, and the Wu Yue Sect had been annihilated, but the aftermath had spread throughout Yunhuang. Killings, in the name of purging Wu Yue Sect followers, were numerous. In Central Plains, where the teachings were upheld, some rules were still followed, but in the barbaric lands of the Southern Border, control was lost.
It was hard to distinguish right from wrong in these instances, and Yuan Ming had no time to discern the morality of each case. He simply swept the area with his Divine Sense, planning to pass by them directly.
However, when he noticed one of the individuals involved in the fight, he uttered a light "eh" and stopped his tunneling light.
Meanwhile, the group engrossed in the fight had not noticed Yuan Ming observing them from afar.
"Wei Die, why resist stubbornly? Just surrender peacefully and become my woman, and we will be a family. I can speak to the Cloud Desolation Alliance on your behalf and ensure a safe path for you and your disciples," a thin-faced Nascent Soul cultivator with a goatee said with an evil grin.
The one he called Wei Die was a slender woman dressed in a white robe, wearing a wide hat and a veil covering her face. Although her face was not visible, her eyes were filled with fury.
"Old Ghost Gan, you're dreaming!" Wei Die shouted angrily, and then again attacked. A jade-handled fan flew into midair and with a light wave, several tornadoes appeared from nowhere, heading straight towards Old Monster Gan.
However, before the tornadoes could reach Old Monster Gan, a corpulent Nascent Soul cultivator dressed like a wealthy merchant suddenly appeared. He opened his mouth wide and swallowed the tornadoes whole.
"Fellow Daoist Gan, why waste words with her? Just kill her. I've long wanted to taste the flavor of Nascent Soul Meat from the Senluo Sect," he said, wiping his mouth, appearing still unsatisfied.
"Hehe, Wei Die, you see, if you don't surrender now, you and your disciples will all become a dish for Fellow Daoist Zhong," Old Monster Gan advised once again.
Wei Die's expression turned grim. Having been on the run, she had barely rested and was in no condition to oppose two Nascent Soul cultivators.
Just as she was about to despair, Yuan Ming suddenly appeared on the battlefield, startling both parties involved.
"Who are you? I am Gan Ye of the Yin Yang Gu Sect, acting on the orders of the Yunhuang Alliance to exterminate the remnants of the Senluo Sect. Please do not interfere," Old Monster Gan, sensing the strong aura around Yuan Ming, quickly spoke up.
"Fellow Daoist, don't believe him. Although we are cultivators ofApp Store Senluo Sect, we stayed at the Sect during the great war and never joined the Wu Yue Sect in slaughtering Yunhuang Alliance cultivators. We have always opposed our Sect's decision to follow Wu Yue Sect. If you don't believe me, I can swear on my daoist heart," Wei Die quickly retorted.
Yuan Ming remained silent, his gaze fixed on Wei Die, causing her to feel nervous as thoughts raced through her mind.
"If you are willing to help, I am ready to offer the Transplanting Technique of the Senluo Sect with both hands!" she suddenly exclaimed.
"Hmph, Fellow Daoist, consider carefully. The Cloud Desolation Alliance now dominates the world, and many Returning Void Great Powers reside within the alliance, especially that Yuan Ming sir, who reportedly despises the Wu Yue Sect and has also helped Pan Si Island against the Senluo Sect before. If you help this demon woman and he learns of it, be careful of his grudge!" Gan Ye sneered, his words full of threat.
But Yuan Ming was not afraid when he heard this; he even felt like laughing.
However, before he could speak, a Core Formation Cultivator suddenly burst out from below among those who were fighting.
"Benefactor Brother, please help my master, we really are not bad people!" the person shouted.
"Tuya, what are you doing, come back here!" Wei Die was anxious, fearing her disciple's words had annoyed Yuan Ming.
But she did not notice that a trace of a smile had suddenly flashed across Yuan Ming's eyes.
"When I speak, how can a junior like you interrupt!" However, Gan Ye seemed quite annoyed, and immediately shouted loudly, swinging his right hand and releasing two streams of black light that shot towards Tuya like lightning.
"Stop."
It was then that Yuan Ming finally spoke; his voice was not loud, yet it immediately reached the ears of everyone present, making them feel an inexplicable force binding their bodies, even slowing down the flow of Mana inside them.
Gan Ye and the others were immediately terrified, and Wei Die's eyes widened.
The two streams of black light flying towards Tuya also stopped in mid-air. Deprived of their spirit light, they were in fact just two Gu Worms the size of thumbs.
Yuan Ming's gaze fell on the Gu Worms, and he looked at them with interest for a moment before casually crushing them into dust.
"Scram," he then said, looking coldly towards Gan Ye and the others.
As soon as his words fell, the bodies of Gan Ye and his group uncontrollably flew backwards, continuing until they were out of sight of Yuan Ming and the others, before finally coming to a stop.
"What kind of power is this? He seems to be just a Nascent Soul, how could his methods be so eerie?" Cultivator Zhong was sweating profusely at this moment, his face filled with disbelief.
"Whatever the method, it appears we've met our match this time. This person's cultivation is unfathomable, we definitely shouldn't force the issue. But it doesn't matter, he can't always be with Wei Die, we will find an opportunity eventually," Gan Ye said, casting a deep glance in the direction where Yuan Ming and the others were.
In the battle on the Central Plains, they had always maintained a neutral stance and did not get directly involved. Now, chasing Wei Die served both their covetousness of her and their intent to provide a loyalty statement to be admitted into the Yunhuang Alliance.
Hence, they had not only failed to recognize Yuan Ming, but they also had little knowledge of the spoken witchery powers of "speak and follow," only being able to tell that Yuan Ming was a Nascent Soul stage Magic Practitioner with strong methods.
On the other hand, Wei Die was struck dumb by Yuan Ming's peculiar power, standing transfixed in mid-air.
What surprised her even more was that the next moment, her disciple Tuya threw herself onto this mysterious master.
"Benefactor Brother, you've saved me once again!" Tuya said excitedly, hugging Yuan Ming.
"You're all grown up now, how come you still act like a child?" Yuan Ming smiled faintly, gently tapping on Tuya's head while operating his Mana to gently push her away.
"Tuya, don't be rude!" Seeing this, Wei Die hurriedly stepped forward and pulled Tuya back.
Tuya pouted discontentedly, but soon put the matter out of her mind.
"Benefactor Brother, this is the master I told you about last time," Tuya introduced.
"I am Wei Die, thank you, Fellow Daoist, for the rescue. This is the 'Transplanting Technique' I had promised, please accept it," Wei Die said, presenting a Jade Scroll.
"Don't you recognize me, Fellow Daoist?" Yuan Ming did not accept the Jade Scroll.
At these words, Wei Die was slightly startled, instinctively scrutinizing Yuan Ming.
She had long heard from Tuya that a young cultivator had saved her and her mother years ago, but according to Tuya, that cultivator had not been highly skilled. Now, the person in front of her exuded a presence that even made her feel fearful. If it weren't for Tuya's recent actions that explained everything, she would never believe this was the same person.
But now, hearing his tone, it seemed he had met her before, yet no matter how much she racked her brain, she could not recall Yuan Ming's face.
"It seems that you have forgotten, and understandably so, you simply offered help at the moment, and probably didn't think much of it," Yuan Ming said with a resigned look as she appeared puzzled.
"Please enlighten me, Fellow Daoist," Wei Die was even more confused.
"Years ago, by the Shangshan Valley near the Feichang River, Fellow Daoist saved a young man with an elixir. Does that ring a bell?" Yuan Ming asked.
"It seems there was such an incident... Could it be..." Wei Die recalled that scene from years ago, and her eyes widened.
"Indeed, that was me. If it had not been for Fellow Daoist's intervention, I might have died there," Yuan Ming said, giving Wei Die a bow.
"Back then, I merely acted on impulse. I didn't expect Fellow Daoist to have such fortune. I didn't take you with me at the time, just left you at the riverbank, so I really don't deserve your gratitude," Wei Die quickly waved her hands, reluctant to accept the bow.
"No matter what, Fellow Daoist has always been my benefactor, and Tuya is also the daughter of a dear friend. At that time, I was powerless to protect her, so I'm fortunate that Fellow Daoist could lead her onto the Immortal Path. To meet Fellow Daoist once again today must be destiny, perhaps, this is karma," Yuan Ming sighed.
"Karma... can things in this world truly be such a coincidence?" Wei Die murmured to herself.

chapters.title: Chapter 762 - 733: Meeting the Old Man Again
chapters.content:
"In any case, Fellow Daoist, you have shown me no small kindness; now that it is within my power, I must offer my assistance," Yuan Ming said. Suddenly, he raised his hand and a beam of spirit light swept across Wei Die and her group of disciples.
The next moment, a gu worm the size of a pinky finger flew out of each of their bodies, gathered in front of Yuan Ming's palm, and he casually crushed them.
"Just now, those two had placed tracking insects on you, which I have now removed for you. Take this token and keep it safe. Given the current situation, it is probably no longer safe for you to stay in the Southern Border. With this token, you can go to the East Sea and join the Moon Sect, where no one will trouble you again," Yuan Ming said as he handed over a jade pendant marked with his Divine Sense, smiling as he spoke.
Wei Die took the jade pendant in a daze, then suddenly looked up at Yuan Ming's face.
"Fellow Daoist, no, you, you are..." Her voice trembled slightly.
"Indeed, I am Yuan Ming. However, there's no need for such courtesy, 'Fellow Daoist' will suffice," Yuan Ming said with a smile.
Wei Die unconsciously clenched the jade pendant; she could never have imagined that the young man she had casually saved years ago had now become a renowned power throughout Yunhuang.
"Benefactor Brother, are you leaving again?" However, Tuya by her side did not care about these things and just tugged at Yuan Ming's arm reluctantly.
"Don't worry, I will also spend some time in the East Sea later. Once you have settled down, I will come and visit you," Yuan Ming said, gently stroking Tuya's head to comfort her.
"Alright, then it's a promise!" Tuya nodded vigorously.
Yuan Ming patted her head and was about to leave when Wei Die called out to him.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, one moment, please take this jade scroll," Wei Die offered the same jade scroll she had produced earlier.
"The 'Transplanting Technique' is a foundation of your Senluo Sect; isn't it inappropriate to simply give it away to me?" Yuan Ming asked.
"Alas, now that only a few of us remain in the Senluo Sect, what use is there in cherishing this technique like a prized broom? Besides, since I have already promised, there is no reason not to give it. I just don't know if it will be of use to you, please don't disdain it," Wei Die said with a sigh.
Yuan Ming nodded, accepted the jade scroll, bid farewell, and then disappeared from the spot.
"Let's go, Tuya, come to my side. Tell me more about when you and your mother were rescued," Wei Die stood silently for a moment before shaking her head, leading her remaining disciples to embark on their journey to the East Sea, and called Tuya to her side.
At the same moment that Yuan Ming eliminated the gu worms from their bodies, Gan Ye's expression suddenly changed far away.
"Damn it, he discovered my gu!" Gan Ye cursed in anger.
"What do we do now? Without the gu, the world is so vast, where do we even begin to look for Wei Die and her group?" Cultivator Zhong was somewhat bewildered.
"Look for what! To have discovered my Ten Thousand Miles Tracking Gu, his Divine Sense must be at least twice as powerful as mine. It's pointless to ask for more trouble; it will be us who end up dead!" Gan Ye said bitterly.
"You noticed quite quickly, but unfortunately, it's too late," Yuan Ming's voice suddenly sounded from the sky at that moment.
"No, we are people of the Cloud Desolation Alliance, you cannot..." Gan Ye's body trembled, and he hurriedly shouted.
Before he could finish speaking, a pitch-black vortex suddenly appeared above his head, sucking in his Nascent Soul.
Cultivator Zhong and his other disciples met the same fate. Within a breath's time, their physical bodies lost their vitality. Just as they were about to fall, they were caught by roots of the Undying Tree summoned by Yuan Ming, all turned into nutrients.
After dealing with this matter with a flick of his hand, Yuan Ming set off once more. As he traveled, he perused through the complete 'Transplanting Technique' scroll and headed towards Luota Town.
With Yuan Ming's tunneling speed, he soon arrived at Luota Town.
The town was an ordinary small town in the Southern Border with no more than a thousand people, all of whom were mortals with not a single cultivator among them, nothing out of the ordinary.
Yuan Ming did not ask anyone for information; instead, he mustered a strand of Soul Power and sent it into the body of an old oil seller in the town.TheM|V|LE&MPYRteamworkedhardonthischapter.
The old man's eyes immediately became vacant, and he stood there motionless.
Yuan Ming circulated the Soul Power and performed the Soul Searching Divine Ability, probing the old man's memories.
With his current level in the Soul Cultivation Realm, performing a Soul Search was no longer as cumbersome as before; a thought was all it took.
Since the old man was just a mortal, Yuan Ming quickly finished probing and found no information about Kato.
A faint light flashed between his eyebrows as he sent out more than a dozen strands of Soul Power to simultaneously conduct a Soul Search on more than a dozen people, still with no results.
Yuan Ming continued casting, and finally, during the third round of probing, he made some discoveries.
He swiftly arrived at an abandoned courtyard in the east of the town with several large holes in the roof and weeds overgrown in the yard, indicating it had long been uninhabited.
Yuan Ming searched the yard and found nothing of value.
"Could I be mistaken?" he wondered, walking out of the abandoned courtyard, his expression suddenly paused.
Not far away, outside another courtyard, a blind old man was holding a broom, sweeping fallen leaves off the ground.
This man was none other than the night watchman old man Yuan Ming had encountered in the Da Jin Palace before.
"This man is from Da Jin, how could he appear in the Southern Border?" Yuan Ming was surprised, examining the old man closely and quickly confirming that it was indeed the same night watchman.
Since his last visit to the palace, enough time had passed for a mortal to travel from Da Jin to the Southern Border. Could this be just a coincidence?
Yuan Ming pondered for a moment, then activated his Divine Sense, attempting to perceive the blind elder. His face immediately betrayed a look of shock and doubt.
No sooner had his Divine Sense made contact with the other party than it disappeared without a trace, as if the space around the blind elder could devour his Divine Sense.
Simultaneously, the blind elder stopped sweeping and turned to 'look' in this direction.
At that "look", Yuan Ming felt the hairs on his back stand on end, as if a terrifying entity had locked its gaze on him, and the Soul Extinguishing Sword within his Dantian hummed a warning.
Moreover, the Stealing Heaven Tripod within his arm trembled non-stop, as if it was about to fly out and move towards the blind elder.
Greatly shocked, Yuan Ming hastened to wrap the tripod in Mana, suppressing its abnormal movements.
Fortunately, the anomaly with the Stealing Heaven Tripod lasted only a few breaths before calming down.
Yuan Ming breathed a sigh of relief, his eyes becoming exceptionally sharp.
Ever since he obtained the Stealing Heaven Tripod, it had always recognized only him as its master. The fact that the blind elder could cause such a reaction from the tripod was astonishing!
"This town is Kato's hometown, and Kato's corpse appeared next to the burial site of the Stealing Heaven Tripod. Now the tripod is acting up... all this...", Yuan Ming's mind raced with countless thoughts as he proceeded forward.
The blind elder dropped his broom and gestured to Yuan Ming to follow, then proceeded into the courtyard with a shaky gait.
Yuan Ming's eyes flickered as he activated his Soul Power.
A dozen soul crows emerged from beneath his feet, burrowing into the ground and flying towards various parts of the town to investigate the situation both inside and outside of it.
Two beams of light flew out from the Spiritual Beast Bag at his waist, it was Vajra and Hua Zhi, landing near the courtyard.
After completing these actions, Yuan Ming continued to move forward and entered the courtyard.
The blind elder sat on a stone bench in the courtyard to rest, apparently not surprised by Yuan Ming's arrival.
"Elder, since our parting at Da Jin Imperial City, I did not expect to encounter you here," Yuan Ming was the first to speak.
The blind elder's white eyes scrutinized Yuan Ming before revealing a set of uneven teeth with a smile, "Yuan, have you reached the Word Witch Realm already? It seems that the current master of the Stealing Heaven Tripod is quite remarkable."
Yuan Ming narrowed his eyes and asked in a deeper tone, "May I know the distinguished name of the Daoist friend, and what is your connection with the Stealing Heaven Tripod?"
"There's no need for wariness, Friend Yuan. I am Xia Jie, from the Overseas World, and as for my identity, I am like you; I have had possession of the Stealing Heaven Tripod for a while," Xia Jie said with a smile.
Hearing this, Yuan Ming could no longer maintain his composure.
It was because of Xia Jie's identity as well as his origins. Xia Jie actually came from the Overseas World—could it be that the Stealing Heaven Tripod was truly an artifact from the Overseas World?
This man seemed to know a great deal about him. Their earlier encounter at the Da Jin Palace could very likely have been intentional on his part.
But what exactly did this series of actions by this man signify? To observe his power, waiting for an opportunity to seize back the Stealing Heaven Tripod?
"So Daoist Xia Jie hails from the Overseas World of cultivators; no wonder your Divine Skills are so exceptional. I admire you," Yuan Ming forced himself to calm down and greeted with a fist and palm salute.
"Friend Yuan flatters me too much. I am now but a half-crippled body, how can I still speak of Divine Skills?" Xia Jie shook his head and said with a wry smile.
Yuan Ming snorted silently; this man could easily devour his Divine Sense, yet he could not see through whatever Divine Skill the other had used.
This kind of capability, even a mid-stage or late-stage Soul Cultivator of Word Witch Realm may not be able to achieve.
Nevertheless, he had now broken through to Word Witch in Soul Cultivation, and his Body Cultivation had also reached the Realm of Wanxiang. He had no fear.
"Friend Yuan, there is no need for vigilance. I am not your enemy. You and I are both owners of the Stealing Heaven Tripod, and in the future, we may well have to help each other," Xia Jie waved his hands at Yuan Ming and said.
"What Daoist Xia Jie said makes sense; I acknowledge you as a friend," Yuan Ming's eyes twinkled as he laughed heartily, stopping the soul crows from scouting, but he did not recall them.
"Friend Yuan is indeed the Nether Moon God, your perceptions and knowledge are first-class in the Yunhuang Continent, far beyond that Wuyue God," Xia Jie laughed and said.
Their laughter helped to ease the tense atmosphere.
"Does Daoist Xia Jie know the Wuyue God?" Yuan Ming inquired.
"I have met her twice. I intended to collaborate with her initially, but who would have expected her to be insane to the core, colluding with the Demon World and forgetting her roots. I didn't conduct any further dealings with her," Xia Jie shook his head and spoke.
Xia Jie then personally set to work preparing a table full of food and drinks, all made from very unusual ingredients, especially a Green Fish with a belly that sported four bulges and a forehead with a small horn, suggesting a possibility of transforming into a dragon.
"These dishes seem to be not from the Yunhuang Continent," Yuan Ming commented.
"You have good eyes, Friend Yuan. These items are all brought from the Overseas World. This fish is called Little Green Dragon and is a rare delicacy, even in the Overseas World. Eating it is quite beneficial for Nascent Soul cultivators, but it is difficult to rear. I have pondered over it for hundreds of years, but the results are still unsatisfactory; it's hard to breed a pure Little Green Dragon," Xia Jie explained.
"I see, then I am in luck today," Yuan Ming said with a laugh, secretly using his Purple Extreme Tai Sui to sense the dishes, and after confirming they were free from poison, began to partake.
As they ate and talked, Xia Jie, with his extensive wisdom and genuine conversation, seemed to really bear no malice, greatly expanding Yuan Ming's horizons.

chapters.title: Chapter 763 - 734: The 13th Master
chapters.content:
After some exchange, Yuan Ming's suspicion towards Xia Jie lessened a bit, but his guard remained unlowered.
"Fellow Daoist Xia, Yuan learned from some hidden classics on the Yunhuang Continent that the Overseas World is rich in spiritual energy, abundant in resources, and far surpasses the Yunhuang Continent. Why would Fellow Daoist Xia come here?" Yuan Ming probed.
"The spiritual energy in the Overseas World is indeed abundant, incomparable to the Yunhuang Continent. As for my coming here, it's because of a battle with a formidable enemy in the Void Turbulence thousands of years ago, which led to my accidental arrival," Xia Jie reflected with a hint of reminiscence and sighed.
Yuan Ming maintained a calm facade, but inside he couldn't help but shiver. Xia Jie was able to fight someone in the Void Turbulence, and with his cultivation almost destroyed, he still possessed the divine powers he had just demonstrated. How powerful he must have been at his peak, definitely far exceeding realms like Returning Void and Word Witch.
"Could it be because Fellow Daoist Xia was gravely injured that the Stealing Heaven Tripod slipped out of your hands and fell to Kato?" Yuan Ming inquired further.
"No, due to the great battle back then, my Divine Soul nearly collapsed. The Stealing Heaven Tripod was useless in my hands. As a divine treasure of incredible mystical powers, it shouldn't be tarnished with me. It was my decision to release it," Xia Jie explained.
Yuan Ming asked calmly, yet he was quite surprised inside. He had thought that Xia Jie's appearance was to scheme for the Stealing Heaven Tripod, but hearing this, could he have been mistaken?
"Counting from my possession, Yuan, you should be the thirteenth master of the Stealing Heaven Tripod," Xia Jie counted on his fingers and said.
"Thirteen masters! With the Stealing Heaven Tripod being so profound and mysterious, having had so many owners, why is its great name not widely known on the Yunhuang Continent?" Yuan Ming wondered.
"The divine powers of the Stealing Heaven Tripod are too astonishing. Anyone who has used it, who would spread the word?" Xia Jie chuckled.To report errors, please visit the original post on *.
Upon slight contemplation, Yuan Ming realized that this was indeed the case. Anyone with a sound mind who gained such a treasure would definitely hide it; he did the same.
