It was just that over thousands of years, without a single accident occurring, it seemed a bit strange.
"Of course, I've also interfered. Due to certain reasons, the Stealing Heaven Tripod is immensely complicated. Although the Yunhuang Continent is isolated from the outside, I didn't want its existence to become common knowledge. I've been erasing traces of the tripod over the years," Xia Jie continued.
"I see. May I ask where the Stealing Heaven Tripod originated from?" Yuan Ming realized and asked with curiosity.
"Regarding the Stealing Heaven Tripod, I actually don't know its origin myself. I inadvertently came across it in a 'Wentian Secret Realm' in the Overseas World and have cultivated with it for many years, but unfortunately, I never managed to fully unravel its mysteries," Xia Jie said with a hint of regret as he shook his head.
Yuan Ming did not press further and discussed the capabilities of the Stealing Heaven Tripod with Xia Jie.
He quickly became disappointed; aside from being able to gather Desire Power and Black Incense Possession, Xia Jie hadn't discovered any other abilities of the tripod.
Regarding the collection of Desire Power and the use of Black Incense Possession Divine Power, Xia Jie's understanding was similar to Yuan Ming's own findings, with the exception of a unique use for Black Incense Possession.
Xia Jie claimed that he could use Black Incense Possession in mountains, gales, volcanoes, thunderclouds, and such, to comprehend their True Intent and aid in cultivation.
"Possession in mountains, in the midst of gales? That sounds somewhat inconceivable," Yuan Ming couldn't help but remark.
"As Fellow Daoist Yuan also knows, the principle of Black Incense Possession is to lodge oneself in the Divine Soul of the host object. Mountains, gales, and such, even though inanimate, are not without Divine Souls. They are just extremely subtle and hard to detect," Xia Jie explained.
After reaching the Word Witch Realm, Yuan Ming did indeed faintly sense that the objects around him contained Divine Souls, and he nodded thoughtfully.
"Of course, not any item is suitable for possession. It must be large enough, strong enough in spiritual power, and the contained Divine Soul must reach a certain scale," Xia Jie added.
"Fellow Daoist Xia's insights are novel, giving me a sudden moment of clarity," Yuan Ming thanked and planned to give it a try later on.
"Does Fellow Daoist Yuan wish to try possessing objects? I'm afraid you're not yet capable. Possessing objects has other constraints; it's not enough to just find a suitable host. There are specific requirements for the Stealing Heaven Tripod as well. You must refine at least one hundred restrictions within the tripod before you can do so. The more restrictions you refine in the Stealing Heaven Tripod, the better the effect of Black Incense Possession and collecting Desire Power," Xia Jie elaborated.
"One hundred restrictions? Yuan understands," Yuan Ming said.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, you are exceptionally talented. I believe you will soon refine the Stealing Heaven Tripod and achieve the ability to possess objects," Xia Jie remarked.
"I'll take Fellow Daoist Xia's kind words to heart," Yuan Ming responded.
Just as Xia Jie was about to continue speaking, he suddenly started coughing violently, his cheeks flushing blood red, his body trembling uncontrollably.
Yuan Ming's expression changed. Xia Jie's body was impossible to probe with Divine Sense, and just as he was about to attempt a rescue with casting, Xia Jie raised his hand to stop him.
A while passed before Xia Jie's coughing finally subsided. His face had turned pale as paper, devoid of any color.
"An old ailment... I've made a fool of myself in front of Young Friend Yuan," Xia Jie managed a weak smile.
"Fellow Daoist Xia is too polite. Your body is currently ill; do you know of any way to heal it?" Yuan Ming asked.
"This injury is longstanding and originates from the Divine Soul, not something ordinary methods can cure. There's no need for Yuan to worry," Xia Jie said.
"The Stealing Heaven Tripod came from Fellow Daoist Xia, and I owe you a great favor. If there's anything I can do, please, Fellow Daoist Xia, don't hesitate to ask," Yuan Ming said attentively, with a sincere tone.
"Since Fellow Daoist Yuan has said so, I do have a favor to ask," Xia Jie hesitated for a moment, looking somewhat embarrassed.
"Please, Fellow Daoist Xia, just say it," Yuan Ming said.
"My injury originates from the Divine Soul and requires starting from the Divine Soul. However, the Soul Power at the Word Witch Realm is not enough; one must reach the Life Witch Realm to heal this injury," Xia Jie said.
"Life Witch?" Yuan Ming's eyes widened in surprise.
"The realm after the Word Witch is the Life Witch. When one reaches the Life Witch Realm, one can perceive the essence of the Divine Soul, bring the dead back to life, and even change fate, hence the name Life Witch," Xia Jie explained.
Yuan Ming quickly concentrated and committed everything to memory.
"Is the ranking of Soul Cultivators the same in the Overseas World? I thought it was something concocted by the Wu Yue Sect," he then asked.
"Whether it's Soul Cultivation, Magic Practice, or Body Cultivation, the division of realms all comes from Ancient Times. That Wu Yue God, if I'm not wrong, should also be from the Overseas World," Xia Jie revealed.
Yuan Ming nodded in agreement. He had guessed as much long ago; otherwise, it wouldn't have been possible for the Wu Yue Sect to possess so many Soul Cultivation books.
"Fellow Daoist Xia means to say, you want me to reach the Life Witch Realm to assist you in healing?" Yuan Ming thought for a moment before asking.
"Indeed. When I severed my link with the Stealing Heaven Tripod and bestowed it upon others, part of it was to not let the treasure collect dust, and partly, I harbored the selfish hope of using the Stealing Heaven Tripod to cultivate a Life Witch. However, Soul Cultivation is arduous and demands extremely high talent. Even with the help of the Stealing Heaven Tripod, none of its masters have gone beyond the realms of Illusion Witch or Sleeping Witch. Yuan is the only Word Witch, and it is for this reason I made my appearance and contacted you," Xia Jie sighed.
"I see. Rest assured, Fellow Daoist Xia, I will do my utmost to break through to the Life Witch Realm as soon as possible. Only, the Moonlight Technique I practice only goes up to the Word Witch mnemonics, and advancing to the Life Witch Realm will likely be difficult," Yuan Ming disclosed.
"The Moonlight Technique is a secret cultivation method from the Bright Moon Palace, a significant faction among the Overseas Soul Cultivators. I do not possess it either. It's best not to switch cultivation methods for Soul Cultivation, unlike for Magic Practice and Body Cultivation. At your current realm, Fellow Daoist Yuan, I presume you won't stay long in the Yunhuang Continent. You can seek the subsequent methods at the Bright Moon Palace," Xia Jie recommended.
"Bright Moon Palace... Thank you for the guidance, Fellow Daoist Xia," Yuan Ming expressed his gratitude.
"Yuan, you needn't rush your cultivation. I see that although your Soul Cultivation Realm is high, your Soul Power is quite chaotic and mixed with many foreign impurities. Have you absorbed a large number of Residual Souls?" Xia Jie inquired.
"Your insight is astute, Fellow Daoist Xia. I encountered some complications when breaking through to the Word Witch Realm and had no choice but to absorb numerous Residual Souls..." Yuan Ming recounted the details of his breakthrough to the Word Witch Realm, conveniently omitting the part about Dual Cultivation with the Xi Ying Divine Soul.
"No wonder. But there's no need to worry. Let your Divine Soul enter the space of the Jade Lotus Platform. With the help of the white flames there to refine, it won't take long to cleanse the impurities from your Divine Soul," Xia Jie suggested.
"What is that white flame? Is its refining effect really so good?" Yuan Ming questioned.
"That flame is called the Bright Soul Fire, also known as the Bright Soul Heavenly Fire. It is the Holy Fire of the Soul Cultivation path, capable of refining Divine Soul impurities and purifying Soul Power. It will have no trouble refining the impurities in your Divine Soul," Xia Jie said with a light chuckle, as if it were a trifling matter.
Delight flashed in Yuan Ming's eyes; the white flame was so miraculous that it meant he could freely refine and absorb Residual Souls to quickly enhance his Soul Power.
However, he soon remembered the Desire Power collected by the Stealing Heaven Tripod. Given the current scale of the Moon Sect, they were amassing Desire Power quite swiftly. To elevate his Soul Power, he could directly refine Desire Power and had no need to refine any Residual Souls.
"Is there anything else you'd like to ask, Yuan? Feel free," Xia Jie invited.
"Fellow Daoist Xia mentioned the White Jade Lotus Platform space, and I assume you've seen the white Round Orbs condensed from Desire Power there, what are they?" Yuan Ming asked bluntly.
"I'm not sure what exactly they should be called, but for now, let's refer to them as Vow Power Pills. Consuming them can quickly enhance Soul Power; however, Yuan, you mustn't use them to speed up your Divine Soul cultivation," Xia Jie's expression turned serious.
"Why is that?" Yuan Ming asked, perplexed.
"The enhancement of Soul Power is also a process of comprehending the true intent of the Divine Soul. By forcibly advancing with external forces, the Soul Power increases swiftly, but it lacks the understanding of the Divine Soul's metamorphosis, which is akin to spoiling growth. From what I've observed of your Divine Soul, you've probably always used Desire Power to enhance it. It's fine to do so in the Lower Four Realms of Soul Cultivation, but continuing in the Word Witch Realm would really jeopardize your Soul Cultivation future. You may never break through to the Life Witch Realm in this life," Xia Jie solemnly elucidated.
Yuan Ming's heart sank. He was just about to use Vow Power Pills to increase his Soul Power, not realizing the significant risks involved. Had his diligent preaching and the Desire Power collected all been in vain?
Nevertheless, Yuan Ming soon considered that even if he didn't use the pills himself, they could be given to those close to him for their use.
Furthermore, with careful management, the Vow Power Pills could also be sold. Given the pill's astonishing effect on enhancing Soul Power, it would unquestionably be a top-tier treasured pill.
With this thought, Yuan Ming's mood lightened considerably.

chapters.title: Chapter 764 - 735: Familiar Deep Valley
chapters.content:
"Young friend, as a Magic Soul Body who practices mixed cultivation, not only Soul Cultivation, but Magic Practitioning and Body Cultivation also should not be overly aggressive; I see there are also signs of instability in your Qi-Blood. Did you also use some special method for cultivation? It's better to be steady and solid," Xia Jie continued.
"What Fellow Daoist Xia Jie says is true. However, the Body Cultivation Method I practiced comes from the Demon World, hence I used Demonic Qi to enhance it. Could this be a hidden problem?" Yuan Ming raised his eyebrows and asked.
He had previously spared no effort to increase his power mainly to deal with the invasion of the Wu Yue Sect and the Demon World. Now that the crisis was resolved, he had no intention of using the Shura Blood Devouring Map to speed up his cultivation anymore.
"That won't be a problem. After all, whether it's Demonic Qi or Spiritual Energy, both are the most fundamental forces of this world. They are just different types, neither inherently good nor evil. You just need to be cautious and avoid conflicts between Mana and Demonic Qi," Xia Jie said.
Yuan Ming's heart relaxed upon hearing this, and he immediately took out an item, which was the broken sword fragment he had acquired from the altar of the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
"This item was acquired from the altar inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod. Since Fellow Daoist Xia Jie was the first owner of the Stealing Heaven Tripod, you must know about this item; do you know where this fragment came from?" Yuan Ming asked.
"Hehe, I didn't expect that you would find this item. Among the thirteen owners of the Stealing Heaven Tripod, you are the only one who noticed the existence of this fragment," Xia Jie said with a laugh, taking the broken sword fragment and gently stroking it with his finger.
"This fragment was also acquired from the Wentian Secret Realm. I haven't been able to clarify its origin, but since it cannot be destroyed, it must be a fragment of a powerful artifact. The three runes on it are very mysterious but also exceedingly dominant; you must be careful when using it," Xia Jie said slowly, then handed it back.
Yuan Ming nodded slowly and put away the broken sword fragment.
He then asked about the reason Stealing Heaven Tripod Space was hard to open. The answer was just as he had guessed: the Crystal Stone in the altar of the Stealing Heaven Tripod had exhausted its Spiritual Power.
Unfortunately, Xia Jie didn't have the Crystal Stones needed for the Array either, and Yuan Ming would have to find a replacement himself in the future.
"I have one last question," Yuan Ming said, looking up at Xia Jie, his expression solemn.
"Feel free to ask," Xia Jie replied, his expression indifferent.
"I've heard that above the level of Spiritual Treasures, all items possess an Artifact Spirit. Does the Stealing Heaven Tripod also have an Artifact Spirit?" Yuan Ming asked.
"The Artifact Spirit of the Stealing Heaven Tripod? I cannot answer that question as I've never sensed the presence of an Artifact Spirit inside the tripod. However, that doesn't mean it doesn't exist," Xia Jie said ambiguously.
Yuan Ming frowned slightly upon hearing Xia Jie's response, lost in thought.
"Kid, I've helped you a lot; How do you plan to repay me?" Xia Jie suddenly smiled and asked.
"If the senior needs anything from this junior, please speak plainly," Yuan Ming replied, bowing with his fists clasped.
"I've been planning to go somewhere important soon; I might need your help," Xia Jie said solemnly.
"Could the senior tell me where he's going, and what he intends to do?" Yuan Ming asked, frowning.
"You're quite cautious. So, if I don't tell you, you won't agree?" Xia Jie raised his eyebrows, his tone teasing.
Yuan Ming thought for a moment, then said, "I can help, but the senior must wait some time. I have an arrangement with someone else that I need to keep first."
"No matter, you go and attend to your own business first," Xia Jie waved his hand, not minding at all.
"Alright," Yuan Ming replied, bowing with his fists.
"Take this with you; you will find it useful," Xia Jie said, waving his hand, and a yellowed piece of paper fluttered toward Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming caught it and immediately his eyes lit up; it was the recipe for crafting Black Incense.
Initially, he had tried and searched bit by bit himself, so when he saw the list of ingredients on the paper, he recognized them at a glance.
This original recipe for Black Incense was almost the same as what he had deduced himself, especially the choice of several main spiritual materials, which were completely identical.
The only differences were in some auxiliary materials and the ratio of ingredients used.
Even so, Yuan Ming was profoundly grateful.
"Many thanks, senior," he said, bowing in thanks.
"Now go take care of your matters," Xia Jie then waved his hand, indicating it was time for Yuan Ming to leave.
After parting with Xia Jie, Yuan Ming immediately rushed to the place where he had an appointment with Luo Zhu.
It was a bamboo shed built in a secluded and hidden valley in the Southern Border and Northern Territory, not a location rich in Spiritual Energy like an Immortal Mansion.
Upon arriving, Yuan Ming released his Divine Sense to scan briefly and detected Luo Zhu's presence.
He did not deliberately conceal his own aura, so by the time he arrived at the bamboo shed's door, Luo Zhu was already waiting at the entrance.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, you certainly made me wait!" Luo Zhu said somewhat reproachfully.
Yuan Ming smiled but did not respond; the two stepped inside the bamboo shed.
After sitting down at the table, Yuan Ming got straight to the point, "Where is that senior?"
No sooner had he spoken than a purple hairpin on Luo Zhu's head suddenly flashed light, and a hazy, fleeting white shadow emerged, settling beside her and transforming into a dignified old woman with white hair.
She appeared to be in a Spiritual Body state, somewhat ethereal, her form enveloped in a faint mist, which rendered her features somewhat blurred.
However, Yuan Ming sensed that although she was in a Soul Body state, the fluctuations of her soul were not weak. Thus, the ethereal quality of her presence was not due to the dispersal of her Spiritual Body but related to her inherent attributes.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, I'm deeply grateful that you could keep our appointment," the old woman said, offering a gesture of respect.
"Senior, there's no need for formalities. May I know how to address you?" Yuan Ming quickly stood up and bowed in return.
"I am called the Water Spirit Saint Mother. I have arranged to meet with Fellow Daoist Yuan hoping to use your Body of Wanxiang to help open a stone gate," the old woman said.
"If that's all, it shouldn't be too difficult. May I ask where this stone gate is located?" Yuan Ming inquired.
"It is in a deep valley in the mountains of the Northern Territory; we will need to trouble you to come with us," the Water Spirit Saint Mother explained.
Yuan Ming frowned slightly, but, embracing the spirit of 'since I'm here, I might as well adapt,' he nodded in agreement.
Afterward, they left the bamboo shed and headed for the valley.
Upon flying over the valley, Yuan Ming was momentarily stunned; the place was not unfamiliar to him—it was precisely Snake King Valley.
"Could it be Snake King Valley that they wanted to visit?"
As Yuan Ming pondered, he heard Luo Zhu say, "This is the place."
With that, she took the lead and flew down, and Yuan Ming immediately followed.
Although he was highly suspicious, he decided to watch and see how things would unfold, thus he maintained a calm expression and continued on.
Indeed, they eventually reached the depths of the cavern and stood at the entrance of the Underground Palace.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, the stone gate we need your help to open is this one," the Water Spirit Saint Mother reiterated as she emerged from a purple hairpin.
Yuan Ming looked at the two women, his expression filled with doubt.
He was fully aware of what lay behind the gate, but what baffled him was why these two wanted to unlock it?
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, you might not be aware. This stone gate is not as simple as it seems on the surface. It is not only extremely solid, but it also has an unusual forbidden seal inside. Any Spiritual Power that touches the gate gets absorbed by the seal. Our Pan Si Island has tried many methods in the past years but failed to open it," Luo Zhu noticed Yuan Ming's hesitation and decided to explain.
"So, you're planning to break it open with brute force?" Yuan Ming said, upon hearing this.
"Such a gate cannot be broken by anyone other than a Body Cultivator like Fellow Daoist Yuan, who possesses the Body of Wanxiang," the Water Spirit Saint Mother declared.
Yuan Ming sighed internally. He had taken away the black stone pillar, and the gate's original seal should have already been broken; they just needed to try once more, and then they would realize that even without the Body of Wanxiang, it could now be opened.
However, he naturally did not voice these thoughts.
"Since that's the case, then I shall give it a try," Yuan Ming said as he stepped forward and rubbed his hands together.
Thanks for reading—brought to you by *.
Upon hearing this, the Water Spirit Saint Mother and Luo Zhu both stepped back a few steps, their eyes gleaming with hopeful joy.
Yuan Ming lifted his hands, the Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill immediately activated within him. His muscles bulged and red steam rose from his body, appearing to exert his full strength; in reality, he had only used 20% of his power.
He stepped forward and threw a punch at the stone gate.
"Bang"
A dull sound echoed as ripples of blue light surged over the surface of the gate.
The three felt the entire cavern shake. Looking at the stone gate, it remained undamaged without a single crack.
This left even Yuan Ming dumbfounded.
He had opened this stone gate before, so he had some understanding of it. The reason he had used only 20% of his strength was intentional—it was sufficient to crack the gate without shattering it.
This way, he could fulfill the task without making the gate seem overly fragile.
But the outcome was completely unexpected.
The Water Spirit Saint Mother also frowned deeply, exchanging a puzzled look with Luo Zhu.
Recovering from his surprise, Yuan Ming immediately activated the Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill again, this time utilizing 50% of his strength, and punched the stone gate.
"Bang" echoed again, shaking the cavern.
Suddenly, a "crack" sound was heard as a fissure emerged from below Yuan Ming's fist, gradually spreading.
Seeing this, the Water Spirit Saint Mother was instantly overjoyed.
Yuan Ming then punched again.
This time, without any surprise, the crack on the gate rapidly widened, and with a "bang," it burst open.
From the destroyed stone gate, black demonic qi coiled out, rolling outward.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming's eyes flashed briefly.
He quickly realized that something else must have occurred in the Underground Palace after he took the Sky-reaching Demon Pillar; otherwise, it wouldn't have accumulated such an immense amount of demonic qi in such a short time.
The next moment, Yuan Ming became even more bewildered.
Because with just a brief sensing, he discovered that the demonic qi here was not only denser but also purer than before!

chapters.title: Chapter 765 - 736 Help Me a Favor
chapters.content:
"Senior, why is there so much Demonic Qi here?" Yuan Ming asked knowingly.
"This... I do not know either. What I am looking for is something hidden behind this door, and I am unaware of the exact situation beyond it," the Water Spirit Saint Mother said.
Her words contained many holes, but Yuan Ming had no time to scrutinize them at the moment.
Without regard for how the other two would react, he waved his hand, and a red ancient scroll flew out. It unfolded in mid-air, revealing a red vortex that began to rapidly absorb the Demonic Qi from the Underground Palace.
Now, to continue practicing the Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill, he needed a large amount of Demonic Qi, the purer the better.
"Map of Ten Thousand Realms..."
The Water Spirit Saint Mother recognized the red ancient scroll, her eyes flashing with surprise as the hazy mist around her body trembled. She was obviously astonished that Yuan Ming possessed such a treasure.
Yuan Ming quickly gathered all the Demonic Qi and retracted the Map of Ten Thousand Realms.
With the Demonic Qi in the Underground Palace swept clean, the area became clear and bright, and the inside was fully revealed.
Yuan Ming was well aware that besides the Demon Eye, which was sealed by the Thirty-Six Star Constellation Sealing Array, there was nothing else here. Thus, he was even more curious about what the Water Spirit Saint Mother was searching for.
Seeing the two of them heading straight for the Thirty-Six Star Constellation Sealing Array, Yuan Ming's figure flashed, blocking their path.
"Senior, Fellow Daoist Luo Zhu. Although I do not know what is peculiar about this place, I can tell that something extraordinary must be sealed beneath this Great Array. If both of you are here to break this seal, you must tell me what it is exactly," Yuan Ming said seriously, making up a story on the spot.
Upon hearing this, the Water Spirit Saint Mother paused, sighed, and said:
"I had no intention of keeping Fellow Daoist Yuan in the dark. I am not a human soul body, but a Water Spirit born from the East Sea Spirit Vein after countless years. Though nurtured naturally and containing the essence of heaven and earth, I lack a body to truly begin my cultivation and achieve the Dao."
Hearing this, Yuan Ming gave the Water Spirit Saint Mother a closer look, and some of his initial doubts were immediately resolved.
"To achieve the Dao, I spared no effort over thousands of years to collect the Canghai Essence and sculpt a Water Spirit Body for myself within the East Sea Spirit Vein. Unfortunately, before I could inhabit it, a very powerful and skilled expert snatched it away. Bound by the East Sea Spirit Vein, I could not pursue it and was filled with regret and hatred," the Water Spirit Saint Mother said with a tinge of resentment.
"What does this have to do with the Sealing Array?" Yuan Ming asked.
"Hundreds of years ago, I finally managed to break free from the East Sea Spirit Vein's restraint. With the help of Pan Si Island's power, I searched far and wide until over a hundred years ago when I finally sensed the location of my Water Spirit Body, which is within that Sealing Array," the Water Spirit Saint Mother said, looking towards the position of the Demon Eye in the center of the array.
This chapter was originally posted on *.
Despite hearing this, Yuan Ming still harbored a skeptical look.
With his perception, he could only feel the rich and pulsating Demonic Qi inside the Demon Eye. How could the Water Spirit Saint Mother sense that the Crystal Body was hidden within it?
"Fellow Daoist Yuan need not be surprised. When refining the Crystal Body, I merged part of my essence into it, so when I am within a certain range, I can sense its presence," the Water Spirit Saint Mother explained, as if guessing Yuan Ming's thoughts.
This explanation made sense, and Yuan Ming nodded his head.
Seeing his reaction, the Water Spirit Saint Mother, along with Luo Zhu, approached the Demon Eye next to the altar and began to carefully investigate.
With the Thirty-Six Star Constellation Sealing Array in place, Yuan Ming wasn't too worried, but he contemplated whether he should inform the two about the Demon Eye.
If extracting her Water Spirit Body required destroying the Sealing Array, Yuan Ming might have to stop them.
After all, if the seal were destroyed, and the crack leading to the Demon World within the Demon Eye were opened, all their efforts against the Wu Yue Sect would have been in vain.
As Yuan Ming pondered, he suddenly heard an exclamation.
He quickly turned his head and saw that from the well on the altar, waves of black light were spewing forth, emitting intense waves of Demonic Qi that enveloped the entire altar in an instant, and the figures of Luo Zhu and the Water Spirit Saint Mother disappeared without a trace.
"Save me..."
The voice of Luo Zhu came from within the Demonic Qi, filled with utter urgency and sheer horror.
Yuan Ming couldn't see what was happening within the black light and Demonic Qi, but his Divine Thought perceived that the aura of Luo Zhu and the Water Spirit Saint Mother had vanished.
In just a few breaths, they had disappeared into thin air.
Before Yuan Ming could recover from his shock, the Demonic Qi surging out of the well began to assault the Thirty-Six Star Constellation Sealing Array, attempting to break through the seal.
Around the altar, one after another, star-like lights lit up from the thirty-six Array Eyes, immediately bursting forth with dazzling starlight, connecting to form a curtain of stars that covered the entire well, trying to block it off.
Under the pressure of the starlight, a large amount of Demonic Qi was forced back, but still, some escaped through the gaps, drifting about the entire Underground Palace.
It was only then that Yuan Ming finally understood how the Demonic Qi had originated here.
Looking at the curtain of stars, a deep concern filled his eyes as the Array's power seemed even weaker.
Just as he was about to bring out the Map of Ten Thousand Realms to collect the escaping Demonic Qi, the black light within the altar surged once more, and the billowing Demonic Qi erupted from the well like a geyser, instantly inflating the layer of starlight into a bulge that protruded outside the well, forming a large blister.
Yuan Ming's pupils suddenly contracted at the sight.
What he saw was a massive black iron coffin suspended within the swollen bulge, its surface uneven as if it were carved from meteorite iron from beyond the heavens, covered with dense and strange patterns.
Just by glancing at the iron coffin, Yuan Ming suddenly felt a heavy thud in his mind, as if he had been struck by something.
He started to circulate the Moonlight Technique almost instinctively, just stabilizing his Divine Soul when his heart suddenly tightened again.
It was because he sensed an extremely sinister Divine Thought locking onto him, feeling as if a primordial Fierce Beast were staring at him from behind, a chilling terror crawling up his back.
Immediately after, a horrifying surge of Divine Soul Power shot out from the black iron coffin, aiming precisely at Yuan Ming as if it were the noose of the grim reaper slung over his neck.
In the void, a streak of gray light shot towards Yuan Ming's head like an arrow.
"That feeling again..." Yuan Ming was shocked, snapping back to his senses.
This sensation was eerily similar to the one he experienced when he and Xi Ying destroyed the Breaking Realm Transfer Array, with the gray shadow that came through the blood-red eye's crack, even more fierce and overpowering than before.
But Yuan Ming had changed since then.
In a flash, the Divine Soul Power within Yuan Ming's Sea of Consciousness boiled over. The Divine Skills of the Realm of Word Witch, nearly without need for invocation, started rotating rapidly under the compulsion of crisis.
In front of his glabella, a pitch-black light condensed, and a black vortex emerged out of nowhere, emitting a tremendously powerful tearing force that directly swallowed the gray light.
The next instant, a loud "bang" erupted.
The black vortex before Yuan Ming's glabella exploded, dissipating into countless specks of black light.
Yuan Ming stumbled as if struck by a great force, his head thrown back violently, his body uncontrollably flung backward.
His Sea of Consciousness felt as if it were about to be ripped apart, his head filled with excruciatingly sharp pain.
But promptly, his abundant Soul Power soothed the pain, and he was not seriously harmed.
Yuan Ming, having just propped himself up from the ground, saw the thirty-six Star Constellation Sealing Array, bulging as if about to burst, suddenly light up around the Array Eyes with dazzling starlight as bright as pillars, exceptionally strong.
The starlight screen covering the black iron coffin suddenly shone brightly, the intense and blinding starlight enveloping the coffin, firmly locking it in place.
"Xia Jie, you old ghost, it's you again..."
The black iron coffin shook violently, an utterly wrathful voice emanating from within.
To Yuan Ming's astonishment, a figure emerged suddenly from a corner of the Underground Palace, and it was indeed the blind old man.
"Heh heh, Reincarnation Demon Lord, you finally couldn't endure any longer. All my years of planning were not in vain; this time, I'll make sure you roll back to the Demon World for good," Xia Jie said, looking at the black iron coffin and laughing coldly.
With that, his hands suddenly moved, creating a series of afterimages as he rapidly cast spells towards the thirty-six Star Constellation Sealing Array.
"Yuan, I originally thought it would be some time before I could make use of you, but now that you are here, do me a favor," Xia Jie shouted at Yuan Ming while casting his spells.
"Senior, what do you want me to do?" Yuan Ming asked with furrowed brows.
"Don't worry, when I tell you, just use your Sky-reaching Demon Pillar to widen the spatial rift within this Demon Eye," Xia Jie said with a chuckle, his demeanor utterly composed as if everything were under his control.
Afterward, he cast seven or eight more spells towards the thirty-six Star Constellation Sealing Array.
As his spells continued to fly, the light pillars emanating from the thirty-six Array Eyes began to twist, exploding one after another, scattering large swathes of starlight vortices.
Although these vortices scattered explosively, they were all restricted by the Great Array and did not spread beyond it.
A glance would make one think they were witnessing clusters of radiant fireworks blooming in succession.
When all thirty-six Array Eyes were detonated and all the starlight vortices merged, an enormous bird's phantom emerged within the dazzling starlight, its wings shimmering with light as it flew low towards the black iron coffin.
"Now is the time, do it," Xia Jie bellowed.
Yuan Ming, already prepared, immediately motivated the Sky-reaching Demon Pillar towards the altar's well opening.
The thick, black stone pillar crashed into the well, its demon patterns lighting up, and mighty, twisting forces of space burst forth from the pillar.
In an instant, the entire altar began to collapse inward, and the space along with it started to distort.
Soon after, a narrow, black crack appeared beneath the Sky-reaching Demon Pillar. It was only two to three zhang long but gave the impression of an unfathomable and bottomless rift.
This crack wasn't splintered on the ground but hovered in the void above.

chapters.title: Chapter 766 - 737 Chaotic Demon Species
chapters.content:
"Begone."
With a fierce shout, Xia Jie thrust both hands heavily towards the void in front of him.
The Starlight Giant Kite flapped its wings vigorously, bringing with it a series of starlight streamers as it violently collided with the black iron coffin.
The bizarre patterns on the surface of the black iron coffin suddenly lit up simultaneously, emitting a strange dark purple glow.
A tangible black mist spread out from it, breaking through the starlight screen that shackled it and filled the surroundings, nearly submerging the iron coffin within it.
It was notably denser and purer than the Demonic Qi previously encountered at the stone gate.
Yuan Ming merely glanced at it and felt an almost suffocating terror descend from the sky in an instant.
At this moment, Xia Jie was muttering under his breath and raised an arm, pointing solemnly at the black iron coffin.
Suddenly, a dazzling golden light shone from the head of the Starlight Giant Kite, and then a spirit light shot out from it, dimly revealing a golden figure a few inches tall within.
The small figure was surrounded by brilliant golden light; from afar, it was too blurred to discern any facial features. As soon as it appeared, it moved slightly and turned into a flash of golden light, vanishing into the iron coffin without a trace.
With a bang!
The black mist that had been furiously rushing out of the black iron coffin rolled back into the coffin after a massive tremor.
In an instant, not a trace of the black mist surrounding the iron coffin remained.
The bizarre patterns on the surface of the coffin then brightened significantly but immediately dimmed to an unprecedented dullness.
At that moment, the Starlight Giant Kite also collided with the black iron coffin. Upon contact, it suddenly dispersed, transforming into even more dazzling starlight that enveloped the entire coffin.
The previously seemingly heavy black iron coffin, now wrapped in starlight, interwoven black and white, appeared surprisingly magnificent and became incredibly light, beginning to fly towards the black crack that Yuan Ming had smashed open with the Sky-reaching Demon Pillar.
After entering the crack, the figure of the iron coffin visibly began to shrink at a speed visible to the naked eye until it flew into the darkness deep within the crack, turned into a bright spot, and finally disappeared.
All this might sound lengthy, but it all happened in just two or three breaths.
Yuan Ming was still somewhat dazed, but then he heard Xia Jie's slightly weary voice:
"You can retract the Sky-reaching Demon Pillar now."
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming immediately waved his hand and collected the Sky-reaching Demon Pillar.
The Space Power that was turbulent inside the Underground Palace immediately contracted, and the hovering black crack in the void also immediately shrank, until it turned into a black spot as small as a grain of rice.
"Mission accomplished," Xia Jie finally relaxed and let out a sigh, saying.
"Senior, what exactly is going on here?" Yuan Ming was not as relaxed, steadying his somewhat turbulent spirit while turning to Xia Jie to ask.
"The fellow in that black iron coffin is the Reincarnation Demon Lord from the Demon World. Back then, we perished together. However, ultimately, both of us were severely injured and near death, too weak to kill the other, so we chose to seek a place to recuperate. This place was built by the Reincarnation Demon Lord as his mausoleum; he hid here, using this demon eye to heal and restore," Xia Jie explained.
"Was this Sealing Array also laid down by you?" Yuan Ming asked.
"Indeed. I discovered this place years ago, but since the Reincarnation Demon Lord was hiding inside that black iron coffin and could resist the oppression of Space Power, he hid inside the space crack within the demon eye and didn't come out. I had no other choice but to set up this Thirty-Six Star Constellation Sealing Array, precisely for today, to thoroughly send him back to the Demon World," Xia Jie nodded and continued.
"Since the array was already set, why did you only activate it today?" Yuan Ming was still somewhat puzzled.
"First, the array needed time to gather strength; second, we needed to wait for an opportunity, one that would make the Reincarnation Demon Lord come out voluntarily. Otherwise, if he kept hiding in the space crack, the Starlight Kite formed by the array wouldn't be able to capture him, naturally unable to send him back," Xia Jie, in a very good mood, answered all of Yuan Ming's questions.
"Was the Sky-reaching Demon Pillar also originally placed here by you?" Yuan Ming asked.
"The Sky-reaching Demon Pillar originally belonged to the Reincarnation Demon Lord. After I sealed it, I placed it outside the Underground Palace, firstly to block the stone gate, secondly to absorb the Demonic Qi leaking from the stone gate, to prevent creatures who accidentally wandered in from being contaminated by the Demonic Qi. Unexpectedly, you yanked it out," Xia Jie said with a laugh.
Yuan Ming, feeling somewhat embarrassed, coughed dryly and changed the subject: "By the way, Senior, what about the two people who came with me earlier?"
"They were too unlucky, I'm afraid they got sent to the Demon World along with the Reincarnation Demon Lord," Xia Jie paused, then said.
"This..." Yuan Ming was somewhat stunned.
He had intended to ask if the one who stole the Water Spirit Body of the Water Spirit Saint Mother was the Reincarnation Demon Lord, but the latter seemed to have run out of patience.
"Alright, stop asking questions. I still need to rearrange the array here to prevent the demon eye from recovering; if you have nothing else, you should leave quickly," Xia Jie waved his hand, already beginning to urge him on.
"Senior Xia Jie, may I know where you reside? I might seek your advice in the future," Yuan Ming asked hesitantly.
"I will return to the town; you can find me there if you need something," Xia Jie said.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming said no more, bowed to Xia Jie, and transformed into a streak of cyan light shooting outside, disappearing in the blink of an eye.
Xia Jie gently closed his all-white eyes, seemingly sensing something. After a moment, once he confirmed Yuan Ming had gone far, he reopened them.
Three purple rings flew out from his sleeve, hovering inside the stone chamber.
He cast several spells in succession, and the rings burst into myriad starlights, instantly flooding the entire stone chamber and forming a starlight barrier.
Xia Jie then tapped into the void at his waist, and a body shot out from a bag there—it was Liu Tianming.
Liu Tianming was still an empty shell, standing silently, motionless.
* (*)
Senior Xia Jie muttered some incantations, and a white orb emerged in his right hand, seemingly composed of countless threads revolving slowly around a black cocoon at its center.
With a flick of his palm, the white orb flew out and merged into Liu Tianming's body, settling in his Dantian.
The rotation speed of the white orb increased several folds, the Demonic Qi in the stone chamber surged and converged towards Liu Tianming, merging into the white orb.
The white orb quickly turned black, emitting waves of Demonic Qi, which rapidly intensified.
"Heh heh, true to a Chaotic Demon Species, its affinity with Demonic Qi is indeed astonishingly strong," said Xia Jie with a satisfied smile on his face.
He recited complex spells under his breath while a stream of Soul Power flew from his brow, merging into Liu Tianming's Sea of Consciousness.
Liu Tianming's previously vacant eyes sparkled with a glint, and he began to move his hands and feet as if familiarizing himself with the body.
Xia Jie continued his chants, rapidly forming hand seals towards the three Starlight Rings.
Bang bang bang!
The three Starlight Rings exploded, transforming into three dazzling starry clouds that enveloped Liu Tianming's body and once again formed a bird-like phantom similar to the previous one.
The Starlight Giant Kite flapped its wings and took Liu Tianming into the rift within the Demon Eye.
"Six Demon Lords, our conflict has not ended yet, since you desire this young man, then I shall use him to engage in another fierce battle," Xia Jie said with a slight smile as he looked at the spatial rift.
The Starlight Giant Kite disappeared into the spatial rift, which immediately started trembling, sending eerie vibrations spreading outward, causing the stone chamber to tremble as well, revealing numerous cracks.
Xia Jie's right hand closed on the void, with starlight rushing from all directions, quickly congealing into a long spear made of starlight about three meters long within a few breaths.
With a flick of his wrist, the starlight spear shot out, instantly disappearing into the spatial rift.
Boom!
A burst of tremendous light, resembling the sun, erupted from within the spatial rift, filling the stone chamber and even the entire Underground Palace.
The power contained within the starlight caused the stone chamber to collapse instantly, and the Underground Palace followed suit, with rolling dust spewing into Snake King Valley through the entrance.
The falling stones hit Xia Jie, but his body seemed to have turned into a phantom, allowing the stones to pass right through without causing any damage.
The spatial rift within the Demon Eye started to twist and, after a few breaths, shattered, thereby dissipating.
Xia Jie nodded, then vanished with a flicker.
...
Atop a mountain tens of miles away, Yuan Ming stood silently, looking towards Snake King Valley.
"Senior Xia Jie can still harness such a level of power, to destroy a spatial rift; it seems his cultivation is not half-ruined..." he muttered to himself.
"This old man is really formidable, destroying a spatial rift; master, perhaps even you couldn't do that, right?" Hua Zhi's voice came from the Spiritual Beast Bag.
Yuan Ming silently nodded, acknowledging that indeed, he was not yet capable of manipulating space to such an extent.
He continued observing Snake King Valley but did not leave.
Did Xia Jie come to Snake King Valley merely to destroy the tomb of the Reincarnation Demon Lord? He always felt that the man had deeper intentions.
After considering for a while, Yuan Ming stopped pondering.
No matter what Xia Jie intended to do, it had little to do with him as long as he did not attempt to summon the Demon Clan to the Yunhuang Continent like the Blood Demon Ancestor had.
Yuan Ming turned to leave, then suddenly remembered something and sat down cross-legged.
He sealed both Hua Zhi and Vajra within the Spiritual Beast Bag to prevent their Divine Sense from leaking, then used the Silver Token to open a silver barrier.
Having done these, Yuan Ming summoned the Stealing Heaven Tripod, lit the Black Incense, and attempted possession of Luo Zhu.
His vision darkened momentarily before brightening again, having possessed Luo Zhu and appearing in a black space.
Yuan Ming did not move carelessly but carefully surveyed his surroundings.
Soon, he saw that Luo Zhu was lying on the sarcophagus of the Reincarnation Demon Lord, his limbs shackled by chains formed from Demonic Qi, speeding forward at an incredibly fast rate.
The black space was shaped like a corridor, emitting tremendous spatial fluctuations, apparently a rather unstable spatial passage.
"Just as suspected, Luo Zhu is not dead but was captured by the Reincarnation Demon Lord," Yuan Ming thought with pleasure.
He had long been curious about the Demon World; every time he asked Qi Ye, Qi Ye would sidestep the question, unwilling to elaborate. Now, having Luo Zhu provided him the opportunity to glimpse into that realm.
However, given the Reincarnation Demon Lord's inscrutable strength, he dared not make any sudden movements, lest he be noticed.
Should Luo Zhu be detected and meet a harsh fate, his plans would be utterly ruined.
With this thought, Yuan Ming retracted his consciousness and waited quietly.

chapters.title: Chapter 767 - 738: Imprisonment
chapters.content:
As time trickled by, the black space where Luo Zhu and the coffin were located did not change much; one could only sense oneself continuously advancing forward along this seemingly endless corridor.
The Reincarnation Demon Lord inside the coffin, whether asleep or not, did not make a sound nor show any signs of disturbance, which allowed Yuan Ming to slightly relax his originally taut nerves.
Still, he dared not act recklessly for fear that any of his actions might bring unforeseen danger to Luo Zhu, which would thwart his original plan to investigate the Demon World through possession.
In the end, when the time of the Black Incense Possession ended, his consciousness returned to his own body.
Yuan Ming opened his eyes, took a long breath, then put away the Stealing Heaven Tripod and Silver Token, turning into a streak of blue light as he headed straight for the East Sea.
With his current cultivation, it took only a few days to reach the East Sea.
He did not go to Dragon King City but headed directly to a second-class island near Bikong Island.
The Island Master of Bikong Island only had mid-stage Core Formation cultivation, and the island had no specialties to speak of; it was quite ordinary among the many second-class islands of the East Sea.
Yuan Ming concealed his cultivation and landed in a mortal town on the island.
In a small courtyard within the town, an elderly woman with white hair was holding a trowel, tending to the flowers and plants in the garden—it was Yuan Mu.
Yuan Zuochong was inside the house, writing at a desk with a flexible wrist motion, giving off the flair of a lively brush, but unfortunately, the characters on the rice paper were not high grade, quite ordinary.
Yuan Ming cracked a slight smile, opened the door, and walked in.
"Mother, I'm back."
"Ming'er…" Yuan Mu's face lit up with surprise, and she put down her trowel to greet him.
Hearing the commotion, Yuan Zuochong looked out the window to see Yuan Ming's figure and dropped his writing brush, leaving a blot of ink on the rice paper.
Ignoring the mess, he quickly walked outside, chiding, "You rascal, leaving the house and neglecting your family, you're really asking for it!"
Yuan Ming's return brought great joy to both Mr. Yuan and Yuan Mu, who personally cooked a table full of dishes.
The family of three chatted happily for a good while, mostly with Mr. Yuan and Yuan Mu talking, while Yuan Ming listened quietly.
Enjoying the long-missed warmth, Yuan Ming felt exceptionally peaceful, and the hidden agitation of his Divine Soul eased a lot.
"Ming'er, how long are you planning to stay this time?" asked Yuan Zuochong, exchanging a glance with Yuan Mu.
"I've handled most things outside; from now on, I will stay here," Yuan Ming replied.
"Good, good…" Yuan Zuochong said, pleased.
"What's good about it? Ming'er, you don't have to keep us company, concentrate on your own affairs," Yuan Mu said, giving Yuan Zuochong a stern look.
"Mother, don't worry, my affairs are indeed taken care of; I can stay with you for a while," Yuan Ming assured her.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Mu didn't say anything more.
"By the way, father, mother, I have brought back some life-extending treasures for you this time," Yuan Ming said as he took out several Jade Boxes.
"Life-extending treasures! Such things are incredibly precious, don't overspend for our sake," Yuan Zuochong said in surprise, hurrying to add.
There was a workshop on Bikong Island, and Yuan Zuochong would occasionally visit it; he understood somewhat the value of life-extending treasures in the Cultivation World.
"It's just a small thing, not worth mentioning," Yuan Ming said.
He took out two yellow spirit fruits and had his parents consume them, using mana to help the elders digest and absorb them.
The fruit was known as Essence Boosting Fruit, which could extend a cultivator's lifespan by twenty years upon consumption.
Yuan Zuochong, who possessed a Spirit Root, absorbed the Essence Boosting Fruit and underwent a significant change in appearance; his skin smoothed out, his eyes became brighter, and he looked more than a decade younger.
Yuan Mu also became much younger, but as she had no Spirit Root and even with Yuan Ming's assistance, only a small portion of the fruit's power was absorbed, extending her lifespan by only five or six years.
Yuan Ming inwardly sighed, knowing that life-extending treasures all worked based on Spiritual Energy, and without a Spirit Root, the effects on mortals would naturally be less satisfactory.
He then administered another life-extending treasure to his mother, which had an even lesser effect, increasing her lifespan by only two or three years.
Yuan Ming brought out a third life-extending treasure. Its medicinal power was similar to the Essence Boosting Fruit, but this time the increased lifespan was a mere half a year.
He wasn't too surprised, as even for cultivators, the efficacy of life-extending treasures would gradually diminish with repeated use.
"It seems ordinary life-extending treasures won't be of much use to mother; I must find those driven by Qi-Blood Power," Yuan Ming thought to himself.
"Ming'er, don't concern yourself too much; everyone must die eventually. Mother has already lived much longer than ordinary people, and having such an exciting life in my years is already very fortunate, you don't need to strive for more," Yuan Mu said with a gentle smile.
"Mother is right," Yuan Ming replied.Spotanerror?VisittheoriginalpostonM&VLEMPY&R.
"Ming'er, stop worrying about us; focus on your own affairs. Although cultivators have long lifespans, you should also consider settling down," Yuan Mu said with a firm gaze at Yuan Ming.
"Yes, Ming'er, with your current cultivation, finding a wife shouldn't be difficult; even the Island Master of Bikong Island, who is a Core Formation Stage cultivator, is rumored to have more than a dozen concubines," Yuan Zuochong added.
"Father, mother, your words are duly noted," Yuan Ming said, an image of Xi Ying flickering in his Sea of Consciousness as he nodded.
In the following days, Yuan Ming settled down on Bikong Island.
He did not construct another Cave Mansion, preferring to live in his parent's yard instead.
He had set up several arrays and an illusion array around the courtyard, making it invisible from the outside.
Yuan Ming took out the Gathering Spirit Tree from the Stealing Heaven Tripod space and planted it in the yard, where the spiritual energy of nature within the array became visibly denser at a speed noticeable to the naked eye.
Yuan Ming nodded in satisfaction, with the blessing of the Gathering Spirit Tree, the spiritual energy of nature in the yard was comparable to that of a first-class island.
"The air seems to have become more humid, and with every breath, I feel a bit more relaxed." In the yard, Yuan Mu looked up in confusion.
"It's Ming'er's doing," Yuan Zuochong said softly.
He could clearly sense the spiritual energy of nature in the yard increasing visibly, and Yuan Ming had not been particularly discreet when setting up the arrays; it must be his doing.
Hearing the conversation of his parents outside, Yuan Ming secretly nodded in agreement.
Indeed, being in a place rich in spiritual energy, even if one couldn't absorb it, was beneficial to his mother's health.
Yuan Ming collected his thoughts and sat down cross-legged.
His Body Cultivation and Soul Cultivation had already reached profound realms, yet his Magic Practitioner abilities lagged far behind and needed rapid improvement.
Yuan Ming had just told his parents that he would stay here, not just to reassure them but with the genuine intention to cultivate in tranquillity.
First, he took out a Communication Talisman and sent a message to Xu Che, asking him to continue looking for life-extending treasures that could be activated with the power of Qi-Blood.
After sorting everything out, Yuan Ming didn't immediately begin to cultivate but summoned the Stealing Heaven Tripod, ready to possess Luo Zhu again.
Counting the days, it had been almost seven, and he wondered if the coffin of the Reincarnation Demon Lord had already reached the Demon World.
He took out a stick of Black Incense, an ordinary type that couldn't control one's actions, but its effect when used for possession was even better.
Remembering Luo Zhu's face, Yuan Ming's consciousness darkened and soon reawakened.
What appeared before him was no longer the black space corridor from before, but rather a dim space that looked like a gray cavern.
Luo Zhu was quietly sitting there, with the cave entrance firmly locked by an iron gate, which looked like a prison.
The cave was devoid of nature's spiritual energy, but instead filled with a faint Demonic Qi.
Luo Zhu's mana and divine soul were sealed by a peculiar restriction, and at this moment, she was no different from an ordinary mortal. Furthermore, the hairpin that housed the Water Spirit Saint Mother was nowhere to be seen.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming felt relieved.
As expected, the Reincarnation Demon Lord had not killed Luo Zhu directly but had taken her to the Demon World.
Although the golden formation inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod had stopped operating and couldn't transfer items, it was still beneficial to learn about the situation in the Demon World.
With a thought, Yuan Ming activated his divine sense to explore the surroundings.
The prohibition within Luo Zhu's divine soul also constrained Yuan Ming's divine sense, but his divine soul was exceptionally strong, far surpassing Luo Zhu's, and he broke through with just a little effort.
He suddenly let out a light sound of surprise.
In the past, while possessing someone else, his divine sense could also leave the body, but there were many limitations, let alone exerting any combat power.
However, this time the divine sense exploration was unusually smooth, as if his own body was extending its divine sense.
Moreover, Yuan Ming had an intuition that although using Illusion Technique would be less effective in this state, it wouldn't be a problem.
"Previously, Xia Jie said that the deeper the refinement of the Stealing Heaven Tripod, the better the effect of possession and the gathering of desire power would be. It seems to be true."
As he pondered, Yuan Ming's divine sense spread out, soon covering a few hundred zhang around and exploring another cave prison where an ox-headed, human-bodied alien was imprisoned.
Yuan Ming had a thought and used the Dream Butterfly Illusion Technique.
The ox-headed alien's divine sense had also been applied with that strange prohibition, but it could not withstand Yuan Ming's powerful divine sense and was quickly invaded.
The ox-headed alien's clear eyes immediately became misty, falling into an illusion.
"It really works," Yuan Ming whispered to himself.
He was just trying it out and soon withdrew his divine sense.
At this moment, Luo Zhu was silently staring ahead, completely unaware of what had happened. Her last memory was being enveloped by the Demonic Qi from within the Demon Eye and losing consciousness immediately after. When she awakened, she found herself here.
What could this place be, devoid of nature's spiritual energy but filled with Demonic Qi?
Recalling everything she had experienced before, Luo Zhu couldn't help but speculate—could she have been brought to the legendary Demon World?
Just then, the cell door opened with a clang, and a red-skinned man clad in black leather armor entered.
The man was a head taller than the people of the Yunhuang Continent, with an exceptionally burly physique. He had a long whip full of barbs wrapped around his waist, and he looked like a prison guard.
"Come out," the man commanded Luo Zhu unceremoniously.
Upon hearing this, Luo Zhu's expression changed, but she quickly concealed any trace of it.
Her divine soul may have been sealed and her divine sense unable to seep out, but her late-stage Nascent Soul's keen spiritual perception was still intact. The power of the red-skinned man in front of her was not weak; his physical body was extremely strong and not something she could contend with in her current state.

chapters.title: Chapter 768 - 739: Sightseeing in the Demon World
chapters.content:
Luo Zhu didn't resist, and silently stood up, obediently following the red-skinned man out.
Seeing that Luo Zhu was sensible, the red-skinned man also said no more and turned to lead the way.
The two walked along the corridor outside and, after a short while, arrived at an underground cave a hundred times larger, where many prisoners, similar to Luo Zhu, gathered, totaling in the hundreds.
The people here were all oddly shaped, some with horns on their heads, some with scales on their skin, and others partly human and partly beast.
In front of the cave was a huge stone wall with many cave openings about ten feet high, densely packed like a honeycomb.
The sound of howling wind came from the cave, sounding very mournful and carrying strong fluctuations of demonic Qi.
Beneath the stone wall of the cave stood dozens of red-skinned men who looked similar and appeared to be from the same clan.
"Alright, one by one enter the Demon Wind Cave. Whether you can withstand the baptism of demonic Qi depends on your fate," a leading red-skinned giant man glanced at Luo Zhu and then averted his gaze, saying coldly.
This man was a head taller than the other red-skinned men, with bulging muscles all over his body, giving him an extremely oppressive appearance.
"Impossible! The Demon Wind Cave is at its strongest right now, how could we possibly withstand it!" an alien with blue scales shouted.
Half of his body's scales had turned black, emitting bursts of demonic Qi fluctuations.
Seeing someone taking the lead, other prisoners also began to voice their resistance.
The red-skinned giant man sneered coldly, his arm shook, and the whip at his waist shot out like an arrow, piercing through the chest of the blue-scaled alien and leaving a bloody hole.
The blue-scaled alien's eyes bulged, his mouth opened, but no sound came out as his body thudded to the ground, twitching a few times before going still.
"Those who enter might still have a glimmer of hope. Those who don't want to can stay out, but they will surely die!" the red-skinned giant man retracted his whip and said indifferently.
Seeing this, the other prisoners fell silent, not daring to speak anymore.
"Move!" The red-skinned giant man sneered again and barked.
The prisoners, angry yet unable to speak out, entered the caves in the stone wall one by one, three to each cave.
Luo Zhu pursed her lips, didn't resist, and entered a cave with a one-horned man and a three-eyed woman.
The one-horned man and the three-eyed woman also had fluctuations of demonic Qi on them, though much weaker.
"The two of you, what is inside this Demon Wind Cave?" As soon as she was out of the sight of the red-skinned men, Luo Zhu quickly whispered.
"Are you new here?" The one-horned man glanced at Luo Zhu, asking with a slight tone of contempt.
"Yes," Luo Zhu did not care, nodding her head.
"What else can be inside the Demon Wind Cave but demonic winds?" The one-horned man said, grinning as he walked.
Luo Zhu was taken aback; she of course knew there were demonic winds here, as she could feel it standing there.
"Fellow Daoist, the winds in the Demon Wind Cave are Body-shaping Demon Winds, which can transform a creature's physique. If you can endure this torturous transformation, you can change into a half-demon form," the three-eyed woman kindly explained in a low voice.
"Turn into a demon?" Luo Zhu was astonished.
"I don't know where you come from, Fellow Daoist, but in the Land of Nothingness, do not harbor any illusions. Accept the baptism of the demonic winds obediently. Being able to transform into a half-demon is considered a great fortune; otherwise, you might just die here," the three-eyed woman sighed lightly and continued.
Luo Zhu stood frozen in place upon hearing this, and it took a few breaths for her to continue forward.
The three of them soon reached the depths of the Demon Wind Cave, where a stele stood, engraved with a mantra that appeared to be a secret skill for absorbing demonic Qi.
Behind the stele, the cave wall was covered with countless small holes, from which strands of black demonic winds emerged and swirled around the cave.
The one-horned man ignored the stele, gritted his teeth, and stepped into the area with the black wind, sitting down cross-legged.
"This stele contains the Demon Qi Technique. Remember to utilize this technique once you enter the black wind area, or you won't last long in the demonic winds," the three-eyed woman explained and then also entered the black wind area.
At this moment, Luo Zhu had fully understood her situation. She bit her lip, quickly reviewed the Demon Qi Technique, and then stepped into the black wind area.
The moment she entered, waves of blade-like demonic Qi assaulted her, creeping into her body through her pores, running rampant everywhere.
Luo Zhu only felt excruciating pain all over, as if she was being slashed by thousands of knives, her body trembling uncontrollably, her muscles sore and weak, on the verge of tears.
She quickly sat down, operated the just-reviewed Demon Qi Technique, and the chaotic demonic Qi in her body began to gather, slowly seeping into her meridians, organs, and other parts.
"So that's it, the Demon Qi Technique is used in this way…" Yuan Ming noted to himself, sensing something.
He was about to sense more carefully, but just then, the time for his Black Incense Possession ended, and he felt darkness before his eyes, then returned to his own body.
Yuan Ming calmed his emotions and put away the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
Although this possession session did not yield any crucial information, seeing the condition of the Demon World was still worthwhile.
The Demon Qi Technique was also quite exquisite, it could even transform individuals from alien clans into beings similar to the Demon Clan, making it highly valuable for research.
Yuan Ming took out a Jade Scroll and recorded the contents of the Demon Qi Technique.
He closed his eyes to cultivate his spirit for a while, took out the Sky-reaching Demon Pillar, spent some effort opening the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space, and his Divine Soul entered it to begin refining his Divine Soul.
The Divine Soul is fundamental, for Yuan Ming at this point, it was even more important than cultivating the Nine Elements Technique.ThefullseriesishostedonMyVirtualLibraryEmpire,knownas*.
Yuan Ming was already very familiar with the situation inside the White Jade Lotus Platform, his Divine Soul quickly arrived at the space of the White Jade Lotus Platform. However, a net of bright Soul Fire blocked his way.
"I forgot about this net of fire," he mumbled to himself, hastily controlling his Divine Soul to stop.
The effect of this Bright Soul Fire burning the Divine Soul was crystal clear to him; within the space of the White Jade Lotus Platform, Pure Will Power could be absorbed for recovery, but not outside.
Once encountered, the Divine Soul would surely be severely damaged, it might even be burned to death directly.
Yuan Ming immediately became calm and focused, controlling his Divine Soul to wander within the space of the White Jade Lotus Platform, looking for a way to break through the fire net.
However, the fire net was extremely dense, without the slightest loophole. After searching for a long while, he could only give up reluctantly.
"Forget it, I'll wait for the Vow Power within the White Jade Lotus Platform to refill, and when the Vow Power Pill condenses, the fire nets will retract. By then, I can enter. Considering the current speed of Vow Power gathering, it should take about a year to fill," Yuan Ming mused to himself and controlled his Divine Soul to leave the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space.
Facing obstacles in refining his Divine Soul, Yuan Ming did not waste more time and prepared to operate the Nine Elements Technique.
"Master, are you about to start intense cultivation next?" Vajra's voice came from the Spiritual Beast Bag.
"Yes, what's the matter?" Yuan Ming nodded and asked.
No sooner had he spoken than he realized Vajra's intention in speaking up and took out the Shura Blood Devouring Map.
Within the map, the remnant body of Xue Li had already been refined cleanly, turning into a cluster of extremely thick Blood Essence.
"Take this, refine and absorb it well, strive to break through to the Body of Wanxiang as soon as possible," Yuan Ming took out this cluster of Blood Origin Power, throwing it into the Spiritual Beast Bag.
"Thank you, Master. It's just too confining in this Spiritual Beast Bag, I'll go outside to find a place to cultivate," Vajra happily thanked him and then flew out of the Spiritual Beast Bag, heading straight outside without another word.
"Master, are you going into seclusion?" Not long after Vajra left, Hua Zhi also flew out of the Spiritual Beast Bag.
"My realm of Magic Practitioner is a bit behind; it needs to be elevated as soon as possible," Yuan Ming nodded.
"Didn't you tell Xi Qian earlier that you only have Cultivation Techniques up to the Nascent Soul Stage? Are you planning to switch techniques?" Hua Zhi asked, puzzled.
"No such thing; I've already obtained the Martial Arts Mantra of the Nine Elements Technique up to the Returning Void Stage from Elder San Jue," Yuan Ming explained.
Xi Ying contributed significantly in the major battle, yet sought nothing in return, giving all the advantages to the Moon Sect. His earlier statement to Xi Qian was just an excuse to cede the Blood Spirit Vein to the Xi Family as a gesture of goodwill.
"I see. Since you are going into seclusion, I will also go out and cultivate for a while. My cultivation was interrupted because of the war last time, and now I'd like to attempt to break through to Level 4 Upper Stage. But, Master, please grant me some Demon Qi," Hua Zhi spoke cheerily.
"Alright then," Yuan Ming took out the Red Ancient Scroll, his expression suddenly changing briefly before returning to normal.
He took out a large cluster of Demon Qi from inside and threw it to Hua Zhi.
Hua Zhi thanked him and dove into the ground, heading outside the island.
Yuan Ming sat cross-legged, spread the Red Ancient Scroll in front of him, and his Divine Sense entered it.
Just moments ago, he noticed that the Magic Cloud Trees inside the ancient scroll were now intertwined with each other, their roots penetrating into each other's bodies, seemingly merging into one.
"What is going on... Can the Magic Cloud Trees actually devour each other?" Yuan Ming murmured to himself.
"What, are those Magic Cloud Trees merging with each other?" Qi Ye's voice sounded.
"Oh, does Fellow Daoist Qi Ye know about this," Yuan Ming raised his eyebrows and asked.
"I can only say I know a bit; mutual devouring is a characteristic of the Magic Cloud Trees, it just requires special conditions to occur. Don't worry, it's a good thing. After devouring each other, the Magic Cloud Trees will undergo a transformation, and after transforming, they will produce even purer Demon Qi," Qi Ye continued.
Yuan Ming was delighted to hear this; his Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill was a Demon World Cultivation Technique, and his future cultivation would certainly demand increasingly high amounts of Demon Qi.
With the space rift in the Snake King Valley already collapsed, he was worried about how to gather pure Demon Qi. He hadn't expected that just as he was worrying, an opportunity would present itself like a pillow for his sleep.
"Under what circumstances will the Magic Cloud Trees mutually devour and transform?" Yuan Ming asked.
"That I do not know; the cultivation of Magic Cloud Trees is the highest secret of the Demon World. I was just a wanderer before, how would I know such details," Qi Ye said.
Yuan Ming heard this and did not inquire further, carefully sensing the Magic Cloud Trees in the Red Ancient Scroll, confirming they were indeed transforming before he put it away.
With various chores finally coming to an end, he sat down cross-legged, took out Five Elements Spirit Marrow, swallowed a drop, and began to cultivate the Nine Elements Technique with closed eyes.
Before long, the Gathering Spirit Tree gathered Spiritual Energy and swirled into his body.
Yuan Ming thus went into seclusion on Bikong Island, his focus primarily on cultivating the Nine Elements Technique, and only at night would he switch to cultivating the Moonlight Technique.

chapters.title: Chapter 769 - 740: Just Deserts
chapters.content:
Time passed quietly, and in the blink of an eye, three months had gone by.
With the help of the Gathering Spirit Tree and the Five Elements Spirit Marrow, as well as a large number of elixirs, Yuan Ming's cultivation of the Nine Elements Technique was exceptionally smooth.
However, three months was too short to achieve significant effects, but there were indeed some noticeable movements from Vajra and Hua Zhi.
Vajra had absorbed the Blood Origin Power refined from Xue Li and had advanced further in strength, but unfortunately, the Body of Wanxiang, a critical threshold of Body Cultivation, was beyond Vajra's reach to break through.
Mixed with shame and anger, Vajra said goodbye to Yuan Ming and simply left Bikong Island to venture out and temper his will.
Hua Zhi, with the help of Demonic Qi, had smoothly broken through to the Level 4 Upper Stage, but it seemed she wanted to surpass Vajra, so she too did not stay on Bikong Island and went out to travel.
Yuan Ming did not stop them, as both Hua Zhi and Vajra were at a bottleneck; venturing out could be beneficial for them.
After all, the path ahead of him might be filled with more unknowns and perilous obstacles. If he had strong reinforcements, it could naturally enhance his own ability to respond.
Yuan Ming slowly opened his eyes and turned his hand to take out a black Jade Scroll, which recorded the experiences of possessing Luo Zhu multiple times over the past three months, as well as the minor gains from those Demon Clan guards.
Through these clues, Yuan Ming had already roughly figured out the location and function of the Land of Nothingness.
The Land of Nothingness was situated in a remote area to the northwest of the Demon World, surrounded by a demonic natural disaster known as the Destructive Demon Wind, making it a death zone impossible to enter or leave on one's own, akin to a natural prison.
In fact, the Land of Nothingness truly was a massive prison, detaining people from many other realms that the Demon World had captured. Luo Zhu and the hundreds of prisoners before them were just an insignificant fraction of those detained in the Land of Nothingness.
The entire Land of Nothingness was ruled by someone known as the "Hell Demon Lord," who also resided within it, though he rarely showed himself—at least, Yuan Ming had never seen him in his several possessions.
The Alien Clan members imprisoned in the Land of Nothingness were mostly like Luo Zhu, being attempted to be transformed into Half-demons and reduced to soldiers of the Demon Clan.
As for Luo Zhu, surprisingly, he had withstood the erosion of the demonic wind and had not fallen.
Yuan Ming tucked away the black Jade Scroll and turned his hand again to take out a Green Spirit Communication Talisman. This was recently sent by Xi Ying, detailing the current situation of both Xi Ying and the Xi Family.
With the help of a black palace left by the Wu Yue God, Xi Ying had successfully completed the ritual to heaven and obtained a title of respect as the Xi Yue God, founding the Xi Yue Sect, which spread in the Northern Desert, taking over all the territories of the Wu Yue Sect.
Many remnants of the Wu Yue Sect were subdued by Xi Ying, only Ni Mu and a few close confidants suddenly disappeared, their whereabouts unknown.
"Xi Ying's actions are quite swift," Yuan Ming murmured to himself, a smile appearing at the corner of his mouth.
As for the departure of Ni Mu and the others, he was not surprised.
Although they had only met a few times, Yuan Ming had a considerable understanding of Ni Mu, who appeared gentle and scholarly but was in fact proud and ambitious, unwilling to submit to Xi Ying. It was normal for him to choose to leave.
"However, since Ni Mu was once under the Wu Yue God, it's uncertain whether he has relations with the Demon World. I'll need to pay attention to this person in the future," Yuan Ming thought to himself.
He then took out a Green Spirit Communication Talisman, whispered a few words into it, and with a pat on his waist, Lei Yu's figure flew out from the Spiritual Beast Bag.
"Here you go," Yuan Ming tossed the Green Spirit Communication Talisman to Lei Yu.
Lei Yu bit it and then fled swiftly, shooting towards the north.
Since the East Sea was too far from the Northern Desert, far beyond the limit of the Green Spirit Communication Talisman, Yuan Ming had Lei Yu act as a messenger between him and Xi Ying.
Fortunately, there were no major matters that needed communication at the moment, and with Lei Yu's fast tunneling speed, such a method of communication wasn't too time-consuming.
Yuan Ming watched as Lei Yu disappeared into the sky, then returned to his place of seclusion to resume his cultivation.
A day later.
Yuan Ming, who was in the midst of a closed-door cultivation, suddenly opened his eyes, a smile forming on his face.
The next instant, his figure flashed, and he appeared outside Bikong Island.
In midair, Wulu stood quietly; upon seeing Yuan Ming appear, he immediately smiled.
"Brother Yuan, I hope my sudden visit hasn't disturbed you," he said with a salute.
"Not at all, I'm more than happy that you could come," Yuan Ming responded, leading Wulu toward the island and introducing him to his parents.
Upon learning that Wulu was Yuan Ming's good friend, they warmly welcomed him, and Yuan Mu even personally cooked to prepare a family feast.
During the meal, Yuan Mu, hearing that the two had been acquainted since the Southern Border, repeatedly inquired about their experiences at that time.
Wulu, being articulate, deliberately downplayed the hardships of those times in conversation, mentioning only some minor, amusing incidents.
For a time, the host and guests were all merry.
After the feast ended, Yuan Ming and Wulu returned to their dwelling alone, continuing to drink and be merry.
"Brother Yuan, I notice your mother has no cultivation, I fear that her lifespan..." However, after two cups had been drunk, Wulu's expression became serious, and he spoke with a hint of worry.
"Alas, I fear she may only have twenty or thirty years left," Yuan Ming sighed deeply and drank a cup of bitter wine.
"Have you ever used anything to prolong lifespan?" Wulu asked.
"Upon my return, Xi Ying gave me some, but my mother lacks a Spirit Root, so the effects were very poor," Yuan Ming shook his head.
Upon hearing this, Wulu fell into thought for a moment, then suddenly touched his Storage Ring and took out a jade figurine in human form.
The surface of the Jade Mummy was covered with milky white jade pieces, seemingly bonded with a special technique. Though there were indentations, it had not broken apart; it was almost seamlessly whole, without any gaps.
"Take this Jade Mummy for now, Brother Yuan. According to the memories of the Blood Demon Ancestor, this mummy can put the wearer into deep sleep, freezing their lifespan. With your cultivation, as long as you spend some more time, you should always be able to find a way to extend your mother's lifespan. Before then, why not use this method to maintain it for a while?" Wulu said.
"I have heard of this method with the Jade Mummy from Xi Ying as well, but the Bone Jade required for its refinement is hard to find, and the Jade Mummy has almost disappeared in the East Sea. This one from Brother Wulu...could it be that you got it from the Blood Demon Ancestor's stronghold?" Yuan Ming quickly guessed the origin of the Jade Mummy.
"Exactly, I've been to several of his strongholds in the East Sea. There wasn't much left inside; most of it must have been used up by him. Such a pity," Wulu sighed regretfully, took out a Storage Ring, and handed it to Yuan Ming.
"Brother Wulu, what do you mean by this?" Yuan Ming asked in confusion.
"Ever since I met you again on Fusang Island, I have always been under your care. These things from the Blood Demon Ancestor's stronghold, I cannot keep them all for myself. Half of these, consider it as my thanks to Brother Yuan," Wulu pushed the Storage Ring toward Yuan Ming again.
"Brother Wulu, with the friendship between you and me, there's no need for this. Moreover, you have helped me before, and the slaying of the Blood Demon Ancestor was solely your achievement. How could I have the face to share in the spoils?" Yuan Ming resolutely shook his head, refusing to accept the Storage Ring.
The full series lives on * (*).
"Enough, enough, let's not play these games between us. In this life, I only owe one person a favor, and these things are just a bonus. Don't force me to use a Stone Talisman to turn invisible and hide them on the island," Wulu made a face, loosely forming a spell with his right hand, as if he would turn invisible and hide the items if Yuan Ming did not agree.
Unable to persuade him, Yuan Ming could only nod helplessly, took the ring and gave it a quick look, planning to pick just one or two items to shut Wulu up.
"There's nothing much good anyway, just some Spirit Stones and spiritual materials. The only things worth noting, besides the Jade Mummy I just took out, are an unclaimed Blood Puppet Armor and a piece of Mixed Hole Primordial Stone," Wulu said as he began to drink again.
But just then, Yuan Ming's eyes widened in disbelief.
"What did you say? Mixed Hole Primordial Stone?" he raised his head in surprise.
