"Yes, that greyish stone in the corner. That's what the Blood Demon Ancestor's memories called it; seemed pretty precious, but exactly what it does, I didn't get that part of the memory. Why, is it important to you?" Wulu, holding a cup of wine, was somewhat puzzled.
"Very important, I have a secret technique that requires it for assistance. You have truly helped me out a lot," Yuan Ming contained his excitement and said.
He quickly took out the stone mentioned by Wulu from the ring and began to identify it.
An important characteristic of the Mixed Hole Primordial Stone is its ability to hold an immense amount of Spiritual Energy. When placed against a Spirit Stone, it can absorb the stone along with the contained Spiritual Energy into itself without increasing in size at all.
Yuan Ming tried all the identification methods mentioned in the Mixed Hole Secret Technique and soon confirmed that the stone in his hand was indeed a Mixed Hole Primordial Stone.
The Mixed Hole Secret Technique only recorded the effects and identification methods of the stone and not its appearance. Now that he saw how unremarkable it looked, if Wulu hadn't happened to mention it, Yuan Ming would have likely overlooked it as an ordinary spiritual material and would not have tested it.
"Since Brother Yuan likes it, then take it. Anyway, it's of no use to me," Wulu immediately said upon seeing Yuan Ming's joyous expression.
"Then I will accept it without protest. However, the Mixed Hole Primordial Stone and Jade Mummy are enough for me. As for the rest, I am not in need; Brother Wulu, you should take them back," Yuan Ming, suppressing his joy, nodded and pushed the ring back.
Wulu was somewhat reluctant but considering that Yuan Ming was now the leader of a power and indeed did not lack Spirit Stones and spiritual materials, he let it be and continued to drink and talk with Yuan Ming.
As the wine flowed freely, both men grew a little drunk when Wulu suddenly brought up his past.
"Whew, Brother Yuan should still remember. Initially, I was just a Dark Child working for the Cao Family, tasked with stealing various clans' Cultivation Techniques," Wulu put down his cup and took a breath.
"I remember. What, does the Cao Family dare to trouble you now?" Yuan Ming was surprised.
"The Cao Family no longer exists," Wulu laughed heartily, took a long swig from his cup, and shouted with satisfaction.
"Oh, who did it?" Yuan Ming asked.
"Naturally, it was Chang Chun Temple. The revenge for the battle where they attacked their stronghold, Tian Jizi always kept in his heart. After the defeat, Cao Xiangqing took his family's disciples and hid in the mountains of the Southern Border, but ultimately they couldn't escape the chase. I heard that in that battle, Tian Jizi personally took action, used a Secret Technique to find all those who bore the blood of the Cao Family, and other than young children, he executed all the rest without mercy," Wulu said, staring intently at his wine cup, an uncertain mix of joy and sorrow in his eyes.
"Tian Jizi wielded such a heavy hand, probably to make an example," Yuan Ming couldn't help but sigh.
"Maybe, but if I were Tian Jizi, I would have killed even more ruthlessly. The Cao Family, deserved what they got!" Wulu drained the last of his drink and then crushed the wine cup in his hand.

chapters.title: Chapter 770 - 741 Obsession
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming looked at Wulu with a surprised expression, not expecting his hatred for the Cao Family to be so deep.
After a brief silence, Wulu began to narrate again.
"Back then, as an orphan, I was taken in by the Cao Family who trained me as a Dark Child. Although I resented their control, I still remembered the kindness they showed by raising me, until I cultivated the Void Thought Technique and discovered that my memories had been tampered with using Demon Clan methods. My biological parents were actually killed by the Cao Family, and yet I had served my enemies for half my life!" Wulu said, his eyes nearly spewing flames.
"Alas, now that the Cao Family has perished, you have taken your revenge," Yuan Ming sighed.
"It's not enough. The Cao Family was merely a pawn; the Demon Clan is the true mastermind. They have long coveted the Chuyun Realm and have secretly laid countless cunning schemes. I swear, I must eradicate them completely and prevent them from invading!" Wulu declared as he slammed the table, stood up, and grabbed a jar of wine to drink heartily.
Yuan Ming noted the mention of "Chuyun Realm" in his words.
This must be the name of the realm where the Yunhuang Continent is located.
Yuan Ming silently memorized it, while Wulu finished the wine in the jar.
"The Blood Demon Ancestor has at least five sets of Blood Puppet Armor; you took one, leaving four," Wulu said, wiping his mouth with the hem of his clothes.
"But you only found one set," Yuan Ming noted the underlying implication in his words.
"Correct, and according to my investigation, the other three sets of Blood Puppet Armor did not appear in the battle. I suspect the Blood Demon Ancestor may have other Demon Clan assistants. These remnants, carrying the remaining Blood Puppet Armor, are hiding in Yunhuang, planning something unknown. I plan to start here, scour Yunhuang, and find their whereabouts," Wulu nodded firmly.
"Good, I'll also have the Moon Sect's people help you. If you need anything, just ask them, and if they cannot manage, I'll step in to help," Yuan Ming nodded.
"That's all I need to hear," Wulu drunkenly chuckled, then suddenly collapsed with a thud.
Since it was a gathering of good friends, they had not deliberately used mana to dispel the effects of the alcohol. The spiritual wine Yuan Ming brought out, bestowed by believers, had Wulu drinking excessively and now utterly intoxicated, he even started to speak nonsense.
However, it was evident that at this moment, Wulu was truly relaxing.
Yuan Ming did not interfere, understanding that Wulu needed this release through true inebriation.
Yuan Ming looked down at the now-empty wine jar and the small amount of liquid left in his own cup, ultimately giving a wry smile. He set up a protective barrier for Wulu, then left on his own.
...
The next morning.
Wulu woke from his hangover; a quick use of his mana cleared his mind and refreshed his body.
He bade Yuan Ming farewell and left alone to fulfill his promise, while Yuan Ming continued with his usual cultivation routine.
Meanwhile, Yuan Ming secretly found several elderly mortals whose life span was nearly exhausted, explained the stakes to them, and hoped they would help him test some theories on the Jade Puppet.
These elders had also received favors from the Moon Sect. Seeing Yuan Ming personally request their help, they immediately prostrated themselves, not even contemplating refusal.
Even so, Yuan Ming still provided some compensation to their families.
However, Yuan Ming's tests soon failed.
The Jade Puppet Technique had long been circulated in the East Sea, used for extending the life of cultivators, but it had never been available for mortals. Therefore, from the inception of the Jade Puppet, the possibility of mortals using it had never been considered.
Without a Spirit Root, the Jade Puppet was utterly ineffective.
Deeply disappointed, Yuan Ming sent the old men home and then secluded himself to study the Jade Puppet, attempting to create a new "Jade Puppet Technique" that could be used by mortals, emulating the Blood Demon Ancestor.
However, just as his research began, his father and mother unexpectedly approached him.
"Dad, Mom, what brings you here?" Yuan Ming quickly got up, asking in confusion.
"Ming'er, your mother and I wish to return to Da Jin," Yuan Zuochong said straightforwardly.
"Why, have you encountered any troubles on the island that need my assistance to resolve?" Yuan Ming was startled and quickly inquired.
"No, life on Bikong Island is good. However, both your mother and I have lived in Da Jin for most of our lives. Now that the world is at peace, we'd like to go back to see it once more. We're also getting older and would like to see our old friends again before we lose the chance," Yuan Zuochong explained.
"Since father has decided, I will accompany you both back," Yuan Ming realized and immediately nodded.
"Ming'er, you have your own matters to attend to, no need to take the trouble to accompany us back. Moreover, this time we go back, we likely won't return to the East Sea," Yuan Zuochong shook his head.
"Don't worry about that. With my current cultivation, anywhere in the Yunhuang Land is the same for me," Yuan Ming waved his hand dismissively.
Yuan Zuochong looked at him, hesitated to speak, but just as Yuan Ming was beginning to feel puzzled, his mother spoke up.
"Ming'er, you've been looking for a way to prolong my life recently, haven't you?" Yuan Ming's mother sighed.
"Mother needn't worry, I've already found some leads. It won't be long before I develop a complete method," Yuan Ming reassured her.
"Ming'er, let it be. Since birth, I have never longed for immortality. Having lived to see this day and raised a son like you, I am already content. Why do you exhaust your mind pondering methods to prolong my life?" Yuan Ming's mother shook her head and said.
"Mother, I do this willingly," Yuan Ming stepped forward and supported his mother.
"I know you are filial, but in this world, which parents would wish to become a burden to their son? Ming'er, promise me, stop worrying about us and focus on what you must do," his mother said gently, looking at Yuan Ming and raising her hand slightly, wanting to stroke his head.
"Mother—" Yuan Ming pursed his lips, lowered his head, feeling the warmth of his mother's palm, his heart full of emotions that he could not express.
"What your mother is saying is right, Ming'er. You should not stop because of us. The world is vast, and ultimately, we cannot accompany you through every journey. But remember, no matter what, our hearts are with you, and even in the depths of the underworld, both your mother and I will always be thinking of you," Yuan Zuochong stepped forward and patted Yuan Ming's shoulder.
Yuan Ming did not respond, but suddenly hugged his parents.
Yuan Zuochong and his wife were slightly surprised, but they soon smiled and embraced him in return.
The three of them hugged quietly, all emotions blooming wordlessly.
...
Several days later, the Flying Boat carrying Yuan Ming's parents left Bikong Island.
Against the firm refusal of his parents, Yuan Ming did not return to the Central Plains with them, but instead had Xu Che select a group of believers to ensure their safety on the road.
He also dispatched a Three-eyed Crow to secretly follow and protect them and contacted various powers to ensure his parents' safety during their journey.
In today's Yunhuang, no one wanted to irritate Yuan Ming over such a trivial matter.
Even the East Sea forces that had abandoned the faith in the Nether Moon God took this matter seriously, dispatching personnel to ensure safety at every segment of the route.
At Chang Chun Temple, Tian Jizi even volunteered to guarantee that no one would disturb Yuan Ming's parents during their time in Da Jin.
After watching his parents depart, Yuan Ming resumed his intense secluded cultivation.
Having obtained the Mixed Hole Primordial Stone, he specifically allocated time in his daily cultivation to further practice the Mixed Hole Secret Technique.
This secret technique, which he previously practiced only occasionally, was now officially part of his routine.
For this purpose, he placed his first soul split in the Dantian to maintain the operation of the Mixed Hole Secret Technique, ensuring it never ceased, whatever the circumstance.
With the strong Soul Power of Yuan Ming's first soul split, the cultivation of the Mixed Hole Secret Technique progressed smoothly, with delightful advancements daily.
During his cultivation breaks, Yuan Ming also never abandoned his study of the Jade Puppet Technique.
In one's lifetime, there are always matters one cannot let go of; these are called obsessions.
For Yuan Ming, he could not just watch his parents pass away. As long as there was a glimmer of hope, he would not give up.
Days passed by, and Yuan Ming at his secluded spot on Bikong Island never opened the doors again.
...
Spring came and went, and swiftly, a year quietly elapsed.
Demon World, Land of Nothingness, inside a certain guard room.
A man with red skin and horned demon patterns on his face was intently flipping through a classics book related to formations.
The man flipped through the pages quickly, finishing in less than half an hour.
Spot an error? Visit the original post on M&VLEMPY&R.
"The formations of the Demon World and those of the Yunhuang Continent differ, yet they also share commonalities, certainly worth studying," the man murmured softly as he closed the book.
Yuan Ming, using Black Incense, possessed this man and controlled his actions.
Over the past year, besides cultivating, he had not neglected to explore the Land of Nothingness, albeit at a slower pace, exploring carefully bit by bit.
Though the Land of Nothingness operates as a prison, with numerous guards ranked by cultivation level and places like the Book Collection Pavilion, Elixir Medicine Pavilion, and Treasure Pavilion, it wasn't much different from a Sect.
The Array Formation Manual that Yuan Ming was currently perusing had been borrowed from the Book Collection Pavilion, where this red-skinned man, known as Huo Mo, a Nascent Soul cultivator, was one of the keepers.
The overall strength of Nihility Prison was formidable, far surpassing Chang Chun Temple and the Wuyue Sect. Just among those capable of Returning to Void, Yuan Ming knew of six, the Six Prison Wardens of Nihility Prison.
As for the Hell Demon Lord, as the Prison Director of Nihility Prison, he was even beyond Returning to Void.
With so many high-level cultivators present, the classics in Nihility Prison's Book Collection Pavilion were not only numerous but also profoundly insightful.
Yuan Ming, having come into contact with Huo Mo through Luo Zhu unexpectedly, spent this time possessed by him, voraciously reading various classics, significantly broadening his horizons.
His Divine Soul Power greatly exceeded Huo Mo's, allowing him to influence with a Soul Seal. Even by possessing Huo Mo multiple times and manipulating him to perform unusual actions, it did not arouse any suspicion.

chapters.title: Chapter 771 - 771: 742
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming set aside the Array Formation Manual in his hand and picked up another classic, continuing to read.
He was not lacking in Cultivation Techniques or secret techniques; therefore, he had recently been contemplating the array manuals here, trying to find parallels and enhance his own Array Formation Cultivation, to hasten the refinement of the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
Although the refinement of the Stealing Heaven Tripod's forbidden was steadily progressing, he still felt it was slow.
Due to the time constraints of possession, Yuan Ming only aimed to memorize the contents of the classics first, planning to contemplate them thoroughly after returning, so his reading speed was exceptionally fast, and he soon finished all the borrowed Array Formation Manuals.
There was still some time left in this visit, so Yuan Ming, controlling Huo Mo, picked up a few classics and walked out of the room.
Outside was a corridor, with neatly arranged rooms on both sides, appearing spacious and tidy.
This was the living quarters for the guards; the Land of Nothingness was divided into three layers from bottom to top. The bottom layer was the prisoners' cells, the second layer was the residence of guards like Huo Mo, and the third layer was the dwelling of the Prison Master and the Six Prison Wardens.
Huo Mo advanced quickly and soon arrived at the Book Collection Pavilion, exchanging a few Array Formation Manuals.
"Huo Mo, have you also started studying formations?" a blue-haired, blue-skinned man approached.
"There's nothing much to do lately, just looking into it casually," Yuan Ming, not knowing who the other party was, could only speak vaguely.
"It's rare for you, Huo Mo, to take an interest in the art of formations. Speaking of which, your Huo Fen Clan's Burning Fire Demon Technique derives from the way of formations. If you had realized the importance of formations earlier, you wouldn't be lingering at the Nascent Soul Early Stage even now," the blue-skinned man said with a laugh.
"Studying formations in isolation rarely leads to success. If you have time, you might visit cell 186 in the Kun District. The prisoner there is from the Hui Clan of the Chuyun Realm, and her Array Formation Cultivation is quite good. You could learn a thing or two from her," the blue-skinned man chatted with Huo Mo and mentioned before leaving.
"The Hui Clan from the Chuyun Realm?" Yuan Ming silently noted the term.
From his demeanor and conversation, the blue-skinned man seemed to have a good relationship with Huo Mo and likely meant him no harm.
After some thought, Yuan Ming didn't return to his residence but instead went straight to the prison in the Kun District.
The Nihility Prison was divided into six districts, each managed by a Prison Warden. Huo Mo was a guard in the Qian District, which was right next to the Kun District.
With little time left for possession, Yuan Ming quickened his pace and soon found cell 186.
This cell was quite clean, with stone slabs on the floor and neatly repaired walls. Complete with tables and chairs, the cell even had a crystal chandelier hanging from the roof. Rather than a prison, it looked like a comfortable living room.
A woman in white sat with her back to the cell door, hunched over a desk, writing something.
As Yuan Ming's Divine Sense spread over, even before it reached the woman, she sensed it and turned to look. She was a young woman in her early twenties, plain in appearance but with an exceptional bearing.
Even within the confines of the cell, the young woman maintained a serene and unruffled demeanor.
"I wonder what brings the guard to this place?" The young woman stood up and asked with composed grace.
Yuan Ming didn't answer; instead, he controlled his Divine Sense to envelop the entire cell and quickly saw what the woman was working on. It was a design for a defense magic array, which at first glance appeared extremely complex.
Yuan Ming was secretly shocked, as his expertise in the art of arrays was already considerable, yet he couldn't understand this particular array.
On the adjacent table were laid out a dozen or so books, each detailing a complicated array that seemed to be the woman's own design, with each book bearing a name as the creator.
"Su Yingxue..."
Yuan Ming looked deeply at the woman, not staying any longer, and turned to leave.
Watching Huo Mo's retreating figure, Su Yingxue tilted her head, a hint of curiosity flickering in her eyes.
Just as Huo Mo had returned to his own residence, the time for possession came to an end. Yuan Ming's vision darkened, and his consciousness returned to his main body.
"This trip has been quite fruitful. That Su Yingxue's Array Formation Cultivation seems even higher than Xi Ying's," he spoke to himself with a look of pleasure.
Yuan Ming took a moment for Breathing Control, without putting away the Stealing Heaven Tripod, his gaze firmly fixed upon it.
The Stealing Heaven Tripod hovered there, its spirit light flickering, but deep within, the Desire Power within the White Jade Lotus Platform was only a small distance away from being completely filled.
Strands of Desire Power kept streaming in, pouring into the space of the White Jade Lotus Platform. At this rate, it wouldn't take long to fill it up completely.
Yuan Ming nodded slightly and summoned the Sky-reaching Demon Pillar to break open the space of the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
Two hours later, a small gap was opened in the space of the Stealing Heaven Tripod, and Yuan Ming's Divine Soul took the chance to fly into it.
Shortly after, the inner space of the Stealing Heaven Tripod trembled violently as the Desire Power within the White Jade Lotus Platform was once again replenished. The Bright Soul Fire that was initially spread on top descended and enveloped the Desire Power, refining it into Vow Power Pills.
At the same time, Yuan Ming's main soul took the opportunity to slip into the White Jade Lotus Platform and into the vortex of Desire Power burning with the Bright Soul Fire.
The Bright Soul Fire quickly wrapped around the uninvited main soul and the flames purged all impurities from within the main soul.
As Yuan Ming sensed the changes taking place within his main soul, he was joyful. Meanwhile, he also detached a portion of his mind to quietly witness the formation of the Vow Power Pills.
According to Xia Jie, these Vow Power Pills were of no use to Yuan Ming, but what that person said might not be entirely true. Yuan Ming still wanted to research them himself, to ease his mind.
As Yuan Ming pondered, a Vow Power Pill quietly took shape in front of him, and the Bright Soul Fire completely flew back above the space of the White Jade Lotus Platform.
Yuan Ming did not control his main soul to escape. In this brief moment of effort, the impurities within his Divine Soul had not been completely refined, and he needed to continue undergoing the smelting of the Bright Soul Fire.
Yuan Ming's main soul looked towards the Vow Power Pill, and whether it was because his Divine Soul had been involved in the creation of this pill from the very beginning or not, a seemingly inexplicable connection had formed between him and the pill.
Suddenly, the Vow Power Pill trembled lightly and then actively flew towards the main soul as if it wanted to directly enter it.
However, with a shift in Yuan Ming's thoughts, he easily severed the connection between his main soul and the Vow Power Pill, causing it to stop not far in front of his main soul.
Just as Yuan Ming wanted to take a closer look, the Second Split Soul that had been staying inside the White Jade Lotus Platform suddenly appeared next to the Vow Power Pill and swallowed it in one gulp.
In the next instant, the Soul Power of the Second Split Soul greatly increased, and its level quickly climbed up to the standard of the Sleeping Witch.
This sight made Yuan Ming quite astonished.
The recent action of the Second Split Soul was definitely not under his command. Could it be that the soul splitting's autonomous consciousness had awakened?
At the same time, the link between the Second Split Soul and Yuan Ming's main body was completely severed, and Yuan Ming lost all control over it.
Yuan Ming was truly taken aback this time. He urged his main soul to release several soul crows within the White Jade Lotus Platform, forming a Crow Formation aimed at the runaway Second Split Soul.
"Who is causing trouble?" Yuan Ming demanded.
In the moment before he lost connection with the Second Split Soul, he sensed another consciousness taking over the Second Split Soul. Everything happened too swiftly, and by the time he reacted, it was all said and done.
"Oh, has the controller of the Stealing Heaven Tripod changed? Has that old man Xia Jie died already?" The Second Split Soul turned its head to look at Yuan Ming and displayed a face identical to Yuan's, speaking emotionlessly.
"You know of Xia Jie. Who, may I ask, are you?" Yuan Ming asked gravely.
"I am called 'Void,' the Artifact Spirit of the Stealing Heaven Tripod," the Second Split Soul stated word by word.
"Artifact Spirit!" Hearing this response, a shock went through Yuan Ming's heart.
He had previously asked Xia Jie this question and did not receive a clear answer. How long had it been before someone claiming to be the Artifact Spirit appeared?
After the surprise, Yuan Ming quickly regained his composure and his eyes reflected a skeptical look.
The Residual Souls in both Hua Zhi and Vajra had flown out from the Stealing Heaven Tripod. This entity that suddenly took control of his split soul might well be the third Residual Soul.
"Do you truly claim to be the Artifact Spirit of the Stealing Heaven Tripod?" he asked slowly.
"What a bold young man you are, to dare question me. If my soul body were not weak and urgently needing Vow Power for recovery, do you think I would appear before you, a minor Spoken Witch like you?" the Second Split Soul paused, then exclaimed angrily.
"Although my Cultivation is low, I have seen the Artifact Spirits of Spiritual Treasures. If you truly are the Stealing Heaven Tripod Spirit, why not show yourself instead of controlling my split soul?" Yuan Ming asked calmly, unaffected by the other's influence.
"Do you think I wish to do this? A long time ago, I was gravely injured and have since been in deep slumber, only recently recovering slightly," the Second Split Soul snorted coldly.
"Since you claim to be the Artifact Spirit of the Stealing Heaven Tripod, then let it be. But why would you seize my split soul? Could it be you wish to take the Stealing Heaven Tripod from me?" Yuan Ming looked at the Second Split Soul and asked.
"I am only an Artifact Spirit, in charge of operating the numerous Forbiddens and Divine Skills within the Stealing Heaven Tripod. Who the tripod acknowledges as its master is a matter of fate, and it has nothing to do with me. Since it has chosen you, I naturally have no reason to object. You can still use the Stealing Heaven Tripod, but I urgently need Vow Power to heal, so in the future, I will take ninety percent of the Vow Power Pills born inside it," the Second Split Soul shook its head, speaking with an indifferent demeanor.
"You're quite arrogant. Do you think I would agree to giving away ninety percent of the Vow Power Pills with just a word from you?" Yuan Ming laughed coldly in his anger.* is the home of this chapter
"If you have the capability to snatch the Vow Power Pills, feel free to take them all," the Second Split Soul chuckled malevolently. Without waiting for Yuan Ming's response, it vanished right before his eyes.
Yuan Ming was slightly taken aback by this situation. He scanned the surroundings with his Divine Sense but could not find any trace of the Second Split Soul.
Nor was there any sign of the Second Split Soul in the space outside the White Jade Lotus Platform.
Seeing this, he had to temporarily put aside the search and flew towards the Bright Soul Fire above to continue refracting the impurities within his soul body.
Yuan Ming's brow furrowed as he recalled the recent events.
The words of the self-proclaimed "Void" Artifact Spirit didn't seem like mere bluster. Given its ability to hide instantly without a trace, could it really be the Stealing Heaven Tripod Artifact Spirit?
If it truly was the Artifact Spirit of the Stealing Heaven Tripod, it would be unwise to offend him. He currently had no use for the Vow Power Pill, so even if he gave ninety percent to the other party, it wouldn't greatly affect him.
But whether it was the Shura Blood Devouring Map, the Evil King Mirror, or the Stealing Heaven Tripod, none of their Artifact Spirits were docile.
Unless he completely stopped using these treasures, he would always be constrained by the Artifact Spirits. Only by fully mastering the treasures could he make the Artifact Spirits obey him obediently.
With this thought, a sense of urgency suddenly rose in Yuan Ming's heart. He wished he could immediately refine all the Forbiddens of the Stealing Heaven Tripod and drag that uncooperative Void out for a good lesson.
But for now, he could only restrain himself.
"No, it's still too early to draw conclusions. Let's see what this 'Void' is capable of when the next Vow Power Pill is formed," Yuan Ming shook his head and stopped speculating.
After giving himself a silent pep talk, he once again immersed himself in cultivation.

chapters.title: Chapter 772 - 743: Times Have Changed
chapters.content:
Seven days later.
Yuan Ming paused his cultivation and ignited the Black Incense to possess Su Yingxue.
"So Su Yingxue is actually a Returning to Void Cultivator." The moment the possession took place, he sensed Su Yingxue's cultivation level, which was almost the same as Blood Demon Ancestor, likely in the mid-stage of Returning Void.
There were also restrictions in Su Yingxue's body that imprisoned her Divine Soul and Mana, but clearluy, these restrictions were much slacker than those on Luo Zhu and others. It allowed the release of some Soul Power and Mana.
Yuan Ming wasn't surprised by this. In Nihility Prison, some prisoners who possessed special skills, such as Alchemy and refining treasures, had better conditions than ordinary prisoners and were allowed to retain some of their cultivation to facilitate their work for Nihility Prison.
Su Yingxue was obviously one of such individuals.
This time, Yuan Ming used ordinary Black Incense that couldn't control one's actions, and at this moment, Su Yingxue was leaning over, designing a formation, the same Defensive Magic Array as before.
Lots of deductions and calculations related to the array started to spin complexly and mysteriously in Su Yingxue's consciousness.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming was naturally overjoyed and quickly tried to understand this array knowledge.
However, after a short while, he stopped his contemplation.
The formations deduced in Su Yingxue's consciousness were too profound for him to fully understand, let alone improve his own Array Formation Cultivation.
"I didn't expect that with my level of Array Formation Cultivation, I couldn't even comprehend Su Yingxue's consciousness," Yuan Ming felt somewhat unwilling. He steadied his spirit and focused more intensely on his comprehension.
However, no matter how hard Yuan Ming tried, he was still unable to grasp the profound array knowledge swirling in Su Yingxue's consciousness. It seemed as if there was a huge divide between them, too far to bridge.
By this point, Yuan Ming could only reluctantly accept this fact.
He couldn't help but lament that the Yunhuang Continent was truly as its name suggested, barren and fierce, incomparable to the world outside.
However, having taken the trouble to possess Su Yingxue, Yuan Ming didn't waste any time and stretched out his Divine Sense to scan the surroundings.
Because the possession last time was rushed, he hadn't taken a close look. Only now did he clearly see the interior of the cell.
Apart from tables and chairs, Su Yingxue's cell also contained two large bookshelves, holding nearly a hundred books and several Jade Scrolls.
Under Yuan Ming's Divine Sense scanning, he found that these books and Jade Scrolls were all Array Formation Manuals with handwriting identical to what Su Yingxue had written before, probably authored by her.L^o!v$e this. s+t#ory? Sho^w# s#u-ppo.r%t at *-.
Especially those Jade Scrolls; each one recorded an array along with many key points to note during the array setup and even included some insights she had during her contemplations, explained in great detail.
Yuan Ming was inevitably excited. He couldn't understand the array knowledge in Su Yingxue's mind, but the content in these Jade Scrolls was simple yet detailed and could possibly help him comprehend something.
He immediately focused his attention without further thoughts and memorized the content firmly.
"The world outside is truly incomparable to Yunhuang Continent, seeing how meticulously they classify arrays," Yuan Ming muttered to himself.
According to these classics, most of the arrays he had encountered before were third-level arrays. The Red Blood Sand Formation and the Life Creation Array set up by Wu Yue Sect during the battle in the East Sea were considered fourth-level arrays, while Chang Chun Temple's Sect Protection Array and the Demon Thunder Array used by the Demon Clan to resist the Cloud Desolate Alliance barely qualified as fifth-level arrays.
However, the Defensive Great Array that Su Yingxue was currently designing was of a higher tier, a sixth-level Magic Array.
There were also strict requirements for Array Masters; one must independently design an array to earn a corresponding Array Master title.
If Su Yingxue could independently design a sixth-level array, she was at least a Level 6 Array Master.
"Although I have made some achievements in Array Cultivation, they are merely theoretical, I don't even qualify as a fourth-level Array Master. No wonder I can't keep up with Su Yingxue," Yuan Ming assessed himself.
He was not discouraged, instead, a sense of unprecedented determination surged within him.
He was quite insightful about arrays, and with the support of Stealing Heaven Tripod, he might catch up to Su Yingxue one day. Her achievements in array cultivation also gave him a clearer understanding of the path in array cultivation he aimed to pursue in the future.
"Ah, this is a Communication Array!" Yuan Ming's Divine Sense paused on a particular Jade Scroll.
Inside the scroll, a fourth-level Communication Array called "Void Communication Array" was recorded. This array's efficacy far surpassed that of the Green Spirit Communication Talisman, capable of enabling communication across tens of thousands of miles.
The materials required for setting up this array were extremely demanding, needing materials with strong sensing effects.
Moreover, the better the materials used for the array, the farther the communication distance would be. If top-grade sensing materials could be obtained, it was even possible to communicate across different domains.
Yuan Ming naturally had a great interest in this array.
The distance between him and Xi Ying was too great, and having Lei Yu act as a messenger every time was somewhat troublesome. Having such a Communication Array would be much more convenient.
He didn't hope to achieve cross-domain communication; being able to communicate from the East Sea to the Northern Desert would suffice.
Yuan Ming immediately focused all his attention on memorizing the array, and he successfully noted down all the contents before the possession by the Black Incense ended.
After his consciousness returned to his main body, Yuan Ming took out several blank jade scrolls and recorded everything he had seen during the possession, especially the Void Communication Array.
...
Time passed leisurely, and in the blink of an eye, twenty years had passed.
In a spirit-energy-rich island near the Overseas World, groups of Heavy Mountain Elephants roamed the dense forests, while giant blue-feathered birds with wingspans of hundreds of Zhang flew overhead.
At a distant lake, enormous serpent-fish leaped out of the water, creating huge waves, filling the entire island with an extremely rich nature's spiritual energy.
In the middle of this island that seemed like a paradise for spirit beasts and giant demons, atop a towering ancient tree more than a hundred Zhang tall, sat a young man in a blue robe, Yuan Ming.
His figure seemed to float at the top of the tree, as if he were sitting on the treetop or floating in midair, emanating waves of Divine Soul fluctuations like ripples of water, not very intense, yet flowing continuously like river water.
After his parents left, Yuan Ming had no reason to stay on Bikong Island, so he moved to this outer sea island, along with the Gathering Spirit Tree.
The nature's spiritual energy here far surpassed that of Bikong Island, which was more beneficial for his cultivation.
After twenty years of arduous cultivation, his mana had broken through to the Nascent Soul Middle Stage, his Mixed Hole Secret Technique had also made great progress, and even his Dantian had expanded by thirty percent.
Moreover, the mixed Soul Power he had hastily swallowed to break through to the Word Witch Realm had now been completely refined, purified of impurities, and became immaculate.
However, he hadn't risked enhancing his Soul Cultivation Realm by devouring living souls again, instead, he heeded Xia Jie's warning and spent these years absorbing the power of moonlight for cultivation.
His Soul Power had improved, but the process was much slower, and he was still a considerable distance from the mid-stage Word Witch Realm.
Nevertheless, Yuan Ming was not in a hurry, only seeking stable progress.
Over the years, he mostly cut off all contacts with the outside world, focusing solely on solitary cultivation, only reaching out to Xi Ying, the Yan sisters, and Xu Che during the intervals between his secluded meditations.
Through them, he also learned of the many changes in the Yunhuang Continent since his departure.
Because of his prominent role in the war against the Wu Yue Sect, Yuan Ming's fame surged, and the name of the Nether Moon God was almost known throughout the entire Yunhuang Continent. With the continued efforts of Xu Che and others, the Moon Sect's development was quite smooth.
Almost all the islands in the East Sea had cultivators who believed in the Nether Moon God, and most mortals also became believers, even many regions and sects in the Southern Border started having followers of the Moon Sect.
Among them, the followers from the islands of Red Ganoderma Island, Thousand Dragon Island, Red Leaf Island, Wanhua Island, and Yuzhu Island were the most devout and steadfast, thus receiving significant support from the Moon Sect.
The islands occasionally experienced minor frictions between each other, but being under the protection of the Moon Sect, no major conflicts arose.
Meanwhile, about two years ago, Wan Tianren, in an effort to strengthen the interests of Fusang Island, took a risk to try and lay siege to the Returning to Void Stage but failed and, although he didn't die, it led to a great decline in his cultivation level.
Xi Ying also sent news from the Northern Desert that after years of development, the Xi Yue Sect had completely stabilized its foundation. It had not only absorbed all the power of the Wu Yue Sect and controlled the entire Northern Desert but had now begun expanding towards the Western Region.
However, both the Xi Yue Sect and the Moon Sect had slow development in the Central Plains.
There were too many ancient cultivation sects in the Central Plains Region with overly complex powers, and competing for territory was not easy.
Additionally, the Chang Chun Temple, originally severely weakened by the invasion of the Wu Yue Sect, experienced a resurgence under Temple Master Tian Jizi who, unknown what chance had come his way, had broken through to the Returning Void Realm. The temple not only rapidly regained its strength but its prestige also exceeded the past.
With these two factors, although the Moon Sect had a good reputation in the Central Plains Region, its strength still fell far short.
Atop a giant tree, Yuan Ming's eyes were slightly closed, but beneath his eyelids, his eyeballs quickly rolled a few times.
A smile appeared on his lips, unable to contain his amusement.
At that moment, in the Stealing Heaven Tripod held against his chest, within the space of the White Jade Lotus Platform, a Vow Power Vortex was continuously collapsing and condensing, gradually forming a sparkling and translucent white bead, the Pure Will Power transformed into a Vow Power Pill.
"Senior Kong, this Vow Power Pill is mine now," Yuan Ming's main soul had entered the Stealing Heaven Tripod and floated above the space of the White Jade Lotus Platform, speaking toward the depths of the space.
There was no sound from the depths of the space, utterly still and quiet.
With a wave of his hand, Yuan Ming's main soul enveloped the Vow Power Pill with Divine Soul Power.
In these twenty years, he managed to condense a Vow Power Pill almost every year, but ninety percent of them had been taken by Artifact Spirit Kong. Initially, Yuan Ming couldn't believe that Kong was the artifact spirit of the Stealing Heaven Tripod, but no matter how much he resisted, he couldn't outcompete the second split soul controlled by Kong, reluctantly accepting that Kong was indeed the artifact spirit of the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
Just as expected, without any incidents, the Vow Power Pill smoothly flew to the vicinity of the main soul.
Yuan Ming breathed a sigh of relief, his eyes gleaming with joy.
This Vow Power Pill was the second one he had obtained over these years.

chapters.title: Chapter 773 - 744: Not Allowed
chapters.content:
The Vow Power Pill solidified completely, and the Bright Soul Fire flew towards it, Yuan Ming's Divine Soul hurriedly left the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space and came outside.
Yuan Ming took out a black gourd and carefully collected the Vow Power Pill into it.
This gourd was a Magic Artifact specially refined for him using Yin Attribute Spiritual Materials, capable of preserving the power of desires, which could be used to store the Vow Power Pills.
Just at that moment, his expression suddenly changed, and he flew towards the center of the island, quickly arriving in front of a black stone house, into which he entered.
Inside the stone house, there was nothing but a black Stone Pillar standing erect at the center, with numerous Array Patterns inscribed around the ground, forming an Array, and atop the stone pillar, a cluster of blood-colored flames burned.
The Array on the ground was the Void Communication Array, which Yuan Ming had set up over the past twenty years, connecting to the central headquarters of the Moon Sect in Dragon King City and the Northern Desert Xiyue Sect.
The blood-colored flames burned fiercely, with the vague outline of a human face appearing within.
Yuan Ming made a hand gesture and pointed, making the face within the blood flames clearer—it was Xu Che.
"Xu Che, what's the matter?" Yuan Ming inquired.
"My lord..." the face within the blood flames called out, but struggled to continue speaking.
Yuan Ming sensed that his mood was somewhat chaotic and realized that something unfavorable must have happened.
"What has happened, tell me the truth." He immediately used his Divine Soul Power to calm Xu Che's mood and continued asking.
"My lord, your parents have passed away." The Soul Wave of Xu Che transmitted this news.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming felt as if struck by Thunder Strike, his breathing becoming rapid.
His Divine Soul caused a strong disturbance, and the blood-colored flames on the stone pillar shook violently, almost extinguishing.
"When did this happen?" However, Yuan Ming quickly steadied his Divine Sense and continued to ask.
"Your... Your mother passed away at sunrise this morning, and your father followed her shortly thereafter." Xu Che bowed his head and replied.
Yuan Ming was silent for a long time after that, then, as if steadying emotions on the verge of erupting, he asked again, "What exactly happened, where is the Three-eyed Crow? Wasn't he supposed to watch over my parents? What is he doing? Why didn't he inform me promptly?"
"The incident was truly sudden... Last night, your parents ascended to Muyun Mountain to pray for blessings, this morning they watched the sunrise together at Fenglai Peak. Afterward, your mother passed away suddenly. Your father didn't make it known, he hid it from the Three-eyed Crow, took a Dissolve Skill Pill that dispersed his cultivation, shortly thereafter he followed your mother." Xu Che spoke with difficulty.
After hearing this, Yuan Ming's eyes were moist, and tears involuntarily rolled down.
He did not find the outcome surprising, but it was nonetheless difficult to accept.
"Both of them had smiles on their faces when they passed away. There were words carved on the stone next to them: 'Your mother has your father by her side, my child, do not worry. From hereafter, the sky is vast and the earth is wide, spread your wings and soar,'" Xu Che brought the last message.
Yuan Ming looked up, tears streaming down his face.
Though the world was vast from this moment on, his parents' hall was gone forever.
...
Half a month later, East Sea, Dragon King City.
Thirty li outside the city, in a valley filled with bamboo, there was a sizeable estate.
Outside the estate, a figure descended from the sky and landed at the front gate—it was naturally Yuan Ming.
He had just landed when several figures rushed out to greet him. Among them were Xu Che, Yan Siyun, Yan Sijing, and even Tuya.
"My lord," Xu Che and the Yan sisters took the lead in offering a salutation with clasped fists.
"Benefactor Brother," Tuya also promptly saluted.
Yuan Ming glanced around and immediately saw that behind them stood a lady in a long dress, face covered with a light veil—it was Tuya's master, Wei Die.
Yuan Ming nodded slightly towards her, and she reciprocated with a bow.
"Let's go inside and talk," Yuan Ming said, walking towards the estate.
The others quickly followed.
As soon as he entered the gate, he saw the Three-eyed Crow in the courtyard.
The creature saw him and seemed somewhat guilty, avoiding approach with fear in its eyes and evident evasiveness.
Yuan Ming had no intention of blaming it, and was just about to speak when he noticed it seemed to have sustained serious injuries, with an unstable aura about it.
"What happened?" Yuan Ming furrowed his brows and asked.
* (*) hosts the original.
"My lord, your parents passed away within the territory of Da Jin, and originally it was our duty to escort their bodies out. However, the current situation has changed. Chang Chun Temple has been overbearingly operating within Da Jin, forbidding the spread of both the Moon Sect and Xiyue Sect and preventing our sect's cultivators from entering." Xu Che took the initiative to respond.
"We couldn't enter, so we had to ask the Three-eyed Crow to carry the bodies of your parents out. Unexpectedly, on the way out, they were obstructed by roaming cultivators from Chang Chun Temple. Ultimately, the Three-eyed Crow was forced to sustain injuries, but it managed to secure the intact bodies of your parents and escape." Yan Siyun continued where he left off.
Hearing this, Yuan Ming's face turned iron-blue, his gaze chilling as if it could condense into droplets.
"Do they know the identity of the Three-eyed Crow, do they know it was escorting the bodies of my parents?" Yuan Ming asked each word with almost measured precision.
"Your parents had retired to Da Jin, the Da Jin Court surely knew of that, and the identity of the Three-eyed Crow is not a secret. I suspect that Chang Chun Temple is fully aware. They acted this way... probably to test your reaction," Yan Siyun analyzed.
"First, take me to see my parents," Yuan Ming said with a somber face, not continuing the topic.
"Yes," Xu Che responded promptly.
Yuan Ming followed the crowd to the inner courtyard, where he saw the already arranged mourning hall.
He asked everyone else to wait outside and entered alone.
In the mourning hall, surrounded by clusters of fresh flowers, there lay a large crystal coffin in the center, with Yuan Ming's parents lying side by side within.
Both had ingested a large amount of Immortal Pills and Spiritual Medicine in life; their bodies showed no signs of decay, appearing as though they were merely asleep, still wearing the faint smiles of their last moments.
Yuan Ming caressed the coffin, his Divine Thought gently sweeping over their bodies.
"Nothing left…"
Moisture rimmed his eyes; he could no longer feel any trace of Divine Soul Aura from them.
Since embarking on the path of cultivation, Yuan Ming had spent little time with his parents, a fact that had felt unavoidable in life's journey, and to which he had grown accustomed.
Only now, with his parents truly gone, did he realize there was no chance left for amends.
Yuan Ming did not consider himself indecisive and understood that the great Dao was merciless, and such partings were inevitable, but his heart was uncontrollably aching, with memories so forcefully crashing into him that his pain was sharp and clear.
He leaned low over the crystal coffin, sobbing quietly.
After a long time, a delicate jade hand gently rested on his back, patting him as his mother used to when consoling him as a child.
Yuan Ming did not look up, and the owner of the hand did not speak.
They remained that way until the evening came, and candles were lit within the mourning hall. Finally, Yuan Ming spoke up, "Why have you come?"
"The Dark Child left by the Moon Sect in the Central Plains sent a message, and I hurried over immediately," Xi Ying said softly.
Yuan Ming nodded, lapsing back into silence.
Xi Ying sat quietly beside him, not bringing up matters regarding Chang Chun Temple. She knew Yuan Ming did not want his parents to hear such sordid affairs.
So, the two of them leaned on each other, keeping vigil for their departed elders.
Seven days later, a discreet yet grand funeral was held in a valley outside Dragon King City.
It was called discreet because only a mere hundred or so people attended, a stark contrast to the scale of sect ceremonies that often numbered in the thousands.
Yet this sparsely attended group consisted of sect leaders and elders from every major island of the East Sea, as well as many Sects from the Southern Border, each a high-ranking cultivator commanding respect and power.
Yuan Ming had no desire for pomp and fanfare, intending only to mourn his parents for seven days before burying them. However, upon receiving the news, Cultivators from every major island of the East Sea came on their own to pay their respects.
In the end, under the persistent insistence of the crowd, Yuan Ming reluctantly conducted a grand memorial ceremony.
During the entire process, Xi Ying, dressed in simple white garments, stayed by Yuan Ming's side. Even though she did not claim to be family, her actions were indistinguishable from such.
After all had paid their respects, a figure arrived late yet with evident haste.
"My apologies, my apologies, I was delayed due to a chaotic battle in the Central Plains, and messages were cut off. Upon hearing of Fellow Daoist Yuan's parents passing, our temple master immediately sent me here non-stop to pay respects, please forgive this affront," said the newcomer, none other than Ancestor Ming Quan from Chang Chun Temple.
On seeing his arrival, Xu Che and the others felt their grief reignited, a fire of anger nearly bursting forth.
The Three-eyed Crow could hardly restrain itself from lashing out, but Yuan Ming silenced it with a psychic message.
With no expression, Yuan Ming said to Ancestor Ming Quan, "Since you've come to pay respects, light an incense stick."
Ancestor Ming Quan, feeling the chill in Yuan Ming's tone, shrank a little and, steeling himself, stepped forward, lighting three sticks of incense and placing them in the incense burner, bowing three times respectfully.
Yuan Ming and Xi Ying returned the gesture together.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, some misunderstandings previously occurred…" Ancestor Ming Quan began, only to be interrupted by Yuan Ming.
"Whatever you have to say, let's talk later," Yuan Ming cut in.
Having spoken, Yuan Ming continued with the memorial ritual, leaving Ancestor Ming Quan sidestepped.
Although Ancestor Ming Quan felt displeased, he dared not show it, instead waiting obediently to one side.
After the burial was complete, and Cultivators from the various islands and Sects had departed, Yuan Ming finally called Ancestor Ming Quan over.
"I hear that Fellow Daoist Tian Jizi has successfully broken through to the Returning to Void Stage?" Yuan Ming asked coldly.
"Yes…" Ancestor Ming Quan replied hesitantly, not understanding where this was heading.
"Well, congratulations are due to Chang Chun Temple," Yuan Ming said with a cold laugh.
"That... Fellow Daoist Yuan, I've heard about what happened before. It was the fault of some subordinates, an oversight on Chang Chun Temple's part. We didn't mean to offend your esteemed parents. The elder responsible has been detained by the Law Hall. I beg you to forgive our ignorance," Ancestor Ming Quan quickly explained.
"I heard your Chang Chun Temple issued an edict against the Moon Sect and Xi Yue Sect spreading their teachings in the Central Plains, forbidding our disciples from setting foot in Central Plains territory?" Yuan Ming, uninterested in his explanations, shifted the topic abruptly.

chapters.title: Chapter 774 - 745: The Best Timing
chapters.content:
"This is all slander... It's only because of the past incidents involving the Wu Yue Sect that the hearts of the Central Plains people have been disturbed, with minor sects and commoners unable to differentiate between our honorable sect and the Wu Yue Sect. As Chang Chun Temple currently holds the title of the righteous leader in the Central Plains, we indeed need to consider the stability of the Central Plains, so please forgive us, Fellow Daoist Yuan," Ancestor Ming Quan urgently replied.
"Take your people and leave the East Sea, from now on, I hope to never see anyone from Chang Chun Temple here again," Yuan Ming said coldly, not wanting to listen to his excuses.
"What did you say?" Ancestor Ming Quan felt as if he had been struck by thunder, hardly believing his own ears.
"Get out," Yuan Ming shouted furiously.
All the pent-up frustration and anger from the past few days mingled in that shout and were released.
Ancestor Ming Quan trembled all over, feeling as if his divine soul had suffered a tremendous impact, with two thin streams of blood flowing down from his ears.
Shocked and furious inside, he dared not show a trace of it on his face; he did not linger any longer and immediately led the cultivators of Chang Chun Temple away, tail between their legs.
...
When night fell.
Yuan Ming and Xi Ying arrived at Dragon King City, the headquarters of the Moon Sect.
Silken golden light emerged in the void above the headquarters, resembling countless sword qi, vaguely forming a massive sword array.
"This Golden Light Shadow Sword Array is quite powerful, it seems your Array Formation Cultivation has reached level 4," Xi Ying remarked.
"It's all thanks to the Stealing Heaven Tripod's help that I barely managed to achieve this," Yuan Ming said, with a sigh flickering in his eyes.
In these twenty years, he had not possessed anyone else, almost exclusively residing in Su Yingxue.
As his understanding of formations deepened, he increasingly found the path of formations to be as vast as the sea, and even someone as strong as Su Yingxue admitted having limited mastery in this field and needing further improvement.
This realization made Yuan Ming more aware of his past ignorance, but it also excited him, prompting him to spend a lot of energy in studying formations.
Yet, even with the help of the Stealing Heaven Tripod, advancement was still extremely difficult.
Twenty years of hard cultivation had produced merely this Golden Light Shadow Sword Array, reaching the Fourth-level Array Master realm.
Inside the main hall of the headquarters, Wulu had been waiting for a long time.
In fact, Wulu had arrived at Dragon King City during the day but kept his presence hidden and paid tribute to Yuan Ming's parents before coming to the headquarters to wait for him.
The three of them went to a secret room, where Wulu got straight to the point:
"Brother Yuan, Daoist Xi Ying, I have located the remnants of the Demon Clan's forces and have destroyed most of them. However, these guys are extremely cunning, and a few have still managed to escape," he said.
"Where did they escape to?" Yuan Ming asked.
"They've fled deep into the ocean. It's hard to find them," Wulu shook his head and said.
Yuan Ming frowned slightly upon hearing this.
Rеаd аhеаd аnd gеt updаtеs аt М*V*L*Е*М*Р*Y*R.
Considering the current distribution of the Moon Sect's forces, it might still be manageable if they were in the Southern Border or near the coast of the East Sea. However, if they had escaped deep into the ocean, where the territory was vast and rarely visited, numerical advantage would be of no help.
"I came here this time to mourn my uncle and aunt, but also because Daoist Xi Ying mentioned you had a technique for tracking and locating people, capable of spanning thousands of miles and nearly ignoring spatial blocks, so I wanted to ask for your help," Wulu continued.
Yuan Ming, puzzled, glanced at Xi Ying.
"Soul Summoning Technique," Xi Ying transmitted mentally.
"I do have such a spell, but do you know the names of those people, or remember what they look like?" Yuan Ming pondered briefly, looking at Wulu and asked.
"Uh... due to the rush, those whose faces I remember are the ones I've killed. As for those I didn't catch up with, I didn't even get a chance to see their faces clearly, let alone know what they look like," Wulu was taken aback and shook his head.
"Then my tracking secret technique can't be effective," Yuan Ming sighed and said.
"If these people aren't eliminated, I always feel they'll be a calamity. If they manage to hide in the vast Yunhuang Continent, I'm afraid they will be the forerunners of another invasion by the Demon Clan," Wulu said with furrowed brows.
"Brother Wu, there's no need to worry too much... If there are a thousand days to be a thief, how can there be a thousand days to guard against one? Even if we were to eliminate all these remnants of the Demon Clan, would the Yunhuang Continent truly be worry-free? Besides, these demons might not even be all that have sneaked into the Yunhuang Continent," Yuan Ming patted his shoulder and consoled him.
Upon hearing this, Wulu's brow tightened, especially agreeing with Yuan Ming's last remark, as he had indeed thought so too.
The remnants of the Demon Clan that they had discovered were still evident, but given how vast the Yunhuang Continent is, it was hard to say how many were hidden.
"To fend off the invasion by the Demon Clan, there's only one way: to be as tough as iron ourselves," Xi Ying suddenly spoke up.
"What?" Wulu asked eagerly.
Yuan Ming also frowned and looked towards Xi Ying.
"To unify the entire Yunhuang Continent, integrate all Sect resources, unite as one, and turn the Yunhuang Continent into a solid plate. When the Demons dare to invade again, it will be no different from seeking death," Xi Ying said slowly.
Her tone was calm, but when she spoke these words, there was an implied dominating spirit.
Wulu, upon hearing this, couldn't help but look deeply at Yuan Ming.
"It's not a bad idea," Yuan Ming first paused, then cracked a smile.
"It sounds easy to say, but how difficult it is to do? Northern Desert, Central Plains, Southern Border, East Sea, the large and small sects combined number not ten thousand, but at least several thousand, right? The intertwined interests are so complex, how could it possibly unite?" Wulu shook his head as he spoke.
"Those who can be united will be united; those who cannot, will be integrated," Xi Ying said indifferently.
To unite, to integrate, a difference of one word, but a huge difference in meaning.
"No. Yunhuang Continent has just gone through a great calamity, everything awaits rejuvenation, it can't withstand another large-scale conflict," Wulu frowned tightly, his head shaking even more fervently.
Having said that, he looked at Yuan Ming, signaling him to persuade Xi Ying.
"Brother Wu, don't you think this is the best opportunity?" Yuan Ming asked.
Wulu was startled upon hearing this and looked at Yuan Ming in surprise.
"The turmoil caused by the Wu Yue Sect has left many sects in the Central Plains crippled and weakened, this is the best time to unite them. In fact, Chang Chun Temple has already been doing this. In just these past twenty years, they have swallowed up hundreds of big and small sects in the Central Plains; otherwise, how do you think they recovered so quickly?" Yuan Ming hadn't spoken, still, Xi Ying took over and continued.
Wulu, upon hearing this, furrowed his brows in contemplation.
"Not only have they recovered their Primordial Qi, but Sect Leader Tian Jizi has also broken through to the Returning Void Realm. The overall strength of the Sect has not decreased but increased, their actions have become increasingly domineering, and they have started to suppress our Moon Sect and Xi Yue Sect. Following this trend, without another invasion by Demons, turmoil is bound to arise again in Yunhuang Continent," Yuan Ming said.
"Since Chang Chun Temple has already revealed their wolfish ambitions, it's impossible to coexist peacefully in the future. Why not engage in this battle earlier, thus sparing some lives?" Xi Ying said.
"However, if we start a war now, it certainly won't be understood by the people, and we may lose popular support. Besides... are we really confident in defeating Chang Chun Temple?" Wulu still had some concerns and hesitated.
"Today, the islands of the East Sea are almost all followers of the Moon Sect, the various factions of the Southern Border also tend to favor dealing with the Moon Sect. As for the Northern Desert, the Xi Yue Sect has made rapid developments in recent years and has almost brought all forces under control. Chang Chun Temple, busy consolidating the power of the sects in the Central Plains, is actually a bit like working behind closed doors. They think that with Tian Jizi, a Returning to Void Stage Cultivator, they can dominate the world and overlook everyone, which is somewhat naive," Xi Ying said with a laugh.
Wulu heard this, fell silent in contemplation, obviously still weighing the pros and cons.
"In fact, over the years, in my pursuit of remnants of the Demon Clan, I have asked Tian Jizi and Chang Chun Temple for help several times, but the former is busy cultivating in seclusion, and the latter is only focused on recovering strength, completely ignoring the looming threats. Maybe really giving them a few more years, and Yunhuang Continent will again be a scene of fratricidal strife," he suddenly spoke after a long time.
"So, your decision?" Xi Ying looked toward Wulu.
"To unify Yunhuang Continent, sooner rather than later, I can help you with this," Wulu said.
Xi Ying, upon hearing this, showed a pleased expression and nodded.
"If Yunhuang Continent is unified, what do you plan to do with the existing sects?" Yuan Ming asked.
"Those willing to join in the great cause can keep their Daoist Lineage, but their original names must be abolished, and they must come under the jurisdiction of the Moon Sect and Xi Yue Sect. For those unwilling... eliminate them altogether," Xi Ying said indifferently.
Yuan Ming heard the resolute decisiveness in her words, and could not help but frown slightly.
But on the journey south previously, he had seen too many obliterated cities, too many lives crushed underfoot, and the capital of Da Jin Country, which is still lifeless.
So he knew that showing mercy was not an option.
Yunhuang Continent absolutely could not withstand another calamity like that of the Wu Yue Sect, nor an invasion from the Demon World. Thus, Xi Ying's plan to integrate the entire Yunhuang Continent into a solid plate at the smallest possible cost was indeed the best way.
There would inevitably be war, death, and new cases of national and familial ruin, but all for a better tomorrow.
"Xi Ying, try to limit this war to the Cultivation World, do not involve the ordinary folk, and avoid unnecessary slaughter," Yuan Ming advised.
"Don't worry, I assure you, it won't be as severe as you think. As soon as I take down Chang Chun Temple, with this big tree fallen, many will flee at the mere sight of it," Xi Ying said with a smile.
"You're not participating?" Wulu asked in surprise.
"After all, this isn't slaughtering the Demon Clan or fighting the Wu Yue Sect. I'm not really interested in conquest. If there's a need for me to fight, just contact me anytime," Yuan Ming shook his head and said.
"Leave this matter to me, you just focus on your cultivation. But before you go, could you lend me your Shura Blood Devouring Map? I need it to train some personnel," Xi Ying said.
"Take it," Yuan Ming nodded, took out the Shura Blood Devouring Map, and handed it to Xi Ying.
Afterward, Xi Ying and Wulu left Dragon King City together.

chapters.title: Chapter 775 - 775: 746
chapters.content:
Just a few days later, a shocking piece of news spread across the Yunhuang Continent: the Moon Sect and the Xi Yue Sect, one in the south and the other in the north, announced an alliance, establishing the Double Moon Alliance.
The Northern Desert had already been pacified by the Xi Yue Sect, so there wasn't much of a reaction there. The Eastern Sea Islands, having been forewarned by Yuan Ming, experienced some minor discontent but, in the end, nothing substantial arose.
The most significantly affected areas were, of course, the Central Plains and the Southern Border.
How could they not understand the implications of the Double Moon Alliance? They all felt that just as the Yunhuang Continent had returned to calm, the winds of change were stirring up once again, bringing with them ominous undertones.
The situation in the Southern Border was particularly complex. There were great differences between the North Territory and the Southern Domain, and significant internal divergences within each sect. Some sought to align with the Central Plains and request assistance from the Chang Chun Temple, while others were secretly making contact with the Double Moon Alliance.
There were also some sects who sat on the fence, watching from the sidelines, waiting to see which way the wind would blow.
However, what was unexpected was that in the time immediately following its establishment, the Double Moon Alliance made no significant moves. They appeared to have formed an alliance and nothing more, leading some naive sects to believe that stability had been restored.
After Ancestor Ming Quan was expelled from the East Sea by Yuan Ming and returned to his sect, the Chang Chun Temple was already aware that they couldn't coexist peacefully with the alliance. Naturally, they took advantage of this time to actively prepare for war.
However, it wasn't long before Chang Chun Temple's aggressive expansion provoked strong dissatisfaction among Central Plains cultivators.
They went from initially persuading gently to later employing both threats and inducements and finally to forcefully annexing other sects, their methods becoming increasingly aggressive. As their strength gradually recovered, their reputation started to crumble bit by bit.
Apart from the increasing strength of Chang Chun Temple, which led some to hubris, a major contributing factor was the spies the Double Moon Alliance had planted, who covertly spread rumors.
A few months later, not only did everyone in the Central Plains feel threatened, but those sects in the Southern Border that had initially intended to seek refuge with Chang Chun Temple also changed their minds and started secretly contacting the Double Moon Alliance.
It wasn't until a swordsmanship sect in the southern part of the Central Plains, near the Southern Border, unhappy about being forcibly annexed by Chang Chun Temple, rose up in resistance to no avail and was directly exterminated, that the loathing for Chang Chun Temple reached its peak among the various sects of the Central Plains.
By the time Chang Chun Temple realized it needed to slow down and adopt a more conciliatory policy, it was already too late.
Negative news about Chang Chun Temple began to surge simultaneously from the Central Plains, the Southern Border, the Northern Desert, and the East Sea. Not only within the mountainous Cultivation Sects but even in mundane marketplaces, storytellers spread tales of disasters like the "swordsmanship sect extermination case."
Among these circulating stories, some were true and others fabricated, but they spread at an astonishing rate, soon sweeping across the entire Yunhuang Continent.
Only then did the Double Moon Alliance issue a manifesto "Denouncing Chang Chun Temple," which listed in detail the various acts of extortion and tyranny by Chang Chun Temple. It pointed out their incompetence in dealing with the previous Wu Yue Sect incident and called for heroes of the world to join in the pursuit.
Meanwhile, the deeds of Yuan Ming and Xi Ying, as the leaders of the Double Moon Alliance who had eradicated the Wu Yue God and the bloodthirsty members of the Demon Clan, turned the tide by destroying the Breaking Realm Transfer Array, and saved the Yunhuang Continent, also began to spread quietly.
Suddenly, the prestige of the Double Moon Alliance reached its peak, while Chang Chun Temple's reputation plummeted to the bottom.
Only then did the belatedly aware Chang Chun Temple remember to maintain its advantage in the propaganda battle, thus they began to propagate widely that the Double Moon Alliance was an evil cult just like the Wu Yue Sect, and that their ultimate goal was to destroy the entire Yunhuang Continent.
However, due to their previous transgressions which had incited widespread outrage, and considering the achievements of the Moon Sect in thwarting the Wu Yue Sect's conspiracies, such slander was not believed by many.
Even before the start of formal hostilities, numerous small sects in the Northern Central Plains had already aligned with the Double Moon Alliance.
Xi Ying's strategic steps were very stable, and initially, she did not force these sects to change their allegiances. They were allowed to keep their identity, and not only were they provided with substantial material support, but they were also offered access to some of the exquisite Cultivation Methods previously belonging to the Wu Yue Sect.
At first, these sects were apprehensive, fearing hidden agendas, but after some time of interaction, they realized that the Double Moon Alliance wasn't demanding anything from them.
After a while, Xi Ying would even personally give lectures on the Dao, helping them resolve issues with their cultivation practices.
Gradually, the cultivators of these sects began to practice alongside the disciples of the Double Moon Alliance, to pray together, and without even realizing it, they converted to followers of the Ming Yue God and Xi Yue God.
When the true battle began, these very individuals became the most zealous fighters.
This was not because Xi Ying had used some Divine Soul technique to control them, but rather because she had set more precious elixirs and Magic Treasures, as well as more advanced Cultivation Methods, as rewards for military exploits.
By distinguishing themselves in the campaign, they could exchange their feats for treasures that had once been beyond their reach.
Among them, the "Blood Origin Pill" refined by the Double Moon Alliance was the most renowned, as it could greatly enhance a cultivator's Qi-Blood Power, making it especially precious to Body Cultivation practitioners.
Many cultivators, eager to obtain this limited-supply "Blood Origin Pill," fought fiercely in battle.
While military progress in the north was smooth, it was relatively slower in the south.
Because the principal military forces of the Double Moon Alliance in the south were the people of the Eastern Sea Islands, who had to cross the Southern Border to enter the Central Plains.
The strategy Xi Ying devised for the Southern Border involved negotiations with an aim to collect adherents as much as possible and, if necessary, conquest by force.
The initial pushes were indeed not as smooth as Xi Ying had predicted, with many Southern Border sects even reluctant to allow troops of the Moon Sect to pass through on their way north.
Wulu, following Yuan Ming's instruction to avoid unnecessary killings, did not expect that a few mid-sized sects, having received promises from Chang Chun Temple, would take the initiative to ambush them.
The results were of course that they were sent fleeing in defeat, with none left alive.
To establish his authority, Wulu led his men to thoroughly slaughter all the high-ranking cultivators within the ancestral halls of those sects, effectively intimidating any other sect that was still harboring petty schemes.
At the same time, news from the Northern Desert also reached the Southern Border. Stimulated by those favorable policies, sects began to send envoys to inquire proactively.
Aware of the importance of both benevolence and severity, Wulu also began to implement various rewarding measures.
Within just a few months, all the troubles of the Southern Border had been smoothed out.
During this process, Yuan Ming didn't even make an appearance, as everything proceeded as smoothly as a boat sailing downstream.
Note: Check * for any corrections.
Initially, Yuan Ming paid close attention to the changes in the situation, but as he found that the entire process unfolded without deviation from Xi Ying's prior analysis, he continued his cultivation in retreat with peace of mind.
Time flew by, and another three months passed.
In the depths of winter, the vast snow sealed the mountains. The mountain range where Chang Chun Temple was located was enveloped within a thousand li, covered in pure white.
The northern and southern armies of the Double Moon Alliance victoriously joined forces outside the Da Jin Capital, beginning to gather, and preparing to launch the final general offensive against Chang Chun Temple.
After nearly half a year of campaigning, the fighting strength of the Double Moon Alliance had not diminished but instead increased. Those sects that joined earliest had voluntarily renounced their original titles without force and took great pride in being part of the Double Moon Alliance.
Before the final battle, Xi Ying led a group of cultivators into the Da Jin Capital.
The city had regained some of its vitality after more than twenty years of recuperation, but with nearly the entire city slaughtered back then, although most of the deceased souls had been taken away by the Wu Yue Sect, many stranded ghosts and wandering spirits remained.
To this day, the entire city still lay shrouded in deathly stillness, with a heavy yin energy that was difficult to dissolve.
The once Da Jin Crown Prince had ascended the throne as the new Emperor, with all the civil and military ministers urging him to move the capital elsewhere, but he, still youthful at the time, firmly vetoed the idea.
He steadfastly believed that neither his father nor his grandfather had abandoned this capital city. Now that the calamity of the Wu Yue Sect had passed, it was even less likely for him to give it up.
Alas, after the calamity of the Wu Yue Sect, the strength of Da Jin plummeted sharply, and parts of the territory had been annexed by foreign states.
They had sought help from their allies at Chang Chun Temple, but unfortunately, the temple, busy restoring its strength, had been unable to spare the attention, let alone conduct a spiritual rite for the countless solitary souls of the Da Jin Capital.
The reason Xi Ying led people into the city this time was for this very matter.
After negotiating with the Da Jin Court, they jointly held a massive Luotian Da Jiao ceremony at the Heavenly Altar of the Da Jin ancestral temple, liberating the remaining souls in the city.
The instant the Luotian Da Jiao ceremony was completed, a refreshing breeze swept through every corner of the city, seemingly purifying every trace of gloom and filth.
While the residents in the city could not see the heavenly phenomenon, they could feel the air around them became fresher, and the dark clouds that had long lingered over the city seemed to dissipate and fade away.
The Da Jin Royal Family, initially anxious, eventually felt overwhelmingly grateful. Emperor Jin himself led the civil and military ministers to respectfully escort Xi Ying and the others out of the city.
In fact, this was not the first time the Double Moon Alliance had done such a thing.
They had held a liberating spiritual ceremony in every city they passed that had suffered the calamity of slaughter, regardless of whether any people were still alive there.
After leaving behind some cultivators proficient in formations to help repair and strengthen the city's defensive arrays, the army once again set out, heading straight for Chang Chun Temple.
After several failed attempts at interception, Chang Chun Temple had no choice but to fall back and defend within its sect.
The sects they had contacted and enticed either excused themselves from aiding at the last moment or turned against them in battle. In the end, only Chang Chun Temple was left in solitary opposition against the increasingly powerful Double Moon Alliance.
Outside Chang Chun Temple, Tian Jizi stood suspended in the air with a host of elders behind him.
The massive and complicated Sect Protection Array had long been activated. The repaired and enhanced array, capable of both attack and defense, safeguarded the entire sect like an iron bastion.
Even at this point, the cultivators of Chang Chun Temple still firmly believed that under the leadership of Tian Jizi, a mighty cultivator in the Returning to Void Stage, with the backing of the Great Sect Array, they would be able to turn defeat into victory, thoroughly vanquishing the Double Moon Alliance.
The ensuing battle lasted for six days and seven nights, with its ferocity comparable to the previous decisive battle against the Wu Yue Sect.
Xi Ying called upon some unknown method to summon Vajra and Hua Zhi to aid her in battle. She, along with the two of them and Wulu, joined forces in assaulting Tian Jizi.
It took six whole days to wear Tian Jizi down until he died in exhaustion.
His soul was captured by the Soul Suppressing Kettle, while his body was sealed within the Blood Puppet Armor.
Perhaps it was only in this moment that he realized he had made a mistake he should not have made. He and Chang Chun Temple could have chosen a better path, but momentarily blinded by desire, they lost their true nature and committed a grave error.

chapters.title: Chapter 776 - 747 Five Elements Returning Void
chapters.content:
After Tian Jizi died in battle, the war intent of the cultivators from Chang Chun Temple immediately collapsed, but there were still some elders and disciples who vowed to never surrender, maintaining their last desperate fight using the Sect Protection Array.
When the Sect Protection Array was completely broken through, those stubborn elders and disciples who refused to surrender were all eliminated.
Xi Ying's methods were not cruel, but they were very decisive.
Some of these people chose to surrender only after being captured, and there were those in the Double Moon Alliance who pleaded on their behalf, but Xi Ying did not hesitate at all, because she had already offered them a chance to surrender after killing Tian Jizi.
That was the last chance for all the Chang Chun Temple cultivators to save their lives. Those who did not surrender then would not be accepted later; they were to be killed without mercy.
Because, she did not want to face numerous internal problems when a greater external threat emerged in the future.
After this incident, the original sect leaders and elders in the Double Moon Alliance's allied forces finally had a clear understanding of Xi Ying.
She commanded respect, acted decisively, wielded both carrot and stick—a true formidable figure, and no one dared to underestimate her because of her being a woman anymore.
Even the followers of the previously defeated Moon Sect had elevated her to a status equal to that of the Nether Moon God.
The battle at Chang Chun Temple defined the fate of the universe, and there was hardly any need to fight anymore afterwards.
Xi Ying stationed herself in Chang Chun Temple, treating it as a hub radiating over the Central Plains, and began to send out cultivators from the Double Moon Alliance to appease and recruit the small and medium-sized sects that had not yet pledged allegiance.
