The process went very smoothly; whether they truly agreed or only verbally, there were no more sects daring to publicly oppose the Double Moon Alliance.
Afterwards, Xi Ying started to establish rules for both the upper and lower mountains, creating a series of standards regulating cultivator activities, with the most important rule being that disputes between mountain cultivators must not affect the Mortal World.
Cultivators should not regard mortals as insects and must not kill mortals without reason.
This was naturally Yuan Ming's idea. In his view, mortals were the source and foundation of cultivators; without mortals, what was there to speak of cultivation?
Besides these, Xi Ying undertook a massive task; she ordered the collection of geographical maps from all over the Yunhuang Continent, summarizing them, and then instructed cultivators skilled in formations to organize the spirit veins.
She aimed to undertake a task unprecedented in history, connecting all the spiritual veins of Yunhuang Continent to build a giant offensive and defensive array capable of mobilizing the entire continent's spiritual energy.
The person who proposed this idea was not a cultivator of the Double Moon Alliance, but an Array Master who had surrendered from the Wu Yue Sect after their defeat. He had once set up a Life Creation Array for Fusang Island, showing great proficiency in the field of formations.
Xi Ying was aware that this process was bound to be long and arduous, but she believed that once completed, it would not be so easy for the Demon World to invade Yunhuang Continent again.
At least, if they were to come again, the sacrifices from Yunhuang Continent would not be as severe as before.
...
A little over two months after the war, Yuan Ming arrived at Chang Chun Temple from the East Sea.
It had been half a year since Yuan Ming had been here, and everything felt as if it had changed, as though he were in a different era.
Compared to the previous atmosphere of the sect, Chang Chun Temple now resembled a strictly regulated military camp, where everyone who came in and out was busily engaged in their own tasks.
Each of them looked serious and focused, yet there was an unspoken eagerness in their eyes.
Yuan Ming made his way to the original Ancestor Hall of Chang Chun Temple, which had now been converted into the Zhengtong Hall for handling affairs.
The hall was brightly lit; in the center of the spacious hall, there was a huge sand table about thirty feet across, depicting topographic features from the south to the north, almost encompassing the entire Yunhuang Continent.
At that moment, Xi Ying was standing outside the sand table, holding a few red triangular flags in one hand and propping her chin with the other, gazing at the gigantic sand table, her brow furrowed in thought without uttering a word.
Her face was still as breathtakingly beautiful as ever, though there was a hard-to-detect weariness hidden in her eyes.
Before Yuan Ming could even greet her, Xi Ying suddenly came back to her senses and looked over.
Upon seeing Yuan Ming, her beautiful eyes slightly curved, a smile appearing on her face, making her expression lively all of a sudden.
"I've been waiting for you for a long time," Xi Ying said with a smile.
"You've handled everything so orderly, even not letting me join the decisive battle with Chang Chun Temple. Where would you still need me?" Yuan Ming said with a smile.
He did not ask about the unification of the Yunhuang Continent because, through the news he received earlier and his observations along the way, he already knew most of it, and he completely trusted Xi Ying.
Even in this aspect, Yuan Ming felt he could not handle things as thoroughly and effortlessly as Xi Ying.
Xi Ying, who always disliked beating around the bush, spoke up, "I've summoned you this time to tell you that I have extracted the secret of advancing to the Returning Void Stage from Tian Jizi's divine soul."
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming's eyes instantly brightened.
"To break through to the Returning Void Stage, besides advancing one's cultivation to the bottleneck of the Late-stage Nascent Soul, one also needs to achieve the Five Elements Unification as a foundation for the breakthrough," Xi Ying explained.
"Five Elements Unification?" Yuan Ming asked in confusion.
"Five Elements Unification means that one must possess the Five Elements Spirit Root, cultivate the Five Elements Power, and accumulate enough of it. Then, combine the power of the Five Elements to break through the Nascent Soul bottleneck and enter the Returning Void stage," Xi Ying explained.
"If that's the case, doesn't it mean that only those who have the Five Spirit Roots can become Returning to Void cultivators?" Yuan Ming asked dubiously.
"Theoretically, you are correct. Hence, Nascent Soul cultivators, in their later stages, all seek to complement their Spirit Roots. However, your situation is special; with the Undying Tree fused within you, you already possess both Yin Yang Five Elements and Seven Spirit Roots," Xi Ying stated.
"Then, having cultivated the Nine Elements Technique and having mastered the Taiyin Refining Spleen Technique, with Wood and Earth powers already within me, do I now only need to cultivate Water, Gold, and Fire powers?" Yuan Ming pondered upon hearing this.
From his remark, it appeared he needed three different techniques to cultivate "Water, Gold, Fire."
"Mastering the Five Elements Technique is not hard, but just relying on the Five Elements Power accumulated inside your body makes it quite difficult to break through the shackles, so you will also need a Companion Spirit Treasure to assist you," Xi Ying continued.
Yuan Ming had reached his knowledge blind spot, so he simply remained quiet and listened attentively.
"Tian Jizi succeeded because the Chang Chun Temple ancestor passed down a secret technique for refining Companion Spirit Treasures. He refined a Five Elements Spiritual Treasure using this technique, merging it with his Spirit Root. That allowed the Spirit Root to cultivate the spiritual nature of the treasure, thereby accumulating Five Elements Spiritual Power. When he was ready to make the breakthrough, he plundered the Spiritual Power from the Companion Spirit Treasure in one fell swoop, greatly increasing his chance of success," Xi Ying elaborated, referring to Tian Jizi's case.
Yuan Ming nodded pensively, thinking to himself that it was no wonder they were called Companion Spirit Treasures, to be fused with and grow alongside the Spirit Root.
"Tian Jizi's Five Elements Spiritual Pearls were five beads, each possessing one of the Five Elements attributes. Among them, the Canghai Xuan Water Pearl was one; the other four beads were replicas he had crafted. At the moment of his breakthrough, all had been rendered useless. Even the Canghai Xuan Water Pearl had nearly half of its spiritual power drained," Xi Ying explained.
Hearing about the Canghai Xuan Water Pearl, Yuan Ming realized that these four replicas were probably not ordinary objects either.
"As for the matter of the Five Elements Spiritual Pearls, don't worry about it. Since I have the method, I can replicate them anew. However, there is no method to replicate the Canghai Xuan Water Pearl, and using it one more time will likely render it completely useless," Xi Ying said regretfully.
"That means we probably only have one chance," Yuan Ming reflected.
"Make thorough preparations, and I believe you can succeed in one go," Xi Ying said, looking at Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming remained silent, lost in thought.
After a long while, his eyes suddenly lit up, and he said, "I almost forgot about the Undying Tree."
Thereferenceversionofthison*.
At hearing this, Xi Ying frowned, initially failing to grasp his implication.
"Xi Ying, after practicing the Ju Mang Spirit Technique, the Undying Tree in my Dantian has essentially become equivalent to one of my Innate Spiritual Treasures. You said earlier that with this tree, I have essentially obtained both Yin Yang Five Elements and Seven Spiritual Roots. So why not directly use the Undying Tree as the Companion Spirit Treasure and merge the Five Elements Power into it?" Yuan Ming proposed with a smile.
"Indeed, where else could you find something that fits so well with your Spirit Root? Not even the Five Elements Spiritual Pearls can compare," Xi Ying responded, her eyes shining as well.
"Starting tomorrow, I plan to enter seclusion here. Is there a suitable place?" Yuan Ming inquired.
"Chaotian Peak has been fully repaired; it is where the spiritual energy of Chang Chun Temple is most abundant. You can seclude yourself there, and I will bring all the techniques, secret skills, elixirs, and spiritual materials you need later," Xi Ying offered.
"Let's do as you suggested," Yuan Ming nodded in satisfaction.
...
Since Yuan Ming had begun his seclusion, Xi Ying once again continued to push forward and stabilize her unified cause.
Chang Chun Temple was completely erased from the annals of history, and the Sect was officially renamed the Double Moon Alliance Headquarters.
Under Xi Ying's governance, Yunhuang Continent swept away the shadows of war and welcomed a decade of rapid development.
After ten years, the Double Moon Alliance had effectively completed its unification.
Throughout Yunhuang Continent, whether in the Southern Border, the Northern Desert, the Central Plains, or the East Sea, almost all large and medium-sized sects had been incorporated under the Double Moon Alliance.
Both on the mountains and beyond, whether cultivators or common people, nearly ninety percent of the population had become devotees of the deities Ming Yue and Xi Yue, receiving their protection.
In the process of deploying union arrays across Yunhuang Continent, Xi Ying also gained a clear understanding of the distribution of spirit fields and spirit veins, deploying personnel for excavation and planting, eventually reserving a portion for unified distribution, with the remaining areas being traded for circulation in the market.
If conflicts arose among different factions within the alliance, the Double Moon Alliance would mediate. Both overt and covert struggles diminished, and practices like the widespread raising of Beast Slaves in the Southern Border were nearly eradicated.
There were also instances where some forces dissatisfied with their constraints plotted rebellions, but before any uprising could occur, they were secretly reported to the Double Moon Alliance and swiftly suppressed.
If there were disasters or famines within the countries of the Mortal World, the local cultivation forces would intervene to prevent catastrophes such as cannibalism or the dreadful misfortune of parents exchanging their children for food.
Under Xi Ying's management, both the Cultivation World and the Mortal World of Yunhuang Continent became orderly and prospered.
Eventually, Xi Ying began to step back gradually, no longer interfering much with specific affairs.
Now, those believers spread across the entire Yunhuang Continent were her greatest reassurance as she let go.
On one hand, she focused more on collecting the resources needed for Yuan Ming to advance to the Returning to Void Stage more quickly; on the other hand, she also continued to gather more intelligence, preparing to venture into the Overseas World.

chapters.title: Chapter 777 - 748 Immortal Elite Conference
chapters.content:
Thirty years later, Chaotian Peak.
The door of the Seclusion Room burst open, and Yuan Ming stepped out at a slow pace, his step firm and powerful, his eyes flashing with spirit light. However, that light quickly receded with his breath, turning into a depth.
After long and arduous cultivation, he had finally reached the late-stage of Nascent Soul, only a step away from Returning Void.
Yet, this step of breakthrough was far more difficult than surpassing the lesser realms.
Therefore, Yuan Ming's heart wasn't filled with much excitement. He had emerged from seclusion simply wanting to take a brief rest and adjust his state.
Yuan Ming pondered the next phase of his cultivation plan, casting his gaze to the Void Communication Array in his Cave Mansion.
He pondered for a moment before suddenly casting a spell towards the Stone Pillar of the Array.
A flicker of black light passed over the pillar, and after a short wait, Xi Ying's face appeared amidst the blood-colored flames.
"You've come out of seclusion?" Xi Ying exclaimed with joy.
"Yes, I've just broken through to the late-stage Nascent Soul. I've come out to clear my mind temporarily. Do you have anything that needs my help? I plan to continue in seclusion until I reach Returning Void, and I fear it will be a long time before I pay attention to external affairs again," Yuan Ming inquired.
"Now that Yunhuang is unified, there really isn't much that requires our intervention. You don't need to worry; continue your cultivation in peace. I will also arrange for supplies to be delivered to your Cave Mansion periodically, striving to help you break through to Returning Void sooner so that we can start preparing to venture Overseas," Xi Ying said.
"Alright, but the resources needed for breaking through to Returning Void are vast, won't your cultivation be affected if I take them all?" Yuan Ming expressed concern.
"No matter, my strength is now enough to preside over Yunhuang. When your cultivation is complete, take me to the Overseas World, and I can amass resources for my breakthrough then. As for the dangers of the journey, isn't there the Sky-reaching Demon Pillar? I can hide in the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space for the entire sea crossing, so it doesn't matter if my cultivation level is lower," Xi Ying had already planned.
Hearing this, Yuan Ming said no more. After exchanging a few more words and learning of the current situation in Yunhuang, he prepared to enter seclusion once again.
"When it's time for your breakthrough, I'll transplant more Gathering Spirit Objects here; they are sure to be of help to you," Xi Ying suddenly suggested.
Yuan Ming naturally had no objection. The two chatted idly for a few more moments before ending their communication.
Yuan Ming returned to the Seclusion Room. With a sweep of his sleeves, the door closed firmly behind him, and there was silence once more.
...
A hundred years later, Yuhua City.
This Immortal City, once ravaged by war, was now completely rejuvenated.
The scale of the city had expanded several times compared to before, with countless pavilions and towers blooming like colorful flowers in every corner of the city.
Among these, the most eye-catching was the Combat Arena in the city center.
"...It is said that the Combat Arena was personally designed by the Xi Yue God and constructed with the collective effort of Array Masters from the Five Regions of Yunhuang. Not only is the area massive, but the countless Formations arranged inside can simulate thousands of realistic illusion scenarios for Cultivators to train and compete," a young man with a cloth turban explained to onlookers in front of the Combat Arena.
In front of him stood a young man and a young woman, both dressed in short robes woven from brocade, styled like the Southern Border People.
The three of them had low levels of cultivation, all at Foundation Establishment. However, judging by their age, they seemed to be only about fifteen or sixteen, truly outstanding among their peers.
"How amazing! Brother Fang, are we going to compete here later on?" The female cultivator, excited after hearing the introduction, tugged at her senior brother's sleeve.
"Are you two here to participate in the Immortal Elite Conference? My apologies, I failed to introduce myself. I'm Liu Mao, representing Black Wind Desert in the competition. If we meet later, I hope you will be lenient," the turban-headed youth bowed.
He had just met the brother and sister, and seeing their curiosity about the Combat Arena, he couldn't help but join the conversation to offer some information.
* is the home% of t&his* ch.ap$te+r
"Our apologies as well. I am Fang Shuang, and this is my junior sister Mei Xiao, and we represent the Southern Border and Northern Territory," Brother Fang returned the greeting.
The so-called "Immortal Elite Conference" was a grand event proposed by Xi Ying after unifying Yunhuang, aiming to select outstanding talents. Held every ten years, it was stipulated that only those under Core Formation and under thirty could participate. Preliminaries were first held across the Five Domains, with each branch selecting five to ten people as regional representatives, culminating in the final competition in Yuhua City.
"Meeting here is fate. It seems it is your first time, why don't I show you two around?" Liu Mao offered with a smile.
"Yes, please!" Before Fang Shuang could answer, Mei Xiao nodded her head repeatedly, her face full of excitement.
"Junior sister, it's getting late, we shouldn't wander too much. Otherwise, if Master returns and finds out we sneaked out, she will definitely punish us," Fang Shuang said with an embarrassed smile, quickly discouraging her.
"Hmph! All she does is make me cultivate. It's so rare for us to come to the Central Plains, and she wants me to stay indoors and seclude myself. Is this how life should be lived?" Mei Xiao complained indignantly.
"She does it for your own good," Fang Shuang shook his head.
"Enough, enough, Brother Fang, don't speak so much, okay? Do I not know what kind of person my mother is? She's an old witch, always looking for excuses to boss us around, like the last time..." Mei Xiao pouted.
"For example, what?" However, just at that moment, a voice filled with coldness came from behind Mei Xiao.
Mei Xiao's body instantly stiffened, and then she turned around stiffly like a puppet, her face switching to a forced smile in an instant.
"Mother, I was just joking, you're the best," she said insincerely.
Standing in front of her was an ethereal-looking woman in light cyan palace attire, her arms crossed over her chest, staring at Mei Xiao with a face full of coldness. On her shoulder, a fiery little marten was grinning and squeaking, as if mocking Mei Xiao.
If Yuan Ming were here, he would definitely recognize that this little marten was none other than Huo Chan'er, whom he had once cared for.
And the refined-looking woman shared some resemblance to Li Zhui and Ling Songhua.
Putting the two together, the identity of the refined woman was self-evident.
She seemed to have just finished some business at the Combat Arena, and there were many Core Formation cultivators nearby, but they showed respect for her, merely glancing over before voluntarily leaving, with no intention of meddling in her family matters.
"Hmph, you always neglect your Cultivation, but now with the Immortal Elite Conference coming up, you still haven't mastered the Secret Techniques I taught you, how do you expect to achieve good results?" Li Yu said with a cold face, but what she cared about wasn't the fact that her daughter had called her an old witch.
"Mother, but I really want to go out and see the world, just for today, one day, okay?" Hearing this, Mei Xiao couldn't maintain her fake smile and immediately pleaded with a sorrowful face.
"No! You're already sixteen. If you miss this Immortal Elite Conference, you'll be close to the age limit next time. And if you achieve a ranking in the conference, you will be able to cultivate at the main temple of the Double Moon Alliance. Then, you can wander around Yuhua City as you please, but for now, you must go back to seclusion obediently!" Li Yu scolded sternly.
Mei Xiao pursed her lips, her face full of dissatisfaction.
And at that moment, a Core Formation cultivator with a burn scar on his left face came out from the Combat Arena. Noticing the scene, he took the initiative to approach and exchanged a look with Liu Mao, who was quietly standing aside, and then greeted Li Yu with a cupped fist.
Coincidentally, this man was Zhang Xiu, whom Yuan Ming had once rescued in the Black Wind Desert.
"Fellow Daoist Li, what's the matter? Did my worthless disciple offend you all?" Zhang Xiu asked.
"Fellow Daoist Zhang has misunderstood. It's my unruly daughter, nothing to do with your disciple," Li Yu then noticed Liu Mao beside her and immediately turned around and shook her head.
Upon hearing this, Zhang Xiu pulled his disciple over. He hadn't intended to interfere with Li Yu's family affairs, but then Liu Mao suddenly transmitted to him the causes and consequences of the dispute.
After learning about the argument, Zhang Xiu couldn't help but glance at Mei Xiao.
"Fellow Daoist Li, please forgive my presumption, but as the saying goes, 'it is better to direct than to block.' Your beloved daughter is at a lively age. Allowing her one day off to explore the world might be beneficial. If you push her too hard, she might become rebellious and even less willing to practice Cultivation," Zhang Xiu thought for a moment and offered his advice.
Li Yu seemed somewhat hesitant upon hearing this, and Mei Xiao seized the opportunity to grab her mother's arm, her large watery eyes blinking pitifully like a little puppy.
"Sigh, just one day, but afterwards you must concentrate on your Cultivation," Li Yu sighed, her heart softening as she finally agreed to Mei Xiao's request.
"Yes!" Mei Xiao cheered.
"Don't be too happy just yet. You're still young; there are places you can't go. Huo Chan'er, you follow Xiao'er, don't let her wander too far, understand?" Li Yu was worried and suddenly turned her head to instruct the marten on her shoulder.
Huo Chan'er immediately stood up, patted its chest with its front paws, and then jumped forward onto Mei Xiao's shoulder.
"Ah, no, Mother, Huo Chan'er is such a glutton, whenever you're not around, it always extorts me for treats; please find someone else to keep an eye on me, Brother Fang Shuang would do!" Mei Xiao became anxious at once.
"Don't talk nonsense," Li Yu flicked Mei Xiao's forehead and reprimanded, not very pleased.
Huo Chan'er also nodded repeatedly, tapping lightly on Mei Xiao as if to complain.
"It's getting late, Fellow Daoist Li, I have urgent matters to attend to, so I will take my leave now," Zhang Xiu said, preparing to leave.
However, his disciple Liu Mao stayed behind.
Having heard of Zhang Xiu's reputation, Li Yu was at ease with his disciple and did not interfere with her daughter's socializing, merely admonishing her with a few words before leaving.
No sooner had she left than Huo Chan'er immediately acted all high and mighty, climbing atop Mei Xiao's head and waving its paws in front of her eyes.
"Ugh...that's all I have..." Mei Xiao pouted, reluctantly dug out a few Fire Crystal Stones from her Storage Bag, holding them in both hands like making an offering above her head.
Huo Chan'er was delighted, vanished in a flash of motion to gobble up the Fire Crystal Stones, and then complained with dissatisfaction, seemingly finding them insufficient, indicating that Mei Xiao should find more.
On the other hand, Fang Shuang was no stranger to these antics, turning his head directly toward Liu Mao, who was happily watching the drama unfold.
"May I ask Fellow Daoist Liu, is not your master the one known as the Lord of the Black Wind Desert?" he asked, curious.

chapters.title: Chapter 778 - 749: Achieving Returning Void
chapters.content:
"Hehe, I don't deserve such praise, I don't deserve it; my master was merely stationed there by the Moon Sect to oversee the Black Wind Desert, he can hardly be called the master of any realm," Liu Mao hurriedly waved his hands.
"Fellow Daoist Liu is truly too modest. Who doesn't know of Senior Zhang's great reputation? It is said he started from nothing, originally a slave, until the chaos in the Wuyue Sect unexpectedly brought him an opportunity. From then on, he soared to the heavens, single-handedly conquering most of the Black Wind Desert and even abolishing the local slave trade. Afterwards, having joined the Double Moon Alliance, he went from campaign to campaign, achieving countless victories. Seeing him today, he indeed possesses an extraordinary aura," Fang Shuang said admiringly.
"Hehe, my master was actually just lucky, but... let me tell you quietly, don't spread it around. The opportunity my master received was actually bestowed by Lord Nether Moon God himself. Back then, he even personally encouraged my master to carve out a career, which led to what my master has achieved today," Liu Mao shared, his eyes filled with reverence as he bowed in the direction of the Double Moon Alliance's main temple.
"Really? I had long heard that Lord Nether Moon God had aided many people in the past, but I never expected Senior Zhang to be one of them. He is truly blessed. I wonder if I will ever have the chance to meet Lord Nether Moon God and receive his guidance," Fang Shuang sighed with envy.
"Are you talking about Lord Nether Moon God? I heard from my grandmother that she had once seen..." Mei Xiao also came over, intrigued.
Before she could finish speaking, a sudden thunderclap exploded in the sky. Following that, a mysterious fluctuation burst forth from the Double Moon Alliance's main temple, and countless fist-sized spheres of spiritual energy rapidly emerged from the ground and buildings around, all rushing towards the sky.
Everyone was greatly alarmed and quickly looked up.
They saw all the spiritual energy spheres converging in the sky like shooting stars in reverse, gathering into a vast, multicolored Spirit Cloud. The cloud shimmered and shifted in dazzling patterns.
The colorful cloud spiraled in midair, forming a funnel shape with its narrower end directly above Chaotian Peak at the Double Moon Alliance's main temple.
Endless rosy light completely replaced the daylight, casting Yuhua City in a spectrum of colors.
A deep rumbling continued to emanate from the sky, but if one listened closely, the surroundings seemed eerily quiet. The sounds, like muffled thunder, seemed not to be resonating next to the ear, but rather emanating from within the chest.
"What kind of astronomical phenomenon is this? Could it be that a senior is about to break through to Nascent Soul?" Fang Shuang's eyes widened.
"No, I had the fortune to witness the Nascent Soul Formation Phenomenon with my master, and it was nothing like this grand scale," Liu Mao decisively shook his head.
"If it's not the Nascent Soul, then could it be..." Fang Shuang swallowed hard, unable to believe her own conjecture.
Just then, the Huo Chan'er on Mei Xiao's head seemed to sense something, straightened up, and started squeaking, vigorously waving its forelimbs at the source of the anomaly, as if waving a greeting.
Seeing Huo Chan'er's reaction, everyone was even more astonished.
...Uploa.d*ed by the *+) t@eam.$
As the celestial phenomenon occurred, countless tunneling lights shot out from the mansions within the Double Moon Alliance, all heading straight for Chaotian Peak.
However, at this moment, Chaotian Peak and the nearby mountains were enveloped by a misty great array, blocking all the visitors outside.
When Xu Che arrived, what he saw was a group of people outside the array, scratching their heads as they waited.
He did not wait with them but communicated into the array. Moments later, Yan Si Jing, holding a token, walked out of the mist and led him inside.
Passing through layers of fog, Xu Che's first sight was the Gathering Spirit Tree at the summit of Chaotian Peak.
To aid Yuan Ming in his breakthrough, in addition to this Gathering Spirit Tree, Xi Ying had prepared many Gathering Spirit Objects, like the Gathering Spirit Blood River held by Xi Qian, which were all buried beneath Chaotian Peak, directly causing the spiritual power of the area to multiply several times; in some places, even the spiritual energy was seen liquefying.
Xu Che then looked up at the celestial phenomena again, noting that the gathering point of the Spirit Cloud was right below the Gathering Spirit Tree; realizing that Yuan Ming was at that very spot attempting his breakthrough, he dared not get too close and simply followed Yan Si Jing to a nearby mountain peak.
At that moment, Xi Ying, dressed in a long gown, stood at the mountaintop, her eyes constantly fixed on the distant Chaotian Peak. Her face was expressionless, but the hands hanging by her sides were clenched tightly.
Xu Che's arrival did not draw her attention, but he respectfully bowed to her, and seeing no response, he quietly stood behind her.
Yan Si Yun was also present. Seeing Xu Che's arrival, she nodded silently without speaking.
After a century, both Xu Che and the Yan sisters had broken through to Nascent Soul; however, the latter two, being more talented, had even gained Xi Ying's favor, who personally taught them the Moonlight Technique, and they also cultivated the path of Soul Cultivation.
However, because Yan Si Yun was occupied with many chores, she had only reached the Love Witch Realm, whereas Yan Si Jing devoted herself to cultivation and had stepped into the Sleeping Witch Realm.
The anomaly in the sky continued, and Xi Ying and the others continued to wait. In the meantime, some others close to Yuan Ming arrived nearby, all being led by Yan Si Jing.
As time trickled by, Yuan Ming's breakthrough still did not conclude, and everyone gradually grew slightly anxious.
But just then, a piercing roar suddenly erupted from the peak of Chaotian Peak, resembling the long chant of a heavenly dragon and the roar of a fierce tiger, causing everyone's hearts to tremble.
The spirit clouds in the sky also suddenly trembled and then quickly started to swirl, like the Milky Way pouring down from the Nine Heavens, all pouring onto the summit of Chaotian Peak.
All the spiritual energy within the range of the phenomenon was instantly drained, making everyone feel a sense of suffocation and thirst, as if fish had been taken out of water and exposed to sunlight.
But in the next moment, a pillar of light shot up from Chaotian Peak, countless spirit lights like a fountain shot upwards and then transformed into rain, gently falling onto the ground.
As the raindrops touched them, everyone immediately felt refreshed, and on the ground, countless blades of tender grass and fresh flowers hurriedly sprouted from the soil, and in the blink of an eye, the mountains were verdant and the ridges colorful.
After but a few breaths, the spiritual rain ceased. In the sky, a seven-colored rainbow hung high, and under the sunlight, a figure slowly drifted down, arriving in front of the crowd.
"Congratulations, Lord Nether Moon God on your breakthrough to the Returning Void!" The crowd hurriedly bowed their heads and congratulated in unison.
Even those like Long Chong, who had once been close to Yuan Ming, dared not call out Yuan Ming's real name at this moment. Almost everyone had a look of reverence on their faces, except for one.
"I did it," Yuan Ming said, looking at Xi Ying with a smile in his eyes.
Xi Ying nodded gently, remaining silent, her gaze fixated on Yuan Ming. For some reason, she was reminded of his struggles for survival in the Ten Thousand Mountains years ago.
The once prisoner of the Southern Border was now the co-ruler of Yunhuang.
In the next instant, Xi Ying stepped forward and embraced Yuan Ming, giving him a kiss.
Yuan Ming was initially slightly surprised, but soon his gaze softened, and they embraced and kissed in the light.
Then, he suddenly flicked his sleeve, taking Xi Ying and instantly disappearing from the mountaintop, leaving behind only a divine thought echoing in everyone's minds.
"In six months, the alliance will host a grand festival. Please spread the message and invite cultivators from the Five Domains to attend the ceremony."
Everyone promptly acknowledged, and when they looked up, they found that both Yuan Ming and Xi Ying had vanished. They didn't give it much thought, exchanged a few words among themselves, and then departed.
...
A few days later, at the Cave Mansion on Chaotian Peak.
Xi Ying had already left, giving Yuan Ming time to stabilize his cultivation.
For this breakthrough, Yuan Ming had made extensive preparations. A century of hard practice not only brought his cultivation to the peak of the Late Stage Nascent Soul, but he had also brought three other cultivation techniques to advanced levels.
Even so, his breakthrough had not been entirely smooth sailing.
Perhaps because he was a Spoken Witch, the amount of spiritual power needed during the breakthrough process had far exceeded his expectations. Even though he had brought his Mixed Hole Secret Technique to perfection in advance and his mana inside the Dantian was twice that of cultivators at the same level, it was still insufficient for the needs of the breakthrough, catching him somewhat off guard at the last moment.
Fortunately, he had learned the Chang Chun Temple Secret Technique, turning the Undying Tree into his Lifebound Spiritual Treasure. By leveraging the massive amount of Five Elements Spiritual Power stored within it, he barely managed to meet the requirements for the breakthrough, stepping into the Returning Void Realm.
As a cost, the spiritual energy accumulated in the Undying Tree was almost drained, and its body suffered severe damage, only narrowly avoiding turning into a mundane object. Luckily, its life force was resilient, and it just managed to hang on, but it would likely need a long period of nurturing to recover.
Yet, although the process was somewhat rough and there were losses, Yuan Ming gained even more after his breakthrough to the Returning Void.
Firstly, having completed his Spirit Root, Yuan Ming no longer had any weaknesses in the Five Elements Techniques. By stepping into the Returning Void, he also gained the ability to control the nature's spiritual energy within a certain range, which could enhance the power of magical treasures and allow him to manifest entirely different divine skills from the techniques he had learned before.
Moreover, during the breakthrough, his Lifebound Magical Treasure, the Soul Destroying Sword, melded with his Spirit Root by chance, undergoing an initial transformation and developing a nascent spiritual consciousness.
This was a sign of the birth of an Artifact Spirit.
Although Yuan Ming found it challenging to control the Artifact Spirits of the Shura Blood Devouring Map and Stealing Heaven Tripod, the Soul Destroying Sword had been by his side all along, and its Artifact Spirit was newly forming. Yuan Ming was confident he could keep it under his control, thus he valued and anticipated it highly, for once successfully nurtured, the enhancement to the Soul Destroying Sword would be indescribable.
However, the Soul Destroying Sword itself still required a period of nurturing and refinement. If possible, he also needed to add some more spiritual materials to re-forge it, otherwise, the time required to develop its Artifact Spirit would be exceedingly long.
But the needed materials were likely hard to gather in the Yunhuang region; he would have to travel overseas to possibly find them.
Therefore, as Yuan Ming solidified his realm, he also readied himself.
Now, with Yunhuang unified and the Returning Void achieved, there was no longer any attachment here, and it was time for him to leave.

chapters.title: Chapter 779 - 750: Three Pages of the Heavenly Book
chapters.content:
News of Yuan Ming's breakthrough to the Returning Void spread rapidly throughout Yunhuang.
In the history of Yunhuang, very few had achieved the realm of Returning Void, and a cultivator like Yuan Ming, who had simultaneously attained Body Cultivation of Wanxiang, Spoken Witch of the Soul Cultivator, and the Returning Void of the Magic Practitioner, was unprecedented.
It was foreseeable that such an unparalleled achievement would not be matched by anyone else in the short term.
Everyone who knew of Yuan Ming's past was astonished by his talent and fortune, while those who knew nothing of his history regarded him as divine from birth.
Rumors even circulated in the workshops that Nether Moon God Yuan Ming was a powerful being from ancient times who had awakened in the present day, just like the Wu Yue God.
As a result, the number of believers in the Moon Sect multiplied several times over the following period, with countless people praying to the Nether Moon God, hoping to receive a sliver of his talent and fortune.
However, for the old ancestors of sects and leaders of powers who had witnessed it all, Yuan Ming's breakthrough to Returning Void also meant that the strength of the Double Moon Alliance had become even more imposing, making its rule over Yunhuang all the more unshakeable.
Consequently, almost every Nascent Soul cultivator upon hearing the news immediately started preparing congratulatory gifts with the greatest haste and set off for the headquarters of the Double Moon Alliance.
No one dared to refuse the invitation, nor dared to arrive unprepared.
It was said that to prepare these congratulatory gifts, the top Spiritual Objects in Yunhuang had been gathered exhaustively, causing prices in every workshop to soar. Some Nascent Soul cultivators who reacted slowly couldn't even find anything presentable and had to rack their brains to come up with more creative congratulatory gifts.
In order to organize the celebration, the Double Moon Alliance also spared no effort; the amount of Spirit Stones spent alone was counted in the hundreds of millions, not to mention the staggering consumption of manpower and resources.
On the day of the grand ceremony, the headquarters of the Double Moon Alliance was packed with people. Core Formation Cultivators, who were rarely seen, became mere extras, while only the old Nascent Soul monsters and those with a past connection to Yuan Ming were able to join the inner seats and meet Yuan Ming a few times.
"Xing'er has gotten pregnant again recently, and she's been nagging me ever since she heard you broke through to Returning Void. She insists on you giving the child a name, hoping to receive a touch of immortal aura. I've been so pestered by her that I had no choice but to come over with a thick face," said Xu Tian with a wry smile, seeking Yuan Ming's opinion in front of him.
"It's just a small matter, Cousin, why bother so? Let me think... How about the name Xu Yuxian?" After pondering for a moment, Yuan Ming said with a smile.
"Xu Yuxian... Yes, this name is good!" Luo Xing'er muttered to herself with a delighted expression on her face.
Xu Tian was very pleased with the name as well, chatted with Yuan Ming for a few more moments, and then took the initiative to leave with his wife, without disturbing Yuan Ming's reception of other guests.
Yuan Ming watched them leave and, after the two had gone far, he couldn't help but sigh deeply.
Around the time he entered Three Immortals Island, his grandmother had ventured into a secret realm seeking Core Formation opportunities, only to perish, and his two uncles had also passed away one after the other as their Life Span exhausted.
And with the passing of Yuan Ming's parents, the only remaining blood relatives left in the world were Xu Tian alone.
Yuan Ming had just covertly probed with his Divine Sense and discovered that Xu Tian's talent was not high and his age was already advanced. Reaching Foundation Establishment was fortunate enough, leaving almost no possibility of further advancement.
The only thing Yuan Ming could do for him was to order Xu Che to arrange a good position within the alliance that could shelter his descendants.
With this thought, Yuan Ming couldn't help but reflect on how long and solitary the Immortal Path is, casting a slight shadow over his previously joyful mood.
"Master, Wan Tianren and Gu Xuanyang are seeking an audience," Xu Che suddenly reported at that moment.
Yuan Ming composed himself a bit and then nodded, asking Xu Che to lead the visitors over.
Wan Tianren, who followed Xu Che, had lost the overwhelming aura he had when they first met; he appeared to have aged by decades, with half his hair turned white, his shoulders slightly stooped, and his figure no longer erect. His cultivation had even regressed to the mid-stage Nascent Soul.
Times had been hard for Wan Tianren over the past century.

Ever since his failure to break through to Returning Void, Fusang Island's status in the East Sea had declined day by day, and when the Double Moon Alliance was formed and Chang Chun Temple was soundly defeated, Fusang Island's situation plummeted.
Most of the islands in the East Sea cut off their connections with them, with the only other contacts being staunch allies such as Gu Xuanyang, but in total they numbered only a few and were also heavily suppressed.
This caused dissension among his subordinates and resulted in a considerable number of defections. The once-renowned Fusang Island in the East Sea had fallen to a state lower than even second-level islands.
Yuan Ming pondered over the intelligence he had gathered from Xu Che in recent days, speculating about Wan Tianren's intentions, and then saw Wan Tianren bend over respectfully to salute.
"Wan Tianren of Fusang Island congratulates Senior Yuan on the great accomplishment of Returning Void," he said with his head lowered.
"Alas, Fellow Daoist Wan, why do you do this?" sighed Yuan Ming, feeling somewhat pity.
In the end, there was no significant conflict between him and Wan Tianren, and the current plight of Fusang Island was indeed the bitter fruit of Wan Tianren's own ambition, with no one else to blame.
"Senior Yuan need not pity me. As the saying goes, 'victors beget glory, and losers bear the blame.' I have accepted my fate and have no intention of contending with the senior any longer. My only wish is not to see my ancestors' legacy destroyed in my hands. Here are three volumes of the Golden Sunflower Heavenly Book once obtained by Fusang Island. I beg you, for their sake, to show mercy and spare Fusang Island," said Wan Tianren as he straightened up and presented a Storage Ring with both hands.
"Sigh, enough is enough, I shall grant Fellow Daoist Wan's request," Yuan Ming said resignedly, accepting the Storage Ring.
After Wan Tianren delivered the Heavenly Book, he seemed not willing to stay a moment longer. Having exchanged only a few words, Yuan Ming noticed his uneasiness and took the initiative to offer tea and see him out.
Not long after Wan Tianren and Gu Xuanyang had left, Xi Ying arrived with her father and sister in tow.
"What did Wan Tianren just say to you?" Xi Ying asked with a hint of curiosity.
Yuan Ming recounted the recent events.
"He is a clever man, it's just a pity that his abilities don't match his ambitions. Now that he has handed over the Heavenly Book, let's follow your wish and spare him," Xi Ying said with an immediate smile after hearing the story.
Yuan Ming nodded in agreement, then his gaze shifted to Xi Zheng and Xi Qian.
A hundred years had passed and Xi Zheng had still not broken through the Body of Wanxiang, but his spirit was quite admirable, and the relationship between him and Xi Ying had become less strained—they appeared to have reconciled.
As for Xi Qian, she had changed a lot; her cultivation had actually reached the late-stage Nascent Soul, not much less than Yuan Ming when he made his breakthrough to Returning Void.
"See, even Yuan Ming is surprised. Sister, your cultivation pace is really fast," Xi Ying said, also looking towards Xi Qian at this moment.
"It's all thanks to you two. If you hadn't refined the Immortal Elixir, I'd still be lying in a coffin right now, nowhere near this level of cultivation," Xi Qian said with a mirthful laughter.
There were many more who wanted to see Yuan Ming, so after a light-hearted exchange, Xi Zheng and others didn't stay much longer. After offering their congratulations, they were led out by Xi Ying.
In the following time, Yuan Ming met with many familiar people, such as the Li Zhui couple, the father and son of Golden Transformation Master, and so on.
During conversations with them, Yuan Ming often found himself reminiscing about his past experiences. As the last person bid farewell and left, he suddenly felt an inexplicable sensation, as if he was saying goodbye to the past, severing all lingering attachments.
But he knew it was just an illusion.
Pondering, Yuan Ming quietly stood up from the reception room in the inner hall and walked into the great hall where a banquet was in full swing.
When everyone in the hall saw Yuan Ming appear, they stood up one after another, cheering and offering their congratulations.
Their voices were not in unison; in fact, they were quite disorderly.
However, looking at those faces, both familiar and unfamiliar, Yuan Ming's lips curved into a smile.
"This cup, I invite you all to drink together," he said, receiving a cup of wine from Xu Che and raising it high.
"To the glory of the Nether Moon God!"
...
As the banquet continued in high spirits, with the noise ebbing and flowing, Yuan Ming's attention had already shifted to the three pages of the Heavenly Book presented by Wan Tianren.
Seizing a moment of quiet, he sent his Divine Sense into the Storage Ring, carefully examining the secret techniques recorded on the pages of the Heavenly Book.
The three pages corresponded to three secret techniques—Golden Sunflower Beast Taming Technique, Planting Beans into Soldiers, and Eyes of Golden Flame.
Yuan Ming had already mastered the Golden Sunflower Beast Taming Technique, so after a cursory glance, he moved on from it.
Planting Beans into Soldiers was a magic that required the assistance of objects. Before casting, a cultivator must specially refine spirit beans and store a certain amount of mana and spiritual power within them in advance.
In actual combat, the practitioner could throw out the prepared spirit beans, transforming them into their own clones to fight.
This technique had three levels. At the first level, one could only create clones with ten percent of the original's combat strength; at the second level, thirty percent; and at the third level, sixty percent.
It should be noted that the level of mastery only affects the strength of the clones created; the number of clones one can control entirely depends on the amount of the practitioner's own soul power.
Compared to Planting Beans into Soldiers and Golden Sunflower Beast Taming Technique, cultivating the Eyes of Golden Flame was much more dangerous.
It required the practitioner to cultivate with the help of Spiritual Fire, absorbing the power of the fire through their eyes to enhance their eyesight, to minutely observe all things, and to see through all illusions and disguises.
The higher the level of the immersed Spiritual Fire, the more powerful the cultivated Eyes of Golden Flame will be, and the farther they can see through deceptions.
However, any mistake during the cultivation process could lead to the Spiritual Fire damaging the eyes, resulting in complete blindness that couldn't be healed or restored by ordinary means.
Overall, once these two secret techniques are mastered, they would be very useful to the current Yuan Ming. Nevertheless, whether it is refining spirit beans or absorbing Spiritual Fire, both require time and, at least for now, Yuan Ming was not planning to start practicing them.
He quickly withdrew his Divine Sense from the Storage Ring and focused on entertaining the cultivators of Yunhuang who came to offer their congratulations.

chapters.title: Chapter 780 - 751: The Successor
chapters.content:
After the celebration, everyone began to leave one by one.
Yuan Ming stood in the empty hall, staring straight ahead in silence.
At that moment, he suddenly sensed something and looked up to see Xi Ying, who had quietly arrived in the hall and was watching him.
"What's the matter?" Yuan Ming asked with a smile.
"I'm just feeling a bit emotional. The Beast Slave boy I met in the mountains of the Southern Border has now grown into the most powerful figure in the Yunhuang Continent. It all feels like a dream," Xi Ying said softly with a smile.
Yuan Ming looked back on the past; it was like a fast horse passing through a gap—all very vivid in his mind, and also kind of surreal.
"What are your plans next?" Xi Ying asked.
"Are you planning to set off for the Overseas World now? You founded the Double Moon Alliance with your own hands—are you really going to just abandon it?" Yuan Ming said.
"The external threats to the Yunhuang Continent have been eliminated, and the development of the Double Moon Alliance has stabilized. The rules are perfected, and with or without me, the difference isn't significant anymore," Xi Ying said, her gaze piercing through the hall to the distant horizon.
After speaking, she turned her gaze back to Yuan Ming, her eyes laden with expectations.
"After successfully breaking through to the Returning Void, the spirit vein at Chang Chun Temple offers limited help to my cultivation now. I think it's time for me to set out and see the outside world. Have you thought about who will manage the Double Moon Alliance after we leave?" Yuan Ming understood her implication and nodded.
"Yan Si Yun," Xi Ying said without hesitation.
Yuan Ming was surprised, "I thought you would choose your uncle to manage the Double Moon Alliance since he is much stronger than Yan Si Yun both in cultivation and experience."
"I know my father very well. Although he is quite talented and good at managing affairs, he is too self-interested. If he were in charge of the Double Moon Alliance, it would be difficult for him to act impartially. Over time, this would inevitably lead to internal strife and even the danger of a civil war," Xi Ying shook her head and slowly continued.
"But Yan Si Yun's experience is too shallow after all, she might not be able to command respect," Yuan Ming said with a frown.
"When it comes to managing the Double Moon Alliance, what one actually need not worry about is the issue of depth of experience. Because no matter when, the Nether Moon God and Xi Yue God are the true leaders of the Double Moon Alliance. The qualification of the manager, and the gods' opinions, weigh heavily. As long as it is someone you and I recognize and announce to the disciples, there's no need to worry about not commanding respect," Xi Ying said smilingly.
Yuan Ming nodded, the Double Moon Alliance was different from a common sect; the bond that maintained its existence was not just the organizational structure, but also faith.
As long as the faith in the Nether Moon God and Xi Yue God didn't crumble, the Double Moon Alliance wouldn't face major problems.
"Actually, besides that, what I value more is Yan Si Yun's capabilities. Over these years, she has been assisting me in managing the Double Moon Alliance. Although her cultivation is a bit weaker, her insight and strategic view are excellent. She is proficient in the Divination Skill, and her sister is very powerful. With further cultivation, she could compensate for her lack of strength," Xi Ying went on.
"That is true, it's just that their cultivation is a bit low at the moment, making it hard to deal with powerful enemies; they need another boost," Yuan Ming said upon hearing this.
Two days later, inside the secret chamber of Chaotian Peak.
Yuan Ming was sitting cross-legged on a cushion, while Yan Si Yun and her sister Yan Sijing stood in front of him, looking slightly nervous.
"Si Yun, Xi Ying must have informed you about taking over the Double Moon Alliance, right?" Yuan Ming asked.
"She did inform me... It's just that, I feel apprehensive and truly believe that I'm not up to the task," Yan Si Yun said with trepidation.
"Don't you trust yourself, or do you also doubt Xi Ying's judgment? If we've made this decision, it's because we believe you're capable of it," Yuan Ming said with a smile.
"Grateful for the trust you both place in me, I will devote myself fully and live up to your expectations," Yan Si Yun replied, calming down as she listened to Yuan Ming's steady voice and bowed deeply.
Yan Sijing stood silently at the side, her face showing genuine delight.
"Very well, I've called the two of you here today to give you a gift," Yuan Ming said.
With that, he flicked his wrist and took out two crystal-clear white orbs, handing one to each of them.
The moment the white orbs appeared, a strong surge of Soul Power emanated from them.
Being Soul Cultivators, Yan Si Yun and her sister were particularly sensitive to this energy, and their faces showed shock, "Are these elixirs condensed from Soul Power?"
"More or less. These are known as Vow Power Pills. They are created by refining and condensing the essence of Desire Power. To Soul Cultivators, they are the best supplements. Taking one could raise your Soul Power by a Great Realm," Yuan Ming explained.
"Sir, such precious items should be used by you, not wasted on us," Yan Si Yun immediately bowed deeply, instinctively refusing.
"My sister is right. We should not receive such treasures," Yan Sijing said, her face showing a longing, yet she still managed to restrain herself.
"Take them. These pills are of little use to me now. Given your current strengths, you won't be able to suppress the powerful figures. With the boost from these Vow Power Pills, you'll both be able to enhance your strength considerably. That way, Xi Ying and I can rest assured when handing over the Double Moon Alliance to you," Yuan Ming said.
Upon hearing his words, Yan Si Yun and her sister reluctantly accepted the pills.
"You both absorb these pills here. I'll guard you for a while," Yuan Ming continued.
"Thank you so much, sir," they said, tears of gratitude in their eyes as they bowed in thanks.
After three full days and nights, the Yan sisters finally refined and absorbed the Vow Power Pills, reaping substantial benefits.
Yan Si Yun successfully broke through her bottleneck, reaching the Sleep Witch Realm, while Yan Si Jing advanced directly to the Peak of the Sleep Witch Realm.
Together, they were formidable enough to intimidate most of the cultivators within the Double Moon Alliance.
Another day passed, and Yuan Ming and Xi Ying gathered the core members of the Double Moon Alliance. In front of them, they handed over the Blood Puppet Armor sealed with Tian Jizi to Yan Si Yun and announced her succession as the new Alliance Hierarch of the Double Moon Alliance.
Initially, everyone was shocked beyond belief, but after reflecting on it, they all felt that no one was more suitable than her, and they congratulated her one after another.
Xi Zheng was quite displeased with this decision. However, as it was a joint decision made by Xi Ying and Yuan Ming, there was nothing he could do about it.
Subsequently, Yuan Ming and Xi Ying announced the sealing off of Chaotian Peak, entering seclusion to comprehend the great Dao. Unless it was a matter of life and death for the Double Moon Alliance, no one was allowed to approach.
Upon hearing this, the members of the Double Moon Alliance solemnly agreed and withdrew from Chaotian Peak.
Seven days later.Tо suppоrt оur wоrk, plеаsе rеаd оn М|V|LЕ_МРYR.
Dense white fog appeared atop Chaotian Peak, enshrouding the entire mountain so that Divine Sense could not penetrate it. Any who touched the fog were devoured by it.
At the border of Da Jin Country, two figures stood silently, Yuan Ming and Xi Ying.
"Why bother with such a lie? It will be exposed sooner or later," Yuan Ming said.
"Even with the Blood Puppet Armor, Yan Si Yun and Yan Si Jing's strength is still insufficient. Using our reputations, for at least a hundred years, no one will dare to make a move. With this time, the Yan sisters will also be able to grow," Xi Ying said.
Yuan Ming nodded at these words, gazing longingly toward his homeland.
This time he was truly leaving, and it was uncertain when he would be able to return.
He patted the Spiritual Beast Bag at his waist, and the Three-eyed Crow flew out, landing in front of him.
The body of the Three-eyed Crow had grown significantly, its black feathers emanating wisps of black aura. Both its appearance and aura were entirely different from before.
Originally a third-level peak demon beast, the Three-eyed Crow had at last made a breakthrough after more than a hundred years and reached the Level 4 Realm.
"This journey to the Overseas World is exceedingly dangerous. Although you have reached Level 4, the risk of going there is still too great. You don't need to follow me anymore," Yuan Ming said as he gently stroked the Three-eyed Crow's head.
The Three-eyed Crow had always followed Yuan Ming, aware that he was about to venture to the Overseas World. But it was a mere demon beast with an innate fear of the volatile Overseas World.
Hearing this, the Three-eyed Crow relaxed, yet in its gaze toward Yuan Ming, a sense of reluctance was evident as it nuzzled his hand.
"Your potential is far less than that of Hua Zhi, Vajra, and Lei Yu. When I first took you as a spirit beast, it was an impulsive act, and I have not deliberately cultivated you over the years. Now that our separation is imminent, I present this to you as a reward," Yuan Ming, moved by emotion, patted the Three-eyed Crow's head and took out a Vow Power Pill, tossing it upwards.
The Three-eyed Crow let out a delighted cry of excitement, flapping its wings and soaring into the sky. It swallowed the Vow Power Pill in one gulp, then circled in the air, refining the demonic power.
In a short moment, its Demon Soul surged, reaching the Level 4 Peak.
Its three eyes shot out terrifyingly bright lights, especially the third eye on its forehead, which shone like a fierce sword light, with powerful Soul Power fluctuations spreading for dozens of miles around.
Yuan Ming showed a look of surprise. The Vow Power Pill's effect on the Three-eyed Crow was exceptionally remarkable, even surpassing that of Yan Si Yun and Yan Si Jing.
Demon beasts were innately strong in body and had thicker demonic power compared to cultivators of the same level. Their only weakness was the Divine Soul. Now that the Three-eyed Crow had just entered Level 4, its Soul Power had reached the Level 4 Peak. As it advanced in realm, its Divine Soul would continue to strengthen, indicating a high chance for the beast to break through to Level 5!
"Your Three-eyed Crow seems to be a mutant demon beast, very compatible with the Vow Power Pill. Do you want to bestow another Vow Power Pill and let the Three-eyed Crow's Divine Soul break through to Level 5 Realm?" Xi Ying suggested.
"No," Yuan Ming shook his head.
Although the Three-eyed Crow was not a Soul Cultivator, refining consecutive Vow Power Pills could easily lead to issues with the Divine Soul.
The Three-eyed Crow had now fully absorbed the Vow Power Pill and was feeling the changes in its Soul Power, screeching excitedly as it flapped its wings wildly in the sky.
After causing quite a ruckus for a while, the Three-eyed Crow calmed down and landed in front of Yuan Ming, its eyes filled with gratitude.
"Good. Your strength has greatly improved. In the future, watch over the Double Moon Alliance for me," Yuan Ming said.
The Three-eyed Crow promised repeatedly before flapping its wings and soaring away into the distant horizon.
"Let's go," Yuan Ming said as he too took flight.
"To the East Sea?" Xi Ying asked, following him.
"No, there are still some matters to attend to. I have to make a trip to the Southern Border," Yuan Ming shook his head, his gaze turning southward.

chapters.title: Chapter 781 - 752: The Three Great Perilous Places
chapters.content:
Several days later, the Southern Border Western Regions, Luota Town.
Yuan Ming and Xi Ying stood side by side in front of a courtyard.
"This is the residence of Senior Xia Jie? It seems that he's not here," Xi Ying said, looking at the courtyard ahead.
Yuan Ming also frowned, his Divine Sense sweeping over the courtyard where Xia Jie lived, finding it empty with no one around. The tables and chairs were covered in a thick layer of dust, clearly, it had been uninhabited for a long time.
"Didn't Senior Xia Jie used to stay here before? Could it be that something happened over the past hundred years?" Yuan Ming thought to himself.
Over the past century, he had attempted possessing Xia Jie but never succeeded, either due to the significant gap between their Divine Soul realms or because Xia Jie, being the former owner of the Stealing Heaven Tripod, had a way to avoid Black Incense Possession.
Yuan Ming extended his Divine Sense to its utmost limit, yet still, no clues were to be found.
He left Luota Town with Xi Ying and soon arrived at Snake King Valley.
The situation in Snake King Valley remained unchanged; the spatial rift had completely disappeared, and the Demonic Qi that once lingered in the ruins of the Underground Palace had also completely dissipated.
Without the influence of the underground Demon Eye, the poisonous fog that once covered the valley's surface was nowhere to be seen, turning Snake King Valley into an ordinary valley.
"It seems Senior Xia Jie has indeed left. Let's go," Yuan Ming said with a sigh.
The two of them hurried to the outer sea and soon reached the island teeming with demon beasts and abundant in Spiritual Energy, where Wulu had been waiting for them for quite some time.
Over the years, Yuan Ming had stayed in contact with Wulu, who had been searching for traces of the Demon Clan spies to no avail, as if they had vanished into thin air.
Feeling bored with nothing to do and with no intention of lingering in the Yunhuang Continent, Wulu heard that Yuan Ming and Xi Ying were preparing to head to the Overseas World and decided to join them.
"Brother Yuan, Daoist Xi Ying, you've kept me waiting," Wulu said with a smile as he greeted the two.
Yuan Ming took a closer look at Wulu, his eyebrows slightly raising.
He noticed that while Wulu's Cultivation Realm hadn't changed much, still at the peak of the Late-stage Nascent Soul, the previously chaotic and mixed aura inside him had been refined and unified.
Even with Yuan Ming's eyesight, he found it somewhat hard to see through Wulu now, sensing that his aura was profound and gave the feeling of boundless potential.
"I was delayed by some affairs of the Double Moon Alliance," said Xi Ying.
"Since everyone is here, let's get started. I've been looking forward to the Overseas World," Wulu said eagerly.
Yuan Ming took out the Golden Jade Token that Hou Yi's Sun-shooting Bow had left them and crushed it in his hand.
The next instant, a humming sound emanated from the sky.
A torrent of golden light poured down from mid-air like a waterfall, enveloping Yuan Ming and the other two, startling the surrounding demon beasts into a panicked flight.
Suddenly, a surge of Space Power expanded and contracted, and the gathered golden waterfall swiftly rolled back.
The figures of Yuan Ming and the others vanished from the spot.
...
Golden Sunflower Island, Fire Essence Palace.
A streak of golden light descended, revealing the figures of Yuan Ming and his companions.The most up-to-date version is on *.
A golden longbow, emanating waves of sunlight-like golden light, gracefully hovered before them.
It was none other than Hou Yi's Sun-shooting Bow.
"It has been many years, Senior. I hope you've been well," Yuan Ming said with a bow.
With his current level of Cultivation, he was able to address Hou Yi's Sun-shooting Bow as an equal, but since they needed the bow's power to travel to the Overseas World and considering its long existence and significant background far beyond his own, it was appropriate to show respect.
"You all have made significant progress in your Cultivation, good. Have you come this time to travel to the Overseas World?" Hou Yi's Sun-shooting Bow circled around them with a smile.
"We appreciate the help, Senior," said Yuan Ming with a bow.
"No bother, but your timing is impeccable," said Hou Yi's Sun-shooting Bow.
"What do you mean, Senior?" asked Yuan Ming in surprise.
"If you had come any later, I might have had to break my promise. An anomaly is about to occur in the Overseas World soon, and the Wind Sea will become tumultuous for several hundred years. By then, even if I wanted to send you there, it would be impossible," explained Hou Yi's Sun-shooting Bow.
Hearing this, the faces of Yuan Ming and the others slightly changed.
"Fortunately, there is still time. Wait here, and I'll start the preparations for the journey," Hou Yi's Sun-shooting Bow continued.
"Hold on, Senior. We know nothing about the Overseas World, please advise us," Yuan Ming quickly interjected.
No matter how pressing the time, it didn't hinge on that very moment.
"Tell me, what would you like to know?" Hou Yi's Sun-shooting Bow asked.
"What risks shall we face on our journey to the Overseas World?" Yuan Ming promptly asked.
"How much do you know about the Overseas World?" Hou Yi's Sun-shooting Bow inquired.
"I've read about some in the classics, that place is home to many unheard-of demon beasts, massive in size, along with various large-scale natural disasters..." Yuan Ming briefly shared what he knew.
"What you're describing is only the encounter upon first entering the Overseas World. The true dangers are ten times more terrifying than what you've depicted," Hou Yi's Sun Shooting Bow remarked.
"Please enlighten me, Senior," Yuan Ming's expression turned solemn.
"There are three major crises in the Overseas World, namely Whale Calamity, Wind Sea, and Demon Song. These three crises are respectively located in the three major zones of the outer sea, which are the unavoidable routes to the Overseas World. The Whale Calamity is in the first zone, where countless giant whales live, capable of swallowing the sky and the earth, with strength that is immense. Mature individuals are comparable in power to those at the Returning to Void Stage. If you're unlucky enough to encounter them, whether you fly to the sky, burrow into the earth, or conceal your tracks, you cannot escape and can only struggle for survival inside a whale's mouth," Hou Yi's Sun Shooting Bow explained.
Returning to Void Stage? The faces of the three, Yuan Ming, changed at once.
They've heard Hou Yi's Sun Shooting Bow continue to explain:
"If you're lucky enough to pass through this region and arrive at the Second Sea Zone, you'll enter the Wind Sea, where fierce winds that obscure the skies rage all year round. So powerful that not only people, even ordinary Spiritual Treasures can be destroyed."
"Is the turmoil you spoke of referring to this, Senior?" Wulu interjected.
"Humph, it's the Wind Sea indeed, but if it were an actual Wind Sea Storm, there'd be no point in going. Even a Returning to Void Cultivator would be courting death," Hou Yi's Sun Shooting Bow scoffed coldly.
Wulu chuckled dryly and said no more.
"The Demon Song in the third zone refers to a kind of evil creature that inhabits this sea area, adept at using their singing to entrance passing cultivators. Once one hears their bewitching songs, it is said that even a Spoken Witch Soul Cultivator cannot resist and will fall into an illusion, becoming a meal for these creatures," after Hou Yi's Sun Shooting Bow finished explaining this, he hung silently in front of the three, as if watching them.
After hearing all this, the expression of Yuan Ming and his companions became very grave.
"If we get past these three crises, can we reach the Overseas World?" Xi Ying asked.
"I do not know," said Hou Yi's Sun Shooting Bow.
"You don't know?" Yuan Ming furrowed his brows.
"These three dangers are recorded in the classics left by the Three Immortals. I've never been there before, so as to whether the Overseas World lies beyond these three perilous places, the classics don't say, and I don't know either," Hou Yi's Sun Shooting Bow said.
The expressions of Yuan Ming and the others stiffened.
"I have made the dangers of the Overseas World clear. It is up to you whether you go or not, there's still time to back out," Hou Yi's Sun Shooting Bow spoke.
Yuan Ming, Xi Ying, and Wulu exchanged glances and smiled slightly; none of them retreated.
"Good, such courage is worthy of traveling to the Overseas World," Hou Yi's Sun Shooting Bow laughed heartily.
"Senior, when do we set off?" Yuan Ming asked.
Hou Yi's Sun Shooting Bow was silent for a moment, then said, "It's not about sending you away. I, the Great Wilderness Star River Pearl, and Qiong Yun will also accompany you to the Overseas World."
Upon hearing this, surprise showed on the faces of Yuan Ming and the others.
"Qiong Yun? Is she here?" Yuan Ming feigned astonishment.
Of course, he knew that Qiong Yun was here all along; the Black Incense Possession Divine Power couldn't be revealed.
"Qiong Yun, bearing the bloodline of the Azure Sea's Blue Whale King, can make our breakthrough of the Whale Calamity much easier," Hou Yi's Sun Shooting Bow said.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming's brow furrowed slightly. He knew that Hou Yi's Sun Shooting Bow had sheltered Qiong Yun on the Three Immortals Island, but he did not know why, and now it seemed he had his answer.
"Senior, when you left Qiong Yun on the Three Immortals Island, could it be that you were preparing for this day? Did you always plan to go to the Overseas World?" Yuan Ming asked with a frown.
"That's right. When I left her here, it was to help her awaken the bloodline of the Azure Sea's Blue Whale King in preparation for traveling to the Overseas World. However, we only plan to overcome the Whale Calamity to take some items before returning," Hou Yi's Sun Shooting Bow did not hide the truth and openly admitted it.
"Senior is quite frank," Yuan Ming said with a light chuckle.
"Now, wait here a while; I will go and call someone, then we can set off together." Having said that, Hou Yi's Sun Shooting Bow did not continue the conversation and left the three behind, turning into a golden light and departing.
Shortly after, he returned with Qiong Yun and a girl in a silver dress.
The instant they saw them, the gazes of Yuan Ming and his companions were unavoidably drawn to the girl in the silver dress.
Especially Xi Ying and Yuan Ming, who, upon feeling the faint fluctuations coming from her body, both of their eyes changed subtly, and after exchanging a look, they confirmed that the girl in the silver dress was indeed the Artifact Spirit of the Great Wilderness Star River Pearl.
The Great Wilderness Star River Pearl had become the size of a fist, concealed within the body of the girl in the silver dress.
"Brother Yuan, it's been a long time. Oh! Your cultivation..." Qiong Yun called out joyfully and then, sensing the unfathomable mana emanating from Yuan Ming, her expression changed dramatically.
"Daoist Qiong Yun," Yuan Ming greeted her with a clasped fist.
"What about Long Chong? Didn't he come with you?" Qiong Yun quickly recovered her composure and inquired.
"We are here to head to the Overseas World. Brother Long is unaware and did not come with us," Yuan Ming replied.
Disappointment flickered in Qiong Yun's eyes upon hearing that.
"Rest assured, Daoist Qiong Yun. If it's fated, you will meet again. The bond between you and him is destined, and there's no way you could be separated," Yuan Ming smiled as he spoke.
"Tch, who has a destined relationship with him?" Qiong Yun spat out, slightly embarrassed.
"Alright, there's no time to delay; we must set out immediately," just as Qiong Yun was about to protest, Hou Yi's Sun Shooting Bow interrupted her.
With that, his gaze fell on the girl in the silver dress.

chapters.title: Chapter 782 - 753: Setting Sail
chapters.content:
The silver-clothed girl nodded slightly and spoke to Yuan Ming and the others, "Come stand by my side."
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming and the others hesitated briefly but still gathered beside her.
Immediately after, they saw the girl bring her hands together in front of her chest. A ring of silver light soon illuminated from her palms and rapidly expanded into a silver sphere about a zhang in diameter, enveloping them all.
In the next instant, a powerful force of space twisted the environment around them. Everyone felt as if they were being pulled in from all directions by an invisible force. Before they could react, they disappeared from their original location under a fierce flash of silver and white light.
Subsequently, within a strangely shaped pyramid building, a burst of silver light expanded, revealing the figures of Yuan Ming and the others.
Upon surveying his surroundings, Yuan Ming recognized the place as the True Sea Hall from the secret realm trial he had once experienced.
In the center of this grand hall, there was also a transmission array almost identical to the one in the Void Temple of Fusang Island.
"This ancient transmission array will take us to an island on the edge of the First Sea Zone. From there, we can enter the seas plagued by the Whale Calamity," declared Hou Yi's Sun Shooting Bow.
The group spoke no further and silently stepped onto the ancient transmission array.
The silver-clothed girl stood in the center of the array, raised her hands high, and murmured incantations as a burst of silver light emanated from her body, forming arcs of silver lightning that struck various parts of the array core.
The long-dormant array started to activate, emitting waves of light and a heavy "rumbling" sound as it slowly began to operate.
The dazzling light swallowed them all, elongating their silhouettes into streaks of afterimages before they vanished.
Thus, Yuan Ming and Xi Ying silently departed from Yunhuang Continent without causing any disturbance.
In the hundred years that followed, under the leadership of the Double Moon Alliance, the Yunhuang Continent's Cultivation World saw no major conflicts. The mortal nations were relatively peaceful, the populace lived and worked in contentment, and the population continued to grow.
In the Cultivation World, thanks to the coordination of the Double Moon Alliance, the resource management across the entire Yunhuang Continent was smooth. The abundance of resources led to a surge in low-level cultivators in the Qi Refinement Realm and Foundation Establishment Stage. There were even constant appearances of Core Formation Stage and Nascent Soul Stage cultivators, resulting in a thriving and prosperous scene everywhere.
Both the mortal realm and the Cultivation World unanimously decided to call this period the Double Moon Prosperity. The names of the Nether Moon God and the Xi Yue God were as glorious as the midday sun, celebrated by countless cultivators.
These, naturally, are stories for another time.
...
In Chuyun Realm, over a cluster of coral islands in the Dongji Sea.
The seawater was a brilliant blue, and the sky was clear. A series of brightly colored coral islands stretched out in continuous links, forming a vast circular string of islands spanning a hundred acres.
In the center of this crescent-shaped string of islands, near the watery edge of one of the islands, lay a large sea shark around thirty meters long.
It had grey-blue skin, a white underbelly, and a gaping mouth filled with interlocking teeth sharp as saw blades. Two long, sharp teeth jutted out about ten meters long, giving it a ferocious appearance.
However, its eyes were gray and lifeless, and a large bloody hole was visible on its forehead—it was dead beyond doubt.
"Master Sikong, is it dead? Is it dead?" At that moment, a black-haired girl in a light blue short skirt hopped briskly from a distant coral island.
Her skin was pale white, her cheeks plump with youthful naivety, making her look very sweet and adorable.
"Hey hey, Xinyao junior sister, slow down, be careful," called a tall young man dressed in a blue robe, full of concern as he followed her.
His skin was dark, and his eyebrows were slightly thick, giving him a very honest and steady appearance.
"Second Brother Lin, hurry up," the girl called back, but not to the thick-browed young man.
Behind him was another young man in a white robe, handsome with striking features, who cheerfully responded and quickly passed by, catching up to the fleeting figure.
The thick-browed young man's gaze slightly narrowed, and he quickly followed.
The few of them had just arrived when they saw a tall middle-aged man leaning on a black blade long sword almost as tall as himself, his expression intensely solemn.
Seeing his demeanor, the three young people immediately stifled their laughter, following the middle-aged man's gaze to the Sword-toothed Shark Beast.
Upon looking, the three of them gasped in unison, uttering a surprised "Huh."
They saw that from the opened belly of the Sword-toothed Shark Beast, a mass of intestines and a blurred mess of organs spilled out, and shockingly, a young man in a blue robe lay amongst them.
He was filthy all over, and his chest was still heaving—he was unmistakably Yuan Ming.
"Uncle Master Situ, how... how could there be a person?" the thick-browed young man asked first.
"Who knows, I felt something strange about this Sword-toothed Shark earlier. It seemed to be suffering from some internal affliction, not showing its usual ferocity. Now we see there was indeed a problem," said the sword-leaning middle-aged man, furrowing his brows.
His words had barely fallen when suddenly a cough echoed.
Yuan Ming on the ground, as though choked, started to cough violently and came to his senses.
Seeing him suddenly awaken, the four people nearby were startled and stepped back a bit, all assuming defensive stances.
The moment Yuan Ming awoke, he noticed their presence and quickly sat up, leaning against the corpse of the Sword-toothed Shark, wiped his face, and looked at them with a weary expression.
"Who are you?" he asked.
As he spoke, the fluctuations of his divine thought surged with his voice, subtly influencing the moods of these individuals.
Among these people, the middle-aged man had the highest cultivation, being a Nascent Soul Early Stage Cultivator, while the remaining three were Core Formation Cultivators.
"My name is Ye Xinyao, this is my master Sikong Zhan, and the other two are my senior brothers, Sikong Zhuo and Sikong Lin." The girl didn't know why, but she honestly revealed their names.
"And who might you be?" Nascent Soul Cultivator Sikong Zhan was the first to stabilize his mind and asked with a frown.
"I am a cultivator from overseas. I was attacked by a demon beast while crossing the sea and ended up stranded here. May I know where this place is?" Yuan Ming casually fabricated a story and continued to inquire.
Compared to the people here, the Yunhuang Continent would also be considered the Overseas World.
"This is the Dongji Sea, Crescent Bay," Sikong Zhan replied without probing further, hesitating slightly.
Yuan Ming furrowed his brows and pondered for a moment, realizing that even though he now knew the name of the place, he still had no idea where he was exactly, which caused him to smile wryly to himself.
He checked his own condition and found that his injuries were not serious, which allowed him to relax slightly.
Seeing that these people were quite wary of him, each showing signs of fear in their eyes, he decided not to ask any more questions.Alwаys rеаd frоm thе sоurсе: М|V|LЕ4МРYR.
"Thank you," he said, clasping his hands together, then prepared to stand up and leave.
The others, seeing this, cautiously stepped back a bit.
Yuan Ming smiled, showing he meant no harm, then took a step forward and plunged into the sea, washing off the dirt from his body while swiftly swimming away towards the distance.
Sikong Zhan and the others, seeing that he had no intention of seizing their prey, all let out a sigh of relief.
As they watched him swim away, Sikong Zhan spoke up:
