"Zhuo'er, Xiao Lin, move quickly, hurry and dismember this Sword-toothed Shark Beast. Extract the Demon Core and the Beast Eye, and also remove the spinal bones. Just save the part of the meat where the fat is thickest. With so much blood spilled, other demon beasts will be attracted soon."
"It's fine, I will scatter some Beast Repelling Powder," Ye Xinyao said with a smile.
Then, she expertly formed a Dharma Seal with both hands, and immediately a green light burst forth behind her, from which four leaf-like green wings sprouted, flapping quickly as she flew towards the sea above.
A green cloth bag hung at her waist; she tapped it, and a large amount of yellow-green powder spilled out, merging into the seawater and disappearing.
The girl worked hard, sprinkling a large circle, before flying back towards Coral Island.
Just then, an urgent shout suddenly came from Sikong Zhan:
"Miss Ye, be careful."
As soon as his words fell, a layer that looked like colorful glass emerged over the sea behind Ye Xinyao, which then burst like a bubble.
In the moment the colorful lights dissipated, a huge, black, worm-like demon beast with a terrifying aura appeared on the sea surface, opening its giant mouth and biting towards Ye Xinyao.
Inside its gaping maw, layers upon layers of circular sharp teeth numbering nineteen layers unfolded, densely packed in a manner that sent chills down one's spine.
Ye Xinyao caught a glimpse and felt a chill in her heart, completely panicking.
Then, a wave rose beside her, transforming into a giant whale shark about thirty feet long, which collided with the demon beast.
Blue waves exploded, splashing countless droplets of water, and bought her a sliver of survival.
"What are you still doing, run!" Sikong Zhan shouted loudly, raising his hands still forming seals.
In a panic, Ye Xinyao quickly flapped her winged back, speeding towards Coral Island.
The demon beast behind her paused only briefly before immediately resuming its chase, its huge body catching up to the girl in merely two or three breaths.
Just as the girl was about to perish in the jaws of the beast, a roar came from her side.
A muscular figure, radiating golden light, strode upon the waves, an illusion of a ten-zhang tall golden-armored figure materializing around him, colliding with the demon beast.
"Zhuo'er, come back..." Sikong Zhan watched his eldest son approaching death without fear, feeling both anxious and angry.
"Brother Zhuo..." In her panic, Ye Xinyao saw that figure and was also shocked.
Before her shock could wear off, another figure leaped high above the water next to her, scooped her up, and with an even faster Water Manipulation Technique, sped towards Sikong Zhan.
"Second Brother Lin," Ye Xinyao's eyes brimmed with tears.
With a "bang," a loud noise came from behind them.
A burst of golden light exploded, the illusion of the golden-armored god shattered upon contact, and Sikong Zhuo's body was thrown high into the air, blood-soaked, plummeting towards the distant sea surface.

chapters.title: Chapter 783 - 754: Abyss Dead Land
chapters.content:
"Damn, how could there be a Level 5 Yin Worm Beast here? Xiao Lin, take Miss Ye and keep running back, don't stop," Sikong Zhan instructed, then his figure swiftly darted out, charging towards the hideous demon beast.
The Yin Worm Beast, having been blocked twice already, was furious. Initially, it wanted to devour Sikong Zhuo first, but seeing Sikong Zhan attacking, it immediately turned and met him head-on.
Its huge demon body twisted and rushed across the surface of the sea with a speed akin to a swimming fish. As it opened its gaping mouth, a cluster of purple-black poison mist gathered in the depths of its throat, flashing with strands of electricity, gathering its strength with great effort.
Seeing this, how could Sikong Zhan not realize it was about to unleash its Innate Divine Ability? Yet at that moment, he could not dodge, and could only brace himself to meet it head-on.
He feared that if he dodged, the other three children would become the beast's new targets.
With a push of his left hand forward and muttering a few quick words, the bronze ring on his middle finger immediately shone brightly. A large amount of green light surged out and converged in front of him, forming a bronze giant shield with a beast head pattern, blocking in front of him.
"Roar..."
A wild beast's roar sounded.
From the gaping mouth of the Yin Worm Beast, a cluster of purple mist erupted like a nebula, entwined with white thunder, emitting a series of oppressive booming noises.
The thunder-laden purple mist roared past the sea surface, lifting two hundred-meter-high giant waves, crashing against the bronze giant shield.
"Bang" sounded loudly!
A lot of purple mist dispersed and filled the air, and although the bronze shield blocked this furious assault, a "hissing" noise came from the shield surface, emitting a large amount of white smoke, visibly corroding it at a speed visible to the naked eye.
"Crackle"
A white arc of electricity broke through the already corroded bronze giant shield and struck Sikong Zhan's shoulder.
He immediately felt a strange power seeping in. Just as he was about to use his Mana to resist, he heard a "bang," and blood splattered from his shoulder, as the white thunder exploded open a ghastly wound exposing the bone.
Sikong Zhan showed a pained expression, feeling a numbing sensation like an electric shock through his body, and then he frantically saw more white thunder tearing through the shield, slashing towards him.
The difference in strength was too great; there was hardly any chance left to survive.
Just as he was losing all hope, suddenly, a majestic yet slightly ethereal voice sounded from the void:
"Thunder, dissipate."
This voice, like an irresistible divine decree, caused the white thunder, which was already within reach, to incredibly "poof" and disappear, returning to nothingness.
The scene was as though the white thunder had never appeared.
Sikong Zhan looked at the magical and bizarre scene, his mind profoundly shaken, momentarily forgetting his situation as he searched for the source of the voice.
It was then that he suddenly saw a figure, standing atop the water waves, speeding towards him in a pose akin to sword flying, and carrying a person under his arm, who was none other than the unconscious Sikong Zhuo.
"It's him!"
Upon seeing Sikong Zhuo, Sikong Zhan's heart slightly relaxed, yet when he saw that the figure was Yuan Ming, whom he had recently cut out of a Sword-toothed Shark, his eyes widened.
"Catch." At that moment, Yuan Ming shouted abruptly.
He maneuvered the water waves, sharply turning back towards the Yin Worm Beast and hurled Sikong Zhuo out while charging at the beast.
With no time to ponder, Sikong Zhan quickly leaped up to catch his son, looking at Yuan Ming with complex eyes.
At this moment, Yuan Ming had already charged straight towards the Yin Worm Beast.
The beast seemed to sense the hostile aura of the newcomer, stopping its forward rush early, its body breathing in and out, lighting up with rings of purple patterns, its gaping mouth gushing with purple mist and thunder roaring intensely, emitting a strong wave from within.
Yuan Ming, fearless against such a charging attack from the Yin Worm Beast, did not intend to stop at all, circulating the Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill within his body, channeling the Qi Blood Power throughout his body.
In an instant, the Body of Wanxiang was activated, and a huge blood-colored giant elephant took shape swiftly outside his body, his aura dramatically increased.
Since advancing to the Returning Void Realm, although his Body of Wanxiang had not visibly changed, his Mana was much denser than before, and the Qi Blood Power was also replenished, making the circulation quicker.
The instant the blood-colored giant elephant took shape, the Yin Worm Beast's accumulated power also reached its peak, and it expelled a massive cluster of purple mist filled with crisscrossing lightning, smashing towards Yuan Ming.
The purple mist turned the seawater entirely dark purple where it passed, the potent poison quickly spreading in the water, while the white thunder that struck evaporated the splashed water vapor instantly, pressing a hundred-meter-deep water mark on the sea surface.
Yuan Ming rushed forward with the waves, the blood-colored giant elephant above his head also charging full force, crashing into the massive purple mist of lightning, and was immediately swallowed up and disappeared.
Watching this scene unfold before him, Sikong Zhan was completely stunned.
He had never seen such a brave and formidable person, able to withstand the full-force strike of a Level 5 demon beast's Innate Divine Ability.
But soon he realized he was shocked too soon.
A series of booming noises erupted in succession!
The cluster of purple mist and thunder exploded amidst the booming sounds, the mist dispersed, and the lightning faded away.
Above the sea, a blood rain began to fall, countless broken limbs and blood were thrown into the high sky and then fell back down, dyeing the entire Crescent Bay area a blood-red color, spreading a pungent bloody smell.
Sikong Zhan's eyes widened in horror as he saw the figure of the young man step out from the blood rain and the thin purple mist, holding a thoroughly dark purple Demon Core in one hand and a wildly struggling, twisting phantom in the palm of his other hand.
That phantom closely resembled the Yin Worm Beast but was many times smaller; it was indeed its Demon Soul.
Being able to slay that demon beast was already no small feat, let alone easily plucking its Demon Core and capturing its Demon Soul; it was truly incredible.
After all, the Yin Worm Beast was a cunning and ferocious demon beast that would usually choose to self-destruct its Demon Core and Demon Soul rather than face defeat, and it was rare for anyone to seize its Demon Core and Demon Soul.
Yet this young man seemed to have done it effortlessly, which unquestionably indicated that his Cultivation was superior to that of the Yin Worm Beast.
Yuan Ming casually stowed away the Yin Worm Beast's Demon Core and Demon Soul, then flew towards Sikong Zhan.
"Thank you, Elder, for your assistance. I have no way to repay the debt of saving my life," the latter swallowed, handing Sikong Zhuo who had just rushed back to Sikong Lin and Ye Xinyao, and directly knelt down to show his gratitude to Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming lifted his hand to emit a force, helping Sikong Zhan up, and said,
"Fellow Daoist Sikong, there's no need for such formalities. That beast was also drawn here sensing the trace of energy I left inside the Sword-toothed Shark, making you victims of an undeserved disaster."
Hearing him say this, Sikong Zhan's thoughts did not change. He still bowed and said, "Regardless, Elder, you saved our lives. I hope you will allow me to show a bit of the host's duty and invite you to Huayun Island for some modest compensation."
Sikong Lin and Ye Xinyao also looked towards Yuan Ming with both fear and anticipation in their eyes. Being able to get acquainted with such a powerful elder was a rare opportunity for them.
"Then I shall accept gratefully."
Yuan Ming thought about it, keeping in mind his unfamiliarity with the area, and didn't refuse.
"Elder, if you do not want those remnants of the Yin Worm Beast, may I..." Sikong Zhan hesitated to ask.
"Just take them," Yuan Ming replied.
Sikong Zhan was overjoyed, quickly excused himself, personally gathered the large amount of remains floating on the sea and also retrieved the Sword-toothed Shark's Demon Core, Beast Eye, and spine, before joyfully returning.
On the way back, Yuan Ming sat on Sikong Zhan's Sea Crossing Flying Boat, finally asking the questions he hadn't had the chance to ask earlier. Due to the previous life-saving aid, Sikong Zhan answered everything without reserve, even proactively providing a lot of information.
After an exchange, as Yuan Ming was quite easy-going, Sikong Zhan and others' nervousness somewhat relaxed, and the atmosphere on the flying boat became much more lively.
"Fellow Daoist Sikong, what is the situation with the Cultivation forces in this Dongji Sea?" Yuan Ming asked.
"Elder, the Dongji Sea spans a million miles with numerous islands, and the multitude of Cultivation forces are like hairs on an ox; however, all are governed by Dongji Palace and are considered vassal forces under its rule. Our Huayun Island is one of them," Sikong Zhan explained after a bit of thought.
After speaking, he frowned slightly as if he had something on his mind but hesitated to speak.
"Daoist brother, feel free to speak," Yuan Ming said with a smile upon seeing this.
"Elder, earlier you said you were a cultivator from Overseas, that wasn't true, was it?" Sikong Zhan hesitated to ask.
"Oh, what makes you say that?" Yuan Ming responded, his expression unchanged.Spot an error? Visit the original post on M&VLEMPY&R.
"To my knowledge, there isn't a passage to the Overseas World from this side of the Dongji Sea," Sikong Zhan explained.
Yuan Ming thought to himself with a chuckle, "You, a Nascent Soul cultivator, wouldn't know, there's nothing strange about that."
"But I indeed came from over there in the Dongji Sea," Yuan Ming pointed in a direction and said.
"Haha, if Elder doesn't want to tell, it's fine," Sikong Zhan laughed upon hearing this, not taking it seriously.
The young girl Ye Xinyao blinked her large eyes and interjected with a smile, "Elder, you're not good at lying; that deep part of the Dongji Sea is a dead land, it's impossible for anyone to come from there."
"Dead land? What do you mean by that?" Yuan Ming asked, intrigued.
"Elder truly doesn't know? We call it the Abyss, it is a place where even Returning Void Great Powers enter with a high chance of falling, full of immense dangers, no different from a land of death," Sikong Zhan said with a bit of surprise.
Yuan Ming thought for a moment, feeling that it was very likely he had indeed come from that Abyss.
However, these people's knowledge about the Abyss was limited, so Yuan Ming didn't ask more about it, instead, he inquired,
"I wonder how many Returning to Void Cultivators are there within this Dongji Sea Area?"

chapters.title: Chapter 784 - 755: Outer Sea Tempering
chapters.content:
"Returning to Void Stage Great Cultivators are as rare as phoenix feathers and unicorn horns wherever they may be in the Chuyun Realm. Elder, you may not realize this, but despite the vast oceans and numerous spirit islands governed by Dongji Palace, there are only a little over a hundred islands that can sustain Returning to Void Cultivators. This, in itself, limits the number of cultivators at this stage," Sikong Zhan said with a smile.
Only a little over a hundred?
Yuan Ming pondered for a moment before asking again, "If one wishes to occupy a spirit island, does one need to purchase it from Dongji Palace?"
"Does the elder wish to settle in Dongji Sea?" Sikong Zhan raised his eyebrows and asked.
"That's the plan," Yuan Ming nodded.
"Given your cultivation realm, they would certainly not refuse if you wanted to join Dongji Palace. Once you successfully join, they will allocate you a spirit island that matches your cultivation level. Thereafter, you only need to obey Dongji Palace's orders and complete the tasks they assign on time," Sikong Zhan thought for a moment and replied.
"Do I have to join Dongji Palace?" Yuan Ming frowned slightly.
"If the elder does not wish to join Dongji Palace and be constrained by others, there is still one way," Sikong Zhan promptly said upon seeing this.
"What way?" Yuan Ming asked.
"Submit one million spirit stones to Dongji Palace and obtain a Challenge Order. With it, you can challenge the master of any spirit island within the Dongji Sea. As long as you can defeat them, you can replace them and become the new owner of that island," Sikong Zhan explained.
"So, can one avoid being under Dongji Palace's jurisdiction with this method?" Yuan Ming pursued further.
"A successful island challenger will still nominally be under the jurisdiction of Dongji Palace. Mostly, one does not have to follow their commands, but correspondingly, if an enemy invades, Dongji Palace will not intervene, leaving one to handle it alone. Besides that, you must also pay a certain number of spirit stones to Dongji Palace annually as a fee for owning the island," Sikong Zhan explained.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming nodded thoughtfully. Both methods had their pros and cons, and there was no need to rush the decision.
Sikong Zhan was responsive all along the way, helping Yuan Ming to grasp the general situation of Dongji Sea.
As evening approached, the Sea Crossing Flying Boat finally landed, arriving at Huayun Island.
Seen from high above, Huayun Island resembled a plum blossom; its upper areas perennially shrouded in mist. The island was humid with abundant vegetation and richer in spiritual energy than Chang Chun Temple.
As the flying boat descended slowly, lights were already lit everywhere on the island, with smoke from cooking rising, linking with the mist to create a unique panoramic view.
Yuan Ming casually glanced around and noticed many ports built along the island's edge, with rows of fishing boats neatly aligned. Adults bustled about handling their catches, while children played merrily among them, creating a lively scene.
"This island is quite lively, and there are so many mortals?" Yuan Ming asked with a smile.
"Haha, not just on Huayun Island, but almost every island has a large population of mortals and low-level cultivators. Becoming a master of an island also involves the responsibility of protecting these mortals and low-level cultivators," Sikong Zhan chuckled and explained.
At Yuan Ming's request, everyone disembarked at the seaside dock and walked along the road leading into the island.
Sikong Zhan walked in front with Yuan Ming, while Sikong Zhuo, who had recovered a little after some rest along the journey, was supported by Sikong Lin as they followed behind.
Interested in Yuan Ming, Ye Xinyao left the Sikong brothers and moved closer to Sikong Zhan, listening to their conversation and occasionally chiming in.
Sikong Zhan, seeing that Yuan Ming did not object, tacitly permitted her.
As they continued toward the center of the island, they occasionally received greetings from mortals, which were not overly familiar but more akin to tenants respectfully acknowledging their landlord, without much fear.
It seemed that they had already grown accustomed to the presence of cultivators.
As they ventured further toward the center of the island, the structures became denser, distinct from those on the Yunhuang Continent. Most were built with bamboo and wood, evidently to prevent moisture and pests.
Near the Island Master Mansion, there were bustling commercial streets filled with various shops and taverns, where mortals and cultivators mingled without clear distinction.
Upon arriving at the Island Master Mansion with the group, Yuan Ming initially intended to pay his respects, but Sikong Zhan informed him that the island master was in seclusion, and he was temporarily handling affairs on the island. Therefore, he directly arranged a separate residence for Yuan Ming to temporarily stay.
At night, Yuan Ming stood by the window of his room, looking out at the lush greenery and the scattered lights on the island. He took out two pieces of Green Spirit Communication Talisman, whispered a few words to each, and then crushed them.
Then, he closed the window, set up an array in the room, and immediately sat down cross-legged to begin meditating and practicing Breathing Control.
After an hour, he slowly opened his eyes, realizing he had not received a response from the Green Spirit Communication Talisman. It seemed like both Xi Ying and Wulu were miles away from him.
After some deliberation, Yuan Ming took out the Stealing Heaven Tripod and inserted a piece of Black Incense into it.
He rubbed the incense head to light it and, after hesitating for a moment, chose to visualize Xi Ying's face in his mind.
Before long, his consciousness became blurred, his eyes clouded, and he soon plunged into darkness, losing all awareness.
He didn't know how much time had passed before his consciousness gradually returned, the bright light ahead of him restoring his vision to clarity.
He had possessed Xi Ying's body.
Now, both being Spoken Witches with little difference in their Divine Soul Power, Yuan Ming still opted to use the Black Incense he had developed on his own, which only allowed him to inhabit Xi Ying's body, not control her actions.
Using Xi Ying's line of sight, he looked around and found that Xi Ying was standing on the deck of an immensely large Sea Crossing Flying Boat.
The giant boat was enveloped in a rhombus-shaped crystalline light screen, reflecting colorful, flowing light, steadily sailing through the void.
At that moment, a tall and stately blue-haired young man approached Xi Ying and introduced himself very politely, wanting to make her acquaintance.
However, Xi Ying seemed to be in a bad mood and ignored him, turning around and heading back to the cabin.
Seeing that she was unharmed, Yuan Ming felt relieved.
After his Divine Soul returned, he tried to contact Wulu using the Void Communication Array, but there was no response.
Having no other choice, he then took out the Sky-reaching Demon Pillar and activated it with difficulty, finally opening the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space and entering it.
In the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space, Hua Zhi and Vajra had reverted to their original forms, lying on the ground, one on each side, with multiple injuries on their bodies, severely wounded and unconscious, their Divine Souls showing extreme weakness.
Seeing this, a hint of guilt appeared in Yuan Ming's eyes, and he began to recall the experiences from the recent past. Always read at the source—*.
They had traveled through the Transmission Array of the True Sea Hall to reach a deserted island in the First Sea Zone, and after exiting the dilapidated hall on the island, they began to navigate across the First Sea Zone using a Sea Crossing Flying Boat.
Just two days into their voyage, they inevitably encountered a Whale Calamity—hundreds of giant whales, each as large as a mountain, swam in groups, each flick of their tails capable of lifting waves a hundred feet high.
Each breath from the whales' blowholes could send up water columns several hundred feet high, the powerful forces contained within capable of directly destroying Magical Treasure Level Sea Crossing Flying Boats.
The situation was even more terrifying when they were feeding.
Their gaping maws could suck in tens of thousands of cubic meters of seawater, creating powerful vortices that could easily draw in even Nascent Soul cultivators if they were caught off guard.
This was only the case when encountering a solitary feeding whale; if they encountered a pod that saw them as intruders or prey, even Returning to Void Stage Cultivators would struggle to escape.
Yuan Ming and his companions managed to get through safely, all thanks to Qiong Yun's Azure Sea's Blue Whale King bloodline.
Using the bloodline's special traits, they avoided the pod's attacks and, with Qiong Yun performing a secret technique, they actually hid inside the belly of a giant whale, which carried them safely across the First Sea Zone without incident.
At the boundary between the First Sea Zone and the Second Sea Zone, the Silver-clothed Girl, transformed from Hou Yi's Sun-shooting Bow and the Great Wilderness Star River Pearl, together with Yuan Ming, dove into the seabed in a concealed trench, retrieved some Three Light Divine Water, and then returned with Qiong Yun.
Yuan Ming and the other two continued towards the Second Sea Zone using the Sea Crossing Flying Boat given by Hou Yi's Sun-shooting Bow.
Upon entering the Second Sea Zone, things were calm at first, allowing them to relax slightly and make adjustments.
But five days later, a storm suddenly erupted on the sea surface, with a thick swath of dark leaden clouds obscuring the sky and numerous robust tornadoes churning below, connecting heaven and earth like twisting dragons.
To be cautious, Yuan Ming opened the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space, taking Wulu, Xi Ying, Hua Zhi, and Vajra inside. He planned to confront the Wind Sea alone, relying on his Body of Wanxiang and Returning to Void Stage Cultivation.
But before this, Xi Ying first used an Illusion Technique to cause the other three to fall asleep, helping Yuan Ming to hide the secret of the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
Afterward, Yuan Ming alone, activating the Wind Stabilizing Pearl, plunged into the Wind Sea.
The storms in the Wind Sea were far more terrifying than he had imagined; the strong winds nearly had the force to tear space apart, and even with the protection of the Wind Stabilizing Pearl, Yuan Ming felt his skin being almost shredded by the hurricane.
He believed that if he were not already a Body of Wanxiang, even with the Wind Stabilizing Pearl, his physical body would have easily been torn to shreds by the storm.
Yuan Ming moved forward with difficulty, using the Wind Stabilizing Pearl, and when he couldn't endure any longer, he would open the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space, retreat inside for recovery, and continue his journey against the wind once his strength was restored.
Stopping and moving like this, he struggled through the Wind Sea, with several careless moments of exhaustion where he was swept away by fierce winds, losing his direction, and by the time he finally stepped out of the Wind Sea, ten years had passed.
Those ten years of arduous trials were even tougher than any of Yuan Ming's previous cultivation practices; by the final part of the journey, even the Wind Stabilizing Pearl could not withstand further use, and it was completely destroyed.
Yuan Ming managed to emerge from the Wind Sea solely relying on the more formidable physique he had honed over the ten years, immense perseverance, and a bit of luck.

chapters.title: Chapter 785 - 756 Dongji Palace
chapters.content:
After leaving the Wind Sea, Yuan Ming did not continue on but found a small island with a circumference of only about seventy to eighty meters in a relatively calm area nearby.
He summoned all his companions on the island and took a good rest for half a month. Once their condition had been largely adjusted, he embarked on his journey again.
Given the difficult experiences before, and facing the potentially more dangerous situations ahead, Yuan Ming, as before, took the other people back into the Stealing Heaven Tripod and crossed the sea alone.
By the time he reached the Third Sea Zone, although Yuan Ming had made plenty of preparations and remained on guard all the time, he was still nearly tricked by his first encounter with that legendary evil.
Those whom he originally thought would be fierce and ugly turned out to be large creatures with a human upper body and a fish tail.
Each was beautifully fair-skinned with blond hair and blue eyes. They sometimes rested on the islands and at other times jumped into the sea, frolicking and splashing around. Especially when they were in the water and their lower halves were submerged, they looked indistinguishable from breathtakingly beautiful women, their bodies exuding an indescribable enchanting power.
Yuan Ming naturally had heard of these creatures' sinister nature and dared not provoke them easily.
When he planned to conceal his presence and stealthily bypass these mermaids, a slightly smaller one with golden scales spotted him.
The moment it spoke, a celestial-like singing voice filled the air, not ringing around his ears but resounding directly in his Sea of Consciousness, rendering sealing his ears useless.
Even though Yuan Ming had advanced to being a Spoken Witch, the moment the voice sounded, a blur crossed his view, and enchanting illusions appeared.
However, being a Spoken Witch and having prepared beforehand, he soon woke from the trance, relying on his incredibly powerful Divine Power.
Note: Check * for any corrections.
Before more mermaids could start singing, he decisively opened the space of the Stealing Heaven Tripod and hid inside.
He then utilized the Undying Tree's ability to teleport through voids, releasing its roots to wrap around a demon fish in the sea, thus controlling it to carry him away from the nearby area.
This method initially worked well, but when he had nearly halfway passed through the Third Sea Zone and again took refuge in the Stealing Heaven Tripod space, controlling a Six-winged Seahorse to carry the tripod on its way, an accident occurred.
The Six-winged Seahorse ventured into a hunting ground of an immensely huge Golden Dragon Demon, resulting in the seahorse, along with the Stealing Heaven Tripod and Yuan Ming and others inside, all being swallowed by the Golden Dragon Demon.
Yuan Ming and Xi Ying took a risk by leaving the space of the Stealing Heaven Tripod and entering the stomach of the Golden Dragon Demon, only to find that it was a demon with strength surpassing the Returning to Void Stage and did not dare to make any rash moves.
However, after two days, Yuan Ming and Xi Ying sensed something wrong with the Golden Dragon Demon, discovering it seemed to be fighting someone fiercely, its Qi-Blood surging strongly within.
Being inside the Golden Dragon Demon, they also felt intense tremors.
Yuan Ming and Xi Ying discussed and decided to take this opportunity to escape.
So, they also summoned Wulu, Vajra, and Hua Zhi. All of them took advantage of the intense battle, attacking the Golden Dragon Demon from inside simultaneously.
Shortly after, they were all expelled by the Dragon Demon in one breath.
Unexpectedly, the one the Golden Dragon Demon was fighting was precisely a gigantic mermaid with golden scales. Just as Yuan Ming and the others were ejected, they heard its singing and immediately fell into an illusion.
Yuan Ming exerted all his strength to barely resist the singing. Just as he was about to look for the others, he was swept up by the aftermath of the two demons' fight and heavily injured, crashing into the sea.
Just when he thought he was undoubtedly going to die, the Artifact Spirit of the Stealing Heaven Tripod suddenly transmitted a message in his Sea of Consciousness. It mentioned that considering his respectful attitude over the years, it would help him and the others be saved if Yuan Ming could provide two hundred Vow Power Pills within the next hundred years.
Yuan Ming, not daring to hesitate, immediately agreed to the deal.
Afterward, he could no longer hold on and lost consciousness, falling into a coma. When he woke up again, he had been extracted from the stomach of a Sword-toothed Shark Beast by Sikong Zhan and others.
Looking at Vajra and Hua Zhi on the ground, Yuan Ming called out to the void, "Artifact Spirit senior, are you still there?"
After a long wait, a faint voice finally responded, "What is it?"
"May I ask the senior, what exactly happened after I fell unconscious? Why did Xi Ying and Wulu get separated from me?" Seeing that the Artifact Spirit was willing to show itself, Yuan Ming quickly asked in excitement.
"I don't remember," the Artifact Spirit responded without any emotion.
"You don't remember? Please don't joke with me, senior," Yuan Ming said helplessly.
"I only promised to save you all, but I didn't guarantee you wouldn't get scattered. Under such circumstances, it was already good enough that you survived. What more do you want?" the Artifact Spirit replied irritably.
Hearing this, Yuan Ming could only stop asking further and instead said, "Then, senior, why do you need so many Vow Power Pills?"
"You don't need to worry about that. As long as you fulfill our agreement on time and provide me with two hundred Vow Power Pills within a hundred years, I can make an exception and help you one more time no matter the issue," the voice of the Artifact Spirit came through.
Yuan Ming listened and felt a warmth in his heart.
This Artifact Spirit senior, who had saved them from the hands of the Golden Dragon Demon and the Mermaid Demon, clearly possessed extraordinary Divine Skills. His statement that "anything is possible" was mostly likely not an exaggeration.
However, when Yuan Ming sensed the concentration of Desire Power within the Stealing Heaven Tripod, he couldn't help but give a bitter smile and shake his head.
Perhaps due to the great distance, the Desire Power from Yunhuang Continent was still coming through but at a pitifully small amount, only about ten percent of what it originally had been.
At this rate, they could at most produce ten Vow Power Pills within a hundred years, which was far from enough to repay what he owed the Artifact Spirit, let alone expect the Artifact Spirit to fulfill his promise.
After sighing, Yuan Ming sent Hua Zhi and Vajra out from the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space, took out two Vow Power Pills, and had them each consume one.
In just moments, their Divine Souls stabilized, and after several two hours, they gradually woke up.
Before they could ask Yuan Ming what had happened, they felt the Divine Soul Power in their Sea of Consciousness rapidly increasing, and immediately closed their eyes and sat cross-legged, meditating to merge with this power.
Two more two hours later, Vajra woke up first. Looking at Hua Zhi beside him, who was still in Breathing Control, confusion flickered in his eyes.
Just as he was about to ask, he saw Hua Zhi's eyes suddenly open, a strange brilliance shining in them, her whole body surged with demonic power, and there was even a sign of a Breakthrough.
"Master, may I have a drop of Three Light Divine Water? I feel an opportunity for a breakthrough," Hua Zhi said excitedly.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming immediately took out a White Jade Porcelain Bottle, pulled out the stopper, and with a flick of his hand, a crystal-clear water droplet full of spirit light flew out and drifted toward Hua Zhi.
Without hesitation, Hua Zhi raised a slender finger, hooked the droplet, and swallowed it.
Immediately, a blue spirit light entwined around her body, bright red flowers burst forth one by one, and her entire being seemed to rejuvenate like a withering wood meeting spring.
Yuan Ming, seeing this, waved his hand and put her into a Spiritual Beast Bag for her to purify her demonic body and go through her breakthrough in seclusion.
Vajra, upon seeing this, gloomily sat on one side, somewhat annoyed.
He was not jealous of Hua Zhi catching the opportunity for a Breakthrough but was annoyed that despite also receiving a Vow Power Pill, he had not managed to break through.
"Hua Zhi has been stuck at this bottleneck for a long time. It's only natural for her to encounter this Breakthrough opportunity now. I believe you will soon have your turn," Yuan Ming said, patting Vajra on the shoulder to comfort him.
Vajra's face showed joy and he felt greatly relieved.
Upon his arrival at the Dongji Sea, Yuan Ming had been separated from his companions in unforeseen circumstances. Of the three of them, he was perhaps the only one who had a chance of finding the others.
Hence, Yuan Ming did not stay on Huayun Island any longer. The next day, he asked Sikong Zhan to send him off.
Seeing that he could not be dissuaded, Sikong Zhan had no choice but to comply with Yuan Ming's request and took him to the largest nearby trading island.
This place had more shops, a larger scale, and a broader range of operations. The island was a gathering place for Demon Hunting Cultivators from various places, who brought the Demon Beast Spiritual Materials they caught from all over the Dongji Sea to sell here.
Sikong Zhan took Yuan Ming to a familiar shop named "Sea Treasure Pavilion."
He sold the Demon Core, spine, and eyeballs of a Sword-toothed Shark Beast he had previously caught, earning a total of seventy thousand Spirit Stones, and then sold the Yin Worm Beast Blood and Flesh he had collected for one hundred thousand Spirit Stones.
He offered to split the earned Spirit Stones with Yuan Ming, but the latter did not accept.
Yuan Ming had previously acquired assets from the Wuyue Sect and Chang Chun Temple, and with what Xi Ying had accumulated over the years, he was not in much need of Spirit Stones, so he only asked Sikong Zhan to help him buy a more detailed sea map of the Dongji Sea and some Classics about Dongji Palace.
Sikong Zhan was overjoyed and happily took care of everything for Yuan Ming, and afterward, the two parted ways.
The former returned to Huayun Island, and the latter spent some time touring the island to learn about the situation and, following the guidance of the sea map, boarded Lei Yu to head for Dongji Palace.
On the way to Dongji Palace, Yuan Ming rode on Lei Yu's back, browsing through the information about Dongji Palace, and started to gain a general understanding of this Immortal Sect that rules over a million li of sea area.
The Dongji Palace Sect was located on the Dongji Islands, which consists of a Main Island and six surrounding Deputy Islands. It was the largest group of islands in the entire Dongji Sea and also the place with the most abundant Spiritual Energy.
In the Dongji Sea, its status was equivalent to what Chang Chun Temple once was in the Central Plains or even closer to the current status of the Double Moon Alliance in Yunhuang Continent, perhaps even with stronger control.
The Dongji Palace itself had many cultivators and experts like clouds, capable of dominating a sea region with sheer power.

chapters.title: Chapter 786 - 757: Challenge
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming had been traveling for half a day before he finally arrived at the Eastern Extreme Island Group.
From a distance, he saw a massive, multicolored light shield covering a vast array of islands scattered like stars across the sky. Among them, seven islands were particularly massive, each topped with a pillar of light reaching into the heavens, supporting the entire shield.
With Yuan Ming's current expertise in rune formations, he recognized at a glance that this was a highly advanced Island Protection Array. The seven islands served as the foundation, mutually supporting each other and delivering remarkable stability, far surpassing the Sect Protection Array of Chang Chun Temple in quality.
As he approached from afar, he had not yet reached the islands when a patrol in a Flying Boat intercepted him.
Upon learning that he was a visitor Cultivator, the guard did not pursue his abrupt approach. Instead, he informed Yuan Ming that unauthorized flying over the airspace of the Eastern Extreme Islands was prohibited and directed him to a Deputy Island on the east side to process his entry documentation.
Shortly thereafter, one of the guards split from the group and led Yuan Ming down to the outside of the eastern Deputy Island.
There, a long embankment had been constructed for Cultivators to land their Flying Boats, and it was bustling with many Cultivators coming and going.
"See that domed hall there? Register your identity and obtain a Passage Order there, and then you can enter the island," the guiding guard pointed out the direction before heading back to his patrol group.
Following the direction pointed out by the guard, Yuan Ming quickly arrived at the round hall, only to see that a long line of Cultivators waiting to handle their Passage Orders had already formed at the entrance.
He also took his place at the end of the line.
Fortunately, the efficiency inside the hall was extremely high. In less than the time it took to drink a cup of tea, Yuan Ming had entered the hall.
The hall had five service counters operating simultaneously, and Yuan Ming randomly chose one and walked over to sit down.
An elderly man with graying hair behind the counter glanced at Yuan Ming and asked, "First time handling this, or renewing your Passage Order?"
"First time," Yuan Ming replied.
"Name, and the purpose of your visit to Eastern Extreme Island?" the elder asked as he began to write swiftly without raising his head, treating it as routine procedure.
"Yuan Ming, I wish to purchase a spirit island," Yuan Ming stated.
"Oh, you wish to join the Dongji Palace. What is your Cultivation level?" the elder's eyes sparkled upon hearing this, and he looked at Yuan Ming with renewed interest, smiling as he asked.
Part of their job here, aside from handling Passage Orders for those entering and exiting the Eastern Extreme Islands, included recruiting talents for the Dongji Palace. Once they recruited a promising candidate, they also received additional rewards.
"I do not wish to join Dongji Palace; I want to buy a Challenge Order," Yuan Ming said with a smile.
"You can purchase the Challenge Order after you land on the island at Liuyun Palace. Now, please submit one thousand Spirit Stones to process your Passage Order," the elder said, his expression cooling slightly upon hearing this.
Indeed, in his view, Yuan Ming seemed rather oblivious to favorable circumstances.
Yuan Ming paid no heed, taking out one thousand Spirit Stones and handing them to the elder.
After receiving the stones, the elder took out a black stone Token and began activating the runes on it, explaining:
"The Passage Order is valid for one hundred years. When the time is up, you need to renew it with Spirit Stones to keep using it. Now, channel a streak of your Mana into this Token, and it will become your personal passage credential."
With that, he passed the Token to Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming pressed his finger on the Token, sending a streak of Mana into it. The runes on the Token flashed brightly and then disappeared, with Yuan Ming's name subsequently appearing on its surface.
"All set. With the Passage Order, you can go through that Light Gate over there and enter this Deputy Island. The island has passages to the Main Island, and from there, you can also access other Deputy Islands," the elder pointed towards a Light Gate behind him and added.
"Thank you," Yuan Ming thanked him and walked towards the Light Gate.
As he passed through the Light Gate, he distinctly felt a unique force scanning over him, seemingly probing him.
However, Yuan Ming had long suppressed his Divine Soul fluctuation and Mana fluctuation using unique techniques available to Spoken Witches, maintaining only the appearance of a Nascent Soul Middle Stage Cultivator.
This Cultivation level wasn't top-tier on Eastern Extreme Island, but it was significant enough to prevent being underestimated or attracting unnecessary trouble, which was just right for Yuan Ming.
After getting onto the island, Yuan Ming instinctively looked up at the sky, only to find it clear and blue, with the multicolored light shield nowhere to be seen.
As he walked amid the noisy crowd towards the interior of the island, what he saw were rows of spacious, smooth streets and series upon series of bustling shops. While the architectural style was somewhat different, the liveliness exceeded that of the Da Jin Capital.
The difference here was that the proportion of those practicing Cultivation was much higher.
Yuan Ming was not in a hurry to find Liuyun Palace. Instead, he strolled around the island, getting familiar with the environment. He found that, apart from somewhat higher prices, it was not much different from the Yunhuang Continent.
By midday, Yuan Ming had finally found Liuyun Palace.
It was a magnificent palace standing at the highest point of the Deputy Island. In the center of the palace sat a sea map with a diameter of ten zhang, scattered with models of tiny islands like stars in the sky.
Yuan Ming entered and his gaze was immediately captivated by the exquisite and lifelike sand table depicting the distribution of the islands.
He had actually memorized this sea map completely, but when he compared it with the sand table, he discovered several discrepancies, realizing that the sand table was far more accurate and comprehensive.
As Yuan Ming was examining it closely, a figure suddenly approached him. It was a short and stout middle-aged man wearing a cyan-purple robe, which seemed to be the exclusive attire of the cultivators from Dongji Palace.
"Greetings, Fellow Daoist. Are you here to join our Dongji Palace today?" the stout middle-aged man asked with a smile.
"I have no such plans at the moment. I am here to purchase a Challenge Order," Yuan Ming said, clasping his fists to declare his intention.
"So, you intend to challenge for control of a spirit island. Do you understand the rules?" the stout middle-aged man asked, his smile fading slightly as he nodded, apparently not too surprised.
"To submit one million Spirit Stones, correct? I have prepared them," Yuan Ming said, patting the Storage Bag at his waist.
"Very good. However, before you purchase the Challenge Order, there are some things I need to clarify with you," the stout middle-aged man said.
"Please enlighten me," Yuan Ming responded, clasping his fists.
"The island challenge is an unrestricted challenge until one party concedes. During the challenge, elders from our Dongji Palace will supervise to ensure fair play without third-party interference. Both parties may fight fiercely without giving up; the responsibility for life and death is their own. However, once one side concedes, the other must not kill, or else they will be hunted by Dongji Palace," the stout man explained slowly.
"Understood," Yuan Ming nodded.
"Since you have decided to challenge, please choose the Island Master you wish to challenge," the stout man said, pointing at the sand table.
Yuan Ming glanced at it and said, "I want to challenge the Island Master of Spiritual Ape Island."
This choice was not made at random, but was planned on the way here.
The Spiritual Power on Spiritual Ape Island was not the best among the islands; rather, its spirit veins were quite ordinary. However, the island's size was significantly larger than Huayun Island, more than three times larger.
The number of cultivators and common folk on the island was also among the highest of all the islands.
This might not be an advantage to others, but it suited Yuan Ming's needs perfectly.
He had just arrived in the Chuyun Realm and urgently needed to develop new believers to help him gather Desire Power, otherwise he could not possibly achieve the goal of gathering two hundred Vow Power Pills within a hundred years.
"Spiritual Ape Island, Island Master Silver Dragon Taoist, control held for fifty-six years, eligible for challenge," the stout man said, flipping through a blue booklet, nodding after a moment.This is pаrt оf а sеriеs frоm Мy Virtuаl Librаry Еmpirе (М|V|L1ЕМРYR).
Yuan Ming was pleased to hear this.
"Come on, give me the Passage Order now, and hand over the Spirit Stones in full so I can register you," the stout man said, leading Yuan Ming to a desk.
Yuan Ming took out the Passage Order and removed his Storage Bag from his waist, placing it on the table.
"When do you plan to start the challenge?" the stout man asked after counting the Spirit Stones and handing Yuan Ming a black wooden Token.
"Right now," Yuan Ming thought for a moment before responding.
"Now? Please wait here for a moment. I will go find the certifying elder to see if he is available," the stout man said, slightly surprised.
"Your efforts are appreciated," Yuan Ming said, clasping his fists.
The stout man secured the Spirit Stones and left, returning shortly with a tall, white-haired, elderly man.
"Elder Mo, this is Fellow Daoist Yuan Ming. He intends to challenge the Island Master Silver Dragon Taoist of Spiritual Ape Island," the stout man said.
The tall elder examined Yuan Ming from head to toe, nodded, and his expression remained serious without any significant change of emotion.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, this is Elder Mo Sanqi from our Dongji Palace, responsible for witnessing your island challenge," the stout man promptly introduced.
"Thank you for your trouble, Elder," Yuan Ming said, clasping his fists.
Seeing his sincere attitude, Elder Mo's expression softened a bit and he said, "Today I happen to be free. Since you have already made your decision, let's not delay any further. We'll set off now and you should have a result before nightfall."
With that, he led Yuan Ming out of Liuyun Palace and onto the long embankment outside the island.
Then, without further explanation, he piloted the Flying Boat, taking Yuan Ming directly towards Spiritual Ape Island.
Spiritual Ape Island was closer to the Eastern Extreme Island Group than Huayun Island. The Flying Boat piloted by Elder Mo was exceptionally fast, and soon, they arrived at a huge island resembling the head of an ape.
"Silver Dragon Taoist, come out of the island at once," Elder Mo Sanqi commanded from high in the sky, his voice booming across the island like a great bell.
Yuan Ming could sense the Mana and Divine Soul Power hidden within that voice, furrowing his brows as he felt slightly shaken, realizing that Elder Mo Sanqi was indeed a Returning to Void Stage Cultivator.

chapters.title: Chapter 787 - 758: One Punch Determines the Universe
chapters.content:
On Spiritual Ape Island, within a cool pavilion.
A middle-aged Taoist with black hair and a white beard, alongside a beautifully dressed woman in palace attire, were sitting next to a stone table savouring Spirit Fruits and sipping Spiritual Tea while chatting merrily.
Suddenly, a rolling voice came, causing both of their expressions to subtly change as they stood up.
"Silver Dragon Daoist, what is this..." the colorfully dressed woman, slightly furrowing her brows, looked towards the middle-aged Taoist.
"Fairy Yun Luo, don't worry, it's an elder from Dongji Palace. I'll go and take a look," the middle-aged Taoist quickly composed himself and said.
"I will come and see too," declared the colorful dressed woman, known as Fairy Yun Luo, immediately.
Silver Dragon Taoist nodded and was the first to move, soaring swiftly, easily bypassing the island's protective Array, and flew out to the island's exterior.
Fairy Yun Luo followed closely behind, also flying out with incredible lightness.
"We've seen Elder Mo." Once they recognized the visitor, neither paid much attention to Yuan Ming and greeted Elder Mo Sanqi with a bow and a fist clench.
"Elder Mo, what kind of wind has blown you my way? Come, come, please step onto the island for a while; we have Spirit Tea and Immortal Fruit ready over there," Silver Dragon Taoist invited warmly with a smile, his eyes, slightly triangular, flicking carelessly over Yuan Ming.
"Silver Dragon Daoist, let's skip the tea. I'm here on official business. This Fellow Daoist Yuan Ming just purchased a Challenge Order at Liuyun Palace and intends to challenge you for the island," Elder Mo Sanqi smiled slightly and spoke bluntly.
Upon hearing this, Silver Dragon Taoist's eyes twitched slightly, and his gaze then turned to Yuan Ming, scrutinizing him closely.
However, he soon made his judgement, at most a mid-stage Nascent Soul, nothing to fear.
"Ha ha, I've waited decades, and finally, someone is interested in my Spiritual Ape Island," Silver Dragon Taoist laughed heartily as if he wasn't facing a challenge but celebrating a great joy.
Having said that, he went forward, extended his hand, and grasped Yuan Ming's palm, looking as if he had met a long-lost friend.
"I have been impolite. I hope you won't take offense, Silver Dragon Daoist," Yuan Ming, though slightly mystified, responded politely.
"Where are you speaking from? Fellow Daoist Yuan, right? You're just following the rules, nothing wrong there. I only hope you can hold back a bit during our bout, and not strike too hard," Silver Dragon Taoist said with a smile.
"It's rare to see Silver Dragon Daoist take action; this trip wasn't in vain," Fairy Yun Luo observed and laughed as well.
"Well, as they say, no fight, no acquaintance. I hope both of you, no matter who wins or loses, can still sit down for a cup of tea afterward," Elder Mo Sanqi waved his hand and spoke.
"Well said, well said," Silver Dragon Daoist's face was full of smiles.
Yuan Ming did not speak, simply nodding silently.
"Shall we get started then?" Silver Dragon Daoist looked at Yuan Ming and said.
Yuan Ming nodded, then immediately positioned himself for the confrontation.
Love this story? Show support at *.
"We can't fight here; if it affects the island, that would be bad. Let's go to the sea," Silver Dragon Taoist said.
"Fine," Yuan Ming said indifferently.
Silver Dragon Daoist merely grinned, a hint of scheming flashing in his eyes.
Thus, the group of four quickly arrived at an open sea area with no islands nearby, and formally began their duel.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, I'm skilled in poisoning, you should be careful," Silver Dragon Daoist warned as he took the initiative.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming arched an eyebrow but did not say anything that might reveal his strength.
Silver Dragon Daoist saluted from a distance, his hand reaching into the void. Light gathered in his palm, soon revealing a dark green spear wrapped with a silver flood dragon.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, be careful."
With a low shout, his figure suddenly turned into a dark green mist, vanishing instantly.
The next instant, he silently appeared right in front of Yuan Ming. His spear spun at high speed, thrusting directly at Yuan Ming's throat like a drill.
Yuan Ming furrowed his brow and, in the instant of his approach, his figure abruptly flashed, skillfully evading and instantly thrusting a fist toward the ribs of Silver Dragon Taoist in a deceptively gentle yet fast blow.
Silver Dragon Daoist could not avoid it and was struck squarely by Yuan Ming's punch.
With a loud "bang," the moment Silver Dragon Taoist was struck by Yuan Ming, he deflated like a punctured ball, his form swiftly shrinking as a large amount of dark green gas escaped his body, instantly submerging the surrounding area in a cloud of mist.
Elder Mo Sanqi and Fairy Yun Luo, originally more than a hundred yards away from where Yuan Ming stood, saw this and swiftly moved back, pulling away as far as possible, evidently aware of the potency of the dark green gas.
At that moment, outside the dark green gas, another silhouette of Silver Dragon Taoist appeared.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, this poison mist isn't so easy to contend with. If you can't handle it, it might be better to concede early," Silver Dragon Daoist, holding the Ink Dragon Spear, called out with a smile.
"I think, it's still manageable," Yuan Ming's voice came from within the dark green poison mist, calm and steady.
Immediately, he stepped on the void, walked calmly out of the poison mist, fanning his hand a few times in front of his nose and mouth to disperse the mist a little. There was not a hint of anomaly in his whole body, as if the poison mist was just ordinary smoke.
Seeing this, Silver Dragon Taoist's expression slightly tightened, evidently a bit taken aback.
Yun Luo Fairy's eyebrows raised slightly, and her gaze toward Yuan Ming grew more interested.
Mo Sanqi, on the other hand, nodded almost imperceptibly, seemingly pleased that his judgment had been validated, realizing that the cultivator named Yuan Ming was not as simple as he appeared.
"Silver Dragon Daoist, your methods are somewhat too showy," Yuan Ming said, lifting his hands as he spoke.
As the sleeves slid down, his palms and a section of his arms were revealed, where there were dark marks slowly fading, evidently signs of poisoning.
Just now, Silver Dragon Taoist had seemed warmly to shake his hand as if greeting him, but in reality, he had stealthily smeared some kind of plant sap on his hand.
This sap itself was not poisonous and was even colorless and odorless, hardly noticeable, but when it came into contact with the dark green poisonous gas, it reacted violently.
If it hadn't been for Yuan Ming's powerful body comparable to a high-level magical treasure due to his Body of Wanxiang, his arms would have been reduced to mere bones by now.
"Heh, I really didn't expect, Fellow Daoist Yuan, that you are a high-level Body Cultivator," seeing that his trick had failed, Silver Dragon Taoist's lips twitched, and he forced a smile.
Yuan Ming, however, could not be bothered to speak with him any longer.
He stepped forward, quickly activating the Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill. A layer of red steam emanated around him, his aura skyrocketing, giving the illusion of confronting a primeval Fierce Beast.
Silver Dragon Taoist's eyes sharpened, a hint of wariness flashing in them.
He then raised his hand and threw something into the air. The ink dragon spear he was holding flew high up, then flipped and dived into the sea.
Immediately, a fierce wind and enormous waves rose on the water's surface while deep, dragon-like roars echoed from beneath it.
Looking down, Yuan Ming saw the shadow of a massive flood dragon swirling in the waters below, stirring giant whirlpools on the surface.
"Rise!" Silver Dragon Taoist's robe billowed as his hair and beard fluttered. He bellowed a command and lifted both hands.
"Ao..."
Accompanied by a loud dragon roar, a massive, dark green flood dragon burst out from the seabed, its jaws wide open, clawing and trying to swallow Yuan Ming.
Its head bore a silver horn, and its body was covered with armour thick like metal, body bristling with a massive water vapor, the aura it emitted was even more formidable than its master, Silver Dragon Taoist.
Seeing the ink dragon charging fiercely, Yuan Ming remained unafraid. He stepped forward into the void, raising his fist and smashing it toward the ink dragon.
The front end of his fist condensed red steam into a tremendous elephant head.
"Boom" was the sound of a massive explosion!
The elephant head enveloped fist smashed heavily onto the silver horn on the ink dragon's forehead.
Under everyone's astonished gaze, the ink dragon could not withstand even for a moment, and it began to collapse from the silver horn and head, breaking into fragments of scales that exploded outward.
The subsequent force of the punch vaporized the massive amount of water vapor, sending up a great cloud of mist.
With his lifebound magical treasure destroyed with a single punch, Silver Dragon Taoist felt as if a thunder had exploded in his chest. He spat out a mouthful of fresh blood and fell toward the sea like a kite with its string cut.
Mo Sanqi, quick to react, waved his hand to invoke a whirlwind that carried him back.
Taking advantage of his consciousness, Mo Sanqi asked, "Silver Dragon Daoist, are you able to continue the fight?"
The question was tactful; truthfully, it was asking if he conceded.
Silver Dragon Taoist looked shocked, even somewhat dazed, unable to believe that his treasured magical treasure nurtured over many years could be smashed by a single punch.
While he was still in a daze, suddenly Yun Luo Fairy shouted, "Silver Dragon Daoist, do you concede?"
Silver Dragon Taoist snapped back to reality, only then fearfully seeing Yuan Ming approaching with huge steps across the void, his aura not only unabated but even more vehement, even carrying a palpable killing intent.
Without doubt, if another punch came his way, it would be his own body that exploded.
"I... concede, I concede," Silver Dragon Daoist called out in a panic.
As he spoke, Yuan Ming was already less than thirty feet away; he could clearly see a hint of regret passing through Yuan Ming's eyes.
Silver Dragon Taoist felt a chill up his spine and shivered involuntarily.
Mo Sanqi also breathed a sigh of relief, fearful Yuan Ming might 'accidentally' strike a lethal blow to Silver Dragon Taoist.
Such an incident had indeed occurred in previous years.
"I announce that Fellow Daoist Yuan has successfully challenged and become the new Island Master of Spiritual Ape Island," Mo Sanqi rushed forward to declare.
Yuan Ming's previously overwhelming momentum faded away, and he reined all his aura back in, returning to his previous demeanor as he bowed to Mo Sanqi.
By then, Silver Dragon Taoist had also forced himself to fly over despite his injuries.
Yet, at this moment, he had completely lost his initial composure, his gaze toward Yuan Ming now tinged with evasion.

chapters.title: Chapter 788 - 759: Change of Ownership
chapters.content:
"Silver Dragon Daoist, give me your Passage Order," Mo Sanqi said, giving Yuan Ming a deep look before turning to speak to the Silver Dragon Taoist.
The Silver Dragon Taoist, without uttering a word, took out his Token from his waist and handed it over.
After receiving it, Mo Sanqi then asked Yuan Ming for his Passage Order, stacked them together, clasped them between his hands, and began to perform a Secret Technique.
As the glow from the two Tokens lit up and then extinguished in succession, he finally stopped the technique and returned their respective Tokens.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, the key to the prohibitions of Spiritual Ape Island has now been transferred to your Passage Order, and the ownership of this island is also now in your hands," Mo Sanqi explained to Yuan Ming. "However, according to the rules, Silver Dragon Daoist still has one last right to set foot on the island one last time to take his belongings."
Yuan Ming nodded, offering no objections.
"Silver Dragon Daoist, according to the rules, you may take your possessions from your mansion, but that is the limit. The products of the spirit field, the cultivators, and the commoners on the island ceased to belong to you the moment you conceded," Mo Sanqi said unemotionally.
"I understand," said the Silver Dragon Daoist.
"You have an hour to retrieve your belongings, but you must not deliberately damage anything on the island that doesn't belong to you, or you will be wanted by Dongji Palace. If you wish to return to Spiritual Ape Island, after a ten-year protection period, you have the right to issue a challenge first," Mo Sanqi said, looking at him.
"Silver Dragon Daoist, if you find yourself without a place to stay, you can come to Yunshan Island to stay temporarily," Yun Luo Fairy offered.
"Thank you," the Silver Dragon Daoist expressed his thanks, then bowed and turned back toward the island in a dejected manner without saying more.
Yun Luo Fairy sighed, knowing that he was most likely not coming back.
Although the dispute between Yuan Ming and Silver Dragon Daoist was short, it caused quite a stir, and many cultivators from nearby Spiritual Ape Island had already flown over. There were low-level cultivators on Flying Boats and others riding artifacts, but all stayed at a distance, not daring to come closer.
"Ladies and gentlemen, from today onward, Silver Dragon Daoist is no longer the Island Master of Spiritual Ape Island, Yuan Ming will take over," Mo Sanqi called out to the distant cultivators.
Hearing this, the cultivators hurried over, led by two Nascent Soul cultivators, a man and a woman, followed by several Core Formation and Foundation Establishment cultivators.
Yuan Ming's gaze fell on the two Nascent Soul cultivators. The woman was dressed in red, beautiful and seemingly in her early thirties, while the man wore a gray cloth short robe, his face marked with acne scars, carrying a black blade on his back.
"Greetings, Island Master Yuan," the two said with humble smiles upon catching Yuan Ming's gaze, bowing their heads.
With these two leading, the rest of the cultivators also bowed in unison.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, most of these people are cultivators born and bred on Spiritual Ape Island, along with some Loose Cultivators who have joined us. You may deploy them as you see fit. Spiritual Ape Island is vast and cannot be controlled by one person alone; these people currently maintain the operation of various parts of the island. Of course, if you are uneasy, you are also free to recruit your own cultivators," Mo Sanqi continued to Yuan Ming without giving another glance at the two Nascent Soul cultivators.
The group of cultivators grew slightly nervous at these words, looking at Yuan Ming.
However, as Mo Sanqi and Yuan Ming were speaking, these people dared not interrupt.
"Everyone, everything will proceed as usual on the island. If there are any other arrangements, I shall inform you beforehand. You may all disperse now," Yuan Ming said, waving his hand dismissively at the cultivators.
The cultivators, as if granted an amnesty, did not dare to linger and hurriedly bade farewell and left.
"These contain the latest details about the Spirit Vein and spirit land of Spiritual Ape Island, which should be of some help to you," Mo Sanqi said, taking out a Jade Scroll and handing it to Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming's Divine Sense entered the Jade Scroll, quickly perusing the contents, and he nodded.
He had somewhat understood the situation on Spiritual Ape Island before choosing it, but the details in the Jade Scroll were more thorough, saving him quite a bit of trouble.
"Thank you, Fellow Daoist Mo," Yuan Ming expressed his gratitude.
"Don't mention it. If you need anything else, you may find me in Dongji Palace anytime," Mo Sanqi chuckled.
A little less than an hour later, the Silver Dragon Daoist flew out from the island, did not come over to greet Mo Sanqi and the others, and went directly toward another direction, vanishing into the distant sky.
Upon seeing this, Mo Sanqi also took his leave.
Yuan Ming looked towards Yun Luo Fairy who showed no intention of leaving: "Do you have any further matters, Fellow Daoist?"
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, this is our first meeting. My name is Yun Luo, and I am the Island Master of Yunshan Island. From now on, we shall be neighbors," Yun Luo Fairy said with a smile.
"So you are Fellow Daoist Yun Luo, nice to meet you," Yuan Ming responded, bowing, his tone neutral.
"Don't misunderstand, Fellow Daoist Yuan. I merely had a nodding acquaintance with Silver Dragon Daoist and harbor no ill intentions towards you," Yun Luo Fairy quickly explained, sensing Yuan Ming's wariness.
"May I know why you stay, Fellow Daoist Yun Luo?" Yuan Ming asked noncommittally.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, can't I stay without a specific reason?" Yun Luo Fairy gave Yuan Ming a reproachful look and coquettishly spoke, a subtle allure spreading around her, making it difficult for one to not feel a fondness towards her.
"Of course, it's just that I have just taken over Spiritual Ape Island, and the cave mansion has not yet been opened up. I do not have a place to entertain Fellow Daoist Yun Luo," Yuan Ming said with an unfazed smile.
"Hehe, Fellow Daoist need not bother. There is a garden on the west side of Spiritual Ape Island. Sitting there would be fine," Yun Luo Fairy said with a smile, a hint of surprise flashing in her eyes.
"If that's the case, please, Fellow Daoist Yun Luo," Yuan Ming pondered briefly and then flew toward the west side of the island.
Yun Luo Fairy pursed her lips in a smile and followed him.
The two soon arrived at the west side of Spiritual Ape Island, where there indeed was a large garden spanning several tens of acres, brimming with flowers, predominantly white, accented with green leaves, and filled with a dreamlike fragrance.
"This is Snow Peony, a specialty of the Dongji Sea. May I ask, Fellow Daoist Yuan, are you a cultivator from abroad?" Yun Luo Fairy asked as she and Yuan Ming sat down in a pavilion at the center of the garden, her eyes smilingly profound as she gazed at him.
"I suppose so," replied Yuan Ming, his brow slightly raising as he spoke composedly.
"Oh, does Fellow Daoist come from the Central Continent?" Yun Luo Fairy pressed.
"Fellow Daoist Yun Luo, I prefer to be straightforward. Please speak directly if you have business, otherwise, I will take my leave," Yuan Ming said, without responding to Yun Luo Fairy's probing.
"Actually, I came to this island uninvited today because I indeed have a matter to discuss with Fellow Daoist Yuan. I wish to purchase some White Infant Fruits and hope you can oblige," Yun Luo Fairy said after a slight bow.
"White Infant Fruit?" Yuan Ming's expression shifted as he saw that Yun Luo Fairy's demeanor did not seem deceitful.
He had read about this item in a Jade Scroll given by Mo Sanqi. Two White Infant Fruit Trees grew on Spiritual Ape Island, with over two thousand years of medicinal age. The fruits they bore were incredibly precious, categorized as Level 4 Spirit Fruits that ripened every century.
In the external Cultivation World, the classification of spiritual materials and Spirit Fruits was much more detailed and included grades similar to those for demon beasts.
"Those two mature White Infant Fruit Trees on your island, I wish to buy three fruits. Actually, my visit was to discuss this with Silver Dragon Daoist originally, but unfortunately, before I could speak to him, he was driven away by Fellow Daoist Yuan," Yun Luo Fairy said with a laugh.
"I have just taken over Spiritual Ape Island and am still unfamiliar with everything here, including those two White Infant Fruit Trees. Allow me to consider this. How about I give you an answer in six months?" Yuan Ming pondered briefly, then lifted his teacup and sipped.
He was not yet familiar with the value of the White Infant Fruit and naturally could not sell it carelessly.
"Of course," Yun Luo Fairy replied, not insisting and still smiling.
Having clarified Yun Luo Fairy's purpose, Yuan Ming slightly lowered his guard towards her, and the atmosphere of their conversation grew much more harmonious.
Yun Luo Fairy seemed intent on befriending Yuan Ming and, recognizing his unfamiliarity with the Dongji Sea, shared much about the area with him.
"…The Dongji Sea here is close to the Abyss and suffers from three major disasters. The first is the Extreme Wind, which occurs every few centuries and blows from the direction of the Abyss," Yun Luo Fairy said, taking a sip of her tea and speaking confidently.
"Extreme Wind, could it be the Wind Sea from inside the Abyss?" Yuan Ming thought to himself but did not interrupt.
"Extreme Wind is no ordinary storm; it contains a strong erosive force. Not only ordinary people, but even cultivators of slightly lower strength cannot withstand it directly. Only by taking shelter inside an array can one escape unscathed. However, the Dongji Sea Area just experienced an Extreme Wind disaster a few years ago, so there will be none for the next few centuries," Yun Luo Fairy continued on her own.
"Oh, what about the other two disasters?" Yuan Ming nodded slightly and asked.
"The second disaster is the Beast Calamity. The Dongji Sea is full of demon beasts, and every once in a while, these beasts launch attacks on the islands of the Dongji Sea, especially those with abundant spiritual energy," Yun Luo Fairy said, her expression growing stern.This сhаptеr wаs first sееn оn МV^LЕМ^РYR.
"And the third disaster?" Yuan Ming asked.
"The third disaster is Demon Cultivators," Yun Luo Fairy said with a grave expression.
"Demon Cultivators?" Yuan Ming set down his teacup, his brows furrowing slightly.
"You don't know about Demon Cultivators? There are quite a few in the Central Continent as well, but they are not as rampant as here in the Dongji Sea," Yun Luo Fairy said, her face showing surprise.
"I come from a humble background and have been in solitary cultivation for many years, with limited experience. Pardon my ignorance," Yuan Ming said with a smile.
"I see. Demon Cultivators practice Demon Techniques, and many are traitors who have sided with the Demon World. These Demon Cultivators are very powerful, many of them supported by the Demon World with extensive resources and even methods to conceal their Demonic Qi. They are not to be underestimated and are very difficult to deal with," Yun Luo Fairy explained.
Yuan Ming nodded seriously, his thoughts turning. It seemed that in the outside world, Demon Clan cultivators were not uncommon and were considered an everyday sight.
"The harm caused by Demon Cultivators is far greater than that of the Extreme Wind or Beast Calamities. In recent years, several Returning to Void Stage island masters under the command of Dongji Palace have been killed by these Demon Cultivators. Fellow Daoist Yuan, having just come to the Dongji Sea, while you need not worry about the Extreme Wind and Beast Calamity for the time being, you must be very cautious of Demon Cultivators," Yun Luo Fairy advised, unable to discern anything from Yuan Ming's expression, hesitated slightly before continuing.
"Thank you for your guidance, Fellow Daoist Yun Luo. I will definitely remember this," Yuan Ming said earnestly.
After some more casual conversation, Yun Luo Fairy did not continue to sit and got up to bid farewell and leave.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, as far as I know, there isn't much to mention about Spiritual Ape Island, but there are two people deeply connected with Silver Dragon Daoist. Please be cautious," the woman's voice transmission echoed in Yuan Ming's ear as she left.

chapters.title: Chapter 789 - 760: Eliminating Hidden Dangers
chapters.content:
Upon hearing the words, Yuan Ming's heart stirred. After he watched Yun Luo Fairy's tunneling light disappear, he took out the Jade Scroll Mo Sanqi had given him and began to carefully examine the situation on Spiritual Ape Island.
The island was not small, covering hundreds of miles, with about five to six hundred thousand mortals living there. They formed several villages and towns, as well as a city, resembling a miniature nation.
Such a large mortal population on a spirit island in the Dongji Sea was uncommon. The main reason so many people were allowed to live on Spiritual Ape Island was that the island had two Red Copper Ore veins that required a large workforce to mine.
In addition to the two Red Copper Ore veins, there were three other industries on the island.
The first was the spirit field. The Spirit Veins on Spiritual Ape Island were somewhat scattered, which was disadvantageous for cultivation, but large tracts of spirit fields had been cultivated, spanning two to three hundred acres.
These spirit fields could grow spirit grain and Spiritual Medicine, yielding a significant profit each year.
The second industry was the Spirit Lake, inhabited by a group of Water Worm Apes. Although they were only Second Rank, they possessed great strength and were skilled swimmers, making them excellent spirit beasts for guarding Cave Mansions and pulling sea ships. Each one could be sold for a high price.
The name Spiritual Ape Island was largely attributed to those Water Worm Apes.
As for the third industry, it was the two White Infant Fruit Trees mentioned by Yun Luo Fairy.
After examining the content of the Jade Scroll, Yuan Ming stood and paced a few times within the pavilion. He then took out a Sound Transmission Talisman, moved his lips a few times, and crushed it.
Before long, two Nascent Soul cultivators hurried over, landing outside the pavilion. Behind them were more than a dozen Core Formation cultivators dressed in various garments, all seemingly influential figures among the island's cultivators.
"Greetings, Island Master."
Yuan Ming's gaze moved back and forth several times over the ma-faced man and the red-clothed woman. The two of them did not dare to meet Yuan Ming's gaze and hurriedly lowered their heads in fear and trepidation, their expressions slightly unsure, while the several Core Formation cultivators didn't even dare to breathe loudly.
After retracting his gaze, Yuan Ming, without wasting words, focused his mind and immediately began to use the Nightmare Divine Ability.
All present, including the red-clothed woman and the ma-faced man, instantly fell into a nightmare.
Yuan Ming walked directly to the red-clothed woman and the ma-faced man and poured Soul Power into the Seas of Consciousness of both, using the Soul Searching Divine Ability.
He raised an eyebrow when he found that seals had been placed in their Divine Souls, preventing his Soul Search.
"Such a crude seal thinks to stop me," Yuan Ming let out a slight cold laugh, intensifying his Soul Power. He quickly broke the seal and accessed their memories.
Just as Yun Luo Fairy had hinted, both individuals had issues. After all, in Yuan Ming's view, looking across the entire island, the first ones that Silver Dragon Taoist would take an interest in were these two Nascent Soul cultivators.
The red-clothed woman, named Ruan Hongxiang, was the elder of the Ruan Family, a Cultivation Family that had settled on Spiritual Ape Island.
The Ruan Family had resided on the island for a long time, and nearly half of the several hundred cultivators on the island belonged to the Ruan Family, overseeing the spirit fields.
Ma-faced Ye San was a Nascent Soul Loose Cultivator, in charge of managing the Spirit Lake.
On the surface, both had an ordinary vassal relationship with Silver Dragon Taoist. However, behind the scenes, they had already become Silver Dragon Taoist's inner disciples and were instructed to monitor Yuan Ming's every move and report on a regular basis, waiting for an opportunity to cooperate with Silver Dragon Taoist to seize back the island.
Yuan Ming was never lenient with those who tried to harm him. He raised his hand to kill the two immediately, but suddenly remembered something and stopped.
His third eye emitted sound waves that shook the bodies of Ruan Hongxiang and Ye San, causing them to collapse to the ground, unconscious.
Yuan Ming's hand emitted a green light, collecting the storage magic tools and Magic Treasures from inside their bodies and taking away the two people as well.
He then emitted streams of Soul Power from his third eye again, Soul Searching the other Core Formation cultivators, finding several who had close dealings with Ruan and Ye and were given tasks to secretly monitor him.
Like Ruan Hongxiang, he confiscated their storage magic tools and Magic Treasures and suppressed them.
Yuan Ming then waved his hand to dispel the Nightmare, and the rest of the people woke up one by one, gasping for air and showing expressions of terror on their faces.
"Starting today, the Ruan Family cultivators will leave Spiritual Ape Island. The rest of you may stay," Yuan Ming ordered indifferently.Thiscontentispresentedby*.
The remaining Core Formation cultivators who had come with Ruan Hongxiang were startled. They soon realized that Ye San and Ruan Hongxiang were nowhere to be seen, finally turning their gazes toward a middle-aged man at the late-stage of Core Formation.
"Island Master Yuan, may I know the reason for sending the Ruan Family away?" The middle-aged man was sweating, but still asked through gritted teeth.
"Do you truly not know the reason?" Yuan Ming gave a cold laugh.
He had just checked this man's memory. The middle-aged man, named Ruan Tao, had not had direct contact with Silver Dragon Taoist nor participated in his conspiracies. However, Ruan Tao knew that Ruan Hongxiang was Silver Dragon Taoist's disciple and had a vague guess about certain matters.
Most of the Ruan Family on the island were actually innocent, but they could no longer stay.
Seeing Yuan Ming's penetrating gaze, Ruan Tao's last bit of hope was shattered, and his face turned ashen.
He numbly bid farewell and flew toward where the Ruan Family resided.
Yuan Ming remained silent. With the departure of the Ruan Family, the daily operations of Spiritual Ape Island would be affected.
Yet, as he had just taken charge of the island, he needed to start well. If he was not ruthless now, removing the known threats, more trouble would arise later.
"Ye San and the Ruan Family harbored dual loyalties; I, as the Island Master, cannot keep them.
