No need to worry, as long as you remain loyal to me, you will not only be able to live and work in peace on Spiritual Ape Island, but I will also reward you handsomely," Yuan Ming looked at the remaining people and said.
The cultivators outside the pavilion, who were previously uneasy, were reassured upon hearing this and thanked Yuan Ming profusely.
"Alright, carry on with your duties. Cao Gang will take over the spirit field as of today, and Li Muhai will be in charge of overseeing the Spirit Lake," Yuan Ming continued, pointing to an elder in green and a young man with blue hair.
Cao Gang and Li Muhai were both mid-stage Core Formation cultivators, one practiced a wood attribute cultivation method, and the other a water attribute cultivation method. Although these two were relatively new, managing the spirit fields and Spirit Lake would be a way to hone and test them. As long as they had the capability and willingness, he did not mind offering them the opportunity.
Cao Gang and Li Muhai were overjoyed and hastily bowed in thanks.
Yuan Ming then allocated tasks to the others, and once everyone had dispersed, he turned to a green mountain in the center of the island.
This was where the spiritual energy of Spiritual Ape Island was the most abundant. The cave mansion of the Silver Dragon Taoist was also located here, though now it had been emptied.
After sweeping the area with a glance, Yuan Ming continued to the back of the mountain where there were two ten-zhang-tall green fruit trees enveloped in a layer of blue light.
The trees were emerald in color, their leaves bearing more than a dozen snow-white spirit fruits the size of a fist, shaped like curled up infants with distinct mouths, noses, hands, and feet—an extremely peculiar sight.
These two spirit trees were none other than the White Infant Fruit Trees, the most important spiritual materials of Spiritual Ape Island.
"Indeed, these fruits are extraordinary; the spiritual power contained within them is no less than that of the Red Mulberry Immortal Fruit," Yuan Ming thought to himself, a flash of green light flickering in his palm as a green jade scroll appeared.
This object had been found in Ruan Hongxiang's storage magic tool, which contained records of the effects of the White Infant Fruit and methods of cultivation.
White Infant Fruits were said to have the effect of cleansing marrow and refining essence and were effective even for Returning to Void Cultivators.
This spirit fruit also had another marvelous use: it could be mixed into a spiritual liquid that, when applied to the skin, could make it flawlessly fair, transforming ugliness into beauty, much to the delight of female cultivators.
Such a spirit fruit naturally could not be guarded by Silver Dragon Taoist's old restrictions.
Yuan Ming released several streaks of green light, which entered the blue light.
The previous array could barely be considered third-level and stood no chance against Yuan Ming's current power—it was quickly breached.
He took out a set of fourth-level arrays and began to arrange them near the two fruit trees.
Once he completed these tasks, Yuan Ming finally felt at ease and headed to the front side of the green mountain.
Although the Silver Dragon Taoist's cave mansion had been emptied, Yuan Ming did not bother to clear out any possible concealed surveillance methods that the adversary might have deployed, instead choosing an appropriate location to carve out a new cave mansion for himself.
In less than two hours, the cave mansion was completed.
Yuan Ming took out another two sets of fourth-level arrays and arranged them around the cave mansion. The Gathering Spirit Tree was also planted inside, gathering spiritual power.
The green mountain was originally abundant with spiritual energy. The roots of the Gathering Spirit Tree penetrated the void, attracting streams of nature's spiritual energy, and the spiritual energy within the cave mansion soon advanced a grade.
Yuan Ming was quite satisfied with this and then formed seals with both hands. A moment later, he conjured a purple palace the size of a washbowl, which slowly rose from his hand.
This palace was none other than the Shura Palace, once hidden in the Black Wind Desert.
With vast space contained within, the Shura Palace was a rare magical treasure. Before Yuan Ming's seclusion at Chang Chun Temple to break through to the Returning to Void Stage, he had made a trip to the Black Wind Desert and claimed the palace for himself.
Yuan Ming entered the palace, arriving in the space where the Black Tower was located, and with a wave of his sleeve, more than a dozen figures flew out—Ruan Hongxiang, Ye San, and others, all unconscious.
A fan-shaped Soul Power emanated from Yuan Ming's brows, awakening these individuals.
As they recognized their surroundings and the hovering Yuan Ming above, they were utterly shocked.
"You know why you're here. You dared to collaborate with the Silver Dragon Taoist under my nose and plot against me. Originally, you all should have been put to death. But as heaven cherishes life, I'll give you a chance to live," Yuan Ming said slowly.
Ruan Hongxiang, Ye San, and the others turned ashen.
"We will heed any command from Island Master Yuan, and we will surely comply," Ye San, with quickly spinning thoughts, knelt with a thud and kowtowed repeatedly to Yuan Ming.
Witnessing this, the others abandoned their dignity and knelt as well, begging Yuan Ming for mercy.
"Relax, it's nothing perilous. From today onwards, you'll live here, praying to me ceaselessly day and night," said Yuan Ming indifferently.
"Praying? Senior, are you a Soul Cultivator?" asked Ye San, relieved that Yuan Ming truly did not plan to kill him and speaking hesitantly.
"Correct, I am also known as the Sect Hierarch of the Moon Sect, the Nether Moon God. The only thing you need to do from now on is pray to the Nether Moon God. As long as you do so sincerely, I will spare your lives," Yuan Ming said slowly.
Ye San had a realization; it was no wonder all their little schemes were transparent to Yuan Ming.
"If someone dares to be slippery and deceitful, there will be only one outcome!" Yuan Ming activated the Exterminating Immortal Sword, and a terrifying Sword Qi that spanned the sky shot out, cleaving the nearby ground.
The Black Tower Space trembled as a vast Sword Trace Rift appeared on the ground, immeasurably deep, as if the earth was split in two.
"We wouldn't dare!" exclaimed Ye San, Ruan Hongxiang, and the others, trembling as they knelt down.
"Good, then begin," Yuan Ming put away the Exterminating Immortal Sword and instructed.
The dozen or so people did not dare to speak another word, promptly sitting cross-legged and praying to Yuan Ming earnestly.
Moments later, streams of Desire Power began to emanate from them and converged toward the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
Yuan Ming assessed the purity of the Desire Power and nodded slightly before turning and leaving the Shura Palace.
With their storage magic tools and magic treasures taken away, they were like defanged tigers with no means of escaping the Black Tower Space.

chapters.title: Chapter 790 - 761 Five Attribute Cultivation Method
chapters.content:
Before long, Yuan Ming stood at the entrance of the newly opened cave mansion, hands clasped behind his back as he gazed forward with a level look.
The spirit lake lay right in front of the green mountain peak, its surface glimmering with light, faint silhouettes of blue shadows frolicking in the waters beneath.
Further afield were patches of spirit fields and lush trees, with the sea breeze carrying refreshing scents of grass and wood.
"Starting today, this will be my territory," Yuan Ming nodded in approval, quite satisfied with the sight before him.
He soon returned to the cave mansion, pondering over his future cultivation plan.
What troubled him the most at present was the two hundred Vow Power Pills demanded by the Stealing Heaven Tripod Artifact Spirit, which was also the main reason he had spared Ruan Hongxiang and the others.
Besides, not only was Spiritual Ape Island densely populated, but there were also many insignificant islands nearby inhabited by large numbers of ordinary people and low-level cultivators, which was conducive to spreading the teachings of the Moon Sect.
When chitchatting with Sikong Zhan and others before, Yuan Ming had subtly inquired and learned that soul cultivators were rare in the Dongji Sea and had never been viewed with hostility, and there wasn't much resistance to the idea of preaching.
However, preaching required manpower, and it certainly wasn't something he could do alone, so Yuan Ming planned to first bring Xi Ying and Wulu back.
While there was still a buffer time for the Stealing Heaven Tripod, he entered a secret chamber within the cave mansion, took out a stack of array setting tools, and started arranging the Void Communication Array.
Afterwards, Yuan Ming placed a spirit stone on the ground, and the top of the black stone pillar began to emit strands of blood light, growing brighter until it finally ignited a burst of blood flames.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming raised an eyebrow, formed a hand seal with one hand, and activated the array.
The blood flames trembled violently and suddenly stopped after a few breaths, revealing a blurry visage of Xi Ying within the flames.
"Finally got in touch. How are things on your end?" Yuan Ming asked with relief.
"I'm relatively safe for now, currently aboard a giant ship..." Xi Ying recounted her experiences over the past few days to Yuan Ming.
The day the Stealing Heaven Tripod Artifact Spirit agreed to act, Xi Ying, like Yuan Ming, had fallen into unconsciousness and woke up inside a large city known as White Emperor City.
After some investigation, she infiltrated the Sky Eagle Chamber of Commerce and was currently traveling on a Heavenly Eagle Flying Boat towards a place called Central Continent.
"What are you doing in that Central Continent, and is it still possible for you to disembark now? We've just arrived in the Overseas World, so it would be better to act together," Yuan Ming furrowed his brows, briefly explained his own situation, and then said.
"This Heavenly Eagle Flying Boat is a direct flight to Central Continent, it won't stop midway, and there are powerful cultivators inside the boat, I no longer have a way to get off," Xi Ying shook her head saying.
"Alright then, be careful, I'll try to get there as soon as possible," Yuan Ming sighed.
"No need, I'm quite safe now, you don't have to rush over here. First, gather desire power in the Dongji Sea and complete the task of the Stealing Heaven Tripod Artifact Spirit," Xi Ying spoke.
Yuan Ming heard this, a flicker of unusual light passing in his eyes; it seemed Xi Ying was hiding something from him.
"Someone's coming, I'll have to leave it at that," Xi Ying suddenly spoke, and then the blood flames flashed, and her silhouette disappeared from within.The reference version of this on *.
Yuan Ming fell silent, ceasing the operation of the Void Communication Array with a hand seal.
After some thought, he decided to follow Xi Ying's advice and stay in the Dongji Sea for a while, gathering more information about Central Continent before deciding whether to go there.
Once he had made up his mind, Yuan Ming then tried to contact Wulu through the Void Communication Array, but again ended in failure.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming couldn't help but frown. Failing to contact Wulu twice in succession, he wondered if something unexpected had happened on the other end?
After a moment of contemplation, he could only sit in meditation with closed eyes, waiting until seven days later when he inserted a normal piece of Black Incense into the Stealing Heaven Tripod and lit it, his consciousness diving into darkness, subsequently taking possession of Wulu's body.
Before his eyes lay a vast and lush forest, with Wulu sitting cross-legged in the center of a giant tree, his body in a translucent state, blending into the surroundings.
Seeing that Wulu was still alive brought some relief to Yuan Ming, and he turned his attention to the surroundings.
This was a primeval forest, its species of trees starkly different from those on the Yunhuang Continent.
Through the gaps in the trees, he could barely make out a continuous range of mountains in the distance, a terrain that did not seem to belong to the Dongji Sea region.
"Wulu, Xi Ying, and I were all saved by the Stealing Heaven Tripod Artifact Spirit, but how did we end up in three completely different places?" Yuan Ming couldn't help feeling somewhat puzzled.
Now, it seemed Wulu had injuries and was hiding in a relatively concealed location, cultivating to heal, so Yuan Ming was unable to gather more useful information.
Yuan Ming had no choice but to quietly wait for the possession time to end, his consciousness returning to his original body.
"Looking at the situation, it seems Wulu and Xi Ying probably won't be able to return anytime soon. Oh well, for now, I must figure something out for myself," Yuan Ming thought to himself.
As he contemplated, he immediately dispersed his divine sense, seeking within the island's cultivators for those who could be nurtured.
Soon, he found two reasonable targets, one at the mid-stage of Core Formation and another at Foundation Establishment Perfection.
These two individuals had mediocre talents but were eloquent speakers, more than capable of attracting ordinary believers.
Yuan Ming did not immediately summon them, deciding to observe them for a while longer to assess their characters.
"Now that other matters have mostly been settled, it's time to start focusing on cultivation," Yuan Ming closed his eyes, and all three of his divine souls sprang into action.
His main soul left his body, hovering above the cave mansion, operating the Moonlight Technique to absorb the power of moonlight.
Inside the Nascent Soul, his divine soul operated the Nine Elements Technique, absorbing nature's spiritual energy.
As for the first soul, it controlled the physical body, operating the Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill, absorbing the Power of the Sun from the nearby void.
This way of cultivation was something Yuan Ming thought of over the past hundred years, taking advantage of having three divine souls, each soul body cultivated simultaneously, without lagging behind any of the others.
Time passed bit by bit, and in the blink of an eye, three days had gone by.
Yuan Ming opened his eyes, his eyebrows knitted together.
In these three days, soul cultivation and body cultivation went smoothly, but only magic practitioner cultivation encountered a problem.
The mana within his Dantian would occasionally become disordered, and each time it happened, it took a long while of cultivating to suppress and calm it down.
"How can this be?" Yuan Ming was deeply perplexed.
Could it be that there was something wrong with the Nine Elements Technique?
Yuan Ming pondered for a moment before taking out the Shura Blood Devouring Map, summoning Qi Ye, and explaining the situation to him.
Nowadays, he had only Qi Ye left to discuss matters with, and after observing for a hundred years, he had fully understood that what were called Demonic Qi and Spiritual Energy were merely different kinds of energy. The magic practitioner cultivation in the Demon World and the Chuyun Realm actually weren't much different in a certain sense.
"Your Nine Elements Technique indeed has serious issues and is no longer suitable for continued cultivation," Qi Ye said after hearing Yuan Ming's words and pondering for a long while.
"How so?" Yuan Ming asked.
"Returning to Void Cultivators, when advancing to the Returning Void stage, have already complemented their Spirit Root, possessing the Five Elements Power simultaneously, while the Nine Elements Technique is a wood attribute cultivation method, which can no longer meet the needs of your Spirit Root and mana. You now need to switch to a cultivation method that incorporates all five attributes." Qi Ye spoke thus.
Yuan Ming's face showed surprise, as the Yunhuang Continent's cultivation techniques were all of a single attribute, at most dual attributes; he had never heard of a cultivation technique of five attributes.
However, if he needed to change his cultivation technique, surely other Returning to Void Stage Cultivators would need to as well, thus, there should definitely be a Five Attribute Cultivation Method available somewhere in the Dongji Sea.
Determining one's cultivation technique was of utmost importance, so Yuan Ming immediately left the cave mansion and returned to the Dongji Islands.
The Dongji Islands were still bustling and lively, with countless large and small sea vessels entering and leaving the docks, shuttling non-stop. Various colored tunneling lights flashed in the sky, looking quite dazzling.
Among the numerous tunneling lights, an unremarkable green light descended. As the light receded, Yuan Ming's figure was revealed.
Having been to the Dongji Islands before, he knew his way well and quickly arrived at one of the deputy islands to the west.
The six deputy islands of the Dongji Islands were named after the six unions: Heavenly Union Island, Earth Union Island, East Union Island, West Union Island, Nanhe Island, and Beihe Island.
Yuan Ming had previously visited East Union Island, and this time he set foot on West Union Island.
Compared to East Union Island, West Union Island was a true hub of commerce, with bustling shops on either side of the street and cultivators shoulder to shoulder, several times more lively than the streets of East Union Island.
Looking at the thriving scene before him, Yuan Ming also revealed a trace of a smile on his face.
He had briefly visited the Dongji Islands during his last trip and had left in a hurry. This time around, he planned to take a good tour around and experience the prosperity here.
"You are... Senior Yuan, right?" A somewhat familiar voice came from the side.
Yuan Ming turned his head to look. Three men and one woman, four figures had just walked out of a nearby shop—It was Sikong Zhan and his companions.
"Oh, it's you guys." Yuan Ming nodded casually, as a greeting.
"Hehe, we never expected to encounter Senior here again. It truly is our honor. Senior Yuan, may I ask what brings you to the East Extreme Island? We are fairly familiar with the island's situation. If there's anything we can assist with, please feel free to ask," Sikong Zhan said warmly, his eyes shifting subtly as he stepped forward.
"I have come here to purchase a Returning to Void Technique; do you know where I can find one on the East Extreme Island?" Yuan Ming asked.
Though he had visited the Dongji Islands once before, he was indeed unfamiliar with the area and didn't know where he could buy a cultivation technique. Having Sikong Zhan and others lead the way could indeed save him a lot of trouble.
"You want to buy a cultivation technique? Naturally, you should go to the Sui Xin Pavilion on Heavenly Union Island. It's specially established by Dongji Palace for the Returning to Void elders. However, the Sui Xin Pavilion is only open to the elders or the Island Masters under the banner of Dongji Palace. If an outsider wishes to enter, they need permission from Dongji Palace, which might be a bit troublesome," Sikong Zhan said, his tone carrying a hint of inquisitiveness.
"I am now the Island Master of the Spiritual Ape Island in the Dongji Sea," Yuan Ming stated plainly.
"Congratulations, Senior Yuan! Then there should be no problem. Does Senior wish to go there now?" Sikong Zhan hurriedly congratulated him and then asked.
"No rush, let's look around elsewhere first, I'm planning to purchase some spiritual materials," Yuan Ming replied.
The daily operations of Spiritual Ape Island were still running smoothly, but its defenses were weak.
The prohibition that Silver Dragon Taoist had previously set up around the island had been dismantled and taken away by him. Yuan Ming planned to arrange a Great Array that would envelop the entire island, but he was somewhat lacking in spiritual materials.
"If Senior needs spiritual materials, you should visit the Ten Thousand Goods Immortal Trip. It's a super chamber of commerce with a presence throughout the Chuyun Realm. Not only is their range of spiritual materials complete, but their quality is absolutely guaranteed," Sikong Zhan proposed after some thought.
"With a presence throughout the Chuyun Realm..." Yuan Ming was inwardly astonished.

chapters.title: Chapter 791 - 762: Master Dian Xiaosan
chapters.content:
"Lead the way," Yuan Ming thought as he spoke.
Sikong Zhan responded and took the lead.
The group soon arrived in front of a large shop in the central area of West Union Island. The shop's doors, windows, and walls were painted a bright red color, making it very eye-catching.
The size of the store was several times larger than the nearby shops, standing out like a crane among chickens. Even from a distance, one could notice the gold-lettered signboard at the top of the shop, which read "Ten Thousand Goods Immortal Trip."
Through the main door, one could see counter after counter, filled with all sorts of items. The shop was crowded with customers, with nearly every counter packed with people, making business extremely brisk.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming became even more interested in the Ten Thousand Goods Immortal Trip and stepped into the shop.
The shop was divided into different areas, selling spiritual materials, elixirs, Magic Treasures, talismans, Arrays, and everything else imaginable, truly living up to the name "Ten Thousand Goods."
Yuan Ming did not immediately go to the spiritual material area but wandered casually through the sections of Magic Treasures, talismans, and Arrays. Sikong Zhan and his companions stayed by his side and acted as guides, allowing Yuan Ming to quickly gain a detailed understanding of the market prices in the Dongji Sea area.
Before long, Yuan Ming arrived in the elixir area and inquired about the prices of several Returning to Void Stage elixirs, finding each to be astonishingly expensive, more than ten times the price of Nascent Soul Stage elixirs.
"The elixir refinement for the Returning to Void Stage is difficult, hence the steep prices," the young female cultivator behind the counter patiently explained.
"Why so?" Sikong Zhan glanced at Yuan Ming then asked the young female cultivator.
"Returning to Void Cultivators possess all Five Elements, and during cultivation, they need to absorb Five Element Spiritual Energy simultaneously, or else their Mana will become chaotic. Therefore, theoretically, Returning to Void elixirs also need to contain Five Elements Spiritual Power. Fellow Daoist must also know that the hardest step in alchemy is Solidifying Pill, which requires perfect control over the elixir's medicinal strength, melding it into one. Nascent Soul Stage elixirs contain only one kind of Spiritual Power, whereas Returning to Void elixirs contain five kinds, making their refinement immensely more difficult," said the young female cultivator.
"I see," Sikong Zhan said.
"Refining Returning to Void elixirs is more than ten times more difficult than Nascent Soul Stage elixirs. Alchemists capable of refining Nascent Soul Stage elixirs are not exactly plentiful but are never in short supply. However, alchemists who can refine Returning to Void elixirs are few and far between. Our Ten Thousand Goods Immortal doesn't have many either, which is why the prices are higher—there's just no helping it," she said apologetically, with an excellent attitude.
Yuan Ming, who had no background in alchemy, learned something new from this.
Having the Gathering Spirit Tree, he was not much dependent on elixirs and had no intention of buying them. He turned his gaze towards other elixirs.
"What is this elixir?" Yuan Ming's interest was piqued, pointing to a wooden box at the corner of the counter.
Inside the wooden box lay a dark elixir, emitting not Mana, but fluctuations of Soul Power.
"This is a Soul Refining Elixir, made from the essence of souls. When taken, it can strengthen the Divine Soul," the young female cultivator explained.
"Soul Refining Elixir... it sounds similar to the Vow Power Pill, but the contained Soul Power is far below that of the Vow Power Pill," Yuan Ming thought to himself.
"How much does this elixir cost?" he asked.
"This is a Low Grade Soul Refining Pill. It costs one hundred thousand Spirit Stones," the young female cultivator said.
Yuan Ming raised an eyebrow. The Soul Refining Pill was indeed expensive. For context, a typical Nascent Soul cultivator's entire fortune wouldn't exceed three to four hundred thousand Spirit Stones, which could only buy three to four Low Grade Soul Refining Pills.
"Senior, do you plan to buy this pill? Forgive me for being blunt, but although the effects of the Soul Refining Pill are significant, the Low Grade ones contain too many impurities in the Soul Power, leading to great risks after consumption that might hinder further cultivation. Only those who are at a dead end would consider taking it," Sikong Zhan approached Yuan Ming and said through a transmission.
Yuan Ming glanced at Sikong Zhan, nodded, and continued to ask, "Then, what about the Mid-grade and even High-grade Soul Refining Pills? How much do they cost?"
"Mid-grade Soul Refining Pills are extremely rare. Our Ten Thousand Goods Immortal rarely has them in stock, and each one costs five hundred thousand Spirit Stones. As for High-grade Soul Refining Pills, they are priced at one million Spirit Stones and are virtually priceless," the young female cultivator said.
As soon as she finished speaking, a grey-clothed elder walked in from outside.
His clothes were somewhat disheveled and he emitted a burnt smell. His hands were dry and yellow as if regularly exposed to intense flames.
"Master Dian, you're here! Do you have new elixirs?" the young female cultivator's eyes lit up, and she moved away from Yuan Ming and others to greet the elder.
"Haha, yes, I was lucky yesterday and produced a batch of Earth Origin Pills. Ziqi, take me to see Fellow Daoist Gu," the grey-clothed elder laughed.
The young female cultivator showed a pleased expression and led the elder inside.
"Master Dian? Could this person be Master Dian Xiaosan?" Sikong Zhan's eyes sparkled, muttering to himself.Visit * (*) for more.
"Dian Xiaosan? That's a peculiar name. Who is this person?" Yuan Ming asked.
"Senior may not know, but Elder Dian Xiaosan hails from the Alchemy Dao of Qingxuan Platform in Central Continent and has previously refined Sixth-grade Elixirs. He is an extremely famous Alchemy Master in the Dongji Sea," Sikong Zhan said quietly.
"Sixth-grade Elixirs!" Yuan Ming was astonished.
Like Arrays and spiritual materials, the Overseas World also grades elixirs, and the medicinal strength of Sixth-grade Elixirs is extraordinarily potent, beyond what a Returning to Void Stage cultivator can endure.
"The Palace Master of Dongji Palace, who is at the Dharma Manifestation Stage, once personally invited Elder Dian Xiaosan to join and even promised a high position as Vice Palace Master, but the Master declined," Sikong Zhan continued.
"Dharma Manifestation Stage? So the realm above Returning Void is called this," Yuan Ming thought to himself.
He carefully sized up the gray-clothed elder before him, committing his appearance to memory.
Over the years, Yuan Ming had become increasingly adept at using the Stealing Heaven Tripod, which was of little use aside from collecting Desire Power if there were no suitable possession targets.
However, if there were a good target for possession, using the Black Incense for possession could unearth astonishing value, with Su Yingxue serving as the prime example.
The Alchemy Master before him was not someone he could afford to miss.
As Yuan Ming observed Dian Xiaosan, the latter seemed to sense something and also turned his head to look back at Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming's eyes suddenly felt a slight pain, as if pierced by a needle.
"This old man possesses strong Soul Power, certainly no weaker than mine; I wonder if I can possess him," Yuan Ming thought to himself.
Dian Xiaosan glanced at Yuan Ming, his eyes showing no particular emotion, and was quickly led away to the back hall by a young female cultivator.
Yuan Ming did not linger in the Elixir Medicine Area, instead, he went to the spiritual material area and purchased a large amount of Water attribute spiritual materials, as well as some materials for refining Array Flag Array Plates.
"To think that the senior is also an Array Master, we are truly disrespectful," Sikong Zhan and the others expressed their admiration.
"Are Array Masters in high demand here in the Dongji Sea?" Yuan Ming casually inquired.
"Of course, the cultivators who come to Dongji Sea are mostly here to hunt demon beasts. Array Masters can set up various Great Arrays, which greatly increase the success rate of hunting. Whether it's Sects or the Scatter Alliance, Array Masters are very welcome," Sikong Zhan explained.
Yuan Ming nodded at this and began to calculate in his mind.
After touring West Union Island, he finally arrived at Heavenly Union Island, the closest to Dongji Main Island.
Heavenly Union Island, being close to the Dongji Main Island, was abundant in Spiritual Energy.
The island had no shops but had built many Cave Mansions for rent or sale to cultivators.
Yuan Ming and his companions came to the north side of Heavenly Union Island, where a large building stood, the wide plaque bearing the golden words "Sui Xin Pavilion."
He did not enter but instead turned his gaze toward the building next to Sui Xin Pavilion.
There was an even larger palace structure there, busy with many people coming and going.
"What is that place?" Yuan Ming curiously asked.
"That's the Good Deed Hall, where the Dongji Palace issues tasks like seeking spiritual materials, hunting demon beasts, Alchemy, Drawing Talismans, pursuing Evil Cultivation, and so on. Anyone can take these tasks, and upon completion, not only is there a reward of Spirit Stones, but one can also accumulate goodwill. Once enough goodwill is accumulated, it can be exchanged for Cultivation Techniques, elixirs, Magic Treasures, and various other items at Dongji Palace," Sikong Zhan said.
Instantly interested, Yuan Ming activated his Divine Sense and quickly understood the situation inside the hall.
The tasks at the Good Deed Hall were relatively easy to complete, all aimed at Nascent Soul Stage or even Core Formation Stage cultivators.
Only the task of hunting Evil Cultivation was somewhat challenging; it involved Returning to Void Stage Evil Cultivators, several of whom were Demon Cultivators, with exceptionally rich rewards. He was quite tempted.
However, with other matters at hand, Yuan Ming naturally wouldn't undertake a hunting task. He withdrew his Divine Sense and headed towards Sui Xin Pavilion.
Two guards in blue armor stood at the main door of Sui Xin Pavilion, stopping the group: "Sui Xin Pavilion is a restricted area; outsiders may not enter. What brings you here?"
"This gentleman is the Island Master of Spiritual Ape Island, here to purchase Cultivation Techniques," Sikong Zhan stepped forward and said, acting almost like Yuan Ming's personal attendant.
Yuan Ming did not expose Sikong Zhan; instead, he took out the Island Master token given by Mo Sanqi and tossed it to one of the guards.
The blue-armored guard hurriedly took out a blue jade book Magic Treasure and brought it close to Yuan Ming's token.
The book flashed continuously with spirit light, quickly displaying Yuan Ming's identity information.
"So it's Island Master Yuan; my apologies for the offense. You can enter the pavilion directly, but the others may not," the guard put away the Jade Album, returned the token respectfully to Yuan Ming, and cleared the way.
"It seems I have troubled you; I'll go in first, please feel free to do as you like," Yuan Ming took back his token and said to Sikong Zhan and the others.
"Senior, go about your business. We'll wait for you outside. If you don't find the right Cultivation Technique here, we can take you somewhere else later," Sikong Zhan said.
Yuan Ming nodded and entered Sui Xin Pavilion.
"The situation is pressing; just waiting here seems somewhat inappropriate," Sikong Zhuo, who had been silent, watched as Yuan Ming's figure disappeared, enveloped the four in his Divine Sense, and spoke through a psychic transmission.
"The elder brother is right; taking advantage of the fact that those people have not yet caught up, we should leave quickly or find a place to hide," Sikong Lin immediately said.
Ye Xinyao lowered her head, remaining silent.
"There's no need for further discussion; I have everything under control," Sikong Zhan glanced toward Sui Xin Pavilion and said indifferently.

chapters.title: Chapter 792 - 763 Attributeless Cultivation Technique
chapters.content:
Sui Xin Pavilion looked rather large from the outside, but upon entering, the space was indeed larger than expected, containing rows of bookshelves numbering in the fifties or sixties.
The shelves were filled with various colored Jade Scrolls, all covered with a layer of protective light from the forbidden.
Seeing so many classics inside Sui Xin Pavilion, Yuan Ming felt more confident about finding a Cultivation Technique here and was about to walk over.
The void buzzed with a sound, and a beam of white light appeared out of nowhere, blocking the way.
Upon seeing this, Yuan Ming immediately stopped.
"Fellow Daoist need not worry," said an elder wearing a white robe and a headscarf, who emerged from behind the bookshelves, holding a bamboo scroll, "This is the Heart Inquiry Forbidden of this pavilion. Everyone who enters Sui Xin Pavilion must pass this Forbidden to prevent Demon Cultivators from infiltrating." He continued without looking up.
Though this person appeared like an ordinary old scholar, his presence was immense, clearly another Being at the Returning to Void Stage.
"I see, thank you for the explanation, Fellow Daoist," Yuan Ming said, looking at the white light in front of him while inwardly feeling apprehensive.
His body was indeed carrying genuine Demonic Qi, which if detected, would lead to trouble.
Yet with the white-robed elder watching, retreating now would only arouse more suspicion.
Yuan Ming silently concentrated the Demonic Qi in his body to one spot and wrapped it with the roots of the Undying Tree, then gritted his teeth and stepped into the white light.
The white light rippled gently, and Yuan Ming passed through the area without any incident.
With his heart finally at ease, Yuan Ming bowed to the white-robed elder and said, "I am Yuan Ming, Island Master of Spiritual Ape Island. I came here today to purchase a Returning to Void Stage Cultivation Technique."
"I am Mao Yi, the Deacon Elder of Sui Xin Pavilion. Fellow Daoist Yuan, please feel free," the white-robed elder said indifferently, continuing to review the bamboo scroll in his hands.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming no longer paid attention to the elder, instead turning to examine the surrounding bookshelves on his own.
Each section of the shelves was labeled, displaying tags such as Cultivation Techniques, Secret Techniques, Formations, Dan Recipes, and Miscellaneous Studies.
Yuan Ming went straight to the section of the shelves storing Cultivation Techniques. There were six or seven rows of shelves here, mostly displaying Core Formation Stage and Nascent Soul Stage Techniques. There were only about a dozen for the Returning to Void Stage.
A white light screen blocked Divine Sense, but there were annotations beside the Jade Scrolls.The full series lives on * (*).
"'Five Elements Longevity Technique,' a Five Attribute Technique, progresses slowly, with benefits for maintaining youth and health."
"'Innate Cave Mysterious Technique,' a Five Attribute Technique, primarily based on Wood Attribute changes, advances quickly, average in fighting."
"'Yellow Court Scripture,' a Five Attribute Technique, primarily focused on Earth Transformation, has a certain effect on strengthening the body, strong in combat…"
Yuan Ming quickly skimmed through the dozen or so Returning to Void Techniques and remained silent.
"These techniques are all decent; you don't fancy any of them?" Qi Ye's voice resounded in his Sea of Consciousness.
"This is Sui Xin Pavilion, and you carry Demonic Qi, do not speak out loud rashly," Yuan Ming said, glancing towards the entrance, speaking through a transmitted voice.
The Shura Blood Devouring Map was a Demon Clan's Spiritual Treasure, and over the years, to enhance its power, he began refining it with Demonic Qi, causing Qi Ye, as the Artifact Spirit, to also be imbued with Demonic Qi.
"No need to worry, although my strength has not increased much over the years, I am much more adept at wielding the Shura Blood Devouring Map than before. Unless it's a Being at the Dharma Manifestation Stage, no one will detect me," Qi Ye replied.
"Even so, we must be cautious. Dongji Sea is no small place like Yunhuang Continent," Yuan Ming commented.
"Rest assured, I know my limits. But let's not discuss this any further; how do you plan to choose the Cultivation Technique? You've cultivated the Ju Mang Spirit Technique, and your Spirit Root condition has greatly improved. You don't need to worry too much about the speed of cultivation; perhaps choose a technique strong in combat, like that 'Yellow Court Scripture'," Qi Ye changed the subject.
"I considered it thoroughly just now; these techniques probably aren't suitable for me," Yuan Ming remarked.
"Why do you say that?" Qi Ye was taken aback.
"You know I've cultivated the Ju Mang Spirit Technique, and earlier I even used the Undying Tree as a Companion Spirit Treasure for refinement, this has deepened my connection with it. Due to this tree, not only do I possess the Five Elements Power of Metal, Wood, Water, Fire, and Earth, the Yin Yang Power in my body has also reached a considerable scale. Like you previously mentioned, the Five Attribute Techniques probably aren't suitable for me," Yuan Ming explained, lifting his palm.
"I forgot about that; indeed, Five Attribute Techniques aren't quite right for you. You would need a Seven Attribute Technique," Qi Ye admitted.
"Unfortunately, these dozen or so Returning to Void Techniques are all Five Attribute ones; there aren't even any Six Attribute Techniques, let alone Seven Attribute Techniques," Yuan Ming sighed.
"Well... you could ask that Mao Yi. He manages Sui Xin Pavilion, so his knowledge in Cultivation Techniques must be profound; perhaps he has a solution," Qi Ye suggested, bereft of any better ideas.
Yuan Ming remained silent. He had considered asking that individual but didn't want to draw attention to himself. He preferred to cultivate quietly, as cultivating seven types of power might be a rare occurrence, and attracting unnecessary attention would be undesirable.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan need not worry. Possessing seven types of power isn't something extraordinarily rare. I'm not sure about Chuyun Realm, but in the Demon World, mutating Spirit Roots, refining Magical Treasures, and employing Secret Techniques with devouring effects can all generate Different Species Magic Power," Qi Ye discerned Yuan Ming's concerns and said.
Yuan Ming heard these words, pondered briefly, turned around, and walked toward the white-robed elder he had met earlier, to communicate his request and inquire about the Seven Attributes Technique.
"Fellow Daoist, you have seven types of Mana within you; that is extremely rare." Mao Yi put down the bamboo scroll and looked at Yuan Ming with a surprised expression.
"In my early years, I refined a Magical Treasure, and by some mistake, I acquired two additional types of Mana, which has led to the difficult situation I am in now, which was certainly not my intention." Yuan Ming gave a wry smile.
"I see, but as for the Seven Attributes Technique, I have never heard of it. There is definitely none in the Dongji Sea, perhaps there might be some in Central Continent," Mao Yi said while stroking his beard.
Yuan Ming heard this and felt his heart sink.
Seeing Mao Yi's expression, which did not seem evasive, could it be that Yuan Ming could only temporarily halt his Magic Practitioner's cultivation?
"Fellow Daoist, do not be discouraged. While we do not possess the Seven Attributes Technique at Sui Xin Pavilion, we do have several attributeless cultivation methods which you could try," Mao Yi suddenly suggested, changing the topic.
"Attributeless cultivation method?" Yuan Ming's eyes showed a trace of astonishment.
"In the Cultivation World, there are countless oddities and wonders. Occasionally, someone's body or Spirit Root undergoes mutations, giving rise to Mana that surpasses the categories of the Five Elements. Such cultivators cannot cultivate ordinary techniques, so to pave a path for these individuals, the predecessors created attributeless cultivation methods. It is suitable for any Spirit Root or Spiritual Body, and even ordinary Five Elements Spirit Root cultivators can practice it, though the effects may be somewhat inferior," Mao Yi said, shaking his head.
"I see. What kinds of attributeless cultivation methods are available at Sui Xin Pavilion?" Yuan Ming asked, feeling enlightened.
Mao Yi stood and walked to a nearby bookshelf. After a moment, he returned with three Jade Scrolls and handed them to Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming thanked him and projected his Divine Sense into them.
The Jade Scrolls only showed the beginning; the rest was sealed by a Forbidden spell.
The three techniques were: "Illusion Sound Technique", "Star Cloud Transformation", and "Primordial True Skill".
Ordinary Five Elements Techniques seek to manage attribute transformations, and deeper cultivation leads to more sophisticated transformations of the Five Elements.
Attributeless cultivation methods, on the contrary, do not pursue transformations of the Mana's attributes but rather its shape, transforming the Mana into various forms to be stored within the Dantian.
"Illusion Sound Technique" transforms Mana into a Sound Waves shape, "Star Cloud Transformation" turns Mana into a nebula-like form, and "Primordial True Skill" transforms Mana into a Mixed Hole Vortex.
Yuan Ming did not pay much attention to "Illusion Sound Technique" and "Star Cloud Transformation"; his gaze stayed on "Primordial True Skill".
According to the descriptions of the three techniques, "Illusion Sound Technique" excels in magical combat, "Star Cloud Transformation" is good at defense, and "Primordial True Skill" features a swallowing effect, even capable of consuming an opponent's Mana during combat.
Given Yuan Ming's unique circumstances, having seven kinds of Mana, a Mixed Hole form of Mana would be easier to suppress any internal conflicts. This technique, "Primordial True Skill", was clearly more suitable for him.
"It seems like Fellow Daoist has chosen 'Primordial True Skill', a truly excellent technique," Mao Yi said with a smile.
Yuan Ming indeed planned to cultivate the "Primordial True Skill", not only because he had seven kinds of Mana, but he also felt a significant affinity with this technique.
"Primordial True Skill" turns Mana into a Mixed Hole Vortex, which puts a considerable strain on the Dantian; therefore, it requires a secret technique to expand and strengthen the Dantian. Fortunately, Yuan Ming had already accidentally laid the foundation with the Mixed Hole Secret Technique, which was initially acquired by the Nine Yin Venerable from an unknown source.
Beyond its swallowing abilities, "Primordial True Skill" also features another aspect: once the practitioner forms the Mixed Hole Vortex, accelerating its rotation speed can increase the absorption rate of nature's spiritual energy, speeding up cultivation.
However, accelerating the Mixed Hole Vortex's rotation speed places a significant burden on the Dantian and Physical Body, making it intolerable for extended periods.
"Hehe, this 'Primordial True Skill' seems tailor-made for you. You have already mastered the Mixed Hole Secret Technique, and your Body Cultivation has reached the Wanxiang body level, making your Physical Body much more robust than ordinary Cultivators. Besides, with the Undying Tree, you need not worry at all," Qi Ye's voice rang out.
Yuan Ming nodded slightly; "Primordial True Skill" was indeed very suitable for him in many aspects.
Of course, while "Primordial True Skill" had several benefits, it also had significant drawbacks.
The biggest issue with this technique was that the Mana, constantly mixing and rotating, became quite chaotic. While daily cultivation progressed quickly, breakthroughs in stages proved exceptionally challenging.
Nevertheless, Yuan Ming had no better alternatives at the moment; worst case, once he completed the task for the Stealing Heaven Tripod Artifact Spirit, he could ask for a Seven Attributes Technique from it.
After all, that Stealing Heaven Tripod Artifact Spirit had initially boasted that it could satisfy any request of his.
"I'll choose this 'Primordial True Skill'. By the way, how many levels does this technique have, and what cultivation stage can it reach?" Yuan Ming asked.
"'Primordial True Skill' was obtained by chance by a Supreme Elder from Dongji Palace and is one of the few attributeless cultivation methods we possess that is relatively complete. There are six levels, and it can directly be cultivated up to the Dharma manifestation Stage. With Fellow Daoist Yuan's current Cultivation, you can start from the fifth level," Mao Yi explained.
"Thank you, Fellow Daoist," Yuan Ming said, bowing slightly.
Perhaps because the content of "Primordial True Skill" was quite comprehensive, the price was naturally not low, costing a total of nine hundred thousand Spirit Stones.
Yuan Ming had not looted any treasures from the Double Moon Alliance, instead leaving many of his Spirit Stones there. Now, with only a bit over a million Spirit Stones left, he reluctantly parted with a substantial amount to purchase "Primordial True Skill".

chapters.title: Chapter 793 - 764 Going with the Flow
chapters.content:
After purchasing the Cultivation Technique, Yuan Ming did not rush to leave; instead, he went to other bookshelves and bought a map of the Chuyun Realm and several geographic Classics.
According to the map, the Dongji Sea is located in the farthest eastern part of the Chuyun Realm, with the Abyss region lying even further east.
However, the Dongji Sea is not the entirety of the easternmost lands of the Chuyun Realm; those lands are vast beyond measure, and the Dongji Sea accounts for only a third of them. Southward lies the Luojia Sea, and northward lies the Azure Dragon Sea.
The powers that rule these two seas are named Luo Jia Mountain and Azure Dragon Pond, with strengths not inferior to Dongji Palace.
Especially the Azure Dragon Pond, which is a force of the Demon Clan, said to command all the demon beasts of the three seas in the eastern extremity, and is not to be underestimated.
Westward from the Dongji Sea lies an expansive and boundless continent—the Central Continent.
The Central Continent boasts vast terrain. Where it borders the three eastern seas, there stretches a continuous range of mountains, known as the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range.
Only by crossing the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range can one enter the true heart of Central Continent, where the Spirit Veins are richest and the resources most abundant in the entire Chuyun Realm.
"The Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range? When I possessed Wulu earlier, I saw endless mountains. Could it be the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range?" Yuan Ming murmured to himself.
His gaze rested on the central region of the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range, where a huge city stood, marked on the map as White Emperor City, where Xi Ying had awakened before.
According to the map and the Classics, White Emperor City is the most prosperous city within the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range.
Yuan Ming's eyes flickered, and he quickly put away the map and geographic Classics and left Sui Xin Pavilion.
He did not immediately return to Spiritual Ape Island, but continued to stroll around the island at leisure.
Sikong Zhan and the others following him naturally had no objections, still enthusiastically guiding and introducing places to him, and Yuan Ming let them be.
However, trouble soon found its way to them.
"Sikong Zhan, you truly made us search hard for you!"
Just as the group was passing in front of a teahouse, a sudden shout erupted from inside, and immediately afterward, three Cultivators clad in white robes flew out and landed in front of the group.
The newcomers, two males and one female, all appeared to be in their early twenties, but their Cultivation had already reached the Nascent Soul Stage, with the square-faced young man in the lead at Late-stage Nascent Soul.
Yuan Ming raised his eyebrows thoughtfully, looking at Sikong Zhan.
Sikong Zhan and the others had bitter expressions, looking as if they had not expected these three to appear.
"Fellow Daoists from the Bai family, as for the matter regarding Xinyao, we have already apologized to your island, and the dowry she accepted was returned intact. Why must your island stubbornly cling to this matter?" Sikong Zhan stepped forward with a salute.
"Hmph, Ye Xinyao's public fleeing from the marriage has disgraced our Bai family. How could your light apologies possibly compensate for that? As for the dowry, sending it back is only proper; otherwise, we would have issued a warrant for your arrest long ago, and you wouldn't be standing here today," coldly scolded a young male Cultivator among the three, with a hawk-like nose.
Ye Xinyao shuddered and lowered her head.
"Matters of marriage should involve mutual consent, your Bai family is too domineering!" Sikong Zhuo stepped in front of Ye Xinyao, shouting.
"Fellow seniors, Dongji Palace has already decreed that no one may go against a woman's wishes and force a marriage or concubine. Does Bai Han Island intend to openly defy Dongji Palace's orders?" Sikong Lin glanced at Sikong Zhuo and Ye Xinyao, a complex expression flitting across his eyes before regaining composure and speaking.
At the mention of Dongji Palace, many surrounding Cultivators also turned to look, and the three from the Bai family all trembled slightly.
"So eloquent with words. When my Bai family proposed, Ye Xinyao's parents agreed, and Ye Xinyao herself nodded in agreement. There was never any force involved," said the cold-voiced female Cultivator from the Bai family.
"Your Bai family is simply deceitful! That Bai Haoshan is only interested in my Hundred Herbs Spiritual Body; he wants to use me as a cauldron for replenishing himself in hopes of breaking through to Mid-stage Nascent Soul—not at all as the marriage proposal stated, to become the chief wife of Bai Haoshan!" Ye Xinyao's expression suddenly turned resolute as she retorted.
Upon hearing this, the expressions of everyone present changed.
The Palace Master of Dongji Palace, an unparalleled female Cultivator, takes great care of women, having set numerous protective decrees, and the act of harvesting is far more grievous than forced marriage.
"What! Bai Haoshan plans to use you as a cauldron, why didn't you speak up earlier!" Sikong Zhuo and Sikong Lin both turned pale, seemingly unaware of this matter.
Ye Xinyao did not respond, merely clenching her fists.
"Nonsense! My Bai family would never engage in the act of harvesting female Cultivators. You dare to backbite, making slanderous accusations here—if we don't take you back to set an example, wouldn't everyone come to look down upon Bai Han Island and the Bai family!" The female Cultivator from the Bai family roared furiously, with a flick of her right hand, an invisible force tugged at Ye Xinyao's body, pulling her straight toward her.This# cha*pter! is f.rom^ the c.oll+ecti!o#n. at M-VL$-E%M-&P*Y*R.@
"Stop!" Sikong Zhan immediately took action, a sharp wave of Sword Qi slashing in front of Ye Xinyao.
The square-faced young man's eyes glimmered with a cold smirk, and he made a light flicking motion with his sleeve.
Sikong Zhan's Sword Qi shattered, and he himself staggered back two steps to steady himself.
"You dare to start a fight here; aren't you afraid of Dongji Palace's people stepping in to punish you?" Sikong Zhan exclaimed in shock and anger.
"This woman publicly slandered our Bai family, insulting a Nascent Soul with her Core Formation cultivation. Even if Dongji Palace law enforcement were to come, we would have justification. But as for you, if you wish to challenge us here, you should think carefully," the square-faced youth sneered, showing a mocking expression.
"Then what crime would it be for you to make a move against her in my presence?" Just at that moment, Yuan Ming spoke indifferently.
Without any visible action from him, the force pulling at Ye Xinyao's body suddenly vanished, causing her to fall to the ground.
"Is... Sir a venerable Returning to Void senior?" The square-faced youth was taken aback upon seeing this, and the other two also looked at Yuan Ming with shocked faces.
Yuan Ming did not speak, but slowly stepped out from behind Sikong Zhan and his group, positioning himself in front of the Bai family cultivators.
He had deliberately repressed his Spiritual Power just now, so the three Bai family cultivators had not sensed his strength and took him for an unrelated passerby.
Now that Yuan Ming had stepped directly in front of them, they could clearly perceive his power, and their faces grew significantly uglier.
"I am Bai Jingshu from Bai Han Island, may I ask who the senior is..." The square-faced youth cupped his hands and asked.
"With your level of cultivation, you are not qualified to inquire about my origins," Yuan Ming said, not offering him any face.
"... The senior speaks the truth, but, Ye Xinyao's matter has already alerted our Island Master. If the senior wishes to protect him, the Island Master might choose to pay a personal visit. Please think it over, senior," Bai Jingshu said, his face stiffening, yet he dared not show anger and instead invoked the name of the Lord of Bai Han Island.
According to the intelligence Yuan Ming had recently gathered, Bai Han Island was a famous island in the Dongji Sea, and its Island Master had reached the middle stage of Returning Void. He was not only well-known but had also once astonishingly fought alone against three early-stage Returning to Void cultivators without defeat.
"Is that so? Then let him come. It would be good for me to fulfill the host's duties." Yuan Ming recalled the intelligence regarding Bai Han Island, smiling faintly, not taking Bai Jingshu's threat seriously.
"I will convey the senior's words to the Island Master exactly as spoken," Bai Jingshu's heart sank as he left a pale threat behind and hastily departed with the other two Bai family cultivators.
Yuan Ming watched their retreating figures, a glint of killing intent briefly crossing his eyes, but it soon vanished into nothingness.
Many had just witnessed their exchange, and even if Yuan Ming killed Bai Jingshu and the others in secret, the news would eventually reach Bai Han Island. Taking action now would instead provoke an endless battle.
With this thought, Yuan Ming thoroughly discarded the idea of ambushing them.
"Thank you, senior, for your assistance. We truly do not know how to repay such a great kindness," Meanwhile, Sikong Zhan and his group hurriedly bowed to Yuan Ming.
"It was merely a trivial matter, but it seems the Bai family will not give up easily. Do you have a place where you can hide from the Bai family's pursuit?" Yuan Ming turned his gaze towards Sikong Zhan.
"The island where we currently reside is relatively concealed; we should be able to hold out for some time. However, if the Island Master of Bai Han Island gets involved, I fear we can only surrender," Sikong Zhan said with a wry smile.
"In that case, I am currently in need of manpower. Why not come work on my island? When the Island Master of Bai Han Island arrives, I shall deal with it. You need not worry," Yuan Ming smiled and extended an invitation.
Sikong Zhan, seeing Yuan Ming's confidence, was reassured and eagerly accepted Yuan Ming's invitation.
Ye Xinyao and the others were also extremely pleased, repeatedly thanking Yuan Ming for his kindness.
"There's no need for that. You once helped me, so naturally, I should repay you. But if you face any difficulties in the future, you may come directly to me for help. I'll assist if I can. As for today's matter, it can only happen once; you must remember this," Yuan Ming, however, changed his tone and said so.
Upon hearing this, Sikong Zhan and his group all tightened their expressions, immediately affirming.
They had known about the presence of the Bai family here today and had brought Yuan Ming with them, hoping to use his strength to temporarily fend off the Bai family. If possible, they also wanted to directly pledge allegiance under Yuan Ming for protection.
Yuan Ming, who had long seen through their intentions using his Emotion Manipulation Ability, went with the flow and spoke to recruit them.
As for the potential troubles, it was just a middle-stage Returning Void Island Master; Yuan Ming truly did not fear him.
Moreover, a Returning to Void cultivator wouldn't make a big deal over a mere Core Formation issue. In Yuan Ming's view, there was still room for manoeuver in this matter.
After this interlude, Yuan Ming lost the desire to wander around. He took Sikong Zhan and the others to purchase a large amount of spiritual materials for refining Arrays and then returned to Spiritual Ape Island with them.
Back on the island, Yuan Ming called over the other cultivators and introduced Sikong Zhan and his group to them.
"Sikong Zhan, Sikong Zhuo, Sikong Lin, aside from praying earnestly every day, you three will be mainly responsible for spreading the teachings of the Moon Sect to Spiritual Ape Island and the nearby islands. If you do well, I will have rewards for you," Yuan Ming dismissed the others and said to Sikong Zhan and his group.
"The Moon Sect? Forgive my impertinence, but I haven't heard of this sect. May I know its doctrines?" Sikong Zhan pondered for a moment and asked.
"This is a sect I have created. All the teachings and some methods of preaching are within this. Just follow these instructions. Our sect does not require believers to do too much, the most important thing is sincere prayer," Yuan Ming took out a Jade Scroll and tossed it over.
Inside the Jade Scroll, the methods of preaching mentioned were akin to what Xu Che had done in the Yunhuang Continent years ago, the benefits being quite tempting for ordinary cultivators and mortals.
"Understood... If I may be so bold, Senior, do you practice both Soul Skill and other paths?" Sikong Zhan immediately accepted the task and then asked with a hint of surprise.
"I have dabbled in both," Yuan Ming replied upon hearing this.
Upon hearing this response, Sikong Zhan was overjoyed, feeling even more confident that Yuan Ming could protect them from the hands of the Island Master of Bai Han.

chapters.title: Chapter 794 - 765: Speak with Strength
chapters.content:
"May I ask the elder, what should I do?" At this time, Ye Xinyao, seeing that Yuan Ming had not arranged for her to go and spread the teachings as well, suddenly felt a bit nervous.
"You said before that you are a Hundred Herbs Spiritual Body, I remember those with this type of spiritual body can enhance the medicinal power of the spirit plants they cultivate by thirty percent?" Yuan Ming asked.
"Yes, but if the rank of the spirit plants cultivated is too high, the increase in medicinal power will be much less," Ye Xinyao explained.
"That's enough. Besides praying daily with sincerity like the others, from now on, you will be in charge of the spirit fields and the Medicine Garden on the island. However, aside from these existing ones, I need you to set aside an area specifically for the cultivation of Poisonous Grass. The quantity can be less, but the variety must be diverse, any questions?" Yuan Ming instructed.
"No, elder, rest assured, I will arrange everything carefully," Ye Xinyao replied with particular joy, immediately accepting the task.
She was a Spirit Plant Master by trade, most skilled in cultivating spirit plants. Although she did not know why Yuan Ming specifically wanted to cultivate Poisonous Grass, if it was just the variety that was required, she had plenty of seeds to choose from.
Yuan Ming's purpose in cultivating the Poisonous Grass was naturally to feed the Purple Extreme Tai Sui. The Dongji Sea was unlike Yunhuang; even without practicing Poison Skill, having an assortment of potent toxins might yield miraculous effects at any moment.
After arranging various matters, Yuan Ming waved his hand, dismissing Sikong Zhan and the others, and then he entered the Cave Mansion, taking out the spiritual materials he had purchased and a Jade Scroll.
The Jade Scroll recorded a Level 5 Array Formation—the Ten Thousand Water Green Wave Formation, which he had obtained through possession of Su Yingxue. Once the Formation was set up, it could enhance its power by utilizing the surrounding water currents. If it were to be laid out on Spiritual Ape Island, even a Returning to Void Cultivator in the Late Stage would have difficulty breaking through without considerable effort.
However, with Yuan Ming's current Array Formation Cultivation, it was still beyond his reach to set up such a Level 5 Formation on his own, fortunately, Su Yingxue had written down her entire array-setting process in detail. Yuan Ming only needed to follow it step by step to replicate the Formation entirely on the island.
But the setup of a Level 5 Magic Array was extremely complex. Even with the notes to help, Yuan Ming still needed to spend a considerable amount of time to properly complete it.
Therefore, for the following several months, Yuan Ming focused almost exclusively on this task, paying no attention to other matters.
Keep us going by reading on *.
...
Three months later, in the sea region where Spiritual Ape Island was located.
Three grand tunneling lights, each a hundred zhang long, tore through the sky from afar, hurtling towards Spiritual Ape Island in a straight line.
The lights emitted strong Mana fluctuations, indicating that they were all Returning to Void Cultivators. Wherever they passed, marine creatures scrambled to flee in terror.
"It's merely a new Returning Void, relying on some skills to act recklessly. Such a child, I, on behalf of Fellow Daoist Bai, will discipline him. Why bother having you personally take action?" said a small-eyed, thick-browed, astute-faced middle-aged man from within the light on the left, laughing as he spoke.
"Fellow Daoist Shen must not underestimate this man. He managed to defeat Silver Dragon Daoist and occupy Spiritual Ape Island, and he even dared to publicly defy my Bai Han Island. He must have something to rely on," said the man in white in the middle, speaking indifferently.
He was of average appearance, but his frame was robust. He wore a spotless white robe adorned with snowflake patterns. As he flew, the robe fluttered slightly, and the snowflakes seemed to really fall from it, as if it were a living snow landscape scroll.
This man was none other than the Lord of Bai Han Island, Bai Zhengxiong.
The thick-browed man who spoke first was Shen Fangyuan, the Island Master of Thousand Gold Island, with the Early Stage of Returning to Void Cultivation. He was very close friends with Bai Zhengxiong.
"Indeed, and this person's background is also quite mysterious. He has never had a reputation in Dongji Sea before, as if he just popped out of a rock," said another cultivator with a square face and a goatee, dressed in a blue robe, speaking next to Bai Zhengxiong.
"Does Fellow Daoist Shi also not know of this person's origins?" Shen Fangyuan asked with a start, eager to know more.
"I have sent letters to friends in other places to commission an investigation. The only thing that can be confirmed for now is that he is not a cultivator from Dongji Sea," the square-faced cultivator shook his head and added.
His name was Shi Huan, an elder of Dongji Palace, who in private dealt with the trading of information and acted as an intermediary. It was said that he could get any information as long as the price was right, and with Dongji Palace backing him, few dared to provoke him.
Even he did not know Yuan Ming's background, which implied something that made Shen Fangyuan feel an unexpected unease.
"Heh, a mysterious background does not mean anything; in the end, we cultivators must speak with our strength," Bai Zhengxiong seemed unconcerned.
Shen Fangyuan agreed with him, and recalling Bai Zhengxiong's past accomplishments, he felt somewhat reassured.
The group continued onwards, but they didn't travel far before another spirit light came from the horizon, landing in front of them.
"It turns out to be Yun Luo Fairy." Bai Zhengxiong saw the incoming person and immediately showed a warm smile.
"Fellow Daoists are...?" Yun Luo Fairy returned the greeting and, looking at the three men with some surprise, asked.
The commotion of three Returning to Void Cultivators passing by was not small, and having been disturbed while in seclusion on Yunshan Island, she had come to check on the situation.
"Hehe, I heard that Spiritual Ape Island has recently welcomed a new daoist whose skills are far from modest. I've come especially to meet them. Since you, Fairy, are a neighbor, how about you join us and introduce us?" Bai Zhengxiong laughed without revealing his true intentions.
"If Fellow Daoist Bai invites me, how could I dare decline?" Yun Luo Fairy feigned sudden realization, but her heart grew more cautious.
After Yun Luo Fairy joined them, Bai Zhengxiong and the others ceased their idle chatter and quickened their pace considerably, arriving at the outskirts of Spiritual Ape Island in less than half a day.
Seeing that the island's Forbidden had not changed much since the Silver Dragon Taoist's control, Shen Fangyuan's last bit of worry completely dissipated.
"Ha! The new daoist is quite thrifty, not even willing to change the Island Protection Array. It seems that this person must have offended someone elsewhere and fled to our Dongji Sea for refuge," Shen Fangyuan laughed.
A smile appeared on Bai Zhengxiong's face, and just as he was about to speak, a surge of Spiritual Energy burst forth from the center of Spiritual Ape Island. Mysterious array runes lit up everywhere on the island. The dense network of Spiritual Energy was like a giant net, enveloping the entire island.
The sea around the island also churned suddenly, sending up dozens of spiral water columns that connected to the Spirit Light Giant Net on the island, as if filling in the blank spaces between the lines on a painting.
Within just a few breaths, Spiritual Ape Island was completely shrouded in a light green Great Array. From the outside, the island's landscape was no longer visible. Only the ripples reflected the sky, integrating almost seamlessly with the surrounding seascape thanks to the difference in hues.
"Eh, this formation is really exquisite. I fear it has reached the Level 5 standard," Shi Huan's eyes lit up, and he couldn't help but marvel.
"Level 5 Formation? Impossible! He has only just taken over Spiritual Ape Island; how could he have invited those few Level 5 Array Masters to set up an array?" Shen Fangyuan's face flushed red as he exclaimed.
"To my knowledge, those masters are currently occupied with other important matters and should not have the time to help Fellow Daoist Yuan with setting up an array," Shi Huan shook his head, implying something more profound.
"Does Fellow Daoist Shi mean that this formation was laid by him himself?" Shen Fangyuan wore a look of disbelief.
"I dare not make unfounded claims, but there seems to be no other possibility," Shi Huan remained noncommittal.
"Fellow Daoist Shi is wrong. If he truly had such ability, with the vast world out there, he would be a respected guest and dominant figure anywhere he went, with access to superior Spirit Veins. Why would he condescend to take over Spiritual Ape Island?" Bai Zhengxiong shook his head in disbelief, yet his eyes held a trace of seriousness.
"What brings you honorable folks from afar?" Just then, Yuan Ming's figure emerged from the array, he swept a look over the four of them and asked indifferently.
"You must be Fellow Daoist Yuan Ming, I am Lord Bai Han, Bai Zhengxiong. Do you remember the recent matter on East Extreme Island?" Bai Zhengxiong sized up Yuan Ming.
"Of course, I remember. Fellow Daoist Bai is here for Ye Xinyao, right? She has now joined Spiritual Ape Island. I would ask you to be magnanimous and let her be, for my sake," Yuan Ming clasped his hands together, speaking politely.
"I can consider your face, but the face that my Bai family has lost, whom should I ask for?" Bai Zhengxiong said lightly.
"It seems that Fellow Daoist Bai is set on making trouble with me," Yuan Ming took a deep breath and smiled wryly.
"Ridiculous, you were the one who sheltered someone who had insulted my Bai family and opposed me. How can you blame me in return?" Bai Zhengxiong sneered.
"Since that's the case, let's judge the truth through a contest. Ye Xinyao is currently on Spiritual Ape Island. If you have the skills, you can try to seize her yourself," Yuan Ming's right hand formed a spell, and the Ten Thousand Water Green Wave Formation rapidly began revolving, ready to strike.
"Seems like you still don't understand the rules of Dongji Palace. If Returning to Void Cultivators have a private dispute, they can agree to a duel to resolve it. However, if someone attacks an island forcibly, it is seen as an enemy of Dongji Palace. If you have the courage, come out and fight me alone; otherwise, stay huddled on your island like a coward," Bai Zhengxiong's eyes flashed with wariness, clearly having no intention of attacking the formation.
Yuan Ming frowned slightly, his gaze sweeping over the people outside the array, pondering something.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, rest assured, I am an elder of Dongji Palace, and I will officiate this battle. I guarantee with the name of Dongji Palace that there will be no bias towards either party," Shi Huan mistook Yuan Ming's concern for fear of being attacked by multiple opponents and immediately reassured him with a smile, showing his elder's Token from Dongji Palace.
"It seems that Fellow Daoist Bai has come prepared. Well then, I shall accept Fellow Daoist Bai's challenge," Yuan Ming contemplated for a moment, shook his head, and with a flash, he walked out from the array.
Being new to the area, if he were to keep backing down, people would think him weak and easy to bully, and he might find more trouble coming his way in the future.
Moreover, he wanted to spread his teachings in the Dongji Sea, and he certainly couldn't afford to have a reputation for being faint-hearted. Otherwise, it would be difficult to gain Cultivator believers, let alone recruit mortal followers.
"Let us find another battlefield then, so as not to affect Spiritual Ape Island," Bai Zhengxiong said, turning to leave.
"Hehe, no need. We can just battle in the sky. It will only cause some minor disturbances. My Great Array is not that fragile, and besides, it won't take long," Yuan Ming called out to him.
He certainly would not rashly follow Bai Zhengxiong to another location, given that it might be a trap.
"Arrogant!" Bai Zhengxiong's expression darkened, and with a loud shout, he swiftly flew into the sky.
Yuan Ming gave a slight smile and flew up as well.

chapters.title: Chapter 795 - 766: Seeing Through
chapters.content:
Before long, a group of people all flew to the cloud top. Yuan Ming faced Bai Zhengxiong from afar, both ready to engage in battle, while those around them kept their distance and watched from afar.
"A duel of Returning to Void over a mere Core Formation really seems a bit unreasonable. How about this: if Fellow Daoist Yuan loses, he will leave Spiritual Ape Island and not challenge any other islands for a hundred years. If Fellow Daoist Bai loses, then he compensates with spirit stones equivalent to a hundred years of income of Spiritual Ape Island as a prize. What do you both think?" Just then, Shen Fangyuan suddenly spoke.
"I fear Fellow Daoist Yuan wouldn't dare to agree," Bai Zhengxiong sneered coldly.
Yuan Ming suddenly glanced at the void behind Bai Zhengxiong, revealing an expression of understanding.
"Why wouldn't I dare if it's picking up something cheap? I just hope Fellow Daoist Bai prepares the spirit stones in advance and doesn't renege later," Yuan Ming retracted his gaze and replied with a crisp laugh.
Upon hearing this, anger flashed in Bai Zhengxiong's eyes. His right hand fiercely formed a spell, and an invisible fluctuation surged from his body and spread rapidly around him.
Yuan Ming immediately felt a cold wind assault his face, messing up his hair and sleeves. The temperature around him plummeted suddenly, and then snowflakes as large as goose feathers began to fall out of thin air, as if it were the depths of winter.
The coldness seeped into Yuan Ming's body, even causing slight stagnation in the circulation of his qi-blood and spiritual power.
Simultaneously, Bai Zhengxiong's aura surged. With another raise of his hand, thousands of pale ice rings appeared in the snowstorm, spinning furiously towards Yuan Ming, threatening to utterly demolish him.
Yuan Ming's expression darkened slightly, his arms blurring momentarily as he unleashed hundreds of punches. The dense fist winds formed a solid wall, blocking and shattering the incoming ice rings.
At the same time, he took the opportunity to close in on Bai Zhengxiong, aiming to launch a fierce melee attack.
Bai Zhengxiong seemed to have anticipated Yuan Ming's thoughts. As soon as he made a move, Bai Zhengxiong immediately spat out a palm-sized white banner, which grew several meters tall as it fluttered in the wind.
Next, Bai Zhengxiong hit the white banner with a spell, and instantly, images appeared on its originally blank surface—strange white shadows hidden within the snowstorm.
The next instant, the snowflakes falling from the sky increased several times over, howling winds came rushing in, and heavy snow whirled about, completely blocking Yuan Ming's vision, and Bai Zhengxiong's figure also disappeared into the blizzard.
Seeing Bai Zhengxiong's figure vanish and even unable to lock onto him with his Divine Sense, Yuan Ming forcefully halted mid-air, slightly frowning as he looked around, feeling the chill within his body slowly building up, gradually affecting the circulation of his qi-blood and mana.
Thus, he immediately activated the Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill, radiating waves of heat from within, driving away all the coldness.
But just then, among the whizzing snowstorms, a chaotic howling sound arose, followed by hundreds of green-eyed, white-furred wolf demons with icy claws leaping out of the surrounding snow.
Their claws, formed of ice, emanated chilling coldness that struck awe into anyone merely by looking.
Faced with the assault of these wolf demons, Yuan Ming decisively countered with punches. Surprisingly, the wolf demons were not particularly strong; their bodies shattered upon contact, failing entirely to approach Yuan Ming, let alone attack him.
However, each time a wolf demon was dispersed by Yuan Ming, a trace of coldness would invade his body. Even though Yuan Ming would expel it with his techniques, it still gradually drained his physical strength.
Moreover, those disassembled wolf demons did not die but turned into a cloud of snowflakes, which were swept up by the wild wind and instantly reformed, once again charging at Yuan Ming.
"Cold Snow Tide Skill of the Fourfold Transformation, seeing this person struggle so pitifully with the first level is truly disappointing," commented Shen Fangyuan with a mocking smile as he watched on the side.This chapter was made possible by the * community.
"Fellow Daoist Bai, with his profound cultivation, has studied this spirit art for many years, and combined with his Lifebound Magical Treasure, it's not so easy for ordinary Returning Void cultivators to break through. If Fellow Daoist Yuan wants to lose less embarrassingly, I'm afraid he needs to pull out some trump techniques," Elder Shi also commented, clearly not optimistic about Yuan Ming's situation.
As if proving his point, Yuan Ming, hindered by the wolf demons, now looked significantly more solemn.
Suddenly, spirit light faintly appeared in his eyes. He then looked around, his eyes gleaming as if he could see through the snowstorm and locate Bai Zhengxiong.
Bai Zhengxiong was also looking into Yuan Ming's eyes at the same time, feeling an inexplicable shock in his heart. He hurriedly urged his Lifebound Magical Treasure, casting another spell.
Only to see the white strange shadows on the banner quickly receding, replaced by dense white ice flowers filling every empty corner.
However, in the next moment, before Bai Zhengxiong's magic could take effect, Yuan Ming's body seemed to ignite red Blood Flames. His left arm was raised in front, right fist drawn back at his abdomen, and even sounds like a surging river of blood boiling resonated from his body.
In an instant, the surrounding snowstorm seemed tamed and no longer scattered randomly downward but revolved around Yuan Ming, whirling in his presence. The rushing wolf demons did not even require Yuan Ming's directstrike to crumble by themselves, turning into snow in the same manner, submitting under the influence of the aura emanating from Yuan Ming.
Bai Zhengxiong felt his heart tighten and hurriedly sped up the manipulation of his spell, his figure disappearing again and reappearing hundreds of meters away in a blink.
However, Yuan Ming's eyes firmly locked onto him. As soon as Bai Zhengxiong reappeared, Yuan Ming also fiercely swung his fist. The surrounding void instantly solidified, the force of heaven and earth rapidly gathering around his right fist and launching it out with his Fist Power.
The next moment, a massive pale elephant, entirely formed of ice, materialized and charged furiously towards the newly appeared Bai Zhengxiong, reaching him in just half a breath's time.
Bai Zhengxiong paled dramatically, instinctively shook the banner.
But then the giant elephant crashed into his body, with a loud "boom". The ice and snow in the sky were blown away by the blast, clearing the view for the onlookers like Shi Huan, who soon saw Bai Zhengxiong's body full of cracks.
Before they could express their astonishment, Bai Zhengxiong's body completely split open, turning into falling ice and snow, while not far away, a pale-faced Bai Zhengxiong reappeared, gasping heavily, his fingers clutching the banner turned white, showing a lingering dread.
Just then, a loud explosion suddenly came from behind Bai Zhengxiong. Startled, he quickly turned around to see a fist the size of a pot hurtling towards his face.
"I admit defeat!" he decisively shouted, as he channeled all his mana toward his Lifebound Magical Treasure, bracing for a final struggle.
However, Yuan Ming's fist ultimately stopped just half an inch from his face, and the fierce gust caused only by the motion messied his hair without inflicting any damage.
