"Thanks for the concession," Yuan Ming nodded, retracting his fist and stepping away.
Onlookers like Shen Fangyuan were completely dumbfounded, not expecting that Bai Zhengxiong, who initially had the upper hand, would be defeated by Yuan Ming in mere moments.
"To harness the energy of the heavens and earth to empower one's Fist Power and even convert Fellow Daoist Bai's summoned wind and snow to his own advantage, Fellow Daoist's Cultivation Technique is truly profound. May I ask under which master you studied?" Shi Huan exclaimed, bowing with clasped hands towards the approaching Yuan Ming.
"Just a nameless Loose Cultivator, it's just good luck and some opportunities I came across," Yuan Ming shook his head slightly, reluctant to say more.
"I see, my apologies for the presumption," Shi Huan was not offended.
Just then, Yuan Ming suddenly turned and threw a punch towards a cluster of white clouds in the nearby sky.
The punch dispersed the white clouds with a thunderous noise, and a figure staggered out, revealing itself to be Silver Dragon Taoist.
"A battle for the island is fair and reasonable, if Fellow Daoist remains unconvinced, you are welcome to apply for a rematch at Dongji Palace. But if any underhanded tactics are used next time, do not blame me for being ruthless and ending your promising path to immortality."
Yuan Ming's voice contained no hint of emotional fluctuations, yet Silver Dragon Taoist's face was dark as water, not daring to speak. He simply left a resentful glance and flew away.
Yuan Ming simply smirked and looked away, knowing in his heart that had he not been reluctant to kill, causing ire amongst the cultivators of Dongji Sea, he wouldn't have let him go so easily.
"Fellow Daoist Bai, I've just arrived here and only wish to find a tranquil place to cultivate in seclusion. I hope you won't let yourself be swayed by others in the future, to avoid tarnishing your own reputation," Yuan Ming then turned to Bai Zhengxiong.
Bai Zhengxiong was both embarrassed and annoyed, muttering a vague response before turning away to leave, eager to stay no longer.
Seeing this, Shen Fangyuan hurriedly followed.
"Ah, Fellow Daoist Yuan, please forgive me. I believed only one side of Fellow Daoist Bai's story without expecting Silver Dragon Taoist to stir up trouble. Rest assured, the rules were set by us at Dongji Palace. I'll report this once I return, and we won't let someone bother you again," Shi Huan, however, stayed behind and spoke politely with a chuckle.
"With Elder Shi's words, I am at ease," Yuan Ming discerned Shi Huan's intentions of making connections and did not turn him away.
Times changed, and now that he was rooted on Spiritual Ape Island, he needed a period of peace. To coldly reject others from afar was not wise.
"That's good to hear. But, it's indeed my negligence; I happen to have a pot of fine wine on me, as an apology. Would Fellow Daoist Yuan care to join me for a drink?" Shi Huan added.
"It's I who should be hosting as the landlord. Perhaps Yun Luo Fairy would also care to join us?" Yuan Ming replied, looking towards Yun Luo Fairy.
Yun Luo Fairy naturally did not refuse, and the three returned to Spiritual Ape Island where they enjoyed a feast, making for a merry gathering which ended in good spirits.
When it was time to leave, Yuan Ming, as previously agreed, plucked two pieces of White Infant Fruit and handed them to Yun Luo Fairy.
"Thank you for your protection, Island Master. Your great kindness is something I can hardly repay," only Ye Xinyao was on the island as Situ Zhan and the others were not around. She fell beside Yuan Ming and knelt down.
"Stand up, since you have joined Spiritual Ape Island, I naturally will protect you," said Yuan Ming indifferently, waving his sleeve to release a force that lifted Ye Xinyao.
"Then, I'll get busy," Ye Xinyao said few words, bowing to Yuan Ming before starting to leave.
"Wait, pick a spot with nice feng shui on the island and build a tomb," Yuan Ming suddenly stopped Ye Xinyao.
"A tomb? Understood," Ye Xinyao was surprised but asked no further.
Yuan Ming gazed at the vast sea. Originally in Shura Palace, he had promised the Residual Soul of Shura Master to bring his body to be buried in the Overseas World. Although Dongji Sea was remote, it was still part of the Overseas World, so he decided to fulfill that wish here.
Yuan Ming did not linger there and turned back to his Cave Mansion.

chapters.title: Chapter 796 - 767 Slow Progress
chapters.content:
Time had flown, and over five months had passed.
In these months, the news of Yuan Ming's competition with Bai Zhengxiong gradually spread, attracting many Returning Void Cultivators from afar who wished to befriend Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming, on his part, welcomed all comers, greatly expanding his network and gradually integrating into the circle of Dongji Sea's Returning Void Cultivators.
During this process, Fairy Yun Luo was quite helpful.
As Yuan Ming's neighbor, she would come by every so often, sometimes inviting Yuan Ming to various trade fairs and symposiums. Initially, Yuan Ming was very grateful for her enthusiastic help, but as time went on, he began to find it somewhat troublesome.
As a Spoken Witch who had mastered the Emotion Manipulation Skill, Yuan Ming was highly sensitive to the emotional changes in others. Each time he met and talked with Fairy Yun Luo, her sparkling eyes and overly apparent thoughts made Yuan Ming feel like a thorn was pressed against his back, causing him great discomfort.
Therefore, when Fairy Yun Luo visited once again, Yuan Ming took the initiative to clarify matters.
"Fairy Yun Luo, you hail from the Central Continent Su Nu Sect, don't you?" Yuan Ming asked.
"Hehe, it's rare that Fellow Daoist Yuan takes an interest in my affairs. Yes, I do come from the Su Nu Sect, although I haven't had much contact with the sect for a long time," Fairy Yun Luo replied with a light laugh.
"I heard that the cultivation techniques of the Su Nu Sect require a Daoist companion for significant advancement. Yet, I see you often alone; why not find a companion?" Yuan Ming inquired tactfully.
"Hehe, you might think highly of yourself, but in the Dongji Sea, few can catch my eye, and there are even fewer like Fellow Daoist Yuan. Since you brought it up, why don't we..." Fairy Yun Luo's eyes suddenly shimmered with emotion.
Yuan Ming hadn't expected Fairy Yun Luo to be so direct and nearly choked on his tea, coughing twice before hastily interrupting, "I appreciate your kindness and help during this period, Fellow Daoist Yun Luo, but I already have a companion, so I must decline your offer."
"...If that's the case, why have I never seen your companion these days?" Fairy Yun Luo asked, taken aback.
"She has currently gone to the Central Continent, and we are temporarily apart," Yuan Ming explained truthfully.
"My sect possesses a secret technique that can probe a man's Primordial Yang. If I am not mistaken, Fellow Daoist Yuan, you have reached Primordial Yang Perfection and are still a virgin. There's no need to fabricate such a flimsy lie just to reject me," Fairy Yun Luo said with a twinkling eye and a light laugh.
"What I've said is no lie, and as a Loose Cultivator, I'm surely not a match for someone of a prestigious origin like Fellow Daoist Yun Luo," Yuan Ming shook his head and continued.
"We are both Returning Void cultivators; there is no real distinction between those from prestigious sects and Loose Cultivators. Besides, your strength is remarkable, and as a Level 5 Array Master, it wouldn't take long to establish your own sect and become a feudal lord," Fairy Yun Luo laughed, showing no signs of backing down.
"Regardless, I truly cannot accept your feelings, Fairy Yun Luo. I've also been somewhat neglecting my cultivation lately and am considering going into seclusion. After today, it might be a long time before we meet again. Please do as you wish," Yuan Ming said with a wry smile, decisively ending the topic and escorting the guest out with tea.
"Since Fellow Daoist Yuan is busy, I won't impose any longer. I'll visit again once you come out of seclusion," Fairy Yun Luo said carefreely with a smile, then departed.
Yuan Ming smiled bitterly to himself, resolving that even after ending his seclusion, he would not let Fairy Yun Luo know.
The Island Protection Array was already set up, and the missionary work of Sikong Zhan and his group was on the right track. Yuan Ming took out the "Primordial True Skill" and began to comprehend it.
With his current level of insight, he mastered this cultivation technique without spending much time.
As he cultivated according to the technique, the seven types of mana in his body were activated, converging towards his Dantian and slowly revolving, soon forming a swirling Mixed Hole Vortex that continued to whirl.
Time swiftly flowed, and soon half a day had passed. The internal situation in the Dantian calmed down; the mana turbulence that used to occur when operating the Nine Elements Technique wasn't present, and the seven types of mana rotated on their own, peacefully coexisting.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming finally let out a sigh of relief and then quickened the speed of the Mixed Hole Vortex, drawing in nature's spiritual energy.
Streams of spiritual energy eagerly converged towards him, integrating into his body at a rate more than twice as fast as when using the Nine Elements Technique.
Yuan Ming was inwardly delighted, yet the strength of his physical body was immense, and the current speed of the Mixed Hole Vortex hadn't even reached the limits that his body could withstand.
With this thought, he sped up the operations of "Primordial True Skill," bringing together a majestic flow of nature's spiritual energy, which soon reached five times that of the initial rate.
He felt a faint tingling all over his body, clearly having reached the limit.
"This rate of cultivation is nearly ten times that of ordinary Returning Void cultivators, but it's still not enough. I want it even faster!" Yuan Ming thought spiritedly, motivating the Undying Tree within his Dantian.
His skin turned black, his limbs morphed into thick tree trunks, and his body quickly transformed into a tall Undying Tree.
As an Undying Tree, his physical strength increased once again, also gaining tremendous regenerative power.
Yuan Ming then further increased the velocity of the Mixed Hole Vortex, reaching fifteen times the drawing speed of nature's spiritual energy compared to ordinary Returning Void cultivators.
The rich, nearly liquefied spiritual energy filled his entire body, circulated through his meridians, and merged into the vortex in his Dantian, rapidly increasing his mana.
A surge of joy leaped in Yuan Ming's heart. The "Primordial True Skill" seemed tailor-made for him, and the sensation of such rapid increase in mana was truly delightful.
"Having Mana escalate too quickly is not a good thing; remember, the 'Primordial True Skill' itself can cause Mana instability. And with your fast advancement in Cultivation, it might become exceedingly difficult for you to break through to the middle stage of Returning Void," Qi Ye's voice suddenly rang out, reminding him.
"I know, but I think breaking through to the middle stage of Returning Void shouldn't be a big problem," Yuan Ming chuckled, his tone light.
"Oh, do you have a method?" Qi Ye asked curiously.
"I plan to use this." Yuan Ming nodded and took out a white jade bottle, the container for the Three Light Divine Water.
The Three Light Divine Water could refine the body, but when Hua Zhi previously used it, he unexpectedly discovered that it not only refined the Physical Body but also had a certain refining effect on Mana.
He was risking the entire bottle of Three Light Divine Water, but it should suffice to significantly refine his Mana and make breaking through to the middle stage of Returning Void feasible.
"The Three Light Divine Water indeed has some effects, but that's all you have. What about later, when you need to break through the late stage of Returning Void or even advance to the Dharma Manifestation Stage?" Qi Ye asked.
"We'll worry about the future later. With such abundant resources in the Overseas Immortal Cultivation World, there will definitely be items with effects similar to the Three Light Divine Water," Yuan Ming replied, unfazed.
"That's also true," Qi Ye said, no longer pressing the matter.Keep us going by reading on *.
Yuan Ming put away the bottle and continued to cultivate, his expression suddenly showing surprise.
Previously, he had only been verifying the effects of the 'Primordial True Skill' and had not paid attention to the Undying Tree. Just now, as he calmed his emotions and circulated his cultivation, he discovered that the demonic power of the Undying Tree was also circulating in the manner of the 'Primordial True Skill,' rapidly absorbing nature's spiritual energy and enhancing its demonic power.
"This Undying Tree has been cultivating instinctively all along, but now it has changed its cultivation method; it seems that the 'Primordial True Skill' is indeed not simple," Yuan Ming thought to himself.
With the dense spiritual energy on Spiritual Ape Island, and the Gathering Spirit Tree gathering more spiritual energy, he was not overly concerned about the Undying Tree consuming some; he continued to immerse himself in cultivation.
Yuan Ming's main soul flew out of the Cave Mansion, cultivating the Moonlight Technique, while his first soul, as before, controlled the Qi-Blood Power within his body, circulating the Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill, and absorbing the Power of the Sun from the void.
...
Time flew swiftly, and in the blink of an eye, seasons changed from spring to winter, and sixty years passed.
In Yuan Ming's secluded spot, a huge Undying Tree dominated the Cave Mansion, its size having grown several times larger than before, with its canopy almost touching the cave's stone ceiling and its hanging vines forming a thick carpet covering every corner of the Cave Mansion.
The demonic power emanating from the Undying Tree had impressively reached the middle stage of Level 5, its aura robust and formidable, commanding respect.
At that moment, the Undying Tree suddenly transformed, its branches and leaves quickly shrinking, and almost instantly, Yuan Ming's figure reappeared.
By now, Yuan Ming's own Mana had successfully broken through to the middle stage of Returning Void.
Cultivating 'Primordial True Skill' and overcoming the bottleneck in Cultivation had indeed been extraordinarily difficult. He had exhausted an entire bottle of Three Light Divine Water to barely manage a successful breakthrough.
During these sixty years, Yuan Ming had not slackened in his cultivation of Soul and Body Cultivation.
His Divine Soul Power had finally progressed further, entering the mid-stage of Word Witch, while his Body Cultivation was slightly behind, although there was progress, it was still in the early stages of the Wandxiang Body.
Such progress in a mere sixty years would have thrilled any other Returning to Void Cultivator, but a smile was rare on Yuan Ming's face at this time.
He raised his hand and summoned the Stealing Heaven Tripod, carefully counting the number of Vow Power Pills inside.
Neither more nor less, there were only forty.
More than half of the century had already passed, but the number of Vow Power Pills was far from sufficient.
Yuan Ming sighed softly, adjusted his appearance slightly, and then stepped out of the secluded Cave Mansion.
Moments later, on Spiritual Ape Island, Yuan Ming summoned Sikong Zhan and others, listening to their reports.
"The mortals and cultivators on Spiritual Ape Island have now pledged allegiance to the Moon Sect, praying regularly every day. Even the mortals and low-level cultivators on the nearby islands have also begun to worship the Nether Moon God about seventy percent..." Sikong Zhan said respectfully.
The Dongji Sea was vast, with distant travels between islands, and almost all islands with Spirit Veins were occupied by cultivators and brought under the rule of Dongji Palace. Despite Sikong Zhan's efforts to develop the Moon Sect, he had to abide by the rules set by Dongji Palace, and could only progress step by step.
Considering the scale of the Moon Sect after sixty years, he had been very dedicated.
But for Yuan Ming, these accomplishments still seemed like a drop in the bucket.
Yuan Ming concealed his disappointment, firstly praising Sikong Zhan and bestowing many rewards, and also provided some guidance on his cultivation doubts. He then encouraged him to broaden his efforts and speed up the growth of believers.
Sikong Zhan naturally rejoiced, thanking Yuan Ming profusely, and assured him that he would double his efforts to further expand the followers of the Moon Sect.

chapters.title: Chapter 797 - 768: Taking a Different Path
chapters.content:
After Sikong Zhan left, Yuan Ming also started to ponder alone on ways to recruit believers more quickly to accelerate the aggregation of the Vow Power Pill.
At that moment, Hua Zhi and Vajra came from outside.
"Master, your brows are all knotted up. Are you troubled by something?" Hua Zhi, brimming with excitement and eager to report something, saw Yuan Ming's pensive face and immediately tilted her head, curiously asking.
She had already made a breakthrough during the sixty years of Yuan Ming's seclusion and had not been in seclusion since then, but was active in the waters near Spiritual Ape Island.
The breakthrough to Level 5 had significantly improved her abilities. According to her, besides the usual enhancements, her spore ability had evolved again, allowing her to switch between two different forms.
One was the highly toxic form. In this form, the spores were extremely poisonous and could kill a person quickly, turning their body into a corpse covered with beautiful, blooming flowers. Even a Returning Void cultivator would have to spend a lot of energy to suppress the poison or they too would succumb to the poison and die.
The other was the healing form. Hua Zhi could absorb and store the Spiritual Power contained in an enemy's body through her spores, and produce a powder-white flower on her body without any poison. The flower contained pure Spiritual Power, which when consumed, could rapidly restore physical strength and Mana.
With these two abilities complimenting each other, even regular Returning Void cultivators might not be a match for Hua Zhi, hence Yuan Ming felt reassured about letting her operate outside.
"It's just the slow acquisition of Vow Power Pills that's worrying me," Yuan Ming responded to Hua Zhi with a sigh, not really expecting her to be able to help.
Unexpectedly, Hua Zhi's next statement jolted him awake like a revelation in a dream.
"What's so difficult about that, Master? In Dongji Sea, I have also subjugated many demon beasts as my subordinates, many of whom have awakened their spiritual intelligence. I have made them worship the Nether Moon God as well. Why not capture more Level 4 demon beasts to serve as believers for you, Master? This way, wouldn't there be an additional source of Vow Power?" Hua Zhi excitedly proposed.
"Right, how did I not think of that?" Yuan Ming's eyes brightened, and he immediately stood up with a slap on the armrest of his chair.
"Hehe, I'm glad I can relieve Master of some worries. Just wait, Master; I'll handle it right now." Hua Zhi said and, excitedly turning around, she left.
Yuan Ming did not stop her but instead started pacing excitedly in the hall.
"Demon beasts have always been enemies to humans. Forcing them to worship is not an evil act, nor does it violate the rules of Dongji Palace. This could indeed be considered an innovative approach. In dealing with ordinary cultivators, however, such tactics must never be used. But for those cultivators who betrayed me, like Ye San and Ruan Hongxiang, it's a different matter altogether…" Yuan Ming contemplated, his smile growing wider.
Soon, he had an idea. With a big wave of his hand, he took the confused-looking Vajra into the Spiritual Beast Bag, and then left Spiritual Ape Island to head directly to the Dongji Islands.
…
East Pole Deputy Island, Greedy Wolf Palace.
Unlike Liuyun Palace, which was responsible for the distribution of islands, Greedy Wolf Palace was the law enforcement hall established by Dongji Palace.
Any cultivator who violated the rules set by Dongji Palace or engaged in wrongdoing would have their name recorded on the wanted list in Greedy Wolf Palace. Regardless of who it was, as long as someone could capture the offenders and bring them to justice, they could exchange the capture for rewards from Greedy Wolf Palace.
The purpose of Yuan Ming's visit was precisely this place.
The external structure of Greedy Wolf Palace was a circular grand hall, with a towering blood-red Stone Pillar standing at the central position. Countless chains wrapped with red cloth were tightly wound around the pillar's body, covered with little black spots, appearing like traces left by dried blood.
When Yuan Ming walked into the grand hall, he noticed that there were not many people inside. The Dongji Palace cultivators stationed here did not come over to greet him.
Yuan Ming was happy with this arrangement and walked by himself to the front of the central Stone Pillar, pressing his hand against one of the chains.
In an instant, countless names and bounties flooded into Yuan Ming's Sea of Consciousness. He picked several hundred names of different cultivators quickly.
The crimes these people had committed were so shocking that even Yuan Ming was alarmed. The only reason they had not been captured, it seemed, was that their whereabouts were hard to trace.
But this was not a problem for Yuan Ming.
He memorized the appearances and information of these people and then left Greedy Wolf Palace without delay. He found an inn on the Dongji Islands, rented a room, set up multiple Forbidden arrangements, and then summoned the Stealing Heaven Tripod and twisted a stick of Black Incense.
"Fan Hai, Nascent Soul cultivator, for refining Magical Treasure, slaughtered three islands, offering a blood sacrifice of a million commoners…"
Yuan Ming silently recalled the names and appearances of the people on the wanted list, then lit the Black Incense. His vision shifted, entering the body of Fan Hai.
In a short while, Yuan Ming finished the possession, standing up again with a hint of a smile on his face.
He took out the map of Dongji Sea that he had bought, confirmed the position, marked the location where Fan Hai was, and then left with Vajra at high speed, beginning his plan.
…
One year later, Shuilan Island.
The night had deepened. Ning Qingshui, the Shuilan Island Master, had just returned to her room to meditate and rest when she saw the maid coming in with a tray of sandalwood.
"Island Master, this is the Concentration Incense that was just delivered today," the maid said respectfully.
"Light it," Ning Qingshui waved her hand, casually instructing.
From some point, it became fashionable on Shuilan Island to light a stick of sandalwood incense during cultivation. Although Ning Qingshui, the Returning Void Island Master, was not particularly interested in this practice, she eventually acquired the habit due to the earnest recommendations and filial piety of her disciples.
"Yes." The maid bowed slightly, respectfully opened the incense burner, and inserted a stick of sandalwood for Ning Qingshui, then lit it and exited the room.
Smoke gracefully rose and soon filled the room, the scent no different from usual.
Like any other day, Ning Qingshui closed her eyes and began her daily meditation.
However, two hours later, Ning Qingshui suddenly felt a wave of dizziness invade her mind. She became somewhat frantic, opened her eyes, and tried to call for someone, but her body suddenly went limp, and she couldn't summon any mana.
"Haha, how do you like the taste of being an Immortal now, Ning Fairy?" Just then, the maid who had left returned, but the voice that spoke was that of a man.Please read this chapter on its original platform—*.
"You, you are…" Ning Qingshui was utterly terrified, but she was so weak that she could not even utter a complete sentence.
The maid swept her right hand across her face, and with a flash of green light, she transformed into a man.
His appearance was exceptionally handsome, his eyebrows like willow leaves, his eyes like the cold moon, and with a head of black hair casually draped down, it didn't seem messy but possessed a unique charm.
Unfortunately, when he smiled, the unintentional release of a lewd aura instantly dissipated any positive impression others might have of him.
"Ning Fairy, your beauty is renowned far and wide, it has truly haunted my dreams for many days. To become your husband for one night today is a great fortune of my life," the man said, walking slowly to the bed, and his fingers gently grazing Ning Qingshui's exposed skin, causing her to shudder in disgust.
Ning Qingshui then recognized the man. His name was Fei Shang, and he was one of the most notorious Returning Void Cultivators of the Dongji Sea.
Compared with other malevolent cultivators, Fei Shang did not have many blood debts. In fact, he rarely killed people and even saved many lives. However, he had a particularly despicable hobby—his love for women.
Logically, in the Cultivation World, this tendency would not be significant as many Returning Void cultivators had multitudes of wives and concubines, but Fei Shang's infamy did not rise from this alone.
Regrettably, his taste was a bit special; it was not merely about liking women, but he relished the feeling of defiling others.
Therefore, he often went out "flower-picking," targeting those who were already devoted to someone or upheld their chastity, thus offending many cultivators of the Dongji Sea, yet he persistently enjoyed his pursuits.
Until one day, during the marriage of a certain elder's daughter in Dongji Palace, he rendered the groom unconscious, defiled the bride, and incited the wrath of Dongji Palace. They placed him on a bounty list, and after being hunted by numerous Returning Void, he was forced to disappear, hidden for over a hundred years.
Who could have imagined that such a debaucher could have been lurking by one's side?
"Tsk tsk, Ning Fairy, why wear such a sorrowful expression? You'll be enjoying yourself soon," said Fei Shang with a laugh, reaching for Ning Qingshui's waist.
"Ah, such good incense, yet you use it for such deeds, truly a waste of heaven's gifts." Just then, a long sigh resounded in the room.
"Who's there? Come out!" Fei Shang's face drastically changed, and he immediately scanned the surroundings with his Divine Sense.
But the next moment, his expression turned terrified as if he had seen something that frightened him.
Yuan Ming, wearing a mask, slowly walked out from the shadows of the room. Before he could command, Hua Zhi emerged from the ground, injecting spores into Fei Shang's body and tightly binding him with vines.
Meanwhile, Fei Shang also regained his senses, but it was too late to struggle.
"Spoken Witch… Level 5 Spiritual Beast… How much did Dongji Palace spend to get you to capture me?" Fei Shang quickly calmed down and asked.
Yuan Ming was not interested in wasting words with him. With a wave of his hand, he let Hua Zhi use the vines to gag him, then turned and left with him, leaving Ning Qingshui limp on the bed until the break of dawn, when she finally recovered.
…
Two years later, Withered Leaf Island.
This island was once a place with high-grade Spirit Veins, but during a clash between Returning Void Cultivators, the veins were damaged by the aftershocks, and since then, the island had been abandoned, no longer attracting anyone's interest.
However, deep under the sea beneath the island, a massive undersea Cave Mansion was situated at the ocean floor, hidden by a secret Great Array, escaping the eyes of many cultivators.
In the Cave Mansion's pharmacy, Core Formation Cultivator Hao Shang was listlessly using a mortar and pestle, occasionally sneakily glancing toward the entrance of the pharmacy as if waiting for something.
"Xu Chunsheng, Yan Hua, come with me. Master wants to see you," suddenly, a Core Formation cultivator in a dark cyan robe with a pale face walked into the pharmacy and called out two names.
The two named individuals immediately turned pale, their eyes filled with fear and resistance.
However, the Core Formation cultivator in the dark cyan robe was somewhat impatient. He casually pulled out a copper bell and shook it, causing the called individuals to cry out in pain and roll on the ground holding their heads.
"Hurry up, I don't want to say it again." The newcomer cursed as he put down the copper bell, grabbed the two, who were now like dead pigs, and walked out of the pharmacy.
Meanwhile, Hao Shang also put down his mortar and pestle.
Because his awaited opportunity had arrived.

chapters.title: Chapter 798 - 769: The End of the Century
chapters.content:
The old monster of the Returning Void Realm who occupied the cave mansion would only open the furnace once a day. Now that the "human material" had been taken away, it meant that for the next two hours, he would focus solely on Alchemy, paying no attention to the happenings in the cave mansion.
Hao Shang thought this as he quickly walked over to a young man with white hair in the pharmacy.
"It's time to start." He whispered into the young man's ear.
The young man seemed unable to see. Upon hearing Hao Shang's words, he silently nodded, took out a small knife from his sleeve, and cut open the palm of his right hand.
Bright red blood immediately oozed from the wound, and soon after, a thumb-sized Gu Worm timidly emerged.
"The Soul-devouring Worm needs at least an hour to create a breach in the formation; we must hurry..." The young man's words were abruptly cut off by a loud noise.
"Oh? I didn't expect that after hiding for so long, I'd still be found. I wonder which Fellow Daoist has been tasked with apprehending me this time?" Following the loud noise, a hoarse voice, like a ghost's wail, echoed from deep within the cave mansion.
"Qu Jiuhuang, was it you who destroyed Wangyou Island, using the hundreds of thousands of mortals and the island's cultivators as raw materials for alchemy?" A deep voice from outside the cave mansion inquired calmly.
"Yes, it was indeed me. What, do you have ties with Wangyou Island and wish to avenge them?" Qu Jiuhuang admitted nonchalantly.
"As long as it's you, I have no interest in avenging them."
As soon as these words were spoken, a sound like thunder resounded across the seabed, followed by the crackling of shattered rock walls and the rush of water flooding in. Outside the pharmacy door, seawater poured in furiously.
"Impossible, the formation is broken!" Hao Shang and the white-haired young man were both taken aback.
Meanwhile, deep within the cave mansion, Qu Jiuhuang also showed a look of surprise. With a sweep of his sleeve, he gathered some important items and flew straight out of the cave mansion, rushing to the sea's surface.
On the sea surface at that moment, Yuan Ming stood with his hands behind his back, wearing a mask, with Vajra and Hua Zhi standing side by side behind him.
As soon as Qu Jiuhuang appeared, Yuan Ming swiftly formed a spell, and the hidden Array Flags flew out instantly, forming a Captive Formation that enveloped both him and Qu Jiuhuang.This translation is powered by the readers at *.
"Such mastery of formations... When did the Dongji Sea produce such an Array Master like you?" Qu Jiuhuang's expression turned grave as he glanced around, realizing why the formation he had set up was so easily breached.
"Hehe, Fellow Daoist, staying at the seabed for so long, you must be somewhat out of touch with current affairs." Yuan Ming smiled slightly, raised his hand to form a spell, and several soul crows flew out from his Sea of Consciousness.
"Master, allow me to deal with him first." At this moment, Vajra stepped forward willingly.
Now, he was just a step away from breaking through and wished to use this battle to thoroughly temper his will and step into the Body of Wanxiang realm.
The insights gained between life and death are the most effective for breaking through bottlenecks. Moreover, with Yuan Ming and Hua Zhi covering the formation, even if he lost, he wouldn't need to worry about Qu Jiuhuang escaping.
Yuan Ming understood his intentions and nodded slightly, agreeing to his request.
However, in Qu Jiuhuang's eyes, Yuan Ming's action undoubtedly meant he looked down on him.
"Arrogant!"
Angered, he gave up the idea of escaping, clapped both hands, and summoned a blood-colored copper mirror, launching an attack towards Yuan Ming and the others.
In an instant, countless blood light and spirit flames rose within the Captive Formation. The great battle lasted four hours before it finally ceased.
As the formation opened, Yuan Ming, with some bloodstains on him, walked out from the formation. His Divine Sense scanned the surroundings, and seeing no one else around, he swiftly departed.
Not long after he left, two figures emerged from the seawater below, none other than Hao Shang and the white-haired young man.
They both had a lingering sense of fear on their faces.
With the formation broken and Qu Jiuhuang's cave mansion engulfed by seawater and collapsed, although they were Core Formation Cultivators, they were so drained and tortured by Qu Jiuhuang that barely any Mana remained. In such a dire situation, they almost couldn't escape, nearly buried at the seabed.
"Qu the Old Ghost, He Luohui from Wangyou Island, has come to settle the blood debt... Huh? Who are you, and where is Qu the Old Ghost?"
As Hao Shang and the young man breathed a sigh of relief, a great beam of light flew from the horizon. A young man in white roared with authority, and upon scanning with Divine Sense, saw only Hao Shang and the young man amid the collapsed seabed cave mansion, filling his eyes with confusion.
Hao Shang and the young man exchanged glances, both showing a bewildered expression.
...
On another front, Yuan Ming spent half a month taking the unconscious Qu Jiuhuang back to Spiritual Ape Island.
During this time, to prevent Qu Jiuhuang from awakening, he specifically found a safe place to implant a Soul Lowering Talisman on him, thereby keeping him completely under control.
The group of evil cultivators previously captured by Yuan Ming were also dealt with in this way.
And when he returned to Spiritual Ape Island, he directly imprisoned Qu Jiuhuang and other evil cultivators in Shura Palace, and ordered him to continuously pray to Ming Yue God, or else he would be completely killed.
After being afflicted with the Soul Descent Rune, Qu Jiuhuang had no choice but to accept Yuan Ming's demands in exchange for a chance to live.
In the past three years, Yuan Ming has been capturing evil cultivators with Vajra and Hua Zhi by his side. Counting them up, he has captured nearly a hundred Nascent Soul evil cultivators, along with Fei Shang and Qu Jiuhuang, both of whom are in the Returning Void stage.
Nowadays, these people under the pressure of the Soul Descent Rune have been converted to believe in the Ming Yue God, praying and repenting day and night in Shura Palace.
As a result, Yuan Ming's income from Desire Power directly doubled, and with the future contributions from the newly captured Qu Jiuhuang, Yuan Ming can already ensure the cohesion of a Vow Power Pill every three months.
This way, gathering two hundred Vow Power Pills within a hundred years is no longer a difficult task.
Through the battle with Qu Jiuhuang, Vajra gained many insights and prepared to break through to the Body of Wanxiang, entering the Spiritual Beast Bag to retreat for cultivation. After consideration, Yuan Ming also decided to stop capturing and went into seclusion again.
Unknown to him, due to these three years of capturing, a rumor began spreading across Dongji Sea.
It is said that there is a great power with a sense of justice, who feels that the evil cultivators are rampant, secretly chasing and killing them to restore a clear sky to Dongji Sea.
Others say it is actually another ambitious demon lord, wanting to unite all the evil cultivators in Dongji Sea to form a new force strong enough to oppose Dongji Palace, capturing the evil cultivators merely as a warning, forcing others to submit.
For a while, rumors spread across Dongji Sea, filling the skies, leading many Returning Void Great Powers to become interested in this mysterious cultivator who never shows up or goes to Dongji Palace for rewards, some even offering bounties, either to meet him or to provoke and declare war.
But all these had nothing to do with Yuan Ming, who went into seclusion again.
...
Time swiftly passed, and thirty-seven years went by.
With the arrival of the century mark, Yuan Ming ended his seclusion once more.
This time, his mana significantly improved, though he was still quite a distance from the Late Stage of Returning Void.
After emerging, Yuan Ming showed up in front of Sikong Zhan and others, dealt with accumulated trivial matters, then returned alone to his cave mansion. Activating the forbidden, he summoned the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
"Artifact Spirit Elder, the hundred-year period has come, and the two hundred Vow Power Pills have been collected. Please appear and meet." Yuan Ming counted out two hundred Vow Power Pills and then called out.
As his voice fell, the two hundred Vow Power Pills instantly disappeared, and the Stealing Heaven Tripod emitted a dazzling spirit light, condensing a half-human-sized head phantom in mid-air, which was Artifact Spirit Kong of the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
"You did well, I have received the Vow Power Pills, and as promised, I will act for you once more. Whatever you need, feel free to speak." He slowly said, his voice directly entering Yuan Ming's Sea of Consciousness.
Compared to before, this appearance of the Artifact Spirit seemed more grandiose, whether due to recovering his original imposing manner or influenced by character, he seemed unwilling to meet Yuan Ming in a usual stance.
"The crystal stones in the Stealing Heaven Tripod altar have several exhausted of spiritual power, wondering if you could restore them, Artifact Spirit Elder?" Yuan Ming, not minding this point, directly asked.
After this period of cultivation, Yuan Ming became increasingly satisfied with Primordial True Skill, dispelling the intention of asking for a Cultivation Technique from the Artifact Spirit, turning instead to consider the possibility of repairing the Stealing Heaven Tripod to restore its original functions.
"Since the crystal stones are exhausted, they cannot be restored, only replaced. However, I cannot leave the Stealing Heaven Tripod, hence cannot assist in obtaining the replacement crystal stones," the Artifact Spirit shook his head.
"Previously you mentioned handling anything…" Yuan Ming's eyes flickered, hesitating to speak.
"Don't worry, I haven't finished speaking. Though I cannot act personally, I can tell you the specific locations of those crystal stones. You only need to follow my instructions to easily acquire these five types of crystal stones." The Artifact Spirit immediately said.
"Dare I ask, Elder, which five types of crystal stones specifically?" Yuan Ming asked in surprise.
"Among the Five Elements Crystal Stones, the Fiery Fire Essence Stone and Earth Element Stone are missing. Among special crystal stones, Guiyuan Heavenly Crystal, Abyss Nether Stone, and Love Inquiry Heart Jade are missing." The Artifact Spirit said, sending a strand of Divine Thought into Yuan Ming's Sea of Consciousness.
The Divine Thought contained the locations of these five types of crystal stones.
Upon careful examination, Yuan Ming found four of the five types of crystal stones were outside the Dongji Sea's range, with the Guiyuan Heavenly Crystal currently held by the Black Evil Sect on Black Mo Island in Dongji Sea.
Regarding the Black Evil Sect, the Artifact Spirit also thoughtfully provided more information, mentioning it as a sect established by demon cultivators, with several Returning Void Demon Cultivators stationed within, possessing significant strength.
After reading the information, Yuan Ming couldn't help but feel shocked.
Demon cultivators in Dongji Sea are practically like rats crossing the street. Even evil cultivators wanted by Dongji Palace rarely want to associate with them. They have mysterious actions, making it impossible to catch their trails. The Artifact Spirit clearly cannot leave the Stealing Heaven Tripod, yet where did he obtain the information?
"According to Elder, Black Mo Island is akin to a dragon's den and tiger's lair. It seems beyond my capability to infiltrate alone. Does Elder have any clever method?" Yuan Ming glanced discreetly at the Artifact Spirit, tempted to inquire, but knowing it would never reveal, hesitated for a moment before putting aside the idea, instead posing the question.

chapters.title: Chapter 799 - 770: Call to Crusade
chapters.content:
"Hehe, don't rush. Just wait for a bit, and soon there will be an opportunity." The Artifact Spirit gave a mysterious smile and then disappeared.
Yuan Ming was taken aback and called out a couple more times. Seeing that the Artifact Spirit no longer responded, a flurry of doubts arose in his heart, not knowing what it meant for him to wait for.
He pondered for a long while without any leads, so he could only sigh and attend to his own matters while waiting for the opportunity the Artifact Spirit mentioned.
Since this transaction was already completed, Yuan Ming's need for the Vow Power Pill was not as urgent. Therefore, after leaving the Cave Mansion, he first went to the Shura Palace to urge those Nascent Soul Evil Cultivators to continue praying, and then specifically brought out Fei Shang and Qu Jiuhuang.
Magic Practitioners capable of reaching the Returning Void stage are rare even in the Overseas World; naturally, they have unique and superior aspects.
Having been at the Returning Void stage for many years, these two must have plenty of Secret Technique insights worth Yuan Ming's exploration and learning. Simply having them pray too much would be a waste. With the Soul Descent Rune, Yuan Ming could ensure they wouldn't escape his control, so it was better to let them continue cultivating so that he could learn stealthily through Black Incense Possession.
However, Yuan Ming would not just let them freely cultivate. The resources provided for cultivation were limited, and they were only allowed to practice the spells that Yuan Ming approved.
What surprised Yuan Ming was that Fei Shang and Qu Jiuhuang were actually grateful for this requirement, viewing it as a mercy from Yuan Ming. Not only did they not resist, but their faith in the Nether Moon God also became more sincere.
Even so, Yuan Ming repeatedly tested and confirmed them before feeling slightly at ease. He then imparted the Secret Techniques of Transplanting Technique and Planting Beans into Soldiers to them, ordering them to comprehend and cultivate so that he could possess them for learning later.
After Yuan Ming arranged these things, he returned to his daily cultivation, thinking the opportunity mentioned by the Artifact Spirit would take some time to come. Who would have thought that just a few days later, the long-unseen Mo Sanqi, an elder of the Dongji Palace, would suddenly visit Spiritual Ape Island?
Yuan Ming welcomed him onto the island and seated him in the guest hall, offering him Spiritual Tea.
"Hehe, Fellow Daoist Yuan, not only is your cultivation profound, but you are also excellent in management and strategy. In just a hundred years, you've managed Spiritual Ape Island so well; you're truly a rare talent." After finishing a cup of Spiritual Tea, Mo Sanqi praised Yuan Ming profusely.
"Fellow Daoist Mo, you're too kind." Yuan Ming refilled the tea with a smile and replied.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, our Dongji Palace has always treasured talent. If you change your mind, I would personally recommend you to the Island Master. It wouldn't be difficult to grant you the management of a few more islands." Mo Sanqi probed with a question.
"Fellow Daoist Mo, I'm used to being carefree. Just managing this Spiritual Ape Island is already giving me headaches. How could I have the energy for more islands? I appreciate your kindness." Yuan Ming waved his hand with a smile.
Seeing his polite refusal, Mo Sanqi did not press further.
Help us out by reading on *.
"Actually, one reason for my visit today, besides paying a visit after such a long absence to see if you need anything, is that Dongji Palace plans to conquer the Demon Dao Sect, Black Evil Sect, and has summoned many Island Masters to go on an expedition. Remembering your prowess, I came to ask if you'd like to participate?" Mo Sanqi asked, changing the topic.
Hearing this, Yuan Ming was stunned and thought to himself, "Is this a coincidence, or...?"
Just a few days ago, the Artifact Spirit had mentioned something about Black Mo Island and the Black Evil Sect to him, telling him to wait. At that time, Yuan Ming didn't know what it meant by "waiting," only to find that today brought news of Dongji Palace's plan to conquer the Black Evil Sect.
Seeing Yuan Ming deep in thought and not speaking for a while, Mo Sanqi continued:
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, since you are not a cultivator of Dongji Palace, you are not obligated to join, so you don't have to worry about that. However, for those Island Masters willing to participate in the conquest, we offer a Ginseng Origin Pill as a reward. This item is a secret elixir of Dongji Palace, with special effects for cultivators breaking through the Returning Void bottleneck. Usually, it's nearly impossible to buy."
He finished, watching Yuan Ming, eager to see his reaction.
"I will participate. I've heard of the Ginseng Origin Pill's fame long ago. For your palace to offer this as a reward, your sincerity is clear, and I have no reason to refuse." Yuan Ming nodded immediately without hesitation.
For years, Yuan Ming had been seeking elixirs to aid in breaking through the cultivation bottleneck to the late stage of Returning Void, and the Ginseng Origin Pill was among the best.
Unfortunately, Dongji Palace had kept this elixir very carefully. It was hard to even catch a glimpse, let alone buy one. Who would've thought it would come to his doorstep today?
"Haha, with Fellow Daoist Yuan joining, we are sure to achieve a great victory. If you make battle achievements, there will be more rewards awaiting you," Mo Sanqi said with a beaming smile.
"Fellow Daoist Mo, I'm just an insignificant role. Please don't have too high expectations of me," Yuan Ming said humbly with a smile.
After a round of courtesies, Mo Sanqi mentioned he had other Island Masters to invite personally and took his leave.
After he left, Yuan Ming immediately took out the Stealing Heaven Tripod and asked the Artifact Spirit, "Senior, how did you know that Dongji Palace was planning to conquer the Black Evil Sect?"
After a moment, the voice of the Artifact Spirit slowly echoed in his Sea of Consciousness: "As long as I wish to know, nothing can be hidden from me."
Hearing this, a sudden sense of dread arose in Yuan Ming's heart.
He knew that this senior Artifact Spirit was not speaking empty words, its status perhaps even higher than he had guessed.
"Senior, about the Crystal Stone?" Yuan Ming inquired cautiously.
"Don't worry. You just need to follow the Dongji Palace cultivators to Black Mo Island, and I will tell you how to find the Crystal Stone then," said the Artifact Spirit, before ignoring Yuan Ming once more.
Hearing this, Yuan Ming was delighted and immediately began preparations for the campaign against the Black Evil Sect.
Since it was impossible to improve his cultivation level quickly, he shifted his focus to Magic Treasures.
Yuan Ming entered the Shura Palace, arrived at the Artifact Refining Hall in the Extreme Fire Realm, and waved his sleeve.
Seven or eight black rocks resembling refined iron fell to the ground, exuding a dense atmosphere of Yin Qi, precisely Nine Nether Iron.
The cultivation resources in the overseas world are exceedingly abundant, far surpassing those of the Yunhuang Continent. Though Dongji Sea is located in a remote area, it still cannot be compared to the Yunhuang Continent.
These past years, Yuan Ming did not spend much effort, only having Sikong Zhan be mindful in his teachings, and already collected so many pieces.
He took out the Sun and Moon Flame Sunrise Furnace, opened his mouth to release the Soul Destroying Sword, and placed it into the furnace body.
The seven or eight pieces of Nine Nether Iron also flew inside, slowly melting under the embrace of Pure Yang Flame within the furnace, merging into the Soul Destroying Sword.
The Soul Destroying Sword was his Lifebound Magical Treasure, though it had begun to develop spirituality, its foundation was not solid, needing further enhancement.
Infusing Nine Nether Iron into the Soul Destroying Sword, Yuan Ming was already skilled in this, allocating a portion of his attention to guard the Sun and Moon Flame Sunrise Furnace, and with a flip of his hand, he took out two Spiritual Treasures, namely the Shura Blood Devouring Map and the imitation Exterminating Immortal Sword.
"Fellow Daoist Qi Ye, let's begin." He said lightly.
"Alright." Qi Ye emerged from the Shura Blood Devouring Map, reaching out towards the screen's void.
A phantom blood shadow in the shape of a giant python emerged, appearing just like the Yin Worm Beast Yuan Ming had slain when he first arrived at Dongji Sea.
Yuan Ming later used the Shura Blood Devouring Map to refine this beast, transforming it into a Blood Slave.
This time, the refinement took considerable effort from him and Qi Ye, only refining the demon soul of the Yin Worm Beast, forming a particularly pure Yin Worm Blood Slave, more suitable for conversion into an Artifact Spirit.
The reason Yuan Ming did this was to prepare to seal the blood slave transformed from the Yin Worm Beast into the Exterminating Immortal Sword, serving as an Artifact Spirit.
The Yin Worm Beast is a demon beast with yin attributes, perfectly matching a killing Spiritual Treasure like the Exterminating Immortal Sword.
Qi Ye pointed at the Shura Blood Devouring Map, and a burst of blood light enfolded the Exterminating Immortal Sword, pulling it inside to mix with the Yin Worm Blood Slave, disappearing into the Shura Blood Devouring Map.
"This time, don't make any mistakes like last time when refining the Ghostly Soul White Bone Banner." Yuan Ming reminded.
"Rest assured, this Exterminating Immortal Sword is far less eerie than the Ghostly Soul White Bone Banner, and my control over the Shura Blood Devouring Map is not what it used to be." Qi Ye said confidently, his figure sinking into the Shura Blood Devouring Map.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming said no more, sitting cross-legged by himself, quietly waiting.
...
Seven days later, as planned, Yuan Ming went to East Extreme Island early in the morning.
Knowing he wouldn't be able to return for a while, he had arranged all the island's affairs in advance and only took Hua Zhi with him, leaving Vajra on the island to watch over it.
When he arrived, a huge cross-sea giant ship was already docked in the harbor outside East Extreme Island, slightly smaller than the Heavenly Eagle Flying Boat Xi Ying once rode.
After some verification, Yuan Ming successfully boarded the giant ship.
The deck of the giant ship was already crowded with people, many of whom had once visited Spiritual Ape Island.
Seeing Yuan Ming board the ship, many people came to greet him.
At this moment, Yuan Ming saw a beautiful figure weaving through the crowd, walking towards him, a fragrant breeze blowing in.
The newcomer was none other than Yun Luo Fairy. As she approached, she gazed at Yuan Ming with a trace of resentment in her eyes, reproaching:
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, why do you avoid me?"
"What do you mean by that, Fellow Daoist Yun Luo? When did I ever avoid you?" Yuan Ming replied with an innocent look.
"Several times I went to Spiritual Ape Island to visit, Fellow Daoist Yuan was always in seclusion and never available for a meeting. Are you saying you weren't intentionally avoiding me?" Yun Luo Fairy said with a hint of grievance in her eyes.
"Really just an unfortunate coincidence, Yun Luo Fairy, please don't overthink it." Yuan Ming replied helplessly.
Ever since he learned Yun Luo Fairy wanted dual cultivation with him, Yuan Ming indeed kept his distance from her. He didn't want Xi Ying to know about it and confront him later.
"Fine, since Fellow Daoist Yuan doesn't fancy me, I'll just keep my distance in the future. However, for this expedition against the Black Evil Sect, how about we accompany each other?" Yun Luo Fairy huffed lightly and then asked.
"Very well." Yuan Ming pondered briefly, nodding his agreement.
Seeing that Yuan Ming did not refuse, a trace of joy flashed in Yun Luo Fairy's eyes.
"Fellow Daoist Yun Luo, I don't know much about this Black Evil Sect. Do you know how strong they are?" Yuan Ming asked.
"Very strong." Yun Luo Fairy replied without hesitation, solemnly.
"Compared with Dongji Palace?" Yuan Ming frowned and asked.
"Naturally, they fall short by a lot; otherwise, wouldn't it be the Palace Master leading the expedition instead of the Vice Palace Master?" Yun Luo Fairy laughed as she replied.

chapters.title: Chapter 800 - 771: Island Attack
chapters.content:
"Vice Palace Master? Huangfu Jue?" Yuan Ming asked.
"Yes, he is a Perfect Returning Void Realm Cultivator, with extraordinary combat power. It is precisely because he is leading the team that so many Island Masters are willing to follow. If another Late-stage Returning Realm Cultivator were leading, probably not so many would have responded," Yun Luo Fairy nodded and said.
"Indeed. But this also means that this must be a tough battle," Yuan Ming replied slowly upon hearing this.
"Haha, I'm quite aware of Fellow Daoist Yuan's strength; accompanying us on this journey, Fellow Daoist Yuan must protect me," Yun Luo Fairy chuckled and said.
Yuan Ming did not respond, smiling noncommittally.
At that moment, several rays of tunneling light flew over from East Extreme Island, landing on the cross-sea giant ship.
The tunneling lights dissipated, revealing several figures. Standing in the center was a young man in a dragon-patterned brocade robe, with handsome features and sharp facial contours. His eyes glinted with a faint golden light, appearing very piercing.
Beside him stood several other individuals, none of whom had weak auras, among them was Mo Sanqi, an elder of the Dongji Palace, whom Yuan Ming knew.
As soon as these individuals appeared, a powerful aura instantly intimidated everyone on the ship, and the previously noisy deck fell into silence.
Everyone's eyes fell on the brocade-robed man, seemingly awaiting his instructions.
"Ladies and gentlemen, I am Huangfu Jue. This time, I will trouble you all to accompany me to Black Mo Island. The rewards of merit are right before us, waiting for you to take them," the brocade-robed man's gaze swept across everyone, speaking concisely.
There were no ice-breaking pleasantries or motivational slogans, his speech was very casual, even somewhat perfunctory.
It didn't feel like leading an expedition, but rather as if he was taking everyone on a trip. Yet this attitude gave everyone the greatest confidence.
Amid the crowd, someone immediately flattered, shouting, "It is an immense honor to go to battle with Vice Palace Master."
Soon, the deck was filled with cries of "immense honor."
Once the crowd quieted down, Mo Sanqi and several other elders started dividing the cultivators into teams for the island battle, arranging strategies.
Only then did Yuan Ming realize how powerful this team was. It turned out that besides the leading Vice Palace Master Huangfu Jue, who was a Perfect Returning Void Stage Cultivator, the other elders were also Returning Void Stage Cultivators.
In addition to the original Dongji Palace cultivators, including the Island Masters affiliated with them, there were actually two to three hundred Nascent Soul Realm cultivators joining the battle.
Besides that, there were many more Core Formation Stage cultivators, acting as support forces, accompanying the army in battle.
These cultivators would not be involved in the initial combat but would act as backup and rescue forces, assisting Nascent Soul Cultivators in battle and helping clean up the battlefield afterwards.
Inwardly, Yuan Ming clicked his tongue. Such a team placed on the Yunhuang Continent would be enough to sweep through all sects.
He was sure that even their Double Moon Alliance could not withstand it.
The cross-sea giant ship moved swiftly with the wind and waves, encountering no obstacles, but still took three months to barely reach the vicinity of Black Mo Island.
The Black Evil Sect had evidently received news of Dongji Palace's expedition, making preparations early on by retreating all affiliated forces to Black Mo Island.
When the cross-sea giant ship reached the sea area a hundred miles outside Black Mo Island, the waves suddenly surged below, boiling like water on a stove, churning up huge splashes.
The cultivators on the cross-sea boat sensed the fluctuations from the sea below, flocking to the sides of the ship to look down.
They saw that deep within the churning sea, paths of dim green light pillars shone from the seabed, forming an immense array spanning thirty miles.
It activated with a deep "rumble," its light growing ever brighter.
Pale green light pillars shot into the sky like spears, gathering colossal waves to form massive waterspouts that connected heaven and earth, charging toward the cross-sea giant ship.
The many cultivators on the boat hurriedly maneuvered the ship to dodge the mighty waterspout attacks.
After dodging three assault attempts consecutively, suddenly three violent whirlwinds surged up from the depths of the sea, simultaneously blocking the ship's path from the front and both sides.
Facing an unavoidable attack, the core of the array operating within the ship suddenly lit up with golden light. Expanding light waves lit the inside layers of the ship, illuminating pathways of runes where they passed.
In an instant, a vast rune array enveloping the entire cross-sea giant ship activated, releasing a myriad of golden rays that congealed into a golden light membrane encasing the whole ship.
"Booming"
The dim green waterspouts collided with the golden light membrane, causing a violent explosion.
The entire cross-sea giant ship trembled, and the hull violently shook, but that layer of golden light film remained steadfast.
As long as this light film remains unbroken, the attacks below won't harm anyone on the boat in the slightest.
"Good!" Someone shouted in approval, and immediately the cheer echoed throughout the boat.
FindthetranslationonMV&LEMPYR.
Immediately after, under the surprised gazes of everyone, two Returning to Void Stage elders suddenly flew out from the ship's sides. Golden and red lights respectively shone from their bodies as they plunged into the sea headfirst against the towering waves.
Upon descent, the elder enveloped in golden light was like an indestructible steel blade, ignoring the ferocity of the water tornado, and simply charged straight in, sending spray flying and extinguishing the green light.
The elder bathed in red light, upon descending, was engulfed in blazing flames, and upon colliding with the water waves, white steam rose to the sky, and his figure vanished within it.
Before long, thunderous roars sounded from the seabed, as everyone watched golden and red lights intertwine, constantly shuttling through the seabed, erupting in dazzling brilliance underwater.
Soon, the water tornado that kept rushing into the void quickly disappeared.
When the emerald glow under the sea completely extinguished, the two elders smoothly returned to the cross-sea giant ship, continuing their journey towards Black Mo Island.
However, not long after, thousands of various demon beasts emerged from the seabed, all appearing as if poisoned, with blood-red eyes, launching suicidal assaults at the cross-sea boat of Dongji Palace in the sky.
These creatures were without reason, unaware of fear or fatigue, relentlessly charging at the boat and choosing to self-destruct their Demon Cores and Demon Souls upon close proximity.
Due to their overwhelming numbers, and the minimal intervals between the self-destructing demon beasts, the explosive power overlapped, forcibly tearing through the defense array of the cross-sea giant ship.
Huangfu Jue gave a command, completely opening the boat's defense array, marking the beginning of the cultivators' first battle.
There was no doubt that the cultivators who came to crusade were not incompetent. Facing those mindless demon beasts was as easy as cutting vegetables, quickly slaughtering them clean.
However, as one wave of demon beasts was eradicated, another surged forward, unending, creating no effective harm to the Dongji Palace cultivators but greatly depleting their mana.
Yuan Ming had noticed this early on and intentionally controlled his mana consumption, not fighting too conspicuously.
Yun Luo Fairy smiled knowingly and accompanied him, the two facing opposite directions, fending off the demon beast attacks, as if mutually guarding and cooperating.
After consecutively eliminating three waves of demon beasts, the cross-sea giant ship finally reached Black Mo Island.
It was a massive island, artificially expanded and transformed, spanning thousands of miles, with two intersecting cross-shaped mountain ranges on it, dotted with stone-constructed fortress-like buildings.
On various parts of the island, towering black stone pillars pierced the sky, radiating black light, emitting thick black smoke, enveloping the island's sky and surroundings, forming a huge array shrouded in black mist.
Yuan Ming stood on the boat deck, gazing afar at the black mist swirling above the island. A while later, he felt his eyes grow sore, vaguely seeing giant grotesque ghost faces forming in the black mist.
As he was about to avert his gaze, he suddenly heard cries of agony around him, turning to see many cultivators clutching their eyes in pain, struggling on the ground.
Those whose cultivation was below Nascent Soul were bleeding from their eyes, attacking their companions on the ship in madness.
"This is the Black Demon Calamity Heart Formation; do not stare at the black clouds of the array, or your mind will be disrupted." At this moment, Huangfu Jue's voice suddenly resounded, like thunder exploding in everyone's ears.
In an instant, this authoritative and potent voice subdued all the cultivators on the ship affected by the Black Demon Calamity Heart Formation.
The Nascent Soul cultivators, though still in pain, stabilized instantly. As for the bewildered Core Formation cultivators, many bled from their eyes and soon fainted, bleeding from their seven orifices.
"Elder Nantian, Elder Huo Zhuo, Elder Sanqi, the three of you mobilize the Haotian Tower and break the array together," Huangfu Jue ordered.
Elder Nantian, tall and robust with short white hair and a golden armor, stood along with the stocky Elder Huo Zhuo, with a leopard's head and fiery eyes, the two who earlier cooperated to break through the underwater array.
They, along with Mo Sanqi, responded in unison, flying out of the cross-sea giant ship to the skies above Black Mo Island.
Mo Sanqi waved his hand, and a golden light flew out, transforming into a nine-story pagoda about a foot tall. The pagoda was crimson with golden eaves, surrounded by spiritual energy, an undeniable spiritual treasure.
The three elders positioned themselves at three points outside the pagoda, channeling their mana towards the Heavenly Treasure Tower.
The Heavenly Treasure Tower buzzed, its body rapidly expanding, transforming into a gigantic tower ten zhang high in moments, hovering high in the sky.
An enormous golden orb was embedded at the tower's top, beginning to absorb the sun's brilliance, becoming incredibly radiant.
In an instant, the temperature of this sea area rose rapidly, and the surroundings turned a glaring white.
Many cultivators found their eyes stung by the light and instinctively looked away from the tower.

chapters.title: Chapter 801 - 772: Killing Through the Battlefield
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming couldn't bear to look away, he kept his gaze fixed on the Haotian Divine Tower, continuously absorbing the True Sun Fire, its golden spherical crown emitting a radiance no weaker than the sun.
At the same time, circles of red flame patterns emerged on the tower's body, as if some kind of forbidden restriction had been activated, releasing a soul-stirring spiritual pressure.
At this moment, the three Returning Void Elders simultaneously began chanting, raising their hands to perform sealing gestures, directing them towards the Haotian Divine Tower.
Beneath the towering structure, a golden light pillar entwined with flames descended abruptly, fiercely striking towards the Black Demon Calamity Heart Formation.
Meanwhile, the Black Evil Sect below was prepared, with cultivators stationed at various formation points around the island, each exerting their full force, making the light on the pillars even more dazzling and bright.
Originally appearing as a mere mass of dark clouds, the Black Demon Calamity Heart Formation suddenly surged with mist, within which a giant demon shadow emerged, with wings on its back, horns on its head, and ferocious features.
Its body was several tens of feet tall, opening its blood-red maw to silently roar at the sky, spewing out a black light pillar straight into the void, colliding with the golden light pillar.
"Boom, boom, boom"
A series of thunderous sounds erupted, causing the surrounding void to shake violently.
The moment the two light pillars collided, a massive ring-shaped shockwave exploded, centering on Black Mo Island, spreading out and causing hundreds of feet-high stormy waves on the sea.
The Cross-sea Giant Ship, controlled by numerous cultivators, swayed back and forth like a small boat amidst the waves.
A momentary explosion did not yield a result.
The Haotian Divine Tower and the Black Demon Calamity Heart Formation found themselves in a stalemate, neither side prevailing.Always read from the source: *.
However, this momentum did not last long before a change occurred once more.
The cultivators of the Black Evil Sect on Black Mo Island seemed to have other tricks up their sleeves. Once unleashed, the towering stone pillars on the island suddenly turned from black to red, and the light pillars emitted gradually shifted from dark black to blood red.
The black mist in the high sky turned into a blood mist, and the giant black demon shadow seemed to be clad in a layer of blood armor, becoming even more formidable.
Yuan Ming sensed a vague hint of danger.
He observed intently for a moment and then loudly exclaimed, "The demon cultivators of the Black Evil Sect have activated the Blood Sacrifice Technique. The defensive array is turning from defense to attack."
Everyone's attention was focused on the stalemate in the high sky, and no one spoke, so his voice was immediately heard by almost everyone.
Yun Luo Fairy was startled, quickly moving to the ship's edge to look down, only to see a surge of blood energy on the island, her expression changing rapidly.
Yuan Ming's call also drew Huangfu Jue's attention. He glanced over here and then directly soared up, arriving above the Haotian Tower.
At this moment, the black demon shadow clad in blood armor had blood-red eyes, and the black light it spewed out transformed into blood color, its power exponentially increasing.
The existing balance was instantly shattered, the golden radiance of the Haotian Divine Tower continuously fractured, being corroded by the blood-colored light pillar, the light forced to retreat upward, seemingly about to be breached.
"Everyone, lend some mana." Huangfu Jue shouted loudly.
Upon hearing this, everyone quickly responded, hurriedly channeling their mana towards the Haotian Tower.
Streams of light flowed into the Haotian Tower, and its golden radiance immediately grew twice as strong, the decline halting abruptly, once again entering a stalemate with the Black Demon Calamity Heart Formation.
But just at this moment, from the direction of Black Mo Island below, an eerie, cackling laughter suddenly resounded, accompanied by a voice:
"Haha, you fools of Dongji Palace, I've been waiting for this moment."
As the voice fell, blood-red ripples suddenly shot out from the eyes of the blood-armored demon shadow, layer upon layer, like ripples on a lake, continuously spreading.
All the cultivators transferring mana to the Haotian Tower simultaneously flinched, their eyes glimmering with red light.
To varying degrees, they were all subjected to the influence of the blood-armored demon shadow, falling into illusion.
Yuan Ming, whose Word Witch Realm was already stable, only felt an external force trying to invade his sea of consciousness but remained unaffected.
He hesitated on whether to use his divine skills to help others break free from the illusion when suddenly he felt a shudder throughout his body, his hairs standing on end.
The air around him suddenly turned scorching, causing everyone's hair to stand unruly on end, as faint, imperceptible currents of electricity fizzled in the air.
Feeling a sense of foreboding, Yuan Ming looked up, seeing Huangfu Jue suspended in mid-air, his robe fluttering wildly, shrouded in a golden electric light, hair swirling, eyes brimming with golden electricity, exuding an awe-inspiring and powerful pressure.
At this moment, he resembled an ancient thunder god, filled with an irrefutable authority and majesty.
"Is this the pressure of a Peak of Returning Void cultivator? Such terrifying strength..." Yuan Ming couldn't help but feel swayed.
Then, he saw Huangfu Jue raise both hands high, grasping the void, as a golden giant axe appeared, electricity swirling on its surface, arcs of lightning crackling loudly.
"Ghost Wood, you may want to play the turtle, but I shall break through your shell." Huangfu Jue shouted.
As the words rang out, his raised hands swung down forcefully, and the golden giant axe erupted with a brilliant electric light, piercing straight into the depths of the sky, tearing through with a golden lightning bolt like a sky-splitting slash.
As the golden giant axe descended with the electric glow, it was like a sky-splitting light blade cutting into the black clouds above Black Mo Island.
Within the black clouds, the Blood Armor Demon Shadow opened a massive hand, reaching towards the golden lightning.
"Boom boom boom"
The moment the two forces touched, a continuous sequence of crackling thunder resounded.
The golden lightning sliced directly into the hand of the Blood Armor Demon Shadow, the exploding electric light nearly instantly shredding its entire arm, and it continued without any pause into its body.
The black cloud rolled violently, thoroughly disrupted.
At this moment, the Heavenly Divine Tower finally regained its momentum, unleashing a blazing sunlight that crashed into the sea of clouds.
With the combination of these two forces, the black clouds in the sky quickly dissipated, and the Blood Armor Demon Shadow, after holding on for a moment, could no longer resist, being torn apart by the golden lightning and rapidly vanishing under the burning sunlight.
On Black Mo Island, the sound of "bang bang" kept echoing, as one stone pillar after another could not stand against this force and finally exploded one after another.
The defensive great array covering the entire island was instantly torn open, one opening after another.
"Everyone, the opportunity for great achievements is right before us, charge!" Huangfu Jue raised his arm and called.
The people on the cross-sea boat erupted with excitement, one after another flying out, rushing towards Black Mo Island.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, shall we go together?" Yun Luo Fairy withdrew her gaze from Huangfu Jue and asked Yuan Ming.
But as she finished speaking and turned her head, she found that Yuan Ming was already nowhere to be seen.
"Fine, we were supposed to go together..." She looked around but could not find any trace of Yuan Ming, suddenly stomped her foot in annoyance, and flew out, heading towards Black Mo Island.
"Huangfu Jue, you've gone too far, dare you have a life-and-death fight with me?" At this time, an angry voice came from the island.
Immediately, a pitch-black figure, wrapped in a mass of black dense clouds, flew up from Black Mo Island, soaring straight into the sky.
"Elder Sanqi, I'll leave this place to you." Huangfu Jue instructed the three people, then immediately flew up, chasing after the black figure.
The two strongest combatants on each side tacitly chose to move away from the island, going to battle over the sea.
On Black Mo Island, sounds of killing and shouting rose up, light of magic treasures and divine skills clashed everywhere, and the battle entered a fever pitch from the start.
The initially planned tactics lost much of their meaning after close combat began; now, there was only fighting.
Yuan Ming landed, moving like lightning, using the powerful physique of the Body of Wanxiang, like a mountain-opening knife, directly plunged into the ranks of the Black Evil Sect cultivators.
He did not hide his body cultivation strength, launching the Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill at full force, his whole being like a moving copper wall, toppling everything in his path.
Unlike the elite group of cultivators from Dongji Palace that came for this battle, the demon cultivators of the Black Evil Sect were numerous but mixed, with vastly differing strengths.
The slightly weaker demon cultivators who encountered Yuan Ming didn't even need him to make a move; solely relying on that overwhelming force, they were knocked to pieces, dying on the spot.
Yuan Ming, in fact, was not here to fight, but only wanted to break through and leave the battlefield as quickly as possible. So he paid no mind and carved a blood path through hundreds and thousands of demon cultivators in no time, disappearing into the demon cultivator army.
This scene startled the Dongji Palace cultivators who landed with him.
"Who was that fellow Daoist just now, fighting so... bravely?" an elderly cultivator with white hair and beard asked in amazement.
In fact, he wanted to say how reckless.
"Rushed so fast that I didn't see clearly." Another person shook his head.
"Probably a cultivator from the main island of Dongji Palace, truly a model for us!" someone else admired.
After the conversation, they too plunged into the demon cultivators' ranks without looking elsewhere.
Yun Luo Fairy initially intended to search for Yuan Ming, but as the battle became increasingly intense, she could no longer care for anything else, urging her magical treasure to fight with all her might.
Little did she know that in just a few moments, Yuan Ming had already cut a path through the demon cultivators' battlefield.
A demon cultivator stationed at the rear with a face of bluish-black and fleshy visage, a bald one, saw Yuan Ming's arrogance, immediately wielded two massive black Vessel Gold Hammers, blocking his path and swinging the hammers at him.
This bald demon cultivator was a Nascent Soul peak elder of the Black Evil Sect, not weak, and the two giant hammers in his hands were also powerful high-level magic treasures.
As he swung the hammer, black light burst from the Vessel Gold Hammers, suddenly rising two somewhat blurry demon beast shadows, with the wind sound carrying two demon beast roars.
This sound had immensely strong penetration, carrying a power capable of intimidating the Divine Soul; if an ordinary Nascent Soul cultivator heard it, they would undoubtedly momentarily lose focus, and what awaited them next would be a heavy hammer strike.
But this level of Divine Soul attack was trivial to Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming didn't even blink, immediately raising his fists and pounding towards the Vessel Gold Hammers.

chapters.title: Chapter 802 - 773: Strange Tree Bark
chapters.content:
"Bang!" A muffled crash!
As Yuan Ming's fists touched those two Vessel Gold Hammers, the fierce impact sent them flying backward.
Yuan Ming's arms also trembled violently, feeling a fierce shock from his bones. He couldn't help but shake his arms, dispersing the force of the shock.
The bald Demon Cultivator, after retreating several steps to stabilize his stance, stared at the cultivator who recklessly charged in, with an expression full of disbelief.
These two Vessel Gold Hammers were refined with various high-grade spirit materials and sealed with the demon souls of two Soul-shocking Beasts as Artifact Spirits, almost comparable to high-level magical treasures, yet were blocked by that man barehanded.
Before he could fully process his shock, Yuan Ming had already charged again.
This time, however, he did not attack with bare hands but with a twist of his wrist, a Exterminating Immortal Sword appeared in his hand.
It's not that he couldn't defeat the other barehanded, but he did not want to waste time here.
The fall of the Black Evil Sect was only a matter of time, he needed to find that Crystal Stone quickly before then, so he must fight swiftly and decisively.
Seeing Yuan Ming advancing with his sword, the bald Demon Cultivator roared angrily, his mana surged forth into the two Vessel Gold Hammers.
Immediately, a flash of light appeared on the hammer bodies, directly condensing into two shadows of demon beasts that enveloped the hammer bodies, emitting intense spiritual power fluctuations.
The bald Demon Cultivator rushed forward, leaping into the air, raising his arms high, and heavily smashing down with both hammers.
In the void, the whistling wind mixed with beastly roars kept sounding, the noise shook several nearby Black Evil Sect cultivators to the point of fainting, yet it still couldn't affect Yuan Ming in the slightest.
He looked up at the bald Demon Cultivator, his expression unwavering, mana within him flowing into the longsword in his hand, slashing diagonally upwards.
"Zing!" A sharp cry rang out.
A jet-black sword light burst forth from the Exterminating Immortal Sword, like a giant black crescent moon flying diagonally.
In the instant of intersecting lights, the dual hammers in the bald Demon Cultivator's hands broke with a snap, being cut into two.
The black crescent sword light relentlessly struck the bald Demon Cultivator.
As the sword light fell, a sheet of golden light appeared on the Demon Cultivator's body, revealing a layer of protective armor.
However, that golden light only shone for a moment before abruptly exploding, shattering the bald Demon Cultivator's body into pieces.
Yuan Ming charged forward, swiftly bent down to remove the storage ring from the bald Demon Cultivator's hand, and dashed away.
The Exterminating Immortal Sword, which had merged the Yin Worm Beast's demon soul as its sword spirit, had power far beyond its original state.
The remaining Black Evil Sect cultivators naturally scrambled away as they saw Yuan Ming in such a manner, especially noticing his apparent intent to leave the battlefield, none willing to provoke him.
