After killing here and moving on, Yuan Ming swiftly sped towards the depths of Black Mo Island, completely out of the sight of Dongji Palace cultivators, he then concealed his form, trying to avoid further clashes with Black Evil Sect demon cultivators.
After about thirty minutes, Yuan Ming stopped outside a valley on the island.
"Artifact Spirit Sir?" He took out the Stealing Heaven Tripod and tried calling out.
After waiting for a while, he finally heard the Artifact Spirit's response echoing within his Sea of Consciousness: "Continue further inside; in the crevice deep in the valley, there's a hidden secret chamber. The Crystal Stone you seek is hidden within."
Yuan Ming was overjoyed upon hearing this and rushed into the valley immediately, no longer hesitating.
After traveling for a while, Yuan Ming was somewhat surprised to find that there were no cultivators guarding the area, and the valley only had some ordinary spiritual medicines planted, making it seem unlike a place containing secret treasures.
As he ventured deeper, he saw only some dilapidated old bamboo buildings in the valley, even without any spiritual medicine planted.
Compared to outside the valley, the spiritual energy here became increasingly thin.
Just as Yuan Ming wondered if he had gone to the wrong place, the terrain ahead gradually narrowed, faintly hearing the subtle sound of flowing water, seemingly reaching the deepest part of the valley.
Yuan Ming quickened his pace and soon reached the end of the path.
The narrowing cliff finally converged, forming a hundred-zhang high cliff face, densely covered with moss, growing some dark green ferns, with no signs of any secret chamber.
At the base of the cliff near the ground, there was a small stone cave, from which a spring flowed slowly, forming over time a small water pool three feet square.
The spring in the pool was crystal clear, with a floor of green stones, faintly revealing finger-sized fish swimming back and forth.
Yuan Ming released his Divine Sense, and after probing, found nothing unusual.
Just as he was about to ask the Artifact Spirit, he saw a sudden blue light shoot from the Stealing Heaven Tripod in his hand, hitting the seemingly mundane pool in front of him.
The surface of the small pool swayed with ripples under the blue light.
Yuan Ming's gaze fell on the ripples, his eyes suddenly changed, immediately noticing that the rippling water surface was glowing with a radiant white light, like a copper mirror, reflecting a beam of light upwards.
The light beam cast onto the opposite cliff, where there was a seemingly inconspicuous protruding rock.
Yuan Ming understood, immediately jumped up, and pressed on the rock, channeling mana into it.
The next moment, the protruding rock suddenly lit up, with a circle of light shining around it, and then a devouring force pulled Yuan Ming inside.
Yuan Ming staggered forward, quickly landing on his feet, and found himself in a secret chamber.
The secret chamber wasn't large, with stone niches carved into the four walls, housing oil lamps burning an unknown demon beast's oil, emitting a bright light without any smoke.
The chamber was very simply furnished, with only a table and a meditation cushion, resembling a quiet room meant for cultivation.
Yuan Ming saw a black incense burner placed at the center of the table, flanked by a purple black wooden box and a jade box, his eyes lit up, and he rushed over.
He swept over with divine thought, checked it, and found no anomalies. As if having an intuition, he grabbed the purple black wooden box and flung it open with a "snap".
As the box lid slid open, a brilliant yellow light emanated, revealing an oval crystal stone the size of a palm, covered with rhombus-shaped crystal surfaces, reflecting dazzling luster from different angles.
However, what surprised Yuan Ming was that he could feel the extraordinary nature of the crystal stone, but couldn't detect any spiritual power fluctuations.
"Don't doubt, this is what you're looking for." As if sensing Yuan Ming's confusion, the voice of the artifact spirit suddenly echoed in his sea of consciousness.
R&ea$d ah#ead and get u$pdat&es! by v!i^sit!i!n-g* M^^+VL$E&MP.Y$R.
"Senior, what exactly is this crystal stone, why is it so special?" Yuan Ming couldn't help but ask.
Silence was the response.
Seeing the artifact spirit ignore him, Yuan Ming didn't mind. Just as he was about to reach out to put the crystal stone away, the Stealing Heaven Tripod in his hand suddenly emitted light, with an invisible force drawing from it.
The crystal stone, attracted by the force, flew up by itself and collided with the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
At the moment of contact, the crystal stone suddenly virtualized and was pulled into the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space, falling onto the altar, perfectly embedded in a groove in the array.
The next moment, a yellow halo lit up on the array, transforming into a streaming glow that expanded outward before quickly disappearing.
Feeling something unusual, Yuan Ming hurriedly checked the changes in the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
Upon investigation, he discovered, to his surprise, that the seal in the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space had significantly loosened, and with a bit of control, he could easily open a narrow passage to freely place items in the tripod's space.
However, it was still quite difficult to allow people to come and go as before.
Nevertheless, Yuan Ming was already very pleased. As long as he could gather all the crystal stones and reclaim control of the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space, it wouldn't be hard anymore.
Calming his emotions, his gaze fell onto the jade box, and he reached out to pick it up.
The jade box felt quite heavy in hand. As Yuan Ming slid open the lid, no light appeared, but a rich life aura emanated.
Yuan Ming's palm trembled, wood grain appeared uncontrollably on his fingertips, and the branches of the Undying Tree extended, reaching toward the jade box but retreating right before touching it.
At the same time, Yuan Ming clearly felt the Undying Tree within him trembling uncontrollably, the sensation filled with joy, reverence, yearning, and a trace of submission.
His heart couldn't help but skip a beat, and his heartbeat sped up.
Yuan Ming's gaze fell inside the jade box, seeing a palm-sized piece of tree wood lying quietly, in shades between blue-gray, covered with rough tree grain, looking extremely ancient.
At the moment his fingertips touched the wood piece, the Undying Tree flared up with a shock, then shook violently, all complex emotions vanished, leaving only submission.
It was submitting to a piece of bark!
At this moment, Yuan Ming's astonishment was indescribable; influenced by the Undying Tree, he too felt a slight urge to bow.
However, he forcibly calmed his emotions, still deeply puzzled in his heart, what kind of existence must this bark belong to for the Undying Tree to willingly submit?
Moreover, why would such an item be here?
Clearly, with something like this present, why did the artifact spirit senior not mention it beforehand?
"Senior, are you aware of the existence of this spirit wood?" He couldn't help but ask.
"Yes," the artifact spirit replied quickly this time.
"What is it? Why didn't you tell me earlier?" Yuan Ming asked in confusion.
"Why should I tell you? You came looking for the crystal stone, not this bark," the artifact spirit countered.
Yuan Ming, upon hearing this, was momentarily speechless.
"Anyway, thank you, senior," Yuan Ming expressed gratitude.
The artifact spirit fell silent again.
He packed the peculiar bark, together with the jade box, and then, with a wave of his hand, collected the exquisite incense burner from the table, not finding anything special about it.
Yuan Ming checked the chamber again, found nothing else, and prepared to leave.

chapters.title: Chapter 803 - 774: Dharma Manifestation Realm Great Power
chapters.content:
Just as Yuan Ming was about to leave, his brow suddenly furrowed, and with a flicker of his body, he immediately dove underground, using the Void Transformation Technique to conceal his form and aura.
Not long after, a ball of white light penetrated the rock wall above the secret chamber, causing the air inside to tremble.
Two figures appeared in the white light; it was Mo Sanqi and Elder Nantian.
The two quickly searched around the secret chamber, finding nothing.
"This secret chamber is Ghost Wood's place of seclusion, and there's nothing here. Could it be that the Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter is on him?" Mo Sanqi said, frowning.
"Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter! Could it be that Dongji Palace's real purpose for attacking the Black Evil Sect this time is for this treasure?" In the ground, Yuan Ming's expression flickered.
This area of the Dongji Sea is extremely vast, bordering the abyss, and the sea itself carries a mysterious aura, leading to many rumors, including secret treasure legends like Three Immortals Island. Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter is one of them.
Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter is the lifebound magical treasure of the legendary loose cultivator, Elder Yan, from ten thousand years ago in the Dongji Sea, reputed to exist in three pieces.
This person was a great power at the Dharma manifestation Stage, with a very mysterious background and outstanding divine skills. Even the Dongji Palace Master from ten thousand years ago fought with him and gained nothing, which only enhanced his formidable reputation in the Dongji Sea.
Later, for some unknown reason, Elder Yan suddenly disappeared, and soon after, rumors spread that he had fallen and left behind Emperor Yan's Mausoleum, containing his lifelong collection.
As for the key to opening Emperor Yan's Mausoleum, it is the three Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepters.
However, whether it is Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter or Emperor Yan's Mausoleum, they have only been known by name. Many people in the Dongji Sea considered it a fabricated rumor by those who enjoy pleasure. Unexpectedly, today the term "Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter" truly emerged from the mouths of two Returning to Void Stage cultivators.
"No, I sensed with secret techniques before, and Ghost Wood did not have the aura of the Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter on him." Elder Nanshan shook his head, his tone firm.
"No matter what, let's search around first." Mo Sanqi said, quickly leaving.
But Yuan Ming underground did not leave, returning to the secret chamber and releasing his Divine Sense to carefully search the chamber once more.
Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter is related to the tomb of a Dharma manifestation Stage great power, so he couldn't possibly not be interested. Even if he doesn't seek the tomb, selling it could still earn him a fortune.
However, there really was nothing hidden in this chamber. After searching for a while, he had to give up helplessly.
Just as Yuan Ming was about to leave again, the ground beneath his feet suddenly began to shake, and cracks appeared on the walls, rapidly widening.
His expression showed surprise, and he immediately turned to fly away.Check * (*) for the latest updates.
At the same time, in the central area of Black Mo Island, the ground was also trembling, and the earth was cracking.
"What's going on?" Having already returned to the surface, Elder Nantian, who was chasing Black Evil Sect cultivators, Mo Sanqi, and others, paused with slight unease.
Other Returning to Void cultivators did the same.
And in mid-air, the battle between Huangfu Jue and Ghost Wood seemed to be nearing its end.
The black aura surrounding Ghost Wood had almost completely dissipated, revealing his true face—a thin, skeletal elder.
His left arm had been severed by Huangfu Jue's Golden Axe, and there were two massive wounds on his chest and abdomen, clearly at the end of his strength.
However, seeing the ground's movement, Ghost Wood's face lit up with joy, and he shook his sleeve.
Several strands of black smoke shot out from his sleeve, dancing wildly in the air, revealing faint images of skeletal ghosts, emitting a chilling and wailing ghostly cry as they rushed towards Huangfu Jue.
"Courting death!" Huangfu Jue snorted coldly, swinging his Golden Axe horizontally.
A flash of golden thunder light passed, cutting through several strands of black smoke, which turned into dissipated black qi.
However, Ghost Wood took the opportunity to escape downwards, burrowing into the ground.
Huangfu Jue furrowed his brow tightly and did not pursue, instead flying down beside Elder Nantian and others.
Before he could speak, the ground suddenly exploded, and a mass of dense black qi surged towards the group with astonishing speed.
"Quick, evade!" Huangfu Jue's figure shot up from the ground, avoiding the black qi.
Elder Nantian and others reacted a moment too slow, and were enveloped by the black qi.
A surge of overwhelming cold burst forth from the black qi, and Elder Nantian and others, without any resistance, instantly turned into a few white ice sculptures.
Seeing this, Huangfu Jue finally showed a mix of shock and anger, his right hand's golden battle axe erupting with golden lightning, which clashed and collided, emitting a deafening thunder roar.
"Go!"
He roared lowly, slashing fiercely with the golden battle axe.
A very thin golden lightning flashed by, vanishing into the black qi.
In the next moment, a series of violent explosions erupted from the ground, with acres of land bulging as if about to burst.
However, the black qi swirling on the ground suddenly condensed, forming a hundred-zhang black hand that struck down harshly.
The bulging ground compressed like a deflated balloon, returning to its original state, and the underground explosions subsided.
"Oh, so this is the Thunder Emperor Saber? It does have some spectacle." A ripple beside the black giant palm revealed an elder with a turban and a black robe—it was Mao Yi, whom Yuan Ming had seen in the Sui Xin Pavilion.
However, Mao Yi now no longer had the aura of an old scholar, his eyes revealing a cold light, with a cold smile at the corners of his mouth, exuding an indescribable ruthlessness.
"Mao Yi, is it really you, and your cultivation..." Huangfu Jue's face was filled with astonishment.
Mao Yi's aura at this moment was extraordinarily powerful, surpassing the Returning Void realm.
"Who exactly are you? Sneaking into my Dongji Palace, what do you intend?" Huangfu Jue quickly calmed down, asking in a deep voice.
Mao Yi sneered and had no intention of answering, his figure soaring into the sky, heading straight for Huangfu Jue.
Huangfu Jue swung the Thunder Emperor Saber in his hand, several arcs of Thunder Blade Light cleaving towards Mao Yi.
A trace of mockery flashed in Mao Yi's eyes as he extended a finger, a black shadow of a finger blocking the arcs of light, pressing down forcefully.
Bang!
The arcs of blade light shattered upon impact, and the shadow of the finger did not pause at all, heading straight for Huangfu Jue's chest.
Huangfu Jue was greatly alarmed, the Thunder Emperor Saber lay horizontally in front of him, his body's spirit light flashed wildly, and four or five defensive magic treasures appeared around him in succession.
However, it was all in vain; whether it was the Thunder Emperor Saber or those defensive magic treasures, they were as fragile as paper-mache in front of Mao Yi's attack.
The black shadow of the finger easily pierced through all defenses, striking Huangfu Jue's chest.
With a loud "bang," a bloody hole was punched through Huangfu Jue's chest.
But at that moment, Huangfu Jue's body suddenly transformed into golden thunder and lightning, sweeping across a hundred zhang away, recondensing his body.
At this moment, Huangfu Jue's complexion was pale, but the wound on his chest had vanished.
"Being able to transform your body into thunder and use the power of thunder and lightning to heal wounds, it seems your Nine Revolutions Divine Sky Technique has been cultivated quite deeply. Unfortunately, compared to the Dongji Palace Master, you're still far from it," Mao Yi said calmly, yet swiftly striking out with a palm.
A massive expanse of black light burst from his body, and the heaven and earth spiritual power within hundreds of miles madly gathered, forming a gigantic dharma manifestation behind him.
This dharma manifestation stood a hundred zhang tall, stepping on a Mystic Turtle, a giant python entwined around it like a divine dragon, exuding an infinite and boundless might, as if it were a god from ancient times.
The gigantic dharma struck out with Mao Yi's movement, the surrounding nature's spiritual energy was drawn in, condensing into countless shadows of palms, slapping towards Huangfu Jue.
In an instant, Huangfu Jue felt as if the nearby heaven and earth were melded into one with Mao Yi; he was no longer facing just Mao Yi, but the entire world. In front of it, he seemed so small, completely unmatched, with nowhere to escape. This sense of helplessness was something he hadn't felt in a long time.
However, Huangfu Jue was the Vice Palace Master of Dongji Palace, having witnessed the Dongji Palace Master engage in battle numerous times, and even fought against him. He was well aware of the divine skills of a Dharma manifestation realm great power.
This sense of unmatched feeling was a psychological illusion produced by the formidable pressure of a Dharma manifestation stage great power, not something actually unbeatable.
Huangfu Jue fully activated the Nine Revolutions Divine Sky Technique, once again transforming into a streak of golden thunder, narrowly slipping through the gaps between the black giant palm and the nearby palm shadows.
Mao Yi showed a hint of surprise on his face, striking out with his right hand again.
The giant palm of the dharma was suddenly filled with a strange dark energy, which instantaneously changed direction, striking towards Huangfu Jue again at a speed several times faster than before. It easily caught up with the golden thunder that Huangfu Jue had transformed into and struck it.
The golden thunder crumbled and dispersed, revealing Huangfu Jue's body, which was swatted down like a fly, smashing heavily onto the ground.
The ground was struck, creating a deep pit, raising countless clouds of dust.
Several hundred zhang away, Yuan Ming had just flown out of the ground, coincidentally witnessing the scene of Mao Yi conjuring the dharma manifestation and batting Huangfu Jue down from the sky with two palms.
"Dharma manifestation realm great power!" His pupils slightly contracted.
This usually low-profile Mao Yi had unexpectedly stepped into the realm of a Dharma manifestation stage great power, and that black dharma contained demonic qi; although not much, he was absolutely certain, that was definitely demonic qi!
In an instant, countless thoughts crossed Yuan Ming's mind. Why would this Dharma manifestation stage great power Mao Yi appear? Was everything on Black Mo Island orchestrated by him, or did he come here by chance?
But regardless of the reason, the mission of Dongji Palace this time, needless to say, had already completely failed.
With this thought, Yuan Ming didn't hesitate to turn and flee with all his might.
However, before he flew far, a powerful suction force emerged from the ground, the surrounding gravity instantly intensified by a thousand-fold.
Yuan Ming's escaping body lost control and fell heavily to the ground.
"What a terrifying Gravity Divine Ability!"
He fully activated his mana, barely managing to stand up.
Though the gravity was terrifying, by employing the Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill, he could still move and was about to continue fleeing.
"Bang""bang" two loud sounds echoed as two figures fell from mid-air, landing close to Yuan Ming.
One of them was Yun Luo Fairy, and the other one was another Returning Void Island Master who came along.
On the island, others were in the same state; those flying in the air fell, and those standing on the ground immediately crumpled down.
In a flash, everyone on the island had fallen to the ground, leaving only Mao Yi hovering in mid-air.
"This..." Yuan Ming was shocked.
The Returning to Void Stage Cultivators who came to the island were not just ten or eight, yet they were all captured together. Who wielded this Gravity Divine Ability? Could there be another Dharma manifestation great power, or is there a level 5 or above great array underground?
Weighing the pros and cons, Yuan Ming dispelled the condensed Qi-Blood, sitting down heavily, pretending to be trapped by the gravity, unable to move, intending to watch the situation change.
"Master, why are you surrendering? Falling into the hands of these demon cultivators, who knows what fate awaits! Let me release spores at full strength to disrupt the situation, and we can escape in the chaos," Hua Zhi's voice echoed in Yuan Ming's Sea of Consciousness.
"Your spores won't be effective against Dharma manifestation stage cultivators. Don't act rashly for now," Yuan Ming replied with his Divine Soul, stopping Hua Zhi's actions.
"Then what should we do?" Hua Zhi asked anxiously.
Yuan Ming didn't reply, instead channeling mana into the Stealing Heaven Tripod, opening a spatial passage.
He then threw his storage ring, Hua Zhi and Lei Yu's Spiritual Beast Bag, the Soul Destroying Sword in his dantian, and even the main soul into it.

chapters.title: Chapter 804 - 775: Coincidence
chapters.content:
As soon as Yuan Ming's main soul entered the Stealing Heaven Tripod, it immediately landed on the White Jade Lotus Platform.
A powerful and invisible wave of Desire Power surged from the White Jade Lotus Platform, merging with the main soul.
Yuan Ming felt the Soul Power of the main soul rapidly ascend, reaching the late stage of Word Witch.
"Only a small realm has been improved; the Desire Power stored within the White Jade Lotus Platform is limited. As my Soul Cultivation Realm elevates, the enhancement effect of Desire Power on Soul Power is becoming smaller..." Yuan Ming sighed softly to himself.
Nonetheless, having reached the late stage of Word Witch soul cultivation, facing Mao Yi, a Dharma manifestation existence, is not entirely without effect.
Yuan Ming's main soul immediately mobilized Soul Power, ready to act at any moment.
Simultaneously, Mao Yi descended from mid-air, lightly landing in front of the pit created by Huangfu Jue, not even raising any dust, seemingly unaffected by the terrible gravity.
He raised his hand to feign a grasp, and a large hand of the black Dharma manifestation behind him reached into the pit, fishing out Huangfu Jue's body.
Huangfu Jue was now covered in wounds, smeared with blood, looking grievously injured and on the brink of death.
Mao Yi performed an incantation with a pinch of his fingers, shooting a jet of black light from the large hand of the Dharma manifestation, swiftly searching Huangfu Jue's entire body.
"Huh, why is it not here... It seems that woman Ouyang Qiang held back, not allowing this child to carry that Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter." Mao Yi muttered to himself.
"Couldn't find it? What do we do now?" a thick voice asked.
"No matter, capturing this Huangfu Jue is sufficient; let's go." Mao Yi said calmly, flicking his finger.
A stream of black light mixed with Demonic Qi entered Huangfu Jue's body, then appeared in his Dantian, turning into a seal that sealed his Nascent Soul.
The Mana fluctuation on Huangfu Jue's body quickly weakened, vanishing entirely after several breaths.
Mao Yi turned towards the ground, opening his mouth to spit.
Strands of black light fell, entering the bodies of Returning to Void cultivators on the ground, sealing their Nascent Souls as well.
Without Mana, everyone was left utterly powerless, collapsing on the ground, their final glimmer of hope extinguished in their eyes.
Yuan Ming's Nascent Soul was also sealed, losing all Mana.
However, this seal was only targeted at the cultivator's Nascent Soul; his Qi Blood Power, the Demonic Qi contained within his body, and the Undying Tree within his Dantian remained unaffected.
However, the Stealing Heaven Tripod space passage needed Mana for support; with his Nascent Soul sealed, the space passage closed in response.
Yuan Ming quietly urged the Undying Tree Demon Power, injecting it into the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
His connection with the Undying Tree grew increasingly close; the Undying Tree Demon Power, carrying his aura, caused the Stealing Heaven Tripod space to tremble a few times, opening a space passage once more.
Yuan Ming was secretly pleased, but immediately withdrew the Undying Tree Demon Power to avoid detection, causing the space passage to close again.
At this moment, Black Mo Island shook more violently, the ground rapidly cracking and collapsing, as a colossal monster surfaced from beneath, almost the size of Black Mo Island itself.
This beast was entirely pitch-black, with a massive turtle shell on its back, appearing to be a turtle demon beast, though its head resembled that of a Flood Dragon, and its claws were shaped like dragon claws.
"Long Gui?" Yuan Ming, with his Divine Soul Power sealed inside the Nascent Soul, sensed the shape of the giant beast below through the Undying Tree.
Supposedly, Long Gui is a special type of turtle demon beast said to be a hybrid of the ancient Mystic Turtle and the Dragon Clan, extremely rare, and has not been truly seen for a long time.
This turtle carried exceedingly powerful demon energy on its body, surpassing even that of Huangfu Jue, who was at the Returning to Void Peak, and faintly felt like reaching Level 6.
The turtle shell on the black Long Gui shimmered with a dense yellow light; the strong gravity was precisely caused by this yellow light.
"A Divine Skill from a half-step Level 6 demon beast, no wonder it's so powerful." Yuan Ming was secretly alarmed.
The yellow light on the turtle shell suddenly intensified, pulling the group of Returning to Void cultivators, including the Dongji Island Master, under the pull of gravity, causing them to fall onto the giant turtle's shell.
At such close proximity to the Gravity Divine Ability, the Returning to Void cultivators' Mana was also sealed, expressions of pain appearing on their faces.
The black Long Gui looked on with a hint of contempt in its eyes; the yellow light on the shell dissipated, and the astonishing gravity vanished with it, allowing the Returning to Void cultivators to finally breathe a sigh of relief.
"Capturing so many Returning to Void cultivators, this harvest isn't bad." Mao Yi also landed on the turtle's back, throwing down Huangfu Jue's body as well.
"You've done well; counting the people previously captured, this century's mission is considered complete." The black Long Gui spat out words like a human.
Ghost Wood, as well as the remaining cultivators of the Black Evil Sect, were not drawn up onto the turtle's back; as the Gravity Divine Ability dissipated, those people levitated in mid-air.
"Lord Mao Yi, how should we proceed next?" Ghost Wood looked at Mao Yi with a respectful expression.
"Erase all traces here completely, then proceed according to the plan previously agreed upon." Mao Yi ordered coldly without even lifting his eyelids.
"Alright." Ghost Wood nodded and led people toward the largely collapsed island.
"Are you certain Ouyang Qiang will fall for it?" the black Long Gui asked.
"Of course, I've been lurking in Dongji Palace for a hundred years. It wasn't a waste of time. Let's go back," Mao Yi said with a confident smile.
The black Mystic Turtle asked no more questions, moved its limbs, and swam toward the deep sea.
Although the Mystic Turtle's size was astonishingly large, its speed was extremely fast. In the blink of an eye, it had left Black Mo Island far behind, its shadow no longer visible.
The people on the turtle's back looked even more despairing upon seeing this.
The Dongji Sea is vast beyond measure. If this black Mystic Turtle dives into the deep sea, even if Dongji Palace sends people to rescue us, they could never find us.
"Who exactly are you? What is your purpose?" A hoarse voice asked, it was Huangfu Jue, who had woken up at some unknown time.
"Hehe, Nephew Huangfu, aren't you famous for your outstanding intellect? I remember you had a nickname like 'Flawless Strategist,' but you can't even guess this little thing?" Mao Yi looked at Huangfu Jue and said with a smile.
"Just now, the dharma manifestation you displayed contained the aspect of a turtle and snake. Are you from the Three Realms Sect?" Huangfu Jue remained silent for a moment before speaking.
"You actually know the Three Realms Holy Sect, well, you do have some insight," a hint of surprise flashed in Mao Yi's eyes, but he remained noncommittal.Enjoying the story? Discover more on *.
Their conversation was not isolated from others, and everyone on the turtle's back heard it, all looking confused, apparently having never heard of the Three Realms Sect.
Yuan Ming also had not heard of this name, but judging from the dialogue between Mao Yi and Huangfu Jue, it seemed to be a very powerful force.
"The Three Realms Sect usually operates in the Central Continent, yet they've sent a Dharma manifestation stage cultivator to the barren Dongji Sea. It seems the rumors about Emperor Yan's Tomb are true," Huangfu Jue said, staring deeply at Mao Yi.
"Oh, so your Dongji Palace hasn't figured out the details of Emperor Yan's Tomb yet?" Mao Yi said, taken aback.
"The Palace Master only discovered some rumors. Though we were defeated today, we didn't come away empty-handed. As long as the Palace Master investigates today's events, he will know those rumors are indeed true," Huangfu Jue said.
"Haha, it seems Ouyang Qiang has a loyal subordinate. Even at death's door, you are still plotting for your master. But rest assured, I still need to trade you for Ouyang Qiang's Emperor Yan Ruyi Scepter, so I won't kill you," Mao Yi said with a hearty laugh.
"Use me to exchange for the Palace Master's Emperor Yan Ruyi Scepter? Haha, I'm just a small subordinate under the Palace Master. You overestimate me," Huangfu Jue laughed.
"Huangfu little friend, do you still want to muddle through this? Others may not know, but I am well aware you are Ouyang Qiang's real son. Otherwise, why go to such great lengths to set up today's scenario?" Mao Yi's smile grew even brighter.
Huangfu Jue's expression tensed, and after a moment, he asked, "How did you know about this?"
"I've been lurking in Dongji Palace for over a hundred years. Nothing escapes my Eyes of Golden Flame," Mao Yi pointed at Huangfu Jue with two fingers, then pointed at his own eyes.
Huangfu Jue fell silent.
The others who heard their conversation were all shocked. Mo Sanqi, Elder Nantian, and the other elders of Dongji Palace were taken aback, their mouths wide open in disbelief.
"You have laid out a long-term plan, using the Emperor Yan Ruyi Scepter as bait to lure us here, and I admit defeat," Huangfu Jue said with a long sigh after a while.
"It's good that you know when to admit defeat. Obeying from now on won't harm you," Mao Yi said casually.
"I can follow senior's instructions and cooperate fully, but I have one question I'd like to ask, and I hope senior will be generous enough to answer," Huangfu Jue said.
"Go ahead and ask," Mao Yi did not refuse.
"Does senior really possess an Emperor Yan Ruyi Scepter?" Huangfu Jue asked word by word.
Upon hearing this, everyone's eyes turned towards him, including Yuan Ming.
They had been struggling for this so-called Emperor Yan Ruyi Scepter all day, and most of them had never even seen it. Yuan Ming was also quite curious about this item.
"There's no point in hiding it now. Since you're so curious, I'll let you all have a look," Mao Yi said, flipping his hand to take out a black short rod, surrounded by a circle of red flames, with a large flame burning at the top, like a torch.
A wave of intense heat swept across, causing the air temperature to rise sharply. Everyone felt like they were being roasted alive inside a massive iron furnace.
The surrounding seawater sizzled and evaporated under the scorching aura, forming large areas of white water mist that draped around.
"It truly is the Emperor Yan Ruyi Scepter. I can't believe the second one has actually emerged," Huangfu Jue stared at the black short rod, muttering to himself.
Yuan Ming stared at the black short rod, dumbfounded.
The shape of this Emperor Yan Ruyi Scepter was exactly the same as the black Fire Burning Stick he obtained from the Three Immortals Island. The only difference was that his Fire Burning Stick did not emit such powerful flames.
Just a coincidence?
According to Huangfu Jue and Mao Yi's words, only two Emperor Yan Ruyi Scepters have surfaced. Could the one he possesses be the third Flame Yellow Ruyi Scepter?
"The idle talk ends here," at this moment, the black Mystic Turtle spoke.
Mao Yi nodded, put away the Emperor Yan Ruyi Scepter, and waved his sleeves.
A dense black light burst forth from his body, spreading rapidly around and enveloping everyone on the turtle's back.
Yuan Ming's vision suddenly fell into darkness, unable to see his surroundings or hear a sound. Even his Divine Sense was greatly hindered, as if an invisible force had imprisoned it.

chapters.title: Chapter 805 - 776: 1 Month's Time
chapters.content:
The black dragon turtle sped forward, constantly changing direction, occasionally diving into the seabed, as if afraid of being tracked by someone.
It is unclear how long this lasted, perhaps seven or eight days, before the galloping dragon turtle finally came to a stop.
The darkness surrounding them dissipated like clouds clearing to reveal the sun, and a barren sea area filled with black island reefs suddenly appeared before the crowd.
The dragon turtle did not linger on the surface, waving its forelimbs, parting the sea water, and dived straight downward.
The seabed here was very undulating, like mountain ranges, and the black dragon turtle quickly arrived at a seabed cliff and stopped.
Mao Yi waved his sleeve, several blue lights lit up around the cliff, forming a blue light barrier that isolated the nearby seawater, creating a large waterless space.
"Master!" Several people dressed in black emerged silently from nowhere, bowing to Mao Yi.
On the turtle's back, a group of returning Void Island Masters all stood up.
"Take these people down and keep a good watch on them," Mao Yi ordered lightly.
"Yes," replied a hunchbacked man at the forefront.
Mao Yi waved his sleeve, shooting out a black light that enveloped Huangfu Jue, and the two of them disappeared, no one knowing where they went.
Yuan Ming saw this and his tense heartstrings relaxed.
Mao Yi had not noticed him until now; his earlier choice was indeed correct.
With his current strength, as long as Mao Yi was not around, escaping from here was not difficult.
With Mao Yi gone, the several black-clad men also relaxed, looking at Yuan Ming and the others, especially eyeing the storage magic tools on their bodies with greed.
The hearts of the returning Void cultivators sank, but at this point, their mana and soul power were sealed, leaving them with no resistance.
"Get to work!" the hunchbacked man said coldly, unleashing a powerful pressure characteristic of the late stage of returning Void.
The other black-clad men changed their expressions, reluctantly withdrawing their gazes.
The hunchbacked man muttered something, raising a black command flag, as did the other black-clad individuals.
Seven or eight command flags floated in the air, forming an array as they cast spells.
* (*) appreciates your readership at the source.
"Go!" The hunchbacked man pointed with his finger, and the command flag array shot forward, entering the cliff ahead.
The cliff suddenly became illusory, like an illusion.
The hunchbacked man stopped, waved his hand to release a halo, enveloping Yuan Ming and the others, moving toward the cliff, directly into it.
Yuan Ming blinked and found himself inside a long and deep black stone passage.
Proceeding along the passage, the group quickly arrived at a large cavern, where the air was quite humid, and eight or so smaller passages led in different directions.
"Alright, lock them up separately," the hunchbacked man said.
"Boss, the master has already left, the brothers here have waited a decade, without any profits, handle this according to the old rules?" asked a knife-scarred man in black quietly.
The others also looked at the hunchbacked man, with hopeful expressions.
"Alright, but don't harm them," the hunchbacked man closed his eyes to sense something, then nodded.
The black-clad individuals rejoiced, immediately swarming over, stripping the storage bags from the island masters and elders, and even confiscating the lifebound magical treasures stored in their dantians.
Yuan Ming had anticipated this situation, so he had thrown the storage magic tools and Soul Destroying Sword into the Stealing Heaven Tripod's space. The storage magic tools he carried were from a Nascent Soul Stage evil cultivator he hunted down years ago, so losing them didn't bother him.
"Hmm, you have a strong qi-blood power, are you a body cultivator?" The hunchbacked man looked at Yuan Ming with sharp eyes.
Yuan Ming felt a chill. This person had an incredibly keen sense. He had already tried his best to suppress his qi-blood power, disguising it to be similar to that of the other island masters, yet this person had still detected it.
"Not quite a body cultivator, just practiced body cultivation methods," he replied calmly.
"Fellow Daoist is too modest. With your qi-blood power, you're no inferior to a body cultivator with the Body of Wanxiang," the hunchbacked man chuckled, flipping his hand to reveal a silver box.
The box opened automatically, revealing thirty-two silver needles, emitting a cold aura.
Yuan Ming's eyes darkened; the silver needles gave him a bad feeling, seemingly crafted specifically to counteract his physical body power.
The hunchbacked man sneered, forming hand seals as the needles shot out, piercing various parts of Yuan Ming's body.
The strong qi-blood power within Yuan Ming was completely dispersed, his legs felt like they were filled with old vinegar, sore and weak, requiring all his strength just to stand stable.
"The boss's Taiyin Needle Technique is getting stronger, even the Body of Wanxiang can be sealed instantly," the other black-clad individuals flattered.
"Trivial technique, nothing to boast about, lock these people up, they were once returning Void entities, so be cautious!" the hunchbacked man said lightly.
The black-clad men responded, leading Yuan Ming and the others into the tunnel deep in the cavern.
There were individual caverns carved out of the stone walls here, with black barred doors forming cells.
Yuan Ming and the others were imprisoned inside, one person per cell.
"Stay put here, or don't blame me for being rude," the hunchbacked man said, his grim voice echoing in the passage.
"Boss, rest assured, these people are already like plucked chickens, incapable of making any trouble. I'll guard here, you can relax," the scarred man said.
"Alright, I'll leave this place to you," the hunchbacked man said, then left with most of the people, leaving only the scarred man and two others.
Yuan Ming felt his whole body ache, struggling to sit up and focusing his mind to check his surroundings.
The silver needles had transformed into sharp, chilling qi forces, piercing the many nodes where physical strength and qi-blood circulated, making it impossible to exert any physical power.
"I never expected the overseas world to have methods to seal body cultivation like this; it's quite an eye-opener!" Yuan Ming tried several times to no avail, giving up and inspecting the prison cell.
The cell appeared ordinary, but both the stone walls and the cell door were extremely solid, of unknown material, making it difficult to break even in perfect condition, not to mention now when the island masters' mana was sealed.
With both his physical strength and mana sealed, Yuan Ming planned to use the power of the Undying Tree to open the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space and use soul cultivation divine power to easily deal with the three guards outside.
However, to escape from the incredibly sturdy cell, he must restore his mana.
Yuan Ming sat with eyes closed, exploring the seal within his dantian.
The seal was not unfamiliar to him, similar methods were used to seal the mana of prisoners in the Demon World's Nihility Prison.
Over the years, Yuan Ming had possessed prisoners and guards in the Nihility Prison, gaining substantial knowledge of their seals, and this, combined with his current array formation cultivation, should make breaking it not too difficult.
He used the power of the Undying Tree Demon to open the passage to the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space, releasing a torrent of divine sense to examine the dantian seal.
As time passed, three days quickly went by.
Yuan Ming opened his eyes, a hint of joy flashing in them.
After three days of study, he had roughly figured out the essence of this seal.
The seal combined demonic qi and sealing skills, containing demonic qi, mana, soul power, and a trace of space power. It not only sealed his nascent soul but also isolated it from his body.
Solely relying on mana and forbidden breaking techniques would hardly suffice to break it.
However, having comprehended the seal's structure, Yuan Ming planned to exploit the root-piercing void trait of the Undying Tree to dismantle the space power within the seal, then use demonic qi and mana to attack from the outside, giving him a seventy to eighty percent chance of breaking it.
Nonetheless, the seal was cleverly designed with some sort of warning mechanism. Should he attempt to break it, Mao Yi would likely become aware immediately.
"Looks like I need a way to isolate the warning effect..." Yuan Ming mused silently.
There were indeed ways, such as escaping into the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space or using the Silver Token to create a space barrier, which should isolate the warning.
But this would be too conspicuous, and who knows if someone in this prison was monitoring in secret?
While Yuan Ming was pondering, footsteps approached rapidly from outside.
Yuan Ming halted all actions, leaning back against the stone wall.
A few breaths later, a black-clad figure appeared outside his cell; it was the hunchbacked man from before.
"What brings you here?" Yuan Ming asked.
"I've investigated your identity; your name is Yuan Ming? Proficient in the way of arrays?" the hunchbacked man asked.
"I wouldn't dare claim proficiency; the way of arrays is vast and limitless. I only know a little," Yuan Ming replied softly.
"Knowing humility, it seems your array formation cultivation is not low. Tell me, do you want to live or die?" the hunchbacked man nodded slightly, continuing to ask.
"If given a choice, I don't think any cultivator would choose death," Yuan Ming replied ambiguously, unsure of the man's intentions.
"Very well, to be frank with you, everyone imprisoned here will die soon. However, your luck is good; Lord Mao Yi will be handling a major event and needs capable people. Since you are proficient in the way of arrays, I'll give you a chance to live," the hunchbacked man formed a seal with his hand.
A black light shot into Yuan Ming's body, directly hitting the seal in his dantian.
With a light hiss, the seal quickly collapsed, having dissipated significantly.
Yuan Ming's mana rapidly recovered, coming back under his control, though only half restored.
Alongside mana, soul power in his nascent soul also recovered by half.
Yet before Yuan Ming could rejoice, a wisp of purple light shot out from the black light, flashing into his nascent soul.
His nascent soul swiftly turned a pale purple, looking like amethyst, giving off a dreamlike, enchanting beauty.
"What is the meaning of this?" Yuan Ming asked with an unsightly expression, looking at the hunchbacked man outside.
The nascent soul was the foundation of a magic practitioner, and for it to suddenly become like this, it surely indicated a major problem.
The hunchbacked man ignored Yuan Ming's angry gaze and retrieved a Jade Scroll, tossing it inside.
"You have one month to practice the secret technique on this scroll. If you reach the third realm, you can survive; otherwise, your nascent soul will be fully eroded by the Purple Fluorescent Poison, turning into a puddle of pus and dying," the hunchbacked man said icily.
"You..." Yuan Ming stood up abruptly, his face turning an extremely dark shade.
"Remember, you only have one month," the hunchbacked man noted, saying no more, turning away and leaving on his own accord.

chapters.title: Chapter 806 - 777: No Time Left
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming watched as the hunchbacked man walked away, furrowing his brow as his expression turned somber.
He had previously devised a rather thorough escape plan, but now it had been completely disrupted.
If he had known this would happen, he should have immediately attacked the seal and fought his way out; at least he would have had a sixty percent chance. But now his Nascent Soul was under the opponent's Forbidden, and his actions were constrained, it's too late for anything.
Yuan Ming stood in place for a moment, quickly taking a deep breath and forcing himself to calm down.
"Hua Zhi, take a look at the Purple Fluorescent Poison in my Nascent Soul, is it possible to neutralize it?" He opened the Stealing Heaven Tripod space passage and informed Hua Zhi of the situation.
"Master, I'll know once I try!" Hua Zhi said, immediately manipulating a stream of demonic power from the space passage to envelop Yuan Ming's Nascent Soul.
"Hm, how strange, what kind of poison is this?" Moments later, Hua Zhi appeared surprised, muttering to herself.
"What, is there anything unusual about this poison?" Yuan Ming asked upon seeing this.
"The poison that Master has been afflicted with is very peculiar, it does not belong to the Five Elements, nor is it a Yin or Yang poison. It might take some time to determine its nature..." Hua Zhi said somewhat uncertainly, clearly lacking confidence.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming's heart sank. Even Hua Zhi found the Purple Fluorescent Poison somewhat challenging; now that they hadn't even determined what it was, let alone neutralized it.
However, he quickly adjusted his emotions: "No rush, take your time to study it."
"Master, rest assured, I will definitely uncover the details of this Purple Fluorescent Poison within a month!" Hua Zhi said solemnly.
Yuan Ming nodded and looked at the Jade Scroll in his hand.
This copy was generated from content at *.
Since the poison couldn't be cured, the temporary solution was to follow the arrangments of the other side.
He took a deep breath, used his Divine Sense to dive into it, and a thoughtful look flashed in his eyes.
The Jade Scroll recorded a Fire Control Secret Technique called "Zhu Rong Heart Technique," which seemed quite exquisite at first glance.
According to the Jade Scroll, there are five levels of this Secret Technique. With each level mastered, one's control over flames increases incrementally, and if one can cultivate it to the Great Perfection of the Five Levels, they can command all the flames in the world.
"That hunchbacked freak wants me to cultivate this Fire Control Secret Technique, could it be related to Emperor Yan's Tomb?" Yuan Ming thought, speculating.
He quickly discarded distracting thoughts, circulated his mana, and focused on trying to cultivate the Zhu Rong Heart Technique.
Yuan Ming had not originally cultivated a Fire Attribute Technique, but in order to study Artifact Refining, he had practiced some fire control methods, so getting started was not difficult.
However, upon entry, Yuan Ming quickly discovered a problem.
The Zhu Rong Heart Technique was extremely obscure; he could enter quickly due to having some fire control foundation.
Yet as he delved deeper into this heart technique, solely relying on diligent practice to cultivate it to a profound level seemed impossible in a mere month.
Just when Yuan Ming was furrowing his brows.
In a dim room within an undersea cavern, Mao Yi was playing with the Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter, with one fire after another flying out from the body of the scepter, swirling around his body yet emitting no trace of temperature.
Sitting on a stone chair in front of him was a burly man clad entirely in Black Armor, with only his eyes exposed, his gaze fixated on Mao Yi as he exclaimed, "Tsk tsk, you can control the Flame of Emperor Yan to such an extent. Your Zhu Rong Heart Technique is nearly at the Great Perfection of the Five Levels, isn't it?"
This person was enveloped in dense demon energy, having reached the Level 5 Peak, clearly the Black Dragon Turtle transformed.
"I'm still a bit short. This secret technique is the cherished one of the Zhu Rong Sect, and breaking through to the Great Perfection of the Five Levels requires undergoing the baptism of the Zhu Rong Fire Pool. Reaching the Fifth Level is already lucky." Mao Yi shook his head and said.
"Since the cultivation of the Zhu Rong Heart Technique is so challenging, you still expect them to achieve the third level within a month? It's impossible." The Black-armored Man said puzzled.
"I don't actually expect them to truly achieve the third level; just reaching the first level would be enough. It's just that if I say so directly, they might feel complacent. There's no time left." Mao Yi said.
"Oh, is there news from the Dongji Palace?" The Black-armored Man's eyes lit up.
"His own son has been captured; Ouyang Qiang can't sit still." Mao Yi chuckled.
...
In the prison, Yuan Ming's brows were tightly knit.
Seven or eight days had already passed, during which he had been practicing tirelessly, not wasting a single moment.
However, the Zhu Rong Heart Technique was overly obscure, his progress was minuscule, not even scratching the surface of the first level.
"Hua Zhi still hasn't found anything, and the advancement of the Zhu Rong Heart Technique is so sluggish. This time I'm really in big trouble." Yuan Ming muttered to himself rather helplessly.
Even though given his current Soul Cultivation Realm, if his Nascent Soul declined, his main soul could still seize a body and be reborn, but Magic Practitioner and Body Cultivation aspects would have to start over, rendering all previous efforts meaningless.
Unless absolutely necessary, he naturally couldn't abandon this body.
"Ah, why am I here stubbornly cracking the Zhu Rong Heart Technique all by myself when there's an easier way?" Yuan Ming suddenly thought of something and slapped his forehead in frustration.
He made a hand seal, and dazzling red light burst from his body, forming a flickering flame protective shield around him, making it seem as though he were comprehending the Zhu Rong Heart Technique.
Inside the flame protective shield, Yuan Ming flipped his hand, and a Silver Token appeared in it.
He softly chanted a few spells, activated the token, and opened a hemispherical silver barrier.
After doing this, he summoned the Stealing Heaven Tripod, took out a Black Incense, lit it, and possessed Qu Jiuhuang.
Qu Jiuhuang is currently obediently staying in the Shura Hall, seemingly in prayer.
Yuan Ming took out a blank Jade Scroll from Qu Jiuhuang, recorded the content of the Zhu Rong Heart Technique, and finally instructed Qu Jiuhuang to suspend all actions and focus entirely on cultivating the Zhu Rong Heart Technique.
The possession time quickly passed, and Qu Jiuhuang's consciousness returned.
"What just happened?" His expression was somewhat bewildered.
He had been praying just now, and his thoughts were suddenly interrupted, as if something had happened. No matter how he tried to recall, he couldn't remember what had occurred.
Qu Jiuhuang then discovered the Jade Scroll on the ground in front of him. His Divine Sense immersed into it, and a flash of realization appeared in his eyes.
"Am I to stop Planting Beans into Soldiers and switch to cultivating this Zhu Rong Heart Technique?" Qu Jiuhuang was somewhat reluctant.
The Planting Beans into Soldiers was profound and mysterious, vaguely containing a trace of the ultimate principle. He had already started to master it, finding more and more pleasure in cultivation, and really didn't want to stop.
But now, his life and death were under Yuan Ming's control, so he could only follow the arrangement. He sighed lightly and began to comprehend the Zhu Rong Heart Technique.
"This... such a mystical Fire Control Secret Technique. In terms of grade, this Zhu Rong Heart Technique is probably not inferior to Planting Beans into Soldiers. Isn't Yuan Ming a Loose Cultivator? Where did he find so many profound secret techniques?" Qu Jiuhuang was shocked after a brief comprehension.
A moment later, the shock on his face dissipated, replaced by joy. His earlier dissatisfaction had long vanished.
As an Alchemist, such a delicate Fire Control Secret Technique as the Zhu Rong Heart Technique was of immense benefit to him. If he could master it, his Alchemy Technique might advance further.
Qu Jiuhuang took a deep breath, calmed his mind, and began cultivating the Zhu Rong Heart Technique.
In the Undersea Prison, Yuan Ming opened his eyes, a slight smile on his lips.
Although Qu Jiuhuang walked an Evil Path, his Fire Control level as an Alchemist was far superior to Yuan Ming's own, so practicing the Zhu Rong Heart Technique would naturally yield twice the results with half the effort.
Once Qu Jiuhuang successfully cultivated it, Yuan Ming planned to use Black Incense Possession to glean experience.
Though unsure how far this could progress, the improvement speed of the Zhu Rong Heart Technique would certainly be much faster than now.
Even with Qu Jiuhuang's help, Yuan Ming was not idle.
He put away the Stealing Heaven Tripod, dispersed the silver barrier, and continued to comprehend the Zhu Rong Heart Technique.
In the blink of an eye, seven days passed, and the Tai Chi Pattern on the first-class Stealing Heaven Tripod was restored. Yuan Ming immediately possessed Qu Jiuhuang.
Qu Jiuhuang obeyed his command, was practicing the Zhu Rong Heart Technique, and a layer of flames surfaced on his body, dancing like elves.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming hurriedly calmed his mind to feel Qu Jiuhuang's thoughts.
A series of insights related to the cultivation of the Zhu Rong Heart Technique was transmitted over, and Qu Jiuhuang's Zhu Rong Heart Technique had already reached the Second Realm.
"Those with advanced Fire Control experience find the cultivation of the Zhu Rong Heart Technique progress rapidly," Yuan Ming thought to himself.
As Yuan Ming deepened his refining of the Stealing Heaven Tripod, the effect of Black Incense Possession also improved, and his Zhu Rong Heart Technique quickly advanced, soon breaking through the First Level.
Qu Jiuhuang's insights continued to flow over, and Yuan Ming's Zhu Rong Heart Technique continued to advance, soon reaching the Second Level.
But at this moment, the time for Black Incense Possession was up, and his consciousness returned to his body.
"What a pity, just a bit short. Once this matter is concluded, I'll need to find a way to extend the burning time of the Black Incense," Yuan Ming resolved secretly.
With this thought, he put away the Stealing Heaven Tripod and independently contemplated the Zhu Rong Heart Technique.
Without Qu Jiuhuang's insights to aid him, comprehending the Zhu Rong Heart Technique became as slow as a crawling turtle once more.
"Time is pressing, half of the one-month period has already passed, and I can at most possess Qu Jiuhuang twice more. It may not be possible to reach the Third Level. I must also find a way to make progress here," Yuan Ming mused, silent in thought.
A moment later, he took out the Stealing Heaven Tripod again, poured Mana into it, merging with the White Jade Lotus Platform, soon touching the Bright Soul Fire within the Lotus Platform space.
His current mastery of the Zhu Rong Heart Technique was close to the Second Level, and attempting to manipulate a powerful spirit flame might also enhance this mental method.
The Bright Soul Fire was controlled by the Forbidden of the White Jade Lotus Platform, making it very difficult to handle, but this could serve as a training opportunity.
The Mana Yuan Ming issued was mixed with Soul Power, and the moment it touched the Bright Soul Fire, his Divine Soul felt a sharp pain, but it was still bearable.
Yuan Ming took a deep breath, performing the Zhu Rong Heart Technique and attempting to control the Bright Soul Fire.
His eyes soon brightened, this method indeed proving effective, as the speed of advancing the Zhu Rong Heart Technique increased significantly.
Yuan Ming immediately closed his eyes, fully operating the Zhu Rong Heart Technique.
In the blink of an eye, another half month passed.
When Yuan Ming finished possessing Qu Jiuhuang for the third time, he sighed helplessly.
Currently, Qu Jiuhuang had already cultivated the Zhu Rong Heart Technique to the Second Level Peak, and through possession and insight, Yuan Ming's Zhu Rong Heart Technique swiftly advanced, also reaching the Second Level Peak.
However, the Third Level seemed like an insurmountable chasm, and neither Qu Jiuhuang nor himself could break through.
Of course, this was due to the short time; if there was ample time, he could comprehend it even without Qu Jiuhuang. Unfortunately, the one-month deadline was approaching, and there was no time left.

chapters.title: Chapter 807 - 778: What Exactly Do You Want to Do?
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming closed his eyes, conducting an inner observation of the Nascent Soul within his Dantian.
The purple on the Nascent Soul had grown denser compared to a month ago. Although he didn't feel any discomfort yet, he had a clear intuition that the time of the poison outbreak was drawing increasingly near.
"Hua Zhi, how are things on your side?" Yuan Ming sent a message to Hua Zhi.
"Master, this Purple Fluorescent Poison is too peculiar. I've never seen anything like it before. I've studied it for so long but still haven't figured out its nature." Hua Zhi shook her head, looking exhausted.
"It's fine, you've worked hard during this time. Leave the rest to me." Yuan Ming was not surprised and comforted her.
"Although I haven't figured out the Purple Fluorescent Poison, I have found a way to delay its outbreak." Hua Zhi smiled broadly.
"Oh? What method?" Yuan Ming immediately asked.
"Despite its peculiarities, this poison still falls under the category of lethal toxins. I am born with an Absorption Poison Divine Ability, and my Lifebound Essence Qi has a strong detoxifying effect. My method is to..." Hua Zhi explained a technique, using her Lifebound Essence Qi to lay a seal in Yuan Ming's Nascent Soul to delay the outbreak of the poison.
"It's not suitable." Yuan Ming pondered for a moment and rejected this proposal.
"Why?" Hua Zhi asked with a frown.
"Although this method is possible, it would greatly consume your Lifebound Essence Qi, potentially causing you to fall out of the Returning to Void Stage. Do not mention this again." Yuan Ming firmly refused.
"But..." Hua Zhi hurriedly said.
"Don't worry, there's still some time left, and I have a plan." Yuan Ming waved his hand, interrupting Hua Zhi's next words and ending the messaging.
Yuan Ming calmed his mind, channeled mana into the White Jade Lotus Platform, and continued to enhance the Zhu Rong Heart Technique using the Bright Soul Fire.
Previously, he had been exercising with the Bright Soul Fire by controlling a single flame. Now, with time running out, he decided to go all out and even involved the main soul hovering on the White Jade Lotus Platform.
As a stream of Soul Power flowed out from the main soul and merged with his mana, he began to control five clusters of Bright Soul Fire at once.
The main soul directly contacting the Bright Soul Fire could indeed unleash the effects of the Zhu Rong Heart Technique, but the Divine Soul still felt an intense stabbing pain, almost as if it were about to fall apart.
Yuan Ming gritted his teeth and endured, continuing to manipulate the Bright Soul Fire, constantly making various changes.
He faintly felt that he had made considerable progress towards breaking through to the third level of the Zhu Rong Heart Technique, advancing much faster than before.
Time quickly passed by half a day.
The main soul rapidly weakened under the scorching of the Bright Soul Fire, nearly weakening by thirty percent.
His comprehension of the Zhu Rong Heart Technique also deepened continuously, yet he was consistently just a bit away from the third level and unable to break through.
Yuan Ming furrowed his brows, gritted his teeth, and increased the control to seven clusters of Bright Soul Fire, the stabbing pain in his Divine Soul became ever stronger, creating an illusion of a splitting headache.
Thus, after another small half-day passed, Yuan Ming's main soul's Soul Power was less than half. The Zhu Rong Heart Technique still hadn't broken through, just missing a final hurdle.
"It seems time is still too finite; I haven't truly settled my mind to practice... There's no time left, let's go all out!" Yuan Ming shook his head at first, then his face showed resolute determination.
He took a deep breath, fully integrating the main soul into his mana to control seven clusters of Bright Soul Fire, pushing himself to the limit to enhance his understanding of the Zhu Rong Heart Technique as much as possible.
"Good lad, gutsy!" Somewhere in the Stealing Heaven Tripod, the Artifact Spirit Kong showed a hint of a smile, made a gesture, and pointed to the void ahead.
In Yuan Ming's consciousness, a sea of flames suddenly appeared, reaching up to the sky and descending into Nine Netherworld, burning fiercely.
The flames, either exploding or flickering, continuously changed, demonstrating the profound mysteries of fire.
The fiery vision came and went fast, disappearing almost as quickly as it had appeared.
In the next moment, Yuan Ming's eyes widened, and he seemed to be immobilized, frozen there, unaware that the main soul was continuously being burned by the Bright Soul Fire.
In his Sea of Consciousness, he repeatedly recalled the scene, enhancing his comprehension of the Zhu Rong Heart Technique at an unbelievable speed.
"Haha, I understand now! The third level of the Zhu Rong Heart Technique emphasizes change, from Dao comes one, one generates two, two generates three, and three generates all things; the Daoist Skill is perfected!" Yuan Ming burst into laughter at the sky, the Zhu Rong Heart Technique instantly clicked, breaking through to the third level.
He made a gesture, and the seven clusters of Bright Soul Fire rapidly changed, forming human shapes or beast shapes, flying around more vividly than before by tenfold.
With the completion of the third level of the Zhu Rong Heart Technique, his control over the Bright Soul Fire became more skillful; what previously required ten parts of Soul Power, now only one part sufficed, greatly reducing the impact on his Divine Soul.
At this time, Yuan Ming's face was deathly pale, looking like his Divine Soul had been severely depleted, yet his expression was surprisingly relaxed. After a long exhale, he did not continue further and began to retract his Soul Power.
As long as his Divine Soul was not fundamentally damaged, absorbing Moonlight Power would quickly recover it. With much hustle, he finally broke through the Zhu Rong Heart Technique to the third level within the allotted time, laying a more solid foundation for studying the Artifact Refining and Alchemy Techniques in the future.
But what was that fiery vision about? It didn't seem to be his own comprehension but rather someone assisting him.
"Senior Kong, was that you just now?" Yuan Ming asked, but there was no response.
Without questioning further, he put away the Stealing Heaven Tripod and the Silver Token, then closed his eyes to begin breathing control.
The Undying Tree Roots in his Dantian took root in the void, absorbing the scattered Moonlight Power in the void to heal the wounds on his Divine Soul.
Early the next morning.
A figure appeared in front of Yuan Ming's cell, none other than Mao Yi himself.
"It's time. How well has Fellow Daoist Yuan cultivated the Zhu Rong Heart Technique?" Mao Yi coldly watched Yuan Ming, slowly asking.

Yuan Ming didn't waste words, raised his hands from his sides, and began chanting.
In the next moment, sparks emerged from his body's surface, swirling around him, akin to living creatures, sometimes forming flying birds soaring, other times transforming into schools of fish swimming around.
"Have you learned the Zhu Rong Heart Technique before?" As Mao Yi's pupils flickered with subtle light, his expression became slightly doubtful and uncertain.
"No, but I have studied Artifact Refining Technique diligently, so I have some foundation in fire control." Yuan Ming replied half-truthfully.
This left Mao Yi thoroughly shocked.
Being well-versed in the Zhu Rong Heart Technique, he could clearly see that Yuan Ming had genuinely mastered it, reaching the third realm.
Yet, if Yuan Ming had truly never practiced the Zhu Rong Heart Technique a month ago, his progress to the third level within a month seemed somewhat unfathomable.
Even for himself, re-cultivating and comprehending the Zhu Rong Heart Technique from scratch could not achieve the third realm in such a short time.
"How exactly did this kid accomplish this?"
Though thoughts churned in Mao Yi's mind, he hid his emotions well on the surface without showing direct surprise, only revealing an expression of admiration after a moment of silence.
"Well, as expected of Fellow Daoist Yuan, truly gifted as entrusted. This bottle of elixir can suppress the Purple Fluorescent Poison, take it." Mao Yi couldn't help but praise, then tossed a porcelain bottle into the cell.
"Suppress? I thought you said surviving by cultivating within a month meant you'd cure the poison." Yuan Ming picked up the porcelain bottle, speaking discontentedly.
"Heh, rest assured. Since I promised, I won't break my word. However, I still need your help with a major task. Once it's done, I will rid you of the poison completely and offer unexpected benefits." Mao Yi smiled slightly.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming gripped the porcelain bottle tightly, feeling a semblance of anger, but he said no more, extracting a green elixir from the bottle.
After carefully examining it, he consumed it.
The green elixir melted upon entering his stomach, transforming into a green mist that entered his Dantian, merging with the Nascent Soul within.
The purple within the Nascent Soul quickly receded, yet did not vanish, condensing into a purple-black spot on the Nascent Soul's abdomen.
Yuan Ming's eyes narrowed slightly, but he said nothing.
"Follow me," Mao Yi gestured, and the cell door opened automatically.
Yuan Ming followed him out of the cell in confusion and soon arrived at a spacious room.
Within the room, Huangfu Jue and three other Returning to Void Cultivators were waiting, including Yun Luo Fairy.
As for the other two Returning to Void Cultivators, one was a bald old man and the other a white-faced scholar, neither known to Yuan Ming.
"Mao Yi, I've complied with your demands for a whole month. What exactly do you intend to do?" Upon seeing Mao Yi and Yuan Ming approach, Huangfu Jue glanced at Yuan Ming and asked in a deep voice.
"Heh, Young Friend Huangfu, be patient. Everything will be revealed soon. Before that, I have one last requirement, which is straightforward. There is a Fire Attribute Array that must be controlled with the Zhu Rong Heart Technique. You all meet the conditions. Just master the array, and then use it to do one thing for me, and I'll cure the Purple Fluorescent Poison and grant you freedom," Mao Yi chuckled.
"What do you intend to do with that Great Array? Surely not to make us oppose Dongji Palace? If so, even with freedom, we'll face endless pursuits from Dongji Palace, ultimately boarding your pirate ship anyway," questioned the bald old man.
"Rest assured, everyone. What I ask isn't something difficult or that will affect your future cultivation. After it's done, I'll return your storage magic tools and magic treasures as promised, without fails," Mao Yi continued without anger.
Everyone exchanged glances, still harboring concern and doubts, but given their current situation, they had no means of resistance, and voicing a few refutations was the most they could do.
However… even if they gained freedom, they would still have to live in Dongji Sea, forced to consider Dongji Palace's stance on the matter.
Thus, all eyes turned to Huangfu Jue, attempting to gauge his attitude.
"Senior Mao, being a Dharma manifestation stage existence, you surely wouldn't break your word. I hope you will keep your promise," Huangfu Jue said slowly after a brief silence.
"Heh, you juniors aren't worth breaking faith with, but I won't show mercy to those without value," Mao Yi coldly smiled at the group.
As Mao Yi's gaze settled on them, everyone felt a chill fill their bodies, as though pierced by knives and spears, instinctively averting his gaze, except Yuan Ming, who seemed unfazed.
"Since Senior has said so, we naturally believe it. But, may I ask, what formation do you wish us to practice?" Yuan Ming asked, looking at Mao Yi.

chapters.title: Chapter 808 - 779: Emperor Yan's Mausoleum
chapters.content:
Facing Yuan Ming's question, Mao Yi flicked his sleeve, and a stack of fiery red Array Flag Array Plates appeared inside the room, the Array Flags engraved with complex runes, emitting bursts of scorching heat.
Everyone felt a wave of heat rushing towards them, as if they were standing at the mouth of a volcano.
Immediately afterward, Mao Yi tossed several Jade Scrolls containing Formation information, which flew into the hands of each person.
Yuan Ming released his Divine Sense into the Jade Scroll in his hand, a trace of surprise flashing in his eyes.
The Formation Mao Yi had given was a top-tier Fire Attribute Level 5 Array Formation. In terms of sophistication, even amongst Su Yingxue's collection of Level 5 Formations, it held a ranking.
However, the structure of this Formation was quite peculiar. It didn't seem meant for attack or defense. Many of the rune combinations used had a certain specificity, seemingly designed to break a certain Forbidden area.
Yuan Ming harbored some suspicions and discreetly observed everyone again.
The other people's expertise in formations weren't as profound as Yuan Ming's, so they didn't notice the strange aspects of the Formation, merely considering them as Mao Yi's treasures.
Yuan Ming had no intention of alerting them, swallowing the matter silently.
In the following days, Yuan Ming and the others, under Mao Yi's supervision, continually practiced this special Formation. Due to its complexity, it took them a full half month to master it.
Once Mao Yi noticed this, he didn't delay further and immediately led everyone and his other subordinates out of the underground, summoning the black Long Gui, and rode it swiftly in the deep sea.
Throughout the journey, Mao Yi did not shield the group's perception, so they quickly realized their destination this time was the Abyss Dead Land, deep within the Dongji Sea.
Unease grew in everyone's hearts at this realization, even Yuan Ming found it difficult to maintain his composure, agitation stirred within.
Half a month later, the black Long Gui finally came to a stop.
Everyone on the turtle's back gazed ahead, the distant sea seemingly calm and peaceful, yet the seabed was filled with deep darkness. Neither eyesight nor Divine Sense could discern its depth, like a Bottomless Abyss.
The surrounding seawater also appeared pristine, without fish or shrimp, and absent of any sound, akin to a sea of dead silence.
"So this is the Abyss Dead Land..." Yun Luo Fairy murmured, seemingly having never been here before.
Huangfu Jue, the bald elder, and the white-faced scholar were no different.
Yuan Ming also looked forward, a trace of unusual color flashing in his eyes.
Mao Yi didn't lead everyone directly into the Abyss but stopped at the edge and moved no further, nor did he explain, appearing to wait for something.
The others followed suit, quietly waiting.
Approximately half a day later, everyone viewed from afar a giant Flying Boat, shadowing the skies like a floating island, arriving swiftly and stopping not far away.
Mao Yi noticed this and also flew up from the giant turtle alone, gazing at the massive boat, his robe flapping despite no wind.
"Palace Master Ouyang, you've come from afar, I've been waiting here for quite some time." He slowly spoke, his voice echoing through the heavens and earth.
"Humph."
Then, everyone heard a loud, clear scoff, like thunder from the Nine Heavens erupting out of nowhere, a terrifying pressure instantly descended all around, suppressing the sea into stillness, the clouds into serene.
However, the Qi Force and pressure couldn't touch Mao Yi in the slightest, as if a Qi Shield protected him, disconnecting everything.
"I didn't expect you to be a member of the Three Realms Sect, Mao Yi. I, Ouyang Qiang, must be truly old, not realizing a rat sneaking right under my nose." A figure appeared in mid-air, confronting Mao Yi from afar.
The person revealed was a woman, around thirty years old, skin whiter than snow, black hair like clouds, clothed in a fiery red palace attire resembling flames and blood, exuding a domineering aura that defies direct gaze.
She stared at Mao Yi, her eyebrows raised, eyes glaring, anyone could discern her overwhelming rage.
"Hehe, Palace Master Ouyang has praised me too much. In the letter, I stated clearly my intentions for inviting the Palace Master here, seeking a negotiation. With such an imposing stance, could it be you're eager for a fight first?" Mao Yi chuckled lightly.
"Do you think I dare not?" Dongji Palace Master Ouyang Qiang coldly retorted.
With those words, her silhouette flashed, suddenly appearing inches before Mao Yi, a fair hand already pointed at his forehead.
Yet Mao Yi's stance never shifted from start to finish, the expression on his face unchanged.
"With Palace Master Ouyang's boundless Divine Skills, not to mention a duel, even outright killing me wouldn't be difficult. But the Nine Revolutions Divine Sky Technique holds earth-shattering power, and if its aftermath were to harm your dear son here, it might leave the Palace Master with deep regret." Mao Yi gestured at Huangfu Jue on the turtle's back, then tucked his sleeves, smiling.
An unknown yellow halo surrounded Huangfu Jue, he opened his mouth, seemingly about to speak, yet uttered no sound.
Witnessing this, Ouyang Qiang's expression grew increasingly gloomy, yet she retracted the extended hand.
"...Tell me, what do you want?" After a moment of silence, Ouyang Qiang flashed back to her original position and asked.
"Just as I mentioned in my letter, I hope that Palace Master Ouyang can bring the Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter and open the Emperor Yan's Mausoleum with me." Mao Yi smiled slightly.
"The story of the Emperor Yan's Tomb has been passed down for so many years, yet no one has ever found its exact location. Judging by what you said, have you discovered something?" Ouyang Qiang's sullen face was moved.He&lp us cont-i!n%ue by r-e$ad%in@g at the s.o+ur%ce^: *&.
"That's right, I've already discovered that the tomb is in this Abyss Dead Land. As for the exact location, I've personally confirmed it, and there will be no mistake." Mao Yi said proudly.
"But even knowing the location, it's said that three Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepters are needed to open the tomb. You and I each have one. Have you found the last one?" Ouyang Qiang frowned slightly.
"No, I only have one in my hand, and as for the remaining one, I have searched every corner of the Dongji Sea for so many years but never found any clues. I suspect it might not even be in the Dongji Sea." Mao Yi shook his head.
"Then what use is there in inviting me?" Ouyang Qiang appeared displeased.
"Palace Master need not worry. Since I dare to invite you, I have a way to open the tomb with two Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepters. To be honest, if I could find the whereabouts of the third Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter, I wouldn't have wanted you to join." Mao Yi said with a regretful expression.
Ouyang Qiang carefully observed the subtle changes in Mao Yi's expression, silently weighing the pros and cons in his mind.
If the other party wasn't holding any chips, as a Demon Cultivator, Ouyang Qiang wouldn't even have given him a chance to speak.
Mao Yi wasn't in a hurry. He believed that even if it wasn't for Huangfu Jue's safety, Ouyang Qiang wouldn't refuse when it involved Emperor Yan's Immortal Mansion.
"Alright, I agree with you, but you must release Huangfu Jue first." After some thought, Ouyang Qiang made a decision.
"That's impossible, Palace Master Ouyang. You should know that before entering the Emperor Yan's Tomb, I won't release Huangfu Jue. This is our basis for mutual trust." Mao Yi decisively refused.
"Then how can I believe you won't betray me after getting what you want?" Ouyang Qiang retorted.
After a bout of sharp exchanges, the two sides eventually compromised, with Mao Yi swearing to release Huangfu Jue upon opening the tomb.
After the discussion, Ouyang Qiang turned and flew back to the giant boat.
Mao Yi didn't linger in mid-air either and flew back to the turtle's back.
"You all heard my conversation with Palace Master Ouyang just now. Next, we will enter the Abyss Dead Land. You should be aware of the two major dangers in the Abyss—Demon Song and Abyss Giant Beast. I won't say more than necessary. As long as you listen to what I say when danger arises, you can keep your lives. If you don't follow orders, don't blame me if you die." Mao Yi said to Yuan Ming and the five others.
The group exchanged glances but, constrained by their situation, no one dared to voice any objections.
After a brief rest, Mao Yi signaled towards the Dongji Palace's Flying Boat, and the two groups set out together, stepping into the Abyss Dead Land.
Not long after they left, a large mass of white cloud quietly flew by in the sky, occasionally flashing with spirit light inside, clear evidence that it was not a natural cloud.
On the cloud stood two or three dozen figures in white, exuding a majestic aura, among whom were Returning Void beings.
"Did you see clearly? Are you sure it was indeed Ouyang Qiang?" asked a middle-aged man in the center of the crowd.
This man stood tall, with features like exquisite jade, and wore a piece of purple jade around his waist, appearing as if a refined scholar from the mundane world.
"Reporting to the Mountain Master, I saw very clearly. It was indeed Ouyang Qiang herself. The Thunder aura from her is unmistakeable. As for the other group, they are indeed the Demon Cultivators from the Black Evil Sect, with Mao Yi at their head." Answered a sturdy, blond man beside him, gazing into the distance.
This man's eyes were bright and occasionally shot out several feet of retractable Golden Light, resembling some Spiritual Eye Divine Power.
"Good, it seems this trip won't be in vain. To think that the Emperor Yan's Tomb truly has a day of emergence," the middle-aged scholar remarked with a gentle smile.
"Then let's quickly catch up. The situation within the Abyss Dead Land is unpredictable, unlike the Dongji Sea. If we lose them, it will be troublesome," a gray-clothed elder suggested in a voice.
