If Yuan Ming were here, he would certainly recognize this person—it was none other than Dian Xiaosan, who appeared at the Ten Thousand Goods Immortal Trip.
"No need to be anxious, Master Dian. With Gao Feng here, they won't be lost, and there's another matter at hand." The middle-aged scholar mentioned.
"What matter?" Dian Xiaosan was taken aback.
"Brother Zhu Yu, we're about to enter the abyss. How long do you plan to hide?" The middle-aged scholar glanced below with a soft smile.
The sea water beneath the white cloud suddenly surged, and a gigantic sea beast with a fearsome shape emerged. It resembled a shark but was a hundred times larger than ordinary shark demon beasts, with four massive beast claws under its ribs, glistening with a chilling light.
On the back of the sea beast stood a dozen Returning Void entities. Though they were humanoid, their eyes carried the fierce quality unique to the Demon Clan.
"Demons from the Azure Dragon Pond!" Dian Xiaosan exclaimed in surprise.
The shark sea beast seemed very displeased with the group in the air, raising its head to let out a silent roar into the sky. The surging waves resembled a storm, seemingly about to strike the cloud's tip.
Meanwhile, the white cloud in the sky roiled, and several Returning Void cultivators inside grasped their Magic Treasures, ready and vigilant.
"Tsk tsk, Brother Bai Yuan, your Spiritual Sense is quite sharp. I've already used the Water Concealing Divine Ability on Guo Sha, yet you still detected us." A blue-robed man atop the shark sea beast shot forward, appearing in front of the white cloud in a blur, moving at terrifying speed akin to Instantaneous Movement.
This man's face was broad, with an enormous mouth extending to his ears, a flat nose, and faint blue scales on his arms, carrying some Demon Clan traits.

chapters.title: Chapter 809 - 780: Searching for the Tomb
chapters.content:
The white-clad cultivators standing on the white clouds stared intently at the blue-robed man on the shark sea beast not far ahead, their eyes full of vigilance, not daring to relax at all.
The higher the bloodline level of the demon beast, the more difficult it is to transform into a human. The enormous demon energy emanating from this blue-robed man has already reached level six, yet he hasn't fully transformed, which speaks volumes.
"I've long heard that the leader of Azure Dragon Pond is a descendant of the ancient whale clan. It seems that this is likely true." The cultivators on the white cloud whispered through Divine Sense.
"Haha, Zhu Yu's Mysterious Water Escape skills have become even more refined. Impressive, impressive." The middle-aged scholar flew out, chuckling.
"Ah, it's merely the Mysterious Water Escape. Compared to the Bodhi Mystical Arts of Luo Jia Mountain, it doesn't count for much. We know each other well, so there's no need for flattery. What actions is Luo Jia Mountain planning next?" The blue-robed man waved his hand and said.
"Since Brother Zhu Yu is direct, then I shall speak frankly. Luo Jia Mountain is very interested in Emperor Yan's Mausoleum and will certainly explore the Abyss. Presumably, the people of Azure Dragon Pond have the same intentions. Seeing how Dongji Palace and Black Evil Sect appear to have joined forces, perhaps our two sides should act together as well?" The middle-aged scholar said bluntly.
A hint of surprise flashed in the eyes of the blue-robed man, who had come here with the same intention. To his surprise, Bai Yuan mentioned it first, rendering his prepared words useless.
"Since Brother Bai Yuan has invited me, how could I refuse?" The blue-robed man thought quickly and laughed heartily.
The two groups quickly reached an agreement, abandoning their hesitations and confrontations, and set off together, following the route of Dongji Palace and Black Evil Sect into the Abyss Dead Land.
On the other side, the forces of Dongji Palace and Black Evil Sect, who entered the Abyss Dead Land first, soon arrived at the region of the Demon Song.
Just as Yuan Ming experienced back then, the mermaids swimming in the sea immediately began singing heavenly songs upon sensing someone approaching their territory.
Mao Yi had prepared for this, forming a spell with his right hand, causing thick black smoke to pour out from his sleeves, surrounding those on the turtle's back.
"Do not attempt to block your hearing. Steady your mind, and attack your Nascent Soul if necessary to break the illusion!" He instructed loudly.
Under the protection of the black smoke, the sound of the Demon Song in everyone's Sea of Consciousness became much fainter. Nevertheless, unprepared, they were almost instantly affected, with some even wandering out, trying to leave the protective black smoke to hear more of the song.
Seeing this, Mao Yi swiftly wielded the black smoke to completely envelop these individuals, constantly corroding their physical bodies and Nascent Souls.
Most of the Black Evil Sect cultivators, with Mao Yi's reminder, managed to break free from the Demon Song's control despite immense pain, emerging from the black smoke, although severely weakened but at least alive.
However, one or two never managed to shake off the influence, perishing in the black smoke, becoming nourishment for it, which made the smoke even denser and more effective at blocking the Demon Song.
Among the crowd, Yuan Ming, with his prior experience, was faring much better than the others.
Due to the obstruction of the black smoke, the influence on him this time was much weaker than that encountered upon leaving Yunhuang. Not only could he withstand it with his Divine Soul Power, but he also had the capacity to quietly observe others.
At this moment, everyone on the turtle's back, except for Mao Yi, appeared in pain. Due to the black smoke's obstruction, Yuan Ming couldn't see the external situation or know the state of Dongji Palace, though he assumed it wasn't faring much better.This chapter first appeared on *.
Suddenly, while Yuan Ming was quietly observing, he noticed that not far away, Yun Luo Fairy, seemingly pained, was actually, like him, discreetly observing the surroundings, on guard for potential attacks.
Startled, Yuan Ming quickly withdrew his gaze as Yun Luo Fairy seemed to be looking his way, pretending to be tormented by the Demon Song.
Yun Luo Fairy's gaze swept past, diving into Yuan Ming's body for a while before moving on.
Just at this moment, the Demon Song ceased, and the recently tormented crowd instantly became lucid, each showing a dazed expression.
Meanwhile, Mao Yi's face changed abruptly. He quickly formed a spell, absorbing all the black smoke back into his body, while the giant turtle swiftly dove into the sea, hiding in the depths under the concealment of Mao Yi's spell.
Yuan Ming, least affected, clearly saw, just before the giant turtle entered the water, far on the horizon was a massive fin, like a mountain, rising from the sea, its shadow even dyed the sea black, as if facing a vast black sea that extended beyond sight.
Around them, the mermaids also fled in panic into the waters, hurriedly swimming away from the fin, not daring to sing anymore.
As the giant turtle submerged, Yuan Ming saw in the distance a white "high wall" suddenly erecting in the sea, with an enormous black part in the middle, raising more questions.
It wasn't until the "high wall" gradually moved away, enveloped by another azure "high wall," that Yuan Ming suddenly realized it was an eye.
After some time, when the giant beast was no longer visible, Mao Yi cautiously maneuvered the giant turtle back to the surface, reconvening with the hiding Dongji Palace group, before continuing their journey.
Everyone on the turtle's back breathed a sigh of relief, as did Yuan Ming.
Among the crowd, Yun Luo Fairy gazed in the direction the beast departed, her expression calm, but Yuan Ming could sense her intense emotions, a mix of excitement and fear.
"Fellow Daoist Yun Luo, you who have long resided in Dongji Sea and come from a prestigious family, surely have more knowledge than I in these matters. Do you know why such a terrifying giant beast resides in the Abyss?" Yuan Ming approached Yun Luo Fairy, asking softly.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan overestimates me. I am but a woman and do not know the secrets of the Abyss," Yun Luo Fairy shook her head and replied.
"Is that so... Does Senior Mao Yi know the reason?" Yuan Ming turned to Mao Yi.
"Your curiosity is indeed not small, but I don't know the exact reason. I've only heard that there exists some special substance in the Abyss that can enlarge the body size of demon beasts by a thousandfold. However, whether such a thing really exists, no one can confirm." Mao Yi looked at Yuan Ming unexpectedly and said faintly.
"A substance that can enlarge the size of demon beasts..." Yuan Ming murmured to himself.
Recalling the giant beast he had just encountered, he couldn't help feeling a lingering fear.
Compared to it, the Golden Dragon Demon he encountered years ago could even be considered medium-sized.
If they had been swallowed by this giant beast back then, it would probably have been difficult to see the light of day again.
As Yuan Ming was contemplating this, he suddenly heard the Demon Song resounding again.
A new wave of danger descended, and everyone hurriedly focused to deal with it.
…
Both sides from Dongji Palace and Black Evil Sect maintained a distance not too close nor too far from each other, trudging forward in the perilous Abyss. But one day, after a month, they had no choice but to stop.
Perhaps they were already close to Wind Sea, as the wind raged furiously over the sea, creating towering angry waves. It was difficult for ordinary Returning Void cultivators to even find footing.
Fortunately, both Dongji Palace and Black Evil Sect had Dharma manifestation stage cultivators, so they could persist. But forcing their way forward wasn't possible.
The two parties halted near a crimson island, where raging flames engulfed everything — the ground and plants — yet everything on the island retained its form, not turning to ash.
From afar, one might mistake the island's flames for having no temperature, merely an illusion, but upon approaching, the hot, dry waves made even the Returning Void cultivators feel parched and seared.
Mao Yi commanded the giant turtle to stop in the sky not far from the island, then looked at the Dongji Palace flying boat closely following behind.
The previously majestic and grand flying boat was damaged in various places, with the stern completely gone.
The Dongji Palace cultivators aboard were significantly reduced in number, having been lost along the way, but Black Evil Sect was also equally affected.
"We have arrived, would Palace Master Ouyang kindly take out the Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter," Mao Yi said loudly.
Ouyang Qiang emerged from the flying boat, looking towards the nearby Flame Island, with a suspicious expression.
"Is this the location of Emperor Yan's Tomb?" Her Divine Sense scanned the island without any discovery, prompting her to ask Mao Yi.
"Naturally, it can't be seen now. Emperor Yan's Tomb is hidden beneath the island; first, we must find a way to summon it out." Mao Yi raised his hand, taking out Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter, pinched a spell with his hand, and simultaneously uttered eight syllables.
Countless crimson fire patterns lit up on the Flame Yellow Ruyi Scepter before him. Simultaneously, the island's flames seemed to be pulled by force, converging toward the island's center.
The surrounding nature's spiritual energy was also stirred, countless red light spots appearing, converging toward Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter. The fierce winds over the sea were affected by the spiritual energy's movement, weakening considerably.
However, these flames ultimately did not converge at one spot, but stopped midway, inexplicably swirling for a while before flying back to their original positions.
"It's already the limit to achieve this with just one Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter," Mao Yi shook his head regretfully, then looked at Ouyang Qiang.
Seeing this situation, Ouyang Qiang snorted lightly, waved her hand, and grasped another Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter in her palm.
"Summoning the tomb requires using both scepters simultaneously. Would Palace Master kindly lend your item to me for a while?" Mao Yi extended his hand and said.
"The activation technique you just used doesn't seem complex, why not teach me this technique, and then you and I can cast together and open the tomb together, wouldn't it be better?" Ouyang Qiang said.
"Palace Master Ouyang, we agreed before that you'd exchange Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter for Huangfu Jue, are you trying to go back on your word now?" Mao Yi frowned and said coldly.
"I never said I would use this treasure for an exchange. Besides, cultivators like you, what integrity can you have? If I give you the Spiritual Treasure, you will have no more concerns," Ouyang Qiang sneered and asked.
Mao Yi's eyes darkened, intending to use Huangfu Jue as leverage again, but upon seeing Ouyang Qiang's resolute expression, he realized that even if he killed Huangfu Jue now, it likely wouldn't result in compromise.
After all, compared to the benefits from Emperor Yan's Tomb, Huangfu Jue was naturally far less important.
For Ouyang Qiang, this was the case, and even more so for Mao Yi.
After weighing things, Mao Yi chose to hand over the spell for activating Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter.

chapters.title: Chapter 810 - 781: Rock Pool
chapters.content:
The spell to activate the Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter may be intricate, but with Ouyang Qiang's ability at the Dharma manifestation Realm, it only took him a moment to fully grasp it.
After achieving the goal, Ouyang Qiang did not speak further, and both of them simultaneously activated the Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter.
With the casting of both Spiritual Treasures at once, the manifestation was even clearer. The surface of the Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter flickered with spirit light, and fire-red runes emerged from the scepter's surface, floating unpredictably.
As the two continued chanting their spells, they fiercely activated the spell.
Immediately, all the runes surged toward the two of them, intertwining and wrapping around, emitting a dazzling fiery glow. In no time, a blazing phantom began to weave around Mao Yi and Ouyang Qiang.
On the nearby Flame Island, endless flames rose into the sky, resembling a flock of birds returning to their nest, converging toward the island's center.
The island's ground began to tremble, the tides surrounding it surged, and even the seabed beneath the ocean emitted muffled sounds of friction and collision.
Soon after, under everyone's gaze, the island suddenly split open, and boundless firelight burst forth from the fissures, with molten lava erupting like a volcano, rushing skyward.
The fire attribute spirit qi in the air became frenetic, and everyone felt as though flames were licking their skin and burning their meridians, forcing them to cast protective spells.
In the next moment, the fiery light and molten lava swarmed upward, revealing a corner of an exceptionally grand building to everyone.
From the outside, the building appeared to be a magnificent palace, its fire-red bricks reflecting the sky, casting a light akin to flames. Red pillars supporting the roof were engraved with cloud-like fire runes, and orange-red flames crawled over the frames of its doors and windows, burning continuously.
"Emperor Yan's Tomb..."
Whether they were cultivators from Dongji Palace or members of the Black Evil Sect, upon seeing this magnificent building, their expressions filled with excitement.Need character sheets and glossaries? Visit *.
Yuan Ming gazed at the fiery palace before him, and a flicker of excitement flashed in his eyes.
He quietly opened a passage to the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space, placing the black Fire Burning Stick near the passage. As the red palace rose, the Fire Burning Stick inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space trembled intensely, resonating powerfully with the red palace.
"It seems that the Fire Burning Stick is indeed the third Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter," Yuan Ming thought to himself.
As the tomb revealed itself, some impatient individuals from both sides attempted to approach it, but the flames on the palace's doors and windows surged forth together, forming a scarlet barrier like an eggshell outside the palace, blocking their advance.
Flames burned on the barrier, intermittently shooting out thick fiery columns like turbulent fire dragons.
"What is this?" Ouyang Qiang's eyebrows furrowed slightly.
"How could Emperor Yan's Tomb lack a forbidden defense? This is the Emperor Yan's Fire Dragon Formation, a genuine sixth-level Great Array. Unfortunately, we couldn't find the third Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter," Mao Yi said slowly.
"Sixth-level Magic Array!" Ouyang Qiang's face pale.
With each level's increase in an array, its power undergoes monumental changes, and even if she and Mao Yi joined forces, breaking through the sixth-level array would be nearly impossible.
However, she soon noticed Mao Yi's expression, serious but not worried.
"Since Fellow Daoist Mao knows about this forbidden defense, he must have prepared a forbidden breaking method. There's no time to waste; let's proceed!" Ouyang Qiang urged.
"Hehe, there's no need to rush, Palace Master Ouyang. Everyone, hear my command, swiftly form the array and break the forbidden defense!" Mao Yi turned and shouted to Yuan Ming and the others.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming became aware, finally understanding the purpose of Mao Yi's insistence on practicing the Great Array. The others also belatedly realized this, surprised by Mao Yi's deep understanding of the tomb's forbidden defenses.
Yet, despite their surprise, the five acted swiftly. Almost at the moment Mao Yi spoke, they followed their practiced habits to jointly perform the Fire Control Secret Technique.
The yellow light circle that originally enveloped Huangfu Jue disappeared, restoring his freedom.
Huangfu Jue hesitated briefly but did not attempt to escape, instead joining Yuan Ming's casting with the others.
The spiritual power connection between the five formed quickly, a scarlet Great Array taking shape rapidly. Countless flame-like spirit lights appeared within the array, flowing swiftly around the five.
The five continued their spell casting, prompting changes in the array, gathering those flame spirit lights toward the center. In a mere moment, a massive red lotus took form.
In the next moment, the five simultaneously altered their spell, and a thick red light shot from the center of the Flame Red Lotus, striking the eggshell-like scarlet barrier enveloping Emperor Yan's Tomb.
The Emperor Yan's Fire Dragon Formation seemed to be activated, with countless flames swarming aside, soon revealing a passage leading straight to the tomb's entrance.
"Go!"
Seeing this, Mao Yi rejoiced and immediately commanded the giant turtle to fly towards the gate.
Ouyang Qiang was also unwilling to lag behind, leading the Dongji Palace forces in close pursuit.
Meanwhile, a formless suction emerged from Emperor Yan's Tomb entrance, and Yuan Ming, along with his companions, were involuntarily sucked in along with the surrounding Flame Lotus Formation.
Just as the two groups entered the passage, the clouds in the sky suddenly churned, rapidly forming a massive vortex covering half the sky.
"Boom."
A vast pillar of spiritual energy descended from the center of the vortex, crashing into the passageway of the Emperor Yan's Fire Dragon Formation.
The Emperor Yan's Fire Dragon Formation emitted an earth-shattering roar, as white and red lights clashed violently, then exploded, sending the people of Dongji Palace and Black Evil Sect flying.
Yuan Ming and his companions were taken aback, and without continuing to maneuver the Array, they scattered in all directions to escape.
However, the suction force from the array's passage suddenly increased by several times, firmly holding the five of them, rendering them immobile, while the aftermath of the explosion was blocked by this suction force.
At that moment, a white cloud flew out from the vortex in the sky, heading straight for the passageway.
Meanwhile, a ferocious shark sea beast emerged from the sea, much smaller in size, with a dozen figures standing on its back, each at the Returning Void level, led by none other than Zhu Yu, with the aura of a Level 6 demon beast fully displayed.
"That person is..." Yuan Ming's expression changed slightly.
Among the people on the shark's back, there was a man in a silver robe, conspicuously the Silver Dragon Taoist.
The Shark Sea Beast turned into a black shadow, also charging towards the passageway.
"Haha, thank you, Fellow Daoist Mao and Palace Master Ouyang, for paving the way for us!" a deafening laugh came from the white cloud, belonging to the middle-aged scholar Bai Yuan.
"Luo Jia Mountain, Azure Dragon Pond!" Mao Yi widened his eyes and immediately shouted fiercely, making a spell with his hands.
The black dharma manifestation reappeared behind him, with its two large hands emitting intense black light, reaching for the white cloud and shark sea beast.
Ouyang Qiang's face was also quite ugly, murmuring a few spells, as rolling thunderclouds erupted above his head, transforming into a thunder and lightning dharma form, standing on dark clouds, clad in lightning armor, holding a gigantic thunder bow in his right hand.
The Thunder and Lightning Dharma Form drew the long bow, a huge thunder arrow several tens of feet long formed, the shaft ejecting blinding arcs of electricity as thick as an arm.
Bang!
The gigantic silver thunder arrow shot out, appearing in a flash before the white cloud and shark sea beast.
Within the white cloud, Bai Yuan remained unflustered, his body moved slightly, releasing dazzling golden light around him.
A golden lotus platform, large enough to cover acres, appeared out of thin air, blocking the black dharma manifestation's palms and the silver thunderbolt.
"Boom" "Boom" two earth-shattering explosions ensued, black, gold, and silver lights clashing together, producing a thunderous boom, and the void trembled violently.
The golden lotus platform shook violently, nearly half collapsing, but it blocked both the black dharma manifestation and the silver thunder arrow.
Zhu Yu spat out a blue light, enveloping the shark sea beast and the white cloud carrying the cultivators from Luo Jia Mountain, transforming into a blue shadow that slipped into the passageway of the Emperor Yan's Fire Dragon Formation.
Neither Mao Yi nor Ouyang Qiang could intervene in time from a distance.
"Don't even think about it!" Mao Yi's eyes flared with fury, swiftly making spells with his hands, pointing towards his Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter.
Flame runes on the scepter instantly shattered, and the staff body splintered apart, turning into numerous red lights that merged into the Emperor Yan's Fire Dragon Formation.
Everyone felt the fiery spiritual power around them become violent, and the freshly opened passage abruptly shattered, trapping the people from Luo Jia Mountain and Azure Dragon Pond inside the great array, like flies in amber, unable to move.
Mao Yi showed a pained expression, then his eyes flashed fiercely at the Luo Jia Mountain cultivators and the shark sea beast, just as he was about to take action, an unexpected change occurred.
The already unstable Emperor Yan's Fire Dragon Formation stirred again, with endless flames erupting outwards, descending upon everyone present.
An overbearing forbidden power enveloped everyone, making them all disappear simultaneously, while the flame array outside the tomb healed again, leaving no gaps.
Yuan Ming felt his vision blur, then his gaze was obscured by a powerful white light, unable to see anything.
After an indeterminate period, the blinding white light suddenly vanished, and Yuan Ming's vision returned, though he couldn't help but squint again.
In front of him, rolling heat waves rose, permeated by trails of smoke, mixed with a pungent sulfur smell in the scorching airflow.
Looking into the distance, Yuan Ming scanned his surroundings, surprised to discover all around were slowly flowing crimson molten lava, with floating black rock plates of various shapes and sizes on top, like small boats drifting on a lake.
He stood on a slightly larger black rock plate, its edges submerged in the molten lava, already glowing hot and would soon be reduced to magma.
Yuan Ming stood up, surveying the surroundings for a while, seeing only scenes of molten lava and black smoke obscuring the distance, making nothing clear.
The people who were transported with him were now nowhere in sight.
No signs of life were visible nearby, not even other sounds besides the bubbling of lava and the cracking of burning rock plates.
Yuan Ming leaped onto a larger nearby rock plate, then sat down cross-legged again.
He formed a peculiar dharma seal with his hands, attempting to use a unique circulation method to operate the mana within his body, aiming to break the half-prohibition Mao Yi left inside him.
In this place, he didn't need to worry about Mao Yi discovering the unsealing.

chapters.title: Chapter 811 - 782 Seizing the Staff
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming followed the method he learned from Su Yingxue and quickly unlocked the forbidden seals, restoring all his mana.
He did not get up but instead channeled all his mana, heading straight for the various nodes where his qi-blood flowed.
Soon, with a light breaking sound, a silver needle flew out from Yuan Ming's chest, precisely the Taiyin Silver Needle that had sealed his body cultivation.
Earlier, his mana was sealed and couldn't tackle these silver needles, but now that his mana was restored, unraveling them was much simpler.
Consecutive breaking sounds rang out, and in no time, thirty-two Taiyin Silver Needles were forced out entirely.
He kept the thirty-two silver needles properly, and then summoned the main soul from the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space. With this, all his divine skills were fully restored, and he finally felt a bit settled in his heart.
After finishing all this, Yuan Ming finally unleashed his divine sense to explore his surroundings.
Soon, a peculiar light flashed across his eyes; despite the apparent desert-like magma sea, there were strong spiritual power fluctuations.
After standing up, Yuan Ming glanced at the sky but did not fly rashly. Instead, he slightly invoked his mana and stepped on the rock plate beneath him, sliding swiftly across the magma lake as if skiing.
"Bang bang" collision sounds echoed consecutively.
The rock plate under Yuan Ming's feet was akin to a black cross-sea boat, constantly crashing through blocking rock plates, darting forward.
In no more than a cup of tea's time, Yuan Ming arrived at the front of a significantly larger black rock island, resembling an island in the sea.
The island was no more than a hundred feet high but spanned a hundred miles; it was all charred, barren, without any vegetation.
Yuan Ming hopped onto the black rock island, where the rocks beneath were dense with varying sizes of pores, pitted everywhere without any flat landing spot.
He walked a couple of steps forward, and as he put his foot down, a crisp "crack" sound spread from beneath, and instantly a scorching feeling rose from the sole of his foot.
Yuan Ming quickly moved his foot away to see a black 'rock' beneath him cracking open, revealing a peculiar worm with eight pairs of short legs, its shattered body leaking red magma.
Before he could look closely, he was surprised to find that the black 'rocks' the size of fists at his feet all began moving, extending pairs of short legs from beneath, migrating en masse towards the distance.
Seeing these crab-like small creatures without any aggression, Yuan Ming paid them no mind and walked boldly towards the depths of the black rock island.
Earlier, his divine sense had detected some strong spiritual power fluctuations here.
Visit * (*) for more.
After walking several hundred steps, Yuan Ming bypassed a high protruding rock.
Soon, he spotted not far ahead a group of strange large birds, fully red and resembling red-crowned cranes, pecking at the migrating small creatures on the ground, one after another.
Yuan Ming's gaze swept over these peculiar large birds, but before he could catch one to examine closely, they all took to the sky, flapping their wings as if frightened, and vanished into the black smoke.
At this point, a series of furious beast roars came; seven or eight giant exotic beasts resembling fierce tigers, bodies comprised of magma and rock, were charging toward him from afar.
The strange fire birds were disturbed by these flame beasts, which caused them to leave hastily.
Yuan Ming glanced at these flame beasts, realizing they were the source of the strong spiritual power waves he had detected earlier, and immediately went to confront them head-on.
The leading flame beast was the largest in size and the fastest in speed, the first to pounce before Yuan Ming.
Without the slightest dodge, Yuan Ming threw a punch straight at the flame beast, hitting it right on the forehead.
With a "bang," the explosive sound echoed.
The flame beast's rock body shattered loudly, magma splashed, rocks scattered, and the body disintegrated instantly.
From its shattered body, a red crystal core dropped out, capturing Yuan Ming's attention.
However, he had no time to pick it up as the other flame beasts were already upon him, so he had to deal with these fellows first.
Not long after, the remaining six or seven flame beasts were smashed by Yuan Ming, leaving a ground full of debris and seven or eight varying-sized red crystal cores.
Yuan Ming stepped forward to pick up the largest crystal core, a wave of heat rushed to his palm, seemingly infused with a rather rich fire attribute spiritual power.
He immediately twisted his wrist, storing it in his storage ring.
Afterward, Yuan Ming raised his hand, summoning the remaining crystal cores that soared from the ground towards his hand.
Yet, just as Yuan Ming reached out to grab them, his wrist suddenly trembled, a hint of bewilderment flashed in his eyes.
Soon, he hovered the other crystal cores in mid-air, a flash of light flickered from the storage ring on his fingertip, and a short black stick about the length of a forearm emerged, the Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter resembling a fire burning stick.
At this moment, the top of the black short scepter was swirling with a cluster of red light, after flickering a few times, it was entirely absorbed by the short scepter, disappearing out of sight.
That cluster of red light was none other than the red crystal core Yuan Ming had just stored in the storage bag.
Yuan Ming grasped the Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter with one hand, then summoned a red crystal core.
The moment the two neared, the red crystal core adhered to the black short scepter like a magnet with a "bang," rapidly transforming into a cluster of red light, gradually absorbed by it.
During this process, specks of red light flickered upon the Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter, and after glowing a few times, it disappeared once more.
Yuan Ming held the Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter in his hand, examining it carefully. However, he found no noticeable changes, so he summoned the other crimson crystal cores once more.
Before long, the Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter had absorbed all the crimson crystal cores completely, and the staff finally showed some slight changes as its temperature increased a little.
"It seems as long as it absorbs enough crimson crystal cores, this Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter can reveal its true nature." After a brief contemplation, Yuan Ming decided to kill more Flame Beasts to collect crystal cores.
He carried the Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter and continued to head deeper into the black rock island, slaying each Flame Beast he encountered along the way.
While he was collecting crystal cores, a swirl of green light suddenly swept in from afar, heading in this direction.
A fierce whirlwind was kicked up as the green light vortex descended, revealing a tall, gaunt man dressed in a green Feather Robe. His cheekbones were high and prominent, his cheeks hollow, and he had two black mustaches on his lips, his eyes narrow and expression arrogant.
Once he landed, his cold gaze swept over Yuan Ming, and he asked sharply, "Are you from the Black Evil Sect or the Dongji Palace?"
Yuan Ming assessed the man with a glance, noticing a layer of indistinct green light surrounding him and emitting a rather sharp aura, unmistakably a demon at the Returning to Void Stage.
"Are you a cultivator from Azure Dragon Pond?" Yuan Ming did not answer but questioned in return.
"You have some insight... that thing in your hand, bring it over so I can take a look." The green-robed man's gaze suddenly landed on the Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter in Yuan Ming's hand, and his eyes narrowed abruptly.
"You want to see this? Just a broken Fire Burning Stick, what's so interesting about it?" Yuan Ming raised the Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter in his hand and said, pretending to be puzzled.
"You know, Fellow Daoist, it's just a broken Fire Burning Stick; it wouldn't hurt to let me see it, right?" The Feather Robe man took a few steps closer, showing a smile he deemed benevolent, and said.
"Not impossible." Yuan Ming frowned and pondered.
"Haha, good." The Feather Robe man laughed as he reached forward with one hand to take it.
"Alright, I'll let you take a look." Yuan Ming lifted his hand and tossed it forward, and the Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter drew an arc, falling in that direction.
The Feather Robe man raised an eyebrow, a flash of joy in his eyes, and immediately stepped forward to grab it.
Unexpectedly, the Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter flying in mid-air still had a thin vine tied to its end, which was suddenly yanked back, retracting it.
The Feather Robe man saw he had been tricked and instantly became furious.
Before he could act, however, a sword light suddenly burst forth in front of him, aiming straight for his throat.
The Feather Robe man's pupils contracted immediately, and he waved his hands before him, a green whirlwind swelling up to block the sword light while pushing his body backward.
The sword light shattered the green whirlwind and chased after the Feather Robe man.
Just before it could strike his body, the Feather Robe man's entire form was enveloped in green light and instantly vanished from his spot, allowing the fierce sword light to cut through an empty spot.
Yuan Ming held the Exterminating Immortal Sword, looking up at the sky.
A figure appeared out of thin air there—it was the Feather Robe man.
"You court death." He shrieked sharply, spreading his arms wide, layers of dense green feathers covering them, revealing a half-human, half-demon form.
"He even carries a trace of the Roc Bloodline; no wonder his Wind Control Technique is so skilled." Yuan Ming's gaze slightly tightened, cracking a light smile as he said.
As soon as he finished speaking, the figure in mid-air surged with green light, and his arms swung fiercely downward.
In an instant, a sharp whistling of wind arose, countless razor-sharp Green Light Wind Blades erupted from beneath his wings, forming a wall of green light pressing down towards Yuan Ming.
The sharp whistling in the Void cut through the surrounding space like ghostly screams, projecting a tangled web of Mihuan light and shadow before Yuan Ming's eyes.
His gaze tightened slightly, lifting the longsword in his grip with mana infused into it.
A clear sword hum rang out as the Exterminating Immortal Sword unleashed thousands of sword lights, clashing with the Green Light Wind Blades.
As soon as the two forces collided, the green wind blades shattered instantly, but most of the Exterminating Immortal Sword's light also burst apart; yet, some of the sword light managed to pierce through, penetrating the Feather Robe man's body.
The Feather Robe man was drenched in blood, finally realizing the gap between him and Yuan Ming, causing a wave of fear to rise in his heart.
Ignoring his wounds, he surged with green light all over, flapping his wings intending to use Wind Escape Technique to flee.
Yuan Ming chuckled coldly, naturally unwilling to give him such a chance.
Just as the Feather Robe man was about to fly away, beams of light suddenly appeared behind him in the void, black roots piercing into his many wounds.
The Feather Robe man's entire body stiffened, feeling as if something had rooted within him, followed by a swift drainage of Qi-Blood, sending a shiver through his heart, filled with terror.
At this moment, a figure suddenly flashed before him, a sword light sweeping across his neck.
"Don't kill me, I..."
Before he could finish speaking, his throat was already severed, fresh blood gushing into his mouth, silencing him forever.
A tiny figure of green light emerged suddenly from the top of his skull, attempting to fly away.
A large hand shrouded in black light was already prepared, swooping down from above, easily grasping the green light figure, preventing it from struggling anymore.

chapters.title: Chapter 812 - 783: The Price
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming raised his hand to capture the demon soul of the man in the feather robe, sealed it, and casually put it away.
This fiend was a wind-attribute Great Demon and contained a trace of Roc bloodline in his body. Although not much, it was quite pure. If refined and sealed into the Palm Leaf Fan to become an artifact spirit, it would still be very good.
Then, he glanced at the Green Feathered Demon Bird, its massive demon body now revealed. He quickly stepped forward, swung his long sword, chopped off its two wings, and stored them in his storage ring.
After doing all this, Yuan Ming intended to leave and continue searching for more Flame Beasts.
However, before he could leave, several rays of tunneling light suddenly flew over from a distance, revealing seven or eight figures. Judging by their attire, they were all cultivators of the Azure Dragon Pond of the Demon Clan.
Leading them was a gold-eyed elder with white hair and a beard, dressed in a purple-gold robe, with a burly figure, exuding a strong aura of vitality and pressure.
The ones following him were not weak either—they were all early-stage Returning Void demons.
Among them, there was only one exception, none other than the Silver Dragon Daoist.
The moment he saw Yuan Ming, he was startled, and then his gaze fell on the remains of the Green Feathered Demon Bird, and his expression became even more terrified.
"You, you... you killed Qing Hezi!" the Silver Dragon Daoist pointed at Yuan Ming and shouted loudly.
The others naturally noticed this as well and glared maliciously at Yuan Ming.
The gold-eyed elder with tiger-like eyes narrowed his eyes, pupils slightly shrinking, the killing intent in them almost spilling out.
"Fellow Daoist Long, don't talk nonsense. I just arrived here, and this demon corpse was already lying here. How can you say I killed him?" Yuan Ming sneered and said.
As he spoke, he released his aura, which was as strong as that of the gold-eyed elder, causing everyone present to change their expressions, a hint of wariness flashing in their eyes.
After speaking, he turned to leave.This chapter was made possible by the * community.
The Silver Dragon Daoist, seeing this, was immediately anxious and exclaimed, "Senior Fu Zhen, Fellow Daoist Qing Hezi was definitely killed by him. This fiend has always hated devil cultivators and is notoriously fond of killing them among the Dongji Palace cultivators."
With these words, Yuan Ming's raised foot paused, and he looked at the Silver Dragon Daoist with some surprise.
The latter shrank his neck back, not daring to meet Yuan Ming's eyes, and continued to embellish, "This guy has some grudge against our Azure Dragon Pond for some reason. He once said that if he encountered a cultivator from Azure Dragon Pond, he would kill one if he saw one, kill two if he saw two."
What he said sounded convincing, and even if the others didn't fully believe it, their anger was fueled.
Not to mention, the gold-eyed elder named "Fu Zhen" had already distinctly smelled Qing Hezi's bloody scent from Yuan Ming.
"All at once, slay him," Fu Zhen commanded in a low voice, his voice deep.
The others immediately responded, each retrieving their magic treasure, poised to encircle Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming had no desire to tangle with them and instantly vanished in a flash of electric light.
"Thunder Escape Technique..." one of the devil cultivators exclaimed, and soon his body was also enveloped in electric light, disappearing in a blinding flash.
Seeing this, the others all swiftly employed their escape skills to give chase.
Yuan Ming's figure flickered continuously in the void, deploying escape techniques to flee far away; however, a blinding electric light persistently pursued him from behind, impossible to shake off.
It was obviously a demon with innate Thunder Escape divine ability, their tunneling speeds similar, making it hard for Yuan Ming to shake him off instantly.
As long as that guy continued to tail him, the group of Azure Dragon Pond cultivators would not be thrown off. Yuan Ming didn't know how many more Azure Dragon Pond cultivators were nearby, and prolonging the situation would only become more unfavorable for him.
With that thought, Yuan Ming, initially flying away, suddenly turned sharply and shot towards the glaring electric light.
The latter, engrossed in the chase, didn't expect Yuan Ming to suddenly turn back with such speed.
By the time he realized something was wrong, Yuan Ming was nearly in his face.
The devil cultivator forcibly halted his forward momentum, urging the electric light around him with all his might. His whole body began to glow brightly, transforming into an immense vortex of thunder, attempting to engulf Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming's response was even more direct; he gripped the Exterminating Immortal Sword tightly with both hands, communicated with the Yin Worm Beast Sword Spirit, and unleashed the full power of the sword, driving it straight into the vortex of thunder.
A shadow appeared on the Exterminating Immortal Sword, and the sword light suddenly became immensely solid. The sword pierced through the vortex of thunder, impaling the devil cultivator's chest through and through.
The devil cultivator let out a scream of agony as the electric light around him dispersed immediately, revealing his true form, a Roc bird.
Yuan Ming sneered coldly at him, glimpsed at the remaining devil cultivators rushing furiously from behind, and stirred his long sword. Sword light erupted from the sword, instantly shredding the Roc bird's body to pieces.
"Stop..."
"You're courting death..."
"Wretch..."
Amid the continuous curses from the Azure Dragon Pond devil cultivators, Yuan Ming struck down with a palm, shattering the devil cultivator's Nascent Soul.
"Roar..."
Fu Zhen saw this and immediately let out a thunderous roar.
As his roar echoed, waves of visible shockwaves layered and pressed through the void, crashing towards Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming hurriedly operated the Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill, but couldn't launch an attack in time, so he could only cross his arms to block in front of him.
The violent sound waves hit Yuan Ming, crashing into him.
Yuan Ming grunted, feeling as if he was struck by a massive mountain. An indescribable pain coursed through his arms, and his body uncontrollably flew backward.
At the same time, behind him, a burst of rainbow-colored brilliance flashed by, and suddenly a robust man covered in green scale armor appeared out of thin air in the void, thrusting a massive black spear towards Yuan Ming's back.
It was at this moment that the remaining devil cultivators also rushed up one after another, each employing their tactics, determined to destroy Yuan Ming in one go.
Seeing that it was too late to avoid, just as he was about to collide, a black light suddenly flashed behind Yuan Ming's head, and several soul crows swiftly flew out, crowing in unison in all directions, performing the Crow-calling Soul Skill.
Waves of visible black sound waves surged out like tidal waves in all directions, instantly engulfing all the nearby devil cultivators.
The cultivators of the Azure Dragon Pond had never seen such a divine soul ability before and were caught off guard. Their pupils dilated, and they fell into a brief daze, their movements halting.
Yuan Ming lifted his long sword, with his back just bracing against the spear tip, and turned to slash the opponent's head.
At this moment, an abrupt change occurred.
A huge white light suddenly descended from above, enveloping Yuan Ming.
Before Yuan Ming could react, his vision blurred, and the scenery around him became indistinct. Bewildering sounds echoed in his ears, and he suddenly fell into an illusion.
However, since he was indeed a genuine Spoken Witch, his divine soul was undoubtedly powerful. Although the illusion affected his mind, it couldn't completely take shape and thus couldn't fully confuse his intellect.
Yuan Ming immediately focused his thoughts and communicated with the Undying Tree within him.
In his Dantian, the Undying Tree lit up with a glow, and a stream of black energy rushed into his Sea of Consciousness, enveloping his Nascent Soul.
Yuan Ming's eyes flashed, and the blurred illusion dissipated instantly, regaining his consciousness.
However, at this moment, the effect of the crow-calling was about to fade.
Yuan Ming's gaze focused, and his divine soul power exploded out, uttering a word spell: "Heavy slumber."
The devil cultivators, who were about to regain their consciousness, fell into dizziness under the influence of the word spell, their eyelids heavy, unable to awaken.
"This is the price for not letting me leave."
This time, Yuan Ming hesitated not at all, his figure darted like lightning through the void, his Exterminating Immortal Sword like a death god's scythe. Each flash of its edge claimed the life of a devil cultivator with extreme decisiveness.
In just a few breaths, among the devil cultivators of Azure Dragon Pond, apart from Fu Zhen and the Silver Dragon Taoist who were a bit farther away, everyone's heads had been severed, suspended in midair.
It wasn't that Yuan Ming didn't want to slay them all at once; it was that Fu Zhen unexpectedly awakened first.
After continuously striking with his sword, Yuan Ming's momentum had waned, and without assurance of a kill in one blow, he chose to retreat.
However, after killing these several people, Yuan Ming didn't forget to perform the Great Black Sky God Palm, sealing the space around him and pulverizing the divine souls and Nascent Souls of those few, ensuring no future trouble.
After a brief exchange of a dozen or so breaths, the devil cultivators of Azure Dragon Pond were nearly annihilated. Fu Zhen, too, was scared out of his wits, without a shred of hesitation, and was disinclined to avenge his comrades, turning to flee.
At this point, why would Yuan Ming give him a chance to escape? He tossed the Exterminating Immortal Sword, which transformed into a chilling stream of light, shooting swiftly towards Fu Zhen's back.
Fu Zhen sensed the sound of the sword cutting through the air and the sharp Sword Qi behind him. Knowing he couldn't evade it with his speed, he could only hurriedly turn, clapping his hands in front of him, letting out a roar.
Blood light surged around him as the token in his palm glowed with spirit light, transforming into a blood-red light ball covered in Spiritual Patterns, enveloping him entirely.
The Exterminating Immortal Sword stabbed into the blood-colored light ball, emitting a piercing hum and stirring up waves of blood-red electric light. The sword tip pierced into the blood-colored light ball but failed to penetrate through in one strike.
Upon seeing his protective Dharma treasure, driven by Essence Blood, being pierced through in one blow, Fu Zhen's expression changed drastically.
Yet, before he could take any action, he saw a blood-colored giant elephant charging straight at him, leaving ripples and a horrifying screech in its wake in the void.
Feeling the terrifying aura emanating from the blood-colored giant elephant, Fu Zhen was filled with dread and stopped holding back completely, letting out a long howl and unleashing all his demonic power.
His body began to expand and grow rapidly, transforming into a semi-humanoid form—a giant reaching a height of a hundred feet with a human body and tiger head, donned in blood-red armor, his demonic power becoming incomparably rich and strong as a rock.
However, before he could fully transform, the blood-colored giant elephant had already charged in, its thick elephant leg stomping down.
"Boom..."
Like the sky collapsing and earth crumbling, Fu Zhen's blood armor shattered in response, breaking into countless fragments and exploding outward.
Following that was his disintegrating flesh and blood.
Fu Zhen's seemingly powerful demonic body couldn't withstand even a single strike from Yuan Ming's fully-powered Body of Wanxiang and was smashed to death on the spot.

chapters.title: Chapter 813 - 784: Orthodox Legacy
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming's figure flew out from within the blood-colored giant elephant, raised his hand to grasp at the void, captured Fu Zhen's demon soul and suppressed it, then took out its demon core, storing it in his storage ring.
At this moment, the Silver Dragon Taoist was also fleeing with all his might into the distance. Feeling the situation behind him, he was terrified, his face ashen, silently cursing his misfortune.
He had thought that aligning with the Azure Dragon Pond, having the backing of Azure Dragon Pond cultivators, would make him unstoppable. He was sure he could avenge Yuan Ming's seizure of the island, but he never expected this outcome.
He hadn't escaped far when a flash of thunder passed through the void ahead, and Yuan Ming's figure appeared out of nowhere.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, no, Senior Yuan, Senior Yuan... Please forgive me this time, forgive me this time..." The will of the Silver Dragon Taoist was already shattered, leaving only endless fear and regret.
Faced with his endless pleas, Yuan Ming did not hesitate at all, raising his hand to deliver a Great Black Sky God Palm.
The Silver Dragon Taoist's head exploded in response, his soul thoroughly shattered, both form and spirit extinguished.
The Lava Land returned to tranquility. Yuan Ming exhaled lightly, collected the Silver Dragon Taoist's corpse and storage magic tools, and returned to the black rock island.
He collected all the storage magic tools of the Azure Dragon Pond devil cultivators, briefly examining their contents, and soon smiled with joy, taking out a golden spirit grass that resembled a seedling.
This item emitted a glow of spiritual charm, far surpassing the fourth-level spiritual grass found earlier.
"Tsk tsk, a gold attribute level 5 spiritual grass, this is something you can only hope to encounter by chance," Yuan Ming said joyfully, placing the grass into the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
"With these two kinds of spirit grass, I can refine the antidote for the Purple Fluorescent Poison in three to four days," Hua Zhi said.
Yuan Ming was overjoyed upon hearing this, praising Hua Zhi a few times, and dug out the magic treasures of these devil cultivators, along with several intact demon cores.
He held up a purple demon core to his eyes, seeing purple arcs of electricity flickering on its surface; it was the demon core of the purple-robed man who had relentlessly wielded thunder against him earlier.
Yuan Ming toyed with it for a moment, then threw the demon core into Lei Yu's spiritual beast bag, instructing:
"Lei Yu, this is a fifth rank thunder attribute demon core. Refining it should greatly help you."
"Thank you, master. I will not fail you," Lei Yu said excitedly.
For over a hundred years, Lei Yu had been diligently cultivating on Spiritual Ape Island. With the resources Yuan Ming provided, Lei Yu's strength had reached the Level 4 Upper Stage, but still had some way to go before reaching Level 5.
Now, with this level 5 demon core, the time required for it to break through to Level 5 would greatly reduce.
Yuan Ming nodded, collected all the corpses into the Shura Blood Devouring Map, then turned to look at the sky above a charred low mountain nearby.
"You've been watching for quite a while, how about coming out now?" he said.
That place remained silent, with no response.
Yuan Ming smirked coldly, raised his hand, and slapped into the void.
Suddenly, in mid-air, flashes of five-colored light appeared, and a massive palm imprint formed, shooting towards that direction.
In what seemed like empty space, a dazzling white light suddenly brightened and rapidly expanded, colliding with the gigantic palm imprint.
With a "bang" sound.
The white light and the gigantic palm imprint simultaneously dissipated, turning into scattered light particles.
Immediately after, a graceful figure wrapped in white light appeared, her voice full of resentment, "Oh dear, Fellow Daoist Yuan, we are old friends, yet you're still so merciless."
"It's easy for you to say, that illusion technique of yours just now nearly took my life," Yuan Ming said coldly, his eyes fixed on the opposite person.
The white light around the figure dispersed, revealing the true face — it was Yun Luo Fairy.
Yuan Ming was not surprised by her appearance, but he was shocked by the cultivation aura she exuded, which had reached the Returning Void Peak.
"Please don't mind, Fellow Daoist Yuan. It's because you've always been distant and wouldn't give me a chance to approach, so I had no choice but to take such a measure, hoping to force you into a dangerous situation so I could have a chance to save you heroically," Yun Luo Fairy said with a smile.
"I'm not interested in discussing such boring matters. If Fellow Daoist Yun Luo doesn't intend to make a move, I'm leaving," Yuan Ming naturally did not believe her nonsense, and turned to leave.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, don't rush off," Yun Luo Fairy stepped forward, instantly blocking his way.
"What, Fellow Daoist Yun Luo insists on having a fight before letting go?" Yuan Ming was quite astonished by Yun Luo Fairy's movement technique and stopped to ask.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, please don't be angry. I apologize for earlier incidents. The reason I made a move just now was to test your strength, to decide whether or not to invite you to form an alliance." Yun Luo Fairy sighed and said.
"An alliance?" Yuan Ming's eyes narrowed slightly.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, you also know the value of Emperor Yan's Mausoleum. Since we have already entered the treasure mountain, surely you wouldn't want to leave empty-handed. However, this time many mixed and powerful forces have infiltrated the mausoleum. You and I are alone and weak. If we can join hands, we will undoubtedly be safer and have more strength to contend for the secret treasure within the tomb." Yun Luo Fairy smiled.
"Fellow Daoist Yun Luo, you have quite an appetite, daring to covet Emperor Yan's secret treasure. Who exactly are you?" Yuan Ming scrutinized Yun Luo Fairy and asked.
"Haven't you already known who I am, Fellow Daoist Yuan?" Yun Luo Fairy raised her eyebrows and said with a smile.
"If Fellow Daoist Yun Luo is unwilling to speak the truth, then let's end the chat here. I have other matters to attend to." Yuan Ming withdrew his smile.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, you've attempted to leave several times. Could it be that I've become such an annoyance that you don't even have the patience or time to talk with me?" Yun Luo Fairy's eyes turned red, appearing as if she was about to cry.
Еnjоy thе stоry by rеаding оn М|V|LЕ%МРYR.
"Fellow Daoist Yun Luo, we've known each other for quite some time and have some understanding of each other. There's no need to act like this. In short, my time is limited, and you must be busy too, so speak directly." Yuan Ming remained unmoved.
"Such a rough man, with no sense of pity for a beautiful woman." Yun Luo Fairy, having her intentions exposed, was somewhat furious and embarrassed.
"Fellow Daoist Yun Luo's seduction technique is impressive, but the personality you've always shown is quite different from the pitiful image you just displayed. If you really want to deceive someone, not only should you train your seduction technique diligently, but also put more effort into your acting skills." Yuan Ming said with a half-smile.
"Alright then, since Fellow Daoist Yuan has seen through me, I have nothing to hide. I will tell you everything. The origins I mentioned earlier aren't lies; they just weren't completely disclosed. I was born into the Su Nu Sect, but later drifted to the Dongji Sea. The reason I've lingered here for many years is partly because it's stable and I can cultivate with peace of mind, and partly because it was the last order from my sect to find the whereabouts of Emperor Yan's Mausoleum." Yun Luo Fairy glared at Yuan Ming and said.
"What exactly is in this Emperor Yan's Mausoleum? It already draws the simultaneous contention of the three major forces, Dongji Palace, Luo Jia Mountain, and Azure Dragon Pond, yet your Su Nu Sect, a major sect of the Central Continent, even seeks to covet this place, going as far as stationing people here for decades just to search?" Yuan Ming asked.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, you've investigated me?" Yun Luo Fairy's eyes flickered as she stared at Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming gave a slight ambiguous smile but did not answer that question.
"It seems Fellow Daoist Yuan is not entirely ignorant of the current situation. Given this, I won't beat around the bush. That Emperor Yan was no ordinary figure; he was a descendant of the Pill King Pavilion Sect from the Central Continent. You should have heard of the Pill King Pavilion, right?" Yun Luo Fairy asked.
"I've heard a bit. It used to be a renowned alchemy sect in the Central Continent with a lofty status. Unfortunately, it was later destroyed by a demon cultivator in a calamity." Yuan Ming nodded and said.
Over the years, while cultivating, he had also been actively gathering intelligence on the Central Continent, learning a bit about major events happening there.
In theory, it wasn't easy for him to investigate information about the Central Continent while being in the Dongji Sea, but Xi Ying has been on that side, and over time has sent over much intelligence regarding the Central Continent.
"Indeed, during the demise of the Pill King Pavilion, only one person managed to escape, and that was Emperor Yan. Therefore, the authentic inheritance of the Pill King Pavilion is most likely within this tomb. Whether it's Dongji Palace, Luo Jia Mountain, Azure Dragon Pond, or Black Evil Sect, what they seek is this inheritance." Yun Luo Fairy looked deeply at Yuan Ming several times before continuing.
"The inheritance of Pill King Pavilion is indeed an extremely precious thing!" Yuan Ming said in sudden realization.
"Yes, the value of Pill King Pavilion is immeasurable. As long as Fellow Daoist Yuan is willing to assist, I can share part of the inheritance with you. These things are enough for you to cultivate to the Dharma manifestation Stage. Moreover, as long as you're willing, I can ensure you join the Su Nu Sect as a high-level tributor. You have investigated the Su Nu Sect and must be aware of its profound foundation. With the sect's substantial support, your cultivation path will surely extend faster and further." Yun Luo Fairy said sincerely.
"I don't focus on alchemy practices, so the inheritance of the Pill King Pavilion has little significance for me. As for being a high-level tributor in your sect... while receiving support, I'd probably also have to follow your sect's commands, right? I'm used to freedom and unwilling to be bound by such commitments. I'm afraid I will disappoint Fellow Daoist Yun Luo regarding the alliance." Yuan Ming contemplated for a moment before shaking his head and refusing.
He wasn't raising his value by declining, but was aware of his own limitations. Emperor Yan's Mausoleum is currently too dangerous; making a gain here and then withdrawing safely is enough for him.
Contending for that inheritance would undoubtedly entail risks beyond his capacity to bear, and such risks are not worth taking.
"I've already told you about my origins and the many secrets of Emperor Yan's Mausoleum, only to have you reject me?" Yun Luo Fairy was greatly annoyed by his words.
"Did I say that hearing your secrets means I would agree to the alliance with Fellow Daoist Yun Luo?" Yuan Ming said with a faint smile.
"You..." Yun Luo Fairy was furious.
Yuan Ming looked over with a smile, an innocent expression on his face.
Yun Luo Fairy secretly took a deep breath to suppress her urge to hit him.
Yuan Ming had just single-handedly defeated six or seven demon cultivators from Azure Dragon Pond, showcasing strength that was by no means inferior to hers. Now isolated, she knew that such a helper was invaluable and necessary to draw in.
Thinking this, Yun Luo Fairy showed a smile, and with a flick of her wrist, a delicate White Jade Porcelain Bottle floated in her palm. She then spoke in a soft and coquettish voice:
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, don't be in a hurry to refuse. Take a look at this first."

chapters.title: Chapter 814 - 785 Rolling Fire River
chapters.content:
Yun Luo Fairy spoke, using two slender fingers to gently pinch and pull out the bottle stopper, pouring out seven round elixirs.
Among them, five were yellowish and two were oily black, all exuding a rich fragrance, brimming with spiritual power.
Yuan Ming glanced at them, his brow slightly furrowed, immediately noticing the extraordinary nature of these elixirs.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, these are five Jade Liquid Pills and two Ginseng Origin Pills. The Jade Liquid Pill contains abundant spiritual power and can quickly enhance mana; it is the top-grade elixir for the Returning Void Stage. Five Jade Liquid Pills are enough to elevate Fellow Daoist Yuan's mana to the peak of the Middle-stage Returning Void. Afterwards, just by consuming two Ginseng Origin Pills, given your aptitude, you should successfully break through to the Late Stage of Returning Void. As long as Fellow Daoist Yuan agrees to the alliance, these are all yours." Yun Luo Fairy was very pleased with Yuan Ming's reaction, her words filled with endless temptation.
"Why should I trust you?" Yuan Ming felt somewhat tempted inside, yet remained expressionless on the surface.
"I can first give Fellow Daoist a Jade Liquid Pill to try, and you'll see if what I say is true or false." Yun Luo Fairy said, flicking her fingers lightly, and a yellowish Jade Liquid Pill flew through the air, slowly falling towards Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming hesitated for a moment but reached out to catch it.
After examining it closely and finding no abnormalities, he threw it into his mouth.
The Jade Liquid Pill melted upon entry, truly living up to its name, turning into liquid in Yuan Ming's mouth and sliding down his throat into his abdomen.
Yuan Ming immediately felt a surge of heat rising from his lower abdomen, followed by a burst of overwhelming spiritual power emerging from within, rushing towards his Dantian like a torrential flood.
He hurriedly waved his hand to arrange several arrays around him, quickly focused his divine thought, and rapidly activated "Primordial True Skill", refining the overwhelming spiritual power, and soon brought it under control.
Yun Luo Fairy observed this with a hint of surprise in her eyes, but it soon faded away.
A moment later, Yuan Ming exhaled a long, turbid breath, feeling that the mana within his Dantian was incredibly abundant, and his cultivation had increased significantly.
If there were really five such Jade Liquid Pills, perhaps his mana could indeed become perfect, reaching the peak of Middle-stage Returning Void.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, the common Returning Void cultivators who take the Jade Liquid Pill generally need three days to refine all its spiritual power slowly, with the fastest taking at least six hours, but you used less than the time for one tea session, truly terrifying." Yun Luo Fairy sincerely praised.
Yuan Ming packed away the arrays, smiling silently; being able to absorb the Jade Liquid Pill's power so quickly, "Primordial True Skill" was indeed crucial.
Of course, it also had an indescribable connection to his simultaneous cultivation of soul, magic, and body.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, you must have seen my sincerity as well, so what do you think about our collaboration?" Yun Luo Fairy tried to probe.
"Thank you, Fellow Daoist Yun Luo, for the gift of the medicine." Yuan Ming clasped his hands but never mentioned the alliance.
This time, he wasn't really refusing but was aiming to raise the stakes.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, not hiding anything, the inheritance of the Pill King Pavilion is so important because it must record their precious dan recipes that have been passed down for years. As far as I know, among them is the long-lost recipe for the Dharma Manifestation Pill, which is invaluable to Returning Void." Yun Luo Fairy said confidently, without surprise.Help us continue by reading at the source: *.
"Dharma Manifestation Pill? What kind of elixir is that?" Yuan Ming's heart leaped upon hearing this, his expression also slightly moved.
"Although the Dharma Manifestation Pill is only of the fifth grade in terms of ranking, it is more precious than sixth-grade elixirs. As the name implies, it is a breakthrough elixir that can increase the chance of breaking through to Dharma manifestation Stage by fifty percent." Yun Luo Fairy's words were astonishing.
"It can increase the chance of breaking through to the Dharma manifestation Stage by fifty percent!" Yuan Ming's heart suddenly leaped, unable to conceal his joy.
Breaking into the Dharma manifestation Stage is exceedingly difficult; there are countless Returning Void cultivators in the Dongji Sea, yet only Ouyang Qiang has reached that stage.
Additionally, Yuan Ming's cultivation of "Primordial True Skill" inherently makes breakthroughs arduous, so he had made long-term plans for advancing to the Dharma manifestation Stage, unexpectedly encountering such a tremendous opportunity at Emperor Yan's Tomb.
If he could obtain the Dharma Manifestation Pill, his chances of successfully advancing to the Dharma manifestation Stage would greatly increase.
"Yun Luo Fairy, I can agree to form an alliance with you, but you must first provide me with the remaining Jade Liquid Pills and two pieces of Ginseng Origin Pills as a prepayment of compensation." Yuan Ming weighed the situation for a long time before speaking.
"Whether it is Jade Liquid Pill or Ginseng Origin Pill, they are extremely precious elixirs, and Fellow Daoist asks for them right away?" Yun Luo Fairy smirked slightly.
"I, of course, won't take your elixirs for free, and will offer a return gift." Yuan Ming replied with a smile.
"Oh, what can Fellow Daoist Yuan give me? I'm very much looking forward to it!" Yun Luo Fairy's eyes turned playfully, exuding incomparable allure.
"Fellow Daoist Yun Luo has been affected by Mao Yi's Purple Fluorescent Poison; surely you haven't found an antidote?" Yuan Ming said.
"You have an antidote for Purple Fluorescent Poison?" Yun Luo Fairy's expression changed.
The Purple Fluorescent Poison within her Nascent Soul is a major concern for her; at this moment, she uses a secret technique to suppress the poison, yet it's not secure. If she can detoxify, her subsequent actions no longer need to worry about being controlled by Mao Yi.
"Certainly, but the antidote's refinement is somewhat challenging and will require a few more days." Yuan Ming said.
"Good, it's a deal." Yun Luo Fairy, seeing Yuan Ming's confident expression, cheerfully tossed out the white jade porcelain bottle in her hand.
"Fellow Daoist Yun Luo is straightforward, and I am not a person who bites back. I can agree to the proposal to join forces, but let me state upfront, I can only assist Fellow Daoist Yun Luo in situations where it is within my power. If my life is threatened, I will prioritize my own safety." Yuan Ming took the bottle and said.
"That's the right approach. If you can't protect yourself, you naturally can't help me. However, I have confidence in you," Yun Luo Fairy said softly with a smile when he finally agreed.
"Since everything is settled, let's discuss business. Yun Luo Fairy, you have investigated Emperor Yan's Mausoleum for many years. You must know the situation here in great detail, right?" Yuan Ming asked.
"Of course, the Su Nu Sect also provided me with a lot of information about the Pill King Pavilion. The place we are currently in is very similar to the Fire Refining Secret Realm from the Pill King Pavilion," Yun Luo Fairy said.
"Fire Refining Secret Realm?" Yuan Ming was surprised.
"Yes, the Fire Refining Secret Realm is a trial secret realm constructed by the Pill King Pavilion using Void Crystal Stone, reportedly used for evaluating and testing entry-level disciples," Yun Luo Fairy said.
"Void Crystal Stone..." Yuan Ming's expression changed as he recalled the Void Stone in the Shura Palace.
"Void Crystal Stone is a secret treasure that can open up space, originating outside the starry skies, extremely rare. Even on the Central Continent, only a few major sects have it, used to open various secret realms. Dongji Sea is remote and poor in resources, so you naturally haven't heard of it," Yun Luo Fairy explained.
"I see. It seems that Emperor Yan ran away from the Pill King Pavilion back then and took quite a lot of good things, bringing the entire secret realm over." Yuan Ming looked around.
"I hope as you said, this is indeed the trial secret realm of the Pill King Pavilion from those years, and not built by Emperor Yan himself, otherwise the intel I got from the sect would be wasted." Yun Luo Fairy sighed softly and became increasingly worried.
"No matter that, if this is indeed the Fire Refining Secret Realm, according to the information collected by the Su Nu Sect, what is this place?" Yuan Ming asked.
"From what we've encountered along the way, this seems to be the Flame Zone, where many Flame Beasts reside." Yun Luo Fairy recalled and said.
"Flame Zone, the name is quite fitting." Yuan Ming thought of the flame beasts he had slain earlier and nodded.
"Beyond this Flame Zone, there will be a Rolling Fire River ahead. Once we cross there, we will be able to reach the core of the Fire Refining Secret Realm. If there truly is a legacy of the Pill King Pavilion in Emperor Yan's Mausoleum, it should be there," Yun Luo Fairy continued.
"It seems the Rolling Fire River is the second test area, do you know anything about it?" Yuan Ming asked.
"The Pill King Pavilion is very closed off, rarely inviting outsiders into the sect, and strictly forbids disciples from telling outsiders about the sect's matters. Therefore, we at the Su Nu Sect haven't been able to gather much intel. Regarding the Rolling Fire River, I don't know the specifics, only that passing the test there is incredibly difficult," Yun Luo Fairy shook her head.
"No matter what, let's go over and have a look," Yuan Ming said upon hearing.
After discussing some enemy countermeasures, they set out again.
…
Several days later.
Yuan Ming and Yun Luo traversed many paths, and after slaying numerous Fire Beasts, they finally reached the end of the Flame Zone.
The journey wasn't easy; the deeper they went into the Flame Zone, the stronger the fire beasts they encountered. Even with their strength, they were in danger multiple times.
Fortunately, they were vigilant and skilled, arriving here safely despite the dangers.
They halted their steps, seeing a long, red river flowing nearby, the surface rolling and mighty, with no sight of the other bank.
The river water was crimson and transparent like glass, with clusters of flames burning merrily, densely clustered, resembling scales on a dragon, protecting the river beneath them as its flesh.
Fierce heat waves roiled from the river, the air burned hot without color or form, the surrounding light distorted, giving the fire river a vague feeling.
"There really is a fire river; it seems this is indeed the Fire Refining Secret Realm of the Pill King Pavilion," Yuan Ming said, his pupils reflecting the flickering flames.
Yun Luo Fairy also breathed a sigh of relief.
They each used techniques to protect their bodies and continued onward.
However, before they approached the riverbank, the surrounding heat made them change their expressions slightly, forcing them to stop.
They added several layers of insulation techniques to themselves before moving again, with difficulty reaching the edge of the Rolling Fire River.
With the scorching flames so close, both their faces turned red, and the air they breathed felt like flames ready to ignite their bodies. If not for their high cultivation, they couldn't endure this.
"Just at the river's edge, the temperature is already so terrifying. If we were to enter it, even we might not withstand it. Is the Pill King Pavilion's entry test truly so rigorous?" Yuan Ming asked.
"Impossible. Although the Pill King Pavilion is a major faction on the Central Continent, entry disciples mostly are at the Core Formation Stage or Nascent Soul Stage. It seems this Fire Refining Secret Realm has been altered a lot by Emperor Yan, turning it into a test area for us. In other words, eight out of ten chances, the legacy of the Pill King Pavilion is indeed ahead," Yun Luo Fairy looked across the Rolling Fire River, her eyes filled with excitement.

chapters.title: Chapter 815 - 786: Stone Bridge Test
chapters.content:
"It's reasonable, but how do we cross this Rolling Fire River right now? Fly directly over it?" Yuan Ming nodded, seemingly in agreement, and then asked.
Yun Luo Fairy did not speak; she raised her hand, and dots of fiery red light appeared and gathered in the void, forming a tiny fiery red bird about the size of a palm.
This bird seemed highly adapted to the scorching environment around it, and after chirping happily, it flew towards the Rolling Fire River under Yun Luo Fairy's command.
Unexpectedly, as the fiery bird reached the sky over the Rolling Fire River, the flames on the river surged up in an instant, enclosing the bird as if they were alive. At the same time, Yuan Ming and Yun Luo Fairy saw a white light flash through the sky, followed by a thunderous explosion. The fiery bird was struck by the white light and immediately consumed by the flames, turning entirely to ash.
"This river is really not easy to cross. With such powerful thunder and fire combined, even with our strength, there's likely no turning back." Yuan Ming's expression changed slightly, speaking with a hint of gravity.
The two then began to discuss, coming up with various methods to cross the river, such as taking a heat-resistant boat; or using the Fire Escape technique; or even the Earth Escape from under the Rolling Fire River. In the end, they all failed without exception.
"Since this Rolling Fire River is used for trials, it can't really be a death trap. Perhaps we've overlooked something, and there should be some hint around here." Yun Luo Fairy's gaze swept around.
Just as the two were about to search along the riverbank, Yuan Ming's expression suddenly shifted, and he whispered, "Someone's coming."
Before he finished speaking, there was a whistling sound of tunneling light behind them, and several strong presences swiftly flew over.
Yun Luo Fairy's body shimmered slightly with white light, her aura reduced to the early stage of Returning Void.
The two glanced at each other and acted as if they had arrived here by chance, gazing at the long river in surprise.
The latest chapters are uploaded first on *.
Soon, several beams of tunneling light stopped beside the two. It was Ouyang Qiang and four or five Returning to Void Elders from Dongji Palace, including Huangfu Jue.
Upon seeing Yuan Ming and Yun Luo Fairy, Huangfu Jue's eyes lit up and, after exchanging a few words with Ouyang Qiang, he was the first to approach.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, Fellow Daoist Yun Luo, seeing you both unharmed truly puts my mind at ease," he said with a smile.
"To be on Fellow Daoist Huangfu's mind is truly an honor for me," Yun Luo Fairy also covered her mouth and chuckled softly.
"Ah, all of you were summoned here but got involved because of me, captured by Mao Yi, a matter that's been troubling me greatly. Fortunately, you two are safe and sound," Huangfu Jue said.
"Thank you for your concern, Fellow Daoist Huangfu. Do you know how Fellow Daoist Wu and Fellow Daoist Qin are doing now?" Yuan Ming politely asked, inquiring about the bald elder who helped set up the array and the white-faced scholar.
"The two of them, I haven't seen since. I can only hope they're safe as well." Huangfu Jue shook his head and sighed.
Yuan Ming nodded without further comment.
"There are many dangers within this tomb's secret realm, and multiple forces are involved. You two wandering outside may encounter danger again. Since we've met again, why not join our team from Dongji Palace, so there's mutual support," Huangfu Jue invited.
Yuan Ming did not speak but looked towards Yun Luo Fairy. He had promised to assist her in treasure hunting, so naturally, it was up to her to make decisions.
"We were worried about this; thank you, Fellow Daoist Huangfu, for the invitation." Yun Luo Fairy readily agreed, showing a relieved expression.
Seeing that they agreed, Huangfu Jue was pleased and brought them over to Ouyang Qiang to introduce them to the others from Dongji Palace.
"Two young friends, when did you arrive here? Have you discovered anything?" Ouyang Qiang looked at Yuan Ming and Yun Luo Fairy and asked.
Yuan Ming's heart skipped a beat, feeling as if Ouyang Qiang's gaze could see through his every secret, making him uneasy.
"Reporting to Palace Master Ouyang, we have just arrived not long ago and haven't found anything special..." He steadied his mind and recounted their actions after arriving at the Rolling Fire River, not hiding their attempts to cross it.
After hearing this, Ouyang Qiang looked at the burning Rolling Fire River, contemplating something.
At the same time, two more groups arrived almost simultaneously at the riverbank. It was the Returning Void Cultivators from Luo Jia Mountain and Azure Dragon Pond, each with three or four people.
Seeing the Dongji Palace cultivators gathered, they scattered, not daring to approach.
"Palace Master, with Bai Yuan and Zhu Yu absent, shall we take this chance..." Huangfu Jue's eyes flashed with a trace of killing intent, and he spoke in a low voice.
Ouyang Qiang's gaze lingered on them for a while, seeming tempted.
But before she could act, a grand tunneling light came from the horizon, landing heavily in the gathering place of Azure Dragon Pond's cultivators with a loud "boom".
"Haha, am I late?" Along with the laughter, Zhu Yu stepped out, showing Ouyang Qiang a provocative smile.
"Zhu Yu, weren't your Devil Cultivators from Azure Dragon Pond always respectful of the Abyss? Why are you here to meddle now?" Ouyang Qiang said coldly.
"The emergence of Emperor Yan's Tomb is open to all. If the people of Dongji Palace can come, why can't we? As for the risks, you needn't worry, Palace Master Ouyang." Zhu Yu chuckled indifferently.
Ouyang Qiang's expression grew colder, and just then, Bai Yuan's voice suddenly came from afar.
