"Zhu Yu is right, the Emperor Yan's Mausoleum is not privately yours, Dongji Palace. How can you monopolize it?" As he spoke, Bai Yuan slowly descended from the sky with two people, who were none other than Dian Xiaosan and the golden-haired strong man who practiced the Spiritual Eye Divine Power.
Seeing that Luo Jia Mountain and Azure Dragon Pond seemed to have the intention of joining forces, while Dongji Palace stood alone, Ouyang Qiang could not help but frown slightly.
At this moment, a burst of laughter came from afar.
"Haha, you all arrived so quickly, I turned out to be the slowest one, how shameful, how shameful."
The laughter had not yet ceased when several shadows flickered and appeared. It was Mao Yi and five or six Black Evil Sect cultivators, including the hunchbacked man and the Black Armor man transformed from Long Gui.
Seeing Mao Yi appear, Ouyang Qiang visibly breathed a sigh of relief.
Yuan Ming watched coldly, basically understanding the current situation.
Azure Dragon Pond and Luo Jia Mountain joined forces, Dongji Palace and Black Evil Sect acted together, but the Four Great Forces have been fighting openly and covertly for years, forming many grudges, and the alliance between the two sides is not strong, it could break at any time.
"Palace Master Ouyang, isn't your Dongji Palace always claiming to be orthodox? To think you would ally with Devil Cultivators, I wonder how the major island master families of Dongji Sea would react if they knew?" Zhu Yu said with a smile.
"It's just a joint action due to coincidental exploration of the secret realm, but you Azure Dragon Pond actually put on the same pants as Luo Jia Mountain, truly eye-opening. Every year Luo Jia Mountain captures and trains no less than eight to ten thousand demon beasts from the sea, I wonder how the demon clans across the Dongji Sea will think once your alliance news spreads? Will they continue to submit to the rule of Azure Dragon Pond?" Ouyang Qiang retorted without backing down.
Zhu Yu's face sank, a trace of killing intent flashed in his eyes as he looked at Ouyang Qiang, and the atmosphere became tense.
"Both fellow Daoists, please be patient. The Emperor Yan's Secret Realm has not been thoroughly explored yet, it's really unnecessary for us to start fighting now, how about stepping back?" Bai Yuan coughed and stepped in to mediate.
Ouyang Qiang and Zhu Yu snorted coldly, each averting their gazes, easing the tense atmosphere a little.
"Palace Master Ouyang, was the news of Emperor Yan's Mausoleum leaked by your people?" Mao Yi asked Ouyang Qiang via voice transmission.
His people were all under his control, and he would never let this matter leak.
"Of course not, as soon as I received your message, I immediately detained all those who know the matter. The news definitely didn't spread from Dongji Palace." Ouyang Qiang replied.
"Then it's strange, how did Luo Jia Mountain and Azure Dragon Pond find out..." Mao Yi was puzzled.
Unable to figure it out, he didn't dwell on it, and consulted with Ouyang Qiang on how to cross the river.
Just then, a sudden loud noise interrupted his words.
Everyone turned their heads and saw that on the wide surface of the river, four stone bridges built from crimson bricks were slowly rising from the flames, connecting the two banks of the Rolling Fire River.
Soon afterward, large patches of crimson mist rose from the Rolling Fire River, like a curtain, enveloping the stone bridges.
Everyone was startled, attempting to probe with their Divine Sense, yet as soon as the Divine Sense touched the crimson mist, it was immediately burned by a vision-like fierce fire, which then spread towards their physical bodies and Nascent Souls.
All those who extended their Divine Sense were shocked and hastily cast spells to cut off the Divine Sense, avoiding the illusory fire reaching their physical bodies.
"It seems these stone bridges are the trial here, but what exactly this trial is..." Yuan Ming thought to himself, knowing the origins of the Fire Refining Secret Realm.
Ouyang Qiang and the other four Dharma Phase Cultivators also used their Divine Sense to investigate the stone bridges, suffering a hidden loss, taking the situation more seriously.
"What is going on with these stone bridges? Could they be passages over the Rolling Fire River?" Zhu Yu asked.
"If it were a normal passage, there's no need to make four. From what I see, the land of crimson flames ahead and these stone bridges now seem like some kind of trial." Bai Yuan shook his head.
"A trial? Interesting." Mao Yi smiled and waved his sleeve.
Four streaks of black light shot out from his sleeve, turning into four flying snakes with fleshy wings, flying towards the opposite side on the stone bridges.
Just like the little fiery red bird sent out by Yun Luo Fairy earlier, the four flying snakes were immediately attacked by the ferocious fire from the river and the thunder from the sky as soon as they reached the stone bridges, shattering into pieces instantly.
Mao Yi frowned slightly, shook his sleeve again, releasing four flying snakes to hover in front of him, but did not let them immediately set foot on the bridge, seemingly pondering how to proceed.
"Senior Mao Yi, how about letting these flying snakes walk on the bridge?" Yuan Ming suggested with a slight cough.
Mao Yi glanced at Yuan Ming, pondered for a moment, then raised his hand to control the four flying snakes to land and slither forward on the stone bridge.
Under everyone's watchful eyes, as the crimson mist around the stone bridge slowly swirled, the flames and thunder that had attacked moments before did not appear.

chapters.title: Chapter 816 - 787 Exploration
chapters.content:
"It seems that as long as you step onto the bridge surface, you can avoid the lightning and fire attacks." Zhu Yu's gaze lingered over several flying snakes, nodding slowly after they slithered ashore.
"You've done well. This is the antidote to the Purple Fluorescent Poison, consider it a reward for you." Mao Yi approvingly said to Yuan Ming, tossing over a small white porcelain bottle.
Yuan Ming caught the bottle, smiled, and put it away.
Hua Zhi had already concocted the antidote yesterday, and both he and Yun Luo Fairy's Purple Fluorescent Poison had been resolved long ago, making the item unnecessary.
Mao Yi closed his eyes to control the flying snakes to continue moving forward, soon disappearing into the red mist.
At this moment, his expression changed slightly as he opened his eyes.
"What happened?" Ouyang Qiang asked.
"The connection between the flying snakes and my mind suddenly severed." Mao Yi said in a deep voice.
"Were they killed?"
"I don't know. They might have been killed, or perhaps isolated by some kind of barrier on the bridge." Mao Yi said slowly.
"It seems this Yan Emperor has some tricks." Ouyang Qiang's eyes flickered slightly.
"Before the Yan Emperor disappeared, he was only at the Dharma manifestation stage. Even if he faked his death to escape and hide here, how could he possibly harm all four of us at once?" Zhu Yu said disdainfully.
"Heh, Fellow Daoist Zhu Yu is indeed the leader of Azure Dragon Pond, truly heroic. In this case, please allow Fellow Daoist Zhu Yu to be the first to ascend the bridge while we support you from outside, how about that?" Ouyang Qiang laughed, speaking thus.
"Alright then, I'll leave it to you." Zhu Yu sneered, striding towards the stone bridge.
"Hey, Brother Zhu Yu, why get angry? We always go first in everything, so what are all these subordinates for? In my opinion, it's better for each faction to send a scout to probe the situation first." Bai Yuan hurriedly stopped Zhu Yu, suggesting.
Upon hearing this, all the Returning to Void cultivators present, along with several Level 5 Demon Race members from Azure Dragon Pond, changed their expressions simultaneously.
"That's actually a good idea. Wu Xiang, you try walking the bridge." Zhu Yu pondered for a moment, nodding, before turning to a man dressed in black and directly instructing him.
The man in black trembled, seemingly very reluctant, but ultimately stepped forward silently, not daring to defy Zhu Yu's will.
"Very well, Jiang Huan, you should go." Mao Yi said.
"Yes!" From the Black Evil Sect crowd, a red-haired man's face turned pale, trembling slightly as he stepped out.
Bai Yuan looked at the cultivators from Luo Jia Mountain by his side and finally chose the eldest one, named He Xin.
"Is anyone willing to go?" Ouyang Qiang turned to look at the group from Dongji Palace.
The situation on the stone bridge was unclear, who would be willing to act as a spy?
Including Yuan Ming, several Returning to Void cultivators from Dongji Palace lowered their heads.
"Since no one is willing, let's draw lots." Ouyang Qiang raised his hand, summoning a bamboo tube filled with bamboo sticks.
Ouyang Qiang swiftly inscribed the names of several people from Dongji Palace on the bamboo sticks, injecting a spell into the tube.
The bamboo tube shook violently under everyone's gaze, and after a moment, a bamboo stick fell out, bearing Yuan Ming's name.
"Then it's decided to be you." Ouyang Qiang put away the Magic Treasure, saying lightly.
The crowd, seeing this, collectively sighed in relief.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, be cautious." Huangfu Jue advised.
Yuan Ming didn't speak, but waved to pick up the bamboo stick from the ground, nodded slightly at Huangfu Jue, and walked out of the crowd.
Just then, like worrying for his safety, Yun Luo Fairy suddenly grabbed his hand. Yuan Ming lifted his head, meeting her gaze.
"Be careful." Yun Luo Fairy murmured with her lips, advising.
At the same time, another voice entered Yuan Ming's Sea of Consciousness: "Ouyang Qiang manipulated the result."
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming's face showed no change, he just lightly patted Yun Luo Fairy's hand on his back, then joined the scouts selected by the other three forces.
"This Shared Fate Talisman, you should wear it closely. It is a talisman I specially researched. Two talismans make a pair; they can not only detect the life and death of the wearer but also communicate with them." Bai Yuan said, sweeping his hand, eight yellow talismans flew out instantly, with four falling before Yuan Ming and the other three.
"Fellow Daoist Bai, is this Shared Fate Talisman reliable? There are prohibitions on the stone bridge. Let's not allow the prohibition to block the sensing." Ouyang Qiang asked.
"Rest assured, Fellow Daoist Ouyang, this Shared Fate Talisman is made from spiritual materials with extremely strong sensing abilities. The prohibition cannot block it; at least I've never seen a prohibition that can obstruct the Shared Fate Talisman." Bai Yuan laughed.
Hearing this, Ouyang Qiang and the others felt relieved.
Yuan Ming and the other three took the talismans, wearing them.
An eerie wave emanated from the talismans, merging into their bodies.
The four showed slight surprise on their faces, then silently walked towards the stone bridge, through the red mist curtain enveloping the bridge, completely vanishing from everyone's sight.
Ouyang Qiang and her group immediately directed their gaze towards the Shared Fate Talisman, and at that moment, the talisman representing Wu Xiang suddenly exploded, shattering into fragments that scattered down.
Next was Jiang Huan, whose Shared Fate Talisman first cracked abruptly but quickly mended itself. However, after holding on for a quarter of an hour, it exploded simultaneously with He Xin from Luo Jia Mountain's talisman.
Text- a*[email protected] +e!d$ f$r%om! M|V|$L+EMP&Y.R.
Yuan Ming was the only one left.
The fall of the three Returning Void Cultivators clearly drained the group's confidence. At this moment, they no longer expected any results, and Mao Yi and others even began selecting the next subordinate to scout the path.
However, after thirty minutes passed, Yuan Ming's Shared Fate Talisman still floated mid-air without a single crack.
"Oh, this person does have some skill, what's his name? Why haven't I heard of him before?" Zhu Yu expressed interest and asked casually.
"His name is Yuan Ming, a rare Level 5 Array Master. Who knows what kind of bad judgment you had, Ouyang Qiang, to use such a talent for pathfinding." Mao Yi sneered, looking at Ouyang Qiang with a hint of meaning.
Ouyang Qiang did not reply, instead grabbing the Shared Fate Talisman.
"Yuan Ming, tell me your current situation." She quickly inquired.
As Yuan Ming crossed the fiery curtain and set foot on the stone bridge, he immediately felt hot winds howling towards him, making him feel as if he were inside a Pill Furnace, being burnt and refined like medicinal materials.
Yuan Ming immediately cast spells, summoning two Fire Resistance Magic Treasures and added several layers of Water attribute protective shields around himself, just barely resisting the onslaught of hot wind.
But before he could walk much further, large patches of ghostly blue flames suddenly surged on the bridge surface. Without getting close, Yuan Ming's Divine Soul felt a blend of frost and searing heat.
Yuan Ming was not surprised by this; he knew there was no way the bridge would let him pass smoothly.
The ghostly blue flames in front were definitely some kind of True Fire; without understanding its nature, he couldn't recklessly withstand it.
With a sharp mind, Yuan Ming decisively reached towards his Storage Ring. A flicker of spirit light flashed in his fingers, and Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter appeared instantly, gripped in his palm.
Since no one could spy on the situation on the bridge, he was not worried about exposing the fact that he had Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter.
With a soft "whoosh," Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter transformed into a black shadow, striking the ghostly blue flames, which shattered immediately upon contact.
Not only that, but the next moment, the shattered blue flames seemed to receive an order, all swiftly reversing direction, madly rushing toward Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter, being completely devoured by it.
With its aid, no flame could approach Yuan Ming's body, let alone harm him.
After the ghostly blue flames were devoured, orange-red flames like tiny ants surged again on the stone bridge, seemingly a new True Fire. But before Yuan Ming could examine it closely, a suction force emanated from Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter, actively devouring the newly arisen True Fire.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming nodded secretly.
Earlier, when discovering that Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter could absorb Flame Beast Crystal Cores, he guessed it might be able to directly absorb flames for power. Now, upon trying it, it was indeed so.
Thus, he no longer worried about river flames attacking while crossing the bridge, saving him quite a bit of effort.
At this moment, the Shared Fate Talisman on Yuan Ming suddenly flashed, with Ouyang Qiang's voice coming through: "Yuan Ming, tell me your current situation."
Yuan Ming remained expressionless. Although he was ostensibly part of Dongji Palace, in truth, he was only in name. Ouyang Qiang treated him as a disposable pawn, throwing him on the stone bridge to test the path; he had nothing to say.
However, after this event, his already little goodwill towards Dongji Palace completely vanished.
Yuan Ming ignored Ouyang Qiang and put away the Shared Fate Talisman, continuing forward.
Various True Flames and fierce flames kept attacking, their power growing increasingly intense.
However, with Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter as his protective body, no matter what True Fire attacked, it became completely powerless in the face of this scepter, being entirely devoured.
The red light on Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter grew brighter and brighter, with a "boom" it flared up, exuding a scorching temperature.
"The Flame Yellow Ruyi Scepters in Ouyang Qiang and Mao Yi's hands, though imposing, don't seem to have the effect of devouring flames. Why does mine? Could something have happened when this scepter drifted to Three Immortals Island, causing some mutation?" Yuan Ming murmured to himself as he looked at the short scepter in his hand.
He then shook his head and continued moving forward.
Before he had taken a hundred steps, a sudden crack resounded in the sky.
Yuan Ming had no time to react before a bolt of Thunder struck down at him, the white Lei Guang instantly hitting his body, transforming into countless tiny arcs that penetrated his body through his pores.
Just like that, Yuan Ming felt a pain like a thousand ants gnawing at his heart. The scent of burning flesh emanated from his body, and his smooth skin turned charred and shrunken, like charcoal.
Fortunately, Yuan Ming possessed the Body of Wanxiang, his Qi-Blood abundant. The burnt flesh from the Thunder Fire quickly regenerated, soon restoring to its original state.
However, at this moment, more Thunder strikes came down from the sky, increasing in both number and frequency, further invading Yuan Ming's physical body, drilling into his meridians, significantly slowing his flesh's regenerative speed.
Yuan Ming was startled, realizing he couldn't rely solely on his physical body to resist any longer. He immediately shifted his focus, transforming his body into the form of an Undying Tree.
Subsequently, countless bolts of Thunder struck down, hitting the top of Yuan Ming's Undying Tree form. The Lei Guang transformed into fire, infiltrating the branches but found no meridians or flesh to burn, its power greatly reduced compared to before.
The Undying Tree's abundant life force rapidly healed the injuries caused by the Thunder Fire, far surpassing the self-healing capabilities of Yuan Ming's physical body.
In this way, a delicate balance was achieved: Yuan Ming still had to endure the pain, but his life was no longer in danger.
Yet in the Undying Tree form, he couldn't move, only allowing the Thunder Fire to strike continuously on his branches and canopy.

chapters.title: Chapter 817 - 788: Can Only Take One Item
chapters.content:
Just as Yuan Ming thought he would be trapped on the stone bridge, the number of thunders falling from the sky gradually decreased, eventually disappearing as suddenly as they had appeared.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming immediately transformed his form and quickly ran toward the other end of the stone bridge. But before long, a new round of thunder and fire descended, and Yuan Ming had to transform into the Undying Tree again to withstand it.
After repeating this cycle seven times, Yuan Ming finally saw the end of the stone bridge.
Not daring to delay, he put away the Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter and jumped off the stone bridge before the True Fire could surround him, landing on the riverbank on the other side of the fire river.
With Yuan Ming's departure, the True Fire on the bridge subsided and returned to where it came from, disappearing without a trace in an instant as if it had never appeared.
Yuan Ming breathed a sigh of relief, took out a Healing Pill and consumed it, while channeling the power of the Undying Tree Demon to recover from his internal injuries completely.
Only then did he survey his surroundings again when a gentle voice suddenly rang in his ear.
"You finally came."
Yuan Ming's body shivered as he looked toward the voice.
Not far away stood a graceful figure in an indigo long dress, astonishingly it was Xi Ying.
"Xi Ying? How are you here?" Yuan Ming asked in surprise.
"No time to explain, just listen to me. Ahead is where the Pill King Pavilion Inheritance is located. You must take the inheritance before anyone else, and absolutely not let it fall into the hands of Ouyang Qiang and others, or the consequences will be unimaginable!" Xi Ying quickly stepped forward, grabbed Yuan Ming's hand, and pulled him along.
"Wait, explain first. Weren't you in the Central Continent before? Emperor Yan's Tomb is in the Abyss, how did you get here?" Yuan Ming frowned slightly, seeming to grow roots on his feet, unmoving.
"Sigh, at this point, why are you still fussing over small matters? The Pill King Pavilion is a sect from the Central Continent, naturally leaving many Secret Realms there. I came through a Transmission Array in one of those Secret Realms, and when I found out you were here, I specifically stayed to wait for you!" Xi Ying exclaimed, speaking rapidly.
"That's strange, Yun Luo Fairy clearly told me that the Secret Realms of the Pill King Pavilion left in the Central Continent are all broken, completely inaccessible." Yuan Ming showed a look of doubt.
"That Yun Luo Fairy is only a Returning to Void Cultivator, and she left the Su Nu Sect many years ago, how could she know the intelligence about the Pill King Pavilion?" Xi Ying said with a frown.
"Oh, then I must have remembered wrong." Yuan Ming nodded, seeming to believe Xi Ying, about to follow her.
But in the next moment, he suddenly raised his hand, and the Soul Destroying Sword flashed, slicing Xi Ying into two.
"Yuan Ming, what are you doing!" Xi Ying cried out in pain, her eyes full of disbelief.
"I've not been in contact with Xi Ying for some time, nor have I ever talked to her about Yun Luo Fairy, so how do you know Yun Luo Fairy?" Yuan Ming asked leisurely.
Xi Ying's face immediately turned vicious, trying to speak, but Yuan Ming didn't give "her" the chance, directly decapitating "her" with a single sword stroke.
Xi Ying's body shattered into pieces and disappeared in a plume of black smoke.
Yuan Ming sighed, a white light flashed in his hand, producing a white rune, the All Living Beings Dream Rune, buzzing and vibrating.
Even though he spoke with certainty just now, if it weren't for the All Living Beings Dream Rune sensing the aura of an illusion technique, he might not have made the decision to kill Xi Ying.
The surroundings of Yuan Ming quickly shifted, and he found himself back on the stone bridge, just a step away from the end where the red mist was, with countless True Fire rushing at him from behind, about to swallow him up.
Everything that just happened was nothing but an illusion.
Yuan Ming decisively stepped forward off the stone bridge, passing through the red mist, and onto the land across the fire river.
He steadied himself, glancing around the empty surroundings, unsure if he felt lost or pleased.
At this moment, the Shared Fate Talisman on him suddenly trembled, flying out and hovering before him.
"Yuan Ming, immediately tell me your current situation!"
"What danger is on the bridge?"
"What are you doing? Immediately respond!"
The voice of Ouyang Qiang continuously emanated from the Shared Fate Talisman, obviously laced with anger.
This translation is powered by the readers at *.
Yuan Ming smiled coldly and suddenly raised his hand, crushing the Shared Fate Talisman, then turned to leave without any intention of lingering.
Soon, a three-story tall Redwood Pavilion appeared in Yuan Ming's vision ahead.
As he approached, he discovered a stele standing outside the pavilion, inscribed with — "Trial takers may enter to exchange Fire Beast Crystal Cores for treasures."
Yuan Ming was stunned, Fire Beast Crystal? Could it be referring to the fiery red crystal cores dropped after hunting those Flame Beasts?
He looked down at the Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter in his hand and smiled bitterly.
Along the way, Yuan Ming had fed all the Fire Beast Crystal Cores he had acquired to the Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter. Even when traveling with Yun Luo Fairy, he secretly placed the Crystal Cores he obtained into the Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter, allowing it to devour them.
Now, all the Crystal Cores had gone into the "belly" of the Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter, leaving Yuan Ming with none to use for exchanging for treasures.
Could it be that this journey will be a waste?
Yuan Ming sighed and eventually stepped into the pavilion.
The decorations within the attic were extremely simple, with only a few waist-high redwood tables, and neatly arranged light red candle racks placed against the wall.
Opposite the redwood tables stood a high wall with numerous squares embedded in it, numbering over a hundred.
The surfaces of these squares were shrouded in a thick white curtain of light, appearing indestructible.
Within the squares were all sorts of rare exotic treasures, while outside of the squares was a wooden plaque recording the required number of Fire Beast Crystal Cores, along with an Array Plate used to place the crystals.
Yuan Ming closely observed the treasures within the squares, spotting elixirs, spiritual materials, and various Magic Treasures. Even through the white curtain of light, he could sense the turbulent aura hidden within.
Unfortunately, the number of Fire Beast Crystals required for these treasures was also enormous, and Yuan Ming, with no crystals at hand, could only stare blankly.
As Yuan Ming gazed at the treasures within the squares and then at the Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter he held, he felt a wave of frustration, and promptly put it away, preferring not to see it.
Entering a treasure mountain, how could one leave empty-handed?
He gathered the redwood tables and other items within the attic, took out the Exterminating Immortal Sword, and fiercely slashed at the high wall.
A burst of cyan Sword Qi struck it but vanished in a flash, swallowed by the white curtain of light, having no effect whatsoever.
Yuan Ming displayed an expression of surprise, reaching out to touch the white curtain while sensing it carefully.
"Ah, so that's it, it's this kind of Forbidden…" His face soon brightened with joy.
The white curtain surrounding the squares was a highly sophisticated Space Restriction, making it impossible for any attack or method to reach the squares.
Breaking such a restriction would require an indeterminable amount of time given Yuan Ming's current level in Formation.
However, since the restriction could neither be touched nor broken, Yuan Ming simply decided to bypass it, as he had another method.
Yuan Ming beckoned with one hand, summoning the Sky-reaching Demon Pillar.
Through this object's void-breaking ability, it might be possible to directly retrieve treasures from the squares.
Yet whether there were other restrictions at this place, Yuan Ming was unsure, but he decided to give it a try.
Yuan Ming pondered, his Divine Sense roving through the attic, seeking the most worthwhile target to act upon.
Suddenly, he noticed a yellow Stone Talisman quietly lying within a square at the base of the attic's high wall, its shape almost identical to the Heavenly Escape Stone Talisman held by Wulu.
Yuan Ming had long witnessed the power of the Heavenly Escape Stone Talisman, and even though he advanced to Returning Void, he still couldn't see through Wulu's concealment. This item was so similar to Wulu's Heavenly Escape Stone Talisman, could it be a treasure with a similar effect?
With this thought, Yuan Ming decisively made his choice, quickly approached the square containing the yellow Stone Talisman, and activated the Sky-reaching Demon Pillar to break the white curtain of light before the talisman.
The white curtain of light was exceptionally resilient, and while it couldn't match the space barrier of the Stealing Heaven Tripod, he still spent a quarter of an hour just barely breaking through.
A space crack, as big as an adult's arm, instantly appeared before him; through the gap, he could clearly see the yellow Stone Talisman lying on red cloth, seemingly without any restriction covering it.
Yuan Ming immediately reached through the space crack, grabbing the Stone Talisman in a quick grasp.
"The Sky-reaching Demon Pillar indeed broke through this white curtain of light!" He rejoiced, preparing to break other square restrictions.
But just then, he suddenly sensed a Space Restriction enveloping his body. Before he could react, his vision blurred, and he found himself in a strange place surrounded by red walls.
"Only able to take one treasure… what a pity!" Yuan Ming sighed, wiped his sweat, then looked down to see the Stone Talisman still gripped in his hand, his expression brightened into a smile.
He put away the Sky-reaching Demon Pillar, and using his Divine Sense, probed the surroundings to discover that the surrounding red walls seemed to be made from some unknown material, not only emitting a faint glow but also isolating Divine Sense.
The place he was now in was quite cramped, with walls and ceiling tightly enclosing it, leaving only four deep and narrow paths, leading to unknown destinations.
Yuan Ming's Divine Sense extended along a passage, discovering on the other side were similarly small enclosed spaces.
Within those spaces were more paths leading in all directions, connected to other narrow spaces, appearing to be a labyrinth.
Yuan Ming didn't immediately proceed but raised the Stone Talisman, scrutinized it for a moment, then gestured to begin refining it.
Soon, he understood the Stone Talisman's function.
This talisman was called the Transformation Stone Talisman, possessing no attack or defense Divine Skills; its only ability was transformation, and when activated, it could turn the user into a stone.
"Transformation…" Yuan Ming murmured, activating the Stone Talisman.
A yellow glow flickered across his body, rapidly shrinking him until he transformed into a gray stone the size of a washbasin.
All Yuan Ming's Mana, Soul Power, and Qi Blood Power were sealed. The gray stone emitted no aura; it was a genuine stone.
"A great thing indeed, truly marvelous!" Yuan Ming was not disappointed, but rather delighted.
Compared to the Heavenly Escape Stone Talisman, this talisman was more limited in usage, unable to move after transformation, but its concealment effect was equally good, and it consumed very little, allowing for a prolonged transformation without worrying about becoming visible.
Yuan Ming attempted it a few times, satisfied with the talisman's effect, then stored the Transformation Stone Talisman away, selected a passage, and continued onward.

chapters.title: Chapter 818 - 789: Road Guide
chapters.content:
Beside the Fire River Stone Bridge, the Shared Fate Talisman in Ouyang Qiang's hand suddenly shattered with a "zzz".
"Hmm, could it be that Yuan Ming has fallen?" Huangfu Jue said.
"The way this Shared Fate Talisman shattered is different from the other three, not due to the talisman's host's demise, but another talisman being crushed." Ouyang Qiang examined the talisman in his hand carefully, speaking thoughtfully.
The members of Dongji Palace heard that Yuan Ming destroyed the Shared Fate Talisman, and their faces turned a bit grim.
"What is that Yuan trying to do? He actually dared to destroy the Shared Fate Talisman!" an elder in a gray robe, bearing the Dongji Palace token, said angrily.
Two other elders from Dongji Palace also shouted furiously, calling to kill Yuan Ming.
These two were a tall and a short middle-aged man, both wearing silver masks on their faces, emitting an eerie aura.
"Enough, no more talking." A trace of impatience flashed across Ouyang Qiang's eyes as she waved her hand.
The three elders immediately shut up obediently.
"Mother, why did you previously send Yuan Ming to scout ahead? His skills are exceptional, and as a Level 5 Array Master, he is actually a good talent." Huangfu Jue hesitated slightly and communicated with Ouyang Qiang through voice transmission.
"This person does have some abilities, but he is not loyal to Dongji Palace, and definitely cannot be utilized," Ouyang Qiang replied coldly.
"Why do you say so?" Huangfu Jue showed a surprised expression.
"Before coming here, I sent people to investigate all Island Masters and elders captured by the Black Evil Sect. Yuan Ming and Mao Yi have been acquainted for a long time, and he was just conspiring with Mao Yi, which makes his identity suspicious—it cannot be guaranteed that he is not a spy of the Black Evil Sect. Juer, when you inherit the position of Palace Master of Dongji Palace in the future, remember when employing people: rather use mediocre talents than villains," Ouyang Qiang transmitted calmly.
Huangfu Jue frowned slightly, feeling that Ouyang Qiang's judgment of Yuan Ming as a Black Evil Sect spy was a bit arbitrary, but at this point, he couldn't argue with Ouyang Qiang, and respectfully agreed.
"Yuan Ming, as a subordinate Island Master of Dongji Palace, defied the orders of the Palace Master and according to the palace regulations, is equivalent to treason. Next time you see this person, no need to hold back, kill him directly," Ouyang Qiang ordered indifferently.
"Yes." Upon hearing this, everyone responded in unison.
Yun Luo Fairy also responded, but she was secretly delighted.
Dongji Palace has severed ties with Yuan Ming, so Yuan Ming can only stand on her side in the future.
"Palace Master Ouyang, Vice Palace Master Huangfu, look." Yun Luo Fairy, spinning thoughts in her mind, spoke up to remind them.
The gaze of Huangfu Jue and others followed the direction Yun Luo Fairy pointed towards, and they were immediately both shocked and angry.
The people from the Black Evil Sect, Luo Jia Mountain, and Azure Dragon Pond had all climbed onto the stone bridge that Yuan Ming had passed and rushed to the other side.
"Let's go too." Ouyang Qiang said, leading the crowd to chase after them.
However, the people of Dongji Palace were ultimately one step slower, and when they stepped onto the stone bridge, the teams from the other three factions were already out of sight.
After ascending the bridgehead, Ouyang Qiang pointed at an elder in a gray robe and said, "You excel at the Earth Technique and have a heavy treasure for protection; you take the lead, and we'll support from behind."
"Palace Master, although I excel at Earth Techniques, my body is not agile enough to take on such a task," the gray-robed elder said, his face changing suddenly, his tone bitter.My Vir-t.ual Lib+ra.ry# Empi&r.e@ (*.)
"Enough nonsense; if scouting is successful, there will be rich rewards upon return. If you refuse to go, I'll kill you right here." Ouyang Qiang's face clouded, unwilling to waste words with him.
"Elder Ding Yuan, don't anger the Palace Master; hurry up and go." The tall mask-wearing elder immediately urged.
"Yes! We have your back, so there won't be any problems." The other short mask-wearing elder comforted.
As long as they weren't the ones to lead, they didn't care about the fate of the gray-robed elder.
The gray-robed elder's face was unpleasant, but knowing there was no choice, he steeled himself and walked onto the bridge.
The others followed, maintaining several feet distance.
None dared to walk too fast, quickly advancing twenty to thirty feet.
Before long, the red mist in front suddenly thickened several times, the gray-robed elder's figure vanished, and the others halted, their faces changing.
"Don't stop, keep going!" Ouyang Qiang's brows furrowed slightly, speaking in a low voice.
Only then did the others step forward, entering the dense red mist.
The dense red mist had low visibility, only allowing sight roughly a few feet ahead; the group moved very cautiously, gripping their Magic Treasures, ready to activate them at any moment.
At this moment, a heartrending scream suddenly came from ahead.
Immediately afterward, they saw a figure burning with Flames, frantically rushing towards them.
Standing at the front were those two mask-wearing elders, who didn't hesitate for a moment, raising their hands, and two glowing Magic Treasures were simultaneously launched, hitting the head and chest of the flaming figure.
With muffled bangs, the figure engulfed in flames was knocked down, collapsing in front of them.
"It's Elder Ding Yuan, it's Elder Ding Yuan..." The tall mask-wearing elder recognized him and shouted immediately.
The others hurried forward to check, but the Flames on the figure were extraordinarily strange, still burning, already disfiguring him beyond recognition.
Ouyang Qiang's brow furrowed slightly, as she turned her wrist, a Dark Blue Ice Pearl emerged in the palm of her hand.
The moment the ice pearl appeared, an extreme cold spread out, transforming into a thin layer of frost mist encircling his palm.
Ouyang Qiang held the ice pearl before her, gently blew at the fiery person on the ground.
A "whoosh" sound arose.
A stream of cold surged from the ice pearl, swooping down on Elder Ding Yuan on the ground.
The cold stream swept over his body, quickly extinguishing the burning flames, revealing a twisted, charred corpse.
Ouyang Qiang crouched down, gently touched it, causing the charred corpse to crumble instantly, like a pile of flour, disintegrating into countless soot particles.
Everyone was terrified by this scene, their faces turned pale as they looked at the road ahead.
"How can a treasure location be without danger? Elder Ding Yuan's sacrifice will be remembered by us all. Elder Yun Liu, you lead the way!" Ouyang Qiang's gaze sharpened, speaking coldly.
The tall masked elder's expression changed, retreating repeatedly.
"If you don't go, your fate won't be much better than Elder Ding Yuan's," Ouyang Qiang glanced at him, spoke coldly.
"Palace Master, I'd rather you kill me than die like Elder Ding Yuan, I fear his Divine Soul is burned to ashes, with no chance of reincarnation," the tall masked elder said in a voice full of despair, shaking his head.
"Elder Yun Liu, there's no need to worry. You're skilled in Water attribute Divine Skills. You may borrow this Extreme Cold Ice Soul Pearl to restrain the flames here. Besides you, no one can unleash its full power. As long as you can guide us through this crisis, this Spiritual Treasure will be your reward," Ouyang Qiang relented, handing the blue ice pearl to the tall masked elder, softening her tone a bit.
The tall masked elder hesitated upon hearing this, looked at the Dark Blue Ice Pearl in Ouyang Qiang's hand, hesitated several times before gritting his teeth and nodded in agreement.
It was the best choice he could make.
Taking the Extreme Cold Ice Soul Pearl from Ouyang Qiang's hand, the tall masked elder walked fearfully towards the bridge.
...
Elsewhere, Yuan Ming was still exploring the maze, standing before a Red Stone Wall, waving his hand to carve a mark on it.
With the newly added mark, there were now twenty-eight intersecting and crisscrossing marks on it.
In fact, this was Yuan Ming's twenty-eighth time standing before this stone wall.
Each time he reached this dead end, he would trace his previous path with a mark. After twenty-eight struggles, not once was it exactly the same, yet he always found himself back at this spot.
Yuan Ming initially attempted to use Divine Thought to sense the terrain of the area, only to find that once he entered this red space, his Divine Sense was sealed, unable to be mobilized.
Helpless, he could only rely on memory to walk different paths, attempting to find the correct route.
Unfortunately, after several probes, he always ended up on the same dead-end path.
Thus, he tried to forcefully break through, planning to simply smash down all these Red Stone Walls one by one, but they seemed to be made of an unknown material, incredibly sturdy. His full-powered punch could only dent a shallow pit, and attempting to smash through them would soon exhaust him.
All he could do was continue trying again and again, but the result remained the same, nothing gained.
Yuan Ming stared dejectedly at the route map carved into the wall, trying to find clues to solve the maze.
After watching for a while, Yuan Ming suddenly frowned, thinking he might have been going in the wrong direction.
He stepped forward, placed his palm against the Red Stone Wall, and carefully sensed a faint aura akin to that of a Flame Beast.
Yuan Ming slightly raised an eyebrow, a smile appearing on his face.
He then twisted his wrist, producing the black Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter.
Earlier, Mao Yi mentioned that this Ruyi Scepter is Emperor Yan's Spiritual Treasure and the key to opening Emperor Yan's Mausoleum, so perhaps the clues to this maze space are also within this treasure.
With a sense of anticipation, Yuan Ming grasped the Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter and pressed it against the Red Stone Wall.
The moment the scepter's tip touched the wall, Yuan Ming felt a heat flow from the stick in his hand, pouring into the Red Stone Wall.
A bright yellow light immediately lit up on the wall, moving like a swimming fish along the wall.
"It works!" Yuan Ming's eyes lit up, and he quickly followed.
But as soon as his Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter left the wall, the light faintly disappeared.
Yuan Ming quickly placed the Ruyi Scepter back on the wall, and sure enough, the light reappeared, continuing to move along the wall, swimming forward.
He followed it again, not letting the Ruyi Scepter leave the wall, sliding it along as he moved.
Following that bright line, who knows how long he walked until Yuan Ming finally stopped at another dead-end wall.
The bright yellow light suddenly enlarged, transforming into a rippling arc of light, spreading and flashing across the wall.
Yuan Ming stepped forward, pressing the Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter firmly into the center of the light arc, forcefully pressing down.
A hollow sensation came, Yuan Ming's body tilted forward, rushing into the light arc on the wall, and his figure vanished into it.
The light arc on the stone wall also disappeared, returning to its original appearance.

chapters.title: Chapter 819 - 790: Mummy
chapters.content:
At the same time, at the entrance of the stone bridge Yuan Ming just crossed.
Ouyang Qiang held a palm-sized black Mystic Tower in her hand, surrounded by electrical light, and leaped down from the bridge, landing on the opposite shore.
Behind her, only Huangfu Jue and a woman followed, precisely Yun Luo Fairy.
Her whole body was wrapped with a white silk that emitted a faint glow, covered in scorch marks from fire and lightning strikes, looking extremely disheveled.
Huangfu Jue also appeared quite disheveled, but his condition was much better than Yun Luo Fairy's.
As for the tall and short mask-wearing elders, they were nowhere to be seen.
"Yunluo Island Master, you've hidden your abilities well, to have such means?" Huangfu Jue stared at Yun Luo Fairy, looking somewhat surprised.
"My humble skills are nothing compared to Vice Palace Master Huangfu. If not for the Palace Master's aid during the illusion challenge, I would never have gotten through it," Yun Luo Fairy said breathlessly, her face looking somewhat unpleasant.
Huangfu Jue smiled and did not ask further.
Ouyang Qiang paid no attention to the conversation behind her, standing still by the riverbank, her gaze fixed on the ground in front of her.
The ground was covered with many chaotic footprints, spreading forward, but these footprints appeared rather indistinct.
"Let's go." Ouyang Qiang spoke softly as if to herself and began running along the footprints, not flying through the air.
Yun Luo Fairy and Huangfu Jue hurriedly followed.
The three soon arrived at the Redwood Pavilion.
The groups from Luo Jia Mountain, Azure Dragon Pond, and Black Evil Sect were all there, seemingly just having arrived not long ago.
The three groups had also suffered heavy losses; from Black Evil Sect, only Mao Yi, a hunched-back man, and a black-armored man who was actually a black dragon turtle remained.
Mao Yi looked unharmed, the hunched-back man was charred all over, emitting the scent of burnt flesh, while the black-armored man showed no obvious wounds but appeared slightly fatigued, evidently not faring well either.
From Luo Jia Mountain, three people emerged—Bai Yuan, Dian Xiaosan, and the golden-haired strong man Gao Feng.
Bai Yuan seemed fine, but Dian Xiaosan and Gao Feng were severely injured, sitting on the ground for breathing control.
From Azure Dragon Pond, only two survived, Zhu Yu and a blue-haired, blue-eyed female devil cultivator covered in blue scales.
She was a Level 5 peak devil cultivator, her scales covered in scars from fire and lightning, also healing her wounds with her eyes closed.
The three groups seemed not to have entered the pavilion, each guarding their wounded while wary of each other.
Seeing the three from Dongji Palace approach, Bai Yuan and Zhu Yu glanced over before withdrawing their gazes, ignoring them.
Mao Yi's expression turned somewhat awkward.
The Black Evil Sect had joined forces with Dongji Palace, but when he saw people from Azure Dragon Pond and Luo Jia Mountain boarding the stone bridge, he immediately followed without notifying the people from Dongji Palace, which was rather unscrupulous.
Ouyang Qiang cast a cold glance at Mao Yi, refraining from complaining out loud, but clearly, the cooperation between the parties had come to an end.
Her gaze shifted to the stele next to the pavilion, her eyes brightening slightly.
However, she did not go in immediately, finding an empty spot at a distance from the other three parties, signaling Huangfu Jue and Yun Luo Fairy to heal quickly.
About two hours later, as the blue-haired female devil cultivator from Azure Dragon Pond stood up first, others also stopped their breathing control simultaneously, and everyone rushed into the Redwood Pavilion.
The hunched-back man, however, stood still, frowning slightly.
Enjoy the story by reading on *.
Mao Yi also halted, glanced at the black-armored man who had entered the pavilion, moved his lips in transmission, and asked, "Kuang Lan Demon Son, you..."
"This is Emperor Yan's Mausoleum, don't call me that name!" the hunched-back man suddenly looked over, interrupting Mao Yi.
"My apologies." Mao Yi expressed in transmission, hastily lowering his head.
"The Pill King Pavilion was destroyed by the Holy Sect back then, and we are mortal enemies. Although Emperor Yan has long been dead, he was a peak Dharma manifestation existence in life, and could have left behind methods against demon cultivators. Even in transmission, use my alias from now on," the hunched-back man transmitted.
"Yes, Lord Jiang Liu." Mao Yi responded in transmission.
The hunched-back man shifted his gaze forward.
"Lord Jiang Liu, the Exchange Treasure Pavilion in the Fire Refining Secret Realm is here; Emperor Yan took half of the Pill King Pavilion back then. There may be good things there to add to your holdings, we should hurry in before the good items are taken," Mao Yi glanced inside the pavilion and said.
"No need, the things inside are useless to me. You go ahead; I have more important matters to attend to," the hunched-back man said.
After saying this, not waiting for Mao Yi to agree, he transformed into a streak of silver light and darted forward, disappearing instantly.
Mao Yi opened his mouth, but the hunched-back man had vanished, so he swallowed his words, quickly entering the Redwood Pavilion.
...
On the other side, after Yuan Ming passed through the stone wall, he found an empty space in front of him and landed back on the ground.
He instinctively activated the Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill, mobilizing Qi Blood Power to protect himself. A flash of spirit light appeared above his head, and a yellow mountain peak about a foot high materialized, its surface faintly shimmering with yellow runes. Although small in size, it projected an immovable and unbreakable aura.
Beams of yellow light descended from the yellow mountain peak, enveloping his body.
This item was precisely the Houtu Peak Magic Treasure, completely refined over the past hundred years. Sixteen defensive runes were inscribed inside of it, making it stand unrivaled in defense among his many magic treasures.
After finishing these preparations, Yuan Ming's gaze swept around the surroundings.
He found himself in a well-lit and spacious grand hall.
After waiting for a moment and seeing no danger coming, Yuan Ming finally relaxed a little, his gaze settling on a tall redwood table directly ahead.
On either side of the table, two items were placed.
On the left, there was a somewhat oddly shaped crimson three-legged round cauldron, over a person's height, adorned with openwork patterns and peculiar runes. Around the furnace body were twelve slightly larger openings seemingly inlaid with gems glowing in twelve different colors, making it extremely beautiful and exquisite.
The scorching high temperature emanating from the crimson round cauldron made Yuan Ming feel as if he were standing amidst a volcano, causing needle-like pain throughout his body, with even the Houtu Peak and Blood Gang Shield unable to resist.
Aside from the terrifying heat, an unusual fragrance wafted from within the cauldron, invigorating the spirit of anyone who inhaled it.
"What kind of cauldron is this? It seems to be an alchemy furnace, incredibly fine and much superior to the Sun and Moon Flame Sunrise Furnace!" Yuan Ming couldn't help but exclaim.
His gaze then shifted to the right side of the table, where a half-finger-thick golden book was placed. Its material seemed like silk yet jade, with the cover inscribed with four large ancient seal script characters: "Pill King Secret Manual".
Yuan Ming's pupils slightly contracted, a flash of excitement crossing his eyes.
Indeed, this was the inheritance place of the Pill King Pavilion. Could the Pill King Secret Manual record numerous Dan Recipes collected by the Pill King Pavilion?
Despite his heart racing, Yuan Ming didn't rashly step forward to take the treasures. Instead, his gaze fell behind the table.
Placed there was a Taishi Chair on which sat a withered corpse in a grand manner.
The corpse was emaciated, its eye sockets sunken. Sparse white hair tied into a somewhat comical topknot, dressed in a wide black robe embroidered with golden patterns that appeared intact yet mismatched with the corpse.
Though Yuan Ming sensed no life force from the withered corpse, he faintly perceived a trace of Divine Soul spiritual light, different from a Residual Soul, resembling more of a Divine Thought preserved through secret techniques.
Such preserved Divine Thoughts often represented some form of obsession or last wish from the deceased's lifetime.
The identity of the corpse was not hard to guess, so Yuan Ming was about to step forward when the previously lifeless corpse suddenly moved, an immensely powerful aura manifesting and filling the grand hall instantly.
Yuan Ming was forced back by this forceful aura, retreating more than ten steps before barely steadying himself.
The withered corpse slowly stood up, air currents swirling around it, supporting the fallen black robe embroidered with golden patterns. Two faint spirit lights ignited within its deeply sunk eye sockets, gazing at Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming's body tensed up, and he instinctively clenched his fist.
The withered corpse's gaze quickly shifted, landing on the Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter in Yuan Ming's right hand, raising its hand in a beckoning gesture.
The Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter flew out of Yuan Ming's grip, silently and effortlessly burning through the Houtu Peak protective shield, sailing toward the withered corpse.
Yuan Ming was alarmed, wishing to retrieve his belonging, yet the overwhelming pressure from the corpse made it difficult for him to move, leaving him with no choice but to watch as the scepter fell into the opponent's hands.
"You have returned..." the withered corpse softly caressed the short scepter with its fingers and spoke gently, as if chatting with an old friend.
Red light flickered constantly on the Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter, as if communicating with the withered corpse.
Yuan Ming was bewildered upon witnessing this scene.
Could the Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter contain an Artifact Spirit? Despite having investigated the scepter many times over the years, he had never discovered an Artifact Spirit within.
"Could it be that you are the senior Emperor Yan? It is a privilege to meet you," Yuan Ming couldn't help but speak after waiting a while as the withered corpse continued caressing the Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter.
The others could come at any moment, and he didn't have much time to waste.
"I am indeed Emperor Yan. What is your name?" The withered corpse returned to its senses, glancing at Yuan Ming, and a dignified voice echoed within Yuan Ming's Sea of Consciousness.
As the voice sounded, the oppressive force covering the entire grand hall intensified once more.
"I am Yuan Ming, from Dongji Sea. I greet the senior," Yuan Ming hurriedly operated his Sea of Consciousness Soul Power to resist the pressure, barely maintaining a steady voice.
"Your mana is mediocre, yet your physical body is well-tempered, and your Divine Soul is quite strong. No wonder you can barely withstand half of my pressure. Are you a Soul Cultivator?" Emperor Yan scrutinized Yuan Ming from head to toe, the terrifying aura around him receding like the tide.
"Yes," Yuan Ming breathed a sigh of relief, not hiding the truth.
"A stronger Divine Soul indeed grants some benefits in Alchemy. To which branch of the Pill King Pavilion do you belong as a disciple? What level has your Alchemy Technique reached?" Emperor Yan asked once more.
"I fear I will disappoint you, senior. I am merely a Loose Cultivator from Dongji Sea, not an heir of the Pill King Pavilion. As for Alchemy, I have only dabbled in Alchemy Technique, and am not formally an Alchemist," Yuan Ming hesitated briefly before deciding to reveal the truth.

chapters.title: Chapter 820 - 791: 2 Tests
chapters.content:
"Oh, you're not a disciple of the Pill King Pavilion? Then where did you get this Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter?" the elderly Emperor Yan asked, somewhat surprised.
Yuan Ming hesitated; to explain the origin of this scepter would require him to reveal that he comes from the Abyss.
The Abyss seemed like a very special place, and unless absolutely necessary, he didn't want others to know that he came from there.
"Never mind, if you don't want to say, there's no need to force it. The fact that you've obtained this scepter suggests some affinity with me and the Pill King Pavilion. Even as a Loose Cultivator, you are eligible to inherit the legacy of the Pill King Pavilion. But before that, there's something I need to clarify. You have Demonic Qi inside you, and your physical training shows characteristics of the Demon Clan. What is your relationship with the Three Realms Sect and the Demon World?" the elderly Emperor Yan asked in a deep voice, his tone carrying a hint of murderous intent.
Yuan Ming suddenly felt a chill, as if he had been thrown stark naked into a frosty world, with everything exposed before this cadaver.
His mind raced, and he quickly said, "I have absolutely no connection with the Three Realms Sect or the Demon World. The Demonic Qi inside me is due to an old body refining cultivation technique from the Demon World I once acquired and practiced."
The elderly Emperor Yan said nothing, raising his right hand adorned with a ring inlaid with a white gemstone.
A streak of red light flashed across the white gemstone and quickly vanished.
"It seems you are still somewhat honest, and haven't lied," nodded the elderly Emperor Yan, throwing the Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter back.
Yuan Ming urgently collected the scepter, unable to resist glancing at the gemstone ring. This thing seemed capable of sensing the truth of people's words, clearly a treasure for Soul Cultivators.
"The Demon Cultivators of the Three Realms Sect destroyed my sect and killed my disciples. The Pill King Pavilion and they are sworn enemies, so it's not impossible to learn some methods of the Demon Clan. Only by knowing oneself and one's opponent can victory be achieved!" said the elderly Emperor Yan.
"Yes," Yuan Ming responded.
"We've spoken enough idle words; it's time to get down to business. The Pill King Pavilion's inheritance is here. The first item of inheritance is this Complete Heaven Exquisite Tripod. It contains twelve types of Earth Fire, and in addition to being a top-grade alchemy furnace for refining elixirs, it is also a top-tier Spiritual Treasure. The twelve kinds of Earth Fire contained within it have immense power when wielded. As for the second item of inheritance, it's this Pill King Secret Manual, an Alchemy Treasure Book passed down through the Pill King Pavilion, containing Dan Recipes painstakingly collected by our sect, as well as the elixir refining insights of alchemy masters throughout the ages," the elderly Emperor Yan pointed to the redwood table and said.
Hearing that, Yuan Ming's eyes burned as he looked at the two items on the table, eager to step forward and take them.For character sheets and glossaries, visit *.
A red-gold flame shot out from the Complete Heaven Exquisite Tripod, transforming into a Red Gold Fire Whip. It swept past in front of Yuan Ming, leaving a charred deep mark on the ground.
Yuan Ming was startled, hastily withdrawing his foot, and looked towards the elderly Emperor Yan.
"The Pill King Pavilion bears the responsibility of passing down the Alchemy Dao in the Chuyun Realm, and these two treasures are of inestimable value. Do you think you can just take them so easily?" the elderly Emperor Yan chuckled faintly.
"What do you plan to do, sir?" Yuan Ming asked, bowing his hands in courtesy.
"I observe that although you're not an alchemist, your Divine Soul is exceptionally strong, and your control over Flame Power is quite adept, showing good potential for alchemy. I'll give you a chance. I have here two trials; if you pass one, you can take one treasure, but if you pass both, you can inherit all the Pill King Pavilion's legacy," the elderly Emperor Yan stated.
"Please, sir, set the trials," Yuan Ming suppressed his enthusiasm and said with cupped fists.
"The first trial is your Fire Manipulation Technique. Pass this trial, and you can take the Complete Heaven Exquisite Tripod," the elderly Emperor Yan said.
As soon as his words fell, the Complete Heaven Exquisite Tripod on the table suddenly wobbled and floated into the air.
Before Yuan Ming could prepare, a scarlet light suddenly shone upon the tripod, and a Red Fire Python leaped out, charging straight at Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming immediately felt a scorching wave of fire surging toward him and subconsciously prepared to ward it off with his palm.
But realizing that the test was of his Fire Manipulation Technique, he quickly adjusted, withdrawing his force and transitioning from offense to defense. He activated the Zhu Rong Heart Technique, and a gentle red glow poured from his palm, weaving an expansive net that enveloped the Red Fire Python.
After being wrapped in mana, the Fire Python instantly dispersed with a "poof," turning into a blaze that scattered in all directions.
Yuan Ming focused his gaze and activated the Zhu Rong Heart Technique with all his might to control the dispersing Fire Python.
However, the blaze transformed from the Fire Python contained terrifying Flame Power, and fiercely resisted, like wild beasts charging in all directions.
"Damn it!" Yuan Ming cursed quietly, pushing the Zhu Rong Heart Technique to its limits, barely restraining the scattered flames.
He exhaled a surge of Red Wind, wrapping around the flames, using the wind to guide the fire, causing it to gather once more into a single entity and reform into a Fire Python.
Continuing to operate the Zhu Rong Heart Technique, the Fire Python swiftly became docile, revolving around him ceaselessly under the guidance of the wind and the bonds of mana, as if it was tamed.
Yuan Ming glanced toward the cadaver, as if asking if he had passed the test.
However, apart from the Soul Fire flickering in the sunken eye sockets, the cadaver conveyed no message at all.
At that moment, an orange-red light lit up again on the Complete Heaven Exquisite Tripod hanging in the void, and a Fire Python darted out, charging towards Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming saw this and with one hand guided the Red Fire Python, using the Zhu Rong Heart Technique to guide the orange-red Fire Python once more.
But as that orange-red Fire Python gradually approached, just as it was about to be enveloped by his mana, it suddenly turned and crashed into the Red Fire Python.
With the sound of flames soaring, the orange-red Fire Python burrowed into the body of the Red Fire Python, and their flames fused, quickly becoming one.
Their merged form still appeared fiery red, with no change in shape, but the fine snake scales on their surface began to transform into large patches of fish scales.
In an instant, when covered in fish scales, the flames on its body surged, temperature sharply rising, and the power contained within also doubled.
Yuan Ming's controlling and restricting mana was instantly broken, and the Zhu Rong Heart Technique lost its effect.
The Red Fire Python immediately became uncontrollable, its mouth wide open, lunging to bite Yuan Ming.
Without moving a muscle, Yuan Ming stepped back, suddenly raising his hands, the Zhu Rong Heart Technique's red light doubling in his palms to withstand the Fire Python's impact. After a brief stalemate, he instantly controlled his mana to cover the Fire Python's entire body.
Once his mana wrapped around it, Yuan Ming exhaled the Red Wind, guiding it with the force of the wind.
However, this time it had no effect.
After the two Fire Pythons merged, they unleashed far greater power than before, their flames fiercely surging, directly burning through Yuan Ming's Red Wind and exhaling a scorching Fire Breath towards him.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming was not flustered. He struck out with one palm, dispersing the Fire Breath, then both palms simultaneously reached out, grasping in the void, forming two large red mana-condensed hands that clamped down at both ends of the Fire Python.
He then manipulated his hands to knead and twist, and the two red hands played with the Fire Python, soon subduing it.
But just before Yuan Ming could rejoice, three rays of light suddenly lit up simultaneously on the Complete Heaven Exquisite Tripod, and a Golden Fire Python, a Green Flame Fire Python, and a Bright Blue Fire Python consecutively shot out from the tripod, charging towards Yuan Ming.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming frowned, quickly grasping both hands, twisting the Red Fire Python into a large fireball, intending to subdue and control it before dealing with the newly emerged two Fire Pythons.
Unexpectedly, when the three Fire Pythons flew in mid-air, they approached each other and directly fused into a Golden Fire Flood Dragon with dragon horns, though lacking scales and dragon claws, it already displayed its majesty, emanating an aura more powerful than the Red Fire Python in his hand.
The temperature in the hall rapidly soared due to the presence of these two Fire Pythons, with a suffocating burnt sensation spreading.
Helpless, Yuan Ming's mana surged and boiled, one hand gripping the Red Fire Python tightly, the other reaching out with a claw towards the Golden Fire Flood Dragon.
In the void, a large red hand tightly grasped the body of the Golden Fire Flood Dragon, which struggled fiercely, its flames surged, the intense heat scorching the red hand, with the mana contained within rapidly depleting.
Yuan Ming was secretly shocked. Just three Fire Pythons merging had such power. If all five merged into one, it would become even harder to handle.
If only dispersing these Fire Pythons would suffice, it would be fine, but the test focused on his Fire Control Power. If he simply and brutally annihilated these Fire Pythons, it would likely be deemed a failure.
At that moment, nothing would be gained, it would not be worth it.
Thinking this, he gradually increased the force in his hands, and unleashed his mana without reservation.
The red hand suppressing the Golden Fire Flood Dragon began to enlarge rapidly. Once it enveloped the entire Flood Dragon, it started to forcibly contract, continuously compressing its body, forcing it to curl and shrink.
"You've learned the Zhu Rong Heart Technique of the Zhu Rong Sect? Unfortunately, your skills are lacking, relying only on brute force; Fire Manipulation Technique is nothing noteworthy." Emperor Yan's slightly disappointed voice echoed.
"Senior, haven't I failed yet?" Yuan Ming defiantly responded.
As long as the Fire Python has not gone out of control and he hasn't destroyed it, this test has not yet failed.
"Constantly suppressing will only invite stronger resistance, you won't be able to hold out for long." Emperor Yan shook his head and said.
Just as Yuan Ming was feeling indignant, his eye twitched.
He saw another glow on the Complete Heaven Exquisite Tripod, as a Blue Fire Python and a Purple Flame Fire Python simultaneously shot out, moving incredibly fast, giving Yuan Ming no chance to control them, as they plunged into the body of the Golden Fire Flood Dragon.
The Golden Fire Flood Dragon, upon absorbing these two Fire Pythons, instantly grew four sturdy Flood Dragon claws, its aura soared abruptly, and the flames on its body burned through the large hand formed by Yuan Ming's mana, breaking free.

chapters.title: Chapter 821 - 792: Winning by Cleverness
chapters.content:
The Golden Fire Flood Dragon stood proudly, silently roaring at Yuan Ming, emanating an immense pressure. Just the heat expelled from its nostrils already scorched the air to a boiling point, creating twisted patterns in the air.
Yuan Ming was drenched in sweat, his throat parched, and his eyebrows and hair tips showed slight scorches.
He stared intently at the Golden Fire Flood Dragon, his mind racing.
The power contained within the opponent was too vast; it was impossible to tame it with the Zhu Rong Heart Technique alone. But if he used too strong a method, he feared he might inadvertently extinguish the Fire Python, failing the trial.
Before he could think of an answer, the Golden Fire Flood Dragon had already launched another wave of attack, a golden flame surged forth like a tide, as if to engulf him.
Yuan Ming dodged in a flash, leaping high into the air, performing a sudden twist mid-air, plunging straight towards the Golden Fire Flood Dragon, and raising a fist, he struck down violently.
A large fist shadow, condensed from red light, emerged out of thin air, falling heavily on the back of the Golden Fire Flood Dragon.
Emperor Yan watched this scene, the disappointment in his eyes deepening.
Still this brute force attack, did he misjudge, was this person in front of him just lucky, actually a mere brute?
The flame dragon that had just soared was immediately struck by the red fist shadow, its body bending, plummeting towards the ground.
Yet, at the same time, it erupted with raging flames, golden waves of fire soaring into the sky, sweeping over the red fist shadow, directly reaching Yuan Ming, entwining him.
Yuan Ming quickly retreated, but still a flame crept up, wrapping around his arm, instantly burning through his Magic Robe sleeve, attaching to his skin.
A Protective Spiritual Light had long lit up on his body surface, isolating the golden flame.
But before he could hold on for even a breath, his Protective Spiritual Light was burned through, the exceedingly intense flame scorching his skin, exposing large patches of charred blackness.
A piercing burn pain struck, even Yuan Ming couldn't help but furrow his brow.
Fortunately, his physical body had long reached the Body of Wanxiang, its formidable nature far surpassing ordinary Magic Treasures, so even under such fierce flames, he still kept the fire at bay outside his skin.
Yuan Ming endured the severe pain across his body, shook his single arm, and punched out again, the red fist shadow shattered the golden flame, the residual momentum unabated, hitting the Golden Fire Flood Dragon once more.
This time, the fist shadow hit the midsection of the Fire Flood Dragon, sending it flying.
But at that moment, the Red Fire Python he had been firmly controlling suddenly went out of control, escaping from his palm, and collided with the Golden Fire Flood Dragon.
In the next instant, the two merged, and the Fire Flood Dragon evolved once more, transforming into a Red Gold Fire Dragon, its entire body glowing with golden-red, dazzling Scale Armor, baring fangs and brandishing claws.
The Red Gold Fire Dragon stood proudly, a glint of intelligence suddenly appearing in its eyes, looking down upon Yuan Ming below, a few more hints of contemptuousness in its gaze, extremely majestic and domineering.
Yuan Ming saw this, and his expression also became a few shades more solemn.
The Undying Tree within his Dantian gently swayed, a life aura surged forth, covering his entire body.
The burn on Yuan Ming's arm quickly healed, and in an instant, it was restored.
Subsequently, he charged towards the Red Gold Fire Dragon without any hesitation, activating the Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill, urging the Body of Wanxiang to its limit, a faint red steam began to rise from his entire body, his aura suddenly changing, like a primordial fierce beast.
A huge blood elephant phantom condensed, enveloping his form, crashing towards the Fire Dragon.
The Red Gold Fire Dragon's eyes spewed flames, its body twisting, silently roaring as it charged as well.
The two colossal beasts collided with a formidable roar, the shockwaves blasting out in all directions.
Within the grand hall, runes lit up everywhere, forming a massive Golden Light Formation, not only enveloping the explosive shockwave, but also transforming and absorbing all the fluctuations.
At the collision center, the two giant beasts stalled together, the flames around the Red Gold Fire Dragon poured over the blood-colored giant elephant, enveloping it entirely, the roaring flames constantly corroding and burning.
A pink mist rose from the Blood Elephant's body, its massive form being worn away bit by bit.
At the same time, within the giant elephant, Yuan Ming's hands emitted two streams of red light, transforming into two massive red hands, boldly grasping the dragon head and tail of the Red Gold Fire Dragon.
Streams of red light continued to pour into the Fire Dragon's body, as if it was regarded as a Magic Treasure being refined.
The Red Gold Fire Dragon let out a roar, the red-gold flames on its body surged, swiftly invading along the red giant hands, enveloping Yuan Ming's hands.
The flesh and blood on his hands rapidly melted away, revealing stark white bones.
Yuan Ming's eye twitched, yet he did not retract his hands, operating the Zhu Rong Heart Technique, injecting streams of red light into the Fire Dragon's body.
Simultaneously, the Undying Tree within his body began to release Undying Demon Power, a majestic Power of Life poured in, restoring his vitality, causing his hands to regenerate at a speed visible to the naked eye.
The Red Gold Fire Dragon seemed to be provoked into ferocity, once again surging with red-gold flames, overpowering the healing effects of the Undying Demon Power, burning Yuan Ming's hands once more.
Yet, the Undying Tree Demon Power soon grew stronger again, regenerating Yuan Ming's hands once more.
In this cyclical exchange, time passed, and soon the standoff lasted a full quarter of an hour.
The flames emitted by the Red Gold Fire Dragon grew fewer and fewer, as if controlled by an invisible force, unwilling to be driven by the Red Gold Fire Dragon any longer.
At this moment, the blood-colored giant elephant surrounding Yuan Ming had been worn down to only a thin layer, ready to collapse at any moment.
This content was first released on *.
However, he paid it no mind, his hands moving like wheels as he formed incantations, a red light burst from his brow, shooting out a red light arrow, mixed with threads of soul power, which flashed and then vanished into the Red Gold Fire Dragon's forehead.
The ferocity in the Red Gold Fire Dragon's eyes gradually faded, replaced by a more docile expression.
"So that's it, that's how it works. I didn't expect this kid to have already reached the Word Witch Realm in soul cultivation. Not sufficient with fire control, he used the Word Witch's divine soul control technique, injecting soul power throughout the Red Gold Fire Dragon's body, gradually taking control of the dragon's surrounding flames, and finally, the entire dragon! Though he took a clever approach, it's both courageous and wise." The nearby Emperor Yan nodded slightly, a dry smile finally appearing on his lips.
Achieving this degree means the test of fire control has been passed.
Yet just after a slight contemplation, Emperor Yan formed another incantation with his fingers.
The massive body of the Red Gold Fire Dragon shrank bit by bit, flying back into the Complete Heaven Exquisite Tripod.
Yuan Ming secretly breathed a sigh of relief in his heart, the firepower contained within the Red Gold Fire Dragon was too formidable, and his soul power was nearly exhausted, continuing would not bode well.
Moreover, if it weren't for the constant supply of life force from the Undying Tree and the support of the Wanxiang Body, he wouldn't have won this prolonged battle.
However, at this moment, another unexpected change occurred.
The previously silent Complete Heaven Exquisite Tripod suddenly shone with two lights, one black and one white. Two Fire Pythons unexpectedly sprang out from the body of the tripod, swimming in the void and rushing towards them.
Yuan Ming's eyelid twitched, wanting to stop them but it was too late. He watched as they charged into the Red Gold Fire Dragon and merged with it.
The form of the Red Gold Fire Dragon didn't change much, remaining the same as before, but its eyes suddenly sparkled with spirit light, directly expelling all the soul power Yuan Ming had injected into the dragon's body.
"Continue? My displayed level of fire control should be sufficient!" Yuan Ming looked at Emperor Yan.
The latter glanced back, smiling.
"This old fox..." Yuan Ming cursed inwardly, ignoring Emperor Yan and turned to the Red Gold Fire Dragon.
In the spirit light gathered by the Fire Dragon, a pair of black-and-white distinct eyes, as if living, appeared.
With just one glance, Yuan Ming felt a strange thought: this Fire Dragon had come to life!
Those eyes endowed not just spirit but also what seemed like life to the Red Gold Fire Dragon, giving it a monumental transformation.
In the next moment, the Red Gold Fire Dragon suddenly opened its bloody maw, spewing out a fiery breath, the scorching heat waves surged as if boiling, instantly engulfing Yuan Ming.
In an instant, the already exhausted blood-colored giant elephant dissolved away in the scorching waves.
Hidden beneath, Yuan Ming couldn't evade; his skin turned blood-red, as if corroded, becoming extremely brutal.
With a sudden shock in his heart, Yuan Ming hastily activated the Undying Tree Demon Power to recover while retreating backward.
Unexpectedly, before he could retreat far, the Fire Dragon's tail had already coiled around behind him, blocking his escape, and the raised scales slapped Yuan Ming's back like scraping knives, tearing a piece of flesh to expose his protruding spine.
His body uncontrollably lurched forward, crashing headlong into the biting maw of the Fire Dragon.
Yuan Ming, caught off guard, could only plant his feet against the Fire Dragon's lower jaw, raising his hands to hold up the descending gigantic fangs, clutched within its mouth.
A formidable force pressed from above and below, barely inferior to him.
Yuan Ming exerted his physical strength to the extreme, managing to sustain it with great difficulty.
At this moment, he saw the Fire Dragon's throat gathering a mass of red dragon's breath, on the verge of erupting.
Knowing he could no longer hold any illusions, even if the test were to fail, he decided to give his all, to destroy the Fire Dragon, otherwise, this next strike would leave him gravely injured, if not dead.
However, just at the moment he was about to deploy various Spiritual Treasures, the black-and-white eyes of the Fire Dragon flashed in his mind, causing him to pause, halting the summoning of Magic Treasures.
Twelve Soul Crows shot from his brow, appearing above the Red Gold Fire Dragon's head, instantly forming a Crow Formation.
All the Soul Crows opened their mouths and emitted a Crow's Call Wave, forming a massive tide of black sound.
The surging sound waves crashed downward, causing a tremor through the Red Gold Fire Dragon's eyes and its massive body suddenly stiffened. The gathering dragon's breath in its throat seemed to jam halfway, halting its momentum.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming rejoiced, and as he slipped from the Red Gold Fire Dragon's mouth, he once again commanded the Soul Crows to emit a crow's cry to deter the Red Gold Fire Dragon.
Just as expected, with its new black-and-white eyes, the Red Gold Fire Dragon had indeed developed its own divine soul, rendering divine soul attacks effective.

chapters.title: Chapter 822 - 793 Heavenly Fire
chapters.content:
After Yuan Ming extricated himself, without the slightest hesitation, he raised his hand and waved. Half of the soul crows swooped down, launching a soul collision against the Crimson Fire Dragon.
The first black crow charged at the Crimson Fire Dragon, taking advantage of its stunned state by the crow cry, it collided head-on into its brow and with a "poof," it penetrated inside.
The Crimson Fire Dragon's body shuddered violently, as if it were desperately struggling to resist, but Yuan Ming, of course, would not give it the chance. The two subsequent soul crows dashed into the dragon's head with lightning speed, followed closely by three more...
After a total of six impacts, the Crimson Fire Dragon's eyes turned completely chaotic, devoid of the previous liveliness.
While performing the soul collision, Yuan Ming also took the opportunity to inject part of the soul crow's soul power into the Crimson Fire Dragon, causing the flames within it to once again spiral out of control, binding its body and restricting its movements.
Yuan Ming seized the opportunity immediately, fully activating the Zhu Rong Heart Technique. Two thick red lights injected into the Fire Dragon, refining the Crimson Fire Dragon once more.
Although heavily damaged by the soul collision, the Crimson Fire Dragon hadn't completely lost its resisting power. Its body, and dragon claws instinctively struggled to resist, yet Yuan Ming had already gained the upper hand, giving it no chance to catch its breath.
After about a quarter of an hour, the Crimson Fire Dragon was once again subdued, its flames retracted, and it lay prostrate before Yuan Ming, offering no sign of resistance.
Yet, Yuan Ming still did not dare to relax, his gaze fixated tightly on the Complete Heaven Exquisite Tripod, fearing that more Fire Pythons might fly out from it.
Fortunately, the Complete Heaven Exquisite Tripod showed no reaction. However, the Crimson Fire Dragon on the ground seemed to have exhausted too much strength, transforming into nine multi-colored Fire Pythons, which flew back.
As the Fire Pythons entered the Complete Heaven Exquisite Tripod, its body continuously emitted light, returning to normal after a moment.
"Senior, does this mean I've passed the test?" Yuan Ming looked towards Emperor Yan and asked.
Emperor Yan also assessed him, nodding slightly: "Although you relied on trickery, being able to subdue the Nine Fire True Dragon barely passes the test. The Complete Heaven Exquisite Tripod is yours."
With that, Emperor Yan waved his hand, and the three-legged round tripod on the table immediately spun and flew straight towards Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming was overjoyed but didn't dare let the Complete Heaven Exquisite Tripod get too close to his body, hurriedly emitting two streams of mana to catch it.
A tremendously heavy force came over him, as the Complete Heaven Exquisite Tripod, barely the height of a person, was surprisingly heavy, as if he were holding up a mountain. He quickly pushed his mana to the extreme, preventing the tripod from falling to the ground.
