"The Complete Heaven Exquisite Tripod was crafted by the Pill King Pavilion over several generations, using Supreme Yang Fire Jade, Five-Colored Stone, and Earth Core Mysterious Copper, other top-notch spiritual materials. Especially its body was made with Earth Core Mysterious Copper, naturally weighting as much as a mountain and exceptionally sturdy, or it could not bear the twelve kinds of Earth Fire," Emperor Yan explained slowly.
Yuan Ming had seen records of Earth Core Mysterious Copper in the classics, stating it was produced deep within subterranean lava, refined from Fire Copper Essence, extremely heavy in texture but also the most resistant to fierce fire roasting.
The Earth Core Mysterious Copper occasionally found is ground into copper powder, applied inside or outside Alchemy Furnaces or Artifact Refining Furnaces, significantly enhancing the furnace's heat resistance. Surprisingly, the entire body of the Complete Heaven Exquisite Tripod was made from this material.
As for Supreme Yang Fire Jade and Five-Colored Stone, though he had never heard of them, he imagined they must be extremely precious spiritual materials as well.
Yuan Ming's gaze towards the Complete Heaven Exquisite Tripod grew even more fervent. While he previously valued the twelve kinds of Earth Fires within, he hadn't anticipated the furnace body would be so extraordinary as well.
"Senior just mentioned this furnace contains twelve kinds of Earth Fire? Shouldn't it be True Fire?" He suddenly thought of a question.This part of the collection on *.
"What is meant by Earth Fire is not subterranean flames, but a level of True Fire. In the Cultivation World, True Fire is divided into Heaven, Earth, and Human levels. Ordinary True Fire is of the Human-level, though precious, they're also abundant. Earth Fire is much rarer and more powerful than Human Fire. The twelve kinds of Earth Fire within the Complete Heaven Exquisite Tripod are top-tier Earth Fires. Our Pill King Pavilion established its illustrious reputation in the Central Continent largely due to these twelve kinds of Earth Fire. You must learn to use them wisely in the future," Emperor Yan elaborated.
Yuan Ming listened intently and hurriedly agreed.
According to Emperor Yan, Yan Sijing's apricot wood green fire and ice core yin fire should be Human Fire, whereas the Pure Yang Flame's power far surpasses the apricot wood green fire and ice core yin fire, so it should belong to Earth Fire.
"And what about Heavenly Fire?" Yuan Ming inquired curiously.
"Heavenly Fire is even rarer, with only nine kinds of True Fire earning the title of Heavenly Fire throughout history. Each Heavenly Fire possesses incredible Divine Skills, with value beyond measure. Our Pill King Pavilion has been searching for Heavenly Fire across multiple generations, alas to no avail. If we had even one Heavenly Fire, our sect would not have fallen to the Three Realms Sect," Emperor Yan's tone was filled with regret.
"Heavenly Fire is so precious!" Yuan Ming was greatly shocked.
He immediately remembered something, his pupils contracting suddenly.
The Bright Soul Fire within the Stealing Heaven Tripod, which Xia Jie once referred to as Bright Soul Heavenly Fire, could it be that the Bright Soul Fire is indeed a kind of Heavenly Fire?
"Senior Yan Emperor, what are the names of the nine Heavenly Fires?" Yuan Ming pretended to ask out of curiosity.
"The nine Heavenly Fires are extremely mysterious and little-known, even in ancient texts they are scarcely recorded. In my days, my status in the Pill King Pavilion wasn't very high, so I only know four: the Great Sun Glaze Flame, the Red Lotus Netherworld Fire, the Purple Heart Fire, and the Bright Soul Heavenly Fire," Emperor Yan detailed without reservation.
Yuan Ming maintained a calm expression, but his heart skipped a beat. The Bright Soul Fire was indeed one of the nine Heavenly Fires!
Nevertheless, considering the incredible magical powers of the Stealing Heaven Tripod, it doesn't seem surprising for it to possess a Heavenly Fire.
"Thank you, senior Yan Emperor, for informing me. I will make good use of this Complete Heaven Exquisite Tripod... Huh, there seems to be something inside the tripod?" Yuan Ming was about to put away the tripod when he suddenly let out a small exclamation.
Earlier, he had smelled a strange fragrance emanating from the tripod, thinking it was the natural scent it acquired after years of alchemy. Now that he had the tripod in his hands, he discovered a white light cluster floating inside, which was surprisingly an elixir the size of a dragon's eye.
"This is an Ancient Spirit Pill, the Three Flowers and Five Qi Pill, not yet completed. It needs to utilize the intense environment inside the Complete Heaven Exquisite Tripod to be preserved. Earlier, if you couldn't tame the Fire Dragon formed by nine kinds of Earth Fires, I would have taken out this elixir to store it elsewhere. But now, it seems you are useful enough to protect this Three Flowers and Five Qi Pill." The Yan Emperor continued.
"Since even the seniors of the Pill King Pavilion couldn't refine this Three Flowers and Five Qi Pill, I'm afraid I too cannot complete it. I wonder how I should handle this?" Yuan Ming was slightly taken aback before he asked.
No wonder the fire control test was so difficult earlier; it turns out the Yan Emperor had this intention.
"It's not that our pavilion cannot complete the Three Flowers and Five Qi Pill, but rather that there isn't enough time. If you have the opportunity to visit the Central Continent in the future, you can go to a place called Flame Mountain and seek out a Daoist Huo Yi there. He will help you complete the refining of this elixir, which will be a great opportunity for you." The Yan Emperor spoke.
"Flame Mountain, Daoist Huo Yi... I will remember that." Yuan Ming committed this to memory and was about to ask about the effects and grade of the Three Flowers and Five Qi Pill.
"Alright, enough has been said. Next is the second challenge, which will test your alchemy talent." The Yan Emperor spoke again.
"Senior Yan Emperor, I've already said that I'm not an alchemist, this challenge might be too difficult to pass." Yuan Ming quickly put away the Complete Heaven Exquisite Tripod and spoke frankly.
"I know, which is why I'm testing your alchemy talent, not your alchemy skills." The Yan Emperor snorted as he spoke.
"I see, then please proceed, senior." Yuan Ming scratched his head and said.
"What is alchemy?" The Yan Emperor asked.
"Alchemy is divided into external and internal elixirs. External elixirs refer to all plant, mineral, and stone substances refined into pills, aiding cultivation; Internal elixirs mean using the body as a furnace tripod, internally refining spirit into a pill bound by essence, Qi, and spirit." Yuan Ming racked his brains for his knowledge of elixirs, thought for a moment, and then replied.
"The inner elixir is also called the Golden Core. When it breaks during the Nascent Soul Stage, can there still be an inner elixir to refine?" The Yan Emperor continued to ask.
"Of course not." Yuan Ming shook his head and said.
"Essence, Qi, and spirit form the Golden Core, which transforms into a Nascent Soul. Isn't the Nascent Soul also consolidated by essence, Qi, and spirit?" The Yan Emperor asked.
Yuan Ming stiffened upon hearing this and hesitantly said, "Yes."
"If that's true, then can there still be an inner elixir to refine?" The Yan Emperor continued.
"Yes." Yuan Ming nodded.
"What is refined?" The Yan Emperor pursued the question.
"The Nascent Soul... No, it's essence, Qi, and spirit." Yuan Ming instinctively responded and then had a sudden realization and corrected himself.
"Is there a connection between external and internal elixirs?" The Yan Emperor asked again.
"Naturally, internal elixir cultivation requires the assistance of external elixirs. The essence of plant, mineral, and stone from the external aids in invigorating the inner elixir." Yuan Ming said.
This was recorded in the alchemy classics he had perused in the past.
However, Yuan Ming's understanding of alchemy was not profound, so being able to answer even this much was already quite commendable.
"Hmph, is that all?" The Yan Emperor snorted coldly and asked.
"Forgive my ignorance." Yuan Ming pondered for a moment, unable to come up with a better insight, and showed a remorseful expression.
"The inner elixir possesses Pill Fire, which is crucial for alchemy practitioners, incomparable to various earth fires outside. The achievement level of an alchemy dao practitioner is largely related to the quality of his Pill Fire..." The Yan Emperor seemed to teach Yuan Ming, detailing aspects of the alchemy dao that he had not known before.
Afterward, the Yan Emperor posed various questions regarding alchemy, many of which Yuan Ming had never heard of, leaving him rather embarrassed.
However, through this exchange, he gained quite a lot.
The knowledge about the alchemy dao, even though he did not understand it, was silently kept in mind, intending to organize it later, thereby helping to preserve a piece of the Pill King Pavilion's inheritance.
He believed that the Yan Emperor had this intention, which was why he spoke to him so extensively.
"Senior, how did I perform in this challenge?" Yuan Ming glanced anxiously at the Pill King Secret Manual on the table, feeling deeply uneasy.

chapters.title: Chapter 823 - 794: Different Agendas
chapters.content:
"Although you have a thirst for learning, your comprehension of alchemy is average and your thoughts are scattered. The 'Pill King Secret Manual' in your hands would only gather dust. Leave now." The elderly Emperor Yan shook his head and slowly raised one hand.
"Senior, I can..." Yuan Ming was in a state of panic, just about to say something more, when his vision suddenly blurred.
In the next moment, his figure had already appeared outside the vermillion hall.
The whole process seemed like instantaneous movement; he wasn't even sure how he had left the hall.
Yuan Ming gazed at the interior of the hall, feeling a sense of deep unwillingness.
He knew that his talent in alchemy was ordinary, but with the Stealing Heaven Tripod, he believed that as long as he was willing to study and practice, he would be no less than any alchemy grandmaster of his time.
He wanted to tell that elderly Emperor Yan that entrusting the Pill King Secret Manual to him would not be a waste.
With this thought, Yuan Ming stepped forward, intending to try and enter the hall again.
However, at that moment, it seemed as if the hall was shrouded in an invisible barrier, blocking his way.
Just as Yuan Ming was about to try using a spell or brute force to break the barrier, his divine sense suddenly detected several auras approaching.
"These guys have come really fast!" Yuan Ming's expression changed slightly. After quickly turning his mind, he immediately gave up trying to break the restriction and moved to an open space beside the hall.
He took out the Transformation Stone Talisman, held it in his palm, and activated it. His body emitted a faint yellow light and soon transformed into a five-foot-tall stone, standing quietly to the side.
Just as Yuan Ming concealed himself, two streaks of spirit light came together from the distance. As the light scattered, it was Mao Yi and the Black-armored Man, who had transformed from a black dragon turtle, arriving first at this place.
"Good! Looks like we are the first to arrive; the Pill King Pavilion Inheritance really is destined for me." Mao Yi glanced around, laughed heartily, and then instructed the Black-armored Man to guard the entrance while he impatiently rushed into the hall.
However, when he saw only a thick book left on the altar inside the hall, he was momentarily stunned.
"Who are you?" On the Taishi Chair, the corpse of the elderly Emperor Yan stood up again.
"Emperor Yan!" Mao Yi seemed to recognize the elderly Emperor Yan and was taken aback.
But he quickly realized the person before him was a corpse and regained his composure.
"Black Evil Sect, Mao Yi, where is the Complete Heaven Exquisite Tripod?" Mao Yi answered and then rudely asked.
"It has already been taken." The elderly Emperor Yan replied calmly without any anger.
"Taken! Who did it? Was it that Yuan kid?" Mao Yi was stunned, recalling Yuan Ming's figure, and asked in a deep voice.Brought to you by *.
"...Would you like to undergo the second test to inherit the 'Pill King Secret Manual'?" The elderly Emperor Yan did not answer, instead, he asked in return.
Mao Yi ignored the elderly Emperor Yan and unleashed a powerful divine sense, searching inside and outside the hall, as well as a large maze area.
Outside the hall, Yuan Ming's heart was also in his throat.
Although the Transformation Stone Talisman was powerful, he wasn't sure if it could deceive the divine sense of a Dharma Phase Cultivator.
Fortunately, the Transformation Stone Talisman did not disappoint him. Mao Yi's divine sense swept over the stone he had transformed into without noticing anything unusual, and soon moved away.
"Escaped? Impossible, that kid's tunneling speed isn't that fast. Could it be...he was transported out after passing the test?" Mao Yi got nothing and murmured with a frown, suddenly asking the elderly Emperor Yan again.
"Would you like to undergo the second test to inherit the 'Pill King Secret Manual'?" The elderly Emperor Yan asked again without any expression.
Mao Yi was displeased but had no way to vent his frustration on a corpse, so he silently swallowed this discontent, nodded slowly, and agreed to participate in the test.
Following that, he experienced the alchemy test exactly like Yuan Ming did.
The elderly Emperor Yan did not increase the difficulty because of Mao Yi's higher cultivation, but even so, Mao Yi's performance was no better than Yuan Ming's, and he soon failed, similarly being transported out of the hall.
"Shall I give it a try?" The Black-armored Man asked proactively after following him out.
"No need. The elderly Emperor Yan's standards are too high. Unless you are a genuine alchemy master, you have no chance of passing the test." Mao Yi's face darkened.
"What about seizing it by force?" The Black-armored Man asked through voice transmission.
"Impossible! Although the elderly Emperor Yan is merely a corpse, the restrictions placed here are formidable, likely a sixth-level array, not to be underestimated." A trace of temptation flashed across Mao Yi's face, but he quickly dismissed it.
"Then..." The Black-armored Man pondered deeply.
Mao Yi quickly surveyed the surroundings while contemplating.
Jiang Liu had also arrived earlier, given his abilities, he should have been here already. Perhaps Jiang Liu has a way to acquire the Pill King Secret Manual.
At that moment, Mao Yi's expression suddenly changed, and he quickly turned his head to look to the side.
Three beams of tunneling light flew out from the maze, heading straight towards the area.
"It's them!" Mao Yi's face darkened. The newcomers were Bai Yuan along with his subordinates Gao Feng and Dian Xiaosan.
Regarding Bai Yuan and Gao Feng, he didn't care much, but Dian Xiaosan was different. He was one of the foremost alchemy masters of the Dongji Sea and was highly likely to pass the test of the elderly Emperor Yan. He must be prevented from entering the hall!
Bai Yuan appeared cheerful at first, but seeing Mao Yi already there, his brows furrowed before loosening again. He smiled and said:
"Haha, I didn't expect Fellow Daoist Mao to arrive so quickly. Could it be that you've already obtained the treasure?"
"Hmph, enough nonsense. The Pill King Pavilion Inheritance is inside the hall, if you want it, first get past me!" Mao Yi took action fiercely, a black dharma manifestation appeared behind him in an instant, his right hand enveloped in smoke-like black light raised, grabbing towards Bai Yuan.
"Mao Yi, are you crazy!" Bai Yuan was taken aback, not expecting Mao Yi to attack immediately, so ruthless.
However, being a Dharma Phase Cultivator as well, Bai Yuan's reaction was not slow in the slightest. As he saw the black giant palm incoming, dazzling golden light burst out from him, a seated Golden Buddha dharma manifestation with closed eyes emerged in an instant.
The Buddha dharma manifestation raised its hands vertically, and a large patch of golden light rose to meet the attack.
In an instant, rolling black smoke collided with dazzling golden light in the sky, exploding with an unprecedented terrifying roar, the earth shook violently, as if a volcano would erupt and spew forth at any moment.
The black-armored man, Gao Feng, and Dian Xiaosan were shaken with stars before their eyes, unable to stand firmly, only able to retreat repeatedly, not daring to approach the battlefield.
At the center of the fierce collision of black and golden light, Mao Yi suddenly turned his head towards Dian Xiaosan,
The black dharma manifestation copied the motion, its eyes suddenly projected two thin black lightning bolts, shooting rapidly towards Dian Xiaosan.
Dian Xiaosan was horrified, not understanding why Mao Yi was targeting him.
Although his cultivation was not weak, having reached late stage Returning Void Realm, he couldn't compare to the Dharma Phase Realm, and was not skilled in combat spells, unable to dodge in time.
Seeing Dian Xiaosan trapped in a predicament, Bai Yuan quickly formed a seal with his left hand and pointed at his brow, while his right hand grasped the void.
The right hand of the golden Buddha dharma manifestation flashed with golden light, producing a golden bottle aimed at the two black lightnings.
Boom!
A terrifying suction force emanated from the golden bottle, enveloping the two black lightning bolts, immediately slowing their speed severalfold.
Simultaneously, the brow of the golden Buddha dharma manifestation cracked open, revealing a golden vertical eye.
A flame-like golden light shot out, intercepting the two black lightning bolts.
"Boom" "Boom", two loud bangs, the black lightning was shattered, turning into nothingness.
This all seems lengthy, but in fact, it happened in the blink of an eye.
"Mao Yi, I never thought you'd be so vile, being a Dharma Manifestation Stage Great Power, yet you sneak attack a Returning Void Stage young cultivator!" Bai Yuan stood in front of Dian Xiaosan, scolded in a deep voice.
Mao Yi secretly thought it was a pity, didn't respond to Bai Yuan's words, and continued to command the black dharma manifestation to attack.
Bai Yuan seeing this, kept silent and faced the battle.
The battling parties started using their full strength, dense black and golden beams scattered and splattered, the entire labyrinth space began to tremble, becoming pitted and uneven in an instant, filled with black smoke and dust.
However, under such intense aftermath of spell combat, the nearby great hall remained intact. Occasionally, scattered black smoke and golden light bombarded the great hall, but they were all blocked by a layer of red spirit light, causing no damage at all.
"The power of a Dharma Phase battle is indeed amazing!" Yuan Ming thought to himself.
His transformed stone block by the aftermath of the battle was flung away, buried under a heap of ruin debris, but this was good, making it less likely to get injured.
"Fight, fight, the more chaotic the situation the better, best to fight directly into the great hall and drag Emperor Yan into it too!" Yuan Ming rejoiced inwardly.
In the chaos, he would seize the opportunity to snatch the Pill King Secret Manual.
Just as the two were fiercely engaged, two tunneling lights approached quickly, Bai Yuan, who was under suppression, suddenly brightened up.
"Brother Zhu Yu, this demon is powerful, quickly come help me!" Bai Yuan seeing this, quickly shouted.
The two spirit lights revealed the figures inside, it was Zhu Yu and the blue-haired lady devil cultivator.
Just revealed, Zhu Yu paused, his gaze only lingered on Bai Yuan and Mao Yi for a moment, then turned to the great hall.
Seeing this, Bai Yuan secretly cried out in alarm.
Although he was in alliance with Zhu Yu, obviously seizing the Pill King Pavilion Inheritance was more in Zhu Yu's interest than helping Bai Yuan.
Mao Yi likewise realized this, his expression became even more grim.
Yet unexpectedly, after Zhu Yu saw the Pill King Secret Manual stored in the great hall with his divine sense, his eyes turned, he laughed aloud, then soared into the sky, a large area of bright blue water light emanated from him.
"Brother Bai Yuan, don't worry, I'm here to help you eliminate the demon." He laughed, punching out.
Only to see a giant Kun dharma manifestation towering to the heavens appear above his head, its back blue, belly white, surrounded by azure ribbons of water light, its size astonishingly larger than Bai Yuan and Mao Yi's dharma manifestations, crashing viciously towards Mao Yi.
Bai Yuan, though confused, became very happy, counterattacking Mao Yi.
With Zhu Yu's addition, the tide of battle rapidly reversed, Mao Yi soon fell to a disadvantage, forced back step by step by Bai Yuan and Zhu Yu's combined forces, unable to mount a counterattack, appearing very embarrassed.
No sooner said than done, Ouyang Qiang and the other two finally arrived outside the great hall.
"Palace Master Ouyang, quickly come help me!" This time, it was Mao Yi's turn to shout out, seeking Ouyang Qiang's assistance.
Ouyang Qiang however pretended not to hear, her gaze turned to the inside of the great hall, directly falling on the Pill King Secret Manual.
Different from Zhu Yu, she entirely ignored Mao Yi's plea, didn't even bother uttering a single unnecessary word, her figure slightly blurred, preparing to charge into the hall alone.

chapters.title: Chapter 824 - 795: Seize the Successor, Death!
chapters.content:
"Not good, she's going for the treasure!" Bai Yuan shouted, no longer holding back, the Buddha Dharma's hands continuously striking out.
Countless palm shadows hit Mao Yi and the black Dharma, as if the Buddha Dharma had grown a thousand hands.
Although Mao Yi tried his best to resist, he was still knocked back, flying away.
Bai Yuan forced Mao Yi back with one move, then turned and wanted to rush into the main hall to stop Ouyang Qiang.
A strange glint flashed in Mao Yi's eyes, and the black Dharma shot out black thunder from its eyes, instantly spreading to every part of the Dharma, and onto Mao Yi himself.
Mao Yi and the black Dharma vanished into thin air, reappearing the next moment to block Bai Yuan once more, not giving him any chance to break free.
"Mao Yi, you've really gone mad! Do you really think Ouyang Qiang will share the Pill King Pavilion inheritance with you after she gets it!" Bai Yuan shouted somewhat frantically.
Mao Yi laughed loudly without answering, while the black Dharma behind him erupted with intense black light, and a blinding white light suddenly shone from Mao Yi's palms.
The black and white lights intertwined, forming a huge Tai Chi yin and yang pattern, slowly rotating.
A force as overwhelming as a tidal wave burst from the Tai Chi yin and yang pattern, throwing Bai Yuan and Zhu Yu back outside the hall door.
While the three Dharma cultivators were battling outside the hall, Ouyang Qiang had already reached the table where the Pill King Secret Manual was placed, a hint of excitement on her face.
"Who goes there?" The corpse of the Yan Emperor in front of the Taishi Chair asked again.
Ouyang Qiang completely ignored his question, as the three fighting outside could rush in at any moment and she didn't have much time. She reached for the Pill King Secret Manual without hesitation.
An unprecedented, terrifying pressure erupted from the Yan Emperor's corpse, blowing up his robes, and his dry corpse even swelled as if regaining vitality.
"Audacious rogue! Who dares to steal my Pill King Pavilion inheritance!" The Yan Emperor's voice thundered throughout the hall.
At this moment, Ouyang Qiang was just a finger's width from the Pill King Secret Manual, but she suddenly stopped, unable to advance even an inch.
Everyone outside the hall heard the Yan Emperor's voice, and both Bai Yuan and Zhu Yu were startled.Thischapterwasuploadedbytheteamat*.
Bai Yuan, anxious, shouted directly, "Mao Yi, if you keep blocking me, the Pill King Pavilion inheritance will be..."
Before he finished his sentence, he heard a loud explosion. Not far away, the palace doors suddenly opened, and Ouyang Qiang was thrown out like a ragdoll, retreating more than ten steps outside the hall before she barely stabilized, her expression filled with disbelief.
The battling trio of Mao Yi, Bai Yuan, and Zhu Yu all stopped simultaneously upon seeing this.
"It seems you're not here to inherit the Pill King Pavilion but to cause trouble!" The Yan Emperor walked out of the hall, his aura surging again, sweeping across the entire maze area like a hurricane, easily suppressing the momentum of Bai Yuan and the other three.
Bai Yuan, Zhu Yu, and others' expressions changed dramatically, but before they could react, cracks suddenly spread across the ground outside the palace with a "crack," and countless magma surged upward like a volcanic eruption, scorching heat and dust mingling with rising lava, coalescing into a towering Molten Rock Dharma Form twice the size of those of Mao Yi, Bai Yuan, and others.
"Is this... the Yan Emperor's Dharma Form? How is it possible? Isn't he already dead!" Bai Yuan's eyes widened.
Not far from him, Mao Yi showed a look of triumph, his strategy having succeeded, and with a change in his spell, his body became shrouded in black smoke, disappearing from before everyone's eyes.
"Those who forcibly seize the inheritance, die!" Before anyone could notice Mao Yi's actions, the Yan Emperor's Molten Rock Dharma Form suddenly spoke, emitting a deafening roar.
In the next instant, the Molten Rock Dharma Form raised its hand, and a great stone rod with flames swirling around its ends appeared in its grasp, which it then swung downward, sending a dense barrage of rod shadows, carrying lava and fierce flames, directly towards Ouyang Qiang.
Ouyang Qiang looked horrified and hurriedly chanted a spell to summon her Thunder and Lightning Dharma Form, pulling a bow and shooting a giant thunder arrow to meet the shadowy attack.
Thunder light and molten rod shadows collided, and amid an earth-shattering roar, they exploded into a dazzling light like the sun, swallowing both the Molten Rock Dharma Form and the Thunder Dharma Form, making it impossible for Bai Yuan and others to see the scene.
When the light faded, they were shocked to find that Ouyang Qiang's Thunder Dharma Form had its abdomen pierced by the stone rod, while Ouyang Qiang's body lay in a bloodied heap in a large pit, her life and death unknown.
"Just a corpse, how can it possess such power?" Zhu Yu was dumbfounded, retreating repeatedly.
"This Yan Emperor isn't called the pinnacle of the Dharma Phase for nothing. Even if just a corpse remains, none of us alone are a match for it. We must join forces... Wait, where's Mao Yi?" As Bai Yuan spoke, he suddenly realized, looking around but no trace of Mao Yi was to be found.
An ominous feeling seized his heart, and he immediately rubbed his eyes, causing them to burst with a large amount of golden light, scanning the surroundings.
Everything nearby was coated in a faint gold, with even the void not spared.
In the void near the left gate of the hall, a blurry black figure was moving swiftly towards the inside.
"Old rogue, don't think you can escape!" Bai Yuan snorted coldly, unleashing his full power.
The Buddha Dharma seated on the golden lotus platform behind him stood up for the first time, opened its once shut eyes, and a barrage of golden light beams shot towards the blurry figure.
Facing such an onslaught, how could the blurred figure dare to ignore it? Hastily stopping, he flicked his sleeve, and the black light that shrouded his form dissipated, revealing none other than Mao Yi. Behind him, a massive black Dharma Form took shape once more.
The Dharma Form raised both fists, colliding with the incoming Golden Light.
Mao Yi struck out hastily, unable to withstand the attack of Bai Yuan's golden Dharma Form, and was sent flying along with his Dharma Form.
Emperor Yan's gaze swept towards the two of them in anger, as the giant hands of the Molten Rock Dharma Form descended, striking towards Bai Yuan and Mao Yi respectively.
The two dared not take it head-on, dodging hastily.
At this moment, a large expanse of blue water light surged from Zhu Yu's body, while the giant beast Dharma Form above his head bellowed and spewed out a ten-thousand-foot water column downward.
The entire hall was instantly flooded, including Emperor Yan and the towering Molten Rock Dharma Form.
Water and fire don't mix, and with loud "sizzling" sounds, countless white mists appeared out of thin air, obscuring everyone's sight in the hall.
This white mist was no ordinary water mist, affecting the Divine Sense of everyone present, preventing them from clearly perceiving their surroundings.
Taking advantage of this, Zhu Yu transformed into an invisible phantom, blending into the water and heading straight for the Inheritance Hall.
He clearly had the same idea as Ouyang Qiang, intending to seize the "Pill King Secret Manual" amidst the chaos.
Just then, the eyes of the Molten Rock Dharma Form lit up with two burning flames, looking towards Zhu Yu in the water.
"For those who would steal the Pill King Pavilion Inheritance, death awaits!" Emperor Yan's voice once again echoed in all directions.
"He sensed me? My Mysterious Water Escape can hide my form and scent, and conceals all aura fluctuations. Coupled with the Soul Scattering Water Mist's effects, how is this possible!" Zhu Yu was shocked and immediately turned to flee.
The Molten Rock Dharma Form did not pursue but instead formed a seal with its hands before its chest.
Suddenly, a red light filled the vision of Zhu Yu, Bai Yuan, and Mao Yi. The surrounding hall vanished into thin air, and the three found themselves amidst a sea of flames, with nothing to support them above or below, surrounded by raging fires.
The severely injured Ouyang Qiang also appeared here, still unconscious.
In the center of the sea of fire loomed an imposing figure, none other than Emperor Yan of the Molten Rock Dharma Form.
"Is this an illusion?" Bai Yuan, remaining the calmest, gathered all his Soul Power in an attempt to break the illusion.
However, waves of intense heat swept over them, making even the Dharma Phase Cultivator-level individuals like Zhu Yu and his companions feel their bodies stinging as if their organs were burning, with Protective Body Mana ineffective as if it wasn't even there.
The Dharma Forms behind the three suddenly lost control and rapidly dissipated, collapsing within a few breaths. No matter how they tried to cast, they could not conjure it again.
It wasn't just the Dharma Forms; their Divine Sense and Mana were also confined within a foot outside their bodies, unable to break through despite their efforts.
"This isn't an illusion, it's...a Spiritual Domain!" Bai Yuan gasped, murmuring in disbelief.
"Impossible! A Spiritual Domain is a Divine Skill that only Mahayana cultivators can manifest. Emperor Yan could never have reached that realm in life!" Mao Yi exclaimed in disbelief, forgetting their recent deadly battle with Bai Yuan.
"No, this isn't a complete Spiritual Domain, otherwise we wouldn't be able to use Mana at all. Based on the Classics left by my ancestors, this is just a Fake Spirit Domain." Zhu Yu discerned the anomaly.
However, the expressions of Bai Yuan and Mao Yi showed no relief, as whether it was a true or fake Spiritual Domain, it was still beyond their capability to resist.
As they spoke, over a hundred volcano-like cracks suddenly appeared on the surface of the Molten Rock Dharma Form, spewing out vast amounts of magma.
Amidst the magma, fiery red iron chains wrapped in flames emerged like living snakes, shooting towards Mao Yi and the others.
Seeing this, Mao Yi and his companions immediately evaded, each casting their defensive spells.
However, the severely injured Ouyang Qiang, lying on the ground, had no means of resistance and was directly bound by the chains.
The situation of Mao Yi and the others wasn't much better. Even though Emperor Yan's incomplete Spiritual Domain made their mana operations unbearably sluggish and their movement speed drastically reduced, even their Divine Skills exhibited less than a tenth of their usual power.
In the blink of an eye, the three of them were entwined by the chains, their mana increasingly sluggish and stagnant.
Despite their desperate struggles, the effect was minimal, and despair crept across their faces.
At this moment, the flames on the red chains suddenly extinguished by more than half, and the fiery light within the surrounding Spiritual Domain dimmed considerably.
"Emperor Yan is but a corpse, incapable of sustaining this Fake Spirit Domain!" Mao Yi exclaimed with delight.
As he spoke, shadowy black light quietly crept along the chains binding him, constantly corroding them and causing rust spots to appear.

chapters.title: Chapter 825 - 796: Displaying Divine Skills
chapters.content:
Without Mao Yi's reminder, Bai Yuan and Zhu Yu also noticed Emperor Yan's power waning and began to employ their own measures for self-preservation.
A mysterious chanting appeared around Bai Yuan, emerging from the void. The flames wrapped around the scarlet chains shook madly, unexpectedly tinged with a hint of gold.
Zhu Yu took a more direct approach, his entire body surging with blue light, as the surging Water spirit light slammed into the scarlet chains, large amounts of mist billowed up, shrouding his figure.
"Too much mana lost, otherwise, how could three mere early-stage Dharma cultivators bounce around in my hands?" Emperor Yan snorted coldly, extending his hand to grab at the void.
Volcanic cracks on the Molten Rock Dharma Form rose one after another, thousand chains shot out from within, once again binding Mao Yi and the others tightly, refusing them any chance to escape.
However, as the number of chains increased, the flames in the sky gradually thinned, and the Spiritual Domain became sparse, as if it was about to vanish at any moment.
This sight made Mao Yi and the others increasingly excited, immediately exerting extra effort, trying to break free from Emperor Yan's Fake Spirit Domain.
But what they failed to notice was, every time they cast a spell to resist the chains, a small portion of their spiritual power mysteriously dissolved, silently merging into the chains, becoming a part of Emperor Yan's Fake Spirit Domain.
The harder they tried, the more their power was secretly devoured, the Spiritual Domain seemed on the verge of collapse, yet always remained on the brink, leaving the three with deep helplessness, only able to bitterly support.
However, Emperor Yan's Spiritual Domain was not complete, he had to focus all his divine thought here, entirely ignoring the outside world, to keep the Spiritual Domain functioning.
Thus, the two sides remained in a standoff, only with one side's active withdrawal could the situation possibly change.
...
Outside the Inheritance Hall, a red light domain hovered in mid-air, occasionally rumbling, with no view into its surroundings.
Beneath the ruins, a purple eye emerged on the stone transformed by Yuan Ming, gazing skyward.
"Still, the master foresaw correctly by not leaving immediately! Mao Yi, Bai Yuan, Zhu Yu, and Emperor Yan are deadlocked within the Red Light Domain, with them occupied, our chance to seize the Pill King Secret Manual has greatly increased!" Hua Zhi's joyful voice sounded in Yuan Ming's sea of consciousness.
Yuan Ming didn't speak, feeling secretly pleased.
Yet, he remained transformed, the restrictions around the Inheritance Hall persisted, and he couldn't emerge at this moment.
"Master, shall I go in? Maybe I can." Hua Zhi's voice came from the Spiritual Beast Bag.
"No need, someone else will retrieve the Pill King Secret Manual for us." Yuan Ming said, his gaze fixed into the distance.
Huangfu Jue, the black Long Gui, and a group of Returning Void cultivators stood there, not daring to approach the Red Light Domain.
Yet as the light domain showed no activity, Huangfu Jue and the six Returning Void cultivators grew restless, all eyes drifting to the bench inside the hall.
The six Returning Void cultivators split into two groups, Huangfu Jue, Yun Luo Fairy, Long Gui transformed into a black armored man stood together, while the blue-haired female demon cultivator, Gao Feng, Dian Xiaosan grouped in the other half, faintly confronting each other.
"Fellow Daoists, although I'm not sure what method Mao Yi, Bai Yuan, and the four senior cultivators used, Emperor Yan is indeed restrained within the Red Light Domain, unable to tend to outside. Now is the perfect opportunity to take the Pill King Secret Manual. I'm not sure what dangers lie ahead in this hall; although we've had some friction, we all came here to seek treasure. Why not temporarily cease hostilities and unite to claim the Pill King Secret Manual? What do you all think?" Black armored man spoke.
"Oh, Fellow Daoist Long Gui makes sense, but the Pill King Secret Manual is singular and yet we are so many. How will it be divided?" Gao Feng exchanged glances with Dian Xiaosan and the blue-haired female demon cultivator, laughing lightly.
"Fellow Daoist Gao Feng forgets, classics unlike other treasures, can be replicated infinitely, extract the Pill King Secret Manual and copy into six sets, everyone present gets a copy, won't that be delightful?" Huangfu Jue smiled.
These words immediately stirred those present.
"Fellow Daoist Huangfu makes sense, let's do it." Dian Xiaosan nodded in agreement.
Gao Feng and the blue-haired female demon cultivator also nodded successively.
"Alright, if that's the case, let's work together to break this forbidden light screen!" Huangfu Jue delightedly approached the Inheritance Hall, touching the light screen at the entrance, only to find his hand easily penetrating through.
"Seems this restriction won't stop us, truly heaven assists us." Huangfu Jue exclaimed joyfully.
"Given this, which fellow Daoist will enter to fetch the Pill King Secret Manual?" The blue-haired female demon cultivator spoke for the first time, her voice hoarse and unpleasant, not matching her appearance.
"This suggestion was made by Fellow Daoist Huangfu and Fellow Daoist Long Gui, so let it be the two of them." Gao Feng said.
Huangfu Jue and Black armored man exchanged glances at the words, nodded, and stepped foot into the light screen.
Yun Luo Fairy silently retreated, clung to a large stone, a faint yellow gleam flashed on her back, and her body flickered, disappearing without attracting any attention.
After Huangfu Jue and Black-armored man entered the hall, they didn't proceed further, but focused intently, gauging the situation around.
However, the surroundings remained silent, with no anomalies appearing.
Huangfu Jue felt slightly assured, golden arcs flashed on his surface, transforming into a golden shadow, rushing towards the bench.
Brought to you by the folks at *.
The Black-armored Man followed close, enveloped in a layer of black light.
At this moment, beneath the bench, a giant beast skull resembling fiery red coral emerged from the ground.
The beast jerked its head, thousands of crystalline tears shot from its eye sockets, like raindrops, striked towards Huangfu Jue, and the black-armored man.
These tears seem to be condensed from water, yet they are scalding hot like lava. Even before hitting their target, they carried waves of hot wind and rushed towards the two.
Huangfu Jue's face changed dramatically, as he seemed unusually afraid of these tears. He swiftly retreated backward, barely avoiding the attack, but his right hand was struck by a tear.
"Sizzle" sounds rang out, and his palm rapidly rotted, revealing white bones. The tears' corrosion quickly continued to spread upward.
The Black-armored Man was not as quick as Huangfu Jue and had no time to dodge. He immediately clapped his hands, preparing to cast a spell to resist forcefully.
Just at that moment, two beams of Golden Light shot from the side, completely enveloping the man's body.
The man instantly felt as if he was petrified, his limbs unable to move, and he could only helplessly watch as the tears struck.
"Gao Feng, Lan Lan, you despicable scums!" Huangfu Jue performed spells repeatedly to stop the spread of the tears' corrosion and angrily shouted backward.
The attackers were indeed Gao Feng and the blue-haired Devil Cultivator woman.
Gao Feng's eyes shot out the two beams of Golden Light, which enveloped the Black-armored Man, while Lan Lan's feet had somehow transformed into a coral state, piercing into the ground.
The coral beast was clearly her creation.
"Demon Cultivators are the public enemy of the entire Chuyun Realm. The Pill King Secret Manual, regardless of who it finally ends up with, must not be taken by Demon Cultivators. You, Dongji Palace, and demon cultivators are in league, and this is your fate!" Gao Feng sneered coldly, continuously casting techniques with both hands.
Seven or eight golden Flying Knives shot out from his sleeve, slashing towards the Black-armored Man.
The Black-armored Man roared in anger, without hesitation, revealing his true form, transforming into a giant black Long Gui.
The range of the Golden Light was limited, and the Long Gui's limbs and head were free from the Golden Light's coverage, regaining their freedom.
The golden Flying Knives struck the turtle's shell with a series of clinks and clanks, leaving only several white marks.
Gao Feng's face sank, yet he didn't continue to attack because the countless tears had already shot forth.
The black Long Gui was also afraid of the tears and hurriedly retracted its head and tail, leaving only the turtle shell exposed, directly facing the tears' assault.
The tears battered the turtle shell incessantly, as if they were acid, leaving scorched black pits on the shell.
The massive body of the Long Gui trembled intensely, unable to conceal its painful groan.
"You're courting death!" the black Long Gui roared, a layer of yellow light emerged on its surface.
The gravity inside the hall instantly increased over a hundredfold, far stronger than when they were on Black Mo Island. Regardless of Gao Feng, Lan Lan, or Huangfu Jue on the other side, their bodies staggered, half kneeling on the ground, unable to move.
Outside the Inheritance Hall, Dian Xiaosan was also affected.
However, the gravity here was not strong, and he braced himself with his legs and endured it.
"This Long Gui actually awakened such a rare Gravity Divine Ability, but unfortunately, it is useless against me." Dian Xiaosan took out a white elixir and consumed it. Soon, a shadow-like yellow transparent rune emerged within his Dantian.
A faint yellow radiance appeared on his body, completely nullifying the surrounding gravity.
"This shadow fruit is indeed formidable, but it's a pity it's only a one-time thing." Dian Xiaosan sighed and was about to dash into the hall.
"No, there's still someone outside!" Dian Xiaosan suddenly recalled an issue, turning his gaze towards Yun Luo Fairy.
However, Yun Luo Fairy, who was just nearby, had disappeared without a trace. No matter how he searched with his Divine Sense, he couldn't find a glimpse.
Dian Xiaosan was cautious, yet he didn't linger there, and his figure quickly darted into the hall, heading straight for the platform, completely unaffected by the terrifying gravity inside.
"How can it be!" the black Long Gui was shocked upon seeing this.
His Gravity Divine Ability should have been impossible for even Mao Yi to break so easily. How did Dian Xiaosan, with only a Returning to Void Cultivation, manage such a feat?
But the situation was urgent, the Long Gui couldn't think much, and its front claws fiercely pressed down.
The ground around Dian Xiaosan exploded with a boom, scattering dozens of debris in all directions, shooting towards Dian Xiaosan.
Each of these debris was covered in a layer of yellow light, emitting astonishing sounding breaking waves, comparable to a Returning Void Cultivator's attack.
Dian Xiaosan didn't care, his right hand pointed into the void, and a hint of yellow light emerged at his fingertips.
All the debris suddenly veered off course, perilously brushing past Dian Xiaosan's body.
"Gravity Divine Ability!" the black Long Gui was stunned.
Dian Xiaosan did not slow down, seizing the moment when the Long Gui was stunned, he arrived at the platform.
"It really is the Pill King Secret Manual, after lingering in Dongji Sea for hundreds of years, I've finally found it!" He picked up the Pill King Secret Manual, an excited expression appearing on his face, and immediately attempted to store it in his Storage Ring.
However, whether it was due to some Forbidden by Emperor Yan, the Pill King Secret Manual couldn't be put into the Storage Ring, and could only be held temporarily.

chapters.title: Chapter 826 - 797: From the Sky
chapters.content:
"Fellow Daoist Long Gui, stop quickly, the item is about to be taken away by this person!" Huangfu Jue transmitted voice over.
"I've withdrawn my divine ability, what about Gao Feng and Lan Lan?" the black Long Gui hesitated.
"No need to worry about them, let's seize the Pill King Secret Manual first, and leave the rest to me." Huangfu Jue said.
"Well then!" transmitted the black Long Gui, waving his hand to remove the gravity divine ability.
As soon as the gravity disappeared, Huangfu Jue's body instantly transformed into a dazzling golden thunder light, rushing straight toward Dian Xiaosan, twice as fast as before.
Dian Xiaosan, although intent on obtaining the treasure at that moment, still kept a bit cautious, guarding against Yun Luo Fairy hiding somewhere.
However, Huangfu Jue's speed was incredibly fast, at the moment he appeared, Dian Xiaosan hadn't even seen his face clearly when he saw a thunder blade light chopping down.
Slash!
The right arm holding the Pill King Secret Manual was abruptly cut off, blood gushed out, and the Secret Manual flew away.
Dian Xiaosan screamed miserably, and was then blasted away by a thunder light, crashing heavily into the hall wall, spitting out a mouthful of blood, and slumping to the ground.
Huangfu Jue did not even glance at Dian Xiaosan, raising his hand to grab towards the Pill King Secret Manual.
"This is the moment I've been waiting for!" Gao Feng flipped and leapt up, opened his mouth, and spat.
A tumbler painted with human faces on both sides instantly flew out, swaying left and right, with the face up becoming upside down in an instant.
Suddenly, Huangfu Jue's vision blurred, and he found himself at the position Gao Feng had just been, while Gao Feng was swapped to the spot next to the Pill King Secret Manual.
"Space Shifting Divine Ability!" Huangfu Jue's face suddenly darkened.
Gao Feng directly reached out, grabbing the Secret Manual and Dian Xiaosan's severed arm, stuffing them into his chest, while white light flashed under his feet, a cloud suddenly emerged, lifting his body as he fled toward the hall exit, at an extremely fast speed as well.
How could Huangfu Jue let him escape, once again transforming into thunder, chasing after him.
Although Gao Feng's speed was fast, he was still much slower than the thunder Huangfu Jue transformed into, and the distance between them quickly closed visibly.
Seeing this, Gao Feng broke out in a cold sweat, his eyes flickering, he suddenly took out a palm-sized Jade Talisman, attempting to crush it.
A stream of water gushed from underground ahead, revealing Lan Lan's figure.
"Fellow Daoist Lan Lan, you arrived just in time, help me block Huangfu Jue!" Gao Feng exclaimed with joy, stopping the action of crushing the Jade Talisman, shouting loudly.
Lan Lan glanced at him, her hands rapidly forming seals, with the coral Beast Bones on her head suddenly opening its mouth.
A faint white spirit light shot out from the coral beast's mouth, hitting Gao Feng with a confused look.
With a "boom" resounding, Gao Feng was blasted away, crashing heavily to the ground.
His skin and flesh tore open, with large patches of coral rapidly growing from his body, within moments transforming him into a monster covered with coral.
"Why... why?" Gao Feng's face torn by coral was full of disbelief.
The black Long Gui had already transformed back into human form, witnessing this scene, was also stunned.
At this moment, he suddenly smelled a faint fragrance, and his demonic power inside ceased to cooperate, his limbs weakened, causing him to sit on the ground.
At this moment, Dian Xiaosan appeared silently behind him, holding a golden treasure sword which he had somehow obtained, stabbing swiftly towards Long Gui's spine.
Long Gui's heart was filled with dread, barely gathering the remaining demonic power, desperately dodging to the side, but still couldn't evade, being pierced through by one stab, the sword penetrating the black armor, entering the waist, all the way to the hilt.
A wild force surged from the golden treasure sword, pouring into the body of the black Long Gui.
The black Long Gui let out a shrill scream, blood sprayed from his mouth and nose, his body splitting with countless wounds, blood rushing out in large puddles.
Long Gui's eyes rolled white, his tall body slowly fell into the pool of blood, fainting.
Lan Lan looked at Dian Xiaosan's side, her expression calm, seemingly unperturbed.
The woman quickly shifted her gaze, looking towards the approaching Huangfu Jue: "We've done what we should, now, it's time for you to fulfill your promises."
"And my share, too." Dian Xiaosan came flying over as well.
"Of course, Master Dian, Fellow Daoist Lan Lan can rest assured, our Dongji Palace holds firm to its promises, we will never go back on our word." Huangfu Jue nodded and smiled.
"Lan Lan, since when did your Azure Dragon Pond collude with Dongji Palace? And Dian Xiaosan, you actually betrayed us Luo Jia Mountain!" Gao Feng glared at the three fiercely.
"You're mistaken, Azure Dragon Pond has been our Dongji Palace ally from the start, as soon as the Palace Master received the news that the Black Evil Sect was about to open Emperor Yan's Mausoleum, he informed Azure Dragon Pond's members to come to aid, unexpected that you Luo Jia Mountain also got wind of the information and wanted to follow, as a precaution, the Palace Master sent Master Dian to join your team, to coordinate as needed." Huangfu Jue said indifferently.
Gao Feng's face became ashen, Dian Xiaosan did indeed suddenly want to join Luo Jia Mountain's team just before heading to Emperor Yan's Mausoleum, they had been manipulated right from the start.
Gao Feng's heart was filled with unwillingness, desperately wanting to crush the Jade Talisman in his hand, but his arm no longer obeyed his commands.
"Why bother talking so much with him? Hurry up and kill him to get the job done." Dian Xiaosan frowned.
"I, Huangfu Jue, do not enjoy slaughter. Even if I must kill, I will fulfill their last wish before their death. Go in peace." Huangfu Jue walked up, took the Jade Talisman from Gao Feng's hand, flicked a finger, and a sword light slashed towards Gao Feng's neck.
But in the next instant, two figures wrapped in black light appeared out of nowhere on Huangfu Jue's left and right, shooting out beams of treasure light, crisscrossing towards him.
Huangfu Jue was startled, flashed and retreated, evading their surprise attack.
Almost at the same time, Dian Xiaosan and Lan Lan were also attacked by two black-cloaked figures.
Each of these shadows possessed Returning Void cultivation, forcing Dian Xiaosan and Lan Lan to quickly dodge.
The two figures who drove back Huangfu Jue did not pursue, but turned to grab Gao Feng lying on the ground,
Huangfu Jue's eyes flashed with cold light. He performed a hand spell, and countless golden lightning bolts shot out, turning the hall into a world of thunder and lightning.
Gao Feng, unable to move, was struck by a barrage of golden thunder. His already critically injured body became charred, and his scant breaths rapidly dissipated, his life or death unknown.
The black shadows hurriedly dodged, but the golden lightning was too dense for them to evade, each being struck by numerous golden thunderbolts, all getting blown away.
The black light on these figures was torn apart by the golden thunder, revealing their true appearances.
Huangfu Jue was taken aback.
These people were none other than the Returning Void Island Masters and Dongji Palace Elders who had assaulted the Black Evil Sect with him before. However, their eyes were now hollow, their expressions wooden, like puppets.
"This is bad, the black Long Gui hasn't lost its battle strength yet!" He whipped his head around, looking at the black Long Gui nearby.
"The Dongji Palace is truly calculating." The black Long Gui got up, smiled coldly.
"Impossible! He was hit by the Soft Demon Fragrance and struck by a blow from the Dragon Spine Sword; how could he recover so quickly?" Dian Xiaosan was in disbelief.
"If I were just an ordinary Long Gui demon beast, I would indeed be waiting for death with my eyes closed. But how could you all forget that the Black Evil Sect is a demon cultivator force, and I am one too." The black Long Gui chuckled, and a jet-black qi surged from his body, pure demonic qi.
The wounds on his body healed rapidly, and his aura soared, almost breaking through the Level 5 threshold to reach Level 6.
The Returning Void Island Masters under his control also exuded strong demonic qi fluctuations, and their auras grew significantly stronger.
Seeing this scene, Lan Lan and Dian Xiaosan couldn't help but change their expressions and instinctively looked at Huangfu Jue, evidently taking their cue from him.
"Do you think having this group of Returning Void Puppets will be enough to defeat me?" Huangfu Jue cast a cold glance at the Returning Void Island Masters.
"You'll know if you try." The Long Gui chuckled, tapping his finger lightly.
The group of Returning Void Puppets ignited clusters of treasure light in their hands, ready to strike.
Just as the battle between the two sides was about to erupt, Gao Feng, severely wounded and on the brink of death, suddenly showed a rich flush on his cheeks like a fleeting revival, and his eyes turned blood-red, appearing as if in madness.
"Since I can't have it, then no one else shall either!" he shouted.
This chapter was made possible by the community at *.
Gao Feng's entire body surged with mana in an abnormal frenzy, and his physical body, torn by coral, swelled violently. Large patches of golden light poured out from his orifices and wounds, seemingly out of control.
"This is bad, his Heart Demon is acting up, and he's about to self-destruct his Nascent Soul!" Huangfu Jue's eyes widened, and he disregarded the unclaimed Pill King Secret Manual, turning to retreat quickly.
In the next instant, a terrifying white light engulfed everything around, and a vast shockwave swept out, inundating the entire hall.
The powerful wind pressure ripped up the ground, rubble and smoke rushed outwards rapidly, as if propelled by an invisible wall, slamming hard against the surrounding walls like a tsunami.
The walls of the Inheritance Hall flickered with threads of golden light, remaining undamaged except for the floor.
The hall could withstand Gao Feng's self-destruction, but Huangfu Jue and the others could not. Their eardrums hurt from the roar, their heads spun with dizziness, and they were swept away like leaves in a storm, crashing heavily into the palace walls.
"What an astonishing power. It seems Gao Feng cultivated some sort of self-destruction secret technique, for even an ordinary Returning Void Nascent Soul self-destruct would not be this shocking! That Pill King Secret Manual better be alright. Damn it, if I'd known, I would have had Hua Zhi sneak in!" Outside the hall, Yuan Ming was shocked and greatly regretted.
At this moment, a figure flew out from the main doors of the hall; it was Dian Xiaosan.
He landed heavily on the ground not far from Yuan Ming, stones splattering, his body's bones crackling and breaking who knows how many ribs.
A mass of golden light immediately shot out from the dusty interior of the hall, revealing itself to be a golden book.
"The Pill King Secret Manual!" Yuan Ming's heart skipped a beat, and without thinking, he cast a spell to remove the Transformation Stone Talisman.
The heavily injured Dian Xiaosan hadn't realized what was happening when he felt a sharp pain on his forehead as the Pill King Secret Manual hit him, then fell into his arms.
Dian Xiaosan looked at the Pill King Secret Manual in bewilderment, quickly regaining his clarity, his heart filled with wild joy.
Having struggled so hard to obtain it to no avail, he never expected the Pill King Secret Manual to fall from the sky now.
He held the Pill King Secret Manual in his hands, and after scanning it with his Divine Sense, his face lit up with even greater joy.
The spirit light that had once faintly glowed on the classic had disappeared, and Dian Xiaosan could now feel that it could be stored within his storage magic tool.

chapters.title: Chapter 827 - 798: Hand in Hand
chapters.content:
However, Dian Xiaosan hadn't had time to put away the Pill King Secret Manual when he heard the sound of thunder rolling in from the direction of the Inheritance Hall.
Moments later, a golden lightning figure darted out from the hall, it was Huangfu Jue, surrounded by thunder, charging aggressively towards him.
Dian Xiaosan was startled when he saw Huangfu Jue's murderous appearance, his thoughts raced after taking stock of his serious injuries, and he raised his hand to throw the Pill King Secret Manual towards Huangfu Jue.
"This old fellow knows what to do." Huangfu Jue snorted coldly in his heart, raising his hand to snatch the Pill King Secret Manual.
But just then, everything went black before his eyes, plunging him into endless darkness, his ears deaf to any sound, his Divine Sense unable to perceive anything nearby.
"Illusion Technique!" Huangfu Jue was shocked and angry, turning the Nine Revolutions Divine Sky Technique to its extreme, with streams of golden lightning shooting from his body.
His right hand continued to reach forward as he had felt before, his fingers touching a hard object — the feel of the Pill King Secret Manual, although thinner than he remembered.
As Huangfu Jue's mind raced, he tightened his grip, firmly holding onto half of the Pill King Secret Manual.
The other half was almost simultaneously grasped by another palm; it was Yuan Ming.
The forbidden on the Pill King Secret Manual had disappeared, the classics weren't very sturdy, and with a "tear," it was ripped in two, with Yuan Ming and Huangfu Jue each holding half.
Yuan Ming put away his half of the Pill King Secret Manual, a flash of black light in his hand, the Soul Destroying Sword shot out, slicing towards Huangfu Jue's wrist.
In the illusion, Huangfu Jue seemed to sense the danger, a large electric arc burst from his forehead, crackling chaotically, forming a golden lightning forest around him again, knocking the Soul Destroying Sword aside.
Meanwhile, Huangfu Jue also broke free from the illusion, reawakening.
"Yuan Ming! You were indeed here! Was the illusion just now your doing?" Huangfu Jue was startled upon seeing Yuan Ming, his body's lightning intensified greatly, retreating instantly by dozens of yards.
The half Pill King Secret Manual in his hand flickered and vanished, stored in his Storage Ring.
Yuan Ming's gaze darkened, and he struck backward with his hand.
A large azure hand appeared out of nowhere, grabbing Dian Xiaosan's body.
At this moment, Dian Xiaosan's gaze was empty, evidently caught in Yuan Ming's illusion, unresponsive to the azure hand's grasp.
As the azure hand withdrew, it captured Dian Xiaosan, tossing him into an empty Spiritual Beast Bag, thereafter putting both him and the bag into the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space.
The Stealing Heaven Tripod Space could only open a tiny slit, too small for a human to pass through, so he resorted to this method.
Though the Spiritual Beast Bag wasn't meant for cultivators, staying in there briefly was harmless.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, what does this mean?" Huangfu Jue frowned and asked.
"This Dian Xiaosan is from Luo Jia Mountain, capturing him shouldn't affect Fellow Daoist Huangfu, right?" Yuan Ming replied unhurriedly.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan has misunderstood, Master Dian Xiaosan is actually an inside agent sent to Luo Jia Mountain by the Palace Master. Please release him." Huangfu Jue's heart surged with murderous intent, yet his face remained calm, even managing a slight smile to explain.
"Palace Master Ouyang... unfortunately, Dian Xiaosan and I have some unfinished business. I'll release him back to Dongji Palace after we're done." Yuan Ming sneered upon hearing Ouyang Qiang's name.
Huangfu Jue's eyes darkened, his murderous intent even stronger.
Yet, the flash-quick exchange earlier had shown Yuan Ming's prowess, shocking him. Given the uncertain situation now, he couldn't afford to completely break with Yuan Ming.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, I know you harbor some resentment towards the Palace Master's prior decision to send you to scout the Fire River Stone Bridge. I, too, disagreed with the decision. At the time, the Palace Master simply picked someone randomly to scout, it wasn't directed at you, Fellow Daoist Yuan, please don't take it to heart." Huangfu Jue smiled, softening his tone.
"Truly? I thought I had offended Palace Master Ouyang somehow," Yuan Ming feigned surprise, not tearing the facade.
His thoughts raced, contemplating how to seize the half Pill King Secret Manual from Huangfu Jue.
Huangfu Jue was stronger than he had anticipated; one failed strike might not afford him a second chance.
"Indeed, but let's not dwell on past matters. Currently, within Emperor Yan's Mausoleum, our Dongji Palace holds the advantage. I wonder if Fellow Daoist Yuan would be willing to return? As Vice Palace Master of Dongji Palace, I promise to persuade the Palace Master not to hold your earlier act of tearing the Shared Fate Talisman against you. As for the half Pill King Secret Manual, it's significantly involved. I hope Fellow Daoist Yuan can return it. In exchange, Dongji Palace offers two million Spirit Stones plus three islands." Huangfu Jue's eyes shifted subtly, his tone conciliatory.
"Vice Palace Master Huangfu's kind offer is appreciated, but as for the half Pill King Secret Manual, I have use for it, and cannot return it." Yuan Ming shook his head.
"It seems Fellow Daoist Yuan arrived here earlier, aware it was the Pill King Secret Manual. I advise you to reconsider. Whether Palace Master, Mao Yi, Bai Yuan, or Zhu Yu, they all greatly value the Pill King Secret Manual. If you refuse to surrender it, you may face pursuit from multiple forces—a complication that isn't trivial..." Huangfu Jue reasoned persuasively.
Before he finished, countless white threads suddenly shot out from the nearby void, instantly entangling Huangfu Jue's body, trapping every finger.
Yuan Ming's expression changed slightly, tapping his forehead, releasing five soul crows from his Sea of Consciousness simultaneously, opening their mouths to send a crow cry towards Huangfu Jue and nearby.
Black sound waves rolled out, submerging the area around Huangfu Jue for dozens of yards.
At the same time, the Soul Destroying Sword once again turned into a black shadow and shot out, slashing towards Huangfu Jue's right hand.
No matter whose Divine Skills the white threads belonged to, Yuan Ming planned to first seize the half book of the Pill King Secret Manual from Huangfu Jue's hand, and then leave immediately.
At this moment, a white sword light shot out from the void, with a "ding" sound, it flicked the Soul Destroying Sword away, then the sword light swiftly made a turn, crossing over Huangfu Jue's right wrist.
"Whoosh"
Blood light suddenly appeared, and Huangfu Jue's right hand was severed.
A white figure emerged out of thin air, grabbed Huangfu Jue's severed hand, and shot off into the distance—it was Yun Luo Fairy.
Yuan Ming squinted his eyes, and the Soul Destroying Sword in front of him lightly trembled, the nine runes on the sword body lit up, ready to be activated.
However, he suddenly sighed, withdrew his mana, and allowed Yun Luo Fairy's figure to vanish into the maze.
He had promised earlier to assist Yun Luo Fairy in seizing the Pill King Pavilion Inheritance. As for the Complete Heaven Exquisite Tripod and that half book of the Pill King Secret Manual, he had taken them from others, and since Yun Luo Fairy did not show up earlier, it was not against his decision.Chapter source: * (*).
Since Yun Luo Fairy decided to make a move for the last half book of the Pill King Secret Manual, he deemed it inappropriate to contend with her for it.
"Thank you, Fellow Daoist Yuan, for your assistance." Yun Luo Fairy's crisp laughter rang out.
"No problem." Yuan Ming shook his head slightly in an indifferent manner, and after retrieving his Soul Crow and Soul Destroying Sword, his figure also transformed into a blue shadow that shot out, disappearing into the maze in the blink of an eye.
Just as his figure disappeared, Lan Lan and the black Long Gui flew out from the hall, followed by the island masters controlled by the black Long Gui, each bearing injuries.
"Where is the Pill King Secret Manual?" Lan Lan's face turned unpleasant when seeing the outside situation and asked.
The white threads binding Huangfu Jue broke inch by inch, turning into many white dots and disappearing, and his mind also awakened from the Crow Attack.
"It was taken by Yun Luo Fairy and Yuan Ming, and Dian Xiaosan was also captured by that Yuan Ming. Both of them concealed their strength and seemed to have colluded long ago." Huangfu Jue said expressionlessly.
"What!" Lan Lan was furious, their eyes almost spouting fire.
They fought fiercely inside, only for someone else to easily reap the rewards!
"That Yuan Ming and Yun Luo Fairy are from your Dongji Palace, right? Hah, your Dongji Palace certainly excels in producing traitors." The black Long Gui mocked, leading a group of puppets into the maze.
"What should we do next?" Lan Lan also wanted to pursue but stopped and asked.
"Yuan Ming and Yun Luo Fairy are extremely powerful, and now we are all heavily wounded and exhausted. If we recklessly pursue, not only will we fail to retrieve the Pill King Secret Manual, but we may also risk our lives. Besides, no method of leaving has ever appeared before us in Emperor Yan's Mausoleum, so it must not be easy to exit. Let's wait for the Palace Master and others to come out, and then make plans." Huangfu Jue took a deep breath, suppressed the anger in his heart, and said slowly.
In that Spiritual Domain space, flames were burning fiercely everywhere.
The crimson chains binding Mao Yi had already been eroded almost entirely, with only the last chain barely restraining him, and Bai Yuan and Zhu Yu were in similar situations.
Ouyang Qiang, who was severely injured and unconscious before, had also awakened by now. While struggling to protect herself, she constantly performed breathing control to recover and did not allocate extra energy to resist the suppression of the Spiritual Domain.
At this moment, Emperor Yan suddenly looked downward, revealing a barely perceptible smile, and the flames within the Spiritual Domain thinned considerably.
"Quickly now, give it your all, the power of that old Emperor Yan ghost is about to be exhausted." Mao Yi said joyfully, shouting loudly.
As his words fell, the black light on his body suddenly surged, and with a "bang", the last chain snapped.
Immediately, two more "bang bang" sounds rang out.
The chains on Zhu Yu and Bai Yuan also snapped simultaneously, scattering a shower of sparks.
The Flame Spirit Domain convulsed violently; many areas completely collapsed and shattered, reducing the suppression on Mao Yi and others by eighty percent. The three of their Dharma manifestations reformed.
The three of them were overjoyed; without any further communication, they tacitly launched an attack towards Emperor Yan's Molten Rock Dharma Form.
Mao Yi struck out with a palm, a massive palm print formed of black smoke expanded in layers in the void, filled with rampant demonic qi, as if countless phantoms of demons were struggling and howling, striking towards Molten Rock Dharma Form's head.
The Buddha Dharma behind Bai Yuan punched out, a golden fist shadow emerged out of thin air, radiant and majestic, as if surrounded by waves of Brahma sound.
Behind Zhu Yu, the giant blue whale's phantom surfaced, rolling waves within, seemingly imbued with the ocean's power, crashing forward.
The three mighty forces converged into one, together striking the Molten Rock Dharma Form.
Two streams of molten lava dripped from the eyes of the Molten Rock Dharma Form, almost as if it were shedding tears, its fists wrapped in molten lava, billowing thick black smoke, met their attack.

chapters.title: Chapter 828 - 799: Ancient Well Inheritance
chapters.content:
"Boom!" A massive explosion echoed.
The enormous body of the Molten Rock Dharma Form suddenly collapsed amidst the loud explosion, its remnants scattered amidst the rolling black smoke, gradually dissipating and vanishing completely into the void.
The pervasive flames in the surrounding space also quickly faded and disappeared without a trace.
The remaining power of Emperor Yan finally ran out; the painstakingly maintained Spiritual Domain completely crumbled, and his remnants fell from mid-air.
Bai Yuan, Mao Yi, Zhu Yu, and Ouyang Qiang—four Dharma manifestation Great Powers—finally broke free. Mao Yi flicked his sleeve, and a black rope shot out, tightly wrapping Emperor Yan's remnants with lightning speed.
But at this moment, an exceedingly strange scene appeared!
Emperor Yan's corpse suddenly self-immolated with a "poof" and in a mere breath or two, turned to ash, leaving only a cluster of golden flames.
This sudden scene left Mao Yi stunned.
In the next moment, he abruptly got up and raised his hand to grasp the golden flame.
However, the golden flame suddenly flared up, exploded with a "bang," and disappeared like shattered fireworks.
"It seems that Emperor Yan has exhausted his strength and completely dissipated!" Seeing this, those present sighed in relief.
The Spiritual Domain power displayed by Emperor Yan was overwhelming, nearly obliterating them, leaving a significant psychological shadow. Surviving this disaster was truly fortunate.
After a brief moment of composure, their gazes turned toward the hall. Inside, it was in complete disarray; not to mention the Pill King Secret Manual, even the table was nowhere to be found.
Mao Yi furrowed his brows, looking outside the hall at Huangfu Jue and Lan Lan, and shouted, "What happened? Where is the Pill King Secret Manual?"
Bai Yuan and the other three Dharma manifestation Great Powers also looked at Huangfu Jue and Lan Lan with grim expressions.
"Honored seniors, we were powerless; the Pill King Secret Manual was stolen by Yuan Ming and Yun Luo Fairy…" Huangfu Jue sorrowfully recounted the situation, concealing his collusion with Lan Lan and Dian Xiaosan's betrayal of Gao Feng and the black Long Gui, blaming everything on Yuan Ming and Yun Luo Fairy.
"That guy again…" Rage flickered in Mao Yi's eyes as he turned to chase after.
This time Bai Yuan's subordinates were completely wiped out, and Dian Xiaosan was also lost with no gain, igniting anger in his heart. He also flew out.
At this moment, a figure darted out from the labyrinth—none other than the black-armored man that the black Long Gui had transformed into.
The man looked at Mao Yi and Bai Yuan and said solemnly, "Sect Leader, Senior Bai Yuan, don't listen to this man's nonsense. Dongji Palace secretly allied with Azure Dragon Pond to trick us, causing Gao Feng to self-destruct and die, injuring me severely. Only then did Yuan Ming and Yun Luo Fairy seize the opportunity to snatch the Pill King Secret Manual amid the chaos!"
"Oh, so you've been colluding all along!" Bai Yuan and Mao Yi were enraged upon hearing this, glaring fiercely at Zhu Yu and Ouyang Qiang.
Zhu Yu said nothing and stood with Ouyang Qiang.
"Do you blame others for falling into someone else's trap due to your own stupidity?" Ouyang Qiang, having somewhat recovered, laughed coldly, a hint of delight flashing in his eyes.
Not mentioning Yuan Ming, Yun Luo Fairy was a Cultivator under Dongji Palace. Having taken the Pill King Secret Manual, she was unlikely to dare keep it and would likely surrender it for a reward.Helpusoutbyreadingon*.
The only concern was not knowing where Yun Luo Fairy was hiding at the moment. It was crucial she not fall into Bai Yuan and Mao Yi's hands, handing them their spoils.
"Palace Master, both Yuan Ming and Yun Luo Fairy seem disloyal. During the struggle earlier, they completely disregarded our existence. My right hand was severed by Yun Luo Fairy's sword." Huangfu Jue, observing Ouyang Qiang's expression, hurriedly remarked.
Ouyang Qiang's smile instantly froze upon hearing this.
"It seems those two youngsters outsmarted all of us." Bai Yuan laughed heartily, very pleased.
"Well done! I've long thought Yuan Ming was no ordinary person; he's even more capable than I expected." Mao Yi too clapped and laughed.
Ouyang Qiang's expression turned as cold as water, ignoring them.
"Let's not mock. We fought with our lives to kill Emperor Yan's corpse, yet the spoils were seized by two Returning Void juniors. If we don't reclaim it, where will our dignity as Dharma manifestation Cultivators be? Let's capture those two first before discussing anything else," Zhu Yu stepped forward and said.
"Whoever catches them gets to keep the items!" Mao Yi declared, leading the black Long Gui into the labyrinth.
Upon hearing this, Zhu Yu and others also split into three groups to pursue.
Elsewhere, Yuan Ming had already returned to the depths of the labyrinth, not daring to pause, pressing forward with all his might.
However, he had guidance from Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter when coming to the Inheritance Hall. Now, without this guide, he was somewhat lost.
"I must stay calm, recall the outlines of the labyrinth paths. If I panic, I'll be completely lost," Yuan Ming thought to himself as he took a deep breath.
He quickly calmed down, recalling the route he took earlier in his mind, and moved again, speeding through the labyrinth.
Moments later, Yuan Ming finally returned to the dead-end wall that blocked him initially.
Seeing the marks he left still on the wall, he was delighted. With the route on the wall, he'd be able to exit the labyrinth in one go.
Yuan Ming carefully memorized his drawn map, erased the marks on the wall, and turned to make his escape.
But just at this moment, the Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter in the Storage Ring began to stir unexpectedly.
Yuan Ming was puzzled in his heart and quickly took it out.
He saw the Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter, which was black and looked like a fire burning stick, its body slightly hot, with red lines flickering continuously on its surface, the head of the staff constantly vibrating, pointing in a direction.
"Not pointing toward the Inheritance Hall?" Yuan Ming showed a look of surprise.
After a brief contemplation, he still decided to follow the direction indicated by the Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter and hurriedly rushed over.
Yuan Ming actually wasn't sure how to leave Emperor Yan's Mausoleum, so he decided to simply follow the actions directed by the Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter. This scepter was the Lifebound Magical Treasure of Elder Emperor Yan, who must have had a purpose.
If worst came to worst, he planned to transform into a stone to hide for a while. The Emperor Yan's Mausoleum was so vast, Mao Yi and the others would not easily catch him.
Soon, under the guidance of the Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter, he zig-zagged through the labyrinth and arrived at another dead end.
Seeing the red wall at the end, Yuan Ming couldn't help but be stunned.
However, at this moment, he suddenly noticed that this dead end was different from the ones he had walked before.
Under the red wall at the end of the road, there was an unexpectedly slightly elevated circular stone platform.
Yuan Ming walked over quickly and saw that it wasn't a stone platform, but merely a wellhead slightly elevated from the ground.
He stood by it and looked inside the well, seeing only darkness, nothing visible, appearing with an unfathomable sense of mystery.
He released his Divine Sense into the well, but the prohibitions within the labyrinth greatly restricted it, and his Divine Thought couldn't reach the bottom.
"Something strange..." Yuan Ming mused silently.
The Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter wouldn't bring him to a well for no reason, there must be something extraordinary here.
Yuan Ming thought to himself, raised his hand, and summoned Hua Zhi, instructing, "Hua Zhi, control a clone and throw it into this well to investigate for me."
Hua Zhi glanced ahead, without the slightest hesitation, her body sprouted purple-black vines, which quickly formed a clone, controlling it to soar and jump into the well.
The clone's figure soon fell into the darkness of the well, disappearing from sight.
But after waiting for a long time, it remained as calm as before, without any change, without even hearing the sound of the clone falling into water or hitting the bottom of the well.
"How is it?" Yuan Ming asked urgently.
"The connection is still there, apparently not dangerous, but it seems to be blocked by something, the connection between the clone and me has become very weak." Hua Zhi closed her eyes to sense and then said.
Hearing this, Yuan Ming's eyes still flickered with some hesitation.
"Master, why don't I help you scout the way?" Hua Zhi looked at him and suggested.
"No need, my physique is stronger than yours, if anyone should go, it should be me." Yuan Ming waved his hand, saying.
With that, despite Hua Zhi's objections, he put her away.
Then, Yuan Ming operated the Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill, wielding the Exterminating Immortal Sword, and leapt into the deep well.
His figure was engulfed in darkness, and his form suddenly flickered, disappearing from sight.
Yuan Ming's vision first went dark, then suddenly brightened.
When he could see his surroundings clearly, his eyes couldn't help but flash slightly with surprise.
At this moment, he found himself in a hidden Stone Chamber, brightly lit, with two black "fire burning sticks" floating not far in front of him, unexpectedly the two Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepters that Ouyang Qiang and Mao Yi had used to open the Emperor Yan's Mausoleum previously.
When they had cracked the prohibition of the Emperor Yan's Mausoleum, due to Bai Yuan and Zhu Yu's interference, a mishap occurred, and everyone was transported into the mausoleum, resulting in the loss of those two Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepters, unexpectedly they were here.
Before he could understand it, tiny spots of Golden Light suddenly appeared in the void in front of him, rapidly converging in the center, soon forming a cluster of golden flames, floating silently.
Yuan Ming held his sword defensively, his eyes fixed on the golden flames, but within it, he found a slightly familiar aura.
"Senior Emperor Yan..." he tentatively asked.
