The golden flames slightly twitched, and within came a sigh of helplessness from Elder Emperor Yan:
"I have spent countless thoughts constructing this Emperor Yan's Mausoleum, intending to find someone of outstanding talent in the Alchemy Dao to inherit the legacy of my Pill King Pavilion, but it seems that fate had other plans. This wish is ultimately difficult to fulfill, and the lineage of the Pill King Pavilion is about to end today. Shame, shame."
Yuan Ming didn't know how to console him and remained silent.
"Even though fate is unkind, I do not wish to give up. Yuan Ming, you have already obtained most of my legacy, and now have been guided here by the Ruyi Main Scepter, this shows fate's intervention. Although you lack much talent in the Alchemy Dao, all that remains of the Pill King Pavilion can only be entrusted to you." Elder Emperor Yan's voice carried exhaustion and regret, lacking the initial majesty and obsession.

chapters.title: Chapter 829 - 800: Gaining the Inheritance and Bearing the Karma
chapters.content:
"Thank you, senior, for your generous gift. I, the junior, will certainly not let you down, and will diligently research so as not to let the Pill King Secret Manual and its Bright Pearl lose its luster," Yuan Ming said with great joy.
"With your talent, you should comprehend as much of the Pill King Secret Manual as you can. However, if you meet someone with exceptional aptitude in alchemy in the future, you must pass on the manual completely, lest the inheritance of our sect be severed," Emperor Yan said calmly, clearly unconvinced about Yuan Ming's talent.
Yuan Ming didn't mind this, suddenly remembering something, and he looked at the Fire Burning Stick in his hand, surprised, "Did you just say that the stick I hold is the main stick? Are the three Flame Yellow Ruyi Scepters of varying ranks?"
"Correct, the three Ruyi Scepters are composed of one main and two subordinate sticks. Only when they are all merged together do they form the true Flame Yellow Ruyi Scepter. This scepter is also an important inheritance of our sect; let me assist you in completing it," Emperor Yan's voice came through the fluttering Golden Flames.
As he spoke, the short stick in Yuan Ming's hand suddenly flew out of his grip and hovered between the two other Fire Burning Sticks.
Three beams of Golden Light shot out from within the Golden Flames, merging into the three sticks.
A profound and incomparable fiery pattern emerged simultaneously on the three short sticks, creating a subtle connection and mutual attraction, drawing them closer together.
"Bang" came a sound.
The three short sticks collided, tightly adhering to one another, and the fire-pattern on their surface began to shine brightly and increasingly intensely.
Subsequently, the three short sticks emitted dazzling scarlet light and produced a continuous "clank clank" sound of metal friction, with numerous sparks scattering around them.
After a few moments of effort, the dazzling light gradually dimmed until it completely disappeared.
The three short sticks mid-air had already merged into one, with not much difference in length compared to before; only two bamboo-joint-like marks appeared on the stick.
Moreover, the previously black stick now had crimson Spiritual Patterns etched into its surface, making it look rather upscale, no longer resembling a mere Fire Burning Stick at a glance.
"Refine it," Emperor Yan's voice sounded, and the newly formed Flame Yellow Ruyi Scepter floated over.
Yuan Ming silently nodded, raising his hand to grasp the scepter, allowing his Mana to circulate, streaming into the short stick.
He silently recited the refining mnemonic in his heart, beginning to attempt refining this treasure.
Contrary to his expectations of the item's exceptional nature making it difficult to refine, the process proved far smoother and easier than anticipated, completing in less than half a moment.
Thirty-five runes were contained within the Flame Yellow Ruyi Scepter, surpassing any Spiritual Treasure he possessed.
All these runes were fire attribute or related to fire attributes, serving a single function: controlling flames.
In terms of practical functionality, this scepter is not intended for combat but as a Magic Treasure that assists in Artifact Refining or Alchemy.
Simply by wielding this scepter, through the activation of Mana, one can freely adjust the intensity and size of flames, even controlling rare Earth Fires, however rebellious and difficult to tame, all subjected to the scepter's command.
In battle, this Flame Yellow Ruyi Scepter is of little use, but for any Alchemist or Artifact Refiner, it is undoubtedly a rare Divine Artifact.
Owning this item outmatches others significantly in the realm of fire control.
"Looking at it this way, the Fire Burning Stick label suits it well, perhaps with the added function of a Blowing Fire Tube," Yuan Ming thought amusingly while holding the Flame Yellow Ruyi Scepter.
Becoming the owner of this item filled his heart with immense joy, especially with half of the "Pill King Secret Manual" in his possession, making future attempts at practicing alchemy far easier.
Just then, the Flame Yellow Ruyi Scepter suddenly shuddered, with the crimson runes on the shaft lighting up, spewing out a crimson spirit light, projecting in all directions.
The Stone Chamber abruptly vibrated, and the walls around the room resonated with trembling, deep rune array maps engraved into the walls lighting up.
Soon, a ring-shaped Great Array gradually rose from the ground, emitting continuous "buzzing" tremors.
"Do not be alarmed; this is the Teleportation Array to the outside world. You need only to activate the Ruyi Scepter, and you can operate the Array to teleport and leave here," Emperor Yan's voice echoed from the slight quivering golden flames.
"Thank you, senior," Yuan Ming said excitedly, expressing gratitude with clasped hands.
After finishing his thanks, he intended to activate the Array to immediately depart from this place of trouble.
"I've spent my entire life unable to revive Pill King Pavilion, and with your mediocre alchemy aptitude, the hope of reviving our sect is scant; however, I have a favor to ask. I hope you can agree," Emperor Yan spoke once more.
"Please speak, senior; as long as it is within my capabilities, I will not refuse," Yuan Ming stopped casting and said.
"The Pill King Pavilion was destroyed by the Three Realms Sect, this enmity is irreconcilable. Although your alchemy is lacking, your prowess in combat is remarkable, and your Spirit Root's aptitude is also extraordinary, showing hope of achieving great things. Given time, if you can reach the Mahayana Realm, I implore you to annihilate the Three Realms Sect to avenge the destruction of the Pill King Pavilion for me!" Emperor Yan spoke gravely, his voice low yet filled with a deadly aura.
"Mahayana Realm... this, I as a junior don't even know if I can break through the Dharma manifestation Stage, let alone Mahayana," Yuan Ming hesitated.
Help us out by reading on *.
"I also know this task is excessively challenging, however, the legacy of the Pill King Pavilion is already soaked in blood. I do not demand you to definitely accomplish this, only that you do not forget this hatred... If you, if you cannot accomplish it, then continue to carry it with this legacy until someone appears who can destroy the Three Realms Sect..." The golden flames trembled slightly, and the voice within also trembled, seemingly about to exhaust its power.
"Rest assured, Senior Yan Emperor, since I have received the legacy of the Pill King Pavilion, I should inherit this karma. As Senior said, I may not be able to accomplish it, but I will certainly try my best, and if it does not work out, I will definitely pass on this hatred," Yuan Ming pondered for a moment and solemnly said.
"So... very well," Emperor Yan's voice came through, sounding both regretful and relieved.
But as the voice fell, the cluster of golden flames slowly dissipated, turning into tiny sparks and vanishing into the world.
Yuan Ming felt a bit heavy-hearted, quickly shook his head, and imbued a strand of Mana into the Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter in his hand.
The next instant, a crimson light shot out from the Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter, striking the Teleportation Array on the ground, which immediately began to hum with the sound of the array operating.
A crimson light rose from the ground, the Teleportation Array hummed and was about to initiate transportation.
But just then, a strange noise suddenly came from outside the Stone Chamber. While Yuan Ming was startled, a black shadow suddenly swooped in from outside, heading straight toward him, rushing into the array.
Yuan Ming was taken aback, but before he could respond, the light from the Great Array had already obscured his vision, and his figure instantly disappeared from where he stood.
His vision blurred, and when it cleared, he found himself outside Flame Island.
Yuan Ming's body dropped, and he quickly exerted his Mana to stabilize himself, then looked around and saw another figure also falling out of the void not far away.
"It's you!" His eyes narrowed slightly, and he recognized the person across as the hunchbacked man from the Black Evil Sect.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, long time no see. To think it ended up being you who obtained the inheritance of Pill King Pavilion, truly unexpected by everyone," the hunchbacked man revealed himself, and instantly balanced himself, laughed heartily.
"Have you been following me all this time?" Yuan Ming asked, frowning.
"Not exactly, but I happened to run into you within that labyrinth, and just tailed you for a short distance," the hunchbacked man said with a smile.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming furrowed his brow.
Earlier in the labyrinth, he had been on guard against those Dharma manifestation cultivators pursuing him, yet he had not detected this person's presence!
"You certainly have good means, we have met multiple times, yet I still do not know your name, could you share it with me?" Yuan Ming asked.
"My name is Jiang Liu," the hunchbacked man replied.
"So, it's Fellow Daoist Jiang Liu, what's your purpose here?" Yuan Ming asked.
"Naturally, it's for the heritage of the Pill King Pavilion. In light of our acquaintance, Fellow Daoist Yuan, if you hand over the Complete Heaven Exquisite Tripod and half of the Pill King Secret Manual, I will not make things difficult for you," Jiang Liu said, extending his hand.
"Fellow Daoist Jiang, that's quite the audacity. You're here all alone; compared to the Pill King Pavilion's legacy, I suggest you cherish your life more," Yuan Ming said, as azure light flashed at his fingertips, the Exterminating Immortal Sword appeared, its sword light flickering endlessly.
"Hehe, those who wished to take the life of Jiang Liu have long had grass growing above their graves," Jiang Liu shook his head and laughed, as if Yuan Ming mentioned a ridiculous topic.
"Fellow Daoist Jiang, like me, possesses merely a Returning to Void cultivation, you speak with such confidence, could it be you have some other special identity, not an ordinary Black Evil Sect cultivator?" Yuan Ming was stunned, looking Jiang Liu up and down, speculating aloud.
"Enough with the small talk, in the Undersea Prison earlier, I already found Fellow Daoist Yuan's Divine Skills extraordinary. It's a pity I had matters to attend to back then and couldn't spar, but today as we cross paths, let me witness your true capabilities," Jiang Liu's smile stiffened, sneering with sharp eyes.
Immediately, his body shuddered violently, demonic power surged throughout his body, and his aura suddenly soared, rapidly reaching the peak of the Returning to Void Stage within an instant.
Circles of Protective Body halos emanated from him, shielding against potential dangers.
Yuan Ming's gaze deepened, he patted the Spiritual Beast Bag on his waist and summoned Lei Yu, landing on its back.
Lei Yu had not completely refined the Level 5 Demon Core yet, but its demonic power had already increased significantly, with its wings spread wide, bright electric sparks flickered over its body.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan planning to use a spirit beast in battle? No matter..." Jiang Liu said, his expression suddenly stiffened.
Because Yuan Ming, without uttering a single word of nonsense, rode Lei Yu and transformed into a streak of lightning, speeding far away, in the blink of an eye, he had already fled hundreds of miles.

chapters.title: Chapter 830 - 801 Forced to Engage in Battle (Happy New Year, Fellow Daoists)
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming urged his thoughts, using the Golden Sunflower Beast Taming Technique within him to channel mana into Lei Yu, increasing its tunneling speed.
Mao Yi and the others could come out of Emperor Yan's Tomb at any moment. Unless he had lost his mind, he wouldn't engage Jiang Liu here.
However, before Lei Yu could continue to flap its wings and speed forward, a black lightning bolt suddenly appeared overhead, instantly exploding with a thunderclap.
Yuan Ming's heart skipped, and without any hesitation, he lifted his palm and struck upward.
In the next instant, a thick black lightning bolt descended from the sky, colliding with the Green Light Palm Seal cast by Yuan Ming.
Amidst the rumbling explosion, the Green Light Palm Seal disintegrated instantly.
The black lightning dissipated halfway, but the remaining electrical light continued to relentlessly strike at Yuan Ming and Lei Yu.
At the moment Yuan Ming raised his palm to block, Lei Yu had already activated the Thunder Escape Divine Ability once more, its form transforming into an electric light, taking Yuan Ming several kilometers away.
However, as soon as they reappeared, another bolt of lightning struck down.
Yuan Ming hurriedly responded in haste, and Lei Yu escaped again.
Yet, the subsequent escapes all ended the same way; the black lightning clung to them like a maggot on the bone, persistently locking on, making escape impossible.
Upon reappearing once more, Yuan Ming already held the Exterminating Immortal Sword tightly and swung it forward without looking.
The sharp Sword Qi split a bolt of lightning, the Sword Qi suddenly exploded, shattering the black lightning into pieces.
Yuan Ming stood on Lei Yu's back, gazing into the distance.
In the void directly ahead, a figure hung in the air—it was Jiang Liu. He spoke calmly, "The promised duel has yet to begin; Fellow Daoist Yuan cannot leave."
"Sorry, Master, his escape technique is more advanced than mine..." Lei Yu said apologetically.
"He is a Demon Cultivator of Peak Returning Void; his escape technique not only contains thunder attribute divine skills but also carries a hint of space divine power's True Intent. It's not surprising you can't outrun him. You should return to the Spiritual Beast Bag; you won't be able to help in the upcoming battle."
After speaking, Yuan Ming waved a hand, and Lei Yu was collected into the Spiritual Beast Bag. He then raised his sword towards Jiang Liu.
"That's more like it; allow me to show my humble skills." Upon seeing this, Jiang Liu smiled.
But before he finished his sentence, his entire body was already wrapped in an electric light, and with a "swish," he disappeared from his original spot.
In the next moment, a figure suddenly appeared before Yuan Ming, with fingers like a blade sweeping across towards Yuan Ming's neck.
On his hand blade, arcs of electricity leapt, converging into a black Light Sword, slashing towards him.
This hand blade strike had no flourish, its sole feature was speed—many times faster than Lei Yu's Thunder Strike.
Yuan Ming's pupils contracted sharply; he didn't have time to defend and could only instinctively lean back.
Immediately, his Protective Treasure Light was torn apart by the black Light Sword, a searing pain flared at his neck, followed by a numbing sensation that surged through his body, disrupting the operation of his mana within.
Yuan Ming let out a low shout, and the Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill began to operate by itself. The powerful Blood Qi instantly activated, halting the black lightning's erosion, allowing him to regain control of his body in an instant.
He thrust the Exterminating Immortal Sword forward, dozens of Sword Qis shot out in eager succession, like a river of swords rolling towards Jiang Liu, but they struck nothing but air.
Jiang Liu's figure had already retreated smoothly at the instant of the sword's strike.
Yuan Ming, holding the sword in one hand, touched his throat with the other, finding a distinct charred, burn mark there, causing his furrowed brows to crease even further.
A hundred meters away, Jiang Liu watched intently, a smile on his lips as he said, "For a body cultivator, Fellow Daoist Yuan's speed is decent, but unfortunately, for me, it's still too slow, eh."
Yuan Ming paid no attention to his words, quietly releasing Divine Soul Power, and focused entirely on Jiang Liu.
The latter's eyes focused, and his body was suddenly entwined with lightning, his form abruptly disappearing.
Without any hesitation, Yuan Ming simultaneously released twelve soul crows, intending to form a Crow Formation and unleash a Crow Cry. However, several black electric lights lit up among the soul crows, scattering them apart before the formation could complete.
Yuan Ming felt his Divine Soul suffer a heavy blow, a sharp pain stabbing through his mind.
With immense willpower, he endured it and immediately urged the soul crows to launch the Crow Cry. Even if he couldn't form a formation, he aimed to suppress Jiang Liu with soul power.
Yet, by the time the black sound waves of the Crow Cry rose, the figure that had made the sudden attack had already retreated far beyond the Crow Cry's range.
"Heh, the methods of a Soul Cultivator are useless against me. Whatever tricks you have, feel free to use them!" Jiang Liu laughed.
Yuan Ming retracted the soul crows, his face extremely grave, quickly contemplating countermeasures.
This Jiang Liu's Thunder Escape Divine Ability was truly too fast, far surpassing Lei Yu. In terms of speed, he was the fastest person Yuan Ming had ever encountered; now he couldn't escape, nor could he land a hit, and even his proudest soul attacks couldn't touch the opponent—he was somewhat on the defensive.
The longer he delayed here, the greater the chances others would catch up, making escape even more impossible.
"Is this all you've got? In that case, it's my turn." Jiang Liu said with a smile.
As soon as he finished speaking, a flash of golden light appeared in his palm, revealing a golden gourd small hammer. The hammerhead was only slightly larger than an ordinary person's fist, and the hammer handle was as thick as a thumb, but the length of a forearm.
Yuan Ming sensed the astonishing spiritual power fluctuations on the small hammer and immediately raised his hand to wave.
A white and a red light flashed, and the Shura Blood Devouring Map and the Ghostly Soul White Bone Banner unfolded behind him. Countless skulls surged out from the Shura Blood Devouring Map, filling the area for dozens of miles around, leaving no space to stand.This text was acquired from *.
These skeletons had been collected by Yuan Ming over the years with the Ghostly Soul White Bone Banner, gathered from the seabed, and stored within the Shura Blood Devouring Map.
Yuan Ming pinched a spell and activated the Ghostly Soul White Bone Banner, causing the spirit light on the banner to flicker as all the skeletons charged toward Jiang Liu.
"Trying to capture me with sheer numbers? Ridiculous!" Jiang Liu chuckled, a black electric light spiraling up from his body.
Jiang Liu's figure disappeared in an instant and reappeared just a few yards in front of Yuan Ming.
Black thunderbolts shot out from his body, tearing apart the skeletons within dozens of yards and clearing out a large space.
The golden gourd small hammer in Jiang Liu's hand shot forward, aimed to smash down on Yuan Ming's head.
Yet, as the hammer fell, there were already over a dozen skeletons standing in front of Yuan Ming, with more skeletons rushing in from other directions.
He wasn't matching Jiang Liu's speed; instead, he summoned nearby skeletons to protect himself at the moment Jiang Liu launched his attack, using a saturation defense to counter Jiang Liu's sudden assault.
With a "boom," there was a loud explosion.
The golden gourd small hammer burst out with dazzling golden light, pulverizing over a dozen blood slaves beneath itself to powder. The descending speed of the golden hammer did not diminish in the slightest, and the numerous nearby skeletons were rendered useless, failing to exert any effect.
A flash of yellow light glimmered above Yuan Ming's head, and Houtu Peak emerged, casting down tens of thousands of yellow lights, forming a yellow spherical light screen that enveloped him protectively.
The golden gourd small hammer struck Houtu Peak, producing a clanging sound.
Houtu Peak was slightly indented, and the yellow light screen trembled violently but did not break.
Jiang Liu showed a look of surprise, then pinched a spell, and the shape of the golden gourd small hammer changed, becoming sharp.
At this moment, the countless skeletons around suddenly exploded, turning into a sky full of bone powder, like gray-white dense smoke, covering the area for dozens of miles.
Jiang Liu was also engulfed by the bone powder smoke, his body suddenly felt heavy, as if trapped in a bog, with his every move greatly restricted, causing him great astonishment.
Not far away, Yuan Ming pressed one hand on the Ghostly Soul White Bone Banner, injecting waves of mana into it.
The bone powder around Jiang Liu surged, rapidly rotating around his body, forming a giant gray-white vortex.
Now that Yuan Ming's cultivation had reached the mid-stage of Returning Void, he could finally fully wield the power of the Ghostly Soul White Bone Banner, this spiritual treasure.
He performed a spell, and a blood-red light pillar shot out from the Shura Blood Devouring Map, joining the vortex.
Both spiritual treasures displayed their might simultaneously, disrupting the nature's spiritual energy over a hundred miles.
The restrictions on Jiang Liu became even greater; his expression turned serious, his body shimmering with Lei Guang, attempting to perform Thunder Escape to get away.
However, the gray-white vortex intensely disturbed the nature's spiritual energy, and any escape technique required utilizing nearby spiritual energy to be executed. Twice he tried to escape but failed, forced to fly outward using ordinary tunneling light instead.
Yuan Ming had gone through great lengths to lure Jiang Liu into his trap; he would not let him escape. He immediately activated the Soul Destroying Sword's curse, annihilation, and frenzy runes.
Jiang Liu's vision went black, his Six Senses were completely severed, and the flow of blood, mana, and soul power within him became chaotic. His internal organs churned violently, making him feel nauseated and wanting to vomit.
Yuan Ming gave Jiang Liu no chance to retaliate, raising his hand to pat the Ghostly Soul White Bone Banner, activating the Bone Control Divine Ability.
The bones within Jiang Liu's body suddenly trembled uncontrollably, shaking as if separating and trying to escape his flesh, making his entire body's mana quiver along with them.
Yuan Ming did not give him the slightest chance to resist. A flash of green light appeared in his hand, revealing the Exterminating Immortal Sword. The sword shot forth waves of violent Sword Qi, wielding the power of the Sword Trace Abyss within the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space.
A flash of ruthlessness glinted in his eyes, and he softly uttered the word "Go."
The Exterminating Immortal Sword thundered, releasing a violent Sword Qi that spanned across the heavens, as if piercing a hole in the sky, aiming straight at Jiang Liu.
Jiang Liu's expression finally changed, performing a spell with one hand to invoke something.
A black shadow shot out from his body, wrapping around him like a cloak.
The violent Sword Qi shot through, engulfing everything, and Jiang Liu's figure vanished, seemingly torn apart by the Sword Qi and reduced to nothingness.
However, Yuan Ming's face showed no sign of joy; instead, he looked up into the distance in midair.
A black shadow emerged in the void dozens of miles away, from which Jiang Liu stepped out, his clothing unscathed, clearly having completely avoided the Exterminating Immortal Sword Qi's attack.
Jiang Liu gazed at Yuan Ming, and the mocking intent in his eyes was completely gone.
Only at this moment did he realize that the guy below was no simple opponent; with endless methods at his disposal, if he wasn't careful, he would be the one to suffer greatly.

chapters.title: Chapter 831 - 802 Black Mist
chapters.content:
In Jiang Liu's eyes, a ghostly light flickered, and a crackling sound arose from his body as two black wings woven from lightning unfurled, transforming his entire demeanor in an instant.
"That black shadow just now was a space divine power..." Yuan Ming watched Jiang Liu from a distance, his expression becoming increasingly solemn.
He had just unleashed almost all of his hidden divine skills, yet he still couldn't achieve his goal, not even managing to harm the opponent.
As thoughts swirled in Yuan Ming's mind, he raised his hand and waved, putting away the Shura Blood Devouring Map and the Ghostly Soul White Bone Banner. These divine skills that relied on quantity and range of attack were useless against this guy, and keeping them out would only waste his mana.
Immediately afterward, he suddenly spread his arms, and his body rapidly expanded, in the blink of an eye transforming into an Undying Tree over a dozen meters tall.
"Oh, are you from the Demon Clan?" Jiang Liu was taken aback at the sight, his eyes revealing a trace of amazement.
Yuan Ming didn't respond; all the roots of the Undying Tree plunged into the void and disappeared.
Seeing this, Jiang Liu refrained from asking further questions. With a sudden flap of his wings, his form transformed into a black flash of lightning heading straight for Yuan Ming, the lightning containing spatial fluctuations and moving a few degrees faster than before.
However, at this moment, several black tree roots suddenly emerged from the void in front of him, thrusting toward him.
"Space divine power!" Jiang Liu raised an eyebrow but did not panic; with a flicker of his form, he dodged aside.
Yet, in the void behind him, the same thing happened as several black tree roots emerged, like a dozen sharp swords lunging toward his back.
It was as if Jiang Liu had eyes on his back; once again, his body turned into a flash of black lightning that swept sideways, dodging the rear tree root attack.
"Not even hitting once. I only need one successful strike to use the Shared Life Divine Power." Yuan Ming thought to himself, striving to urge the Undying Tree roots to attack.
In Jiang Liu's eyes, excitement flickered. Ignoring the relentless attacks of the black roots, his body swirled in electric light, diving rapidly straight toward Yuan Ming.
However, the closer he got to Yuan Ming, the more and faster the roots emerged from the void. Several times Jiang Liu almost got hit by the roots and thus dared not get too close.
Yuan Ming was equally frustrated, having exerted all his efforts in propelling the void-piercing capability of the Undying Tree roots. While visibly troublesome for Jiang Liu, the latter consistently managed to evade at the last moment; up to now, Yuan Ming hadn't hit him once.
For a while, neither could gain the upper hand over the other, causing a stalemate in the confrontation.
"Master, your mana is running low. This will go on forever if you let it—let me handle it!" Hua Zhi's voice echoed in Yuan Ming's Sea of Consciousness.
"With your attack speed, I'm afraid you won't even touch Jiang Liu's shadow." Yuan Ming replied through voice transmission.
"I have a plan..." Hua Zhi quickly explained.
Hearing this, Yuan Ming's eyes revealed a trace of surprise, then a Black Mist appeared on the body of the Undying Tree, blocking off the investigation by Divine Sense.
Jiang Liu, seeing this scene, turned stern once again, after evading another thrust from the Undying Tree roots, his body made a sharp turn, distancing himself slightly from the tree body, and raised his hand, striking fiercely towards the tree.
A black lightning shot straight from his palm aimed at the trunk of the Undying Tree.
As it was about to hit, Houtu Peak reappeared, its body emanating a thick Yellow Cloud that blocked the black lightning's attack.
"Hmph, that Magic Treasure again!" Jiang Liu's gaze darkened as he considered how to dismantle Houtu Peak.
Right at that moment, the void behind him fluctuated again, and several black tree roots emerged to strike his body.
These roots were much thicker than before, yet not particularly fast.
Jiang Liu's mana was mostly depleted, and without using an Escape Technique, he dodged to the side.
However, a human figure suddenly emerged atop these black roots—none other than Hua Zhi.
With a reach of her hand, she transformed it into countless green wooden pikes shooting swiftly at Jiang Liu.
Jiang Liu casually waved his hand, sweeping a robust bolt of lightning through, shattering all the wooden pikes into powder, turning into a cloud of black dust drifting in the air.
Jiang Liu, perplexed over dealing with Yuan Ming, lit up at the sight of Hua Zhi appearing, his body flashing with Lei Guang before disappearing.
When he reappeared, he was behind Hua Zhi, with his Golden Gourd Small Hammer glowing brightly as it swung down towards her.
Before the hammer could land on her, Hua Zhi felt the void in front of her vibrating, with an invisible pressure locking her in place, preventing her escape.
In haste, she crossed her arms in front of her, vines intertwining to form a thick green shield.
Quicker still were Yuan Ming's Undying Tree roots, which swiftly formed into a spherical vine cage encasing her.
The Golden Gourd Small Hammer slammed onto the vine cage, instantly detonating a blaze of Golden Light.
The vine cage and green shield lasted only a few moments before they crumbled in the Golden Light, dissipating into countless fragments.
The Golden Gourd Small Hammer continued relentlessly, smashing towards Hua Zhi.
Just as it was about to hit the shield formed by Hua Zhi's arm, Jiang Liu's body suddenly stiffened, and a large amount of pink mist emanated from him, with dazzling red flowers sprouting from all over his body.
He suddenly felt his breath choke, as if his entire body was being bitten by countless insects and ants, enduring unbearable pain.
Hua Zhi was overjoyed to see that the spores planted by the spore avatar had finally succeeded in parasitizing. Her hand suddenly thrust forward, transforming into a long wooden fork, piercing towards Jiang Liu's eyes.
Yuan Ming also seized this opportunity, as strands of Undying Tree Roots reached out from the Void, thrusting straight towards Jiang Liu.
The latter saw the crisis approaching and the power of thunder and lightning within his body suddenly exploded.
He raised his head to the sky, letting out a thunderous roar, as black electric arcs erupted from his eyes, ears, mouth, and nose, countless arcs swirling around his body.
These bolts were astoundingly violent, instantly pulverizing all the spore plants parasitizing him.
The wooden fork from Hua Zhi and the Undying Tree Roots were also instantly torn to shreds.
Seeing the expanding electric arcs around him, Yuan Ming immediately abandoned the attack, pulled back the vines, and brought Hua Zhi away.
The next moment, a colossal lightning bolt spanning a hundred yards erupted, black electric arcs spreading out, engulfing and pulverizing all the approaching vines.
Fortunately, Yuan Ming had retracted his power just in time, saving Hua Zhi from suffering great loss.
Once the electric arcs subsided, Jiang Liu's figure emerged once more.
His face was now slightly pale, neck stiff, shoulders hunched, breathing heavily with restraint.
Clearly, the previous strike was not easy for him either, consuming much of his strength.
Just when he looked grim, planning to continue the attack, he suddenly seemed to sense something unusual, abruptly turning his head and gazing into the distance.
At the junction of the Heavenly Sea, a seemingly boundless black line suddenly appeared, rapidly spreading towards him.Nоtе: Chесk М_VLЕМРY_R fоr аny соrrесtiоns.
"This is... not good!" Jiang Liu's expression changed abruptly, quickly retracting his magic, not caring about battling Yuan Ming, turning to flee.
Yuan Ming, seeing Jiang Liu so fearful, dared not linger either, hurriedly making a spell, flying away.
However, his escape speed was far inferior to Jiang Liu's, and in less than 15 minutes, Jiang Liu's silhouette vanished ahead.
At the same time, the "black line" behind him also caught up, revealing its true form to Yuan Ming.
What appeared to be a "black line" was actually a boundless black mist, thick and sticky, resembling a high wall dividing heaven and earth, pressing towards Yuan Ming with irresistible force.
The spreading speed of the black mist was extremely fast, even as Yuan Ming desperately flew escaped, the distance between him and the mist grew closer and eventually was completely overtaken.
And just as his body was touched by the black mist, it easily penetrated his Protective Light Ring, causing Yuan Ming to feel his limbs and torso uncontrollably swell, nature's spiritual energy uncontrollably poured into him, growing at a speed ten times that of usual cultivation.
As the overwhelmingly abundant spiritual energy surged in, Yuan Ming's mana and Qi Blood Power rapidly rose as though sprouting mushrooms after a rain, but simultaneously, each part of his body emitted a violent ripping sensation, as if he would be torn apart in the next moment.
Hua Zhi, next to Yuan Ming, exhibited the same symptoms, not only did her body enlarge rapidly, her demonic power grew swiftly, accompanied by considerable pain.
"This black mist can make the body swell, could it be the substance Mao Yi mentioned in the Abyss that can enlarge the demon beast's body?" A thought flashed through his mind.
In the agony of intense pain, Yuan Ming's consciousness began to blur, his mana subsequently lost control, making him incapable of maintaining his flying escape, crashing straight into the sea.
Nevertheless, even in the sea, the black mist persisted, Yuan Ming was unable to escape.
Yet, the icy cold seawater barely revived a bit of his clarity, taking advantage of this, Yuan Ming gathered a bit of strength, transforming his body into the Undying Tree form.
The Undying Tree form was more resilient and possessed strong regenerative abilities, perhaps capable of resisting the mysterious black energy.
However, contrary to his wishes, the resilient body of the Undying Tree could not prevent the invasion of the black mist, under its influence, Yuan Ming transformed into the Undying Tree grew persistently taller at a rate far exceeding his human form.
Whether it was due to turning flesh into wood, Yuan Ming's sense of pain dropped significantly, his mind also swiftly recovered.
At the same time, Hua Zhi too plunged into the seawater, but her condition seemed far more serious than Yuan Ming's, she now fell completely unconscious, losing all senses.
Yuan Ming saw this and hurriedly stored her into the Spiritual Beast Bag, attempting to shield her from the influence of the black mist.
But when he opened the Spiritual Beast Bag, he discovered the black mist had infiltrated the bag's space, Lei Yu, who had been staying inside the bag, also exhibited signs of gigantism, though it seemed slower than facing the black mist directly as Hua Zhi did.
Yuan Ming instantly realized that spatial isolation could slow down the symptoms of black mist corrosion, but with a low-level spatial artifact like the Spiritual Beast Bag, the effect was minimal, perhaps only high-level treasures could completely shield from the influence.

chapters.title: Chapter 832 - 803: Origin Power
chapters.content:
As soon as Yuan Ming thought of this, he immediately raised his hand to summon the Stealing Heaven Tripod and threw Hua Zhi and Lei Yu, along with the Spiritual Beast Bag, into it.
And as expected, once Hua Zhi and Lei Yu entered the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space, the black mist outside could not affect their bodies, only the small strands of black mist that had previously entered their bodies continued to wreak havoc.
As a result, the speed at which their bodies enlarged and their demonic power increased slowed significantly, though the speed of absorbing spiritual energy was still beyond normal, but had at least dropped to an acceptable range.
"The Stealing Heaven Tripod Space can indeed isolate the black mist!" Seeing that the method was effective, Yuan Ming immediately thought of entering the Stealing Heaven Tripod to save himself.
However, if he wanted to enter the Stealing Heaven Tripod in the flesh, he needed to focus on activating the Sky-reaching Demon Pillar to open the Tripod Space, something that was impossible in his current state.
Yuan Ming's mind raced, and he quickly came up with an idea.
He turned his hand to take out the Silver Token, barely urging the rapidly expanding Mana to activate it, opening a layer of silver barrier around his body.
With the appearance of the barrier, the rate of black mist erosion suddenly decreased, but compared to the absolute isolation of the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space, the silver barrier could only delay, not completely isolate the black mist.
Even so, this bought Yuan Ming precious time to save himself.
He immediately took out the Sky-reaching Demon Pillar, desperately suppressing the chaotic Mana within his body, and began to exert himself.
During this process, the Undying Tree he transformed into continued to rapidly expand under the influence of the black mist, its size increasing inch by inch, growing to several hundred feet tall in just 15 minutes, with its demonic power almost reaching the Upper Fifth Level, just shy of a breakthrough.
However, because of this, Yuan Ming's control over the power within his body diminished, delaying the opening of the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space, preventing him from entering.
More critically, due to the Undying Tree's massive size, the silver barrier Yuan Ming set up could no longer contain it. Just moments later, with a dull "boom," the Undying Tree pushed against the limits of the silver barrier, bursting it from within.
In an instant, the black mist outside flooded in all at once. Due to the previous obstruction by the silver barrier, their momentum was even fiercer now, almost instantly filling the several hundred feet tall Undying Tree, causing its size to soar again, simultaneously breaking through to the Upper Fifth Level.
The balance that Yuan Ming had painstakingly maintained was swiftly shattered, with his internal Mana and Qi Blood Power thrown into chaos by the ravaging black mist, leaving him with no control whatsoever.
The pain engulfing his body intensified abruptly, every inch of skin from head to toe showing blood streaks, as if about to explode and completely turn into a mist of blood.
"No, if this continues, it'll be disastrous!" Yuan Ming shouted in his heart, desperately trying to stabilize his body, yet feeling an uncontrollable tendency.
Just as disaster seemed imminent, the rapid influx of black mist seemed to have stirred something within Yuan Ming's Storage Ring, as a consuming force suddenly emerged, drawing the surrounding black mist towards it.
The black mist within Yuan Ming's body instantly thinned considerably, and the agitated Mana and Qi Blood Power within him gradually calmed, while the maddening pain eased swiftly.
Yuan Ming, once again afforded a respite, dared not delay and focused all his efforts on driving the Sky-reaching Demon Pillar, opening the barrier of the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space within moments.
He hurriedly dispelled the Undying Tree transformation, desperately slipping into the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space, with all the black mist completely isolated outside.
Yuan Ming collapsed to the ground, like a deflated ball, unwilling even to lift a hand.
Although the Stealing Heaven Tripod had isolated the invasion of the external black mist, a considerable amount of it still lingered within him, causing welts to bubble up on his skin, resembling a toad, which looked particularly eerie.
With his entry into the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space, the consuming force within the Storage Ring gradually dissipated, seemingly falling back into a slumber with no further reaction.Thе М|V|LЕ&МРYR tеаm wоrkеd hаrd оn this сhаptеr.
Yuan Ming mustered his spirit, beginning to deal with the black mist within his body.
First, he took everything out of the Storage Ring in one go, excluding those whose uses he already knew, aligning the remaining items in a row, then operated his Cultivation Technique, forcing the black mist to his chest, trying each one in succession.
Soon, when Yuan Ming tested the ash green tree bark he obtained from Black Mo Island, that consuming force suddenly surged from the bark, absorbing all the black mist from Yuan Ming's body without leaving a trace.
"It's this thing..." Yuan Ming's face revealed an unusual expression.
With the black mist entirely removed, his mutated physical body quickly shrank back to normal size, completely returning to its original appearance in moments.
Yuan Ming breathed a sigh of relief, then proceeded to check the Undying Tree within his Dantian, attempting to use the bark to absorb the black mist within, but soon discovered, to his surprise, that the black mist seemed to have thoroughly merged into the Undying Tree, disappearing without a trace.
Upon confirming that no black mist remained in his body, Yuan Ming also helped Hua Zhi and Lei Yu cleanse the black mist within them.
However, unlike Yuan Ming, while the black mist within them was removed, their sizes remained multiplied from before, not reverting to their original forms.
Hua Zhi remained in a coma, while the demonic power had broken through to the mid-level Level 5, and Lei Yu could be said to have turned misfortune into a blessing, directly advancing to Level 5.
Yuan Ming was both surprised and delighted by this, yet he couldn't help but worry if such an unconventional breakthrough could cause any harm to Lei Yu.
Just as he was about to conduct a detailed inspection of Lei Yu, in the next instant, Lei Yu suddenly opened his eyes and looked up at Yuan Ming.
Its eyes were completely blood-red, showing no sign of rationality, only an endless desire for slaughter.
Seeing Yuan Ming beside him, it showed no intention of closeness, instead spreading its wings and soaring into the air, claws sharp as hooks, diving directly at Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming furrowed his brow, immediately activating the Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill, raising his hand to block Lei Yu's claw attack which was like tearing gold and shattering iron, attempting to seize its claws to restrain it.
However, Lei Yu reacted extremely quickly, transforming into a bolt of thunder, easily evading Yuan Ming's grasp, flying into the air, blood-red eyes fixed on Yuan Ming, seemingly searching for an opportunity to attack.
Yuan Ming showed a look of surprise; Lei Yu's recent evasion vaguely gave him an illusion of facing Jiang Liu.
His brow furrowed, surprised in his heart, he once again performed a spell, transforming into an Undying Tree form.
Now his Undying Tree form had grown to a height of seven to eight hundred zhang, with a crown like clouds and a trunk resembling a wall, its enormous size was in no way inferior to the Undead Tree Demon on Three Immortals Island in the past.
"That Undead Tree Demon was only Level 5, yet so enormous, could it have also encountered the Black Mist within the Abyss?" This thought suddenly flashed through Yuan Ming's mind.
As Yuan Ming's form transformed, countless branches and roots spread out, the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space had expanded considerably when Yuan Ming broke through the Returning Void, yet it was still too small for the current Undying Tree.
The sprawling branches and roots instantly enveloped the entire Stealing Heaven Tripod Space, leaving Lei Yu with almost nowhere to hide in mid-air, captured by the Undying Tree within moments.
Yuan Ming used roots to bind Lei Yu's wings and claws, pulling it closer for a detailed inspection, and quickly discovered a strand of black energy on Lei Yu's Divine Soul within the Sea of Consciousness.
That black energy was continuously eroding Lei Yu's Divine Soul, although compared to this, the speed was not as rapid as the erosion of the body.
Realizing this, Yuan Ming hurriedly attached the Ash Green Tree Bark to Lei Yu's head, guiding it with his own Divine Sense, soon drawing out the black energy from Lei Yu's Sea of Consciousness to be devoured by the Ash Green Tree Bark.
As the black energy left the body, Lei Yu's blood-red eyes became clear, gradually regaining calmness.
Yuan Ming let out a slight sigh of relief and was about to say something when the Ash Green Tree Bark in his hand suddenly emitted a barely audible little sound that he keenly detected.
He quickly looked at the tree bark and was astonished to find that after swallowing the black energy, the surface of the Ash Green Tree Bark began to sprout, a tiny bud emerging.
An indescribable ancient aura instantly spread out, Yuan Ming felt a shock to his spirit, as if a drumbeat echoed in his ears, and scenes vaguely shifted before his eyes.
At first was a realm of chaos, followed by a sudden and dazzling sky light, from which emerged a towering giant tree.
The giant tree held up the sky, pressed down the earth, smoothing chaos, reshaping laws, creating a world of all phenomena, and nurturing all things.
Yuan Ming gazed in astonishment at the illusory scene before him, his consciousness completely immersed, as if personally arriving in the primordial ancient times, facing the spectacle of the creation of heaven and earth.
Meanwhile, the Undying Tree into which Yuan Ming had transformed was also affected by this aura, lowering its branches as though a vassal serving a king, bowing its head and raising the Ash Green Tree Bark high.
The Ash Green Tree Bark seemed to sense something, the ancient aura emanating from the wooden bud grew even more intense, the rough, uneven surface transforming at a visible rate into a burst of spirit light, which then merged into the Undying Tree with a "whoosh" sound.
The trunk of the Undying Tree trembled slightly, but showed no sign of resistance.
Yuan Ming, still engrossed in the vision of the world's creation, was momentarily unable to stop it, and only realized afterward that the Ash Green Tree Bark had already blended into the Undying Tree he had become.
Immediately, a palm-sized ash-green spot appeared on the pitch-black trunk of the Undying Tree, conspicuously visible.
Yuan Ming sensed it with his Divine Sense, discovering that within the spot, a new emerald green Origin Power was sprouting, flowing slowly like a swimming fish within the Ash Green Tree Spot.
That strand of Origin Power carried an intensely rich life force, seemingly possessing the power to promote growth, under its influence, the tree crown of the Undying Tree became lush, sprouting new branches and leaves, bursting with strong vitality and vigor.
Moreover, the Undying Tree contained gold, wood, water, fire, earth, yin, and yang Spiritual Power within its body, under the influence of this Origin Power, it had a tendency to fuse, all merging into this Origin Power, becoming a part of it.

chapters.title: Chapter 833 - 804 Transformation
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming silently observed the series of changes caused by this strand of Origin Power within the Undying Tree, feeling greatly astonished. He quickly recalled Hua Zhi mentioning the Power of Ten Thousand Wood Origin.
According to Hua Zhi, the World Tree was a Chaos Spiritual Root born at the dawn of creation, the Ancestor of Ten Thousand Trees, containing the Power of Ten Thousand Wood Origin. The Fusang Tree, as a close relative of the World Tree, naturally contained a trace of the Ten Thousand Wood Origin aura.
And now, after the fusion of the Ash Green Tree Bark with the Undying Tree, it surprisingly made the Undying Tree develop the Power of Ten Thousand Wood Origin.
"Could this bark be from the World Tree?" Yuan Ming recalled the various illusions he had just seen, his heart momentarily shocked.
"Hey, you kid, truly lucky, huh?" Just then, the voice of Stealing Heaven Tripod Artifact Spirit Kong suddenly rang out, clicking his tongue in wonder.
"Senior Kong, do you mean this piece of bark..." Yuan Ming hastily asked.
"Indeed, it's actually a piece of dead bark from the World Tree." Kong confirmed his guess.
"It's really the World Tree!" Yuan Ming's face lit up with joy.
"Hehe, you kid, truly lucky to have encountered the Heavenly Cicada Mother Qi; otherwise, holding this bark would just be a dead thing." Kong seen Yuan Ming's expression, instead comforted him.
"The Heavenly Cicada Mother Qi, are you referring to the Black Mist just now? Senior, can you explain in detail?" Yuan Ming keenly sensed the information hinted in its words.
"Alright, since I've mentioned so much, let me clear the doubts for you. The Heavenly Cicada Mother Qi is a unique Divine Skill innately possessed by the ancient fierce insect—the Six-winged Heavenly Cicada. It appears like Black Mist, capable of accelerating the growth of Six Paths Creatures and inducing the awakening and resurrection of hidden bloodlines." Kong slowly explained.
"Is there truly such a Divine Skill entirely beneficial to others in this world?" Yuan Ming was astonished.
"Oh, where do you get such a good thing? Do you realize, the Six-winged Heavenly Cicada is fond of eating, with an appetite like a bottomless pit, almost needing to eat every moment. The prey it devours daily is several hundred times its size. With such a demand, how do you think it seeks prey?" Kong asked.
"Senior means, the Heavenly Cicada Mother Qi is actually used to cultivate food?" Yuan Ming somewhat understood.
"Exactly so, in the Ancient Times, wherever Heavenly Cicada Mother Qi appeared, they were actually hunting grounds of the Six-winged Heavenly Cicada. Although outsiders saw these places teeming with Exotic Beasts, with terrifying sizes, in reality, they were just lambs waiting to be slaughtered, only waiting for the Six-winged Heavenly Cicada to decide to eat them." Kong spoke with a tone of sarcasm.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming immediately recalled the gigantic Exotic Beasts he saw in the Abyss, even the Dharma manifestation Great Power Mao Yi had to avoid them, but in the eyes of the Six-winged Heavenly Cicada, they were just tasty meals.
Such vast disparity inevitably stirred a sense of indescribable absurdity within Yuan Ming's heart.
"Is there truly such a fierce insect in the Abyss?" Yuan Ming murmured, thinking of many things.
"Isn't it self-evident? Otherwise, why do the demon beasts in the Abyss grow so large? Anyone knowledgeable about the Six-winged Heavenly Cicada would immediately understand the truth upon seeing the Abyss. But from my observation, that Heavenly Cicada Mother Qi was extremely thin; the Six-winged Heavenly Cicada at the bottom of the Abyss is either a larva or has a problem." Kong said.
Yuan Ming breathed a sigh of relief upon hearing this.
No matter which case, the probability of encountering the Six-winged Heavenly Cicada is low; merely encountering the Heavenly Cicada Mother Qi almost cost him his life, and he wouldn't want to face any Six-winged Heavenly Cicada again.
"With your current cultivation, it's best to keep this matter to yourself and not leak it to avoid trouble." Kong said, suddenly reminding him.
Yuan Ming nodded, sensing that Kong knew more than he let on, but seeing his unwillingness to speak further, Yuan Ming refrained from asking out of curiosity.
"But to speak again, the Abyss is vast, the release of Heavenly Cicada Mother Qi by the Six-winged Heavenly Cicada has no fixed interval; if unlucky, it may not happen for thousands of years. Your encounter is sheer luck." Kong couldn't help but sigh again.
"Senior's words are mistaken; if it weren't for the World Tree bark helping me absorb the Heavenly Cicada Mother Qi, I would have died outside just now. This can't be considered good luck." Yuan Ming shook his head, not feeling fortunate for encountering the Heavenly Cicada Mother Qi.
"I haven't finished speaking. Merely encountering Heavenly Cicada Mother Qi alone isn't good luck; obtaining the World Tree bark alone is the same. But the coincidence lies in encountering both simultaneously and possessing the Undying Tree; that's simply predestined." Kong said.
"What do you mean by this, Senior? The Undying Tree has fused with the World Tree bark, apart from gaining this strand of Origin Power, it seems not yielding much more benefits." Yuan Ming felt slightly regretful.
"That strand of Ten Thousand Wood Origin Power is the greatest benefit, which you cannot yet comprehend. The World Tree is the origin of ten thousand woods, the only one in the heavens and earth, destroyed in the Ancient Times. Throughout history, countless cultivators have exhausted efforts to revive the World Tree, all failed. Only you barely succeeded halfway." Kong spoke.
"Is that so..." Yuan Ming still didn't quite grasp it.
"The World Tree has long been utterly dead. Even encountering the Heavenly Cicada Mother Qi, it can't be revived, with a tiny chance of reawaken for a few breaths, then decay again. Coincidentally, your body contains the closest lineage to the World Tree—the Undying Tree. The two fused and, leveraging the Undying Tree's ability, stabilized that World Tree bark's vitality. Although feeble, it gained the possibility of being replanted anew. You tell me, are you not riding on the crest of good fortune?" Kong sighed once more.
Yuan Ming heard the words and nodded somewhat woodenly.
"Cultivate this World Tree fragment well; don't waste this heavenly opportunity. Given time, if you can truly resurrect it and grow it into a new World Tree, not only will achieving Mahayana be almost certain, but you might even have a chance to reach True Immortal!" In the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space, Kong saw Yuan Ming still bewildered and rolled his eyes in annoyance, saying.
"Is Senior speaking the truth?" Yuan Ming's body shook, and he hastily asked.
"If you don't believe me, wait until the day the World Tree truly revives, and you'll see whether what I said is true or false." Kong snorted, his voice falling silent once more.
From then on, no matter how Yuan Ming called, there was no response.
Yuan Ming sighed helplessly, remaining indifferent for a moment, and ultimately could only put the matter aside temporarily, shifting focus to checking on Lei Yu's condition.
After the black energy in Lei Yu's Sea of Consciousness was absorbed, its Divine Sense finally returned to normal. It noticed that Yuan Ming seemed busy, so it dared not make a sound. Now that Yuan Ming was back to normal, it hastily approached and prostrated on the ground.
"Lei Yu's madness attacking Master deserves death. Please punish me," it said, its voice trembling.
"Get up, it wasn't your intention," Yuan Ming comforted.
"Please punish me!" However, Lei Yu refused to rise, its voice trembling but its attitude exceptionally firm.
"How about this: later, when the Heavenly Cicada Mother Qi dissipates, I want you to carry the Stealing Heaven Tripod with full speed to Spiritual Ape Island, ensuring arrival before Mao Yi and his people come out. If achieved, consider your atonement fulfilled, no rewards or punishments. If not, then severe punishment will follow." Yuan Ming pondered for a moment, quickly having an idea.
He took the Pill King Pavilion inheritance, and neither Dongji Palace, Black Evil Sect, nor Luo Jia Mountain and Azure Dragon Pond would let him go. He must hurry back to take everything on Spiritual Ape Island and hide it away.
No matter whether Lei Yu attacked him just now, this task had to be entrusted to it as an excuse for atonement, simply because Yuan Ming didn't want to punish his loyal spirit pet at this critical moment.
"Yes!" Lei Yu felt it was Yuan Ming's mercy and quickly responded.
"Lei Yu, you broke through due to the Heavenly Cicada Mother Qi, which might be different from a regular breakthrough. Do you feel any discomfort?" Yuan Ming asked again.
"Um... It seems there's no discomfort, but if there is any..." Lei Yu self-checked for a while, mumbling softly, suddenly enveloped in a bolt of lightning, its form rapidly changing.The latest chapters are always available first on *.
Moments later, before Yuan Ming stood a young man of handsome appearance with short, fine black and purple hair, sharp eyes, and an aquiline nose, looking somewhat fierce. His appearance seemed to cloak him in a robe made of feathers, hiding his body and limbs entirely.
Yet in the next instant, the purple-black "robe" abruptly opened, spreading to both sides, appearing startlingly like Lei Yu's wings before it was transformed.
"After breaking through to Level 5, you can finally shape-shift? Incomplete transformation, it seems your bloodline level is not low." Yuan Ming looked at the transformed Lei Yu with interest and nodded.
"Though I hold the Thunder Peng Bloodline, it's not pure. Reaching my current cultivation level is all thanks to Master's nurturing," the young man half-knelt on the ground, eyes full of gratitude.
"I merely offered an opportunity; seizing the chance to break through was your own doing. However, these wings are quite conspicuous, so keep them folded behind you like a feathered cloak. It's also a kind of disguise." Yuan Ming extended the branches of the Undying Tree like human hands, patting Lei Yu's wings.
"Yes." Lei Yu replied.
Subsequently, Yuan Ming checked Hua Zhi's status. There was no black energy surrounding her Sea of Consciousness, and she quickly awoke, hearing from Yuan Ming about everything that had just happened, leaving her incredibly surprised.
Seeing Lei Yu and Hua Zhi recover, Yuan Ming employed his Divine Sense to explore the outside world, discovering that the Heavenly Cicada Mother Qi had disappeared, and immediately released Lei Yu, ordering it to head swiftly toward Dongji Sea with the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
He himself remained in the Stealing Heaven Tripod, thoroughly examining his internal condition.
Thanks to the Heavenly Cicada Mother Qi, the mana within him had increased significantly. Although it hadn't reached the peak of Middle-stage Returning Void, it had made considerable progress.
According to Yuan Ming's assessment, with the current mana level, even without consuming Jade Liquid Pill in the future, he was confident of reaching the Late Stage of Returning Void within ten years.
In terms of Body Cultivation, his Qi Blood Power had likewise skyrocketed, finally breaking through to the mid-stage Wanxiang Body.
This kind of enhancement ultimately took advantage of shortcuts, and now Yuan Ming's mana and Qi Blood Power are quite unstable, with a possibility of regression at any moment.

chapters.title: Chapter 834 - 805: Full-scale Manhunt
chapters.content:
To stabilize his cultivation, Yuan Ming immediately activated his cultivation technique, beginning to sort out the power within himself, trying to stabilize his current state.
While stabilizing his cultivation, he devoted a strand of his consciousness to studying the ash green tree bark that had become one with him, repeatedly contemplating the words Artifact Spirit Kong had just spoken.
Kong only mentioned that Yuan Ming should properly cultivate the piece of tree bark, to nurture it into an existence akin to the World Tree, but did not specify the necessary means. It was unclear whether Kong did not know himself or simply did not tell him.
Currently, there was no response to his call from the other party, and helplessly, Yuan Ming could only figure out a solution by himself.
After long pondering, Yuan Ming still did not have any idea, and finally chose the most foolish method—directly injecting his mana into the tree bark as a makeshift solution.
When his mana touched the tree bark, the Power of Ten Thousand Wood Origin within it instantly unleashed a suction force, absorbing Yuan Ming's injected mana completely in just a moment.
However, nothing changed afterwards.
Yuan Ming tried injecting mana once again, and the same situation occurred immediately. Thus, Yuan Ming could confirm that this was not an accident; the Power of Ten Thousand Wood Origin was indeed craving for spiritual energy's replenishment.
Perhaps by continually providing spiritual energy to the Power of Ten Thousand Wood Origin, it could be strengthened, thereby reviving the World Tree?
Yuan Ming speculated in his heart, unable to get an answer, but eventually finding a somewhat feasible method.
Thus, he continuously injected the sorted mana into the tree bark, simultaneously calling upon the demonic power of the Undying Tree, and also injecting it into the tree bark.
Not only that, he manipulated the Undying Tree Roots, commanding them to absorb nature's spiritual energy to the fullest, and also poured the acquired spiritual energy into the tree bark.
The Power of Ten Thousand Wood Origin within the tree bark welcomed all, absorbing all the injected spiritual energy, mana, and demonic power, yet still, there were no changes.
Meanwhile, at the labyrinth's entrance of Emperor Yan's Tomb, Mao Yi, Bai Yuan, and the others gathered again, their expressions not looking good.
"How about it? Did you find those two?" Mao Yi immediately asked upon meeting.
Zhu Yu glanced at him and shook his head.
Bai Yuan and Ouyang Qiang also had no results.
The group had collectively searched the entire labyrinth area more than three times, not leaving any corner unchecked. Even a fly couldn't escape their scrutinizing gaze, yet they found not the slightest trace of Yuan Ming and Yun Luo Fairy.
"Perhaps they ran fast and have already escaped from here," Bai Yuan suggested.
"Impossible, I just arrived here at the fastest speed, though those two Returning Void cultivators left earlier, they couldn't possibly be faster than me!" Mao Yi said in a low voice.
When entering the labyrinth, he secretly left a sensing forbidden at this entrance, which was intact without any trace of being touched. Thus, it could be inferred that Yuan Ming and Yun Luo Fairy were definitely still inside the labyrinth.
"Is that so? But we've gone through this labyrinth several times, still finding nothing. Continuing the search may be futile, better stop here," Ouyang Qiang remarked in a cold voice.
"Palace Master Ouyang giving up so soon, could it be that they've already fallen into your hands? Dongji Palace has more than one Space Spiritual Treasure to hide people, the Cold Smoke Hairpin on Palace Master's head is one of them," Mao Yi said, glancing at the Green Jade Hairpin in Ouyang Qiang's hair.
Hearing this, Bai Yuan also looked at the hairpin, his eyes filled with obvious suspicion although he said nothing.
"I've already said, we haven't found those two, besides, your Black Evil Sect and Luo Jia Mountain aren't lacking in Spiritual Treasures to hide people, right?" Ouyang Qiang coldly retorted.
"If that's the case, please, Palace Master Ouyang, hand over the Cold Smoke Hairpin for us to inspect, and prove your innocence," Bai Yuan said.
"What a joke, the things of this Palace Master are not for you to look at as you please," Ouyang Qiang said furiously, her face icy cold.
"Palace Master Ouyang's resistance to investigation only makes us more suspicious," Mao Yi said, narrowing his eyes.
"Those two are subordinates of your Dongji Palace after all. If Palace Master Ouyang cannot prove your innocence, it would be hard to justify today," Bai Yuan sneered, with Mao Yi blocking the road ahead in a pincer formation.
Ouyang Qiang knitted her brows. Her cultivation of the Nine Revolutions Divine Sky Technique was renowned for speed, ordinarily, even if Mao Yi and Bai Yuan joined forces, she could confidently leave safely.
But having been heavily injured by Emperor Yan earlier, her wounds had not yet healed, engaging in a fight with these two again might result in a loss.
However, as the Palace Master of Dongji Palace, to hand over the Cold Smoke Hairpin just like that would result in a great loss of face, potentially affecting the leadership of Dongji Palace.
"Do you two want to start a fight? Very well, this Palace Master has long wanted to experience the Divine Skills of the Three Realms Sect and Luo Jia Mountain!" Ouyang Qiang sneered, her eyes flickering with golden arcs of electricity as a divine-like imposing aura spread.
Mao Yi and Bai Yuan dared to be so assertive only by judging that Ouyang Qiang was severely injured, but seeing this scene, they couldn't help but wonder, could it be that Ouyang Qiang's injuries were healed?
"All three, calm down. The matter is still unclear; if we start a fight here, it would be too reckless. I have an alternative solution, why don't the three of you hear me out?" Zhu Yu stepped forward to mediate.
"Oh, Fellow Daoist Zhu, what solution do you have?" Bai Yuan, seizing the opportunity, subtly redirected the conversation.
"As you all know, my Azure Dragon Pond belongs to the Demon Clan forces, with a variety of demon beasts under my command. I happened to encounter a spirit beast with ancient Truth Listener bloodline some years ago. Its hearing is extraordinarily sharp, even space spiritual treasures can't isolate it. How about we let this Truth Listener Beast check from outside Palace Master Ouyang's Cold Smoke Hairpin to see if anyone is hiding inside?" Zhu Yu patted the Spiritual Beast Bag at his waist, and a small snow-white beast with a tiger head and a dog body flew out.
"A Truth Listener Beast!" Bai Yuan and Mao Yi showed a strange expression, sizing up the snow-white little beast.
"I've seen the appearance of a Truth Listener Beast in the classics, and it looks very much like this little beast. Besides, I've vaguely heard before that Zhu Yu indeed has such a demon beast under his command; his words should be reliable." Bai Yuan communicated to Mao Yi via voice transmission.
Mao Yi slightly nodded. He saw records of the Truth Listener, an ancient strange beast in the classics. Its hearing is astonishing; legend has it can hear all sounds within a realm.
This little beast naturally doesn't have the ability to listen to the entire realm, but it should be able to listen to the situation inside a spiritual treasure.
"Fellow Daoist Zhu has such an exotic beast, let's proceed as you said. However, since you're speaking in unison with Palace Master Ouyang, Fellow Daoist Bai and I intend to cast a Telepathy Technique on this beast to prevent any cheating. Fellow Daoist Zhu shouldn't disagree, right?" Mao Yi said.
"Of course." Zhu Yu agreed readily.
Seeing this, Mao Yi and Bai Yuan cast their spells without hesitation, two white lights merged into the Truth Listener Beast's body.
The Truth Listener Beast's body slightly trembled, its originally clear eyes sparkled with two lights of divine brilliance, looking towards Ouyang Qiang.
"Wait a minute," Ouyang Qiang suddenly spoke up.
"Does Palace Master Ouyang have any comments? Or perhaps someone's hiding in that hairpin, and you're afraid of letting the Truth Listener Beast investigate?" Mao Yi immediately said, his aura became sharp, seeming ready to act at any moment.
"Since Fellow Daoist Zhu has spoken, our palace will naturally give you that face, but Mao Yi and Bai Yuan should also check!" Ouyang Qiang ignored Mao Yi and spoke to Zhu Yu.
"Certainly, not only us four, but everyone present should be checked thoroughly," Zhu Yu said.
"Fine." Mao Yi and Bai Yuan nodded in agreement.
Seeing this, Zhu Yu raised his hand and pointed.
The Truth Listener Beast approached Ouyang Qiang, listened for a moment beside him, then stepped away.
"There's really nothing..." Mao Yi and Bai Yuan perceived the thoughts of the Truth Listener Beast through the Telepathy Technique, both frowned.
The Truth Listener Beast then walked past everyone present, still finding nothing, turned around, leaped into Zhu Yu's arms, and closed its eyes to rest.
"How could this be? Have they really escaped?" Mao Yi murmured incredulously.
"If we had set off to chase earlier, we might have caught up. Now, after wasting so much time, it's impossible to pursue." Ouyang Qiang mocked sarcastically.The r$e%f!er&e#nc%e v#e*r*s.i&o!n# of t^h!i+s ch#ap%te*r! is on M**V$*LE@MP&YR!.
"Palace Master Ouyang, less of the cool talk. We're all equally fooled by them." Bai Yuan said indignantly.
"Indeed, it was I, Mao Yi, who delayed everyone's time just now. I hereby apologize to all present." Mao Yi gestured to Bai Yuan and clasped his fists respectfully to those present, showing sincere attitude.
The people present were all rather surprised by this, and seeing this, Ouyang Qiang did not target with cold words anymore.
"Since those two have escaped, the most important thing now is to capture them back. Palace Master Ouyang, those two were your people. You should have investigated their backgrounds, right?" Mao Yi asked.
Ouyang Qiang hesitated slightly, looking towards Huangfu Jue, not far away.
The latter looked a bit embarrassed, frowned, stepped forward, and said:
"Reporting to the Palace Master, these two joined via challenging the Dongji Island Master. Since they haven't officially entered our Dongji Palace, the background check on them wasn't detailed. Also... Elder Mo Sanqi was always responsible for this matter, but he's already fallen, and I'm not clear on those two's situation. I need to return and investigate to know."
Upon hearing this, everyone's expressions turned solemn.
"Very well, you will be responsible for this matter. Upon returning, immediately blockade their respective islands and thoroughly investigate all their information." Ouyang Qiang said coldly.
"Yes." Huangfu Jue responded promptly.
"Aren't we supposed to be notified of the investigation results as well?" Bai Yuan frowned.
"There's no need for such trouble. Once outside, we'll jointly issue a wanted order, conducting a comprehensive pursuit of these two throughout the Dongji Sea Area. Given our sects' scale, they can't escape anywhere," Zhu Yu suddenly spoke up.
The others, hearing this, all nodded silently in agreement.
Just then, an unforeseen event occurred!
The ground beneath the people suddenly shook violently, followed by a muffled roar-like sound of a fierce beast emerging from deep underground.
Their expressions immediately changed, and before they could investigate closely, the earth beneath their feet suddenly began crumbling and cracking, gigantic fissures tore the ground apart, and billowing smoke emanated from them.

chapters.title: Chapter 835 - 806: Demon World Plot
chapters.content:
Mao Yi raised an eyebrow, glancing down at the fissure below. His expression changed immediately as he saw the deep crevice filled with lava, rising at a visibly rapid rate.
Above, the void also shook violently, revealing cracks.
"Not good, this place is about to collapse, let's go quickly." Mao Yi hastily shouted.
With that, he was the first to escape towards the outside of Emperor Yan's Mausoleum, and the others followed suit.
After less than an hour, the crimson light screen outside the mausoleum shattered, and the entire structure completely collapsed, turning into countless fragments, which fell like rain into Flame Island.
At that moment, a white light shot out from the collapsing tomb, striking the nearby sea surface, forming a white Transmission Array.
Figures of Mao Yi, Bai Yuan, Ouyang Qiang, Zhu Yu, and others flashed, appearing, each with a pale face, disheveled clothes, many places charred, looking rather battered.
Fortunately, everyone managed to escape, and no one perished.
In the gaze of the crowd, the ruins of Emperor Yan's Mausoleum slowly sank into the volcanic lava, submerged by the magma.
Seeing this scene, the few Dharma Manifestation Stage Great Powers who had spent a lot of energy and resources, losing many personnel, only to end up doing others' work without gain, all had faces as gloomy as water.
"I have no objection to the joint warrant for those two, and I will also share information about them with you in a timely manner. However, I have one request." Ouyang Qiang said, looking at the others.
"Speak." Mao Yi said impatiently.
"No matter who first finds traces of those two, everyone must be notified so we can capture them together, increasing our chances of success," Ouyang Qiang said.
"I have no objection." Zhu Yu shrugged and said.
"Alright. Once we catch those two, we can discuss how to divide the spoils. As for the Pill King Secret Manual, the four of us will share it. Do you have any objections?" Bai Yuan asked.
"None." The others said simultaneously.
Then, they discussed the details of the warrant for Yuan Ming and his accomplice and the subsequent chase deployment, and then left separately with their remaining personnel.
The vicinity of Flame Island returned to peace, with only the sound of waves surging and fires burning on the island.
A moment later, a figure suddenly hurriedly flew from afar, hovering back and forth around the volcanic lava, casting probing glances downwards.
It was none other than Mao Yi.
At this moment, his eyes suddenly brightened. In the rolling magma, a large bubble suddenly rose from below, inside which a human figure was encapsulated, none other than Jiang Liu.
As the bubble burst from the magma, Jiang Liu rushed out from within, flying directly towards Mao Yi.
Upon approaching, Mao Yi saw a palm-sized transparent Crystal Stone in Jiang Liu's hand and frowned, asking, "Is that a Void Crystal Stone?"
"My spatial bloodline still needs improvement; the Void Crystal Stone is a rare and valuable supplement. It's not every day you come across such a large Secret Realm, so naturally, I couldn't miss it." Jiang Liu nodded, playing with the stone, clearly attached to it.
"Were you the one who caused the collapse of Emperor Yan's Mausoleum?" Mao Yi asked.
"The Secret Realm of the mausoleum itself was constructed relying on the Void Crystal Stone. When I removed it, it lost balance and collapsed. Anyway, the secret treasures inside had already been taken; if it collapsed, so be it." Jiang Liu said indifferently.
"The collapse of the Secret Realm caused spatial storms powerful enough to annihilate Dharma Manifestation Stage Great Powers. Considering your cultivation, doing such a thing was too risky. What if something happened? How would I explain this to Lord Yan Emperor?" Mao Yi said with a stern face.
"Rest assured, I wouldn't take risks if I wasn't confident." Jiang Liu chuckled, unconcerned.
Mao Yi found this perfunctory response frustrating, his face taking on an even darker shade.
"Where have you been lately? Did you take the Pill King Pavilion inheritance?" He took a deep breath, suppressing the urge to scold, and asked.
"No, that inheritance was taken by Yuan Ming and Yun Luo Fairy. However, Yun Luo only took a small portion, with the majority being in Yuan Ming's hands." Jiang Liu replied casually.
"Did you see it with your own eyes? Why didn't you snatch it?" Mao Yi's breath quickened, and he asked urgently.
"I did make a move, but unfortunately, I couldn't seize it..." Jiang Liu raised his head, briefly recounting his encounter with Yuan Ming.
"Unexpectedly, Yuan Ming has such Divine Skills that even Master Demon Son cannot deal with him. However, he was swallowed by the Heavenly Cicada Mother Qi; even if he didn't perish, he would become a mindless madman. It's unlikely that the Pill King Pavilion inheritance will be secured." Mao Yi frowned deeply and sighed lightly.
"It's lost, so be it. The Pill King Pavilion inheritance is insignificant to us in the Demon World. Just report the situation truthfully; Father is busy dealing with the Reincarnation Demon Lord and won't blame you." Jiang Liu waved his hand as he spoke.
Mao Yi breathed a sigh of relief upon hearing this, but the next moment his expression changed dramatically: "What! The Reincarnation Demon Lord has already returned to the Demon World?"
"He returned two or three hundred years ago, but his demon body and demon soul were exterminated, and only a trace of residual soul survived by luck. Even with father's intervention, it will still take some time to recover," Jiang Liu said indifferently.
"That's good. The Reincarnation Demon Lord is a madman. If it weren't for his nonsense back then, the Three Realms Sect wouldn't have declined to this point, and Emperor Yan's plan wouldn't have been greatly delayed. This person truly deserves death!" Mao Yi said furiously.
"Before completely conquering the Chuyun Realm, father probably wouldn't bear to kill the Reincarnation Demon Lord. As for occupying Chuyun Realm, it's not an overnight effort. This isn't a small realm. During the last realm war, even though Chuyun Realm lost a Mahayana, Blood Skeleton Emperor was severely injured and hasn't recovered for so many years. Now the new generation of realm guardians in Chuyun Realm have matured. In the next realm war, the victory might still be undecided, let's take it slow," Jiang Liu said.
"The second generation of Chuyun Realm guardians have already appeared?" Mao Yi asked with a slight "Hmm".
"Two have already appeared, one dubbed Qin Mo, the other called Hua Xian, both very powerful. They fought a draw with five Demon Lords in the Returning Ruins," Jiang Liu said.
"Able to fight five with two and still tie, Qin Mo and Hua Xian truly cannot be underestimated. However, Demon Son, once you breakthrough to the Dharma manifestation Stage, I think you won't be weaker than them," Mao Yi said.
"The guardians of Chuyun Realm are cultivated with all resources the realm has, something extraordinary. Simply breaking through Dharma manifestation is not enough. I need to cultivate the Demon Thunder Nirvana Technique to the Seventh Layer, form an Undying Body, only then can I rival them," Jiang Liu said, looking at his hand indifferently.
"Demon Son, have you sensed the opportunity for Demon Body Nirvana?" Mao Yi's face beamed with joy.
"Almost, still needs a bit more time to refine. Don't tell father about this matter yet," Jiang Liu said.
"Yes." Mao Yi hurriedly agreed.
"What's the situation with the Three Realms Sect?" Jiang Liu asked.
"Same as before, several factions governing themselves, complete chaos," Mao Yi shrugged his shoulders and said.
"Ever since the Black Emperor fell, the Three Realms Sect has been going downhill each day. Forget it, these matters aren't related to us, let them cause a ruckus," Jiang Liu shook his head and said.
"I'll ensure our men act cautiously to avoid getting involved in the internal strife of the Three Realms Sect," Mao Yi said.
"Next, I need to sleep for some time, absorb the power of Void Crystal Stone, and seek the opportunity for nirvana, all trivial matters rely on you," Jiang Liu said, then tilted his head back and swallowed the transparent crystal stone he held.
Immediately, a white light seeped from his mouth and nose, and he fell into a deep sleep.
Yet, even while asleep, Jiang Liu's body didn't fall but was buoyed by an intangible force, gently floating in the void.
