Mao Yi raised his arms, and nearby void spanned a layer of black barrier, enclosing hundreds of meters, isolating all airflow fluctuations from affecting Jiang Liu.
The white light emanating from Jiang Liu's mouth and nose began to spread, enveloping him like a thin cicada chrysalis membrane.This content is hosted at *.
Within the light film, his body suddenly underwent rapid transformation, hunchbacked spine gradually straightened, his black hair cascading down and quickly growing, soon reaching his waist.
Jiang Liu's facial features altered along with his body, skin becoming delicate and smooth, features becoming refined, with an indescribable androgynous beauty that made it hard to distinguish male from female at a glance.
Mao Yi seemed unfazed by this, retrieving a palm-sized exquisite jade coffin and began casting.
The jade coffin quickly enlarged, enveloping Mao Yi's body, then swiftly departed.
...
Lei Yu flew forward rapidly over the Abyss Sea Surface, body transformed into a purple lightning bolt, each flash shooting tens of miles forward, with everything below retreating quickly.
Inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod, Yuan Ming remained in the form of the Undying Tree, absorbing nature's spiritual energy, injecting it entirely into the World Tree bark.
Half a day had passed, the World Tree bark absorbed an immense amount of spiritual energy without showing any sign of stopping, resembling a bottomless pit.
Yuan Ming, after probing, found that after all this time, the Power of Ten Thousand Wood Origin scarcely increased, he sighed slightly inside, reluctantly halting.
"It seems this matter won't succeed solely by infusing spiritual energy, it must progress slowly," he muttered to himself, reverting to human form.
Later, Yuan Ming turned his wrist, took out the half manual of the 'Pill King Secret Manual', and began to carefully peruse it, appearing disappointed.
He got the front half of the manual, mostly recording Dan Recipes and secret techniques, along with refining experiences for the realms of Qi Refinement, Foundation Establishment, Core Formation, and Nascent Soul.
Given Yuan Ming's current cultivation, he hardly needed these elixirs.
However, the deeper he read, the quicker his initial disappointment dissipated.
This 'Pill King Secret Manual' was completely different from any other Alchemy Secret Manual he had ever seen. The recipes it recorded were extremely comprehensive, whether elixirs for stabilizing the foundation, speeding up cultivation, or breaking through bottlenecks, they had everything.
The process for refining these elixirs was also meticulously documented within the manual, without any indistinct language as if veiled in clouds, easy to understand at a glance. Even a new alchemist, by mastering basic alchemy skills and strictly following the methods and steps inside, has a fair chance of forming elixirs.

chapters.title: Chapter 836 - 807: The 100-Year Agreement
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming looked at these Dan Recipes, and his heart gradually warmed.
He has always been not very interested in cultivating forces, but Xi Ying not only deeply understands this path but also enjoys it. If he hands over this half of Pill King Secret Manual to her, he believes that with her ability, she will surely be able to cultivate a large number of Nascent Soul cultivators in a short time, forming a considerable force.
Of course, this also has a great effect on him recruiting believers and improving the efficiency of accumulating Desire Power.
Who would refuse to worship a god that can genuinely help themselves improve their cultivation?
It's just a pity that the second half of the Secret Manual fell into the hands of Yun Luo Fairy, and the legendary Dharma Manifestation Pill Recipe should be among that half of the Secret Manual.
"Need to think of a way to find Yun Luo Fairy, but I can't go to her immediately. In this situation, she and I should have already been wanted by Dongji Palace and Luo Jia Mountain. Gathering recklessly is not a wise move," Yuan Ming mused to himself.
After pondering for a moment, he carefully stowed away the half Secret Manual and took out a Spiritual Beast Bag, waved his hand, grasping at the air.
A figure flew out from the Spiritual Beast Bag, none other than Dian Xiaosan, who was still in a coma.
Yuan Ming glanced at Dian Xiaosan several times and then waved his hand; a large mist rose in the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space, engulfing everything around.
He subsequently infused a stream of Undying Tree Demon Power into Dian Xiaosan's body, healing his physical wounds, and ejected a black light into his Dan Tian.
The black light transformed into several black chains, wrapping around Dian Xiaosan's Nascent Soul, forming a deadlock.
Wisps of black thunder light shimmered on the chains, which were the Yin Thunder Rune of the Soul Destroying Sword.
Dian Xiaosan soon awoke, looked at the surrounding space, momentarily confused, then his pupils suddenly shrank in shock when he saw Yuan Ming.
"It's you! What do you want? What is this place?" Dian Xiaosan asked.
"This is not something you should worry about. Master Dian should be more concerned about whether he can survive," Yuan Ming said indifferently.
Dian Xiaosan's pupils contracted when he noticed the chains on his Dan Tian Nascent Soul, his face changed dramatically, and he instinctively attempted to break the seal with mana.
Immediately, a black Yin Thunder shot from the chain, into his Nascent Soul's forehead.
The Nascent Soul screamed, while Dian Xiaosan's face showed pain, blood flowed from his seven orifices, his body trembled like a sieve, and it took a long time to calm down.
"What are those black chains?" Dian Xiaosan stared at Yuan Ming and asked.
"A means to imprison the Divine Soul; if I were Master Dian, I wouldn't touch it carelessly. If the power of the Yin Thunder is completely triggered, it will result in soul extinction," Yuan Ming said leisurely, as a table of sumptuous food appeared between them.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan has great skills, managing to deceive all of us. The inheritance from the Pill King Pavilion must have fallen into your hands! It's laughable how many of us fought fiercely, only to make you a bridegroom," Dian Xiaosan said coldly after watching Yuan Ming for a while.
"Master Dian overpraises; it was just some petty means," Yuan Ming said with a smile, pouring Dian Xiaosan a cup of wine.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan captured me, certainly not for idle drinking and chatting. Whatever you want, just say. If I have it, it can be used to buy my life; but if you want me to be a slave or a dog, then you might as well kill me directly," Dian Xiaosan said as he downed the wine.
"Master Dian is straightforward, so I won't mince words. I admire your alchemy skills and invited you here, not to make you a slave or a dog. I need someone who wholeheartedly works for me. If Master Dian serves me for a hundred years, during this period, I assure you safe passage, and once the term expires, I will set you free," Yuan Ming replied.
Upon hearing these words, Dian Xiaosan showed slight disbelief, looking at him: "Just need to serve for a hundred years and I can regain my freedom?"
"It's true; if Master Dian doesn't believe, I am willing to swear an oath with heart demon," Yuan Ming said seriously with one hand raised.
Dian Xiaosan didn't immediately speak, his expression showed uncertainty as he pondered deeply.
He didn't doubt Yuan Ming's words. Alone in Dongji Sea, he had neither disciples nor kin, nor created any forces, and cooperated with Dongji Palace merely for convenience in alchemy.
As such, the only thing worth coveting by others is his skilled alchemy technique.
Dian Xiaosan asserts he holds no grudges with Yuan Ming. Now captured, helping him refine elixirs for a hundred years seems fine, except Yuan Ming, having taken the Pill King Pavilion inheritance, has already offended Dongji Palace, Luo Jia Mountain, Black Evil Sect, and Azure Dragon Pond—the Four Great Forces—and will surely be hunted by them, with him as a vassal, danger looms.
If Yuan Ming perishes, his own fate may not be good.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, alone to offend these Four Major Sects, is akin to death. If they know I'm serving you, it's hard to escape death; how then to ensure my safety?" Dian Xiaosan pondered for a long time before expressing his concerns.
"Master Dian can rest assured; since I could seize the Pill King Pavilion inheritance from Mao Yi and others, I have means to deal with their pursuit," Yuan Ming said confidently.
"What if there's an accident?" Dian Xiaosan asked, staring fixedly into Yuan Ming's eyes.
"That's just Master Dian's bad luck," Yuan Ming said with a smile.
Dian Xiaosan's face froze, and a hint of anger flashed in his eyes.
The man in front of him seemed decent enough, but his words and actions were utterly roguish.
"Master Dian is a smart man. Since you're in my hands now, you can only follow my orders. No more conditions, fulfill my requests, cooperate with me, and everyone will be happy. If Master Dian refuses, even though I would regret it, I can only see you off." Yuan Ming said nonchalantly, playing with the wine cup.
"Alright, I can serve you." After a long silence, Dian Xiaosan spoke.Love this story? Show your support on *.
"Master Dian understands the situation and made a wise choice. I will also plant a Divine Soul Mark on you. For the next hundred years, all your activities will be under my watch. So, it's best not to think of escaping or rebelling. Because the moment you have such thoughts, I'll be able to detect it," Yuan Ming said with a smile, nodding slowly.
Upon hearing this, Dian Xiaosan's face changed again. However, given the situation, he had no choice but to nod in agreement.
Seeing his change in expression, Yuan Ming said, "Having Master Dian serve me for a hundred years won't be a thankless task. I wonder if Master Dian knows the Zhu Rong Heart Technique?"
"Zhu Rong Heart Technique? That's the Fire Control Secret Technique that the Zhu Rong Sect never shares. Why are you bringing it up? Could it be that you know it?" Dian Xiaosan asked, his expression changing slightly.
The Zhu Rong Sect is a major Artifact Refining sect on the Central Continent, also skilled in Fire Attribute Divine Abilities, and is extremely renowned even among supportive sects, surpassing the Qingxuan Platform and the Pill King Pavilion.
The Zhu Rong Secret Technique is the Zhu Rong Sect's famed technique, rumored to be passed down by an ancient Fire God. If this secret technique is cultivated to the Great Perfection Realm, one can control all flames in the world.
"Indeed, if Master Dian is interested in the Zhu Rong Heart Technique, I'll pass it on to you as a token of my regard," Yuan Ming said.
"Are you serious?" Dian Xiaosan's eyes lit up, and he asked excitedly.
As an Alchemist, having the opportunity to study such an advanced Fire Control Skill was a great fortune. Initially, he might have been ninety percent unwilling, but now he was thirty percent willing.
Yuan Ming wasted no time and immediately stepped forward, touching Dian Xiaosan's forehead with his fingers, transferring a trace of Soul Power into his Sea of Consciousness.
While implanting the Divine Soul Mark, he also imparted the cultivation contents of the Zhu Rong Heart Technique to him.
Dian Xiaosan's expression changed from solemnity to joy, and he sincerely said, "Within these hundred years, I will loyally carry out your tasks, but after a hundred years, you must abide by our agreement and restore my freedom."
Yuan Ming nodded and paid him no more mind.
Dian Xiaosan didn't mind either and immediately sat cross-legged, closing his eyes to concentrate on comprehending the Zhu Rong Heart Technique.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming smiled slightly.
As a sixth-level Alchemist, Dian Xiaosan's Fire Control Skill surely surpassed that of Qu Jiuhuang. It's likely he could soon cultivate the Zhu Rong Secret Technique to a profound level, offering another opportunity to enhance himself.
Watching Dian Xiaosan immersed in cultivation, Yuan Ming set up another Array nearby, then left the Stealing Heaven Tripod and mounted Lei Yu's back.
"Master, why have you come out?" Lei Yu paused his Thunder Escape.
"There's something I need to do," Yuan Ming said, taking the Stealing Heaven Tripod, handling a stick of Black Incense, lighting it, and sticking it in.
He visualized Huangfu Jue's face in his Sea of Consciousness, planning to possess him to investigate the moves of those Dharma manifestation Stage Great Powers.
At that moment, Yuan Ming's gaze suddenly flickered, and he temporarily changed his mind.
As the spiraling smoke rose, his vision began to blur until it went dark, and his Divine Sense suddenly sank.
In the next instant, his vision cleared, seeing himself sitting in a corner of the courtyard in the Spiritual Ape Island Mansion. A ray of sunshine was streaming over the courtyard wall, falling on him warmly.
At that time, Yuan Ming didn't possess Huangfu Jue but rather possessed Vajra.
After contemplation, he decided that even by possessing Huangfu Jue and discovering the movements of Ouyang Qiang and others, it would still be useless. It would be better to possess Vajra and cut the problem at its root.
Yuan Ming quickly returned to the room, took an empty Jade Scroll from a wooden box on the desk, and transferred a strand of Divine Thought into it. After a moment, he placed it back on the table.
Then he took a sheet of white paper, laid it beside the Jade Scroll, and wrote, "Check the Jade Scroll."
Having done all this, he pulled over a wide chair, sat down heavily at the desk, closed his eyes, and quietly awaited his consciousness's return...

chapters.title: Chapter 837 - 808: The Cicada Sheds Its Golden Shell
chapters.content:
Moments later, Vajra awoke in confusion, finding himself inexplicably inside a room. Initially startled, he saw the handwriting on the white paper on the desk, recognized it as Yuan Ming's, and finally relaxed.
Vajra knew Yuan Ming had a remote possession ability, so he hurriedly picked up that Jade Scroll and placed it against his forehead to check its contents.
Yuan Ming explained in detail within the Jade Scroll the situation inside Emperor Yan's Mausoleum and the possibility of Ouyang Qiang and others targeting Spiritual Ape Island.
"... All the resources on the island, whether the planted spiritual medicine or the stored Spirit Stones, or the artifacts and Magic Treasures kept in the treasury, must be taken without leaving a single piece. Gather them all and take them away."
"As for the believers on Spiritual Ape Island and the surrounding islands, those willing to go with you should be placed inside Shura Palace. As for those unwilling, don't force them; just give them some spiritual medicine and Spirit Stones and let them leave. Get all this done within half a day and leave Spiritual Ape Island with Shura Palace, trying to get as far as possible from the Dongji Palace domain and find a concealed place to hide. I will find you through the Divine Soul Mark."
Yuan Ming gave Vajra clear instructions at the end of the Jade Scroll.
"Understood, Master." Vajra opened his eyes and nodded.
He destroyed the paper on the desk, put away the Jade Scroll, and immediately got into action.
...
Almost simultaneously, Ouyang Qiang and Huangfu Jue were standing on a diamond-shaped Flying Shuttle, surrounded by dazzling brilliance, and their figures streaked like rainbows flying back toward Dongji Palace.
The Flying Shuttle under her feet was a high-level Spiritual Treasure, emitting thousands of star lights, advancing like a meteor breaking through the void, passing a hundred-mile distance in a flash, much faster than Lei Yu.
On the Flying Shuttle, Huangfu Jue held a peculiar round jade pendant in his hands, casting spells with both hands.
The jade pendant flashed red and green lights intermittently, seeming to sense something.
Time ticked by, and after a full quarter of an hour, the situation with the jade pendant remained unchanged with no improvement.
"Mother, it still doesn't work; this place is too far from Dongji Palace, well beyond the Six Harmonies Communication Array's range." Huangfu Jue stopped his hand and said helplessly.
"Then forget it; if we can't contact Dongji Palace, Yuan Ming and Yun Luo Fairy surely can't reach the outside either. Focus on speeding up and make sure you leave the Abyss before them!" Ouyang Qiang said.
"Understood." Huangfu Jue put away the jade pendant and injected mana into the Flying Shuttle beneath him.
The Flying Shuttle's speed increased again, rushing out swiftly like a bolt of lightning.
...
Half a month later.
Dongji Palace suddenly announced it was closing its doors for retreat, activating the protection array, preventing anyone from approaching.
While countless cultivators on East Extreme Island speculated on what had happened, the Returning to Void Elders within Dongji Palace moved out quietly, leaving the island with two teams each numbering over a hundred, arriving separately at Spiritual Ape Island and Yunshan Island.
However, Spiritual Ape Island was already deserted.
The entire island seemed to have undergone a devastating catastrophe, with all spiritual medicine and fairy grass dug up and everything in the treasury moved away, leaving only empty pavilions and corridors.
On the island, not a single person could be found.
Afterwards, those Returning to Void Elders took people to thoroughly investigate the nearby islands, only to find that the situation was the same as on Spiritual Ape Island; they had all turned into empty islands.
Moreover, according to various traces on the islands, those people likely left at least ten days ago.
Before, they hadn't gotten a single bit of news.
On the other side, the situation on Yunshan Island similarly surprised them.
Yunshan Island's Island Protection Array was still operating, and everything on the island seemed as usual. But when those elders broke through the array and brought their team on the island, they found the situation there was hardly better than Spiritual Ape Island.
Although there were still some people, those few were almost all ordinary folks, left on the island under an illusion technique, and knew nothing after being woken.
An elder soul cultivator of Dongji Palace performed a Soul Search Divine Ability and learned that Yun Luo Fairy had arranged everything when she left Yunshan Island for the mission, clearly never intending to return.
Ouyang Qiang was still rushing back when she received the news from the elders, so angry she was seething.
"Alright, I underestimated these two people." Ouyang Qiang gritted her teeth and said coldly.
"What do we do now?" Huangfu Jue waited a while before asking softly.
Ouyang Qiang took a deep breath, closing her eyes, and when she opened them, she had regained her calm: "Tell Dongji Palace to put a bounty on capturing Yuan Ming and Yun Luo. At the same time, inform Black Evil Sect, Luo Jia Mountain, and Azure Dragon Pond of the situation with Yuan Ming and Yun Luo."
"Do you really want to tell them? Yuan Ming and Yun Luo Fairy might not have gotten far yet. If we act ourselves, we might find them. The inheritance of Pill King Pavilion must not fall into their hands." Huangfu Jue said somewhat unwillingly.
"I just recalled all the events at Emperor Yan's Mausoleum. We all underestimated Yuan Ming and Yun Luo; they're definitely not ordinary Returning to Void Cultivators. The Dongji Sea is vast beyond measure, with so many places where we can't intervene. It's too optimistic to think our Dongji Palace's manpower alone can capture them. It's better if the Four Great Forces join hands; the likelihood of success would be greater," Ouyang Qiang shook her head and said.
"Indeed," Huangfu Jue agreed.
"Have their backgrounds been thoroughly investigated?" Ouyang Qiang immediately asked.
"According to the intelligence we currently possess, that Yun Luo Fairy definitely isn't ordinary. It's almost certain she's a dark child from the Central Continent's Su Nu Sect. As for Yuan Ming, his origins remain elusive, as if he appeared in the Dongji Sea out of nowhere," Huangfu Jue replied.
"Oh, it seems Yuan Ming's background is even more mysterious. Could he also be under some major force from the Central Continent?" Ouyang Qiang pondered.
The closure of Dongji Palace did not last long, only two or three days before it was lifted.Uplоаdеd by thе М|V|L(ЕМРYR) tеаm.
Along with its lifting came a wanted notice. Dongji Palace issued a high bounty and demanded all islands under its jurisdiction to participate in the search and capture of Yuan Ming and Yun Luo Fairy, dead or alive.
A few days later, Luo Jia Mountain and Azure Dragon Pond also issued similar wanted notices, and the Black Evil Sect even released a bounty on Yuan Ming and Yun Luo Fairy in the underground world.
These four wanted notices stirred up chaos in the entire Dongji Sea Area, with rumors spreading everywhere and turbulence increasing all around.
...
Two months later.
In an unknown sea area, a giant reef turtle was slowly swimming across the sea surface.
On its one-hundred-zhang-wide shell was a strange rock-strewn small island reef, covered in moss, with sea birds occasionally landing on the rocks to peck at the moss.
Inside a narrow cave formed by several huge rocks, a White Ape was sitting cross-legged on the turtle's back, concealing its aura and quietly meditating.
Suddenly, a gigantic shadow drifted across the sky above, covering the entire island reef and blocking the light filtering through the gaps onto the White Ape.
The White Ape slowly opened its eyes, carefully observing above, but dared not extend any Divine Sense, fearing exposure.
At this moment, a sharp bird cry suddenly echoed from above.
"Lei Yu..." The White Ape's eyes immediately lit up. It dashed out of the rocky cave and stood on the highest point of the island, looking up at the large purple bird above.
Then, a figure suddenly leaped down from the back of the purple bird, descending towards him.
The descending figure was, naturally, Yuan Ming.
"Vajra, I only told you to hide, not to stay hidden forever. You really made me search all over for you," he complained with a hint of exasperation as he steadied himself.
"Master, you've stirred up the entire Dongji Sea, with people searching for you everywhere. With the heavy Demonic Qi on me, I can only hide on the back of the reef turtle to avoid being discovered by those with ill intentions," Vajra replied helplessly.
"Well done," Yuan Ming, understanding the current Dongji Sea situation and Vajra's difficulties, had no intention of being harsh. He patted Vajra's shoulder and smiled.
"Master, you're too kind," Vajra immediately responded.
"Did you bring everything from the island?" Yuan Ming asked with a smile.
"Except for the houses, we brought almost everything. Even the people, we managed to bring almost all of them," Vajra beamed with a hint of pride.
"How many?" Yuan Ming frowned.
"Nearly all the mortals followed, as they are loyal believers of yours. As for the Cultivators, nearly a hundred came, all pledging to continue following you. Those who didn't come, I gave settlement fees and dismissed them," Vajra replied.
"You did well," Yuan Ming nodded with satisfaction.
Vajra took two steps back, gave a respectful salute to Yuan Ming, and with a mystic spell, a purple light shone on his palm, revealing a delicately constructed purple palace, emitting a faint glow.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming raised his hand to receive the purple palace, his figure flickered, and he transformed into a stream of light, flying into the palace.
Inside the Shura Palace, a desolate square was crowded with tens of thousands of people, most of whom were ordinary mortals. They had already been in this space for some time. Although food was adequate, the oppressive environment was sapping their patience.
As a result, the square was chaotic and noisy.
If not for the Cultivators present, managing and restraining them, these people would have already scattered throughout Shura Palace, likely leading many to inadvertently wander into Array traps, meeting their ends.
Nevertheless, the Cultivators were also uncertain; they had no idea what was happening. It was their trust in the Island Master and faith in the Nether Moon God that made them follow so resolutely.
Now, if the Island Master did not appear soon, they would likely have their own resolve faltering, contemplating escaping.

chapters.title: Chapter 838 - 809: Settling In
chapters.content:
Speaking of which, it's already challenging for Vajra to bring these mortals and Cultivators into the Shura Palace. Expecting him, a creature cultivating a transformation, to manage them is impossible.
At this moment, seeing Yuan Ming appear, everyone immediately became excited.
The Cultivators hurriedly approached Yuan Ming and cupped their fists, saying, "Lord Nether Moon God, what exactly happened that we must hastily leave Spiritual Ape Island?"
The ordinary folks also stood up one by one, looking over towards Yuan Ming.
Noises surged across the square, making the scene increasingly chaotic.
Yuan Ming swept his gaze over everyone, raised his hand, and pressed down. A wave of Divine Soul Power spread out, enveloping everyone in the square like a gentle spring breeze and drizzle.
Everyone saw a vast, endless grassland, an infinite stretch of green reaching the horizon. A warm, fresh breeze, mixed with the scent of grass, came blowing towards them, instantly soothing their restless emotions.
Soon, the noise in the square quieted down.
"Dear folks, our Moon Sect has encountered a crisis, and we had no choice but to bring everyone away..." Yuan Ming did not hold back, revealing the situation of being hunted by the Four Great Forces, including Dongji Palace.
Of course, he omitted the reason for being pursued, just stating that the Four Great Forces coveted an artifact on him.
Upon hearing that the Moon Sect was jointly wanted by the Four Great Forces, including Dongji Palace, everyone in the square turned ashen-faced.
Dongji Palace has dominated the Dongji Sea for long, its authority deeply ingrained. To them, natives of the Dongji Sea, Dongji Palace is akin to heaven.
Being wanted by Dongji Palace, can they still survive?
"Do not worry, the crisis is temporarily under control. This place is a secret realm space I created. As long as you stay here, neither Dongji Palace, Azure Dragon Pond, Luo Jia Mountain, nor Black Evil Sect can harm you." Yuan Ming's calm voice spread, reassuring everyone.
Upon hearing this, everyone in the square breathed a sigh of relief, kneeling to express their gratitude for Lord Nether Moon God's protection.
"The crisis cannot be resolved in a short time, and you cannot return to Spiritual Ape Island immediately. Stay here for a while." Yuan Ming continued.
"Lord Nether Moon God, staying here is manageable, but we cannot remain idle daily. If we do, trouble will surely arise in the long run." A Cultivator in gray clothes flew out, worriedly saying this was Sikong Lin.
"There's no need to worry. This secret realm space is far larger than you imagine, enough for all of you to reside peacefully. Essential living supplies have also been prepared. I came here to settle everyone." Yuan Ming said loudly.
The people in the square, especially the mortals, felt relieved upon hearing this.
They do not have high demands as long as they have enough to eat and wear and their families are safe. It does not matter if they live on Spiritual Ape Island or here; there is no significant difference.
"However, there are still some formations and traps within this secret realm, so you cannot wander around recklessly, or it might endanger your lives." Yuan Ming continued.
"Understood, we will surely comply with Lord Nether Moon God's instructions." The ordinary people in the square quickly agreed.
"As for you, follow me." Yuan Ming said to the twenty or so Cultivators present, including Sikong Lin.
Those people immediately responded and followed Yuan Ming to a large hall outside the square.
Yuan Ming waved his hand to take out more than twenty bottles of elixirs that assist in cultivation, distributing them to everyone, saying, "During this period, you have worked hard to calm those mortals and stabilize the situation. You've performed well, and consider these as your reward."
The twenty-odd people received the medicine bottles, opened them, and a strong medicinal fragrance welcomed them. The quality was far superior to the usual elixirs they used, and they were delighted.
Sikong Lin's Cultivation had already reached the Peak of Late-stage Core Formation, and he was also rewarded with an elixir greatly beneficial for advancing to the Nascent Soul stage.
"Thank you, Lord Nether Moon God, for bestowing the elixirs." Sikong Lin and the others cupped their hands in gratitude.
"Lord Nether Moon God, will these mortals live here in the future? Sorry to be frank, but the environment here isn't very good. It's okay for short-term residence, but long-term stay may lead to illnesses." Sikong Lin said.
This square is near Yin Capital City, close to the Yin Qi Canyon, where heavy Yin Qi fills the void, making it indeed unsuitable for long-term mortal stay.
"Rest assured, this secret realm space is very large. I will now take all of you to a more habitable area." Yuan Ming brought out the Shura Stone Tablet, activating its Forbidden.
Everyone's vision blurred for a moment, and they found themselves in a place under clear skies and beside green mountains and waters, precisely where the Black Tower is located.
This space is much larger than that where Yin Capital City resides. It could easily accommodate not just tens of thousands but millions.
These mortals who have spent their entire lives living on islands were amazed by the scenery so different from Spiritual Ape Island, gradually dispelling their prior gloomy mood.
Sikong Lin and the others also showed a look of joy. The Spiritual Energy here is abundant enough for their cultivation.
"This is another area within the secret realm. Although it seems harmonious here, there are still many formations. Even for you, carelessly venturing into them may lead to death. I will allocate a relatively safe area for you. Afterwards, follow the route map I drew and take those mortals there. Upon arrival, use the materials within to build houses and residences, and settle them." Yuan Ming took out ten or so large Storage Bags filled with various ordinary materials he had collected.
He then took out a pre-drawn map and handed it to Sikong Lin.
The terrain is vast, and the environment is complicated. When Yuan Ming first acquired the Shura Palace, he hadn't thoroughly explored all areas. Only after settling Qu Jiuhuang, Fei Shang, and Ye San did he completely explore the Black Tower space, drawing this map based on his memory and naming some locations.
He chose an area called Flower Garden Wilderness as the settlement place for these ordinary people — it has ample area, no mechanisms or formations, and is one of the few absolutely safe places. Furthermore, there is considerable land available for use, and it can even be reclaimed into medicine fields for continued farming.
The only drawback is that it is desolate and uninhabited, with no ready-made buildings like in Yin Capital City, requiring a lot of effort to construct.
"Help me do these things well, and you won't lack benefits." Yuan Ming finally said.
"Thank you, Lord Nether Moon God!" Sikong Lin accepted the order joyfully, then led those mortals to the Flower Garden Wilderness.
After settling everything, Yuan Ming activated the Shura Stone Tablet and came to another place in the Yin Capital City space, where tens of thousands of followers and cultivators who had come from Spiritual Ape Island and nearby islands had also gathered.
Among this group of people, Sikong Zhan saw Yuan Ming appear and hurriedly came over to salute.
The Vajra had previously sent these people into the Shura Palace space in batches; there are four such temporary settlements.
Sikong Zhan, Sikong Zhuo, Sikong Lin, and Ye Xinyao, the four people Yuan Ming trusts the most, each lead one area.
"Lord Nether Moon God, earlier Lord Vajra sent us here, I wonder..." Sikong Zhan asked.
"You don't need to think much about this; just manage these people well." Yuan Ming did not explain.
"Yes." Seeing this, Sikong Zhan did not inquire further.
"Your cultivation is nearing the Nascent Soul middle stage; spend more time on your practice and strive to break through as soon as possible. If you need any auxiliary elixirs, let me know in advance." Yuan Ming said after glancing at Sikong Zhan.
"Thank you, Lord Nether Moon God." Sikong Zhan gratefully bowed in thanks.
Yuan Ming came before the people below, comforted them a bit, and also sent these people into the Black Tower Space.
The remaining two places were the same; after calming them, they were all placed into the Black Tower Space.
Sikong Zhan's cultivation was profound, and he was also adept at handling affairs, so Yuan Ming let him continue to manage everyone.
After finishing everything, he went to the places where Qu Jiuhuang, Fei Shang, Ye San, and others were; these people stayed obediently in their detention area, completely unaware of the changes happening in the Black Tower Space.
Yuan Ming nodded silently, came to the peak of a mountain in the Black Tower Space, and sat down cross-legged.
The mortals and cultivators were temporarily settled, but he did not intend to let them out again, at least not for the next hundred years.
Yuan Ming is currently wanted by Dongji Palace, the Black Evil Sect, and others. Unless those sects can be wiped out, the Dongji Sea is uninhabitable. If these followers are released, their fate will not be good.
For the safety of these followers and for him to collect Desire Power, he can't leave them unattended.
However, letting those people live peacefully within the Shura Palace is not a simple task. Although the area of the Shura Palace is vast and the environment decent, staying here for a long time is still akin to imprisonment, and he doesn't really know how to manage so many people.
"The person best at management would be Xi Ying. I should ask for her opinion." Yuan Ming murmured to himself, took out the Stealing Heaven Tripod, lit a stick of Black Incense, and inserted it.
...
Central Continent, Xuejing Country, Fengxue City.
In a quiet building in the west of Fengxue City, snowflakes swirled down from the sky, covering the courtyard in a thick blanket of snow that reflected the bright light under the moonlight.
A cat with silver-white fur was jumping around, leaving plum blossom footprints in the snow, playing happily.
Just as it made a big leap from one end of the courtyard to the other, its body suddenly stiffened mid-air, then fell to the ground. Its bright eyes revealed a moment of daze, but soon returned to normal.Theoriginalsourceis*.
However, the silver cat no longer continued its previous game and quickly changed direction, running towards the back courtyard.
The silver cat passed through the corridor and a dangling flower arch gate, arriving at the back courtyard.
There stood a solitary house behind a few blooming plum trees. Inside, a lamp was lit, and through the window, the silhouette of a woman could be seen, seemingly sitting at the window reading by candlelight.
The silver cat trotted over, nimbly jumped onto the windowsill, and before it could make a sound, the window creaked open a crack.
The silver cat hesitated slightly, shook off the snow on its paws, and quickly slipped through the crack.
"Guoguo, why are you back so soon today..." The woman in the room was none other than Xi Ying. Before she could finish, her gaze fell on the silver cat's pupils, and her words abruptly stopped.
"Xi Ying..." the silver cat opened its mouth and spoke in human language.
"Yuan Ming, why are you possessing Guoguo now?" Xi Ying put down the book she was holding.
"Something happened over here..." Yuan Ming didn't delay and immediately recounted his earlier experiences to Xi Ying.
"I didn't expect that in this period, you went through so many things. I've already heard of the name of that 'Pill King Secret Manual'. Many sects on the Central Continent have been searching for it over the years, and the Sky Eagle Chamber of Commerce has also been heavily rewarding its discovery. However, most found are fake and counterfeit; I didn't expect the genuine one had already spread to the Dongji Sea." Xi Ying said slowly after listening.
"I remember that the Sky Eagle Chamber of Commerce also deals in the elixir business; this half of the 'Pill King Secret Manual' should be of significant use to you. Once I settled down, I immediately contacted you. Unfortunately, I only managed to grab the first half; the other half is in someone else's hands."

chapters.title: Chapter 839 - 810 Imprisonment
chapters.content:
"From your description, even half of the 'Pill King Secret Manual' is already a treasure. With this, my position in the Sky Eagle Chamber of Commerce can be elevated considerably," Xi Ying said with a smile.
"You want to hand it over to the Sky Eagle Chamber of Commerce?" Yuan Ming asked in a lowered tone.
"Of course not. You've just stirred up major trouble with Dongji Palace, Luo Jia Mountain, and those sects over there, and now bringing out half of the secret manual would draw too much attention. I'll just pick out some lost Dan Recipes and claim I've found them through painstaking efforts from elsewhere, and that'll be enough to make a contribution in the Sky Eagle Chamber of Commerce," Xi Ying shook her head and said.
"Alright, handle it as you see fit," Yuan Ming said, channeling a stream of soul power into Xi Ying's Sea of Consciousness.
This soul power transformed into a black vortex, spinning rapidly.
Quickly, countless words as tiny as mosquitoes and flies flew out densely from the black vortex, precisely the first half of the 'Pill King Secret Manual'.
"Your Life and Death Reincarnation Path is becoming more exquisite. You can even refine your own memories," Xi Ying's Divine Soul emitted a surge of soul power to sweep away all these words.
A shimmering, crystalline light appeared on her Divine Soul, appearing as if countless thoughts were spinning, restoring calm within a few breaths.
"This small trick of mine is nothing to brag about; just skilled hands, yet you, in a few breaths, comprehended half of the 'Pill King Secret Manual' entirely. How has your comprehension capability increased so much?" Yuan Ming asked.
"It's nothing really, I've recently undergone a second Wisdom Awakening on my Divine Soul," Xi Ying explained.
"What! You've applied the Wisdom Awakening Secret Technique on yourself again? That's too dangerous; don't you value your life?" Yuan Ming's voice changed, angrily questioning.
This Wisdom Awakening Secret Technique was the secret technique Xi Ying practiced earlier to metamorphose the Divine Soul, enhancing the aspect of comprehension. Xi Ying always kept it secret, and a few years ago, Yuan Ming persistently questioned and even secretly possessed Xi Ying to investigate, which made Xi Ying finally disclose everything.
The Wisdom Awakening Secret Technique had an astounding effect; each application tremendously enhanced comprehension. However, each use was extremely perilous, torturing the Divine Soul like a thousand cuts, with the slightest oversight leading to Divine Soul collapse and soul dispersal.
Moreover, the risk of a second Wisdom Awakening was much greater than the first.
A normal cultivator with adequate soul power had about a thirty percent success rate for a first Wisdom Awakening, while the second had less than ten percent, and the third was lower still.
Of course, high risk would bring high rewards; the more times you awaken wisdom, the stronger the enhancement of comprehension for the Divine Soul.
"Don't worry, you know I'm not impulsive. I wouldn't undergo a second Wisdom Awakening without complete confidence," Xi Ying said with a smile.
"No, from the moment I met you, you've been an impulsive person," Yuan Ming replied angrily.
Xi Ying's smile froze, she glared at Yuan Ming, then continued flipping through her book, ignoring him.
"Alright, let's let this matter rest here. But you cannot proceed to a third Wisdom Awakening," Yuan Ming sighed, knowing the Black Incense Possession time was limited.
"Okay." Xi Ying raised her head, her face returning to a smiling expression.
"What's your situation now in the Sky Eagle Chamber of Commerce?" Yuan Ming sighed again, asking.
"I just became an Outer Elder of the Sky Eagle Chamber of Commerce last month, and currently I'm leading a trade caravan in Xuejing Country at the northeastern region of Central Continent. If this business succeeds, I'll have the opportunity to be promoted to Internal Elder," Xi Ying said.
"Your advancement is swift, very good." Yuan Ming showed delight on his face.
The Sky Eagle Chamber of Commerce was a super chamber of commerce on the Central Continent, although not as widespread as the Ten Thousand Goods Immortal Trip across the Chuyun Realm, it ranked among the top two or three. The post of Internal Elder in the Sky Eagle Chamber of Commerce already held significant status.
"By the way, the Fiery Fire Essence Stone you asked me to find just recently had some leads. However, I can't confirm the authenticity of the source's information, so I'll let you know once it's verified. As for the Earth Element Stone, Abyss Nether Stone, and Love Inquiry Heart Jade, there's no news for the time being," Xi Ying said.
"No need to rush, take your time searching," Yuan Ming replied.
"Once matters here in Xuejing Country are settled, I'll take the caravan to the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range." Xi Ying suddenly said.
"The Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range... What are you going there for? Gathering supplies?" Yuan Ming paused and asked.
"That's one reason, but more importantly, there's recently been a rumor of Heavenly Fire appearing there. I want to try my luck," Xi Ying said.
"Heavenly Fire! Do you know which kind?" Yuan Ming's soul power fluctuated sharply, immediately asking.
"No, this news is just a rumor for now," Xi Ying shook her head.
"Even if it's merely a rumor, Heavenly Fire is incredibly precious; not just your Sky Eagle Chamber of Commerce, even the noteworthy sects and forces on Central Continent would likely send people to investigate. You must ensure your safety," Yuan Ming said after a brief silence.
"You needn't worry too much. Although occupied with the chamber's affairs these years, I haven't neglected cultivation. My cultivation has advanced to the middle-stage Returning Void, backed by the Sky Eagle Chamber of Commerce; ordinarily, there wouldn't be any danger," Xi Ying said.
"That's good. Wulu is in the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range; when you get there, you can contact him for assistance," Yuan Ming said.
"I can handle these matters myself, but you, possessing Guoguo this time, aren't just handing over the 'Pill King Secret Manual', are you? Just say what's on your mind, time's running short," Xi Ying put down the book in her hand and said lightly.
"How did you guess that?" Yuan Ming couldn't help but feel speechless.
"The Wisdom Awakening Secret Technique causes a transformation of the Divine Soul, enhancing more than just comprehension," Xi Ying said indifferently.
"There is indeed something..." Yuan Ming briefly explained the matter of relocating a large number of believers to the Shura Palace and his current dilemma of how to manage them.
Xi Ying smiled slightly and said, "This is simple. Mortals are ignorant and usually live passively without much thought. You just need to give them a clear goal, and most will obediently follow."
"You can refer to the national systems of the mortal world on the Yunhuang Continent, integrate those mortals into a country, and as long as you control the leaders, those mortals won't cause major disturbances."
"As for those cultivators, since you've already established the name of the Moon Sect, you might as well form a sect. The sect system is very popular in the Chuyun Realm for a reason, especially good for managing cultivators. It works well, and you just need to establish hierarchies and rules for rewards and punishments. With the resources at hand, it's not difficult to manage those cultivators..."
Xi Ying spoke eloquently, quickly dispelling the worries in Yuan Ming's heart.
"So that's how it is. I knew asking you about this was the right choice," Yuan Ming laughed.
He then inquired about some details, and the time for the Black Incense Possession was up.
"Xi Ying is already in the middle-stage of Returning Void. I must accelerate my cultivation too. Only by advancing to the Dharma manifestation Stage quickly can I avoid being passive when facing people like Mao Yi," Yuan Ming's consciousness returned to his own body, and he furrowed his brows, starting to contemplate his next cultivation plan.
Now that he no longer uses the Shura Blood Devouring Map and Desire Power, the progression speed of his soul cultivation and body cultivation had slowed down, with only his magic practice able to advance significantly.
With the cultivation speed of the Primordial True Skill and the Jade Liquid and Ginseng Origin Pills in his possession, he could quickly break through to the late stage of Returning Void, and reaching the peak was within sight. Your support on * keeps this series going.
Right now, he needs to first obtain the other half of the "Pill King Secret Manual" from Yun Luo Fairy.
The Dan Recipe for the Dharma Manifestation Pill he longed for was most likely in that half of the secret manual.
Yuan Ming smiled slightly; it might be difficult for others to find Yun Luo Fairy, but it was very simple for him.
He put away the Stealing Heaven Tripod and closed his eyes to cultivate.
Seven days passed swiftly.
Yuan Ming once again took out the Stealing Heaven Tripod, lit the Black Incense, and chose to possess Yun Luo Fairy.
As the darkness before his eyes gradually lightened, he slowly opened his eyes but couldn't see anything. He only felt an indescribable intense pain coming from all over his body.
Yuan Ming instinctively struggled a bit, and immediately there was a clinking sound of chains. The intense pain that enveloped his entire body immediately surged again like a tide.
Yuan Ming forced open his blood-crusted eyes, and in his blurred vision, he saw a dim cavern prison, with torches burning dimly all around and the distant sound of dripping water.
He turned his head with difficulty and found Yun Luo Fairy's hands pierced by black iron nails, pulled by two thigh-thick chains, dragging her body, and suspending it on a rack.
Her body was covered with scars, her feet also pierced by black nails, and below hung an octagonal stone platform carved with dense and intricate runes.
With a slight sensing of his Divine Sense, Yuan Ming found that Yun Luo Fairy's mana had been entirely sealed, and her storage magic artifacts were also gone, leaving only deep scars reaching to the bone.
His heart sank, realizing that Yun Luo Fairy ultimately failed to escape, but he didn't know which faction in Dongji Palace had captured her.
As he pondered, there was a "smack" sound of a whip swinging, remarkably clear in the empty cavern prison.
Yuan Ming's body, as if having muscle memory, involuntarily shivered.
He lifted his heavy eyelids and looked towards the sound.
With the sound of footsteps, a tall woman in a purple skirt appeared, holding a blood-stained fiery red long whip.
Behind her stood two women dressed in identical long skirts, except their color was pure white.
The leading woman in the purple skirt was very beautiful, with a face like a white fox and seductive almond-shaped eyes, exuding a captivating and mesmerizing charm, as if a fox turned humanoid.
"Hehe, Junior Sister Yun Luo, you've rested for one incense stick of time, it's time for Senior Sister to continue whipping you," the woman raised her hand, hooking Yun Luo Fairy's chin, and spoke flirtatiously.
Upon hearing this address, Yuan Ming's heart filled with suspicion. The ones who captured, imprisoned, and tortured Yun Luo Fairy were from the Su Nu Sect.
Why is this?
Could it be that the words Yun Luo Fairy said about being ordered to infiltrate the Dongji Sea to find Emperor Yan's Tomb were all lies?
Or did she plan to swallow the half of the "Pill King Secret Manual" privately after obtaining it, which led to the sect's punishment?

chapters.title: Chapter 840 - 811: Searching for the Island
chapters.content:
"What will it take for you to let me go?" Yuan Ming suppressed the many doubts in his heart, controlling Yun Luo Fairy, and said these words.
"Oh, finally speaking up? Didn't I make it clear, Junior Sister? As long as you hand over Yuan Ming's hiding place and promise to help me find the other half of the Pill King Secret Manual and the Complete Heaven Exquisite Tripod, I naturally won't make things difficult for you. Junior Sister Yunluo knows that of all the junior sisters in your generation, you're the one I've always liked the most." The woman in the purple skirt noticed Yun Luo Fairy speaking up, showing a joyful expression, and said softly.
"I've already said, I'm not familiar with Yuan Ming at all. We parted ways to act separately after seizing the treasure in Emperor Yan's Mausoleum. How could I know where he is now..." Yuan Ming carefully considered his words to avoid revealing any flaws, speaking slowly.
Before he could finish speaking, a crisp whip sound rang out.
Then, he felt an intense burning pain on his face, as if the flesh on his cheeks was being torn apart, and the feel of a whip's touch was transmitted through his bones.
Having her mana sealed, Yun Luo Fairy's physical body wasn't particularly strong, and under the whipping, it was hard to endure. At this moment, Yuan Ming was temporarily enduring all this pain on behalf of the woman.
"Junior Sister Yunluo, do you think I'm a three-year-old child to believe such absurd words? The inheritance of the Pill King Pavilion is so important; with your way of handling things, would you cooperate with someone you know so little about?" The woman in the purple skirt asked with an unfaltering smile after delivering a whip.
Yuan Ming, realizing that speaking too much would lead to trouble, simply kept his mouth shut and did not speak again.
The consequence of this was taking two more merciless lashes from the woman in the purple skirt, causing him to wince in pain, letting out a muffled groan.
"Senior Sister Zi Mei, Yunluo was known as a hard nut to crack back in the sect. Beating her like this will likely have no effect, just wasting time. Better to use the Soul-splitting Talisman instead." A voice coldly spoke from behind the woman in the purple skirt.
The white-dressed woman speaking was equally beautiful, with bright eyes and white teeth, though slightly less so compared to the woman in the purple skirt, still a top beauty. However, her pupils were a bit unusual; upon closer look, they were slightly narrower than normal, giving her a more sinister and cold look.
Another white-dressed woman, also a beauty, had a rather gentle temperament, giving a feeling like warm water, lips slightly pursed, and gazed at Yun Luo Fairy with a hint of reluctance.
Zi Mei looked at the cold-eyed woman, waved her hand, and tossed the whip over.
The cold-eyed woman caught the whip, a hint of a cruel smile flashing at the corner of her mouth, took out a black talisman from her bosom, and pasted it on the handle. The fiery red whip immediately radiated a layer of crystalline black light.
She stepped forward two steps, looked at Yun Luo Fairy, and with a single hand swung sharply; the long whip, like a black snake, lashed out again on Yun Luo Fairy's body.
"Snap"
Yuan Ming widened his eyes abruptly; this time, in addition to the physical pain, his divine soul also seemed to have been severely whipped. The pain penetrated directly into the deepest part of his soul, even he found it hard to bear.
Yet, Yuan Ming gritted his teeth without making a sound, quietly channeling his divine sense.
The three saw Yuan Ming still not making a sound and had a look of surprise in their eyes, though their expressions were different.
They knew very well the effect of the Soul-splitting Talisman; the pain hitting the divine soul was not something that could merely be endured through grit.
"Bitch, don't think that just enduring the pain would allow you to get through. Let me tell you, the sect will soon send a soul cultivator here, and when the barrier in your Sea of Consciousness is broken, we'll conduct a Soul Search and still get what we want. By then, it's not just you; none of your family will survive." The cold-eyed woman exchanged a glance with Zi Mei and said coldly.
After speaking, she continued to vent her anger by lashing Yun Luo Fairy's body everywhere madly.
Yuan Ming, while enduring the pain from the whipping, was spreading his divine sense outwards.
These people had sealed Yun Luo Fairy's mana and trapped her divine soul, but Yuan Ming's divine soul was not restricted. His divine thought quickly spread out, probing the surroundings.
However, the dungeon prison's outside was also cast with a formation to obscure things. Yuan Ming, after all, wasn't truly present as his whole divine soul, but had descended in spirit. His divine power was greatly reduced, and with strenuous effort, he only got a rough sense.
He only clearly saw that the location this dungeon prison was in was a desolate island in the sea, with the only distinguishable feature being a lake outlined like a crescent moon.
Being attacked while in a state of possession would shorten the time he could remain possessed.
Before Yuan Ming could get a clearer look, his consciousness returned to his body.
He opened his eyes and first felt an intense pain sweeping through his entire body including his divine soul. He hurriedly activated a spell to nourish his soul. Although the Soul-splitting Talisman had a great impact on the soul, with his current soul recovery capacity, he wasn't too worried.
However, he wasn't sure how long Yun Luo Fairy could hold on under these circumstances.
But since they mentioned waiting for the sect to send a soul cultivator, until then, it would at most be some physical and soul suffering, probably not fatally harming the woman.
This thought flashed briefly through Yuan Ming's mind. He calmed himself and began pondering the earlier events, feeling that there was probably more to Yun Luo Fairy's plight than met the eye.
Yuan Ming considered himself only a casual acquaintance of the woman, and with her deep thoughts which he couldn't fully grasp, if not for the Dharma Manifestation Pill recipe, he would naturally leave her to her fate rather than get involved.
Yet, the Dharma Manifestation Pill recipe was still with Yun Luo Fairy, along with the last wishes of Emperor Yan's Residual Soul...
Yuan Ming quickly dismissed all distracting thoughts; he had to save Yun Luo Fairy.
However, to rescue someone, he had to first locate the place, but the previously seen desolate island and Crescent Lake were too vague. Relying solely on that to find the location was akin to fishing for a needle in the sea.
Just as Yuan Ming was pondering, a massive shadow swept across above his head—it was Lei Yu.
* (*) hosts the original.
Hua Zhi jumped down from Lei Yu's back, landing nearby.
"Master, we've been here for several days already, and it's really dull. Can't you let me go out and have some fun? There's nothing interesting inside this Shura Palace," Hua Zhi complained, somewhat depressed, as she came before Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming was about to scold her when a thought suddenly crossed his mind, and he said immediately, "Since you're bored, I'll find you something to do."
"What is it?" Hua Zhi perked up at once.
"Can't you command demon beasts? Help me find a place," Yuan Ming said.
"What kind of place?" Hua Zhi asked.
"A round deserted island with a crescent-shaped lake on it. The lake isn't large, covering about one-fifth of the island," Yuan Ming carefully described the island where Yun Luo Fairy was imprisoned.
"In which direction?" Hua Zhi asked.
"I don't know," Yuan Ming shook his head.
"Besides what you just said, are there any other characteristics?" Hua Zhi continued to ask.
"No," Yuan Ming replied.
"The Dongji Sea is vast and boundless, with countless islands. With so little information, where am I supposed to start looking..." Hua Zhi frowned, appearing somewhat troubled.
"Precisely because it's hard to find that I'm giving this task to you. If you can't do it, I'll let Vajra give it a try," Yuan Ming shifted his tone, looking at the Spiritual Beast Bag hanging at his waist containing Vajra.
"Wait, I can definitely find it! Count on me for this small task, but I'm not fast on foot, and will need Lei Yu's help this time," Hua Zhi responded immediately.
"Alright," Yuan Ming nodded.
Upon hearing this, Hua Zhi raised her hand to her mouth and gave a loud whistle.
Lei Yu, soaring in the sky, immediately swooped down with its wings fully spread. As it approached, Hua Zhi leapt lightly into the air, landing gracefully on Lei Yu's back.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming merely smiled slightly, and with a wave of his hand, sent Hua Zhi and Lei Yu out of the Shura Palace.
"And you, if you're feeling restless, you can also go out for a while?" He then patted the Spiritual Beast Bag at his waist, asking Vajra.
"Master, I have no problem fighting, but I'm not good at searching for people," Vajra replied briskly.
Hearing this, Yuan Ming simply smiled without comment, and with a flash, he appeared outside as well.
He stored away the Shura Palace, taking the reef turtle with it, and his figure transformed into a streak of azure light, flying off into the distance.
...
A few months later, in the northwest of the Dongji Sea, on Wuya Island.
Wuya Island is one of the largest among the many affiliated islands of the Dongji Sea. Its Island Master, Ye Wuya, had long reached the Returning to Void Peak in his cultivation, and was assisted by several Deputy Island Masters at the Returning to Void Stage. Although nominally subordinate to Dongji Palace, in reality, they operated independently and mostly ignored Dongji Palace's orders.
While Dongji Palace was displeased, it also feared the strength of Wuya Island. As long as they did not openly raise a flag of rebellion, threatening the rule of Dongji Palace, they were left alone, and Dongji Palace was reluctant to provoke them.
Thanks to this, the prosperity of Wuya Island far exceeded that of the other islands in the Dongji Sea. Various factions ran businesses here, even many shops that couldn't conveniently establish themselves on East Extreme Island.
Qingjin Building was one of them.
This building had significant backing, reportedly having some indescribable connections with Dongji Palace, Azure Dragon Pond, and Luo Jia Mountain. Specializing in the intelligence business, its power was astonishing. Rumor had it that as long as one was willing to spend Spirit Stones, any information could be obtained.
Yet, because Qingjin Building was too adept at maneuvering, it was disliked by Dongji Palace Master Ouyang Qiang, and thus had never set up a branch on East Extreme Island.
The Qingjin Building on Wuya Island was located at the far end of the workshop, a five-story tall building with white jade qilin statues on either side of the entrance. Its roof was in the style of overhanging gables, carved with dragons and phoenixes, exuding classical charm. The scent of incense and the sounds of silk and bamboo orchestra floated out, giving it the appearance of a mundane world brothel.
Today, there were few guests inside the building, and a slender Foundation Establishment Stage youth standing outside the door was feeling somewhat bored. Suddenly, he heard a voice.
"Is this the Qingjin Building?"
The youth quickly turned around to see a man dressed in blue, who had appeared some distance away, surveying the tall building behind the youth.

chapters.title: Chapter 841 - 812: Idle is still idle
chapters.content:
"This is Qingjin Building, welcome, esteemed senior. What instructions do you have for us?" The thin young man quickly stood up, bowed to the green-clothed man, and greeted him.
"Coming to your Qingjin Building, naturally, I am here to gather information." The green-clothed man took out a Mid-grade Spirit Stone and tossed it over.
"Thank you, esteemed senior. As you can see, our Qingjin Building has five floors. The first floor only sells information related to the Core Formation Stage and below, the second floor is for Nascent Soul Stage information, and the third floor deals with Returning to Void Stage information. As for the fourth and fifth floors, only honored guests approved by the tower master can ascend. Esteemed senior may choose according to your needs." The thin young man received the Spirit Stone, feeling delighted, and quickly introduced.
"Take me to the third floor." The green-clothed man said after a brief contemplation.
"Esteemed senior, please follow me." The thin young man responded and led the man into the Qingjin Building.
Inside the first-floor hall of Qingjin Building, there were numerous women mingling around; some played the zither, and others danced, truly resembling an artist venue in the mundane world.
"Your Qingjin Building is indeed quite different." The green-clothed man said.
"We at Qingjin Building not only sell information but also engage in dual cultivation business. The sisters in the building are personally trained by the tower master and will surely satisfy esteemed senior. Would you need me to arrange something for you?" The young man said familiarly.
"No need, just lead the way." The green-clothed man said with a cold expression.
Seeing this, the young man shrank his neck, dared not say more, and led the green-clothed man to an elegant room on the third floor.
"Esteemed senior, please wait here for a moment, I will fetch a deacon over..." The thin young man said.
"I have already been aware of this honored guest. I am Tao Rui. May I know this Fellow Daoist's full name? What information do you wish to inquire about at our Qingjin Building?" Just as the young man's voice trailed off, a charming woman in a jade-colored long dress entered and gestured for the thin young man to leave.
This woman was also a Returning to Void Cultivator, her face like a peach blossom, fingers smooth and long, exuding a faint hint of fragrance as she walked around casually.
"I am Vajra, and I have come to Qingjin Building this time to find a certain place." The green-clothed man said with a calm expression.
This man was actually Yuan Ming, who had changed his appearance. No matter how great his Divine Skills, searching for the unknown Moon Lake deserted island alone was akin to finding a needle in a haystack. Spending money to hire these information brokers to help find the location where Yun Luo Fairy is imprisoned was undoubtedly the best choice.
However, this Qingjin Building disappointed him, as it turned out to be a place dealing in flesh trade.
The people from the Su Nu Sect may not stay on that deserted island for long; it seems that after leaving Qingjin Building, he still needs to seek other information brokers to search for the Moon Lake deserted island.
"I wonder what place Fellow Daoist is trying to find? Our building has unique methods for locating places. As long as the place Fellow Daoist is looking for is within the Dongji Sea region, our building is confident to find it." Tao Rui, upon hearing this, smiled slightly and confidently said.
Yuan Ming's eyes flashed with an unusual look, and he took out a Jade Scroll and handed it over. Inside was a topographical map he had drawn of Moon Lake deserted island.
"It looks like a deserted island, but the Moon Lake is quite a notable feature, so it shouldn't be difficult to find. However, such deserted islands are rarely visited, and our building will need some time to gather information." Tao Rui explored with Divine Sense and quickly replied.
Yuan Ming was inwardly surprised, as Qingjin Building agreed so comprehensively. Could it truly have some special methods?
"How long will it take?" He asked after a brief consideration.
"At least a year. The Dongji Sea is vast and boundless, and deserted islands are as many as a sea of smoke. Even for our building, searching throughout the Dongji Sea will take time. Moreover, the map you drew is somewhat crude, and we might find many similar islands. This, please forgive us, Fellow Daoist." Tao Rui said.
"I heard that as long as one is willing to spend Spirit Stones at Qingjin Building, nothing is undoable. Here is a deposit of one hundred thousand Spirit Stones, and after the task is completed, I will pay double. However, I must find the target within three months." Yuan Ming took out a Storage Bag and tossed it on the table with a crisp "pop".
Tao Rui's body slightly trembled upon hearing a deposit of one hundred thousand Spirit Stones, but she still shook her head and said, "Three months? That time frame is too rushed."
"I will pay triple afterward." Yuan Ming lightly tapped the table with his finger and said.
The people from the Su Nu Sect might leave at any time. If Yun Luo Fairy is taken to the Central Continent, it would be disastrous. The Moon Lake deserted island must be found quickly. As for the expenditure of three to four hundred thousand Spirit Stones, it is insignificant compared to the Dharma Manifestation Pill Recipe.
"Alright, since Fellow Daoist Jin is so generous, our building will not let Fellow Daoist down." Tao Rui raised her eyebrows and stood up, saying.
"Qingjin Building's reputation is well-deserved. In the three-month time frame, however many islands you can find, provide them to me first. Whether it's the place I'm looking for, I will determine myself." Yuan Ming said with a slight smile.
"Alright, we ask Fellow Daoist to leave a contact address so that we can deliver the information in due course." Tao Rui said.
"I will be staying at Tongju Pavilion on Wuya Island for the next three months. Fellow Daoist Tao Rui can send any information there." Yuan Ming said.
Tongju Pavilion is an inn on Wuya Island offering lodging to visiting cultivators.
Since he was waiting for information, Yuan Ming found it inconvenient to stray far from Wuya Island. Hiding outside the island would only draw more attention. Therefore, he rented a place at Tongju Pavilion.
With matters settled, Yuan Ming soon took his leave.
Since Qingjin Building gave a certain promise, and Hua Zhi was also searching through her channels, he didn't go looking for other intelligence dealers. If the matter of someone investigating the deserted island of Moon Lake spread, it would be unfavorable for him.
Leaving Qingjin Building, Yuan Ming did not immediately return to Tongju Pavilion but went to the spiritual medicine shop in the Wuya Island workshop to purchase a large batch of low-level spiritual materials used for refining Qi Refinement and Foundation Establishment Stage Elixirs.
The time needed to gather intelligence was not long, and using it for cultivation would not yield much improvement. So instead of idling, it was better spent on researching and refining miscellaneous arts.
Now, with the "Pill King Secret Manual" in hand, possessing countless Dan Recipes, combined with the Fire Control Secret Technique, Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter, and the Complete Heaven Exquisite Tripod for assistance, not learning alchemy would truly be a waste.
So he took the materials he bought back to Tongju Pavilion and devoted himself to cultivating the Alchemy Technique.
With Yuan Ming's current fire control skills and soul cultivation proficiency, getting started in alchemy was quite simple. It took less than two or three days for him to become familiar with the method of refining low-level elixirs, and with the aid of the Complete Heaven Exquisite Tripod, he raised the pill formation rate to over ninety percent, with virtually no errors, and each elixir produced was of extremely high quality.
Of course, when refining such a level of elixir, Yuan Ming couldn't use all the power of the Complete Heaven Exquisite Tripod, not even the most basic Red Feather Bright Fire of the Earth Fire was fully utilized.
This fire is Pure Yang Fire, which can ward off evil and annihilate the Five Elements when used offensively, and when used in alchemy, it perfectly removes impurities from the spiritual medicine, greatly enhancing the quality of the elixir.
After becoming familiar with the refining of Qi Refinement and first and second grade Foundation Establishment Stage Elixirs, Yuan Ming went out to purchase spiritual materials once again and then began refining Core Formation Stage third-grade elixirs.
This time, the difficulty was much higher. The firepower of a single Earth Fire was insufficient, so Yuan Ming activated the second Earth Fire within the Complete Heaven Exquisite Tripod.
Find the translation on MV&LEMPYR.
This Earth Fire is named Warm Spring Sun Flame, a Yimu True Fire. When used against opponents, it can accelerate the user's Spiritual Energy recovery and repair hidden injuries within the body. In alchemy, it can, to some extent, boost the potency of the medicine, increasing the effective age of the spiritual medicine used.
However, even with the second Earth Fire, Yuan Ming still couldn't refine third-grade elixirs.
Yuan Ming carefully scrutinized his alchemy process and finally discovered that his problem lay in the fusion of medicinal power into a pill.
The properties of third-grade elixirs are complex, requiring a careful balance of the medicinal power proportions between different spiritual materials. This demands that the alchemist be familiar with the changes in the medicinal liquid within the alchemy furnace and that any slight change must be adjusted promptly.
Yuan Ming particularly lacked experience in this area. Even when he observed changes in the medicinal liquid, he often didn't know how to adjust.
Yuan Ming pondered for several days, realizing that he still wasn't skilled enough, so he called out Dian Xiaosan and asked him for the secrets of refining third-grade elixirs.
Dian Xiaosan, being under Yuan Ming's control, clearly understood that his treatment was entirely at Yuan Ming's discretion, so he withheld nothing. He virtually taught Yuan Ming step by step, imparting all his secrets of refining third-grade elixirs.
However, in his heart, although he acknowledged Yuan Ming's high starting point, alchemy was not something easily mastered.
First and second-grade elixirs were manageable, but from third-grade elixirs onward, the alchemist's experience significantly influenced the pill formation rate.
No matter how gifted, to achieve the level of a third-level Alchemist, one must undergo extensive study and practice, spending at least a dozen or so years to reach the threshold.
Therefore, Dian Xiaosan was prepared for long-term teaching and even secretly began planning the teaching progress, ready to guide Yuan Ming step by step.
But soon, he found that his prepared teaching plan could be thrown into the sea to feed the fish.
The reason was simply that Yuan Ming's progress was too rapid. Often Dian Xiaosan would only give a few hints, and Yuan Ming would draw inferences from them, deducing the corresponding rules on his own.
In just half a month, Yuan Ming successfully refined a third-grade elixir, reaching the level of a third-level Alchemist.
This speed left Dian Xiaosan utterly flabbergasted and dumbfounded, even suspecting that Yuan Ming was feigning ignorance of alchemy to deliberately make a fool of him.
After all, it took him over two years to reach the third-level Alchemist stage under his master's constant guidance.
Yuan Ming was certainly not an alchemy genius. His quick mastery of third-grade elixir refining was due to his exceptionally powerful Divine Soul Power, enabling rapid achievements.
Familiar with third-grade elixirs, Yuan Ming did not stop and proceeded to attempt refining the fourth-grade cultivation elixir Black Essence Pill as recorded in the "Pill King Secret Manual."
The difficulty of fourth-grade elixirs was entirely different from before, and Yuan Ming finally encountered a bottleneck, making no progress over a dozen consecutive days.
Only then did Dian Xiaosan's mindset balance quite a bit, attributing Yuan Ming's previous rapid progress to excessively advanced auxiliary means.
After all, not everyone has the resources to use a Spiritual Treasure Level alchemy furnace and Fire Burning Stick to learn to refine third-grade elixirs.
Even at the Pill King Pavilion back then, if the Pavilion Master attempted such a thing, he'd likely be scolded furiously by his disciples and elders.
It's simply too extravagant.

chapters.title: Chapter 842 - 813: Suspicious
chapters.content:
Not mentioning Dian Xiaosan's complaints, Yuan Ming reflected on his process of refining the Black Essence Pill, and realized that this time, the shortcoming was actually his Fire Control ability.
To provide the firepower required for refining a fourth-grade elixir, Yuan Ming activated a new Earth Fire named "Spirit-transforming Golden Flame", which possessed intense firepower with the magical effect of transmutation, capable of burning wood and plants into gold, and turning gold into wood and plants.
If this fire is used for pill refining, it can increase the efficiency of Spiritual Liquid solidifying into pills, thereby increasing the number of pills produced.
Even though it was just one more Earth Fire, the pressure on Yuan Ming increased exponentially.
With the assistance of the Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter, he could control three Abnormal Fires with ease, but the Black Essence Pill required coordination between several Earth Fires, which was beyond the Fire Burning Stick's control range, making it necessary for Yuan Ming to adjust them personally.
As a result, Yuan Ming's current level in the Zhu Rong Heart Technique was somewhat inadequate.
Having identified the root of the problem, he temporarily paused his practice of the Alchemy Technique and began to improve the Zhu Rong Heart Technique.
Of course, based on previous experiences, Yuan Ming knew clearly in his heart that trying to quickly improve the Zhu Rong Heart Technique on his own was absolutely impossible.
Fortunately, he had prepared for this and inquired about Dian Xiaosan's experience with practicing the Zhu Rong Heart Technique.
"Already cultivated to the fifth level, this method is truly profound, but unfortunately, it seems to lack something for further advancement. Even if I practice with all my strength, I cannot achieve the fifth level perfect." Dian Xiaosan sighed, seemingly worried that Yuan Ming might think his cultivation speed was insufficient, and specifically added a clarification.
Yuan Ming calculated the time in his mind and remained silent for a while.
At that time, he had managed to use the Stealing Heaven Tripod and risked his life to control the Bright Soul Heavenly Fire, just coinciding within a month to cultivate this method to the third level. And since Dian Xiaosan got access to the Zhu Rong Heart Technique, it's been about six months in total, yet without external assistance, he could cultivate this method to the fifth level. Truly, his talent is extraordinary, no wonder he became an Alchemy Master.
Of course, this is also related to Dian Xiaosan's inherently high fire control level.
Yuan Ming sighed to himself a few times, then sent Dian Xiaosan back to the Shura Palace, instructing him to operate the Zhu Rong Heart Technique.
Dian Xiaosan was quite puzzled by Yuan Ming's sudden request, but now he could only listen to Yuan Ming and obediently practice the Zhu Rong Heart Technique.
Feeling Dian Xiaosan's actions, Yuan Ming took out the Stealing Heaven Tripod, and inserted a stick of Black Incense, then slowly closed his eyes.
...
A month later.
"How is this possible!" Dian Xiaosan looked at the scene before him in shock, instinctively rubbing his eyes, suspecting he had fallen under an Illusion Technique.
Not far in front of him, Yuan Ming sat in front of the Complete Heaven Exquisite Tripod, slightly raising his hand, streams of light flew out from the tripod and fell into the porcelain bottle in his other hand.
The sound of elixirs filling the bottle was crisp and pleasant, but in Dian Xiaosan's ears, it was like the sound of rolling thunder, dazzling his vision with flashes.
"Master Dian, please look at the elixirs from this furnace, how is their quality?" Yuan Ming smiled as he handed over the porcelain bottle he was holding.
Dian Xiaosan came to his senses, woodenly accepted the porcelain bottle, and when he used his Divine Sense to inspect it, his face showed even more astonishment.
"These elixirs are of the highest quality, out of all the fourth-grade elixirs I have ever seen, they are difficult to compare with. Fellow Daoist Yuan's alchemist talent is truly astounding; I am completely impressed." He sighed deeply and cupped his hands towards Yuan Ming, sincerely admiring him.
"Master Dian is too modest, my achievements owe entirely to your good teaching and the assistance of the spiritual treasure; it really is nothing." Yuan Ming waved his hand, sincerely speaking.
The reason he was able to perfectly refine the Black Essence Pill was mainly due to the fact that he used the Stealing Heaven Tripod's Black Incense Possession on Dian Xiaosan to deeply comprehend it, thereby elevating the Zhu Rong Heart Technique to the fifth level, while also learning many insights from Dian Xiaosan about pill refining, leading to a rapid improvement in his Alchemy Technique.
Ultimately, he merely transferred Dian Xiaosan's talent to himself in a roundabout way through the Stealing Heaven Tripod, and now being praised so by the original owner, Yuan Ming felt a bit bashful, along with increased awe at the Stealing Heaven Tripod's miraculous effect.
Unaware of the truth, Dian Xiaosan had quite a change of heart towards Yuan Ming.
"This young man's alchemy talent is so astounding, observing his behavior these days, he is not from any Great Sect. If I could take him as a disciple, my alchemy skills would have a successor; when returning to Qingxuan Platform to compete for that artifact later on, I could have quite an aid..." Dian Xiaosan's heart was filled with different thoughts.
Yuan Ming didn't know what Dian Xiaosan was thinking, he walked to the window and looked towards the direction of Qingjin Building.
It has been more than a month, yet there has been no news from Qingjin Building; I wonder how the search is going.
Fortunately, by confirming through the Black Incense Possession, he knew that Yun Luo Fairy and the others were still on that deserted island.
"Let's be patient for a little longer..." Yuan Ming thought quietly, taking out the "Pill King Secret Manual" and started reading it.
As there was no dan recipe for fifth-grade elixirs in the "Pill King Secret Manual," he did not continue to enhance his Alchemy Technique, but instead began to research other fourth-grade elixirs.
"Let it be this Purple Thunder Pill, although it's not of high grade, if taken in large quantities, it can also accelerate Lei Yu's cultivation speed," Yuan Ming pondered to himself.
...Help us continue by reading at the source: *.
Northern part of Wuya Island, Kunyuan Palace.
