This is the place with the most abundant Spiritual Energy on Wuya Island, where Island Master Ye Wuya and several Deputy Island Masters reside.
Today, a light rain fell, with fine rainwater sprinkling on the eaves, adding a touch of misty elegance to the corridor's exterior scenery. In the pond, the fake mountain emitting a faint spirit light was soaked by the rain, surprisingly covered with drifting clouds and mist.
From time to time, fish in the pond would leap out of the water, crashing into the mist, as if trying to leap over the dragon gate, only to fall back into the water with a "splash" in the end.
Meanwhile, hurried footsteps suddenly sounded on the corridor, and Chen Luo, without appreciating the rainy scene of the pond and mountain, walked briskly, stepping into an elegant building beside the pond.
"Master, Chen Luo is here." As soon as he entered the room, he heard the voice of a child about five years old.
Looking up, Chen Luo saw that the speaker was a Jinwei parrot standing on a coral pillar.
Beside the parrot, a black-haired man in a light green robe stood quietly behind a pearl curtain, seemingly admiring the pond view, and did not show any intention to turn around upon hearing the parrot's voice.
"Lord Yin, were you looking for me?" Chen Luo dared not be negligent and cupped his hands toward the man in the green robe.
"Chen Luo, your Alchemy Technique has improved again, you're about to reach the level of a Level 5 Alchemist, right?" The parrot chirped up before the man in the green robe could speak.
"Sir Parrot overpraises me, I've only recently made some minor progress in Fire Control Technique, increasing the pill formation rate slightly; I'm still far from refining a fifth-grade elixir," Chen Luo respectfully replied to the parrot.
"Little Parrot is born with the Qi Observation Divine Ability, since it says so, it proves you already have the potential to refine a fifth-grade elixir." At this moment, the man in the green robe turned around, walked out from behind the curtain, and came before Chen Luo.
Besides Island Master Ye Wuya, there are several Returning to Void Deputy Island Masters on Wuya Island, and this man in the green robe, named Yin Lang, is one of them.
"Lord Yin, do you mean..." Chen Luo became excited upon hearing Yin Lang's words.
"You can prepare to break through to a Level 5 Alchemist. I'll gather the needed dan recipe and spiritual materials for you, but in return, you must refine elixirs without charge for me for over a hundred years after your breakthrough," Yin Lang said slowly.
"Thank you, Lord Yin, for nurturing me." Chen Luo did not hesitate at all. Compared to the temptation of breaking through to a Level 5 Alchemist, Yin Lang's condition seemed insignificant.
"This ancient Thunder Origin Pill recipe is specifically chosen for you; it belongs to a relatively easy-to-refine Level 5 Elixir. Focus on refining this pill during this period, gather the materials, and then officially start refining," Yin Lang nodded satisfactorily, casually throwing down a piece of old Jade Scroll.
"I will not fail Lord Yin's trust." Chen Luo received the dan recipe, bowed respectfully to Yin Lang, then turned and left.
"Master, after all, Chen Luo is not yet a Level 5 Alchemist. Letting him refine the Thunder Origin Pill, isn't that risky?" The Jinwei parrot suddenly spoke up after Chen Luo walked away.
"Each Level 5 Alchemist is in high demand. I wish to refine the Thunder Origin Pill, but it's inconvenient to let others know. I intended to find Dian Xiaosan, but he is nowhere to be found. Currently, besides Chen Luo, I don't have time to find anyone else; let's give it a try." Yin Lang sighed and turned around again, gazing at the rain-drenched pond.
At that moment, a koi suddenly leaped high from the pond, flying into the mist, and surprisingly leapt over the fake mountain, landing on the other side.
Unfortunately, as the fake mountain wasn't the legendary dragon gate, the koi did not turn into a True Dragon and ended up leaving the pond, landing on the muddy ground instead.
Yin Lang didn't feel any bad luck witnessing this. He raised his hand, used Mana to capture the koi in the air, looked at it twice, and then tossed it toward the Jinwei parrot.
The Jinwei parrot's eyes brightened instantly, it opened its beak and sprayed a rainbow-colored light to wrap the koi, swallowing it into its belly.
Judging from the aura it emitted while casting, this parrot turned out to be a Fourth-level Peak Demon Beast, seemingly only a step away from breaking through.
After feeding the spirit beast, Yin Lang seemed a bit tired, sat on a cushion by the desk, and silently began cultivating.
Yet, less than half a day passed before Chen Luo unexpectedly returned, with a look of shock on his face.
"What's going on? Didn't I tell you to study the Thunder Origin Pill recipe? Why have you come back now?" Yin Lang asked displeased.
"Reporting to you, sir, upon examining the Thunder Origin Pill recipe, I found it quite enigmatic, so I first went to the workshop to purchase the needed spiritual materials, only to find that two main ingredients were unavailable. Upon inquiry, I learned that recently, someone on the island's workshop has been purchasing a large number of alchemy spiritual materials, including many that match those of the Thunder Origin Pill recipe," Chen Luo hesitated and said.
"Oh, is there such a thing? Do you know who that person is and where they are now?" Yin Lang was a bit surprised.
"I've already sent someone to investigate, but we have no results yet," Chen Luo quickly replied.
"This matter indeed seems a bit peculiar... I'll go with you," Yin Lang pondered for a moment, then suddenly stood up, stored the parrot into the Spiritual Beast Bag, and went outside with Chen Luo.

chapters.title: Chapter 843 - 814: Significant Progress in Pill Techniques
chapters.content:
On the other side, in Tongju Pavilion.
In the room Yuan Ming rented, a furnace of Purple Thunder Pills had just been completed, resulting in as many as six pills.
"Finally, it's done..." Yuan Ming exhaled lightly, pinching a Purple Thunder Pill with two fingers and bringing it close to his eyes for examination.
The pill was entirely black, containing a potent power of thunder and lightning, a type of elixir for enhancing cultivation, suitable for cultivators practicing Thunder Attribute Techniques.
Of course, demon beasts like Lei Yu, who have a thunder attribute, can also consume this pill to accelerate their cultivation progress.
Among his three spirit beasts, Hua Zhi and Vajra had exceptional talent, requiring little of his attention, as they had their own methods of cultivation and progressed swiftly.
In comparison, Lei Yu was much slower, trailing far behind.
Although the grade of the Purple Thunder Pill wasn't high, consuming it in large amounts could significantly boost Lei Yu's cultivation speed without any side effects.
Yuan Ming carefully stored the pills in a porcelain bottle and then packed away all the alchemy tools.
The time he agreed upon with Qingjin Building was already halfway through, and he had nearly mastered the Alchemy Technique. During this time, he had openly purchased various spiritual materials for alchemy, drawing quite a bit of attention.
For safety's sake, Yuan Ming didn't plan to stay on Wuya Island any longer, to avoid being caught by Dongji Palace.
As for this room, he naturally wouldn't return it. He intended to leave a soul crow on the beam, awaiting news from Qingjin Building.
Upon settling everything, Yuan Ming was just about to leave when he suddenly stopped in his tracks, sensing something.
"Is Vajra Daoist home?" Simultaneously, a voice transmission suddenly came from outside the room.
Yuan Ming immediately frowned, and his Divine Sense extended outside the room.
He saw two figures standing outside the room's formation, one in a flowing blue robe with an elegant appearance, he recognized as the Deputy Island Master Yin Lang. The other, with white hair and beard, resembling an old man, was Chen Luo, who accompanied Yin Lang to find Yuan Ming.
Before arriving on Wuya Island, Yuan Ming conducted some investigation into the island's intelligence and recognized Yin Lang's identity, which made him uneasy.
However, the soul crows he had scattered around Wuya Island hadn't detected a large presence of Dongji Palace cultivators, so he chose not to act hastily and instead feigned ignorance as he flew out of the room.
"You two are..." Yuan Ming cupped his hands toward Yin Lang and Chen Luo, asking with some hesitation.
"Vajra Daoist, forgive us for the unannounced visit. I am Chen Luo, an Alchemist of Wuya Island, and this is Lord Yin Lang, the Deputy Island Master." Dressed in white, Chen Luo immediately introduced himself upon seeing Yuan Ming.
In recent days, Yuan Ming had been concealing his cultivation level, but to purchase Level 4 spiritual materials, he had displayed a Nascent Soul level of cultivation, which is why Chen Luo addressed him as a peer.
"Ah, Senior Yin and Fellow Daoist Chen, nice to meet you. What might be the purpose of your visit today?" Yuan Ming feigned politeness with a few words before getting straight to the point.
"This isn't the place to talk..." Chen Luo glanced around.
Yuan Ming immediately understood and invited them into the room.
The formation in the rented room on Wuya Island wasn't very strong, but Yuan Ming had secretly modified it. Now it was powerful enough to trap a Returning to Void Cultivator for several moments, so letting Yin Lang and Chen enter the room to talk was precisely what he intended.
"Vajra Daoist is an Alchemist, correct?" As soon as they were seated in the room, Chen Luo started warmly.
"How did Fellow Daoist Chen figure that out?" Yuan Ming raised an eyebrow, not admitting to anything.
"Well, it's quite coincidental. Recently, under the Island Master's orders, I intended to refine an elixir, and when I inquired at the island's workshops, I found that certain spiritual materials had been purchased in advance. After much searching, I found them here with Fellow Daoist Jin, hence the question." Chen Luo replied with a smile.
"I see. So you and Lord Yin came for those spiritual materials? I'm afraid you'll have made the trip for nothing; those materials have already been turned into elixirs and can't be extracted again." Yuan Ming nodded, feeling a bit helpless inside.
The spiritual materials required for Purple Thunder Pills weren't particularly rare, and he had assumed that on a large island like Wuya, the circulation of such common Level 4 materials would at most draw the attention of some Nascent Soul cultivators. He believed he could handle any trouble with ease.
But who would have thought that a formidable Deputy Island Master at the Returning Void Stage would care about the whereabouts of some Level 4 spiritual materials?
Thanks for reading—brought to you by *.
"You've misunderstood, Fellow Daoist Jin. Such trivial spiritual materials are of little consequence. We are actually here to invite you to join Wuya Island." Chen Luo shook his head at this point, revealing a surprising intention.
"I apologize; I am accustomed to being a Loose Cultivator and have no current plans to join any organization." Yuan Ming was slightly stunned, immediately using his usual excuse.
"Don't rush, young friend. Listen to me talk about the benefits first before making a decision. As long as you're willing to join our island, the treatment will be on the same level as us Returning to Void cultivators. Aside from being required to refine a batch of elixirs for our island from time to time, there are no other mandatory requirements. If you wish to try breaking through to the Returning to Void stage in the future, the resources needed can also be provided for free," Yin Lang suddenly interrupted Yuan Ming, extending an earnest invitation.
Beside him, Chen Luo was also somewhat astounded upon hearing his words.
Even a top-tier Level 4 Alchemist cannot receive treatment equal to that of a Returning to Void Cultivator, yet Yin Lang was willing to pay such a high price, indicating then...
Could this obscure figure referred to as "Vajra" actually be a Level 5 Alchemist?
Chen Luo's first reaction was to doubt that Yin Lang had seen wrong. After all, the other party only bought Level 4 spiritual materials, not necessarily to refine Level 5 elixirs. Moreover, a Level 5 Alchemist is extremely dignified in the Dongji Sea, respected by everyone, and can be treated as a distinguished guest on virtually any island. Why would they choose to roam as a Loose Cultivator?
But since Yin Lang dared to propose such conditions, he must be confident in his judgment. Chen Luo recalled Lord Yin's parrot spirit beast, and any words of dissuasion suddenly stuck in his throat.
"Senior Yin, I truly appreciate your kindness, but I have no intention of joining any faction. Please forgive me," Yuan Ming shook his head and declined.
"Young friend Jin, are you sure you don't want to reconsider? As an Alchemist, having no support from a faction can make daily expenses quite a hefty sum. Furthermore, the Dongji Sea is vast, handling matters on one's own can be limited. Although we at Wuya Island may not be on par with Dongji Palace, we can still offer considerable assistance," Yin Lang didn't retreat, clearly determined not to stop until he achieved his goal.
Upon hearing these words, Yuan Ming's expression darkened slightly.
What he had revealed on Wuya Island was no more than the skills of a Level 4 Alchemist. It's not surprising for someone from Wuya Island to come to recruit him, but Yin Lang's unwavering attitude was somewhat peculiar.
"Could it be that Yin Lang has some special means to see through my true identity?" Yuan Ming was startled, immediately preparing for the worst outcome. His fingers hidden in the sleeve subtly made a casting gesture, ready to unleash a spell.
However, considering that he still needed to go to Qingjin Building for information, he refrained from acting rashly.
"Senior Yin, I won't hide it from you anymore. I am indeed tempted by these conditions you've mentioned, but I am currently honing my Dao Heart, seeking the chance to reach the Returning to Void stage, and can't stay in one place for long. However, please rest assured, Lord Yin. If I ever wish to settle down, I will certainly prioritize your island," after contemplating for a moment, Yuan Ming found another excuse.
"I see, then I shall not persuade you further. That said, I have a personal request. Would you be willing to refine a batch of elixirs for me? We can discuss the payment," Yin Lang sighed with regret and then spoke again, his eyes gleaming with a passion that wasn't there before.
"Could I have misunderstood? Yin Lang didn't discover my identity, and his true purpose lies here?" Yuan Ming mused, startled by his behavior.
"I am merely a Level 4 Alchemist. Wuya Island is vast and prosperous; surely, you don't lack Level 4 Alchemists. Not to mention, Fellow Daoist Chen Luo is a seasoned Level 4 Alchemist; his Alchemy Technique is far superior to mine," Yuan Ming glanced at Chen Luo and said.
"Chen Luo can indeed refine these elixirs, but Fellow Daoist Jin's Alchemy Technique is not inferior to Chen Luo's. These elixirs are highly demanded, the more the merrier, so I wish to also seek your assistance," Yin Lang said with a smile.
"Since Senior Yin insists, it would be ungracious of me not to agree. Yet, I haven't been in a favorable state recently, and hurried refinement might be unsuccessful. Would Lord Yin allow me a few days' rest before I help with the alchemy?" after a brief thought, Yuan Ming finally consented.
"Excellent, then I will pay you a visit in five days. During this time, I'll cover your expenses on the island as a gesture of goodwill. Please do not refuse," Yin Lang said with delight.
Yuan Ming engaged in pleasantries, agreeing to the arrangement.
The atmosphere among the three grew congenial, laughing and chatting for a while before Yin Lang stood up to leave.
Chen Luo quickly followed, but before leaving, he turned around and gave Yuan Ming a glance, with an indescribable look in his eyes, perhaps of envy or resentment.
After seeing them off, Yuan Ming's expression quickly darkened. Without hesitation, he changed his appearance and quietly left the room, heading directly to Qingjin Building.
No matter whether Yin Lang had come to see him for alchemy or to probe him, Wuya Island must no longer be a place to stay.
In Qingjin Building, Yuan Ming met Tao Rui once again.
"Deacon Tao, most of the three-month period has passed, yet you've shown no progress. Is this how Qingjin Building operates?" Yuan Ming asked solemnly.
"Fellow Daoist Jin, for your task, our building has already mobilized people for an expedited search. We have currently identified two to three probable locations and were just about to send them to you. I didn't expect that Vajra Daoist would come in person," Tao Rui hurriedly responded, handing over a map Jade Scroll.
Yuan Ming took the Jade Scroll, and his Divine Sense probed it, finding indeed three marked locations.
"In that case, I'll first go and verify these three locations. Fellow Daoist Tao Rui, if you find other places, please contact me directly using these Communication Talismans," he took out three blood-colored Communication Talismans and placed them on the table.
These Communication Talismans can connect to his Void Communication Array, allowing transmission over greater distances than ordinary Communication Talismans.
"Alright," Tao Rui nodded.
Hurried to leave Wuya Island, Yuan Ming quickly rose to take his leave.

chapters.title: Chapter 844 - 815: Mixed Feelings
chapters.content:
On the other side, Yin Lang and Chen Luo were still on their way back to Kunyuan Palace.
Yin Lang appeared calm, but his eyes were somewhat gloomy.
Seeing this, Chen Luo dared not speak much and could only follow silently, speculating in his heart about the origin of Yuan Ming.
What he didn't know was that at this moment, Yin Lang was actually communicating with the Jinwei Parrot inside the Spiritual Beast Bag.
"Are you sure that Vajra is at the level of a Level 5 Alchemist?" Yin Lang suddenly transmitted his voice.
"I am sure. Just now, with my Qi Observation Divine Ability, I observed this person. I found that he was hiding his cultivation level and is actually a mid-stage Returning Void Cultivator. Moreover, the fluctuations of the Fire Spirit on him are extremely agile, and his Fire Control Skills definitely reached the level of a Level 5 Alchemist. Even Dian Xiaosan you took me to see last time was just about the same. This Vajra definitely has the ability to refine a fifth-grade elixir," the Jinwei Parrot said with certainty.
"His Fire Control Skills are similar to Dian Xiaosan's! When did such an Alchemist appear in the Eastern Sea? Is it possible this person is Dian Xiaosan in disguise?" Yin Lang frowned slightly.
"Absolutely impossible. This person's aura is completely different from Dian Xiaosan's. Dian Xiaosan cultivates the Green Wood Flame Technique of Qingxuan Platform, which primarily focuses on Wood and Fire attributes and naturally manifests the phenomenon of wood creating fire. However, this Vajra's aura is more mixed, faintly forming a mixed hole state. The two are definitely not the same person," the Jinwei Parrot replied.
"Oh, it seems your Qi Observation Divine Ability has improved a lot and you can already see through the characteristics of a cultivator's technique. Can you see which sect or school this Vajra belongs to?" Yin Lang's eyes lit up as he asked.
"This person's cultivation technique is very peculiar, I've never seen it before. But the fluctuation of his divine soul contains a trace of faith power, he should be a Soul Cultivator," the Jinwei Parrot thought for a moment and said.
"Being both a Soul Cultivator and an Alchemy Master, there shouldn't be such a person in the Eastern Sea, perhaps he came from the Central Continent? But such a person perfectly fits my needs." Yin Lang nodded, a thoughtful look in his eyes.
"Master, if you ask me, it's better not to provoke him. Chen Luo's level has also met the requirements, let him refine the Thunder Origin Pill," the Jinwei Parrot advised against it.
"What else did you see? Why do I sense you fear that Vajra?" Yin Lang asked in surprise.
"Master, you didn't see it. The killing aura on this person is as thick as sludge, almost covering his aura. Recently, many cultivators must have died by his hands, and just now when conversing with you, he seemed to have killing intent towards you!" the Jinwei Parrot swallowed and said.
"If that's the case, this person should have come to our Wuya Island to take refuge, perhaps having offended enemies outside and mistakenly thought I would capture him? Our Wuya Island has a transcendent position, every year many such people come over, no need to pay attention," Yin Lang was indifferent.
"Master, I still think it's more appropriate to let Chen Luo refine the elixir, he isn't that bad," the Jinwei Parrot continued to advise.
Yin Lang did not heed the Jinwei Parrot's advice. He took out a Sound Transmission Talisman, arranged some people to deliver the promised Spirit Stones, and simultaneously instructed them to covertly monitor Vajra's actions, but not to watch too closely to avoid offending him.
However, Yuan Ming's decisiveness was still beyond his expectations. By the time the people he arranged arrived near Yuan Ming's room, only a short span of fifteen minutes had passed, yet the room was already empty without any sign of Yuan Ming.
His subordinates inquired with the owner of Tongju Pavilion and searched nearby but could not find him.
"It seems this person has escaped! Damn it, how dare he show me such disrespect! Immediately send someone to seal the island and search for his whereabouts!" At that moment, Yin Lang had just returned to his residence and received this report, his face darkened as he gave the order.
The subordinates hurriedly complied and quickly left.
Yin Lang furrowed his brow. This Vajra had escaped just like that. Could he really have caused some major disaster?
"Lord Yin, Island Master Ye is calling for you," at this moment, a servant walked in and respectfully said.
"The Island Master is out of retreat?" Yin Lang was somewhat surprised but dared not delay and hurried to meet Ye Wuya.
When he arrived at the main hall of the island, he found he was the last to arrive. The other three Returning to Void Deputy Island Masters on the island were already present.
As for Island Master Ye Wuya, he was already seated at the head of the main hall.
Ye Wuya's appearance was handsome, looking only about twenty-seven or twenty-eight years old, dressed in a dark green gown with bamboo patterns. His collar was slightly open, revealing baby-smooth skin, and a strand of black hair hung over his chest, adding a touch of ruffianism and free-spiritedness.
"Yin Lang pays respects to the Island Master!" Yin Lang saluted Ye Wuya.
"Sit down," Ye Wuya raised his hand and said indifferently.
Yin Lang took a seat on the left side.
A#lway+s r$ead. at the s-our$ce-—*&.
"Island Master, what has happened that we were summoned here so urgently?" asked a young man in black with a red belt around his waist sitting next to Yin Lang, looking up at the upper position.
This person was Yang Qing, the youngest Returning Void cultivator on Wuya Island, with exceptional aptitude. He had recently joined Wuya Island, and his cultivation had reached mid-stage Returning Void.
However, Yang Qing's character was arrogant, and on the entire Wuya Island, he was not convinced by anyone but Ye Wuya.
"Dongji Palace has issued a decree, requiring us to comply. Those who disobey will be deemed traitors," Ye Wuya slowly spoke.
"Has the Dongji Palace gone mad, issuing such an order! Does that woman want to start a war with our Wuya Island?" Yang Qing exclaimed in surprise.
"What exactly do they want us to do?" asked a man dressed as a scholar, seated across from them.
The man's name was Xu Changyu. Despite his cultivation being just at the Early Stage of Returning to Void, he had been following Ye Wuya the longest and was extraordinarily shrewd, acting as Ye Wuya's most trusted advisor.
Seated next to Xu Changyu was a man dressed as an old farmer named Lu He, whose cultivation was second only to Ye Wuya, having reached the peak of the Middle-stage Returning Void. However, his appearance was rather ordinary, with an aged face full of wrinkles.
"We are to capture two individuals, one named Yun Luo Fairy, at the peak of Returning to Void Late Stage, once a disciple of the Su Nu Sect, adept at Escape Skills and Illusion Techniques. The other is named Yuan Ming, with a mid-stage Returning Void cultivation level, who also practices Soul Cultivation and Body Cultivation. He is a Level 5 Array Master with extremely advanced Fire Control Skills, possibly disguising as an Alchemist." Ye Wuya said as he flicked his fingers, sending four Jade Scrolls flying to Yin Lang and the others, containing more detailed information.
To capture Yuan Ming, Dongji Palace had put in significant effort, revealing almost all of its available intel, except it didn't mention he possessed the Yan Emperor's legacy.
"I've heard of Yun Luo Fairy, the Island Master of Yunshan Island. But who is this Yuan Ming? Never heard of him. With such skills, is he really just a Loose Cultivator? And the background part about him is as if nothing has been said. Dongji Palace didn't manage to find anything either?" Xu Changyu said with a slight frown after reviewing the information.
"I'm more curious about what these two actually did. Ouyang Qiang isn't reckless. Spending such effort implies capturing these two is extremely important to her." Yang Qing chuckled and said.
"I'm still inquiring about it, but what's known is that Ouyang Qiang suffered a significant loss from them, even getting injured. Besides Dongji Palace, both Luo Jia Mountain and Azure Dragon Pond have issued similar bounties, all hunting for these two." Ye Wuya said.
"A joint bounty from three major forces? Do these two hold some great fortune? In that case, we might as well send someone to look," Xu Changyu speculated with a thoughtful look in his eyes.
"The issue is how to search? The Dongji Sea is vast; there are countless places to hide. We can't all go out and search inch by inch, can we?" Lu He finally spoke.
The group fell into silence, lured by the temptation of the bounty from Dongji Palace but knowing locating these two wasn't an easy task.
Yin Lang stared at the Jade Scroll in his hand, momentarily dazed.
The information about Yuan Ming described in the Jade Scroll matched seven or eight points with the "Vajra" they had just encountered. That person was unusually vigilant, as if they had committed some crime; it couldn't just be a coincidence, could it?
"Yin Lang, why do you have that expression? Do you perhaps have a lead?" Ye Wuya asked, noticing Yin Lang's expression.
The other three turned their attention to him upon hearing this.
"I think I might indeed have a lead here," Yin Lang hesitated before saying.
...
Half a month later.
Across the sea, Yuan Ming, having altered his appearance once more, traveled swiftly, flying toward an uninhabited island marked on his map without stopping for a moment.
Soon, a deserted island appeared in his view. Without any hesitation, his Divine Sense immediately spread out, enveloping the island below.
The intelligence from Qingjin Building recorded the positions of three deserted islands. In the past half month, he had already visited one, which wasn't the island he was looking for, and now this was the second one.
Yuan Ming's face quickly showed disappointment as the island before him also wasn't the one he was seeking.
Yuan Ming did not linger and continued flying toward the third island. Though he didn't hold much hope, he couldn't quite let it go without checking.
Seven or eight days later, he finally reached the third island, his eyes lighting up immediately.
Ironically, the terrain of this island looked exactly like the one where Yun Luo Fairy was confined.
"This Qingjin Building does have some capability; they really found it," Yuan Ming thought happily as he quietly approached the island, spreading his Divine Sense.
However, his joy quickly turned to disappointment.
At that moment, there wasn't any presence on the deserted island, and the location where Yun Luo Fairy had been held was long abandoned.
Yuan Ming frowned. Just five days ago, he had confirmed Yun Luo Fairy's location on this island through Black Incense Possession. Unexpectedly, right during the seven-day interval between possessions, her location changed.
And in the days he was traveling, Qingjin Building had sent him a few more locations of similar deserted islands via the Void Communication Array, but now there was no need to visit them.
Yuan Ming sighed and prepared to leave, planning to use the possession to confirm Yun Luo Fairy's location again in two days.
But suddenly, he sensed something and turned to look behind him before landing on the island. Activating the Transformation Stone Talisman, he immediately became an ordinary stone, standing still.

chapters.title: Chapter 845 - 816: Investigation
chapters.content:
Just as Yuan Ming concealed himself, five grand tunneling lights whistled over, stopping on the deserted island. They were five Returning to Void cultivators, one of whom was, surprisingly, Yin Lang.
"Yin Lang... How did he come here? Judging from the appearance and cultivation of these five people, could they be the five Returning to Void cultivators from Wuya Island?" Yuan Ming thought to himself.
Yuan Ming's guess was correct; the visitors were indeed the Island Master of Wuya Island, Ye Wuya, and his four Returning to Void Deputy Island Masters.
"Strange, this island is already the last of the three islands given by Qingjin Building, yet there are still no signs of Yuan Ming's presence. Yin Lang, your spirit beast didn't make a mistake, right? Did you truly detect Yuan Ming's aura earlier?" Ye Wuya looked around a few times before turning to Yin Lang.
"Reporting to the Island Master, my Seven-Colored Parrot excels at detecting auras; it definitely won't make a mistake." Yin Lang hurriedly said.
"It really is the people from Wuya Island, and they already know my real name! Damn Qingjin Building, actually selling me out! Luckily, I decided to leave right away; otherwise, I might be in some trouble if blocked!" Yuan Ming thought to himself.
"There's no sign of anyone here; could Yuan Ming have already escaped? Yin Lang, let your spirit beast take a look, which direction did Yuan Ming head to?" Ye Wuya said.
Yin Lang quickly responded and raised his hand to summon.
The Jinwei parrot flew out from the Spiritual Beast Bag at his waist, its eyes flashing with seven-colored spiritual light, looking around.
"Reporting to the Island Master, there is Yuan Ming's mana fluctuation on the island; judging from the traces, it was just left." The Jinwei parrot quickly said.
"Which direction did Yuan Ming go?" Ye Wuya nodded and asked.
The Jinwei parrot continued to look around with glowing eyes, suddenly uttering a slight exclamation: "There is no sign of Yuan Ming leaving here; it seems he hasn't left yet and is still hiding on the island!"
When Ye Wuya and the others heard this, they were both surprised and delighted; their Divine Sense swept across the deserted island repeatedly but couldn't find Yuan Ming, who had transformed into a stone.
"Let's see how long you can hide!"
Ye Wuya snorted lightly, suddenly raised his hand to form a seal. A spiritual light, resembling green bamboo, gradually illuminated him, and a Wind Roll arose, gently revolving around his body.
Then, Ye Wuya suddenly opened his mouth, emitting a Mihuan sound wave akin to a sea demon's song. The Wind Roll around him promptly surged, sending the sound wave to every corner of the deserted island.
The rock into which Yuan Ming had transformed was also swept by the sound waves; despite his Divine Soul cultivation, a momentary illusion unexpectedly appeared before his eyes.
However, when he used the Transformation Stone Talisman, his Divine Soul was firmly restricted by the talisman's power, without dispersing due to the brief hallucination, revealing his true self.
"Such formidable Wind Spirit Body; if not for the Transformation Stone Talisman's effect, I nearly exposed myself." A surprised Yuan Ming thought after regaining clarity.
Before going to Wuya Island, he had already inquired thoroughly about Ye Wuya's situation.
This person is not an ordinary cultivator; he was born with a rare Wind Bamboo Spirit Body.
It's said that people with this physique possess voices with wind-calling power. With some practice, they can summon the wind at will and call for rain with a sound, though not possessing the power of changing world laws with mere words like the Spoken Witch, it is nonetheless extraordinary.
After Ye Wuya used his divine skills and waited for several breaths, seeing no abnormal situation arise on the island, he frowned: "Impossible, under the attack of Wind Spirit Butterfly Sound, anyone under Dharma manifestation Stage will fall into illusion. Yuan Ming is just at middle-stage Returning Void; even if he's a Soul Cultivator, his Divine Soul power can't reach the Dharma manifestation Level. How could there be no reaction? Did Yin Lang's spirit beast see incorrectly?"
The other four had closed their Six Senses when Ye Wuya used his divine skills, still felt dazed, and only recovered after a while.
"Island Master, what do you think?" Yang Qing asked first.
"There is no anomaly on the island; it seems Yuan Ming is not here." Ye Wuya said slowly.
"How could that be, Yin Lang, didn't your spirit beast say that it hadn't detected any mana traces of Yuan Ming leaving?" Yang Qing looked towards Yin Lang.
"The Seven-Colored Parrot indeed hasn't detected any mana traces of Yuan Ming leaving around the island..." Yin Lang hesitated.
"Is it possible that Yuan Ming has gone into the sea and escaped from the seabed? The sea is unlike land; when casting magic from the seabed, the mana traces are quickly washed away by tides." Xu Changyu said.
"I've heard about this from the Seven-Colored Parrot; it's indeed the case. It seems Yuan Ming has most likely escaped from the seabed." Yin Lang, eager to shirk responsibility, quickly said.
"Looking at the mana traces on the island, he should not have run far. Let's pursue in five groups; there's a high chance we can catch up." Yang Qing said disdainfully, casting a glance at Yin Lang.
"We should not underestimate Yuan Ming; this person was able to put Ouyang Qiang at a disadvantage. If truly matched, he might stand a chance against me. If you encounter him alone, don't take it lightly." Ye Wuya shook his head.
"Island Master, you really overestimate him; intelligence says he's young and has learned so much, but probably wouldn't be proficient in any area. Encountering him alone, although he has many tricks, we wouldn't easily be defeated." Yang Qing seemed unconvinced.
"Alright, alright; being cautious is never wrong, and besides, the opportunities related to him are significant for us. Even if we obtain them, we must consider how to handle Dongji Palace. Losing personnel in capturing him would be a loss." Xu Changyu intervened to mediate.
"What Changyu said is right. Just now, Qingjin Building sent me information on several islands. Go there to search for Yuan Ming. Do not let him escape!" Ye Wuya ordered.
"Yes, so what about here..." Xu Changyu asked.
"Just like before, set up an investigation array here. Perhaps Yuan Ming might still come back." Ye Wuya instructed.
Xu Changyu and the others immediately complied, setting up a reconnaissance array in a hidden corner of the island, then swiftly left with Ye Wuya.
Yuan Ming, watching their entire array setup process from the side, naturally bypassed the array's surveillance and quietly left the deserted island after they departed.
Since Yun Luo Fairy had already been taken away from this place, Yuan Ming did not continue to search for Yun Luo Fairy on other islands. Instead, he found a secluded spot and waited silently for two days. When the time came, he immediately summoned the Stealing Heaven Tripod and lit a stick of Black Incense.
Unfortunately, he discovered that Yun Luo Fairy was currently being transported by the Su Nu Sect on a Flying Boat, sailing over the vast ocean with nothing around to determine location.
Could they be intending to take Yun Luo Fairy back to the Central Continent?
Yuan Ming grew anxious, quickly using his Divine Thought to locate Zi Mei and the others, hoping to gather information from their conversation. However, they remained silently cultivating without any intention to talk, until the possession time expired, and Yuan Ming was unable to gather any information regarding Yun Luo Fairy's whereabouts.
The situation seemed to be getting complicated, but Yuan Ming quickly calmed down, contemplating the reasons for Zi Mei and the others' departure while waiting for the next seven days to arrive.This translation is powered by the readers at *.
Time passed swiftly, and Yuan Ming soon gained another possession opportunity. This time, he did not choose to possess Yun Luo Fairy but instead possessed Zi Mei.
As he opened his eyes, Yuan Ming found Zi Mei and the others still seated silently in the cabin, cultivating—just like during the previous possession. Outside the Flying Boat, there was still the boundless sea, with no islands in sight.
Yuan Ming glanced at the distant cold-eyed woman and the gentle woman, a hint of murder rising in his heart, which he quickly suppressed.
If he were to manipulate Zi Mei to act at this moment, there was a high chance of success. However, once the Black Incense Possession ended, Zi Mei would flee in terror with Yun Luo Fairy, adding uncertainty. It's better to plan slowly and cautiously.
Yuan Ming activated his Divine Sense to probe Zi Mei's Mana, Divine Soul, and the contents of her storage magic tool, and stood up.
The other two immediately sensed it and stopped cultivating.
"Senior Sister Zi Mei, what's wrong?" the cold-eyed woman asked.
"We left in a hurry. If we were spotted on the way, it would be troublesome. We should have made more preparations before setting off." Yuan Ming pretended to sigh.
"There wasn't enough time. Who knows when that person would come? If we stayed on that island any longer, we would definitely be spotted." the cold-eyed woman responded.
Yuan Ming was taken aback by this remark but soon realized that Zi Mei and the others absolutely hadn't discovered that he was searching for Yun Luo; otherwise, they wouldn't be so hurriedly escaping.
Besides, who is the person referred to by the cold-eyed woman's words?
Yuan Ming silently pondered, intending to lead the cold-eyed woman to reveal more information.
"Strange, we were perfectly safe under that deserted island, hardly going out during this time. How could we be discovered? And with a reward at Qingjin Building?" the gentle woman asked ahead.
Yuan Ming was stunned by this statement.
Were these three aware that he was using Qingjin Building to search for news about the Moon Lake deserted island?
Ye Wuya, as the Island Master of Wuya Island, could possibly pressure Qingjin Building to find him. But how did these three women learn of this? Could it be that they have some connection with Qingjin Building?
"Who knows? We've inspected that island countless times with no anomalies. It was just an ordinary deserted island, hence chosen as a temporary base, only to be discovered!" the cold-eyed woman was puzzled.
"Senior Sister Zi, Senior Sister Chen, I just thought through the matter from beginning to end and found it odd. If our hiding place had already been discovered, why didn't that person lead others directly to ambush us, instead placing a reward at Qingjin Building to find our location? It's as if the person knew we were hiding on a Moon Lake deserted island but didn't know the exact position." the gentle woman explained.
"Thinking that way, it indeed seems strange." the cold-eyed woman furrowed her brows.
Yuan Ming felt uneasy. If they continued discussing, the secret of the Black Incense Possession might be exposed.
"This matter isn't hard to explain. It must be Yun Luo's doing. If I'm not mistaken, our whereabouts on the Moon Lake deserted island were secretly leaked by Yun Luo. Perhaps due to the urgency, she only mentioned being on the Moon Lake deserted island but didn't specify the exact location." he spoke.
"It makes sense. Indeed, it's highly possible. Yun Luo's tactics are formidable; even subdued, she managed to send out information, no wonder she snatched the 'Pill King Secret Manual' from Ouyang Qiang and the others. Rest assured, Senior Sister Zi Mei, I'll lay down a few more Forbidden around Yun Luo to completely seal her Mana and Divine Sense!" the cold-eyed woman realized.
The gentle woman also nodded in agreement.

chapters.title: Chapter 846 - 817: I am the Goddess, You are the Holy Master
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming noticed that the thoughts of the two women had been led astray, and he felt relieved. He continued, "Junior Sister Chen's methods are naturally trustworthy, and I will trouble you shortly. Ah, I just hope we can quickly find traces of that Yuan Ming and retrieve the Complete Heaven Exquisite Tripod and the other half of the Pill King Secret Manual. This way, we can report back to the sect."
He had just quietly probed Zi Mei's storage magic tool, which contained the identity information of the other two women: the cold-eyed woman was named Chen Yuluan, and the gentle woman was Wang Qi.
"Rest assured, Senior Sister Zi. Yun Luo has been interrogated by us for so long, and her spirit is already on the edge of collapse. I'm sure she will soon submit. As long as we can extract news about that Yuan Ming, capturing him is just a matter of time, and once we reach Wuya Island, it will be more convenient for us to act," Chen Yuluan said.
Yuan Ming almost couldn't suppress his shock. Unexpectedly, after going around, the three from the Su Nu Sect brought Yun Luo Fairy back to this island he had left not long ago.
"But with so many cultivators on Wuya Island, isn't the probability of being discovered even greater?" Wang Qi asked with some concern.
"No, with so many cultivators on Wuya Island, it's actually easier for us to hide. Right now, everyone in the Dongji Sea is searching for Yuan Ming and that wretched Yun Luo. We should do the opposite and deliberately hide on such a large island. As the saying goes, the greatest disguise is amidst the crowds, and they'll never expect it," Chen Yuluan replied with a smile.
Yuan Ming nodded slightly, as if feeling reassured. He stopped speaking and continued to cultivate.
Seeing this, Chen Yuluan and Wang Qi also resumed their cultivation state.
Soon, the possession time ended, and Yuan Ming suddenly stood up, a cold smile inadvertently appearing at the corner of his mouth.
No matter how many schemes those three from the Su Nu Sect came up with, they could not escape from the palm of his hand.
He sprang up, harnessing a spirit light to speed towards Wuya Island. Simultaneously, he raised a hand to send two communication talismans, instructing Hua Zhi and Lei Yu to meet at a Black Stone Reef sea area outside Wuya Island.
...
Half a month later, outside the Black Stone Reef near Wuya Island, a streak of cyan light shot over like a meteor from a distance, quickly arriving nearby and revealing Yuan Ming's figure.
His face was slightly pale, and he was panting, with sweat faintly visible on his back.
In his haste to return to Wuya Island, he had been traveling day and night without rest, barely taking a break. It took him half a month to reach Wuya Island, and he was utterly exhausted.
Yuan Ming took out an elixir and consumed it, taking a while to calm down.
The sea surface around the Black Stone Reef was empty and unusually calm, with Hua Zhi and Lei Yu yet to arrive.
Yuan Ming frowned slightly, but he didn't wait for Hua Zhi and Lei Yu. Instead, he raised his hand to release Vajra, preparing to directly board the island to rescue people.
But just then, Yuan Ming raised an eyebrow and looked towards the distance.
He saw dozens of cultivators flying on spirit lights in the sky, arranged in a formation like southward-heading geese, led by a dazzling thunder light orb that contained Lei Yu's figure.
Below these spirit lights on the sea surface, the water seemed to boil, "gurgling" and "bubbling" up, soon revealing a massive whale demon beast emerging from the sea, spraying a water column towards the sky.
Atop the water column, a Taishi Chair made of purple-black vines was lifted, with Hua Zhi sitting boldly on it, waving her hand at Yuan Ming from afar.
"Master!" she called out excitedly.
Accompanying her voice, hundreds of fierce-looking demon beasts surfaced from underwater, gathering near the whale demon beast, riding the sea waves as if a dragon king were on a grand parade.
Yuan Ming's eye twitched at this sight, feeling somewhat speechless for a moment.
"Where did you gather so many people? Are there even cultivators among them?" Yuan Ming hurriedly flew to meet them, asking in a deep voice before Hua Zhi and the others approached.
As he spoke, he waved his hand to summon several array flag array plates, setting up an array around everyone, encapsulating all the demon clan members and those cultivators, preventing any disturbances.
"Don't worry, Master. These demon clan members and cultivators were personally recruited by me one by one; they are absolutely trustworthy," Hua Zhi said quickly.
Those demon beasts all lowered their heads upon seeing Yuan Ming, in a sign of reverence.
"Greetings to the Holy Master!" the cultivators also clasped their fists and saluted Yuan Ming, with an attitude of utmost respect.
"Holy Master? What is going on?" Yuan Ming frowned and looked at Hua Zhi.
"Master, this is the force I recently organized—the Holy Spirit Association! Those guys from Dongji Palace, Luo Jia Mountain, and Azure Dragon Pond dared to bully us and drove us out of Spiritual Ape Island because they had the numbers. So, I simply formed this Holy Spirit Association. I'm the Goddess, and you're the Holy Master! But don't worry, Master, I haven't revealed your true identity to these people," Hua Zhi proudly transmitted.
"Who allowed you to do such things..." Yuan Ming said, speechless, and waved his hand.
The vision of those demon beasts and cultivators darkened, and they all fell into unconsciousness.
Yuan Ming flew over and performed a soul search on each one, confirming that none harbored ill intentions, which relieved him slightly.
Not only that, but these cultivators were actually sincere and upright individuals, and those demon beasts were also well-behaved without any bloodthirsty nature.
"Where did you find such relatively simple-minded cultivators and demon beasts?" Yuan Ming asked curiously.
"They were gathered while searching for the Moon Lake Island. I found them pleasing to the eye, so I took them under my wing," Hua Zhi said.
"You can distinguish between good and evil just by looking?" Yuan Ming was taken aback.
"More or less. I used to have a similar ability for heart telepathy, which allowed me to communicate with various demon beasts. As my power grew, this telepathy has strengthened. Recently, it's reached the point where I can see through someone's nature, otherwise, I wouldn't dare to form the Holy Spirit Association and cause trouble for you," Hua Zhi transmitted her voice. Content presented by *.
"Since you're confident, do as you wish, but your way of hurrying just now was too flashy," Yuan Ming sighed lightly with a hint of helplessness.
"We've been traveling underwater all the way, unnoticed. We only surfaced at the designated location," Hua Zhi explained.
Yuan Ming nodded and said no more.
He personally acted low-key and couldn't forcibly require those around him to be the same. As long as nothing went wrong, he wouldn't interfere.
"Come on, master, let me introduce the members of the Holy Spirit Association..." Hua Zhi eagerly said.
"Rescuing people is the priority. We'll talk about other things when we return," Yuan Ming quickly stopped her.
This bunch of little followers included both Human Clan cultivators and demons. With so many of them, who knows how long introductions would take.
"Understood, master." Hua Zhi nodded, extraordinarily obedient.
But seeing her like this, Yuan Ming couldn't help but recall her imposing leader-like posture earlier, feeling a pang of helplessness akin to a daughter growing up in an unexpected way.
As Yuan Ming and Hua Zhi conversed, Vajra widened his eyes at Hua Zhi and the numerous members of the Holy Spirit Association, feeling a bit jealous.
However, he had always been a lone wolf without Hua Zhi's capabilities, so he simply looked away.
"Master, let's move quickly. How could a mere Wuya Island stop us? We could just sweep through it," Hua Zhi looked towards Wuya Island and said excitedly.
"I'm just going to rescue someone, not to annihilate Wuya Island. There's no need to make such a big deal out of it. Hua Zhi, you wait outside, Vajra and I will handle it," Yuan Ming said.
Hua Zhi had come from afar, only to find she wasn't needed, immediately feeling disappointed.
"You have something to do too. Hua Zhi, you and Lei Yu take positions here as a precaution," Yuan Ming suggested.
Ye Wuya and others likely weren't on Wuya Island at the moment, so the rescue should proceed without much issue, but it's always good to have precautions.
"Okay." Hua Zhi nodded, and Lei Yu echoed with a shout.
Yuan Ming and Vajra took flight, heading directly toward Wuya Island.
"Your appearance is too conspicuous. Use this Illusion Charm to alter it," Yuan Ming said as he handed over a talisman to Vajra during their flight.
"No need for the talisman, I can do it myself," Vajra shook his head, clenching his fists.
Inside him, a series of popping sounds emanated, his muscles and skin writhing.
Vajra's appearance rapidly changed; his body hair receded quickly, and his stature shrank. Within a few breaths, he transformed into an ordinary-looking white-haired man.
"What kind of divine skill is this?" Yuan Ming showed a hint of surprise.
"As my strength improved, my memory also recovered significantly. This is a body cultivation secret technique, recently remembered, called Transmutation Technique. It requires achieving the Body of Wanxiang to perform, allowing one to completely alter their form and appearance. When trained to a high level, it even changes one's aura, though I'm not there yet," Vajra explained as he moved his body.
"Using body cultivation techniques to change appearance, impressive," Yuan Ming raised an eyebrow, invoking his Divine Sense to inspect further, growing more astonished.
Vajra's transformation wasn't an illusion or mana transformation but was actual physical change, making it impossible to be seen through.
If it weren't for Vajra's unchanged aura, Yuan Ming might have thought the man in front of him was someone else.
"An amazing secret technique indeed. Deserving of the name Transmutation Technique, it truly has effects like rebirth," Yuan Ming nodded, murmuring to himself.
"Your body cultivation has also reached the Body of Wanxiang. If you're interested, you could try learning it," Vajra straightforwardly remarked, inscribing the mnemonic of the Transmutation Technique onto a Jade Scroll, handing it over.
Yuan Ming was genuinely interested in the Transmutation Technique, but now wasn't the time to delve into it. He put the Jade Scroll away and quickly entered Wuya Island with Vajra.
Inside Wuya Island, it was bustling as usual. Yuan Ming didn't hurry, strolling leisurely with Vajra, heading towards the eastern part of the island. Soon, they reached the eastern region.
Here, the crowd was sparser, and the buildings along the streets weren't as dense, with garden-like residences appearing.
The east side was near Wuya Island's Spirit Vein. Although its spiritual energy wasn't as strong as Ye Wuya's Kunyuan Palace, it was decent. These manors contained many Cave Mansions, leased long-term to visiting cultivators.

chapters.title: Chapter 847 - 818: Ruthless Hand Crushing Flowers, I
chapters.content:
Seeing nothing unusual along the way and with few people around, Yuan Ming and Vajra quickened their pace, soon arriving at a house called "Qingchun Garden."
This place was considered a temporary lodging that visiting cultivators could rent. Inside, there were interwoven woods and lakes, with smoke lingering and several cave mansions distributed throughout.
Three days ago, using Black Incense once more, he confirmed that the three members of the Su Nu Sect and Yun Luo Fairy were residing inside.
A Forbidden was set around Qingchun Garden, but it was only Level 4.
"Is it here? This sort of Forbidden, I can break it with one punch." Vajra raised his fist, eager to try.
"Wait, let me see what's inside first." Yuan Ming shook his head, muttering under his breath, flicking his fingers.
A white light sphere appeared, flickering continuously, it was the Circular Light Technique.
Yuan Ming had mastered this technique back in the Yunhuang Continent, and over the years had put some effort into refining it during leisure time, becoming quite proficient, with a detection range of twenty to thirty miles.
After a few breaths, an image appeared inside the light sphere, showing a secret chamber where Yun Luo Fairy sat silently on a stone chair, her hands and feet chained, still unconscious.
Yuan Ming felt relieved, worried that after three days, there might be changes in her status; since Yun Luo Fairy was still here, everything was fine, and they wouldn't have come for nothing.
He shifted his mind, and the Circular Light Technique's perspective changed, looking at other parts of the cave mansion, his brows furrowing quickly.
"Master, has something changed?" Vajra asked seeing this.
"Not a major issue, just one of the three Returning to Void Cultivators of the Su Nu Sect isn't inside." Yuan Ming said.
Inside the cave mansion were only Chen Yuluan and Wang Qi, but Zi Mei was absent.
"Maybe she just happened to be out, nothing strange." Vajra didn't take it seriously.
"That's true, just a minor change, everything proceeds as usual." Yuan Ming said, beginning to break the array.
He naturally wouldn't rely on brute force to break the array, which would cause a big commotion and unnecessary trouble.
After taking a deep breath, Yuan Ming extended a palm, muttering incantations as his five fingers illuminated with patches of green light, inserting them into the Forbidden, performing unlocking techniques.
Over the years, Yuan Ming had been busy cultivating and hadn't spent much time on formations; however, with the Stealing Heaven Tripod, occasionally possessing Su Yingxue, his array formation cultivation had improved considerably, reaching the Level 5 stage, quickly breaking the garden's Forbidden and silently entering Qingchun Garden.
Yuan Ming cast an invisibility secret technique on himself and Vajra, darting into the depths of the garden, soon arriving at the cave mansion holding Yun Luo Fairy.
"Master, this time the enemies are only two Returning to Void Cultivators, leave one to me!" Vajra said excitedly.
"Alright." Yuan Ming nodded, waving his hand.
Several array flags shot out, silently landing near the cave mansion, disappearing instantly. Following Yuan Ming's spell, all the hidden array flags emanated blue light lines, weaving and intertwining in the air, forming a blue Forbidden that enveloped the entire cave mansion.
He took out a silver token, laying down another layer of silver barrier inside the blue Forbidden.
Vajra rubbed his fists impatiently, seeing Yuan Ming stop, spread his arms wide, a crackling sound came from within, like beans popping, his form swelling, transforming into a White Ape, charging into the cave mansion.
With a loud "boom," the cave mansion door was smashed by Vajra's punch, and he barreled in like a raging bull.
Chen Yuluan and Wang Qi heard the commotion, flying out from their respective secret chambers. Seeing Vajra, they were shocked, "Demon Clan? Who are you? Why attack our cave mansion?"
Vajra didn't waste words with the two women, his body leaping forward, instantly reaching Chen Yuluan, his millstone-sized fist carrying an air-breaking force, aimed brutally at her face, with no regard for her beauty.
The cave mansion space was small, optimal for Body Cultivation combat; Chen Yuluan couldn't react in time, but a sudden flash of light from a green jade ring on her finger enveloped her in a green light shield.
Boom!
The green light shield was deeply indented, and a mournful sound came from the green jade ring, revealing two cracks, but it barely held off the blow, though Chen Yuluan was left pale with shock behind the shield.
Before Vajra could deliver a second punch, a yellow light flashed beneath his feet, and an earth-yellow rope emerged, swiftly entangling his body, an action from Wang Qi nearby.
Seeing this, Chen Yuluan immediately counterattacked, opening her mouth to spit out.
A flurry of slender silver light shot out, consisting of twenty to thirty silver needles, piercing through the green shield, aimed straight at Vajra's forehead.
Vajra activated the Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill, his body emitting a bright blood light, instantly condensing into a blood-red elephant shadow.
This blood elephant's skin grew thick blood-colored fur, entirely different from when Yuan Ming used the Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill. The silver needles struck it only to rebound without any effect.
The blood shadow's trunk swung with a dull air-breaking sound, striking the green shield with more force than Vajra's fist.
The already damaged green jade ring couldn't withstand the blow, shattering with a "bang."
The green light shield shattered alongside, turning into countless fragments of green light scattering.
Vajra ignored the yellow rope around him and Wang Qi, turning fist into palm, slicing towards Chen Yuluan's throat, his speed as quick as lightning.
Unprepared, Chen Yuluan's face immediately showed despair.
"Just severely injure her, do not kill!" Yuan Ming's voice suddenly rang in Vajra's ears.
Hearing this, Vajra's palm shifted direction, stabbing into Chen Yuluan's chest instead.
"Pfft"
A blood hole was punctured into her chest, and she was sent flying backward, crashing heavily against the rear wall, collapsing with no signs of getting up.
"Senior Sister Chen!" Wang Qi's expression changed drastically, immediately forming hand seals.
Earthen yellow ropes emanated with yellow runes, penetrating into the Vajra's body.
These yellow runes seemed to have the effect of restraining qi-blood. The blood-colored elephant shadow around the Vajra quickly turned dim, almost collapsing.
With a wave of her sleeve, three Flying Wheel Spiritual Treasures shot out, their blades snow-bright, yet exuding a trace of purple eerie light, forming a character shape and slashing towards the Vajra.
"Poison?" Outside the cave mansion, Yuan Ming's face slightly furrowed, raising his arm.
"Mere insect poison, how can it affect me! Master, do not intervene!" the Vajra snorted coldly, activating the "Violent Blood" conception.
A red mist rose from his body, looking like rolling flames, burning away the yellow runes that permeated him.
The blood-colored elephant shadow condensed back to solidity, the elephant trunk swung, and the three flying wheels were immediately knocked away.
The Vajra pushed outwards with both arms, doubling its immense power, breaking the earthen ropes into seven or eight pieces, regaining its freedom.
Wang Qi was in disbelief at the scene before her, urgently retreating while reaching for the storage bag at her waist with a single hand.
Yet the Vajra gave her no opportunity, leaping forward.
For a b!ett#er@[email protected] . ex*p!erie+n.ce^, v@is$it& *)-.+
The blood-colored giant elephant also raised a foot, stomping fiercely towards Wang Qi.
Bang!
An indescribable immense force came crashing down, the void emitting strange creaks as if unable to withstand such power, about to shatter.
Wang Qi's face showed terror, swiftly performing incantations and consecutively deploying three or four defensive magic treasures, forming three or four protective body light screens around her.
But such hastily deployed means could not withstand the Vajra in Violent Blood state.
The blood-colored elephant foot, carrying endless immense force, descended, and those few protective body light screens couldn't hold for even half a breath, shattered into countless spirit lights scattering.
Those few magic treasures also broke into pieces, completely rendered useless.
Yuan Ming had just said not to kill, and the Vajra, always obedient to Yuan Ming, brought the blood-colored elephant foot to a halt just an inch before Wang Qi, giving a gentle shake through the air.
Wang Qi's entire body had dozens of bones cracked with snapping sounds, and she was knocked flying, collapsing weakly to the ground.
"Truly unsatisfying." The Vajra retracted the Violent Blood conception, and the blood-colored giant elephant gradually dissipated, stating with lingering interest.
"The space within the cave mansion is limited, and these two cultivators of the Su Nu Sect couldn't fully display their abilities. That's why you could succeed. If it were outside, defeating them wouldn't be so easy." Yuan Ming walked in.
"Who... are you..." Wang Qi, lightly injured, barely lifted her head to look at Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming didn't answer her, snapping his fingers.
Two black lights mixed with demonic qi shot out, striking into Chen Yuluan and Wang Qi's bodies.
The black light turned into a sealing, enveloping the two's Dan Tian Nascent Souls. It was precisely the method of the Nihility Prison Forbidden, imprisoning and sealing off mana and soul power, a secret technique Yuan Ming had comprehended thoroughly since being affected by it last time.
The fluctuations of mana on Wang Qi and Chen Yuluan's bodies completely dissipated, leaving them utterly limp on the ground.
"Xuan Demon Seal! You're from the Three Realms Sect?" Wang Qi's gaze at Yuan Ming changed, she spoke in a trembling voice.
Chen Yuluan did not faint, her face also showing fear.
The duo's mana was sealed, their injuries rapidly worsening.
Yuan Ming moved his fingers, once again sending out two green lights, which merged into the two of them.
These two green lights were healing spells, containing a hint of Undying Tree Demon Power.
Their injuries were suddenly controlled, the broken bones and internal organs enveloped by a warm stream, rapidly healing, and in just a few breaths, more than half were healed.
The duo was astonished, their injuries were severe enough to nearly claim their lives, even using the best healing pills of the Su Nu Sect would take several days to recover to this extent. Yet, this person in front of them, using an unknown strange method, achieved this effect with a wave of the hand.
In fact, even Liu Ming was quite surprised, could it be the fusion of the Undying Tree with the bark of the World Tree had further enhanced its healing ability?
"Watch over these two." Yuan Ming quickly collected his thoughts, instructing the Vajra, and proceeded directly to the chamber holding Yun Luo Fairy.
Upon seeing this, Chen Yuluan and Wang Qi's faces changed, they attempted to stand from the ground.
A strong killing intent shot over from the side, as the Vajra stepped forward, one hand clenched into a fist, with the air of being ready to take lives at any disagreement.
"My master cherishes beautiful women, but I am not interested in human clan females like you. I wouldn't mind snuffing you out, twisting off your heads to drink wine." The Vajra spoke in a deep voice.
The duo shivered in fear at these words, not daring to move, while a satisfied expression flashed in the Vajra's eyes.
Yuan Ming ignored the Vajra's nonsense, raising his hand to push open the secret chamber door.
The door remained motionless, a layer of blue fluorescence emerged on its surface, runes dancing within, appearing even more mysterious than the forbidden on the cave mansion's main entrance.
Yuan Ming curled his five fingers, five points of blue light igniting at his fingertips, merging into the blue fluorescence.
The blue fluorescence flickered, from slow to fast, dazzling to the eye.
After a few breaths, the blue fluorescence shattered with a "bang", dissolving into countless gleams, and the secret chamber door creaked open.
A strange look flashed in Chen Yuluan's eyes, and she lowered her head.

chapters.title: Chapter 848 - 819 Calculation
chapters.content:
At this moment, inside the mansion of the Island Master of Wuya Island.
Zi Mei was sitting with a woman in her thirties, voluptuous and beautiful, wearing a long dress. Two cups of milky-white spiritual tea sat on the table beside them, with white mist gently rising.
"Hehe, Junior Sister Lin, it seems you have been doing quite well over the years," Zi Mei chuckled.
"I'm just serving our master, there's no such thing as good or bad," the woman in the long dress shook her head.
The aura around this woman was quite powerful, unmistakably a mid-stage Returning Void Cultivator.
"A few days ago, I must thank you for sending the message, otherwise I wouldn't have known that my hiding place had been discovered," Zi Mei said nonchalantly, getting up and bowing politely.
"It was just a coincidence. If Yuan Ming hadn't gone to Qingjin Building for a bounty mission, I wouldn't have known either," the woman in the long dress smiled lazily, her expression still rather indifferent.
"It seems Junior Sister Lin still harbors some resentment towards our master's early arrangements. But you really misunderstood her. Although the Central Continent is bustling and lively, it's full of dangers. There were over a dozen of us senior and junior sisters who joined the master's ranks back then, and now less than half still live peacefully," Zi Mei sighed.
"What! The loss is this severe?" The face of the woman in the long dress changed slightly.
"Now, with the Demon World advancing constantly, and the Three Realms Sect stirring up trouble, the situation on the Central Continent is increasingly unstable. The various factions are at odds, constantly fighting. Our Su Nu Sect, caught in the middle, finds it increasingly difficult to maintain stability. Our master is constantly preoccupied with the affairs of the sect, without even having time for seclusion, inevitably affecting her progress in cultivation," Zi Mei said slowly.
"Master..." The woman in the long dress was finally moved, the fingers holding her teacup trembled slightly.
"Though the Eastern Sea is a bit remote, it's peaceful and leisurely. It's better for you to oversee Qingjin Building and live quietly here than many of our other sisters in the sect. Moreover, that Ye Wuya has decent talent. If he can break through to the Dharma manifestation Stage, you can rely on our sect's dual cultivation secret technique to make further progress, maybe even reaching the Dharma Manifestation Realm," Zi Mei continued, seeing the expression on the woman in the long dress.
"My aptitude is mediocre, and I have only comprehended two or three tenths of our sect's Sutra of the Pure Woman. Back then, I injured my Spirit Root due to excessive cultivation. Being able to maintain my cultivation without regression is a blessing; how dare I hope for progress?" The woman in the long dress lowered her eyelashes, a hint of self-mockery in her eyes.
"Why be so discouraged, Junior Sister? Your internal injuries are not without remedy. Did you know that master has successfully refined another batch of Suxin Pill? If you can take one, not only will it heal your Spirit Root injury, but you might also break through to the late stage of Returning Void," Zi Mei smiled and took the woman's hand.
"Is this true?" The woman's body trembled, a fervent glow in her eyes.
"I naturally wouldn't deceive you. But there are few pills in this batch of Suxin Pills, only three. Master used one, and a few years ago, Junior Sister Qin used another to reach the Great Perfection of Returning Void, leaving only one now," Zi Mei patted the woman's hand and said.
"Only one left! With my contributions to the sect over the years, how could master grant me the last Suxin Pill?" The fiery light in the woman's eyes faded mostly away, and she sighed.
"With your merits from previous years, it's indeed not enough. But there is a significant task at hand. If it can be completed, I guarantee master will grant you this pill," Zi Mei leaned closer, speaking softly.
"Is Senior Sister Zi referring to capturing Yuan Ming?" The woman in long dress moved slightly and asked.
"Correct. The Pill King Secret Manual and the Complete Heaven Exquisite Tripod are incredibly precious. Even powerful entities like Taixuan Sect, Heavenly Saint Academy, and Bright Moon Palace covet them. If we can bring these two items back, obtaining a Suxin Pill will be a trivial matter," Zi Mei said with a charming smile.
"That's easy to say, but we've already alerted the target. Ye Wuya recently sent a message and hasn't captured him. With Yuan Ming's cunning, he's probably far away by now. In this vast ocean, where do we even begin to search?" The woman in the long dress looked regretful.
"Junior Sister may not know. I've already learned from Yun Luo that Yuan Ming teamed up with her to seize a treasure for the Dharma Manifestation Pill Recipe. This endeavor of Yuan Ming is probably also for the Dharma Manifestation Pill. As long as he is pursuing something, we'll have a chance," Zi Mei smiled confidently, unhurried.
"I see. Senior Sister's analysis makes sense. What do you plan to do? How can I help?" The woman in the long dress nodded and asked.
"I plan to falsely use Yun Luo's name to spread the word covertly, using the Dharma Manifestation Pill Recipe as bait to lure him out. But, my forces are somewhat lacking. So, I wanted to ask Junior Sister for assistance in borrowing some manpower from Wuya Island. Ideally, if Ye Wuya could personally act, it would greatly increase our chances," Zi Mei said.
"From what you just said, Yuan Ming is an outstanding mid-stage Returning Void cultivator. To deal with him, only a Returning Void cultivator would be effective. Although Ye Wuya treats me well, he doesn't always follow my every word. Moreover, the Deputy Island Masters on the island are each proud and hardly regard me as the Island Master's Daoist companion. This matter could prove difficult," the woman in the long dress looked troubled and replied helplessly.
"Why say that, Junior Sister Lin? I know your methods better than anyone. Those Deputy Island Masters on Wuya Island are probably long since your admirers," Zi Mei giggled, sending a voice transmission.
The woman in the long dress playfully glanced at Zi Mei, her heart somewhat pleased. After pondering for a moment, she said, "I can agree to this, but besides the Suxin Pill, I have another request for Senior Sister."
"What is it?" Zi Mei's smile faded.
"Since Senior Sister Zi captured Yun Luo, I believe you've already read the second half of the Pill King Secret Manual. I hope Senior Sister can transcribe a copy for me to view," the woman's eyes flickered with a greedy gleam.
"The Pill King Secret Manual involves too much; I didn't dare look at it. After obtaining that half of the secret manual, I immediately handed it over to Senior Sister Qin to take back to the sect," Zi Mei took a sip of tea before speaking slowly.Th^i&s c^hapt.e@r was m@a$de p!oss@i-b$l.e^ by the c-o$m&m^un*i.t%y at *.
"Oh, is that so?" A hint of doubt flashed through the woman's eyes.
Zi Mei noticed the expression on the woman in the long dress and was about to say something when a crystalline jade pendant at her waist suddenly shattered with a "bang".
Her expression changed drastically, and she stood up abruptly.
"What happened?" The woman in the long dress asked hurriedly.
Zi Mei remained silent, quickly removing two white jade earrings from her ears and forming hand seals to activate them.
A faint white light flickered on the earrings, gently rippling with no other response.
"Qingchun Garden's Cave Mansion was attacked, and it seems Chen Yuluan and Wang Qi have already been captured. What's going on? Who are they?" Zi Mei said coldly, her face darkening.
"Could it be that Yuan Ming?" The woman in the long dress speculated aloud.
Zi Mei's face turned pale at these words, and she stood there, stunned.
It was indeed possible, but she had just moved from the deserted island at Moon Lake to Wuya Island. How could Yuan Ming find here so quickly?
However, the situation was urgent, and Zi Mei couldn't think deeply, saying to the woman in the long dress, "Yun Luo is also in my cave mansion. No matter if it's Yuan Ming or not, we can't let him leave. Please, junior sister, go and fetch Ye Wuya and others to help. This is a rare opportunity; we must stop him at all costs!"
"Ye Wuya and the others haven't returned to the island yet. What should we do?" The woman in the long dress appeared slightly flustered.
Zi Mei felt her heart sink upon hearing this.
She had learned everything about Emperor Yan's Tomb from Yun Luo Fairy and understood Yuan Ming's strength well, knowing she was no match for him. Going recklessly would not only fail to save people but might also sacrifice herself.
The woman in the long dress had a lower cultivation level and was only proficient in seduction techniques, of no significant use.
Just then, a jade pendant at the waist of the woman in the long dress suddenly lit up.
The woman hurriedly grabbed the jade pendant, her divine sense immersing in it, and a look of joy appeared on her face.
...
Meanwhile, in Qingchun Garden's Cave Mansion.
Yuan Ming walked into the secret chamber and saw Yun Luo Fairy sitting slumped in a stone chair, her eyes closed, her hands and feet shackled, her head tilted to one side, motionless.
Yuan Ming brought out the Exterminating Immortal Sword, slashing twice to cut the handcuffs and shackles.
Yun Luo Fairy's body went limp, sliding off the stone chair.
Yuan Ming released a surge of potential, catching Yun Luo Fairy's body and reached out to touch her forehead to check her condition.
Having endured consecutive punishments, Yun Luo Fairy's internal injuries were severe. Fortunately, the culprits still had plans for her and hadn't injured her significantly, leaving her life intact.
As Yuan Ming pondered, he directed a wave of Undying Tree Demon Power from his finger into her forehead, stabilizing her injuries while attempting to awaken her.
Despite trying for a moment, her injuries were stabilized, but she remained unconscious as if affected by a sleep secret technique.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming frowned slightly, then swept Yun Luo Fairy into Shura Palace and turned back to the outer room.
"May I ask the esteemed fellow's name? The two of us were disrespectful earlier and offended you and your friend from Demon Clan. Please forgive us." Chen Yuluan implored apologetically upon seeing Yuan Ming come out.
"As long as you comply obediently, I won't take your lives," Yuan Ming replied slowly, observing them.
"Who needs your mercy! We are weak in divine skills and lost to you, but our Su Nu Sect is not easily bullied. Dare to touch a hair on us today, and you'll pay a thousandfold price someday!" Wang Qi suddenly shouted beside.
"Junior Sister Wang, silence! This fellow daoist, my junior sister is impulsive and straightforward, please forgive her," Chen Yuluan reprimanded Wang Qi and then quickly apologized to Yuan Ming, begging for leniency.
Yuan Ming wasn't angry and suddenly appeared beside Wang Qi, placing a hand on her head.
Wang Qi's face changed with panic, trying to struggle but her body was held immobile by an invisible force.
Yuan Ming promptly performed the Soul Searching Technique, surging black mist into her head.
"Soul Searching Technique!" Chen Yuluan exclaimed in panic, a soft bang sounded from her sleeve, and a spray of black needles shot out towards Yuan Ming.
However, Vajra's figure blurred, standing before Yuan Ming, raising a hand to create a visible shockwave that scattered all the black needles.
Chen Yuluan's body was also lifted by the shockwave, flying backward and landing heavily, immediately falling unconscious.

chapters.title: Chapter 849 - 820: Don't Say You Were Not Warned
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming seemed oblivious to what had just occurred, continuing to perform a Soul Search on Wang Qi until his eyebrows slightly twitched, and he retracted his palm from atop the woman's head.
Wang Qi let out a pained cry, collapsing to the ground like a heap of mud.
"Master, what kind of trick are these two playing?" Vajra asked.
"They are stalling for time. The hidden chamber door where Yun Luo is imprisoned has a mixture of Zi Mei's soul power in its forbidden seal. When I broke through the secret chamber's defense, Zi Mei must have realized something was amiss and is likely on her way back. We should leave now," Yuan Ming quickly said, raising his hand to emit a blue light that enveloped Chen Yuluan and Wang Qi, and brought the two women into the Shura Palace.
"Zi Mei is merely at the late stage of Returning Void; what's there to worry about? It's even better if she comes, we can seize her together," Vajra said indifferently, clenching his fists with a cracking sound.
"Stop wasting time, let's go!" Yuan Ming lowly exclaimed, his form already darting outside.
He had seen the situation at Qingjin Building in Wang Qi's memory, and although he had accounted for everything, he hadn't expected that place to be an industry of the Su Nu Sect. Moreover, the building master Lin Qingjin was Ye Wuya's Daoist companion. If Zi Mei brought people from Qingjin Building and the Island Master Mansion, it would be troublesome to escape.
Yuan Ming, together with Vajra, quickly exited the Cave Mansion. With a wave of his hand, the restrictions he had set around were withdrawn, and his body continued to fly outwards without pause.
Just at this moment, a massive crash of thunder erupted in mid-air, and two purple lightning bolts descended from the sky, striking fiercely towards Yuan Ming and Vajra.
Yuan Ming frowned, raising one hand as a flash of yellow light shot out from his sleeve, expanding rapidly in the wind to form a giant yellow peak, tens of meters tall, blocking in front.
"Crackling"
The purple lightning struck Houtu Peak, and the dazzling purple light immediately engulfed the peak along with Yuan Ming below it.
Vajra was completely unprepared; the speed of the purple thunder was astonishing. He had barely lifted his head when the purple lightning struck him, sending him flying backward and tearing open a huge, charred wound on his chest struck by the thunder.T&h%a#n$ks for reading+—-b$roug-ht to you by *.&
The sky above Qingchun Garden Cave Mansion had become dimly overcast at some unknown time, and thick dark clouds continuously churned within.
Vajra turned over and stood up, enraged, his body emitting a popping sound, suddenly swelling a circle and radiating a dazzling blood light.
Yet another purple lightning fell, tearing through the newly emerged blood light on Vajra, sending his body flying again.
Before Vajra could stand up once more, purple thunder bolts descended from the sky continuously, all striking Vajra.
