Vajra's tall body soon turned charred black, severely injured, lying prone and unable to move.
In mid-air, the dark clouds rolled, once again revealing over a dozen purple lightning bolts. They formed a gigantic purple thunder spear, cutting through the sky like a swift force, straight towards Vajra's head, the power completely different from the previous strikes.
Given Vajra's grievous wounds, if struck, he would likely perish directly, soul and spirit extinguished.
At the critical moment, a yellow shadow flashed past, and Houtu Peak appeared above Vajra.
Countless yellow lights descended, forming a bowl-shaped yellow light screen that enveloped Vajra within.
The purple thunder spear shattered upon striking Houtu Peak, with thick arcs of lightning scattering, all blocked outside by the yellow light screen.
"What do you think? Realized there are always people stronger than oneself, heavens beyond one's sky? Although the Body of Wanxiang is formidable, there are ways to counter it," Yuan Ming asked calmly, looking at Vajra.
"Thank you, Master, for saving my life," Vajra stubbornly raised his head, coughed up a mouthful of blood, and said with difficulty.
Yuan Ming activated the Undying Tree within his dantian, and an Undying Tree Root appeared in front of Vajra, piercing into his body, injecting wisps of Undying Tree Demon Qi into Vajra.
The wounds on Vajra's physical body began to heal at a visibly rapid speed.
Rumbling!
The thunder clouds in mid-air started surging once more, nearly a hundred lightning bolts cascading down, striking Houtu Peak, causing it to tremble unceasingly.
Yuan Ming muttered incantations, causing two streaks of blue light to emerge from his feet, injecting into the ground beneath, rapidly spreading in all directions.
This sky full of dark clouds was a Thunder Array, and at a level of five, otherwise, it couldn't have easily defeated Vajra.
When he and Vajra had entered Qingchun Garden earlier, this array hadn't been present; it was evident Zi Mei's reaction speed had surpassed his expectations.
However, Yuan Ming believed that with his current strength and multitude of tactics, unless a Dharma Manifestation existence descended, he could manage to cope.
The underground blue light quickly contacted the nearby Thunder Array and began probing swiftly.
This array seemed to have been set up hastily, with numerous vulnerabilities; he quickly identified several weak points.
"So that's how it is, the Array Eye is here…" Yuan Ming thought, flipping his hand to retrieve the Exterminating Immortal Sword, and swung it towards a certain point.
A rampant streak of Sword Qi shot out, piercing into a spot in mid-air.
After an almost inaudible soft sound, the dense dark clouds appeared to deflate like a balloon, rapidly dispersing and soon returning to their previous clarity.
Dozens of figures appeared instantly in mid-air, led by Ye Wuya, alongside Yin Lang, Yang Qing, and five Deputy Island Masters, Zi Mei, and Lin Qingjin were also present.
Aside from them, there were some Nascent Soul stage cultivators, holding magic treasures standing further away.
"You are indeed skilled in formations, breaking through my Dayan Thunder Array so swiftly. Truly, the younger generation is formidable." Ye Wuya descended from midair, stopping not far from Yuan Ming.
The others also flew down, activating various magic treasures and completely surrounding the area.
"You must be Ye Wuya. Why are you stopping me?" Yuan Ming ceased his healing of the Vajra and asked.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan Ming, I have no intention of making you my enemy. Just leave Yun Luo Fairy, the Pill King Secret Manual, and the Complete Heaven Exquisite Tripod, and you can immediately leave. I swear by my heart demon, I will not stop you," Ye Wuya said, a flash of green light in his right hand producing an emerald green jade flute.
"These things are still useful to me, Island Master Ye. I'm afraid you'll be making this trip in vain." Yuan Ming shook his head, refusing decisively.
"Since Fellow Daoist Yuan is unwilling to hand them over, I suppose we must take them ourselves," Ye Wuya said leisurely, exuding absolute confidence.
All the elites of Wuya Island were present, and they held a favorable position. Even if two or three peak Late Stage of Returning Void cultivators joined forces, it would be impossible to escape.
"Does Island Master Ye truly wish to obstruct me? The legacy of the Pill King Pavilion runs deep, something a mere Wuya Island cannot meddle with," Yuan Ming said calmly, unconcerned by the encirclement.
Ye Wuya looked at Yuan Ming's calm face, slightly stunned, secretly wondering, "To remain so calm at this point, does this person have a backup plan?"
Zi Mei also felt some unease, quickly pondering what Yuan Ming might do.
"Haha, you're just a mid-stage Returning Void cultivator, yet you speak so boldly. One would think a Dharma manifestation Stage Great Power had arrived!" Yang Qing paid no heed to Yuan Ming, and upon hearing this, burst into laughter.
The others had similar thoughts. Instead of retreating, they tightened their encirclement around Yuan Ming and the Vajra.
A few who excelled in Earth Attribute Divine Skills quietly cast spells to seal the ground, preventing Yuan Ming from using Earth Tunneling to escape.
"I have already given you a chance. Since you remain obstinate, blame me not for not warning you," Yuan Ming said calmly, summoning the powerful soul power from his Sea of Consciousness.
A cold and immense wave of soul power erupted, rivaling even that of a Dharma manifestation Great Power.
The divine souls of those present were overwhelmed, and their vision distorted.
"Not good, this person is a Soul Cultivator, beware of illusions..." Zi Mei suddenly widened her eyes and shouted.
However, before she could finish, her vision went dark, and she fell into a deep sleep, trapped in an endless dreamscape.
The others present were likewise affected, all falling into slumber.
"Is this the master's Nightmare Divine Ability?" The Vajra's face showed shock.
Having followed Yuan Ming for years, he knew Yuan Ming possessed the Nightmare Divine Ability, capable of forcibly putting people to sleep, but did not expect its power to be so astonishing when unleashed now.
Yuan Ming exhaled gently. Though the Nightmare Divine Ability was useful, putting those whose soul power was lower than his own into forced slumber, there were seven Returning Void cultivators present, making the soul power expenditure exceptionally large.
He adjusted his breathing and raised his hand to flick his fingers rapidly.
Seven rays of black light shot out in succession, vanishing into the seven Returning Void cultivators present, casting the Xuan Demon Seal.
Zi Mei, Lin Qingjin, Yang Qing, and others remained in slumber, yet to awaken, and were sealed from using mana.
A layer of white light suddenly shone on Ye Wuya's body, emanating from a white jade pendant hanging at his waist, blocking the Xuan Demon Seal.
Not only that, the pendant emitted a white light that entered Ye Wuya's forehead.
Ye Wuya's body trembled, immediately regaining consciousness and gazing at Yuan Ming with some fear.
"A Soul Cultivator Spiritual Treasure... It seems Fellow Daoist Ye did not become Island Master for nothing." Yuan Ming glanced at the white jade pendant, then waved to cast the Dream Butterfly Illusion Technique.
Ye Wuya's vision blurred, illusions appeared one after another, changing unpredictably like a kaleidoscope, drawing him in.
At this moment, the pendant radiated white light once more, and with a flicker, Ye Wuya's eyes regained clarity.
Seeing this, a trace of cold light flashed in Yuan Ming's eyes. The pendant Ye Wuya wore was no ordinary item; it seemed capable of restraining all Soul Cultivator techniques.
Nevertheless, with everyone else sealed, and only Ye Wuya remaining, he posed no major threat.
In contemplation, Yuan Ming activated a sword technique in his mind. A flash of green light ahead, and the Exterminating Immortal Sword and Soul Destroying Sword appeared simultaneously, transforming into hundreds of fierce sword qi, sweeping down towards Ye Wuya.
The Immortal Slaying Sword Qi echoed through the void, while the Soul Destroying Sword Energy remained silent.
Ye Wuya's expression turned solemn, as he waved the jade flute in his hand, countless verdant bamboo shadows emerged from thin air, emitting waves of Illusion Sound, colliding with the sword qi.
Upon contact, a continuous thundering sound erupted, most of the verdant bamboo shadows instantly collapsing, but the onslaught of sword qi was also blocked.
Leveraging the force, Ye Wuya flew backward, shooting towards the distance.
At this point, he realized the unimposing mid-stage Returning Void cultivator before him was not simple, and he promptly decided to withdraw from this place first.
After all, continuing the fight, he was unsure of gaining any advantage, and with the slightest misstep, he could fall into a situation of eternal damnation.

chapters.title: Chapter 850 - 821 Clash
chapters.content:
However, just as Ye Wuya had withdrawn a short distance, waves appeared in the void ahead, and four or five black roots suddenly emerged, stabbing fiercely.
Ye Wuya couldn't recognize what these black roots were, and immediately stopped his tunneling light, moving sideways to evade.
However, at that moment, the Soul Destroying Sword appeared in the nearby void, and the three major runes of annihilation, curse, and frenzy lit up.
Ye Wuya's vision went black, his six senses completely extinguished, and his soul power, qi-blood, and mana became chaotic. His sideways movement halted, and he was pierced in the chest by a black root.
Ye Wuya's body was penetrated, yet not much blood flowed out. His skin took on a bamboo-like hue.
Ye Wuya, having cultivated to this point, was no easy opponent. Using some unknown means, he seemed to recover part of his six senses instantly and immediately flipped his hand to take out a black sword magic treasure, slashing toward the few undying tree roots.
Suddenly, his right arm was in severe pain, inexplicably split with a wound, as if pierced by a sharp blade.
This wound was very precise, not only severing the muscles of his right arm but also cutting off the most crucial meridian nodes.
Ye Wuya's mana couldn't run to his arm, and the black sword could not slash down.
"What happened?" Ye Wuya was shocked, glancing backward instinctively.
In the next moment, he was stunned to discover Yuan Ming holding a sharp blade, piercing his right arm.
When the black roots had just hit Ye Wuya, although they hadn't caused him severe harm, they completed the life-locking step of the Shared Life Divine Power, linking the life force of the two.
Yuan Ming flipped his hand again to take out a shining sharp blade, piercing his own left arm.
Ye Wuya's left arm was in agonizing pain, and the meridian nodes were similarly severed, preventing mana from flowing there.
With both arms incapacitated, he could not perform hand gestures, rendering much of Ye Wuya's divine skills useless.
Yuan Ming did not stop, once again activating the undying tree. Dozens of black roots emerged around Ye Wuya, tightly entwining his body.
His eyes showed a glint of ferocity, with his skin turning blood red and his body rapidly swelling.
Yuan Ming's body also swelled as a result, shocking him.
Relying on the undying tree to gain a recovery ability unattainable by ordinary people, he used the Shared Life Divine Power to restrain Ye Wuya with forceful methods. However, he hadn't anticipated Ye Wuya's fierce resolve; if his body were to self-destruct, it wouldn't be recoverable.
He hastened his thoughts and quickly dispelled the Shared Life Divine Power.
At that moment, a silver lightning bolt descended from the sky, striking Ye Wuya.
Ye Wuya's entire body immediately emitted arcs of electricity, his body's swelling halted, and he trembled, seemingly in a paralyzed state beyond control.
A giant purple bird appeared in mid-air—it was Lei Yu. Silver electric light glinted at its mouth; clearly, it was responsible for the strike.
Ye Wuya's body trembled, not making any moves for several breaths.
Yuan Ming flew close, waving his hand to remove the white jade pendant.
His right arm's meridians had mostly recovered, and he flicked his fingers to emit a Xuan Demon Seal, sealing Ye Wuya's mana.
"Master, have you rescued him?" Lei Yu flew down.
"He's already rescued, why did you come over? Where is Hua Zhi?" Yuan Ming asked.
"Just now, Hua Zhi saw Ye Wuya and others suddenly returning from outside the island, worried that you were outnumbered, and sent me to assist. At present, she's leading the Holy Spirit Association members to attack Wuya Island, drawing the attention of other cultivators on the island," Lei Yu explained.
Yuan Ming realized, no wonder he and Ye Wuya had been fighting for a while, but no other cultivators from Qingchun Garden came to watch.
"This place is not safe for a prolonged stay, we must leave!" Yuan Ming didn't ask further questions, and stored Ye Wuya and others in the Shura Palace, jumped onto Lei Yu's back with Vajra.
Lei Yu flapped its wings, flying toward the island's exterior, disappearing in the vast night after a few flashes.
Near the sea of Wuya Island, Hua Zhi took on the form of a flower demon, leading a group of demons to war against the island's cultivators.
At this moment, she seemed to sense something, looked towards the distant horizon, smiled, and immediately led them back into the sea, disappearing in an instant.
The cultivators on the island were puzzled, did not pursue, and stood bewildered, looking at the ravaged coastline.
Yuan Ming and Ye Wuya's confrontation, though concealed, was nonetheless seen by cultivators residing near Qingchun Garden, plus the total disappearance of Returning to Void Cultivators on Wuya Island. The events soon spread widely, particularly Yuan Ming's reappearance, which drew almost everyone's attention.
Dongji Palace, Black Evil Sect, Azure Dragon Pond, and Luo Jia Mountain quickly sent people to investigate Wuya Island, with the Su Nu Sect also discretely dispatching members. However, neither Yuan Ming, nor Ye Wuya, nor Zi Mei were found, with no clues discovered.
...
Yuan Ming left Wuya Island and headed straight into the deep sea, arriving at an uninhabited island three days later.
On the island, he casually carved out a temporary cave mansion, set up formation restrictions around it, then entered the cave mansion, waving to summon the Shura Palace with a flick of his hand.
Immediately, a figure flew out of the Shura Palace, none other than Yun Luo Fairy.
At this moment, her eyes remained tightly shut, still unconscious, with no sign of awakening.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming gently waved his hand, and a black divine soul ripple spread, sweeping over Yun Luo Fairy's body.
A moment later, a light cough sounded, Yun Luo Fairy's long eyelashes fluttered slightly as she slowly awoke, seeing the change in scenery before her, especially the presence of Yuan Ming not far away, she appeared dazed.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan? Why are you here... Am I dreaming?" Yun Luo Fairy struggled to sit upright, frowning at Yuan Ming.
"What do you think?" Yuan Ming asked without turning his head. This is part of a series from * (*).
"It doesn't seem like it. I've dreamed of Fellow Daoist Yuan many times recently. In my dreams, Fellow Daoist Yuan is always gentle and considerate, not as cold-hearted as he is now," Yun Luo Fairy remarked with a smile.
"Making such a joke, it seems Yun Luo Fairy has recovered." Yuan Ming turned around.
"Was it Fellow Daoist Yuan who rescued me?" Yun Luo Fairy tilted her head, scrutinizing Yuan Ming.
"Fellow Daoist Yun Luo promised me the Dharma Manifestation Pill Recipe but hasn't delivered yet. I naturally couldn't let Fellow Daoist Yun Luo be taken away by the people of Su Nu Sect," Yuan Ming said plainly.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan really doesn't understand a woman's heart, even at this time, unwilling to say a few words to make someone happy," Yun Luo Fairy huffed coquettishly.
"Words to please, let your future Daoist companion say them to you. I want to know why Fellow Daoist Yun Luo was captured by Su Nu Sect and subjected to such severe torture? Aren't you a disciple of Su Nu Sect?" Yuan Ming chuckled, asking straightforwardly.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, even if you have no feelings for me, shouldn't you show some sympathy at this moment? I'm gravely injured and not healed yet. Can we wait until I've cultivated to heal before I answer your question?" Yun Luo Fairy said.
As the words fell, she couldn't help but cough a few more times, spitting out a large pool of black blood.
"It was my oversight; Fellow Daoist Yun Luo, please heal quickly. It seems your storage magic tool was taken by the people of Su Nu Sect. I have some healing pills here with decent effects, take them." Yuan Ming took out a medicine bottle and handed it over.
"Then I'll trouble Fellow Daoist Yuan," Yun Luo Fairy replied, not taking the medicine bottle, but opening her mouth.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming frowned slightly but still took out a yellow pill, flicked it with his finger, and it landed in Yun Luo Fairy's mouth.
Yun Luo Fairy smiled sweetly, swallowed the elixir, and began cultivating.
A moment later, the medicine began to take effect, and her complexion improved slightly.
"Can you talk now?" Yuan Ming asked again.
"To talk of this matter, blame Fellow Daoist Yuan somewhat. If you hadn't taken away that half of the 'Pill King Secret Manual,' how could I have been punished by the sect?" Yun Luo Fairy said with a hint of ghostly tone.
"Words can't be spoken recklessly; surely there's another hidden reason for Yun Luo Fairy to be treated like that, which is largely unrelated to me?" Yuan Ming said, furrowing his brows.
"If Fellow Daoist says so, then it is so," Yun Luo Fairy smiled.
"Enough, these are Fellow Daoist Yun Luo's private matters. If you don't wish to speak, so be it; according to our prior agreement, give me the Dharma Manifestation Pill's recipe," Yuan Ming extended his hand.
"The Dharma Manifestation Pill's recipe is in that half of the 'Pill King Secret Manual,' which is no longer in my possession but was taken by the Su Nu Sect," Yun Luo Fairy spread her hands, looking quite helpless.
"Didn't Fellow Daoist Yun Luo at least glance at that half of the 'Pill King Secret Manual' when you got it?" Yuan Ming frowned deeply.
"There was no time. The day I left Emperor Yan's Mausoleum, the people of Su Nu Sect captured me, and I had no chance to look," Yun Luo Fairy shook her head.
"Fellow Daoist Yun Luo, you know I'm a soul cultivator, and all soul cultivators are extremely sensitive to divine soul fluctuations, capable of discerning the truth of others' words. I'm quite proficient in this," Yuan Ming fell into silence for a moment, then spoke slowly.
He had been using the emotion manipulation ability, sensing Yun Luo Fairy's emotional fluctuations. Though her face was calm, her emotions fluctuated wildly, clearly speaking nonsense.
"Oh, Fellow Daoist Yuan possesses such divine skills, quite beyond my expectations," Yun Luo Fairy smiled.
"Fellow Daoist Yun Luo, let's not beat around the bush. I put in considerable effort to rescue you; are you unwilling to give the Dharma Manifestation Pill recipe?" Yuan Ming's patience was wearing thin, and his tone grew heavier.
"If I simply don't want to give it, what would Fellow Daoist Yuan do?" Yun Luo Fairy put away her smile.
"If Fellow Daoist Yun Luo refuses to keep her promise, I might not kill you out of our acquaintance, but I can certainly sell you off. As for who to sell you to, it'll depend on whether Su Nu Sect or Dongji Palace offers a higher price," Yuan Ming said coldly, looking at Yun Luo Fairy.
"Would Fellow Daoist Yuan really hand me over? Don't you want to obtain that half of the 'Pill King Secret Manual' from me? Besides the Dharma Manifestation Pill, it contains many precious elixir recipes with immeasurable value," Yun Luo Fairy gazed into Yuan Ming's eyes.
When Yuan Ming heard this, his eyes flickered slightly.
"Don't think about performing a soul search on me. My divine soul has a soul fire talisman sealed in it; a little provocation will cause it to explode, burning my divine soul. After that, it will be more troublesome for Fellow Daoist to retrieve the recipe," Yun Luo Fairy chuckled lightly, stretched lazily, and lay down.

chapters.title: Chapter 851 - 822: Pointing Out the Way
chapters.content:
"Since Yun Luo Fairy is unwilling to give even the Dharma Manifestation Pill recipe, it's useless for me to forcefully keep Fellow Daoist by my side. Besides, the Su Nu Sect has already tried, and Fellow Daoist is really stubborn. I'm not sure I can make you talk, so it's more economical to just sell you." Yuan Ming said slowly.
Yun Luo Fairy looked at Yuan Ming for a few moments, then suddenly laughed, and sat back up: "Ah, I was just joking earlier, why is Fellow Daoist Yuan taking it seriously? I have the Dharma Manifestation Pill recipe with me, I'll tell Fellow Daoist Yuan later, why so anxious?"
Yuan Ming was taken aback and frowned.
What is this Yun Luo Fairy plotting with her fickle words?
"Since Fellow Daoist Yuan is interested in how I was captured, I'll tell you the reason. I'm not sure how much Fellow Daoist Yuan knows about the Su Nu Sect?" Yun Luo Fairy asked with a smile.
"Not much, I only know it's a well-known sect on the Central Continent, primarily composed of female cultivators." Yuan Ming replied indifferently, not really wanting to talk to Yun Luo Fairy.
"Hmph, well-known... Perhaps infamous in reputation. On the surface, it seems like a legitimate sect, but in reality, it's a high-class brothel using the beautiful female disciples of the sect as bargaining chips." Yun Luo Fairy said with a cold smile, her tone dripping with sarcasm.
"What does the Fairy mean by this?" Yuan Ming asked with a slight raise of his eyebrows.
"The Su Nu Sect recruits female disciples widely on the Central Continent, especially those with exceptional beauty or unique constitutions, supposedly to cultivate them for longevity. But in reality, they are raising Furnace Tripods for the powerhouses of the Central Continent. All carefully nurtured disciples are just goods to be sold." Yun Luo Fairy said with a look of mockery.
"Is that so? Then Fellow Daoist Yun Luo, you..." Yuan Ming hesitated.
"Since I joined the Su Nu Sect, I shared the same fate. I was chosen by a Dharma Phase Cultivator, not even for Dual Cultivation, but only as a lowly slave. Naturally, I was unwilling and took the chance to escape while the sect was unprepared. When they couldn't find me, they massacred most of my family, and those they considered valuable were all taken to the Su Nu Sect." Yun Luo Fairy paused here.
Yuan Ming glanced at Yun Luo Fairy after hearing this but didn't urge her to continue.
"The sect threatened me with the lives of my clan members, forcing me to return. Fortunately, an elder in the sect took pity and negotiated for my freedom by making me agree to find the long-lost Pill King Pavilion Inheritance for them in exchange for sparing me and my clan, allowing those still alive to escape suffering and regain freedom." Yun Luo Fairy continued, a hint of hatred flashing in her eyes.
"That seems fair, meeting each other's needs." Yuan Ming said.
"Yes, if everything went smoothly, I would be eternally grateful, but unfortunately, my strength wasn't enough. I only brought back half of the 'Pill King Secret Manual'. The Su Nu Sect thought I hid the other half and the Complete Heaven Exquisite Tripod, and immediately captured me, torturing me without any chance to explain." Yun Luo Fairy said with a bitter smile.
"If Fellow Daoist Yun Luo thinks you faced calamity because you only brought back half of the manual, you are greatly mistaken. Even if you returned with the complete inheritance of the Pill King Pavilion, they still wouldn't spare you." Yuan Ming said flatly.
"What do you mean by that?" Yun Luo Fairy was startled and looked at Yuan Ming.
"The 'Pill King Secret Manual' is incredibly precious, and such a great merit is too much for a rebellious disciple like you. Although you sought only to save your clan, your fellow disciples wouldn't believe it, nor would they let you take all the credit. They didn't kill you because the other half of the secret manual and the Complete Heaven Exquisite Tripod are in my hands. If you had returned with the complete inheritance, you would have been a corpse by now." Yuan Ming said slowly.
After hearing this, Yun Luo Fairy opened her mouth but couldn't say anything, her eyes vacant and lost.
This reasoning wasn't complicated, but Yun Luo Fairy was caught in the situation with her heart set on her clan, causing confusion in her care.
Now that she thought about it calmly, Yun Luo Fairy quickly understood the stakes involved, stood up, and solemnly bowed to Yuan Ming, saying with deep apology: "Fellow Daoist Yuan is correct. I was too foolish, even blaming you for taking the other half of the secret manual, truly ashamed."
"You were evasive about giving me the Dharma Manifestation Pill recipe earlier because you were angry and intentionally making it difficult, weren't you?" Yuan Ming asked in return.
"It was my narrow-mindedness; I ask for Fellow Daoist Yuan's forgiveness." Yun Luo Fairy blushed slightly, her guilt even more evident.
Yuan Ming was somewhat speechless, but seeing Yun Luo Fairy's remorseful expression, he inexplicably softened and gestured that he didn't care.
"Hehe, I knew Fellow Daoist Yuan was generous and wouldn't mind such a small thing." Yun Luo Fairy immediately seized the opportunity, changing her expression to a playful smile like a switch.
Yuan Ming was momentarily stunned and shifted his gaze with annoyance.Publication courtesy of *.
"Although I have escaped the clutches of the Su Nu Sect, my family is still in their hands. Fellow Daoist Yuan, you are far more thoughtful than I am; could you point me towards a way out?" Yun Luo Fairy asked again, seemingly certain that Yuan Ming wouldn't really be angry with her.
Yuan Ming understood the ins and outs of Yun Luo Fairy being captured, and there was nothing that worried him, so he couldn't be bothered to pay attention to this woman anymore. He closed his eyes on his own.
Yun Luo Fairy pleaded two more times, seeing that Yuan Ming continued to ignore her, she became shameless: "Fellow Daoist Yuan, are you really unwilling to offer some guidance? Then the Dharma Manifestation Pill Recipe will be gone too."
"Fellow Daoist Yun Luo, what cultivation technique do you practice in the Su Nu Sect? Could it be the Iron Face Divine Skill?" Yuan Ming frowned.
Yun Luo Fairy chuckled, unconcerned by Yuan Ming's sarcasm, urging Yuan Ming to speak quickly.
"I can share some superficial insights, but once I speak, the Dharma Manifestation Pill Recipe must be given to me." Yuan Ming said seriously.
"Alright." Yun Luo Fairy readily agreed.
"Fellow Daoist Yun Luo, in order to save your clan members, you chose to make a pact with the Su Nu Sect. This was a major mistake; you should not pin your hopes on the sect's mercy." Yuan Ming sat up, shaking his head.
"The Su Nu Sect has always resolved disputes through exchanges of interests. This is not uncommon in the sect; why can't my situation be handled the same way?" Yun Luo Fairy was somewhat incredulous.
"Because your defiance is not a minor issue; it's a challenge to the Su Nu Sect's authority, uncovering the sect's disgrace. No matter what contributions you have made to the sect, they will never let you go. To appease that Dharma Phase cultivator's wrath, you would merely be forced into submission and sent back to his bed, or even silenced forever." Yuan Ming said calmly.
Yun Luo Fairy's body trembled, and her mouth opened, but ultimately she said nothing.
"Fellow Daoist Yun Luo, instead of placing your hopes on others, it's better to strengthen your own power to protect your family. Otherwise, others will always use your family as a weakness to endlessly coerce and exploit you." Yuan Ming said.
Upon hearing this, Yun Luo Fairy's eyes first lit up, then gradually dimmed: "Fellow Daoist Yuan, you haven't been to the Central Continent, and you don't know much about the Su Nu Sect. Its foundation is far stronger than you imagine, not to mention being a millennium-old sect. In recent years, by sending out female disciples, it has formed countless connections with other forces. This is not something that can be achieved through individual strength."
"So what? I know someone, also a woman, who faced oppression from a power far stronger than her own. Even her family and clan stood against her. But she was never afraid, tirelessly devoted, strategically advancing, gradually enhancing her power and influence until she became strong enough to defeat that unbeatable enemy, crushing it into the dust, never to rise again." Yuan Ming said to the azure sky, a gentle smile on his lips.
"Is there really such a remarkable woman? How do I compare to her?" Yun Luo Fairy said in disbelief, then saw the tenderness on Yuan Ming's face and understood a little, snorting coldly as she asked.
"You are worlds apart. She never questioned her own capabilities, only considered how to achieve them." Yuan Ming said casually.
Yun Luo Fairy was internally unconvinced, but considering her current situation, she couldn't help but feel disheartened.
"You currently cannot contend with the Su Nu Sect, and begging for mercy is useless. The only option is to fight desperately. Since you can't develop a force to counter the Su Nu Sect in the short term, then first enhance your own strength. At least break through the Dharma manifestation Stage, become a figure that the Su Nu Sect cultivators will fear. Your Yun Family members will also fare much better." Yuan Ming continued.
"Though my cultivation has reached the peak of Returning to Void Late Stage, there is still a distance to breaking through to the Dharma manifestation Stage. If I go into hiding to cultivate, will the Su Nu Sect not persecute the Yun Family people?" Yun Luo Fairy asked with some worry.
"The Su Nu Sect may make some moves, but if you can remain patient and not show yourself, then those within your sect will act with caution and likely not dare to go too far." Yuan Ming said.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, your words make sense. Hearing your counsel today is truly enlightening. At this moment, the most important thing for me is to refine the Dharma manifestation Pill." Yun Luo Fairy, rejuvenated, swept away her previous decline and said.
"It's good that you think that way. It wasn't in vain that I went to the trouble of saving you." Yuan Ming nodded and said.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, such a lifesaving grace may only be repaid by offering myself to you." With the shadow in her heart cleared, Yun Luo Fairy returned to a playful state.
"That's not necessary. If you want to repay the favor, just give me the Dharma manifestation Pill Recipe and the refining method." Yuan Ming said.
"I thought you'd ask directly for the remaining half of the 'Pill King Secret Manual'?" Yun Luo Fairy said with some surprise.
"Oh, if I asked, would you give it to me?" Yuan Ming retorted.
"Of course not!" Yun Luo Fairy said confidently.

chapters.title: Chapter 852 - 823: Each Takes What They Need
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming was not surprised by Yun Luo Fairy's response. He extended his hand to her, palm open, revealing a blank jade slip.
This time, Yun Luo Fairy did not refuse. She took the blank jade slip from Yuan Ming's hand, infused it with mana, and soon returned it.
Yuan Ming received the jade slip and immersed his Divine Sense into it.
"Refining a Dharma Manifestation Pill presents two major challenges. First is the difficulty in acquiring the elixir materials. Most of the required materials are level five spiritual materials, and some are even level six. The most core and hardest to obtain ingredient is a Nascent Soul of a Dharma manifestation stage cultivator, or a demon core and demon soul of a level six demon beast. Second, the level of the alchemist must be very high, requiring at least a level five alchemist, and to be safe, a level six alchemist," Yun Luo Fairy said slowly.
Yuan Ming finished reading the Dharma Manifestation Pill's recipe and realized that the materials were indeed as Yun Luo described, causing his heart to sink slightly.
Whether it's the Nascent Soul of a Dharma manifestation stage cultivator or the demon core and demon soul of a level six demon beast, they are precious treasures that are not easily found.
Comparatively, the requirement for the alchemist isn't much of a problem. Yuan Ming himself is not far from being a level five alchemist, and if necessary, Dian Xiaosan can assist.
Yuan Ming is conscious that his skills in alchemy are not as profound as Dian Xiaosan's.
Subsequently, fearing that Yuan Ming might not be familiar with the spiritual materials, Yun Luo Fairy described each of the relatively obscure materials in the recipe in detail.
Yuan Ming memorized them in his heart and further inquired about the entire refining process and important points to note, receiving thorough answers.
Finally obtaining the Dharma Manifestation Pill recipe, Yuan Ming let out a long sigh and began to plan how to gather the spiritual materials.
He is currently quite wealthy; those level five and even level six spiritual materials can probably be gathered just by spending a lot of spirit stones.
If spirit stones aren't enough, he still has many Vow Power Pills on hand, which he can pretend are Soul Refining Elixirs to sell for a large number of spirit stones.
The only trouble is the Nascent Soul of Dharma manifestation stage or the demon core and demon soul of a level six demon beast, but now that he knows the direction, there should be more solutions than difficulties.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, trying to find the spiritual materials required for refining the Dharma Manifestation Pill on one's own is exceedingly difficult. Now we are both wanted by the East Pole Palace and have incurred trouble with the Su Nu Sect, making it hard to take action freely. How about we cooperate?" After a series of questions and answers, Yun Luo Fairy suddenly proposed.
"How do we cooperate?" Yuan Ming raised an eyebrow and asked.
"Leave the search for the remaining spiritual materials to me, while Fellow Daoist Yuan focuses on obtaining the Nascent Soul of a Dharma manifestation stage cultivator, or the demon core and demon soul of a level six demon beast. After successfully refining the pill, we will split it evenly," Yun Luo Fairy suggested.
"Fellow Daoist Yun Luo, isn't this division unfair? The items you have to find, although numerous, can be steadily acquired with some effort. Mine, on the other hand, will likely require risking my life," Yuan Ming said, shaking his head.
"If it seems unfair to Fellow Daoist Yuan, then I'm willing to compromise further by selecting a pill of the same level as the Dharma Manifestation Pill from the second half of the secret manual and giving its recipe and refining method to you as compensation. How about that?" Yun Luo Fairy contemplated briefly and spoke.
"Agreed." Yuan Ming did not hesitate further and nodded.
Immediately, Yun Luo Fairy began choosing the names and effects of several level five elixirs, explaining them one by one to Yuan Ming.
"I'll choose the Melding Spirit Pill," Yuan Ming said after considering for a while.
The Melding Spirit Pill is an obscure elixir with a very singular effect: it can transform the body.
According to Yun Luo Fairy, this recipe wasn't created by the Pill King Pavilion but was obtained through an exchange with a body refining sect called "Ten Thousand Beast Sect."
The Ten Thousand Beast Sect is unique, having not only strong Body Cultivation Methods but also a secret technique that allows the transplantation of parts of demon beasts into cultivators.
By using this method, disciples of the Ten Thousand Beast Sect can gain the abilities of demon beasts.
However, these foreign body parts are hard to assimilate with the original physical body, leading to conflict and even rejection. The Melding Spirit Pill can eliminate this conflict and truly unite both together.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, are you really going to choose this pill? This opportunity is quite rare; once missed, it won't come again," Yun Luo Fairy asked.
"Of course, but I have a question for Fellow Daoist Yun Luo. Does the Ten Thousand Beast Sect's secret technique for merging demon beast bodies have a name?" Yuan Ming asked.
The Ten Thousand Beast Sect's secret technique seemed quite similar to his own Transplanting Technique. Could it be that the Transplanting Technique originated from the Ten Thousand Beast Sect?
"I'm not aware of that. The Ten Thousand Beast Sect keeps a low profile and is not well-known on the Central Continent. Few people know about them, and I've never had any contact with them," Yun Luo Fairy was taken aback before shaking her head.
"So, is the transplantation secret technique of this sect really as powerful as you say? If we transplant some special parts, like the poisonous sack of a demon beast, will taking the Melding Spirit Pill allow it to perfectly merge with the cultivator's body?" Yuan Ming continued to ask.
"It can, and to a certain extent, it can even retain the abilities of the poisonous sack. This has precedent; once, a loose cultivator, after obtaining a Melding Spirit Pill, fused the demon eye of a Level 5 demon beast into his body, and then possessed the ability to petrify others with the demon eye, greatly enhancing his power," Yun Luo Fairy nodded in agreement.
"Alright, then I want this Melding Spirit Pill recipe," Yuan Ming's eyes lit up at her words, making a decision.
His choice of this recipe was not for himself but for Lei Yu.
The reason Yuan Ming valued Lei Yu was not for his offensive capabilities but for his potential in tunneling speed.
After Lei Yu advanced to Level 5, although his tunneling speed increased significantly, it was still far behind those at the Dharma Phase stage.
He planned to use the Transplanting Technique to attach the wings of the Roc demon clan from the Azure Dragon Pond onto Lei Yu. As that creature contained Roc blood, if the Melding Spirit Pill could help Lei Yu perfectly fuse, he would gain entirely new Thunder and Wind wings, greatly increasing his tunneling speed.
In this way, Yuan Ming would have more confidence when facing Dharma Phase cultivators.
"The Melding Spirit Pill recipe includes a total of ten spiritual materials, with nine being Level 5 materials and one being a Level 6 material. They are respectively..." Yun Luo Fairy didn't ask for a Jade Scroll this time and directly recited the recipe.
Yuan Ming listened carefully and found that most of them were materials produced from demon beasts, with some being rare spirit ores, making it not easy to gather them all.
"That's the essence of refining the Melding Spirit Pill. Although it's a bit easier than the Dharma Manifestation Pill, I advise you to find a reliable alchemist to help you refine it," Yun Luo Fairy said.
"Actually, I'm also interested in the other recipes on that half of the secret scripture. If you are willing, I'm willing to fund the purchase or trade for something you need, feel free to ask," Yuan Ming nodded, and after a slight hesitation, he said.
"Forget about it," Yun Luo Fairy replied without a thought, directly refusing.
She then fixed her gaze on Yuan Ming and said, "Or you can try to forcibly Soul Search me. You are a Soul Cultivator, your Soul Searching Divine Ability must be exquisite, maybe you can avoid triggering the Soul Fire Talisman and explore my memories."
"If I had really intended to do that, I would have Soul Searched you when you were unconscious earlier..." Yuan Ming laughed.
However, halfway through his sentence, his voice suddenly stopped.Helpuscontinuebyreadingatthesource:*.
The three guarding disciples of the Su Nu Sect had all been caught by him; the half portion of the Pill King Secret Manual on Yun Luo should be with those three. Why bother trying to obtain it from Yun Luo Fairy; he could simply go and look at it later.
"If Fellow Daoist Yun Luo is unwilling, then never mind; I'll figure out another way," thought Yuan Ming, smiling faintly.
"The ones guarding me, like Zi Mei, have been suppressed by you? If you intend to acquire that half of the 'Pill King Secret Manual' through them, you might as well forget it. Though I'm not wise, I'm not completely unprepared against the Su Nu Sect. The secret scripture I handed over to them was a counterfeit I recreated after copying it. The recipes have been subtly altered; while it won't make the elixirs completely ineffective, the success rate will be greatly reduced, possibly even impossible to refine. As for the original, I've already destroyed it," Yun Luo Fairy seemed to have guessed Yuan Ming's thoughts, clutching her stomach and repressing her wound while laughing lightly.
Yuan Ming, still operating his Emotion Manipulation Divine Ability to assess her emotional fluctuations, judged that her words were true and felt a touch of helplessness.
"Alright, Fellow Daoist Yuan, let's part ways here. But before leaving, could you give me a communication magical artifact so we can contact each other in the future? My storage magic tool, when being pursued by them with no place to escape, I threw it into the sea. Although it has a sensing mark, I'm not certain if I can retrieve it," Yun Luo Fairy said.
"The Dongji Sea Area is vast; ordinary communication magical artifacts might be inadequate. I'll give you a set of 'Void Communication Array', which you can use to contact me as long as you're within the Dongji Sea Area," Yuan Ming replied.
"That would be wonderful," Yun Luo Fairy said, overjoyed.
Yuan Ming then handed over a Void Communication Array to Yun Luo Fairy.
"Take these healing pills as well; they should help your injuries recover faster." With that, he handed over two White Jade Porcelain Bottles.
"Thank you," Yun Luo Fairy graciously accepted.
Upon turning to leave, she turned back and asked, "Fellow Daoist Yuan, I'm curious, how did you know I was captured by the Su Nu Sect and find their location to rescue me? Did you leave some sort of mark on me earlier when I wasn't paying attention?"
"Correct." Yuan Ming would not reveal the real reason about the Stealing Heaven Tripod and Black Incense Possession, so he went along with what she said.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, you do have intentions toward me. So, all that previous reserve was just a show. Nonetheless, given that you are deeply infatuated with me, if you want any other genuine Dan recipes in the future, you can come to me for purchase. The price is negotiable..." Yun Luo Fairy, surprisingly not upset, seemed quite pleased.
With that, she bid farewell to Yuan Ming and then left his temporary cave mansion, transforming into a tunneling light that soon vanished into the distance.
Yuan Ming also stepped outside the cave mansion, watching her departing figure, shaking his head somewhat speechlessly.

chapters.title: Chapter 853 - 824 Separating for Cultivation
chapters.content:
Several days later.
At Yuan Ming's summons, Hua Zhi quickly arrived at the deserted island; however, to Yuan Ming's dismay, behind her came a large group of so-called "Holy Spirit Association" demon beast members, looking grand and imposing.
Yuan Ming instructed Hua Zhi to settle those demon beasts briefly, then summoned her along with Vajra and Lei Yu to his side.
"The previous matters have come to an end. In the coming period, I plan to find a suitable place for focused training. The outside world is still in turmoil, so you'll also need to conceal yourselves and lie low with me for a while," Yuan Ming said.
Hua Zhi, Vajra, and Lei Yu were already aware of Yuan Ming's plans and showed no surprise.
"Hua Zhi, the Holy Spirit Association you established lacks organizational structure and action plans. It's just chaotic messing around. With those subordinates around, you're too conspicuous. If powers like Dongji Palace or Luo Jia Mountain find out, it will harm both yourself and others. Disband them all," Yuan Ming said, looking at Hua Zhi.
"Master, I got along very well with those people and don't want to just abandon them like this. Besides, you're underestimating me. When Sister Xi Ying unified the Yunhuang Continent back in the day, I was always by her side, learning quite a bit about sect management methods. Although the Holy Spirit Association was formed on a whim, I have already planned out how it will develop, and it might have potential in the future," Hua Zhi said reluctantly.
"So what do you want to do?" Yuan Ming noticed her little scheme and asked deliberately.
"Master, I want to take them out for an adventure... Rest assured, I will develop the Holy Spirit Association well. When it grows strong enough, like Dongji Palace, I'll bring them to find you, and by then, we'll return to Dongji Sea together and see who dares to pursue you?" Hua Zhi said, patting her chest.
"What if I disagree?" Yuan Ming raised his eyebrows and asked.
"If you disagree… if you disagree, disagree… then I won't go," Hua Zhi dropped her small face immediately, saying pitifully.
"Fine, always staying by my side, you still seem like an immature child. Going out to experience the world might be good, but be sure to protect yourself," Yuan Ming thought for a moment and suddenly smiled.
"Thank you, Master, you're really great!" Hua Zhi immediately exclaimed with joy.
Vajra, standing beside them, seeing this, also spoke up: "Master, I've been thinking carefully these days. What you said before is right. The Body of Wanxiang has many shortcomings. I also want to go out for some adventure."Read ahead and get updates at *.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming shifted his gaze to Vajra, showing a contemplative expression.
Now, Hua Zhi's strength has advanced further, reaching the upper fifth level, while Vajra lags considerably behind.
So Vajra, unlike Hua Zhi, really wants to go out for training rather than just traveling around.
He's different from Hua Zhi, being a body cultivation type, with an exceptionally robust physique, the kind that becomes stronger in battle as you fight fearlessly, improving quickly.
Always staying by Yuan Ming's side, he actually had too few chances to experience life and death tempering.
"You do need to experience more tempering outside to achieve higher accomplishments in the future. Just as well, I've recently refined some Blood Origin Pills, perfect for providing you some, to assist with training," Yuan Ming said.
Speaking up, he took out a White Jade Porcelain Bottle and tossed it to Vajra.
Vajra caught it, opened the stopper, and poured out three round blood-red pills, feeling the incredibly rich blood qi power within them, his eyes immediately brightened.
"These three Blood Origin Pills are refined from the corpses of Level 5 demon beasts slain in Emperor Yan's Tomb, containing great blood qi power, needless to say, but also retain some difficult-to-remove impurities. So don't rely too much on these elixirs and avoid continuous use for the sake of quick advancement, remember," Yuan Ming warned.
"Thank you, master. Rest assured, I understand. Body cultivation tempers the physical body, and indeed absorbing the Power of the Sun is the correct way; hastiness will not lead to success. I know this truth," Vajra said, clasping his hands.
On hearing this, Yuan Ming nodded slightly.
Vajra has always been steady in character, and in this aspect, Yuan Ming feels assured.
Then Yuan Ming turned his gaze to Lei Yu, who had remained silent by the side.
Before Yuan Ming could ask, Lei Yu had already proactively spoken: "Master, I don't want to go out for training yet. I want to continue staying by your side."
"Lei Yu, aren't you silly? With the vast world outside, don't you want to broaden your horizons with some adventures? Following me, I'll take you to the Azure Dragon Sea and Luojia Sea to gain knowledge that will open your eyes and captivate you completely," Hua Zhi asked with a puzzled look.
"You want Lei Yu to follow you as your mount," Vajra mercilessly exposed her thoughts.
Hua Zhi's little thought got publicly revealed, immediately displaying a look of ashamed anger, preparing to fight Vajra.
"I'm not going, though. If master completes retreat and wants to contact you, having me here makes it convenient," Lei Yu said.
Upon hearing this, Hua Zhi and Vajra fell silent, feeling a bit guilty in their hearts.
Yuan Ming was also surprised at Lei Yu's answer, but soon showed a pleased and satisfied expression.
He then advised Hua Zhi and Vajra again before letting the two leave.
"Lei Yu, was what you said earlier your true thoughts? You really don't want to go on adventures with Hua Zhi?" Yuan Ming asked.
After a slight hesitation, Lei Yu said, "Being with Hua Zhi is quite fun, but since they all left, someone has to accompany master, right?"
Yuan Ming felt a warmth in his heart upon hearing this.
"Lei Yu, when you attacked Ye Wuya earlier, what kind of divine skill did you use? How could you make a late-stage Returning Void cultivator instantly lose combat ability?" Yuan Ming suddenly remembered something and asked.
Mentioning this matter, Lei Yu seemed a bit excited, with a hint of pride in his voice: "Master, after I advanced to level five, I awakened a brand new ability, which I call 'Thunder Heart Strike'."
"Thunder Heart Strike..." Yuan Ming murmured.
"This is a precise attack that can directly apply the power of thunder and lightning to the opponent's heart. Once hit, the enemy, no matter how strong their physical body, will be paralyzed and unable to move for a short period." Lei Yu further explained.
"Your ability is quite interesting. Combined with your speed, it can indeed be unexpectedly effective." Yuan Ming praised.
Lei Yu was even happier upon hearing the compliment.
"Let's go, this is not a place to linger. We should keep moving." Yuan Ming glanced at the sky and stood up.
With such a large group of members from the Holy Spirit Association brought here by Hua Zhi, even the most inconspicuous deserted island would probably be noticed, leaving him no choice but to depart.
Lei Yu immediately leaped up, spread its wings, and took off into the void, carrying Yuan Ming swiftly away into the distance.
...
A month later.
In a remote area of the Dongji Sea, a few small islands were sparsely distributed.
The islands were bare, with exposed rocks and rarely any vegetation, making them look desolate.
In midair, Lei Yu retracted its wings and circled above for a while with Yuan Ming, using its divine soul to scan the islands below, before swooping down and landing on a desolate island with sparse trees in the center.
These islands were all deserted, with little wildlife, indicating that they were places with scarce spiritual energy, hardly visited by anyone, making it an ideal hiding spot for Yuan Ming.
Lei Yu landed with him on the east side of the island, where there was a sparse patch of trees. Hidden within the trees was a wind-eroded cave beneath a steep cliff, less than two meters high, making it highly concealed and impossible to spot without divine sense from above.
Yuan Ming first stored Lei Yu back into the spiritual beast bag, then walked into the cave himself.
The inside of the cave was not large, but aside from the uneven floor, it was quite dry and comfortable, suitable for taking refuge.
He quickly tidied up the cave, then set up an array at the entrance to conceal his presence, took out the Shura Palace, placed it on the ground, and with a flicker, entered it.
Yuan Ming walked directly to the space where the Black Tower was located.
As soon as he appeared, Ruan Hongxiang, Ye San, and others immediately came forward to salute him: "Lord Nether Moon God."
Yuan Ming nodded slightly, not saying much to them, merely waving his hand to make a dozen figures appear, rolling to the ground, all still in a deep sleep.
Seeing this, Ye San and the others exchanged glances with a flash in their eyes, and all took a few steps back, standing silently.
Among the people on the ground, aside from three female disciples of Su Nu Sect, the rest were all cultivators from Wuya Island, including six late-stage Returning Void cultivators and over ten Nascent Soul realm cultivators, led by Island Master Ye Wuya.
Yuan Ming stripped them of their storage magic tools and then proceeded to implant a soul descent rune into each of them, one by one.
After completing this, he pointed a single finger to his brow, releasing a fan-shaped soul power to awaken all the people on the ground.
In the moment of awakening, all those people looked terrified, as if they had been through a never-ending nightmare. The moment they recognized their surroundings, they all appeared wary, attempting to summon their magic treasures.
However, upon feeling their wrists and fingers, they realized their storage magic tools had all been stripped away.
"Haven't you had enough fighting on Wuya Island? I could suppress you then, and I can kill you now." Yuan Ming shouted violently, his robe billowing without wind, his aura suddenly erupting.
Simultaneously, twelve soul crows flew out, forming a crow formation.
Each soul crow opened its mouth and emitted a Crow's Call Wave, instantly creating a magnificent black sound wave.
The surging sound wave spread out fan-shaped, crashing towards Ye Wuya, Zi Mei, and the others. Sensing danger, they immediately tried to use their cultivation techniques to protect their divine soul.
However, the Nascent Souls and soul powers of Ye Wuya, Zi Mei, and the others were sealed, unable to function at all.
Though the Nascent Soul realm cultivators had some residual mana left, that bit of magic power and divine soul was hardly able to resist the Crow's Call Wave.
The moment the black sound wave swept over, everyone from Wuya Island was struck stiff, as if having their throats grabbed, each eye wide in shock, emitting "uh uh" sounds, their vision beginning to blur.
Ye San and the others standing behind Yuan Ming were not directly hit, but even the residual sound waves were hard to endure, causing each of them to clutch their heads and flee into the distance.

chapters.title: Chapter 854 - 825 Placement of Congregants
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming judged that the timing was just right, and with a wave of his single hand, withdrew his divine skill.
Only then did the people of Wuya Island gradually come to their senses, their eyes dizzy and ears ringing.
Having been tossed around by Yuan Ming like this, everyone immediately became much more obedient.
They recalled how they inexplicably fell into a nightmare earlier and couldn't break free despite trying everything, cold sweat dripping down their bodies. They finally realized what kind of existence they had provoked.
"Island Master Yuan, we were ignorant and foolish. Now, we deeply understand our stupidity. Please show mercy, we are willing to offer any compensation," said Ye Wuya, stepping forward with clasped hands and bowing.
After speaking, he kept his head lowered, not raising it even an inch.
The other cultivators of Wuya Island saw this and quickly followed suit, clasping their hands and bowing to Yuan Ming.
Zi Mei, a senior sister from the Su Nu Sect, pondered for a moment, then twisted her waist, stepped forward to salute, and said:
"Island Master Yuan, I am from the Su Nu Sect. I believe you already know this, but you might not be very familiar with our sect. I feel it's necessary to explain it to you."
Upon hearing their words, Ye San and others who were hiding far away were incredibly shocked.
The one Lord Nether Moon God had newly captured turned out to be the renowned Island Master of Wuya Island, Ye Wuya, and also a female disciple from the Central Continent Su Nu Sect.
They always thought they held Island Master Yuan and Lord Nether Moon God in high enough regard and awe, but now it seemed insufficient. He was a true divine, possessing vast divine skills and methods beyond their imagination.
"Hmph, what? Want to use your sect to pressure me?" Yuan Ming sneered, unaware of the shock in the hearts of the believers behind him, and asked.
"I dare not. I meant to say that the Su Nu Sect has always revered the strong. If you are willing, I can recommend you to become a sacrificial elder in our sect. At that time, the resources and female cultivators of the Su Nu Sect will be at your disposal." Zi Mei quickly explained, recalling the earlier agony that nearly shattered her divine soul.
"Female cultivators at my disposal? Does that include you?" Yuan Ming raised an eyebrow and asked.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, with your vast divine skills, it would be my honor to serve you." Zi Mei's thoughts spun rapidly, a charming smile appeared on her face, her beautiful eyes even more bright and intoxicating, seemingly able to capture one's soul.
Yuan Ming sneered, raised his hand, and pressed forward into the void.
In the next instant, the void above the cultivators' heads fluctuated, a mass of black light condensed out of thin air, transforming into a black giant palm the size of a palace, emanating circles of black light waves pressing downward—the Great Black Sky God Palm.
Within dozens of feet, everything was frozen, space itself seemed to freeze, and the powerful spiritual pressure bore down, bringing unspeakable stress to everyone, changing their complexions.
Zi Mei bore an even heavier pressure than the others, directly kneeling to the ground with a thump, her charming face turned ashen, the earlier enchantment completely vanished.
"Those improper transactions of the Su Nu Sect hold no interest for me, nor your shallow seduction techniques; do not flaunt them in front of me again, or I won't hesitate to cripple your cultivation," Yuan Ming calmly stated, the chill in his tone making Zi Mei and the other three feel faint-hearted.
"Yes..." Zi Mei shivered, not daring to utter another word.
"And as for you, since you dared to strike at me on Wuya Island that day, you shall pay the price now," said Yuan Ming, looking at the others.
Having witnessed Yuan Ming's methods, everyone present was apprehensive, not daring to meet his gaze.
"Island Master Yuan, indeed, we offended you that day. What kind of compensation do you desire?" Ye Wuya cupped his hands and asked.
"You've known my identity; aside from being the Spiritual Ape Island Master, I am also the Sect Hierarch of the Moon Sect, the Nether Moon God. Unless you henceforth submit to the Moon Sect, settle here, sincerely pray to the Nether Moon God, and follow my commands, I might leave you alive," Yuan Ming slowly stated.
Upon hearing this, everyone was relieved to know their lives were spared, but immediately became anxious again.
It seemed from Yuan Ming's words that he intended to confine them permanently, a fate worse than death.
"Island Master Yuan, will there be a day when we can regain our freedom?" Ye Wuya bravely asked.
"I am not unreasonable; as long as you behave well, there will naturally be a time to see the light of day again," replied Yuan Ming, looking at him.
"Alright, as long as there's a chance for freedom, I am willing," Ye Wuya nodded, said.
His words prompted the other cultivators of Wuya Island to naturally comply.
The three from the Su Nu Sect also expressed their willingness to comply.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming's expression remained calm, but inwardly, he was overjoyed.
With so many Returning to Void believers, the desire power generated would multiply.
"Very good, it's best that you can think it through, sparing me the need to take action and causing unnecessary killings. Now, tell me what cultivation techniques you practice, your cultivation levels, and what you excel in. Ye Wuya, you start," Yuan Ming nodded, said.
Cultivation techniques, cultivation levels, and divine skills are critical information for cultivators, and even the closest people may not disclose them.
But when Yuan Ming asked, Ye Wuya dared not refuse to answer. After a brief hesitation, he said, "I primarily cultivate the 'Xuan Yuan Spirit Technique', and I'm at the peak of the Late Stage Refining. I'm proficient in formations."
"You are an Array Master? Was it you who set up the Thunder Array inside the Qingchun Pavilion? Being able to arrange such a great array in haste is impressive. What is the level of your array formation?" Yuan Ming's face showed a slight delight, and he inquired further.
"I am a Level 5 Array Master and have lingered at this level for many years... I just saw a glimmer of hope for advancing to Level 6." Ye Wuya noticed Yuan Ming's joyful expression and said nervously.
"Not bad, in the future, besides your prayers, you should also continue to delve into the path of formations. Here are some classics on formations, which should be of significant help to your study of this path. Do not slack off." Yuan Ming nodded, taking out four or five books, along with a dozen jade scrolls, and placed them in front of Ye Wuya.
At the same time, he flicked his finger, shooting a ray of black light into Ye Wuya's dantian.
The Xuan Demon Seal within Ye Wuya loosened considerably, releasing one-tenth of his Mana and Soul Power.
"Thank you... Lord Nether Moon God, for your Divine Gift." Ye Wuya sensed the recovery of his Mana, and gratefully thanked him.
As for the classical jade scrolls given by Yuan Ming, he initially didn't pay much attention.
Having been the Wuya Island Master for many years, and being a Level 5 Array Master himself, Ye Wuya had seen all sorts of array formation manuals.
However, if he completely ignored what Yuan Ming had bestowed, he feared it might incur the other's displeasure.
Ye Wuya put on a facade of eagerness, opened a classic, and after a glance, quickly became moved, his pupils shrinking, staring intently at the book in his hand, and began reading hungrily.
The people nearby saw this and were curious about the content of the classic, but dared not speak rashly.
"That's enough; the classics and jade scrolls are for you. No one will compete with you; just study them slowly." Yuan Ming said.* is the home of this chapter
What was recorded in those classical jade scrolls were precisely Su Yingxue's research on formations, invaluable indeed.
He granted these things to Ye Wuya with his plans in mind.
Yuan Ming had possessed Su Yingxue multiple times over the years; however, for some reason, he never could, through possessing Su Yingxue, quickly enhance his array formation cultivation as he did with others.
In the past, when his formation cultivation was low, he was unable to grasp Su Yingxue's insights into formations, which was understandable. But now, his formation level had reached Level 5, only one level short of Su Yingxue, yet possessing Su Yingxue was still the same as before.
Now meeting Ye Wuya, Yuan Ming planned to change his strategy, help Ye Wuya improve his array formation cultivation, and then possess this person to learn his insights on formations, to figure out where the problem lay.
"Next is Fellow Daoist Yin Lang." Yuan Ming collected his thoughts and looked at Yin Lang.
"I cultivate the 'Nine-layered Separation Fire Technique', and am at the Early Stage of Returning to Void, with some research on Beast Taming Techniques." Yin Lang said with some hope.
Yuan Ming recalled Yin Lang's parrot spirit beast, nodded, and also liberated one-tenth of his cultivation, recording the Golden Sunflower Beast Taming Technique in a jade scroll to pass on to him.
"Since you excel at Beast Taming Techniques, I pass this Beast Taming Secret Technique to you; in future prayers, study it earnestly."
"Thank you, Lord Nether Moon God, for your Divine Gift." Yin Lang let his Divine Sense enter the jade scroll, and soon also showed an expression of great joy.
The others, seeing Yuan Ming so generous, actually bestowing benefits, eagerly followed suit, stating their cultivation and cultivation techniques, hoping Yuan Ming would grant them divine skills and secret techniques.
With so many willing to aid in his cultivation, Yuan Ming naturally wouldn't let them down and imparted various secret techniques from himself to them one by one.
When it was Zi Mei's turn, speaking of her specialties, her cheeks blushed a deep red, momentarily finding it hard to speak.
Under Yuan Ming's urging, she finally admitted her expertise in Dual Cultivation techniques and hinted that she could serve as a Furnace Tripod for Yuan Ming, assisting in cultivation.
After speaking, she gazed at Yuan Ming with affectionate eyes.
The result was only another roll of the eyes from him.
Yuan Ming had no secret techniques for Dual Cultivation, so he taught her the Circular Light Technique.
Upon completing the teachings, Yuan Ming told everyone, "From now on, you are all believers of my Moon Sect. How to pray will be taught to you later. Ye San, these people are now your responsibility. If you have any cultivation needs on ordinary days, you can also speak to him."
Hearing Yuan Ming calling him, Ye San immediately stood out and replied, "As you command."
After arranging for those people, Yuan Ming left alone, arriving at the Medicine Garden within the Shura Palace.
The Medicine Garden here had been newly refurbished, with a newly arranged formation enveloping the entire garden, forming a nearly invisible, translucent light shield.
Yuan Ming walked slowly into the Medicine Garden, arriving at a series of terraced fields gradually rising in height, where a small stone and wood building of modest size had been constructed.
This was the cave mansion he built for himself. With the Shura Palace as a space treasure, there's no need to dig and hollow walls anymore. Wherever he went, he could cultivate within this stone building.
The Gathering Spirit Tree was also transplanted here. The nature's spiritual energy within the Medicine Garden had already become quite dense, comparable to that on Spiritual Ape Island.

chapters.title: Chapter 855 - 826: Misfortune and Fortune Go Hand in Hand
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming walked into the stone building, closed the door, and took out all the storage magic tools he had collected earlier, inspecting each one.
These cultivators mostly had respectable cultivation levels, and their storage magic tools were naturally filled with treasures; spiritual materials, magic treasures, elixirs—anything imaginable.
However, it was somewhat regrettable that either the grade of these elixirs and magic treasures was far different from Yuan Ming's or their effects were not suitable, providing limited help to him.
Fortunately, these individuals had a substantial amount of Spirit Stones, totaling as much as five to six million.
Yuan Ming organized all the elixirs by category, but did not bother with their magic treasures, leaving them in their original storage magic tools.
These items now became his private stash, possibly to be returned to those who proved useful in the future, or even used to reward those cultivators who followed him; who would get them depended on their performance.
Yuan Ming waved his sleeve and gathered up all the storage magic tools, leaving only three.
These three storage magic tools belonged to the three women from the Su Nu Sect, who hailed from the Central Continent; perhaps they held something different.
Yuan Ming used his Divine Sense to peer into the three storage magic tools, quickly revealing an expression of disappointment.
The storage magic tools of those three did not contain the forged "Pill King Secret Manual" that Yun Luo Fairy had mentioned.
Although Yun Luo Fairy said it was full of errors, Yuan Ming wanted to obtain it to verify it himself.
If nothing else, when he acquired the Dan Recipe from Yun Luo Fairy later, he could use it for reference and corroboration.
Earlier, when Yuan Ming had used the Soul Searching technique on Chen Yuluan and Wang Qi, he learned that the two women had never encountered the "Pill King Secret Manual." After Yun Luo Fairy handed over half of the secret manual, it was Zi Mei who took it, yet it turned out that the manual was not in Zi Mei's storage magic tool either.
"Master, are you looking for that half of the 'Pill King Secret Manual'? Perhaps the three women from Su Nu Sect didn't record it but remembered it in their minds," Lei Yu said, flying out of the Spiritual Beast Bag.
"There is indeed such a possibility." Yuan Ming nodded, standing up and moving to the Black Tower Space.
Lei Yu stretched its wings to follow.
Currently, the cultivators from Wuya Island, including Zi Mei, were each choosing a location to build their cave mansions.
Zi Mei, when called out individually by Yuan Ming, was not fearful but delighted inside, secretly speculating on Yuan Ming's intentions, wondering if he could not resist the allure of Dual Cultivation and thus returned.
"Island Master Yuan, did you summon me alone for some other matter?" Zi Mei asked with a hopeful tone, her gaze flowing.
"I want to know, where is the 'Pill King Secret Manual' handed over by Yun Luo Fairy?" Yuan Ming asked, staring coldly.
Zi Mei shivered slightly at his demeanor.
She felt a pang of disappointment but did not dare to deceive, saying, "That half of the 'Pill King Secret Manual' was taken by my Senior Sister Qin Meiniang."
"Qin Meiniang?" Yuan Ming raised his eyebrows slightly.
"Zi Mei does not dare to deceive. My Senior Sister is a peak Middle-stage Returning Void cultivator. If she hadn't been with us, there was no way we three could have captured Yun Luo... Junior Sister alone. After acquiring that half of the 'Pill King Secret Manual,' to avoid trouble later, Senior Sister Qin instructed us to watch over Junior Sister Yun Luo while she returned to the sect ahead of us," Zi Mei quickly explained.
"Have the three of you read the contents of that half of the 'Pill King Secret Manual'?" Yuan Ming asked.
"The 'Pill King Secret Manual' is extremely important, and we are not qualified even though Junior Sister Yun Luo certainly has seen it. You saved her..." Zi Mei spoke, cautiously glancing at Yuan Ming's expression.
Seeing his face was indifferent, she did not say more.
The implication was naturally: You saved her, yet she hasn't shown it to you?
Yuan Ming ignored her attempts to sow discord, waved his hand to send her into an illusion, then pointed at her forehead and briskly used the Soul Searching Divine Ability.
Zi Mei's Divine Soul did not contain any techniques like the soul fire talisman, so Yuan Ming completed the soul search quickly.
She indeed did not deceive him, and that half of the "Pill King Secret Manual" had indeed been taken by Qin Meiniang.
Regarding Qin Meiniang, Zi Mei's memories contained quite a lot; this woman is the Sect Leader's direct disciple at Su Nu Sect, her cultivation is profound, her Divine Skills are exceptional, and she is quite famous on the Central Continent.
Yuan Ming withdrew his finger, letting Zi Mei return, and turned to head back to the Medicine Garden Cave Mansion.
"Lord Nether Moon God, I have something to report," Yin Lang suddenly appeared, bowed to Yuan Ming after glancing at Lei Yu hovering overhead.
"Whatever matters you have, feel free to speak," Yuan Ming said, nodding with some surprise.
"I possess a valuable Dan Recipe and wish to present it to Lord Nether Moon God," Yin Lang said, taking out a Jade Scroll, channeling mana into it before placing it before Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming accepted the Jade Scroll, and his Divine Sense delved into it; within was recorded a Level 5 Dan Recipe, Thunder Origin Pill.
"Is this Thunder Origin Pill the elixir you requested me to refine that day?" He recalled Yin Lang's visit requesting alchemy and asked.
"I was impulsive that day, and I ask Lord Nether Moon God not to blame me," Yin Lang said, bowing.
"At that time, you had not yet joined the Moon Sect. Why would you be blamed? Now tell me, what is special about this elixir?" Yuan Ming waved his hand and asked.
"This Thunder Origin Pill comes from an ancient dan recipe, containing the power of thunder, with a potency extraordinarily domineering, not something the Human Clan's cultivators can withstand." Yin Lang said.
"Not something the Human Clan's cultivators can withstand? Could it be that this is not an elixir for cultivators to consume?" Yuan Ming showed a bit of interest.
"Lord Nether Moon God has guessed correctly. This pill comes from an ancient Beast Taming Sect and is meant for demon beasts with Thunder Attribute to consume. Seeing that Lord Nether Moon God has a Thunder Attribute spirit beast, perhaps this pill might be of use. Thus, I dared to offer it." Yin Lang glanced at Lei Yu hovering mid-air, a look of flattering on his face.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming raised his eyebrows.
He had prepared Purple Thunder Pills for Lei Yu's cultivation, but Purple Thunder Pills were merely Level 4 elixirs, far less effective than this Thunder Origin Pill.
"You indeed have put thought into it. I shall remember this merit." Yuan Ming stored the Jade Scroll and vanished from where he stood with a flicker.
Yin Lang breathed a sigh of relief, joy flashing in his eyes, and turned to fly back to his own cave mansion.
Yuan Ming returned to the Medicine Garden Cave Mansion to continue examining the Thunder Origin Pill recipe. After a while, he activated the Void Communication Array to contact Hua Zhi.
He instructed Hua Zhi to help collect spiritual materials needed to refine Melding Spirit Pills and Thunder Origin Pills while traveling outside. Once found, regardless of the high price, she must find a way to purchase them.
Afterward, Yuan Ming inspected the encampments of the mortals and low-level cultivators on Spiritual Ape Island, finding all were settled steadily. Moreover, managing according to Xi Ying's method, it was well organized, allowing him to be at ease.
With everything in order, Yuan Ming entered the Medicine Garden Cave Mansion, transforming into the Undying Tree form, and began secluded cultivation.
...
Spring passed, autumn came, and five years flashed by.
With the aid of Jade Liquid Pills and his diligent cultivation, Yuan Ming finally reached the peak of Middle-stage Returning Void. Subsequently, he consumed the Ginseng Origin Pill to break through to Late Stage of Returning Void.
The Primordial True Skill advanced his mana rapidly, but breaking through was extremely difficult.
Yuan Ming consumed two Ginseng Origin Pills along with other auxiliary methods, barely and fearfully achieving a breakthrough to Late Stage of Returning Void.
One day, sitting cross-legged in the cave mansion, Yuan Ming closed his eyes, sensing the state of his Dantian.Always read at the source—*.
Whether it was the Mana Mixed Hole within the Dantian or the richness of the mana, compared to before, both were enhanced multiple times over, roaring as it operated, bursting out with astonishing mana fluctuations, like a great bloodthirsty maw that could shred and devour all.
Inside the Mana Mixed Hole, seven distinct mana fluctuations clashed intensely, despite the suppressing spin of the mixed hole, much fiercer than while at Middle-stage Returning Void.
Yuan Ming furrowed his brows. The mnemonic of the Primordial True Skill mentioned mana disorder post-cultivation; he had previously dismissed it lightly.
Now it seemed that the mana disorder would gradually manifest more as his cultivation continued to enhance.
However, having chosen this path, Yuan Ming could only grit his teeth and forge ahead. As for the issues arising, he would find ways to resolve them.
He shook his head, ceasing to dwell on it, and sensed the situation of his Divine Soul and physical body. The Divine Soul made no significant progress, and Body Cultivation did not advance much.
This was no surprise to him, as most of his focus during these five years of cultivation was on Magic Practitioner, leaving little progression for Soul Cultivation and Body Cultivation.
At this moment, a faint sound of a sword humming emerged from his body.
Yuan Ming quickly followed the sound for inner observation, discovering its source to be the Mixed Hole Vortex where the Soul Destroying Sword silently hovered.
With his Magic Practitioner realm breakthrough, the Soul Destroying Sword, as his Lifebound Magical Treasure, also benefited, emitting joyous light hums.
With a thought, the Soul Destroying Sword appeared in his hand. The fingers of his other hand pinched together, tracing gently along the sword's surface.
Moments later, he withdrew his fingers, confusion flickering in his eyes.
Over the years, despite never relaxing in nurturing and refining the Soul Destroying Sword, its power improved, yet its spiritual growth was incredibly slow, failing to nurture an Artifact Spirit till now.
"Could there be an issue with my Nurturing Method?" Yuan Ming speculated internally.
"There is no issue with your Nurturing Method. The reason the Soul Destroying Sword hasn't nurtured an Artifact Spirit is mainly because the runes you use are too high-level." The voice of Senior Kong suddenly sounded.
"Senior Kong, how come you have the time to come out today?" Yuan Ming's eyes flickered as he asked.
A flash of spirit light crossed his arm, and the Stealing Heaven Tripod emerged automatically, emanating a white glow, transforming into a figure identical to Yuan Ming's—Kong.
"Since when do I need your permission to appear?" Kong said coldly.
"That is of course not needed, but it seems Senior has greatly recovered, truly something to be congratulated." Yuan Ming shook his head and smiled as he said.
The form into which Kong transformed now was condensed from Divine Soul Power, far stronger than his own Divine Soul, surpassing the realm of a Spoken Witch, giving one a sense of destiny being fully under control.

chapters.title: Chapter 856 - 827: Border Defense Plan
chapters.content:
"For my body to reach its current state, the Vow Power Pills you offered have played a certain role. Unfortunately, your refining of the Stealing Heaven Tripod is still insufficient, unable to further purify the Vow Power, so the power of this body is currently unstable." Kong looked at his body and said lightly.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming's eyebrows slightly twitched, somewhat confused.
Further purify Vow Power?
Wasn't the Vow Power collected by the Stealing Heaven Tripod already refined by the Bright Soul Fire? Could it be further purified?
"Forget it, you can't achieve this yet, so it's pointless to say more. Your next goal is to find a way to quickly refine the Stealing Heaven Tripod's Forbidden to a hundredfold." Kong changed the subject, seemingly unwilling to discuss it further.
"Junior will do his best to speed up the refining process." Yuan Ming, seeing Kong's attitude, also refrained from asking further.
He then glanced at the Stealing Heaven Tripod and sighed inwardly.
Over the years, he had too much to do, his Array Formation Cultivation progressed slowly, and as the layers of the Stealing Heaven Tripod's Forbidden increased, the refining became more difficult.
Various factors combined, leading to slow progress in refining the Stealing Heaven Tripod, and to this day, it was still less than forty layers, far from the hundred layers required.
"Since embarking on the path of cultivation, the Stealing Heaven Tripod has been crucial for my progress. It seems I was a bit overconfident before, not understanding this treasure thoroughly. I must not slack off in the future and must focus more to master it as soon as possible," Yuan Ming thought, a realization awakening within him as he secretly made up his mind.
