However, Kong's goal at this moment was not the Stealing Heaven Tripod but the Soul Destroying Sword.
Yuan Ming immediately brought the topic back to the Soul Destroying Sword and asked, "Senior just mentioned that the runes inscribed on my Soul Destroying Sword are too advanced... Senior, are you referring to the runes of Curse, Annihilation, and Frenzy Blood?"
"These three runes have a great origin, and are not something you can control at present. The Artifact Spirit of a Spiritual Treasure originates from the rune formation; all the runes within the formation must be fed before an Artifact Spirit can be born. To feed these three runes requires too much spiritual power, relying on you alone as a little Returning Void cultivator to nurture with mana, even after a thousand years would not suffice." Kong waved his hand and summoned the Soul Destroying Sword in front of him, causing the runes of Curse, Annihilation, and Frenzy Blood on the sword to light up.
"I see, since Senior pointed out this issue, there must be a solution, right?" Yuan Ming did not stop Kong's actions, he asked.
"Of course I have a solution, the usual price, two hundred Vow Power Pills." Kong turned to look at Yuan Ming, a sly merchant-like smile appearing on his face.
"So Senior Kong had this intention, but your previous promise to help me find Abyss Nether Stone, Love Inquiry Heart Jade, and the like, seems not yet fulfilled?" Yuan Ming realized and said.
"I naturally know where to find those things, but you can't go there at the moment, and besides, the last transaction and this one are two separate matters. If you are unwilling to comply, it's no big deal, just pretend I never mentioned it." Kong's tone turned cold, tossing the Soul Destroying Sword back to Yuan Ming as he was about to return to the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
"It's rare for Senior to make a request, how could I refuse? It's just that I don't have that many Vow Power Pills at hand, I hope Senior Kong can grant some leniency with the deadline." Yuan Ming hastily sought to retain him.
"Give them to me within five years." Kong said.
Yuan Ming raised his brows. Since adding Ye Wuya and other Returning Void believers, the formation of Vow Power Pills had significantly increased. Over the past five years, he had accumulated almost a hundred Vow Power Pills. Another five years would suffice to gather two hundred. Kong intended to drain the Vow Power Pills, leaving not a single one for him.
Nevertheless, he decided to agree; although the Vow Power Pills were precious, he dared not use them, using them for a trade with Kong was acceptable.
"Agreed." Yuan Ming said.
Kong smiled, waved his hand with a virtual grasp, a flash of white light at his fingertips, and a small pile of white elixirs appeared out of thin air, precisely the Vow Power Pills.
Yuan Ming's expression changed slightly, hurriedly using his Divine Sense to explore his Storage Ring, finding that the hundred Vow Power Pills stored there had disappeared without a trace.
He was shaken inside, the contents of his Storage Ring had been stolen without his awareness, Kong had cast his spell before him without him detecting a sign.
"Impressive means, Senior." Yuan Ming clasped his hands in respect.
Kong chuckled, did not respond to Yuan Ming, and swallowed those hundred Vow Power Pills.
"I have agreed to Senior's request, and half of the Vow Power Pills have been given, may I inquire about your solution?" Yuan Ming asked.
"Didn't I just say, increase the spiritual power of the Soul Destroying Sword, for instance, seeking a large amount of Nine Nether Iron to integrate into it, about the size of a mountain should suffice." Kong's body emitted flickers of white light, seemingly refining and absorbing those Vow Power Pills, speaking casually.
Yuan Ming's expression darkened, Nine Nether Iron was a top-tier Yin Attribute Spiritual Material; while it was more abundant in the Overseas World, it was not something easily obtainable. Mountain-sized Nine Nether Iron was practically a fantasy.
"Surely Senior is joking? If I could find that much Nine Nether Iron, why would I trouble Senior?" Yuan Ming suppressed his dissatisfaction and said coldly.
"This method is the most reliable. Well, since you think it's unmanageable, let's proceed with the second plan." Kong said with a faint smile.
Before the voice fell, a white light shot from Kong's hand, transforming into countless small characters arranging in the void; it was a mysterious secret skill, the Devouring Truth Treasure Sealing Technique.
Yuan Ming's gaze quickly scanned these words, his eyes slightly brightening.
This secret technique is a strange sealing skill that can seal one magic treasure within another and communicate the essence of both, allowing them to gradually fuse together.
Ultimately, the two magic treasures will completely merge into one, transforming into a new magic treasure.
He could hardly believe his eyes, not expecting there to be such a miraculous secret technique in the world. This method is similar to the fusion techniques in artifact refining, but even more advanced.
This copy comes from content on *.
Of course, using the Devouring Truth Treasure Sealing Technique also has certain requirements. The essences of the two magic treasures being sealed must be the same, otherwise, the spiritual power of the two treasures will clash, eventually leading to their mutual destruction.
"This Devouring Truth Treasure Sealing Technique is truly a wonderful sealing skill, but it seems this technique cannot solve the problem of the Soul Destroying Sword, as I don't have many yin attribute magic treasures," Yuan Ming said.
"Seems like your insight needs improvement. You're bearing a heavy treasure without realizing it, how is that different from being blind? That sword fragment is the best nourishment for the Soul Destroying Sword," Kong snorted, speaking bluntly.
"Senior Kong is referring to this?" Yuan Ming was taken aback, flipping his hand to take out the sword fragment obtained from the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
"Of course, those three runes were obtained from this item. To solve the trouble caused by those three runes, naturally, this sword fragment must be used," Kong said.
"Senior Kong knows the origin of this fragment?" Yuan Ming asked quickly.
"Two hundred Vow Power Pills," Kong did not answer, just extended his hand to Yuan Ming.
"Then forget it," Yuan Ming's expression froze, shaking his head.
Kong smiled faintly, not minding this, and said, "The method has been given to you. The rest is up to you. Your current strength is decent, but you lack a proper spiritual treasure. Quickly enhance the Soul Destroying Sword, and learn a few powerful divine skills from the Stealing Heaven Tripod. Don't wait until the real danger arrives to regret it."
"Real danger? What do you mean by this, Senior?" Yuan Ming asked hurriedly.
"You've now reached the middle stage of Returning Void. It's not a problem to tell you. Do you know about the Guardian Plan of the Chuyun Realm?" Kong asked.
"Guardian Plan? I don't know," Yuan Ming recalled carefully, shaking his head.
"With the Stealing Heaven Tripod in hand, collecting information is the easiest. Don't you ever think to pay more attention to the various places of the Chuyun Realm, especially the matters of the Central Continent?" Kong seemed somewhat speechless, remaining silent for a moment before speaking.
Yuan Ming gave an awkward smile. He indeed didn't pay much attention to the Central Continent, mostly inquiring about things he was interested in over the years through Xi Ying.
"The so-called Guardian Plan was a plan devised by various forces united after the Chuyun Realm first suffered a severe invasion by the Demon World. Detailed information, I won't say, you will have to investigate on your own. In short, the plan is to exhaust the resources of the Chuyun Realm to cultivate several Guardians to resist the Demon World's invasion. Xia Jie, whom you met, is one of them," Kong said.
"Senior Xia Jie is a Guardian?" Yuan Ming was shocked.
"He was a Guardian of the previous generation. In the domain war ten thousand years ago, he killed several Dharma manifestation stage cultivators and demons with an Undying Body. In the end, he and a Fiery Sun Body opponent were both seriously injured, his Dao Foundation destroyed, and he withdrew from the position of Guardian. I was also severely wounded in that battle, having to sleep until now," Kong said indignantly.
"Undying Body? Fiery Sun Body? Are these terms for Body Cultivation realms?" Yuan Ming, having never heard these terms before, asked.
"Correct, the Undying Body is above the Body of Wanxiang, and the Fiery Sun Body is the current pinnacle of Body Cultivation, with combat power equivalent to the Mahayana stage Magic Practitioner," Kong said.
Yuan Ming's eyes shone as he couldn't help but guess the divine skills of the Undying Body and Fiery Sun Body through their names.
The Undying Body, just from the name, is related to formidable life force. As for the Fiery Sun Body, the source of Body Cultivation's power is the sun, so this Fiery Sun Body should be related to the Power of the Sun.
Yuan Ming quickly collected his thoughts, considering the other information in Kong's words.
He knew a bit about Xia Jie's affairs. Xia Jie was injured fighting the Reincarnation Demon Lord, ending up in the Yunhuang Continent. So, it seems the Reincarnation Demon Lord might be that demon with the Fiery Sun Body?
But according to his understanding of the Demon World, all Mahayana stage demons have the title of Demon Emperor. The Fiery Sun Body should be the same. Why then does the Reincarnation Demon Lord still retain the title of Demon Lord?
"Those Guardians are the outstanding talents of the Chuyun Realm, receiving resources from the entire realm. Each of their cultivation levels reaches the pinnacle, at least at the peak of the Dharma manifestation stage. Moreover, several heavy treasures of the Chuyun Realm are in their possession, and the one Xia Jie had was the Stealing Heaven Tripod," Kong said slowly.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming, connecting it with his previous experiences, suddenly understood some previously unclear aspects.
Before he could think more, Kong's voice continued to speak:
"Back then, with Xia Jie's disappearance, the Stealing Heaven Tripod was also lost. Now, with you returning with this tripod, several Mahayana cultivators of the Chuyun Realm will eventually become aware of its return. Do you think they would allow someone at the Returning Void stage like you to hold such a heavy treasure?"
Hearing this, Yuan Ming's heart shuddered, and he fell into silence.

chapters.title: Chapter 857 - 828: Sword Fragment
chapters.content:
"Not only in the Chuyun Realm, but back then, the Stealing Heaven Tripod was also a renowned heavy treasure in the Demon World, coveted by many powerful figures there. If they knew the Stealing Heaven Tripod was in your possession, they would likely send people immediately to kill and seize the treasure," Kong continued.
Yuan Ming furrowed his brows, his expression becoming even more grave.
The fact that the Stealing Heaven Tripod is entangled in such significant causes and effects... It seems I was rather cautious in possessing this treasure in the past, but more so, just lucky. Otherwise, I might have been killed countless times by now.
However, this made him think of another matter.
"Senior Kong, with your omniscience and methods beyond my comprehension, if you wish for the Stealing Heaven Tripod to return, I couldn't stop you at all. Yet, you remind me now; perhaps you do not wish it to return to the hands of those Guardians?" Yuan Ming asked.
"Naturally, having been tricked once by those Guardians, do you suppose I want to go back and suffer another loss?" Kong snorted.
Hearing this, Yuan Ming secretly breathed a sigh of relief.
"I've told you the situation, handle it well on your own," Kong said, before his figure flickered and disappeared, and the Stealing Heaven Tripod automatically flew back to Yuan Ming's arm.
Yuan Ming remained silently unmoving in place for a long while, seemingly becoming a sculpture.
The origin of the Stealing Heaven Tripod is so immense; even though using it is concealed, there is always some trace left. Unless I never use it, it will eventually be noticed by others.
I guess only when my cultivation reaches a much higher level, high enough that no one can take this treasure from me, will I truly be at ease.
Yuan Ming took a deep breath, calming his mind before looking at the sword fragment and the Soul Destroying Sword.
After another silent moment, he picked up the sword fragment and injected his Yin attribute mana into it, while using his Divine Sense to carefully sense it.
Yet, no matter how much mana he injected, the sword fragment remained the same, showing no reaction.
Yuan Ming frowned deeply, unable to perceive the spiritual power attributes contained in the sword fragment, and dared not follow Kong's method.
"With your current strength, how could you possibly detect the spiritual power in this sword fragment? Fine, let me give you a hand," Kong's voice sounded again, and the Stealing Heaven Tripod appeared with a flash above the sword fragment.
A white line of fire shot out from the tripod, clearly condensed from Bright Soul Fire, piercing the sword fragment in a flash.
The white line of fire penetrated the sword fragment and then flew back into the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
However, no trace was left on the sword fragment, as if the white line of fire was an illusory object.
Yuan Ming was somewhat puzzled, but at this moment, a layer of profound black light appeared on the sword fragment.
Yuan Ming's eyes lit up, hastily using his Divine Sense to probe, as the black light emitted an extremely pure wave of energy, precisely the yin attribute spiritual power.
Yuan Ming's heart eased; it's good that the sword fragment has the yin attribute.
However, he didn't stop there, tracing the black light further into the interior of the sword fragment.
However, as his Divine Sense just entered the black light, an overwhelmingly powerful aura burst out without warning, directly shattering Yuan Ming's Divine Sense.
Yuan Ming's body was also struck as if hit by a meteorite, sent flying and crashing heavily into the Medicine Garden, carving out a trench on the ground like a plow.
He got up, a streak of blood trailing from the corner of his mouth, yet his eyes were filled with joy.
The sword fragment actually contained such a vast amount of yin attribute power, superior to any spiritual treasure he possessed. If the Soul Destroying Sword could absorb it, its power would completely transform, reaching unprecedented levels.
"Activating the power within this sword fragment is no easy task. Before this power subsides again, hurry and cast the sealing technique to enclose it within your Soul Destroying Sword," Kong's voice rang out once more.
Yuan Ming nodded, sitting cross-legged, placing the Soul Destroying Sword and sword fragment in front of him.
He let out a light breath, then activated the Devouring Truth Treasure Sealing Technique, casting spells with his hand signs.
Black rays of light shot out from Yuan Ming's fingertips, falling onto the Soul Destroying Sword and sword fragment, turning into rune-like imprints.
It was Yuan Ming's first time casting the Devouring Truth Treasure Sealing Technique, so his technique was inevitably clumsy. Fortunately, this secret technique wasn't complex, and he quickly became proficient, increasing the speed of engraving runes considerably.
Moreover, this Devouring Truth Treasure Sealing Technique seemed somehow connected to the Primordial True Skill. When casting, the Mixed Hole Vortex in his dantian occasionally quivered, as if resonating with the Devouring Truth Treasure Sealing Technique.
Yuan Ming felt puzzled but didn't have time to dwell on it, focusing instead on casting spells.
Time flowed by, and three days and nights passed in the blink of an eye.
The Soul Destroying Sword was densely engraved with the runes of the Devouring Truth Treasure Sealing Technique, and so was the sword fragment.
Yuan Ming looked exhausted; once he started casting the Devouring Truth Treasure Sealing Technique, he couldn't stop, or else it would all go to waste.
Even with his current cultivation, a continuous month of casting left him extremely weary.
Fortunately, everything went smoothly, and no errors occurred in the process.
Yuan Ming steadied himself, took out a recovery elixir and swallowed it, making hand signs and pointing.
A black light fell onto the sword fragment, and the runes on the fragment shone with radiant black light, rotating rapidly to form a black array.
The Soul Destroying Sword also erupted into black light, with countless runes rotating within, forming a vast black light domain that encompassed the sword fragment and the surrounding black array.
Yuan Ming rapidly made hand signs, causing the black light domain around the Soul Destroying Sword to rotate slowly, resonating with the nature's spiritual energy nearby, which howled violently.
The sword fragment within the light domain was drawn into motion, spinning with the black light domain.
Yuan Ming's face showed a trace of joy as he continued making hand signs and casting spells.
The rotation speed of the black light domain was becoming faster and faster, and the nearby nature's spiritual energy formed a massive Spiritual Energy Vortex.
Yuan Ming bit his tongue tip, spitting out a mouthful of blood onto the Soul Destroying Sword and the sword fragment.
Blood Light emerged around the black light domain of the Soul Destroying Sword, swiftly contracting, just like the sword fragment and the surrounding black Array.
In less than half an instant, the black light domain shrank to several feet in size, and the black runes scattered across the Soul Destroying Sword converged into one place, forming a black sealing pattern, which was the Devouring Truth Seal.
The sword fragment had mostly merged into the Devouring Truth Seal, slowly sinking, soon to be completely integrated within.
At this moment, the sword fragment suddenly trembled, a deep black light flickering incessantly on its surface.
Simultaneously, the Devouring Truth Seal also shook violently, cracks appeared as if it were about to collapse.
"What, the consciousness of the Great Freedom Sky Demon Sword hasn't completely disappeared!" Senior Kong's figure flashed into view, looking shocked.
His hand immediately grasped the sword fragment, merging into it.
The sword fragment's tremor stopped instantly, and the flickering black light ceased.
"Quickly, attack me with your most powerful Divine Soul attack!" Senior Kong turned to Yuan Ming, urging.
Hearing this, Yuan Ming's thoughts swirled, raising his hand to slap the void.
A black giant palm, the size of a house, emerged from him, it was the Great Black Sky God Palm.
Yuan Ming gestured again, and black energy appeared in the palm of the Great Black Sky God Palm, forming a bizarre vortex, slamming hard into Senior Kong.
Senior Kong's body burst at the sound, turning into countless scattered soul light, shooting in all directions.
At this moment, streams of black energy appeared out of nowhere, forming a massive black vortex. Inside the vortex, various Divine Soul attacks surged, from Crow's Call Wave, to Nightmare Illusion Technique, and even Emotion Manipulation Soul Searching.
A strange aura of Life and Death Reincarnation spread, freezing space within dozens of feet; all scattered soul light was immobilized completely.Te.xt@ acq*u$ir*ed f%r&o@m! M|V@|L*E-MP!&@YR..+
The black vortex roared and spun, resembling an ancient Fierce Beast, lunging forward to rapidly devour the scattered soul light.
Numerous Divine Soul attacks flickered inside the vortex, and the devoured scattered soul light was instantly shattered, transforming into pure Soul Power and chaotic memories.
"Enough, stop now!" Senior Kong's voice rang out from the scattered soul light.
Yuan Ming raised an eyebrow, gesturing.
The black vortex ceased attacking, then swiftly returned, merging into his body, and the frozen space returned to normal.
The remaining soul light amassed into one place, recondensing into Senior Kong's figure.
His body appeared much thinner, the soul power he emitted was now only a third of what it was before, and he looked at Yuan Ming with astonishment.
"What was that black vortex attack just now? How could it hurt me?"
"That is the Divine Skill that awakened after I broke through as the Spoken Witch, the Life and Death Reincarnation Path," Yuan Ming spoke with no pretense, calmly explaining.
"Life and Death Reincarnation Path... I see, your Divine Skill has great potential, cultivate it more in the future," Senior Kong said with a nod.
Yuan Ming nodded, then remembered something, quickly looking at the Soul Destroying Sword.
The black light domain around the Soul Destroying Sword had vanished, the sword fragment was nowhere to be seen, and the sealing pattern on the sword body had dissipated, as if nothing had happened.
However, Yuan Ming could feel that the sword fragment had been sealed inside the Soul Destroying Sword, motionless, and the previously awakened consciousness seemed to have been extinguished.
"It seems the sealing is complete, but how was the consciousness of the sword fragment exterminated? Senior Kong asked me to attack him just now, could the damage have transferred to the sword fragment? And what did he mean by the Great Freedom Sky Demon Sword earlier, could this have been the sword's former name?" Yuan Ming had several questions surfacing in his mind, instinctively looking at Senior Kong.
"As long as you provide enough Vow Power Pills, I will answer any questions," Senior Kong said, appearing indifferent.
Yuan Ming rolled his eyes and looked away.
"If you're not willing, you'll have to handle the rest yourself. This was a huge loss; I lost half of the power I had painstakingly amassed, such a huge loss," Senior Kong said, shaking his head, and his figure disappeared again.
Yuan Ming didn't bother with Senior Kong; he put away the Stealing Heaven Tripod, closed his eyes, and shifted his focus to his Sea of Consciousness.
There, a cluster of pure Soul Power and a mass of chaotic memory floated, just what he had stolen from Senior Kong using the Life and Death Reincarnation Path.
Yuan Ming's gaze swept past the Soul Power, directly focusing on the memory, a smile crept on his face.
After much scheming, he finally managed to get something from Senior Kong, perhaps there might be some useful information within.
Yuan Ming utilized his Divine Sense, probing into it, his brows furrowing more and more.
The memory turned out not to be Senior Kong's, but the memory of the providers of Desire Power, filled with images of their prayers, completely worthless.
"As expected of the Stealing Heaven Tripod Artifact Spirit, my little schemes likely have been seen through long ago," Yuan Ming sighed, waved his hand, and destroyed the memory.
As for the Soul Power, he did not absorb it but instead injected it into the Stealing Heaven Tripod before reaching for the Soul Destroying Sword.
Pure yin attribute Spiritual Power continuously flowed from the sword fragment, merging into the Soul Destroying Sword, its power constantly increasing, and its Artifact Spirit's presence rapidly enhancing.
At this speed, it won't be long before this sword gives birth to an Artifact Spirit.

chapters.title: Chapter 858 - 829: One Formation, One Time Help
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming was still examining the state of the Soul Destroying Sword when suddenly a wave emanated from the Void Communication Array set up in the nearby pavilion.
He put away the Soul Destroying Sword and went into the pavilion, casting a spell towards the array with a wave of his hand.
Before he could speak, a chatter of voices came from within the array.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, it's me. How are things going on your side?" Yun Luo Fairy's face appeared in the blood flames of the Communication Array.
"I've been in seclusion recently." Yuan Ming replied with no joy or sorrow.
"Oh, have you made any progress?" Yun Luo Fairy asked, with a hint of concern in her tone.
"A bit of progress, I've finally broken through to the late stage of Returning Void." Yuan Ming said.
"Is that so, that's wonderful! By the way, you mentioned earlier that your two spirit beasts are out there hunting targets for you, have they found anything? Is it a Level 6 Demon Beast or a Dharma manifestation Cultivator? I'm about to collect all the spiritual materials I need here, should I meet up with you first then?" Yun Luo Fairy spoke more animatedly.
Yuan Ming rubbed his brow and said, "They haven't sent any news yet, and I still need some time to prepare. Fellow Daoist Yun Luo, please wait a bit longer, I'll contact you then."
After saying this, without waiting for Yun Luo Fairy to reply, he immediately closed the Communication Array. His ears suddenly fell silent, and he breathed a long sigh of relief.
Since having a heart-to-heart conversation with himself five years ago, Yun Luo Fairy frequently communicated with him.
It seemed as if she had revealed her true self, contrasting with her previous charming and wise demeanor, becoming very talkative, chattering incessantly like a small sparrow.
However, Yuan Ming could sense genuine relief in Yun Luo Fairy's tone, as if shedding a heavy shackle.
"It seems things are going smoothly on Yun Luo Fairy's side. In that case, I really should spend some effort finding hunting targets." He muttered to himself.
However, with Yuan Ming's current strength, even with the assistance of Hua Zhi, Vajra, Lei Yu, and others, their chances against a Dharma manifestation existence were slim, and there was a significant risk of falling.
Most of the elixirs on him were used up, and he couldn't enhance his strength further in the short term. The only remaining help he could gather were Xi Ying and Wulu, but they were too far away, not coming anytime soon, thus were not considered.
After pondering for a while, Yuan Ming realized that the only method left to increase their odds was through formations.
Over the past five years, by possessing Ye Wuya with Black Incense, his Array Formation Cultivation had advanced to the peak of Level 5, just half a step away from Level 6.
With his current formation level, he wasn't yet able to design a Level 6 Array, but following a blueprint posed no significant issues.
If they could muster the support of a Level 6 Array, they could remain undefeated. Even if they couldn't kill the target, they could at least escape safely and reassess their options later.
Among the Array Masters Yuan Ming knew, the only one capable of designing a Level 6 Array was Su Yingxue, who was trapped in the Land of Nothingness.
Recently, Su Yingxue had been focused on studying Space Restriction, Teleportation Array, and related things, so she hadn't designed any formations for a while. Her residence also didn't have a ready-made Level 6 Array to use.
To acquire a functional Level 6 Array, it seemed he would have to discuss it directly with Su Yingxue.
"Very well, after all these years, it's about time to have direct contact with her." Yuan Ming murmured to himself, taking out the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
Knowing the origins of the Stealing Heaven Tripod, he initially didn't want to use it, but to break through to the Dharma manifestation Stage, he had to take some risks.
It wasn't simple to gain Su Yingxue's help, and after much contemplation, he finally thought of a way.
...
Land of Nothingness.
As usual, Su Yingxue sat at her desk researching the array, her eyes suddenly turned hazy before quickly regaining clarity, already possessed by Yuan Ming.
He got up and searched around the cell, not finding any usable Level 6 Arrays, and then moved to the desk where Su Yingxue had been sitting, taking the pen beside it.
A moment later, Su Yingxue's consciousness returned, and she was about to continue her reading.
But inexplicably, a chill crept into her heart, as if being watched by something, giving her a foreboding intuition.
"...Is it an illusion?" Su Yingxue looked around, observed no changes inside or outside the cell, and no guards had passed by recently, assuming her Spiritual Sense was mistaken. She rubbed her brow and continued perusing the book in front of her.
However, when her gaze landed on the book, she was stunned.
At the end of the current page of the book, there was a line of small characters: Please design a Level 6 Confinement Array usable in Returning Void.
The ink was not dry, seemingly written not long ago.
"Someone has been here!" Su Yingxue suddenly stood up, looked around, and spread out her Divine Sense.
There was no sign of the cell door being opened or the prohibition being tampered with, showing no trace of intrusion.
"What's going on?" Su Yingxue muttered, suddenly realizing something, carefully recalling.
Vaguely, a scene flashed in her mind of her writing down that line.
"Did I write it myself? How could that be, impossible!" A hint of confusion showed in her eyes before she firmly shook her head.
As an Array Master, Su Yingxue often had the habit of jotting down random thoughts, but writing down this inexplicable sentence should have left an impression.
"Could it be that someone just controlled me?" Su Yingxue thought of a possibility, as the sentence on the page indeed seemed like a message from someone else.
However, with her cultivation level and the strong Divine Soul she developed from years of specializing in formation techniques, it would be impossible for even a Great Power of the Dharma Manifestation Stage to control her without her awareness.
Su Yingxue pondered for a long time, but gained nothing. She stood up and rearranged the restrictions around the cell, enhancing their power to the extreme.
After doing this, she casually erased the line on the page and continued her daily research, while also dedicating half of her attention to observe her surroundings.
If someone did control her and had already made a request, they would definitely appear a second time.
Day by day passed, and seven days quickly flew by.
Su Yingxue had been sitting at the desk without stepping away even once. No guard came by outside, and no unusual occurrences happened inside the cell.
"Could I have guessed wrong..." she mused silently.
Su Yingxue shook her head and picked up a book she had just finished reading. As she was about to put it back, her motion caused her sleeve to slip slightly, revealing ink-stained arms.
Su Yingxue froze, hurriedly lifting her sleeve to find her arms covered in tiny writings, all repeating the same sentence: "Please design a sixth-level Confinement Array usable at the Returning Void Stage, Fellow Daoist."
It was the same handwriting as last time; she vaguely remembered writing these words on her arms, but she was certain it wasn't something she would do.
Looking at the words on her arms, Su Yingxue felt a chilling sensation envelop her body, making her hair stand on end.
Even though she had not let up for a moment for the past seven days, she still fell victim unwittingly.
Yet, she did not panic but instead formed seals and pointed to the nearby wall.
A layer of blue light appeared on the wall, with scenes continuously flashing.
This was the image-capture restriction she had added when she rearranged the cell bans, recording everything that had happened in the cell during those seven days.
"Whoever you are, even if you can evade my perception, I don't believe you can also escape the image-capture restriction!"
Su Yingxue fixed her gaze on the blue light, not missing any detail. Initially, there was nothing unusual, but at the very end of the seventh day, something odd happened.
The recording showed her putting down a book, standing up, and walking in a circle in the cell, as if searching for something, before sitting back down at the desk and writing those small words on her arm.
After doing this, she continued reading as if nothing had happened until she noticed the writing on her arms and sprung up in a panic.
Su Yingxue's eyes widened slightly. Judging from the situation, someone indeed controlled her with an unknown technique, making her completely unaware. If not for the image-capture restriction, she would never have known she was manipulated to do many things.
She vigorously erased all the writings on her arms, then repeatedly examined her Sea of Consciousness, yet still found nothing amiss.
"What technique is the opponent using? Soul Cultivation Divine Power? So elusive and invisible, the opponent might indeed be a Life Witch." Su Yingxue speculated secretly, a hint of fear inevitably creeping into her heart.
A Life Witch was not someone she could contend with; the opponent had not shown any hostility so far and merely asked her to design a sixth-level array. Perhaps she should obediently do as they said...
However, Su Yingxue seemed to remember something, her expression firming up. She stood up once more to rearrange the cell's restrictions, even deploying a set of sixth-level restrictions capable of isolating Divine Power around the cell.
After doing all this, she returned to the desk, continued reading, and spread her Divine Sense throughout her body, remaining constantly vigilant for any changes within every corner, not overlooking the smallest detail.
Su Yingxue maintained this stringent posture for another seven days without any slackening.
Sample from *—read more on M&VLEMPY&R.
But at a fleeting moment on the seventh day, Su Yingxue suddenly noticed there was now a Jade Slip in her hand.
The cell already housed many blank Jade Slips for recording formations, but Su Yingxue could swear she absolutely hadn't reached for a Jade Slip a moment ago.
Su Yingxue closed her eyes, deep in thought, recalling a fuzzy memory in her mind: it was the image of her drawing a Jade Slip towards her and leaving a message with her Divine Sense inside it.
This memory came quite suddenly, yet the more Su Yingxue recalled, the clearer it became, almost to the point where she nearly believed it was truly her own thoughts and actions.
She formed seals to activate the image-capture restriction, revealing the events of those past seven days, soon witnessing herself being possessed again, taking hold of a Jade Slip.
"Even the sixth-level Prohibition God Restriction can't block it, huh?" Su Yingxue murmured quietly, then looked at the Jade Slip in her hand, hesitating for a moment before finally probing it with her Divine Sense.
Inside the Jade Slip was a line of small text, except its content had changed: "A Formation, in exchange for assistance."
Su Yingxue was momentarily stunned but soon relaxed slightly, exhaling deeply.
No matter what kind of existence was manipulating her body, at least this time the message proved that the other party was not angered. There was still room for communication, and they seemed to be someone reasonable.
After twice not responding, ignoring their request any longer might truly upset them.
Moreover, the proposed exchange intrigued her.
As she pondered, her eyes flickering briefly, she silently added text on the back of the Jade Slip.

chapters.title: Chapter 859 - 830: The Sect Hierarch of the Three Realms
chapters.content:
Shura Palace, inside the Extreme Fire Realm hall.
Yuan Ming sat cross-legged, quickly pointing at the Complete Heaven Exquisite Tripod, while chanting words softly.
Suddenly, a spirit light flashed on the surface of the Exquisite Tripod, the lid automatically flew open, and three purple-black elixirs with faint electric glow appeared, precisely the three Thunder Origin Pills.
Yuan Ming flicked his sleeve, capturing the three Thunder Origin Pills in his hand. After a brief examination, he nodded slightly, then took out a small white jade bottle, carefully placing the pills inside.
In these five years, during his cultivation breaks, he often possessed Dian Xiaosan, enhancing his alchemy technique through direct insight, progressing rapidly in alchemy. Now, he has truly become a Level 5 Alchemist.
A few days ago, Hua Zhi returned to Shura Palace, bringing back a new batch of Thunder Origin Pill materials, which he refined into over thirty Thunder Origin Pills.
"Take it." He raised his hand, tossing the jade bottle. The black-robed man standing beside him caught it; it was Lei Yu.
Currently, Lei Yu's back had a pair of azure wings entangled with an invisible airflow, seemingly ready to carry him away at any moment.
"Thank you, Master." Lei Yu expressed joy, kneeling on one knee in gratitude.
Having refined the Thunder Origin Pills multiple times, Lei Yu had been continuously consuming them over the years. His demonic power advanced swiftly, nearing the Level 5 middle stage.
"Quickly refine this batch of elixirs and strive to break through to the Level 5 middle stage and master the four wings of wind and thunder. That way, you'll be very useful in the upcoming hunting operation," Yuan Ming said.
"Yes, I will not disappoint you and will work hard to break through," Lei Yu agreed and left the hall, seeking a place for intense cultivation.
Yuan Ming did not leave, continuing to sit cross-legged in front of the Complete Heaven Exquisite Tripod, taking out the Stealing Heaven Tripod for inspection.
Everything Su Yingxue experienced before was naturally orchestrated by him.
What he can do in the Land of Nothingness is very limited; even if he could possess the guards and make Su Yingxue design a formation for him, the risk of exposure was significant.
Possessing Su Yingxue and communicating through hidden messages, although a bit troublesome, was much safer.
However, this method had to remain mysterious. If Su Yingxue realized his activities in the Land of Nothingness were limited, he wouldn't be able to obtain the formation.
Only by making Su Yingxue let her imagination run wild, scaring herself, could Yuan Ming possibly achieve his goal.
He had left messages for Su Yingxue three times, and the timing seemed appropriate.
As thoughts churned in Yuan Ming's mind, he waved his sleeve to store away the two tripods, standing up and returning to the Medicine Garden.
Seven days passed quickly; he did not immediately possess Su Yingxue but waited an additional three days before using Black Incense Possession on her.
The successive three possessions were every seven days, which was somewhat ill-considered and revealed a slight flaw.
Although the probability of Su Yingxue realizing something was wrong was extremely small, it was still necessary to be as cautious as possible.
Just as Yuan Ming possessed Su Yingxue, upon opening his eyes, he saw a square-shaped Jade Scroll on the desk, awaiting perusal.
"Since you, Senior, can infiltrate the Land of Nothingness, just say what you want me to do. Why the intimidation, causing me sleeplessness for days?" The Jade Scroll opened with Su Yingxue's complaint.
"If I let you be at ease and think calmly, that would be disadvantageous for me." Yuan Ming felt secretly pleased, shook his head, and continued reading.
"The formation Senior requires, I have a rough draft — a trapping array called the 'Eight Extremes Golden Lock Array.' It's relatively simple to set up, but its power is not weak at all, meeting Senior's requirements. However, I need more time to complete the formation's intricate design, so I ask for your patience." Su Yingxue soon mentioned the main matter, clearly not daring to be too cryptic, fearing to incur Yuan Ming's displeasure.
Yuan Ming did not doubt her words, as even with a simpler sixth-level array, it wouldn't be reasonable to expect an array map to be drawn up in just one or two days. Waiting a while was quite normal.
"As for 'one formation in exchange for a favor' that Senior mentioned, I don't dare to trouble you too much. Since you can move freely in Nihility Prison, I presume you have ways to contact the outside world. What I ask is for you to pass a message to the White Emperor City Lord of the Wanyao Mountain Range in Chuyun Realm. There's no need to mention my name, just tell him: 'The Three Realms Sect has elected a new leader.' I know cross-realm communication is difficult, so you may proceed at your discretion, delivering the message within five years to fulfill the promise." At the end of the Jade Scroll, Su Yingxue made her request.Alwаys rеаd аt thе sоurсе—МV@LЕМР@YR.
After reading the contents of the Jade Scroll, Yuan Ming's brow furrowed slightly.
Su Yingxue is trapped in the Land of Nothingness, and logically, her request would certainly revolve around how to escape.
But the information she wants to convey, Yuan Ming really cannot see how it relates to escaping from this place.
Moreover, informing the White Emperor City Lord that the Three Realms Sect has elected a new sect leader, could it be that the White Emperor City Lord and the Three Realms Sect are connected?
Su Yingxue's request might be difficult for others, but for him, it is extremely easy because Wulu is currently at the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range.
However, this matter is somewhat suspicious and might not be anything more than a trap, requiring investigation first, anyway, there is plenty of time.
Yuan Ming pondered for a moment, still raised his hand to pick up the Jade Scroll, and left only the word "okay". Then quietly awaited the possession time to end, his consciousness returned to the main body, and he stood up to arrive before the Void Communication Array.
He didn't contact Wulu but sent a message to someone else.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, you're looking for me? Did you find the target? What kind of existence is it?" As soon as the communication connected, Yun Luo Fairy's curious voice sounded, with a hint of excitement in her tone.
"That I'm still considering. This time I'm contacting you because of another matter. Fellow Daoist Yun Luo comes from a great sect and is surely well-informed about the Three Realms Sect. Could you explain a bit to me?" Yuan Ming asked.
"The Three Realms Sect? Why are you asking about this sect? Could it be the Black Evil Sect has found you?" Yun Luo Fairy's tone revealed a bit of tension.
"No, I've recently heard some news concerning the Three Realms Sect, so I want to find out a bit more. Among the people around me, Fellow Daoist Yun Luo is the most knowledgeable, hence the communication for advice," Yuan Ming praised Yun Luo Fairy slightly.
"Hehe, is that so. Actually, I'm not very familiar with the Three Realms Sect either. But since you're asking, I'll certainly tell you everything I know. This sect is well-known throughout the Central Continent. The specific rise time of this sect is untraceable. It's said to have been founded by a group of unconventional cultivators at first, who believe that the Three Realms are essentially one, and all races are equal, advocating peaceful coexistence with the Demon World and other realms, which gained acceptance from many cultivators in the Central Continent. At its strongest, even the Great Mahayana Ancestors served as strongholds, comparable to any great sect," Yun Luo Fairy said with great joy, providing a detailed introduction.
"From its doctrine, it seems the Three Realms Sect isn't inherently evil. Why has it now fallen to the point of being an evil sect, infamous and hated by all? Moreover, since the sect was once so strong, why have I heard almost no relevant information in the Dongji Sea?" Yuan Ming felt some surprise and asked.
"The Three Realms Sect, in its early days, conducted itself fairly reasonably; otherwise, it wouldn't have attracted so many cultivators. But during the last realm war with the Demon World, the Three Realms Sect was tempted by the Demon World and embraced it, thoroughly becoming an evil sect, seen as a disgrace by all major sects in the Central Continent, jointly hunted down. There was quite an uproar at the time, but after the Three Realms Sect leader fell several thousand years ago, the entire sect fragmented, and gradually faded into obscurity. The major sects of the Central Continent deliberately minimized the influence of the Three Realms Sect, forbidding discussion among cultivators, let alone recording in classics, while the Dongji Sea is remote, hence few know of it," Yun Luo Fairy explained.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming understood a bit, nodding slightly.
"By the way, you mentioned hearing news about the Three Realms Sect earlier? What news?" Yun Luo Fairy asked curiously.
"A few days ago, I received news from a friend saying that the Three Realms Sect recently elected a new sect leader. Do you think this news is true or false, Fellow Daoist Yun Luo?" Yuan Ming pondered slightly, without hiding anything.
"Oh, so it's this," Yun Luo Fairy's expression was quite calm within the communication array.
"Why such a reaction, Fellow Daoist Yun Luo? The Three Realms Sect, as a demon-controlled evil sect, despite its current decline, still has its base. If indeed a sect leader is elected, wouldn't it pose a considerable threat to the Chuyun Realm?" Yuan Ming questioned in confusion.
"It's clear that you, Fellow Daoist Yuan, don't know much about the Three Realms Sect! This sect differs from ordinary sects; after aligning with the Demon World, all sect rules were abolished. There's no hierarchy among its members, allowing anything to be done, even assassinating the leader. As for being the leader, anyone can. Over the years, many have claimed to be the Three Realms Sect leader, but soon were either killed by major sects of the Central Continent or within the Three Realms Sect itself, mere clowns jumping about. Since its founding, the true leader has only been the one known as the Black Emperor. The news you heard is likely nothing more than some reckless fool boasting," Yun Luo Fairy laughed softly.
Yuan Ming noncommittally uttered "oh", his expression not relaxed.
Yun Luo Fairy's answer was off the mark. The content that Su Yingxue wanted him to communicate was that the Three Realms Sect elected a new leader, not someone claiming to be the new leader.
"Thank you, Fellow Daoist Yun Luo, for clearing up the confusion. It's good if this news is false. If the Three Realms Sect really elects a leader, the situation would be dire," Yuan Ming didn't correct Yun Luo's mistake, but said.
"Speaking of which, recently there have been many incidents of demonic cultivators causing disturbances in the Central Continent. All major sects are investigating the underlying reasons, with some speculating that the Demon World is planning big moves again. Now it seems, perhaps it's the Three Realms Sect causing trouble," Yun Luo Fairy said.
"So, the situation in the Central Continent might turn chaotic," Yuan Ming said thoughtfully.
"Perhaps, but if the sky collapses, the major sects will bear it. We should focus on the present task first. How long does Fellow Daoist Yuan need to prepare? I'm ready on my side and can come over to meet you." Yun Luo Fairy, seeing, did not question further, instead asked about the main business.
"Not more than half a year at most, I'll contact you then," Yuan Ming roughly estimated the time and reported it.
"Hehe, then I'll be at ease waiting for Fellow Daoist Yuan's news! Oh, by the way, I've recently procured a jar of fine Hundred Flowers Spirit Wine in Age Lake City on Flowers Island. There's no need to rush the hunting; the Wanhua Festival on Flowers Island is about to happen, very lively. Since Fellow Daoist Yuan isn't ready, why not..." Yun Luo Fairy laughed.

chapters.title: Chapter 860 - 831 Wanyao White Emperor City
chapters.content:
"Fellow Daoist Yun Luo, I appreciate your thoughts, but I am not fond of such spiritual wine. You should enjoy this jar yourself. I have quite a bit to prepare for, so I'll be busy for now," Yuan Ming interrupted her, making an excuse to end the communication, his brows furrowing.
He wondered whether Yun Luo Fairy was overly confident or simply missing a crucial point. They were currently still wanted and had no time to hide, yet she had the mind to attend some Flowers Gathering event.
Shaking his head, he decided to ignore matters concerning Yun Luo Fairy and instead focused on Su Yingxue's exchange request.
Although he had learned a lot about the Three Realms Sect from Yun Luo Fairy, he still couldn't judge the truth of Su Yingxue's information or the hidden meaning behind it.
This woman, confined in the Nihility Prison and yet highly valued, could naturally overhear some news from the Demon World from time to time.
If the news was only about the apparent meaning, he could somewhat understand Su Yingxue's thinking.
She didn't wish to escape, but rather found it more important to transmit the news of the Three Realms Sect's selection of a Sect Hierarch back to the Chuyun Realm.
Realizing this, Yuan Ming couldn't help but hold Su Yingxue in higher regard, with a hint of admiration and respect.
Thinking this far, Yuan Ming no longer hesitated and once again activated the Void Communication Array. Blood Flames flickered within the array, soon revealing another face—it was Wulu.
"Haha, Brother Yuan, what brings you to contact me today? Could it be you missed me?" Wulu laughed as he appeared.
Back then, a group ventured to the Overseas World, and to prevent getting lost unexpectedly, both Wulu and Xi Ying carried a set of the Void Communication Array. Shortly after Yuan Ming took Spiritual Ape Island, Wulu also established a foothold in the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range.
The Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range wasn't too far from the Dongji Sea, within the communication range of the Void Communication Array. Hence the two had maintained contact over the years, exchanging information from time to time.
Now, Wulu used White Emperor City as a base and diligently cultivated within the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range, having already broken through to the Returning to Void Stage through his efforts.
"Brother Wulu, are you suggesting I shouldn't contact you without a reason?" Yuan Ming replied with a smile.
After some chatter to catch up on each other's situations, Yuan Ming went straight to the point.
"I remember you mentioning earlier that after breaking through to the Returning to Void Stage, the concealment effect of the Heavenly Escape Stone Talisman became more exquisite?" Yuan Ming asked.
"Indeed," Wulu nodded.
"To what extent has the concealment effect of the Heavenly Escape Stone Talisman reached now?" Yuan Ming continued his inquiry.
"Recently, when I went out hunting beasts, even a Sixth-level Demon Beast couldn't discern it," Wulu said quite proudly.
"That's good. To be honest, I have a matter here for which I'll need your help," Yuan Ming's expression turned serious.
...
Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range, White Emperor City.
The Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range lies at the junction of the Dongji Sea Area and the Central Continent, covering an extremely vast area, almost no less than the Dongji Sea Area, teeming with countless demon beasts, hence the name "Ten Thousand Demon."
The Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range not only has abundant demon beasts but also rich spiritual energy and various spirit grass and mineral veins, attracting innumerable cultivators every year to seek treasures, continuously sending large quantities of demon cores, demon beast materials, spiritual materials, ores, and other resources into the Central Continent.
To facilitate the exploitation of the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range's resources, many cultivator cities have been built nearby, and White Emperor City is the most renowned among them.
White Emperor City is situated in the core area of the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range, where there are numerous powerful demon beasts, including some at Level 5, and even Level 6 Great Demons.
According to usual logic, it's impossible for a city to appear in such a dangerous place. Yet, White Emperor City stands majestically here like an ancient colossal beast and has remained unyielding for tens of thousands of years.
White Emperor City covers a vast area, encompassing several mountain peaks, surrounded by a cluster of mountains, and even within the city, the terrain is undulating, green stretching to the horizon, with few flat open areas, only an array of high-eaved buildings scattered, crisscrossed by wooden pathways, with trees and buildings set against each other, extending with the mountain terrain.
At the city center stands a mountain far taller than the other peaks, shaped like a long sword thrust into the ground.
The lower half of the sword-shaped mountain's rocky body has long been hollowed out and carved into spacious, magnificent halls, with bridges extending out, suspended to connect with other nearby peaks.
As for the upper half of the sword-shaped main peak, it resembles the hilt of a long sword, fully covered in a man-made enormous garden.
Inside the garden, except for plants and ponds, everything is constructed from pure white bricks and stones, above which numerous buildings and palaces are perched.
This is the core of White Emperor City, where the City Lord's Mansion is located.
Within the City Lord's Mansion, the most striking feature is the nine-story pagoda situated at the garden's center.
The pagoda towers majestically, with cloud mist like ribbons winding around from the third layer upwards, and at its apex, a brilliant Spirit Light Sky Pillar pierces the sky like the sun, casting its light over the entire city day and night, dispelling cold and dampness.
The City Lord's Mansion may seem defenseless, but in reality, it is fully enveloped by an invisible Great Array, making entry impossible except through heavily guarded entrances scattered in all directions.
A white-faced scholar flew over from a distance and landed at the western entrance of the City Lord Mansion.
"Halt, why has Fellow Daoist Xu returned so early today?" A Nascent Soul guard responsible for this area stopped the white-faced scholar.
"This batch of spiritual materials is urgently needed by the Pill Control Department. I dare not linger outside any longer and had to return early," the white-faced scholar replied with a wry smile.
"I see. However, you know the rules. If you return early, the inspection will be stricter than usual," the guard nodded and waved his hand, and three more people surrounded them from all sides.
* (*) hosts the original.
The white-faced scholar removed the storage bags from his waist one by one and handed them over for inspection.
"Alright, you may go in," the guard said after confirming everything was in order, stepping aside.
The white-faced scholar quickly proceeded forward. A long corridor appeared in front, with array patterns carved into its floor and stone walls, forming a great array that emitted a faint white light.
This formation was named the "Visible Formation", capable of rendering all means of concealment ineffective. If the white-faced scholar had hidden someone using any special method, they would be easily discovered. Its power had even been personally tested by the White Emperor City Lord, making it impossible to evade even for those at the Dharma manifestation Stage.
The white-faced scholar walked in, and the formation automatically activated. Several beams of spirit light scanned him up and down, as if probing for something.
The white-faced scholar continued forward and soon entered the garden from the other end of the corridor, heading straight toward the deeper parts without lingering.
The security in this place is known to be strict, and everyone who wishes to enter must go through such a process. For many years, no one has been able to cheat this series of overt and covert methods and infiltrate.
But today, there was an exception.
Just as the white-faced scholar left, a few steps behind the spot he had just stood, an invisible figure stepped out. It was Wulu, holding the Heavenly Escape Stone Talisman and maintaining invisibility.
He turned to look at the formation that had just been activated, clicking his tongue in wonder.
Wulu had followed the white-faced scholar into the City Lord Mansion, and entered the Visible Formation with him. Although the formation didn't recognize him, he felt a flicker of unease when the spirit lights swept over him.
If not for advancing to the Returning to Void Stage, allowing him to further harness the power of the Heavenly Escape Stone Talisman, he might have been revealed on the spot and caught.
Yet, this experience further confirmed to Wulu the might of the Heavenly Escape Stone Talisman, instilling greater confidence in what he intended to do next.
The white-faced scholar headed in another direction, leaving Wulu to find his own way.
The mansion's area was much larger than Wulu anticipated. He spent half a day to finally figure out the location and found where the City Lord resided—on the top floor of the nine-story pagoda.
There were also restrictions set within the pagoda, but thanks to the ingenious use of the Heavenly Escape Stone Talisman, he managed to pass through uneventfully.
The study on the top floor of the pagoda was where the White Emperor City Lord handled city affairs, not for residence or cultivation. When Wulu arrived, the City Lord was not present.
This allowed Wulu to exhale deeply, though confident in the power of the Heavenly Escape Stone Talisman, facing someone at the peak of the Dharma manifestation Stage made him nervous, not daring to be careless.
Wulu didn't hesitate, immediately flipping his palm to take out a Jade Scroll, placing it on the City Lord's desk, then turned to leave, but suddenly footsteps approached.
An overwhelming aura rushed towards him, causing Wulu, who was concealed, to momentarily freeze.
But he quickly realized the aura was merely incidental, not directed at him, so he stepped back and hid in a concealed corner of the study.
A few breaths later, a man with sword-like brows and starry eyes walked in, wearing a white robe, with black hair cascading like a waterfall down to his shoulders, barefoot yet untouched by dust, and exuding an aura of sharpness.
Wulu only glanced at him, feeling a slight sting in his eyes, and hurriedly looked away, fully activating the invisibility of the Heavenly Escape Stone Talisman.
The newcomer was none other than White Emperor City Lord Jin Mu, whose cultivation had reached the peak of Dharma manifestation, surpassing even Ouyang Qiang of the Dongji Palace and others.
Jin Mu walked slowly to the desk, intending to take something, but upon lowering his head, he saw the Jade Scroll Wulu had just placed, furrowing his sword brows and clapping his hands.
"City Lord," a black-robed figure flew in from outside, kneeling on one knee—a black-robed youth.
This person's cultivation also reached the Returning to Void Stage, yet his aura was so faint as if he could disappear at any moment.
"Has someone else come by? Was it Chen E'r?" Jin Mu asked.
"No, Young Master Chen went out of the city yesterday to search for traces of Heavenly Fire," the black-robed youth replied, slightly raising his head.
Jin Mu frowned, waved the youth away, picked up the Jade Scroll on the desk, and infused it with his Divine Sense.
In the next moment, his expression drastically changed, and a terrifying tide-like Divine Sense exploded, enveloping the entire room.
Under the pressure of this Divine Sense, Wulu, hiding in a corner, felt suffocated, and the Heavenly Escape Stone Talisman in his hand trembled slightly, but he barely maintained his invisibility.

chapters.title: Chapter 861 - 832: Surging Waves
chapters.content:
Jin Mu's all-round, seamless Divine Sense search didn't last long. He soon withdrew his Divine Sense, and his expression grew increasingly serious.
However, after thinking for a moment, his Divine Sense spilled out once more, searching the room repeatedly, trying to find the trace of the person who left the Jade Scroll.
This time the Divine Sense was different from the previous tumultuous waves; it was soft and gentle like a breeze, yet left an impression of being all-pervasive.
Wulu closed his eyes and concentrated on activating the Heavenly Escape Stone Talisman for stealth, revealing no weaknesses.
Not long afterwards, Jin Mu abandoned this futile search, his gaze fell on the Jade Scroll, seeming deep in thought.
"Someone, activate the Communication Array and contact Ancestor Bing Lan!" After an unknown period, Jin Mu suddenly called the black-robed man from before and instructed.
The man agreed with a single word and swiftly left.
Jin Mu paced in the room for a while, then hurriedly left.
Wulu finally let out the breath he was holding, no longer daring to linger. He quickly left the City Lord Mansion, escaping during the gap when the guards changed shifts.
...
Half a day later, within a Cave Mansion in White Emperor City.
"...That's how it happened, I was truly scared to death this time." Wulu recounted everything he saw in the City Lord Mansion through the Void Communication Array to Yuan Ming, finally breathing a sigh of relief, appearing quite shaken.
"This time, Brother Wu Lu, you've truly gone through a lot; I didn't expect you to take such a great risk. I'll remember today's kindness, I assure you." Just hearing Wulu's description made Yuan Ming feel a bit fearful, he said solemnly.
"No need for excessive words, when you come to White Emperor City you better treat me to two or three good drinks, or I won't let you off!" Wulu laughed.
"Deal, I'll make sure you are not sober till you leave." Yuan Ming sensed Wulu's comfort in his words, warming his heart.
"Brother Wulu, you've been in White Emperor City for many years, have you heard of any connection between City Lord Jin Mu and the Three Realms Sect?" He thought for a moment and asked.
"City Lord Jin Mu is a low-key person, rarely showing himself, and there is little information about him. I haven't heard anything about a connection with the Three Realms Sect." Wulu thought for a moment then replied.
"Who is this Ancestor Bing Lan, mentioned by City Lord Jin Mu?" Yuan Ming further queried.
"I know this person; Ancestor Bing Lan is a Great Mahayana Ancestor from the Heavenly Saint Academy. City Lord Jin Mu is born from the Heavenly Saint Academy and seems to have a bit of a master-disciple relationship with Ancestor Bing Lan. I've heard that Jin Mu became the City Lord of White Emperor City thanks to Ancestor Bing Lan." Wulu replied enthusiastically.
Yuan Ming nodded; he had seen information about the Heavenly Saint Academy in Zi Mei's memories, knowing it was one of the three major powers on the Central Continent.
The other two major forces are Taixuan Sect and Bright Moon Palace.
The Heavenly Saint Academy is located in the Central Domain of the Central Continent; its predecessor was merely an alliance formed by many small and medium sects during the first realm wars to resist the Demon World invasion.
Note from the editor: Always check * for corrections.
After the great war, the alliance was not immediately disbanded due to some reasons. It later went through some ups and downs, eventually evolving into today's Heavenly Saint Academy.
Perhaps due to sect heritage, the Heavenly Saint Academy is very different from ordinary sects, it doesn't force disciples to stay. Once their cultivation reaches a certain stage, disciples can choose to leave, return to their families, or go out alone, the academy won't intervene unnecessarily.
Furthermore, the requirements for becoming a disciple of the Heavenly Saint Academy are not high; as long as they have a clean background and are diligent, regardless of their aptitude, they will be admitted, while students in the academy are not strictly managed, and can study based on their interests freely.
In addition to recruiting disciples, the academy also recruits teachers, the requirements are likewise very lenient; regardless of background and cultivation, as long as someone has a skill and hasn't committed evil deeds, they can join the academy to teach.
The Academy's approach was once ridiculed by many sects on the Central Continent, thinking it would soon deplete its resources and collapse.
Yet surprisingly, not only did the Heavenly Saint Academy not collapse, but its inclusive and harmonious sect culture led to its prosperity, now becoming one of the pillars of the Chuyun Realm.
As for Taixuan Sect and Bright Moon Palace, they are traditional sects, among which Bright Moon Palace is predominantly a Soul Cultivator sect.
Xia Jie had previously mentioned to Yuan Ming that his Moonlight Technique came from Bright Moon Palace.
Yuan Ming sighed inwardly, if possible, he never wanted to have relations with these major sects, but now it seems impossible to completely avoid them.
"Brother Wulu, are you busy lately? If you have time, I want to trouble you to investigate someone for me." He thought for a moment and suggested.
"What are you being polite about? I've just stabilized my Returning to Void Stage cultivation, and besides hunting beasts, I have nothing special, tell me, who do you want to investigate?" Wulu replied.
"A young woman named Su Yingxue, a Level 6 Array Master, reportedly from the Hui Clan." Yuan Ming said.
"Hui Clan... what kind of clan is that? But as long as there's a name and title, and she's a Level 6 Array Master, there should be a way to find out." Wulu was momentarily surprised, then said.
"Then thank you, Brother Wu Lu, be extremely careful when investigating this woman." Yuan Ming reminded.
"Don't worry, I have the Heavenly Escape Stone Talisman, not even City Lord Jin Mu was able to find me despite his full efforts, who else can catch me?" Wulu laughed heartily.
Afterwards, the two chatted casually for a long time, and Yuan Ming ended the communication.
...
Seven or eight days later, in the Land of Nothingness.
Su Yingxue sat silently at her desk, aimlessly flipping through books, her gaze was always drifting beyond the pages, as if contemplating something or awaiting something.
According to previous experience, these two days would be the time for that mysterious expert to contact her again, and she had already prepared the promised Array Map, the book she was currently flipping through documented the Eight Extremes Golden Lock Array.
Yet, regarding whether that expert could fulfill her request, Su Yingxue was not very confident.
The Nihility Prison is a place of certain death; except for the Prison Master, even the Six Prison Wardens cannot leave at will, let alone the fact that even with a way to get in and out, outside is Demon World territory, aiming to travel between there and the Chuyun Realm directly would be pure fantasy.
Her request was more of a test than an actual transaction.
As time slowly passed, a hint of fluctuation appeared in Su Yingxue's eyes.
At that moment, the thoughtful expression on Su Yingxue's face vanished instantly, replaced by a relaxed demeanor, and a glint in her eyes that did not belong to her.
It was Yuan Ming who had possessed her.
Yuan Ming had possessed her many times before, navigating smoothly. As soon as his vision cleared, he immediately looked down at the desk and quickly spotted the book Su Yingxue had prepared in advance.
"Hmm, not bad. The Eight Extremes Golden Lock Array is indeed profound, Su Yingxue did not try to deceive me with some substandard goods." Yuan Ming flipped through the book and couldn't help but nod in satisfaction.
In this way, their transaction was considered complete.
Yuan Ming raised his hand to take a blank jade scroll and wrote a message for Su Yingxue before focusing on studying the array map of the Eight Extremes Golden Lock Array.
The possession time quickly passed, and when Yuan Ming regained consciousness, his awareness had already returned to his body.
With the end of the Black Incense Possession, Su Yingxue's consciousness also quickly recovered, discovering that a jade scroll had appeared on the desk.
Had that person already been here?
Su Yingxue's eyes flickered slightly as she picked up the jade scroll to check the message inside.
"I have fulfilled your request. Upon receiving the news, the White Emperor City Lord immediately sent someone to contact Ancestor Bing Lan."
But just this one sentence made waves surge in Su Yingxue's heart.
Few people knew about the connection between Jin Mu, Ancestor Bing Lan, and the Three Realms Sect, yet in just a few days, that person had indeed conveyed the message to the Chuyun Realm!
The prison, which the Demon Clan prides themselves on and considers unbreakable, seemed to be like a back garden to this person, who could come and go at will.
Who exactly was this person? With such divine skills, could it be that they had mastered a cross-realm space passage connecting the Chuyun Realm?
The cross-realm passages connected to Chuyun Realm are held by several Demon Emperors of the Demon World; could this person be from one of these Demon Emperors?
Su Yingxue's gaze was fixed on the jade scroll, silent for a long time.
...
In the Medicine Garden Cave Mansion of the Shura Palace.
As soon as Yuan Ming's consciousness returned, he immediately took out a jade scroll and recorded the array map of the Eight Extremes Golden Lock Array inside, lest he forget it.
A loud thunderclap sounded, as a massive black storm cloud hovered above the medicine garden, with piercing lightning occasionally flashing through, making bursts of thunder noise.
Lei Yu hid within the black cloud, continuously swallowing and refining Thunder Origin Pills, as the rich nature's spiritual energy in the medicine garden gathered toward the black cloud.
Lei Yu's strength improved rapidly, moving towards mid-level Level 5.
Yuan Ming was quite pleased with this and closed his eyes to comprehend the Eight Extremes Golden Lock Array.
A month quickly passed.
Yuan Ming suddenly opened his eyes from seclusion, frowning.
The complexity of the Level 6 Array, the Eight Extremes Golden Lock Array, far exceeded his expectations and couldn't be compared to a Level 5 Array. Even though Su Yingxue had marked the array map in detail, after a month of painstaking meditation, there were still many unclear places.
"It seems unrealistic to fully understand this Eight Extremes Golden Lock Array solely by my own comprehension. I still need to communicate with Su Yingxue again." Yuan Ming muttered to himself, taking out the Stealing Heaven Tripod and lighting the black incense.
This time, he did not directly possess Su Yingxue but instead descended into the body of an ordinary guard of the Nihility Prison, making his way to Su Yingxue's cell door.
The Eight Extremes Golden Lock Array was too complex, and understanding it thoroughly wasn't something that could be conveyed in just a few sentences. Continuing to possess Su Yingxue and exchanging messages was too slow, so this method was more convenient.
Su Yingxue was sitting at her desk as usual but wasn't studying formations; instead, she was somewhat lost in thought, not even noticing Yuan Ming's presence outside.
It wasn't until Yuan Ming knocked on the cell door that Su Yingxue was startled awake.
"What is it? The space array requested by the Hell Demon Lord hasn't been designed yet." Seeing Yuan Ming outside, Su Yingxue stood up, her expression reverting to coldness.
"Fellow Daoist Su, it is I," Yuan Ming said plainly.
Hearing these words, Su Yingxue was stunned, carefully observing Yuan Ming, her expression gradually transforming from astonishment to surprise, mixed with a hint of joy.
"Are you... that Senior?"
"You could say that," Yuan Ming replied indifferently.
"Did you control this guard this time?" Su Yingxue asked tentatively.
"That is not important. I came this time because I do not fully understand the Eight Extremes Golden Lock Array and need you to clarify a few parts," Yuan Ming said.
"Of course, I can, but Senior, please wait a moment. There is a surveillance restriction setup by the Hell Demon Lord here; although he might not be watching right now, it's better to disrupt it a little, just to be safe," Su Yingxue said, performing hand seals, sending several white lights outside the prison.
The void around Yuan Ming rippled faintly, soon returning to its original state.

chapters.title: Chapter 862 - 833: Exploring the Abyss Again
chapters.content:
"It's done." Su Yingxue lowered her hands, then looked up at the ordinary guard possessed by Yuan Ming and spoke.
Yuan Ming nodded and sat cross-legged at the cell door, inquiring about the complexities of the Eight Extremes Golden Lock Array.
Su Yingxue answered every question, making efforts to explain.
With this woman's profound understanding of formations, she was now willing to impart her knowledge generously. Coupled with Yuan Ming's direct insights gained when he possessed her, the combination greatly benefited Yuan Ming.
A quarter of an hour passed quickly.
By this time, Yuan Ming had a good grasp of the Eight Extremes Golden Lock Array. While not claiming complete mastery, he understood most of the key points, leaving the rest to further comprehension through practice.
"Thank you, Fellow Daoist Su, for clearing my doubts." Calculating that the time was just right, Yuan Ming stood up and bid farewell.
"Please wait, Senior." Su Yingxue called after Yuan Ming.
"Does Fellow Daoist Su have further business? Or do you perhaps require compensation from me?" Yuan Ming looked over.
"The Eight Extremes Golden Lock Array was promised to you, Senior, from the beginning. Explaining it is natural and not something that should require compensation. Calling to you is because I wish to make another transaction with you." Su Yingxue said with a smile.
"Oh, what kind of transaction would you like?" Yuan Ming furrowed his brow slightly and asked.
"Having observed Senior through our encounters and just now, I dare to speculate that Senior is also an Array Master, stuck at the Level 5 Peak realm, correct?" Su Yingxue inquired.
"Indeed, your observation is sharp." Yuan Ming nodded, acknowledging without hesitation.
"I have a way to help Senior advance your Array Formation Cultivation to Level 6. In return, I wish to ask Senior to investigate the space array connecting Nihility Prison to the outside world." Su Yingxue said slowly, her bright eyes flowing with thought.
"Why are you investigating this?" Yuan Ming asked, his gaze flickering upon hearing these words.
He knew that Nihility Prison was located within the Demon World's absolute danger zone, its connection to the outside reliant entirely on a space array.
"Senior needn't concern yourself with this. My investigation bears no relevance to you." Su Yingxue arranged her hair with a smile.
"I'll give you an answer next time I seek you out." Yuan Ming scrutinized Su Yingxue for a moment, gave an ambiguous reply, and then turned to leave.
...
A year later, on a desolate island somewhere in the Dongji Sea.
A tunneling light sped towards the horizon, swiftly approaching, and gradually diminishing.
Before the visitor could stop, a faint golden light flickered on the desolate island, its powerful Spiritual Power causing the visitor's face to change drastically.
"Fellow Daoist Yun Luo, you have arrived." At this moment, Yuan Ming's figure appeared silently on the island, waving towards the sky.
Hua Zhi and Vajra stood on either side of him.
In the years that passed, Hua Zhi's power did not seem significantly enhanced, but Vajra had reached the mid-stage of the Wanxiang Body.
However, its Qi-Blood fluctuation was slightly unstable, a side effect from quickly advancing with the aid of the Blood Origin Pill.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, just now, that was..." Yun Luo Fairy landed from the clouds, arriving beside Yuan Ming, and looked around nervously while searching for the vanished golden light.
"It was a nested array I arranged through connections, which inadvertently leaked some aura due to the aura of Fellow Daoist arriving." Yuan Ming smiled.
"I see. However, just a little glimpse of its aura shocked me greatly. I wonder what it would look like if the full power were unleashed?" Yun Luo Fairy smiled slightly, adopting a dignified appearance unlike her verbose communication through talismans.
"You'll see when we hunt Level 6 Demon Beasts later." Yuan Ming gave her a glance and said.
"Oh? It seems Fellow Daoist Yuan has already decided on a target. But in the Dongji Sea, where Spiritual Energy is sparse, Level 6 Demon Beasts are hard to find. Are you planning to go to the Abyss or the Biluotan Ancestor Spirit Secret Realm?" Yun Luo Fairy's eyes flashed with intrigue as she asked.
Unlike the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range, Level 6 Demon Beasts were nearly extinct in the Dongji Sea, with only two places harboring them: the Abyss and the Ancestor Spirit Secret Realm at Azure Dragon Pond.
The Ancestor Spirit Secret Realm is a natural secret realm controlled by Azure Dragon Pond, rich in nature's spiritual energy, regarded as a cultivation sanctuary where many predecessors from Azure Dragon Pond retreat.
The former Sect Leader of Azure Dragon Pond was also there, so surely Level 6 Demon Beasts must reside there.
However, those entering the Ancestor Spirit Secret Realm have never returned.
"I'll naturally go to the Abyss." Yuan Ming declared without hesitation.
The Ancestor Spirit Secret Realm being located at Azure Dragon Pond's stronghold, Yuan Ming's intention to avoid provoking Dongji Palace, Azure Dragon Pond, and other major forces through hunting Level 6 Demon Beasts would be betrayed if he ventured into the Ancestor Spirit Secret Realm.
Nevertheless, the Abyss, being the hunting grounds of the Six-winged Heavenly Cicada, was also far from safe.
Fortunately, Void previously mentioned that the Six-winged Heavenly Cicada dwelled within the Abyss's depths, so if Yuan Ming intended only to search its outskirts, there should not be major issues.
"There indeed are Level 6 Demon Beasts within the Abyss, but it is a place of peril in the Dongji Sea..." Yun Luo Fairy said with a solemn expression.
"We'll search the outskirts of the Abyss without venturing deeper in, even if it takes several years." Yuan Ming waved his hand dismissively.
"That should be alright then." Yun Luo Fairy, with less knowledge of the Abyss than Yuan Ming, seeing his strong confidence, readily agreed.
In fact, Yuan Ming chose to hunt beasts in the Abyss for another reason; the demon beasts there are rarely rational, making them much easier to deal with than normal Level 6 demon beasts, making it the best current choice.
Apart from these considerations from the big picture, he also harbored a small hope in his heart to encounter the Heavenly Cicada Mother Qi again.Sаmplе frоm Мy Virtuаl Librаry Еmpirе—rеаd mоrе оn М&VLЕМРY&R.
Although the previous encounter had caused him no end of troubles, this time, the bark of the World Tree had already merged with the Undying Tree. Should he encounter it again, he believed he wouldn't be as embarrassed as before and could even gain some transformative benefits.
Afterward, Yuan Ming spent some time gathering the array apparatus for the Eight Extremes Golden Lock Array before setting off with Yun Luo Fairy and Hua Zhi towards the Abyss.
Given their speed, they finally reached the Abyss over two months later.
"What should we do next? Act separately or search together?" Yun Luo Fairy blinked her beautiful eyes and asked.
"Let's act separately; it will be more efficient that way. Take these communication talismans with you. If you spot traces of a Level 6 demon beast, use these to get in touch," Yuan Ming took out several Void Communication Talismans and handed them to Yun Luo Fairy, Hua Zhi, and Vajra.
Hua Zhi and Vajra put away the talismans and flew off in two different directions.
