"I will be off as well," Yuan Ming said, transforming into a green light and speeding away.
Seeing Yuan Ming leave so swiftly and decisively, Yun Luo Fairy snorted slightly in dissatisfaction before flying off into the distance.
Once the group entered the Abyss and began searching for Level 6 demon beasts, they realized finding a suitable target for hunting was far more difficult than imagined.
The outermost area of the Abyss barely had any traces of demon beasts, and after several months of searching separately, they all came up empty-handed.
In the end, they cautiously flew a bit further into the Abyss, once more arriving at the Demon Song Sea Domain.
Here, the number of demon beasts increased, but most were transformed under the influence of the Heavenly Cicada Mother Qi, each larger than the next. Relying on their size, they could often unleash powers far exceeding their demonic power levels.
During their journey, Yuan Ming and the others repeatedly encountered beasts whose strength was comparable to Level 6 but had demonic power only at Level 5 or even Level 4.
Even if they were slain, such beasts wouldn't meet the standards needed for refining a Dharma Manifestation Pill, and because of their immense size, fighting them was extremely troublesome.
Thus, Yuan Ming and his group had to repeatedly avoid these formidable and massive beasts, searching within the vast Abyss for suitable targets.
...
Near the Abyss, in a certain sea area, seven or eight cultivators were slowly flying along the sea surface, constantly looking around, divine senses scanning beneath, seemingly searching for something.
The leader among them was a white-bearded elder in a wide gray robe, with cultivation at the Early Stage of Returning to Void, while most of the others seemed to be at the Nascent Soul Middle Late Stage.
"Uncle Master, this is near the Abyss. Are we really going to search for Corrosive Immortal Stone here?" A young man with sword-like brows beside the white-bearded elder asked, with a tone of complaint.
"What can we do? This is an order from Dongji Palace. How can our minor force at Huiyun Island oppose Dongji Palace?" the white-bearded elder said gloomily.
The young man with sword-like brows paused and lowered his head.
"Alas, originally, with Wuya Island keeping them in check, Dongji Palace couldn't cover the sky with one hand. But it's vexing that Yuan Mo wiped out Wuya Island in one fell swoop, and then continued to assassinate several Island Masters, allowing Dongji Palace to expand its influence. It is becoming increasingly difficult for us neutral islands to survive," another beautiful young girl in a red dress pouted.
"The matter of Yuan Mo is rather suspicious. Though Dongji Palace has offered a reward for his capture, they haven't stated the reason. Moreover, years have passed with no message at all. With Dongji Palace's power, how could this be? Do you think Yuan Mo could possibly be one of them, and it's all a double act?" A sallow-faced man beside the young girl said.
The young girl in the red dress's expression changed slightly, about to speak.
"I don't think so. It isn't just Dongji Palace offering a reward for capturing Yuan Mo, but also Luo Jia Mountain, Azure Dragon Pond, and even Black Evil Sect. If Yuan Mo hadn't stirred up major trouble, how would these major forces in the Extreme East join hands in offering a reward for his capture?" the young man with sword-like brows shook his head.
"Even so, it doesn't mean Yuan Mo isn't one of Dongji Palace's people," the sallow-faced man retorted, seemingly not wanting to lose face before the girl in the red dress.
"If you can think of this, wouldn't those from Luo Jia Mountain and Azure Dragon Pond have considered it too? If Yuan Mo were really one of Dongji Palace's people, Luo Jia Mountain and Azure Dragon Pond would have joined forces to demand him long ago and wouldn't let things remain so calm," the young man with sword-like brows said bluntly.
The sallow-faced man's face showed dissatisfaction and he wanted to retort.
"Enough, instead of spending time arguing, focus on finding the Corrosive Immortal Stone," the white-bearded elder said coldly.
Upon hearing this, the sallow-faced man and the young man with sword-like brows closed their mouths.
At this moment, an uninhabited deserted island appeared ahead, with thunder rumbling from it. Nearby, there was a fierce storm, causing huge waves to rise on the sea surface, while thick black clouds appeared overhead, rapidly expanding and enveloping an area dozens of miles wide within a few breaths.
Upon seeing this scene, the group halted.
"What's going on?" The sallow-faced man was startled.
"This kind of celestial phenomenon, could it be an Exotic Treasure appearing?" The young man with sword-like brows brightened his eyes.
Upon hearing this, the others all showed joy.
The celestial phenomenon was so astonishing that if it were truly an Exotic Treasure appearing, it would be extraordinary.
Thinking this, several people couldn't help but start itching to act.
"Calm down, it's not an Exotic Treasure, but a demon beast undergoing the Transforming Thunder Tribulation," the white-bearded elder said in a low voice, quelling their thoughts.
"Transforming Thunder Tribulation? What is that?" The young girl in red asked.
"Typically, I tell you to read more of the classics and widen your knowledge, but you turn a deaf ear. The so-called Transforming Thunder Tribulation is the tribulation experienced by demon beasts with high-grade bloodlines when they completely transform into human form," the white-bearded elder explained slowly.

chapters.title: Chapter 863 - 834: Yuan Mo's Lawless Behavior
chapters.content:
"Is there such a thing? My master's Wind Bird possesses the Ancient Green Bird bloodline, and I happened to be present when it transformed. No Thunder Tribulation appeared." The red-clothed girl tilted her head, asking with some confusion.
"Not every demon beast that contains bloodline power will encounter Transforming Thunder Tribulation. The higher the bloodline level, the greater the chance of it appearing and the greater its power." The white-bearded elder said.
"So, having a high bloodline level might not be a good thing. It's so difficult just to transform." The sword-browed young man said thoughtfully.
"Some people pretend to know when they don't. The sect's classics contain records that Transforming Thunder Tribulation is both a calamity and an opportunity. The thunder not only refines the demon beast's body but also has the effect of stimulating bloodline power. After undergoing the baptism of thunder, the beast's power will be greatly enhanced." The yellow-faced man said with a mocking expression.
"You..." The sword-browed young man showed an angry face.
"Uncle Master, with your vast experience, can you tell what level demon beast is undergoing Thunder Tribulation?" The yellow-faced man ignored the sword-browed young man and asked the white-bearded elder.
"I also can't determine, but it's at least a Level 5 demon beast." The white-bearded elder said, staring straight ahead.
"I read that after overcoming Transforming Thunder Tribulation, demon beasts are seriously injured. Shall we seize the opportunity to capture it? With Uncle Master's strength and ours, it might not be impossible, right?" The yellow-faced man said, itching to try.
The white-bearded elder was somewhat tempted but shook his head after examining the sky full of black clouds for a while, "Judging by the scale of this Thunder Tribulation, this demon beast's strength is quite extraordinary. Even if it's injured after the transformation, we might not be able to capture it. If there are casualties, our Huiyun Island's situation will become even tougher, so let's not cause more trouble, let's go."
Although others were somewhat unwilling, they dared not contradict the white-bearded elder's order.
The group changed direction, preparing to bypass this small island.
Just at this moment, a large mass of white mist suddenly appeared nearby and quickly became thick.
The Huiyun Island crowd wanted to speed up their retreat but it was too late, they were soon engulfed by the white mist. Their Divine Sense couldn't probe the situation inside the mist, instead, it was completely rebounded back.
"Not good, this white mist is a Forbidden illusion! Quickly grab the person next to you and don't get separated in the mist!" The white-bearded elder was shocked.
However, before he could finish speaking, a great suction force emanated from the depths of the white mist, causing the Huiyun Island crowd to uncontrollably fly forwards, including the Returning to Void Cultivator like the white-bearded elder.
A few breaths later, everyone's vision blurred, and they heavily crashed onto the ground in a valley, falling in a dizzy and disoriented state, covered in dust and dirt.
The white-bearded elder also could only barely land, staggering a few steps before stabilizing his stance.
The valley was sealed off by dense white mist, and not far away, there was a cave on the rock wall, faintly emitting spirit light from within.
"Fellow Daoist, we are cultivators from Huiyun Island. Our purpose this time is to find ore and arrived here purely by chance, with no intention of interrupting your spirit beast's tribulation. Please, Fellow Daoist, do not misunderstand." The white-bearded elder's eyes flickered and he bowed towards the cave.
The power used to capture the crowd was astonishing, yet it hadn't reached the Dharma manifestation level. The presence inside the cave should be a Late Stage of Returning to Void existence.
Although it wasn't a Dharma manifestation Great Power, a Late Stage Returning Void cultivator could eliminate them without much effort. Thus, the white-bearded elder acted exceptionally respectfully.
The others, seeing the elder's demeanor, hurriedly stood up, respectfully saluting towards the cave, not daring to breathe heavily.
"Huiyun Island? Never heard of it. It's not some big island in Dongji Sea, right? A Returning to Void Early Stage with a few Nascent Souls dare to wander near the abyss, they really seem tired of living." A gloomy voice came from inside the cave.
"You guessed correctly, Huiyun Island is just a small island in Dongji Sea, low in strength. This trip near the abyss was indeed forced." The white-bearded elder smiled bitterly.
"I heard your conversation just now, no need to explain further. I didn't expect that only after closing off for a mere hundred years, the forces of East Extreme Island would expand so rapidly." The gloomy voice said.
Upon hearing that the person inside the cave didn't intend to pursue, the white-bearded elder was secretly pleased and quickly explained, "East Extreme Island expanded so quickly thanks to that Yuan Mo removing the eye-sore of Wuya Island. However, Yuan Mo also caused considerable trouble. Wuya Island Master Ye Wuya's Daoist companion comes from the Central Continent Su Nu Sect and has been captured by Yuan Mo. It's said that Su Nu Sect has already sent people over."
"This Yuan Mo indeed behaves recklessly, quite to my taste. But Yuan Mo seems to be a nickname. What is this person's real name? Where does he come from?" The gloomy voice asked with interest.
"Reporting to senior, Yuan Mo's real name is Yuan Ming. Several years ago, he did something unknown that attracted the joint pursuit by Dongji Palace, Luo Jia Mountain, Azure Dragon Pond, and the Demon Cultivator sect Black Evil Sect. His strength is formidable; he suddenly appeared on Wuya Island some years ago, capturing all the Returning void cultivators there, including Ye Wuya at the peak of Late Stage. His ruthless actions and suspected demon cultivator status earned him the nickname Yuan Mo." The white-bearded elder spoke eloquently.
"I see, quite an intriguing person. Perhaps after coming out of retreat, I should meet him." The gloomy voice said.
The gloomy voice then inquired about a few issues in the Dongji Sea Cultivation World, and the white-bearded elder answered each in detail.
At this moment, a deafening thunderous roar suddenly came from above, shaking the void, causing the ground underfoot to tremble, and everyone's expression changed.
The valley's sky was also shrouded in white mist, preventing the Huiyun Island group from seeing the situation above.
"Enough, my spirit beast is about to start its tribulation, you may leave." The gloomy voice said, and the white mist outside the valley split open, revealing a passage.
The white-bearded elder rejoiced, promptly replied, and hurriedly led several disciples to fly out.
The mist passage automatically closed, and a figure emerged from within the cave, it was Yuan Ming.
"Yuan Mo? I have always conducted myself openly and honestly, such a nickname for me." He frowned, his voice somewhat displeased.
Enjoy the story by reading on *.
"Master, I think your style of conduct has nothing to do with being open and honest..." Vajra's silhouette came out of the cave.
Yuan Ming glared at Vajra, making the latter swallow back the rest of his words, then formed a seal and pointed at the sky above the valley.
The white mist above dissipates, revealing the scene in mid-air.
Bolts of lightning descend from the black clouds in the sky, striking a four-winged Thunder Spirit Bird, about twenty or thirty zhang long—it is Lei Yu.
Lei Yu's demonic power has already reached mid-level Level 5, its entire body covered by dense lightning, resembling a suit of Thunder Armor.
The lightning in mid-air strikes it, not only failing to shatter the Thunder Armor but is completely absorbed, making the armor even more robust.
Yuan Ming observes the situation, a hint of delight appearing on his face.
It's been more than two years since entering the abyss to search for a Level 6 demon beast.
During these two years, he, along with Yun Luo Fairy, Hua Zhi, and Vajra, have diligently searched, but unfortunately, there hasn't been any substantial gain.
However, just recently, Lei Yu, who had been meditating in the Shura Palace, finally broke through to mid-level Level 5 with the help of the Thunder Origin Pill.
Yuan Ming was initially quite pleased, thinking he had another helper for the search, but unexpectedly, Lei Yu actually sensed the Transforming Thunder Tribulation.
The abyss might have the presence of Heavenly Cicada Mother Qi and other dangers, not a suitable place for facing the Transforming Thunder Tribulation. As a result, Yuan Ming informed Yun Luo Fairy and took Lei Yu out of the abyss, arriving at the edge for the tribulation crossing.
As the lightning falling from the thundercloud above grew denser, the Thunder Armor around Lei Yu, despite having the Divine Skill to absorb lightning, began to show signs of crisis, with numerous tears appearing.
Lei Yu did not cower, but instead seemed exceptionally excited, lifting its head to emit a piercing cry that reached into the sky.
Dozens of thick lightning bolts shot out from Lei Yu's mouth, counterattacking the descending thunder tribulation.
Scores of lightning bolts intertwined in the sky, colliding with each other, churning into a massive Thunder Ball.
Lei Yu was inside the Thunder Ball, enduring one wave of lightning baptism after another.
"Master, there's no need to worry. Lei Yu possesses the Ancient Thunder Peng Bloodline and had the ability to devour lightning long ago. Now that its power has reached Level 5, the Transforming Thunder Tribulation won't harm it," Vajra noted, seeing a trace of concern on Yuan Ming's face.
"I'm not worried about Lei Yu, it's just that I previously attached those Great Peng Wings on Lei Yu and then used the Melding Spirit Pill to connect their bloodlines. I wonder if these wings will affect Lei Yu's tribulation crossing," Yuan Ming mused, touching his chin thoughtfully.
Vajra wasn't certain of the outcome either and kept silent.
Time passed gradually, and the thunderclouds in the sky finally began to dissipate; the Transforming Thunder Tribulation concluded.
The Thunder Ball in mid-air also started to shrink, becoming increasingly dazzling and radiant.
The ball shrunk rapidly at a visible pace and transformed into several scattered electric arcs after a few breaths, completely vanishing, and Lei Yu disappeared without a trace.
Yuan Ming was taken aback when suddenly thunder rumbled behind him, and a black-clad youth appeared out of nowhere.
At this moment, Vajra realized that Lei Yu had instantaneously moved behind them, and quickly turned around, showing a look of shock.
"After going through the tribulation, your Thunder Escape has indeed become much faster," Yuan Ming said as he turned around.
This black-clad youth was none other than Lei Yu, and the four wings on his back had disappeared, transforming completely into human form.
"Thanks to Master's Thunder Origin Pill, which not only rapidly improved my demonic power but also had a significant effect on catalyzing my bloodline's power, otherwise, I wouldn't have successfully transformed so soon," Lei Yu said joyfully, looking at his hands.
"How do you feel now?" Yuan Ming carefully observed Lei Yu for a moment, asking.
"I feel great, my bloodline's power has been fully activated, and the power of the thunder and lightning I control has greatly increased," Lei Yu said as he spread his fingers, five thick bolts of lightning shooting out, more dazzling than before and appearing exceedingly violent.
"This is..." Yuan Ming's expression shifted slightly.
Lei Yu moved his five fingers, and the five bolts of lightning merged into one, transforming into a Thunder Spear and blasting forward.
The Thunder Spear flashed to the end of the valley, before a hundred-zhang tall peak, and after a few breaths vanished as if it had simply disappeared.
"Is that all?"
The moment Vajra spoke, there was a thunderous boom, like a colossal pillar of lightning rising to the sky, engulfing the hundred-zhang giant peak within it.
The giant peak shattered instantly into countless pieces and then turned into nothingness.
Though the giant peak vanished, the pillar of lightning did not disperse but soared upwards into the clouds and pierced downwards into the ground.
"Crack!"
In an instant, the ground across the island seemed to be torn by an invisible force, and a massive fissure opened up, running across the island with the lightning pillar as the center.

chapters.title: Chapter 864 - 835: Hunting Target
chapters.content:
"The power of this thunder and lightning is truly astonishing." Yuan Ming looked at everything happening before him, unable to hide his shock, and muttered to himself.
In terms of destructive force, this strike from Lei Yu has already surpassed him.
"I also don't know why this newly-born power of thunder and lightning is so astonishing. This force is too wild; I can't control it myself." Lei Yu said, a hint of pain flashing across his face.
His palm had turned jet-black, as if it had been scorched by fire.
"Your wild and fierce thunder and lightning somehow resembles Destruction Thunder." Vajra said from the side.
"Destruction Thunder? What kind of divine skill is that?" Yuan Ming asked.
"I can't say for sure, the term just popped up." Vajra furrowed his brows in deep thought.
Yuan Ming pondered for a moment and immediately understood. It seemed that this Destruction Thunder was part of Vajra's past memory, possibly a divine skill from the Demon World?
"Since you can't control this newly-born thunder and lightning, it's better to use it less. How is your flying escape divine ability?" He advised Lei Yu, then asked.
It's good news that Lei Yu's thunder and lightning power has increased, but I'm most concerned about Lei Yu's flying escape technique.
"Master, rest assured, after the baptism of the Transforming Thunder Tribulation, I have already refined the pair of Roc Wings into my body and have completely mastered the Wind Escape power within them. Now using Wind and Thunder Double Escape is absolutely no problem." Lei Yu said and his body swelled, reverting to his original form, with four wings of wind and thunder appearing on his back.
"Let me give it a try." Yuan Ming leapt onto Lei Yu's back.
Lei Yu's four wings shook, and his massive body surged skyward, reaching hundreds of miles away in an instant, comparable to the Meteor Shuttle spiritual treasure owned by Ouyang Qiang.
"This speed is quite good." Yuan Ming nodded, but felt a bit disappointed inside.
Originally, he hoped Lei Yu could surpass those Dharma manifestation Great Powers after mastering the wind and thunder wings, but it now seems they're just on par.
R+e.a!d& ahead and get u&pd@a^tes by v$isi!t@ing M+^%V*L$EM@P&YR@.
"Master, I haven't exerted my full power yet." The wind and thunder power on Lei Yu's four wings intertwined together, emitting a deafening roar.
In the next moment, Lei Yu's figure suddenly blurred, and his speed increased several times.
A glint of surprise flashed in Yuan Ming's eyes. Combining the power of wind and thunder truly increased Lei Yu's tunneling speed to this extent.
Just then, he suddenly stopped Lei Yu, and then summoned Shura Palace, entering inside.
Inside the stone building of the Medicine Garden, the blood flames within the Void Communication Array flickered incessantly.
Yuan Ming's figure appeared next to the Void Communication Array, pinched a seal, and pointed at the blood flames, from which Hua Zhi's image emerged.
"Master, come quickly, I've found a Level 6 demon beast suitable for hunting." Hua Zhi's voice came from the blood flames.
"Really? What kind of demon beast?" Yuan Ming's heart was delighted, he urgently asked.
"It's a Sea Jelly Demon Beast. Its size isn't too big, and its spiritual intelligence is normal..." Hua Zhi described the situation of the discovered demon beast in detail, and it indeed met the needs for refining a Dharma Manifestation Pill.
"This beast is indeed a suitable hunting target. You continue to follow the demon beast from afar, don't let it find you. Lei Yu has successfully passed the Transforming Thunder Tribulation; I will head over now." Yuan Ming instructed, then asked for Hua Zhi's current location before cutting off the communication.
He activated the Void Communication Array to contact Yun Luo Fairy, informing her of the situation, and then returned to the tribulation island with Lei Yu.
Yuan Ming collected the array set up on the island and immediately took Vajra, riding Lei Yu straight to Hua Zhi's location.
With Lei Yu's increased tunneling speed, what originally took half a month's journey now only took about four to five days.
In a certain sea area of the Abyss, the seawater here surprisingly appeared deep red, resembling blood.
On a small reef, Hua Zhi transformed into a purple-black vine, quietly coiled around a large rock.
At this moment, Hua Zhi's demonic power was completely gone, and she looked just like an ordinary vine.
Just then, the figure on the reef flickered, revealing Yuan Ming's figure.
However, his body was currently in a semi-transparent state, clearly utilizing the Void Transformation Technique to conceal his emitted aura.
"Master, you've arrived!" A green light flashed atop the vine, turning into Hua Zhi's head.
"Where's the Sea Jelly Demon Beast you mentioned?" Yuan Ming asked through transmission.
Hua Zhi had informed him during the transmission earlier that this Sea Jelly Demon Beast's perception was extremely keen, so Yuan Ming stored Lei Yu away from hundreds of miles away, utilizing the Void Transformation Technique to conceal his traces and carefully sneaking over.
"In a Sea Eye on the seabed ahead." Hua Zhi pointed towards a certain sea area in front, responding through transmission.
Yuan Ming glanced over there and attempted to probe with his Divine Sense.
"Master, don't use Divine Sense to probe; the Sea Jelly Demon Beast's perception is exceptionally acute. Although your Divine Sense is powerful, it might still alert this demon." Hua Zhi hurriedly stopped him.
Yuan Ming's brow furrowed slightly; without freely probing, how could he devise an action plan?
His Circular Light Technique was rudimentary, and he couldn't probe that far. As for using Black Incense Possession to investigate, that was out of the question.
"What's going on with the seawater here?" Yuan Ming pondered for a moment, not immediately finding a clue, and asked another question.
The seawater for several hundred miles along the way had been a normal color, but here it had turned into a strange blood-red.
"Master, you may not know, but the seawater here is blood-red because of a special kind of Blood Light Algae that grows on the sea floor. This seaweed releases a blood-red powdery substance at certain times, dyeing the water in this manner. The Sea Jelly Demon Beast enjoys consuming this Blood Light Algae, so it has settled its lair here," Hua Zhi explained.
Yuan Ming nodded, remained silent for a moment, and then left, retreating a hundred miles away.
He first took out the Array instruments for the Eight Extremes Golden Lock Array and set them up at a spot on the sea floor. Once everything was in place, he was contemplating how to further investigate the whereabouts of the sea beast when his expression suddenly changed. He flew out from the sea floor, gazing into the distance.
Moments later, a white light flew swiftly towards him, soon revealing the figure of Yun Luo Fairy near Yuan Ming.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, apologies for being late," she said.
"I just arrived too. Fellow Daoist Yun Luo should recover your mana first, and then we'll talk," Yuan Ming replied.
Yun Luo Fairy, a bit out of breath at the moment, didn't stand on ceremony and found a spot in the sea to settle, closed her eyes, and began cultivating. Yuan Ming, seated cross-legged not far away, wore a contemplative expression.
Half a day later, with her mana restored, Yuan Ming informed her of the current situation.
"Listening to Fellow Daoist Hua Zhi's description, I do know the origins of this Sea Jelly Demon Beast. There's no need for effort to investigate," Yun Luo Fairy thought for a moment and said.
"Please enlighten me, Fellow Daoist Yun Luo," Yuan Ming raised an eyebrow.
"If I'm not mistaken, this beast is known as the Sea Scale Stinging Demon, a near-extinct demon beast from the Dongji Sea. Its demon body possesses astonishing vitality, able to regenerate severed limbs instantly and survive even when cut in half, making it extremely difficult to kill," Yun Luo Fairy explained.
Yuan Ming listened, not speaking, but nodded slightly, signaling Yun Luo Fairy to continue.
"Additionally, this beast contains a potent toxin, which is quite distinctive. It not only attacks the physical body but also assaults the Divine Soul. With this beast's Level 6 demon power, its toxicity is such that not the slightest contact can be made, or there would be no chance of survival," Yun Luo Fairy's expression turned grave.
"That indeed poses a conundrum," Yuan Ming mused, considering how to slay this Sea Jelly Demon Beast.
With the Eight Extremes Golden Lock Array in place, if the beast could be lured inside, half the battle would be won. The key was how to lure this demon beast out of its lair.
A Level 6 demon beast's spiritual intelligence was long awakened, its senses extremely sharp. Luring it from the lair wasn't difficult, but bringing it here was not easy.
Yuan Ming pondered for a while, roughly formulating a plan, then immediately summoned Hua Zhi and Vajra, and briefly explained.
"This plan, though feasible, involves considerable risk," Yun Luo Fairy expressed concern.
"To hunt a Level 6 demon beast, risks are inevitable. Let's do it without delay. Prepare as we discussed," Yuan Ming said, his figure transforming into a streak of azure light as he plunged into the sea, heading straight for the Sea Jelly Demon Beast's lair, without concealing his presence.
Yun Luo Fairy, Vajra, and Hua Zhi each flew in different directions.
Yuan Ming soon arrived at the Sea Eye where the Sea Jelly Demon Beast resided. Still a mile away, he could already see purple light emanating from the Sea Eye, tinting the nearby soil a purplish-black.
He glanced at the ground, quickly shifting his gaze back to the Sea Eye, his form gradually approaching.
"Roar..."
When Yuan Ming was within fifty feet of the Sea Eye, a low roar echoed from within, full of warning.
This sound was as deep as thunder, and Yuan Ming's Divine Soul felt like it was struck, causing his vision to momentarily darken.
"With this beast's Soul Power, using Black Incense Possession to control it is not feasible," Yuan Ming thought to himself, his Divine Sense spreading out, soon detecting the Sea Jelly Demon Beast within the Sea Eye.
This beast was as large as a palace, resembling an upside-down purple bowl, its surface covered with tiny, luminous specks. Countless tiny tentacles hung down, looking much like an ordinary jellyfish.
The tentacles seemed to sense Yuan Ming's Divine Sense, trembling lightly.
Possibly due to Yuan Ming's overt appearance, the Sea Jelly Demon Beast's low roars grew more urgent, yet it didn't immediately charge out to attack him.
Yuan Ming felt secretly pleased, finding everything to be going as he anticipated. He lightly shook his sleeve.
A black sword shadow appeared from his sleeve, merged into the shadow of the sleeve, and in a flash, disappeared.
In the darkness near the Sea Jelly Demon Beast, a black sword shot out, slashing at the demon's head; it was the Soul Destroying Sword.
The Sea Jelly Demon Beast was filled with rage and surprise, its massive body immediately retreating, spewing out a large cloud of purple poisonous mist to meet the Soul Destroying Sword.
Yet, at that moment, the Sea Jelly Demon Beast's senses were completely cut off. It couldn't see with its eyes, nor sense with its Divine Sense, suddenly becoming as blind as a bat.
Before it could react, its Divine Soul suddenly experienced excruciating pain, as if struck by a sword, twisting its body. Innumerable tentacles shot out like arrows in all directions, trying to thwart any second attack by the enemy.
However, the next moment, a black light flashed above the Sea Jelly Demon Beast's head. A giant black palm descended from the sky, slamming fiercely onto the demon's head—this was the Great Black Sky God Palm.

chapters.title: Chapter 865 - 836: Witness Extraordinary Feats
chapters.content:
The Sea Jelly Demon Beast would not sit idly by and await its doom. Its tentacles rose up around it, striking the Great Black Sky God Palm, making a sound like raindrops hitting banana leaves, and astonishingly pierced it through with holes.
The power of the Great Black Sky God Palm was greatly diminished. Although it ultimately hit the Sea Jelly Demon Beast, it only managed to knock it away, causing no significant damage.
Above the Sea Eye, Yuan Ming's expression was solemn, his hands rapidly forming seals.
A black vortex flew out from the palm of the Great Black Sky God Palm, instantly expanding hundreds of times, engulfing the entire Sea Eye, exuding a strange aura of life and death—the Life and Death Reincarnation Path.
The Life and Death Reincarnation Vortex seemed like a giant mouth, viciously biting into the Sea Jelly Demon Beast, seemingly about to swallow it whole.
"Roar! Roar! Roar!"
The Sea Jelly Demon Beast unleashed earth-shaking roars, its massive body suddenly erupting with dazzling purple light, containing astonishing demonic power fluctuations.
"This is…" Yuan Ming's face changed color, he raised one hand, urgently summoned the Soul Destroying Sword back, and his figure flew backward swiftly.
However, before he could fly far, the dazzling purple light exploded.
Yuan Ming's expression was anxious, he immediately summoned Houtu Peak to hover above his head, dropping a yellow protective shield to protect his body.
Yet, the expected earth-shaking collision did not happen, and the exploding purple light dispersed like bubbles, as the vast Sea Jelly Demon Beast caught by the Life and Death Reincarnation Path disappeared without a trace.
Yuan Ming was stunned, his expression immediately showing surprise.
Nearby, the void was shimmering with purple shadows, with countless fist-sized little purple sea jellies appearing out of thin air, densely packed, impossible to count.
These sea jellies shot their purple tentacles from all directions towards Yuan Ming, sealing off all his escape routes, making it impossible to dodge.
"No, this isn't an illusion, it's real! This Sea Jelly Demon Beast actually has the ability to split its body!"
Yuan Ming was inwardly startled, yet his hands rapidly formed seals, injecting mana into the Spiritual Beast Bag of Lei Yu, employing the Golden Sunflower Beast Taming Technique, his body suddenly glowing with dazzling lightning.
After a thunderous bolt, Yuan Ming's figure vanished, appearing a few miles away, narrowly escaping the encirclement of countless sea jelly clones.
Even so, his right arm was still pierced with several small blood holes, and the flesh around the wounds turned purple-black.
Sourced directly from *.
Despite having used Thunder Escape to get away in time, Yuan Ming's right arm was still injured by the tentacles of the Sea Jelly Demon Beast.
A tingling, numbing sensation instantly spread from his right arm, leaving half of his body weak and powerless.
"What a terrifying poison!" Yuan Ming was startled at heart and hurriedly activated the Undying Tree within his Dantian.
His skin started to reveal black tree patterns, and his hands and feet transformed into trunks of the Undying Tree, with bursts of Undying Demon Power surging out to resist the intense poison in his right arm.
The Undying Tree's life force was astonishing, offering great resistance to poison, especially after merging with the bark of the World Tree, its life force elevated once more, quickly warding off the encroachment of the Sea Jelly's poison.
Simultaneously, several roots of the Undying Tree pierced into the void, subsequently appearing next to some nearby sea jelly clones, striking at these clones, yet swiftly retracting.
"Good, everything is progressing smoothly!" A hint of delight flashed in Yuan Ming's eyes, ready to activate the Thunder Escape Divine Ability again.
"Thunder Escape... transforming into Wood... you know quite a few tricks, but unfortunately, they are nothing more than petty gimmicks," a cold and hard voice sounded.
Yuan Ming's pupils slightly constricted, with no hesitation he activated the Thunder Escape Divine Ability to continue fleeing far away.
Yet at that moment, his Divine Soul suddenly throbbed with excruciating pain, as if subjected to countless cuts, the lightning on his body suddenly vanished.
Not only was his Divine Soul in acute pain, but its color rapidly changed, turning black.
"This is soul poison! When did I get poisoned?" Yuan Ming's heart was instantly in turmoil.
"It naturally began from the moment you set foot near my Cave Mansion, you were already destined to die here, eventually to be devoured by me, becoming a part of me—a glory for you!" From within the many little sea jellies ahead, a huge sea jelly, over a yard tall, flew out.
The sea jelly in front of him was entirely dark black, extraordinarily conspicuous, seemingly the true body of the Sea Jelly Demon Beast.
As the black sea jelly appeared, the pain in Yuan Ming's Divine Soul doubled, as if his whole head were about to explode.
He firmly retained the last shred of clarity in his heart, mobilizing all his Soul Power to resist while probing the anomaly in his Divine Soul, finally discerning the clues.
His Divine Soul, unknowingly, had been pierced through by over a dozen tiny, almost invisible black threads.
These threads were so infinitesimal that with his probing capability, unless he concentrated all his Soul Power to carefully observe, they would be entirely unnoticeable.
Yuan Ming traced the black thread's trail in his examination and was startled at heart.
The surrounding void was filled with such black threads, spreading across the entire vicinity of the nest, resembling a massive, endless net, waiting for prey to deliver themselves into the net.
"Oh, you can actually perceive the presence of my Soul Thread Net, it seems your Divine Soul Power is quite formidable too, then use your Soul Power to atone for disturbing my rest," the black sea jelly declared.
No sooner had the words fallen when the black threads piercing Yuan Ming's Divine Soul quickly thickened, cutting his Divine Soul mercilessly like a dozen blades.
Yuan Ming's Divine Soul throbbed with unbearable pain, his entire being seemingly being torn apart.
Yet over the years, his Divine Soul had continuously suffered similar damage, his endurance far surpassing that of ordinary people, as long as he did not fall into complete despair initially, he could prolong the time through focusing his Soul Power.
A cold smile emerged at the corner of his mouth, quietly uttering a word, "Shared Fate!"
"Ah..." The black sea jelly suddenly let out a painful scream, streams of black soul power spilled out, and it flew backward.
The other ordinary small sea jellies were the same, threads of soul power spilled out, and their Divine Souls were completely devastated in an instant.
Many smaller sea jelly clones shuddered and directly exploded to death.
Yuan Ming saw this scene and was slightly stunned.
The counterattack of the "Shared Fate" Divine Power, he originally thought it would only harm the original body of the sea jelly demon beast, but did not expect those clones to be affected as well, without missing a single one.
Yuan Ming's mind was racing with thoughts, and he made a grasping motion in the air with his left hand, and a black shadow appeared in his hand, the Soul Destroying Sword.
He activated the annihilation rune of the Soul Destroying Sword again, and an invisible wave spread out.
The perceptions of the nearby sea jelly clones were once again severed and they ran around in all directions aimlessly.
Yuan Ming waved his hand, and the Shura Palace emerged, glowing and expanding rapidly.
With a muffled "boom," a towering palace appeared out of nowhere, suddenly descending to the seabed.
"Collect!" Yuan Ming formed a seal with his hands and shouted in a low voice.
A tremendous suction came from the Shura Palace, drawing in several hundred sea jelly clones nearby and throwing them into the Extreme Fire Domain.
The black sea jelly let out an extremely furious roar, and a powerful wave of soul power erupted, forcibly breaking through the invisible power of the annihilation rune.
Numerous sea jelly clones found their direction again and hurriedly flew towards the black sea jelly, merging rapidly.
The body of the black sea jelly began to enlarge at a speed visible to the naked eye, showing signs of returning to its original form.
Yuan Ming saw this scene but did not continue to take action. He waved his hand to retract the Shura Palace, and a flash of thunder appeared beneath him, as Lei Yu flew out from the Spiritual Beast Bag.
As soon as Lei Yu appeared, it spread its four wings without hesitation, lifting Yuan Ming and swiftly flying towards the setup location of the Eight Extremes Golden Lock Array.
The black threads in Yuan Ming's Divine Soul were completely severed; although his Divine Soul still throbbed with pain, he could now act.
He controlled his Divine Soul to tunnel into the Stealing Heaven Tripod and entered the White Jade Lotus Platform space, crashing into the Bright Soul Fire.
With a light "hiss," a significant portion of his Divine Soul was incinerated by the Bright Soul Fire.
Under the effect of the Shared Fate Divine Power, a shrill scream from the sea jelly demon beast echoed in the distance once again.
The several hundred sea jellies drawn into the Shura Palace also suffered heavy damage, and dozens of sea jelly clones were directly destroyed.
Seeing this scene, Yuan Ming finally confirmed that his "Shared Fate" not only could harm the enemy's original body, but also bring damage to their clones, making it a nemesis of clone-type Divine Skills.
While secretly pleased, he dared not relax, continuously controlling his Divine Soul to crash into the Bright Soul Fire for the third time.
At this moment, the countless clones of the sea jelly demon beast had already fully merged, and its Divine Soul was suddenly subjected to mysterious attacks again, causing much of its soul power to be destroyed for no reason.
However, as all the clones had now unified, the soul power that was originally spread among them had merged into one, greatly resisting the mysterious attack and seemingly withstanding it.
Just then, a hideous human face appeared on the sea jelly demon beast's tentacles, full of intense rage.
In its view, the human clan's cultivator before it had come brazenly, injured it this badly, and even captured many clones, which was unforgivable.
The vast body of the sea jelly demon beast turned into a purple shadow, pursuing Yuan Ming closely.
"Sure enough, it's coming!" Yuan Ming glanced back, secretly joyful, and continued letting his Divine Soul touch the Bright Soul Fire.
His plan to hunt the beast was actually quite simple: enter the sea jelly demon beast's nest alone, lure it to the Eight Extremes Golden Lock Array, and it would be considered a great success.
To achieve this goal, the most troublesome aspect was the sea jelly demon beast's keen perception.
The attack he had just launched in the Sea Eye Nest had only one purpose: to injure this demon's Divine Soul, thus weakening its perceptive abilities.
What Yuan Ming hadn't expected was that this beast would give him a chance to get close and use the Shared Fate Divine Power.
With this, his plan became even smoother.
Lei Yu's tunneling speed was astonishing, quickly reaching the location of the Eight Extremes Golden Lock Array, but it didn't stop even for a fraction of a second, flying over with a "whoosh" and continuing to flee into the distance.
The sea jelly demon beast's Divine Soul was continuously injured, greatly affecting its perception, as it furiously pursued Yuan Ming without noticing the Eight Extremes Golden Lock Array, flying over it.
On Lei Yu's back, Yuan Ming's eyes lit up with joy, and he flipped his hand to cast out eight golden Array Flags, activating them with a seal.
Boom boom boom!
A thick golden light pillar erupted, enveloping the sea jelly demon beast's body, and countless golden chains shot out from the light pillar, binding the sea jelly demon beast within the array tightly.
The sea jelly demon beast had not anticipated the trap, and in a mix of shock and anger, struggled a few times but could not break free.
Just as it was about to attempt to split its body again to free itself from the array's confinement, a flash of thunder passed at the front, revealing Lei Yu's figure.
Standing on Lei Yu's back, Yuan Ming had already used emergency measures to completely transform into an Undying Tree form, currently striving to suppress the intense poison within.

chapters.title: Chapter 866 - 837: Hunt
chapters.content:
The Sea Jelly Demon Beast, upon seeing Yuan Ming appear, immediately ceased the action of splitting its body and commanded countless tentacles to reverse-wrap the golden chains.
A stream of purple light surged from within the tentacles, its innate deadly poison, attempting to corrode the golden chains but unable to cause any notable damage.
"The Sixth-level Array, how could you break it so easily!" Yuan Ming muttered lowly, gesturing to invoke the eight-sided Array Flag surrounding him.
The golden chains within the array emitted a rumbling sound, tightening more forcefully, with many chains even piercing into the Sea Jelly Demon Beast's body.
These golden chains carried sealing effects, beginning to seal the meridians and demonic power of the Sea Jelly Demon Beast.
In a panic, the Sea Jelly Demon Beast's large mouth within its tentacles opened wide, shooting a purple Demon Core towards the surrounding golden chains.
Amongst a burst of crackling sounds like popping beans, seven or eight golden chains were shattered.
Far from being shocked, Yuan Ming was rather pleased, continuing to drive the array, causing more golden chains to emerge, not only restoring the destroyed chains, but forming a golden cage with dozens of chains that confined the Demon Core of the Sea Jelly Demon Beast inside.
"Now is the time!" Yuan Ming's gaze focused as he drove his Divine Soul to fiercely crash into the Bright Soul Fire, directly burning nearly half of his soul power.
The Sea Jelly Demon Beast let out a piercing screech, its massive body trembling violently.
At this moment, shadows flickered in the nearby void of the great array, and the figures of Yun Luo Fairy, Vajra, and Hua Zhi appeared out of thin air.
Yun Luo Fairy opened her mouth, spitting out two snow-white Flying Swords, which flashed and appeared above the head of the Sea Jelly Demon Beast.
With her hands gesturing, the two Flying Swords emitted a long cry, transforming into two dozen-zhang long snow-white giant swords, slashing towards the head of the Sea Jelly Demon Beast.
The snow-white giant swords emitted circles of white light, dizzying anyone who glanced at them, causing the Sea Jelly Demon Beast to momentarily pause in its movement.
Hua Zhi twisted her figure, transforming into her vine body, with robust vines rapidly growing, in the blink of an eye, a vast forest spanning dozens of acres formed.
Large purple flowers emerged, with vast amounts of purple pollen dispersing, exuding an enchanting aroma that enveloped the Sea Jelly Demon Beast.
Large and vividly colored red flowers grew on the Sea Jelly Demon Beast's body, swiftly devouring its demonic power.
Vajra's whole body dazzled with blood light, manifesting a blood-colored giant elephant, stomping towards the Sea Jelly Demon Beast's body.
Meanwhile, Lei Yu was not idle, opening his mouth wide, spraying a massive Destruction Thunder toward the Sea Jelly Demon Beast.
Yuan Ming immediately suspended the "Shared Fate" Divine Skills when Yun Luo Fairy and others appeared.
The poison within his body had now been suppressed, and he gestured to retract the transformation of the Undying Tree, flicking his sleeve to shoot out the Soul Destroying Sword.Yo^u@r% suppo*rt# at *. k@eep^s& the s$eries goi%ng+.@
The sword flashed and appeared below the Sea Jelly Demon Beast, swirling rapidly.
Yuan Ming pushed the power of the Soul Destroying Sword to its maximum, a black Sword Shadow the size of a small mountain emerged and cut upward into the Sea Jelly Demon Beast's body.
Various attacks submerged the Sea Jelly Demon Beast, producing earth-shaking booms.
The body of the Sea Jelly Demon Beast was shattered into pieces; although not killed instantly, its demonic power and soul power both drastically diminished.
Particularly the soul power, nearly half was annihilated by a single slash from the Soul Destroying Sword.
Since the sword blade fragments were sealed into the Soul Destroying Sword, the sword's power has been continuously enhancing over the years, incomparable to before.
The Sea Jelly Demon Beast felt an immediate crisis of life and death, disregarding Yuan Ming, its body emitted a purple light, once more splitting apart, transforming into countless Sea Jelly clones attempting to break the confinement of the Eight Extremes Golden Lock Array.
"I've been waiting for this moment!" Yuan Ming sneered, quickly gesturing with both hands.
The eight-sided golden Command Flag beside him shot out, merging into the array in a flash.
Eight tall golden doors appeared around the array, the Sea Jelly Demon Beast's eyes blurred, and the scenery nearby drastically changed, no longer an endless sea but a world filled with unending chains.
Nearby, densely packed golden chains shot forth, aiming at each clone.
The Sea Jelly Demon Beast was startled, immediately scattering its clones, fleeing in different directions.
However, wherever its clones escaped, countless golden chains pursued like an omnipresent Heaven and Earth Net.
Each clone of the Sea Jelly Demon Beast was successively entangled by golden chains, swiftly captured.
Among continuous "clattering" chain dragging sounds, powerful sealing power seeped into the Sea Jelly Demon Beast's clones, quickly sealing their demonic power.
The clones fought back desperately, but with their main body severely injured, the resistance seemed futile and were rapidly fully sealed.
Before long, the split Sea Jelly Demon Beast reintegrated as one, completely bound by golden chains, motionless.
"I didn't expect the plan to go so smoothly. Fellow Daoist Yuan indeed has brilliant methods, and this array is truly formidable, capable of sealing a Level 6 Demon Beast," Yun Luo Fairy said joyfully, her bright eyes glistening.
"The Eight Extremes Golden Lock Array is operating at full power and cannot maintain for long. This demon beast's life force is extremely tenacious and has not entirely lost resistance. Do not halt your attacks, keep attacking!" Yuan Ming continued gesturing, urging the Array, speaking sternly.
Upon hearing this, Yun Luo Fairy, Hua Zhi, Vajra, and Lei Yu dared not stop and continued their relentless assaults on the Sea Jelly Demon Beast without undermining the Eight Extremes Golden Lock Array.
The Sea Jelly Demon Beast was unable to move, and its Demon Core was sealed elsewhere. Its body was soon battered with countless wounds, demonic power drastically reduced, and was finally completely defeated, gravely injured.
Yuan Ming then stopped a few people and flashed to appear in front of the sea jelly demon beast, extending a black, soul-power condensed hand, which penetrated into its body.
Moments later, the black hand returned, holding the broken demon soul of the sea jelly demon beast.
Yuan Ming took out a sealing jade bottle, collected the demon soul inside, affixed a sealing talisman, and then turned to the other side of the Eight Extremes Golden Lock Array to extract the demon core of the sea jelly demon beast and seal it as well.
Having done all this, Yuan Ming finally breathed a genuine sigh of relief.
"Did it really succeed? Are both the demon core and demon soul still functional?" Yun Luo Fairy hurriedly flew over, her face flushed as she asked.
"I just checked carefully; the demon core of the sea jelly demon beast is intact. Although the demon soul is not lightly damaged, the remaining soul power is still sufficient. There's absolutely no problem," Yuan Ming replied.
"That's great," Yun Luo Fairy patted her chest, exhaling a long breath.
"Regarding the refinement of the Dharma Manifestation Pill, I have already found an alchemist, and there is absolutely no problem with refining this pill. If Fellow Daoist Yun trusts me, please leave the alchemy matter to me," Yuan Ming said.
"Of course, I will trouble Fellow Daoist Yuan then," Yun Luo Fairy replied without hesitation, tossing a storage bag containing auxiliary materials to Yuan Ming.
After taking the storage bag, a sweep of his Divine Sense made Yuan Ming's heart move. Yun Luo Fairy had prepared two portions of auxiliary materials; was she also preparing his share?
"There is no need to worry about the refinement of the Dharma Manifestation Pill, Fellow Daoist Yun. It will certainly be completed successfully. Fellow Daoist Yun can now prepare to break through to the Dharma manifestation Stage," Yuan Ming assured, returning the favor.
With Dian Xiaosan's alchemy skills, coupled with the Yan Emperor's Ruyi Scepter and the Complete Heaven Exquisite Tripod, the probability of failing to refine the Dharma Manifestation Pill is extremely small.
"Good," Yun Luo Fairy nodded happily.
As the abyss was unsafe, Yuan Ming put away the sea jelly demon beast's body and the Eight Extremes Golden Lock Array, and then, with Yun Luo Fairy, Hua Zhi, and others, he left aboard Lei Yu.
Yuan Ming entrusted the Shura Palace to Lei Yu for safekeeping and entered the Shura Palace's Medicine Garden with Hua Zhi.
Upon stepping onto the land of the Medicine Garden, Yuan Ming could no longer endure and sat down on the ground, his face pale as he panted heavily.
"Master, are you alright?" Hua Zhi hurriedly supported Yuan Ming.
"After battling fiercely with the sea jelly demon beast, I was poisoned by its soul poison, and then, due to fighting it, my soul power was greatly depleted, requiring a period of good rest..." Yuan Ming sighed.
"Since my cultivation has significantly advanced, my detoxification divine skill has also improved, let me help Master with breathing control!" Hua Zhi sat behind Yuan Ming and began circulating demonic power into Yuan Ming's body.
Yuan Ming did not stop Hua Zhi's actions, circulating mana and soul power.
The poison in his body was not much, and most of it had already been neutralized by the Undying Tree earlier, so it was nothing to worry about; the troublesome part was the soul poison.
Yuan Ming immediately calmed his mind and used the Moonlight Technique, trying to refine the soul poison within the Divine Soul. Suddenly, he discovered that the soul poison had already significantly lightened, and the originally pitch-black Divine Soul had become gray-black.
"What's going on?" Yuan Ming was somewhat puzzled.
At this moment, a thought flashed through his mind, and he summoned the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
After being poisoned by the soul poison, he had repeatedly used his Divine Soul to touch the Bright Soul Fire. Kong had said that the Bright Soul Fire had the ability to refine impurities within the Divine Soul and purify soul power. The essence of soul poison was also soul power, could it have been refined by the Bright Soul Fire?
Thinking of this, he once again let his Divine Soul enter the Stealing Heaven Tripod, entering the space of the White Jade Lotus Platform, and touched the Bright Soul Fire.
With a soft "hissing" sound, Yuan Ming's Divine Soul was once again burned away a little; however, the soul poison within his Divine Soul was similarly reduced significantly, and the black Divine Soul became even lighter.
"Indeed, this is the case!" Yuan Ming rejoiced inwardly, unable to help but marvel at the endless wonders of the Bright Soul Fire as a Heavenly Fire.
In the following days, with the help of the Bright Soul Fire and Hua Zhi, Yuan Ming completely expelled the poison within his body.
However, the damage to his Divine Soul was not something that could recover in a short time, and Yuan Ming was not anxious about it either.
A month later, Yuan Ming and his companions arrived on an island in the Dongji Sea. This island was littered with stubborn rocks, extremely desolate, seemingly devoid of any spiritual energy.
Yun Luo performed a hand incantation, and with a "hissing" sound, the space before them split open like a curtain, and a stream of rich spiritual energy emanated from within.
"What a powerful Forbidden Space, able to isolate nature's spiritual energy to such an extent and leaves no trace itself; is this a sixth-level array?" Yuan Ming's eyes lit up.
"You flatter me, Fellow Daoist Yuan. This is a sixth-level incomplete array I acquired by chance, nothing compared to Fellow Daoist's Eight Extremes Golden Lock Array. Please, come in," Yun Luo Fairy smiled gracefully and flew into the curtain first.
Just as Yuan Ming was about to follow, Hua Zhi called out to him.
"Master, there are still matters regarding the Holy Spirit Association that need arranging. Now that the beast hunt is completed, I want to leave for some time," Hua Zhi said.
"Very well, be safe and send me a message immediately if there's any danger," Yuan Ming nodded, saying.
Hua Zhi agreed, turning into a tunneling light and heading off into the distance, disappearing over the horizon in the blink of an eye.
"Master, I won't go inside either," Vajra also said.
"Do you have matters to attend to as well?" Yuan Ming looked at Vajra.
"I have no matters, it's just that as my Body Cultivation Realm progresses, my need for the Power of the Sun increases, and nature's spiritual energy becomes rather dispensable. Staying inside the Forbidden Space doesn't benefit my cultivation, so it's more comfortable for me to stay outside," Vajra explained.

chapters.title: Chapter 867 - 838 Protection
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming listened to Vajra's words and raised an eyebrow; he himself didn't quite feel the same way.
But he soon understood. In recent years, whenever he cultivated, he would directly transform into the form of the Undying Tree, using the Undying Tree Roots to absorb nature's spiritual energy and the Power of the Sun to refine his mana and temper his physical body.
The Undying Tree Roots could penetrate the void and directly communicate with the outside world. Naturally, it didn't matter where it was located, but Vajra didn't have such conditions and would certainly be uncomfortable staying within the forbidden constraints.
"Alright, I'll agree with you." Yuan Ming nodded toward Vajra and then stepped into the "curtain" inside.
The next moment, the scenery before him changed dramatically; it was no longer the desolate island. Before his eyes was a lush and beautiful island, filled with blooming flowers and abundant spiritual energy, almost like a holy land from a fairy tale.
"Is this a space treasure?" Yuan Ming looked around and said.
Such a spirit island could absolutely not exist within the Dongji Sea, and moreover, it was under the control of Yun Luo Fairy. The only explanation was that, like the Shura Palace, this place was the interior of a space treasure.
"Hehe, Fellow Daoist Yuan has a keen eye. This is a space treasure I fortuitously acquired many years ago, named the Flowers Map. Since everyone has worked hard to hunt a Level 6 demon beast for me, please rest here; it is absolutely safe." Yun Luo Fairy said with a gentle smile.
"Flowers Map..." Hearing this, Yuan Ming suddenly recalled something.
Earlier, when he was preparing to hunt a Level 6 demon beast, Yun Luo Fairy unexpectedly ventured to Flowers Island in the Dongji Sea, despite the dangers, saying she was attending some Ten Thousand Flowers Festival.
Flowers Map, Flowers Island, Ten Thousand Flowers Festival — the names have quite a few similarities. Such coincidences, could there be some connection among them?
"I will first go into retreat to consolidate my cultivation level, making my final preparations to enter the Dharma manifestation Stage. Fellow Daoist Yuan, you may move freely here without any concerns. When the Dharma Manifestation Pill is complete, please lend me a helping hand," Yun Luo Fairy said to Yuan Ming.
"Once the pill is complete, I will hand it over to you at the first opportunity," Yuan Ming nodded in response.
Seeing that her friendly gesture had been accepted by Yuan Ming, Yun Luo Fairy had nothing more to say and departed with a smile.
Yuan Ming watched her leave and then looked around, discovering that the spiritual energy in this place was extremely dense, even more so than in the Medicine Garden of the Shura Palace.
Apart from the dense spiritual energy of nature, the air was filled with a rich floral fragrance.
Yuan Ming wasn't particularly a flower lover and didn't especially like floral scents, particularly ones as strong as this. However, the fragrance here was ethereal and elegant, not at all overwhelming, and instead helped to calm his mind.
"This Yun Luo Fairy indeed harbors quite a few secrets," he thought to himself, but didn't wander around the island. Instead, he found a spot to summon the Shura Palace and entered it.
Inside the black hall of the Extreme Fire Realm in the Shura Palace, Dian Xiaosan was sitting cross-legged, staring fixedly at the Complete Heaven Exquisite Tripod, with twelve Earth Fires under his control, a look of fascination on his face.
"Master Dian, how is the Complete Heaven Exquisite Tripod?" Yuan Ming asked with a gentle smile.
"The Complete Heaven Exquisite Tripod from the Pill King Pavilion is indeed a top-grade Alchemy Furnace, better than my Qingxuan Creation Cauldron. Are you truly willing to let me use it?" Dian Xiaosan hurriedly stood up upon seeing Yuan Ming.
The more advanced an alchemist, the more particular they become about the Alchemy Furnace they use. Dian Xiaosan was a sixth-level alchemist; his furnace was only a Seven-Orifice Pill Furnace, with just two Earth Fires and the rest Human Fires.
In recent years, Dian Xiaosan had followed the directives of the Dongji Palace, mainly because backing the Dongji Palace made it easier for him to obtain a variety of alchemical resources. More importantly, there was an Earth Fire within the Dongji Palace that he wished to acquire to upgrade his furnace to an Eight-Aperture Pill Furnace.
Now, a furnace with twelve Earth Fires appeared before him. How could Dian Xiaosan not be excited?
"A treasure sword for a hero. Master Dian's alchemy skills far surpass mine. Naturally, this furnace should be given to you to use, to maximize its potential," Yuan Ming said with a smile.
"Good, good, good..." Dian Xiaosan was so moved that he repeated "good" three times.
"Not just this Complete Heaven Exquisite Tripod. This Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter, which possesses flame-controlling divine skills, is also yours to use from today onward," Yuan Ming said, handing the Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter to Dian Xiaosan.
Knowing its effects from Yuan Ming, Dian Xiaosan received the scepter with trembling hands.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, you have bestowed such heavy treasures one after another. Is there something you need me to do?" he quickly calmed down and asked.
"There's no major matter; I was just hoping you could help refine a Dharma Manifestation Pill," Yuan Ming said coolly.
"A Dharma Manifestation Pill! Have you already prepared the materials?" Dian Xiaosan exclaimed.
To support our work, please read on *.
"Naturally. The materials for refining a Dharma Manifestation Pill are scarce. The most important sixth-level demon core and demon soul, I only have one set, and failure is not an option. I'll need to trouble Master Dian for this alchemy task," Yuan Ming said.
"Of course!" Dian Xiaosan immediately nodded.
The Pill King Pavilion and Qingxuan Platform are both the leaders of the Alchemy Dao in Central Continent. As a disciple of Qingxuan Platform, Dian Xiaosan naturally knew about the signature elixir of the Pill King Pavilion — the Dharma Manifestation Pill. Being able to see the Dharma Manifestation Pill recipe and personally refine such a precious elixir is an opportunity no alchemist would refuse.
"Although the Dharma Manifestation Pill is only fifth-grade, its refinement difficulty is no less than ordinary sixth-grade elixirs. The hardest part is refining the sixth-level demon beast's core and soul. What type of demon core did you prepare, Fellow Daoist? I need to make some preparations," Dian Xiaosan said after his initial excitement.
He might not have known the Dharma Manifestation Pill recipe, but he had refined many similar elixirs, and he identified the most challenging aspect of its refinement at a glance.
"It's the Sea Scale Stinging Demon. Don't worry, Master Dian. I know the difficulty of refining the demon core and soul, so I have already prepared accordingly," Yuan Ming said, with a wave of his sleeve.
In the great hall, a flash of white light revealed a purple jellyfish, towering nearly ten feet high, appearing out of thin air, motionless.
"Could this be the Sea Scale Stinging Demon you have slain?" Dian Xiaosan asked, evidently not very familiar with the Sea Scale Stinging Demon either.
"Indeed, it is transformed from its clone. Having this for research may certainly assist Master Dian in refining the Dharma Manifestation Pill." Yuan Ming said.
"It will surely be helpful, thank you, Fellow Daoist Yuan." Dian Xiaosan expressed gratitude.
"That's good, I leave the matter of alchemy to Master Dian." Yuan Ming took out the Dharma Manifestation Pill recipe and the refining materials all at once, then turned and left the great hall.
As soon as Yuan Ming's figure disappeared, Dian Xiaosan revealed his true colors, hugging the Dharma Manifestation Pill recipe, alchemy materials, and Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter, unable to keep his mouth from laughing widely.
These treasures, which he never dared to dream of in past days, were now delivered one after the other.
Recalling the hundred-year agreement with Yuan Ming, Dian Xiaosan suddenly felt that this time was a bit too short.
Moreover, if he leaves here, whether it's the Complete Heaven Exquisite Tripod or Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter, Yuan Ming would certainly take them back.
At this thought, Dian Xiaosan felt an inexplicable pain in his heart.
"Damn Yuan Ming, he probably calculated my thoughts, deliberately giving me these things." Dian Xiaosan muttered resentfully, rubbing his chest.
Although he saw through Yuan Ming's intentions, the bait was indeed too tempting for him to resist.
After a moment of silence, Dian Xiaosan shook his head to dismiss miscellaneous thoughts, took the Dharma Manifestation Pill recipe, and began to study it carefully.
Outside the black great hall, Yuan Ming stood in the void, a hint of a smile on his lips, and turned away.
...
A month later, outside a secret chamber atop a mountain peak in the central island of the Flowers Map space.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan, I must trouble you to guard my path." Yun Luo Fairy accepted the white jade porcelain bottle Yuan Ming handed over, expressing her gratitude softly.
Although she was in a partnership with Yuan Ming, the various experiences since they met gradually made her realize that Yuan Ming was different from all the people she had encountered in the past.
He neither coveted her beauty nor desired the benefits she offered. The foundation of their relationship was merely mutual benefit, a win-win situation, fair trade for all.
It's as if this person would not be affected by emotions or sentiments, always able to make the correct judgment calmly.
Undoubtedly the most reliable partner.
However, thinking about this, Yun Luo Fairy couldn't help but feel a bit resentful.
If at first she showed admiration for Yuan Ming with a clear purpose of use, then from the moment Yuan Ming saved her from the Su Nu Sect, she truly developed a bit of undefined affection towards him.
Unfortunately, whether it was the previous fake intentions or the current genuine feelings, they seemed invisible to Yuan Ming, like a mud cow entering the sea without stirring any waves.
"Fellow Daoist Yun Luo, rest assured to meditate in seclusion. I will personally guard your retreat." Yuan Ming assured with focused eyes.
"Thank you." Yun Luo Fairy expressed gratitude, turning to enter the inner chamber of the secret room.
This secret chamber was newly established by Yuan Ming, divided into two zones, with Yun Luo Fairy meditating in the inner chamber and Yuan Ming guarding in the outer chamber.
Yun Luo Fairy arrived in the inner room, placing spirit stones around the already prepared array.
Afterward, she sat on the cushion at the center of the array, waving her hand to take out six or seven white jade porcelain bottles and a purple sandalwood box, placing them in front.
Inside the white jade porcelain bottles were elixirs to aid cultivation, and within that purple sandalwood box was a Dharma Manifestation Pill.
Yun Luo Fairy's cultivation had reached the peak of Returning to Void Late Stage, only a step away from breaking through that barrier.
Of course, this step could be said to be easy yet difficult; some might never cross it throughout their life, remaining in Returning to Void Late Stage.
For most low-level cultivators, Returning Void was already an insurmountable existence.
Yun Luo Fairy burned incense and sat calmly for two hours, regulated her breathing, and then took out a white jade porcelain bottle from her bosom, took out a golden-yellow elixir pill, and swallowed it, immediately starting to operate her mana, cultivating the Sutra of the Pure Woman.
A thin layer of mist rose around her body, her robes automatically slipping off, revealing a flawless body as white as mutton-fat jade, her hands formed a lotus treasure seal, and murmuring chants arose from her mouth.
When the sound arose, the surrounding mist slowly flowed, amidst the mist as if immortal cranes were flying, spiritual deer were jumping, immortal flowers were blooming, and a goddess was roaming.
For a time, within the inner chamber, the scene was grand and magnificent.

chapters.title: Chapter 868 - 839: Insights into Breakthrough
chapters.content:
While Yun Luo Fairy was concentrating on her retreat, striving to break through her bottleneck, a different scene was unfolding in the outer chamber.
Yuan Ming had also opened the forbidden array outside the secret chamber and sat cross-legged on a mat in the center of the outer chamber.
He first closed his eyes, focused on breathing control to adjust his state to the best condition, then immediately swallowed two bottles of elixirs to assist in cultivation, operating the "Primordial True Skill" to crazily absorb nature's spiritual energy.
In his uniquely structured Dantian, a Mixed Hole Vortex slowly rotated, like a bottomless pit continuously absorbing the surging nature's spiritual energy and the elixir's spiritual power.
Over the past few years, under the dual effects of numerous elixirs and the "Primordial True Skill," Yuan Ming's cultivation had not fallen behind and had indeed advanced greatly.
However, as his cultivation improved, the side effects of the "Primordial True Skill" also became increasingly severe.
Advancing to the Dharma manifestation Stage, the most notable trait is the fusion of a cultivator's divine soul and mana, inducing a synergy with the surrounding nature's spiritual energy, together forming a massive external dharma form.
The external dharma form isn't necessarily stronger when larger, but typically, a massive dharma form isn't weak, and its terrifying pressure alone can force most low-level cultivators to their knees before it.
Once the dharma form attacks, its power and range greatly surpass the cultivator's own, capable of smashing mountains with a punch, shattering islands with a palm, even shifting mountains and filling seas with ease.
However, to advance to the Dharma manifestation Stage and condense a formidable external dharma form, the most challenging part is having the divine soul descend into the Dantian and merge with one's own mana. Only after this step is completed can it manifest externally, manipulating the nature's spiritual energy to form.
In this case, the stronger the divine soul and the purer the mana, the easier it is to succeed.
As a mid-stage Word Witch soul cultivator, Yuan Ming's divine soul was undoubtedly strong, yet due to cultivating the Mixed Hole Secret Technique, his Dantian had formed a Mixed Hole Vortex that devoured nature's spiritual energy.
This caused his mana to become exceedingly chaotic and disorderly, and even with his strong divine soul, descending into the Dantian risked being engulfed by the vortex—a huge risk indeed.
Yuan Ming secretly smiled bitterly; with his current cultivation speed, reaching the Peak of Returning to Void Late Stage wasn't difficult, but with such severe mana turbulence, attempting the breakthrough to the Dharma manifestation Stage required far more preparation.
...
Soon, seven days had passed.
The originally calm inner chamber of the secret room suddenly experienced a violent vibration, a strong wave of divine soul energy erupted, followed closely by an intense fluctuation of mana.
Yuan Ming, who was sitting quietly in the outer chamber, slowly opened his eyes, revealing a trace of joy on his face: "It has begun..."
Having said that, he immediately took out the Stealing Heaven Tripod, lit a stick of black incense, and placed it within.
This wasn't the original version of Possession Black Incense, but a replica crafted by Yuan Ming, which could only descend into the host's body without controlling the host's actions.
As wisps of smoke rose gently upward, Yuan Ming's consciousness gradually sank, and soon he awoke inside the inner chamber.
Help us out by reading on *.
At this moment, he had already descended his divine soul into Yun Luo Fairy's body.
The additional insurance he sought was to descend into her body, to observe and comprehend the process of Yun Luo Fairy attempting the breakthrough to the Dharma manifestation Stage, a precious experience regardless of her success.
Yuan Ming saw through Yun Luo Fairy's eyes, observing a pair of delicate hands lifting a Purple Sandalwood Box.
It was then he realized Yun Luo Fairy was completely unclothed, her jade-like body fully exposed, which greatly embarrassed him. He quickly focused his thoughts on the Purple Sandalwood Box.
This was not because Yuan Ming was so righteous, but because this rare opportunity to comprehend the Dharma manifestation Stage's breakthrough was too vital to be distracted.
Yun Luo Fairy then opened the Purple Sandalwood Box, taking out the Dharma Manifestation Pill, and, after gazing at it for a moment, solemnly swallowed it.
Yuan Ming could feel Yun Luo Fairy's heart beating "bang bang," clearly showing her own tension.
As the Dharma Manifestation Pill was swallowed, its medicinal power quickly dispersed, but it didn't scatter to be absorbed by the Dantian like other elixirs, instead forming a cloud-like entity hovering within the Dantian.
Yuan Ming immediately sensed that the mana within Yun Luo Fairy's Dantian was being drawn towards this liquid cloud.
However, once the mana converged, it wasn't absorbed by the liquid, nor did the two merge; they were in a state of mutual attraction yet not combining.
Yuan Ming's mind moved, realizing that it was waiting for Yun Luo Fairy's divine soul.
Yun Luo Fairy, naturally aware, after a brief breathing control, descended her divine soul from the Sea of Consciousness, sending it toward the Dantian.
At the moment her divine soul entered the Dantian, it was drawn toward the liquid just like the mana; however, there was a difference in that her divine soul didn't attach externally but plunged directly into the liquid.
In an instant, the mist-like potion rapidly contracted and directly merged into Yun Luo Fairy's Divine Soul.
Yuan Ming's Divine Thought was connected with it, and he immediately sensed that as Yun Luo Fairy's Divine Soul merged with the potion, it began to rapidly absorb the Mana from her Dantian.
The initially separate three entities finally, at this moment, experienced a marvelous fusion.
Perhaps due to the effect of the Dharma Manifestation Pill, the fusion of the Divine Soul and Mana was exceptionally smooth. Originally existing only in spirit, without form, the Divine Soul began to manifest into a real shape, astonishingly formed from condensed Mana.
Meanwhile, the Nascent Soul quietly seated in the Dantian seemed to sense something and moved closer to the manifesting Divine Soul figure.
"Could it be that to advance to the Dharma manifestation stage, one must also fuse with the Nascent Soul?" Yuan Ming harbored a moment of doubt in his heart.
This evidently conflicted with what he previously knew.
But since he was not the one attempting to break through the bottleneck, he didn't dwell on it. After all, thinking wouldn't be of any use; he simply watched how Yun Luo Fairy would respond.
Regardless, such an immersive experience of comprehension was extremely valuable.
At this moment, the Nascent Soul of Yun Luo Fairy approached and extended its two little hands, pressing on the nascent Dharma manifestation, seemingly infusing its power into it.
Subsequently, Yuan Ming saw the shape of the "Dharma manifestation" in the Dantian rapidly condense, gradually forming the figure of a graceful woman clad in long, wide-sleeved robes, her form nearly perfect, though her facial features remained somewhat indistinct.
Her figure towered significantly over the Nascent Soul, the size difference akin to that between an adult and a child.
As the woman's form fully consolidated, a subtle sound echoed from Yun Luo Fairy's Dantian, immediately causing the Mana within to autonomously circulate, absorbing the surrounding nature's spiritual energy.
In an instant, countless threads of nature's spiritual energy surged in from all directions, converging upon Yun Luo Fairy, forming a spiritual energy vortex visible to the naked eye above her, swirling gently yet unceasingly.
The entire chamber was immediately filled with surging spiritual energy, mist rising.
At that moment, the array set beneath Yun Luo Fairy suddenly lit up, revealing a circular light array, densely covered with runes on its surface, all intercepting the gathered vortex of nature's spiritual energy above.
To say it intercepted it isn't quite accurate, as the nature's spiritual energy was not entirely blocked but filtered through a mesh, allowing only the purer energies to pass through.
Once filtered, the nature's spiritual energy became much more refined and, after being refined through the body's meridians, entered the Dantian.
As the threads of nature's spiritual energy were refined into Mana and absorbed by the Dantian, the Dharma manifestation of the woman in wide sleeves rapidly expanded, quickly filling the entire Dantian.
Before long, it continued to swell, manifesting externally as a Dharma manifestation phantom equal in height to Yun Luo Fairy's true form, though one was seated and the other standing.
At that moment, Yuan Ming suddenly sensed a wave of pain from Yun Luo Fairy's Divine Soul and quickly focused his mind to investigate, only to be surprised to find the "Dharma manifestation" manifesting externally was covered with cracks resembling a porcelain glaze.
"This is the hidden danger of impure Mana, isn't it? The Divine Soul cannot perfectly merge with the Mana, thus cannot fully control it. Wouldn't it burst this way?" Yuan Ming pondered.
As he was considering how to handle this, he suddenly saw that the previously used potion to merge the Divine Soul and Mana rapidly vaporized, transforming into a layer of white mist, enveloping the entire "Dharma manifestation" like a thin gauze.
"No wonder the Dharma Manifestation Pill can greatly increase the breakthrough probability; it indeed has such marvelous use," Yuan Ming thought with delight.
However, relying solely on the Dharma Manifestation Pill's effects was insufficient to help Yun Luo Fairy completely avert the crisis, for otherwise, the pill wouldn't just increase the breakthrough probability but would guarantee that Returning to Void Cultivators advance to the Dharma manifestation stage.
As the Nascent Soul's power continued to infuse, the obscure face of the Dharma manifestation began to emit a water-blue glow, layers of water-like ripples undulating over its surface, while the figure's lines became animated and alive.
At the same time, the face of the Dharma manifestation gradually revealed itself within the misty vapor, bearing a seven-tenths resemblance to Yun Luo Fairy, yet even more beautiful, more noble, more ethereal.
"Luoshui Goddess..." Yuan Ming couldn't help but silently praise in his heart.
Once the Dharma manifestation of Luoshui Goddess fully formed, a sound of something shattering abruptly emanated from within Yun Luo Fairy's body. In the next moment, a spiritual energy vortex manifested in her Dantian, luminous and revolving.
The surrounding spiritual energy rushed into her like tides, simultaneously condensing upon her Dharma manifestation.
Yun Luo Fairy's aura surged, the water-blue dress of her Dharma manifestation deepening in hue, spreading a vast mist of water, enveloping the entire chamber.
"Success!" Yuan Ming inwardly exclaimed.
