He understood from Yun Luo Fairy's success in breaking through—a valuable experience that would undoubtedly greatly assist him in his own future attempts, significantly boosting his chances of advancing to the Dharma manifestation stage.
At this time, he suddenly noticed that the Nascent Soul figure in Yun Luo Fairy's Dantian was also continuously absorbing the inundating Mana from outside, growing bit by bit, seemingly on the verge of transforming into an adult form.

chapters.title: Chapter 869 - 840 Dao Seal
chapters.content:
Before Yuan Ming could see clearly, a more surprising scene unfolded.
Threads of mysterious spirit light descended from the sky, merging into Yun Luo Fairy's body.
She, as if called by some invisible force, began to form seals with her hands, casting various Divine Skills of hers. Although she did not move, the Dharma manifestation enveloping her silently stood outside her, the fluctuations emanating from it clearly grew significantly.
The power of the various Magical Powers she had previously demonstrated was noticeably enhanced.
Simultaneously, three clusters of Mana suddenly condensed outside her and, after entering the Dantian, surged straight toward her Nascent Soul.
Yuan Ming could hardly see clearly, but only sensed three familiar forces on those three clusters of Mana. The three differently colored light clusters had already landed on Yun Luo Fairy's Nascent Soul and disappeared momentarily.
Then, light emerged from Yun Luo Fairy's Nascent Soul forming three runes of different shapes.
After the runes formed, the power they emitted burst forth. Yuan Ming's Divine Thought swept over them, instantly understanding that the three runes represented Yun Luo Fairy's three most proficient Divine Skills.
Among them, the first was her Illusion Technique Divine Rune, the second her Divine Movement skill, and the third her Sealing skill.
These three Great Divine Powers had clearly made considerable progress since she advanced to the Dharma manifestation Stage.
Yuan Ming immediately followed Yun Luo Fairy's own thoughts and started to comprehend the uses of these three Divine Skill runes.
As time passed, the time of possession finally ended, and while Yun Luo Fairy continued her closed cultivation to stabilize her realm, Yuan Ming's Divine Soul returned to his own body.
Outside the chamber, Yuan Ming's eyes suddenly opened, the excitement and joy in his eyes were barely concealable.
He immediately waved his hand to put away the Stealing Heaven Tripod, formed seals with his hands in front of his body, and sat quietly in meditation, beginning to observe the Illusion Technique Divine Rune of Yun Luo Fairy in his mind.
As that rune gradually formed and took shape in his Sea of Consciousness, Yuan Ming's Divine Soul Power, as if drawn by some invisible force, began to operate on its own, exhibiting the Dream Butterfly Illusion Technique.
Around Yuan Ming, illusory shadows appeared, sometimes forming pavilions and towers, sometimes collapsing into vast flowing sands, sometimes the desert turning into a boundless sea, and at times the sea transforming into a sea of fiery lava...
The surrounding scenery continuously changed, with Yuan Ming sitting alone in the midst of it, seemingly unaffected and unmoving.
His Divine Sense kept gaining insights from the experience gleaned from Yun Luo Fairy, continually deconstructing the Illusion Technique Divine Rune, and his understanding of Illusion Techniques improved significantly in the process.
Time flew by, and seven days passed.
Yun Luo Fairy had not yet awakened from her closed cultivation, but outside the chamber, Yuan Ming suddenly opened his eyes, and a boundless illusory peach blossom burned into raging flames, until everything turned into ashes.
As the flames burned out, the chamber returned to normal, yet a brilliant butterfly illusion appeared in Yuan Ming's eyes.
In his haze, he saw the brilliant, multicolored butterfly fly out from his eyes, with wings shimmering with specks of glow, flying towards his abdomen.
When Yuan Ming reached out to catch it, the multicolored butterfly turned into an illusion, passing through his palm and directly entering his Dantian, instantly forming a butterfly-shaped mark.
"Dream Butterfly Rune..." Yuan Ming's eyes flashed with a hint of excitement.
The appearance of this Dream Butterfly Rune signified that his Illusion Technique had reached new heights, and his Dream Butterfly Illusion Technique had attained an unprecedented Perfect Realm, Void Silence.
From now on, as long as the enemies' Divine Soul was not strong enough, once they entered the space created by Yuan Ming's Dream Butterfly Illusion Technique, Yuan Ming could control their life and death within that space, annihilating their Divine Soul.
Suppressing the excitement in his heart, Yuan Ming carefully felt the Dream Butterfly Rune, feeling not only joy but also confusion.For character sheets and glossaries, visit *.
Yun Luo Fairy's three runes had merged into her Nascent Soul, yet his Dream Butterfly Rune had merely entered his Dantian, without merging into his Nascent Soul.
However, Yuan Ming did not think much of it, assuming it was related to his Cultivation Realm, which had not yet reached the Dharma manifestation Stage.
As he circulated his Mana, the Dream Butterfly Rune in his Dantian lit up, and there was an intangible spiritual power fluctuation emanating, spreading outwards.
The illusion that had just vanished reappeared at once.
Yet at this moment, the All Living Beings Dream Rune, which Yuan Ming had not activated, unexpectedly resonated spontaneously with the Dream Butterfly Rune.
Yuan Ming immediately took out the Night Parade of Hundred Demons, and before he could unfurl the scroll, the All Living Beings Dream Rune flew out on its own, also diving straight into his Dantian.
Inside his Dantian, the two runes seemed to be drawn together by some force, quickly approaching each other, maintaining a certain distance, floating and rotating not too far nor too close.
Though Yuan Ming had always borrowed the power of the All Living Beings Dream Rune to battle, he actually did not understand it well.
With the fortuitous encounter today, the All Living Beings Dream Rune entered his Dantian, establishing a completely different connection with him.
Yuan Ming circulated Mana and Soul Power to refine the All Living Beings Dream Rune and soon fully mastered it, truly understanding the Divine Skills of this rune.
As for the All Living Beings' Dream, it is as if creating a dream for all beings, a daydream, a dream of a thousand years!
The All Living Beings Dream Rune creates an illusory world similar to a dreamland, essentially somewhat akin to the Dream Butterfly Illusion Technique.

chapters.title: Chapter 870 - 840 Dao Seal_2
chapters.content:
However, this dream illusion technique has reached the pinnacle of control over the illusion's time. One instant outside equates to ten or a hundred years inside.
Yuan Ming nodded to himself; this All Living Beings Dream Rune is extraordinary and, if used properly, can have miraculous effects.
Yuan Ming focused his thoughts and took out the Stealing Heaven Tripod, calling out with his Divine Thought: "Senior Kong, are you there?"
There was no fluctuation from the Stealing Heaven Tripod, nor did anyone respond.
Having called several times with no feedback, Yuan Ming had no choice but to give up.
With no other option, Yuan Ming could only ask Qi Ye: "Fellow Daoist Qi Ye, do you know what the rune in the Dantian is?"
"The rune in the Dantian? I've never heard of it. How did it come about?" Qi Ye quickly responded.
Apparently, he was also very interested in this.
Yuan Ming thought for a moment and then briefly explained to Qi Ye how Yun Luo Fairy, upon breaking through to the Dharma manifestation Stage, condensed three types of Divine Skills into runes and integrated them into the Nascent Soul.
After hearing this, Qi Ye could only shake his head and sigh: "Fellow Daoist Yuan, in my previous life, I was only a cultivator in the Returning Void Realm, unable to witness the splendor of the Dharma manifestation Stage. What you describe likely can only be understood by Dharma Phase Cultivators."
Yuan Ming was somewhat disappointed after hearing this but not surprised.
Then he tried to comprehend the other two runes of Yun Luo Fairy but, not being adept in Divine Movement and Sealing, achieved little. Moreover, he was preoccupied with the matter of the Dantian rune, so he soon gave up.
Seeing that Yun Luo Fairy wouldn't emerge anytime soon, Yuan Ming took out a stick of Black Incense, ignited it, and possessed Guoguo.
Xi Ying was in a meeting with several people dressed in Sky Eagle Chamber of Commerce deacon robes when Guoguo rushed in and jumped onto her lap, meeting her eyes with a glance.
Xi Ying's gaze flickered, and amidst the deacons' puzzled looks, she ended the meeting.
After everyone left, Xi Ying waved her hand, activating the Forbidden Array within and outside the room, then placed Guoguo on the table in front of her.
They shared their recent situations with each other. Xi Ying was still in Xuejing Country and had refined several precious elixirs from the Pill King Secret Manual, selling them under a new identity.
By relying on these elixirs, the Sky Eagle Chamber of Commerce rapidly expanded its business in Xuejing Country.
Xi Ying was credited with offering the Dan Recipe, now overseeing all business in Xuejing Country, thus remaining there.
Yuan Ming also recounted his situation, particularly focusing on the two Divine Skill runes.
After listening, Xi Ying looked surprised.
"The All Living Beings Dream Rune and Dream Butterfly Rune have entered the Dantian... Such a situation shouldn't occur for you, especially since you haven't reached the Dharma manifestation Stage..." Xi Ying said, puzzled.
The c#an^on+ica%l sou#r#c-e# for this cont@e#n+t:^ M&|V|L2&EM*PY@R@.@
"Do you know what these runes are?" Yuan Ming asked with some delight.
"Yes, the true name for such runes is 'Dao Seal'. Typically, a high-level Divine Skill or magic, whether self-awakened or learned through practice, can communicate with the power of Dao if cultivated to the Perfect Realm. Once infused with the aura of the Dao, it can condense into a Dao Seal." Xi Ying nodded and explained.
Yuan Ming recalled that his Dream Butterfly Rune indeed formed after comprehending Yun Luo Fairy's Illusion Technique Divine Rune and achieving the Perfect Realm.
"Moreover, when a cultivator undergoes a major breakthrough and communicates with the power of the Dao, there's a certain chance to condense a Dao Seal." Xi Ying continued.
"What constitutes a major breakthrough?" Yuan Ming quickly asked.
"Such as a Magic Practitioner breaking through the Dharma manifestation Stage, a Soul Cultivator advancing to the Life Witch Realm, a Body Cultivator reaching the Undying Body; these all shatter the earthly constraints to some extent, reaching a level capable of communicating with the power of Dao. Even if the divine skill hasn't reached perfection, as long as it's close, there's a chance to condense a Dao Seal." Xi Ying explained as she glanced into Guoguo's eyes.
Yuan Ming nodded; the three Dao Seals condensed by Yun Luo Fairy belonged to this category.
"I can feel that this Dao Seal contains a special aura, and the power of the magic has significantly increased from before." He said.
"Naturally, the Dao Seal contains the essence of the Dao, and its power is incomparable to the past." Xi Ying explained.
"I see. But Shura Master mentioned that the All Living Beings Dream Rune originates from the Abyss and wasn't condensed by himself. Could it be that a cultivator's Dao Seal can be passed on posthumously?" Yuan Ming asked.
"Such situations are rare. Generally, after a cultivator's demise, their Dao Seal dissipates. However, under certain special external influences, a Dao Seal might persist beyond the owner's death." Xi Ying replied.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming recalled that Shura Master obtained the All Living Beings Dream Rune amidst the Abyss Yin Qi Ghost Fog.
The All Living Beings Dream Seal, sharing its origin with the Yin Qi Ghost Fog, must have leveraged the Yin Power of the ghost fog to survive.
"Dao Seals contain the power of the Dao; the more condensed, the more beneficial they are to the cultivator. Especially for Magic Practitioners, the more Dao Seals they form in the Dharma Phase, the stronger their combat power. The Sky Eagle Chamber of Commerce has a Dharma Phase Tributor from the Heavenly Saint Academy who has condensed nine Dao Seals. Although his cultivation is only at the early-stage Dharma manifestation, he can rival ordinary mid-stage Dharma manifestation opponents." Xi Ying stated seriously.
Yuan Ming felt a surge of delight upon hearing this; there was indeed such a concept.
All these years, he'd been using the Stealing Heaven Tripod to enhance his mastery of various Divine Skills, without realizing how fortuitous it was.
"The role of the Dao Seal is not only to boost combat ability. From the information I've reviewed recently, the more Dao Seals condensed, the more it aids in advancing to the Mahayana Realm." Xi Ying continued.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming was stunned.
Mahayana cultivators are the pinnacle existence in the Cultivation World, with fewer than five in the entire Chuyun Realm, and each is a pillar supporting the realm.
Reaching this realm means being a prodigy with great fortune, possibly appearing once in countless years.
To think that the elusive Mahayana Realm could be related to Dao Seals?
"Could you elaborate further?" Yuan Ming promptly requested.
"I saw related records in the Sky Eagle Chamber of Commerce's Wanjuan Pavilion Classics. To breakthrough to the Mahayana Realm, one must comprehend the Dao, and these Dao Seals present the best opportunity for a cultivator to do so." Xi Ying recalled, explaining.
"So, the more Dao Seals, the higher the chances of advancing to the Mahayana Realm?" Yuan Ming pondered slightly and said.
"Indeed, since you have the Stealing Heaven Tripod in hand, which allows you to quickly enhance your Divine Skills by possessing others, this is a great fortune. I hope you can condense as many Dao Seals as possible, preferably before breaking through the Dharma manifestation Stage." Xi Ying nodded and advised.
"Why is that?" Yuan Ming was slightly puzzled.
"Every breakthrough after the Dharma manifestation Stage will involve the descent of the power of Dao. Your Dao Seals can absorb more of the Dao's aura, becoming stronger, which will benefit your understanding and comprehension." Xi Ying explained.
"I see, I understand now. Xi Ying, how is your progress in training your Divine Skills? Have you condensed any Dao Seals?" Yuan Ming asked upon hearing this.

chapters.title: Chapter 871 - 841: Matters of Greater Concern
chapters.content:
"I have now perfected the Six Jia Qimen Divine Ability and recently have been diligently practicing the Circular Light Technique. The intricacy of this spell far exceeds my expectations, especially in tracking and targeting, where it is remarkably effective." Xi Ying said, though she didn't mention whether she had condensed the Dao Seal.
"When do you usually practice the Six Jia Qimen and Circular Light Technique?" Yuan Ming did not continue to inquire further but instead asked.
"Do you want to use the Stealing Heaven Tripod to possess and learn these two divine skills?" Xi Ying raised her eyebrows.
"It's because your talent surpasses mine, Xi Ying, that if I were to study them myself, who knows when I could reach mastery. To catch up with you is even more inconceivable." Yuan Ming smiled.
Listening to Yuan Ming's compliments, Xi Ying snorted lightly and said, "If you want to gain insight from my practice experience, it's possible, but you have to help me get a set of powerful defensive Sixth-level Array from Su Yingxue."
"Need a Sixth-level Defense Array, is there some trouble on your end?" Yuan Ming asked immediately upon hearing this.
"No trouble, with the Sky Eagle Chamber of Commerce as my backing, what danger could there be? Just wish to have another card up my sleeve." Xi Ying said indifferently.
"Alright, I'll find a way." Yuan Ming examined Xi Ying for a moment before replying.
"I usually practice at 9 p.m., and stop after 12:45 a.m." Xi Ying thought for a moment then said.
Yuan Ming memorized this timing carefully, then asked, "How long will you stay in Xuejing Country? What about the matter of Heavenly Fire in the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range you mentioned earlier, how is that situation now?"
Although Wulu was in the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range, he was alone, roaming freely, holding information that paled compared to the Sky Eagle Chamber of Commerce's.
"According to the information gathered by the Sky Eagle Chamber of Commerce, the Heavenly Fire has yet to appear, but the number of people gathering at the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range is increasing. How, do you also want to pursue the Heavenly Fire?" Xi Ying asked.
"The Heavenly Fire opportunity is incredibly precious, how could I dare to have such ambitions? I'm merely curious." Yuan Ming shook his head.
"The area of the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range is vast, finding an opportunity there might take decades or centuries without guarantee. If you're interested in the Heavenly Fire, come over, you'll certainly have time." Xi Ying laughed lightly, obviously not buying Yuan Ming's words.
"Let's discuss it once you handle affairs in Xuejing Country and head to the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range." Yuan Ming no longer concealed his intentions, though he hadn't yet hunted the second Level 6 Demon Beast, currently having no plans to leave Dongji Sea.
"You're intending to hunt the second Level 6 Demon Beast in the Abyss? There are more Level 6 Demon Beasts in the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range, why risk the Abyss?" Xi Ying said.
"The Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range is tremendously complex, countless demon beasts, cultivators everywhere. With my current strength, I can't directly contend with Level 6 Demon Beasts there; hunting beasts in the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range is actually more risky than here in the Abyss." Yuan Ming shook his head.
Hearing this, Xi Ying did not speak further.
"By the way, I've obtained the recipe for the Dharma Manifestation Pill, you'll likely be using it soon." Yuan Ming shared the Dharma Manifestation Pill recipe.
Xi Ying's gaze flickered but she remained silent.
Afterwards, they chatted about some trivial matters, and Yuan Ming's consciousness returned.
After a brief contemplation, he continued guarding the pass for Yun Luo Fairy.
...
Seven days later, in the Demon World, Land of Nothingness, within a tidy cell.
Su Yingxue dressed in white, was seated at the desk, penning down her insights on formations on white paper, when suddenly her vision blurred, and her consciousness uncontrollably sank.
In a blink, her pupils gleamed with a strange light, and her gaze had quietly transformed.
Yuan Ming's consciousness had entered her body, taking control of her physical faculties.
Upon successful possession, Yuan Ming immediately began searching the desk, quickly locating the blue notebook used for communication, buried beneath a thick pile of books.
The request for a Sixth-level Array from Xi Ying might be difficult for others, but for Yuan Ming, it was simple to achieve.
Su Yingxue had previously asked him to investigate the Space Transmission Array of the Nihility Prison, offering in return to assist him in advancing to a Level 6 Array Master, which he planned to accept.
Once advancing to a Level 6 Array Master, designing a Sixth-level Defense Array wouldn't be challenging.
Yuan Ming pulled out the notebook but paused upon hearing heavy footsteps outside the cell, swiftly placing the notebook back.
The footsteps stopped outside the prison, belonging to a burly young man with red hair, one eye, and a fierce, wolf-like demeanor.
Yuan Ming was slightly startled. Though unfamiliar with this man, he couldn't mistake such distinctive features; this was Li Zheng, one of the Six Prison Wardens.
Waiting for a moment and seeing no one speaking, Yuan Ming had no choice but to rise, maintaining a composed demeanor, and looked towards him.
"Is there something you need, Warden Li Zheng?" He asked with calm composure.
Li Zheng scrutinized her for a moment, seemingly probing something.
"Nothing's the matter, continue with your affairs, don't mind me." Li Zheng coldly replied.
After speaking, he didn't leave immediately, instead lingering outside the prison, staring intently.
Yuan Ming, seeing this, returned to the desk and resumed reviewing Su Yingxue's earlier notes, thoughts swirling in his mind.
Considering Li Zheng's position as one of the Six Prison Wardens, he wouldn't come here without reason. Had the Hell Demon Lord detected something?
Time ticked away as Yuan Ming worried that the rare opportunity for possession might be wasted, when finally the footsteps resumed, and Li Zheng left.
Yuan Ming exhaled quietly, promptly retrieving the blue notebook and opening it.
Flipping ahead several pages, Yuan Ming saw multiple messages left by Su Yingxue, all asking about their previous transaction, with increasingly urgent tones, the last even stating that in addition to helping him ascend to Level 6 Array Master, she would grant him another request if he helped her investigate the Space Transmission Array.
Yuan Ming smiled faintly, decisively picked up the pen, and agreed to Su Yingxue's request.
Simultaneously, he brought up Xi Ying's request for a Sixth-level Defense Array.
After finishing, Yuan Ming placed the blue notebook properly in front of Su Yingxue, and immediately, the time for possession ended, and his consciousness returned.
Su Yingxue felt a momentary daze, as if she had a brief lapse while writing, and then she found the brush in her hand had been put down at some unknown time, and the blue notebook that had been pressed under the pile of books had appeared in front of her out of nowhere.
Had that mysterious expert been here?
Her expression first tightened, and she instinctively looked around, then with a mix of surprise and excitement, she opened the notebook.
Flipping back to the place where she had left off, she immediately saw Yuan Ming's message, and joy appeared on her face.
"You want a Sixth-level Defense Array? That's not a difficult task, the Five Elements Formation will do." Su Yingxue mused slightly, pondering to herself.
Regarding whether Yuan Ming could help her obtain the Space Array connecting the Nihility Prison to the outside world, she seemed not worried at all.
Su Yingxue first erased the writing on the notebook, then picked up her brush and wrote:
"The promotion to Level 6 Array Master cannot be achieved through personal effort alone, you need to undergo the Array Dao Inheritance Baptism to pave the way in the path of formations, only then can you break through. Half a year later, I will prepare the Inheritance Array at midnight, and all you need to do then is enter the array with your Divine Soul to receive the baptism."
Keep us going by reading on *.
"Additionally, as for the Sixth-level Defense Array you need, wait until you obtain the information on the Transmission Array connecting to the Nihility Prison, and then we can make the exchange."
After writing down, she put the blue notebook back to its original place.
Su Yingxue picked up her brush again and continued writing about the formation insights.
...
Half a month later, Yuan Ming possessed Su Yingxue again, and after receiving her affirmative answer, he began preparing the subsequent work to explore the Nihility Prison.
During this period, Yun Luo Fairy finally finished her seclusion and gracefully walked out of the chamber.
Upon seeing Yun Luo Fairy, Yuan Ming almost didn't recognize her, as the person in front of him had undergone significant changes in appearance and temperament, especially in looks, compared to the Yun Luo Fairy he knew.
The former Yun Luo Fairy was just an ordinary beauty, but now, she could be called stunningly beautiful.
If Yuan Ming hadn't been able to sense her unchanged aura, it would have been hard to believe that the person in front was indeed Yun Luo Fairy.
"What's the matter, can't recognize me?" Yun Luo Fairy arched her eyebrows, smiling as she spoke.
After seeing that Yuan Ming had been guarding for her during her seclusion, she felt quite touched.
"A bit." Yuan Ming nodded.
The Yun Luo Fairy before him was wearing a water-blue gauze dress, exuding an ethereal and transcendent aura, making her appear more noble and elegant than before, yet without a cold and distant vibe, invoking a conflicting feeling in people of wanting to admire from afar yet desiring to approach and observe closely.
Yuan Ming knew that this was the manifestation of her significant advancement in cultivation and perfection of her Cultivation Technique, and with a slight activation of his Divine Thought, he collected his myriad thoughts.
Yun Luo Fairy had been carefully observing his expression changes and found that he quickly stabilized his mind, which made her a bit disappointed.
"It seems that my study of the 'Sutra of the Pure Woman' is still not at home; even after reaching the Dharma manifestation Stage, I still cannot move Fellow Daoist Yuan's heartstrings." Yun Luo Fairy said somewhat resentfully.
"Fellow Daoist Yun Luo underestimates herself too much, I am very curious, is this change on your body an illusion technique, or..." Yuan Ming shifted the topic.
"It's due to the Cultivation Technique of the Su Nu Sect. The deeper one cultivates, the better one's appearance and temperament become; however, the effects can vary when different people cultivate it." Yun Luo Fairy explained.
"I see, congratulations to Fellow Daoist Yun Luo." Yuan Ming realized and said with cupped hands.
"Thanks to the Dharma Manifestation Pill that you refined, which was of excellent quality, otherwise it wouldn't have been so easy for me to advance to the Dharma manifestation Stage. Now that my matters are temporarily settled, let us not delay; we should set out to find a Level 6 demon beast and help you refine a Dharma Manifestation Pill as well." Yun Luo Fairy sincerely thanked, then continued.
"This matter isn't urgent for the moment." Yuan Ming hesitated a bit upon hearing this.
What Yuan Ming cared more about currently was the deal with Su Yingxue, and having already verified the efficacy of the Dharma Manifestation Pill, he had also gained a lot of experience from Yun Luo Fairy's advancement, so this matter was not as urgent.
"Is it really not urgent? Do you have something more important than refining a Dharma Manifestation Pill?" Yun Luo Fairy asked with a frown.
"During the time I guarded the path for you, I also had some insights and want to go into seclusion for a while to cultivate." Yuan Ming nodded in acknowledgment.
"If that's the case, then let's set out later, I can also take this time to consolidate my cultivation." Yun Luo Fairy nodded in agreement upon hearing this.
...
Seven days later.
In the inner chamber of the secret room, Yuan Ming, who was in seclusion, lit the Black Incense once more.
In the Nihility Prison, the warden Li Zheng was walking in the corridor when suddenly he felt his eyelids twitch, his eyes quickly dimmed, and uncontrollably leaned against a nearby stone wall.
As his body touched the wall, his lowered head lifted again, his eyes bright with spirit, he immediately looked around.
At this moment, the one controlling this body had already become Yuan Ming.
To investigate the situation of the space Transmission Array in the Nihility Prison, the higher the position of the person possessed, the better.
Yuan Ming had come to the Nihility Prison multiple times, but the Six Prison Wardens usually stayed aloof, and every time he possessed someone, he was busy with important tasks, so up until now, he had only seen this Li Zheng.
After possessing Li Zheng, Yuan Ming didn't delay, immediately controlling Li Zheng's body, heading deeper into the Nihility Prison.
In Su Yingxue's memory, there was a partial structural diagram of this prison, which included the approximate area where the space Transmission Array was located, although it wasn't the exact position.
With Li Zheng's identity, as Yuan Ming expected, he encountered no obstacles along the way and smoothly arrived at the area where the space Transmission Array was located.
As Yuan Ming arrived near, a guard of the Nascent Soul Stage demon clan holding a long spear came up to him, and seeing Li Zheng from afar, he bowed and saluted: "Lord Li Zheng, what brings you here today?"

chapters.title: Chapter 872 - 842: Suspicion and Surveillance
chapters.content:
"Under the orders of Lord Demon, I'm here to conduct a patrol," said "Li Zheng," controlled by Yuan Ming, brazenly involving the Hell Demon Lord in the conversation.
"When did Lord Demon issue this order? Didn't he ask you to monitor the Hui Clan woman in the Chuyun Realm? Be honest, did you leave your post and sneak out for a stroll?" a voice interrupted. It was a towering yellow-skinned giant with muscles resembling a mountain of flesh.
Yuan Ming felt a stir in his heart, and from appearances, this was none other than another Prison Director of the Nihility Prison, Jiao Shan.
Li Zheng appearing at Su Yingxue's location was indeed because the Hell Demon Lord sensed something and dispatched someone for investigation.
"Heh heh, you already know, so why ask? Watching people all the time is too tiring, makes me feel stifled." Yuan Ming quickly lowered his voice and said.
"Alright, alright, this Nihility Prison is just these places, no matter where you stay, it's stifling. After I finish my business, I'll come over for a drink with you." Jiao Shan seemed to be just passing by, waved his hand, and left with heavy steps.
After he left, Yuan Ming continued forward, and upon turning at the end of the passage, he arrived at a spacious hall.
In the center of the hall, white light swirled, and a massive formation of over ten zhang in diameter stood impressively.
Yuan Ming focused his gaze to see sixteen black stone pillars, three zhang tall, standing around the formation, engraved with dense runes. The ground was also etched with complex array patterns, with high-quality spirit stones embedded in the sixteen array eyes.
At the array core in the formation's center, a fist-sized white orb hovered, emitting thin strands of white glow, containing an intense space power.
Being a Level 5 Peak Array Master, Yuan Ming naturally understood this teleportation array and carefully memorized the great array's details. After a moment, he frowned.
He had seen the other parts of the teleportation array clearly, but the core region was obscured by the white orb. To inspect it, the orb must be moved.
His eyes flashed slightly, and he quickly made up his mind, approaching the array. He reached out with both hands in the void, invoking the Six Jia Qimen Divine Ability.
During this period, he had possessed Xi Ying once and comprehended the Six Jia Qimen.
Xi Ying had already mastered this divine skill to the Perfect Realm. Although it was only one possession, Yuan Ming's Six Jia Qimen also improved significantly.
The space power around the white orb fluctuated violently, severing its connection with the teleportation array, making the orb vanish into thin air. It then reappeared several zhang away, revealing the core array patterns of the space teleportation array.
Yuan Ming's eyes lit up, and he quickly memorized the core array patterns.
However, at that moment, a terrifying pressure suddenly swept over, accompanied by a thunderous roar: "Bold! Who dares to trespass into the teleportation array?"
As the voice resounded, Yuan Ming saw a tall black figure, wrapped in a broad black robe with its face unseen, appearing out of nowhere not far in front of him.
Before he could react, that figure reached out to grab him through the air.
Yuan Ming's body tensed immediately, feeling the void around him suddenly constrict as an indescribable oppressive force locked the space around him, rendering him immobile.
He was not one to sit and wait for death. He immediately activated Li Zheng's body, causing all his magic power to surge and form ripples of magic in an attempt to break through the space confinement.
However, the black figure gave him no chance to resist.
Behind the figure, black virtual light condensed, manifesting into a ten zhang tall black dharma manifestation—a giant demon shrouded in black mist, with the face of an evil ghost and six arms.
An overwhelming force descended, and Yuan Ming had no strength to resist and was suppressed, unable to move a single finger.
"Dharma Manifestation Stage Great Power... This is that Hell Demon Lord!" His heart tightened instantly, though he wasn't surprised.
"Li Zheng? What are you doing here?" The Hell Demon Lord's voice carried a tone of astonishment, seeing the person suppressed.
Yuan Ming naturally didn't answer, closing his eyes.
"No, you're not Li Zheng! Who are you? Daring to meddle in the Nihility Prison!" The Hell Demon Lord fixed his gaze on Yuan Ming, suddenly seeming to realize something, and shouted sternly.
A surging Divine Soul pressure descended from above, directly invading Li Zheng's sea of consciousness. Thiscontentoriginatesfrom*,MyVirtualLibraryEmpire.
Yuan Ming's Divine Soul trembled, seemingly about to be crushed by this force.
Fortunately, his Divine Soul was not weak, and he operated the Moonlight Technique, withstanding the pressure.
"Indeed, this is a divine soul possession technique. How bold of you to play tricks under my nose! Ghost Gate!"
Accompanied by a voice seemingly from the abyss of Hell, the six arms of the demon dharma manifestation clapped together, and a black city gate suddenly rose before it from thin air.
The gate tower exuded a chilling yin aura; a row of heads hung, all bleeding from their seven orifices, silently screaming with open mouths. The two gate doors, dripping with blood, opened inward, revealing a deep, dark portal with a black vortex rapidly rotating within.
Yuan Ming only felt an irresistible attraction, dragging him and Li Zheng's Divine Soul towards the Ghost Gate.
Yuan Ming's heart surged with a sense of foreboding, for within the terrifying vortex, he sensed a peculiar aura capable of obliterating the Divine Soul, setting off alarms in his heart.
Possessed through the Stealing Heaven Tripod, his main soul would face unimaginable consequences if devoured here. Yuan Ming dared not take the risk and immediately attempted to separate his Divine Soul from Li Zheng's body.
However, there was no time; he and Li Zheng's Divine Soul were already beneath the Ghost Gate.
At this critical juncture, Yuan Ming sensed a familiar dizziness, and his heart brimmed with immense joy.
The Black Incense had burned out, and his possession time was up.
The Divine Soul returned to his body, Yuan Ming's eyes suddenly opened, and he couldn't help but start breathing heavily.
"That was close, that was close, luckily I was delayed by someone calling me earlier... The Dharma Manifestation Stage Great Powers of the Demon Clan are indeed more terrifying than those Dharma Phase Cultivators of the Dongji Palace Master! I must advance to the Dharma Manifestation Stage as soon as possible." Yuan Ming once again deeply felt his own weakness and was eager to improve.
Though this possession was dangerous, it allowed him to understand the situation of the Space Transmission Array and fulfill Su Yingxue's request.
Yuan Ming took a deep breath, closed his eyes, and circulated the Moonlight Technique to heal his Divine Soul's injuries.
Half a month later, he opened his eyes, and his Divine Soul injuries had healed.
He looked at the time, took out the Stealing Heaven Tripod, and lit the Black Incense.
Yuan Ming did not possess Su Yingxue but descended onto Xi Ying, contemplating the Six Jia Qimen and the Circular Light Technique.
The huge commotion in the Nihility Prison, and the fact that the Hell Demon Lord knew there was an external intervention in the Nihility Prison, had likely turned the entire Nihility Prison upside down.
However, Su Yingxue had anticipated this situation. The reason she had set the Array Dao Inheritance Baptism for six months later was precisely because of this.
...
In the prison of the Nihility Prison.
Su Yingxue was setting up the Array Dao Inheritance Array for Yuan Ming's baptism in her cell, when a tall figure appeared outside her cell—it was Jiao Shan.
"Master Jiao Shan." Su Yingxue merely glanced at him and continued with the setup on the ground.
"What are you doing?" Jiao Shan asked, puzzled.
"Depicting the Formation. I want to see if there's still room for improvement in the Array Dao Inheritance Array." Su Yingxue said calmly.
Jiao Shan, who had some knowledge of formations, recognized at a glance that this was not a Transmission Array for escape, nor a powerful Attack Array, so he didn't pay it much heed.
After all, even if it was, it would be impossible to escape from the Nihility Prison with just these formations.
He watched for a while, then turned and left.
Su Yingxue suddenly thought of something, stopped what she was doing, and asked, "Master Jiao Shan, why haven't I seen Lord Li Zheng these days?"
"A few days ago, he lost his mind and caused trouble in the Hell Demon Lord's territory. He almost got himself killed and is currently in confinement." Jiao Shan replied with a slight frown.
"What a pity, without him, there's one less person to talk to." Su Yingxue sighed.
Jiao Shan said nothing further and left.
Su Yingxue paid no heed to Jiao Shan's departure, a trace of joy flashed across her heart.
She believed that Li Zheng's unusual behavior was by no means accidental, and was surely related to the mysterious master. She wondered if the other party had already succeeded.
Su Yingxue sped up the arrangement of the formation, quickly completed it, and then activated it, sitting inside to seemingly feel the effect of the Great Array.
A moment later, Su Yingxue stood up, wiped out the ground's array patterns with a wave, and rearranged them, acting as usual, flawless and without any slip-ups.
...
In a spacious hall in a certain area of the Nihility Prison, the nearby walls were illuminated to a ghostly green by the burning emerald green Ghost Fire, and the hall was permeated with an eerie aura, with occasional ghostly wails echoing.
This was the residence of the Hell Demon Lord, and along with him, all but one, Jiao Shan, of the other five Prison Directors were gathered here.
Li Zheng's face was pale, his aura weak, as if he had suffered severe injuries.
In the hall, a green light curtain was suspended, clearly displaying the state of Su Yingxue's cell.
"What do you think? Was the previous disturbance related to this Su Yingxue?" The Hell Demon Lord, still wrapped in his wide Black Robe, asked.
"It doesn't seem like a problem, but as you know, Lord Demon, Su Yingxue is of the Hui Clan, most skilled in sweet talk and deception. Even if she had issues, we wouldn't know just by watching." Said a seductive woman in red.
"Indeed, Lord Demon, it might be better to conduct a Soul Search on her; then we'd know if there's a problem." Suggested a young man with horns and blue scales on his arm.
The others nodded in agreement.
"This Su Yingxue is the Heavenly Fox Demon Lord's lunatic's ward here, and in a decade or two, she'll take her back. She can't be touched recklessly. Besides, my Forget River Soul-searching Technique hasn't condensed a Dao Seal, and the Hui Clan excels at manipulating memories. Su Yingxue is outstanding among her clan, having awakened wisdom three times already, so a Soul Search might be in vain." The Hell Demon Lord said.
The five prison directors exchanged looks, seemingly unsure of what to say.
"Alright, let's end this matter here. Thoroughly investigate all areas of the Nihility Prison and scrutinize anyone suspicious. Do not relax vigilance on Su Yingxue; have a director monitor her at all times. Dismissed." The Hell Demon Lord said with impatience upon seeing the five's helplessness.
The five, as if granted amnesty, swiftly exited.
"Su Wu, I only give you this one opportunity. Whether you can grasp it depends on you." The Hell Demon Lord murmured, looking at the light curtain in mid-air, then waved to disperse the green light curtain…

chapters.title: Chapter 873 - 843 Inheritance Space
chapters.content:
Su Yingxue repeatedly refined the Array Dao Inheritance Array and made modifications to it seven or eight times before a hint of satisfaction appeared on her face.
She returned to the desk, took out the blue notebook, and began to meticulously document the various details of how to activate the Array Dao Inheritance Array for the baptism.
At that moment, a figure silently appeared outside the cell; it was the red-clothed woman who had just received instructions from the Hell Demon Lord.
The red-clothed woman not only concealed her aura but also seemed to become a semi-transparent, ethereal existence, her body adhered against the cell wall as if boneless and formless, ready to drift away at a breath.
Su Yingxue was naturally oblivious to the movements outside the cell, deeply focused on writing diligently in the notebook. After finishing, she hesitated briefly before picking up the pen to draw on a new page.
Before long, a complex structure, densely filled with array patterns, appeared on the paper.
Beside the array diagram, Su Yingxue wrote the words "Five Elements Formation."
Afterward, she detailed the method to configure the Five Elements Formation, the materials required for the setup, and the ways to break the array, all written below the array diagram.
All of this naturally fell within the view of the red-clothed woman separated by a wall.
Since Su Yingxue usually researched various arrays in this Nihility Prison, and this array seemed innocuous without involving any forbidden actions, it didn't arouse the red-clothed woman's suspicion.
The red-clothed woman's face remained expressionless, lying motionlessly against the wall as if in meditation, showing no intention of leaving.
After drying the ink, Su Yingxue turned to the next page and continued to draw the second array.
...
Time passed swiftly, and the day Yuan Ming and Xi Ying had agreed upon arrived.
Yuan Ming lit the Black Incense and possessed Su Yingxue's body.
He didn't act immediately, but his divine sense quietly spread outward, soon detecting a nearly imperceptible concealed aura outside the cell.
"It seems last time's incident indeed caused suspicion within this prison. I'll need to be extra cautious," Yuan Ming thought to himself, glancing at the prepared array on the ground beside him, his eyes narrowing.
Suppressing the joy in his heart, he took out the blue notebook, turned to where Su Yingxue had left her notes, carefully reread it, and even felt a touch of gratitude.
Despite it being just a transaction, Su Yingxue showed great diligence, writing every detail clearly as if afraid he might misunderstand and fail.
Upon flipping to the next page and seeing the "Five Elements Formation," Yuan Ming was even more surprised.
He immediately took detailed notes, then chose to modify his decision to undergo the Array Dao Inheritance Baptism, instead picking up the pen to record the teleportation array patterns he observed.
Yuan Ming didn't record them directly; instead, he divided the array patterns into several parts, reversing their order to prevent the observer from discerning his intentions.
Then, on another page, he drew some seemingly unrelated array runes, which at first glance appeared as drafts for some array, yet actually recorded information about the Hell Demon Lord that he had learned.
He believed that with Su Yingxue's sharp intellect and deep understanding of arrays, she would naturally comprehend his notes.
After finishing, he returned the notebook to its original place and stood up, entering the Array Dao Inheritance Array.
Throughout the process, Yuan Ming strove to mimic Su Yingxue's facial expressions and walking habits in an effort to prevent the monitors outside from noticing anything suspicious.
Yuan Ming had an intuition that the watcher outside possessed considerable cultivation, likely comparable to or not far from the Six Prison Wardens.
In the eyes of the red-clothed woman, "Su Yingxue" had been studying some high-level array these days, so entering the array now wasn't particularly strange.
After sitting cross-legged, Yuan Ming brought his hands together in front to control his breathing for a while, suddenly raised his hand, and pointed forward, a stream of mana shot out and landed on the array's core.
The core of the Array Dao Inheritance Array was not a Spirit Stone but rather a hollow circular jade adorned with unique array patterns. As Yuan Ming's mana infused it, an intense burst of light erupted.
Subsequently, a snow-white trace emerged from it, serpentine in its movement, lighting up one array eye after another.
The entire array immediately activated, a dense milky white glow rose from the ground, engulfing Yuan Ming completely.
In the next instant, Yuan Ming felt his view obscured by dazzling white light, and then his divine soul lightened, being drawn into an unknown white world.
His divine soul manifested into his bodily form, looking around, finding the surrounding void seemingly boundless, with nothing but a vast expanse of white emptiness visible.
Even time seemed frozen in this place.
Though according to Su Yingxue's notebook, everyone experiences a different inheritance space due to varying talents and dispositions, the method of inheritance remains the same.
Therefore, Yuan Ming wasn't anxious, and he began to visualize the arrays he had seen and mastered as taught in Su Yingxue's notebook.
He closed his eyes and first envisioned the Flame Array; as he imagined it, virtual light began to appear in the white space, gradually coalescing into a Flame Array.
Within the array, flames surged, blazing fiercely with twisting light. A new array manifested, transforming into the more powerful White Flame Flowing Fire Formation.
The white flame transformed again, and amidst the twisting flames, it converted into a Nine Palace Fire Formation.
And through it all, Yuan Ming remained unaware; the flame array was naturally evolving according to some mysterious principle.
At this moment, Yuan Ming had already begun envisioning the Green Flow Circulation Array.
In the midst of the azure glow, a formation with formidable defensive attributes emerged, carrying an immense and profound foundation, slowly operating on its own, and then began undergoing a certain metamorphosis.
Yuan Ming continued envisioning from the Five Elements Illusion Destruction Array, to the Blood River Formation, then to the Yellow Sand Formation, and onto the Star Shifting Array…
Formation after formation was condensed and transformed out of thin air in this white space under Yuan Ming's visualization.
All the formations, in continuous derivation, ultimately twisted and transformed into various unique array patterns, floating up into the air.
Content presented by *.
As more and more array patterns emerged, the originally snow-white space was like a piece of rice paper spread open, with ancient characters written on it in ink.
When Yuan Ming fully envisioned all the formations he had encountered, a massive white halo suddenly appeared, twisting in the light above his head.
The surface of that halo was inscribed with countless runes, looking almost identical to that circular jade in the Array Dao Inheritance Array Core.
Light flowed across it, and at the center of the ring, a vortex cyclone suddenly emerged.
An invisible suction emanated from it, and all the array patterns envisioned by Yuan Ming began flying into the vortex in the ring one after another like fledglings returning to their nests, vanishing into the light.
Then, rings of light rippled out from the ring, and all the inscribed runes on it lit up.
A beam of white light projected down, enveloping Yuan Ming's Divine Soul.
Yuan Ming immediately felt his Divine Soul stiffen, and he could no longer move freely.
As he was perplexed, the white light falling on him suddenly started manifesting array pattern images, like snowflakes drifting down, disappearing the moment they touched his Divine Soul.
Numerous insights related to formations surged into his Sea of Consciousness, quickly permeating his Divine Soul.
"The inheritance has begun!" Yuan Ming's Divine Soul trembled, and he came to his senses immediately.
He promptly set aside all distractions, focusing entirely on comprehending the snowflakes falling onto him, actively guiding them to merge into his body.
As time passed, an indescribable enlightenment grew, and Yuan Ming's understanding of formations rapidly improved.
Since his Array Formation Cultivation reached Level 5 Peak, he had tried countless times to break through to a Level 6 Array Master. Although seemingly within reach, every attempt ended in failure, like a chasm blocking his way.
However, at this very moment, that chasm was quickly collapsing.
With more snowflakes falling from the white light, the phantom light surrounding Yuan Ming's Divine Soul grew increasingly radiant.
"Ka…"
After an indeterminate amount of time, an invisible shackle silently shattered.
In the next instant, Yuan Ming's Divine Soul abruptly opened his eyes, which shone with an extraordinary light, and peculiar runes flickered faintly in his gaze.
As his eyes opened, the surrounding white space began to disintegrate, becoming fragmented.
His Divine Soul returned to Su Yingxue's body, and his eyes opened.
Yuan Ming glanced around and noticed that the Spirit Stones in the Array Eyes of the Array Dao Inheritance Array hadn't exhausted their spiritual power, but their glow had dimmed, while the white jade in the Array Core had turned gray-white.
With a slight touch of his finger, the jade turned to powder.
Standing up, Yuan Ming began to recall the scenes from before in his Sea of Consciousness, where numerous insights about arrays inexplicably appeared. The Eight Extremes Golden Lock Array, which he could only grasp partially before, now seemed clear and straightforward.
"This is a Level 6 Array Master… truly incomparable to a Level 5 Array Master. Without this inheritance method, who knows how many years it would take to cross this threshold." Yuan Ming couldn't help but be overwhelmed with emotion.
Full of delight, he immediately sat down at Su Yingxue's desk, took the blue notebook, and began flipping through it again.
It contained the design of the Five Elements Formation by Su Yingxue.
The Five Elements Formation was much more complex than the Eight Extremes Golden Lock Array. With Yuan Ming's previous expertise in formations, he couldn't understand the contents recorded there at all.
However, this time, he was surprised to find that he comprehended the contents with ease, even quickly grasping the intricacies of Su Yingxue's design.
Which was impossible before.
After continuing to flip through the journal, which also documented several other formation techniques, he planned to thoroughly review them all during this opportunity. Even if he couldn't master them completely, memorizing them first would be beneficial.
Unfortunately, he had only turned two pages when the familiar drowsiness overwhelmed him strongly. Unknowingly, the time had come for the Black Incense Possession to end.
Yuan Ming's Divine Soul immediately withdrew and returned to his body.
Almost simultaneously, Su Yingxue's eyes regained focus, and upon seeing the open books on the desk, a moment of confusion flashed in her eyes.
But she quickly reacted, turning her head to look at the formation laid out on the ground, her heart instantly understanding.
"It seems that this mysterious expert also has profound knowledge and talent in formations. Otherwise, they couldn't have completed the Array Dao Inheritance so swiftly." Su Yingxue couldn't help but marvel in her heart.

chapters.title: Chapter 874 - 844: Reappearance
chapters.content:
Su Yingxue's mind was racing. She tidied up the books on the table and pulled out that blue notebook.
When she turned to the place where Yuan Ming had left a message, a glint of surprise flickered in her eyes. The content recorded inside was far more detailed than she had imagined.
Especially the array map drawn by Yuan Ming, which, although slightly flawed, was overall quite accurate. Some details were even annotated, making it quite perfect.
Referring to Yuan Ming's notes, Su Yingxue reviewed the entire teleportation array, and a hint of a smile appeared at the corner of her mouth.
Then, she saw the draft composed of array runes left by Yuan Ming. Initially, she was slightly taken aback, but then a look of understanding appeared in her eyes.
She naturally recognized that this was actually using obscure means to convey information about the Hell Demon Lord to her, while also indirectly reminding her to be more cautious.
It seemed that the matter of Li Zheng had attracted some people's attention, leading them to suspect her.
However, she was confident that her current actions could not be more "normal."
But all of this was no longer important.
In just a few thoughts, Su Yingxue sorted out many clues, though a faint smile crossed her lips.
She seemed a bit tired as she reached out to pinch the space between her eyebrows, then closed her eyes, and meditated for a moment in breathing control.
However, when she opened her eyes again, they suddenly gleamed with vitality. Suddenly, she lifted her hand, and several beams of light of various colors shot out, disappearing into the corners of the cell.
A dense, white mist appeared on the stone walls surrounding the area and quickly spread across the entire cell, completely blocking all voyeurism.
As she formed a spell with her hands, a series of incantations were recited, and a low humming sound ensued. A silver light veil appeared, almost adhering to the outer white fog wall.
In the silver light veil, dots of golden light flickered, almost covering the entire veil.
These Forbidden Arrays were evidently set up by her long ago, and before being triggered, nothing could be noticed by outsiders.
Almost simultaneously with her activation of the second layer of the formation, a series of dull drum beats resounded, causing the surface of the silver light veil to tremble violently, as if struck by some intense force.
Yet, after numerous golden lights flared briefly on the surface of the veil, they transformed into a stream of light that rapidly spread across it, immediately stabilizing the previously trembling silver light veil.
Su Yingxue seemed to remain indifferent to all of this, her expression unchanged.
She brought her fingers together, and a glimmer of golden light shone at her fingertips, as she suddenly pointed to various acupoints on her body.
"Bang, bang"
With each strike at an acupoint, a collision sound echoed beneath her fingertips, and a golden ripple spread out.
Under the collision of layers of ripples, a translucent covering robe surrounding her body gradually came into view, with dark red array patterns beginning to appear on it.
This was a Forbidden Array imposed on Su Yingxue by the Nihility Prison after an accident with the Teleportation Array, and it was more formidable than before.
Su Yingxue's eyes revealed a trace of disdain. This was a garment formed by Forbidden Arrays, its function was to suppress her physique, cutting off her ability to absorb nature's spiritual energy, thus keeping the mana she could absorb at an extremely low level.
As her fingertip movements accelerated, one by one starlight-like points lingered on the surface of the Forbidden garment, interlocking with each other to form a formation.
Breaking an array with another array was a common technique employed by Array Masters to break prohibitions.
Su Yingxue's final finger point landed at the center of her chest, instantly causing the golden formation to radiate with golden light that spread outwards, extending to every corner of the Forbidden garment.
Wherever the golden light reached, the red prohibition array patterns quickly dissolved and disappeared within a few breaths.
"Su Yingxue, what are you doing?" a fierce shout from a red-clothed woman came from outside the prison, with several serpent-like red lights shooting toward Su Yingxue, only to be blocked by the silver light veil.
Su Yingxue regained her freedom, with a slight turn of her wrist, a cyan ring formation appeared beneath her feet.
It wasn't a high-grade formation, just a simple Spirit Gathering Array.
With the operation of the array, the surrounding spiritual energy rushed like a tide, forming a vortex in the center of the Great Array, enveloping Su Yingxue within.
The sound of impact from the silver light veil continued, and the tremors of the veil intensified, while the golden light covering it continued to diminish, leaving only a small portion remaining.
Su Yingxue gently shook both sleeves, from which two cyclones emerged out of thin air, while a Dao Seal appeared on each arm. The spiritual energy enveloping her was swiftly drawn into her sleeves like a dragon absorbing water.
Su Yingxue was absorbing the spiritual energy with astonishing speed, and soon her once desolate and depleted dantian became full.
With the final piece of golden light on the silver light veil collapsing, the entire veil began to tremble violently, on the verge of collapse.Catch the formatted version at *.
The inner white fog wall, which isolated divine sense, shattered directly ahead of time.
"You're trying to escape! Stop your foolish actions, or you know better than anyone what awaits you!" The red-clothed woman's expression changed dramatically as she coldly spoke.
"Why are you wasting words with her now? Act with full force and suppress this woman!" A tall figure appeared out of thin air as yellow light flashed in the prison, it was none other than Jiao Shan.
Accompanying the voice, a large yellow seal flew out from Jiao Shan, smashing heavily onto the silver light veil.
The trembling of the light screen intensified, with cracks appearing on its surface, yet it still firmly blocked the way.
Su Yingxue raised an eyebrow and smiled, stretching lazily, her beautiful eyes narrowing in comfort.
Then, as she gently waved her hand, golden light traces spiraled upward around her, forming a semi-transparent golden array.
"We'll meet again," Su Yingxue said softly.
As her words fell, the golden array shone brightly for a moment before it quickly extinguished.
When the light array disappeared, Su Yingxue was nowhere to be seen within the prison, along with all her classics and books.
Almost in the next instant, with a "bang," the silver light screen finally couldn't hold, collapsing completely.
Then two figures flashed in: they were Jiao Shan and the red-clothed woman.
Seeing the empty prison cell, they were shocked and immediately took out Sound Transmission Talismans, intending to do something.
However, the next moment, a thunderous boom echoed through the Nihility Prison, an energy wave sweeping through, causing Jiao Shan and the red-clothed woman to stagger.
Jiao Shan's face changed dramatically, sensing the direction of the wave, and shouted in alarm, "Oh no! Something happened over at the Teleportation Array..."
As soon as his words fell, he and the red-clothed woman rushed in that direction.
But when they arrived, all they could see was a mess in the expansive hall, and the Teleportation Array had already been destroyed.
"Neither of you could even watch a person, letting that Array Master escape," the cold and icy voice of the Hell Demon Lord rang out from the side.
"You couldn't stop her either?" Jiao Shan wasn't questioning, just incredulous.
"An Array Master of her level is too difficult to kill," the Hell Demon Lord said coldly.
...
Meanwhile, deep within the Demon Wind Cave.
By the stele that recorded the Demon Qi Technique, a golden array appeared from nothing, and Su Yingxue emerged from it.
The body-shaping demon wind roared around, the Wind Blades like knives, their sound like ghostly wails, yet when they touched her, it felt like a gentle spring breeze, unable to harm her in the slightest.
Above Su Yingxue's head, white light gathered like a tiny sun hanging there, within which floated a rune-covered Dao Seal.
It was the power released from this Dao Seal that protected her, causing the terrifying demon wind to bypass her.
Su Yingxue walked quickly toward the depths of the Demon Wind Cave, stopping only at a stone wall at the deepest point. She bowed deeply to it, then knelt down in homage.
Sitting cross-legged at the base of the stone wall was a figure.
His body was enveloped in dense black air, making his appearance indistinguishable.
At this moment, he seemed to be cultivating an Evil Technique, his body swelling like a balloon or shrinking swiftly to the size of a small child.
In this expansion and contraction, the swirling demonic qi and demon wind in the cave were all absorbed into his body, completely devoured.
"Sect Hierarch, I have announced your assumption as the Three Realms Sect Leader," Su Yingxue said respectfully, head lowered.
The bizarre figure swelled again and then started to slowly shrink.
This time, he directly returned to normal adult size and didn't continue shrinking, revealing a clear face—a gentle, scholar-like young man's face.
"You've done well," the young man smiled and said.
"I've leaked the information to Jin Mu; Ancestor Bing Lan might make a move," Su Yingxue dared to raise her head slightly and said.
"Bing Lan? Meeting him isn't bad, but how did you leak the information? The Hell Demon Lord likely wouldn't help," the young man nodded, the black air on his body quickly forming a black robe.
"Recently, a mysterious figure infiltrated the Nihility Prison, possibly a Soul Cultivator under the Void Moon Demon Emperor. The Void Moon Demon Emperor and Sect Hierarch have a decent relationship. With a bit of luck, I asked him to transmit the message, and unexpectedly, it worked..." Su Yingxue recounted the developments in detail.
"Oh, he could control your body, and you were unaware of it? This person is quite formidable. Could it be the Thousand-faced Demon Lord under the Void Moon Demon Emperor? Or..." The young man's body suddenly trembled, as if he recalled something.
"How many times did he possess you? How long was each interval?" The young man abruptly turned to Su Yingxue and asked.
"Four or five times, the intervals varied, sometimes seven or eight days, sometimes over ten," Su Yingxue was startled by the young man's change, carefully recalling before answering.
"Seven or eight days, over ten days, ha ha, I understand now," the young man laughed, seeming quite pleased.
"Sect Hierarch, do you know who he is?" Su Yingxue asked.
"Can't guess. But I now know his means; never thought the Stealing Heaven Tripod would reappear," the young man said.

chapters.title: Chapter 875 - 845: Sect Hierarch of the 3 Realms
chapters.content:
"What! The Stealing Heaven Tripod!" A flicker of surprise flashed in Su Yingxue's eyes.
"Don't make a fuss about this. From that person's actions, they seem extremely cautious. If we alert them and they flee afar, it will be troublesome," the young man said in a deep voice.
"Understood." Su Yingxue had already regained her composure and nodded in agreement.
She then took out a fist-sized white sphere from her sleeve and raised it high above her head.
"Hierarch, this is the Two Realms Pearl from the Transmission Array inside the Nihility Prison. I have retrieved it for you. You can leave here anytime and return to the Chuyun Realm," Su Yingxue said respectfully.
The young man casually summoned the Two Realms Pearl into his hand.
"No rush. This Nihility Prison is actually quite to my liking. I find it necessary to conduct a selection here," the young man said with a smile, fiddling with the Two Realms Pearl.
"The Hierarch wishes to conduct a selection here?" Su Yingxue was slightly taken aback.
"What, do you think it's inappropriate?" the Three Realms Sect Leader asked in a relaxed and casual tone.
"I wouldn't dare, but the Hell Demon Lord..." Su Yingxue hesitated.
"If he dares to obstruct, I don't mind having one more dharma manifestation clone," the young man said lightly, then stood up, tossed the Two Realms Pearl back; Su Yingxue quickly caught it.
Afterward, the young man raised his arms, twisted his neck, stretched lazily, and exhaled a breath of turbid air.
Soon after, a bone-cracking "pop" sound echoed.
Su Yingxue's face changed, and with a wave of her hand, she sent out a streak of Golden Light, which she directed to the young man's chest, where a green round bead hung.
The Golden Light struck the green round bead and merged into it with a flash.
The young man paid no heed to Su Yingxue's actions; beneath the cloak's hem, a dense sound of fluttering wings arose. Three pairs of thin, transparent cicada wings, filled with golden veins, stretched out, reflecting a metallic sheen.
Simultaneously, a vast expanse of black qi began to surge beneath him.
The nearby demonic qi visibly thinned, and the surrounding rocks became pitted, then gradually sank at a visible rate.
Boom!
The black qi on the young man burst forth suddenly, sweeping the entire Demon Wind Cave in an instant, and the stone walls within quickly vanished.
The mountain above lost its support and began to collapse. Countless stones of various sizes fell, yet they all disappeared upon contact with the black qi.
Some prisoners who were tempering their bodies within the Demon Wind had no time to grasp what was happening before being engulfed by the black qi, falling silent forevermore.
In the blink of an eye, the black qi devoured everything within the Demon Wind Cave, surging even higher, like a maddened beast unleashed, rushing outwards.
Wherever it passed, all was consumed by the black qi, leaving only a dead, silent void.
"Su Wu, you bastard..." came the enraged voice of the Hell Demon Lord from outside.
The young man laughed heartily, more black qi surging from his body.
Meanwhile, completely unaware of this, Yuan Ming had already resumed his journey, setting off with Yun Luo Fairy, continuing their quest to track the Level 6 Demon Beast.
...
A year later.
Over the vast ocean, a White Feathered Seagull, with a wingspan of a hundred zhang, soared freely across the sky.
Its eyes were fixed keenly on the sea's surface, incessantly observing the waves as if searching for something.
Suddenly, it dove from the sky, and as its wings flapped forward, a fierce wind howled out, "bang" onto the water, as if a giant hammer had struck, leaving a "giant pit" on the surface.
From that "giant pit," a massive blue-backed Fish Demon, resembling a whale, emerged and sprayed a vast blue water column dozens of zhang thick at the approaching seagull.
Yet, the seagull's body suddenly burst with a vast blue light, its speed abruptly increasing, deftly dodging the water column. In the next instant, it reached the Fish Demon's head, its sharp claws piercing the Fish Demon's eyes.
With a "puff" sound, the Fish Demon's eyes were punctured by the claws. In pain, the Fish Demon went berserk, but the seagull clung tightly to it, flapping its wings to lift it into the sky.
Only then did the sea, parted by the gale, gradually fall back into place, smoothing out the "giant pit" at sea.
The seagull, full of pride, cawed a couple of times, then continued holding on to the frantically struggling Fish Demon, searching for a suitable landing spot where it could enjoy its lunch comfortably.
Soon, a verdant island came into view.
The island was vast, covered with verdant forests and lush grasses that obscured the soil from view.
At the island's center stood a towering tree hundreds of zhang high, basking in the sunlight. Its dense foliage cast a shadow over the sky, yet between the leaves were many gaps, allowing sunlight to sprinkle onto the island like specks.
Seeing a place to land, the White Feathered Seagull flew straight over without a second thought.
However, just as it approached the "island," the ground suddenly trembled, and a thick branch from the tree shot out, piercing both the seagull and its captive Fish Demon, staining the vine with blood.
The White Feathered Seagull didn't perish immediately but struggled frantically, flapping its wings in desperation to break free.
The ground nearby cracked open once more, and seven or eight similar tree branches shot out, entangling the White Feathered Seagull, quickly strangling it to death, and delivering it before the large tree.
A massive mouth appeared on the trunk of the tree, nearly a thousand feet tall, swallowing the White Feathered Seagull and Fish Demon whole, its chewing sounds audible.
In the distant sky, two figures concealed themselves among the clouds, watching this scene from afar. They were Yuan Ming and Yun Luo Fairy.
"I never thought that within the Abyss, there would actually be Tree Men growing. I remember the Tree Clan living in the Suoluo Rainforest in the northwestern Central Continent. How did they end up here at sea?" Yun Luo Fairy clicked her tongue in amazement.
"That might not be the case. Perhaps the trees on the island were influenced by the Abyss, thus developing spiritual intelligence and becoming Tree Demons," Yuan Ming said, thinking of the Heavenly Cicada Mother Qi.
"In any case, this tree's demonic power has reached Level 6, which fits our requirements perfectly. Our luck is really good; we found a suitable target in just a year. However, creatures like Tree Demons generally act slowly and rarely leave their territory. If we want to deal with it using the previous methods, it might not work," Yun Luo Fairy nodded and said.
"Not necessarily," Yuan Ming smiled slightly and said.
After reaching the level of a Level 6 Array Master, his ability to set up arrays had undergone a significant transformation, and his perspective had elevated as well. Naturally, he gained a new understanding of his strength.
"Is that so? It seems Fellow Daoist Yuan is confident. However, times have changed. Now that I've achieved dharma manifestation, to repay Fellow Daoist Yuan for previous favors, let me take the lead in this battle," Yun Luo Fairy smiled gently and then charged forward.
After breaking through to the dharma manifestation, Yun Luo Fairy's speed increased significantly. With a single flash, she appeared above the Tree Man. The two white Flying Swords she used against the Sea Jelly Demon Beast earlier shot out, transforming into two white Giant Swords and fiercely slashing toward the giant Tree Man.
The white Flying Swords, still mid-flight, emitted a dazzling and enchanting light, making Yuan Ming feel his Divine Soul slightly shaken, so he quickly looked away.
With two clashing sounds, the Tree Man's two branches firmly blocked the white Giant Swords, seemingly unaffected by their enchantment effect.
Surprise flashed in Yun Luo Fairy's eyes, but her hands continued forming spell gestures, activating the Illusion Technique Divine Communication Seal within her dharma manifestation.
The two Giant Swords suddenly radiated a dazzling white light like the sun, with countless white light threads flying out, entangling the Tree Man's trunk and penetrating it.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming retreated over a hundred feet to avoid being caught in Yun Luo Fairy's Illusion Technique Divine Skills.
Finally, the huge Tree Man's movements paused as it fell into Yun Luo Fairy's illusion.
A smug smile appeared at the corner of Yun Luo Fairy's mouth. Her figure flickered, appearing before the Tree Man, her right palm revealing the Dao Seal of sealing divine skills, pressing it toward the giant tree.
Dozens of rope-like white lights shot out, rushing toward the giant tree.
The Su Nu Sect's sealing divine skill, the Immortal Binding!
Just at this moment, the giant Tree Man that had fallen into the illusion suddenly moved. Branch after branch shot out fiercely, carrying afterimages, stabbing toward Yun Luo Fairy, who's only a stone's throw away, obviously feigning under the illusion until now.
Yun Luo Fairy's expression was astonished, but she did not panic. Her figure flickered and disappeared from her original position, then reappeared opposite the giant Tree Man, flicking her sleeve.
Three silver beams of light shot out, which were three silver flowers rushing towards the tall Tree Man, nailing onto its trunk with a "thud, thud, thud."
The flowers lit up with dazzling silver light, unleashing three powerful space powers. The nearby void immediately twisted like a vortex, causing the tall body of the Tree Man to twist and "crack," breaking into two.
"This fluctuation of space power... is it the power of the Flowers Map?" In the distant sky, Yuan Ming had already retreated far away, muttering upon seeing this scene.
He didn't have any dissatisfaction with Yun Luo Fairy's battle outcome. This insightfully decisive female actually managed to kill the Tree Man straightforwardly, saving him some trouble.
After one strike, Yun Luo Fairy did not stop. She flicked her sleeve again.
Another three silver flowers shot out, heading straight for the base of the Tree Man.
But just at this moment, the Tree Man's trunk at its base cracked open, revealing a large mouth.
A pure and intense green light shot out, splitting into three, hitting the three silver flowers.
With three booming explosions, the three green lights shattered, and the three silver flowers were also obliterated.
Initially confident in her attack, Yun Luo Fairy couldn't believe how easily the other side broke through it, so she no longer held back, forming spells with both hands.
A white light shot up from her head, transforming into a graceful woman's dharma manifestation with nearly perfect form, exuding the noble aura of the Nine Heavenly Goddess as a giant jade hand pressed towards the Tree Man.
With a "bang," the Tree Man's two-sectioned body was knocked to the ground by the divine woman dharma manifestation.
Hundreds of rope-like white lights shot from the divine woman dharma manifestation, wrapping around the Tree Man's two halves. This time they securely bound the Tree Man's body, finally sinking into it.
Seeing this, Yun Luo Fairy sighed in relief, about to descend.
"Watch your back!" Yuan Ming's voice echoed.
Startled awake, Yun Luo Fairy's eyes widened as a massive tree stump emerged from the ground behind her, its top extremely sharp, driving straight at her back.
In a critical moment, the divine woman dharma manifestation spun around, its giant hands gripping the sharp tree stump, causing it to momentarily pause.
Taking advantage of this opportunity, Yun Luo Fairy immediately retreated to a safe distance. But a cracking sound came from the front, prompting her to look up, her expression turning grave.
The sharp tree stump had somehow turned black, breaking through the divine woman dharma manifestation's grip, piercing straight through it.
With a loud crash, the divine woman dharma manifestation collapsed. Yun Luo Fairy's face paled, her body swaying slightly as her aura significantly weakened.
A dharma manifestation is condensed from a cultivator's own mana and nature's spiritual energy, and once shattered, the mana will also greatly diminish.

chapters.title: Chapter 876 - 846 The Acacia Tree
chapters.content:
As Yun Luo Fairy's Divine Woman Dharma was shattered, the severed Tree Man body moved again. The lower half of the Tree Man raised the broken upper half and reattached it to its body.
A green light shone at the fracture point, and the two parts of the Tree Man's body merged in the blink of an eye, without even leaving a scar, appearing completely unharmed.
The Tree Man opened its giant mouth and roared at Yun Luo Fairy in mid-air, but it was not out of anger; rather, it was full of mockery.
Yun Luo Fairy clenched her silver teeth, ready to strike again.
"Fellow Daoist Yun Luo, don't be impulsive; this Tree Man is somewhat unusual." At this moment, Yuan Ming flew over, reminding Yun Luo Fairy to stay calm.
"Has Fellow Daoist Yuan discerned something?" Yun Luo Fairy suppressed the anger in her heart and asked.
"The Illusion Technique Divine Skills of Fellow Daoist Yun Luo have already condensed the Dao Seal, so even when dealing with mid-stage Dharma Phase Cultivators, it would still have some impact, let alone a mere demon beast?" Yuan Ming said.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan need not console me; the most powerful skill of Su Nu Sect is the seduction technique, and Illusion Technique Divine Skills aren't considered top-notch, so failure is quite normal." Yun Luo Fairy shook her head and said.
"I'm not consoling Fellow Daoist Yun Luo. Actually, when that Tree Man was fighting Fellow Daoist Yun Luo, I wasn't just standing by watching; I also launched a Divine Soul Attack, which had no effect either." Yuan Ming flipped his hand to summon the Soul Destroying Sword and looked at the Curse Rune on it.
Yun Luo Fairy looked at the Soul Destroying Sword, feeling the astonishing cold power it contained, then asked, "So, what does Fellow Daoist Yuan think is the issue with this Tree Man?"
"I believe that it's not that the Tree Man's Divine Soul is abnormal, capable of resisting our Divine Soul attacks. Rather, the Tree Man before us is merely a puppet, and the real body is not here at all. No matter how we attack, it will naturally be futile." Yuan Ming shook his head and said.
Yun Luo Fairy's body slightly trembled, and she then said, "Fellow Daoist Yuan's words make sense; is there any way to solve this?"
"I just used Divine Sense to carefully search, but didn't find the Tree Man's true body. However, the spiritual power contained within this puppet is extraordinary. If it were about to be destroyed, I don't believe the Tree Man's true body could remain idle. As long as it shows itself, we will have a chance to truly kill it!" Yuan Ming said.
"This is indeed a method, but the Tree Man's skills are impressive. Even if you and I join forces, defeating it is difficult, let alone killing it. Is Fellow Daoist Yuan planning to wait for your spirit beasts to arrive?" Yun Luo Fairy asked with furrowed brows.
"If facing another demon beast, I might not be able to, but to deal with this Tree Man, killing it is not difficult." Yuan Ming smiled slightly.
Without waiting for Yun Luo Fairy to inquire, he flew forward, quickly arriving above the giant Tree Man, and waved his sleeve.
A large number of Array Flags and Array Plates shot out, forming a formation in the void, precisely the equipment for the Eight Extremes Golden Lock Array.
Seeing Yuan Ming's actions, the Tree Man below seemed somewhat uneasy. From its body grew two extremely thick trunks, like two giant arms swinging in the air.
Whoosh, whoosh, whoosh!
Countless branches and leaves shot out densely, like a torrential rain of arrows, each branch and leaf containing astonishing power, rushing toward Yuan Ming and the Eight Extremes Golden Lock Array.
Although Yun Luo Fairy didn't know what Yuan Ming was doing, she wouldn't let the Tree Man interfere. With a coquettish shout, two white rainbows shot out, the same two white flying swords from before.
With a flash, the flying swords appeared below Yuan Ming, flying and slashing.
White Sword Qi shot out one after another, colliding with the incoming branches and leaves.
