In a thunderous boom, clusters of spirit light and storms spread out, nature's spiritual energy was shaken away, and the nearby space seemed on the verge of collapse, vibrating intensely.
Yuan Ming ignored this, his hands forming seals in the air. The equipment for the Eight Extremes Golden Lock Array glowed with dazzling golden light, then scattered forcefully, transforming into spirit light shooting downward, disappearing into the ground near the Tree Man.
The giant Tree Man was confronting Yun Luo Fairy head-on and wanted to stop this, but it was already too late.
Dazzling golden light emerged from the gaps, forming a giant golden light pillar, enveloping the Tree Man's body within.
The Tree Man was startled, disregarding its battle with Yun Luo Fairy, its two arm-like thick trunks swinging to try and extinguish the light pillar.
However, within the light pillar, thick chains shot out, wrapping around the Tree Man more and more tightly.
The Tree Man roared in anger, desperately swinging its tree trunks in an attempt to break free, but it was to no avail, and it became entirely immobilized, trapped by more and more chains.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan's formation cultivation has reached such a degree; just a wave of his hand can set up a Level 6 Array. Are you already a Level 6 Array Master?" Yun Luo Fairy asked in amazement.
"During the time I was protecting Fellow Daoist Yun Luo, I felt inspired and unexpectedly broke through." Yuan Ming replied, half-truthfully.
Yun Luo Fairy stared at Yuan Ming with her bright eyes, her heart in turmoil.
Earlier during the hunt for the Sea Jelly Demon Beast, Yuan Ming found setting up the Eight Extremes Golden Lock Array quite difficult, and at that time, his formation cultivation was at most Level 5 Peak. This is but a short timeframe, yet he actually broke through to Level 6.
Yun Luo Fairy, coming from Central Continent Su Nu Sect, although not practicing formation, knew well that Level 6 Array Master is a watershed in the path of formation, stopping countless Array Masters.
Unable to break through, one can only be an ordinary Array Master, but once crossed, one can be among the ranks of Array Masters akin to a master, receiving great treatment even in lofty sects like Heavenly Saint Academy, Taixuan Sect, and Bright Moon Palace.
"Alright, let's talk about my matters later. First, we'll join forces to kill this Tree Man and force out its true body." Yuan Ming said as his hands formed seals and waved in the air.
A series of red array patterns appeared in mid-air, condensing into numerous array diagrams, forming a red great array within a few breaths.
Meteor Fire Rain Formation!
Although not as powerful as the Eight Extremes Golden Lock Array, it was still a standout among the Level 5 Array Formations.
Within the red formation, fierce flames burned, and gigantic Fireballs like meteorites shot out from the array with a terrifying whooshing sound, hitting the Tree Man.
The Tree Man couldn't move, struck by one giant Fireball after another, soon its body was riddled with holes, and fierce flames still burned on it.
The Tree Man roared in fury and horror, spitting out the previous green light in an attempt to intercept the overwhelming flaming meteorites, and bright green light emanated from its body, trying to heal its wounds.
Yuan Ming smiled slightly, waving his hands again, gold and green lights flashed in the void, and a blue formation and a golden formation appeared in mid-air.
Countless Wind Blades and a vast array of golden Sword Shadows fell, hitting the Tree Man as well.
Hundred-Split Storm Array!
Taiyin Sword Shadow Array!
The Tree Man's body was completely submerged, and its angry roars were swallowed by the countless attacks.
This is the combat style of a Level 6 Array Master, swiftly forming multiple formations, unleashing a sky-covering barrage of attacks, which even Dharma Phase Cultivators cannot withstand and can only evade.
Deep underground below the Tree Man, a gray figure stealthily moved, heading towards the Eight Extremes Golden Lock Array set up underground.
"Damn it, where did these two fiends come from? The tree slave I've painstakingly cultivated for a thousand years is being reduced to this state, damn it, damn it..." The gray figure roared in his heart but acted with extreme caution, not letting a trace of aura escape.
The gray figure was not slow, quickly reaching the vicinity of the Eight Extremes Golden Lock Array, spitting out a gray light towards one of the array flags.
At this moment, white light strands suddenly shot from the side, enveloping the gray figure.
The gray figure was shocked, immediately abandoning the attack on the Eight Extremes Golden Lock Array, turning to flee downward, while a charming female voice sounded in his ear: "Fellow Daoist Yuan guessed correctly, the Tree Man outside is indeed a Puppet. I didn't expect a Lianli Tree Demon to still exist in this world."
The gray figure was startled, his form pausing involuntarily.
At this moment, below him, the soil flashed with white light, and Yun Luo Fairy's figure appeared out of thin air, just a few feet away from the gray figure. Countless white light strands shot from her body, enveloping the gray figure.
The gray figure trembled, suddenly splitting into a dozen identical gray figures, fleeing in all directions.
Yun Luo Fairy was not flustered in the slightest, casually waving her hand downward. From the surrounding soil, light strands appeared, forming a Heaven and Earth Net, capturing all the gray figures in one move.
The white net quickly tightened, suspending in front of Yun Luo Fairy. Within the net, the gray figure revealed its true form, a bizarre existence with a large head and short body, covered in bark-like wrinkles, half-human, half-tree.
"The Lianli Tree, also known as the Love Tree, is rumored that the red thread used by the Matchmaker is made from the silk of the Love Tree. I didn't expect it to be so ugly." Yun Luo Fairy sized up the Lianli Tree Demon, her beautiful brows furrowed in disgust.
The Lianli Tree Demon whimpered, seemingly wanting to say something, but unable to speak.
Yun Luo Fairy paid it no mind, flicking her finger.
A white light shot into the Lianli Tree Demon's glabella, causing it to immediately fall into an illusion, motionless.
The woman flew upward, quickly reaching the surface.
Yuan Ming's attack had also ceased, and he landed on the island's ground.
The gigantic Tree Man had completely fallen to the ground at this moment, with a large part of its body missing, and the remaining part charred black, appearing on the brink of death.
However, Yuan Ming did not let his guard down, still restraining it with the Eight Extremes Golden Lock Array.
"Fellow Daoist Yun Luo, thank you for your hard work," Yuan Ming said.
"It wasn't much work. If it weren't for Fellow Daoist Yuan, who detected the exact location of this Lianli Tree Demon through emotional fluctuations, I wouldn't have been able to capture it. However, the demonic power of this Lianli Tree Demon is only about Level 5. Is it really the main body of this Tree Man?" Yun Luo Fairy asked.
"Calling it the main body isn't accurate. It's more that the Lianli Tree Demon was the manipulator of the Tree Man. The Lianli Tree itself isn't a particularly powerful Wood Demon. This demon's demonic power is special, enabling it to merge with most spirit woods and accelerate their growth. In ancient times, many powerful individuals captured these Lianli Tree Demons to oversee Spirit Wood Tree Gardens," Yuan Ming explained eloquently.
Since refining the Undying Tree into his Lifebound Spirit Plant, Yuan Ming had been very interested in various exotic spirit trees and had read about the Lianli Tree in the Spirit Wood Classics some years ago.
"Since it can only foster the growth of spirit wood, why would this Tree Man become a Puppet of the Lianli Tree Demon?" Yun Luo Fairy asked in some puzzlement.
"It could be due to the unique environment of the Abyss. The nature's spiritual energy here is too violent, damaging the spiritual intelligence of demon beasts. Perhaps the Tree Man's Divine Soul was severely damaged and the Lianli Tree Demon took advantage of it, leading to the current situation," Yuan Ming speculated, stroking his chin.

chapters.title: Chapter 877 - 847: Wooden Body
chapters.content:
"No matter what, this Tree Man has already reached Level 6, so our trip wasn't in vain. Let's take out its Demon Core and Demon Soul now." Yun Luo Fairy said softly after a moment of silence, exhaling slowly.
Yuan Ming nodded, raised his hand, and a massive black palm flashed, entering the enormous Tree Man's body, quickly extracting a verdant Demon Core within which the Demon Soul was hidden.
Compared to the Sea Jelly Demon Beast, the Tree Demon's Demon Soul was much more refined, seemingly having only Soul Power without any awareness.
"It seems that this gigantic Tree Man was truly completely controlled by the Lianli Tree Demon; otherwise, its Divine Soul wouldn't be like this." Yuan Ming thought to himself.
However, this is better. The gigantic Tree Man's Demon Soul lacks awareness, making it easier to refine into a Dharma Manifestation Pill.
"Master Dian, I'll have to trouble you again." Yuan Ming handed the Demon Core and Demon Soul into the Shura Palace, passing them to Dian Xiaosan's hand.
Dian Xiaosan was still within the Extreme Fire Territory, researching the Complete Heaven Exquisite Tripod. Seeing another set of Dharma Manifestation Pill materials being sent in, he showed a confident smile and said to the void, "Fellow Daoist Yuan, rest assured, with last time's experience, refining pills this time should be much faster."
"Then I await your news with great anticipation." Yuan Ming's voice came from the void.
Dian Xiaosan took over the Demon Core and Demon Soul and began studying them carefully.
After Yuan Ming finished explaining the matters at Dian Xiaosan's place, his gaze fell again on the corpse of the gigantic Tree Man.
"This gigantic Tree Man is a Level 6 Demon Beast, though its Demon Core is gone, the remaining demon body is still good stuff; we can't waste it. Fellow Daoist Yun Luo, do you wish to take a portion as spiritual material?" Yuan Ming turned and asked.
"I'm not in need of much; this amount is enough, so the rest you should handle, Fellow Daoist Yuan." Yun Luo Fairy nodded slightly, taking only two zhangs of spiritual material from the tree trunk.
The gigantic Tree Man was nearly a thousand zhangs tall; what she took was but a drop in the ocean.
"I've already taken the gigantic Tree Man's Demon Core and Demon Soul. Fellow Daoist Yun Luo only wanted this little bit from the corpse; how can I feel at ease?" Yuan Ming blinked and said.
"Since Fellow Daoist Yuan says so, let me have this Lianli Tree Demon as compensation, how about that?" Yun Luo Fairy smiled.
"This demon was caught by Fellow Daoist Yun Luo; you may naturally dispose of it as you wish." Yuan Ming nodded.
"Thank you, Fellow Daoist Yuan." Yun Luo Fairy took out a Spiritual Beast Bag and collected the Lianli Tree Demon.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming also stored the gigantic Tree Man corpse.
...
A few days later, Lei Yu, Hua Zhi, and Vajra gathered, and with the demon hunting done, they didn't continue to stay in the Abyss, leaving aboard Lei Yu.
Within the Shura Palace's Medicine Garden, Yuan Ming cast a spell and transformed into the Undying Tree form.
The roots of the Undying Tree quickly spread out, enveloping and devouring the corpse of the gigantic Tree Man. Yuan Ming felt wave after wave of pure power pouring into his body, causing the demonic power of the Undying Tree to continuously rise, soon reaching Level 5 Peak.
The gigantic Tree Man's corpse still contained much demonic power, and Yuan Ming continued to manipulate the Undying Tree roots to devour, aiming for the Level 6 bottleneck.
However, the difficulty of this step far exceeded Yuan Ming's expectations, perhaps because he hadn't absorbed the gigantic Tree Man's Demon Core and Demon Soul. No matter how he increased the devouring intensity, there was no sign of further growth in the Undying Tree's demonic power.
A full quarter-hour passed, and the Tree Man's corpse had shrunk significantly, with most of its demonic power already absorbed, yet the Undying Tree still remained at Level 5 Peak.
With a silent sigh in his heart, Yuan Ming was preparing to stop the absorption and hand over the remaining corpse to Hua Zhi when he suddenly noticed something strange.
Yuan Ming concentrated to sense and discovered that it was the bark of the World Tree, which was substituting for the Undying Tree, continuing to absorb the demonic power contained in the gigantic Tree Man's corpse.
Simultaneously, the trace of Ten Thousand Wood Origin Power within the bark began to slowly grow.
Yuan Ming was both surprised and delighted; since heeding the advice of the Void, he had tried various ways to cultivate this piece of World Tree bark without success, only to find the bark was now acting on its own.
With this thought, he simply sat cross-legged, quietly waiting for the bark to continue absorbing.
As time passed, when the gigantic Tree Man's corpse was completely absorbed, the World Tree bark had grown considerably, and the Ten Thousand Wood Origin Power within it had more than doubled.
As Yuan Ming's heart was filled with joy, a trace of Ten Thousand Wood Origin Power actively emerged from the World Tree bark, entering the Undying Tree.
The Undying Tree's demonic power immediately surged like oil boiling over a fierce fire.
Visible black mist drifted from the Undying Tree into the air; those were impurities accumulated within the Undying Tree from devouring various living beings previously.
That trace of Ten Thousand Wood Origin Power was like the Bright Soul Fire refining Desire Power, purifying most of the impurities within the Undying Tree. The demonic power of the Undying Tree was much more refined, and though the realm had not yet broken through, compared to before, the efficiency of demonic power circulation significantly improved, and the strength that could be exerted greatly increased.
Yuan Ming was momentarily taken aback, then a smile appeared at the corner of his mouth.
Ten Thousand Wood Origin Power unexpectedly had these effects; no wonder the Void cared so much about this piece of World Tree bark.
At this moment, the massive demonic body of the Undying Tree suddenly underwent a new transformation.
The Undying Tree's demonic power, along with the impurities in its body, has been refined, strengthening its connection with Yuan Ming, and the operation of the Ju Mang Spirit Technique is now several times faster than before.
The previously rampant branches and leaves gradually contracted, transforming into a head and limbs, and the sturdy trunk also condensed and slowly outlined the shape of a torso.
A moment later, the towering Undying Tree completely disappeared, replaced by a wooden man, several tens of zhang tall, stark naked.
Its features bore a striking resemblance to Yuan Ming's, but its skin was black, just like the Undying Tree.
Yuan Ming was stunned; the situation before him had exceeded the scope of the Ju Mang Spirit Technique.
The Ju Mang Spirit Technique can establish connections between a cultivator and their lifebound spirit plant, allowing mutual influence, yet both remain independent entities. However, the Undying Tree now seemed to truly merge with him.
Yuan Ming felt the changes within his own body, instinctively raising his hand and stamping his foot, and even these slight movements caused the air to ripple in an instant.
The suddenly augmented power made it somewhat difficult for him to control at first, signifying that this power has already exceeded the limits achievable by the Returning Void.
Yuan Ming clenched his fist and unleashed a full-force punch.
The void emitted a piercing shriek as the massive fist cut through, leaving a white streak as if tearing space itself.
Yuan Ming felt a thrill; although the sudden change had caught him off guard, with this wooden body, he was confident in facing off with Dharma Phase cultivators directly.
However, the limitation of mana still persisted; the wooden form of Yuan Ming lacked endurance, and the damage he could inflict upon the Dharma Phase remained rather limited.
Nonetheless, having such an additional trump card still left Yuan Ming satisfied.
He familiarized himself with the wooden body a bit more, then reverted from the Undying Tree transformation back to his original form.
At that moment, Yuan Ming unexpectedly discovered that even his original body's mana and Qi-Blood power had undergone a certain degree of refinement and purification, calming much of the mana chaos caused by the Primordial True Skill.
Yuan Ming's spirit instantly perked up, and he hurriedly inspected his internal state.
He saw the Power of Ten Thousand Wood Origin, which had been roaming and washing through the Undying Tree's body, now appearing within his own body. Although it seemed nearly depleted, it still managed to harmonize and reconcile Yuan Ming's chaotic mana, restoring it to its normal state.
However, this process only lasted a brief moment, after which the Power of Ten Thousand Wood Origin was completely exhausted, and Yuan Ming's mana no longer changed.
Seeing this, a flicker of regret crossed his mind, but it was quickly replaced by joy.
The greatest gain from absorbing the giant wooden man's corpse wasn't the increase in power, but discovering a method to enhance the bark of the World Tree: by devouring high-level spirit wood, the Power of Ten Thousand Wood Origin in the bark could be rapidly augmented.
Still, Yuan Ming felt it wasn't completely reliable, perhaps due to some uniqueness of the giant wooden man, and more verification was needed.
He waved his hand, causing seven to eight various-colored pieces of spirit wood to appear on the ground—these were the only high-level spirit wood he had left on him.
Yuan Ming activated the Undying Tree, and several roots shot out into the open, embedding themselves in these spirit woods, quickly absorbing them completely.
Yuan Ming operated the Ju Mang Spirit Technique, injecting the spiritual power transformed from the spirit woods into the bark of the World Tree, which greedily absorbed it, slightly enhancing the Power of Ten Thousand Wood Origin within.
He breathed a sigh of relief, confirming his hypothesis: the bark of the World Tree indeed needs high-level spirit wood.
And the Power of Ten Thousand Wood Origin can help Yuan Ming alleviate the mana chaos caused by the Primordial True Skill.
Thus, whether for the World Tree or for his own strength, searching for high-level spirit wood should be prioritized.
Yuan Ming pondered, gradually forming a plan in his heart.
"Master, the Dharma Manifestation Pill has been refined." At that moment, Hua Zhi's voice echoed in from outside the Medicine Garden.
"So fast? I just entered closed-door practice a few days ago." Yuan Ming waved his hand, creating a gap in the Forbidden around the Medicine Garden, allowing Hua Zhi to enter.
"It's almost been a month," Hua Zhi replied.
Yuan Ming realized that time always flies when high-level cultivators are practicing. He felt like he had just started absorbing the corpse, yet in the blink of an eye, a month had passed.
Yuan Ming nodded, summoned the Shura Stone Tablet, and headed to the Extreme Fire Realm, retrieving the freshly refined Dharma Manifestation Pill from Dian Xiaosan.
The pill's quality seemed even better than the one belonging to Yun Luo Fairy; its effects should be superior.
"Thank you, Master Dian, for your hard work." Yuan Ming expressed his gratitude and stored the White Jade Bottle containing the Dharma Manifestation Pill.
"Being able to personally refine this Dharma Manifestation Pill fulfills a wish I've had for many years. I'm glad I chose the right path, haha!" Dian Xiaosan waved his hand dismissively, letting out a hearty laugh.
"I may call on Master Dian's help again in the future," Yuan Ming smiled faintly.
"Whenever you have good elixir recipes and spiritual materials, just bring them over!" Dian Xiaosan's eyes lit up slightly, saying boldly.

chapters.title: Chapter 878 - 848: Retreat Again
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming bid farewell to Dian Xiaosan, and in a flicker, he disappeared from where he stood.
In the next moment, he had already left the Extreme Fire Realm and the Shura Palace, his figure now appeared on Lei Yu's back.
At this time, Lei Yu was gliding smoothly over the calm sea surface, with everything around swiftly flowing backward, but Yuan Ming knew they had not yet left the range of the Abyss.
The Abyss was too vast, and they had delved too deep searching for a Level 6 Demon Beast. Naturally, it would take longer to leave now.
Of course, with the prior experience, Lei Yu could now avoid some of the dangers here, without being entangled.
Yun Luo Fairy sat quietly on Lei Yu's neck, silently gazing at the sea scenery, seemingly lost in thought, unclear about what she was pondering.
"Fellow Daoist Yun Luo, thank you for guarding Lei Yu during this period," Yuan Ming approached and said.
"No problem, it's only been a month. How was Fellow Daoist Yuan's closed cultivation session?" Yun Luo Fairy came back to her senses, shook her head, and asked.
"I've made some small gains," Yuan Ming replied.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan has excellent aptitude, only your cultivation technique seems to have some issues, causing your mana to be slightly chaotic. Now it looks much more harmonious, it seems you have found a solution. Congratulations, it seems you won't take long to advance to the Dharma manifestation Stage," Yun Luo Fairy scanned Yuan Ming up and down, chuckling lightly.
"I've only recently advanced to the Late Stage of Returning Void, so talking about the Dharma manifestation Stage is still too early. As for the issue with my cultivation technique, I've found a temporary solution, taking one step at a time," Yuan Ming said.
Yun Luo Fairy nodded thoughtfully, turned her head to once more gaze at the distant, endless horizon, and appeared deep in thought.
"Fellow Daoist Yun Luo, you should probably return to the Central Continent next, right?" Yuan Ming turned to ask.
"Indeed, the Yun family has been waiting for me for a long time. Now it's time to rescue them," Yun Luo Fairy said in a quiet tone.
"With Fellow Daoist Yun Luo's current cultivation, the Su Nu Sect shouldn't trouble you, but to be on the safe side, I feel you should quietly extract your clansmen," Yuan Ming suggested.
"Thank you, Fellow Daoist Yuan, I will consider it," Yun Luo Fairy nodded and replied.
"Take these Communication Talismans, Fellow Daoist Yun Luo. If your journey encounters any trouble, you can inform me through them. I have a few friends on the Central Continent who may be able to assist," Yuan Ming took out three Void Communication Talismans and handed them over.
"Does that include the woman you like?" Yun Luo Fairy suddenly asked, without accepting the Void Communication Talismans, her bright eyes shimmering like autumn water, fixed directly on Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming paused slightly, then nodded.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan has not changed, still stone-hearted, not the slightest bit cherishing towards women," Yun Luo Fairy averted her gaze, chuckled softly.
Yuan Ming didn't respond, the air suddenly became quiet, leaving only the rustling sound of Lei Yu's wings slicing through the void.
"As I've already exited seclusion, leave Lei Yu to me. Fellow Daoist Yun Luo, you can rest for a bit," After a brief silence, Yuan Ming moved the Void Communication Talismans towards Yun Luo Fairy's hand and said.
Yun Luo Fairy said nothing, continuing to gaze into the distance.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming no longer spoke, moving to sit on the other side of Lei Yu's back, while releasing his Divine Sense to remain vigilant of the surroundings, and began contemplating his upcoming cultivation plan.
"Can you tell me about you and that woman?" Yun Luo Fairy's voice suddenly came, carrying a hint of melancholy.
Yuan Ming was surprised by Yun Luo Fairy's words, a flicker of astonishment passed through his eyes.
After witnessing Yun Luo Fairy's breakthrough to the Dharma manifestation Stage, he had gained some interest in the Su Nu Sect's Sutra of the Pure Woman, which he had learned about from Zi Mei.
The Sutra of the Pure Woman is a cultivation technique combining seduction techniques with Dual Cultivation arts, barely considered exquisite.
However, both seduction techniques and Dual Cultivation require the aid of Power of Seven Emotions, making the likelihood of Su Nu Sect disciples developing Heart Demons much higher than other cultivators.
The major taboo in cultivating the Sutra of the Pure Woman is not to fall genuinely in love with a man, else at best, one's Dao heart wavers, cultivation halts, worst, it leads to deviation, destroying one's Dao path.
Yun Luo Fairy had always remained calm, although she'd once made some flirtatious remarks, they were jokes, but now, does she really have feelings for him?
Or has breaking through to the Dharma manifestation Stage left her in an unstable state of mind?
"The Abyss' nature's spiritual energy is tumultuous, easily causing instability of mind. How about resting for a while inside the Flowers Map, Fellow Daoist Yun Luo?" Yuan Ming gently advised.
Yun Luo Fairy's expression turned cold, snorting, "I am well aware of the stability of my mind, I don't need reminding!"
Hearing this, Yuan Ming touched his nose awkwardly.
"I lost my composure, but I am very curious about your past with her, please would Fellow Daoist Yuan kindly share," Yun Luo Fairy took a deep breath, calming herself, and softly spoke.
Yuan Ming initially intended to refuse, but seeing the grievance in Yun Luo Fairy's eyes, softened his heart inexplicably.
After hesitating for a moment, he briefly recounted the past of his acquaintance and bonding with Xi Ying.
Of course, Yuan Ming omitted the inconvenient-to-disclose details and hid the fact that they came from the Yunhuang Continent.
"From what you said, she indeed seems to be an intelligent, brave, wise, and clear-minded extraordinary woman, no wonder Fellow Daoist Yuan pays no heed to any other women," Yun Luo Fairy was in a daze for a while, then smiled self-mockingly.
Yuan Ming offered a faint, noncommittal smile, without speaking a word.
The two sat side by side on Lei Yu's back, gazing at the boundless vast sea, silent for a long time.
"On this day of departure, speaking such dispiriting words, I hope Fellow Daoist Yuan will not mind." After a long while, Yun Luo Fairy suddenly laughed, then lifted her head again, her face returning to a playful expression, as if she had managed her emotions.
"How could I?" Yuan Ming felt a sense of relief in his heart and hurriedly replied with a smile.
"I should be going now, Fellow Daoist Yuan. In the future, if you have the chance to come to the Central Continent, you must remember to visit, so that I can fulfill the duties of a host." Yun Luo Fairy stood up.
"Certainly. If you encounter any trouble again when you return this time, you can also contact me. I will definitely do my best to help." Yuan Ming also stood up.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan has already saved me once. If I were to ask for your help again, I would have to repay the favor with my life." Yun Luo Fairy half-jokingly said, her emotions no longer fluctuating.
"Fellow Daoist Yun Luo has also helped me before, besides, between friends, there is no need for such formalities." Yuan Ming laughed.
"Since Fellow Daoist Yuan considers me a friend, if that time truly comes, I will not be polite with you. Just don't find me troublesome." Yun Luo Fairy said playfully.
With that, she did not wait for Yuan Ming's response, waved, and swiftly mounted her tunneling light, vanishing to the horizon in an instant.
Yuan Ming gazed in the direction she disappeared, after a silent moment, he let out a gentle breath, his gaze restored to complete tranquility.
In the following days, there were no waves; Lei Yu continued advancing with his flying escape, finally, a few days later, carrying Yuan Ming away from the Abyss Dead Land, returning to the Dongji Sea Area.
As before, Yuan Ming found a remote and concealed location to settle the Shura Palace.
Since the Dharma Manifestation Pill was already refined, this time Yuan Ming planned to have a good retreat, to fully prepare for breaking through to the Dharma manifestation Stage.
This retreat would not be short; Hua Zhi, Vajra, and Lei Yu did not want to stay in the Shura Palace with Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming naturally did not insist, letting them go out for free activities, and tasked them with finding the whereabouts of high-level spirit wood.
He then entered the Shura Palace and informed Sikong Zhan and others about his long-term retreat situation, instructing them to make preparations.
"Lord Nether Moon God, as for those mortals, as long as there is food and drink, it's fine. However, many cultivators have gathered in the Black Tower Space, especially those in the Returning Void stage, and they absorb nature's spiritual energy at a terrifying rate. Currently, the spiritual energy in the Black Tower Space is beginning to thin, which may not last long. Many people have started complaining." Sikong Zhan said.
Yuan Ming frowned, this indeed was a difficult problem.
Although the spiritual energy within the Black Tower Space would not be depleted immediately, if a solution wasn't found, it probably wouldn't last for a few years.
Even though those cultivators were suppressed by him, if he couldn't provide even a basic cultivation environment, over time it would be inevitable for someone to act out in desperation.
Moreover, he relied on these people to provide Desire Power and enhance various divine skills through possession, so he could not treat them too harshly.
"I will handle this matter." Yuan Ming said.
Sikong Zhan nodded in agreement and withdrew.
Yuan Ming went to the Medicine Garden Cave Mansion and began setting up.
Half a day later, he opened a space passage between the Medicine Garden and the Black Tower Space, infusing the nature's spiritual energy from the Medicine Garden into the Black Tower Space at a certain pace.
The Gathering Spirit Tree could absorb a limited amount of nature's spiritual energy, and with the Black Tower Space being too large, this action caused a considerable thinning of nature's spiritual energy in the Medicine Garden. However, it temporarily alleviated the spiritual energy issue in the Black Tower Space.
Though it didn't immediately enrich the Black Tower Space's spiritual energy, it was better than before and could be maintained for a hundred years or more.
"It seems that later on, if possible, I must find more Gathering Spirit Objects." Yuan Ming thought to himself.
Fortunately, he still had plenty of elixirs, and the thinning of nature's spiritual energy had little impact on his cultivation.
For Yuan Ming right now, collecting Desire Power wasn't urgent, thus he ordered his cultivators to cease their prayers and fully focus on cultivating various secret techniques and divine skills.
After arranging all of these, Yuan Ming began his retreat, focusing on cultivation, ignoring everything from the outside world unless actively contacted by Xi Ying and the others.
Time passed swiftly, and eighty years went by in a flash.
In the Shura Palace's Medicine Garden, Yuan Ming sat cross-legged with eyes closed, numerous objects floating around him, including magic treasures, stones, and blocks of wood.
He suddenly opened his eyes, formed a single-hand seal, and those objects started to shift and move frequently, appearing in mid-air and then landing on the ground, then to the back, almost without any pause.
Moreover, each moment, the locations these objects appeared were completely different, without discernible patterns.
Yuan Ming maintained this divine skill for two hours before ceasing the hand seals, letting out a long breath.
"Not bad, with the condensation of Dao Seal, the consumption of the Six Jia Qimen has significantly decreased, making it less mentally taxing to use." Yuan Ming pondered, his Divine Sense probing into his Dantian.
Within his Dantian, aside from the Dream Butterfly Dao Seal and All Living Beings Dream Seal, there were three other Dao Seals with distinct shapes, quietly floating.
One of them was the Six Jia Qimen Dao Seal, the other two were the Transplanting Technique and Circular Light Technique Dao Seals, respectively.

chapters.title: Chapter 879 - 849 Ten Thousand Treasure Auction
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming examined the three Dao Seals for about thirty minutes before shifting his gaze towards the thundering, spinning Mixed Hole Vortex. The surging mana fluctuations erupted from it were much stronger than before he went into seclusion.
In eighty years, besides condensing these three Dao Seals, Yuan Ming also elevated his cultivation to the peak of the Late Stage of Returning to Void, just a step away from breaking through to the Dharma Manifestation Stage.
He did not rush to attempt to break through to the Dharma Manifestation Stage but instead, as suggested by Xi Ying, aimed to condense a few more Dao Seals first to ensure greater gains upon breakthrough.
Yuan Ming activated the Circular Light Technique Dao Seal, and over a dozen white orbs appeared in front of him, each revealing the figures of Ye Wuya, Zi Mei, Qu Jiuhuang, and other Returning to Void cultivators.
After the Circular Light Technique condensed into a Dao Seal, not only did its detection range significantly increase, but it could also simultaneously monitor more than a dozen people, making it very efficient.
Inside those white orbs, Ye Wuya and the others were clearly divided into three groups. One group practiced the Golden Sunflower Beast Taming Technique, another was practicing Planting Beans into Soldiers, and the last group had a cluster of True Fire suspended before them, cultivating with their eyes, absorbing and refining, which was the Eyes of Golden Flame technique.
Over the years, he did not relax his refinement of the Stealing Heaven Tripod while cultivating, and now he has mastered seventy-five forbidden techniques.
As the layers of forbidden techniques he refined increased, the various divine skills of the Stealing Heaven Tripod subtly transformed. Yuan Ming, through constant exploration, accidentally discovered a new insight about Black Incense Possession: when comprehending Divine Power Secret Techniques, possessing multiple cultivators is far more effective than possessing just one.
The three Dao Seals Yuan Ming condensed during these eighty years, the Six Jia Qimen and Circular Light Technique came from Xi Ying, while the Transplanting Technique was condensed by simultaneously possessing Fei Shang, Yang Qing, and Chen Yuluan.
He initially passed the Transplanting Technique to Fei Shang, but unfortunately, Fei Shang's cultivation speed was too slow, so he then also taught it to Yang Qing and Chen Yuluan.
Although the three of them practiced diligently over these eighty years, the Transplanting Technique was too esoteric, and none of them was able to cultivate it to the Perfect Realm.
Yuan Ming took turns possessing the three of them for comprehension, and unexpectedly, his progress in the Transplanting Technique was much faster than any of the three.
At first, he was puzzled but later pondered deeply and summarized the reason behind it.
Even for the same divine skill, different people have different directions of understanding: some are specialized here, others excel there. With Black Incense Possession, Yuan Ming could gather all these experiences into himself. After synthesizing and comparing, his progress naturally accelerated.
As for the Golden Sunflower Beast Taming Technique, Eyes of Golden Flame, and Planting Beans into Soldiers, Yuan Ming was also practicing them using the same method to quickly condense Dao Seals.
He had already planned that the day when he cultivated these three divine skills to the Perfect Realm would be the time for him to break through to the Dharma Manifestation Stage.
As Yuan Ming turned these thoughts in his mind, he took a deep breath and began to circulate his soul power.
Soon, a massive black vortex appeared above his head, spinning with a rumbling sound. It was the divine skill awakened when he broke through to the Spoken Witch: Life and Death Reincarnation Path.
He previously learned from Xi Ying that the divine skills like Crow Cry, Emotion Manipulation, Life and Death Reincarnation Path, and Shared Fate for Body Cultivation could also elevate one's realm and eventually condense into Dao Seals.
These divine skills were Yuan Ming's innate divine abilities, which he naturally did not want to miss.
Unfortunately, no one else had these divine skills and couldn't be cultivated through possessing others, so he had to think and practice them on his own.
His comprehension was far less than Xi Ying's, and despite many years' comprehension, his improvement was still limited. How many more years it would take to condense Dao Seals was unknown, and it certainly wouldn't be completed before breaking through to the Dharma Manifestation Stage. He could only study and explore slowly, hoping to succeed someday.
Of course, if he could encounter other fortuitous encounters or opportunities in the future, perhaps he could significantly speed up the condensation of Dao Seals.
Soon, Yuan Ming became immersed in cultivating the Life and Death Reincarnation Path, with time slipping away unnoticed until a message suddenly arrived from the nearby Void Communication Array.
Yuan Ming ceased his cultivation, raised his hand to send a spell towards the Void Communication Array, and the Blood Flames flickered for a moment before revealing Hua Zhi's face.
"Master, I've found some good news!" Hua Zhi said excitedly.
"What news? Let's hear it," Yuan Ming replied casually.
"It's about high-level spirit wood. I heard that in another half a year, the Five-Hundred-Year Ten Thousand Treasure Auction will be held on East Extreme Island. Not only will the island masters of the Dongji Sea gather, but it's said that even cultivators from Luo Jia Mountain and Azure Dragon Pond, and even from the Central Continent will come to participate. There will be plenty of treasures, and the high-level spirit wood you need isn't a rare item; quite a few will surely appear then!" Hua Zhi said with some excitement in her voice.
Yuan Ming pondered for a moment, recalling the information he had gathered while serving as the master of Spiritual Ape Island.
The so-called "Ten Thousand Treasure Auction" mentioned by Hua Zhi was actually more akin to a grand festival in the Dongji Sea Area, jointly held by Dongji Palace, Luo Jia Mountain, and Azure Dragon Pond. The specific hosting location was also rotated among the three, with the last one five hundred years ago held in the depths of Azure Dragon Pond, and now it was East Extreme Island's turn.
The greatest feature of this auction was the presence of many individuals from the Central Continent, ensuring that treasures from both Central Continent and other regions would appear at the event. After each auction, many cultivators from the Central Continent were so enamored by the scenery that they chose to stay and become a part of the Dongji Sea Area.
All of these individuals, without exception, became prime targets for recruitment by the major sect forces of the Dongji Sea Area, as they not only possessed impressive personal strength but also often had significant family or sect backgrounds from the Central Continent.
It is said that this is also the true purpose of the three major forces holding this auction, to attract talent from the Central Continent, which is quite a painstaking effort.
Yuan Ming felt a joy in his heart; at such a grand gathering, the high-level spirit wood he wanted would surely not be hard to find.
However, firstly, he was still a wanted man, and rashly going to East Extreme Island could pose significant risk. Secondly, he was currently somewhat short on funds.
The trip to Emperor Yan's Tomb, and the subsequent battle on Wuya Island, saw Yuan Ming slaying many Returning Void cultivators and seizing a lot of spirit stones.
Yet, maintaining so many people in the Black Tower Space, and cultivating various divine skills, cost quite a bit. Hua Zhi, Vajra, and others had also spent much spirit stone seeking high-level spirit wood outside, so now he calculated that he had only four million spirit stones in total.
These spirit stones are not considered few to the various Returning Void cultivators, but far from enough to bid against the cultivators hailing from great powers like Dongji Palace and Azure Dragon Pond.
What Yuan Ming required was also considered precious to Returning Void cultivators, and the quantity needed would be large, so relying on four million spirit stones would definitely not suffice. Deciding to participate would pose a major challenge.
In contrast, having mastered the Transmutation Technique, the problem of appearance and identity had become easier to address.
Yuan Ming asked Hua Zhi to continue to gather information, then began pondering ways to gather spirit stones.
After much contemplation and hesitation, he eventually raised his hand and summoned the Vow Power Pills condensed from the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
"Looks like I can only sell this," Yuan Ming murmured to himself.
He had long since investigated, discovering that in terms of soul power and purity, the Vow Power Pills exceeded high-grade Soul Refining Pills.
A single high-grade Soul Refining Pill could be sold for a high price of a million spirit stones, and Vow Power Pills could sell for even more.
All the Vow Power Pills he owed to the Void had been repaid in full, and he currently had nearly a hundred pills stocked. Even selling just half would fetch him a fortune, enough to buy however much high-level spirit wood he needed.
"If you want to expose the Stealing Heaven Tripod, feel free to sell the Vow Power Pills." Suddenly, Void's voice rang in Yuan Ming's Sea of Consciousness.
"What do you mean by that, Senior?" Yuan Ming asked, stunned.
"Vow Power Pills and Soul Refining Pills are fundamentally different. Most people can't see the difference, but there are always some who can. And as luck would have it, Xia Jie also harbored the idea of selling Vow Power Pills and even acted on it. Although his customers were all on the Central Continent, this time the Ten Thousand Treasure Auction includes participants from there. If they discover it, your secret won't be safe," Void sternly warned.
Yuan Ming frowned slightly; was this rare opportunity to make money going to slip away just like that?
"The composition of Vow Power Pills and Soul Refining Pills is similar. If I re-refine the Vow Power Pills according to the method for refining Soul Refining Pills, should that deceive everyone?" After much deliberation, he suddenly inquired.
"That might just work," Void replied after a moment of surprise.
The moment Yuan Ming heard this, he felt relieved and went into the Extreme Fire Realm to find Dian Xiaosan, handing him the task of re-refining the Vow Power Pills.
"Re-refining? Fellow Daoist Yuan, you must be joking. These Soul Refining Pills are rare for their purity, utterly deserving to be called top-grade. If you re-refine them, the soul power contained will inevitably be damaged, maintaining just high-grade would be the best outcome," Dian Xiaosan frowned immediately upon hearing the request.
"That's even better. Also, Master Dian, when you re-refine them, add some demon souls in as well," Yuan Ming said, taking out the Night Parade of Hundred Demons, which harbored many demon beast souls.
"Why? Doing so will decrease the quality of the pills again, and even keeping them at high-grade would be uncertain," Dian Xiaosan puzzledly asked.
"Master Dian, there's no need to worry, just follow my instructions. I have my own plans for these pills, and if the quality is too high, it's actually unsuitable," Yuan Ming smiled.
Upon hearing this, Dian Xiaosan still seemed somewhat unwilling, his eyes full of regret that treasures were being squandered. Yuan Ming had to persuade him repeatedly before Dian Xiaosan finally agreed.
Dian Xiaosan, having refined Soul Refining Pills before, found that re-refining the Vow Power Pills took an additional step and more time.
It took him three months to finally produce ten high-grade Soul Refining Pills.
After the re-refining, especially with the addition of demon beast soul power, the pill's appearance and aura bore no resemblance to the original form, beyond even his recognition, leaving no worries of being discovered.
Looking at the ten high-grade Soul Refining Pills, a smile finally broke on Yuan Ming's face.
Ten high-grade Soul Refining Pills could convert to at least ten million spirit stones, giving him confidence in purchasing high-level spirit wood.
He instructed Dian Xiaosan to continue refining Soul Refining Pills, then immediately employed the Transmutation Technique to completely change his appearance and physique, setting off straight for East Extreme Island.

chapters.title: Chapter 880 - 850 The Way to Treat Guests
chapters.content:
Dongji Islands.
As the date of the Ten Thousand Treasure Auction approaches, the buildings on several islands have been renovated, adorned with lights and colors. Magical barriers shoot into the sky, with beautiful female cultivators bustling among them, creating a vibrant and lively scene.
Dongji Palace has spared no expense in arranging and promoting this auction event to attract more people, especially the cultivators from the Central Continent.
The number of cultivators visiting East Extreme Island has multiplied several times, with long lines at the entrances of several islands.
A black tunneling light shot from afar, quickly landing at the end of the cultivator queue on West Union Island, revealing the figure of a young man in black.
"Haven't been here in over a hundred years, and quite a lot has changed," the young man murmured to himself as he looked towards West Union Island.
The young man was none other than Yuan Ming, who had disguised himself using the Transmutation Technique. His cultivation was suppressed to the Nascent Soul Early Stage to avoid drawing attention.
Having set out from near the Abyss, it took him more than two months to finally reach the Dongji Islands, just in time for the auction event.
Despite the numerous cultivators at the entrance, the island entry procedures were swift, and it soon came to Yuan Ming's turn.
"Is this your first time to East Extreme Island, or are you renewing a passage certificate?" an elderly man in a circular hall responsible for processing entry permits asked routinely, although the staff had changed.
"I am Wan Tianren, here for the first time to attend the Ten Thousand Treasure Auction and would like to process a temporary passage certificate," Yuan Ming replied smoothly, providing the necessary information and handing over Spirit Stones.
"This doesn't seem like your first time," the elder remarked, giving Yuan Ming a surprised glance. He took out a blank passage token, recorded the information, and paused before handing it over.
"I've heard a friend explain the rules here," Yuan Ming smiled, discreetly channeling the Undying Tree's demonic power into the token.
In an instant, a black light flickered across the token, and the name "Wan Tianren" appeared.
"A devil cultivator?" the elder muttered, though he seemed unsurprised.
Aside from demon cultivators, Dongji Sea is also home to special cultivators practicing the Demon Clan's cultivation techniques, known as devil cultivators. Azure Dragon Pond is a faction of the Demon Clan, and many Human Clan's cultivators have joined them, increasing the number of devil cultivators.
Due to Azure Dragon Pond, devil cultivators in Dongji Sea are considered outliers but not as reviled as demon cultivators.
"This passage token is only valid for one month. After that, Fellow Daoist, you must either renew the certificate or leave," the elder nodded slightly, handing over the token with a reminder.
Yuan Ming was already aware of this. He collected the token and headed toward the Light Gate for island entry.
As he stepped through the Light Gate, a power mixed with divine sense enveloped his body, meticulously inspecting his physical body and mana.
This power was entirely different from what Yuan Ming had encountered on his first visit. He even sensed a sharpness comparable to Dharma Phase cultivators.
Yuan Ming felt a slight chill in his heart; as expected, Dongji Palace had increased their entry inspection intensity. Fortunately, the Transmutation Technique was incredibly effective, completely altering the physique, with only the underlying Qi Blood Power retaining a trace of its original imprint, everything else was entirely different.
His main soul had already retreated into the Stealing Heaven Tripod's space, and all mana was hidden within the Undying Tree. At this moment, his Dantian stored Nascent Soul-level Undying Tree Demon Power.
Such perfect measures ensured that even if Ouyang Qiang personally checked, she wouldn't find any flaws.
Indeed, the restriction power quickly withdrew. Throughout, Yuan Ming maintained a calm demeanor and continued walking, eventually passing through the Light Gate and stepping onto the Dongji Islands.
Only then did Yuan Ming secretly let out a sigh of relief.
After all, this was the heartland of Dongji Palace, and he dared not be careless. After confirming there was no exposure, he headed straight to the Ten Thousand Goods Immortal Trip on West Union Island.
With only a few days left before the auction officially began, he needed to sell his High Grade Soul Refining Pill quickly, or the trip would have been in vain.
East Extreme Island, with the strongest financial power and capability to purchase the Soul Refining Pill, had to be the Ten Thousand Goods Immortal Trip.
A century's time for Yuan Ming was merely some seclusion periods, but for those low-level cultivators serving as clerks in the workshop shops, it might encompass a lifetime.
When Yuan Ming once again stepped into the Ten Thousand Goods Immortal Trip, the female cultivators responsible for welcoming guests were still young and beautiful, yet all unfamiliar faces.
Yuan Ming felt a slight nostalgic pang but didn't dwell on it and headed straight to the Elixir Medicine Area.
The young female cultivator who had previously introduced him to the Soul Refining Pill was nowhere to be seen, replaced by two others—one a beautiful, graceful married woman, and the other a tall, young maiden, with an excellent figure and lovely features.
The Elixir Medicine Area currently had no customers. The two women were chatting closely, appearing quite friendly.
"Dear guest, what elixir would you like to purchase?" Seeing Yuan Ming approach, the beautiful married woman hastily stopped her conversation and came forward to greet him.
"I'm not buying elixirs; I have elixirs to sell," Yuan Ming shook his head, concisely stating his purpose.
The beautiful married woman was momentarily stunned, then after giving Yuan Ming a brief once-over, she smiled as before, "I see. Qing'er, I remember you've been learning the Elixir Inspection Skill for some time. Why don't you take a look at this guest's elixirs?"
The tall young maiden nodded and was about to step forward.
"It's inconvenient to display here with so many eyes. I've heard the Ten Thousand Goods Immortal Trip has a Pill Assessment Pavilion reputed to appraise any elixir in the world. We should look at it there," Yuan Ming glanced around and casually suggested.
The High Grade Soul Refining Pill has a strong soul power. Taking it out here will surely attract a crowd.
"The Pill Assessment Pavilion is an essential place for our industry. If the customer's elixir is not selected there, they have to pay a considerable appraisal fee," the beautiful young woman said, frowning slightly and speaking tactfully.
"I am aware, and I ask Fellow Daoist to lead the way," Yuan Ming said, unmoved.
"The Elixir Appraisers in the Pill Assessment Pavilion are all masters from our Ten Thousand Goods Immortal Trip. To have them appraise an elixir, it costs at least two thousand Spirit Stones, so you should think it over carefully," the tall young woman said coldly, seemingly displeased with Yuan Ming's attitude.
"Elixir Appraiser?" Yuan Ming was slightly taken aback, as he hadn't heard of such a position before.
"Fellow Daoist may not have heard of it. As the name suggests, an Elixir Appraiser is someone who evaluates elixirs. They can deduce the quality, age, and potency of the elixir through its appearance and scent, and skillful Elixir Appraisers can even infer the Dan Recipe from appraising the elixir," the beautiful young woman explained.
Yuan Ming suddenly understood. The Overseas World was indeed prosperous, with even such professions.
"It's fine, let's take it over," he said calmly.
"In that case, Qing'er, take this guest to the Pill Assessment Pavilion," the beautiful young woman instructed.
"Sister Ling, I haven't finished talking about the Bright Face Dew for the upcoming auction..." the tall young woman said.
"We'll discuss it next time. The store's matters take precedence. Since you're here to work, you must follow the rules here," the beautiful young woman said with a slight sternness.
"Alright," the tall young woman reluctantly agreed and walked inside, followed by Yuan Ming.
The two walked through several passages and soon arrived at a pavilion filled with the scent of elixirs, with a plaque reading "Pill Assessment Pavilion" above.
"Fellow Daoist, hand over the elixir to me, and I'll take it in for appraisal," the tall young woman said, extending her hand.
The Ten Thousand Goods Immortal Trip had a large and reputable business, and Yuan Ming was not worried about them taking his elixir. He took out a white Jade Bottle sealed with a talisman and handed it over.
The tall young woman took it and walked in without looking back, leaving Yuan Ming outside.
Yuan Ming looked around and saw a pavilion not far away, where he walked over and sat down.
Time passed slowly, and soon an hour had gone by without any movements from within the Pill Assessment Pavilion.
"What's going on? It's just an elixir appraisal; does it need to take so long?" Yuan Ming frowned, extending a finger and flicking it gently.
A white light sphere appeared in front of him, revealing the image of the tall young woman inside, chatting leisurely with a middle-aged man in luxurious clothing in the Pill Assessment Pavilion, without any appraisal happening.
Yuan Ming's expression darkened slightly. With his cultivation, while he wouldn't argue with juniors, he wouldn't let others treat him lightly either.
He took out another white Jade Medicine Bottle and infused mana into it.
The powerful soul power of the High Grade Soul Refining Pill spread out, transmitting into the Pill Assessment Pavilion.
Inside the pavilion, the luxuriously dressed man talking with the tall young woman suddenly sensed something and stood up immediately.
"Such pure soul power fluctuations, it seems to be a Soul Refining Pill, and not of low grade. Could it be that Elder Tian's Soul Refining Pill has improved?" the luxuriously dressed man murmured to himself.
"Uncle Gu, what's wrong?" the tall young woman asked upon seeing this.
"Qing'er, I was just thinking, you suddenly coming to the Pill Assessment Pavilion—is it that the firm has received new elixirs for appraisal?" the luxuriously dressed man asked.
"No... Ah, how could I forget that person!" the tall young woman exclaimed softly, recalling Yuan Ming outside.
"Which one?" the luxuriously dressed man asked.
"A Nascent Soul cultivator outside, overestimating his abilities, who learned alchemy for a few days and thought he was an Alchemy Master, came demanding the Pill Assessment Pavilion to appraise his elixir. It's this one," the tall young woman said, taking out the medicine bottle Yuan Ming gave her.
"Even so, you shouldn't have kept him waiting outside for so long. That's not how the Ten Thousand Goods Immortal Trip treats guests. Quickly invite him in," the luxuriously dressed man admonished.
The tall young woman playfully stuck out her tongue. She indeed found Yuan Ming somewhat disagreeable and intentionally left him hanging for a bit, as a small act of revenge. However, she became so engrossed in her conversation with the luxuriously dressed man that she completely forgot about Yuan Ming.
She agreed with a nod and headed outside.
The luxuriously dressed man watched her, sighing with a bit of disappointment, then turned his gaze to the Jade Bottle in his hand.
The quality of the Jade Bottle was ordinary, with nothing more than a common Sealing Talisman on it, which hinted at the quality of the elixirs inside.
Regardless, since he came, he was a guest. This had little to do with the elixir's quality and more with an attitude toward guests and the firm's reputation.
The luxuriously dressed man shook his head slightly, casually peeled off the talisman on the Jade Bottle, and removed the stopper.
Instantly, a powerful soul power fluctuation emanated from within. Although the luxuriously dressed man was a Returning to Void Cultivator, his body still trembled slightly.
(Fellow Daoists, Wang Yu is attending the annual meeting of the platform, so there will be only one update these two days.)

chapters.title: Chapter 881 - 851: Suspicion
chapters.content:
The tall girl hadn't walked far when she sensed movement behind her and hurriedly turned back to look.
"This... this is a Soul Refining Elixir, and it's of high grade!" the man in elegant clothes exclaimed.
"High Grade Soul Refining Elixir! How is that possible? That person outside is just a Nascent Soul Early Stage Cultivator!" The tall girl quickly returned, speaking in disbelief.
"There's no mistake, this is definitely a high grade Soul Refining Elixir, the Soul Power is exceptionally pure, even better than the ones refined by our main branch's Alchemy Master! Where is that person? Quickly take me to them!" The man in elegant clothes corked the bottle urgently said.
The tall girl, her face alternately turning pale and red, led the man in elegant clothes outside.
The two quickly arrived outside and immediately saw Yuan Ming sitting in the pavilion, playing with a white jade medicine bottle.
The man in elegant clothes had already regained a calm expression, raised his fists in salute from afar, and warmly said, "Honored guest, I apologize for any negligence, please forgive us."
"You must be the Elixir Appraiser of the Pill Assessment Pavilion? I presume you've seen my elixir. I wonder if it suits your Immortal Trip?" Yuan Ming put away the white jade medicine bottle he was holding and asked.
"The quality of Fellow Daoist's elixir is superb, naturally, we want it. The young ones didn't know better and neglected Fellow Daoist. I've already scolded them harshly, please forgive them." The man in elegant clothes said, giving a signal to the tall girl beside him.
"I was negligent, treating the honored guest improperly. I apologize." The tall girl bowed her head, saluting lowly.
"No need. I came today to sell elixirs, let's get down to business quickly." Yuan Ming waved his hand and said.
"Fellow Daoist is right, please come in quickly." The man in elegant clothes hastily said, welcoming Yuan Ming into the Pill Assessment Pavilion, leaving the tall girl outside alone.
The girl's face looked quite unhappy. She stomped lightly and headed to the shop in front.
"I am Gu Xingdong, serving here as the steward. May I ask for Fellow Daoist's esteemed name? How many more of those elixirs do you have?" The man in elegant clothes led Yuan Ming to an elegant room and personally served him a cup of Spiritual Tea.
"Wan Tianren." Yuan Ming nodded, reported a pseudonym, and with a wave of his hand, eight white jade porcelain bottles appeared on the elegant pavilion's table.
He then also placed the one he was holding on the table.
Gu Xingdong restrained his inner excitement upon seeing this, keeping a calm face, he picked up the nine bottles and used his Divine Sense to inspect them one by one, his heart filled with shock.
"They are all High Grade Soul Refining Pills! Judging from their appearance, they were refined not long ago. When did the Dongji Sea produce someone capable of refining such elixirs?"
"It seems Fellow Daoist Gu is indeed a connoisseur." Yuan Ming smiled slightly.
"Please forgive me, this elixir is truly rare. My elixir inspection skill is quite average and further identification is needed, please wait here for a moment while I invite the best Alchemy Master of our firm." Gu Xingdong immediately said.
"Fine, but I have other matters to attend to, so I will wait for a quarter of an hour at most," Yuan Ming said.
Gu Xingdong did not say much more, nodded, and hurried out of the room.
He did not keep Yuan Ming waiting long, soon returning with a young man with a complexion as fair as jade.
"This is Master Tong Xin of our firm, not only an Elixir Appraiser but also a Level 5 Alchemist," Gu Xingdong introduced.
Yuan Ming wasn't concerned about the visitor's identity, nodded towards him, and let him begin identifying the elixirs he had brought.
"Whew... indeed high grade Soul Refining Elixirs! The Soul Power in these elixirs exceeds that of ordinary ones by twenty percent and their purity is also a level higher—the finest I've seen in my life." After Tong Xin's appraisal, he showed a look of admiration.
Yuan Ming nodded secretly, realizing that Tong Xin was an honest person and didn't devalue the Soul Refining Elixirs intentionally.
"Forgive my impertinence, Fellow Daoist Wan, could you tell me which Alchemy Master created these ten Soul Refining Pills?" Tong Xin asked, cupping his hands.
"Does Fellow Daoist Tong intend to probe my secrets?" Yuan Ming inquired.
"Forgive me, Fellow Daoist Wan, however, High Grade Soul Refining Elixirs are extremely important to Ten Thousand Goods Immortal. If you have a stable supply, we wish to continue purchasing them," Tong Xin said.
"These elixirs were refined by an elder of mine. He's solitary by nature and forbids me from revealing his name. As for future transactions, I cannot guarantee them—it depends entirely on my elder's mood." Yuan Ming shook his head and said.
Tong Xin looked visibly disappointed upon hearing this.
"Now that the appraisal is done, shouldn't we discuss the price?" Yuan Ming returned to the topic.
"Certainly! According to market value, a High Grade Soul Refining Pill is about a million Spirit Stones each. Considering the superior quality of yours, would one hundred and twenty thousand Spirit Stones each work for you?" Gu Xingdong spoke up, offering a price.
Meanwhile, Tong Xin turned and went into the inner chamber.
"One million five hundred thousand per pill, High Grade Soul Refining Pills are already without a market price, and with your widespread channels, selling them would only fetch a higher price." Yuan Ming immediately shook his head.
Before coming, he had already discussed the pricing of these pills with Dian Xiaosan, according to Dian Xiaosan's own calculations, one million five hundred thousand should be the bottom line for Ten Thousand Goods Immortal Trip.
As expected, upon hearing Yuan Ming's offer, Gu Xingdong displayed a deeply conflicted expression.
"If Fellow Daoist Gu feels the price is unsuitable, no problem, I can ask other merchants." Yuan Ming threw out a sentence.
"Alright, let's go with Fellow Daoist's offer." Gu Xingdong hurriedly said.
Yuan Ming smiled inwardly and pushed all ten bottles of Soul Refining Pills across.
The transaction of a whole fifteen million Spirit Stones wasn't a simple process. Once the deal was made, Gu Xingdong immediately went to allocate the Spirit Stones, and only after waiting nearly an hour did he return with a Storage Ring.
"The Spirit Stones are all inside, please Fellow Daoist verify them. Additionally, here is a Minister Token from Ten Thousand Goods Immortal Trip. Whether buying or selling, Fellow Daoist can present this token to any branch of ours, and they will prioritize your needs, offering up to a twenty percent discount." Gu Xingdong said as he handed the Storage Ring and the token to Yuan Ming.
"Fellow Daoist Gu is thoughtful, I happen to have two items that I would like your esteemed establishment to help me locate." Yuan Ming checked the number of Spirit Stones in the Storage Ring, looked at the token, put both items away, and said.
"Fellow Daoist Wan please speak directly, what two items are you looking for?" Gu Xingdong smiled upon hearing there was more business.
"Nine Nether Iron, and any type of high-level Spirit Wood. Does your esteemed establishment have stock?" Yuan Ming asked.
"Our Ten Thousand Goods Immortal Trip's business spans the Chuyun Realm, unmatched by other merchants. Although what Fellow Daoist Wan seeks are precious items, our store happens to have them. How much does Fellow Daoist need? I will have someone fetch them right away." Gu Xingdong laughed.
The person before him had just made off with over tens of millions of Spirit Stones from Ten Thousand Goods Immortal Trip; he would not be lenient, aiming to earn back as much as possible!
"Quantity is not limited, the more the better!" Yuan Ming showed a joyful expression.
Gu Xingdong, keen on making a profit, was taken aback by this statement.
Though the branch in Dongji Sea of Ten Thousand Goods Immortal Trip had Nine Nether Iron and high-level Spirit Wood, the quantity was not very large, especially the Nine Nether Iron, with only four or five pieces. This boast turned out to be a self-imposed trap.
"Ahem, although the store has Nine Nether Iron and high-level Spirit Wood, the quantity is not much. However, please rest assured, Fellow Daoist Wan, I will notify nearby branches to acquire these two items for you. When the time comes, should they be delivered to your residence or will you come collect them yourself?" Gu Xingdong said with a dry cough.
"After the auction, I will personally come to collect them. Fellow Daoist Gu, please do your utmost in gathering them. If there's difficulty, use the Communication Talisman to inform me." Yuan Ming took out a Communication Talisman and placed it on the table.
"Alright, within the store we have high-level Spirit Wood and Nine Nether Iron; would Fellow Daoist Wan like to take them?" Gu Xingdong agreed naturally and immediately asked.
"No need, I require a large quantity, a small amount is meaningless. I will collect them all after the auction." Yuan Ming shook his head and said.
"Alright! Also, there's one more thing. In two days, we will hold a small trade meeting as a prelude to the Ten Thousand Treasure Auction, where numerous treasures will appear, attended by known cultivators of Dongji Sea. Fellow Daoist Wan, with your wealth, if interested, you are welcome to participate." Gu Xingdong extended an invitation.
Yuan Ming, upon hearing this, had little interest in attending.
Currently, he only desired Nine Nether Iron and high-level Spirit Wood, which Ten Thousand Goods Immortal Trip had promised to help collect. Attending the trade meeting would not yield substantial results.
Moreover, with the Ten Thousand Treasure Auction officially yet to start, securing his assets with fewer appearances would be safer.
"Yuan, don't refuse too quickly. This trade meeting will showcase something you urgently need." At that moment, Kong's voice suddenly sounded.
"Something I need? Could it be high-level Spirit Wood?" Yuan Ming immediately asked.
But just like on numerous occasions before, after Kong's reminder, there was no further response.
Yuan Ming, helpless, could only temporarily set aside his thoughts and agreed to Gu Xingdong's invitation.
After exchanging pleasantries with Gu Xingdong, he left Ten Thousand Goods Immortal Trip.
Gu Xingdong walked into the inner room where Tong Xin was seated quietly, holding a white Jade Bottle.
"Mr. Tong, this Wan Tianren seems suspicious." Gu Xingdong said softly to Tong Xin.
"Why do you say that?" Tong Xin poured out a Soul Refining Pill from the bottle and scrutinized it closely.
"The Wan Tianren from earlier, I've never seen him in Dongji Sea. A Nascent Soul Early Stage Cultivator capable of producing such high-level pills, isn't it suspicious? Also, not long ago Dongji Palace issued a new wanted notice concerning Yuan Ming to our large associations, asking us to monitor any alchemists or Array Masters who suddenly appear. Do you think this person might be Yuan Ming in disguise?" Gu Xingdong put forth his conjecture.
"You're overthinking it. Dongji Island is currently loose on the outside but tight on the inside, and Ouyang Qiang personally altered the necessary Light Gate to enter the island. If Wan Tianren were indeed Yuan Ming, he certainly wouldn't pass that test." Tong Xin shook his head, not believing his theory.
"Yuan Ming is someone who took the Pill King Pavilion Inheritance, not an ordinary Loose Cultivator; being able to evade Ouyang Qiang's secret technique scrutiny is reasonable. If he truly is Yuan Ming, this would be an immense opportunity for us." Gu Xingdong continued.

chapters.title: Chapter 882 - 852: The 3 Great Families
chapters.content:
"Put away those thoughts, there is no 'what if.' The Ten Thousand Treasure Auction is about to be held. There's nothing wrong with a mysterious alchemist showing up. Our Ten Thousand Goods Immortal Trip is a business; everything is business-oriented. No matter who Wan Tianren is or which force he opposes, as long as he's not a demon cultivator and wishes to trade with us, he's our guest! The reason why our Ten Thousand Goods Immortal Trip has stood firm in the Chuyun Realm is due to our reputation for integrity. Do you want to tarnish our Immortal Trip's reputation for a little benefit?" Tong Xin reprimanded sternly.
"Your instruction is correct." Gu Xingdong trembled and quickly bowed his head, saying.
"This is your last warning. If you make another mistake, you should return to the main office for punishment." Tong Xin said slowly.
"Yes, I had inappropriate thoughts." Gu Xingdong showed utter terror, kneeling on the ground as sweat poured down his face.
"You are an elder of the East Extreme Sea branch. As long as you remember everything should be for the Immortal Trip, consider this matter settled. Stand up." Tong Xin's tone softened.
Gu Xingdong wiped the sweat from his forehead and stood up.
"Take utmost care of the customer Wan Tianren. During the trade meeting in a few days, ensure everything goes smoothly to prevent our reputation from being damaged. When Fellow Daoist Wan comes, do not overly flatter him. He doesn't seem like someone who enjoys such praise, so be careful not to go overboard." Tong Xing further advised.
"Understood." Gu Xingdong immediately accepted the order.
"Moreover, I heard Wan Tianren had a minor conflict with Miss Qingqing when he first entered the store. You are tasked with resolving this matter. Ensure he doesn't develop a dislike for Ten Thousand Goods Immortal Trip." Tong Xin continued to instruct.
"Rest assured, Mr. Tong, I will handle it properly." Gu Xingdong replied.
...
On the other side, Yuan Ming left the Ten Thousand Goods Immortal Trip and did not continue visiting other commerce guilds. Instead, he rented a room at an inn on the island to stay temporarily.
Then, he set up two formations as a precaution and entered the Shura Palace, summoning Dian Xiaosan.
Before coming to East Extreme Island, he had inquired about any notable figures in the Ten Thousand Goods Immortal Trip from Dian Xiaosan, but Tong Xin's name was not mentioned.
"Oh, Tong Xin? He came to the East Extreme Sea too?" Dian Xiaosan was slightly surprised by Yuan Ming's inquiry.
"It seems Master Dian knows this person. Why didn't you mention him before?" Yuan Ming pursued the question.
"Don't be offended, Fellow Daoist Yuan. I didn't expect he would come to preside over the East Extreme Sea. After all, he is one of the store managers of Ten Thousand Goods Immortal Trip and rarely leaves Central Continent. Although his cultivation isn't very high, his business acumen is outstanding. It's said he has received recognition from the owner of Ten Thousand Goods Immortal Trip." Dian Xiaosan explained.
"Such a person suddenly coming to East Extreme Sea, could it be for the 'Pill King Secret Manual'?" Yuan Ming pondered aloud.
"Hard to say. The Ten Thousand Goods Immortal Trip's business is extensive but highly fragmented. It's normal for them to be eager for something related to a sect's legacy like the 'Pill King Secret Manual.' However, they highly value their reputation, so even if they covet the 'Pill King Secret Manual,' they probably won't act personally." Dian Xiaosan shook his head.
Yuan Ming nodded silently, then took out the token given by Gu Xingdong and touched the words "Guest Elder" with his finger.
"As I expected, Ten Thousand Goods Immortal Trip gave you a Minister Token. For ordinary big clients, they usually give out an Immortal Token, which only offers some price discounts. The Minister Token grants much greater privileges. With this, you can use many resources of the Ten Thousand Goods Immortal Trip, making things much more convenient." Dian Xiaosan said, clicking his tongue in wonder at the token in Yuan Ming's hand.
"I see. It seems Tong Xin really needs the High Grade Soul Refining Pill." Yuan Ming chuckled slightly, put away the token, and left the Shura Palace.
Two days later, at Ten Thousand Goods Immortal Trip.
Yuan Ming arrived as promised, and the moment he entered, a tall girl in a dark blue dress approached him. She turned out to be the female cultivator named "Qing'er," with whom he had a minor conflict earlier.
"Fellow Daoist Wan, welcome to the trade meeting. The meeting will be held in the Hanhai Hall, please follow me." Qing'er wore a bright smile, gesturing politely.
Though smiling, Yuan Ming clearly sensed her reluctance. It seemed due to their prior clash, and the high-level management of Ten Thousand Goods Immortal Trip forced her to host him, trying to resolve the tension.
Yuan Ming nodded slightly, letting Qing'er lead the way, as he subtly observed the Ten Thousand Goods Immortal Trip.
Because of the upcoming collaboration with Ten Thousand Goods Immortal Trip and the sudden arrival of Tong Xin, he used the Circular Light Technique and Black Incense Possession over the past two days to investigate the East Extreme Island's Ten Thousand Goods Immortal Trip thoroughly. He found that the branch had no intention to be hostile towards him, allowing him a slight breath of relief.
However, the fact that East Extreme Island could predict his attendance at the Ten Thousand Treasure Auction and unite all major forces on the island to seek him out made Yuan Ming feel uneasy.
Nearly a hundred years had passed, yet East Extreme Island's pursuit of him hadn't slacked at all!
Fortunately, since arriving on the island, he had only visited the Ten Thousand Goods Immortal Trip and then stayed hidden at the inn. East Extreme Island probably hadn't discovered his whereabouts yet.
Yuan Ming cleared his thoughts, looking at the girl in front of him, and asked, "Has the trade meeting started?"
"Yes, but Ten Thousand Goods Immortal Trip has prepared numerous treasures for this trading fair, which will last for a long time, so Fellow Daoist Wan doesn't need to worry about arriving late and missing out on good items," Qing'er said, maintaining her smile.
Yuan Ming frowned, "Fellow Daoist Shen, you don't need to force yourself to smile; just watching you makes me feel tired. The friction from the other day was a small matter, and I haven't given it much thought. There's no need for Ten Thousand Goods Immortal Trip's members to be so cautious."
Qing'er didn't expect Yuan Ming to say this suddenly and was momentarily stunned.
However, the girl immediately realized another issue, "You know me?"
"One of the three major families of Ten Thousand Goods Immortal Trip, the Shen family—who hasn't heard of them? I didn't expect the granddaughter of the Shen family head to personally come to such a remote place as the Dongji Sea," Yuan Ming said in a calm tone.
While investigating the Ten Thousand Goods Immortal Trip, he inadvertently learned about the situation of this girl in front of him.
The person before him was named Shen Qingqing, hailing from the Central Continent, a direct descendant of the Shen family, one of the three major families of the Ten Thousand Goods Immortal Trip. This time she came to the Ten Thousand Goods Immortal Trip branch on East Extreme Island to gain experience and build connections for future development.
The Ten Thousand Goods Immortal Trip's influence spans the Chuyun Realm, with countless subordinate branches, yet its foundation lies with the three powerful families from the Central Continent: the Hua, Shen, and Lei families.
These three families are immensely powerful, and any one of them is a colossal entity. It's because of these three strong backers that the Ten Thousand Goods Immortal Trip can remain unfaltering and always firmly occupy the top spot as the Chuyun Realm's premier commerce association.
"How do you know my name? Only a few people like Tong Xin, Gu Xingdong, and others know my identity. Where did you get your information?" Shen Qingqing stared intently at Yuan Ming, her eyes narrowed into slits.
"This expression suits you better; the forced smile doesn't work for you," Yuan Ming said with a smile, bypassing the girl and continuing to move forward.
Shen Qingqing watched Yuan Ming's back and quickly followed, her little face stern as she continued to lead the way.
The two soon arrived at another circular hall connected to the Ten Thousand Goods Immortal Trip shop.
This place was deserted, and a white Light Gate floated there, emanating waves of Space Power.
"The Void Gate, did your shop open a space secret realm?" Yuan Ming's eyes showed a curious expression.
"Fellow Daoist Wan, you overestimate it. It's just that land on West Union Island's workshop is precious, so we opened a small space to expand the shop area," Shen Qingqing explained, then took the lead and stepped in.
Yuan Ming's eyes flickered, and he stepped in as well.
His vision blurred for a moment, and he found himself in a massive hall, at least ten times the size of the Ten Thousand Goods Immortal Trip shop.
There were no excess items in the hall, only numerous jade stone exhibition stands surrounded by Forbidden light shields, showcasing various treasures in the center of the hall. Each stand had a mahogany placard in front and behind it: the front described the treasure, while the back recorded the items or Spirit Stones required for the trade.
There weren't many people browsing here, but upon scanning, they were mostly Returning Void existences, with the lowest cultivation being that of Nascent Soul cultivators.
"This seems unlike any trading fair I've heard of," Yuan Ming glanced around and couldn't help but feel curious.
"This is a specially designed trading method by our shop. You can directly place the items you wish to trade on the stand, and when someone wants to trade, we will handle it all, ensuring no privacy issues. Of course, with mutual consent from both parties, you can also meet the trader directly.
