Regardless of the choice, our shop doesn't charge extra fees, rest assured," Shen Qingqing explained in detail, having put away her fake smile and assumed her role as a Ten Thousand Goods Immortal Trip staff member.
"What if I'm not comfortable entrusting you with the treasures for safekeeping beforehand? Also, what if there is an error during storage or trade—will you compensate for it?" Yuan Ming asked.
"We certainly will compensate. Please trust in the reputation of our Immortal Trip. As for the prior concern, our shop provides special Illusion Arrays on the exhibition stand, allowing you to display a shadow of your treasure. However, choosing this service requires a small usage fee, so please be mindful," Shen Qingqing replied immediately.
"I see," Yuan Ming nodded, his gaze sweeping over the stands, searching for the item Senior Kong had mentioned.
Nearly all the items on display were rare, but unfortunately, he needed none of them.
Yuan Ming browsed most of the stone platforms in the hall but didn't find anything, and just as he intended to directly inquire with Kong, something on a jade platform in front caught his attention.
On the jade platform was a blue stone the size of a washbasin. It looked unassuming, yet the Spiritual Energy around it was so abundant, it almost condensed into a visible mist.
"Gathering Spirit Stone! And it's so large! What a good item! Senior Kong, is this what you mentioned earlier?" Yuan Ming suppressed the joy in his heart and communicated with Kong.
He had previously been troubled by the Shura Palace's lack of nature's spiritual energy and didn't expect to find a Gathering Spirit Object here.
If this Gathering Spirit Stone were placed in the Black Tower Space, it should significantly alleviate the scarcity of Spiritual Energy.

chapters.title: Chapter 883 - 853: Turmoil
chapters.content:
"Of course not. What's merely a Gathering Spirit Object? How could it bother me enough to remind you?" Void said irritably.
Yuan Ming, upon hearing this, became even more curious about the thing Void mentioned. But for now, it was essential to secure this Gathering Spirit Stone.
He glanced at the jade platform below the wooden sign of nanmu. This item didn't require barter; it was sold for a million Spirit Stones.
"I want this." Yuan Ming said.
Shen Qingqing, upon hearing this, took out a token and unlocked the Forbidden around the jade platform, taking the Gathering Spirit Stone out.
Yuan Ming happily paid the Spirit Stones and pocketed the Gathering Spirit Stone, placing it into the Black Tower Space of the Shura Palace, instructing Sikong Zhan to bury it somewhere underground beneath the Black Tower.
A Gathering Spirit Stone was already buried here, absorbing nature's spiritual energy from the Void and dispersing it throughout the Black Tower Space.
If not for this, the nature's spiritual energy within the space would have been absorbed dry by those Returning to Void Cultivators.
Though, this Gathering Spirit Stone was much smaller than the one Yuan Ming had just purchased and not particularly useful.
Yuan Ming ordered Sikong Zhan to bury this green Gathering Spirit Stone nearby, with both Gathering Spirit Stones working together, the increase in nature's spiritual energy was visible to the naked eye, flowing like a dark river towards various parts of the Black Tower Space, showing signs of forming a Spirit Vein.
Yuan Ming nodded to himself, then retracted his Divine Sense and continued forward.
Yuan Ming quickly surveyed the jade platforms in the hall, but did not find the object Void mentioned, calling out Void's name in his heart.
"Stop shouting, just keep going forward. The seventh display case on the left is where the thing you're looking for is." Void's impatient voice quickly rang out.
Following Void's advice, Yuan Ming looked over and soon saw the display case Void mentioned.
On the display case, there was a red crystal the size of a human head, externally resembling a precious pearl, with a flame-like red spirit light inside that flickered like breathing, offering a dreamy beauty.
"Red Shining Crystal, Fire Attribute Spiritual Material. After being combined into a Magic Treasure, it can increase the affinity for Fire Attribute Spiritual Power. It requires trade for top-grade Golden Light Iron or equivalent Spirit Stones for settlement... Senior, is this the thing you said I urgently need?" Yuan Ming read the introduction on the wooden sign, becoming increasingly confused.
"I was definitely not talking about this Red Shining Crystal itself, but about the Fiery Fire Essence Stone hidden inside it. You failed to detect even that. Your perception is still lacking!" Void, as usual, mercilessly mocked.
"Fiery Fire Essence Stone!" Yuan Ming was both surprised and delighted, his eyes showing a layer of Golden Light as he looked at the red crystal on the jade platform.
The Divine Skill of Eyes of Golden Flame was beginning to take shape for him, allowing him to see through some Forbidden, though not anything too profound.
Under Eyes of Golden Flame, the layers of the red crystal peeled away, revealing the innermost object.
This was a fist-sized fiery red crystal. Both its material and spiritual aura were almost identical to the Red Shining Crystal. Without Void's reminder, even if he had just used Eyes of Golden Flame, he likely wouldn't have noticed.
"I advise you to purchase it quickly to avoid complications later." Void spoke again.
Yuan Ming, though confused, trusted Void and didn't think much more, calling Shen Qingqing to prepare to buy this crystal.
At this moment, an untimely commotion suddenly erupted from the front.
Yuan Ming looked over to see a group approaching from afar, led by a young man dressed in a long robe of golden mystical silk, with a waist belt of deerskin agate, his face white as jade.
Regarding attire and demeanor, this person was quite ostentatious.
However, considering appearance, this white-faced young man was the most handsome person Yuan Ming had ever seen.
Beside the white-faced young man were four or five female cultivators, each of extraordinary beauty and unique demeanor, some fiery and passionate, others cold and aloof, slender and graceful, a feast for the eyes.
Outside the few female cultivators were more than a dozen black-clad guards whose cultivation was seemingly not low. Among them, a robust middle-aged man had Late-stage Nascent Soul Cultivation.
The white-faced young man held a female cultivator in his arm, laughing and joking loudly with the female cultivators, causing people to naturally avoid them wherever they went.
Others in the hall also noticed this group, and quickly started discussing.
"I wondered who it was; turns out it's that wastrel Nan Shangfeng, who spends all his time indulging in pleasure. Truly a disgrace to the Daluo Sect."
"Shh, keep it down. His master is the Daluo Sect Master."
"It's truly baffling. The Daluo Sect Master is such a figure; how can he tolerate someone behaving so outrageously outside?"
Yuan Ming listened to the nearby discussion, showing an incredulous expression. This white-faced young man was actually affiliated with the Daluo Sect.
The Daluo Sect was a cultivation sect in the Central Continent; he knew of it, though it wasn't as mighty as the Heavenly Saint Academy or the Taixuan Sect, it wasn't too far behind either.
Such a Central Continent powerhouse sending people to East Extreme Island—could it be about the Ten Thousand Treasure Auction?
Yuan Ming withdrew his gaze and looked at Shen Qingqing.
The female cultivator was also drawn by the group, her gaze fixed on Nan Shangfeng's handsome face.
"Fellow Daoist Shen, you're staring so intently; could it be you're interested in that Nan Shangfeng?" Yuan Ming teased with amusement.
Shen Qingqing snapped back to attention, her cheeks flushed red as she cast a fierce glare at Yuan Ming, then took out a token to open the prohibition on the Jade Platform.
Yuan Ming paid the Spirit Stone, took the Red Shining Crystal, and a smile appeared on his face.
The missing spiritual material for the Stealing Heaven Tripod was finally found.
Before he could put it away, a sweet and charming female voice suddenly rang out.
"Young master, this Crystal Stone is so beautiful. If it could be used to make Jade Pendants or some jewelry, it would surely look stunning."
Yuan Ming turned around, only to find Nan Shangfeng and his group had somehow arrived nearby. A stunning woman in Nan Shangfeng's arms looked at the Red Shining Crystal in Yuan Ming's hand, clutching the front of Nan Shangfeng's clothes, and said sweetly.
"Since my beauty fancies it, naturally I will comply. Fellow Daoist, would you let this item go to me? I'm willing to pay double the price." Nan Shangfeng patted the stunning woman's fragrant shoulder and said to Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming's heart surged with waves. Indeed, Senior Kong was right; someone was trying to seize the Red Shining Crystal from him!
"Senior Kong, I can barely understand how you divined the location of spiritual materials, perhaps through some secret technique, but how could you also foresee the actions of these people? Could it be that you can predict the future?" He glanced at Nan Shangfeng, ignored him, and transmitted his inquiry to Kong.
"Guess?" Kong chuckled.
Yuan Ming furrowed his brows, but was also helpless.
The people nearby were astonished, seeing Yuan Ming's wooden expression and ignoring Nan Shangfeng, even the laughing girls shut their mouths.
"You brat, my young master is speaking to you!" The robust guard in the lead shouted.
"This Red Shining Crystal has already been bought by me, and I'm unwilling to let it go; Fellow Daoist will have to be disappointed." Yuan Ming shook his head and said.
"It's loved by a beauty, please show some grace and part with it. I'm willing to offer triple compensation to you." Nan Shangfeng waved his hand grandly, displaying a demeanor unconcerned with money.
"This item is of great use to me, even ten times the price wouldn't sway me, Fellow Daoist need not waste words." Yuan Ming put away the Red Shining Crystal and headed toward the great hall's door.
The Fiery Fire Essence Stone was a must-have for him, and he couldn't let it go to others, despite the Daluo Sect's might, he, a mere Loose Cultivator, harbored no fear.
However, given Yuan Ming's current wanted status, the dispute would inevitably draw attention from others, others might be inconsequential, but if Dongji Palace noticed him, he might not be able to peacefully attend the Ten Thousand Treasure Auction.
Nan Shangfeng had never been so ignored, feeling that he had lost face in others' eyes, his expression darkened.
"Halt, do you know who my young master is? Hand over the item sensibly, or don't expect to leave Ten Thousand Goods Immortal Trip today!" The robust guard flickered to block the front, his vast Late-stage Nascent Soul aura instantly enveloping Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming's quarrel with Nan Shangfeng quickly attracted attention from other guests in the hall.
"Who is that? Why have I never seen them before?" Some people gazed at Yuan Ming.
"Who knows, maybe he's a Loose Cultivator from some small place, otherwise, he wouldn't have the nerve to provoke someone like Nan Shangfeng." A nearby companion didn't care about Yuan Ming's identity.
Yuan Ming, impatient, summoned the main soul from the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space, ready to use an Illusion Technique to trap a few people and escape.
"What are fellow Daoists gathering here for? Is it possible that my Ten Thousand Goods Immortal Trip has been less than accommodating?" A cheerful laugh sounded suddenly, it was Gu Xingdong, having received word from his subordinates, hastily rushing over.
"Manager Gu, when hiring people at your Ten Thousand Goods Immortal Trip, you ought to be more discerning. Some can enhance the place's prestige and wealth, while others only invite disaster." Nan Shangfeng said indifferently.
"Thank you, Young Master Nan, for the insight, this Fellow Daoist Wan is a distinguished guest of my Ten Thousand Goods Immortal Trip, a friend of Lord Tong Xin, and as per our store's regulations, the Red Shining Crystal cannot be reclaimed once bought, may Young Master Nan please grant me this face and let the matter rest?" Gu Xingdong said with a smile.
"Want my young master's face? I'm afraid you, Gu Xingdong, can't take it!" Nan Shangfeng's expression grew darker, and at last, he laughed wantonly.
Gu Xingdong's eyes flashed with a hint of anger, quickly suppressed, he looked apologetically at Yuan Ming, transmitted, "Fellow Daoist Wan, I'm really sorry, this Young Master Nan is naturally capricious, could you possibly let the Red Shining Crystal go for him? Rest assured, afterward, we will furnish similar treasures as compensation."
"Apologies, Fellow Daoist Gu, this Red Shining Crystal is a must-have for me." Yuan Ming shook his head in response.
Gu Xingdong showed a difficult expression but did not leave, standing still between Yuan Ming and Nan Shangfeng.
Yuan Ming's patience had run out, he nodded to Gu Xingdong, then turned to leave.
"Stop, capture this person for my young master!" Nan Shangfeng's face was full of murderous intent, he shouted harshly.
The robust guard along with a dozen black-clad guards showed killing intent, and all rushed out, pouncing toward Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming's eyes also flashed with a hint of coldness, just about to take action.
Before that could happen, a crystal light shot out from the void, instantly enveloping those guards, sending them all back.
"Young Master Nan, why the fiery temper today?" Tong Xin's figure appeared from within the crystal light, chuckling.
"Tong Xin." Seeing Tong Xin appear, Nan Shangfeng frowned slightly, seeming somewhat apprehensive of him.
"Haha, Young Master Nan, calm down. While the Red Shining Crystal is sold, the Rainbow Stone here is similarly splendid and possesses even greater value, let me gift it to the young master and the lovely ladies." Gu Xingdong laughed and took out another splendidly crafted Seven-Colored Crystal Stone, presenting it.
Yuan Ming glanced back at Tong Xin, took the opportunity while Nan Shangfeng and the others were distracted by the Rainbow Stone, continued to walk forward, his steps seemingly slow but swift, in a flash disappearing from the great hall's door.

chapters.title: Chapter 884 - 854: A Great Difference
chapters.content:
"Attending a trade fair and encountering such troublesome matters, it seems better to stay put at the inn for the next few days." Yuan Ming quickly walked out of the Ten Thousand Goods Immortal Trip, his figure disappearing into the throngs of the street.
Yuan Ming did not return to the previous inn. Instead, he simply chose another one. Once he expertly set up the forbidden spell in the room, he immediately entered the Shura Palace to start processing Crystal Stones.
The shell of the Crystal Stone was extremely hard, and Yuan Ming was exceptionally cautious while cutting, fearing that even a slight mistake would cause damage to the Fiery Fire Essence Stone inside.
After half a day's effort, Yuan Ming finally managed to grind away the shell of the Crystal Stone bit by bit, revealing the fiery red stone within.
The stone, apart from its color, appeared no different from an ordinary stone. However, the moment Yuan Ming held it, he felt an intense heat that seemed to boil the Qi-Blood within his body.
In just a moment, the high temperature emanating from his body ignited the surrounding air, causing a large amount of steam to form.
"Such powerful Fire Essence Power. If refined into a Spiritual Treasure, even Cultivators at the Late-Stage of Returning Void might not be able to resist it," Yuan Ming thought to himself.
In the next instant, the Stealing Heaven Tripod suddenly emerged, emitting a ray of light that absorbed the Fiery Fire Essence Stone and embedded it into the Altar Formation.
The array instantly lit up with a red halo, quickly spreading to the surroundings and merging into the Void.
Yuan Ming immediately attempted a probe, discovering that the seal on the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space had further loosened, allowing the space passage to expand to a size he could easily pass through.
Yuan Ming's face showed a trace of joy; the Stealing Heaven Tripod had finally regained a bit of its power.
It seemed that by collecting the remaining spiritual materials, the Stealing Heaven Tripod's Divine Skills could be restored.
At that moment, his joy quickly faded as he looked up toward the outside.
The forbidden spell he had set up in the inn room was triggered—someone seemed to have come looking for him.
Yuan Ming decisively put away the Stealing Heaven Tripod, left the Shura Palace, and returned to the room, using his Divine Sense to probe outside. He discovered it was a stranger male cultivator with a Nascent Soul Stage cultivation that came looking for him.
"Who are you, and what do you want from me?" Yuan Ming murmured for a moment, then opened the door and directly asked.
"Senior, my master said he has found the whereabouts of many high-level spirit woods and would like to invite you to another elegant room in the inn for a detailed discussion." The person outside didn't dare delay and directly stated the purpose.
"Who is your master?" Yuan Ming asked, puzzled.
"It is President Cao of the Green Wave Chamber of Commerce," the stranger male cultivator immediately replied.
"Green Wave Chamber of Commerce..." Yuan Ming's expression changed slightly.
He had heard the name of this chamber of commerce before; it was based on East Extreme Island and had business dealings with many islands. Not weak in power, possessing high-level spirit wood would be normal.
"So, it's the Green Wave Chamber of Commerce. How did you come to know that I need high-level spirit wood?" Yuan Ming asked.
"Our president and Steward Liu of Ten Thousand Goods Immortal Trip are long-time friends. He heard from Steward Liu the day before that Fellow Daoist Wan needed a lot of high-level spirit wood. Coincidentally, our chamber collected a batch recently, so we wish to make a deal with Fellow Daoist Wan," the stranger male cultivator said.
"I see. If that's the case, why not discuss it directly at the Green Wave Chamber of Commerce?" Yuan Ming's gaze became slightly focused.
"My master said that the origin of that batch of spirit wood is somewhat troublesome and it's not convenient to discuss it at the chamber," the stranger male cultivator replied, his expression unchanged.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming stared into the eyes of the Nascent Soul cultivator before him, causing him some unease.
"In that case, lead the way," Yuan Ming withdrew his gaze and said.
The stranger male cultivator let out a sigh of relief in his heart and quickly turned to lead the way.
Soon, the two arrived in front of a room on the fourth floor of the inn.
"Please, Fellow Daoist Wan," the stranger male cultivator made a gesture of invitation at the door.
Yuan Ming did not hesitate; he pushed open the door and walked in.
Upon entering, he immediately saw a screen with cloud-patterned white cranes carved upon it, standing before him. Beside the screen, two burly men stood like iron towers, silent but emitting a powerful aura, both were at the Late Stage of Returning Void.
"The young master is waiting for you," said the burly man on the left, his tone disdainful, indicating Yuan Ming to go around the screen to meet the master.
Yuan Ming frowned slightly, directly ignoring the two burly men, stepping around the screen into a more spacious hall.
"Haha, Fellow Daoist Wan, how have you been?" At that moment, Nan Shangfeng lounged lazily on a large canopied bed, with a demure female cultivator gently massaging his temples from behind.
Beside him sat two female cultivators clad only in veils, one holding a goblet and another with a fruit platter, cheeks flushed, attending to Nan Shangfeng.
One of them, an exceptionally beautiful woman in a pink dress, was the same person who demanded the Red Shining Crystal at the trade fair.
"If Young Master Nan wanted to invite me over, there was no need for such roundabout methods. You could have just said so," Yuan Ming said, his face showing no surprise, as he sat opposite Nan Shangfeng.
"Oh, you guessed it was me?" Nan Shangfeng showed an intrigued expression.
"I have just arrived at East Extreme Island, and have not made enemies with others. Apart from you, I cannot think of anyone else who would go to such lengths to draw me here," Yuan Ming remarked calmly.
"Since you guessed it was me, you still dared to come?" Nan Shangfeng sat up straight.
"Young Master Nan has already found the inn, whether I come or not, what's the difference?" Yuan Ming chuckled lightly and responded.
"Indeed, it seems you're not only smart but also quite self-aware. I truly have some admiration for you. However, your rushed judgment this time does make a big difference whether you come here or not." Nan Shangfeng laughed heartily.
Noticing Nan Shangfeng's imperious demeanor, always with a condescending attitude, Yuan Ming felt repulsed and couldn't be bothered to think about the meaning of those words. He said blandly, "I've already come. Young Master Nan, just say what you have to say."
"On account of Tong Xin, I can overlook your offense at the trade fair. What the man just said inviting you here was no deceit, indeed there is a business to do with you." Nan Shangfeng put away his smile and said faintly, raising a hand to clap.
The female cultivator holding a wine cup beside him immediately stood up and took out three wooden boxes from the Storage Ring to display to Yuan Ming.
The first wooden box contained a green spirit wood several feet long, its surface covered with fish scale-like Spiritual Patterns, exuding a startling Spiritual Power fluctuation.
Level 5 spiritual material, Green Scale Xuan Wood.
The second wooden box also contained a Level 5 Spirit Wood, Iron Gang Wood.
The third wooden box held a section of withered yellow bamboo, without the slightest spiritual power aura, appearing like an ordinary dead bamboo. The only peculiar aspect was the many brown spots on its surface, resembling tears.
"This is the sixth-level spiritual material, Tear Bamboo! Unfortunately, it's already withered, greatly reducing its value." Yuan Ming's gaze fell on the third wooden box, his eyes flickering.
"Name your price, Young Master Nan, for these three pieces of high-level spirit wood, how many Spirit Stones do you want?" He quickly raised his head and said.
"What a joke! The last thing I lack are Spirit Stones, and I'm not selling these three pieces of spirit wood. I want to exchange them for the Red Shining Crystal you bought before. This offer should be generous enough, right?" Nan Shangfeng leaned back against the bed again, stating his demand.
"These three pieces of high-level spirit wood, when priced, are several times more than that Red Shining Crystal. What is it that you truly want, Fellow Daoist?" Yuan Ming pondered for a moment before asking.
If not for Void's reminder, he wouldn't have noticed the Fiery Fire Essence Stone hidden within the Crystal. Nan Shangfeng's cultivation is slightly lower than his, so he shouldn't have noticed it either. Why this obsession with the Crystal?
"Naturally, it's for the smile of a beauty. My ambition in life is not great; I just wish to expand my harem and collect all the beauties in the world. Whatever catches their eye, I must help them acquire." Nan Shangfeng laughed loudly, pulling the girl in the pink dress beside him closer and running his hands freely over her.
Yuan Ming scrutinized Nan Shangfeng in front of him, seemingly verifying the truthfulness of his words, then shook his head and said, "I'm afraid you'll be disappointed, Young Master Nan. As I said at the trade fair, that Crystal I have great use for, no matter how high the price, I won't part with it."
"I've already shown you enough respect. It seems you've made up your mind to snub me," Nan Shangfeng's face turned cold.
"It's not that I'm unwilling, I simply can't." Yuan Ming sighed lightly, shaking his head.
To extract the Fiery Fire Essence Stone, the outer Red Shining Crystal was already destroyed in the process. Even if he wanted to, he couldn't give it to Nan Shangfeng anymore.
However, the light in front suddenly dimmed as two robust men guarding the screen approached.
"Leave the item, don't refuse a toast only to be forced to drink a forfeit!" The man on the left said in a muffled voice.
"This is East Extreme Island, the Ten Thousand Treasure Auction is about to begin, and Dongji Palace strictly forbids any fighting. Surely Young Master Nan wouldn't knowingly break the law?" Yuan Ming looked at Nan Shangfeng.
"Mere Dongji Palace, my Daluo Sect couldn't care less. Moreover, ensuring the outside doesn't notice the battle here is quite simple." Nan Shangfeng raised his hand, casting a spell.
Suddenly, the walls around the room glowed, becoming solid rapidly, and the surrounding scenery changed swiftly.
In the blink of an eye, everyone present found themselves in a spacious White Jade Hall.
Yuan Ming looked around, suddenly remembering Nan Shangfeng's earlier words, "Whether you come here makes a big difference," and a trace of a smile appeared at the corner of his mouth.
This inn room was probably transformed from this White Jade Hall, entering this room meant entering the hall.
"This is my Void Palace. What do you think, Fellow Daoist Wan? Even if we fought fiercely here, the outside wouldn't detect a thing." Nan Shangfeng asked with a smile.
"What a treasure, able to merge with the void, completely undetectable. Could it be a Space Spiritual Treasure?" Yuan Ming retracted his gaze and asked, his expression still calm.
"Has no one ever told you that your act of calmness is extremely irritating!" Anger suddenly appeared on Nan Shangfeng's face, and with a wave of his sleeve, a green light shot out, stabbing toward Yuan Ming's throat.
Seeing this, several women around him hurriedly flew to a distant place to avoid danger.
Yuan Ming raised his right hand, and two fingers turned pitch-black in the state of the Undying Tree, clamping down on the green light with a clanging sound.
The green light revealed its true form, an odd green sword molded like a Spiritual Snake.
The sword buzzed while writhing, trying to pierce Yuan Ming's fingers but could not move forward an inch.
"No wonder you dared to come here without fear, you've hidden your strength well, but you're just being clever." Nan Shangfeng's expression subtly changed, and he swiftly formed a spell with both hands.
The green sword's light flourished intensely, and a phantom of a giant green python, an Artifact Spirit, appeared on the blade.
The power of the green sword surged, suddenly breaking free of Yuan Ming's grip, aiming for his heart.
The two burly guards of Nan Shangfeng also took out Spiritual Treasures, one wielding Dragon Pattern Dual Blades and the other wielding a Blood-colored Long Spear, assaulting Yuan Ming from front and back.

chapters.title: Chapter 885 - 855 New Idea
chapters.content:
Facing a three-pronged attack, Yuan Ming formed seals with both hands, activating the Six Jia Qimen Dao Seal, and disappeared into thin air from his original spot, reappearing more than ten feet away. The attacks of the three from Nan Shangfeng all missed.
"Spatial Shifting Divine Ability! Young Master!" shouted the burly guard holding a blade.
Upon hearing this, Nan Shangfeng immediately stepped back, forming a seal with one hand and striking the ground.
Suddenly, numerous silver spiritual patterns appeared on the floor and walls of the great hall, resembling an array.
A burly guard swung the Dragon Pattern Dual Blades, and the sharp blade light seemed like the Outer Heaven Xun Wind that could slash through the void, forming a web of dozens of blade shadows around Yuan Ming.
The other person held a blood-red spear emitting an endless aura of slaughter, which shot out like a meteor, aiming at Yuan Ming's body.
Yuan Ming tried to once again use the Six Jia Qimen Shifting, but the surrounding silver formation of the great hall suddenly lit up, with waves of invisible space fluctuations attacking from all directions.
The space power around him was disrupted, and the Six Jia Qimen was forcibly interrupted.
"Fighting in someone else's Spiritual Treasure Space, of course, the opponent has the advantage of terrain," Yuan Ming thought to himself, his hands not stopping as he swiftly summoned the protective shield of Houtu Peak, a layer of yellow light appeared on his body, thick and seemingly indestructible.
Clang, clang, clang!
The spiritual treasures of the two guards were all repelled, but Houtu Peak also resonated with a buzzing vibration.
Yuan Ming cast a spell with his left hand to stabilize Houtu Peak and sketched a Level 5 Fire Attribute Array in the void with his right hand, its surface glowing with intense firelight.
In the next moment, dozens of massive fire dragons shot out from the array, exuding an extremely scorching aura, pouncing on the three.
"This person is an Array Master, be careful!" shouted the burly man with the blade.
The four engaged in offensive and defensive maneuvers, quickly exchanging several rounds.
The two burly guards became increasingly apprehensive as the battle progressed, realizing that although the confrontation seemed evenly matched, no matter how they attacked, the "Wan Tianren" before them easily dodged each assault.
As for their opponent's counterattacks, they had to exert great effort to fend them off.
As for Nan Shangfeng, not only was his cultivation the lowest among the four, but having led an indulgent life, he lacked much combat experience. Aside from manipulating the void palace's restrictions to constrain Yuan Ming, he could barely contribute; as "Wan Tianren" became familiar with the void palace's restrictions, Nan Shangfeng turned into a burden, not worth considering as combat strength.
"It's about time to end this." Waving his hand, Yuan Ming once again forced the three back and suddenly raised one hand, flicked his fingers, and more than ten Soul Destroying Sword Energies shot out.
Each Sword Qi was several feet long, majestic like meteors, yet they made no sound, targeting the two burly guards separately.
"Be careful, it's a Divine Soul attack!" warned the burly man with the spear, his blood-red spear's lethal aura surging.
A surge of Soul Power shot out from between his brows, merging with the spear's lethal aura to form a blood-red shield in front of him.
Six Soul Destroying Sword Energies slashed at the shield, causing it to tremble violently, breaking it after blocking only three. The remaining three sword energies flashed and pierced into the body of the guard holding the spear.
The man's body trembled, blood flowed from his seven orifices, and he staggered backward.
On the other side, the dual-bladed burly man was greatly alarmed at the sight, slashing out dozens of violent blade lights imbued with Soul Power in a whirlwind to defend through attack.
However, his soul attack was far inferior to the Soul Destroying Sword Energies; the dense blade lights only managed to extinguish half of the sword energies, with the rest all penetrating his body.
The dual-bladed man's Divine Soul was severely damaged, and his face turned deathly pale.
"This is impossible!" Nan Shangfeng stood stunned not far away, his face devoid of the previous arrogance, staring at Yuan Ming in disbelief.
These two burly men weren't just any guards but respected Guest Elders within his family.
The two were twin Loose Cultivators, the blade-wielding one was the older brother Ruan Lianyu, and the spear-wielding one was the younger brother Ruan Lianxin, known collectively as the Ruan Brothers, who had previously been active around the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range.
As twins, they were of one mind, later refining a Combined Attack Secret Technique, nearly able to rival Dharma Phase Cultivators together, making a significant name for themselves in the Ten Thousand Demon Mountains. Nan Shangfeng's family expended great effort to recruit them, yet they were gravely wounded after just a few exchanges. Could this person be a Dharma Phase existence?
Yuan Ming, however, was not surprised by this. In eighty years, the Spiritual Power within the broken sword fragment had mostly merged into the Soul Destroying Sword, with the number of runes on the Soul Destroying Sword not increasing but its power had greatly surged, incomparable to the past.
"Who exactly are you?" Nan Shangfeng asked, struggling to regain composure, his voice feigning authority.
Yuan Ming ignored him, looking around and pondering in his heart, "After such a long fight, Nan Shangfeng has faced danger several times, yet no one has appeared. It seems he doesn't have any Dharma Phase cultivators protecting him."
"I am a disciple of the Daluo Sect Master. If you dare act against me, the Daluo Sect will not let you go!" Nan Shangfeng, seeing Yuan Ming looking around, assumed he was hesitant and raised his voice.
"Since we're fighting so fiercely here, the outside world won't detect a thing, so the Daluo Sect naturally won't know, right?" Yuan Ming chuckled lightly, raised his hand with a wave, and activated the Dream Butterfly Dao Seal and the All Living Beings Dream Seal in his Dantian.
"You..." Nan Shangfeng's face showed surprise, intending to say something more.
Two waves of void energy, like ripples in water, spread one after another, causing everyone in the hall, including Ruan Lianyu and Ruan Lianxin, to stand frozen in place. Even the three female cultivators who had fled to the distance were the same, trapped in the Dream Butterfly Illusion Technique, unable to extricate themselves.
The Dragon Pattern Dual Blades and the blood-red spear lost their power and fell to the ground with a clang, the white chains binding Yuan Ming's feet also loosened automatically.
Yuan Ming looked at Nan Shangfeng and shook his head.
Recalling the conflict between Nan Shangfeng and himself, he found it absurd, and with a lift of his hand, he summoned them through the air.
Then Yuan Ming performed a Soul Search on each of them, extracting the parts about Nan Shangfeng.
After thirty minutes, he lowered his hand.
According to the results of the Soul Search, this Nan Shangfeng was the second disciple of the Daluo Sect Master, originally very gifted, but had injured his foundation during an expedition, causing his cultivation to stagnate at the Late Stage of Returning Void. Afterwards, he indulged in women and collected various beauties to fill his harem.
His personality had changed from dignified and generous to timid and fearful.
As for why Nan Shangfeng approached him, it was as he said, there were no conspiracies or tricks involved, it was simply to earn a beauty's smile from beginning to end.
Nan Shangfeng's parents were from a wealthy merchant family in the Central Continent and had some relations with the Bright Moon Palace, possessing vast assets. A few million Spirit Stones really meant nothing to them.
"The perspective of a scion from a wealthy lineage on Spirit Stones is really beyond the imagination of ordinary people." Yuan Ming shook his head with a bitter smile.
Having confirmed there were no conspiracies or schemes behind Nan Shangfeng, he decided not to entangle with them any further, preparing to erase all their memories of him and leave.
But as Yuan Ming raised his hand, he paused slightly, having another idea in mind.
Then, he directly changed the spell, planting a Soul Descent Rune in Nan Shangfeng's Sea of Consciousness, and then awakened him.
"No—don't—" Nan Shangfeng, as soon as he opened his eyes, roared hoarsely, as if witnessing a scene he dreaded to see.
And when he saw everything around him clearly, discovering Yuan Ming standing intact before him, and that his two Returning to Void Peak guards were lying not far away, their lives uncertain, he finally came back to his senses, recalling everything that had just happened.
"Illusion... Illusion Technique? So powerful, you... no, you are the Life Witch?" Nan Shangfeng trembled as he spoke.
"I have just planted a rune in your Sea of Consciousness, which can completely erase your Divine Soul with a single thought. If you don't believe me, you can feel it yourself." Yuan Ming didn't answer him but spoke expressionlessly.
Nan Shangfeng gave it a try, then his body began to shake violently, he even collapsed limply, unable to stand.
"Fellow Daoist Wan, if you have any requests in the future, I will comply, please be magnanimous and spare me." He hurriedly knelt before Yuan Ming, begging earnestly.
"I am not averse to agreeing to your request, including ignoring today's incident. However, I have one condition." Yuan Ming looked at him and said slowly.
"Please say it, not just one condition, even ten or eight are no problem." Upon hearing this, Nan Shangfeng's eyes lit up, and he hurriedly said.
"I will take these three pieces of spirit wood you bought, and during the Ten Thousand Treasure Auction, I will stay hidden in your Space Treasure, and you will participate on my behalf, bidding for the items I want. After it's over, I will leave and won't harm you." Yuan Ming said.
"Okay, rest assured, whatever you fancy, as long as I can afford it — no, as long as you want it, I will definitely get it for you!" Hearing this, Nan Shangfeng quickly slapped his chest in assurance.
Seeing Nan Shangfeng's response, Yuan Ming nodded in satisfaction.
Afterwards, he came to the two Returning to Void Peak guards, pressing both hands on their foreheads.
Seeing this, Nan Shangfeng's face turned deathly pale, thinking Yuan Ming had changed his mind and was going to kill them.
However, only a faint light glowed in Yuan Ming's palms, as he released Divine Soul Power to erase all memories of himself from their minds.
Then, he deleted the memories of the other attendants one by one, including the three female cultivators who had fled earlier, naturally erasing their memories as well.
"When they wake up, they won't remember anything about me, and you'd better keep quiet, otherwise, I don't mind ensuring you can never speak again." Yuan Ming looked at Nan Shangfeng and said calmly.
"Rest assured, Fellow Daoist Wan, I won't leak half a word about you." Nan Shangfeng breathed a sigh of relief, immediately nodding in cooperation to guarantee.
"Does your Space Spiritual Treasure contain a secret room?" Yuan Ming asked again.
"Yes, yes, please follow me, Fellow Daoist Wan." Nan Shangfeng quickly said, turning with a face full of dread to lead the way.

chapters.title: Chapter 886 - 856: The yin soul Lingers
chapters.content:
Before long, Yuan Ming followed Nan Shangfeng to a room approximately twenty zhang in size, with intricate and mysterious runes engraved all over the floor and walls, clearly indicating the presence of more than one array.
"This is where I occasionally retreat for closed cultivation. The arrays on the walls and floor are used to assist with cultivation and seal the chamber," Nan Shangfeng hastily explained, fearing Yuan Ming might misunderstand.
Yuan Ming glanced around briefly, nodded, and said, "The Level 5 Wanxiang Gathering Spirit Array and the Level 4 Hundred Gates Sealing Array are quite decent... with some modifications, they can also be used."
"It's impressive that Fellow Daoist Wan can even improve a Level 5 array!" Nan Shangfeng couldn't help but express his amazement upon hearing Yuan Ming's remarks.
He increasingly felt that the person before him was unfathomable.
"Here are the three pieces of spirit wood. Please accept them, Fellow Daoist Wan." He then handed over three wooden boxes to Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming was not at all polite and accepted them; "Name a price."
"It's merely three pieces of spirit wood, not worth mentioning. Fellow Daoist Wan, please accept them," Nan Shangfeng said nervously.
"I just mentioned that I would buy everything you purchase at the original price. Don't be falsely modest. State the number of Spirit Stones or offer an exchange for other spiritual materials," Yuan Ming stated.
"To not lie to you, Fellow Daoist Wan, these three pieces of spirit wood were exchanged for two well-crafted Magic Treasures. Fellow Daoist Wan can just offer equivalent items in exchange." Nan Shangfeng hesitated slightly before saying.
Although high-level spirit wood is precious, it usually has limited use and isn't as versatile as Magic Treasures. It can fetch a high price for those who specifically need it, but generally, its value is less than that of Magic Treasures of a similar level.
Yuan Ming, hearing this, thought for a moment and took out seven or eight Magic Treasures he had previously seized from Ye Wuya and Zi Mei, placing them in front of Nan Shangfeng for selection.
Nan Shangfeng scanned them, immediately drawn to a purple gauze robe and an emerald green hairpin among them.
With Yuan Ming's consent, he picked up the two Magic Treasures and examined them closely.
The purple gauze robe, named "Joyful Zen Robe," was a high-level Magic Treasure given to Zi Mei by a Su Nu Sect elder for dual cultivation. Used with the Dual Cultivation Method, it can significantly increase the cultivation speed of both parties.
The emerald green hairpin was crafted using the special technique of emerald inlay, incorporating a feather containing the soul of a Peacock Demon King, an attack type Magic Treasure. Not only is it beautiful, but it also contains deadly poison, capable of catching others off guard.
"I like both of these Magic Treasures, Fellow Daoist Wan. If you don't mind, I would like to exchange them for the spirit wood," Nan Shangfeng said with a look of joy, clearly satisfied with the Magic Treasures.
"That's acceptable," Yuan Ming agreed without hesitation.
"Thank you, Fellow Daoist Wan," Nan Shangfeng said happily.
He was eager to find those female cultivators to test the effectiveness of the Joyful Zen Robe.
"You can indulge in Joyful Zen anytime, but don't be careless about what you promised me. Also, let me remind you, since I dared to stay in your Space Spiritual Treasure, I naturally have a way to leave. So don't entertain any sinister thoughts of sealing me inside," Yuan Ming said coldly, casting a glance at him.
With the Sky-reaching Demon Pillar in his possession and the Undying Tree's ability to traverse the void, he had no concerns.
"Rest assured, Fellow Daoist Wan, I wouldn't dare cross any lines. There is actually a misunderstanding between us," Nan Shangfeng said, his spine chilling as he hurriedly spoke.
"Alright, your people should be waking up soon. Take them out, and I'll be in closed cultivation here for a while," Yuan Ming said.
Taking the order, Nan Shangfeng ran out as if granted amnesty.
He brought the now-awakened Ruan Lianyu and Ruan Lianxin and gathered everyone to wake them up together.
After waking up, everyone felt somewhat bewildered, as if they had just woken from a deep sleep.
"Listen, there is a task for you now. Please handle it with care," Nan Shangfeng instructed without explaining anything to them.
"Please instruct us, Young Master," the others said, cupping their fists.
"Spread the word that I, Nan Shangfeng, am collecting a large amount of high-level spirit wood. The price is negotiable, and the better the item, the higher the price," Nan Shangfeng said with a wave of his hand.
Although Yuan Ming didn't ask him to purchase high-level spirit wood, he wasn't foolish. With his fate in Yuan Ming's hands, he naturally needed to find a way to win favor.
"As you command," everyone said in unison and dispersed.
Nan Shangfeng, along with two guards, also left the inn.
In the Void Palace's secret chamber, Yuan Ming sensed Nan Shangfeng's actions through the Soul Descent Rune.
Nan Shangfeng's Soul Descent Rune was unique; he had a soul crow residing in it for security, allowing better monitoring of Nan Shangfeng.
Yuan Ming quickly turned his attention back and took out the three newly acquired pieces of high-level spirit wood, feeding them to the World Tree's bark. The Power of Ten Thousand Wood Origin within the bark increased significantly again.
...
Three days later, while Nan Shangfeng was busy using various channels to help "Wan Tianren" collect high-level spirit wood, an unexpected visitor came to the door.
When Nan Shangfeng saw that person, he couldn't help but startle, asking, "Mountain Master Zhu Yu, why are you here?"
"Young Master Nan, I had quite a time looking for you. Come with me quickly; the people from White Emperor City and Heavenly Dragon Hall have arrived and wish to meet with you," Zhu Yu said anxiously.
"Looking for me? What do they want with me?" Nan Shangfeng leaned back in his chair, resting his legs on the front table.
"Of course, it's about the Ten Thousand Treasure Auction; this operation must not fail," Zhu Yu replied.
"That's a troublesome bunch. I don't want to deal with them. Can't you handle it for me?" Nan Shangfeng sighed and said.
"This is the Sect Master's order; otherwise, I wouldn't trouble you," Zhu Yu said with a forced smile.
"Since it's Master's order, let's go then. The sooner it's discussed, the sooner we can return," Nan Shangfeng got up from the chair reluctantly upon hearing it was the Daluo Sect Master's order.
Zhu Yu took him away from the residence and soon arrived at another inn within the workshop.
Unlike other bustling inns, this place was almost devoid of people, permeated by an indescribable tension.
"Truly a bunch of fools, ruining a perfectly good inn like this, afraid that others won't know there's a problem here," Nan Shangfeng shook his head disdainfully, walking into an isolated elegant room deep within the inner courtyard.
Outside the elegant room, layers of faint light halos enveloped the entrance, clearly indicating a Forbidden Array was set up inside.
Zhu Yu reached the doorway, swung his hand lightly, and a stream of light hit the door.
Immediately, a gold stream of light rippled out, as if pulling back a golden curtain on the door, revealing an opening just tall enough for a person, from which broken sounds of conversation intermittently emitted.
Nan Shangfeng pushed the door and stepped through the opening, followed closely by Zhu Yu.
Afterwards, the door closed again, the golden curtain pulled back into place, everything returned to its original state.
Inside was a rather large hall, a redwood round table placed in the center around which four people sat.
One of them was a handsome young man in white tight clothing, holding a folding fan with golden patterns, gently swaying it.
Across from the young man in white sat a young woman wearing a lotus flower short skirt, her hair in two short braided pigtails, looking stunningly pure, both bearing smiles as if discussing something.
"Junior Sister Yu Huan, long time no see, I didn't expect Heavenly Dragon Hall would send you this time. Had I known, I would have come sooner. This is a Green Glass Bead Chain I saw at the workshop a few days ago, refined from the Demon Cores of eighteen Qingli Beasts, it's effective in cooling and beautifying, matching you perfectly, let me help you wear it," Nan Shangfeng's eyes lit up, walking towards the short-skirt woman, producing an azure necklace with great flattery.
"No need, Senior Brother Nan, perhaps you should give it to your concubines instead," the smile vanished instantly from the short-skirt woman's face; she didn't even glance at Nan Shangfeng, as wisps of white chill spread within three feet of her.
"How could those concubines compare to Junior Sister Yu Huan by even a tenth? Never mind, since you don't like the Green Glass Bead Chain, I'll find you something rarer next time," Nan Shangfeng halted, appearing quite apprehensive of the white chill, yet didn't leave.
"Brother Nan, I'm here too. Although Junior Sister Long is here, you didn't even glance at an old friend, that's rather too much," the young man in white tapped the table, expressing dissatisfaction.
"Oh, Jin Chen, you're here too," Nan Shangfeng glanced at him indifferently.
The young man in white's face sank suddenly at this.
Inside the Void Palace, Yuan Ming observed the people in the hall via Soul Descent Rune.
Besides Jin Chen and the woman named Long Yu Huan sat two others, who turned out to be East Pole Island Master Ouyang Qiang and Luo Jia Mountain Master Bai Yuan, neither of whom had spoken from the beginning.
This didn't surprise Yuan Ming.
Though the Dongji Sea Area was remote and resource-poor, it was also a vast territory, with Dongji Palace, Azure Dragon Pond, and Luo Jia Mountain each commanding parts of the Dongji Sea Area, all having backing behind them.
He had seen from Nan Shangfeng's memories that Daluo Sect backed Azure Dragon Pond, White Emperor City supported Dongji Palace, as for Luo Jia Mountain's rise, it couldn't be separated from Heavenly Dragon Hall.
The young man in white and the short-skirt woman were both acquaintances of Nan Shangfeng; the young man in white was called Jin Chen, the son of the White Emperor City Lord, while the short-skirt woman Long Yu Huan was the Closed-door Disciple of the Heavenly Dragon Hall's Hall Master.
"Brother Nan, we'll talk about casual matters later. Now that you're here, we can discuss the main business," Jin Chen put away his playful expression and said seriously.
Nan Shangfeng looked impatient but sat down, waving his hand, "What business is to be discussed? Is it that the Ten Thousand Treasure Auction will have some shady dealings again? Every auction pulls this same act, utterly boring."
"No rush, Brother Nan, it's not about that matter, Palace Master Ouyang, you're leading this operation, so why don't you explain in detail to Brother Nan," Jin Chen turned to Ouyang Qiang, saying.
Ouyang Qiang nodded and looked at Nan Shangfeng, "Young Master Nan, this gathering concerns two people: Yuan Ming and Yun Luo Fairy."
In the Void Palace, Yuan Ming's heart gave a slight jump.
He was just speculating on why Daluo Sect, White Emperor City, and Heavenly Dragon Hall were meeting, only to find out it was to capture him!
"It seems these people are indeed relentless!" Yuan Ming couldn't help but touch his nose with a bitter smile, thinking helplessly to himself.

chapters.title: Chapter 887 - 857 Heaven and Earth Net
chapters.content:
"Yuan Ming and Yun Luo Fairy... I've heard of them, aren't they two Returning Void Stage cultivators? Why bother capturing them after having already been jointly wanted?" Nan Shangfeng pondered briefly before asking in return.
"Now that matters have reached this point, I won't hide the reason. The reason for issuing the wanted order and reward for these two is that many years ago when Emperor Yan's Mausoleum emerged, the inheritance of the Pill King Pavilion was taken by them," Ouyang Qiang said gravely.
"Oh, the Pill King Pavilion's inheritance! That's quite something. Ever since the Pill King Pavilion was destroyed, Dharma Manifestation Pills have gone extinct. Those two are lucky indeed. I wonder if they've managed to refine any Dharma Manifestation Pills; this young master would like to buy a few," Nan Shangfeng finally showed an expression of interest.
"Young Master Nan, there's something you might not know. The Emperor Yan's Mausoleum was discovered by the three of our families together, and we jointly broke the forbidden. The inheritance of the Pill King Pavilion should have been ours. Those two took advantage of our carelessness and stole the inheritance. That's why Palace Master Ouyang organized this operation to capture them and reclaim the inheritance," Zhu Yu coughed lightly and said.
"Such an ownerless inheritance of the Pill King Pavilion naturally belongs to whoever takes it. From the looks of it, you're planning to kill for treasures? In this young master's opinion, why not announce to buy the inheritance from those two at a high price? Why resort to violence when it can be solved with Spirit Stones? That would be quite a buzzkill!" Nan Shangfeng said disdainfully.
As he spoke, the people in the hall looked at each other without speaking, causing the atmosphere to become somewhat awkward.
"Brother Nan's suggestion may not be a bad method, but those two don't show up at all. Even if we wanted to use Spirit Stones to buy the inheritance back, we can't. For now, it's best to find them first," Jin Chen spoke, breaking the silence.
"Young Master Jin is right. We've received news that Yun Luo's cultivation has reached the late stage of Returning Void and is about to break through to the Dharma manifestation stage. To refine the Dharma Manifestation Pill, those two are searching everywhere for the required materials. This is our opportunity to locate them," Ouyang Qiang said.
Yuan Ming secretly laughed upon hearing this; these guys' sources of information were really too outdated.
The news of gathering materials may have leaked earlier when Yun Luo Fairy was buying spiritual materials everywhere, but that was a long time ago. Ouyang Qiang truly underestimated him, still thinking he hadn't collected the materials after decades?
"Could this information be released recently rather than long ago?" Yuan Ming wondered.
"Su Nu Sect obtained half of the Pill King Secret Manual from Yun Luo. We've already purchased the Dharma Manifestation Pill recipe from them at a high price and gathered all the main materials needed for refining the Dharma Manifestation Pill, intending to sell them at the auction," Bai Yuan added.
"You're planning to use these materials as bait to lure those two out? But how can you be sure they will take the bait? Moreover, as you said, it's been over a hundred years since the Emperor Yan's Mausoleum emerged; those two might have already left the Extreme East," Nan Shangfeng furrowed his brows and asked.
"Rest assured, Young Master Nan, I have confirmed accurate information that the two are still in the Extreme East. They are being hunted on multiple fronts by us. Just avoiding us won't work. The best course of action for them is to advance to the Dharma manifestation stage as soon as possible to increase their ability to resist us. Therefore, I believe they will not miss this Ten Thousand Treasure Auction," Ouyang Qiang confidently said.
Hearing this, Nan Shangfeng nodded noncommittally.
"All these materials have been tampered with, leaving special marks that can't be isolated even in a storage bag or space treasure. We just need to monitor the tracks of the buyers and follow the clues. We will surely find Yuan Ming and Yun Luo," Bai Yuan said with conviction.
"That's not enough. We also need to set up a Heaven and Earth Net on the island and arrange sufficient personnel. If they dare to step onto the island, we absolutely cannot let them escape," Jin Chen's eyes flickered, and he said, clenching his fist.
"Of course," Ouyang Qiang nodded.
Listening to their plans, Yuan Ming couldn't help but laugh inside.
Not to mention he had already refined the Dharma Manifestation Pill, Yun Luo Fairy had already successfully advanced to the Dharma manifestation stage. Even if they hadn't, they wouldn't fall for such a shallow trap.
However, it's worth paying attention to this matter. If there really is someone with ulterior motives spreading this information, Jin Chen and the others might be able to find some clues.
After some further discussion, everyone finally departed.
Back at his residence, Yuan Ming had Nan Shangfeng enter a space spiritual treasure, explaining the arrangements for the auction in detail.
...
In the blink of an eye, several days passed, and the day of the Ten Thousand Treasure Auction finally arrived.
Outside the Dongji Palace, in a wide open square, stood a grand and towering circular treasure building, refurbished anew, decorated with lanterns and colorful banners, exuding a festive atmosphere.
Above the entrance of the circular treasure building hung a plaque with the words "Ten Thousand Treasure Tower" written on it.
In front of the open building doors, a hundred-zhang long vivid red carpet was laid, welcoming guests from all directions into the building.
Upon entering the Ten Thousand Treasure Tower, the space suddenly expanded more than tenfold, clearly the effect of a forbidden, otherwise, it wouldn't accommodate as many participants coming from all over.
The interior was also meticulously decorated, with a square stage set up inside, being the auction platform.
On the opposite side of the auction platform, there were five tiers of staggered viewing platforms, filled with tables and chairs.
At this moment, the tables and chairs of the lower four tiers were already occupied, and on each table were the freshly produced Spiritual Tea from Cloud Mist Island and fresh Spirit Fruits from Bai Fang Island.
On the fifth layer of the viewing platform, independent luxurious private boxes were separated. The tables inside were also laid with spiritual tea and spirit fruits, though the quality was beyond those available downstairs.
Apart from the spiritual tea and fruits, the tables in the boxes were adorned with incense burners of various designs, with spirit incense smoldering, the long-lasting fragrance lingering throughout the room.
Each private box had two young and beautiful maids standing beside them, serving carefully.
These private boxes were reserved for esteemed guests.
In the central box, Jin Chen sat by the table, holding a wine pot in one hand and a cup in the other, sipping leisurely, his expression relaxed, as if sitting idly at home.
Ouyang Qiang, sitting beside him, appeared somewhat anxious, her gaze frequently sweeping towards the lower floor.
"Palace Master Ouyang, ease your mind. A Heaven and Earth Net has been laid throughout the island and here. If those two come today, they won't escape. If they don't come, your anxiety is needless," Jin Chen said with a smile, downing a cup of fine wine.
"The Young Master speaks the truth," Ouyang Qiang nodded, but the anxiety on her face did not diminish.
This operation, initiated by her, had utilized considerable resources and manpower. If it failed in the end, Dongji Palace's reputation would suffer greatly, especially before White Emperor City.
Jin Chen, seeing her demeanor, shook his head slightly, preparing to continue drinking.
"By the way, I hadn't asked earlier, Palace Master Ouyang, you've mentioned exact information that Yuan Ming and Yun Luo Fairy are still in the Dongji Sea. From where did this information come?" Jin Chen suddenly inquired.
"It came from Qingjin Building. Their previous building lord was captured by Yuan Ming. In recent years, a new building lord arrived, who, by some means, confirmed that Yuan Ming and the fairy are still in the Dongji Sea. That person vowed with a heart demon oath, assuring the information's authenticity. You know the drawbacks of the Sutra of the Pure Woman—they most fear the heart demon. I think it's reliable," Palace Master Ouyang explained.
"The Su Nu Sect... Hm, since they swore by a heart demon, it should be true," Jin Chen nodded in agreement.
...
In the box to the left, Long Yuhuan leaned one hand on the table and traced the rim of a teacup with the other, looking somewhat bored and uninterested.
"Fellow Daoist Long, do you think Ouyang Qiang's plan is truly feasible?" Bai Yuan, who accompanied her, inquired.
"The plan itself has no issues, but it hinges on a premise—that Ouyang Qiang's information is genuine," Long Yuhuan replied slowly.
"Do you think her information is false?" Bai Yuan asked again.
"I don't know. She doesn't seem to be lying. However, whether the plan works or not matters little to us. Let's enjoy this auction and hope some interesting items appear," Long Yuhuan shook his head, looking towards the auction stage below with anticipation in his eyes.
...
The box to the right was much livelier. Nan Shangfeng leaned against the bosom of a voluptuous and beautiful woman, while another gorgeous woman beside him poured wine into his mouth.
"Haha..." The whole room was filled with his joyful laughter.
Zhu Yu sat opposite him, looking at this libertine with an expressionless face.
"Fellow Daoist Zhu, don't be so tense! This plan was devised by Dongji Palace and White Emperor City. It has nothing to do with us. We just need to cooperate a little. Relax," Nan Shangfeng said with a smile and a wave of his hand.
The two maids in the box immediately swayed their slim waists, approaching Zhu Yu, but he pushed them away.
"This plan concerns the inheritance of the Pill King Pavilion. You should put some effort into it. It's a chance to stand out. If you return the inheritance to the sect, the Sect Master and those elders will hold you in higher esteem," Zhu Yu advised.
"I am quite satisfied with my current lifestyle and have no intention of inheriting the Sect Master's position. Whoever wants it can have it," Nan Shangfeng laughed.
"The position of Sect Master carries heavy responsibilities. If you continue to idle away your time, even if you don't care, it will lower the impression of other senior brothers. Aren't you afraid of hindering the sect's affairs? To my knowledge, several elders of the Daluo Sect also covet the position," Zhu Yu remarked with a frown.
"Who cares? If the sky falls, the tall will uphold it. Even if the Master blames us, it won't land on our heads. Let's enjoy ourselves today while we have wine to drink; life should be savored to its fullest!" Nan Shangfeng appeared as a hopeless case, unable to be molded.
Zhu Yu sighed, turning his head away, out of sight and out of mind.
Seeing this, Nan Shangfeng laughed heartily, stood up, went to the balcony railing, and leaned over, looking down.
Though he seemed carefree, he wasn't entirely relaxed. This auction involved "Wan Tianren," and he had to be more attentive...

chapters.title: Chapter 888 - 858: There Is a Way
chapters.content:
In an inconspicuous box on the fifth floor of the auction venue, sat two stunning women.
One of the women looked just over twenty, dressed in aqua green, with a cultivation level only at mid-stage Returning Void, exuding an exceptionally lively aura.
The other woman was slightly older, wearing a bright red long dress, resembling a blooming red lotus, radiating a vast aura, clearly at the Dharma manifestation Stage.
"The plan is going smoothly. The people from White Emperor City, Heavenly Dragon Hall, and Daluo Sect have already been sent out," the woman in the red dress said.
"Very well, Meiniang, please keep a close watch on their actions," the woman in the green dress nodded and said.
"That's no problem. But is this method really useful? Will Yuan Ming truly come to the Ten Thousand Treasure Auction? According to your analysis, Yuan Ming's cultivation has already reached the peak of Returning to Void Late Stage, and he has likely already refined the Dharma Manifestation Pill. With a breakthrough imminent, why would he waste time attending an auction instead of focusing on his seclusion?" the woman in the red dress asked hesitantly.
"For anyone else, it would certainly be so. Unfortunately, he cultivates 'Primordial True Skill.' Although this cultivation technique progresses swiftly, breaking through bottlenecks is extremely difficult. Moreover, the higher the cultivation, the more unstable the mana becomes. Yuan Ming is likely troubled by mana disorder at this moment, so he will definitely not miss this Ten Thousand Treasure Auction," the woman in the green dress smiled confidently as she spoke.
"Even so, he has already refined the Dharma Manifestation Pill and surely won't fall into such a low-level trap," the woman in the red dress still seemed skeptical.
"I never expected him to fall into such a crude trap. It's enough if he takes notice of this matter. Based on the information I've gathered, Yuan Ming is cautious in his actions but too curious to hold back on mysteries. He will surely investigate. Once he's involved, no matter how discreet he tries to be, I have ways to find out," the woman in the green dress chuckled softly as she spoke.
"Alright, then I'll leave everything to you," the woman in the red dress said, her eyes shifting to look downward.
The seating on the fourth floor below was already packed, with most attendees bearing expressions of excitement and anticipation, chattering animatedly.
"Clang..."
Accompanied by the sound of a distant chime, the doors of the Ten Thousand Treasure Tower closed automatically.
The noisy sounds inside the building quickly quieted down.
Under the gaze of the crowd, a figure slowly walked onto the stage.
This person was dressed in a purple-golden robe, with an aged appearance, a thin face, three strands of long whiskers hanging from his cheeks, yet his eyes were glowing with a sharp brilliance, making him appear remarkably vigorous.
"Honored guests, I am grateful that you have not dismissed us, and have come to participate in this Ten Thousand Treasure Auction today. I am Mu Qingfeng, entrusted by the Dongji Palace to host this auction. I hope each of you can find treasures of your heart's desire, come with your spirits high, and leave with satisfaction," Mu Qingfeng's introductory words sparked a wave of murmurs among the crowd.
"Tsk tsk, this Mu Qingfeng is a Guest Elder of the Ten Thousand Goods Immortal Trip, a master appraiser, and fair-minded. The fact that the Dongji Palace invited him to host the auction suggests there will be no counterfeit goods this time," a young man in a blue robe said from the audience below.
"The Ten Thousand Treasure Auction is held only once every five hundred years. Who dares to fake it? Unfortunately, the various rare treasures appearing at the auction are not cheap; they're out of our reach," an elderly man in a gray robe sighed beside him.
"Whether we can buy it or not, just witnessing it is worthwhile," said a burly man with a full beard.
"Indeed, even if we can't buy it, looking is a joy, and having a target gives more motivation for future cultivation," another companion immediately agreed.
A young man in white sitting in the front row with a mole under his chin turned and glanced at them, a hint of disdain flashing in his eyes.
He rubbed his finger over the storage ring on his finger, already calculating how to fight fiercely for the object of his desire.
Meanwhile, some cultivators seated even more to the front appeared more calm and composed. Many of them were not attending the Ten Thousand Treasure Auction for the first time, having experienced such events early on, and despite their affluence, they carried themselves with more steadiness.
However, those truly capable of fiercely competing for high-level materials and magic treasures weren't on the lower floor; they had been arranged in the upper-level boxes early on.
After Mu Qingfeng's introductory words, he also elaborately mentioned a few auction precautions and promises. This was mostly for the benefits of first-time attendees, while for veterans, it seemed somewhat redundant.
"I say, Fellow Daoist Mu, stop beating around the bush and get started," at this point, a window of a box on the fifth floor opened, and a figure leaned halfway out, urging loudly.
The sound attracted quite a few people, who looked up and saw that the speaker was a chubby young man dressed in a brocade robe with cloud patterns, adorned in gold and jade, seemingly just to show everyone that he was wealthy.
"No wonder, it's the eldest son of the Lu family from Golden Cloud Island..." The crowd all had a look of realization, as if they were not surprised by this.
Golden Cloud Island is located in the near-sea region near the Central Continent, one of the few islands not under the jurisdiction of Dongji Palace. The island's specialty is a high-grade spiritual material called 'Golden Cloud Fragrance,' which, through sales, has made them immensely wealthy.
Rumor has it that a powerful sect from the Central Continent backs the Lu family on Golden Cloud Island. Thus, although many covet the island's profits, few dare to truly set their sights on it.
"Hehe, Young Master of the Lu family, please be patient. Our first auction item is about to appear, and I'm sure you'll be interested," Mu Qingfeng smiled and said.
With these words, the crowd's attention returned to the stage.
Mu Qingfeng gently clapped his hands, and immediately, an exceptionally beautiful maid sashayed onto the stage, standing beside him.
The maid held a velvet-lined wooden tray with a pair of jade-green pillows on it.
"Hmm, what is this?" Young Master Lu looked on, somewhat disappointed, the anticipation that had just risen in his eyes vanished.
"This is the Cloud Dream Immortal Pillow, the lost treasure of the Soul Cultivation Sect, Yuyang Huanhuan Sect, which perished thirty thousand years ago. This item can nurture the divine soul. If you sleep with this pillow at night, it can also accelerate the enhancement of soul power. Everyone must not miss it." Mu Qingfeng introduced, speaking eloquently.
Upon hearing this, a burst of exclamations erupted from downstairs.
"It's said that this treasure had already been destroyed. I never expected to have the fortune of seeing it here today," someone said in surprise.
"It's rumored that dual cultivation couples who sleep with this item can meet in dreams, not only enhancing their cultivation but also nourishing their divine souls. It's a rare soul refining secret treasure." Someone else supplemented Mu Qingfeng's introduction.
Young Master Lu upstairs was filled with joy, slapped the railing, and shouted, "No one compete with me for this item; this young master wants it!"
"The treasure of the Soul Cultivation Sect..." Yuan Ming expressed some interest.
"Yuan, this is a good item, not to be missed," Kong's voice suddenly appeared.
"Senior Kong knows about this item?" Yuan Ming was slightly shocked and hurriedly asked.
"I know a thing or two. The forbidden inside the Cloud Dream Immortal Pillow is insignificant, but its material is quite extraordinary; it's the nearly extinct Moonlight Stone," Kong said.
"Moonlight Stone! Is it the immortal stone born from the moon as the legends say?" Yuan Ming's face showed surprise.
"You are a person accomplished in the immortal path; how could you believe such nonsense? The sun, moon, and stars are transcendent existences beyond the realms. The sun, moon, and stars you see every day are not their true forms but their projections in the Chuyun Realm. How could something from the moon appear in the Chuyun Realm? The so-called Moonlight Stone is merely a special yin attribute spiritual material," Kong sneered.
Yuan Ming was greatly shocked to hear this; the sun, moon, and stars he saw every day were merely projections!
"What is the wonderful use of the Moonlight Stone?" He quickly calmed down his emotions and asked.
"The Moonlight Stone has the function of accelerating the absorption of moonlight power and can be used to refine the Moon God's Three Treasures. Even refining one piece can greatly speed up soul cultivation without any side effects," Kong said.
"The Moon God's Three Treasures, could they be the legendary Moon God Ring, Moon God Pendant, and Moon God Crown?" Yuan Ming's eyes flickered.
Since Kong's previous reminder, he has been avidly supplementing his knowledge about the Central Continent, reading many rumors and legends, among which are the Moon God's Three Treasures.
The Moon God's Three Treasures are supreme treasures in the path of soul cultivation, said to be refined by a great soul cultivator of ancient times, though the exact origins are untraceable.
Over ten thousand years ago, a soul cultivator named Tan Hua in the Central Continent obtained one of the treasures, the Moon God Pendant, and his strength surged rapidly, gaining a huge reputation in a short time, even challenging the great soul cultivation sect Bright Moon Palace.
Unfortunately, he later suddenly vanished, and the Moon God Pendant also vanished without a trace, just like its name—a short-lived glory, now reduced to rumors.
"That's correct," Kong said.
"Does Senior Kong know the method to refine the Moon God's Three Treasures?" Yuan Ming was surprised and delighted.
Ever since he stopped absorbing desire power, his soul cultivation speed had greatly slowed down, and he had fallen behind magic practitioners. If he could refine one of the Moon God's Three Treasures, his soul cultivation speed could be greatly increased.
"Of course," Kong nodded.
"Thank you, Senior Kong. What price do I have to pay to refine the Moon God's Three Treasures?" Yuan Ming thanked.
"Forget it this time, I will assist you for free once. Quickly raise your strength so you don't fall early," Kong said, and his voice fell silent.
"Thank you for your guidance, Senior Kong." Yuan Ming got up and made a solemn thanks again, then transmitted a message to Nan Shangfeng.
"The starting bid for the Cloud Dream Immortal Pillow is five hundred thousand spirit stones. Each bid increment must be no less than one hundred thousand spirit stones. Well, the introduction is over; let's begin the bidding." Mu Qingfeng said with a smile, and the auction officially began.
"Don't bother, I'm bidding eight hundred thousand." Young Master Lu shouted loudly before Mu Qingfeng's voice fell.
He looked down at the crowd below with a condescending gaze as if no one else should dare to contest with him.
"I bid nine hundred thousand spirit stones." In the first row downstairs, a woman in red gauze with charming features bid, her voice somewhat cold.
"I bid one million two hundred thousand spirit stones." Young Master Lu glanced at her and immediately shouted.
The coquettish woman turned her head and threw a flirtatious glance at him, continuing to bid, "One million three hundred thousand spirit stones."
"One million five hundred thousand spirit stones," Young Master Lu frowned and shouted.
At his shout, the coquettish woman immediately withdrew, clearly having exceeded the value of the Cloud Dream Immortal Pillow too much.
"Anyone bid higher than one million five hundred thousand spirit stones?" Mu Qingfeng looked around the scene and asked.

chapters.title: Chapter 889 - 859: Profligate Behavior
chapters.content:
The Ten Thousand Treasure Tower fell silent for a moment. Just as he was about to announce the ownership of the item, a lazy voice suddenly came from somewhere upstairs: "I offer 1.8 million Spirit Stones."
The crowd was instantly abuzz upon hearing this.
Mu Qingfeng also searched around with his eyes before they landed on the box slightly off-center to the left on the fifth floor.
The window in this box was also pulled open, revealing the figure of Nan Shangfeng.
Young Master Lu initially looked angry and was about to lose his temper, but when he saw Nan Shangfeng, his face froze, and he quietly retreated.
He prided himself on his extravagant lifestyle, seldom meeting his match when it came to spending money lavishly, but he had long heard of Nan Shangfeng's reputation. Compared to him, he was still a minor character; pushing matters any further would not be worth the potential consequences.
"Nan Shangfeng, you really are..." Jin Chen continued drinking by the table, smiling and shaking his head without speaking further.
In the adjacent box, Long Yuhuan seemed indifferent, apparently uninterested in the first auction item, focusing instead on the scattered leaves in her teacup.
"Is there anyone else bidding... Very well, then congratulations to Fellow Daoist Nan Shangfeng for winning the Cloud Dream Immortal Pillow," Mu Qingfeng asked symbolically once more, and upon seeing no one else was bidding, he straightforwardly announced.
The maid quickly brought over the Cloud Dream Immortal Pillow. Nan Shangfeng paid the spirit stones and swept his sleeves to collect it, but in fact, handed it over to Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming used his Divine Sense to explore the Jade Pillow, but aside from containing Moonlight Power, there was nothing else he could discover.
"The Moonlight Stone used in this Jade Pillow contains too many impurities, making it look unremarkable. If you purify it, it would be completely different. Lend me the Complete Heaven Exquisite Tripod for a moment," the voice of Void sounded again.
Yuan Ming didn't hesitate and immediately requested the Complete Heaven Exquisite Tripod from Dian Xiaosan, sending it along with the Cloud Dream Immortal Pillow into the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space.
White light flashed on the White Jade Lotus Platform, and both the Complete Heaven Exquisite Tripod and the Cloud Dream Immortal Pillow disappeared, their whereabouts unknown.
Yuan Ming's eyes flickered without saying anything.
The auction continued, and now the second auction item was brought forth.
It was a three-foot-long piece of purplish-red wood as thick as an adult's thigh, naturally engraved with circle patterns of fire clouds. Its whole body shone brightly and was as smooth as jade, clearly not an ordinary item at a glance.
Inside the Void Palace, Yuan Ming's eyes lit up: "The first auction item was the Cloud Dream Immortal Pillow, and the second item is a high-level spirit wood, which seems like Sixth Grade Spirit Wood. The Ten Thousand Treasure Auction indeed has many treasures."
"This second auction item is called the Purple Fire Cloud Crystal Wood, a Sixth Grade Spirit Wood, an excellent primary material for refining fire attribute spiritual treasures. Although it is wood, it has a jade-like form and greatly enhances fire attribute spiritual power," Mu Qingfeng explained, shooting a flame from his fingertip into one end of the Purple Fire Cloud Crystal Wood.
With a loud "boom," a thick crimson fire column erupted from the other end of the Purple Fire Cloud Crystal Wood, sending scorching waves over a dozen yards.
Many people below used mana to resist, with no blame in their expressions but instead showing a greedy look, staring intently at the Purple Fire Cloud Crystal Wood.
"All of you have probably seen the effects of the Purple Fire Cloud Crystal Wood, and this is without refining. The enhancement effect will be better after it's refined into a spiritual treasure. The starting price is 600,000 Spirit Stones, with minimum increments of 50,000 Spirit Stones," Mu Qingfeng announced.
Upon hearing this, the people below could not stay calm.
"I bid 650,000 Spirit Stones," announced the young man with a mole on his chin as he took the lead.
This time, Nan Shangfeng did not wait, directly offering, "One million Spirit Stones."
The main task given to him by Yuan Ming was to collect high-level spirit wood, and he had already decided not to let any piece slip by.
The young man with the mole froze momentarily. He had some savings, but compared to Nan Shangfeng, he had no confidence.
Facing Sixth Grade Spirit Wood, the numerous dignitaries in the loft were also restless.
"I bid 1.2 million Spirit Stones," a woman's voice rang out from the neighboring box; it was Long Yuhuan.
Nan Shangfeng turned his head to look. Under normal circumstances, he would thump his chest in assurance, not only refraining from competing with Long Yuhuan but also sweeping away all rivals to help her buy the item, just to win a beauty's smile.
Unfortunately, not today.
He thought of Yuan Ming's methods, his spine chilled, and even his soft heart had to harden.
"I'm sorry, Junior Sister Long, but this Sixth Grade Spirit Wood is highly important to me as well. I truly cannot yield it to you this time, so I must offend you. I bid 1.5 million Spirit Stones," Nan Shangfeng said, clasping his hands.
Long Yuhuan was unexpectedly taken aback, and although displeased, she said with a frown, "I bid 1.7 million Spirit Stones."
"1.9 million Spirit Stones," Nan Shangfeng was relentless.
