This price was already heavily inflated; Long Yuhuan bit her lip and ceased bidding further.
Ultimately, Nan Shangfeng secured the piece of Purple Fire Cloud Crystal Wood for 1.9 million Spirit Stones.
The third auction item was a bronze tripod furnace, a pill furnace magic treasure containing five kinds of True Fire, including Earth Fire, and likewise aroused much contention.
Yuan Ming was inwardly delighted; the Ten Thousand Treasure Auction truly gathered many heavy treasures, and none of them were ordinary. This trip was indeed worthwhile.
"Acquire this as well," he transmitted to Nan Shangfeng.
Nan Shangfeng, high-profile in his participation, spent another 1.2 million Spirit Stones to acquire it.
In this way, Nan Shangfeng suddenly became the focal point of the entire place, attracting a lot of discussions.
The fourth and fifth auction items were spiritual materials, while the sixth was an elixir, all of high quality, prompting a fierce bidding war among the crowd.
The two spiritual materials were of the metal and water attributes, which Yuan Ming had no use for. However, the bottle of elixir was for body cultivators to enhance physique and strengthen muscles. Initially, Nan Shangfeng, following Yuan Ming's instructions, raised the price to a high of eight hundred thousand spirit stones. Yet when the price continued to climb to eight hundred and fifty thousand, Yuan Ming stopped him from bidding further.
"The next auction item is called Purple Cloud Dan Sand, a sixth-level spiritual material, an auxiliary substance indispensable for refining many sixth-level elixirs. It is extremely valuable. The starting price is fifty thousand spirit stones, with each increase no less than ten thousand." Mu Qingfeng introduced loudly.
"It's finally here..." Yuan Ming's eyebrows twitched upward.
This Purple Cloud Dan Sand was one of the materials for refining the Dharma Manifestation Pill, and was also bait to lure out Yuan Ming and Yun Luo Fairy.
Jin Chen stood up, approaching the railing to look down.
Zhu Yu, Ouyang Qiang, and Bai Yuan all also coincidentally arrived at the railing, sweeping their gazes downward.
"I offer fifty thousand spirit stones." A thick-brow Taoist sitting in the front row on the second floor was the first to speak.
Ouyang Qiang's gaze immediately fell upon him, scrutinizing him while also scanning him with Divine Sense.
She was not worried about alerting the enemy, as there were certainly more than one pair of eyes on that thick-brow Taoist; everyone interested in the Purple Cloud Dan Sand would inevitably check him out.
"I offer sixty thousand." A middle-aged woman not far from him raised the bid.
"I offer seventy thousand." Another burly man in the back row also joined the bidding war.
Without Nan Shangfeng's involvement, the bidding became much more normalized.
After a few rounds of shouting, the price was pushed up to ninety thousand.
Ninety thousand spirit stones had already exceeded the normal price, so the bidding voices dwindled.
"I offer one hundred thousand." At this moment, a low voice suddenly came from a private room on the fifth floor.
The top floor boxes were made from special materials, rendering Divine Sense unable to penetrate. Without opening the doors and windows by oneself, outsiders could not see inside. Although the people below were curious, they did not know who the voice belonged to.
Ouyang Qiang, having devised this entrapment plan, naturally was not bothered by such minor issues. All the private boxes were secretly set with surveillance prohibitions.
She took out a black round mirror and activated it, revealing the situation inside the box: a person entirely dressed in a black robe and wearing a black hood.
His features were all concealed under the hood, revealing not a single trace of his true face.
Jin Chen also looked over, frowning slightly, "Who is this person? Such concealment is highly suspicious."
Zhu Yu, Bai Yuan, and Long Yuhuan also had the same round mirror in hand, watching the situation inside the box with serious expressions.
Nan Shangfeng had not received a message from Yuan Ming, and he himself had no interest in the Purple Cloud Dan Sand, playing with two concubines and completely ignoring the situation with Zhu Yu.
Yuan Ming was quite interested in the bidders. Although he did not have that black round mirror, he used the Circular Light Technique to spy on the person in the black robe.
At this moment, the voice from downstairs sounded again: "One hundred ten thousand spirit stones."
The bidder was the thick-brow Taoist who had initially spoken.
"One hundred thirty thousand spirit stones!" The black-robed person raised the bid.
"One hundred fifty thousand!" The thick-brow Taoist seemed determined to win.
The black robe moved slightly, silently sitting back, withdrawing from the bidding.
In the end, the thick-brow Taoist successfully acquired the Purple Cloud Dan Sand.
Jin Chen and the others weighed their options, and their gaze mostly fell on the thick-brow Taoist, focusing suspicion on this person.
The auction process continued as one auction item after another was brought out.
The atmosphere of the auction became increasingly lively, with bidding voices rising and falling, resembling a battlefield, contending for the ownership of treasures.
Among them, Nan Shangfeng's performance was the most noteworthy, having bid on nearly half of the auction items and eventually acquiring quite a few things.
Nan Shangfeng's profligacy was well-known, and Yuan Ming took advantage of this point, instructing him to increase his bids generously each time. Naturally, he could not possibly want every item, but it allowed him to confuse the observers, facilitating the acquisition of items he truly desired.
However, Jin Chen and Long Yuhuan both secretly shook their heads, snorting at Nan Shangfeng's wasteful behavior.
Nonetheless, it suited Nan Shangfeng's temperament and did not arouse much suspicion.
Their attention was more focused on those who had bought the baits they had laid out.
Besides the Purple Cloud Dan Sand, they had also placed two other materials needed for refining the Dharma Manifestation Pill. One of them was, again, secured by that thick-brow Taoist, while the other fell into the hands of a young man with a mole.
As a result, both of them became the primary suspects for Ouyang Qiang and her group, who secretly arranged for people to monitor them.

chapters.title: Chapter 890 - 860: Harvest
chapters.content:
While Ouyang Qiang and others focused their attention on the Thick-Brow Taoist and the young man with a mole, Yuan Ming leisurely checked his recent gains in the Void Palace's secret chamber.
In front of him were seven or eight boxes containing different types of spirit wood, among which there were three Sixth Grade spirit woods, and the rest were fifth-grade items.
Yuan Ming's face revealed a hint of joy as he waved his hand to close and store the boxes.
A few days ago, Nan Shangfeng had already found him some high-level spirit woods, which significantly increased the Power of Ten Thousand Wood Origin in the World Tree's bark. With the addition of these, he could almost refine his mana again.
The auction continued, but in the next dozen rounds, there was nothing Yuan Ming needed, and by this time, the auction was gradually coming to an end.
After Mu Qingfeng's brief preamble, another item was brought onto the stage. It was a transparent crystal stone about a tall height, with a golden flame the size of a bowl gently flickering at its core.
Even through the transparent crystal, a wave of heat swept over the venue, as if the scorching sun had descended.
"This is..." Yuan Ming's breath halted upon seeing this through the soul crow on Nan Shangfeng.
Zhu Yu, Bai Yuan, Long Yuhuan, and others also showed surprised expressions, only Jin Chen and Ouyang Qiang remained calm.
"Haha, I believe many fellow Daoists recognize this item. Indeed, this flame is the top-tier Earth Fire — the Profound Sun Earth Fire, born in the Nine Heavens, condensed by the Power of the Sun. It can be used for artifact refining and alchemy, and for a Body Cultivation practitioner, it's a dream come true. The Supreme Yang Fire Power within the Profound Sun Earth Fire can purify the body, refine impurities, increase the breakthrough chances, and has many other wonderful uses that I will not elaborate here. Starting price, one million Spirit Stones, with increments of no less than a hundred thousand each time," Mu Qingfeng said loudly.
Upon hearing this, the audience below who didn't understand also "buzzed" in excitement.
"It is indeed the Profound Sun Earth Fire," Yuan Ming thought to himself.
Whether used for condensing Eyes of Golden Flame or assisting Body Cultivation, this Profound Sun Earth Fire is an excellent choice.
The initial price of one million is clearly not high, obviously intended to lure more participants and push the price higher.
"I'll offer one million Spirit Stones." Below, the young man with a mole was the first to bid.
"One million three hundred thousand Spirit Stones." Soon, the sound of competing bids rang out.
In the fifth-floor box, Zhu Yu, Long Yuhuan, and others were clearly eager but did not immediately make a move.
Down below, the rising sound of bids was constant as Nan Shangfeng sat at the table eating Spirit Fruit, embracing a beauty, paying no attention to the fierce competition below, as he had no interest in the Profound Sun Earth Fire.
However, Yuan Ming's voice suddenly sounded in his Sea of Consciousness: "Get that Profound Sun Earth Fire for me, regardless of the cost."
Nan Shangfeng, who was kneading the soft flesh of the beauty's chest, jolted in surprise, stopped his actions, got up, and pushed the beauty aside, before approaching the railing again.
Seeing this, Zhu Yu, Long Yuhuan, and others frowned, but the cultivators below were excited.
Whenever Nan Shangfeng made this move, it meant he intended to make a bid.
"Your cultivation technique is not focused on Fire Attribute, nor are you skilled in artifact refining or alchemy, and you haven't pursued Body Cultivation. Why want this Profound Sun Earth Fire?" Zhu Yu suppressed his inner displeasure and couldn't help asking.
Though he was a member of the Demon Clan, he was not on the Body Cultivation path, but he still valued tempering his demon body and didn't want to miss out on the Profound Sun Earth Fire.
"Naturally, to gift it to someone. Phoenix has reached a bottleneck in cultivation, and this Profound Sun Earth Fire is a nice gift, though I'm not sure if it's suitable," Nan Shangfeng replied with a smile.
Zhu Yu was instantly infuriated, unsure if it's suitable, yet you want to buy it?
"I'll offer three million Spirit Stones." Nan Shangfeng looked at the auction stage and quoted.
His single bid raised the price from one point nine million to three million.
Upon hearing this, other cultivators wanting the Profound Sun Earth Fire looked unhappy, clearly having an urge to curse inwardly.
"Fellow Daoist Nan, why join in the excitement?" Bai Yuan, determined to get the Profound Sun Earth Fire, asked with furrowed brows.
"I see everyone bidding fiercely, so I know this must be a good item. Since it's a good item, how can I miss out?" Nan Shangfeng chuckled and replied.
Bai Yuan felt speechless upon hearing this.
Nan Shangfeng was not mindlessly just bidding; his sudden price increase was meant to intimidate other competitors, giving them the impression that he was determined to win, thus crushing their confidence.
At first glance, it seemed like an unwise move, but sometimes it had magical effects, and could actually save quite a bit of money.
As expected, after Nan Shangfeng suddenly raised the price, those hoping to get it cheap had given up, no longer bidding.
Some without adequate resources, like the young man with a mole who started bidding, also withdrew from the competition.
"Three million three hundred thousand Spirit Stones." At this moment, Long Yuhuan joined the battle.
Nan Shangfeng looked towards her, and Long Yuhuan also looked back unblinkingly, eyes shining with unyielding determination.
Just as Nan Shangfeng was about to speak, a voice came: "Three million five hundred thousand Spirit Stones."
This time, it was Jin Chen who spoke.
"Sorry, you two, I also want this Profound Sun Earth Fire." Jin Chen smiled and said.
"Three million six hundred thousand Spirit Stones." Another person spoke up, it was the Black Robe person.
Nan Shangfeng's expression changed. So many people had followed up, it seemed that obtaining the Profound Sun Earth Fire would not be easy.
"Four million." He decisively raised the bid.
"Four million two hundred thousand." Long Yuhuan followed closely.
"Four million five hundred thousand, everyone, I must get this fire." This time Jin Chen seemed determined as well.
"Four million eight hundred thousand." Nan Shangfeng raised his hand.
After some back-and-forth, the price of the Profound Sun Earth Fire quickly reached six million, with Nan Shangfeng being the bidder.
Long Yuhuan hesitated for a moment and did not continue to bid.
Bai Yuan seeing this, said, "I still have some Spirit Stones, if Fellow Daoist Long truly wishes for it, you can still give it another shot."
"No need, the price is too high; continuing to compete would not be worthwhile." Long Yuhuan said calmly.
The Black Robe person also did not make a move again.
"Six million one hundred thousand." Jin Chen gritted his teeth and continued with another bid.
"Fellow Daoist Wan, the price of Earth Fire generally ranges from one to two million. Although this Profound Sun Earth Fire is a top-level Earth Fire, this price is too outrageous, should we continue?" Nan Shangfeng transmitted a query.
"Of course, no matter how many Spirit Stones it takes, we must obtain this fire." Yuan Ming said without the slightest hesitation.
He had now mastered the method to refine High Grade Soul Refining Pills; with a little effort, earning ten million Spirit Stones would only take a few months.
The Profound Sun Earth Fire is different from other items; if missed, who knows when it will be encountered again.
"Six million three hundred thousand!" Nan Shangfeng understood Yuan Ming's intention and made a generous bid as usual.
"Six million four hundred thousand!" Jin Chen hesitated for a moment and then called out.
"Six million five hundred thousand! Jin Chen, I am determined to get this fire!" Nan Shangfeng looked provocatively at Jin Chen and laughed heartily.
"Young Master, this auction is hosted by Dongji Palace. White Emperor City is Dongji Palace's upper house. The current price far exceeds the value of a Profound Sun Earth Fire. If you continue to compete, others might think we are colluding to drive up the price. A reputation like that is something Dongji Palace cannot afford. I hope you can understand." Ouyang Qiang said in a low voice.
Jin Chen furrowed his brows and did not continue.
Nan Shangfeng appeared unconcerned on the surface but was truly sweating inside. Seeing Jin Chen back down, he breathed a sigh of relief.
Mu Qingfeng's tense face also softened. If rumors of malicious bidding spread, his reputation would also be damaged.
The Profound Sun Earth Fire finally fell into Nan Shangfeng's hands for six million five hundred thousand Spirit Stones, causing nearly everyone present to whisper, bringing the atmosphere to another climax.
"Everyone, the pleasant time has passed swiftly. Our Ten Thousand Treasure Auction tonight is also coming to an end. The final, grand item is about to take the stage. Let's wait and see." Mu Qingfeng said loudly.
As the words fell, an item covered by a transparent crystal cover was brought up.
This time, the person carrying the item was not a tall, beautiful woman but a man covered with a cloak filled with runes, and inside the crystal cover was a miniature altar the size of a dinner plate.
The altar was entirely pitch-black, round on top and bottom, and carved with strange runes. In the center of the altar, there was a circular sacrificial pool, its color crimson, like it still had traces of blood that had not yet dried.
The moment this item appeared, it attracted almost everyone's gaze. Just by looking at it, they felt an indescribable yet extremely uncomfortable sensation crawling up their spine.
It was like they were being watched by an ominous, dreadful creature from an unknown void, filled with malevolence and ferocity.
Fear and disgust climbed to their hearts. Some instinctively turned their eyes away, while others felt a greedy desire, wanting to possess this item.
Yuan Ming looked at the altar, unable to help but frown, but for some reason, he also felt a sense of familiarity.
"Right, it's that Evil King Mirror! The aura of both is very similar. Could this altar also be a Curse Spiritual Treasure?" He suddenly remembered the Evil King Mirror lying at the bottom of his Storage Bag.
"You may not have heard of it, but this treasure is called the Evil Curse Altar. It is a Curse Spiritual Treasure from the Central Continent, containing thirty-five Curse Runes and a Supreme Evil Spirit. Unfortunately, no one has been able to awaken it to date. The Evil Curse Altar's killing divine skills are astonishing. If used properly, killing across one or two levels is a trivial matter. Once, a Returning Void Cultivator used it to achieve the feat of hunting down a Dharma manifestation existence." Mu Qingfeng said in a straightforward manner.
The crowd below was in an uproar. There is an insurmountable gap between Returning Void and Dharma manifestation, whether in Mana levels or Spiritual Treasure powers. Even ten returning void cultivators would still be defeated when facing a Dharma manifestation Great Power, making it impossible to defeat by crossing levels!
However, considering Mu Qingfeng's character and the current occasion, this person would never lie. Could this Evil Curse Altar truly possess such heaven-defying divine skills?

chapters.title: Chapter 891 - 861: Black Robe Man
chapters.content:
"I know some of you doubt my words, but the secrets of the Evil Curse Altar cannot be elaborated here. Please weigh it yourselves. Moreover, I must state in advance that while the Evil Curse Altar is certainly a sharp weapon for killing, its dangers are immense. Most of its past owners have, for some reason, suffered great misfortune, either perishing or being severely injured. Only those with great fortune can control this treasure. I urge prepared Cultivators to participate in the auction. Now, let the auction begin, with a starting price of six million Spirit Stones, and the increments are up to you!" Mu Qingfeng spoke frankly, without any concealment, stating the pros and cons, and announced the start.
The crowd below looked at each other, and for a moment, no one made a bid.
Mu Qingfeng was not concerned and looked towards the various boxes on the fifth floor.
Bai Yuan, Long Yuhuan, and Zhu Yu were already excited when they heard the name "Evil Curse Altar". At this moment, without exception, they all got up, their eyes fixed on that treasure.
The only one not interested, on the contrary, was Nan Shangfeng.
"I didn't expect that the finale treasure of this auction would be it," Bai Yuan murmured to himself.
"Wasn't it said that this treasure was long destroyed in the last demon horde war on the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range? How could it appear again?" Zhu Yu also found it hard to believe and communicated with the others via sound transmission.
"That was merely a rumor. I heard from my master that those who participated in that great battle were all cursed, including the previous owner, and all perished in battle. The Evil Curse Altar vanished since then. Unexpectedly, after all these years, it surfaced in the hands of Dongji Palace," Long Yuhuan shook his head and said.
Yuan Ming, through the Circular Light Technique, observed Long Yuhuan and the others, showing a look of surprise.
Judging by their appearance, it seemed they all recognized this so-called "Evil Curse Altar".
He sent a sound transmission to inquire Nan Shangfeng, who didn't know, and only after asking Zhu Yu did he learn that the origin of the Evil Curse Altar was unknown, first appearing in a small assassin organization, "Blood Clothes Building", on the Central Continent.
With this treasure, Blood Clothes Building quickly rose from an unknown small force, becoming one of the top assassin organizations on the Central Continent in just a few hundred years.
After rapid expansion, Blood Clothes Building acted recklessly and eventually provoked Taixuan Sect by assassinating an important member.
In a fit of rage, Taixuan Sect dispatched several Dharma manifestation beings and dozens of Returning to Void Cultivators in one fell swoop, wiping out Blood Clothes Building, but the Evil Curse Altar mysteriously disappeared.
Subsequently, the Evil Curse Altar appeared several times. Those who obtained it shone brightly for a while on the Central Continent but soon encountered misfortune.
The last owner of this altar was a Demon Hunting Cultivator from the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range, who once single-handedly hunted a Level 6 demon beast, gaining great fame from it.
However, during the last demon horde outbreak, he was besieged by a large number of demon beasts. It's unknown what method he used, but before his death, he cursed to death all Cultivators and demon beasts within a radius of several hundred miles, taking them with him.
After that, the Evil Curse Altar mysteriously vanished again until it reappeared now.
After hearing all this, Yuan Ming finally realized and looked at the altar on the auction platform, seemingly tempted.
"The curse power contained within this altar is quite formidable. I advise you not to get any ideas. This item is more harmful than beneficial to you in your current state." An empty voice suddenly rang out, then went silent again, seemingly busy refining treasure and taking a moment to remind Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming pondered in his heart, finally deciding to heed the advice of the void and relinquish the idea of bidding.
While Yuan Ming chose not to buy, others fiercely competed.
"Six million Spirit Stones." A voice rang out, belonging to Zhu Yu.
"Six million three hundred thousand." Long Yuhuan also joined in.
"Six million five hundred thousand." Bai Yuan also participated.
The few of them contested with each other, and surprisingly, Zhu Yu slightly won, suppressing Long Yuhuan and Bai Yuan with nine million seven hundred thousand.
The entire Ten Thousand Treasure Tower fell into a brief silence.
Bai Yuan frowned, his face showing a rare look of dilemma.
He forced himself to speak, "Fellow Daoist Long, it's my fault for being too reckless earlier, having bought too many things, and now I no longer have enough Spirit Stones to compete with Zhu Yu."
"No problem, auctions are about both strength and luck. Although this treasure is indeed tempting, it's not to the point of being absolutely necessary. Since it's already overvalued, there's no need for us to unnecessarily waste Spirit Stones," Long Yuhuan shook his head and replied.
"Nine million seven hundred thousand, is there no one to offer a higher bid?" Mu Qingfeng asked.
The Ten Thousand Treasure Tower was quiet, almost everyone glancing around, holding a wait-and-see attitude, hoping someone would raise the bid higher, but no one did.
Mu Qingfeng glanced around, and seeing no one continued bidding, intended to announce the result.
"I bid ten million Spirit Stones." But just as he opened his mouth, a hoarse voice suddenly came from the venue.
"This person can actually come up with ten million Spirit Stones!" Jin Chen and Long Yuhuan also observed the black-robed person through the black Round Mirror, showing surprised expressions.
Although they were important figures in White Emperor City and Heavenly Dragon Hall and were valued by their Sects, with access to considerable resources, they still couldn't casually produce so many Spirit Stones.
"Eleven million!" Zhu Yu's eyes scanned the person repeatedly, gritting his teeth to quote again.
"Twelve million!" The black-robed person's tone didn't fluctuate at all.
Zhu Yu wished to continue, but lacking funds, he was ultimately forced to give up.
In the end, the Evil Curse Altar landed in the hands of the mysterious black-robed person.
A five-hundred-year Ten Thousand Treasure Tower auction concluded perfectly, and Cultivators in the venue began to leave one after another.
Bai Yuan, Long Yuhuan, Zhu Yu, and others reconvened in Jin Chen's box, with Nan Shangfeng also brought over.
"So, have the personnel arrangements been made?" Jin Chen asked.
"Don't worry, I've arranged people to track them," said Ouyang Qiang.
"Have you found out their identities?" Bai Yuan asked.
"The thick-browed Taoist, whose Dao Name is Wang Fan, is a quite renowned loose cultivator from the East Sea, with cultivation at the late stage of Returning Void. However, he has always been reclusive, rarely coming out, so it's unlikely," Ouyang Qiang replied.
"Regardless of whether he is or not, the tracking must not be relaxed," Jin Chen said.
"That goes without saying. As for the young man with a mole under his chin, we haven't been able to dig out his background; the fluctuation of cultivation on him seems like the early stage of Returning Void, which doesn't match Yuan Ming's identity but is indeed suspicious," Ouyang Qiang nodded.
"Lastly, the black-robed man managed to produce 12 million Spirit Stones, which doesn't seem like an ordinary cultivator. Should we also have someone check him out?" Zhu Yu asked with a slightly discontent voice.
"This person made a normal bid and has no connection with Yuan Ming and Yun Luo Fairy, so there's no need to stir up more trouble," Ouyang Qiang shook his head.
"Indeed, the most important thing now is to find Yuan Ming and Yun Luo Fairy," Jin Chen agreed.
Zhu Yu snorted and said no more.
"Wang Fan Taoist and that young man have left! We should split into two groups to follow them, observe their actions, and then decide whether to keep tracking or directly capture," Ouyang Qiang said, eyeing outside.
"I'll go with Fellow Daoist Bai to follow the young man with a mole," Long Yuhuan spoke first.
Hearing this, Jin Chen said, "Then I'll go with Palace Master Ouyang to follow Wang Fan Taoist."
Zhu Yu glanced at Nan Shangfeng, waiting for him to speak.
But the latter was absent-minded, as if he didn't hear their conversation at all.
"Young Master Nan, which one should we chase?" Zhu Yu reminded him.
"Any will do. You can decide fully; my people are at your disposal. I won't go," Nan Shangfeng yawned and remarked indifferently.
"Master, don't forget the instructions of Master Tantai," Zhu Yu whispered.
"You have arranged everything so thoroughly, those two definitely can't fly away. Whether there's one more person or less capturing them, what difference does it make? Besides, I have to rush backstage to settle the account for the Profound Sun Earth Fire I bought. If they think I can't afford it and ran away, where should I place my face?" Nan Shangfeng waved his hand and left the private room.
"Young Master Nan acts so casually, my apologies to everyone," Zhu Yu said with an unpleasant expression, then apologized to the others.
"Haha, Brother Nan is genuine like this. We're truly enough to track Wang Fan Taoist and that young man," Jin Chen chuckled.
Long Yuhuan remained expressionless, never glancing at Nan Shangfeng from start to finish.
Afterwards, Long Yuhuan and Bai Yuan, accompanied by Zhu Yu, went to follow the traces to track the young man with a mole.
Meanwhile, Jin Chen took Ouyang Qiang to track Wang Fan Taoist.
...
Backstage at the auction, the huge Crystal Stone sealing the Profound Sun Earth Fire was currently in a white Great Array, surprisingly reduced to nearly half its size.
Strands of white light from the Array were injected into the Crystal Stone as the seal on the Crystal Stone slowly recovered.
"So this is the reason you didn't immediately give this Profound Sun Earth Fire to me earlier," Nan Shangfeng said, looking at the scene before him.
"Exactly. The Profound Sun Earth Fire can burn anything. Before it's completely subdued, it can only be sealed using the Array. Young Master must take this Array along with the Profound Sun Earth Fire. It's heard that Young Master owns the Space Spiritual Treasure, Void Palace, so it shouldn't be a problem," Mu Qingfeng stood at the side, speaking.
"Of course." Nan Shangfeng flicked his sleeve, enveloping the Array in a white light.
"Young Master, please wait a moment, I'll immediately have someone transfer the Array to your Space Spiritual Treasure..." Mu Qingfeng hurriedly said upon seeing this.
"No need, that would be too cumbersome," Nan Shangfeng shook his head.
With a loud "boom," both the Array and the Crystal Stone inside disappeared, along with a large piece of the nearby ground.
A several-foot-deep pit appeared before them, causing the entire Ten Thousand Treasure Tower to quake.
"Here, are the Spirit Stones. The extra can be considered compensation to the Ten Thousand Treasure Tower," Nan Shangfeng tossed a Storage Bag to Mu Qingfeng and walked away.
Mu Qingfeng smiled wryly, using Divine Sense to probe the Storage Bag and nodded.
Nan Shangfeng quickly left the Ten Thousand Treasure Tower, disappearing into the bustling crowd.
At this moment, inside a nearby inn, two graceful figures leaned by the window, the red-skirted and green-clad women from the auction.
The green-clad woman held a Brass Ancient Mirror, inside which appeared a scene identical to East Extreme Island—buildings, roads, even the people on the streets—with perfect synchronous facial expressions, as though it were another real world.
The green-clad woman pinched a technique gesture, shifting the perspective inside the mirror to display Jin Chen and others tracking Wang Fan Taoist and the situation of the young man with a mole.
"How is it? Any findings?" the red-skirted woman asked.
"Not yet for now, but it's not over," the green-clad woman stared at the Brass Ancient Mirror intently, not looking away for a second.
"Then let's wait and see," the red-skirted woman nodded, replying.

chapters.title: Chapter 892 - 862: Favorable Impression
chapters.content:
Nan Shangfeng left the Ten Thousand Treasure Tower and quickly arrived at the inn he previously stayed at.
In the inn room, he set up several forbidden barriers in one breath, then opened his Void Palace and entered it, soon finding Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming was looking at the array that sealed the Profound Sun Earth Fire. Upon seeing Nan Shangfeng enter, he flicked his sleeve, shooting out a beam of blue light, transferring the array and the sealing crystal stone, along with the ground below, into the Shura Palace.
Then he took out a storage bag and handed it to Nan Shangfeng.
"This is for my expenses at the auction; keep it safe," Yuan Ming said.
Almost all the spirit stones he carried were inside this storage bag, which also contained a few magic treasures and spiritual materials; their value roughly matched the auction expenses, with a little extra.
"Fellow Daoist Wan, this is belittling me. Who outside doesn't know that I, Nan Shangfeng, am loyal to friends? Especially to you? It's just some spirit stones, consider it my tribute to you," Nan Shangfeng waved his hand repeatedly, speaking sincerely.
"Each matter should be kept separate. Please accept it without worry; I'm not being pretentious or testing you. You've helped me greatly this time, and I won't treat you unjustly; I'll soon return you your freedom," Yuan Ming said likewise.
Upon hearing this, joy flashed across Nan Shangfeng's face, and he said, "Since Fellow Daoist Wan says so, I won't be polite then."
Saying that, he accepted the storage bag and didn't check its contents, simply putting it away.
"By the way, does Fellow Daoist Wan have any other instructions? I can prepare in advance," Nan Shangfeng asked again.
Yuan Ming stood there silently, not answering, lost in thought.
Seeing this, Nan Shangfeng did not dare to disturb him.
"Fellow Daoist Nan, I ask you, do you have the aspiration to reach the Dharma manifestation stage?" Yuan Ming suddenly opened his mouth and asked in return.
Upon hearing this, Nan Shangfeng was taken aback, revealing a rare touch of melancholy, and then he smiled: "The Dharma manifestation stage, who wouldn't want to advance? Unfortunately, it's beyond my reach now."
Yuan Ming had seen Nan Shangfeng's past memories and knew that Nan Shangfeng was actually highly talented. The reason he had descended to such a licentious state was largely due to a severe injury from the past; his spirit root was severely damaged and his cultivation could no longer progress, thus he indulged in women.
"Your spirit root may still have the possibility of healing. If there remains even a breath of ambition to rise, I can provide you with an opportunity to advance to the Dharma manifestation stage," Yuan Ming said slowly.
After spending these days with Nan Shangfeng, his opinion of this fellow was not bad, in fact, somewhat optimistic.
"Does Fellow Daoist Wan have a way to heal my spirit root problem? My master tried countless methods, but none worked," Nan Shangfeng suddenly raised his head, showing a serious expression.
"Certainly. You're a wood attribute Heavenly Spirit Root, right? If it were another type of spirit root, I couldn't help, but a Wood Spirit Root is no problem," Yuan Ming said affirmatively.
"If Fellow Daoist Wan can heal my spirit root injury, I am willing to regard you as my elder brother, follow you for life, and never betray!" Nan Shangfeng looked at Yuan Ming carefully, solemnly bowed, and spoke with a tone tinged with excitement, even trembling slightly.
"Fellow Daoist Nan, it's not necessary. To heal your spirit root, other preparations are needed. I need to go out for a while; wait here for me," Yuan Ming pulled up Nan Shangfeng, patting his shoulder, and said.
Nan Shangfeng nodded blankly, still somewhat taken aback after Yuan Ming left the Void Palace.
Yuan Ming left the inn and went straight to the Ten Thousand Goods Immortal Trip.
Perhaps due to the influence of the Ten Thousand Treasure Auction, there weren't many people inside the Ten Thousand Goods Immortal Trip today, and the number of maids behind the store counter was far fewer than before, making it quite deserted.
Just as Yuan Ming was about to enter, he heard a familiar voice from behind: "Oh, isn't it Fellow Daoist Wan?"
Upon hearing the familiar voice, Yuan Ming turned his head to see two beautiful figures walking over, it was Shen Qingqing and the beautiful mature woman known as "Sister Ling."
Judging by the appearance of the two women, they were just returning from outside.
"Ah, it's you two. How come you're returning from outside? Did you also attend the auction?" Yuan Ming asked with a smile.
"The Ten Thousand Treasure Auction is held once every five hundred years, we naturally couldn't miss it; it's good to broaden our horizons. Speaking of which, didn't seem to spot Fellow Daoist Wan earlier, maybe you didn't attend?" The beautiful mature woman inquired.
Shen Qingqing stood beside her, glancing at Yuan Ming with slightly cold eyes, without speaking.
"The Ten Thousand Treasure Auction is so rare, I naturally also went, just the seat was a bit secluded," Yuan Ming raised his eyebrows and said.
"I see, did Fellow Daoist Wan come here because of an agreement with Manager Gu?" The beautiful mature woman chuckled softly and changed the topic.
"Yes, might I trouble Fellow Daoist to take me to meet your Manager Gu?" Yuan Ming didn't want to waste time, saying directly.
"Alright, follow me please." The beautiful mature woman didn't hesitate, pulling Shen Qingqing along to lead the way.
Very soon, Yuan Ming followed the two women and arrived at the Pill Assessment Pavilion inside the Ten Thousand Treasure Tower, meeting Gu Xingdong.
"Fellow Daoist Wan, I sincerely apologize. Most of the high-level spirit wood flowed to the Ten Thousand Treasure Auction, there wasn't much directly purchased. However, I've managed to collect some Nine Nether Iron again, among which there's one piece of quite good quality." Upon meeting, Gu Xingdong first apologized to Yuan Ming.
"It doesn't matter, it's no problem," Yuan Ming waved his hand.
All the spirit wood from the auction was bought back by Nan Shangfeng without missing a piece.
"Please take a look first, then we can discuss the price." Gu Xingdong said.
As he spoke, with a wave of his hand, twelve pieces of spirit wood appeared on the table in front of him. Four of them were of sixth grade, and the rest were fifth-grade, fairly standard.
As for the Nine Nether Iron, there were a total of thirteen pieces, the largest one indeed as Gu Xingdong described, of excellent quality and as large as a barrel.
Yuan Ming bargained several times and finally bought everything for seven million spirit stones.
Naturally, he didn't have that many spirit stones on him, but fortunately, Dian Xiaosan had recently produced a batch of High Grade Soul Refining Pills, so he took out six Soul Refining Pills as compensation, and Gu Xingdong was overjoyed.
After exchanging a few more pleasantries, Yuan Ming took his leave.
After Yuan Ming left, Gu Xingdong stood in the room, his brows slightly furrowed, still feeling that this "Wan Tianren" was somewhat peculiar.
However, whether or not he was the person Gu Xingdong suspected had little to do with their Ten Thousand Goods Immortal Trip.
As long as this person could continuously provide pills like High Grade Soul Refining Pills, he would be a good friend to the Ten Thousand Goods Immortal Trip.
...
At this moment, in a certain room of the inn where the women in red dress and green garment were,
the brass ancient mirror in the hand of the woman in green suddenly began to emit a yellow light, rippling outward like water waves.
"Have you found anything?" the woman in a red dress asked eagerly.
"No, the spiritual power of the Da Ji Ancient Mirror is exhausted. My cultivation is too low to activate the full power of the Da Ji Ancient Mirror, causing it to enter a dormant state periodically, a problem I hadn't anticipated at this critical moment." The woman in the green garment frowned with a bitter smile.
The light on the brass ancient mirror quickly dimmed and soon vanished completely, becoming an ordinary mirror with no spiritual power fluctuation.
The woman continued to perform hand seals, attempting to awaken the Da Ji Ancient Mirror again, but the mirror showed no response.
Seeing this, the woman in the red dress showed a disappointed look: "The auction has already concluded. If Yuan Ming had come, he wouldn't have taken no action until now. It seems there's an eighty-percent chance he did not attend the Ten Thousand Treasure Auction."
"That's the only possibility, after all, it's my overconfidence that has brought Meiniang Sister's efforts in vain." The woman in green laughed self-deprecatingly.
"Junior Sister Chu, why do you say such things? I was the one who asked for your help; there's no need for you to apologize." The woman in red quickly comforted.
The woman in green shook her head and said nothing.
"For this setup, Junior Sister made a Heart Demon Oath to Ouyang Qiang, promising that Yuan Ming and Yun Luo would appear at the Ten Thousand Treasure Auction. Now that the oath has been broken, will it affect your future cultivation?" the woman in red asked, changing the topic.
"There's no need to worry, Meiniang Sister. The oath was made by a mere mirror clone, what does it have to do with me?" the woman in green replied with a cunning smile.
"A mirror clone? So that's it." The woman in red was taken aback, and seeing the Da Ji Ancient Mirror in the other's hand, she seemed to understand something and breathed a sigh of relief.
"That Yuan Ming is incredibly cunning. The Dongji Palace, Luo Jia Mountain, and Azure Dragon Pond have joined forces to search for him for so many years, yet they still haven't found him. To catch him will indeed require some thought, there's no need for Meiniang Sister to be anxious." The woman in green said.
"I'm naturally not anxious, but the Sect can hardly wait anymore. Over the years, Master personally verified the half Pill King Secret Manual given by Yun Luo, including the Dharma Manifestation Pill, and found all the Dan recipes to be incorrect." The woman in red smiled bitterly.
"Incorrect! Yun Luo, so malicious at heart!" The woman in green's brows immediately furrowed in anger.
"If it were just obtaining a fake half-secret manual, that would be one thing. However, Master promised opposing sects reward with Dharma Manifestation Pills to alleviate pressure on the Su Nu Sect. Now unable to refine the pills, it puts our sect in an even more passive position. If the correct Dan recipe can't be found in time, the Su Nu Sect is truly in jeopardy." The woman in red's expression dimmed.
The eyes of the woman in green also showed traces of sadness, and she opened her mouth but didn't know what to say.
"Enough, it's better not to talk about these vexing matters. At this point, Junior Sister staying on East Extreme Island is useless, you might as well return to Wuya Island quickly." The woman in red waved her hand and said.
"What does Meiniang Sister plan to do next?" the woman in green asked.
"I have some personal matters to attend to." The woman in red replied.
After the two women conversed for a while longer, the woman in red transformed into a crimson silhouette and shot off into the distance, disappearing in a few breaths.
As the green-garbed woman watched the red-dressed woman leave, her sorrowful expression turned cold, and she muttered to herself hatefully: "Heaven's justice prevails, retribution is inescapable. Such a dirty sect like the Su Nu Sect should have disappeared long ago."
She then took out the brass ancient mirror, performing a sign with her hand, and the previously dim mirror surface suddenly regained its brightness, clearly indicating that the statement about the Da Ji Ancient Mirror's spiritual power being exhausted was entirely false.
The green-garbed woman performed a series of hand signs, and a figure appeared in the mirror, none other than Yuan Ming.
In the mirror, he was enveloped entirely in a shroud of black aura, his appearance somewhat blurred.
"Disguising himself with demon energy? No wonder he could evade the detection arrays of the Dongji Palace, but he still couldn't escape the Da Ji Ancient Mirror's probing." The woman chuckled, then chanted an incantation, her figure rapidly becoming transparent, disappearing completely within a few breaths.

chapters.title: Chapter 893 - 863: Extortion
chapters.content:
At the same time, Yuan Ming suddenly stopped his steps on the street and looked around.
For a moment, he had a feeling that someone was watching him secretly.
"Is someone spying on me?" Yuan Ming immediately spread his Divine Sense, covering a radius of a hundred feet, but found nothing.
Yuan Ming did not continue searching but quickened his pace, soon arriving at the inn where Nan Shangfeng was staying.
He didn't go inside but stopped in a deserted alley nearby.
"You've been following me for so long, it's time to show yourself." Yuan Ming turned and looked behind him.
"Fellow Daoist, your Divine Skills are impressive. Even Dharma Phase Cultivators may not see through my earth escape invisibility." From the ground at the alley's entrance, a figure emerged, it was the woman in green clothing.
"Who are you? Following me for so long, don't you know that tracking others without reason is quite an offensive act?" Yuan Ming glanced the person over, confirming they hadn't met, a flash of hostility in his eyes.
"Hehe, Fellow Daoist, there's no need to be so fierce. I mean no harm. I've come today just to make a deal with you." The woman in green smiled as usual, with no concern for Yuan Ming's murderous intent.
"I have no interest in making deals with someone of unknown origin. I can pretend I didn't realize your surveillance just now, you should leave." Yuan Ming flatly refused and turned to leave.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan should not refuse so easily, it's beneficial for both of us." The woman in green lightly smiled.
The air in the alley condensed for a moment and then returned to normal.
"I think you've got the wrong person. I am Wan Tianren, not surnamed Yuan." Yuan Ming stopped, speaking calmly.
"Fellow Daoist Yuan's disguise is indeed exquisite, almost flawless, but unfortunately, you can only change your Mana aura, not disguise the Divine Soul aura. You still left a flaw." The woman in green said.
"Divine Soul aura... I never paid attention to that before. That you can discern a cultivator from Divine Soul aura shows you're not ordinary." Yuan Ming realized and stopped disguising, turning around.
"I'm just a nobody compared to the famous Yuan Mo." The woman in green smiled triumphantly and said.
"Are you provoking me? Do you think holding onto a little evidence gives you free rein?" Yuan Ming said coldly.
"How dare I, Fellow Daoist Yuan didn't leave, should I take it as you're agreeing to the deal?" The woman in green smiled charmingly, appearing to retreat but actually pressing forward step by step.
"As I said, I won't make deals with someone of unknown origin. If you want something from me, state your full name first." Yuan Ming said calmly.
"I apologize for my rudeness, I am Chu Zhixian." The woman in green hesitated briefly, then gave her name.
"I wonder what kind of deal Fellow Daoist Chu has in mind?" Yuan Ming asked.
"I'm very interested in Alchemy. I heard the Pill King Secret Manual from the Pill King Pavilion is in your possession, and I wish to take a look at it and will return it immediately after." A glint of uncontrollable greed flashed in Chu Zhixian's eyes.
"You want to see the Pill King Secret Manual? It's not impossible, but what does Fellow Daoist Chu offer in exchange?" Yuan Ming asked.
"How about exchanging it for your safety? That should suffice, right?" Chu Zhixian smiled sinisterly, her threat crystal clear.
"Using my life to exchange for my Pill King Secret Manual—Fellow Daoist is certainly good at business." Yuan Ming laughed instead of getting angry.
"Although I know I'm not your match, I can manage to resist for a while. This is East Extreme Island Square, with countless cultivators, and forces like Dongji Palace and White Emperor City are all watching for you. As soon as I shout, Fellow Daoist Yuan won't be able to leave here!" Chu Zhixian stepped back two steps. Meanwhile, she raised her right hand, and a Yellow Stone Shield appeared in front of her, enveloping her in a thick yellow light.
"If it were an ordinary cultivator, indeed so, but unfortunately I am not." Yuan Ming's tone turned chilling in an instant, his powerful Divine Sense erupting, enveloping only the alley.
He used the Nightmare Divine Ability, spreading an invisible wave.
Chu Zhixian's expression froze, her body limply collapsed on the ground, falling into sleep.
Yuan Ming flicked his sleeve, casting a yellow light to wrap around Chu Zhixian's body, drawing her into the Shura Palace, then turned to leave.
At this moment, his expression suddenly froze.
Inside the Shura Palace, Chu Zhixian's body suddenly turned into countless yellow spirit lights, dispersing like bubbles.
Her clothes and the shield Magic Treasure she used were the same.
"It's a clone condensed from Mana!" Yuan Ming realized.
No wonder this female cultivator, with her low cultivation, dared to extort him directly; she had sent a clone.
Yuan Ming's expression was extremely stern, immediately flying out of the island.
His actions were exposed, he had to leave before others arrived.
The only consolation was that due to the Ten Thousand Treasure Auction, the islands of the Dongji Islands had not activated their defense arrays.
However, Yuan Ming had only flown a short distance before stopping again, landing in the deserted alley, waving his hand.
An Illusion Array was instantly set up, covering the entire alley.
From the outside, there was nothing unusual in the alley, as quiet and empty as ever, and Yuan Ming's figure vanished from within.
Yuan Ming took out the silver token and opened a silver spherical barrier, completely blocking any external probing.
He didn't stop and then summoned the Shura Palace, entering the Medicine Garden Cave Mansion within it.
After doing all this, Yuan Ming finally sat cross-legged and summoned the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
He took out a stick of black incense that could control the host, lit it, and possessed Chu Zhixian.
In a private room of a teahouse three blocks away, Chu Zhixian suddenly stood up, her right hand tightly gripping the Da Ji Ancient Mirror, her face full of anger.
"Well, Yuan Ming, since you're courting death, don't blame me!" Chu Zhixian gritted her teeth and said, taking out a communication talisman, ready to activate it.
However, recalling the Pill King Secret Manual, especially the Dharma Manifestation Pill Recipe on it, she hesitated for a moment.
At that moment, Chu Zhixian's consciousness suddenly plunged into endless darkness, the light in her eyes completely vanished, and the next instant, she regained her composure.
Yuan Ming's consciousness successfully controlled her body, and upon seeing the unactivated communication talisman in her hand, his expression relaxed.
He released his divine sense, confirmed there were no issues in the area, and manipulated her to leave the teahouse, quickly entering a deserted alley and walking into an illusion array.
A moment later, Chu Zhixian appeared inside the Shura Palace, unconscious.
The mana fluctuations on her body had also completely disappeared, seemingly sealed.
Yuan Ming raised his hand and placed it on Chu Zhixian's head, using the Soul Searching Divine Ability, quickly understanding everything.
"I see, everything about the auction was orchestrated by Chu Zhixian and Qin Meiniang," Yuan Ming realized.
The woman in the red dress was Qin Meiniang, the most capable disciple of the Su Nu Sect's Sect Leader, unexpectedly her cultivation had reached the Dharma manifestation stage, and it was unclear how she compared with Yun Luo Fairy in terms of strength.
As for Chu Zhixian's extortion of him, it had nothing to do with the Su Nu Sect, it was purely due to her greed, and no one else knew about it at this moment.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming let out a small sigh, placed another sealing on Chu Zhixian to put her into a deep sleep, and then left Shura Palace.
Although his identity wasn't exposed, he couldn't stay longer on East Extreme Island.
Yuan Ming returned to the inn, instructing Nan Shangfeng to leave.
Nan Shangfeng, at this moment, followed Yuan Ming's words without question, didn't ask the reason, sent a message to Zhu Yu, and then led his subordinates and concubines to leave East Extreme Island on a flying boat.
Feeling the flying boat leave East Extreme Island, Yuan Ming finally felt relieved and re-entered the Shura Palace's Medicine Garden.
His body whirled, transforming into the form of an Undying Tree, expanding its branches, swaying within the Medicine Garden.
On the black trunk, a palm-sized cyan-grey spot remained conspicuously visible.
Yuan Ming glanced at the bark of the World Tree, then with a flick of the vines, took out all the high-level spirit wood acquired from the auction and just bought from Gu Xingdong.
In the instant these spirit woods appeared, they all floated in mid-air, establishing a natural connection with the World Tree that was indescribable.
Without Yuan Ming's manipulation, each piece of spirit wood began to tremble slightly, with a layer of indistinctly colored halo appearing on the surface, then transformed into streams of light flowing towards the palm-sized cyan-grey bark.
As dots of light merged into that cyan bark, Yuan Ming felt the origin power of the Undying Tree replenished, though it felt slightly different from before, exactly how he couldn't quite say.
The cyan bark within emitted a bright glow, turning the original cyan-grey color to a transparent jade, and upon closer inspection, specks of firefly-like light pulsed within, exuding an indescribable life force, precisely the power of Ten Thousand Wood Origin.
At this moment, a streak of green light suddenly appeared within the bark of the World Tree, emanating bursts of the aura of Ten Thousand Wood Origin.
Unlike the other Ten Thousand Wood Origin within the bark, this green light moved slowly within, ready to be drawn out at any moment.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming was delighted.
His previous speculation was correct; as long as the World Tree absorbed enough high-level spirit wood, it could harness the Ten Thousand Wood Origin's power within, refining mana through the physical body.
At this moment, a series of changes again occurred within the bark of the World Tree.
Beneath the jade-like bark, a thin green vein extended, wrapping around to the other side of the tree body. After lingering there, a mass of emerald green light spread out like ink.
Soon the area of the green bark expanded several times.
The trunk of the Undying Tree beneath the bark also began to transform, turning the same emerald green as the bark.
Yuan Ming, joyful, through absorbing the spiritual power of these high-level spirit woods, the bark of the World Tree continued to expand, and if the whole Undying Tree transformed into the World Tree in the future, it wouldn't be impossible.
He suppressed the excitement in his heart, continuing to absorb the remaining spiritual power from the spirit woods.
A moment later, the bark of the World Tree expanded significantly, and a second streak of green light from the Ten Thousand Wood Origin emerged.
Yuan Ming was extremely satisfied with this, but he wasn't yet in a safe place to cultivate, so he didn't immediately use the two green lights of Ten Thousand Wood Origin to refine his body.

chapters.title: Chapter 894 - 864: Yuan Ming's Answer
chapters.content:
Just after Nan Shangfeng and Yuan Ming left East Extreme Island, Ouyang Qiang and others, tracking both the Forgetful Taoist and the young man with a mole, also departed from East Extreme Island.
Among them, the actions of the Forgetful Taoist appeared particularly suspicious.
As soon as he left the Ten Thousand Treasure Tower, he changed his aura, attire, and appearance in a hidden place, trying to shake off those secretly tailing him.
Little did he know, Dongji Palace and the other two major forces had already laid down an inescapable Heaven and Earth Net. Despite changing his appearance multiple times on the way, he was never able to shake off his trackers, instead causing these forces to become increasingly suspicious of him.
However, after they followed him all the way, they found that the Forgetful Taoist merely wanted to hide his seclusion location. During this period, he made no contact with others and returned directly to the isolated island where his cave mansion was located.
When Jin Chen and the others broke open the defense magic array on his island, he thought it was someone coveting the treasure he won at the auction and fought back with all his strength, but was soon completely suppressed.
However, after Jin Chen and others conducted a Soul Search on him, they found that he had no relation to Yuan Ming or Yun Luo Fairy. He bought the spiritual materials they used as bait just to refine high-grade elixirs.
Jin Chen and the others looked at each other. To prevent any leaks, they mercilessly killed the Forgetful Taoist to keep it quiet and erased all traces on the island.
On the other side, Long Yuhuan and others, tracking the young man with a mole, were even more speechless.
After leaving the Ten Thousand Treasure Tower, he was not in a hurry to leave East Extreme Island but rented a manor instead and moved in with two concubines.
For two whole days, he was wholeheartedly studying the art of the bedchamber, not stepping outside even once.
In the end, Bai Yuan and others, unable to bear it any longer, forcibly broke in and captured him.
After a round of interrogation and soul searching, they also found nothing.
In a great hall of Dongji Palace, Ouyang Qiang and others gathered to review this operation.
"This operation failed. Does anyone have anything to say?" Jin Chen asked with a gloomy expression.
"Perhaps those two received some information and did not attend this auction at all," Ouyang Qiang, also looking displeased, said.
After speaking, she looked towards the side of the hall, where an elliptical white light screen floated, showing the image of Nan Shangfeng with women in his arms.
This operation was a collaboration of the six powers, and although Nan Shangfeng was reluctant, he was still dragged in to remotely attend this meeting.
"Palace Master Ouyang, why are you looking at me? Do you suspect me? I've never met Yuan Ming or Yun Luo Fairy, so why would I leak the information?" Nan Shangfeng laughed.
"Never met them? Who can be sure of that? Everyone knows you are a lecher; it's possible you've long fallen under Yun Luo's skirt," Ouyang Qiang said.
"Palace Master Ouyang, I thought you were a calm and composed beautiful lady, but it turns out to be nothing more, throwing a tantrum when the task fails, what's the difference from a shrew?" Nan Shangfeng chuckled.
Already in a terrible mood due to the complete failure of the operation, Ouyang Qiang rose abruptly, golden arcs flashing around her body.
"The situation is already bad enough, there's no need for you two to make it worse," Jin Chen frowned and said in a deep voice.
Ouyang Qiang dared not offend Jin Chen and suppressed her anger by force.
"None of us wanted to see the mission fail. Although Fellow Daoist Nan is somewhat carefree, I accompanied him for most activities after reaching the island. The information was not leaked by him," Zhu Yu coughed and explained for Nan Shangfeng.
Bai Yuan and Zhu Yu never suspected Nan Shangfeng, they looked at Ouyang Qiang: "The reason for the task's failure lies in the intelligence. Palace Master Ouyang, where did you get the information that Yuan Ming and Yun Luo would come to participate in the Ten Thousand Treasure Auction?"
"The new owner of Qingjin Building." At this point, Ouyang Qiang would not cover for anyone, directly saying.
"Qingjin Building? I remember it being an industry of the Su Nu Sect. Could it be that the Su Nu Sect is behind all this?" Bai Yuan murmured.
"We can't rule out their suspicion. After the mission failed, I tried to contact the new owner of Qingjin Building multiple times but received no response. Other people at Qingjin Building said that the owner left Qingjin Building more than ten days ago and disappeared," Ouyang Qiang said as she attempted to shrug off responsibility.
"It seems likely that this affair is indeed orchestrated by the Su Nu Sect," Long Yuhuan said.
Bai Yuan and Zhu Yu nodded.
Seeing this, Ouyang Qiang secretly breathed a sigh of relief.
The main reason for this mission's failure was her credulity in Qingjin Building's intelligence. Now by shifting the blame to Su Nu Sect, her burden of responsibility was lessened.
"How boring, this young master has no interest in listening to your summary of failures here. You all can chat among yourselves; I will take my leave." Nan Shangfeng sneered and cut off the communication.
"The island is loose on the outside and tight on the inside, continue the search for several more days," Jin Chen said with a sigh, not minding Nan Shangfeng's departure.
...
The night grew deeper.
In the sky, the stars were sparse, with only a solitary moon hanging high, casting moonlight as bright as frost and snow, only to be quietly swallowed by the boundless sea, revealing some light only during the surging waves.
Many newly awakened fish demons and sea beasts surfaced, bathing in the moonlight, breathing spiritual energy, maintaining a peculiar harmony with each other, unwilling to disturb the tranquillity beneath the moon.
But suddenly, a low rumble sounded, revealing a massive flying boat in the sky, its deck ablaze with lights, filled with singing and dancing, a picture of revelry.
However, the group of Little Demons were startled by the surge of Spiritual Power from the Flying Boat as it crossed over, scrambling to dive into the seawater, fearing they would be caught and made into fish stew for someone's midnight snack.
But the patrolling guards on the deck paid no attention to this group of Little Demons. At this moment, they stood guard outside, listening to the voluptuous sounds echoing from the ship's cabins, feeling somewhat restless inside.
"Even on a journey, such extravagance—they really know how to enjoy themselves," one guard muttered quietly.
"Silence! If Lord Nan hears you, you'll suffer for it," the guard patrolling with him quickly chastised.
Yet as he spoke, he turned his head to glance at the ship's cabins, eyes full of envy.
Meanwhile, within the ship's cabins, Nan Shangfeng, surrounded by women, ended the communication with Jin Chen and the others.
"A bunch of fools, Yuan Ming and Yun Luo Fairy have been missing for over a hundred years, it's not that easy to find them," Nan Shangfeng spat on the ground, speaking with disdain.
"The Young Master is right," a group of enchanting female cultivators agreed.
Though Nan Shangfeng, as usual, held an enchanting female cultivator in his arms, his hand was not as free-wandering as usual. While his face bore a smile, he seemed somewhat distracted.
"Forget it, I'm tired, you all leave," suddenly, Nan Shangfeng sighed, raising his hand to pat a female cultivator's shoulder beside him, ushering them all out.
The group of female cultivators were of course puzzled but dared not disobey Nan Shangfeng's wish, obediently retreating.
"Does Young Master Nan have something troubling him?" Ruan Lianyu, who had been standing by Nan Shangfeng's side, hesitated for a moment before asking.
"Sigh, it's just the thought of returning to the Sect to face all those bothersome matters, I've lost my mood," Nan Shangfeng shook his head, lying down wearily, as if pondering something.
The Ruan Brothers exchanged a glance, not daring to ask more, only lowering their heads silently, continuing to guard Nan Shangfeng without a word.
What they didn't know was that at this time, Nan Shangfeng, who appeared to be deep in thought, was actually communicating with Yuan Ming inside the Void Palace.
"Fellow Daoist Wan, we need to head west next, returning to the Daluo Sect. It may take another half-year or more to reach the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range. During this time, I'll have to trouble you to remain in the Void Palace for a while longer," Nan Shangfeng said respectfully.
"No worries, you needn't concern yourself with me. Just act as you usually would, lest others notice anything amiss," Yuan Ming replied.
He had already completed what needed to be done in the Dongji Sea; it was time to leave. Now, with various forces relentlessly pursuing him, leaving with Nan Shangfeng naturally posed the least risk.
"I will certainly act cautiously, ensuring no one notices anything amiss," Nan Shangfeng hurriedly assured.
Yuan Ming grunted an acknowledgment, then looked up at the sky.
Besides being within Nan Shangfeng's body, he had left a few soul crows on the Flying Boat to observe the situation outside.
Through these soul crows, Yuan Ming quietly watched the dark ocean.
"Kid, I didn't expect you to be so sentimental. Are you reluctant to leave the Dongji Sea?" The Void's voice suddenly arose.
"Senior Kong, have you finished refining the Cloud Dream Immortal Pillow?" Yuan Ming asked quickly upon hearing this.
A flash of white light appeared beside Yuan Ming, and the Void's figure emerged: "It's far from over, still refining the materials."
Yuan Ming was somewhat disappointed.
"Kid, you haven't answered my question yet," the Void continued.
Yuan Ming hesitated for a moment before understanding the Void's meaning: "After all, I've spent quite some time in the Dongji Sea."
"This is the fate of a cultivator, always on the road of pursuit, never able to stay in one place for long," the Void said.
"What the Senior says is true," Yuan Ming nodded, though he was rather surprised in his heart.
Since the Void's awakening, he had not been treated to either scorn or orders, and it was the first time they had such a calm conversation.
"Yuan kid, come to think of it, I've never asked you, what is your pursuit?" the Void suddenly inquired.
"Why does the Senior ask this suddenly?" Yuan Ming didn't answer immediately but asked instead.
"You've been refining the Stealing Heaven Tripod's forbidden array quite smoothly, surpassing sixty arrays, much faster than Xia Jie back in the day. I feel I should know more about you," the Void explained.
Yuan Ming was silent for a moment, controlling the soul crows to gaze into the endless starry sky, staying speechless for a while.
"What's the matter, difficult to answer?" the Void asked.
"Of course not, I'm just recalling the past, confirming my answer," Yuan Ming shook his head.
"Oh, and what is your answer?" the Void asked.
"In my youth, I was adrift at the Southern Border, accidentally embarking on the path of cultivation. Later I returned to Da Jin, contended with Chang Chun Temple, then fought with Wu Yue Sect and the Demon World, and in recent years roamed the Dongji Sea... All of this seems compelled by circumstances, unavoidable. Yet fundamentally, it's because I don't want to be constrained by others; I just wish to live free," Yuan Ming looked down at his hands, speaking slowly.

chapters.title: Chapter 895 - 865: Calamity Knocks at the Door
chapters.content:
"So, you're pursuing freedom?" Void said.
"Yes!" Yuan Ming responded without hesitation, his tone rather firm.
"Pursuing freedom is easier said than done. You possess the Stealing Heaven Tripod, whether you like it or not, sooner or later you'll be drawn into the conflict between the two realms. The strength of the Chuyun Realm is far inferior to the Demon World. Unless you can watch Chuyun Realm perish, there is no freedom to speak of," Void said.
"If that's the case, then just find a way to drive back the Demon World," Yuan Ming said calmly.
Void looked at Yuan Ming in astonishment and after a long time laughed heartily: "It's been a long time since I've heard such arrogance. I didn't expect it from you, young man. Do you know what kind of existence the Demon World is? Before reaching the Mahayana Realm, you don't even have the qualification to stand before the Demon World. Given your current conditions and resources, the bottleneck of the Dharma manifestation Stage might not stop you, but Mahayana Realm is an absolute chasm—countless Dharma manifestation Cultivators exhaust their entire life without achieving it. What confidence do you have to reach it? As for Body Cultivation and Soul Cultivation, their difficulty in cultivation doesn't pale in comparison to Magic Practitioner."
"How would I know it's impossible unless I try," Yuan Ming's tone barely fluctuated.
"I didn't expect Yuan to be so confident in himself now; it's quite different from before," Void said with surprise.
"I am indeed still far from a Mahayana cultivator, but I have a long life span. I will focus on my cultivation. If ten thousand years isn't enough, then twenty thousand years; if twenty thousand years isn't enough, then forty thousand years. Eventually, I'll reach the peak." Yuan Ming said.
"The maximum life span of a Returning to Void Cultivator is four or five thousand years. Even if you break through to the Dharma manifestation Stage, your life span will at most double, reaching ten thousand years. Where will you find forty thousand years to cultivate?" Void sneered.
"In the past, I wouldn't dare to say this, but now it's different. These days, I've been continuously searching for High-level Spirit Wood, nurturing a piece of World Tree bark. As the World Tree grows, my body undergoes subtle changes, my life span increased significantly. If I continue nurturing it, doubling or even multiplying my life span is not impossible." Yuan Ming said.
"Is there such a thing?" Void was startled, he extended a finger towards Yuan Ming's Dantian.
Yuan Ming instinctively dodged, but his Divine Soul was bound by an invisible force, rendering his body immobile, and was pointed at by Void.
A powerful Divine Sense infiltrated Yuan Ming's Dantian, entering the Undying Tree and explored every part.
After a short while, Void withdrew his finger, looking at Yuan Ming with a surprised expression: "The Ju Mang Spirit Technique you cultivated is extremely simplistic, yet it has such effects, merging you with the World Tree entirely. With the Ten Thousand Wood Origin Power fed back by the World Tree, coupled with the aid of the Stealing Heaven Tripod to condense the Dao Seal, you actually have a slight possibility to reach the Mahayana Realm." Void said.
"I'll take that as good words from senior." Yuan Ming smiled.
"Good! I'll be watching to see if you truly can walk to that step," Void said, his figure shifted and disappeared, flying back to the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
Yuan Ming sat down cross-legged, closed his eyes, and began cultivating.
But just then, a sudden bang erupted outside the pavilion, the entire Flying Boat came to a sharp halt, and everyone aboard was uncontrollably thrown forward.
The Ruan Brothers were already standing, so they quickly stabilized themselves, but Nan Shangfeng, who was half-lying on the couch, unexpectedly rolled twice on the ground before stopping.
"Young Master, are you alright?" The Ruan Brothers hurriedly stepped forward to help him up.
"Damn it, which idiot is steering the ship!" Nan Shangfeng couldn't help but curse at this moment.
Yet the next instant, the pavilion's door on the ship burst open, and cold wind howled into the room, making the three of them shiver.
The trio, with such cultivation, felt cold due to a gust of wind, which instantly changed the expressions on their faces.
"Something's not right, seems like trouble is coming." Ruan Lianxin immediately stepped forward, blocking in front of Nan Shangfeng.
The open door continued to let in the cold wind, the outside was empty, yet no trace of anyone could be seen, and no sound could be heard anymore.
The musicians and dancing girls who were just sent out, the many guards patrolling the ship, nearly a hundred cultivators on the vessel, now seemed to have vanished, leaving just the Ruan Brothers and Nan Shangfeng facing the cold wind, not knowing what had happened.
The Ruan Brothers stared intently at the wide-open door, their expressions tight, even their breathing lowered significantly, with their mana surging unabashedly, ready to strike at any moment.
"You are Nan Shangfeng, right?" But in the next moment, a voice as cold as eternal frost echoed from behind the trio, raising their hair on end.
The Ruan Brothers spun around simultaneously and attacked with full force.
Ruan Lianyu made incantation gestures with both hands, his full mana whistling, manipulating nature's spiritual energy, while thousands of starlight descended from the sky, gathered into two dazzling beams of the Star River.
The immense power directly tore the Flying Boat apart, exposing everyone to the night sky.
Ruan Lianyu's supernatural technique altered the night sky, causing the moonlight to sink, the stars to shine brightly, the circumstellar sky casting starlight, sealing the surrounding space and fixing everyone in place.
Meanwhile, Ruan Lianxin raised both arms, his long spear in hand tapped three times, forming three gradually spreading bloodstains in the void before him, which exploded in the next breath, releasing three blood-colored dragons that roared and charged towards the direction of the icy voice.
Two late-stage Returning to Void Cultivators exerted their full strength, and the momentum was undeniably grand.
What a pity that after their attack was unleashed, they found that the source of the sound was completely empty, just a stretch of darkness where one couldn't see their hand.
The blood-colored evil dragon rushed forward, just like a drop of water vanishing into the sea, disappearing into the darkness without a trace. Ruan Lianyu's Star River divine skill met the same fate, having no effect at all.
However, after absorbing their attacks, the darkness disappeared without a trace.
The Ruan brothers' hearts sank immediately, but with Ruan Lianyu's starlight sealing the space, they remained calm, quickly releasing their divine sense, searching for the lurking enemy.
At that moment, the void behind the three suddenly turned pitch black, and three streaks of black knife light appeared without warning, flashing toward them, aiming directly at Nan Shangfeng and the others' heads.
Ruan Lianxin responded swiftly, standing his long spear up to block the knife light, while Ruan Lianyu remained unflinching, allowing the starlight around him to surge forward, spontaneously intercepting the black knife light for himself and Nan Shangfeng.
However, their defensive measures were completely useless against the black knife light.
Ruan Lianxin's spear spiritual treasure was sliced cleanly in half upon contact with the black knife light, leaving him only a brief moment to register shock before his head was severed.
Ruan Lianyu's starlight fared even worse; it vanished into thin air upon being struck by the black knife light, followed by a soft hissing sound as Ruan Lianyu's body was split in two, and the nascent soul within his dantian was also cut into pieces.
Nan Shangfeng had just recovered from his shock, only to find the black knife light already hovering above his head, poised to slice him in half.
Not adept in combat, Nan Shangfeng stood frozen, unable to respond.
Right at the critical moment, a creamy white arm broke through the void overhead, striking the black knife light.
With a loud "bang," the trajectory of the black knife light was forcibly changed, causing it to cleave into the ocean, creating an immense water column.
Soon after, the owner of the creamy white arm stepped forth from the void, standing before Nan Shangfeng.
The newcomer was dressed in a red gown, her figure voluptuous and her demeanor elegant, with mana at the dharma manifestation stage. Her every gesture was both graceful and alluring.
"Qin Meiniang, why is it her?" In the Void Palace, Yuan Ming recognized the person who appeared and was secretly astonished.
Nan Shangfeng was attacked, and he was already aware and prepared to intervene, but Qin Meiniang got there first.
"Qin Meiniang, why did you come so late? Another moment and I'd have lost my head!" Nan Shangfeng exhaled a sigh of relief before speaking indignantly.
"Who told you to suddenly leave East Extreme Island." Qin Meiniang glared at Nan Shangfeng.
Yuan Ming listened to their conversation, raising an eyebrow, indicating the two had arranged to meet.
"Nan Shangfeng, what is going on? Why is Qin Meiniang here?" He transmitted his inquiry to Nan Shangfeng.
"Fellow Daoist Wan, you know Qin Meiniang? Don't misunderstand; I have no secret dealings with her. We've known each other for a while. After the Ten Thousand Treasure Auction concluded and you left, I received news from Qin Meiniang that I might be ambushed on the way back, so I asked her to secretly guard me."
Yuan Ming didn't inquire further, deciding to watch and see what happens.
"I wonder which fellow Daoist attempted to assassinate. Could you spare Nan Shangfeng for my sake?" Qin Meiniang looked gravely at the dark void not far away.
"Hehe, I recall there's no connection between the Daluo Sect and the Su Nu Sect. Why protect him now? Did Nan Shangfeng charm you into bed, bringing you to defend your lover?" As the voice spoke, the darkness in front of them gradually shrank, revealing a figure in a black robe.
"It's him!" Yuan Ming murmured in surprise.
The man in the black robe was none other than the one who appeared at the auction earlier and purchased the Evil Curse Altar for a high price of twelve million spirit stones.
"It's you! I'm just hired for high rewards by Nan Shangfeng. I'm not sure who instructs you, why kill him?" Qin Meiniang recognized the figure, calmly questioning without anger.
"Does the Three Realms Sect need a reason to kill?" The black-robed man laughed coldly, raising a finger.
The void behind Qin Meiniang twisted suddenly, sending out a swarm of black light aimed at her and Nan Shangfeng.
Qin Meiniang hadn't expected the attack to come from behind, hastily sweeping her sleeve backward, releasing a large swathe of pink radiance to temporarily hold the black light at bay.
Taking advantage of the distraction, Qin Meiniang grabbed Nan Shangfeng, and they dodged to the side.
The black-robed man snorted coldly, raising his hand towards Qin Meiniang.
Two streaks of black light shot out instantly, morphing into two black ribbons, one heading toward Qin Meiniang and the other toward Nan Shangfeng.

chapters.title: Chapter 896 - 866: Black Emperor's Legacy
chapters.content:
Qin Meiniang's face suddenly darkened, the pink radiance on her body surged and transformed into a height of several zhang, with countless pink petals interspersed, rolling forward.
"Screech" A tearing sound echoed, those two beams of black light were indeed extraordinary, slicing through most of the pink radiance, seemingly about to pierce through completely.
However, at this moment, a flash of light sparked within the pink radiance, and a pink palace appeared out of thin air.
The two beams of black light struck the pink palace, immediately rebounding as if encountering immense force.
Qin Meiniang's five fingers made a virtual grasp, the pink radiance rapidly condensed, transforming into countless pink threads, entwining the two beams of black light.
The black light instantly became unstable, its surface light swiftly dissipating, revealing their true form, which turned out to be two crystal-clear black flying knives, their blades shimmering with a cold light and full of spirituality.
Yet at this moment, the two flying knives appeared like fish caught in a net, struggling in vain, their movements growing slower and seemingly about to be completely immobilized.
"Su Nu's Radiant Light! You do have some skills." The black-robed figure remained unconcerned, casting a spell with a flick.
Above Qin Meiniang's head, black light flickered, and over ten beams of black blade light spiraled down, slashing at the pink radiance with lightning speed.
The pink radiance was instantly torn to shreds, and the two black flying knives broke free, flashing back to the side of the black-robed figure.
However, at that moment, the two black flying knives suddenly reversed direction, crossing paths to slice toward the black-robed figure.
The black-robed figure was evidently unprepared for this, retreating in shock, their black robe tearing with a "screech", revealing their true face, a young woman.
She had short black hair, her complexion as white as snow, eyes like stars, her black outfit snug and complementing her exquisite figure. The dark red sash at her waist fluttered in the wind, the only color on her yet carrying a bloody scent, unsettling to the heart.
"What a technique, to temporarily control my Spiritual Treasure. I underestimated you!" The black-haired woman sneered coldly, as darkness emerged behind her, swallowing the two flying knives.
Qin Meiniang's expression was somewhat peculiar, as she had just attempted to use the Su Nu Sect's "Delirious" divine skill to manipulate the two black flying knives.
