"Delirious", a secret divine skill of the Su Nu Sect, specifically targets Spiritual Treasures, allowing temporary control of the Artifact Spirit without the owner noticing.
However, the will of the Artifact Spirit within the black knives was unexpectedly tenacious, and "Delirious" couldn't control the Artifact Spirit's consciousness for a long time.
At a critical moment, another force invaded the black knives, the Artifact Spirit of the black knives seemed to fall into a slumber, allowing her to succeed.
Who was aiding her?
The black-haired woman cast a spell with both hands, a vast darkness emerged between her brows, coalescing in mid-air into a face-less black shadow Dharma image, swallowing all light, nearly merging with the deep night sky.
Qin Meiniang could only barely make out the outline of the black-haired woman's Dharma image by some moonlight, unable to tell how enormous it was, its emitted aura filled with ominousness, causing her heart to stir with fear.
This woman immediately took a deep breath, casting a spell, a large amount of pink radiance burst forth above her head, manifesting into a Divine Woman Dharma image, whose attire and appearance differed from that of Yun Luo Fairy yet exuded a somewhat similar aura.
The moment the Divine Woman Dharma image appeared, it began to dance in mid-air, pink petals suddenly falling like rain in the night sky, and an inexplicably sweet fragrance drifted under everyone's noses.
The black-haired woman sneered coldly, raising her hand for a grasp.
The black shadow Dharma image simultaneously mimicked the action, its massive right arm disappearing into the void.
In the next moment, a disturbance in the void in front of Qin Meiniang emerged, and a gigantic black hand appeared, striking down like a mountain, drawing in the surrounding space power.
The Divine Woman Dharma image raised its arms, barely withstanding the strike of the black hand, but a large expanse of pink radiance was scattered away.
Qin Meiniang's arms maintained an upward-raised position, her body trembling uncontrollably, her ten fingers continually casting spells.
Pink radiance flared around the black shadow Dharma image, and pink branches extended from the void, rapidly swelling with buds, blooming with the fragrant wind greeting them.
In an instant, countless particles of pink spirit light spewed from the buds, rushing towards the black shadow Dharma image, turning the entire night sky into a hazy pink.
However, the black-haired woman remained coldly smiling, not moving at all, as the black shadow Dharma image above her head suddenly transformed, its head elongating as if opening a mouth, an invisible suction force erupting like a hurricane.
The entire sky of pollen was sucked into the mouth of the black shadow Dharma image, seemingly devoured, vanishing without a trace.
"Void Sky Demon Technique! Who exactly are you?" Qin Meiniang's face changed dramatically, exclaiming in shock.
Yuan Ming's expression slightly changed upon hearing these words.
He had heard of the name "Void Sky Demon Technique," rumored to have been created by the previous Sect Hierarch, the Black Emperor of the Three Realms Sect. It was a space attribute Cultivation Technique that once held great prestige, shaking the Chuyun Realm.
Since the fall of the Black Emperor, the Void Sky Demon Technique had disappeared, and no one had mastered it since. Unexpectedly, it has reappeared now.
"You have good eyes. I, Hei Lian, am indeed the successor of the Black Emperor. Since you know of our sect's Divine Skills, why not surrender obediently? I can let you die more swiftly," Hei Lian said calmly.
"Hmph, don't think that because you've practiced the Void Sky Demon Technique of the Black Emperor, I will fear you. Our Cultivation is equivalent. I want to see how much power the once-prestigious Demon Technique holds in your hands!" Qin Meiniang formed a spell with her hands to steady her mind and launched another attack toward Hei Lian.
Strands of pink radiant light shot from the Divine Woman Dharma, like a peacock opening its tail, sweeping over Hei Lian and the dark shadow Dharma.
In the Void Palace, Yuan Ming listened to the conversation between the two women, frowning deeply.
This Black Emperor was the previous Sect Hierarch of the Three Realms Sect. To inherit his Cultivation Technique proves Hei Lian's unusual status within the sect.
Why would such a figure specifically come to hunt Nan Shangfeng?
What exactly is the relationship between Qin Meiniang and Nan Shangfeng, and did the two anticipate this attack?
Yuan Ming pondered silently, feeling that a few more layers of mystery shrouded Nan Shangfeng, but the urgent matter at hand was to find a way to escape Hei Lian's pursuit; otherwise, given his situation hiding in the Void Palace, whether he had any connection with Nan Shangfeng or not, Hei Lian would not spare him easily.
With this in mind, Yuan Ming focused on observing the combat between Hei Lian and Qin Meiniang, while also diverting a bit of his mind to send a voice transmission to Master Dian: "Fellow Daoist Dian, have you heard of the grand name of the Void Sky Demon Technique?"
Although he had crammed a lot of information about the Central Continent over these years, it was ultimately last-minute efforts, and Master Dian, a disciple of the Qingxuan Platform on the Central Continent, certainly knew more about the Black Emperor than he did.
"I've heard a little. The Void Sky Demon Technique was a unique Cultivation Technique created by the Sect Hierarch Black Emperor of the Three Realms Sect. It's a very rare space attribute Cultivation Technique, rumored to be a combination of a Space Divine Power from the Demon World and a Cultivation Technique from the Chuyun Realm by the Black Emperor. Practicing this Technique allows one to manipulate Space Power freely, and especially after breaking through to the Dharma manifestation Stage, a Void Heaven Dharma Image will condense, where a space forms within the Dharma, capable of swallowing all incoming attacks, leaving the Dharma body unscathed," Master Dian said. He wasn't sure why Yuan Ming was asking about this but sensed the gravity in Yuan Ming's tone and dared not delay, directly relaying the information he knew.
"Is there any secret to counter this Demon Technique?" Yuan Ming keenly asked.
"This... Fellow Daoist Yuan, you overestimate me. The Black Emperor's Cultivation Technique is beyond my deep understanding. Even the information I just shared is merely hearsay from many years ago, and I cannot vouch for its absolute accuracy." Master Dian shook his head repeatedly.
Yuan Ming also didn't harbor much hope for this; he was merely asking casually.
"However, as the saying goes, 'An eye for an eye,' to combat the Void Sky Demon Technique, using attacks with space attributes might have an extraordinary effect," Master Dian suggested.
"Thank you for your guidance, Master Dian," Yuan Ming expressed his gratitude and asked no more, focusing his full attention on the battlefield outside, where new developments were unfolding.
Qin Meiniang launched attacks in rapid succession, with the Divine Woman Dharma launching grand strikes, the hazy pink spirit light illuminating the night sky, turning even the sea at the feet of the people into a pale pink, and amid the roaring waves, a sweet floral fragrance spread.
Yet, every Magical Attack hurled forward was absorbed and devoured by the shadowy Dharma before they could approach Hei Lian's body, all swallowed into the darkness.
"You won't shed tears until you see the coffin. I shall make you give up hope," Hei Lian crossed her arms and sneered, then abruptly raised her hand.
The chest of the shadowy Dharma suddenly exploded, revealing dozens of pitch-black tentacles rushing toward Qin Meiniang.
Qin Meiniang's expression changed slightly, transforming her hand spell, causing the dance of the Divine Woman Dharma to alter. In mid-air, numerous tiny pink buds sprang forth, and with crisp pops, the buds instantly bloomed, releasing miniaturized Divine Woman Dharma figures who laughed as they climbed onto the tentacles.
Wherever they made contact, pink spirit light instantly spread, causing the pitch-black tentacles to turn into floral powder falling into the sea within a few breaths.
Hei Lian disdainfully curled the corner of her mouth, pointing her finger toward her brow. The pitch-black tentacles transformed into pure shadow void, preventing the miniaturized Divine Woman Dharma figures from touching them; as soon as they approached, a mysterious suction pulled them into the darkness, merging them into the shadow.
Qin Meiniang gritted her teeth, casting spells, as more buds emerged beside her, attempting to use their numbers to fend off the assault.
The hazy light illuminated the surroundings, yet unnoticed, it left Qin Meiniang's shadow on the surface of the sea beneath her feet.
And in the next instant, countless tentacles surged from the shadow beneath Qin Meiniang's feet, reaching for her.
Startled to the core, Qin Meiniang decisively bit the tip of her tongue in an instant and spat out a mouthful of Essence Blood. Instantly, her body transformed completely into falling floral powder, causing the tentacles to grab at nothing.
Immediately, her figure appeared on the shoulder of the Divine Woman Dharma, her face pale. Yet before she could even catch her breath, her face changed drastically, and she turned suddenly, looking in the direction of Nan Shangfeng.
At this moment, Nan Shangfeng was already tightly bound by the tentacles surging from the shadow beneath him, with the shadows around him spreading like mud, pulling his body continuously downward, swiftly merging completely into the shadow.

chapters.title: Chapter 897 - 867: Refusal
chapters.content:
At the critical moment, the void beside Nan Shangfeng suddenly tore open, and dozens of thick black roots broke through the void, wrapping around Nan Shangfeng. They were indeed the roots of the Undying Tree.
The roots and the black shadow's tendrils vied with each other, both trying to pull Nan Shangfeng toward their own side.
Hei Lian raised an eyebrow, not expecting such a turn of events. Just as she was about to cast a spell, she saw the void near Nan Shangfeng crack open, and two large thunder spears shot out from it.
One shot towards the shadow under Nan Shangfeng's feet, while the other aimed at her.
A violent thunderous aura erupted from the thunder spears, as if it would tear the void apart wherever it passed.
"Destruction Thunder!"
Hei Lian's pupils contracted sharply, her hands forming seals, as the black shadow's dharma manifestation stepped forward. The creeping darkness spread in the void, swiftly enveloping the incoming thunder spear and devouring it quickly.
At the same moment, the other thunder spear had already struck the shadow under Nan Shangfeng's feet.
After a brief silence, a blinding lightning accompanied by a huge boom erupted, forming a sky-reaching pillar of lightning on the sea surface. Countless silver thunder arcs leaped up, easily shredding the shadow entangling Nan Shangfeng.
The roots of the Undying Tree pulled back rapidly, narrowly pulling Nan Shangfeng out of the range of the Destruction Thunder's explosion.
Nan Shangfeng coughed twice, not having time to speak, when the Soul Descent Rune in his Sea of Consciousness lit up, his expression changing instantly as his body was controlled by Yuan Ming.
"Fellow Daoist Qin, this person is too formidable. No need to protect me, let's each flee for our lives!" Nan Shangfeng shouted, raising his hand to summon a Thunderbolt Flying Car.
A glaring thunder light circled around the flying car, then transformed into a long rainbow of lightning, disappearing into the distant sky in the blink of an eye.
Qin Meiniang was momentarily stunned. Seeing Nan Shangfeng decisively retreating, she was shocked and angry, stomping her foot.
However, as Nan Shangfeng had said, she was not at all a match for Hei Lian. She bit her teeth, turned around, and fled in flying escape in the opposite direction.
All this happened in just a few breaths. Hei Lian, having just used her black shadow dharma manifestation to swallow the thunder spear, looked up and saw the scene, also momentarily stunned.
"Without Qin Meiniang's protection, do you really think you can escape?" The woman was not frightened but delighted, her figure transforming into a black long rainbow, chasing directly after Nan Shangfeng.
The black long rainbow, whose escape technique was unknown, was more than twice as fast as using a Thunderbolt Flying Car, quickly closing the distance between them.
"Nan Shangfeng" turned his head, noticing the situation, but did not panic, raising his hand again.
A gigantic silver thunder shadow appeared, lifting his body. It was Lei Yu.
Lei Yu unfolded its four wings, fully unleashing its Wind and Thunder Power, intertwining with each other.
Boom!
Nan Shangfeng's speed suddenly increased severalfold, far surpassing the black long rainbow behind, rapidly widening the distance between them.
"How is it possible!" Hei Lian was incredibly stunned.
At this moment, she was using the Void Stealth Technique. How could she be outpaced by someone in the late stage of Returning Void!
Hei Lian quickly formed seals again, and specks of silver light appeared within the black long rainbow, increasing its tunneling speed by nearly half.
However, the speed of the Thunderstorm Wind Thunder Escape far exceeded her expectations. Even with the secret technique, she still couldn't catch up, and could only watch as Nan Shangfeng's figure gradually turned into a small dot, soon disappearing at the edge of her vision.
In less than half an incense stick's time, Lei Yu completely left her Divine Sense's detection range.
...
One day and one night later.
Yuan Ming had long since stopped controlling Nan Shangfeng's body, only allowing Lei Yu to fly with all its might.
Hei Lian had been left far behind somewhere, but since Hei Lian's cultivation was a whole Great Realm higher than his, whether she could still track his trail remained an unknown.
"Nan Shangfeng, how did you provoke that Hei Lian? Why does she want to kill you? Tell me truthfully, or don't blame me for leaving you behind and letting that demon handle you," Yuan Ming transmitted his voice to Nan Shangfeng, his tone clearly displeased.
"Fellow Daoist Wan, don't be angry. I'm not very clear on this matter either. Today is the first time I've met that Hei Lian, how could I provoke her? It's just..." Nan Shangfeng hurriedly begged for mercy, then hesitated.
Judging by his expression, he seemed to have some guesses about Hei Lian's arrival, but wasn't very sure.
"Just what is it, don't hem and haw, speak quickly!" Yuan Ming said impatiently.
"It's like this, Fellow Daoist Wan also knows, I am the second disciple of the Daluo Sect Master. Our master is already advanced in age, and he has been intending to seclude himself in an attempt to take the final step to see if he can break through the Mahayana Heaven Barrier. However, the position of Sect Master still needs someone to inherit it, and the candidate will be chosen among us disciples." Nan Shangfeng hastily explained.
"You mean to say, this Hei Lian is here because of the succession of the Daluo Sect?" Yuan Ming realized what he was trying to say.
"Exactly, senior is unaware that my master has four disciples in total. Senior Brother He Xiuwen has the highest cultivation and has already reached the Dharma manifestation stage; Third Junior Brother Yang Fan is a Sword Cultivator, following the path of Supreme Forget Love, and his cultivation is also above mine; Junior Sister Gan Wenqing practices the way of Soul Cultivation and has reached the Word Witch Realm. According to the sect rules, if nothing unexpected happens, the next Sect Master will be chosen from the four of us. Those three have been fighting openly and secretly for the position for a long time. Although I'm not very capable, I have some influence from my family, and some people in the sect are willing to support me. I'm not interested in becoming the Sect Leader at all, nor do I want to be drawn into the whirlpool of intrigue, so I've been trying to stay away from the sect over the years. I came to the Extreme East this time to participate in the Ten Thousand Treasure Auction for this reason, but I didn't expect they still wouldn't let me go." Nan Shangfeng said with hatred.
The Flying Boat was destroyed, and the Ruan Brothers were killed, which was fine, but several of his concubines were also on the Flying Boat, and they were probably doomed.
"So, you think this Hei Lian was sent by one of your three fellow disciples?" Yuan Ming asked.
"Yes, if my guess is correct, it's most likely sent by my Senior Brother. There have long been rumors in the sect that he has dealings with the Three Realms Sect, and now it seems, it's probably true." A trace of coldness flashed in Nan Shangfeng's eyes.
During their conversation, Yuan Ming quietly cast the Emotion Manipulation Divine Ability to sense Nan Shangfeng's emotional fluctuations and found no inconsistencies, indicating that what Nan Shangfeng said should be true.
If Hei Lian's attack was merely due to internal strife within the Daluo Sect, it had nothing to do with him, so there was no need to worry excessively.
"This... Fellow Daoist Wan, forgive my boldness, you have seen the current situation. Hei Lian is pursuing me, and I don't know what the other fellow disciples think, they might also send someone. My life is at stake, and I wonder if you could protect me for the sake of my sincere efforts during the Ten Thousand Treasure Auction? Rest assured, I won't make you come for nothing. As long as I survive, whatever price you name, I, Nan, will have no objections." Nan Shangfeng's expression changed, and he suddenly stood up and bowed.
"... That Qin Meiniang, did you hire her in this way?" Yuan Ming asked quietly after a moment of silence.
"Exactly, but I don't know where she is now, and with Qin Meiniang's nature, she might not risk coming to fulfill the promise anymore." Nan Shangfeng said wistfully.
"According to your original plan, you were supposed to let her escort you back to the sect. Now, are you asking me to replace her and take you back?" Yuan Ming asked.
"Fellow Daoist Wan, that is absolutely impossible. If my Senior Brother has already resorted to such means, returning to the sect would likely be a dead end. For now, I can only seek out Master and ask him to resolve all this." Nan Shangfeng hurriedly said.
"At such an important time for choosing the next Sect Master, your Master isn't personally presiding over the sect?" Yuan Ming asked somewhat puzzledly.
"He was personally presiding over it previously, but years ago he suddenly received a message and went alone to Wuliang City in Central Continent, leaving the sect affairs to the four of us as a test for inheriting the position. He will finalize the candidate when he returns." Nan Shangfeng explained.
"In other words, you're asking me to accompany you to Wuliang City? That's absolutely impossible, seek someone else, Fellow Daoist Nan." Yuan Ming pondered for a long time and finally shook his head.
"This... Fellow Daoist Wan, my safety now depends solely on you. I beseech you to save me. I still have thirty million Spirit Stones, and I'm willing to give them all to you, Fellow Daoist Wan!" Nan Shangfeng said, his face turning pale.
"In essence, this is still trouble within your sect, and I have other matters to attend to, with no intention of getting involved. For the sake of past interactions, I will help you evade Hei Lian's pursuit as best as I can, but then we part ways. As for the Spirit Stones, keep them to hire other cultivators." Yuan Ming still refused.
He had heard of Wuliang City, located in the northwest of the Central Continent, while his destination was White Emperor City to meet with Xi Ying and Wulu, so it was impossible to go to Wuliang City, which was too far away.
As for helping Nan Shangfeng restore his Spirit Root, it would also have to be disregarded.
This man had too many troubles, and Yuan Ming felt that helping him escape from Hei Lian's pursuit was already a magnanimous gesture on his part.
Nan Shangfeng looked desperate upon hearing this.
Yuan Ming did not speak further with him and directly left the Void Palace, landed on Lei Yu's back, and summoned Shura Palace, entering it.
Before Yuan Ming could instruct further, Lei Yu opened its mouth and swallowed Shura Palace whole.
Seeing Yuan Ming unwilling even to stay in the Void Palace, Nan Shangfeng's face showed even more gloom.
Yuan Ming paid him no mind and telepathically instructed Lei Yu to continue fleeing at full speed to avoid being caught by Hei Lian.
"Master, at this full speed, Hua Zhi and Vajra might not be able to keep up," Lei Yu reminded telepathically.
Hua Zhi and Vajra had been out training for years, returning occasionally. Although Hua Zhi had informed Yuan Ming about the Ten Thousand Treasure Auction, Hua Zhi was busy with Holy Spirit Association affairs and did not attend with Yuan Ming.
"No worry, we're not going somewhere too far, let them take their time to catch up," Yuan Ming was unconcerned.
Hearing this, Lei Yu ceased further comment and focused on speeding away.
"I plan to seclude myself for a few days, keep watch over Nan Shangfeng for me, and if he makes any wrong moves, toss him off immediately," Yuan Ming instructed further.
"Rest assured, Master, I understand," Lei Yu replied.
After eighty years of arduous training, Lei Yu's strength had nearly reached the Upper Fifth Level, and dealing with someone like Nan Shangfeng, who wasn't adept at combat, shouldn't pose a problem.

chapters.title: Chapter 898 - 868: Concealment
chapters.content:
After Yuan Ming arranged all this, he came to the Medicine Garden Cave Mansion, sat cross-legged, closed his eyes, calmed his mind, and restored his Mana.
Half a day later, when he opened his eyes again, they were shining brightly, and his Mana and Soul Power had returned to their peak state.
He immediately employed the Ju Mang Spirit Technique, channeling a wisp of Ten Thousand Wood Origin from the World Tree, merging it into his body.
Bang!
The Ten Thousand Wood Origin Power rapidly circulated within him, causing his Mana and Qi-Blood to boil once more, becoming quickly purified.
At this moment, Yuan Ming did not undergo the transformation of the Undying Tree, so he absorbed most of this Ten Thousand Wood Origin himself.
The effect of purifying Qi-Blood was secondary. As his Mana became increasingly refined, the turbulence in the Mana vortex within his Dantian quickly diminished.
Moments later, the Ten Thousand Wood Origin Power was completely absorbed, greatly purifying Yuan Ming's Mana, calming the chaotic situation in his Dantian considerably.
Without hesitation, Yuan Ming drew another wisp of Ten Thousand Wood Origin Power to cleanse himself.
His Mana and Qi-Blood Power were further purified, the Mana vortex calmed once again, nearly coming to a stop.
Yuan Ming felt secretly delighted, estimating that at this rate, after absorbing once or twice more of the Ten Thousand Wood Origin, the Mana vortex would stabilize completely, allowing him to start the impact on the Dharma manifestation Stage.
He did not stop then, and summoned the Shura Stone Tablet, moving to a burning mountain range in the Extreme Fire Realm, where he threw the Array sealing the Profound Sun Earth Fire.
Yuan Ming found a flat area within the mountains to place the Profound Sun Earth Fire, and set up another Array around it, the Eight-direction Fierce Fire Formation.
This Array could absorb the Earth veins' heat to preserve True Fire.
The two Arrays resonated, and the Sealing Crystal around the Profound Sun Earth Fire quickly decomposed, completely disappearing within a few breaths, leaving the Profound Sun Earth Fire suspended in the center of the two Arrays, burning fiercely.
Hei Lian could appear again at any time, and although the Tree Man form could resist ordinary Dharma manifestations, facing Hei Lian might lead to defeat in just a few rounds.
Feeling it troublesome even in the Dongji Sea Area, not to mention a place like the Central Continent.
Yuan Ming entered the Array, activated the spell, inducing the Profound Sun Earth Fire into his body, and began refining his Physical Body.
His skin turned charred, and fire light shot out from his eyes, nose, and mouth, seemingly burning from the inside out, causing intense pain throughout his body.
With Yuan Ming's current state of mind, such pain naturally didn't cause much impact. He remained calm and focused, operating the Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill, collaborating with the Profound Sun Earth Fire to refine his Physical Body.
Thin strands of black gas continuously emerged from his pores, followed by the Profound Sun Earth Fire turning to ashes, which were the impurities within his body.
In his early years, Yuan Ming absorbed Blood Origin Power and quickly improved his body cultivation, accumulating many impurities within his flesh. Though he had absorbed the Power of the Sun to cultivate over these years, and tried to refine hidden dangers within his body, the effect hadn't been good. Unexpectedly, the Profound Sun Earth Fire could refine so many impurities.
He increased the absorption of the Profound Sun Earth Fire, continuing to refine his body.
...
Three more days passed.
In the back sea area, a black tunneling light descended, revealing the figure of Hei Lian.
She had donned the Black Robe again, with a black veil over her face, slightly panting.
Over the past few days, Hei Lian had been chasing relentlessly, but couldn't catch up with Lei Yu.
With hatred in her eyes, she gazed forward, where Yuan Ming and Nan Shangfeng were located, obviously having a way to lock onto their position.
Hei Lian's heart was filled with resentment, which turned into a cold snort.
Instantly, the sea under her feet exploded, the seabed was fully exposed, and countless fish, shrimp, and sea beasts were pulverized with just a snort.
The displaced seawater gathered into giant waves roaring away, transpiring into clouds, turning into continuous light rain falling onto the exposed seabed.
After venting her anger, Hei Lian quickly calmed down, bowing her head in thought.
"Since you think you can run fast, let's see if you can outrun this!" she sneered, then flicked her sleeve to take out an item, none other than the Evil Curse Altar that had been bought at a high price during the auction.
With a pinch of the spell, the Evil Curse Altar soared into the air, slowly spinning, with clusters of blood-colored spirit light trailing a tail flame emerging at its center, spiraling and dancing around.
Staring at the Evil Curse Altar, Hei Lian raised her hand again, taking out a porcelain bottle covered with talismans from her Storage Ring, casually tearing open the talisman seal at its mouth. Her right hand pinched a spell and flicked, causing the stored blood energy inside to slither into the Evil Curse Altar like a snake.
The altar flashed with Blood Light, a corrupt and decaying aura instantly filled the air, causing the Protective Spiritual Light on Hei Lian's body to flare up, as if corroded by something, smoking and sizzling continuously.
Hei Lian's expression became much more serious, and she dared not delay too much, promptly pointing a finger at her glabella, prompting a pitch-black Dao Seal to fly out from her Dantian, while countless black shadows flew in the void, merging into a black and white brush in her hand.
Immediately afterwards, she swiftly raised her brush, sketching furiously. Despite lacking ink, one black character after another appeared in the air - exactly the name and birthdate of Nan Shangfeng.
On the Evil Curse Altar, the blood aura filled by Hei Lian rose again, transforming into countless fine blood threads in mid-air, climbing onto the black characters written by Hei Lian.
In an instant, the whole world was polluted by the foul smell of blood, and the seawater under Hei Lian's feet, which had just been recomposed, also began to blacken and rot, as if piled with countless decomposing corpses, inducing nausea.
After doing all this, Hei Lian took out a small cloth bag and opened it, revealing several strands of hair inside.
These hairs were precisely Nan Shangfeng's, which she found on the wrecked Flying Boat and from Nan Shangfeng's concubines.
"Go!"
Hei Lian lightly tapped her brush, and the blood characters in front of her, along with the strands of hair, flew into the Evil Curse Altar, disappearing completely.
But soon, black mist emerged from the Evil Curse Altar, revealing Nan Shangfeng's twisted face inside, brimming with resentment, hatred, anger, and all kinds of negative emotions.
Hei Lian's eyes revealed a grave look as her fingers shot a black Light Pillar mixed with Blood Light and Soul Power into the Evil Curse Altar.
The aura on Hei Lian's body rapidly declined, the black mist grew denser, and Nan Shangfeng's twisted face slowly became lifelike.
After nearly half a quarter of an hour, Nan Shangfeng's face looked as real as life, gazing forward as if confirming a target.
Subsequently, Nan Shangfeng's face exploded with a "bang," transforming into tiny black lights and merging into the void.
All the filth and blood aura on the altar disappeared completely, and the blood-colored spirit light also vanished into the void.
Hei Lian almost collapsed, hurriedly taking out a medicine bottle, pouring all the elixirs inside into her mouth without caring for the quantity.
After a while, her complexion slightly improved.
"You can't escape." Hei Lian gently said, then put away the altar and continued to fly escape forward.
...
On the other side, Nan Shangfeng sat quietly on Lei Yu.
Yuan Ming had also completed the True Fire Body Refining, emerging from the Shura Palace, sitting on Lei Yu's neck.
After all this time, they still couldn't detect any sign of Hei Lian pursuing them, his urgency and tension slightly eased.
"It seems that Hei Lian should not be able to catch up, Xuankong Island seems to be right ahead. This island is a major commercial island with many cultivators coming and going. I will have Lei Yu drop you off later, from there you are on your own." Yuan Ming looked at Nan Shangfeng, his tone calm and indifferent.
"Fellow Daoist Wan, there's truly no room for negotiation regarding escorting me to Wuliang City?" Nan Shangfeng said with a bitter smile.
"Fellow Daoist Nan has plenty of Spirit Stones; why worry about finding a guard? There should be no shortage of late-stage Returning Void cultivators on Xuankong Island, choose a few to escort you quickly." Yuan Ming said.
As he spoke, a large island appeared in the front, packed with structures, with tunneling lights continuously rising and falling on it, exactly Xuankong Island.
Yuan Ming signaled Lei Yu to throw Nan Shangfeng down.
"Wait, Fellow Daoist Wan, I am willing to change my destination. You only need to send me to the Central Continent, and Nan will offer a piece of Innate Bitter Bamboo Leaf as a reward." Nan Shangfeng hurriedly said.
"Innate Bitter Bamboo!" Yuan Ming's eyes shifted.
He had read records of this item in the classics; the Innate Bitter Bamboo, also known as the Six Clean Bamboo, is an ancient celestial bamboo, with which one can attain a state of extreme calm, impervious to desires or disturbances even when struck by Thunder.
In this state, whether cultivating techniques or comprehending divine skills, the efficiency is ten times that of ordinary people.
"I don't have the bamboo leaf on me at the moment; it is stored with a friend in the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range. As long as Fellow Daoist Wan brings me to the Central Continent, I will obtain it for you immediately." Nan Shangfeng said.
"No need." Yuan Ming shook his head and refused.
"Fellow Daoist Wan might not know that besides calming the mind, the Innate Bitter Bamboo is very useful in overcoming bottlenecks. While the Bamboo Leaf is far inferior to the spirit bamboo itself, I had a master refine it into something similar to a talisman, usable only three times yet able to exert half the effect of the spirit bamboo. I see Fellow Daoist Wan is about to break through to the Dharma manifestation Stage, you will definitely find it useful." Nan Shangfeng hurriedly said.
"The Innate Bitter Bamboo Leaf is indeed good, but as a Loose Cultivator, rashly getting involved in the Daluo Sect's power struggle would risk losing my life." Yuan Ming's tone remained steady.
"Well..." Nan Shangfeng was anxious, scratching his cheek, trying to persuade further.
"Moreover, Fellow Daoist Nan's troubles are not just about competing for the Daluo Sect Master's position, right? You requested my assistance while concealing many things; I have no interest in getting involved in any disputes." Yuan Ming interrupted Nan Shangfeng's words.
"What do you mean, Fellow Daoist Wan?" Nan Shangfeng showed a surprised expression.
"I sensed something unusual earlier while performing Soul Search on you. Despite your soul power being weak, it is unexpectedly agile; what I probed from your memories seemed normal but was actually incomplete. For instance, I didn't see Qin Meiniang in your memories; you must have hidden this part. You are also a Soul Cultivator, aren't you?" Yuan Ming's voice gradually rose.
Nan Shangfeng blinked and laughed, "Indeed, nothing can be hidden from Fellow Daoist Wan. Yes, Nan is indeed a Soul Cultivator, but this shouldn't pose any trouble for you, right?"

chapters.title: Chapter 899 - 869: Accepting the Request
chapters.content:
"At this point, Fellow Daoist Nan, are you still going to feign ignorance? Your divine soul aura is ethereal and lofty, like the bright moon. If I am not mistaken, you are cultivating the 'Moonlight Technique,' one of the three major sect techniques of the Bright Moon Palace? The Bright Moon Palace is extremely protective of its internal heritage and never allows it to be passed on. Otherwise, they will pursue the offender relentlessly. If your cultivation of the 'Moonlight Technique' were to be discovered, the Daluo Sect might not withstand the wrath of the Bright Moon Palace," Yuan Ming said coldly, speaking slowly.
His 'Moonlight Technique' only had the first seven layers. After reaching the Dongji Sea, he had been paying close attention to matters regarding the Bright Moon Palace and the 'Moonlight Technique,' gathering a lot of information over the years.
Like the Wu Yue Sect, the Bright Moon Palace has strict regulations, and disciples are divided into different classes. It is the most conservative sect among the Three Giant Sects, and their protection of the sect's heritage borders on obsession.
Because of this, countless sects have been exterminated, which has resulted in the Bright Moon Palace having a bad reputation. Many people secretly refer to it as the Evil Moon Palace.
"Fellow Daoist Wan, you indeed see through everything, but regarding this matter, your guess is wrong. My 'Moonlight Technique' was not learned through theft, so I am not afraid of being known by the Bright Moon Palace. As for hiding my identity as a soul cultivator, there are other reasons for that," Nan Shangfeng smiled and said.
"Oh, is that so?" Yuan Ming's eyes flickered slightly.
"Just as Fellow Daoist Wan can sense my soul cultivation method, I can also sense yours. Your divine soul aura is similar to mine, and your soul cultivation method is also the 'Moonlight Technique,' right? Aren't you afraid I will spread this information?" Nan Shangfeng's tone suddenly changed, saying.
"The origin of my 'Moonlight Technique' is equally legitimate, Fellow Daoist Nan. Feel free to do as you please," Yuan Ming replied with a calm expression.
"Hahaha, Fellow Daoist Wan has shown kindness to me; how could I repay kindness with enmity? That was just a joke," Nan Shangfeng laughed heartily.
Yuan Ming didn't respond, raising his head to look at the sky.
"I asked Fellow Daoist Wan for protection but hid many things, which was wrong of me. I solemnly apologize. However, not telling you these things was also for your own good. Getting involved in my matters would bring you significant trouble, possibly even ten times worse than being hunted by Hei Lian!" Nan Shangfeng said, bowing solemnly to Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming scrutinized Nan Shangfeng for a few moments and nodded.
"Since I have now disclosed everything, could I ask Fellow Daoist Wan to escort me to the Central Continent? The reward of the Innate Bitter Bamboo Leaf remains unchanged, and the pursuit by Hei Lian should have nothing to do with my identity as a soul cultivator, meaning we won't encounter any other formidable enemies," Nan Shangfeng further inquired.
"Alright, but I have an additional request," Yuan Ming said after a brief pause.
"Please, speak, Fellow Daoist Wan," Nan Shangfeng responded promptly.
"Due to certain reasons, I wish to visit the Bright Moon Palace in the future. Unfortunately, the Bright Moon Palace is extremely strict with their rules, seldom seeing outsiders, especially a loose cultivator like myself. Fellow Daoist Nan must have some connections with the Bright Moon Palace. Could you please introduce me in the future?" Yuan Ming said.
"A trivial matter, no problem," Nan Shangfeng readily agreed.
Yuan Ming maintained a calm demeanor but was secretly delighted.
The Bright Moon Palace is known for its ruthless methods, yet rarely do its disciples roam outside, making encounters difficult. With Nan Shangfeng's assistance, meeting someone from the Bright Moon Palace would be much easier.
His only objective in agreeing to protect Nan Shangfeng was to establish a connection with the Bright Moon Palace.
As long as Yuan Ming could get acquainted with one or two cultivators from the Bright Moon Palace, he could follow the trail, using the Black Incense Possession ability of the Stealing Heaven Tripod to find the subsequent layers of the 'Moonlight Technique.'
This approach was not exactly legitimate, but the Bright Moon Palace would never pass the 'Moonlight Technique' to an outsider like him. Therefore, after pondering over it, this was his only resort. He hadn't expected the other party to agree so readily, suggesting that Nan Shangfeng's background was even more complex than he had anticipated, and his identity was probably not simple either.
After the two reached an agreement, Lei Yu continued on its journey, only altering its course to head straight for the Central Continent.
Nan Shangfeng seemed to have let go of some burden, in good spirits, and began to chat and laugh with Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming wanted to glean some information about the Bright Moon Palace and struck up a casual conversation.
Thereupon, they chatted from strange stories from various places to insights on cultivation, covering topics as diverse as heaven and earth.
For Yuan Ming, it was indeed a rare time for relaxation.
However, just as they were engrossed in conversation, something unexpected happened!
Nan Shangfeng was halfway through a sentence when his face suddenly contorted, his eyes filled with thick black mist, and his blood vessels bulged eminently, turning black-purple.
"Fellow Daoist Nan?" Yuan Ming's expression changed.
Nan Shangfeng looked towards Yuan Ming, seemingly wanting to say something, but couldn't utter a word.
"Ah..." he screamed, unable to control his body, falling off Lei Yu's back and plummeting toward the ground.
Yuan Ming couldn't afford to ponder too much and immediately darted out to catch the falling Nan Shangfeng.
At this moment, Nan Shangfeng was emitting a rotting corpse-like stench, and his body was swollen as if bloated with pus, resembling a corpse that had been dead for some time.
Yuan Ming hurriedly used his divine sense to investigate, but found Nan Shangfeng's mana was exceedingly chaotic, his aura rapidly declining, resembling poisoning. Yet, within, there was not a hint of any poison to be found.
He intensified his divine sense, but was still unable to detect the cause.
"Looking like this is useless; channel the Desire Power of the Stealing Heaven Tripod into your eyes," Kong's voice suddenly rang out.
Yuan Ming's expression flickered, then, following Kong's instructions, melded the Desire Power into his eyes. His vision changed instantly, revealing what was previously unseen.
Several strands of filthy Black Qi rampaged through the meridians within Nan Shangfeng's body, the Nascent Soul at the Dantian was heavily shrouded and entangled by Black Qi. Only at the neck was there a faint spirit light encircling, desperately resisting the Black Qi, preventing it from invading the Nascent Soul's head.
But the Black Qi was powerful, and this spirit light was continuously being consumed, on the verge of dissipating.
Upon seeing this, Yuan Ming immediately infused the demonic power of the Undying Tree into Nan Shangfeng's body, simultaneously healing Nan Shangfeng's bodily injuries while trying to dispel the Black Qi around the Nascent Soul.
After being baptized by the Power of Ten Thousand Wood Origin, the healing effects of the Undying Tree Demon Power were even stronger, and Nan Shangfeng's body rapidly recovered.
However, the Black Qi in his body was much more troublesome. No matter how he drove the demonic power to attack, the Black Qi remained tenaciously cohesive and couldn't be dispersed.
Thus, he quickly changed his approach, injecting demonic power into Nan Shangfeng's Nascent Soul, attempting to bolster its power to resist the corrosion of the Black Qi.
This attempt yielded some results.
With the help of Yuan Ming's demonic power, the spirit light on the surface of Nan Shangfeng's Nascent Soul brightened, and the spirit light at the neck finally stabilized, just barely holding its own against the Black Qi.
As a result, Nan Shangfeng's consciousness also slightly recovered, a flicker of light returned to his eyes as he gratefully glanced at Yuan Ming.
"Senior Kong, what kind of Divine Skill is this Black Qi? Its power is so astonishing, I didn't notice it at all before!" Yuan Ming spread his Divine Sense, searching for the enemy's traces, while communicating with Kong through voice transmission.
"Can't you recognize this? You shouldn't be unfamiliar with this kind of power." Kong replied coldly, with a tone returning to its usual sarcasm.
Yuan Ming paused, carefully sensing the Black Qi, an eerie and ferocious power transmitted over, like a beast tearing and slaughtering.
"It's the power from that Evil Curse Altar!" He resisted the Black Qi's corrosion, suddenly realizing.
"Not entirely stupid, this is the Curse Power, no need to look nearby, the enemy launched the attack from a distance." Kong said.
Hearing this, Yuan Ming withdrew his Divine Sense, focusing on assisting Nan Shangfeng in resisting the Curse Black Qi, while asking: "Senior Kong, can you break this curse?"
"Can't solve such a small issue, how can I rely on you in the future? Figure it out yourself." Kong left a sentence, and the sound fell silent.
Yuan Ming knew the other's temperament, smiled wryly with helplessness, and could only do his best to help Nan Shangfeng suppress the curse, plotting a countermeasure.
"Fellow Daoist Wan... this... is a curse... go to Black Tiger City in the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range... find Wu Yu..." Nan Shangfeng's condition improved, although he couldn't fully recover, he could speak with difficulty.
"Wu Yu? Who is this person? Can they lift the curse?" Yuan Ming's eyes lit up, and he hurriedly asked.
"Wu Yu is a Prophet in Black Tiger City, I heard that they once helped someone remove a curse..." Nan Shangfeng's speech gradually became fluent.
"If that's the case, I'll take you there." Yuan Ming nodded.
Hearing this, Nan Shangfeng's eyes slightly relaxed, then he closed his eyes, relying on the demonic power Yuan Ming injected into him and his own Mana, to fully resist the Black Qi's erosion.
Yuan Ming shook his head, continued to infuse the Undying Tree Demon Power, and patted Lei Yu, urging it to speed up.
Lei Yu nodded and fully unleashed the Wind and Thunder Power, rushing towards the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range.
...
Over the sea, the sky gradually darkened, a setting sun half-sunk into the sea level, staining the sea surface with a blood-red hue.
Yuan Ming sat cross-legged on Lei Yu's back, using the Undying Tree Demon Power to sustain Nan Shangfeng's life.
With Kong's guidance, he had mostly figured out the Curse Power's attack method, using the Curse Runes on the Soul Destroying Sword, along with the Undying Tree Demon Power, he slowly suppressed the Curse Power in Nan Shangfeng's body.
But these Curse Powers clung stubbornly to Nan Shangfeng and couldn't be expelled.
"Thank you, Fellow Daoist Wan." Nan Shangfeng's condition improved significantly, able to sit up, expressing gratitude.
Yuan Ming shook his head without speaking.
Just then, his ear twitched, seemingly hearing a sharp yet indistinct call of a beast.
Yuan Ming's eyes immediately focused, his Divine Power spreading instantly.
In the next instant, his expression changed dramatically, immediately raising his hand to release a round Array Plate, pointing at it with two fingers.
The Array Plate shone, a series of golden Light Pillars erupted, crossing in mid-air to form a circular golden formation, enclosing Nan Shangfeng within.
"Master, there's a powerful demonic power approaching below." Lei Yu also noticed the abnormality, transmitting to Yuan Ming.
As the words left its mouth, a thunderous roar suddenly came from the seabed below, the sound magnified a hundredfold suddenly, resembling both a bull's roar and a tiger's howl!
Ahead on the sea surface "splash," as a large octopus-like sea beast, its tentacles wrapped around water tornadoes, perched in the void like a giant spider, directly blocking Lei Yu's path.

chapters.title: Chapter 900 - 870: Misfortunes Never Come Singly
chapters.content:
"Level 5 Demon Beast!"
Yuan Ming's gaze swept toward the octopus, his eyes slightly narrowed.
The octopus's head seemed to have just noticed Lei Yu, momentarily stunned, then its body rapidly inflated, nearly tripling in size in an instant. Immediately afterward, the abyssal mouth hidden beneath it suddenly opened, revealing rings of sharp giant teeth.
From the wide-open maw, it spewed a dense dark green mist that quickly spread hundreds of zhang, enveloping Lei Yu.
Where it passed, the void was filled with "puff puff" sounds, accompanied by a strong stench of decay.
The range of the dark green poisonous fog was too vast, and Lei Yu's speed was swift, leaving no time to evade, plunging directly into it.
As it rushed into the Black Mist, a sharp pain seared its eyes, unbearable, forcing them shut. Attempting to rely on Divine Thought to discern direction, it found that the Divine Thought was disturbed by the dark green poisonous fog, rendering it unable to detect anything.
At the same time, its feathers, tougher than iron, rapidly corroded under the mist's erosion.
On Lei Yu's back, the array protecting Nan Shangfeng was also continuously emitting white smoke under the fog's erosion, barely holding on.
Nan Shangfeng felt a dry throat and instinctively sought Yuan Ming's figure, but could see him nowhere.
Just then, a sharp sword cry rang out from the void ahead.
A sword light, like the dawn sun, tore through the shrouding poisonous fog, reopening a line of light for the world.
Following that, raging Sword Qi rolled like a Flood Dragon, thoroughly dispersing the poisonous fog, revealing the dim yet clear sky once more.
Standing on Lei Yu's head, Yuan Ming held the Exterminating Immortal Sword.
As for the octopus demon beast, it had already been cleaved in two by a single sword strike, its unveiled top of the skull falling away into the distance.
"Truly heroic..." Nan Shangfeng sighed in relief and couldn't help but praise.
"Continue onward." Yuan Ming took the Demon Core and shouted aloud.
Lei Yu used demonic power to heal the body eroded by the poison fog and continued forward.
However, before it could fly out half a ke, the sea surface's winds and waves suddenly turned violent, sweeping the heavens with a foul stench of sea breeze, with countless dark currents and vortices appearing on the dim sea surface.
Rows of nearly hundred-zhang-high waves rose in succession, clashing with thunderous roars, splattering countless water droplets like a torrential downpour.
Suddenly, dark clouds gathered above, with bright lightning slithering through.
Yuan Ming focused his eyesight, scanning around, and was astonished to find that not only their sea area displayed such behavior, but even the entire sea within hundreds of li was engulfed in such whirlpools and storm waves.
"We must leave this sea area at once. This isn't just an ordinary sea storm!" Nan Shangfeng urgently said, with a tinge of panic in his voice.
Yuan Ming returned to Lei Yu's back, inquiring, "Do you know what's going on?"
"This is the fabled Heavenly Sea Reverse Thunder Flow, rarely seen in the Dongji Sea Area once in a century, yet we've encountered it." Nan Shangfeng said bitterly.
"Heavenly Sea Reverse Thunder Flow?" Yuan Ming hadn't heard of it before.
"It's a unique phenomenon in the Dongji Sea, where sea water reverses upwards, and lightning descends from above, intertwining together. The exact causes are unknown, but it's extremely dangerous. Even Dharma Phase Cultivators struggle to cope once caught in it!" Nan Shangfeng's knowledge was limited to this.
"Lei Yu, increase speed!" Yuan Ming's expression changed drastically, shouting loudly.
Lei Yu flapped its wings in swift flight, reaching maximum speed, yet the vast ahead sea area still loomed, unable to escape the danger zone.
At that moment, resounding "boom boom" sounds exploded from the sea floor.
It was as if countless cannons were bombarding the sky from the sea floor, with massive waterspouts rising forth from the sea whirlpools, like twisting Black Dragons, shooting straight into the clouds.
These massive waterspout columns, filled with terrifying power, tore through the dark clouds above, piercing through like spears.
Almost simultaneously, lightning fell from above, entwining around the water columns, turning the water spears into thunder spears.
Lei Yu hurriedly maneuvered through the gaps formed by the waterspouts, narrowly avoiding the violent impact.
In its eyes suddenly reflected a firelight, a glow that emerged from the waterspout.
Lei Yu was startled, intending to unleash Divine Skills to attack, when Yuan Ming's voice rang out: "Focus on dodging the impact of the waterspouts, don't concern yourself with anything else."
Immediately, it saw that Yuan Ming's figure was already blocking one side.
Within the waterspout, a grotesque, hideous and bloated fish demon appeared, with a large lantern-like globe hanging from the antenna atop its head, glowing with a fierce red light.
In the next moment, the bright red glow expanded dramatically, turning into a fiercely burning Fireball, bursting through the water wall, heading towards Yuan Ming fiercely.
Yuan Ming raised his hand and grabbed in the void, manipulating a stream of water to coalesce in the air, directly enveloping the Fireball.
However, even encountering water, the Fireball didn't extinguish and still flew towards him.
Yuan Ming's eyebrows slightly furrowed, his palm suddenly clenched, instantly bursting the ball of flames with a powerful force.
The sound of the Fireball explosion rang out, scattering countless sparks, disturbing the demon beasts lurking within the waterspouts.
Afterward, within each water tornado, countless blazing red lanterns lit up, all aimed at Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming sighed inwardly, knowing that it was impossible to avoid and pass through smoothly.
Chasing after Lei Yu, he swiftly flew ahead, and upon seeing countless fireballs approaching from all directions, he raised a hand and struck it toward the void.
In the next instant, above him, dark light erupted from the sky, a massive black palm emerged out of thin air, overshadowing the sky, and pressed down, stirring up circles of black light waves, pressing downward.
The Great Black Sky God Palm emitted a brilliance that instantly engulfed nearly all the fireballs, easily extinguishing them.
Several sturdy surrounding water tornadoes were also shattered by the palm print.
Witnessing this, Yuan Ming's expression showed no signs of relief, as more demon creatures from the sea bottom had locked onto them.
Lei Yu responded with a bright scream, flapping its wings sharply and flying away towards the distance, finally escaping the Heavenly Sea Reverse Thunder Flow area.
Yuan Ming then flew back onto its back and checked his injuries, finding them not serious, he slightly relaxed and turned to look at the chaotic sea area behind them.
At this moment, it was completely dark, the sea region where the water tornadoes shot up seemed like demon dragons twisting their bodies, obscured by torrential rain, becoming hazy and unclear.
Within the curtain of rain, those two glaring scarlet lanterns stayed at the edge for a while and then slowly retreated.
"What is that thing?" Nan Shangfeng stretched his neck looking towards that direction, asking nervously.
"I don't know, but the demon aura is not weak, at least level six, maybe even... level seven." Yuan Ming silently exhaled a turbid breath, waved his hand to retract the array, and sat down beside him.
"Fortunately, that thing didn't chase after us." Nan Shangfeng said with a change of expression, feeling relieved.
Yuan Ming didn't speak again, closing his eyes to begin breathing control.
Nan Shangfeng also closed his mouth, gazing far into the black sea, lost in thought.
...
Late at night.
Lei Yu carried the two of them soaring above the clouds, under the pitch-black sky dotted with stars, a solitary moon cast a cold light, everything was silent, except for the howling wind, there were no other sounds.
Nan Shangfeng sat bored, looking at Yuan Ming who was meditating and cultivating beside him, wanting to say something but dared not disturb, feeling slightly hesitant.
But at this moment, Yuan Ming suddenly opened his eyes abruptly, his gaze flashing with brilliance, startling Nan Shangfeng.
"Wha... what happened?" he asked instinctively.
"There's a demon coming." Yuan Ming spoke while standing up and focused straight ahead.
Nan Shangfeng also jolted awake and climbed up, widening his eyes, looking toward the distance.
A moment later, aided by the moonlight's clear glow, he saw a large shadow flying rapidly over, and his expression changed instantly.
"Why are they coming again? We're really unlucky!" Nan Shangfeng lamented bitterly.
Yuan Ming said nothing, raised his hand, and once again threw the array plate, releasing an array that protected Nan Shangfeng in the center.
Then, he turned his wrist, firmly grasped the Exterminating Immortal Sword, and leaped off Lei Yu's back, transforming into a stream of light rushing forward.
A thousand feet away, a group of hundreds of giant blue-feathered birds approached in formation, seeing someone rush them, they opened their mouths and emitted waves of cries.
Amidst the shrill cries, there were intense Divine Soul waves, condensing in the void into layers of sound waves, overwhelming like sea waves, attacking.
Yuan Ming turned his direction, diving into the sea of sound waves, immediately feeling a stinging pain in his eardrums followed by a wave of dizziness.
His eyes narrowed, and divine soul power surged out, instantly dispelling all abnormal sensations.
His Divine Soul was like an indestructible reef, unmoved despite the continuous waves crashing against it.
At this moment, the approaching giant birds flapped their wings fiercely, fanned against Yuan Ming, and from beneath their feathers, green wind blades surged out, interwoven as they attacked.
The gale howled like a dense net of blades descending, shredding the clouds in the high sky.
Yuan Ming brandished his long sword, countless sword lights bursting forth, intermingling with the net of blades, filling the air with a continuous "clang" as wind blades were shredded by the sword light.
Yuan Ming's figure pierced through like a stream of light, crashing into the flock of giant birds.
In the next instant, the mournful cries of the giant birds resounded through the sky, as one after another, their bodies were torn apart by crisscrossing sword light, turning into countless pieces amid the blood rain and plummeting down.
Just then, a sharp piercing sound suddenly reached his ears, extraordinarily sharp.
This sound was completely different from before, carrying an extremely strong penetrative force, directly bypassing Yuan Ming's Divine Soul defense, like a steel knife, directly stabbing into his Sea of Consciousness.
While fervently slaying the giant birds, Yuan Ming was caught off guard, feeling his brain "buzz" into ringing, tumbling down from the sky.
(Dear fellow daoists, it's almost New Year, there are more matters at Wang Yu's home, many social obligations, thus during the Spring Festival, the update speed can only slow down, starting today for a week, there will be only one update per day. Wang Yu here wishes everyone a happy New Year and all the best ^^)

chapters.title: Chapter 901 - 871: The Way of Fortune
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming's figure only fell more than ten feet before a Protective Treasure Light lit up around him, stabilizing in midair for a moment. His face turned stiff as he looked up overhead.
The flock of cyan giant birds had already scattered, and the originally moonlit and sparse night sky was unknowingly obscured by a massive black shadow.
The shadow stretched endlessly from one glance. It was pure black yet seemed enveloped with a layer of moonlight, appearing somewhat hazy and indistinct, exuding an indescribably strange feeling.
Yuan Ming was certain that the earlier shrill scream had emanated from that black shadow.
His brows slightly furrowed, and his face was somewhat grave.
The emergence of this black shadow was too eerie, catching him completely off guard.
However, after waiting a moment, no more piercing screams arose, nor did any anomaly appear within that black shadow.
Yuan Ming immediately sent a message to Lei Yu, urging him to quickly increase his pace and avoid disturbing whatever lay inside the shadow.
Lei Yu hesitated not a moment, his body shimmering with cyan light and electric threads, transforming into a streak of lightning, swiftly bypassing both the shadow and Yuan Ming, speeding away ahead.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming breathed a slight sigh of relief, intending to distance himself from the area as well.
Although he did not know what peculiarities lay within, slipping away quietly was undoubtedly the best choice.
He exerted full power in his Flying Escape, his figure transforming into a rainbow. Just as he was about to catch up with Lei Yu, his gaze suddenly flickered, and his heart experienced a tremendous jolt.
Above Lei Yu's head, unknown when, another black shadow enveloped in hazy moonlight appeared.
Turning back, Yuan Ming saw that the earlier shadow had disappeared entirely.
"Damn it..."
Yuan Ming felt a sudden jolt, unable to warn Lei Yu in time.
From within that peculiar shadow, a flicker of azure and purple lightning emerged, brightening a flash of lightning, within which a massive, mountain-like blurry figure faintly appeared.
It resembled a giant bird yet had four legs, its body covered in black feathers with azure-purple arcs of electricity flashing over them.
The giant bird opened its hooked mouth wide, spewing forth a mass of azure-purple electric plasma that transformed into a gigantic tree-shaped lightning bolt, momentarily lighting up the entire night sky, striking downward toward Lei Yu.
At the critical moment, Yuan Ming's two arms morphed into two Undying Tree Roots, piercing through the void directly above Lei Yu's head. One coiled around the God Bombarding Cone, its apex pointing upward, while the other grasped the Thunder God Hammer, smashing down fiercely.
With a "boom," a burst of golden lightning erupted from the God Bombarding Cone, shooting straight into the sky, colliding with the fearsome tree-shaped lightning, resulting in a deafening rumble.
The exploding electricity scattered, transforming into countless irregular arcs and sparks, striking in all directions.
Nanshang Feng, sitting atop Lei Yu's back, looked up, mouth agape, witnessing a sight he would never forget!
The electric arcs rained down like waterfalls enveloping everything in dazzling electric light, exuding an overwhelming aura of destruction that seemed to imprison him in a giant cage made of thunder.
He believed that, without Yuan Ming intervening, he would have been obliterated long ago.
Once the electric light dissipated, Yuan Ming had already seized the opportunity to catch up.
But his hands holding the God Bombarding Cone and Thunder God Hammer were fiery red, nearly melting.
Without pausing for a breath, Yuan Ming stored away his two treasures and summoned the Exterminating Immortal Sword and Soul Destroying Sword, holding one in each hand. He infused all his mana into them, slashing upward in a crisscross motion.
Two massive sword lights flashed, crossing like scissors high above, forming an enormous cross strike that tore into the black shadow.
From within the shadow came a chilling shriek, sharp and unbearable.
Yuan Ming withstood it, but Lei Yu and Nan Shangfeng could not. The former used the demon clan's tough physique to barely continue flying, though his direction began to waver, while the latter rolled his eyes and fainted.
Lei Yu, in this unsteady state, flew over a hundred miles before finally finding respite when the shadow overhead disappeared.
Meanwhile, Yuan Ming remained vigilant, using his Divine Sense to scan the surroundings to prevent the entity from reappearing abruptly and launching another surprise attack.
Fortunately, it seemed the entity was either deterred or injured by Yuan Ming, as it did not pursue them.
Yet, their brief respite was soon interrupted as they unexpectedly flew into a thunderstorm zone, chased by countless massive lightning strikes for a quarter of an hour before finally escaping.
Afterwards, Lei Yu was too exhausted, so Yuan Ming led them to take a rest on a nearby island.
Scarcely had they set foot on the island when a massive tremor echoed from beneath the ground, and the long-dormant island volcano suddenly erupted.
Streams of lava rained from the sky, yet relying on the formation Yuan Ming set up and continuous interception, they narrowly managed to escape.
But immediately, a tsunami triggered by the volcanic eruption formed towering waves that rushed towards them.
Utterly helpless, Lei Yu had no choice but to fly above the clouds again, resulting in another attack by a group of flying demon beasts.
Yuan Ming fared a bit better, but Lei Yu was tormented to the extreme.
Nan Shangfeng was also accidentally injured, looking rather disheveled with many visible wounds on his body.
Finally freed from the demon beasts' entanglement, Yuan Ming quickly took out an elixir and consumed it, sitting down to practice Breathing Control.
"This isn't right; ever since we started flying across the ocean, we've encountered endless misfortunes. How come we're encountering all these demons, monsters, natural disasters, and catastrophes?" Nan Shangfeng couldn't help but speak up.
Yuan Ming had actually already realized something wasn't right; however, there were constant big problems and small troubles along the way, leaving him no time to think deeply until now.
"Senior Kong, you should know what's going on with the situation we're encountering, right?" Yuan Ming asked in his heart.
Between pondering it himself and seeking advice from others, he chose the latter.
After all, if Senior Kong could directly tell him the answer, it would definitely be easier and more accurate than his own guesswork.
"Being unlucky to this extent, still can't figure it out?" Surprisingly, this time Senior Kong gave a face and immediately responded.
"Is it related to that Evil Curse Altar?" Yuan Ming tentatively asked.
He actually already had a vague guess in his heart, just couldn't be completely certain yet.
After all, luck is invisible and untouchable, mysterious and elusive, hard to grasp.
"Not too dumb." Kong replied.
"So how should it be solved?" Yuan Ming immediately asked.
That's the reason he chose to ask Senior Kong, because even if he guessed where the problem was, finding a solution immediately wouldn't be easy.
And the next wave of bad luck could descend at any time.
"This thing is indeed beyond your current capability, well then, three million Spirit Stones." Kong's voice echoed in his Sea of Consciousness.
"What?" Yuan Ming didn't react momentarily.
"Give me three million Spirit Stones, and I'll tell you how to solve it." Kong replied.
"Senior Kong, not asking for Vow Power Pills this time but Spirit Stones? What do you want three million Spirit Stones for?" Yuan Ming asked curiously.
"That's not something for you to worry about. In short, if you want to know how to solve the current predicament, give me three million Spirit Stones, or think of a way yourself." Kong explained without elaboration.
"Alright, I promise you, but I don't have enough Spirit Stones right now; I'll give them to you when we reach the Central Continent." Yuan Ming hesitated slightly and said.
"Okay. The attacks from the Evil Curse Altar are far more mysterious than you think; its attacks are more obscure than your Curse Runes and almost impossible to resist or detect. Once struck, not only the physical body will be affected by the Curse Power, but luck will also be influenced." Kong explained directly.
"Luck? Are you talking about luck, Senior Kong?" Yuan Ming asked.
"Yes, you could say so. Nan Shangfeng is currently entangled with misfortune, encountering accidents wherever he goes, due to the curse affecting his luck." Kong continued.
"Such attack methods? Is there any way to counter it?" Yuan Ming felt greatly enlightened.
"To completely lift the curse is beyond your current ability, but there is a way to let him temporarily avoid the disturbance of misfortune, just need to isolate his connection with the outside world." Kong ignored Yuan Ming's astonishment and continued.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming felt greatly disappointed.
"I've already tried that method; I placed him in the Void Palace, but the dangers we encountered didn't lessen in the slightest, all falling on me without exception."
"Ordinary Space Spiritual Treasures can't isolate the influence of the curse on luck, but the space within the Stealing Heaven Tripod can. You just need to hide him inside to block out misfortune, reducing the curse's impact on him." Kong chuckled lightly, speaking at a leisurely pace.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming's eyes brightened as he turned to look at Nan Shangfeng.
Throughout the journey, Nan Shangfeng was paranoid and now seemed as skittish as a startled bird. Seeing Yuan Ming looking at him, he instinctively thought something unexpected had happened again.
"Wha- what's wrong?" he asked in panic.
Yuan Ming was about to speak when a rolling thunder suddenly came from the sea ahead.
"Why is it still not over..." Nan Shangfeng showed a bitter expression, looking as if he was about to cry without tears.
Yuan Ming raised his eyes to look into the distance, only to see that thousands of feet away, the sea waves rolled, thunder roared, and the gloomy sky seemed to have entered an apocalypse, carrying an indescribable might of heaven and earth, rolling towards them.
"Don't worry, we'll be safe soon." He withdrew his gaze and while speaking, raised his hand to pat Nan Shangfeng's shoulder.
In his palm, a colorful light appeared, and a butterfly-shaped rune flew out from his palm, circling above Nan Shangfeng's head.
Nan Shangfeng's eyes immediately took on a layer of hazy color, and he reversed his eyes, sinking into a deep dream.

chapters.title: Chapter 902 - 872: 100 Years
chapters.content:
After Yuan Ming put away the Dream Butterfly Dao Seal, he took out the Stealing Heaven Tripod and placed the sleeping Nan Shangfeng inside.
At the moment the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space closed again, Yuan Ming suddenly had an illusion, as if he felt the wind blowing over the sea had become slightly weaker.
When he raised his eyes again, he saw the lightning storm in the sea ahead dimming little by little, and the raging storm was also gradually subsiding.
By the time Lei Yu flew to that sea area, the sky was bright, and the clouds and rain had cleared.
The surging waves on the sea surface had disappeared, leaving only a few ripples gently undulating.
"This... it changes faster than a woman's face," Yuan Ming sincerely sighed.
However, looking at the sea area restored to normal, Yuan Ming finally breathed a sigh of relief, no longer needing to worry about dangers appearing at any moment.
Lei Yu also breathed a sigh of relief.
It could finally spread its wings without restraint, carrying Yuan Ming on his journey at full speed.
...
Behind them, on the sea surface, a black long rainbow was advancing like the wind and lightning, heading straight towards where Yuan Ming and Nan Shangfeng were.
At this moment, the black long rainbow suddenly stopped, revealing Hei Lian's figure, her face full of disbelief.
She could no longer sense the position of Nan Shangfeng.
During her previous battle with Qin Meiniang, she had imprinted a mark on Nan Shangfeng. In the past few days, despite being far behind by Yuan Ming, she had still been able to track them because of this mark.
But now, Hei Lian couldn't sense that mark at all.
"This is impossible! That mark is formed from the essence of the Space Power of the Void Sky Demon Technique. Even if he hides in a Space Spiritual Treasure, it shouldn't completely obscure the mark! Could it be that Nan Shangfeng discovered the Void Sky Mark and has destroyed it? Or does he have a Space Dao Treasure on him?" Hei Lian's face turned ugly.
Without the spatial mark, she could no longer pursue them.
"After lying low for years, the Blood Clothes Building needs a sensational assassination to announce its return. Is it all going to be in vain..." Hei Lian said bitterly.
"Tsk tsk, killing a Daluo Sect Master disciple counts as a sensational assassination? Little Lian'er, after all these years, you're still so petty," a voice suddenly interrupted.
"Who is it!" Hei Lian's expression changed sharply, and her powerful Divine Sense spread in all directions, yet found nothing.
"You've been practicing the Void Sky Demon Technique of your master for years, and still can't reach the stage of entering the void with a single thought?" Not far in front of Hei Lian, a void split open, and a youth in black robe emerged.
"Su Wu!" Hei Lian's expression changed dramatically, much more intense than when she sensed the spatial mark disappearing earlier.
As the void fluctuated, a white-clothed woman appeared next.
If Yuan Ming were here, he would have recognized this woman as Su Yingxue, who previously negotiated with him, bent over, and offered a deal in exchange for a Formation.
"Su Wu, Su Yingxue, you both managed to return from the Demon World?" Hei Lian secretly gulped, barely calming the shock on her face.
"I only passed Yan Emperor's test, that's all," Su Wu said with a light laugh.
"The Eighteen Layers of Hell of Yan Emperor, even those in the same Mahayana Realm may not survive it. How did you pass through it? You haven't broken through to the Mahayana Realm yet, have you?" Hei Lian looked Su Wu up and down and said.
"So-called Mahayana, it only means mastering the Five Elements Undying Body and possessing more Power of Dao. My Heavenly Cicada Undying True Body is not weaker than the Five Elements Undying Body; what's strange about passing through the Eighteen Layers of Hell?" Su Wu said calmly.
"Alright, what brings you back now?" Hei Lian rolled her eyes and asked.
"To take control of the Three Realms Sect and retrieve the Three Realms Immortal Order from the Wentian Secret Realm, haven't I already sent you this information?" Su Wu said, with a flash in his eyes.
"The recent news about the emergence of a new leader in the Three Realms Sect was your doing?" Hei Lian suddenly recalled something.
"Hehe, of course, besides me, who else could replace our master and inherit the position of the Three Realms Sect Leader?" Su Wu said calmly.
"Don't ask me, you should ask the Seven Spirits Daoist, Water and Fire Immortals, and the Four-direction Killing Gods, those cunning figures; they wouldn't recognize you as leader just because you say so," Hei Lian said slowly.
"These people, I will visit them one by one later. But in my heart, Junior Sister Hei Lian, you're the most important. You must know, it was our master's dying wish for you to succeed as the leader," Su Wu said with a smile.
"I've long said I'm not interested in that position. Right now, I just want to revive the Blood Clothes Building. You can have the position of the Three Realms Sect Leader if you want it," Hei Lian said.
"Since Junior Sister says so, I will step up to the occasion." Su Wu seemed relieved.
"Wait! Since you're here, you might as well do me a favor and help me kill someone," Hei Lian's tone shifted.
"That Nan Shangfeng? What's the point in killing him, since Junior Sister wants to make a name for the Blood Clothes Building, I'll involve you in a truly earth-shattering assassination!" Su Wu laughed heartily, flicked his sleeve, covering the three of them in a silver light.
Hei Lian showed a hint of hesitation but did not resist.
The silver light enveloped the three, and in a flash, they merged into the void.
...
Hei Lian still didn't appear again, nor did she launch any attack, which made Yuan Ming feel slightly at ease, continuing his journey with peace of mind.
In the blink of an eye, more than three months have passed, and Yuan Ming finally flew out of the Dongji Sea Area, reaching the Central Continent.
Yuan Ming stood on Lei Yu's back, hovering over a jagged steep sea cliff.
This is where the Central Continent meets the Dongji Sea, with a long and winding coastline stretching into the distance, with no end in sight.
The sea cliffs are dozens of feet higher than the sea level, and behind them lies a range of even taller, endless majestic mountains, shrouded in dense forests, with no sign of people in sight.
Yuan Ming gazed at this mountain range, genuinely sighing.
The Dongji Sea Area is vast and boundless, like a drop in a bucket, yet the continent in front of him is even more imposing, towering high, firmly suppressing the Dongji Sea Area.
"Sitting in the center and intimidating all directions, no wonder this continent is called the Central Continent." Yuan Ming muttered to himself.
The mountain range behind the sea cliffs already belongs to the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range, though this is just a borderland.
Yuan Ming took out a map, bought on an island near the Central Continent, a map of the "Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range."
After carefully identifying it for a moment, he quickly confirmed his current location, somewhere in the eastern part of the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range.
According to the markings on the map, there are a total of nineteen cities in the entire region of the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range.
The Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range is different from the Dongji Sea; it is a paradise for the Demon Clan. Although many cultivators on the continent come here to hunt demons and seek treasures, only those nineteen cities can be considered safe.
His destination on this trip, White Emperor City, is located in the middle of the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range, far from him; the closest city to him is one called Yin Mountain.
According to Nan Shangfeng, Black Tiger City is not far from here, a neighboring city to Yin Mountain City.
Yuan Ming carefully examined the map of the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range. The nineteen cities are scattered throughout the mountain range, like nineteen nails, driven into the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range.
These cities are mostly in the border areas of the mountain range, only a few located deep within the mountains.
The nineteen cities are not arranged in a straight line; some skew south, some north. Just from the map, it's unclear if they are distributed following the mountain's terrain or the river systems.
However, overall, it appears to be quite systematic.
After inspecting the eastern cities, Yuan Ming glanced at the western side as well.
Upon doing so, he couldn't help but furrow his brows.
He turned the map upright and took a closer look at the mountain range's direction, the corner of his mouth gently lifting in a smile.
"How interesting, I knew the distribution of these nineteen cities was somewhat unusual. Indeed, there's a hidden array pattern. To be able to lay out such a grand formation, it must be extraordinary!" Yuan Ming secretly marveled in his heart, while also harboring a faint anticipation for this mysterious array.
However, with just a map, he could only discern that this was an array; to uncover more intricacies, he would have to personally traverse the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range to truly see.
"To perceive this great array spanning the entire Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range, your vision is no longer low, and your attainments in the path of formations have significantly progressed." At this moment, Kong's voice suddenly echoed in his sea of consciousness.
"I know you know everything and can do anything, but please don't casually probe my thoughts, okay?" Yuan Ming's heart tightened at the words, feeling somewhat displeased.
"Do you know the origin of these nineteen great cities of the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range?" Kong ignored his protest and asked.
"If you want to say it, just say it, no need to ask me." Yuan Ming said helplessly.
"These nineteen cities were built thousands of years ago by a Mahayana cultivator who connected the nineteen cities to the underground spirit veins of the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range, forming a Heavenly Crane Array to constrain the demons within the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range from invading and threatening the peace of the Central Continent and Dongji Sea Area." Kong explained self-absorbedly.
"To set up a great array using the entire spirit veins of the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range is truly a grand gesture! But this seems to have nothing to do with me. You appearing now is probably not just to enlighten me, right?" Yuan Ming asked.
"Of course not, I want to tell you that the Abyss Nether Stone you're looking for is within this Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range." Kong's tone softened as he spoke.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming's expression immediately changed from calm, and he pressed on, "Where in the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range?"
"Where it is, I will naturally tell you later, but before that, you need to agree to something." Kong said.
"Don't keep me in suspense, what do you want?" Yuan Ming frowned.
"I want you to stay in this Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range for a hundred years." Kong said.
"Why?" Yuan Ming asked, puzzled.
"I cannot tell you the reason for now. As long as you agree, I will do my utmost to help you obtain the Abyss Nether Stone." Kong said.
Yuan Ming pondered; though he did not know what Kong intended, staying in the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range for a hundred years didn't seem like a big deal.
"A hundred years isn't long, and right now I also need to help Nan Shangfeng solve the curse problem. Alright, I agree." He consented.
