"Rest assured, staying here for a hundred years will only benefit you, not harm you." Kong's tone carried a hint of pleasure.
"Let's hope so." Yuan Ming said noncommittally.
Then, he directed Lei Yu towards the direction of Yin Mountain City.

chapters.title: Chapter 903 - 873: Entering the City (Happy Spring Festival)
chapters.content:
As soon as Yuan Ming set off, the voice of Void sounded again in his ear:
"By the way, let me remind you, when you walk through the cities in the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range, it's best not to let people notice the demonic aura on you, otherwise it would invite unnecessary trouble."
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming silently noted down Void's advice and did not respond.
On the way to Yin Mountain City, the roar of demon beasts continuously echoed from the dense forests of the mountain range that he passed.
This was just the outskirts of the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range. Most of the demon beasts residing here were only at the third-level or fourth-level, and there were not any excessively powerful demons. Naturally, they dared not seek trouble with him, and thus the journey was peaceful.
Seven days later, Yuan Ming arrived at Yin Mountain City.
Yin Mountain City was located in a valley between two towering peaks, with walls over a hundred feet high, entirely built from large slabs of refined steel rock. These walls reflected a metallic luster in the morning sunlight, appearing indestructible.
Yuan Ming stood outside the city, looking up at the city walls. On the hundred-foot-wide city head stood a grand gate tower, and on either side, there were octagonal watchtowers echoing each other, emanating a formidable aura of hostility.
On the city walls were engraved densely packed and intricate runes, extending into the gateway. This seemed to be part of the entire gate's defense magic array.
Yuan Ming shifted his gaze to the two peaks flanking the city gate, where he saw towering fortress-like structures similar to watchtowers, equipped with some sort of giant bed crossbow and arrows, faintly showing traces of rune arrays.
Yin Mountain City, rather than a city, resembled a fortified stronghold on alert, ready to transform into something else should an external enemy invade.
It was early morning, and not many were entering the city gate, but quite a few were leaving, mostly in groups of seven or eight, with few traveling alone.
Yuan Ming watched for a moment, then stepped toward the city gate.
Just as he reached the gate, he was stopped by a squad of armored guards stationed there.
"Stop, where's your entry permit?" asked the bearded man leading the guard, after sizing Yuan Ming up and down.
"I am here for the first time and don't have a permit." Yuan Ming replied honestly.
Upon hearing this, the bearded man frowned and, noticing Yuan Ming's aura only at the Nascent Soul Early Stage, did not say much, merely gesturing for Yuan Ming to follow him, before turning around and walking ahead.
Following behind him, Yuan Ming entered the gate tunnel.
As soon as he entered the tunnel, Yuan Ming felt a wave of spiritual energy sweep over him from top to bottom.
He looked up and saw a circular copper mirror, the size of a washbasin, embedded in the wall above the tunnel. The wave of spiritual energy had just emanated from this copper mirror.
"That's a Demon Mirror, capable of revealing the demonic aura on you, to prevent demons from sneaking into the city." The bearded man walking ahead stopped when he saw no abnormalities on the copper mirror and explained it to Yuan Ming.
"Do demons often sneak into the city?" Yuan Ming asked.
"Not really. However, in this Yin Mountain City, most people are here to hunt demon beasts in the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range, and over the centuries, they've become mortal enemies with the demons within, always needing to be vigilant." The bearded man replied.
Yuan Ming nodded at this statement without saying anything further.
Soon, the two entered inside the city gate and arrived at a barracks to handle the entry permits.
The entry permits were of two types, one for long-term residency, allowing a thirty-year stay in Yin Mountain City, and the other short-term, permitting only a one-year stay.
To Yuan Ming's surprise, the long-term permit only required one hundred Spirit Stones, whereas the short-term permit came at a hundred times the price, requiring ten thousand Spirit Stones.
"Why is the short-term permit so expensive? Normally, wouldn't it be the other way around?" Yuan Ming asked in a low voice.
Could this bearded man be taking advantage of his unfamiliarity and holding him to an unreasonably high price?
"It seems that Fellow Daoist is visiting the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range for the first time and is completely unaware of the situation here. All nineteen cities within the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range are like this…" The bearded man smiled and then explained the reason behind it.
It turns out, those cultivators who acquire long-term permits, although allowed to reside within the city for an extended period, would be under the supervision of the Yin Mountain City Lord Mansion, not allowed to leave the city without permission, and required to regularly receive tasks from the City Lord Mansion, essentially becoming part of the Mansion.
The short-term permits, however, had no restrictions and offered more freedom, naturally making them more costly.
Within the city, most low-level cultivators had long-term permits, while only those strong enough to venture out hunting demon beasts could afford the short-term permits.
"If Fellow Daoist is financially tight, you might consider obtaining a long-term permit. The tasks issued by the City Lord Mansion are not difficult, mostly patrols and guard duties. With Fellow Daoist's strength, they can be easily completed, and joining the City Lord Mansion provides more convenience for actions within many areas of the city." The bearded man suggested.
Yuan Ming still planned to go to Black Tiger City, so he immediately paid ten thousand Spirit Stones for the short-term permit.
"Fellow Daoist is quite wealthy, keep this permit safe, don't lose it, otherwise, you will have to spend Spirit Stones to re-acquire it. Additionally, do not engage in unauthorized battles within the city, otherwise your permit will be immediately confiscated and you will be expelled from the city." The bearded man handed Yuan Ming a black Jade Token and advised him.
"Thank you." Yuan Ming cupped his hands in thanks.
Then, the burly man with a bushy beard left him and returned to his post.
Yuan Ming proceeded alone towards the city.
Inside Yin Mountain City's gate, there was a straight and wide green stone avenue, flanked not by shops but by towering arrow towers, seemingly constructed for defense against demon invasions.
Each arrow tower had a dozen cultivators stationed.
These cultivators wore uniform black tight-fitting outfits, none spoke, each had a solemn expression, closely monitoring the situation outside the city, the air filled with an atmosphere of tension.
Yuan Ming crossed the wide green stone avenue, ahead the terrain suddenly dropped steeply, descending the stone steps for several dozen steps, the terrain suddenly opened up, with streets and towering buildings appearing in sight.
The tense and solemn atmosphere vanished, morning sunlight falling on the streets, casting a warm orange glow, the long-missed bustle of life greeting him.
Street stalls selling food had already begun operations, milky-white steam mixed with the aroma of food wafted through the air.
Yin Mountain City is a city of cultivators, with most street vendors also being cultivators, selling largely spirit foods made from spiritual materials.
Yuan Ming, long missing the craving for food, felt his Adam's apple move as he walked over.
He sat at a stall selling lamb soup, upon the staff's recommendation, he ordered a bowl made from demon beast triangular lamb, enjoying it with freshly baked bread, devouring a large bowl.
Yuan Ming did not leave immediately, giving the staff several spirit stones, and inquired about the affairs of Yin Mountain City.
Though the staff was only at the Qi Refinement realm, he had been in Yin Mountain City for over a decade, quite familiar with the situation here, answering all questions Yuan Ming posed.
After a round of inquiries, Yuan Ming basically understood the situation of Yin Mountain City.
The Yin Mountain City Lord is named Long Shan, his cultivation has reached mid-stage Dharma manifestation, he commands a deputy city lord at early-stage Dharma manifestation, and over twenty leaders at the Returning to Void stage, each leader in charge of five hundred household soldiers directly under the city lord's mansion.
The entire Yin Mountain City essentially revolves around the Yin Mountain City Lord as the center of cultivation forces; as for other cities in the Ten Thousand Demons Mountain Range, it is much the same.
Yuan Ming nodded slowly, the strength of cities in the Ten Thousand Demons Mountain Range is indeed formidable, no wonder Dongji Palace has to submit to White Emperor City's command.
As they spoke, a team of black-clothed cultivators walked down the street, wearing the same tight-fitting black outfits as those on the arrow towers, their cultivation all in the Nascent Soul stage.
Other cultivators on the street showed immense respect for these individuals, clearing the path from afar.
"Who are these people?" Yuan Ming asked.
"They are the household soldiers of the city lord's mansion, no one dares to interfere even if they commit murder, senior must absolutely avoid conflict with them," the staff quietly advised.
"Does the city lord's mansion truly have such absolute control over Yin Mountain City? As far as I know, this Yin Mountain City was built long ago and is not privately owned by the city lord," Yuan Ming asked.
"That I do not know, but the nineteen city lords of the Ten Thousand Demons Mountain Range gather periodically, perhaps someone governs them," the staff said, scratching his head.
Yuan Ming pondered, the three big forces in the Extreme East region—Dongji Palace, Luo Jia Mountain, Azure Dragon Pond—all have backing, the nineteen cities in the Ten Thousand Demons Mountain Range likely are no exception.
The city lord Jin Mu of White Emperor City has deep ties with Ancestor Bing Lan from Heavenly Saint Academy, could it be Heavenly Saint Academy governing the Ten Thousand Demons Mountain Range?
Just then, Yuan Ming detected a gaze upon him.
Yuan Ming looked over, finding another guest at the stall drinking lamb soup.
It was a tall man wearing a silver robe embroidered with floral patterns, his posture erect, not imposing yet quite robust, with well-defined features and smooth lines, sporting flowing silver long hair and a bushy short beard, which added a touch of dashing boldness rather than untidiness.
Upon sensing Yuan Ming's gaze, the silver-haired man offered a slight smile and resumed drinking his soup.
Yuan Ming subtly assessed the person, then withdrew his gaze and continued to ask the staff, "Are there any large trade associations within Yin Mountain City?"
"Of course, most in the city are cultivators who hunt demons outside, bringing back numerous demon beast materials, spirit grasses, and ores daily, there are up to seven or eight trade associations in the city." The staff appeared envious, seemingly aspiring to be those demon-hunting cultivators.
"Does Ten Thousand Goods Immortal Trip have a branch here?" Yuan Ming inquired.
"Certainly, Ten Thousand Goods Immortal Trip is the foremost trade association on the continent, with branches in all cities of the Ten Thousand Demons Mountain Range," the staff replied.
After extracting the location of Ten Thousand Goods Immortal Trip from the staff, Yuan Ming didn't linger further, settling the bill and headed over.
A short while later, Yuan Ming arrived at Yin Mountain City's commercial district, and without much effort, he found Ten Thousand Goods Immortal Trip.
Yin Mountain City's Ten Thousand Goods Immortal Trip was taller and grander than that on East Extreme Island, towering above nearby shops, visible even from afar.
(Wishing Fellow Daoists a Happy New Year, with health, harmony, and prosperity!)

chapters.title: Chapter 904 - 874: Exchange (Happy New Year)
chapters.content:
As soon as Yuan Ming entered the shop, he took out his Guest Elder Token.
The shop assistant immediately went to find a steward to escort Yuan Ming to the inner hall.
"Haha, Elder Wan's honorable visit makes our branch shine," the slightly plump steward said with a face full of smiles, appearing very cordial.
"Oh, you know me?" Yuan Ming asked, somewhat surprised.
"Your status as a Guest Elder has been communicated to all branches. We've been instructed to ensure we treat you well and fulfill all your needs as best as we can," the steward said, diligently pouring the shop's finest Immortal Tea for Yuan Ming.
"I see. The reason I've come to bother you is that I would like your branch to help me collect some high-grade spirit wood, preferably Level 5 or above, as much as possible," Yuan Ming directly stated upon hearing this.
The reason he came to Yin Mountain City was to understand the nineteen cities of the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range, but more importantly, to collect high-grade spirit wood.
"Not a problem, not a problem. When do you need it by?" the steward asked.
"Three days. I won't be staying in Yin Mountain City for long," Yuan Ming thought for a moment and said.
"Three days... it's a bit tight, but we'll do our utmost to gather it for you," the steward replied, slightly frowning as he spoke.
"Thank you," Yuan Ming cupped his fists in thanks.
"No need to thank us yet, Fellow Daoist Wan. All our major branches have also been tasked to ask if you still have any High Grade Soul Refining Pills for sale should you visit again," the steward asked with a smile.
"In three days, when I come to pick up the high-grade spirit wood, I will bring along the Soul Refining Pills," Yuan Ming replied.
"Very well, very well..." The steward was immediately overjoyed at this.
After bidding farewell, Yuan Ming found an inn in the city, rented a courtyard, and settled in temporarily.
First, he helped Nan Shangfeng suppress the curse's backlash, then took out the Stealing Heaven Tripod and used Black Incense Possession on Ye Wuya to comprehend the Golden Sunflower Beast Taming Technique.
Once the Black Incense Possession ended, his Golden Sunflower Beast Taming Technique improved a little more.
Yuan Ming nodded silently. At this rate, in a few more years, his Golden Sunflower Beast Taming Technique, Planting Beans into Soldiers, and Eyes of Golden Flame would all reach the Perfect Realm, at which point he could begin to advance to the Dharma manifestation Stage.
He gently exhaled, closed his eyes, and cultivated.
Three days quickly passed, and Yuan Ming left the inn, heading towards the Ten Thousand Goods Immortal Trip.
"Yuan, the Cloud Dream Immortal Pillow has already been refined. Now we need to start creating a treasure, which means you'll have to gather some materials," came the voice of Kong while on the way.
"What Moon God's Treasure does the senior wish to refine? What materials are needed? I will do my utmost to find them," Yuan Ming said delightedly.
"Although the Cloud Dream Immortal Pillow seems large, the refined Moonlight Stone essence is only a tiny bit, enough to make the least effective of the Moon God's Three Treasures—the Moon God Ring. The materials needed are Snow Jade, Moon Cold Core, Deep Sea Marrow Silver, Heavenly Star Sand..." Kong listed about twenty or thirty materials.
"So many spiritual materials are needed, and none of them are not precious materials, especially Snow Jade, Moon Cold Core, and Heavenly Star Sand. I'm afraid they are not easier to find than the Moonlight Stone," Yuan Ming said with some distress.
"If ordinary spiritual materials were enough to refine them, the Moon God's Three Treasures wouldn't be so renowned. I'll tell you where to find Snow Jade, Moon Cold Core, and Heavenly Star Sand. You just need to handle the rest," Kong said.
Yuan Ming nodded, quickening his pace, and soon arrived again at the Ten Thousand Goods Immortal Trip, where he was met once more by the slightly plump steward.
"Elder Wan, I'm truly sorry. Three days was very limited time. Despite our best efforts, we only managed to gather ten pieces of high-grade spirit wood, including one piece of Level 6 Phoenix Wing Cloud Wood, with the rest being Level 5 spirit wood," the steward warmly greeted him as soon as they met.
Yuan Ming was somewhat surprised by this. To collect so much high-grade spirit wood in such a short span of three days was not a simple feat, showing that the Ten Thousand Goods Immortal Trip had indeed shown considerable dedication.
"I have also prepared what you need," Yuan Ming responded.
Soon, he was led to a meeting room, where collecting this batch of spirit wood cost four hundred and sixty thousand Spirit Stones. Yuan Ming offered three High Grade Soul Refining Pills for exchange, and the chubby steward quickly agreed.
After both sides verified their items, the transaction concluded rapidly.
"Elder Wan, do you have any more High Grade Soul Refining Pills? I heard that on East Extreme Island, they sold for one hundred and fifty thousand Spirit Stones each. I'm willing to buy them at a price of one hundred and sixty-five thousand Spirit Stones each," the chubby steward asked.
"I'm very sorry. The High Grade Soul Refining Pills were refined by a friend of mine and only gave me these. The three I just sold were the last," Yuan Ming shook his head.
In truth, he still had some High Grade Soul Refining Pills with him, but having already distributed a dozen or so recently, producing more would truly be too conspicuous.
The chubby steward also knew that Yuan Ming had already sold several High Grade Soul Refining Pills and probably didn't have more, so while disappointed, he didn't doubt it.
"Elder Wan, if you get more High Grade Soul Refining Pills in the future, please prioritize selling them to us at the Ten Thousand Goods Immortal Trip," the chubby steward implored.
"Of course," Yuan Ming readily agreed.
"Apart from the high-grade spirit wood, there are some other spiritual materials I wish to buy today. Manager Cao, could you please check if the store has them?" He then took out a Jade Scroll and handed it over, listing the materials needed to refine the Moon God Ring, excluding Snow Jade, Moon Cold Core, and Heavenly Star Sand.
"These are all precious spiritual materials, Elder Wan. Please wait a moment while I check," the chubby steward said, taking the Jade Scroll with quick steps.
Yuan Ming quietly sipped tea, waiting for nearly an hour before the chubby steward returned, bringing only five types of Moon God Ring spiritual materials.
In his heart, Yuan Ming felt disappointed, having exhausted almost all his Spirit Stones to pay for them. Without staying long, he promptly bid farewell and left.
The stout steward escorted Yuan Ming all the way to the door, his enthusiasm unwavering.
Yuan Ming walked slowly along the streets of the city, heading towards his residence. He passed by a shop that bought and sold demon beast materials and stepped inside.
Looking at the items displayed on the shelves, Yuan Ming casually asked, "What levels of demon beasts do you accept here?"
"We accept anything above third-level, including the corpse, demon core, and essence blood, with prices varying by type. The higher the level, the higher the price," the shopkeeper said, handing Yuan Ming a price list.
The man looked cunning with his sharp features, but the prices he offered were fair.
Yuan Ming took out the demon beast materials he had accumulated over the years and sold them all, exchanging them for over eight hundred thousand Spirit Stones.
"These demon beasts of yours seem to be sea beasts. Could they be from the Extreme East?" The shopkeeper's enthusiasm increased.
"That's right. The Extreme East is barren, but I heard the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range is rich in spiritual materials and filled with demon beasts, so I came to take a look," Yuan Ming replied.
"You're correct. The Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range is abundant in Spiritual Energy, unlike the remote places such as the Extreme East. Are you planning to become a demon beast hunter?" the shopkeeper inquired.
"Exactly. So, before hunting, I came to inquire about the prices of demon beasts here, which are worth hunting, and which areas of the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range are dangerous, and which are relatively safe?" Yuan Ming nodded and asked.
"Senior, when it comes to that, you've asked the right person. Although our store has limited wealth, it has been passed down from our ancestors and has existed in Yin Mountain City for over a thousand years, making us very familiar with the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range. However, these are precious pieces of information passed down from our ancestors, so you see…" The shopkeeper made a show of reluctance.
Yuan Ming took out a few Mid-grade Spirit Stones and tossed them onto the counter.
"The higher the price for a demon beast, naturally the harder it is to hunt, but there are exceptions for some demon beasts, for instance..." The shopkeeper laughed heartily and began to talk about the various demon beasts within the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range and their activity areas.
Though the shopkeeper spoke confidently, his knowledge of the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range was just average, and the demon beasts he mentioned only inhabited the perimeter of the range, reaching at most level five.
"Shopkeeper, I've heard that there are level six demon beasts deep within the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range. Is this true?" Yuan Ming asked.
"Of course it's true. The depths of the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range are within the territory of the Ten Thousand Demon Country, incredibly dangerous. Even the Returning Void and Dharma manifestation powers rarely return unharmed from there; I advise you not to think about it." The shopkeeper waved his hand repeatedly.
"Ten Thousand Demon Country? Is it a nation formed by the Demon Clan?" This was the first time Yuan Ming heard the name.
"Indeed, the Ten Thousand Demon Country is a power formed by powerful demon clans within the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range. It is said to have countless sixth-level Great Demons and is extremely hostile to the Human Clan's cultivators, killing them on sight. They are notoriously ruthless, and the beast tide that occurs every hundred years in the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range is orchestrated by the Ten Thousand Demon Country." The shopkeeper showed signs of fear.
Yuan Ming's expression grew solemn. He wanted to ask more about the Ten Thousand Demon Country, but seeing that the shopkeeper only knew hearsay and wasn't clear about the place, he had to give up.
"If it's your first time going out to hunt beasts, I suggest you form a team, find someone experienced to accompany you, the chances of success will be greater," the shopkeeper suggested.
"May I ask where I can form a team?" Yuan Ming inquired.
"In this city, any shop that collects demon beasts can arrange team formations. Follow me this way..." The shopkeeper said, leading Yuan Ming to a wall inside the store with a red notice board affixed to it.
Yuan Ming took a closer look and saw it was a reward list, with different types of demon beasts and varying reward amounts.
"Anyone with a target in common and wanting to team up can register here with us. We help connect and form teams. Would you like me to recommend a few reliable hunter partners for you?" the shopkeeper asked cautiously.
"I'll think about it some more." Naturally, Yuan Ming would not really go out of the city to hunt beasts, so he merely said noncommittally.
He didn't linger in the shop and soon took his leave, a slight frown crossing his face.
Without turning back, Yuan Ming could sense that ever since he left the Ten Thousand Goods Immortal Trip, a figure had been tailing him, now once again catching up.
He didn't return directly to his residence but instead gradually moved towards a less populated area.
Upon reaching a deserted alley, Yuan Ming stopped, turned around, and looked behind him.
To his surprise, the person didn't bother hiding and openly appeared before him. It was the dashing silver-haired man he had encountered earlier while drinking mutton soup.
"You..." Yuan Ming was just about to question when the person interrupted him first.
"Fellow Daoist, don't misunderstand. I am Xuan Ye, not one with sinister intentions." The silver-haired man's voice was quite magnetic, his tone steady.
Yuan Ming sized up the silver-haired man, trying to sense his cultivation level, a look of surprise flashing in his eyes.
The person before him had a restrained aura, making it impossible to ascertain his true cultivation level.
...
A friendly recommendation for the work "Knife Cutting Heaven" by the author Shao Ye Bu Tai Leng.
The gods above show no mercy, and monsters run rampant below.
The wavering flame of the Human Clan can never illuminate the world.
So draw the blade...
Slay the gods above, cut down the demons below, and only then shall I, the earthly rogue, be worthy of the butcher's knife in my hand...

chapters.title: Chapter 905 - 875: Each With Their Own Plans
chapters.content:
"Why are you following me?" Yuan Ming asked, seeing that the silver-haired man in front of him showed no signs of making a move, and tried to remain calm.
"Earlier at the Ten Thousand Goods Immortal Trip, I overheard Fellow Daoist trading High Grade Soul Refining Elixirs. I wonder if Fellow Daoist still has any Soul Refining Elixirs?" The silver-haired man clasped his hands in salute, with a quite sincere attitude.
"Are you from the Ten Thousand Goods Immortal Trip?" Yuan Ming frowned.
The business he discussed with that fat steward in the quiet chamber should have been inaudible to outsiders, except for those from the Ten Thousand Goods Immortal Trip themselves.
"I, Xuan, was born with extraordinary hearing. Ordinary restrictions can't block sound from reaching my ears. I assure you it wasn't intentional to overhear Fellow Daoist's secret; it's just that sounds inevitably pass into these ears, and I hope for Fellow Daoist's understanding." The silver-haired man pointed to his own ears and said with a smile.
"Since Fellow Daoist Xuan heard my conversation with Ten Thousand Goods Immortal Trip's steward, you should also know that I no longer have any Soul Refining Elixirs," Yuan Ming said calmly.
"Fellow Daoist Wan, don't be so quick to refuse. I have always believed no transaction is impossible, provided one is willing to pay the adequate price. I noticed you purchased quite a lot of high-level spirit wood from the Ten Thousand Goods Immortal Trip. I wonder if you still need more. I happen to have some." The silver-haired man replied with a smile.
As he spoke, he waved his hand.
A flash of light appeared in the void, revealing more than ten pieces of spirit wood with varying colors. Various Five Elements Attributes instantly emanated from these pieces.
Yuan Ming immediately noticed a light blue piece about three feet long floating in the center, exuding strands of white cold air, causing the surrounding void to be covered with snowflakes and ice crystals.
It was unmistakably a Level 6 piece of Arctic Winter Wood, a rarity.
Besides this Arctic Winter Wood, there was also a Level 6 piece of Red Phoenix Spirit Wood, and it wasn't small.
With these spirit woods, along with what he got from the Ten Thousand Goods Immortal Trip, it would be enough to refine another trace of the Power of Ten Thousand Wood Origin.
"Your spirit wood is not bad. If you agree, I can offer you two High Grade Soul Refining Elixirs for them," Yuan Ming said without revealing any emotion.
"Fellow Daoist, don't try to deceive me. These spirit woods are not only high quality, but also nearly twenty pieces. Even five High Grade Soul Refining Elixirs would be more than enough in exchange," the silver-haired man said in surprise, shaking his head with a helpless laugh.
"First look at the quality of my Soul Refining Elixirs," Yuan Ming said, flicking a finger and sending out a High Grade Soul Refining Elixir, simultaneously drawing the Level 6 Arctic Winter Wood and Red Phoenix Spirit Wood to himself as collateral.
The silver-haired man did not stop him and carefully examined the High Grade Soul Refining Elixir he received. After a moment, he showed a contemplative expression.
"Your High Grade Soul Refining Elixir is indeed excellent quality. Four pieces then, exchange with four." The silver-haired man said.
"Three pieces," Yuan Ming shook his head.
"That's not acceptable..."
"Fellow Daoist, your spirit wood is dispensable to me. Anyway, the spirit wood from the Ten Thousand Goods Immortal Trip is enough for my needs. If the High Grade Soul Refining Elixir is the same for you, then let's part ways as if this never happened, shall we? Or perhaps you could try asking the Ten Thousand Goods Immortal Trip if you can use these spirit woods to exchange for those three elixirs?" Yuan Ming smiled and asked.
In business, if the Ten Thousand Goods Immortal Trip doesn't sell such precious elixirs as the High Grade Soul Refining Elixir for two or three times the purchase price, they'd incur a loss.
The silver-haired man showed a conflicted expression and hesitated for a long time before agreeing.
After the deal was completed, the silver-haired man scratched his head somewhat gloomily, turned, and was about to leave.
Suddenly, Yuan Ming's voice came from behind: "I wonder where Fellow Daoist Xuan resides? What sect or school are you affiliated with? If you have more high-level spirit wood in the future, we can trade for Soul Refining Elixirs again. I'll surely offer you a favorable price next time."
The silver-haired man paused upon hearing this, turned his head, and smiled wryly: "Fellow Daoist Wan really knows how to strike a good bargain. I, Xuan, did a losing deal this time and may be punished upon my return. A second trade seems unlikely."
After saying this, he left without looking back.
Yuan Ming watched the silver-haired man walk away and continued wandering around the city's major shops, inquiring about news of the Ten Thousand Demon Country and purchasing many classics about the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range until nightfall, when he returned to his residence.
He re-arranged restrictions in the room and immediately entered the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space.
Nan Shangfeng was still unconscious under his Illusion Technique control. Yuan Ming checked and found the influence of his Curse was relatively stable, so he relaxed and began meditating with Breathing Control.
An hour later, he took out the high-level spirit wood he bought from the Ten Thousand Goods Immortal Trip and the silver-haired man, transforming into the body of the Undying Tree and began absorbing the Spiritual Power within.
As time slowly passed, when the last piece of spirit wood was completely absorbed, a brand new trace of the Power of Ten Thousand Wood Origin was once again condensed.
Yuan Ming was delighted in his heart; after reverting to human form, he utilized the Ju Mang Spirit Technique, drawing a strand of green light condensed from the Power of Ten Thousand Wood Origin within the World Tree into his body.
As the Power of Ten Thousand Wood Origin circulated within, roaring sounds resonated from his body. His Mana and Qi-Blood began to boil and, under the cleansing of this power, quickly became more refined.
Yuan Ming's heart remained calm; there was no trace of the initial joy he felt as everything was exactly as he anticipated.
He constantly drew upon the Power of Ten Thousand Wood Origin, purifying his own Mana and Qi-Blood.
After a quarter of an hour, the final trace of the Power of Ten Thousand Wood Origin was exhausted. The Mana vortex within his Dantian slowly turned, with no further turmoil, settling into complete calm.
Yuan Ming slowly opened his eyes and exhaled a long breath of turbid air, his eyes showing joy.
To collect high-level spirit wood, he had expended countless thoughts and Spirit Stones, and at last, it was not in vain as he completely solved the problem of Mana turbulence.
Next, all he needed was to safely deliver Nan Shangfeng to Black Tiger City, remove the Curse, and then cultivate the Golden Sunflower Beast Taming Technique and several other Divine Skills to perfection, allowing him to find a Spiritual Energy-rich place for Life and Death Seclusion, so he could attempt the Dharma manifestation Stage.
However, before leaving Yinshan City, there is still a task to complete.
As the thought crossed his mind, Yuan Ming immediately summoned Shura Palace, his figure flickered and entered, arriving at the entrance of a cave mansion in the Black Tower Space.
The cultivator within the cave mansion sensed someone arriving outside and hurriedly flew out—this was Yin Lang.
"Greetings, Lord Nether Moon God."
Inside Shura Palace, apart from praying, the cultivators diligently train.
After years of arduous cultivation, Yin Lang's cultivation level has slightly improved, now approaching the early stage peak of Returning to Void.
"Yin Lang, I captured you and locked you in here for so many years. Do you hold any resentment?" Yuan Ming asked impassively.
"I am wholeheartedly loyal to Lord Nether Moon God and harbor no such thoughts!" Yin Lang quickly replied.
"The methods of a Soul Cultivator are renowned for their mystery, but my techniques are even more formidable than ordinary soul cultivation. Not only can I control the birth and death of Divine Souls, but I can also manipulate your thoughts and memories, even make you forget everything of the past and turn into a puppet devoted to me." Yuan Ming spoke slowly.
Upon hearing this, Yin Lang couldn't help but shudder.
Becoming such a person, completely losing oneself—what difference is there from dying? Maybe even worse than death.
"Over the years, I've refrained from controlling your thoughts. Apart from implanting the Soul Descent Rune, I've not interfered much because I don't want a batch of puppets acting on orders. Now tell me your true thoughts." Yuan Ming looked down at Yin Lang calmly.
"When I was first captured by Lord Nether Moon God, I naturally had resentment, but I later came to understand that the root cause of our capture was greed. Lord Nether Moon God was merely protecting himself. Understanding this, the anger in my heart vanished." Yin Lang hesitated for a long time before speaking.
Using the Emotion Manipulation Divine Ability, Yuan Ming sensed Yin Lang's emotions and asked, "What do you plan for the future?"
"Naturally, to serve Lord Nether Moon God wholeheartedly." Yin Lang replied resolutely.
"Very well, you've passed my test." Yuan Ming nodded.
"Test?" Yin Lang raised his head in surprise.
"Yes, through the questioning just now, I have confirmed your loyalty. There's a mission for you to accomplish." Yuan Ming said.
"Mission? Do you mean leaving here to go outside?" Yin Lang became excited.
Having witnessed Yuan Ming's formidable power, although he decided to submit to Yuan Ming, staying in the monotonous Shura Palace was still too stifling. Going outside would surely be delightful.
Not just him, other cultivators felt the same.
"Yes. I will leave you in Yinshan City in the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range to gather intelligence while secretly developing believers." Yuan Ming said.
"Yes, I will certainly live up to Lord Nether Moon God's expectations!" Yin Lang suppressed his excitement and said.
"Good, prepare yourself. Here is the intelligence of Yinshan City." Yuan Ming handed Yin Lang a jade scroll and swiftly left Shura Palace.
The Stealing Heaven Tripod is gradually recovering, and to utilize this treasure more effectively, believers must be dispersed like on the Yunhuang Continent.
Currently, Yin Lang does not represent absolute loyalty to him. However, considering various factors, there's no one else more suitable in Shura Palace.
Yuan Ming then entered the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space, transferring a strand of Origin Power from the Undying Tree to Nan Shangfeng to help suppress the curse's backlash, and released Yin Lang afterward.
After instructing Yin Lang to act cautiously, Yuan Ming did not linger and hurriedly set off towards Black Tiger City.
...
In the dense forest outside Yinshan City, two figures stood here, one being the silver-haired man Xuan Ye.
The other was entirely cloaked in a black robe, with their true face unseen.
"The timing is about right, let's start the setup." The silver-haired man gazed at the verdant, endlessly vibrant forest around and said slowly.
"Even using this method to break free from the Human Clan's constraints—looks like your Ten Thousand Demon Country is at the end of its line." The black-robed figure laughed gratingly.
"Enough talk, get moving!" The silver-haired man retorted coldly.
The black-robed figure chuckled dryly, ignoring further conversation. He formed a spell with his hands, closing his eyes, as wisps of azure air arose faintly from the top of his skull.
His hands quickly turned jet-black, emitting wisps of black aura.
Egg-sized black spheres emerged from the palms of the black-robed figure, flashing out and melting into the ground.
"Sizzle." Sounds arose, and the surrounding dense forest began to wither rapidly.
(Normal updates will resume tomorrow.)

chapters.title: Chapter 906 - 876: Two Rules
chapters.content:
Half a month later, Black Tiger City.
The towering city walls were heavily guarded, with countless guards in bright silver armor standing atop, staring intently at the mountain forests outside the city.
Compared to Yin Mountain City, Black Tiger City was even more towering and majestic.
At the city gate, several soldiers guarded a Treasure Mirror, scrutinizing each person entering the city and verifying their identities one by one.
Suddenly, a tunneling light swiftly came from the horizon, descending urgently before reaching the city gate, revealing the figures of Yuan Ming and Nan Shangfeng.
"We're finally here. Fellow Daoist Nan, do you know exactly where Master Wu Yu resides?" Yuan Ming looked up at the plaque above the city gate and turned to ask Nan Shangfeng.
"I've only heard that the Master lives in the city; I don't know the exact location," Nan Shangfeng replied somewhat weakly.
After some exploration during this period, the curse within him had been temporarily suppressed by Yuan Ming, allowing him to move like a regular person, but he looked very weary due to the depletion of his Primordial Qi.
Yuan Ming nodded slightly, swept his gaze over the guards in front of the city gate, and quickly walked up.
Just like in Yin Mountain City, entering Black Tiger City also required handling an entry pass, divided into long-term and short-term categories.
"Seems like the nineteen cities of the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range all have similar practices," Yuan Ming silently noted, spending twenty thousand Spirit Stones on two short-term entry passes.
This expense naturally came from the wealthy Nan Shangfeng.
"Excuse me, Fellow Daoist, have you ever heard of Master Wu Yu? Where does he live in the city?" Yuan Ming cupped his hands toward the tall guard beside the Treasure Mirror and asked.
"You've asked the right person. Master Wu Yu's residence is in Nine Curves Lane. After entering the city, head west, and you'll soon see it. It's the one with two Three-eyed Lion statues," the tall guard raised his hand and pointed Yuan Ming in the direction.
"Thank you." Yuan Ming expressed his gratitude and was about to enter the city when he was stopped again by this guard.
"Hold on, Fellow Daoist. If I may ask, did you come from Yin Mountain City?" the tall guard inquired somewhat apologetically.
"Why do you ask that?" Yuan Ming was momentarily stunned and inquired without showing his thoughts.
"A few days ago, I was fortunate enough to meet Master Wu Yu once. I did a small favor for the Master, who then pointed out that I would meet a noble from Yin Mountain City today who would ask me for directions, and that a fortuitous encounter awaited me," the guard explained.
"Did the Master really say that?" A hint of surprise flashed in Yuan Ming's eyes.
"Of course! Master Wu Yu's reputation is famous. How could I tarnish his name with such lies?" The guard said confidently.
"I see, but to disappoint you, my friend, I am not from Yin Mountain City," Yuan Ming's thoughts raced, and he shook his head in denial.
"Is that so? Looks like that noble hasn't arrived yet, my apologies for bothering you," the tall guard said apologetically, looking towards the cultivators behind, seemingly searching for that so-called noble.
Evidently, the tall guard held firm belief in Master Wu Yu's guidance.
"Though somewhat nosy, I'm quite curious, what is this fortuitous encounter you mentioned?" Yuan Ming did not leave, instead asking.
"Nothing much. Half a year ago, I was swindled into buying this item, losing half of my family's savings. Master Wu Yu said that the noble I meet today will buy it from me at a high price," the tall guard looked at Yuan Ming in surprise, taking out a Silver Crystal Stone.
The item was crystal-clear and very beautiful, yet emitted little energy wave.
"This is..." Yuan Ming's eyes slightly widened.
This item was none other than the Moon Cold Core needed to refine the Moon God Ring.
Senior Kong had just mentioned recently that he would help him find this item, and now it had appeared. Could everything have been orchestrated by Kong? But then, what was Master Wu Yu's role?
"Senior Kong, is this your doing?" Yuan Ming queried Senior Kong in his mind but received no response.
He furrowed his brow and after quickly weighing his options, said to the tall guard, "This item doesn't appear particularly special, but since Master Wu Yu has prophesied about it, this Crystal Stone must be extraordinary. Would you be willing to sell it to me? I'm willing to offer fifty thousand Spirit Stones."
"Sell it to you? But Master Wu Yu said to sell it to the noble from Yin Mountain City..." The tall guard was greatly tempted but remained hesitant.
"I have some understanding of prophecy. So-called prophecy is about foreseeing trends in the future, not a set outcome. The real future has endless possibilities; what Master Wu Yu said is just one among many, not without variability," Yuan Ming raised his hand and said.
"You... oh no, Senior, are also versed in prophetic divine skills, but..." The tall guard still hesitated.
"The day is getting late, and today will soon pass. If you hesitate any longer, you'll miss this great opportunity," Yuan Ming said, turning as if to leave.
"Alright, I'll sell it to Senior," the tall guard hurriedly called out to stop Yuan Ming, handing over the Silver Crystal Stone.
Yuan Ming was about to take out the Spirit Stones, but Nan Shangfeng beside him was quicker, producing a Storage Bag and handing it to the tall guard.
Yuan Ming nodded his thanks to Nan Shangfeng, then fell silent, wordlessly heading toward Master Wu Yu's residence.
"Yuan, you really are quite the deceiver," Kong's voice suddenly rang out.
"Just a small trick of necessity, Senior. What were you up to just now?" Yuan Ming transmitted a message to ask.
"It's been a long time since I've encountered someone good at prophecy. I just went to deduce that Wu Yu for a while. That Moon Cold Core is fine; you can receive it with peace of mind," Kong replied with a chuckle.
"Senior Kong, you are indeed proficient in prophetic divine skills. Could it be that you have already discerned Wu Yu's origins?" Yuan Ming pursued.
"Naturally, but you need not know," Kong's voice was emotionless.
"If Wu Yu has figured out that I need the Moon Cold Core, could he have deduced everything about me?" Yuan Ming asked with a frown.
He harbored many secrets, and having them deduced by someone else could spell disaster.
"Rest assured, that Wu Yu only deduced that someone would buy the Moon Cold Core at a high price; he doesn't know about your other matters," Kong said.
Hearing this, Yuan Ming secretly breathed a sigh of relief.
Before long, Yuan Ming and Nan Shangfeng saw the residence with the three-eyed stone lion statues at its entrance. The main gate was tightly closed, and there were no door attendants to welcome guests, presenting a cold and desolate appearance.
Beside the residence stood a three-story tea house, bustling with many guests inside, giving it a lively atmosphere.
Yuan Ming arrived in front of Master Wu Yu's residence, just thinking of knocking when the host welcoming guests outside the tea house stepped up first.
"Are the two seniors here to see Master Wu Yu?" The host bowed and asked.
"Indeed. Could it be that this tea house is not owned by Master Wu Yu?" Yuan Ming nodded and glanced at him.
"Oh no, we wouldn't dare claim such a connection. Our proprietor merely received favors and guidance from Master Wu Yu, allowing us to open this tea house here, solely to provide a waiting place for seniors who come in admiration. It's not claimed as Master Wu Yu's property," the host hurriedly waved his hands.
"Since it's for waiting, it seems Master Wu Yu does not meet guests all the time," Yuan Ming mused.
"Naturally, Master Wu Yu always adheres to two rules when meeting guests. I was about to explain to the seniors, but the street is chilly, so may I invite the seniors inside, where we can serve Spiritual Tea and slowly explain," the host gestured with an inviting hand.
Yuan Ming nodded slightly and entered the tea house with Nan Shangfeng.
The tea house was not large, with most tables and chairs placed by windows. About twenty to thirty guests were inside, sipping tea slowly, occasionally glancing outside to the main gate of Master Wu Yu's residence, otherwise remaining silent.
These guests had profound cultivation, among them were several Returning Void Cultivators.
The host led Yuan Ming to a tea table on the second floor. Before he could order, someone promptly came with a Purple Nan Tea Pot, followed by maids carrying trays of fruit.
In no time, Yuan Ming's table was filled with fruits for enjoyment, and the tea in his cup was fragrant, instantly refreshing, clearly an expensive high-grade Spiritual Tea.
With Yuan Ming's current wealth, such trivial delicacies didn't mean much. However, he noticed that other cultivators' tables weren't as lavish, causing him some confusion.
"Senior needn't worry, these are complimentary from our store. Master Wu Yu once advised our proprietor that first-time visiting guests should be treated with utmost hospitality," the host warmly explained.
"I see, many thanks to Master Wu Yu then," Yuan Ming raised his cup and gestured towards the neighboring residence.
"You just mentioned that Master Wu Yu has two rules for meeting guests. Specifically, what are these two rules?" Nan Shangfeng sipped the Spiritual Tea and eagerly asked about the main matter.
"Master Wu Yu values fate above all. Hence, the first rule is that the days for meeting guests are not fixed and are determined solely by Master Wu Yu's divination. Sometimes, he comes out daily; other times, he isn't seen for decades. No matter who visits, they must wait patiently," the host explained.
Yuan Ming's brows knitted tightly upon hearing this. A decade might not be long for a Returning Void Cultivator, but given Nan Shangfeng's situation, such a wait was untenable.
Nan Shangfeng's face turned somewhat sullen upon hearing these words.
At this moment, the tea house suddenly became lively. A multitude of cultivators stood up enthusiastically, hurrying toward the outside.
"Seniors are indeed fortunate; having just arrived, you've coincidentally encountered Master Wu Yu opening his residence to guests," the host immediately congratulated.
Yuan Ming and Nan Shangfeng also stood up and looked outside.
They saw the main gate of Master Wu Yu's residence slightly open, and a silver-haired man emerged, surveying the surroundings before cupping his hands towards the crowd of cultivators.
Yuan Ming's pupils suddenly contracted, as the silver-haired man was none other than the mysterious figure Xuan Ye, whom he had previously traded with in Yin Mountain City.
"Everyone, I won't say much. You all know the rules. If your secret technique is ready, please hand it over to me. I'm only waiting for thirty minutes," Xuan Ye announced loudly.
"Senior, this is the second rule. Master Wu Yu enjoys collecting various divine power secret techniques. All who visit must present a secret technique for Master Wu Yu to review. Only those that catch his eye may request an audience," the host explained opportunistically.
"The more exquisite the secret technique, the more likely it is to be noticed by Master Wu Yu?" Yuan Ming stared deeply at Xuan Ye and asked.
"Not necessarily. Master Wu Yu's second rule also considers fate. Last time, a Core Formation Stage Cultivator gained an audience with a common secret technique. However, fate is elusive, so seniors who come to pay respects usually present exquisite secret techniques," the host said.

chapters.title: Chapter 907 - 877: Losing Composure
chapters.content:
"I've got three secret techniques here, all of which are exclusive transmissions of the Daluo Sect." Nan Shangfeng took out three jade scrolls and handed them over.
Yuan Ming swept his Divine Sense over the three jade scrolls and discovered that one was called Heart of Ice, an ice attribute secret technique, another was Invisible Escape, an earth attribute escape technique, and the last one was Wanxiang Wind Spirit, a wind attribute attack divine ability.
Although these three would be considered quite exquisite cultivation techniques in the outside world, they might not necessarily catch Wu Yu's eye.
"Let me do it instead." Yuan Ming took out a jade scroll and began to inscribe the essentials of the Heavenly Destiny Skill.
While inscribing the essentials, he inquired with the servant about Xuan Ye's identity. The servant knew little about Xuan Ye, only that Xuan Ye was the steward of Master Wu Yu's residence.
Master Wu Yu never appears publicly and handles all miscellaneous affairs through Xuan Ye.
Yuan Ming nodded and quickly finished writing the Heavenly Destiny Skill, leaving his name, and then handed the jade scroll to the servant.
"Please help deliver this."
The servant replied affirmatively, quickly ran out of the teahouse, and handed Yuan Ming's jade scroll to Xuan Ye.
After listening, Xuan Ye looked up and his gaze happened to meet Yuan Ming's, displaying a hint of surprise. He nodded slightly before quickly averting his gaze.
Soon, thirty minutes passed, and Xuan Ye finished counting the jade scrolls handed over by everyone and turned to enter the residence.
Outside the house, everyone appeared quite anxious, with some pacing about nervously.
Yuan Ming and Nan Shangfeng also came outside but did not join in, standing on the outskirts of the crowd.
"Fellow Daoist Wan, is your secret technique sufficient to gain an audience with Master Wu Yu? What if it fails?" Nan Shangfeng asked anxiously.
"If it doesn't work, we'll think of another way." Yuan Ming responded calmly.
The Heavenly Destiny Skill is also a divination secret method. As long as Master Wu Yu doesn't know it, it should pique his interest.
An hour later, the residence gate reopened, and Xuan Ye came out.
"Mr. Xuan Ye, what does Master Wu Yu say?"
"Did Master have any favorites today?"
The cultivators outside immediately approached eagerly with expectant expressions.
"Please, everyone, be patient, Master was impressed by one secret technique today." Xuan Ye said calmly.
As he spoke, his gaze drifted towards Yuan Ming, standing outside the crowd.
"Fellow Daoist Wan, Master Wu Yu awaits you." Xuan Ye said, cupping his hands.
The crowd turned their eyes towards Yuan Ming and Nan Shangfeng, faces full of confusion, shock, envy, and other complex emotions.
Yuan Ming, as if expecting this, nodded slightly and slowly stepped forward.
Nan Shangfeng suppressed the excitement in his heart and followed behind Yuan Ming.
He hadn't truly been honest with Yuan Ming earlier; years ago, he had come here with another person, waiting for over two years and offering secret techniques three times to meet Master Wu Yu, all ending in failure.
Unexpectedly, Yuan Ming's seemingly casual action had secured an audience with Master Wu Yu.
Watching Yuan Ming's back, Nan Shangfeng's gaze was complicated, his resolve further deepening.
Under the envious and slightly jealous gazes of the cultivators, the two followed Xuan Ye into the residence.
"Fellow Daoist Xuan Ye, I wouldn't have thought we'd meet again in Black Tiger City just after half a month." Yuan Ming said with a smile.
"Indeed, had I known Fellow Daoist Wan would come to Black Tiger City, we could have traveled together that day." Without outsiders present, Xuan Ye shed his cold demeanor and smiled.
"Brother Wan, you know each other?" Nan Shangfeng inquired through voice transmission, addressing Yuan Ming more familiarly.
"Yes, we met once in Yin Mountain City." Yuan Ming replied briefly, glancing at Nan Shangfeng.
Embarrassed, Nan Shangfeng scratched his head and stopped speaking.
"I didn't realize that Fellow Daoist Xuan Ye was with Master Wu Yu. Could those Soul Refining Elixirs be for Master Wu Yu? If so, I have two more, willing to offer them both to Master Wu Yu." Yuan Ming continued conversing with Xuan Ye, taking out a white porcelain bottle.
"Thank you for your kindness, Fellow Daoist Wan. Those Soul Refining Elixirs are needed by someone else, unrelated to Master Wu Yu." Xuan Ye shook his head and replied.
Aiming to probe about Master Wu Yu, Yuan Ming actively engaged in conversation, but Xuan Ye was reluctant to elaborate, responding with laughs and maintaining a smile.
The two continued walking into the residence, bypassing a picturesque garden, until they arrived before a bamboo pavilion.
"Master Wu Yu is inside, but please, Fellow Daoist Wan, enter alone for the meeting." Xuan Ye said as his gaze fell upon Nan Shangfeng.
"Fellow Daoist Xuan Ye, your cultivation is profound, I believe you can see the peculiarity of my friend. To be honest, I, Yuan Ming, have come to visit Master Wu Yu today precisely to resolve his issue." Yuan Ming cupped his hands in greeting.
Xuan Ye examined Nan Shangfeng a few more times, then silently stepped aside.
"Thank you." Yuan Ming expressed gratitude, pushed the door open, and walked in, his expression suddenly freezing.
In the bamboo pavilion, a girl who looked only sixteen or seventeen sat quietly behind a square table.
Her appearance was beautiful, as if she walked out from a painting, with fine brows and pink lips delineated like brush strokes, jade-like skin and a complexion sculpted from ice and snow. Though she wore no makeup, her natural beauty was captivating, making it hard for others to avert their gaze.
At that moment, she was lifting her hands to brew tea, her light green silk dress gently fluttering with her movements, and the white gauze over her shoulders shimmered like moonlight, lightly floating, and without a speck of dust.
She sensed Yuan Ming and his companion entering, her clear eyes slightly lifted, gaze falling on Yuan Ming with a clarity as if wanting to see through him completely.
"Fellow Daoist Wan has arrived, please sit." She smiled, putting down her teacup and gracefully gesturing for Yuan Ming and his companion to take a seat.
Nan Shangfeng, upon seeing the girl in the green dress, stood there as if struck by thunder, with his soul seemingly transported to the clouds above.
Seeing Nan Shangfeng like this, Yuan Ming knew his old problem had resurfaced, and he coughed lightly, channeling a trace of soul power.
Nan Shangfeng's Divine Soul trembled, he came to, yet his eyes still fixated on the girl, displaying a look of obsession.
Yuan Ming sighed inwardly and activated the All Living Beings Dream Seal.
Nan Shangfeng's vision blurred and he appeared in a misty space.
"Illusion Space? Brother Wan, is this your doing?" Nan Shangfeng immediately returned to his senses, shouting at the surroundings.
"Fellow Daoist Nan, our visit today must not lack etiquette." Yuan Ming's voice echoed within the white space.
"Brother Wan, you don't understand, this is true emotion, meeting a beloved woman, one must express it boldly! Today I finally understand what it means to have a beautiful person, one who sees and can't forget, even a day apart makes one think madly..." Nan Shangfeng was assailed by his own feelings.
"What true emotions, you are truly lustful..." Yuan Ming couldn't help but roll his eyes inwardly.
"Fellow Daoist Nan, the matter at hand is of utmost importance, if you anger Master Wu Yu and get us expelled, what about your curse?" he reminded.
"Brother Wan, you have no woman you desire, you don't understand my feelings right now, I'm exceedingly sure that Miss Wu Yu is my destined one! For her, what fear is death, let me out quickly! Don't delay my great marriage!" Nan Shangfeng urgently shouted, seeming to disregard life and death, releasing his Divine Sense to fiercely impact the illusion space.
However, the illusion space formed by the All Living Beings Dream Seal was beyond what Nan Shangfeng could break, no matter how he assaulted, the white space did not even ripple.
"You should calm down here." Yuan Ming, speechless, transmitted a voice and ceased paying attention to Nan Shangfeng.
In the reality of the bamboo pavilion, Nan Shangfeng was motionless, his expression vacant, akin to a stone statue.
"Fellow Daoist Wan has quite an impressive Illusion Technique." The girl in the green dress smiled graciously, as if all flowers in bloom, the light within the bamboo pavilion seemed brighter.
Yuan Ming secretly marveled at the girl's charm, waved his sleeve, and stored Nan Shangfeng into the Shura Palace, bowing to the girl: "The illusion is but a trifling matter, Fellow Daoist overpraises me, my friend is uncouth, I beg you not to mind."
"It is human nature, Fellow Daoist Wan please sit." The girl slightly shook her head.
"Though it may be presumptuous, I wish to confirm, you are indeed Master Wu Yu?" Yuan Ming hesitated slightly, but still asked.
"Fellow Daoist Wan doesn't think so?" The girl in the green dress poured Yuan Ming a cup of Spiritual Tea.
Yuan Ming indeed didn't expect Wu Yu to be such a girl, everyone referred to her as a master, he thought she would be an elderly person with immortal demeanor, unexpectedly, she's a young maiden.
"The master's nobility is above me. I have judged wrongly." Yuan Ming did not decline, sat across the girl, accepted the teacup from her, and took a small sip.
Wu Yu also lifted her teacup, took a gentle sip, her clear eyes examining Yuan Ming.
"Did master foresee I would come?" Yuan Ming took a small sip.
"Why does Fellow Daoist Wan think so?" Wu Yu smiled and countered.
"The city gate guards got a prophecy from you, the teahouse owner outside gave extra care, surely not just because I'm a new guest, and the Fellow Daoist Xuan Ye who guided us here recently sought me out in Yin Mountain City, buying several Soul Refining Elixirs from me. Once, twice might still be coincidence, yet I encountered three times, is there truly such coincidence in the world?" Yuan Ming's smile carried a hint of playfulness.
Wu Yu's willow brows slightly furrowed, as if pondering over who Yuan Ming was referring to, and moments later revealed a sense of realization.
"I see, Fellow Daoist Wan may have misunderstood, the prophecy I gave them was merely concerning their own affairs, not expecting the prophesied person to be solely you." Wu Yu explained.
"Master means, you did not foresee today's events?" Yuan Ming carefully chose his words.
"The future is elusive, we cultivators, no matter how adept in prophecy, can at best glimpse a corner of the future, and cannot see the full picture. Even if I can predict some traits of a person's noble one, I ultimately cannot truly discern their identity." Wu Yu gently shook her head, further clarifying.
"So, master's Art of Prophecy excels at predicting others' destined noble ones? Some time ago, I met a Prophet who specialized in forecasting calamities." Yuan Ming relaxed internally and said.
"Every Prophet, due to differing fates, varying cultivation techniques, naturally excels in different fields." Wu Yu slowly explained to Yuan Ming.
"I see, I have learned much." Yuan Ming nodded thoughtfully.

chapters.title: Chapter 908 - 878: Seeking Guidance
chapters.content:
"It's just some superficial insights. Since Fellow Daoist Wan could present a divination secret technique as high-level as the Heavenly Destiny Skill, you must have your own understanding of the Dao of causality. I wonder if you could discuss it with me?" Wu Yu took the opportunity to invite.
"Master overestimates me. The Heavenly Destiny Skill was acquired from a friend of mine, who might have some insights on this Dao. Although I've comprehended it for many years, I've still yet to enter its doors and dare not show off." Yuan Ming quickly shook his head.
"In that case, I wonder if Fellow Daoist Wan could act as a mediator and introduce me to this friend of yours? I'm really curious about the origin of the Heavenly Destiny Skill and have many questions to ask her." Wu Yu looked at Yuan Ming, his eyes shining with strange light.
Yuan Ming suddenly realized that after all Wu Yu had said, this was his purpose.
"Apologies, that friend is far from the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range and might not be able to meet you, Fellow Daoist. As for the origin of the Heavenly Destiny Skill, she once mentioned it was obtained from some ruins, but she probably doesn't remember the exact location." Yuan Ming decisively extinguished Wu Yu's investigative thoughts.
Wu Yu also realized Yuan Ming's intentions, merely sighed, and silently sat back down.
"Even though that friend can't come, I will definitely convey to Master after that and ask her to come and meet Master." Yuan Ming added.
"In that case, I thank Fellow Daoist Wan. Since our cultivation levels are similar, there's no need to use the title 'Master'; addressing each other as fellow daoists is sufficient." Wu Yu rose and bowed respectfully.
"Then, with your permission, I will overstep. Actually, the reason I'm here isn't to ask you to divine the future but because a friend of mine has been hit by an extremely advanced curse. I wanted to see if Master could help remove it. I wonder if Fellow Daoist Wu has any expertise in this area?" Yuan Ming hastily rose to return the greeting and then retrieved Nan Shangfeng's body from the Shura Palace.
Nan Shangfeng's expression was no longer dazed, freed from the illusion, and he appeared quite different, looking at Wu Yu with extraordinary calm.
He couldn't help but be calm; he had spent decades in that white space, and any emotional turmoil had dried up.
A hint of surprise flashed through Wu Yu's eyes, then he said indifferently, "Very well, but I need to first examine this fellow daoist to make a diagnosis. I can't promise a solution."
"Master just do your best." Nan Shangfeng said weakly.
Wu Yu approached Nan Shangfeng, placed a hand on his wrist, and carefully examined him with Divine Sense.
"This is the Seven Evil Heart Curse. It seems your friend has provoked quite a formidable enemy." After a while, Wu Yu withdrew his hand, looking somewhat grave.
"The Seven Evil Heart Curse? I've never heard of it." Yuan Ming frowned and said.
"This is a Blood Robe Tower curse technique. Blood Robe Tower has been gone for many years, so it's not surprising Fellow Daoist Wan hasn't heard of it." Wu Yu replied.
"Blood Robe Tower..." Yuan Ming was stirred internally.
Nan Shangfeng had mentioned that the Evil Curse Altar was once a prized treasure of the Blood Robe Tower, and Hei Lian had spent a fortune to bid on it. Could Hei Lian be a remnant of the Blood Robe Tower?
"Since Fellow Daoist Wu knows this curse, do you have a method to dispel it?" Yuan Ming collected his thoughts and asked.
"Curse techniques are troublesome but not without solutions. However, the solution can't be found here. Fellow Daoist Wan must take him with me to a certain place in the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range and use the power of the spirit vein there to break the curse." Wu Yu pondered briefly and offered a solution.
"Using the spirit vein of Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range? What for?" Yuan Ming was puzzled.
"Fellow Daoist Wan may not know, but curses are actually divine skills formed by utilizing the malicious intent and resentful energy between heaven and earth. Today, the population in the Cultivation World is vast, and mortal humans abound. Resentful energy is now omnipresent, so those afflicted with a curse have nowhere to hide; even if they flee to the edge of the sky, they will eventually be invaded by resentful energy. To cut off the influence of this energy, one must rely on power of the same attribute." Wu Yu explained.
"The power of the same attribute, might Fellow Daoist Wu be referring to Desire Power?" Yuan Ming speculated.
"Exactly. It's so easy talking with Fellow Daoist Wan. You might not know, but within the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range lies the Heavenly Crane Array, rooted in underground spirit veins, with nineteen cities as its hub, used to suppress the fortune of the Demon Clan there. For tens of thousands of years, the cultivators of these nineteen cities have unconsciously offered their gratitude and prayers, accumulating an astonishing amount of Desire Power within the Heavenly Crane Array. Flowing alongside the spirit veins, it can be used to break the Seven Evil Heart Curse. I happen to know a place where the spirit veins converge, where the Desire Power is abundant, making it convenient for casting." Wu Yu explained.
Hearing this, Yuan Ming suddenly understood, realizing that Desire Power existed within the Heavenly Crane Array.
"Aside from external assistance, is there no personal way to break the curse?" he asked.
"There is, but one would have to rely solely on their own soul power to gradually erode it, and this option is only viable if one's Divine Soul Power surpasses that of the spell-caster. Your friend likely won't be able to do it." Wu Yu continued.
Yuan Ming recalled how he had once worn down Wu Yue's Divine Curse Killing Technique, secretly feeling fortunate. It was good that he had the Stealing Heaven Tripod back then, drawing upon its Desire Power to continually mend his Divine Soul. Otherwise, he could not have sought out a master like Wu Yu to save him.
"As long as there's a solution, it's all good. I wonder if the mountain peak you mentioned is far, Fellow Daoist Wu? When can we set off?" Yuan Ming returned to his senses and asked again.
"It's not far; traveling from Black Tiger City takes less than ten days to reach. However, I need to prepare some instruments I will use, which will take about five days before we can depart." Wu Yu said, taking out a map of the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range and showing its location to Yuan Ming.
"Alright, I'll visit in five days then." Yuan Ming said, getting up to leave.
"Thank you, Master Wu, this kindness South Shangfeng will never forget." Nan Shangfeng also stood, giving Wu Yu a solemn bow.
"If you two fellow daoists don't mind, you can stay at my residence for a few nights to prevent anything unexpected from happening." Wu Yu offered.
"Very well, then I will trouble Fellow Daoist Wu." Yuan Ming glanced back at Nan Shangfeng, saw that he had no objections, and agreed.
"No problem, Xuan Ye, come in, and take two Fellow Daoists to the guest rooms to rest." Wu Yu smiled and waved his hand, then called in the silver-haired man guarding outside.
...
That night, when the night was deep and quiet, the bright moon hung high.
Yuan Ming sat alone in the guest room, quietly gazing at the moonlight, contemplating future plans.
In the room next to him, Nan Shangfeng sat cross-legged on the bed, silently cultivating, relying on his own mana and the demonic power infused by Yuan Ming, continuing to suppress the onset of the curse.
Suddenly, Yuan Ming sensed something unusual.
"What is this..." He looked up at the void, threads of Desire Power converging from all directions, gathering towards Wu Yu's bamboo pavilion.
Soul Cultivators and Magic Practitioners are different; without deliberately revealing their aura, it is difficult for ordinary people to discern their cultivation level, so when Yuan Ming met during the day, he only discovered that Wu Yu was a mid-stage Returning Void cultivator.
However, the silver-haired cultivator Xuan Ye had specifically sought out Yuan Ming in Yin Mountain City to purchase Soul Pills, so Yuan Ming guessed that Wu Yu also practiced Soul Cultivation, though he was unclear about the specific cultivation level. But now, seeing her absorbing Desire Power, he was not surprised.
Yuan Ming had never seen other Soul Cultivators absorb Desire Power and was quite curious, watching the bamboo pavilion from afar, soon showing a look of astonishment.
The situation of Wu Yu absorbing Desire Power was completely different from his own, as the Desire Power gathering over the bamboo pavilion slowly divided into seven distinct streams.
Each stream of Desire Power gave Yuan Ming a different feeling, varying somewhat in type—some were joyful, some angry, and others fearful, among others.
Yuan Ming suddenly remembered that Kong had once said Desire Power could be purified. Could this be what he meant?
Yuan Ming pondered in the direction of the bamboo pavilion for a moment, then stood up and left the room, once again arriving at the bamboo pavilion.
"Master is cultivating." Xuan Ye was still standing guard outside the bamboo pavilion, surprised to see Yuan Ming approaching, but still stepped forward to block him.
"Though it is somewhat presumptuous, might I ask Fellow Daoist Xuan Ye to notify within, that I have an important matter to discuss?" Yuan Ming cupped his hands.
Xuan Ye's face showed even more surprise, yet he still shook his head, just about to speak.
"It's alright, Xuan Ye, let Fellow Daoist Wan in." At this moment, Wu Yu's voice came from within the bamboo pavilion, and the Desire Power swirling above quickly dissipated.
Xuan Ye couldn't help but frown but still did not go against Wu Yu's wishes, stepping aside to make way.
Wu Yu, as during the day, sat poised by the table in the bamboo pavilion.
"Fellow Daoist visiting at such a late hour, could it be that your friend is experiencing a new situation?" Wu Yu asked as Yuan Ming entered the bamboo pavilion.
"He is doing well now. I just now saw Desire Power gathering outside Fellow Daoist's room, the situation seeming quite different from my usual experience, so I came to inquire, if there is any disturbance, please forgive me." Yuan Ming stated straightforwardly.
"No problem, feel free to speak of anything you do not understand." Wu Yu was exceptionally amiable.
"You can probably see that I also practice Soul Cultivation, having now reached the Realm of Word Witch, and have established a sect outside, collecting significant Desire Power daily. However, this Desire Power is mixed and indistinguishable, unlike the clear separation by Fellow Daoist. Is there some method to this?" Yuan Ming candidly stated his situation.
"Are you speaking of differentiating the Power of Seven Emotions? It seems that you have not received formal Soul Cultivation inheritance, lacking knowledge in this area, so I'll start from the beginning." Wu Yu nodded knowingly.
Yuan Ming was momentarily stunned, as such insight was extremely precious. He had come over merely for a slight guidance from Wu Yu.
Even so, he had prepared several precious items as payment, but who knew that Wu Yu was so open-minded, directly sharing with no request in return.
While Yuan Ming was in a daze, Wu Yu had already continued speaking.
"Since Fellow Daoist has also established a sect and collects Desire Power, you should know, in essence, Desire Power is a new force born from the integration of Soul Power and emotions, thus it can be absorbed and refined by us, transforming into part of our Divine Soul Power."
Yuan Ming nodded.
"In today's world, human emotions are divided according to the Seven Emotions, namely joy, anger, sorrow, fear, love, evil, and desire; the emotions contained in Desire Power are likewise." Wu Yu used his finger as a pen, writing seven small characters in mid-air with Spiritual Power.
"I see, but what is the significance of differentiating Desire Power according to the Seven Emotions? Desire Power, unlike Moonlight Power, has substantial drawbacks when absorbed directly." Yuan Ming stated.

chapters.title: Chapter 909 - 879: The Seven Emotions
chapters.content:
"Fellow Daoist Wan, you don't even know the method to condense the Outer Soul? It seems your soul cultivation inheritance is seriously lacking." Wu Yu expressed surprise.
"I stumbled upon a soul cultivation classic years ago, which led me down this path. As for the method of the Outer Soul, I truly know nothing about it," Yuan Ming replied honestly.
Wu Yu fell silent for a moment, performed a hand spell, and a white light flashed across her body. An identical clone of herself appeared out of thin air.
Yuan Ming focused his gaze and let out a surprised sound.
This clone was not condensed by mana but was formed by Desire Power, exuding Soul Power fluctuations reaching the Late Stage of Word Witch.
"What Fellow Daoist Wan just said is correct. Desire Power cannot be directly absorbed to enhance Soul Power; it can only be used externally. This application is the method of the Outer Soul. This Outer Soul avatar is merely one of many Outer Soul Divine Skills. However, to condense the Outer Soul, Desire Power must first be divided. Otherwise, with unstable Desire Power, any Outer Soul method is merely wishful thinking." Wu Yu waved her sleeve, and the clone merged back into her body.
"I see, thank you, Fellow Daoist Wu, for your guidance." Yuan Ming's eyes flashed with contemplation, and he sincerely expressed his gratitude.
He finally understood what the body formed by the Vow Power Pill was—it must also be some kind of Outer Soul avatar Divine Skill.
Ku certainly knew about the method of the Outer Soul, but he had never shared it with him. However, considering Ku's stingy nature of demanding rewards for anything, it was not surprising that he didn't voluntarily inform him.
"Additionally, only when mastery over the Power of Seven Emotions reaches the point of dividing Desire Power can one sense the existence of the Three Souls and Seven Spirits and lay the foundation for breaking through to Life Witch," Wu Yu continued.
"Three Souls and Seven Spirits? Breaking through to Life Witch?" Yuan Ming froze again.
"To break through to Life Witch is not just about accumulating Soul Power; the Three Souls and Seven Spirits must be refined. The Three Souls govern life, the Seven Spirits govern emotion. The Seven Spirits in humans are Joy Spirit, Anger Spirit, Sadness Spirit, Fear Spirit, Love Spirit, Hatred Spirit, and Desire Spirit. Without sufficient mastery over the Power of Seven Emotions, the existence of the Seven Spirits cannot be sensed, let alone refined." Wu Yu looked at Yuan Ming with helplessness and spoke again.
"Refining the Seven Spirits... No wonder Fellow Daoist Wu's emotional power is extraordinarily stable. Have you already started refining the Seven Spirits?" Yuan Ming looked at Wu Yu.
Ever since meeting Wu Yu, he had been covertly using 'Emotion Manipulation' to sense Wu Yu's emotions to judge the truth of her words. However, Wu Yu's emotions were exceptionally calm, like a still ancient well, and he could detect nothing.
"I'm ashamed; I've only refined up to the fourth spirit. There are still three spirits I haven't started on," Wu Yu shook her head and chuckled lightly.
"Fellow Daoist Wu mentioned only the Seven Spirits. What about the Three Souls? Do they not require refining?" Yuan Ming pursued.
"The Three Souls govern life. Their cultivation can only proceed after reaching Life Witch, so it's not beneficial for Fellow Daoist Wan to know now." Wu Yu shook her head.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming did not inquire further and fell silent.
Wu Yu's guidance practically opened the door to a new world for him, giving him a sense of enlightenment. Had he not heard these words, he wouldn't know how many detours he might have taken.
"I'm deeply grateful for Fellow Daoist Wu's guidance today. Although it may seem presumptuous, I still wish to ask how to improve control over the Power of Seven Emotions to reach the point of dividing Desire Power?" Yuan Ming took a deep breath and asked with a bow.
"Getting hold of a profound Seven Emotions Heart Method will suffice. However, comprehending the Seven Emotions requires exceptional insight. In our Chuyun Realm, there are plenty of Word Witches, but Life Witches are exceedingly rare for this reason." Wu Yu stated directly, without beating around the bush.
"Does Fellow Daoist Wu have any spare Seven Emotions Heart Methods? I have several decent Secret Techniques here, which I'd be willing to exchange with Fellow Daoist." Yuan Ming asked, his heart filled with joy, as he took out several Jade Scrolls in a probing manner.
The Jade Scrolls contained techniques from the Golden Sunflower Heavenly Book, such as the Golden Sunflower Beast Taming Technique, Eyes of Golden Flame, and Transplanting Technique.
The Golden Sunflower Heavenly Book was mysterious and unfathomable, and the Divine Skills recorded on it were considered exquisite techniques even in the Overseas World, more than sufficient to exchange for a Seven Emotions Heart Method.
"No need; if Fellow Daoist Wan is truly inclined to cultivate, I wouldn't be so stingy. Here, take this 'Love Inquiry Technique' and feel free to comprehend it. If there are any unclear aspects, you can ask me at any time." Wu Yu shook her head, declining Yuan Ming's offer, and flipped her right hand to drop a Jade Scroll in front of Yuan Ming.
"The kindness Fellow Daoist Wu has shown today, I will remember." Yuan Ming was taken aback but accepted her favor, collecting the Jade Scroll.
Afterward, Yuan Ming did not disturb further and stood up to bid farewell.
"Your Majesty, wasn't 'Love Inquiry Technique' the Seven Emotions Secret Technique you painstakingly acquired from Bright Moon Palace back then, and now you're giving it away like this?" Xuan Ye entered from outside and asked.
"Say no more, I have my own considerations." Wu Yu took out a Jade Bottle and poured out an elixir, which was precisely the Soul Refining Elixir Yuan Ming had previously sold to Xuan Ye.
"Such pure Desire Power essence can only be refined by the Bright Soul Fire. To think there are two kinds of Heavenly Fire appearing—our Demon Clan's opportunity for liberation is at hand..." she mused, a smile tugging at her lips.
Yuan Ming walked towards his residence while attempting to contact Ku through the Sound Transmission but received no response.
He furrowed his brow slightly; recently, Ku's responses to him had become increasingly perfunctory, often impossible to find, and he didn't know what Ku was up to.
Yuan Ming soon returned to his residence, and suddenly he smelled a fresh clove fragrance, which originated from next-door Nan Shangfeng's room, where there was no sound coming from within.
His heart stirred, and he walked swiftly over, pushing open the door.
Inside, Nan Shangfeng was seated cross-legged on the bed, having lit a short purple incense at some point.
