The smoke from the short incense spread freely in the room, only condensing into a clear human head in front of Nan Shangfeng.
"So, it's agreed. I'll be heading your way with the items now," a slightly deep male cultivator's voice emanated from the "head."
"Cough, cough, okay, do come quickly." Nan Shangfeng was not surprised to see Yuan Ming come in and nodded after indicating to him.
The smoke-condensed head seemed to notice something, rotated in thin air, turning its gaze towards Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming looked at it, vaguely recognizing the handsome features of a young male cultivator.
At that moment, the "head" suddenly shattered, reverting to smoke and dispersing within the room.
"What was that just now?" Yuan Ming asked.
"That was a friend I mentioned last time to Fellow Daoist Wan. I just got in touch with him, and he said he's nearby and will deliver the Innate Bitter Bamboo Leaf I promised in two days." Nan Shangfeng replied.
"Oh, the way Fellow Daoist contacts people is quite unique." Yuan Ming's gaze fell on the short incense in front of Nan Shangfeng.
"This is a Spiritual Communication Incense developed by our Daluo Sect; its effect and communication distance are far better than a Sound Transmission Talisman. However, one incense can only be bound to one person. I've used all I had, and if you need it, you'll have to wait until I return to the Daluo Sect to get you a batch." Nan Shangfeng hurriedly extinguished the incense and then took out a white Eight-sided Treasure Box.
The box was as white as jade, emitting strands of Spiritual Power fluctuations, evidently not an ordinary item.
Nan Shangfeng opened one side of the treasure box to reveal a compartment, storing the short incense inside.
"No problem, I don't need it." Yuan Ming shook his head; he had the Void Communication Array and didn't need other means of communication for now.
Seeing this, Nan Shangfeng didn't say much and continued to channel mana, suppressing the curse power within him.
Yuan Ming injected a surge of Undying Tree Demon Power into Nan Shangfeng's body, then returned to his quarters and took out the Jade Scroll given to him by Wu Yu to study carefully.
The content of the Love Inquiry Technique wasn't long. Besides the opening summary of the seven categories of emotions, there were three mnemonics of only a few hundred words, ranging from shallow to deep, corresponding to the realms "Emotion Detection," "Emotion Control," and "Refining Emotion."
The Love Inquiry Realm allows you to initially sense the power of the seven emotions; the Emotion Control realm is about maneuvering the seven emotions, and only by reaching the Refining Emotion realm can you perfectly manipulate the power of the seven emotions, achieving desire power differentiation, Outer Soul condensation methods, refining the Seven Spirits, and more.
Yuan Ming quickly read through the spell several times, memorizing all the content, and closed his eyes to start cultivation.
Time flew by, with the bright moon outside the window setting and rising, rising and setting again, until the evening of the third day when Yuan Ming finally opened his eyes, revealing a hint of helplessness on his face.
He finally understood at this moment what Wu Yu emphasized about enlightenment truly meant.
In three days, he couldn't even grasp the entry method, unable to comprehend the spell's meaning no matter how he tried, completely at a loss.
This situation clearly indicated a lack of enlightenment.
Yuan Ming was unfazed, having experienced similar situations many times before. With the Stealing Heaven Tripod, there was no need for urgency.
He sensed Nan Shangfeng tirelessly suppressing the curse within him next door, not disturbing him, and directly got up and went outside.
The outside night was deep, moonlight like water illuminating Black Tiger City.
Yuan Ming had no intention of appreciating the moonlight, his gaze shifting over to Wu Yu's bamboo pavilion.
Indeed, there was a gathering of Desire Power there again.
A smile graced Yuan Ming's lips as he called forth the Shura Palace, entered alone, and arrived at the usual cultivation spot, unapologetically taking out the Stealing Heaven Tripod, picking up a piece of Black Incense and lighting it.
Before long, Yuan Ming possessed Wu Yu's body, and as he had anticipated, Wu Yu was cultivating the Love Inquiry Technique.
He wouldn't waste time; he immediately began his insights with Wu Yu's body.
With such close insight from Wu Yu's realm as a soul cultivator, coupled with his already strong foundation, progress was naturally swift; when the possession ended, Yuan Ming had finally elevated the Love Inquiry Technique to the Love Inquiry Realm.
He opened his eyes again, not rushing to get up but silently pondering the insights gained from possession, then activated the Love Inquiry Technique, peering into his Sea of Consciousness to examine his Divine Soul.
The originally colorless Divine Soul, under the effect of the Love Inquiry Technique, showed seven different colors intertwining, impossible to distinguish in quantity, but could vaguely determine that the color representing joy now commanded the dominant position.
He secretly rejoiced that reaching the Love Inquiry Realm indeed allowed sensing the power of the seven emotions. Unexpectedly, the seven emotion powers within his Divine Soul manifested in this manner.

chapters.title: Chapter 910 - 880: Journey to Wanyao
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming observed for a moment, then captured a strand of the desire power that had gathered. He noticed that the color had faded slightly, though it still remained a chaotic mix, indistinguishable in its main qualities.
He tried to separate the desire power, but due to insufficient cultivation of the Love Inquiry Technique, his thoughts were like stones sinking into the sea, receiving no response.
This was expected, so Yuan Ming didn't feel disappointed. He got up and left Shura Palace, heading to his room.
Just then, he suddenly frowned, looked around, but found nothing unusual inside or outside the room.
While puzzled, Yuan Ming's Divine Sense inadvertently sensed a small table placed in front of Nan Shangfeng in the next room.
On the table was a black wooden box, carved with intricate dark red patterns, giving a very mysterious feeling.
Nan Shangfeng was still meditating with his eyes closed, apparently unaware of the wooden box's presence.
Yuan Ming slightly frowned, immediately releasing his Divine Sense to scan the two rooms but found nothing unusual, only a vague feeling that someone was hiding in the room.
With a cold snort in his heart, Yuan Ming formed a spell with his hands, creating a dozen white light rings around him. It was the Circular Light Technique, illuminating everything in both rooms.
Soon, he discovered a faint presence in the southeast corner of Nan Shangfeng's room, nearly merging with the ground, which could have deceived him if not for the perfection of his Circular Light Technique.
Yuan Ming did not act at the scene but instantly appeared in the next room, channeling Soul Power to capture the intruder with a single strike.
"Hey, wait, don't attack, I am—" In the next moment, from the southeast corner, a male cultivator in a deep purple shirt revealed his form.
He seemed to sense Yuan Ming's hostility, but unfortunately, just as he spoke, Yuan Ming made a fierce move, casting the Dream Butterfly Illusion Technique, drawing him directly into an illusion.
"Who are you... Xiang Mingxuan? Fellow Daoist Wan, please hold back, he's one of us." Nan Shangfeng said urgently upon hearing the commotion and opening his eyes, seeing the purple shirted male cultivator.
"One of us?" Yuan Ming questioned, examining the male cultivator's features, and quickly realized he was the one Nan Shangfeng contacted with the Spiritual Communication Incense two days ago.
"Yes, he is my friend, wasn't he supposed to come over to deliver something... Look, it's this wooden box, inside is Innate Bitter Bamboo." Nan Shangfeng said anxiously, his eyes landing on the wooden box on the small table, quickly presenting it to Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming accepted the wooden box and slowly opened it.
In an instant, all the distractions in his mind seemed to dissipate, and a sense of unprecedented peace washed over him, his mind becoming clear, and even his thoughts flowed several times faster than usual.
Looking down, he saw a four-inch long, one-inch wide jade green bamboo leaf, as clear and transparent as glass, unstained by dust.
"Since he's your friend, why was he skulking around, sneaking in?" Yuan Ming asked.
"Sigh, that's Xiang Mingxuan's nature; he claims his Escape Skill and Concealment Technique are unmatched, usually considering himself a chivalrous thief, delighting in infiltrating various sects' forbidden areas to steal treasures for fun, getting constantly hunted because of it. This time, he probably just wanted to pull a prank." Nan Shangfeng laughed bitterly.
"Your friend is quite interesting." Hearing this, Yuan Ming laughed, raising his hand to dissolve the illusion.
"Uh... Nan Shangfeng, where did you find such a ruthless person? With formidable Divine Sense, and such decisive actions." Xiang Mingxuan, having recovered, was startled before snapping back to his senses, looking at Yuan Ming with great trepidation.
"Didn't I tell you? This Fellow Daoist Wan is very powerful; otherwise, he couldn't have saved me from Hei Lian." Nan Shangfeng chuckled proudly.
"How much did you tell him about me?" Yuan Ming frowned and transmitted telepathically to Nan Shangfeng.
"Don't worry, Fellow Daoist Wan, I didn't say a word I shouldn't!" Nan Shangfeng shivered slightly, quickly responding with a smile.
"Fellow Daoist, I haven't seen Nan Shangfeng in a long time, and there's much I wish to discuss with him, so..." Xiang Mingxuan hesitated, apparently gleaning something from Nan Shangfeng's attitude.
Yuan Ming nodded in understanding, turning around to leave the room, giving them space to talk privately.
Since the item had been delivered, his dealings with Nan Shangfeng were largely concluded. Were it not for his curiosity about Wu Yu's method of breaking the curse and wanting to witness it, he could have left on his own.
"Fellow Daoist Wan, did you encounter any trouble just now?" Yuan Ming had just stepped out when he saw Xuan Ye approaching quickly.
Thinking for a moment, Yuan Ming quickly realized that his use of Soul Power to cast illusions might have been detected by Wu Yu, prompting Xuan Ye to investigate.
"It's nothing, just a misunderstanding when a friend of my companion arrived, but it's been resolved." He explained with a smile.
"That's good to hear. We're nearly ready, and we can set off early the day after tomorrow." Xuan Ye nodded in acknowledgment.
Yuan Ming agreed, watching Xuan Ye return to the bamboo pavilion to report.
…
Two days later.
At the crack of dawn, Yuan Ming's door was knocked.
"Fellow Daoist Wan, it's time to set off." Xuan Ye's voice came from outside.
Having waited for some time, Yuan Ming opened the door to find Wu Yu and Xuan Ye standing outside, looking prepared.
Their clothes were also changed to styles more suitable for outdoor activities. Wu Yu, who had previously worn a long gown, now donned brocade garments and long pants, with her waterfall-like long hair tied up high, exhibiting an entirely different and capable aura.
"Isn't Fellow Daoist's new friend coming with us?" Xuan Ye asked as he saw only Yuan Ming and Nan Shangfeng stepping out.
"He has personal matters to handle and won't be traveling with us. He only came to deliver something," Nan Shangfeng explained.
Xuan Ye nodded slightly and glanced at Wu Yu.
"Since that's the case, let us depart immediately," Wu Yu remarked softly, seemingly well aware of the situation.
The group then exited the residence's back door and headed out of the city.
To avoid being surrounded by those who came for her reputation, Wu Yu continually used an illusion technique to conceal herself once outside, preventing anyone from seeing her.
Yuan Ming noticed this and realized that fame sometimes might not always be beneficial.
"This trip isn't far, but the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range is filled with demon beasts. I need to reserve energy to help Fellow Daoist Nan remove the curse. If attacked along the way, I'll trouble Fellow Daoist Wan and Xuan Ye to resolve it," once out of the city, Wu Yu felt somewhat at ease and spoke.
"Of course," Yuan Ming agreed immediately.
"But please know in advance, since you will be traveling with me, spare all lives unless absolutely necessary. If attacked by demon beasts, simply subdue them," Wu Yu paused and advised again.
"Why is that?" Yuan Ming asked, a bit puzzled.
"Heaven naturally favors life, and all things in the world are ultimately equal. Be it humans or demons, even beings of the Demon Clan are merely creatures existing between heaven and earth without much difference. They should coexist peacefully, cease fighting and killing. This is the path of balance," Wu Yu spoke gently, her gaze as clear and sincere as water.
"Since Fellow Daoist Wu says so, I shall comply. If faced with enemies, I'll use illusion techniques to subdue them," Yuan Ming thought Wu Yu's views were too idealistic, yet as he needed her assistance, he refrained from arguing and agreed.
Wu Yu nodded slightly, a subtle smile appeared at the corner of her mouth.
Then the group mounted tunneling light and sped toward the depths of the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range.
...
During the first day or two, aside from encountering some occasional second and third-level demon beasts, there were no other anomalies, and the group advanced quickly.
However, after the third day, the mountains ahead suddenly became sparse, replaced by a tall and dense forest where each tree stood hundreds of meters high, and nature's spiritual energy became abundant.
"Be cautious, up ahead lies the territory of the Wood Xiao Tribe from the Ten Thousand Demon Country," Xuan Ye said.
"Isn't the Ten Thousand Demon Country supposed to be deep within the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range?" Yuan Ming asked, somewhat confused.
During this time, he had crammed information about the Ten Thousand Demon Country.
The Ten Thousand Demon Country's influence spanned the entirety of the deep mountain range, boasting immense power.
Unlike the demon clans in the Extreme East, the demon clans within the mountain range were highly cohesive, distributed in tribes deep within the range. The leader of the Ten Thousand Demon Country was the Ten Thousand Demon Empress, whose strength was said to have reached the Peak of Dharma, close to the Mahayana Realm.
Beneath the Ten Thousand Demon Empress were five Great Demon Kings, each possessing extraordinary power. Further down were thirty-six tribes, countless demon soldiers, and generals.
Human Clan's cultivators used White Emperor City and other nineteen cities as defensive lines just to barely fend off the Ten Thousand Demon Country, preventing it from invading other cities on the Central Continent. The Wood Xiao Tribe was one of the thirty-six tribes.
"Yes, this is merely a peripheral force of the Wood Xiao Tribe, likely won't encounter the Wood Demon Clan directly. However, it's better to be cautious just to be sure," Xuan Ye said while chanting a spell.
His skin emitted faint green lines, resembling plant veins, as his aura quickly converged and completely gathered.
Simultaneously, Wu Yu also activated a secret technique to conceal her aura, resulting in the sudden disappearance of her aura.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming operated the Void Transformation Technique, rendering himself transparent.
With the curse afflicting Nan Shangfeng, he couldn't hold up shortly after entering the mountain range, and Yuan Ming had already absorbed him into the Dream Butterfly Illusion Technique, bringing him into the Shura Palace.
The three continued onward, no longer flying escape but weaving through the forest.
Traveling deep within the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range, unless possessing overwhelming power, no one dared fly escape as that would make them easy targets for the demon clan lurking in the forest.
Yuan Ming maintained his virtualization state, advancing straight through the forest, penetrating trees as he went without avoiding them, making not a sound.
In contrast to Yuan Ming's ease, Wu Yu and Xuan Ye appeared somewhat more rushed, inevitably causing leaves to rustle while passing through dense foliage.
Due to this, they attracted some demon beast attacks, but both managed to handle them.
As the three penetrated deeper into the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range, the demon beasts they encountered grew increasingly formidable, even facing some patrol soldiers from the Wood Xiao Tribe.
Luckily, the three were vigilant, promptly hiding and avoiding any confrontation with the Wood Xiao Tribe.

chapters.title: Chapter 911 - 881: Breaking Free from Control
chapters.content:
After seven or eight days, Yuan Ming and the others finally passed through that dense forest, and a gigantic, winding mountain range appeared ahead.
The mountain range extended all the way from the southeast, its peaks intertwined, lush and verdant, resembling a high wall spanning the earth's hills, or like a dragon's spine shallowly buried in the ground, steep and rugged, an awe-inspiring sight.
"We're almost there, follow me," said Wu Yu, proceeding along the mountain range.
A half-day later, another equally majestic mountain range appeared, stretching out from a different direction.
The two mountain ranges intersected, and where they converged, seven peaks clustered together, forming a vast, deep and secluded valley.
The sunlight could not bypass its surrounding peaks, with shadows almost constantly covering the valley floor.
In such a dark place, life seemed scarce, yet within the valley, faint spirit lights akin to fireflies lit up among the deep green trees, illuminating the valley floor in a brilliant array of colors, as if a fantastical coral reef in the sea.
Above the valley, the winds howled, unable to surmount the high mountain barriers, emerging through the gaps between the intersecting peaks, altering their direction, intertwining and merging, stirring the clouds and whirling the sky, ultimately forming a towering vortex in the sky.
This unusual phenomenon drew nature's spiritual energy from all directions, continuously pouring into the cloud vortex, eventually forming substantial "long dragons" of spiritual energy that clung to the vortex, reaching the valley's center.
The sky formed the cloud roll, the earth gave birth to spiritual manifestations; even though Yuan Ming was not versed in land surveying skills, he could see that this was a spectacle of converging spirit veins, a natural spirit gathering array of phenomenal tides, judged to be a Level 6 or higher formation.
"This is the place," declared Wu Yu, gazing at the valley floor.
Yuan Ming summoned Nan Shangfeng, who, upon seeing the scene before him, nervously asked, "Master Wu, how should the curse be removed, and what do I need to do?"
With his life at stake, he could not help but be wary and anxious.
"Worry not, once I enter the valley floor and set up an altar, I can channel the vast desire power within the spirit vein to help you eradicate the curse. Fellow Daoist Nan only needs to sit quietly and wait," Wu Yu replied.
Hearing this, Nan Shangfeng visibly relaxed and nodded.
The four of them flew into the valley, selecting an open area near the spiritual energy vortex. Wu Yu and Xuan Ye took out pre-prepared magic artifacts to set up the altar, while Yuan Ming stepped aside to observe the spiritual energy vortex.
The spiritual energy here was overwhelmingly dense. As soon as Yuan Ming entered the valley, he felt a lightness in his body, his breathing and cultivation speed increased many times over, with the circulation of spiritual energy within his body becoming increasingly smooth, as though his entire being was nourished.
This blissful sensation also put Yuan Ming in an extraordinarily calm state of mind.
Nan Shangfeng felt the same; any lingering anxiety vanished entirely upon entering the valley. He sat cross-legged nearby, appearing calm and completely devoid of his former playboy demeanor.
Yuan Ming activated his divine sense, probing into the depths of the spiritual energy vortex, feeling a vague premonition arise within his clear Sea of Consciousness.
As he was about to grasp a crucial understanding, Xuan Ye's voice interrupted, "The altar is ready, Fellow Daoist Nan, please step up."
Yuan Ming turned to see Nan Shangfeng being led by Xuan Ye step by step onto the altar, assuming a posture with five points facing the sky at its peak.
Xuan Ye placed nine jade stones emitting spiritual light in a circle around Nan Shangfeng before quickly descending the altar.
Outside the altar, Wu Yu spread his arms slightly, chanting a spell slowly. Each syllable seemed to possess the power of "speak and follow," subtly altering the spiritual energy flow around them, gathering the forces of heaven and earth in silence.
Yuan Ming saw Wu Yu's body being gently lifted by spiritual energy, suspending him in midair, as Nan Shangfeng and the nine jade stones around him rose up. Above his body, profound Heaven and Earth Spiritual Power gathered, which was the power of the subterranean spirit vein.
Indeed, the spirit vein contained vast desire power, flowing like immense rivers.
Activating the Love Inquiry Technique, Yuan Ming quickly discovered that most of this desire power carried positive emotions, its color bright and vivid.
The spiritual power around Nan Shangfeng rapidly accumulated, and when it reached a certain threshold, it struck down powerfully, akin to an artifact refiner tempering refined iron, harshly pounding on Nan Shangfeng's body.
The encroaching force of heaven and earth was mighty, and ordinarily, even at the Returning Void stage, Nan Shangfeng wouldn't withstand it, yet he showed no signs of pain, with only a crack appearing on one of the jade stones floating around him.
As the spiritual force coalesced again and struck, one jade stone near Nan Shangfeng suddenly shattered, turning to dust that drifted down.
At the same time, a wisp of ashen smoke drifted from his physical body, barely escaping before being smashed apart by the nearby forces of heaven and earth.
Yuan Ming watched this scene, suddenly sensing a change in the surrounding spiritual energy. He turned and saw the spiritual energy vortex was affected by Wu Yu's altar setup, its rotation speed gradually increasing, along with an escalation in the quantity and speed of the spiritual energy drawn in.
Simultaneously, the Mixed Hole Vortex within Yuan Ming's body was also being influenced, starting to operate spontaneously, increasingly faster.
Yuan Ming realized it, no wonder he felt a strange familiarity while sensing the spiritual energy vortex earlier.
Although this spiritual energy vortex was outwardly different from the Mixed Hole Vortex within him, its internal operation logic was very similar. Now provoked by the forces of heaven and earth, it stimulated his Primordial True Skill, causing it to run involuntarily, pushing him towards a breakthrough to the Dharma manifestation stage.
"Not good, now isn't the time for a breakthrough," Yuan Ming thought to himself, hastily suppressing the momentum for a breakthrough within himself.
Yet the Primordial True Skill seemed to be stimulated by the spiritual energy vortex, and despite his efforts to cultivate and suppress it, he couldn't slow the Mana Vortex.
To escape the influence of the spiritual energy vortex, he had to leave this place.
He looked up at Wu Yu and the others, Wu Yu was still casting, unable to finish in a short time.
Wu Yu and Xuan Ye were quite friendly, but after all, they had only met recently, he couldn't just hand Nan Shangfeng over to the two of them.
"What a bother..." Yuan Ming thought to himself as he fully suppressed the anomaly of the Mana Vortex, remaining silent.
Wu Yu's speed in dispelling the curse was quick, having now ground five out of the nine pieces of jade into dust.
The woman's expression was solemn, her hands swiftly forming incantation gestures.
A dragon-shaped spirit light appeared around the altar, containing immense Desire Power, flying in mid-air with its head swinging and tail swaying, then plunged into Nan Shangfeng's body.
Boom!
The Curse Power within Nan Shangfeng was completely crushed, and the pain and fatigue that had entangled him for so many days disappeared entirely. He couldn't help but let out a long roar skyward, his voice echoing through the canyon, with leaves fluttering all around.
...
In a cave abundant with spiritual energy within the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range, Hei Lian sat cross-legged, surrounded by flowing black light, forming a gigantic black Lotus Platform.
A large magic array was set up on the ground below her, seemingly a Spirit Gathering Array.
Su Yingxue stood nearby, making incantation gestures with both hands, the array rumbled and operated, gathering nature's spiritual energy within the cave.
Along with the nature's spiritual energy, streams of silver light emerged intermittently from the surrounding void, unexpectedly power of the void, also gathered through the Spirit Gathering Array.
The black Lotus Platform slowly rotated, swallowing the gathered nature's spiritual energy and the silver light completely.
Hei Lian's aura fluctuated incessantly, seemingly trying to break through a bottleneck.
At this moment, a beam of gray-black light descended from the sky, piercing through the black lotus, entering the woman's body.
Hei Lian's body shook violently, spurting a mouthful of fresh blood, her aura became incredibly chaotic, and the breakthrough attempt was instantly interrupted.
"What's going on?" Su Wu's figure emerged from the shadows of the cave, his eyebrows slightly furrowed.
Hei Lian didn't say a word, raising her hand with a wave, the Evil Curse Altar appeared, on which at some unknown time, a white jade token had appeared, but now it was shattered.
"Oh, it seems the Seven Evil Heart Curse has been dispelled. Even though you haven't really cultivated curse divine abilities, relying solely on the Evil Curse Altar for spellcasting, breaking the Seven Evil Heart Curse won't be easy. Things are getting more interesting." Su Wu showed an expression of surprise.
Hei Lian's expression was ashen, staring intently at the shattered jade token on the Evil Curse Altar.
...
In the canyon, everyone allowed Nan Shangfeng to vent freely, no one stopping him.
During this time, he had appeared relatively calm, but in fact, the pressure he endured wasn't small, until this moment, he finally truly laid down the burden in his heart, feeling as if he had been reborn.
After stabilizing his mind, he solemnly bowed to Yuan Ming and Wu Yu with the three of them.
"If it weren't for your utmost help, I would have surely been unable to escape this disaster. Though I do not express my gratitude verbally, if there is anything I can assist with in the future, please don't hesitate to ask." Nan Shangfeng said.
"The Curse Power has just been removed, although it will no longer continue to erode your vitality, your previous losses were significant. To recover, you need a good period of nurturing." Wu Yu advised.
"Thank you." Nan Shangfeng expressed his gratitude again.
Yuan Ming's attention was drawn to the changes in his own Mixed Hole Vortex, his reaction was slightly delayed.
"This is for you. It can help replenish your Qi-Blood and restore vitality." He took out a prepared bottle of elixir and handed it to Nan Shangfeng.
Nan Shangfeng looked grateful, wordlessly bowing his fists.
Yuan Ming didn't respond to Nan Shangfeng, remaining silent.
"Although this place isn't deep within the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range, it's hardly safe. Now that the matter is finished, let's leave quickly." Xuan Ye suggested.
"Indeed, then we..." Wu Yu nodded.
"If you three wish to leave, please go ahead. My opportunity for breakthrough has arrived. I probably need to set up an array here to break through." Yuan Ming suddenly spoke.
He originally didn't want to attempt breaking through the Dharma manifestation Stage in this utterly unsafe Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range, but having suppressed for so long, the Mana Vortex within his Dantian hadn't ceased, instead rotating faster and faster, already beyond his control, even if he left this canyon, he could no longer suppress it.
Wu Yu's beautiful eyes flashed slightly, sizing up Yuan Ming from head to foot.
"Is breaking through here not too risky?" Nan Shangfeng said with some concern.

chapters.title: Chapter 912 - 882: Major Upheaval
chapters.content:
"I have encountered some changes, and I need to go into seclusion here. You all may do as you please." Yuan Ming said this and, without caring about the trio's reactions, immediately flew into the canyon.
Wu Yu and the other two looked at one another and didn't speak for a moment.
"You two may go first. Fellow Daoist Wan has done me a favor, and I, Nan Shangfeng, cannot flee when he is in need. I will stay here to guard him." Nan Shangfeng slightly cupped his hands toward the other two and flew to land beside the valley, sitting cross-legged.
Xuan Ye looked at Wu Yu, seemingly seeking his opinion.
"Since we came together, we should naturally return together." Wu Yu flickered, appearing on the other side of the valley.
Xuan Ye saw this and descended as well.
"Thank you both. With the three of us guarding, I believe everything will go smoothly." Nan Shangfeng was greatly pleased and thanked the two.
"I hope Fellow Daoist Wan can successfully break through." Wu Yu murmured.
At this moment, Yuan Ming had already reached the depths of the canyon, stopping at a relatively flat and spacious area.
With a wave of his hand, a cyan light swept by, clearing the ground of dust, rocks, and fallen leaves.
Yuan Ming took out an Array Plate, holding it with one hand as he took steps in four directions, seeking the positions, and then began taking out Magic Artifacts used for arraying, starting to lay them on the ground.
In a short time, he arranged the Primordial Truth Formation, a sixth-level array adept in both offense and defense.
This array was the first sixth-level array he independently comprehended and improved upon after advancing to a Level 6 Array Master, intended for protection during his breakthrough to the Dharma manifestation Stage.
It not only has the function of absorbing and purifying nature's spiritual energy but can also withstand continuous attacks from ordinary Level 6 demon beasts. After being attacked, it will accumulate power inversely, capable of injuring or even killing Level 5 demon beasts.
Subsequently, Yuan Ming released Lei Yu, instructing him to guard outside the formation.
"Master, it's not that I'm cowardly, but the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range is filled with demon beasts, and relying on myself alone might not ensure your safety. If only Hua Zhi and Vajra were here as well." Lei Yu said helplessly.
"No worries, you hold the Shura Palace, and temporarily take control of the Shura Stone Tablet. If any demon beasts attack during my breakthrough, summon Ye Wuya and others to defend." Yuan Ming handed the Shura Palace and Shura Stone Tablet to Lei Yu.
Lei Yu then sighed with relief, opened his mouth to swallow the two items into his belly, and flapped his wings to fly away.
Yuan Ming naturally sensed that Nan Shangfeng and the other two did not leave, glanced outward but ignored it, and sat cross-legged back in the center of the array, pointing remotely at the Array Plate and pouring a strand of Mana into it.
A humming tremor sounded.
Under him, golden light surged, and a huge golden circular Array Map emerged. Then, sixty-four golden Light Pillars rose around the Array Map, their light intertwining, forming an Eight Treasures Canopy.
Above the canopy, golden light condensed into eight golden dragons, each holding a golden Round Orb in their mouths, facing eight different directions, with scarlet gleams in their eyes, appearing lifelike.
Yuan Ming glanced at the array, nodded in satisfaction, and immediately embraced the Primordial True Skill with both hands and actively began to operate the Primordial True Skill.
In an instant, the surrounding world seemed to be stirred by an invisible giant hand.
The once-clear sky suddenly gathered clouds from all directions, enveloping the sky above the canyon and darkening the entire gorge.
"This... is all nature's spiritual energy?" Nan Shangfeng looked up at the sky and exclaimed with a sudden change in expression.
"The place is originally rich in nature's spiritual energy, naturally conducive to Gathering Spirit. Combined with Fellow Daoist Wan's array that can manipulate nature's spiritual energy, forming such clusters of Spirit Cloud is not surprising." Wu Yu calmly said.
As her words fell, she suddenly felt a wind rising in the canyon.
The next moment, the whistling wind grew louder, with breezes passing by their sides, without a trace of chill but instead carrying immense nature's spiritual energy.
In the depths of the canyon, Yuan Ming sat in the center of the array, with nature's spiritual energy suddenly gathering around.
He no longer needed to consume any elixirs to replenish Spiritual Power, immediately fully operating the Primordial True Skill. The Mixed Hole Vortex within the Dantian began to spin frantically, like a vast Abyssal mouth, frantically devouring nature's spiritual energy.
"Rumble"
The sound of a storm echoed.
Within the Spirit Cloud gathered above his head, streaks of Thunder flashed, stirring with azure-purple light, forming a massive storm vortex, crashing down toward the Primordial Truth Formation below.
"Boom"
The Spirit Cloud surged, and the storm entangled by Thunder smashed down fiercely, lighting up the Primordial Truth Formation. The eight golden dragons on the canopy suddenly raised their heads, opening their blood-red mouths.
Miniature vortices formed in their mouths, tearing into the giant spirit storm, splitting it into eight smaller tornadoes, leading them into their mouths.
The next instant, the scales on the eight golden dragons bristled, and green-blue light emerged between the scale gaps, flowing into their bodies, then being steadily channeled to the array canopy above.
The canopy instantly shined with radiant light, purifying the absorbed nature's spiritual energy, then sending it underground through the eight golden Light Pillars.
Afterward, the surging Spiritual Energy flowed along the array patterns on the ground, pouring into Yuan Ming's body, where it was devoured by the Mixed Hole Vortex within his Dantian, starting to impact the breakthrough barrier step by step.
Outside, Lei Yu watched this scene, his eyes filled with a complex mix of surprise and joy. Unable to resist the aura, he began cultivating, greedily absorbing the Spiritual Energy gathering from the world.
In the mountains and forests outside the canyon, numerous mystical creatures with spiritual intelligence also sensed something. One by one, they stood still, looking up towards the sky above the canyon, then rushed over, either running or flying. Among them were not a few Level 4, even Level 5 demon beasts.
"Damn, Fellow Daoist Wan's attempt to achieve Dharma manifestation has caused too much commotion, attracting many demon beasts. Let's each take action and drive them away!" Wu Yu said, her pretty face changing slightly.
With that, she shot out.
Nan Shangfeng and Xuan Ye also spoke no more, each choosing a direction to block the approaching demon beasts.
Although the number of these demon beasts was not small, there were few Level 5 demon beasts, and the three quickly intercepted them.
At this moment, a huge roar came from the sky a hundred miles away, and a Silver Giant Bird, as gigantic as a mountain with wings spread like drooping clouds, approached through the void. Its entire body was covered with a faint blue flame on its silver feathers, and each flap of its wings released a massive rumble.
The aura of the silver giant bird was terrifying, causing flocks of birds in the sky to scatter and the Hundred Beasts in the forest below to hide.
Even some towering ancient trees over a hundred feet high caught fire from the heat it emitted, burning in fierce flames, despite being a hundred feet away from it.
This beast was clearly attracted by the celestial phenomenon caused by Yuan Ming's breakthrough to the Dharma manifestation Stage.
"A Level 6 demon beast!" Nan Shangfeng's face changed color.
"Xuan Ye, go intercept that Level 6 Silver Feathered Blue Flame Owl. Don't let it get near the canyon sky." Wu Yu glanced at the distant sky and said calmly.
Upon hearing this, the latter did not hesitate at all and immediately nodded in agreement.
Then, his figure turned into a "whoosh" silver whirlwind, rushing straight into the sky.
The dense and heavy Spirit Cloud in the high sky was hit by him, creating a hole visible to the naked eye, which couldn't close for a long time.
A flash of white light passed over Wu Yu's body, and the Outer Soul Avatar shot out, filling the gap left by Xuan Ye's departure.
Before long, the sky was filled with the sounds of thunderous rumblings and beastly roars, and the chaotic fluctuations began to move further and further away.
Seeing this scene, Nan Shangfeng showed a look of surprise.
A Level 6 demon beast, an existence comparable to the Dharma manifestation Stage, was actually intercepted and led away by Xuan Ye with a single movement?
In the canyon, Yuan Ming was naturally unaware of all this; he had reached the critical moment of his breakthrough.
Raising his finger in the air, a Dharma Manifestation Pill immediately flew up, falling into his mouth, and with a swallow, it was ingested into his abdomen.
The Dharma Manifestation Pill dissolved rapidly upon entering the abdomen; however, unlike other elixirs, it did not disperse to be absorbed by the Dantian, but instead condensed into a cloud-like form, suspended within the Dantian.
This did not surprise Yuan Ming; he had already experienced this once when he was possessed by Yun Luo Fairy.
But there was a difference; Yun Luo Fairy's Dantian only contained pure mana, while Yuan Ming's Dantian had the slowly rotating Mixed Hole Vortex.
As the cloud-like medicinal liquid condensed, it failed to draw a single trace of mana closer; instead, it was pulled towards the Mixed Hole Vortex by the gravitational force emanating from it.
Soon, the cloud-like medicinal liquid was devoured by the Mixed Hole Vortex, the two merging into one.
This left Yuan Ming somewhat stunned.
When Yun Luo Fairy condensed her Dharma manifestation, it was not like this!
Thus, he hesitated for a moment, unsure whether to continue attempting to merge the Divine Soul into it.
Only hesitating for a moment, Yuan Ming dispelled all hesitations; all the necessary preparations had already been made, and it was impossible to find a more suitable place for a breakthrough than this. Instead of retreating in doubt, it's better to forge ahead and strive forward.
Once his mind was set, Yuan Ming wasted no more hesitation.
In the next instant, he controlled his thoughts, allowing his main soul to descend gradually into the Dantian, moving closer.
At the moment when the main soul approached, the previously steady Mixed Hole Vortex suddenly spun rapidly out of control, a powerful tearing force seized Yuan Ming's main soul and pulled it in fiercely.
A tearing pain surged through Yuan Ming's Divine Soul.
The intense and extreme pain instantly overwhelmed his consciousness, and the next moment, an uncontrollable surge of chaos flooded Yuan Ming's Divine Soul under the influence of the Mixed Hole Vortex.
In an instant, various emotions like pain, regret, disappointment, remorse, helplessness, and fury surged out, and the Mixed Hole Vortex became increasingly out of control, with the condensation of Dharma manifestation teetering on the brink of failure.
The split soul hidden in the Sea of Consciousness dared not move recklessly, immediately channeling Divine Soul Power into the Dantian, attempting to stabilize the main soul, yet it was entirely devoured the moment it entered the Dantian.

chapters.title: Chapter 913 - 883: Dharma Manifestation Condensation
chapters.content:
Just as the soul splitting tried to fully suppress the chaos of the Divine Soul, Yuan Ming suddenly remembered an object.
He quickly raised his hand and took it out.
It was a jade-like, crystalline green bamboo leaf—none other than the Innate Bitter Bamboo Leaf.
Yuan Ming picked up the Innate Bitter Bamboo Leaf and placed it on his forehead. Instantly, spirit light flashed on the bamboo leaf, followed by waves of blue-green spiritual power. An indescribable yet gentle and penetrating force immediately permeated his body.
His soul splitting was the first to be affected, feeling a refreshing coolness running through him from top to bottom in an instant, attaining tranquility and purity, as if transformed into a branch of transcendental green bamboo.
When that force delved into his Dantian, Yuan Ming's chaotic main soul seemed to take a heavy blow—all chaotic emotions were forcibly suppressed and gradually became stable.
His rationality returned, and he immediately communicated with his Nascent Soul.
The Nascent Soul, which had been quietly seated in the Dantian, suddenly began to move, unsteadily extending its tender hands toward the Mixed Hole Vortex.
At the moment Nascent Soul's power poured in, the previously fierce Mixed Hole Vortex suddenly calmed down as if instantly soothed, becoming unexpectedly gentle.
The Divine Soul, absorbed inside, had already completely merged with the pill liquid of the Dharma Manifestation Pill, beginning to absorb the pure mana within the Mixed Hole Vortex, thus initiating the condensation of the Dharma manifestation.
The Mixed Hole Vortex suddenly began to collapse inward, and after a series of twisting transformations, it converged into a white sphere filled with layers of flames.
The flames on the edge of the sphere danced and leaped wildly, like little figures dancing around a campfire, brimming with surprising, vigorous life force.
At this moment, as the white sphere was leaping, it began to elongate at a speed visible to the naked eye, becoming oval, then large at the top and small at the bottom. Like an infant, a head and limbs appeared, resembling the Nascent Soul closely.
But soon, the infant began to grow swiftly, transforming from a toddler into a youth, then from a youth into a young man, until it became a tall and handsome man with an impressive stature.
At this time, the man had ceased his previous jumping motions and was sitting cross-legged, appearing quite serene.
His eyes were closed, he wore a wide-sleeved robe, and sported a beaded crown. Behind his head floated a vortex resembling the sun and moon, its interior glowing, eternally vibrant, circulating endlessly.
With the moment the man's form was condensed, a thunderous boom suddenly came from Yuan Ming's Dantian, followed by the vortex behind the man's head beginning to spin on its own.
Instantly, an invisible force centered at Yuan Ming's Dantian spread outward, spinning clockwise to form a vortex.
Next, the entire valley was shrouded in mist condensed from spiritual power; the spirit clouds in the sky rolled, spiritual energy boiled, drawn by an invisible force toward the vortex below.
The Primordial Truth Formation below ran wildly but still struggled, trying to stabilize the influx speed of nature's spiritual energy.
As threads of nature's spiritual energy were refined into mana and transferred into the Dantian to be absorbed by the vortex, a gray-white beam surged from Yuan Ming's head, transforming into a Dharma manifestation.
Immediately, the Dharma manifestation expanded continuously, until it stood over a hundred zhang tall, like a god towering in the center of the valley, emitting a boundless might that suppressed the gigantic spiritual energy vortex within the valley.
The demon beasts surrounding the valley sensed the terrifying pressure of the Dharma manifestation, showing fear and turning to flee.
Yuan Ming could feel the perspective of the Dharma manifestation, as if he was standing in the sea of clouds, looking down at the rocks and woods below, possessing a regal stance that gazed down upon the world.
Perhaps due to the shared cultivation of Dharma and body, he felt that his Dharma manifestation was solid and inflated, seeming to hold endless power.
With his thoughts turning, the Dharma manifestation pushed a palm forward as if flexing his arm.
A palm wind surged out like a tornado, with rolling waves crashing onto the side wall of the gorge.
Boom!
Countless smoke and dust rose, stirring the dense misty spirit sea within the gorge, rolling to both sides. The ground echoed with the roar, and the gorge's cliff wall was blasted open with a huge gap, instantly extending a thousand zhang, resembling a small gorge.
Outside the gorge, the mountains and forests shook, howling winds, beasts fled in panic, and birds flew in unison.
Nan Shangfeng saw this scene, showing a look of delight.
"What an astonishing palm... Fellow Daoist Wan's Dharma manifestation is truly remarkable." Wu Yu looked over to this side, his slender, curved eyelashes fluttering, a hint of surprise in his eyes.
At this moment, Xuan Ye had already returned to the gorge, looking at Yuan Ming's Dharma manifestation, his eyes also full of surprise and solemnity.
Yuan Ming retracted his arm and nodded slightly.
The attack from the Dharma manifestation was as he expected, rather sharp. If faced with the previous Level 6 Tree Man and the Sea Jelly Demon Beast, he reckoned he could break them with a single palm.
Yuan Ming didn't continue trying, closing his eyes tightly, carefully sensing the changes within himself, while the Dharma manifestation retreating and shrinking in mid-air.
Within his Dantian, the Nascent Soul child shrouded in crystalline brilliance was also continuously absorbing the mana surging in from the outside world, its body growing nearly twice as large.
Looking at its physical characteristics, it no longer resembled an infant, almost approaching the appearance of a teenager.
Yuan Ming inwardly observed his Nascent Soul, feeling a stirring as he looked up, a vast cascade of mysterious spirit light descended from the sky, entering his body.
He immediately felt as if his whole being had fallen into the clouds, bathing in a pool of warm spring water.
This mysterious spirit light was precisely the power of the Great Dao bestowed after breaking through to the Dharma manifestation Stage.
At this moment, Yuan Ming personally experienced it; it was far more genuine and profound than the insight he gained when he borrowed Yun Luo Fairy's breakthrough.
Perhaps because Yuan Ming had cultivated so many exquisite Divine Skills, the bestowed power of the Dao was several times more than Yun Luo Fairy had received.
Nurtured by the power of the Dao, the many Divine Skills he mastered were undergoing indescribable transformations.
The Soul Cultivator's Crow Cry, Corpse Control, Far Travel, soul collision, Soul Search, Emotion Manipulation, Nightmare, Life and Death Reincarnation Path; the Body Cultivation's Shared Fate; the Magic Practitioner's Golden Sunflower Beast Taming Technique, Planting Beans into Soldiers, Eyes of Golden Flame, Zhu Rong Heart Technique, even the Fire Cloud Secret Technique, rain praying technique, Wood Prison Technique learned long ago, all advanced rapidly without exception.
As for the Dream Butterfly Illusion Technique, All Living Beings' Dream, Circular Light Technique, Six Jia Qimen, Transplanting Technique that already had Dao Seals, they greedily absorbed the descending power of the Great Dao, growing rapidly.
Yuan Ming felt both surprised and delighted, as he hadn't anticipated that with the breakthrough of his magic practice, the Divine Skills of soul cultivation and body cultivation would also advance!
He took a deep breath, quieted his mind, and focused on comprehending the enhancements of the various Divine Skills.
The next moment, Yuan Ming's expression suddenly changed slightly.
Just now, he noticed something peculiar; not only his many Divine Skills were absorbing the power of the Dao, the Mana Vortex in his Dantian was also absorbing it.
"Could this Mana Vortex also be a Divine Skill?" He was surprised and pondered briefly before realizing the truth.
This Mana Vortex was condensed by the Primordial True Skill and could be considered a Divine Skill, with the effect of refining others' mana.
However, given Yuan Ming's many techniques, he had never used this Divine Skill.
As time passed gradually, golden light gathered around his body, and a golden sunflower-like rune directly condensed in his Dantian, where a beast pattern emerged, precisely the Dao Seal condensed by the Golden Sunflower Beast Taming Technique.
This technique he had mastered for a long time, and he deeply comprehended it; now, taking advantage of this breakthrough to condense a Dao Seal was a natural and inevitable course of action.
After this, another phenomenon occurred in Yuan Ming's Dantian, where golden light scattered like beans, rolling over the ground and transforming into a group of small golden figures that drilled and maneuvered like an army.
A moment later, these golden figures gathered like forming a formation, clustering in golden light, transforming into a bean-shaped peculiar rune, which was the Dao Seal formed by the Planting Beans into Soldiers Divine Power.
Yuan Ming was secretly delighted, then focused his attention on the Eyes of Golden Flame Divine Skill.
Over the years, he had invested the most effort in these three Divine Skills, and now, only the Eyes of Golden Flame were closest to achieving the Perfect Realm, possibly forming another Dao Seal.
But at this very moment, the descending power of the Great Dao suddenly ceased, and the enhancement of several Divine Skills came to a halt, including the Eyes of Golden Flame.
Yuan Ming sighed; it was just a little short, and ultimately, the Eyes of Golden Flame could not condense a Dao Seal as he had hoped.
He steadied himself, forming spell gestures with his hands.
The enlarged Dream Butterfly Dao Seal first surged out of the Dantian, plunging into his Nascent Soul and merging within amidst radiant light.
The All Living Beings Dream Seal followed next, then the Circular Light Technique Dao Seal, Six Jia Qimen Dao Seal, and Transplanting Technique Dao Seal followed suit.
The newly condensed Golden Sunflower Beast Taming Technique Dao Seal and Planting Beans into Soldiers Dao Seal also floated up, rushing into his Nascent Soul, becoming one with it.
Once all these Dao Seals returned to the Nascent Soul, Yuan Ming felt a palpable strengthening of his Nascent Soul.
After breaking through to the Dharma manifestation Stage, his Divine Soul also grew significantly.
Including his main soul, his current Soul Power was comparable to that of an ordinary mid-stage Dharma manifestation Cultivator.
He opened his eyes, exhaled a mouthful of turbid qi lightly, his eyes shining brightly.
With his current strength in magic practice, combined with the soul cultivation and body cultivation Divine Skills, he was indeed strong within the Dharma manifestation Stage, and need not flee in embarrassment when encountering that Hei Lian again.
"Master, congratulations on breaking through to the Dharma manifestation Stage!" Lei Yu dived down from mid-air, circled around Yuan Ming, and landed by his side, speaking joyfully.
Yuan Ming looked at Lei Yu, showing a surprised expression.
The demon energy around Lei Yu surged, astonishingly breaking through to the Upper Fifth Level.
Its body also became significantly larger, and the Thunder and Lightning Spiritual Patterns on its feathers became denser, somewhat resembling the demeanor of that Level 6 Silver Giant Bird just now.
The most noticeable change was a lightning-shaped vertical mark on Lei Yu's forehead, emitting an incredible destructive thunder aura, far surpassing the Destruction Thunder Lei Yu had previously wielded.

chapters.title: Chapter 914 - 884: A World Apart
chapters.content:
"Lei Yu, when did you achieve your breakthrough?" Yuan Ming's gaze lingered for a moment on the lightning mark on Lei Yu's forehead before he asked.
"Just now. The Beast Taming Rune inside me suddenly changed, transforming into a golden sunflower pattern. Then a thought was transmitted to me, causing the demonic power in my body to surge and successfully break through to the Upper Fifth Level in one fell swoop. Master, do you know what happened?" Lei Yu stopped near Yuan Ming and asked.
"Golden sunflower pattern... It's the Golden Sunflower Beast Taming Technique! This technique, when cultivated to the Perfect Realm, has such an effect that it can promote a spirit beast's breakthrough?" Yuan Ming did not answer Lei Yu, but inner waves of emotion surged fiercely.
Golden Sunflower Beast Taming Technique allows its master to borrow the divine skills of the spirit beast, which is already quite astounding. Now it seems it can even accelerate the spirit beast's cultivation. Isn't this divine skill a bit too powerful?
Not only the Golden Sunflower Beast Taming Technique, but the Circular Light Technique, Transplanting Technique, and the effects of the Six Jia Qimen are also astonishing.
Though he has been using these divine skills over the years, he has not excavated any one of them to its extreme.
"As for the origins of the Three Immortals Island, there are still many mysteries. It seems the origins of the Golden Sunflower Heavenly Book, the Lank Jade Book, and the Penglai Immortal Book are even greater than I anticipated..." Yuan Ming thought to himself.
He instructed Lei Yu to go aside to cultivate, while he sat down cross-legged again to begin cultivating the Golden Sunflower Beast Taming Technique, intending to calm his mind and appreciate this divine skill.
At this time, a unique sensation emerged in his heart, as golden light flickered within the Dantian's Undying Tree, revealing a cluster of golden sunflower patterns.
Yuan Ming was not surprised. Back then, to completely subdue the Undying Tree, he also used the Golden Sunflower Beast Taming Technique on it.
As he continued to operate this technique, he quickly discovered that through the Dao Seal of this divine skill, he could indeed connect his thoughts with the Undying Tree, somewhat similar to the effect of the Stealing Heaven Tripod's Black Incense Possession.
Yuan Ming steadied his mind and transmitted his insights about the Dharma manifestation Stage.
The Origin Power of the Undying Tree began to stir. Roots extended in all directions, piercing through the void and swiftly absorbing the nearby nature's spiritual energy.
Yuan Ming was astonished, then glanced outside the canyon and began to activate the Primordial Truth Formation with a hand seal.
Inside the great array, dazzling spirit light enveloped his body.
Outside the canyon, Wu Yu, Xuan Ye, and Nan Shangfeng could not see Yuan Ming's situation, as their Divine Senses were also isolated by the Primordial Truth Formation.
Within the Primordial Truth Formation, Yuan Ming operated the Ju Mang Spirit Technique, his figure trembling as he transformed into a black ancient tree.
The earth veins seemed to be aroused, and the canyon was once again filled with thick spirit fog, and nature's spiritual energy became incredibly rich.
The Undying Tree roots absorbed the spiritual energy with full force, and the Undying Tree Demon Power within the tree surged turbulently, undergoing a slight transformation.
The next moment, the branches and leaves of the Undying Tree began to light up with tiny white points, intermingling and illuminating with a hazy glow, making the entire tree appear somewhat dreamy and ethereal.
Not far away, Lei Yu was also enclosed within the Primordial Truth Formation, greedily absorbing the extremely rich spiritual energy in the array, eagerly enhancing his demonic power.
Yuan Ming, now transformed into the Undying Tree, paid no attention to Lei Yu, focusing entirely on his own transformation.
He could feel that as the abundant nature's spiritual energy poured into his body, the Undying Tree Demon Power grew rapidly, seemingly about to break through to Level 6 soon.
And at this moment, he already understood that the opportunity for the Undying Tree's breakthrough was not solely due to the Golden Sunflower Beast Taming Technique; the bark of the World Tree was also playing a role.
As it gradually strengthened, the bark of the World Tree also yearned for continued growth, accelerating the Undying Tree's breakthrough.
Yuan Ming continued to operate the Golden Sunflower Beast Taming Technique, transmitting his insights about the Dharma Phase as he fully absorbed the rich spiritual energy in the array, infusing it into the Undying Tree.
After a day and night.
The Undying Tree Demon Power surged and finally broke through its bounds, reaching Level 6.
The Power of Dao descended accordingly, although the Undying Tree, unlike Yuan Ming, had not cultivated numerous divine skills, so the resulting power was not much and soon ceased.
Dense black demon energy surged out of the Undying Tree, and its body quickly grew larger, soon pressing against the light screen of the Primordial Truth Formation.
The Undying Tree crown did not pause, continuing to grow upward.
With a "bang," the Undying Tree pierced through the array's light screen, continuing to grow, and soon turned into a towering giant tree, taller than the peaks on either side of the canyon.
The dense canopy spread out visibly in all directions, quickly covering a vast area near the canyon.
Outside the canyon, Nan Shangfeng, Xuan Ye, and Wu Yu were taken aback upon witnessing this scene.
"What is this? Could it be the work of Fellow Daoist Wan?" Nan Shangfeng murmured to himself.
Xuan Ye and Wu Yu remained silent, watching the vast spreading tree before them.
...
Meanwhile, Yuan Ming naturally couldn't be bothered by the exposure of the Undying Tree's actions; instead, he focused inwardly to sense its changes.
After breaking through Level 6, the resilience of the Undying Tree has undeniably reached new heights, matching that of ordinary Spiritual Treasures.
As for its regeneration capability, it has similarly improved from its original state, reaching an incredible extent.
Nowadays, no matter what attacks the Undying Tree suffers — even if burned to charcoal or smashed to bits — it cannot be completely destroyed. As long as enough Spiritual Power is supplied, the Undying Tree can rapidly heal.
Yuan Ming found it hard to believe, and he raised the Exterminating Immortal Sword, channeling Dharma Phase Stage Mana into it.
The Exterminating Immortal Sword emitted a clear sword hum akin to a dragon's roar, and a thick stream of Immortal Slaying Sword Qi shot forth, instantly pulverizing one trunk of the Undying Tree into particles smaller than wood chips.
Wisps of Undying Tree Demon Power emerged from those particles, gathering towards one spot, quickly growing and stitching themselves together.
In just a couple of breaths, a brand new trunk took shape, suspended in mid-air.
This trunk was lush and vibrant, indistinguishable from the one previously part of the Undying Tree, though it consumed a considerable amount of demon power.
Yuan Ming nodded slightly but did not stop. With a wave of his hand, he summoned a small purple-black banner.
With a gentle flick of his fingers at the banner, it suddenly expanded to roughly ten feet in size, its surface emitting rings of undulating purple-black light, as if there were living creatures roaming its fabric, exuding astonishing Spiritual Energy.
This item was a Magic Treasure refined from the Poisonous Sack of the Sea Jelly Demon Beast. Although it hadn't reached the level of a Spiritual Treasure, it inherited over eighty percent of the Sea Jelly Demon Beast's poison.
"Whoosh"
A burst of purple-black light shot from the banner, wrapping around the trunk of the Undying Tree.
A "sizzle" of corrosion sounded, and all the leaves and smaller branches decayed rapidly. The once lush trunk left only a rotted main trunk with pits and hollows, devoid of vitality, and its inner demon power completely dissolved.
Yuan Ming cultivated, gathering nature's spiritual energy from nearby to infuse it.
The decayed trunk quickly regained vitality, sprouting branches, which then grew leaves.
Before long, a flourishing branch appeared once more.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming couldn't help but marvel, finally convinced of the tree's indomitable life force, worthy of the name "Undying."
Joy surged in his heart; unlike cultivators, the Undying Tree had no vulnerable spots like a Dantian or head. Now with its tenacious vitality and formidable regeneration capability, it feared no adversaries.
Even facing two or three Dharma Phase Cultivators in siege, the worst for the Undying Tree would just be rapid demon power consumption, easily manageable.
Moreover, with the powerful absorption ability of the Undying Tree Roots, demonic power can be swiftly restored. Prolonged battles aren't something ordinary same-level cultivators can match; careful maneuvering could potentially wear out two or three Dharma Phase Cultivators.
"With my current Divine Skills, facing Level 6 Undying Tree, victory seems uncertain," Yuan Ming pondered, assessing himself and the Undying Tree.
Of course, the Undying Tree isn't without weaknesses; its Divine Soul remains.
However, its Undying Tree Demon Qi can devour Divine Soul attacks, making Divine Soul extermination attempts futile for even Dharma Phase Cultivators or Life Witches.
Besides its regeneration ability, the Void-piercing capability of the Undying Tree Roots greatly enhances.
The Undying Tree has now morphed into a towering giant, its roots unknowingly extending deeply underground. Yuan Ming, with a thought, controlled the roots to probe further below, employing its Void-piercing ability.
Tree root tendrils pierced the Void, reaching previously unreachable strata, discovering a place of intense spiritual flow.
"Could this be... the touch of underground Spirit Vein?" Yuan Ming, observing the situation, paused slightly.
Central Continent differs from Yunhuang Continent, Dongji Sea islands, and other places; the Earth's crust is over ten times thicker, with Spirit Veins buried deep. Unless pre-arranged Arrays guide spiritual power, even Dharma Phase Cultivators cannot casually access them. Yet the Undying Tree Roots could touch them!
While Yuan Ming stood in thought, the Undying Tree Roots began autonomously withdrawing spiritual energy from the underground Spirit Vein.
Pure earth vein spiritual power was quickly extracted, flowing "gurgling" down the roots, pouring into the tree trunk.
Yuan Ming sensed this scene, delighted, intensified the extraction by the Undying Tree Roots, and diverted a portion of the spiritual power to himself.
The underground vein's spiritual power, exceptionally pure, aided both him and the Undying Tree in stabilizing their realms.
Not only was the Void-piercing ability of the Undying Tree Roots greatly increased, but their absorption capability also improved significantly, rapidly depleting the abundant spiritual power within the underground Spirit Vein.
Fortunately, underground Spirit Veins interconnected, causing spiritual power from other areas to converge.
Yuan Ming paid no mind to these developments, continuing to stabilize his realm.
In the blink of an eye, two days passed, and Yuan Ming's cultivation realm stabilized completely, as did the Undying Tree.
"To cultivate directly by drawing from underground Spirit Vein's power is unexpectedly beneficial! If a suitable vein site is found in the future, employing this method would obviate any need for elixirs, accelerating cultivation progress," Yuan Ming secretly thought.

chapters.title: Chapter 915 - 885: Abundant Wealth
chapters.content:
In order to breakthrough and comprehend the changes of his new realm, Yuan Ming had stayed in the canyon for several days. His cultivation had largely stabilized, and it was time to depart.
With this thought, he began to circulate the Ju Mang Spirit Technique, intending to dispel the Undying Tree transformation, but his actions suddenly paused.
Amidst the lush foliage of the Undying Tree's crown, a white sphere the size of a human head had unknowingly formed, hanging heavily like a ripe fruit.
This was definitely not an Undying Tree Fruit; he had seen real Undying Immortal Fruits, and their auras were completely different.
Yuan Ming enveloped the white sphere with his Divine Thought and soon discovered that it contained exceptionally pure and lively spiritual power.
This aura was somewhat similar to that of Gathering Spirit Stones and Gathering Spirit Trees.
"Could this be a new Gathering Spirit Object?" Yuan Ming mused to himself.
It takes thousands of years to nurture a Gathering Spirit Object, yet the Undying Tree had reached level six, and with the bark from the World Tree, plus the Undying Tree Roots continuously absorbing spiritual energy from the spirit veins underground, forming a Gathering Spirit Object Fruit was not impossible.
He waved his hand, plucking the fruit-like sphere from the tree branch, wrapping it in mana, and sent it into the Shura Palace's Medicine Garden.
Inside the white fruit, spiritual power slowly circulated, drawing in spiritual power from the void and dispersing it into the Medicine Garden.
"Indeed, it's a Gathering Spirit Object, but unfortunately, its effect is minimal, akin to the poorest Gathering Spirit Stone." Yuan Ming thought to himself.
Still, even a small mosquito is meat; he tossed the white sphere next to the Gathering Spirit Tree, enabling the two Gathering Spirit Objects to work together.
In the Shura Palace's Medicine Garden, the Gathering Spirit Tree swayed gently in the breeze.
The moment the white sphere touched the tree, it released a brilliant white light and then merged directly into the Gathering Spirit Tree. The tree shook violently, and under the shroud of white light, grew visibly larger.
With a slight sense, Yuan Ming discovered that the tree not only grew three feet taller, but its crown expanded considerably, and its speed of attracting nature's spiritual energy was slightly faster than before.
Yuan Ming was both surprised and delighted.
"Gathering Spirit Objects are inherently lively and often devour each other. That white sphere was a half-finished Gathering Spirit Object and was naturally absorbed by the Gathering Spirit Tree." Kong's voice suddenly sounded.
Hearing these words, Yuan Ming felt a secret relief.
The Gathering Spirit Tree is vital to the cultivation of all cultivators in Shura Palace; as long as there are no issues, it's good.
"Senior Kong, you've finally appeared; it's been quite difficult trying to find you recently." He then said.
"I have my own matters; you need not concern yourself, just proceed at your own pace. Your cultivation has finally broken through to the Dharma Manifestation Stage, and the Undying Tree has successfully advanced, well done." Kong said with a hint of praise in his tone.
"Senior Kong asked me to stay in the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range for a hundred years, surely with a purpose? Can I wander freely next, as long as I don't leave the range?" Yuan Ming inquired.
"Yes, but you should soon go to White Emperor City; the clues to the Abyss Nether Stone will appear there soon." Kong replied.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming's face broke into a smile.
Finally, it's time to explore the Abyss Nether Stone. If this trip goes smoothly, the restrictions on the Stealing Heaven Tripod Altar can be partially restored.
"Be cautious when you reach White Emperor City. It's not like the Dongji Sea Area; don't let anyone discover the existence of the Stealing Heaven Tripod." Kong cautioned again.
Yuan Ming, naturally not reckless, agreed.
Kong's voice faded away, seemingly in a rush.
Yuan Ming did not continue to absorb the spirit vein here. The absorption over the past two days had already caused considerable impact on the spirit vein here. Continuing would undoubtedly cause irreversible damage and cause unnecessary trouble.
He formed a seal to retract the Undying Tree transformation, the gigantic tree body rapidly shrinking and soon retracting into his dantian.
The area of World Tree bark had expanded significantly, and two more strands of Ten Thousand Wood Origin Power were born, evidently nourished by the advancement of the Undying Tree.
Yuan Ming gazed at these two strands of Ten Thousand Wood Origin Power, pondering for a while but ultimately not absorbing them.
His issue with the mana vortex disturbance had been resolved, and these two strands of Ten Thousand Wood Origin might have other uses, so he decided to store them for now.
He put Lei Yu back into the Shura Palace and dispelled the Primordial Truth Formation, then flew out.
Yuan Ming's figure soon appeared at the canyon entrance, and Wu Yu and others noticed him at once, standing up to greet him.
"I am infinitely grateful for your protection." Yuan Ming quickened his pace and walked over, cupping his fists to those who had guarded him.
"A trivial matter, nothing worth mentioning. Still, congratulations to Fellow Daoist Wan on successfully advancing to the Dharma Manifestation Stage." Wu Yu spoke first.
"Brother Wan, what are you talking about? You saved my life; helping you hold the pass is only right, isn't it? Besides, I didn't actually help much; it was Fellow Daoist Xuan Ye who helped repel a level 6 demon beast when you were breaking through." Nan Shangfeng said somewhat sheepishly.
"I am deeply grateful to Fellow Daoist Xuan Ye for this favor. Is there anything I can do for you?" Yuan Ming looked towards the silver-haired man, once again cupping his fists in thanks.
"It was just a small effort... However, if you must repay someone, then you should repay Master Wu Yu. She was the one who first discovered that demon beast and also the one who instructed me to act," Xuan Ye looked towards Wu Yu and said.
"Even without today's favor as a protector, Fellow Daoist Wu has helped me considerably in the past. As long as it's within my capabilities, Fellow Daoist Wu can feel free to ask," Yuan Ming turned to Wu Yu and said earnestly.
Her beautiful eyes flickered as she spoke, "Fellow Daoist Wan, you're too kind. You are now a Dharma Manifestation Stage great power. I may indeed require your assistance in the future. However, I don't have any urgent requests at the moment. Can this promise be postponed?"
"Of course," Yuan Ming replied without hesitation.
"Then I shall thank you in advance," Wu Yu said with a rare smile.
After speaking, she looked Yuan Ming up and down, and sincerely praised, "Fellow Daoist Wan, the grandeur of your Dharma manifestation earlier could even surpass that of an ordinary mid-stage Dharma manifestation cultivator."
"Fellow Daoist Wu, you flatter me," Yuan Ming said with a slight smile.
After some casual conversation, Wu Yu and the others tacitly did not mention the Undying Giant Tree. Naturally, Yuan Ming would not bring it up either, and he said, "Fellow Daoist Wu Yu, now that matters here are concluded, shall we return to Black Tiger City together?"
"You and Fellow Daoist Nan should return first. Xuan Ye and I have other matters to attend to, so we shall take our leave," Wu Yu said.
Yuan Ming was a bit surprised to hear this but asked no more questions. He simply cupped his hands in farewell.
Wu Yu and Xuan Ye cupped their hands at Yuan Ming and Nan Shangfeng before leaving with the wind.
Nan Shangfeng watched as Wu Yu and Xuan Ye's figures became distant, his gaze lingering until they turned into a black dot on the horizon, still unwilling to look away.
"This Fellow Daoist Wu is not a simple person, and she doesn't have any romantic inclinations. It's better not to waste your feelings," Yuan Ming advised upon seeing this.
"Of course, I can see that Master Wu Yu has no interest in me. It's just that it's rare to encounter such a beauty among ten thousand, and to let her slip away like this is too much of a pity," Nan Shangfeng said with a face full of regret.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming's expression was a bit strange. He previously thought there might be genuine feelings in Nan Shangfeng's intense infatuation with Wu Yu.
Now it seems he was overthinking; Nan Shangfeng was simply fascinated by Wu Yu's beauty.
But this was his own matter. Yuan Ming didn't comment further but changed the subject, saying, "Fellow Daoist Nan, now that the curse on you has been lifted, our agreement has been fulfilled. Let's go our separate ways from here."
"What are your plans, Brother Wan?" Nan Shangfeng asked after a brief silence.
"Perhaps I'll visit various cities in the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range and then make a trip to White Emperor City," Yuan Ming said.
"If I return to Wuliang City now, I'll mostly receive scolding, so I don't want to go back for the time being. I've been to White Emperor City once before and had a good impression of it. Brother Wan, would you mind if we continue traveling together?" Nan Shangfeng said with a flattering smile.
"What are you plotting now?" Yuan Ming asked.
"There's no plot; I just feel a connection with you, Brother Wan, and want to travel together," Nan Shangfeng laughed.
"Very well, since you acted as my protector, do as you wish," Yuan Ming said nonchalantly, turning his head forward.
"I won't follow you for nothing, Brother Wan. I have no lack of Spirit Stones. Last time Xiang Mingxuan came, he brought a few billion in pocket money from home. Whatever Brother Wan needs along the way, I'll cover it all," Nan Shangfeng said with a gleam of delight, patting his chest.
"A few billion in pocket money..." Yuan Ming remained silent.
Even if he freely sold High Grade Soul Refining Pills, it would take considerable effort to earn such an amount, which was merely loose change for Nan Shangfeng.
With such robust financial backing, Yuan Ming felt his actions would be more convenient. Of course, primarily it was his positive impression of Nan Shangfeng's character over this period that made him agreeable to the company.
The two then boarded Lei Yu's back, and Lei Yu flew high into the sky, heading towards Black Tiger City.
Yuan Ming sat cross-legged at Lei Yu's neck, gazing ahead, seemingly watching for movements around, but his attention was actually focused inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
After breaking through to the Dharma Manifestation Stage, the white mist inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod receded once more, and the space inside the tripod expanded several times over.
With a thought, Yuan Ming's main soul entered the Stealing Heaven Tripod space, taking human form. He looked up and reached up into the void with his hand.
The entire Stealing Heaven Tripod space emitted a buzz like a trembling echo, and a wave of space shock spread outward.
The main soul's face lit up with joy as, after the white mist receded this time, a powerful space power was released.
This space power was quite formidable, able to suppress even Dharma Manifestation cultivators to some extent. The Stealing Heaven Tripod space finally had some semblance of a Void Palace-like Space Spiritual Treasure.
The main soul withdrew his gaze from the sky and looked around.
This time, as the Stealing Heaven Tripod space expanded, while most areas remained barren, a significant portion of Sword Trace Abyss was revealed, with a majestic golden palace being particularly noticeable.
The palace, covering several hundred zhang, was cleaved in two by the Sword Trace Abyss.
Despite being split in two, the golden palace remained imposing, evidently not an ordinary structure.

chapters.title: Chapter 916 - 886: Courting Death
chapters.content:
The main soul observed for a moment, then rose up into the air, flying towards the golden palace. However, as soon as he got close, he was blocked by an invisible barrier and could not advance an inch. His divine sense also could not probe inside.
Seeing this, the main soul immediately moved to the other side of the Sword Trace Abyss, attempting to enter from there, but was once again stopped by the invisible barrier.
The main soul's divine sense spread out, sensing this invisible barrier, and quickly discovered some traces of forbidden marks within it.
This forbidden mark was constructed extremely skillfully, seemingly far surpassing a Level 6 existence.
"Could it be a Seven-level Magic Array?" The main soul's face turned serious, yet there was a hint of excitement in his eyes.
He had an intuition that, as long as he could enter this golden hall, he might be able to fathom all the secrets of the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space.
However, a Seven-level Magic Array wasn't something that could be easily broken; any slight mistake might lead to unexpected troubles. This matter needed long-term planning.
Yuan Ming quickly retracted his main soul, glanced back at Nan Shangfeng, who was sitting cross-legged with eyes closed, and urged Lei Yu to continue on their journey.
...
Somewhere in the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range, a dozen or so figures stood sparsely. Although they appeared humanoid, each of them exuded a domineering demon energy, clearly all were Level 6 Great Demons.
Among them, a young man wearing a silver crown and a silver-white feather robe, with small eyes and an aquiline nose, was exactly the Silver Giant Bird that appeared when Yuan Ming broke through earlier.
The dozen or so people did not speak, occasionally looking towards the distance, seemingly waiting for someone.
A moment later, a silver light shot over from the horizon, and as the tunneling light converged, two figures descended; they were Wu Yu and Xuan Ye.
Wu Yu was now dressed in luxurious armor, no longer the gentle demeanor from before, as if an Empress high above, her aura imposing, looking down on all living beings.
Xuan Ye's aura also changed drastically, having reached the Level 6 realm, emanating overwhelming demon energy.
"Greetings to Her Majesty the Empress." Upon seeing this, the dozen Level 6 Great Demons all bowed and saluted exceedingly respectfully.
"How is the execution of the plan going?" Wu Yu asked blandly.
"According to your instructions, the Magic Cloud Tree Seeds have been planted near nineteen cities, now we just wait for the right moment," a black-skinned man replied in a muffled voice.
"Very well, everyone has worked hard. Just proceed according to the plan," Wu Yu nodded.
"Understood," the group of great demons replied in unison.
"Your Majesty the Empress, why didn't you let me kill that Human Clan cultivator at the Broken Dragon Canyon earlier, instead of helping him advance?" The youth in the feather robe spoke up.
At these words, the group of demons present all reacted, looking at Wu Yu together.
"That person is not an ordinary Human Clan cultivator; even if you made a move, you wouldn't be able to kill him, and it would cause considerable trouble for the Ten Thousand Demon Country," Wu Yu shook her head and said.
"A mere Human Clan cultivator, not to mention he was only in the Late Stage of Returning Void, even now that he's broken through to the Dharma manifestation Stage, he couldn't possibly be my opponent, isn't Your Majesty exaggerating a bit?" The feather-robed youth laughed heartily, as if he had heard something utterly amusing.
