"Feng Falcon, I know your strength very well, you're still not a match for that person. If you encounter him in the future, remember to keep your distance," Wu Yu's tone was as calm as ever.
The feather-robed youth's laughter ceased, a flash of fierce light passed through his eyes, and he did not refute further.
"Your Majesty the Empress, who are you talking about?" The black-skinned man asked.
"A Human Clan cultivator I just met; you all should remember his appearance. If you encounter him in the future, be cautious," Wu Yu waved her jade hand, and sparkling shards swirled in mid-air, transforming into a lifelike illusion of none other than Yuan Ming.
The illusion maintained for a few moments before transforming back into sparkling shards and vanishing without a trace.
Only a few of the great demons nodded, while the others, like the feather-robed youth, were indifferent.
"Your Majesty the Empress, just now there was news from the capital that people from the Three Realms Sect wish to see you," a gray-robed elder with a cane and a face full of wrinkles came forward and said.
"Three Realms Sect? Who are they?" Wu Yu's expression turned solemn.
"The other party didn't reveal their identity, only saying there is a major issue to discuss, and left behind this image," the gray-robed elder took out a white talisman and crushed it.
After a blinding white light flashed, an ancient black token appeared within, one side inscribed with the word "Three" and the other with a sinister Evil Ghost depiction.
"You all return to your respective clans and await orders," Wu Yu's expression changed dramatically, dispersing the white light with a wave of her hand, and said in a deep voice.
The group of demons agreed, each flying and tunneling away.
The feather-robed youth also transformed into a silver light and left. After flying a distance and ensuring he was outside the range of others' divine sense probing, he suddenly flew in another direction, a chilling murderous intent flashing in his eyes.
"Since that woman Wu Yu thinks so highly of you, I will have a look at what kind of role you truly play." The feather-robed youth was enveloped in silver light, his form rapidly swelling and transforming into the silver giant bird's true form.
The silver giant bird spread its wings, its speed suddenly multiplied several times, transforming into a silver rainbow heading straight for Black Tiger City.
...
After Lei Yu broke through to the Upper Fifth Level, his tunneling speed increased again, quickly reaching the lush forest where the Wood Demon Clan resided.
Yuan Ming did not let Lei Yu slow down or conceal their whereabouts, but instead instructed him to continue flying swiftly.
The demon beasts in the forest sensed the vast aura emanating from Yuan Ming, and all crouched low and hid, not daring to seek trouble, so naturally, the journey was uneventful.
However, after barely half an hour, Yuan Ming suddenly opened his eyes, looking back at a certain place behind them.
"What's wrong?" Nan Shangfeng noticed Yuan Ming's actions, opened his eyes, and asked.
"A Level 6 demon beast is pursuing us. It seems to be the same silver giant bird that appeared when I broke through," Yuan Ming said after pondering briefly.
"Wasn't that demon led away by Xuan Ye? Why has it returned?" Nan Shangfeng recalled the might of that silver giant bird and showed a change of color on his face.
"Let's see its intentions first." Yuan Ming decisively instructed Lei Yu to land on a flat hill, quietly waiting.
A moment later, a silver rainbow appeared on the distant horizon, then vanished into thin air, and the next second, it instantaneously arrived before the two humans and one beast, revealing the figure of a silver giant bird.
This demon raced around Yuan Ming, its silver eyes, the size of millstones, sizing him up both up and down.
"Are you a Great Demon of the Ten Thousand Demon Country? What might be your purpose here?" Yuan Ming asked calmly, his voice clear.
"To kill you!"
The Wind Falcon spoke human words, its speed suddenly multiplying several times. Its trace couldn't be seen; only dozens of giant bird illusions swirled around Yuan Ming as they raced by.
Sss...sss...sss...
Countless silver lights shot out unexpectedly from all directions, as fast as thunderbolts.
Yuan Ming, Nan Shangfeng, and Lei Yu couldn't even react before the silver light penetrated their bodies, causing a flood of blood to spill and rain down.
The Wind Falcon halted its flight, gazing at the severely injured Yuan Ming and others, slightly surprised: "Is this all you've got?"
Just at that moment, the Wind Falcon's view suddenly froze and then shattered like a mirror, leaving not even half a shadow of a person.
"Isn't it somewhat excessive, attacking indiscriminately like this? I profess to having no grudges with you." Yuan Ming's voice came from behind.
The Wind Falcon abruptly turned around to see Yuan Ming's figure standing in the void, but Lei Yu and Nan Shangfeng were nowhere to be seen.
"You're a Soul Cultivator?" The casualness left the Wind Falcon's eyes as its expression turned serious.
The body of a demon beast is inherently powerful, stronger than Human Clan's cultivators, but its divine soul is relatively weaker, thus vulnerable before a soul cultivator.
"Since you refuse to answer, I'll find out myself." Yuan Ming said casually, from his body emerged a gray-white Dharma manifestation Giant Palm, slow yet swift, striking towards the Wind Falcon.
The palm's center glimmered with swirling black light, embodying the Life and Death Reincarnation Path.
Upon breaking through to the Dharma manifestation Stage earlier, the Life and Death Reincarnation Path absorbed considerable Power of Dao, improving significantly, plus his Soul Power had greatly increased, elevating the path's power by double.
Perceiving the massive aura of the gray-white Giant Palm and Life and Death Reincarnation Path, the Wind Falcon inwardly shivered and spread its wings as it transformed into a silver shadow, effortlessly evading the Giant Palm's attack.
Yuan Ming remained indifferent, his other hand gesturing to activate the Six Jia Qimen Dao Seal from within his Nascent Soul.
The Wind Falcon's vision suddenly blurred, and Yuan Ming's figure appeared in front out of thin air.
"What! That human cultivator has such speed! No, it's me who's moved!" The Wind Falcon was startled, soon realizing the true situation.
It wasn't Yuan Ming appearing ahead but somehow, he who should've been escaping forward had reversed, plunging back.
"Giant Peak Crush!" Yuan Ming's majestic voice echoed nearby.
The Wind Falcon's body suddenly burdened, as if genuinely crushed by a giant peak, plummeting downward.
The gray-white Giant Palm continued descending, aiming for the Wind Falcon's head.
"Speak and follow!"
The Wind Falcon's anger and shock intertwined, its body barraged with silver light, transforming into seven or eight identical figures, fleeing in different directions.
"Illusion Technique?" Yuan Ming smirked, ignoring the rest as the gray-white Giant Palm heavily slammed into one giant bird.
The silver giant bird was struck as if by a meteorite, crashing heavily into the forest below.
With a "boom", the ground within dozens of miles rose and fell ceaselessly, ancient trees toppled.
The other giant birds dissolved into silver light, drifting apart.
The forest ground formed a blackened pit, with the Wind Falcon buried in the soil, half of its skeleton shattered, mouth spewing blood relentlessly.
"How could this be! A mere Dharma manifestation Stage human possesses such abilities!" The Wind Falcon was horrified, forcing itself to fly out of the pit.
"Still able to rise, worthy of a sixth-level demon." Yuan Ming murmured, his mind stirring as he activated the Annihilation Rune on the Soul Destroying Sword within his Dantian.
The Wind Falcon's vision suddenly turned pitch black, unable to see or hear anything, with its Divine Sense perceiving nothing, akin to being imprisoned in the Nine Netherworld.
The demon's body paused in mid-air, unmoving.
"Go!" Yuan Ming flicked his robe gently.
A black Sword Shadow shot out like lightning, slicing through the Wind Falcon's head, passing through as if it were an Illusion.
The Wind Falcon's eye brilliance dimmed rapidly, and its massive corpse fell from the sky without any life.
Yuan Ming waved his sleeves, shooting out a green light, capturing the Wind Falcon's corpse and storing it within the Shura Palace.
He also followed inside, raising his hand to grab the void.
Dispersed soul fragments emerged from the Wind Falcon's corpse, converging in his palm, transforming into a petite silver-white bird Illusion — the Wind Falcon's Demon Soul.
In the previous sword strike, he held back, only shattering the Wind Falcon's divine soul without entirely annihilating it.
Seldom does a sixth-level demon deliver itself to his door; he still anticipated using its Demon Soul and Demon Core to refine a Dharma Manifestation Pill.
Yet before refining, it was necessary to ascertain the demon's identity first.

chapters.title: Chapter 917 - 887: Heavenly Fire Emerges
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming thought this, and his palm flickered with black light as several small black hands emerged, merging into the Wind Falcon Demon Soul to probe its memory.
At that moment, the Wind Falcon Demon Soul suddenly trembled and then "bang" exploded into a mass of scattered soul power.
The three souls and seven spirits of the Wind Falcon completely collapsed, and its memory dissipated, making it impossible to read.
"Forbidden Spell has been cast..." Yuan Ming raised his brow slightly.
Meanwhile, thousands of miles away, above a dense forest, Wu Yu held a shattered black token in his hand, his expression devoid of joy or sorrow.
"The Wind Falcon was a young genius of the Peng Clan, fallen like this. I'm afraid they will cause trouble," Xuan Ye, standing beside him, said with some concern.
"It's no matter; the Five Royal Families have become increasingly arrogant and unruly in recent years. Wind Falcon's death serves as a good reminder to them," Wu Yu said casually as he tossed away the shattered token.
Xuan Ye said no more upon hearing his words.
Yuan Ming soon emerged from the Shura Palace, along with Lei Yu and Nan Shangfeng.
"Let's go," he instructed, playing with a shiny silver storage bracelet, which belonged to the Wind Falcon.
The wealth of a sixth-level great demon was immense, not to mention the Heavenly Materials and Earthly Treasures, there were at least twenty to thirty million spirit stones alone, filling his once empty pockets.
Lei Yu let out an excited screech, spreading its wings as it continued towards Black Tiger City.
Nan Shangfeng said nothing, sitting quietly on Lei Yu's back, occasionally glancing at Yuan Ming's back with a hint of reverence in his eyes.
He had not seen Yuan Ming and Wind Falcon's battle firsthand, but the fight ended so swiftly with Yuan Ming unscathed, seemingly without much effort, which spoke volumes.
The journey that followed was uneventful, and the two humans and one beast returned to Black Tiger City after several days.
Yuan Ming did not go to Wu Yu's residence; he found an inn to stay at and then visited the branch of the Ten Thousand Goods Immortal Trip, continuing to use his status as Guest Elder to ask the branch for assistance in purchasing high-level spirit wood and other spiritual materials needed for the Moon God Ring.
The steward of the Ten Thousand Goods Immortal Trip at this location was familiar with Yuan Ming and agreed readily.
Yuan Ming then returned to the inn, went to his room, and entered the Shura Palace directly.
In the canyon, due to time constraints and borrowing the power of the underground spirit vein, his mana was only initially stabilized, and he naturally needed time to further consolidate it.
In the secret chamber of the Medicine Garden Cave Mansion, he sat cross-legged, hands forming a breathing control pose, eyes slightly closed, observing internally the scene within his dantian.
The nascent soul that had greatly changed in appearance had already resumed a cross-legged position, sitting quietly.
Not far behind it, the mana vortex turned rapidly, transforming into a swirling ring of white light, floating gently.
A glance showed the mana vortex glowing with radiance, stably inhaling and exhaling nature's spiritual energy, becoming even more perfect, as if forged by Heaven, flawless.
Yuan Ming willed it, and the speed of the mixed hole vortex began to accelerate, and the surrounding spiritual energy surged in, being swallowed like a whale.
Compared to before, the sense of chaotic turbulence caused by the massive consumption of spiritual power could hardly be felt anymore.
Yuan Ming nodded; after absorbing the power of Dao, this mana vortex was indeed becoming more stable, seemingly never to become unstable again.
He closed his eyes, entering a state of cultivation.
Seven days later, Yuan Ming's realm was thoroughly stabilized, much faster than Yun Luo Fairy when she broke through to the Dharma manifestation Stage.
He did not leave but instead took out the Stealing Heaven Tripod, lit the black incense, and possessed Guoguo.
When his gaze fell upon the silver cat, he saw endless blue sky, heard the rushing wind, and smelled a faintly lingering feminine fragrance.
After looking around, he realized he was being held by Xi Ying, standing on the deck of a Sky-controlling Ferry.
Originally surveying the distance, Xi Ying sensed the abnormal soul wave emanating from Guoguo and slowly retracted her gaze, looking down just as Guoguo looked up.
Her and Yuan Ming's gazes seemed to traverse endless distances, meeting each other.
Xi Ying's eyes carried a trace of smile, she hugged Guoguo and returned to the room, lifted her hand to activate the array that prevented probing.
"I have broken through to the Dharma manifestation Stage," Yuan Ming immediately shared the good news with her.
Hearing this, Xi Ying's expression was briefly stunned, then turned to sincere joy.
Xi Ying had always known of Yuan Ming's cultivation progress; she just didn't expect he would advance to the Dharma manifestation Stage so quickly.
"Faster than I expected, which is a good thing. After advancing to the Dharma manifestation Stage, facing the people from White Emperor City and Heavenly Dragon Hall will be less passive," Xi Ying nodded and said.
"While breaking through to the Dharma manifestation Stage, my Transplanting Technique and Planting Beans into Soldiers Divine Power also condensed Dao Seals, enhancing their powers, only Eyes of Golden Flame is still lacking. And during this time..." Unconsciously, Yuan Ming had grown accustomed to telling Xi Ying all his recent circumstances in detail.
After arriving at the Central Continent, they had become the only ones they could rely on.
Xi Ying did not interrupt, listening quietly until he finished, then shared her recent circumstances with Yuan Ming as well.
"Are you saying you've reached Locking City in southwestern Central Continent and are on your way to the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range?" Yuan Ming asked delightedly halfway through hearing her update.
"Yes, in about half a year, I should be able to reach White Emperor City," Xi Ying said.
"Great, I'm also planning to stay in the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range for a hundred years. We can finally meet," Yuan Ming said happily.
"You're planning to stay in the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range for a hundred years?" Xi Ying asked in surprise.
Guoguo nodded anthropomorphically, explaining the requirements of the senior "Void" to Xi Ying.
Upon hearing this, Xi Ying just nodded without saying much.
"Afterward, I plan to visit White Emperor City and expect to stay there for a long period. Let's agree to meet there, shall we?" Yuan Ming proposed.
"Alright," Xi Ying readily agreed.
After returning to his senses, Yuan Ming began to ponder.
Since Xi Ying was about to arrive, he didn't plan to wander to other cities and decided to head straight to White Emperor City.
He got up and went to Nan Shangfeng's residence to inform him of his plan.
"If you're going to White Emperor City, no need to trouble Lei Yu. There's a teleportation array in Black Tiger City that connects to White Emperor City. We can use the teleportation array to go directly there," Nan Shangfeng immediately suggested upon hearing Yuan Ming's intention to go to White Emperor City.
"A teleportation array? That's convenient," Yuan Ming nodded thoughtfully.
"Yes, this teleportation array was built in recent years and isn't always available. If I remember correctly, it opens only once every three months. So... rest here for now and let me find out the timing," Nan Shangfeng volunteered.
"Alright, I'll leave this matter to you," Yuan Ming naturally had no objections.
As Nan Shangfeng left, Yuan Ming didn't stay at the inn either and went to the Ten Thousand Goods Immortal Trip to collect goods.
This time, the Ten Thousand Goods Immortal Trip didn't yield much, gathering only four or five pieces of high-level spirit wood, and there were only two spiritual materials for the Moon God Ring.
Feeling somewhat disappointed, Yuan Ming paid the spirit stones and returned to the inn.
Not long after, Nan Shangfeng returned and informed Yuan Ming that the next teleportation was in half a month.
Yuan Ming then stopped worrying about the matter and continued to focus on his cultivation.
However, just two days later, Nan Shangfeng hurriedly found Yuan Ming.
"Brother Wan, there's been a mistake, a mistake. We must hurry to arrange the teleportation procedures," he said anxiously upon meeting him.
"What happened?" Yuan Ming frowned and asked.
"There's news that Heavenly Fire has emerged from the depths of the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range. This news has already spread in Black Tiger City. Those who have heard will certainly head to White Emperor City; I'm afraid the teleportation slots will be snatched up long before the teleportation day," Nan Shangfeng said anxiously.
"The Heavenly Fire has finally appeared!" Yuan Ming instantly understood the situation and, without hesitation, followed Nan Shangfeng out.
Sure enough, when they arrived at the City Lord's Mansion, a long queue had already formed outside the pavilion that managed the teleportation array, with people lining up to book teleportation slots.
"How many slots are there?" Yuan Ming asked with a frown.
"The teleportation array opens once every three months, operates for ten rounds each time, and can only teleport thirty people per round, so there are only three hundred slots in total," Nan Shangfeng explained.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming frowned even deeper, seeing that the line outside exceeded three hundred people.
As he was pondering, he suddenly felt someone tugging at his sleeve.
Yuan Ming looked in confusion to find Nan Shangfeng winking, signaling him to follow.
Then, Nan Shangfeng led him around to another large hall at the back of the pavilion.
As soon as they entered, an impatient voice sounded inside, "Out, out, this is not a reception area. If you want to purchase teleportation slots, go to the front Transmission Hall."
A young man with short eyebrows, showing a face full of impatience, walked out while yawning.
Nan Shangfeng showed no awareness of being driven away. He approached with a smile and, before the young man could wave him off, grabbed his hand and slipped several high-quality spirit stones into his sleeve.
"I'm acquainted with your steward elder. Can you take us to meet them?" Nan Shangfeng grinned.
The young man felt the items in his sleeve, his face first stiffening, then easing, and his impatience disappeared.
"Oh... I see, that's no problem. I'll take you to meet them; it's only right for old friends to catch up," the short-browed young man said, suddenly understanding.
He then led the way in front.
Nan Shangfeng caught up again, grabbing his sleeve and slipping in a dozen more spirit stones, smiling as he asked, "I forgot the name of the steward elder, could you remind me?"
Yuan Ming was stunned upon hearing this.
Not knowing the name – how could they be acquaintances?
The short-browed young man's expression twitched slightly, but perhaps to save face, he didn't turn angry, whispering, "How could you forget? Elder Duan is such a good person."
"Yes, yes, I won't forget. Thank you," Nan Shangfeng chuckled.
Then they were led to the inner hall of the large hall, and the short-browed young man announced their presence and opened the door to the inner hall.

chapters.title: Chapter 918 - 888: Supreme Yang Spirit Vein
chapters.content:
Nan Shangfeng, being accustomed to this sort of situation, was the first to walk into the inner hall. Upon seeing the fat middle-aged man seated behind the desk, he immediately spoke with a smile:
"Hehe, Elder Duan, it's been years since we last met, but you seem just as spirited as ever."
The latter's cheeks twitched at these words but he didn't expose his lie.
"Since you are an old acquaintance, just speak directly about your business. For the sake of old times, I'll help you as much as I can," Elder Duan said, glancing at the two of them with a calm demeanor.
"Elder Duan, you are straightforward. We need to make a trip to White Emperor City and would like to reserve two transmission slots from you," Nan Shangfeng said.
"Oh, it's about that, is it... Though it's not a big deal, you know the current situation. It's not so easy," Elder Duan frowned, looking very troubled.
"Elder Duan, we're all old friends; naturally, we won't make things difficult for you," Nan Shangfeng said, taking out a storage bag and placing it on the table with a light pat.
Elder Duan coughed twice, showing a slight smile on his face, pressing his hand over the storage bag.
After a brief inspection, his eyes lit up, clearly satisfied with what Nan Shangfeng had given him. He then slowly stowed it away, taking out two transmission tokens and placing them on the table.
"Gentlemen, it's purely for the sake of old acquaintances that I'm helping you. Make sure to come on time in a few days; don't miss the schedule, or it won't be something an old acquaintance can fix. Otherwise, you can only wait for three months before another transmission is possible," Elder Duan reminded them.
"Thank you, Elder Duan, for your reminder and kindness. We will remember it well," Nan Shangfeng said with a smile, clasping his hands.
As the two walked out of the inner hall, they saw several other people being led in by the short-browed youth, who, after exchanging some courtesies, were led to the door of the inner hall.
"How much did it cost?" Yuan Ming asked after they walked out of the main hall.
"Ten times the usual price. But as long as it's done, it's worth the expense," Nan Shangfeng smiled, not minding too much.
Several days later, Yuan Ming and Nan Shangfeng arrived punctually at the City Lord Mansion's Transmission Hall.
After being inspected by the Demon Mirror once more, they stepped into the teleportation array together, being transported to White Emperor City.
...
"Please, both of you, do not linger on the transmission array to avoid affecting the next round of transmission."
Just as Yuan Ming and Nan Shangfeng arrived at White Emperor City, without even getting a clear view of the scenery around the teleportation array, a cultivator approached them, half-reminded, half-forced, pushing them off the array.
Because Yuan Ming had hidden his cultivation level, the person did not recognize him as a Dharma Phase cultivator.
Seeing this, Nan Shangfeng looked slightly displeased.
"Let's go; there's someone waiting for us outside," Yuan Ming, however, did not feel offended but merely glanced around at the decorations before speaking softly.
Nan Shangfeng was slightly taken aback, but seeing Yuan Ming walking out, he said no more and hurriedly followed.
As they walked out of the Transmission Hall's doors, the dazzling sunlight poured from the sky, giving a slightly dazzling yet cozy warm feeling.
After a brief adaptation, the entire scenery of White Emperor City unfolded before their eyes.
With pavilions and towers accompanying the mountains, crisscrossing corridors and pathways, countless cultivators maneuvered their magic artifacts, flying back and forth between the mountains, yet all slowed down their speed, appearing like a stream of vehicles and horses forming a line in the sky.
"No matter how many times I see it, the scenery of White Emperor City never fails to impress," Nan Shangfeng couldn't help but marvel.
Yuan Ming, however, did not focus on the scenery of White Emperor City but instead looked around, quickly spotting the person he was looking for.
"Haha, Brother Wan, I finally caught up with you," Before Yuan Ming could speak, the person walked over with a smile. It was Wulu.
Before coming here, Yuan Ming had already communicated with him in advance and specially advised him not to call him by his real name.
"Who might this be..." Nan Shangfeng, however, was unaware of this and was instantly puzzled.
"My surname is Wu, I am a close friend of Brother Wan, and I've been residing in White Emperor City for quite some time, so I'm somewhat of a local. Upon hearing of Fellow Daoist Wan's arrival, I specially came here to welcome him," Before Yuan Ming could speak, Wulu proactively explained.
"I see, I am Nan Shangfeng, nice to meet Fellow Daoist Wu," Nan Shangfeng realized and introduced himself.
"I've heard about you from Fellow Daoist Wan, no need to be so polite. By the way, do you have a place to stay in White Emperor City? If not, why not stay at my place with Fellow Daoist Wan," Wulu warmly invited.
"This... then I'll trouble Fellow Daoist Wu. Consider this compensation for the disturbance, please accept it," Seeing that Yuan Ming had no objections, Nan Shangfeng also agreed and moved over, taking out a storage ring and placing it in Wulu's hand.
Wulu took the ring, inspected it with his divine sense, and his smile became even warmer.
"Come, come, I'll take you to the cave mansion right away," He stored the storage ring away and said at the same time.
Yuan Ming nodded and followed Wulu with Nan Shangfeng.
"Ah, I almost forgot to ask, which district is Fellow Daoist's Cave Mansion located in?" On the road, Nan Shangfeng suddenly asked.
"Rest assured, it's in Yuanjian District," Wulu turned his head and said.
"Are there differences between the different districts?" Yuan Ming asked.
"Naturally there are. White Emperor City divides the living areas for cultivators into five major districts. From bottom to top, the concentration of spiritual energy gradually increases. Yuanjian District ranks second, just after the Heavenly Sword District," Wulu explained.
"Getting a Cave Mansion in the Heavenly Sword District is not easy. Besides needing Spirit Stones, you also need sound connections," Nan Shangfeng added.
"Speaking of which, the Power of the Sun here seems to be richer than in other places," Yuan Ming noted and asked about another topic.
"Fellow Daoist Wan is indeed perceptive, able to sense even such subtle differences. Yes, because there is a Supreme Yang Spirit Vein in the city, the Power of the Sun here is naturally denser than elsewhere. However, later the City Lord put in great effort to build a Fierce Sun Pond, concentrating the power of the spirit vein. When it's not activated, the Power of the Sun in the city isn't as dense as before," Wulu said.
"Why did the City Lord do that?" Yuan Ming asked, curious.
"Of course, it's for cultivation. It's said that the main cultivation technique he practices is called the Great Sun Golden True Technique, which requires a large amount of solar power during cultivation. The Fierce Sun Pond was also built to assist his cultivation," Wulu said casually.
Yuan Ming nodded thoughtfully and asked no more questions. Soon, they arrived in front of Wulu's Cave Mansion.
"My Cave Mansion is spacious. The two rooms in the southeast have already been prepared. Brother Wan and Fellow Daoist Nan can stay there," Wulu brought Yuan Ming and another person into the Cave Mansion and pointed it out.
"Alright, then I'll go rest and not disturb your catch-up." Seeing this, Nan Shangfeng courteously cupped his hands and left, entering his own room.
After he left, Wulu's previously cheerful face changed instantly. He raised his hand and activated the forbidden barrier in the mansion, isolating Nan Shangfeng's room to ensure no sound could leak in.
"What does Brother Yuan plan to do about this person?" Wulu asked in a low voice.
"He has indeed helped me a lot. Though along the way, he's been obedient, so let him be and treat him as an ordinary friend," Yuan Ming shook his head.
"But the Daluo Sect isn't easy to deal with. Besides, you've mentioned that he's currently involved in inheritance squabbles, which could easily bring us trouble," Wulu said with some concern.
"As long as he doesn't show himself, there won't be any trouble," Yuan Ming replied.
"But I can see he seems to have some plans as well. There might be other ties involved," Wulu still insisted.
"As long as he stays put, we won't bother with him. Otherwise, let him face his own fate," Yuan Ming thought for a moment and said.
Wulu nodded, understanding Yuan Ming's thought process and hearing the implied meaning.
"What is the current situation with the Heavenly Fire?" Yuan Ming asked at this moment.
"From the information gathered so far, the Heavenly Fire seemed to have appeared for a while in the Fire Rock Desert but quickly disappeared. Now, many cultivators have already gone there to investigate," Wulu said, taking out a map and pointing out the location for Yuan Ming.
"Aside from that, is there any other information?" Yuan Ming nodded slightly.
"No, I've checked everything. The other things are unreliable rumors. Only this place has confirmed information. So, what do you think, should we go and take a look?" Wulu asked.
"No need, let's wait for Xi Ying to come back, meet with her first, and ask for her opinion," Yuan Ming thought for a while and shook his head.
Wulu naturally had no objections to this.
After they finished discussing business, they chatted aimlessly, drank, and reminisced, not returning to their rooms until the moon began to rise.
Yuan Ming sat back in his room, summoned his mana to dispel the effects of the alcohol, and then began to contemplate alone.
His current path in Magic Practice has already surpassed Dharma manifestation, and there is no room for improvement in a short time. To strengthen himself, he must focus on Body Cultivation and Soul Cultivation.
Due to the lack of a cultivation technique in Soul Cultivation, he couldn't advance further. After pondering, he decided to first focus on improving Body Cultivation.
But this means he needed a lot of solar power to temper his physical body.
In this way, the Supreme Yang Spirit Vein in White Emperor City becomes particularly useful to him.
However, the White Emperor City Lord considers the Supreme Yang Spirit Vein a private treasure and has built the Fierce Sun Pond. Trying to get a share might not be easy.
Yuan Ming thought for a moment, then suddenly pinched a technique, and an Undying Tree Root sprouted from his right leg, breaking through the void, exploring and extending underground in White Emperor City.
Soon, following the trail of the Power of the Sun, the Undying Tree Root found the location of the Supreme Yang Spirit Vein—right beneath White Emperor City Main Peak.
Within the spirit vein, the Power of the Sun had almost condensed into a liquid, flowing and rippling like river water.
However, right at the center of the spirit vein, a Bronze Square Pool cut the spirit vein in half. Countless runes were engraved on the pool, and spiritual light tendrils resembling pipelines were fiercely embedded into the spirit vein from both sides, continuously extracting the Power of the Sun and channeling it into the pool.

chapters.title: Chapter 919 - 889: Good Stuff
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming, relying on the Undying Tree Roots, discerned the situation within the Spirit Vein. Seeing no shadow in the Bronze Square Pool, and seemingly no guards around, thoughts churned in his mind. Finally, he couldn't resist and reached towards the Spirit Vein.
But in the next instant, the Undying Tree Roots he just extended seemed to hit a steel wall, being stopped in place.
Near the Spirit Vein, a vague pale yellow mist floated out, blocking the Undying Tree Roots and then swiftly dissipating.
"This Forbidden..." Yuan Ming furrowed his brows slightly and once again stimulated the roots, employing the Breaking Space Power.
However, the space near the Spirit Vein was as solid as iron. No matter how Yuan Ming urged it, he couldn't open a single pathway to let the roots pass through the Forbidden and delve into the Spirit Vein.
Unwilling to give up, Yuan Ming tried several more times, ultimately sighing helplessly and retracting the roots.
This was the first time he encountered a Forbidden that the Undying Tree Roots couldn't penetrate. He wondered if using the Sky-reaching Demon Pillar would make a difference.
However, such a high-level Forbidden, once breached, would surely be noticed by others, contrary to Yuan Ming's idea of secretly stealing the Power of the Sun.
"Better plan this for the long term."
Yuan Ming sighed deeply in his heart, resumed his seated position, and silently began cultivating.
"Boy, tomorrow at Chen hour, make your way to the marketplace east of White Emperor City." At this moment, Kong's voice suddenly echoed.
"Senior, have you perhaps discovered the whereabouts of another treasure?" Yuan Ming hurriedly asked.
"You'll know when you go." Kong didn't elaborate, then fell silent again.
The next day, at the beginning of Chen hour.
Yuan Ming left the Wulu Cave Mansion alone, following Kong's instructions, arriving at the marketplace located on the eastern side of White Emperor City.
Since it was still early, there weren't many stallholders yet. Yuan Ming wandered aimlessly, passing several stalls, all with unremarkable items.
"Senior Kong, what is it exactly you're having me look for here?" Yuan Ming couldn't help but whisper.
"Continue east. The stall on the far left, the owner wearing beast skin." Kong still didn't clearly state, just instructed.
Curiously, Yuan Ming moved forward and soon saw the stall Kong had mentioned.
Surprisingly, that beast-skin-wearing stall owner seemed to have just arrived as well, taking out items to sell one by one.
Feigning indifference, Yuan Ming loitered nearby, yet his Divine Sense constantly enveloped the stall, carefully inspecting every item.
"This is... Snow Jade!" When the stall owner took out a pale white jade, completely crystalline and exuding waves of cold air, Yuan Ming's eyes immediately brightened.
"Fellow Daoist, how much for this Jade?" He quickly stepped forward and asked the price.
"Five thousand Spirit Stones, no negotiation. Don't complain it's expensive. After all, this is my..." the beast-skin-clad man began to say.
"I'll take it." Without waiting for him to finish, Yuan Ming directly tossed a Storage Bag filled with Spirit Stones, took the Jade, and turned to leave.
The beast-skin man instinctively caught the Storage Bag, quickly counted it, confirmed the quantity was correct, and wanted to say something, yet could only watch Yuan Ming's receding figure.
Did I sell it too cheap?
He thought with some regret, wanting to catch up and reclaim the item from Yuan Ming, but for some reason, whenever this notion arose, he'd feel an indescribable terror.
Hesitating for a while, he ended up muttering a few curses, then sat back in a sulk, blaming only his poor judgement, unable to recognize true treasures.
On the other side, Yuan Ming, who had purchased the Jade, was quite pleased.
"Senior Kong, your investigative abilities are astonishing, always the first to know where the treasures are! If you have time, perhaps you could help me find more treasures. I'll try to give you more Vow Power Pills in return, never letting you act without reward." Yuan Ming sighed and let other thoughts arise.
"Cease your wishful thinking. Exercising my Divine Skills to seek items consumes a lot each time. If not for fulfilling promises, I wouldn't act lightly." Kong mercilessly quashed Yuan Ming's fantasies.
Yuan Ming also knew persuading someone like Kong with such high stature wasn't easy. For now, he could only wait for when Kong had needs, and then attempt some negotiation.
After this little interlude, Yuan Ming didn't immediately return but strolled around the marketplace, gaining insights into the White Emperor City's atmosphere from the side.
Unknowingly, Yuan Ming arrived outside a uniquely styled pavilion, resembling a mighty eagle with spread wings.
Looking up, he saw a Southern Wood tablet held in the eagle's beak, inscribed with "Ten Thousand Goods Immortal Trip."
With its business scope covering the entire Chuyun Realm, it's natural for there to be a branch of Ten Thousand Goods Immortal Trip in White Emperor City, which, from the exterior, appeared even more luxurious than the branch in Dongji Sea.
After some thought, Yuan Ming quickly stepped inside, entering the shop.
"Is the steward here?" Yuan Ming casually called over a clerk, briefly displaying his Minister Token.
The clerk, upon seeing it, hurriedly invited Yuan Ming into the inner hall and went to fetch the steward.
"Haha, I've long heard our establishment gained a remarkably capable Guest Elder. Now that I see you, it's truly extraordinary." Moments later, an old Daoist in robes, thin and holding a duster, came over with a smile.
"And you are...?" Yuan Ming saw his attire and was instantly puzzled.
"I am Hou Luyuan, serving under orders from the headquarters to oversee this place, temporarily taking the steward's position," the Daoist in robes said.
The Novel will be updated first on this website. Come back and continue reading tomorrow, everyone!

chapters.title: Chapter 920 - 889: Good Stuff (Part 2)
chapters.content:
"Holding a temporary position? Is it because of the heavenly fire incident?" Yuan Ming saw that his mana had reached the peak of returning to void and immediately understood.
"Fellow Daoist Wan has sharp insight. The heavenly fire affair has been causing a stir, happening right in the critical area of White Emperor City. The store managers are really not at ease, so they sent me first to check the situation." Hou Luyuan explained.
"I see, but I came today mainly to purchase some items, and since you have other pressing tasks, I dare not trouble you." Yuan Ming said politely.
"No matter, the heavenly fire has yet to appear, and I am free for the moment. Besides, I am responsible for this area and must be diligent. Just tell me what you need, and I will have someone find it." Hou Luyuan replied.
Hearing this, Yuan Ming did not hold back, listing out several required items. Besides the high-level spirit wood he's been seeking, he mentioned Nine Nether Iron and the remaining spiritual materials needed to refine the Moon God Ring.
"The spiritual materials you requested are quite precious, and the store has limited stock, so it will take some time to gather them." Hou Luyuan said with some apology.
"That's fine, just collect them all and pass them to me when ready." Yuan Ming, having collected these in several cities, knew it would take time.
"Thank you for your understanding. Speaking of high-level spirit wood, I do have a piece of unknown origin on hand. Would Fellow Daoist Wan be interested?" Hou Luyuan said with a bit of delight and then a hint of embarrassment.
"Oh, may I have a look first?" Yuan Ming nodded.
Hou Luyuan waved his right hand, and a jade box about a foot high and three feet long appeared on the table.
As he gently opened the lid of the jade box, a faint ancient aura wafted out, and Yuan Ming focused his gaze.
Inside the wooden box lay a trunk, as thick as a bowl and two feet long, with an aged, rough appearance, its color between green and gray.
In an instant, Yuan Ming felt the bark of the World Tree in his dantian world stir, spurring the undying tree roots and vines to desperately break through the void, to entwine this tree branch and devour it completely.
"This is the World Tree!" Although his face showed no change, his heart was in turmoil.
The last time he only obtained a piece of the World Tree's bark, cultivating it brought countless benefits, and here lay a piece this thick!
Yuan Ming suppressed his excitement, maintaining a calm face, examining the branch as if seeing it for the first time before slowly speaking:
"I can't discern much, but this trunk seems quite ancient and might be useful. I'll buy it; how much does Fellow Daoist want for it?"
"Since you favor it, the price is negotiable. I heard you previously sold a batch of high-grade soul refining pills here, and should still have some in reserve. I'll ask for no more, just twenty pieces, and this branch is yours." Hou Luyuan closed the jade box with the appearance of offering a bargain.
Yuan Ming glanced at Hou Luyuan, noting how the aura of the World Tree fragment was restrained, bearing no distinct characteristic other than appearing ancient. Hou Luyuan indeed grasped the opportunity, daring to set such a high price.
Of course, if Hou Luyuan knew this branch was a fragment of the World Tree, even two hundred pieces might not suffice.
"Twenty high-grade soul refining pills? You're really opening the lion's mouth, do you perhaps know its origin?" Yuan Ming laughed mockingly.
"This, I'm also unaware of its origin, but I've tested it with true fire, thunder strikes, and water submersion, yet nothing can shake it, so its origin must be extraordinary." A hint of embarrassment flashed across Hou Luyuan's face.
"So even Fellow Daoist Hou doesn't know, you're really fleecing me here; no matter what, I am the Guest Elder of the Ten Thousand Goods Immortal Trip." Yuan Ming said flatly.
"If Fellow Daoist feels it's too high, we can agree on fifteen high-grade soul refining pills." Hou Luyuan conceded, admitting his initial asking price was steep.
"Fifteen soul refining pills are worth 15 million spirit stones, enough to buy several prime spiritual treasures. You might as well keep this item." Yuan Ming waved him off.
"Then ten high-grade soul refining pills." Hou Luyuan pondered momentarily before saying.
"I've run out of high-grade soul refining pills, let's settle it with spirit stones, three million spirit stones." Yuan Ming proposed.
"No high-grade soul refining pills? Then twelve million spirit stones, no less." Hou Luyuan said firmly, after a brief pause.
He noticed that although Yuan Ming said no, he continued negotiating, clearly intending to buy.
"The business I did with your Ten Thousand Goods Immortal Trip recently was quite profitable for you. If Fellow Daoist Hou truly wants to seal this deal, offer a sincere price." Yuan Ming, seeing his intent recognized, did not pretend anymore.
"Ten million spirit stones." Hou Luyuan considered for a moment and said.
"Four million spirit stones."
"Nine million..."
After some back-and-forth negotiations, Yuan Ming reluctantly agreed to a price of eight million spirit stones.
"For Fellow Daoist Hou, eight million it is, but I don't have that much on hand. How about this, I pay five million spirit stones now, and the remaining three million upon my next collection of materials; what does Fellow Daoist Hou think?" Yuan Ming suggested after some thought.
"Agreed." Hou Luyuan nodded without hesitation, pushing the jade box towards Yuan Ming.
"Are you not worried I won't pay the rest?" Yuan Ming was a bit taken aback.
"I trust Fellow Daoist Wan, as well as the token in your hand." Hou Luyuan chuckled.
Understanding dawned on Yuan Ming, and without further ado, he took out five pieces of high-grade soul refining pills before putting away the jade box.
"Does Fellow Daoist Wan have accommodations in the city, or would you like me to arrange a cave mansion in the Yuanjian District?" Hou Luyuan, rising to see him off, inquired courteously along the way.
Yuan Ming politely declined, and soon left the Ten Thousand Goods Immortal Trip, returning to Wulu's cave mansion.
After informing Wulu, he entered the secret chamber within the cave mansion, setting up several prohibitions before eagerly taking out the branch of the World Tree to inspect.
The undying tree in his dantian was now frantically writhing its roots and vines, seemingly eager to manifest and devour the branch.
Yuan Ming didn't keep it waiting long, staring at the branch for a moment before willing himself into the undying tree form. Innumerable roots and vines spread out, completely enveloping the World Tree branch in his hand.
In an instant, an ancient aura from times immemorial poured out, and Yuan Ming's vision once again revealed the hazy scene of the World Tree's birth.
Meanwhile, the World Tree in his grasp melted into a misty light of chaos, swiftly merging into the World Tree bark.
The Ten Thousand Wood Origin within the World Tree's bark expanded visibly, and the bark itself rapidly grew.

chapters.title: Chapter 921 - 890: Whereabouts in Doubt
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming didn't know how much time had passed when the illusions before his eyes rapidly faded, and his vision returned to clarity.
He slightly lowered his head and discovered that the Undying Tree he had transformed into had now got half of its trunk turned into the color of the World Tree.
The entire Undying Tree was shrouded in a faint ancient aura, as if it had become half a World Tree.
The roots of the Undying Tree had also noticeably changed, becoming more robust and resilient compared to before.
"Indeed, to let the World Tree grow rapidly, one must find other fragments of the World Tree." Yuan Ming thought to himself.
As he was observing the changes in the Undying Tree, he suddenly discovered that inside the World Tree, fifteen strands of green light from the Ten Thousand Wood Origin had been born; along with the two strands produced when he broke through to the Dharma manifestation stage, he now had seventeen strands of Ten Thousand Wood Origin light in his hand.
Yuan Ming was overjoyed and then pondered deeply.
Now that his Mana vortex was stable, he didn't need these Ten Thousand Wood Origin lights, and saving them would do no good, so it would be better to use them.
Thinking of this, Yuan Ming disbanded the Undying Tree transformation and channeled these strands of Ten Thousand Wood Origin light into his body.
The seventeen strands of Ten Thousand Wood Origin light surged forth, rushing into his body along the connection between Yuan Ming's body and the Undying Tree.
In an instant, Yuan Ming felt his Mana and Qi-Blood power being constantly condensed and compacted by the rushing Tend of Ten Thousand Wood Origin force.
It wasn't his first time using the Ten Thousand Wood Origin force, but using seventeen strands in one go was unprecedented, making his body quite overwhelmed, and he started cultivating to refine it.
After a whole hour, his internal Mana and Qi-Blood power finally calmed down.
Upon sensing the state of his Mana, it was now refined to an unbelievable level, almost surpassing the level expected of the Dharma manifestation stage, and it operated several times faster than before.
Although he hadn't attempted yet, he could feel that using his current Mana to wield magic power would significantly enhance its strength.
The Mana vortex in his Dantian was more stable, its operation becoming smoother and more fluid.
Not only was his Mana refined, but his Qi-Blood was also exceedingly refined, even surpassing his Mana, reaching a certain extreme state.
As Yuan Ming activated his Qi-Blood power, an intense sense of hunger permeated his Divine Soul, almost overwhelming his will, frantically craving the cleansing and irrigation of the Power of the Sun.
"What's happening? Is the Qi-Blood over-refined?" Yuan Ming frowned and transformed again into the Undying Tree.
A series of green-grey roots spread outward, piercing through the void, drawing in the Power of the Sun from the void.
However, this bit of the Power of the Sun was too little, not even enough to fill the gaps in his teeth.
Driven by hunger, the roots of the Undying Tree spread out instinctively, rapidly burrowing underground, rushing toward the location of the Supreme Yang Spirit Vein.
A few breaths later, the roots of the Undying Tree again reached the top of the Supreme Yang Spirit Vein, and without hesitation, they stabbed towards the Sun-like flowing power within the vein.
As expected, the Forbidden space restriction reappeared, and a hazy light-yellow mist instantly appeared before the roots, attempting to block them.
However, with more than half of its trunk transformed into the World Tree, the ability of the roots of the Undying Tree to pierce the void had greatly improved, advancing forward without hesitation.
The previously indestructible Space Restriction was like tofu before the roots of the current Undying Tree, unable to withstand even a moment.
The Undying Tree roots made contact with the Supreme Yang Spirit Vein, greedily absorbing the surging Power of the Sun within, with warm sunlight-like power flowing into Yuan Ming's body, swiftly alleviating the hunger pangs, continuously refining and transforming his body and Qi-Blood power.
Yuan Ming was intoxicated both physically and mentally, unable to resist indulging in it.
"Hmm?"
However, at that moment, a soft hum of doubt suddenly emanated from the center of the Supreme Yang Spirit Vein's Fierce Sun Pond.
The next moment, a turbulent Divine Sense spread out from the Fierce Sun Pond, quickly discovering the roots of the Undying Tree stealing the Power of the Sun.
Soon after, several brilliant golden spirit lights rose from the Fierce Sun Pond, condensing into a gigantic Golden Light Dharma manifestation in the air, surrounded by ten Spirit Light Magic Swords of various designs, rotating like a halo continuously.
A formidable Spiritual Pressure emanated from the Dharma manifestation, striking terror in the heart.
The Dharma manifestation looked at the roots of the Undying Tree and waved its hand, instantly sending out three Spirit Light Magic Swords from its back, slicing towards the roots, striking right at the ends.
However, this attack utterly failed to breach the defense of the roots; it couldn't even cut off a single fragment, and the Spirit Light Magic Swords shattered instead, vanishing into thin air.
The Undying Tree suddenly received a blow, but even without its defense broken, it still startled Yuan Ming awake.
Having been nourished by the Power of the Sun, his consciousness immediately cleared as well.
Yuan Ming's heart throbbed wildly, and with a thought, he quickly withdrew the Undying Tree along with its roots entirely, leaving no trace behind.
It wasn't until his trace was entirely gone that a figure slowly ascended from the Fierce Sun Pond, coming to the place where the roots had just been—it was Jin Chen, the son of the White Emperor City Lord.
His gaze swept over the marks of battle left nearby, and his expression became increasingly grave.
"Chen E'r, what happened? Why did you attack so suddenly?" At this moment, Jin Mu, the White Emperor City Lord, appeared in a flash and asked in a deep voice.
"Someone secretly entered the Spirit Vein, trying to steal the Power of the Sun within it while I was cultivating." Jin Chen briefly explained what had just happened.
"You couldn't even inflict a wound on them? Did you hold back?" Jin Mu immediately frowned.
"I didn't. The situation was sudden, and I thought enemies were attacking, even using the Dharma manifestation." Jin Chen shook his head slightly.
"To endure an attack from you, that demon must be of the Dharma manifestation Stage as well. However, the demon energy left here... seems completely different from the Giant Tree King." Jin Mu looked around.
"Hmm, perhaps not from the Demon King of Ten Thousand Demon Country, but regardless of its origin, since it dared to take the risk to infiltrate the city, its intentions must be significant." Jin Chen nodded slightly.
"But if that's the case, today's incident is rather peculiar. Exposing its identity just to steal some Power of the Sun is quite unreasonable." Jin Mu frowned slightly.
"Father, why ponder so hard? Don't forget we have the Demon Seeking Sky Mirror. We just need to gather the demon energy, use the Treasure Mirror to find where the demon is, and capture it for questioning." Jin Chen smiled confidently, immediately raising his hand to take out a small bronze bottle carved with intricate patterns.
Then, he opened the bottle cap, performed a spell, and the small bottle instantly flew out of his hand, stopping mid-air, releasing an invisible suction force from the bottle mouth that absorbed all the residual demon energy nearby.
Afterward, Jin Chen put away the small bottle, and along with Jin Mu, left the Supreme Yang Spirit Vein, entering a secret chamber at the center of the City Lord Mansion.
In the middle of the secret chamber, a bronze round mirror the size of a millstone was placed. Its frame was engraved with numerous vivid and lifelike images of rare birds and Exotic Beasts, as if they would jump off the mirror at any moment.
Both Jin Mu and Jin Chen walked to the mirror, but strangely, the mirror did not reflect their images at all.
They were not surprised. First, they placed the bronze bottle with collected demon energy in front of the mirror, then stood on either side of the mirror, simultaneously performed spells, and cast several spirit light spells onto the round mirror.
In the next instant, the bronze round mirror suddenly began to tremble, a pale white spirit light surged from the surface of the mirror, shining on the small bottle with demon energy.
Immediately, an invisible wave of Spiritual Energy erupted from the mirror, swiftly sweeping past Jin Chen and Jin Mu, spreading through the entire White Emperor City.
...
On the other side, Yuan Ming put away the undying tree avatar but still felt uncertain, and after pondering for a moment, he released a soul crow outside while he quickly entered Shura Palace, summoned the Stealing Heaven Tripod, and entered it.
At that moment, an invisible wave swept past the soul crow Yuan Ming left outside.
This strange sensation made Yuan Ming's heart skip a beat, thankfully the wave did not linger but continued to surge outward.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming sighed in relief but did not fully relax, instead stayed in the Stealing Heaven Tripod to check his current condition.
After part of the tree body transformed into the World Tree, the life force and durability of the Undying Tree increased greatly, having just endured a Dharma manifestation attack, only a white mark appeared on the roots, with no major harm.
Yuan Ming sighed in relief, then his expression froze.
Although he had only absorbed the Power of the Sun from the Supreme Yang Spirit Vein for a short time, his Physical Body Realm had significantly improved, reaching the late-stage Wanxiang Body, subtly showing signs of transforming towards an Undying Body.
Yuan Ming estimated that as long as he could absorb sufficient Power of the Sun, he could attempt a breakthrough, completely advancing his physical body to the level of Undying Power.
However, having been spotted at the Supreme Yang Spirit Vein, it was impossible for him to return and steal the Power of the Sun again, he could only cultivate calmly and wait for other opportunities.
While Yuan Ming examined himself, in the City Lord Mansion, Jin Mu and Jin Chen watched the Demon Seeking Sky Mirror that showed no images, their expressions somewhat unpleasant.
"It seems this demon indeed has some tricks, to evade the Demon Seeking Sky Mirror, it's no wonder they managed to infiltrate the city without being noticed." Jin Mu sighed, opening his mouth slowly.
"Father, in your opinion, what should we do next? I'm worried that this creature infiltrating the city may have other plots." Jin Chen said with a serious expression.
"First, we should secretly increase our vigilance, this demon has just suffered a setback, it probably won't act again soon. In any case, as long as it dares to show itself, it will certainly be unable to hide its tracks." Jin Mu said sternly.
Upon hearing this, Jin Chen could only nod, turned around and left to arrange the necessary vigilance measures.
After this incident, the monitoring of the Underground Yang Spirit Vein in White Emperor City became even tighter.
Yuan Ming did not risk trying to directly absorb the Power of the Sun from the Supreme Yang Spirit Vein again, nor did he leave Wulu's Cave Mansion to go outside, continuing to calmly cultivate within the cave.
During this period of stable cultivation, White Emperor City became increasingly lively.
Due to the appearance of the Heavenly Fire, more and more cultivators arrived in White Emperor City from all directions, the pressure on city defense increased several times, the checks on people coming and going through the city gates and Transmission Array became several times stricter.
During this time, several incidents of devil cultivators attempting to infiltrate the city were caught, yet they did not cause major disturbances, and were quietly suppressed swiftly.
Outside the city, turmoil also flared up, several groups of cultivators started conflicts due to hunting demons outside, resulting in massive fights with casualties exceeding those from being counterattacked by demons.
Compared to the chaos outside, the city was more stable, with almost all inns and temporary Cave Mansions fully occupied, various businesses hosting auctions, aiming to profit greatly from this event.
Private exchanges among cultivators also became more frequent, some hidden meetings were held across the city, showcasing various Magic Treasures, Immortal Elixirs, spiritual materials, and exotic items.
Since Nan Shangfeng arrived in White Emperor City, he seemed to change, no longer lingering in the quarters of women, and reduced his dissipated behavior, the only thing unchanged was his lavish spending, throwing money extravagantly.
He frequently attended various auctions and exchange meetings, besides purchasing some rare materials, most times he competed fiercely with others for some high-level Spirit Wood, often leading to bloody battles.
Supported by vast financial resources, he indeed achieved numerous gains.

chapters.title: Chapter 922 - 891: Voluntarily Admitting Fault
chapters.content:
Time flew by, and three months had passed.
The bustling scene within White Emperor City not only persisted but increased, accompanied by private duels, assassinations, and chaotic events, forcing the City Lord Mansion to issue decrees to start restricting cultivators entering the city.
Meanwhile, all sorts of rumors about the appearance of the Heavenly Fire were growing increasingly absurd.
There were claims that the Heavenly Fire descended from the sky, resembling a waterfall of flowing fire hanging from the heavens; others said the Heavenly Fire was born from the earth, gushing from beneath like springs, as viscous as oil; and yet some swindlers were selling strange stones under the guise of phenomena related to the Heavenly Fire, claiming they were born within it.
In short, the chaos was escalating more and more.
Yuan Ming, immersed in his cultivation, was completely unaware of these happenings, until the arrival of Nan Shangfeng disrupted his tranquility.
When he walked out of the secret chamber, he immediately saw Nan Shangfeng pacing back and forth outside, with his head lowered.
"What's wrong, has something happened?" Yuan Ming asked.
Nan Shangfeng abruptly raised his head, his brow furrowed, his expression full of worry.
"Fellow Daoist Wan, this morning, people from Heavenly Dragon Hall and Daluo Sect arrived at White Emperor City, including Heavenly Dragon Palace Master Long Hou and my mentor Master Tantai," Nan Shangfeng quickly approached, speaking rapidly.
Master Tantai was none other than the Sect Leader of Daluo Sect.
Yuan Ming's mind stirred, understanding why he was so flustered.
"The appearance of the Heavenly Fire has attracted attention from all around. It's expected your mentor would come. They likely don't know your whereabouts, you shouldn't worry too much," Yuan Ming said calmly, comforting him.
"I understand that. But previously on East Extreme Island, regarding the setup to encircle and kill Yuan Ming and Yun Luo Fairy, my performance was unsatisfactory. I suppose that scoundrel Zhu Yu has already exaggerated and reported it. I'm... I'm afraid that my mentor will punish me," Nan Shangfeng said, looking at Yuan Ming and smiling bitterly.
"Since he's your mentor, you cannot avoid it. It's better to meet him voluntarily than to be dragged back by the sect," Yuan Ming said.
"That's true," Nan Shangfeng pondered briefly, agreeing and nodding.
After speaking, he flicked his wrist, and a virtual light flickered before him, revealing over twenty pieces of high-level spirit wood, mostly Level 5, with only three or four pieces of Level 6 spirit wood.
"I've recently bought these at several auctions and exchanges. Their quality might be a bit unstable, uneven. Fellow Daoist Wan, pick and use them as you wish. If my mentor does punish me upon returning, I'll probably be taken back to the sect for reflection. Who knows when we'll meet again," Nan Shangfeng said.
Upon hearing this, a trace of surprise flashed in Yuan Ming's eyes.
This time the spirit wood was not requested by Yuan Ming for purchase and collection but entirely voluntarily done by Nan Shangfeng.
"Thank you, your thoughtfulness is appreciated," Yuan Ming thanked him and put them away.
The high-level spirit wood collected by Ten Thousand Goods Immortal Trip had also been brought, and with these pieces, he could gather two more Ten Thousand Wood Origins.
"Done easily. Then I bid farewell," Nan Shangfeng said with a smile, turning to leave.
"I'll go with you," Yuan Ming said.
"You're coming too?" Nan Shangfeng said, surprised.
"Just like last time, I'll hide within your Void Palace and won't be discovered," Yuan Ming said.
Upon hearing this, Nan Shangfeng hesitated briefly and asked, "I don't understand, Fellow Daoist Wan, why do you want to accompany me?"
"Your mentor and his entourage must have come to White Emperor City for the Heavenly Fire. I believe, given their status, they know more details. Going to listen might be beneficial," Yuan Ming replied honestly.
"Indeed, with you accompanying me, I feel more at ease," Nan Shangfeng thought for a moment and nodded.
His fellow disciples would likely accompany their mentor, and none of them were easy to deal with.
Instantly, he opened the Void Palace and welcomed Yuan Ming inside.
Being the Heavenly Dragon Palace Master and Daluo Sect Leader, their visits couldn't be regarded as the same as other cultivators. The White Emperor City Lord Jin Mu had already set up a banquet in the City Lord Mansion, waiting for the cultivators from the two great sects to attend.
The Daluo Sect and Heavenly Dragon Hall both had mansions within White Emperor City, which Nan Shangfeng hadn't stayed at before and was now visiting for the first time this mansion close to the City Lord Mansion.
As soon as he reached the mansion entrance, he was recognized by the gatekeepers who hurriedly welcomed him inside while sending someone to notify the others.
Quickly, Nan Shangfeng found himself in a spacious hall, meeting his mentor.
Master Tantai was preparing to depart for the White Emperor City Lord Mansion, with a few direct disciples like He Xiuwen accompanying him.
Inside the Void Palace, Yuan Ming used a soul descent rune to observe the people in the hall.
Among them, Master Tantai was an elder clad in a feather robe and Daoist robe. Though his hair and beard were all white, his features were youthful without a single wrinkle, looking quite immortal and refined.
He Xiuwen was a towering young man, with short, thick eyebrows, large eyes, and dark skin, looking honest and reliable, yet he was the most ruthless among the disciples.
Yang Fan's brows and eyes were cold and stern, his arms crossed over his chest, holding his treasure sword, projecting an image of unapproachability. Upon seeing Nan Shangfeng, he snorted lightly and turned his face away.
Fourth junior sister, Gan Wenqing, glanced up and down at Nan Shangfeng and took the initiative to call out, "Second senior brother."
Nan Shangfeng did not respond to her. He took the initiative to kneel before Master Tantai and kowtowed, saying, "Master, your unworthy disciple Nan Shangfeng, has come to pay respects."
"Oh, you still remember to come back. I thought you wouldn't return unless I sent someone to fetch you," Master Tantai glanced at him sideways and said lightly.
"Master, this disciple has been traveling outside, and was recently ambushed, nearly losing my life. I truly did not dare to take the risk of a long journey back to the sect." Nan Shangfeng slid on his knees up to Master Tantai's feet, clutching his pant leg, and began to wail and cry.
Yuan Ming was completely stunned at this sight, never expecting Nan Shangfeng to do such a thing.
Unexpectedly, although the behavior was somewhat disgraceful, the effect was surprisingly good.
"It's fine, as long as you've returned safely," Master Tantai's expression indeed softened as he spoke.
He lifted his hand to pull Nan Shangfeng up, then examined him closely, and his brows furrowed slightly.
"The injuries you suffered earlier were not light; it seems you have indeed encountered significant trouble," he said, sweeping his gaze over the other three disciples.
The three of them hurriedly looked away, slightly lowering their heads.
He was very aware of the clear and hidden struggles among his disciples, but he deliberately did not stop them, hoping they would grow through the competition.
In fact, he always valued this second disciple highly, but although this one had good talent, his character was somewhat lacking. Additionally, having sustained injuries to his core previously, he lacked a spirit of competition, which made him displeased.
"Though your injuries were severe, it seems your cultivation has significantly improved, which is good; you've gained from your misfortune," Master Tantai nodded and said.
His words were like a stone dropping into the hearts of the other disciples, creating ripples.
The three either openly inspected or cautiously observed, all focusing their attention on Nan Shangfeng.
Nan Shangfeng had indeed been diligent in his cultivation during this time, and was now quite different from before. However, his cultivation realm had not yet advanced to the next level, still a notch below the other three.
"All right, let's not talk about anything else for now. Come with me to the City Lord Mansion to attend the banquet," Master Tantai concluded.
...
Inside the City Lord Mansion, a guest reception hall was set up with several large round tables.
The tables were already laden with various precious ingredients, immortal fruits, and immortal brews, waiting for the esteemed guests to arrive.
When Master Tantai's group arrived, the people from the Heavenly Dragon Hall also arrived.
After exchanging pleasantries, they all entered the guest reception hall together.
As the host, Jin Mu immediately invited everyone to be seated. There were only seven or eight seats at the head table, intended for Long Hou, Master Tantai, and other sect leaders and prominent figures.
Nan Shangfeng and the other accompanying members were arranged at another table.
Jin Mu was not in his usual flowing hair and bare feet but wore Cloud Boots and a Purple Gold Crown, exuding a more formidable aura, making him hard to look at directly.
As for Long Hou, he was a well-built, dark-red-skinned man with dark golden rings in his eyes, naturally imposing, filled with explosive power.
Once everyone was seated, after some polite conversation, Master Tantai spoke first, inquiring about the Heavenly Fire: "Fellow Daoist Jin Mu, being so close to the source, have you had a chance to witness the Heavenly Fire firsthand these days?"
"That's not quite right. I've been busy managing city affairs and haven't personally gone to investigate, but based on reports from spies in the city, I guess it might be the legendary Great Sun Glaze Flame," Jin Mu said after a brief pause.
As soon as he spoke, the entire room was filled with exclamations.
"It is actually the Great Sun Glaze Flame…" a cultivator exclaimed, drawing everyone's attention.
In the Void Palace, upon hearing it was this flame, Yuan Ming was momentarily stunned, then felt a surge of indescribable excitement.
This Great Sun Glaze Flame is a pure True Fire formed by the condensed Power of the Sun, a high-level True Fire many times stronger than the Profound Sun Earth Fire.
Yuan Ming believed that if he could obtain this fire, its contained Power of the Sun would allow him, in his path of Body Cultivation, to progress smoothly, without any obstacles.
"This time, many people have their eyes on the Great Sun Glaze Flame. Besides us, the Ten Thousand Demon Country is also involved. They've already infiltrated the Fire Rock Desert, so if you truly wish to compete, it's best to set aside historical grudges and animosities and work together. Otherwise, Ten Thousand Demon Country might defeat each of us separately and reap the benefits," Jin Mu said, glancing around.
"Fellow Daoist Jin Mu is right. Under no circumstances should we allow Ten Thousand Demon Country to seize the advantage," Long Hou nodded in agreement.
"In that case, we shouldn't waste any time; we must set out immediately," Master Tantai also said with a solemn expression.
"Indeed. The Heavenly Fire has appeared; now is the perfect time to compete for it," everyone echoed.

chapters.title: Chapter 923 - 892: Guardian
chapters.content:
Seeing this, Jin Mu stood up, raised his hand and pressed it a few times in the air, signaling everyone to remain calm.
"Everyone, the Great Sun Glaze Flame is not an ordinary True Fire, and taming it is not something that can be achieved overnight. So there's no need to rush for the moment. Today, I've set up a banquet here to entertain you, and there's also news to share. In three days, a distinguished figure will arrive. By then, he will lead you to obtain the Great Sun Glaze Flame, ensuring that nothing will go wrong," Jin Mu said.
Upon hearing this, everyone's curiosity was immediately piqued.
Yuan Ming was equally puzzled. Anyone able to lead Jin Mu, Master Tantai, and Long Hou must have an extraordinary identity, at least not weaker than them in strength.
"Fellow Daoist Jin Mu, stop keeping us in suspense, who exactly is this distinguished figure?" Long Hou asked.
"It's not that I'm deliberately keeping it a secret; it's just that I don't know who this person is either," Jin Mu shook his head and said with a wry smile.
"You don't know either?" Master Tantai asked in confusion.
"I truly don't know. The information was sent by Ancestor Bing Lan, and he didn't specify who it was, only that we should make preparations and welcome them in advance," Jin Mu said.
The mention of Ancestor Bing Lan's name instantly silenced the hall.
"If Ancestor Bing Lan were to come personally, it would be expected that we prepare as best as we could, but for someone sent by him to expect us to prepare ahead reeks of arrogance. If the person who comes fails to impress me, I will surely challenge him before entering the Fire Rock Desert," Long Hou said somewhat displeasedly.
"Fellow Daoist Long Hou, since Ancestor Bing Lan said so, it surely isn't baseless. So there's no need for anger, just calmly wait for three days," Master Tantai advised.
Following this, everyone's conversations revolved around the mysterious person about to arrive, speculating variously about their identity, yet no one could arrive at a consensus.
Yuan Ming listened for a while before losing interest.
He planned to continue his concealed actions; it didn't matter who the arrival was, as it had nothing to do with him.
He was naturally curious about the Heavenly Fire in the Fire Rock Desert and planned to take a look if the timing was right after Xi Ying arrived.
In the City Lord Mansion's main hall, after discussing a little longer, everyone dispersed.
Nan Shangfeng escorted Yuan Ming back to the Cave Mansion and didn't stay there any longer.
Master Tantai was already there, so he couldn't continue staying outside and went to the Daluo Mansion.
Yuan Ming stepped into the secret chamber of the Cave Mansion, entered the Shura Palace, and approached the Void Communication Array, activating the Array to contact Xi Ying.
He had been in White Emperor City for three months and wondered where Xi Ying had gone.
The flames within the Communication Array flickered for a long time before Xi Ying's face finally appeared.
"So late? Are you busy?" Yuan Ming asked.
"Sort of," Xi Ying's expression clearly hesitated for a moment, and she replied vaguely.
Yuan Ming's eyebrow arched slightly; Xi Ying was always straightforward and decisive in words and actions. When had she ever hesitated like this? It seemed something indeed happened.
"What happened?" he asked.
"Nothing much, I'll arrive in White Emperor City via the Teleportation Array in three days. Could you come pick me up then?" Xi Ying's voice resumed its usual rhythm.
Three days later?
Yuan Ming recalled the news heard at the City Lord Mansion today; that distinguished figure would also arrive in three days. What a coincidence!
"Alright," he agreed without asking further questions.
...
Time flew by, and three days passed.
White Emperor City, Transmission Hall.
Led by Jin Mu, Master Tantai, and Long Hou, a group of cultivators awaited inside the hall.
The news of the impending arrival of a distinguished figure had spread, and curious cultivators crowded outside the hall.
Yuan Ming also suppressed his cultivation and blended into the crowd.
The Transmission Array inside the hall was operating, occasionally sending cultivators out, but seeing Jin Mu, Master Tantai, and Long Hou standing next to it, sensing their formidable aura, they quickly left.
Time ticked away, and soon it was noon.
"City Lord Jin Mu, weren't they supposed to arrive by noon? It's already 11:45 AM, why haven't they arrived yet?" Long Hou expressed impatience with a tone of irritation.
"Perhaps something delayed them, let's wait patiently a bit longer," Jin Mu said.
As soon as he finished speaking, the Teleportation Array suddenly glowed brightly, beginning to operate autonomously.
Beams of light shot skyward, enveloping the entire array, then quickly fell, dissipating into the air.
As the light faded, more than a dozen figures emerged.
Upon seeing these individuals, everyone's eyes lit up, drawn to a woman in a white gauzy dress and a wide-brimmed hat among the crowd.
Her figure was delicate, her demeanor exceptional; just standing there, she seemed to radiate brilliance, irresistibly drawing everyone's gaze.
The hall also had no shortage of beautiful female cultivators; Gan Wenqing of the Daluo Sect and Long Yuhuan of the Heavenly Dragon Hall were top beauties. But compared to the woman in white, they fell short not just in appearance but in charm as well.
Yuan Ming's gaze was similarly captured in an instant.
Because that woman was none other than Xi Ying, wasn't she?
After possessing Guoguo so many times over the years and conversing with Xi Ying, seeing her face-to-face now stirred his emotions.
Moreover, Xi Ying had undergone quite a change since their last meeting, her fair cheeks faintly glowing with a holy light, her aura reaching a new level.
Beside Xi Ying stood an elder in a green robe with long whiskers, his face gaunt and his frame lean, looking like a regular old man from the market. The cuffs of his sleeves bore an embroidered pattern of a green bird, emblematic of the Sky Eagle Chamber of Commerce.
Behind the pair stood eight or nine cultivators also in green robes, each wearing the attire of the Sky Eagle Chamber of Commerce.
However, neither Xi Ying nor the people of the Sky Eagle Chamber of Commerce could overshadow the presence of another individual.
This person was dressed in a yellow robe, a purple-black ancient zither slung across his back, and his long hair flowing down. He was a young man with striking features.
His demeanor was excellent, yet without any hint of ostentation, appearing like an ordinary zither master, but impossible to ignore.
The gaze of Jin Mu and the others quickly shifted from Xi Ying to the yellow-robed youth, and their expressions immediately changed.
Their eyes reflected both surprise and reverence.
Long Hou's face stiffened, and the initial displeasure he felt promptly dissipated.
"It's him!" Even Nan Shangfeng couldn't help but exclaim softly.
At this moment, he was not standing among the members of the Daluo Sect; he was outside the hall with Yuan Ming.
"Who is he?" Yuan Ming's gaze also fell on the yellow-robed youth, and he transmitted a question.
"You don't know him?" Nan Shangfeng was somewhat surprised.
"I don't know. Didn't Jin Mu mention a leader, is it him?" Yuan Ming asked.
"It can only be him… though I didn't expect that you don't recognize the famous Guardian, Qin Mo!" Nan Shangfeng sighed secretly and, through transmission, responded.
Yuan Ming knew of the Guardians. Kong had told him about it, but he had never heard the name Qin Mo before.
"You surely know about the Guardians, right? In this era, only three Guardians have emerged: Qin Mo, Hua Xian, and Xizhuang Yuan. Since he emerged, Xizhuang Yuan has been elusive, while Qin Mo and Hua Xian partook in the Returning Ruins battle two to three hundred years ago. Qin Mo alone contended against three Demon Lords without being overshadowed; his reputation among the three is the most resounding. Recently, there are even rumors of his preparation for advancement to the Mahayana Realm." Nan Shangfeng said with a slightly sour tone.
Yuan Ming nodded, scrutinizing the yellow-robed youth.
Jin Mu and the others had already regained their composure, smiled, and were about to step forward to greet him when they saw the yellow-robed youth slightly bow and extend a hand toward Xi Ying.
"Fairy Xi, please, you go first."
Outside the hall, Yuan Ming witnessed this scene and couldn't help furrowing his brows, narrowing his eyes as he looked at the yellow-robed youth.
The others saw this and were filled with doubt.
"Who is that young woman to receive such courtesy from Lord Qin Mo?" Long Hou asked in a low voice.
"Not sure, never seen her before. City Lord Jin, you have a unique relationship with Ancestor Bing Lan, and Qin Mo is a successor of Ancestor Bing Lan. This white-robed woman appears alongside Lord Qin Mo—do you recognize her?" Master Tantai pondered, casting a look at Jin Mu.
"I don't know either, never seen her before. I do know the elder beside this woman, he is the Second Elder of the Sky Eagle Commerce Elder Council, Elder Yun Tian." Jin Mu shook his head and said.
"Regardless of who it is, to stand alongside those two and receive such treatment from Lord Qin Mo, we should not be negligent." Master Tantai's expression turned solemn as he spoke.
The other two nodded upon hearing this and all three went up together to greet them.
At this moment, they witnessed a rather unexpected scene.
Lord Qin Mo courteously allowed the white-robed woman to go ahead, but the woman did not move, her expression quite indifferent, and she performed the same gesture, allowing Elder Yun Tian to proceed first.
