"Lord Qin Mo, please go ahead." Elder Yun Tian gave Xi Ying a reproachful glance and then discreetly led Qin Mo forward.
Qin Mo did not refuse and stepped out of the teleportation array.
"Jin Mu from White Emperor City, Long Hou from Heavenly Dragon Hall, Tantai from Daluo Sect, greet Lord Qin Mo." Jin Mu and the three bowed in salute.
The others quickly followed suit.
"No need for such formality, please rise," Qin Mo said warmly.
Once everyone stood up straight, he took the initiative to introduce Elder Yun Tian and Xi Ying to the crowd.
Though the Sky Eagle Chamber of Commerce has a president, the actual core power rests with the Elder Council, and practically all major decisions of the chamber are made by the Elder Council.
The Elder Council of the Sky Eagle Chamber of Commerce is composed of five elders. As the Second Elder, Elder Yun Tian is highly influential and is a notable figure in the Central Continent, exchanging greetings with many people.
Xi Ying, while unknown to most, had just witnessed the respectful demeanor Qin Mo showed towards her, so nobody dared to underestimate her, and the voices of flattery continued.
Xi Ying maintained a rather indifferent attitude, only responding with basic courtesy, her eyes scanning the interior and exterior of the hall.
Yuan Ming no longer stayed hidden within the crowd; he stepped out and waved a hand towards Xi Ying.
Xi Ying immediately looked over, and though Yuan Ming's appearance was disguised, she recognized him instantly, her delicate face breaking into a smile.
At that moment, Qin Mo was exchanging pleasantries with Jin Mu and the others, still mindful of XI Ying's change in expression and was about to turn his head to look outside.
"Lord Qin Mo, Fairy Xi, Elder Yun Tian, we have already prepared a banquet at the City Lord Mansion for everyone. Let us move to the feast and continue our conversation there." Jin Mu proposed.
"Alright," Qin Mo replied, retracting his gaze.
"Thank you," Elder Yun Tian also responded with a smile.
Qin Mo gazed at Xi Ying with a gentle look and said, "Fairy Xi, shall we go together?"
"It would be discourteous to decline such a gracious invitation, Lord Qin Mo, but I have someone waiting to meet me, so there's no need for us to go together," Xi Ying replied with a polite smile.
With that, she headed straight towards the outside of the hall.

chapters.title: Chapter 924 - 893: Hatred as Deep as the Sea
chapters.content:
Everyone's gaze was on Xi Ying as she moved.
Yuan Ming showed a slight look of surprise, but did not step away.
Under the shocked and puzzled eyes of the crowd, Xi Ying came to the side of an ordinary young man outside the hall and naturally took his arm.
"Why put on such a show?" Yuan Ming did not shy away from Xi Ying's embrace and asked via transmission.
"Why, are you unhappy with me hugging you like this? You don't know how many people are envious of you right now," Xi Ying snorted in response via transmission.
"Of course not, you know my situation, being so conspicuous is not ideal…" Yuan Ming replied via transmission.
"I've encountered some trouble recently, need to resolve it like this, let's go." Xi Ying briefly explained, then started walking outside.
Yuan Ming nodded slightly, and the two walked out of the Transmission Hall hand in hand.
This unexpected scene left everyone dumbfounded.
Nan Shangfeng stood frozen, murmuring, "Fellow Daoist Wan, you truly hide your abilities…"
Long Hou and the others exchanged glances, unsure of what to say for a moment.
Elder Yun Tian felt particularly awkward, being a seasoned elder, he naturally noticed Qin Mo's interest in Xi Ying.
The Sky Eagle Chamber of Commerce had developed well in recent years, but still couldn't compare to the Ten Thousand Goods Immortal Trip, and the benefits of getting Qin Mo's help were immeasurable.
He intended to matchmake Xi Ying and Qin Mo but didn't expect such an incident with Xi Ying.
Elder Yun Tian looked towards Yuan Ming's back, a hint of gloom crossing his eyes.
"Lord Qinmo, Xi Ying hasn't been with us long and has a stubborn nature, please don't take it to heart…" Elder Yun Tian coughed and said, trying to ease the awkwardness.
"Didn't expect Xi Ying to have an old acquaintance here; I'll have to get to know him someday." Qin Mo, also looking at Yuan Ming, waved his hand to interrupt Elder Yun Tian, not particularly concerned.
Elsewhere, Yuan Ming and Xi Ying left the Transmission Hall alone, soon arriving at a floating platform within White Emperor City.
This platform was called Moon Viewing Platform, perched at a lofty height, almost allowing a full view of White Emperor City. The bustling scenery unfolded like a painting, making it a prime viewing spot in White Emperor City, often causing passersby to stop and admire.
However, due to the arrival of Qin Mo and others, nearly half of the city's cultivators had gone to watch the commotion, leaving Moon Viewing Platform deserted and peaceful.
Xi Ying walked leisurely, arm in arm with Yuan Ming, even when out of sight of the crowd, showing no intention of letting go.
"Alright, we're here, can you tell me about the trouble you've encountered?" Yuan Ming slightly tilted his head and asked.
His gaze fell on Xi Ying, seeing a breeze pass through her hair, causing it to sway slightly, the jade hairpin trembling, and an inexplicable tenderness arose in his heart.
"Because of the Pill King Secret Manual, I have risen quickly within the Sky Eagle Chamber of Commerce these years. A few years ago, I accidentally met the Third Elder of the chamber, who saw potential in me and allowed me to encounter the Elder Council," Xi Ying said softly.
"Oh, that's a good thing." Yuan Ming said.
"It is indeed a good thing, but internal power struggles in the Elder Council are fierce. My foundation is weak, and I can only be at their mercy. That Qin Mo's real name is Sima Changqin, whom I met by chance two years ago. Somehow, he became entangled with me, but I've never paid attention to him. The Elder Council, knowing this, wants to leverage that relationship," Xi Ying continued.
Yuan Ming nodded gently, understanding.
"The Sky Eagle Chamber of Commerce is ultimately a business, greedy for power. The status of a Guardian in the Chuyun Realm is extraordinary, especially as Sima Changqin has the Great Mahayana Ancestor as a backing. The Elder Council wants to align the chamber with this influential figure, and for this, the Second Elder Yun Tian is the most active," Xi Ying shook her head slightly, full of disdain in her tone.
"I see, won't today's display make it difficult for you in the Sky Eagle Chamber of Commerce?" Yuan Ming asked after hearing it.
"No need to worry, the Third Elder in the Elder Council supports me, and she has a strong voice in the chamber, others won't dare to push too hard," Xi Ying said.
"Then what will you do next?" Yuan Ming pondered and asked.
"I'll just placate them at first, considering the president and the Third Elder have looked out for me, it's best not to make everyone look bad," Xi Ying said.
"Want me to help kill Yun Tian? It wouldn't be difficult." Yuan Ming looked at Xi Ying and suddenly said.
Elder Yun Tian was also a Dharma manifestation cultivator, but only at the early stage, and his aura wasn't strong.
With his current means, even within White Emperor City, there are several ways to make him die inexplicably.
Xi Ying looked at Yuan Ming with surprise, and after a few breaths, she smiled sweetly: "Actually, it's not that serious. I have been managing within the chamber for many years, just waiting to be promoted to Dharma manifestation. Once I have a say, I can oust him from the center of power."
As she spoke, she actively revealed her cultivation aura.
Yuan Ming did a slight probe and quickly discovered that Xi Ying's cultivation had reached the late stage of Returning Void, her aura was almost perfect, and it wouldn't be long before she could attempt to break through to Dharma manifestation.
"Have all the preparations for the breakthrough been adequately made? Is there anything lacking?" Yuan Ming asked.
"Almost everything is ready, but breaking through Dharma manifestation is not an easy task. Even with thorough preparation, I can't say I have a hundred percent certainty." Xi Ying sighed.
"Don't worry. In the next few days, I will sort out my experiences and insights for you. Additionally, I'll prepare the Dharma Manifestation Pill in advance. You just need to adjust your mindset and prepare for the breakthrough. With your talent, failure is not an option." Yuan Ming lightly patted her shoulder, seeming even more confident than Xi Ying.
"I will prepare well." Seeing his seriousness, Xi Ying smiled with her eyebrows curved.
"With your ability, you can take charge of the Sky Eagle Chamber of Commerce, but Sima Changqin will be more troublesome. He might still cling to you, so leave him to me." Yuan Ming continued.
"Are you confident? Sima Changqin's strength is exceptional; he can almost be considered the top individual below the Mahayana Realm in the entire Chuyun Realm. Not many are his match. You must handle him with caution." Xi Ying cautioned softly, seeing through Yuan Ming's intention.
"Don't worry, I won't act recklessly." Yuan Ming replied.
He didn't want to cause trouble, nor was he seeking to stand out, but he couldn't let Sima Changqin pursue his woman without consequence.
Understanding Yuan Ming's character, Xi Ying nodded and then took out a jade scroll, handing it to Yuan Ming.
"What is this?" Yuan Ming asked curiously, taking it. Probing it with his divine sense, his face immediately showed surprise.
The jade scroll contained a Body Cultivation Method called "Dragon Elephant Great Strength Divine Ability" with seven layers, the highest reaching the Fiery Sun Body, equivalent to the Mahayana Realm in the Body Cultivation realm. Importantly, many parts of this technique were quite similar to the Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill but were even more exquisite.
"I obtained this technique in a secret realm. I remember your Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill has only five layers and is nearing its peak; this can help you continue." Xi Ying said calmly, as if it were a small matter.
Yuan Ming understood that the technique he held, even to a Dharma manifestation cultivator, was extremely precious, even to the point of being worth fighting for without regard for reputation.
The experience Xi Ying went through to obtain it in the secret realm was by no means simple, known only to her heart.
Such a treasure, yet Xi Ying gave it away so easily, and wasn't even interested in taking credit for it.
Yuan Ming felt the jade scroll in his hand grow heavy, but he said nothing, choosing to remember this kindness in his heart, silently storing the jade scroll.
Seeing this, Xi Ying smiled and started chatting with Yuan Ming about trivial matters of life.
Yuan Ming quietly listened, occasionally chiming in, sharing his own experiences as well.
It seemed they had endless things to talk about until the sun gradually set, then they stopped, leaning on each other's shoulders, silently gazing at White Emperor City under the sunset, enjoying their exclusive time.
"The Sky Eagle Chamber of Commerce came this time not only for the Heavenly Fire but also to further expand business here and deepen cooperation with White Emperor City. As one of the persons in charge, I will be here for a long time. The Chamber has arranged a private cave mansion for me in the Heavenly Sword District. Would you like to come and stay?" Xi Ying suddenly asked, her cheeks slightly red under the sunset, her eyes sparkling with an inexplicable light.
"... Better not for now. You're not in the best situation, and I would only bring trouble if I came, making it inconvenient for my actions." Yuan Ming shook his head.
Xi Ying thought for a bit and agreed her proposal was abrupt and did not insist further.
"Put the Chamber's matters aside, focus on intensive cultivation. I know you're clever and good at business, but don't let the Sky Eagle Chamber's atmosphere influence you. For us cultivators, strength is everything. Once you break through to Dharma manifestation, you can do as you please." Yuan Ming continued.
Xi Ying was slightly taken aback, recalling she indeed had recently not put as much effort into cultivation as before.
She nodded, leaning closer to Yuan Ming.
The two silently watched the sunset, enjoying the rare tranquility until the light faded, then parted ways and returned to their respective places.
...
Yuan Ming returned to the Wulu Cave Mansion and saw Nan Shangfeng was there as soon as he entered the door, welcoming him with a flushed face.
Behind him, Wulu gave Yuan Ming a helpless glance and then went back to his room, seeming unwilling to stay even a moment longer.
"What brings you here?" Yuan Ming glanced at the table cluttered with cups and plates, then at Nan Shangfeng's drunken face, immediately understanding why Wulu left quickly.
"The villa is dull and lifeless; it's more comfortable here." Nan Shangfeng chuckled.
Yuan Ming said nothing, finding a stone stool to sit next to Nan Shangfeng.
"Brother Wan, you're incredible! I knew I wasn't wrong about you being remarkable. I've never admired anyone in my life, but I admire you today!" Nan Shangfeng immediately said as he leaned over.
"Why mention this?" Yuan Ming replied calmly.
"Heh, it's because of Brother Wan's performance in the Transmission Hall today. Fairy Xi, such a heavenly beauty, caught even Sima Changqin's eye, yet she was arm in arm with you. Ha, just thinking about that scene makes me want to drink and celebrate again!" Nan Shangfeng laughed heartily, with a tone of avenging a great grudge.
"You seem to hate Sima Changqin quite a bit. Do you have a grudge against him?" Yuan Ming asked.
"A grudge as deep as the sea!" Nan Shangfeng's expression suddenly turned somber.

chapters.title: Chapter 925 - 894: Plotting
chapters.content:
"Care to elaborate?" Yuan Ming sat up slightly.
"It's a long story. Back then, after I broke through to the Late Stage of Returning Void, I represented the Daluo Sect in a treasure hunt at a Secret Realm in the Central Continent. Sima Changqin meddled in and snatched a treasure from me, not to mention, his Black Demon severely injured me, which left me with this Spirit Root problem!" Nan Shangfeng's eyes were full of resentment.
Yuan Ming looked surprised; Nan Shangfeng's Spirit Root issue was actually due to Sima Changqin.
"What did you just mention about the Black Demon?" He pondered for a moment and asked.
"That's Sima Changqin's personal guard. Every Guardian has their own protective power, and Sima Changqin, who is nicknamed Qin Mo, has his guards call themselves Black Demon," said Nan Shangfeng.
"Do you still remember the Black Demon's appearance and name?" Yuan Ming was secretly pleased and queried further.
He was worried about how to deal with Sima Changqin, and unexpectedly, Nan Shangfeng provided a clue.
"Of course, I know. The man's name is Wu Li, and as for the appearance, it's like this." Nan Shangfeng waved his hand, and a white light screen appeared in front of him, showing a cold-eyed, slender-eyebrowed young man.
Yuan Ming examined the white light screen and committed the man's image to memory.
"Brother Wan made Sima Changqin lose face today, which really pleases me. But Brother Wan must be careful, Sima Changqin may appear gentle and kind like a good person, but he is actually very deep-minded and is not someone easy to deal with, so beware of his later revenge," Nan Shangfeng warned.
Yuan Ming nodded silently and asked more about Sima Changqin.
Nan Shangfeng didn't hold back and shared everything he knew with Yuan Ming until it was entirely dark and then took his leave.
Yuan Ming saw Nan Shangfeng off and looked towards the City Lord Mansion, his gaze penetrating as if through the Cave Mansion's gates.
He then turned and entered the secret chamber, took out the Stealing Heaven Tripod, and possessed Wu Li.
...
Meanwhile, in a pavilion within the City Lord Mansion, Sima Changqin leaned by the window, looking out at the city's scenery, his face calm, devoid of any extra emotion, revealing nothing of his inner thoughts.
The soft sound of qin and flute echoed within the pavilion, coming from a snow-white screen inside the room, embroidered with five maidens.
The five women seemed to come to life, playing flutes and qin on the screen.
On either side of the pavilion's entrance stood a black-armored guard, one of whom was Wu Li.
The other was a middle-aged man with a broad face, lion nose, and mouth, exuding a fierce aura.
"Fellow Daoist Sima, I apologize for keeping you waiting." The door was pushed open, and it was City Lord Jin Mu.
Wu Li and the black-armored middle-aged man reached out to block Jin Mu, their eyes cold.
"It's no trouble. There are many guests today, and as the host, you must be very busy. Besides, I intended to rest for a while, so how could I mind waiting?" Sima Changqin turned around, waved his hand, and spoke.
Wu Li and the black-armored middle-aged man returned to their positions, allowing Jin Mu to enter.
The five women on the white screen rose together, saluted Jin Mu, and continued playing qin and flute.
"Fellow Daoist Sima, you're too kind." Jin Mu wasn't angered by Wu Li's actions, instead, he glanced at the white screen again, his smile widening.
Sima Changqin and Jin Mu took seats by the table, and Wu Li brewed two cups of Spiritual Tea for them, then returned to stand by the door.
At that moment, a fluctuation arose from the depths of Wu Li's Divine Soul, and an invisible apparition appeared—it was Yuan Ming possessing him.
To deal with Sima Changqin, the first step was naturally to gather his intelligence; what Nan Shangfeng provided was far from enough.
Yuan Ming examined the pavilion's situation and noticed Sima Changqin and Jin Mu seemed to be discussing important matters, a quiet happiness rising in his heart.
This possession of Wu Li was merely to probe the situation, yet he found himself unexpectedly fortunate.
Just then, Jin Mu's voice came: "I wonder if Fellow Daoist Sima has brought any instructions from the Ancestor this time?"
"Recently, the Demon World has been frequently reinforcing the area around the Returning Ruins, and the Three Realms Sect has been quite active as well. The Ancestor and several other Mahayana seniors are handling it; he only instructed me to resolve the Heavenly Fire matter as quickly as possible and return promptly," said Sima Changqin.
"Wasn't there a battle at the Returning Ruins not long ago, and the Demon World suffered heavy losses? It's hardly been any time; they're moving again?" Jin Mu's expression changed slightly.
"The Demon World has never abandoned its intent to destroy the Chuyun Realm; it's no surprise they might attack at any moment. However, according to the information I've gathered, it's because the Six Demon Lords have reappeared and are already at the Returning Ruins, prompting the Demon World to prepare for another offensive." Sima Changqin chuckled and replied.
Yuan Ming was observing the pavilion, especially focusing on the white screen when he heard the name Six Demon Lords—his expression shifted, paying closer attention to Sima Changqin and Jin Mu.
"The Six Demon Lords! Wasn't it said that he perished along with Senior Xia Jie? The Ancestor personally told me that their Divine Soul Lamps at Bright Moon Palace have already extinguished." Jin Mu couldn't control his expression and stood up suddenly.
"The Divine Soul Lamp isn't absolutely foolproof. As far as I know, there are several ways to circumvent it, let alone the Six Demon Lords and Senior Xia Jie," Sima Changqin replied at a leisurely pace.
"So you actually believe the Six Demon Lords have truly returned?" Jin Mu asked.
"Naturally, the Six Demon Lords' Tao Divine Ability is the Six Paths of Reincarnation, controlling the Power of Reincarnation. He was never easy to kill, and for him to still be alive isn't surprising at all," said Sima Changqin.
"If the Six Demon Lords have truly returned, that's quite troubling. His Six Paths of Reincarnation is a force even Ancestor Bing Lan might not withstand. Had Senior Xia Jie not comprehended the 'Great Wish of All Living Beings,' the last great domain war could have put the Chuyun Realm in danger," Jin Mu stated as he calmed down and sighed.
"The Six Demon Lords aren't dead, nor is Senior Xia Jie; City Lord Jin Mu has little to fear," Sima Changqin paused for a moment, then suddenly laughed.
"What! Senior Xia Jie is also alive?" Jin Mu was astonished once again.
"This is just my speculation. Senior Jin Mu, please don't spread it around." Sima Changqin waved his hand and said.
"Of course, Fellow Daoist Sima, rest assured." Jin Mu straightened his expression.
Yuan Ming's eyes flickered. Sima Changqin seemed to know about Xia Jie's situation. Could it be that he came to the Central Continent?
Moreover, both Sima Changqin and Jin Mu referred to Xia Jie as Senior, could it be that Xia Jie is a Mahayana cultivator?
"Well, these matters are not for you and me to decide. When the time comes, we'll act according to orders." Sima Changqin laughed heartily.
"That's true, we should focus on the tasks at hand first. Regarding the Heavenly Fire, how should we proceed, please enlighten us, Fellow Daoist Sima." Jin Mu asked with a smile after.
"We still need to locate the Heavenly Fire first, and only then discuss other matters. Now, the Ten Thousand Demon Country is watching covetously. We certainly don't have enough manpower. It's best to mobilize the scattered cultivators in the city, let them do the hardest work, and we'll conserve our strength to deal with any potential dangers." Sima Changqin meticulously explained his thoughts.
"I was thinking the same thing." Jin Mu nodded repeatedly.
The two then delved into a detailed discussion of the plan, spending quite some time before finalizing everything.
Yuan Ming listened intently to their conversation, feeling that this trip was worthwhile.
The time for possession was almost up. He quietly waited for his consciousness to return to his body.
"Alright, I will arrange for people to spread the word. Fellow Daoist, you may rest first, and preparations can be made at the latest within three days." Jin Mu said as he stood up.
"Wait, City Lord, there's one more thing I forgot to inquire about. Today, when we met that Fellow Daoist Wan, do you know his background?" At this moment, Sima Changqin suddenly asked.
Yuan Ming's heart stirred as he looked at Sima Changqin.
"Him? I don't have much information at the moment. I only know that he was brought by Nan Shangfeng of the Daluo Sect and is a loose cultivator. The rest needs to be investigated." Jin Mu showed a troubled expression.
"Then I'll trouble the City Lord." Sima Changqin nodded.
After Jin Mu agreed, he left in a hurry, leaving Sima Changqin alone in the room, slowly sipping his tea.
The mist from the tea rose steadily, and when the cup was raised, it even obscured Sima Changqin's face.
In that haze, only his eyes slightly gleamed, resembling the moonlight and stars reflected in water, enigmatic and elusive.
At this moment, Yuan Ming's possession ended, and he returned to his body.
Sima Changqin indeed started targeting him, but his identity was fake, so he wasn't afraid of Sima Changqin and Jin Mu's investigation.
Yuan Ming pondered, considering his next move.
The next day, in the morning.
Yuan Ming was still calmly cultivating in his room when he suddenly heard Nan Shangfeng's voice coming from outside.
"Fellow Daoist Wan, come out quickly, there's big news!" he said loudly.
"What now?" Yuan Ming said helplessly, getting up to open the door and allowing him inside.
"I just received news that after discussion, Jin Mu and my master decided to select people from the city, organize a large team, and head to the Fire Rock Desert to find the Heavenly Fire," Nan Shangfeng said excitedly.
"Oh? They're not planning to use their own people? Aren't they afraid the Heavenly Fire will be obtained by others?" Yuan Ming had already known Sima Changqin's plan but still showed a look of surprise on the surface.
"Usually, they would first use their own people, but the Heavenly Fire appeared suddenly, and the Ten Thousand Demon Country is eyeing it greedily. Waiting for more people to arrive might be too late. Moreover, they are offering rich rewards this time. Anyone participating can receive treasures matching their cultivation as a reward, and if someone finds the Heavenly Fire, they can even have a wish granted by all the Dharma Manifestations," Nan Shangfeng explained.
"With such generous conditions, what are the requirements for participation?" Yuan Ming showed a thoughtful expression.
"There are no requirements, regardless of cultivation level, as long as one is not from the Demon Clan or Demon Country, anyone can sign up," Nan Shangfeng replied immediately.
"…It seems they want to gather more cannon fodder to pave the way for them." Yuan Ming said slowly.
"Though that may be true, as they say, wealth is sought in danger. Just participating guarantees a reward, and the Heavenly Fire is a great opportunity, surely many will be enticed," Nan Shangfeng retorted.
"You probably don't lack these things, so why are you so eager to tell me about it?" Yuan Ming looked at Nan Shangfeng.
"Well... it's for your sake, Fellow Daoist Wan. I thought you seemed quite interested in the Heavenly Fire, so..." Nan Shangfeng's eyes shifted, forcing a smile as he spoke.
"Nice words, but I bet it's because your master is forcing you to go, so you're trying to drag me along as cover." Yuan Ming bluntly exposed his intentions.
Nan Shangfeng chuckled awkwardly, tacitly acknowledging.
However, Yuan Ming wasn't inclined to take issue with it. Nan Shangfeng was right. He did have some thoughts about the Heavenly Fire. Now, being able to search for it openly aligned with his intentions.
"I suppose I can go. Wait a moment, I have some matters to attend to. After I'm done, I'll go with you to sign up." Yuan Ming thought for a moment and said.
"Good, then I'll go persuade Fellow Daoist Wu to join us as well." Nan Shangfeng nodded repeatedly and then turned to walk towards Wulu's room.

chapters.title: Chapter 926 - 895: Assembly
chapters.content:
After Nan Shangfeng left, Yuan Ming took out a communication talisman and activated it, quickly contacting Xi Ying.
Now they were not far apart, and ordinary means could be used to communicate without carefully setting up a communication array.
"Have you heard about forming a team in the city?" Yuan Ming didn't waste time and asked proactively.
"Yes, the chamber of commerce also asked me to join the team and go searching together," Xi Ying replied.
"Can you make an excuse to decline? You're not far from breaking through now; you should be focusing on quiet cultivation," Yuan Ming said with a tone of concern.
"They've named me specifically, so I can't refuse. Besides, I'm still some time away from breaking through; instead of quiet cultivation, it's better to go out for experience, maybe I'll gain something more," Xi Ying replied.
"Alright then, take care of yourself. I will also participate, so if anything happens, send me a message, and I'll come immediately," Yuan Ming instructed.
Xi Ying agreed, and after exchanging a couple of brief sentences, the communication ended.
Yuan Ming left the room and saw Nan Shangfeng and Wulu waiting outside. He nodded towards them, and the three of them set out together to register at the recruitment place.
As expected by Nan Shangfeng, the news of recruiting people, once released, immediately stirred the entire city, creating a wave of enthusiasm.
The number of cultivators in the streets was several times more than usual. On the way, Yuan Ming and the others frequently heard people discussing the matter. When they arrived at the recruitment place, it was surrounded by so many cultivators that it was impenetrable; the line for registration extended beyond the hall and couldn't be seen at a glance.
However, among the cultivators in line here, most were at the Nascent Soul and Core Formation levels. Nan Shangfeng released a bit of Returning Void aura, and the cultivators in front of them spontaneously made way, not daring to block their path.
Soon, they passed through the crowd and entered the hall responsible for recruitment.
The person in charge of registering Returning Void cultivators in the hall was a venerable old man with white hair. He saw Yuan Ming and the others arrive and immediately took out three jade scrolls.
"Please write down your names, cultivation levels, and the magic treasures you excel at using. They will be used during team formation later," the white-haired old man said politely.
"Team formation?" Wulu was surprised.
"Because there are too many people registering, the City Lord has ordered that everyone be divided into five teams. Those at the Nascent Soul and below are easy to divide by headcount, but you, Fellow Daoists, have high cultivation levels and are considered the main force. In battles, if not coordinated, at least you shouldn't hinder each other, hence writing down your preferred combat methods," the white-haired old man explained.
"The three of us are together and have a tacit understanding with each other. I hope Fellow Daoist will assign us together on the registration list," Nan Shangfeng interjected.
"That's easy," the white-haired old man noted down his request.
"Fellow Daoist Nan, shouldn't you follow Master Tantai?" Wulu whispered.
"My master specifically requested not to use his name," Nan Shangfeng replied with a wry smile.
Yuan Ming understood immediately, knowing that Master Tantai had forced Nan Shangfeng out for training, so it was impossible for him to hide behind his master's name and enjoy privileges.
The three of them quickly handed back the jade scroll with their information, and to conceal his identity, Yuan Ming suppressed his cultivation to the Early Stage of Returning Void, not revealing his Dharma manifestation status.
"Good, I've submitted your information. Please take this token and keep it safe. In three days, the token will display the team you have been assigned to and the gathering place. At that time, you will also need to check your identity through the token, so please don't lose it," the old man took the jade scroll, operated for a while, and distributed three tokens to Yuan Ming and his companions.
Yuan Ming and his companions accepted the tokens and turned to leave, but just as they exited the hall, they were suddenly stopped by two Returning Void cultivators.
"Are you Wan Tianren?" The leader was a burly man carrying a broad ax.
"You are?" Yuan Ming slightly frowned, not recalling seeing this man before.
"My name is Chong Di; just seeing your extraordinary demeanor, I figured you must have some skill. I wanted to seek some pointers, hoping you won't disappoint me," the burly man grinned, unabashedly dismissing Yuan Ming.
Wulu's face darkened upon hearing this, glancing at Yuan Ming, but seeing he wasn't reacting, remained silent. Beside him, Nan Shangfeng sneered.
"Fellow Daoist Chong has mistaken me. I'm just an ordinary loose cultivator. If you're looking to make a name in White Emperor City by challenging someone, you'd better find someone else," Yuan Ming shook his head and replied calmly, showing no anger.
"Haha! Is Fellow Daoist Wan afraid? As a dignified Returning Void cultivator, how could you be so timid? It might go against your Dao heart!" The burly man laughed loudly, deliberately raising his voice to attract the attention of nearby cultivators.
Yuan Ming didn't respond, silently bypassing the group and continuing towards the cave mansion with Wulu and the others.
"Bah, Wan Tianren, what a coward you are, not even daring to spar. I suggest you don't register for the treasure hunt; save yourself from embarrassment," the burly man spat in the direction of Yuan Ming, his voice loud enough to be heard by all.
However, Yuan Ming didn't turn back, seeming not to hear, and continued straight ahead.
…..
Several days later.
Due to the unexpectedly high number of registrations, the City Lord Mansion posted a new notice, announcing that the departure time was postponed to half a month later.
Yuan Ming didn't think much upon hearing the news and continued to pass the time by retreating into his cultivation.
However, within a few days after he registered, strange rumors started circulating in the city.
"Tsk, where did people hear these rumors from? Saying things like Fellow Daoist Wan had been involved in kidnapping and extortion, and some even said he massacred mortals, destroying dozens of Human Clan cities. The most absurd of all is some unknown female cultivator claiming she was violated by Fellow Daoist Wan, but when one tries to investigate, she hides away. What do you make of this?" Nan Shangfeng slammed his wine cup on the table, speaking in an indignant tone.
"It's definitely someone deliberately trying to tarnish Brother Wan's name, that Chong Di who approached us that day was just the beginning." Wulu also said coldly.
"No, we must find a way to help Fellow Daoist Wan clear his name, otherwise, if this continues, something bad is definitely going to happen!" Nan Shangfeng said.
"No need to waste your efforts." Yuan Ming, who had been silently listening, shook his head.
"Why? Is Fellow Daoist Wan willing to be humiliated by them?" Nan Shangfeng asked unwillingly.
"Of course not, but how can we clarify something we haven't done? Moreover, how many cultivators in the city truly believe the rumors, and how many just want to see a Returning to Void cultivator embarrassed? The more you respond, the more you fall into their trap. To them, spreading rumors is costless, achieved with just a few spoken words." Yuan Ming calmly said.
"But..." Nan Shangfeng still wanted to argue.
"No more words, the opinion of the masses doesn't matter to me, as long as you are willing to believe in me. The one spreading rumors wants to force me to react, but I refuse to comply." Yuan Ming raised his hand to stop Nan Shangfeng.
"Sigh, alright, since you say so." Nan Shangfeng reluctantly agreed.
"Let's focus on cultivation."
Yuan Ming slowly stood up, leaving these words behind before returning to his quarters to continue his retreat.
...
Half a month later.
The day of departure arrived, and Yuan Ming along with the other three left the Cave Mansion early, heading to the assembly point indicated by the token.
They were assigned to the fifth team, led by a Dharma manifestation Cultivator named Wang Fulong from the Sunset Sect.
When Yuan Ming and his two companions arrived, the other Returning to Void cultivators had mostly gathered, and Wang Fulong was already waiting.
"Hmm, why don't you three wait by my side for now." Wang Fulong verified the identities of the three and his gaze lingered on Yuan Ming for a few moments.
"Yes." Yuan Ming and the other two responded in unison.
After settling, they noticed that Chong Di, who previously provoked Yuan Ming, had also been assigned to the fifth team.
Seeing Yuan Ming and his companions notice him, he responded with a provocative smirk.
"Don't bother with him." Yuan Ming quietly advised, with Nan Shangfeng and Wulu both nodding silently.
Soon, the members of the fifth team were all present. Wang Fulong counted the numbers before leading the group outside the city to rendezvous with the larger force.
When they reached outside the city, Yuan Ming and his companions were surprised to find that White Emperor City had assembled nearly ten thousand cultivators, and all five teams were led by Dharma manifestation Cultivators.
The leader of the first team was Sima Changqin, the second team was led by Long Hou, the third by Master Tantai, and the fourth was led by Jin Chen, the son of the White Emperor City Lord.
"Strange, why didn't the White Emperor City Lord come?" Yuan Ming was pondering when he overheard discussions around him.
"In the Nineteen Cities of Ten Thousand Demon, from the day the City Lord takes office, he must always stay within the city, regardless of the major events, not allowed to step out. This is an ironclad rule." Surprisingly, Wang Fulong, who seemed to overhear the discussions among the Returning to Void cultivators, proactively explained.
Upon hearing this, the previously puzzled crowd burst into praises for the selflessness of the White Emperor City Lord.
Yuan Ming, however, was not interested in this, his eyes scanning around until he spotted Xi Ying and the cultivators from the Sky Eagle Chamber of Commerce within the first team's ranks.
Perhaps telepathically connected, at this moment, Xi Ying was also searching for Yuan Ming. Their eyes met from afar, both realizing they were looking at each other, and a smile appeared on their faces simultaneously.
"Fellow Daoists, thank you all for gathering here to contribute to our Human Clan in seeking the Heavenly Fire. I am Qin Mo, appointed by Ancestor Bing Lan to oversee the Heavenly Fire mission. Rest assured, with me here, I will not let the Demon Clan lay a finger on the Heavenly Fire. We shall certainly return fulfilled!" At this moment, Sima Changqin soared up, amplifying his voice with mana, reaching every corner of the five teams.
In an instant, emotions were stirred; many cultivators raised their arms and shouted, praising Sima Changqin as well as lauding the Human Clan's brilliance. Though the voices were uneven, they were earth-shaking and spine-tingling.
"Set off!" Sima Changqin smiled slightly, raising his hand and pointing forward.
Subsequently, the five teams moved out together, driving their tunneling light, heading towards the Fire Rock Desert like meteors...

chapters.title: Chapter 927 - 896: Unexpected Gains
chapters.content:
Fire Rock Desert.
According to legend, this scorching red world was created by the aftermath of a battle between a former Great Mahayana Ancestor and a past Demon Emperor, leaving behind a perilous land.
Here, red sand fills the sky, and every grain of sand and every stone on the ground appears in a fiery orange-red. If touched, it will instantly ignite, forming a sea of flames that cannot be extinguished with water.
Once the five teams from White Emperor City arrived here, they quickly dispersed and each carved out a region, advancing in a fan shape to search for traces of the Heavenly Fire.
The exploration area assigned to Yuan Ming's fifth team was vast.
The elder of the Sunset Sect, Wang Fulong, simply divided the direction, splitting the team into several small squads led by Returning to Void Stage Cultivators.
"Wan Tianren, you are at the Returning to Void Stage?" Wang Fulong looked at Yuan Ming and asked.
"Early Stage of Returning to Void." Yuan Ming emphasized.
"Then you and Wei Ling will take a team to search the westernmost area." Wang Fulong said after a brief consideration.
"As you command." As the words echoed, a young scholar in a Confucian robe with a square cap stepped forward.
Yuan Ming looked up at him, and the scholar gave him a gentle smile.
"Wei Ling is at the middle-stage Returning Void. With the two of you leading the team, you should be safe. If you encounter danger or make a discovery, Wei Ling will use a talisman arrow to notify me, and I will assist promptly." Wang Fulong said.
"Understood." Yuan Ming cupped his fists and said.
Then, Wei Ling randomly selected seven or eight Nascent Soul cultivators and twenty or thirty Core Formation cultivators from the team and led them westward.
As they gradually distanced themselves from the other teams, Wei Ling began to instruct everyone:
"No matter what happens later, remember not to panic or get separated from the team. If you encounter a demon beast and it does not attack, do not provoke it. Remember, our goal is to search for traces of the Heavenly Fire, not to fight demon beasts. I have the responsibility to lead you into the desert, and I also have the responsibility to bring you out. I hope you will all follow my command."
"Yes." The group responded one after another, hearing this.
Most of them came for the generous rewards of this mission, naturally wanting to return alive.
"Fellow Daoist Wan, your cultivation is slightly weaker, so I will lead the way in front. A few Nascent Soul cultivators will be in the center, and the rest of the Core Formation cultivators will be in groups of three at both ends of the team. You will follow at the rear, just in case of any emergencies. How about it?" Wei Ling finally looked at Yuan Ming and asked.
"That's fine, let's do as Fellow Daoist Wei says." Yuan Ming thought for a moment and nodded.
Soon, the team rearranged their formation and prepared to officially begin the search mission.
"Does anyone in the team have a flying spiritual beast? Release them to search from high above, and report any suspicious areas immediately." Wei Ling suddenly said, glancing subtly at Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming turned a deaf ear to this and did not send Lei Yu ahead to explore.
Instead, a few cultivators in the team responded and released their flying spiritual beasts to patrol the sky.
The team set off again, and Yuan Ming silently followed at the end of the team, constantly observing the surroundings.
After half a day passed, the scorching sun was high, and the deserted desert lay in complete silence.
As far as the eye could see, there was not a trace of life, as if it were a forbidden zone untouched by any being.
The small team searched the desert for a long time without encountering danger or finding any trace of the Heavenly Fire.
"Master, searching with these people is too slow. The people of the Ten Thousand Demon Country have already entered this desert and may have already found the Heavenly Fire. Perhaps we should break away from the team and head towards the depths of the Fire Rock Desert." Lei Yu's voice resounded in Yuan Ming's Sea of Consciousness.
"If the Heavenly Fire were so easy to obtain, it would have been taken by the Ten Thousand Demon Country long ago; there's no rush." Yuan Ming shook his head slightly.
Having faced no danger for such a long time, the members of the small team also gradually relaxed from their initial vigilance, spreading out to search for spiritual materials buried in the desert.
These Core Formation and Nascent Soul cultivators did not dare hope for capturing the Heavenly Fire, and they were here for the various spiritual materials of the Fire Rock Desert.
The desert appeared barren, yet the Spiritual Energy was extremely abundant, producing plenty of spiritual materials, which were occasionally found, although they were mostly ordinary items.
Yuan Ming had no interest in the spiritual materials and did not join the search, instead planning his next move.
The Heavenly Fire probably would not appear anytime soon, and he was considering whether to possess Wu Li again to see the situation on Sima Changqin's side.
"What is this?" A voice came from nearby as a burly Core Formation man with a rough face dug out a piece of blue ore from the red sand, its surface faintly emitting the radiance of stars, looking quite mysterious.
Two nearby Core Formation cultivators came over, but neither recognized it.
Yuan Ming glanced over casually and was slightly intrigued, "Oh, this is..."
In a blink of an eye, he appeared above the three Core Formation cultivators.
"Mr. Wan!" The three hurriedly greeted him.
"Let me see the ore." Yuan Ming extended his hand.
Upon hearing this, the three had their expressions change.
In the wild lands of the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range, the law of the jungle prevails, with cultivators continually preying on each other, robbery and even murder for treasures happen all the time.
At present, although the group was acting as a team, they were scattered, and their small unit was entirely under the control of two Returning to Void cultivators.
If a Returning to Void Stage leader seized something from a Core Formation Stage cultivator, no one would say anything.
One of the three men, a short man, turned and left, indicating he wanted to stay out of it.
The other cultivator, however, did not walk away but instead moved closer to the burly man.
It was then that Yuan Ming noticed that this Core Formation Stage cultivator was also burly and rugged. His appearance was strikingly similar to the burly man who found the blue ore, as if they were twin brothers.
The burly man holding the ore, however, had shifty eyes and seemed very anxious, while the other looked innocent, a bit naive, and stared straight at Yuan Ming.
"Second brother, do not be rude! Mr. Wan, my younger brother is naturally a bit silly, please do not take offense. Let this ore be our apology." The burly man hurriedly pulled his brother behind him and offered the blue ore with both hands to Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming ignored the burly man's words, took the blue ore, and examined it carefully.
"Not bad, it's indeed Heavenly Star Sand!" he thought to himself, a slight smile creasing his lips.
This blue ore was the final main material needed to refine the Moon God Ring, the Heavenly Star Sand.
Having already found Moonlight Stone, Snow Jade, and Moon Cold Core, and most of the other auxiliary materials, finding the Heavenly Star Sand was significant.
Once this operation concluded and he returned to White Emperor City, he would gather the remaining auxiliary materials and could then refine the Moon God Ring.
The burly man noticed Yuan Ming's expression, knowing this blue ore was undoubtedly extraordinary, and felt quite pained.
However, he dared not speak and was about to pull his brother away.
"This item is of use to me, I will take it. Do you need anything? Spirit stones can also be used for purchase." Yuan Ming's voice suddenly resounded.
The burly man was surprised by these words, staring blankly at Yuan Ming.
"I am short on time, speak up quickly if you need anything." Yuan Ming put away the Heavenly Star Sand and said.
"I humbly request a more refined Earth Attribute Cultivation Method, preferably one that can be cultivated to the Nascent Soul Stage!" The burly man suddenly woke, his heart filled with unexpected joy, and bowed deeply.
Pressing his hand on his brother's head, they both bowed to Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming was not surprised and, using his Divine Sense, searched through his storage magic tool, quickly retrieving a Jade Scroll and tossing it over.
"Take it, this 'Earth Core Magnetic Skill' is fairly refined and can be cultivated to the late-stage Nascent Soul."
'Earth Core Magnetic Skill' came from the Guiyuan Sect on the Yunhuang Continent, and after the Guiyuan Sect was destroyed, the complete cultivation technique fell into his hands.
Though this technique was of little use to him now, it was extremely valuable to these two brothers, especially since the 'Earth Core Magnetic Skill' included a rare Divine Skill for controlling Earth Core Primordial Magnetism.
"Thank you, Mr. Wan!" The burly man quickly checked the content of the Jade Scroll, his eyes showing excitement, and bowed deeply again.
He and his brother had both reached the late-stage Core Formation, only lacking a Nascent Soul Stage cultivation method to attempt forming a Nascent Soul.
This 'Earth Core Magnetic Skill' was not only refined but also contained two secret techniques to assist in forming a Nascent Soul, something the brothers longed for.
Yuan Ming waved his hand and flew forward.
The younger brother asked about the Jade Scroll's content, and the burly man explained briefly before carefully storing it away and leading his brother to catch up with the team.
The younger brother stared in a daze at Yuan Ming's figure in the mid-air.
The team continued onward, soon passing another half day.
The temperature here was increasingly scorching, and the spiritual energy from nature was even more abundant, with desert demon beasts beginning to attack.
The team did not dare to freely search for spiritual materials anymore, coming together again for fear of being caught by demon beasts.
Yuan Ming remained at the back of the team on guard, gathering his Divine Thought, exploring the surroundings.
"Once you encounter a demon beast attack, do not chase too far, stay by my side. Help others if you can, but if you can't save them, don't risk it." A voice came, the older brother of the burly twins who had sold him the Heavenly Star Sand.
The younger brother nodded heavily, saying nothing.
Yuan Ming was slightly surprised by these words.
Most cultivators are practical people; not plotting against others is already considered decent. Yet this seemingly naive younger brother still wished to help others?
"Don't be too afraid. As long as I'm here, I'll ensure you're safe. Once we get the rewards from this mission, we'll rent a nice cave mansion and go into seclusion to advance to the Nascent Soul Stage." The older brother saw his sibling's tense expression, patted his shoulder, and comforted him.
The younger brother, upon hearing this, smiled awkwardly.
Yuan Ming's gaze lingered on the two brothers for a few extra breaths before moving on.
At that moment, Wei Ling, walking at the front, suddenly called for the team to halt and shouted, "Be careful, something is approaching."
Yuan Ming naturally had already noticed, but he found that the approaching threats were only a few low-level demon beasts, so he didn't take them seriously.
As the words fell, from the distant sand, emerged numerous large yellow-brown heads, with fleshy wings at the back; they were unmistakably low-level fire lizards.

chapters.title: Chapter 928 - 897: Fellow Loose Cultivators
chapters.content:
These guys are simply curious about Yuan Ming and the others who intruded, with no intent to attack.
However, their appearance still made everyone perk up; they were indeed quite tense for a moment.
A Core Formation Stage cultivator couldn't hold back and launched a sharp icicle several feet long at a nearby fire lizard, piercing its skull directly and instantly causing the other fire lizards to retreat in shock.
"I haven't given the order, who told you to act!" Wei Ling scolded immediately upon discovering the situation.
"I-I was too nervous... Isn't it true that nothing went wrong," the Core Formation cultivator said anxiously.
"If this happens again, I will expel you from the team, and you will fend for yourself," Wei Ling, despite his scholarly appearance, was full of authority when angry.
Just as his words fell, Yuan Ming's reminder came.
"Pay attention to both sides; demons are approaching." Yuan Ming's calm and steady voice startled but did not panic everyone, making them concentrate and cautiously look to the sides.
Sure enough, from the distant sand dunes came the sound of sand sliding, black shadows densely packed, layered, surging over like a black tide.
"Don't panic, they are Desert Fire Scorpions, demons not even third-level. Let them get closer to attack; don't waste your mana," Yuan Ming glanced at them and said.
Upon hearing this, everyone truly did not rush to act. It wasn't until the tide-like black scorpions swarmed to within ten or so feet that they began casting divine powers and magic techniques against the scorpions.
Patches of Fire Cloud, blades of ice, streaks of thunder... fell one after another into the scorpion tide, crackling and exploding quickly clearing out all the scorpions.
Yuan Ming did not act throughout; he simply watched others' performance calmly, silently estimating their combat power.
To his surprise, among the twin brothers, the one with richer mana and stronger magic power was not the older brother but the younger.
This person's cultivation was already at the peak of late-stage core formation, wielding the divine power of Earth God Thunder; he continuously unleashed large Earth Thunder Balls, and if it weren't for the brother's timely admonition, he might have exhausted all his mana regardless of the consequences before stopping.
Once this batch of fire scorpions was repelled, more fire beasts attacked successively, but they were all rather weak and were quickly repelled.
After searching for another hour, Wei Ling found Yuan Ming.
"Fellow Daoist Wan, searching like this is indeed inefficient, and along the way, we haven't found any powerful demon beasts. How about dividing the team into two squads, you and I each lead a squad to search, how about it?" Wei Ling suggested.
"Alright." Yuan Ming had no objection, nodding in agreement.
Subsequently, the team split into four Nascent Soul Realm cultivators and thirteen Core Formation cultivators, following Yuan Ming to search further west.
The twin brothers were also among them.
After splitting up, Yuan Ming rearranged the formation, taking the lead, with four Nascent Soul Stage cultivators scattered around and thirteen Core Formation cultivators in the center.
Once the squad split, both the four Nascent Soul Stage cultivators and the thirteen Core Formation Stage became more cautious, fully deploying their techniques.
The sturdy man among the twin brothers summoned an Iron Feathered Black Hawk that flew overhead, surveying the surroundings.
Though this hawk was only a third-level demon beast, it appeared exceptionally majestic, with pitch-black iron feathers faintly revealing purple thunder patterns, quite resembling the Thunder Peng.
Yuan Ming observed the Iron Feathered Black Hawk for a moment, then gestured to the sturdy man.
The sturdy man hurried over, bowing in salute to Yuan Ming, "Mr. Wan, what instructions do you have?"
"No need to be so formal; your black hawk seems unusual with its thunder patterns. What kind of demon beast is it?" Yuan Ming asked.
"This is an Iron Winged Bird, but it carries traces of Thunder Peng bloodline, although the bloodline is very thin, giving it no special qualities other than faster flight speed," the sturdy man replied.
Yuan Ming nodded slightly and continued, "Is your Iron Winged Bird female?"
"Yes," the sturdy man replied, slightly taken aback.
Yuan Ming didn't say anything more, but a glimmer of joy passed through his eyes.
Having understood the divine power of the Golden Sunflower Beast Taming Technique's Dao Seal, he had, for some time, been relaying messages urging Hua Zhi and Vajra to hurry over and simultaneously striving to elevate the spirit beast nurturing techniques.
A few days ago, Yuan Ming spent a significant amount of Spirit Stones at the workshop in White Emperor City on a manual regarding spirit beast nurturing, which contained a Replenishing Secret Technique similar to evil cultivation, able to increase the chances of a spirit beast breakthrough by absorbing the original demon power of female demon beasts.
However, this Replenishing Secret Technique had quite stringent conditions, only allowing replenishment from demon beasts with the same bloodline power.
Lei Yu's talents were far inferior to Hua Zhi and Vajra, and its potential was nearly depleted, though reaching the peak of the upper fifth level wouldn't be a problem. Breaking through to level six, even with the aid of the Golden Sunflower Beast Taming Technique, seemed unlikely.
The Golden Sunflower Beast Taming Technique can only impart breakthrough experience; without enough qualifications, a spirit beast still cannot break through.
To increase Lei Yu's chances of breaking through to level six, he could only use this Replenishing Secret Technique.
This Iron Winged Bird possesses the Thunder Peng bloodline and is female; it's not to be missed.
"This Iron Winged Bird is somewhat useful to me as well. May I purchase it? The reward is negotiable," Yuan Ming said.
"This beast has been with me for many years, and we have a deep bond. But since Mr. Wan requires it, of course, I will offer it up willingly. As for the reward, could the senior kindly bestow an elixir or spiritual object that aids in breaking through to the Nascent Soul stage?" the burly man was overjoyed internally, yet showed a face of difficult decision.
He placed the Iron Winged Bird into the Spiritual Beast Bag and presented it with both hands.
Without needing emotion manipulation, Yuan Ming could discern the burly man's true intentions but chose not to expose them, casually tossing two jade bottles over.
Inside the jade bottles were two Level 4 Fetus Nourishing Pills, which aid in breaking through to the Nascent Soul.
"Thank you, senior, for the elixirs." The burly man opened a tiny gap in the bottle stopper, his eyes shining with delight as he thanked.
Yuan Ming paid him no mind, placing his palm over the Spiritual Beast Bag and using the Golden Sunflower Beast Taming Technique to remove the Beast Taming Rune planted by the burly man inside the Iron Winged Bird, then re-tamed it using the Golden Sunflower Beast Taming Technique.
"Mr. Wan, you don't seem like a cultivator from the Sunset Sect?" Having conducted two consecutive deals with Yuan Ming, the burly man was less reserved and asked.
"I'm a loose cultivator," Yuan Ming replied calmly.
Upon learning Yuan Ming was a loose cultivator, the burly man relaxed significantly, showing more a sense of closeness, introducing himself, "I'm Niu Gengtian, and my younger brother is Niu Fengshou, also a loose cultivator."
"The two of you have achieved considerable cultivation, though your names have some common worldly air," Yuan Ming said, slightly surprised upon hearing their names.
"Our family hails from a secular farming background; these names were given by our parents. After cultivating for a longer life, I've nearly forgotten my parents' looks, leaving only this name they bestowed. If changed, there would be no memory left," Niu Gengtian said with a shake of his head.
Yuan Ming nodded, recalling his own parents, feeling a sense of melancholy.
"How did you and your brother embark on the Immortal Path?" He quickly adjusted his emotions and asked.
"It's quite a long story..." Niu Gengtian began narrating.
Seemingly having great admiration for Yuan Ming's achievement of reaching the Returning Void realm as a loose cultivator, Niu Gengtian revealed his entire cultivation journey as though pouring beans.
He and his brother came from a family dedicated to farm work. Their master, while wandering, stumbled upon that remote mountain village, unexpectedly discovering they were raw jade with excellent cultivation talent, thus taking them as disciples and leading them onto the cultivation path.
At that time, they were already close to twenty.
In the cultivation world, a slower start means continuously falling behind, especially for those who squander the best years for cultivation, making their journey tens of times more difficult.
Fortunately, he and his brother had a strong determination toward Dao, were diligent in cultivation, coupled with good fortune, ultimately surpassing their master who reached only Early-stage Core Formation after a lifetime of struggle, attaining Late-stage Core Formation, they truly excelled.
"Your brother seems to have mental maturity that doesn't align with his age; is this innate?" Yuan Ming asked, glancing at Niu Fengshou beside him.
He could perceive Niu Fengshou's Seven Emotions, differing from ordinary people.
"Yes, he has been simple-minded since childhood. But this isn't entirely a bad thing; with a simple mind, once he commits to a task, his resolve surpasses ordinary people by several times, whether in cultivation or practicing divine skills, I'm no match for him," Niu Gengtian said, looking at Niu Fengshou.
"I see, but his approach to life seems quite naive; you should keep a close watch on him in the future," Yuan Ming raised an eyebrow and advised.
"That is the master's teaching; his last words before passing were that as loose cultivators, our cultivation is challenging, and we must try to be kind to others, avoiding hindrance. My brother remembers these words well, helping those in need whenever possible, leaving me helpless," Niu Gengtian smiled wryly.
"Your brother is quite interesting," Yuan Ming laughed.
Encountering much deception and betrayal in the cultivation world, Yuan Ming did not agree with Niu Fengshou's conduct, but he wasn't the type to lecture others and did not object.
"Since you're a loose cultivator, you've probably taken a task here in the Fire Rock Desert, right?" Yuan Ming asked.
"That's correct; I took on a task from the Sky Eagle Chamber of Commerce. The reward is quite generous; upon completing it, we can rent a cave mansion rich in spiritual energy, along with the elixir bestowed by Mr. Wan, greatly enhancing my and my brother's chances of breaking into the Nascent Soul stage," Niu Gengtian smiled simply and said.
"What are your plans after breaking into the Nascent Soul stage?" Yuan Ming asked.
The pair had good cultivation and character, intriguing him to recruit them into the Moon Sect.
Additionally, Niu Fengshou's mental issue related to the Seven Emotions, if researched thoroughly, could significantly aid his mastery of the Power of Seven Emotions.
"Well..." Niu Gengtian was about to speak.
Before he could finish, Yuan Ming's heart suddenly jumped, overwhelmed by an indescribable sense of crisis.
"It's an ambush! Retreat quickly!"
Yuan Ming's brow furrowed as he shouted, simultaneously raising a hand.
An invisible force swept out with him at the center, sending over a dozen cultivators, including Niu Gengtian, flying back dozens of feet without understanding what happened.

chapters.title: Chapter 929 - 898: Ambush
chapters.content:
In the next instant, a blinding white light suddenly lit up from beneath, briefly depriving Yuan Ming of his sight.
Then, a misty water fog emerged all around, obscuring everything in view, enveloping him completely.
Yuan Ming felt as if all the auras around him were isolated, as if he were trapped in a water prison, unable to see anything from the outside.
"Has it finally come?" Yuan Ming murmured to himself, using his Divine Sense to probe his surroundings, but it was like probing into endless mist, finding no clue.
"What a powerful Array, almost reaching the sixth-level standard. Not to mention ordinary Returning to Void Stage cultivators, even those with Dharma manifestation would find it difficult to detect. Could it be that my true strength has been discovered?" His face showed a hint of surprise, and he quickly analyzed the characteristics of the Array with his experience as a Level 6 Array Master.
Though this water mist Great Array was elusive, it was not yet a sixth-level Array. He soon found a clue and raised his hand to grab.
A giant yellow hand emerged from his body, grabbing a part of the Array.
Outside, four cultivators wearing black magic robes revealed themselves from the surroundings.
Each of them formed a spell with their hands and seemed to be channeling Mana towards the position beneath Yuan Ming.
There, a circular silver mirror, three feet in radius, shone with dazzling light and runes flickered within.
Beneath the circular silver mirror, water mist condensed, forming an inverted bell-shaped white mist cover several tens of meters large, firmly enveloping Yuan Ming within.
At this moment, the white mist bell suddenly emitted a thunderous roar, shaking violently, showing signs of collapse.
"The Silver Light Water Moon Array alone can't hold him. Quickly, continue adding arrays!" The tallest among the four whispered urgently.
As his words fell, the four of them turned their wrists and took out a palm-sized earthy yellow seal.
Each seal had a sculpture of a mountain on top, each of different shapes but all vivid and lifelike.
"Four Mountains Linked, Suppress!" The four shouted in unison.
The seals in their hands instantly emitted yellowish light, enveloping Yuan Ming at the center.
Each layer of light that covered condensed into a phantom of a mountain, pressing down on the Silver Light Water Moon Array.
Inside the Array, Yuan Ming immediately felt as if he was carrying a mountain on his shoulders, his whole body sinking.
Layer upon layer of light covered, mountain phantoms stacking one upon another, quickly reaching four layers.
The Silver Light Water Moon Array, which was violently shaking, completely stabilized, and Yuan Ming inside seemed to be thoroughly suppressed.
"Who are you people? Why ambush us?" Not far away, a dried-up, withered, yellow-skinned Nascent Soul Stage elder, braved himself to shout.
The four ignored him, continuing to operate the Array and add more mountains.
"We are people of White Emperor City, you..." The yellow-skinned elder tried to bluff, attempting to scare them off.
But before he could finish his words, a black light suddenly attacked him.
The elder was shocked, hurriedly summoning a green wooden shield magic treasure.
Unfortunately, it was useless. The black light pierced through the wooden shield magic treasure with a puff and hit his chest, creating a bloody hole.
The yellow-skinned elder sidestepped half a foot at the critical moment, avoiding a fatal injury, vomiting blood as his body flew away, landing on the ground immobile.
"Noisy..." One of the four black robed men, a skinny monkey-like fellow, said impatiently.
The yellow-skinned elder's cultivation had reached the Nascent Soul Middle Stage, the highest among the four Nascent Soul cultivators. The others, seeing this, didn't dare say a word, quickly escaping to a distance, with another Nascent Soul Stage cultivator taking the yellow-skinned elder away.
"Hehe, this Wan Tianren indeed hid his skills. A Returning Void Early Stage cultivator couldn't last so long under the Four Mountains Linked Seal." The tallest cultivator among the four black robes spoke.
"Even if he hid his skills, it's useless. With us four brothers jointly operating the Silver Light Water Moon Mirror, he couldn't detect it at all. Falling into the Array was an unavoidable outcome. Once the Four Mountains Linked Seal stacks enough layers, even if he's in the Late Stage of Returning Void, he'll still be crushed into a pile of mud!" Another laughed heartily.
The four laughed as they spoke, but their hands didn't slow down, fully activating the yellow seal.
Inside the Great Array, Yuan Ming also felt some pressure, forming hand seals with both hands.
A gray and white light rose from his body, forming a scaled-down Dharma manifestation, finally resisting the heavy pressure coming at him.
"So it's a nested array, no wonder it has such power." He murmured.
Nesting arrays involves combining two large arrays together.
This combination is not simply placing two arrays together but merging array patterns, requiring extremely high Array Formation Cultivation to set up.
Of course, the power of a nested array is also much greater than the sum of two arrays.
Although Yuan Ming was already a Level 6 Array Master, he hadn't researched nested arrays before, and breaking it by array means would take considerable time.
He didn't bother, operating the Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill, a blood-colored giant elephant appeared behind him.
The thick elephant trunk swung with a whistling sound, causing ripples to appear in the Void, heavily striking the Great Array.
The Silver Light Water Moon Array trembled again, the mountain phantoms on the Array shook incessantly, nearly being shaken off.
"What!" The four black robed men exclaimed in shock, hurriedly struggling to maintain the Array.
"Scram!" the scrawny monkey among the black-robed men suddenly remembered something and shouted at the squad in the distance.
The heavy injury of the yellow-skinned elder threw the rest of the squad into panic, and as they saw the scrawny monkey roar, almost everyone chose to flee.
The twin brothers were no exception.
However, when Niu Gengtian was pulling on Niu Fengshou's arm, trying to drag him away, Niu Fengshou suddenly seemed to be triggered by something and charged madly towards the cage that trapped Yuan Ming.
"This is bad..." Niu Gengtian's face changed suddenly.
The reason their master fell years ago was due to an ambush during an outing, suppressed by four cultivators using an array, and severely injured. If not for him and Niu Fengshou arriving in time, their master would have perished on the spot.
Even though he was saved, their master ultimately succumbed to his injuries and passed away.
The situation back then was exactly the same as Yuan Ming's current predicament.
But neither Niu Fengshou nor he had the ability to rescue Yuan Ming.
"Come back!" Niu Gengtian chased after him.
Niu Fengshou's palms radiated with yellow light, and dozens of Earth God Thunder, head-sized, shot out towards the four black-robed men.
"Courting death!" The black-robed scrawny monkey, upon seeing this scene, was both surprised and greatly annoyed.
A Core Formation Stage cultivator dared to attack them!
With a wave of his arm, another wave of black light swept over, easily extinguishing the dozens of Earth God Thunder and continued slashing towards Niu Fengshou.
Niu Gengtian arrived in the nick of time, crashing heavily into Niu Fengshou, knocking him away.
A burst of blood light appeared, and the two brothers were simultaneously knocked away.
Niu Fengshou's right arm was severed, gushing blood.
Niu Gengtian's body was cut in half, the Golden Core in his dantian shattered, and his divine soul collapsed and dispersed, leaving him as a mere corpse.
"You insignificant wretch, dare to meddle in this?" The scrawny monkey sneered coldly, ignoring the two and continued to intensify his casting.
Yet, just as he finished speaking, a dazzling light suddenly erupted within the Four Mountains Linked Formation, which had already stacked twelve layers of mountains.
An indescribably powerful presence surged forth, shattering the stacked mountain shadows with a boom, dispersing countless golden fragments, as a blood-colored elephant phantom enveloping Yuan Ming emerged.
The four black-robed men were violently shaken, forced back by the immensely strong shockwave.
In panic, they retreated. The tall leading cultivator exclaimed, "He's a body cultivation, a Body of Wanxiang!"
Yuan Ming's divine soul power broke through the formation's control, sensing that most cultivators had already fled, thus he chose to break the array and emerge. However, he didn't expect to see the severely injured twins upon coming out.
Niu Fengshou was clutching his brother's corpse, his face full of panic and helplessness.
A flash of murderous intent appeared in Yuan Ming's eyes, yet he didn't immediately act. Instead, he restrained his mana and dispersed the blood-colored elephant phantom, pretending to have forcibly broken through the array and had his aura disturbed.
"Something's not right; his aura is chaotic," shouted one of the black-robed men loudly.
As his voice sounded, Yuan Ming, as if his facade of strength had been uncovered, showed a brief moment of panic in his eyes, and then instantly sprang up and fled rapidly into the distance.
"He's used a secret technique that harms his qi-blood, chase him; don't let him escape," the tall cultivator quickly reacted, shouting loudly.
The other three snapped back to their senses and immediately gave chase.
In just a few dozen breaths, the five engaged in pursuit and escape had reached a desolate area.
The four black-robed cultivators flying through the air saw Yuan Ming standing calmly in the middle of the wasteland, facing them with a composed demeanor.
The four immediately sensed something was amiss. Having lived together since childhood, they were of one mind, understanding one another without communication. Simultaneously, they formed sealing signs and jointly struck a palm towards Yuan Ming.
Black light lit up on their bodies simultaneously, and four streams of intensely water attribute power burst forth, converging into an extraordinarily thick giant pillar of light, smashing toward Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming's eyes focused, and the Nascent Soul within his dantian slowly opened its eyes, releasing an indescribable vast power from his body.
In the next instant, a brilliant white light surged behind him, and a three hundred zhang high grand dharma manifestation arose, swinging its small mountain-sized palm to press down on the four men.
"Dharma manifestation stage..." the four exclaimed in unison.
They couldn't believe that the man in front of them had hidden his power so deeply, that he wasn't some Returning to Void Stage cultivator, but a Dharma manifestation stage great power.
But by the time they realized, it was already too late.
The giant dharma manifestation hand was already covering the void above their heads, its immense power seemed to bring the press of the heavens and earth, leaving them no place to hide.
"Quick, use the Four Mountains Linked Seal formation," shouted the tall black-robed cultivator in a panic.
The other three immediately approached him, urgently activating their mountain seal, radiating brilliant golden light.
The surging golden light condensed into a massive mountain peak, enveloping and shielding the four, facing the giant hand.

chapters.title: Chapter 930 - 899: Bitter Disappointment
chapters.content:
"Boom boom boom"
Amidst a series of explosive roars, a massive Golden Light Mountain, along with the figures of those four people, was pressed into the depths of the desert.
The desert trembled, the sand dunes heaved, and a muffled rumble continually emanated from beneath the ground.
After a while, all the tremors subsided.
Yuan Ming's gigantic Dharma manifestation dissipated, and several roots of the Undying Tree slowly emerged from the ground, dragging out four Black Robed Cultivators, their bodies in tatters.
Among the four, only the tall cultivator still had breath, while the other three had been instantly drained of their life force, leaving behind three withered corpses.
Yuan Ming wasted no words, directly hoisting him up, and pointed at his forehead, forcefully beginning a Soul Search.
Within moments, he understood the identity of this group of people.
They were known as the Black River Four Foes, four Southern Central Continent Returning to Void Stage loose cultivators with a notorious reputation, who usually engaged in robbery and murder, none of them dying unjustly.
And this time, the reason they attempted to assassinate Yuan Ming was due to taking on a task from the Sunset Sect.
That Wei Ling was the person directly in contact with them, so proposing to act separately beforehand was also part of the plan—only by acting separately could they clear themselves from involvement.
"Senior, we're just doing business for money. You've already killed my three brothers. Could you spare me? The four of us have some considerable assets, and if you let me live, I'm willing to offer them all to you." The towering Black Robed Cultivator steadied his mind and said.
Yuan Ming paid no attention to his words and showed no reaction at all.
In fact, he wasn't even listening to what the other was saying, instead pondering the ins and outs of this ambush in his mind.
There had never been any dealings or grudges with the Sunset Sect before, so this inexplicably targeted assassination surely hid other secrets.
Using his identity as "Wan Tianren," he could only think of one person with whom he might have a grudge: the Guardian, Sima Changqin, whom he had only met once.
This fellow indeed had an extraordinary identity, publicly appearing virtuous, but secretly using underhanded tactics; the previous slanders against Yuan Ming seemed not enough, as he now attempted to completely eliminate him.
Yuan Ming had not planned to act against Sima Changqin so soon, but the opponent's initiative to approach aligned with his intentions.
His face remained solemn and silent, lifting a palm to strike out.
The tall Black Robed Cultivator bled from all seven orifices, all vitality, Nascent Soul, and Divine Soul completely annihilated.
Afterward, Yuan Ming collected the storage magic tools from the four, briefly inspecting them. Inside were numerous spiritual materials, spiritual medicine, and magic treasures, combining to surpass the wealth of an ordinary Dharma manifestation cultivator.
He put away the Four Mountains Linked Seal and the Silver Light Water Moon Mirror, then selected a few pieces of high-level spirit wood and some spiritual materials, subsequently leaping into the air, heading back to where he came from.
By now, Niu Gengtian's body had gone cold, while Niu Fengshou still tried to awaken his brother, tears streaming down, emitting sobs like a puppy's whimpering.
Yuan Ming sighed and approached Niu Fengshou.
Niu Fengshou's previously vacant gaze suddenly glowed fiercely, and he threw a punch toward Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming caught his wrist with one hand, twisted it forcefully, and Niu Fengshou showed a pained expression, his other hand ready to counterattack.
Yuan Ming waved his sleeve, and Niu Fengshou saw black, collapsing into deep sleep.
He touched Niu Fengshou's forehead with a finger, sending a surge of Soul Power inside and withdrawing it moments later.
Yuan Ming took out a High Grade Soul Refining Pill, stuffed it into Niu Fengshou's mouth, then stepped forward to hold down Niu Fengshou's head, helping him refine the medicinal power.
Niu Fengshou's mental problem fundamentally lay in his Divine Soul, initially intending to study it well, but now with Niu Gengtian dead, he felt uneasy about further research on his brother, hoping he might restore him.
Yuan Ming was actually not completely clear about Niu Fengshou's Divine Soul issue, resorting to the foolish method of enhancing his Divine Soul Power to see if it could help.
He used the Love Inquiry Technique, adjusting Niu Fengshou's Seven Emotions, and brought them into proper alignment.
As the vast Soul Power of the Soul Refining Pill was injected, Niu Fengshou desperately flailed his arms, trying to break free, but was unable to do so.
As the immense medicinal power began to be absorbed, Niu Fengshou's movements gradually slowed until they finally stopped, sitting quietly, his face covered in tears.
His expression no longer foolish, his eyes restored to the normal spirit of a person.
Yuan Ming released his hand, it seemed Niu Fengshou's mental problem was cured.
He also gained some insight, deepening his understanding of the Power of Seven Emotions.
Niu Fengshou remained still, his mind filled with images of his brother valiantly shielding him.
"Brother, I'm better now..." After a long time, he finally spoke such words in a trembling voice to his brother's corpse.
Yuan Ming offered no comfort, merely placing one of the Black River Four Foes' storage magic tools beside him.
"This mission is far more dangerous than you imagine, you can still withdraw now. Take your brother and leave the Fire Rock Desert, go back."
Niu Fengshou glanced at the storage magic tool and stood up.
"My mind is clear now, your ambush wasn't a coincidence, these four aren't the true culprits behind my brother's death. Can you tell me who really is?"
His eyes were full of hatred, waves of formidable Divine Power rippling around him.
The High Grade Soul Refining Pill not only cured Niu Fengshou's mental issues, but also increased his Soul Power by several times, rivaling that of late-stage Nascent Soul cultivators.

chapters.title: Chapter 931 - 899: Bitter Disappointment (Part 2)
chapters.content:
The Soul Power surged, but Niu Fengshou's cultivation was still at the Core Formation Stage, and he couldn't help but lose control.
"Restrain your Soul Power, or you might harm your Divine Soul," Yuan Ming reminded him.
Niu Fengshou was startled and tried to restrain his Divine Soul Power, quickly calming the turbulent Divine Sense fluctuations around him.
A trace of surprise flashed in Yuan Ming's eyes. Niu Fengshou had formidable control over his Divine Soul, truly a promising Soul Cultivator.
