"I don't know who the opponent is right now, but they must have a significant background. You're not their match, go back," he said, shaking his head and turning to walk away.
"I'm not afraid to die; please allow me to contribute!" Niu Fengshou chased after him, speaking anxiously.
"Is that so?" Yuan Ming took a few more steps forward before stopping.
"My brother has taken care of me since childhood. If not for him, I'd have died long ago. If I don't avenge him, I won't be at peace living!" Niu Fengshou's face was full of determination, ready to face death.
"Very well, return to White Emperor City first. If I need you later, I'll find you," Yuan Ming said.
With those words, he shot into the air, flying toward the direction of Wei Ling's team.
Niu Fengshou watched as Yuan Ming's tunneling light disappeared over the horizon, then collected Niu Gengtian's corpse and flew out of the Fire Rock Desert.
...
On the other side, the other three Nascent Soul cultivators from Yuan Ming's squad had all returned to Wei Ling, bringing with them the severely injured yellow-skinned elder, who was now in a coma.
A Nascent Soul stage man was nervously recounting the events of the ambush to Wei Ling.
"Where is that Fellow Daoist Wan? Where is he?" Wei Ling frowned and asked.
"He should have already fallen... I saw him suppressed by the Great Array, unable to move," the Nascent Soul stage man replied.
"You didn't see Fellow Daoist Wan fall with your own eyes?" Wei Ling pressed on.
"Mr. Wan was trapped by those four with a Forbidden. Fellow Daoist Chen tried to scare them away after that, but just after revealing our identity and uttering two sentences, he was seriously injured by a move from a man in black robes. We didn't dare to linger and fled, so we didn't see the end," the Nascent Soul cultivator replied with lingering fear.
"Alright, I understand. Go and rest to heal," Wei Ling said, his expression shifting unpredictably as he waved them off.
The three didn't say much more and went aside to rest.
The cultivators within Wei Ling's team were abuzz with discussion, speculating on the reason for Yuan Ming's ambush.
Wei Ling remained silent and contemplative, looking off into the distance.
At that moment, everyone suddenly looked up at the sky and immediately saw a figure flying toward them, silhouetted against the sun.
But when they recognized Yuan Ming's face, they were all shocked.
They couldn't believe that an early-stage Returning to Void cultivator could escape safely from a joint ambush by four Returning Void cultivators.
Wei Ling's face also showed surprise.
Yuan Ming seemed to sense something and looked over.
Wei Ling's heart tightened, but his face remained unchanged, as he quickly walked over: "Fellow Daoist Wan, I already know the situation there. Fortunately, you're alright."
"I was caught off guard and fell into a trap, but luckily I managed to escape," Yuan Ming took a deep breath and said.
After speaking, he couldn't help but cough softly, quickly covering his mouth.
But between his fingers, a hint of red seeped through.
"Are you injured?" Wei Ling asked concernedly.
"Just a minor injury, I'm fine," Yuan Ming wiped away the blood at the corner of his mouth with an expressionless face.
"That's good, I heard from the cultivators who returned that those four are likely the Black River Four Foes, the evil cultivators who have been active in the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range in recent years. They actually dared to attack a treasure-seeking team. Once we regroup with other teams, I will report this to my master to seek justice for you, Fellow Daoist Wan!" Wei Ling said indignantly.
"Then many thanks to Fellow Daoist Wei. However, given what happened, it's unwise to split up. Let's continue together," Yuan Ming coldly sneered in his heart, while keeping a neutral expression.
"Of course," Wei Ling immediately responded.
Yuan Ming thanked him and turned to fly forward.
Wei Ling watched Yuan Ming's back and called out to the others to follow him.
The rest of Yuan Ming's team returned one after another, and the two teams merged into one, smoothly advancing through the desert as they continued to search for traces of the Heavenly Fire.
Night quickly descended.
Everyone ceased traveling and gathered near a cluster of withered poplar trees to rest.
Yuan Ming leaned against a dried-up tree, slightly apart from the others, arms crossed, eyes gently closed as if in sleep.
In fact, beneath him, the roots of the Undying Tree had extended dozens of miles downward, deeply embedded in an underground Spirit Vein, absorbing its Spiritual Power for cultivation.
The climate in the Fire Rock Desert was arid, but Spiritual Energy was surprisingly abundant here, with intermittent Spirit Veins present underground.
Yuan Ming had discovered a substantial Spirit Vein underground, so he disregarded Wei Ling's request to continue exploring and decided to set up camp here for a temporary rest.
In other parts of the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range, he had to worry about depleting the Spirit Veins too much, affecting the environment. But in the barren land of the Fire Rock Desert, Yuan Ming had no such concerns.
The roots of the Undying Tree continuously extracted Spiritual Power from the underground Spirit Vein, merging it into the Mana Vortex within his Dantian.
The Fire Attribute Spiritual Power in this underground Spirit Vein was exceptionally abundant, and as Yuan Ming's Fire Attribute Spiritual Power advanced rapidly, a red orb gradually condensed on the Undying Tree.
"It seems that different Spirit Veins produce different Gathering Spirit Objects on the Undying Tree..." he thought to himself.
As Yuan Ming exerted efforts to draw out the Spiritual Power from the Spirit Vein, Wei Ling left the camp under the pretense of a night patrol.
Behind a distant sand dune, he set up several Forbiddens and then took out a round Array Plate, manipulating the seals on it to contact others.
Before long, a scroll of light projected from the Array Plate, revealing a figure — Elder Wang Fulong of the Sunset Sect.
"Master," Wei Ling bowed immediately upon seeing the figure appear.
"No need for formalities, how is the task proceeding?" Wang Fulong asked in a steady tone.
"The Black River Four Foes have failed. Either they've fled, or have been killed. But it's been several hours without contact, so the latter is more likely," Wei Ling urgently reported.
"What did you say? Although the Black River Four Foes individually aren't much stronger than ordinary early-stage Returning to Void cultivators, when they combine their efforts, they can even fight against mid-stage Returning Void cultivators, especially with the Four Mountains Linked Seal Magic Treasure that was lent to them to assist in the ambush. Even a late-stage Returning Void cultivator would find it difficult to survive. How could they have failed?" Wang Fulong exclaimed in surprise.
"I don't know the full details either. According to the cultivators who were with Wan Tianren, he didn't detect anything beforehand and was genuinely trapped within the Array. With the Four Mountains Linked Array's suppression, he was surely doomed... yet he managed to return alive," Wei Ling truthfully replied, avoiding speculation.
The figure in the Array Plate remained silent for a long time, lost in thought.

chapters.title: Chapter 932 - 900: Enemy Attack
chapters.content:
"This suggests that Wan Tianren has been hiding his true capabilities. Either he suppressed his realm in my presence, or he possesses some formidable life-saving Divine Artifact. Either way, it indicates that this person not only has deep thoughts but also a deeper foundation than we imagined," Wang Fulong sighed and said.
"Master, do you think he might already know that we arranged all of this? I always feel that the way he looks at me after returning is a bit odd. I'm afraid he might strike at me at any moment; my situation is probably very dangerous," Wei Ling said with some panic.
"Don't scare yourself. If he indeed had some solid evidence, he would have already acted against you while in the Fire Rock Desert, where there is no supervision. Why would he continue to carry out tasks with you?" Wang Fulong scolded slightly.
Thinking it over, Wei Ling found it reasonable and nodded quietly to himself.
"After he returned, did you notice any signs of injury?" Wang Fulong pondered for a moment and then asked.
Wei Ling hesitated, then recalled carefully and immediately said, "Yes, when he returned today, he coughed up blood. Although he tried to conceal it, I still saw it."
"It's normal to get injured, especially when dealing with the Black River Four Foes. If he could wipe them out unscathed, he wouldn't be a Returning to Void Stage Cultivator; he would probably be a Dharma manifestation Stage Cultivator," Wang Fulong said thoughtfully.
"So Wan Tianren might be a Dharma Phase Cultivator!" Wei Ling said, taken aback.
"Of course not. No matter how much a Dharma Phase Cultivator suppresses their aura, I would be able to see through it. Even if I couldn't, that esteemed individual wouldn't make such a mistake," Wang Fulong scoffed and shook his head.
Little did he know, Yuan Ming was not an ordinary Dharma Phase Cultivator; he was also a Body Cultivation cultivator with the Body of Wanxiang, and a Soul Cultivator in the Word Witch Realm.
With simultaneous suppression by Divine Soul Power and control by Qi Blood Power, combined with the concealment of the Undying Tree, even the Guardian Sima Changqin couldn't see through him.
"So, in his injured state, do you have the confidence to kill Wan Tianren?" Wang Fulong suddenly asked.
Hearing this, Wei Ling's heart tightened, and he quickly shook his head, replying, "Master, although he is injured, it definitely doesn't seem to have affected his core. I know very little about him; if I rashly make a move and succeed, that's fine. But if I fail, it would undoubtedly bring disaster upon our Sunset Sect. That is definitely not a wise move."
Although he said this, in his heart, he was truly thinking that he wouldn't risk his own life at any cost.
"What you say makes sense. Let's do this: continue to monitor him for a few days. Don't do anything out of the ordinary to disturb him. I will think of a way to solve him as soon as possible," Wang Fulong said without forcing him.
"As you command, Master," Wei Ling exhaled in relief, bowing deeply.
Upon returning to the camp, he saw Yuan Ming sleeping against the tree trunk. He initially thought to greet him and check his injuries up close, but recalling his Master's earlier words, he refrained from doing anything excessive.
Yuan Ming glanced in Wei Ling's direction and dispersed the Circular Light Technique from his hand.
His attention returned to the crimson orb on the Undying Tree, yet he wasn't in a rush to pick it. Instead, he continued to absorb the Spiritual Vein Power from the ground for cultivation.
Time flew by, and three days passed in a flash.
During this period, besides several attacks from fire beasts, Yuan Ming's group didn't encounter any particular dangers. They unconsciously quickened their pace in exploration.
Wei Ling behaved quite normally, even consulting Yuan Ming on some decisions to be made. Although his tone wasn't exceptionally polite, he mostly respected Yuan Ming's suggestions.
Yuan Ming mostly stayed at the back of the team, showing a relatively low profile, except when Wei Ling approached him voluntarily.
Another two days passed, and as all groups seeking the Heavenly Fire ventured deeper into the Fire Rock Desert, they became significantly dispersed.
Even though the exploration teams were numerous, scattered across the vast desert, they were like buckets of sand falling into an ocean, causing hardly any waves.
In the same way, as they delved deeper, various fire beasts encountered in the desert grew more numerous, some reaching levels three to four, causing casualties to many teams.
This led to a gradual slowdown in each exploration team's progress, merely covering a hundred miles daily, maintaining contact through Communication Talismans.
On the morning of the sixth day,
A group of people reached a circular dune area and stopped to rest.
As usual, Yuan Ming sat down, using the Undying Tree Root to absorb the underground Spirit Vein.
In the past few days, he tried to rest wherever there were Spirit Veins underground.
Over these days, his cultivation hadn't improved much, but the red orb on the Undying Tree had grown several times larger, with a faint sense of imminent breakthrough.
"It seems this red orb is about to transform; I wonder what it will become?" Yuan Ming thought with anticipation.
"Master, it's already the sixth day. Since it's confirmed that Wei Ling is an accomplice of the Black River Four Foes, why don't you take him down, yet continue following him around?" Lei Yu's voice rang in Yuan Ming's Sea of Consciousness.
"No rush, let's wait a bit longer," Yuan Ming replied via transmission.
"What are you waiting for?" Lei Yu asked, puzzled.
Yuan Ming chuckled silently. Wei Ling was of little concern; capturing him could be done anytime.
He kept this person around to observe Sima Changqin's subsequent actions.
Having advanced to the Dharma manifestation Stage, Yuan Ming was not the small figure who had previously been chased around. If Sima Changqin wanted to play, he was more than willing to join.
Moreover, if he captured Wei Ling and left now, he would be completely blind, needing to guard against both the treasure-hunting teams and the Ten Thousand Demon Country, which would be counterproductive.
"You do as you please, but Master, could you let me out to gather some intel? Staying in the Shura Palace all day is really boring," Lei Yu said.
"No, the people from the Ten Thousand Demon Country are in the Fire Rock Desert now. You would be treated as a demon from the Ten Thousand Demon Country, very dangerous," Yuan Ming firmly refused.
"Alright," Lei Yu answered grudgingly, knowing Yuan Ming's words were indeed true, and didn't insist further.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming closed his eyes, urging the Undying Tree Root to absorb the underground Spirit Vein.
At this moment, a Golden-eyed Spirit Falcon patrolling the high sky suddenly folded its wings and plummeted straight down.
Immediately, a Nascent Soul cultivator in the team shouted loudly:
"Enemy attack!"
This shout tore through the morning silence, instantly alerting everyone who had started to relax.
They had agreed beforehand that in case of a demon beast attack, they would generally shout 'demon beast', if the situation was unclear, they would shout 'situation', and only during an enemy attack would they shout 'enemy attack'.
Since entering the Fire Rock Desert, their only enemy naturally was the Demon Clan of the Ten Thousand Demon Country.
Yuan Ming had been distractedly investigating the underground Spirit Vein, trying to discover its distribution pattern, and had not paid much attention to the external situation.
When he turned his head towards the direction of the enemy, he saw only hundreds of long spears made of condensed yellow sand in the sky, like a rain of arrows, falling towards them.
"Arrange formation, meet the enemy." Wei Ling shouted aloud while his figure flicked and moved to the forefront of the team.
His sleeves shook, and with a "whoosh", two cyan whirlwinds twisted like Flood Dragons, rushed straight up into the sky, and swept into the rain of sand spears.
Amidst the explosions, the sand spears broke completely, turning into falling sand dust.
Hundreds of feet away behind the sand dust, over a hundred tall figures emerged, each covered in hard scale armor, with long tails trailing behind them, the Lizardmen.
Their heads were broad, necks thick, blending almost imperceptibly into their bodies. Each was bare-chested, with brown-black pants exposing their tails, standing on distant sand dunes, staring with round bulging eyes, pupils forming two slits, peering from afar.
"Are these the Demon Clan of the Ten Thousand Demon Country?" Yuan Ming moved beside Wei Ling and asked.
"Sand Lizard Clan, one of the thirty-six tribes of the Ten Thousand Demon Country, born Body Cultivators, favorites of the desert, natural assassins." Wei Ling glanced at him, frowning, and said.
"Assassins?" Yuan Ming asked in surprise.
During this period, he had been collecting intelligence on the thirty-six tribes of the Ten Thousand Demon Country. This Sand Lizard Clan was insignificant in the country, and he hadn't collected intelligence on it yet.
"These guys excel at concealment and ambush; in the desert, they can integrate with sand and soil, sometimes even Divine Sense investigation might not detect them." Wei Ling said, glancing around.
Yuan Ming's gaze suddenly shifted; he looked at a spot on the ground, jumped back, and warned, "Be careful!"
Wei Ling, startled like a bird, leapt high and retreated.
From where Yuan Ming had looked, the ground suddenly spun inward, a vortex of yellow light unexpectedly appeared, then expanded instantly.
In a flash, it was like countless blade lights spinning out, slashing in all directions.
Had Yuan Ming and Wei Ling not timely retreated, they would surely have been caught within it.
As Yuan Ming retreated, his sleeves fluttered, pushing the cultivators behind him backward. Although they staggered and fell backward in panic, they completely avoided the attack of the blade lights.
In mid-air, after releasing a breath, Wei Ling suddenly felt a strong wind behind his ears, shrank his neck, and fell downward.
A snow-bright blade light appeared from nowhere, grazing over his head, slashing his kerchief off, along with a few strands of hair, floating in the air.
As a Returning to Void cultivator, Wei Ling reacted swiftly, shaking his wrist while falling.
Three golden copper coins flew out, flashing golden light in mid-air, instantly dispersing into hundreds of afterimages, transforming into a rain of coins, chasing and enveloping the blade light.
The snow-bright blade light was originally about to disappear when enveloped by the rain of coins, it brightened again, resonating into numerous blade glows, dispersing the rain of coins.
At the same time, a figure appeared behind the blade glows, undoubtedly another Sand Lizard.
Only this one's figure was relatively smaller, scales shimmering blue-black, holding a snow-bright scimitar almost as large as himself, shaped like a crescent moon.
This demon's demon energy was powerful, had already reached Level 5.
By now, the ground's swirling blade lights gradually dissipated, revealing half a dark red Sand Lizard head in the sand pit, looking coldly towards Yuan Ming, also a Level 5 Demon Clan member.
Wei Ling's face was grim, raised his sleeves and retrieved the golden copper coins, intending to strike again.
"These Sand Lizard demons seem reluctant to start a fight; we'll see." Yuan Ming restrained Wei Ling.
Wei Ling paused upon hearing, halting his hand.
Indeed, the Sand Lizard Clan on the ground slowly retreated, leaving the area.
Just like Yuan Ming's team, they too were thrown into the Fire Rock Desert by the Ten Thousand Demon Country; this encounter was like two armies' scouts suddenly meeting, probing each other's depth without the necessity of a deathly battle.
Seeing their retreat, Wei Ling also breathed a sigh of relief.
"Fellow Daoist Wan, thanks earlier." He thanked Yuan Ming for the earlier warning.
"No problem." Yuan Ming waved his hand, unconcerned.
Wei Ling relaxed inwardly; apparently, Wan Tianren was still unaware of his relationship with the Black River Four Foes, which relieved him.
"Please help keep watch to prevent another sneak attack by the Demon Clan of the Ten Thousand Demon Country; I must quickly report this encounter to the higher-ups." Wei Ling said seriously, cupping his fists.
"Of course, Fellow Daoist Wei, feel free, I will keep an eye on things here." Yuan Ming nodded.
"Thank you." Wei Ling thanked swiftly and left.
In a secluded spot, he took out the Communication Array Plate to contact Wang Fulong.

chapters.title: Chapter 933 - 901: The News Arrives
chapters.content:
"Master, we have encountered the Sand Lizard Clan of the Ten Thousand Demon Country..." He quickly reported the recent battle to Wang Fulong.
"We have already penetrated deep into the Fire Rock Desert, and are bound to meet the Ten Thousand Demon Country soon. Don't worry, let me connect with the other teams first and make arrangements. In the meantime, stay vigilant for any sneak attacks from the Demon Clan." Wang Fulong advised after hearing the report.
"Disciple understands." Wei Ling replied.
"From your description just now... did Wan Tianren warn you of danger proactively?" Wang Fulong asked.
"Correct." Wei Ling nodded.
"It seems he doesn't yet know that the Black River Four Foes are backed by us. This is a good thing." Wang Fulong pondered aloud.
"Disciple thinks the same." Wei Ling concurred.
"Has he shown any strange behavior lately?" Wang Fulong asked.
"No, he just occasionally stops to rest, often meditating on the spot for about an hour." Wei Ling recalled briefly and then said.
"He should be healing, forget it, just keep watching." Wang Fulong instructed before cutting off the connection.
Over at the squad's side, Yuan Ming hovered in mid-air, looking at his palm.
In the center of his palm, a white light circle flickered, clearly revealing the conversation between Wei Ling and Wang Fulong.
Yuan Ming curled the corner of his mouth into a smile and dissipated the Circular Light Technique.
...
Meanwhile, somewhere high above the Fire Rock Desert.
A luxuriously styled three-layered large ship was suspended in the air, its hull painted entirely in red lacquer, adorned with many antique bronze metal decorations. At the bow stood a bronze dragon head statue, which from a distance, looked frighteningly like an evil dragon coiled around the tower ship, instilling sudden dread.
The tower ship appeared fearsome and intimidating from the outside, but its interior was lavishly decorated.
In every corridor on the ship, soft carpets made from demon beast skins were laid. On the walls, every few steps, a perpetual glazed lamp was hung, requiring a large number of Spirit Stones to maintain. The light emitted from them was carefully adjusted to be neither glaring nor dim.
The rooms on the ship were even more exquisitely decorated. Even the flower pots used for cultivating plants were made from special spiritual materials, crafted by renowned artisans, being rare magic artifacts. Their design was unique and they had the effect of regulating moisture and promoting the growth of spirit grass.
Such meticulous design was merely to ensure that the owner of the tower ship would not see withered plants, highlighting the extraordinary luxury within the ship, leaving people astonished.
At this moment, in a spacious room on the third floor of the tower ship, Sima Changqin stood in front of a massive sand table, seemingly depicting the Fire Rock Desert.
The sand table was divided into many sections of varying sizes, with each treasure-hunting team's location marked, appearing systematically organized.
Sima Changqin looked at the sand table, silently pondering.
Besides him, seven more cultivators quietly awaited.
Closest were Wu Li and the Black-armored Middle-aged Man, both members of the Black Demon, standing on Sima Changqin's left and right.
Across from the sand table stood four women, none of whom were members of the first team.
As the commander, Sima Changqin naturally needed to have an understanding of all teams' situations, so to facilitate relaying orders, each team sent a delegate to the tower ship to act as messengers.
Initially, Sima Changqin intended to randomly select a few to stay by his side, but the second team's Long Hou strongly insisted on sending his last female disciple, Long Yuhuan, to represent the second team and deliver messages, while taking care of Sima Changqin's daily needs.
Everyone knew Long Hou's true intention: to cling to Sima Changqin.
Sima Changqin showed no opposition, so no one dared to speak up.
Long Hou's actions served as a reminder to other commanding cultivators.
In terms of unparalleled female cultivators, they also had their share under their command. How could they let the Heavenly Dragon Hall seize this chance to climb high?
Therefore, the cultivators they sent as liaisons were all glamorous female cultivators, each varying in looks and personality, all outstanding.
The third team sent Gan Wenqing, the fourth team sent a woman in white, and the fifth team sent a charming maiden.
Gan Wenqing was elegant and introverted, petite and gentle.
The woman in white was named Shu Ling, a cultivator from White Emperor City, heroic and bold, full of vigor.
The charming maiden was named Qi Ya, a female cultivator from the Sunset Sect, graceful and alluring, with an amorous gaze.
The four women stood in the room, gracing it with their presence, like a hundred flowers contending in beauty, drawing attention.
Besides the four women, Xi Ying was also there, sitting leisurely in the corner, sipping tea.
As Long Yuhuan and the other three women glanced over Xi Ying, they carried an air of distance and vigilance.
Sima Changqin, handsome and elegant, with profound cultivation, was also a Guardian, destined to stand at the pinnacle of the Chuyun Realm in the future.
Though Long Yuhuan, Gan Wenqing, and the other women were prideful, they couldn't help but secretly admire Sima Changqin. Assigned here, they frequently showed favor, even treating Xi Ying as a rival, joining forces against her.
Xi Ying seemed oblivious to the four women's hostility, sitting quietly aside, always maintaining a considerable distance from Sima Changqin.
Just then, a white light flew in from outside.
Long Yuhuan, being the closest, was the first to reach out and catch it; it was a Communication Talisman.
"Lord Qinmo." Long Yuhuan held the talisman with both hands and presented it before Sima Changqin.
"Thank you for your hard work, Fellow Daoist Long." Sima Changqin nodded, taking the Communication Talisman.
Long Yuhuan's pretty face flushed slightly, and she retreated.

chapters.title: Chapter 934 - 901: The News Arrives (Part 2)
chapters.content:
Sima Changqin reviewed the contents of the Communication Talisman and adjusted the position of a squad on the sand table.
Information from various teams continuously converged, eventually all displayed on the sand table in front of Sima Changqin.
"Many teams have made contact with the Ten Thousand Demon Country, but no major battles have broken out. It seems the Demon Clan is quite restrained; it seems the Ten Thousand Demon Country also wants to gauge our strength first," Sima Changqin said.
"With Lord Qin Mo here, naturally the Demon Clan from the Ten Thousand Demon Country wouldn't dare to act rashly," Gan Wenqing complimented.
"Fellow Daoist Gan overpraises me. The Ten Thousand Demon Country has many sixth-level demons, and the Ten Thousand Demon Empress is even more mysterious; I dare not claim victory," Sima Changqin shook his head.
"What should we do next?" Shu Ling asked.
"Although we do not have a guarantee of victory, the current situation is like an arrow on a bow, leaving no room to retreat. Send out the order for all teams to continue advancing, and feel free to take the initiative. It would be best to capture one or two Great Demons and interrogate them for the current intelligence on the Ten Thousand Demon Country," Sima Changqin thought for a moment and resolutely gave the command.
"Yes!" Long Yuhuan and others responded in unison, then took their leave to prepare their methods of sending messages to their respective teams.
Sima Changqin waved his hand, and Wu Li and the Black-armored Middle-aged Man also withdrew.
The room was left with only Sima Changqin and Xi Ying.
"I shall also take my leave," Xi Ying stood up.
"Fairy Xi, what do you think of my response? Is there a better approach?" Sima Changqin looked toward Xi Ying.
"Lord Qin Mo's response is fair and unbiased, with no mistake. However, I feel that with such large-scale actions, we are always exposed, being closely watched by the Ten Thousand Demon Country on all sides. It might be difficult to locate the Heavenly Fire," Xi Ying said.
"Indeed, Fairy Xi is truly wise and perceptive. The enemy is hidden while we are exposed. No matter how we respond, we are always one step behind. If Fairy Xi were to lead the treasure hunting team, how would you break the stalemate?" A trace of admiration flashed in Sima Changqin's eyes as he asked.
"I am not worthy to claim leadership of the treasure hunting team," Xi Ying shook her head.
"Fairy Xi is intelligent and insightful, as I have witnessed firsthand. With only the two of us here, feel free to speak your mind," Sima Changqin looked at Xi Ying, his gaze gentle.
"If it were me, I would organize a special group, using the main force as cover, to search for the whereabouts of the Heavenly Fire," Xi Ying seemed not to notice Sima Changqin's gaze, thought for a moment, and replied.
Sima Changqin nodded and did not speak.
At that moment, the space in the room fluctuated, and a silver light appeared out of nowhere; it was another Communication Talisman.
Sima Changqin took the talisman, his Divine Sense penetrated it, and a look of joy quickly appeared on his face.
"Speaking of which, since entering the Fire Rock Desert, aside from Wu Li and Tie Xuan, the other Black Demons of Lord Qin Mo have remained out of sight. Could it be that they were sent out secretly to search for the Heavenly Fire's trail?" Xi Ying, seeing Sima Changqin's expression, had a thought and spoke.
"Indeed, I couldn't hide it from Fairy Xi. I had indeed sent them out long ago, secretly searching for the Heavenly Fire's whereabouts, and they've already found a clue," Sima Changqin laughed.
"Oh, where might the Heavenly Fire be?" Xi Ying couldn't help but ask.
"It's not yet certain, but according to intelligence, more than half of the sixth-level demons from the Ten Thousand Demon Country have gone to Fire Peak Mountain. The Black Demons have checked it out; the temperature at Fire Peak Mountain is significantly higher than usual, so there is more than an eighty percent chance the Heavenly Fire is there," Sima Changqin said.
In the Fire Rock Desert, there are several volcanic regions, and Fire Peak Mountain is one of them. Lava eruptions occur there year-round, with raging fires spreading across the area almost daily, making it far more dangerous than other places.
"It seems that the Heavenly Fire is already in Lord Qin Mo's grasp. However, since you already have everything planned, why ask for Xi Ying's opinion? Did my presumption mislead you?" Xi Ying furrowed her brows.
"I just wanted to see if your thoughts aligned with mine. Fairy Xi, please don't overthink it; I meant no offense," Sima Changqin immediately explained.
"Just kidding, Lord Qin Mo need not take it seriously. If there is nothing else, I would like to rest for a while; please grant me permission," Xi Ying shook her head, as if she believed Sima Changqin's explanation.
"Now we only wait for more messages. Fairy Xi, feel free to do as you please. If something arises, I'll send someone to invite you," Sima Changqin said.
Xi Ying didn't engage in further pleasantries and turned to leave upon hearing this.
"Fairy Xi, please wait... calling me 'Lord' feels distant. How about addressing me as Chang Qin next time?" Sima Changqin suddenly called out.
Xi Ying paused but did not answer, and she walked directly out of the room.
She returned to her assigned quarters on the ship, setting up several layers of Forbidden, sealing the room tightly.
"Yinkong," she spoke again.
A silver light shot from the Spiritual Beast Bag at Xi Ying's waist, transforming into the Silver Void Tree Demon, its power surprisingly at the Upper Fifth Level.
The mouth of the Silver Void Tree Demon opened wide, and its body rapidly expanded, transforming into a presence resembling a white palace within a few breaths, with its mouth as the entrance.
Xi Ying walked inside, finding many things stored within the white palace. At the farthest point was a communication array known as the Void Communication Array.
Xi Ying formed a seal with her hands to activate it. Soon, Yuan Ming's face appeared within the Blood Flames in the array.
"What news have you gathered over there?" Yuan Ming asked.
Before entering the Fire Rock Desert, the two had decided to keep each other informed, working together to overcome difficulties. This is also why Xi Ying stayed with Sima Changqin instead of following Yuan Ming.
"Indeed, I have some news to tell you." Xi Ying quickly recounted the conversation she had just had with Sima Changqin.
"Finally, we've been waiting for this! Fire Peak Mountain, I understand. I'll find a way to leave and have a look," Yuan Ming's face showed joy, and he turned to leave.
"Wait, before you go, make sure to find a way to spread this news," Xi Ying's eyes flickered, suddenly calling Yuan Ming back.
"I can do that, but in doing so, won't other team members also head to Fire Peak Mountain? And if Sima Changqin finds out, wouldn't he easily suspect it was you who leaked it?" Yuan Ming asked, puzzled.
"Don't worry about that; I have my reasons," Xi Ying shook her head, replying.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming didn't say more.
Since Xi Ying said this, he wouldn't ask further.
"Heading to Fire Peak Mountain may not go smoothly, with the Black Demons and people from the Ten Thousand Demon Country all there, be cautious," Xi Ying cautioned.
"Don't worry, Sima Changqin doesn't know my true strength, so even if there's a hidden plot against me, I should be able to handle it," Yuan Ming replied with confidence.
The two discussed other matters before ending the communication.
...
In a certain part of the Fire Rock Desert, Yuan Ming's squad once again set up camp to rest.
Yuan Ming came to the edge of the camp, looked at the night sky, and remained silent.
After a moment, he took out two pieces of the Void Communication Talisman and contacted Wulu and Nan Shangfeng, telling them the whole situation and asking them to find a way to spread the message.
Upon hearing such significant news, Wulu and Nan Shangfeng were shocked, yet they both agreed to do it.
Afterward, Yuan Ming sat in place, seemingly deep in thought, lowering his head without further action.
At the other end of the camp, where Wei Ling was staying.
At that moment, he was sitting cross-legged, forming a seal with his hands, manipulating a Magic Treasure, a copper basin, in front of him.
The copper basin was filled with an unknown light blue liquid, which, under Wei Ling's spellcasting, seemed to come alive, leaping up and forming a palm-sized human silhouette in the basin—exactly Yuan Ming, muttering as if speaking.
"It seems two Communication Talismans just flew out; is Wan Tianren plotting something?" Wei Ling, seeing the mirrored image in the copper basin, felt deeply puzzled.

chapters.title: Chapter 935 - 902: Demon King’s Traces
chapters.content:
Wei Ling's magic treasure can only be used for reconnaissance, allowing him to see distant events unnoticed, similar to Chu Zhixian's Da Ji Ancient Mirror.
Unfortunately, this treasure doesn't transmit sound, so he can only guess at Yuan Ming's discussions with others based on the expressions of the tiny figures formed by the liquid.
"Just this information isn't enough to report," Wei Ling muttered hesitantly.
As he debated whether to inform Wang Fulong, he saw the liquid figure representing Yuan Ming suddenly look up, giving him a knowing smile, as if meeting his gaze.
Wei Ling was stunned, his heart racing, and just as he wanted to act, a thick azure-gray root burst from the ground and pierced his body.
Wei Ling was terrified, ready to leap into action.
At that moment, Yuan Ming's icy voice echoed in his ear.
"Do not move!"
Accompanied by Yuan Ming's voice, a mysterious power enveloped Wei Ling, silencing all sounds around him, leaving only a profound silence.
Wei Ling's face was etched with the word 'pain', and at the brink of life and death, he unleashed unprecedented strength. Even as his body was penetrated, his fingers struggled to form a spell to attempt self-saving magic.
But in the next instant, another root emerged, binding his body tightly.
At the same time, Yuan Ming's figure appeared before him, raising a finger.
Wei Ling's body went limp on the ground, unable to move an inch.
The other people in the camp were busy with their own tasks, noticing nothing.
Despair filled Wei Ling's eyes as he watched the scene.
Yuan Ming concealed his actions with an illusion technique, unafraid of being noticed by others, and performed Soul Searching Divine Ability.
Wei Ling didn't know much, merely following orders to report Yuan Ming's movements to Wang Fulong, ignorant of the reasons.
Yuan Ming anticipated this, without any disappointment.
"Fellow Daoist Wan, I failed to recognize greatness, please spare my life..." Yuan Ming ceased the soul search, and Wei Ling regained consciousness, pleading for mercy.
"Rest assured, I won't kill you," Yuan Ming replied with a faint smile.
Wei Ling was overjoyed by these words.
But at that moment, several undying tree roots pierced deep into his body, freezing Wei Ling's expression and rendering his gaze wooden, transforming him into an Undead Tree Puppet.
He was directly linked to Wang Fulong, and a sudden disappearance might alert him. Yuan Ming had previously refrained from acting because of this, but now, with his upcoming journey to Fire Peak Mountain, leaving Wei Ling unchecked was unwise.
Of course, merely controlling Wei Ling wouldn't suffice. If a demon attack occurred again and he didn't appear, it would leave a flaw.
Fortunately, Yuan Ming had another plan.
He first ordered Wei Ling to continue reporting to Wang Fulong as per usual, then returned to his place and took out a small yellow spirit bean, the size of a pinky.
Next, he cast a spell and tossed the spirit bean forward. The Dao Seal of Planting Beans into Soldiers in his Nascent Soul instantly lit up, emitting flowing spirit light that infused the bean.
In a matter of moments, a clone identical to Yuan Ming's current appearance fell to the ground.
Yuan Ming examined the clone, finding no flaw in its appearance or aura except that the clone only possessed thirty percent of his original strength.
But this was an unavoidable situation. Although he had refined the Planting Beans into Soldiers technique to perfection, even condensing a Dao Seal, the magic required external assistance, and he had yet to find suitable spiritual materials to create a spirit bean capable of holding sixty percent of his power. For now, he had to settle for a clone with thirty percent strength to hold up appearances.
Still, at his current strength, thirty percent was sufficient to handle most cultivators below the Dharma manifestation stage.
Yuan Ming did not dwell on the matter, quickly organizing everything and quietly departing.
After leaving the camp, he summoned Lei Yu.
Lei Yu, having been cooped up in the Shura Palace for a long time, emitted a sharp cry and transformed into a bolt of thunder, shooting toward Fire Peak Mountain.
...
The day after Yuan Ming's departure, rumors quickly spread that Heavenly Fire had appeared at Fire Peak Mountain, circulating rapidly among the teams.
For a time, hearts wavered, with many cultivators neglecting their orders, just wanting to know whether the news was true.
As the rumors spread wider, some teams, unable to resist temptation, left their assigned search areas without permission and headed toward Fire Peak Mountain.
Once such a trend appeared, other cultivator teams began to follow suit, covertly and overtly converging towards Fire Peak Mountain.
These developments quickly reached the Dharma Phase cultivators, who, puzzled by the rumor's origin, also headed to Fire Peak Mountain.
Aboard the Flying Boat, Sima Changqin was in the same room with Wu Li and Tie Xuan when he received the news.
"Lord Qin Mo, this news must have been spread by Xi Ying. I will go capture her immediately for daring to disrupt your plan," Wu Li said sternly.
Sima Changqin frowned, his gaze icy cold, clenching and unclenching his fists.
"Unlikely. Xi Ying has been on the Red Phoenix Boat these past few days, and the entire vessel is shrouded by a forbidden seal. Aside from a few individuals, no one else can contact the outside world. The news might not have leaked from her," Tie Xuan said, lightly coughing upon seeing Sima Changqin's expression.

chapters.title: Chapter 936 - 902: Demon King Traces (Part 2)
chapters.content:
"Besides Lord Qin Mo and our few Black Demons, only Xi Ying knows this secret. Who else could it be?" Wu Li argued.
"Now that things have come to this, it's pointless to argue about who leaked the information, let's think about our countermeasures." Tie Xuan said solemnly.
Upon hearing this, Wu Li finally fell silent and looked at Sima Changqin.
"Originally, I wanted to use others to draw the attention of the Ten Thousand Demon Country, while we take the opportunity to seize the Heavenly Fire. Now the plan is exposed, so we will go to Fire Peak Mountain as well." Sima Changqin's expression returned to calm, casually playing with the chess pieces on the sand table with two fingers, and said lightly.
"Understood." Tie Xuan nodded in agreement.
"What should be done with Xi Ying?" Wu Li pressed on.
Sima Changqin didn't speak, continuing to gaze at the sand table.
Tie Xuan gave Wu Li a look and pulled him out of the room.
Sima Changqin stood in front of the sand table and silently watched the large and small chess pieces on it.
Suddenly, he closed his eyes, his face turning alternately blue and white, his clothes fluttering without wind, and the entire hall shook continuously.
Moments later, he suddenly opened his eyes, two lightning-like beams shot out, hitting the void with a muffled sound.
Sima Changqin staggered back a few steps before stabilizing, sweat barely visible on his forehead.
"The power of the Heart Demon is indeed frightening, it actually made me lose my composure." He gasped lowly, murmuring to himself.
Sima Changqin raised his hand to wipe away the sweat, his face already back to normal, and raised his hand to draw an inconspicuous small chess piece, "Snap," placing it on the location of Fire Peak Mountain.
Outside in the corridor, Wu Li and Tie Xuan walked side by side.
"Tie Xuan, why didn't you let me ask clearly? Leaving Xi Ying by Lord Qin Mo's side will only be a disaster." Wu Li said in a deep voice.
"You've been with the Black Demons for quite some time, yet you still act so recklessly. How to deal with Xi Ying, Lord Qin Mo knows well, it doesn't require your doubt or mine." Tie Xuan sighed helplessly, speaking in a tone of hating iron for not becoming steel.
"I just feel Lord Qin Mo seems to have lost his composure this time; why would he tell Xi Ying about the Heavenly Fire? Though there are Forbidden techniques on the Red Phoenix Boat, giving such vital information to outsiders will only increase risks, the old Lord Qin Mo would never make such a mistake." Wu Li said, puzzled.
"That's not for us to speculate, just focus on your own tasks." Tie Xuan shook his head.
Wu Li seemed somewhat unwilling but didn't say more.
"By the way, how's the matter I asked you to investigate?" He remembered something and asked.
"Are you talking about Nan Shangfeng? His cultivation is still at the late stage of Returning Void, not much progress compared to back then. You were really ruthless back then." Tie Xuan chuckled.
"That kid dared to offend Lord Qin Mo, if not for the face of Master Tantai, I would have taken his life long ago, how could I let him live till now." Wu Li said coldly.
"You already took away nearly half of his Spirit Root back then, what do you intend to do now?" Tie Xuan asked with a frown.
"Naturally, to take away the other half, it's just a curse he had to appear in front of me again!" Wu Li's eyes showed a vicious glint.
Tie Xuan looked at Wu Li's expression, shaking his head with a sigh.
...
Three days later, Yuan Ming finally arrived at the Fire Peak Mountain Range.
The thick black smoke spewing from the volcanic crater covered the sky, with no sunlight piercing through, yet the flowing lava between scorched black stones illuminated the series of volcanoes brightly.
At the edge of the Fire Peak Mountain Range, Yuan Ming steered Lei Yu to a halt in midair, looking distantly at the Fire Peak Mountain Range in front, feeling the high temperatures emanating from within, he was slightly astonished.
The entire Fire Peak Mountain Range's temperature had reached levels far beyond the norm, the scattered flames heating the air to the point of peeling skin and flesh, and the pervasive Fire Poison ignited the organs, wishing to burn people to ash from the inside out.
According to his understanding, the previous Fire Peak Mountain was dangerous, but it hadn't reached this level.
The current change, perhaps, is indeed due to the emergence of the Heavenly Fire.
"You've worked hard, take a rest first." Yuan Ming thought for a moment, leapt off Lei Yu's back, and simultaneously waved his sleeve, returning it to Shura Palace.
Relying on Lei Yu's speed, he reached here in just three days; other Dharma Phase cultivators, even if they received the news in time, could not arrive in a short period.
Therefore, the time left for Yuan Ming to investigate is relatively sufficient.
According to Xi Ying, more than half of the sixth-level Great Demons from the Ten Thousand Demon Country have come here. Yuan Ming used the Void Transformation Technique, turning his body transparent, and then, with a push of his mana, he flew into the Fire Peak Mountain Range on a tunneling light.
A scorching heat swept over him, but fortunately, Yuan Ming's cultivation was deep, and he could resist it by applying a mana shield around himself.
While flying forward, he released his Divine Sense, staying vigilant around him, searching for any possible traces.
Time flowed quickly, and soon a whole day had passed.
Yuan Ming stood on a crimson peak, frowning as he looked ahead.
He had penetrated deep into the Fire Peak Mountain Range, yet there were no traces left by the sixth-level Great Demons.
"Could it be that the information Xi Ying revealed through Sima Changqin is false?" Yuan Ming wondered privately.
Due to resisting the high temperature for a long time, his mana had also been consumed significantly, so he did not continue searching. Instead, he found a relatively concealed place halfway up the crimson peak to rest and contemplate his next move.
Meanwhile, he again released the Undying Tree Roots, extracting the underground Spirit Vein in a needle-threading manner.
Upon entering the Fire Peak Mountain Range, he discovered the abundant Fire Spirit land beneath the mountain.
The Undying Tree Roots quickly delved into the earth, touching the underground Spirit Vein.
Yuan Ming showed a look of surprise, the spiritual power of the Spirit Vein beneath the Fire Peak Mountains was astonishingly concentrated.
If an ordinary Spirit Vein were likened to a babbling brook, then the spiritual power contained within this vein would be like a great river flowing eastward, merely extracting a wisp or a strand even if hundreds or thousands of Returning to Void cultivators absorbed it simultaneously.
Such a vast Spirit Vein could not possibly be naturally formed. In truth, only by gathering the Spirit Veins of the entire Fire Rock Desert here could such a scale be achieved.
Yuan Ming's eyes flickered; there must have been a major upheaval here, and there's a high likelihood that the Heavenly Fire is located here.
Yet, if that's the case, where have those sixth-level Great Demons of the Ten Thousand Demon Country gone?
As Yuan Ming pondered, he suddenly sensed a change, noticing that the red orb he had condensed earlier had swelled several times over, with fissures faintly appearing on its surface.
Thrilled, Yuan Ming immediately extended more roots to fully absorb the power of the Fire Spirit Vein underground.
With Yuan Ming's unreserved supply, only half an incense stick later, the red orb seemed to be filled with the Fire Spirit Vein's power, expanding to its limit.
Suddenly, with a crisp "pop" sound, the orb cracked open from its base, out of which many tree roots emerged, and the orb further disintegrated, soon completely transforming into a fiery red tree exuding intense heat.
Although its appearance differed somewhat, Yuan Ming quickly recognized that it was also a Gathering Spirit Tree.
However, unlike a standard Gathering Spirit Tree, this tree seemed capable of channeling only fire attribute spiritual power and even repelled the approach of other attributes.
For those cultivating fire attribute techniques, this tree was naturally a treasure, but for other cultivators, it seemed somewhat lacking in utility.
Yuan Ming did not mind, and with slight contemplation, he used his mana to send this tree into the Shura Palace, placing it within the Extreme Fire Realm to enhance the fire attribute spiritual power there.
The transplantation process was very simple, and Yuan Ming did not expend much effort before returning to the Fire Peak Mountain Range, preparing to continue using the Undying Tree to extract the power of the Fire Spirit Vein.
However, shortly after extending the roots, a look of surprise emerged in his eyes as the Undying Tree Roots detected an unusual fluctuation of breath deep within the earth.
He performed a spell with a flick of his fingers, casting the Circular Light Technique.
The Circular Light Technique soon revealed the situation underground.
In the Fire Spirit Vein, a large bald man, naked from the waist up, was searching around for something. His face had three ferocious scars, as if they had been torn by claws, and his neck bore a ring of fiery red fur that resembled a protective collar, swaying slightly with his movements.
"It's him!" Yuan Ming's pupils contracted.
The intelligence he had collected about the Ten Thousand Demon Country was sparse, but he couldn't possibly mistake the strange features of this man—for he was undoubtedly the Flame Wolf King, one of the Five Great Demon Kings.

chapters.title: Chapter 937 - 903: Five-Element Gui Zang Pill
chapters.content:
At this moment, the Flame Wolf King had not noticed anyone was spying on him, as he meticulously searched the surroundings, but soon, his expression became puzzled.
"Hmm, this is really strange. That fellow clearly said there was an abnormal fluctuation in the spirit vein. Could he have made another mistake?" Flame Wolf King muttered, as if giving up, he turned away and soon disappeared from sight.
However, moments later, red light flickered within the spirit vein, and the Flame Wolf King's figure instantly appeared, sweeping his powerful divine sense around, playing a clever empty city strategy, pretending to flee far but silently returning using an escape technique.
Yet, there was still no abnormality nearby, and the Flame Wolf King displayed genuine disappointment on his face.
After a moment of silence, he shook his head, turned around again, and continued walking along the spirit vein.
Yuan Ming secretly breathed a sigh of relief, fortunately, his Circular Light Technique had reached Great Perfection, condensing the Dao Seal, otherwise he might have been detected by the Flame Wolf King.
He continued to use the Circular Light Technique to track, and soon the Flame Wolf King arrived at an underground area filled with lava, then suddenly vanished without leaving any trace.
Yuan Ming witnessed all of this through the Circular Light Technique, feeling immensely astonished.
He had certainly not relaxed just now, so how did the Flame Wolf King suddenly disappear?
He continued to employ the Circular Light Technique to probe, yet could not discover anything peculiar in that area.
Yuan Ming pondered for a moment, then once again activated the Undying Tree Root to delve deeper into the region's situation.
He discovered that the distribution of spiritual power in that area was normal, but the space power was much denser than in other places, causing the penetrating void property of the Undying Tree Root to become difficult.
"No need to try, that area resulted from the integration of a space spiritual treasure and space, similar to what Nan Shangfeng's Void Palace did before. Only Nan Shangfeng's cultivation was too low, so the degree of integration between the Void Palace and the void is far less than the one in front of us." At this moment, Kong's voice suddenly sounded, carrying a hint of fatigue.
Yuan Ming was enlightened, no wonder he felt a sense of familiarity from that void.
"Senior Kong, why did you suddenly appear?" he asked immediately.
"Naturally, I have something to tell you, concerning the Abyss Nether Stone I promised earlier." Kong's tone was flat.
"Abyss Nether Stone! Senior Kong, do you mean that the Abyss Nether Stone is inside?" Yuan Ming realized something.
"Yes, you guessed right, there is a piece of Abyss Nether Stone within that space spiritual treasure." Kong straightforwardly pointed out the reason for the reminder.
"I see, thanks for the reminder, Senior Kong." Yuan Ming looked at that void through the Circular Light Technique, his gaze gradually firm.
"There is no danger in that area. As long as you reach there, you can enter that spiritual treasure, but with your current abilities, you can't enter silently and will surely be discovered by those inside. However, perilous mountains have paths, and deep seas have ships; you must weigh everything yourself," Kong continued, then his voice fell silent again, no matter how Yuan Ming called, there was no response.
Kong spoke very bluntly, but Yuan Ming had to carefully deliberate.
The Flame Wolf King had just entered that area, meaning other Level 6 demon beasts of the Ten Thousand Demon Country might also hide within that space spiritual treasure, and if one imagines boldly, the Ten Thousand Demon Empress might also be inside.
If Yuan Ming rushed in without care, it would be tantamount to suicide.
He pondered, only then realizing.
Xi Ying had previously instructed him to spread the news of Heavenly Fire on Fire Peak Mountain, presumably predicting the current situation, aiming to draw everyone in, to avoid facing the Ten Thousand Demon Country alone.
Thinking of this, Yuan Ming took out a Communication Talisman and contacted Wulu and Nan Shangfeng again, telling them everything about the space spiritual treasure.
"Try to spread this news as well, as for the source, say it came from intelligence leaked by Sima Changqin." Yuan Ming quickly said, unceremoniously shifting the blame to Sima Changqin.
Wulu and Nan Shangfeng agreed immediately and began their respective actions.
Yuan Ming delved underground, approaching the space spiritual treasure nearby.
He took out a Transformation Stone Talisman, transformed himself into a piece of red ore, mixed with the lava, quietly waiting for others to arrive.
Half a day later.
The second team of cultivators led by Long Hou first arrived at Fire Peak Mountain.
Before approaching the foot of the mountain, the steaming heat waves made many Core Formation Stage cultivators feel their throats burning, struggling to breathe.
Even the Nascent Soul cultivators felt as if they were inside a furnace, unbearably scorching.
"The temperature here is so scorching, it seems the news is correct. The Great Sun Glaze Flame is within this Fire Peak Mountain," Long Hou's eyes narrowed, showing a hint of excitement.
"Master, what should we do? Shall we enter the mountain immediately or wait for others?" said a young man with bronzed skin.
This person had a tall figure, with large gold earrings on each ear, looking quite imposing.
His name was Long Yinkong, also Long Hou's disciple, and Long Yuhuan's junior.
The Heavenly Dragon Hall is not a cultivation family that bears the surname Long; this sect has a rule that every Hall Master and Direct Disciple must change to the surname Long.
Long Hou frowned slightly, considering carefully before deciding to proceed first.
Just before he could speak, a magnificent treasure ship flew swiftly from afar and descended here, it was Sima Changqin's ship.
The first team of cultivators were all on the ship, standing at the front of the deck were Sima Changqin, Wu Li, Tie Xuan, and others.
Xi Ying was also there, glancing unobtrusively into Firetip Mountain, seemingly searching for something.
Long Hou regretted it, thinking he shouldn't have hesitated earlier but should have entered the mountain straight away.
He brought his people to Firetip Mountain for an unauthorized mission, unexpectedly caught by Sima Changqin before even entering the mountain range.
However, at this point he could only accept his bad luck, his throat moved, but he remained silent and led his team over to meet them.
When the treasure ship smoothly landed, people began to disembark one by one.
"Greetings, Lord Qin Mo." Long Hou stepped forward and saluted, and the members of the second team followed suit.
"Only you have arrived?" Sima Changqin swept his gaze over Long Hou and the others, but surprisingly did not admonish them.
"Well… we just arrived, but whether anyone else got here before us, I dare not say," Long Hou replied honestly, astonished.
Sima Changqin looked ahead, his face showing no sign of urgency.
Just as Long Hou wanted to say something, there was some movement in the distance, which seemed like other teams arriving.
Long Hou saw this and glanced at Sima Changqin, noting his expression still calm and indifferent; he swallowed back the words he was going to say and decided to accompany him in waiting quietly.
At this moment, several lines of tunneling lights appeared in the distant sky, led by Jin Chen's fourth team.
Seeing Sima Changqin's ship, Jin Chen's expression changed slightly, and the tunneling lights stopped.
"Fellow Daoist Jin Chen, come over." Sima Changqin's voice called out.
Jin Chen showed an expression similar to Long Hou's earlier, and finally led his team over obediently.
Within less than half a day's time, the third team led by Master Tantai and the fifth team led by Wang Fulong had all gathered outside Firetip Mountain.
Yuan Ming's clone, along with Wei Ling as the Undying Tree Puppet, naturally returned to Wang Fulong's team at this time.
Wulu and Nan Shangfeng were also present, though the two deliberately distanced themselves from Yuan Ming, standing elsewhere.
"Fellow Daoist Tantai, did you also come to Firetip Mountain because of that rumor?" Long Hou communicated with Master Tantai.
Long Hou was quite apprehensive when caught by Sima Changqin, but now that everyone had gathered, he felt reassured.
"Indeed, Fellow Daoist Long, are you as well?" replied Master Tantai.
"Hmm, Fellow Daoist Tantai, where do you think that rumor comes from? Judging from its content, it seems Lord Qin Mo spread it, but if he wanted to inform us, he could have just ordered us directly, why resort to this mysterious approach?" continued Long Hou.
"Are you suggesting someone else leaked this information?" Master Tantai communicated.
"Highly likely, this person probably learned about it from Lord Qin Mo and deliberately spread it around." Long Hou speculated.
"What's their purpose then?" Master Tantai asked.
Long Hou did not answer, looking towards the five teams.
Close to ten thousand cultivators stood ambiguously in the void, extending far into the distance.
With so many cultivators, it was impossible to discern them all; among them, who knows how many harbored ill intentions.
Long Hou's eye twitched a few times, suddenly feeling some regret about coming to Fire Rock Desert.
"Everyone is gathered here at Firetip Mountain because you heard that rumor, aren't you?" Sima Changqin spoke up.
"Correct, Lord Qin Mo. Is the heavenly fire truly in Firetip Mountain?" Master Tantai asked, eyes flickering, with a clasped fist gesture.
He actually wanted to ask if the rumor came from Sima Changqin, but altered his words slightly.
"Indeed." Sima Changqin nodded.
Master Tantai and the others felt a surge of joy upon hearing this.
"You've all come to Fire Rock Desert for the heavenly fire too, I don't intend to have you follow my lead, but the upcoming situation differs from before; we will face Ten Thousand Demon Country's main force. If we fight separately, the heavenly fire will certainly fall into their hands." Sima Changqin continued.
"Joining forces against Ten Thousand Demon Country is fine, but there's only one heavenly fire and several of us. If we do obtain it, how will it be divided?" At this point, Master Tantai bluntly spoke up.
The words were rather direct, causing Wu Li's face to darken, about to reprimand.
"I don't want the heavenly fire for myself, but Ancestor Bing Lan commanded me to obtain it. If you are willing to assist, I can request the Ancestor to grant each of you a Five Elements Returning Storage Pill as compensation afterward, how about it?" Sima Changqin raised his hand to stop Wu Li and communicated with the four.
"Five Elements Returning Storage Pill!"
Master Tantai and Long Hou both showed excited expressions.
Five Elements Returning Storage Pill is a sixth-level elixir, capable of regulating lifebound essence qi and aiding mid-stage Dharma manifestation cultivators in breaking through to the later stage.
Of course, taking this pill when breaking through from early-stage to mid-stage also works, but the pill's potency is fiercely strong and early-stage cultivators might not handle it.

chapters.title: Chapter 938 - 904: Ambush
chapters.content:
Master Tantai and Long Hou have been stuck at the peak of the mid-stage Dharma manifestation for years. If they can obtain this pill, advancing to the late stage would be almost certain.
As for Jin Chen and Wang Fulong, their cultivation is still at the early-stage Dharma manifestation. However, they also greatly desire the Five Elements Returning Storage Pill.
"We are willing to follow Lord Qinmo's command!" the four of them said in unison.
"That's good. Thank you all. As long as we work together, that Heavenly Fire will be ours," Sima Changqin said with a joyful expression.
The group then discussed the matter of entering Fire Peak Mountain.
Among the fifth team, Yuan Ming's clone curiously observed Fire Peak Mountain ahead and secretly transmitted a message to Nan Shangfeng and Wulu: "Have you finished what I asked you to do earlier?"
"Rest assured, Brother Wan. I recorded that information on several Communication Talismans and spread it out. It should have already been disseminated by now," Nan Shangfeng replied.
Wulu also transmitted that it was done. His method was to use the Heavenly Escape Stone Talisman to hide and then spread the rumors.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming's clone nodded secretly.
Wulu and Nan Shangfeng were both very capable and extremely cautious. Even if Sima Changqin sent someone to investigate, it would be difficult to trace back to them.
With so many experts around, Wulu and Nan Shangfeng dared not say much. After replying to Yuan Ming, they closed their mouths, lowered their brows, and looked extremely obedient.
Yuan Ming's clone, however, paid them no mind, turning instead to look at Xi Ying, seemingly evaluating something.
However, his vision suddenly blurred, and he found himself in a golden, misty space.
"An illusion?" Yuan Ming's clone raised an eyebrow.
"It's me," Xi Ying's figure also appeared in the golden space.
"Your illusion skills have greatly improved. Have you perhaps also condensed the Dao Seal? I didn't notice it at all," Yuan Ming's clone said with a smile, looking around.
"Pulling one of your clones into an illusion, if noticed, would mean my years of soul cultivation would have been in vain," Xi Ying said with a light snort.
"Just a joke. Naturally, this clone of mine couldn't detect it, but with so many experts around, if they noticed, it might cause you some trouble," Yuan Ming's clone said, his expression becoming serious.
"They can't detect it. Don't worry," Xi Ying confidently replied.
This time, Yuan Ming's clone was truly surprised and scrutinized Xi Ying closely.
Without offering an explanation, Xi Ying asked about the whereabouts of the Heavenly Fire.
Yuan Ming didn't hide anything and revealed everything he knew.
Xi Ying pondered silently, unclear on his thoughts.
"How have you been these past few days? Has Sima Changqin troubled you?" Yuan Ming's clone asked after studying Xi Ying for a moment.
"Don't worry. I have a way to deal with him," Xi Ying replied.
"I know you have many tricks, but your cultivation hasn't reached the Dharma manifestation stage yet, far from being a match for Sima Changqin. Staying there is quite dangerous, so return to my side after this," Yuan Ming's clone suggested.
He had previously disagreed with Xi Ying staying undercover with Sima Changqin, but Xi Ying insisted. Now that the whereabouts of the Heavenly Fire had been found, there was little reason for Xi Ying to remain there.
"I have it under control," Xi Ying said calmly, dispelling the illusion with a wave of his hand.
Yuan Ming's clone's vision returned, and he instinctively looked at Xi Ying.
Xi Ying stared into the distance, clearly not intending to pay him any further attention.
Yuan Ming's clone sighed and closed his eyes.
Meanwhile, Sima Changqin and the others finished their discussion and prepared to enter Fire Peak Mountain.
"Distribute the Fire Avoidance Pills to cultivators below the Nascent Soul stage. The high temperatures in Fire Peak Mountain may be bearable, but the fire poison lingering in the air is not something one can simply endure," Sima Changqin instructed, looking at the assembly of cultivators.
Long Hou, Master Tantai, Jin Chen, and others quickly acted, distributing a thumb-sized red elixir.
"Lord Qinmo is truly considerate, remembering even such small matters," Gan Wenqing praised, her eyes full of admiration.
The other female cultivators felt the same.
However, Sima Changqin's gaze didn't land on them but rather subtly glanced at Xi Ying, who intentionally kept a distance.
This scene was observed by the female cultivators who almost had their eyes fixed on Sima Changqin. Each of them felt a mix of emotions, increasing their dislike for Xi Ying.
Once all the Nascent Soul and Core Formation cultivators had taken the Fire Avoidance Pills, the group finally set off, officially heading into the mountains.
Within the Fire Peak Mountain region, the number of Fire Beasts was low, but their levels were much higher than those outside. Most of these Fire Beasts also possessed higher spiritual intelligence. Seeing such a large group marching into the mountains, they had long hidden underground, not daring to show themselves.
The treasure-hunting team advanced in great momentum, heading straight for the magma area where the Space Spiritual Treasure was located.
Yuan Ming's clone realized that the information Wulu and Nan Shangfeng spread had reached Sima Changqin and the others.
The treasure-hunting team quickly traversed the Fire Peak Mountain Range, and with little effort, they reached the mountain's depths, where they could already see the magma area from afar.
"Is this the place?" Sima Changqin asked Wang Fulong.
"According to what the Communication Talisman stated, this is indeed the place," Wang Fulong replied.
The information about the magma area was provided by Wang Fulong.
For safety's sake, the treasure hunting team halted near the magma region, and Master Tantai and others arranged for people to scout the surroundings.
High above, over a dozen types of flying spiritual beasts hovered continuously, using a bird's-eye view to check for dangers below. After a long time, they signaled that there was nothing unusual.
Only then did the treasure hunting team move forward, beginning to approach that magma region.
The closer they got, the more the temperature in the mountain increased. The air was filled with a scorching smell, and the presence of fire poison became more intense. Many Core Formation Cultivators, even after taking Fire Avoidance Pills, still felt discomfort.
Not a few cultivators who practiced Wood attribute or Water attribute cultivation methods felt dizzy and lightheaded.
Meanwhile, Yuan Ming's true body remained silently within the magma, observing the approaching treasure hunting team from afar.
He wasn't too concerned with these people; rather, he was more wary of Sima Changqin's Black Demons.
After all this time, those Black Demons hadn't appeared, and it was unknown where they were hiding.
Soon, the treasure-seeking group arrived above the magma region.
Wulu and Nan Shangfeng exchanged a glance and retreated quietly.
They knew that Ten Thousand Demon Country had an ambush here, but they couldn't clearly inform the others, so they could only cautiously investigate, trying their best not to become sacrifices.
"Wasn't the Communication Talisman saying there's a Space Spiritual Treasure beneath this magma, with the Heavenly Fire inside? Why haven't I discovered any Space Spiritual Treasure?" Long Hou extended his Divine Sense into the ground but found nothing.
Master Tantai and others also used their secret techniques to search, but similarly found nothing.
"Could it be the news in the Communication Talisman is false..." Wang Fulong looked pale.
Yuan Ming wasn't surprised by this; the Space Spiritual Treasure had already merged completely with the void, and it was because he had followed the Flame Wolf King and received a reminder from the void that he discovered this place.
He considered causing some commotion to reveal the location of the Space Spiritual Treasure.
At that moment, a zither's sound suddenly rang out. It was Sima Changqin's ancient zither playing by itself, shooting waves of soundwaves that covered the magma region below.
The entire magma started to tremble, sending up waves, and even the hard rocks within the magma shook and then shattered.
"What kind of attack is this?" Yuan Ming was secretly shocked upon seeing this scene.
Before he could figure it out, the soundwave had already spread deep underground, also covering the ore Yuan Ming had transformed into.
Yuan Ming's body trembled uncontrollably, and his mana vibrated out of control, causing the effect of the Transformation Stone Talisman to vanish quickly.
At this rate, it wouldn't be long before the transformation was undone.
Yuan Ming operated the Primordial True Skill, attempting to negate the zither sound waves' impact, but with little effect.
"Am I going to be exposed..." he thought with a sigh in his heart.
At this moment, beams of silver light shot forth from the side; it was the Space Spiritual Treasure influenced by the zither sound waves.
"Found it!" Sima Changqin stopped the sound of the zither, ready to cast a spell to dive in.
Just then, a disturbance appeared underground, and the Space Spiritual Treasure shot out a thick beam of silver light.
"Be careful!" Master Tantai was the first to shout a warning.
The treasure-hunting team immediately became tense, each surrounded by a glow of treasure, entering a defensive state.
In the next instant, a ripple floated above the magma region, and a simple Teleportation Array emerged. One after another, figures of the Demon Clan appeared densely, numbering nearly five or six thousand.
Among these demon clans, there were Fire Lizard Clan members with fiery red scales and long tails, slender Fire Bee Clan members with crystal red scaled wings, and Armadillo Clan members with large plate armor, but the most numerous were the tall and robust Fire Wolf Clan.
These demon soldiers were clearly selected by Ten Thousand Demon Country, all either naturally fire-attribute or extremely fire-resistant, mainly third-level and fourth-level, led by fifth-level War Generals.
The one standing at the forefront, completely devoid of Fire Wolf Clan traits, was a towering sixth-level demon with an immensely powerful aura.
A circle of fiery red fur adorned his neck, and three ferocious scars ran almost across his whole cheek on a smooth head. His towering figure, over one zhang tall, wore only a beast-skin cloak over a bare chest without any armor, exposing muscles carved like granite, glistening with metallic luster and filled with wild power.
"Flame Wolf King!" Jin Chen's pupils shrank sharply upon seeing the tall Fire Wolf Clan man.
As the son of the White Emperor City Lord, he was far from unfamiliar with the demons in front of him, having dealt with them more than once.
"With the Flame Wolf King here, it seems the Heavenly Fire is indeed within that Space Spiritual Treasure." Sima Changqin smiled.
"Kill!"
The Flame Wolf King, facing Sima Changqin and the others, showed no trace of fear. His expression cold, he lifted his steel claw-like hand high and swung it forward.
In the eyes of the thousands of demon clans, an intense war intent surged, and they let out various roars and strange cries, charging towards the treasure hunting team.
"Counterattack." Sima Changqin casually glanced at them and said indifferently, seemingly dismissing the thousands of demon clans.
"Do not panic. Follow your team's allocation, form your arrays to resist, stabilize the formation first, and then counterattack," stated Master Tantai, more like a calm leader, in a clear voice.
Each team immediately lined up, preparing to counterattack.
The cultivators skilled in magic and ranged attacks formed seals with both hands and waved at the demon beasts charging at them.
The sound of howling echoed in the void, with various streaks of light appearing in the sky. Arrows of flames, light pillars of thunder, green light wind blades, and icy flying blades manifested out of thin air, crashing down upon the demon clans.

chapters.title: Chapter 939 - 905: Full Mobilization
chapters.content:
Facing various magic attacks, the Demon Clan cultivators were utterly fearless, each displaying their divine skills to respond.
However, compared to the flashy and varied attack methods of the Human Clan, the Demon Clan was much simpler and more direct, relying purely on physical combat.
Almost all Demon Clan cultivators were naturally born body cultivators, each having a powerful physique. Most magic attacks could only momentarily slow them down but could not harm their lives at all.
As a result, the Demon Clan army soon reached the treasure hunting team's formation.
The treasure hunting team had anticipated this situation long ago. As the Demon Clan army charged close, various magic treasures flew out, transforming into streaks of rainbow-like treasures and crashed towards the Demon Clan.
Within the Demon Clan's ranks, nearly a hundred of the Armadillo Clan with the best defenses revealed their true bodies, transforming into demon bodies several to a dozen feet tall, curling into balls at the forefront.
Streaks of treasure light struck the Armadillo Demon Clan's bodies, with a series of deafening collision sounds resounding.
The scale armor of these Armadillo Demon Clan was exceptionally sturdy, rendering the magic treasures almost ineffective, with most being repelled.
The Armadillo Demon Clan's bodies radiated a dense red light, rolling forward like a rumbling chariot, crashing directly into the treasure hunting team.
The formation of the treasure hunting team was breached, torn into a large gap.
Other demon clans followed behind the Armadillo Clan, killing their way through the breach, and the original formation battle instantly descended into a tangled melee.
The treasure hunting team had superior numbers, yet they couldn't seize the upper hand.
Master Tantai, Long Hou, and Jin Chen, upon seeing this, were about to make a move.
"Everyone, our purpose here is to find the Heavenly Fire, not to fight these demon clans," Sima Changqin suddenly spoke.
"Are we leaving now? What about the others?" Jin Chen said somewhat reluctantly.
He had brought many cultivators from White Emperor City and couldn't possibly take them all. In these exceedingly fiery toxin-laden grounds, the demons of Wanyao Country, mostly of the fire attribute, had not only unfazed combat power but rather enhanced, whereas most of the treasure hunting team's combat power had diminished, except for a few cultivators who practiced fire attribute techniques.
Once the Dharma Phase cultivators — the backbone and significant force — and Returning to Void cultivators withdrew from the battlefield, the remaining cultivators were likely doomed.
Sima Changqin did not speak, transforming into a streak of light and darting downward.
"Those who achieve great things cannot afford to be soft-hearted," Long Hou said disdainfully.
With that, he was the first to abandon the rest of his team, taking only Long Yinkong, transforming into a long rainbow, chasing in the direction of Sima Changqin.
Master Tantai and Wang Fulong saw this and followed with the cultivators from their respective sects.
"Young City Lord, these people came voluntarily. Their life and death are their choices, no need to bother," said an old man in black beside Jin Chen.
This person, with a face as red as dates and short beard, exuded a vast aura, was also a Dharma Phase cultivator.
The old man in black, named Gu Chuanting, was the right-hand man of White Emperor City Lord Jin Mu, dispatched to assist Jin Chen this time.
Jin Chen nodded painfully, leading some White Emperor City cultivators to leave the battlefield and gave chase.
"Stop them!"
Unexpectedly, the Flame Wolf King didn't continue to pursue the remaining treasure hunting team but instead roared to direct the group of demons to block Sima Changqin and others.
Hundreds of Fire Wolf Clan members blocked the front, their eyes turning crimson as they doubled in height, their bodies becoming more werewolf-like. They exhaled scorching breaths through their nostrils, veins resembling lava began to surface on their bodies, each inflated with power, charging fiercely forward.
Dozens of figures also emerged from the Fire Bee Clan, soaring a hundred feet into the air.
Their abdomens bulged, constantly flashing firelight, and their stingers, laden with intense fire poison, shot down like a fiery meteor shower with rapid speed.
Nearly a hundred demons surged forth from the Fire Lizard Clan, opening wide mouths to unleash thick tongues of fire, weaving into a massive fiery net.
Apart from the Armadillo Demon Clan entrenched deep within the formation, all three remaining demon clans exerted full force to block Sima Changqin and others.
Sima Changqin did not halt, flying directly into the demon ranks ahead.
Somehow, six mysterious figures clad in black armor had appeared beside him, including Wu Li and Tie Xuan.
Sima Changqin didn't even need to strike. The demons blocking his way were swiftly slain by those few in black armor.
Occasionally, Sima Changqin would make a move. A mere casual wave would create harp string-like traces of light in the void, slicing through surrounding demon bodies.
His movements were light, his demeanor unrestrained, and while he killed with a wave of his hand, not a trace of blood stained him.
Xi Ying, Long Yuhuan, and Gan Wenqing, along with a few other female cultivators, followed behind him, not needing to lift a finger.
Master Tantai, Long Hou, and others weren't idle, each making their moves.
The strength of these demon clans was formidable, but they couldn't stop the presence of numerous Dharma Phase cultivators, and their formation was easily broken through.
