The Flame Wolf King's face turned ashen. Transforming into a red light, he blocked the front, tearing apart several Returning to Void cultivators with a wave of his hand, including an elder in the late Returning Void stage who was a Heavenly Dragon Hall cultivator.
"Get out of the way!" Long Hou's eyes flashed with a cold light, raising a golden baton with a coiled golden dragon on its body, and with a whoosh, smashed it toward the Flame Wolf King.
A force almost suffocating descended from the sky. Before it had truly landed, the nearby space was already distorted and deformed, even producing creaking sounds out of thin air, as if about to be crushed.
The Flame Wolf King did not dare to be careless. His overwhelming demonic power exploded, reaching the Sixth Rank Upper Stage as he extended an arm forward.
This arm suddenly grew several times thicker, with dense crimson fur sprouting on his skin, each muscle bulging high, seemingly containing endless strength as he fiercely grabbed at the Coiling Dragon Giant Stick.
With a deafening clang, a tumultuous airwave erupted from the collision.
Long Hou's figure shook violently, retreating several steps before regaining his footing, suffering a minor loss.
Beside him, Master Tantai raised his hand and made a grasping motion in the void, grabbing a silver duster in his hand, which he then waved forward.
In an instant, the silver threads on the duster seemed to come alive, shooting forward, wrapping around the Flame Wolf King's body.
The Flame Wolf King didn't mind, as golden-red flames ignited on his body, counter-wrapping the silver threads of the duster.
These Red Gold Demon Fires were extremely hot, distorting the nearby void.
However, those silver threads, made of some unknown material, showed no signs of damage under the roasting of the Red Gold Demon Fire.
Master Tantai flicked his wrist, and the silver threads of the duster instantly tightened, ripping dozens of deep, bone-revealing wounds into the Flame Wolf King's body.
Before the Flame Wolf King could react, a broad golden shadow flashed, which was Long Hou's Coiling Dragon Giant Stick.
With a loud bang, the Flame Wolf King was struck and sent flying into the distant magma.
With no barrier ahead, the group immediately flew into the magma, quickly plunging downward, soon reaching the bottom of the magma near the spatial treasure.
The spatial treasure, originally blended with the void, now, for some reason, emitted a dazzling silver light, appearing very conspicuous in the magma, like a giant silver vortex, rumbling as it spun.
Yuan Ming strained to activate the Transformation Stone Talisman to avoid being discovered while scrutinizing Sima Changqin and the others.
Beside Sima Changqin at this moment were only six Black Armor figures, along with Xi Ying, Long Yuhuan, Gan Wenqing, and a few other female cultivators.
Next to Master Tantai were his disciples, namely He Xiuwen, Yang Fan, and Nan Shangfeng.
As for Long Hou, he only brought Long Yinkong.
On Wang Fulong's side, there was Wei Ling, Wulu, a clone of Yuan Ming, and another Returning to Void Stage elder from the Sunset Sect.
Jin Chen was the last to arrive, with several Returning to Void cultivators from White Emperor City accompanying him, as well as the black-clothed Dharma Phase Stage elder, Gu Chuanting.
The pressure at the depth of the magma was astounding, and intensely hot. Apart from the Flame Wolf King, not many of the Demon Clan army above could plunge to this depth, allowing the group to slightly relax.
Sima Changqin's gaze swept over everyone, seemingly counting their number, quickly settling on Yuan Ming's clone.
Yuan Ming's clone had an indifferent look, gazing idly around as if he was not here for a treasure hunt, but a leisurely outing.
"Fellow Daoist Wan seems quite leisurely," Sima Changqin said.
"I am weak in strength and low in status, so I might as well take it easy. I'll follow Lord Qinmo's commands in everything," Yuan Ming's clone said with a smile.
"Is that so…" Sima Changqin said, noncommittally.
"If Lord Qinmo is unsatisfied, I can pave the way first," Yuan Ming's clone said as he proceeded to fly towards the silver vortex first.
Others were taken aback at this.
But Yuan Ming's clone stopped after just two steps.
Because in front of them, golden ripples suddenly appeared within the silver vortex, like a resplendent glow, and four figures emerged from it one after another.
The one leading stood over two meters tall, his body covered with a layer of dense black short hair, resembling a towering iron tower or a giant bear standing upright. His face had a long scar, his eyes gleamed with a fierce light, and a sinister smile was faintly visible at the corners of his slightly protruding mouth.
Beside the bear demon was a female demon, slightly shorter, yet over a meter tall, wearing a long purple dress. She was quite beautiful in appearance, with a pair of broad purple wings that occasionally emitted a flash of electricity.
Beside the female demon was an old man with shriveled skin, yet robust in physique, covered in tangled hair and grayish all over, appearing to be a tree demon.
The last person was a green-robed man with an extraordinarily large mouth extending to his ears, his skin deathly pale without a trace of color, and his whole body exuded a chilling aura.
One solid, extraordinary demon aura after another surged skyward from the four demons, forming an indescribable terrifying pressure. They had all reached the Sixth Rank, far beyond the silver giant bird Yuan Ming had slain earlier, equivalent to the Flame Wolf King as Sixth Rank Upper Stage Great Demons.
"The Black Bear King, Electric Roc King, Giant Tree King, Green Snake King, and the Flame Wolf King just now—are the Five Great Demon Kings of Ten Thousand Demon Country coming out in force?" Jin Chen glanced over each one, his expression greatly changed.
Master Tantai, Long Hou, Wang Fulong, and others' faces also turned extremely grave, involuntarily looking at Sima Changqin.
Sima Changqin's expression was calm, with no trace of panic, offering slight reassurance to the others.
The Returning to Void cultivators present all had pale faces, not daring to make a sound.
After the four demon kings appeared, they did not speak, seemingly waiting for someone.

chapters.title: Chapter 940 - 906: I'm Not Going
chapters.content:
At this moment, as the golden ripple rose again, another figure emerged.
However, the appearance of this person made everyone present even more unsettled.
Because the newcomer was no longer a strong and tall demon clan but a girl who seemed to be only sixteen or seventeen years old.
Her appearance was so exquisite, as if she had stepped out of a painting, her beauty so natural that only the words "heavenly beauty" could describe it, drawing everyone's eyes to her involuntarily.
Then, almost everyone had the same question in their hearts: Who is she?
"Fellow Daoist Wu Yu?" Nan Shangfeng couldn't hold back his surprise, exclaiming, which attracted everyone's attention.
"Do you know her?" Master Tantai frowned and asked.
Nan Shangfeng, engrossed in his shock, couldn't answer for a moment.
Yuan Ming, who had been disguised as a piece of ore in the magma, was also greatly surprised.
He never expected Wu Yu would appear in this occasion.
However, Wu Yu was no longer wearing the previous light green silk dress but had changed into a rather luxurious golden robe, which added a sacred, inviolable, noble aura to her slender and tall figure.
The aura of Golden Robed Wu Yu greatly changed, standing before the Four Great Demon Kings, not only did she not seem out of place, but the invisible aura she emitted suppressed all the Demon Kings, akin to the moon being surrounded by stars.
At this moment, she seemed to be the empress of all demon kings.
"Everyone, cease this battle; there's no need to continue anymore," Wu Yu said.
Her voice was icy, like the collision of ice blocks, crisp and pleasant, yet extremely penetrating.
Though not loud, her voice penetrated through the magma-covered battlefield and reached everyone's ears.
"Hmph, you think you can stop the battle with just your words?" Long Hou glanced at Sima Changqin, saw he had no reaction, and stepped forward to reply.
However, on the battlefield above, the demon soldiers of the Ten Thousand Demon Country turned pale and retreated one after another.
The treasure-hunting team was surprised but did not pursue.
The originally fierce melee abruptly stopped because of Wu Yu's single sentence, with both sides withdrawing to form two distinct camps.
"Who are you?" Long Hou asked solemnly, sizing up Wu Yu as if trying to know her anew.
"You must be the Ten Thousand Demon Empress, honored to finally meet you," Sima Changqin finally spoke.
Wu Yu suddenly raised her right hand and grabbed towards her side.
With a clang, Golden Robed Wu Yu's robe billowed, unleashing unimaginable, majestic demonic power, carrying irresistible pressure that swept across the battlefield.
Even the Dharma manifestation cultivators felt the mountainous pressure descending from above, thick as mountain ranges and aggressive as the blazing sun, causing them to nearly bow if they weren't careful, hurriedly circulating their mana to resist.
Returning Void cultivators like Wulu and Nan Shangfeng were even less able to bear it, collapsing back onto the ground.
Wulu's body went limp, supporting with his left hand as he pressed backward, grabbing an inconspicuous red ore.
Naturally, that ore was Yuan Ming in disguise.
Wulu seemed a bit surprised and snatched up the red ore, continuing to cultivate to resist the pressure from Wu Yu.
The surrounding cultivators were too focused to notice, and the few who saw it merely thought Wulu picked up a piece of fire attribute ore, paying little mind.
Master Tantai and Long Hou, with their deep cultivation, steadied themselves first, exchanged glances, seeing shock in each other's eyes.
They felt that the girl before them, whose beauty seemed otherworldly, had cultivation vast and boundless, most likely surpassing any other Dharma manifestation cultivator present.
Yuan Ming was also awestruck.
He was more shocked by Wu Yu's hidden identity, realizing that when they previously interacted, he hadn't sensed Wu Yu's tremendous strength.
The explosive gale dissipated, revealing Wu Yu's form, with a faintly blue string mark caught in her palm.
The string mark squirmed but couldn't break free from Wu Yu's grasp.
"Fellow Daoist Qin Mo's greetings are truly ingenious. I've heard Fellow Daoist Qin Mo possesses the Ten Great Qin Sound Divine Abilities; could this be the Lifeless Sound Blade that slays invisibly?" Wu Yu said, laughing.
While speaking, she exerted force with her palm, directly crushing the string mark.
"The Ten Thousand Demon Empress's power is indeed formidable, intending to make us retreat without a fight by herself alone; truly deserving to be the King of Ten Thousand Demons," Sima Changqin smiled lightly.
"Fellow Daoist Qin Mo exaggerates. If it were only you, I wouldn't dare claim victory, not to mention with everyone present," Wu Yu smiled faintly, her gaze sweeping over Master Tantai, Long Hou, Jin Chen, and others.
"What is the purpose of Fellow Daoist's visit?" Sima Changqin inquired.
"Naturally seeking the Heavenly Fire," Wu Yu replied.
"What do you mean?" Sima Changqin's eyes showed a slight ripple and asked.
"You and I have the same purpose for coming to the Fire Rock Desert, for the Heavenly Fire. Instead of fighting to the death, why not join forces to search for the Heavenly Fire together?" Wu Yu looked at him and said.
"Hasn't your Ten Thousand Demon Country already seized the advantage? Previously, you let the Fire Wolf Clan block us, and now you're proposing cooperation. You're not trying to trap us, are you? Do you really think we're fools?" Long Hou sneered.
"I believe you all have seen it already, this area behind us hides a world of its own. To be honest, there's a Space Spiritual Treasure tightly fused with the Void here, and the Heavenly Fire is hidden inside this Space Spiritual Treasure." Wu Yu looked at the silver whirlpool and said.
"Isn't this Space Spiritual Treasure controlled by your Ten Thousand Demon Country? Otherwise, how can you enter and exit freely?" Master Tantai focused his gaze and asked.
"This treasure is not controlled by our Ten Thousand Demon Country. We don't even know where it came from. If you don't believe it, you can try refining it yourselves. If you succeed, our Ten Thousand Demon Country will immediately withdraw and won't contend with you." Wu Yu shook his head and stepped aside.
The four Great Demon Kings also stepped aside.
Master Tantai and the others looked at each other, but for a while, no one stepped forward to try.
At this moment, a graceful silhouette suddenly walked out from the crowd; it was Xi Ying, who directly walked toward the Void.
The crowd looked on with surprise.
"Fairy Xi, be careful," Sima Changqin reminded.
"No worries," Xi Ying did not turn around and waved her hand, quickly arriving before the silver whirlpool.
She raised her hand and shot out two beams of white light, which entered the silver whirlpool. After some probing, she released her Divine Sense to carefully inspect.
After a moment, a strange expression appeared on her face, and she turned back.
"Fairy Xi, did you discover anything?" Long Hou asked impatiently.
"Indeed, there is a Spiritual Treasure's aura there. However, for some reason, it is perfectly fused with the Void. Not to mention refining it, even touching the body's treasure is impossible," Xi Ying said.
"When we discovered it, we also tried various methods to refine it, but the results were fruitless. Fortunately, the entrance of this Space Spiritual Treasure is open, allowing unrestricted access," Wu Yu added upon seeing this.
"Since entry is unimpeded and you have entered first, why cooperate with us?" Master Tantai still did not understand.
"You haven't entered yet and don't know that inside the Spiritual Treasure is vast and expansive. The Heavenly Fire is too powerful and elusive; finding and capturing it is as difficult as finding a needle in a haystack," Wu Yu explained.
"As far as I know, your Ten Thousand Demon Country is not short of manpower," Master Tantai was not entirely satisfied with this answer.
"The presence of the Heavenly Fire makes the space inside the Spiritual Treasure extremely hot, and the Fire Poison is intense. Besides a few Fire Attribute Demon Clans with adequate cultivation, others cannot withstand it. Long-term exploration requires clan members of at least Level 5, and approaching or capturing the Heavenly Fire requires Level 6 or above," Wu Yu continued.
Upon hearing this, the people thoroughly understood.
The Ten Thousand Demon Country also doesn't want to cooperate with the Human Clan, but they have too few people who meet these stringent conditions. Instead of constantly depleting power inside the Spiritual Treasure Space and fighting the treasure hunting teams, they might as well invite the other side to join in finding the Heavenly Fire together.
"Fellow Daoist's move to invite us into the trap is quite clever. As long as we refuse to give up the Heavenly Fire, we must enter the game," Sima Changqin clapped lightly, laughing.
"So, what is your decision?" Wu Yu, smiling coyly, asked.
Sima Changqin surveyed the people and saw them all nodding in agreement, then nodded himself: "Since it's an open scheme, how can we refuse? But it's best to set three agreements: before finding the Heavenly Fire, avoid senseless depletion, or else cooperation will be meaningless."
"Naturally, we shall each restrain our clans and agree not to attack each other before finding the Heavenly Fire. Once found, we'll rely on our own abilities," Wu Yu nodded.
Wulu, Nan Shangfeng, and other Returning Void Cultivators sighed in relief.
The previous tension made many expect a battle, but unexpectedly, the situation turned, and they cooperated with the Ten Thousand Demon Country.
"You've all heard what this Fellow Daoist said. Who is willing to join me?" Sima Changqin asked, looking at the crowd.
"I am willing to follow," Long Hou responded first.
"We are willing to follow," Master Tantai represented his disciples and stated together.
Wang Fulong also quickly expressed his willingness to go, and Wulu, Wei Ling, and others nodded as well, only Yuan Ming's clone remained motionless, standing with his head down.
The crowd's attention fell on Yuan Ming's clone, and even Wu Yu looked over.
"Fellow Daoist Wan, aren't you going?" Sima Changqin asked with a smile.
"My strength is insignificant, so I won't join the excitement. It feels quite dangerous inside," Yuan Ming's clone waved his hand and said.
The crowd didn't say anything, but disdain flashed in their eyes.
Sima Changqin slightly frowned, somewhat surprised: "Unexpectedly, Fellow Daoist Wan is of a prudent character. But letting Fairy Xi enter the Spiritual Treasure Space alone—aren't you worried for her safety?"
"Xi Ying's strength is far above mine; entering wouldn't help much. Moreover, we don't know who placed this Space Spiritual Treasure here, or what changes might occur. I'll stay outside to guard against any mishap," Yuan Ming laughed undisturbed by Sima Changqin's sarcasm.
He spoke reasonably, upright and righteous, leaving nothing to pick flaws in.
Meanwhile, his words dispelled some people's thoughts of entering.

chapters.title: Chapter 941 - 907: Splitting Up to Explore
chapters.content:
The danger that Yuan Ming's clone mentioned does indeed exist. If someone truly designs this from behind the scenes and shuts down the entrance to the space spiritual treasure, then those who enter would truly be trapped like fish in a barrel.
The reason Yuan Ming wants to leave a clone outside is naturally for surveillance purposes. After all, once everyone enters the spiritual treasure space, they may not be able to promptly know the external changes, posing some risk.
"Fellow Daoist Wan, your words are reasonable. Wei Ling, you should also stay behind to guard the entrance for everyone," Wang Fulong instructed.
"Yes," Wei Ling agreed.
Master Tantai, Long Hou, Jin Chen, and others heard the words and left people outside to watch over.
Soon, the selection of those entering the space spiritual treasure was finalized.
Sima Changqin and his six Black Demon Guards, led by Master Tantai from the Daluo Sect and four disciples, Long Hou from the Heavenly Dragon Hall with Long Yinkong and Long Yuhuan, Jin Chen from White Emperor City with Gu Chuanting and three Returning to Void cultivators, and Wang Fulong from the Sunset Sect with two gold-robed youths at the Returning to Void Stage.
Besides these, only Wulu and Xi Ying were entering.
Of course, Yuan Ming, who had transformed into a stone hiding in Wulu's sleeve, was also among them.
On the Ten Thousand Demon Country's side, Wu Yu brought along seven or eight sixth-level demons, including the Five Great Demon Kings.
The Flame Wolf King also flew over, hearing that Wu Yu was unexpectedly teaming up with Sima Changqin and others for the treasure hunt, feeling displeased but not daring to defy Wu Yu's decision.
In addition to several sixth-level demons, about a dozen fifth-level demons accompanied, both sides maintaining roughly equivalent strength.
"Everyone, let's meet inside the spiritual treasure space," Wu Yu led a group of the Demon Clan, flew into the silver vortex, and disappeared.
"Let's go in as well," Sima Changqin said, taking the six Black Demons, walking into the silver vortex, their forms enveloped in a faint ripple, then vanished.
Seeing this, the others also went over one by one and disappeared into the spatial ripples.
Wulu, carrying Yuan Ming and Xi Ying, were the last to enter.
Initially, a distortion came before Wulu's eyes, then darkness ensued, and after it brightened again, they had already arrived in another world.
It was a vast expanse of crimson mountains and rivers; wherever one looked, there was red scorched earth and clusters of flaming fire.
In the distance, winding rivers could be seen.
However, the rivers did not flow with water but with bright red molten magma.
The most immediate feeling upon entering this space was not the intense heat but an indescribable force of space.
It resembled an omnipresent mountain, heavily pressing on everyone's shoulders.
Fortunately, those who entered were all high-cultivation human and demon clans, hence not unable to withstand this formidable space power. However, everyone's Divine Sense and eyesight were greatly affected.
The range at which Divine Power could be externalized wasn't even a tenth of what it was outside, and as for eyesight, at most one could see the magma river ten or so miles away; beyond that was a distorted, blurred scene, with nothing visible.
"To avoid conflicts in the beginning, how about we use that magma river as the initial boundary and each explore half?" Wu Yu suggested.
"Alright, but we'll choose first," Sima Changqin said.
"Please go ahead, Qin Demon," Wu Yu nodded.
Sima Changqin narrowed his eyes, looking around; moments later, he pointed towards the left side of the river, saying, "We'll take this side."
"Then let's split up and see whom destiny favors more," Wu Yu replied.
Having said that, she led the Ten Thousand Demon Country's team towards the right side of the river, swiftly disappearing at the horizon's edge.
"Let's move out," said Sima Changqin.
After speaking, he headed towards the left side of the magma river, leading the team to move out.
Yuan Ming wasn't used to following others, but unfortunately, at this moment, he didn't have a suitable opportunity to detach from the team, so his clone had to keep up.
Due to the powerful suppression of space power, flying through the air in this mountain and river space wasn't an easy task.
Fortunately, the team had cultivators no lower than the Returning to Void Stage, so even with the space power suppression, their flying escape speed wasn't too slow.
In no time, the group tunneled hundreds of miles, yet they had not seen the boundary of the space spiritual treasure.
At this point, they understood what Wu Yu meant by saying this place was vast and extensive.
After flying for a while, Sima Changqin waved to stop everyone.
"No one knows how big this ghostly place is; searching like this is pointless. We need to stop moving collectively and act separately to quickly find where the Heavenly Fire is," said Sima Changqin.
"Separate exploration?" Upon hearing this, a hint of hesitation appeared on everyone's faces.
"Lord Qinmo, the Ten Thousand Demon Country people came here long ago; they might have already set up an ambush within this space, separating and acting is somewhat risky," Master Tantai said with a frown.
"Delaying here too long is also very dangerous. If the Ten Thousand Demon Country finds the Heavenly Fire first, our situation becomes very passive," Sima Changqin shook his head.
The others heard this and for a moment, no one spoke.
"All of you are elite warriors of the Human Clan. I believe you have confidence in your own strength. You wouldn't become so timid just because you've come here, would you?" Sima Changqin continued.
"Lord Qin Mo is right. However, in this Spiritual Treasure Space, the Space Power is abnormal, and the Divine Power is suppressed. The Communication Talisman will likely be affected too. Once we disperse, if we encounter danger or find the location of the Heavenly Fire, how should we inform the others?" Long Hou spoke.
Upon hearing this, everyone agreed, yet there was no good solution.
"You don't need to worry about this; I've been prepared." Sima Changqin said, turning his wrist, revealing a deep purple lacquered wooden box in his palm.
With a "snap," he opened the lid of the wooden box, revealing twenty to thirty small purplish-red wooden blocks, roughly half the size of a palm.
"This is..."
Everyone looked over in confusion, and after careful observation, found that they were miniature handcrafted wooden zithers, with all the necessary shapes and parts of an Ancient Zither, except for the strings.
"These are Demon Sound Talismanic Zithers I handcrafted from Dragon Roar Wood. They are refined with a wisp of my Essence Blood. Please carry them close to your body. When you encounter danger, just channel mana to activate them, and I can sense it. I may even be able to use the Demon Sound Talismanic Zither to assist remotely," Sima Changqin explained.
Upon hearing this, everyone's expression turned to joy, except Master Tantai and Xi Ying, who remained unchanged.
With the assistance of Lord Qin Mo, their chance of survival would certainly increase significantly.
Yuan Ming, hiding in Wulu's sleeve at the moment, heard this and scoffed inwardly.
Soon, everyone received a Demon Sound Talismanic Zither from Sima Changqin's hand.
"Take care, everyone." Sima Changqin cupped his hands, glanced at Xi Ying, and with six Black Demons, flew into the air, quickly disappearing into the distance.
The others also chose their directions and flew away.
Only Wulu and Xi Ying remained on the spot.
"I'll be off too," Xi Ying said, transforming into a tunneling light, and disappeared.
Yuan Ming originally wanted Xi Ying to travel with him, but seeing this, he had no choice but to give up.
Wulu also transformed into a flying rainbow, flying hundreds of miles away before stopping after completely distancing himself from everyone.
The stone in his sleeve shot out, and after a flash in mid-air, it quickly returned to human form.
Wulu was about to speak but was stopped by Yuan Ming raising his hand, followed by Yuan Ming's voice transmission sounding in his Sea of Consciousness.
"Throw away that Demon Sound Talismanic Zither, let's leave here first and discuss later."
"Why?" Wulu paused, but also replied via voice transmission.
"This Demon Sound Talismanic Zither contains a surveillance Forbidden. Besides the functions Sima Changqin mentioned, it also serves to monitor everyone at all times," Yuan Ming transmitted.
Wulu, upon hearing this, his expression changed dramatically, without the slightest hesitation, took out the small wooden zither, and threw it away.
Immediately, the two accelerated their flying escape, distancing themselves from the area quickly.
"I didn't expect Sima Changqin to be so despicable, wanting to surveil all of us." Wulu spoke angrily.
"He's acting under orders from Ancestor Bing Lan, naturally trying to control the progress of searching for the Heavenly Fire as much as possible," Yuan Ming said calmly, not angry at all.
"Brother Yuan, this region is vast, even if everyone separates, it's like searching for a needle in the ocean. Do you have any good solutions?" Wulu stopped scrutinizing Sima Changqin and asked.
For some reason, he always felt that Yuan Ming would have a solution to break the impasse.
"I have a rather crude method; I just don't know if it will work," Yuan Ming pondered.
"What method?" Wulu's eyes lit up in delight, asking.
"I once read about a cultivator who specialized in detecting Spirit Veins, writing a Classic on mining. Whenever he arrived in unfamiliar places to find mines, he would start from the Spirit Veins. Places rich in spiritual power are likely where mines are born. In this space, it's filled with Fire Attribute Spiritual Power, and the space is entirely enclosed. You can see a lot from the spiritual power distribution. What do you think is the main factor affecting the abundance of spiritual power?" Yuan Ming asked.
"Heavenly Fire..." Wulu's eyes sparkled; he immediately thought of this answer.
In fact, this answer was not accurate; factors affecting the distribution of Fire Attribute Spiritual Power were definitely more than just this one.
This wasn't a normal world but a Spiritual Treasure Space, no matter how vast, it was ultimately a refined spiritual treasure, and couldn't possibly entirely emulate the external environment.
But the most likely factor affecting the Fire Attribute Spiritual Power distribution here was undoubtedly the existence of Heavenly Fire.
The closer to the Heavenly Fire, the more concentrated the Fire Attribute Spiritual Power would be.
"Brother Yuan's method makes sense, but how to explore the underground Spirit Vein path when the Space Power here suppresses the sensing of Divine Power?" Wulu asked.
"Leave this to me," Yuan Ming said with a smile.
He had the Undying Tree, and by releasing the roots deep underground, he could explore the distribution of the Spirit Veins below.
The suppression on the Undying Tree Roots here was not severe; he had just tried it.

chapters.title: Chapter 942 - 908: Supreme Tonic
chapters.content:
"Please wait a moment, let me investigate." Yuan Ming said, sitting cross-legged.
He closed his eyes slightly, urging the roots of the Undying Tree in his Dantian to penetrate deep into the ground, quickly intertwining with an underground spirit vein.
In the next moment, Yuan Ming felt that the richness of the fire attribute spiritual power within this underground spirit vein was nearly half stronger than that of the Fire Peak Mountain outside.
The Undying Tree instinctively began to greedily absorb the underground spiritual power.
Yuan Ming didn't let the Undying Tree act freely and controlled the roots to swiftly investigate the flow of the underground spirit vein.
Quickly, he discovered the flow of this underground spirit vein.
"There's a direction, go that way." Yuan Ming stood up, pointing in a direction and said.
Upon hearing this, Wulu was delighted, and the two immediately flew off in that direction.
The trajectory of the earth veins meandered and twisted, but the general direction was not wrong. The two traveled over a hundred miles before descending again.
Yuan Ming let Wulu rest for a while, before repeating the previous operation to further confirm the direction of the underground fire vein flow, and then they set off again.
After repeating this twice, the spiritual vein they were investigating reached its end, merging into another larger spiritual vein.
Yuan Ming controlled the Undying Tree to ascertain the flow situation of this larger spiritual vein and continued on their journey.
As time passed, the areas the two traversed became increasingly vast, with the terrain below changing from monotonous gobi desert to undulating hills, and then to wind-eroded mountains.
In the broad plains, numerous dark red low mountains towering tens of feet or even over a hundred feet emerged, eroded by the wind into rounded towers, wide-topped mushrooms, or hollowed out wind tunnels.
Yuan Ming secretly marveled at the vastness of this space, far surpassing the Shura Palace.
To open such a large space and shape the underground spirit veins to be almost indistinguishable from the outside world, how many Void Crystal Stones and Heavenly Materials and Earthly Treasures would be required.
While Yuan Ming marveled, a flash of fire suddenly appeared atop a tower-shaped mountain, shooting clusters of magma fireballs at the two.
Wulu, seeing this, waved his hand, and a vast blood-colored wind pillar appeared out of thin air, protecting the two in the center.
This blood-colored wind pillar was the vortex divine ability sealed within the Blood Soul Demon Crystal, now completely mastered by Wulu.
"Boom, boom," loud sounds echoed.
The moment the whirlwind collided with the magma, it exploded with a huge bang.
The magma fireballs suddenly burst open, transforming into countless magma fire rains, forcefully tearing through the blood-colored whirlwind, with the dense magma fire rain continuing towards Yuan Ming and Wulu, enveloping them.
Yuan Ming raised his hand to form a green light shield, blocking the magma fire rain.
Unexpectedly, the magma had an extremely strong corrosive effect, making a sizzling sound as soon as it fell on the light shield, instantly corroding through the green light shield.
Helpless, the two could only retreat, avoiding the finer and more concentrated sparks.
They landed on a mushroom-shaped low mountain, cautiously eyeing the tower-shaped peak.
"What are those?" Wulu asked in surprise.
"Fire beasts." Yuan Ming said, his gaze directed forward.
Following his gaze, Wulu saw a dozen strange exotic beasts emerge from the shadow of the tower-shaped mountain.
They were as big as calves, resembling mantises, each part of their bodies appeared covered with a layer of carapace, their entire bodies were grayish-white, except for their compound eyes, which were exceedingly red.
Those fire mantis-like exotic beasts crouched and sprang, leaving afterimages as they landed near the mushroom low mountain, surrounding Yuan Ming and Wulu at the center.
Yuan Ming's eyes scanned around, his heart moved slightly.
The aura of these dozen fire beasts was very strong, all above level 5, far beyond the fire beasts in the Fire Rock Desert.
"These creatures are a bit strange, be careful." Yuan Ming reminded.
"Leave these fire beasts to me!" Wulu said in a deep voice.
Since entering the Spiritual Treasure Space, he had stayed behind Yuan Ming, with all troubles solved by Yuan Ming, such a free ride was not his style.
"Alright, leave it to you, call me if you need help." Yuan Ming said, raising an eyebrow.
Yuan Ming's voice had barely fallen when the two fire mantises on the left initiated the attack.
A bright red firelight rose from their abdomens, climbing abruptly towards their chest and throat, and the fire mantis suddenly opened its mouth, spewing out two extremely hot magma fireballs.
Having learned from previous encounters, neither Yuan Ming nor Wulu attempted to block, instead eliciting a tacit understanding to dodge to the left and right.
However, just as they maneuvered, several nearby fire mantises lunged forward, their sickle-like forelimbs slashing towards the two.
Yuan Ming moved swiftly, flashing aside, leaping onto another small hill.
Wulu, flipping his wrist, drew a pitch-black long knife, slashing towards the fastest-moving fire mantis.
Blade and sickle collided, sparking fires, neither side yielded, locked in a stalemate, while other mantis fire beasts approached.
Wulu was about to summon the blood-colored whirlwind again, but suddenly, the sickle of the mantis he was grappling with glowed with a blinding red light, unpredictably exploding.
A scorching flame swept out, engulfing Wulu's body, with specks of gold mixed in the red flames.
Wulu had not expected this, being blown away entirely, his arm wielding the knife was shredded with cuts, and an exceptionally scorching force traveled up the blade, directly into his hand.

chapters.title: Chapter 943 - 908: Supreme Tonics (Part 2)
chapters.content:
The intense burning pain almost made him lose his grip on the knife.
However, Wulu seized the moment to leap out of the encirclement and immediately activated the Heavenly Escape Stone Talisman.
His figure vanished from sight instantly, disappearing without a trace.
The fire mantis creatures that were hunting him immediately lost their target. After a moment of hesitation, they turned their gaze towards Yuan Ming.
But just as they turned, Wulu's figure suddenly reappeared behind one of the fire mantises, his jet-black long knife slashing towards its head.
The black blade light flashed, and the fire mantis's head rolled off, with molten lava-like blood flowing out.
The other fire mantis beside it saw this and swiftly turned around. Its two scythe arms turned into two red shadows, instantly striking at Wulu from the front.
Wulu had no time to cloak himself, hurriedly using the knife to block, only to see the fire mantis's eyes suddenly light up with a red glow, and two fire line-like red lights burst from the mantis's forelimbs.
The blade of the scythe on the forelimbs seemed to ignite as it turned fiery red, its surface glowing brilliantly as it fiercely struck the jet-black long knife.
With two loud explosions!
Two more bursts of flames erupted, sending Wulu flying once again, his body half-charred.
Sparks flew from the jet-black long knife, creating two dents on it.
Wulu's eyes showed surprise. This black long knife, though seemingly ordinary, was actually a Spiritual Treasure he had meticulously crafted according to ancient methods, with intentions of making it his Innate Spiritual Treasure.
Unexpectedly, after enduring just two attacks from the fire mantises, the long knife showed signs of damage.
These fire beasts were unexpectedly formidable to such an extent.
Two nearby fire mantises lunged at him, forcing Wulu to retreat hurriedly and once again activate the Heavenly Escape Stone Talisman, concealing himself.
By the time he reappeared, he had arrived beside Yuan Ming.
"These creatures are indeed strange, not easy to deal with," Wulu sighed, looking somewhat pained at his long knife.
"Look over there." Yuan Ming didn't agree or disagree but raised his hand and pointed to the side.
Following the sound, Wulu saw the fire mantis whose head he had previously chopped off still standing in place instead of falling, its severed head on the ground with its compound eyes staring directly at him.
"It won't die from that?" Wulu remarked in disbelief.
"These fire beasts appear similar to common demon beasts, but their body structure is vastly different. Places like the head and the dantian are no longer vital points and can't be judged by common sense," Yuan Ming explained.
"No wonder, I better leave these fire beasts to Brother Yuan." Wulu smiled wryly.
Yuan Ming nodded and leaped off the low hill, landing amidst several mantis fire beasts.
Seeing this scene, Wulu felt uneasy. He had been fighting these fire beasts, trying all he could to avoid being surrounded, yet Yuan Ming had landed right in the center of the fire beasts.
The gap between him and Yuan Ming seemed even larger than he had anticipated.
Amidst Wulu's scattered thoughts, over a dozen fire mantises charged forward,
Yuan Ming twisted his wrist, and a black Fire Burning Stick appeared in his palm, which was Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter.
A red shadow flashed beside him, and a towering fire mantis was the first to pounce, raising both its forearms high to strike at his head.
Yuan Ming lowered his body to evade the mantis's slash, and his Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter swung towards the fire mantis's head.
With a dull "bang," the fire mantis's head burst open like a watermelon, spraying crimson lava.
Yet the head was not the vital part of the fire mantis; its body staggered slightly but steadied itself, with its two mantis blades continuing to slash at Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming deftly dodged again, and his Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter turned into a black shadow and plunged through the wound on the fire mantis's neck into its chest cavity.
The red spiritual patterns on the Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter suddenly lit up, emanating a peculiar wave.
In the next instant, the fire attribute spiritual power within the fire mantis gushed uncontrollably out, being fully absorbed by the Flame Yellow Ruyi Scepter.
It was as if the fire mantis had been drained of all its strength in an instant. Its form quickly wilted, collapsing to the ground.
Yuan Ming dodged another fire mantis's attack and raised his hand to beckon.
The Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter pierced through the fire mantis's skin and flew back into his hand.
The previously warm stick was now scalding hot, wrapped with a strand of golden-yellow peculiar spiritual power, which was clearly the pure power of the Sun.
"Just as I suspected, these fire mantises contain the power of the Sun within them, no wonder their strength is so formidable." Yuan Ming thought, cultivating to absorb it into his body.
His physical body was always in a state of hunger and thirst, and the moment that strand of Power of the Sun entered his body, it was swiftly absorbed by his physical form, instantly bringing a wave of warmth all over, incomparably comfortable.
After this experience, Yuan Ming looked at those Fire Mantises with only joy in his eyes, as if he were gazing at plates of delicious food ready to be served at the table.
All of this, although complex to describe, was actually completed in the blink of an eye.
Other Fire Mantises lunged at him from all directions, swinging their Mantis Blades at a speed invisible to the naked eye.
Dozens of red blade shadows slashed toward Yuan Ming, forming a massive web of blades, seemingly leaving no chance for dodging.
Wulu watched this scene from afar, showing a worried expression.
He knew that Yuan Ming could cast Thunder Escape Divine Ability, and theoretically he shouldn't fear such attacks, but here, the Fire Attribute Spiritual Power was extremely dense, and the Space Power was peculiar, so he might not be able to use Thunder Escape.
Yuan Ming operated his Eyes of Golden Flame, and his pupils emitted two beams of Golden Light.
The dense web of blades suddenly became clear, the previously seamless attack now full of gaps.
His figure transformed into a wisp of blue smoke, and with a single leap, he jumped out of the web's encirclement, shooting his Fire Burning Stick in his hand, aimed at a nearby Fire Mantis.
With a splat sound, Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter pierced through the Fire Mantis's Scale Armor and into its body.
This Fire Mantis's body quickly became shriveled, and its Spiritual Power was drained in the blink of an eye.
Yuan Ming retrieved Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter and rushed towards the next one.
Before long, all the Fire Mantises were slain by Yuan Ming, and dozens of strands of exceptionally pure Power of the Sun merged into his body, giving his physical strength a substantial boost.
Wulu watched everything from afar, and the expression of surprise on his face grew heavier.
"How did you do that?" Wulu couldn't help but ask when Yuan Ming returned.
"Just relying on Magic Treasure." Yuan Ming raised his hand and smiled.
Wulu glanced at the Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter in Yuan Ming's hand and did not ask further.
The two did not linger, and continued forward following the flow of underground fire veins.
On the road ahead, whenever there were Fire Beasts, Yuan Ming would take the initiative to handle them.
After all, these were great nourishment!
And with Yuan Ming leading at the front, the speed of their advance significantly increased, and soon they found a place where Spirit Veins gathered.
It was a vast lake, so wide that the two of them couldn't see the far shore with their eyesight.
What's even stranger was that the water of the lake was actually fire-red, containing extremely dense Fire Attribute Spirit Qi, and it was hot and boiling like magma, yet not as viscous. As the waves undulated, from time to time, scarlet flames would burst out from the water, exploding into fireworks in mid-air.
Although this place was where Spirit Veins converged, it was not the center of the spatial Spirit Vein, so Yuan Ming and Wulu did not stop, flying directly towards the opposite shore of the lake.
When they were almost in the center of the Fire Lake, Yuan Ming suddenly showed a hint of surprise, grabbing Wulu to stop.
"What's wrong?" Wulu asked.
"There's someone fighting ahead." Yuan Ming said.
Wulu concentrated and quickly detected chaotic waves of Spiritual Power emanating from the front, indicating that someone seemed to be fighting there.
However, the noise was very faint, and he could only sense it with complete focus.
Wulu glanced at Yuan Ming and let out a sigh again.
Yuan Ming didn't notice Wulu's thoughts and began casting the Circular Light Technique to investigate the situation ahead.
"It's him!" Yuan Ming muttered to himself.
In the Circular Light Technique appeared a giant white palace illusion, occupying a corner of the sky.
In the center of the palace illusion, a white-clothed cultivator was raising his arms casting spells, his face full of anxiety, it was Nan Shangfeng.
Outside the palace illusion, six ferocious and lion-like fire beasts were incessantly attacking the palace.
These Fire Lions spewed terrifying flames from their mouths, sweeping through the heaven and earth, looking extremely horrifying, their power surpassing the Fire Mantises encountered earlier.
However, whenever the Fire Lions' attacks landed on the palace illusion, a ripple like water would pass through the illusion, and the Fire Lions' attacks would be displaced, hitting the void around the palace illusion.
The palace illusion, relying on its space displacement technique, barely resisted the fire beasts' attacks, but the sweat continuously seeping from Nan Shangfeng's forehead, and his gradually unstable mana aura, all showed that he was reaching his limits.

chapters.title: Chapter 944 - 909: Collusion
chapters.content:
"Should we help him?" Wulu asked in a low voice.
"Let's wait a bit; the aura of these fire beasts seems off." Yuan Ming slightly shook his head, changed his spell, and summoned another Circular Light Technique orb to expand the reconnaissance range.
Soon, in the corner of the battlefield, he discovered three cultivators concealing themselves using magic.
The Circular Light Technique had reached Great Perfection, with extremely strong detection abilities, revealing the appearances of the three.
One of them had big eyes and thick eyebrows, with dark skin, and surprisingly turned out to be He Xiuwen, a senior brother of Nan Shangfeng.
As for the other two, they were both wearing black armor. One had a head full of red hair and was tall and thin, holding a red jade talisman, with spirit light flashing on it incessantly. It seemed faintly connected with the distant fire beasts' aura, as if controlling them.
The other had a fierce appearance, with vicious eyes and a large mouth, his head completely bald, and his body wrapped in thick Yin Qi, looking quite malicious.
These two were both black demons under Sima Changqin, having met once before.
"It's the black demons! How is He Xiuwen involved with them? Could it be Sima Changqin also wants Nan Shangfeng dead?" Wulu was somewhat puzzled.
He had often been hanging around with Nan Shangfeng lately and heard about the grudges between Nan Shangfeng and Sima Changqin.
"I don't know. There may be other reasons." Yuan Ming shook his head and said.
"What is the strength of these two black demons?" Wulu asked.
"The bald one is Early-stage Dharma manifestation, while the one with red hair is at the peak of Returning Void, but his aura is very strange, perhaps he has some hidden trump card." Yuan Ming said.
Just as the two of them were speaking, He Xiuwen within the Circular Light Technique suddenly spoke, his tone discontented: "Fellow Daoist Zheng Heng, this Nan Shangfeng is only in the Late Stage of Returning Void, and yet you haven't managed to kill him after so long. You're too slow; if this continues, I'll go to the heart of the lake first to get that Earth Core Purifying Fire."
Earth Core Purifying Fire!
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming was delighted.
Of course, he had heard of this fire's great name. The Earth Core Purifying Fire belongs to the Earth Fire category and is an extremely unique type of Earth Fire.
Normally, once formed, an Earth Fire's form and nature are fixed. It may be as extremely Yang as the Profound Sun Earth Fire, adept in body refinement; or as pure as the Pure Yang Flame, suitable for alchemy and artifact refining.
However, the Earth Core Purifying Fire is not like this. Legend has it that this fire is mysteriously linked to the sun, changing with the sun's transformations.
In the morning, when the sun first rises, the Earth Core Purifying Fire is full of vitality; at noon, when the sunlight is intense, the fire becomes scorching; and at dusk, when the sun sets in the west, it presents a reserved and subdued state...
Because it changes too easily, the Earth Core Purifying Fire is unsuitable for alchemy, artifact refining, and body refinement.
However, this fire has other wonderful uses.
Because the Earth Core Purifying Fire is constantly changing, understanding this fire can aid in comprehending the True Intent of Fire.
It is said that the Zhu Rong Sect has a pool named the Zhu Rong Fire Pool. Training within it rapidly enhances fire attribute divine abilities, and one of the most essential true fires in the pool is the Earth Core Purifying Fire.
Yuan Ming's Zhu Rong Heart Technique had long reached a bottleneck, urgently requiring the baptism of the Zhu Rong Fire Pool, and he had been seeking opportunities.
But the Zhu Rong Sect is a major sect in the Central Continent. If they knew Yuan Ming had mastered the Zhu Rong Heart Technique, they would chase him endlessly, let alone allow him to use their fire pool.
Now, having found the Earth Core Purifying Fire here, Yuan Ming was, of course, overjoyed.
He quickly summoned another Circular Light Technique orb, looking toward the center of the lake.
Amidst the vast red lake water, a white flame several feet in size was slowly burning. At a glance, it seemed unremarkable, but with closer inspection, one would realize that this fire changed constantly, as if it were alive.
These traits matched perfectly with the descriptions of the Earth Core Purifying Fire, confirming Yuan Ming's suspicions and increasing his delight.
On the other side, hearing He Xiuwen's complaint, the bald black demon Zheng Heng's face turned cold.
"Fellow Daoist He, are you trying to go back on our agreement?" he said coldly.
"What do you mean I'm going back on our agreement? Previously, our agreement was crystal clear: you help me kill Nan Shangfeng, and I will voluntarily withdraw from the competition, yielding the Earth Core Purifying Fire to you. If, after all this time, Nan Shangfeng is still not dead, who knows what unexpected changes might occur if we keep dragging it out. I can't wait any longer." He Xiuwen questioned.
"This is also something beyond my control. Who knew your junior brother had such a powerful space artifact for protection? Besides, he won't last much longer. Fellow Daoist He, please be patient for just a little while longer." Zheng Heng said, a bit awkwardly.
"I can't wait; the strength of these fire beasts is insufficient. Can't you take action personally? No matter how mighty Nan Shangfeng's space artifact is, it can't withstand the two of you." He Xiuwen shook his head.
"Aren't you also an existence at the Dharma manifestation stage? Why not take action?" Zheng Heng mocked.
He Xiuwen was speechless, saying nothing.
These few Direct Disciples of the Sect Masters had their Lifebound Soul Lamps leave traces at the sect.
The Daluo Sect's Lifebound Soul Lamps were refined with a secret technique. Unlike ordinary soul lamps, which could only display the owner's life and death, theirs would record everything the owner saw before dying, no matter the distance, to track down the murderer.
"You are more aware than us of Master Tantai's methods. If Nan Shangfeng dies, he will undoubtedly investigate to the end. If he discovers that we were the ones who acted, that would indeed be troublesome." Zheng Heng snorted.
He Xiuwen's face darkened, but he also knew Zheng Heng's reasoning was sound and didn't have any excuse to refute it.
"Fellow Daoist He, don't be too hasty. We are under Lord Qin Mo. Even if something occurs, although we can't avoid suffering, the lord will ultimately protect us. But you're different; should the matter of killing your junior brother be exposed, the Daluo Sect will no longer provide you with any place to stand." Zheng Heng continued, seeing He Xiuwen's expression.
He Xiuwen remained silent for a moment before slowly saying, "I will only wait for an hour at most."
"Fellow Daoist He is indeed sensible." Zheng Heng revealed a slight smile.
The two then fell silent, but moments later, He Xiuwen suddenly spoke again.
"May I ask Fellow Daoist Zheng Heng, if one wishes to join under Lord Qin Mo, are there any conditions?" He asked Zheng Heng.
"Oh? Fellow Daoist He has an idea? Rest assured, Lord Qin Mo highly values talent. With your gift and strength, as long as you are willing, the lord will gladly accept you. Considering your status, you might not need to follow at all times like us, just answer when summoned during necessary times." Zheng Heng paused for a moment, soon revealing a deeper smile on his face.
"That would be perfect. However, alone, I bring too little help to Lord Qin Mo. If I could also remove Yang Fan and securely sit on the position of Daluo Sect Master, then I would surely mobilize the entire sect's power to repay the lord's assistance." He Xiuwen's eyes sparkled with keen light.
Zheng Heng, hearing this, felt a jump in his heart.
Though Sima Changqin is a Guardian, there is more than one Guardian and they also compete among themselves.
Daluo Sect is a major sect in the Central Continent; if it can be completely conquered and used by Sima Changqin, it would certainly be a great achievement.
"This matter is significant; it's best to notify Lord Qin Mo first. I dare not make decisions on my own." Zheng Heng said calmly.
"No problem, I will quietly wait for good news from Fellow Daoist Zheng." He Xiuwen showed a trace of disappointment in his eyes but soon calmed down, continuing to silently observe Nan Shangfeng being surrounded.
Yuan Ming listened to their conversation through Circular Light Technique, showing a thoughtful expression in his eyes.
"Brother Yuan, it seems Nan Shangfeng is about to falter." At this moment, Wulu, who was watching Nan Shangfeng's situation, spoke up to remind him.
Yuan Ming raised his eyes and saw Nan Shangfeng, drenched in sweat, with Void Palace's teleportation divine ability running slower now, sometimes even having to forcefully withstand the attacks of the Fire Beast.
On the other side, He Xiuwen and the other two, also aware of Nan Shangfeng's condition, became alert, ready to counter his retaliation, aiming to have Nan Shangfeng killed by the Fire Beast here.
"I'll lead, and you act according to the situation. Don't bother with Nan Shangfeng; he should still have trump cards. As long as we hold back He Xiuwen and the other two, he should handle mere Fire Beasts well." Yuan Ming quickly laid out the plan.
Wulu had no objection to this, instantly agreeing, then urged the Heavenly Escape Stone Talisman, disappearing from where he was.
Yuan Ming also operated the Void Transformation Technique to conceal his figure, cautiously approaching He Xiuwen and the other two, soon getting nearby.
The three were still focused on Nan Shangfeng's situation, not noticing someone nearby.
Yuan Ming touched his brow, and soul power surged in his Sea of Consciousness, the Nightmare Divine Ability fully deployed, instantly descending upon He Xiuwen and the other two.
Their divine soul power was less than Yuan Ming's, their eyes simultaneously vacant, falling into the nightmare.
But at this moment, three paths of white light suddenly emerged from their bodies, a pleasant soundwave of zither music appeared in the void.
Following this, the three awoke, each was extremely astonished.
Yuan Ming, lurking nearby, was also greatly surprised, using Eyes of Golden Flame to look at the three paths of white light.
"It's this thing..."
Under Eyes of Golden Flame, the things within the white light appeared clearly, the Dragon Roar Wood Small Zither given by Sima Changqin before was shown. At that time, Sima Changqin hadn't mentioned this zither's effect of protecting the divine soul against illusion techniques, now it seems unclear if he forgot or was waiting for someone to fall into a trap.
At this moment, following the traces of Nightmare Divine Ability, He Xiuwen and his companions discovered Yuan Ming lurking nearby.
"It's you!" He Xiuwen recognized Yuan Ming, his expression turning icy cold.
"Who are you? Why interfere?" Zheng Heng scanned Yuan Ming's face and asked.
He and the Red-haired Black Demon did not follow Sima Changqin to White Emperor City, arriving at the Fire Rock Desert before Sima Changqin, in secret, seeking traces of Heavenly Fire. Though they encountered Yuan Ming's clone earlier at Fire Peak Mountain, they did not understand much about Yuan Ming's matters.
"This man is named Wan Tianren, a friend of Nan Shangfeng! A Loose Cultivator with no significant background, and has some resentment with Lord Qin Mo, he must not escape!" He Xiuwen said quickly.
"Resentment with Lord Qin Mo!" Murderous intent arose in the eyes of Zheng Heng and the Red-haired Black Demon.
Their exchange lasted just a moment, the next instant they lunged toward Yuan Ming, leaving only the Red-haired Black Demon to continue wielding the Jade Token to control the Fire Beast's siege on Nan Shangfeng.
Yuan Ming's expression remained unchanged, raising his hand to form a spell.
As He Xiuwen and Zheng Heng came from both sides, two "Yuan Ming"s emerged from the void, clones formed from Planting Beans into Soldiers,
Both clones wielded the Soul Destroying Sword, filled with murderous aura, runes on the Soul Destroying Sword lit up entirely, emitting an unsettling and eerie aura as they swung out.
Two massive black sword lights attacked, slashing at He Xiuwen and Zheng Heng.
The duo sensed the eerie nature of the black sword lights, avoided them without confronting directly.
"Clone Divine Ability? Even spiritual treasures can be embodied, quite remarkable." Zheng Heng, with broader insight, identified the power of Planting Beans into Soldiers.
"A clone is merely a shell." He Xiuwen was anxious, punching toward one Yuan Ming's clone.
Behind him emerged a gold-colored dharma manifestation giant fist, striking at the clone.
With a muffled "boom," an immense and non-human force came from the golden fist, the void buzzed and trembled.
This Yuan Ming maneuvered his spell, and a vast amount of grayish-white spirit light emerged from his body, mixing with the surrounding nature's spiritual energy, in a blink condensing a tall figure, also a dharma manifestation, with twin fists meeting the incoming force.

chapters.title: Chapter 945 - 910: Swift and Decisive Battle
chapters.content:
With a loud bang!
Yuan Ming's clone was violently shaken and pushed back a dozen feet, but He Xiuwen's massive yellow fist was still caught.
"A clone can also manifest Dharma!"
This time, not only Zheng Heng but also He Xiuwen was shocked.
However, the two soon noticed that the Dharma manifestation by Yuan Ming's clone was weak, only about thirty percent of a normal Dharma's power.
Another Yuan Ming also summoned his Dharma, wielding the Soul Destroying Sword and charging at Zheng Heng.
He Xiuwen and Zheng Heng looked serious. Although the clone's Dharma was only thirty percent powerful, a Dharma was still a Dharma and couldn't be underestimated. They each responded solemnly.
He Xiuwen raised his hand first, calling out a straw man with features made of woven rope, and directed several spells toward it.
The straw man's arm trembled, firing dozens of straws straight at one of the "Yuan Ming" figures.
That "Yuan Ming" quickly manipulated his Dharma to advance, slashing the incoming straws with his Soul Destroying Sword.
Yet the withered straws suddenly accelerated several times, striking the Dharma before the Soul Destroying Sword could land.
These seemingly fragile withered straws were extremely sharp, easily piercing through the Dharma's form, even penetrating the Yuan Ming clone behind it.
Bang!
The Yuan Ming clone exploded into fragments, turning into a shattered spirit bean.
Elsewhere, Zheng Heng summoned a white water mirror and clapped his palms together.
The mirror's chill intensified as a white frost beam, as thick as an arm, shot out, splitting into two thinner white beams mid-air, precisely hitting another Yuan Ming and his Dharma.
With a sizzling sound, the Yuan Ming clone and his Dharma were instantly covered with a layer of glistening white ice armor, becoming large and small ice sculptures.
He Xiuwen and Zheng Heng sighed slightly with relief, ready to attack Yuan Ming's main body when a ripple flashed in the void ahead, and four of Yuan Ming's clones appeared.
He Xiuwen and Zheng Heng's expressions darkened, and they could only continue to attack, slaying the four clones.
But this time, with the four clones working in unison, they held off the two for a moment, consuming considerable effort.
However, before He Xiuwen and Zheng Heng could catch a breath, eight more clones appeared, each summoning a Dharma and charging again with their Soul Destroying Swords.
This time, He Xiuwen and Zheng Heng looked entirely grave, not holding back anymore, immediately forming spells and summoning their respective Dharmas.
He Xiuwen's Dharma looked like an old farmer, with a wide straw hat hiding its entire face and clad in a straw-woven raincoat, everything about it glowing yellow.
As soon as the Dharma appeared, the straw man disassembled on its own, transforming into countless straws that flew to the Dharma's side, reforming into a slender straw sickle held in its hand.
The Mainon Dharma swung its arm, the straw sickle lengthening with the wind, slashing through a clone.
The straw sickle was far sharper than before, easily slicing a clone and its Dharma in half.
The other three clones lunged from different directions, but the straw sickle curved like a whip, striking at the three clones.
Swish swish swish!
The three clones were quickly dealt with as well.
Meanwhile, Zheng Heng's Dharma also materialized.
Its entire body was crystal clear like an ice sculpture, enveloped in a waterfall-like chilling aura from the neck down, like a cloak completely covering its body, shrouding its limbs.
Facing the assault of four Yuan Ming clones, the Frost Dharma merely suddenly opened its eyes, and the chill from its neck surged out, flowing towards the four Yuan Ming clones like rising tidewaters.
The temperature around them dropped instantly, and the scorching lake water beneath their feet solidified into ice.
The Yuan Ming clones rushing towards him were engulfed by the cold, immediately transforming into four ice sculptures.
"After manifesting Dharma, dealing with the clones does become more challenging, but fortunately, I am well-prepared," Yuan Ming muttered to himself from afar, flipping out eight spirit beans and tossing them again.
Eight clones manifested, standing in the way of He Xiuwen and Zheng Heng.
Since perfecting the Planting Beans into Soldiers Divine Power, Yuan Ming had crafted clone spirit beans whenever he had time. Now he had more than a hundred in his possession, and today was the perfect time to test their effectiveness.
The straw sickle swung, cold surges roared, and the eight clones were vanquished again.
Yuan Ming, unfazed, tossed out eight more spirit beans.
"How many has it been already? Damn it, how can Wan Tianren still create clones? Is his mana endless?" He Xiuwen and Zheng Heng communicated telepathically.
"There are two types of clones: one is the regular, instant-use clone, and the other is the storage type. Those clones are made from spirit beans, so it seems to be the latter," Zheng Heng replied.
"So what do we do? If this guy has made a lot of spirit beans, we might exhaust ourselves to death," He Xiuwen asked.
"I'll help you hold off those clones for a while; you take care of Wan Tianren," Zheng Heng lowered his voice.
He Xiuwen nodded.
The eight spirit beans tossed by Yuan Ming turned into clones, swooping over.
Zheng Heng leaped forward, the Frost Dharma spewing a massive chill, enveloping the eight clones.
Yuan Ming had already understood the Frost Dharma's attack patterns, so several clones immediately dodged, but the attack range was so vast that two clones were still engulfed in the cold, turning into ice sculptures.
Zheng Heng manipulated his Dharma to hold off the other clones, flying over a frozen clone.
Just then, several runes suddenly lit up on the frozen Soul Destroying Sword held by the clone.
"Damn it, this sword isn't mana-formed but the Spiritual Treasure itself!" Zheng Heng caught this in his peripheral vision, his expression drastically changing.
But before Zheng Heng could react, his vision suddenly went black, losing all perception of the outside world.
Meanwhile, a massive curse power descended from above, causing Zheng Heng's Nascent Soul to throb in pain, and his qi-blood and soul power within to churn into chaos.
The Frost Dharma behind him wavered, its clear features becoming blurred, the emitted chill thinning instantly by half.
At that moment, the Dragon Roar Wood Small Zither on Zheng Heng's body emitted a resounding zither sound once again.
His vision immediately restored, and the Curse Power within him was forced out.
"Even the Annihilation and Curse Runes can be restrained; could it be that this Dragon Roar Wood Small Zither can shield against all Divine Soul attacks?" Yuan Ming observed from afar, furrowing his brow, and performed a spell gesture.
Zheng Heng's vision returned, filled with joy, and he leaped forward to flee.
However, his back suddenly chilled as a black Sword Shadow pierced through his body from behind, it was the Soul Destroying Sword.
Zheng Heng's Divine Soul felt intense pain, and the Frost Dharma manifestation behind him showed signs of collapsing.
Just at this moment, Yuan Ming's true form appeared out of thin air in front of him, hands forming spell signs.
A vast amount of nature's spiritual energy gathered, and a giant gray-white Dharma manifestation instantly appeared, emanating an extremely powerful mana wave, surpassing even the Frost Dharma.
The gray-white Dharma raised its arm and struck with a punch.
Before the gray-white giant punch stopped, a crushing force as if from a giant peak descended first, bending Zheng Heng's spine as if overwhelmed.
Zheng Heng was utterly shocked, disregarding his injuries, embraced with both hands to summon the Water Mirror Spiritual Treasure, transforming into a large white mirror to shield in front.
A massive Light Pillar shot out from the mirror, aiming at Yuan Ming's Dharma manifestation.
Yuan Ming's Dharma did not dodge, continuing to throw that punch forward.
The fist collided with the Light Pillar, erupting with blazing brilliance that overshadowed the sun, followed by a deafening boom.
"Fellow Daoist Zheng!" He Xiuwen, seeing things going awry, immediately flew over to assist.
However, before him, six clones appeared blocking his path.
"Get out of the way!" He Xiuwen wielded the Mainon Dharma's straw sickle, sweeping towards the six clones.
The six clones deployed their Dharma Manifestation Divine Power, stubbornly obstructing He Xiuwen.
...
As the intense light dissipated, the situation within was revealed.
Zheng Heng's large white mirror was shattered into countless fragments, and the Frost Dharma was pierced through by Yuan Ming's gray-white Dharma fist, dispersing into chilling air.
Yuan Ming's gray-white Dharma was also halfway frozen, yet the completely crystallized fist still slammed a blood-soaked body into the ice on the lake's surface.
This person was indeed Zheng Heng; if it weren't for a Spiritual Treasure protecting him, he would have been utterly annihilated.
Even so, he only had a breath left, and the Dragon Roar Wood Small Zither on him had shattered under Yuan Ming's Dharma punch.
"I don't accept this…" Zheng Heng thought with bitterness.
Had he not spent much mana recently dealing with Yuan Ming's clones, he wouldn't have been defeated so quickly.
Yuan Ming was unaware of Zheng Heng's thoughts, pointing his finger at his brow, and the Nightmare Divine Ability reemerged.
This time, no white light appeared on Zheng Heng's body, nor did any zither sound awaken him from the illusion; he could only sink into the dreamscape.
Zheng Heng's defeat happened quickly; He Xiuwen hadn't yet dealt with the clones in front of him. Witnessing all this, he was dumbfounded.
He knew very well the power of Zheng Heng's Frost Dharma, yet it was beaten in just a few moves.
Yuan Ming turned around to face He Xiuwen, the enormous gray-white Dharma also moved with him.
He Xiuwen's face changed drastically; he immediately turned and fled without a backward glance.
At this moment, his vision suddenly darkened, losing all perception, as Curse Power descended, disrupting his mana and Qi-Blood flow.
However, the Dragon Roar Wood Small Zither on He Xiuwen also emitted zither sound, avoiding the effects of the Annihilation Rune.
Yet Yuan Ming had already driven the Dharma forward, the ice on the Dharma was dissolved, aiming a punch at his back.
He Xiuwen gritted his teeth, controlled the Mainon Dharma to raise its arms, directly confronting Yuan Ming's punch.
With a "bang," a world-breaking force erupted!
The Mainon Dharma's arms were covered with cracks under this punch, and subsequently shattered into pieces.
He Xiuwen also let out a wretched cry, his form flew out like a broken sack, his energy waning.
But He Xiuwen gathered the Dharma, utilizing the momentum of flying backward to twist his form, accelerating his escape.
Yuan Ming did not pursue but instead summoned the Soul Destroying Sword towards himself, fiercely stabbing it into his abdomen.
Shared Life Divine Power!
He Xiuwen's Dantian suddenly throbbed with pain, his tunneling light dissipated, and he fell from midair.
Yuan Ming extracted the Soul Destroying Sword, relying on the life force fed back from the Undying Tree to heal his injuries, his movement entirely unhindered, dashing forward to grab He Xiuwen before he fell into Fire Lake.
"You can't kill me... I'm with Master Tantai…" He Xiuwen held on to his spirit, speaking with difficulty.
Yuan Ming was not interested in his words, reaching out to yank off the Dragon Roar Wood Small Zither on him, crushing it with one hand, then casting a Nightmare spell, causing He Xiuwen to fall into an illusion.
Yuan Ming stored He Xiuwen away as well, turning towards the Red-haired Black Demon and Nan Shangfeng's side.
The Red-haired Black Demon was tangled in battle with Wulu, a large wound, vaguely revealing bone, appeared on his back, at the edges of which were purple-black, evidently injured by a weapon imbued with poison.
No doubt, it was caused by Wulu's stealth attack utilizing the Heavenly Escape Stone Talisman.
The Red-haired Black Demon seemed to have unleashed some Secret Technique at the moment, his whole body turning crimson red, and his form even seemed faintly transparent, as if about to fully transform into flames.
He relied on transforming his body into flames to resist the poison's erosion at the wound.
And truly battling Wulu were the Fire Lions under his control.
Nan Shangfeng had also stored away the Void Palace, a Space Spiritual Treasure, coordinating with Wulu to deal with those Fire Lions.

chapters.title: Chapter 946 - 911: Confiscation
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming, after seeing the battle situation clearly, rushed over immediately.
The red-haired Black Demon also saw He Xiuwen and the process of Zheng Heng's defeat, his expression changed drastically, and without hesitation, he took out the Dragon Roar Wood Small Zither, injecting all his mana into it.
In the next instant, a gigantic white light pillar erupted from the Dragon Roar Wood Small Zither.
Amidst the light beam, a massive phantom identical to Sima Changqin appeared above everyone's heads, emanating an ominous aura like a true dharma manifestation.
Nan Shangfeng and Wulu were immediately oppressed by the aura, feeling as if they were buried underground, unable to move, while those manipulated fire beasts all prostrated themselves, not daring to lift their heads.
Yuan Ming slightly narrowed his eyes, showing a hint of interest.
If He Xiuwen and Zheng Heng were present, Yuan Ming might still worry, but now with the two suppressed, only the red-haired Black Demon was left, he was curious to see how much power Sima Changqin could display using the Dragon Roar Wood Small Zither.
He flew towards the red-haired Black Demon, arriving in front of him in the blink of an eye without making the first move.
The red-haired Black Demon was overjoyed seeing Yuan Ming being so overconfident, and sent the Dragon Roar Wood Small Zither flying, which spun mid-air and landed before Sima Changqin's phantom.
The small wood zither rapidly enlarged, immediately matching the size of Sima Changqin's phantom.
Sima Changqin's phantom then raised his hand, gently touching the zither strings, and instantly, a powerful zither sound echoed through the heavens, causing everyone's bodies to stiffen.
In the next moment, an invisible blade of sound waves emerged above the Fire Lake, rapidly expanding outward with Sima Changqin's phantom at the core.
The fiery lake water beneath was parted by the sound waves, raising towering waves rolling far away, exposing the riverbed and revealing the crimson-red lakebed mud.
Nan Shangfeng and Wulu, however, had no energy to focus on the changes in the Fire Lake; as the sound waves swept across, they screamed miserably, feeling as if they were slashed by a blade.
Both felt as if from Nascent Soul to Divine Soul they were being torn apart, causing their mana to become chaotic, leaving them defenselessly thrown away.
Yuan Ming stood a bit further, and as the sound waves approached, he promptly controlled the dharma manifestation to block in front.
Even so, he still groaned, feeling his Sea of Consciousness tumbling, with his mana and soul power disturbed, the previously stable mana vortex even began to sway.
His grey-white dharma manifestation also shook, retreating repeatedly under the sound wave's impact, becoming significantly less solid.
"Indeed powerful," Yuan Ming nodded silently, circulating Primordial True Skill, quickly subduing the inner chaos.
The grey-white dharma manifestation also returned to its original state, leaping forward to attack the red-haired Black Demon.
Sima Changqin's phantom raised his hand again, activating the zither sound once more.
Another invisible blade of sound waves shot out, slicing towards the grey-white dharma manifestation.
Yuan Ming operated the Eyes of Golden Flame, a golden light flashed in his eyes, and he punched out.
The grey-white dharma manifestation also punched, striking a spot in the void, colliding head-on with the blade of sound waves.
A booming sound arose, the void vibrated, and the blade of sound waves shattered with a single hit.
Sima Changqin's phantom seemed surprised as he plucked the Dragon Roar Wood Zither again, shooting blades of sound waves towards Yuan Ming and the grey-white dharma manifestation.
Yuan Ming dared not be careless, manipulating the grey-white dharma manifestation to meet the attack with punches.
One could only hear the ceaseless sound of banging, with continuous booming sounds between the two gigantic figures, while the fiery lake below surged with towering waves, making it a stalemate for a moment.
Yuan Ming frowned slightly, controlling the dharma manifestation to fight for a while, the mana consumption was huge, continuing like this is not good, he must quickly find a way to end the battle.
He suddenly looked at the Dragon Roar Wood Zither, his eyes gleaming, immediately raised his hand, summoning the Undying Tree Roots, and unleashed the Breaking Space Power.
Sima Changqin's phantom just moved to strum the zither again to unleash the zither divine skills, but the next moment he froze for a moment, looking down sharply at the small zither in front of him.
Seeing a blue-gray root drilling out of the void below the Dragon Roar Wood Small Zither, fiercely stabbing into the zither, voraciously sucking its spirituality.
The small zither, made of Dragon Roar Wood, a high-level spirit wood, is on the "recipe" of the World Tree.
Sima Changqin's phantom encountered such a situation for the first time, slightly parted his lips in surprise but quickly recovered, pressing down on the zither immediately.
A white light burst from his hand, quickly drilling into the blue-gray root.
The blue-gray root suddenly twitched, its surface rapidly split into finger-length fissures, bursting into countless fragments falling down.
Sima Changqin regained control of the Dragon Roar Wood Small Zither, but the spiritual power contained within the zither was less than one-tenth.
Sima Changqin's phantom also dimmed significantly because of this, its oppressive aura greatly reduced.
Yuan Ming smiled slightly, seizing this opportunity, he controlled the dharma manifestation to approach, arriving close instantly, without saying a word, raised his hand and punched.
Sima Changqin's phantom strummed the zither strings again, trying to block, but the zither sound's power was greatly reduced, merely brushing past the grey-white dharma manifestation like a spring breeze, having no effect at all.
Yuan Ming's dharma manifestation's punch easily pierced through the phantom.
Sima Changqin's phantom gave Yuan Ming a deep look, transforming into a large mass of spirit light and dispersing.
The Dragon Roar Wood Small Zither fell with it, caught by Yuan Ming, who casually tossed it to the Undying Tree Roots for absorption.
He immediately used the Nightmare Divine Ability, pulling the red-haired Black Demon who hadn't escaped into an illusion, then suppressed him along with the previously captured He Xiuwen and the others into the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
Both the red-haired Black Demon and Zheng Heng are Black Demons; who knows if Sima Changqin left behind any remote detection methods on them; only within the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space can detection be completely isolated.
The red-haired Black Demon was suppressed, and those few Fire Lions immediately departed without restraint.
Nan Shangfeng and Wulu ignored them and flew to Yuan Ming's side.
"Brother Wan, we owe you again this time." Nan Shangfeng said gratefully.
"Weren't you acting together with Master Tantai, how did you end up alone?" Yuan Ming asked.
"Master sent a few of us out to find the whereabouts of the Heavenly Fire, unexpectedly encountering assassination attempts. It seems my luck is truly terrible; I shouldn't have gotten into this mess." Nan Shangfeng said with a bitter smile.
"This was done by He Xiuwen, who colluded with two Black Demons wanting to eliminate you, clearing away a major obstacle in the fight for the position of Sect Leader." Yuan Ming briefly explained the course of events.
Nan Shangfeng already guessed the general idea upon seeing He Xiuwen, yet his expression still dimmed upon hearing this.
"I've long told him I'm not interested in the position of Daluo Sect Master..."
"No matter how much you explain, as long as you stay in the Daluo Sect, your few senior brothers won't believe you." Yuan Ming said casually.
Nan Shangfeng was stunned upon hearing this, then showed a realization: "Brother Wan makes sense, I understand what to do now."
This time, it was Yuan Ming's turn to be stunned; he just said it casually, yet Nan Shangfeng's reaction seemed to indicate a major decision was made.
However, these matters were not related to him.
Yuan Ming exchanged simple updates with Nan Shangfeng, advising Shangfeng and Wulu to rest nearby while he entered the Shura Palace, then into the Stealing Heaven Tripod, arriving beside He Xiuwen and the other three.
...
In the Spiritual Treasure Space, on the thousand-mile red earth of the desert, there was a deeply entrenched canyon ravine, sprawling across the ground like an unsightly scar.
At the canyon's bottom, on a level stone platform, Sima Changqin sat cross-legged, holding an entirely dark Round Orb.
He closed his eyes slightly, muttering softly.
The black Round Orb began to vibrate slightly under his chant, sending rippling waves projecting outward.
Moments later, scenes of magnificent mountains and deep canyons emerged within the black ripples, along with various cultivator figures.
