Sima Changqin inspected them one by one, seemingly searching for something, but found nothing.
"Why can't I detect Zheng Heng and Yan Jue's situation? Are they dead, or sealed?" After a long while, Sima Changqin slowly opened his eyes, a rare trace of worry and doubt crossing his gaze.
"Lord Qinmo, should I go take a look?" A tall figure enveloped in a Black Robe appeared behind Sima Changqin, speaking in a deep voice.
"No need, continue as planned." Sima Changqin stowed the black Round Orb and took out two white Jade Talismans.
Each Jade Talisman bore an apparition—Zheng Heng and the red-haired Black Demon.
Sima Changqin gripped the Jade Talismans tightly, crushing them.
The Jade Talismans shattered into white points of light, quickly dissipating.
"Lord Qinmo, is this spatial treasure truly the legendary Three Realms Flying Boat?" The tall Black Robe silently watched Sima Changqin's actions, asking only after the white light faded.
"Initially, I wasn't sure either, but after such extensive investigation, it's almost certain." Sima Changqin smiled.
"Understood." The tall Black Robe acknowledged, transforming into a black shadow and darting away.
Sima Changqin also departed shortly, turning into a green light and taking off, soon vanishing into the distant sky.
Moments later, a space fissure nearby opened, and a person stepped forth—it was Xi Ying.
"Indeed, this is the Three Realms Flying Boat of the Three Realms Sect..." She looked toward the direction Sima Changqin left, smiling.
"Master, Sima Changqin is too strong; next time, can I avoid such dangerous tasks?" The space fissure became a large mouth, then a silver tree shadow emerged from the void—it was the Silver Void Tree Demon, appearing extremely fatigued.
"Rest assured, I've shielded your destiny; Sima Changqin won't discover you." Xi Ying said calmly.
"Master, facing both Sima Changqin and Ten Thousand Demon Country is too difficult; let Yuan Ming help, with his power, he could at least relieve one side." The Silver Void Tree Demon suggested, looking at Xi Ying.
"Now is not the time." Xi Ying shook her head.
...
Elsewhere, in the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space.
Yuan Ming looked at Zheng Heng and the red-haired Black Demon, showing a hint of excitement.
Finally suppressing the two Black Demons, these two were Sima Changqin's close guards and definitely knew much regarding his activities.
Zheng Heng was heavily injured, barely clinging to life.
Yuan Ming emitted a burst of Undying Tree Demon Power, melding it into his body, rapidly healing Zheng Heng's shattered form.
Yuan Ming ignored him, placing his hand on the red-haired Black Demon's forehead, commencing a forced Soul Search.
Moments later, Yuan Ming slowly opened his eyes, his brow slightly furrowed.

chapters.title: Chapter 948 - 913: The Right Choice
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming didn't speak, and once again waved his hand. The All Living Beings Dream Seal flew over the heads of the three, blooming with a gentle glow, pulling them all into the illusion.
In reality, the three of them simultaneously flipped their eyes and fell into a deep sleep.
But in the dream realm, they only felt a sudden darkness before everything around them disappeared.
Before them was absolute silence and darkness, unable to hear any sound, not even the sound of their own breathing and heartbeat, and even when they opened their mouths to shout, there was no sound.
The only thing left was touch.
They could still feel themselves, which was the only evidence that they could confirm their existence.
Zheng Heng tried to activate his Divine Power to sense the other two, hoping to contact them through transmission, but his Divine Sense had long been sealed, yielding no results.
He felt as if he had been thrown into a completely void world, the only thing he could perceive being himself, the only thing he could touch being himself.
"Is this the trial?" After fruitless attempts, Zheng Heng abandoned the idea of searching for the other two.
He forced himself to remain calm, then sat cross-legged and began trying to cultivate to pass the time.
However, naturally there was no Spiritual Power in this void world, not even the Spiritual Power within his body could be felt; he was like a deaf and mute ordinary person.
The only two things they could do were to wander aimlessly and to think wildly.
Zheng Heng didn't want to wander aimlessly, but couldn't stop his chaotic thoughts. After a bout of random musings, he corrected and refocused his thoughts, starting to recall past cultivation techniques and cultivate through his consciousness.
Yan Jue and He Xiuwen went through a similar mental journey, eventually returning to reminiscing about the past and reviewing cultivation techniques.
"Isn't it just one day?"
"Reflecting on my past...carefully, even three days and three nights might not be enough..."
This was what they thought.
Yuan Ming looked at the three who had fallen into the illusion, a smile forming at the corner of his mouth.
From the beginning of this trial, he stood in an undefeated position, leaving no chance for Yan Jue and the other two to win.
This was simply because the dream space Yuan Ming constructed was an unsolvable dead end; the time flow within the illusion space differed completely from the outside world, and as long as he wished, he could indefinitely extend the time inside.
Even a momentary passage of time outside could equal several years within the illusion.
Initially, Yan Jue and the others weren't overly alarmed, as cultivators at the Returning to Void Stage, or even the Dharma manifestation Stage, were accustomed to maintaining their composure.
But as time trickled by, they gradually realized something was amiss.
When Yan Jue reflected on his experiences from birth till now, it was then he realized his life wasn't actually that long, and many memories from the past had faded away.
And the time he had calculated by silently counting had only amounted to a few hours.
Thus, he began to continue contemplating his cultivation techniques and secret techniques, though he couldn't cultivate, it helped to distract his mind, sparing him from constantly noticing the flow of time.
Zheng Heng and He Xiuwen were both slightly more composed, each similarly calculating time while silently contemplating their cultivation techniques.
He Xiuwen even imagined himself as a puppet, studying the abandoned "True Understanding of Heavenly Puppet", contemplating how he could deconstruct himself, not only avoiding boredom but finding inspiration, making considerable gains.
Zheng Heng, despite not having as many insights, also found enjoyment in it.
Such tranquility, where their entire focus remained on themselves, wasn't often available, and they'd slowly shifted their mentality, treating this as a grindstone for their own Dao Hearts.
However, as time continued to pass, their mental calculations had reached a terrifying number, and when they came to realization, they noticed that years had gone by.
The trio now understood that the time within the illusion space differed from the outside world, and their mental calculations were meaningless.
Still, they did not give up.
Among the three, Yan Jue, who had the lowest cultivation, didn't choose to abandon despite recognizing the anomaly.
He believed that no matter how formidable Wan Tianren was, he couldn't stop the flow of time, and as long as time continued to pass, they would eventually win.
Thus, the trio refrained from praying to the Nether Moon God Statue in their hearts, persisting onward.
However, the scale of time within the illusion still surpassed their imagination.
After spending over three hundred years in the illusion, the first to surrender was not Yan Jue, but He Xiuwen.
Not because he couldn't bear the passage of time, rather, through contemplation over this period, he had a breakthrough in his understanding of the "True Understanding of Heavenly Puppet", and many new ideas began to erupt.
It was precisely these new thoughts that tormented him mightily.
He couldn't wait to verify these ideas and attempt them, but trapped in the illusion, he couldn't do anything but contemplate again and again.
Thus, he was the first to visualize the Nether Moon God Statue in his heart, sincerely praying to it.
In the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space, Yuan Ming sensed a sudden surge of immense Desire Power, his gaze falling on He Xiuwen, a smile appearing on his face.
Raising his hand to wave it, he released He Xiuwen from the illusion, waking him up.
He Xiuwen's eyes fluttered open, and what he saw was still the lush bamboo forest, feeling the gentle breeze.
"I didn't expect you to be the first to wake up," Yuan Ming laughed.
"How long have I been in the illusion?" He Xiuwen frowned slightly, speaking.
Yuan Ming smiled without responding, holding up three fingers.
"Three hours?" He Xiuwen inquired.
"Thirty breaths," Yuan Ming shook his head and smiled.
Upon hearing this, He Xiuwen's pupils shrank suddenly, falling silent.
At this moment, Yuan Ming's smile widened again, and with a wave of his hand, he awakened Yan Jue and Zheng Heng.
"You two held out for nearly two hours longer than Fellow Daoist He." Yuan Ming said with a smile.
"You tricked us." Yan Jue's face turned unpleasant, with a hint of anger in his expression.
"I wouldn't dare. Just look at the hourglass." Yuan Ming gestured to the side.
The three looked over; indeed, only thirty breaths had passed on the hourglass, and the seals they placed within the hourglass showed no anomalies, confirming Yuan Ming hadn't tampered with anything.
Zheng Heng and the others turned pale and fell silent.
"I didn't lie to you; if you can continue to hold out, you won't need to pray to the Nether Moon God. Persist until the end, and I will keep my promise." Yuan Ming said with a serene expression.
"Fellow Daoist Wan is a soul cultivator of the Spoken Witch type; we should have anticipated such means. I am willing to submit, but could my storage magic tool be returned to me?" Zheng Heng sighed and asked.
"Of course, besides the Spirit Stones, I can return the magic treasure materials inside untouched to you." Yuan Ming nodded.
"Thank you." Zheng Heng bowed with folded fists.
"Fellow Daoist Wan, I can also do without my Spirit Stones, but the puppet materials inside are crucial to my future cultivation; could they be returned to me?" He Xiuwen hesitated slightly before speaking.
His implication naturally indicated submission.
"Sure. If you ever encounter issues with Soul Power, you can seek my help." Yuan Ming said.
He Xiuwen was overjoyed; he had decided to retrain in the "True Understanding of Heavenly Puppet", and as a Puppet Master, the requirements for Divine Soul were quite stringent. The strength of Soul Power directly affects the manipulation of puppets. To receive guidance in this aspect from a Spoken Witch is undoubtedly a tremendous opportunity.
With these two making their decisions, Yan Jue's emotions quickly calmed down.
"Fellow Daoist Yan Jue, what is your decision?" Yuan Ming asked with a slight smile, looking at Yan Jue.
"I..." Yan Jue still showed some resistance, hesitating without immediately giving an answer.
"Like the others, your storage magic tool can also be returned to you, and I can even support you with cultivation resources in the future." Yuan Ming said to Yan Jue, once more offering an olive branch.
"Alright." Yan Jue's eyes flickered, and he finally nodded.
"Good, you have all made the right choices. I trust that in the near future, you'll be grateful for your decisions today." Yuan Ming said with a smile.
Then, he returned their storage magic tools as promised.
"You must pray to the Nether Moon God at least once every day. The rest of the time, you can focus on your cultivation." Yuan Ming instructed.
The three nodded silently without speaking.
Yuan Ming stopped talking to them, as he valued them enough to go through this trouble; he then waved his hand to take them outside.
Wulu and Nan Shangfeng were originally sitting cross-legged, controlling their breath, and they jumped in shock upon seeing the three figures suddenly appear.
"No need to worry; they have already submitted to me and will not act against you anymore." Yuan Ming said, looking at Nan Shangfeng.
Upon hearing this, Nan Shangfeng's gaze fell on He Xiuwen, with a complex expression in his eyes.
"No need to look at me like that; there is always someone stronger, and beyond the sky is an even higher sky. Without enough strength, inheriting the position of Sect Master is meaningless. I no longer have the ambition to compete with you." He Xiuwen said calmly.
Yuan Ming waved his hand to open the Shura Palace, sending Yan Jue and the others inside, settling them in Yin Capital City.
He had long intended to subdue some Dharma manifestation stage believers and had set up a sixth-level array around Yin Capital City to accommodate these people, finally using it today.
"How did you do it?" Nan Shangfeng asked Yuan Ming in disbelief.
"I have my methods." Yuan Ming said casually.
"Thank you for this, Fellow Daoist Wan." Nan Shangfeng didn't press further, instead folding his fists in gratitude.
"Alright, no need for politeness. Continue your breathing control recovery; I have other matters to attend to." Yuan Ming waved his hand and said.
After speaking, he arrived at the center of the Fire Lake, at the site of the Earth Core Purifying Fire.
The Earth Core Purifying Fire remained calmly in place, unaffected by the previous battle.
Yuan Ming raised his arm and stretched forward.
His hand quickly transformed into the roots of the Undying Tree, stretching forward like living tendrils, piercing through the void directly into the white flames in the center of the lake.
As soon as the Undying Tree Roots pierced through, an indescribable scorching power accompanied by intense pain surged forth.
Even though the Earth Core Purifying Fire mainly manifests changes, it is nevertheless an earth fire, and the temperature is extremely high.
Yuan Ming's brow furrowed, his eyebrows twitching a few times as sweat beads streamed down his cheeks.
Feeling the Undying Tree Roots quickly shriveling and blackening under the high-temperature scorching, with signs of carbonization appearing at the tips, Yuan Ming immediately infused them with the Origin Power of the Undying Tree.
Nourished by the Origin Power, the blackened, shriveled Undying Tree Roots quickly revived, beginning to engage in a tug-of-war with the scorching Flame Power, repeatedly switching between carbonization and recovery.
Once Yuan Ming securely controlled the Earth Core Purifying Fire with the Undying Tree Roots, he immediately opened the Extreme Fire Realm of the Shura Palace.
At that place, Dian Xiaosan had been waiting for quite some time.
Previously, Yuan Ming transmitted a message to Dian Xiaosan, requesting him to set up a Gathering Spirit Formation to store Fire Attribute Spiritual Power. Dian Xiaosan did not know why, but upon seeing the large mass of white flames being moved, he finally understood.
"This... This is the Earth Core Purifying Fire, right?" Dian Xiaosan's gaze suddenly changed, exclaiming in surprise.
"How is the formation set up?" Yuan Ming asked.
"It's completed, but given the fire attribute spiritual power within the Extreme Fire Realm, it's hard to maintain balance; the Gathering Spirit Formation might not be able to keep the Earth Core Purifying Fire stable." Dian Xiaosan now understood what Yuan Ming intended to do and quickly expressed his concern.
Without much hesitation after hearing this, Yuan Ming sent the Earth Core Purifying Fire into the formation.

chapters.title: Chapter 949 - 914: Three Realms Immortal Boat
chapters.content:
In the next moment, the Gathering Spirit Formation suddenly lit up with a gleam, a surge of scorching force burst forth, and billowing heat waves spread and instantly swept over an area of dozens of miles.
The Fire Attribute Spirit Qi within the Extreme Fire Realm began to boil uncontrollably, and the surrounding temperature rose sharply.
The white flames, originally only a few meters in diameter, suddenly began to expand, doubling in an instant.
The Gathering Spirit Formation used for stabilization immediately became unstable, on the verge of collapsing.
Yuan Ming glanced and understood what was going on.
The Fire Attribute Spirit Qi within the Extreme Fire Realm was not as abundant as in the Spiritual Treasure Space, unable to maintain balance with the Earth Core Purifying Fire. The solution was simple, increase the Fire Attribute Spirit Qi within the Extreme Fire Realm.
"First, do your best to stabilize the formation, you only need to persist for a moment." Yuan Ming instructed, then immediately moved to a nearby low-lying area.
He raised his hand and grasped at the void, a giant black hand appeared out of thin air, grasping fiercely towards the ground.
Within a few breaths, a deep pit of dozens of miles was carved out of the Extreme Fire Realm.
Subsequently, Yuan Ming went to the Red Fire Lake, directly connecting the Extreme Fire Realm with the Fire Lake, establishing a mana-condensed channel between them.
Under his guidance, the lake water started to flow swiftly into the Extreme Fire Realm, filling the deep pit he had just excavated.
As the lake water gurgled in, the pit quickly filled up, and large quantities of lake water overflowed, eventually forming a lake of dozens of miles in the low-lying area.
And as this lake gradually formed, the temperature across the Extreme Fire Realm continued to rise, and the Fire Attribute Spiritual Power contained within this small realm also increased rapidly.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming withdrew the Gathering Spirit Formation, moving the Earth Core Purifying Fire over, placing it back at the center of the lake.
The white flames gently floated for a moment, showing no signs of collapsing, settling down peacefully.
Yuan Ming observed, feeling relieved, and turned his gaze to Dian Xiaosan.
"You should know what the Earth Core Purifying Fire is used for, right?" Yuan Ming asked.
"I have heard that within the Zhu Rong Sect, there is a cultivation Fire Pool, containing this very Earth Core Purifying Fire. The cultivators of the sect receive the purifying fire baptism in the Fire Pool to break through the bottleneck of the Zhu Rong Heart Technique, advancing to the Perfect Realm." Dian Xiaosan nodded.
"That's correct. I want you to undergo the purifying fire baptism to achieve a breakthrough." Yuan Ming nodded.
Yuan Ming's talent in Fire Control was quite average, so choosing to let Dian Xiaosan break through first while he learned through the Stealing Heaven Tripod was the most efficient approach.
Hearing this, Dian Xiaosan was initially excited but soon calmed down.
"The purifying fire baptism of the Zhu Rong Sect is not merely being engulfed in flames, nor is it achievable only with the Zhu Rong Heart Technique. They also have special secret techniques for assistance. Without this secret, using the Earth Core Purifying Fire for baptism is akin to seeking death." Dian Xiaosan shook his head and smiled bitterly.
"Isn't it just the secret technique for the baptism? I can tell you that." Yuan Ming smiled.
Dian Xiaosan was startled at first, then seemed to realize something, looking at Yuan Ming in disbelief.
If the Zhu Rong Heart Technique was already a closely guarded secret of the Zhu Rong Sect, then the secret technique used to break through the bottleneck of the Zhu Rong Heart Technique was even more central to their core secrets.
Is it really something that can just be obtained so easily?
Dian Xiaosan thought of this and calmed down again, filled with doubt in his heart.
"When breaking through the Zhu Rong Heart Technique, you need to first prepare a Heart Fire Inheritance Array, and then..." Yuan Ming didn't pay attention, carefully describing the breakthrough process he saw in Yan Jue's memories to Dian Xiaosan.
The more he listened, the more alarmed he became, his expression turning from initial doubt to seriousness, then shock, and finally to sheer joy.
"According to this method, it might actually be possible," Dian Xiaosan muttered to himself after a long time of coming to his senses.
"The secret technique I taught you, you should carefully comprehend it. To maintain the existence of the Earth Core Purifying Fire requires a lot of Fire Attribute Spirit Qi, and although this lake can sustain it for a time, it is not a long-term solution, so you need to start breaking through quickly." Yuan Ming glanced at the lake water and said.
When he completes his own breakthrough, Yuan Ming himself might also need to use the Earth Core Purifying Fire for breakthrough, so time was of the essence.
"I understand." Dian Xiaosan immediately nodded.
With that, he closed his eyes, meticulously reviewing the information on the baptism Yuan Ming had given him, carefully analyzing every detail of the secret technique.
A moment later, Dian Xiaosan opened his eyes again and said, "I can start attempting now."
Hearing this, Yuan Ming was overjoyed, immediately taking out various Magic Artifacts for arraying, arranging them around the lake. Soon, a Heart Fire Inheritance Array was set up.
"You can begin." Yuan Ming said.
"The time needed for a breakthrough is hard to estimate. If it takes too long, can the Earth Core Purifying Fire be maintained?" Dian Xiaosan raised his concern after some deliberation.
After analyzing the baptism breakthrough process in detail, this was his only worry.
"You can rest assured about this, I will search for more treasures containing Fire Attribute Spiritual Power in the Secret Realm later, continuously feeding them into the lake to ensure a constant supply of Spiritual Power, preventing failure due to insufficient Spiritual Power." Yuan Ming promised.
Dian Xiaosan heard this and hesitated no further.
He formed seals with his hands, performing the secret Zhu Rong Sect's Burning Body Technique, enveloping himself in his own flames. Using the Heart Fire Inheritance Array as a guide, he activated the Zhu Rong Heart Technique, and leaped into the white flames at the center of the lake.
The Earth Core Purifying Fire surged and closed in from all directions, wrapping him in its center.
At this moment, Dian Xiaosan was like the wick of a flame in an oil lamp, engulfed by fire yet unharmed, completing his purification under the burn of the Earth Core Purifying Fire.
Yuan Ming watched for a while; seeing him calm and unscathed, he then left the Shura Palace and came outside.
At this moment, Wulu and Nan Shangfeng had also finished their Breathing Control, waiting for a long time.
Yuan Ming and Nan Shangfeng discussed a few words and decided that Nan Shangfeng would travel together with Yuan Ming and Wulu.
The three promptly set off, continuing their journey, and soon flew out of the Fire Lake range.
But just then, a golden light rapidly descended from the high sky in the distance, the tunneling light receding to reveal a delicate figure landing gracefully in front of them.
Upon seeing the visitor's appearance, Yuan Ming and the others showed expressions of surprise.
The visitor was a sixteen or seventeen-year-old girl, astoundingly beautiful—wasn't it Wu Yu?
But looking at the person before him, Yuan Ming couldn't help but frown.
This girl, whom the Great Demon Kings of the Ten Thousand Demon Country all obeyed, appeared before them—what could be the reason?
Externally, her attire was as before, still that dignified and luxurious golden robe, but the aura emanating from her now seemed much weaker than before.
Yuan Ming noticed her cultivation had returned to the Returning to Void Peak, as if reminiscent of their first meeting at Black Tiger City.
"Fellow Daoist Wan, I've come over this time..." Wu Yu began, but was interrupted by Yuan Ming.
"You're not the main body, are you?" Yuan Ming asked.
Upon hearing this, Nan Shangfeng couldn't help but show a look of surprise, scrutinizing Wu Yu carefully.
"That's right, I am just a clone; the main body is elsewhere." Wu Yu paused slightly and calmly admitted.
Yuan Ming nodded and gestured for her to continue.
"I've come to see you this time to ask you to fulfill the promise you made back in the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range," Wu Yu continued.
Yuan Ming naturally remembered this; he had promised to help her if he could as gratitude for Wu Yu's kindness back then. He hadn't expected her to ask him to fulfill it now.
"Fellow Daoist Wu Yu, you are quite the strategist. You've been setting me up since our first meeting at Black Tiger City. Did you anticipate the current situation back then?" he said calmly.
"Back at Black Tiger City, due to certain reasons, I had to hide my identity, and I hope Fellow Daoist Wan won't mind," Wu Yu said, bowing solemnly to Yuan Ming.
Seeing this, a trace of surprise flashed in Yuan Ming's eyes.
Wu Yu was the Empress of the Ten Thousand Demon Country, and although the one in front of him was just a clone, she actually bowed to him? Could he really wield such influence?
"Fellow Daoist Wu Yu, you're overdoing it. We are old acquaintances, and if we set aside our Human and Demon Clan positions, we're friends. However, I'm just an ordinary loose cultivator, with limited abilities and not much I can do to help you." He chuckled, speaking vaguely.
"Fellow Daoist Wan, you have already broken through to the Dharma manifestation Stage, with exceptional strength, and will undoubtedly become famous in the Chuyun Realm. Why undervalue yourself?" Wu Yu said with a smile, tidying her sideburns.
"Fellow Daoist Wu Yu, flattery is unnecessary. Since I made the promise, I won't renege on it. Just tell me what you want me to do. As long as it doesn't involve siding with the Ten Thousand Demon Country against my clan, I will give it serious consideration." Yuan Ming dusted his sleeve and asked directly.
With Dian Xiaosan's casting, the Spiritual Power within the Extreme Fire Realm's Fire Lake was being continuously consumed, and he needed to quickly find Fire Attribute spiritual materials to replenish it. He had no time to chat idly with Wu Yu.
"Rest assured, Fellow Daoist Wan; I have no intention for you to betray the Human Clan. I only ask that you ensure not to attack the demons of the Ten Thousand Demon Country while in this Spiritual Treasure Space," Wu Yu smiled and said.
"If that's all, it's no problem. However, the premise is that the demons of the Ten Thousand Demon Country also cannot attack me. Otherwise, I will choose to retaliate," Yuan Ming said in astonishment, pondering slightly before speaking.
"Of course," Wu Yu relaxed, smiling.
"If that's the case, then let's leave it at that. We still have treasure hunting to do, so we'll take our leave." Yuan Ming said, flying ahead.
"Fellow Daoist Wan, please wait; I have something else to tell you," Wu Yu suddenly called after Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming stopped in his tracks, looking over suspiciously.
"Actually, the Ten Thousand Demon Country has discovered some clues about this Space Spiritual Treasure we are in. As a thank you for not attacking the cultivators of the Ten Thousand Demon Country, I am willing to share this information with you," Wu Yu spoke on her own.
"Please, Fellow Daoist, do tell," Yuan Ming slightly furrowed his brow, replying.
"The origins of this Space Spiritual Treasure may very well be the legendary Three Realms Immortal Boat," Wu Yu said.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming froze slightly; it was the first time he had heard this name, and a sense of perplexity filled his heart.

chapters.title: Chapter 950 - 915: Boarding Order
chapters.content:
"What did you say, the Three Realms Immortal Boat?" Nan Shangfeng's face changed as he exclaimed.
"What is the Three Realms Immortal Boat, and why are you reacting like this?" Wulu asked, evidently unfamiliar with the name.
"The Three Realms Immortal Boat is a supreme treasure created by the Three Realms Sect, who poured immense effort into its making. It is said to be capable of penetrating space barriers and navigating through void turbulence. In critical moments, it can also serve as a vital treasure for the continuation of the sect," Nan Shangfeng explained.
"It seems Fellow Daoist Nan doesn't know much about the Three Realms Immortal Boat. The Three Realms Sect created this Immortal Boat not to sustain their sect. The sect, long ago, was not the evil sect it is now. The earliest disciples were a group of adventurers keen on exploring the unknown. They wanted to leave the Chuyun Realm and explore endless realms until they reached the world's end. That's why they decided to build the Three Realms Flying Boat. Unfortunately, not many remember this original intention," Wu Yu said, his tone tinged with regret.
Yuan Ming heard these words for the first time, and a wave of emotion stirred in his heart.
His resolve to leave the Yunhuang Continent was driven by a belief similar to that of the early disciples of the Three Realms Sect.
"I see. The Three Realms Immortal Boat is an unimaginably valuable treasure. But how did it end up here?" Wulu asked, puzzled.
"I don't know. The Three Realms Immortal Boat was once famous, but it mysteriously disappeared later and gradually faded from memory, eventually vanishing in the river of time. As for where it went, no one knows. I didn't expect to find it here," Nan Shangfeng said excitedly, looking around.
"Fellow Daoist Wu Yu, you specifically tell us of this matter. Could it be that the appearance of the Heavenly Fire is related to the Three Realms Sect?" Yuan Ming finally asked upon hearing this.
"Whether the appearance of the Heavenly Fire is related to the Three Realms Sect, I do not know. But since the Three Realms Immortal Boat has appeared, there is no way the people of the Three Realms Sect will remain indifferent. Perhaps they have already infiltrated here," Wu Yu said slowly.
"If this Space Spiritual Treasure is truly the Three Realms Immortal Boat, then they will certainly come to reclaim it, and we would all be trapped here, wouldn't we?" Wulu's expression slightly changed as he spoke.
Nan Shangfeng also looked worried.
"The Three Realms Immortal Boat has been lost for many years and is already ownerless. Even if the Three Realms Sect wants to regain it, it won't be easy. According to what we currently know, to seize control of the Three Realms Immortal Boat requires collecting ten Boarding Orders. These ten Boarding Orders are within this space, and whoever collects them first can claim this Space Supreme Treasure," Wu Yu continued.
After speaking, her gaze fell on Yuan Ming.
"Fellow Daoist Wu Yu, informing me of this matter is probably not just a simple thank you, right? What other hidden reasons are there? Can you explain them one by one?" Yuan Ming frowned and asked as he saw her looking at him.
"Nothing else, it's just that I cast a hexagram earlier and calculated that you have a special fate with the Three Realms Immortal Boat. Instead of trying to fight for the Heavenly Fire with us, the Ten Thousand Demon Country, Sima Changqin, and others, why not attempt to seize the Three Realms Immortal Boat?" Wu Yu smiled and said.
After saying this, she no longer lingered, turned, and transformed into a long rainbow, disappearing into the horizon in the blink of an eye.
Yuan Ming watched Wu Yu's figure disappear, his eyes blank, unsure what he was considering.
He suddenly remembered something and flipped his wrist.
In his palm, a flash of silver appeared, revealing a palm-sized Silver Token, the token capable of opening a space barrier.
"Brother Wan, what is this?" Nan Shangfeng asked curiously upon seeing it.
Yuan Ming did not hurry to answer but stared intently at the token in his hand, carefully observing it.
Upon closer look, he noticed that the silver light emanating from the Silver Token was more intense than usual, with a faint, starlight-like silver gleam, making it appear quite extraordinary.
"Could this be the Boarding Order Wu Yu mentioned?" Wulu, familiar with Yuan Ming, immediately guessed his intention in taking out the token.
"Yes. When I entered this space, I already felt this object subtly react. I didn't understand why at first, but after Wu Yu spoke, I immediately thought of it," Yuan Ming nodded and said.
"No wonder she said you have a destiny with the Three Realms Immortal Boat. It seems it wasn't just idle talk. You should quickly cast a spell to activate it and see," Nan Shangfeng said excitedly.
With a thought, Yuan Ming activated his Primordial True Skill and transferred a surge of mana into the token.
Suddenly, the Silver Token emitted a bright light, uncontrollably spinning in his palm. The end with the point turned in a direction, then stopped, gently vibrating.
It seemed to be urging him to head in that direction.
"Ha, it really is. Brother Wan, you are indeed a person of great fortune," Nan Shangfeng said with great envy.
Yuan Ming looked at the token, remained silent for a moment, then put it away with a wave.
"Let's go, we'll continue on our way." He did not look in the direction the token pointed and continued forward.
"Brother Wan, aren't you going to try? The Great Sun Glaze Flame is precious, but compared to the Three Realms Immortal Boat, it is still much less," Nan Shangfeng chased up, puzzled.
"There are ten Boarding Orders for the Three Realms Immortal Boat. Even if the one in my hand is one of them, it will still not be easy to gather all of them. Searching for them, we may not necessarily succeed," Yuan Ming shook his head and said.
"But didn't Wu Yu say that you have a destiny with the Three Realms Immortal Boat? If you search for it, your chances of success should be the highest, right? If you could control the Three Realms Immortal Boat before others find the Heavenly Fire, wouldn't the Heavenly Fire also belong to you?" Nan Shangfeng said somewhat anxiously.
"The problem lies here. The difficulty of finding the Heavenly Fire is evidently far lower than controlling the Three Realms Immortal Boat. Also, since I have already secured one Boarding Order, others cannot take control of the Three Realms Immortal Boat before me," Yuan Ming said leisurely.
"I see, no need to rush then," Nan Shangfeng nodded, suddenly realizing.
"The main thing is, Wulu's appearance this time is rather mysterious," Yuan Ming continued.
"What do you mean?" Nan Shangfeng seemed a bit confused.
"I don't have direct evidence, just a feeling," Yuan Ming shook his head and said.
"I also feel that her arrival is suspicious, as if she was specifically waiting for us here," Wulu remarked, stroking his chin.
"Are you saying Wulu's visit to remind you of your promise was just a ruse, and her real purpose was to inform you about the Three Realms Immortal Boat?" Nan Shangfeng furrowed his brows and said.
"Something like that. No matter what, her intentions are not simple, as if she deliberately led me onto the path of collecting the Boarding Orders," Yuan Ming said, frowning.
"Hearing you say that, we indeed should be cautious, but giving up on the Three Realms Immortal Boat is truly a pity," Nan Shangfeng sighed.
Yuan Ming hesitated slightly, summoned the Shura Palace, and called out Yan Jue.
"Fellow Daoist Wan, calling me out, shouldn't be to release me, right?" Yan Jue looked around and, after being momentarily stunned, asked.
"There's something I need you to do," Yuan Ming said.
"You trust me to do it?" Yan Jue was greatly surprised and said.
"I don't, so I'm going to trouble you to sleep for a while," Yuan Ming grinned and said.
As he spoke, a stream of Divine Soul Power emanated from him, instantly activating the Soul Descent Rune within Yan Jue's body.
Yan Jue was about to speak when his pupils suddenly dilated, and then he returned to normal.
Yan Jue's eyes remained bright, but they appeared slightly vacant. The entire person was already under Yuan Ming's control.
However, relying solely on the Soul Descent Rune was not secure enough, so Yuan Ming's first soul emerged and entered Yan Jue's Sea of Consciousness to assist the Soul Descent Rune in controlling this body.
"Brother Wan, what are you doing?" Nan Shangfeng asked.
"Didn't you say giving up on investigating the Three Realms Flying Boat was a pity? I think so too, so I'm letting Yan Jue go ahead to scout the situation first," Yuan Ming said with a smile.
He didn't choose the more obedient Zheng Heng or He Xiuwen because Yan Jue's cultivation of the "Heavenly Fire Scripture" gave him a more pronounced advantage in this area.
Subsequently, Yuan Ming handed the Silver Token to Yan Jue, instructing him to search in the direction indicated by the token.
Yuan Ming and his party of three continued their journey, following the flow of the underground fire veins to find the Heavenly Fire.
Behind the expanse of undulating, crimson mountain peaks, Jin Chen was sitting cross-legged with closed eyes, practicing Breathing Control.
Beside him stood three Returning to Void Stage Cultivators, who were intently guarding, with their gazes scanning the surroundings.
On a distant mountain ridge, an enormously large black Dharma manifestation was shrinking at a speed visible to the naked eye until it disappeared altogether.
A moment later, a figure dragged a One-Horned Demon Clan being, whose size was larger by a circle, towards this location.
"Uncle Gu, you've worked hard," Jin Chen opened his eyes, stood up, and said.
Gu Chuanting nodded and tossed the Level 5 Demon Race of the One-Horned Demon Clan at Jin Chen's feet.
The One-Horned Demon Clan had already been beaten half to death, with a sunken chest, breathing heavily, and eyes full of fear.
"If I remember correctly, you're one of the demon clans following Wulu. Why have you separated from the group and secretly trailed us?" Jin Chen asked coldly.
"I haven't been following you guys, cough..." The One-Horned Demon Clan hadn't finished speaking when its chest was heavily stomped on.
"You've been tailing us for half an hour and still dare to deny it! I have no patience for lies. If there's any more falsehood, I'll destroy you, body and soul! Speak now, what exactly are you following us for?" Jin Chen said impatiently and coldly.
"I truly haven't been following you. I was ordered by Her Majesty the Empress to search for the Boarding Order, and our paths just happened to be the same," the One-Horned Demon Clan's eyes showed fear and said urgently.
"Boarding Order? Not the Heavenly Fire?" Jin Chen raised an eyebrow and asked.
"It is the Boarding Order. Lord Wulu said that as long as we find all the Boarding Orders, no matter in whose hands the Heavenly Fire ends up, it will ultimately be ours," the One-Horned Demon Clan said hurriedly, fearing Jin Chen might not believe him.
"What's this Boarding Order?" Jin Chen frowned.
The demon beast was taken aback by Jin Chen's ignorance of the Boarding Order, but then it explained in detail that this space was the Three Realms Immortal Boat, and whoever collected all the Boarding Orders scattered throughout the space would control the Three Realms Immortal Boat.

chapters.title: Chapter 951 - 916: Luring Away Three Forces
chapters.content:
"Uncle Gu, have you ever heard of the Three Realms Immortal Boat and the Boarding Order?" Jin Chen asked, looking at Gu Chuanting with some skepticism.
Gu Chuanting nodded and said, "I've heard of it. It's said that the so-called Three Realms Flying Boat is an unrivaled Space Spiritual Treasure with Great Divine Power capable of piercing the void. Back in the day, when the Three Realms Sect was at its peak, they used this Three Realms Immortal Boat to break into several sealed Space Secret Realms, seizing a large number of treasures. It was quite famous on the Central Continent. Later, when the Three Realms Sect declined, even the City Lord spoke of the Three Realms Immortal Boat, expressing much regret over its loss."
Upon hearing this, Jin Chen didn't speak for a while. His gaze flickered, as though lost in thought.
Seeing this, Gu Chuanting turned to the Demon Clan and asked a few questions. The One-Horned Demon Clan, having already conceded, was naturally forthcoming with answers.
Seeing that everything he wanted to ask had been answered, there was no further use for the demon. Gu Chuanting's eyes took on a fierce glint, as he intended to exterminate it.
"Don't...don't kill me, don't kill me. I know the location of a Boarding Order. I can take you there." The One-Horned Demon Clan sensed the ominous atmosphere and quickly kowtowed repeatedly, begging for mercy.
Gu Chuanting hesitated for a moment and looked at Jin Chen.
"Uncle Gu, let him stay for now. Let him take us to find that Boarding Order. If it turns out to be fake, it's not too late to kill him then," Jin Chen said slowly.
"Won't this delay our search for the Heavenly Fire?" Gu Chuanting frowned.
"It won't. Right now, we have no clues about the Heavenly Fire anyway, so wherever we look, it's still searching. If that Boarding Order is real, once we obtain it, we can then decide whether to continue searching for the Heavenly Fire or collect the Boarding Orders. It's still timely," Jin Chen replied.
"That works too." Gu Chuanting nodded.
...
In another area filled with bizarre stone formations on a desert wasteland.
Master Tantai of the Daluo Sect sat cross-legged beneath a severely wind-eroded rock wall, facing a giant, black-skinned man with a build like an iron tower.
This black-skinned giant was none other than the Black Bear King, one of the Demon Clan's Demon Kings.
At this moment, rather than dueling with magic, the two appeared as old acquaintances, casually chatting back and forth.
Yang Fan and Gan Wenqing were not nearby, perhaps sent off on some errands.
"Alright, enough small talk, let's get to the point. I'm a bit puzzled as to why you would inform me about the Three Realms Immortal Boat and the Boarding Orders?" Master Tantai's eyes were filled with confusion as he asked.
"To be frank, there are mainly two reasons: we are old acquaintances, and I don't wish for us to confront each other in life or death, with both sides heavily wounded, which is meaningless. If you decide to seek the Boarding Orders instead, it's likely we won't conflict over the Heavenly Fire anymore. Besides, if you go collecting the Boarding Orders, our Ten Thousand Demon Country will have one less competitor." The Black Bear King extended one hand, showing two fingers, and spoke candidly.
"Heh, you do have a very open strategy..." Master Tantai chuckled.
"In any case, the location of the Boarding Order I know of has been told to you. Whether or not to search for it is up to you. That's all I have to say. I have other matters, so I'll take my leave first." The Black Bear King clasped his fists in salute, stood up at once, and turned to leave.
Master Tantai continued to sit upright, watching the direction the Black Bear King left for a long time before suddenly standing up with a slight smile.
However, he did not head towards the pointed location but continued along his original path, moving forward.
...
On a riverbank desert in an unknown area, the dust on the ground gradually dispersed, revealing a huge pit over ten zhang in size.
At the bottom of the pit lay a somewhat dilapidated demon beast carcass, measuring five or six zhang. Judging by the remaining aura, it appeared to be a Level 5 Demon Beast that had just died. Its large, murky eyes stared into the sky, gradually losing their luster.
Long Hou stood beside the demon beast, his foot on its head, and his hand pressed upon its head, conducting a Soul Search while its Divine Soul had yet to dissipate.
After a moment, he withdrew his hand, his eyes flashing with delight.
"Let's go, we'll head over there." He spun around, recognized the direction, and waved his hand.
"Why change direction?" Long Yinkong asked in surprise.
"There's something more important than the Heavenly Fire, no wonder those folks from the Ten Thousand Demon Country were willing to negotiate with us. It turns out they plan to find the Boarding Orders. Heh, if we can gather them first, forget about the Heavenly Fire, everything in this space will be ours." Long Hou's eyes showed excitement as he spoke.
Long Yinkong and Long Yuhuan listened in confusion and were about to ask more when they saw Long Hou already moving, Flying Escape in the decided direction, leaving them to catch up hurriedly.
...
Meanwhile, on a desolate desert wasteland about ten miles away from Long Hou and the others, Sima Changqin stood still. In front of him was an ancient stele half the height of a person.
The stele was inscribed with ancient characters from the Central Continent, detailing the Three Realms Immortal Boat and the Boarding Orders.
He only glanced at it briefly, a faint mocking smile tugging at the corners of his mouth, showing no intention of paying it any heed.
...
Elsewhere, Wang Fulong and two golden-robed Returning to Void Cultivators under his command were racing in one direction, speed fastened by tunneling light.
Leading the group, Wang Fulong was at the forefront, his face filled with barely concealed excitement as he continuously formed seals with one hand to accelerate the tunneling light.
A golden-robed cultivator within the team discreetly transmitted his voice to Wang Fulong, "Sect Master, the lord's message indicated that Wan Tianren is also within this Space Spiritual Treasure, and we're to go and assassinate him. Ignoring this responsibility outright—is it really alright? If that lord holds us accountable, Sunset Sect can't afford such consequences."
"Speaking of which, our Sunset Sect indeed rose to power upon the support of that esteemed one. But relying on others is not a long-term plan, as they say, 'Fortune lies in danger.' If we successfully seize the Three Realms Immortal Boat this time, we won't need to look at that person's expression ever again. Sunset Sect will truly be able to root itself firmly. This risk is worth taking." Wang Fulong said solemnly.
After speaking, the excitement on his face became increasingly hard to suppress.
This trip to the Fire Rock Desert truly is a heaven-sent opportunity, holding unexpected joy!
The two golden-robed cultivators seeing this, no longer tried to persuade.
...
On the summit of a certain crimson mountain peak, Golden Robed Wu Yu stood calmly facing the wind, his gaze fixed ahead.
A moment later, a silver light shot from afar, landing behind him, it was Xuan Ye.
"How many groups went over?" Wu Yu did not turn back, asked.
"Three groups, respectively White Emperor City, Heavenly Dragon Hall, Sunset Sect." Xuan Ye replied.
"He really didn't take the bait." Wu Yu said quietly after a moment of silence.
"Him? Her Majesty the Empress meant Sima Changqin?" Xuan Ye asked.
Wu Yu shook his head, not answering Xuan Ye's question. He said, "To draw away three paths is already a considerable achievement, let's proceed as planned."
A long rainbow wrapped the two, flying towards the distance.
...
Meanwhile.
Yuan Ming and his companions were advancing along the underground spirit vein's flow.
The further they went, the more abundant the power of the spirit vein felt. Along the way, they encountered increasingly numerous fire attribute heavenly materials and earthly treasures.
Yuan Ming naturally didn't let any slip, collecting them all and throwing them into the Fire Lake.
As a result, the fire attribute spiritual power within the Fire Lake became increasingly dense, the Earth Core Purifying Fire grew slightly stronger than before.
In the Fire Lake, Dian Xiaosan was surrounded by Earth Core Purifying Fire thicker than before, his skin a fiery red, looking like a fire robe was forming around him.
Yuan Ming nodded slightly, just about to withdraw his divine sense, his action suddenly paused, looking towards Dian Xiaosan's forehead.
Amidst the speckled flickering flames, a strange red pattern appeared on Dian Xiaosan's forehead, akin to flames, slowly spreading downward.
"Dian Xiaosan truly lives up to being a sixth-level alchemist, his talent in the Zhu Rong Heart Technique is indeed astounding, so quickly forming the Zhu Rong Fire Pattern." Yuan Ming felt a burst of joy in his heart, musing silently.
The Zhu Rong Fire Pattern only appears when the Zhu Rong Heart Technique reaches perfection; when this fire pattern covers the entire body, it signifies the technique has reached perfection.
He originally thought Dian Xiaosan would need some time to immerse himself in careful ponderance and refinement before achieving success, unexpectedly the actual progress was so rapid.
Yuan Ming then discovered another situation; possibly due to Dian Xiaosan's imminent breakthrough, the demand for fire attribute spiritual power drastically increased, leading to an accelerated depletion rate of spiritual power in the Fire Lake, and a rapid decline in fire attribute spiritual power within.
"This won't do at all!" He immediately withdrew his divine sense, speeding up his advance, fully collecting every fire attribute spiritual material encountered along the way.
Wulu and Nan Shangfeng, upon seeing this, also extended a helping hand, handing all collected spiritual materials to Yuan Ming, reluctantly sufficing Dian Xiaosan's consumption.
"Fellow Daoist Wan, look ahead!" On a lava land covered with flowing fire, Nan Shangfeng pointed forward, addressing Yuan Ming beside him.
Yuan Ming looked up, only to see a tall red spirit grass growing by a broad lava river ahead.
This grass resembled a Fire Phoenix, with a flame-shaped spiritual flower atop, radiating a dazzling red glow, remote as it was, the astonishing heat could be felt, even with his current cultivation, it felt somewhat unbearable.
"This is the Red Flame Zhu Li Flower!" Yuan Ming revealed a look of joyous surprise.
The Red Flame Zhu Li Flower is a level 6 spiritual grass, quite similar to the Earth Core Fire Lotus he had encountered before; both absorb the scorching fire power from lava for growth, containing exceedingly rich fire spiritual power, casting it into the Fire Lake would surely be effective.
Yuan Ming did not move forward immediately but sent out his divine sense to sweep around the Red Flame Zhu Li Flower, confirming there were no signs of fire beasts lurking, before he leapt over, waving his hand and plucking it.
The root system of the Red Flame Zhu Li Flower was quite long, and when uprooted, it brought out four or five deep red stones.
On the riverbed of the lava river, similar stones lay scattered.
"These are... Red Essence Stones?" Yuan Ming's eyes lit up.
Red Essence Stone is a type of fire attribute ore, not as valuable as the Red Flame Zhu Li Flower, yet still classified as a level 5 spiritual material.
Yuan Ming felt a surge of joy in his heart; luck was truly on his side, with the Red Flame Zhu Li Flower and so many Red Essence Stones, it was sufficient to support Dian Xiaosan's breakthrough.

chapters.title: Chapter 952 - 917: Striding Forward Alone
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming immediately opened the Shura Palace, throwing the Red Flame Zhu Li Flower into the Fire Lake of the Extreme Fire Realm.
With a soft "boom," the Red Flame Zhu Li Flower began to burn, an incredibly pure Fire Spiritual Power surged forth, merging into Dian Xiaosan's body.
The Zhu Rong Fire Pattern had almost spread throughout Dian Xiaosan's entire body, he remained seated with eyes closed, but the aura around him was no longer calm. The Earth Core Purifying Fire enveloping him seemed stimulated, sometimes rising, sometimes falling, clearly at the most critical moment.
Yuan Ming reached out and grabbed, capturing nearly a hundred Red Essence Stones from the riverbed and throwing them into the Fire Lake.
The Fire Spiritual Power in the Fire Lake surged, causing Dian Xiaosan's aura to fluctuate even more. The concentrated Spiritual Power was evidently beneficial for his breakthrough.
"You two have worked hard, take a break here while I handle some affairs." Yuan Ming said to Wulu and the other, and then flickered into the quiet room in the Shura Palace.
He took out the Stealing Heaven Tripod and possessed Dian Xiaosan.
...
Fifteen minutes later, in the center of the Fire Lake of the Extreme Fire Realm.
Dian Xiaosan suddenly opened his eyes, large areas of crimson flames gushed from his body, swirling and intertwining above his head.
At this moment, the Zhu Rong Fire Pattern on his body seemed to come to life, converging towards the Dantian, finally condensing into a complex red Dao Seal.
Dian Xiaosan raised his eyebrows, the Earth Core Purifying Fire surrounding him suddenly exploded, transforming into hundreds of white fireballs the size of fists, slowly rotating above the Fire Lake around Dian Xiaosan.
He raised a hand in a gesture, and all the fireballs flew back, reconverging into a large mass of Earth Core Purifying Fire, its shape and size identical to before, without any loss.
The fiercely scorching Earth Core Purifying Fire, at this moment in Dian Xiaosan's hands, was as tame as a house cat.
He abruptly stood up, his hands moved slightly.
The Earth Core Purifying Fire changed again, condensing into a white Fire Lion, wandering through the void, its fur bristled, issuing roaring sounds, looking much like any ordinary lion.
"Transform!" Dian Xiaosan shouted in a low voice.
The white Fire Lion rolled in place, transforming into a white spirit ape, scratching its back and rubbing its head, chattering noisily.
Dian Xiaosan's mouth instantly revealed a hint of an excited smile, having broken through Zhu Rong Heart Technique to Great Perfection, after condensing a Dao Seal, his fire control ability had reached an astonishing level.
The increase in fire control ability greatly aided alchemy, Dian Xiaosan even felt he could attempt to refine a seventh-grade elixir.
He did not continue to attempt further, placing the Earth Core Purifying Fire back into the Fire Lake, and took out a Jade Scroll, summarizing his insights from the breakthrough.
"Congratulations to Master Dian on breaking through Zhu Rong Heart Technique to Great Perfection Realm, Master's fire control talent is indeed extraordinary, I was not mistaken." The void nearby fluctuated, and Yuan Ming suddenly appeared above the Fire Lake, smiling and cupping his hands at Dian Xiaosan.
"This is also thanks to Fellow Daoist Yuan for maintaining the Fire Lake, allowing me to breakthrough. The gratitude I owe Fellow Daoist I truly have no way to repay, in future times of need, I will do my utmost!" Dian Xiaosan quickly emerged from the Earth Core Purifying Fire, flying up high, sincerely speaking.
"Haha, then I won't be polite, I'll seek your help when needed in the future. But Master Dian, having just broken through, should be tired, go rest first, we'll talk about future matters later." Yuan Ming laughed.
"Alright, by the way, Fellow Daoist Yuan, this is the breakthrough insights I've just written down, it may be useful to you." Dian Xiaosan handed the newly completed Jade Scroll.
"Many thanks to Master Dian, I will definitely study it thoroughly." Yuan Ming nodded and accepted the Jade Scroll.
Then, he activated the teleportation divine ability of the Shura Stone Tablet, sending Dian Xiaosan back to his residence, while himself stood over the Fire Lake, reading the Jade Scroll's content twice before storing it away.
Immediately afterward, Yuan Ming descended from the sky, landing in the Earth Core Purifying Fire, accepting the fire's baptism like Dian Xiaosan did.
Time passed rapidly, a day and night soon elapsed.
Yuan Ming's body was also covered with Zhu Rong Fire Patterns, suddenly opening his eyes, surging his whole body's Mana.
The Zhu Rong Fire Patterns on his body also gathered towards the Dantian, soon condensing into a Dao Seal representing the Zhu Rong Heart Technique.
Yuan Ming showed an expression of astonishment; he had just possessed Dian Xiaosan, experienced the complete process of the other's breakthrough, but the realization was not profound.
It was only now, having personally undergone an Earth Core Purifying Fire baptism, unexpectedly breaking through to the fifth layer Great Perfection of the Zhu Rong Heart Technique, also condensing a Dao Seal.
Yuan Ming was initially confused but soon understood.
The Zhu Rong Heart Technique is a Fire Control Technique, heavily reliant on talent and comprehension, and the required Earth Core Purifying Fire baptism for breakthrough doesn't truly mean to temper the physical body or Mana with fire, but rather to use this fire to comprehend the ineffable true intent of fire control.
Yuan Ming's possession through the Stealing Heaven Tripod effectively directly apprehended the answer, thus didn't need to further undergo the Earth Core Purifying Fire refinement to break through to the fifth layer Great Perfection Realm of the Zhu Rong Heart Technique.
The breakthrough insights given by Dian Xiaosan were really just focused on elucidating how to comprehend the true intent of fire control, for Yuan Ming now, were not very useful.
He took a deep breath, controlled the Earth Core Purifying Fire at the scene, experiencing the power after the breakthrough of the Zhu Rong Heart Technique, a satisfied smile quickly appeared on his face.
Yuan Ming fiddled with the Earth Core Purifying Fire, feeling increasingly joyful.
With his current level of fire control, only needing to study alchemy for a while longer, refining sixth-grade elixirs was no longer a difficult task.
Yuan Ming was contemplating his future plans. He casually placed the Earth Core Purifying Fire back into the Fire Lake and turned to leave, but suddenly felt a bit reluctant.
The fire attribute spirit qi in the Fire Lake was abundant, and it should be able to sustain the Earth Core Purifying Fire for a while. If more fire attribute heavenly materials and earthly treasures were added over time, this duration could be extended. It felt like a waste to just leave it, which pained him somewhat.
Yuan Ming thought for a moment, then suddenly turned around and went to other places in the Shura Palace to call over Ye Wuya and the others who were cultivating Eyes of Golden Flame.
"This fire is called Earth Core Purifying Fire, extremely precious, and cannot be preserved for long. You can try cultivating Eyes of Golden Flame with it, but don't be greedy for progress and risk harming your foundation," Yuan Ming instructed.
Ye Wuya and the others had all heard of the Earth Core Purifying Fire's fame and were extremely excited. They quickly responded and immediately began absorbing the fire to cultivate.
Yuan Ming nodded in satisfaction and turned to leave the Shura Palace, continuing forward with Wulu and two others.
...
Four days later.
The three of Yuan Ming arrived at a vast Red Mountain Range, where the entire range seemed ablaze, resembling the legendary Flame Mountain.
From time to time, head-sized flames would shoot out from the mountain ground and then explode, scattering into countless sparks that fell like raindrops into the ocean, re-immersing in the blazing flames of the mountain.
The temperature in the Red Mountain Range reached an astonishing level, and even the air they breathed was scorchingly hot, as if it could ignite all the internal organs.
The three stood before a valley in the mountain range, refraining from advancing further.
Frenzied beast roars echoed from the front, reverberating across the skies. More than a dozen tall fire beasts blocked the way, each with an aura not weaker than late-stage Returning Void cultivators.
The fire beasts roared at the three, then sprang forward aggressively.
"Brother Wan, it's up to you." Wulu and Nan Shangfeng retreated a few steps and naturally stood behind Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming wanted to speak, but eventually sighed and activated the Ju Mang Spirit Technique.
The void around the fire beasts quivered as Undying Tree Roots broke through the void, entwining each incoming fire beast.
With a wave of his sleeve, Yuan Ming transformed into a red shadow shooting towards those fire beasts, wielding the Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter.
With his Zhu Rong Heart Technique perfected, Yuan Ming was even more adept at controlling the Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter, taking only a few breaths to slay all the fire beasts.
More than a dozen strands of power of the sun flowed through the Undying Tree Roots and merged into Yuan Ming's body.
"These fire beasts seem to contain more power of the sun, we should be close to the heavenly fire now." With Yuan Ming having absorbed all the strands of power of the sun, he looked ahead expectantly.
"True, but Fellow Daoist Wan, I might not hold on much longer. The temperature is getting higher, and if we go any further, I fear I might melt." Behind Yuan Ming, Nan Shangfeng let out a wry smile, drenched in sweat.
"Yes, the temperature here is indeed much higher than outside. How many days have we traveled from the mountain entrance to here?" Yuan Ming turned to glance at Nan Shangfeng and asked.
"Only about a day's time," Wulu wiped the sweat from his forehead and replied.
"Just this short distance, and the temperature has increased tenfold," Yuan Ming calculated, clicking his tongue in disbelief.
"Indeed, and it will only get hotter the further we go. It seems this heavenly fire is beyond us return void cultivators even to approach." Nan Shangfeng sighed.
"From here onwards, it might have to be you on your own, Brother Wan. Nan Shangfeng, and I can only retreat into your Spiritual Treasure Space to avoid the heat," Wulu also sighed.
Yuan Ming naturally didn't force them. He immediately opened the Shura Palace and took them in.
"Take the Heavenly Escape Stone Talisman with you. It might be more useful than your current one if need be." Before entering, Wulu took out the Heavenly Escape Stone Talisman and offered it.
Yuan Ming accepted without formality, putting it away directly.
After familiarizing himself with the talisman's use, he embarked alone, continuing his flight deeper into the mountain range.
...
Half a day later.
Yuan Ming was drenched in sweat, his robe soaked through.
He felt as if everything before him was melting away, with the lines between rocks and flames blurring, all merging together in the overwhelming heat, indistinguishable from one another, burning in unison.
The entire world seemed to be reduced to a single color, making it hard to discern up from down or left from right. If not for the steadily rising spiritual vein power guiding him, Yuan Ming wouldn't know if he was moving forward or backward.
The surrounding temperature had unwittingly reached a point even Yuan Ming found intolerable.
Luckily, anticipating this, he had timely summoned the Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter to shield himself from the flames and the intense heat, or he would be in an even more sorry state.
Perhaps due to the Zhu Rong Heart Technique reaching the Fifth Layer Perfection, Yuan Ming found the effect of using the Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter to isolate the heat much better than before, an unexpected delight.

chapters.title: Chapter 953 - 918: Dao Treasure Piercing the Heavens
chapters.content:
As time slowly passed, Yuan Ming continued to move forward silently, but suddenly, he noticed that the surrounding temperature seemed to no longer fluctuate greatly, and the power of the spirit vein ahead was even more abundant to the extreme.
"It seems I've finally reached the core region of the Red Mountain Range." He was pleased at heart and quickly extended his divine sense, looking forward.
He saw that ahead was an unusually long steep canyon, bottomless, and filled with blazing white flames, far more dazzling than the Earth Core Purifying Fire, the temperature scorching several times more. Just a glance from afar made his eyes burn, as if the moisture was being baked dry.
Yuan Ming erected a protective shield and flew to the front of the canyon, but the white fire in the canyon burned intensely, filling the entire gorge and blocking the way.
After a moment's thought, he summoned the Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter, attempting to disperse the obstructing white fire.
However, the power of the Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter fell upon the blazing white flames, as if a mud bull entered the sea, with no response at all.
"What kind of flames are these? Even with the Zhu Rong Heart Technique and Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter, I still can't disperse them!" Yuan Ming was greatly surprised, and after pondering for a moment, he once again used the Circular Light Technique to probe the situation in the canyon.
But the light ball he summoned was still a blank white, with only the flames quietly burning; the Circular Light Technique couldn't investigate either.
This left Yuan Ming in a difficult position, staring intently at the flames before him, his mind turning over thoughts, striving to find a solution.
Just then, a low whistling sound suddenly came from behind.
Yuan Ming's expression changed slightly, and he immediately flickered aside, simultaneously activating the Heavenly Escape Stone Talisman. His body quickly turned transparent, then completely vanished, as if he didn't exist in the valley at all.
Yuan Ming had previously only indirectly used the Heavenly Escape Stone Talisman through Wulu, and now, activating it himself, he finally understood the mysterious aspects of the Heavenly Escape Stone Talisman.
At this moment, an invisible force emerged from the stone talisman, enveloping him as if it were a barrier.
This layer of invisible barrier had no defensive power of its own but had an extremely strong concealment effect, such that even Dharma Phase Cultivators couldn't detect a trace of it from the outside.
Yuan Ming showed a hint of joy, but before he could feel it in detail, the whistling sound approached rapidly, forcing him to put aside his investigations and turn his head towards the horizon.
He saw, approaching quickly in the direction opposite to where he had come from, a red great cauldron protecting five people who soon landed before the canyon.
As the distance narrowed, Yuan Ming discovered that the newcomers were led by Master Tantai, along with Yang Fan and Gan Wenqing, his two disciples, and two other elderly men in yellow robes. Both were in the Late Stage of Returning Void, ordinary-looking, seemingly unremarkable.
Yuan Ming's brows furrowed slightly; in his impression, there were no such yellow-robed elders among the people who entered from the Daluo Sect. Where did they come from?
However, thinking of his own Shura Palace, he quickly relaxed.
Master Tantai, as the sect master of the Daluo Sect, having a space treasure wasn't surprising.
Yuan Ming looked at the red great cauldron suspended above the five, its shape rectangular, with countless floating cloud fire patterns carved on its body. Spirit light flickered, and the fire patterns continuously flowed and swirled, colors hazy and dreamlike, seemingly containing some peculiar rhythm, bringing up bursts of intangible ripples.
A red twilight beam fell from the great cauldron, tightly protecting the five below, preventing the mountain flames from touching them in the slightest.
Seeing the five's relaxed expressions, they didn't seem to feel the unbearable heat.
Yuan Ming's eyes moved slightly, the fire-repelling and heat-insulating effect of this red great cauldron seemed to exceed that of the Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter by quite a margin.
The Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter had as many as thirty-five runes and specialized in fire control, yet it couldn't compare to this red great cauldron. Who knows what kind of wonder this cauldron contained.
With this thought, Yuan Ming secretly extended a wisp of divine sense, wanting to probe what was so special about the red great cauldron.
But when his divine sense touched the cauldron body, it was gently flicked away by an invisible force.
Yuan Ming was taken aback and tried other methods but to no avail.
The invisible force around the red great cauldron wasn't particularly thick, yet it blocked all his methods.
"Fellow Daoist Nan, I saw your master using a red great cauldron to shield himself from the flames. It seems quite miraculous. How much do you know about this treasure?" Yuan Ming, disinclined to waste more effort, directly asked Nan Shangfeng.
"Red great cauldron? What does it look like?" Nan Shangfeng's voice sounded.
Not wanting to describe it, Yuan Ming waved his hand to cast a Circular Light Technique in the Shura Palace, revealing the situation outside.
"This is the Daluo Sect's Emperor Yan's Mysterious Fire Tripod. How did Master bring it out?" Nan Shangfeng exclaimed in surprise upon seeing the red great cauldron.
"Is this cauldron very precious?" Yuan Ming asked upon seeing this.
"Not just precious, it's unique. The Emperor Yan's Mysterious Fire Tripod is the Daluo Sect's heavy treasure, inscribed with thirty-six runes, a Great Perfection Spirit Treasure, not to be used lightly, even by the sect master, unless in critical situations." Nan Shangfeng, without hiding anything, directly stated.
"A Great Perfection Spirit Treasure? It's the first time I've heard this term. Perfection... does it mean the internal runes have reached the limit?" Yuan Ming curiously asked.
In terms of artifact refining, he had some achievements, but in recent years, he had devoted most of his energy to cultivation and had not delved deeper into artifact refining. He truly hadn't heard of the so-called Great Perfection Spirit Treasure.
"Indeed, a spirit treasure, regardless of how good the material is, can accommodate up to thirty-six runes. Anything that reaches this standard can be called a Great Perfection Spirit Treasure. Not only is the power of this kind of spirit treasure several times higher than other spirit treasures, but the key point is that the Great Perfection Rune Array composed of thirty-six runes can communicate with the heavens and nurture a bit of the power of a Dao Treasure. This alone is enough to outshine all ordinary spirit treasures." Nan Shangfeng spoke eloquently.
"Dao Treasure?" Yuan Ming was once again taken aback.
"It is my oversight; Fellow Daoist Wan has not heard of the Great Perfection Spirit Treasure, and naturally doesn't know about the Dao Treasure. The so-called Dao Treasure is an existence above the spirit treasure, extremely rare, and there may not be a few in the entire Chuyun Realm. Each one contains the immense power to reach the heaven and earth." Nan Shangfeng explained.
"I see, then what is the difference between a Dao Treasure and a spirit treasure?" Yuan Ming asked.
"It can't be described in words. Dao Treasures and spirit treasures are not existences of the same level and cannot be measured by the same means." Nan Shangfeng said seriously.
"Have you seen a Dao Treasure, Fellow Daoist Nan?" Yuan Ming pressed on.
"No, the Dao Treasures of our Chuyun Realm are all held by reclusive Mahayana Realm experts, how could I have seen one? But I have heard my master mention it once or twice." Nan Shangfeng said.
"Alright, let's not talk about Dao Treasures for now. Why can the Emperor Yan's Mysterious Fire Tripod isolate divine sense probing?" Yuan Ming was quite upset about his divine sense being blocked by the Emperor Yan's Mysterious Fire Tripod.
"That is one of the effects of a trace of Dao Treasure power within a Great Perfection Spirit Treasure. The power of a Dao Treasure is incredibly mysterious, and one of them is the ability to block the probing of divine soul power." Nan Shangfeng said.
"Doesn't this mean that if you have a Great Perfection Spirit Treasure as protection, you can be completely undefeated against a Soul Cultivator?" Yuan Ming was very surprised.
"Not necessarily, soul cultivation divine powers are enigmatic and unfathomable, and simply blocking divine sense does not guarantee peace of mind." Nan Shangfeng said.
Yuan Ming recalled the curse killing divine power of the Wu Yue God, which could kill someone from a thousand miles away. Relying solely on a Great Perfection Spirit Treasure for protection was indeed not immune.
However, the ability of Great Perfection Spirit Treasures to block divine soul power is equivalent to nullifying most of a Soul Cultivator's methods, and that is quite terrifying.
"Great Perfection Spirit Treasures are scarce. Even with our Daluo Sect's status, we only have one, and other sects won't have many either. It's unrealistic to rely on Great Perfection Spirit Treasures to resist Soul Cultivators." Nan Shangfeng continued.
"Fellow Daoist Nan, you seem to know a lot about Great Perfection Spirit Treasures. What are the conditions for advancing a spirit treasure with thirty-five runes to a Great Perfection Spirit Treasure?" Yuan Ming nodded and asked again.
The Ruyi Scepter in his hand was a spirit treasure containing thirty-five runes. If he could find a way to inscribe one more rune and thus advance it to Great Perfection, it would be greatly beneficial to him.
"How would I know? Fellow Daoist Wan, you overestimate me." Nan Shangfeng immediately shook his head.
Yuan Ming was just asking casually, so he quickly put the thought aside and continued to observe the movements of the Daluo Sect's group.
Master Tantai's group of five arrived in front of the canyon and, upon seeing the blazing white flames in the valley, Yang Fan and the others each used their means to probe but, like Yuan Ming, all were unsuccessful.
So they stopped wasting effort, turning to look at Master Tantai: "Master, what should we do?"
"Judging from the situation here, there is a big problem under the canyon, so naturally, we need to go down and have a look!" Master Tantai said immediately, raising his hand and casting several spells towards the Emperor Yan's Mysterious Fire Tripod.
The Emperor Yan's Mysterious Fire Tripod instantly radiated a red light, and from its opening, it emitted a vast fire pillar of three colors: red, orange, and yellow, striking directly upon the blazing white flames.
"Don't just stand there, help me out!" Master Tantai reprimanded.
Upon hearing this, Yang Fan and the others hurriedly channeled their mana into the Emperor Yan's Mysterious Fire Tripod.
The fire pillar from its mouth grew several times larger, and the frenzied, dense cracking sound became overwhelming. After a moment of duel between the two flames, the blazing white flames were finally defeated, leaving a large gap.
However, the blazing white flames at the gap continued to extend towards the center, and if not for the support of the three-colored fire pillar, they would have quickly fused again.
"Let's go!"
Master Tantai recited this, and then led everyone through the gap under the protection of the Emperor Yan's Mysterious Fire Tripod, widening the path as they went.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming's eyes brightened, and he quickly followed them before the gap closed.
However, to avoid being discovered, he didn't dare follow too closely, and the speed at which the blazing white flames fused was too fast. Even though Yuan Ming did not slow down, he was still burned by part of the blazing white flames.
For the same reason, he didn't dare to openly use the Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter for protection, so he could only store it in his dantian, trying to gather his strength, barely protecting vital organs like his heart and lungs.
Under the constant burning of the blazing white flames, half of Yuan Ming's body was scorched black, appearing like a charred corpse from the outside—really a pitiful sight.
Fortunately, the Undying Tree's vitality was strong, continuously providing him with life force to repair the damage to his physical body.
Therefore, although he appeared pitiful at the moment, he was actually not much harmed.

chapters.title: Chapter 954 - 919: Xihe Palace
chapters.content:
The depth of the canyon was not as deep as expected. Before long, Yuan Ming followed in the footsteps of Master Tantai and his group, thoroughly breaking through the blockade of the Blazing White Flames and reaching the canyon floor.
The situation here was very different from above; there were no traces of flames scorching the brown earth here, and the temperature around had decreased significantly, becoming no longer unbearably hot.
And in the center of the valley stood a massive grand palace.
The palace was entirely crimson, with every brick and tile shrouded in what seemed like a fiery red glow. Above the main gate hung a plaque inscribed with the three powerful characters "Xihe Palace," appearing to have witnessed the passage of countless years, exuding an ancient and unsettling aura.
Master Tantai and his party landed in front of the grand palace, like ants standing before a giant tree, unable to see the full extent of the palace even with just their sight.
The main gate of Xihe Palace was tightly closed, with faint phantom runes flickering on it, clearly sealed by some kind of Forbidden seal.
"I didn't expect the canyon to hold such a situation. It seems there must be something good inside this palace, even if it's not the Heavenly Fire, it's an extremely precious secret treasure," said Gan Wenqing somewhat excitedly, looking at the enormous Xihe Palace.
Master Tantai shared the same thought, staying silent while raising a hand to cast a spell to probe the seal on the gate.
But just then, a surge of black energy suddenly rose from behind them, and within the black energy emerged a massive black claw resembling a bear's paw, several meters in size. The palm and nails were covered in strange runes, mercilessly descending upon the group of five.
Master Tantai and the others were still observing the Xihe Palace ahead, completely unaware of the impending danger.
"What's happening?" Yuan Ming wondered to himself.
The speed of the black bear claw was fast, yet not astonishingly so. With Master Tantai's level of Cultivation, he should have sensed it beforehand. Could it be that this black bear claw had some special Divine Skills, completely bypassing the Spiritual Sense of Master Tantai and the others?
The five were on the verge of being crushed when the Emperor Yan's Mysterious Fire Tripod suspended in mid-air suddenly released a bright light, swiftly descending to block the black bear claw.
Without anyone to activate it, the power of the Emperor Yan's Mysterious Fire Tripod was insufficient. With a "bang," it was sent flying.
However, Master Tantai finally sensed the bear claw behind him, his expression changing dramatically, as he fiercely waved his sleeve.
The Emperor Yan's Mysterious Fire Tripod, which had been knocked away, instantly stopped, and a torrent of three-colored flame pillars gushed forth, quickly forming a flame giant fist the size of a house, colliding with the ambushing black bear claw.
Accompanied by a loud "boom," the black bear claw was driven back, retracting into the black energy, while the flame giant fist flew back into the Emperor Yan's Mysterious Fire Tripod.
"Tsk tsk, a Great Perfection Spirit Treasure is indeed troublesome," a voice grumbled from the black energy.
"That's because your Alaya Divine Claw is not fully refined, unable to deceive the Artifact Spirit's senses," another voice replied.
"Black Bear King, since when did you learn to attack from behind!" Master Tantai looked towards the black energy behind him, shouting in a deep voice.
"Tantai, didn't I already tell you not to come? Why do you never heed my warnings? Now it's come to this, I have no choice but to take your life," a tall figure appeared from the black energy, rubbing his head. It was indeed the Black Bear King.
"Did you leak the Empress's plan? After this battle, I will report this matter in detail to the Empress," a flash of red light appeared beside Black Bear King, and the figure of the Flame Wolf King emerged as well.
