And behind the two demons, more than a dozen tall demon beasts appeared simultaneously, all Level 5, surrounding Master Tantai's group, clearly having been lying in ambush for a while.
Master Tantai's expression was heavy; raising a hand, the silver duster appeared in his grasp.
Yang Fan and the others also summoned their respective Spiritual Treasures, readying themselves for battle.
"It seems the Ten Thousand Demon Country was indeed prepared early on. Could it be that the Xihe Palace truly holds the Heavenly Fire?" Yuan Ming, having already moved aside, watched the spectacle unfold.
"Brother Wan, our master and the others are in danger. Can you lend a hand?" Nan Shangfeng's voice suddenly resonated in his Sea of Consciousness.
Only then did Yuan Ming realize he forgot to disperse the Circular Light Technique inside the Shura Palace, allowing Nan Shangfeng to observe the situation outside.
"Sorry, I don't have the ability, nor do I want to get involved in this murky water," Yuan Ming refused decisively without a second thought.
Both the Black Bear King and the Flame Wolf King were Sixth Rank Upper Stage Great Demons; helping them would be seeking his own death.
"I'm willing to offer Spirit Stones as compensation, name your price!" Nan Shangfeng said, as generous as ever.
Yuan Ming quickly dispersed the Circular Light Technique inside the Shura Palace, ignoring Nan Shangfeng.
While Yuan Ming and Nan Shangfeng were conversing, a fight was already breaking out on the other side.
"Tantai, it's been hundreds of years since we last sparred. Let me see how much you've progressed over the years!" Black Bear King laughed aloud, clapping his hands together and striking towards Master Tantai.
Master Tantai flicked his wrist, the silver duster transforming into countless silver threads, piercing towards Black Bear King's palms.
The Emperor Yan's Mysterious Fire Tripod also shot out another flame blast, targeting Black Bear King.
The Flame Wolf King did not seize the opportunity to join forces against Master Tantai, instead flashing towards Gan Wenqing and the other four.
As a dignified Sixth Rank Great Demon, just the fierce momentum he released caused Gan Wenqing and the others to tremble all over, their actions delayed by several beats. It wasn't until the Flame Wolf King charged at them that they finally raised their Spiritual Treasures to protect themselves.
Gan Wenqing is a Spoken Witch, but also a concurrently practiced Magic Practitioner, with cultivation reaching the Returning to Void Stage, she raised a yellow umbrella to protect herself.
The two elder men in yellow robes were skilled in Joint Attack Technique, and together they summoned a green mountain-like Spiritual Treasure, several mountain phantom images appeared around them, sheltering them within.
"An ant trying to shake a tree!" The Flame Wolf King sneered, striking out with a large hand.
Two gigantic flaming palms appeared before Gan Wenqing and the two yellow-robed elders, striking harshly against the yellow umbrella and the mountain phantoms.
However, the expected earth-shaking sound did not occur, and the two flaming giant palms disappeared into thin air without a trace.
Gan Wenqing and the two yellow-robed elders were momentarily stunned, not knowing what had happened.
But at that moment, Gan Wenqing's yellow umbrella suddenly exploded, turning into countless tattered pieces, with endless fiery red flames emerging from nowhere, sweeping in all directions.
The green mountain summoned by the two yellow-robed elders similarly exploded, destroyed by the fiery red flames that suddenly emerged from within the mountain.
Both Gan Wenqing and the two yellow-robed elders were blown away by the explosive flames, suffering significant injuries.
The Flame Wolf King seized the chance to pursue, raising both claws as ten sharp red beams shot out, intending to tear the three into pieces.
On the other side, Master Tantai saw the Flame Wolf King's actions but did not even turn his head as he continued to engage with the Black Bear King.
"Something's not right, watch out for treachery!" The Black Bear King, having known Master Tantai for many years, immediately sensed something, yelling urgently.
But just then, the Flame Wolf King heard a sharp "clang" as a white sword light appeared before him, slashing swiftly towards his throat.
At such a distance, it was already unavoidable.
The Flame Wolf King's heart tightened, and he immediately disregarded killing Gan Wenqing and the others, as his red mane around his neck ignited instantly, while countless scarlet red spiritual patterns surfaced on his body. He forcibly twisted his body, crossing his arms just in time to block the incoming sword light.
With a sound of clashing iron, the Flame Wolf King was sliced back, crashing into Xihe Palace behind before stopping.
The Flame Wolf King's arms were marked with a long and deep wound, with his skin split open and pale bones exposed, looking extremely terrifying.
The white sword light also flew backward, but quickly stopped, transforming into a broad, snow-white longsword emitting a piercing Sword Qi that penetrated the void.
A white light flashed over the longsword, and Yang Fan's figure emerged from within, exuding a vast fluctuation of aura, entirely different from before.
"So Yang Fan has reached the Dharma Manifestation Stage and is also an astonishingly powerful Sword Cultivator; no wonder Master Tantai is unconcerned," Yuan Ming nodded silently.
"Good sword, and not a bad person. It's been ages since I encountered a Sword Cultivator that unites man and sword. Today, let's enjoy a good fight!" The Flame Wolf King, extremely angry yet laughing, praised, then raised his arms, licking the wound with his tongue.
The split skin on his arms rapidly healed at a speed visible to the naked eye, soon returning to its original state.
Yang Fan silently flew out, raising an arm to lift his sword, pointing the sword tip slantingly at the Flame Wolf King.
The next moment, both of them exploded out simultaneously, transforming into beams of red and white light colliding together.
On the other side, Gan Wenqing and the two elder men in yellow robes finally stabilized their stances, but before they could catch their breath, the remaining Level 5 Demon Beasts surrounded them, launching a fierce attack on the three.
Yang Fan, having only just entered the Dharma Manifestation Stage, was far from a match for the Flame Wolf King, but being a Sword Cultivator, he could deploy the Divine Skill of Man and Sword Unity, moving nimbly and swiftly, which left the Flame Wolf King unable to do much in a short time.
As for Gan Wenqing and the others, Gan Wenqing utilized her Soul Cultivation Divine Power, her soul manifestation was a clam, puffing her chest and abdomen to spew a large white mist.
This mist had a strong hallucinogenic effect, causing the dozen or so Level 5 Demon Race to not dare to approach closely. Under the cover of the white mist, the trio managed to fight and flee around Xihe Palace, barely holding on.
The situation in front of the palace became chaotic, various spirit lights flickered madly, and demon energy clashed with Mana in the air, erupting in piercing shrieks.
However, no one noticed that amidst their entangled battle, a transparent figure quietly bypassed everyone, gradually making its way to the front of Xihe Palace.
Yuan Ming gripped the Heavenly Escape Stone Talisman tightly, standing long, meticulously observing the grand door before him.
The door of Xihe Palace was of the same color as the bricks and tiles, with a similar texture, all forged from giant stone, exceptionally sturdy. Even when struck by the aftershocks of the Dharma Manifestation battle not far off, it left no marks.
On both sides of the door, there were several brass door nails embedded, arranged from top to bottom, a total of twenty. Each door nail was larger than a human head, with runes continually flashing on them. Yuan Ming tried remembering for a while, only to find out that the runes had hundreds of variations and no discernible pattern.
He attempted to summon the Undying Tree Root, hoping to use its void-piercing Divine Skill to penetrate into the hall.
But the Forbidden on the door had the surrounding space tightly locked. After several attempts, Yuan Ming couldn't open a spatial rift at all.
Finding no shortcuts, Yuan Ming could only honestly try to decode the Forbidden on the door.
But after spending quite a while, Yuan Ming still couldn't grasp the situation, only able to faintly sense that the Forbidden on the door far exceeded the Sixth Level, presumably a Seventh Level Array.

chapters.title: Chapter 955 - 920: Nine-Tailed Celestial Fox
chapters.content:
"A seventh-level restriction, with my current array formation cultivation, it's impossible to break..." Yuan Ming sighed silently, feeling a heavy heart.
He also understood why the Black Bear King and the Flame Wolf King were lying in ambush for the Daluo Sect; it was likely that these two Demon Kings couldn't open the door either and could only guard outside the palace.
As Yuan Ming was pondering the forbidden breaking method, the battlefield not far away saw a change in its situation.
The Black Bear King forced back Master Tantai with a single move, then suddenly pounded his chest, letting out a sky-shattering roar. His body rapidly expanded, transforming in an instant into a hundred-zhang tall black fur bear with silver patterns all over.
"This is the Sky Demon True Body! Looks like the Black Bear King has unleashed his True Fire!" Seeing this scene, Yuan Ming immediately distanced himself from the Xi He Palace's gate.
High-level demon clans inherently dual cultivate their Dharma Bodies, and after reaching Level 6, they face two paths: one is to refine demonic power like human cultivators condensing a Dharma Manifestation.
The second path is to abandon the cultivation of demonic power and focus on honing the physical body, condensing the Sky Demon True Body.
The Sky Demon True Body possesses unparalleled power, surpassing those of the same level in Dharma Manifestation; however, its weakness is evident, becoming an easy target after enlarging, and not utilized unless in a life or death crisis.
Master Tantai's face turned solemn instantly, flicking the duster, causing the surrounding nature's spiritual energy to rush furiously. An imposing Dharma Body dressed in a Daoist robe manifested in an instant, stepping forward and single-handedly lifting Emperor Yan's Mysterious Fire Tripod.
As man and demon were about to engage in a full-force battle, the void above Xi He Palace rippled, revealing a silver-white extravagant flying car from thin air.
Yuan Ming noticed the situation and immediately turned to look at the flying car, seeing spirit light gleaming upon it, with a majestic aura akin to Emperor Yan's Mysterious Fire Tripod, clearly also a Great Perfection Spirit Treasure.
Four figures were standing on the flying car, precisely Sima Changqin and three Black Demons.
"Qin Demon!" The Black Bear King was startled, his advancing body abruptly halted.
The Flame Wolf King and other demon clans changed their expressions, ceasing their struggle against Yang Fan, Gan Wenqing, and others, retreating to the side.
The Daluo Sect members were nearly at their limit, and seeing Sima Changqin arrive, they were naturally overjoyed.
"Fellow Daoist Tantai, it's unexpected that you've arrived ahead of us," Sima Changqin remarked from the flying car, looking at Master Tantai.
"Lord Qinmo, you've caught us off guard with our state," Master Tantai withdrew his Dharma Body, smiling wryly.
"Fellow Daoist Tantai, your words are too heavy. These demon clans bully with numbers; why bother dwelling on it?" Sima Changqin chuckled, then turned to the Black Bear King and Flame Wolf King.
The two Demon Kings' expressions subtly changed, focusing their vigilance.
"The legend says the Ten Thousand Demon Country descends from the Ancient Sky Demon Royal Court, where the royal court hosted the Bear Demon Saint, Greedy Wolf Demon Saint, Sky Roc, Coiling Serpent, and Vinesprout—five great demon saints, each with cultivation as vast as the sky and earth, renowned across the Chuyun Realm. Seeing you two, you seem to inherit from the Bear Demon Saint and Greedy Wolf Demon Saint. Today, I'll have a lesson," Sima Changqin raised his hand and the purple-black ancient zither on his back flew out, landing in front of him.
This zither is over four feet long, wide in front and narrow at the back, appearing exquisite and refined.
The Black Bear King and Flame Wolf King's faces changed, immediately leading everyone to fly far away.
Sima Changqin paid no heed, gently placing his hands on the zither, casually plucking a melody that flowed like water, reaching into everyone's ears.
The Black Bear King had already fled to afar, even casting treasures for protective body, yet the zither sound still clearly penetrated their ears.
In an instant, the demon clan of Ten Thousand Demon Country witnessed numerous enchanting demonesses appear before them, dancing gracefully to the melody, their flying garments carrying an eerie magic that seized their souls, stirring their emotions.
"Be careful! This is one of Sima Changqin's ten enchanted musical themes, the Heavenly Demon Charm. Close your eyes and focus your mind!" yelled the Black Bear King.
The group of demons hurriedly shut their eyes, calming their minds.
However, even though they blocked their ears and closed their eyes, the soul-seizing zither sound continued to serenade, as if playing within their hearts.
All Level 5 demon beasts soon had their minds crazed, swaying to the movements of the demonesses.
Both the Black Bear King and Flame Wolf King were drenched in sweat, demonic power surging wildly, yet barely maintaining their sanity.
"Worth being among the Five Great Demon Kings, they can withstand Lord Qinmo's Heavenly Demon Charm, but unfortunately, it ends here," Wu Li sneered, then looked at the nearby Black Demon woman with a high ponytail.
This woman raised her hand, drawing across the void, and silky red spirit light surged from her fingertip, resonating with the surrounding nature's spiritual energy, causing four red talismans to appear from thin air, layer upon layer of intricate runes appeared.
"Void Formation! Moreover, judging from the complexity of these talismans, it's at least a Level 5 Talisman—this woman is a talisman master?" Yuan Ming, hiding below, watched with a shocked expression.
The Black Demon woman pointed with her fingers, and the four talismans suddenly glowed brightly, transforming into four large crimson arrow shadows, shooting out.
The red arrow shadows, burning with crimson flames, carved shallow marks in the void as they tracked towards the two demons, Black Bear and Flame Wolf.
The Black Bear King and Flame Wolf King sensed the impending crisis, yet they were utterly incapable of resistance, watching wide-eyed as the arrow shadows approached.
At this moment, a massive fox tail phantom swept over, hitting the four crimson arrow shadows.
Boom, boom, boom!
The four crimson arrow shadows exploded, producing massive mushroom clouds in mid-air, the surrounding void issued explosive sounds, wobbling and twisting.
"A Level 5 Talisman couldn't possibly have such power; could it be a Level 6 Talisman?" Yuan Ming was genuinely astounded and then suppressed the surprise, looking towards the white fox tail's location.
"Lord Qin Demon, with your esteemed status, why bother with my subordinates? If you wish to duel, you may seek me." In the location of the white fox tail, the void rippled once more, revealing Wu Yu's figure, looking at Sima Changqin as he spoke calmly.
Behind Wu Yu, light flashed, and Xuan Ye and the Electric Roc King appeared simultaneously.
"Since Chang Qin arrived here, he has never encountered a decent opponent. Since Her Majesty wishes to spar, I am happy to oblige," Sima Changqin said with a smile, as the sound of the zither flowed once more.
This time, the sound of the zither was completely different from before, urgent and fervent.
In an instant, the fire attribute spirit qi in the surroundings became agitated, rapidly gathering at one point, and in the blink of an eye, it condensed into a giant blazing sword a hundred feet long, slashing straight towards Wu Yu.
Flames continuously erupted from the giant sword, producing bursts of explosive sounds, carrying an incredibly terrifying heat. As it swung, it seemed as if even the void was burnt away, making it impossible to see its descending trajectory.
Yuan Ming, hiding to the side, immediately saw that this sword was not merely a simple aggregation of spiritual power, but contained the true intent of flames, bearing a power capable of burning everything in the world.
Even if it were him facing this sword, it would not be easy to withstand.
"Dutian Fierce Fire Song?" Wu Yu's expression slightly changed. Two white fox tails instantly emerged from behind her, pure white throughout, seemingly containing some kind of divine power.
One of the white fox tails swept towards Xuan Ye and the Electric Roc King, gently pushing them away to avoid any accidental injuries, while the other struck the blazing great sword.
With a loud "boom," the blazing great sword was swept and broken, its remnants thoroughly dispersed.
Sima Changqin's smile did not fade, clearly not surprised by this, as he plucked the zither strings once more.
Red light flashed in mid-air, and four giant swords of flames appeared instantly, just as large as before, each containing the true intent of flames, slashing down towards Wu Yu together.
Wu Yu's expression did not change, merely summoning one more white tail, intertwining to scatter the flaming giant swords.
However, before she could catch her breath, red light flashed around, and sixteen gigantic fire swords appeared, continuing to rush towards Wu Yu, sealing off all space for evasion.
Finally, Wu Yu was no longer at ease, and directly crossed her arms, forming a spell with each hand.
Demonic power surged madly from her body, and six white fox tails emerged, wrapping her body completely, making it look like a giant white light cocoon.
The sixteen giant swords slashed onto the fox tail light cocoon, instantly causing flames to fly wildly, white light to flash intensely, and explosive sounds to merge into one, making the ears of the spectators hum so much that they couldn't hear anything else, nor see what was happening inside.
Yuan Ming's eyes flickered with golden light, penetrating the sky full of fiery white glow to see Wu Yu's current state.
The white light cocoon formed by the fox tails was mostly slashed apart, but the remaining fox tails still protected Wu Yu.
"Her Majesty, be careful,"
Sima Changqin's voice rang out again, and without caring whether Wu Yu could hear, he continued to drive his mana, his fingers dancing on the ancient zither, producing shadow after shadow.
In an instant, more and more giant swords of flame appeared out of nowhere in the sky, one became ten, ten became a hundred…
In the span of two breaths, the densely packed giant swords of flame covered the sky, numbering in the hundreds.
These flaming giant swords circled the white light cocoon, forming a sword array, swirling and cutting without pattern, yet quietly closing in towards the center.
The surrounding temperature rose sharply, and a series of crackling sounds echoed in the air, causing everyone to simultaneously feel a difficulty in breathing, as the moisture in their bodies evaporated rapidly, seeming as if they would turn into desiccated corpses in the next moment.
Everyone's expressions changed, quickly retreating backwards, not daring to linger for even a moment.
And this, was merely the power of the residual ripples of Sima Changqin's spell.
The cultivators could not even imagine how Wu Yu, facing this move directly, must feel. In their eyes, the legendary Ten Thousand Demon Empress was likely in dire danger.
But in the next instant, as if to refute the speculation of the crowd, the white light cocoon surrounded by the red sword light suddenly expanded, and then with a roar, exploded abruptly.
Nine enormous white fox tails, like petals, spun open, piercing the flaming sword array.
The densely packed sword shadows were pierced through, and Wu Yu's form shot out from the sword array, with the nine tails unscathed, still bright and new, exuding a sacred white glow.
The onlookers witnessed this scene, and for a moment, it was as if they saw a white lotus blooming amidst the endless flow of fire, dreamlike and enchanting, leaving one in awe.
While everyone was engrossed in Wu Yu's majestic presence, Sima Changqin gently chuckled, proactively stepping down from the silver flying car, and bowed towards Wu Yu.
"The Ten Thousand Demon Empress indeed lives up to her reputation. It appears the Heavenly Fox Bloodline has been fully activated, my compliments," he said with a smile.
"Not at all, it is Fellow Daoist Qinmo's superior skills. Were it not for holding back a bit, I fear I would have already been defeated," Wu Yu slightly bowed in return, also giving a salute.
The two exchanged smiles, as if the sparring match had never occurred.
Many of the onlookers were left confused, scratching their heads.
But Yuan Ming saw clearly from the side, realizing that the bout was merely Sima Changqin's way of probing Wu Yu's abilities, to ascertain her strength.
Now that his goal was achieved, he immediately ceased the exchange.
As for Wu Yu, it seemed she was unwilling to engage in conflict with Sima Changqin, welcoming his withdrawal with a smile.

chapters.title: Chapter 956 - 921: Dragged Into the Water
chapters.content:
"Since Fellow Daoist Wu Yu has also arrived here, you must be here for the Xihe Palace, right? Continuing to fight is meaningless. Why don't we first think of a way to break the restriction here?" Sima Changqin said.
"Qin Mo's suggestion is not bad. We can collaborate on this matter." Wu Yu nodded slightly and said.
"There's no rush for collaboration. You've been here at the Ten Thousand Demon Country long before us, yet you haven't broken the restriction. Perhaps it's just that you're not destined for the Heavenly Fire?" Master Tantai interjected.
"Tantai, what do you mean by this? Are you saying we're incompetent?" Black Bear King heard these words and was displeased.
"Not at all. I'm saying that if by chance we break the restriction, discussing collaboration would be a bit unfair." Master Tantai laughed.
"This place has a seventh-level array restriction. Even Lord Wu Yu couldn't break it. Can you?" Flame Wolf King mocked with a smile.
"Since we haven't tried yet, nothing is certain." Sima Changqin smiled faintly and said.
"Everyone is welcome to try. If you can truly open the restriction by your own strength, we concede. Everything in the hall will belong to you." Wu Yu also smiled.
She seemed very confident, convinced that just relying on the power of these humans, the great array could not be broken.
"Since Fellow Daoist Wu Yu has said so, why not give it a try?" Sima Changqin also smiled and said.
With that, he stepped forward and lifted the ancient zither from his back, letting it suspend in front of him.
Sitting cross-legged in the air behind the zither, his hands pressed on the strings, he began to pluck them.
As the strings vibrated, beautiful zither music transformed into sound waves that struck the Xihe Hall.
The sound waves were not intense, like a spring breeze gently brushing past, barely enough to trigger the formation's defensive glow but doing no harm.
"Using zither sounds to test the array and find flaws, this Guardian is quite inventive." Yuan Ming watched from the side, secretly praising in his heart.
At first, many did not understand the purpose of the zither sounds, but as the waves became denser and pounded the restriction light shield of the hall, the entire formation's outline gradually emerged.
Sima Changqin gazed at the restriction light shield for a long time, his eyes suddenly sharpened, and his fingers plucking the strings sped up rapidly, each note sharper than the last, piercing directly at a point in the formation.
In the rapid zither music, a distinct dent appeared on the formation, deepening and expanding into a large vortex of light, seemingly on the brink of rupture.
The others observed with a mix of delight and shock, all fixated on that spot, even Black Bear King's eyes flickered with uncertainty.
However, Wu Yu remained calm and indifferent, seemingly unconcerned.
As time passed, when the vortex deepened twice as much, regardless of how much Sima Changqin added his zither sounds, the depth of the vortex did not increase any further.
Just as he was about to escalate his strength, the entire great array suddenly trembled violently. A massive force burst from the vortex on the restriction, transforming into a Fire Flood Dragon charging straight at Sima Changqin.
The latter immediately raised the ancient zither to shield himself, his fingers moving swiftly like illusions, plucking the strings rapidly.
The zither sound surged like a storm, colliding with the Fire Flood Dragon.
In the deafening roar, the Fire Flood Dragon's body trembled wildly before quickly turning into dust.
The violent zither sound hit the door restriction, but the light shield only dented and quivered with no significant change from before.
Sima Changqin looked at the Xihe Hall gate and stopped his attempts.
Seeing this, the treasure-seeking team could not help but sigh.
"So, do you still want to try?" Wu Yu asked with a smile.
"No need, it's pointless." Sima Changqin shook his head.
"What a pity, just a little bit short," Yang Fan sighed.
"If Lord Qin Mo could try once more..." Master Tantai also hesitated as he looked at Sima Changqin.
"Earlier, I used only a fraction of my strength. The great array returned only a fraction of its force, no more, no less. If I used my full power, the array would return its full power as well, likely resulting in mutual destruction," Sima Changqin said, glancing at Wu Yu, shaking his head.
When he tried earlier, he already gauged the strength of this great array, understanding that relying solely on his power, he could not break it.
"So, can we discuss the previous suggestion now?" Wu Yu smiled and said.
"How does Fellow Daoist Wu Yu propose we cooperate?" Sima Changqin asked.
"Joining forces to break the restriction, and then each relying on their own abilities," Wu Yu replied.
"Alright, but do you have a method for breaking the array together?" Sima Changqin inquired.
"No rush, another friend has arrived," Wu Yu said with a smile.
Hearing this, everyone looked around, eager to see who had arrived.
But after waiting a long time, no tunneling light appeared in this direction, and for a moment, they were puzzled.
"Fellow Daoist Wan, at this moment, why not show yourself?" Wu Yu suddenly gazed at a corner of the Xihe Hall and spoke.
"The Heavenly Escape Stone Talisman has been seen through?" Upon hearing his name suddenly called, Yuan Ming's heart was filled with surprise.
He looked up in disbelief, only to find her gaze locked straight onto him, as if piercing through space and void, disregarding the concealment of the Heavenly Escape Stone Talisman.
Yuan Ming was surprised that she could actually locate his position, causing him to hesitate for a moment.
The others couldn't see Yuan Ming at all, nor could they detect his presence, so they were left perplexed by this sudden interrogation, glancing around in confusion.
Only Sima Changqin followed Wu Yu's gaze and looked over, his expression somewhat unusual, as though he too had noticed something.
Yuan Ming's mind raced as he put away the Heavenly Escape Stone Talisman, revealing his form at once, which immediately elicited a low murmur from everyone.
"Wan Tianren, didn't you stay outside?" Master Tantai frowned and asked.
He hadn't realized Yuan Ming's whereabouts at all, hence the apprehension in his heart outweighed his surprise.
"That was just a clone, please pardon me," Yuan Ming said with a smile and clasped his fist.
"Fellow Daoist Wan keeps his abilities hidden; if Fellow Daoist Wu Yu hadn't pointed out his location, even though I sensed someone was lurking around, it would have been difficult to pinpoint his trace, truly astonishing." Sima Changqin lightly clapped and laughed.
"It's just some crude technique, it still couldn't fool everyone," Yuan Ming said indifferently.
He really had no fondness for someone like Sima Changqin, who put on a front of magnanimity while behaving maliciously.
"Fellow Daoist Wu Yu, why did you make Wan Tianren reveal himself? Can he help break the array?" Master Tantai seemed to still doubt Yuan Ming's strength and asked directly.
"You all might not know, but Fellow Daoist Wan is quite knowledgeable about arrays and is a genuine Sixth-level Array Master," Wu Yu said.
As these words fell, the others' gazes towards Yuan Ming changed once again.
A Sixth-level Array Master is considered a valuable ally anywhere.
"Oh? If so, why don't you share your thoughts, Fellow Daoist Wan?" Master Tantai said, a little embarrassed but courteously.
"Fellow Daoist Wu Yu praises me too much; I am merely somewhat acquainted with magic arrays, hardly a master. I have observed for quite a while but have regrettably not thought of a forbidden breaking method." Yuan Ming glanced at Wu Yu and shook his head.
Judging from the earlier interaction with Sima Changqin, this Wu Yu should be the main body, whereas that clone had run off somewhere.
Everyone initially expected the person Wu Yu was waiting for to have a solution, but was inevitably disappointed upon hearing this.
"Fellow Daoist Wan, there's no need to shirk; since you're here, why not lend a hand, right?" Wu Yu's eyes sparkled slightly, and he enticingly drew Yuan Ming into the fray.
"Naturally," Yuan Ming saw everyone's gaze turn towards him, and he reluctantly nodded in agreement.
Wu Yu seemed satisfied with achieving his aim and nodded contentedly.
"Everyone, among us, none are Level 7 Array Masters. Trying to unravel the mysteries of this forbidden great array is akin to a wild fantasy. You must have seen Fellow Daoist Sima's attempt earlier; it was merely about finding the weak points of the array and attacking with full force to break it. This is the most direct and effective method right now," Wu Yu said.
"What Fellow Daoist Wu Yu said makes sense, but I ultimately failed, so this method might not be viable," Sima Changqin reminded.
"Many hands make light work; gathering everyone's strength may not fail," Wu Yu said.
"Then let's try it," Master Tantai said.
The others promptly voiced their approval.
"Later, I will divine the weak point of the array. When I point it out, I hope everyone will attack with full force without holding back," Wu Yu glanced at everyone and said.
The others had no objections and agreed.
Wu Yu then wasted no more words, sat cross-legged, took out a disk resembling a compass in her arms, closed her eyes slightly, and brushed her fingers over the surface of the disk, instantly lighting up with a thin layer of white light.
Wu Yu quickly performed spells, her ten fingers moved in succession, pulling out multiple afterimages faster than Sima Changqin's earlier zither play.
A moment later, the white light faded, Wu Yu ceased casting spells, showing a hint of fatigue on her face, and put away the disk.
Her gaze unconsciously glanced at Yuan Ming, then at the others.
The result of divination was the same as before; the key to breaking the restriction lay with Yuan Ming.
"I divined the weak spot to be at the lower right corner of the hall door, near the rivet. Everyone, try casting spells to attack there," Wu Yu pointed to a spot on the hall door and said.
Everyone's eyes shifted simultaneously, nodded, and upon Wu Yu's command, they all began casting spells in that direction.
In no time, various colored rays shot straight from their hands, heading towards the spot Wu Yu mentioned.
Even though Sima Changqin wasn't too optimistic about this method, the situation had reached a point where he couldn't stand by.
Yuan Ming called upon seventy percent of his mana and also threw a punch.
At the convergence of the light, the array restriction emerged, instantly forming a deeply recessed whirlpool, more intense than when Sima Changqin tried breaking the array earlier.
Everyone thought they'd glimpsed hope in breaking the array and intensified their mana output, starting a full-blown attack.
However, in the next moment, this seventh-level magic array gave everyone the most direct response.

chapters.title: Chapter 957 - 922: Hope for Forbidden Breaking
chapters.content:
Just when the great array seemed about to collapse, the array patterns on the formation suddenly transformed, and hundreds of crimson strands surged out, turning into complex and mysterious runes. These runes interwove and entangled, forming large round array patterns that coalesced in the void, with flames surging inside.
The next moment, huge bursts of crimson flames erupted wildly from the array patterns, shooting towards the crowd like a violent storm of pear blossoms.
Upon seeing this, everyone was startled and hurriedly deployed their skills to resist, or frantically dodged and defended, instantly dissolving their initial offensive.
Outside the hall, flames erupted like a tempest, accompanied by constant roaring and exploding sounds that lasted for quite a while before subsiding.
The Dharma Manifestation Stage great powers managed to cope well, while among the Returning to Void Stage cultivators, several unlucky individuals got hit by the flames, leaving numerous scorch marks on their bodies, looking quite embarrassed.
This attempt undoubtedly ended in failure.
Following Wu Yu's proposal, everyone brainstormed and attempted several more times, but results were still fruitless.
"A seventh-level array has its own system, often able to repair itself and change formations. It usually doesn't have obvious flaws. Without a targeted array-breaking technique, such attempts are meaningless," Sima Changqin said.
Wu Yu remained silent, her beautiful eyes glimmering with a hint of regret.
Her predictive ability shows a very vague future, merely observing that the forbidden-breaking involves Yuan Ming, but exactly how to break the forbidden remains unknown.
"Fellow Daoist Wan, earlier in the Fire Rock Desert, you were ambushed by the Black River Four Foes. Since you returned safely, they must have been slain by you, right?" At this moment, Sima Changqin suddenly looked at Yuan Ming and asked.
Hearing this, Yuan Ming's eyebrows furrowed immediately.
He didn't understand why Sima Changqin would suddenly bring this up. Was it provocation, or settling scores?
Others heard this and their attention was drawn to the scene.
"What do you mean by asking this? Whether they are dead, doesn't your heart know?" Yuan Ming slowly replied.
"I wanted to ask, when they were besieging you, was the set of magic treasures they used the Four Mountains Linked Seal? Did that thing end up in your hands?" Sima Changqin ignored the displeasure in Yuan Ming's tone and continued to ask.
Yuan Ming said nothing, flipping his wrist, revealing four small mountain-shaped seals in his palm.
"Yes, that's the thing," Sima Changqin, seeing the Four Mountains Linked Seal, nodded and smiled.
Yuan Ming found his expression inexplicable, looking at Sima Changqin and said, "A great man should dare to act. Since you sent the Black River Four Foes to assassinate me, why do you make such a demeanor?"
"Sent the Black River Four Foes to assassinate you? Fellow Daoist Wan misunderstand, I haven't done such a thing. The Black River Four Foes were a menace, how could I be involved with such people?" Sima Changqin smiled slightly in surprise.
Yuan Ming, hearing this, stared intently at Sima Changqin.
Instead of defending, Sima Changqin's first reaction was confusion, which is not typical of a liar's language pattern.
Looking at his expression now, Yuan Ming also felt it wasn't intentionally faked.
Evidently, the one who sent people to assassinate Yuan Ming was really not Sima Changqin.
"Sorry, it was a misunderstanding on my part," Yuan Ming slightly cupped his hand and said.
But after saying it, he sank into a bout of confusion.
All this time, he always thought that the methods targeting him, including the ambush by the Black River Four Foes, were orchestrated by Sima Changqin. Unexpectedly, it was someone else.
But if not Sima Changqin, then who?
Since arriving at White Emperor City, Yuan Ming had kept himself secluded, not making enemies except with Sima Changqin. So who would go to such lengths to hire the Black River Four Foes to kill him?
Yuan Ming remained silent. Only after controlling Wang Fulong could he know the truth.
"Fellow Daoist Wan, since the Four Mountains Linked Seal is truly in your possession, we have hope of breaking the forbidden," Sima Changqin did not mind Yuan Ming's questioning and ignored his apology, continuing.
"Isn't the Four Mountains Linked Seal a set of spiritual treasures with both offensive and defensive capabilities? Does it have some special function?" Yuan Ming puzzled.
"You haven't refined this thing, right? As far as I know, the Four Mountains Linked Seal was crafted by a master from the Hui Clan known as 'Four Mountains Wanderer.' Their clan is very peculiar; even their divine souls differ from normal people. They can read classics at ten- to hundredfold speed of ordinary people and possess the ability to never forget, comprehending common knowledge swiftly, thus learning remarkably fast. It can be said that almost every member of their clan is learned and knowledgeable," explained Sima Changqin.
Everyone around, hearing about the "Hui Clan" for the first time, leaned in to listen.
"Thus, the Hui people love collecting all kinds of classics, whether they are cultivation techniques, secret techniques, formations, talismans, beast taming, or artifact refining, all these fields they delve into deeply. Once they specialize in one path, they often become leading figures in it. Four Mountains Wanderer, who refined the Four Mountains Linked Seal, is a prime example," Sima Changqin continued.
He then briefly introduced Four Mountains Wanderer's life, and everyone came to know that although his cultivation was not as high as Mahayana, he had reached the level of a seventh-level array master in array Dao comprehension, culminating in the first realm battle unexpectedly, fading into the river of history.
"The Four Mountains Linked Seal is the most precious innate spiritual treasure crafted by Four Mountains Wanderer during his lifetime. Rumor has it that while refining this treasure, his array Dao insights were fused into it, and it has always been regarded as an extension of the legacy he left behind. After Four Mountains Wanderer's demise, many who specialized in array Dao obtained the seal, trying to comprehend this legacy but, unfortunately, no one succeeded," concluded Sima Changqin.
"In whose hands did this seal ultimately ended up?" Yuan Ming asked.
"As far as I know, the Four Mountains Linked Seal ended up in the hands of the Taixuan Sect." Sima Changqin glanced at Yuan Ming and said.
"Taixuan Sect..." Yuan Ming furrowed his brows.
He had no connection with the Taixuan Sect, how could his assassination be linked to this prominent sect?
"Do you intend to use the Array Dao Inheritance within the Four Mountains Linked Seal to break the restriction of Xihe Palace?" Yuan Ming quickly ceased his thoughts and asked.
"Indeed, you should refine this seal as soon as possible, and carefully comprehend it, perhaps you might find a way to break the impasse." Sima Changqin nodded, glanced at Wu Yu, and said.
"In that case, I must bother Fellow Daoist Wan." Wu Yu had been silently listening to the conversation between the two, and now he nodded to Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming nodded, then sat cross-legged and began refining the four seals.
Being continuously purified by the Power of Ten Thousand Wood Origin, his mana was already extremely refined, almost exceeding the Dharma manifestation Stage, and his Divine Soul Power was exceptionally strong, thus the refining speed was very fast, quickly touching the rune formation within one seal.
Yuan Ming showed a look of astonishment, indeed the Four Mountains Linked Seal was different from ordinary Spiritual Treasures, which have rune formations composed of runes, the more runes the higher the level.
But the Four Mountains Linked Seal was different, the rune formation within this treasure was composed of array patterns, each rune formation had as many as three hundred and sixty array patterns.
Two array patterns were in a bright state, while the other three hundred and fifty-eight were dim.
Yuan Ming raised his brows slightly, and infused mana into the two array patterns.
The two array patterns quickly expanded, and after a few breaths, they exploded with a "bang", transforming into two miniature arrays, precisely the Silver Light Water Moon Trapping Array and Mountain Array that the Black River Four Foes used to ambush him.
Yuan Ming's eyes showed a sudden realization, as he infused mana into one dim array pattern.
The array pattern gradually brightened and quickly expanded.
Yuan Ming increased the mana infusion, soon breaking through a certain limit, the array pattern completely illuminated, and then with a "bang" it shattered, transforming into a miniature array.
This array seemed to be a kind of confinement array, reaching the level five standard.
He examined the miniature array for a while and withdrew his mana.
The three miniature arrays simultaneously shrank back into three array patterns.
"Indeed, the Four Mountains Linked Seal has such a great origin, it wouldn't be so simple; every array pattern within this treasure is transformed from an array." Yuan Ming's eyes flickered as he murmured to himself.
With this thought, he continued to infuse mana into other array patterns, quickly lighting them all up.
The arrays formed by these array patterns varied in level, the lowest being fourth-level arrays, and the highest being seventh-level arrays.
However, seventh-level arrays were extremely rare, with only one in the rune formation of this seal.
As for the effects of the arrays, all were confinement types.
The rune formation within the seal was also extremely mysterious, linking so many arrays together, even enabling them to be used in combination, the exquisiteness was unprecedented for Yuan Ming.
"No wonder the Black River Four Foes could deploy nested arrays, it turns out it was because of this." Yuan Ming suddenly realized.
He then operated the mana to refine the other three seals.
Yuan Ming focused on refining, not noticing the change occurring in the four seals, the color became more profound, and mysterious patterns emerged on the seals.
"I didn't expect him to truly comprehend the inheritance of the Four Mountains Wanderer!" Sima Changqin's eyes flashed with surprise upon seeing this scene.
The Four Mountains Linked Seal had been obtained by several Array Masters, even sixth-level Array Masters, yet none had acquired the inheritance of the Four Mountains Wanderer, how could Wan Tianren fathom it? Could this person's array formation cultivation possibly be approaching level seven Array Master?
Sima Changqin's mind flashed an image of Xi Ying, his eyes swept over with a shadow.
The others were not familiar with the Four Mountains Linked Seal, but seeing the transformation of the four seals at this moment, they speculated some aspect of it, several from the Demon Clan couldn't help but whisper among themselves.
"Silence." Wu Yu immediately stopped them.
She could see that Yuan Ming was currently immersed in comprehending the Four Mountains Linked Seal, pivotal to breaking the current situation, hence no disturbance could be tolerated.
Sima Changqin also gestured to maintain silence, and everyone closed their mouths.
For a moment, the entire outside of the great hall plunged into a deathly silence.
Sima Changqin sat cross-legged, gently stroked the strings of the zither, and strands of ethereal music reverberated around.
The ethereal music not only isolated the influence from the outside world but also seeped into the depths of the Divine Soul like gentle rainwater, making people become introverted and focused.

chapters.title: Chapter 958 - 923: Array Dao Inheritance
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming immersed himself in the various formations contained within the four seals, feeling as if he had entered a peculiar state beyond words.
He seemed to have traversed the constraints of time and space, suddenly standing at the scene where the Four Mountains Wanderer refined the Four Mountains Linked Seal.
Following the steps of the Four Mountains Wanderer, he began to sketch array patterns one by one, connecting them into formations bit by bit.
At that moment, he seemed to forget the passage of time.
After watching everything, he finally understood that the Four Mountains Wanderer left not just a set of spiritual treasures, but his understanding and inheritance of the formation path.
"Truly a genius conception..." After a long time, Yuan Ming slowly opened his eyes with a heart full of reverence.
As his eyes opened, Sima Changqin's music also came to a halt.
"How did it go?" Wu Yu asked first.
"Indeed, the insight left within the Four Mountains Linked Seal is the essence of the formation path of the Four Mountains Wanderer senior. I have already figured out some threads, but to fully comprehend it will require more time." Yuan Ming said.
"Have you really grasped the mystery of the Four Mountains Linked Seal?" Master Tantai couldn't help but ask.
"Of course." Yuan Ming nodded.
He felt that comprehending the secrets of the Four Mountains Linked Seal wasn't that difficult. Sima Changqin had said that these four seals had been acquired by multiple array masters, possibly Level 6 Array Masters, so why couldn't these people comprehend them?
"What is the wonder within the Four Mountains Linked Seal, could Fellow Daoist Wan let us have a glimpse?" Wu Yu said.
"Explaining this is complicated, and if detailed, it would take ten days and nights to finish. But Fellow Daoist Wu Yu need not worry, there are indeed methods to break arrays within it." Yuan Ming said ambiguously.
The Four Mountains Linked Seal was his possession; how could he divulge its secrets to outsiders?
"Although I have not refined the Four Mountains Linked Seal, I have heard about it from my sect seniors. It is said to contain the Four Mountains Wanderer's most prized four formation inheritances: the killing array, defensive array, trapping array, and breaking array, is that so?" Sima Changqin's voice suddenly sounded.
Yuan Ming glanced at Sima Changqin, his brow slightly furrowed, but still nodded.
The four seals contain different kinds of formations; the first seal is of the confinement type, the second is attack-oriented, the third defensive, and the last one is for breaking arrays.
Yuan Ming had already refined the Four Mountains Linked Seal, and except for the four seventh-level formations that were too mysterious and beyond his capability, he could freely summon and use the other formations.
With those four magical rune formations, he could also perform nested divine skills, embedding two or more formations together to form more complex and powerful arrays within arrays.
This inheritance was truly precious for an array master.
"No need to say more; can you break the array?" Flame Wolf King asked impatiently.
Yuan Ming did not answer but held up the Break Formation Seal with one hand, lifting it upwards.
In an instant, the seal floated up, hovering in front of the entrance to Xihe Palace.
Yuan Ming focused his gaze, hands waving, adjusting as if tweaking something, as strands of golden light flowed from the Break Formation Seal.
The golden lines intertwined in the air, forming one formation after another.
Every formation condensing represented a part of Yuan Ming's comprehension of the formations contained within the Break Formation Seal.
As his hands waved faster, more and more formations gathered in the void, soon reaching eighteen, all of the fifth and sixth levels, densely covering the sky above Xihe Palace.
Yuan Ming's actions came to a halt; with his current mana and formation cultivation, he could only simultaneously activate this many break formations.
The people below looked up, each revealing a look of surprise.
Each one of them had cultivated for hundreds or even thousands of years; although most had not deeply studied the formation path, their insight was not lacking, and they could see the exceptional nature of these formations.
The formations covering the sky interconnected, forming a giant cross shape.
Yuan Ming raised both hands, mana pouring into the Break Formation Seal.
All the large formations in midair were activated, and a grand cross-shaped brilliance descended, striking the rivet on the lower right corner of the palace door.
The forbidden outline on the door reappeared, then rapidly dissipated.
Others rejoiced and once again launched efforts to assist Yuan Ming in breaking the array.
The forbidden light screen quickly became thin, taking less than half the previous time to verge on collapse.
The crowd was greatly invigorated, enhancing their offensive to break the forbidden screen.
At this moment, the large array suddenly changed, with more mysterious array patterns emerging. Large circular patterns appeared on the forbidden light array, forming a new restriction.
Yuan Ming was not surprised, continuing to activate the eighteen formations, the giant cross-shaped light growing even brighter, striking the newly formed restriction.
The others didn't stop either, continuing their attacks, causing the new restriction to disperse again.
However, the newly formed forbidden barrier was even more resilient, and breaking it was evidently much more difficult, with speed slowing progressively.
Thus, it went on in cycles. When half of the forbidden barrier was dismantled, it completely stopped, and regardless of how Yuan Ming and others tried hard, there was no movement.
"Is this still not working..." Wu Yu looked serious.
"Fellow Daoist Wan, from what I know, the power of the Four Mountains Linked Seal to break formations is not just limited to this. Years ago, the Four Mountains Wanderer used this treasure to break the Great Demon Luo Chaos Array in the Demon World, which was a Level 7 Peak Array, far beyond what this forbidden barrier can compare to," Sima Changqin said.
"With my current abilities, I am temporarily unable to activate the Level 7 Array within the Four Mountains Linked Seal, hence the limited power I can mobilize, and the current power to break the array is just like that," Yuan Ming glanced at him and said.
Upon hearing this, the Flame Wolf King immediately looked disappointed, and the others couldn't help but sigh.
"I see, but this matter is not without a solution," Sima Changqin laughed heartily.
Everyone turned to look at Sima Changqin.
"Qin Demon, what do you mean by this?" Wu Yu asked.
"No matter how strong the Four Mountains Linked Seal is, it's still just a spiritual treasure. If Fellow Daoist Wan cannot control it at all, then my method is useless. Since you can understand it to this extent, the matter is much simpler," Sima Changqin said with a smile.
Yuan Ming frowned, puzzled by Sima Changqin's words.
Sima Changqin took out a Jade Scroll and handed it to Yuan Ming.
"This is a Sacrificial Refining Secret Technique called 'Mysterious Sect's Root Qi Skill.' It allows forcibly activating the rune formation within a spiritual treasure without refining it, exerting its power. As long as there is enough mana, it can forcibly activate the Four Mountains Linked Seal and unleash greater power to break the array," Sima Changqin explained.
"Forcibly activating a spiritual treasure... such a heaven-defying technique surely has considerable risks, right?" Yuan Ming said.
"It's not really about risks. Forcing the activation of the spiritual treasure consumes a lot of mana, three to ten times under normal circumstances, and may cause some damage to the rune formations within the spiritual treasure. However, you have already refined the Four Mountains Linked Seal, and are only unable to activate the Level 7 Array due to cultivation limitations, so there shouldn't be much damage," Sima Changqin explained.
With his explanation, everyone understood.
As long as everyone combined their forces, they could assist Yuan Ming in forcibly activating the Four Mountains Linked Seal to break the forbidden barrier.
"Fellow Daoist Wan, what do you think?" Wu Yu asked.
Yuan Ming thought it over and found this method feasible, so he said, "Let me set up an array to merge everyone's mana, then we'll proceed to activate the Four Mountains Linked Seal."
Everyone was only consuming mana and agreed.
So, Yuan Ming took out several array plates and array flags and began setting them up on the vacant ground outside the hall.
Before long, an advanced Melding Spirit Array was set up completely.
Yuan Ming called everyone into the array and seated himself at the forefront of the formation, with Sima Changqin and Wu Yu behind him, followed by the others seated in a branching sequence.
Then, Yuan Ming raised his hand again, and the Break Formation Seal flew up.
Yuan Ming's eyes focused intensely, starting to change the spell, activating the Four Mountains Linked Seal.
Distinct from before, this time, the cross-shaped Great Array instantly formed, like a magnificent colorful silk spread over Xi He Palace.
"Now's the time, go ahead," Yuan Ming called out softly.
Those who were ready began channeling their mana.
Suddenly, beams of mana light burst from everyone's bodies, transforming into streaks of light, converging along the Melding Spirit Array's patterns into Yuan Ming's body.
In an instant, a vast and boundless wave of mana surged from the Melding Spirit Array, causing nearby voids to distort, exceeding that even of Sima Changqin and Wu Yu, who were at the Peak of Dharma manifestation.
When this power converged into Yuan Ming's body, his eyes abruptly widened, his pupils shook violently, and an indescribable pain swept through him as if his whole being felt about to explode from the swelling of meridians.
"Fellow Daoist Wan, do not resist, do not hesitate. Our combined strength rivals that of a Mahayana cultivator, do not guide it into your Dantian; release it directly, or it will harm yourself," Sima Changqin's reminder came belatedly.
Yuan Ming inwardly cursed but didn't hesitate, following Sima Changqin's guidance, leading that overwhelming power into the Break Formation Seal, and operating the Mysterious Sect's Root Qi Skill.
With a muffled roar, the Break Formation Seal swallowed the mana rapidly like a whale, causing the Level 7 Array to rumble and activate.
A majestic formation emerged in mid-air, integrating with the already suspended cross-shaped formation.
The next moment, a sword-like golden light descended from the sky, shining on the gate of Xi He Palace.
Only then did the forbidden formation of Xi He Palace sense danger, lighting up fiery red glows everywhere, attempting to resist.
But it was too late, as the golden beam pierced the forbidden formation, quickly permeating inside.
The Forbidden Light Screen rapidly dissolved, flowing down like molten iron, until it vanished completely.
The Xi He Palace's forbidden barrier disintegrated in an instant.

chapters.title: Chapter 959 - 924: Heavenly Fire Trial
chapters.content:
"It's opened!"
The crowd, upon seeing this, was immediately overjoyed, with several people even cheering.
"It seems the prediction was correct, the key to breaking the prohibition indeed lies with him." Wu Yu, with eyes gleaming, looked at Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming also displayed a joyful expression, secretly clenching his fist within his sleeve.
His happiness was not only because the prohibition of Xihe Palace was broken, but also because he had mastered the use of the Four Mountains Linked Seal.
From now on, he could use a similar method to break the seventh-level array around the golden hall within the Stealing Heaven Tripod, completely unveiling its secrets.
At this moment, a red light shot out, colliding with the palace gate.
With a loud "bang," the gate was knocked open, and the red light shot inside.
"It's the Flame Wolf King, quickly, follow him!" Master Tantai was taken aback, transforming into a green light and giving chase.
The others also rushed in, flooding toward the hall.
Yuan Ming calmly put away the Breaking Array Seal and was the last to enter Xihe Palace.
As soon as he stepped into the hall, a golden light surged towards him, with scorching heat waves that obstructed his view, making it impossible to see clearly.
An extremely intense heat hit him, nearly driving him mad, his skin feeling as if it was about to burn.
He hurriedly summoned the Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter, releasing a red light shield to protect himself from harm.
Just then, a dozen figures swiftly flew out from within Xihe Palace, accompanied by groans of pain; these were more than ten Level 5 Demon Clan members, along with Gan Wenqing of the Daluo Sect and two elderly men in yellow robes.
These people were scorched by the intense heat, all looking disheveled and grimy.
The temperature inside the hall was too frightening, not a place for those at the Returning Void Level to casually enter.
Even the Dharma Phase beings inside the hall were extremely cautious, with Master Tantai wielding the Emperor Yan's Mysterious Fire Tripod, emitting a crimson glow that enveloped himself and Yang Fan.
Sima Changqin summoned the silver Flying Car from before to protect himself and three Black Demon members.
The members of the Ten Thousand Demon Country also each cast spells to protect themselves.
The Flame Wolf King, in particular, bore burn marks on his skin and scorched scalp, looking quite bedraggled and embarrassed.
This situation clearly showed that the Flame Wolf King had been the first to rush in, not anticipating the high temperature inside the hall, and suffered a setback.
Yuan Ming shifted his gaze to the inside of the hall.
The entire hall was quite spacious, not even featuring a single Stone Pillar. In the middle of the hall, hovering mid-air, was a cluster of golden flames, three feet in diameter.
"Great Sun Glaze Flame!" Master Tantai softly exclaimed, even with a slight tremor in his voice.
Everyone was equally drawn to the cluster of flames, their faces showing excitement.
Yuan Ming too looked over; the cluster of golden flames was clear as crystal, with an extremely dazzling golden sheen, resembling a miniature golden sun, embodying a masterful creation yet immensely perilous.
The golden flames emitted an all-consuming heat, causing the nearby space to warp.
"So this is the Heavenly Fire condensed by the Power of the Sun..." Yuan Ming couldn't help but be fascinated by the Great Sun Glaze Flame, sighing inwardly.
The hall was filled with terrifying heat, and the Power of the Sun here was incredibly rich.
Yuan Ming was ecstatic, looking at the golden glow filling the hall as if gazing upon a top-grade delicacy, almost drooling.
He executed the Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill, while all the roots of the Undying Tree plunged into the void, zealously absorbing and refining the Sun's power within the hall.
The rest of the crowd, eyeing the Great Sun Glaze Flame, also revealed greedy expressions but refrained from taking action.
The Great Sun Glaze Flame was a Heavenly Fire, invaluable yet extremely dangerous.
"Since no one dares to try, let me be the first." Wu Li, his eyes burning with eagerness, scanned the crowd.
No one replied.
"Be careful," Sima Changqin advised with a brief contemplation, nodding slightly.
"Rest assured, Lord Qinmo."
Wu Li formed a spell with his hands, conjuring a peculiar red armor enveloping his entire body, exposing only his eyes.
Yuan Ming's eyes sharpened, recognizing the armor made from sixth-grade spiritual material Fire Cloud Mysterious Iron, with golden array patterns interwoven across the red armor, forming a flame-resistant formation.
Wu Li leaped into the air, flashing to the vicinity of the Great Sun Glaze Flame, yet not too close.
A golden shadow flickered in his palm, manifesting a large net with a golden handle out of thin air.
The handle was adorned with golden patterns, and golden runes surfaced on the net, indicating it was a high-grade Spiritual Treasure.
"This is a Spiritual Treasure crafted from Fusang Wood, seemingly a replica of the Ancient Spiritual Treasure Divine Fire Net, clearly showing that Qin Demon prepared thoroughly." Wu Yu remarked with a smile.
Sima Changqin did not respond, his gaze fixated on the mid-air scene.
Wu Li formed a spell and pointed into the void, directing the golden net towards the hovering Great Sun Glaze Flame. The runes on the net lit up entirely, and a red misty light surged forth, enveloping the Great Sun Glaze Flame ahead of time.
The red light instantly evaporated upon contact with the Great Sun Glaze Flame.
The Great Sun Glaze Flame seemed to be provoked, its blaze surged upwards and touched the golden net bag.
This high-quality net bag turned to ashes in an instant upon contact with the flames.
Wu Li's face stiffened, gripping the net bag's handle dumbfoundedly, seemingly unable to believe that the spirit treasure he painstakingly prepared was utterly helpless.
"Watch out!" Sima Changqin's urgent voice suddenly rang out, as his figure shot over.
Wu Li snapped back to his senses, noticing a faint golden flame swiftly spreading along the net bag's handle.
He was horrified and immediately discarded the handle, retreating backward, but it was too late.
The instant the golden flames reached the back of his hand, they surged upward, releasing a booming sound of explosive combustion.
Wu Li was engulfed by the golden flames almost instantly.
The red armor covering his body could only emit a fleeting glow before turning into rubble, and Wu Li, hidden inside, didn't even have time to let out a cry of pain before he was completely reduced to ashes.
Even his Divine Soul couldn't escape, being utterly extinguished.
A shadow flickered near Wu Li, Sima Changqin appeared, ultimately a step too late.
This sudden turn of events shocked everyone once again; from the moment Wu Li attempted to seize the Great Sun Glaze Flame to being burned into ashes, it all happened in an instant.
"A Dharma Phase Cultivator couldn't withstand even a single breath in this Great Sun Glaze Flame; this is the power of Heavenly Fire!" Yuan Ming's pupils slightly contracted, feeling a chill in his heart.
Sima Changqin's gaze was slightly cold, his face solemn, lost in thought.
The Demon Cultivators of the Ten Thousand Demon Country like Wu Yu, despite their fear, revealed even more greedy expressions.
To them, the stronger the Great Sun Glaze Flame was, the more worthwhile their plans seemed.
Although everyone wanted the Great Sun Glaze Flame, Wu Li's ashes remained there, reminding them not to act rashly.
The hall was plunged into silence for a moment, with no one speaking.
Just then, a sudden yet ethereal voice rose, "Finally, you have come, the destined ones of mine!"
Hearing this voice, everyone was startled, searched around but found no trace of anyone.
Sima Changqin, Wu Yu, and Yuan Ming almost simultaneously looked up towards the Great Sun Glaze Flame hanging in mid-air.
Noticing their movements, others also directed their gaze there.
"Was it you just now?" Sima Changqin asked loudly.
"Naturally, it is this deity. Your courage and perseverance to break through layers of difficulties and enter Xihe Palace is commendable. Next, this deity will present a challenge, passing it will grant you my protection, and you may take Xihe Palace with you," the voice said again.
This time everyone noticed that the sound came from within the Great Sun Glaze Flame, their faces showing delight.
Their greatest fear was being in the dark; with this assessment, there's now a regular method, making things easier to handle.
"What kind of test?" Flame Wolf King asked impatiently.
"Very simple, stay inside Xihe Palace, enduring the scorching of the Great Sun Glaze Flame, and whoever persists to the end will own Xihe Palace and the Great Sun Glaze Flame. Those unwilling to participate should leave immediately," said the Great Sun Glaze Flame.
Upon hearing the words, everyone glanced at each other but none moved.
Clearly, no one was willing to give up at this moment.
"Senior, if I may be so bold, there are two matters I'd like to know, if possible?" asked a voice suddenly, which was from Yuan Ming.
"Speak briefly," the Great Sun Glaze Flame said.
"I wish to ask if senior is the spiritual intelligence derived from the Great Sun Glaze Flame? Do all Heavenly Fires possess spiritual intelligence?" Yuan Ming asked two questions entirely unrelated to the assessment.
"Hehe, you are quite interesting. As I am about to leave this place and am in a good mood, I will answer you. I am indeed the Fire Spirit of the Great Sun Glaze Flame. As for your second question, I cannot tell you the answer as I have never encountered other Heavenly Fires," said the Great Sun Glaze Flame.
Yuan Ming nodded and retreated.
"Very well. The assessment is about to begin, those who cannot endure may exit Xihe Palace, ensuring safety while losing the right to compete," the Great Sun Glaze Flame's voice sounded once more.
As soon as the words fell, the Great Sun Glaze Flame suspended in mid-air suddenly intensified, a fiery vortex forming in the center, spinning slowly while releasing waves of hot energy.
The temperature inside the hall immediately rose sharply, as rolling heat waves, like tangible objects, slammed into everyone.
Yang Fan, Electric Roc King, and Black Bear King instinctively stepped back towards the hall door.
However, they quickly realized that this slight movement made no difference to the intense heat inside the hall.
Yuan Ming, due to having Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter, better tolerated the heat, resisting the onslaught of heatwaves.
His Divine Power extended to investigate the vortex within the flame, but as soon as his Divine Soul Power left his body, it was instantly burned away by the terrifying heat.
His face slightly changed; his Divine Soul Power was utterly unable to spread.
And as the vortex within the Great Sun Glaze Flame spun faster, as if releasing more and more hot energy, the temperature in the hall abruptly doubled.

chapters.title: Chapter 960 - 925: Perseverance
chapters.content:
In the face of the terrifying high temperature rising continuously inside the hall, the Dharma Phase Cultivators present each utilized their techniques to resist.
Master Tantai pushed the power of Emperor Yan's Mysterious Fire Tripod to its utmost, its body glowing with a crimson light, continuously absorbing the surrounding heat, projecting a red light shield downward, isolating the fearful heat around.
Sima Changqin stood as usual, forming a spell with one hand in front of him, while a pale green light emanated from the ancient zither on his back, like swirling breezes, enveloping him.
Wu Yu simply placed her hands together in front of her and stood there quietly.
At a glance, it seemed she wasn't doing anything, nor did any treasure light up on her, yet the surrounding high temperature seemed to have no effect on her, unable to harm her in the slightest.
Yuan Ming, on the other hand, operated the Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter from his Dantian to resist the heat while secretly using the Undying Tree Roots to absorb the Power of the Sun inside the hall.
He couldn't completely block the heat's assault, so his physical body also endured indescribable burning pain.
However, this degree of scorching heat could no longer significantly affect Yuan Ming.
Standing behind Sima Changqin, Tie Xuan had at some unknown time taken out a broad Black Iron Heavy Sword, holding it with both hands in front of him, the sword emanating circles of white Sword Qi, constantly extending outward, repelling the heat.
Not far from him, the female Black Demon Shen Xiu pinched a strange spell with her fingers, a long water-blue Spirit Light Talisman flowing from her palm, wrapping around her in circles, emitting a cool glow, blocking the heat.
Yang Fan formed a sword technique with both hands in front of him, and suddenly a sword-shaped rune appeared on his forehead, emitting an unbelievably sharp aura, clearly a Sword Rune Dao Seal.
That Dao Seal emitted fierce Sword Qi, yet did not recklessly scatter, instead condensing outside Yang Fan, forming a sword-shaped phantom that enveloped him in the center.
The heatwaves coming from all around were shattered upon nearing that powerful sword-shaped phantom.
As for Xuan Ye, Electric Roc King, Black Bear King, and Flame Wolf King, the four demons did not summon Spiritual Treasures, relying instead on their demonic power or physical bodies to withstand.
Xuan Ye and Electric Roc King demonstrated their Dharma manifestations, with silver-white light gathering outside Xuan Ye, forming a Dharma manifestation nearly as tall as himself, enveloping him centrally.
The Dharma manifestation bore only a seven-tenths resemblance to him, appearing to wear a cloak of silver feathers, with the dazzling silver light similarly capable of isolating the scorching heat.
Behind Electric Roc King, a Thunder and Lightning Dharma Form appeared, with broad wings growing from its back, flashing with blue-purple electric light, covering its whole body.
Black Bear King displayed the Sky Demon True Body, his figure doubling in height, with rough, hard black hair like steel needles sprouting from his body, surging with blood energy, relying purely on physical strength to withstand the roasting of the Great Sun Glaze Flame.
As for Flame Wolf King, being a Fire Attribute demon beast, he gained the most advantage in this environment, neither displaying his Dharma manifestation nor using his Sky Demon True Body, simply circling demon fire around him to easily fend off the hall's high temperature.
Initially, everyone's condition was quite good, but after half an hour, the entire hall's temperature doubled.
The air inside the hall had turned into wispy, visible red heat, the floor, though not melted, had turned fiery red, with perceptible waves of heat rolling across it.
Under such an assault of heat, everyone's state began to vary.
Yuan Ming appeared to be the worst off, his entire body pitch black, with charred hair, and skin showing cracked patterns revealing bright red flesh, slowly oozing blood, looking like a bloodied figure.
The Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter was usually unmatched against ordinary flames but was obviously inadequate for dealing with the Great Sun Glaze Flame.
Fortunately, Yuan Ming's physique was strong enough; otherwise, the pain alone would have been unbearable. Besides, the hall was filled with the intense Power of the Sun, with the continued absorption by the Undying Tree Roots, his Physical Body Cultivation was also gradually increasing, though not yet ready for a breakthrough, the foundation being laid was growing more stable.
So while Yuan Ming looked tragic, in reality, he was using this special environment to continuously cultivate, absorbing the Power of the Sun while observing the conditions of others.
Sima Changqin maintained the posture of bearing the ancient zither on his back, seemingly in meditation, his expression appearing relatively relaxed, though the pale light from the zither on his back was now noticeably thicker than before.
Wu Yu showed no obvious changes and remained unperturbed.
Her gaze occasionally swept over everyone present, and upon seeing Yuan Ming, an unusual gleam flickered in her eyes.
As for the others, they were gradually starting to show signs of fatigue, especially Shen Xiu, Tie Xuan, and Yang Fan, the situation for these three Human Clan's cultivators was the worst.
Shen Xiu had already summoned a Dharma manifestation, which was quite peculiar, having thirty-six arms, each holding a Sixth-level Talisman, forming a talisman barrier to withstand the blazing heat.
Tie Xuan and Yang Fan had also summoned their Dharma formations behind them, Tie Xuan's being a seemingly solid Iron Man Dharma manifestation, appearing indestructible.
Yang Fan's Dharma manifestation, surprisingly, was not human-shaped, but rather a giant sword.
Tie Xuan and Yang Fan had also summoned several Spiritual Treasures for protection.
Unfortunately, even using so many methods yielded little effect; the three were ordinary Magic Practitioners with fragile bodies, now all flushed, trembling, evidently about to reach their limits.
Shen Xiu was the first to reach her limit, with the thirty-six talismans on her Dharma manifestation breaking apart inch by inch, her body igniting into raging flames, threatening to engulf her.
In panic, she flickered and directly fled from Xihe Palace.
Just as Shen Xiu's figure slipped out of the hall, the flames suddenly peeled off from her body, flying back into the hall and merging with the heat inside, dissipating from sight.
Although the flames returned to the hall, the scorched marks of burns on Shen Xiu's body did not vanish, and she hurriedly took out an elixir to heal, sitting cross-legged on the ground.
I don't know if it's because one less person is sharing the heat challenge, but after Shen Xiu retreated, the temperature inside the main hall suddenly rose again, and everyone felt like their very breath was about to spew flames.
After a moment, a miserable groan echoed.
This time, it was Tie Xuan who couldn't hold on anymore. His Iron Man Dharma manifestation had turned red from the flames, and his broad iron sword was the same, unable to insulate the heat, his hands nearly fused with the sword handle.
Just as the Sword Qi of the broad iron sword collapsed, his body also ignited in flames.
Tie Xuan wielded his sword and dashed out of the main hall, retreating.
Almost simultaneously, Yang Fan also retreated. His giant sword Dharma manifestation was nearly consumed by the flames. Before the fire could cause him harm, he fled from the main hall.
"Tie Xuan, are you alright?" Shen Xiu asked.
"No worries, our Human Clan's cultivators have weaker physical bodies, facing such a test is at a disadvantage." Tie Xuan took out an elixir and swallowed it, sighing.
So far, the Dharma Phase Cultivators who had retreated were all from the Human Clan, not one from the Demon Clan had backed down.
"Don't worry, with Lord Qinmo here, the Great Sun Glaze Flame will surely be subdued by him," Shen Xiu said.
"Of course," Tie Xuan immediately replied.
However, his tone lacked firmness, as if a sliver of doubt had formed in his heart.
Time continued to pass, about another hour went by.
The temperature inside the hall increased once again, and someone once more couldn't hold on; this time, however, it was three Demon Kings.
Xuan Ye's silver Dharma manifestation was also near collapse, his face flushed red.
The Electric Roc King had currents crackling all over his body, constantly relying on the strikes of the lightning to wipe out the surrounding fire power, but the ever-pervasive flames still eroded his body, burning patches of bald marks onto him like scrapes.
The Black Bear King had completely transformed into a giant bear several meters tall, shrouded in a layer of Blood Light. His surface condition was almost the same as Yuan Ming's, also cracking open with fissures, through which one could even see the flowing blood.
"If you can't hold on, there's no need to force it," Wu Yu said.
Xuan Ye and the three demons did not give up, choosing to grit their teeth and persevere.
Time ticked away with every drop, soon a quarter of an hour passed.
The excruciating pain seemed to stretch everyone's perception of time; evidently, it was just a quarter of an hour, yet the three demons felt like they had gone through a long year.
Xuan Ye was the first to give up; his Dharma manifestation was nearly destroyed, so he retreated timely.
The Electric Roc King's feathers had all been completely burned away, and before his physical body was set aflame, he darted out of the main hall.
As for the Black Bear King, he looked like he could endure for a while longer, but he did not force himself and also leaped out.
As a result, including Yuan Ming, only five people remained on the scene, namely Sima Changqin, Master Tantai, Wu Yu, and the Flame Wolf King.
The group of demons of the Ten Thousand Demon Country outside the hall did not look well. Originally, the number of the Demon Clan inside the hall had a definite advantage, but now with three falling behind, the Human Clan started to gain the upper hand instead.
"To hold out until now, you all are impressive. In that case, let me increase the difficulty a bit more." A voice descended again from mid-air.
Before the voice fell, the Great Sun Glaze Flame suspended in the center of the main hall suddenly surged, and piece after piece of glazed glass flame shot down from it, falling toward the ground.
The five remaining people inside the hall saw this and all darted to dodge.
As each cluster of glazed flames hit the ground, the already blazingly red floor flared up in a nearly transparent semi-glazed fire sea, engulfing everyone within.
Yuan Ming felt the heat suddenly spike, directly increasing five or six times compared to before. The Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter couldn't thoroughly isolate the Great Sun Glaze Flame, and now the situation was even worse.
Waves of scalding heat seeped into his body, beginning to destroy his internal organs.
Yuan Ming was taken aback, not daring to be careless anymore, he hurried to call on the Undying Tree Demon power to heal his body and withstand the destruction brought by the Great Sun Glaze Flame.
Surprisingly, he found that in this state, the enhancement of his Physical Body Realm unexpectedly began to accelerate.
After these glazed flames fell, indeed, the Power of the Sun inside the hall had become much more intense, but the impact shouldn't have been this great.
Yuan Ming couldn't figure it out and simply didn't bother to think about it, instead fully activating the Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter to shield himself, and frantically using the Undying Tree Roots to absorb the Power of the Sun.
His Physical Body Realm quickly advanced, soon reaching the peak of the late-stage Wanxiang Body, just a step away from breaking through to the Undying Body.
But as a result, from the outside, Yuan Ming looked even more miserable, his hair had turned to ashes, his whole body was entirely charred black, with large volumes of blood seeping through the cracked skin, turning into threads of Blood Mist evaporating under the burning heat, leaving behind hideous, prominent black and red blood cocoons.

chapters.title: Chapter 961 - 926: Heavenly Fire Takes Form
chapters.content:
Just when the onlookers thought Yuan Ming was going to be the next to withdraw from the trial, the other two found themselves in trouble.
Not far from Yuan Ming, the Flame Wolf King also revealed much of his true form, his enormous wolf head bared its teeth, exhaling scarlet flames, emitting heavy breaths.
Its abdomen, visible through its fur, showed a bright glow that flickered uncertainly, as if an energy was churning inside its belly, absorbing the dreadful heat within the hall to alleviate the damage it endured.
Even so, the Flame Wolf King gradually showed signs of pain.
