A condition similar to the Flame Wolf King was Master Tantai, who relied on the Emperor Yan's Mysterious Fire Tripod, a perfect fire attribute spiritual treasure, to support him thus far.
However, the Emperor Yan's Mysterious Fire Tripod had been burned bright red by the sea of flames, resembling freshly forged metal awaiting quenching, clearly reaching its limit.
A crisp sound of "crack" rang out.
An eye-catching crack appeared on the Emperor Yan's Mysterious Fire Tripod, spreading from the rim to the legs.
Master Tantai's expression changed drastically, without hesitation, he took the Emperor Yan's Mysterious Fire Tripod, transformed into a streak of red light, and dashed out of the hall.
At this moment, the Flame Wolf King emitted a reluctant howl from its throat.
His body was enveloped in flames, billowing black smoke, obviously no longer absorbing the flames of his own volition, but having exceeded his limit, being devoured by the flames in reverse.
With a howl, he strode out of the hall, the flames extinguishing along with him.
Thus, only Sima Changqin, Wu Yu, and Yuan Ming remained inside the hall.
Sima Changqin had lost his initial ease and comfort, now his eyes wide open, fingers forming a spell, the ancient zither behind him rippling with waves of blue light, carrying a unique rhythm, continuously dispersing the flames around him.
Wu Yu stood suspended in the air, her feet not touching the flames, unable to discern any measures she took, but her face gradually showed a solemn appearance.
As for Yuan Ming, he looked even more miserable, his whole body blackened like a piece of burnt charcoal; if not for the occasional slight twitching of his figure, everyone would think Yuan Ming had already burned to death.
Seeing this outside the hall, everyone's eyes flashed with disbelief.
Clearly, they were not surprised that Sima Changqin and Wu Yu stayed until the end, but it was unexpected that Yuan Ming lasted longer than the Flame Wolf King with fire attributes and Master Tantai with a heavy treasure protecting him.
"Master, that Wan Tianren can actually endure this far?" Yang Fan said incredulously.
"There is always a sky beyond the sky, and someone beyond every person. Anyone who comes here has some hidden treasures. But this person indeed hid very deeply." Master Tantai said indifferently, taking the Emperor Yan's Mysterious Fire Tripod into his dantian and nurturing it with mana.
"What is the background of this Wan Tianren?" The demons of the Ten Thousand Demon Country finally regarded Yuan Ming seriously, whispering among themselves.
Yuan Ming naturally noticed the strange gazes of those inside and outside the hall, but his physical body was at a crucial point of cultivation, unable to pay attention to much else.
Just then, the door of the Xihe Palace began to close, with the forbidden light screen quickly restoring, intending to completely trap Yuan Ming, Sima Changqin, and Wu Yu inside.
"What's going on?" The crowd outside the hall was shocked.
Seeing this, Shen Xiu quickly summoned a spiritual treasure to strike the door of the Xihe Palace, only to be easily rebounded, unable to shake it in the slightest.
The crowd suddenly recalled that the three main forces breaking the hall's restriction were now within the Xihe Palace.
"Damn it, this is a conspiracy!"
Inside the hall, Sima Changqin's pupils shrank, his right hand suddenly moved like lightning, grabbing the ancient zither behind him, plucking the strings with ten fingers.
Seven or eight blue sound blades several feet long shot out, instantly appearing before the rapidly closing hall door, and slashed down fiercely.
The blue sound blades struck the door, emitting several thunderous booms!
The entire Xihe Palace shook with it, yet the door remained unmoved.
"What is your intention? Why close the hall door?" Sima Changqin's face darkened slightly, looking up at the Great Sun Glaze Flame.
Yuan Ming, focused on refining the power of the sun within the hall, only noticed the abnormality at that moment, quickly stopping his cultivation.
Faced with Sima Changqin's questioning, the Great Sun Glaze Flame curiously fell silent, not uttering a word.
Yuan Ming furrowed his brows, using the Eyes of Golden Flame divine skills to probe the surrounding situation.
His eyes swept over Wu Yu, suddenly halting.
Wu Yu seemed perfectly normal, but his Eyes of Golden Flame was close to perfection, insight shocking, discovering that Wu Yu was indeed just an empty shell.
Sima Changqin noticed Yuan Ming's actions, his gaze fell on Wu Yu, immediately realizing the anomaly: "Heavenly Fox Illusion Clone! Fellow Daoist Wu Yu, is all this your conspiracy?"
"My apologies to you both, I did not wish to harm you, but for the future of my Demon Clan, I must ask you both to meet your end here." Wu Yu sighed.
As soon as her voice fell, her body burst open, transforming into sparkling, crystal-like white light, disappearing just like that.
At the same time, the Great Sun Glaze Flame in mid-air suddenly plummeted down, spraying tens of thousands of glazed-colored fireballs, scattering gracefully to the ground, merging into the sea of fire within the hall.
With a continuous thunderous roar, the sea of fire in the hall suddenly surged upward. The glazed-colored flames rapidly transformed, directly converting into the true Great Sun Glaze Flame.
The entire hall seemed to have been suddenly thrown into the scorching sun above the Nine Heavens, with the temperature uncontrollably rising frantically.
Those glazed flames, like living creatures, pounced toward Yuan Ming and Sima Changqin.
Beside Sima Changqin, the protective azure light that had just been able to block the sea of fire was instantly dissolved into nothingness with a "hiss" as it met the Great Sun Glaze Flame.
The Great Sun Glaze Flame resembled fierce beasts of tremendous might, opening their bloodthirsty mouths to devour Sima Changqin.
Sima Changqin's expression shifted slightly as his hands swiftly plucked at the zither strings.
Instantly, the sound of the zither, as if thunderous, resounded through the hall. The entire sea of fire trembled, and then invisible gusts of wind burst from the body of the zither, sweeping out around like surging waves.
The nearby void vibrated with a hum, raising ripples visible to the naked eye. The pouncing Great Sun Glaze Flame was the same, subsequently collapsing completely, extinguished by the zither's sound storm, creating a pure land several meters wide around Sima Changqin.
On the other side, Yuan Ming quickly formed a spell with his fingers, fully activating the Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter.
A flash on his Nascent Soul, the Dao Seal representing the Zhu Rong Heart Technique instantly appeared above his head, assisting the Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter.
Rings of red light emanated from the staff, shining on the Great Sun Glaze Flame around.
The greatest Divine Skill of the Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter is fire control. Now, with the Zhu Rong Heart Technique, the Ruyi Scepter's fire control divine skill advanced greatly, and the incoming Great Sun Glaze Flame quickly slowed down.
Finally, when it was still a foot away from Yuan Ming's body, the Great Sun Glaze Flame completely stopped.
Yuan Ming slightly relaxed his tense heart. With the power of the Great Sun Glaze Flame, just touching his body would burn him to ash in an instant, leaving no trace of life.
He continued to fully operate the Zhu Rong Heart Technique while also activating the Undying Tree Roots, brazenly beginning to absorb the Power of the Sun within the Great Sun Glaze Flame.
"Great Sun Glaze Flame, you, Heavenly Fire, born with the will of Heaven and Earth, value your oath above all, yet you violated your promise by colluding with the Demon Clan, deliberately leading us to our death. Are you not afraid of being tainted by karma and completely dissipating between Heaven and Earth?" Sima Changqin, after protecting his body, immediately questioned the Great Sun Glaze Flame loudly.
The Great Sun Glaze Flame gathered towards the center, quickly condensing into a golden figure.
It was a woman, with golden skin, looking quite graceful, her hair blazing with fierce glazed flames, exuding the majesty of an ancient fire god.
"Heavenly fire can take human form?" Yuan Ming thought silently.
"Today's matter is indeed a betrayal of my word. However, the previous Demon Emperor of the Ten Thousand Demon Country had shown me grace, and I must repay it. I ask the two of you to forgive me and to rest in peace!" The Great Sun Glaze Flame said coldly, lifting her hand mercilessly.
The Great Sun Glaze Flame in the hall surged, the glazed fire waves on the ground suddenly soared, crashing toward Sima Changqin like a giant wave.
Sima Changqin's face changed color, raising his hands to stroke the ancient zither in front of him. Instantly, a vast amount of azure spirit light surged from the zither strings, climbing up Sima Changqin's hands and covering his body in the blink of an eye.
Sima Changqin's body transformed into an azure light, merging into the ancient zither.
The ancient zither emitted bright spirit light, upon closer inspection, this spirit light was composed of countless rune particles the size of rice grains.
Immediately after, the ancient zither suddenly rose into the air, the strings playing by themselves.
Powerful and resonant zither tones poured out, instantly replacing all sounds in the hall. Explosions and burning sounds all transformed into beautiful zither music in that instant.
Along with the zither tones, numerous sound wave runes appeared, swirling and dancing around the ancient zither like a nebula, flashing wildly, dazzling to the extreme.
These sound wave runes encompassed an area over ten feet wide, forming an independent space.
All of this seemed complicated but was completed in the blink of an eye.
The glazed fire wave attacked, but as it entered the sound wave space, it halted as if frozen, unable to move.
"A Spiritual Domain... but it's incomplete!" The Great Sun Glaze Flame exclaimed in surprise, then sneered, pointing with a finger.
The flames in the hall gathered, forming a huge glazed-colored sun, smashing toward the ancient zither with a "boom".
However, that ancient zither suddenly wavered and disappeared, directly traversing the void, appearing before the wall not far away.
The zither tones from the ancient zither abruptly quickened, and the whole zither vanished into thin air, transforming into a wave of zither sound like a rampaging dragon, crashing against the wall.
The wall shimmered with forbidden light, revealing the seventh-level restriction on the door.
Under the fierce bombardment of the zither's sound waves, the restriction on the wall soon resonated, its light trembling in rhythm with the zither tones.
The zither's sound waves seemed to pass through the wall like an illusion, disappearing without a trace.
"To be able to deploy a Spiritual Domain with that ancient zither, could it be a Dao Treasure? No, it can't be a complete Dao Treasure, it must be a damaged Dao Treasure not yet repaired, otherwise, that Spiritual Domain wouldn't be so weak." The Great Sun Glaze Flame murmured to itself, looking in the direction where the zither disappeared.
A glint of unwillingness flashed in her eyes, but she ultimately had to accept the fact that Sima Changqin escaped, turning to look at Yuan Ming, the only one left in the hall.

chapters.title: Chapter 962 - 927: Stalemate of Heavenly Fires
chapters.content:
"Poor little creature, although Wu Yu regards you and that kid Tan Qin equally, it seems you don't have the same means as him. Better not to struggle, be obedient and save me from wasting effort," the Great Sun Glaze Flame said.
Yuan Ming didn't reply, continuing to fully employ the Zhu Rong Heart Technique, keeping the nearby Great Sun Glaze Flame at bay.
"Why waste your efforts?" The Great Sun Glaze Flame sighed lightly, reaching out with his right hand into the void.
The sea of fire in the hall suddenly surged, layers of flames converging at one point, the glazed firelight merging into one, and gathering like flowing water.
Yuan Ming watched this scene, his expression unchanged, yet his heart was extremely anxious.
The Great Sun Glaze Flame was Heavenly Fire, already beyond his capabilities.
Moreover, he had been calling out for Senior Kong from the beginning, with Kong's divine skills, he couldn't believe for a second that Kong was unaware of the danger here.
Since Senior Kong previously assured that entering the Three Realms Immortal Boat was safe, there must be a method to deal with this.
But despite his calls, Senior Kong had not responded at all.
"Senior Kong, I came in here because I listened to you. If you don't respond now, I'll have to hide inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod!" Yuan Ming transmitted coldly.
"Absolutely not, the Great Sun Glaze Flame is the Flame of Extreme Yang, the Stealing Heaven Tripod may not withstand it. Even if you hide inside, it will only hold for a moment longer!" Kong's voice immediately echoed.
"So, Senior Kong has finally shown up? I thought you had fled?" Yuan Ming said.
"How could I, I just had another urgent matter to attend to, but here I am now..." Kong chuckled.
"Enough, since you've appeared, if you have a way, hurry and tell me. Otherwise, both of us will perish here today!" Yuan Ming interrupted Kong's rambling, urging him.
At that moment, a muffled "boom" resounded.
The cluster of flames transformed into a Glazed Fire Tower, growing crazily in size at a speed visible to the naked eye.
In the blink of an eye, the tip of the tower nearly touched the ceiling of the hall.
"Senior Kong, do you have a solution or not?" Yuan Ming's heart tightened, shouting anxiously.
But the Great Sun Glaze Flame pressed the void, sending the massive Glazed Fire Tower crashing down on Yuan Ming.
Still, there was no response from Kong, Yuan Ming's eye twitched wildly, pouring mana into the Stealing Heaven Tripod on his arm, prepared to escape into it.
At that moment, a wave appeared in the void above Yuan Ming's head, and a large mass of white flame appeared out of nowhere, precisely the Bright Soul Fire.
The Bright Soul Fire instantly unfolded, transforming into a shield resembling a canopy, colliding with the Glazed Fire Tower.
No earth-shattering explosion occurred upon collision, yet the Glazed Fire Tower was blocked, unable to descend an inch.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming let out a sigh of relief.
He was not surprised that the Bright Soul Fire could block the Great Sun Glaze Flame, as the Bright Soul Fire was also a Heavenly Fire, naturally able to block another Heavenly Fire.
"I can use the Bright Soul Fire to temporarily block the Great Sun Glaze Flame for you, but the Bright Soul Fire's fighting power is far less than that of the Great Sun Glaze Flame, so I can only buy you at most an hour. You must achieve the Undying Body within this time, or we both face certain death!" Kong's voice came.
"Thank you, Senior Kong!" Yuan Ming thanked him, immediately activating the Zhu Rong Heart Technique, attempting to use the Bright Soul Fire to form a protective shield around him.
As soon as he thought of it, the Bright Soul Fire surprisingly spread on its own, forming an eggshell-like white fire shield, firmly protecting him without leaving a gap.
Yuan Ming was slightly taken aback, immediately realizing that there was consciousness within the Bright Soul Fire.
Pressed for time, he set aside those thoughts and closed his eyes, focusing entirely on controlling the Undying Tree Roots to absorb the Power of the Sun within the hall.
"Bright Soul Fire! This person's strength is insufficient to subdue you; why do you obey him?" the Great Sun Glaze Flame recognized the Bright Soul Fire, exclaiming in surprise.
Faced with the Great Sun Glaze Flame's inquiry, the Bright Soul Fire remained silent, like a dead object, offering no response.
"In that case, don't blame me for being merciless!" the Great Sun Glaze Flame said coldly, raising his hand to wave again.
The flames in the hall gathered once more, taking the form of a Glazed Fire Flood Dragon which lunged at Yuan Ming, striking the Bright Soul Fire Shield.
With a muffled "boom," the Bright Soul Fire Shield shook violently but soon stabilized.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming felt a surge of confidence, no longer distracted by the outside.
He cast a spell, summoning more Undying Tree Roots to pierce directly into the Great Sun Glaze Flame.
Although the Undying Tree was also a spiritual tree of Heaven and Earth, it was still far inferior to the Great Sun Glaze Flame. Especially since wood is naturally overcome by fire, most roots turned to ash upon touching the glazed flames.
However, part of Yuan Ming's Undying Tree had already transformed into the World Tree, including its roots. Being the Ancestor of Ten Thousand Trees, those roots imbued with the World Tree's power didn't burn and successfully absorbed the Power of the Sun from within the Great Sun Glaze Flame.
The Power of the Sun within the Great Sun Glaze Flame was exceedingly pure, containing a terrifying heat. As Yuan Ming absorbed it into his body, it was like swallowing a mass of searing flame, causing severe damage to all his meridians and internal organs.
He did not stop, activating the Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill to absorb this scorching Power of the Sun, while simultaneously calling upon the Undying Tree Demon Power to heal his damaged body.
Previously, his body was injured by the high temperatures of the Great Sun Glaze Flame, healing while absorbing the Power of the Sun to cultivate.
Amidst this cycle of destruction and rebirth, the enhancement of the Physical Body Realm accelerated significantly.
The current situation was similar to before, and the degree of the body's destruction and rebirth was even greater, potentially allowing for even faster enhancement of the Physical Body Realm.
The scorching heat inflicted significant internal damage, but the Undying Tree Demon Power restored it, and with the continuous influx of pure Solar power, Yuan Ming's Physical Body Realm rapidly improved once again.
"It's truly effective..." He was overjoyed and urgently continued to cultivate according to the current method.
"Damn it, what is this thing? How dare it steal my power!" The Great Sun Glaze Flame quickly detected the Undying Tree Roots' presence and immediately summoned more Glazed Glass Flames, attempting to incinerate it completely.
However, the World Tree Roots were exceptionally resilient, possessing terrifying regenerative abilities. Despite being burned several times, they could not be completely destroyed.
The Great Sun Glaze Flame's gaze fell upon Yuan Ming. By now, she naturally did not dare to underestimate Yuan Ming and could clearly see the source of those strange roots was Yuan Ming.
As long as this strange kid is dead, everything will end!
The nearby sea of flames surged, and three Glazed Fire Flood Dragons shot out, pouncing towards Yuan Ming.
The Bright Soul Fire around Yuan Ming suddenly soared, and with a clear cry, six large white firebirds emerged, flapping their wings to battle the Glazed Fire Flood Dragons.
Roaring and chirping instantly filled the air, with scales and feathers continuously falling and bursting into Fireballs.
Despite being three against six, the Glazed Fire Flood Dragons maintained the upper hand. However, the white firebirds weren't aiming to kill but to entangle the fire dragons relentlessly, preventing them from advancing a single step.
"Bright Soul Fire, do you truly intend to protect this Human Clan?" the Great Sun Glaze Flame berated.
The Bright Soul Fire remained silent, focused on dealing with the three Glazed Fire Flood Dragons.
"If that's the case, then let us settle this once and for all!" The Great Sun Glaze Flame's gaze turned icy.
No actions were needed; flames flashed in the sea of fire, and ten thick fire pillars surged into the sky, crashing solidly into the protective shield formed by the Bright Soul Fire.
Accompanied by a thunderous boom, dazzling glazed spirit light exploded on the shield, causing the Bright Soul Fire to tremble, showing signs of collapsing.
But just then, another burst of Bright Soul Fire tore through the void, quickly diving into the shield.
The shield on the verge of collapse instantly stabilized, even becoming considerably stronger.
The Great Sun Glaze Flame seemed unsurprised by this, continuing to cast spells, summoning all the Glazed Glass Flames within the hall.
Countless head-sized Glazed Fireballs shot into the sky, pounding onto the Bright Soul Fire's shield like raindrops, completely engulfing it with continuous explosions.
Time flew quickly, and it soon approached the half-hour limit.
Inside the Bright Soul Fire Shield, Yuan Ming's body ballooned, shrinking and swelling, as if he were a balloon.
The Solar power filled every inch of his flesh, constantly transforming his body with its scorching force, metamorphosing every inch of skin and every bone from the inside out.
The breakthrough to the Undying Body was now at a critical moment.
The Bright Soul Fire Shield protecting Yuan Ming had also reached its limit.
Under the relentless assault of the Great Sun Glaze Flame, the Glazed Protective Shield had thinned immensely, its flickering flame aura low, seemingly ready to extinguish at any moment.
In mid-air, the Great Sun Glaze Flame showed no joy, instead appearing somewhat flustered.
She sensed that, although the Bright Soul Fire Shield seemed on the brink of collapse, it could still hold for a while, but Yuan Ming inside the shield had already reached the verge of a breakthrough.
Perhaps in the next moment, he would completely break through, achieving the Undying Body.
In the past, she had encountered Body Cultivators with Undying Bodies; they were truly hard to kill. Moreover, Yuan Ming inexplicably gave the Great Sun Glaze Flame a sense of unease.
Mystically, she seemed to foresee that Yuan Ming's breakthrough would inevitably have a severe impact on her.
"Originally, I intended to reserve the Array to deal with that thing, but since you're so troublesome, you'll try it first." After a moment of hesitation, the Great Sun Glaze Flame quickly determined, trembling the void slightly to activate the Forbidden in the Xihe Palace.
The next moment, pale white spirit lights flared up on the palace walls, accompanied by a low chanting in the void.
Spirit lights emerged from the Xihe Palace floor, shooting numerous white chains at Yuan Ming, forming a Five-pointed Star Array.
This Array had five points, each emitting a powerful wave of Sealing Power, each distinct.
The five Sealing Powers merged into one, causing everything in the hall to freeze instantly, and the blazing flames seemed solid, ceasing all change. In mid-air, the fire dragons and white birds battling came to a standstill, scattered feathers and scales suspended in the air, never falling.

chapters.title: Chapter 963 - 928: Undying
chapters.content:
Facing the changes of the forbidden spells around him, Yuan Ming remained motionless, seemingly sealed.
The only thing unaffected was the bright soul fire on the Bright Soul Fire Shield.
This fire finally showed a trace of panic. As nearby void fluctuations surged, several more bright soul fires filled in, causing the flames on the Bright Soul Fire Shield to swell.
In the next instant, six thick pillars of fire suddenly erupted from the Bright Soul Fire Shield, crashing onto the chain array with a loud "boom," attempting to break it open.
"It's useless. This Nine Heavens and Ten Earths Sealing God Prohibition is a seventh-level restriction. Once activated, it can completely seal everything, including people's thoughts! This kid, even if he breaks through to the Undying Body, absolutely cannot break this restriction. No matter how much time you buy for him, what use is it?" The Great Sun Glaze Flame said with a cold smile.
The Bright Soul Fire, however, remained silent, still exerting all its strength to block the further contraction of the chain array, though it seemed hardly capable.
The chain array continued to press down, instantly confining Yuan Ming completely.
The Great Sun Glaze Flame seemed relieved, then looked at the Bright Soul Fire with surprise.
It was unexpected that the Bright Soul Fire could be unaffected by the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths Sealing God Prohibition, as this formation is a seventh-level great array, capable even of trapping Mahayana cultivators.
The seventh-level great array is already the pinnacle of formations, touching upon the mysteries of heaven's dao. Some great arrays can even directly summon the Power of Dao to assist, hence the seventh-level magic array is also called a Dao Array.
Yuan Ming was completely sealed. She raised her hand to break the Bright Soul Fire Shield and then kill Yuan Ming.
Just when the Great Sun Glaze Flame thought everything was settled, the void around her fluctuated, and seven to eight Undying Tree Roots emerged without warning, piercing into her body like lightning.
The Great Sun Glaze Flame recognized these roots, showing a look of surprise.
The Nine Heavens and Ten Earths Sealing God Prohibition had already been fully completed, the person ahead should have been sealed, so how could he still launch an attack?
The Great Sun Glaze Flame, though surprised, did not lose her composure, and was about to activate the True Fire to incinerate the roots.
But at that moment, she realized that her body was inexplicably unable to move, seemingly also confined by an exceedingly powerful force of restriction.
"What's going on... This is the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths Sealing God Prohibition... Why am I... also confined..." The Great Sun Glaze Flame was both shocked and furious, but could not utter a sound, her thoughts also becoming sporadic.
Inside the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths Sealing God Prohibition, Yuan Ming's body also remained motionless, but inside his Dantian, the Nascent Soul could move freely.
The many Dao Seals on the Nascent Soul were now radiating brilliantly, activating all the Power of Dao, temporarily isolating the influence of the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths Sealing God Prohibition.
"The Power of Dao is indeed miraculous, able to even resist a seventh-level great array." The Nascent Soul's little person wore a look of delight.
The Undying Tree was right next to the Nascent Soul, and was also protected along with it, allowing Yuan Ming to use the Undying Tree Roots to perform the Shared Life Divine Power, borrowing the power of the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths Sealing God Prohibition to reverse-confine the Great Sun Glaze Flame.
"Not bad, knowing how to make practical use of divine skills! But the Bright Soul Fire is about to reach its limit. Without its protection, your body will be turned to ashes by the Great Sun Glaze Flame in the blink of an eye, rendering any divine skills useless. You don't have much time; only by advancing to the Undying Body can you contend with the opponent." The voice of the Void echoed.
How could Yuan Ming not understand this? For some time, he had been desperately trying to advance, getting closer to the Undying Body, yet always a step away from breaking through.
"There's no time left. If failure means death, then I might as well gamble everything!" A fierce determination flashed in his eyes, and he manipulated the Undying Tree Roots to directly devour the Great Sun Glaze Flame.
A force of the Sun, several times purer than the nearby sea of fire, flowed along the Undying Tree Roots, merging into Yuan Ming's body.
Golden flames emerged on his body, interspersed with threads of Glazed Glass Flames, precisely from the Great Sun Glaze Flame.
Under the baking of the Great Sun Glaze Flame, Yuan Ming's body rapidly withered, apparently turning into dried bones, with darkness flickering in his vision.
The Undying Tree's powerful regenerative abilities took effect, and he drove the Demon Image Prison Suppression Skill to the extreme, absorbing this remarkably pure force of the Sun.
His shriveled body gradually stabilized, then began to fill out again, as he returned from the brink of death.
"So it is: life is death, death is life, neither living nor dying, neither dying nor living, placing oneself at death's door before reviving, this is the true intent of the Undying Body!" Yuan Ming, after a journey through the path of life and death, displayed an expression of enlightenment.
He fully unleashed the Power of Dao on the Nascent Soul, temporarily restoring his ability to move, and inhaled sharply.
The surrounding Power of the Sun, as well as the flames of the Great Sun Glaze Flame, surged toward him like a tide, pouring incessantly into his body.
Yuan Ming's body quickly expanded, turning into a massive burning balloon.
The enormous Qi Blood Power within him rotated rapidly, forming a vortex akin to the Primordial True Skill, refining everything.
The Divine Soul Power within the Sea of Consciousness was also absorbed by the Qi Blood vortex, yet Yuan Ming did not stop it; on the contrary, he released soul crows, allowing the Qi Blood vortex to devour and refine them.
He had long understood from various classics, Xi Ying, and the Void that breaking through to the Undying Body required the involvement of the Divine Soul.
With a thunderous explosion, Yuan Ming's body suddenly burst apart, shattering into countless scattered blood lights.
Outside the great array, due to the Shared Life Divine Power, the Great Sun Glaze Flame's body also exploded, turning into countless fragments of flame, drifting away, yet she thus rid herself of the Shared Life Divine Power's influence.
"Damn it, he still managed to break through..." The Great Sun Glaze Flame was both shocked and furious.
Her true form was flames, so naturally, she would not perish because of this. She endeavored to gather the scattered flames to reform her body.
Within the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths Sealing God Prohibition, countless blood light quickly gathered, reshaping form, soon condensing into Yuan Ming's body again.
"This is the feeling of the Undying Body... it's quite mysterious!" Yuan Ming looked at his own hands.
His physical strength had multiplied several times, incomparable to before; he could suppress his previous self with just one hand.
The enhancement of power was secondary; his body transformed into a state that seemed both void and tangible, both real and unreal. When condensed, it became a divine and demonic body, capable of suppressing all; dispersed, it could turn into countless blood light and scatter across the heavens and the earth, enough to evade any attack.
More importantly, every strand of qi blood and every drop of blood in Yuan Ming's body seemed like an independent entity, fully bearing his consciousness and memories. Unless someone could utterly annihilate him in an instant, he could rebuild his physical body from any remaining fragment.
Such a body could be called Undying and Immortal!
Yuan Ming was perceiving the transformation of his body when a "boom" sounded, and a vast amount of mysterious spirit light descended from above—this was the Power of Dao.
The Power of Dao that descended this time was even greater than during his breakthrough to Dharma manifestation; all his divine skills within were greedily absorbing it.
The Dao Seals of Dream Butterfly Illusion Technique and Zhu Rong Heart Technique grew considerably larger, with the contained Power of Dao increasing in turn, naturally further advancing the power of the divine skills.
As for those yet to condense Dao Seals, they were absorbing the Power of Dao at the moment, swiftly advancing towards the Perfect Realm.
Yuan Ming's eyes emitted fluctuations of Power of Dao, with golden Dao Seals shaped like pupils forming in each eye—these were the Fire Eye Golden Eye Dao Seals.
During his previous breakthrough to the Dharma manifestation Stage, this divine skill was on the verge of perfection; now it finally took the last step.
His eyes emitted two beams of golden light; his eyesight underwent an earth-shattering transformation.
Almost simultaneously, an intricate sense arose within Yuan Ming, clustering and forming a Dao Seal intertwined with chains.
This was the Shared Life Divine Power, reaching the Perfect Realm at this moment, condensing into a Dao Seal.
The mana vortex within his Dantian devoured the Power of Dao, finally undergoing metamorphosis, condensing into a vortex-shaped Dao Seal.
This was the Primordial Dao Seal, looking most peculiar, consisting of seven smaller Dao Seals, representing the seven streams of mana within his Dantian.
The divine skill of the Primordial Dao Seal is refinement, issuing an astonishing tearing force between the turning seals like a black hole, capable of crushing any spiritual power and swallowing it whole.
"Three more Dao Seals condensed; it feels wonderful!" Yuan Ming rejoiced inwardly.
The numerous Dao Seals he refined; several have undergone two consecutive transformations, containing Power of Dao far surpassing the ordinary Dao Seals condensed by a Dharma manifestation Cultivator.
At this moment, the Power of Dao surrounding Yuan Ming had grown visibly strong, seemingly spreading outwards, thoroughly counteracting the influence of the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths Sealing God Prohibition.
"This one's accumulation is truly formidable; having just broken through Dharma manifestation, achieving the Undying Body, the Power of Dao he wielded already reached this level, almost forming the embryonic state of a Spiritual Domain..." Within the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space, Void couldn't help but praise.
The Power of Dao finally halted, and Yuan Ming's body stopped transforming.
This series of transformations, though complex in description, happened within just a few breaths.
Yuan Ming slightly clenched his fist, feeling the power mastered after cultivating the Undying Body, filled with immense satisfaction.
Now, his physical body had no weaknesses left; whether Sima Changqin or Wu Yu, they could no longer pose a true threat to him.
As long as he didn't face a Mahayana-level entity, he feared no one!
"Excellent! You didn't disappoint me, but don't rush to be happy, your troubles aren't over yet," Void's voice sounded again.
"I understand, let's get out first!" Yuan Ming roared, raising his right hand.
Just at this time, several explosive sounds echoed; the Bright Soul Fire Shield finally couldn't withstand the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths Sealing God Prohibition, completely shattering under the pressure of the Sealing Chains and vanished without a trace.
Yuan Ming didn't care; he merely clenched his five fingers, and a terrifying force abruptly erupted, attacking the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths Sealing God Prohibition directly.
Outside the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths Sealing God Prohibition, the Great Sun Glaze Flame had just condensed her body.
Seeing Yuan Ming's action, her complexion tightened, and she immediately performed casting.
Within the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths Sealing God Prohibition, countless Sealing Chains shot out, rushing towards Yuan Ming from all directions.
Yuan Ming raised his arms, slightly blurred them, transforming them into layers upon layers of fist shadows, knocking all those Sealing Chains away.
The Sealing Chains of the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths Sealing God Prohibition were originally extremely orderly; at this moment, Yuan Ming's chaotic strikes caused significant disorder in the Formation.
He took a slight breath, letting loose a punch with his right arm glowing with blood light, seemingly slow but actually fast.
A massively condensed giant fist shadow appeared, slamming fiercely into a weak spot of the Formation.
In the next instant, countless blood-colored radiance erupted from the fist shadow, engulfing the chains, unleashing world-destroying force, exploding with deafening blasts.
The Sealing Chains attacked by the fist shadow were covered with dense cracks, seeming on the verge of collapse.

chapters.title: Chapter 964 - 929: Another Xihe Palace?
chapters.content:
"Shared Fate!"
Yuan Ming shouted in a low voice, his left fist striking out again, tracing an arc in front of his chest, only to slam into his own chest.
His body instantly exploded, turning into a disordered mass of blood light.
At the same time, the sealing chains that had appeared with cracks also exploded, producing a "boom" sound as they blasted a hole in the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths Sealing God Prohibition.
This was the new ability produced after the Shared Life Divine Power condensed into a Dao Seal; the target of Shared Fate was no longer limited to living beings, it could also be applied to prohibitions, Magic Treasures, and other non-living entities.
The Nine Heavens and Ten Earths Sealing God Prohibition, after all, is a seventh-level restriction. Not only did it not collapse, but spirit light flashed, and the sealing chains in other places instantly surged, rushing to the hole to try to fill it again.
However, Yuan Ming's movements were faster, and as his body transformed into a wavering mass of blood light, he took advantage of the hole before it disappeared, flying directly out, escaping the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths Sealing God Prohibition, reconsolidating his physical body, and donning a new robe.
Now, Yuan Ming, unless facing an existence whose cultivation far exceeds his own, or being completely sealed within a space, and then directly smashed to bits through thunderous means, it was difficult to be completely annihilated.
Great Sun Glaze Flame didn't expect Yuan Ming, after breaking through the Undying Body, to have his divine skill reach such a level, capable of instantly escaping the confines of the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths Sealing God Prohibition.
She wanted to stop him but was already a step too late, her expression exceedingly unpleasant.
"Haha, next let's join forces to meet this Great Sun Glaze Flame!" Kong laughed heartily.
"The Undying Body can only resist the burning of the Great Sun Glaze Flame, but to suppress this fire, I fear it's difficult." Yuan Ming transmitted his voice back.
"Ha, you don't need to worry about that; I have my own ways!" Kong chuckled softly.
As soon as these words fell, Yuan Ming suddenly felt a warmth in his dantian. Looking down, he saw a faint gray talisman inside him, mist swirling around it, making the runes engraved upon it obscure, emanating strange waves of the power of the Dao.
"Is this a Seventh-level Daoist Talisman?" Yuan Ming asked.
Like formations, when talismans reach the seventh level, they also contain the power of the Dao, thus being called Dao Talismans.
"This talisman is named Stealing Heaven Talisman. You need only plant it in the core of Great Sun Glaze Flame to collect this fire and make it serve you," Kong explained.
Yuan Ming's eyes lit up, and without waiting for Kong's urging, he immediately got up and rushed toward Great Sun Glaze Flame.
"Just in time!"
Great Sun Glaze Flame shouted angrily, her figure flickering in mid-air, sending out several rippling glazed fire rings instantly, aimed at Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming didn't dodge but raised his hand to slap down on the fire rings.
However, the glazed fire rings suddenly sprouted several sharp fire blades, piercing through before Yuan Ming's hand could exert force, furthermore burning his hand to ashes as it dispersed in the void.
Yet Yuan Ming was indifferent, a flash of blood light at his wrist, his hand instantly restored to its original state, continuing to strike down with a palm.
A dull boom resounded as several fire rings were sent flying, subsequently exploding.
Meanwhile, his figure continued to shoot forward, now only three or four yards away from Great Sun Glaze Flame.
Great Sun Glaze Flame raised a hand and flicked, and in mid-air, a glazed-colored sun the size of a millstone emerged, directly colliding with Yuan Ming's head.
This time, Yuan Ming didn't even bother to resist, continuing to fly forward.
A soft "hiss" sound was heard, his head instantly turned to ash, only to recover to its original state just a breath later.
As Yuan Ming flickered, he found himself in front of Great Sun Glaze Flame, punching toward her chest, his fist wind condensed as if tangible, resembling a sword or blade.
Great Sun Glaze Flame opened her mouth and spat, a torrent of glazed flame surged out, turning into a sea of fire engulfing her body.
Subsequently, as the glazed fire sea swelled, it transformed into a gigantic fire wave over ten yards high, rolling relentlessly toward Yuan Ming, nullifying his sharp fist wind.
Yuan Ming's face remained expressionless, activating the Six Jia Qimen Dao Seal within his dantian, his figure blurred and disappeared, appearing behind Great Sun Glaze Flame the next moment.
His fist continued to strike out, blurring for a split second, then penetrating her body.
While puncturing Great Sun Glaze Flame's body, Yuan Ming retrieved the Stealing Heaven Talisman, leaving it within her.
There emerged several gray lines, swiftly spreading across Great Sun Glaze Flame's body, covering her entirely soon enough.
These gray lines seemed to possess a binding ability; Great Sun Glaze Flame remained motionless.
A flicker of unusual color appeared in Yuan Ming's eyes as he was about to transmit his voice to communicate with Kong, when before him, Great Sun Glaze Flame suddenly broke apart, transforming into points of firelight scattering away.
The raging sea of fire within the grand hall extinguished, and the once frightful high temperatures rapidly decreased.
"Escaped?" Yuan Ming raised his eyebrows.
The Great Sun Glaze Flame restricted by the Stealing Heaven Talisman just now was clearly a shell; the true form most likely fled upon sensing the talisman.
"Alas, each Heavenly Fire is craftier than the last; this flame must still be within the Spiritual Treasure Space. Let's catch it the next time we encounter it," Kong said regrettably.
Yuan Ming nodded slightly, silently cursing his own carelessness. Obviously he had condensed the Fire Eye Golden Eye Dao Seal, yet he hadn't used it.
If he had used the Fire Eye Golden Eye from the start, he would surely have discovered the Great Sun Glaze Flame's attempt to escape.
He flashed to the palace gate, and whether it was due to the Great Sun Glaze Flame's departure, the Inner Sect's Forbidden restriction had ceased. He raised his hand and opened it.
Yuan Ming's figure flew out, but the Great Sun Glaze Flame was already nowhere to be seen.
At this time, there were also no other figures outside Xihe Palace.
Not only that, the dazzling white flames above the canyon had disappeared without a trace, leaving the canyon empty with only Xihe Palace standing there alone.
Yuan Ming frowned slightly, both because of the change in the outside environment, and because it was unexpectedly empty outside.
From the time he was locked in Xihe Palace until now, an hour had passed, and it wasn't surprising that others had left. But even the Ten Thousand Demon Country hadn't left anyone to check the outcome. Were they so confident in the Great Sun Glaze Flame?
Yuan Ming flew into the air above the canyon and turned around, discovering that the flames of the entire mountain range had vanished, and the temperature had dropped significantly. The previous scene of raging flames seemed like a dream.
"How could this be?" he found it strange, manipulating the Undying Tree Root to inspect the underground Spirit Vein.
The abundant Fire Spiritual Power within the underground Spirit Vein had now diminished by ninety percent, and the remaining Spiritual Power was quickly flowing toward the southwest direction.
Yuan Ming looked over there, but returned without exploring further.
Previously, he had pursued the direction of the Spirit Vein to find the Great Sun Glaze Flame, ultimately wanting to use this flame's power to enhance his Body Cultivation Realm. Now that he had broken through to the Undying Body, his desire to seek out the Great Sun Glaze Flame had waned.
Moreover, the sudden shift in the Spirit Vein signified another significant change in this space, and Yuan Ming did not want to get involved with it.
His primary goal now was to find the Abyss Nether Stone of unknown whereabouts, and then contact Xi Ying.
Whether it was the plot of the Ten Thousand Demon Country or the betrayal of the Great Sun Glaze Flame, these matters were for the Guardian Sima Changqin to address, not for Yuan Ming to toil over.
With this thought in mind, Yuan Ming flew back into Xihe Palace. With the departure of the Great Sun Glaze Flame, the temperature in the palace had returned to normal, all other restrictions had stopped, except for the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths Sealing God Prohibition which continued to operate, sealing the area where Yuan Ming had previously been.
The hole that Yuan Ming had struck in the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths Sealing God Prohibition had vanished without a trace, and the restriction was now operating smoothly, as if it had never been damaged.
Yuan Ming looked at this restriction and couldn't help but praise the Formation's ingenuity. If it weren't for the sufficient Dao Seals within him, he would have been sealed, possibly even fallen.
Yuan Ming quickly withdrew his gaze, released his Divine Sense, and simultaneously used the Fire Eye Golden Eye to search within the palace.
This Xihe Palace was set with a Seventh-level Restriction, it certainly wasn't an ordinary place, and perhaps there were treasures inside.
Unfortunately, after searching around, he still found nothing.
Yuan Ming was a bit hesitant; such a large palace shouldn't have been so empty.
But since the Great Sun Glaze Flame had already colluded with Wu Yu, it indicated that the people of the Ten Thousand Demon Country had surely entered Xihe Palace in advance and perhaps taken everything from here, leaving only this empty hall as a trap.
Yuan Ming was still unwilling to give up, so he searched the hall once more.
This time, he was not only looking for hidden treasures but also examining the hall's restrictions.
The Great Sun Glaze Flame had previously said that this palace was also a reward; perhaps this Xihe Palace was a Spiritual Treasure that could be taken away.
However, after another round, Yuan Ming still found nothing, and there was no sign of Xihe Palace being a Spiritual Treasure. It seemed the previous words were just the Great Sun Glaze Flame's nonsense.
He sighed, glanced at Xihe Palace one last time, just about to leave when his body suddenly paused.
A thread of Golden Light shone in his eyes, and he flew directly to the plaque of Xihe Palace, scrutinizing it up and down.
The plaque originally had only the three large characters "Xihe Palace," but now, outside of the three characters was an additional faint golden outline, which could not be seen without using the Fire Eye Golden Eye.
He approached for a closer look and discovered that the outline was actually composed of tiny runes.
Yuan Ming pondered slightly, raised his hand to press the plaque, and injected his Mana into it.
In an instant, the tiny runes on the plaque lit up one after another, and with a flash of Golden Light, Yuan Ming felt a wave of transporting power envelop him, and as his vision blurred, he appeared inside a grand hall.
"This seems to be another Xihe Palace?" he looked around and quickly recognized it.
However, this time the Xihe Palace was no longer empty; on either side of the hall were rows of silver lamps with flames, emitting a warm and bright glow.
The silver lamps holding the flames flickered with spirit light and had been refined into Magic Treasures, seemingly of high grade.
In the center of the hall stood a lifelike Golden Qilin Statue with its head held high, exuding an aura of authority with its golden eyes, as if gazing at nothing and watching the newcomer simultaneously, compelling submission and reverence.
In front of the Qilin Statue was a table carved from Gold Silk Spirit Wood, emitting threads of golden spirit light, which also turned out to be a Magic Treasure.
On the table lay a foot-high red Stele, exuding a faint treasure glow, appearing to be an Exotic Treasure.
The Stele was inscribed with countless tiny gold characters the size of grains of rice, not in the language of the Human Clan, but in the demon script used only by the Ten Thousand Demon Country.

chapters.title: Chapter 965 - 930: I Have Two Conditions
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming retracted his gaze from the stele, looked around, cautiously extended his divine sense, and approached the red stele to investigate carefully after confirming there were no traps around.
The next moment, he was surprised to find that his divine sense would vanish instantly upon touching the stele, without receiving any feedback at all.
Instead of being alarmed, Yuan Ming was delighted and used his Eyes of Golden Flame to inspect the stele, soon revealing a look of surprise and joy.
This stele was filled with spirit light and treasure radiance, clearly a rare heavy treasure, in no way inferior to the Emperor Yan's Mysterious Fire Tripod.
"Could this be a Great Perfection Spirit Treasure?" Yuan Ming immediately walked over and attempted to refine the stele.
However, after a long effort, he could hardly refine any of it, as his mana could not penetrate it at all.
"Don't waste your energy; with your current power and without the Dao Treasure Formula, it's impossible for you to refine me." Just then, a gentle voice suddenly emanated from the stele.
"Are you the artifact spirit of this stele?" Yuan Ming was secretly surprised and asked unperturbed.
"Exactly, I am the artifact spirit of the Xi He Tablet, you may call me Xi Hezi." Along with the words, a female silhouette emerged from the stele.
She appeared to be in her late teenage years, dressed in red, with a slightly chubby face, looking quite cute, though there was a lazy and indifferent expression on her face, as if she hadn't had enough sleep.
"I am Yuan Ming, pleased to meet you, Fellow Daoist Xi Hezi." Yuan Ming, seeing her aura tied to the stele, was certain she was indeed the artifact spirit and greeted politely.
"What's with the fellow Daoist? I don't like formalities, just call me Xi Hezi. Let's be straightforward, do you want to take the Xi He Tablet away?" The red-clothed girl stared at Yuan Ming and said bluntly.
Yuan Ming was taken aback by Xi Hezi's directness, but he also got a sense of her personality from this and nodded to acknowledge, "That's right."
"I find you somewhat agreeable, so I can reluctantly allow you to take the Xi He Tablet. But I have two conditions; if you don't agree, I won't recognize you, much less assist you in activating the Xi He Tablet." Xi Hezi waved her hand, speaking rather nonchalantly.
Yuan Ming was stunned, starting to discuss the conditions already? This was much easier than expected.
He thought Xi Hezi would test his divine skills, character, etc.
"Please speak directly." Yuan Ming raised his hand and said.
"First, I hate combat the most in my life, so unless it's a matter of life and death, don't use me for fighting. Of course, as a trade-off, I can help you refine various spiritual treasures for combat." Xi Hezi raised a finger.
Yuan Ming looked at Xi Hezi, feeling like he had met a simpleton. This was no condition at all; given the grade of this stele, even without Xi Hezi saying it, he wouldn't casually use it for combat. Xi Hezi was even offering treasure refining in compensation, fearing he wouldn't be pleased.
"Of course, no problem. Xi Hezi, you are skilled in artifact refining?" Yuan Ming nodded immediately and then asked.
"What do you mean skilled? I love artifact refining! My master also said I have a talent for it. Unfortunately, there's nothing in this place. Once we get outside, if you have anything that needs refining, just hand it to me. No need to prepare an Artifact Refining Furnace or True Fire, the Xi He Tablet has a refining treasure space I've opened, with everything needed…" Xi Hezi's eyes lit up instantly, prattling on ceaselessly about artifact refining.
Yuan Ming listened patiently, then glanced at the silver lamps holding the candles in the hall and the table in front, understanding why Xi Hezi was so ready to leave with him.
It seemed Xi Hezi was an artifact refining enthusiast; the silver lamps and tables in the hall were probably made by her in her spare time.
Such an artifact refiner certainly wouldn't want to stay in this place.
"As for the second condition, I've already mentioned I love artifact refining, so you must provide me with the materials needed for researching artifact refining." Xi Hezi continued.
"No problem, I can agree to both conditions." Yuan Ming agreed directly without thinking.
He was currently in need of a trustworthy artifact refiner, making Xi Hezi's two requirements exactly what he wanted.
Yuan Ming's expression changed suddenly; he took out the Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter.
"Xi Hezi, since you are proficient in artifact refining, I happen to have a spiritual treasure with thirty-five runes. Could you help me elevate it to a Great Perfection Spirit Treasure?" Yuan Ming handed over the Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter.
"Oh, this looks like something nice, let me have a look." Xi Hezi took it with great interest.
"Your spiritual treasure was originally a Great Perfection Spirit Treasure, but one critical rune was damaged and became dormant, and the artifact spirit was annihilated, causing it to fall. However, repairing it isn't too difficult." Xi Hezi quickly concluded after a brief examination.
"Great, as long as it can be repaired. Do you need any spiritual materials?" Yuan Ming became excited immediately.
"It's just about awakening a dormant rune and adding an artifact spirit, no need for auxiliary spiritual materials, just wait a moment." Xi Hezi shook her head, disappeared with the Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter, and flew back into the Xi He Tablet.
Yuan Ming blinked, only reacting after Xi Hezi's figure vanished, realizing she had immediately started working, truly efficient.
He just didn't know how long Xi Hezi would need; if it took too long, he couldn't wait.
While waiting, Yuan Ming wandered around the hall, soon arriving at a candlestick, picking up and playing with the silver lamp beneath.
His expression gradually turned solemn; after putting down the silver lamp, there was already a look of shock in his eyes.
The material of this silver goblet is very ordinary, it is a second-grade spiritual material called Radiant Iron Stone. Though it looks radiant and brilliant, in reality, it lacks toughness, making it unsuitable for artifact refining. The cultivation world usually grinds and carves this material for use as a decorative item.
Xi Hezi actually refined this kind of unsuitable ore into a decently graded magic treasure. The silver goblet surprisingly contains seven runes.
He walked to another candlestick, picked up that silver goblet for a brief inspection, and surprisingly found it to also be a seven-rune magic treasure.
Yuan Ming walked around the hall, examined all the silver goblets, and found they were all seven-rune magic treasures.
"It seems I underestimated Xi Hezi's artifact refining technique. Lucky indeed, encountering a true artifact refining master." Yuan Ming smiled slightly.
He walked back to the desk and patiently started waiting.
After a short half day, red light flashed on the Xi He Tablet, and Xi Hezi appeared, holding the Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter in hand.
The Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter at this moment emitted a bright red aura that vibrated from time to time, radiating circles of red spirit light outward.
"There, it's repaired." Xi Hezi casually tossed the Emperor Yan's Ruyi Scepter over.
Yuan Ming reached out and caught it, exerting a bit of mana to inject into it.
The scepter was indeed completely restored, with thirty-six runes forming a perfect rune array, and the artifact spirit was recondensed into a red-clothed woman, cooperating exceptionally well with Yuan Ming's refinement.
"Xi Hezi, your artifact refining technique has surely reached the seventh level, hasn't it?" Yuan Ming asked probingly.
"What seventh level? I don't know, Master never mentioned it." Xi Hezi shook his head and said.
Yuan Ming's eyes flickered briefly, then cupped his hands and said, "I actually have some knowledge of the artifact refining technique myself and have one unresolved matter that I wish Xi Hezi would clarify, could you?"
"Whatever question you have, just ask outright without hesitation." Xi Hezi waved his hand and said.
"I'm curious, how did Xi Hezi gather the artifact spirit just now? It's incredibly difficult to gather an artifact spirit for a spiritual treasure; refining for a hundred years may not necessarily succeed." Yuan Ming asked with a smile.
His Soul Destroying Sword had long reached the level of a spiritual treasure in terms of runes, yet after years of refinement, he still hadn't managed to gather an artifact spirit.
"That's simple. Your stick has nice material, and its spiritual power is abundant. I split a portion of the artifact soul, infused it, and let it nurture slightly, and it succeeded." Xi Hezi glanced at Yuan Ming strangely, as if saying what's so perplexing about such a simple matter.
Yuan Ming recalled the red-clothed woman artifact spirit and indeed found some resemblance to Xi Hezi, realizing it was condensed from Xi Hezi's artifact soul.
"Splitting the artifact soul must have considerable impact on you, should I help you recover?" he hastily asked.
The artifact soul of an artifact spirit is equivalent to the soul of a cultivator, not something to split at will.
"No worries, my artifact soul is strong, this is nothing." Xi Hezi shook his head, his aura indeed not showing any weakness compared to before.
Yuan Ming scrutinized Xi Hezi for a moment, seemingly assessing him.
"Do you still have questions? You sure have a lot. Ask quickly so we can leave this ghostly place; I don't want to stay even for half a moment." Xi Hezi pouted slightly and grumbled.
"Just one last question: earlier you mentioned my cultivation level is insufficient and without the Dao Treasure Formula, it's impossible to refine the Xi He Tablet. Could it be that the Xi He Tablet is a Dao treasure?" Yuan Ming smiled and asked.
"It used to be, but now, well, it's only at the level of a Great Perfection Spirit Treasure." Xi Hezi shook his head slightly, his tone rather regretful.
Yuan Ming was about to pursue why but remembered the promise not to ask further, so he swallowed his words.
"The Xi He Tablet is the lifebound Dao treasure of the Qilin Demon Emperor from the Ancient Sky Demon Royal Court. During a certain battle, I was destroyed by an enemy, causing the Dao treasure to fall to the level of a spiritual treasure. Afterward, the master worked hard to restore me, but ultimately could only bring it back to the level of a Great Perfection Spirit Treasure." Xi Hezi explained to himself, looking somber.
Sky Demon Royal Court?
Yuan Ming had previously heard this term from Sima Changqin, supposedly an incredibly powerful demon clan force from ancient times, whose descendants are now the Ten Thousand Demon Country.
So, Xi Hezi has existed since ancient times; why did it appear here? Did people from the Ten Thousand Demon Country put it here?
He suddenly recalled when driving the Great Sun Glaze Flame to activate the Nine Heavens and Ten Earths Sealing God Prohibition, mentioning it was originally intended to target another person. Could it be Xi Hezi? Do they have grudges?
"If there's a chance, I'll also try to help restore you back to a Dao treasure." Yuan Ming, without further inquiry, said this after a moment of silence.
"With you? Forget it. Things that even the Qilin Demon Emperor couldn't achieve back then, what can a mere Dharma Phase cultivator do?" Xi Hezi spoke straightforwardly.
"I may not be able to now, but in the future, who can say for certain?" Yuan Ming replied without getting angry.
"That said, to defeat the Great Sun Glaze Flame does show some capability, perhaps one day reaching the Mahayana Realm capable of helping me." Xi Hezi recalled something, his expression becoming somewhat serious.

chapters.title: Chapter 966 - 9301: First Evil Sword
chapters.content:
"So, Xi Hezi, you witnessed my battle with the Great Sun Glaze Flame," Yuan Ming laughed and said.
"Of course, here and the Xihe Palace outside are essentially one entity, just separated by the Mirror Image Restriction. That battle was indeed exhilarating, though it's unfortunate that the shrew Great Sun Glaze Flame escaped. Next time you encounter her, I'll assist you. The Illusion Sun True Intent contained within the Xi He Tablet can restrain that Mother Insect perfectly," Xi Hezi said resentfully, showing deep hatred towards Great Sun Glaze Flame.
"Then I'll trouble you, Xi Hezi," Yuan Ming said, secretly delighted.
"Enough talk, my mouth is dry. I'll pass on the Dao Treasure Formula of the Xi He Tablet to you, so you can take it, and then we'll leave," Xi Hezi said, transmitting a piece of the Sacrificial Refining Method into Yuan Ming's Sea of Consciousness.
This Sacrificial Refining Method isn't complex. Yuan Ming merely pondered for a moment and quickly grasped it.
According to the Dao Treasure Formula instructions, each Dao Treasure differs due to the various True Meaning of Dao they contain, making their Dao Treasure Formulas distinctive, which is vastly different from Spiritual Treasures and Magic Treasures.
Yuan Ming stepped forward, pressed his hand on the Xi He Tablet, and began the refining.
"Refining Dao Treasures is much more challenging than refining Spiritual Treasures. Take your time. As long as you refine one rune, you can pick up the Xi He Tablet. The remaining runes can be refined gradually after leaving here," Xi Hezi said with a yawn.
Yuan Ming didn't respond, continuing his casting.
Xi Hezi stretched lazily, preparing to enter the Xi He Tablet for a nap, but her expression suddenly changed, showing disbelief.
As the Artifact Spirit of Xi He Tablet, she could distinctly feel Yuan Ming's refining progress, and the Xi He Tablet was slightly responding to Yuan Ming's Mana, being swiftly refined by him.
Even Mahayana cultivators refining the Xi He Tablet couldn't match this.
"Impossible, how did you do it?" Xi Hezi looked at Yuan Ming wide-eyed.
Yuan Ming smiled and remained silent. After the baptism of the Power of Ten Thousand Wood Origin, his Mana was exceptionally pure, not inferior to Mahayana cultivators. Furthermore, being a Soul Cultivator, his Divine Soul Power was strong. With both combining, refining the Xi He Tablet naturally proceeded swiftly.
Xi Hezi noticed Yuan Ming's Mana was unusual but couldn't have expected his Mana to be so pure, only feeling that this Mana had an extraordinarily strong penetration, assuming it to be some Secret Technique Yuan Ming used.
However, since she had already reached an agreement with Yuan Ming, being refined now didn't evoke any resistance from her.
Yuan Ming refined earnestly, and after half a day, he finally refined one rune of the Xi He Tablet and picked it up.
The treasure was exceptionally heavy. Despite having invoked his Mana, it still felt like he was holding a mountain.
"The Xi He Tablet is crafted by its owner using an entire Meteor Star Core, extremely heavy. When you have refined all thirty-six runes, you'll be able to control it freely," Xi Hezi explained.
Yuan Ming nodded, deciding not to linger here. With a single hand wave, he collected the Xi He Tablet.
Xi Hezi obediently returned to the tablet, entering the Shura Palace along with it.
Soon, Yuan Ming returned outside, glanced once more at the Xihe Palace, and left after confirming there was nothing else worth his attention.
"Haha! Finally out, the sky, the earth, and this vast world—it's so beautiful," an excited voice suddenly exclaimed.
"Xi Hezi?" Yuan Ming looked to his sleeve, the voice originating from there.
"It's me."
A spirit light flashed from a jade button on the sleeve, revealing a thumb-sized Xi Hezi, peering around as if never getting enough of the sights.
"What's this?" Yuan Ming asked with some surprise, stopping his tunneling light.
"This is my Artifact Spirit Clone, temporarily attached to you, to take a proper look at this magnificent landscape outside," Xi Hezi said.
"Aren't an Artifact Spirit and a Spiritual Treasure supposed to be closely linked? Can they attach to other objects at will?" Yuan Ming found it incredible.
"An ordinary Artifact Spirit indeed wouldn't, but I can," Xi Hezi said, hands on her hips and chin up proudly.
Yuan Ming's eyes shimmered, considering that Xi Hezi's method of clone possession was somewhat similar to Soul Cultivators' abilities. Could it be she had practiced a similar Secret Technique? Or perhaps this was a unique ability of Xi Hezi?
No matter the type, Yuan Ming felt that his understanding of this artifact spirit was still too shallow.
He pondered for a moment, flipping his hand to take out an object, which was his Innate Spiritual Treasure—the Soul Destroying Sword, and said, "Xi Hezi, you are an Artifact Refining Master, and an artifact spirit yourself. Can you help me see if there is any problem with this sword?"
This Innate Spiritual Treasure of his was already very powerful, but he still couldn't condense a sword spirit, which worried him greatly.
Xi Hezi glanced at the Soul Destroying Sword a few times, and suddenly a look of surprise appeared on her small face: "Oh! It's the Great Freedom Sky Demon Sword! Where did you get the sacrificial refining method for this sword? Wait, this sword only contains three Great Freedom Sky Demon Sword runes, the others are third-rate and patchwork, low in grade and mutually conflicting. What idiot refined this?"
Yuan Ming's face turned embarrassed upon hearing this, "It was me..."
"Oh, no wonder, no wonder..." Xi Hezi looked at Yuan Ming with a knowing expression.
"In Xi Hezi's eyes, I'm just an artifact refiner idiot?" Yuan Ming touched his nose and said with a smile.
"Pretty much, I've already said it very politely, at most you can be called a half-baked on the rune aspect." Xi Hezi replied bluntly.
"I indeed don't know much about artifact refining; this Soul Destroying Sword is my Innate Spiritual Treasure, and it has yet to condense an artifact spirit. Xi Hezi, since you've seen so many issues, is there any solution?" Yuan Ming asked with a slight bitter smile and clasped his hands in inquiry.
"I've already said, no need to be so courteous with me. Your Innate Spiritual Treasure has many problems; the runes are chaotic and disordered, and the source of yin qi in the sword body is very mixed, not properly refined. Most importantly, a part of the Great Freedom Sky Demon Sword is also sealed inside. Which fool taught you to refine a treasure in such a way? Knowing only bits about artifact refining and still messing around with ideas—the fragments of the Great Freedom Sky Demon Sword are not something an artifact like yours can swallow. It's a miracle this Innate Spiritual Treasure hasn't shattered; how could it possibly nurture an artifact spirit?" Xi Hezi waved her hand first and then gave a caustic evaluation.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming couldn't help but glance at the Stealing Heaven Tripod tattoo on his arm, worried that Void might jump out and fight with Xi Hezi.
Fortunately, Stealing Heaven Tripod had no reaction; Void likely fell asleep again.
"Then what should be done? Or, what can I do?" Yuan Ming asked.
"The yin qi problem is easy to solve; just refine it once. The troublesome issues are the runes and the fragmented Great Freedom Sky Demon Sword sealed inside. There are two solutions: first, remove the fragments of the Great Freedom Sky Demon Sword and the three Heavenly Demon Sword runes, and then add new runes. I know several sacrificial refining methods of ancient yin attribute spirit swords that can quickly cultivate an artifact spirit, though its power cannot compare to the Great Freedom Sky Demon Sword." Xi Hezi weighed the Soul Destroying Sword and said.
"And the second?" Yuan Ming asked after a moment of silence.
"Naturally, to continue on the path of the Great Freedom Sky Demon Sword, refining your sword into the second Great Freedom Sky Demon Sword. However, this would be extremely difficult, if not impossible, as the Great Freedom Sky Demon Sword is the First Evil Sword of the ancient Demon World, and its traces vanished long before I was born; I do not know the sacrificial refining method. Fortunately, you have a fragment; if I study it, I should be able to replicate two or three tenths of its power." Xi Hezi shook her head with a slight sway and said.
"The First Evil Sword? Is the Great Freedom Sky Demon Sword so malevolent?" Yuan Ming had long heard the name Great Freedom Sky Demon Sword from Void, and judging by its name, he guessed it came from the Demon World. However, he didn't know the specifics, so he couldn't help but pursue further questions.
"Of course! The origin of the Great Freedom Sky Demon Sword is unknown; some say it was refined by the ancient Demon World's first artifact refiner, the Red Tears Demon Emperor; others say it's an innate spiritual treasure. The sword first appeared in the hands of the Great Freedom Sky Demon Emperor of the Demon World, thus being called the Great Freedom Sky Demon Sword. This sword possesses astonishing divine skills and has claimed the lives of at least ten Mahayana existences beneath its blade. It is said to have once wiped out all life in a small realm with a single sword, which is extremely dreadful." Xi Hezi spoke with a solemn expression, faintly showing some signs of fear.
"Eliminating an entire realm with a single sword truly deserves the title of an evil sword." Yuan Ming involuntarily drew in a sharp breath upon hearing this.
"The dread of the Great Freedom Sky Demon Sword is not limited to this; aside from its terrifying power, this sword also harbors a bizarre True Meaning of Dao Treasure. Every time it kills, it absorbs the mana, essence blood, divine soul, and even the comprehended True Meaning of Dao of the slain, utilizing them for itself. The more it kills, the more powerful the Great Freedom Sky Demon Sword becomes. It's said that upon reaching the peak, its power might surpass the scope of Dao Treasures." Xi Hezi shook her head and continued.
"The Great Freedom Sky Demon Sword possesses such an ability!" Yuan Ming couldn't help but express his surprise.
"Naturally! Otherwise, how could it be deemed the First Evil Sword?" Xi Hezi giggled and said.
"What happened later with this sword? Why did it break?" Yuan Ming pursued further questions.
"I don't know. When the Great Freedom Sky Demon Sword was rampant, the Demon World had not yet invaded our Chuyun Realm. I heard from my master that something major occurred during the Demon World's invasion of the Black Soil Realm, leading to the fall of several Demon Emperors there, including the Great Freedom Sky Demon Emperor. The Great Freedom Sky Demon Sword also vanished accordingly. Many say it was due to the excessive accumulation of True Meaning of Dao by the sword, rendering its power unacceptable by the Heavenly Dao, leading to a divine punishment that destroyed it." Xi Hezi seemed to enjoy chatting after being silent for so long, discussing enthusiastically with Yuan Ming.
Listening to these ancient secrets, Yuan Ming couldn't help but feel astonished, his heart filled with admiration.
"By the way, where did you get the fragments of the Great Freedom Sky Demon Sword?" Xi Hezi asked again.
"They were gifted by a senior; as for where he obtained them, I'm not quite sure." Yuan Ming shook his head and said.
Xi Hezi did not pursue further, shifting the topic back: "After talking for so long, you haven't told me yet, how do you intend to deal with this Soul Destroying Sword?"
"Since I'm going to refine a spiritual treasure, I would naturally refine the most powerful one, and continue on the path of the Great Freedom Sky Demon Sword." Yuan Ming said decisively without any hesitation.
Given the supernatural abilities of the Great Freedom Sky Demon Sword, being fortunate enough to obtain a fragment compelled him to attempt replicating it. Achieving even two or three tenths of its power would significantly boost his own strength.

chapters.title: Chapter 967 - 932: A Happy Matter
chapters.content:
Xi Hezi wasn't surprised by Yuan Ming's decision and nodded, "Alright, I'll help you complete it as soon as possible, but I don't recommend cultivating this sword as your Innate Spiritual Treasure. The Innate Spiritual Treasure involves a lot and isn't necessarily better because it's stronger."
"How so?" Yuan Ming was just about to express his gratitude when he couldn't help but ask after hearing this.
"If it's a regular Dharma manifestation Cultivator, it'd be one thing. But I see your cultivation is aiming to break through to the Mahayana Realm, so you should choose an Innate Spiritual Treasure that suits you," Xi Hezi said.
"Is the Innate Spiritual Treasure related to advancing to the Mahayana Realm?" Yuan Ming looked at Xi Hezi.
"Of course, and it's very much related. You should know that advancing to the Mahayana Realm requires comprehending the Five Elements True Intent, right? The relatively easiest and most feasible way to comprehend the True Meaning of Dao is by leveraging your Innate Spiritual Treasure. Once the Spiritual Treasure advances to the Great Perfection Realm, it will naturally birth a trace of the True Meaning of Dao Treasure. Actually, the True Meaning of Dao Treasure and the True Meaning of Dao for you cultivators are essentially the same; both are insights into the Dao of Heaven and Earth. One is nurtured by the Dao Treasure, and the other is realized through your cultivation. By leveraging this trace of the True Meaning of Dao Treasure from your Innate Spiritual Treasure, cultivators have a significant chance of comprehending their own True Meaning of Dao, laying a solid foundation for advancing to the Mahayana," Xi Hezi continued eloquently.
Hearing this, Yuan Ming deepened his somewhat hazy understanding of the True Meaning of Dao a bit more, and most importantly, he completely understood the importance of the Innate Spiritual Treasure.
"The imitation Great Freedom Sky Demon Sword we're replicating is unlikely to develop the True Meaning of Dao Treasure. Even if it were to miraculously emerge, it won't have the Five Elements Attribute and won't aid your advancement to the Mahayana. It's better to face short-term pain than long-term pain; you should change your Innate Spiritual Treasure early. Look, I have a few great Spiritual Treasures here for your reference," Xi Hezi, perhaps enjoying teaching, lifted a hand.
Three beams of red light shot into Yuan Ming's Sea of Consciousness; they were the refining methods for three types of Five Elements Spiritual Treasures.
The first Spiritual Treasure is called the "Heavenly Gang Five Elements Sword," a set of five Spirit Swords that can form the Heavenly Gang Five Elements Sword Formation, possessing power that can be considered world-shaking.
The second is the "Five Elements Treasure Light Fan," also an attack Spiritual Treasure. It can release attacks of Gold, Wood, Water, Fire, and Earth types, which can amplify each other through the interaction of the Five Elements, making its power, to some extent, surpass that of the Heavenly Gang Five Elements Sword Formation.
The third Spiritual Treasure is the most magical, named "Five-Colored Divine Light." When cultivated to mastery, it can restrain all Five Elements attacks, but its primary material is extremely rare, requiring tail feathers from the Ancient Strange Beast, the Five-Colored Peacock.
Yuan Ming couldn't help but glance at Xi Hezi. The refining method of each of these three Spiritual Treasures would be considered invaluable outside, yet Xi Hezi just handed them over?
"Thank you, Fellow Daoist Xi Hezi, for your guidance, but this matter is of great importance, and I need to think it over," he solemnly thanked.
"Well, take your time to consider. I'll first help you sort out the Yin Qi within the Soul Destroying Sword, and I'll also handle the runes inside. As for that sword fragment, since we're imitating the Great Freedom Sky Demon Sword, no need to touch it," Xi Hezi said.
"How do you plan to handle the runes of the Soul Destroying Sword?" Yuan Ming curiously asked.
"Consider it your luck; my master was once very interested in the Great Freedom Sky Demon Sword and collected information about it from everywhere. Although not as lucky as you to acquire even a single sword fragment, I did find two runes for the Great Freedom Sky Demon Sword. Now I will engrave these two runes into your Soul Destroying Sword and remove the others. Refining a Spiritual Treasure requires the right combination; those low-level runes would only be a hindrance," Xi Hezi explained.
Yuan Ming was overjoyed to hear this. He thanked Xi Hezi again and handed over a storage bag: "These are some Nine Nether Iron I've recently acquired; they should help with refining treasure."
"You've prepared well. Reforging the Soul Destroying Sword indeed requires this material," Xi Hezi accepted it.
Yuan Ming waved to bring Xi Hezi's clone into the Shura Palace before continuing his journey.
"Do you trust this Xi Hezi so much that you even handed over your Innate Spiritual Treasure?" Kong's voice suddenly echoed in his Sea of Consciousness.
"Senior Kong, I thought you had fallen asleep, but you were listening in all along," Yuan Ming's gaze shifted, and he couldn't help but smile.
"I'm the Artifact Spirit of the Stealing Heaven Tripod, not the Refining Treasure Cauldron's Artifact Spirit, so it's normal that I'm not skilled in Artifact Refining. What are you smiling about?" Kong said, a bit annoyed.
"I wouldn't dare, I just suddenly thought of something happy," Yuan Ming quickly stifled his smile and said.
"What happy thought?" Kong coldly asked.
"In the mortal realm inside the Shura Palace, the people live peacefully, with many children being born recently, the population increasing, and believers growing. As the Nether Moon God, I'm naturally pleased," Yuan Ming explained earnestly.
Kong snorted, "Although Xi Hezi isn't entirely wrong, you don't have to rely on your Innate Spiritual Treasure to comprehend the True Meaning of Dao."
"Then how should I comprehend it? It's not that I'm being humble, but my talent in magic cultivation isn't that high, and I had to rely on Ju Mang Spirit Technique to compensate for my spirit root deficiencies. Comprehending Divine Power Secret Techniques was all thanks to the Stealing Heaven Tripod... Senior, you mean I can continue to rely on the possessing divine power of the Stealing Heaven Tripod to comprehend the True Meaning of Dao?" Yuan Ming said, realizing Kong's intention midway.
"Indeed, the divine power of the Stealing Heaven Tripod is beyond your expectations, don't underestimate it," Kong said.
"I see, I understand now." A thought stirred in Yuan Ming's heart as he said with some insight.
"Additionally, aside from the Stealing Heaven Tripod, you can comprehend the Dao Seal and grasp the true meaning of Dao. Of course, what I'm referring to is not the usual Dao Seal formed by Divine Skills, ordinary Dao Seals at most connect some Power of Dao. To truly comprehend the true meaning of Dao from them is basically impossible. You should look for something exquisite, it would be best to find the Divine Skill listed on the Creation Heaven List."
Yuan Ming's expression changed slightly.
