He naturally had heard of the reputation of the Creation Heaven List, a miraculous list held by the Heavenly Saint Academy, Taixuan Sect, and Bright Moon Palace, three giant sects. It recorded many exquisite Divine Skills and secret techniques, said to include a thousand kinds, each possessing boundless power.
Furthermore, the list is also said to have some sensing ability of the heavens and earth, automatically detecting newly born Divine Skills within the Chuyun Realm and including them on the list, very miraculous.
"Thank you, Senior Kong, for the guidance." Yuan Ming expressed his gratitude solemnly.
Seeing Yuan Ming like this, Kong seemed finally satisfied, saying no more.
"Senior Kong, I want to search for Abyss Nether Stone next, which direction should I go?" Yuan Ming was afraid Kong would fall silent again, hastily stopping the other.
"Just continue along the direction of the Spirit Vein's flow, you'll naturally find it." Kong replied coolly.
Yuan Ming furrowed his brow secretly. He had decided not to get involved in the changes here, yet unexpectedly he still had to go.
"Senior, do you know what happened in the southwest direction? Is it because of the Three Realms Flying Boat?" Yuan Ming asked after some thought.
"Why ask so much? If you want to know, go and see for yourself." Kong said with a smile.
Yuan Ming frowned, wanting to ask more, but Kong seemed to know his thoughts, speaking first: "Controlling the Bright Soul Fire just now exhausted me significantly. I'll need to rest for a while and can't assist you further. I bestow upon you a Stealing Heaven Talisman to deal with the Great Sun Glaze Flame. As for other matters, consider them yourself."
After saying this, Kong's voice soon fell silent.
Yuan Ming, feeling helpless, could only change direction and continue flying towards the southwest, following the Spirit Vein's flow.
Uncertain of how long he flew, he gradually left the mountain where Xihe Palace was located, arriving at a crimson plain.
The Fire Spiritual Power here was very thin, yet the Fire Beasts along the way gradually increased. However, for Yuan Ming now, dealing with them required no action. He could simply collide physically, and the Fire Beasts blocking his path would burst into Blood Mist with a 'boom,' the Power of the Sun contained within them merging into Yuan Ming's body.
Yet, the Power of the Sun within these Fire Beasts had become negligible, Yuan Ming was too lazy to slaughter them one by one, immersing himself in flight, his speed increasing ever faster.
Half a day later, Yuan Ming suddenly stopped his tunneling light, looking to the left front.
After condensing Dao Seal with Eyes of Golden Flame, not only did close-range detection ability skyrocket, but the range of his vision greatly expanded.
Twenty or thirty miles away, four beams of tunneling light were flying urgently, belonging to the Flame Wolf King and his three Level 5 clansmen.
Yuan Ming thought for a moment, his muscles wriggling, transforming back into the appearance of Wan Tianren. Previously advancing the Undying Body, naturally, he couldn't maintain the transformed appearance. Now, he accelerated to catch up quickly, blocking the four demons ahead.
"Wan Tianren! You're not dead?" Seeing Yuan Ming, Flame Wolf King was taken aback.
"Ha, your Empress is quite the schemer, but she underestimated my methods. The mere Great Sun Glaze Flame couldn't harm me." Yuan Ming sneered coldly.
"Fellow Daoist Wan, apologies, Her Majesty the Empress's prior actions were aimed only at Sima Changqin and not meant to involve you..." Flame Wolf King looked at Yuan Ming, surprised, then smiled awkwardly.
"Does Flame Wolf King consider me a child of three? If your Ten Thousand Demon Country truly wanted to deal only with Sima Changqin, why did you not open Xihe Palace and release me after he escaped?" Yuan Ming's expression was icy, his face becoming more grim.
"Fellow Daoist Wan, past matters were all by Her Majesty the Empress's direction, truly unrelated to me. We have no animosity between us. If Fellow Daoist Wan insists on a fight to vent frustration, I'll accompany you for a few moves. Please don't trouble my three subordinates." Flame Wolf King sighed, assuming a fighting posture.
Yuan Ming's eyes flashed coldly, but suddenly dispersed, his expression returning to tranquility: "Rest assured, you're just a Demon King. Should I seek revenge, I will look for Wu Yu. This time I came to inquire what happened after I was confined in Xihe Palace. Why did the temperature in the canyon suddenly drop, and all flames vanish? Why did you all flee swiftly?"
"The flames in the canyon suddenly vanished? I don't know about that. When we left, those flames were still there." Flame Wolf King's face showed surprise, apparently not pretending.
"Why did you all suddenly leave?" Yuan Ming asked.

chapters.title: Chapter 968 - 933: The Schemes of the Three Realms
chapters.content:
"Not long after you were imprisoned in Xihe Palace, there was a sudden disturbance in the space, and a huge silver light pillar appeared in the southwest, reaching straight to the sky, making a great commotion. At that time, Sima Changqin was leading those cultivators in a fight against us. Upon seeing this vision, both Sima Changqin and Her Majesty the Empress immediately stopped and rushed over there. If you want to see Her Majesty, just go there," the Flame Wolf King raised his hand, pointing southwest, which was almost in line with the flow direction of the spiritual power within the spirit vein.
"Since that's the case, why didn't you go with Wu Yu?" Yuan Ming asked again.
"I have tasks entrusted by the Empress to complete," the Flame Wolf King confessed.
Yuan Ming stared at the Flame Wolf King for some time until beads of sweat appeared on the other's forehead. Only then did he let out a loud laugh toward the sky, summoned Lei Yu, mounted it, and flew straight towards the southwest, quickly disappearing into the horizon.
"Master, the Ten Thousand Demon Empress set you up. There's no doubt these people are involved. Why not kill them to at least let off some steam?" Lei Yu asked.
"There's something off about them. They're not from the Ten Thousand Demon Country. Their transformation technique is truly formidable. If it weren't for my Eyes of Golden Flame already forming the Dao Seal, even I wouldn't have noticed," Yuan Ming said after a moment of silence, his eyes flashing with golden light.
Lei Yu was startled at the words and quickly asked, "Then who are they?"
"I don't know. The commotion from this Heavenly Fire searching operation is huge. It's not surprising for anyone to have infiltrated. We still have other important matters to attend to; it's better to avoid unnecessary troubles," Yuan Ming shook his head.
The Flame Wolf King and the other three demons were shrouded in a peculiar force. He only saw through their disguises but couldn't discern their true bodies.
Once Yuan Ming was far away, the Flame Wolf King suddenly wiped his hand over his face, a large black mist emerged from his body, causing his appearance to rapidly change, finally settling into a gentle young man's face—it was precisely Su Wu.
Simultaneously, the three Level 5 Fire Wolf Clan members following him also removed their disguises.
One of them was Su Yingxue, another was Hei Lian, and the last one was shrouded completely in a black robe, with even a mask on the face, seemingly unwilling to reveal the true face.
This person's cultivation was slightly weaker, only at the middle-stage Returning to Void.
"Sect Hierarch, just letting Wan Tianren go like that?" Su Yingxue stepped forward and asked.
"What are you trying to say? Our Three Realms Sect isn't like the Blood Worship Sect of old, killing everyone on sight," Su Wu glanced at her.
"That's not what I meant. Our Three Realms Sect is currently in need of talent. Wan Tianren is a loose cultivator, not only reaching the Dharma manifestation Stage but also a Level 6 Array Master. If we could recruit him, it would significantly strengthen our sect," Su Yingxue suggested.
"Yingxue, your array cultivation has improved over the years, but your insight hasn't grown at all," Su Wu said, shaking his head.
"Please, Sect Hierarch, enlighten me," Su Yingxue bowed her head and said.
"In this world, some people can be recruited as subordinates, while others cannot. Wan Tianren we just encountered is precisely such a person. No matter how his emotions change, there's always a trace of pride hidden in his eyes. Such people are either indifferent to fame and fortune or very ambitious; they are unlikely to submit to others," Su Wu remarked calmly.
"If so, why did you not make him into a Sky Cicada Puppet, such that we'd have an extra powerful subordinate? It surely beats letting him go for nothing?" Su Yingxue asked in confusion.
"Have you spent too much time in the Demon World, adopting the Demon Clan's ways, quick to kill?" Su Wu frowned and admonished.
"I understand my mistake," Su Yingxue hurried to say, though she couldn't help but complain inwardly.
When it comes to being ruthless and bloodthirsty, few in the Chuyun Realm or the Demon World could compare to Su Wu.
"Even if I wanted to act, it's not as simple as you think. Wan Tianren isn't an ordinary Dharma manifestation. He practices Body Cultivation, and though his Divine Soul Cultivation is only at the level of a Spoken Witch, his physical body has already achieved an Undying Body. The Body Cultivators with an Undying Body are the most difficult to deal with. Even if I acted myself, I might not capture him. Moreover, there are bigger things to attend to, and I have no time to waste on him," Su Wu continued.
Upon hearing these words, not only was Su Yingxue taken aback, but the other two also showed signs of surprise.
In the realm of Dharma Body Soul Three Cultivations, Body Cultivation has always been low in presence, not recognized by practitioners of the other two systems.
But once someone broke through to an Undying Body, it was entirely different; no one dared to be careless, not even Mahayana cultivators.
The reason is quite straightforward; it's exceedingly challenging to utterly kill a Body Cultivator with an Undying Body.
"Since your time is precious, is it really okay for us to move so slowly? Both Sima Changqin and the Ten Thousand Demon Country have gone to the Three Realms Tower. Aren't you worried they might seize control of the Three Realms Flying Boat?" Hei Lian quickly concealed her gaze and interjected.
"I have my plans, don't worry. Aside from me, there's no second person in this space who can control the Three Realms Flying Boat. Let them fight if they wish. I need to first inspect the damage on the ship; otherwise, if we get our hands on it but can't use it, we'll be a laughingstock," Su Wu explained with a smile.
"As long as you know what you're doing," Hei Lian nodded and fell silent.
"Sect Hierarch, since you can't spare yourself, why not let me try it at the Three Realms Tower to see if we can recruit some personnel for the sir? With Hei Lian and Master Su here, there's no significant need for me to remain here," at this moment, the masked Returning to Void Cultivator spoke up voluntarily, his voice sounding like a young man's.
"Do as you please, as long as you don't delay my affairs," Su Wu didn't look at the masked man, waving his hand.
The masked man immediately bowed to Su Wu, then turned and flew toward the direction Yuan Ming had headed off.
The black mist reappeared on his body, enveloping him once more, transforming him back into a Level 5 Demon.
"Heh, the new subordinate you recruited doesn't seem very strong, although he has a strong desire to achieve merit. Just be careful not to let his ambition lead us into trouble," Hei Lian remarked with a hint of sarcasm.
"It's fine. I've already fixed his Heavenly Cicada transformation, making it impossible to Soul Search him. Even if he dies, he will disintegrate into pus and cause no harm," Su Wu waved his hand.
"This person is diligent and clever in his duties. Should we give him some life-saving cards? You know, a mid-stage Returning Void Cultivator is the lowest level of existence in this space," Su Yingxue proposed.
"No need. There are as many people of his aptitude as there are stars in the sky. The Three Realms Sect is in the rebuilding phase, and we don't have spare resources to invest in him," Su Wu stated coldly.
Su Wu and the others did not lower their voices; the masked man hadn't gone far and clearly heard the conversation, yet he showed no reaction, as if Su Wu and the other two weren't talking about him.
The trio of Su Wu set off again, their figures quickly disappearing on the horizon.
...
Two days later, Lei Yu carried Yuan Ming, finally leaving the boundless Red Plain.
The scenery ahead transformed dramatically, no longer a sea of crimson, but instead a range of undulating silver mountains appeared.
This mountain area was barren, devoid of any vegetation coverage. Perhaps due to some metal contained within the rocky mountains, it reflected a silvery metallic sheen under the sunlight.
Yuan Ming landed on one of the low peaks and once again sensed the flow of the underground Spirit Vein, discovering that only about thirty percent flowed into the mountains, with the remaining seventy percent heading in another direction.
With a look of curiosity, he was contemplating which way to pursue when he suddenly detected a clash of mana from within the mountains, as if someone was fighting.
Yuan Ming briefly sensed the intensity of the fluctuations and found that both sides of the battle had Dharma Phase Cultivation. He took out the Heavenly Escape Stone Talisman, activated it, and concealed his presence.
After doing all this, he spread his form and flew towards that direction.
Crossing five or six mountain peaks in succession, Yuan Ming found the source of the fluctuations in a valley surrounded by three mountain peaks, where two groups were fiercely battling.
One group consisted of three people: Long Hou, Long Yuhuan, and Long Yinkong, while the other group, slightly larger in number, was led by Wang Fulong, comprised of seven or eight Returning to Void Cultivators from the Sunset Sect.
Previously, the Sunset Sect hadn't sent so many people into this space, so it seemed Wang Fulong carried a Space Spiritual Treasure.
Long Hou and Wang Fulong were locked in an intense fight, further away from the others, and no one dared to intervene.
Long Yinkong and Long Yuhuan joined forces to face the encirclement of the Sunset Sect cultivators, fully displaying their capabilities, revealing that they were both Dharma Phase Cultivators.
The strength gap between Dharma Phase and Returning Void is incomparable, ordinarily making them no match for seven or eight Sunset Sect cultivators. However, with Long Yinkong and Long Yuhuan both severely injured, they could only exert thirty to forty percent of their strength, leaving the sides evenly matched.
Both battlefields were in a stalemate, and, judging by their posture, neither side could easily take down the other in a short period.
"Why are these two groups fighting?" Yuan Ming was slightly surprised, his gaze scanning the surroundings before quickly stopping at the central void between the two groups.
There, crisscrossing void fissures appeared, flashing intermittently with a silvery radiance, enveloping an area several feet in diameter.
At the center of this area, a silver-white token was suspended, identical to Yuan Ming's Silver Token—indeed, the Boarding Order of the Three Realms Immortal Boat.
"So it's the Boarding Order they're fighting over," Yuan Ming mused.
Although less interested in the Boarding Order than in the Great Sun Glaze Flame, seeing it did not mean he wouldn't take it.
Yuan Ming's gaze fixed on the area, counting numerous space fragments surrounding the Boarding Order, with larger ones outside that were half a foot long, while the smaller ones inside were more numerous.
The array of space fissures wrapping the Boarding Order was extremely thorough. In other words, retrieving the Boarding Order required passing through layers of space fissures.
After a brief consideration, Yuan Ming controlled the Undying Tree Roots to pierce through the void, attempting to sweep towards the Boarding Order.
However, as soon as the Undying Tree Roots emerged next to the Boarding Order, a chaotic and twisted Space Power immediately pulled at them, drawing them towards a space fissure.
Seeing they were off course, Yuan Ming immediately manipulated the Undying Tree Roots to twist and approach the Boarding Order.
Yet, the chaotic Space Power was uncontrollable; as soon as the Undying Tree Roots moved, they were immediately sucked into another space fissure and torn apart.
The space fissures in this void were inherently unstable, and as the Undying Tree Roots disappeared instantaneously, it didn't draw the attention of the others.

chapters.title: Chapter 969 - 934: Still Something to Say
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming did not get annoyed, he calmed his heart and tried several more times in succession, but still ended in failure.
The Space Power near the Boarding Order was too distorted, making it impossible to freely manipulate the Undying Tree Root.
"It seems trickery won't work!" He no longer continued, glanced at the still fighting crowd, and immediately made a certain decision in his heart.
In the next instant, Yuan Ming's figure suddenly shot out, transforming into a whirlwind as he rushed towards the Boarding Order.
The commotion he stirred up was too great, even with the Heavenly Escape Stone Talisman, he could not conceal it.
However, Yuan Ming wasn't bothered by this, his figure swift as lightning, he rushed into that space without the slightest pause, directly plunging in.
As soon as he stepped into that area, the distorted Space Power enveloped him.
Yuan Ming only felt a force pulling at his head, drawing it upwards, but another force pulled his legs downwards, and a force behind him seemed to want to swallow up his waist.
At the same time, there was also a force beside him trying to twist him around.
He was like a strand of dough about to be twisted into shape, his muscles were being tugged, and his joints made cracking sounds.
Yuan Ming let out a soft grunt, his blood surged, physical strength exploded out, bursting with indescribable terrifying strength, forcefully breaking through the distortion and obstruction of Space Power, extending his hand through the spaces of the spatial rift, reaching out to grab that Silver Token.
The spatial rifts around the Silver Token were dense and tiny, with no strong distortion power, but sharper than the sharpest blade, his palm just approached, yet it was cut with a hundred wounds.
Were it a normal body, it would have been reduced to mush, however, Yuan Ming had cultivated the Undying Body, the wounds on his hand instantly healed, his five fingers clenched, grabbing the Silver Token tightly.
His figure immediately retracted from that area, swiftly exiting the spatial rift region, and returned to his original position.
All of this seemed long in words, but actually happened in the span of one or two breaths, the cultivators from the Heavenly Dragon Hall and Sunset Sect who were still battling immediately sensed something amiss.
Long Hou and Wang Fulong each withdrew their Spiritual Treasures, stopping their disciples, retreating to both sides.
"Where's the Boarding Order? How did it suddenly disappear?" Long Yinkong looked at the empty spatial rift region, shouting in shock and anger.
"Someone appeared just now, I heard the sound of breaking through the air." Long Yuhuan said in a low voice, her gaze sweeping around, her eyes faintly glowing gold, seemingly using a Pupil Technique.
Long Hou's expression was solemn, flipping his hand to summon a golden bell, flicking it with his finger.
Jingling, a circle of golden ripples spread out.
The golden ripple seemed to have a mind of its own, avoiding the people of Sunset Sect, enveloping a range of several tens of feet below.
The others, seeing this, also employed their detection methods.
However, the effect of the Heavenly Escape Stone Talisman was such that even Sima Changqin couldn't see through it, let alone those present could detect it.
"The attacks from the spatial rifts are truly terrifying..." Yuan Ming exhaled softly.
He looked fine at the moment, but his Qi-Blood Power was depleted by thirty percent, more than what was consumed in the previous battle with the Great Sun Glaze Flame.
Yuan Ming slightly regulated his breathing but did not leave; instead, he lifted the concealment effect of the Heavenly Escape Stone Talisman.
The sudden appearance of Yuan Ming startled those nearby.
"Wan Tianren, it's you!" Long Hou examined Yuan Ming up and down, his expression seemingly a bit surprised.
Long Yinkong and Long Yuhuan also looked shocked.
The golden bell that Long Hou had just summoned was no ordinary treasure, but the Golden Dragon Bell of the Heavenly Dragon Hall, with the bell sound containing Soul Capturing, Jin Hua, and Shattering Body effects.
Wan Tianren clearly was within the attack range of the bell, yet appeared completely unharmed.
The people of the Sunset Sect, however, were unaware of the Golden Dragon Bell's effects, and seeing that Yuan Ming had now hidden his cultivation once again, only showing the Mana fluctuation of the Returning to Void Stage, a few impatient individuals immediately wanted to act.
Wang Fulong, still somewhat rational, stopped a few and said loudly: "Fellow Daoist Wan, you took advantage of our struggle to reap the benefits as the fisherman, aren't you afraid we will unite to deal with you?"
Yuan Ming paid no attention to Wang Fulong, looking at the three from the Heavenly Dragon Hall: "I'm taking this Boarding Order, do the three of you have any objections?"
Long Yinkong's gaze turned cold, about to speak, but was stopped by Long Hou's stern look.
"The Boarding Order was originally ownerless, it goes to the capable. Since Fellow Daoist Wan has already pocketed it, we naturally have no objections." Long Hou said with a smile.
"Very well, I have some matters to discuss with the few from the Sunset Sect, so I won't keep the three of you here." Yuan Ming unceremoniously issued a dismissal order.
"Farewell." Long Hou cupped his fist at Yuan Ming, turned and flew away.
Long Yuhuan immediately followed, Long Yinkong seemed somewhat unwilling but eventually followed, the three quickly disappearing into the distant mountains.
"Master, although Wan Tianren is troublesome, we could completely take him on with the three of us plus the people from the Sunset Sect, there's no need to retreat like this." Long Yinkong said unwillingly.
Long Yuhuan, standing beside them, didn't speak, occasionally glancing back as if pondering something.
"You still lack steadiness in your temperament, Kong'er. Didn't you notice? Wan Tianren is no longer the same as before." Long Hou said softly.
"Not the same, how so?" Long Yinkong was taken aback.
"Yuhuan, did you see it?" Long Hou did not answer, instead, he looked at Long Yuhuan.
"Wan Tianren previously tried to conceal himself, but his physical body's Qi Blood Power is abnormally strong. He is likely a Body of Wanxiang Body Cultivator. I just used the Spirit Dragon Pupil Technique to observe carefully, and his body seems quite different from before. This person has just retrieved the Boarding Order from countless space fissures without a scratch, and the sound of the Golden Dragon Bell has no effect on him. Combining these clues, I boldly speculate that Wan Tianren must have found the hiding place of the Great Sun Glaze Flame and, using its power, has greatly advanced in Body Cultivation, reaching the realm of the Undying Body," Long Yuhuan said slowly.
"Yuhuan has good insight; this is how I see it too," Long Hou nodded satisfactorily.
Long Yinkong's face turned extremely unpleasant upon realizing the grave mistake he just made.
"Fortunately, he seems to have a conflict with the Sunset Sect and did not trouble us," Long Hou sighed and continued.
He had no desire to be enemies with someone who has cultivated the Undying Body.
"Master, I've heard that it's incredibly difficult for Body Cultivators to break through to the Undying Body. I don't believe that Wan Tianren is really a Loose Cultivator. Can you deduce his sect origin?" Long Yuhuan suddenly asked.
"Body Cultivation in Chuyun Realm is declining, with many passing on secret inheritances. Even I can't discern it," Long Hou shook his head.
Upon hearing this, a look of disappointment flashed in Long Yuhuan's eyes.
"Wan Tianren's origin is mysterious, but with his strength exposed, he will not remain unnoticed. The area around the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range will be lively," Long Hou's eyes flickered, and he chuckled.
...
Watching the three from Heavenly Dragon Hall leave obediently, Wang Fulong's expression changed, and countless thoughts raced through his mind.
"Since Fellow Daoist Long Hou admitted this Boarding Order belongs to you, I accept it. Farewell," he said, turning to fly in another direction.
"Fellow Daoist Wang, didn't I just say that I have something to discuss with you all?" A ghostly figure of Yuan Ming once again blocked Wang Fulong's path.
"Such speed..." Wang Fulong's eye twitched, his expression slightly changing.
The other cultivators of the Sunset Sect couldn't discern Yuan Ming's strength due to their less acute vision, each one seething with anger.
"How dare you! Wan Tianren, you are merely a Returning to Void Cultivator and dare to disrespect our Sunset Sect Sect Leader!"
"Hand over the Boarding Order and surrender; you'll still have a whole corpse left!"
A tall and a short cultivator from Sunset Sect leaped with fury, their faces full of wrath.
"Noise!" Impatience flashed in Yuan Ming's eyes, and he flicked his fingers.
"Wang Zhen, Du Ke, be careful!" Wang Fulong exclaimed, warning the two most vocal disciples of the Sunset Sect.
Startled, the two swiftly erected several protective shields in succession while activating their Protective Spiritual Treasures.
However, with several crisp "puff puff" sounds, the defensive shields around them shattered, and their Protective Spiritual Treasures were knocked away.
The two were horrified; as they were about to react, their heads suddenly "bang" exploded, scattering red and white matter everywhere.
The necks of the two headless corpses sprayed blood wildly and collapsed stiffly.
The other Returning to Void Cultivators of Sunset Sect were greatly shocked, hurriedly retreating to a distance, not daring to utter a word.
"Such power, Fellow Daoist Wan, you've already advanced to the Undying Body Realm!" Wang Fulong said in a deep voice.
Only now did he realize Yuan Ming's hidden card. Considering this, the death of the Black River Four Foes wasn't unjust at all.
"Just a minor trick, pardon my humble display, Fellow Daoist Wang," Yuan Ming said with a smile.
"Fellow Daoist Wan is jesting. If the Undying Body is a minor trick, then we have no face to show ourselves. May I know what Fellow Daoist Wan wishes to discuss by blocking our path?" Wang Fulong forced a smile and asked.
"Why pretend, Fellow Daoist Wang? I have searched the souls of the Black River Four Foes; there's no point in arguing," Yuan Ming said coldly.
Wang Fulong hesitated, looking troubled:
"Fellow Daoist Wan, I admit, the Black River Four Foes were arranged by our Sunset Sect, but we were compelled to do so, forced into enmity with you."
"I believe your explanation; if you tell me who instructed you, I might spare your life," Yuan Ming's expression unchanged, spoke slowly.
"This... I cannot comply. The other party is someone that our Sunset Sect cannot offend, and likewise, someone you cannot afford to offend, Fellow Daoist Wan. If Fellow Daoist Wan doesn't pursue this matter further, I am willing to mediate and turn hostility into friendship, how about it?" Wang Fulong clasped his fists and said.
Yuan Ming sneered, uninterested in further words, he suddenly raised his hand and pressed down.
Wang Fulong and the others felt a sudden darkness overhead. Looking up, they saw an enormous hand covering the sky, filled with layers of black light, pressing down on them—it was the Great Black Sky God Palm.
A powerful force of Divine Soul Power instantly enveloped them, causing their hearts to tremble.
Although Wang Fulong hadn't predicted Yuan Ming's sudden attack, he was somewhat prepared.
"Fellow Daoist Wan, do you really choose punishment over a toast? Though I am unworthy, I am not easy to provoke!" Seeing the Great Black Sky God Palm pressing down, he shouted in anger.
After all, Wang Fulong was a Dharma Phase Cultivator; with his anger rising, he lost some fear and gained some fury.
As he spoke, outside his body, the cyan light gathered, and an enormous Dharma manifestation rose from the ground, directly confronting the Great Black Sky God Palm pressing down from above.
"Boom boom boom..."
In the midst of a series of explosions, the Great Black Sky God Palm was shattered by the hundred-zhang tall majestic Dharma manifestation, the black light scattering.
Yuan Ming sighed internally, realizing his Soul Cultivation Realm was lagging, and the power of the Great Black Sky God Palm was starting to fall short.

chapters.title: Chapter 970 - 935: Heavenly Destiny's Daughter
chapters.content:
As he sighed, Yuan Ming's hands were still in motion, casting a spell.
In the dispersing radiance, two Dao Seals intertwined and spun downward, heading toward Wang Fulong.
Wang Fulong sensed danger and immediately waved his sleeve to strike.
With his movement, the giant Dharma manifestation also swept its robe, raising gusts of air to collide with the two Dao Seals.
Just as his arm extended halfway, the void behind him suddenly cracked open, and four or five black roots as thick as arms emerged, directly binding his arm, then coiling around his body.
"Space Divine Power..." Wang Fulong thought in shock, immediately operating an Attack Divine Ability.
Golden light burst around him, emitting invisible sharpness that sliced the black roots.
However, just as the Undying Tree Roots were being cut by the sharpness, Wang Fulong's eyes lost focus suddenly, losing their luster.
The All Living Beings Dream Seal and Dream Butterfly Dao Seal, carried by a root of the Undying Tree, pierced through the void and entered his body.
The Illusion Space unfolded. Although Wang Fulong's Divine Soul Power wasn't weak, compared to Yuan Ming, it was far inferior, and he instantly fell into the illusion with no resistance.
The other Returning to Void Stage Cultivators of the Sunset Sect wanted to help, but Yuan Ming flashed forward, clenched his five fingers, and punched out.
After advancing to the Undying Body, his control over power reached a new level, the concentrated punch wind was like a sharp Sword Qi, carving a deep, seamless trench in the ground in front of the few cultivators.
"If you don't want to die, stay put!" Yuan Ming shouted.
With his shout, he surged Qi Blood Power and operated Dan Tian Power; his voice was like a great bell, carrying penetrating power and assisted by Divine Soul intimidation. Instantly, the people of the Sunset Sect froze in place in terror.
When they regained their senses, they felt as if their innards were torn apart, not daring to assist or flee, rooted to the spot.
Yuan Ming turned to Wang Fulong, covering his face with a palm, delving into his Sea of Consciousness with Divine Soul Power, employing the Soul Searching Divine Ability.
However, as his Divine Thought entered Wang Fulong's Sea of Consciousness, a golden light suddenly shone from within, forcibly expelling his Divine Thought.
"Divine Soul Forbidden..." Yuan Ming frowned slightly and continued casting.
Yet, this golden light prohibition was extraordinarily domineering, making Yuan Ming's Soul Search unable to delve deeper. Forcing through would make Wang Fulong's Divine Soul in his Sea of Consciousness suffer a backlash, scattering his soul into oblivion, resulting in nothing.
Reluctantly, Yuan Ming halted, first restraining Wang Fulong's Mana, then dispelled the illusion to awaken him.
As his eyes opened, Wang Fulong immediately understood the situation, his heart sinking to rock bottom.
"I hadn't anticipated that Fellow Daoist Wan was cultivating body, mana, and soul; I am no match for you." He sighed, sitting on the ground without regard for his image, completely relinquishing his resistance.
"Since that's the case, do you still intend to resist? Although your Divine Soul is set with a prohibition, preventing me from forcibly soul searching, you know as well, Soul Cultivators have ways to make you wish you were dead." Yuan Ming spoke indifferently.
Wang Fulong's body shuddered, yet remained silent.
"Since Fellow Daoist Wang wants to test my methods, I shall oblige!" Yuan Ming coldly snickered, without apparent action, the surrounding temperature swiftly turned bone-chillingly cold.
"No, I'll speak!" Wang Fulong suddenly lifted his head.
"Oh, why surrender so quickly?" Yuan Ming was rather surprised, waving to disperse the surrounding coldness.
"Falling into Fellow Daoist Wan's hands, if I don't cooperate, the outcome is surely soul scattering, and I don't want to die yet." Wang Fulong lowered his head.
He only had a relationship of mutual benefit with the person behind him, and with his life hanging by a thread, he couldn't care for that anymore.
Although telling Yuan Ming everything would later bring great danger to himself, that was a worry for another time.
"Fellow Daoist Wang is reasonable. Speak." Yuan Ming smiled and sat opposite Wang Fulong.
"The person who wants to assassinate Fellow Daoist Wan is the Young Master of Taixuan Sect, Young Master Que Yue." Wang Fulong didn't hesitate and said immediately.
Young Master Que Yue?
Yuan Ming pondered for a while and found he didn't recognize the person.
Suddenly, he remembered something Sima Changqin once told him, that after the death of the Four Mountains Wanderer, the Four Mountains Linked Seal fell into the hands of the Taixuan Sect.
"Is this Young Master Que Yue mentally impaired? I have no dealings with the Taixuan Sect, why would he want to kill me?" Yuan Ming asked with a frown.
"Because of that Fellow Daoist Xi Ying." Wang Fulong explained.
"Xi Ying?" Yuan Ming was taken aback, then fell into deep thought.
"Daoist Xi Ying's actions in White Emperor City a few days ago practically told everyone that her intended person is you, Fellow Daoist Wan. Young Master Que Yue sent us to assassinate you because of this," Wang Fulong said.
"Just because of this? Is Young Master Que Yue also a suitor of Xi Ying?" Yuan Ming asked, his eyes flickering at the words.
"Yes, it's not just Sima Changqin and Young Master Que Yue, but also other Young Masters from several major forces," Wang Fulong said.
"Xi Ying is indeed extraordinary, but is she really that sought after?" Yuan Ming was puzzled.
"It seems, Fellow Daoist Wan, that you are not aware of the special trait of Daoist Xi Ying," Wang Fulong looked at Yuan Ming with a surprising gaze.
"What do you mean?" Yuan Ming inquired upon hearing this.
"It's a long story. Daoist Xi Ying's matter must begin with Elder Xue Shan. Fellow Daoist Wan, you must have heard of the name of Taixuan Sect's Supreme Elder, Elder Xue Shan, right?" Wang Fulong sat up straight and asked.
Yuan Ming shook his head. He knew very little about the Taixuan Sect, let alone knowing a Supreme Elder.
"Elder Xue Shan is not an ordinary Supreme Elder of the Taixuan Sect. He is a prophet who played a significant role in the last realm boundary war, successfully predicting the Demon Clan's movements, making a vital contribution to repelling them. He is hailed as the first prophet of the Chuyun Realm," Wang Fulong paused for a moment before explaining.
"I see, did Elder Xue Shan make some prophecy regarding Xi Ying that caused so many people to flock to her?" Yuan Ming nodded and asked.
"Correct, not long ago, Elder Xue Shan was invited to visit the Sky Eagle Chamber of Commerce and unexpectedly encountered Daoist Xi Ying. He assessed her fate, calculated that Daoist Xi Ying's fate is extremely noble, reflected in the Tianshu Star, marking her as the Heavenly Destiny's Daughter. Whoever joins with her can inherit the heavenly destiny, becoming this generation's Heavenly Destiny Son," Wang Fulong said.
"Heavenly Destiny's Daughter, Heavenly Destiny Son..." Yuan Ming stroked his chin, letting out a soft laugh.
"After this news spread, many young talents wanted to meet Xi Ying, with Sima Changqin and Young Master Que Yue being the most enthusiastic. It's just that Young Master Que Yue has been busy with important matters recently and didn't come to White Emperor City. He contacted me, asked me to monitor Xi Ying's every move, and after learning about her behavior in White Emperor City, he instructed me to find a way to eliminate you during the Heavenly Fire search operation. That's when I contacted the Black River Four Foes," Wang Fulong confessed everything honestly.
Yuan Ming briefly considered and compared various details after entering the Fire Rock Desert, finding no unreasonable points, indicating that Wang Fulong was not lying.
"Finally, I know who really wants to kill me, Young Master Que Yue..." He snorted coldly in his heart, but showed no expression on his face.
After a moment of silence, Yuan Ming swept his gaze around before continuing to ask, "By the way, why did you and the people of Heavenly Dragon Hall come to this Silver Mountain Range? This is where the silver light pillar phenomenon appeared previously, right?"
"Correct." Wang Fulong nodded, answering every question.
"I didn't see you from the Sunset Sect or the three from Heavenly Dragon Hall at Xihe Palace. How did you all arrive here?" Yuan Ming continued to ask.
"I came here following the Boarding Order. You should know about it, right? It's the silver token you took previously," Wang Fulong said.
"I know about the Boarding Order and the Three Realms Immortal Boat, but you said you followed the Boarding Order here, what do you mean?" Yuan Ming asked impatiently.
"A few days ago, after entering this space..." Wang Fulong, seeing Yuan Ming's displeased expression, hurriedly recounted his experiences from the past few days.
Shortly after entering the space, Wang Fulong unexpectedly discovered information about the Three Realms Immortal Boat and the location of a Boarding Order. After weighing his options, he abandoned the search for Heavenly Fire to pursue the Boarding Order.
Following a trace, Wang Fulong led his people to locate the Boarding Order. Just as he was about to seize it, the phenomenon of the silver light pillar appeared, and the Boarding Order seemed to be drawn towards it, flying towards the silver light pillar.
Wang Fulong had mastered a secret tracking technique, so he led his people to follow the Boarding Order, eventually reaching this Silver Mountain Range.
When Yuan Ming heard this, a slight change flickered across his face.
If the Boarding Order in his hand was drawn here by the silver light column, does it mean that other Boarding Orders were also drawn to this place?
"After arriving here, we searched thoroughly and discovered the Boarding Order trapped in a spatial rift. Just as we were planning how to retrieve it, the people of Heavenly Dragon Hall arrived, and a conflict ensued. After that, you arrived," Wang Fulong concluded.
Yuan Ming nodded in satisfaction at his response.
"Fellow Daoist Wan, I have told you everything I know. How do you plan to handle me? Can you let us go?" Wang Fulong looked at Yuan Ming, hesitated for a moment, and then asked.
"Whether or not you were instigated by someone, you have a part in the Black River Four Foes' attempt to assassinate me. How could you leave without paying the price?" Yuan Ming sneered and said.
"You... what do you intend to do?" Wang Fulong's heart sank, asking bravely.
"I haven't decided how to deal with you yet. For now, you'll have to trouble yourselves to stay in my domain for a while," Yuan Ming said.
As he finished speaking, the Dream Butterfly Dao Seal shone brightly on Wang Fulong's forehead, releasing powerful waves of Soul Power.
Wang Fulong fell back into the illusion, and the members of the Sunset Sect nearby were enveloped by the Dream Butterfly Illusion Technique.
Despite being at the Returning to Void Cultivation, they were unable to resist Yuan Ming's Illusion Technique and quickly fell into a dream, sprawled haphazardly all around.

chapters.title: Chapter 971 - 936: Treasures Everywhere
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming collected all the storage magic tools from the Sunset Sect members, then opened the Shura Palace and threw them inside to suppress them.
Just as Yuan Ming was about to continue on his journey, Kong's voice suddenly echoed in his Sea of Consciousness:
"Heh, you're quite lucky; inside Wang Fulong's Storage Ring is what you need."
"What is it?" Yuan Ming immediately asked upon hearing this.
"Jinglan Sand, Unrivaled Leaf, and Magic Cloud Rosin," Kong replied.
Hearing these names, Yuan Ming felt a bit familiar, and quickly realized.
"Aren't these the auxiliary materials missing for refining the Moon God Ring?" Yuan Ming exclaimed in delight.
"With these materials, the spiritual materials needed to refine the Moon God Ring are complete. You can start refining now; your Magic Practitioner and Body Cultivation have both advanced, and your Soul Cultivation also needs to accelerate," Kong said.
Yuan Ming was overjoyed upon hearing this and promptly searched the storage magic tools of several people. As expected, he found these three spiritual materials and sent them along with the other materials into the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space.
"For the next period, I will focus on refining the Moon God Ring, don't bother me," Kong's voice transmitted.
"Thank you, senior," Yuan Ming quickly replied.
After waiting for a moment without hearing Kong's voice again in the Sea of Consciousness, he suppressed his joy, thought for a while, and continued on his way.
He did not pursue a larger spirit vein but instead headed towards the Silver Mountain Range.
After delving into the Silver Mountain Range, the place was no longer desolate but began to show lush vegetation and some demon beasts.
These demon beasts were not only fire beasts; demon beasts of other attributes also began to appear.
After walking for a while, Yuan Ming had just reached the back of a mountain ridge when he saw a fire beast shaped like a hunting dog but as large as a bull. It was fiercely biting with a Fire Python as thick as a barrel.
The hunting dog fire beast was exceptionally fierce and swift, constantly changing positions and attacking from different angles. Each bite could tear a large chunk of flesh from the Fire Python, with its blood and scales scattered all over the ground.
Both demon beasts only had level four strength. Yuan Ming glanced and was about to leave when he inadvertently saw a spirit medicine with bright red flowers growing within the coils of the Fire Python, its fragrance masked by the surrounding bloody atmosphere.
On closer inspection, it was a rather rare Red Earth Fire Lotus, judging by the veins on its leaves, it had at least seven hundred years of medicinal potency.
Yuan Ming's eyes lit up instantly, showing joy on his face.
Red Earth Fire Lotus is a level five spiritual material, the main ingredient for refining the level five elixir Red Lotus Pill, which is a Strengthening and Nourishing type elixir, extremely effective for enhancing the cultivation of Returning to Void cultivators.
Although he no longer needed such elixirs, those Returning to Void cultivators in the Shura Palace could use them.
Yuan Ming immediately struck and killed both fire beasts, transplanting the Red Earth Fire Lotus into the Spiritual Medicine Garden in the Shura Palace.
He continued on his journey but hadn't traveled far before discovering a high-grade Fire Jade Marrow vein buried under a small hill over thirty feet high. Moreover, in that Fire Jade Marrow vein, he found many Broad-Eared Fire Rats with low spiritual intelligence.
These Broad-Eared Fire Rats were not very aggressive and had low attack power. They fed on Fire Jade Marrow but could produce a unique spiritual material called 'Fire Octopus'.
This spiritual material cannot naturally form in nature and can only be created through the consumption and excretion conversion inside the Broad-Eared Fire Rats. It is usually in very limited supply and highly valuable.
Yuan Ming didn't hesitate and excavated the entire Fire Jade Marrow vein, transplanting it wholesale into the Extreme Fire Realm, along with the Broad-Eared Fire Rats residing in the vein.
Afterward, he continued on his way and along the route found some more precious spiritual materials, as well as some magic treasures left behind by unknown individuals, most of which were already damaged.
These magic treasures retained materials still with spiritual essence, and if used thoughtfully, a little refining would yield rather fine spiritual materials.
"The nature's spiritual energy in this Silver Mountain Range isn't very dense; why are there so many Heavenly Materials and Earthly Treasures and these magic treasures?" Yuan Ming asked as he picked up a completely ruined palace lantern magic treasure from a mountain ravine.
This palace lantern was severely damaged and entirely beyond repair, but the wood used in this treasure was a rather precious level five spirit wood.
After pocketing the lantern, Yuan Ming realized something unusual about this mountain range.
He pondered briefly and released Wulu and Nan Shangfeng, briefly explaining what happened after they entered the Shura Palace, especially the peculiar circumstances in the current Silver Mountain Range.
"The environment here is not harsh, yet treasures are everywhere. You two should collect some, so the trip won't be wasted," Yuan Ming finally said.
Wulu and Nan Shangfeng were doubtful; Yuan Ming didn't explain much but took them along as they continued to advance deeper into the Silver Mountain Range.
After traveling for less than an hour, any doubts Wulu and Nan Shangfeng had were quickly dispelled to the skies as they each gathered a lot of precious spiritual materials.
Especially Nan Shangfeng, who found a not-too-damaged Earth Attribute Spiritual Treasure, the Crossing Earth Golden Light Boots, containing thirty-four runes inside, capable of extremely fast earth tunneling.
"I didn't expect such danger in the Spiritual Treasure Space to truly hold such hidden treasures. We should speed up; perhaps we'll find even better treasures," Nan Shangfeng encouraged after tasting success.
"This place exudes eeriness everywhere; let's not get complacent," Yuan Ming cautioned.
Yuan Ming's words carried more weight here, and Nan Shangfeng obediently agreed.
At this moment, Wulu suddenly stopped in mid-air and looked in a direction ahead.
"What's wrong?" Yuan Ming asked.
"Do you smell something strange?" Wulu glanced at the two and asked.
Upon hearing this, Nan Shangfeng subconsciously wrinkled his nose, then shook his head.
"What did you smell?" Yuan Ming frowned and asked.
After advancing to the Undying Body, his five senses had become much sharper, yet he did not detect any special smell.
"A scent similar to a mix of Windflower and Dragon Grass, very faint. The source is probably dozens of miles away from here, and it's highly toxic." Wulu waved his hand, stirring the air in front of his nose, differentiating it carefully, then said.
"Brother Wulu, what kind of Divine Skill is this?" Nan Shangfeng asked with a face full of curiosity.
Yuan Ming also cast a curious glance; Wulu's senses were even sharper than his.
"I've been cultivating a Poisonous Skill called 'Ten Thousand Poison Evil Skill' recently. It includes a Divine Skill for detecting poison, thus making my perception of toxic materials extremely sensitive." Wulu hesitated briefly, then explained.
"'Ten Thousand Poison Evil Skill'? Isn't your main Cultivation Technique 'Five Elements Returning to Truth Technique'? When did you change it?" Yuan Ming asked.
In White Emperor City, there's a Good Deed Hall where Loose Cultivators can undertake various tasks for the City Lord Mansion, earning good deeds to exchange for various items, including Returning to Void Stage techniques.
After Wulu advanced to Returning to Void Stage and lacked a technique, Yuan Ming prepared a few good books to give him, but Wulu had a strong sense of pride and did not accept Yuan Ming's help, redeeming the 'Five Elements Returning to Truth Technique' from the Good Deed Hall.
'Five Elements Returning to Truth Technique' isn't a particularly advanced technique, rather mundane, with the sole characteristic being its balanced nature which doesn't easily lead to Qi deviation.
"About five or six years ago, during a hunt for demon beasts in the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range, I accidentally obtained the Martial Arts Mantra for the 'Ten Thousand Poison Evil Skill'. 'Five Elements Returning to Truth Technique' is overly mundane; cultivating it means there's no hope of breakthrough in the Dharma manifestation Stage this life. In comparison, although 'Ten Thousand Poison Evil Skill' is somewhat perilous, it's much more mystical and allows for greater advancement in the future." Wulu said with a smile.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming did not ask further, but looked ahead, "Is that thing useful to you?"
"Very much." Wulu looked towards the direction of the poison source and said solemnly.
"Alright, let's go take a look." Yuan Ming said.
Then the three changed direction, flying towards that side.
A moment later, before reaching the target location, Wulu stopped the two.
"The poison of that substance is stronger than I anticipated, you should first take a Detoxification Elixir and then come with me." As Wulu spoke, he took out a white jade bottle.
Yuan Ming looked to the front, seeing a dozen miles away in the void, a thick black poisonous smoke spiraled upwards like a black Flood Dragon shooting into the sky.
In the high sky, a large mass of poison mist gathered persistently, forming a dense black cloud.
"Thank you."
Nan Shangfeng accepted the white jade bottle, thought for a moment, poured out two piece of Detoxification Pill, and swallowed them.
Afterwards, he handed the bottle to Yuan Ming.
"I don't need it." Yuan Ming waved his hand.
Having cultivated the Undying Body, this mere poison cloud is not enough to threaten him.
Nan Shangfeng and Wulu both understood Yuan Ming's strength, so they said no more.
The three continued their journey and soon arrived at the place.
It was an open area spanning hundreds of yards, contaminated by black Poison Liquid, making it black in color, and quite conspicuous in the Silver Mountain Range landscape.
"Indeed, it used its own Poison Liquid to alter the environment of an entire area; this toxicity is quite terrifying. Be cautious, return to Shura Palace if you can't withstand." Yuan Ming said when seeing this.
Wulu and Nan Shangfeng both answered, continuing forward.
The closer they went, the denser the poison mist became. Nan Shangfeng soon began to cough, feeling his throat uncomfortable, eyes slightly sore, and breathing becoming heavy.
Nan Shangfeng was secretly startled; even after taking two Detoxification Pills, he was like this. If he hadn't taken them and ventured here, he'd probably be poisoned and fallen by now.
"The poison mist ahead is too strong, stay here; I'll go alone." Wulu said, impatiently flying ahead, appearing completely unaffected by the toxic gas.
"It seems the 'Ten Thousand Poison Evil Skill' is quite powerful, able to ignore such poison; Brother Wan, do you know the origin of this technique?" Nan Shangfeng, unwilling to proceed, halted.
Yuan Ming also stopped, shook his head, and used Eyes of Golden Flame to gaze ahead.
In the center of the black area, there was a small pond three feet square, with black slurry bubbling and spewing bubbles, sending a column of black smoke twisting into the void.
A mysterious large flower, shaped like a begonia, quietly bloomed in the center of the pond, with faint traces of black mist lingering around it.

chapters.title: Chapter 972 - 937: Walking the Line Between Life and Death
chapters.content:
"So it's the Black Flame Begonia, no wonder it has such intense toxicity," Wulu looked at the eerie large flower in the center of the pond and said with a smile.
After speaking, he stepped forward, squatting at the edge of the black pond, and took a deep breath.
Black toxic smoke was seen being inhaled into his nasal cavity, and a cloud of black energy immediately appeared on his face, with black veins throbbing on his forehead.
Wulu's hands slightly clenched into fists, his entire body faintly glowing with purple light, and the blackness on his face quickly dissipated, revealing a look of satisfaction.
"Is Wulu using the venomous power for cultivation?" Yuan Ming thought as he watched this scene.
If this is true, then the "Ten Thousand Poison Evil Skill" indeed has some tricks.
Wulu sniffed his nose, turned his wrist, and took out a half-foot-long short dagger, entirely black, with the blade engraved in purple patterns depicting a bird poised to capture prey, its beak precisely the dagger's tip.
He held the short dagger in one hand and waved it a few times before stabbing it towards the Black Flame Begonia.
With a "hiss," the dagger tip pierced the center of the flower bud.
Immediately, a purple glow appeared on the dagger, as if it were sucking, continuously drawing strands of black poison liquid from the large black flower into Wulu's body.
The hand holding the dagger turned black and blue, followed by the wrist, arm, and finally reaching the chest.
Before long, even half of his face was stained black, the color deeper than before.
Wulu's brow furrowed, and the spot where veins throbbed on his forehead continuously pulsed, as if he was enduring immense pain, and his breath became chaotic.
Even though Nan Shangfeng didn't have the Eyes of Golden Flame skill, he could see Wulu's condition and couldn't help but sweat.
Then, Wulu suddenly erupted in a burst of blood light, and a set of blood-colored armor emerged, encompassing his whole body, the Blood Puppet Armor, instantly stabilizing his chaotic breath.
He immediately sat cross-legged, seemingly operating the "Ten Thousand Poison Evil Skill."
The Black Flame Begonia withered rapidly at a visible speed, and the small pond where it was planted quickly shrank, soon absorbed completely.
The black smoke ascending into the air disappeared, and the clouds in the sky, lacking a continuous supply of toxic smoke, quickly dissipated.
After absorbing all the deadly toxins, Wulu continued to meditate, changing his posture into a strange one, with one leg crossed and the other raised.
His body alternated between green and white, starting with bulging veins of black and blue on his arm and forehead, and later, nearly all his veins bulged, twisted like centipedes.
Wulu's brow wrinkled, and his teeth clenched with a grinding sound, clearly enduring extremely intense pain.
"Is he alright like this?" Nan Shangfeng asked with some concern.
"No problem, his current state should be related to his cultivation technique," Yuan Ming shook his head, saying.
However, just as he finished speaking, black blood suddenly flowed from both the corner of Wulu's mouth and eyes.
Before he could step forward to check, a wisp of faint black smoke emerged from the top of Wulu's head, and his complexion gradually went from blue to white, seemingly relieved of some pain.
Subsequently, all the unusual conditions on his body gradually disappeared, and he returned to normal.
However, when he opened his eyes, besides fatigue, a trace of joy flashed in them, as if his cultivation had advanced.
With the deadly toxins absorbed by Wulu, Yuan Ming and Nan Shangfeng flew over.
"You scared me to death just now," Nan Shangfeng sighed in relief, stepping forward.
"Sorry for worrying you," Wulu smiled.
"That dagger of yours doesn't look like an ordinary spiritual treasure," Yuan Ming remarked, looking at the dagger placed aside.
Wulu picked up the dagger, shook it, and said:
"This is a poisonous spiritual treasure I obtained along with the 'Ten Thousand Poison Evil Skill,' named the Ten Thousand Gods Poison Dagger. It can devour toxic substances, enhancing the dagger's power and transferring the absorbed toxins to its owner. It's indispensable for my battles and cultivation now."
"From your recent cultivation display, it seems the 'Ten Thousand Poison Evil Skill' requires constantly absorbing toxins to cultivate, right?" Yuan Ming asked.
"Yes and no. The cultivation of 'Ten Thousand Poison Evil Skill' has two parts: the advancement of mana and the refining of toxins. Regular cultivation only requires the advancement of mana, but each level breakthrough needs enough toxins to borrow their power to break through," Wulu explained.
"This kind of risky cultivation technique is truly dangerous," Yuan Ming said with a frown.
"Day-to-day cultivation is fine; only at the bottleneck of mana transformation do difficulties arise. Recently, my cultivation has progressed rapidly, nearing the early-stage peak of Returning to Void, preparing to advance to mid-stage, so I urgently need to store some toxins," Wulu stated.
"May I take a look at your physical condition?" Yuan Ming said.
Wulu hesitated for a moment but eventually nodded, putting away the Blood Puppet Armor.
Yuan Ming concentrated his mind, and his Divine Sense surged forth, penetrating Wulu's body. His expression quickly turned grave.
Wulu's mana was filled with poison, and his body was also saturated with toxins, which were trapped in his Dantian, palms, and soles by his mana through some mysterious method, preventing them from spreading.
However, the toxins were dangerously close; no matter how profound the "Ten Thousand Poison Evil Skill" was, it couldn't completely control all the toxins, and inevitably, there were leaks. Wulu's internal organs had been significantly corroded.
Fortunately, Wulu had profound cultivation and the regenerative abilities of the Blood Puppet Armor, allowing him to withstand the toxins for now.
"Such a sinister cultivation technique. If I'm not mistaken, each breakthrough is like a life and death ordeal. If successful, all is well, but if not, the poison backlash will lead to death and disappearances." Yuan Ming said slowly.
"Fellow Daoist Wan's observation is indeed correct." Wulu nodded.
"With such a dangerous cultivation technique, why not abandon it? Brother Wulu, if you're not opposed, I have several Returning to Void techniques here, all quite exquisite..." Nan Shangfeng, deeply alarmed, took out several Jade Scrolls and handed them over.
"Thank you for your kind offer, Brother Nan. Although the 'Ten Thousand Poison Evil Skill' is indeed sinister and overbearing, making it perilous to cultivate, its prowess in combat is extraordinary. It's also a rare technique that directly leads to the Mahayana Realm. I, although not confident, still wish to reach the peak of Mahayana." Wulu smiled nonchalantly.
Seeing Wulu's determined eyes, Nan Shangfeng sighed and put away the Jade Scrolls.
"From what I've observed earlier, the most challenging part of the 'Ten Thousand Poison Evil Skill' should be gathering and merging all kinds of toxins with mana, correct? I noticed during your cultivation that you seemed to use 'Void Thought Technique.' Do you rely on this technique's divine skills of refining different species magic power to meld toxins with mana?" Yuan Ming inquired once more.
"Have you studied other poison skills?" Wulu looked surprised.
Yuan Ming hadn't studied other poison skills, but he had encountered numerous techniques. With his high cultivation realm, he could often guess the gist at just a glance.
However, he didn't explain explicitly, only nodded and said, "Void Thought Technique, while mysterious, mainly excels in refining magic power, not in melding toxins. Currently, your cultivation is still shallow, allowing you to suppress the toxin backlash, but as your cultivation deepens, sooner or later..."
Yuan Ming stopped midway, not finishing his sentence.
Wulu just smiled and said, "I understand your meaning. Indeed, luck played a significant role in my successful cultivation to my current realm. I'm not confident about how far I can go in the future. Perhaps the next breakthrough attempt will result in my death from my own toxins, but..."
Here, he paused.
"Isn't cultivation like climbing a perilous peak? Brother Wan, your path to breakthroughs wasn't a smooth journey either, was it? Besides, I quite enjoy the feeling of walking between life and death. Only when constantly facing fatal dangers do I truly feel alive," Wulu laughed.
Yuan Ming nodded noncommittally, knowing Wulu's past and refraining from further persuasion.
He pondered for a moment and then spoke, "Since your mind is made up, I won't say more. However, I have something quite compatible with your poison skill."
"What is it? Let me see." Wulu's interest was piqued immediately.
With a wave of his hand, Yuan Ming made a sphere of purple light flash before him, revealing a round piece of purple jade that seemed to breathe like a living thing.
"This is the Purple Extreme Tai Sui!" Both Wulu and Nan Shangfeng quickly recognized the artifact.
"Your eyesight is quite sharp. This is indeed the Purple Extreme Tai Sui, currently considered a Level 4 Demon Beast. You must be aware of its abilities?" Yuan Ming asked.
"I've heard of it. The Purple Extreme Tai Sui can devour poisonous substances and fuse various toxins to generate a new, stronger poison, hence it's called the Tai Sui of Ten Thousand Poisons. With this, I won't have to worry about finding more potent poisons. As long as I keep feeding it toxins, the Purple Extreme Tai Sui can naturally generate deadlier poisons for me," Wulu exclaimed in surprise.
"Not only that, but the ability of the Purple Extreme Tai Sui to merge poisons can also shield you. If you suffer from toxin backlash in the future, this beast can use its ability to save you," Yuan Ming added.
Wulu was so overwhelmed with excitement that he was momentarily at a loss.
"Yuan... Brother Wan, the abilities of this beast are equally valuable to you. I can't accept it," he realized suddenly and waved his hand to decline.
"I have now cultivated an Undying Body and have no use for this beast. Besides, I encounter poisons rarely, so keeping Purple Extreme Tai Sui with me would stifle its potential. Please, don't refuse," Yuan Ming chuckled.
Wulu hesitated, still looking at the Purple Extreme Tai Sui.
Beside them, Nan Shangfeng had been listening to their conversation, and his expression was complex.
The Purple Extreme Tai Sui was an exceedingly rare demon beast in the Chuyun Realm and held immense value for poison cultivators. If a Level 4 Purple Extreme Tai Sui were auctioned in the Ten Thousand Goods Immortal Trip, its price could easily reach millions of Spirit Stones.
Such an invaluable treasure, yet Wan Tianren wanted to give it away so casually.
Nan Shangfeng found it baffling. In his impression, Wan Tianren, despite his vast expenditures, spent primarily on purchasing top-grade spirit wood and seldom squandered wealth randomly, nor was he often so generous.
Only today did he realize that Wan Tianren could be so magnanimous with friends, earning his admiration.

chapters.title: Chapter 973 - 938: Nine-Story Silver Tower
chapters.content:
While Nan Shangfeng was lost in thought, Yuan Ming had already successfully persuaded Wulu.
Subsequently, he straightforwardly severed the contract with the Purple Extreme Tai Sui and handed it over to Wulu.
Learning that Wulu's Beast Taming Technique wasn't very advanced, Yuan Ming took the time to teach him the Golden Sunflower Beast Taming Technique as well.
After successfully signing a contract with the Purple Extreme Tai Sui, Wulu felt that its abilities were indeed perfectly compatible with his own. The two were mutually reinforcing, able to enhance each other simultaneously, truly a match made in heaven.
"Brother Wan, I owe you a great debt this time. If there's ever a chance in the future, I shall repay it with my life without regret," Wulu said earnestly, clasping his fists solemnly.
"Train well and don't let my efforts go to waste. I only hope that one day we can ascend to the Mahayana Saint Realm together," Yuan Ming said, patting his shoulder.
Wulu nodded heavily.
Afterwards, the three took a short break and then sped up, racing towards the depths of the Silver Mountain Range.
About two hours later, Yuan Ming and his companions appeared near two towering peaks.
Yuan Ming looked towards a certain place between the towering peaks, his expression suddenly changing slightly.
"Brother Wan, what's wrong?" Wulu asked.
Yuan Ming did not immediately respond. Just now, the long-disconnected link between him and his first soul suddenly reconnected.
He vaguely sensed Yan Jue's location, seemingly somewhere between these peaks.
"I sense something unusual over there, let's go take a look," Yuan Ming said, and dashed forward.
Wulu and Nan Shangfeng had no objections and quickly followed, soon arriving at a valley that appeared before them.
This valley wasn't too deep, and it wasn't long before they discovered many traces of battle along the roadside, as well as numerous demon beast corpses.
"Looks like there are others in this valley," Wulu said.
"Let's go in and check it out," Yuan Ming said, leaping into the valley first.
The three quickly reached the depths of the valley, their expressions slightly changing.
A nine-level high, pagoda-style treasure tower sat here, its body bright silver, covered with intricate runes everywhere, clearly not an ordinary item.
Many people had already gathered below the treasure tower.
Yuan Ming swept his gaze over them and surprisingly found the Daluo Sect's Master Tantai, Yang Fan, Gan Wenqing, along with Long Hou from the Heavenly Dragon Hall, Jin Chen from White Emperor City, and all the demons from the Ten Thousand Demon Country.
He scanned the crowd but didn't find Xi Ying, and his heart sank a bit.
At that moment, a bright silver light suddenly lit up on the tower.
Yuan Ming stared at the tower door on the base level, where a round mirror was hung, displaying a large number "8".
His reaction was sharp, realizing the silver light was a flash from the treasure mirror, changing the previous number "7" on the mirror to the current "8".
"What does this number represent?" Yuan Ming silently guessed.
The crowd in front of the tower also noticed the appearance of Yuan Ming and his companions and the change in the silver mirror's number, their expressions varied, some happy, some worried.
Whether they had witnessed Yuan Ming's performance in the Xihe Palace or seen him seize the Boarding Order, they all realized Yuan Ming was far more unfathomable than he appeared.
Master Tantai's gaze moved away from Yuan Ming and landed on Nan Shangfeng, causing his brow to furrow involuntarily.
"Greetings, Master," Nan Shangfeng hesitated slightly but then walked over.
"Why are you all together?" Master Tantai asked.
Nan Shangfeng had long prepared an explanation and said:
"Earlier on the road, Senior Brother He suddenly attacked me, and it so happened that Fellow Daoist Wan was passing by. I paid a high price to ask for his help, and that's how I escaped from Senior Brother He, following him all the way here."
"He Xiuwen attacked you?" Master Tantai frowned.
He was aware of the discord among the disciples, but he hadn't expected He Xiuwen to make a move against Nan Shangfeng in this Dao Treasure Space.
"Master, not only did He Xiuwen attack me, but he also declared he would kill Junior Brother Yang Fan to compete for the Daluo Sect's Sect Leader position," Nan Shangfeng said softly, glancing at Yang Fan.
Upon hearing this, Yang Fan's eyes narrowed, and a sharp gleam seemed to flicker within them.
After the battle in the Xihe Palace, his aura had become even more intense.
"Where is He Xiuwen now?" Master Tantai asked, glancing at Yuan Ming in the distance, hesitating.
"After being repelled by Fellow Daoist Wan, he fled, and his whereabouts are currently unknown," Nan Shangfeng replied.
Master Tantai furrowed his brow and remained silent, while Nan Shangfeng also stopped speaking and stood quietly by his side.
"What should we do?" Wulu transmitted his voice to Yuan Ming, seeking direction.
"So many people gathering here, this Silver Tower surely holds much intrigue. Perhaps the phenomenon of the silver Light Pillar originates here. Let's wait and see," Yuan Ming whispered back.
Wulu did not object, and the two also found a spot far from others to stand.
Wu Yu's gaze landed on Yuan Ming, with a hint of hesitation in her eyes, but she still walked over.
"Fellow Daoist Wan, regarding the earlier incident at Xihe Palace, it was indeed my fault, and I sincerely apologize." Wu Yu took the initiative to bow.
Yuan Ming looked at her expression, finding it somewhat amusing for a moment.
"Fellow Daoist Wu Yu, earlier in Xihe Palace you clearly intended to put me to death, and now playing so innocent, I'm afraid there's another conspiracy waiting for me?" Yuan Ming replied, mocking her.
"Back at Xihe Palace, my intention was solely against Sima Changqin. I truly didn't expect that Fellow Daoist Wan would persist to that extent, and I was compelled to involve you too," Wu Yu explained.
"So, ultimately, it's my fault?" Yuan Ming retorted coldly.
If it were truly unintentional, just a word of warning would suffice.
In such situations, it was clear they intended to execute him along with Sima Changqin.
"Perhaps no matter what I say, Fellow Daoist would not believe me. The fault lies with me, and whether or not you forgive me, I still owe you an apology," Wu Yu said.
"Wu Yu, the previous incident cannot simply be written off with a light apology. Since you've already acted against me, the promise I made not to act against the Ten Thousand Demon Country's Demon Clan is void," Yuan Ming said coldly.
"Of course. But I assure you, the plotting against you was solely my doing, and the other demons of the Ten Thousand Demon Country knew nothing of it. They have strictly followed my orders not to act against you and will continue to do so. If you must seek revenge, please direct it at me alone," Wu Yu bowed again.
Yuan Ming chuckled coldly, saying nothing more.
Seeing this, Wu Yu lowered her gaze, sighed deeply, and turned to leave.
Yuan Ming quietly watched Wu Yu's departing figure, with a thoughtful look in his eyes.
Suddenly, his head was lightly tapped by someone, startling him. He instantly gathered all his mana and was about to strike.
The next moment, Yuan Ming relaxed his brow, a wry smile appearing on his face, and the gathered mana quickly dispersed.
"Was it enjoyable? Staring at someone for so long," Xi Ying's voice echoed in his Sea of Consciousness, carrying a hint of jealousy.
"Not as enjoyable as looking at you," Yuan Ming quickly replied softly.
"Hmph, you always say sweet things," Xi Ying responded indifferently, dissatisfied with Yuan Ming's response.
As soon as the voice faded, a transparent figure appeared behind him in Yuan Ming's Divine Sense—it was Xi Ying.
Xi Ying's Invisibility Divine Ability was exceptionally profound, and since they communicated telepathically, no one noticed, not even Wulu standing nearby.
Seeing that Xi Ying had no intention of revealing herself, Yuan Ming gently grabbed her hand.
"Don't resist," he whispered, secretly opening the Stealing Heaven Tripod and pulling Xi Ying inside.
Then, Yuan Ming sent a soul crow inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod as well.
"Where have you been these past few days? How was the journey? Did you encounter any troubles?" As soon as they entered the Stealing Heaven Tripod, the soul crow expanded, morphing into Yuan Ming's appearance, and eagerly asked.
"Don't worry, this place can't trouble me. Besides, I've been hiding nearby all these days and was never discovered, so I've naturally faced no difficulties," Xi Ying said, undoing her invisibility.
"You arrived early?" Yuan Ming was surprised.
"That's right. I was almost the second to arrive. While you weren't here, I searched the area. Based on my deductions, we are indeed in the inner space of the Three Realms Immortal Boat, and this Silver Tower is the control hub. The earlier silver Light Pillar also erupted from the tower," Xi Ying explained in detail.
"I see. Then did you find a way to enter the Silver Tower?" Yuan Ming was greatly surprised and quickly asked.
"Of course not. The restrictions around the Silver Tower are highly advanced. I tried for a long time without finding a way in. In my opinion, perhaps the only way is to collect all ten Boarding Orders. When the number on the tower's Round Mirror becomes ten, we can enter the Silver Tower," Xi Ying shook her head.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming realized the numbers on the Silver Mirror had this meaning.
"By the way, you mentioned you were the second to arrive. Who was the first?" Yuan Ming pondered and asked suddenly.
"I'm not sure about that either. When I arrived, there was no one else outside the tower, but the number on the Round Mirror was one. I suspect someone might have come and left after finding no way in. Otherwise, it's unlikely someone has already entered the tower, right?" Xi Ying shrugged.
"That's not necessarily true," Yuan Ming shook his head slightly.
He could sense that Yan Jue was currently inside the tower. When Xi Ying arrived and the number on the Round Mirror was one, it might refer to the Boarding Order in Yan Jue's hand.
However, Yuan Ming had no clue how Yan Jue got inside.
Perhaps the previous statement about collecting ten Boarding Orders might not be entirely true, and each Boarding Order might grant access to the Silver Tower independently.
Of course, these were only conjectures.
Yuan Ming shared these thoughts with Xi Ying.
"There might be another way into the Silver Tower, but with so many people around, even if you knew, it's inadvisable to act rashly. Otherwise, you'll undoubtedly become the target of everyone," Xi Ying reminded.
Yuan Ming nodded in agreement, then held his thoughts in abeyance and continued with the others, waiting for the arrival of the holders of the remaining two Boarding Orders.

chapters.title: Chapter 974 - 939: The Last Boarding Order
chapters.content:
A half-day later, the sky suddenly echoed with a piercing sound of air being torn, as if something sharp had sliced through the tranquility.
Soon after, a silver-white flying car sped through, like a flash of lightning streaking across the sky, finally coming to a steady halt on the open ground near the Silver Tower, under the gaze of everyone.
The door of the flying car slowly opened, revealing Sima Changqin accompanied by three figures of the Black Demons in everyone's sight.
His gaze swept through the crowd in front of the tower, and when it landed on Yuan Ming, his pupils involuntarily contracted slightly, as if he had captured something that surprised him.
But he quickly moved his gaze away, focusing on Wu Yu.
"Ten Thousand Demon Empress, our previous encounter left us evenly matched. Regarding the Xihe Palace matter, shouldn't you give me an explanation?" Sima Changqin slowly spoke, his voice seemingly suppressing anger, with each word carrying immense weight.
Facing Sima Changqin's questioning, Wu Yu remained unusually calm, as if she had anticipated this moment.
She responded lightly, "Fellow Daoist Qin Demon, what sort of explanation do you want? Or are you saying you wish to fight me here, to death, only for others to pick up the pieces and seize the Three Realms Immortal Boat?"
Her words exuded composure and confidence, as if she had already counted everything within her control.
Sima Changqin, hearing this, hesitated briefly but ultimately did not act. As Wu Yu had anticipated, he did not erupt into action but chose to endure.
Seeing this, Wu Yu smiled slightly, no longer pushing Sima Changqin's nerves further.
Meanwhile, Yuan Ming shifted his attention to the three Black Demons behind Sima Changqin.
Besides the already familiar Tie Xuan and Shen Xiu, there was now an additional mysterious cultivator wrapped entirely in a black robe.
This mysterious cultivator exuded a powerful and unfathomable aura, evidently having reached the late-stage Dharma manifestation level, much stronger than Master Tantai and Long Hou.
The arrival of Sima Changqin naturally caused varied reactions among those present, though most chose to remain silent at this moment.
As everyone harbored their own thoughts, Sima Changqin suddenly transmitted a message to Yuan Ming: "Fellow Daoist Wan, it's fortunate that you are safe and sound. Do you know what happened to the Great Sun Glaze Flame afterwards? Did you manage to subdue it?"
His voice carried a hint of concern but couldn't conceal the underlying inquisitiveness.
Yuan Ming slightly shook his head, showing a bit of helplessness, and replied in kind: "After a stalemate with the Great Sun Glaze Flame, it found a chance to escape. As for its whereabouts, I do not know."
Sima Changqin, hearing this, raised an eyebrow and said in a slightly comforting tone, "I see, but no matter. Having left the Xihe Palace, that Great Sun Glaze Flame shouldn't be able to cause much trouble. However, with the Ten Thousand Demon Empress setting us up like this, can you swallow this grievance?"
His words carried an ounce of provocation, seemingly probing Yuan Ming's attitude.
Yuan Ming chuckled lightly, calmly answering, "And what if I can't? After all, my abilities are no match for Fellow Daoist Qin Demon's nor am I a rival to the Ten Thousand Demon Empress. Even if you all start fighting later, I can only cheer from the sidelines to avoid getting caught in the crossfire."
His response was neither humble nor arrogant, showing neither excessive hostility nor undue vulnerability.
Seeing Yuan Ming's stance, Sima Changqin felt slightly displeased but refrained from acting on it.
He changed the subject, asking, "Does Fellow Daoist Wan know anything about this Silver Tower? Is it truly the location of the Three Realms Immortal Boat?"
Yuan Ming shook his head, responding indifferently, "I just arrived here as well and know nothing of the situation."
Intending to win over Yuan Ming, Sima Changqin, seeing his unyielding attitude, furrowed his brows slightly and said nothing more.
Yuan Ming withdrew his gaze, taking another look at the round mirror atop the Silver Tower.
With Sima Changqin's arrival, the numbers on the mirror changed from eight to nine, leaving just the final boarding order missing from the vicinity of the Silver Tower.
Three days passed like this, yet no one else arrived.
The people below the tower began to grow anxious, frequently gathering to discuss whose hands the final boarding order might be in.
Each harbored their own motives, and the discussions yielded little insight, being partially true and partially false.
Yuan Ming looked at the Silver Tower, his brow slightly furrowing.
Over these three days, he had repeatedly inspected this tower, finding that it surprisingly bore no prohibitions and was constructed entirely from a mineral unable to conduct spiritual power.
He attempted to use the Breaking Array Divine Ability of the Four Mountains Linked Seal but found there was no place to apply it.
