This silver mineral was unexpectedly and extraordinarily tough, and even the combined assaults of Sima Changqin and others failed to break the tower's body.
Amidst everyone's discussions, Wulu suddenly transmitted to Yuan Ming, "Brother Yuan, it's been three days already. I feel staying here is just wasting time. If no one arrives today, I plan to explore the mountains further."
Just as Yuan Ming was about to nod in agreement, a crimson tunneling light suddenly sped in from the horizon.
Before it even got close, the crowd outside the Silver Tower simultaneously turned their gazes, staring intently at the tunneling light.
Everyone felt a surge of inexplicable excitement and anticipation, as if seeing a ray of hope.
"Finally, someone else has arrived..." Many people stood up excitedly, expressions of anticipation on their faces.
However, when the tunneling light landed, the crowd realized that the newcomer was merely a Level 5 Fire Wolf Clan member.
His cultivation was average, with nothing on him worthy of the crowd's attention.
In an instant, the excitement on their faces faded, replaced by disappointment and helplessness.
Yet some turned their gaze to the Round Mirror on the Silver Tower, hoping for some change.
However, the number on the Round Mirror stubbornly remained at nine, without the slightest fluctuation.
The disappointing mood outside the tower spread like ripples, revealing a hint of impatience between their brows.
Their eyes were filled with longing for the final Boarding Order, yet reality did not align with their wishes.
The Fire Wolf Clan member, Di Huo, also sensed the displeasure of the crowd and cautiously flew into the Ten Thousand Demon Country's ranks, not daring to make a single sound for fear of drawing more attention.
Wu Yu's gaze fell on Di Huo, and she asked blandly, "Di Huo, how are things on the Flame Wolf King's side?"
Di Huo respectfully replied, "Your Majesty, the Flame Wolf King is still carrying out the task you assigned, but it's quite challenging. He estimates it will take some time to complete. He's worried he won't make it here in time, so he sent me ahead to report to you."
Upon hearing this, Wu Yu nodded, seemingly unsurprised by the Flame Wolf King's decision.
She said nothing more, merely withdrawing her gaze to continue observing the situation on the Silver Tower.
In the distance, Yuan Ming's eyes flickered as he noticed the Fire Wolf Clan member named Di Huo.
This was indeed a subordinate of the fake Flame Wolf King, and he was bold enough to come here alone.
However, Yuan Ming did not immediately expose this demon's identity. Like most present, he was neither friend nor foe, and even vaguely antagonistic with many.
In such circumstances, it was naturally best to remain silent and watch the situation unfold.
...
In the depths of the Spiritual Treasure Space lay a vast subterranean Soluble Cave, far more extensive than the Xihe Palace.
Here, searing magma formed a roiling lake that occupied most of the cave space, like a slumbering giant beast whose roars could shake the entire cavern.
The crimson light in the cave resembled blood-stained silk, dyeing every inch of stone wall fiery red.
The air, distorted by the high temperature, seemed scorched, the steaming heat waves like invisible blades, making one's eyes dry, almost impossible to keep open.
The temperature here was comparable to the scorching fire in the Xihe Palace.
And at this moment, the Great Sun Glaze Flame that once hung high above Xihe Palace revealed itself within this cave.
She maintained a human form, calmly seated in the magma, hands resting on her knees like an ancient statue.
However, the suction force emanating from her body was terrifyingly suffocating.
The surrounding heat seemed summoned by some force, converging towards her like rivers to the sea, constantly raising the cave's temperature.
Suddenly, her expression shifted slightly. Her once closed eyes snapped open, emitting two sharp rays of light.
Her gaze pierced through the steaming mist, directly towards the cave's entrance.
At this moment, three tunneling lights swiftly raced across the cave's ceiling, stopping steadily nearby. As the light dissipated, three figures emerged: Su Wu, Su Yingxue, and Hei Lian.
"Ha, it really is you." Su Wu's gaze fell on the Great Sun Glaze Flame in the magma, his lips curling into a meaningful smile. Behind him, Su Yingxue and Hei Lian also silently observed the Great Sun Glaze Flame, their eyes revealing a complex emotion.
The three of them now displayed their true appearances, without any illusory tricks.
They stood at the edge of the cave, their eyes fixed intently on the Great Sun Glaze Flame in the magma.
"So it's you!"
The Great Sun Glaze Flame's eyes narrowed, her brow furrowing, her tone tinged with coldness. "Earlier, you were sneaking around in Xihe Palace, changing appearances. Now you've followed me here. What are your true intentions?"
Facing the Great Sun Glaze Flame's questioning, Su Wu showed no panic. Instead, he smiled slightly and said, "Great Sun Glaze Flame, your reputation is well-deserved. Even with our careful disguises, we couldn't escape your discerning eyes. However, you needn't worry. We mean no harm. We're merely searching for something."
Upon hearing this, the Great Sun Glaze Flame frowned deeper: "Searching for something? In this desolate place?"
"Within the Three Realms Immortal Boat, there are only three places where Spirit Veins converge. Since Xihe Palace didn't have what we sought, naturally we had to come here for a look." Su Wu explained, his tone carrying a hint of determination.
"Who exactly are you? You seem quite familiar with this place," the Great Sun Glaze Flame asked gravely.

chapters.title: Chapter 975 - 940: The Numbers Don't Add Up
chapters.content:
Su Wu faintly smiled and said, "Our identities are not something you need to know. As long as you don't interfere with our affairs, we won't inquire into the schemes between you and the Ten Thousand Demon Country. Both sides take what they need, like well water not mixing with river water, wouldn't that make everyone happy?"
Though the Great Sun Glaze Flame had doubts in her heart, seeing Su Wu and the others' determined attitude and seeming unwillingness to be her enemy, she suppressed her suspicions and continued to absorb the Fire Attribute Spirit Qi in the Soluble Cave with her eyes closed.
As Su Wu said, he still stood at the edge of the Soluble Cave, waiting quietly without any improper action.
As the Great Sun Glaze Flame absorbed, the Fire Attribute Spiritual Power in the cave quickly diminished, and the previously boiling magma gradually calmed down.
The temperature in the cave dropped rapidly, and the water level of the Magma Lake noticeably lowered.
Once the Fire Attribute Spirit Qi in the cave was fully absorbed, the Great Sun Glaze Flame slowly opened her eyes, gave Su Wu and the other two a deep look, then her figure blurred and transformed into a Golden Shadow, quickly leaving the place.
After watching the Great Sun Glaze Flame leave, Su Wu waited a moment longer, then chuckled lightly and said, "She saved us some trouble after all."
Saying this, he suddenly raised his hand and cast several spells on the magma beneath his feet.
Suddenly, a silver spirit light surged from the magma, pushing the surrounding magma aside to form a passage.
Soon after, a rumbling sound echoed as a silver-lit door slowly emerged from the magma.
With a wave of Su Wu's hand, the door seemed pulled by some mysterious force, opening with a boom to reveal a hidden staircase.
This staircase seemed to lead into endless depths, each step emitting a faint silver light, as if formed from condensed stars.
Su Wu, Su Yingxue, and Hei Lian descended this staircase on foot, quickly arriving at a room flickering with silver light.
The room was empty, save for a Jade Box floating in mid-air, its body surrounded by complex runes emitting a mysterious aura.
Su Wu stepped forward and cast several spells on the Jade Box with a raised hand.
As the spells landed, those runes seemed drawn by a certain force, shattering and dissipating into starlight in the air.
The Jade Box then flew out with a "whoosh," landing steadily in Su Wu's hand.
Su Wu gently opened the Jade Box, revealing a key of ancient form lying quietly inside.
This key was a shade between blue and gray, though only half a foot long, it exuded an aura of age and weight, as if containing endless years and secrets.
If Yuan Ming were here, he would immediately recognize the extraordinary nature of this blue-gray key—its material, precisely from the legendary World Tree.
"Finally found it."
Su Wu's lips curled into a satisfied smile as he reversed his hand to put away the key.
He then left the Soluble Cave with Su Yingxue and Hei Lian, speeding toward the direction of the Silver Tower.
Their figures quickly disappeared at the cave's exit, leaving behind the slow-closing door and the room filled with silver light, quietly shimmering in the darkness, as if telling some unknown secrets.
...
Near the Silver Tower.
Another day passed, and the final tenth Boarding Order remained without news.
Everyone's emotions were like a lake surface swept by wind, waves rising and falling, hard to calm.
"Could it be that the final Boarding Order is really trapped in some hidden corner of the Three Realms Immortal Boat, untouched to this day?" Long Hou, with furrowed brows, said thoughtfully.
Jin Chen heard this and gently shook his head, "It's possible. Let's wait a bit longer. Wang Fulong and the Sunset Sect people have yet to appear, perhaps they are searching for this final Boarding Order with all their might."
After hearing this, Long Hou unconsciously glanced at Yuan Ming.
He appeared undisturbed, as if the external turmoil had nothing to do with him, causing an indescribable emotion to rise in Long Hou's heart, then he fell silent.
At this moment, Wulu was sitting cross-legged beside Yuan Ming, originally intending to explore outside, but Purple Extreme Tai Sui, after devouring several poisonous spiritual materials, showed signs of advancing to Level 4 Middle Stage.
Wulu simply gave up his thoughts of going out, closing his eyes and focusing, carefully sensing the changes in Purple Extreme Tai Sui, just in case.
Long Hou's gaze turned again to Wu Yu, solemnly asking, "Fellow Daoist Wu Yu, your Ten Thousand Demon Country was the first to enter this Three Realms Immortal Boat space, and you were the first to reveal the truth of this space to us. So, regarding the whereabouts of this final Boarding Order, do you truly know nothing, or are you secretly plotting something?"
"Though our Ten Thousand Demon Country was here first, the area explored was very limited. Regarding the whereabouts of the final Boarding Order, we indeed have no clue. If Fellow Daoist doesn't believe, I can swear by my Heart Demon." Wu Yu replied solemnly upon hearing this.
Seeing Wu Yu speak so decisively, though Long Hou had doubts, he didn't continue to press.
"Fellow Daoist Qin Mo, among the fellow Daoists gathered here, you are the most knowledgeable, can you think of any way to break through this situation?" Suddenly, Wu Yu looked at Sima Changqin.
"In recent days, I've devoted myself to studying the Boarding Order I possess and have indeed gleaned some insights. The Forbidden within this Boarding Order is quite unique, seemingly having a subtle resonance with other Boarding Orders," Sima Changqin said, slowly taking out a Boarding Order from his sleeve, its surface gleaming with radiant colors, as if concealing endless secrets.
"What can this resonance do?" Long Hou asked, a bit curious.
Sima Changqin smiled faintly and said, "I once learned a Secret Technique that can actually drive the Forbidden within the Boarding Order and perhaps sense the location of other Boarding Orders. However, this Secret Technique requires multiple Boarding Orders to work in concert for it to be performed. Therefore, I have a proposal: lend me your Boarding Orders temporarily, and perhaps we can sense the whereabouts of the final Boarding Order."
Upon hearing this, Long Hou's face immediately changed, and he said sternly, "What? Hand over the Boarding Order to you? This Boarding Order concerns our major affairs; how can it be handed over lightly?"
"Fellow Daoist Qin Mo, this matter is of great importance and warrants careful consideration," Wu Yu said noncommittally.
Master Tantai and Jin Chen also remained silent, clearly holding a reserved attitude towards this matter.
Seeing this, Sima Changqin nonchalantly put away the Boarding Order in his hand and said indifferently, "Since you are all unwilling to help, then let us continue to wait here. Perhaps in a month or two, the final Boarding Order will fly to us on its own."
Upon hearing this, the faces of Long Hou, Wu Yu, and the others all changed slightly. They all knew that coming to this Fire Rock Desert to seek treasure had already consumed quite some time, and there was indeed not much more time to waste here.
Master Tantai was the first to break the silence. He flipped his palm and took out two Boarding Orders, saying, "Lord Qin Mo's words are very reasonable. I am willing to hand over the Boarding Orders. However, I request Lord Qin Mo to cast the spell here to avoid unexpected incidents."
Jin Chen hesitated for a moment but also took out a Boarding Order, holding it in his hand while glancing at the others around.
Seeing this, Long Hou reluctantly took out a Boarding Order as well.
Yuan Ming pondered for a while, and then, without changing his expression, took out a Boarding Order.
Everyone's eyes then turned to the people from the Ten Thousand Demon Country, and Wu Yu smiled faintly, saying, "Since everyone is so united, our Ten Thousand Demon Country will not lag behind."
As she spoke, she turned over her palm, and a Boarding Order appeared in her hand.
However, when Sima Changqin saw the Boarding Orders in his hand, he couldn't help but frown. He found that with the Boarding Orders handed over by everyone and his own, there were only seven.
"It seems that someone here is hiding two Boarding Orders and hasn't handed them over. Is it necessary to resort to such cleverness at this time?" Sima Changqin's voice carried a hint of coldness.
The people present looked at each other, yet no one spoke.
"Lord Qin Mo, I suspect those two Boarding Orders might not be in our hands," Jin Chen said.
"What does that mean?" Sima Changqin's eyes shifted.
"Among everyone here, I was probably the first to arrive, and before I came, the number on the Round Mirror was already two," Jin Chen said.
With these words, the tense atmosphere in the room began to ease.
"Could it be that someone got ahead and entered the Silver Tower early? Or perhaps that person came and left, and is not here at this moment?" Long Hou's brow furrowed tightly, filled with doubt.
Master Tantai turned his gaze to Sima Changqin, and with a hint of urgency asked, "Fellow Daoist Qin Mo, with the number of Boarding Orders we currently have, is it sufficient to perform your Secret Technique?"
Sima Changqin nodded slightly, saying in a deep voice, "Seven Boarding Orders should be worth a try."
Upon hearing this, Master Tantai's face lit up with joy, and he laughed, "That's good. With the Secret Technique performed, surely we can find out the whereabouts of the remaining three Boarding Orders."
Everyone nodded in agreement, even Yuan Ming nodded slightly, expressing his approval.
Seeing this, Sima Changqin reminded everyone, "Then please take out your Boarding Orders, and later, as I cast the spell, everyone must inject Mana into your Tokens."
With that said, he was the first to raise his Boarding Order, and Mana surged out.
His hands quickly formed Seals, and he muttered words, obscure syllables continuously spilling out.
As the spell was cast, the Boarding Order in Sima Changqin's hand instantly burst forth with dazzling silver light, rapidly expanding into a silver ball of light several feet in size, completely enveloping his left hand.
Seeing this, the others also poured Mana into their Boarding Orders. In no time, seven silver balls of light floated in their hands, and the brilliant light reflected on them made their robes glimmer, as if clad in silver War Armor.
"Rise!"
With a gentle shout from Sima Changqin, beams of light simultaneously rose from the silver balls in everyone's hands, intersecting in the air to form a larger ball of light.
Under their watchful eyes, the ball of light slowly ascended and began to drift southeast.
"Great, the Secret Technique is indeed effective!" Seeing this, everyone couldn't help but feel joyful.
However, just as the silver ball was about to fly into the distance, it suddenly trembled and then exploded in mid-air. The silvery light spilled down like water, enveloping everyone outside the tower, forming a silver ball of light.
With a cry of shock, they instinctively wanted to resist, but the surrounding silver light suddenly became dense, as if an invisible force was pulling them into the air, directly crashing into the Round Mirror on the Silver Tower.

chapters.title: Chapter 976 - 941: Level 1000 Trial
chapters.content:
The silver light ball swiftly collided against the round mirror at the top of the Silver Tower, like a shooting star streaking across the night sky, disappearing within an instant.
Ripples appeared on the surface of the mirror, akin to a stone breaking the tranquility of a lake.
Everyone felt that the surrounding space was filled with a vast silver expanse, and after a violent fluctuation, it seemed to have traversed through several invisible barriers, finally descending into a mysterious space shrouded in milky white fog.
As the silver light around them gradually dissipated, the seven Boarding Orders returned to their respective owners.
No one had the leisure to mind these, as they all gazed around in surprise and uncertainty.
This space was enveloped by dense fog, making everyone feel as though they were in an illusory realm, their bodies floating lightly in the void.
All around was a vast whiteness, with nothing but fog to be seen. This sudden change filled everyone with caution, unsure of what challenges lay ahead.
"It seems that this is the interior of the Silver Tower. Qin Demon is truly capable of divine skills; with a mere spell, he brought us here," Wu Yu looked at Sima Changqin with an approving smile.
Sima Changqin did not boast of his accomplishment but said gently, "The method I just used was merely a guiding secret technique. As for why we were transported here, I do not know. Perhaps it was some sort of coincidence."
Upon hearing this, the others did not act rashly, each employing their own means to investigate.
However, the spatial pressure here seemed greater than outside, and the white fog severely impeded everyone's vision and divine sense. Everyone was thus extra cautious, not daring to act recklessly.
At that moment, a voice suddenly spoke, "Downward."
Everyone turned towards the voice, only to see Yuan Ming gazing downward.
Jin Chen beside him asked, "Have you discovered something, Fellow Daoist Wan?"
Yuan Ming did not answer but flew directly downward.
Seeing this, Wulu followed without hesitation.
The others, seeing this, also followed.
Yuan Ming flew downward for a moment, then suddenly changed direction, heading to the left.
Though puzzled, everyone followed suit, altering their course.
"Fellow Daoist Wan, are you using the Four Mountains Linked Seal to explore?" Sima Changqin asked curiously.
Yuan Ming did not speak, only nodded.
In his Dantian, the Four Mountains Linked Seal floated, rotating slowly.
Since achieving the Undying Body, his body could transform at will. Activating spiritual treasures was now more concealed than before, requiring no external projection, only internal activation.
At this moment, Yuan Ming's eyes faintly glowed with gold, interwoven with array patterns of the Breaking Array Seal. Under the insight of the golden eyes, the chaotic fog perceived by others revealed a subtle formation change.
Clearly, a rather advanced illusion array was hidden within that white fog.
This array, although advanced, reaching the seventh level, did not fully realize its potential for some reason.
With the Breaking Array Seal activated and the insight from his Eyes of Golden Flame, Yuan Ming had discerned its intricacies.
Yuan Ming led everyone in flight, going up and down through the fog for a short while. Suddenly everyone's view cleared, revealing they had unknowingly flown out of the fog's coverage.
Before their eyes was a vast and boundless land, flat, open, and silent.
In the center of this land stood a tall, blue-gray altar, serene and mysterious.
The altar reached a hundred zhang in height, wholly constructed from a peculiar kind of wood. Despite the distance, everyone could clearly sense a life force emanating from the altar, as if from ancient times.
A wooden staircase, roughly a thousand steps long, extended from the altar's top all the way to their feet. Each step was exceptionally wide, large enough to accommodate several people standing side by side without feeling cramped.
Long Hou gazed from afar at the altar, filled with amazement, and said, "This wood... Could it be the legendary World Tree? Who could wield such exquisite craftsmanship, using such precious wood to build an altar and staircase?"
Master Tantai, hearing this, also showed a look of disbelief, asking, "World Tree? Are you sure, Fellow Daoist Long?"
Long Hou nodded affirmatively, saying, "In Heavenly Dragon Hall, there is a classic book detailing the characteristics of the World Tree, with accompanying illustrations. I have pondered it many times; naturally, I wouldn't mistake it."
With these words, the others stepped forward to examine the altar closely. Some couldn't resist and reached out to feel the surface of the wood, as if trying to closely experience the aura of the Ancestor of Ten Thousand Trees.
The World Tree is the legendary spirit wood, long extinct in the world, unexpectedly appearing here.
Yuan Ming discovered the material of the altar earlier than Long Hou, and although his expression was calm, in his heart, he was secretly overjoyed.
Back in White Emperor City, the piece of World Tree trunk he accidentally acquired had already caused his Undying Tree to transform, producing dozens of strands of Ten Thousand Wood Origin Power. Yet the altar before him was entirely made from the World Tree. If he could refine all of it, who knows to what level his Undying Tree would advance.
Thus, Yuan Ming also approached the altar, reaching out to gently touch the surface of the wood.
From his palm emerged a root of the Undying Tree, smoothly piercing into the interior of the altar.
However, when he attempted to channel force to absorb the World Tree's Original Spiritual Power, he discovered the entire altar was enveloped by a formidable forbidden power, preventing the Undying Tree's roots from extracting even a trace of spiritual power.
As everyone was carefully observing this mysterious altar, an azure spirit light suddenly rose from the altar.
This spirit light coalesced mid-air into the spectral figure of an old man with cyan hair and beard, whose sudden appearance startled everyone below the altar, drawing all eyes to him.
"Hehe, you all are indeed exceptional to have entered the Three Realms Immortal Boat, arriving here. It seems the Three Realms Immortal Boat may find a qualified helmsman among you. I am the helmsman of this Three Realms Immortal Boat; you may call me Jie Cha," the cyan-bearded elder said with a warm smile to everyone.
Upon hearing his words, everyone felt a sense of happiness, secretly pondering that this place truly was the legendary Three Realms Immortal Boat.
From Jie Cha's words, they seemed to sense a hint of selecting an inheritor.
Long Hou's gaze was sharp, carefully examining Jie Cha before suddenly speaking up, "Helmsman? If I'm not mistaken, you should be the Artifact Spirit of the Three Realms Immortal Boat."
Jie Cha smiled slightly, replying, "To the Three Realms Immortal Boat, helmsman and Artifact Spirit are merely titles differing in name, with no essential distinction."
"I dare to ask Senior Jie Cha, how can we gain control over the Three Realms Immortal Boat?" Jin Chen directly voiced the common curiosity of everyone.
Jie Cha's gaze was profound as he slowly said, "The method is actually simple. This altar where I stand is the control hub of the Three Realms Immortal Boat. Whoever can first ascend this thousand-step stairway and reach the altar top will become the next master of the Three Realms Immortal Boat."
Master Tantai furrowed his brows, glancing at Wu Yu, and asked in a deep voice, "Senior Jie Cha, how can we trust what you say? Could this trial be a trap meticulously set by some?"
Wu Yu's expression remained calm, seemingly oblivious to Master Tantai's gaze.
Jie Cha's demeanor unchanged, replied indifferently, "If you do not believe, simply activate your Boarding Order to leave. I have no need to prove myself."
Upon hearing this, Master Tantai's brows tightened, though he had no intention of leaving.
At this moment, Yuan Ming asked, "Are there any rules to follow in ascending these steps?"
Jie Cha nodded, saying, "Naturally. Everyone has only one attempt; failure means elimination. During the climb, the body must remain entirely on the steps; if any part disengages, it also results in failure. However, ascending the altar has rewards. If you manage to reach the steps at 300-level, 600-level, and 900-level, you can choose a treasure from me. Even if you cannot eventually reach the top, you won't have expended effort in vain."
Upon hearing this, everyone began to discuss fervently.
Though these steps seemed ordinary, in Jie Cha's words, they concealed a challenging trial.
The various camps, despite lacking communication, quickly made the same decision: to dispatch individuals to scout the way ahead.
Wu Yu cast a glance and said, "Kong Liang, you proceed."
Several Level 5 demon race members from Ten Thousand Demon Country immediately stepped forward, saluted Wu Yu, and without looking back, proceeded up the stairway.
Simultaneously, other forces dispatched Returning Void-level cultivators to attempt the climb and scout the path for Dharma Manifestation Realm cultivators.
On Yuan Ming's side, Wulu transmitted his voice, "Brother Yuan, I will also give it a try."
Yuan Ming nodded, advising, "Safety first. Retreat promptly if anything is amiss."
Wulu responded and then ascended the steps.
Not far off, Nan Shangfeng of the Daluo Sect also stepped out, exchanging greetings with Wulu before together ascending these steps that appeared ordinary yet concealed hidden secrets.
Yuan Ming watched Nan Shangfeng and Wulu's receding figures, his heart remaining vigilant. He quietly immersed his mind into the Stealing Heaven Tripod, discussing the impending trial with Xi Ying.
"The trial of the Three Realms Immortal Boat is no child's play."
Xi Ying's voice echoed within the tripod, carrying a hint of seriousness, "I suspect those Returning to Void Realm cultivators will likely only be able to reach the 300-level steps before exhausting themselves and returning."
Yuan Ming's soul splitting nodded slightly in agreement, "Indeed, it is so. The road ahead will likely be truly probed only by Dharma Manifestation Realm cultivators. My concern is that the difficulties on the steps may only be felt firsthand. If this is the case, everyone will have to rely on their own skill, unable to first observe others' progress on the climb."
Xi Ying sighed before continuing, "Moreover, earlier, Jie Cha never mentioned whether conflict is permitted on the steps. In my view, the rule that the body must not fully leave the steps seems to secretly encourage conflict. In the end, this assessment may turn into a chaotic battle. However, given your strength, apart from Sima Changqin and Wu Yu, there is little need to worry."

chapters.title: Chapter 977 - 942: The Pioneers
chapters.content:
"Sima Changqin's target isn't the Three Realms Immortal Boat, so I'm not too worried. But Wu Yu, the Queen of the Ten Thousand Demon Country, cannot be underestimated. She voluntarily told me the intelligence about the Three Realms Immortal Boat, she must have deeper plans," Yuan Ming's split soul pondered for a moment and said.
"As long as you know. This woman's mind is deep, don't be fooled by her beauty. When it's time to act, be decisive, don't hesitate at all," Xi Ying coldly snorted and reminded.
"Don't worry, I am not the kind of person who would pity beauty. During the climb, I will never let anyone stand in my way," Yuan Ming chuckled dryly and replied.
While they were talking, a group of Level 5 Demon Race and Returning to Void Realm cultivators had already stepped onto the seemingly ordinary but perilous staircase. Their figures gradually faded into the distance on the stairs, while Yuan Ming stood quietly in place, gazing deeply, his heart already prepared to face all challenges.
Wulu and Nan Shangfeng mingled in the crowd and stepped onto the seemingly mundane steps.
"Buzz"
A deep buzzing sound suddenly echoed in their ears, as if some ancient power had been triggered.
They instantly felt as if they were at the bottom of a ten-thousand-foot-deep ocean, the space around them seemed solidified, pressing against their bodies.
At the same time, immense pressure surged from all directions, as if to forcefully pin them to this step.
Both of them sternly performed spells, and their mana burst forth like a tide, a spirit light glowing on their bodies, forming a protective shield that offset much of the pressure on them.
However, before they could catch their breath, a strange suction force suddenly emerged from the wooden steps under their feet, continuously devouring their mana.
Wulu and Nan Shangfeng's mana operation was instantly thrown off balance, and the spirit light flickered on the surface of their bodies.
Although both were Returning to Void Stage cultivators with profound mana, at this moment they had to give it their all to withstand the suction from below and the pressure from outside.
After some effort, they finally adjusted their mana flow within and took another step onto the second-level stair.
In an instant, the external pressure and the suction from below intensified, as if invisible shackles were binding their bodies.
Wulu and Nan Shangfeng had to stop again and readjust their state.
In the ensuing time, they discovered that with each step they took, the pressure and suction increased by a margin, making it increasingly difficult to cope.
Initially, they could advance to the next level within a few breaths, but the higher they went, the longer it took.
Sometimes they couldn't even take a step within thirty minutes.
Looking up at the hundreds of steps above, they couldn't help but feel a sense of powerlessness from the depths of their hearts, as if an insurmountable mountain was in front of them.
Below, the Dharma manifestation cultivators observed all this, gradually deducing some details about the trial. They began contemplating strategies, trying to find ways to counter this pressure and suction.
At this moment, Yuan Ming was utilizing the Eyes of Golden Flame, closely observing the situation of Wulu and Nan Shangfeng.
Soon, he noticed the issue Xi Ying had pointed out.
It turned out that the suction from the steps not only targeted mana but also absorbed the Qi Blood Power and Soul Power of the climbers.
Moreover, the steps' absorption varied for each climber.
For those with abundant Qi Blood, the steps absorbed more, while for those cultivators with weaker physical bodies, the steps absorbed less.
This difference surprised Yuan Ming and made him even more vigilant.
"It seems these steps are quite intelligent. But it's not impossible to deal with," Yuan Ming's eyes flickered, and a strategy slowly formed in his mind.
"Oh? Then I'll await and see," Xi Ying said lightly.
"Not to mention me, Xi Ying, your perception outside the Stealing Heaven Tripod is unusually sharp. Moreover, I can hardly sense your Soul Power fluctuation. What realm has your Soul Cultivation reached? Could it be..." Yuan Ming suddenly changed the topic, inquiring about Xi Ying's Soul Cultivation Realm.
Xi Ying heard and smiled calmly, saying, "You're right, not long ago, I made a breakthrough in Soul Cultivation and reached the Life Witch Realm."
Yuan Ming was both surprised and delighted to hear this.
He knew well how powerful the Soul Cultivation of the Life Witch Realm was; not only did it greatly enhance calculation abilities, but it also allowed one to peer into fate to some extent. One could even cultivate the Yin Moon Body, a state of intangibility that made him extremely envious.
"No wonder you have the confidence to stay by Sima Changqin's side. Tell me, what does it feel like to be a Life Witch? I've heard that upon reaching the Life Witch Realm, one can somewhat foresee fate, is that true? Also, I've heard that a Life Witch can merge the Divine Soul and physical body to cultivate into the intangible Yin Moon Body; can you let me witness this?" Yuan Ming curiously asked several long-held questions.
Xi Ying smiled while answering Yuan Ming's questions, then formed seals with her hands. Her body quickly turned into a phantom state, soon completely disappearing from Yuan Ming's perception.
At this moment, no matter how hard Yuan Ming tried to sense, he couldn't detect Xi Ying's presence.
"Is this the Yin Moon Body? It is indeed incredibly mysterious. No wonder you were able to approach invisibly outside the tower, and I was completely unaware. Moreover, the abilities of this Yin Moon Body seem to far exceed mere invisibility; otherwise, it wouldn't possess such powerful effects," Yuan Ming's tone was filled with astonishment and curiosity.
The invisibility ability of the Yin Moon Body left him utterly shocked, a capability almost on par with the Heavenly Escape Stone Talisman in Wulu's possession, making it impossible for anyone to perceive its true location.
Xi Ying nodded slightly and explained, "The Yin Moon Body is indeed extraordinarily marvelous. Besides invisibility, it can also shield its own providence, causing others to naturally ignore its existence. This is the fundamental reason why the Yin Moon Body is difficult to detect."
"Shielding heaven's secret? So that's how it is, this ability is truly defying the heavens," Yuan Ming suddenly understood.
In the time that followed, while observing the progression of Wulu and others up the ranks, Yuan Ming also inquired Xi Ying about the other abilities of the Life Witch. Xi Ying patiently answered each question, revealing a profound understanding of the path of the Life Witch.
Besides powerful divination and invisibility abilities, the Life Witch also comprehends the mysteries of the Three Souls and Seven Spirits, possessing an exceptional healing ability regarding the Divine Soul. As long as the soul hasn't completely scattered, the Life Witch can revive it.
Back then, when Xia Jie guided Yuan Ming, it was with the intention that when Yuan Ming reached the Life Witch Realm in the future, he could use this ability to assist in healing.
"Aside from these basic abilities, after advancing to Life Witch, have you awakened any other unique Divine Skills?" Yuan Ming thought of something and asked again.
Xi Ying remained silent for a moment, then shook his head and pointed outside, saying, "We'll discuss this later; look, Wulu and the others have reached a crucial moment in their trial."
Seeing Xi Ying unwilling to elaborate, Yuan Ming did not pursue the question further and turned his attention to the people on the stairs.
At this moment, Wulu and the other pioneers had already climbed to a considerable height.
The originally neck-and-neck team began to diverge under the dual test of pressure and suction.
The fastest climbers were nearing the 200th-level steps, while the slowest were only at the seventy or eight-level.
Wulu and Nan Shangfeng were at a middle level, neither rushing ahead nor falling behind.
Regardless of their speed, the climbers appeared fatigued, with many even swaying as if they might collapse at any moment.
This arduous test was a challenge not only of their strength but also of their willpower and determination.
Soon, the first to be defeated finally appeared.
This was a devil cultivator from the Ten Thousand Demon Country, whose true form was a Level 5 green snake.
When he stepped onto the 130th level, he could no longer withstand the powerful pressure and suction, collapsing heavily onto the stairs, unable to move further.
Jie Cha on the altar above waved his hand expressionlessly, and a green spirit light flashed, teleporting the Level 5 green snake to the ground below the stairs.
Not all the Level 5 demon clan from the Ten Thousand Demon Country participated in the trial. Those familiar with the defeated person immediately rushed forward to support him to the side.
At this time, a figure walked over, it was Di Huo.
He held a white jade box in his hand, offering it to the Level 5 Snake Demon and said, "Brother She Li, you look seriously injured. Please take this Jade Spirit Rejuvenation Pill; it will help with your injuries."
The jade box opened, revealing a red and white elixir that emitted a peculiar medicinal fragrance.
"If I recall correctly, this is a healing pill newly developed by the Fire Wolf Clan, not only recovering demonic power quickly but also having miraculous effects on recovering Qi Blood Power. It's indeed very suitable for you," said another Green Snake Clan devil cultivator supporting She Li, his eyes lighting up.
She Li looked at the elixir, tempted, but still waved his hand in refusal, "Brother Di Huo, this elixir is so precious, I can't accept it."
The intricate relationships between various clans in the Ten Thousand Demon Country meant that there wasn't a deep friendship between the Green Snake Clan and the Fire Wolf Clan, so he naturally wouldn't readily accept Di Huo's elixir.
Di Huo smiled, "Brother She Li, you misunderstood. This Jade Spirit Rejuvenation Pill was refined by me personally; it's not some precious item. I took it out merely to regain some of my costs."
She Li understood and asked, "May I ask how many Spirit Stones Brother Di Huo is asking for?"
"In the Silver Mountain Range, treasures abound. Brother She Li must have collected quite a few. I intend to exchange this elixir for some Spirit Grass to continue alchemy. One Jade Spirit Rejuvenation Pill for two Level 5 Spiritual Grass, or ten Fourth-level Spiritual Grass," Di Huo replied.
This price was quite reasonable. Without another word, She Li took out two Level 5 Spiritual Grass to exchange for the Jade Spirit Rejuvenation Pill and consumed it.
As the elixir entered his body, strands of red light emanated from his body, and his pale complexion noticeably improved.
This exchange among the Three Demons did not cause much of a stir. Although their voices were not loud, they were enough for the nearby demon clan to hear clearly.
Many Level 5 demon clan members who hadn't participated in the trial showed interest in the Jade Spirit Rejuvenation Pill, eagerly offering Spirit Grass to exchange for the elixir for future use.
Meanwhile, Wu Yu, the Green Snake King, and others remained indifferent to all this, their eyes continually fixed on the stairway, focusing on those Returning Void Cultivators still arduously climbing.

chapters.title: Chapter 978 - 943: Something Fishy
chapters.content:
After She Li left, the defeated ones on the steps appeared like bamboo shoots after a rain.
They were either mercilessly crushed by Space Power, or collapsed to the ground in despair due to depleted Mana. Once they lost the possibility of continuing to climb, they would be ruthlessly teleported down by Jie Cha.
Di Huo busily weaved through the crowd, marketing Jade Spirit Rejuvenation Pills to every Devil Cultivator who was defeated on the steps.
Soon, almost all the defeated demons received a pill from Di Huo.
These elixirs were indeed effective. Shortly after consumption, these demons recovered one after another.
"After leaving this place, inform the Flame Wolf King to have the Fire Wolf Clan refine some more of these elixirs," Wu Yu said quietly to Xuan Ye beside him.
"Yes." Xuan Ye nodded in response.
The effectiveness of the Jade Spirit Rejuvenation Pill not only caught the attention of the Devil Cultivators but also began to attract the gaze of the Human Clan's cultivators.
As a large number of defeated individuals began to appear among the human cultivators, they too longed for elixirs that could restore Mana and Qi-Blood.
However, there existed a longstanding animosity between the Human and Demon Clans in the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range. Though both sides harbored doubts and curiosity, no one dared to easily ask.
It was at this moment that Di Huo took the initiative to approach, holding several pieces of Jade Spirit Rejuvenation Pills, and smiled, "Fellow Daoists of the Human Clan, do you need elixirs for healing?"
A Returning to Void Cultivator from White Emperor City looked at Di Huo in surprise, "You demon clan actually willing to offer elixirs to help us?"
Di Huo smiled and said, "We are all trapped inside this Three Realms Immortal Boat now. Helping each other is merely mutually beneficial, so why bother with the distinction between human and demon?"
The cultivators of the Human Clan exchanged glances. Finally, a cultivator from White Emperor City couldn't resist the temptation, taking out two pieces of Level 5 Spiritual Grass to purchase a Jade Spirit Rejuvenation Pill from Di Huo.
However, he didn't consume it immediately but handed the elixir to Gu Chuanting for inspection.
After examining it carefully for a moment, Gu Chuanting said, "No problem."
Getting Gu Chuanting's confirmation, the Returning to Void Cultivator finally felt at ease and swallowed the elixir.
Soon, he felt the Mana surging within his body, as if he had returned to the state before climbing the steps.
Other Returning to Void Cultivators seeing this also came forward to exchange elixirs for consumption.
Before long, even Wulu and Nan Shangfeng were defeated, sustaining considerable injuries.
"Brother Wulu, that elixir seems good; do you want to try one, too? It's on me," Nan Shangfeng said, watching others benefit from the elixir with inclination.
However, Wulu shook his head and said, "No, I have my own elixirs for healing."
"Then I'll just buy my own," Nan Shangfeng said and then approached Di Huo.
At this time, Yuan Ming's voice suddenly rang in Nan Shangfeng's Sea of Consciousness, "Fellow Daoist Nan, this Di Huo is suspicious. The appearance he shows now is a disguise. He's not actually from the Ten Thousand Demon Country."
Startled by the words, Nan Shangfeng scrutinized Di Huo carefully, yet he could not find anything unusual.
"There's no need for futility; his disguising methods are extraordinary. It's normal if you can't find anything. I just suspect there's something odd about his elixirs, but I can't say specifically what purpose. Just be cautious," Yuan Ming transmitted his voice again.
Nan Shangfeng hesitated, looking at the other cultivators who had already consumed the elixirs. Eventually, he decided to come forward and buy one. However, seemingly influenced by Yuan Ming's reminder, he didn't consume the elixir immediately, appearing to plan to observe others' situations further.
Yuan Ming took this opportunity to glance at the Jade Spirit Rejuvenation Pill in his hand. The elixir was smooth as jade, emanating a faint glow, with a rich aroma, clearly a top-notch healing elixir.
Even with Yuan Ming's insight, he couldn't find any flaws, let alone see anything unusual.
He became even more puzzled in his heart, but without solid evidence and not wanting to complicate matters, he had to temporarily give up.
As time passed, the first wave of Returning to Void Cultivators attempting to climb the stairs was defeated.
Most among them only managed to climb to about the hundred-level, while the best only reached the 210th Level before halting.
From the mouths of the defeated, the Dharma manifestation Cultivators gained a clearer understanding of the situation on the steps.
However, they still refrained from taking action, intending to continue letting their subordinates try to gain more information about the steps.
Beside Yuan Ming, only Wulu stood silently; he also did not participate in the second wave of attempts. Other Dharma manifestation Cultivators tacitly did not rush to climb the stairs.
As time passed, the second round of Returning to Void Cultivators also concluded their attempts. The results remained unsatisfactory, with no one able to reach three hundred steps.
"It seems it's time for us to step in personally," Long Hou suddenly chuckled softly, his figure flashed to the front of the stairs.
Seeing this, the other Dharma manifestation Cultivators no longer waited, flashing forward one by one, stepping onto the stairs in succession.
Naturally, Yuan Ming didn't continue to wait.
Jie Cha mentioned earlier that the first person to reach the summit could control the Three Realms Immortal Boat.
Those Returning to Void Cultivators obviously couldn't complete this task, so the Dharma Phase Cultivators present allowed them to try first. At this moment, a group of Dharma Phase Cultivators began participating, and naturally, no one wanted to fall behind.
Compared to the Returning to Void Cultivators, the pace at which the Dharma Phase Cultivators ascended the steps was several times faster.
At the start, their stay on each level of the steps did not exceed even half a breath.
It wasn't until they passed the hundredth step that the speed slightly slowed, but they still progressed calmly, showing no sign of pressure.
Yuan Ming was positioned in the upper middle of the group, neither conspicuous nor falling behind. The spatial pressure on his body and the suction power of the steps didn't seem particularly strong, similar to the others.
"You really think fast, using this method to weaken the stair's influence," Xi Ying tilted her head and smiled inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space.
Opposite Xi Ying, Yuan Ming sat cross-legged.
This Yuan Ming was not a Divine Soul Transformation but was his actual physical body.
Since the World Tree steps adjusted the suction power based on the cultivator's situation, Yuan Ming used the Undying Body's ability to hide his main soul and over ninety percent of his Qi Blood Power inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
At this moment, Yuan Ming seemed no different than usual, but his Qi Blood and Soul Power had dropped to the level of an ordinary Dharma Phase. Therefore, the steps' suction power wasn't particularly strong on him, similar to the others.
"There's no choice. If I don't use this method, these steps will significantly drain my Qi Blood Power and Soul Power. Even I wouldn't last long. After all, recovering Qi Blood and Soul Power is much harder than Mana. This test is very disadvantageous to Soul Cultivators and Body Cultivators. It seems that the Three Realms Immortal Boat favours Magic Practitioners," Yuan Ming said helplessly.
"That's only natural. Among Dharma Body Soul Three Cultivations, Body Cultivators only cultivate the physical body, and Soul Cultivators specialize in the divine soul, each with their shortcomings. Only Magic Practitioners are relatively the most balanced," Xi Ying explained.
"That makes sense," Yuan Ming slowly nodded.
While Yuan Ming and Xi Ying were chatting casually, the group of Dharma Phase Cultivators advanced quickly, soon reaching the three hundredth step.
The moment they stepped on this level of the staircase, all pressure and suction disappeared without a trace.
Everyone immediately felt their bodies lighten and couldn't help but breathe a sigh of relief.
This step was unusually wide, enough to accommodate all Dharma Phase Cultivators standing.
"Congratulations on reaching the three hundredth level. You can rest here for an hour. Fighting is forbidden here, and violators will be immediately expelled from the test. You can rest assured, the six hundredth and nine hundredth levels are the same," Jie Cha's figure appeared with a flash of green light and said.
Upon hearing this news, everyone was delighted and promptly took out healing pills to consume, taking the opportunity to refine and recover.
The first three hundred levels were easy to walk, but significant Mana had been consumed.
Moreover, they had no information about the following paths, which would only be harder than before. Therefore, they had to maintain their best state to smoothly handle the upcoming tests.
"Fellow Daoist Jie Cha, previously you mentioned that there would be rewards upon reaching the three hundredth level. Could you reveal a bit, what kind of treasures are they?" Jin Chen, closest to Jie Cha, saluted and asked curiously.
Hearing this, everyone else also turned their eyes to Jie Cha, their eyes gleaming with anticipation.
Jie Cha smiled slightly without answering directly and waved his hand.
In an instant, a large area of green spirit light emerged on the steps beneath them. These spirit lights danced like elves, quickly gathering in front of everyone to form a phantom screen.
On the screen, words flowed, filled with the names of various treasures.
Counting carefully, there were actually over two hundred items, a dazzling variety, ranging from rare spiritual materials and elixirs to powerful cultivation techniques and spiritual treasures, truly everything one could ask for.
"Seven-leaf Jade Chalice Flower! It's said that consuming this flower can assist in breaking through the bottleneck of the Dharma Phase. This Seven-leaf Jade Chalice Flower has been extinct for millennia; I never expected to see it by chance here!" Long Hou looked at one item on the screen in surprise and exclaimed.
"Flying Spirit Wings, actually a flying spiritual treasure with thirty-five runes! This item is the sacred treasure of the Feitian Sect; it's rumored that a single flap can carry one hundred miles, truly astonishing," Master Tantai also exclaimed in joy, his eyes fixed on that spiritual treasure on the screen.
"These elixirs... are all geared towards enhancing the divine soul! Soul Refining Elixir, Soul Stabilizing Pill, Soul Nourishing Pill, a complete range with such a large quantity. It seems this Three Realms Flying Boat is indeed deeply rooted," the Black Bear King of the Ten Thousand Demon Country muttered with low growls, both eyes flashing with excitement.
Yuan Ming looked at the items on the screen and was also pleasantly surprised.
These items were quite precious; any one of them would greatly aid his current cultivation. Unfortunately, he could only choose one.
His magic and body cultivation had just recently broken through, now only his soul cultivation was still lagging, so he hoped to choose an item that could aid in advancing his soul cultivation.
Of course, although elixirs like the Soul Refining Elixir were also good, he hoped to find a treasure like the Moon God's Three Treasures that could speed up absorbing the Moonlight Power.
While Yuan Ming pondered, his gaze quickly scanned the list on the screen but found no similar treasure.
"Indeed, treasures that aid soul cultivation are rare," Yuan Ming sighed inwardly, intending to settle for another treasure when his gaze suddenly stopped on a certain item.
"There's actually this item..." Yuan Ming's eyes lit up, and he began to contemplate.

chapters.title: Chapter 979 - 944: The Second Trial
chapters.content:
While Yuan Ming was silently making his selection, the others were also choosing their desired items, but soon, an urgent question arose among the crowd.
"Fellow Daoist Jie Cha, may I ask, what is the order for selecting rewards based on?" Master Tantai couldn't help but inquire.
"Naturally, it is based on the order of reaching the three hundredth step," Jie Cha replied calmly.
"Haha, everyone, then I won't hold back," Sima Changqin chuckled upon hearing this. He was the first to reach the three hundredth step, thus having the priority pick.
Ultimately, he chose a Spiritual Treasure named the Nine Heavens Phoenix Flute, which bore thirty-five runes and possessed formidable power.
Next was Wu Yu, who selected a Spiritual Treasure of the illusion type.
The Electric Roc King followed, also choosing a powerful Spiritual Treasure.
In everyone's eyes, compared to elixirs or spiritual materials, Spiritual Treasures were naturally more valuable. Even if one didn't need them, they could be exchanged for a huge amount of Spirit Stones.
During the previous climb, although the Dharma Manifestation Cultivators moved at a similar pace, there were still slight differences in speed. Those who ranked behind, watching treasures worth cities get picked by others, couldn't help but feel annoyed, regretting not having sped up before.
However, luckily, there were plenty of treasures on the light screen, so even those at the back could always pick something and not be too disadvantaged.
As the seventh Cultivator to reach the three hundredth step, it was finally Yuan Ming's turn to select a reward.
He had long made up his mind; he slightly raised his hand and, with a firm gaze, pointed to a spot on the light screen, saying, "I'll choose this Ten Thousand-Year Innate Bitter Bamboo."
At this remark, the surrounding Cultivators showed a trace of surprise.
In their eyes, although the Innate Bitter Bamboo was rare, due to its slow growth, its value to them at the Dharma manifestation stage was not as direct and significant as other spiritual materials or elixirs.
However, Jie Cha didn't pay much attention to these discussions. With a wave of his hand, a green Spirit Light emerged from his palm, gracefully tracing a path through the air like a green Spiritual Snake, finally landing in front of Yuan Ming.
The Spirit Light faded, revealing a stone box carved from white jade.
This stone box was simple and elegant, engraved with intricate patterns, emanating a mysterious aura.
Yuan Ming reached out, took the stone box, and gently opened the lid.
Inside lay a two-foot-long, forearm-thick verdant young bamboo segment.
Though small, the bamboo was full and robust, exuding a faint sense of life and vitality. Underneath the bamboo were roots, seemingly containing a boundless force of growth.
"Innate Bitter Bamboo? What kind of spiritual material is this? Why did you choose it with such certainty?" In the Stealing Heaven Tripod, Xi Ying's voice carried a hint of doubt and curiosity.
Yuan Ming chuckled, stored the stone box in the Stealing Heaven Tripod, handed it to Xi Ying, and explained, "This Innate Bitter Bamboo, though not much use to me now, has extraordinary significance for you. Its effect lies in assisting the breakthrough of Dharma manifestation, which is exactly what you need to enhance your chances of breaking through."
Xi Ying took the stone box, a complex look flashing in her eyes.
She could naturally feel the extraordinary nature of this Innate Bitter Bamboo, but she also understood that Yuan Ming's generosity in giving it to her stemmed from deep camaraderie and trust.
"Thank you." Xi Ying lowered her eyes and said softly.
Her voice was calm, but her tone revealed a hint of emotion.
Yuan Ming waved his hand dismissively, saying, "There's no need to be so formal between us. Your Dharma Manifestation Pill still lacks some auxiliary spiritual materials. I've already sent someone to gather them, and once this task is over, they should all be collected. Regarding this Innate Bitter Bamboo, don't rush to use it; I wish to ask Senior Xi Hezi if he could refine it into a Spiritual Treasure, which would give you better assurance in your breakthrough to the Dharma manifestation stage."
Saying this, Yuan Ming suddenly remembered something and continued, "Oh, Xi Ying, how's your Five Elements Child spirit pet doing? I recall it has a talent for cultivating Spirit Grass, perhaps it could help cultivate this Innate Bitter Bamboo?"
"The Five Elements Child is naturally adept at managing the Medicine Garden. Over these years, I've been nurturing him towards becoming a Spirit Plant Master, and he's made considerable progress. I'll ask him later if he can help cultivate this Innate Bitter Bamboo." Xi Ying blinked and said:
"Much appreciated." Yuan Ming nodded and said.
He already had a plan in mind; the Ten Thousand Wood Origin produced by the World Tree continuously had an astonishing effect on cultivating Spirit Plants.
If the Five Elements Child could use this Ten Thousand Wood Origin to cultivate the Innate Bitter Bamboo, it might greatly enhance its growth speed, thereby unleashing greater value.
Meanwhile, the other Dharma manifestation Cultivators, after selecting their rewards, also sat down cross-legged, closing their eyes to rest.
They knew the road ahead would be even more arduous, requiring every bit of time to rest and adjust their state.
An hour passed in the blink of an eye.
At this moment, all the Dharma Phase Cultivators awoke from contemplation and stood up.
In this short hour, everyone did their utmost to restore their Mana and energy.
Yuan Ming, aided by the Undying Tree, although unable to draw from the underground Spirit Vein here, the roots of the Undying Tree could directly draw Spiritual Power from Spirit Stones, allowing Mana to recover faster than anyone else.
As for Qi-Blood and Soul Power, though expended to some extent, they too had long been fully restored under the nurturing in the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space.
As everyone prepared to continue the ascent, Jie Cha's voice suddenly sounded, "Everyone, the upcoming trials will be much more difficult than before, and if you can't sustain, leave the stairs immediately to avoid harming your life."
Master Tantai hurriedly asked upon hearing this, "What do you mean by that, Fellow Daoist Jie Cha?"
Yet Jie Cha did not reply and merely disappeared in a blur, reappearing atop the altar just like before.
The people exchanged glances, a hint of solemnity flashing in their eyes.
But they did not retreat. Instead, they stepped onto the three hundred and first step, and their expressions shifted.
Yuan Ming also stepped onto the new level, and in an instant, a terrifying force suddenly descended upon his shoulders.
This force far surpassed any of the previous levels, and the suction from the staircase beneath his feet had also increased severalfold, seeming as if it would swallow him whole.
However, Yuan Ming showed not a hint of panic. In fact, he appeared somewhat delighted.
He understood that the difficulty of climbing had increased.
If the previous difficulty remained, perhaps everyone could easily reach the top, but now was the true test of strength and perseverance.
He immediately calmed and focused, activating fifty percent of his mana. His entire body glowed with spirit light, isolating the spatial pressure, continuing his steady progress.
At this moment, a thunderous crash echoed from the sky, and countless earth-yellow runes appeared out of thin air. As their brilliance circulated, a raging gale was stirred up.
Following this, countless grains of yellow sand descended from the sky, swept along with the gale, striking the people.
This yellow sand was as hard and sharp as golden iron, with each grain like a sharp blade, constantly slicing through their bodies.
A group of Dharma manifestation cultivators saw this and hastily cast spells to resist.
Yet, Yuan Ming seemed completely unaffected, continuing to stride forward, allowing the yellow sand to strike his body.
Though his body was battered with countless wounds, in the next instant, a flash of blood light swept across his surface, instantly restoring all the injuries as if they never existed.
"This is the Undying Body!"
Many on the stairs exclaimed in surprise when they saw this.
Though they had previously speculated, witnessing Yuan Ming emerge unscathed from the yellow sand filled their hearts with shock.
The trio of Long Hou felt the earth shake within them more profoundly, as they had guessed before that this "Wan Tianren" had already achieved the Undying Body. Now, seeing this, their suspicions were finally confirmed.
Sima Changqin narrowed his eyes, looked at Yuan Ming's back, clasped his hands in congratulation, and smiled, "So, Fellow Daoist Wan has already achieved the Undying Body. Truly commendable."
However, Yuan Ming seemed to have not heard his words, continuing to stride forward, leaving everyone far behind.
In this whirlwind of yellow sand, only Sima Changqin and Wu Yu were unaffected like Yuan Ming.
Behind Sima Changqin, an ancient zither resounded, forming invisible sound waves that kept the wind and sand at bay.
As for Wu Yu, she was shrouded in a layer of white light, transforming into a giant fox shadow, similarly isolating the wind and sand.
She gazed at Yuan Ming's back, her eyes filled with complexity.
Originally, she thought she had a chance to surpass Yuan Ming, but now it seemed, it was becoming increasingly difficult.
She couldn't help but feel some regret; if she had joined forces with Yuan Ming back then, perhaps the situation now would be completely different.
As for Yuan Ming, he seemed utterly oblivious to this, with only one goal in mind, which was to climb to the top of the altar.
He quickened his pace, leaving everyone far behind.
As time passed, the people behind gradually adapted to the onslaught of wind and sand. Using their cultivation and divine skills, they gradually stabilized their figures, starting to catch up with Yuan Ming at the front.
The raging wind and sand seemed to sense their resilience and did not persist for long, gradually dissipating to reveal a clear sky.
Just as everyone thought they could temporarily breathe a sigh of relief, a sudden explosion echoed from mid-air, deafeningly loud.
Following this, countless millstone-sized fireballs rained down from the sky, intensely and violently crashing towards the people below.
These fireballs contained terrifying temperatures, igniting the surrounding air into a sea of sweltering flames even before touching the ground.
Everyone quickly summoned their magic treasures, casting spells to form protective divine powers, defending against this abrupt fiery assault.
Behind Sima Changqin, an ancient zither resounded, spreading invisible sound waves to block the incoming fireballs. Wu Yu was shrouded in a layer of white light, forming a sturdy protective shield that kept the fireballs out.
However, within this fiery onslaught, Yuan Ming appeared particularly composed.
He didn't fully defend like the others but activated the Primordial Dao Seal within his Dantian. He fully understood the weakness of the Undying Body, yet this fiery attack was a rare training opportunity for him.
As he did so, a seven-colored mana vortex appeared above his head, shimmering brightly.
One after another, the gigantic fireballs smashed onto the steps, producing deafening explosions, and the entire staircase was transformed into a sea of fire, its scorching waves engulfing everyone.
Yuan Ming activated the Primordial Dao Seal, and the seven-colored mana vortex spun rapidly, emanating a horrifying force of tearing.
The nearby scorching fire waves hadn't even approached when they were drawn into the mana vortex, shredded and devoured, not causing him the slightest harm, instead enhancing the fire attribute mana within him considerably.

chapters.title: Chapter 980 - 945: Obstruction
chapters.content:
A trace of joy flashed in Yuan Ming's eyes; the effect of the Primordial Dao Seal was much better than he had anticipated.
As he controlled the Primordial Dao Seal to absorb the raging flames, he continued to ascend the steps, and his speed was almost completely unaffected.
Although Sima Changqin and Wu Yu also blocked the surging flames, they were obviously not as relaxed and free as Yuan Ming.
They watched Yuan Ming's figure steadily advancing in the sea of fire, their eyes involuntarily revealing a hint of surprise.
The vast fire rain only lasted for a moment before disappearing without a trace, yet the sky did not calm down because of it.
The next moment, thunder suddenly appeared, and huge bolts of lightning struck down, seemingly trying to shatter the entire altar into pieces.
However, facing this thunderous power, Yuan Ming repeated his trick.
He activated the Primordial Dao Seal to absorb the falling lightning one by one.
In the following moments, various attacks continued to fall from the air, whether they were Five Elements Techniques or Yin Yang Power.
However, no matter what kind of attack it was, Yuan Ming shredded and refined them all with the Primordial Dao Seal, absorbing them completely.
His speed was almost completely unaffected, and he never paused.
Compared to other Dharma manifestation Cultivators, Yuan Ming's response method was undoubtedly the most relaxed.
The others had to frequently switch methods to respond, and while they managed when encountering compatible attributes, they often had to lag behind for a moment to find a way to break through when encountering difficult ones.
Although Sima Changqin and Wu Yu possessed high cultivation skills and numerous treasures, under the continuous onslaught, they also had to devote most of their energy to defense, thus gradually being left behind by Yuan Ming.
Gradually, the differences among the Dharma Phase Cultivators became apparent.
Yuan Ming took the lead, ahead of the others, with Wu Yu and Sima Changqin close behind.
Behind them was the Black Demon, who was always shrouded in a black robe and had never revealed his true face.
Further behind were the Five Great Demon Kings of the Ten Thousand Demon Country, Master Tantai, Long Hou, and others.
As for cultivators like Long Yinkong, Long Yuhuan, Jin Chen, and Yang Fan, who were at the bottom in terms of strength, they had already been left far behind.
At this moment, the clouds in the sky rolled again, as if brewing an even more terrifying power.
Suddenly, numerous blue rain arrows as thick as fists fell from the sky, dense and swift, as if to drown the entire altar.
However, Yuan Ming was not afraid at all, activating the Primordial Dao Seal to refine the incoming rain arrows while accelerating his pace once more.
On the steps below, Master Tantai was fully focused on casting spells to resist the rain arrows pouring down from overhead. He suddenly looked up, with a calm light flashing in his eyes, and lightly pointed his finger at his brow.
In an instant, a beam of ghostly blue light shot up from the top of his head, gradually condensing into a towering Dharma Form.
This Dharma Form emitted a profound blue light all over, with a smooth face like a sphere, and its features were blurred and indistinguishable, except for the starry outline of its brows and eyes, appearing mysterious and solemn.
Starry light sparkled on the robust right arm of the Dharma Form, seemingly containing endless power. It waved in mid-air and pressed into the void in Yuan Ming's direction.
Yuan Ming suddenly felt a shadow of darkness descending overhead. Looking up, he saw the deep blue nebula covering the entire sky, with hundreds of azure starlights falling from the nebula like meteors, carrying cyan tails in a fierce assault.
"Starry Sky Daluo Dharma Form! Master Tantai, to think, you are the first to act." Faced with this scene, Yuan Ming showed no sign of panic, instead calmly forming a seal with his fingers.
The seven-colored vortex above his head suddenly expanded several times, like a giant whirlwind, attempting to crush and refine all those azure starlights.
However, at this moment, the starlights suddenly exploded like brilliant fireworks, and each starlight bloomed with a deafening thunderous roar, in the midst of the ear-splitting crashes, the seven-colored vortex was shattered to pieces.
Master Tantai once again formed a seal with his fingers, and the scattered starlights in the air regrouped, transforming into slender chains of starlight that firmly bound Yuan Ming's hands and feet.
At the same time, beside Master Tantai, Long Hou clasped his palms together, a dragon's roar resounding through the sky, and a golden Dharma Form with two horns, half-human and half-dragon, suddenly appeared behind him.
The golden Dharma Form slightly opened its mouth, and endless golden light surged and rolled within it, the next moment transforming into a thick golden pillar, rushing straight towards Yuan Ming's legs with overwhelming momentum.
The scorching aura emitted by the golden pillar was suffocating, distorting the void wherever it passed, its temperature no less than the previous giant fireball.
Master Tantai and Long Hou's attacks were exceptionally coordinated; one locked Yuan Ming's movement, while the other launched a fierce attack with overwhelming breath.
Their objective was clear: even though Yuan Ming possessed an Undying Body and could not be completely killed, as long as they temporarily destroyed his legs, preventing him from reaching the stairs, he would be deemed out of competition.
The sudden attack from these two startled Jin Chen and the group of demons from Ten Thousand Demon Country, each of them on guard, fearing they would be affected.
Yuan Ming's expression also became serious as he quickly withdrew the Qi-Blood clone from the Stealing Heaven Tripod, and forcefully stretched his arms outward.
The terrifying immense power of the Undying Body burst forth at this moment. With a crisp "crack," the starry chains on his body snapped and scattered into stardust drifting in the air.
Before he could counter the dragon breath attack of Long Hou, the starlight on his arms flickered once more, and new starry chains formed, continuing to bind his body.
"As long as the starlight remains, the chains never cease. Master Tantai is indeed worthy of his reputation. As a peak Mid-stage Dharma manifestation existence, his Divine Skills are not as simple as they appear," Yuan Ming silently marveled.
In that fleeting moment of delay, Long Hou's breath had already reached Yuan Ming, leaving him with no time to react.
Just when everyone thought Yuan Ming was cornered, an unexpected change occurred.
Yuan Ming suddenly took a deep breath, as if drawing in the entire atmosphere. In an instant, fierce winds howled, and the air in front of him was drained by an invisible force, forming a temporary vacuum zone.
"Roar!"
Immediately, Yuan Ming opened his mouth and let out a thunderous roar.
This roar exploded like a lightning-bolt from the Nine Heavens, echoing in the vast void, inducing fear and awe.
At the same time, a fierce gale accompanied his shout, gushing out from his mouth, confronting the incoming golden light pillar.
"Boom"
A deafening explosion resonated in the area, as if the entire world quaked at that moment.
The golden light pillar shattered instantly under the intense impact of the gale, turning into countless golden fragments scattering in the air.
The raging winds swept across, even causing the Returning to Void Cultivators below the steps to stagger and falter, unable to stand firm.
The Dharma manifestation Cultivators on the steps, being closer, although they timely cast spells for defense, a few of the lesser Cultivated Dharma Phase Cultivators were pushed back several steps by the shockwave, nearly falling from the stairs.
At this critical juncture, Yuan Ming's arms exerted force again, shattering the starry chains binding him.
Then he quickly cast a spell with one hand, and the familiar seven-colored vortex reappeared above his head.
Without waiting for the scattered starlight to reform into chains, he absorbed all the nearby starlight into the vortex.
As gray-white light emanated from Yuan Ming's body, a majestic Dharma manifestation emerged out of thin air, its fists carrying world-destroying power, striking downward at Master Tantai and Long Hou.
However, just as the strike was about to land, several black spirit lights suddenly lit up around Yuan Ming.
Within these spirit lights, three black masks appeared, floating in the air, their eyes hauntingly lifelike, as if they held a life of their own.
With detailed irises, pupils, and blood streaks, being stared at by them induced a creepy sensation.
As these six eyes gazed, six black concentric rings appeared out of nowhere, quickly enveloping Yuan Ming's body.
These concentric circles were imbued with an eerie Power of Dao, containing the sealing magic similar to Xi He Palace's seven-level formation.
Under the influence of this strange power, Yuan Ming's body suddenly could not move, and even his newly formed Dharma manifestation seemed immobilized, frozen in mid-air.
His gaze swept down the steps below, he saw Tie Xuan, Shen Xiu, and that tall, big black Demon wrapped entirely in a black robe had gathered together.
Each of their faces was adorned with the same black mask as those around Yuan Ming, the masks' eyes flickering with a cold, penetrating light, as if seeing through one's soul.
"It seems that Master Tantai and Long Hou's actions were mere distractions; the joint assault of these three black Demons is the true lethal strike," Xi Ying's voice came from within the Stealing Heaven Tripod, tinged with a hint of gravity.
Confronted with this sudden turn of events, Yuan Ming did not display a trace of panic.
He took a deep breath, and activated half of the Dao Seal in his Dantian. Instantly, a powerful surge of Dao force erupted, ramming into the black concentric circles.
Rumble!
A loud noise was heard as the six black concentric circles trembled violently under Yuan Ming's Dao force assault, nearly dispersing.
Simultaneously, the twin glowing eyes on the three black masks dimmed significantly, leaking six lines of blood.
Affected by this backlash, the bodies of the three black Demons also trembled violently. They simultaneously let out a subdued grunt, evidently impacted by the backlash.
"This person is just Early-stage Dharma manifestation, how can he possess such formidable Dao power? Quickly use the Holy Sacrifice Technique to activate the Six Extremes Mask!" The tall, big black Demon barely steadied himself, his eyes filled with disbelief.
He swiftly formed a hand seal in front of him, and a black light surged behind him, promptly revealing a tall and eerie black Dharma manifestation.
This Dharma manifestation took a humanoid shape, yet was entwined by two sinister black giant pythons, as if it were a sinister deity from the Nine Netherworld, instilling a profound sense of unease.
"This is..." Wu Yu observed this Dharma manifestation, seemingly recalling something, causing his expression to subtly change.

chapters.title: Chapter 981 - 946: Confrontation
chapters.content:
The tall, big black Demon quickly slit his finger, and the fresh blood dripped onto the black mask.
He drew with force, leaving three shocking blood marks on the mask.
As the blood seeped in, the black mask immediately emitted a strong blood light, and an extremely sinister aura erupted like a storm.
Within this sinister aura, besides the fluctuations of mana, there was also a strong mix of Desire Power, as if countless creatures were shouting and praying.
Immediately after, the tall black Dharma manifestation turned into a dark light, like a black lightning bolt, that instantly merged into the mask on his face. At the same time, Tie Xuan and Shen Xiu executed the same move, each offering their own Dharma manifestation into their masks without hesitation.
As the Dharma manifestations of the three merged, the six black concentric circles around Yuan Ming stabilized and unleashed even greater power.
A massive black Light Pillar shot straight up into the sky, its might seeming to tear the heavens and earth apart, directly engulfing Yuan Ming's figure.
At this moment, the strange Power of Dao increased several times over, like a surging torrent, completely suppressing the Power of Dao fluctuations on Yuan Ming.
Under the suppression of this power, Yuan Ming seemed to become a trapped beast, unable to break free from the restraints.
Sima Changqin witnessed this scene, and his previously raised arm slowly lowered, a hint of satisfaction flashed in his eyes, as if everything was under his control.
"That is the mask of the Six Extremes Evil God, indeed extraordinary. To eliminate Wan Tianren, Qin Demon, you are even willing to let three Black Demons take such a great risk. Such decisive slaughter, worthy of a Guardian." Not far away, Wu Yu said.
"Hehe, Her Majesty the Empress overpraises me." Sima Changqin clapped and laughed.
As the two were conversing, Master Tantai and others attacked Yuan Ming again.
He and Long Hou once more activated their Dharma manifestations, brilliant starlight and golden breath intertwined, like two torrents, suddenly rushing towards the black Light Pillar.
At the same time, Yang Fan, Long Yinkong, and Long Yuhuan, these three young ones, were not to be outdone, each summoned their Dharma manifestations and performed Divine Skills, following closely behind to attack Yuan Ming inside the Light Pillar.
For a moment, on the stairway, various lights intermingled, like magnificent fireworks, engulfing the black Light Pillar that enveloped Yuan Ming's figure.
Under this intense onslaught, Yuan Ming's Dharma manifestation instantly collapsed, and his body seemed to be blasted into pieces, with not a trace of breath detectable.
The three Black Demons' eyes flashed with a hint of joy, yet in the next moment, their bodies suddenly trembled uncontrollably, violently shaking as if sieved, and their aura rapidly declined.
Sima Changqin noticed and quickly walked along the stairway, soon arriving beside the three Black Demons.
His palm emitted a black light that split into three, enveloping the masks of the three, and then he pulled hard.
The blood light on the three masks surged, being extremely difficult to remove.
It was seen that the faces of Tie Xuan and the others were now a bloody mess, as if something had gnawed on them, looking rather bloody and hideous.
Sima Changqin expressionlessly waved to take out three talismans, sticking them on the masks, causing the blood light on the masks to finally recede a bit.
He promptly put away the three masks, then sent out three strands of green light into the bodies of Tie Xuan and the other two.
Only then did the trembling of their bodies cease, and their aura stabilized.
At this moment, that black Light Pillar shattered with a crash, turning into dots of light that scattered and vanished, revealing the situation inside.
However, contrary to everyone's expectations, there was nothing there, as if Yuan Ming had been blasted into bits and had completely vanished from this world.
Master Tantai, Long Hou, and the others initially felt joy at the sight.
Their meticulous planning and cooperative efforts had finally ousted Yuan Ming from the trial.
Then Master Tantai's face suddenly turned stern, feeling something amiss, his gaze swept towards the bottom of the stairway, where only a crowd of Returning to Void Cultivators and Level 5 Demon Race stood, with no trace of Yuan Ming.
"Could it be that the attack was too heavy just now and that boy was killed directly?"
At this moment, a point of black light appeared on the staircase where Yuan Ming had just stood.
Immediately, a small black tree sprouted from it, firmly rooted on the staircase.
Soon after, flesh rapidly regenerated on the small black tree, and in an instant, Yuan Ming's form was reconstructed.
