This scene left Master Tantai and others greatly astonished, staring in disbelief at Yuan Ming, who had seemingly risen from the ashes.
"How is that possible!" Sima Changqin also showed a look of surprise.
He knew well that the material of this stairway was the World Tree, and he had just tried it, finding that neither mana nor Divine Sense could penetrate it.
Yet Yuan Ming seemed to possess some miraculous means, able to resurrect on the stairway of the World Tree.
Once Yuan Ming's body was consolidated, he immediately lifted his foot and stomped down with all his strength.
The steps beneath everyone suddenly sank downward, then abruptly bounced up again.
The force generated between this sinking and bouncing made everyone unstable, and they quickly cast spells to stabilize themselves.
"It's rude not to return a blow when one's given; take this from me!" Yuan Ming shouted lowly, raising both arms abruptly, his hands blurring for a moment.
The people from Daluo Sect, Heavenly Dragon Hall, and Sima Changqin saw a flash before their eyes, as hundreds of fist shadows appeared instantly, striking fiercely on their protective light screens.
"Bang! Bang! Bang!" A series of loud crashes sounded, and Long Hou and others, who had just stabilized themselves, were caught off guard by Yuan Ming's attack, getting hit one after another by the fist shadows, their bodies lifted from the stairs.
At the peak of the altar, Jie Cha expressionlessly waved his sleeve.
In mid-air, several emerald spirit lights streaked across like meteors, and the figures of Master Tantai, Yang Fan, Long Hou, Long Yinkong, and Long Yuhuan flashed and were transported below the steps.
At the same time, Sima Changqin and three Black Demons also came under attack.
However, Sima Changqin reacted swiftly; the ancient zither in his hand flew like a spiritual snake to the front of several people, and the virtual shadows of zither strings traced elegant arcs in the air, turning Yuan Ming's fist shadows into nothingness with the zither strings' gentle brush.
"Fellow Daoist Sima, since you want to stop me from taking the treasure, why use such underhanded means to incite others to act? Wouldn't it be more convenient for you and me to compete directly?" Yuan Ming looked at Sima Changqin with not much fluctuation in his tone.
Sima Changqin chuckled lightly and said openly, "Fellow Daoist Wan possesses the Undying Body, and the rules here favor body cultivation, how could Changqin be careless? I just didn't expect that even with Fellow Daoist Tantai and the others joining hands, they still aren't your match."
Yuan Ming was somewhat surprised that Sima Changqin admitted his scheming so frankly.
"Fellow Daoist Wan, don't misunderstand. The earlier matter was truly not a petty dispute. The Three Realms Immortal Boat is a treasure that can alter the battle situation between the Chuyun Realm and the Demon World; its importance is self-evident. The current Chuyun Realm seems calm on the surface, but underneath there are undercurrents, with external threats from the Demon Clan and internal concerns from the Demon Clan and Three Realms Sect. The existence of the Three Realms Immortal Boat provides the Human Clan with an extra chance at victory in the coming storm. Therefore, it should be in the hands of the Guardian of the Realm. Fellow Daoist Tantai and the others assisted me with this intention. However, the prior situation was indeed our fault, and I ask Fellow Daoist Wan for forgiveness." Sima Changqin clasped his hands in a sincere gesture.
Yuan Ming laughed heartily, dismissively saying, "Qin Demon, you truly are a Guardian of the Realm, your words are remarkable, able to paint your ambush in such a righteous light. Unfortunately, I, Wan, don't buy it. If you want the Three Realms Immortal Boat, then come and take it based on your own abilities!"
With those words, his arms blurred again, thousands of fist shadows instantly gathered, transforming into clusters of intense red light, crashing down on Sima Changqin like meteors.
Instantly, the air was filled with deafening sounds of rupturing air.
Sima Changqin's expression turned slightly grim, his fingers plucking rapidly across the ancient zither, leaving trails of afterimages.
A blue spirit light suddenly shot out from the zither, bursting with a bang in mid-air, transforming into a large net woven from countless blue threads to meet Yuan Ming's dense fist shadows.
At the moment of collision, a continuous thunderous rumble erupted nonstop, as Yuan Ming's fist shadows exploded one after another, sending surging waves of air in all directions, yet that blue net was exceptionally resilient, blocking all the fist shadows.
Yuan Ming wasn't discouraged at all, elevating his Qi Blood Power to the extreme, slicing fiercely in front of him with his palm like a blade.
A sharp blood light broke through the air, like a bolt of lightning, cleaving towards the blue net.
With a loud booming sound, the spirit light on the blue net dimmed, unexpectedly split into two by the blood light, scattering in mid-air.
Sima Changqin was secretly astonished, yet didn't panic, gently brushing his fingers over the zither strings again.
A melodious zither sound arose, transforming into an invisible sonic wave that rushed towards Yuan Ming.
As soon as this sonic wave entered his ears, Yuan Ming felt as if his internal organs were being pounded, the pain unbearable.
Yet Yuan Ming seemed unaware, silently turning his internal organs into a flowing Qi-Blood state, resisting the zither sound's assault, while his body swiftly moved forward, stepping forcefully on the stairs, quickly closing the distance with Sima Changqin.
Sima Changqin knew the frightening nature of a body cultivator's close combat with the Undying Body, but with the trial of the steps prohibiting Flying Escape, he had to retreat with all his might, widening the gap between him and Yuan Ming.
At the same time, he quickly formed a spell with his hands, slapping down on the ancient zither.
"Zheng! Zheng!" The zither sound echoed, full of chaos and tumult.
Spirit light flickered wildly from the zither's body, as a blue hurricane shot out, filled with densely packed blue Wind Blades, like knives and swords, slicing towards Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming initially intended to let the Wind Blades slash at him, but to his surprise, these Wind Blades could actually extinguish his Qi-Blood.
In just a moment, his entire body was lacerated, blood spraying out, making him seem as if he had emerged from a Blood Pool.
His Qi Blood Power was cut down by as much as two-tenths at that moment.
A chill ran through Yuan Ming's heart, realizing instantly that these Wind Blades contained some kind of special True Intent.
He did not retreat because of this, instead accelerating, charging through the hurricane to Sima Changqin's front.
He clenched his right fist, aiming straight for Sima Changqin's face, seemingly intending to kill this Guardian of the Realm with one strike.
Seeing this, Sima Changqin quickly formed another spell, pointing at the ancient zither.
In an instant, countless blue spirit lights enveloped his body, causing his form to vanish from where he stood.

chapters.title: Chapter 982 - 947: Accelerated Growth
chapters.content:
"Still trying to escape?" Yuan Ming's mind moved, activating the Primordial Dao Seal within him.
Immediately, a seven-colored vortex suddenly emerged like a blooming lotus, enveloping the surrounding area of over ten feet.
This seven-colored vortex spun rapidly, as if it was a giant beast devouring the heavens and earth, shattering the spiritual energy in this region and transforming it into nothingness.
On the stairway below, a blurry figure slowly appeared, holding the Ancient Zither tightly—it was Sima Changqin.
Yuan Ming flipped his palm, transforming it into a sharp claw, suddenly reaching towards the bottom and grasping the Ancient Zither in Sima Changqin's hands, and then fiercely pulling it away.
Sima Changqin tried his best to reclaim it, but against Yuan Ming's unparalleled strength, the Ancient Zither was snatched away instantly.
With the departure of the Ancient Zither, Sima Changqin's body gradually turned from illusory to real, reappearing before everyone.
Yet before he could cast a spell, Yuan Ming's blurred right leg kicked out like lightning, accurately striking his abdomen.
Sima Changqin only felt a great force surge over him, causing his body to fly backward. In mid-air, he was enveloped by the spirit light emerging from the steps and transmitted back below the stairway.
Yuan Ming then swiftly laid several sealing spells on the Ancient Zither, unceremoniously storing it in the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
Sima Changqin landed, his face ashen, his eyes filled with anger and resentment.
On this stairway, his abilities couldn't be fully exerted. Under normal circumstances, how could he be defeated so easily?
Moreover, at this moment, he couldn't sense the Ancient Zither's presence, which was his Innate Spiritual Treasure, vital for survival.
"Fellow Daoist Wan, you've won; no need to take away my Spiritual Treasure. This was a gift from Ancestor Bing Lan, please return it!" Sima Changqin suppressed his anger, trying to stay calm, yet his words subtly revealed a threat.
Hearing this, Yuan Ming's lips curved into a playful smile, saying, "Oh? This Zither was indeed gifted by Ancestor Bing Lan, no wonder it's so extraordinary. To avoid unpleasant incidents, I'll keep this treasure for a while. If Qin Demon wants it back, just exchange it for a hundred pieces of Sixth-level Spiritual Wood as a custody fee."
Sima Changqin's face grew darker.
As a Guardian, when had he suffered such humiliation? However, being below the stairway now, unable to fight Yuan Ming, he had to endure his anger.
Yuan Ming ignored him, turned his gaze to other Dharma Phase Cultivators on the steps, and said, "Anyone else wishing to challenge Wan, feel free to strike."
Jin Chen and others dared not respond, remaining silent.
They knew "Wan Tianren" was formidable, and now that Qin Demon was defeated by him, challenging him further would be futile.
Yuan Ming's gaze swept across them before finally landing on the silent Wu Yu.
"Our Ten Thousand Demon Country harbors no enmity towards Fellow Daoist Wan," Wu Yu sighed and added.
Only then did Yuan Ming withdraw his gaze, turning around to continue ascending.
Wu Yu and others from Ten Thousand Demon Country, along with Jin Chen and Gu Chuanting, followed suit, yet dared not approach too closely, fearing to anger this powerful Body Cultivator.
On the subsequent path, no one started a fight again.
Everyone silently faced their own trials, praying deep down to pass this barrier smoothly.
Meanwhile, Yuan Ming marched forward resolutely, heading towards the top of the stairway.
...
As the group climbed higher, the challenges increased exponentially in difficulty, with a mix of magical attacks appearing in mid-air, causing great distress to everyone, with defeated participants dropping out frequently.
Among them, Jin Chen, whose strength was weakest and had only recently broken through to the Dharma Phase, was the first to be defeated.
Following immediately was Xuan Ye, whose cultivation was less than the Five Great Demon Kings.
Next were Gu Chuanting, the Black Bear King, and the Green Snake King, retreating one by one. Before long, only a few persisted on the steps.
When the group arduously reached the 510th step, the Electric Roc King gasped heavily, struggling against the thunder and flames pouring down from above.
The surrounding spatial power was like invisible giant hands binding her tightly, while her feet's suction power continuously devoured her demonic power and qi blood.
"It seems I can only reach here," the Electric Roc King sighed gently in her heart.
She felt her power quickly draining away, and if she persisted further, she might harm herself.
Thus she gave up resisting, relaxed her strength, allowing the spatial force to press her down onto the hard steps.
Before being completely enveloped by the green spirit light, she desperately looked forward, where Wu Yu and the Giant Tree King were struggling to climb, while Yuan Ming led from afar, unstoppable.
In the next moment, the Electric Roc King was completely swallowed by the green light, teleporting back below the stairway.
As soon as she landed, the Green Snake King hurried forward to help her stand.
However, the Electric Roc King pushed away his hand coldly, struggling to rise by herself.
The Green Snake King stood awkwardly, unsure whether to advance or retreat in that moment.
At this moment, Di Huo stepped forward, holding a Jade Spirit Rejuvenation Pill with both hands, respectfully offering it to the Electric Roc King: "Lord Electric Roc King, please use the pill."
The Electric Roc King glanced at the elixir in Di Huo's hand and asked casually, "Have all of you taken it?"
The Green Snake King swiftly explained, "Xuan Ye hasn't used it, as his recovery power is strong, and he doesn't prefer elixirs. But both Chu Hong and I have taken it, and its effects are indeed good."
Electric Roc King nodded, retrieved two Level 5 Spiritual Grasses and tossed them to Di Huo as a reward, then accepted the elixir and swallowed it.
She sat cross-legged and began healing, as the atmosphere around her gradually became serene.
Di Huo stowed away the Spiritual Grass and retreated to the side, not daring to disturb either the Electric Roc King or the Green Snake King.
At this moment, though there were fewer figures on the steps, the air was still filled with an intense and solemn atmosphere.
Below the steps, the crowd silently watched those still climbing, each with varied expressions, their thoughts unknown.
...
Yuan Ming paid no attention to what was behind him, steadfastly climbing upwards, each step firm and forceful, progressing with swift speed as if like the wind before soon reaching the six hundredth step.
At this moment, the elder with the green beard appeared again, suspended in the void like a carefree cloud or wild crane.
He spoke leisurely, his voice carrying a sense of ancientness and majesty: "You have successfully reached the six hundredth step. Do you have any idea about your reward this time?"
With those words, green light flickered in front of him, as numerous spiritual materials appeared like stars.
Among these spiritual materials, some were black and shiny like ink, exuding a metallic sheen, others were brilliantly colorful as if ignited by hot flames, some bore tortoise shell patterns appearing ancient and mysterious, and others emanated eerie red glows like ghostly fires in the dark night.
Ten to nine of these Yuan Ming couldn't name, but each emitted astonishing spiritual power fluctuations and power of Dao, showcasing their extraordinary nature.
Yuan Ming gazed at these spiritual materials, a hint of joy flashed in his eyes, secretly marveling in his heart.
These are all seventh-level spiritual materials!
Seventh-level spiritual materials are considered top-tier in the Cultivation World, containing the power of Dao, and are rare materials for refining Dao Treasures, capable of sparking fierce competition among high-level cultivators when outside.
"This one isn't here either. Where exactly is the Abyss Nether Stone?" he frowned slightly.
Despite feeling somewhat disappointed, Yuan Ming quickly settled his emotions.
In the next moment, he pointed at one of the spiritual materials, speaking to the elder with the green beard: "It will be this one."
What he pointed to was a three-foot-long round wooden stake.
This wooden stake was entirely black, glowing with a polished sheen, its surface adorned with layers of dark golden dragon scale-shaped patterns, appearing both mysterious and majestic.
The elder with the green beard looked at the item Yuan Ming pointed to, nodding slightly: "Are you certain you want this Black Gold Dao Wood?"
Yuan Ming nodded affirmatively: "Certain."
Though limited by his cultivation, unable to refine Dao Treasures, this seventh-level spiritual wood had a special use for him, intending to feed it to the World Tree to spur the growth of the Ten Thousand Wood Origin.
Upon hearing this, the elder with the green beard said no more, waving his sleeve as the round black wooden stake floated out, slowly flying towards Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming reached out to catch the Black Gold Dao Wood, inspecting it closely, feeling a surge of joy within.
He sensed the tremendous spiritual power contained within this spiritual wood, knowing undeniably he had made the right choice.
Yuan Ming didn't continue climbing upwards but chose to sit cross-legged right there, planning to take a short rest.
He closed his eyes and, with a thought, sent the Black Gold Dao Wood into his body.
In his dantian, the roots of the Undying Tree quickly coiled around the Black Gold Dao Wood, began devouring frantically, absorbing spiritual wood essence rapidly, then transferring it to the World Tree.
As a seventh-level spiritual wood, the wood attribute spiritual power in the Black Gold Dao Wood was indeed vast.
As the abundant spiritual power continuously flooded into the World Tree, it again surged with vibrant vitality, and within moments, more than a dozen strands of Ten Thousand Wood Origin were condensed one after another.
The trunk of the Undying Tree also evolved once again, becoming sturdier and more robust, while the space occupied by the World Tree continued to expand, now taking up about fifty percent of the space.
Witnessing this, a gleam of happiness passed through Yuan Ming's heart.
So many Ten Thousand Wood Origins, once fully absorbed, could significantly enhance his physical body and mana.
However, this place wasn't suitable for peaceful cultivation due to the multitude of people, so he manipulated the Undying Tree's roots to embed into the Shura Palace, beginning quiet cultivation there.
Inside Shura Palace, a heap of Spirit Stones and several blood-red pills lay scattered on the ground.
These pills were Blood Origin Pills refined using the Shura Blood Devouring Map, containing extremely pure mana.
The roots of the Undying Tree enveloped these Spirit Stones and Blood Origin Pills, starting rapid recovery of mana and Qi Blood Power.

chapters.title: Chapter 983 - 948: Joining Midway
chapters.content:
While Yuan Ming was concentrating on his cultivation, Wu Yu and the Giant Tree King also arrived at the six hundredth step in succession.
Yuan Ming opened his eyes to glance at Wu Yu and the Giant Tree King, and then closed them again.
Seeing this, Wu Yu and the Giant Tree King were curious but dared not disturb him, each receiving their rightful rewards from the old man Qing Xu.
Just as they hesitated whether to proceed alone and continue climbing, Yuan Ming suddenly opened his eyes, stood up, and looked at the two.
"For the path ahead, I plan to go alone. Please stop here," Yuan Ming said with a calm and firm tone, leaving no room for negotiation.
Upon hearing this, Wu Yu looked at Yuan Ming without much change in expression, whereas a flicker of anger and surprise passed through the Giant Tree King's eyes.
"Wan Tianren, what do you mean by this?" the Giant Tree King asked angrily.
"Just the literal meaning, please stop here," Yuan Ming replied indifferently.
"Fellow Daoist Wan, are you worried that we'll compete with you for the Three Realms Immortal Boat? Rest assured, neither I nor the Giant Tree King have such desires. We simply wish to reach the nine hundred steps and obtain the rewards there, that's all," Wu Yu interceded with a charming smile, stopping the Giant Tree King from rebuking.
Yuan Ming remained unmoved, shaking his head, "The two of you must stop here, that's my decision."
Wu Yu's face also darkened, her voice tinged with displeasure, "Fellow Daoist Wan, must you be so harsh? We did not assist Sima Changqin when he attacked you, which you should be well aware of."
Yuan Ming responded expressionlessly, "So I didn't deal with you just now. Now, if you wish to continue, you only need to defeat me."
The rewards at the six hundredth level were already ample, and what was at the nine hundred steps could be imagined. Since he had already broken with the Ten Thousand Demon Country, he couldn't allow Wu Yu and the Giant Tree King to proceed.
"Fellow Daoist Wan is joking. Even Qin Demon was sent flying with just a few punches; we are no match for you. Is there really no room for negotiation? I am willing to offer all my spiritual treasures, spiritual materials, and the rewards I just obtained, in exchange for a chance to proceed," Wu Yu said, waving her hand to make a myriad of items appear on the step.
The Giant Tree King suppressed his anger and also brought out numerous items.
Yuan Ming glanced at the treasures on the ground, feeling a surge of temptation. These items, combined, were worth as much as four or five pieces of seventh-level spiritual materials, indeed enticing.
At that moment, Xi Ying's voice suddenly sounded in Yuan Ming's Sea of Consciousness, "Bring over that bronze token that the Giant Tree King took out for me to see."
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming turned his gaze to the Giant Tree King's side.
There lay a palm-sized token, seemingly made from some kind of spiritual iron, engraved with profound patterns, clearly not an ordinary item.
He summoned it with a wave of his hand, and the token flew into his hand. He sent it into the Stealing Heaven Tripod with a thought.
Xi Ying received the token, formed a mysterious gesture with his hands, and performed an enigmatic technique.
The token shone in five colors, and its surface patterns gradually faded, replaced by numerous tiny characters. These characters seemed to contain a profound secret, enticing exploration into their mysteries.
"Indeed, this token is the legendary Five Elements Talisman, and inscribed upon it is the Five Elements Dao Fruit, truly great news!" Xi Ying's face showed surprise, his eyes flashing with excitement.
"Five Elements Talisman? Five Elements Dao Fruit? What are these things?" Yuan Ming asked curiously.
Xi Ying explained, "The Five Elements Talisman is the token of the head of the Five Elements Sect, which was once strong in the Chuyun Realm a million years ago. The Five Elements Sect was extremely powerful, and several Mahayana cultivators emerged from it. Its fame was second only to the Taixuan Sect and Bright Moon Palace. However, during the first invasion by the Demon World, the Five Elements Sect suffered heavy losses, and its disciples were almost completely wiped out. Many profound cultivation techniques and divine skills were lost, which was truly regrettable. The Five Elements Sect specialized in the Five Elements Taoist Skill, pushing the understanding of the changes in the Five Elements to the extreme. Among them, the strongest divine skill was the Five Elements Dao Fruit. It is said that this divine skill can break through all Five Elements Divine Techniques, its power strong enough to be ranked on the Creation Heaven List, and to this day still holds the third position."
Listening to Xi Ying's account, Yuan Ming's heartbeat involuntarily quickened.
Previously, the Void had told him that to comprehend the Five Elements True Intent and lay the foundation for advancement to Mahayana, he would need to cultivate the divine skills listed on the Creation Heaven List.
Now, upon learning that the Five Elements Dao Fruit was the third on the list, Yuan Ming naturally understood its immense benefit for his future cultivation.
In comparison, the treasures at the Ninth Layer seemed insignificant.
Meanwhile, Wu Yu also noticed that Yuan Ming had taken the Giant Tree King's bronze token, a flicker of surprise flashing in her eyes.
She sent a message to inquire about the token's details from the Giant Tree King, who said that the token was found by chance in some ruins, without understanding its origin; he only knew that it accelerated the recovery of demonic power, so he always carried it personally.
After hearing this, Wu Yu looked at Yuan Ming again, her eyes betraying a hint of thoughtful consideration.
"Fellow Daoist Wu Yu's persistence in reaching the nine hundred steps—does it mean you know something?" Yuan Ming's voice suddenly sounded in Wu Yu's ear.
Wu Yu hurriedly composed herself, giving a half-true, half-false reply, "It's my first time here too, so I know nothing about this place. However, I divined with a hexagram before stepping onto the staircase and learned that reaching nine hundred steps would yield something crucial for the Ten Thousand Demon Country. I implore you, Fellow Daoist Wan, to allow it."
"Since Fellow Daoist Wu Yu is so sincere, if I were to refuse again, I would seem unkind." Yuan Ming chuckled, sending out a green glow to sweep up all the items Wu Yu and the Giant Tree King had laid out, storing them in his storage magic tool.
After doing so, he said no more and turned, continuing his ascent.
Wu Yu's eyes lit up with joy, and she was about to follow when she felt a premonition and turned back to look.
Within the Silver Tower Space, the void twisted, and three figures appeared out of thin air.
These three, two men and one woman, were none other than Su Wu, Hei Lian, and Su Yingxue.
They wore no disguises, showing their true faces to everyone.
The people below the altar had never seen these three before, and their expressions varied as they communicated through sound transmissions, inquiring about Su Wu and the others' identities.
In the crowd, Nan Shangfeng's expression changed instantly upon seeing Hei Lian.
"You know these three?" Master Tantai asked curiously.
"I was hunted by that black-robed woman, and I only escaped thanks to Fellow Daoist Wan's assistance."
Nan Shangfeng did not conceal the truth, and he said softly, "This woman is called Hei Lian, who claims to be a descendant of the Black Emperor from the Three Realms Sect. She cultivates the Void Sky Demon Technique of the Black Emperor and possesses a curse spiritual treasure. Her strength is quite formidable."
"Descendant of the Black Emperor!" Master Tantai was taken aback upon hearing this.
Although Nan Shangfeng's voice was not loud, those nearby heard him clearly, and their expressions changed subtly, with many casting glances at Hei Lian.
Di Huo, who was recommending the Jade Spirit Rejuvenation Pill to Jin Chen and Gu Chuanting, also paused his actions upon seeing Su Wu and the others suddenly appear.
Yuan Ming was also drawn by the sudden commotion below and turned to glance down.
His gaze wandered among the crowd until it settled on Su Yingxue's elegant and otherworldly face. His eyes lingered on her briefly before quickly sweeping over Hei Lian and Su Wu.
At this moment, Su Wu also lifted his head, and his eyes met with Yuan Ming's.
The moment their gazes crossed, both faces showed surprise, but they quickly masked this emotion.
Su Wu paid no attention to the varied gazes around him, and with a flash of his figure, he arrived before the stairs and began climbing without hesitation. Hei Lian and Su Yingxue did not follow.
Su Wu's climbing process seemed extraordinarily easy, with each step taken calmly and leisurely.
What was a nightmare of suction and immense pressure for others seemed to have no effect on him.
His climbing speed was much faster than anyone present, almost as if the constraints within this space were non-existent to him.
Yuan Ming did not focus much on Su Wu's climb and turned to continue his ascent.
Wu Yu and the Giant Tree King hurriedly followed upon seeing this.
After the six hundredth level, the suction on the stairs grew stronger, consuming their mana, qi-blood, and soul power at an alarming rate, while also anchoring their feet to the steps.
Each step for the three of them felt like an enormous struggle against a colossal force, exceedingly difficult.
Meanwhile, the pressure in the void intensified, as if invisible mountains were pressing down on their shoulders, forcing them to stoop, and their breaths became increasingly heavy, as if each inhalation required immense effort.
The attacks falling from the sky also grew more intense, with various powerful spells and attacks pouring down like rain, nearly engulfing the entire staircase.
Yuan Ming's gaze narrowed; even he felt unprecedented pressure at this moment.
Despite the falling attacks and spatial pressure, which added to his burden, he could barely manage to cope using the Primordial Dao Seal and various techniques.
However, the suction from the steps on his mana, qi-blood, and soul power began to worry him.
Yuan Ming's mind raced, and he took a deep breath, gathering all his internal strength, aiming to reach the legendary nine hundred steps before exhausting all his strength.
After advancing only thirty to forty levels, the suction on the steps suddenly intensified, as if an invisible giant hand was pulling at his body, making each step as arduous as bearing the weight of ten thousand pounds.
More critically, the consumption rate of his mana, qi-blood, and soul power far exceeded expectations, already more than half depleted. He understood that relying solely on his strength, he could not possibly persevere to the nine hundredth layer.
"It seems I'll have to use this." Yuan Ming thought to himself, then controlled the Undying Tree to enter the Shura Palace, starting to absorb spirit stones and blood origin pills to restore strength.
"Stop absorbing the blood origin pills. The impurities within them are too plentiful and will affect your future progress in body cultivation." At this moment, Xi Ying's voice rang out in Yuan Ming's sea of consciousness.
"Of course, I know this, but there's no choice now but to pass the test first." Yuan Ming sighed softly, well aware of Xi Ying's correct reminder, but at this moment, he found himself in a dilemma without alternatives.
"Don't act recklessly; I have a method that might weaken the stair's suction." Xi Ying's voice sounded again, providing Yuan Ming with a potential way out.
"What method?" Yuan Ming paused his absorption of the blood origin pills upon hearing this and quickly asked.

chapters.title: Chapter 984 - 949: The Original Purpose
chapters.content:
"I once read ancient texts at the Sky Eagle Chamber of Commerce, which recorded information about the World Tree. In ancient times, the World Tree still existed between heaven and earth and was said to connect multiple realms. However, this tree is actually a Tree of Death, and any living being that approaches it will be drained dry. The absorbing effect of the stairway here stems from this ability of the World Tree," Xi Ying quickly explained.
"The World Tree has such an ability? But the bark and the segment of the trunk I obtained are not like that," Yuan Ming frowned and asked, confused.
"That's because the bark and trunk you got have already lost their vitality. This stairway was originally a dead object, but someone used a Forbidden to activate its vitality," Xi Ying pointed out the key to the problem sharply.
Hearing this, Yuan Ming nodded slowly, suddenly enlightened.
He remembered that as the bark of the World Tree in the upper world expanded on his Undying Tree, its root absorption ability also grew stronger, apparently for the same reason.
"I see, to isolate the absorbing force of the World Tree, can using another piece of World Tree bark work?" Yuan Ming suddenly thought of something and asked.
Xi Ying nodded slightly in affirmation. "Indeed, this is a unique method that only you can use."
With a thought, the Undying Tree in Yuan Ming's Dantian was summoned, and it began to tremble violently.
His legs gradually became covered with a faint azure light, and under its shroud, his once fleshy legs gradually took on the form of the World Tree.
At the moment this transformation was completed, Yuan Ming felt a sudden lightness underfoot, and the terrifying suction that had almost drained him just moments ago had diminished by more than ninety percent.
He was overjoyed, but the sudden change made him a bit unsteady, causing his body to stumble and almost fall. Fortunately, he reacted swiftly and braced his stance.
"Indeed, the World Tree can isolate the suction of these stairs," Yuan Ming thought to himself with delight. Without further hesitation, he fully energized his legs and accelerated his climb.
By now, Yuan Ming was no longer bound by the suction of the stairway, and the immense spatial pressure, under the power of his Undying Body, became insignificant.
His climbing speed increased suddenly. Though he could not move as effortlessly as Su Wu below, he was far beyond comparison with others, quickly widening the gap between him and Wu Yu and others.
The spectators below were all astonished. Master Tantai was full of surprise and then smiled wryly, saying, "That Wan Tianren has such hidden reserves; we lost justifiably..."
The trio of Long Hou also showed incredulous expressions, exchanging glances amongst themselves.
Sima Changqin, who was treating Tie Xuan, Shen Xiu, and the tall, big black Demon, also had a look of seriousness flash across his eyes.
The number of Yuan Ming's hidden tricks far exceeded his expectations, likely making him a formidable opponent.
Wu Yu looked at Yuan Ming's back complexly, starting to genuinely regret his earlier calculations.
While below, Su Wu's gaze was tightly fixed on Yuan Ming's legs, now transformed into the shape of the World Tree, with a flash of cold light in his eyes. He accelerated again, quickly catching up.
As the stairs got higher, the surrounding spatial pressure also increased significantly.
Yuan Ming had to fully engage his Undying Body, with his blood nearly boiling, emitting a pinkish mist around him.
He maintained an astonishing speed and was the first to ascend to the nine hundredth step.
At that moment, the old man with a green beard appeared in front of Yuan Ming, smiled, and said, "You have reached the nine hundred steps. For this level's reward, you can specifically request what you want."
"Request specifically? Does that mean I can ask for anything?" Yuan Ming asked.
The old man with a green beard nodded and smiled, "Almost. The wealth of the Three Realms Immortal Boat's collection is beyond your imagination. As long as you can name it, it's basically here. At worst, a similar substitute can be found."
His heart stirred as Yuan Ming tentatively asked, "Then if I ask for control of this Three Realms Immortal Boat?"
The old man's expression did not change in the slightest. He replied blandly, "That reward is only available after reaching the top."
Yuan Ming felt some disappointment at the words, but he understood that this was to be expected.
He no longer teased the old man with a green beard and said seriously, "I want the Abyss Nether Stone."
Hearing this request, the previously imperturbable old man with a green beard finally showed a look of surprise.
He gave Yuan Ming a deep look, then nodded and disappeared.
A few breaths later, the old man with a green beard reappeared and waved his sleeve.
A piece of azure light shot out, within which floated a palm-sized, oval stone, suspended in front of Yuan Ming.
It was a strange stone, entirely jet-black and covered with holes on its surface, emitting a profound coldness.
Wreaths of black mist traversed between all the holes on the stone surface, as if it had life.
"Indeed, it is the Abyss Nether Stone!" Yuan Ming felt a surge of joy and reached out to take the strange stone.
In the next moment, a strong chill penetrated through his Undying Body's hand and seeped into his bones.
The feeling was unusual, not truly bone-chilling, yet it made him shiver involuntarily.
Yuan Ming didn't linger further. After thanking the old man with a green beard, he stored it within the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space.
This Abyss Nether Stone was both the initial and most crucial purpose of him entering this Three Realms Immortal Boat space and wading through these troubled waters.
Inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space, Xi Ying had long been waiting.
After obtaining that precious Abyss Nether Stone, she immediately flew to the top of the majestic altar, gently activating the complex array at its peak, carefully inserting the Abyss Nether Stone into the corresponding groove.
Suddenly, light flowed on the altar like a reversing star river, dazzling and brilliant.
In the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space, earth-shaking changes occurred as if new life force had been injected, making it more lively and agile.
That White Jade Lotus Platform now emitted a soft and lustrous glow, and countless Desire Power light spots appeared around once more, like stars in the night sky, flickering with mysterious light.
Yuan Ming's main soul had long been waiting here. Seeing this scene, he unhesitatingly flew up and sat lightly on the White Jade Lotus Platform.
Those Desire Power light spots flocked to him, as if drawn by an invisible force.
Voices calling out resounded chaotically in Yuan Ming's ears, transforming into those exclusive titles for him.
"Master Yuan Ming..."
"Lord Nether Moon God..."
"My Lord..."
Yuan Ming was extremely excited. Through these Desire Powers, he finally restored contact with his believers.
He carefully distinguished these Desire Power light spots, finding that most were from overseas believers.
The Yunhuang Continent was too far away, and only a few people's Desire Power could be transmitted, but it was enough to comfort him.
At least, he finally reconnected with the Yunhuang Continent.
However, the situation was urgent at the moment, and Yuan Ming didn't have much time to communicate with the Yunhuang Continent believers to understand the situation there.
He attempted to use the Desire Power as an anchor to open a space channel to transmit items to his believers, but unfortunately, he failed.
"It seems that to fully restore the functions of the Stealing Heaven Tripod, it's necessary to find the Love Inquiry Heart Jade and Earth Element Stone." Yuan Ming thought to himself.
He quickly refocused, not staying here longer.
He understood that behind him, Su Wu was swiftly catching up, already surpassing the 600th level.
Yuan Ming didn't dare to relax or rest at all, needing to continue climbing with full force towards the summit of the stairs.
Thus, Yuan Ming once again urged his Undying Body, accelerating his climbing speed.
His figure dashed across the stairs, leaving behind trails of afterimages.
Now, there was only one thought in his heart, and that was to reach the summit as soon as possible.
However, when Yuan Ming crossed over the nine hundred steps, the pressure of the surrounding space instantly multiplied, as if invisible mountains were heavily pressing down on him, and the suction force from the stairs also significantly increased.
But the power of Yuan Ming's Undying Body was inherently formidable; after his legs transformed into the World Tree, they isolated ninety percent of the stair's suction, and he could still hold on.
Meanwhile, the anomalies in the sky became increasingly intense.
The void above seemed to be frantically stirred by invisible giant hands, forming countless turbulences and vortices.
In the roaring wind, dense Wind Blades poured down like a violent storm, slicing every inch of space, and sharp wind glows carved out cracks in the void as if trying to tear the whole world apart.
Accompanying the roaring wind was a deafening thunderclap.
Purple, cyan, gold, and silver hues of electric lights interwoven into a net, transforming into lightning-like Thunder Spears, frantically shooting downward.
The air was filled with a scorching scent as if the entire world was shrouded in a blanket of thunder and fire.
Then, a downpour of red rain with a strong corrosive aura descended from the sky.
This red rain splashed down like fresh blood, creating white smoke as it hit the stairs. The acrid smell spread in the air, causing a wave of discomfort.
Yuan Ming slightly furrowed his brows, noticing that the current trial differed from before.
Previously, the attacks in midair were of a single attribute, but now multiple attacks descended simultaneously.
He took a deep breath and fully activated the Primordial Dao Seal. Under his control, the Seven-Colored Vortex spun rapidly, unleashing an unparalleled suction force that absorbed all the attacks in the sky.
Yet as he continued ascending, reaching the 950th level, the wind and rain intensified again, with thunder endlessly rumbling, and all attacks becoming increasingly frenzied and powerful.
Even though Yuan Ming fully operated the Primordial Dao Seal, he gradually couldn't completely absorb these attacks.
Occasionally, Wind Blades, thunder, and red rain penetrated the Seven-Colored Vortex and fell on him, piercing blood holes and dissolving flesh in the attacks, exposing white bones.
Yuan Ming, however, was unfazed by this.
Relying on the incredibly strong recovery ability of his Undying Body, he resisted these offensive moves, persistently climbing upwards, though his speed had slowed significantly.
As if no matter how many challenges and obstacles lay ahead, nothing could stop his advancing steps.

chapters.title: Chapter 985 - 950: Contest
chapters.content:
Unlike Yuan Ming's fearless progress, Wu Yu and the Giant Tree King were struggling at this moment.
When they reached around Level 850, they were overwhelmed and had to pause to rest.
Wu Yu looked up, gazing at Yuan Ming's gradually receding figure, and couldn't help but mutter softly, "Where is his limit?"
At this moment, a rush of footsteps suddenly came from below.
Wu Yu turned his head and saw Su Wu quickly catching up.
His speed was incredibly fast, swiftly surpassing Wu Yu and the Giant Tree King.
On the narrow staircase, Wu Yu and the Giant Tree King hastily stepped aside, clearing the way.
Su Wu passed between them expressionlessly, continuing to climb toward the summit without even glancing at the two of them.
At this moment, he saw evidently only Yuan Ming, who was still climbing close to the one thousand steps mark.
"Who's this person? His speed in climbing the steps is even faster than Wan Tianren's!" Wu Yu's eyes flickered slightly, curious about Su Wu's strength and identity.
"Her Majesty the Empress, we must also speed up. Seeing the speed of Wan Tianren and that young man in black, I'm afraid they'll reach the top soon. If the trial ends by then, all our previous efforts would be in vain. We must reach nine hundred steps before that to obtain that item!" The Giant Tree King transmitted to Wu Yu, his tone full of urgency.
"I know, but the resistance of these stairs far exceeds our previous expectations. Unless we use the Devil Ancestor Origin Power, there's no way we can speed up." Wu Yu responded helplessly.
She knew in her heart that the Devil Ancestor Origin Power was crucial to her potential advancement to Mahayana, and she couldn't afford to use it lightly.
"Her Majesty the Empress, there's no need to worry too much." A spark of determination and resoluteness flashed in the Giant Tree King's eyes, and his right arm suddenly transformed into a green vine, shooting out rapidly and tightly wrapping around Wu Yu's wrist.
A scorching airflow flowed through the vine, slowly infusing into Wu Yu's body. Her face instantly changed dramatically, and she hurriedly shouted, "No! How can you give me the Devil Ancestor Origin you accumulated over a thousand years? This will not only ruin your cultivation future but also significantly reduce your strength, possibly even falling out of Level 6!"
However, the Giant Tree King laughed heartily and said, "Your Majesty, you don't need to worry. My aptitude is mediocre, and I originally have no chance of advancing to Mahayana. As long as Her Majesty the Empress can break the shackles of my Ten Thousand Demon Country and bring hope to my people, then everything is worth it." As he spoke, the scorching airflow he transmitted sped up a bit more.
A few breaths later, the green vine slowly retracted, and the Giant Tree King's body fell weakly onto the steps.
His face looked even older, and his breath quickly weakened, yet his mouth managed to show a faint smile.
In the next moment, a green light flashed, and the Giant Tree King's figure disappeared from where he was, reappearing at the bottom of the stairs.
Wu Yu glanced downward, a complex emotion flashing in her eyes.
She clenched her teeth tightly and turned back to continue climbing the steps.
At this moment, a green glow surged around her body, and her energy seemed completely restored. Her climbing pace quickened, though not quite matching Su Wu's, it was not far off.
Su Wu, at this point, had no mind to bother with Wu Yu. His eyes were solely on Yuan Ming's back, that figure steadfastly advancing despite the increasingly fierce attacks.
Yuan Ming's body was occasionally sliced by Wind Blades, scorched black by Thunder, yet his Qi Blood Power was burning wildly, the vigorous vitality constantly healing the injuries, his steps never slowing down a bit.
On the last hundred steps, Yuan Ming had already crossed more than half, with less than twenty steps to the top remaining.
Seeing this, Su Wu's eyes flashed with urgency.
His climbing speed had far exceeded everyone else, but due to Yuan Ming starting too early, even his furious chase had yet to reach nine hundred steps.
"If he continues, it'll really be bad." Su Wu thought to himself.
While pondering, he turned his wrist, and a green-black wooden key appeared in his palm.
This key had an ancient style, without any carvings, seemingly naturally formed, and was precisely the World Tree Key he acquired from that scorching cave.
With another turn of his wrist, the key fell vertically, hitting the stairs.
At the moment they collided, circles of cyan ripples lit up on the stairs and directly sank into them.
In the next moment, from Su Wu's step as center, a cyan-gray light spread instantly toward both ends of the stairs, radiating from each step.
At this moment, Wu Yu was just four or five steps away from Level 900.
She was about to rush forward in one go, but her feet were tightly entangled by a layer of cyan-gray light.
She suddenly felt as if she was stuck in a quagmire, her feet entwined by an attraction pulling downwards, unable to move any further, just like being bound on the steps, unable to budge.
At the same time, the cyan-gray light also lit up under Yuan Ming's feet, enveloping them so they couldn't lift.
Not far below, Su Wu's whole body was shrouded in a layer of cyan-gray light ring, continuing his rapid ascent, soon reaching the nine hundredth step.
He didn't pause to ask for compensation, but instead continued to hastily ascend the higher steps without stopping.
The overwhelming attacks flooded down instantly, yet they were all absorbed by some force around him, disappearing without a trace.
Su Wu's speed remained unaffected, and the distance between him and Yuan Ming rapidly closed.
"What kind of divine skills is this person using? It's even more mysterious than Wan Tianren's Undying Body, which relies on an almost abnormal recovery ability to force its way through. Yet this person seems capable of absorbing all attacks completely." Below the steps, everyone exchanged puzzled looks.
Each of them was considered a notable figure in the outside world, even core members of major forces, well-versed and experienced.
However, ever since entering the Three Realms Immortal Boat, almost everything surpassed their expectations; unheard-of events occurred one after another.
Being the defeated ones now, except for Nan Shangfeng and Wulu, none of the others had any psychological burden, watching the competition between Yuan Ming and Su Wu with an attitude of enjoying the spectacle.
Yuan Ming was still trapped with his feet ensnared by the cyan-gray radiance, sensing Su Wu rapidly approaching from below, he couldn't help but become anxious.
He suddenly urged his magic formulas, elevating the power of the Undying Body to its peak, causing blood mist to surge around him instantly.
With a low shout, he expanded his arms to the sides, a tremendous force erupted from within him, causing visible ripples in the nearby void.
As he exerted force, a World Tree root sprouted from his leg, piercing into the staircase, lest he lose control after breaking free and his body ascend.
Yet under this mountain-shattering force, the cyan-gray radiance binding his feet merely trembled gently before returning to normal.
"What divine skill is this cyan-gray radiance after all!"
Yuan Ming's pupils contracted, starting to envelop the cyan-gray radiance with the seven-color vortex of the Primordial Dao Seal, attempting to extract its Spiritual Power, weakening the cyan-gray radiance's power, then breaking free using the strength of the Undying Body.
At that moment, his hand motion halted.
He faintly sensed that the cyan-gray radiance was suffused with a familiar aura, precisely the unique wood qi of the World Tree.
Yuan Ming first froze, then joy filled his heart.
The Undying Tree within his Dantian seemed to have sensed something, its roots instantly broke through its confines, naturally delving into the stairs below, greedily absorbing the World Tree's wood qi contained within.
Previously, he had tried to absorb the wood qi from the stairs using the roots of the Undying Tree, but the stairs were imbued with a mysterious forbidden, tightly confining the World Tree's wood qi.
However, at this moment, due to Su Wu's release of cyan-gray radiance, the forbidden was quietly unlocked.
In this way, the wood qi in the stairs faced no obstacle, freely available to Yuan Ming's wishes.
The wood qi was pure and vast, and after flowing into the Dantian, the Undying Tree quickly transformed, its branches and leaves growing more lush, the aura of the World Tree becoming more intense.
Simultaneously, within the World Tree, Ten Thousand Wood Origin's green light flickered, originally numbering only a dozen, now quickly increasing, twenty rays, thirty rays, fifty rays...
Each ray of green light represented an even deeper comprehension of the wood path by Yuan Ming.
As the wood qi within the steps was continuously absorbed, the cyan-gray radiance shrouding Yuan Ming's feet gradually weakened, like flames losing fuel, finally completely dissipating.
The restraining power binding his legs vanished along with it, he regained his freedom.
Joy flashed in Yuan Ming's eyes, he controlled the Undying Tree's roots to continue extending forward, absorbing the World Tree's wood qi within the steps ahead, sweeping away the cyan-gray radiance one by one, then continued to swiftly ascend.
Su Wu had already reached the nine hundred and fifty steps, witnessing the scene, a look of surprise emerged in his eyes.
With a slight gesture of magic formulas, he touched the staircase, and the cyan-gray radiance quickly dispersed, the World Tree's wood qi became dormant again, as if it had never been disturbed.
Yuan Ming sighed inwardly, knowing he could no longer extract wood qi from these steps, thus withdrew the Undying Tree roots, concentrating solely on climbing further.
Just then, a muffled sound suddenly came from behind.
Yuan Ming looked back, only to see Su Wu's clothes inflate, an overwhelming black energy suddenly erupted from his body, instantly enveloping him completely.
The black energy was dense and uncanny, seemingly alive, swirling around Su Wu.
The next moment, the black energy suddenly shot forth, morphing into the shape of a Black Dragon, rushing directly at Yuan Ming above.
Simultaneously, the attacks descending from the high sky seemed to sense the presence of the black energy, becoming more concentrated and swift, striking at the rolling black energy.
Yet surprisingly, once those attacks entered the black energy, they vanished completely, like a mud ox entering the sea, seemingly absorbed entirely by the black energy.
The Black Dragon of black energy was extremely fast, catching up to Yuan Ming in just a few breaths.
Xi Ying's voice sounded in Yuan Ming's ear, with a solemn tone: "Be careful, this black energy is extraordinary!"

chapters.title: Chapter 986 - 951: Causality Decree
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming naturally had already sensed the approach of the black energy, and with a jolt in his heart, he immediately activated the seven-color vortex within his Dantian, attempting to envelop it and refine it to devour.
At the very instant the two met, he immediately felt an incredibly terrifying devouring force.
The seven-color vortex crumbled instantly in the face of this force, even some of its own power was completely swallowed by the black energy.
Although Yuan Ming had anticipated that the Primordial Dao Seal would be difficult to resist the strange black energy, he had never expected to be defeated so brutally.
He bellowed, the mana within his Dantian frantically circulating, and around his Nascent Soul a dazzling light burst forth.
Immediately afterwards, a towering Dharma manifestation emerged from outside his body, a giant palm stretched out across the void, descending thunderously as if wielding the force of thunder.
Within the Dharma manifestation giant palm, spirit light gathered and condensed into two massive mana vortices, one of which was multicolored, precisely the seven-color vortex transformed by the Primordial Dao Seal, and the other was the Life and Death Reincarnation Path, mysterious and unfathomable.
Moreover, numerous Dao Seals such as the Dream Butterfly, All Living Beings' Dream, and Shared Fate were simultaneously activated, and a surging power of Dao erupted from within the Dharma manifestation giant palm like a wild storm, sweeping all directions.
Yuan Ming exerted his utmost effort, deploying all the attack means he could exhibit, attempting to smash that black energy in one fell swoop.
Yet when the Dharma manifestation giant palm collided with the black energy, a world-shaking mana fluctuation exploded forth, causing even the space to quiver.
But astonishingly, the black energy did not scatter as a result; instead, it became even more turbulent, enveloping the Dharma manifestation giant palm tightly like a black torrent.
In an instant, the Dharma manifestation giant palm collapsed under the corrosion of the black energy, turning into nothingness.
The various true meanings of Dao contained within the giant palm were rendered completely ineffective against this black energy, vanishing without a trace as if a clay ox entering the sea.
The black energy advanced with the unstoppable momentum of breaking bamboo, continuing its corrosion upwards, instantly devouring Yuan Ming's Dharma manifestation's entire arm as well as shoulder, and then lunged towards the body of the manifestation.
Yuan Ming's heart sank, his figure rapidly retreating while he chanted an incantation aloud.
The enormous Dharma manifestation contracted inward abruptly and then exploded with a roar, sending rolling waves to forcibly repel the surging black energy.
Self-detonating the Dharma manifestation caused considerable damage to the Nascent Soul; Yuan Ming's face turned pale, yet he dared not hesitate in the least, turning around and sprinting towards the top of the staircase.
This was the final sprint!
However, although his speed was fast, the black energy was even faster, sweeping past from the left and right, forming a dense black fog wall in front.
Meanwhile, the black energy behind surged like a tide, completely sealing off Yuan Ming's retreat.
Yuan Ming's expression turned extremely grave, forcing him to halt his steps.
He was utterly shocked; the strangeness of this black energy far exceeded his imagination. Even when facing a mighty opponent like Sima Changqin, he had never felt so powerless.
Although he knew he wasn't a match, Yuan Ming had no intention of giving up.
A flash of red light appeared on his right hand, and a red stone stele emerged, the mighty Xi He Tablet.
He had already refined nearly half of the runes on this treasure, enough to exert considerable power.
At this moment, Xi Ying's voice suddenly echoed in Yuan Ming's Sea of Consciousness: "Open the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space!"
Yuan Ming's eyes flashed, and without any hesitation, he opened a passage between the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space and the outside world.
Xi Ying clasped her hands in front of her chest, seeming to pray, and simultaneously seemed to be performing some sort of secret technique.
Yuan Ming could clearly sense a hitherto unseen power of Divine Soul surging within her, enveloping an ocean-like Desire Power, unleashing an astounding ripple.
Xi Ying spread her hands and threw a white light sphere the size of a fist, which flew through the passage to the outside world, directly landing on Yuan Ming.
As soon as the white light sphere touched Yuan Ming, it blossomed with a dazzling brilliance, which flashed and disappeared, quickly shriveling into Yuan Ming's body, vanishing without a trace, leaving not a hint.
Yuan Ming tried to sense his body but did not detect any anomalies.
However, he had no time to examine closely, as the black energy from all directions had already pounced upon him like hungry wolves.
Yuan Ming's brow furrowed tightly, an intense sense of crisis surged within him, and without hesitation, he activated the Xi He Tablet, the red light bursting forth, attempting to resist the surging black energy.
At this moment, thunder suddenly rolled high in the sky, and several thunderbolts of interwoven purple and gold lightning struck fiercely from the clouds onto the churning black energy.
"Uh…"
A somewhat pained muffled groan issued from within the black energy.
With this groan, the nearby surging black energy suddenly paused, surprisingly showing a brief collapse.
Yuan Ming's eyes brightened; seizing this rare opportunity, the Protective Treasure Light illuminated all around him, and he launched upwards without hesitation.
As he dashed into the black energy, the treasure light around him instantly dissipated, his clothes were eroded, creating large holes, and even his flesh dissolved, emitting plumes of white smoke.
Despite enduring extreme pain, Yuan Ming did not dare hesitate at all.
He exerted all his strength to break through the blockade of the black mist, and when he finally did, his forehead, arms, and chest were already eroded and riddled with cuts, a horrifying sight of flesh and blood.
Ignoring his injuries, Yuan Ming moved like flowing water, astonishingly transforming into a billowing blood mist and resolutely rushing toward the top of the stairway.
Within the blood mist, dozens of Immortal Beans shot out like stars, bursting into dazzling light immediately.
In an instant, these points of light transformed into dozens of "Yuan Ming," each with a different form but all displaying powerful Dharma manifestations, like a group of courageous warriors standing on the narrow stairs.
These clones worked together to resist the surging black mist.
Yet the black mist, like a devil's claws, swept over swiftly, devouring the clones one by one, leaving only their anguished screams echoing in the space.
This shriek lasted only a breath or two before it was swallowed by the boundless darkness.
The black mist, like a raging torrent, climbed rapidly, pursuing Yuan Ming relentlessly.
As it intertwined with the blood mist Yuan Ming had become, a large portion of the blood mist was mercilessly consumed by the black mist.
Only at this moment did Yuan Ming deeply comprehend the terror of this black mist.
The blood mist he transformed into was supposed to be an undying body, difficult to destroy completely. Yet under the devouring of the black mist, it seemed to be wiped away from this world, and his connection to it was thoroughly severed.
With thoughts spinning rapidly in his mind, Yuan Ming continued climbing upward, spreading the blood mist as much as possible to slow down the black mist's devouring speed.
As he climbed closer to the top of the stairway, the pressure in the space grew more intense, and attacks became increasingly dense, assaulting him like a tempest.
Su Wu, however, seemed particularly unfortunate, with most attacks hitting the black mist, leaving only a few for Yuan Ming.
This inadvertently slowed down the speed at which the black mist devoured the blood mist Yuan Ming had become.
Seeing Yuan Ming was only ten steps away from the top, Su Wu also couldn't spare any effort for other means, disintegrating his body into dense black mist and shooting straight upwards.
This black mist split into two streams, one entangling the blood mist Yuan Ming had become, trying to prevent his progress, while the other surged to the sky, bypassing Yuan Ming, racing directly to the top of the stairway.
At the moment when the black mist was about to surpass Yuan Ming, thunder suddenly rumbled in the sky, and a fierce wind howled.
Dozens of blood-red storm tornadoes descended from the sky, intermingled with purple-gold entwined lightning, like angry dragons, all striking the black mist Su Wu had become.
The black mist, caught off guard by this sudden fierce attack, struggled to absorb all these forces and was momentarily slowed down.
Taking this opportunity, the blood mist Yuan Ming had become rushed out swiftly, closing in on the final summit.
At this moment, Su Wu's entire Mana burst forth, and the black mist suddenly transformed into a several-meter-tall black mantis.
This black mantis moved all six of its limbs simultaneously, becoming a black shadow streaking through the attacks of thunder and storm, also heading for the summit of the stairway.
Ultimately, a patch of blood mist and a black mantis reached the top of the stairway at the same time.
The blood mist reformed into Yuan Ming's figure, his face exceptionally pale, his chest heaving subtly as he panted.
The black mantis also twisted and transformed back into Su Wu's form.
His complexion was as usual, but his expression seemed a bit sinister.
The two exchanged a glance, and the atmosphere instantly became tense.
"To think they reached the top simultaneously…"
Below the stairway, spectators gazed up at the unreachable thousandth step, their eyes revealing a variety of emotions, some astonished, some envious, while others carried a hint of worry.
Wu Yu's figure also quietly appeared among the crowd, observing silently with deep eyes.
Since Su Wu unsealed the blue-gray glow's Forbidden, she smoothly climbed to the nine hundred steps, and after obtaining her reward, she was content to stop and proceed no further.
As for the reward she received, no one paid attention, thus it remained unknown, becoming a mystery.
In the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space, Xi Ying suddenly collapsed to the ground, her body trembling violently, as if she had just undergone a life-and-death battle.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming's main soul, which had been hiding in the tripod, hurried forward to inquire.
He was shocked to find Xi Ying covered in sweat, her pupils flickering uncertainly, her face as pale as paper, appearing even more severe than Yuan Ming's injuries.
"Was that series of attacks in mid-air targeting Su Wu related to that white light orb you released earlier? Could it be some Forbidden-type Divine Skill causing you such great consumption?" Yuan Ming asked with concern.
Xi Ying took a deep breath and slowly replied, "That's a Divine Skill I awakened after advancing to Life Witch, called Causality Decree."
"Causality Decree?" Yuan Ming repeated, a myriad of sentiments rising in his heart.
"I'll explain this to you in detail later; I'm fine. You should quickly return to your main body and focus on dealing with that person, making sure to seize the Three Realms Immortal Boat." Xi Ying gestured gently, indicating to Yuan Ming that he need not worry.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming's main soul nodded, then left the Stealing Heaven Tripod and returned to his body.
```

chapters.title: Chapter 987 - 952: An Additional Trial
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming's Divine Soul had just returned, when he sensed a sharp killing intent flash through Su Wu's eyes.
Su Wu suddenly took a step forward, raising one hand, and began to cast a spell with a single hand, seemingly planning to use some means.
However, at this moment, a flash of green light appeared between them, and Qing Xu, the mysterious arbiter, appeared out of nowhere, separating them.
"This is a place of assessment, and dueling is prohibited. Anyone who violates this will be immediately expelled from the Three Realms Immortal Boat!" Jie Cha's voice was cold and commanding, leaving no room for doubt.
The killing intent in Su Wu's eyes quickly vanished as he slowly released his grip on the finger mnemonic, a hint of reluctance in his gaze.
Yuan Ming also withdrew his mana, knowing it wasn't the right time to fight Su Wu.
He quickly manipulated the roots of the Undying Tree into the Shura Palace, beginning to draw Spiritual Stones and Blood Origin Pills to swiftly restore his mana and Qi-Blood.
Forced by the current circumstances, he could no longer care if it would affect his future cultivation.
"Senior Jie Cha, long time no see, I hope you've been well. Fellow Daoist Wan and I have both passed the test. May I ask how the ownership of the Three Realms Immortal Boat should be decided?" Su Wu looked at Jie Cha, cupping his hands with a smile, his tone carrying a hint of respect.
Jie Cha spoke expressionlessly, "Su Wu, you have finally come. I have long told the Black Emperor that the Three Realms Sect has already deteriorated, and the Three Realms Immortal Boat is not suitable for the current world."
"I naturally know this matter. I also know that you and my master have an agreement, that as long as a disciple of the Three Realms Sect finds the location of the Immortal Boat, they can take it away. Does Senior Jie Cha still remember this?" Su Wu said with a slight smile upon hearing this.
Jie Cha nodded lightly and said, "Indeed, I did have such an agreement with your master. However, you are not the only one who passed the test. There is a pause of an hour here just like at the three hundred and six hundred steps. You should all recover your mana and then decide the ownership of the Three Realms Immortal Boat."
As Jie Cha's words fell, astonishment appeared on the faces of those below the steps.
They didn't expect that Jie Cha and Su Wu actually knew each other, and from their conversation, they learned a shocking fact—Su Wu was actually a disciple of the Black Emperor!
Yuan Ming also couldn't help but glance at Su Wu, then at Su Yingxue below, a thought suddenly sprouting in his mind.
Could it be that the new Hierarch of the Three Realms Sect, whom Su Yingxue mentioned that day in the Nihility Prison, was none other than Su Wu here?
This Su Wu, with his formidable strength and being a disciple of the Black Emperor, it was very likely.
He closed his eyes, focusing on his recovery.
Time was relatively ample, and he was not in a hurry to absorb the power from the Blood Origin Pill but instead manipulated the roots of the Undying Tree to search for the Power of the Sun in the void, to replenish his depleted Qi-Blood.
Within his Dantian, that Undying Tree had mostly transformed into the World Tree by now, with its roots' penetration capability greatly enhanced.
In this Silver Tower Space, the previously iron-hard Space Power now appeared as thin as gauze before the roots of the Undying Tree, allowing it to shuttle at will.
Yuan Ming focused all his thoughts on the roots of the Undying Tree, striving to extend them deep into the space, eager to draw more of the Power of the Sun.
At this moment, he suddenly felt as if the roots of the Undying Tree had closely connected to something.
Immediately, a torrent of abundant and waterfall-like nature's spiritual energy surged along the roots.
This Spiritual Energy not only contained the power of the Five Elements—Gold, Wood, Water, Fire, Earth but also included Yin Yang Qi.
Even more astonishing, the purity of this Spiritual Power was remarkably high, far surpassing the Spiritual Energy drawn from underground Spirit Veins by several multiples.
Nurtured by this surging nature's spiritual energy, Yuan Ming's mana was restored to its original state within just a few breaths.
Although the recovery of his depleted Qi-Blood Power was slightly slower, it was fully replenished within a quarter of an hour, and his face, previously pale from battle, now became rosy again.
However, this sudden change startled Yuan Ming greatly.
He tried his best to sense and finally perceived, faintly, a colossal tree in the depths of the space, its body as enormous as a mountain, standing majestically in the void.
The pure and vast nature's spiritual energy originated from this giant tree.
What astonished Yuan Ming more was that he sensed an aura on that giant tree similar to his own Undying Tree.
"Could that giant tree be the legendary World Tree?"
A surge of excitement welled up in Yuan Ming's heart. His Undying Tree shared origins with the World Tree, and if he could receive nourishment from the Wood energy of the World Tree, he could completely transform, reaching a new realm.
He attempted to absorb the Wood energy of that World Tree through the roots of the Undying Tree.
However, no matter how hard he tried, he could only draw some nature's spiritual energy, but the World Tree's Wood energy seemed to have an invisible barrier, blocking his perception and absorption.
Helpless, Yuan Ming reluctantly gave up further exploration of that mysterious giant tree and focused on absorbing and refining the transmitted nature's spiritual energy.
There was still some time left, and regardless of what requirements Jie Cha would propose next, enhancing his strength even slightly was beneficial.
Time slowly passed by, and an hour seemed to stretch extraordinarily long.
Jie Cha quietly observed the whole time, his next move filled with the unknown, making him unpredictable.
Yuan Ming understood deeply that he must give his all at this moment, whether for the fight over the Three Realms Immortal Boat or for his own safety.
Su Wu frowned in deep thought. His true form, the Six-winged Heavenly Cicada, was an entity capable of devouring everything. In the recent battle, he had absorbed all the attacks falling from the sky and had devoured dozens of Yuan Ming's clones, so he did not feel any depletion.
However, for some reason, Jie Cha's attitude made him feel a hint of unease. He even vaguely sensed that Jie Cha seemed to be more inclined toward Yuan Ming.
Nonetheless, Su Wu did not reveal any emotions. He, too, closed his eyes and began Breathing Control to prepare for the upcoming trial.
An hour finally passed, and Yuan Ming and Su Wu opened their eyes at the same time.
Their gazes were both fixed on Jie Cha, awaiting his next instructions.
Jie Cha's gaze swept across the two of them and slowly spoke: "You two have both reached the peak and completed the trial, but there can only be one master of the Three Realms Immortal Boat. Therefore, I have decided to add an additional trial."
With that, he crossed his hands in front of him, and a dazzling azure light shone in his palms.
With a gesture toward the ground, a complex array pattern instantly emerged on the platform's surface. As the azure light surged, a grayish-blue wooden stake rose from the ground.
This wooden stake stood several dozen feet tall and was as thick as three people embracing it. It was covered with vine-like array patterns, mysterious and naturally formed.
Yuan Ming immediately recognized that this wooden stake was also part of the World Tree, and no Forbidden had been set upon it.
His heart stirred, thinking that if he could completely absorb and refine it, his Undying Tree would surely undergo a transformation, but with Jie Cha nearby, he had to temporarily suppress his desire.
"What is this?" Yuan Ming couldn't help but ask.
Jie Cha replied lightly, "This is the core Forbidden of the Three Realms Immortal Boat. The two of you need to refine this pillar simultaneously, and whoever completes the refining first will own the Three Realms Immortal Boat."
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming immediately scrutinized the wooden stake closely from top to bottom.
In the next moment, he was surprised to find that although the array patterns on the stake appeared to be naturally growing, a closer examination of their distribution nodes revealed that these patterns were composed of numerous small arrays intertwined with each other in a nested array format, forming an incomparably complex Forbidden.
"When you are ready, you may begin." Jie Cha moved to the side, giving space to the two.
Yuan Ming and Su Wu stood on opposite sides of the wooden stake. Upon hearing the start command, both of them acted simultaneously, channeling their Mana into the stake to begin refining the Forbidden upon it.
Su Wu's Mana was profound, and as the black light flickered from his palm, it quickly permeated the grayish-blue stake.
The stake immediately glowed with black light, diffusing from his palm as a central point to surrounding areas.
Where the black light passed, the array patterns writhed as if coming to life.
Within a short time, Su Wu had already refined two arrays.
Although Yuan Ming's Mana was not as profound as Su Wu's, his Array Formation Cultivation had reached Level 6, and his understanding of formations was equally outstanding.
After just one look, he understood the trajectory of the entire wooden stake's Forbidden, so the position he chose to refine was not random but a carefully selected core array pattern.
This pattern connected the core of three arrays, and through these three arrays, it could remotely connect to another nine arrays.
When Yuan Ming began refining the first array, his Mana had already permeated the other three arrays, effectively refining four arrays simultaneously.
Therefore, although his Mana was not as abundant as Su Wu's, the speed of his refining was no slower than Su Wu's.
At the area Su Wu was refining, the black light quickly spread along the Prohibition Array Patterns, rapidly refining as it went, appearing quite domineering.
In contrast, at the side Yuan Ming was refining, the azure light followed the trajectory of each array pattern, extending from a single point to a line, then expanding into a surface, appearing more ingenious than Su Wu's domineering approach.
About half an hour later, Yuan Ming's side was enveloped in azure light, covering one-third of the entire stake like a peacock spreading its tail, whereas Su Wu's progress was quietly lagging behind.
"Who is this Wan Tianren? His formation expertise is so profound," Hei Lian said with some surprise, seeing what was happening above from below the stairs.
Su Yingxue didn't answer Hei Lian. Her eyes shone with a peculiar brilliance.
Yuan Ming's technique for refining the Forbidden bore many similarities to hers.
"Could this person have some connection to the Hui Clan?" Su Yingxue speculated inwardly.
At this moment, although Su Wu was falling behind, there was no expression of concern on Hei Lian and Su Yingxue's faces.
Su Wu saw a streak of azure light trailing along the array patterns, already invading the area covered by black light, beginning to reverse-refine the area he had already refined, causing his brow to furrow slightly.
He extended his free hand, pressing his fingers between his brows, and began chanting softly.
In the next moment, three strands of azure light emerged behind his head, falling beside him, condensing into three figures, one of whom was a young woman in white, none other than Su Yingxue.
The other two were a middle-aged Daoist with a fiery red robe and crimson fire brows and a graceful mature woman in a water-blue robe.
"Clone Divine Ability?" Yuan Ming's expression slightly changed upon seeing Su Wu's casting.
Below the stairs, Su Yingxue was standing there perfectly well; what Su Wu had summoned was evidently just a clone.

chapters.title: Chapter 988 - 953: Creating Space
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming wasn't familiar with Daoist Huo Mei and the Blue Robed Beauty, but when Su Wu summoned Su Yingxue's clone, his heart started pounding.
That clone, whether in demeanor or in that elegant orchid-like aura, was identical to the Su Yingxue he knew, as if she was reborn.
As Su Yingxue and the two others appeared, they gracefully dispersed like dancing butterflies, each forming hand seals to assist Su Wu in refining the Forbidden Wood Pillar.
Their techniques were skillful and exquisite, clearly masters in the way of formations, and the refining methods they employed were unlike anything Yuan Ming had seen before.
Xi Ying let out a soft exclamation and whispered a reminder, "This is the number seven ranked 'One Qi to Three Pure Ones' divine skill from the Creation Heaven List, capable of summoning clones equal in strength to the original. You must be careful."
Yuan Ming's heart tightened, and he hurried to accelerate his refining speed.
With the addition of Su Yingxue and the others, Su Wu's refining speed greatly increased, and the array patterns refined by the black light expanded rapidly, soon surpassing Yuan Ming and beginning to erode the area he had previously refined.
Working together, their Mana was like a storm, slowly pushing Yuan Ming's Mana out.
In just a moment, the area Yuan Ming had refined was compressed to only a quarter of its size, while the area refined by Su Wu had already taken over the majority.
Yuan Ming, anxious, desperately searched for a solution.
However, in terms of numbers, cultivation, or refining technique, he was clearly at a disadvantage, seemingly with no way out.
"If that's the case, then I can only take a risk!" A trace of determination flickered in Yuan Ming's eyes.
He activated the roots of the Undying Tree, attempting to refine the inner part of the Forbidden Wood Pillar.
As soon as the roots touched the pillar, a dense wave of wood qi from the World Tree rushed towards him.
Before Yuan Ming could actively absorb it, the wood qi poured along the roots into his Dantian, infusing the body of the Undying Tree.
In an instant, it was as if thunder exploded within Yuan Ming's Dantian, and all the roots of the Undying Tree uncontrollably pierced the void, delving deep into the Forbidden Wood Pillar.
Streams of pure and abundant wood qi from the World Tree frantically surged in, infusing the Undying Tree.
The color of the Undying Tree's body rapidly changed, and the last small portion began transforming into the World Tree, with an invisible wave emanating from within the Forbidden Wood Pillar.
Su Wu seemed to sense something but paid it no mind, continuing to focus all his efforts on refining the forbidden area.
Jie Cha cast a fleeting glance at Yuan Ming but took no action.
With the support of Su Yingxue's three clones, Su Wu's progress in refining the pillar proceeded steadily.
As for Yuan Ming, due to constant encroachment, the area he had refined was dwindling, making it difficult even to contend with Su Wu.
At this moment, however, Yuan Ming's attention was entirely focused on the body of the Undying Tree within his Dantian.
As the surging wood qi from the World Tree rushed in like a river, the last bit of black bark on the Undying Tree was gradually washed away, transforming into an ash-green color under this power.
The entire Undying Tree, at this moment, seemed to undergo a rebirth akin to Phoenix Nirvana, transforming completely into a brand-new World Tree, standing proudly within Yuan Ming's Dantian, emanating vibrant vitality.
The moment the World Tree was formed, a vigorous and immense vitality surged within Yuan Ming's Dantian.
```
