This vitality spread like a spring breeze over the earth, making his Mana seem somewhat uncontrollable, as a layer of dazzling green spirit light enveloped him, as if shrouded by a mysterious green veil.
At the same time, nourished by the origin power of the World Tree, his Mana became increasingly vigorous, as if infused with new vitality.
His previously slow refining speed suddenly surged, successfully resisting Su Wu's erosion.
Su Wu sensed the sudden backlash of Yuan Ming's Mana, a cold smile flashing in his eyes.
He remained unperturbed, joining his three clones in exerting their full strength, and immediately subdued the momentum that Yuan Ming had just gained.
Meanwhile, the formations refined by the three Array Master clones also completed their final linkage at this moment.
Their Mana poured down like a storm, pressuring Yuan Ming's Mana to retreat step by step.
In just a few breaths, the area Yuan Ming had initially controlled was largely occupied by black Mana.
On the entire Forbidden Wood Pillar, seven or eight-tenths of the area were already covered by Su Wu's black Mana, leaving only a small space under Yuan Ming's control, tenaciously shimmering with green light, struggling against the advance of Su Wu's four.[/p]
In the eyes of others, Yuan Ming appeared to be at the end of his rope, a foregone defeat.
But at this moment, Yuan Ming's face showed no sign of defeat; instead, there was a confident smile on his lips.
His eyes shone with an emerald light, and the World Tree within his Dantian swayed gracefully, releasing rings of silver-white light that rippled out in all directions.
These lights contained intense spatial ripples, as if capable of tearing the void and creating a new world.
"Condense!"
Yuan Ming's hands made a virtual grip, and he uttered a low shout.
In an instant, a massive silver light domain appeared out of thin air, enveloping a vast area with Yuan Ming at the center.
The Forbidden Wood Pillar was enveloped by the silver light domain, isolating Su Wu and his three spiritual clones outside, unable to pose any more threat to Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming nodded with satisfaction, for this was precisely the unique ability of the World Tree—space creation.
As the transformation in the dantian space of the World Tree completed, he immediately sensed this miraculous ability.
The World Tree contained space characteristics, with roots that could absorb space power from void turbulence, thus forming a space uniquely its own.
If time permitted, this space could even evolve into an entirely new world.
Before Su Wu and the others could react, a layer of space power pushed them away, completely severing their connection with the Forbidden Wood Pillar, unable to see what's inside.
Yuan Ming, using the power of the World Tree, successfully turned the tide of battle, earning himself valuable time for a counterattack.
"What kind of divine skill is this?"
Su Yingxue's clone showed a look of surprise, gently flicking a finger, and suddenly, a massive purple thunder array materialized out of thin air, covering the silver light domain as if it were something from beyond.
Inside the array, blinding streams of Lei Guang circulated, seemingly capable of tearing through void space.
Jie Cha observed the scene and spoke calmly: "You may compete in refinement but must not assault each other; otherwise, you'll be expelled from the Three Realms Immortal Boat!"
His words, though peaceful, carried undeniable authority.
Su Wu's eyes subtly shifted, scanning around, then returned to calm, seemingly unbothered by Jie Cha's warning.
Su Yingxue again formed seals, and hundreds of purple lightning bolts as thick as bowls suddenly fell, each flashing a strong aura of Destruction Thunder.
These purple bolts came together to form a Thunder Forest, roaring and bombarding the silver light domain.
The silver light domain merely trembled slightly, as if protected by an invisible force, showing no signs of fragmenting.
Yuan Ming was not surprised by this, as he understood the mysteries of the silver light domain.
This was not a simple barrier but another entrance to the void space, its toughness incomparable to the silver barrier summoned by a boarding order.
Unless there were divine skills capable of breaking the void, this silver light domain could not be penetrated.
Red Eyebrow Taoist and Blue Robed Beauty also acted, their attacks simple yet direct, each releasing a massive fireball and a massive water sphere.
The fireball blazed fiercely, seeming capable of burning all things; the water sphere emitted a chilling aura, as if freezing space-time.
These two massive energy spheres emanated intense power of Dao fluctuations, especially the fireball, within which a figure stood, dressed in a fiery red emperor robe, donning a Flat Heavenly Crown, exuding boundless momentum.
Nearby fire attribute nature's spiritual energy gathered madly, as if worshiping the fire emperor.
"This is the Fire Emperor True Intent! The supreme true intent within the fire attribute, its power surpasses the Illusion Sun True Intent of the Xi He Tablet! The silver light domain may not withstand it!" Xi Ying quietly remarked from the side, in caution.
Yuan Ming's gaze flickered, his ten fingers continuously moving, seemingly performing some divine skill.
Suddenly, the silver light domain blended into the void, vanishing without a trace as if it never appeared.
The massive fireball and water sphere missed and hit the altar, causing it to quake violently as if about to fly off.
At this moment, rays of green light appeared on the ground nearby, these green lights seemingly acting as a stabilizing force, quickly restoring the altar's stability.
Su Yingxue, Red Eyebrow Taoist, and Blue Robed Beauty all showed expressions of surprise, as did the ones below.
They never imagined Yuan Ming could possess such methods, disappearing into thin air, evading their attacks.
Su Wu frowned, fingers brushing across his brow, a white mark emerged.
White beams shot out from the mark, moving with apparent sentience, wandering in the void, like an eye scanning the surroundings.
He was searching for Yuan Ming's whereabouts, trying to locate the silver light domain.
Meanwhile, in the void turbulence, the silver light domain hovered quietly, seemingly isolated from the world.
Yuan Ming and the Forbidden Wood Pillar were brought along, placed within this silver void, as if entering another world.
"The World Tree actually possesses such divine skills, truly worthy of being the Ancestor of Ten Thousand Trees." Xi Ying smiled joyously, praising highly.
Yuan Ming remained silent, focusing all mana on refining the Forbidden Wood Pillar with utmost concentration.
He understood well that while the silver light domain could retreat to void turbulence, it might not remain undisturbed for long, as Su Wu had numerous methods, possibly finding a way to locate him.
Previously, Su Wu had nearly completed the refinement of the entire wood pillar, and though the silver light domain now isolated Su Wu and others' mana, their mana still resided within the pillar, not dissipated.
Yuan Ming steadily expelled the mana from Su Wu and the others while carefully completing the refinement, progressing steadily but not swiftly.
He recalled Su Wu's earlier use of the One-Qi-to-Three-Pure-Ones divine skill, his heart stirred, and he waved his sleeve.
Four spirit beans flew from his sleeve, landing nearby, flashing with spirit light before transforming into four spiritual clones of Yuan Ming, identical to the clones Su Wu had just summoned, and began assisting in refining the wood pillar.

chapters.title: Chapter 989 - 954: A Resolute Act
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming knew that the mana contained in these clones he summoned was limited, so he raised his hand to shoot out four streams of spirit light, injecting them into the four clones to sustain the mana consumption.
Although this would accelerate the mana consumption by several times, with the help of the World Tree, he could absorb a large amount of pure spiritual power from afar, without any worry about running out of mana.
The five "Yuan Ming" worked together, and indeed, the refining speed increased significantly.
However, Yuan Ming's brows remained furrowed, feeling that the speed was still not sufficient.
The next moment, he again channeled a stream of mana through the roots of the World Tree into the Forbidden Wood Pillar, attempting to refine the pillar from within.
However, his mana was not compatible with the Forbidden Wood Pillar, and this method was not effective.
"The Soul Destroying Sword is already dealt with, you just need to nurture it with mana for a while to use it. Eh, where is this? What are you doing?" Xi Hezi's figure emerged from the Xi He Tablet, his face showing surprise upon seeing Yuan Ming's actions.
Only then did Yuan Ming notice that the Xi He Tablet had been hovering beside him and had not been put away.
"Thank you for your hard work, Fellow Daoist Xi He." He expressed his gratitude and flicked his sleeve to receive the Xi He Tablet into the Shura Palace.
As for the current situation, he did not hide it from Xi Hezi and explained it simply.
"So you are fighting for the Three Realms Immortal Boat. This treasure is of immeasurable value, indeed worth contending for. However, your refining method is too poor, and your approach is incorrect. Since you have the World Tree, why use your own mana to refine this item?" Xi Hezi shook his head and said.
"Please, teach me, Fellow Daoist Xi He." Yuan Ming's eyes lit up, remembering Xi Hezi's status as an Artifact Refining Master, and hurriedly sought guidance.
"If you trust me, give me the World Tree, and I'll help you refine that Forbidden Wood Pillar." Xi Hezi said.
Yuan Ming hesitated slightly, then nodded in agreement, releasing Xi Hezi from the Shura Palace.
Xi Hezi's figure turned into a red shadow and quickly merged into Yuan Ming's Dantian, becoming one with the World Tree.
Under Xi Hezi's control, the World Tree charged towards the Forbidden Wood Pillar.
At the moment of contact, azure-gray light flickered, and the World Tree directly merged into the wood pillar.
Spirit light shimmered beneath the pillar, roots rapidly grew, and tender new shoots sprouted from the top, instantly transforming the entire pillar into a more towering World Tree.
Xi Hezi utilized the original spiritual power of the World Tree to swiftly refine the Forbidden Wood Pillar, at a speed much faster than when Yuan Ming and his four clones worked together.
Just then, a flash of white light appeared in the void turbulence, and a white sphere emerged out of thin air.
The sphere swiftly expanded a hundredfold, transforming into a house-sized white giant pearl, emanating astonishing spatial fluctuations as it hurtled towards the silver light domain.
Feeling the aura contained within, Yuan Ming's heart sank, thinking to himself, "As expected, they found me!"
In his reflections, he hurriedly controlled the silver light domain to escape into the distance.
However, the World Tree had just formed and was weak in power, moving sluggishly in the void turbulence, failing to avoid in time, and was directly hit by the white giant pearl.
With a loud crash, the silver light domain trembled violently, directly struck by the giant pearl, thrown off from the void turbulence, reappearing on the altar.
Su Wu was already standing not far away, holding one hand high, with a cluster of silver light congealing in his palm.
He suddenly swung it, and a ribbon-like silver light shot skyward, transforming into a silver giant sword stabbing into the heavens.
The blade of the silver giant sword had intense space power fluctuations, with the edges vibrating with serrated sharpness, ripping through the surrounding void even before slashing down, revealing gashes of space fissures.
"This is the Great Void Slash, a divine skill from the Creation Heaven List, specifically countering space divine power!" Xi Ying's voice sounded in Yuan Ming's ear, warning him to be cautious.
With a low shout, Su Wu swung the silver giant sword heavily down.
The void was instantly torn into a long black fissure, rapidly closing as soon as it appeared.
Yuan Ming's silver light domain, having just been knocked away from the void turbulence and not yet stabilized, was once again struck by the silver giant sword.
A sharp screech as if metal blades clashed resounded, the silver light domain was slashed with an enormous crack.
With a "boom," the silver light domain exploded, scattering into countless disordered silver glows.
The Forbidden Wood Pillar, along with Yuan Ming and his four clones, staggered into view.
Finally seeing the situation inside, Su Wu's expression turned exceedingly grim.
The Forbidden Wood Pillar, which he painstakingly set up, had turned into a lush, leafy tree in such a short time.
Fortunately, the array patterns on the trunk remained, and the mana he had infused earlier had not completely dissipated, still occupying about half of the prohibition array patterns.
After a brief moment of shock, Su Wu swiftly regained composure.
He had no time to worry about the peculiar changes to the Forbidden Wood Pillar and decisively led three clones to rejoin the refining process.
The four of them pressed their palms tightly against the tree trunk, with Su Wu at the core and Su Yingxue and the others encircling him, forming a mysterious refining formation.
They pushed their mana to the fullest, engaging in a fierce struggle for control over the Three Realms Immortal Boat with Yuan Ming.
Su Wu was initially full of confidence, thinking he could once again overtake Yuan Ming, but at the moment when his mana flowed into the Forbidden Wood Pillar, he was shocked to discover his mana, like water flowing into a blocked channel, advanced with extreme difficulty, and the refining progress was incredulously slow.
This sudden change left Su Wu off guard.
Meanwhile, on Yuan Ming's side, it was a completely different scene.
Green spirit light surged like a river, rapidly spreading over the forbidden wood pillar, refining most of the array patterns in a few breaths.
Su Wu's mana retreated step by step under Yuan Ming's assault, with no power to resist.
The situation reversed instantly, Yuan Ming was overjoyed, but dared not relax at all.
The people below stared dumbfounded at everything happening above. Since the appearance of the Silver Light Domain, they already couldn't comprehend the situation up there.
Nan Shangfeng asked, bewildered, "Master, what exactly did Wan Tianren do that even Su Wu is not his match?"
Master Tantai shook his head, silent, as he also couldn't explain it all.
"It looks like Su Wu is going to lose..." Yang Fan murmured.
The others remained silent, only able to roughly gauge the situation based on the surface events. It seemed that Yuan Ming, originally at a disadvantage, used some unknown method to turn the tables and take the upper hand.
"How could this happen?" Hei Lian and Su Yingxue's faces grew solemn.
Su Wu looked at Yuan Ming and asked in a deep voice, "What methods did you use?"
Yuan Ming did not answer his question, only his hands quickly formed seals.
His mana had spread over the entire forbidden wood pillar, now only a small corner occupied by Su Wu's mana remained.
As Yuan Ming formed seals, more than a dozen beams of green light pounced from all directions like starving wolves, fiercely gnawing at this corner.
Su Wu's mana rapidly collapsed under this ferocious attack.
Despite Su Wu's desperate resistance, it was still in vain.
Seeing his mana about to completely disperse, a trace of determination flashed in his eyes.
He suddenly raised an arm, and a hundred-yard-long silver light sword appeared above the altar.
This was indeed yet another Great Void Slash, grander in scale than before, and the spatial power fluctuations it emitted were even more terrifying.
Jie Cha saw this, and shouted, "What are you doing?"
However, Su Wu ignored Jie Cha's questioning, waved his arm, and the Great Void Slash fell like thunder, striking the center of the altar.
"Boom, boom, boom"
The sound of explosions rang out, the entire altar was split in two under this terrifying power.
Yuan Ming had been prepared, dodging away in time, thus unharmed.
But the altar's destruction caused the light on the forbidden wood pillar to disperse, and the array patterns instantly dimmed.
"Daring to destroy the altar, unforgivable!"
Jie Cha was furious, his breath surged like a storm, his hair and beard bristled, his eyes flashing with a fierce killing intent.
He raised his hand high and waved it forcefully, and then the previously silent attack surged forth once more.
This time, all the attacks gathered into thunder entwined with purple-gold and red tornadoes, crashing down like divine punishment on Su Wu, seemingly to completely engulf him.
Su Wu was already prepared, and a dense black qi emerged from him, swirling around like a demonic barrier.
No matter how dense and swift the attacks sweeping toward him, once they touched his body, they were swallowed by the black qi instantly, disappearing without a trace.
Jie Cha's face grew even darker upon seeing this, coldly saying, "Su Wu, your Heavenly Cicada Black Qi may be honed to ninety percent completion, but this is the Three Realms Flying Boat, there is no room for your recklessness!"
His words falling, he grasped into the void with his right hand, and streams of silver light flew from Yuan Ming and the people below, exactly as boarding orders.
These boarding orders plus one flying from Jie Cha's hand totaled to eight, appearing at various positions around Su Wu with a flicker.
The eight boarding orders emitted intense silver light, tightly encasing Su Wu within a giant silver light sphere.
Though the Heavenly Cicada Black Qi was fierce, under the suppression of this silver light sphere, it could not swallow anything.
Jie Cha waved his sleeves, the silver light sphere carrying Su Wu quickly merged into the void, seemingly to expel him from the Three Realms Flying Boat.
At that moment, an unexpected change arose!
A silver light suddenly shone from within Su Wu, mixed with rolling black qi, exactly from the last boarding order.
This order seemed to have been ritualized by Su Wu with some secret technique, dyed with a layer of eerie black on the surface.
Soon, Su Wu's body disassembled rapidly, transforming into a surge of black qi that quickly merged into that silver token.
The token emitted bright light, breaking free from the silver light sphere, tearing through the void.
Jie Cha saw this scene, his face sank, a trace of shock and suspicion flashing in his eyes.
"Jie Cha, I gave you some face for the sake of my master, don't think I truly fear you. Once I take control of this Immortal Boat, I will come to settle today's insult with you!" A cold voice from Su Wu came from within the silver token.
After that, the token transformed into a streak of silver light and drilled into the ground beneath the altar, disappearing without a trace in an instant.

chapters.title: Chapter 990 - 955: Underground Space
chapters.content:
Jie Cha witnessed this scene, his expression changed drastically, and his figure vanished like the wind, concealing himself in invisibility.
Beneath the sacrificial altar lay a vast, boundless soluble cave, its depths seemingly endless, as if leading to another unknown world.
In the middle of the cave stood a towering green-gray giant tree, like an ancient guardian deity, which was, astonishingly, the legendary World Tree.
Its trunk soared into the clouds, towering over a hundred feet, as thick as a city wall, dozens of feet wide, with branches intertwining and diverging into hundreds of branches, lush with greenery and teeming with life.
Even more astonishing was that this World Tree's height was not its ultimate limit. Its crown seemed to pierce through the void, with all its branches and leaves concealed in the endless void, their entirety unseen.
Even so, the scale of this World Tree was already breathtaking, as if it were a masterpiece of nature, filled with endless mystery and majesty.
Beneath the World Tree lay rows upon rows of formations that extended endlessly.
These formations varied in color, numbering as many as thirty-six.
Each grand array was composed of tens of thousands of array patterns, intricate and complex, each was a seventh-level array, arranged according to the circulation of the heavens, resembling a cosmic chessboard, seemingly containing infinite profound mysteries and wisdom.
At this moment, a fluctuation abruptly arose in the void below the World Tree, and a silver token appeared.
With the token's appearance, thick black aura surged forth, quickly coalescing into the figure of Su Wu.
Su Wu swiftly scanned the surroundings and, upon seeing the towering World Tree and the thirty-six seventh-level arrays below it, couldn't help but feel a bit of awe in his heart.
Though he wasn't an array master, he was well-versed and quickly discerned the mysteries of these formations.
Among these arrays were attack formations, defense formations, and gathering spirit formations, all emanating a faint glow and independently operating, guarding this mysterious space.
What surprised Su Wu most was that there seemed to be some mysterious connection among these thirty-six seventh-level arrays, as if they were interlinked, subtly forming a grander hexagonal formation.
This hexagonal formation seemed to encompass all the changes of formations in the universe, appearing profound and deep.
"This feeling... could this hexagonal giant formation be the legendary Eight Extremes Array?" Su Wu marveled silently to himself.
He couldn't imagine what kind of extraordinary talent it would take to perfectly integrate so many formations, combining them into such an unparalleled, grand formation.
Su Wu did not linger and immediately flew towards the center of the grand array.
During his flight, black aura continuously emanated from his body, swiftly landing on the formations below. However, instead of refining the formations, it began to quickly corrode and destroy these seventh-level arrays.
Although the seventh-level arrays were powerful, at this moment, without anyone to activate them, numerous array patterns were severed by the black aura, and the formations began to be destroyed.
One by one, the arrays extinguished their light, and the entire underground formation started to tremble violently, as if on the brink of collapse.
Meanwhile, Jie Cha had already pursued into the underground space.
He saw Su Wu crazily destroying the arrays and immediately became furious, shouting, "Stop! This place is the core of the Three Realms Immortal Boat. If it's destroyed, the Three Realms Immortal Boat will collapse with it!"
Su Wu seemed not to hear, letting out a chilling laugh, releasing more black aura from his body, continuing to destroy the other arrays.
His laughter echoed in the cave, filled with madness and determination.
"How dare you!"
Jie Cha's face turned ashen, his eyes blazing with anger.
He suddenly pressed his palms into the void, and brilliant blue light burst from his palms, swiftly connecting with the formations on the ground, weaving into a complex network.
Jie Cha's fingers moved swiftly, the blue light flickering with them, as if the formations on the ground were infused with new life, causing each to erupt with dazzling radiance.
These lights were brilliant, like falling stars, illuminating the entire cave as if it were daylight.
The defense arrays lit up first, emitting blue and gold lights, surging forth like ocean waves, roaring mightily.
These lights met with the Heavenly Cicada black aura released by Su Wu. Although they couldn't completely block it, they significantly slowed the aura's corrosive devouring speed, buying precious time for a counterattack.
Immediately following, Jie Cha activated each of the attack formations.
Fiery clouds gathered atop the formations, as if fire phoenixes were soaring among them, exuding a blazing aura. Beams of lightning intertwined into a net, sparking bright lightning, releasing powerful electrical energy, layers of ice fog permeated around the formations, so cold it seemed to freeze everything.
All these attack methods exploded with powerful might, crashing towards the black aura and directly at Su Wu like a storm.
Although the black aura was fierce, it could not withstand such a dense barrage of attacks, and it retreated step by step, being gradually consumed, and eventually dissipating into the air.
Seeing this, Jie Cha felt slightly relieved.
He knew this was far from enough, as Su Wu's strength was unfathomable, and he must go all out to truly stop him.
…
On the ground, after Su Wu and Jie Cha's figures disappeared one after the other, Yuan Ming did not leave immediately.
At this moment, he was still single-mindedly imparting mana into the towering tree trunk, carefully transmitting every strand of mana, fearing that he might disturb something.
Finally, after his relentless efforts, the refining process was complete.
On the forbidden wood pillar, azure light flickered ceaselessly, and each rune seemed to be endowed with life, shimmering with brilliant hues, as if declaring they had a new master.
The apprehension in Yuan Ming's heart finally settled at this moment, and he felt a sense of solidity he'd never experienced before.
"It's done."
Xi Hezi's voice echoed in Yuan Ming's sea of consciousness, carrying a hint of fatigue.
Then, the towering World Tree seemed summoned, slowly floating out from the azure light, gently detaching from the wood pillar, and returning to Yuan Ming's dantian.
"Thank you, Fellow Daoist Xi Hezi." Yuan Ming sincerely expressed his gratitude.
He knew that without Xi Hezi's help, this forbidden wood pillar would have long been subdued by Su Wu, and all his efforts would have come to naught.
Once the World Tree departed, the forbidden wood pillar also returned to its original state, with the array patterns on it still shimmering brilliantly, undiminished in glory.
Yuan Ming's palm gently brushed the wood pillar, and suddenly, a warm current surged from the pillar, flooding into his sea of consciousness.
It was a torrent of forbidden information, uncontrollably surging into his divine soul, deeply imprinting itself like a brand.
The forbidden information was so extensive that Yuan Ming, with his current cultivation, could hardly bear it for a moment, his pupils briefly losing focus.
After a while, he recovered, his face revealing an irrepressible look of delight.
The information that surged into his mind was the forbidden knowledge of the interior of the Three Realms Immortal Boat.
Inside the Three Realms Immortal Boat, thirty-six seventh-level magic arrays were deployed, known as the heavenly gang number, hidden deep beneath the altar.
Besides these seventh-level magic arrays, there were seventy-two sixth-level magic arrays and three hundred sixty-five fifth-level magic arrays, distributed further away, collectively shielding this Immortal Boat.
These arrays were arranged according to the circulation orientation, linked by the spirit veins, and under synergy, their power was exceedingly formidable.
Just the simultaneous operation of the thirty-six seventh-level magic arrays could achieve the power of the legendary eighth-level array.
However, Yuan Ming's cultivation was shallow, and even after refining the forbidden wood pillar, he couldn't activate so many great arrays.
Despite this, Yuan Ming was not disappointed but rather showed a look of joy.
During the process of communicating with the forbidden, he memorized the array maps of two seventh-level magic arrays, which was an extremely precious treasure for him.
Yuan Ming is now a sixth-level array master; comprehending several seventh-level magic arrays could significantly enhance his array formation cultivation.
Unfortunately, due to tight time constraints, he couldn't thoroughly investigate other seventh-level magic arrays.
In the Silver Tower Space, there was a spatial teleportation forbidden. Yuan Ming activated the wood pillar, his form flickered, and he vanished from his original spot.
The next instant, he appeared in the underground space.
Upon emergence, Yuan Ming immediately saw Su Wu, who was continuously releasing black qi to damage the great array, and Jie Cha, who was in hot pursuit.
His eyes briefly flickered, deciding not to join in or take any other action.
He understood there was still a significant gap between his strength and Su Wu's, and rashly stepping forward would only increase the danger.
Thus, Yuan Ming once again activated the forbidden wood pillar, and with a flicker, he appeared beside the towering World Tree, under the watchful eyes of Su Wu and Jie Cha.
In the former's eyes was a mix of jealousy and anger as he accelerated the release of the black qi, while the latter showed no particular change in expression upon seeing Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming gently placed his palm on the tree trunk, and from his palm emerged roots of the World Tree, attempting to root themselves into the giant tree.
This giant tree contained an immense amount of World Tree wood energy, far beyond what his World Tree could compare to. If he could refine it all, his World Tree could ascend to the heavens in one step.
A few breaths later, Yuan Ming showed a look of helplessness and withdrew his palm.
This giant tree also contained similar sealing forbiddances, preventing him from absorbing its wood energy.
Although a bit regretful, this attempt was not in vain. Just now, he immediately discovered something: the huge tree shadow his World Tree previously communicated with was indeed this World Tree before his eyes.
Inside this tree was a vast space, storing an immense amount of heaven and earth spiritual power, forming a colossal sea of spiritual power, surpassing any spirit vein Yuan Ming had seen.
The World Tree is known as the Ancestor of Ten Thousand Trees, surpassing the Undying Tree by far, with its roots able to directly take root in the void turbulence, drawing spiritual power.
The Three Realms Immortal Boat has been stationed here for unknown ages, during which the giant tree has amassed tremendous heaven and earth spiritual power, and all the arrays within the Immortal Boat are operated with the spiritual power provided by the World Tree.
Yuan Ming's World Tree had just formed and had yet to display a similar function.

chapters.title: Chapter 991 - 956: Pressing Onward
chapters.content:
The giant tree before him stood tall and majestic, with branches and leaves so dense it seemed capable of holding up the entire sky.
Yuan Ming gazed up at the giant tree, a profound sense of awe welling up within him.
This World Tree truly is the Ancestor of Ten Thousand Trees. Its existence is like a top-tier Spirit Vein that can be carried around, brimming with endless vitality and power.
He couldn't help but wonder when his own World Tree would grow to such a magnitude.
Yuan Ming quickly shook his head, dismissing these thoughts.
He took a deep breath, and a green light emanated from his body, transforming him into a much smaller World Tree.
This small World Tree emitted a faint green light, slowly approaching the enormous World Tree, and finally merged into the trunk, vanishing without a trace.
The current situation was fraught with danger, and Yuan Ming knew he had to act quickly.
He decided to use Xi Hezi's secret technique. Like before, when he refined the Forbidden Wood Pillar, he would first control this giant World Tree and then use it to activate the various Great Arrays here to deal with Su Wu.
Only by eliminating all enemies could he then calmly consider refining this World Tree.
The World Tree incarnation of Yuan Ming smoothly entered the interior of the giant tree, their powers of the same origin, quickly melding together.
He employed the assimilation secret technique Xi Hezi had just used, attempting to control the power of the World Giant Tree.
Unexpectedly, the entire process proceeded exceptionally smoothly.
"How can this be? Such a massive World Tree should have developed spiritual intelligence, yet it shows no resistance," Yuan Ming thought with surprise.
However, this was undoubtedly a good thing for him.
He continued to use the secret technique, attempting to completely control this World Tree.
Inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod, Xi Ying sat cross-legged on the ground, practicing Breathing Control.
Her soul fluctuations were much more stable than before, her complexion mostly restored, as she slowly opened her eyes.
"How are you feeling now?" Yuan Ming's main soul asked with concern.
"Much better, don't worry," Xi Ying replied.
"What exactly is the Causality Decree you used earlier? It consumed so much soul power that it even affected the stability of your divine soul," Yuan Ming's main soul asked again.
Hesitating slightly, Xi Ying explained: "The Causality Decree is a divine skill that can manipulate fate. This skill allows one to make a wish, influencing everything nearby to fulfill it. It's somewhat akin to the 'speak and follow' concept but much more complex. Earlier, I wished for you to safely reach the top of the steps, and the power in the ether assisted you in escaping Su Wu's pursuit."
Thinking it over, Yuan Ming's main soul asked, "So did the Causality Decree's influence cause the unforeseen attack that obstructed Su Wu, who was trying to prevent my safe ascent, thereby missing the opportunity to kill and obstruct me?"
Xi Ying nodded, "Pretty much."
"Such a divine skill exists! But using it must come with a heavy toll, right?" Yuan Ming's main soul marveled.
"All things have a cause and effect. The greater the wish, the greater the price the practitioner pays. But don't worry, I know my limits," Xi Ying said.
"Alright, be cautious when using this divine skill," Yuan Ming pondered over her words and slowly responded.
Just as he finished speaking, his expression suddenly changed.
"What's wrong?" Xi Ying immediately asked.
"There was a slight change outside. But it doesn't matter; once I finish refining the World Tree, the Three Realms Immortal Boat will be entirely under my control. You should focus on your recovery," Yuan Ming said solemnly.
Simultaneously, the group beneath the altar also seemed flustered by the series of changes.
Just at that moment, the entire space suddenly shook violently.
Huge fissures appeared on the ground, and the altar split in two fell into them, with cracks also appearing in the void.
Seeing signs of this space collapsing, everyone's faces filled with terror.
Hei Lian and Su Yingxue exchanged a glance, seemingly reaching a tacit agreement, and both moved swiftly as the wind.
At this moment, Su Yingxue stepped forward lightly, raising her jade hand to press on the trial steps.
From her palm surged a rich green light, like rippling emerald waves, shimmering with a mysterious luster.
On the steps, the green light flared, and a ray of light floated out, enveloping the key that had been refined from the World Tree.
It seemed to have been waiting for this moment of summoning, finally seeing the light of day again.
Su Yingxue's eyes were sharp, capturing the key with a quick move, and she gracefully returned to Hei Lian's side.
At that moment, Hei Lian was muttering incantations, her hands forming seals, performing an unusual spell.
Suddenly, dark light spewed from her fingertips, like a meteor in the night, slicing through the void.
As the dark light flickered, the void was torn open.
Inside the opening, a swirling vortex of black mist teemed, unlike the flickering light of a spatial rift, as if leading to another mysterious realm.
Hei Lian and Su Yingxue's figures flickered, slipping into the void rift.
Their actions were so swift that when the others came to their senses, the two figures had already vanished.
The crowd watched the void rift gradually close, looking at each other in confusion and puzzlement.
The group of demons from the Ten Thousand Demon Country turned to Wu Yu, waiting for her decision.
Wu Yu glanced over the precarious Silver Tower Space and said in a deep voice, "This is not a safe place to stay. We should leave first."
Six phantom fox tails suddenly appeared behind her, drawing an elegant arc in the void.
Six streams of silver light shot out, like meteors streaking across the night sky, instantly opening a space passage in the void.
The group of demons from the Ten Thousand Demon Country flew into that space passage, which then slowly closed, as if it had never appeared.
Seeing that the people from the Ten Thousand Demon Country had also left, the others began to grow restless.
"Master, what should we do now?" Yang Fan asked, a trace of urgency on his face.
Master Tantai's gaze roamed among the people, finally resting on Sima Changqin as he asked, "Lord Qinmo, you have the highest cultivation here, what should we do next? We need your guidance."
Long Hou, Jin Chen, and others also cast questioning looks at Sima Changqin, clearly viewing him as the leader here.
Tie Xuan, Shen Xiu, and the tall, big black Demon had also recovered from their previous weakened states and now stood beside Sima Changqin, silently waiting for his decision.
"Does anyone have the means to break open the void?" Sima Changqin asked, looking around at everyone.
Upon hearing this, they all shook their heads.
Though they were all strong in their own right, they were powerless when it came to such advanced techniques as breaking open the void.
"If my ancient zither were still around, breaking open the void wouldn't be difficult, but unfortunately, it was taken by Wan Tianren, and now I cannot leave this place," Sima Changqin said with a slight shake of the head, a hint of helplessness on his face.
"What do we do then? This space looks like it's about to collapse. Are we just going to stay here and wait to die?" Long Hou asked anxiously, his face full of unwillingness.
"No need to panic. I just used a secret technique to explore and found another world underground here. Since we cannot break open the void to leave, why don't we explore below? There might be a way out there. Moreover, the final ownership of the Three Realms Immortal Boat is still undecided; we might still have a chance," Sima Changqin said earnestly.
Upon hearing this, everyone fell silent.
They recalled the terrifying black energy from before, where even Wan Tianren was powerless, and an overwhelming sense of helplessness surged within them.
But Sima Changqin's words also gave them a glimmer of hope; perhaps they could find a new way out underground.
"Are any of you willing to join me in exploring below, at your own discretion?"
Seeing everyone silent, Sima Changqin said, "In that case, we shall take our leave."
With that, he and the three black demons employed the Escape Technique and headed deeper underground.
Watching Sima Changqin and the others disappear, Jin Chen, Master Tantai, and Long Hou glanced at each other.
"After all this toil, if we return empty-handed, it truly feels unsatisfactory," Long Hou said with determination, spitting on the ground in frustration.
"I feel the same way," Jin Chen hesitated briefly, then nodded.
Their gazes simultaneously turned to Master Tantai, seemingly awaiting his decision.
Master Tantai's gaze darkened slightly, hesitating for a moment, but eventually, he made up his mind.
He took a deep breath and slowly said, "Since you've all decided to go down and explore, let's go together."
The allure of the Three Realms Immortal Boat was just too great; they ultimately couldn't resist that deep-rooted desire.
Nan Shangfeng stood aside, feeling conflicted.
He both wanted to know Yuan Ming's situation and was worried about the imminent dangers below.
Upon hearing his master's decision, his inner conflict dissipated. Since his master had already decided, he no longer needed to struggle; he'd just follow them.
Having made up his mind, he was about to send a message to Wulu to invite him along when his expression changed slightly.
He was surprised to find that Wulu, who had been standing next to him just moments ago, had disappeared without a trace.
...
Meanwhile, outside the Three Realms Immortal Boat, atop Fire Peak Mountain.
With the upper echelons on both sides entering the Three Realms Immortal Boat, the Human Clan's cultivators and the demon soldiers from the Ten Thousand Demon Country each found places to camp, keeping a considerable distance from one another, maintaining a scene where they wouldn't disturb each other.
Amid the Human Clan's camp, Yuan Ming's clone stood silently, his face showing no emotion.
He quietly watched the distant Spiritual Treasure Space, contemplating his next move.
"I wonder how those inside are doing," Wei Ling muttered softly beside him, worry etched on his face.
Yuan Ming's clone did not reply. Though there was a connection between him and his true form, it was severed by the Three Realms Immortal Boat, leaving him unaware of what was happening inside.
Moreover, his true self had left him outside merely as a precaution; the clone's power was insufficient, and even if it participated, it wouldn't make much difference.
While pondering, Yuan Ming's clone suddenly had a change in expression.
He looked down at the ground beneath his feet, feeling a strange sensation rising from the depths, as if something were quietly changing.
"Could this be a disturbance in the Spirit Vein?" he murmured to himself, frowning.

chapters.title: Chapter 992 - 957: The Giant Vessel
chapters.content:
Wei Ling was stunned by the words, just about to lower his head to investigate.
Suddenly, a loud "rumbling" sound erupted next to his ears.
He looked up, only to see the distant ground suddenly trembling, countless cracks spreading across the surface.
Scorching black smoke rolled out from the fissures, erupting with a mournful rumbling sound.
In the next instant, orange-red lava surged forth, shooting straight into the clouds, like a pillar of heaven collapsing, shaking the earth and mountains.
Everyone in the Human Clan and Demon Clan camps was alarmed by this sudden change and rushed out to check the situation. When they saw this apocalyptic scene, everyone was shocked and immediately began to retreat.
Due to the overwhelming and fierce surge of lava, many Cultivators and Demon Soldiers were still engulfed by the rolling lava.
At the brink of life and death, both groups fled desperately, running for more than ten miles before stopping to catch their breath.
They looked back, only to see that the place where they had camped had turned into a sea of fire and lava.
"What happened, where are the lords, are they still in the Space Spiritual Treasure?" Both sides were in a state of panic, not knowing what had happened, with people continually asking, but no one could provide an answer.
Just when everyone was uncertain and suspicious, a loud "splashing" sound arose from the surface of the Magma Lake, as if some gigantic object was turning in the deep sea, about to break through the water.
Everyone immediately turned their heads, only to see the lava erupting from the top of Fire Peak Mountain rising and falling, with a silver-white, long sharp horn tearing through the space like a sharp sword, emerging abruptly from the void.
Immediately after, the spatial rift suddenly expanded, and a massive silver-white ship hundreds of meters long broke through, its prow pointing skyward, imposing and magnificent, as if escaping from a giant sea beast's lair.
Embraced by the lava, the silver-white ship suddenly plunged downwards, with surging airwaves rolling in all directions, then it stabilized firmly in mid-air.
The ship's multiple towers made it look from afar like a large mobile palace complex, grand and spectacular.
On either side of the ship, large white cylindrical structures extended from the ship's hold, resembling the whiskers of a giant dragon, fierce and majestic.
Everyone gazed at this silver-white giant ship, showing expressions of amazement, not daring to approach easily, only staying at a distance in mid-air, discussing and speculating about the ship's origin.
Among the crowd, Yuan Ming's clone also showed a look of surprise.
After instructing Wei Ling beside him with a phrase, he used the Void Transformation Technique to conceal himself, quietly approaching the silver giant ship. Soon, he landed on the ship's deck.
The silver giant ship was incomparably vast, with Yuan Ming's clone choosing to board at the foredeck.
This place seemed a bit empty, with only the mast hoisting a large sail and a passage leading into the ship's towers.
However, this passage was blocked by a heavy grayish-green wooden door, enveloped by a Forbidden energy, exuding a mysterious and powerful aura.
After studying for a moment, Yuan Ming's clone soon found in frustration that with only the clone's power, it was impossible to break this Forbidden energy.
He was preparing to find another way into the ship when he suddenly detected a fluctuation in the nearby space, as if someone was breaking through the void and emerging.
Yuan Ming's clone felt a chill in his heart and quickly restrained his breath, hiding behind the mast.
Only to see a crack suddenly opening in the void above the deck, with Hei Lian and Su Yingxue stepping out in succession.
Their expressions were urgent, seemingly having something important to do, so they did not pay attention to the Cultivators and Demon Soldiers in the distance and went straight to the wooden door.
Su Yingxue stood before the wooden door, flipped her right hand, and held the key of the World Tree.
As she brought the key close to the door, several emerald spirit lights appeared on the door, as if resonating with the key. The key gently inserted into the door.
With a twist of Su Yingxue's wrist, a soft "click" sounded, and the door slowly opened.
Su Yingxue withdrew the key and, together with Hei Lian, walked inside.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming's clone hiding behind the mast was moved, wanting to take this opportunity to enter as well.
But just as he took a step, the wooden door suddenly closed, shutting him out.
Yuan Ming's clone reluctantly retracted his foot, feeling a little annoyed inside.
He paced around the deck a few times, finding that there was only this single passage to enter the ship, so he decided to sit down on the ship, quietly waiting for other opportunities to present themselves.
...
Inside the ship, it was like a maze.
The path beyond the wooden door was intricate and complex, interwoven like a spider's web.
On both sides of the passage were mysterious rooms of various sizes, with tightly closed doors and no markings, seemingly concealing endless secrets.
For those coming here for the first time, even if not lost in the winding passages, it was difficult to find their target among the countless rooms.
Yet Su Yingxue and Hei Lian seemed to know this place like the back of their hands.
Their steps were quick and determined in the passage, as if each step was on a predetermined path.
Soon, they arrived at the stern, coming to a tightly closed door.
Su Yingxue once again took out the key of the World Tree, gently inserting it into the door.
With a soft "click," the door slowly opened, revealing a unique room.
The walls and floor of the room seemed to be meticulously crafted from silver jade, translucent and reflecting faint human figures, while emitting a gentle silver light that made the whole room look like a dream.
In the center of the room, there was a raised platform.
On the platform, a silver-white ancient ship's helm was installed.
The helm was carved with unique patterns, but at the moment, it appeared dull, as if it had lost its former brilliance.
Su Yingxue walked to the front of the platform, formed seals with her hands, and chanted silently.
After a while, she waved her hand and cast several spells on the helm.
In an instant, a dazzling silver light erupted from the helm, and then the four walls and floor lit up, like shining stars, splendid and dazzling.
Amidst the flowing light, images slowly appeared on the walls.
These images were clear and vivid, astonishingly showing the scenes outside the Three Realms Immortal Boat, with distant mountains, rivers, and clouds seemingly within reach.
At this moment, Hei Lian lightly stepped onto the platform, holding the helm with both hands.
After slightly discerning the direction, she forcefully turned it.
With her movement, light surged simultaneously from various parts of the giant silver ship.
A deep and awe-inspiring humming sound echoed through the sky, as if a slumbering giant beast was awakened, roaring thunderously.
The cultivators and demon soldiers in the distance had just seen Su Yingxue and Hei Lian descend onto the giant boat, and then saw the boat burst into spirit light. Those brave and curious flew over immediately, trying to board the ship to explore its mysteries.
However, just as they were about to approach the giant ship, a faint silver barrier suddenly appeared around the ship.
This barrier quickly expanded, enclosing the entire ship within it, forming an oval shell.
Those attempting to board were isolated outside this barrier, forced to watch helplessly as the giant ship slowly ascended in front of them.
On the deck, Yuan Ming's clone was surprised to see this scene, and stood up to approach the barrier.
He attempted various methods to break through the barrier, but soon discovered it was incredibly strong, even a Dharma Phase Cultivator would struggle to break it in a short time.
As the barrier rose, the giant boat slowly turned and, accompanied by a roar, gradually took flight, like a giant silver eagle spreading its wings towards the direction of White Emperor City.
Those outside the boat were astonished to see it embark.
They hurriedly tried to catch up, but although the ship appeared slow, it was a deceptive impression due to its massive size, even Returning to Void Cultivators couldn't keep pace with its speed.
In just a few breaths, the giant ship had left them far behind, disappearing from sight.
On the deck, Yuan Ming's clone watched the ship's receding figure, feeling a ripple in his heart.
Recalling Su Yingxue and Hei Lian who had just boarded, his brow furrowed.
Su Yingxue and Hei Lian were from the Three Realms Sect, their intentions here were undoubtedly not good. Sadly, he was just a clone here, his true self engaged elsewhere, and could only sigh as he continued sitting at the bow to observe the unfolding situation.
...
Outside the Three Realms Immortal Boat, beside the towering Silver Tower, space suddenly rippled, as though a stone had been thrown into a calm lake.
Soon after, a spatial passage quietly appeared, from which Wu Yu led a group of Great Demons from the Ten Thousand Demon Country, lightly landing on the open ground outside the Silver Tower.
"Her Majesty the Empress, what should we do next? Should we just go out directly?" The Black Bear King asked cautiously, his brows slightly furrowed.
Wu Yu glanced back at the imposing Silver Tower, a deep light flashing in her eyes.
She raised her hand, and suddenly a deep red light flickered in the void, followed by a Flying Wheel Spiritual Treasure appearing before everyone.
This Flying Wheel was entirely deep red, its spirit light resonating with nature's spiritual energy, and upon its appearance, flames surged, winds howled, emitting an intimidating pressure.
Most strikingly, at the center of the Flying Wheel were nine meticulously arranged slots, each perfectly fitting a person.
"All of you, sit down." Wu Yu said calmly, her figure floating up as she was first to fly into a slot and sit down.
The other five Great Demons followed suit, each finding their slot, leaving three slots vacant.
Wu Yu raised her hand again to cast a spell, suddenly three white tail-like shadows flashed behind her, and then three clones emerged from her body.
These figures looked exactly like Wu Yu, as if reflections in three mirrors.
After these three clones appeared, they occupied the remaining empty slots.
Then, the nine demons simultaneously cast spells, pouring demonic power into the Flying Wheel.
Nine different types of demonic power converged, and with a sound, the Flying Wheel soared up, its exterior suddenly erupting in deep red flames, engulfing Wu Yu and the demon clan within.
With a "whoosh," the Flying Wheel transformed into a red light, shooting far into the distance at a speed like a meteor across the sky, far surpassing Lei Yu's full-speed flying escape.

chapters.title: Chapter 993 - 958: Fortune from Misfortune
chapters.content:
In just a few breaths, the Flying Wheel Spiritual Treasure flew out of the Silver Mountain Range, continuing to race forward. In no time, it reached another volcanic peak surrounded by scarlet flames.
As Wu Yu and the other demons stepped off the Flying Wheel, they heard several crisp "crack" sounds. This top-level spiritual treasure suddenly exploded mid-air, shattering into countless fragments that fluttered down into the volcano's lava.
Wu Yu didn't seem distressed at all by this. With a flip of his right palm, he took out a talisman and crushed it.
A few breaths later, a mass of scorching flames instantly flew out from the volcano below, landing in front of Wu Yu.
From within the flames came the voice of the Great Sun Glaze Flame: "You got here quickly, it seems the plan is going smoothly."
"So far, so good. How's your preparation coming along?" Wu Yu asked, with a hint of concern in his tone.
"Almost done. I just need to absorb a little more Fire Spiritual Power, give me an hour," the Great Sun Glaze Flame replied.
Wu Yu frowned slightly and said, "The plan is urgent now. I can only wait for you for a quarter of an hour."
"Alright, I'll hurry," replied the Great Sun Glaze Flame, with a tone of slight resignation.
Wu Yu nodded, waved away the flames in front of him, and then sat in a meditative position in the void.
Except for Xuan Ye, all the other Demon Kings, including the Black Bear King, were visibly surprised, evidently full of curiosity about the impending plan.
"Your Majesty, at this stage, can you tell us the plan?" The Electric Roc King couldn't help but ask.
Wu Yu looked up towards the distance, in the direction of White Emperor City.
Her eyes flashed with determination and resolve, and she spoke slowly: "Of course. I didn't tell you before because I feared you might be captured and Soul Searched, which would lead to a leak of the plan. Now, everything will finally end..."
...
Beneath the Silver Tower, within the deep and dark cave.
As Sima Changqin and the others stepped into this underground world, beams of Forbidden light slashed towards them like swords, catching them off guard.
None present were ordinary people. They immediately cast spells to block the incoming Forbidden lights one by one.
After a brief panic, the group quickly regained their footing, and their eyes gradually adjusted to the dimness inside the cave.
"The World Tree? This tree is so enormous, it's beyond imagination!" someone exclaimed.
"And these Magic Arrays, their complexity has reached the pinnacle of a seven-level Magic Array!" someone else added, full of astonishment in their voice.
Even someone as composed as Sima Changqin couldn't help but show a look of surprise.
All those present were well-informed, yet the sight before them still left them astonished.
Among the crowd, Nan Shangfeng quietly observed the World Giant Tree, a flicker of light in his eyes that soon returned to calmness. It seemed he was contemplating something.
Meanwhile, in mid-air in the cave, Jie Cha's eyes were wide open with anger, with countless blue lights flashing around him.
He activated over a dozen seven-level Magic Arrays in the cave, all aimed at Su Wu.
The lights from those Arrays flickered with formidable power, as if they wanted to tear the entire cave apart.
However, any attacks that fell upon Su Wu were devoured by the Heavenly Cicada Black Qi surrounding him.
The black qi seemed to have an endless devouring power, and no attack could cause it any harm.
Even though those Forbidden attacks couldn't harm Su Wu, the constant consumption restricted the Heavenly Cicada Black Qi within a certain range, unable to overflow.
Both sides were locked in a mutual stalemate, seemingly engaged in a silent contest.
"Let's bypass them, we don't need to involve ourselves in their conflict," Sima Changqin quickly assessed the situation and said calmly.
His words immediately gained the agreement of the others, and they all concealed themselves, intending to slip past along the cave wall while the two engaged combatants remained unaware.
Just as they started moving, Su Wu in mid-air suddenly turned his head to look at them.
A cold smile flashed across his eyes, as if he'd spotted something interesting.
"Heh, you arrived just in time, I was just in need of puppet reinforcements!" Su Wu's lips curled into a cold smile as he raised his hand and waved.
Instantly, a black qi Long Dragon shot out like an arrow, rushing straight towards Sima Changqin and the others.
Seeing this situation, Jie Cha immediately activated a Wood Attribute seven-level Magic Array to intercept.
Dozens of emerald giant trees appeared out of nowhere, seemingly alive, swaying elegantly in the void.
Each giant tree was entwined with clusters of azure Lei Guang, rumbling with thunderous sounds. It was the purest Yimu Divine Thunder, containing the ripple of the Power of Dao.
Dozens of giant trees seemed like dozens of arms, smashing toward the black qi Long Dragon from all directions, causing even the void to stir, as if an invisible force was pressing down on everything.
Yet the black qi Long Dragon seemed to ignore all attacks, continuing its charge towards Sima Changqin and the others.
At the critical moment when everyone was holding their breath, the black qi Long Dragon suddenly accelerated, splitting into over a dozen streams like a crafty Spiritual Snake, deftly weaving through the gaps between the green giant trees.
In an instant, thunderous roars echoed throughout the cave; the majority of the black qi was pushed back by the Yimu Divine Thunder released by the giant trees. However, five streams of black qi ghostly slipped through, unstoppable, lunging at Sima Changqin and the others.
Sima Changqin and the others did not expect Su Wu to suddenly launch an attack on them. Seeing five streams of black energy rushing towards them, they hurriedly summoned their respective spiritual treasures to prepare for the enemy.
In an instant, the air was filled with roaring sounds as various spirit lights flashed wildly, clashing fiercely with the five streams of black energy.
These five streams of black energy dragons were exceptionally tenacious. Even though they were shattered by the combined efforts of the group, the scattered black energy seemed to possess intelligence, deftly slipping through the gaps between the spiritual treasures and rushing directly at their bodies.
The group was shocked, hurriedly forming spell seals, either raising spiritual treasures or employing other protective divine powers.
The black energy, however, was unusually bizarre; whether it was the protective light rings formed by spiritual treasures or other protective divine powers, they were instantly corroded and penetrated upon contact with the black energy.
Sima Changqin and the others' expressions changed drastically, finally witnessing the terrifying power of the Heavenly Cicada Black Qi.
They wanted to dodge, but it was already too late as the black energy struck them and rapidly invaded their bodies.
The group felt their bodies paralyzed instantly, unable to move even a finger.
Immediately, their bodies began to swell rapidly, as if inflated, resembling the scene when Yuan Ming was invaded by the Heavenly Cicada Mother Qi.
The spiritual energy between heaven and earth seemed to be summoned by something, frantically pouring into their bodies, causing their cultivation to soar rapidly in a short time.
Despite this anomaly, no one felt any joy.
Their faces were filled with pain, and their swollen bodies seemed on the verge of exploding.
The frantic pain tormented their minds, causing them to quickly lose consciousness, their eyes gleaming with bestial blood light, as if about to transform into wild beasts.
Among them was Nan Shangfeng.
His cultivation rapidly reached the peak of Returning Void with the help of the Heavenly Cicada Black Qi, and his body swelled to several meters in height, with blood vessels bulging alarmingly.
At this moment, the void not far in front of Nan Shangfeng suddenly rippled, and a thick green-gray tree root emerged from thin air, quickly wrapping around him and dragging him into the void.
Mere moments later, the root brought Nan Shangfeng into a silver space.
As soon as the green-gray root set Nan Shangfeng down, more roots emerged from thin air, piercing into his body and exerting a force of suction.
The black energy within Nan Shangfeng's body was swiftly absorbed by the suction of the roots, and his body gradually returned to its original form.
"Indeed, the World Tree is the nemesis of the Heavenly Cicada Black Qi."
A vague face appeared on the green-gray tree root, belonging to Yuan Ming.
He had already begun to control the World Giant Tree, and upon seeing Nan Shangfeng's dire state, he immediately used the roots of the World Tree to rescue him from afar.
Yuan Ming carefully observed Nan Shangfeng, and suddenly his expression shifted as if he had sensed something.
Soon after, a slender tree root shot out from the void, silently entering Nan Shangfeng's Dantian.
A moment later, a look of surprise appeared on Yuan Ming's face.
Despite being eroded by the Heavenly Cicada Black Qi, Nan Shangfeng had unexpectedly gained some benefits.
His cultivation did not regress; he remained steadily at the peak of Returning Void.
More importantly, his previously damaged Spirit Root had considerably recovered.
Recalling his earlier promise to Nan Shangfeng, Yuan Ming couldn't help but feel a bit emotional.
He had promised to help restore his Spirit Root, but due to various reasons, this had been delayed until now.
Seeing Nan Shangfeng's Spirit Root recovering on its own, Yuan Ming felt much relieved, knowing it would now be much easier to repair.
He took a deep breath, carefully separating a strand of Ten Thousand Wood Origin from his body, and gently infused it into Nan Shangfeng's Dantian.
Yuan Ming cautiously guided his Mana, trying to perfectly integrate this strand of Ten Thousand Wood Origin into Nan Shangfeng's Spirit Root.
After all, it was his first attempt, and Yuan Ming's technique was somewhat clumsy.
The majority of the Ten Thousand Wood Origin dispersed during the integration process, merging into Nan Shangfeng's body, washing through his Mana, with only a small part successfully merging into his Spirit Root.
Nevertheless, this bit of Ten Thousand Wood Origin was already enough for Nan Shangfeng to use.
His Spirit Root was completely restored and even showed significant advancement compared to before.
This unexpected discovery greatly pleased Yuan Ming as he hadn't anticipated the nurturing effect of the Power of Ten Thousand Wood Origin on Wood Attribute Spirit Roots to be so profound.
He resolved internally to try it on himself in the future, wondering if it could elevate his own Spirit Root to the next level.
At this moment, Nan Shangfeng's consciousness gradually awakened.
A trace of confusion first flashed across his face, but upon seeing the roots around him, he immediately recalled everything that just happened.
He quickly checked his body and displayed an uncontrollable expression of joy.
"Fellow Daoist Wan, is that you?" He pondered briefly and then stood up to salute.
"It is I." Yuan Ming's voice echoed, seeming to emanate from all directions, making it impossible to pinpoint its exact location.

chapters.title: Chapter 994 - 959: You Didn't Let Me Down
chapters.content:
"Thank you, Fellow Daoist, for your timely rescue and resolving the issue with my Spirit Root. This great kindness, Shangfeng will always remember and dare not forget," Nan Shangfeng said sincerely, his tone filled with gratitude.
"It was merely a trivial act. The outside is fraught with danger now; staying there is too risky. You should return to my Shura Palace and recuperate," Yuan Ming said indifferently, as if it were all a matter of course.
Before Nan Shangfeng could respond, Yuan Ming activated the Shura Palace, a flash of light passed, and Nan Shangfeng's figure vanished, taken into the Shura Palace.
Having done all this, Yuan Ming once again cast his gaze towards the outside.
Master Tantai, Long Hou, and others were now immobilized, each becoming extraordinarily tall, resembling giants.
Besides, their aura far surpassed before, yet their expressions were empty and fierce, as if they had completely lost their minds.
More strangely, their skin had grown fish-scale-like black scale armor, looking extremely bizarre, as if they had turned into some unknown creatures.
Yuan Ming furrowed his brow slightly, looking at these cultivators turned monsters, feeling uncertain about restoring them to their original state.
Just then, he noticed Sima Changqin among the group.
Unlike the others, his body was enveloped in a shield of ice-blue, emitting an icy cold aura, surprisingly able to withstand the black aura, keeping it out.
Sima Changqin's figure moved like the wind, transforming into a blue light speeding towards the depth of the cave, as if to merge into the endless darkness.
Su Wu glanced at the escaping figure but did not pursue, focusing solely on fending off Jie Cha's attacks.
He waved his hand, revealing a dark mark in his palm.
The next moment, Master Tantai and others' eyes suddenly turned blood-red, issuing beast-like low growls, driven by some power, madly rushing towards Jie Cha.
Su Wu laughed out loud, lightly waving his hand, sending seven or eight strands of Heavenly Cicada Black Qi like arrows towards Jie Cha, forming an encircling attack alongside Master Tantai and others.
Jie Cha sneered, nimbly dodged the black qi, landing steadily within a three-layered circular seventh-level magic array.
At the center of the formation, a golden light suddenly appeared, array patterns consecutively lit up like ignited, the dazzling golden light layer by layer rose, as if to pierce the cave vault.
In this layered golden light, an enormous golden sword formation slowly emerged, the brilliant golden sword shadows stacked layer upon layer, like a towering golden sword tower, piercing the sky.
Jie Cha formed a sword technique, and immediately came the "clang clang" sound of metal friction from the golden sword tower, countless golden sword shadows shooting out like meteors, slashing straight at Master Tantai and others, and those black aura.
In an instant, the sword shadows illuminated the entire underground cave, and the sharp Sword Qi sealed the area within a hundred feet around Jie Cha impenetrably.
Master Tantai and others seemed oblivious, directly rushing into the countless sword lights.
The next moment, their bodies were torn apart under the criss-cross sword Qi.
Surprisingly, their bodies didn't turn to pieces but morphed into waves of black Qi, aside from being slightly coarse, that black Qi was almost indistinguishable from Su Wu's Heavenly Cicada Black Qi.
After the sword glow passed, the black Qi quickly condensed, once again forming the figures of Master Tantai and others.
They seemed unharmed, continuing their attack towards Jie Cha.
Jie Cha's eyes flashed with surprise, and even Yuan Ming's brow slightly furrowed.
They were amazed by Master Tantai's current form, resembling the Undying Body; what means had Su Wu used to instantaneously grant such divine skills to Master Tantai and the group of puppets?
Jie Cha quickly regained his composure, continuing to control the golden sword formation to slash at Master Tantai.
In the face of the sharp Sword Qi, Master Tantai and others showed no fear, directly confronting the boundless sword light.
At this moment, the boundless sword light suddenly withdrew, recondensed into a towering golden sword tower, tightly enclosing Master Tantai and others within.
The air inside the sword tower seemed to be transformed by some force, becoming as solid as golden iron, Master Tantai and others instantly immobilized, unable to break free despite their struggles.
Jie Cha's gaze shifted, looking towards the place where Su Wu originally was, and his expression suddenly changed.
Su Wu, previously surrounded by numerous formations, had disappeared without a trace, as if merging into the surrounding void.
Jie Cha became alert, ready to cast a spell to probe, when a deep voice suddenly rang in his ear: "He's to your left, retreat quickly!"
Jie Cha's eyes narrowed, without hesitation, he flew to the right, his figure turning into a green shadow, traversing the cave.
At this moment, Su Wu, concealing his figure, saw this and his face darkened, his form slowly revealing.
He flipped his palm, and a surge of black Qi poured out like tide, instantly engulfing most of the sword formation.
Those sharp sword lights and sword shadows, before the dense Heavenly Cicada Black Qi, were rapidly swallowed completely, even the golden sword tower imprisoning Master Tantai and others, disintegrated under the corrosion of the black Qi.
Jie Cha's face darkened.
He knew Su Wu's methods were bizarre and dared not linger, accelerating his escape towards the distance.
At this moment, the void before him suddenly split open with a crack, Su Wu's upper body emerged from it, while his lower half remained in the distance.
This scene was extremely bizarre, as if Su Wu's body was being torn apart alive.
Su Wu raised his arm, and a long sword, black as ink, suddenly appeared in his hand. Without hesitation, he swung the sword and thrust it, the tip pointing directly at Jie Cha's chest.
The black long sword emitted a fierce Black Sword Qi, which instantly pierced through Jie Cha's chest, corroding a large hole in it.
The Black Sword Qi seemed to have a life of its own, poised to devour Jie Cha's entire body.
A flash of green light shimmered across Jie Cha's body, and his form suddenly dissipated into countless green glows, vanishing into the air.
The next moment, in the void a dozen feet away, these glows reconverged, and Jie Cha's figure reappeared.
Surrounding the void, streams of azure light spiraled and flowed into his body, and the large hole in his chest began to heal at a speed visible to the naked eye, completely restored within a breath or two.
As an Artifact Spirit, Jie Cha was closely connected to the entire Three Realms Immortal Boat, his Life Force nearly endless.
Although the recent strike was dangerous, it didn't cause him much harm.
Witnessing this, a trace of surprise flickered in Su Wu's eyes.
He retreated his upper body back into the void, returning to the location of his main body.
Meanwhile, Jie Cha seized this opportunity, flickering into a streak of green light and executed a Flying Escape, once again entering a Level 7 Fire Attribute Formation.
As he waved his hands, the formation blazed up with towering flames.
Eight fire dragons, red as blood, soared and intertwined, their heads held high, their dragon scales glistening, as if they had stepped out of ancient legends.
The fire dragons spewed endless flames towards the attacking Su Wu, with the flames surging forward as if to incinerate the entire cavern.
This formation was called the "Eight Desolate Fire Dragon Formation," a masterpiece of Jie Cha's, with the True Dragon Flames it emitted capable of melting everything.
Even at this moment, Su Wu didn't dare to underestimate it, and his expression turned serious.
He opened his mouth and spat out, unleashing a mountain-like black mist that collided with the flames on the verge of igniting the sky.
Although the Heavenly Cicada Black Qi could devour flames, the True Dragon Flames opposing them were too ferocious. The black mist couldn't suppress them instantly, leading to a stalemate.
Just then, two blue-green tendrils suddenly jabbed out from the void.
Like living creatures, they deftly pierced through the Eight Desolate Fire Dragon Formation's defenses and punctured the core of the Array.
The next moment, tremendous Fire Attribute Spiritual Power surged through the tendrils into the Array, as if injecting new life into the fire dragons.
In an instant, the entire formation's firelight and spirit light surged, with the flames pouring out like a breached flood, more imposing than ever.
The fire on the eight fire dragons burgeoned rapidly, the crimson in their flame-forged eyes turning gold-red, as if bestowed with life, enhancing their power five to six times over.
The combined flames spewed by the eight fire dragons exploded violently upon striking Su Wu's black mist without waiting to be devoured.
A loud "boom" resounded.
The black mist was directly shattered, and the scorching flames blasted Su Wu into the air, heavily slamming him against the cavern's stone wall.
"Good, little friend Wan, you didn't disappoint me. Quickly join me in subduing this brute!" Jie Cha shouted loudly.
As the Artifact Spirit of the Three Realms Immortal Boat, although Jie Cha could mobilize the Spiritual Power within the World Tree, he was significantly restricted, and the amount of Spiritual Power he could access was quite limited.
The true power lay in the hands of the owner of the Three Realms Immortal Boat, who had refined the World Tree. They could freely command that vast ocean of Spiritual Power at will.
Yuan Ming stood quietly to the side, making no vocal response, merely silently manipulating the tendrils of the World Tree, flexibly inserting them into the cores of the other four Seven-level Magic Arrays, like Spiritual Snakes.
As these tendrils delved deeper, torrents of vast Spiritual Power poured into these formations like a flood, greatly enhancing their might.
The first to change was the Ten Thousand Sword Cage Formation.
The previously faltering Sword Array regained form with the new influx of Spiritual Power. The golden light within the array surged several times over, the layers of Golden Light Sword Shadows becoming more substantial, as if capable of slashing through the void.
Master Tantai and others, just breaking free of their bonds, barely had time to catch their breath before being suppressed once more by the resurging power of the Sword Tower.
At the same time, thousands of Golden Light Sword Shadows coalesced into a brilliant Sword Dragon in the void, roaring as it unleashed unparalleled Sword Qi, charging directly at Su Wu.
The other three formations also displayed astonishing power.
In the Water Wood Formation, azure black vines grew wildly like tentacles.
In the Water Attribute Formation, towering waves surged, threatening to engulf everything.
The Earth Attribute Formation emitted ring after ring of dense earth-yellow glow, rapidly expanding out to envelop Su Wu.

chapters.title: Chapter 995 - 960: Salvation
chapters.content:
As the earthen yellow halo passed through, Su Wu immediately felt a heaviness all over his body. The suppression power of the surrounding space increased significantly, making him involuntarily fall downward.
Meanwhile, the cyan-black wooden vines on the ground surged upwards, entangling towards him, and those rippling blue waves caused his Divine Soul to tremble, leading to a momentary daze.
This brief lapse gave Jie Cha and the others a chance to act.
Fierce Fire Dragons and incomparably Sharp golden Sword Qi instantly enveloped Su Wu, as if to swallow him whole.
Just when the two thought Su Wu was about to be defeated, his eyes suddenly flashed with a trace of black light, immediately regaining his senses.
Facing the aggressive attacks around him, he sneered, holding a long black sword against the ground. Suddenly, a dense black light exploded from outside his body, rapidly coalescing into a black Light Domain, which was a Spiritual Domain.
Within this black Spiritual Domain stood towering black peaks, with black mist swirling at the peaks and black water surging below, turning the entire Spiritual Domain into a substantive reality, as if it were a real existing space.
Those cyan-black vines turned to ashes the instant they penetrated the black Spiritual Domain…
The heat breath of the Fire Dragons melted and disappeared in the blink of an eye…
Even the golden dragon formed by the golden Sword Qi, as soon as it dashed into the black Spiritual Domain, dispersed without a trace. Not a single Sword Qi could touch Su Wu.
Inside the World Tree, Yuan Ming's pupils involuntarily contracted, utterly shocked.
Jie Cha's face changed dramatically, exclaiming, "This is... turning virtual into reality! You have cultivated a Spiritual Domain? Impossible, you have not yet reached the Mahayana Realm, how could you have cultivated a Spiritual Domain!"
Su Wu smiled faintly and said, "As long as one has a deep enough understanding of the True Meaning of Dao, combined with sufficient Spiritual Power to drive it, evolving a true Spiritual Domain, what's the difficulty?"
Jie Cha remained silent, yet within his heart surged an indescribable envy.
Though he, as the Artifact Spirit of the Three Realms Immortal Boat, could exert power here on par with anyone else, he was handicapped by his nature as an Artifact Spirit, innately disadvantaged.
Even if he could comprehend some True Meaning of Dao with the aid of the Three Realms Immortal Boat, cultivating a Spiritual Domain was as hard as ascending to the heavens.
With this thought, Jie Cha's resolve grew even stronger.
Ignoring Su Wu's taunt, he continued manipulating the Great Array for attacks, while secretly discussing countermeasures with Yuan Ming through telepathy.
At this moment, Su Wu suddenly formed a peculiar spell with his hand and pointed it at Jie Cha across the void.
A black dot suddenly appeared between Jie Cha's brows, and his body instantly stiffened there.
The black dot rapidly spread like ink, and within a breath's time, Jie Cha's eyes were dyed black.
"What have you done..."
Jie Cha's angry shout echoed in the empty cavern, but his voice seemed suppressed by some invisible force, gradually growing weak and trembling.
His left eye was now completely consumed by darkness, as black as ink, devouring all light like an abyss.
And around the pupil of his right eye, the once-clear white had been reduced to mere threads, gradually eroded by darkness.
Jie Cha's expression underwent a tremendous change in that brief moment, transforming swiftly from anger and confusion to reverence and submission.
His body seemed controlled by an invisible force, and the Arrays that fiercely attacked Su Wu moments ago had weakened, finally coming to a complete halt.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming's heart trembled with shock, urgently calling Jie Cha through telepathy.
Jie Cha, however, seemed to lose his sense of hearing, completely ignoring Yuan Ming's call.
Yuan Ming's heart sank. Knowing things were going awry, he immediately manipulated the World Tree, sending a dozen thick roots rushing through the void, attempting to wrap around Jie Cha's body, just like the recent rescue of Nan Shangfeng, to save Jie Cha.
Just as the roots were about to touch Jie Cha, his body suddenly transformed into a green shadow, eerily escaping from the roots of the World Tree, landing lightly beside Su Wu.
