"Your Excellency indeed possesses remarkable skills, subduing Jie Cha with a wave of your hand. It seems it was a method used when piercing Jie Cha's body with that Black Sword just now?" Yuan Ming asked in a deep voice, eyes intently watching the Black Sword in Su Wu's hand, not pursuing further.
The Black Sword was over three feet long, emitting an ominous aura, seemingly capable of devouring all things, with the air seemingly torn apart wherever it pointed.
Yuan Ming's expression suddenly changed slightly.
Though the aura of this Black Sword was entirely different from his Soul Destroying Sword, it gave him a familiar feeling, as if there was a subtle connection between them.
"Could this sword be..." A bold thought emerged in Yuan Ming's mind, but he immediately suppressed it.
"Fellow Daoist Wan truly has keen insight, seeing through everything at a glance. Now that Jie Cha has been subdued by me, if Fellow Daoist Wan knows what's good for him, hand over the World Tree obediently, and I can promise you a safe departure." Su Wu said solemnly upon seeing this.
Yuan Ming looked at Su Wu with a mocking smile and said, "Would Fellow Daoist Su swear by his Heart Demon to guarantee my safe departure?"
Upon hearing this, Su Wu's expression turned grim.
He had long harbored murderous intent toward Yuan Ming, especially after witnessing Yuan Ming's potential, making him all the more apprehensive. His earlier words were merely intended to lure Yuan Ming out.
"Since you refuse a toast only to drink a forfeit, you shall slumber here eternally!" Su Wu said coldly, his voice filled with intense killing intent.
Jie Cha's hollow gaze shifted, finally resting on the World Tree where Yuan Ming was hiding.
With a wave of his sleeve, the Sword Qi on the Ten Thousand Sword Cage Formation changed direction, lifting the suppression on Master Tantai and others, transforming into several golden Sword Dragons rushing towards the World Tree with lightning speed.
Then, the Eight Desolate Fire Dragon also roared and spewed True Dragon Flames, tumultuous waves of water surging around, all turning directions to attack the World Tree.
In an instant, the entire World Tree seemed to be engulfed by endless assaults.
Inside the World Tree, Yuan Ming's face turned cold as mana swirled at his fingertips.
A dazzling silver light suddenly expanded from within the tree, rapidly forming a giant spherical silver light domain space, like an indestructible silver dome, protecting almost the entire World Tree.
The golden Sword Dragon roared hideously, opening its giant mouth, spewing out dense Sword light and Sword Qi, pouring onto the silver space like torrential rain.
The Sword Qi only emitted a series of crisp metallic clash sounds before being scattered by the mysterious power of the silver space, turning into nothingness.
The Eight Desolate Fire Dragon surrounded all sides, flames blazing, its fiery Dragon Flame engulfing the entire silver space.
The flames burned fiercely, seemingly about to devour everything, yet even after exhausting more than half of its power, the silver space remained unscathed and indestructible.
Other attacks continuously rained down, but all proved futile, as the silver space seemed to possess endless defensive strength, unable to be shaken in the slightest.
Su Wu was not surprised by this.
His form moved, transforming into a stream of light shooting upwards, fingers combined like a blade, raised high.
"Swoosh"
A dazzling silver glow burst forth from his palm, instantly transforming into a massive silver Light Sword, carrying world-destroying force, slashing down fiercely at Yuan Ming's silver space.
Great Void Slash!
At the moment the silver Light Sword struck, countless black space fissures flickered like fragmented lightning outside the spherical silver space.
The chaotic Space Power interwove, constantly tearing apart the void, emitting a thrilling roaring sound.
Although the silver space held firm for several breaths under the slash of the silver Light Sword, it ultimately couldn't withstand the unmatched force.
A massive crack tore open on the silver space, revealing its deep and mysterious interior.
Su Wu's eyes showed a hint of delight, about to fly in, only to see the torn silver space quickly surging with dense silver light.
The silver light flowed like water, rapidly repairing the crack, in the blink of an eye, the silver space was restored to its original state, intact.
Su Wu's eyes twitched slightly, a wave of regret rising in his heart.
He suddenly recalled the previous battle with Yuan Ming, regretting not following Su Yingxue's advice to kill him in advance.
"Go, mobilize all the Forbidden Great Array's power to seal the World Tree, restricting its strength." Su Wu's gaze narrowed slightly, dismissing useless thoughts, sternly instructing Jie Cha.
Upon hearing this, Jie Cha lifted his foot, but then put it down again, not following Su Wu's command.
A hint of struggle and resistance flashed in his eyes, seemingly influenced by some force.
Su Wu's face sank, a clump of black light suddenly brightening at the center of his brow, containing eerie power, seemingly able to control one's mind.
"Yes..."
Jie Cha's somewhat aged voice became suppressed and low, with noticeable resistance, yet his body obediently leaped high, hovering in mid-air.
Jie Cha's sleeves waved, his body exuding blue light intensely.
Strands of blue threads extended from him, like countless tentacles connecting all the underground space's arrays.
With his movements, arrays after arrays of Forbidden Array lit up, symbolizing layers of forbidden runes extending like chains, intertwining towards various parts of the void.
Inside the World Tree, Yuan Ming immediately felt the vast sealing power rapidly spreading throughout the underground space.
The sealing power was like invisible shackles, binding the World Tree's strength, clearly weakening its connection with the Three Realms Immortal Boat.
His face darkened slightly, with a thought, the void near Jie Cha suddenly cracked open.
Twelve thick tree roots emerged from the void, each root hosting a soul crow.
The soul crows had Black Feather like ink, their eyes flashing with gloomy light, seeming to hold endless Spiritual Power.
"Awaken!"
Yuan Ming suddenly shouted, his voice carrying some mysterious power.
The twelve soul crows simultaneously opened their mouths, emitting piercing black Crow Cry.
The Crow Cry pierced the void like sharp arrows, directly striking Jie Cha's mind.
In the soul crows' cry, Jie Cha's body jolted fiercely.
In the eye yet to be completely dyed black, a dazzling light suddenly shone, as if breaking free from the abyss, gradually regaining its original luster.

chapters.title: Chapter 996 - 961: Escaping with the World Tree
chapters.content:
Su Wu witnessed this scene, his complexion changed drastically, and he immediately strengthened his control over Jie Cha, intending to reverse the declining situation.
However, his actions were ultimately half a beat too slow.
As soon as the consciousness of Jie Cha recovered slightly, he unhesitatingly raised his hand and heavily struck his own chest.
A dazzling azure light suddenly burst from Su Wu's body, becoming instantly blinding, as radiant as the rising sun, making it hard to look at directly.
"Boom" sounded a loud explosion.
Jie Cha's body exploded amidst the thunderous noise, transforming into countless azure lights, like meteors streaking across the sky, eventually dissipating into nothingness.
He would rather destroy his physical body than be controlled by Su Wu anymore, an act of determination that invokes lament.
"Just an Artifact Spirit, how dare it rebel like this!" Su Wu was furious in his heart, his face livid.
Without the assistance of Jie Cha, his attempt to break through the silver space upheld by Yuan Ming with the World Tree became ten times more difficult.
Now that things had come to this, Su Wu could only suppress his inner anger and resentment, continuing to perform the Great Void Slash, trying to breach that silver spherical space.
Unfortunately, no matter how he wielded his sword to cleave, the silver space could always swiftly repair itself after shattering, seemingly possessing endless life force.
Su Wu helplessly stopped his actions, turned around, and shouted to the people behind him, "Come over here!"
Master Tantai, Long Hou, Jin Chen, and others heard this and quickly flew over, gathering around him.
Su Wu condensed a silver Light Sword in one hand, while the Black Sword in his other hand lightly pointed at the crowd.
On the Black Sword, black light surged, and a rolling black qi flowed out, winding through the void like tiny streams, eventually flowing towards Master Tantai and the others.
Those people appeared dazed, as if they had lost their own consciousness, raising their heads and opening their mouths, allowing the black qi to pour into them, continuously infusing into their bodies.
As the black qi kept pouring in, their pupils suddenly enlarged, their eyes round and wide, faces contorted with a ferocious and painful expression, yet they were powerless to resist, passively swallowing the black qi.
Under the continuous erosion of the black qi, the expressions of several people gradually became calm, as if even the last trace of their own Divine Sense was being obliterated, and their bodies quietly undergoing transformation.
In the blink of an eye, Master Tantai and others transformed into bizarre half-man half-cicada beings, with a pair of black cicada wings growing from their backs, and their hands turning into sharp hooks.
These people turned into black shadows, swooping out, their hooks shooting streaks of black light akin to Sword Qi, which were burning with black flames, striking at the silver light sphere.
Bang bang bang…
The power of these black lights was astonishing, almost on par with Su Wu's Great Void Slash, and under their attacks, the silver light sphere trembled as if it might collapse at any moment.
Seeing this, Su Wu also continued to perform the Void Slash, tearing the defense of the silver space once more with his silver Light Sword.
The silver light sphere shook violently, constantly being slashed with cracks, yet the Spiritual Power contained within the World Tree was overwhelmingly vast, causing those cracks to quickly recover under the surge of power.
No matter how fiercely Su Wu and the others attacked, the silver light sphere steadfastly held on.
Seeing this, Yuan Ming breathed a sigh of relief, but he did not relax his vigilance because of it.
At this moment, suddenly multiple regions around Su Wu and others appeared with distorted spaces, and one by one, grayish-green tree vines unexpectedly shot out from within, directly aiming at them.
Su Wu let out a cold laugh, unflustered, and continued to wield the Light Sword condensed in his hand, slashing at the silver space.
Simultaneously, black qi billowed around him, forming into large black mist hands from thin air, reaching toward the thrusting tree vines.
Those black mist hands moved extremely fast, quickly gripping all the tree vines tightly, with black qi surging in their palms, trying to corrode and devour these vines.
However, the vines of the World Tree were not ordinary, contained exaggeratedly immense Power of Ten Thousand Wood Origin, and showed no fear of the erosion by the Heavenly Cicada Black Qi.
The surface of the vines lit up with a gleaming green light, contending with the black qi, with neither side conceding.
Seeing this, Su Wu was slightly startled, then he discovered to his astonishment that the bright green light emitted by the vines of the World Tree contained incredibly rich life force.
This life force not only resisted the erosion of the Heavenly Cicada Black Qi but also consumed the energy of the black qi inversely.
At this, Su Wu was suddenly somewhat unsettled.
Silver light blossomed from both of his hands, fingertips emitting a sound akin to a sword singing, seemingly gathering an even more formidable power.
A gigantic silver Light Sword soared into the sky, carrying a world-ending momentum, once again slashing down.
The silver light sphere surrounding the World Tree was torn apart by an enormous sword light, like a silver screen sliced by a sharp blade, leaving a shocking gash.
The sword light plunged deeper within, even cutting a deep sword mark on the ancient trunk of the World Tree, as if attempting to cleave the entire tree in two.
Before the crack in the silver light sphere could fully heal, Master Tantai and the others shot forward like arrows off the bowstring, heading straight for the body of the World Tree.
As they were about to get close, vines of the World Tree suddenly extended from the void, either launching a surprise attack from behind or wrapping around from the sides, like cunning poisonous snakes, aiming to trap them.
With the vibration of the black cicada wings behind them, Master Tantai and the others moved with exceptional agility, weaving through the void, effortlessly avoiding the vines and gradually approaching the World Tree.
As they flipped their palms, black light blades shot out, like meteors in the night, tearing through the void, slashing towards the World Tree.
At this moment, the World Tree radiated dazzling silver light once again, as a new silver light sphere emerged from within, rapidly expanding.
Master Tantai and the others couldn't dodge in time and were struck by this newly appeared silver light sphere, their black light blades dissipating amidst the sphere's shockwave.
Su Wu witnessed this scene, furrowing his brow as a wave of unease surged within his heart.
He knew deeply that if things continued like this, capturing the World Tree would become increasingly difficult.
Elsewhere, Yuan Ming was fiercely battling while also striving to refine the World Tree, though his progress was exceptionally slow.
He could feel that the World Tree had been growing for countless years, its immense life force and energy far beyond his imagination, while his own World Tree had just completed its transformation and was still relatively weak. Absorbing the larger World Tree in its entirety was by no means easy.
"The situation is dire, Jie Cha has already fallen, and you face Su Wu alone. Unless you can completely control this World Tree, you have no chance of winning. Persist in entanglement with Su Wu and the others, and loss is inevitable." At this moment, Xi Ying's voice sounded in Yuan Ming's ear, calm yet laced with concern.
Yuan Ming was naturally aware of what Xi Ying said.
If he could successfully refine and devour this World Tree, his own World Tree could rapidly evolve and grow to an unimaginably powerful level.
As its host, he would naturally gain enormous benefits.
Unfortunately, the World Tree before him was far too vast, its life force and energy exceedingly strong, beyond his expectations.
To absorb it completely, he might need to spend decades or even hundreds of years, yet the current situation did not allow him the time to refine it slowly.
Just as Yuan Ming was deep in thought, Kong's voice suddenly echoed in his Sea of Consciousness: "Miss Xi's words hold truth, relying on yourself alone, there's little hope of capturing the Three Realms Immortal Boat. Instead of passively taking hits here, why not take the World Tree and flee?"
Startled by what he heard, Yuan Ming asked doubtfully, "Take the World Tree and run? Senior Kong, this World Tree and the Three Realms Immortal Boat are refined into one. Without complete refinement, how can it be taken away?"
"Haha, a good question. This World Tree is essentially the power chamber of the Three Realms Immortal Boat, providing power for its operation. When the Immortal Boat is intact, indeed, separation is difficult. But now that the restrictions within the Immortal Boat are severely damaged, the connection between them is not as tight." Kong's voice carried a hint of laughter.
"May I ask, Senior Kong, if you have devised a method?" Yuan Ming asked eagerly upon listening, his eyes gleaming with desire, humbly seeking Kong's guidance.
To him, as long as he could grasp this World Tree, the gains or losses concerning the Three Realms Immortal Boat were insignificant.
Kong responded calmly, "Simple, just store it inside a Space Spiritual Treasure."
Yuan Ming furrowed his brow, showing some difficulty, "Store it inside a Space Spiritual Treasure... the World Tree is so massive, its roots buried deep in the void, still somewhat linked to the Three Realms Immortal Boat, is it really possible to extract it easily?"
Kong chuckled lightly and explained, "You don't need to act in haste to pull the tree out all at once. Even a Mahayana cultivator struggles in achieving such a feat. Since you've already gained initial control of the World Tree, you can gradually extract its roots and let them take hold in the Space Spiritual Treasure, thereby being able to carry it away."
Yuan Ming was overjoyed at hearing this, expressing his gratitude with clasped hands, "Many thanks for your guidance, Senior Kong."
With that said, he raised his hand, ready to summon the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
However, Kong stopped him in time: "Hold on, don't use the Stealing Heaven Tripod to collect the World Tree. The space within the Stealing Heaven Tripod is unique, incomparable to ordinary space treasures, not suitable for transplanting the World Tree."
"What should I do then? I only have the Shura Palace, a space treasure that doesn't even reach the level of a Spiritual Treasure, can it truly hold the World Tree?" Yuan Ming felt a chill in his heart and promptly inquired.
"You need not worry. The World Tree is a divine skill of Earth's creation, possessing the power to open space. Transplanting it into the Shura Palace will not only avoid damaging the treasure but can lead to its transformation, advancing to a Spiritual Treasure is not out of the question." Kong chuckled.
Receiving Kong's affirmative response, Yuan Ming no longer had any concerns and immediately began attempting it while fending off Su Wu and others' attacks.
Things are easier said than done.
The roots of the World Tree spread throughout every corner of the Three Realms Immortal Boat, to transplant it means first extracting these roots one by one, and gradually moving them into the Shura Palace.
Fortunately, Yuan Ming had previously refined the restrictive stakes of the Three Realms Immortal Boat, at this moment his World Tree was gradually merging with the ancient World Tree, the boundaries between the two becoming increasingly blurred.
This allowed him to simultaneously control them to some extent, making the transplant work relatively easier.

chapters.title: Chapter 997 - 962: Seizing Treasure from the Tiger's Den
chapters.content:
Under Yuan Ming's control, the figure of the World Tree began to slowly shrink. The branches and vines piercing deep into the void were being pulled out bit by bit, like silk being unwound from a cocoon.
Each time a root was lifted, the Three Realms Immortal Boat trembled as if its heartstrings were being plucked.
In the void, the Space Power seemed to be summoned by some force, surging and forming chaotic space whirlpools, like waves whipped up by a fierce wind.
With a thought, Yuan Ming gently opened the space gate of the Shura Palace, revealing a deep entrance.
He cautiously maneuvered the roots of the World Tree, slowly extending them toward that entrance.
When the first root pierced through a barren plain in the Shura Palace, a torrent of nature's spiritual energy surged into this space like a flood.
The once withered flowers, grass, and trees seemed to be called to life, instantly flourishing with vibrant vitality—green leaves lush and wildflowers blooming, with a fragrant scent filling the air.
As the second, third, and fourth roots successively struck down, the entire Shura Palace seemed to experience a life awakening, with every corner brimming with new life and vitality.
Even ordinary people living there could feel the wind around them becoming fresher and more pleasant, with an indescribable comfort and joy pervading the air.
As the master of the Shura Palace, Yuan Ming could feel this earth-shattering change even more deeply.
He looked at the scene before him, the joy in his heart was almost beyond words, as if seeing the powerful hope of his future.
The space of the Shura Palace also emitted a loud rumble, seemingly celebrating this significant transformation.
The Space Power quickly became firm and stable, with the range continuously expanding, heralding a new era for the Shura Palace.
Suddenly, a loud shout came from afar.
Su Wu had already keenly perceived Yuan Ming's intention, his face changing dramatically, as a black light lit up in his Dantian, and rolling black gas surged out like a tide, covering the World Tree.
He once again deployed the Sky Cicada Spirit Domain, attempting to trap the entire World Tree along with Yuan Ming's silver spherical space.
How could Yuan Ming let him succeed?
With a thought, the silver spherical space suddenly shone brilliantly, blocking the invading black gas one by one.
Su Wu's face turned even darker, knowing that if he couldn't stop Yuan Ming, the consequences of the World Tree being taken away would be dire for him.
So, he exerted all his strength, trying to break through the defense of the silver spherical space.
Yuan Ming, not showing any weakness, continued to control the roots of the World Tree penetrating into the Shura Palace while fending off Su Wu's attacks.
The battle between the two became increasingly fierce, and the space whirlpools in the void grew more chaotic, seeming ready to collapse at any moment.
...
Meanwhile.
Sima Changqin had already ventured deep into the underground cavern, where a towering bronze door stood before him.
He scrutinized closely and saw the complex runes on the door and the unique marks on the door rings, causing his brow to furrow slightly.
Though he was not particularly skilled in the art of arrays, he could still see that the forbidden on the bronze door was extraordinary, not far off from the power of a seventh-level restriction.
Attempting to break this restriction on his own power alone was undoubtedly as difficult as climbing to the heavens.
"It seems I have no other choice!"
A gleam of determination flashed in Sima Changqin's eyes as he then took out a set of blue array flags, quickly arranging them in front of the bronze door.
In no time, a blue array took shape, emitting a faint glow.
Sima Changqin took a deep breath and used his Mana to activate the array.
Suddenly, a deep blue light erupted from the center of the array, transforming into streams of extreme cold, striking violently at the bronze door.
The bronze door swiftly became coated with white frost, which then solidified into a layer of blue ice crystals, tightly enveloping the entire door.
Yet, the restriction seemed unaware, continuing to operate quietly.
"As expected, it's still not enough."
Sima Changqin sighed lightly, a trace of helplessness crossing his face.
He flipped his hand to take out a blue Spirit Talisman, which emanated an astonishing aura of the Power of Dao, seemingly containing endless mysteries.
His eyes flashed with a hint of reluctance, but in the end, he raised his hand and tossed the Spirit Talisman into the blue array.
Upon entering the array, the Spirit Talisman immediately shattered, transforming into a dazzling blue light.
The cold energy emitted by the array swelled several times, freezing the forbidden on the bronze door, causing it to cease shimmering.
"Explode!"
Sima Changqin uttered in a low voice, forming a seal and pointing out.
Instantly, the blue ice crystals on the bronze door exploded with a crack, scattering into icy debris.
The restriction also disintegrated in that moment, revealing the original appearance of the bronze door.
A gleam of joy appeared in Sima Changqin's eyes; with a twist of his wrist, he pulled out a blue long sword.
The sword's blade gleamed with a chilling luster, exuding a sinister aura.
He wielded the long sword, slashing left and right at the bronze door, sending a cross-shaped sword light shooting toward the door.
With a crisp "crack" sound, a gap split open at the bottom of the bronze door, revealing a black, pitch-dark opening inside.
Dim light flickered within the cave entrance, as if hiding some earth-shattering secret.
Sima Changqin felt a surge of joy in his heart and immediately leapt into the cave entrance.
Inside, the cave was dark and profound, yet he seemed to see through everything, advancing steadily.
Soon, he arrived at a vast stone chamber.
The stone chamber spanned a hundred yards, meticulously and orderly arranged, with massive display shelves.
Various treasures were arranged on the shelves, some radiant, some ancient and plain, but all exuded an extraordinary aura.
Sima Changqin's eyes brightened, just as he was about to carefully inspect these treasures, he suddenly noticed a figure lying on the ground near a wooden shelf on his side.
His heart jolted, and he stepped forward for a closer look, only to find the figure somehow familiar.
"Who's there?" he asked in a low voice, but the person showed no reaction, lying motionless.
Sima Changqin's Divine Thought flowed like water within the stone chamber, and as it swept over the figure on the ground, his brows furrowed slightly.
He quickly walked over, and upon seeing the person's face clearly, he couldn't help but be startled.
It turned out the unconscious person was Yan Jue.
"How could he be here?" Sima Changqin felt a wave of inexplicable doubt.
Sima Changqin reached out a finger, gently placing it on Yan Jue's pulse, slowly injecting a stream of Mana, attempting to awaken him.
Yet Yan Jue seemed utterly lifeless, showing no reaction.
His breath was still there, weak yet tenacious.
Sima Changqin's eyes flickered, realizing Yan Jue must have had his consciousness sealed by someone's Divine Skills.
This place, located deep within the cave, was unreachable by ordinary people. Who else could seal Yan Jue here, if not the mysterious cave master?
Thinking of this, Sima Changqin ceased his attempt to wake Yan Jue, turning his gaze towards the surrounding wooden shelves.
The wooden shelves were filled with dazzling treasures, ores, spirit wood, elixirs, and spiritual treasures.
"Nine Yang Wood, Netherworld Grass, Ten Thousand Water Essence Jade..." Sima Changqin murmured the names while browsing the treasures.
These spiritual materials were mostly of Sixth Grade, with occasional Seventh Grade pieces. The spiritual treasures and elixirs were also remarkable, some of which he hadn't even seen during the earlier trial steps.
His heart swelled with joy; any one of these treasures could cause a sensation in the outside world.
Moreover, here was an entire stone chamber filled with such treasures.
Sima Changqin took a deep breath, calming his excitement, then raised his hand, and a vast swath of white light surged from his sleeves, swiftly sweeping over the treasures on the display shelves.
In his eyes, these treasures were precious resources, and he intended to take them all.
Just then, Sima Changqin sensed a subtle spatial fluctuation.
He spun around with alarming speed, his gaze fixed on another wooden shelf on the opposite side of the chamber, where a purple Jade Box had been, now vanished into thin air.
Sima Changqin furrowed his brows; his Divine Sense was already spread throughout the chamber, and such a minor change did not escape his observation.
He understood that someone had tampered with something here.
"Which Fellow Daoist is here?"
He asked sternly, but the chamber remained silent.
Sima Changqin felt a chill in his heart, certain that besides himself and the unconscious Yan Jue, someone else was present.
He snorted coldly, waving his sleeve toward the direction where the Jade Box had been.
Instantly, a ripple surged through the void, large swaths of green spirit light appeared indiscriminately, striking toward that location.
The area where the Jade Box had been was engulfed by explosive sounds, nearby wooden shelves shattered, and even the space showed subtle ripples.
Yet despite all this, the purple Jade Box was nowhere to be seen.
Sima Changqin grew increasingly puzzled, knowing he might have encountered a formidable opponent today.
Before long, a figure emerged from the aftermath of his attack, none other than Wulu.
Due to Sima Changqin's rapid and wide-ranging attack, Wulu failed to evade in time and suffered considerable injury.
The Mana within him became chaotic, unable to maintain the Concealment effect of the Heavenly Escape Stone Talisman, forced to reveal himself.
"It's you!" Sima Changqin instantly recognized Wulu, a trace of surprise flashing in his eyes.
Wulu had no intention of conversing, quickly stabilizing his Mana, and once again activating the Heavenly Escape Stone Talisman, disappearing from Sima Changqin's sight.
"Dare to snatch things from me, quite bold!"
A glint of coldness flashed in Sima Changqin's eyes. Raising his hand, two blue finger shadows shot out like lightning, directed at the nearby void.
Just when Wulu was hit by the green light, Sima Changqin had quietly attached a special Mana mark on him.
Now, this mark came into effect, causing Wulu's figure to reappear in the void, forcibly struck by Sima Changqin's finger shadows, heavily slamming into the stone wall behind.
He struggled to rise, blood oozing from the corner of his mouth, but his life was not at risk.

chapters.title: Chapter 998 - 963: Ancestor Bing Lan
chapters.content:
Sima Changqin showed a hint of surprise upon seeing this.
His Heavenly Wind Finger was his proud skill, imbued with the True Meaning of Dao, and yet it failed to kill a Returning to Void cultivator.
Just as he prepared to unleash a more powerful killing move to slay Wulu, his expression suddenly changed, and he turned his head towards Yan Jue.
There at Yan Jue's position, an unexpected change occurred. Innumerable blue light clusters emerged from the void, converging into a blue vortex that swiftly entered his body.
Accompanied by a dull sound of exhaling, Yan Jue's eyes abruptly opened, shooting out two sharp beams of light. He propped himself up with his arms and stood up from the ground.
"Yan Jue?" Sima Changqin called out tentatively.
"Is it you? It's unexpected that you would arrive here, lucky indeed." Yan Jue moved his hands and feet, as if familiarizing himself with the body, and looked at Sima Changqin with a low tone.
"You are the Inspector!" Sima Changqin was slightly startled, then spoke with a confident tone.
"Good eyesight, but unfortunately your skills fall short, no match for those two outside." The Inspector shook his head slightly, seemingly disdainful of Sima Changqin's strength.
"You just blew yourself up and died, why are you possessing Yan Jue's body?" Sima Changqin frowned and asked, filled with confusion.
"You are not the master of the Three Realms Immortal Boat, so I don't need to explain much to you."
The Inspector glanced at the two empty shelves, and said indifferently, "This is also not a place you should be, withdraw. I will overlook the treasures you've taken as your fate."
Sima Changqin heard this and sneered, "Heh, you can't beat Su Wu, and now you want to vent your anger on me? You just possessed Yan Jue's body, even if you can fully unleash Yan Jue's power, you are merely at the Returning to Void peak, and you wish to meddle with me?"
The Inspector glanced at Sima Changqin through his eyes and said faintly, "I will not repeat my words a second time."
Sima Changqin's blue long sword in his right hand glowed brightly, instantly slashing out countless sword lights filled with cold air, overwhelming towards the Inspector.
These sword lights were like a winter blizzard, carrying a bone-chilling coldness, pressing straight towards the Inspector.
The Inspector didn't even look at the oncoming sword lights. With a mere lift of his hand, a large area of silver light emerged on the secret chamber walls.
The light rapidly converged into a silver formation, appearing out of nowhere, blocking all the sword lights.
At the same time, the formation's light enveloped Sima Changqin, seemingly intending to trap him.
"Stubborn." The Inspector said faintly, with a hint of disdain in his tone.
Before Sima Changqin could make another move, the Inspector had already wielded a divine skill with a wave of his hand.
Amidst the flickering silver light, Sima Changqin's vision was filled with a strong light. When the light faded, he found himself in a vast range of towering mountains.
As he looked around, mountain ranges stretched endlessly, enshrouded in clouds and mist, resembling a splash-ink landscape painting.
And above him, a giant silver-white ship sped by, unmistakably the Three Realms Flying Boat.Follow current ɴᴏᴠᴇʟs on NoᴠᴇFɪre.nᴇt
"Damn it!" Sima Changqin cursed inwardly.
He hadn't anticipated that the Inspector, even after changing bodies, could still activate such a powerful formation.
With his mind racing, he quickly formed a spell and summoned the silver-white flying car, chasing after the Three Realms Flying Boat.
Although he had gained considerably from the treasury, Sima Changqin's losses were equally severe.
His minions, the Black Demons, were all lost, and his Innate Spiritual Treasure was also taken. How could he be reconciled with all this?
The speed of the Three Realms Immortal Boat far exceeded the silver flying car, and even though Sima Changqin pursued relentlessly, the giant ship quickly vanished from his sight.
Sima Changqin did not stop his chase, glaring hatefully in the direction where the Three Realms Immortal Boat had disappeared, contemplating his next strategy.
At that moment, a white light suddenly shone from his body.
Sima Changqin took out a Jade Talisman from his bosom, the talisman exuding cold energy, constantly flashing with spirit light as if it had been triggered by something.
"Ancestor Bing Lan!" Sima Changqin showed a look of delight, eagerly injecting mana into the Jade Talisman.
The spirit light on the Jade Talisman grew several times brighter, flickering incessantly, as if summoning something.
Sima Changqin ceased to move, hovering in the air.
A moment later, the sky suddenly darkened, and snowflakes as large as goose feathers fluttered down, quickly covering everything around in frost white.
The fierce wind swept through the forest, carrying cold air. The snowstorm was so overwhelming that it blinded people.
Standing in mid-air, Sima Changqin's figure trembled slightly, seemingly invaded by the endless cold.
The endless frost spread wantonly across the land, wherever it reached, whether flowers, grass, or wild beasts, were instantly frozen, turning into lifelike ice sculptures standing on the earth.
At this moment, between heaven and earth, it seemed nothing but ice and snow existed, the sky and ground blended into a seamless white, with no distinction between you and me.
The myriad snowflakes, like curtains, shrouded all living things behind, revealing nothing.
And amidst the wind and snow, a pale blue figure slowly stepped forward.
He walked barefoot, his ice-crystal-like eyes full of gentle intent, and with long, frost-white hair hung loosely, his azure robe slightly thin, fluttering in the wind, yet exuding an Immortal-like transcendental aura.
Sima Changqin didn't need to extend his Divine Sense to know who had arrived.
He immediately turned around and cupped his fists, bowing respectfully: "Welcome, Ancestor."
His tone was full of awe and humility.
Snow stretched on for thirty thousand miles, ice sealing nineteen states.
This was not due to a change in the world, but the power inadvertently released by a Mahayana cultivator.
In the Chuyun Realm, only one person could create such a spectacle—Great Mahayana Ancestor Bing Lan.
"Chang Qin, I have told you before, there's no need for such formalities," Ancestor Bing Lan said blandly.
Although his voice was gentle, it carried an undeniable authority.
"With the Ancestor personally visiting, Chang Qin dares not be disrespectful," Sima Changqin replied respectfully, before finally raising his head.
Standing before him was a man even younger and more handsome than himself.
"Ancestor, weren't you in seclusion cultivating in the Heavenly Saint Tower? How come you've suddenly arrived here?" Sima Changqin asked respectfully, with a hint of confusion.
Ancestor Bing Lan gave a faint smile and said: "I have been out of seclusion for some time. Recently, I have been busy handling Three Realms Sect matters in Wuliang City. Upon receiving your message stating you discovered traces of the Three Realms Immortal Boat, I came immediately. I didn't find any trace in the Fire Rock Desert previously, so I followed your aura here. Where is the Three Realms Immortal Boat now? How did you end up in this isolated place?"
As he spoke, his gaze was sharp, scanning the surroundings as if seeking clues.
Sima Changqin looked ashamed, lowering his head as he said: "Disciple is incompetent, disappointing the Ancestor. I had already penetrated the core area of the Three Realms Immortal Boat, and was about to pass the test to take control of it. However, I unexpectedly encountered a Body Cultivation with an Undying Body level, whose strength was overwhelming, and I was defeated. Later, I met Su Wu of the Three Realms Sect, who attempted to seize the Immortal Boat, and I was defeated again. In the end, I ran into the Immortal Boat's Artifact Spirit Inspector and was expelled."
Upon hearing this, Ancestor Bing Lan sighed lightly and consoled: "You need not blame yourself excessively. Body Cultivation is proficient in physical combat, so being defeated by one is understandable. As for that Su Wu, being a disciple of the former Sect Hierarch of the Three Realms Sect, naturally he has some means. Being able to retreat unscathed is already an achievement."
Upon hearing this, Sima Changqin felt a bit more at ease, and his expression improved.
Ancestor Bing Lan asked no more, and instead inquired: "Do you know where the Three Realms Immortal Boat has headed now?"
Sima Changqin raised his head to look into the distance and said: "It seems to be heading towards White Emperor City."
Upon hearing this, Ancestor Bing Lan's face darkened, and he said: "White Emperor City... not good, we must hurry there quickly!"
As his words fell, he prepared to set off.
Seeing this, Sima Changqin urgently asked: "Ancestor, is there something amiss with the Three Realms Immortal Boat going to White Emperor City?"
Ancestor Bing Lan said solemnly: "No time to explain, we must reach White Emperor City before them. There's no time to lose, follow me!"
With that, he waved his sleeve, and a gentle force enveloped Sima Changqin, and the two of them disappeared in a flash.
When they reappeared, they were already thousands of miles away.
Ancestor Bing Lan did not pause, continuing to chant spells, his figure flashing again, covering another thousand miles.
His heart was anxious, only wanting to reach White Emperor City quickly to prevent the potential disaster brought by the Three Realms Immortal Boat.
...
Elsewhere, with Sima Changqin's departure, the hidden chamber returned to silence.
The Artifact Spirit Inspector did not dispel the silver formation he had summoned, but instead, his sharp gaze was cast towards another corner of the chamber.
"Stop hiding and reveal yourself," he said calmly, his voice carrying a subtle, undeniable authority.
After two breaths, the chamber remained silent as if empty.
"Are you planning to follow in Sima Changqin's footsteps?" The Artifact Spirit Inspector's tone carried a hint of displeasure.
As his words just fell, Wulu reluctantly released the invisibility state, revealing himself.
He cupped his hands towards the Artifact Spirit Inspector, his expression showing both respect and fear.
He had just attempted to use the Invisibility Technique to quietly escape the chamber. However, the Artifact Spirit Inspector's gaze remained sharp, firmly locked onto him, leaving him with no choice but to abandon his hopeful thoughts.
"Is the Ten Thousand Poison Three Treasures of the Ancestor of Ten Thousand Poisons currently in your hands?" The Artifact Spirit Inspector asked directly, paying no mind to Wulu's attitude.
Although it was a question, his tone conveyed an undeniable certainty.
"Is this what Senior is referring to?" Wulu asked carefully as he took out the purple Jade Box he had just taken.
The Artifact Spirit Inspector touched a spot in the air, and the Jade Box opened automatically, revealing a dark purple Dragon Pattern Small Tripod and a small purple banner inside.
"So this is it..." Wulu's face showed delight.
He originally only wanted to follow Sima Changqin invisibly, not intending to expose himself. However, upon sensing a resonance with a treasure inside the Jade Box connected to the Ten Thousand Gods Poison Dagger, his greed led him to rashly take action and obtain the Jade Box.
However, the Jade Box was covered with a Forbidden technique, and his previous attempts to unlock it had failed.
"If Senior intends to have it, this junior will readily offer it with both hands," Wulu quickly said as thoughts raced through his mind. He also took out the Ten Thousand Gods Poison Dagger and placed it inside the Jade Box.

chapters.title: Chapter 999 - 964: The True Plot
chapters.content:
Jie Cha gazed at Wulu, and said lightly, "What do I need these things for? It's just that back in the day, there was a connection between the Ancestor of Ten Thousand Poisons and me. Seeing someone inherit his legacy today settles a matter in my heart. You can take the Ten Thousand Gods Poison Cauldron and the Ten Thousand Gods Poison Banner with you as well. The Ancestor of Ten Thousand Poisons was an extraordinary figure back then; do not tarnish his reputation."
Upon hearing this, Wulu secretly breathed a sigh of relief in his heart and promptly assured, "Rest assured, senior, I will make sure the name of the Ancestor of Ten Thousand Poisons resounds once more in the Chuyun Realm."
Jie Cha nodded and said no more, raising a hand to gather all the remaining treasures in the secret chamber.
"Where would you like to go, senior?" Wulu asked quickly upon seeing the situation.
"For many years, I've been the helmsman of the Three Realms Immortal Boat. Now, by self-destruction and funeral, I have concluded a karma. From now on, with the vastness of the world, naturally, I can go anywhere," Jie Cha said calmly.
"But senior, such a divine artifact as the Three Realms Immortal Boat, if you are not present, won't it soon fall into the hands of the Three Realms Sect's demonic practitioners? They are in collusion with the Demon Clan; if they acquire the Three Realms Immortal Boat, it will surely endanger the safety of the Chuyun Realm," Wulu panicked, hastily advising.
In his heart, he also harbored a thought: Yuan Ming was still outside, and if Jie Cha left like this, Yuan Ming's situation would indeed be unfortunate.
Jie Cha, discerning like observing fire, saw through Wulu's thoughts and said lightly, "You said so much, but actually, you just want me to help that boy with the last name Wan to seize the Three Realms Immortal Boat, right?"
Wulu, being seen through, showed a look of embarrassment, but still frankly said, "I dare not deceive the senior. I do have such an intention. It's not entirely out of selfishness. My friend there is someone with great fortune, exceptional talent, and profound cultivation. If he could wield the Three Realms Immortal Boat, he certainly wouldn't demean this treasure."
"What you say might be true. However, the Three Realms Immortal Boat was originally created by the Three Realms Sect, so it is fitting to fall into the hands of the Three Realms Sect descendants now. Whether it will be used for the Demon Clan or the Chuyun Realm is the decision of the Three Realms Sect descendants and has nothing to do with me," Jie Cha shook his head and said.
At that moment, suddenly, a loud "rumbling" sound burst out in the secret chamber, and the void around Wulu shook and trembled violently, seemingly about to collapse at any moment.ʀᴇᴀᴅ ʟᴀᴛᴇsᴛ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀᴛ NovᴇlFɪre.ɴet
"This place is about to completely collapse soon. We can't stay here any longer. Follow me," Jie Cha finished speaking and, without waiting for Wulu to respond, raised his hand to activate the silver formation, taking Wulu with him, disappearing from the secret chamber.
...
White Emperor City.
On the horizon, splendid crimson clouds burned like fierce fire, painting the sky a deep red, while silver light flickered between the mountains as if stars were falling, casting warm rays and dispelling surrounding darkness, leaving no place for any evil to hide.
This White Emperor City was like a majestic heavenly palace, yet to fully reveal its city silhouette, already emanating an aura of awe to subdue the mountains and suppress a myriad of demons.
The sunrise just rose, the golden sunlight shining on the city walls, glittering brilliantly, adding to its sanctity and solemnity.
Inside the city, it was bustling early on, the shopkeepers busy cleaning up their stores, getting ready to welcome new customers for the day, seller cries echoing one after another in the streets, mixed with some innocent childlike voices.
Cultivators setting out to hunt demons walked out of the city in high spirits, their figures appearing more agile in the morning light.
A new day, the entire White Emperor City was brimming with vitality and exuberance.
And at a place ten thousand miles away from White Emperor City, suddenly came a loud "rumbling" noise.
A massive Three Realms Immortal Boat was seen racing forward, its hull flickering with dazzling light, cutting through the sky, leaving a long trail behind.
Above the ship's hull, a sudden wave of fluctuations appeared in the void, and Jie Cha and Wulu appeared out of thin air.
As they steadied themselves, they saw the silvery-white giant boat rapidly moving away, heading straight towards White Emperor City.
"Is that giant ship the body of the Three Realms Immortal Boat? Why did it suddenly start moving, and who is controlling it?" Wulu watched the silver-white giant boat gradually moving further away, revealing a puzzled look on his face.
Jie Cha looked at the distant Three Realms Immortal Boat, showing a relaxed smile on his face, explaining, "The people of the Three Realms Sect have been scheming for this immortal boat for a long time, naturally having backup moves. Though the master of the immortal boat hasn't been decided yet, it doesn't mean it cannot be controlled."
"Could it be those two women controlling the Three Realms Immortal Boat? No wonder they didn't come down with us earlier. Judging by the direction the immortal boat is flying, it seems to be heading to White Emperor City. What do they plan to do in White Emperor City?" Wulu's curiosity grew deeper, and he couldn't help but ask.
"Their goal is simple, to crash and break the Pillar Hongjun and destroy the Heavenly Crane Array," Jie Cha chuckled and said.
"Pillar Hongjun? I have lived in White Emperor City for quite some time, yet I have never heard of this Hongjun Pillar," Wulu's face was full of confusion.
"This Hongjun Pillar is the greatest secret of the Ten Thousand Demon Nineteen Cities. Your cultivation is still shallow, so naturally, you wouldn't know. The world is full of conflicts, just as there's the eternal strife between the Chuyun Realm and the Demon World; the strife between the Human Clan and the Demon Clan within the Chuyun Realm has never ceased. Tens of thousands of years ago, the battle between humans and demons finally ended with the Demon Clan's defeat. The only surviving Great Mahayana Demon Emperor of the Demon Clan, in his dying moments, threatened to completely destroy the Chuyun Realm, forcing the Human Clan's great Mahayana ancestors to swear, allowing the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range to be the dwelling place for the Demon Clan, without utterly annihilating them," Jie Cha said nonchalantly, unsurprised.
"I have read about this in the classics, that the Human Clan's great Mahayana ancestor finally agreed to this demand, which allowed the Ten Thousand Demon Country to be passed down. However, was there another plot involved?" Wulu nodded and said.
"Of course, the Human Clan would not easily let go of the Demon Clan. After the Demon Emperor's death, although the Human Clan's great Mahayana couldn't eradicate the Demon Clan due to the oath, they secretly built nineteen cities in the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range, which are now known as the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range Nineteen Cities. Each city beneath has a Pillar Hongjun connected to the underground Spirit Vein, forming a Heavenly Crane Array that encompasses the entire mountain range. This array collects all the Spirit Veins under the Human Clan's control, thoroughly suppressing the Demon Clan," Jie Cha continued.
"Is that so? So the history of those Nineteen Cities in the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range is like this," Wulu's eyes lit up, unable to help but sigh.
Jie Cha continued to speak at length: "Moreover, this Heavenly Crane Array possesses the miraculous ability to suppress fortune. Even if the Demon Clan utilizes Spiritual Vein Power to cultivate to the level of a Sixth-level Demon King, they ultimately cannot advance further and cannot train a true Level 7 Demon Emperor. This is the true intention of the Human Clan's Mahayana; they want to bind the Demon Clan forever in the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range."
Upon hearing this, Wulu suddenly realized and sighed deeply: "No wonder there has been no news of a Level 7 Great Demon emerging in the Chuyun Realm for tens of thousands of years, it turns out to be suppressed by this Heavenly Crane Array."
Jie Cha nodded, a hint of seriousness flashing in his eyes: "The Heavenly Crane Array is designed by a Mahayana master, and each Hongjun Stone Pillar is incredibly sturdy. Unless a Mahayana master personally takes action, there is no way to break it. Therefore, just relying on the Ten Thousand Demon Country's current power to want to destroy this Heavenly Crane Array is undoubtedly a pipe dream."
Wulu's heart stirred as if he realized something: "I understand! This treasure-seeking operation in the Fire Rock Desert is actually a conspiracy between the Ten Thousand Demon Country and the Three Realms Sect. From the start, the Ten Thousand Demon Country had no intent to seek the Heavenly Fire nor wanted to seize the Three Realms Immortal Boat. All of this was simply to present a gift to the Three Realms Sect, and in return, the Three Realms Sect would help them destroy the Heavenly Crane Array, allowing them to break free from the Human Clan's control completely!"
Jie Cha looked at Wulu, a trace of admiration flashing in his eyes: "You're quite clever, realizing it in one go."
Wulu, however, did not feel relieved because of this. Instead, he became extremely anxious: "Senior, we absolutely cannot sit idly by and let the Demon Clan's plot succeed. Otherwise, once the Heavenly Crane Array is destroyed, the Chuyun Realm will surely fall into chaos, and the Demon Clan might take the opportunity to invade. At that time, if war breaks out, countless lives will perish, and it will be our fault!"
He had lived in White Emperor City for many years, where his friends resided, and he could not imagine such a disaster befalling it.
Jie Cha, however, merely shrugged and laughed heartily: "That's something for you to worry about, it has nothing to do with me. I was trapped inside the Three Realms Immortal Boat by Gongshu Lingren for countless years, finally breaking free, and I intend to enjoy some freedom."
Saying this, he laughed and flew away into the distance, leaving Wulu standing there, helpless.
At this moment, a raspy voice suddenly sounded: "Wanting comfort? It's not up to you!"
As the voice fell, a burst of white light emerged around Jie Cha, completely enveloping him.
Jie Cha's body instantly became immobile, his face changed dramatically.
The void near the white light split open, forming a spatial passage, and an old blind man with a cane walked out from it.
His entirely white eyes saw nothing, yet seemed to perceive everything.
"Xia Jie, it's you!" Jie Cha exclaimed in surprise, evidently not expecting to encounter this old man here.
Meanwhile, Wulu, upon discerning who it was, was overjoyed: "Senior, it's you!"
Xia Jie nodded, scanning Wulu with his all-white eyes and said: "Your cultivation progress is not bad, but why have you switched to cultivating the technique of that Ten Thousand Poisons? Abandoned the Void Thought Technique I taught you? Though this technique seems unorthodox, at a high level it is no less than any technique in the Chuyun Realm."
"The senior's reprimand is justified. But after I broke through to the Returning Void Realm, I needed a Five Elements simultaneous cultivation technique to advance my cultivation. Although the Void Thought Technique is exquisite, it can only regulate the different species magic power within, without any use for advancing cultivation, so I was forced to abandon it," Wulu replied with his head down.
Hearing this, Xia Jie's brows slightly furrowed as he said: "Foolish! The essence of the Void Thought Technique lies in refining various mana, who told you it was limited to internal use? This technique can also refine external spiritual power. Watch carefully."
As he spoke, an open-minded aura emanated from him, the surrounding nature's spiritual energy seemingly summoned, surged like a tide, merging into his body.

chapters.title: Chapter 1000 - 965: The Cauldron Appears
chapters.content:
Wulu watched the scene happening on Xia Jie, and was stunned as if struck by thunder, standing there with his mouth agape.
He had never imagined that the Void Thought Technique could have such a wonderful use.
Xia Jie ignored Wulu's shock and continued, "Enough, your mind is resilient, but your aptitude is somewhat lacking. Come with me, I'll guide you for a while longer."
After speaking, he led Jie Cha towards the space portal.
Jie Cha, seeing this, shouted in anger, "Xia Jie, where are you taking me? I'm the Artifact Spirit of the Three Realms Immortal Boat; I have no intention of meddling in your battle with the Demon World."
Wulu also snapped back to reality and hurriedly said, "Senior, the Three Realms Immortal Boat intends to destroy the Stone Pillar Hongjun of White Emperor City, ruining the Heavenly Crane Array. I am too weak, and I beg for your assistance!"
Xia Jie's steps hesitated slightly, and a trace of complex expression flashed across his face, but he quickly returned to calm.
He said lightly, "It's not yet time for me to appear."
After finishing, he took Jie Cha and flew into the space portal without looking back.
Wulu looked in the direction where the two disappeared, then glanced towards White Emperor City, gritted his teeth, stomped, and flew into the space portal.
...
Inside the Three Realms Immortal Boat.
In the land of volcanoes, lava rolled over, and the various Demon Kings and Demon Generals from the Ten Thousand Demon Country were gathered here, the atmosphere solemn and tense.
Wu Yu suddenly felt something, she raised her hand and summoned a copper mirror from the void.
She lightly pressed a spell, and spirit light flowed over the copper mirror, gradually forming an image.
In the image, the Three Realms Immortal Boat was speeding along, quickly approaching the direction of White Emperor City.
Seeing this, all the demons looked over, expressions of anticipation in their eyes.
The Black Bear King was even more delighted, saying, "That Light Pillar… it's definitely White Emperor City! The Three Realms Immortal Boat is heading toward White Emperor City; everything seems to be going according to plan, that's great!"
Several other Demon Kings also showed joy and nodded in agreement.
Wu Yu's eyes flashed with a hint of joy, but it was quickly suppressed.
She communicated with the ground in a low voice, "Is everything ready? We are about to reach White Emperor City; everything must be ready."
A red shadow flickered on the ground, and the figure of the Great Sun Glaze Flame slowly appeared.
She looked at the image on the copper mirror and said indifferently, "Hasn't the Three Realms Sect already set the Three Realms Immortal Boat in motion? What do you have to worry about?"
The Black Bear King and other Demon Kings saw the Great Sun Glaze Flame appear and halted their conversation.
"The affairs of my Ten Thousand Demon Country are of great importance, and not a single mistake can be afforded. Moreover, for some reason, I have a bad premonition, so we must prepare for contingencies." Wu Yu shook her head, frowning slightly.
"A bad premonition? Didn't you calculate that Su Wu, holding great fortune, can surely seize the Three Realms Immortal Boat? Now White Emperor City is nearby, the collision of the Three Realms Immortal Boat with the Pillar Hongjun is already set, what could change the situation?" The Great Sun Glaze Flame said with a look of surprise.
"Reasonably, that's correct, but as for Wan Tianren, I can never see through him or calculate him. His escape from Xihe Palace was completely beyond my expectations, and his ascent of a thousand steps almost made me think I miscalculated. Things have developed to the point where many aspects have already escaped my control." Wu Yu's face turned slightly dark as she spoke slowly.
Upon hearing this, the Great Sun Glaze Flame also fell silent, recalling the confrontation with Yuan Ming in the Xihe Palace, and felt a moment of fear.
After a while, she said solemnly, "That boy is indeed strange, I used almost all of my strength in Xihe Palace, yet still couldn't handle him. Moreover, even the Bright Soul Fire has submitted to him; he definitely harbors great secrets."
"Therefore, we must prepare for failure. Although I hope everything goes smoothly, we must guard against any unexpected situations." Wu Yu nodded in acknowledgment.
The Great Sun Glaze Flame raised the Fiery Sun Pearl in her hand and said, "Rest assured, I have refined the Fiery Sun Pearl as per your plan, ready for use at any moment. Should the Three Realms Immortal Boat encounter any problem, I will immediately detonate the Fiery Sun Pearl, utterly destroying White Emperor City."
Upon hearing this, Wu Yu felt slightly reassured.
She looked up toward the direction of the Silver Tower, the control hub of the Three Realms Immortal Boat, and muttered to herself, "Let's hope nothing goes wrong."
...
Deep within the Silver Tower Space's cave, the dim light could only sketch out vague outlines.
The World Tree quietly stood, shrouded by the Sky Cicada Spirit Domain, Yuan Ming only felt his body suddenly become Heavy, as if falling into a deep sea, surrounded by oppressive and Heavy atmosphere.
He was not encountering the Divine Skills of the Spirit Domain for the first time; Sima Changqin had also displayed them in the past, but the power of Su Wu's Spirit Domain far surpassed the former.
At this moment, he seemed to be bound by intangible shackles, Mana circulating stiffly, and the transfer of the World Giant Tree halted at this moment.
Su Wu wore a faint sneer at the corner of his mouth, fingers lightly conjuring spell seals, Heavenly Cicada Black Qi surged like tide, fiercely scouring the shell of the silver sphere.
The black sphere quivered amidst sizzling sounds, as the black Qi collided fiercely with the silver spirit light, making ear-piercing noises.
That silver sphere was the barrier of space, exceptionally sturdy, yet under the erosive assault of the Heavenly Cicada Black Qi, its silver shell began to thin gradually.
Just then, the World Giant Tree suddenly emitted a cyan-gray spirit light, primordial Wood Qi continuously flowed out, swiftly repairing the damage on the silver shell.
The duel between the two was like the scales balanced at both ends, neither giving way.
A flash of surprise crossed Su Wu's face, while Yuan Ming was equally shocked.
Although he hadn't cultivated a Spiritual Domain, he had seen records of it in the Classics and had consulted with Xi Ying and Void about the wonders of the Spiritual Domain.ᴜᴘᴅᴀᴛᴇ ꜰʀᴏᴍ ɴovᴇl(F)ɪre.ɴet
The greatest Divine Skills of the Spiritual Domain lie in its absolute suppressive power; once expanded, everything within its scope falls under its control, unless challenged by an equally or more powerful Spiritual Domain.
The giant World Tree in front of him could actually remain unaffected by the Sky Cicada Spirit Domain, which was beyond his imagination.
Yuan Ming quickly regained his composure and attempted to communicate using his own World Tree with the giant World Tree.
Waves of primordial Wood energy surged forth, allowing his World Tree to start freeing itself from the Sky Cicada Spirit Domain's suppression, and the Mana began to slowly flow.
He felt a surge of joy in his heart and manipulated the giant World Tree to continue its transfer into the Shura Palace.
As time passed, more and more roots penetrated deep into the Shura Palace, the vitality of the entire palace became increasingly exuberant. The Spiritual Power was so dense it almost turned liquid, and the space grew increasingly solid, seemingly developing an independent realm.
Outside, Su Wu's face grew increasingly grim.
He realized that despite his best efforts, he was unable to suppress the opponent.
Although losing the World Tree wouldn't shake his control over the Three Realms Immortal Boat, the power of the Three Realms Immortal Boat would be drastically reduced, something he absolutely couldn't tolerate.
He gazed into the silver space where Yuan Ming stood, his eyes flickering with cold determination, as if he had made some kind of resolution.
He clapped his hands together and inhaled sharply, instantly a whirlwind surged from his nostrils, gathering all the Heavenly Cicada Black Qi around him and drawing it into his body.
His abdomen swiftly swelled to the limit, as if it would explode at any moment.
Following this, he tilted his head upward and opened his mouth wide, his right hand transformed into a sword finger, slowly sliding along his throat.
"Hulala"
Countless ghostly purple spirit lights were forced out from his mouth, condensing and compressing in mid-air, quickly transforming into a translucent insect egg no larger than a grain of rice.
As the insect egg formed, Su Wu's abdomen deflated, his aura diminished sharply, and he appeared weakened and drained.
At this moment, Yuan Ming heard a sudden warning from Void: "No good, it's the Heavenly Cicada Soul Egg! Kid, pause your retrieval of the World Tree and hide in the Stealing Heaven Tripod!"
Startled, Yuan Ming immediately intended to comply.
However, Su Wu suddenly raised his hand and pointed forward.
The Black Sword instantly appeared above his head, shooting forth with a roar, flashing to the silver sphere and stabbing downward in mid-air.
With a soft "puchi" sound, the silver sphere, which could only be slightly eroded by the Heavenly Cicada Black Qi, was pierced through, creating a large hole.
Yuan Ming's heart trembled violently as he saw the insect egg in mid-air transform into a ghostly purple stream, streaking through the night sky, darting into the large hole and heading straight for the World Tree.
In an instant, the insect egg penetrated layer after layer of the giant World Tree's barriers, like an arrow splitting the air, effortlessly drilling into Yuan Ming's Sea of Consciousness.
Within his Sea of Consciousness, it surged into a tempestuous fury.
Yuan Ming felt a sharp pain, his Soul Power swept away like a storm, uncontrollably surging toward the suddenly appeared insect egg.
Nourished by the Soul Power, the insect egg rapidly grew and hatched, releasing a powerful suction that even caused Yuan Ming's Divine Soul to start trembling, being pulled toward the insect egg bit by bit.
Yuan Ming felt a deep dread, wanting to resist but found his Divine Soul bound by invisible shackles, unable to muster even a trace of Soul Power.
Just as Yuan Ming was about to despair, the Stealing Heaven Tripod suddenly emerged from within him, hovering above his head.
From the tripod's mouth, countless flows of Desire Power sprang forth, transforming into beams of light, shooting straight into Yuan Ming's Sea of Consciousness.
The insect egg seemed to sense something amiss, emitting a piercing cicada screech, unleashing vast swathes of ghostly purple spirit light, attempting to resist the assault of Desire Power.
But the Desire Power stored within the Stealing Heaven Tripod was immense, and despite the continuous dispersion of ghostly purple spirit light, more Desire Power flowed relentlessly.
Encased in the Endless Desire Power, within merely two breaths' time, an egg shell formed from solidified Desire Power enveloped the insect egg, sealing it within securely.
No matter how piercing the cicada's screams, no matter how the ghostly light dashed around wildly, the seal of the Stealing Heaven Tripod remained unshaken.
Yuan Ming's Sea of Consciousness gradually returned to calm, and his Divine Soul was momentarily freed.
Before he could catch his breath, he heard Su Wu suddenly burst into laughter.
"Haha, good, good, good! So you're the mysterious person who approached Su Yingxue. Truly, breaking through iron shoes to find it, only to come across it effortlessly. Seems like this is fate. The Stealing Heaven Tripod is destined to fall into my hands!"
Su Wu's gaze was fixed intently on the Stealing Heaven Tripod suspended above Yuan Ming's head, his eyes gleaming with greed.
Despite his face paled from coughing up the insect egg, now it was flushed with excitement, as if he saw a rare treasure.

chapters.title: Chapter 1001 - 966: Great Wish of All Living Beings
chapters.content:
Yuan Ming's heart sank as he realized his secret had been exposed, but he did not panic.
After years of experience, his strength was no longer weak, and with the World Giant Tree soon in his hands, as long as he didn't face a Mahayana cultivator, he was confident he could keep the Stealing Heaven Tripod.
With this thought, Yuan Ming steadied his mind and continued to manipulate the transfer of the World Giant Tree.
At this moment, Su Wu seemed completely immersed in the joy of obtaining the Stealing Heaven Tripod, ignoring Yuan Ming's actions.
He flipped his right palm, and a round elixir appeared, which he swallowed without hesitation.
The elixir entered his stomach, and his body once again became full, his aura increasing, even stronger than before.
The shadow on his face disappeared, replaced by excitement and anticipation.
At this moment, his eyes were only on the Stealing Heaven Tripod, ignoring everything else.Google seaʀᴄh N0v3l.Fiɾe.net
"This move was supposed to be my trump card for someone else. But for the Stealing Heaven Tripod, it's worth showing it now. You should feel honored!" Su Wu laughed loudly, his sleeves fluttering without wind, and a formidable aura surged forth.
As his laughter subsided, a large mass of Heavenly Cicada Black Qi gushed from him, forming into a thick darkness.
Within this darkness, a black celestial cicada with three pairs of wings slowly emerged.
This creature had a hideous face, filled with slender sharp spikes in its mouth, and its dark eyes seemed like bottomless voids, brimming with endless greed, as though it wanted to devour everything in the world.
"Senior Kong, is this Su Wu's Dharma Form? Can the Stealing Heaven Tripod hold it back?" Yuan Ming felt the powerful pressure emanating from the black celestial cicada's shadow, and his heart tensed. He quickly transmitted his inquiry.
Before Senior Kong could reply, Xi Ying already stood up saying: "Just focus on collecting the World Giant Tree. I will block this strike for you. Open a passage in the Stealing Heaven Tripod Space!"
Her voice was calm and firm, an invisible aura emanating from her, forming a sharp contrast with Su Wu's Heavenly Cicada Dharma Form.
Yuan Ming was surprised by Xi Ying's proactive challenge, but there was no time to ponder. Instinctively, he transmitted his inquiry to Senior Kong. It wasn't that he didn't trust Xi Ying, but Su Wu's strength was almost on par with a Mahayana existence, truly not something Xi Ying could handle.
"This aura... trust Miss Xi." Senior Kong's tone carried a hint of surprise.
Yuan Ming's eyes shifted, and he secretly activated the Stealing Heaven Tripod. Before Xi Ying, the space distorted and suddenly revealed a passage leading to the outside world.
Xi Ying's figure moved, gliding into the passage like a swift swallow, reaching the cave's exterior in an instant.
The spiritual energy from outside surged in like a tide, and the endless Desire Power within the Stealing Heaven Tripod erupted, swirling around Xi Ying, like a brilliant star river flowing incessantly.
The Desire Power contained the purest faith and hope between heaven and earth, gathering into a powerful force.
Seeing Xi Ying's display, a trace of astonishment and confusion flashed in Su Wu's eyes.
His spell did not stop, and the giant celestial cicada's shadow gradually solidified, its wings poised to fly, carrying a bizarre and powerful aura directly towards Yuan Ming and Xi Ying.
A mountain-crushing pressure descended from above, mixed with the Power of Dao, even the World Giant Tree could not withstand it, easily penetrating within.
In an instant, Yuan Ming felt numb all over, his mana, Qi-blood, and even soul power pulled by this strange aura, as if wanting to burst out of his body.
In this critical moment, Xi Ying slowly spoke, her voice soft, as though murmuring to herself: "Greedy and filthy bloodthirsty worm, this is not a place for you to run wild, leave quickly!"
As her words fell, the once noisy sound in the cave instantly vanished, leaving only Xi Ying's gentle and firm voice echoing.
That voice grew louder, like a giant bell tolling, shaking the entire underground cave.
At the same time, the Desire Power around Xi Ying ignited, transforming into a fiery sea.
An irresistible force descended in the cave, stopping the colossal celestial cicada's shadow in its tracks.
"Is this... speak and follow?"
Yuan Ming stared in shock at the scene, a surge of indescribable astonishment welling up inside him.
He had heard of the Life Witch's power, but never witnessed such an astonishing sight.
Su Wu seemed to realize something, a look of fear appearing in his eyes.
In mid-air, Xi Ying's expression remained calm, her hands rising slowly as she softly uttered: "May the magic of the Human Clan here not harm them, may no disasters hurt them!"
As her voice fell, Yuan Ming felt his body lighten, his mana and soul power, once suppressed by Su Wu's Spiritual Domain, instantly restored.
Overjoyed, he quickened his pace to transfer the World Giant Tree into the Shura Palace.
Meanwhile, Xi Ying's voice continued to reverberate in the cave: "May all evil spirits here face endless tribulations!"
As soon as her words ended, Su Wu let out a muffled groan, spitting a mouthful of black blood, his aura rapidly declining.
His Sky Cicada Spirit Domain emitted a loud bang, shattering into pieces instantly, and the gigantic celestial cicada Dharma Form collapsed, dissipating into countless black qi in the air.
"Great Wish of All Beings!"
Su Wu cried out in horror. At this moment, he couldn't care less about his injuries and turned to flee into the distance.
Yuan Ming was also shaken when he heard Su Wu's terrified scream.
Ever since he knew that the Divine Skills on the Creation Heaven List could help him comprehend the True Meaning of Dao, he had studied the skills on the list in detail.
Among them, the Great Wish of All Beings was included and ranked second, even above the Five Elements Dao Fruit. It was unexpected that Xi Ying would be able to—
While Yuan Ming was in shock, Xi Ying spoke again, "May the bloodthirsty and murderous perish, body and soul!"
As her words fell, Su Wu's body, fleeing in the distance, suddenly exploded, turning into a rain of blood, and his presence completely vanished.
Staring blankly at the spot where Su Wu disappeared, Yuan Ming was dumbfounded.
He never imagined that such a powerful existence as Su Wu would fall after enduring only three attacks from the Great Wish of All Beings.
At this moment, Xi Ying's body suddenly trembled, and blood flowed from her seven apertures.
Her aura plummeted rapidly, and she fell directly from mid-air.
Yuan Ming was shocked, disregarding the state of the Sea of Consciousness insect eggs, and hurriedly flew forward to catch Xi Ying in his arms.
At this moment, Xi Ying's aura was extremely weak, her Divine Soul was declining, and she couldn't even maintain her consciousness, completely slipping into a coma.
Yuan Ming quickly took out two healing pills and made Xi Ying swallow them.
After the Undying Tree transformed into the World Tree, the originally healing Undying Demon Qi had disappeared, so he could only circulate his mana to assist in refining the elixirs and activate several healing talismans.
After a period of busy effort, Xi Ying's condition barely stabilized, but she did not wake up.
Yuan Ming was still full of worries in his heart, pondering whether there were other methods to heal her when suddenly the ancient and calm voice of Senior Kong came to his ears:
"Boy, you don't need to worry too much. Her condition has stabilized a lot; it's only due to excessive exhaustion of soul power that her Divine Soul fell silent. You've already healed her physical injuries, just let her rest peacefully for a time, and she will naturally awaken."
Only then did Yuan Ming feel a bit relieved, and he urgently asked, "Senior Kong, was what Xi Ying used just now the legendary Great Wish of All Beings?"
"Indeed, it is this Divine Skill. It ranks second on the Creation Heaven List, and I don't know where Miss Xi learned it from. What's even more commendable is that she could comprehend such a skill just after entering the Realm of Life Witch. She truly is a prodigy." Senior Kong praised.
"Will this Divine Skill cause her any irreversible damage?" Yuan Ming didn't care about the source of the skill; his mind was solely concerned with Xi Ying's safety.
Senior Kong pondered for a moment and slowly said, "In general, using the Great Wish of All Beings with Miss Xi's cultivation at the initial stage of a Life Witch does place a heavy burden. But before she acted, I used the Desire Power from the Stealing Heaven Tripod to assist her, so her injuries are not too severe and haven't reached the roots. Rest assured, she will be fine."
Hearing this, Yuan Ming finally felt a great weight lifted from his heart, exhaling a long breath.
He remained silent for a moment, filled with self-recrimination.
The events of today were all due to his lack of strength; otherwise, Xi Ying wouldn't have had to take such a great risk.
"Boy, treasure Miss Xi well. In this world, willing to do this much for you, now, there's only her left." Senior Kong's voice carried a touch of emotion.
Yuan Ming slowly nodded, his gaze towards Xi Ying full of tenderness.
"Alright, now that Su Wu's form has been completely scattered by the Great Wish of All Beings, quickly move the World Tree. Don't let down her intentions." Senior Kong reminded.
"Scattered form? Does that mean Su Wu hasn't truly fallen?" Yuan Ming asked in astonishment.
"Su Wu's true form is the Six-winged Heavenly Cicada, which has a survival ability even greater than your Undying Body. Although Xi Ying's Great Wish of All Beings is powerful, she's just started learning it, and her skills are not yet mature, so she couldn't completely annihilate Su Wu." Senior Kong shook his head, explaining.
"Since Su Wu's form has been shattered, can't we take this opportunity to eradicate him completely?" A flash of cold light appeared in Yuan Ming's eyes as he pursued the question.
"Impossible. After Su Wu's form collapsed, he utilized the parasitic ability of the Six-winged Heavenly Cicada to merge into the Three Realms Immortal Boat. Unless you can completely destroy the Three Realms Immortal Boat, it's not possible to completely kill Su Wu." Senior Kong sighed.
Hearing this, Yuan Ming's gaze shifted to where Su Wu's body had collapsed, seeing only emptiness without a trace of blood, knowing Senior Kong spoke the truth.
He scanned his surroundings again, searching for the Black Sword, but unfortunately, the sword was nowhere to be seen.
"Not only that. After being parasitized by Su Wu, the Three Realms Immortal Boat is now completely under his control. Do not attempt to seize it; leaving this place promptly is wise." Senior Kong's voice sounded again.
Yuan Ming nodded and carefully placed Xi Ying into the Shura Palace, dedicating an area for her to recuperate.
Then he continued his efforts to relocate the World Giant Tree.
Without the suppression of Su Wu's Spiritual Domain, Yuan Ming's speed in relocating the World Giant Tree increased severalfold.
Soon, he transferred more than ninety percent of the World Giant Tree into the Shura Palace.

chapters.title: Chapter 1002 - 967: A Step Too Late
chapters.content:
At this moment, within White Emperor City, the crowds surged.
Cultivators bustled through the streets and alleys as usual, the sounds of hustle and bustle never ending.
On the city walls, the soldiers stood in neat formation, their eyes sharp as they vigilantly watched the areas beyond the city.
Suddenly, a burly soldier furrowed his brow, casting his gaze toward a certain direction outside the city.
His brow slightly furrowed as his vision captured a point of white light in the distant sky, rapidly magnifying, releasing a massive roar that shook the entire world.
"Enemy... enemy attack!" The soldier's voice, though drowned by the wind, was enough to spread a tense atmosphere across the city walls.
Before he could shout, a rapid alarm bell's sound had already echoed from the corner tower, the "clang clang" resonating through every corner of the city, the grand sound waves rushing like tides, instantly awakening White Emperor City's alertness.
For the first time, the cultivators heard such an urgent and continuous alarm bell; the initial bewilderment quickly replaced by tension.
They knew well that the significance of this bell was extraordinary.
In the past, even if the Demon Clan launched a large-scale attack, it was merely three rings per group, striking three groups in succession. Yet, today's continuous bell clearly foretold a more severe situation.
Amidst the crowd's surprise and uncertainty, the arrays throughout the city suddenly activated.
In the dazzling golden light, countless golden light swords soared into the sky, forming a sword array mid-air, radiating sword intent, pointing fiercely outside the city.
Simultaneously, mechanisms on the city walls quickly activated, massive fireballs whistled into the sky, carrying raging flames, smashing towards the rapidly approaching white light mass.
Shockingly, whether it was the golden light sword array or the crimson fireballs, upon contacting the white light mass, they exploded one after another, turning into a rain of light, yet unable to damage the light mass in the slightest.
The white light mass continued its astonishingly rapid approach towards White Emperor City, seemingly unstoppable.
As the light mass drew near, its true form gradually revealed itself before everyone.
It turned out to be a silver giant ship as large as a mountain!
On the arrow tower atop the city walls, a flash of light occurred, and Jin Mu's figure suddenly emerged.
