His face ashen, he swiftly gestured with both hands before his chest, dozens of array flags floating and swirling around him.
A dazzling white light shot into the sky from within the arrow tower, transforming into a giant silver-white light pillar, piercing into the high-altitude clouds.
In succession, various places in White Emperor City saw silver light pillars brighten up, like sky-piercing pillars, piercing straight into the clouds.
Instantly, the sea of clouds above surged, the thunderous roar deafening.
Gigantic lightning pillars extended from mid-air, akin to the tentacles of a giant beast.
These lightning pillars intertwined and converged in the air, forming a massive thunder array that enveloped White Emperor City.
Simultaneously, the main roads within the city also lit up with green light, these lights crisscrossed, converging into a massive green light array.
This array complemented the outside thunder array, jointly protecting White Emperor City.
On the outer city walls of White Emperor City, huge array runes also lit up at this moment.
These runes emitted dazzling light, diamond-shaped light screens resembling turtle shells appeared above the city walls, tightly linked like a giant protective net, securely shielding the entire city.
In an instant, the three defense arrays of White Emperor City fully deployed, forming a mighty and impregnable defense line.
The people on the city walls largely breathed a sigh of relief.
However, Jin Mu's expression showed no sign of relief.
He flipped his palm hidden in his sleeve, a purple jade talisman appearing in his palm.
He grasped it forcefully, the jade talisman instantly crumbling.
With the jade talisman's crushing, the flying swords shooting out from the arrow tower suddenly enveloped in a layer of blue-purple thunder.
These flying swords emitted a thunderous roar, tens of thousands of flying swords shot out, converging into a vast sword qi torrent, charging directly at the silver giant ship.
"This is the Yin-Yang Thunder Sword Formation! Personally arranged by Master Murong of Heavenly Saint Academy, a seventh-level formation!" someone exclaimed.
"Hmph, overestimating its capability. White Emperor City has stood for hundreds of years, with many sixth-level demons unable to shake its foundation, relying solely on a Magic Treasure flying boat to break the city? It's simply laughable!" someone else sneered.
"Once that giant ship crashes, we shall charge out of the city and slay all invading enemies!" more cultivators shouted boldly.
The crowd within the city erupted in cheers, yet before the silver giant ship's thunderous roar splitting the sky, these cheers seemed so insignificant.
The vast sword qi torrent sped off, yet just as it was about to touch the silver giant ship, the ship's bow suddenly glowed bright with silver light, like an arrow cutting through the void, vanishing in an instant.
The enormous hull likewise disappeared, leaving only the vast sword stream of the Yin-Yang Thunder Sword Formation crisscrossing in the air, swinging in vain.
Upon witnessing this, all the people on the city walls glanced at each other, a nameless fear welling up within their hearts.
Jin Mu's face became ashen, shouting abruptly: "It's disastrous, Pillar Hongjun!"
His figure then flashed, transforming into golden light, swiftly heading towards a certain place within the city.
In the depths beneath White Emperor City, a vast underground space unfolded before their eyes.
This space was broad and boundless, as though it could encompass all things in the world.
At the center of this space stood a massive crimson stone pillar, resembling stalactite stone, its surface smooth as jade, densely carved with peculiar runes, emitting subdued light.
At this moment, a sudden change occurred!
The void within the underground space suddenly cracked open, an eye-catching silver light shooting out, followed closely by the massive Three Realms Immortal Boat emerging out of thin air, its speed unabated, charging straight towards the crimson stone pillar.
Golden light flashed before the stone pillar, Jin Mu's figure appeared out of nowhere.
With the sight of the enormous Three Realms Immortal Boat, cold sweat covered his forehead, yet White Emperor City entrusted to him by Ancestor Bing Lan must not be lost.
He extended both hands outward, opening a golden spiritual domain around him, simultaneously spitting out a golden treasure umbrella.
The golden light within the spiritual domain fully gathered, merging with the golden treasure umbrella, spreading out a thick golden light curtain.
Before Jin Mu could do more, the Three Realms Immortal Boat had already arrived with a roar, colliding with the golden light curtain.
The golden light curtain shattered like fragile crystal, the golden treasure umbrella also splintering into pieces.
"How could this be..." Jin Mu's face showed a look of horror.
But before he could make any move, the massive bow of the Three Realms Immortal Boat collided with his body.
Bang!
Jin Mu's body and the light screen burst apart, just like the precious umbrella.
The Three Realms Immortal Boat crushed Jin Mu's blockade with irresistible force and, without any delay, rammed into the dark red Stone Pillar.
"Boom!"
The sound was like the sky collapsing and the earth cracking, coming from the depths beneath White Emperor City, shaking the entire city.
The cultivators on the city wall and the citizens within the city felt a dull yet grand beast roar in their ears, then the whole White Emperor City began to shake violently.
The originally impregnable three Defense Magic Arrays now appeared fragile as paper, shattering completely.
The rumbling sound echoed above the entire city, the buildings within White Emperor City crumbled like fragile blocks, collapsing in large swathes as smoke and dust rose.
The city walls, standing for countless years, also cracked in this violent tremor, with giant gashes tearing from different angles, causing the entire city to fall into a state of collapse and destruction.
The nearly thousand cultivators controlling the Great Array within the city suffered the most direct impact in the massive quake, all perishing.
The cultivators on the city wall also sustained severe injuries amidst the collapse of the arrow towers and the leaked Sword Qi.
The low-level cultivators and mortals within the city experienced an even greater catastrophe, with heavy casualties.
Within a thousand miles around White Emperor City, the ground shook, and mountain ridges stretching hundreds of miles crumbled one after another in the massive quakes.
Smoke and dust billowed in the mountains and forests, birds flew away startled, and the cries of beasts echoed, creating a scene of apocalypse.
And in the underground space, the gigantic dark red Stone Pillar was mostly shattered, crumbling into countless pieces of varying sizes.
These fragments shimmered with a glow, emitting a starry flicker like sparks, seemingly containing some mysterious power.
A vast surge of nature's spiritual energy gushed out from the shattered Stone Pillar, turning into rolling waves of gas, spreading in all directions.
Meanwhile, a boundless wave of Desire Power also spread, as if it had been sealed for millennia, now beginning to slowly leak out, permeating the entire underground space.
...
The cabin of the Three Realms Immortal Boat also shook violently from the collision, Su Yingxue and Hei Lian were flung around heavily, barely managing to stabilize themselves.
Both women were pale as snow, whether it was from controlling the massive Three Realms Immortal Boat, which consumed much of their energy, or from the recent tremor.
"We finally succeeded, let's go!" Su Yingxue immediately said.
"Are we just leaving like this? What about the Three Realms Immortal Boat?" Hei Lian asked in astonishment.
"Don't worry, the Sect Hierarch will handle it." Su Yingxue replied.
Hei Lian, upon hearing this, spat out a mass of black light, enveloping both herself and Su Yingxue.
The two merged into the night, quietly slipping into the void.
Meanwhile, on the deck of the Immortal Boat, Yuan Ming's clone experienced a violent collision, leaving his body in tatters.
The silver light screen that once enveloped the Immortal Boat had shattered and disappeared, and the tightly closed wooden door of the cabin was forcefully knocked open in the crash.
Yuan Ming's clone, enduring his broken body, rapidly chanted incantations.
The shattered body turned into a ball of green light and split in two.
One ball of green light flew into the cabin, while the other flew outside, disappearing into the rubble of the collapse.
At that moment, a silver ripple suddenly emerged in the underground space, as Wu Yu led the demons of the Ten Thousand Demon Country to emerge, landing in the already collapsed underground space.
Seeing the already fragmented Pillar Hongjun, excitement appeared on their faces, as if a millennia-long wish was finally fulfilled that day.
"Good, good, good..." The Black Bear King was so excited he could hardly speak a complete sentence, repeatedly expressing his approval.
Wu Yu sternly shouted, "Pillar Hongjun hasn't completely shattered, it's up to you now!"
Her voice echoed in the vast underground space, though not loud, yet it carried exceptional authority.
The nearby void suddenly flashed with a scarlet shadow as the Great Sun Glaze Flame appeared.
She opened her mouth and a golden light instantly enveloped her entire body, though surrounded by no flames, the rising scorching heat forced all the demon clan to retreat, distancing themselves.
A red light burst from the mouth of the Great Sun Glaze Flame, revealing a fiery red Spiritual Pearl.
This Spiritual Pearl emitted a terrifyingly powerful Fire Attribute Spiritual Power, yet it did not swell outward but was almost entirely restrained within the fiery red pearl, seemingly containing immense power.
"Go!"
The Great Sun Glaze Flame let out a low shout, and the fiery red Spiritual Pearl immediately transformed into a red light, rapidly striking the shattered Pillar Hongjun.Read full story at noⅴelfire.net
In the next instant, blazing flames suddenly erupted, revealing a gigantic red sun at the center.
The red sun emitted rolling flames of firelight, fiercely impacting the Pillar Hongjun.
The demons of the Ten Thousand Demon Country retreated even further, yet their faces were illuminated by the firelight of the red sun, all showing expressions of excitement.
The gigantic red sun, upon striking the Pillar Hongjun, suddenly exploded, unleashing an unfathomable spiritual pressure that twisted and shattered the void wherever it passed.
The cracks on the Pillar Hongjun widened further, as if they could completely crumble at any moment.
Just then, another change occurred.
The void beside the Pillar Hongjun suddenly twisted, and an unexpected figure appeared—Ancestor Bing Lan.
"Still a step too late..."
Ancestor Bing Lan looked at the Pillar Hongjun before him, his expression darkening, as a hint of regret flashed in his eyes.
Then, his gaze fell on the Great Sun Glaze Flame and the demons of the Ten Thousand Demon Country, a deep dislike and uncontainable anger flickering in his eyes.

chapters.title: Chapter 1003 - 968: Frozen World
chapters.content:
Ancestor Bing Lan rapidly sealed with one hand, his palm suddenly lighting up with a dazzling icy blue light. Then, with a wave of his sleeve, the brilliance surged forward like a raging flood.
The entire underground space was instantly shrouded in this icy blue glow, an intensely piercing coldness flooding forth, seemingly capable of freezing all life.
The sound of "crack crack" was endless, as the underground space quickly transformed into a blue ice cave under this chill.
The Stone Pillar Hongjun was also tightly wrapped in a thick layer of frost, even the newly risen giant red sun could not escape, sealed along with its scorching flames in this ice cave.
Seeing this, all the demons of the Ten Thousand Demon Country showed expressions of terror, turning around in an attempt to flee from this icy land.
Yet the speed at which the coldness spread was extremely fast, many demons were engulfed by the chill before they could even turn around.
This chill was extraordinarily domineering, the Protective Spiritual Light of everyone in the Demon Cave was like paper in the face of this cold, easily penetrated.
Their bodies gradually turned into ice-bound sculptures, frozen in place, unable to move, maintaining their posture from the moment before being frozen, as if time itself had stopped.
Even Wu Yu was not spared, a hint of astonishment still in his exquisite eyes.
Amid this freezing disaster, only the Great Sun Glaze Flame retained a trace of vitality.
As the icy blue chill erupted, she sensed the crisis, quickly mobilizing her fire power, transforming into a red-red stream of flame and turning to flee.
At the moment the chill struck, blazing golden flames surged up around her, burning fiercely like a small sun, temporarily holding off the extreme cold aura.
Yet, as Ancestor Bing Lan is, after all, an existence in the Mahayana Realm, even the Great Sun Glaze Flame could not escape a fate of being frozen.
Ancestor Bing Lan once again sealed with his right hand, a blue line of light shot out like an arrow, accurately hitting the Great Sun Glaze Flame who had fled far away, easily piercing through her body.
With a light cracking sound.
The body of the Great Sun Glaze Flame also transformed into an ice sculpture, her surrounding flames, like the giant red sun, frozen within this cold.
In the underground cave, the sound of "crack crack" was unending, layers of blue ice crystals began to spread through the void.
The hull of the Three Realms Immortal Boat was also covered with a thick shell of ice, the cold invasion penetrating into the interior of the Immortal Boat.
The temperature within the world of the Three Realms Immortal Boat suddenly plummeted.
Outside the Ninth Level Silver Tower, even goose feather-like snow began to fall.
In the howling, piercingly cold wind, the chilling cold constantly seeped in from above the firmament.

Meanwhile, the underground cave in the Silver Tower Space began to shake violently.
"What's going on? Is this Su Wu's doing, or has something gone wrong with the Three Realms Immortal Boat?" Yuan Ming showed a look of surprise.
Inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod, the main soul sat on the White Jade Lotus Platform, using Desire Power to communicate with Wei Ling.
He originally left Wei Ling outside precisely for this reason.
Wei Ling, still in the treasure-hunting group, was retreating towards the perimeter of the Fire Rock Desert, recounting everything he had witnessed, including the situation of the bean soldier clone infiltrating the Three Realms Immortal Boat.
"I see, it seems that the Three Realms Sect and the Ten Thousand Demon Country have been meticulously preparing for everything long ago, with their sights set on the Three Realms Immortal Boat…" Yuan Ming's main soul thought.
At that moment, a piercing cold seeped in, and the underground cave began to freeze.
Even concealed within the World Tree, Yuan Ming could not immunize against this extreme cold feeling, as he urged his cultivation technique to resist, feeling greatly amazed.
He had never before felt such an intense icy intention within the Three Realms Immortal Boat, immediately realizing someone was attacking here.
"It's Ancestor Bing Lan freezing the Three Realms Immortal Boat, don't worry about other things, quickly transfer the World Tree, there's no time to lose." Empty's reminder sounded timely, breaking Yuan Ming's contemplation.
Upon hearing Ancestor Bing Lan's appearance, Yuan Ming was startled, becoming even more curious about the outside situation.
But now was not the time to examine the outside, he continued to mobilize the World Giant Tree, transferring it towards the Shura Palace.
At this moment, within the underground cave, many Forbidden Arrays had ceased to function under the influence of the extreme cold aura, and even those still operating had their power greatly reduced.
This caused the connection between the Three Realms Immortal Boat and the World Giant Tree to rapidly weaken, making the transfer process extraordinarily smooth.
Yuan Ming controlled the World Tree, transferring the last dozens of root tendrils in one swift motion into the Shura Palace.
As all the tree roots anchored within the Shura Palace Space, the enormous World Tree was also completely transferred over.
Just as the World Tree fully entered the Shura Palace, all the tree vines and roots suddenly began to madly take root, extending to every corner of the Shura Palace Space.
The huge canopy swayed continuously, branches delving into the void, leaving a patchwork of picturesque views.
At this moment, the Shura Palace was also shaking violently, undergoing an earth-shattering transformation.
The entire Shura Palace Space was forcefully expanded under an invisible force, whether it was the space where the Black Tower was located, the Yin Capital City Space, or even the Medicine Garden Space, they all expanded rapidly.
Besides the increase in space, the previously rather loose Space Power within the Shura Palace was also constantly being folded and reorganized, becoming heavy and solid, with nature's spiritual energy increasing sharply, drastically changing the environment.
The previously somewhat desolate Black Tower Space, after the World Tree took root, was suffused everywhere with a green glow.
Sporadic flowers and grasses began to spread madly under the rich Spiritual Power. Before long, the Black Tower Space was already filled with blooming wildflowers and lush green grass.
The same situation was unfolding simultaneously in other areas of the Shura Palace.
Spiritual Medicine Garden, Yin Capital City, Extreme Fire Realm, Cold Martial Realm, and Netherworld, each space is undergoing earth-shattering transformations.
Especially the Spiritual Medicine Garden, the changes are particularly significant.
The spiritual medicines planted in the garden have matured ahead of time under the dual catalysis of drastic changes in the world and the surge in spiritual energy, exuding an enchanting fragrance.
Those spirit woods planted personally by Yuan Ming are growing at an astonishing speed, seemingly crossing hundreds of years in an instant, gaining hundreds of years in medicinal age, with lush branches and an exuberant vitality.
The sky in Shura Palace space has become even more distant, as if one could reach the ethereal stars just by stretching one's hand, and the ground has become solid and steady, carrying endless vitality and vigor.
Amid the circulation of heaven and earth spiritual energy, white clouds unexpectedly appeared above the sky, like an immortal landscape in a painting, captivating people's imagination.
These changes make Shura Palace increasingly resemble the outside world, filled with mystery and allure.
As for the cultivators and mortals living in Shura Palace, they have successively felt this dramatic change in space.
Some are delighted by the expansion of space and the rich spiritual energy, while others are fearful of the unknown changes and the uncertain future, and for a moment, they do not know whom to ask for the reason behind this.
The World Giant Tree soon completely took root in the depths of Shura Palace, and as it stabilized, the changes in Shura Palace gradually stopped.
Yuan Ming carefully sensed for a moment, and immediately felt joy in his heart.
He discovered that the space of Shura Palace had expanded three to four times, and its tenacity nearly matched that of the Three Realms Immortal Boat space.
It means Shura Palace now has a much stronger carrying capacity and protective ability, enough to cope with more challenges and crises.
And the few Dharma manifestation cultivators imprisoned in Shura Palace space have always been a concern in Yuan Ming's heart.
He worried that those people would break through the space and escape, so he specifically imprisoned them in a Level 6 Array.
But now, with the expansion and enhancement of space, he no longer has to worry about this issue.
Even beings at the peak of Dharma manifestation like Qin Mo and Wu Yu, without a spiritual treasure specifically for breaking through the void, cannot possibly open this sturdy space.
The heaven and earth spiritual energy within Shura Palace has also become much richer, increased several times.
This completely solves the original issue of insufficient spiritual power in Shura Palace, providing a superior environment and conditions for cultivators' training.
"Indeed, the grade of this Shura Palace has greatly improved, whether the contained space power or heaven and earth spiritual power far exceeds ordinary spiritual treasures. The only flaw is the palace's forbiddance, still arranged by Shura Master originally, thus no artifact spirit was born. However, this is not difficult for you to resolve." The voice of Void timely sounded, guiding Yuan Ming.
Yuan Ming nodded in agreement.
Immediately after, he raised his hand and summoned the Forbidden Wood Pillar of the Three Realms Immortal Boat into his hand.
The wood pillar records all the array maps of forbidden arrays within the Three Realms Immortal Boat, including the space restriction, reaching as high as Level 7.
He plans to elevate his array formation cultivation and then set up this Level 7 space restriction within Shura Palace, possibly transforming Shura Palace into a world-class space spiritual treasure akin to the Three Realms Immortal Boat.
Just as Yuan Ming prepared to further arrange the forbiddance, the cold air in the underground cave dramatically increased, starting to seep into Shura Palace.
Feeling this chill, Yuan Ming dared not linger, immediately activating the World Giant Tree, ready to take Shura Palace and leave this place about to be frozen.
Several thick cyan-gray tree roots emerged from within Shura Palace, slashing down like large swords.
As the roots wielded, the void was cleaved into several intersecting fissures, and Shura Palace vanished in the shattered space, disappearing without a trace.
With the complete departure of the World Giant Tree, the forbiddance within the Three Realms Immortal Boat also completely ceased operation.
More cold air surged in, the temperature plummeted drastically, transforming the entire space rapidly into an ice and snow world.
Ancestor Bing Lan gazed at the Three Realms Immortal Boat, his eyes narrowed, and a sharp gleam shot from his eyes.
His gaze is like a steel knife, piercing inside the Three Realms Immortal Boat, attempting to explore the mysteries within.
...
At the depths of the Three Realms Immortal Boat, it is dark and silent.
Su Wu's body has gradually recovered its former vitality; at this moment, he is meditating with closed eyes, regulating the breath within him.
His brows are furrowed, filled with doubt and unwillingness.
He never thought that the guy named "Wan Tianren" actually had a Life Witch hidden by his side to assist.
If he hadn't reacted in time, he might have already fallen to such eerie tactics.
"It seems next time I act, I must be more careful and cautious." Su Wu secretly thought.
Just as he planned to continue his breathing control for a moment, the surrounding temperature suddenly dropped, a bone-chilling cold rushed in.
Soon after, snow began to fall from the sky, a wave of extreme cold seeped through the underground cracks.
Su Wu sharply lifted his head, his eyes like electricity, coldly staring at the firmament.
There, he sensed a powerful divine sense fluctuation, surprisingly it was Ancestor Bing Lan's aura.
"Discovered? You bug hiding in the gutter!" Ancestor Bing Lan's indifferent voice echoed in Su Wu's mind, piercing his heart like an ice cone.
In the next instant, an icy blue light penetrated the void, falling from the sky like a cold giant dragon, enveloping Su Wu's location.

chapters.title: Chapter 1004 - 969: True Form
chapters.content:
Where the ice-blue light passed, the void seemed to freeze, forming an ice tower covered with thorn-like protrusions, exuding a chilling coldness, pressing down towards Su Wu.
Su Wu's body moved, flipping to stand, with billowing black aura surging from him, crashing towards the ice-blue light like a black torrent.
The Heavenly Cicada Black Qi continuously devoured the power of the ice-blue light, yet more frost power descended from the sky, instantly suppressing the spread of the black aura.
The ice-blue light continued to press down, its speed increasing, rapidly closing in on Su Wu.
At that moment, black mist rolled and surged all around Su Wu, as a strange power erupted from within him.
Suddenly, six pairs of translucent membranous wings grew from his back, covered with hexagonal patterns, reflecting a kaleidoscope of glorious light.
With a "whirring" sound, those six pairs of membranous wings flapped, swiftly propelling Su Wu's body sideways, narrowly dodging the strike of the ice-blue light.
Before Ancestor Bing Lan could change his move, Su Wu's figure rapidly enlarged, with the black aura surging, directly revealing the true form of the Six-winged Heavenly Cicada.
It was a gigantic six-winged insect over a hundred feet tall, its body jet black like ink, exuding a powerful demon energy.
Its sickle-like forelimbs swiped through the void, tearing a massive rift in front, where space power was tangled and twisted, flickering with alternating light and darkness.
The monstrous form Su Wu had turned into plunged into the spatial rift, disappearing in an instant.
"Six-winged Heavenly Cicada?" Ancestor Bing Lan saw this, his brow slightly raised, eyes flashing with a hint of surprise.
At that moment, a crack suddenly appeared in the void outside White Emperor City, the gigantic Six-winged Heavenly Cicada emerged from it, reappearing in Ancestor Bing Lan's sight.
Ancestor Bing Lan looked up at the sky, his figure blurred and then vanished from the spot, appearing opposite the Six-winged Heavenly Cicada the next moment, confronting it in mid-air.
"The Six-winged Heavenly Cicada has been extinct for many years, what is your connection with the Heavenly Cicada Demon Ancestor of the Abyss Dead Land?" Ancestor Bing Lan looked Su Wu over, and asked.
Su Wu, however, did not answer his question, merely spewing rolling black aura from his mouthpiece, directly rushing towards Ancestor Bing Lan.
Ancestor Bing Lan pointed forward with two fingers, light immediately gathered in the void, forming a gigantic blue light formation.
Countless extreme cold ice cones gathered and shot towards the opposite side like a torrential rain.
The black aura sprayed out from Su Wu's mouthpiece churned, transforming into a massive black vortex, swallowing all the extreme cold ice cones coming his way.
Although Su Wu was severely wounded by Xi Ying using the Great Wish of All Living Beings, with his demonic power nearly exhausted, he had just recovered part of his strength underground.
At this moment, after devouring these ice cones, a layer of fluorescent light appeared on the surface of the Six-winged Heavenly Cicada, restoring a portion of its demonic power.
"To even devour my Beiming Ice Cone, it seems you truly are a Six-winged Heavenly Cicada." Seeing this, Ancestor Bing Lan nodded, a trace of heaviness flashing in his eyes.
Su Wu did not give Ancestor Bing Lan a chance to breathe, crossing his scythe-like forelimbs to strike out, transforming into two exceedingly sharp black light blades, tearing through the void, directly reaching Ancestor Bing Lan's front.
However, Ancestor Bing Lan did not evade, as his robes fluttered, rolling frost surged out, ice blue light expanded, instantly transforming into a spherical Spiritual Domain covering a hundred miles.
Within that domain, frost surged, snowflakes drifted, as if freezing the entire world within.
The two black light blades barely approached Ancestor Bing Lan before they were frozen by the terrifying cold, shattering into countless ice crystals.
Su Wu was enveloped within the extreme cold Spiritual Domain, snow covering his wings, freezing instantly into ice, with every part of his body covered by a layer of ice shells.
The bone-chilling cold infiltrated his body, seemingly about to freeze his blood into ice, hindering the flow of mana within him. It wouldn't take long before he would turn into an ice sculpture.
At this critical moment, a jet black light suddenly erupted from Su Wu's lower abdomen, rapidly spreading to form a black spherical light domain.
This light domain devoured all the snow and ice it touched, dissolving them without a trace.
Su Wu expanded his Heavenly Cicada Black Qi Spiritual Domain, enveloping a range of several hundred feet around him.
Within this domain, the strands of black aura roamed like dragons or serpents, blocking the external snow and ice, managing to stabilize his own territory within Ancestor Bing Lan's extreme cold Spiritual Domain.
"Is this the True Intent of Devour? To even swallow a Spiritual Domain..." Ancestor Bing Lan appeared surprised, but his astonishment did not last.
After devouring a portion of the ice Spiritual Domain's power, Su Wu began to emit a glimmering light, with his aura rapidly recovering to almost its peak state.
"Is this all the renowned Ancestor Bing Lan can do?" Su Wu laughed heartily, his voice filled with provocation.
Ancestor Bing Lan was not swayed by his provocation, with a flick of his wrist, the blue light within the ice Spiritual Domain quickly gathered, instantly forming a blue ice spear about thirty feet long.
With another flick of his fingers, the blue ice spear pierced through the air, unexpectedly tearing through Su Wu's Heavenly Cicada Spiritual Domain, directly thrusting towards his brow.
Su Wu was taken aback, rapidly retreating, while urging the Heavenly Cicada Black Qi to circle and attack.
As soon as the Heavenly Cicada Black Qi touched the blue ice spear, it was rapidly frozen into ice crystals by the extreme cold emanating from the spear.
"Your True Intent of Devour is impressive, but unfortunately, your mana is too weak. The battle between Mahayana cultivators is not as simple as you think." Ancestor Bing Lan sneered, flicking his fingers once more.
The blue ice spear spun rapidly, the True Intent of Frost within it fully exploding, shredding the Heavenly Cicada Black Qi entirely. It flashed, appearing before Su Wu, making it impossible for him to evade.
Su Wu's face no longer showed the previous expression of triumph.
He hurriedly swung his two sickles to block, barely managing to intercept the blue ice spear.
At that moment, the blue ice spear suddenly lit up with a dazzling brilliance and exploded abruptly.
Countless sharp ice needles burst out from the ice spear, shooting forward like a torrential rain.
Su Wu could not dodge at all; he was instantly engulfed by the dazzling blue light. Numerous ice needles directly pierced his body, and the Frost True Intent erupted within him.
The enormous body of the six-winged Heavenly Cicada was penetrated by several thick blue ice crystals, frozen in mid-air.
The Sky Cicada Spirit Domain surrounding them also shattered and scattered.
Ancestor Bing Lan had no intention of stopping, clearly aiming to completely annihilate.
He clasped his hands together in front of him, from his palms surged a wave of ice-blue light, stirring up intense Spiritual Power fluctuations.
Moreover, a chilling aura far surpassing before was being emitted, making people shiver involuntarily.ʀᴇᴀᴅ ʟᴀᴛᴇsᴛ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀᴛ .net
A palm-sized, semi-transparent Crystal Ball shot out from the blue light, slowly ascending into mid-air.
In an instant, it seemed as if a blue sun rose above White Emperor City.
Wherever that ice-blue light reached, whether mountains, woods, or city ruins, instantly condensed into blue ice crystals.
The stones and trees within these ice crystals also transformed into a transparent crystal state, from the inside out turning into ice crystals.
Those trees, once full of life, instantly lost their vitality, becoming lifeless ice trees with no aura fluctuations.
The entire White Emperor City seemed to transform into a jewel-like illusion of ice sculptures.
And Su Wu's enormous Heavenly Cicada body was quickly turning into an ice crystal state under this blue light.
He floated in mid-air, like a giant ice sculpture.
At this moment, the still unfinished crystallizing body of the six-winged Heavenly Cicada suddenly disassembled, transforming into strands of black mist.
The surrounding void seemed to be torn by some mysterious force, a subtle fissure silently appeared, and the black mist darted into it like agile fish, disappearing without a trace.
"Space Escape Technique!"
Ancestor Bing Lan showed an expression of surprise, his massive Divine Sense spread like a tide, attempting to track the vanished Su Wu, but he found no trace.
Outside the Frost Spirit Domain in the void, a subtle fissure silently opened, and Su Wu's silhouette slowly emerged from it.
He had reverted to human form, yet the membrane wings as thin as cicada wings remained, rapidly fluttering, emitting a faint buzzing sound.
Ancestor Bing Lan's eyes flashed with a cold light, he moved his form, and pursued Su Wu.
He made a gesture, and the blue mini-sun in mid-air burst with radiant light, countless blue rays shot out, directly aiming at Su Wu.
Su Wu's aura diminished sharply at this moment; he did not choose to unfold the Sky Cicada Spirit Domain but turned his form into a series of afterimages, deftly dodging the falling blue rays.
The speed was astonishing, the movement technique exquisite, truly incredible.
Though Su Wu could dodge the attacks of the blue rays, he could not escape the Frost True Intent contained within the rays.
Every falling blue ray made him feel as if the surrounding space was suddenly frozen by a layer of frost, causing his movements to become increasingly sluggish, making it hard to avoid the subsequent attacks.
The sound of "whoosh whoosh" was continuous, nine blue rays fell at an extremely fast speed, faster than before, and at a tricky angle, seemingly sealing all of Su Wu's escape routes in advance.
At this critical moment, spirit light suddenly flashed on Su Wu's body, shooting out several golden talismans that blossomed with dazzling light, coalescing into a golden rune formation, sheltering him in the center.
That golden rune formation spun rapidly, looking like a golden bell, humming and vibrating out layers of golden halos.
"Clang clang clang," a few loud sounds, the nine ice-blue rays were shockingly all repelled, and only a small area of the golden rune formation was frozen into ice crystals.
At this moment, the dazzling blue light suddenly flooded the nearby void.
It turned out that the blue mini-sun in mid-air suddenly descended, fiercely colliding with the golden rune formation.
With a "bang," the golden rune formation froze into ice crystals instantly upon the impact of the blue sun, shattering into countless Crystal Powder, scattering apart.
In the midst of the drifting ice crystal powder, a black Flying Sword abruptly shot out, under the illumination of the blue light, transforming into a black sword arc, slicing toward the blue sun.
With a piercing "clang," the blue sun was struck by the black Flying Sword and sent flying, all the frost light dissipated, revealing the semi-transparent Round Orb underneath.
That Round Orb wobbled, extremely unstable, obviously severely damaged.

chapters.title: Chapter 1005 - 970: Reincarnation Demon Lord
chapters.content:
Ancestor Bing Lan's face showed a look of heartache as he hurriedly flew up to catch the translucent crystal ball.
To his shock and anger, he discovered that a deep black mark had been slashed into the crystal ball.
This round orb was his life-bound Dao treasure, the Nine Cold Ice Crystal Ball, and his trump heavy treasure; yet it had been scored so deeply with just one attack.
What kind of spiritual treasure was that black sword to possess such power?
Before Ancestor Bing Lan could examine it closely, another change occurred.
The void behind him suddenly tore open, and a long knife gleaming with dark green blade light emerged without warning.
The long knife slashed towards the back of Ancestor Bing Lan's neck with astonishing speed.
This strike was too sudden, and by the time Ancestor Bing Lan reacted, his body had already suddenly virtualized, turning into fragments of ice crystal snowflakes and scattering apart.
The dark green long knife brushed past his shoulder, its blade light sweeping up a piece of bloody fabric that had not yet turned into ice crystals.
Then, with a flash, the dark green long knife withdrew back into the void and disappeared.
The next appearance of this knife was several hundred meters away.
A figure shrouded in black shadow appeared beside the long knife, holding a miniature altar of the size of a dinner tray, placing the piece of bloody fabric into the altar.
The altar was ink black in its entirety, round on top and square beneath, covered with strange and ancient runes, precisely the legendary Evil Curse Altar.
The figure's palm, like an abyss, covered the altar, fingers spread, and the veins on the back of the hand protruded like writhing little snakes.
In the center of his palm, an evil dark red array pattern gradually emerged.
He rapidly chanted a string of obscure and incomprehensible spells, as if communicating with some unknown power.
As the spell was recited, the array patterns on the Evil Curse Altar seemed to come alive, tearing open the skin of that person's palm.
Dark red blood slowly dripped, seeping into the altar's central sacrificial Blood Pool, soaking through the piece of fabric.
At that moment, a cluster of blood-red flames suddenly erupted from the Blood Pool, burning fiercely, quickly reducing the piece of cloth to ashes.
Immediately following, a blood-colored tiny figure the size of a palm appeared within the altar, and except for being smaller, its form and appearance were identical to that of Ancestor Bing Lan, even down to the shocked expression he wore at that moment.
From a distance, Ancestor Bing Lan's face turned incredibly gloomy upon seeing this and exclaimed, "The Ten Thousand Tribulation Blood Soul Curse! It's you!"
The black silhouette let out a eerie and strange laugh, as if he had heard something incredibly amusing: "Jie jie, who would've thought that after thousands of years away from the Chuyun Realm, Fellow Daoist Bing Lan still remembers me. It is truly an honor! As a meeting gift, let's ignite the atmosphere!"
As his words fell, he flicked his finger at the blood-colored little figure, which was instantly engulfed by an invisible force, exploding and transforming into a blood flame that entwined around the blood-colored figure.
At the same time, black smoke began to emanate from various parts of Ancestor Bing Lan's body. Although no visible fire could be seen, the intense heat was real.
Ancestor Bing Lan's eyes twitched, clearly enduring significant pain.
He immediately raised one hand, a chilling light enveloped his body, sweeping down from head to toe, attempting to extinguish the invisible flames.
However, the flames seemed connected to the world and could not be extinguished no matter what.
Just as Ancestor Bing Lan continued to employ techniques to eliminate the burning pain, the black figure acted again, pointing his fingers ahead and aiming at the Blood Pool in the center of the Evil Curse Altar.
Ancestor Bing Lan's expression changed dramatically, his form disappearing into thin air, reappearing above the black figure the next moment.
The black figure, along with the Evil Curse Altar, vanished and reappeared several hundred yards away, reaching again into the Blood Pool.
With a brittle "crack," the black figure's two fingers exploded within the Blood Pool, transforming into a sharp blood light that pierced through the blood-colored little figure's chest.
Almost simultaneously, Ancestor Bing Lan's chest bulged abruptly, and with a "bang," erupted into a large blood mist.
Ancestor Bing Lan let out a painful groan, staggering involuntarily.
At this moment, a flurry of rapid wing beats suddenly resounded from behind him, and Su Wu's figure appeared ghost-like, wielding the pitch-black long sword against Ancestor Bing Lan.
An ink-black sword light burst forth, carving a massive rift in the void, slashing down towards Ancestor Bing Lan.
Ancestor Bing Lan didn't have time to transform into ice crystals. He hurriedly dodged, narrowly avoiding a fatal blow, but one arm was severed by the inky sword light.
The black silhouette seeing this swooped in, reaching for the severed arm of Ancestor Bing Lan.
However, before he touched it, the severed arm had already turned into ice crystals, shattering inch by inch.
Ancestor Bing Lan raised the Nine Cold Ice Crystal Ball with one hand, his expression cold to the extreme, shouting in an icy tone like pronouncing a fateful decree: "Ice Seal Heaven and Earth!"
As the words echoed, the Nine Cold Ice Crystal Ball radiated light a hundred times stronger than before, a dense blue light bursting forth, covering an area of a thousand miles almost instantaneously.
At the moment the blue light bloomed, the vast territory froze instantly!
The collapsed ruins of White Emperor City stood amidst a vast and desolate wilderness.
Above the wilderness, countless mountains and forests undulated, beasts roamed the woods, and flocks of birds soared through the sky.
In that instant, the movements of all living beings seemed frozen in time, the breath of heaven and earth solidified instantly.
The mountains, beasts, birds, and even the entire wilderness were thoroughly frozen within that fleeting moment, transformed into crystal-clear ice sculptures, devoid of life, as if time itself had stopped.
Su Wu and the black shadow did not escape either, covered by the sudden frost, turned into two immovable ice sculptures.
The Evil Curse Altar that used to emit an eerie aura was also sealed by thick frost, turned into a gigantic block of ice, silently standing on the wilderness.
Yet, black mist continued to surge from Su Wu's body, as if the frost was being consumed by a mysterious power, gradually melting away.
Around the black shadow, blood-red flames ignited fiercely, burning hot and weird, quickly melting the extreme frost covering its body.
Where Ancestor Bing Lan's arm had been severed, a flash of spirit light appeared, and a new arm grew out.
He had cold, sharp eyes as he reached out toward where Su Wu and the black shadow were with a grasp in the void.
With two earth-shattering bangs, the void seemed to tremble.
The ice crystals around Su Wu and the black shadow shattered under this power, transforming into dancing crystal powder.
Amidst that crystal powder, the two were also reduced to powder, disappearing into the air.
The crystal powder, under the sunlight, refracted colorful circles, like a wondrous painting in the world.
Only the block of ice where the Evil Curse Altar was, did not shatter.
Ancestor Bing Lan lifted his hand to grasp through the void, his palm emitted a powerful suction force, pulling the block of ice along with the altar toward him.
At that moment, a gigantic blood-red hand emerged out of thin air, fiercely grabbing at the Evil Curse Altar.
Ancestor Bing Lan sneered, his figure transformed into a ghostly shadow, instantly appeared in front of the Evil Curse Altar, and with a flick of his sleeve, he collected the altar along with the ice block into his sleeve.
He sent out dozens of blue ice cones with his other hand, each emitting a bone-chilling coldness, attacking the blood-red giant hand until it was riddled with holes like a sieve.
The blood-red giant hand shattered under the bombardment of the ice cones, turning into a diffuse blood light.
The scattered blood light did not vanish but was pulled by a unique force, continuously gathering toward the center. Gradually, the blood light reassembled into a somewhat insubstantial humanoid form.
Before the humanoid form could completely solidify, a black robe descended from the void, cloaking its body tightly.
On the other side, strands of Heavenly Cicada Black Mist slowly emerged from the void, gathering at a certain spot.
The black mist seemed to have a life of its own, instantly coalescing into the figure of Su Wu.
He stood on the wilderness, coldly gazing at Ancestor Bing Lan.
"The Reincarnation Demon Lord from the Demon World, why such cowardice and concealment in coming to my Chuyun Realm?" Ancestor Bing Lan did not continue to attack, but looked at the black shadow with a slight squint, his tone carrying a hint of disdain and mockery.
The figure in the black robe upon hearing this let out an eerie laugh, waving his hand, the black robe covering him dispersed like smoke, revealing his true face.
The person was tall and sturdy, covered in crimson scars like a breathtaking painting.
Under the moonlight, the scars glowed bizarrely, as if narrating his past battles fought in blood.
"Fellow Daoist Bing Lan has truly keen eyes, I merely used a few tricks and was discovered." The Reincarnation Demon Lord leaned on a blade with both hands, his voice rough and deep.
Ancestor Bing Lan sized him up, a look of ridicule flickered in his eyes: "So it's just a reincarnation clone, no wonder your divine skills are limited."
"Though you have taken the Evil Curse Altar, the Ten Thousand Tribulation Blood Soul Curse placed on you has yet to be lifted. Do you think delaying time can suppress the curse within your body? It's a futile effort. If the Ten Thousand Tribulation Blood Soul Curse were that easily resolved, the Black Emperor wouldn't have fallen in the past." The Reincarnation Demon Lord remained indifferent to Ancestor Bing Lan's ridicule, chuckling softly instead.Tʜe source of this ᴄontent ɪs novel·fire.net
Ancestor Bing Lan's brows furrowed slightly, a faint blue light surfaced over his body, swiftly penetrating his body like flowing water, attempting to dispel the invisible curse.
The Reincarnation Demon Lord smiled faintly but did not attack Ancestor Bing Lan, raising his hand and pressing down.
From the palm of his hand, a broad blood light shot out, diving into the ground like a giant dragon.
Within a few breaths, shadowy figures flashed within the blood light, and the group of demons from the Ten Thousand Demon Country along with the Great Sun Glaze Flame all emerged.
The ice crystals covering these members of the Demon Clan had entirely vanished, and they were all intact, as if the damage they previously sustained had fully recovered.
"Your Six Paths of Reincarnation have indeed grown more formidable, not only can you use it on yourself but also let others reincarnate, it seems you won't take long to break through the Mahayana Realm," said Ancestor Bing Lan.
The Reincarnation Demon Lord dissipated the blood light at his side, remaining silent.

chapters.title: Chapter 1006 - 971: The Giant's Heart
chapters.content:
Only now did Wu Yu see the situation clearly, standing with the group of demons from Ten Thousand Demon Country beside Su Wu and Reincarnation Demon Lord.
Ancestor Bing Lan, upon witnessing this scene, glanced at Su Wu, Wu Yu, and the Great Sun Glaze Flame before finally fixing his gaze on the Reincarnation Demon Lord: "It seems this treasure hunt in the Fire Rock Desert is an alliance between the Demon World, Three Realms Sect, and Ten Thousand Demon Country. When exactly did you collude together?"
"Ancestor Bing Lan overestimates us. We merely discovered shared interests during the treasure hunt, hence the temporary alliance. After all, in this treacherous desert, having one more friend is better than having one more enemy." The Reincarnation Demon Lord chuckled and said.
Ancestor Bing Lan, upon hearing this, turned his gaze to Wu Yu, and said in a deep voice: "Ten Thousand Demon Country is still a creature of the Chuyun Realm, yet you ally so easily with the Demon World? In the first realm war a million years ago, the Sky Demon Royal Court fought fiercely against the Demon World."
"Precisely because of that war, the Sky Demon Royal Court suffered heavy losses and its power greatly diminished, while your Human Clan's cultivators continuously encroached on the survival space of Ten Thousand Demon Country. Without resistance, within ten thousand years, Ten Thousand Demon Country would inevitably perish completely." Wu Yu replied expressionlessly.
"Do you know what will happen if the Three Realms Immortal Boat falls into the hands of the Demon World?" Ancestor Bing Lan said solemnly, his complexion grave.
Upon hearing these words, everyone's hearts trembled.
They knew the Three Realms Immortal Boat had the ability to penetrate realm barriers. Once this Flying Boat fell into the hands of the Demon World, the Demon Clan could invade the Chuyun Realm anytime and anywhere, without any hindrance.
Just a moment ago, Ancestor Bing Lan had tried to use the Frost True Intent to destroy the Three Realms Immortal Boat but unfortunately failed.
Wu Yu lowered his eyes, his voice deep and resolute: "What I know is limited, but one thing is certain: without the Three Realms Immortal Boat, it's impossible to destroy the Heavenly Crane Array."
"Very good, since Ten Thousand Demon Country and the Three Realms Sect have both defected to the Demon World, they are naturally the public enemy of the Chuyun Realm." Ancestor Bing Lan said lightly.
With these words, the atmosphere instantly became extremely tense.
Once labeled as colluding with the Demon World, Ten Thousand Demon Country would become the target of the entire Chuyun Realm, and any force could come to attack.
Wu Yu's heart tightened, and he couldn't help but look at Su Wu and the Reincarnation Demon Lord.
Seeing this, Su Wu immediately said: "Her Majesty the Empress need not worry; our Three Realms Sect and the Demon World are always the most solid backing for Ten Thousand Demon Country."
The Reincarnation Demon Lord also nodded in agreement, giving Wu Yu some reassurance.
Ancestor Bing Lan suddenly laughed, a hint of mockery in his laughter: "You struggled hard, calculated in every possible way, but ultimately it was all for naught. Without the World Tree, the Three Realms Immortal Boat is like a giant without a heart, reduced to a mere heap of scrap iron. What use is it to you now that you've obtained it?"
The Reincarnation Demon Lord's expression changed drastically upon hearing this, suddenly turning to Su Wu: "The World Tree has been taken away?"
Su Wu waved his hand, feigning calmness: "Just a minor setback. The World Tree is currently in the hands of an early-stage Dharma manifestation fellow. Once we settle things here, we'll take it back."
Yet the Reincarnation Demon Lord did not relax his guard because of this, snorted coldly, gripped his long knife tightly, and his figure flashed, rushing swiftly toward Ancestor Bing Lan.
Su Wu also brandished that black longsword and said to Wu Yu and the others: "Since you are our allies, don't stand idly by."
With that, he too flew up to join the fray.
The group of demons from Ten Thousand Demon Country upon seeing this, looked one after another at Wu Yu.
Wu Yu took a deep breath, determination flashing in his eyes: "We will act too!"
With Wu Yu's command, the group of demons from Ten Thousand Demon Country surged forth like a tide.
Above the Fire Rock Desert, a fierce battle was unfolding.
Sword shadows and blade lights intertwined, spell glows flickered, and the wind in the desert seemed to become even more violent.
Meanwhile, outside this battlefield, the sky above the Chuyun Realm remained blue as ever, silently observing this fate-changing confrontation.
...
At the same time, amidst the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range stretching for tens of thousands of miles, the eighteen cities including Black Tiger City and Yin Mountain City were filled with smoke and shouts of battle echoing to the heavens.
From all directions around these cities, numerous demon clans surged, sweeping in like a tide, seemingly ready to swallow these eighteen cities whole.
And beneath the city walls, deep underground, erupted waves of shocking Demonic Qi, rolling and wildly eroding the Stone Pillar Hongjun beneath the cities, as if searching for some flaw in its power.
Since their establishment, these eighteen cities have weathered countless challenges, never facing a crisis of life and death like today.
Initially, the city lords held onto faint hope, thinking this was merely another probing attack from Ten Thousand Demon Country, not paying too much attention.
However, as the demon clan's offensive grew increasingly fierce and reckless, they finally realized the situation was far from simple.
Once they perceived the seriousness of the situation, the various city lords hurriedly contacted each other, discussing countermeasures.
After some deliberation, they decided to activate the city protective restrictions while also initiating the legendary Heavenly Crane Array.
The Heavenly Crane Array was the guard array of the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range. Once activated, it would connect the entire mountain range's Spirit Veins, forming an indestructible defensive system, greatly enhancing the cities' restricted defense strength.
Just as they were about to activate the array to obliterate the invading enemies, they were astonished to find that the array was completely unresponsive, no matter how they tried to operate it.
At this moment, they realized that the root of the problem did not lie in the Demon Clan's offensive, but in the Great Array itself.
The eighteen cities were plunged into unprecedented panic and chaos.
The City Lords were anxiously searching for the source of the problem, but to no avail. Meanwhile, the citizens were panicking, not knowing what to do.
At this life-and-death juncture, each city could only rely on its own strength, waging its own fights, cooped up behind city walls, struggling to hold on.ʀᴇᴀᴅ ʟᴀᴛᴇsᴛ ᴄʜᴀᴘᴛᴇʀs ᴀᴛ novel⦿fire.net
Above the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range, dark clouds gathered, lightning flashed and thunder roared, as if foretelling a greater disaster about to unfold.
...
In a certain place within the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range, the void gently rippled like a slight wave, and then a lofty palace appeared out of thin air, none other than the mysterious Shura Palace.
It quietly floated there, like a silent star, emitting a faint radiance.
Inside the palace, Yuan Ming flew out from the depths of the World Giant Tree, a barely concealed look of delight on his face.
Having left the constraints of the Three Realms Immortal Boat, the restrictions within the World Tree had already dissipated without a trace. Now, he could finally absorb the essence of this giant tree at will.
"With this tree, I finally have the fundamentals to establish myself."
Yuan Ming stretched out his hand, gently stroking the giant tree. The roots of the World Tree within his Dantian wriggled like Spiritual Snakes, slowly piercing into the giant tree.
Pure cyan-gray streams of energy transmitted along the tree roots, like trickling streams, continuously flowing into Yuan Ming's body.
Under the nourishment of this power, his World Tree grew rapidly, becoming increasingly robust and flourishing.
However, Yuan Ming did not continue cultivating, as there were still many things he needed to understand.
"Senior Kong, the World Tree has been settled. Now, can you tell me what exactly happened just now?"
"It's not really a big deal, just that the Three Realms Sect manipulated the Three Realms Immortal Boat to collide with the Stone Pillar Hongjun in White Emperor City," Kong said indifferently.
"Stone Pillar Hongjun?" Yuan Ming was taken aback, for he had never heard of this name before.
Kong, seeing this, explained the origin and importance of the Stone Pillar Hongjun.
"I didn't expect so many things to happen. What is the current situation in White Emperor City? Was the Stone Pillar Hongjun really struck and broken?" Yuan Ming's face couldn't help but change color, and he hurriedly asked.
"I don't know. Investigating news consumes Desire Power, and my supply of Vow Power Pills is almost exhausted. When you just left with the World Tree, I didn't continue to pay attention to the situation there. If you want to know the situation in White Emperor City, you should go and see for yourself," Kong said.
Yuan Ming, upon hearing about Kong's method of exploring the outside world for the first time, showed a slight hint of surprise.
He moved, leaving Shura Palace, transforming into a green light, heading straight for White Emperor City.
The location where Yuan Ming was currently wasn't far from White Emperor City, and it didn't take long for him to reach the destination.
The scene before him left him amazed.
The battle outside White Emperor City had already ended, and the entire city had become a complete ruin, with snow covered the ground. Traces left by intense fighting were everywhere, a total mess.
Yuan Ming hovered in midair, looking out across the countryside.
He saw two ice mountains standing in the distance, inside of which were frozen the remains of countless demon beasts from the forests. He saw a sword-scarred ravine spanning nearly a hundred miles, still faintly emitting black smoke. He also saw several deep pits with diameters of dozens of miles, similarly in complete disarray.
"It seems there was an extremely fierce battle here just now. The scale of this is beyond the power of a Dharma manifestation Realm expert..." Yuan Ming's gaze swept the surroundings, secretly astonished.
He did not forget the purpose of his visit and flew downwards to the underground of White Emperor City.
There, he saw the Stone Pillar Hongjun, which had been completely shattered.
What puzzled him was that the Three Realms Immortal Boat, which had collided with the Stone Pillar Hongjun, had disappeared, and the group of demons from the Ten Thousand Demon Country that attacked here had vanished without a trace.
Kong's figure slowly emerged from the Stealing Heaven Tripod, looked around, and clicked his tongue, saying, "So they really broke the Hongjun Pillar. This Su Wu has some tricks."
Yuan Ming stared at the broken Stone Pillar Hongjun, his gaze deep. After a moment, he looked away, scanning the surrounding ruins.
A chilling atmosphere permeated the air, as if one could still feel the intensity of the prior battle.
Suddenly, his eyes shimmered slightly, as if sensing something: "It seems there's some Demonic Qi residue here..." he murmured, releasing his Divine Sense to investigate carefully.
Not long after, a look of certainty appeared on his face.
The demonic aura fluctuations here were unusually intense, purer and stronger than anything he had sensed before.
According to his calculations, to leave behind such intense demonic aura fluctuations, it would be at least from a Demon Lord level existence, or possibly even the legendary Demon Emperor.

chapters.title: Chapter 1008 - 973: Waves Arise
chapters.content:
"Reincarnation Demon Lord!" Kong's pupils constricted slightly, evidently apprehensive about this name.
"It's just a clone. Even though it possesses the Reincarnation True Intent, its power is limited. As long as we handle it properly, it shouldn't cause too much trouble." Daoist Mu said calmly.
"I don't mind, it's your problem to worry about." Kong said, curling his lips.
"This matter indeed troubles me greatly. Right now, I need to immediately gather manpower to help, but this will take some time. The most important thing now is to activate the Heavenly Crane Array and protect the other eighteen cities in the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range. Yuan, this matter can only be entrusted to you. You only need to hold on until my people arrive. During this time, I will forbid anyone from approaching White Emperor City, so your secret won't be exposed. Once the matter is resolved, I will give you a satisfactory reward." Daoist Mu nodded, speaking with a serious expression.
Upon hearing this, Yuan Ming's heart stirred, but he immediately shook his head and refused, "Thank you for your kind intentions, Senior Mu, but I fear my limited strength might lead to a major mishap."
"Yuan, you are worried about the Stealing Heaven Tripod being coveted once exposed, aren't you? Actually, you don't need to be. Since this matter is already known to me, you can't hide it anymore. In this Chuyun Realm, no one I've set my sights on has ever managed to escape." Daoist Mu, seemingly unsurprised by his refusal, smiled and said.
Yuan Ming's heart tightened; he hadn't expected Daoist Mu to know about the existence of the Stealing Heaven Tripod!
He pondered in his heart, perhaps it was due to the Ten Thousand Wood Spirit Rhinoceros Divine Power that Senior Kong mentioned, that he was noticed right after stepping onto the Central Continent.
"Rest assured, since I promised to keep you safe, I won't go back on my word. If you agree to this, not only will I ensure your safety, but I'll also provide you with ample rewards and status." Daoist Mu continued.
Yuan Ming furrowed his brows deeply, hesitating internally.
He knew the value of the Stealing Heaven Tripod was extraordinary and once exposed, it would surely attract countless coveting eyes, but the current situation compelled him to consider the possibility of cooperating with Daoist Mu.
While he was hesitating, Kong's voice resonated in his Sea of Consciousness: "He didn't lie to you. The tracking methods of Daoist Mu are renowned among the Mahayana cultivators of the Chuyun Realm. Whoever he wants to track, unless they leave the Chuyun Realm, they absolutely cannot escape."
"Senior Kong, are you hoping I accept this?" Yuan Ming transmitted his voice in response.This update is available on n͟o͟v͟e͟l͟f͟i͟r͟e͟.net
"Exactly. Daoist Mu is mild-mannered, extremely powerful, and keeps to himself, not involving in worldly disputes. Cooperating with him will ensure your safety. Besides, aren't I still here?" Kong said in a deep voice.
Hearing this, Yuan Ming silently pondered.
The existence of the Stealing Heaven Tripod was already known to Su Wu, and it would eventually spread across the world. Connecting with Daoist Mu at this moment might not be a bad thing.
"Observing your cultivation, Yuan, it's truly extraordinary, yet you have no place to gain a foothold. The Heavenly Crane Array is the foundation of stability in the Chuyun Realm and must not be compromised. If you, my young friend, can guard it and ensure its safety, I will acknowledge your possession of the mysterious Stealing Heaven Tripod. Furthermore, I solemnly promise that the entire Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range can be yours to command, allowing you to run freely." Daoist Mu seemed to discern Yuan Ming's inner concerns, thus he continued to speak slowly.
Upon hearing this, a jolt ran through Yuan Ming's heart.
Although he hadn't been in the Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range for long, he understood the vastness and the endless potential of this place.
If he could take it under his control, it would facilitate both the cultivation of his Dharma Body and the collection of Desire Power, with benefits that were self-evident.
However, Yuan Ming also knew the responsibility and risk entailed by the promise.
Listening to the conversation between Kong and Daoist Mu, along with information previously discovered, it was evident that another great war between the Chuyun Realm and Demon World was not far off. By accepting this heavy duty, he might face unforeseen challenges and dangers.
Daoist Mu observed him deep in thought, not rushing to prompt him, but simply standing quietly by the side, waiting for his response.
The gentle breeze blew, ruffling Yuan Ming's hair and clothes, stirring the waves in his heart.
In this ancient and mysterious mountain range, he felt as if a powerful force was surging, seemingly beckoning him to face the future's challenges and opportunities.
After an indeterminate amount of time, Yuan Ming slowly raised his head, his eyes reflecting the leisurely figure of Daoist Mu.
He took a deep breath and spoke calmly, "Since Senior Mu is so gracious, it would indeed be ungrateful for me to refuse any further."
Daoist Mu's face displayed a gratified smile, "Good, good. Speaking of which, I also knew the previous owner of the Stealing Heaven Tripod."
Upon hearing this, a hint of surprise surged in Yuan Ming's heart, "You knew Senior Xia Jie?"
Immediately, his heart tightened, realizing it was not surprising for Daoist Mu, who was on good terms with Kong, to also know Senior Xia Jie.
Daoist Mu gently stroked his beard and slowly began to recount an old story, "Not only did I know him, but he also partially counted as my disciple. Years ago, when Xia Jie retrieved the Stealing Heaven Tripod from the Wentian Secret Realm, there was an extremely troublesome seal on it, and it was I who helped him break it."
Hearing Daoist Mu's narration, most of Yuan Ming's doubts dissipated, and he continued to ask, "Then how should I replace the Pillar Hongjun?"
"You only need to transform into the World Tree and deeply root into the Spirit Vein, the rest will be arranged for you." Daoist Mu smiled slightly, explaining.
Yuan Ming nodded in agreement, a thought crossed his mind, and the World Tree in his Dantian merged with his body. Soon, he transformed into a towering giant tree, its roots rapidly spreading in all directions.
The dense tree roots tightly wrapped around the fractured Pillar Hongjun, its roots deeply embedded in the earth, closely connected to the spirit veins.
Daoist Mu muttered incantations, forming seals with his hands, casting out two brilliant beams of white light, which respectively infused into the Stone Pillar and the World Tree transformed from Yuan Ming.
Instantly, Yuan Ming felt as though a thread of connection had formed between him and the Stone Pillar. The moment the roots of the World Tree connected with the spirit veins underground, rich earth vein spiritual power surged forth like a tide, flowing into the fractured Stone Pillar, illuminating each shattered rune.
In that instant, Yuan Ming felt as though he had merged with the entire Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range, an indescribable mystical sensation welled up in his heart.
Just then, a loud buzz resonated in his mind, countless sounds seemed to echo all at once beside his ears—excitement, shouting, roaring, praying, weeping... various voices intertwined, continuously assaulting his divine soul.
These voices were not unfamiliar to him; they were the emotions contained within Desire Power. Previously, these were absorbed by the Stealing Heaven Tripod, yet now they rushed toward his body, with numbers far greater than before.
Given Yuan Ming's current divine soul strength, he could not help but feel a tremor in his divine soul under this ocean-like immense Desire Power impact, mana stirred, almost incapable of maintaining his transformed state.
Yet the World Tree remained as steady as a mountain, unaffected by the Desire Power.
The transformed World Tree's internal demonic energy had completely turned a bluish-gray, losing the healing effect of the Undying Tree, the attributes of demonic energy unrecognizable.
The greatest characteristic demonstrated by this bluish-gray demonic power was extreme stability, unaffected by any spiritual power injected into it.
Because of this, it was able to remain steadfast under the impact of Desire Power.
Seeing Yuan Ming unable to withstand the Desire Power's impact, Senior Kong immediately summoned the Stealing Heaven Tripod, controlling it to fly out and enter the roots of the World Tree.
"Leave the matters outside to you," Senior Kong advised Daoist Mu, then began activating the forbidden within the Stealing Heaven Tripod, guiding the Desire Power within the earth veins.
Inside the Stealing Heaven Tripod, the White Jade Lotus Platform's light suddenly bloomed, dazzlingly radiant, array patterns flowed like water across the Tripod's surface, causing the entirety of the altar to glow brilliantly, akin to daylight.
The root of the World Tree was shrouded in a white light at this moment, the light streamed gently into the ground, connecting with the spirit veins.
In an instant, the colorful rays within the spirit veins began to move slowly, like gorgeous satin, winding around the immense body of the World Tree.
These rays were the Desire Power contained within the spirit veins, mostly absorbed under the Stealing Heaven Tripod's influence, gathering within the Tripod.
As the Desire Power decreased, the impact Yuan Ming endured also lessened considerably.
He exhaled deeply, his taut nerves relaxed slightly.
Meanwhile, Daoist Mu slowly approached the World Tree, sitting cross-legged beneath it, his posture akin to a pine tree, motionless.
A blue array pattern subtly emerged beneath him, along with an imperceptible ripple, the array pattern began emitting a vast power, unseen but felt as it continuously spread outward.
Under this power's influence, the fractured Stone Pillar seemed to establish a certain mystical connection with the World Tree.
Illusory light suddenly flared up from the Stone Pillar, gathering into a beam that soared into the sky, penetrating the ground, piercing the clouds.
At this moment, above the ruins of the entire White Emperor City, stood this dazzling light beam, seemingly becoming the new symbol of the ruins.
With the rise of the light beam, the Heavenly Crane Array resumed operation, the flow rate of the spiritual power within the underground spirit veins accelerated dozens of times instantaneously.
The previously tranquil earth veins now transformed into a massive vortex, spiritual power furiously surged within, continuously nourishing the World Tree and the Stone Pillar.
Meanwhile, thousands of miles away at Yin Mountain City, the situation had already reached a critical point.
On the city walls, several damaged holes were alarming, left by the frenzied assault of demon beasts.
On the ruins, corpses of the Human Clan and Demon Clan lay intertwined, a bloody scent pervaded the air.
Compared to the complete destruction of White Emperor City, buried beneath ruins, the slaughter at Yin Mountain City appeared more brutal and bloody.
The majority of the Demon Clan had invaded the city, slaughtering recklessly, without restraint.
Outside the city, a large number of the Demon Clan continued to charge into the city, seeking revenge for long-standing oppression and massacres.
The cultivators of Yin Mountain City suffered heavy casualties, the survivors retreated to the deepest part of the city, relying on the remaining Forbidden to fend off the attacks from demon beasts.
These Forbidden, under the successive fierce assaults of numerous demon beasts, were already extremely precarious, on the verge of collapse at any moment.

chapters.title: Chapter 1009 - 974: Hidden Dragons and Crouching Tigers
chapters.content:
At the entrance of a dilapidated palace, Yin Lang was desperately resisting the assault of more than a dozen rampaging Level 4 Flame Wolf demon beasts.
He wielded a large earth-yellow seal, each swing repelling several Flame Wolves, but the sheer number of demon beasts was overwhelming, and he could only barely hold on.
The great hall was crowded with cultivators, none of whom had high cultivation levels; the strongest was merely at the Nascent Soul Early Stage, while the rest were Core Formation Stage or even Foundation Establishment Stage.
At this moment, they all sat quietly with their eyes closed, murmuring as if praying for something.
Yin Lang knew this wasn't a sustainable solution. Although he had several life-saving items left by Yuan Ming, the followers inside the great hall were the result of his hard work these past days.
If they all perished at the hands of the demon beasts, his efforts would be wasted, and he would lose significant favor with Lord Nether Moon God.
"If worst comes to worst, I'll escape with a few promising ones..." Yin Lang secretly pondered.
His divine sense swept over the crowd inside the great hall, lingering a bit longer on a young girl in green at the Foundation Establishment Stage.
She was named "Qiu Nu," highly gifted, possessing a Wood Attribute Heavenly Spirit Root, along with a special innate ability.
Yin Lang initially planned to cultivate her to the Core Formation Stage and then present her to the Nether Moon God. Now, it seemed he must quickly take her away.
Just then, a loud roar echoed from the Yin Mountain City Lord Mansion, shaking the heavens and the earth. Even from a distance, Yin Lang felt a tremor in his mind.
"Not good! It's a Sixth-level Great Demon!" Yin Lang's heart was filled with dread, and his expression changed.
He knew the power of a Sixth-level Great Demon was far beyond their capability to withstand. If it truly charged over here, none of them would escape death.
...
Inside the Yin Mountain City Lord Mansion, the Yin Mountain City Lord, drenched in blood, stood like a war god reborn in flames, confronting a gigantic Flame Wolf covered in fiery red flames, half human and half beast.
The Flame Wolf's eyes flashed with ferocity, and it held a half-dead young man in its huge wolf-claw, its face filled with a mocking expression.
If Yuan Ming were here, he would recognize at a glance that this Sixth-level Great Demon was the notorious Flame Wolf King.
Behind the Flame Wolf King stood many similarly fierce-looking Demon Clan accomplices.
In contrast, the Yin Mountain City's side seemed quite inferior in both numbers and strength, at a severe disadvantage.
The Flame Wolf King sneered, applying force, crushing the young man's head, causing blood to splatter everywhere.
He looked at the Yin Mountain City Lord and coldly said, "You Human Clan cultivators, relying on the Heavenly Crane Array, wantonly slaughter our Demon Clan kin and plunder the resources of our Ten Thousand Demon Mountain Range. Today, you shall pay the price you deserve!"
The Yin Mountain City Lord glared angrily, shouting, "Flame Wolf King, don't push your Ten Thousand Demon Country too far! Yin Mountain City was established by the Heavenly Saint Academy. If you dare destroy it, Ancestor Bing Lan and True Monarch Tianjing will never let you off!"
"Since our Ten Thousand Demon Country dared to attack you, we naturally made thorough preparations. Old Ghost Bing Lan indeed rushed over, but we had long prepared for that, and now that old ghost is likely already dead. As for True Monarch Tianjing, you think I don't know? He was injured by the Demon Realm Yan Emperor thousands of years ago and has been recovering in the Nine Yang Tower of the Heavenly Saint Academy for years, busy dealing with his own problems." The Flame Wolf King, hearing this, laughed heartily, full of mockery.
The Yin Mountain City Lord, hearing the Flame Wolf King's confident words, though unwilling to believe, felt uneasy nonetheless.
He knew that today's battle likely promised more doom than good fortune.
At this moment, a sudden change occurred!
In the depths of Yin Mountain City, the originally silent Stone Pillar Hongjun suddenly burst with a brilliant cyan light.
The demonic qi that had been eroding the pillar was instantly suppressed the moment the cyan light appeared.
Then, a magnificent cyan light pillar shot straight into the sky, piercing into the dark clouds above.
In an instant, the entire sky began swirling rapidly, forming a massive vortex covering thousands of miles.
The cyan light pillar, like a celestial column, engulfed the entire City Lord Mansion within it.
The Yin Mountain City Lord and other Human Clan cultivators, bathed in this cyan light, not only suffered no harm but instead felt a comfortable sensation filling their bodies.
But those Demon Clan beings that charged forward found themselves struck as if by thunder upon contact with the cyan light, regardless of their strength, all were blasted away, screaming miserably.
The Flame Wolf King saw this, his expression drastically changed, and he had to halt his movement.
He felt an overwhelming power within the cyan light that filled him with dread.
As the cyan light pillar soared into the sky, the entire Yin Mountain City began to shake violently.
On the streets of the city, dazzling lights appeared, revealing the true form of a grand array formed by the layout of the entire city.
"The Heavenly Crane Array is operating..." Yin Mountain City Lord's eyes gleamed as he felt a sense of newfound hope.For more chapters visit novel~fire~net
He knew once this great array operated, it would provide them with powerful protection and counterattack capabilities.
As he spoke, the cyan light erupted from the whole city, enveloping the entire Yin Mountain City within it.
Under the shroud of this cyan light, though the city protection array of Yin Mountain City was damaged in many places, it still operated tenaciously driven by the abundant spiritual power of the Heavenly Crane Array.
In the radiance of the cyan light, the Yin Mountain City Lord could feel a pure and abundant spiritual power pouring into his body, replenishing his depleted mana and healing his injuries.
The remaining cultivators in the city who had not perished in battle were also enveloped by this force, rapidly regaining their strength.
Meanwhile, the demon clan that had charged into the city felt an invisible suppression.
This great array, formed using the layout of the entire city, seemed to repel them, pressing down so heavily they could barely breathe.
Nature's spiritual energy was greatly resistant to them, automatically avoiding the demon clan, making it impossible for them to enhance themselves using the power of the heavens and earth.
Simultaneously, the terrifying azure cloud vortex high in the sky resembled a giant beast about to awaken, its roaring thunder never ceasing, as if repressing anger long waiting to be unleashed.
All members of the demon clan at this moment felt an indescribable suppression, the fear akin to icy snakes wrapping around their souls, causing them to involuntarily tremble.
The Flame Wolf King had a contorted expression, his heart filled with pain, clearly on the verge of victory, yet the cooked duck was about to fly away.
He looked at the Heavenly Crane Array that had started operating again, a trace of unwillingness and helplessness flashing in his eyes.
He knew today's events were now irretrievable.
"Retreat..." the Flame Wolf King ordered through gritted teeth, a tone filled with anger and unwillingness.
With his command, all demon beasts surged toward the outside of the city like retreating tides, but it was already too late.
The booming sound in the sky grew louder, dazzling azure thunderbolts shot out from the vortex with precision like the fury of the heavens, striking accurately at those fleeing demon clans.
Yet those Human Clan cultivators who were just a stone's throw away from them were unharmed under this rampaging lightning.
The thunder's might was so powerful it was heart-palpitating; even a Level 4 demon beast, once struck by lightning, would instantly be charred, severely wounded, and unable to escape the fate of being struck again and killed.
The group of demons fled in panic under the lightning's assault, the scene was chaotic.
As the Human Clan cultivators caught their breath and witnessed this, their morale soared, and they rallied back into the battle, vowing to massacre the demon clan completely.
The shift in offensive and defensive stances occurred at that moment, and the demon clan within Yin Mountain City was quickly driven out, gradually restoring order within the city.
...
